groups.nuance_en: beef up: bolstering potency or defensive heft by adding resources (security / squad / server) · crank up: manually ratcheting intensity or volume to maximal levels (volume / pressure / heat) · hike: abrupt and steep artificial upward revision (prices / rates / taxes) · boost: delivering a vigorous upward propulsion or lift (morale / sales / immune system) · elevate: raising to an ethically or socially exalted plane (rank / discourse / stature)
groups.nuance_zh: beef up: 充实资源以强化战力或防御 (security / squad / server) · crank up: 调大旋钮将音量或强度拉满 (volume / pressure / heat) · hike: 陡峭大幅上调官定标准 (prices / rates / taxes) · boost: 提供强劲推力助其拔高上扬 (morale / sales / immune system) · elevate: 拔高至崇高或更尊崇的层级 (rank / discourse / stature)

groups.name: Color & Impart Pigment · 染色与着色 (Color, Dye, Tint)
groups.tip: 改变颜色或发生变色

items.def_en: To add a slight, subtle amount of color to something.
items.ex_en: The setting sun began to tinge the evening clouds with soft lavender hues.
items.ex_zh: 落日开始将傍晚的云彩微染上一层淡淡的薰衣草紫。

items.def_en: (+ sth) fill an outline or shape with colored pigment
items.ex_en: The children quietly used wax crayons to color in the detailed animal drawings.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们安静地用蜡笔给那些精致的动物线稿涂上颜色。

items.def_en: (+ sth) apply small amounts of paint or dye to correct or refresh the color of a surface
items.ex_en: She spent a few minutes touching up her makeup before the live broadcast.
items.ex_zh: 在直播开始前，她花了几分钟补了补妆。

items.def_en: To become white or cause something to become white.
items.ex_en: Heavy winter frosts white the desolate moorland under the pale morning light.
items.ex_zh: 冬日浓重的严霜在苍白的晨光中将荒芜的原野染成一片雪白。
items.ex2_en: His dark beard began to white noticeably around his temples with passing years.
items.ex2_zh: 随着岁月流逝，他两鬓附近的深色胡须开始明显变白。

items.def_en: To make or become blue; to treat fabric or metal with a blue substance.
items.ex_en: The artisans blue the tempered steel blades to protect them from coastal corrosion.
items.ex_zh: 工匠们将淬火后的钢制刀刃烤蓝，以保护其免受沿海湿气的侵蚀。
items.ex2_en: The clear summer sky blues beautifully as the morning sea mist clears away.
items.ex2_zh: 随着清晨的海雾散去，晴朗的夏日天空泛出美丽的湛蓝。

items.def_zh: 给……着色，染色；（使）变色；脸红；影响
items.def_en: 1. To give color to something, or to take on color. 2. To become red in the face with embarrassment or anger. 3. To influence something, especially in a negative way.
items.ex_en: She added a drop of natural extract to color the vanilla frosting yellow.
items.ex_zh: 她加了一滴天然提取物，把香草糖霜染成了黄色。
items.ex2_en: Her pale cheeks colored deeply with sheer embarrassment during the awkward speech.
items.ex2_zh: 在那场尴尬的演讲中，她苍白的脸颊因极度难堪而涨得通红。

items.def_zh: （使）变成褐色，（烹饪时使）呈棕黄色；晒黑
items.def_en: To become brown, or make food brown by cooking it; to become tanned from the sun.
items.ex_en: Gently brown the sliced onions in butter before adding the minced garlic.
items.ex_zh: 加入蒜末之前，先用黄油将洋葱丝轻轻煎至焦黄。
items.ex2_en: The buttered toast browns nicely within two short minutes inside the hot oven.
items.ex2_zh: 涂了黄油的吐司在热烤箱里短短两分钟就能烤得焦黄诱人。

items.def_en: (biology / technical) To color skin, tissue, or a substance with pigment.
items.ex_en: Specialized dermal cells pigment the outer scales of the rare chameleon.
items.ex_zh: 特化的真皮细胞为这种罕见变色龙的外层鳞片赋予了色素。

items.def_zh: 给……染上淡淡的颜色，微染，轻微着色
items.def_en: To give a small amount of color to something, such as hair or glass.
items.ex_en: The auto mechanic offered to tint the vehicle windows to reduce solar glare.
items.ex_zh: 汽车修理工建议给车窗贴膜微染颜色，以减少太阳眩光。

items.def_zh: 给（黑白照片或电影）上色
items.def_en: To add color to a black-and-white photograph or film using a computer or other process.
items.ex_en: Technicians worked painstakingly to colorize the rare archival footage from the First World War.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员煞费苦心地为一战时期的珍贵历史档案胶片进行上色。

items.def_en: (+ sth) cover or obscure text or an area entirely with dark pigment
items.ex_en: He blacked out for a few seconds after hitting his head on the doorframe.
items.ex_zh: 他的头撞在门框上后昏厥了数秒。

items.def_zh: 把……涂黑；（鞋油）擦亮；（使）变黑
items.def_en: 1. To make something black, especially with polish. 2. To become or cause to become black.
items.ex_en: He used a stiff brush to black his leather boots before inspection.
items.ex_zh: 在接受检阅前，他用一把硬毛刷将皮靴刷黑擦亮。
items.ex2_en: The horizon blacked ominously before the violent thunderstorm broke over the valley.
items.ex2_zh: 在猛烈的雷暴降临山谷之前，地平线不祥地黑了下来。

items.def_en: To treat a surface (such as wood or microscopic tissue) with a colored liquid to bring out its texture or details.
items.ex_en: The carpenter decided to stain the oak tabletop with a rich walnut finish.
items.ex_zh: 木匠决定用浓郁的胡桃木色着色剂给这张橡木桌面染色。

items.def_en: [I/T] To change the color of something (especially cloth or hair) permanently by soaking it in a chemical solution.
items.ex_en: She decided to dye her faded cotton curtains a vibrant forest green.
items.ex_zh: 她决定将褪色的棉质窗帘染成鲜艳的森林绿。

groups.summary_en: Deliberate causative actions whereby an agent applies dye, pigment, or tone to alter the visual coloration of an object or surface.
groups.summary_zh: 指人为通过涂敷颜料、染料等工艺手段使物体呈现或改变特定色彩的行为。
groups.desc_en: Applying or infusing an extrinsic hue or pigment onto a surface, contrasting with inherently emitting light or undergoing natural chromatic transformation.
groups.desc_zh: 通过外力将色素或特定色调施加于物体表面，区别于物体本身发光或经历自然的色泽蜕变。
groups.nuance_en: color: basic addition of hue or pigment (drawing / cheeks) · tinge: slight, subtle infusion of a secondary shade (sky / petals / gray hair) · color in: filling an outlined space completely with color (coloring book / illustration) · touch up: minor localized correction or recoloring of blemishes (roots / paintwork / photograph) · pigment: dense, deliberate biochemical or industrial coloration (skin / synthetic fibers)
groups.nuance_zh: color: 最通用的着色或上色 (drawing / cheeks) · tinge: 微量且微妙地赋予杂色或浅色 (sky / petals / gray hair) · color in: 在线框内涂满颜色 (coloring book / illustration) · touch up: 局部补色或润饰瑕疵 (roots / paintwork / photograph) · pigment: 工业或生物学层面的深入着色或沉淀色素 (skin / synthetic fibers)

groups.name: Deliberate & Ponder · 沉思与反思 (Ponder, Muse, Rethink, Introspect)
groups.tip: 由漫无边际到深刻自省

items.def_zh: 留待第二天再考虑；慢慢思量
items.def_en: (+ sth) to delay making a decision until the following day in order to think about it more carefully
items.ex_en: Do not rush into signing the lease; just sleep on the offer tonight.
items.ex_zh: 别急着签租约，今晚先好好考虑一晚再说。

items.def_en: 1. To think again about a decision, opinion, or plan, especially with the possibility of changing it.
items.ex_en: The committee respectfully urged the minister to reconsider the controversial educational reforms.
items.ex_zh: 委员会恭敬地敦促部长重新审视这项引发争议的教育改革。

items.def_zh: 重新审视，重新考虑；重访，重游
items.def_en: 1. To think about, reconsider, or examine an idea, issue, or policy again. 2. To visit a place or person again.
items.ex_en: The board agreed to revisit the quarterly budget allocation during the next session.
items.ex_zh: 董事会同意在下一次会议上重新审议季度预算分配方案。

items.def_zh: 重新思考，反思，重新考虑
items.def_en: 1. To think carefully about a plan, idea, or policy again in order to change or improve it.
items.ex_en: The sudden loss of funding forced the researchers to rethink their entire strategy.
items.ex_zh: 资金的突然断绝迫使研究人员反思并重新规划他们的整套策略。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to ponder or discuss something thoroughly over time
items.ex_en: We spent hours at the diner chewing over different business models together.
items.ex_zh: 我们在小餐馆里花了好几个小时一起推敲各种商业模式。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to think deeply and carefully about something over an extended period
items.ex_en: The retired executive took several quiet days to mull over the job offer.
items.ex_zh: 这位退休高管花了几天清静的时间仔细琢磨这份工作邀约。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to meditate on, reconsider, or think carefully about past events or decisions
items.ex_en: In her memoir, the author paused to reflect on her tumultuous early career.
items.ex_zh: 在回忆录中，作者停下笔触，反思了自己坎坷的早年职业生涯。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To meditate upon or examine one's thoughts, actions, or history
items.ex_en: Historians frequently reflect upon the profound socioeconomic consequences of the industrial revolution.
items.ex_zh: 历史学家经常反思工业革命所带来的深远社会与经济后果。

items.def_en: To think deeply and at length about something, often serenely
items.ex_en: The philosopher retreated to the tranquil monastery to contemplate the nature of existence.
items.ex_zh: 这位哲学家隐退到幽静的修道院中，沉思存在的本质。

items.def_zh: 沉思，冥想，若有所思地想
items.def_en: 1. To think carefully, quietly, and deeply about something for a period of time.
items.ex_en: The poet sat by the tranquil lake to muse upon lost youth.
items.ex_zh: 诗人坐在宁静的湖畔，若有所思地缅怀逝去的青春。

items.def_en: 1. To think about something carefully and deeply, especially before making a decision.
items.ex_en: The judicial panel retired behind closed doors to ponder the intricate legal precedent.
items.ex_zh: 司法评审团退入密室，仔细斟酌这一错综复杂的法律先例。

items.def_zh: 集思广益，头脑风暴，集体献计献策
items.def_en: 1. To hold a lively group discussion to produce ideas or find solutions to a problem quickly.
items.ex_en: The creative department gathered this morning to brainstorm effective marketing campaign slogans.
items.ex_zh: 创意部门今天上午齐聚一堂，集思广益构想有效的营销活动口号。

items.def_en: 1. To examine your own thoughts, emotions, and feelings closely.
items.ex_en: Disciplined scholars often introspect deeply to identify unconscious biases in their theoretical frameworks.
items.ex_zh: 严谨的学者常常深刻自省，以查明自身理论框架中的潜意识偏见。

items.def_en: (+ on/over) To think deeply and repeatedly about something over an extended period
items.ex_en: The despondent patient continued to ruminate on past failures despite extensive counseling.
items.ex_zh: 尽管接受了广泛的心理疏导，这位沮丧的病人仍旧反复纠结于过去的失败。

groups.summary_en: Verbs indicating deep, deliberate mental focus, weighing alternatives, reviewing past positions, or plumbing inner cognitive and emotional states.
groups.summary_zh: 指集中精力进行深入、反复或向内的理性思考与权衡检视。
groups.desc_en: Sustained, iterative mental processing or retrospection aimed at evaluating implications or modifying a decision, distinct from immediate instinctive reaction.
groups.desc_zh: 持续且反复地对某事进行心智审视或回溯评估以调整决策，区别于凭直觉做出的瞬时反应。
groups.nuance_en: reflect on: deliberate retrospection to draw deeper meaning (past / life choices / mistakes) · mull over: prolonged, unhurried weighing of options (offer / proposal / idea) · chew over: casual, thorough mental or verbal dissection (problem / scenario) · rethink: reconsidering an established stance to alter course (strategy / policy) · sleep on: deferring a decision overnight to allow subconscious clarity (decision / offer)
groups.nuance_zh: reflect on: 回溯反思以提炼深层意义 (past / life choices / mistakes) · mull over: 长时间从容斟酌权衡多种选择 (offer / proposal / idea) · chew over: 细致反复推敲或与人嚼磨 (problem / scenario) · rethink: 重新审视既定立场以做出修正 (strategy / policy) · sleep on: 将决定推迟至次日以待头脑清醒 (decision / offer)

groups.name: Desire & Crave · 渴望与追求 (Want, Crave, Yearn)
groups.tip: 从普通想要到极度渴望的欲望升级

items.def_en: 1. To desire or wish for something. 2. To need or require something. 3. (formal) To lack something.
items.ex_en: The ambitious scientific project will surely fail should it want adequate financial backing.
items.ex_zh: 这项雄心勃勃的科研项目若缺乏充足的财政支持，必然会走向失败。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to have a strong, persistent longing or appetite for something
items.ex_en: After five stressful months downtown, he really hankered after a quiet seaside cottage.
items.ex_zh: 在市中心度过焦虑的五个月后，他真渴望拥有一间宁静的海边小屋。

items.def_en: (rare) To desire eagerly or seek ambitiously.
items.ex_en: The young courtiers openly ambitioned imperial favor through reckless flattery and deceit.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的侍臣们通过肆无忌惮的谄媚与欺诈，热切谋求皇帝的恩宠。

items.def_en: (+ after/for) To have a strong, persistent desire or craving for something.
items.ex_en: Ever since he tasted authentic ramen, he has hankered for another bowl.
items.ex_zh: 自从尝过正宗拉面后，他就一直渴望再来一碗。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to feel an acute, visceral emotional longing for someone or something
items.ex_en: Exiled in a distant land, the poet ached for his beloved ancestral shores.
items.ex_zh: 流亡异国他乡，这位诗人深切思念着自己心爱的故土海岸。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to feel a strong desire, craving, or yearning for someone or something
items.ex_en: She longed for the peaceful days she had spent in the countryside.
items.ex_zh: 她十分渴望能重温曾经在乡村度过的宁静岁月。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to experience intense, aching grief or longing for someone or something missing or out of reach
items.ex_en: The solitary traveler continued to pine for the familiar comforts of home.
items.ex_zh: 孤身一人的旅者仍然苦苦思念着家中熟悉的温暖慰藉。

items.def_en: (+ for/to do) To have a strong, earnest desire or longing for something.
items.ex_en: Weary after months abroad, the foreign students longed to see their families again.
items.ex_zh: 在国外生活数月后，疲惫的留学生们渴望再次见到家人。

items.def_en: 1. (formal) To want or crave something strongly. 2. (formal) To ask for or request something.
items.ex_en: The committee respectfully desires your immediate presence at the extraordinary annual symposium.
items.ex_zh: 委员会恳请您立即莅临本次特别年度研讨会。

items.def_en: 1. (+ for/after) To have a strong craving or desire for something. 2. (archaic) To feel hungry.
items.ex_en: The young ascetic hungered after divine truth through relentless fasting and solitary meditation.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的苦修者通过不懈的禁食与独处冥想，热切渴求神圣的真理。

items.def_en: to feel an intense, overwhelming, often physical desire for something
items.ex_en: After working out in the blistering afternoon heat, I crave cold lemonade.
items.ex_zh: 在酷暑的午后锻炼后，我极度渴望喝到一杯冰柠檬水。

items.def_en: (+ for/after) to have a strong, burning desire or need for something
items.ex_en: The oppressed populace thirsted for justice beneath the shadow of tyrannical rule.
items.ex_zh: 在专制统治的阴影下，受压迫的民众极度渴求公正。

items.def_en: (+ for/to do) to feel deep, tender, or painful longing for something unattainable or distant
items.ex_en: She yearned to return to the sunlit meadows of her carefree childhood.
items.ex_zh: 她热切向往着回到自己无忧无虑的童年所拥有的阳光草甸。

items.def_en: (+ for) to yearn deeply and suffer emotionally or physically from unfulfilled desire
items.ex_en: The imprisoned knight began to pine under the torment of unending darkness.
items.ex_zh: 被囚禁的骑士在无休止的黑暗折磨中逐渐消沉憔悴。

groups.summary_en: Experiencers feel a strong internal longing or appetite for an object, state, or outcome, ranging from simple conscious wants to intense, visceral yearnings. Verbs typically take noun phrases or infinitive complements, or collocate with prepositions like 'for' or 'after'.
groups.summary_zh: 表达对特定事物或状态的情感渴望，由浅入深层层递进。
groups.desc_en: Experiencing an acute affective pull toward an absent, distant, or unattained object, contrasting with functional necessity or calm preference.
groups.desc_zh: 对缺失、遥远或尚未获得的目标产生强烈的心理渴求，区别于功能性需求或平静的偏好。
groups.nuance_en: want: basic, generic striving or volition (change / break) · long for: sustained, wistful yearning for what is distant or lost (home / peace) · crave: urgent, visceral appetite demanding immediate gratification (sweets / attention / drugs) · pine for: debilitating emotional languishing over an unrequited or lost love (ex-lover / homeland) · hanker after: persistent, restless itching for something just out of reach (adventure / luxury / recognition)
groups.nuance_zh: want: 最基础通用的主观想要或意愿 (change / break) · long for: 持续深沉、略带忧伤地渴望遥远或失去之物 (home / peace) · crave: 身体或神经本能般极度迫切的生理/心理渴求 (sweets / attention / drugs) · pine for: 因思念难以企及或失去的挚爱而憔悴萎靡 (ex-lover / homeland) · hanker after: 蠢蠢欲动、难以按捺地向往心仪之物 (adventure / luxury / recognition)

groups.name: Equip & Furnish · 装备与配具 (Equip, Fit, Outrig)
groups.tip: 配置部件以完善其功能

items.def_en: (+ sth/sb) supply a vessel, building, or person with necessary furnishings or equipment
items.ex_en: The laboratory was fitted out with the latest analytical instruments.
items.ex_zh: 该实验室配备了最先进的分析仪器。

items.def_zh: 为……配备全套装备或用具
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) supply someone or something with all the necessary clothing, tools, or equipment
items.ex_en: The guide will kit out every novice hiker with essential mountaineering equipment.
items.ex_zh: 向导会为每位初学徒步者配备全套必备的登山装备。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) equip or fit out with special gear or garments
items.ex_en: They rigged out the rescue team with heavy thermal jackets and boots.
items.ex_zh: 他们为救援队配备齐整了厚实的保暖夹克和靴子。

items.def_en: 1. To provide or equip someone or a carriage with a horse or horses.
items.ex_en: The royal quartermaster hastened to horse the vanguard before the dawn offensive.
items.ex_zh: 皇家军需官赶在黎明进攻前急忙为先锋部队配齐了战马。

items.def_zh: 给……装底，给……配底座；到达底部
items.def_en: 1. To provide or equip something with a bottom or seat. 2. (+ out) To reach the lowest point.
items.ex_en: The skilled artisan labored to bottom the antique walnut chair with rush.
items.ex_zh: 技艺精湛的工匠费力地用灯心草为那把古董胡桃木椅编装座底。

items.def_zh: 给（马）钉蹄铁；给……装护套，给……穿鞋
items.def_en: 1. To fit a horse with horseshoes, or provide someone or something with a protective shoe or covering.
items.ex_en: The blacksmith arrived early this morning to shoe the farmer's two draft horses.
items.ex_zh: 铁匠今天一大早就赶来给农夫的两匹挽马拉蹄铁。

items.def_en: 1. To dress or cover someone with a shirt.
items.ex_en: The gentle nurse shirted the shivering young orphan in soft, warm linen.
items.ex_zh: 温柔的护士给瑟瑟发抖的幼小孤儿穿上了一件柔软保暖的亚麻衬衫。

items.def_zh: 给……接线，给……安装电线；用金属丝绑扎；拍电报
items.def_en: 1. To equip a building, vehicle, or piece of equipment with electrical wires. 2. To fasten or secure something with wire. 3. To send a telegram or transfer money electronically.
items.ex_en: Electricians arrived this morning to wire the newly constructed residential complex properly.
items.ex_zh: 电工们今天上午赶来，为新建的住宅小区规范地铺设电线。

items.def_en: 1. (engineering) To fit or line a machine part with a bushing or bush.
items.ex_en: The machinist chose to bush the worn bronze casing to restore alignment.
items.ex_zh: 机械师选择给磨损的青铜外壳加装轴套，以恢复对齐状态。

items.def_zh: 给……装管；用管输送；把……装入管中
items.def_en: 1. To equip something with a tube or tubes, or insert a tube into something.
items.ex_en: Engineers plan to tube the geothermal drainage channel to preserve surrounding soil.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们计划给地热排水渠铺设管道，以保护周围的土壤。

items.def_zh: 给……配备仪器（或测量仪表）；为……配器，为……谱写管弦乐曲
items.def_en: 1. To equip a machine, vehicle, or system with measuring instruments or controls. 2. To orchestrate a piece of music.
items.ex_en: Specialists meticulously instrumented the rocket casing to monitor atmospheric pressure during flight.
items.ex_zh: 专家们在火箭外壳上精密配备了测量仪器，以监测飞行期间的大气压强。

items.def_en: (+ with/out) to fit a ship, machine, or person with necessary gear or functional equipment
items.ex_en: The sailors worked tirelessly to rig the trawler with brand-new nylon nets.
items.ex_zh: 水手们不知疲倦地工作，给拖网渔船装配上崭新的尼龙渔网。

items.def_en: (+ in/with) to encase or provide an object with a protective covering or casing
items.ex_en: Shipbuilders sheathed the vessel's lower hull in thick copper plates against barnacles.
items.ex_zh: 造船工人给船只的下层船体覆上一层厚铜板，以防止藤壶附着。

items.def_en: to equip or outfit something with protective plating or armor
items.ex_en: Engineers armored the reconnaissance vehicles with reinforced steel plates against roadside explosives.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们用强化钢板为侦察车辆加装装甲，以防御路边爆炸物。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve supplying, outfitting, or structurally reinforcing an entity with specific functional parts, protective hardware, or necessary fittings.
groups.summary_zh: 指为某物装配、加固或供应特定配件、保护件或设备。
groups.desc_en: Supplying an agent, entity, or structure with specialized implements, gear, or components for operational readiness, unlike mere spatial furnishing.
groups.desc_zh: 为行动主体、设施或空间配置专用工具、装备或构件以达到即用状态，区别于纯粹的生活化陈设布置。
groups.nuance_en: fit out: comprehensive equipping of an interior space or vessel for service (shop / vessel / apartment) · kit out: providing a person or team with full specialized gear or uniform (players / expedition / soldiers) · rig out: dressing or outfitting elaborately, often in specialized or odd attire (boat / crew / attendee) · wire: outfitting structurally with electrical or telecommunication circuitry (building / device / circuit board)
groups.nuance_zh: fit out: 对船舶或室内空间进行全套功能性装配 (shop / vessel / apartment) · kit out: 为个人或团队配齐全套专用装备或制服 (players / expedition / soldiers) · rig out: 特意装配或打扮穿戴 (boat / crew / attendee) · wire: 为建筑或设备布设电气与通信线路 (building / device / circuit board)

groups.name: Inscribe & Transcribe · 书写与记录 (Write, Jot, Scrawl)
groups.tip: 用笔墨书写或键盘打字记录

items.def_en: (+ sth) to write something down quickly and informally on paper
items.ex_en: Please jot down her phone number on this sticky note right now.
items.ex_zh: 请立刻把她的电话号码顺手记在这张便签纸上。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to write something hastily, carelessly, or untidily
items.ex_en: She had to scribble down the address quickly before the battery died.
items.ex_zh: 在手机电量耗尽之前，她不得不匆匆把地址胡乱记下。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to write notes or transcriptions of words spoken by another person
items.ex_en: The clerk will carefully take down your formal statement for official records.
items.ex_zh: 办事员会认真记下你的正式陈述，以作官方记录存档。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to record information, words, or figures in writing on a surface
items.ex_en: Make sure you write down the meeting passcode before entering the room.
items.ex_zh: 进入会议室之前，务必把会议密码写下来。

items.def_zh: 打字，用键盘键入；测定……的类型，分型
items.def_en: 1. To write or enter text using a keyboard or typewriter. 2. To identify or classify something as belonging to a particular type.
items.ex_en: The secretary can type eighty words per minute on this mechanical keyboard.
items.ex_zh: 秘书在这台机械键盘上每分钟能打八十个单词。

items.def_en: 1. To form letters, words, or symbols on a surface using a pen, pencil, or keyboard. 2. To compose a text, book, article, or piece of music. 3. To send a letter or written message to someone.
items.ex_en: Students must write their final essays using black ink on lined paper.
items.ex_zh: 学生必须用黑色墨水在横线纸上书写他们的期末论文。

items.def_zh: 写博客，在博客上发布内容
items.def_en: To write about something in a blog or online journal.
items.ex_en: She loves to blog about her budget backpacking trips across Southeast Asia every week.
items.ex_zh: 她喜欢每周在博客上分享自己游历东南亚的穷游背包客之旅。

items.def_en: To write or compose something formally using a pen or ink.
items.ex_en: In his final days, the aging poet penned a sorrowful sonnet to his muse.
items.ex_zh: 暮年的诗人在弥留之际，为他的缪斯提笔写下了一首哀婉的十四行诗。

items.def_zh: 用铅笔写（或画）；暂定，初步安排（通常与in连用）
items.def_en: 1. To write, draw, or mark something with a pencil. 2. (pencil in) To arrange or schedule something tentatively.
items.ex_en: Let's pencil in the strategy meeting for next Tuesday afternoon if that works for you.
items.ex_zh: 如果方便的话，我们暂定下周二下午开战略会议。

items.def_en: To write something by hand with a pen or pencil rather than by typing or printing.
items.ex_en: She preferred to handwrite thank-you letters rather than sending quick, impersonal emails to guests.
items.ex_zh: 她宁愿亲手给宾客写感谢信，也不愿发送匆匆且缺乏人情味的电子邮件。

items.def_en: (also 'jot down') To write a brief note or reminder quickly.
items.ex_en: Wait a second while I jot down your phone number on this sticky note.
items.ex_zh: 等我一下，我把你的电话号码随手记在这张便签上。

items.def_en: To write or draw something hastily, carelessly, and untidily.
items.ex_en: The hurried doctor scrawled an illegible prescription across the bottom of the notepad.
items.ex_zh: 匆忙的医生在便签纸底部潦草地写下一张字迹难辨的处方。

items.def_en: [I/T] To write or draw something quickly, carelessly, or untidily.
items.ex_en: Bored during the long lecture, he began to scribble aimless geometric patterns in his notebook.
items.ex_zh: 由于漫长的讲座令人厌倦，他开始在笔记本上随意乱画几何图案。

items.def_en: To write or carve words formally on a surface or in a book.
items.ex_en: The jeweler will inscribe their wedding date on the inner band of the gold ring.
items.ex_zh: 珠宝匠将把他们的结婚纪念日刻在金戒的内圈上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs describing the physical act or manner of putting text on a surface, distinguished by speed, care, medium, and degree of legibility.
groups.summary_zh: 描述将文字落于载体的书写与记录行为，依书写速度、工整度及媒介区分。
groups.desc_en: Fixing spoken thought, ephemeral text, or mental formulations into durable graphical or digital signs, contrasting with abstract composition or spoken delivery.
groups.desc_zh: 将口头语言、短时思维或零散信息落于纸面或数字化介质中保存，区别于纯粹的脑内构思或口头传达。
groups.nuance_en: write: broad generation of text on any surface (letter / report) · jot down: hasty, brief recording of transient details before forgetting (notes / address / phone number) · scribble down: rushed, careless, or messy transcription (thoughts / directions) · take down: verbatim or systematic recording of spoken words (statement / dictation / minutes) · pen: deliberate, stylistic, and formal manual authoring (novel / poem / formal reply)
groups.nuance_zh: write: 最通用的书写与文字创作 (letter / report) · jot down: 仓促、提纲挈领地记下防忘信息 (notes / address / phone number) · scribble down: 匆忙、字迹潦草地随手记下 (thoughts / directions) · take down: 现场记录或听写他人话语 (statement / dictation / minutes) · pen: 带有文人风格、郑重其事地亲手撰写 (novel / poem / formal reply)

groups.name: Metallic & Resonant Impacts · 碰撞与金属鸣响 (Clang, Clink, Jingle)
groups.tip: 金属硬物相碰发清脆声

items.def_zh: 发出叮当声，发出清脆的金属声
items.def_en: To make a light, clear ringing or metallic sound.
items.ex_en: A single drop of rain tinked against the rusted iron rim of the barrel.
items.ex_zh: 一滴雨水落在水桶生锈的铁边上，发出清脆微弱的叮当声。

items.def_en: To make or cause to make a light, high-pitched ringing sound.
items.ex_en: Wind chimes tinkled softly in the gentle evening breeze on the open balcony.
items.ex_zh: 在开敞的阳台上，风铃在轻柔的晚风中发出清脆悦耳的叮当声。
items.ex2_en: The young girl tinkled the tiny silver bicycle bell as she rode past.
items.ex2_zh: 小女孩骑车经过时，轻轻按响了小巧的银色自行车铃铛。

items.def_en: To strike against each other producing a sharp, ringing, metallic or glassy sound
items.ex_en: The champagne flutes clinked together as the wedding guests raised a warm celebratory toast.
items.ex_zh: 婚礼宾客们举杯热情祝酒，香槟杯轻脆地碰在一起。
items.ex2_en: The cheerful guests clinked their glasses together to toast the newlyweds' good fortune.
items.ex2_zh: 欢快的客人们碰杯，为新婚夫妇的美好未来祝酒。

items.def_zh: 使发出轻微叮当声；叮当作响
items.def_en: [I/T] To make or cause to make a light, ringing metallic sound (e.g. keys or coins).
items.ex_en: He nervously jingled the loose keys in his trouser pocket during the difficult interview.
items.ex_zh: 在艰难的面试过程中，他紧张地把裤兜里散落的钥匙晃得叮当作响。
items.ex2_en: Loose copper coins jingle inside his coat pocket with every quick step forward.
items.ex2_zh: 随着向前迈出的每一步，大衣口袋里零散的铜币都叮当响。

items.def_en: To produce a faint, clear, ringing sound.
items.ex_en: Far off in the quiet valley, the ghostly sheep bells tingled through the mist.
items.ex_zh: 在寂静山谷的远处，若有若无的羊铃声穿透薄雾微弱地鸣响。

items.def_zh: （使）发出叮当响声，（使）丁丁作响；填补裂缝
items.def_en: 1. To make or cause to make a light, sharp ringing sound, like glasses or coins hitting each other. 2. To fill narrow cracks or fissures.
items.ex_en: The silver coins chinked softly inside his heavy leather purse as he walked along.
items.ex_zh: 随着他前行，沉重的皮钱包里的银币发出轻微清脆的撞击声。
items.ex2_en: The bartender chinked two heavy whiskey glasses together while washing them carefully.
items.ex2_zh: 调酒师在仔细清洗两个厚重的威士忌酒杯时不慎碰出了轻响。

items.raw_cluster: 发出声响 Make Sound & Clatter
items.def_zh: （使）发出清脆的碰撞声，（使）叮当碰响
items.def_en: To make or cause to make a sharp, ringing sound, especially by touching glasses, coins, or metal objects together.
items.ex_en: They clinked their glasses of beer together and smiled across the crowded pub table.
items.ex_zh: 他们在拥挤的酒吧桌旁碰了碰啤酒杯，相视一笑。
items.ex2_en: The thick beer mugs clinked loudly as football fans cheered inside the bar.
items.ex2_zh: 当足球迷在酒吧里欢呼时，厚重的啤酒杯发出了清脆的碰撞声。

items.raw_cluster: 发出声响 Make Sound & Clatter
items.def_zh: （蒸汽机等）发出突突声，发噗噗声行驶
items.def_en: (especially of a steam engine) To move along making regular, sharp puffing sounds.
items.ex_en: The majestic old steam locomotive chuffed steadily up the steep, snow-covered mountain pass.
items.ex_zh: 那台威严的古老蒸汽机车发出有节奏的呼哧声，稳步驶上白雪皑皑的陡峭山口。

items.def_zh: （使）发出啪嗒声，（使）发出咔嗒声
items.def_en: To make or cause to make a sharp, dry sound, especially by striking hard objects together.
items.ex_en: The castanets clacked in rhythmic bursts as the dancer spun across the wooden stage.
items.ex_zh: 舞者在木制舞台上旋转，手中的响板发出阵阵清脆急促的咔嗒声。
items.ex2_en: The typist clacked the mechanical keys rapidly throughout the busy working afternoon.
items.ex2_zh: 打字员在整个忙碌的工作下午快速地敲击着机械键盘。

items.def_zh: 持续发出当啷金属巨响
items.def_en: To continuously produce loud, resonant, metallic ringing noises
items.ex_en: Down in the noisy shipyard, heavy machinery clanged away beneath the relentless midday heat.
items.ex_zh: 在嘈杂的造船厂里，重型机械在酷热的正午阳光下持续发出铿锵巨响。

items.def_zh: （使）发出当啷声，（使）发出沉重的金属撞击声
items.def_en: To make or cause to make a loud, heavy, metallic ringing sound.
items.ex_en: The heavy iron chains clanked ominously as the prison drawbridge was slowly raised.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的铁链发出不祥的当啷撞击声，监狱的吊桥被缓缓拉起。
items.ex2_en: The prison guard clanked his heavy iron keys against the sturdy steel bars.
items.ex2_zh: 狱警用沉重的铁钥匙在结实的钢条上敲得当啷作响。

items.def_en: To make or cause to make a loud, resonant metallic sound.
items.ex_en: The cathedral's bronze bell clanged loudly across the quiet town to announce the wedding.
items.ex_zh: 大教堂的铜钟在宁静的小镇上空当啷作响，宣告婚礼的举行。
items.ex2_en: The blacksmith clanged his steel hammer down heavily onto the glowing red anvil.
items.ex2_zh: 铁匠将钢锤重重地砸在泛红的铁砧上，发出清脆的当当声。

items.raw_cluster: 发出声响 Make Sound & Clatter
items.def_zh: 发出沉重的闷响；（炮弹等）轰然爆炸
items.def_en: To make a loud, heavy, dull thudding sound, especially when a heavy shell explodes.
items.ex_en: A heavy artillery shell crumped in the muddy field, throwing up wet black earth.
items.ex_zh: 一枚重炮炮弹在泥泞的田野中沉闷地轰然爆炸，掀起湿漉漉的黑土。

items.def_zh: 发出连续响亮的当啷声
items.def_en: [I/T] To make a loud, resonant, continuous metallic clanging sound.
items.ex_en: A dozen war hammers clangored against the castle gates, shattering the midnight silence.
items.ex_zh: 十几柄战锤轰然砸向城堡大门，发出震耳欲聋的连续金属撞击声，撕碎了午夜的寂静。
items.ex2_en: Workers clangored iron pipes against the concrete floor while unloading the delivery truck.
items.ex2_zh: 工人们在卸货车时将铁管砸在水泥地上，发出一阵阵巨响。

groups.summary_en: Verbs denoting sharp, resonant, or ringing acoustic emissions produced when hard objects (especially metal, glass, or stone) collide. They range from delicate, high-pitched ringing to deafening, heavy metallic impacts.
groups.summary_zh: 指硬物（尤其是金属、玻璃）碰撞发出清脆鸣响或沉重撞击声的动词，按音量与沉重度递增。
groups.desc_en: Acoustic emission of light, resonant, metallic or vitreous impact sounds, distinguishing high-frequency percussion from deep, dull percussive thuds.
groups.desc_zh: 金属或硬质玻璃等碰撞所发出的清脆、高频共鸣声响，区别于沉闷低钝的撞击声。
groups.nuance_en: clink: clear, sharp chime of hard brittle surfaces touching lightly (glasses / coins / bottles) · jingle: continuous, light metallic tinkling of loose small items rattling together (keys / coins / bells) · tinkle: delicate, high-pitched, melodic percussive ringing (bell / chandelier / laughter) · chink: thin, solitary, sharp metallic or stone contact noise (armor / coins / teacups)
groups.nuance_zh: clink: 玻璃或金属轻微碰触时短促清脆的声响 (glasses / coins / bottles) · jingle: 细小金属散件相互碰撞晃动发出的叮当声 (keys / coins / bells) · tinkle: 极其纤细、清亮悦耳的连续轻响 (bell / chandelier / laughter) · chink: 孤立而薄脆的金属或瓷器轻碰微声 (armor / coins / teacups)

groups.name: Paint & Render Techniques · 绘画与技法描摹 (Paint, Sketch, Stipple)
groups.tip: 运用彩料与画笔描绘形象

items.def_en: (+ sth) draw lines across an item to eliminate or designate it
items.ex_en: She felt a sense of relief as she crossed off the final chore today.
items.ex_zh: 当她在今天划掉最后一项杂务时，感到一阵轻松。

items.def_en: To draw lines, shapes, or pictures absentmindedly while thinking about something else.
items.ex_en: He tended to doodle silly cartoon faces on margins whenever meetings dragged on endlessly.
items.ex_zh: 每当会议没完没了时，他总喜欢在空白边缘随手涂鸦滑稽的卡通脸。

items.def_en: (+ sth) paint or draw the main areas or background color without fine detail
items.ex_en: The landscape artist blocked in the dusky purple shadows before painting any fine foliage.
items.ex_zh: 这位风景画家在绘制精细树叶前，先勾画出暗紫色的阴影大色块。

items.def_en: (+ sth) draw a rough, preliminary outline or draft of a picture
items.ex_en: She quickly sketched out the composition of the portrait on her canvas with charcoal.
items.ex_zh: 她用炭笔在画布上迅速勾勒出了这幅肖像画的构图轮廓。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make a rough, preliminary drawing without detailed shading or color
items.ex_en: He loved to sit by the riverbank and sketch the passing barges and bridges.
items.ex_zh: 他喜欢坐在河岸边，速写过往的驳船和桥梁。

items.def_en: [I/T] to shade an area of an artistic work with closely spaced parallel lines
items.ex_en: The illustrator carefully hatched the shadows beneath the marble arch to create believable depth.
items.ex_zh: 插画师在大理石拱门下方细密排线画出阴影，以营造出逼真的层次感。

items.def_zh: 用水彩画，用水彩颜料绘制
items.def_en: To paint a picture using watercolors.
items.ex_en: She spent her Sunday morning water-coloring the vibrant wild poppies in her flower garden.
items.ex_zh: 周日清晨，她用水彩描绘了花园里盛开的鲜艳野生罂粟。

items.def_en: To draw or color a picture using colored wax crayons.
items.ex_en: The toddler happily crayoned bright orange suns and green houses on the butcher paper.
items.ex_zh: 蹒跚学步的孩子兴高采烈地用蜡笔在牛皮纸上画出亮橙色的太阳和绿色的房子。

items.def_zh: 重新粉刷；重新油漆；重画
items.def_en: 1. To paint a wall, room, vehicle, or picture again.
items.ex_en: We hired professional painters to completely repaint the weathered exterior of the beach cottage.
items.ex_zh: 我们请了专业油漆工将海边小屋饱经风霜的外墙彻底重新粉刷了一遍。

items.def_en: 1. (art) To paint, draw, or engrave using thousands of tiny dots rather than solid lines.
items.ex_en: The patient printmaker stippled the shaded cheek of the nymph with countless tiny dots.
items.ex_zh: 这位耐心的版画师用无数细小的微点，点绘出宁芙面颊上的阴影。

items.def_zh: 用胶画颜料粉刷（或作画）
items.def_en: 1. (British / art) To paint walls or scenery using water-based paint mixed with glue or egg.
items.ex_en: The theatre crew distempered the rough backdrop boards to mimic an ancient stone wall.
items.ex_zh: 剧组人员用胶画颜料粉刷粗糙的背景板，以模拟古老石墙的效果。

items.def_en: 1. (art) To shade an area of a drawing or engraving with two sets of fine intersecting parallel lines.
items.ex_en: Using a fine quill pen, the engraver crosshatched deep shadows beneath the seated figure.
items.ex_zh: 雕刻师用细羽毛笔画出交叉排线，为端坐的人物下方打上浓重阴影。

items.def_en: [I/T] to shade an area with intersecting sets of parallel lines
items.ex_en: He cross-hatched the background of the etching to give the print intense dramatic contrast.
items.ex_zh: 他在蚀刻版画的背景上密布交叉平行线，使画面呈现出强烈的戏剧性反差。

items.def_en: to apply a very thin, semi-opaque layer of paint over dry paint to soften the tone
items.ex_en: The portraitist scumbled opaque white paint across the velvet dress to soften its glare.
items.ex_zh: 肖像画家在天鹅绒裙上薄薄地涂上一层不透明白漆，以柔化其反光。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe executing visual artwork by applying pigments or rendering lines through specific mediums or technical stroke patterns (such as shading, dotting, or washes).
groups.summary_zh: 指运用特定颜料媒介或笔触技法进行绘制、着色与描摹。
groups.desc_en: Executing deliberate pictorial rendering through specific medium applications, lines, or compositional blocking, distinct from utilitarian coating.
groups.desc_zh: 运用特定画具、线条或构图笔法进行造型表现，区别于工业或家居层面的大面积涂刷。
groups.nuance_en: sketch out: rapid, preliminary structural drafting of an image or concept (composition / design / idea) · block in: laying down initial broad areas of tone or mass before detail (shadows / figures / background) · doodle: absent-minded, unguided scribbling while attention is elsewhere (margins / pad) · hatch: building depth, tone, or shade using fine closely spaced parallel lines (drawing / shadow / etching)
groups.nuance_zh: sketch out: 快速勾勒构图或概念轮廓 (composition / design / idea) · block in: 细化前以大色块或基础色调起稿定型 (shadows / figures / background) · doodle: 心不在焉或开会时漫无目的涂鸦 (margins / pad) · hatch: 用密集平行的排线法表现阴影明暗 (drawing / shadow / etching)

groups.name: Shrink & Compress · 收缩与压缩 (Shrink, Shorten, Diminish)
groups.tip: 尺寸体积收缩变小或被压缩

items.def_en: (+ sth) reduce the physical size, scope, or proportion of something
items.ex_en: The architect had to scale down the building's blueprint to meet municipal budget limits.
items.ex_zh: 建筑师不得不缩小建筑蓝图的规模，以符合市政预算限制。

items.def_en: 1. (+ down) To lose body weight, or reduce the size, staff, or costs of an organization.
items.ex_en: Facing falling profits, the manufacturing conglomerate moved swiftly to slim its bloated management layer.
items.ex_zh: 面对利润下滑，这家制造集团迅速采取行动精简其臃肿的管理层。
items.ex2_en: Her slim athletic waist will slim down further after months of rigorous marathon training.
items.ex2_zh: 经过数月严格的马拉松训练，她纤细健美的腰围会进一步变瘦。

items.def_en: (+ sth) reduce a liquid's volume through heating and evaporation
items.ex_en: Simmer the fragrant beef stock gently until you boil it down to rich demiglace.
items.ex_zh: 文火慢炖香浓的牛肉高汤，直至将其浓缩成浓稠醇厚的半釉汁。
items.ex2_en: The thick tomato sauce boils down rapidly over a low burner heat setting.
items.ex2_zh: 浓稠的番茄酱在低温炉火上迅速熬浓减少。

items.def_en: recede or become physically drawn together and smaller
items.ex_en: The timid creature seemed to shrink back into the dark underbrush away from lights.
items.ex_zh: 那只胆小的动物似乎缩退回阴暗的灌木丛中，避开灯光。

items.def_en: [I/T] to decrease in size, number, or range by pulling together tightly
items.ex_en: Most metals expand when exposed to heat and contract markedly when cooled to freezing.
items.ex_zh: 大多数金属受热时会膨胀，而冷却至冰点时则会显著收缩。
items.ex2_en: Sudden freezing winter air contracts the rubber seals around the drafty exterior windows.
items.ex2_zh: 骤然冰冷的冬季空气使漏风外窗周围的橡胶密封条收缩。

items.def_en: 1. To become smaller, weaker, or less important, or to make something seem less valuable.
items.ex_en: Years of unchecked inflation have steadily diminished the purchasing power of the national currency.
items.ex_zh: 多年来未受遏制的通货膨胀，稳步削弱了该国货币的购买力。
items.ex2_en: The speaker's influence diminished steadily as newer scandals emerged across national newspapers.
items.ex2_zh: 随着全国各大报纸爆出更新的丑闻，演讲者的影响力稳步下降。

items.def_en: 1. To become smaller in size or amount, or make something smaller. 2. (+ away/from) To move back or recoil from fear or disgust.
items.ex_en: If you wash this delicate wool sweater in hot water, it will surely shrink.
items.ex_zh: 如果你用热水洗这件精致的羊毛衫，它肯定会缩水。
items.ex2_en: Boiling hot water will definitely shrink that delicate woolen shirt beyond all recognition.
items.ex2_zh: 滚烫的开水绝对会让那件精致的羊毛衫缩水到完全变形。

items.def_en: 1. To slide together into a shorter space like sections of a folding telescope, or to shorten a time period or narrative.
items.ex_en: The innovative curriculum managed to telescope three full academic years into an intense eighteen-month program.
items.ex_zh: 这一创新课程成功地将整整三学年的内容压缩进一个为期十八个月的密集项目中。
items.ex2_en: The metal passenger train cars telescoped together violently during the tragic head-on collision.
items.ex2_zh: 在悲惨的迎面相撞事故中，金属客车车厢像望远镜节一样狠狠插叠在了一起。

items.def_en: 1. To become shorter in length or duration, or to cut something to make it shorter.
items.ex_en: The tailor offered to shorten the trousers so they would fall neatly above shoes.
items.ex_zh: 裁缝主动提出把裤子截短，使其能工整地垂在鞋面上方。
items.ex2_en: Daylight hours shorten noticeably as late autumn gives way to freezing winter days.
items.ex2_zh: 随着深秋让位于严冬，白昼时间明显缩短。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make something more dense, compact, or concise
items.ex_en: The editor helped him condense his lengthy academic dissertation into a compelling journal article.
items.ex_zh: 编辑帮助他将冗长的学术论文精简成一篇引人入胜的期刊文章。
items.ex2_en: Water vapor in the humid air will condense on the cold windowpane overnight.
items.ex2_zh: 潮湿空气中的水蒸气会在冰冷的窗玻璃上凝结过夜。

items.def_zh: 收缩，缩小（shrink 的过去式）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense of shrink; became smaller or pulled back.
items.ex_en: His wool coat shrank noticeably in the wash, leaving the sleeves awkwardly above wrists.
items.ex_zh: 他的羊毛大衣在水洗后明显缩水，袖口尴尬地缩到了手腕上方。
items.ex2_en: Hot water and aggressive agitation quickly shrank my favorite cotton shirt in the wash.
items.ex2_zh: 热水和剧烈搅拌很快把我最喜欢的棉衬衫洗缩水了。

items.def_zh: 收缩，缩小（shrink 的过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. (archaic) Past participle of shrink; having become smaller or shriveled.
items.ex_en: The shrunken mummy lay undisturbed in the arid desert tomb for three thousand years.
items.ex_zh: 这具萎缩的风干古尸在干燥的沙漠墓穴中静静沉睡了三千年。
items.ex2_en: Centuries of intense arid heat had completely shrunken the ancient wooden artifact.
items.ex2_zh: 几个世纪酷烈的干燥高温彻底收缩风干了这件古代木制品。

items.def_en: 1. (technology) To design and build electronic devices or components on a much smaller scale.
items.ex_en: Engineers continue striving to miniaturize microchips without sacrificing processing speed or thermal stability.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们继续致力于在不牺牲运算速度或热稳定性的前提下，将微芯片微型化。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make or become narrower, tighter, or physically smaller by encircling pressure
items.ex_en: Cold mountain air caused the blood vessels in his fingers to constrict painfully tight.
items.ex_zh: 冰冷的山间空气致使他手指上的血管剧烈收缩，带来阵阵刺痛。
items.ex2_en: The giant boa constrictor tightened its coils to constrict the struggling animal.
items.ex2_zh: 巨大的红尾蚺收紧躯干，紧紧勒住挣扎的动物。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical or conceptual reduction in dimensions, volume, or overall scale through contraction, folding, or progressive loss.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体或概念在体积、长度或规模上发生收缩、压缩或递减。
groups.desc_en: Reducing physical dimensions, spatial volume, or scope through intrinsic contraction or intentional condensation, contrasting with external cutting or truncation.
groups.desc_zh: 物理尺寸、体量或广度发生自我收缩或浓缩提炼，区别于直接从外部进行物理裁切或截断。
groups.nuance_en: shrink: spontaneous reduction in size from moisture, temperature, or fear (wool / tumor / budget) · contract: systemic structural narrowing or formal tightening under physical/economic forces (muscles / economy / metals) · boil down: aggressive extraction and reduction to essential core elements (argument / liquid / report) · scale down: systematic, planned proportional reduction of scope (operations / production / ambition) · telescope: sliding or collapsing sequentially into a shorter compact form (sections / timeline / mechanism)
groups.nuance_zh: shrink: 因受潮、受热或情绪而自然缩水、退缩 (wool / tumor / budget) · contract: 物理或宏观机制下的规律性收紧收缩 (muscles / economy / metals) · boil down: 蒸发浓缩或提炼至核心要点 (argument / liquid / report) · scale down: 有计划、成比例地削减规模或投入 (operations / production / ambition) · telescope: 像望远镜节段般套叠压缩或压缩时间线 (sections / timeline / mechanism)

groups.name: Soil & Contaminate · 污染与弄脏 (Soil, Stain, Befoul)
groups.tip: 因泥土污渍等破坏原本洁净

items.def_en: (+ sth) make something dirty, unkempt, or stained
items.ex_en: Don't mess up your new dress by rolling around on the dusty lawn outside.
items.ex_zh: 别在外面灰尘扑扑的草坪上打滚，免得弄脏你的新裙子。

items.def_zh: 玷污，弄脏；（被）染上污渍；给……着色（染色）
items.def_en: 1. To leave a mark on something that is difficult to remove, or to become marked in this way. 2. To color wood, glass, or cloth using a special liquid.
items.ex_en: Be careful with that glass of red wine, or it will stain the carpet.
items.ex_zh: 小心端着那杯红酒，否则会把地毯弄脏留下污渍。

items.def_en: To cover, soil, or plaster something with mud.
items.ex_en: The wild stallion mudded its flanks to protect against biting insects during the drought.
items.ex_zh: 在旱季，野马用泥巴涂抹身体两侧，以防御叮人的昆虫。

items.def_zh: 用粘性污垢堵塞或弄脏
items.def_en: (+ sth) foul, clog, or contaminate a mechanism with sticky residue
items.ex_en: Cheap, inferior lubricants will eventually gum up the delicate gears of this precision timepiece.
items.ex_zh: 廉价劣质的润滑油最终会用黏性油垢堵塞这只精密钟表的细小齿轮。

items.def_en: (+ sth) make something filthy, soiled, or muddy
items.ex_en: Take off your muddy boots before you muck up the clean kitchen floor again.
items.ex_zh: 脱掉你的泥靴子，别又把干净的厨房地板搞得满是污泥。

items.def_zh: 弄脏，搞脏；变脏；玷污，败坏（名誉）
items.def_en: 1. To make something dirty, or to become dirty. 2. To damage someone's reputation; dishonor.
items.ex_en: The corrupt politician refused to soil his family name with illicit campaign contributions.
items.ex_zh: 这位腐败的政客不愿因非法的竞选捐款而玷污自己的家族声誉。
items.ex2_en: Light-colored satin dresses easily soil when worn outdoors in wet muddy weather.
items.ex2_zh: 浅色缎面连衣裙在潮湿泥泞的天气穿到户外时很容易弄脏。

items.def_zh: 使沾上泥，弄脏；使（水等）变浑浊；使（局势或问题）复杂化
items.def_en: 1. To make something dirty with mud, or to make liquid cloudy. 2. ('muddy the waters') To make an issue or situation more complicated and difficult to understand.
items.ex_en: Heavy trucks muddied the dirt road until passenger cars could no longer pass safely.
items.ex_zh: 重型卡车把泥土路弄得泥泞不堪，以致客车已无法安全通行。

items.def_zh: 使积满污垢，使蒙上灰垢
items.def_en: To cover or soil deeply with dirt or soot.
items.ex_en: Decades of industrial smoke had grimed the cathedral's ornate stone facade in deep soot.
items.ex_zh: 数十年的工业浓烟让大教堂华丽的石雕外墙深积了厚厚的黑垢。

items.def_en: To spoil or mar the purity or cleanliness of something physically or morally.
items.ex_en: No scandal could sully the pristine reputation of the selfless village doctor.
items.ex_zh: 任何丑闻都无法玷污这位无私乡村医生的清白声誉。

items.def_en: (archaic or dialect) To blacken or begrime with soot or coal dust.
items.ex_en: The chimney sweep’s pale face was thoroughly collied by heavy coal dust and soot.
items.ex_zh: 扫烟囱工苍白的面孔全被厚重的煤尘和烟灰熏得漆黑一片。

items.def_en: [I/T] To make dirty, polluted, or smelly, especially water or pipes.
items.ex_en: Grease and kitchen waste will foul the municipal drainage pipes if poured down sinks.
items.ex_zh: 油脂和厨余垃圾若直接倒入水槽，就会弄脏并堵塞市政排水管道。
items.ex2_en: The clean mountain stream began to foul when raw industrial sewage entered.
items.ex2_zh: 当未经处理的工业污水排入时，清澈的山间溪流开始变脏变臭。

items.def_en: 1. To make air, water, or land dirty and dangerous with chemicals or waste. 2. To destroy the purity or sanctity of something; corrupt.
items.ex_en: Industrial facilities along the river continue to pollute drinking water supplies for local communities.
items.ex_zh: 沿河的工业设施持续污染当地社区的饮用水供应水源。

items.def_en: (formal or literary) To make something dirty, foul, or impure; to tarnish.
items.ex_en: Crude oil spills befouled the coastal wetlands, killing countless seabirds and delicate marine plants.
items.ex_zh: 原油泄漏严重污染了沿海湿地，造成无数海鸟和娇嫩的海洋植物死亡。

items.def_en: To make a substance or environment impure or poisonous by introducing unwanted matter.
items.ex_en: Leaking underground fuel storage tanks will inevitably contaminate the local shallow aquifer over time.
items.ex_zh: 久而久之，渗漏的地下燃料储存罐必将污染当地的浅层地下含水层。

groups.summary_en: Verbs describing the degradation of cleanliness, purity, or physical integrity of a surface, medium, or substance by coating, soaking, or introducing foul matter.
groups.summary_zh: 指以泥垢、污渍、杂质或废料使物体表面或环境遭到玷污、污染或腐化变质。
groups.desc_en: Tainting an otherwise clean surface or medium with dirt, viscous grime, or impurities, distinct from chemical destruction or structural breakage.
groups.desc_zh: 以污垢、黏稠附着物或杂质破坏表面洁净度或纯度，区别于化学性腐蚀或结构破坏。
groups.nuance_en: soil: superficial smudging with earth, bodily waste, or moral blemish (clothes / hands / reputation) · stain: deep, disfiguring chromatic penetration that resists cleaning (shirt / carpet / teeth) · muddy: clouding or coating heavily with wet dirt or ambiguity (waters / water / boots) · grime: encrusting gradually with stubborn, greasy film or soot (windows / collar / walls) · gum up: clogging smooth function with sticky, viscous matter (works / mechanism / printer)
groups.nuance_zh: soil: 表面沾染泥土、排泄物或名誉受损 (clothes / hands / reputation) · stain: 色素深层渗透、留下顽固印记 (shirt / carpet / teeth) · muddy: 被泥浆涂裹或使液体浑浊 (waters / water / boots) · grime: 长期积攒顽固的油垢或煤灰 (windows / collar / walls) · gum up: 被黏稠物质堵塞卡死以致无法运转 (works / mechanism / printer)

groups.name: Speak to Roar · 发声与呼吼 (Say, Shout, Bellow)
groups.tip: 从日常说话到高声吼叫

items.def_zh: 宣告，宣判；正式声明；发音，读（音）
items.def_en: 1. To officially or formally announce or declare a decision or judgment. 2. To make the sound of a word or letter.
items.ex_en: The presiding judge will pronounce the final verdict tomorrow morning at ten o'clock sharp.
items.ex_zh: 主审法官将于明早整十点正式宣判最终裁决。

items.def_en: to make a sound with your voice, or say something aloud
items.ex_en: The defendant refused to utter a single word during the entire cross-examination.
items.ex_zh: 被告在整个交叉盘问过程中拒绝说出一言半语。

items.def_en: (+ to sb) speak or utter sth in a raised voice to attract attention
items.ex_en: She called out to him across the crowded terminal, but he did not hear.
items.ex_zh: 她在拥挤的航站楼里大声呼喊他，但他并没有听见。

items.def_en: To utter words in order to communicate thoughts, opinions, or information.
items.ex_en: Please listen carefully to what the instructor has to say about lab safety.
items.ex_zh: 请仔细听讲师就实验室安全所要表达的内容。

items.def_zh: 说，讲（say的过去式与过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of say; to utter words or express in speech.
items.ex_en: The manager said that all quarterly performance reports must be submitted before Friday.
items.ex_zh: 经理说所有季度绩效报告必须在周五之前提交。

items.def_zh: 滔滔不绝地讲；高谈阔论；（尤指为推销而）极力兜售
items.def_en: To speak rapidly, fluently, and at length, especially in a rehearsed way to persuade someone.
items.ex_en: The salesman spattered us with a fast spiel about high investment returns.
items.ex_zh: 那个推销员极力兜售，向我们滔滔不绝地吹嘘高额投资回报。

items.def_en: make a loud exclamation or shout because of pain, fear, or surprise
items.ex_en: He cried out in sudden agony when the heavy crate fell on his foot.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的板条箱砸在他脚上时，他疼得猛然大声叫喊起来。

items.def_en: (+ sth) say or express sth in a loud, clear, forceful voice
items.ex_en: He couldn't resist shouting out the answer before the teacher called his name.
items.ex_zh: 老师还没点他的名字，他就忍不住大声喊出了答案。

items.def_en: To say something in a very loud voice, or to utter a loud cry from anger, pain, or excitement.
items.ex_en: The coach had to shout across the noisy field so everyone could hear.
items.ex_zh: 教练不得不在嘈杂的球场上大声喊叫，好让每个人都能听见。

items.def_en: [I/T] to shout something loudly, especially when excited, angry, or in pain
items.ex_en: Frustrated by the constant delays, the angry customer began to yell at staff.
items.ex_zh: 由于接连不断的延误感到沮丧，愤怒的顾客开始对工作人员大声吼叫。

items.def_zh: 自以为是地发表意见，武断地高谈阔论；执行教皇职务
items.def_en: To speak or express opinions in a pompous, dogmatic, and self-important manner.
items.ex_en: The professor loved to pontificate about economic policy without offering any workable solutions.
items.ex_zh: 这位教授喜欢自以为是地就经济政策高谈阔论，却提不出任何切实可行的解决方案。

items.def_en: (+ sth) shout, sing, or roar sth in a very loud, deep, resonant voice
items.ex_en: The drill sergeant bellowed out commands that echoed across the entire parade ground.
items.ex_zh: 训练军士怒吼出指令，声音在整个阅兵场上回荡。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make a very loud, deep, prolonged sound with your voice
items.ex_en: The crowd began to roar as the home team scored the winning goal.
items.ex_zh: 主队攻入制胜一球时，全场观众开始放声咆哮欢呼。

items.def_zh: 怒吼，大声吼叫；怒声喝道
items.def_en: To shout in a deep, loud, and angry voice; to roar loudly.
items.ex_en: The furious foreman began to bellow at the workers for their careless mistake.
items.ex_zh: 怒不可遏的领班因工人们犯下粗心的错误而对他们大声吼叫。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame cover vocal production across a scale of acoustic and rhetorical intensity, ranging from standard verbalization through pompous speech to loud, resonant shouting.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖从普通言语表达、高谈阔论到雷鸣般怒吼呼喊的声强递进过程。
groups.desc_en: Vocal acoustic articulation scaled across loudness and emotional urgency, ranging from bare phonetic phonation to thunderous explosive projection.
groups.desc_zh: 发音器官在响度与情绪张力上的层级释放，涵盖从纯粹发音到震耳欲聋的高声咆哮。
groups.nuance_en: utter: minimally emitting an articulate sound or word from the mouth (sigh / word / warning) · pronounce: deliberately shaping audible phonetic sounds or authoritative decrees (words / sentence / name) · call out: pitching the voice loudly across distance to summon or challenge (name / answer / guard) · shout out: sudden, loud, uninhibited vocal burst to project excitement or warning (warning / answer / encouragement) · cry out: involuntary, piercing vocal projection driven by acute agony or panic (in pain / for help / in terror)
groups.nuance_zh: utter: 最低限度地吐出声音、叹息或只言片语 (sigh / word / warning) · pronounce: 清晰准确地读出音节或庄严宣告 (words / sentence / name) · call out: 提高音量向远处喊话、点名或叫唤 (name / answer / guard) · shout out: 抑制不住、高声叫嚷以引起注意或警告 (warning / answer / encouragement) · cry out: 因极端痛苦或恐惧发出的凄厉惊呼 (in pain / for help / in terror)

groups.name: Adjust & Calibrate · 调节与校准 (Fine-tune, Regulate, Calibrate)
groups.tip: 按标尺旋钮微调至标准状态

items.def_en: (+ sth to sth) adjust, design, or regulate parameters to suit a specific purpose
items.ex_en: The training program was geared to meet the strict demands of modern industry.
items.ex_zh: 该培训项目经过精心调整，以适应现代工业的严苛需求。

items.def_zh: 调音；调试检修（引擎或仪器）
items.def_en: (+ sth) adjust an engine, instrument, or machine to proper working order
items.ex_en: The mechanic will tune up the sports car before next week's track race.
items.ex_zh: 技工将在下周的赛道比赛前对这辆跑车进行调试检修。

items.def_zh: 调整，微调（机器或引擎等）；为（乐器）调音；调谐（收音机频率）
items.def_en: 1. To adjust an engine, machine, or system so that it operates at peak performance. 2. To adjust a musical instrument so that it produces the correct pitch.
items.ex_en: The concert pianist carefully tuned the strings to ensure flawless acoustic performance.
items.ex_zh: 音乐会钢琴师仔细为琴弦调音，以确保无瑕的声音表现。

items.def_zh: 调节，调整，微调；适应，习惯
items.def_en: 1. To change or move something slightly to achieve a desired fit, appearance, or functioning. 2. (+ to) To adapt to a new situation or condition.
items.ex_en: She had to adjust the microscope lens slightly to bring the cells into focus.
items.ex_zh: 她不得不微调显微镜镜头，使细胞成像清晰对焦。
items.ex2_en: Her eyes took several minutes to adjust to the pitch-black cave surroundings.
items.ex2_zh: 她的眼睛花了好几分钟才适应漆黑的洞穴环境。

items.def_en: to make slight changes to a machine, system, or plan to improve it
items.ex_en: We just need to tweak the design slightly before launching the product.
items.ex_zh: 在发布产品之前，我们只需要对设计稍作微调即可。

items.def_zh: 调节，调整（音量、语气或程度）；【电】调制；【音】（使）转调
items.def_en: 1. To adjust or control the tone, volume, or intensity of something. 2. To alter the frequency or amplitude of a carrier wave; to transition from one musical key to another.
items.ex_en: The skilled diplomat carefully modulated his tone to avoid escalating the tense conflict.
items.ex_zh: 这位经验丰富的外交官谨慎地调整语气，以避免加剧紧张的冲突。
items.ex2_en: The gentle melody modulated smoothly from major to minor keys during the bridge.
items.ex2_zh: 温柔的旋律在过渡段平稳地从大调转为小调。

items.def_zh: 重新调整，微调；重新适应
items.def_en: 1. To adjust something again or to a new position. 2. (+ to) To adapt yourself to new conditions or changes.
items.ex_en: He paused to readjust the rearview mirror before merging onto the busy highway.
items.ex_zh: 在并入繁忙的高速公路前，他停下来重新调整了后视镜。
items.ex2_en: After moving abroad, she slowly readjusted to the completely unfamiliar daily routines.
items.ex2_zh: 移居国外后，她慢慢重新适应了完全陌生的日常生活规律。

items.def_zh: 调整……的大小（尤指计算机窗口、图像或衣物）
items.def_en: To change the physical or digital dimensions of an image, window, or garment.
items.ex_en: Please resize the header image so that the web page loads much faster.
items.ex_zh: 请调整横幅图片的大小，以便网页加载得更快。

items.def_zh: 精准校准；调节到最佳状态
items.def_en: (+ sth) fine-tune settings or operational parameters to achieve precise accuracy
items.ex_en: The audio engineer took hours to dial in the perfect sound settings.
items.ex_zh: 音频工程师花了数小时才把声音设置精准调节到最佳状态。

items.def_zh: 调整……以适应，使适合于 (gear to/towards)；给……装上齿轮
items.def_en: (+ to/towards) To adjust, adapt, or design something so that it is suitable for a particular purpose or person.
items.ex_en: The new curriculum is geared towards students with minimal prior technical experience.
items.ex_zh: 新课程经过专门设计，旨在适应此前几乎没有技术经验的学生。

items.def_en: to control the speed, temperature, pressure, or volume of a mechanism
items.ex_en: The automated thermostat is designed to regulate indoor temperatures throughout the severe winter.
items.ex_zh: 该自动恒温器旨在严冬期间调节和控制室内温度。

items.def_en: to make very small adjustments to something in order to achieve the best possible result
items.ex_en: The software engineers worked late to fine-tune the algorithm for optimal speed.
items.ex_zh: 软件工程师加班加点对算法进行微调，以实现最佳运行速度。

items.def_en: to mark units of measurement on an instrument or adjust it so that it gives accurate readings
items.ex_en: The astronomer paused to calibrate the delicate brass telescope beneath the velvet sky.
items.ex_zh: 天文学家在天鹅绒般的夜空下停下脚步，校准那架精致的黄铜望远镜。

groups.summary_en: An agent modifies the settings, dimensions, frequency, or operational parameters of a mechanism, instrument, or system to achieve optimal performance, accuracy, or suitability. Nuances range from delicate musical/mechanical adjustments to systematic technical calibration.
groups.summary_zh: 对装置、参数或系统进行微调、校准或适配以达最佳状态。
groups.desc_en: Altering mechanical, spatial, or operational parameters by small margins to achieve optimal fitness or harmony, distinct from radical overhaul.
groups.desc_zh: 对机械、空间或运行参数进行小幅精细修正以达到最佳匹配或工作状态，区别于推倒重建。
groups.nuance_en: adjust: general modification to fit requirements or settle position (straps / mirror / thermostat) · tweak: tiny, expert modification to optimize performance or fix a glitch (settings / code / engine) · fine-tune: meticulous, micro-level calibration for perfect balance (model / instrument / strategy) · modulate: shifting pitch, volume, or biological/electrical intensity within limits (voice / frequency / immune response) · gear to: purposefully aligning or designing something for a specific audience or purpose (needs / market / demands)
groups.nuance_zh: adjust: 最通用的调节、校对位置或参数 (straps / mirror / thermostat) · tweak: 针对细节或瑕疵进行微调使其更顺畅 (settings / code / engine) · fine-tune: 精雕细琢般的微量校准以达极致平衡 (model / instrument / strategy) · modulate: 在一定范围内调节语调、频率或生理反应 (voice / frequency / immune response) · gear to: 使系统或方案专门匹配特定需求或对象 (needs / market / demands)

groups.name: Attract & Captivate · 吸引与魅惑 (Attract, Charm, Enchant)
groups.tip: 以魅力、诱惑等不同方式吸引关注

items.def_en: (+ sb) capture someone's interest or admiration and bring them closer
items.ex_en: The novel's compelling opening chapter immediately drew in thousands of eager readers.
items.ex_zh: 这部小说引人入胜的开篇第一章立即吸引了成千上万热切的读者。

items.def_en: (+ sb) attract large numbers of interested people or spectators
items.ex_en: The spectacular weekend air show pulled in huge crowds from across the region.
items.ex_zh: 周末精彩绝伦的航空展吸引了来自整个地区的大批观众。

items.def_en: (+ sb) gain someone's favor, affection, or captivated support
items.ex_en: His witty presentation helped win over even the most skeptical investors.
items.ex_zh: 他机智风趣的演说赢得了哪怕是最持怀疑态度的投资者的支持。

items.def_en: 1. To attract someone's attention and arouse their curiosity.
items.ex_en: The documentary on deep-sea marine life failed to interest the restless children.
items.ex_zh: 这部关于深海海洋生物的纪录片未能引起坐立不安的孩子们的兴趣。

items.def_zh: 吸引，引起（兴趣或注意）；招引，诱发
items.def_en: 1. To pull or draw someone or something towards oneself by particular qualities, forces, or actions.
items.ex_en: The historic botanical garden attracts visitors with its rare collection of exotic orchids.
items.ex_zh: 这座历史悠久的植物园凭借其珍稀的奇异兰花品种吸引了众多游客。

items.def_zh: 迷住，使陶醉，吸引；施魔法于
items.def_en: 1. To attract and delight someone through personal charm or pleasing qualities. 2. To affect or influence by using magic spells.
items.ex_en: His effortless wit and gentle manners never failed to charm dinner party guests.
items.ex_zh: 他自然的幽默和温和的举止总能迷住晚宴上的宾客。

items.def_zh: 激起……的好奇心（或兴趣）；密谋，搞阴谋
items.def_en: 1. To arouse someone's curiosity and interest by being unusual or mysterious. 2. (+ with/against) To make secret and dishonest plans.
items.ex_en: The mysterious coded letters found in the attic greatly intrigued the amateur detective.
items.ex_zh: 阁楼里发现的神秘密码信极大地激起了这位业余侦探的好奇心。

items.def_en: to powerfully attract or entice someone, often with a mysterious or seductive quality
items.ex_en: The forbidden beauty of the misty valley allured the wanderer deeper inside.
items.ex_zh: 雾霭笼罩的山谷那摄人心魄的幽美，引诱着漫游者步步深入。

items.def_en: 1. (often passive) To fill someone with wonder, delight, and fascination.
items.ex_en: The singer's hauntingly ethereal voice seemed to entrance the entire midnight audience.
items.ex_zh: 那位歌手空灵凄美的嗓音仿佛让午夜的全场观众都听得出神入迷。

items.def_zh: 使入迷，使陶醉；施魔法于
items.def_en: 1. To delight and fascinate someone completely. 2. (literary) To put a magical spell on someone or something.
items.ex_en: The moonlit garden seemed to enchant everyone who stepped beneath its fragrant boughs.
items.ex_zh: 月光下的花园仿佛施了魔法，让每一个漫步其芬芳枝桠下的人都为之陶醉。

items.def_en: to hold the complete attention and interest of someone by being extraordinarily charming or attractive
items.ex_en: Her expressive performance on stage managed to captivate the audience from the start.
items.ex_zh: 她在舞台上富有感染力的表演从一开始就深深迷住了观众。

items.def_en: to charm or enchant someone, sometimes in a deceptive or deeply engrossing way
items.ex_en: The charismatic stranger managed to beguile the townsfolk with his honeyed promises.
items.ex_zh: 那位富有魅力的陌生人用甜蜜的诺言彻底迷惑了镇上的居民。

items.def_en: to hold someone's attention so completely that they cannot look away or think of anything else
items.ex_en: The rhythmic dance of the ocean waves seemed to mesmerize the lonely onlooker.
items.ex_zh: 海浪富有节奏的起伏舞动似乎让那位孤独的旁观者看得入神发呆。

groups.summary_en: An entity or quality captures someone's attention, curiosity, or emotional affection through pleasing or magical appeal. Verbs scale from mild curiosity and polite attraction up to spellbound, overpowering captivation.
groups.summary_zh: 某人或事物凭借特质唤起他人的兴趣、好感或使其着迷沉醉。
groups.desc_en: Exerting a psychological, aesthetic, or interpersonal gravitational pull that captures attention, distinct from physical dragging or overt coercion.
groups.desc_zh: 凭借心理、美学或人际吸引力诱发关注或好感，区别于机械性的物理拖拽或武力胁迫。
groups.nuance_en: attract: generic exertive power drawing attention or interest (visitors / investment / attention) · charm: delighting and disarming through pleasing manners, wit, or grace (audience / hosts / voters) · allure: enticing by projecting mysterious, sensual, or lucrative promise (customers / travelers / investors) · intrigue: seizing interest through curiosity, secrecy, or novelty (scientists / readers / minds) · win over: gradually converting skepticism into active loyalty or agreement (critics / crowd / voters)
groups.nuance_zh: attract: 最通用的引起注意、吸引兴趣或投资 (visitors / investment / attention) · charm: 凭借讨喜的举止、谈吐令人折服与卸下防备 (audience / hosts / voters) · allure: 以诱惑、神秘或潜在巨利诱人深入 (customers / travelers / investors) · intrigue: 凭借悬念、新奇感强烈激发好奇心 (scientists / readers / minds) · win over: 逐步化解疑虑争取到他人的支持与信任 (critics / crowd / voters)

groups.name: Bodily Fluids Discharge · 分泌与排出 (Secrete, Excrete, Discharge)
groups.tip: 分泌乳汁或向体外排泄废物

items.def_en: (of bodily fluids) discharge slowly through pores, cuts, or small openings
items.ex_en: Thick yellow fluid began to ooze out slowly from the infected scrape.
items.ex_zh: 浓稠的发黄液体开始从受感染的擦伤处慢慢渗出。

items.def_en: (of blood or fluids) leak slowly out from biological tissues
items.ex_en: A steady trickle of blood continued to seep out through the porous bandage.
items.ex_zh: 一股持续的细小血流继续从透气的绷带间缓缓渗出。

items.def_en: discharge a massive or fatal amount of blood from the body
items.ex_en: Without immediate medical intervention, the wounded soldier would quickly bleed out completely.
items.ex_zh: 如果没有及时的医疗救治，那名受伤的士兵很快就会因大量失血而丧命。

items.def_en: to let saliva dribble uncontrollably from the mouth
items.ex_en: The hungry puppy began to drool all over the kitchen floor at dinner.
items.ex_zh: 晚餐时，饥饿的小狗开始在厨房地板上到处流口水。

items.def_en: [I/T] to slowly seep or discharge a thick liquid through pores or small openings
items.ex_en: Sticky resin began to ooze through the fresh cut in the pine bark.
items.ex_zh: 黏稠的树脂开始从松树皮的新切口中慢慢渗出。
items.ex2_en: The injured pine tree oozed fragrant amber resin all over the fallen needles.
items.ex2_zh: 受损的松树将芬芳的琥珀色树脂渗落得满地松针都是。

items.def_en: to produce and release a substance from a gland or cell into the body or outside
items.ex_en: Specialized endocrine glands secrete essential hormones directly into the human bloodstream.
items.ex_zh: 特化的内分泌腺将至关重要的激素直接分泌到人体血液中。

items.def_en: (of a female mammal) to produce milk to feed babies or young animals.
items.ex_en: The mother cow will lactate for several months after giving birth to calves.
items.ex_zh: 母牛在产下牛犊后会持续分泌乳汁数月。

items.def_en: to discharge or eliminate waste matter from the body.
items.ex_en: Healthy kidneys work continuously to filter blood and excrete toxic metabolic waste products.
items.ex_zh: 健康的肾脏持续工作，以过滤血液并排泄有毒的代谢废物。

items.def_zh: 射精，射出；脱口而出，猛然喊出
items.def_en: 1. (physiology) To eject semen from the penis at orgasm. 2. (literary) To say or shout something suddenly.
items.ex_en: "Great heavens, look at the fire!" ejaculated the startled night watchman.
items.ex_zh: “天哪，快看起火了！”受惊的守夜人失声惊呼道。

items.def_en: to produce saliva, especially in anticipation of food
items.ex_en: The dogs began to salivate profusely as the aroma of roasted meat filled.
items.ex_zh: 当烤肉的香气弥漫开来时，猎犬们开始大量分泌唾液。

items.def_zh: 流口水，淌口水；（对……）过分谄媚，肉麻地表示喜爱
items.def_en: 1. To let saliva run or drip carelessly from the mouth. 2. (+ over) To show excessive or messy affection toward someone.
items.ex_en: The excited puppy began to slobber messy saliva all over my clean jeans.
items.ex_zh: 那只兴奋的小狗开始把脏兮兮的口水蹭得我整条干净牛仔裤都是。

items.def_en: 1. (physiology) When a woman or girl menstruates, blood and tissue flow from her uterus roughly once a month.
items.ex_en: Most adolescent girls begin to menstruate between the ages of twelve and fourteen.
items.ex_zh: 大多数青春期女孩在十二至十四岁之间开始行经。

items.def_en: 1. (formal) To sweat through the pores of your skin because of heat, exercise, or nervousness.
items.ex_en: Athletes tend to perspire heavily during high-intensity training sessions in warm climates.
items.ex_zh: 在温暖气候下进行高强度训练时，运动员往往会大量出汗。

groups.summary_en: Biological organisms produce, release, or expel natural fluids or waste from internal glands and tissues into the external environment. Verbs range from neutral physiological terms to informal or involuntary secretions.
groups.summary_zh: 生物体通过腺体或器官向外自然分泌、排出体液或代谢废物。
groups.desc_en: Physiological or internal fluid emission filtering out from living tissues or vessels, contrasting with high-velocity ballistic spurting.
groups.desc_zh: 有机体内体液从组织、腺体或破损血管中析出或排出，区别于高压高速的喷射。
groups.nuance_en: secrete: purposeful biological synthesis and release of specialized fluids (hormones / saliva / enzymes) · excrete: physiological elimination of waste by-products from the body (toxins / sweat / waste) · ooze: slow, viscous, passive percolation through a pore or wound (pus / blood / sap) · drool: involuntary, uncontrolled dripping of excess saliva from the mouth (infant / dog / sleep) · bleed out: catastrophic, fatal exsanguination through severe hemorrhage (victim / patient / livestock)
groups.nuance_zh: secrete: 有机体主动合成并释放特化生理液体 (hormones / saliva / enzymes) · excrete: 身体将代谢副产物或废物排出体外 (toxins / sweat / waste) · ooze: 黏稠液体从疮口或细孔中缓慢渗透外溢 (pus / blood / sap) · drool: 唾液不受控地流下 (infant / dog / sleep) · bleed out: 因大量失血致使血液流尽或丧命 (victim / patient / livestock)

groups.name: Clean, Dry & Polish Surfaces · 表面清洁、擦干与打磨 (Clean, Dry & Polish)
groups.tip: 擦拭清洗或打磨使物体恢复洁净

items.def_en: (+ sth) rub a surface with a soft dry cloth until it becomes glossy
items.ex_en: He took a clean rag to buff up his leather boots before inspection.
items.ex_zh: 他在检查前拿了一块干净的抹布将皮靴擦得锃亮。

items.def_en: (+ sth) remove liquid from a floor or surface using a mop or cloth
items.ex_en: The janitor quickly grabbed a rag to mop up the spilled orange juice.
items.ex_zh: 清洁工迅速抓起一块抹布把洒在地上橙汁拖干擦净。

items.def_en: (+ sth) clean, dry, or smooth a surface thoroughly by rubbing it vigorously
items.ex_en: After sanding the wooden tabletop, rub down the surface with a lint-free cloth.
items.ex_zh: 打磨完木质桌面后，用无绒布将表面彻底擦拭干净。

items.def_en: (+ sth) clean the entire surface of sth with a damp cloth or sponge
items.ex_en: Please wipe down the kitchen counter thoroughly with disinfectant after preparing raw chicken.
items.ex_zh: 切完生鸡肉后，请用消毒剂将厨房操作台表面彻底擦拭干净。

items.def_en: 1. To clean, dry, or remove something by rubbing a cloth, towel, or hand across a surface. 2. To erase or eliminate completely.
items.ex_en: She grabbed a paper napkin to wipe the greasy sauce from her chin.
items.ex_zh: 她抓起一张纸巾擦掉下巴上油腻的酱汁。

items.def_zh: 用肥皂擦洗，在……上涂肥皂
items.def_en: 1. To wash or rub someone or something all over with soap.
items.ex_en: The caregiver gently soaped the patient's trembling hands under warm running tap water.
items.ex_zh: 护理员在温热的自来水下轻轻地给病人颤抖的双手涂上肥皂清洗。

items.def_zh: 用毛巾擦干，用毛巾擦拭
items.def_en: 1. (often towel down/off) To dry or wipe yourself, someone else, or an object using a towel.
items.ex_en: He stepped out of the warm shower and began to towel his hair.
items.ex_zh: 他走出温热的淋浴间，开始用毛巾擦干头发。

items.def_zh: 用软布擦亮，打磨；使（皮革等）起绒变软
items.def_en: 1. To polish and make something shiny using a soft cloth or a buffing tool. 2. To give leather a soft, velvety finish.
items.ex_en: Use a soft microfiber cloth to buff the car hood to a shine.
items.ex_zh: 用柔软的超细纤维布打磨汽车引擎盖，使其光亮如新。

items.def_en: to clean or wipe a surface with a wet or damp sponge
items.ex_en: She used a damp rag to sponge the sticky juice from the counter.
items.ex_zh: 她用一块湿抹布把台面上黏糊糊的果汁擦洗干净。

items.def_en: to clean or wipe a floor or surface using a mop or absorbent cloth
items.ex_en: The kitchen staff had to mop the greasy tile floor after every shift.
items.ex_zh: 厨房员工在每次轮班后都必须用拖把拖洗油腻的瓷砖地板。

items.def_en: to make a surface smooth and shiny by rubbing it with a cloth or compound
items.ex_en: He spent the afternoon using wax to polish his prized classic motorcycle frame.
items.ex_zh: 他花了一下午时间用车蜡将自己珍爱的老爷摩托车车架磨光擦亮。

items.def_en: 1. To clean something using a vacuum cleaner.
items.ex_en: We usually vacuum the living room carpets twice a week to remove dust.
items.ex_zh: 我们通常每周用吸尘器清扫两次客厅地毯以清除灰尘。

items.def_zh: 抛光，打磨（金属等硬质表面）
items.def_en: to polish a metal or hard surface by continuous friction to produce a bright shine
items.ex_en: The ancient armorer labored ceaselessly to burnish the knight's ornate silver breastplate.
items.ex_zh: 老军械匠不知疲倦地打磨着骑士华丽的银色胸甲，使其熠熠生辉。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe cleaning, drying, or finishing a surface through physical rubbing, wiping, or suction with a tool or agent. They range from basic surface washing and drying to mechanical polishing and shine enhancement.
groups.summary_zh: 通过擦洗、擦干、吸尘或研磨等手段处理物体表面的清洁与抛光动作。
groups.desc_en: Applying mechanical friction, moisture, or polish to an exterior to eliminate residue, liquid, or dullness, distinct from volumetric washing.
groups.desc_zh: 通过机械摩擦、擦拭或抛光去除表面水渍、脏污或暗沉，区别于完全浸入式的冲洗。
groups.nuance_en: wipe: sweeping a flexible cloth or hand across a surface to clean or dry (table / brow / slate) · wipe down: thoroughly scouring an entire broad surface using wiping motions (counters / walls / tables) · mop up: soaking up pooled liquids or finishing off remaining remnants (spill / mess / resistance) · buff: vigorously rubbing with a soft material to produce high gloss (shoes / car / nails) · towel: rapidly drying skin or hair by patting or rubbing with a towel (hair / face / body)
groups.nuance_zh: wipe: 用布或手拂过表面以擦净或抹干 (table / brow / slate) · wipe down: 对大面积台面进行彻底擦拭清洁 (counters / walls / tables) · mop up: 用吸水工具吸干积水，或收尾扫荡残余 (spill / mess / resistance) · buff: 用软布或抛光机高速摩擦产生光泽 (shoes / car / nails) · towel: 用毛巾按揉擦干水分 (hair / face / body)

groups.name: Compete & Contend · 竞争与抗衡 (Compete, Rival, Vie)
groups.tip: 正面角逐竞争与抗衡

items.def_en: to confront an opponent or enter into open competition or conflict
items.ex_en: The two veteran rivals will face off in the championship bout tonight.
items.ex_zh: 这两位老对手将于今晚在冠军争夺战中正式交锋。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to compete or contend with someone or something
items.ex_en: Our small startup must go up against established multinational corporations for market share.
items.ex_zh: 我们这家初创小企业必须与根基深厚的跨国大公司争夺市场份额。

items.def_en: to prepare to fight, argue, or compete against someone
items.ex_en: The two rival boxers will square off in the championship bout tonight.
items.ex_zh: 两位势均力敌的拳击手将在今晚的冠军赛中一决高下。

items.def_en: 1. To confront or compete against someone in a contest or battle. 2. To accept or deal with a difficult situation.
items.ex_en: Our football team must face defending champions in the upcoming semi-final round.
items.ex_zh: 我们的足球队必须在即将到来的半决赛中对阵卫冕冠军。

items.def_zh: 向……挑战，向……发起竞争；质疑，对……表示怀疑
items.def_en: 1. To invite someone to compete or fight in a contest or trial of strength. 2. To question the truth, rightness, or honesty of something.
items.ex_en: The rookie tennis player dared to challenge the world champion yesterday afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 那位网球新秀昨天下午大胆地向世界冠军发起了挑战。

items.def_zh: 斗争，抗争；拼搏，努力奋斗；挣扎
items.def_en: 1. To fight or compete forcefully against a person, group, or opposing power. 2. To make a strenuous effort to achieve something difficult.
items.ex_en: Local union leaders continue to struggle against harsh corporate wage cuts daily.
items.ex_zh: 当地工会领导人每天都在继续顽强抗击企业严酷的降薪措施。

items.def_zh: 冲突，抵触，相矛盾；争执，交锋
items.def_en: To be in active disagreement, opposition, or struggle with someone or something.
items.ex_en: These new municipal zoning regulations directly conflict with regional development objectives.
items.ex_zh: 这些新的城市规划分区规定与区域发展目标直接冲突。

items.def_zh: 竞争，对抗；参加比赛（竞赛）
items.def_en: To strive to gain or win something by defeating others in a contest, sport, or market.
items.ex_en: Dozens of startup technology firms compete for scarce venture capital funding each quarter.
items.ex_zh: 数十家初创科技公司每个季度都在争夺稀缺的风险投资资金。

items.def_zh: 角逐，争夺；质疑，对……提出异议
items.def_en: 1. To compete or fight for power, control, or victory. 2. To formally argue against or challenge the validity of a decision or result.
items.ex_en: Several prominent candidates will vigorously contest the vacant seat in parliament tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 几位显要的候选人明天将全力角逐议会中的空缺席位。

items.def_zh: 挺胸迎战，顽强对抗；奋力穿过，顶着……前行
items.def_en: To confront or struggle against an obstacle or opposing force bravely; to push through.
items.ex_en: The solitary traveler breasted the biting winter gale with unyielding determination.
items.ex_zh: 这位孤独的旅人怀着坚定的毅力，迎着刺骨的冬日狂风艰难前行。

items.def_en: To be as good, impressive, or successful as someone or something else; to compete with.
items.ex_en: Few modern digital cameras can rival the image fidelity of this model.
items.ex_zh: 很少有现代数码相机能在图像保真度上与这款型号相匹敌。

items.def_en: (+ with/for) To compete eagerly with someone in order to achieve or acquire something.
items.ex_en: Top technology firms constantly vie for the market share in artificial intelligence.
items.ex_zh: 顶尖科技公司在人工智能领域不断激烈争夺市场份额。

items.def_en: (+ with/against/for) To compete intensely or struggle to surmount an opponent or hardship.
items.ex_en: The marathon runner had to contend with severe muscle cramps during the race.
items.ex_zh: 这位马拉松运动员在比赛中不得不顽强克服严重的肌肉痉挛。

groups.summary_en: Verbs encoding dynamic oppositional striving where two or more parties match capabilities, pursue identical finite rewards, or resist antagonistic forces.
groups.summary_zh: 指多方之间角逐有限目标、抗衡争雄或与对手正面抗拒较量的冲突框架。
groups.desc_en: Actively striving against a rival or adversary for supremacy, victory, or a finite prize within an oppositional dynamic, unlike solo performance.
groups.desc_zh: 在对抗格局中与对手争夺优势、胜利或有限资源，区别于无对抗的单人测验或孤立表现。
groups.nuance_en: compete: standard participation in a contest for success or market share (market / race / tournament) · face off: standing directly in head-to-head confrontation before an encounter begins (teams / rivals / debaters) · square off: adopting a defensive or aggressive combat posture against an opponent (boxers / candidates / rivals) · challenge: directly inviting or provoking a rival to battle, contest, or justify themselves (champion / authority / decision) · go up against: stepping forward to confront a formidable competitor or entrenched power (incumbent / titan / system)
groups.nuance_zh: compete: 最通用的在竞赛或商业中同台竞争 (market / race / tournament) · face off: 赛前或冲突前双方迎面直接对峙 (teams / rivals / debaters) · square off: 摆开架势准备拳脚相见或正面交锋 (boxers / candidates / rivals) · challenge: 向权威或擂主下战书发起挑战与质疑 (champion / authority / decision) · go up against: 挺身而出与强敌或庞大势力硬碰硬 (incumbent / titan / system)

groups.name: Confuse & Discombobulate · 困惑与错乱 (Befuddle, Flummox, Discombobulate)
groups.tip: 让人摸不着头脑甚至思维错乱

items.def_en: to cause someone to feel confused because they cannot understand something
items.ex_en: The sudden disappearance of the antique diamond necklace continues to puzzle investigators.
items.ex_zh: 古董钻石项链的离奇失踪仍然令调查人员大惑不解。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to confuse someone so that they cannot think clearly or understand
items.ex_en: All those complicated tax rules will mix up anyone trying to file independently.
items.ex_zh: 那些复杂的税收规定会让任何尝试独立报税的人感到糊涂。

items.def_en: 1. (often passive) To confuse, puzzle, or slightly bewilder someone.
items.ex_en: His bizarrely eccentric lecture style seemed to bemuse the entire freshman audience.
items.ex_zh: 他极其古怪的讲课风格似乎让整批大一新生都茫然不知所措。

items.def_en: (+ sb's head/mind) to cause someone cognitive confusion, distress, or psychological disorientation
items.ex_en: Gaslighting tactics like that can mess with someone's mind over extended periods.
items.ex_zh: 那样操纵心理的手段久而久之会严重扰乱一个人的心智。

items.def_zh: 扰乱；使措手不及而困惑
items.def_en: (+ sb) to confuse, distract, or disorient someone unexpectedly
items.ex_en: The unexpected technical question managed to throw off the experienced keynote speaker.
items.ex_zh: 那个突如其来的专业技术问题让经验丰富的主讲人一时措手不及。

items.def_en: to totally bewilder or perplex someone so they cannot find an explanation
items.ex_en: The sudden engine failure continued to baffle seasoned aircraft mechanics all morning.
items.ex_zh: 突发的发动机故障一上午都让经验丰富的飞机机械师们百思不解。

items.def_zh: 使神秘莫测，使大惑不解
items.def_en: to utterly confound someone by presenting something inexplicable or mysterious
items.ex_en: The magician's impossible levitation illusion never failed to mystify audience members completely.
items.ex_zh: 魔术师那看似不可能的悬浮幻象总能让观众彻底大惑不解。

items.def_zh: 使（头脑）昏乱，使糊涂；（蛋）变质
items.def_en: 1. (often passive) To confuse someone's mind so they cannot think clearly. 2. (of eggs) To become rotten, or make rotten.
items.ex_en: Too much confusing legal jargon can easily addle a layperson's thoughts.
items.ex_zh: 过多晦涩的法律术语极易使外行人的思维陷入昏乱。

items.def_en: 1. (often passive) To confuse someone's mind so they cannot think clearly, especially because of alcohol or complexity.
items.ex_en: The potent spiced wine served at dinner managed to befuddle his senses entirely.
items.ex_zh: 晚餐时喝的烈性加香热葡萄酒彻底弄昏了他的神智。

items.def_zh: 使迷失方向，使困惑，使迷茫
items.def_en: 1. (chiefly British variant of disorient) To make someone feel confused and lose their sense of direction or mental clarity.
items.ex_en: Dense morning fog can quickly disorientate walkers on the open moorland trails.
items.ex_zh: 清晨浓重的大雾很容易让开阔荒原小径上的徒步者迷失方向。

items.def_zh: 使彻底困惑，使不知所措
items.def_en: 1. (informal, often passive) To confuse or baffle someone completely so they have no idea what to do or say.
items.ex_en: That trick question on the calculus exam completely flummoxed most bright students.
items.ex_zh: 微积分考试中的那道陷阱题彻底难倒了大多数聪明的学生。

items.def_zh: 使慌乱，使困惑，使手足无措
items.def_en: 1. (informal, often passive) To confuse, upset, or throw someone completely off balance.
items.ex_en: The chaotic flight delay and gate changes managed to discombobulate tired travelers.
items.ex_zh: 混乱的航班延误和登机口变更让疲惫的旅客们手足无措。

items.def_en: to astonish or shock someone so intensely that they are unable to think or react
items.ex_en: The astonishing news of his sudden betrayal seemed to stupefy everyone present.
items.ex_zh: 他突然背叛的惊人消息似乎让在场的每一个人都目瞪口呆。

groups.summary_en: A situation or riddle impairs someone's ability to think clearly, reason logically, or orient themselves. The continuum escalates from mild perceptual muddle and temporary loss of bearings to total cognitive paralysis and dizzying disorientation.
groups.summary_zh: 外在事物干扰认知，导致从思维轻微发懵到彻底混乱失措。
groups.desc_en: Disrupting an agent's cognitive equilibrium, leaving them intellectually paralyzed, bewildered, or unable to make sense of reality, distinct from mere ignorance.
groups.desc_zh: 打破认知平衡，致使大脑短路、错乱迷茫或无法理解现实逻辑，区别于单纯的无知。
