items.def_zh: 再现，重新创造；娱乐，消遣
items.def_en: 1. To make something exist again, or reproduce a past event, scene, or experience. 2. To take recreation, relax, or refresh oneself.
items.ex_en: The documentary makers tried to recreate the battle scene using vivid computer graphics.
items.ex_zh: 纪录片制作者尝试利用逼真的计算机绘图再现当年的战斗场景。

items.def_zh: 彻底重塑，重新创造；重复发明
items.def_en: To produce something new based on an existing idea, or to change something so completely that it appears entirely new.
items.ex_en: The struggling fashion brand had to reinvent its core image to attract younger shoppers.
items.ex_zh: 这家陷入困境的时尚品牌不得不彻底重塑其核心形象以吸引年轻买家。

items.def_zh: 创新，革新；引进（新事物或新方法）
items.def_en: To introduce new methods, ideas, or products; to make changes in something established.
items.ex_en: Companies must constantly innovate to survive in such an intensely competitive global marketplace.
items.ex_zh: 在这个竞争异常激烈的全球市场上，企业必须不断创新才能生存。

items.def_en: to create or devise an elaborate plan, story, or mixture using various ingredients
items.ex_en: The suspect tried to concoct an elaborate alibi to mislead the homicide detectives.
items.ex_zh: 嫌疑人试图编造一套天衣无缝的不在场证明来误导命案侦探。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey bringing original products, mechanisms, concepts, or linguistic terms into existence through creative ingenuity or groundbreaking technical exploration.
groups.summary_zh: 指凭独创力构思、设计并发明前所未有的事物、方法或术语。
groups.desc_en: Emphasizes the seminal inception, intellectual synthesis, or fabrication of unprecedented ideas, systems, or lexical units, contrasting with passive discovery or imitation.
groups.desc_zh: 强调破天荒地在智力上构思、合成或虚构出前所未有的思想、体系或词汇，与被动发现或照搬模仿相对。
groups.nuance_en: originate: serve as the initial source, parent concept, or fountainhead of something (style / practice / rumor) · coin: invent a fresh and memorable linguistic term or catchphrase (term / phrase / word) · devise: formulate a clever, complex mechanical or systemic plan through ingenuity (scheme / strategy / apparatus) · pioneer: break ground by introducing unprecedented techniques or fields (technique / field / treatment) · dream up: invent fanciful, improbable, or visionary concepts out of thin air (scheme / excuse / scenario)
groups.nuance_zh: originate: 作为源头倡导或首创母体概念 (style / practice / rumor) · coin: 创造独具一格的新词或警句 (term / phrase / word) · devise: 巧妙设计出精密的方案、计谋或仪器 (scheme / strategy / apparatus) · pioneer: 开疆拓土引入全新技术或前沿领域 (technique / field / treatment) · dream up: 凭空异想天开构想出离奇创意或借口 (scheme / excuse / scenario)

groups.name: Cry Out & Wail · 叫嚷与号哭 (Hollo, Yawp, Caterwaul)
groups.tip: 由大声呼叫到凄厉哀号

items.def_en: (+ to sb) to shout loudly to attract someone's attention from a distance
items.ex_en: She had to call out to her little brother across the crowded park.
items.ex_zh: 她只得穿过拥挤的公园大声呼喊自己的小弟弟。

items.def_en: to shout, yell, or scream loudly because of pain, fear, or surprise
items.ex_en: The terrified toddler began to cry out when the sudden thunder shook the room.
items.ex_zh: 当突如其来的雷声震动房间时，吓坏了的幼儿大声哭喊起来。

items.def_en: to make a long, loud, sorrowful or fierce cry like that of a wolf or in agonizing pain
items.ex_en: The injured hiker began to howl with agony when he twisted his swollen ankle.
items.ex_zh: 扭伤了肿胀的脚踝后，受伤的徒步者痛苦地哀嚎起来。

items.def_zh: 发出刺耳巨响，高声嚷嚷；脱口而出；（羊等）咩咩叫
items.def_en: 1. To make a loud, harsh noise; to shout or say something loudly or indiscreetly. 2. To bleat like a sheep or calf.
items.ex_en: He had to blat his reckless opinion before anyone could explain the actual facts.
items.ex_zh: 在别人还没来得及解释事实前，他就大声嚷嚷起自己的鲁莽看法。

items.def_en: to weep or cry out loudly and raucously
items.ex_en: The upset child began to bawl out uncontrollably when his red balloon popped.
items.ex_zh: 当红气球破裂时，那个伤心的小孩失控地放声嚎哭起来。

items.def_en: to make an unpleasant, loud, high-pitched shrill cry or noise
items.ex_en: We heard the frightened bird screech loudly as a stray cat approached the nest.
items.ex_zh: 当一只野猫靠近鸟巢时，我们听到受惊的鸟儿发出一阵尖厉的刺耳叫声。

items.def_en: to make a very high-pitched, piercing cry or sound of terror or pain
items.ex_en: The woman let out a piercing shriek when she spotted the venomous spider.
items.ex_zh: 当看到那只毒蜘蛛时，那个女人发出了刺耳惊恐的尖叫。

items.def_zh: 尖声号叫，凄厉哀号；（猫发情时）尖叫
items.def_en: To make a loud, high, unpleasant wailing sound, like cats fighting or mating; to screech or complain shrilly.
items.ex_en: Feral cats began to caterwaul on the tin roof throughout the chilly moonlit night.
items.ex_zh: 在寒冷月夜里，野猫在铁皮屋顶上整夜凄厉地号叫着。

items.def_en: To shout loudly, especially to attract attention or to urge on hunting dogs.
items.ex_en: The old hunter paused to hollo loudly across the misty valley toward his hounds.
items.ex_zh: 老猎人停下脚步，穿过薄雾弥漫的山谷向他的猎犬大声呼唤。

items.def_en: To cry 'halloo' loudly to attract attention, or to urge on hounds in hunting.
items.ex_en: The huntsman rose in his stirrups to halloo the eager pack toward the scent.
items.ex_zh: 猎手踩在马镫上直起身子高声喝彩，催促急切的猎犬群循着气味追逐。

items.def_zh: 粗声叫喊，大声嚷嚷；大发牢骚
items.def_en: To shout, yell, or talk loudly and harshly; to complain in a raucous manner.
items.ex_en: The embittered peddler began to yawp loudly against the unfair city ordinances.
items.ex_zh: 满腹怨气的摊贩开始扯着粗嗓门大声抱怨不公的市政条例。

items.def_en: To make a loud, long, mournful cry, especially in pain, distress, or grief.
items.ex_en: The injured hound continued to yowl pitifully in the deserted alleyway.
items.ex_zh: 那只受伤的猎犬在僻静的小巷里凄惨地哀号不止。

groups.summary_en: A human or creature emits loud, harsh vocal emissions expressing distress, summoning distance, or primal agitation, escalating from rustic hailing calls to grating cries, feral yowling, and shrill unearthly caterwauling.
groups.summary_zh: 发出响亮、粗粝或刺耳的呼喝与嚎叫，达至歇斯底里之哀号。
groups.desc_en: Refers to discharging unconstrained, high-decibel vocalizations manifesting primal pain, animal terror, or vulgar rowdiness, contrasting with articulate speech or muffled weeping.
groups.desc_zh: 指不受控制地发出高分贝嘶嚎以宣泄剧痛、惊骇或粗野叫嚣，与有条理的言语或低声啜泣相对。
groups.nuance_en: shriek: emit a sudden, piercing, high-pitched scream of terror or agony (horror / pain / laughter) · howl: bay mournfully, loudly, or sustainedly in wind, anguish, or mockery (wind / grief / laughter) · bawl out: shout or chastise crudely and vociferously at top volume (orders / obscenities / subordinate) · screech: utter an intensely harsh, grating, and jarring cry (brakes / alarm / terror) · caterwaul: make a discordant, wailing, and shrill howling reminiscent of rutting cats (protest / sound / singers)
groups.nuance_zh: shriek: 惊恐或剧痛下爆发出极其尖锐短促的尖叫 (horror / pain / laughter) · howl: 凄厉悲切或狂乱不绝地号叫 (wind / grief / laughter) · bawl out: 粗野、高声雷鸣般咆哮怒骂 (orders / obscenities / subordinate) · screech: 撕心裂肺、金属摩擦般刺耳地怪叫 (brakes / alarm / terror) · caterwaul: 发出如猫叫春般难听吵闹的哀号 (protest / sound / singers)

groups.name: Decorate & Adorn · 装饰与点缀 (Embellish, Garnish, Adorn)
groups.tip: 添加细节纹饰以增进美感

items.def_en: (+ sth) to add decorative accents to make something look more appealing or elaborate
items.ex_en: You don't need to dress up; casual clothes are fine for the party.
items.ex_zh: 你不需要盛装打扮，去参加聚会穿便装就行。
items.ex2_en: She decided to dress up the plain dining table with colorful flowers.
items.ex2_zh: 她决定用色彩斑斓的鲜花将朴素的餐桌装饰一番。

items.def_en: (+ sth/sb) to make someone or something look cleaner, neater, or more attractive
items.ex_en: We should spruce up the living room before our dinner guests arrive.
items.ex_zh: 晚宴客人到来之前，我们应该把客厅收拾整洁一番。

items.def_en: to decorate an edge, garment, or object by adding contrasting borders, ribbons, or accessories
items.ex_en: The seamstress decided to trim the velvet cuffs with delicate silver lace.
items.ex_zh: 女裁缝决定用精致的银色蕾丝给丝绒袖口镶边装饰。

items.def_zh: 在……边缘做扇形饰边；用扇贝状碟烘烤
items.def_en: to decorate the edge of fabric, pastry, or wood with a series of rounded curves
items.ex_en: Delicate lace scalloped the flowing hemline of her vintage silk wedding gown.
items.ex_zh: 精致的蕾丝在她那件复古丝绸婚纱飘逸的裙摆上缀出扇形边饰。

items.def_en: to decorate a dish of food with a small amount of different food
items.ex_en: The chef chose to garnish the roasted salmon with fresh sprigs of dill.
items.ex_zh: 主厨选用新鲜的莳萝嫩枝来点缀烘烤好的三文鱼。

items.def_zh: 使成方格图案；使交替变化，使多样化
items.def_en: (chiefly British English) to mark or decorate with a pattern of alternating squares or colours
items.ex_en: Afternoon shadows chequered the courtyard flagstones in rich patterns of dark and amber.
items.ex_zh: 午后的光影在庭院石板上交织出一片浓重的深色与琥珀色相间的方格图案。

items.def_en: (architecture) to finish or decorate the top edge of a wall or building with a cornice
items.ex_en: Elaborate acanthus reliefs corniced the lofty ceilings of the restored ballroom.
items.ex_zh: 精美的毛茛叶浮雕为修复后的大宴会厅的高挑天花板饰上了飞檐。

items.def_en: (+ sth/sb) to decorate or dress someone or something in a very elaborate or festive way
items.ex_en: They decked out the entire hall in bright banners for the championship party.
items.ex_zh: 他们用鲜艳的条幅把整个大厅精心装点一番，以庆祝夺冠。

items.def_en: to enhance the beauty or appearance of someone or something, often with ornaments
items.ex_en: Strands of lustrous pearls adorned the neck of the young noblewoman.
items.ex_zh: 串串光泽耀眼的珍珠装点着这位年轻贵妇的颈项。

items.def_zh: 装饰，布置；给（故事等）添枝加叶，润色
items.def_en: 1. to make something more beautiful by adding decoration to it 2. to add details to a story, sometimes untrue, to make it more interesting
items.ex_en: The witness tended to embellish the simple narrative with dramatic fabricated details.
items.ex_zh: 该证人往往会在朴素的叙述中添枝加叶，加入戏剧性的虚构细节。

items.def_en: to drape or adorn a place or object with ribbons, garlands, or decorative chains
items.ex_en: Garlands of fragrant jasmine festooned the ancient marble pillars for the festival.
items.ex_zh: 为了迎接节日，芬芳的茉莉花环如彩带般缀饰着古老的大理石柱。

items.def_en: to decorate or cover something lavishly with colorful decorations or jewels
items.ex_en: The priests bedecked the sacred idol with glittering jewels and silken ribbons.
items.ex_zh: 祭司们用璀璨的宝石和丝质飘带将神像厚厚装点起来。

groups.summary_en: An agent enhances the visual appeal or artistic finish of an object or surface by adding decorative motifs, borders, or edible accents. Verbs vary by the specific decorative technique or specialized domain involved (e.g., culinary, architectural, or geometric patterning).
groups.summary_zh: 通过增设饰边、花纹或配料以美化外观或结构。
groups.desc_en: Centers on adorning boundaries, surfaces, or presentations with deliberate accents or finery to heighten visual allure, contrasting with utilitarian assembling.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重于在边缘、表面或装潢上添加专门的细节点缀或锦簇饰品以提升观赏性，与实用性的装配相对。
groups.nuance_en: trim: decorate borders or edges neatly with ribbons, lace, or lights (tree / dress / hedge) · garnish: add culinary flourishes to food to elevate visual presentation (cocktail / dish / platter) · scallop: cut or embroider outer edges into an undulating series of curves (fabric / hem / edge) · chequer: pattern a flat surface with contrasting alternating squares (pattern / light / history) · cornice: furnish an architectural wall or cabinet with projecting ornamental molding (ceiling / facade / cabinet)
groups.nuance_zh: trim: 沿边缘镶饰花边、蕾丝或点缀挂饰 (tree / dress / hedge) · garnish: 菜肴装盘时配以小菜香草等做秀色点缀 (cocktail / dish / platter) · scallop: 将衣物或物料外缘裁绣出贝壳状波浪纹 (fabric / hem / edge) · chequer: 使表面呈现棋盘方格状交错图案 (pattern / light / history) · cornice: 给天花板或外墙顶部装置飞檐冠顶线 (ceiling / facade / cabinet)

groups.name: Defeat & Subdue · 战胜与降伏 (Outwit, Overbear, Subjugate)
groups.tip: 以绝对优势压制收服

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to cause a ruler, government, or opponent to fall or lose power
items.ex_en: The financial scandal eventually helped bring down the controversial prime minister.
items.ex_zh: 这场金融丑闻最终促成了这位饱受争议的首相下台。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to gradually overcome an opponent's opposition or stamina through sustained pressure
items.ex_en: Persistent negotiations finally wore down the opposition's resistance.
items.ex_zh: 旷日持久的谈判最终瓦解了反对派的抵抗意志。
items.ex2_en: The rubber soles will wear down quickly from running on rough asphalt.
items.ex2_zh: 在粗糙的沥青路面上跑步会导致橡胶鞋底迅速磨损变薄。

items.def_en: to defeat or gain physical control over someone by greater strength
items.ex_en: Two brave security guards managed to overpower the intruder near the vault.
items.ex_zh: 两名英勇的安保人员合力在金库附近制服了那名闯入者。

items.def_en: To defeat or gain an advantage over someone by being cleverer than they are.
items.ex_en: The cunning fox easily outwitted the pursuers by doubling back through the brush.
items.ex_zh: 狡猾的狐狸折返钻入灌木丛，轻而易举地以智甩掉了追捕者。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to defeat an opponent decisively or crush their resistance by force
items.ex_en: Riot police moved in swiftly to beat down all remaining insurgent resistance.
items.ex_zh: 防暴警察迅速出动，彻底击溃了叛乱分子残余的抵抗。

items.def_en: to subdue an opponent or rebellion forcefully and completely
items.ex_en: The imperial legions marched south to crush the spreading rebellion once and for all.
items.ex_zh: 帝国军团向南挺进，一劳永逸地彻底粉碎了蔓延的叛乱。

items.def_en: to thoroughly defeat an enemy or adversary in a battle or competition
items.ex_en: The legendary warrior vowed to vanquish the invading tyrant before sunset.
items.ex_zh: 这位传奇勇士立誓要在日落之前彻底击溃来犯的暴君。

items.def_zh: 战胜，克服，解决（困难）；置于……顶端
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To deal successfully with a difficulty or overcome an obstacle. 2. To be placed on top of something.
items.ex_en: The determined team worked tirelessly to surmount every formidable engineering obstacle.
items.ex_zh: 这支坚定的团队不知疲倦地工作，以克服每一个艰巨的工程障碍。

items.def_en: (formal) To overwhelm, dominate, or crush someone's resistance by superior force or authority.
items.ex_en: The tyrannical chairman sought to overbear all dissenting voices on the board.
items.ex_zh: 这位专横的董事长企图依仗权势压服董事会中的所有异议。

items.def_zh: 以技艺击败，在比赛中胜过
items.def_en: To play much better than an opponent and defeat them in a game or match.
items.ex_en: The young challenger managed to completely outplay the reigning chess grandmaster.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻的挑战者在棋艺上完全压制并击败了现任国际象棋特级大师。

items.def_zh: 远胜于，轻易击败，技术显著高出
items.def_en: To be much better than an opponent or competitor in skill, quality, or performance.
items.ex_en: The visiting football squad completely outclassed their hosts in every department.
items.ex_zh: 客队足球队在各个环节上的实力都远胜主队，轻松取胜。

items.def_zh: 征服，降服，使臣服；抑制，克制
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To defeat a people or country and bring them under complete control by force. 2. To bring one's desires or impulses under complete control.
items.ex_en: The ruthless warlord attempted to subjugate the neighboring tribes through brutal force.
items.ex_zh: 残暴的军阀企图凭借残酷的武力使邻近部落彻底臣服。

groups.summary_en: An agent overcomes an opponent or obstacle, scaling from intellectual and tactical superiority to overwhelming physical dominance and complete institutional or political subjugation.
groups.summary_zh: 从智谋与战术上超越胜过，递进至全面压制并彻底征服降伏敌方。
groups.desc_en: Depicts prevailing decisively over an opponent, obstacle, or internal resistance through superior might, strategy, or attrition, contrasting with mere competition or stalemate.
groups.desc_zh: 描绘凭借压倒性力量、计谋或消耗战彻底制服对手、难关或抗力，与平分秋色或陷入相持相对。
groups.nuance_en: vanquish: utterly and conclusively obliterate an adversary in battle or debate (foe / army / doubt) · overpower: overcome physical or mental resistance through superior irresistible strength (guards / defenses / senses) · wear down: erode an enemy's resolve or vitality progressively through continuous pressure (opposition / resistance / competitor) · outwit: gain decisive superiority over an opponent by superior cunning (adversary / police / competitors) · surmount: triumph over a formidable abstract obstacle through resilience (obstacles / difficulties / odds)
groups.nuance_zh: vanquish: 征战或辩论中将劲敌彻底剿灭击溃 (foe / army / doubt) · overpower: 凭无可抗拒的强绝力量瞬间压倒制服 (guards / defenses / senses) · wear down: 持续高压消磨对手意志体力 (opposition / resistance / competitor) · outwit: 技高一筹凭计谋暗算智胜对手 (adversary / police / competitors) · surmount: 凭借韧劲力克艰险逾越险阻 (obstacles / difficulties / odds)

groups.name: Delight & Enrapture · 欢欣与陶醉 (Gladden, Exult, Enrapture)
groups.tip: 从心生欢喜到狂喜陶醉

items.def_en: (+ sb) to make someone feel happier or more joyful, or to become happier
items.ex_en: A spontaneous cup of hot cocoa helped cheer up the exhausted hikers.
items.ex_zh: 一杯适时送上的热可可让疲惫不堪的徒步者们精神振作起来。
items.ex2_en: His gloomy facial expression cheered up noticeably when good friends suddenly arrived.
items.ex2_zh: 当好友突然到来时，他原本阴沉的面部表情明显明朗高兴起来。

items.def_en: (+ in/at) to feel or express great joy and satisfaction openly
items.ex_en: The entire hamlet rejoiced at the welcome news of their hero's safe return.
items.ex_zh: 听到英雄平安归来的喜讯，整个村庄都欣喜若狂。

items.def_en: To entertain or delight someone, especially by telling stories; to feast or provide lavish food and drink.
items.ex_en: The elderly captain regaled his wide-eyed listeners with tales of forgotten seas.
items.ex_zh: 老船长讲述着被遗忘海域的奇闻故事，把听众逗得心驰神往。

items.raw_cluster: 使高兴与使满意 Please & Delight
items.def_en: (formal or literary) To make someone feel happy, pleased, or cheerful.
items.ex_en: The arrival of unexpected letters from home will always gladden the weary traveler.
items.ex_zh: 意外收到的家书总能让疲惫的旅人倍感欣慰与喜悦。

items.def_zh: 使大为倾倒；令人极度叹服
items.def_en: (+ sb) to please, impress, or thrill someone overwhelmingly
items.ex_en: Her electrifying guitar solo was enough to blow away the stunned audience.
items.ex_zh: 她那段令人热血沸腾的吉他独奏足以让全场目瞪口呆的观众大为折服。

items.def_zh: 使沉溺；使陶醉；冲昏头脑
items.def_en: (+ sb) to cause someone to be overwhelmed by excitement, delight, or intense emotion
items.ex_en: Listening to the majestic symphony can easily carry away any passionate music lover.
items.ex_zh: 聆听这壮丽的交响曲，任何热忱的乐迷都极易沉醉其中不能自拔。

items.def_en: to make someone extremely proud, cheerful, and exhilarated
items.ex_en: The unexpected award served to elate the humble scientist beyond measure.
items.ex_zh: 这份意料之外的殊荣让这位谦逊的科学家无比振奋与自豪。

items.raw_cluster: 得意与幸灾乐祸 Gloat & Exult
items.def_zh: 幸灾乐祸；自鸣得意，沾沾自喜
items.def_en: (+ over/about) To feel or express great, often malicious pleasure or satisfaction at one's own success or another's misfortune.
items.ex_en: It is petty and unkind to gloat over your rival's public misfortune.
items.ex_zh: 对竞争对手公之于众的不幸幸灾乐祸是狭隘且不厚道的行为。

items.def_en: (+ at/in/over) To feel or show great happiness, triumph, or rejoicing.
items.ex_en: The triumphant athletes exulted in their hard-won victory beneath the stadium lights.
items.ex_zh: 凯旋的运动员们在体育场的灯光下为来之不易的胜利欢欣雀跃。

items.def_en: to captivate someone completely with enchanting charm or delight
items.ex_en: Her mesmerizing soprano voice could enthrall even the most cynical critics.
items.ex_zh: 她那令人着迷的女高音足以使最挑剔苛刻的评论家都为之倾倒。

items.def_zh: 使狂喜，使陶醉；强暴；强夺
items.def_en: 1. (literary) To fill someone with intense delight, joy, or enchantment. 2. (archaic or literary) To rape someone; to seize and carry off by force.
items.ex_en: The fragrant summer breeze and golden moonlight ravished her romantic heart.
items.ex_zh: 芬芳的夏夜微风与金色月色令她浪漫的心扉如痴如醉。

items.raw_cluster: 取悦与使高兴 Please & Delight
items.def_zh: 使狂喜，使陶醉，使极度欢悦
items.def_en: (formal or literary, often passive) To fill someone with intense pleasure, delight, or wonder.
items.ex_en: The poetic beauty of the misty valley will certainly enrapture any visitor.
items.ex_zh: 雾霭笼罩中山谷那诗意盎然的美景定会让每一位来访者心醉神迷。

groups.summary_en: Experiencers or stimuli evoke increasing degrees of joyful pleasure, progressing from mild heartening warmth to triumphant outward jubilation, and culminating in overwhelming, ecstatic bliss.
groups.summary_zh: 从适度的喜悦慰藉，递进至外显的狂喜胜意，直至极致的销魂沉醉。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an escalating trajectory of positive emotion, distinguishing intense internal transport, public jubilation, or external entertainment from baseline passive contentment.
groups.desc_zh: 表述积极情感不断攀升的心理与行为样态，区别于一般平静的满足，强调从抚慰提振、款待愉悦到狂喜失控或幸灾乐祸的强烈情感位移。
groups.nuance_en: gladden: gently warm or cheer the heart (heart / spirit) · regale: entertain lavishly with stories or food (guests / audience) · elate: fill with high-spirited pride and joy (victory / success) · blow away: thoroughly astonish and delight (performance / talent) · gloat: relish malicious triumph over another (misfortune / defeat)
groups.nuance_zh: gladden: 温和宽慰并振奋心神 (heart / spirit) · regale: 设宴或以趣事款待逗乐 (guests / audience) · elate: 因成就或胜利而心花怒放 (victory / success) · blow away: 令人惊艳折服并极度震撼 (performance / talent) · gloat: 幸灾乐祸地洋洋自得 (misfortune / defeat)

groups.name: Describe & Depict · 描述与刻画 (Describe, Depict, Portray)
groups.tip: 生动细致描摹人事物特征

items.def_en: To say or write what someone or something is like.
items.ex_en: Could you please describe the missing backpack to the airport staff?
items.ex_zh: 能否请你向机场工作人员描述一下那个遗失的背包？

items.def_zh: 详述，详细说明；派遣，选派
items.def_en: 1. To describe or list something completely and thoroughly. 2. To assign someone to a particular duty.
items.ex_en: The comprehensive manual will detail every step required to assemble the machine.
items.ex_zh: 这本详尽的手册将详细说明组装该机器所需的每个步骤。

items.def_zh: 给……写传略（或人物简介）；描出……的轮廓
items.def_en: 1. To write or produce a short description of someone's life, character, or work. 2. To outline or represent in profile.
items.ex_en: The investigative reporter plans to profile the reclusive billionaire in next week's issue.
items.ex_zh: 调查记者计划在下周的刊物中为这位隐居的亿万富翁撰写人物特写。

items.def_en: To reproduce or represent something vividly through artistic or verbal means.
items.ex_en: The painter managed to render the evening light with astonishing poetic fidelity.
items.ex_zh: 这位画家以惊人的诗意逼真度再现了傍晚的光晕。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to explain or present facts, reasons, or details clearly and in order
items.ex_en: The author used the opening chapter to set out his core philosophical thesis.
items.ex_zh: 作者利用开篇第一章清晰阐述了自己的核心哲学论点。

items.def_zh: 展示；具体说明；清晰解释
items.def_en: (+ sth) to explain an idea, plan, or piece of information clearly and step by step
items.ex_en: The CEO laid out an ambitious five-year growth strategy.
items.ex_zh: 首席执行官详细阐述了一项雄心勃勃的五年增长战略。

items.def_en: (+ sth/sb) to capture or describe the essential qualities of someone or something concisely
items.ex_en: A single word could hardly sum up the intricate genius of his work.
items.ex_zh: 单凭一个词很难概括描述出他作品中精妙绝伦的才华。

items.def_en: To represent or show someone or something in a painting, drawing, or written description.
items.ex_en: The classical fresco depicts various mythological beasts surrounding an ancient deity.
items.ex_zh: 这幅古典壁画描绘了环绕在一尊远古神祗周围的各种神话异兽。

items.def_en: 1. To represent or describe someone or something in a painting, book, or film. 2. To play the part of a character in a film or play.
items.ex_en: Biographers often portray the historical monarch as an ambitious yet deeply conflicted visionary.
items.ex_zh: 传记作家常将这位历史上的君主描绘成一位野心勃勃却内心极度矛盾的远见者。

items.def_zh: 描绘……的特性，刻画；是……的特征
items.def_en: 1. To describe the distinctive qualities or character of someone or something. 2. To be a typical feature or quality of someone or something.
items.ex_en: Scholars characterize this golden era by its unprecedented artistic and commercial flourishing.
items.ex_zh: 学者们将这一黄金时代的特质概括为前所未有的艺术与商业繁荣。

items.def_en: To bring a feeling, image, or memory vividly to mind through evocative description.
items.ex_en: The novel's opening passages evoke the bleak atmosphere of postwar London.
items.ex_zh: 这部小说的开篇段落传神地勾勒出了战后伦敦凄凉萧条的氛围。

items.def_zh: 详细描述，阐明；描画……的轮廓，标出……的界线
items.def_en: (formal) To describe, draw, or explain something in detail, or mark its exact outline or boundaries.
items.ex_en: The formal contract must delineate the precise territorial borders between both districts.
items.ex_zh: 该正式合同必须精确标明并阐清两管辖区之间的地域界线。

groups.summary_en: Verbs centered on representing, characterizing, or rendering the details of a person, event, or scene through language or artistic portrayal, ranging from general narration to rigorous analytical specification.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过言语、文字或艺术形象生动传达或细致剖析事物特征的表述动词。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the structured representation of entities or events through words or art, contrasting mere raw reporting by emphasizing interpretive framing, granular detail, or aesthetic realization.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过言辞或艺术手段对人事物进行具象化呈现，区别于简单的客观陈述，侧重透视角度、细节颗粒度及艺术传神的再现过程。
groups.nuance_en: describe: give a general verbal account (scene / symptoms) · detail: enumerate specific particulars exhaustively (plans / specifications) · depict: evoke a vivid pictorial or narrative image (character / suffering) · render: translate into artistic, technical, or emotional form (likeness / verdict) · profile: sketch distinct biographical or psychological contours (candidate / subject)
groups.nuance_zh: describe: 常规叙述外观或情状 (scene / symptoms) · detail: 详尽列举具体细节与条款 (plans / specifications) · depict: 具象生动地刻画形象或苦难 (character / suffering) · render: 艺术性或技巧性地传神再现 (likeness / verdict) · profile: 勾勒人物传记或心理侧写 (candidate / subject)

groups.name: Discharge Weapons & Bombard · 射击与炮击轰炸 (Shoot, Shell, Bombard)
groups.tip: 枪炮射击与空中轰炸

items.def_en: (+ sth) to fire a gun or explode ordnance, bombs, or fireworks
items.ex_en: Rowdy teenagers let off loud firecrackers right in the crowded marketplace.
items.ex_zh: 喧闹的青少年在拥挤的集市里引爆了响亮的爆竹。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to shoot or discharge a weapon, bullet, or volley of shots
items.ex_en: Infuriated by the decision, he fired off an angry email to the manager.
items.ex_zh: 他对这个决定大为光火，立即给经理匆忙发了一封措辞愤怒的邮件。

items.def_zh: 开火，开枪，射击；解雇，开除；激发，点燃
items.def_en: 1. To shoot a bullet, shell, or other projectile from a weapon. 2. (informal) To dismiss someone from a job.
items.ex_en: The nervous sentry had orders to fire his rifle at any moving shadow.
items.ex_zh: 神经高度紧张的哨兵奉命对任何移动的黑影开枪射击。
items.ex2_en: The heavy artillery gun fired thunderously across the barren northern battlefield yesterday.
items.ex2_zh: 重型火炮昨天在荒凉的北方战场上发出了雷鸣般的射击声。

items.def_zh: 开枪，射击；射门，投篮；拍摄；飞驰
items.def_en: 1. To fire a weapon such as a gun, or wound or kill someone with a bullet or arrow. 2. To kick, hit, or throw a ball toward a goal. 3. To film or photograph.
items.ex_en: The marksman managed to shoot the distant clay pigeon with deadly precision.
items.ex_zh: 神枪手以极其精准的枪法击中了远处的泥鸽靶标。

items.def_en: 1. To shoot wildfowl or birds in flight. 2. To fit feathers onto an arrow.
items.ex_en: Sportsmen gathered along the marshy inlet at dusk to flight incoming mallards.
items.ex_zh: 黄昏时分，猎手们聚集在沼泽水湾旁，射击飞临的野鸭群。

items.def_en: (+ at sth/sb) to shoot repeatedly or bombard heavily using guns or artillery
items.ex_en: The soldiers continued to blast away at the armored convoy across the ravine.
items.ex_zh: 士兵们隔着山峡持续向装甲车队猛烈射击。

items.def_zh: 用枪射击，枪杀（常作 gun down）；加足（发动机）马力
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To shoot someone with a firearm (usually in 'gun down'). 2. To accelerate the engine of a vehicle rapidly.
items.ex_en: Ruthless hitmen were hired to gun down the key prosecution witness outside court.
items.ex_zh: 残忍的职业杀手受雇在法庭外枪杀关键的控方证人。

items.def_zh: 轰炸，用炸弹袭击；（演出、计划等）惨败
items.def_en: 1. To attack a place or target with bombs. 2. (informal) (of a play, film, etc.) To fail badly.
items.ex_en: Hostile aircraft returned before midnight to bomb the vital rail communications hub.
items.ex_zh: 敌机在午夜前回返，轰炸了这一至关重要的铁路交通枢纽。

items.def_en: 1. To fire artillery shells or explosive missiles at a place or target. 2. To remove the shell or pod from nuts, seeds, or seafood.
items.ex_en: Heavy artillery batteries began to shell the besieged fortress relentlessly at sunrise.
items.ex_zh: 重炮部队在日出时分开始对被围困的要塞展开无情的炮击。

items.def_en: to continuously attack a place with sustained heavy gunfire or bombs
items.ex_en: Enemy forces prepared to bombard the reinforced harbor fortifications throughout the night.
items.ex_zh: 敌军准备通宵连番轰炸港口加固的防御工事。

items.def_en: to attack ground targets with repeated machine-gun fire from low-flying aircraft
items.ex_en: Fighter jets dipped beneath the clouds to strafe retreating infantry columns.
items.ex_zh: 战斗机俯冲穿出云层，猛烈扫射正在撤退的步兵纵队。

items.def_en: to deliver a concentrated artillery or rocket bombardment against a position
items.ex_en: Field guns were mobilized to barrage the fortified defensive ridge before infantry advance.
items.ex_zh: 野战炮被调动起来，在步兵推进前以密集弹幕猛烈轰击加固的防御山脊。

groups.summary_en: Military forces or shooters propel ordnance, bullets, or explosive warheads toward targets. Verbs differentiate by weapon type and delivery mechanism, spanning small-arms direct fire, artillery shelling, and aerial bombardment.
groups.summary_zh: 使用枪械、重炮或航空弹药向目标进行直接或范围性的火力打击。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the aggressive propulsion of projectiles or ordnance toward targets, contrasting continuous mechanical thrust by emphasizing explosive initiation, weapon discharge mechanics, or saturation destructive intent.
groups.desc_zh: 指利用爆炸能量将弹药或弹丸射向目标的动作，区别于一般的机械发射，强调扣扳机释放瞬时能量、火力烈度或毁灭性覆盖。
groups.nuance_en: fire off: discharge rapidly or impulsively (rounds / salvo) · shoot: strike or discharge with a targeted firearm (gun / bullet) · gun: shoot deliberately with small arms (down rival / assailant) · bomb: drop explosive ordnance from aircraft (city / target) · blast away: discharge heavy firepower relentlessly (fortification / position)
groups.nuance_zh: fire off: 迅速或连续击发开火 (rounds / salvo) · shoot: 瞄准目标射击或中弹 (gun / bullet) · gun: 特指用枪支特意射击或击倒 (down rival / assailant) · bomb: 从空中投掷炸弹实施轰炸 (city / target) · blast away: 持续猛烈轰击坚固目标 (fortification / position)

groups.name: Expel & Exile · 驱逐与流放 (Forced Ouster)
groups.tip: 以权力或法令强行逐出境地

items.def_en: (+ sb) to force someone to leave a place, group, or organization
items.ex_en: He was kicked out of the university for repeatedly cheating on exams.
items.ex_zh: 他因多次考试作弊被大学开除。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to expel or force someone to leave a property or institution
items.ex_en: The judge threw out the lawsuit due to lack of evidence.
items.ex_zh: 法官因证据不足驳回了该起诉讼。

items.def_en: to legally expel a foreigner from a country for violation of immigration laws
items.ex_en: Immigration authorities took immediate legal steps to deport the convicted foreign felon.
items.ex_zh: 移民局立即采取法律措施，将这名被定罪的外籍重罪犯驱逐出境。

items.def_zh: 驱逐，赶走（尤用turf out）；铺草皮于
items.def_en: 1. (informal, chiefly British) (usually 'turf out') To force someone to leave a place, job, or organization. 2. To cover a piece of ground with turf.
items.ex_en: The rowdy patrons were promptly turfed out of the club by security.
items.ex_zh: 那些闹事的酒客很快就被保安从俱乐部里直接轰了出去。

items.def_en: to force someone to leave a building or venue, often physically
items.ex_en: The aggressive protestor was forcefully ejected from the legislative chamber by bailiffs.
items.ex_zh: 那名言行过激的抗议者被法警强行逐出了立法会议事大厅。

items.def_en: to forcibly remove someone from a position of power, office, or place
items.ex_en: A sudden boardroom rebellion managed to oust the authoritarian chief executive.
items.ex_zh: 一场突如其来的董事会倒戈成功罢免了那位专制独断的首席执行官。

items.def_en: to formally hand over an accused or convicted person to another jurisdiction
items.ex_en: The court ruled that the government must extradite the fugitive fraudster tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 法院裁定，政府必须在明天将这名在逃的诈骗犯正式引渡。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to force someone to leave an area, community, or homeland permanently
items.ex_en: The ruthless chieftain chose to cast out the rebellious warrior from the tribe.
items.ex_zh: 冷酷的酋长决定将那名叛逆的勇士永远逐出部族。

items.def_zh: 驱逐，开除；排出（气体、液体等）
items.def_en: 1. To officially force someone to leave a school, organization, or country. 2. To force air, liquid, or gas out of the body or a container.
items.ex_en: The headmaster resolved to expel the unrepentant vandal from the school immediately.
items.ex_zh: 校长毅然决定立即将这名不知悔改的破坏分子开除出校。

items.def_zh: 流放，驱逐；消除，排除（杂念或忧虑）
items.def_en: 1. To officially send someone away from a country or place as a punishment. 2. To get rid of or eliminate unwanted thoughts, feelings, or fears.
items.ex_en: The tribunal decided to banish the convicted conspirator from the realm forever.
items.ex_zh: 法庭决定将这名被定罪的阴谋者永远放逐出国境。

items.def_en: To legally force someone to leave a house, apartment, or land they are renting or occupying.
items.ex_en: The landlord obtained a court order to evict the delinquent tenants immediately.
items.ex_zh: 房东获得了一纸法院法令，立即将拖欠房租的租客驱逐出去。

items.def_zh: 清洗，清除（异己或有害人员）；净化，肃清
items.def_en: 1. To rid a group, organization, or country of unwanted people. 2. To clear or free something of impurities or guilt.
items.ex_en: The military regime moved swiftly to purge disloyal officers from the ranks.
items.ex_zh: 军政权迅速采取行动，从队伍中清洗不忠的军官。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the compulsory removal or ejection of a person or group from an institution, property, or homeland by authority or force.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过权威、法律或武力将人员从某组织、住所或国家强行驱逐赶走。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the compulsory removal of individuals from a territory or group, contrasting voluntary departure or routine dismissal by highlighting physical ejection, administrative force, or legal banishment.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过强力、司法或行政手段将人从特定领地或团体中驱除，区别于自愿离职或普通遣散，强调暴力驱逐、法律放逐与剥夺居留权。
groups.nuance_en: kick out: forcibly and unceremoniously dismiss (tenant / troublemaker) · oust: displace from power or position via struggle (regime / leader) · deport: legally remove an alien from a country (immigrant / criminal) · extradite: hand over an accused individual to another jurisdiction (fugitive / suspect) · cast out: socially or spiritually banish (pariah / heretic)
groups.nuance_zh: kick out: 粗暴、毫不留情地轰走踢出 (tenant / troublemaker) · oust: 通过争斗排挤下台或夺其职位 (regime / leader) · deport: 依据法令将外侨驱逐出境 (immigrant / criminal) · extradite: 依法将逃犯引渡回所属国 (fugitive / suspect) · cast out: 在社会或精神上彻底放逐弃绝 (pariah / heretic)

groups.name: Explain & Explicate · 解释与阐明 (Clarify, Elucidate, Explicate)
groups.tip: 澄清概念与深入解说

items.def_zh: 讲得一清二楚；详尽解释
items.def_en: to explain something clearly, explicitly, and step by step to avoid ambiguity
items.ex_en: You don't need to spell out every detail; we get the general idea.
items.ex_zh: 你不需要把每个细节都阐释得那么细，我们明白大意。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make someone aware of a fact or detail to clarify a topic
items.ex_en: The auditor was careful to point out several minor discrepancies in the report.
items.ex_zh: 审计员细心地指出了报告中的几处微小出入。

items.def_en: (+ sb through sth) to explain or demonstrate a process or topic carefully step by step
items.ex_en: Let me walk you through the new software setup process step by step.
items.ex_zh: 让我带你一步一步熟悉这款新软件的安装配置流程。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to explain complex information by dividing it into simpler, manageable parts
items.ex_en: The instructor will break down the complex algorithm into simple, manageable steps.
items.ex_zh: 导师将把这个复杂的算法分解为简单易懂的步骤来讲解。
items.ex2_en: The worn-out engine broke down unexpectedly during the heavy morning highway traffic.
items.ex2_zh: 这台老旧破损的发动机在清晨繁忙的公路车流中意外抛锚报废了。

items.def_zh: 详细阐述，进一步说明；详尽制定
items.def_en: 1. To explain, describe, or develop something in greater detail (often followed by 'on' or 'upon'). 2. To work out or develop a plan, theory, or system carefully.
items.ex_en: The minister declined to elaborate upon the proposed changes to the tax policy.
items.ex_zh: 部长拒绝就拟议中的税收政策改革作进一步详细说明。

items.def_zh: 阐明，使清楚明了；使（液体等）澄清
items.def_en: 1. To make something clearer or easier to understand by explaining it in more detail. 2. To make a liquid pure or clear by removing impurities.
items.ex_en: The spokesperson issued a formal statement to clarify the government's official stance.
items.ex_zh: 发言人发表了一份正式声明，以阐明政府的官方立场。

items.def_en: to analyze the intricate components or hidden implications of a complex statement or concept
items.ex_en: In this seminar, we will unpack the hidden philosophical assumptions behind modern law.
items.ex_zh: 在本次研讨会中，我们将剖析现代法律背后隐藏的哲学假设。

items.def_en: (formal) To make something clear and easy to understand by explaining it thoroughly.
items.ex_en: The professor attempted to elucidate the difficult theoretical concept with practical examples.
items.ex_zh: 教授试图用实际范例来阐明这个晦涩的理论概念。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ on) to explain an idea, theory, or belief in detail and with formal analysis
items.ex_en: The philosopher was invited to expound his radical theories on moral consciousness.
items.ex_zh: 这位哲学家受邀系统阐述他关于道德意识的激进理论。

items.def_zh: 改述，重述，换种说法表达
items.def_en: To express an idea, statement, or question again using different words to make it clearer or more acceptable.
items.ex_en: Could you please rephrase your question so the audience can understand it better?
items.ex_zh: 你能把问题换个说法重述一遍，以便听众更好地理解吗？

items.def_zh: 使明白易懂，使（复杂或神秘的事物）明朗化
items.def_en: To make a complex, technical, or mysterious subject clear and easy for ordinary people to understand.
items.ex_en: Her best-selling book aims to demystify artificial intelligence for ordinary readers.
items.ex_zh: 她的畅销书旨在为普通读者揭开人工智能的神秘面纱，使其通俗易懂。

items.def_zh: 详细阐述，深入剖析，系统解释
items.def_en: (formal) To analyze and explain a complex text, idea, or theory in clear, systematic detail.
items.ex_en: The scholar will explicate the medieval manuscript line by line during today's lecture.
items.ex_zh: 学者将在今天的讲座中逐行深入剖析这部中世纪手稿。

groups.summary_en: A speaker or writer makes a complex, obscure, or misunderstood topic clear, accessible, or systematically detailed to an audience. Verbs vary in formality from conversational rewording to scholarly, text-level hermeneutic analysis.
groups.summary_zh: 对抽象或费解的内容进行澄清、深入阐述或学理剖析。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the cognitive unpacking of complex ideas to render them intelligible, contrasting mere recitation or assertion by emphasizing logical decomposition, pedagogy, or the removal of ambiguity.
groups.desc_zh: 指对复杂观念、文本或机制进行认知层面的解构以使其通晓，区别于简单的陈述或断言，强调逻辑拆解、循序引导与消除晦涩。
groups.nuance_en: clarify: remove ambiguity and ensure comprehension (intentions / statement) · unpack: dissect complex components step-by-step (concept / data) · elucidate: shed scholarly light upon obscure topics (theory / mystery) · spell out: express explicitly without omission (terms / details) · walk through: guide incrementally through an intricate process (steps / procedure)
groups.nuance_zh: clarify: 消除歧义以澄清真实意图 (intentions / statement) · unpack: 细致拆解分析复杂概念或数据 (concept / data) · elucidate: 阐明晦涩深奥的学说与原理 (theory / mystery) · spell out: 毫无保留地逐字逐句讲明 (terms / details) · walk through: 手把手演示并逐步梳理流程 (steps / procedure)

groups.name: Fluster & Mortify · 慌乱与羞惭 (Disconcert, Fluster, Mortify)
groups.tip: 从局促慌乱到羞愧难堪

items.def_en: to make someone feel anxious, upset, or shaken in composure
items.ex_en: The sudden change in leadership served to unsettle the entire sales department.
items.ex_zh: 领导层的突然变动让整个销售部门的人心绪不宁。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to confuse, fluster, or upset someone's composure
items.ex_en: Her blunt and aggressive questioning threatened to throw off the young candidate completely.
items.ex_zh: 她直截了当且咄咄逼人的质问差点让那位年轻候选人心慌意乱。

items.def_en: to cause someone to feel self-conscious, awkward, or ill at ease
items.ex_en: He did not wish to embarrass his colleague in front of the board.
items.ex_zh: 他不想在董事会面前让自己的同事感到难堪。

items.def_zh: 使慌乱，使局促不安，使胆怯
items.def_en: 1. (informal, chiefly negative) To disturb, shock, or upset someone's calm confidence.
items.ex_en: The harsh criticism from hostile reporters did not faze the veteran diplomat at all.
items.ex_zh: 来自敌对记者的严厉批评丝毫没有让这位资深外交官慌乱。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to make someone nervous, flustered, or rattled
items.ex_en: The sudden siren seemed to rattle up the rookie driver at the intersection.
items.ex_zh: 十字路口突然响起的警笛声似乎让那个新手司机有些慌乱紧张。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to distress, unsettle, or severely disturb someone's composure
items.ex_en: The new CEO plans to shake up the entire management structure.
items.ex_zh: 新任首席执行官计划对整个管理架构进行大洗牌。

items.def_zh: 使尴尬，使慌乱，使局促不安；打乱（计划等）
items.def_en: To make someone feel suddenly uneasy, confused, or embarrassed.
items.ex_en: The investigator's direct accusation seemed to disconcert the usually unflappable executive.
items.ex_zh: 调查员直接的指控似乎让那位向来沉着冷静的高管感到了局促不安。

items.raw_cluster: 使困惑与使慌乱 Confuse & Fluster
items.def_zh: 使慌乱，使紧张不安，使心慌意乱
items.def_en: (often passive) To make someone feel nervous, hurried, and confused.
items.ex_en: The unexpected arrival of the inspectors flustered the entire kitchen staff.
items.ex_zh: 检查员的突击到来让整个厨房的工作人员都陷入了慌乱。

items.raw_cluster: 使尴尬与使困窘 Embarrass & Fluster
items.def_zh: 使窘迫，使难堪，使尴尬；挫败，打乱（计划）
items.def_en: (formal) To make someone feel uneasy, embarrassed, or confused; to thwart or frustrate.
items.ex_en: The lawyer's sharp cross-examination was designed to discomfit the hostile witness.
items.ex_zh: 律师尖锐的交叉盘问旨在让那个敌意证人陷入尴尬与窘迫。

items.def_zh: 使深感羞愧，使难堪，使极为尴尬；克制（肉欲），苦修
items.def_en: 1. (often passive) To make someone feel deeply embarrassed, ashamed, or humiliated. 2. (religion) To subdue bodily desires through self-discipline or suffering.
items.ex_en: She was deeply mortified when her private email was forwarded to the entire firm.
items.ex_zh: 当她的私人邮件被转发给全公司时，她深感羞愧难当。

items.raw_cluster: 使尴尬与使困窘 Embarrass & Fluster
items.def_zh: 使羞愧，使难堪，使局促不安
items.def_en: (formal, usually passive) To make someone feel ashamed, embarrassed, or self-conscious.
items.ex_en: He stood abashed before his austere father, unable to utter a single excuse.
items.ex_zh: 他满面羞愧地立在严厉的父亲面前，找不出半句借口。

items.def_en: to crush someone's dignity and pride profoundly in the eyes of others
items.ex_en: The tyrannical manager sought to humiliate the junior staff member in open view.
items.ex_zh: 那个专横的经理试图在众目睽睽之下彻底羞辱那名初级员工。

groups.summary_en: An awkward event, error, or exposure strips away someone's composure, self-esteem, or poise. The emotional intensity progresses from slight unease and agitation to paralyzing, excruciating public humiliation.
groups.summary_zh: 突发尴尬或失态剥夺从容镇定，由轻微局促升格至无地自容的羞辱。
groups.desc_en: Denotes destabilizing an agent's mental composure through surprise, embarrassment, or awkwardness, contrasting physical immobilization by highlighting loss of poise and cognitive disorientation.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过意外、尴尬或窘境瓦解个体心理防线与镇定状态，区别于纯肉体压制，强调神态失常、手足无措与认知紊乱。
groups.nuance_en: unsettle: disturb baseline equilibrium or confidence (market / nerves) · throw off: break rhythm or concentration unexpectedly (timing / defense) · fluster: induce agitated and clumsy confusion (speaker / staff) · disconcert: ruffle calm through awkward surprise (opponent / guest) · faze: disturb composure sufficiently to hinder action (criticism / pressure)
groups.nuance_zh: unsettle: 动摇基本平衡或让人心神不宁 (market / nerves) · throw off: 意外打乱节奏、防备或注意力 (timing / defense) · fluster: 使人慌乱失措而举止笨拙 (speaker / staff) · disconcert: 因突兀或尴尬局面使人局促不安 (opponent / guest) · faze: 因外界压力而心生畏怯、乱了阵脚 (criticism / pressure)

groups.name: Fold & Crumple · 折叠与卷皱 (Pleat, Crimp, Crumple)
groups.tip: 折叠弯曲形成褶皱

items.def_en: (+ sth) to bend paper or cloth repeatedly so that it forms a smaller, neater shape
items.ex_en: Please fold up the clean linen neatly before placing it into the closet.
items.ex_zh: 请在将干净的亚麻布放进衣橱前，将其整齐地折叠起来。
items.ex2_en: This lightweight camping chair folds up easily into a compact travel bag.
items.ex2_zh: 这款轻便野营椅可以轻松折叠进紧凑的旅行袋里。

items.def_en: to make a line or ridge appear in cloth, paper, or skin by pressing or folding
items.ex_en: Sitting in that tight seat for hours will crease your silk trousers badly.
items.ex_zh: 在那个狭小的座位上坐好几个小时会把你丝绸裤子压出严重的折痕。
items.ex2_en: This delicate linen fabric will crease easily if you sit for too long.
items.ex2_zh: 如果你坐太久，这种精致的亚麻面料很容易起皱。

items.def_en: 1. To crimp or form fine crinkles or wrinkles in fabric, paper, or hair.
items.ex_en: Specialized machines are used to crepe the paper for delicate medical bandages.
items.ex_zh: 专用机器用于使纸张起细皱，以便制作精细的医用绷带。

items.def_en: 1. To fold cloth or paper into neat, flat, parallel pleats and press or sew them in place.
items.ex_en: The tailor took great care to pleat the heavy wool skirt perfectly.
items.ex_zh: 裁缝极为用心地为这条厚羊毛裙压制出完美的褶裥。

items.def_zh: 使起褶，压褶；使（头发）卷曲；阻碍，抑制
items.def_en: 1. To press or pinch hair, fabric, or pastry into small neat folds or waves. 2. To restrict or have a limiting effect on something.
items.ex_en: She used a fork to crimp the edges of the pastry securely.
items.ex_zh: 她用叉子把油酥面皮的边缘压出规整的花边并封牢。

items.def_en: to form thin, shallow folds or fine wrinkles across a surface
items.ex_en: Fine lines began to crinkle around his eyes whenever he smiled warmly.
items.ex_zh: 每当他温暖地微笑时，眼角便会泛起细密的微皱。
items.ex2_en: The bright sunlight caused him to crinkle his eyes against the glare.
items.ex2_zh: 明亮的阳光使他眯起眼睛以避开刺眼的强光。

items.def_zh: 卷起，收拢（旗帜、帆、雨伞等）
items.def_en: 1. To roll or fold up neatly and securely, such as a flag, sail, or umbrella.
items.ex_en: The sailors worked swiftly to furl the massive sails against the rising gale.
items.ex_zh: 水手们迅速行动，迎着逐渐增强的大风将巨大的帆收拢卷好。
items.ex2_en: The ship's white sails furled smoothly as the strong offshore wind subsided.
items.ex2_zh: 随着强劲的离岸风平息，船上的白帆顺畅地卷拢了起来。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to crush paper, cloth, or metal into a compact, wrinkled mass
items.ex_en: Frustrated by the poor draft, the writer crumpled up the manuscript page.
items.ex_zh: 由于对拙劣的初稿感到沮丧，作家将那一页手稿揉成了一团。
items.ex2_en: Thin tissue paper crumpled up instantly under the heavy weight of the books.
items.ex2_zh: 薄薄的棉纸在沉重的书籍重压下立刻皱成了一团。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to squeeze paper or fabric tightly together into a disordered shape
items.ex_en: The child liked to scrunch up colorful wrapping paper into tight little balls.
items.ex_zh: 那个孩子喜欢把彩色的包装纸捏皱成紧实的小球。
items.ex2_en: The thin foil scrunched up easily into a tiny ball between my fingers.
items.ex2_zh: 那张薄铝箔在我的手指间轻易地皱成了一个小球。

items.def_zh: （使）起皱，揉皱；（由于受伤、失去意识等）瘫倒，垮掉
items.def_en: 1. To crush or press paper or fabric into untidy folds and wrinkles. 2. To fall or collapse suddenly to the ground from weakness, pain, or injury.
items.ex_en: If you pack silk dresses so tightly, they will inevitably crumple during transit.
items.ex_zh: 如果你把丝绸连衣裙塞得这么紧，它们在运输途中势必会起皱。
items.ex2_en: Careless packing will quickly crumple your expensive linen shirts during the long journey.
items.ex2_zh: 在漫长的旅途中，粗心的打包很快就会把你昂贵的亚麻衬衫弄皱。

items.def_en: to make something untidy or uneven by forming irregular folds
items.ex_en: The playful wind managed to rumple his carefully combed hair within seconds.
items.ex_zh: 顽皮的风在几秒钟之内就将他精心梳理的头发吹得凌乱不整。
items.ex2_en: His bedsheets rumpled untidily as he tossed and turned throughout the restless night.
items.ex2_zh: 他在不安的夜晚辗转反侧，床单被弄得凌乱不堪。

items.def_en: 1. (formal or technical) To fold into neat, fan-like pleats or ridges.
items.ex_en: The artist sought to plicate the stiff vellum into elegant architectural forms.
items.ex_zh: 艺术家试图将坚硬的羊皮纸折叠成优雅的扇状建筑造型。

groups.summary_en: An agent alters the planar structure of pliable material (cloth, paper, metal) through regular geometric creasing, decorative rolling, or chaotic destructive crushing.
groups.summary_zh: 对柔韧材质进行规律折裥、卷边起皱或无序揉捏折损。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the spatial deformation of planar materials along bends, ridges, or chaotic compressions, contrasting clean cutting or tearing by emphasizing surface manipulation and volumetric compaction.
groups.desc_zh: 指片状材料通过折弯、起棱或杂乱挤压发生形变，区别于剪裁与撕裂，强调表面的几何重塑、结构性收叠或体积压缩。
groups.nuance_en: fold up: bend double into a compact form (chair / letter) · pleat: press into neat, uniform parallel folds (skirt / drapery) · crimp: pinch or press into small ridges (edge / pastry) · crumple up: crush into a chaotic, wrinkled mass (paper / sheet) · furl: roll tightly and secure against a spar (sail / umbrella)
groups.nuance_zh: fold up: 规则对折收拢以缩小体积 (chair / letter) · pleat: 压制出整齐平行的规则褶裥 (skirt / drapery) · crimp: 将边缘夹紧起波浪褶或压痕 (edge / pastry) · crumple up: 揉捏压皱成杂乱的一团 (paper / sheet) · furl: 紧密卷起并绑牢固定 (sail / umbrella)

groups.name: Fret to Infuriate · 恼人与激怒 (Irk, Peeve, Exasperate)
groups.tip: 反复刺激招致反感恼火

items.def_en: to make someone slightly angry or upset, often through repeated actions
items.ex_en: The incessant dripping from the faulty bathroom tap began to annoy the tenants.
items.ex_zh: 故障浴室水龙头不停的滴水声开始让房客们感到心烦恼火。

items.raw_cluster: 激怒与使烦恼 Anger & Irritate
items.def_en: (formal) to make someone feel annoyed, dissatisfied, or unhappy.
items.ex_en: Any violation of the agreed protocol will severely displease the international committee.
items.ex_zh: 对既定协议的任何违背都将使国际委员会感到极为不快。

items.raw_cluster: 激怒与使烦恼 Anger & Irritate
items.def_en: (informal, often passive) to make someone annoyed, irritated, or resentful.
items.ex_en: She was peeved by his constant habit of interrupting her during presentations.
items.ex_zh: 他总是在做报告时打断她，这一习惯让她大为恼火。

items.raw_cluster: 激怒与使烦恼 Anger & Irritate
items.def_en: to annoy, irritate, or bother someone persistently.
items.ex_en: His dismissive attitude continued to irk his superiors throughout the lengthy audit.
items.ex_zh: 在漫长的审计过程中，他不以为然的态度持续惹恼着他的上级。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to make someone annoyed or angry
items.ex_en: Her rude behavior at the family dinner really served to tick off everybody.
items.ex_zh: 她在家庭晚宴上的粗鲁举止真把所有人都给惹怒了。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to deliberately annoy or tease someone until they become angry
items.ex_en: The older brother would deliberately wind up his sister until she lost patience.
items.ex_zh: 哥哥总是故意招惹妹妹，直到她彻底失去耐心发脾气。

items.raw_cluster: 使不满与使恼怒 Discontent & Irritate
items.def_en: (formal or archaic) to make someone dissatisfied or discontented.
items.ex_en: Nothing could discontent the humble monks who sought only quiet spiritual contemplation.
items.ex_zh: 对于只寻求静谧灵修的谦逊僧侣而言，没有什么能令他们心生不满。

items.def_en: to bring distress, confusion, or sharp annoyance to someone
items.ex_en: These unresolved diplomatic ambiguities vex the negotiators as the final deadline approaches.
items.ex_zh: 随着最终截止日期的临近，这些未解决的外交含混之处令谈判人员倍感困扰。

items.raw_cluster: 激怒与使烦恼 Anger & Irritate
items.def_en: 1. (informal, often 'rile up') to make someone angry, annoyed, or irritated. 2. to make liquid cloudy by stirring up sediment.
items.ex_en: His provocative remarks were intentionally crafted to rile the conservative audience.
items.ex_zh: 他那些挑衅性的言论是刻意设计用来激怒保守派听众的。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to make someone extremely angry or deeply annoyed
items.ex_en: His arrogant arrogance managed to piss off the entire development team yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 他傲慢自大的态度昨天彻底惹火了整个开发团队。

items.raw_cluster: 激怒与使烦恼 Anger & Irritate
items.def_zh: 激怒，使极度恼火，使大为气恼
items.def_en: to make someone extremely annoyed, irritated, or frustrated.
items.ex_en: The constant bureaucratic delays began to exasperate even the most patient investors.
items.ex_zh: 持续不断的官僚主义延误开始让哪怕最有耐心的投资者也大为气恼。

items.def_en: to make someone extremely angry and furious beyond endurance
items.ex_en: The blatant dishonesty displayed by the politician will infuriate the ordinary taxpayers.
items.ex_zh: 那位政客所表现出的公然不诚实必将激怒普通纳税人。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify provoking negative affective reactions in another, mounting from mild irritation and displeasure to utter, frenzied exasperation.
groups.summary_zh: 表示引发他人的负面情绪，自轻微的不悦、厌烦逐渐递进到极度抓狂与暴怒。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the graduated provocation of negative affect from low-grade friction to active irritation, contrasting explosive wrath by focusing on recurrent vexations, persistent chafing, or deliberate prodding.
groups.desc_zh: 表述负面情绪从隐约摩擦向显著烦躁的渐进诱发，区别于暴怒发作，强调琐碎事物的反复滋扰、心理磨损或故意激惹。
groups.nuance_en: annoy: perturb through recurrent minor bothers (habits / noise) · irk: wear down patience via tedious irritation (delay / bureaucracy) · peeve: grate upon specific personal sensitivities (pet peeve / attitude) · vex: agitate with puzzling or intractable trouble (problem / question) · wind up: deliberately bait someone into losing temper (sibling / opponent)
groups.nuance_zh: annoy: 因琐碎烦人之事引起轻度不快 (habits / noise) · irk: 因冗长厌烦之事物消磨耐心 (delay / bureaucracy) · peeve: 触犯个人特定怪癖或禁忌 (pet peeve / attitude) · vex: 陷入棘手难题引起焦躁困扰 (problem / question) · wind up: 存心言语挑拨促使对方发火 (sibling / opponent)

groups.name: Grumble & Grouse · 牢骚与怨言 (Habitual or Petty Complaining)
groups.tip: 嘀咕嘟囔、发牢骚的不满态度

items.def_en: (British informal) to mutter repetitively in a grumbling tone
items.ex_en: The grumpy gardener would chunter to himself while weeding the overgrown flowerbeds.
items.ex_zh: 那个脾气暴躁的花匠在杂草丛生的花坛除草时，嘴里总爱低声嘟囔抱怨。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to complain constantly or pettily about something irritating
items.ex_en: The factory workers gathered outside to gripe about the miserable working conditions.
items.ex_zh: 工厂工人们聚集在外面，对恶劣的工作条件不停地发牢骚。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to complain persistently about something in an annoying or dissatisfied way
items.ex_en: He will constantly moan about the cold weather whenever winter arrives in town.
items.ex_zh: 每当冬天降临这座小镇，他就会没完没了地抱怨天气寒冷。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to complain repeatedly about something in an irritating, high-pitched, or petulant tone
items.ex_en: The spoiled child started to whine about having to finish his vegetables.
items.ex_zh: 那个被宠坏的孩子开始哼哼唧唧地抱怨不得不把蔬菜吃完。

items.def_zh: 抱怨，发牢骚，挑剔；使侧移，侧滑
items.def_en: 1. (informal) to complain or grumble constantly; find fault. [I, T] 2. to move or cause an aircraft or vessel to move sideways.
items.ex_en: The old clerk would constantly crab about the noise from the street.
items.ex_zh: 那位老店员总是没完没了地挑剔抱怨街上的噪音。

items.def_en: (+ about/at) to complain petulantly about trivial matters
items.ex_en: The passengers began to grouse about the unexpected delay at the boarding gate.
items.ex_zh: 乘客们在登机口开始对突如其来的延误发起了牢骚。

items.def_en: (informal) to complain habitually about minor grievances
items.ex_en: He will find any petty excuse to kvetch about his daily commute.
items.ex_zh: 他总能找到任何微不足道的借口来对自己每天的通勤大倒苦水。

items.def_zh: 抱怨，发牢骚；发隆隆声，咕哝
items.def_en: 1. to complain quietly about something in a bad-tempered way. [I] 2. to make a low, heavy, continuous sound.
items.ex_en: The tired soldiers grumbled beneath their breath about the grueling morning march.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的士兵们在私下里对艰苦的晨间行军低声抱怨。

items.def_zh: 哭闹，啼哭抱怨（尤指小孩）；变成灰色
items.def_en: (informal) to whimper, fret, or complain continuously, especially of a child.
items.ex_en: The teething infant would grizzle for hours unless her mother held her.
items.ex_zh: 除非母亲抱着，否则那个正在长牙的婴儿会连续啼哭哭闹数小时。

items.def_en: (informal) to complain loudly and continuously in an irritating manner
items.ex_en: Stop trying to bellyache about the strict rules and just get to work.
items.ex_zh: 别再没完没了地抱怨严格的规矩了，赶紧去工作吧。

items.def_zh: 吹毛求疵，挑剔，无端抱怨
items.def_en: to complain continually about unimportant things; find fault unreasonably.
items.ex_en: Critics continued to carp at petty errors in the otherwise magnificent academic translation.
items.ex_zh: 批评家们继续对这部原本极其出色的学术译作中的微小瑕疵吹毛求疵。

items.def_zh: 发牢骚，抱怨，在背后恶语中伤
items.def_en: (informal) to complain persistently, spitefully, or unpleasant about someone or something.
items.ex_en: The disgruntled employees gathered by the coffee machine to bitch about their boss.
items.ex_zh: 心怀不满的员工们聚在咖啡机旁，恶狠狠地数落起老板的不是。

groups.summary_en: These verbs depict the expressive manner of expressing discontent through low, peevish muttering, petty fault-finding, or persistent whining rather than formal protest.
groups.summary_zh: 刻画以嘟囔、挑刺、刻薄咒骂或小声嘀咕等恼人姿态持续发牢骚、发泄不满。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the vocalization of chronic, low-stakes dissatisfaction, contrasting constructive grievance or formal protest by emphasizing habitual, petty, or undertone grumbling.
groups.desc_zh: 指就琐碎事由持续宣泄低烈度不满，区别于建设性批评或正式抗议，强调习惯性、发泄性、常带窃窃私语或令人厌烦的牢骚。
groups.nuance_en: grumble: mutter low, indistinct complaints (stomach / workers) · gripe about: obsessively air petty complaints (food / hours) · whine about: complain in a high-pitched, childish tone (rules / chores) · grouse: voice sullen chronic discontent (conditions / pay) · kvetch: engage in relentless, reflexive complaining (weather / health)
groups.nuance_zh: grumble: 私下咕哝嘀咕低声抱怨 (stomach / workers) · gripe about: 纠缠于鸡毛蒜皮的琐事发牢骚 (food / hours) · whine about: 用尖刻幼弱的哭腔哼唧哀怨 (rules / chores) · grouse: 阴郁且习惯性地宣泄不满情绪 (conditions / pay) · kvetch: 成为条件反射式的无休止唠叨挑刺 (weather / health)

groups.name: Increase & Intensify · 增加与增强 (Amplify, Escalate, Multiply)
groups.tip: 数量成倍增加或强度规模放大

items.def_en: 1. To become louder, or to make a sound louder.
items.ex_en: The chanting began to louden across the ancient valley as dawn approached.
items.ex_zh: 随着黎明临近，赞美诗的吟唱声在古老的山谷间回荡并逐渐变响。
items.ex2_en: The enthusiastic sound engineer decided to louden the background music during the climax.
items.ex2_zh: 热情的高级音效师决定在高潮部分调大背景音乐的音量。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to increase the level, volume, or speed of sth sharply
items.ex_en: The pharmaceutical company decided to ramp up the production of life-saving vaccines.
items.ex_zh: 这家制药公司决定大幅提高这种救命疫苗的生产量。
items.ex2_en: Electric vehicle production will ramp up significantly over the next few financial quarters.
items.ex2_zh: 电动汽车的产量将在未来几个财政季度内大幅提升。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to increase the amount, speed, or intensity of an activity or effort
items.ex_en: The hospital had to step up security measures following the recent incident.
items.ex_zh: 在最近的事件发生后，医院不得不加强安保措施。

items.def_en: to make something stronger, louder, or more pronounced
items.ex_en: The echo chamber tended to amplify extremist political rhetoric across social networks.
items.ex_zh: 回音室效应往往会在社交网络上放大极端的政治言论。

items.def_zh: 增强（药效、生化反应等），加强
items.def_en: 1. (pharmacology / biology) To increase the power, potency, or effectiveness of a drug or biochemical reaction.
items.ex_en: This chemical agent is known to potentiate the therapeutic effects of antibiotics.
items.ex_zh: 已知这种化学试剂能显著增强抗生素的治疗效果。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to increase the intensity, volume, or power of sth, especially by turning a control
items.ex_en: The excited teenagers decided to crank up the stereo system for the party.
items.ex_zh: 兴奋的青少年们决定把派对上的音响音量开到最大。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to increase sth steadily and repeatedly by increments
items.ex_en: The coach decided to ratchet up training intensity right before the championship finals.
items.ex_zh: 教练决定在锦标赛决赛前逐步提升训练强度。
items.ex2_en: Diplomatic tensions ratcheted up rapidly after the border incident between both neighboring countries.
items.ex2_zh: 两国边境事件发生后，外交紧张局势迅速逐步升级。

items.def_en: to increase rapidly in intensity, scale, or severity
items.ex_en: Border skirmishes threaten to escalate into an all-out war between both nations.
items.ex_zh: 边境冲突恐将迅速升级为两国之间的全面战争。
items.ex2_en: Provocative rhetoric could escalate regional tensions into a full-scale armed military conflict.
items.ex2_zh: 挑衅性的言论可能会使地区紧张局势升级为全面的武装军事冲突。

items.def_zh: （使组织或器官）肥大，（使）过度增大
items.def_en: 1. (medicine / biology) To enlarge excessively due to an increase in the size of cells, or to cause an organ or tissue to do so.
items.ex_en: Chronic hypertension caused the left ventricle of his heart to hypertrophy abnormally.
items.ex_zh: 慢性高血压导致他的左心室异常肥大。
items.ex2_en: Consistent heavy weightlifting will hypertrophy skeletal muscle fibers over several dedicated months.
items.ex2_zh: 持续的大重量举重训练会在几个月内使骨骼肌纤维肥大。

items.def_zh: （使）加倍，极大增强（努力、力量等）
items.def_en: 1. To become much greater or stronger, or make something much greater or stronger, especially one's efforts.
items.ex_en: The rescue team will redouble their efforts to locate the missing climbers.
items.ex_zh: 救援队将加倍努力搜寻失踪的登山者。
items.ex2_en: Their collective enthusiasm redoubled after hearing the inspiring news from the expedition leader.
items.ex2_zh: 听到探险队长鼓舞人心的消息后，大家的热情倍增。

items.def_en: 1. To become five times as great, or multiply something by five.
items.ex_en: The tech firm managed to quintuple its profits within just three years.
items.ex_zh: 这家科技公司在短短三年内将利润增加了四倍（增至五倍）。
items.ex2_en: The initial investment quintupled within five years due to unprecedented market expansion.
items.ex2_zh: 由于前所未有的市场扩张，这笔初始投资在五年内增长了四倍。

items.def_en: to increase something to the highest possible degree or amount
items.ex_en: We must optimize production lines to maximize overall output before the holiday.
items.ex_zh: 我们必须优化生产线，以便在节前将总产量提升至最高。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote escalating, multiplying, or augmenting a measurable quality, capacity, volume, or biological dimension across an intensifying scale.
groups.summary_zh: 在数量、强度、体积或效应上呈现级数递增、成倍累加或显著强化。
groups.desc_en: Denotes a dynamic, often deliberate upward escalation of magnitude, volume, or severity, contrasting steady linear growth by emphasizing intentional force, gear shifts, or compounding intensity.
groups.desc_zh: 指幅度、体量或剧烈程度发生动态且常为刻意推动的升级，区别于稳态的线性增长，强调人为加码、挡位切换或复合增强机制。
groups.nuance_en: ramp up: scale up production or activity systematically (production / efforts) · step up: act decisively to increase pace or intervention (security / pressure) · amplify: magnify intensity, signal, or effect (sound / impact) · ratchet up: increment steadily without allowing regression (rates / tension) · escalate: intensify conflict or crisis dramatically (violence / dispute)
groups.nuance_zh: ramp up: 有计划、成规模地逐步提升产能或投入 (production / efforts) · step up: 采取果断手段加强防范或行动力度 (security / pressure) · amplify: 放大信号、声量或连锁影响力 (sound / impact) · ratchet up: 单向度步步咬合收紧、不可逆递增 (rates / tension) · escalate: 使冲突或危机急剧恶化扩大 (violence / dispute)

groups.name: Inform & Apprise · 告知与通知 (Inform, Notify, Apprise)
groups.tip: 向他人传达信息或讲述情况

items.def_zh: 告诉，告知；讲述，叙述；分辨，识别
items.def_en: 1. To communicate information, facts, or instructions to someone. 2. To narrate a story. 3. To distinguish or discern.
items.ex_en: Please tell me the exact arrival time of the overseas delegacy tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 请告诉我明天海外代表团确切的抵达时间。

items.def_zh: 告诉，告知；讲述（tell 的过去式及过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense and past participle of tell: to communicate information or narrate a story.
items.ex_en: The manager told us that the annual budget was approved this morning.
items.ex_zh: 经理告诉我们年度预算已在今天上午获得批准。

items.def_zh: 通知，告知；对……产生影响，贯穿于
items.def_en: 1. To give someone facts or information. 2. (formal) To influence or pervade the character of something.
items.ex_en: The human resources department will inform employees of the new benefits policy.
items.ex_zh: 人力资源部将把新福利政策正式告知员工。

items.def_en: (+ on) to instruct or give detailed background information to someone beforehand
items.ex_en: The intelligence director will brief the president on the unfolding diplomatic crisis.
items.ex_zh: 情报局长将向总统简要汇报不断发酵的外交危机。

items.def_en: (+ of/that) to formally notify or make someone aware of an official matter or development
items.ex_en: The bank advised the client that their international wire transfer was completed.
items.ex_zh: 银行正式通知客户其跨国电汇已经完成。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to give someone essential information or an explanation about a situation
items.ex_en: Can someone please clue me in on what happened during the meeting?
items.ex_zh: 能有人给我讲讲会上究竟发生了什么吗？

items.def_en: (+ sb) to give someone the necessary details and background facts about something
items.ex_en: Sarah took a few minutes to fill him in on the project.
items.ex_zh: 萨拉花了几分钟向他交底该项目的详细情况。

items.def_zh: 通风报信；向…透露秘密消息
items.def_en: (+ sb) to give advance, secret, or cautionary information to someone about an upcoming event
items.ex_en: An anonymous caller decided to tip off the police about the robbery.
items.ex_zh: 一名匿名来电者决定向警方通风报信，揭露那起抢劫案。

items.def_en: 1. (+ of/that) To formally or officially inform someone about something.
items.ex_en: The agency failed to notify affected residents of the severe water contamination.
items.ex_zh: 该机构未正式通知受影响居民有关严重水源污染的情况。

items.def_en: (+ on/about) to provide explanation or truth to someone who was previously unaware
items.ex_en: The professor kindly offered to enlighten the class on quantum mechanics principles.
items.ex_zh: 教授亲切地向全班同学阐明了量子力学的原理。

items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To make someone or oneself familiar with or informed about something.
items.ex_en: New employees must acquaint themselves with all company safety regulations immediately.
items.ex_zh: 新员工必须立即熟悉公司的所有安全规章制度。

items.def_en: 1. (+ of) (formal) To tell or inform someone officially about important facts or news.
items.ex_en: The ambassador must apprise the council of sudden changes in border security.
items.ex_zh: 大使必须将边境安全的突发变动正式告知理事会。

groups.summary_en: A speaker or formal authority conveys factual information, official updates, or instructions to another person. Verbs range from general conversational communication to structured administrative or diplomatic notifications.
groups.summary_zh: 向他人传达事实、官方动态或决定，由口头传话延伸至公文通告。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the transmission of functional knowledge from one agent to another, contrasting casual chatter by highlighting epistemic enablement, situational readiness, or official notification.
groups.desc_zh: 指将功能性信息或警讯从传递者定向赋权给接收者，区别于漫无目的的闲聊，强调认知校准、战备知情或程序化告知。
groups.nuance_en: inform: convey formal factual knowledge officially (public / authorities) · brief: impart concise, mission-critical instructions (team / president) · advise: formally notify or prudently recommend (client / passenger) · fill in: provide missing context or background (colleague / newcomer) · tip off: pass confidential or warning intelligence discreetly (police / investigators)
groups.nuance_zh: inform: 正式系统地传达确凿事实 (public / authorities) · brief: 言简意赅地传授关键指令与动态 (team / president) · advise: 审慎提议或依规向当事人通告 (client / passenger) · fill in: 填补信息空白以补全来龙去脉 (colleague / newcomer) · tip off: 秘密通风报信以示预警 (police / investigators)

groups.name: Ingestion Manners & Voracity · 进食与狼吞虎咽 (Munch, Devour, Guzzle)
groups.tip: 大口吞吃与咕嘟豪饮的方式

items.def_zh: 无精打采地吃；挑剔地吃
items.def_en: (+ sth) to eat only small amounts of food reluctantly or without appetite
items.ex_en: Feeling quite nauseated, the sick child could only pick at his dinner.
items.ex_zh: 生病的孩子感到相当恶心，只能无精打采地吃着晚饭。

items.def_en: [I/T] take small, gentle bites of food tentatively or slowly
items.ex_en: The nervous guest began to nibble quietly on a small chocolate biscuit.
items.ex_zh: 紧张的客人开始安静地一点一点啃着一小块巧克力饼干。

items.def_zh: 大快朵颐；津津有味地吃
items.def_en: (+ sth) to start eating food eagerly and with relish
items.ex_en: After hiking all afternoon, we couldn't wait to tuck into hot stew.
items.ex_zh: 徒步了一下午后，我们迫不及待地大快朵颐吃起热炖菜。

items.def_zh: 大声咀嚼，津津有味地嚼
items.def_en: (+ on) To eat food steadily and with a noticeable chewing sound, especially crisp or crunchy items.
items.ex_en: The children sat by the fireplace to munch on freshly popped corn.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们围坐在壁炉旁，津津有味地嚼着刚爆好的爆米花。

items.def_en: 1. (formal or technical) To take food, liquid, or medicine into the body by swallowing or absorbing it. 2. (technical) To take in or assimilate data or information.
items.ex_en: The creature had managed to ingest dangerous amounts of discarded plastic waste.
items.ex_zh: 这只动物体内摄入了危险数量的废弃塑料垃圾。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to eat sth voraciously and in a hurry
items.ex_en: He had to scarf down his lunch before catching the departing train.
items.ex_zh: 在赶这趟即将发出的火车前，他不得不狼吞虎咽地吃完午饭。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to eat food very quickly and greedily
items.ex_en: The starving dog began to wolf down the bowl of meat greedily.
items.ex_zh: 饥饿的狗开始贪婪地狼吞虎咽吃掉那碗肉。

items.def_zh: 狼吞虎咽地咽下（不经咀嚼）
items.def_en: (+ down) swallow food whole or quickly without proper chewing
items.ex_en: He tended to bolt down entire sandwiches without chewing them thoroughly first.
items.ex_zh: 他往往看都不细看，整块三明治不嚼就直接咽了下去。

items.def_zh: 狼吞虎咽地吃，吞食；如饥似渴地阅读（或观赏）；吞噬，毁灭
items.def_en: 1. To eat food quickly, greedily, and completely. 2. To read, look at, or listen to something with intense eagerness. 3. (of fire, disease, or emotion) To consume or destroy something completely.
items.ex_en: The ravenous hikers began to devour the entire roast chicken within minutes.
items.ex_zh: 饥肠辘辘的徒步者们在几分钟内就狼吞虎咽地吃光了整只烤鸡。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ down/up) eat something hurriedly and noisily in large mouthfuls
items.ex_en: The hurried boy started to gobble down his breakfast before school started.
items.ex_zh: 匆忙的男孩在上学前开始大口吞吃早餐。

items.def_zh: 大口吃（或喝），暴饮暴食；大量消耗（燃料等）
items.def_en: 1. To eat or drink something quickly, greedily, and in large amounts. 2. To use large amounts of petrol, fuel, etc.
items.ex_en: Thirsty marathon runners guzzle vast quantities of cold water at the finish.
items.ex_zh: 口渴的马拉松选手在终点处大口痛饮大量冰水。

items.def_zh: 像狼一样吞食，大口吞吃
items.def_en: (+ down) devour voraciously and messily like an animal
items.ex_en: Do not wolf down your food like that or you will choke.
items.ex_zh: 别像那样狼吞虎咽地吃东西，否则你会噎住的。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey distinct physical and behavioral manners of consuming food or liquid, spanning rhythmic, noisy chewing (munch), clinical or biological intake (ingest), ravenous, predatory destruction of food (devour), and greedy, rapid drinking/eating (guzzle).
groups.summary_zh: 具体细致地描述进食动作与吃相，包括咀嚼声响、狼吞虎咽与暴饮暴食。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the physical manner and speed of food consumption, contrasting biological digestion by highlighting behavioral hunger, oral mechanics, or social voracity.
groups.desc_zh: 指摄入食物时的具体动作机制与速度风貌，区别于单纯的生理消化，侧重饥饿驱动的进食仪态、咀嚼质感与饕餮粗野程度。
groups.nuance_en: nibble: take tiny, cautious, repetitive bites (cheese / biscuit) · munch: chew steadily with audible rhythmic enjoyment (popcorn / snack) · scarf down: consume greedily and with extreme haste (lunch / burger) · wolf down: swallow ravenously like a predator (meal / food) · bolt: swallow whole without adequate chewing (supper / meal)
groups.nuance_zh: nibble: 谨慎细碎地反复小口轻咬 (cheese / biscuit) · munch: 有节奏地大口有声咀嚼零食 (popcorn / snack) · scarf down: 狼吞虎咽极速塞入口中 (lunch / burger) · wolf down: 如饥狼般风卷残云般吞食 (meal / food) · bolt: 顾不上充分咀嚼便囫囵吞下 (supper / meal)

groups.name: Inhabit & Settle · 居住与安置 (Billet, Quarter, Accommodate)
groups.tip: 安居落户生活场景

items.def_en: To inhabit a place or fill it with people or characters.
items.ex_en: Elves and mythical beasts people the enchanted forest in her fantasy novel.
items.ex_zh: 精灵与神兽栖息在她奇幻小说中的这片魔法森林里。

items.def_zh: 为……提供住处，安置；（鸽子、导弹等）回巢，导向目标
items.def_en: 1. To provide someone or an animal with a home or shelter. 2. ('home in on') To move toward a target or destination directly.
items.ex_en: The local sanctuary works tirelessly to home abandoned cats and stray dogs.
items.ex_zh: 当地收容所不知疲倦地工作，为被遗弃的猫和流浪狗安置住处。

items.def_zh: 为……提供住所，安置；收容，容纳，收藏
items.def_en: To provide shelter, lodging, or living accommodations for someone; to store, contain, or protect something.
items.ex_en: This modern shelter can house up to two hundred displaced flood victims.
items.ex_zh: 这个现代化的避难所能够安置多达两百名流离失所的洪灾灾民。

items.def_zh: 租房住宿，寄宿，居住；（与……）合住一室
items.def_en: (+ with/at) To lodge, rent a room, or share a room with someone.
items.ex_en: During his freshman year, David chose to room with his childhood friend.
items.ex_zh: 大一期间，大卫选择与他的儿时玩伴合住一室。

items.def_en: to provide lodgings or temporary living quarters for people or troops
items.ex_en: The commanding officer ordered them to quarter the soldiers in local inns.
items.ex_zh: 指挥官命令他们将士兵安置在当地客栈里驻扎。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ with/at) to stay somewhere temporarily, or to provide someone with a temporary room
items.ex_en: The traveling scholar decided to lodge with an elderly couple for tonight.
items.ex_zh: 游学学者决定今晚借宿在一对老夫妇家里。
items.ex2_en: The generous innkeeper agreed to lodge the stranded travelers during the storm.
items.ex2_zh: 慷慨的店主同意在暴风雨期间为滞留的旅客提供住宿。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to provide someone with accommodation or a temporary place to sleep
items.ex_en: My aunt graciously offered to put us up for the whole weekend.
items.ex_zh: 姑姑非常慷慨地提出为我们提供整个周末的住宿。

items.def_zh: 安排寄宿；让…住在别人家里
items.def_en: (+ sb) to arrange for someone to live and receive meals in another person's home
items.ex_en: Students from rural areas often board out during the semester.
items.ex_zh: 来自农村的学生在学期期间往往寄宿在校外。

items.def_en: to stay or hide inside a safe or secluded dwelling place
items.ex_en: The armed fugitives decided to hole up in an abandoned mountain cabin.
items.ex_zh: 持械逃犯们决定躲在一座废弃的深山木屋里避风头。

items.def_en: to provide lodging, space, or room for guests or travelers
items.ex_en: The luxury seaside resort can easily accommodate over five hundred foreign guests.
items.ex_zh: 这座豪华海滨度假酒店能轻松容纳五百多位外国客人入住。

items.def_en: to inhabit an area or supply an area with inhabitants
items.ex_en: Hardy nomadic tribes used to populate these vast, barren desert lands centuries ago.
items.ex_zh: 数百年前，顽强的游牧部落曾居住在这些广袤荒凉的沙漠土地上。

items.def_en: (+ on/in/with) to lodge troops or official personnel temporarily in private or public quarters
items.ex_en: The regiment was ordered to billet its cavalry troops in civilian farmhouses.
items.ex_zh: 该团奉命将其骑兵部队安排入驻平民农舍。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on providing shelter, placing human occupants into dwellings, or populating a territory, typically featuring institutional, logistical, or domestic housing arrangements.
groups.summary_zh: 指提供居所、统筹安置人员住宿或使某地有人居住的生活与治理框架。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the provision or occupation of physical shelter, contrasting permanent botanical or geopolitical rooting by emphasizing infrastructural quartering, logistical billeting, or temporary containment.
groups.desc_zh: 指为人员提供实体掩蔽所或在其中栖宿，区别于永久定居或地缘生根，强调后勤分配、营宿安排及临时性容留空间。
groups.nuance_en: house: provide shelter, containment, or storage for (refugees / collection) · lodge: secure temporary residential quarters (tourist / guest) · quarter: assign specific military or administrative living space (troops / personnel) · billet: enforce civilian lodging for soldiers (troops / soldiers) · put up: host temporarily as a domestic favor (relatives / friend)
groups.nuance_zh: house: 提供成体系的房屋容纳或保管 (refugees / collection) · lodge: 临时承租寄居或安排借宿 (tourist / guest) · quarter: 依军需或行政命令分派驻地 (troops / personnel) · billet: 征用民房供军队临时官兵宿营 (troops / soldiers) · put up: 出于人情或款待短宿提供留宿 (relatives / friend)

groups.name: Injure & Traumatize · 身体致伤与创伤 (Hurt, Injure, Lacerate)
groups.tip: 身体受损及引发的痛楚

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to physically hurt or bruise someone in an accident or fight
items.ex_en: A nasty fall on the icy sidewalk managed to bang him up.
items.ex_zh: 在结冰的人行道上狠狠摔了一跤，把他磕伤得不轻。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to inflict multiple wounds or lacerations on someone's body
items.ex_en: The shattered windshield managed to cut up the driver's face quite badly.
items.ex_zh: 破碎的挡风玻璃把司机的脸划伤得相当严重。

items.def_zh: 使受伤害，使受伤；（身体）感到疼痛；伤……的感情
items.def_en: 1. To cause physical pain or injury to someone, or to feel pain yourself. 2. To cause emotional distress or upset to someone.
items.ex_en: The unexpected rejection began to hurt his delicate pride and professional confidence.
items.ex_zh: 这次突如其来的拒绝开始伤害到他脆弱的自尊心和职业自信。
items.ex2_en: His fractured knee still hurts badly whenever the weather turns cold and damp.
items.ex2_zh: 每当天气变冷受潮，他骨折的膝盖依然剧烈作痛。

items.def_zh: 使（身体）疼痛；使痛苦，使痛心；感到疼痛
items.def_en: 1. To cause physical or emotional pain, distress, or suffering to someone. 2. (archaic) To suffer pain or ache.
items.ex_en: It deeply pained the old king to watch his realm fall apart.
items.ex_zh: 目睹自己的王国分崩离析，老国王感到万分痛心。

items.def_en: to injure a part of the body, especially by making a hole in the skin with a weapon
items.ex_en: Shrapnel from the explosive device managed to wound three patrolling border guards.
items.ex_zh: 爆炸装置的弹片炸伤了三名正在巡逻的边防卫兵。

items.def_en: To cause physical injury, illness, damage, or other bad effects to a person, living thing, or object.
items.ex_en: Careless disposal of toxic chemicals will severely harm the local river ecosystem.
items.ex_zh: 随意丢弃有毒化学品将严重损害当地河流的生态系统。

items.def_en: To injure someone's brain temporarily through a violent blow to the head; to shake violently.
items.ex_en: The violent tackle during the football match threatened to concuss the quarterback.
items.ex_zh: 橄榄球比赛中的猛烈冲撞差点导致四分卫脑震荡。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to violently attack someone by repeatedly hitting and kicking them, causing injury
items.ex_en: Don't beat yourself up over an honest mistake.
items.ex_zh: 不要因为一次无心之失而过度自责。

items.def_zh: 使受伤，弄伤（身体）；损害，破坏（名誉等）
items.def_en: To cause physical harm or bodily injury to someone; to damage or impair something.
items.ex_en: Falling down the steep stairs managed to injure his right knee severely.
items.ex_zh: 从陡峭的楼梯上跌落严重弄伤了他的右膝。

items.def_zh: 撕裂，划伤（皮肉）；深深伤害（感情）
items.def_en: (formal or medical) To cut or tear skin or flesh deeply and roughly; (figurative) to hurt someone's feelings severely.
items.ex_en: Sharp barbed wire began to lacerate the panicked horse's lower legs.
items.ex_zh: 锋利的铁丝网开始割破这匹惊恐的马的腿部皮肉。

items.def_en: to damage severely, disfigure, or cut off parts of the body
items.ex_en: The cruel trap threatened to mutilate the young bear's trapped paw.
items.ex_zh: 残忍的捕兽夹恐将严重损毁小熊被困的脚掌。

items.def_en: to injure someone so severely that part of their body will no longer work as it should
items.ex_en: Exploding landmines continue to maim innocent civilians long after the war ends.
items.ex_zh: 战争结束很久之后，爆炸的地雷依然在致残无辜平民。

groups.summary_en: An external force or condition causes physical trauma or distress to bodily tissue or living subjects, scaling in severity from simple pain or superficial harm to severe blunt concussion, deep tearing, and catastrophic mutilation.
groups.summary_zh: 外力或疾患造成机体组织受损，从隐痛轻伤升级至撕裂重创。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the infliction of physical bodily damage, contrasting abstract impairment by highlighting tissue destruction, blunt mechanical trauma, and acute physical pain.
groups.desc_zh: 指外力对机体造成的器质性破坏与致伤过程，区别于抽象的损害，强调组织撕裂、钝击机械性创伤及直接的剧烈肉体痛楚。
groups.nuance_en: hurt: cause generic physical pain or injury (back / knee) · wound: breach tissue via a penetrating weapon or combat (soldier / flesh) · concuss: injure the brain via violent impact or jarring (brain / player) · beat up: assault violently with repeated physical blows (victim / intruder) · bang up: batter, bruise, or damage through rough collision (car / leg)
groups.nuance_zh: hurt: 造成普遍的身体疼痛或功能挫伤 (back / knee) · wound: 由利刃、弹药刺破皮肉造成战斗性创伤 (soldier / flesh) · concuss: 头部受强烈震荡冲击导致脑震荡 (brain / player) · beat up: 连续暴力殴打并致全身受创 (victim / intruder) · bang up: 碰撞摔打致使身体或器件淤伤破损 (car / leg)

groups.name: Irritate & Infuriate · 恼怒与愤懑 (Pique, Miff, Seethe)
groups.tip: 由小摩擦演变为怒火中烧

items.def_en: (informal, often passive) To annoy, offend, or irritate someone slightly.
items.ex_en: Her snide remark managed to miff several distinguished colleagues at the table.
items.ex_zh: 她冷嘲热讽的话让同桌的几位杰出同事感到有些恼怒。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to make someone become very upset, agitated, or angry
items.ex_en: The bathroom mirror steamed up quickly as the hot shower ran.
items.ex_zh: 热水淋浴一开，浴室镜子很快就蒙上了一层水汽。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to cause someone to feel agitated, furious, or intensely resentful
items.ex_en: The fiery speech threatened to work up the angry crowd even further.
items.ex_zh: 激昂的演说势必会进一步激怒愤怒的人群。

items.def_zh: 使愤恨，激怒；激起，引起（兴趣或好奇心）
items.def_en: 1. To cause someone to feel annoyed, hurt, or resentful, especially by wounding their pride. 2. To excite or stimulate someone's curiosity or interest.
items.ex_en: His dismissive tone of voice managed to pique her pride deeply today.
items.ex_zh: 他今天不屑一顾的语气深深伤害了她的自尊心，令她极为愤恨。

items.raw_cluster: 激怒与使烦恼 Angered & Aggrieved
items.def_zh: 使愤愤不平，使委屈；侵害（权益）
items.def_en: (usually passive) To make someone feel indignant, resentful, or wronged by unfair treatment.
items.ex_en: The harsh corporate restructuring continues to aggrieve dozens of seasoned senior workers.
items.ex_zh: 严苛的企业重组持续让数十名资深的老员工感到愤愤不平。

items.def_en: [I/T] to cause persistent resentment, bitterness, or irritating anger over time
items.ex_en: His unfair dismissal continued to rankle in his mind for many months.
items.ex_zh: 那次不公的解雇在随后数月里一直让他耿耿于怀。

items.def_zh: 怒目而视，阴沉着脸；（天空等）变阴暗
items.def_en: 1. (literary) To frown angrily or look sullen and threatening. 2. (of clouds or the sky) To appear dark, gloomy, and stormy.
items.ex_en: The brooding tyrant began to lour at the trembling messengers before him.
items.ex_zh: 阴郁的暴君开始怒目而视面前战战兢兢的信使。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to make someone intensely angry or enraged
items.ex_en: Their arrogant refusal to cooperate will definitely burn up the chief investigator.
items.ex_zh: 他们傲慢地拒绝配合绝对会让首席调查员怒火中烧。

items.def_en: to feel, show, or express great suppressed anger
items.ex_en: Unable to retaliate immediately, she could only fume in silent, bitter indignation.
items.ex_zh: 无法立即反击的她只能在沉默与痛苦的愤慨中生闷气。

items.def_zh: 强忍怒火，生闷气；翻滚，沸腾
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To feel intensely angry while keeping the emotion suppressed. 2. (of a liquid) To bubble, boil, or churn violently.
items.ex_en: He continued to seethe with silent fury throughout the humiliating disciplinary hearing.
items.ex_zh: 在整场令人受辱的纪律听证会上，他一直在内心强忍着怒火。

items.raw_cluster: 激怒与使怨恨 Anger & Embitter
items.def_zh: 使心生怨恨，使怨愤；使更加痛苦
items.def_en: (often passive) To make someone feel bitter, resentful, or angry over a long period.
