items.ex_en: Decades of political betrayal served to embitter the exiled statesman for life.
items.ex_zh: 数十年间的政治背叛让这位流亡的政治家终生心怀怨恨。

items.def_en: to make someone extremely angry, furious, or enraged
items.ex_en: His constant interruptions began to infuriate the normally patient panel of judges.
items.ex_zh: 他接二连三的打断开始激怒平时很有耐心的评审团。

groups.summary_en: An agent, remark, or grievance causes an experiencer to feel annoyance, resentment, or smoldering anger, or the experiencer simmers with inward rage. Verbs range from mild irritation and slighted pride to suppressed, boiling indignation.
groups.summary_zh: 描述因受冒犯或委屈而引发的不快、愤懑乃至暗自暴怒。
groups.desc_en: Denotes internal brooding and simmered emotional fury, contrasting outward volcanic aggression by focusing on sustained resentment, injured vanity, or suppressed indignation.
groups.desc_zh: 指内心持久发酵、暗自翻腾的恼恨与窝火，区别于向外爆发的狂怒，强调自尊受创、深层怨恨与压抑中的愤懑沸腾。
groups.nuance_en: pique: wound pride or arouse brisk resentment (pride / interest) · miff: cause petty, visibly huffy annoyance (friend / host) · rankle: fester persistently like an unhealed psychological sore (slight / insult) · seethe: boil inwardly with suppressed fury (rage / indignation) · aggrieve: distress deeply with an enduring sense of injustice (party / employee)
groups.nuance_zh: pique: 刺伤自尊心或激起短暂傲慢的不悦 (pride / interest) · miff: 因小事惹得微恼赌气 (friend / host) · rankle: 侮辱如倒刺般在心头持久发溃 (slight / insult) · seethe: 强压怒火在内心如沸水般翻腾 (rage / indignation) · aggrieve: 因蒙受不公深感委屈愤懑 (party / employee)

groups.name: Kill & Slaughter · 杀戮与屠杀 (Kill, Slay, Massacre)
groups.tip: 出于政治动机秘密暗杀

items.def_en: (+ sb) to murder someone deliberately
items.ex_en: The ruthless cartel hired an undercover assassin to bump off their rival.
items.ex_zh: 冷酷的贩毒集团雇佣了一名卧底杀手去干掉他们的死对头。

items.def_en: to put someone to death, typically as a legal penalty or extrajudicial execution
items.ex_en: The authoritarian regime chose to execute political dissidents without a fair trial.
items.ex_zh: 该独裁政权选择未经公正审判便将政治异见人士处死。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to assassinate or execute someone in an underworld or gangland context
items.ex_en: The mob boss ordered his hitman to rub out the snitch before sunrise.
items.ex_zh: 黑帮头目命令他的杀手在日出前除掉那个告密者。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to kill or assassinate a targeted adversary or enemy
items.ex_en: A covert sniper squad was dispatched to take out the rogue insurgent leader.
items.ex_zh: 一支秘密狙击小队被派遣去干掉那名叛变叛乱分子的头目。

items.def_zh: 大屠杀，残杀（大量手无寸铁者）
items.def_en: to kill a large number of people or animals indiscriminately and cruelly
items.ex_en: The invading army mercilessly massacred hundreds of defenseless villagers in cold blood.
items.ex_zh: 侵略军冷酷无情地残杀了数百名手无寸铁的村民。

items.def_zh: 残杀，杀戮；（俚语）深深打动，惊艳
items.def_en: 1. (literary or archaic) To kill a person or animal violently or in war. 2. (informal) To impress, delight, or amuse someone overwhelmingly.
items.ex_en: Her breathtaking performance at the gala tonight will completely slay the audience.
items.ex_zh: 今晚她在庆典上令人叹为观止的表演绝对会惊艳全场观众。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to completely destroy or kill an entire group of people or creatures
items.ex_en: Heavy artillery strikes completely wiped out the trapped enemy battalion in minutes.
items.ex_zh: 猛烈的炮火打击在几分钟内彻底全歼了被围困的敌方营队。

items.def_zh: 屠杀，残杀；屠宰（牲畜）；彻底打败
items.def_en: 1. To kill a large number of people cruelly and violently; massacre. 2. To kill animals for meat. 3. (informal) To defeat an opponent overwhelmingly.
items.ex_en: Our home basketball team utterly slaughtered their biggest rivals in the playoff finals.
items.ex_zh: 我们主场的篮球队在季后赛总决赛中彻底打败了劲敌。

items.def_zh: 残杀，屠杀；屠宰（牲畜）；（因拙劣而）搞砸，糟蹋
items.def_en: 1. To murder people brutally and indiscriminately. 2. To kill and cut up animals for meat. 3. (informal) To ruin or spoil something by poor execution.
items.ex_en: The rookie guitarist managed to butcher that famous solo during the live broadcast.
items.ex_zh: 那位新手吉他手在直播演出中把那段著名的独奏弹得一塌糊涂。

items.def_zh: 处死（以使其成为殉道者）；迫害，折磨
items.def_en: 1. To kill or torture someone because of their religious or political beliefs, making them a martyr.
items.ex_en: The tyrannical regime martyred the outspoken priest for defying state religious decrees.
items.ex_zh: 专制政权处死了这名直言不讳的牧师，只因他反抗国家的宗教法令。

items.def_zh: 暗杀，行刺；诋毁，破坏（名誉等）
items.def_en: 1. To murder an important political or public figure deliberately, usually for political reasons. 2. To deliberately destroy someone's reputation.
items.ex_en: Conspirators plotted secretly to assassinate the visiting prime minister during his motorcade route.
items.ex_zh: 阴谋分子秘密策划在到访首相的车队路线中刺杀他。

items.def_en: to completely destroy or kill off an entire population or species
items.ex_en: Aggressive government campaigns sought to exterminate invasive rodent species from the reserve.
items.ex_zh: 政府发起的强力治理行动旨在彻底根绝保护区内的外来入侵啮齿物种。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures acts of killing another being with escalating brutality, scale, premeditation, or political motive, spanning single assassinations to indiscriminate bloodbaths.
groups.summary_zh: 表达致人死命的行为，从暗杀、斩杀升级至灭绝人性的屠戮。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the deliberate termination of life, contrasting natural mortality by emphasizing extreme violence, cold-blooded execution, legal implementation, or wholesale butchery.
groups.desc_zh: 指以外力刻意终结生命的行为，区别于自然死亡，强调血腥暴力程度、冷酷处决程序、法律死刑或成规模的群体屠戮灭绝。
groups.nuance_en: slay: kill violently or heroically, often in combat (dragon / foe) · execute: put to death via lawful sentence or summary order (convict / hostage) · take out: neutralize or eliminate a tactical target precisely (sniper / operative) · massacre: indiscriminately murder large numbers of defenseless people (civilians / villagers) · slaughter: butcher brutally and en masse like livestock (animals / victims)
groups.nuance_zh: slay: 在战斗或神话中血性诛杀、斩除 (dragon / foe) · execute: 依法定刑罚或命令执行死刑处决 (convict / hostage) · take out: 战术性精准清除或定点消灭 (sniper / operative) · massacre: 屠杀大批手无寸铁的平民弱者 (civilians / villagers) · slaughter: 如宰杀牲畜般残酷血腥地成批戕害 (animals / victims)

groups.name: Loiter & Idle About · 游荡与闲晃 (Loiter, Dally, Gad, Vagabond)
groups.tip: 磨蹭时间闲游漫步

items.def_zh: 随波逐流；漫无目的地走
items.def_en: to wander or move slowly from place to place without a fixed plan
items.ex_en: Without any clear goals, he preferred to drift along through unfamiliar coastal towns.
items.ex_zh: 没有任何明确目标，他宁愿漫无目的地穿行于陌生海滨小镇。

items.def_zh: 到处闲逛；无所事事地游荡
items.def_en: to spend time wandering aimlessly and living idly without steady work
items.ex_en: After finishing college, Jack chose to bum around Europe for the entire summer.
items.ex_zh: 大学毕业后，杰克选择整个夏天在欧洲各地四处闲逛游荡。

items.def_en: to wait or spend time idly in a place with no clear objective
items.ex_en: Suspicious teenagers began to hang around the convenience store parking lot every evening.
items.ex_zh: 可疑的青少年每天晚上都开始在便利店停车场附近游荡逗留。

items.def_en: to hang around idly and needlessly in a public place
items.ex_en: Bored youths often loiter about the train station arcade on cold weekend nights.
items.ex_zh: 无聊的年轻人在寒冷的周末夜晚经常在火车站骑楼周围闲逛徘徊。

items.def_en: (+ on/around) to stay in a place longer than necessary because of reluctance to leave
items.ex_en: The couple lingered around the dimly lit garden path, reluctant to say goodbye.
items.ex_zh: 这对情侣在昏暗的花园小径旁依依不舍地徘徊，迟迟不肯道别。

items.def_zh: 虚度光阴；无所事事地闲晃
items.def_en: (+ about/around) to spend time doing nothing productive or walking without aim
items.ex_en: The disconsolate poet would idle about the quiet estate grounds for weeks unproductively.
items.ex_zh: 这位郁郁寡欢的诗人会在静谧的庄园里无所事事地闲晃数周。

items.def_en: (also 'gad about') (informal) To travel or wander from place to place in search of pleasure or amusement.
items.ex_en: Instead of studying, she spent the weekend gadding about downtown shopping centers.
items.ex_zh: 她没去学习，而是把整个周末都花在市中心商场闲逛作乐上。

items.def_en: 1. (+ around/outside) To stand or wait around in a public place without any obvious purpose.
items.ex_en: Local authorities strictly prohibit citizens from loitering outside the sensitive government compound.
items.ex_zh: 地方当局严禁市民在敏感政府大院外无故闲逛逗留。

items.def_zh: 磨蹭，闲荡，虚度光阴；调情
items.def_en: 1. (+ over) To waste time moving or acting slowly. 2. (+ with) To treat something lightly or flirt playfully.
items.ex_en: The handsome count chose to dally with the young governess during summer evenings.
items.ex_zh: 英俊的伯爵选择在夏日的傍晚时分与年轻的女家庭教师调情嬉戏。

items.def_en: to delay or be tardy in acting or departing; linger unnecessarily (literary/archaic)
items.ex_en: The traveler dared not tarry on the mountain path after darkness fell.
items.ex_zh: 夜幕降临之后，行路人不敢在山径上稍作耽搁。

items.def_en: 1. (literary) To wander from place to place without a settled home or regular job.
items.ex_en: In his youth, he would vagabond across the sunlit Mediterranean provinces freely.
items.ex_zh: 年轻时，他常自由自在地在阳光明媚的地中海各省四处流浪。

items.def_en: (+ about/around) to wander slowly and aimlessly, often looking listless (informal)
items.ex_en: Depressed by bad news, Tom mooched about his dreary apartment all day.
items.ex_zh: 坏消息让他心情低落，汤姆整天在阴郁的公寓里无精打采地瞎溜达。

groups.summary_en: Moving about aimlessly or lingering needlessly without serious purpose, wasting time, or roving in search of diversion. Distinctions hinge on lingering suspiciously in public places, social flitting, or wandering as a vagrant.
groups.summary_zh: 无所事事地游手好闲、流连盘桓或居无定所地游荡
groups.desc_en: Denotes moving or standing about aimlessly without urgent utility, contrasting purposeful pilgrimage or vigorous strolling by highlighting aimlessness, temporal dissipation, or covert lingering.
groups.desc_zh: 指缺乏紧迫目的或生产性的流连与游荡，区别于有明确方向的跋涉或闲适散步，强调无所事事、消磨时光或形迹可疑的滞留。
groups.nuance_en: loiter: linger in a public place without evident purpose (corner / doorway) · linger: delay departure due to reluctance to leave (scent / guest) · idle: spend time in inert non-productivity (hours / days) · hang around: remain in a vicinity awaiting events passively (station / mall) · gad: wander restlessly in pursuit of social diversion (about town / country)
groups.nuance_zh: loiter: 在公共场所无端徘徊滞留、常具可疑性 (corner / doorway) · linger: 依依不舍或拖延不愿离去 (scent / guest) · idle: 虚度光阴、机器或人处于空转状态 (hours / days) · hang around: 在某处无所事事地闲呆打发时间 (station / mall) · gad: 寻欢作乐四处闲逛、热衷交际 (about town / country)

groups.name: Long & Hunger For · 渴望与渴求 (Aspire, Yearn, Crave, Lust)
groups.tip: 由期盼憧憬加剧为极度饥渴渴望

items.def_en: (+ sth) to want sth very much, often with a feeling of persistent sadness
items.ex_en: She longed for the peaceful days she had spent in the countryside.
items.ex_zh: 她十分渴望能重温曾经在乡村度过的宁静岁月。

items.def_en: 1. (+ to/after) To have a strong desire and ambition to achieve something great or become someone important.
items.ex_en: Many ambitious scholars aspire to leadership roles within international academic organizations.
items.ex_zh: 许多雄心勃勃的学者立志在国际学术组织中担任领导职务。

items.def_en: (+ for/to do) to feel an intense, often tender and painful longing for someone or something
items.ex_en: Exiled across the ocean, he yearned constantly to see his native hills again.
items.ex_zh: 被流放到大洋彼岸的他，无时无刻不在深切渴望重睹故土的山峦。

items.def_zh: 苦苦思念；因思慕而憔悴
items.def_en: (+ for) to feel unhappy and miss someone or something agonizingly, losing vitality
items.ex_en: Separated from her childhood sweetheart, she slowly began to pine away in solitude.
items.ex_zh: 与青梅竹马的恋人分离后，她在孤独中渐渐为相思而消瘦憔悴。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to suffer emotionally and waste away with deep longing for someone or sth
items.ex_en: Imprisoned in the foreign capital, the weary diplomat pined for his quiet homeland.
items.ex_zh: 被困异国首都的疲惫外交官，苦苦思念着自己平静的故乡。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to feel an intense, deep emotional longing for sth that is hard to attain
items.ex_en: Locked in an arranged marriage, the young duchess yearned for authentic romance.
items.ex_zh: 困在包办婚姻中的年轻公爵夫人，深深渴求一份真挚的爱情。

items.def_en: (+ for/after) to feel an insatiable, visceral craving or deep inner urge
items.ex_en: The visionary reformer hungered for profound systemic justice across the divided society.
items.ex_zh: 这位富有远见的改革家如饥似渴地渴求在分裂的社会中实现深层制度正义。

items.def_en: 1. To have a very strong, urgent, or uncontrollable desire for something (such as food, love, or power).
items.ex_en: After running twelve arduous miles, athletes crave cold water and salty carbohydrates intensely.
items.ex_zh: 跑完艰辛的十二英里后，运动员极度渴望冰凉的水分和含盐的碳水。

items.def_en: 1. (+ for/after) To have an intense, desperate desire for something; feel a strong physical need for water.
items.ex_en: The oppressed citizens thirsted for freedom under the prolonged dictatorial rule.
items.ex_zh: 长期处于独裁统治下的受压迫民众，如饥似渴地追寻着自由。

items.def_en: to desire eagerly and greedily something that belongs to someone else
items.ex_en: The ambitious general secretly coveted the sovereign's jewel-encrusted ceremonial crown.
items.ex_zh: 野心勃勃的将军暗中觊觎着君主那顶镶满宝石的典礼王冠。

items.def_zh: 极度渴求；贪图；色迷迷地觊觎
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to feel an overwhelming sexual craving or an intense, greedy desire for sth
items.ex_en: The corrupt nobleman lusted after his neighbour's fertile coastal vineyard for years.
items.ex_zh: 贪婪的贵族多年来一直贪图邻人那片肥沃的海滨葡萄园。

items.def_en: 1. (+ after/for) To have an intense, greedy desire for something (such as power or money), or to feel strong sexual desire.
items.ex_en: Ruthless politicians often lust for absolute control over every public institution.
items.ex_zh: 冷酷的政客往往极度渴望对每一个公共机构实行绝对控制。

groups.summary_en: Experiencing an internal drive, desire, or longing for an object, goal, or experience, escalating from lofty intellectual ambition to painful emotional yearning, physical addiction/craving, and overwhelming primal lust.
groups.summary_zh: 从崇高志向递增至揪心渴念、生理性瘾欲与贪婪狂热
groups.desc_en: Denotes a deep, persistent psychic pull toward an absent object or ideal, contrasting momentary whim by highlighting agonizing deficiency, physical appetite, or lofty reach.
groups.desc_zh: 指个体对缺失对象或理想境界持久深切的心理牵引，区别于偶发的念头，强调因匮乏产生的煎熬苦楚、生理饥渴或高远追求。
groups.nuance_en: long for: feel a deep, aching emotional pull toward (home / peace) · yearn: stretch outward with tender, wistful desire (freedom / past) · crave: experience an urgent, visceral physiological need (sugar / attention) · pine for: waste away in grief over an unattainable loss (lover / homeland) · aspire: direct noble ambition toward a elevated goal (greatness / leadership)
groups.nuance_zh: long for: 心怀隐痛且深情地渴望 (home / peace) · yearn: 带着忧郁憧憬向往不可即之物 (freedom / past) · crave: 出于生理或心理成瘾性迫切渴求 (sugar / attention) · pine for: 因思念无法挽回之人事而日渐憔悴 (lover / homeland) · aspire: 抱负远大、立志追求崇高目标 (greatness / leadership)

groups.name: Mock & Tease · 嘲弄与戏弄 (Deride, Taunt, Jeer)
groups.tip: 言语戏谑或轻蔑嘲弄

items.def_en: to tease someone in a friendly and lighthearted way
items.ex_en: His coworkers constantly ribbed him about his bright purple mismatched socks.
items.ex_zh: 同事们经常拿他那双颜色扎眼的紫色混搭袜子开善意的玩笑。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to tease or ridicule someone in a mischievous or mocking manner
items.ex_en: School bullies loved to poke fun at his peculiar southern accent daily.
items.ex_zh: 学校里的恶霸每天都喜欢拿他古怪的南方口音开玩笑。

items.def_en: (informal) To tease or joke with someone in a playful and friendly way.
items.ex_en: Uncle Dave loved to josh with the children during lively holiday dinners.
items.ex_zh: 戴夫叔叔喜欢在热闹的节日聚餐上逗弄孩子们，开开玩笑。

items.def_zh: 取笑，戏弄，逗弄；梳理（头发或纤维）
items.def_en: 1. To laugh at or make jokes about someone in a playful or unkind way. 2. To comb hair or wool backward to give it volume or fluff it up.
items.ex_en: The older brother liked to tease his little sister about her crush.
items.ex_zh: 哥哥喜欢拿妹妹暗恋的对象来取笑逗弄她。

items.def_en: (dated) To tease or joke with someone in a good-humored way.
items.ex_en: The grandfather liked to chaff the timid boy about his clumsy posture.
items.ex_zh: 祖父喜欢善意地打趣那个胆怯男孩笨拙的姿态。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to make unkind, derisive, or mocking remarks about someone
items.ex_en: Cruel classmates would openly laugh at her homemade vintage winter coat.
items.ex_zh: 残忍的同班同学会当面嗤笑她那件自制的复古冬衣。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to subject someone to unkind ridicule, mimicry, or laughter
items.ex_en: It was unfair of the senior staff to make fun of his mistake.
items.ex_zh: 资深员工拿他的错误大肆嘲弄取笑，实在有失公允。

items.def_zh: 嘲弄，嘲笑；（通过模仿）戏弄；使落空，使显得可笑
items.def_en: 1. To laugh at someone or copy them unkindly to make them look foolish. 2. To make something seem completely useless or ineffective.
items.ex_en: Rude spectators would mock the opposing team's goalkeeper whenever he fumbled.
items.ex_zh: 每当客队守门员失误时，粗鲁的观众就会无情地嘲弄他。

items.def_zh: 讥笑，冷笑，轻蔑地嘲弄；冷笑着说
items.def_en: To smile or speak in an unkind, mocking way that shows you have no respect for someone.
items.ex_en: The arrogant critic sneered dismissively at the amateur artist's gallery showcase.
items.ex_zh: 傲慢的评论家对这位业余画家的画廊展览嗤之以鼻、冷嘲热讽。

items.def_en: to intentionally provoke or insult someone with contemptuous remarks
items.ex_en: Hecklers continued to taunt the nervous young speaker from the front row.
items.ex_zh: 起哄者在前排不断用奚落的言语故意激怒那位紧张的年轻演讲者。

items.def_en: to treat or speak of someone or something with utter contempt and ridicule
items.ex_en: Conservative academics continued to deride the young scholar's unconventional thesis proposal.
items.ex_zh: 保守派学者不断鄙薄讥讽这位年轻学者离经叛道的开题报告。

items.def_en: (+ at) to shout loud, rude, and mocking remarks at someone
items.ex_en: Rowdy protesters began to jeer loudly at the controversial visiting diplomat.
items.ex_zh: 喧闹的抗议者开始对这位引发争议的到访外交官大声喝倒彩。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe targeting someone with playful banter, pointed sarcasm, or contemptuous ridicule, ranging from lighthearted ribbing to cruel, malicious derision.
groups.summary_zh: 以言语或表情取笑、逗弄或蔑视嘲弄他人，从善意玩笑延伸至恶毒讽刺。
groups.desc_en: Targets an individual or idea through playful or malicious jesting, differing from neutral critique by relying on ridicule, imitation, or interpersonal provocation.
groups.desc_zh: 通过戏谑、挑逗或恶意嘲弄针对某人或某事，与中性批评的区别在于其带有取笑、戏弄或人际挑衅色彩。
groups.nuance_en: tease: persistent playful or petty baiting (hair / sibling / child) · mock: contemptuous imitation or scornful derision (efforts / accent / fears) · rib: good-natured colloquial poking (pal / colleague / teammate) · chaff: lighthearted bantering without malice (friend / groom / newcomer) · poke fun at: gentle ridicule highlighting quirks (quirks / appearance / habits)
groups.nuance_zh: tease: 持续性的取笑或戏弄 (hair / sibling / child) · mock: 带有轻蔑模仿或冷酷嘲笑 (efforts / accent / fears) · rib: 口语化的善意打趣 (pal / colleague / teammate) · chaff: 善意玩笑与打趣 (friend / groom / newcomer) · poke fun at: 针对小毛病的温和取笑 (quirks / appearance / habits)

groups.name: Moderate & Relieve · 缓和与减轻 (Temper, Buffer, Mitigate)
groups.tip: 提供缓冲以减轻冲击

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make sth less forceful, severe, or extreme
items.ex_en: The editor advised the columnist to tone down the aggressive personal rhetoric.
items.ex_zh: 编辑建议专栏作者缓和文章中咄咄逼人的人身攻击措辞。

items.def_en: to become less severe, intense, or aggressive
items.ex_en: Fortunately, the driving torrential rain began to ease up before midnight.
items.ex_zh: 幸运的是，倾盆大雨在午夜前终于开始逐渐放缓。

items.def_zh: 减弱（痛苦、严厉）；缓和锋芒
items.def_en: (+ of sth) to dull or soften the sharp impact, intensity, or unpleasantness of sth
items.ex_en: A cup of warm chamomile tea helped take the edge off his anxiety.
items.ex_zh: 一杯温热的洋甘菊茶有助于缓解他焦躁不安的情绪。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to dilute or weaken the strength, force, or effect of sth
items.ex_en: Lawmakers were pressured to water down the strict carbon emissions regulations.
items.ex_zh: 议员们迫于压力削弱了严格的碳排放监管法规的力度。

items.def_zh: 缓和，调和，使温和；使回火，淬炼
items.def_en: 1. To make something less severe or extreme, especially by moderating or softening it. 2. To harden or strengthen metal or glass by heating and cooling.
items.ex_en: Prudent judges always temper strict legal punishment with genuine humanitarian mercy.
items.ex_zh: 审慎的法官总是以真正的人道仁慈来调和严酷的法律惩罚。

items.def_zh: 缓和，减轻；使迟钝，变迟钝；使变暗，变暗淡
items.def_en: To make or become less sharp, intense, clear, or vivid.
items.ex_en: Strong painkillers could dull the throbbing ache in his fractured shoulder.
items.ex_zh: 强效止痛药能够减轻他骨折肩膀处阵阵发作的剧烈钝痛。
items.ex2_en: The bright golden light began to dull as thick grey storm clouds gathered.
items.ex2_zh: 随着厚重的灰色乌云聚集，明亮的金色光芒开始变暗。

items.def_en: To protect someone or something from the impact of something harmful, shocking, or sudden; cushion.
items.ex_en: The family savings fund helped buffer them against the sudden economic recession.
items.ex_zh: 家庭储蓄基金帮助他们缓冲了突如其来的经济衰退所带来的冲击。

items.def_en: To make something bad, such as harm, damage, or risk, less severe, serious, or painful.
items.ex_en: City authorities introduced sandbags to mitigate catastrophic flood damage along the river.
items.ex_zh: 市政当局设置了沙袋，以减轻沿河灾难性洪灾造成的损失。

items.def_en: To soften the adverse effects of an impact, shock, or blow
items.ex_en: A generous severance package helped cushion the blow of his sudden dismissal.
items.ex_zh: 丰厚的遣散补偿金有助于缓冲他突然被解雇所遭受的打击。

items.def_en: [I/T] To make less harsh, severe, or intense
items.ex_en: Gentle candlelight served to soften the harsh industrial contours of the restaurant.
items.ex_zh: 柔和的烛光缓和了餐厅内冰冷生硬的工业风轮廓。
items.ex2_en: Her stern facial expression softened visibly when the playful kitten entered the room.
items.ex2_zh: 当顽皮的小猫走进房间时，她严厉的表情明显缓和了下来。

items.def_en: To make suffering, deficiency, or hardship less severe
items.ex_en: Targeted subsidies can significantly alleviate the economic burden carried by low-income families.
items.ex_zh: 专项补贴可以大幅减轻低收入家庭所背负的经济负担。

items.def_en: To appease the anger, anxiety, or severity of a person or situation
items.ex_en: The airline gave vouchers to mollify angry passengers delayed by the storm.
items.ex_zh: 航空公司发放了代金券，以安抚因暴风雨延误而愤怒的乘客。

groups.summary_en: An agent or intervention reduces the severity, intensity, harshness, or impact of an adverse force, pain, or conflict.
groups.summary_zh: 削弱外来冲击或减缓痛苦、严厉程度，起缓冲平抑作用。
groups.desc_en: Actively reduces the harshness, potency, or extremity of a condition, unlike passive decline or total neutralization.
groups.desc_zh: 主动减弱某状态的严厉性、强度或极端性，区别于被动的消退或彻底的中和清除。
groups.nuance_en: temper: modifying harsh extremes by blending restraint (justice / tone / enthusiasm) · mitigate: formally alleviating severity or harmful consequences (damage / risk / impact) · tone down: deliberately softening boldness or aggressiveness (rhetoric / colors / language) · buffer: providing a physical or fiscal cushion against shock (impact / blow / volatility) · water down: diluting potency or compromising integrity (proposal / bill / strength)
groups.nuance_zh: temper: 调和并克制严苛的极端状态 (justice / tone / enthusiasm) · mitigate: 正式减轻严峻后果或危害 (damage / risk / impact) · tone down: 刻意降低激烈度或醒目度 (rhetoric / colors / language) · buffer: 提供物理或财务缓冲以减缓冲击 (impact / blow / volatility) · water down: 稀释效力或妥协原则 (proposal / bill / strength)

groups.name: Ponder & Contemplate · 思考与沉思 (Weigh, Contemplate, Mull)
groups.tip: 权衡得失利弊并深入斟酌

items.def_en: to spend time thinking carefully about a proposal, plan, or problem before deciding
items.ex_en: The committee needs several days to mull over the ambitious merger proposal.
items.ex_zh: 委员会需要几天时间来仔细斟酌这项雄心勃勃的合并提案。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to consider a matter or proposal thoroughly and carefully before making a decision
items.ex_en: It's a major career move, so please think it over before deciding.
items.ex_zh: 这是职业生涯的重大转变，所以在做决定前请仔细考虑。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to reflect or deliberate deeply on a thought or problem over a period of time
items.ex_en: Give the manager a few quiet minutes to chew on your proposal.
items.ex_zh: 给经理几分钟安静的时间，让他好好细想你的提议。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to think long and hard about something complicated or difficult to understand
items.ex_en: Scientists continue to puzzle over the strange cryptographic signals from deep space.
items.ex_zh: 科学家们仍在对来自深空那串奇特的加密信号苦苦思索。

items.def_zh: 权衡，斟酌，考量；称……的重量；重达；有影响
items.def_en: 1. To consider or compare options carefully before making a choice. 2. To measure the heaviness of something, or to have a particular weight. 3. To have influence or importance in a decision.
items.ex_en: Prospective buyers must weigh the potential financial risks against the expected returns.
items.ex_zh: 潜在买家必须在潜在财务风险与预期收益之间仔细权衡斟酌。

items.def_zh: 盘算，深思，考量；凝视，沉思注视
items.def_en: 1. To think deeply or carefully about something, especially a potential future action. 2. To look at something quietly and thoughtfully for a long time.
items.ex_en: The board met this afternoon to contemplate an aggressive global market expansion.
items.ex_zh: 董事会今天下午开会，深思盘算一次进取型的全球市场扩张。

items.def_zh: 深思熟虑，仔细斟酌；商议
items.def_en: To think about or discuss something very carefully, especially before reaching a decision.
items.ex_en: The trial jury will deliberate carefully before delivering the official final verdict.
items.ex_zh: 审判陪审团将在正式作出最终裁决之前进行审慎商议。

items.def_en: 1. (+ on/upon) To think deeply and carefully about something. 2. To focus the mind in silence for spiritual peace or relaxation.
items.ex_en: Philosophers often meditate upon the delicate relationship between free will and destiny.
items.ex_zh: 哲学家们经常深思自由意志与命运之间错综微妙的关系。

items.def_zh: 深思熟虑，仔细琢磨（常与 over 连用）；加香料温热（酒等）
items.def_en: (also 'mull over') To think carefully and at length about something before deciding.
items.ex_en: The investor took the weekend to mull the lucrative acquisition offer over.
items.ex_zh: 这位投资人利用周末时间反复琢磨了那份利润丰厚的收购要约。

items.def_en: (+ on/over) to think deeply and repeatedly about something over a long period
items.ex_en: The philosopher spent months ruminating on the ethical dilemmas posed by artificial intelligence.
items.ex_zh: 这位哲学家花了数月时间，反复沉思人工智能所带来的伦理困境。

items.def_zh: 使全神贯注，占据（某人的心头）
items.def_en: (often passive) To fill someone's thoughts completely so that other matters are ignored.
items.ex_en: Thoughts of the impending audit preoccupied him so completely that he missed his train.
items.ex_zh: 对即将到来的审计的心思完全占据了他的心头，以至于他错过了火车。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to ponder or deliberate intently in a formal, scholarly manner
items.ex_en: The committee convened quietly to cogitate upon the long-term ramifications of the proposed doctrine.
items.ex_zh: 委员会悄然召开会议，慎思该拟议学说的长期影响。

groups.summary_en: Cognizers engage in deep, sustained, and deliberate mental processing over complex questions, options, or memories. Verbs vary from weighing concrete pros and cons to reflective interior meditation or passive mental absorption.
groups.summary_zh: 对复杂问题、选项或记忆进行深入、持续且审慎的思量与回味。
groups.desc_en: Mentally turns an issue over with sustained focus and deliberation, contrasting with spontaneous intuition or quick decisions.
groups.desc_zh: 持续专注地在心智中反复权衡推敲某事，与自发直觉或仓促决定相对。
groups.nuance_en: contemplate: prolonged introspective gazing or considering possibilities (future / retirement / mortality) · mull over: reflective informal rumination over time (offer / decision / problem) · weigh: comparative objective balancing of competing options (options / pros and cons / evidence) · deliberate: formal, highly structured collective or individual evaluation (jury / panel / issue) · chew on: colloquial mental mastication of a difficult notion (idea / concept / feedback)
groups.nuance_zh: contemplate: 深入沉思或长远考量可能性 (future / retirement / mortality) · mull over: 随性但反复深思 (offer / decision / problem) · weigh: 对比权衡多方利弊与证据 (options / pros and cons / evidence) · deliberate: 正式、极具条理的审议深思 (jury / panel / issue) · chew on: 口语中对棘手想法反复咀嚼琢磨 (idea / concept / feedback)

groups.name: Praise & Exalt · 赞赏与歌颂 (Laud, Acclaim, Hymn)
groups.tip: 从口头好评升华至热烈鼓掌狂赞

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to speak very highly or enthusiastically about someone or something to promote them
items.ex_en: The company talked up the new phone, but users found it quite ordinary.
items.ex_zh: 公司对那款新手机大加吹捧，但用户发现它其实平平无奇。

items.def_en: 1. To clap the hands repeatedly to show approval or enjoyment. 2. To praise and strongly approve of an action, decision, or policy.
items.ex_en: Environmental groups applauded the council's decision to ban single-use plastics across the entire city.
items.ex_zh: 环保团体赞赏市议会在全城范围内禁止一次性塑料制品的决定。

items.def_zh: 唱赞美诗歌颂；赞美，称颂
items.def_en: (archaic or literary) To celebrate or praise someone or something in psalms or hymns.
items.ex_en: The ancient chronicler psalmed the king's glorious victories across every page of the manuscript.
items.ex_zh: 这位古代编年史家在手稿的每一页上都作诗歌颂国王的辉煌胜利。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to praise someone or something loudly and publicly
items.ex_en: Court sycophants constantly cried up the minor achievements of the vain and fickle emperor.
items.ex_zh: 宫廷奉承者们不断大肆吹捧那位虚荣且善变的皇帝所取得的微小功绩。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to express enthusiastic and glowing approval of someone or something
items.ex_en: The academic journal sang the praises of her innovative approach to cancer research.
items.ex_zh: 该学术期刊高度赞扬了她在癌症研究中所采用的创新方法。

items.def_zh: 公开称赞，热烈欢呼，高度赞扬
items.def_en: (+ as) To praise and welcome someone or something publicly and enthusiastically.
items.ex_en: Critics acclaimed the young pianist as the most promising musical genius of her generation.
items.ex_zh: 批评家们公开称赞这位年轻的钢琴家为同代人中最具前景的音乐天才。

items.def_en: (literary) To praise, celebrate, or extol someone or something in song or writing.
items.ex_en: Generations of local poets have hymned the quiet beauty of these misty northern fells.
items.ex_zh: 一代代本土诗人都在诗文中歌颂这些多雾北方丘陵的幽静之美。

items.def_en: To applaud or cheer enthusiastically, especially by shouting 'bravo'.
items.ex_en: The enraptured audience stood up to bravo the soprano after her final soaring aria.
items.ex_zh: 女高音唱完最后一首高亢的咏叹调后，陶醉的观众纷纷起立向她高声喝彩。

items.def_en: to praise someone or something lavishly and formally in public
items.ex_en: The headmaster lauded the students for their exemplary dedication to the community service project.
items.ex_zh: 校长极力赞扬了学生们对社区服务项目所展现出的典范奉献精神。

items.def_zh: 热烈赞扬，赞不绝口 (rave about/over)；胡言乱语，狂暴吼叫
items.def_en: 1. (+ about/over) To speak or write with extreme enthusiasm and high praise. 2. (+ at/against) To talk wildly, incoherently, or angrily.
items.ex_en: Food critics rave about the chef's bold integration of traditional and modern culinary techniques.
items.ex_zh: 美食品评家对这位主厨将传统与现代烹饪技法的大胆融合赞不绝口。

items.def_en: to praise someone or something very enthusiastically and at great length
items.ex_en: The prime minister extolled the virtues of free trade during his international summit address.
items.ex_zh: 首相在国际峰会演说中大加赞颂自由贸易的种种益处。

items.def_en: to praise someone or something very highly, especially in a formal speech or writing
items.ex_en: The senator eulogized his late colleague with profound dignity and heartfelt reverence yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 参议员昨天以极其庄严和由衷的敬意，在悼词中高度赞颂了他已故的同事。

groups.summary_en: A speaker or community expresses vocal, written, or ceremonial approval of someone or something, scaling from enthusiastic public approval up to exalted, near-sacred adulation and singing of praises.
groups.summary_zh: 对某人或事由衷赞赏、公开喝彩乃至作诗赞颂与神圣崇奉。
groups.desc_en: Verbally elevates and glorifies someone or something with high approval, exceeding routine complimenting through fervor or public resonance.
groups.desc_zh: 以极高认可度公开赞颂、称赞某人某事，在热情与声量上远超常规称赞。
groups.nuance_en: applaud: formally expressing strong endorsement or approval (decision / efforts / courage) · acclaim: enthusiastically celebrating with public renown (critics / audience / masterpiece) · hymn: reverently extolling in poetry or song (virtues / hero / nature) · talk up: promotionally boosting reputation or expectations (prospects / candidate / economy) · sing praises of: effusively magnifying virtues to others (staff / mentor / host)
groups.nuance_zh: applaud: 正式表达强烈赞赏与支持 (decision / efforts / courage) · acclaim: 公开而狂热地赞誉喝彩 (critics / audience / masterpiece) · hymn: 虔敬崇高地歌颂吟咏 (virtues / hero / nature) · talk up: 吹捧、积极宣扬以抬高声望 (prospects / candidate / economy) · sing praises of: 热情洋溢地大加赞扬美德 (staff / mentor / host)

groups.name: Propel & Hurl · 投掷与抛甩 (Throw, Toss, Hurl)
groups.tip: 扬臂将手中物体飞掷甩出

items.def_en: (+ sth) to toss or throw an object in a high, gentle arc over an obstacle
items.ex_en: The tennis player deftly lobbed the ball over the net and past her opponent.
items.ex_zh: 网球选手灵巧地将球高高挑过球网，越过了她的对手。

items.def_zh: 轻抛，轻掷；甩（头）；（使）摇摆，颠簸
items.def_en: 1. To throw something lightly or carelessly. 2. To move or shake gently or violently from side to side or up and down.
items.ex_en: She tossed the crumpled draft into the recycling bin and started writing all over.
items.ex_zh: 她把揉皱的草稿轻抛进回收桶，然后重新开始写。

items.def_zh: 随手扔，随便抛；放弃，抛弃
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To throw something carelessly or casually. 2. (informal) To give up or reject something.
items.ex_en: He chucked his wet jacket onto the sofa and grabbed a warm mug of tea.
items.ex_zh: 他随手把湿外套扔到沙发上，然后端起一杯热茶。

items.def_en: 1. (British informal) To throw or put something somewhere casually. 2. To close or plug a hole with a stopper.
items.ex_en: Just bung the dirty laundry in the basket and come help me with dinner.
items.ex_zh: 直接把脏衣服扔进篮子里，然后过来帮我做晚饭吧。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to throw or cast something away forcefully and abruptly
items.ex_en: She flung away the broken locket in a sudden fit of grief and anger.
items.ex_zh: 在突如其来的悲愤交加之下，她用力扔掉了那个摔坏的小盒吊坠。

items.def_en: 1. To send something through the air by a rapid movement of the arm and hand. 2. To put someone or something suddenly into a particular state or condition.
items.ex_en: The boy threw a smooth pebble across the lake, watching it skip three times.
items.ex_zh: 男孩将一颗光滑的卵石投向湖面，看着它在水面上跳跃了三次。

items.def_zh: 投，掷，抛；投射（视线、阴影等）；铸造；选派（角色）
items.def_en: 1. To throw something, especially by casting a fishing line or net. 2. To direct light, a shadow, or a look at something. 3. To shape molten metal or material in a mold; to assign an actor to a role.
items.ex_en: The setting sun cast long, solemn shadows across the quiet expanse of the valley.
items.ex_zh: 夕阳在宁静辽阔的山谷间投下道道庄严而悠长的阴影。

items.def_en: [I/T] To throw an object deliberately toward a specific target or player.
items.ex_en: The catcher crouched low as the veteran ace pitched a blistering fastball over home.
items.ex_zh: 老牌王牌投手向本垒投出一记迅猛的快速球，捕手随之压低身子。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to throw an object back with great strength or violence
items.ex_en: Enraged protesters hurled back the tear gas canisters toward the retreating lines of police.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的抗议者将催泪弹猛掷回步步后撤的警察防线。

items.def_en: To throw or fling something casually yet forcefully with a sweeping arm movement.
items.ex_en: He slung his heavy rucksack over one shoulder and marched into the dense jungle.
items.ex_zh: 他一把将沉重的帆布包甩上一侧肩膀，迈步走进了茂密的丛林。

items.def_zh: 连续投掷，向……掷击；倾泻；疾驰
items.def_en: 1. To throw a continuous stream of objects at someone or something. 2. (of rain) To fall heavily. 3. (informal) To run very fast.
items.ex_en: Mischievous neighborhood children pelted the abandoned wooden shed with ripe tomatoes every hot afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 每个炎热的下午，附近淘气的孩子们都会用熟番茄连续投掷那间废弃的木棚。

items.def_en: To throw something with tremendous force, violence, or velocity.
items.ex_en: A sudden violent gust hurled debris across the highway, forcing all traffic to halt.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的一股狂风将碎屑猛掷穿过公路，迫使所有车辆停驶。

groups.summary_en: Verbs expressing the manual propulsion of an object through the air, distinguished by trajectory, exertion of force, care, and aggressive intent.
groups.summary_zh: 指以手部发力将物体送入空中的动作，按用力强度、随意程度及攻击性排序。
groups.desc_en: Propels an object through space by releasing it from the hand with momentum, differing from controlled carrying or precision firing.
groups.desc_zh: 借由手部发力与动量将物体抛射至空中，与受控携带或精确发射有别。
groups.nuance_en: throw: standard purposeful manual propulsion (ball / stone / punch) · toss: light, relaxed, or underhand release (coin / salad / keys) · chuck: casual, careless, or discard-oriented throwing (junk / rubbish / ball) · pitch: targeted, forceful delivery toward a specific mark (baseball / tent / payload) · fling away: abrupt, forceful throwing driven by disregard or impatience (coat / letter / weapon)
groups.nuance_zh: throw: 标准、有目的的手部投掷 (ball / stone / punch) · toss: 轻松、随意或轻手的抛掷 (coin / salad / keys) · chuck: 随手乱扔或抛弃式掷扔 (junk / rubbish / ball) · pitch: 朝向特定目标的定向发力投掷 (baseball / tent / payload) · fling away: 带着不耐烦或嫌恶的猛力甩弃 (coat / letter / weapon)

groups.name: Provide & Supply · 提供与供应 (Provide, Supply, Furnish)
groups.tip: 向他人供给所需物资

items.def_zh: 提供，供应；（法律、合同等）规定
items.def_en: 1. To give something to someone or make it available for them to use. 2. (formal) To state or lay down as a condition, especially in a law or contract.
items.ex_en: The contract explicitly provides that all disputes must be settled through neutral binding arbitration.
items.ex_zh: 该合同明确规定，所有争议均须通过中立且具约束力的仲裁加以解决。

items.def_zh: 提供，给予；表示愿意（做某事）；出价；奉献
items.def_en: 1. To make something available or present it to someone to accept or reject. 2. To express willingness to do something. 3. To propose an amount of money for buying something.
items.ex_en: The tech firm offered him a competitive salary along with generous stock option packages.
items.ex_zh: 这家科技公司为他提供了极具竞争力的薪资以及丰厚的股票期权套餐。

items.def_zh: 供应，提供，补给；满足（需求）
items.def_en: 1. To provide someone or something with things that they need or want, especially in large quantities.
items.ex_en: The international agency supplies vital emergency medical goods to remote and underserved rural regions.
items.ex_zh: 该国际机构向偏远且物资匮乏的农村地区供应重要的急救医疗物资。

items.def_zh: 为……提供物资（尤指口粮或给养）
items.def_en: 1. To supply someone or a group (such as an expedition, army, or ship) with food and necessary supplies.
items.ex_en: The naval admiralty provisioned the expeditionary fleet with enough salted meat for two years.
items.ex_zh: 海军部为这支远征舰队配给了足够支撑两年的腌肉等给养物资。

items.def_en: (+ with) to provide someone or an organization with a full set of equipment or clothing
items.ex_en: The university outfitted the new biology lab with state-of-the-art electron microscopes and sensors.
items.ex_zh: 大学为新建的生物实验室装配了最先进的电子显微镜和传感器。

items.def_en: (+ with) to supply a person or place with the necessary tools, skills, or items
items.ex_en: The school aims to equip students with critical thinking skills required for future careers.
items.ex_zh: 该校旨在让学生掌握未来职业生涯所必需的批判性思维技能。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to distribute food, money, or goods freely or in large quantities
items.ex_en: The campaign volunteer dished out hundreds of pamphlets to curious commuters outside the station.
items.ex_zh: 竞选志愿者在车站外向好奇的通勤者分发了数百份宣传手册。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to provide someone or an organization with all the necessary clothing, tools, or gear
items.ex_en: The expedition leader kitted out every climber with thermal suits and sturdy spiked boots.
items.ex_zh: 探险队队长为每位攀登者都配齐了保暖服和坚固的冰爪靴。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to equip or furnish someone or something with special items, clothes, or gear
items.ex_en: They rigged out the antique vessel with modern navigation gear before the transatlantic voyage.
items.ex_zh: 横渡大西洋航行之前，他们为这艘老旧船只配备了现代导航设备。

items.def_en: (+ for/to) to provide food and drink for a social event, or supply what is required
items.ex_en: The local banquet hall expertly catered for more than three hundred distinguished wedding guests.
items.ex_zh: 当地的宴会厅专业地为三百多位尊贵的婚礼宾客承办了酒席。

items.def_zh: 提供，供应；为（房间、房屋）配备家具
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To supply or provide someone with something needed or useful. 2. To put furniture and fittings into a room or building.
items.ex_en: The whistleblower promised to furnish investigators with confidential internal documents detailing the massive fraud.
items.ex_zh: 举报人承诺向调查人员提供详细记录这起巨额欺诈案的内部机密文件。

items.def_zh: （专业地）供应，提供（食物、货物、信息等）
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To supply or sell goods, food, or information, especially as a business.
items.ex_en: The boutique shop has purveyed rare artisan cheeses to fine restaurants for decades.
items.ex_zh: 这家精品店数十年来一直向高级餐厅供应珍稀的手工干酪。

groups.summary_en: A supplier or benefactor makes goods, services, or necessities available to a recipient. Verbs shift across general everyday terms, commercial procurement, formal or legal granting, and specialized food/equipment provisioning.
groups.summary_zh: 向接受方提供物品、设施或给养，涵盖通用提供至商业与官方配给。
groups.desc_en: Furnishes necessary goods, materials, or facilities to meet a requirement, distinguished from mere granting by its logistical utility.
groups.desc_zh: 供给必要的物品、资材或设施以满足需求，区别于单纯给予之处在于其保障性与功用性。
groups.nuance_en: provide: general supply of essentials, resources, or conditions (food / shelter / service) · supply: restocking depleted inventory or logistical distribution (goods / weapons / energy) · equip: outfitting with specialized tools or skills (soldiers / laboratory / team) · furnish: appointing an interior or supplying abstract evidence (apartment / room / proof) · outfit: kitting out comprehensively for a specific expedition or duty (explorers / ship / vehicle)
groups.nuance_zh: provide: 通用的生活要素、资源或条件供给 (food / shelter / service) · supply: 后勤补给、定期供应库存物资 (goods / weapons / energy) · equip: 配备专业工具、器械或技能 (soldiers / laboratory / team) · furnish: 室内布置陈设或提供抽象证据 (apartment / room / proof) · outfit: 为特定任务或探险进行全套行头装备 (explorers / ship / vehicle)

groups.name: Reduce & Diminish · 减损与缩减 (Curtail, Deplete, Decimate)
groups.tip: 数量削减或规模由大变小

items.def_en: (+ sth) to reduce the amount, size, or number of something
items.ex_en: The factory must cut down operational expenses to survive the severe economic downturn this year.
items.ex_zh: 该工厂必须削减运营开支，才能挺过今年严峻的经济低迷期。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make or become smaller, fewer, or less significant
items.ex_en: Her persistent physical pain diminished gradually following the successful surgical procedure last winter.
items.ex_zh: 去年冬天手术成功后，她持续的身体疼痛逐渐减轻了。
items.ex2_en: Strict conservation efforts helped diminish the environmental impact of the nearby factory.
items.ex2_zh: 严格的保护措施有助于减少附近工厂对环境造成的影响。

items.def_zh: 减损，贬低（价值、声誉等）；转移
items.def_en: (also 'detract from') To make something seem less valuable, attractive, or impressive.
items.ex_en: The minor typographical errors in the appendix do not detract from the book's value.
items.ex_zh: 附录中的些许排版错误丝毫不减损该书的学术价值。

items.def_en: To gradually decrease in strength, importance, or size; (of the moon) to show a smaller lighted area.
items.ex_en: Public enthusiasm for the lengthy military campaign began to wane as casualties mounted rapidly.
items.ex_zh: 随着伤亡人数迅速攀升，公众对这场旷日持久军事行动的热情开始衰退。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to gradually reduce something to its essential minimum size or cost
items.ex_en: The municipal council pared down the municipal infrastructure budget to its absolute bare minimum.
items.ex_zh: 市议会将市政基础设施预算层层压缩至绝对的最低限度。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make something smaller in size, scope, or extent than originally planned
items.ex_en: Management decided to scale back expansion plans due to soaring international freight shipment costs.
items.ex_zh: 由于国际货运成本飙升，管理层决定按比例缩减扩张计划的规模。

items.def_en: (+ from) To take away a number, amount, or part from a whole.
items.ex_en: Once you subtract all hidden transaction taxes from gross revenue, net profits plunge dramatically.
items.ex_zh: 一旦你从总收入中扣除所有隐形交易税，净利润就会大幅缩水。

items.def_en: to cut short or reduce the extent, duration, or quantity of something
items.ex_en: The administration was forced to curtail spending after projected tax revenues fell sharply short.
items.ex_zh: 在预计税收大幅短缺后，该届政府被迫缩减财政开支。

items.def_zh: 删节，缩减，节录；剥夺（权利等）
items.def_en: To make a book, play, or other text shorter by removing parts while preserving the core meaning.
items.ex_en: The editor abridged the thousand-page historical novel into a manageable edition for high schoolers.
items.ex_zh: 编辑将这本千页的历史小说删节成适合高中生阅读的精炼版本。

items.def_en: to reduce the number or quantity of something so that little remains
items.ex_en: Decades of overfishing have severely depleted wild salmon stocks throughout the coastal bay area.
items.ex_zh: 数十年的过度捕捞已严重耗尽了整个沿海海湾地区的野生三文鱼资源。

items.def_zh: 使人口剧减，使荒无人烟
items.def_en: (often passive) To greatly reduce the number of people living in an area.
items.ex_en: The brutal famine and subsequent plague depopulated fertile villages across the entire eastern province.
items.ex_zh: 残酷的饥荒以及随后的瘟疫使整个东部省份原本富饶的村庄人口剧减。

items.def_en: to kill or drastically reduce the strength or number of a population or group
items.ex_en: The harsh winter blizzard decimated the local deer population, leaving scarce survivors behind.
items.ex_zh: 严酷的冬日暴风雪使当地的鹿群大批死亡，幸存者所剩无几。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey the reduction in number, size, value, or intensity of a target, scaling from mathematical deduction or gradual decline to aggressive truncation and massive depletion.
groups.summary_zh: 表示数量、价值、规模或强度的减弱与消减，从常规扣减渐变至大幅剥夺消减。
groups.desc_en: Decreases the volume, scope, or duration of an existing whole, contrasting with total abolition or spontaneous shrinking.
groups.desc_zh: 削减已有整体的体积、规模或时长，区别于彻底废除或自然的自然萎缩。
groups.nuance_en: curtail: imposing restrictive limits to shorten or restrain (spending / rights / freedom) · diminish: gradual intrinsic lessening in magnitude, importance, or power (influence / value / power) · pare down: systematically trimming excess down to essentials (costs / staff / budget) · scale back: strategic reduction of operational size or ambition (plans / operations / targets) · detract: subtracting value, prestige, or beauty from an entity (merit / looks / quality)
groups.nuance_zh: curtail: 施加限制以强行削减或缩短 (spending / rights / freedom) · diminish: 规模、重要性或威力的渐进削损 (influence / value / power) · pare down: 剥离多余部分以精简至核心 (costs / staff / budget) · scale back: 战略性压缩规模或降级指标 (plans / operations / targets) · detract: 减损某物的价值、声誉或美感 (merit / looks / quality)

groups.name: Relinquish & Cede · 放弃与让渡 (Forgo, Relinquish, Cede)
groups.tip: 交出权力或放弃控制权

items.def_en: to state officially that a rule, claim, or right can be ignored or will not be enforced
items.ex_en: The magistrate agreed to waive the strict filing deadline under these extraordinary humanitarian circumstances.
items.ex_zh: 鉴于这些特殊的人道主义情况，法官同意放弃执行严格的提交期限规定。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to surrender possession, control, or a legal claim to something
items.ex_en: The rebellious prince finally gave up his claim to the disputed border territory peacefully.
items.ex_zh: 这位叛逆的王子最终和平放弃了他对有争议边境领土的所有权主张。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to surrender power, responsibility, or custody of something to someone else
items.ex_en: The defeated commander will formally hand over authority to the civilian interim government tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 战败的指挥官将于明日正式向文官过渡政府交出领导权。

items.def_en: to give up position, possession, or control, often reluctantly after pressure
items.ex_en: Under intense political pressure, the incumbent mayor yielded control of the municipal housing board.
items.ex_zh: 在巨大的政治压力下，现任市长让出了对市政住房委员会的控制权。

items.def_zh: （尤指不情愿地）放弃，交出（权力、权利或财产）；松开
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To give up power, control, a claim, or possession of something, often reluctantly. 2. To let go of a hold on something.
items.ex_en: The monarch was compelled to relinquish his sovereign powers to the elected parliament immediately.
items.ex_zh: 君主被迫立即向民选议会交出其最高统治权力。

items.def_zh: 放弃，舍弃（尤指令人满意之物）；居先，在……之前发生
items.def_en: 1. (variant of forgo) To decide to do without or give up something enjoyable or advantageous. 2. (archaic) To precede in time or place.
items.ex_en: The ascetic poet chose to forego worldly delights in quiet contemplation of eternal truth.
items.ex_zh: 这位苦行诗人选择舍弃凡尘俗乐，在静谧中沉思永恒的真理。

items.def_zh: 放弃，舍弃，克制不做（尤指令人满意之物）
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To decide to do without or give up something enjoyable or advantageous.
items.ex_en: She resolved to forgo her annual holiday bonus to help fund the unpaid internships.
items.ex_zh: 她决意放弃自己的年度节日奖金，以资助那些无薪实习岗位。

items.def_en: 1. Past participle of forego: to have given up or preceded.
items.ex_en: Having foregone all material wealth, the monk walked penniless through the snowy mountain pass.
items.ex_zh: 已经舍弃了一切世俗财富的僧人，身无分文地走过白雪皑皑的山口。

items.def_en: 1. Past participle of forgo: to have decided to do without or relinquished.
items.ex_en: She has forgone several lucrative promotions to care for her ailing father at home.
items.ex_zh: 为了在家照顾生病的父亲，她已经放弃了数次待遇优厚晋升机会。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to legally relinquish rights, ownership, or property to another party by signing a document
items.ex_en: The aging tycoon signed over his entire commercial real estate empire to the trust.
items.ex_zh: 这位年迈的大亨签字将其整个商业地产帝国过户转让给信托机构。

items.def_en: to give up control or possession of something to another person or power under force
items.ex_en: Besieged troops were forced to surrender their remaining heavy weapons to the advancing coalition.
items.ex_zh: 被包围的部队被迫向推进中的联军交出其剩余的重型武器。

items.def_zh: 割让，让给，放弃（领土、权利或控制权）
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To formally surrender or hand over power, territory, or rights to another country or person.
items.ex_en: The defeated empire was forced to cede three strategic maritime ports under the treaty.
items.ex_zh: 根据该条约，战败的帝国被迫割让三个具有战略意义的海港。

groups.summary_en: An agent parts with a right, claim, privilege, or territory, advancing in intensity from voluntarily declining a personal benefit to formally or reluctantly surrendering sovereignty and power under pressure.
groups.summary_zh: 从主动放弃便利与权益，递进至被迫或正式让渡领土与主权。
groups.desc_en: Gives up a claim, possession, or entitlement, contrasting with involuntary loss by involving an element of intentional surrender.
groups.desc_zh: 放弃所有权、主张或权益，与被动丢失的区别在于具有明确的主动让出或屈服意志。
groups.nuance_en: relinquish: formally or reluctantly releasing hold, power, or possession (control / claim / power) · waive: legally and voluntarily giving up a formal right or requirement (fees / rights / claim) · forgo: consciously passing up a pleasure, benefit, or convenience (dessert / opportunity / income) · cede: officially yielding territory or jurisdiction under pressure (land / territory / jurisdiction) · yield: submitting or bowing to superior force or demand (ground / power / priority)
groups.nuance_zh: relinquish: 正式或不情愿地交出掌控权或所有物 (control / claim / power) · waive: 依法律自愿放弃正式权利或规费 (fees / rights / claim) · forgo: 自觉舍弃某项利益、便利或享受 (dessert / opportunity / income) · cede: 在压力下官方割让领土或管辖权 (land / territory / jurisdiction) · yield: 向优势力量妥协退让 (ground / power / priority)

groups.name: Rest & Relax · 闲歇与怠惰 (Laze, Loaf, Slouch)
groups.tip: 体力耗尽后松弛与歇息

items.def_en: relax completely and take it easy, not doing anything strenuous
items.ex_en: After exhausting finals, we just want to chill out on the beach all weekend.
items.ex_zh: 期末考考得精疲力竭之后，我们整个周末只想在海滩上彻底放松。

items.def_en: pass time idly or stand around without doing anything productive
items.ex_en: Don't just loaf around the living room all afternoon; go finish your overdue homework.
items.ex_zh: 别整个下午都在客厅里无所事事地游手好闲，去把拖欠的作业写完。

items.def_zh: 闲荡；懒洋洋地消磨时间
items.def_en: spend time relaxing or doing very little in a lazy way
items.ex_en: On rainy Sundays, the kids love to lounge around in their soft pyjamas all day.
items.ex_zh: 在下雨的星期天，孩子们喜欢整天穿着柔软的睡衣懒洋洋地消磨时间。

items.def_en: (+ around/about) To lie, sit, or stand in a relaxed, lazy, or comfortable way.
items.ex_en: The tourists loved to lounge around the swimming pool all afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 游客们喜欢整个下午都在游泳池边懒散地闲坐着。

items.def_zh: 无所事事地放松，瘫着休息
items.def_en: (also 'cabbage out') (informal) To relax completely, resting and doing nothing mentally or physically demanding.
items.ex_en: After working sixty hours this week, I just want to cabbage out.
items.ex_zh: 这周工作了六十个小时后，我只想彻底瘫着好好休息。

items.def_en: (+ around/about) to spend time idly or avoid productive activity
items.ex_en: Stop loafing around the living room and help me clean the kitchen.
items.ex_zh: 别在客厅里晃荡虚度光阴了，快来帮我打扫厨房。

items.def_en: to sit, stand, or lie in a lazy, drooping way
items.ex_en: Tired from practice, the teenagers slouched on the sofa without speaking.
items.ex_zh: 训练累了的青少年们没精打采地瘫坐在沙发上一言不发。

items.def_en: To sit or lie in the sun, especially in order to get a suntan and relax.
items.ex_en: Many vacationers like to sunbathe on the sandy beaches during summer.
items.ex_zh: 许多度假者喜欢在夏天到沙滩上沐日光浴放松身心。

items.def_zh: 懒洋洋地坐卧（或靠着）；（舌头、头等）耷拉，下垂
items.def_en: 1. (+ around/about) To sit, lie, or stand in a lazy, relaxed way. 2. To hang or droop loosely.
items.ex_en: The exhausted hound lolled upon the porch, its long tongue dangling loosely.
items.ex_zh: 疲倦的猎犬懒洋洋地趴在门廊上，长长的舌头耷拉在外面。

items.def_en: to spend time in a relaxed, lazy manner without doing much work
items.ex_en: On quiet Sundays, we usually laze about the garden drinking iced tea.
items.ex_zh: 在宁静的周日，我们通常在花园里消闲偷懒，喝着冰茶。

items.def_en: to relax completely and do nothing mentally demanding
items.ex_en: Tonight I will just order pizza and veg out watching old movies.
items.ex_zh: 今晚我打算点份披萨，看老电影彻底放空瘫着。

items.def_zh: 无所事事地生活，过呆板单调的生活
items.def_en: (informal, disapproving) To live a dull, inactive life without physical or mental stimulation.
items.ex_en: He refused to vegetate in front of the television all summer long.
items.ex_zh: 他拒绝整个夏天都坐在电视机前过着浑浑噩噩的日子。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict the manner of idling, lying back, or passing time without mental or physical exertion, contrasting languid leisure with sluggish inactivity.
groups.summary_zh: 指以闲躺、懒散无所事事或无脑放空的方式休憩或度过时光。
groups.desc_en: Adopts an idle, inert posture or attitude free from exertion, contrasting with productive rest by emphasizing aimless ease.
groups.desc_zh: 采取无所事事、怠惰松散的姿态，与建设性休息的区别在于其强调无目的的消磨与安逸。
groups.nuance_en: lounge: reclining or moving languidly in comfortable repose (poolside / sofa / lobby) · loaf: aimlessly idling and actively avoiding constructive activity (afternoon / job / time) · slouch: adopting an ungainly, lazy, or drooped posture (chair / corner / posture) · chill out: modern conversational relaxing to de-stress (evening / friends / home) · sunbathe: lying indolently exposed to solar warmth (beach / deck / lawn)
groups.nuance_zh: lounge: 慵懒地斜倚或懒洋洋地消磨时光 (poolside / sofa / lobby) · loaf: 游手好闲、主动逃避劳作 (afternoon / job / time) · slouch: 没精打采地瘫坐或松垮站立 (chair / corner / posture) · chill out: 现代口语中的彻底放松减压 (evening / friends / home) · sunbathe: 懒散地日光浴曝晒 (beach / deck / lawn)

groups.name: Rest & Sleep · 休息与睡眠 (Depth of Slumber)
groups.tip: 从闭目小憩到熟睡休眠

items.def_en: to be half asleep and sluggish in a state between waking and sleeping
items.ex_en: The old scholar drowsed in his armchair under the gentle afternoon warmth.
items.ex_zh: 老学者在午后温煦的暖意中倚着扶手椅昏昏欲睡。

items.def_en: to sleep lightly or fitfully for a short period, often intermittently
items.ex_en: Grandpa began to doze lightly while listening to the calm classical music.
items.ex_zh: 听着平静的古典音乐，爷爷开始轻轻打起盹来。

items.def_zh: 慢慢入睡；不知不觉睡着
items.def_en: to gradually, peacefully enter a state of sleep
items.ex_en: Listening to the gentle rain, the child began to drift off peacefully.
items.ex_zh: 听着淅淅沥沥的细雨，孩子开始不知不觉安然入睡。

items.def_en: to succumb to tiredness and slip into sleep
items.ex_en: I can drop you off at the station on my way to work.
items.ex_zh: 我上班顺路可以把你送到车站下车。

items.def_en: to fall asleep unintentionally for a short period, especially while sitting upright
items.ex_en: The lecture was so tedious that several students began to nod off.
items.ex_zh: 讲座实在太枯燥了，以至于好几个学生都开始打瞌睡。

items.def_en: to remain asleep and stay in bed later in the morning than usual
items.ex_en: I always sleep in on Sundays to recharge for the coming week.
items.ex_zh: 我周日总会睡个懒觉，为接下来的一周补充精力。

items.def_zh: 睡，睡觉；提供住宿，容纳……住宿
items.def_en: 1. To rest in a state of natural unconsciousness. 2. To provide sleeping accommodation for a specified number of people.
items.ex_en: This small mountain cabin can comfortably sleep up to six exhausted hikers.
items.ex_zh: 这座小山中小屋可以舒适地容纳多达六名疲惫的徒步者住宿。

items.def_en: to take a brief, deliberate period of sleep during daytime
items.ex_en: She likes to nap for twenty minutes after lunch every single workday.
items.ex_zh: 每个工作日的午饭后，她都喜欢小憩二十分钟。

items.def_en: (literary) To sleep, especially peacefully or quietly.
items.ex_en: The weary traveler slumbered deeply beneath the ancient, rustling willow trees.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的旅人在沙沙作响的古老柳树下沉沉安睡。

items.def_en: to take a short, comfortable sleep, typically during the day
items.ex_en: I managed to snooze for half an hour during the long flight.
items.ex_zh: 在漫长的飞行途中，我设法打了半个小时的小盹。

items.def_zh: 睡，睡觉（sleep的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of sleep; to rest in sleep.
items.ex_en: The exhausted marathon runner slept for nearly twelve straight hours last night.
items.ex_zh: 筋疲力尽的马拉松跑者昨晚连续睡了将近整整十二个小时。

items.def_en: To sleep longer than intended and wake up late.
items.ex_en: Because his alarm did not ring, he oversleeps and misses breakfast.
items.ex_zh: 因为闹钟没有响，他睡过了头并错过了早餐。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame scale across states of physical rest and unconsciousness, from light dozing and restful repose to deep, extended, or excessive sleep.
groups.summary_zh: 体现由浅歇小憩到深沉沉睡、以至睡过头的生理睡眠程度变化。
groups.desc_en: Transitions into or maintains a state of suspended sensory consciousness, differentiated along a continuum of sleep depth.
groups.desc_zh: 进入或维持一种感官意识休眠状态，以睡眠深度与唤醒难易度为阶梯轴线。
groups.nuance_en: doze: sleeping lightly and intermittently, easily disturbed (armchair / lecture / heat) · nap: taking a brief, planned sleep during daytime (couch / afternoon / hour) · drowse: hovering languidly between wakefulness and light slumber (sun / medication / fever) · nod off: falling asleep unintentionally while upright (wheel / meeting / television) · sleep: undergoing prolonged natural subconscious physiological rest (bed / night / hours)
groups.nuance_zh: doze: 浅睡、打瞌睡且极易被惊醒 (armchair / lecture / heat) · nap: 白天短时间、有意识的小憩 (couch / afternoon / hour) · drowse: 昏昏欲睡、半梦半醒的状态 (sun / medication / fever) · nod off: 坐立时不由自主地打盹垂头 (wheel / meeting / television) · sleep: 持续深入的自然生理睡眠 (bed / night / hours)

groups.name: Rob & Plunder · 劫掠与洗劫 (Manner of Pillaging)
groups.tip: 战乱趁火打劫洗劫财物

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ through) to search quickly and illicitly through something to steal valuables
items.ex_en: The burglar rifled through the bedroom drawers looking for expensive gold jewelry.
items.ex_zh: 窃贼快速翻拣卧室的抽屉，搜寻贵重的黄金首饰。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) completely steal or plunder all money, goods, or possessions from a place or person
items.ex_en: The sneaky con artist cleaned out the pensioner's entire life savings.
items.ex_zh: 狡猾的骗子将这位领养老金老人的毕生积蓄洗劫一空。

items.def_zh: 当海盗，劫掠；从事冒险投机活动
items.def_en: to act as a pirate, raiding ships and coastal settlements, or engage in ruthless, opportunistic ventures.
items.ex_en: Fierce corsairs buccaneered across the stormy seas to raid Spanish coastal ports.
items.ex_zh: 凶悍的海盗在风暴肆虐的大海上打劫，突袭西班牙的沿海港口。

items.def_en: to search thoroughly through a house or room, causing damage and stealing items
items.ex_en: Vandals broke into the mansion and ransacked every single room for valuables.
items.ex_zh: 歹徒闯入豪宅，翻箱倒柜搜掠了每一个房间里的财物。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) rob a person, bank, or vehicle using a weapon and threats of violence
items.ex_en: Two masked men attempted to hold up the local convenience store tonight.
items.ex_zh: 今晚两名蒙面男子企图持械抢劫当地的那家便利店。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) threaten someone with a gun in order to rob them
items.ex_en: The outlaw pulled out a revolver and tried to stick up customers.
items.ex_zh: 这名亡命徒拔出左轮手枪，试图持枪抢劫在场的顾客。

items.def_zh: 掠夺，劫掠；盗版，非法复制
items.def_en: 1. to rob or attack ships or coastal areas as a pirate. 2. to reproduce or distribute copyrighted material without authorization.
items.ex_en: Ruthless raiders used to pirate merchant ships carrying spices and silk across.
items.ex_zh: 冷酷的劫掠者曾在此掠夺运送香料和丝绸的商船。

items.def_zh: 拦路抢劫；扮鬼脸；（考试前）突击苦读
items.def_en: 1. to attack and rob someone in a public place. [I] 2. to make exaggerated facial expressions. 3. (mug up) to study a subject rapidly, especially before an exam.
items.ex_en: A masked stranger tried to mug the tourist in a dark alley.
items.ex_zh: 一名蒙面陌生人企图在一条阴暗的小巷里拦路抢劫该游客。

items.def_zh: 洗劫，掠夺，抢劫（尤指在战乱或动乱期间）
items.def_en: to steal goods from shops, houses, or buildings, especially during a war, riot, or natural disaster.
items.ex_en: Rioters began to loot electronics stores during the chaotic blackout last night.
items.ex_zh: 昨晚混乱的停电期间，骚乱分子开始洗劫各家电器商店。

items.def_en: [I/T] to steal property ruthlessly using force or military supremacy
items.ex_en: Conquering legions plundered the ancient capital and stripped its temples bare.
items.ex_zh: 征服者的军团洗劫了这座古都，将城中的神庙抢夺一空。

items.def_en: [I/T] to steal goods violently from a place during wartime or civil unrest
items.ex_en: Invading forces pillaged the defenseless villages along the northern border mercilessly.
items.ex_zh: 侵略军残忍地洗劫了北部边境线上毫无防备的村庄。

items.def_zh: 劫掠，洗劫（被攻占的城镇）；解雇，开除
items.def_en: 1. to plunder, destroy, and strip a captured city or place of valuables. 2. (informal) to dismiss someone from a job.
items.ex_en: After winning the fierce siege, enemy troops sacked the wealthy trading town.
items.ex_zh: 在激烈的围城战获胜后，敌军洗劫了这座富庶的商贸城镇。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote taking property unlawfully by force, piracy, or violent raid, ranging from opportunistic street mugging to the organized pillaging of entire settlements or maritime targets.
groups.summary_zh: 强调通过暴力袭击、海盗行径或战乱乘机对人、船只或城池实施抢掠与洗劫。
groups.desc_en: Unlawfully strips a location or victim of valuables through force or disorder, contrasting with stealthy non-violent theft.
groups.desc_zh: 以武力、强暴或洗劫方式非法剥夺财物，区别于隐秘的非暴力偷窃。
groups.nuance_en: ransack: thoroughly and destructively searching a place for plunder (house / drawers / office) · rifle: rummaging hastily through contents to steal items (pockets / safe / files) · mug: physically assaulting someone in public to steal valuables (pedestrian / tourist / victim) · hold up: robbing at gunpoint or weapon threat (bank / store / train) · clean out: completely draining or stripping of all assets (savings / vault / account)
groups.nuance_zh: ransack: 翻箱倒柜、极具破坏性地洗劫搜刮 (house / drawers / office) · rifle: 快速翻找翻拣并盗取 (pockets / safe / files) · mug: 在街头对人施暴并抢夺财物 (pedestrian / tourist / victim) · hold up: 持枪或武器拦路截击抢劫 (bank / store / train) · clean out: 席卷一空、掏空全部资金物资 (savings / vault / account)

groups.name: Sew, Knit & Needlework · 编织与缝纫
groups.tip: 穿针引线，纺织缝合手艺

items.def_en: (+ sth) join or interlace threads, fabric, or parts closely together
items.ex_en: The tailor carefully knit together the individual fabric strips into one panel.
items.ex_zh: 裁缝细心地将零散的布条紧密编织在一起，拼成整幅布面。
items.ex2_en: The separated bone fragments knit together firmly after six weeks in a cast.
items.ex2_zh: 打石膏六周后，断裂的骨碎片牢固地愈合在一起。

items.def_en: (+ sth) mend or join a piece of fabric, garment, or tear using a needle and thread
items.ex_en: Can you stitch up this small tear along my jacket seam quickly?
items.ex_zh: 你能帮我把夹克接缝处这个小裂口快速缝补好吗？

items.def_en: (+ sth) close or repair an opening or tear in cloth by sewing
items.ex_en: The tailor promised to sew up the torn pocket by tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 裁缝答应在明天早晨之前把破损的口袋彻底缝好。

items.def_en: join, mend, or ornament with individual passes of a needle and thread
items.ex_en: She used fine golden thread to stitch delicate flowers onto the silk.
items.ex_zh: 她用精细的金线在丝绸上绣缝出娇艳的花朵。

items.def_en: make garments or fabric by interlocking loops of wool or yarn with knitting needles
items.ex_en: Grandmother loves to knit warm woolen mittens for her grandchildren each winter.
items.ex_zh: 祖母每年冬天都喜欢为孙辈们编织温暖的羊毛手套。
items.ex2_en: Broken bones typically knit together naturally if kept properly aligned during recovery.
items.ex2_zh: 在恢复期间如果保持正确对齐，断骨通常会自然愈合。

items.def_en: join, fasten, or repair cloth or garments using a needle and thread
items.ex_en: She learned how to sew her own clothes using an electric machine.
items.ex_zh: 她学会了如何用电动缝纫机来缝制自己的衣服。

items.def_en: form fabric by interlacing warp and weft threads on a loom or by hand
items.ex_en: Artisans still weave colorful patterns on traditional wooden looms in this village.
items.ex_zh: 工匠们依然在这个村庄里用传统木织机织造多彩图案。

items.def_en: repair a hole in knitted or woven fabric by interweaving yarn
items.ex_en: Grandmother showed me how to darn old wool socks with thick yarn.
items.ex_zh: 祖母向我展示了如何用粗纱线织补旧羊毛袜上的洞。

items.def_zh: 缝制（被褥或棉衣），做绗缝；绗缝
items.def_en: To make a quilt, or to stitch layers of fabric together with soft padding in between.
items.ex_en: The elderly sisters gathered each evening to quilt warm blankets for charity.
items.ex_zh: 老姐妹们每晚聚在一起，为慈善机构缝制保暖的被褥。

items.def_en: To make delicate lace or ornamental edging by knotting thread with a small shuttle.
items.ex_en: The elderly artisan used a small shuttle to tat delicate lace trim.
items.ex_zh: 那位老手艺人用一个小梭子结出了精致的花边饰条。

items.def_en: decorate cloth with patterns sewn in colored thread or yarn
items.ex_en: The skilled artisan began to embroider intricate patterns onto the velvet robe.
items.ex_zh: 技艺精湛的工匠开始在这件天鹅绒长袍上刺绣繁复图案。

items.def_en: To make garments, fabric, or decorative items using yarn and a single hooked needle.
items.ex_en: She likes to crochet soft baby blankets using pastel colored cotton yarn.
items.ex_zh: 她喜欢用柔和色调的棉线钩织柔软的婴儿毯。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to constructing, joining, or embellishing fabric, yarn, or thread using needles, hooks, or a loom. They range from basic utilitarian stitching to delicate decorative textile crafts.
groups.summary_zh: 用针、钩或织机制作、拼接及修饰织物或线料的手工与缝纫工艺。
groups.desc_en: Interlaces or joins flexible strands and textiles via hand tools, differing from industrial molding or rigid joining.
groups.desc_zh: 通过针具将柔性纤维或布料进行交织与缝合，区别于刚性构件的机械拼接。
groups.nuance_en: sew: joining fabrics using a needle and thread (garment / patch / hem) · stitch: executing precise individual thread loops or surgical closures (wound / seam / motif) · knit: forming fabric by interlocking yarn loops with needles (sweater / scarf / blanket) · weave: interlacing warp and weft threads on a loom (tapestry / fabric / basket) · darn: repairing holes in fabric by interlacing replacement threads (socks / sweater / wool)
groups.nuance_zh: sew: 用针线缝合织物布料 (garment / patch / hem) · stitch: 缝缀精细线迹或外科缝针 (wound / seam / motif) · knit: 用织针将毛线结套编结成衣物 (sweater / scarf / blanket) · weave: 在织机上经纬交错穿梭编织 (tapestry / fabric / basket) · darn: 经纬交织式织补织物破洞 (socks / sweater / wool)

groups.name: Shape & Mold · 塑造与成型 (Sculpt, Form, Fashion)
groups.tip: 揉塑成形赋予具体轮廓

items.def_en: (+ sth) remove the interior of something to shape it into a cavity or vessel
items.ex_en: The sculptor used a chisel to hollow out the solid block cleanly.
items.ex_zh: 雕刻家使用凿子将那块坚硬的实心原料干净利落地挖空。
items.ex2_en: The soft sandstone cliff hollowed out over centuries from constant coastal wave action.
items.ex2_zh: 在沿海海浪的持续作用下，柔软的砂岩悬崖历经数百年形成了空洞。

items.def_en: to bring parts or material together to produce a specified structural shape
items.ex_en: The artist pressed wet clay with both hands to form a bowl.
items.ex_zh: 艺术家双手按压湿润的黏土，将其塑成一只碗的形状。
items.ex2_en: Delicate ice crystals form on the bedroom windowpane during extremely cold winter nights.
items.ex2_zh: 在极其寒冷的冬夜，卧室的窗玻璃上会形成精致的冰晶。

items.def_zh: 塑造，做模型；做模特展示；使模仿，模拟
items.def_en: 1. To shape, fashion, or create a three-dimensional figure or object out of clay or other material. 2. To work as a model wearing clothes or displaying products. 3. To design or create something based on another thing.
items.ex_en: The sculptor began to model a human bust from soft gray clay.
items.ex_zh: 雕塑家开始用柔软的灰色黏土塑造一座人物半身胸像。

items.def_zh: 使符合……的轮廓，依形塑造；画等高线于；（用化妆品）勾画轮廓
items.def_en: To shape or mold something along natural curves and outlines; to fit the contours of an object.
items.ex_en: Special foam seats were designed to contour the driver's body perfectly.
items.ex_zh: 特制泡沫座椅的设计能够完全依循贴合驾驶员的身材轮廓。

items.def_en: (+ sth) fashion, cut, or shape a specific form or structure from a raw material
items.ex_en: The carpenter managed to carve out an ornate mask from cherry wood.
items.ex_zh: 木匠设法用樱桃木精心雕刻出了一副华丽的面具。

items.def_en: (+ sth) shape or flatten a piece of metal or pliable material by repeatedly striking it
items.ex_en: The blacksmith worked tirelessly to hammer out a smooth sheet of copper.
items.ex_zh: 铁匠不知疲倦地敲击，锤打成型了一块平整的铜片。

items.def_zh: 塑造，使成形；决定，影响（发展）
items.def_en: 1. To give a particular form or shape to something. 2. To influence or determine the nature, development, or character of something.
items.ex_en: Her early mentors helped shape her artistic vision during art school years.
items.ex_zh: 在她上艺术学校期间，早期的导师们帮助塑造了她的艺术视野。

items.def_en: (+ from/into) to make or shape something skillfully by hand or careful effort
items.ex_en: The craftsman fashioned a delicate silver ring from raw unpolished metal strips.
items.ex_zh: 手艺人从未抛光的原始金属条中精心打造出一枚精美的银戒。

items.def_en: to shape molten metal, plaster, or plastic by pouring it into a mold
items.ex_en: The artisan cast a heavy bronze bell using ancient ancestral methods tonight.
items.ex_zh: 工匠今晚使用古老的祖传技艺浇铸了一口沉重的青铜钟。

items.def_zh: 使成阶梯状，把……筑成梯田
items.def_en: 1. To shape a sloping hillside into a series of flat, stepped levels for farming or building.
items.ex_en: Farmers worked for centuries to terrace the steep hillside for rice cultivation.
items.ex_zh: 几个世纪以来，农民们努力将陡峭的山坡筑成阶梯状梯田以种植水稻。

items.def_zh: 塑造，模压，浇铸；塑造（性格等）；发霉
items.def_en: 1. To shape a soft substance into a particular form. 2. To strongly influence someone's character or opinions. 3. To become covered with mold.
items.ex_en: A great teacher can easily mold the curious minds of young students.
items.ex_zh: 优秀的老师可以轻易塑造年轻学生那充满求知欲的心灵。

items.def_en: to shape raw solid material into a specific three-dimensional artistic form
items.ex_en: The master artist took marble blocks to sculpt a magnificent equestrian statue.
items.ex_zh: 这位艺术大师采用大理石石料雕刻出了一尊壮丽的马术雕像。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote giving physical or conceptual form to raw or malleable materials by carving, pressing, fitting, or styling into a specific contour or structure.
groups.summary_zh: 对可塑材料或抽象概念进行加工、修整、压制或雕刻，赋予其明确外形与结构。
groups.desc_en: Imparts definite spatial form or aesthetic contour to raw substance, distinguished from mere assembly by volumetric manipulation.
groups.desc_zh: 对原材料施加外力以赋予其确切的空间轮廓与造型，区别于单纯组装。
groups.nuance_en: shape: imposing spatial form or conceptual direction on mass (clay / dough / future) · mold: pressing or casting pliable material into a rigid matrix (plastic / lead / opinions) · fashion: skillfully crafting or contriving out of available materials (tool / shelter / garment) · carve out: cutting or excavating solid matter to form hollows or niches (niche / career / sculpture) · hammer out: forging metal by striking, or laboriously negotiating consensus (agreement / deal / metal)
groups.nuance_zh: shape: 塑造外在轮廓或决定概念走向 (clay / dough / future) · mold: 将可塑材料注入模具定型，或塑造思维 (plastic / lead / opinions) · fashion: 巧妙利用手头材料手工制作 (tool / shelter / garment) · carve out: 雕琢硬物以凿出空间，或开创领域 (niche / career / sculpture) · hammer out: 锤打锻造金属，或艰难谈妥达成共识 (agreement / deal / metal)

groups.name: Socialize & Escort · 相伴与随行 (Visit, Accompany, Date)
groups.tip: 结伴而行相随护送

items.def_en: (+ sb) invite someone out socially, especially with romantic intent
items.ex_en: He finally gathered the courage to ask her out for a movie.
items.ex_zh: 他终于鼓起勇气约她出去看电影。

items.def_en: (+ sb) have a romantic relationship with someone, regularly going on dates together
items.ex_en: Mark asked Sarah if she wanted to go out with him tonight.
items.ex_zh: 马克问萨拉今晚是否愿意同他一起出去约会交往。

items.def_en: (+ sb) accompany someone to a station, airport, or departure point to say goodbye
items.ex_en: We all went down to the train station to see off David.
items.ex_zh: 我们全都赶到火车站去为大卫送行道别。

items.def_en: to spend time with someone in order to win their love and marry them
items.ex_en: The modest gentleman sought to court the noble maiden with tender sonnets.
items.ex_zh: 这位谦和的绅士试图用温存的十四行诗来向贵族少女求爱。

items.def_zh: 与……约会，谈恋爱；注明日期；确定……的年代
items.def_en: 1. to have a romantic relationship with someone, going on dates regularly. 2. to write or determine the date of something.
items.ex_en: They decided to date each other exclusively after meeting at university last year.
items.ex_zh: 自从去年在大学相遇后，他们便决定正式确立恋爱关系。

items.raw_cluster: 拜访与探望 Visit & Call On
items.def_zh: 拜访，探望；参观，游览；作客，闲聊
items.def_en: 1. to go to see someone socially or spend time with them. 2. to go to a place to look around or stay there as a tourist.
items.ex_en: I plan to visit my elderly grandparents in the countryside this weekend.
items.ex_zh: 我计划这个周末去乡下探望我年迈的祖父母。

items.def_en: to travel or go somewhere with someone as a companion or escort
items.ex_en: The doctor asked a nurse to accompany the patient to the ward.
items.ex_zh: 医生让一名护士随同护送该病人前往病房。

items.def_en: (formal or literary) to accompany or be a companion to someone.
items.ex_en: The faithful hound companioned the solitary shepherd across the lonely bleak moors.
items.ex_zh: 那只忠诚的猎犬伴随着孤独的牧羊人穿过荒凉荒僻的荒原。

items.def_en: to accompany someone somewhere, especially for protection or as an official courtesy
items.ex_en: Security officers were assigned to escort the diplomat safely into the building.
items.ex_zh: 安保人员受命护送外交官安全进入了政府大楼内部。

items.def_en: (archaic) to accompany or keep company with someone.
items.ex_en: The gentle monk chose to company the sick pilgrim throughout his journey.
items.ex_zh: 慈悲的僧侣选择在整个旅途中陪伴那位患病的朝圣者同行。

items.def_zh: 遇见，相逢；（与……）会面，结识；满足，达到
items.def_en: 1. to come into the presence of or encounter someone; to get together socially or formally. 2. to fulfill or satisfy a condition or need.
items.ex_en: Let us meet outside the central library tomorrow morning at nine o'clock.
items.ex_zh: 让我们明天早上九点整在中央图书馆门外碰头会面吧。

items.def_zh: 遇见，会面；满足（meet 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: past tense and past participle of meet: to come into the presence of someone, or to fulfill a need.
items.ex_en: I met our new marketing director for lunch to discuss the upcoming project.
items.ex_zh: 我和我们新来的市场总监共进午餐，商讨即将开展的项目。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe personal interactions involving visiting, accompanying, or courting another person, differentiated by social formality and intimacy.
groups.summary_zh: 表现拜访看望、随行陪同或浪漫交往等具有人际陪伴性质的社交方式。
groups.desc_en: Partners with someone socially or geographically to provide company, protection, or romantic attention, surpassing solitary presence.
groups.desc_zh: 在社交或地理空间中与人作伴，提供陪伴、护送或追求爱慕，区别于孤立自处。
groups.nuance_en: accompany: formally traveling with or being present beside someone (delegation / singer / guest) · escort: guarding or guiding someone in public for courtesy or security (dignitary / convoy / prisoner) · court: pursuing romantic intentions toward marriage formally (partner / suitor / favor) · date: engaging in romantic social appointments mutually (colleague / partner / boyfriend) · see off: accompanying someone to a departure station to bid farewell (relatives / train / airport)
groups.nuance_zh: accompany: 正式随行、伴随或作乐器伴奏 (delegation / singer / guest) · escort: 出于礼仪或安保在公共场合护送引路 (dignitary / convoy / prisoner) · court: 正式追求、求爱或拉拢青睐 (partner / suitor / favor) · date: 双方互约进行浪漫约会 (colleague / partner / boyfriend) · see off: 送行至车站机场并道别 (relatives / train / airport)

groups.name: Soothe & Comfort · 安抚与抚慰 (Calm, Pacify, Placate)
groups.tip: 缓和紧张情绪抚慰受伤心灵

items.def_en: (+ down) to stop someone from feeling upset, angry, or excited
items.ex_en: The nurse spoke softly in order to calm the frightened little girl.
items.ex_zh: 护士轻声细语，以安抚那个受惊的小女孩。
items.ex2_en: The rough ocean waters began to calm as the severe storm passed eastward.
items.ex2_zh: 随着猛烈的风暴向东移动，汹涌的海水开始平静下来。

items.def_en: to make someone feel less worried, unhappy, or distressed
items.ex_en: She sat beside him and tried to comfort him after the tragic news.
items.ex_zh: 得知噩耗后，她坐在他身边，试图抚慰他的情绪。

items.def_en: (+ sb) make someone less agitated, angry, or distressed, or become quieter
items.ex_en: Take a few deep breaths and try to calm down before speaking.
items.ex_zh: 开口说话之前，先做几次深呼吸，努力平静下来。
items.ex2_en: The gentle nursery music helped calm down the agitated toddlers before afternoon naptime.
items.ex2_zh: 轻柔的童谣音乐有助于在下午午睡前安抚躁动不安的幼儿。

items.def_en: (+ sb) become calm, tranquil, or quiet, or cause someone to do so
items.ex_en: The teacher waited patiently for the noisy children to settle down completely.
items.ex_zh: 老师耐心地等待着喧闹的孩子们彻底安静下来。
items.ex2_en: The tired mother rocked the baby gently to settle down her crying child.
items.ex2_zh: 疲惫的母亲轻轻摇晃婴儿，以安抚啼哭的孩子安静下来。

items.def_en: (+ sb) make someone or become less loud, excited, or emotionally disturbed
items.ex_en: The barking dogs began to quiet down as their owner approached the gate.
items.ex_zh: 随着主人走向大门，狂吠的狗开始安静下来。
items.ex2_en: The headmaster raised his hand to quiet down the noisy assembly hall immediately.
items.ex2_zh: 校长举起手，立刻让喧闹的礼堂安静了下来。

items.def_zh: 安慰，抚慰，使平静；缓解，减轻（痛苦或不适）
items.def_en: 1. To make someone who is anxious, upset, or angry feel calmer. 2. To relieve physical pain, soreness, or irritation.
items.ex_en: Applying this herbal lotion will quickly soothe your irritated and sunburned skin.
items.ex_zh: 涂抹这种草本乳液可以迅速舒缓你发炎和晒伤的皮肤。

items.def_zh: （常与 along 连用）逗乐，鼓励，哄……高兴
items.def_en: 1. (usually jolly somebody along) (informal) To keep someone in a good mood or encourage them with friendly, cheerful talk.
items.ex_en: The manager managed to jolly the tired crew along until the job was done.
items.ex_zh: 经理设法哄着疲惫的团队保持干劲，直到任务顺利完成。

items.def_en: 1. To calm someone or prevent conflict by giving them what they demand.
items.ex_en: The prime minister made concessions to appease the growing crowd of protesters.
items.ex_zh: 首相做出了让步，以平息日益壮大的抗议人群的怒气。

items.def_en: 1. (formal) To give comfort, consolation, or emotional relief to someone who is grieving or distressed.
items.ex_en: The priest offered gentle words to solace the grieving widow during her mourning.
items.ex_zh: 在寡妇哀悼期间，牧师用温和的话语抚慰她悲痛的心灵。

items.def_zh: 哄（某人）入睡；使放松警惕，使平静；变平静
items.def_en: 1. To make someone feel calm, safe, or sleepy. 2. To trick someone into feeling safe or complacent. 3. (of a storm or noise) To become quiet or less active.
items.ex_en: The rhythmic sound of ocean waves helped to lull the baby to sleep.
items.ex_zh: 海浪有节奏的声音帮助小婴儿安然入睡。

items.def_en: to stop someone from feeling hostile or indignant by acting conciliatory
items.ex_en: The airline offered free hotel vouchers to placate the stranded, angry passengers.
items.ex_zh: 航空公司提供免费酒店住宿券，以平息滞留乘客的愤怒。

items.def_en: to soften someone's anger or anxiety by making gentle remarks or concessions
items.ex_en: A personal apology from the director did little to mollify the furious customer.
items.ex_zh: 主管本人的亲口道歉并没能平息那位愤怒顾客的情绪。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote easing emotional agitation, physical pain, or distress by providing tenderness, reassurance, pleasant distractions, or concessions.
groups.summary_zh: 通过温柔抚慰、言语开导或让步平息他人的悲伤、烦躁、愤怒或躯体痛楚。
groups.desc_en: Restores emotional equilibrium or physical stillness to an agitated subject, differing from medicinal curing by targeting distress.
groups.desc_zh: 使焦虑、狂乱的对象恢复情绪平衡或生理宁静，与治愈疾病的区别在于其专注于抚慰痛苦。
groups.nuance_en: soothe: gently relieving physical ache or frayed nerves (pain / nerves / throat) · comfort: extending consoling warmth to alleviate grief or distress (child / mourner / patient) · pacify: actively suppressing turmoil, revolt, or anger to restore calm (crowd / territory / rebels) · appease: placating an aggrieved party through concessions (dictator / public / conscience) · calm down: de-escalating heightened individual emotional agitation (breath / speaker / temper)
groups.nuance_zh: soothe: 温和抚平生理痛楚或焦躁神经 (pain / nerves / throat) · comfort: 给予慰藉温情以分担忧伤困苦 (child / mourner / patient) · pacify: 强力平定骚乱、反抗或暴怒以恢复和平 (crowd / territory / rebels) · appease: 通过原则妥协平息对方怨愤 (dictator / public / conscience) · calm down: 缓和抚平激动的个体情绪 (breath / speaker / temper)

groups.name: Throw & Launch · 投掷与发射 (Fling, Sling, Catapult)
groups.tip: 用力甩出或猛力投掷

items.def_en: (+ sth) throw something away or propel it outward through the air
items.ex_en: Remember to toss out all the expired food from the office refrigerator.
items.ex_zh: 记得把办公室冰箱里的所有过期食品都清理扔掉。

items.def_en: to throw or hit something in a high, curving arc with gentle or measured force
items.ex_en: The quarterback chose to lob the football gently over the defender's outstretched arms.
items.ex_zh: 四分卫选择把橄榄球高高吊传过去，越过防守球员伸出的手臂。

items.def_en: (+ sth) discard, throw, or push something away with a swift, forceful motion
