items.ex_en: He stepped inside the warm cabin and hurriedly began to fling off his wet coat.
items.ex_zh: 他踏进温暖的小木屋，匆匆一把甩掉身上湿漉漉的外套。

items.def_zh: 将（球）高高击出（或踢出、抛出）；把……储存于阁楼
items.def_en: 1. To hit, kick, or throw a ball high into the air. 2. To store something in an attic or loft.
items.ex_en: The batter managed to loft the ball easily beyond the outfield fence.
items.ex_zh: 击球手设法将球高高击出，轻松越过了外野围栏。

items.def_zh: （用力或随意地）扔，掷；（随便地）搭，挂；用吊带吊运
items.def_en: 1. To throw something casually or with great force. 2. To hang or swing something loosely or carelessly. 3. To carry or hoist something with a sling or strap.
items.ex_en: He decided to sling his heavy leather backpack loosely over one shoulder.
items.ex_zh: 他随手将沉重的皮质双肩包搭在了一侧肩膀上。

items.def_en: to throw something heavy using sustained physical effort
items.ex_en: The dockworkers gathered their strength to heave the heavy wooden crate onto the ship.
items.ex_zh: 码头工人们使出浑身力气，把沉重的木箱吃力地抛抬到船上。

items.def_zh: （sling的过去式和过去分词）扔，掷；搭，挂
items.def_en: 1. Past tense and past participle of sling: to throw casually or with force, or hang loosely.
items.ex_en: She slung her jacket over the back of the chair and sat down.
items.ex_zh: 她把外套随手搭在椅背上，然后坐了下来。

items.def_en: (+ sth) throw something downwards violently and with great force
items.ex_en: The angry protester attempted to hurl down the metal barrier onto the street.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的抗议者试图将金属路障重重摔到街面上。

items.def_en: to throw something with tremendous force, violence, or rage
items.ex_en: In a fit of blind rage, he began to hurl stones at the window.
items.ex_zh: 盛怒之下，他抓起石头猛力砸向窗户。

items.def_en: 1. To throw or push someone or something suddenly and with great force. 2. To move somewhere quickly and violently or angrily.
items.ex_en: She opened the window and proceeded to fling the torn letter outside.
items.ex_zh: 她推开窗户，一把将撕碎的信件狠狠扔了出去。

items.def_zh: 用弹射器发射；（使）猛掷，（使）猛冲；使突然跃升（为明星等）
items.def_en: 1. To launch or propel someone or something forward suddenly with great speed. 2. To suddenly push or be pushed into a particular state or prominence.
items.ex_en: The massive explosion served to catapult debris hundreds of meters into the air.
items.ex_zh: 剧烈的爆炸将碎片猛烈地弹射到数百米的高空。

items.def_zh: 把（某人或某物）抛出窗外；罢免，把……革职
items.def_en: 1. (formal or humorous) To throw someone or something out of a window. 2. (informal) To remove or dismiss someone abruptly from a position of power.
items.ex_en: He jokingly threatened to defenestrate the malfunctioning printer out of sheer frustration.
items.ex_zh: 出于极度沮丧，他开玩笑威胁说要把这台出故障的打印机从窗户扔出去。

groups.summary_en: An agent propels an object or entity forcefully through the air, distinguished by the bodily dynamic, mechanical mechanism (e.g. catapulting, lofting in a high arc), or specific physical trajectories.
groups.summary_zh: 施力将物体掷向空中，按力道轨迹、身体动作或发射机制细分。
groups.desc_en: Projects a heavy or distant object through the air with significant velocity or high trajectory, differing from gentle tossing.
groups.desc_zh: 以极大速度、力量或高弧线轨迹将物体射向远方，区别于轻缓的掷落。
groups.nuance_en: hurl: violently projecting an object with maximum muscular force (rock / javelin / abuse) · fling: launching abruptly or recklessly with dynamic swing (doors / coat / insult) · sling: catapulting or swinging an item from a strap or pivot (bag / stone / hammock) · lob: arcing an object high and softly over an obstacle (grenade / ball / shot) · heave: exerting massive bodily effort to lift and cast something unwieldy (anchor / pack / sigh)
groups.nuance_zh: hurl: 倾注全身肌肉力量的猛烈投掷 (rock / javelin / abuse) · fling: 突然而粗暴地大幅度甩掷 (doors / coat / insult) · sling: 吊挂或利用摆动惯性掷出 (bag / stone / hammock) · lob: 呈高抛弧线越过障碍物抛出 (grenade / ball / shot) · heave: 极力搬起并沉重抛投沉重笨拙之物 (anchor / pack / sigh)

groups.name: Wage War & Clash · 交战与厮杀 (Fight, Battle, Combat)
groups.tip: 交锋肉搏与武装战斗

items.def_en: to fight a war or be engaged in conflict or struggle against someone.
items.ex_en: Rival kingdoms continued to war against each other for control of the valley.
items.ex_zh: 各敌对王国为了争夺山谷的控制权而持续相互征战。

items.def_zh: 搏斗，打架；交战，打仗；抗争，努力争取
items.def_en: 1. to take part in a violent physical struggle or battle against someone. 2. to struggle to overcome something or achieve a goal.
items.ex_en: The brave soldiers had to fight courageously against an overwhelming enemy force.
items.ex_zh: 英勇的士兵们不得不勇敢地同压倒性的敌军殊死搏斗。

items.def_en: to fight or struggle hard against someone or something, especially in a battle or competition.
items.ex_en: Firefighters continue to battle through the night against the raging forest fires.
items.ex_zh: 消防队员们彻夜奋战，与肆虐的森林大火展开搏斗。

items.def_en: [I/T] to enter into military combat against an enemy force
items.ex_en: The naval fleet prepared to engage the approaching enemy vessels at dawn.
items.ex_zh: 海军舰队做好准备，在黎明时分与逼近的敌舰交战。

items.def_zh: 与……战斗，同……搏斗；设法消除，制止（不良事物）
items.def_en: 1. to fight or struggle against someone or something in battle. 2. to take action to reduce, defeat, or stop something bad.
items.ex_en: Special forces were urgently deployed to combat the insurgent group in the mountains.
items.ex_zh: 特种部队被紧急调派，去山区同叛乱武装进行战斗。

items.def_zh: 搏斗，战斗；抗争（fight 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: past tense and past participle of fight: to take part in a violent struggle or battle.
items.ex_en: The allied troops fought fiercely to defend the bridge from being captured.
items.ex_zh: 联军部队激烈搏斗，全力保卫大桥不被敌军夺取。

items.def_zh: 发动（战争），开展，进行（斗争等）
items.def_en: to begin and continue a war, battle, or campaign.
items.ex_en: The government resolved to wage a relentless campaign against organized international crime.
items.ex_zh: 政府下定决心，对有组织跨国犯罪开展一场毫不留情的打击战役。

items.def_en: (+ against sb/sth) defend oneself against an opponent or attack by fighting
items.ex_en: The beleaguered defending garrison gathered their remaining strength to fight back bravely.
items.ex_zh: 陷入重围的守军集结剩余力量，英勇地进行反击。

items.def_en: (+ sb) engage in direct armed combat or hostile physical engagement against someone
items.ex_en: Rebel forces were reported to clash with government troops near the northern border.
items.ex_zh: 据报道，叛乱分子在北部边境附近与政府军爆发了武装冲突。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) fight continuously or fiercely against an enemy or adversary
items.ex_en: The exhausted infantry had to battle against cold weather and advancing enemy troops.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的步兵既要抗击严寒天气，又要同步步逼近的敌军搏斗。

items.def_en: to come into sharp, violent military or physical confrontation with an opponent
items.ex_en: Riot police and masked demonstrators were seen to clash outside the parliament building.
items.ex_zh: 有人看到防暴警察与蒙面示威者在议会大厦外发生激烈冲突。

items.def_en: to take part in a short, unplanned fight between small groups
items.ex_en: Scouts from both opposing armies began to skirmish along the rugged mountain ridge.
items.ex_zh: 两军的侦察兵在崎岖的山脊线上展开了小规模交火。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express armed or direct physical engagement against an adversary, varying from single close-quarters combat to organized national warfare.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖从短兵相接的个体搏斗到国家间组织化宣战与阵地交锋。
groups.desc_en: Engages in armed, organized, or sustained physical/strategic struggle against an enemy, contrasting with minor disputes.
groups.desc_zh: 与敌对势力进行武装化、有组织或持久的肉体与战略交锋，区别于日常争吵斗嘴。
groups.nuance_en: wage: pursuing and sustaining an extended campaign or hostility (war / battle / campaign) · battle: clashing in a protracted, grueling struggle against adversity (elements / disease / rivals) · combat: taking active military or strategic measures to fight a hazard (inflation / terrorism / fire) · engage: making direct offensive tactical contact with an enemy (troops / enemy / target) · fight back: mounting an active defensive retaliation against assault (tears / attackers / regime)
groups.nuance_zh: wage: 发动并持续进行大规模战役或对抗 (war / battle / campaign) · battle: 陷入持久、艰苦卓绝的恶战抗争 (elements / disease / rivals) · combat: 采取直接军事行动或战略阻击有害物 (inflation / terrorism / fire) · engage: 与敌军在战术上正式交火接触 (troops / enemy / target) · fight back: 遭受攻击时进行防御性自卫反击 (tears / attackers / regime)

groups.name: Wear & Attire · 穿戴与着装 (Wear, Dress, Clothe)
groups.tip: 衣物鞋帽的穿戴状态

items.def_zh: 穿，戴，佩戴；蓄，留（发、须）；磨损，耗损
items.def_en: 1. To have clothing, shoes, glasses, or jewelry on your body. 2. To become damaged or thinner through continuous use, or cause something to do so.
items.ex_en: All factory workers must wear protective safety goggles inside the manufacturing area.
items.ex_zh: 所有工厂员工在生产区域内都必须佩戴防护护目镜。
items.ex2_en: These heavy leather boots wear well even during the harshest winter weather conditions.
items.ex2_zh: 即使在最恶劣的冬季天气条件下，这些厚皮靴也非常耐磨。

items.def_en: to wear or display a garment, accessory, or feature with prominence or pride
items.ex_en: The athlete stepped on stage proudly to sport his newly won gold medal.
items.ex_zh: 运动员骄傲地走上领奖台，耀眼地佩戴着他刚赢得的金牌。

items.def_zh: 穿衣服；给……穿衣；穿着，着装
items.def_en: To put clothes on yourself or someone else; to wear clothes of a particular style or type.
items.ex_en: Guests are expected to dress in formal black-tie attire for the annual gala.
items.ex_zh: 宾客们需身着正装出席这场年度晚宴。

items.def_zh: 给……穿衣；为……提供衣服；覆盖，遮盖
items.def_en: 1. To dress someone or provide them with clothes. 2. (literary) To cover or envelop something.
items.ex_en: Thick white morning mist seemed to clothe the silent pine forest completely.
items.ex_zh: 清晨浓密的白雾仿佛将静谧的松林全然笼罩。

items.def_en: (formal/literary) to clothe or furnish someone with fine garments
items.ex_en: Attendants hurried forward to apparel the newly crowned monarch in velvet robes.
items.ex_zh: 侍从们匆忙上前，为新加冕的君主穿上华丽的天鹅绒礼袍。

items.def_en: to place a garment, piece of jewellery, or accessory onto one's body
items.ex_en: Make sure you put on a warm coat before going out into the snow.
items.ex_zh: 出门走进雪地之前，一定要穿上一件暖和的外套。

items.def_en: to put on formal, elaborate, or fancy clothes, or dress someone in special attire
items.ex_en: You don't need to dress up; casual clothes are fine for the party.
items.ex_zh: 你不需要盛装打扮，去参加聚会穿便装就行。
items.ex2_en: She decided to dress up the plain dining table with colorful flowers.
items.ex2_zh: 她决定用色彩斑斓的鲜花将朴素的餐桌装饰一番。

items.def_zh: 穿得暖和；裹得严严实实
items.def_en: to dress warmly in many layers of clothing, or wrap someone warmly
items.ex_en: It is freezing outside, so please bundle up before you head out.
items.ex_zh: 外面冷极了，出门前请务必裹得严严实实的。
items.ex2_en: The caring parents bundled up their small children before sending them out to play.
items.ex2_zh: 细心的父母在送小孩出去玩耍之前，先把他们裹得严严实实的。

items.def_en: to put on a piece of clothing easily, quickly, or smoothly
items.ex_en: She decided to slip on a light sweater before running to the grocery store.
items.ex_zh: 跑去杂货店之前，她决定随手套上一件薄毛衣。

items.def_zh: 给……穿上长袍（或礼袍、罩衣）
items.def_en: (often passive) To dress someone or oneself in a gown, such as an academic robe or a surgical gown.
items.ex_en: Graduating seniors gathered in the hall to be formally gowned for the ceremony.
items.ex_zh: 应届毕业生齐聚大厅，依礼穿戴上学位袍准备参加典礼。

items.def_en: (formal) to dress someone in particular, typically formal or elaborate, clothing
items.ex_en: The young princess was richly attired in a hand-embroidered silk gown.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的公主身着一袭手工刺绣的丝绸长裙，盛装华丽。

items.def_zh: 穿得过于讲究（或隆重、暖和）；使穿得过分华丽
items.def_en: To dress in clothes that are too formal, fancy, or warm for an occasion.
items.ex_en: Wearing a tuxedo to a casual backyard barbecue made him feel painfully overdressed.
items.ex_zh: 穿着无尾礼服参加随意的后院烧烤，让他觉得自己穿得过分隆重了。

groups.summary_en: An agent has garments, ornaments, or coverings on the body as a state, or puts them on someone or oneself in varying degrees of formality. Verbs contrast in habitual wearing versus ceremonial, elaborately formal attiring.
groups.summary_zh: 指身体穿着衣物或进行特定规格着装的常规及礼仪场景。
groups.desc_en: Covers the human frame with textiles or accessories for protection, decorum, or vanity, surpassing simple utility.
groups.desc_zh: 用织物或配饰覆盖身体以提供防护、维系体统或展现仪容，超越单纯的覆盖功能。
groups.nuance_en: wear: standard enduring state of having apparel on one's body (suit / watch / glasses) · sport: proudly or conspicuously displaying an item or style (mustache / tie / brand) · don: literarily or ceremoniously stepping into or putting on clothing (coat / mask / gloves) · bundle up: wrapping someone thoroughly in heavy garments against cold (child / warm / scarf) · dress up: adorning oneself in formal or flamboyant costume (party / evening / dinner)
groups.nuance_zh: wear: 身体穿戴衣饰的常态性延续状态 (suit / watch / glasses) · sport: 自信、高调地炫示某种穿搭或体貌特征 (mustache / tie / brand) · don: 文雅或庄重地披挂穿戴 (coat / mask / gloves) · bundle up: 为防寒而将全身严实裹紧厚重衣物 (child / warm / scarf) · dress up: 盛装打扮或换上特定盛装正装 (party / evening / dinner)

groups.name: Whack & Strike Heavily · 猛击与重击 (Whack, Slug, Clobber)
groups.tip: 沉重物体击中发出响亮闷响

items.def_en: To strike someone (especially a child) repeatedly on the buttocks with an open hand or flat object as punishment.
items.ex_en: Modern pediatricians strongly advise parents never to spank their misbehaving children.
items.ex_zh: 现代儿科医生强烈建议父母绝不要打淘气孩子的屁股。

items.def_en: to strike someone or something vigorously with a flat object, making a sharp resonant sound
items.ex_en: He used a rolled-up newspaper to thwack the large fly on the table.
items.ex_zh: 他用卷起的报纸啪地一声重重拍打桌上的大苍蝇。

items.def_en: (informal) To hit or strike something hard with a quick, heavy blow.
items.ex_en: She swung the pillow and managed to whap her brother across the shoulder.
items.ex_zh: 她抡起枕头，猛地一下狠狠砸在了她弟弟的肩膀上。

items.def_en: (+ sb) hit or kick someone violently and repeatedly, causing injury
items.ex_en: Don't beat yourself up over an honest mistake.
items.ex_zh: 不要因为一次无心之失而过度自责。

items.def_en: (+ sb) render an opponent unconscious or incapacitated with a heavy strike
items.ex_en: Our team was knocked out of the tournament in the quarter-finals.
items.ex_zh: 我们队在四分之一决赛中被淘汰出局。

items.def_en: (+ sb) attack someone forcefully with severe physical blows
items.ex_en: The angry bouncer suddenly began to lay into the disorderly patron with heavy punches.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的保镖突然挥起重拳，开始痛揍那位滋事的顾客。

items.def_en: to strike someone hard with a fist or solid blow, especially unexpectedly
items.ex_en: The boxer managed to sock his opponent directly in the jaw with a hook.
items.ex_zh: 拳击手一记勾拳，狠狠揍在了对手的下巴上。

items.def_en: 1. (informal) To hit someone or something very hard, especially with a fist or bat. 2. (informal) To drink a large mouthful of liquor quickly.
items.ex_en: The villain swung his fist violently to slug the detective across the mouth.
items.ex_zh: 恶棍猛地挥动拳头，重重击中了侦探的嘴角。

items.def_en: 1. (informal) To hit someone or something forcefully with a sharp, noisy blow. 2. (informal) To reduce something by a large amount.
items.ex_en: He picked up a sturdy wooden stick to whack the stubborn tennis ball away.
items.ex_zh: 他捡起一根结实的木棍，砰的一声猛力将网球击飞。

items.def_en: to hit someone or something extremely hard with a heavy, swinging force
items.ex_en: The heavyweight champion managed to wallop his challenger with a devastating right punch.
items.ex_zh: 重量级拳王挥出毁灭性的右手重拳，狠狠痛击了挑战者。

items.def_zh: 痛打，猛击；彻底击败；重创
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To hit someone or something very hard. 2. (informal) To defeat someone thoroughly or cause severe damage to them.
items.ex_en: The angry giant raised his heavy iron club, threatening to clobber any intruder.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的巨人举起沉重的铁棒，威胁要痛击任何闯入者。

items.def_en: (informal) To strike heavily and noisily, producing a loud resonant or slapping sound.
items.ex_en: He swung the wooden mallet to whang the metal gong with great force.
items.ex_zh: 他挥起木槌，砰的一声重重敲响了金属大锣。

groups.summary_en: An agent strikes a person or object with forceful, blunt, and often resounding impact, frequently using a fist, heavy implement, or swinging motion. Verbs differ in informal flavor, acoustic quality, and degree of punishing violence.
groups.summary_zh: 描述以拳头或钝器进行有力、发出声响的猛烈击打。
groups.desc_en: Denotes delivering blunt, forceful physical impacts characterized by distinctive kinetic manner, audible resonance, or debilitating violence, contrasting with generic contact verbs like 'hit' through emphasis on sheer force, sound, or incapacitation.
groups.desc_zh: 指带有鲜明力道、声响特征或致伤/致晕后果的沉重钝性打击，与中性动词 hit 相比，更强调击打的沉重度、发出的声效或压倒性暴力。
groups.nuance_en: thwack: sharp resonant blow with a flat object (stick / ruler / ball) · slug: heavy, deliberate punch with a fist (opponent / jaw / face) · sock: sudden, forceful direct punch (jaw / eye / nose) · beat up: prolonged, severe physical assault (victim / rival) · knock out: concussive blow inducing unconsciousness (boxer / rival)
groups.nuance_zh: thwack: 扁平物体的脆响抽打 (stick / ruler / ball) · slug: 挥拳重击、痛击 (opponent / jaw / face) · sock: 猛烈直拳重揍 (jaw / eye / nose) · beat up: 持续暴力痛殴 (victim / rival) · knock out: 击昏、打倒使其丧失意识 (boxer / rival)

groups.name: Wipe & Cleanse · 擦拂与揩抹清洁 (Manner and Instrument of Cleaning)
groups.tip: 用海绵、抹布擦掉尘垢

items.def_en: to clean or wash something or someone using a wet sponge
items.ex_en: The exhausted athlete took a moment to sponge down his dusty neck and arms.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的运动员抽空用海绵擦洗了沾满灰尘的脖颈和手臂。

items.def_en: to clean the entire surface of an object by rubbing it with a damp or soapy cloth
items.ex_en: The waiter used an antibacterial spray to wipe down the dining tables thoroughly.
items.ex_zh: 服务员用抗菌喷雾彻底擦净了餐桌表面。

items.def_zh: 掸去……的灰尘，擦拭；撒粉（于）
items.def_en: 1. To wipe or clear dust from the surface of something. 2. To sprinkle something lightly with a fine powder or dust.
items.ex_en: She spent the morning helping her mother dust the antique wooden bookshelves.
items.ex_zh: 她花了一整个上午帮母亲掸去古董木质书架上的灰尘。

items.def_en: 1. To clean, smooth, or apply something with a brush. 2. To touch or graze something lightly in passing.
items.ex_en: He paused in front of the mirror to brush the crumbs off his lapel.
items.ex_zh: 他在镜子前停下脚步，刷掉了翻领上的碎屑。

items.def_en: to polish a surface smooth and shiny using a soft dry cloth
items.ex_en: He took a soft flannel cloth to buff the silver teapot until it shone.
items.ex_zh: 他拿出一块柔软的法兰绒布，将银质茶壶擦得锃亮。

items.def_zh: 用海绵（或湿布）擦拭；揩油，蹭钱蹭吃
items.def_en: 1. To wash, clean, or wipe something using a damp sponge or cloth. 2. (disapproving) To obtain money, food, or shelter from others without paying.
items.ex_en: The veterinarian used warm water to gently sponge the injured dog's dirty coat.
items.ex_zh: 兽医用温水轻柔地用海绵擦拭受伤小狗弄脏的皮毛。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ up) to clean or wipe a floor or liquid with a wet mop or cloth
items.ex_en: The janitor quickly grabbed a bucket to mop up the spilled juice in aisle three.
items.ex_zh: 保洁员迅速拿来水桶，去拖干净三号走道洒出的果汁。

items.def_zh: 用拖把（或棉签）擦洗，擦拭
items.def_en: To clean, wash, or treat a surface or wound with a mop, sponge, or swab.
items.ex_en: The nurse gently swabbed the open wound with antiseptic before applying the clean bandage.
items.ex_zh: 护士在敷上干净绷带前，用消毒液轻轻擦拭了敞开的伤口。

items.def_en: to remove liquid from a surface using a mop, sponge, or absorbent cloth
items.ex_en: He quickly grabbed a towel to mop up the milk spilled across the kitchen floor.
items.ex_zh: 他迅速抓起一条毛巾，擦掉洒在厨房地板上的牛奶。

items.def_zh: 打扫，清扫；席卷，掠过（sweep的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of sweep: to clean or clear with a broom; to move swiftly across an area.
items.ex_en: She swept the fallen autumn leaves from the stone steps before the guests arrived.
items.ex_zh: 在客人到来之前，她清扫了石阶上的秋季落叶。

items.def_en: to clean something thoroughly by rubbing hard with a stiff brush and water
items.ex_en: The sailors had to scrub down the wooden deck with stiff brushes every morning.
items.ex_zh: 水手们每天早晨都必须用硬毛刷把木质甲板彻底刷洗干净。

items.def_en: to clean thoroughly by hard rubbing with an abrasive material
items.ex_en: She used steel wool to scour the stubborn burnt grease from the iron skillet.
items.ex_zh: 她用钢丝球用力刷除了铁锅上顽固的焦黑油垢。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures physical actions of clearing dirt, dust, or moisture using specific instruments (sponges, brushes, swabs) or mechanical motions across surfaces.
groups.summary_zh: 运用特定工具（如刷子、海绵、医用棉签、掸子）对表面进行扫拂擦抹清理。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on surface cleansing accomplished through repeated friction, absorbent wiping, or specialized manual sweeping tools, moving beyond generic 'clean' to foreground physical contact gestures and implements.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过重复摩擦、吸水抹布或专用工具拂拭以清除污垢的表面清洁动作，区别于一般的 clean，聚焦于具体的触抹动作与擦拭工具。
groups.nuance_en: wipe down: thorough cleaning of large flat planes (counter / table / surface) · mop: liquid absorbent cleaning of floors (floor / spill / deck) · dust: light sweeping away of loose dry particles (furniture / shelf / blinds) · buff: vigorous polishing to create shine (shoes / car / leather) · swab: absorbent cleansing of wounds or tight decks (wound / deck / throat)
groups.nuance_zh: wipe down: 彻底擦拭平坦表面 (counter / table / surface) · mop: 用拖把拖洗液体污渍 (floor / spill / deck) · dust: 拂去轻微干燥积灰 (furniture / shelf / blinds) · buff: 摩擦抛光起亮 (shoes / car / leather) · swab: 医用或甲板吸水涂擦 (wound / deck / throat)

groups.name: Wrinkle & Crease · 起皱与弄皱 (Wrinkle, Crease, Rumple)
groups.tip: 平整表面收缩起褶皱

items.def_en: to make or develop a sharp, distinct fold or line in paper, cloth, or skin
items.ex_en: Be careful when folding the linen trousers so you do not crease the fabric unnecessarily.
items.ex_zh: 折叠亚麻裤时要小心，以免在织物上压出不必要的折痕。
items.ex2_en: This smooth silk fabric will crease readily if packed tightly inside a suitcase.
items.ex2_zh: 这种光滑的丝绸面料如果紧紧塞在行李箱里很容易起皱。

items.def_en: (+ up) To gather skin, lips, or fabric into small tight folds or wrinkles.
items.ex_en: The sour lemon caused the little girl to pucker her lips in obvious distaste.
items.ex_zh: 酸柠檬让小女孩嫌弃地噘起了嘴唇。
items.ex2_en: The lightweight cotton fabric puckered along the seam after being washed in hot water.
items.ex2_zh: 这种轻薄的棉织物在用热水清洗后，接缝处起了皱缩。

items.def_en: (+ up) To form many small, fine wrinkles or folds in paper, fabric, or skin.
items.ex_en: Small laugh lines began to crinkle around his eyes as he shared the amusing story.
items.ex_zh: 当他分享那个有趣的故事时，眼角泛起了细小的笑纹。
items.ex2_en: The curious child crinkled the crisp cellophane paper to hear the crunchy sound.
items.ex2_zh: 好奇的孩子揉搓着清脆的玻璃纸，想听那沙沙的声音。

items.def_zh: 使起皱褶；变得满是褶皱
items.def_en: to develop or cause to develop unintended lines, folds, or wrinkles
items.ex_en: If you pack your cotton shirts too tightly, they will quickly crease up in transit.
items.ex_zh: 如果你把棉衬衫塞得太紧，它们在运输途中很快就会变得满是褶皱。
items.ex2_en: Rough handling will crease up the delicate blueprints during transportation to the site.
items.ex2_zh: 粗暴的搬运会在将脆弱的蓝图运往工地的途中将其弄皱。

items.def_en: to crush or press paper or fabric into a compact, wrinkled mass, or to become crushed in this way
items.ex_en: Frustrated by the poor draft, he decided to crumple up the paper and start over.
items.ex_zh: 因草稿写得不顺而感到沮丧，他决定把纸揉成一团重新开始。
items.ex2_en: The thin paper crumpled up easily under the crushing weight of the textbooks.
items.ex2_zh: 薄纸在厚重教科书的压迫下很容易揉皱成一团。

items.def_en: to tightly contract lips or fabric into small tight folds or wrinkles
items.ex_en: She told her toddler to pucker up so she could wipe the sticky jam off.
items.ex_zh: 她叫小宝宝缩拢嘴唇，好把上面黏糊糊的果酱擦掉。
items.ex2_en: The child puckered up her lips playfully before giving her grandmother a kiss.
items.ex2_zh: 小女孩调皮地噘起嘴唇，然后给了奶奶一个吻。

items.def_zh: 捏皱，拧成一团；皱起（脸等）
items.def_en: to crush or squeeze something tightly into a ball or wrinkled shape, or contract one's facial features
items.ex_en: The frightened boy began to scrunch up his face as the doctor prepared the injection.
items.ex_zh: 医生准备注射时，受惊的小男孩紧紧皱起了脸。
items.ex2_en: The dried autumn leaves scrunched up noisily under the hiker's heavy hiking boots.
items.ex2_zh: 干枯的秋叶在徒步旅行者沉重的登山靴下发出沙沙的声响揉碎了。

items.def_en: to crush or press fabric or paper into uneven, messy folds or a compact ball
items.ex_en: She shoved the receipt into her pocket, watching it crumple into an unsightly mess.
items.ex_zh: 她把收据塞进口袋，看着它被压成皱巴巴的一团。
items.ex2_en: Anger caused him to crumple the rejection letter into a tight ball.
items.ex2_zh: 愤怒使他将那封拒绝信揉成了一个紧实的纸团。

items.def_zh: 使（眉头等）起皱；在……上耕出沟畦
items.def_en: 1. To form narrow folds or wrinkles in the brow or forehead. 2. To plow or make long narrow grooves or trenches in the ground.
items.ex_en: A deep shadow of anxiety seemed to furrow his pale brow as the bad news arrived.
items.ex_zh: 噩耗传来，一阵深深的焦虑阴影仿佛使他苍白的眉头紧蹙。
items.ex2_en: His thick eyebrows furrowed in deep concentration as he examined the intricate blueprint.
items.ex2_zh: 当他仔细查看复杂的图纸时，浓密的眉毛因高度集中而皱起。

items.def_en: to crush, squeeze, or wrinkle something tightly into a compact mass
items.ex_en: He loved to scrunch the wrapping paper noisily before tossing it into the recycling bin.
items.ex_zh: 他喜欢在把包装纸扔进回收箱之前，将其哗啦哗啦地揉成一团。
items.ex2_en: The thin plastic foil scrunched easily between the playful toddler's energetic little hands.
items.ex2_zh: 薄薄的塑料箔在顽皮幼儿充满活力的小手里轻易地揉成了一团。

items.def_en: (+ up) To make clothes, hair, or sheets untidy and wrinkled.
items.ex_en: A sudden gust of wind managed to rumple his neatly combed hair during the stroll.
items.ex_zh: 散步时，一阵突如其来的大风把他梳理整齐的头发吹得凌乱不堪。
items.ex2_en: Smooth bedsheets rumple easily whenever restless sleepers move around throughout the long night.
items.ex2_zh: 每当焦躁不安的入睡者在漫漫长夜中翻来覆去，光滑的床单就很容易变皱。

items.def_zh: 起波状褶皱；起瓦楞形皱纹
items.def_en: to contract or shape into parallel ridges and grooves (of brows, metal, or surfaces)
items.ex_en: Intense concentration caused deep lines to corrugate the elderly scholar's high, thoughtful brow.
items.ex_zh: 高度的专注使那位老学者高耸深沉的额头上泛起道道平行的深褶。
items.ex2_en: The smooth metal sheets corrugate evenly under the immense pressure of industrial rollers.
items.ex2_zh: 在工业滚筒的巨大压力下，光滑的金属板被均匀地压出波纹。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe causing smooth surfaces (such as skin, fabric, or paper) to contract into irregular ridges, folds, or furrows, or becoming so marked. They differ in manner: tight pursing, fine crinkling, deep linear furrowing, or disheveled crumpling.
groups.summary_zh: 平整表面（皮肤、织物、纸张等）因挤压或收缩形成褶皱或皱纹。
groups.desc_en: Depicts the distortion of smooth, pliable surfaces into lines, ridges, or chaotic compressed folds, differing from structural 'bend' or 'break' by preserving material continuity while disrupting plane integrity.
groups.desc_zh: 指柔韧平整物体的表面受外力挤压产生褶皱、折痕或紊乱凹凸，区别于 bend 或 break，保持材料连续性但破坏了表面的平滑状态。
groups.nuance_en: crease: forming a sharp, distinct fold line (trousers / paper / forehead) · crumple: compressive crushing into a chaotic wad (paper / receipt / sheet) · pucker: contracting into small gathered folds (lips / skin / fabric) · crinkle: forming a network of fine superficial wrinkles (foil / eyes / paper) · scrunch up: tight, forceful facial or manual wrinkling (face / paper / napkin)
groups.nuance_zh: crease: 压出鲜明锐利的折痕 (trousers / paper / forehead) · crumple: 揉搓揉瘪成团 (paper / receipt / sheet) · pucker: 撅起、缩拢收聚成褶 (lips / skin / fabric) · crinkle: 形成微细密集的细纹 (foil / eyes / paper) · scrunch up: 紧紧揉成一团或皱起 (face / paper / napkin)

groups.name: Write & Compose · 书写与创作 (Drafting & Text Production)
groups.tip: 落笔成文，记录谱写篇章

items.def_en: to originate and write a published book, report, or substantive paper
items.ex_en: The distinguished professor was commissioned to author a definitive report on regional economic policy.
items.ex_zh: 这位著名教授受命就区域经济政策撰写一份权威报告。

items.def_en: to write the preliminary version of a speech, essay, contract, or law
items.ex_en: The legal team worked late into the night to draft the new employment contract.
items.ex_zh: 法务团队工作到深夜，以起草新的雇佣合同。

items.def_en: to write or compose a letter, poem, or article by hand or authorship
items.ex_en: The lonely poet retired to his chamber to pen an elegy for departed friends.
items.ex_zh: 孤独的诗人退回房间，执笔为逝去的朋友撰写挽歌。

items.def_zh: 写成完整的文章或报告；详述
items.def_en: to prepare a full, structured, or official piece of writing based on preliminary notes
items.ex_en: The field researcher needs to write up her laboratory findings before the funding deadline.
items.ex_zh: 实地研究员需要在资助截止日期前将她的实验室发现写成完整报告。

items.def_en: to write, compose, or draw something very quickly and with little effort
items.ex_en: I need to dash off a quick thank-you note before heading out the door.
items.ex_zh: 出门前我得飞快写出一封简短的感谢便条。

items.def_en: to set down words, thoughts, or compositions on paper using a pen
items.ex_en: The retiring diplomat sat in his quiet study to pen down his final memoirs.
items.ex_zh: 即将退休的外交官坐在安静的书房里，落笔写下他最后的回忆录。

items.def_zh: 匆匆记下，随手潦草写下
items.def_en: to write something down quickly and untidily
items.ex_en: Please scribble down the gate access code so we do not forget it tonight.
items.ex_zh: 请随手记下大门的门禁密码，免得我们今晚忘了。

items.def_en: to compose verses that use words with matching terminal sounds
items.ex_en: The children giggled as they tried to rhyme simple words during their English lesson.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们在英语课上尝试为简单的单词作押韵诗时咯咯笑了起来。
items.ex2_en: The clever poet managed to rhyme traditional verses with contemporary urban slang seamlessly.
items.ex2_zh: 这位聪明的诗人成功地将传统诗句与现代都市俚语无缝押韵。

items.def_zh: 仓促写下，潦草地书写；乱写，涂画
items.def_en: To write or draw something quickly, carelessly, or untidily.
items.ex_en: He had to scribble the directions hastily on a scrap piece of cardboard paper.
items.ex_zh: 他只得匆忙在废弃的硬纸板上潦草地写下行车路线。

items.def_zh: 作十四行诗歌颂，用十四行诗写
items.def_en: (literary) To compose sonnets; to celebrate or address someone in a sonnet.
items.ex_en: Courtly bards would sonnet their beloved patrons during extravagant Renaissance court festivals.
items.ex_zh: 宫廷吟游诗人会在奢华的文艺复兴节日里作十四行诗歌颂心仪的恩主。

items.def_zh: 用红字书写（或印刷）；在（文稿等）上加红字标题或提示
items.def_en: (specialist or archaic) To write, print, or mark headings, instructions, or liturgical rules in red ink.
items.ex_en: The medieval monk spent tedious hours to rubric the sacred passages with scarlet vermilion ink.
items.ex_zh: 中世纪僧侣花费数小时的枯燥工夫，用猩红朱砂墨水为圣训书写红字标题。

items.def_zh: 写作，创作，撰写（诗文、信件等）
items.def_en: (archaic or literary) To write or compose a poem, speech, or formal letter.
items.ex_en: The exiled courtier resolved to indite a humble petition to his sovereign monarch.
items.ex_zh: 被流放的侍臣决意向他的君王草拟一份谦卑的请愿陈情文。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scenario depict the deliberate act of composing, penning, and producing written literary or textual works, ranging from hasty scribbling to formal verse composition.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖动笔书写、文学创作、起草文本及撰写诗文的具体场景行为。
groups.desc_en: Encompasses the intellectual framing, physical inscription, and stylized drafting of text, distinguishing itself from raw mechanical transcription by emphasizing literary composition, formulation speed, or official authorship.
groups.desc_zh: 涵盖文本的构思、物理书写与文风起草全过程，区别于单纯机械的记录或打印，突显构思创作、撰写速度或署名权。
groups.nuance_en: author: take formal intellectual responsibility for a work (book / report / legislation) · draft: formulate a provisional initial version (contract / speech / bill) · pen: compose with literary flair or personal hand (letter / column / memoir) · dash off: write rapidly with casual ease (note / reply / poem) · write up: prepare a finalized structured account (report / findings / notes)
groups.nuance_zh: author: 创作并享有署名权 (book / report / legislation) · draft: 起草初步草案 (contract / speech / bill) · pen: 执笔拟就、撰写 (letter / column / memoir) · dash off: 挥就、随手匆匆写就 (note / reply / poem) · write up: 整理撰写成完整报告 (report / findings / notes)

groups.name: Abate & Subside · 减弱、平息与消减 (Subside, Abate, Lessen)
groups.tip: 风暴、强度或痛感趋于平息减弱

items.def_en: to recede, dwindle, or gradually decline in force or quality
items.ex_en: As twilight gathered over the harbor, the crowd's frantic energy gradually ebbs away.
items.ex_zh: 随着暮色笼罩港口，人群狂热的活力逐渐消退殆尽。

items.def_en: to gradually become less strong, active, noisy, or violent until calm returns
items.ex_en: We waited for the storm to die down before resuming our journey.
items.ex_zh: 我们等暴风雨减弱后才继续赶路。

items.def_en: to gradually reduce in intensity, severity, pressure, or speed
items.ex_en: We should wait until the torrential rain begins to ease off before leaving home.
items.ex_zh: 我们应该等到倾盆大雨开始减弱后再出门。

items.def_en: to stop, pause, or diminish in intensity, especially of bad weather or harsh conditions
items.ex_en: The howling winter gale showed no signs that it would let up before morning.
items.ex_zh: 呼啸的冬日狂风毫无在天亮前停歇的迹象。

items.def_en: to gradually draw to a close or subside in excitement and activity
items.ex_en: The wild celebrations started to wind down as exhausted guests headed toward the exits.
items.ex_zh: 随着精疲力竭的客人们走向出口，狂欢庆祝活动逐渐平息下来。
items.ex2_en: The factory manager decided to wind down manufacturing operations ahead of the holidays.
items.ex2_zh: 工厂经理决定在假期前逐步缩减并停止生产作业。

items.def_zh: 缓解；减轻（严重性或痛苦）
items.def_en: to make something bad, painful, or severe less harsh or intense
items.ex_en: Emergency relief shipments were dispatched immediately to mitigate the severe suffering of the villagers.
items.ex_zh: 紧急救援物资已立即发出，以缓解村民们的极度痛苦。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make or become less in degree, intensity, or extent
items.ex_en: Taking prescribed painkillers should significantly lessen the discomfort following your wisdom tooth extraction.
items.ex_zh: 服用处方止痛药应能显著减轻拔除智齿后的不适感。
items.ex2_en: Traffic congestion will lessen noticeably once the new bypass road opens next month.
items.ex2_zh: 下个月新绕城公路开通后，交通拥堵将显著减轻。

items.def_zh: 平息，减退，消退；（水等）回落，退去；（地面、建筑物等）下陷，沉降
items.def_en: 1. (of pain, anger, storm, or noise) To become calmer, quieter, or less intense. 2. (of water) To sink to a lower or normal level. 3. (of ground or a building) To sink lower into the ground.
items.ex_en: The coastal floodwaters began to subside after the heavy storm moved inland yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 在强风暴昨日移向内陆后，沿海的洪水开始退去。

items.def_zh: （风暴、痛苦、激烈情绪等）减弱，减退，平息；减轻，削弱
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To become less strong, severe, or intense, or to make something less intense.
items.ex_en: The violent blizzard began to abate, allowing rescue teams to resume their search operation.
items.ex_zh: 猛烈的暴风雪开始减弱，使救援队得以恢复搜救行动。
items.ex2_en: City authorities implemented emergency measures to abate the rising industrial air pollution levels.
items.ex2_zh: 市政府采取了紧急措施，以减轻日益严重的工业空气污染水平。

items.def_en: to decrease in vigor, power, or extent over time
items.ex_en: His youthful arrogance began to wane as he encountered harsh realities in life.
items.ex_zh: 当他在生活中遭遇严酷的现实时，年少轻狂的傲气开始衰退。

items.def_en: 1. (formal) To make a crime, mistake, or bad behavior seem less serious and more forgivable by providing an excuse.
items.ex_en: Nothing you say now can extenuate your reckless negligence during the dangerous operation.
items.ex_zh: 你现在说什么也无法为你在这场危险作业中的鲁莽失职开脱。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate a reduction in the violence, intensity, severity, or perceived gravity of an adverse phenomenon, condition, or offense.
groups.summary_zh: 描述风暴、愤怒或剧痛等负面现象的强度自然减退、平息或严重性减轻。
groups.desc_en: Captures the organic, temporal weakening, slackening, or receding of natural forces, physical symptoms, or emotional turmoil, differing from active 'suppress' by occurring gradually and non-agentively.
groups.desc_zh: 指自然力、生理痛楚或紧张事态自身逐渐减弱、平息与消退的过程，区别于外力强行镇压 (suppress)，强调自然渐退与趋于平静。
groups.nuance_en: subside: sink back to a quiet or normal baseline (storm / swelling / floodwaters) · die down: gradual loss of noise, fury, or intensity (wind / excitement / controversy) · let up: pause or slacken in unrelenting severity (rain / snow / pressure) · ease off: relax in strictness, pain, or speed (pain / throttle / restrictions) · mitigate: formal external alleviation of severity (harm / impact / risks)
groups.nuance_zh: subside: 回落归于平息、消肿 (storm / swelling / floodwaters) · die down: 声势或狂热逐渐渐息 (wind / excitement / controversy) · let up: 严酷态势放缓、停歇 (rain / snow / pressure) · ease off: 痛感、管控或速度减退放慢 (pain / throttle / restrictions) · mitigate: 正式施策以缓和危害 (harm / impact / risks)

groups.name: Acquire & Purchase · 购买与采购 (Shop, Buy, Procure)
groups.tip: 从日常买到正式采购

items.def_en: (+ sth) buy or obtain something casually, conveniently, or cheaply
items.ex_en: Business usually picks up in the spring, and sales figures improve rapidly.
items.ex_zh: 生意通常在春季好转，销售额也会迅速回升。

items.def_en: to buy things in shops or online
items.ex_en: Consumers increasingly prefer to shop for domestic groceries using mobile delivery applications online.
items.ex_zh: 消费者越来越倾向于在手机外卖应用上选购日常生鲜杂货。

items.def_zh: 掏钱购买；不情愿地支付
items.def_en: (+ for/on sth) pay or spend money to purchase something, often reluctantly
items.ex_en: I really hated having to fork out fifty dollars for basic airport parking yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 我真讨厌昨天不得不为基本的机场停车费掏出五十美元。

items.def_en: to buy something quickly and eagerly as soon as it becomes available
items.ex_en: All front-row concert tickets were snapped up within seconds of going on sale.
items.ex_zh: 演唱会前排门票在开售几秒钟内便被一抢而空。

items.def_zh: 大肆挥霍采购；下本钱买
items.def_en: spend a substantial amount of money purchasing luxuries or special treats
items.ex_en: They decided to splash out on a luxury beachfront villa for their wedding anniversary.
items.ex_zh: 他们决定下本钱租下一栋豪华海滨别墅来度过结婚纪念日。

items.def_zh: 购买，买；收买，贿赂；相信，接受（非正式）
items.def_en: 1. to obtain something by paying money for it 2. (informal) to believe or accept something as true
items.ex_en: Nobody in the conference room seemed willing to buy his flimsy and unconvincing excuse.
items.ex_zh: 会议室里似乎没有人愿意相信他那站不住脚、毫无说服力的借口。

items.def_en: (formal) to buy something
items.ex_en: The municipal corporation announced official plans to purchase land for the new hospital complex.
items.ex_zh: 市政公司公布了为新医院大楼采购土地的官方计划。

items.def_zh: 买，购买（buy 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: past tense and past participle of buy; to have obtained something by paying money for it
items.ex_en: She bought fresh vegetables and warm bread from the local morning market yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 她昨天从当地早市购买了新鲜蔬菜和热面包。

items.def_en: to buy something again, especially something you previously owned or sold
items.ex_en: The board authorized a strategic move to repurchase five million outstanding company shares.
items.ex_zh: 董事会批准了一项战略举措，拟回购五百万股流通中的公司股份。

items.def_en: to obtain or buy equipment or supplies, especially for an organization or government through formal procedures
items.ex_en: The defense agency was established to procure high-technology surveillance equipment for border security.
items.ex_zh: 国防局的设立旨在为边境安全正式采购高科技监控设备。

items.def_en: to purchase all or large quantities of something to gain total control or exhaust supply
items.ex_en: A real estate developer is buying up all the farmland around the village.
items.ex_zh: 一家房地产开发商正在大肆收购村庄周边的所有农田。

groups.summary_en: An individual or organization exchanges money to acquire goods, services, or assets, progressing from casual consumer shopping to deliberate commercial purchase, structured procurement, and full market buyouts.
groups.summary_zh: 从日常浏览消费递增至正式采办与强力收购。
groups.desc_en: Profiles transactional acquisition along a continuum of expenditure willingness, urgency, and effort, contrasting with neutral 'get' by highlighting financial cost, opportunistic speed, or profligacy.
groups.desc_zh: 描摹基于金钱交易获得物品的场景，区别于单纯的获得 (get)，突出交易支出意愿、抢购速度、随手顺带买或挥霍程度。
groups.nuance_en: purchase: formal or institutional buying transaction (property / equipment / shares) · pick up: casually or opportunistically buy in passing (groceries / bargains / coffee) · snap up: eagerly buy immediately before stock vanishes (tickets / bargains / shares) · splash out: lavishly spend money on luxury (holiday / meal / car) · fork out: reluctantly pay significant amounts (fee / fine / cash)
groups.nuance_zh: purchase: 正式采购或大宗购置 (property / equipment / shares) · pick up: 顺带随手买下 (groceries / bargains / coffee) · snap up: 敏捷抢购抢注 (tickets / bargains / shares) · splash out: 豪掷重金挥霍购买 (holiday / meal / car) · fork out: 勉强掏腰包支付大笔钱 (fee / fine / cash)

groups.name: Active Participation & Engagement · 参与与互动 (Participate, Engage, Partake)
groups.tip: 投身事务并融入群体互动

items.def_en: (frequently passive or reflexive: be/get involved in) to cause someone to take part in an activity
items.ex_en: Parents are strongly encouraged to involve their young children in creative weekend household projects.
items.ex_zh: 强烈鼓励家长让年幼的孩子参与到周末富有创意的家庭项目中。

items.def_zh: 参与，从事；与……建立联系，进行互动；吸引（注意力）
items.def_en: 1. (+ in/with) To become involved in an activity; to interact or communicate with someone. 2. To attract and hold someone's interest or attention.
items.ex_en: Diplomats must engage directly with foreign counterparts to negotiate sustainable international peace treaties.
items.ex_zh: 外交官必须与外国同行进行直接互动，以协商可持续的国际和平条约。

items.def_en: (+ in) To take part in an activity or event.
items.ex_en: Over two hundred international delegates will participate in the annual medical research symposium.
items.ex_zh: 两百多位国际代表将参加这次年度医学研究研讨会。

items.def_zh: 交流，交往；相互作用，相互影响
items.def_en: (+ with) To communicate or react with someone; to have a mutual effect on each other.
items.ex_en: Kindergarten teachers design cooperative group games to help shy children interact with others.
items.ex_zh: 幼儿园老师设计合作团队游戏，以帮助害羞的孩子与他人交流互动。

items.def_en: to take part with others in an activity or discussion already underway
items.ex_en: Don't be shy; feel free to join in the discussion.
items.ex_zh: 别害羞，尽管参与到讨论中来。

items.def_en: to be actively involved in an event, activity, or social gathering
items.ex_en: Every enrolled student is expected to take part in the upcoming sports tournament.
items.ex_zh: 预计每位注册学生都将积极参与即将举行的体育锦标赛。

items.def_en: to join with others in contributing effort, work, or money to accomplish a task
items.ex_en: If we all pitch in, we can finish clearing the yard in an hour.
items.ex_zh: 如果我们大家齐心协力，一个小时就能把院子清理干净。

items.def_en: to secure a share or become actively involved in an activity, deal, or venture
items.ex_en: Eager venture capitalists tried hard to get in on the promising tech startup.
items.ex_zh: 热切的风投家们极力想介入这家前景广阔的科技初创企业。

items.def_en: to join into a conversation or debate by offering an opinion or comment
items.ex_en: She felt compelled to chime in when the discussion turned toward environmental preservation.
items.ex_zh: 当讨论转向环境保护议题时，她忍不住插话表达观点。

items.def_en: (+ with/on) to work jointly with others on an intellectual, artistic, or professional task
items.ex_en: Several prominent universities agreed to collaborate on an extensive renewable energy research initiative.
items.ex_zh: 几所知名大学同意在一项大型可再生能源研究计划上开展合作。

items.def_zh: 参与，参加；享用（食物或饮料）
items.def_en: 1. (+ in) (formal) To take part in an activity. 2. (+ of) (formal) To eat, drink, or share something.
items.ex_en: The guests were politely invited to partake in the lavish evening celebration feast.
items.ex_zh: 宾客们受到礼貌邀请，共同参与并享用丰盛的晚间庆祝宴席。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe an agent actively taking part in an activity, enterprise, or social discourse, either formally or socially.
groups.summary_zh: 主体积极介入、投身或分担某项集体活动与社会交往。
groups.desc_en: Depicts agents actively stepping into, investing effort, or dynamically cooperating within an ongoing activity, contrasting with passive 'attend' by requiring direct contribution or reciprocal interaction.
groups.desc_zh: 指主动介入、投入精力或在活动中形成双向协作，区别于被动出席 (attend)，强调实质性的参与、行动配合与协同贡献。
groups.nuance_en: participate: formally take an active role in structured events (discussion / survey / debate) · engage: enter into meaningful dialogue or immersive activity (audience / stakeholders / enemy) · pitch in: join collaboratively with manual labor or resources (chores / cleanup / funds) · join in: casually unite with an ongoing shared activity (game / applause / chorus) · interact: establish reciprocal communication or influence (users / colleagues / chemicals)
groups.nuance_zh: participate: 正式参与结构化活动 (discussion / survey / debate) · engage: 深入介入、与……互动 (audience / stakeholders / enemy) · pitch in: 众人协力搭手投入 (chores / cleanup / funds) · join in: 加入到已在进行的群体活动中 (game / applause / chorus) · interact: 相互交流、彼此互动 (users / colleagues / chemicals)

groups.name: Adjust & Coordinate · 调整与协调 (Tailor, Attune, Synchronize)
groups.tip: 量身定制以调整适应

items.def_en: (+ sth to sth) design, adjust, or adapt something so that it matches a specific need or purpose
items.ex_en: The training program was deliberately geared to the specific needs of novice programmers.
items.ex_zh: 该培训项目经过精心设计，专门适合初级程序员的特定需求。

items.def_en: (+ to sth) adjust or attune something so it aligns or operates in harmony with something else
items.ex_en: Modern managers need to tune in to the emotional wellness of their remote employees.
items.ex_zh: 现代管理者需要调整自身，以便与远程员工的情感健康状况保持谐调。

items.def_en: to organize or integrate different elements or groups to work together efficiently
items.ex_en: The relief agency must coordinate logistical efforts across several remote disaster-stricken mountain regions.
items.ex_zh: 救灾机构必须协调多个偏远受灾山区的后勤保障工作。
items.ex2_en: The dancers' precise movements coordinate perfectly with the dramatic rhythm of the orchestra.
items.ex2_zh: 舞者精确的动作与管弦乐队充满戏剧性的节奏配合得天衣无缝。

items.def_en: to adjust components or positions so they line up or correspond with an external benchmark
items.ex_en: Engineers worked diligently to align the heavy steel tracks with the foundation markers.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们认真工作，将重型钢轨与地基标记校准对齐。
items.ex2_en: The front wheels must align properly to prevent uneven tire wear during driving.
items.ex2_zh: 前轮必须正确对齐，以防止行驶过程中轮胎磨损不均。

items.def_en: (+ sth) link or synchronize components or parameters so that they operate in fixed coordination
items.ex_en: Borrowers rushed to lock in low mortgage rates before the announced hike.
items.ex_zh: 借款人赶在宣布加息前抢先锁定较低的抵押贷款利率。

items.def_zh: 使适应，量身定制，调整；裁制（衣服）
items.def_en: 1. To adapt or modify something to suit a particular purpose, need, or person. 2. To make or alter clothes to fit someone.
items.ex_en: The educational academy will tailor its advanced curriculum to suit working adult professionals.
items.ex_zh: 该教育学院将量身定制其进阶课程，以适合在职成年专业人士。

items.def_en: (informal) To synchronize, coordinate, or match in timing or operation.
items.ex_en: Make sure your mobile phone can sync properly with the central cloud database.
items.ex_zh: 请确保你的手机能够与中央云端数据库正常同步。
items.ex2_en: Software engineers must sync all local application files with the remote corporate server.
items.ex2_zh: 软件工程师必须将所有本地应用程序文件与远程企业服务器同步。

items.def_zh: 校准；精确调整（以达精准标准）
items.def_en: to adjust an instrument or plan precisely to ensure accuracy or proper operational alignment
items.ex_en: The master watchmaker meticulously calibrated the delicate brass springs to ensure flawless astronomical timing.
items.ex_zh: 制表大师精益求精地校准脆弱的黄铜弹簧，以确保天文计时的分毫不差。

items.def_en: To happen or operate at the exact same time and speed, or to cause two or more things to do so.
items.ex_en: The dancers spent endless hours rehearsing to synchronize their intricate footwork with the tempo.
items.ex_zh: 舞者们花费数小时排练，以使他们复杂的步法与音乐节拍完全同步。
items.ex2_en: The atomic clocks synchronize automatically across the global network via satellite signals daily.
items.ex2_zh: 这些原子钟每天通过卫星信号在整个全球网络中自动同步。

items.def_en: to bring elements, rules, or systems into agreeable proportion, agreement, or consistency
items.ex_en: The council sought to harmonize conflicting urban development regulations across all neighboring provinces.
items.ex_zh: 理事会试图使所有邻省之间相互冲突的城市发展法规协调一致。
items.ex2_en: The distinct vocal tones harmonize beautifully during the choir's impressive final performance.
items.ex2_zh: 在合唱团令人印象深刻的压轴演出中，不同的声调优美地融洽在一起。

items.def_zh: 使协调，使适应，使合拍；为……调音
items.def_en: (+ to) (often passive) To make someone or something sensitive to, aware of, or in harmony with a situation or mood.
items.ex_en: The diplomat was finely attuned to the subtle shifts in political climate.
items.ex_zh: 这位外交官对政治气候的微妙变化有着敏锐的洞察力。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote modifying, calibrating, or aligning components, behaviors, or schedules so that they correspond harmoniously or operate simultaneously. They vary by manner: customizing to fit a specific purpose, bringing into cognitive/sensory harmony, or aligning strictly in time and operation.
groups.summary_zh: 依特定需求或节奏对事物进行适配、校准与同步，使其融洽协同。
groups.desc_en: Denotes bringing disparate mechanisms, parameters, or behaviors into deliberate harmony, alignment, or exact specifications, differing from generic 'change' by aiming for functional synchrony and compatibility.
groups.desc_zh: 指精细调整参数或协同运作，使多方机制、行为或规格达成匹配与和谐，区别于泛指的改变 (change)，目标在于功能同步与兼容。
groups.nuance_en: calibrate: precise technical setting against standard measures (instrument / scale / expectations) · align: orient into parallel conformity with strategic goals (strategy / teeth / incentives) · tailor: custom-fit precisely to specific requirements (program / message / approach) · coordinate: organize diverse actors into smooth teamwork (efforts / logistics / rescue) · sync: bring simultaneous timing into absolute unison (data / audio / clocks)
groups.nuance_zh: calibrate: 对准标准严密校准 (instrument / scale / expectations) · align: 调整使目标或方向对齐一致 (strategy / teeth / incentives) · tailor: 量身定做专项调整 (program / message / approach) · coordinate: 统筹协调多方协同运作 (efforts / logistics / rescue) · sync: 使时间或数据完全同步 (data / audio / clocks)

groups.name: Aggregate & Total · 累计与汇总计算 (Aggregate, Accumulate, Total)
groups.tip: 零散数值累加聚合为总量

items.def_en: to combine into a substantial total amount or continuously increase in sum
items.ex_en: Small daily expenses quickly add up over the course of a year.
items.ex_zh: 一年下来，日常的点滴开销很快就会累积成一笔巨款。

items.def_zh: 结清汇总，盘点算出总数
items.def_en: to calculate and record the complete final total of a set of figures or scores
items.ex_en: Give me a minute while I tally up our dinner receipts.
items.ex_zh: 给我一分钟，我把我们晚餐的发票汇总盘点一下。

items.def_en: to add individual numbers or items together to reach a final total
items.ex_en: The cashier tot up the purchases and handed me the final bill.
items.ex_zh: 收银员将购买的商品逐项累计相加，递给了我最终账单。

items.raw_cluster: 合计与相当于 Amount & Total
items.def_zh: 总计，共达；等同于，相当于
items.def_en: 1. (+ to) To add up to a particular total or sum. 2. (+ to) To be equal or equivalent to something.
items.ex_en: The repair costs will amount to nearly five thousand dollars in total.
items.ex_zh: 维修费用总计将近五千美元。

items.def_en: to calculate or record a running total of points, scores, or amounts
items.ex_en: The official carefully tallied the votes cast in the close mayoral race.
items.ex_zh: 官员仔细清点了这场胶着的市长竞选中投出的选票。
items.ex2_en: The final test scores tally perfectly with the teacher's original grade book entries.
items.ex2_zh: 最终的测试成绩与老师原始成绩册上的记录完全吻合。

items.def_en: (+ to/from) to accumulate or be added as a natural or regular gain or increase over time
items.ex_en: Substantial interest will accrue to your retirement fund over the coming decades.
items.ex_zh: 在接下来的几十年里，你的退休基金将自然孳生出可观的利息。
items.ex2_en: The shrewd real estate investor accrued substantial wealth through strategic urban land purchases.
items.ex2_zh: 这位精明的房地产投资者通过战略性的城市土地收购积累了巨额财富。

items.def_en: to result in a specific aggregate numerical sum or total quantity
items.ex_en: All these minor delays add up to several wasted hours each week.
items.ex_zh: 所有这些微小的延误加起来，每周都会浪费好几个小时。

items.def_zh: 总计达，共计；计算……的总和；彻底毁坏（车辆等）
items.def_en: 1. To add up to a particular number or amount; to calculate the total of something. 2. (informal) To damage a vehicle so badly that it cannot be repaired.
items.ex_en: The damages from the recent hail storm total over ten million dollars.
items.ex_zh: 最近这场冰雹造成的损失总额超过了一千万美元。

items.def_en: To amount to a combined total, or to combine several different amounts or items into a single total.
items.ex_en: The website aggregates reviews from multiple independent critics into a single score.
items.ex_zh: 该网站将来自多位独立评论家的评价汇总为一个综合得分。
items.ex2_en: Individual customer donations aggregate quickly into a massive humanitarian relief fund every year.
items.ex2_zh: 每年，个别客户的捐款很快汇聚成一笔巨额的人道主义救援基金。

items.def_en: To gather or collect something gradually over a period of time, or to increase in amount over time.
items.ex_en: Harmful toxins can gradually accumulate in the bloodstream without prompt medical treatment.
items.ex_zh: 如果不及时治疗，有害毒素会逐渐在血液中积聚。
items.ex2_en: The avid historian hopes to accumulate rare manuscripts regarding medieval European maritime trade.
items.ex2_zh: 这位狂热的历史学家希望收集有关中世纪欧洲海上贸易的珍贵手稿。

items.def_en: to collect or gather a large quantity of wealth, materials, or information gradually
items.ex_en: The ruthless industrialist managed to amass a vast fortune during the boom.
items.ex_zh: 这位冷酷的实业家在经济繁荣时期聚敛了巨额财富。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses processes where individual numerical units, values, or tangible quantities grow over time into a collective sum. Distinctions rest on whether the verb indicates natural collection over time ('accumulate'), calculation of a sum ('total'), or synthesizing dispersed items into a whole ('aggregate').
groups.summary_zh: 通过逐步堆积或统合计算，使分散零碎的数据或事物汇总为总量。
groups.desc_en: Involves progressive arithmetical reckoning, compounding growth, or synthesizing separate quantities into a comprehensive final figure, contrasting with 'count' by focusing on the cumulative result rather than sequential enumeration.
groups.desc_zh: 指将各项离散数据或递增量通过加和计算汇聚成总数，区别于机械数数 (count)，聚焦于最终累积的综合总量与算术总和。
groups.nuance_en: total: formally reach an ultimate arithmetic sum (damages / sales / score) · tally up: systematically record and calculate ongoing points or units (votes / points / scores) · accrue: passively accumulate over time through rules or interest (interest / benefits / debt) · add up: combine to reach a logical or numeric total (figures / expenses / receipts) · amount: achieve an aggregate level or equivalency in impact (losses / sum / total)
groups.nuance_zh: total: 最终加总达……之数 (damages / sales / score) · tally up: 清点点算并汇总记账 (votes / points / scores) · accrue: 随时间依规则孳生累积 (interest / benefits / debt) · add up: 累加合计出具体数目 (figures / expenses / receipts) · amount: 总计相当于、达到某种总额 (losses / sum / total)

groups.name: Alter & Customize · 修改与专项调整 (Modify, Customize, Tweak)
groups.tip: 针对细节参数进行调校改动

items.def_en: (+ sth) Quickly make or adapt a piece of equipment or structure from available parts
items.ex_en: We managed to rig up a temporary shelter using tarps and branches.
items.ex_zh: 我们用防水布和树枝拼凑搭建了一个临时避难所。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Make slight adjustments or modifications to improve performance
items.ex_en: He tweaked up the audio mixer to give the bass more punch.
items.ex_zh: 他微调了音频混音器，让低音听起来更有冲击力。

items.def_zh: 修改，微调，变更；（语法上）修饰；缓和
items.def_en: 1. To make small changes to something in order to improve it or make it more suitable for a particular purpose. 2. (grammar) To qualify or limit the meaning of a word.
items.ex_en: The engineers had to modify the original design to meet safety regulations.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们不得不修改原始设计，以符合安全规范。

items.def_en: to make small adjustments to something in order to improve it or make it work more effectively
items.ex_en: I need to tweak the layout slightly before printing the final flyer.
items.ex_zh: 在打印最终传单之前，我需要对排版稍作调整。

items.def_en: to make very small adjustments to an engine, plan, or system so that it works as well as possible
items.ex_en: The technician spent hours fine-tuning the sensitive laboratory equipment for accurate readings.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员花了数小时对精密的实验室仪器进行精细微调以确保读数准确。

items.def_zh: 倒填日期，回溯（使合同、支票或加薪生效日期提前）
items.def_en: 1. To put an earlier date on a document, check, or pay agreement so that it takes effect from that past time.
items.ex_en: Management decided to backdate the salary increase to the beginning of January.
items.ex_zh: 管理层决定将加薪的生效日期回溯到一月初。

items.def_en: to make unauthorized changes to something, especially so as to damage or improperly alter it
items.ex_en: Someone attempted to tamper with the electrical box behind the warehouse yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 昨天有人企图擅自改动仓库后面的配电箱。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Decorate, customize, or equip something in an elaborate or stylish way
items.ex_en: He spent thousands of dollars to trick out his vintage sports car.
items.ex_zh: 他花了好几千美元精心改装打扮他那辆老式跑车。

items.def_zh: 改装，加大……的马力（通常与 up 连用）
items.def_en: (also 'soup up') To modify an engine or machine to make it faster, more powerful, or more impressive.
items.ex_en: The local mechanic knows how to soup any ordinary vehicle for racing.
items.ex_zh: 当地的汽修工懂得如何改装任何普通车辆以提升赛车性能。

items.def_zh: 定制，定做；按个人需求修改
items.def_en: 1. To modify or adapt something to meet the particular requirements or preferences of an individual.
items.ex_en: Clients can customise the dashboard interface according to their specific operational workflows.
items.ex_zh: 客户可以根据具体的业务流程定制仪表盘界面。

items.def_en: to modify something, especially a car or engine, to make it more powerful or faster
items.ex_en: The teenager worked all summer to soup up his motorcycle engine.
items.ex_zh: 那个少年整个夏天都在打工，以便改装增强他摩托车的发动机马力。

groups.summary_en: An agent alters the structure, timing, or performance of an object, document, or vehicle to adapt it for a specific purpose or enhance its capability. Verbs range from neutral partial alteration to specialized enhancement or retroactive dating.
groups.summary_zh: 对事物结构、性能或日期等进行局部修改、定制或强化。
groups.desc_en: Profiles modifying existing artifacts, mechanisms, or systems through specialized adjustments, unauthorized alterations, or bespoke upgrades, differing from neutral 'change' by focusing on utilitarian customization or tampering.
groups.desc_zh: 指对已有机械、系统或文书进行局部微调、非法篡改或定制化改造，区别于通用的 change，侧重于功利性定制或违规动手脚。
groups.nuance_en: modify: officially alter parameters or phrasing to suit conditions (terms / design / behavior) · tweak: make minor, precise mechanical or technical adjustments (settings / code / algorithm) · fine-tune: meticulously adjust for peak performance (engine / balance / model) · tamper with: make unauthorized, illicit, or damaging changes (evidence / locks / meter) · trick out: lavishly embellish or customize with flashy accessories (car / motorcycle / rig)
groups.nuance_zh: modify: 针对条件做结构性修改 (terms / design / behavior) · tweak: 细微调整参数或代码 (settings / code / algorithm) · fine-tune: 精细微调以达极致表现 (engine / balance / model) · tamper with: 非法动手脚篡改破坏 (evidence / locks / meter) · trick out: 酷炫改装、加装花哨配置 (car / motorcycle / rig)

groups.name: Amass & Stockpile · 收集与储备 (Collect, Stock, Garner)
groups.tip: 从各处聚拢汇集资源

items.def_en: to buy or gather a large quantity of goods or supplies for future use
items.ex_en: Local residents began to stock up on bottled water before the blizzard.
items.ex_zh: 暴风雪来临之前，当地居民开始大量储备瓶装水。

items.def_zh: 收集，采集；聚集；领取，收取
items.def_en: 1. To bring or come together from different places; to gather things as a hobby; to pick up or receive money or goods.
items.ex_en: Volunteers will collect canned goods outside the supermarket all day tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者们明天将整天在超市外募集罐头食品。
items.ex2_en: Rainwater collects naturally in shallow stone basins carved into the mountain rock face.
items.ex2_zh: 雨水自然地汇聚在刻在山岩表面的浅石盆中。

items.def_en: [I/T] To gradually gather or increase in quantity over a period of time
items.ex_en: Layers of dust will accumulate rapidly in any abandoned and unsealed warehouse.
items.ex_zh: 在任何废弃且未密封的仓库里，灰尘都会迅速积聚厚厚一层。
items.ex2_en: The ambitious bibliophile managed to accumulate thousands of rare antique books over decades.
items.ex2_zh: 这位雄心勃勃的藏书家几十年来收集了数千本珍贵的古籍。

items.def_zh: 储存，储备（以备不时之需）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to collect and store a supply of something for future need
items.ex_en: The villagers diligently laid in firewood well before the harsh winter arrived.
items.ex_zh: 严冬到来之前，村民们勤勉地储备了充足的柴火以备不时之需。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to accumulate or gather into a large amount or pile over time
items.ex_en: Unanswered emails continued to pile up while she was away on leave.
items.ex_zh: 她休假期间，未回复的电子邮件不断堆积起来。
items.ex2_en: Snowplows continued to pile up clearing snow along the edges of the highway.
items.ex2_zh: 扫雪机继续将清理出来的积雪堆积在高速公路的两侧。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to store or hide money, goods, or valuables in a safe place
items.ex_en: He stashed away some emergency cash in a hollowed-out dictionary.
items.ex_zh: 他把一些应急现金藏进了一本被挖空的字典里。

items.def_zh: 储备，进货；存有，备有（货物）
items.def_en: 1. To keep a supply of goods available for sale; to fill or supply with goods, food, or livestock; 2. to keep stocks or supplies.
items.ex_en: The grocery store stocks organic produce grown by local family farms.
items.ex_zh: 这家杂货店备有当地家庭农场种植的有机农产品。

items.def_zh: 收集，获得（支持、荣誉、信息等）；储存
items.def_en: 1. To collect, gather, or earn something through effort, such as support, praise, or information.
items.ex_en: The ambitious reform proposal garnered broad support across the political spectrum.
items.ex_zh: 这项雄心勃勃的改革提案赢得了各个政治派别的广泛支持。

items.def_zh: 积攒，积聚（财富、证据等巨量物）
items.def_en: To gather together or accumulate a large amount of valuable material or information
items.ex_en: The prosecutor amassed overwhelming evidence against the corrupt corporate executives.
items.ex_zh: 检察官针对那些腐败的企业高管搜集了大量的铁证。

items.def_zh: 秘藏，囤积（尤指出于贪婪或焦虑）
items.def_en: [I/T] To amass money or valued objects and hide or store them away greedily or anxiously
items.ex_en: Fearing severe shortages, panicked citizens began to hoard gasoline in plastic jugs.
items.ex_zh: 出于对严重短缺的恐慌，惊恐的市民开始用塑料罐囤积汽油。

items.def_zh: 大量囤积，储备（以防短缺）
items.def_en: [I/T] To collect and store a large quantity of goods or materials for future use
items.ex_en: The government decided to stockpile essential medical supplies in underground facilities.
items.ex_zh: 政府决定在地下设施中大量储备急需的医疗物资。

groups.summary_en: An agent systematically gathers, amasses, or reserves commodities, resources, or intangible assets over time. Verbs range from neutral accumulation to deliberate hoarding or hard-won harvesting of support.
groups.summary_zh: 系统性或大量积攒、储备物资或抽象资源。
groups.desc_en: Centers on gathering, hoarding, or preserving materials in large quantities for future security or strategic reserve, contrasting with simple 'find' or 'hold' through its foresight and accumulating volume.
groups.desc_zh: 指为备未来之需或战略储备而有意识地大量收集、囤积与储藏物资，区别于单纯的获得或持存，强调预见性与数量累积。
groups.nuance_en: stockpile: mass accumulation of strategic reserves for crises (weapons / food / grain) · stash away: secretly hide valuables or reserves for later (cash / savings / loot) · amass: steadily collect vast wealth or data over time (fortune / wealth / evidence) · garner: earn and collect abstract value or recognition through effort (support / praise / votes) · lay in: proactively store supplies in anticipation of need (provisions / wood / coal)
groups.nuance_zh: stockpile: 战备性或应急性大量囤积 (weapons / food / grain) · stash away: 隐秘储存藏匿 (cash / savings / loot) · amass: 长期聚敛巨额财富或资源 (fortune / wealth / evidence) · garner: 经努力逐步博得声誉支持 (support / praise / votes) · lay in: 提前储备过冬或应急物资 (provisions / wood / coal)

groups.name: Appellation & Designation · 命名与赐名 (Name, Dub, Denominate)
groups.tip: 为事物或人赋予名称与头衔

items.def_zh: 自称；尊称为（多用于正式头衔）
items.def_en: designate or address with an official title, honorific, or surname
items.ex_en: The exiled prince continued to style himself as the rightful monarch.
items.ex_zh: 这位流亡王子继续自封为合法的君主。

items.def_en: attach a label, moniker, or descriptive identity to someone or something
items.ex_en: His cynical coworkers tagged him as a complete corporate bootlicker.
items.ex_zh: 他那些愤世嫉俗的同事把他标榜为一个彻头彻尾的职场马屁精。

items.def_en: give a specific title to a book, article, or other artistic work
items.ex_en: The author chose to entitle her debut novel after a quiet constellation.
items.ex_zh: 作者决定以一个静谧星座的名字来为她的处女作小说题名。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Give someone or something the same name as an existing person or thing
items.ex_en: She was named after her grandmother, who had passed away the year before.
items.ex_zh: 她是用她祖母的名字命名的，祖母在前一年去世了。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Label, describe, or categorize someone or something by a particular designation
items.ex_en: Critics immediately tagged him as the most promising young director this year.
items.ex_zh: 影评人立刻将他贴上了今年最具潜力的青年导演这一标签。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Give an unofficial, honorary, or descriptive nickname or title to someone or something
items.ex_en: The local press dubbed him as the savior of the neighborhood.
items.ex_zh: 当地媒体把他称作该街区的救世主。

items.def_en: To give an informal, humorous, or descriptive name to someone or something.
items.ex_en: His high school teammates nicknamed him Lightning because of his blazing speed.
items.ex_zh: 高中队友因为他飞快的速度而给他起了个“闪电”的绰号。

items.def_zh: 把……称为，给……起绰号；授予称号（如封爵）；（为电影等）配音
items.def_en: 1. To give an unofficial name, nickname, or title to someone or something. 2. To confer knighthood on someone. 3. To replace the original spoken dialogue in a film or broadcast with another recording or language.
items.ex_en: Journalists dubbed the controversial new tax bill an unfair burden on families.
items.ex_zh: 记者们把这项备受争议的新税法案戏称为对家庭的不公负担。

items.def_en: To give a new or different name to a person, place, organization, or object.
items.ex_en: The university decided to rename the historic library after a prominent benefactor.
items.ex_zh: 该大学决定以一位知名捐赠者的名字给这座历史悠久的图书馆重新命名。

items.def_zh: 为……施洗礼并命名；正式命名
items.def_en: give a baby a name at baptism, or give a ship or project a name officially
items.ex_en: They gathered at the shipyard to christen the massive new naval vessel.
items.ex_zh: 他们齐聚造船厂，为这艘崭新的巨型海军舰艇举行命名仪式。

items.def_zh: 命名，称呼；以某种货币单位计价
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To give a specific name, title, or designation to something. 2. (finance) To express or record a financial sum in a particular currency unit.
items.ex_en: The international bonds were denominated in euros rather than domestic currency.
items.ex_zh: 这些国际债券是以欧元而非本国货币计价的。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote speech acts that assign an identity, title, or label to an entity, covering formal or ritualistic conferring of titles (dub, denominate), colloquial or descriptive monikers (nickname), and modifying existing designations (rename).
groups.summary_zh: 通过言语行为赋予人或事物名称、头衔或称谓，含正式命名与戏称。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on the social, honorific, or colloquial act of conferring titles, monikers, or identities upon persons or things, contrasting with descriptive 'call' through its formal, ritualistic, or affectionate social weight.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过赋予正式名称、荣誉头衔或通俗绰号确立某人某物的称谓身份，区别于随口称呼 (call)，带有正式性、礼仪性或公众契约色彩。
groups.nuance_en: dub: confer a popular, evocative, or informal epithet (hero / legend / king) · style: formally self-designate or address with an official title (monarch / sovereign / leader) · nickname: affectionately or humorously assign an informal moniker (friend / player / newcomer) · tag: categorize or label with an identifying marker (suspect / photo / file) · name after: bestow a moniker in tribute to an ancestor or figure (ancestor / hero / father)
groups.nuance_zh: dub: 册封命名、冠以贴切美名 (hero / legend / king) · style: 正式自称或称颂正式尊号 (monarch / sovereign / leader) · nickname: 起外号、冠以通俗昵称 (friend / player / newcomer) · tag: 贴标签分类标识 (suspect / photo / file) · name after: 为纪念某人而随其取名 (ancestor / hero / father)

groups.name: Astound & Appall · 震惊与骇然 (Shock, Stupefy, Flabbergast)
groups.tip: 由目瞪口呆到惊恐万分

items.def_zh: 使深受震撼，使极其惊愕
items.def_en: (+ sb) Overwhelm, amaze, or intensely impress someone
items.ex_en: The band's electrifying live performance completely blew away the entire festival crowd.
items.ex_zh: 乐队激动人心的现场表演让全场音乐节观众彻底折服震撼。

items.def_zh: 使大吃一惊，使极其震惊
items.def_en: (+ sb) Astonish, surprise, or overwhelm someone completely
items.ex_en: Her sheer generosity bowled me over when I desperately needed lodging.
items.ex_zh: 在我极需住处时，她极大的慷慨让我惊愕又感动。

items.def_zh: 使惊骇恶心，使毛骨悚然
items.def_en: (+ sb) Disgust, repulse, or horrify someone intensely
items.ex_en: The sight of moldy leftovers in the fridge grossed everyone out.
items.ex_zh: 冰箱里发霉剩菜的景象让所有人都感到反胃恶心。

items.def_en: to shock, astonish, or deeply unsettle someone with an overwhelming fact or number
items.ex_en: The colossal cost of the infrastructure project will stagger most ordinary taxpayers.
items.ex_zh: 该基建项目庞大的开支将令大多数普通纳税人难以置信。

items.def_en: to shock or surprise someone greatly by something very unexpected or extraordinary
items.ex_en: The young prodigy's breathtaking chess moves astounded the veteran grandmasters present.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻神童惊险精妙的棋招令在场的资深特级大师大为震惊。

items.def_zh: 使大吃一惊，使目瞪口呆
items.def_en: (usually passive) To shock, surprise, or amaze someone completely.
items.ex_en: We were utterly flabbergasted by the sudden resignation of our chief director.
items.ex_zh: 首席董事的突然辞职让我们所有人彻底目瞪口呆。

items.def_zh: 使呆住，使惊呆不动；刺穿，穿透
items.def_en: 1. (usually passive) To make someone unable to move or speak because of fear, shock, or fascination. 2. (literary) To pierce or impale with a sharp object.
items.ex_en: The sudden shriek transfixed the midnight wanderers on the lonely woodland path.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的尖叫声让寂寥林间小道上的夜行人吓得呆立原地。

items.raw_cluster: 使震惊与使困惑 Stun & Baffle
items.def_zh: 使惊呆，使惊愕；使麻木，使昏昏沉沉
items.def_en: 1. To shock or surprise someone so much that they cannot think or speak clearly. 2. To make someone dull or drowsy, as through tiredness or alcohol.
items.ex_en: The sheer magnitude of the devastation seemed to stupefy the relief workers.
items.ex_zh: 惨烈的破坏程度似乎让救援人员惊愕得不知所措。

items.def_en: (often passive) To impress or frighten someone so much that they feel nervous or unable to speak or act freely.
items.ex_en: The rookie delegate was visibly overawed by the grandeur of the assembly.
items.ex_zh: 这位新代表显然被大会庄严宏伟的场面震慑住了。

items.raw_cluster: 使惊恐与使震惊 Terrify & Shock
items.def_zh: 使惊骇，使大为震惊，使深感厌恶
items.def_en: To shock, horrify, or disgust someone deeply.
items.ex_en: The deplorable living conditions in the refugee camp appalled international human rights observers.
items.ex_zh: 难民营中恶劣的生存条件让国际人权观察员深感震惊与骇然。

items.def_zh: 使毛骨悚然，使极度震惊
items.def_en: to fill someone with deep shock, aversion, or dismay at something atrocious
items.ex_en: The brutal assault captured on security cameras horrified the quiet suburban community.
items.ex_zh: 监控拍下的残忍袭击画面令这个宁静的郊区社区深感毛骨悚然。

groups.summary_en: An event, sight, or revelation overwhelms an observer's emotional or cognitive capacity, progressing from intimidating awe and paralyzing bewilderment to utter incredulity and profound moral horror.
groups.summary_zh: 由心生敬畏、目瞪口呆递增至极度错愕与骇然惊骇。
groups.desc_en: Involves cognitive paralysis or intense emotional shock induced by the incredible, horrifying, or profoundly unexpected, differing from mild 'surprise' through its overwhelming, immobilizing force.
groups.desc_zh: 指因极端难以置信、骇人听闻或出乎意料的事物而引发强烈的心理震慑与认知失能，区别于轻度惊吓 (surprise)，具有压倒性与定身般的冲击力。
groups.nuance_en: flabbergast: leave utterly speechless with bewildered astonishment (critics / audience / voters) · astound: overwhelm with sheer magnitude or brilliance (scientists / observers / public) · stupefy: stun into dull, senseless paralysis or bewilderment (bystanders / mind / senses) · stagger: unnerve or shake balance deeply by shocking news (investors / company / market) · transfix: root to the spot through sheer terror or amazement (crowd / gaze / onlooker)
groups.nuance_zh: flabbergast: 令人瞠目结舌、惊呆语塞 (critics / audience / voters) · astound: 以宏大或卓越极度震撼 (scientists / observers / public) · stupefy: 震得发懵发木、麻木失神 (bystanders / mind / senses) · stagger: 噩耗重创动摇令人心神失衡 (investors / company / market) · transfix: 吓呆或惊艳至定在原地不动 (crowd / gaze / onlooker)

groups.name: Auditory Perception & Attention · 听觉与倾听 (Hear, Overhear, Listen)
groups.tip: 从被动听到主动倾听

items.def_en: (+ sth) Hear and grasp the significance of what is being spoken
items.ex_en: It took him a moment to catch on to their whispered inside joke.
items.ex_zh: 他过了好一会儿才听懂他们窃窃私语所说的内部笑话。

items.def_zh: 察觉听到，注意到（声音或暗示）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Detect or notice an audible remark, tone, or clue
items.ex_en: The shrewd investigator picked up on the nervous tremor in the suspect's voice.
items.ex_zh: 精明的调查员察觉到了嫌疑人声音中那一丝紧张的颤抖。

items.def_zh: 听见，听到；得知，获悉；审理，听审
items.def_en: 1. To perceive sounds with your ears. 2. To receive information or news about something. 3. (law) To listen to and judge a legal case in court.
items.ex_en: Did you hear that strange metallic rattling coming from the basement floor?
items.ex_zh: 你听到地下室传来那种奇怪的金属碰撞声了吗？

items.def_en: To hear what other people are saying without their knowledge or intention.
items.ex_en: I accidentally overheard their secret merger plans during the noisy elevator ride.
items.ex_zh: 在嘈杂的电梯里，我无意中听到了他们秘密的并购计划。

items.def_en: Listen secretly or attentively to a conversation happening nearby
items.ex_en: She could not resist listening in on her parents' private evening discussion.
items.ex_zh: 她忍不住偷听了父母在傍晚进行的私密谈话。

items.def_en: (+ to) consciously direct one's attention to a broadcast or speaker
items.ex_en: Millions of anxious citizens tuned in to hear the president's emergency address.
items.ex_zh: 数百万焦虑的市民收听了总统发表的紧急电视讲话。

items.def_zh: 听见，听到；得知（hear 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of hear: perceived a sound with the ear, or received information about something.
items.ex_en: I heard an unusual scratching sound outside my bedroom window last night.
items.ex_zh: 昨晚我听见卧室窗外传来一阵反常的抓刮声。

items.def_en: 1. (+ to) To pay conscious attention to a sound or to what someone is saying. 2. (+ to) To take notice of advice or instructions and follow them.
items.ex_en: You should really listen to your doctor's advice about getting enough rest.
items.ex_zh: 你真应该听从医生的建议，保证充足的休息。

items.def_en: (+ to) listen attentively or pay close attention to something
items.ex_en: Hark to the gentle whisper of the autumn wind through the trees.
items.ex_zh: 且倾听穿梭在林间的飒飒秋风之轻语。

items.def_en: (+ on) secretly listen to a private conversation
items.ex_en: The curious reporter tried to eavesdrop on the confidential board meeting next door.
items.ex_zh: 好奇的记者试图窃听隔壁正在进行的机密董事会会议。

items.def_zh: 全神贯注地听（某人的话）
items.def_en: (+ every word/to) listen with intense fascination and undivided attention
items.ex_en: Hang on a second, let me grab a pen to write that down.
items.ex_zh: 稍等一下，我拿支笔把它记下来。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the auditory reception of sound, ranging from involuntary sensory reception (hear) or accidental reception (overhear) to deliberate, focused cognitive attention directed toward sounds or speech (listen, attend).
groups.summary_zh: 从被动感知声音、无意中听到，到主动集中注意力倾听与专注。
groups.desc_en: Profiles sensory reception of acoustic phenomena spanning passive detection, deliberate concentration, and clandestine monitoring, contrasting with mere 'hear' by emphasizing intention and covert surveillance.
groups.desc_zh: 涵盖声学信号的被动接收、专注倾听与隐秘窃听等全频谱听觉行为，区别于生理中性的 hear，凸显主观专注意图或私密窥听机制。
groups.nuance_en: listen: consciously pay sustained auditory attention (music / lecture / speech) · overhear: accidentally catch private talk without intention (conversation / gossip / remark) · eavesdrop: deliberately and covertly listen to private speech (neighbors / calls / secrets) · tune in: purposefully adjust attention or receiver to a broadcast (radio / broadcast / frequency) · pick up on: perceptively detect subtle auditory or contextual cues (accent / sarcasm / tone)
groups.nuance_zh: listen: 有意识专注倾听 (music / lecture / speech) · overhear: 无意间偶然偷听到 (conversation / gossip / remark) · eavesdrop: 故意潜伏窃听私密谈话 (neighbors / calls / secrets) · tune in: 调频收听、主动将注意力切入 (radio / broadcast / frequency) · pick up on: 敏锐捕捉听到细微语调线索 (accent / sarcasm / tone)

groups.name: Bind, Restrain & Secure · 捆绑、拴锁与固定 (Tie, Bind, Lock, Chain)
groups.tip: 用绳链或卡扣锁死位置

items.def_zh: 系，拴，扎，捆绑；（使）打结；与……打成平手
items.def_en: to fasten, attach, or bind something with string, rope, or cord; to make a knot or bow; to finish a contest with equal scores.
items.ex_en: Please tie the loose bundles securely with this thick rope before loading them.
items.ex_zh: 在装车之前，请用这根粗绳把松散的包裹绑紧。
items.ex2_en: The silken ribbon ties easily into a graceful bow around the gift package.
items.ex2_zh: 丝带很容易在礼品盒上系成一个优雅的蝴蝶结。

items.def_zh: 锁上，锁住；固定，卡住；（使）紧密结合
items.def_en: to fasten or secure something with a lock; to become firmly fixed or held in place.
items.ex_en: Make sure you lock the front door securely before leaving the office tonight.
items.ex_zh: 今晚离开办公室前，务必把前门锁好。
items.ex2_en: The heavy vault door locks automatically whenever the bank closes for the evening.
items.ex2_zh: 每当银行傍晚闭门时，沉重的金库门就会自动锁死。

items.def_zh: 用铁链锁住，拴住；束缚，囚禁
items.def_en: to fasten, secure, or confine someone or something with a chain.
items.ex_en: The guard used heavy iron links to chain the rusty gate shut overnight.
items.ex_zh: 警卫用沉重的铁链将生锈的大门整夜锁紧。

items.def_zh: 捆绑，系紧；使结合，使黏合；约束
items.def_en: to tie or fasten tightly with rope or cloth; to hold or stick together; to impose a legal or moral obligation on.
items.ex_en: The paramedics had to bind his fractured arm tightly with clean linen strips.
items.ex_zh: 医护人员不得不使用干净的亚麻布条紧紧包扎他骨折的手臂。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) bind someone or something securely with rope, cord, or string to restrict movement
items.ex_en: Most of his capital is tied up in long-term real estate investments.
items.ex_zh: 他的大部分资金都被长期房地产投资套住了。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) secure a person, animal, or object in an enclosed space with a lock
items.ex_en: Officers will lock up the expensive laboratory equipment safely inside the reinforced vault.
items.ex_zh: 人员会把昂贵的实验室设备安全地锁在强化金库内。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) fasten or restrain someone or something securely with a chain
items.ex_en: Farmers usually chain up the aggressive guard dog whenever unfamiliar visitors arrive unannounced.
items.ex_zh: 每当陌生访客不期而至时，农户通常会用铁链拴住凶猛的看门狗。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) hold someone or something firmly against a surface so they cannot move
items.ex_en: Two burly officers managed to pin down the violent suspect against the pavement.
items.ex_zh: 两名身材魁梧的警官合力将暴力嫌疑人按倒在人行道上制服。

items.def_en: [I/T] to attach, tie, or secure one object firmly to another or close an opening securely
items.ex_en: Passengers must fasten their safety restraints securely prior to the aircraft entering turbulence.
items.ex_zh: 在飞机进入气流颠簸之前，乘客必须系紧安全带。
items.ex2_en: The magnetic jacket buttons fasten securely with a light press of the thumb.
items.ex2_zh: 只要用拇指轻轻一按，夹克上的磁性纽扣就会紧紧扣住。

items.def_en: to tie an animal or object with a rope or chain to limit its range of movement
items.ex_en: The rancher chose to tether the young stallion to a sturdy wooden post.
items.ex_zh: 牧场主选择把那匹小公马拴在一根结实的木桩上。

items.def_en: to fasten someone's limbs with metal restraints to severely restrict physical movement
items.ex_en: Guards arrived swiftly to shackle the dangerous inmate before escorting him to court.
items.ex_zh: 警卫迅速赶来，在押送这名危险囚犯出庭前给他戴上镣铐。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve physically restraining, tethering, or fastening a person, animal, or object with cords, chains, or mechanical fasteners to restrict movement or hold components firmly together. Nuances vary by the specific binding medium (rope, chain, mechanical lock) and the degree of permanence.
groups.summary_zh: 用绳索、链条或机械构件捆绑、锁闭或固定以限制其移动。
groups.desc_en: Encompasses confining movement or securing physical objects through cords, metallic shackles, or rigid immobilizing holds, contrasting with open 'hold' by enforcing durable, inescapable physical restraint.
groups.desc_zh: 指使用绳索、金属镣铐或身体压制等手段剥夺行动自由或紧固物体，区别于暂时的握持 (hold)，强调不可逃脱的物理强约束与稳固性。
groups.nuance_en: bind: constrict firmly with wrapped bands or emotional obligations (hands / wounds / contract) · chain: securely confine with heavy metal links (prisoner / bicycle / gates) · tie up: immobilize completely using ropes or cords (hostage / package / boat) · lock up: secure firmly behind locked mechanical enclosures (valuables / criminal / bicycle) · pin down: immobilize mechanically against a surface (suspect / opponent / limb)
groups.nuance_zh: bind: 缠缚捆绑、受契约束缚 (hands / wounds / contract) · chain: 用沉重铁链锁住限制 (prisoner / bicycle / gates) · tie up: 用绳带严密捆牢 (hostage / package / boat) · lock up: 关入牢房或上锁存入柜中 (valuables / criminal / bicycle) · pin down: 压住使其动弹不得 (suspect / opponent / limb)

groups.name: Blend & Fuse Together · 混合与融合 (Blend, Intermingle, Coalesce)
groups.tip: 多种成分交融混为一体

items.def_en: Combine seamlessly with surroundings or other components without standing out
items.ex_en: The modern glass pavilion was designed to blend in naturally with its surroundings.
items.ex_zh: 这座现代玻璃亭在设计上力求与周围环境自然地融为一体。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Move smoothly into and become joined with another substance or stream
items.ex_en: Several mountain rivulets gradually flow into the wider river winding through the valley.
