groups.nuance_en: illuminate: casting clear, broad intellectual or physical light that banishes obscurity (path / page / room) · floodlight: bathing an expansive exterior zone in violent, high-intensity artificial glare (stadium / façade / field) · beam down: focusing a concentrated, directional shaft of luminescence downwards (sunlight / spotlight / ray) · irradiate: penetrating deeply with electromagnetic or photonic rays (tissue / food / darkness) · light up: igniting sudden brilliance or visible animation across a surface (sky / room / face)
groups.nuance_zh: illuminate: 广域而清晰地投光照明或照彻晦涩 (path / page / room) · floodlight: 以大功率探照灯将整片区域浸入白昼般的强光 (stadium / façade / field) · beam down: 居高临下聚焦投射笔直光束 (sunlight / spotlight / ray) · irradiate: 电磁光线穿透照射与辐射透注 (tissue / food / darkness) · light up: 刹那间通明大亮或满面生辉 (sky / room / face)

groups.name: Integrate & Merge · 混合共溶与化合一体 (Mix, Combine, Merge, Unify)
groups.tip: 将不同要素融为一体

items.def_en: to combine smoothly with the surroundings or other elements so as not to be noticed
items.ex_en: The desert fox's pale coat helps it blend in seamlessly with the sand.
items.ex_zh: 沙狐浅色的皮毛帮助它与沙地天衣无缝地融为一体。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to add an ingredient or element into a substance and combine thoroughly
items.ex_en: Gently mix in the melted butter until the batter becomes completely smooth.
items.ex_zh: 轻轻拌入融化的黄油，直到面糊变得完全顺滑。
items.ex2_en: The powdered cocoa mixes in smoothly with warm milk after gentle stirring.
items.ex2_zh: 可可粉在轻轻搅拌后顺滑地融入了温牛奶中。

items.def_en: (+ with sth) to fit together or unite closely with something else
items.ex_en: The proposed advertising campaign must tie in with the core brand identity.
items.ex_zh: 提议的广告宣传活动必须与核心品牌形象紧密结合。

items.def_en: to mix substances or qualities smoothly so they form an inseparable, harmonious mixture
items.ex_en: The chef expertly chosen spices to blend together into a harmonious flavor.
items.ex_zh: 厨师巧妙地挑选香料，使其完美调和成和谐的风味。
items.ex2_en: She carefully blended natural essential oils to create a relaxing aromatic fragrance.
items.ex2_zh: 她精心混合天然精油，调配出一种令人放松的芳香。

items.def_en: 1. To combine two or more substances so they become a single substance, or to become combined. 2. To meet and talk to people, especially socially.
items.ex_en: You need to mix the two powders before adding any warm liquid.
items.ex_zh: 在加入任何温热液体之前，你需要将这两种粉末混合。
items.ex2_en: Oil and water will never mix thoroughly, regardless of vigorous stirring.
items.ex2_zh: 无论怎样用力搅拌，油和水永远不会完全混合。

items.def_en: To join or bring together two or more things to form a single unit, or to possess two or more qualities together.
items.ex_en: The new design aims to combine modern elegance with everyday practicality.
items.ex_zh: 这项新设计旨在将现代优雅与日常实用性结合起来。
items.ex2_en: The two powerful corporate entities combined smoothly to form a dominant market leader.
items.ex2_zh: 这两家实力雄厚的企业顺利合并，成为占主导地位的市场领军者。

items.def_zh: （使）合并，（使）融合；渐渐消失在……中
items.def_en: To combine or cause two or more things to combine into a single entity, or to blend gradually into something else.
items.ex_en: The two small family businesses decided to merge into a single corporation.
items.ex_zh: 这两家小型家族企业决定合并为一家公司。
items.ex2_en: The banking consortium merged the independent regional branches into a streamlined system.
items.ex2_zh: 该银行财团将各个独立的地区分行合并为一个精简的体系。

items.def_en: to combine two or more organizations, ideas, or materials into one harmonious entity
items.ex_en: The board decided to amalgamate several regional departments into one corporate entity.
items.ex_zh: 董事会决定将几个区域部门合并为一个法人实体。
items.ex2_en: The separate research units amalgamated into a premier multidisciplinary institute last spring.
items.ex2_zh: 各个独立的研究单位去年春天合并为一个顶级跨学科研究所。

items.def_en: (of separate parts) to come together to form one larger system or group
items.ex_en: Various grassroots movements gradually began to coalesce into a powerful national coalition.
items.ex_zh: 各类基层运动逐渐开始汇聚成一个强大的全国性联盟。

items.def_en: To bring different parts, groups, or regions together to form a single, united whole.
items.ex_en: The new treaty seeks to unify the fragmented regions under common trade laws.
items.ex_zh: 新条约旨在将四分五裂的地区统一在共同的贸易法之下。
items.ex2_en: Diverse cultural factions unified into a single peaceful nation through persistent dialogue.
items.ex2_zh: 通过持续的对话，多元文化派系联合成了一个和平的国家。

items.def_en: to join together securely by or as if by melting, making the constituent parts indivisible
items.ex_en: Intense heat caused the adjacent metal plates to fuse into a single structure.
items.ex_zh: 高温使相邻的金属板熔合成了单一结构。
items.ex2_en: Extreme volcanic heat fused individual rock fragments into a massive granite boulder.
items.ex2_zh: 极度的火山高温把分散的岩石碎片融合成一块巨大的花岗岩岩石。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on bringing discrete entities, ingredients, or organizations together into a single whole. Nuances differentiate simple physical blending where elements may remain distinct ('mix'), systematic integration ('combine'), seamless absorption into a common stream ('merge'), and political or structural consolidation into a singular identity ('unify').
groups.summary_zh: 将独立个体、原料或组织融入为一个整体，从机械混合到有机化为一体。
groups.desc_en: Unites multiple discrete components into a unified, indistinguishable, or chemically harmonious whole, contrasting with adjacent coexistence, stratified layering, or mechanical assembly.
groups.desc_zh: 将多个分立元素共溶、化合或有机熔铸为浑然一体的全新整体，区别于并列拼凑、分层堆叠或机械拼装。
groups.nuance_en: amalgamate: formally or chemically unifying disparate bodies into a coherent corporate or alloy whole (companies / guilds / cultures) · blend: smoothing distinct ingredients or notes until boundaries vanish into sensory harmony (spices / voices / colors) · merge: continuous gradual converging of flows or identities until lost in a single continuum (traffic / corporations / rivers) · combine: joining separate elements into a single functional grouping or mixture (forces / efforts / chemicals) · tie in: aligning and coordinating a secondary element to match an overarching master plan (promotions / themes / operations)
groups.nuance_zh: amalgamate: 企业、组织或金属法理性地汞齐化合并 (companies / guilds / cultures) · blend: 消除界面使香气、色泽等感官元素浑然交融 (spices / voices / colors) · merge: 两股潮流或主体平滑汇聚消弭界限 (traffic / corporations / rivers) · combine: 兼收并蓄将相异要素并为一个复合体 (forces / efforts / chemicals) · tie in: 依附主干使辅助要素与主线配套挂钩 (promotions / themes / operations)

groups.name: Intellectual Impasse & Disorientation · 困惑与束手无策 (Baffle, Confound, Stump)
groups.tip: 从难解其意到彻底难住

items.def_en: cause someone to feel confused because they cannot understand something
items.ex_en: His bizarre reaction to the simple question began to puzzle everyone present.
items.ex_zh: 他对这个简单问题的怪异反应让在场的每个人都感到费解。

items.def_zh: 使心烦意乱；使思维混乱
items.def_en: (+ sb) to cause someone to become severely confused, disoriented, or emotionally troubled
items.ex_en: The constant conflicting instructions began to mess up the new trainee completely.
items.ex_zh: 不断相互矛盾的指令开始让这名新实习生彻底思维混乱。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to confuse or distract someone so that they lose their bearings or make an error
items.ex_en: A sudden noise outside managed to throw off the speaker's concentration entirely.
items.ex_zh: 外面突然传来的一声响动彻底扰乱了发言者的注意力。

items.def_zh: 使陷入困境；使犯错难住
items.def_en: (+ sb) to cause someone to stumble intellectually, make a mistake, or become stymied
items.ex_en: That tricky follow-up question seemed designed to trip up the candidate.
items.ex_zh: 那个棘手的追问似乎就是为了难住这位候选人而设计的。

items.def_zh: 难住，使困惑，使束手无策；迈着沉重的步子走；在……巡回作政治演说
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To be too difficult for someone to answer, solve, or explain; baffle. 2. To walk heavily and stiffly. 3. To travel around an area making political campaign speeches.
items.ex_en: The difficult math problem continued to stump even the brightest students.
items.ex_zh: 那道数学难题继续难倒了即使是最聪明的学生。

items.def_en: complicate matters mentally and cause someone to feel anxious uncertainty
items.ex_en: The contradictory laboratory findings continued to perplex the team of experienced scientists.
items.ex_zh: 自相矛盾的实验结果继续困扰着这支经验丰富的科学家团队。

items.def_zh: 使迷失方向；使迷茫，使困惑
items.def_en: To make someone lose their sense of direction, position, or mental clarity; confuse.
items.ex_en: Thick smoke from the fire quickly began to disorient the trapped residents.
items.ex_zh: 大火产生的浓烟很快让被困的居民迷失了方向。

items.def_en: 1. To confuse or puzzle someone completely; mystify. 2. To control, impede, or absorb the flow of sound, fluid, or gas.
items.ex_en: The mysterious disappearance of the ancient artifacts continues to baffle local investigators.
items.ex_zh: 古代文物的神秘失踪继续让当地调查人员大惑不解。

items.def_zh: 使困惑，使惊疑；击败，挫败；弄混，混淆
items.def_en: 1. To confuse and surprise someone, especially by not fitting expectations. 2. To prove someone or something wrong; defeat. 3. To mix up or confuse one thing with another.
items.ex_en: The unexpected economic downturn served to confound the predictions of top analysts.
items.ex_zh: 意外的经济衰退彻底打乱并推翻了顶级分析师的预测。

items.def_zh: 使迷惑不解；使大惑不解
items.def_en: utterly bewilder someone by presenting things that defy logical explanation
items.ex_en: The magician's impossible vanishing act managed to mystify the entire audience.
items.ex_zh: 魔术师不可思议的隐形表演让全场观众大惑不解。

items.def_en: completely baffle and bewilder someone to the point of speechless confusion
items.ex_en: The complicated legal jargon seemed to flummox the poor witness entirely.
items.ex_zh: 复杂的法律术语似乎彻底把可怜的证人给弄懵了。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame mark degrees of cognitive paralysis where understanding breaks down, from temporarily halting someone with a difficult problem (stump), through perceptual or mental loss of bearings (disorient), to total explanatory failure (baffle) and bewildering astonishment (confound).
groups.summary_zh: 认知障碍由浅入深，从被难题难住，到方向迷失，再到彻底无法理解与震惊。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an epistemic breakdown where incoming information defies processing, halting forward progress; unlike mere confusion or ignorance, it emphasizes cognitive deadlocks, cognitive derailment, and complete explanatory failure.
groups.desc_zh: 指认知机制遭遇阻碍而陷入僵局或脱轨，区别于一般的不解或无知，强调思维彻底卡壳、线索中断与解释力崩溃。
groups.nuance_en: puzzle: active mental searching for missing logic (mystery / behavior) · perplex: complicated entanglement generating anxious hesitation (problem / decision) · stump: complete stoppage halting problem-solving (question / detective / panel) · baffle: total opacity defying rational comprehension (scientists / police / motive) · disorient: sudden loss of cognitive bearing or mental equilibrium (driver / patient)
groups.nuance_zh: puzzle: 苦思寻找缺失线索 (mystery / behavior) · perplex: 因错综复杂而犹疑困扰 (problem / decision) · stump: 彻底卡壳停滞 (question / detective / panel) · baffle: 扑朔迷离令人绝望不解 (scientists / police / motive) · disorient: 瞬间丧失认知方向感或心智平衡 (driver / patient)

groups.name: Lead & Escort Physically · 带领与引导演进 (Guide, Lead, Usher)
groups.tip: 在前引路或导向

items.def_zh: 带领，引路；引领，引导；导致
items.def_en: 1. to show the way by going in front; to take or guide someone somewhere. 2. to direct or control an activity or group. 3. (lead to) to cause or result in something
items.ex_en: The experienced ranger volunteered to lead the lost tourists back to safety.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的护林员自告奋勇带领迷路的游客返回安全地带。

items.def_zh: 导引，引领（正式陪同步行）
items.def_en: to lead, guide, or accompany people along a route in a formal or ceremonial capacity
items.ex_en: The protocol officer will conduct the foreign dignitaries through the grand palace hall.
items.ex_zh: 礼宾官将引导外国贵宾穿过宏伟的宫殿大厅。

items.def_en: 1. to show someone which way to go by going with them. 2. to direct or influence the behavior, decision, or development of someone or something
items.ex_en: Local scouts were hired to guide the survey team through dense mountain forests.
items.ex_zh: 当地向导受雇带领勘探队穿越茂密的森林山区。

items.def_en: to direct or steer someone safely through a complex physical area
items.ex_en: The local harbor master helped pilot the massive vessel through narrow waters.
items.ex_zh: 当地港口领航员帮助引导这艘巨轮穿过狭窄水域。

items.def_zh: 领入，领进（房间或建筑物）
items.def_en: (+ sb) to lead or escort someone into a room or building
items.ex_en: The receptionist showed the client in as soon as the manager was ready.
items.ex_zh: 经理一准备好，前台就把客户领了进去。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to escort or conduct someone politely into a room or venue
items.ex_en: The royal attendants stepped forward to usher in the foreign ambassadors formally.
items.ex_zh: 皇家侍从上前正式引领外国大使们步入大厅。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to guide someone through a place so they can see and explore it
items.ex_en: Our manager offered to show around the newly hired engineers this morning.
items.ex_zh: 我们经理今天早上主动提出带新入职的工程师们参观公司。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to guide or accompany someone on foot through an area or path
items.ex_en: Let me walk you through the new software setup process step by step.
items.ex_zh: 让我带你一步一步熟悉这款新软件的安装配置流程。

items.def_en: to accompany someone to protect, honor, or show them where to go
items.ex_en: Armed security officers arrived to escort the visiting diplomat to the embassy.
items.ex_zh: 武装安保人员抵达，护送来访的外交官前往大使馆。

items.def_en: to guide or direct a group of people carefully along a desired path
items.ex_en: Chaperones carefully worked to shepherd the noisy students through the crowded terminal.
items.ex_zh: 随行监护员小心翼翼地引导吵闹的学生穿过拥挤的航站楼。

items.def_zh: 引，领，陪同；开辟，宣告……的到来
items.def_en: 1. to guide or escort someone politely where they should go. 2. (usher in) to signal or mark the beginning of something new
items.ex_en: A polite concierge stepped forward to usher the guests toward the reception.
items.ex_zh: 一位彬彬有礼的门童走上前，引导客人们前往接待处。

groups.summary_en: Verbs denoting moving along with someone to show them the path, direct their forward movement, or courteously escort them into a place.
groups.summary_zh: 引路同行，带领某人前往目的地或礼貌引其入座/入内。
groups.desc_en: Involves physically directing and accompanying a person through a spatial trajectory or institutional boundary, contrasting with remote directing or driving forward from behind.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过身体力行引领、陪伴他人通过特定空间动线或体制门槛，区别于远程指挥或自后驱赶。
groups.nuance_en: lead: walking ahead to show path or direction (group / expedition) · guide: expert escort providing route knowledge and safety (tourists / climber) · usher: ceremonial or orderly indoor escorting (guests / audience) · pilot: maneuvering through perilous or intricate physical passages (ship / aircraft / vehicle) · walk through: step-by-step spatial or procedural accompaniment (facility / steps)
groups.nuance_zh: lead: 走在队伍前列带路 (group / expedition) · guide: 凭借专业知识提供安全导引 (tourists / climber) · usher: 礼仪性或秩序性室内引座迎宾 (guests / audience) · pilot: 操舵领航穿过险阻狭道 (ship / aircraft / vehicle) · walk through: 步步相随实地踏勘或演示 (facility / steps)

groups.name: Leap & Bounce · 弹跳与跃进 (Bound, Spring, Ricochet)
groups.tip: 受力反弹或发力跳

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ on/over) to move by small short jumps on one foot or both feet
items.ex_en: Injuring his left foot forced him to hop around the kitchen awkwardly.
items.ex_zh: 左脚受伤迫使他在厨房里别扭地单脚跳来跳去。

items.def_en: to spring or rebound back after hitting a surface
items.ex_en: The rubber ball would quickly bounce back whenever thrown against the wall.
items.ex_zh: 橡胶球每次砸向墙壁都会迅速反弹回来。

items.def_en: to jump or bound suddenly forward from a place
items.ex_en: A wild rabbit suddenly managed to leap out from the thick bushes.
items.ex_zh: 一只野兔突然从茂密的灌木丛中猛跳了出来。

items.def_en: to leap or rise very quickly and suddenly from a resting position
items.ex_en: Alarmed by the sound, the watchdog prepared to spring up instantly.
items.ex_zh: 被声音惊动的看门狗做好了瞬间一跃而起的准备。

items.def_en: (+ up/forward) to move rapidly and suddenly by a spring-like muscular exertion
items.ex_en: The agile leopard coiled its muscles to spring toward the fleeing prey.
items.ex_zh: 敏捷的猎豹蓄势待发，猛扑向逃跑的猎物。

items.def_en: (+ over/along) to walk or run with long, energetic leaping strides
items.ex_en: Energetic dogs would bound across the grassy fields every single sunny afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 精力充沛的狗儿们每个晴朗的下午都会在草地上奔跃。

items.def_en: To move quickly away from a surface after hitting it, or to cause something to do this; to jump up and down repeatedly.
items.ex_en: The children loved to bounce the colorful rubber balls on the playground.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们喜欢在操场上拍打反弹那些五颜六色的橡胶球。
items.ex2_en: The bright red tennis ball bounced high across the polished wooden floor.
items.ex2_zh: 那颗鲜红的网球在抛光的木地板上高高弹起。

items.def_en: 1. To bounce back after hitting a hard surface. 2. To recover in value, strength, or condition after a decline.
items.ex_en: The tennis ball would rebound predictably off the smooth concrete surface.
items.ex_zh: 网球会稳定地从光滑的水泥地面上反弹而起。

items.def_zh: 跳跃，跃过（leap的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of leap; jumped high or far, or moved suddenly.
items.ex_en: The deer leapt cleanly over the tall wooden fence without any hesitation.
items.ex_zh: 那只鹿毫不犹豫地轻盈跃过了高高的木栅栏。

items.def_zh: （用手支撑或撑竿）跳跃，腾跃；给……建穹顶
items.def_en: 1. To jump over an obstacle in a single leap, especially using your hands or a pole for support. 2. To construct or cover something with an arched roof or ceiling.
items.ex_en: The gymnast managed to vault over the high barrier with incredible precision.
items.ex_zh: 体操运动员以极高的精准度腾跃翻过了高高的障碍物。

items.def_en: (+ off) to rebound sharply and unpredictably off a hard surface after striking it
items.ex_en: The stray bullet managed to ricochet off the heavy iron beam harmlessly.
items.ex_zh: 流弹击中沉重的铁梁后折射弹开，没有造成伤害。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe explosive ballistic motions or sudden rebounds off a surface, distinguishing between elastic recoil, cleared obstacles, and athletic bodily jumps.
groups.summary_zh: 指利用弹力反弹或发力腾跃的运动方式，包括跨障跃过与撞击反弹。
groups.desc_en: Denotes explosive physical propulsion off a surface using kinetic energy or elastic recoil, distinguishing from sustained flight, steady running, or plain upward jumping.
groups.desc_zh: 指借助动能或弹性势能脱离支撑面发生暴发性弹起或回跃，区别于持续奔跑、飞行或平缓起跳。
groups.nuance_en: hop: small light spring off one or both feet (bird / rabbit / fence) · bound: long, energetic leaps across terrain (deer / dog / stairs) · spring: explosive sudden release like a coiled mechanism (trap / feet / bed) · bounce: elastic rebound after striking a resilient surface (ball / check) · rebound: directional deflection or recovery after physical impact (puck / basketball)
groups.nuance_zh: hop: 短促轻巧的单双脚微跳 (bird / rabbit / fence) · bound: 大步连贯跨越地表的疾跃 (deer / dog / stairs) · spring: 如压簧骤放般的暴发性窜跳 (trap / feet / bed) · bounce: 撞击弹性表面后的被动弹回 (ball / check) · rebound: 碰撞受阻后的反向偏折弹射 (puck / basketball)

groups.name: Manufacture & Produce · 制作与生产 (Craft, Manufacture, Fabricate)
groups.tip: 动手加工或工业产出物品

items.def_en: to produce goods in large quantities using machinery
items.ex_en: The automated factory continues to manufacture precision medical devices for global hospitals.
items.ex_zh: 这家自动化工厂继续为全球医院制造精密医疗设备。

items.def_en: To make or produce something skillfully and with great care, especially by hand.
items.ex_en: Skilled local artisans carefully craft beautiful wooden instruments in their private studios.
items.ex_zh: 技艺精湛的当地工匠在个人工作室里精心制作优美的木质乐器。

items.def_zh: 生产，制造，产出；输出（数据或信号）
items.def_en: To produce, manufacture, or generate an amount of goods, power, or data.
items.ex_en: The new plant will output ten thousand solar panels every single month.
items.ex_zh: 新工厂每月将生产一万块太阳能电池板。

items.def_zh: 出产，产生，提供；屈服，让步
items.def_en: 1. To produce or provide a crop, result, or profit. 2. (+ to) To surrender, submit, or give way to pressure.
items.ex_en: This fertile agricultural valley can yield tons of organic grain each season.
items.ex_zh: 这片肥沃的农业河谷每季都能出产数吨有机粮食。

items.def_en: To make or repair wooden barrels and casks.
items.ex_en: The master craftsman spent weeks to cooper tight oak barrels for aging wine.
items.ex_zh: 这位大师级工匠花费数周时间制作严密的橡木桶以供陈酿葡萄酒。

items.def_en: to produce something in significant numbers, especially in a factory
items.ex_en: The assembly lines can turn out hundreds of finished vehicles every day.
items.ex_zh: 这些装配流水线每天都能制造出数百辆成品车。

items.def_zh: 大量炮制；粗制滥造地生产
items.def_en: (+ sth) to produce large quantities of sth quickly and mechanically, often with low quality
items.ex_en: That budget studio continues to churn out cheap romance novels every single month.
items.ex_zh: 那家廉价工作室每月依然在粗制滥造地批量生产言情小说。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to produce or fabricate sth rapidly or roughly
items.ex_en: Our team was knocked out of the tournament in the quarter-finals.
items.ex_zh: 我们队在四分之一决赛中被淘汰出局。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to manufacture and launch a new mass-produced article onto the market
items.ex_en: The tech company plans to roll out its newest smartphone line next month.
items.ex_zh: 这家科技公司计划于下个月向市场推出其最新的智能手机系列。

items.def_en: to construct or manufacture an industrial product or structure from standardized parts
items.ex_en: Specialized workshops fabricate heavy steel frames for constructing modern high-rise buildings.
items.ex_zh: 专业车间负责制造用于建造现代高层建筑的重型钢框架。

items.def_zh: 使机动化，使摩托化；给……装上马达
items.def_en: To equip a vehicle, machine, or military unit with an engine, motor, or motor vehicles.
items.ex_en: Engineers decided to motorize the manual assembly line to boost overall production efficiency.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们决定使这条人工装配线机动化，以提高整体生产效率。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe generating, making, or turning out physical goods or industrial outputs through specialized labor, industrial processing, or technical design.
groups.summary_zh: 通过精湛技艺、专业加工或工业流程制造与产出物品。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the deliberate industrial, artisan, or volumetric transformation of materials into finished physical goods, contrasting with natural growth or abstract creation.
groups.desc_zh: 指将原材料经工业、手工或批量工序加工转化为实物产品，区别于自然生发或抽象创造。
groups.nuance_en: manufacture: systematic industrial-scale fabrication (vehicles / electronics) · craft: skilled, meticulous manual shaping (furniture / jewelry / narrative) · churn out: uninspired, rapid high-volume output (novels / pop songs / widgets) · turn out: batch-wise or factory-line completion (graduates / products / engines) · yield: productive harvest or volumetric return (crops / profit / chemical)
groups.nuance_zh: manufacture: 规格化工业级批量制造 (vehicles / electronics) · craft: 倾注匠心的手工精细打磨 (furniture / jewelry / narrative) · churn out: 机械粗糙地大肆倾销 (novels / pop songs / widgets) · turn out: 依配额或工序稳定产出 (graduates / products / engines) · yield: 产出物料、收成或收益总量 (crops / profit / chemical)

groups.name: Measure & Quantify Precisely · 测算与量化评估 (Gauge, Clock, Calibrate)
groups.tip: 测定尺寸分量与量化指标

items.def_en: to measure the duration or speed of an event using a stopwatch or clock
items.ex_en: The track coach used a digital stopwatch to time the runner's sprint.
items.ex_zh: 田径教练用数字秒表记录了该跑步选手的冲刺时间。

items.def_zh: 记录下（速度、时间或距离）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to register or reach a precise measured speed, distance, or time on an instrument
items.ex_en: The new sports car managed to clock up phenomenal speeds on the test track.
items.ex_zh: 这辆新跑车在测试跑道上跑出了令人惊叹的高速纪录。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to calibrate or take an exact measured quantity of sth using an instrument
items.ex_en: The chef carefully measured out the spices for the recipe.
items.ex_zh: 大厨仔细称量出食谱所需的香料。

items.def_zh: 测出……的时间（或速度），记录；达到（某速度或时间）；打卡；击打
items.def_en: 1. To measure or record the speed, time, or distance of something. 2. (informal) To reach or achieve a particular time or speed. 3. (slang) To hit someone.
items.ex_en: The radar gun clocked his fastball at ninety-eight miles per hour yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 测速枪昨天测出他的快速球时速达到了九十八英里。

items.def_zh: 用仪表计量（流速、用量等）
items.def_en: to measure the rate or total amount of a substance passing through a meter
items.ex_en: The municipal authority precisely metered natural gas consumption across commercial properties.
items.ex_zh: 市政管理局用仪表精确计量了各个商业物业的天然气消耗量。

items.def_zh: 标出……的尺寸；按规定尺寸制作
items.def_en: To measure or mark the dimensions of an object or design.
items.ex_en: Engineers dimensioned the structural blueprints to ensure seamless integration of prefabricated panels.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们在结构图纸上标明了具体尺寸，以确保预制板构件的完美契合。

items.def_zh: 判定，评估，判断；精确测量
items.def_en: 1. To judge, estimate, or assess a situation, feeling, or measurement. 2. To measure the exact size, capacity, or amount of something.
items.ex_en: She watched his expression closely to gauge his true reaction to the proposal.
items.ex_zh: 她仔细观察着他的神色，以研判他对该提案的真实反应。

items.def_en: to express or measure the exact quantity, amount, or proportion of something
items.ex_en: Scientists struggled to quantify the long-term ecological damage caused by the chemical spill.
items.ex_zh: 科学家们难以量化这次化学品泄漏造成的长期生态损害。

items.def_zh: 定量测算分配；精确计量分发
items.def_en: (+ sth) to measure and dispense exact precise amounts of sth according to a meter or standard
items.ex_en: The computerized dispensing pump metered out precise micro-doses of the experimental catalyst.
items.ex_zh: 电脑分配泵精确计量并分发了实验催化剂的微量剂量。

items.def_en: to mark units of measurement on an instrument or adjust it to standard precision
items.ex_en: The horologist carefully calibrated the pendulum to mirror the celestial cadence of stars.
items.ex_zh: 钟表匠精心校准摆锤，使其与群星的天体韵律分秒契合。

items.def_en: (chemistry) To determine the concentration of a substance in solution by adding a measured amount of a reagent.
items.ex_en: The alchemist titrated the luminous reagent dropwise until the tincture achieved perfection.
items.ex_zh: 炼金师逐滴滴定那种发光的试剂，直至药剂臻于完美。

groups.summary_en: Determining an exact physical magnitude, speed, chemical concentration, or spatial boundary using an instrument, standard scale, or timed procedure. Registers range from workshop quantification to precise lab analysis.
groups.summary_zh: 借助仪器或标准规范对物理量、速率或指标测算
groups.desc_en: Involves applying standard calibrated instruments, temporal benchmarks, or numerical criteria to assess exact physical dimensions or rates, contrasting with rough estimating or subjective rating.
groups.desc_zh: 指运用标准标定仪器、时间基准或量化尺度精确测定物理维度或速率，区别于粗略估计或主观评级。
groups.nuance_en: gauge: measuring physical magnitude or diagnosing capacity (pressure / depth / public mood) · clock: instrumentally recording speed or elapsed duration (runner / laps / vehicle) · meter: precisely regulating and registering volumetric flow (consumption / electricity / flow) · quantify: converting observational phenomena into discrete numerical data (losses / benefits / risk) · dimension: taking or cutting to exact spatial specifications (lumber / stone)
groups.nuance_zh: gauge: 仪器测定物理量度或探测容量 (pressure / depth / public mood) · clock: 仪器测录瞬时速度或耗时 (runner / laps / vehicle) · meter: 精准计量并控量供输 (consumption / electricity / flow) · quantify: 将现象转化为量化数字指标 (losses / benefits / risk) · dimension: 测定或依规加工精确空间尺寸 (lumber / stone)

groups.name: Melt & Dissolve · 融化与溶解 (Melt, Dissolve, Flux)
groups.tip: 受热熔化或在溶剂中消融分散

items.def_en: (+ sth) to become warm enough to melt ice or return from a frozen state to liquid/soft state
items.ex_en: Leave the frozen salmon on the counter so it can thaw out before dinner.
items.ex_zh: 把冷冻三文鱼放在台面上，这样晚餐前就能化开了。
items.ex2_en: The warm kitchen air quickly thawed out the frozen steaks on the counter.
items.ex2_zh: 厨房里温暖的空气迅速化冻了案板上的冷冻牛排。

items.def_en: [I/T] To pass from a frozen to a liquid or unfrozen state by warming
items.ex_en: The thick ice along the river began to thaw under the morning sun.
items.ex_zh: 河岸边厚厚的冰层在晨曦照耀下开始融化。
items.ex2_en: The chef carefully thawed the frozen poultry in the refrigerator overnight.
items.ex2_zh: 厨师在冰箱里放了一夜，小心地化冻了冷冻家禽。

items.def_en: to dissolve or liquefy gradually until entirely gone
items.ex_en: The morning frost melted away as warm sunshine spread across the garden path.
items.ex_zh: 随着温暖的阳光洒向花园小径，晨霜逐渐消融殆尽。

items.def_en: 1. To change or cause to change from a solid to a liquid state by heating. 2. To become softer or more gentle; soften.
items.ex_en: The butter melted rapidly in the hot skillet, spreading a rich savory aroma.
items.ex_zh: 黄油在热平底锅中迅速融化，散发出浓郁诱人的香气。
items.ex2_en: The chef melted the dark chocolate carefully over a bowl of boiling water.
items.ex2_zh: 厨师在一碗热水上小心翼翼地融化了黑巧克力。

items.def_en: 1. To cause a solid to be incorporated into a liquid so as to form a solution, or to become incorporated in this way. 2. To officially end an organization, assembly, or legal arrangement.
items.ex_en: Stir the mixture gently until the sugar crystals completely dissolve in hot tea.
items.ex_zh: 轻轻搅拌混合物，直到糖晶完全溶解在热茶中。
items.ex2_en: Hot boiling water will dissolve the dense salt crystals within a few seconds.
items.ex2_zh: 沸腾的热水会在几秒钟内溶解密集的盐结晶。

items.def_en: (technical) To melt or become fluid, or to treat metal with a flux to promote melting.
items.ex_en: Intense thermal currents fluxed the raw ore into incandescent rivers of glowing slag.
items.ex_zh: 强烈的热流使未经提炼的矿石融化成炽热流淌的熔渣之河。
items.ex2_en: The dense metallic scrap fluxed quickly within the blazing blast furnace.
items.ex2_zh: 致密的废金属在熊熊燃烧的高炉内迅速熔化。

items.def_en: To absorb moisture from the air and dissolve completely into liquid
items.ex_en: Exposed crystals deliquesced under the nocturnal dampness, fading into clear glassy pools.
items.ex_zh: 裸露的晶体在夜色湿气中潮解，化为了清澈明净的浅池。

items.def_en: (archaic) Past participle of melt; to have liquefied or melted by intense heat.
items.ex_en: The fiery mountain unleashed molten stone upon the slumbering valley in dreadful splendor.
items.ex_zh: 烈火巨峰将熔化的岩石倾泻于沉睡的山谷，景象骇人而壮丽。
items.ex2_en: The thick scrap metal moltened slowly in the intense forge furnace.
items.ex2_zh: 厚重的废金属在炽热的锻炉中缓缓融化成液态。

items.def_zh: 融化；将（金属或固体）熔毁
items.def_en: (+ sth) to melt an object made of metal or solid substance completely into liquid form
items.ex_en: Thieves melted down the stolen antique silver chalice into unrecognizable bullion blocks.
items.ex_zh: 盗贼将盗来的古董银酒杯熔毁，铸成了面目全非的银条。
items.ex2_en: The huge candle melted down completely after burning uninterrupted for several hours.
items.ex2_zh: 那根巨大的蜡烛在不间断燃烧了几个小时后彻底熔尽了。

items.def_en: [I/T] To melt together with intense heat so as to join into a single body
items.ex_en: Extreme heat caused the adjacent metallic conduits to fuse into an inseparable alloy.
items.ex_zh: 极端的高温使得相邻的金属导管熔合成了不可分割的合金。
items.ex2_en: Specialized laser welders fuse delicate circuit components into a unified microscopic board.
items.ex2_zh: 专用激光焊接机将精密的电路元件熔接成统一的微型电路板。

items.def_en: [I/T] To convert into liquid form, especially solids or gases under heat/pressure
items.ex_en: Compressor systems liquefy atmospheric nitrogen under ultra-high pressure for cryogenic storage.
items.ex_zh: 压缩机系统在超高压下使大气中的氮气液化，以便于低温贮存。
items.ex2_en: Solid helium liquefies only under extremely low temperatures and high atmospheric pressure.
items.ex2_zh: 固态氦只有在极低温度和高气压下才会液化。

groups.summary_en: Solids break down their structure through thermal heat, chemical solvent action, or fusing agents, passing into a liquid state or homogeneous solution.
groups.summary_zh: 固体受热液化或在溶剂/助熔剂作用下解构分解成液体。
groups.desc_en: Denotes thermal phase transition, dissolution, or structural softening into a liquid state, contrasting with mechanical pulverization or chemical burning.
groups.desc_zh: 指受热相变、溶剂溶解或软化液化成流态，区别于机械粉碎或化学燃烧。
groups.nuance_en: melt: thermal phase transition from solid to liquid (ice / cheese / metal) · thaw: thermal recovery of frozen matter to natural soft/liquid state (meat / snow / ground) · dissolve: solid disintegrating completely into liquid solute (sugar / tablet / salt) · deliquesce: solid liquefying gradually by absorbing ambient atmospheric moisture (salts / fungi) · flux: applying chemical heat to liquefy and fuse minerals (ore / metals)
groups.nuance_zh: melt: 固体受热相变液化 (ice / cheese / metal) · thaw: 冻结物升温解冻复原 (meat / snow / ground) · dissolve: 溶质在溶剂中离解互溶 (sugar / tablet / salt) · deliquesce: 吸收空气潮气而自溶潮解 (salts / fungi) · flux: 加热或加助熔剂熔化提纯 (ore / metals)

groups.name: Moisten & Soak · 浸润与浸泡 (Moisten, Soak, Saturate)
groups.tip: 液体彻底浸透渗透

items.def_en: to make something slightly wet or moist
items.ex_en: She dampened a clean sponge with lukewarm water before gently wiping the baby.
items.ex_zh: 她用温水弄湿了干净的海绵，然后轻轻擦拭婴儿。

items.def_en: 1. To apply a cream or liquid to skin or hair to make it soft and prevent dryness.
items.ex_en: Apply this nourishing cream every evening to moisturize dry winter skin effectively.
items.ex_zh: 每晚涂抹这种滋养霜，能有效滋润冬季干燥的皮肤。
items.ex2_en: Dry human skin moisturizes quickly after applying specialized botanical lotion.
items.ex2_zh: 涂抹了专门的植物乳液后，干燥的人体皮肤很快变得水润。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to take in and absorb liquid greedily or completely
items.ex_en: We stood silently at the summit, drinking in the magnificent view.
items.ex_zh: 我们静静地站在山顶上，尽情饱览那壮丽的景色。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to absorb a liquid thoroughly into a material or porous surface
items.ex_en: He grabbed a dry kitchen towel to soak up the spilled olive oil.
items.ex_zh: 他拿了一条干燥的厨房毛巾去吸干洒出来的橄榄油。

items.def_zh: 吸干；用海绵等吸取（液体）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to take up or absorb liquid completely with an absorbent substance
items.ex_en: We used thick crusts of bread to sop up the leftover pasta sauce.
items.ex_zh: 我们用厚厚的面包皮把盘子里剩下的意面酱汁蘸吸得干干净净。

items.def_zh: 浸泡，沏（茶）；使沉浸于，使深谙（be steeped in）
items.def_en: 1. (+ in) To soak food, tea, or herbs in liquid to soften them or extract flavor. 2. ('be steeped in') To fill someone or something completely with a quality or tradition.
items.ex_en: Steep the chamomile blossoms in boiling water for five minutes before drinking.
items.ex_zh: 饮用前将洋甘菊放入沸水中浸泡五分钟。
items.ex2_en: The loose herbal tea steeped in hot water, releasing a fragrant soothing aroma.
items.ex2_zh: 散装花草茶在热水中浸泡，散发出芳香宜人的气息。

items.def_en: 1. (+ in) To put something into liquid until it is completely wet, or to become thoroughly wet. 2. ('soak up') To absorb liquid completely.
items.ex_en: Remember to soak the dried beans overnight so they cook much faster tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 记得把干豆子浸泡一整夜，这样明天煮起来就会快得多。
items.ex2_en: Thick cotton towels soak quickly when plunged into a tub of warm water.
items.ex2_zh: 厚棉毛巾浸入一桶温水中时很快吸饱了水。

items.def_en: 1. (+ in/with) To make someone or something completely wet.
items.ex_en: A passing truck drove through a muddy puddle and drenched my fresh clothes.
items.ex_zh: 一辆驶过的卡车碾过泥水坑，把我刚换的衣服溅得湿透。

items.def_en: (+ with) to thoroughly permeate or saturate with moisture, dye, or a quality
items.ex_en: Evening vapors imbued the velvet tapestry with the cold dew of midnight.
items.ex_zh: 薄暮的水汽浸透了丝绒织锦，染上一层午夜清冷的露水。

items.def_zh: 使浸透，浸湿；使饱和，使充满
items.def_en: 1. (+ with/in) To make something completely wet; to soak thoroughly. 2. To fill a place or market completely so that no more can be added.
items.ex_en: Heavy seasonal downpours saturated the topsoil, severely hampering foundation excavation works.
items.ex_zh: 强烈的季节性暴雨浸透了表层土壤，严重阻碍了地基开挖工程。

items.def_en: to saturate or fill something completely with water so that it becomes heavy or unmanageable
items.ex_en: Continuous torrential rains waterlogged the farmland, choking the crops beneath standing muddy water.
items.ex_zh: 连绵的暴雨使农田彻底积水过饱和，令作物窒息在漫溢的泥水之下。

groups.summary_en: This frame describes the progressive penetration and absorption of liquid into a solid substrate, scaling in intensity from slight hydration to maximum waterlogging.
groups.summary_zh: 液体渗入固体的程度递增，从轻微湿润逐步达到完全饱和透湿。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the progressive transfer and retention of liquid into porous surfaces or fibrous matter, differentiated by saturation depth from surface wetting to complete waterlogging.
groups.desc_zh: 指液体逐步渗入并滞留在多孔表面或纤维内部，依据浸润深度区分表面微湿与彻底湿透。
groups.nuance_en: dampen: applying light surface moisture to reduce dryness (cloth / hair) · moisturize: infusing skin or tissue with protective hydration (skin / cream) · steep: long static immersion in liquid to extract essence or soften (tea / herbs / grains) · soak: prolonged thorough immersion penetrating the core (beans / laundry / rain) · drench: sudden overwhelming liquid deluge leaving dripping wet (rain / downpour / sweat)
groups.nuance_zh: dampen: 表面轻微浸润以去燥 (cloth / hair) · moisturize: 为皮脂角质层注入锁水滋润 (skin / cream) · steep: 静态浸泡以析出药效或滋味 (tea / herbs / grains) · soak: 长时间深度浸润透心 (beans / laundry / rain) · drench: 倾盆暴淋导致水淋淋 (rain / downpour / sweat)

groups.name: Pack & Crate for Freight · 打包捆扎与装箱 (Bale, Crate, Bundle)
groups.tip: 装入船舱箱盒打包

items.def_en: (often + up) to put items into cardboard or wooden boxes for transport
items.ex_en: Volunteers helped box the emergency canned goods for delivery to flooded areas.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者们帮忙把应急罐头食品装箱，以便运往受灾地区。

items.def_en: to put commodities or manufactured goods into protective containers or wrappings
items.ex_en: The warehouse crew packaged the fragile ceramic dishware using layers of bubble wrap.
items.ex_zh: 仓库人员用多层气泡膜将易碎的陶瓷餐具打包封装好。

items.def_zh: 在托盘上堆放固定；码盘包装
items.def_en: to place and secure packaged freight items onto a pallet for shipping
items.ex_en: Warehouse automation systems efficiently palletize corrugated containers for containerized sea shipment.
items.ex_zh: 仓库自动化系统高效地将瓦楞纸箱码上托盘打捆，以便海运集装箱运输。

items.def_zh: 把（货物或物品）收拾打包装箱
items.def_en: (+ sth) to put items into containers, boxes, or parcels in preparation for moving or shipping
items.ex_en: It's five o'clock—let's pack up and go home.
items.ex_zh: 已经五点了——咱们收拾收拾回家吧。

items.def_zh: 装箱，把……装入盒/箱中以便运输
items.def_en: (+ sth) to place goods or possessions into cardboard boxes or crates for storage or transport
items.ex_en: Before moving out, we spent three days boxing up all our books and clothes.
items.ex_zh: 搬家前，我们花了三天时间把所有的书和衣服打包入箱。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to tie or wrap several items securely together into a compact package
items.ex_en: She bundled up the old newspapers with sturdy twine before recycling day.
items.ex_zh: 在回收日之前，她用结实的粗麻绳把旧报纸扎成了一捆。
items.ex2_en: The schoolchildren bundled up warmly in thick coats against the freezing snowstorm.
items.ex2_zh: 小学生们穿上厚外套把自己裹得严严实实，以抵御严寒暴风雪。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to pack items into large wooden crates specifically for shipping or freight
items.ex_en: Movers will crate up the priceless marble sculpture before shipping it overseas.
items.ex_zh: 搬运工将在把无价的大理石雕塑运往海外前将其装入板条箱。

items.def_en: (+ up) to tie, bind, or pack a group of items together into a single unit
items.ex_en: Workers bundle the freshly cut timber tightly using industrial steel banding straps.
items.ex_zh: 工人们用工业级钢带把新伐的木材紧紧捆扎成捆。

items.def_en: To press and tie material (such as hay, cotton, or paper) tightly into large bales or bundles.
items.ex_en: Farmhands baled alfalfa in the golden afternoon fields before the seasonal storms.
items.ex_zh: 农工们赶在季节性暴风雨来临前，在洒满夕阳的田野里将苜蓿打包成捆。

items.def_en: To pack goods or equipment into a crate or crates for transport or storage.
items.ex_en: Technicians crated the delicate optical instruments into padded wooden boxes for export.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员将精密的仪器装入加衬垫的木板条箱中以备出口。

items.def_en: (dated or literary) To load cargo onto a ship or other vessel.
items.ex_en: Stevedores laded the wooden galleon with fragrant spices from distant eastern archipelagoes.
items.ex_zh: 码头搬运工将来自遥远东方群岛的香料装上木质大帆船。

groups.summary_en: Workers bundle, compress, or encase goods into boxes, crates, bales, or secure packaging units specifically to prepare them for physical transport, distribution, or shipping.
groups.summary_zh: 将物品打包、压缩捆扎或装入板条箱以供长途物流运输。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the systematic securing, enclosing, or strapping of physical items into standardized containers or units for shipping, contrasting with casual storing or untidy piling.
groups.desc_zh: 指为长途货运而进行的规整入箱、打捆或栈板托盘化装载，区别于随手储藏或散乱堆放。
groups.nuance_en: box: packing goods into cardboard or corrugated cartons (merchandise / shoes) · crate: securing heavy or fragile freight in rigid wooden framing (machinery / statues / art) · palletize: securing modular goods atop wooden skids for forklift handling (freight / boxes / cargo) · bundle: strapping multiple loose units into a single cohesive parcel (newspapers / firewood / rods) · package: sealing commodities into commercial transit-ready wrappers (shipment / goods)
groups.nuance_zh: box: 装入纸板箱或瓦楞纸盒 (merchandise / shoes) · crate: 用坚固木框架钉装重物或易碎品 (machinery / statues / art) · palletize: 装卸打托上栈板以便叉运 (freight / boxes / cargo) · bundle: 捆扎零散长条物为一束 (newspapers / firewood / rods) · package: 封装包裹为商业配送单元 (shipment / goods)

groups.name: Paddle, Row & Watercraft Navigation · 驾舟与水上划行
groups.tip: 水上驾船、航行、划艇或漂行

items.def_en: propel a small boat through water by pulling on oars attached to rowlocks
items.ex_en: They decided to row their small wooden dinghy across the tranquil lake.
items.ex_zh: 他们决定划着小木艇横穿宁静的湖面。

items.def_zh: （乘冲浪板或小舟）划向深水/外海
items.def_en: to move across the surface of the water using your arms or a paddle, especially away from the shore towards waves or open water
items.ex_en: Surfers paddle out past breaking waves every dawn to catch high swells.
items.ex_zh: 冲浪者每天黎明时分都会划水穿过碎浪区，去迎击更高的海浪。

items.def_en: to push against the bank or shore with an oar, paddle, or foot in order to move a boat out into the water
items.ex_en: The guide used his wooden oar to push off from the bank.
items.ex_zh: 向导用他的木桨顶住岸边，推离岸堤启航。

items.def_en: to move away from the shore, a dock, or another vessel by rowing or paddling
items.ex_en: The four rowers pulled away from the stone jetty with synchronized strokes.
items.ex_zh: 四名桨手动作划一地摇桨，划船离开了石码头。

items.def_en: ride the face of a forward-moving ocean wave while standing or lying on a board
items.ex_en: Enthusiastic tourists gathered along coastal breakers to surf the magnificent ocean swells.
items.ex_zh: 热情的游客聚集在海岸碎浪前，迎着壮丽的海浪冲浪。

items.def_en: move a canoe, kayak, or small board through water using a handheld paddle
items.ex_en: We rented small kayaks and began to paddle across the calm bay.
items.ex_zh: 我们租了小皮艇，开始划桨横穿平静的海湾。

items.def_en: travel in or navigate a lightweight canoe across rivers or lakes
items.ex_en: The siblings planned to canoe down the winding river during summer vacation.
items.ex_zh: 这对兄妹计划在暑假期间划独木舟顺着蜿蜒的河流而下。

items.def_en: travel across water or run rapids in a kayak using a double-bladed paddle
items.ex_en: Adventurers love to kayak through turbulent whitewater canyons during early spring runoff.
items.ex_zh: 冒险家们喜欢在早春融水期划着皮划艇穿越湍急的峡谷白浪。

items.def_zh: 乘摩托艇航行；驾驶汽艇
items.def_en: To travel or cruise on water in a boat powered by a motor.
items.ex_en: Wealthy vacationers often motorboat between secluded coves along the rocky Mediterranean coast.
items.ex_zh: 富有的度假者经常驾驶汽艇穿梭在地中海岩岸偏僻隐秘的海湾之间。

items.def_en: To propel a boat across water using a pair of oars or a single oar over the stern.
items.ex_en: The lone athlete loved to scull in his sleek racing shell at dawn.
items.ex_zh: 这位形单影只的运动员喜欢在拂晓时分划着轻巧的双桨赛艇训练。

items.def_en: To ride across water standing on a board fitted with a sail.
items.ex_en: Athletic tourists windsurf across the breezy lagoon under the brilliant tropical sunshine.
items.ex_zh: 身手健美的游客在热带灿烂的阳光下，玩着风帆冲浪穿行于微风吹拂的泻湖。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate steering, propelling, and handling small watercraft, personal boats, or boards across water using manual paddles, oars, small outboard motors, or physical balance.
groups.summary_zh: 操控划艇、摩托艇或滑水板等小型船只及水上器材划行与疾驰。
groups.desc_en: Denotes manual or personal propulsion of small watercraft through water surfaces using paddles, oars, or wave mechanics, contrasting with motorized cruising or wind-driven sailing.
groups.desc_zh: 指利用船桨、划水器具或水波动力驱动小型水上舟艇行进，区别于风帆航行或轮机巡航。
groups.nuance_en: row: using fixed oars levered against rowlocks in back-facing strokes (boat / galley / oars) · paddle: using unattached handheld blades in forward-facing strokes (canoe / kayak / board) · canoe: navigating inland waters via an open single-bladed craft (river / lake / rapids) · kayak: maneuvering a low-decked craft using a double-bladed paddle (fjords / coastal waters / surf) · push off: shoving a watercraft away from shore or dock into open water (boat / bank / pier)
groups.nuance_zh: row: 背向借用桨架杠杆摇橹划桨 (boat / galley / oars) · paddle: 面向前方手持自由叶桨点水前移 (canoe / kayak / board) · canoe: 驾敞篷独木舟划行内陆湖泊 (river / lake / rapids) · kayak: 操双头叶桨驾驭狭长皮划艇 (fjords / coastal waters / surf) · push off: 撑离堤岸入水平稳起航 (boat / bank / pier)

groups.name: Pant & Gasp · 急喘与呼吸作声 (Wheeze, Gasp, Choke)
groups.tip: 气喘吁吁急促喘气或打鼾

items.def_en: to breathe in short, quick gusts after physical exertion
items.ex_en: The runner could only puff in exhaustion after sprinting up the steep hill.
items.ex_zh: 冲上陡峭的山坡后，那名跑步者累得只能呼哧呼哧喘气。

items.def_en: 1. To breathe noisily through your nose and mouth while asleep.
items.ex_en: My grandfather began to snore loudly as soon as his head touched pillows.
items.ex_zh: 我祖父的头刚一沾上枕头，就立刻大声打起呼噜来。

items.def_zh: （因气愤或劳累）大声呼哧，吹气；恼怒，生气
items.def_en: 1. To blow or breathe out air noisily, especially to express annoyance or from heavy exertion.
items.ex_en: She sat down on the chair with an irritated huff after the meeting.
items.ex_zh: 散会后，她带着一脸恼火的粗重呼哧声坐在了椅子上。

items.def_en: 1. To make a sudden, sharp, involuntary sound in the throat caused by spasms of the diaphragm.
items.ex_en: Drink a glass of cold water quickly whenever you begin to hiccup.
items.ex_zh: 每当你开始打嗝时，就赶快喝下一整杯凉水。

items.def_en: to have difficulty breathing or speaking normally because of throat tightness, smoke, or intense emotion
items.ex_en: Thick acrid smoke from the fireplace made the firefighters choke up coughing.
items.ex_zh: 壁炉里飘出的浓烈刺鼻烟雾呛得消防员喉咙发紧、连声咳嗽。

items.def_en: to breathe rapidly, loudly, and heavily over a period of continuous physical exertion
items.ex_en: He puffed away heavily on the treadmill during the final cardiovascular test.
items.ex_zh: 在最后的心肺功能测试中，他在跑步机上呼哧呼哧地大喘着粗气。

items.def_zh: 喘气，气喘吁吁；渴望，渴求
items.def_en: 1. To breathe quickly and loudly with your mouth open, as after strenuous exercise. 2. (+ for/after) To long for or desire intensely.
items.ex_en: The exhausted retriever collapsed under the oak tree, panting with its tongue out.
items.ex_zh: 那只精疲力竭的寻回犬瘫倒在橡树下，吐着舌头气喘吁吁。

items.def_en: to inhale suddenly and sharply through the mouth from surprise, pain, or breathlessness
items.ex_en: Spectators let out a collective gasp when the acrobatic performer slipped midair.
items.ex_zh: 当杂技演员在半空中滑脱时，观众们不约而同地倒吸了一口凉气。

items.def_en: to breathe with a rough whistling or rattling sound due to obstructed airways
items.ex_en: Dusty air in the basement caused the elderly asthmatic gentleman to wheeze continuously.
items.ex_zh: 地下室布满尘土的空气使得那位患有哮喘的老先生不停地带哮鸣音喘息。

items.def_zh: 喘着粗气挣扎着吸入（空气）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to struggle violently to breathe in air, especially due to exhaustion, shock, or lack of oxygen
items.ex_en: The surfaced diver removed his damaged mask and gasped for fresh air.
items.ex_zh: 潜水员浮出水面后摘下了破损的面罩，拼命挣扎着呼吸新鲜空气。

items.def_zh: 过度换气，呼吸急促异常
items.def_en: 1. To breathe at an abnormally rapid and deep rate, typically caused by panic or anxiety.
items.ex_en: During the panic attack, the patient began to hyperventilate uncontrollably in the emergency room.
items.ex_zh: 恐慌发作期间，该病患在急诊室里不由自主地开始过度换气。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote involuntary or labored respiratory acts where air intake produces distinct acoustic qualities, irregular rhythms, or signs of oxygen distress.
groups.summary_zh: 由于疲惫、缺氧、惊吓或病理反应导致的急促、费力或发出杂音的呼吸生理动作。
groups.desc_en: Denotes audible, distressed, or spasmodic respiratory mechanics triggered by exertion, airway restriction, or shock, contrasting with quiet rhythmic breathing.
groups.desc_zh: 指因剧烈耗力、气道受阻或生理惊厥引发的作响、吃力或痉挛性呼吸，区别于常态平稳呼吸。
groups.nuance_en: pant: rapid, shallow open-mouthed breathing after physical exertion (dog / runner / breath) · gasp: sudden, sharp intake of air provoked by shock or air hunger (air / surprise / horror) · puff: forceful short exhalations while straining or smoking (runner / steam / cigar) · huff: heavy, disgruntled exhalation signaling physical fatigue or annoyance (breath / indignantly) · choke up: constriction of the throat caused by particulate matter or emotion (sobs / dust / tears)
groups.nuance_zh: pant: 耗力后张口急促微喘 (dog / runner / breath) · gasp: 震惊或窒息时倒抽冷气 (air / surprise / horror) · puff: 气短吃力或吞云吐雾时噗哧呼气 (runner / steam / cigar) · huff: 疲乏或气恼时重浊呼气 (breath / indignantly) · choke up: 颗粒呛咳或情绪哽咽闭喉 (sobs / dust / tears)

groups.name: Pierce & Thrust · 戳刺与贯穿 (Pierce, Jab, Gore)
groups.tip: 利器或尖角刺穿皮肉机体

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ at/with) to poke someone or something with a finger or a pointed object
items.ex_en: The curious boy used a twig to prod gently at the sleeping hedgehog.
items.ex_zh: 那个好奇的男孩用细树枝轻轻地戳了戳正在睡觉的刺猬。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to pierce through a surface so that a sharp tip emerges on the other side
items.ex_en: A sharp metal nail poked through the thick sole of his leather workboot.
items.ex_zh: 一枚锋利的铁钉戳透了他皮质工装靴厚厚的鞋底。
items.ex2_en: He accidentally poked a sharp needle through the thick layer of leather.
items.ex2_zh: 他不小心用一根尖锐的针戳穿了厚厚的皮革层。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ at/into) to quickly push a finger, stick, or other object into someone or something
items.ex_en: Don't poke your fingers into that delicate electrical outlet while cleaning the wall.
items.ex_zh: 清理墙壁时，千万不要把手指戳进那个脆弱的电源插座里。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to make sudden, aggressive, sharp thrusting motions at a target with a pointed weapon or object
items.ex_en: The nervous camper jabbed at the approaching snake with a heavy walking stick.
items.ex_zh: 那个紧张的露营者用沉重的手杖朝逼近的毒蛇猛戳过去。

items.def_en: (+ sth/sb) to push a sharp, pointed object deeply into someone or something
items.ex_en: The gardener accidentally stuck a rusted trowel deeply into his own left thumb.
items.ex_zh: 园丁一不小心将生锈的铁铲深深扎进了自己的左手大拇指。

items.def_en: 1. To push something sharp or pointed into or towards someone or something with a quick, hard movement. 2. (boxing) To hit someone with a short, quick punch.
items.ex_en: He quickly jabbed the sharp pencil into the cardboard box to make air holes.
items.ex_zh: 他迅速用尖铅笔捅进纸箱，扎出几个气孔。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ with/into) to pierce or wound someone or something deeply with a short pointed weapon such as a knife
items.ex_en: The robber tried to stab the shopkeeper with a hunting knife during the struggle.
items.ex_zh: 在搏斗中，强盗试图用一把猎刀刺伤店主。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ through/with) to force a sharp pointed instrument into or through something
items.ex_en: The thick needle pierced through several layers of tough leather with great difficulty.
items.ex_zh: 粗针费了很大力气才穿透几层厚硬的皮革。

items.def_zh: （动物用角或獠牙）顶伤，戳伤，刺穿
items.def_en: (of an animal with horns or tusks) To pierce or wound someone or something with its horns or tusks.
items.ex_en: The enraged bull turned violently and gored the careless matador in the thigh.
items.ex_zh: 被激怒的公牛猛然转身，用角顶伤了粗心斗牛士的大腿。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to push a sharp point completely through someone's or something's body
items.ex_en: The unfortunate climber fell and was impaled upon a sharp metal railing below.
items.ex_zh: 这名不幸的攀登者坠落下来，被下方尖锐的金属栏杆刺穿了身体。

items.def_en: to pierce completely through someone or something with a pointed weapon, pinning them in place
items.ex_en: The warrior's heavy spear transfixed the beast, pinning it firmly to the oak tree.
items.ex_zh: 勇士沉重的长矛刺穿了野兽，将它死死钉在橡树上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe striking or penetrating a target with a sharp or pointed object or horn. They range from quick, shallow prods with fists or blunted weapons (jab) to deep, tearing bodily puncture typically inflicted by horns or tusks (gore).
groups.summary_zh: 以尖锐物或犄角快速戳刺或深层贯穿肉体。
groups.desc_en: Denotes dynamic ballistic penetration or thrusting of pointed or sharp objects into/through a resistant barrier, contrasting with broad crushing, blunt bludgeoning, or surface slicing.
groups.desc_zh: 指使用尖锐物体施加轴向动能穿透或扎击抗力表面，区别于钝力横向劈砍、重压或切削。
groups.nuance_en: poke: light prodding thrust with finger or dull point to test or probe (fire / ribs / hole) · prod: sharp or irritating poke to urge action or inspect (cattle / stick / conscience) · jab: quick, straight, stinging punch or thrust (needle / ribs / jaw) · stab: intentional forceful thrust with a pointed blade aimed at wounding (dagger / heart / back) · pierce: clean perforating puncture penetrating through a surface or organ (ears / armor / darkness)
groups.nuance_zh: poke: 用手指或钝端试探性轻戳 (fire / ribs / hole) · prod: 用尖头戳弄以刺激催促或探查 (cattle / stick / conscience) · jab: 迅疾凌厉地短促刺扎 (needle / ribs / jaw) · stab: 握持锋利刀刃蓄力致命捅刺 (dagger / heart / back) · pierce: 尖刃直接贯穿坚硬障壁或耳膜 (ears / armor / darkness)

groups.name: Piercing Cries & Alarms · 尖叫与高声呼喊 (Shriek, Squeal, Yelping)
groups.tip: 情绪激动时失声叫喊或惊呼呼救

items.def_zh: 尖声说话；突然插嘴高叫
items.def_en: to suddenly speak or utter a shrill, high-pitched remark, especially after being quiet
items.ex_en: After staying silent for hours, the youngest boy piped up with a clever solution.
items.ex_zh: 沉默了几个小时后，最小的男孩突然尖声插嘴提出了一个巧妙的解决办法。

items.def_en: to make a sudden, loud, high-pitched vocal sound in pain, surprise, or fear
items.ex_en: She cried out in sheer agony when the boiling tea spilled on her hand.
items.ex_zh: 当滚烫的茶水泼在手上时，她因剧痛而失声痛呼。

items.def_zh: （刺耳的呼叫、警报等）骤然响起
items.def_en: to sound loudly and clearly through an area, typically describing a sudden sharp cry, alarm, or shot
items.ex_en: A sudden shrill scream rang out across the quiet street, startling the pedestrians.
items.ex_zh: 一声突如其来的尖叫在寂静的街道上骤然响起，吓坏了行人。

items.def_zh: （因痛苦、受惊或兴奋而）尖叫，短促尖吠；尖声大喊
items.def_en: To give a sudden, short, high-pitched cry or bark, usually because of pain, fear, or excitement.
items.ex_en: The puppy gave a sharp yelp of fright when the thunder shook the house.
items.ex_zh: 雷声震动屋子时，小狗吓得发出了一声短促的尖叫。

items.def_zh: （嘲弄或抗议地）大喊，高呼；鸣笛，按喇叭；（猫头鹰）鸣叫
items.def_en: 1. To shout or laugh loudly, especially to show disapproval, amusement, or scorn. 2. To make a loud, deep sound (like a car horn or an owl).
items.ex_en: The hostile audience began to hoot in loud scorn at the politician's bizarre excuse.
items.ex_zh: 充满敌意的观众开始大声起哄嘲弄，讥讽这位政客离奇的借口。

items.def_en: to cry out or scream loudly, harshly, and continuously (often said of infants)
items.ex_en: The sick infant continued to squall piteously throughout the dark and stormy night.
items.ex_zh: 在漆黑的风雨之夜，生病的婴儿整夜发出凄厉的啼叫。

items.def_en: to utter a loud, harsh, piercing, high-pitched scream
items.ex_en: The frightened girl screeched loudly when she saw a large rat in the hallway.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的女孩看见走廊里有一只大老鼠，吓得发出一声刺耳的尖叫。

items.def_zh: 尖叫，尖声喊叫；尖声说出
items.def_en: To give a loud, high-pitched cry or scream, especially from fear, pain, or excitement.
items.ex_en: The terrified children shrieked at the top of their lungs during the lightning storm.
items.ex_zh: 在雷暴天气中，受惊的孩子们扯着嗓子放声尖叫。

items.def_zh: 发出长而尖的叫声，高声尖叫；（向警方）告密，告发
items.def_en: 1. To make a long, high-pitched cry or sound. 2. (informal) To inform the police about an accomplice.
items.ex_en: The young thief threatened to squeal to the police if he was left behind.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的贼威胁说，如果把他扔下，他就向警方告发同伙。

items.def_zh: 大声呼喊，喧嚷；吵闹着要求
items.def_en: To shout loudly, make a persistent din, or make a loud and noisy demand as a group.
items.ex_en: Angry crowds began to clamor outside the palace gates, fiercely demanding cheaper grain.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的民众聚集在王宫门外大声喧嚷，激烈要求降低粮价。

items.def_zh: 发出尖声哀嚎，尖叫吵闹
items.def_en: to make a shrill, discordant, or wailing cry like a rutting cat
items.ex_en: A pack of stray cats began to caterwaul loudly beneath our bedroom window.
items.ex_zh: 一群流浪猫开始在我们卧室窗下发出刺耳凄厉的哀嚎。

groups.summary_en: Verbs specifying acoustic properties—high pitch, sharpness, suddenness, or shrill resonance—of human or animal alarm cries and shouts.
groups.summary_zh: 因恐惧、疼痛、惊叫或喧闹而发出的尖锐、高亢或刺耳的呼喊叫声。
groups.desc_en: Denotes acute vocalizations or mechanical noises characterized by high pitch, sudden amplitude, and panic/distress, contrasting with low rumbles or articulate speech.
groups.desc_zh: 指发出的高频、刺耳且突发性的呼叫或机械噪音，往往蕴含恐惧、剧痛或警报，区别于低频咕哝或清晰吐字。
groups.nuance_en: shriek: piercing, high-pitched vocal outburst of terror or hysterical agony (victim / wind / laughter) · screech: harsh, grating high-frequency friction or cry (tires / brakes / owl) · yelp: brief, shrill cry of sudden acute physical pain (puppy / pain / dog) · squall: loud, abrasive wailing of infants or stormy winds (baby / brat / gales) · ring out: loud resonant sound carrying distinctively through an area (shot / alarm / applause)
groups.nuance_zh: shriek: 惊恐或歇斯底里时的尖厉哀号 (victim / wind / laughter) · screech: 刺耳摩擦声或金属撕扯尖啸 (tires / brakes / owl) · yelp: 骤遇急痛时的短促哀吠 (puppy / pain / dog) · squall: 婴儿刺耳号哭或疾风呼号 (baby / brat / gales) · ring out: 清脆响亮、在空间中传荡 (shot / alarm / applause)

groups.name: Pilfer & Purloin · 偷窃与窃取 (Pilfer, Filch, Purloin)
groups.tip: 趁人不备暗中顺走财物

items.def_en: (+ sth) to illicitly or surreptitiously take property that belongs to someone else
items.ex_en: Someone managed to walk away with my expensive leather jacket at the party last night.
items.ex_zh: 昨晚在派对上，有人悄悄顺走了我那件昂贵的真皮夹克。

items.def_en: (informal, chiefly BrE) to take something that belongs to someone else dishonestly
items.ex_en: A teenager tried to nick an expensive bottle of perfume while the clerk looked away.
items.ex_zh: 趁店员不注意，一个少年试图偷走一瓶昂贵的香水。

items.def_en: (informal) to take something without permission, especially something of small value
items.ex_en: He brazenly pinched a fresh apple from the fruit vendor's stall without paying.
items.ex_zh: 他厚颜无耻地顺手从水果摊上顺走了一个新鲜苹果，没有付钱。

items.def_en: (informal) to steal something quickly and opportunistically while no one is looking
items.ex_en: The pickpocket swiped her new smartphone right out of her unzipped backpack.
items.ex_zh: 扒手趁机从她未拉拉链的背包里顺手牵羊偷走了新智能手机。

items.def_zh: 偷窃，小偷小摸（尤指零星窃取价值不高之物）
items.def_en: 1. To steal small quantities of goods or small amounts of money repeatedly, especially from work or a store.
items.ex_en: The dishonest clerk was caught having pilfered office supplies from the storage closet regularly.
items.ex_zh: 那名不老实的职员被发现经常从储藏室零星偷拿办公用品。

items.def_zh: 偷窃，顺手牵羊（窃取小件财物）
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To steal something small or of little value slyly and quietly.
items.ex_en: The greedy boy managed to filch two chocolate bars while his mother was distracted.
items.ex_zh: 那个贪吃的男孩趁母亲分心时，偷偷顺走了两块巧克力糖。

items.def_zh: 顺手牵羊，占为己有；抢先弄到手
items.def_en: 1. (informal, chiefly British) To take, steal, or grab something quickly for oneself, especially without permission.
items.ex_en: She managed to snaffle the last slice of cheesecake before anyone else noticed.
items.ex_zh: 在别人还没注意到之前，她眼疾手快地抢先把最后一块芝士蛋糕据为己有。

items.def_zh: 携（赃物等）潜逃；顺手牵羊带走
items.def_en: (+ sth) to steal something and hurriedly escape with it
items.ex_en: Thieves broke into the gallery and made off with three priceless paintings.
items.ex_zh: 盗贼闯入画廊，盗走了三幅无价的名画。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to secretly take possession of money or property without permission and depart
items.ex_en: The cunning accountant had run off with the company's emergency cash reserves overnight.
items.ex_zh: 那个狡猾的会计一夜之间拐跑了公司的应急现金储备。

items.def_en: (formal) to take possession of something, often without permission or legally dubious grounds
items.ex_en: The rogue general attempted to appropriate government funds to purchase private weapons.
items.ex_zh: 那个叛变将军试图侵吞政府资金，用于购买私人武器。

items.def_zh: 偷窃，盗取（幽默或正式表达）
items.def_en: 1. (formal or humorous) To steal or secretly take something that belongs to someone else.
items.ex_en: The rogue scholar purloined an ancient illuminated manuscript from the secluded monastery library.
items.ex_zh: 这名败类学者从幽静的修道院图书馆中盗取了一本古老的泥金手抄本。

groups.summary_en: An agent takes another's property unlawfully and surreptitiously without overt violence, typically involving small sums, office goods, or sneakily seized valuables.
groups.summary_zh: 神不知鬼不觉地顺手牵羊、小偷小摸或侵吞财物。
groups.desc_en: Denotes surreptitious, non-violent petty theft marked by stealth, opportunism, and small stakes, contrasting with armed robbery or grand burglary.
groups.desc_zh: 指在无身体对抗下趁人不备的小偷小摸或顺手牵羊，区别于持械抢劫、破门盗窃或巨额侵吞。
groups.nuance_en: pilfer: repeatedly stealing small quantities of trivial office/store supplies (supplies / goods / stamps) · filch: sneaky, dexterous snatching of small personal items (wallet / apples / cash) · pinch: colloquial informal lifting of minor goods (cigarettes / bike / purse) · swipe: swift opportunist grabbing when no one looks (phone / chocolate / credit card) · make off with: escaping successfully carrying stolen booty (loot / jewels / cash)
groups.nuance_zh: pilfer: 细水长流蚕食小宗公私杂物 (supplies / goods / stamps) · filch: 动作敏捷、鬼祟摸走小物件 (wallet / apples / cash) · pinch: 俚语口语中顺手牵羊 (cigarettes / bike / purse) · swipe: 趁人不备飞快顺走抓取 (phone / chocolate / credit card) · make off with: 得手后携财物溜之大吉 (loot / jewels / cash)

groups.name: Plant Growth & Vegetative Development · 植物萌发与发育成株 (Sprout, Root, Tiller)
groups.tip: 生命体从小到大发育

items.def_en: to produce lateral stems or boughs from a main trunk or stem
items.ex_en: As spring progressed, the young sapling began to branch out with healthy green shoots.
items.ex_zh: 随着春天推进，这株小树苗开始生出健康的嫩绿侧枝。

items.def_en: to begin to grow and appear above the soil surface
items.ex_en: Dozens of tiny radish seedlings began to sprout up through the dark moist soil.
items.ex_zh: 数十株细小的萝卜幼苗开始穿透湿润的黑土，萌芽钻出地面。

items.def_zh: 生根，扎根；使生根；（猪等）用鼻拱土；搜寻
items.def_en: 1. (of a plant) To develop roots, or cause a cutting or plant to put forth roots and begin growing. 2. (+ for) (informal) To support or cheer for someone.
items.ex_en: These stem cuttings root really easily if you keep them in warm water.
items.ex_zh: 如果把这些茎段插条浸在温水里，它们很容易就能生根。
items.ex2_en: The experienced gardener rooted the rose cuttings in moist nutrient soil.
items.ex2_zh: 经验丰富的园丁把玫瑰插条生根在潮湿的营养土中。

items.def_en: to begin to grow or send out new shoots, leaves, or buds
items.ex_en: The dormant rose bushes finally began to sprout tiny green buds this week.
items.ex_zh: 休眠的玫瑰灌木本周终于开始抽生出小小的绿芽。
items.ex2_en: Warm spring rains sprouted the newly planted sunflower seeds within several days.
items.ex2_zh: 温暖的春雨在数天内催生了新种下的向日葵种子发芽。

items.def_en: 1. (botany, agriculture) (of cereal crops or grasses) To produce side shoots or stalks from the base of the stem.
items.ex_en: In the mild spring weather, the winter wheat began to tiller vigorously across fields.
items.ex_zh: 在温暖的春光下，田野间的冬小麦开始旺盛地分蘖。

items.def_en: to cause a seed or spore to start growing after a period of dormancy
items.ex_en: Adequate moisture and warmth are strictly required to germinate these delicate orchid seeds.
items.ex_zh: 要想使这些娇嫩的兰花种子发芽，必须具备充足的水分和温暖的环境。
items.ex2_en: The tiny tomato seeds germinated quickly in the humid soil tray.
items.ex2_zh: 微小的番茄种子在潮湿的育苗盘中迅速萌发了。

items.def_en: to grow upwards very rapidly and noticeably, as young plants or shoots do
items.ex_en: After two days of continuous rain, the bamboo shoots seemed to shoot up overnight.
items.ex_zh: 连续下了两天雨后，这些竹笋仿佛一夜之间拔节猛长起来。

items.def_en: (of a plant) to push forth vegetative buds or stems rapidly
items.ex_en: The trimmed hedge quickly began to shoot again as warm weather returned.
items.ex_zh: 随着天气转暖，修剪过的树篱很快又开始抽生出新枝。

items.def_zh: 生长，成长；种植；逐渐变得（grow 的过去式）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense of grow; increased in size, developed, or cultivated.
items.ex_en: The tomato plants grew rapidly under the warm glow of the greenhouse lights.
items.ex_zh: 在温室灯光的温暖照耀下，番茄植株生长得非常迅速。
items.ex2_en: The local agricultural cooperative grew organic sweet corn for urban farmers markets.
items.ex2_zh: 当地农业合作社为城市农贸市场种植有机甜玉米。

items.def_en: to breed or reproduce specimens of a plant naturally or artificially
items.ex_en: Botanists carefully propagate rare alpine plants inside climate-controlled research greenhouses.
items.ex_zh: 植物学家在受控温室中精心繁殖罕见的高山植物。
items.ex2_en: These hardy mountain ferns propagate readily through windborne airborne spores.
items.ex2_zh: 这些耐寒的高山蕨类植物很容易通过风力传播的孢子繁殖。

items.def_en: 1. To grow again after being cut, damaged, or lost, or cause something to do so.
items.ex_en: After severe pruning, the vigorous shrub will easily regrow its damaged foliage by summer.
items.ex_zh: 重度修剪之后，这种生命力顽强的灌木在夏天前会重新长出受损的叶片。
items.ex2_en: The damaged lawn regrew quickly after several days of gentle spring rain.
items.ex2_zh: 经过几天的春日细雨，受损的草坪很快重新长好了。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures biological, vegetative development in flora, detailing how a plant establishes anchors, sends out shoots, or regenerates tissues. Key verbs distinguish anchoring ('root'), lateral shooting ('tiller'), and regenerative vegetative proliferation.
groups.summary_zh: 专指植物生根、抽蘖、生枝与再生等阶段性生化与植株生理发育过程。
groups.desc_en: Denotes biological plant morphogenesis from dormancy through shoot emergence and structural branching, contrasting with artificial construction or cellular decay.
groups.desc_zh: 指植物从种胚休眠中萌动、破土成株并抽薹分枝的形态发生过程，区别于人工建造或细胞坏死。
groups.nuance_en: germinate: seed breaking dormancy and initiating growth (seed / spore / idea) · sprout: primary emergence of young buds or shoots above soil (seeds / potatoes / wings) · shoot: rapid, vigorous elongation of tender stems upward (saplings / vines / stalks) · root: developing radicles or anchoring deeply into soil (cuttings / plants / tradition) · tiller: grasses sending out multiple side shoots from the base (wheat / rice / turf)
groups.nuance_zh: germinate: 种子破除休眠吸水萌发 (seed / spore / idea) · sprout: 破土初绽嫩芽幼叶 (seeds / potatoes / wings) · shoot: 枝条茎秆向上旺盛拔节 (saplings / vines / stalks) · root: 胚根下扎深植固着 (cuttings / plants / tradition) · tiller: 禾本科植物自基部分蘖成丛 (wheat / rice / turf)

groups.name: Ponder & Cogitate · 深思与反省 (Ruminate, Muse, Meditate)
groups.tip: 反复沉吟深思并检视内省

items.def_en: (+ on/upon/over) to think deeply and dreamily in silence about a matter
items.ex_en: The poet sat by the quiet stream, ready to muse upon human transience.
items.ex_zh: 诗人坐在静谧的小溪旁，若有所思地沉思起人生的短暂。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to discuss or think about something carefully and thoroughly
items.ex_en: The committee members need a few days to chew over your budget proposal.
items.ex_zh: 委员会成员需要几天时间来细细考虑你的预算提案。

items.def_zh: 仔细考虑；深思；反复琢磨
items.def_en: (+ sth) to think carefully about something over a period of time
items.ex_en: The manager spent the entire weekend mulling over the lucrative corporate buyout offer.
items.ex_zh: 经理花了一整个周末反复琢磨那份诱人的企业收购报价。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to think deeply or carefully about a past event or idea
items.ex_en: The retired general paused quietly to reflect on his painful choices during wartime.
items.ex_zh: 这位退役将军静静停顿下来，深思反省战时那些痛苦的抉择。

items.def_en: to think about something carefully, weighing consequences, before reaching a conclusion
items.ex_en: The directors met privately to ponder the serious legal consequences of the merger.
items.ex_zh: 董事们秘密会面，仔细斟酌这次合并可能带来的严重法律后果。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to focus one's mind intensely in silence or spiritual contemplation
items.ex_en: She sits quietly each morning to meditate on peace, gratitude, and inner strength.
items.ex_zh: 每天清晨，她都会静静坐着，冥想和平、感恩与内心的力量。

items.def_zh: 沉思，反复思考；（动物）反刍
items.def_en: 1. (+ on/over/about) To think deeply and carefully about something for a long time. 2. (zoology) (of cattle and other animals) To chew the cud.
items.ex_en: The philosopher often spent hours to ruminate on the complex nature of consciousness.
items.ex_zh: 这位哲学家常常花上数小时，反复深入思考意识的复杂本质。

items.def_en: (also 'bethink oneself') (archaic / literary) To remind yourself, reflect, or stop to consider.
items.ex_en: The tired traveler paused, bethinking himself of the perilous mountain pass lying ahead.
items.ex_zh: 疲倦的旅人驻足停歇，深思起前方那座艰险莫测的山口。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to think anxiously or gloomily about something for a long time
items.ex_en: It does no good to brood on the bitter mistakes of your past.
items.ex_zh: 忧心忡忡地一直琢磨过去的痛苦过失毫无益处。

items.def_en: (+ on/over) to dwell morosely, resentfully, or anxiously on an unhappy subject
items.ex_en: He preferred to isolate himself in his bedroom and brood over his failures.
items.ex_zh: 他宁愿把自己关在卧室里，郁闷地纠结于自己的种种失败。

items.def_en: (+ on/about) (formal or humorous) To think deeply, carefully, and seriously about something.
items.ex_en: The senior scholar retired to his book-filled study to cogitate on the ethical dilemma.
items.ex_zh: 老学者退回堆满书籍的书房，仔细深思起这一伦理困境。

groups.summary_en: A thinker engages in sustained, deep, and often inward intellectual or emotional deliberation over a subject. Verbs vary from cyclical, troubled mental revisiting (ruminate) to quiet philosophical reflection (muse, meditate) and rigorous formal contemplation (cogitate).
groups.summary_zh: 持续专注地反复琢磨、反躬自省或静心思虑。
groups.desc_en: Denotes deliberate, sustained cognitive immersion turning over an idea or memory from multiple perspectives, contrasting with reactive impulsiveness or superficial glance.
groups.desc_zh: 指长时间深沉调动注意力对特定观念或过往经历反复品评推敲，区别于下意识冲动或浮面略思。
groups.nuance_en: ponder: weightily weighing alternatives and consequential outcomes (future / decision / dilemma) · mull over: patient, informal chewing on an idea over days (offer / proposal / problem) · ruminate: repetitive, often brooding recycling of melancholic thoughts (past / failure / mistakes) · muse: idle, dreamy, philosophical contemplation (nature of love / mortality) · meditate: deep structured spiritual or philosophical focus (scripture / mortality / thoughts)
groups.nuance_zh: ponder: 权衡重大决策利弊后果 (future / decision / dilemma) · mull over: 经年累月非正式思索消化 (offer / proposal / problem) · ruminate: 陷于负面纠结反复反刍 (past / failure / mistakes) · muse: 沉浸悠闲缥缈的哲理冥想 (nature of love / mortality) · meditate: 静默沉潜的灵修或深度打坐 (scripture / mortality / thoughts)

groups.name: Provision of Sustenance & Overindulgence · 供食与饲育 (Feed, Nourish, Overfeed)
groups.tip: 为幼体或病患提供养分

items.def_zh: 喂养，喂（食），饲养；供养，滋养；供给，提供（原料、信息等）
items.def_en: 1. To give food to a person or animal, or provide nourishment. 2. To supply a machine, system, or organization with material, fuel, or information.
items.ex_en: The farmer walked into the wooden barn early each morning to feed his cows.
items.ex_zh: 农夫每天清晨都会走进木棚，去给他的奶牛喂食。

items.def_en: (+ sb/animal) to feed someone or an animal lavishly so they become stronger, healthier, or plumper
items.ex_en: The kind nurse worked tirelessly to feed up the malnourished orphan with warm milk.
items.ex_zh: 善良的护士不知疲倦地用温牛奶给营养不良的孤儿补充营养。

items.def_en: (+ sb/animal) to feed livestock or a person a large amount of food so that they gain substantial weight
items.ex_en: They fatten up the pigs with grains for several months before the harvest.
items.ex_zh: 在收获季前，他们用谷物把猪催肥数月。
items.ex2_en: The grazing cattle fattened up noticeably on the rich summer pasture grass.
items.ex2_zh: 吃草的牛群在茂盛的夏日牧草滋养下明显长膘了。

items.def_en: to eat eagerly and heartily, often consuming generous quantities of food
items.ex_en: The hungry construction workers sat under the shade to chow down on their burritos.
items.ex_zh: 饥肠辘辘的建筑工人们坐在阴凉处，痛痛快快地大嚼卷饼。

items.def_zh: 用谷物（或玉米）喂养（牲畜）；用盐腌（肉等）
items.def_en: 1. To feed cattle or other livestock with corn or grain. 2. To preserve meat or other food with coarse salt or brine.
items.ex_en: At dusk, the elderly herdsman prepared to corn the weary horses in the stable.
items.ex_zh: 黄昏时分，老牧人准备在马厩里用谷物喂养疲惫的马匹。

items.def_en: To eat a snack or small amount of food between regular meals.
items.ex_en: I try not to snack on greasy potato chips while watching late-night television.
items.ex_zh: 深夜看电视时，我尽量不去吃油腻的薯片当零食。

items.def_en: [I/T] feed on growing grass, or eat small portions of food throughout the day
items.ex_en: Instead of eating heavy meals, she likes to graze on fresh vegetables all day.
items.ex_zh: 她不喜欢吃正餐，而喜欢整天零星吃些新鲜蔬菜。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ on/oneself) eat large quantities of food until completely stuffed
items.ex_en: The ravenous tourists began to gorge on fresh seafood at the lavish hotel buffet.
items.ex_zh: 饥肠辘辘的游客们开始在豪华酒店的自助餐上狼吞虎咽地大吃海鲜。

items.def_en: provide with the food or other substances necessary for growth and health
items.ex_en: A balanced and diverse diet is necessary to nourish the human body effectively.
items.ex_zh: 均衡多样的饮食对于有效地滋养人体是必不可少的。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ up) feed an animal intensely so that it becomes fat enough to slaughter
items.ex_en: The livestock breeders intensively fatten the steers on corn before selling them to butchers.
items.ex_zh: 牲畜饲养员在把肉牛卖给屠户之前，会用玉米对其进行密集催肥。
items.ex2_en: The herd of grazing cattle fattened steadily throughout the lush autumn season.
items.ex2_zh: 吃草的牛群在丰沃的秋季稳步长肥。

items.def_en: To feed someone or an animal too much food, or to eat excessively.
items.ex_en: Careless pet owners often overfeed their indoor cats, causing dangerous obesity and joint issues.
items.ex_zh: 粗心的宠物主人常常把室内猫喂得过饱，导致危险的肥胖症和关节问题。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the human or institutional act of supplying food, fodder, or biological nutrients to creatures or humans, covering casual light eating (snack), basic provision (feed), grain feeding of livestock (corn), and harmful excessive provisioning (overfeed).
groups.summary_zh: 提供营养物质与食物以维系生命，涵盖日常喂食、饲喂牲畜及过量喂饲。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the biological ingestion of sustenance spanning regular metabolic nourishment, systematic agricultural fattening, and unrestrained gluttony, contrasting with starvation or medical fasting.
groups.desc_zh: 指生物摄取养分的各种形式，涵盖基础代谢供给、农业育肥增重至饕餮暴食，区别于挨饿或绝食疗法。
groups.nuance_en: feed: supplying essential nutrition to animals or dependents (cattle / baby / birds) · fatten up: intensive overfeeding designed to increase livestock weight (pigs / cattle / calves) · graze: continuous casual nibbling of pasture grass or light snacks (cows / pasture / all day) · chow down: enthusiastic, unceremonious informal feasting (burgers / pizza / ribs) · gorge: ravenous, unrestrained gluttony packing the stomach (food / chocolate / themselves)
groups.nuance_zh: feed: 供养牲口幼弱基础食料 (cattle / baby / birds) · fatten up: 强化饲喂育肥贴膘 (pigs / cattle / calves) · graze: 牲畜舔食青草或随意零食慢吃 (cows / pasture / all day) · chow down: 狼吞虎咽大饱口福 (burgers / pizza / ribs) · gorge: 暴饮暴食吃到撑胀 (food / chocolate / themselves)

groups.name: Purify & Cleanse · 净化与提纯 (Filter, Clarify, Refine)
groups.tip: 滤除杂质提炼出纯净成分

items.def_en: (+ sth) to remove unwanted solids or impurities from a liquid or gas by passing it through a permeable medium
items.ex_en: The software is designed to filter out spam emails automatically.
items.ex_zh: 该软件旨在自动过滤掉垃圾邮件。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to remove dirt, stains, or chemical residues from something by cleaning it with water
items.ex_en: The outdoor music festival was completely washed out by the downpour.
items.ex_zh: 室外音乐节因倾盆大雨而被迫彻底取消。
items.ex2_en: Frequent machine washing will cause bright summer fabric dyes to wash out completely.
items.ex2_zh: 频繁的机洗会导致鲜艳的夏季面料染料彻底褪色。

items.def_en: [I/T] to pass liquid or gas through a porous device to remove solid particles
items.ex_en: You should filter the tap water through activated carbon before using it for cooking.
items.ex_zh: 将自来水用于做饭之前，你应该先用活性炭进行过滤。
items.ex2_en: Golden sunlight filtered softly through the dense canopy of ancient oak trees.
items.ex2_zh: 金色的阳光柔和地穿透古老橡树密集的树冠洒下来。

items.def_en: to make a liquid clear or pure by heating, straining, or removing solids
items.ex_en: The chef demonstrated how to clarify the broth by slowly skimming off floating impurities.
items.ex_zh: 厨师演示了如何通过慢慢撇去漂浮的杂质来澄清肉汤。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to evaporate liquid completely or concentrate a substance by prolonged heating
items.ex_en: Simmer the sauce gently to boil away the excess water and concentrate its flavor.
items.ex_zh: 文火慢煨酱汁以煮沸蒸发多余的水分，并使风味更加浓郁。
items.ex2_en: The boiling broth boiled away until only thick savoury paste remained.
items.ex2_zh: 沸腾的高汤不断蒸发，直到只剩下浓稠鲜美的酱汁。

items.def_en: 1. To clean something or oneself with water and usually soap. 2. (of water) To carry or sweep something away, or flow over.
items.ex_en: Remember to wash the fresh garden strawberries thoroughly under running water before eating.
items.ex_zh: 吃之前记得用流动水将刚从花园摘下的草莓彻底清洗干净。

items.def_en: to remove impurities or unwanted elements from a substance through an industrial process
items.ex_en: The chemical company uses advanced thermal methods to refine crude oil into aviation fuel.
items.ex_zh: 这家化工公司采用先进的热法工艺将原油精炼成航空燃料。

items.def_en: to clean thoroughly, especially the skin, or free from guilt/sin
items.ex_en: The monk sought ancient rituals to cleanse his troubled soul from enduring guilt.
items.ex_zh: 这位僧侣寻求古老仪式，以荡涤自己饱受折磨的心灵与持久的罪疚。

items.def_zh: 使纯净，净化，提纯；变纯净
items.def_en: To remove dirty, harmful, or foreign substances from something so that it becomes pure.
items.ex_en: Advanced chemical filters are employed to purify contaminated groundwater for local residents.
items.ex_zh: 先进的化学过滤器被用来净化受污染的地下水，供当地居民饮用。
items.ex2_en: The stagnant pool water purified naturally as it seeped through porous limestone.
items.ex2_zh: 死水池中的水在渗过透水石灰石时自然净化了。

items.def_en: 1. To purify a liquid by boiling it and condensing its vapors. 2. (+ into) To extract the essential elements or meaning of something.
items.ex_en: The scholar managed to distill complex economic doctrines into three fundamental principles.
items.ex_zh: 这位学者设法将复杂的经济学说提炼为三项基本原则。

items.def_zh: 除去盐分，使淡化（如海水）
items.def_en: (chemistry / engineering) To remove salt from seawater so that it can be used for drinking or agriculture.
items.ex_en: The coastal facility can desalinate millions of gallons of seawater each day.
items.ex_zh: 该沿海设施每天能够淡化数百万加仑的海水。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate specific physical, chemical, or ritual methods of removing contaminants, impurities, or unwanted substances from a liquid, substance, or entity.
groups.summary_zh: 指采用过滤、沉淀、脱盐或蒸馏等物理化学或仪式手段除去杂质以达纯净。
groups.desc_en: Denotes physically or chemically purging contaminants and turbid components to achieve absolute compositional purity, contrasting with surface wiping or contaminating mixing.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过物理拦截或化学分流沉淀去除浊质杂质以达高度纯正，区别于表面抹尘或掺假混合。
groups.nuance_en: filter: passing fluid through porous media to trap particulate solids (water / air / impurities) · clarify: removing suspended solids to render liquid optically clear (butter / broth / wine) · refine: industrial processing to strip coarse elements to high purity (petroleum / sugar / metal) · cleanse: deeply purging toxins, pathogens, or spiritual taints (wound / skin / soul) · wash out: rinsing with water flow to remove stubborn stains or chemicals (color / stains / dye)
groups.nuance_zh: filter: 多孔介质机械拦截悬浮颗粒 (water / air / impurities) · clarify: 去除浑浊残渣使油脂或汤汁澄清 (butter / broth / wine) · refine: 工业级深加工精炼提纯 (petroleum / sugar / metal) · cleanse: 深度清除毒素、致病源或涤净灵魂 (wound / skin / soul) · wash out: 水流冲洗除尽陈年色斑污渍 (color / stains / dye)

groups.name: Rebuke & Scold by Intensity · 责备与斥责 (Admonish to Lambaste)
groups.tip: 从轻微批评到严词斥责

items.def_en: to speak to someone in a gentle but firm way, criticizing their behavior or warning them
items.ex_en: The teacher gently admonished the students to refrain from whispering during silent study.
items.ex_zh: 老师温和地告诫学生们在自习期间不要窃窃私语。

items.def_en: (formal) to criticize or scold someone gently or kindly for doing wrong
items.ex_en: The mother gently reproved her child for forgetting to thank their gracious host.
items.ex_zh: 母亲温柔地责备孩子忘记向热情的房东道谢。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to speak angrily to someone because they have done something wrong
items.ex_en: The teacher told him off for chatting during the exam.
items.ex_zh: 老师因为他在考试中聊天而严厉训斥了他。

items.def_en: to speak angrily and sternly to someone because they have done something wrong
items.ex_en: The supervisor sharply rebuked the clerk for repeatedly disregarding essential workplace safety protocols.
items.ex_zh: 主管严厉斥责了那名反复无视基本工作场所安全规程的职员。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to severely scold or reprimand someone in authority over their mistakes
items.ex_en: On Fridays, staff are allowed to dress down.
items.ex_zh: 每周五，员工可以穿便服上班。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to attack someone verbally with harsh or angry criticism
items.ex_en: The coach completely laid into the team after their careless performance today.
items.ex_zh: 球队今天表现松懈，教练随后对他们痛骂了一顿。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to criticize or verbally attack someone with extreme anger and ferocity
items.ex_en: She suddenly tore into her brother for carelessly breaking her antique porcelain vase.
items.ex_zh: 因弟弟粗心打碎了她的古董瓷瓶，她突然对他破口痛斥。

items.def_en: to criticize or speak angrily to someone for an extended period
items.ex_en: The irate manager berated the trembling assistant for over twenty uninterrupted minutes yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 昨天，愤怒的经理对着瑟瑟发抖的助理连续痛骂了二十多分钟。
