items.def_en: to criticize someone severely in public or with great indignation
items.ex_en: Opposition leaders castigated the administration for widespread corruption throughout the regional agencies.
items.ex_zh: 反对派领导人严厉谴责了该行政部门在地区机构中普遍存在的腐败行为。

items.def_en: (formal) to criticize or scold someone severely for doing something wrong
items.ex_en: The stern magistrate upbraided the delinquent officer for complete dereliction of duty.
items.ex_zh: 严厉的法官严词申斥了那名彻底玩忽职守的违纪警官。

items.def_en: to criticize someone or something fiercely and publicly; (dated) to beat or hit severely
items.ex_en: Reviewers savagely lambasted the pretentious novel for its vacuous prose and clichéd characters.
items.ex_zh: 书评人极其严厉地痛批了这本自命不凡的小说，指责其文字空洞、人物刻板。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe expressing verbal disapproval to someone regarding their fault or misconduct, graded from mild formal correction up to furious public dressing-down.
groups.summary_zh: 指就某人过失进行语言斥责，语气从温和告诫递增至极其严厉的痛骂抨击。
groups.desc_en: Denotes expressing explicit verbal disapproval across a sliding scale of severity, from mild corrective warning to unbridled, thunderous castigation, contrasting with calm praise or indifferent silence.
groups.desc_zh: 指基于道德规训或权威位阶逐级释放口头严正责难，从轻度劝诫至雷霆斥挞，区别于表彰或缄默。
groups.nuance_en: admonish: mild, well-meaning corrective warning urged upon someone (children / staff / friend) · reprove: firm yet calm authoritative expression of disappointment (student / conduct) · rebuke: sharp, formal, and authoritative verbal check (minister / subordinate / insolence) · berate: prolonged, angry, and degrading verbal barrage (employee / children / driver) · tear into: ferocious, uninhibited aggressive verbal assault (opponent / performance / rival)
groups.nuance_zh: admonish: 循循劝诱式的善意温和告诫 (children / staff / friend) · reprove: 严肃庄重的威权性摇头指责 (student / conduct) · rebuke: 疾言厉色的当面严厉弹劾 (minister / subordinate / insolence) · berate: 滔滔不绝、伤人自尊的痛骂 (employee / children / driver) · tear into: 毫无克制的狂风骤雨式劈头猛批 (opponent / performance / rival)

groups.name: Record & Document · 记录与记载 (Log, Register, Minutise)
groups.tip: 系统记录与文献归档保存

items.def_zh: 记录，记载；录音，录像；标明，显示
items.def_en: 1. To set down information in writing or other permanent form for future reference. 2. To store sound, music, or moving pictures on disc, tape, or digital media.
items.ex_en: Please record all daily financial transactions carefully in the general accounting ledger.
items.ex_zh: 请将每日的所有财务收支仔细记录在总账簿中。

items.def_zh: 详细记录，记载；用文件（或文献、证据）证明
items.def_en: 1. To record the details of an event, process, or situation in writing, film, or photographs. 2. To support or prove something with evidence or official documents.
items.ex_en: Independent human rights observers rigorously documented numerous serious abuses during the conflict.
items.ex_zh: 独立人权观察员严谨记录了冲突期间发生的诸多严重侵害事件。

items.def_en: to enter details about someone or something into an official list or public record
items.ex_en: Every foreign national must register their residential address with the local municipality.
items.ex_zh: 所有外籍公民都必须向当地市政机构登记自己的居住地址。

items.def_zh: 记录，跟踪记录（进展或变化）；绘制……的图表（或地图）
items.def_en: 1. To record or track the development, progress, or change of something over time. 2. To make a map or chart of an area.
items.ex_en: The medical study charts the gradual development of cognitive functions in toddlers.
items.ex_zh: 这项医学研究记录了幼儿认知功能的逐步发展轨迹。

items.def_zh: 记入航海/飞行/工作日志，系统记录
items.def_en: to make a systematic, chronological record of events, measurements, or occurrences in an official log
items.ex_en: The chief navigator dutifully logged the ship's coordinates at three-hour intervals.
items.ex_zh: 领航长忠实地每隔三小时将船只的坐标记入航海日志。

items.def_en: to write down what is said and decided during a formal meeting
items.ex_en: The executive secretary carefully minuted every formal resolution adopted by the board.
items.ex_zh: 行政秘书仔细将董事会通过的每一项正式决议记入了会议记录。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to record information, facts, or data on paper or in a document
items.ex_en: Be sure to write down the emergency telephone number on that notepad.
items.ex_zh: 务必把那个紧急电话号码写在那个便笺本上。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to record or enter details, events, or measurements systematically into an official record or system
items.ex_en: The laboratory technician logged in all newly arrived tissue samples this morning.
items.ex_zh: 实验室技术员今天早晨将所有新收到的组织样本录入了系统。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to transcribe or write down words or proceedings as they are spoken
items.ex_en: The court stenographer quickly took down the witness's exact testimony word-for-word.
items.ex_zh: 法庭速记员迅速逐字逐句抄录下了证人的原话证词。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to write down quickly or briefly on a piece of paper for later reference
items.ex_en: Let me jot down your email address before I completely forget it.
items.ex_zh: 趁我还没完全忘掉，让我草草记下你的电子邮件地址吧。

items.def_en: to record a related series of events in chronological order
items.ex_en: His monumental biography chronicles the tumultuous political events of the Victorian era.
items.ex_zh: 他的这部不朽传记按时间顺序详细记载了维多利亚时代的动荡政治事件。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to transcribing, registering, or recording empirical data, progress, or official proceedings on physical or digital media to preserve an accurate evidentiary record.
groups.summary_zh: 指将数据、进展、实况或会议进程录入介质以备留存查考。
groups.desc_en: Entering or committing facts, events, or measurements into an enduring official medium, contrasting with fleeting mental recall or casual unrecorded observation.
groups.desc_zh: 将事实、事件或测量数据录入或固化在持久、具公信力的介质中，区别于转瞬即逝的记忆或非正式观察。
groups.nuance_en: record: capturing and storing facts or data in durable form (history / temperature / transactions) · document: authenticating or substantiating via written evidence (abuses / procedures / findings) · register: officially cataloging an entry to establish legal notice (voters / births / trademark) · log: chronologically appending routine operational events (flight hours / calls / incidents) · minute: formally writing down proceedings of an assembly (meeting / resolutions / discussions)
groups.nuance_zh: record: 以持久形式捕获并存储事实或数据 (history / temperature / transactions) · document: 用书面凭证佐证或详尽记录 (abuses / procedures / findings) · register: 正式登记以确立官方效力 (voters / births / trademark) · log: 按时间顺序流水账式录入运行事件 (flight hours / calls / incidents) · minute: 正式记录会议或议案的纪要 (meeting / resolutions / discussions)

groups.name: Refurbish & Touch Up · 修缮、翻新与补修 (Renovate, Refurbish, Retouch)
groups.tip: 修复破损使旧物换新貌

items.def_en: to repair something quickly and often temporarily or inexpertly
items.ex_en: He managed to patch up the leaking garden shed with spare plywood.
items.ex_zh: 他用多余的胶合板勉强把漏雨的花园棚子草草修补好了。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to repair, decorate, and refurbish an old room, building, or car to restore it to good condition
items.ex_en: They bought a dilapidated country cottage and spent months doing it up.
items.ex_zh: 他们买下了一座破旧的乡间农舍，花了数月时间将其翻新整修。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make a place or object look cleaner, neater, or more attractive with minor improvements
items.ex_en: We decided to spruce up the guest bedroom before the in-laws arrived.
items.ex_zh: 在姻亲到来之前，我们决定把客房收拾粉饰一新。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to improve the surface appearance of something by making minor repairs or adding small amounts of paint
items.ex_en: She spent a few minutes touching up her makeup before the live broadcast.
items.ex_zh: 在直播开始前，她花了几分钟补了补妆。

items.def_zh: 翻新，修复，修缮（旧建筑、家具等）
items.def_en: 1. To repair, redecorate, and improve a building, room, or piece of furniture so that it is in good condition again.
items.ex_en: The city council allocated significant funds to renovate the historic public library.
items.ex_zh: 市议会拨出巨额资金用于翻新这座具有历史意义的公共图书馆。

items.def_en: to examine a machine or system thoroughly and make necessary repairs or improvements
items.ex_en: Certified aerospace mechanics will overhaul the commercial airliner's jet engines next week.
items.ex_zh: 具备资质的航空机械师将于下周对这架商用客机的喷气发动机进行全面大修。

items.def_en: to change or arrange something again in order to improve its appearance or efficiency
items.ex_en: The marketing firm revamped the company's outdated branding to attract younger consumers.
items.ex_zh: 这家营销公司重新改造了该公司过时的品牌形象，以吸引年轻消费者。

items.def_en: to clean, redecorate, and provide new equipment or fittings for a building or room
items.ex_en: The luxury hotel closed for six months to refurbish its guest suites.
items.ex_zh: 这家豪华酒店停业六个月，对其客房套间进行了全面翻新装潢。

items.def_zh: 润饰，修补，修整（照片、画作等）
items.def_en: 1. To improve a photograph, painting, or other image by making small changes or removing flaws.
items.ex_en: The professional photographer used advanced software to retouch the model's portrait subtlely.
items.ex_zh: 这位专业摄影师使用高级软件精细修整了模特的肖像照。

items.def_zh: 拙劣地修补；粗制滥造，草率应付
items.def_en: 1. (informal, chiefly British) To mend, repair, or make something clumsily and carelessly.
items.ex_en: He completely bodged the plumbing repairs, causing a disastrous leak downstairs yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 他粗制滥造地乱修管道，结果昨天导致楼下发生了严重的漏水。

items.def_zh: 重修……的表面，为……贴换饰面
items.def_en: 1. To put a new outer surface or finish on a building, wall, or piece of furniture.
items.ex_en: Contractors were hired to reface the building's exterior with polished granite slabs.
items.ex_zh: 承包商受雇为该建筑的外立面贴换抛光花岗岩饰面板。

groups.summary_en: An agent works on a building, surface, or artifact to restore its condition, improve its aesthetic appearance, or patch up defects. Nuances range from comprehensive overhaul and professional resurfacing to superficial touch-ups or shoddy repairs.
groups.summary_zh: 对建筑物、外观或器具进行翻新、修葺、修饰或敷衍修补。
groups.desc_en: Restoring, modernizing, or cosmetically improving the physical condition or appearance of a structure or object, contrasting with functional repair of broken mechanisms or building anew.
groups.desc_zh: 对结构或物件的物理外观与状况进行更新、美化或修整，区别于单纯修复故障机械或推倒重建。
groups.nuance_en: renovate: restoring a building or room to good repair and modern standards (house / kitchen / property) · refurbish: comprehensively cleaning, re-equipping, and redecorating for renewed use (offices / fleet / equipment) · revamp: restructuring and restyling to give a modern competitive appeal (image / website / lineup) · overhaul: thoroughly examining, dismantling, and repairing machinery or systems (engine / system / curriculum) · touch up: making minor cosmetic improvements or adjustments (paintwork / makeup / roots)
groups.nuance_zh: renovate: 将建筑或房屋翻新修缮至良好现代标准 (house / kitchen / property) · refurbish: 全面清洁、翻修并换新设备以供再用 (offices / fleet / equipment) · revamp: 全面改版换貌以提升吸引力 (image / website / lineup) · overhaul: 彻底拆解排查并大修系统或机器 (engine / system / curriculum) · touch up: 做局部细微的润色或补缀 (paintwork / makeup / roots)

groups.name: Release from Confinement or Bondage · 释放与解放 (Free, Liberate, Emancipate)
groups.tip: 打破枷锁重获自由与自主权

items.def_en: (+ from) to release someone from captivity, confinement, or physical restraint
items.ex_en: Paramedics worked tirelessly to free the trapped driver from the mangled wreckage.
items.ex_zh: 医护人员不知疲倦地工作，将受困司机从变形的残骸中解救出来。

items.def_en: (+ from) to allow someone to leave prison, custody, or institutional care formally
items.ex_en: The correctional facility will officially release the inmate from custody tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 惩教机构将于明早正式准予该在押犯人出狱。

items.def_en: to release from fetters or any hindering constraints
items.ex_en: The reformist legislation sought to unfetter creative industry from bureaucratic state control.
items.ex_zh: 这项改革立法旨在解除国家官僚管控对文化创意产业的束缚。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to allow someone to leave confinement, imprisonment, or detention
items.ex_en: The warden ordered the guards to let out the wrongfully detained suspect.
items.ex_zh: 典狱长命令警卫释放那名被错误关押的嫌疑人。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to release someone from captivity, bondage, or imprisonment
items.ex_en: Activists successfully campaigned to set free the captive marine mammals into sanctuaries.
items.ex_zh: 活动家们成功争取到了将圈养的海洋哺乳动物释放至庇护区的结果。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to secure the release of an arrested person by paying a required financial deposit
items.ex_en: Her wealthy uncle agreed to bail out her troubled cousin after midnight.
items.ex_zh: 午夜过后，她富有的叔叔同意出资将她惹麻烦的堂弟保释出狱。

items.def_en: (+ from) to officially allow someone to leave an institution, hospital, or military service
items.ex_en: The doctor decided to discharge the recovering patient from the hospital today.
items.ex_zh: 医生决定今天准予这名正在康复的病人出院。

items.def_en: To set someone or something free from control, captivity, or oppression.
items.ex_en: Allied forces fought fiercely to liberate the occupied towns from brutal oppression.
items.ex_zh: 盟军奋勇作战，将沦陷的城镇从残酷的压迫统治下解放出来。

items.def_en: To release a prisoner before their sentence has finished, on condition of good behavior.
items.ex_en: The review board decided to parole the nonviolent offender after eight years.
items.ex_zh: 审查委员会决定在八年后准予这名非暴力犯罪者假释出狱。

items.def_en: To remove the chains from a person, animal, or thing to set them free.
items.ex_en: The heroic captive managed to unchain his fellow prisoners under cover of darkness.
items.ex_zh: 那位英勇的战俘在夜幕的掩护下设法解开了狱友身上的锁链。

items.def_en: To give freedom and equal rights to someone, especially by freeing them from slavery or social and legal restrictions.
items.ex_en: The historic proclamation sought to emancipate millions of people from chattel slavery.
items.ex_zh: 这份具有历史意义的宣言旨在将数以百万计的人民从农奴式奴役中解放出来。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote granting physical liberty, political rights, or release from institutional, physical, or social constraints.
groups.summary_zh: 解除人身拘禁、政治压迫或法律枷锁，赋予其自由。
groups.desc_en: Unbinding or discharging an entity from physical, legal, or institutional captivity, contrasting with internal psychological healing or unmonitored escape.
groups.desc_zh: 解除实体在人身、法律或制度层面的束缚与关押，区别于内心的解脱或未经许可的脱逃。
groups.nuance_en: free: removing external bonds, captivity, or subjugation broadly (hostages / slaves / prisoners) · release: officially discharging from legal, medical, or physical custody (inmate / patient / captive) · liberate: emancipation from political oppression, military occupation, or systemic subjugation (country / city / oppressed) · unfetter: releasing from literal chains or restrictive encumbrances (mind / trade / enterprise) · discharge: authoritatively releasing upon fulfillment of an obligation (soldier / patient / bankrupt)
groups.nuance_zh: free: 广泛意义上去除束缚、监禁或奴役 (hostages / slaves / prisoners) · release: 经官方或正规程序解除拘禁或监护 (inmate / patient / captive) · liberate: 从政治压迫、军事占领或系统性奴役中解放 (country / city / oppressed) · unfetter: 解除字面链条或抽象束缚 (mind / trade / enterprise) · discharge: 履职或期满后依规准予离开或免除 (soldier / patient / bankrupt)

groups.name: Repair & Restore · 修复与恢复 (Restoring Proper Function)
groups.tip: 纠正差错并修复原状

items.def_en: (+ sth) to resolve a confusing, disordered, or problematic situation and restore normal order
items.ex_en: We spent all afternoon trying to straighten out the confusing billing discrepancy.
items.ex_zh: 我们花了一整个下午试图理顺那笔令人困惑的账目差异。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to deal successfully with a problem, malfunction, or muddle and put it right
items.ex_en: The experienced IT specialist quickly sorted out the chronic network connection problem.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的IT专家迅速修复妥当了长期存在的网络连接故障。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to correct a mistake, fault, or injustice and return conditions to what they should be
items.ex_en: The ombudsman took decisive steps to set right the administrative administrative injustice.
items.ex_zh: 监察专员采取果断措施，纠正了该行政过程中的不公待遇。

items.def_zh: 补救，纠正，矫正（差错、弊端等）；消除
items.def_en: To correct, cure, or put right an undesirable situation, problem, or mistake.
items.ex_en: Prompt legislative action is urgently needed to remedy the severe housing shortage.
items.ex_zh: 迫切需要采取迅速的立法行动来补救严重的住房短缺问题。

items.def_zh: （使）清醒，醒酒（通常作sober up）；（使）严肃起来，冷静下来
items.def_en: (often followed by 'up') To become or cause someone to become sober after drinking alcohol, or to become calm, serious, and thoughtful.
items.ex_en: A cup of strong black coffee helped sober him up after dinner.
items.ex_zh: 一杯浓烈的黑咖啡帮助他在晚饭后醒了醒酒。
items.ex2_en: The drunken sailor sobered up rapidly after taking a freezing cold shower.
items.ex2_zh: 喝醉的水手冲了个刺骨的冷水澡后很快清醒了过来。

items.def_zh: 重新设置，重置；（使断骨）复位；重新安装
items.def_en: 1. To adjust a machine, device, or digital system back to its original or default setting. 2. To put a broken bone back into the correct position to heal.
items.ex_en: The technician advised the user to reset the wireless router to factory settings.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员建议用户将无线路由器重新重置为出厂设置。

items.def_en: to restore someone or something to a previous position, rank, or functional state
items.ex_en: The governing board voted to reinstate the dismissed professor to his academic post.
items.ex_zh: 管理委员会投票决定恢复被解雇教授的原职学术岗位。

items.def_en: to put right a mistake, imbalance, or undesirable state of affairs
items.ex_en: Management took immediate procedural steps to rectify the accounting error before the audit.
items.ex_zh: 管理层在审计之前立即采取程序性措施纠正了该会计错误。

items.def_zh: 修复，改造（建筑等使其恢复良好状态）；使康复，使恢复正常生活；恢复（名誉、地位）
items.def_en: 1. To repair, renovate, or restore a building, environment, or system to good condition. 2. To help someone return to a healthy, normal life after illness, addiction, or imprisonment.
items.ex_en: The municipal agency secured millions in federal grants to rehabilitate deteriorating urban wetlands.
items.ex_zh: 市政机构获得了数百万联邦拨款，用于修复日趋恶化的城市湿地生态。

items.def_en: to remedy or set right an unfair situation or grievance
items.ex_en: The tribunal awarded financial compensation to redress the severe injuries suffered by workers.
items.ex_zh: 仲裁法庭裁决给予经济赔偿，以弥补工人们遭受的严重伤害。

items.def_en: to recover from illness, exhaustion, or severe financial losses
items.ex_en: The injured athlete retired to a quiet mountain village to recuperate slowly.
items.ex_zh: 受伤的运动员隐退到一个宁静的山村慢慢康复休养。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe taking corrective action to counter an impairment, reset an abnormal condition, or bring an injured, broken, or troubled entity back to sound health and order.
groups.summary_zh: 采取补救或矫正行动，纠正缺陷或使失调对象重归正常健康状态。
groups.desc_en: Correcting a malfunction, disorder, or injustice to restore a system or situation to proper standard alignment, contrasting with physical replacement or unassisted recovery.
groups.desc_zh: 纠正故障、混乱或不公以使系统或局势恢复正常规准，区别于整体替换或自愈。
groups.nuance_en: rectify: adjusting an error, flaw, or systemic unfairness back to standard (mistake / injustice / deficiency) · remedy: supplying an effective cure or corrective solution for a chronic problem (grievance / defect / situation) · sort out: resolving tangled confusion or personal disputes into orderly form (finances / mess / dispute) · reinstate: restoring someone or something to an original lost position or authority (privilege / official / policy) · reset: bringing an instrument, bone, or relationship back to baseline state (counter / password / bone)
groups.nuance_zh: rectify: 将失误、缺陷或偏差修正回归规准 (mistake / injustice / deficiency) · remedy: 为长期存在的弊端提供补救或治疗措施 (grievance / defect / situation) · sort out: 理清纷乱局面或妥处争端 (finances / mess / dispute) · reinstate: 使人员或制度复归原职原权 (privilege / official / policy) · reset: 将计数器、关节或状态重置回初始基准 (counter / password / bone)

groups.name: Represent & Embody · 代表与象征 (Represent, Typify, Epitomize)
groups.tip: 具象化体现与象征某种特质

items.def_zh: 象征，体现；代表；描绘，展现
items.def_en: 1. To be a symbol or embodiment of something. 2. To act or speak officially on behalf of someone. 3. To describe or portray something in a particular way.
items.ex_en: The stylized olive branch represents peace and universal reconciliation across all cultures.
items.ex_zh: 图案化的橄榄枝在所有文化中都象征着和平与普遍和解。

items.def_en: (stand for sth) to serve as a symbol, abbreviation, or representation of something
items.ex_en: The school management will not stand for any form of bullying on campus.
items.ex_zh: 学校管理层绝不容忍校园内出现任何形式的霸凌行为。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) represent the views, wishes, or character of a person or group
items.ex_en: The union delegate was officially chosen to speak for all factory workers.
items.ex_zh: 工会代表被正式选出，代表所有工厂工人的心声发言。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) represent or embody the typical characteristics of someone or something
items.ex_en: His selfless devotion to public service truly sums up the community spirit.
items.ex_zh: 他投身公共服务的无私奉献，真正体现了社区精神的精髓。

items.def_en: to express, personify, or give a tangible physical form to an idea or quality
items.ex_en: The new constitutional amendment embodies the fundamental democratic values of our nation.
items.ex_zh: 这项新宪法修正案体现了我们国家根本的民主价值观。

items.def_zh: 作为……的典范，体现；例证，例示
items.def_en: To be a typical or perfect example of a quality, style, or rule; to show or illustrate by giving an example.
items.ex_en: Her distinguished academic career exemplifies the highest standards of rigorous scientific inquiry.
items.ex_zh: 她卓越的学术生涯体现了严谨科学探究的最高典范。

items.def_en: To embody or represent a quality, spirit, or idea in human or physical form.
items.ex_en: To his loyal followers, the revered general incarnated military courage and honor.
items.ex_zh: 在其忠诚的追随者眼中，这位受人尊敬的将军便是军人勇气与荣耀的化身。

items.def_zh: 是……的化身，体现；把……拟人化
items.def_en: 1. To be a perfect example of a quality or idea; to embody. 2. To represent an abstract quality or thing as a human figure in art or literature.
items.ex_en: The dedicated doctor seemed to personify professional compassion and kindness to every patient.
items.ex_zh: 在每位病人眼中，这位敬业的医生仿佛就是职业同情心与仁善的化身。

items.def_en: To represent an idea, quality, or entity by means of a symbol; to be a symbol of something.
items.ex_en: White doves traditionally symbolise purity, enduring innocence, and unyielding hope in Western art.
items.ex_zh: 在西方艺术中，白鸽传统上象征着纯洁、持久的无辜以及不屈的希望。

items.def_zh: 是……的典型特征，代表；作为……的典型
items.def_en: To be a classic or typical example of a particular group, style, or condition; to characterize.
items.ex_en: These towering brick chimneys perfectly typify industrial architecture of the late nineteenth century.
items.ex_zh: 这些高耸的砖砌烟囱完全代表了十九世纪晚期工业建筑的典型特征。

items.def_zh: 作为……的典型，成为……的缩影；概括，摘要
items.def_en: 1. To be a perfect or typical example of a particular quality, style, or type. 2. To give a summary of something.
items.ex_en: Her sophisticated fashion choices epitomize timeless elegance and classic British tailoring.
items.ex_zh: 她高雅的穿搭品味堪称永恒优雅与经典英伦剪裁的完美缩影。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate serving as a visible, living, or archetypal manifestation of an abstract quality, idea, group, or institutional identity.
groups.summary_zh: 指作为某种抽象特质、概念或群体的具象化体现、象征或典型代表。
groups.desc_en: Serving as a tangible, concrete, or authorized stand-in that manifests an abstract concept, group, or principle, contrasting with direct self-expression or causal generation.
groups.desc_zh: 作为具象化或获授权的代表，彰显抽象概念、群体或原则，区别于直接自我表达或因果催生。
groups.nuance_en: represent: acting as a legally designated proxy or standing as a symbol for a whole (constituents / company / nation) · embody: expressing an abstract idea or quality in complete physical or behavioral form (spirit / ideal / values) · personify: treating or exhibiting an abstraction as a living human character (greed / elegance / evil) · exemplify: serving as a quintessential typical model or prime example of (trend / virtues / success) · stand for: serving as an agreed semantic symbol or enduring principle (initials / justice / freedom)
groups.nuance_zh: represent: 作为法定代理人或代指整体的符号 (constituents / company / nation) · embody: 在实体或行为上全方位具象化抽象理念 (spirit / ideal / values) · personify: 将抽象品质人格化、典型化体现 (greed / elegance / evil) · exemplify: 作为典型范例或典范来佐证 (trend / virtues / success) · stand for: 约定俗成地代表符号或捍卫原则 (initials / justice / freedom)

groups.name: Respiratory Mechanics & Exertion · 呼吸与喘息机制 (Inhale, Puff, Gasp)
groups.tip: 剧烈运动后急促短浅喘气

items.def_en: (+ sth) to take air, gas, or vapor into your lungs through the nose or mouth
items.ex_en: Breathe in deeply through your nose and hold it for three seconds.
items.ex_zh: 用鼻子深吸一口气，屏住三秒钟。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to expel air or gas from your lungs through the nose or mouth
items.ex_en: Relax your shoulders and breathe out slowly through your mouth.
items.ex_zh: 放松肩膀，通过嘴巴缓缓呼气。

items.def_en: (+ air/breath) to pull a breath or volume of air deeply into the lungs
items.ex_en: She stepped outside to draw in a deep lungful of crisp mountain air.
items.ex_zh: 她走到室外，深深地吸了一口山间清新的空气。

items.def_en: [I/T] breathe out air, vapor, or smoke from the lungs
items.ex_en: He closed his eyes and slowly exhaled the warm steam from his tea.
items.ex_zh: 他闭上双眼，缓缓呼出茶水冒出的温热蒸汽。

items.def_zh: 抽鼻涕，吸鼻子（常因哭泣或感冒）
items.def_en: To breathe in repeatedly through a runny or congested nose with a quiet sniffing sound, especially when crying or ill.
items.ex_en: The tearful child continued to sniffle quietly while gripping her mother's hand.
items.ex_zh: 那个泪眼汪汪的孩子紧紧拉着妈妈的手，继续轻轻抽泣吸鼻涕。

items.def_en: breathe with short, quick, labored breaths, typically from exertion or heat
items.ex_en: The tired dog began to pant loudly after sprinting across the sunny yard.
items.ex_zh: 那只累坏了的狗在阳光普照的院子里飞奔后，开始大声喘粗气。

items.def_zh: 气喘吁吁，大口喘气；喷出（烟、气）；抽（烟）
items.def_en: 1. To breathe loudly and rapidly, especially after strenuous physical exercise. 2. To blow or send out bursts of smoke, steam, or air; to smoke a pipe, cigarette, or cigar.
items.ex_en: He puffed heavily as he hauled the heavy luggage up the steep stairs.
items.ex_zh: 当他把沉重的行李拖上陡峭的楼梯时，累得气喘吁吁。

items.def_en: 1. To take a sudden, sharp, quick breath through the mouth because of shock, pain, or breathlessness. 2. (+ for) To crave or desperately need something.
items.ex_en: The audience gasped in sudden horror when the acrobat lost his balance.
items.ex_zh: 当杂技演员失去平衡时，观众们惊恐地倒抽了一口凉气。

items.def_en: 1. To breathe air, smoke, or vapor into the lungs. 2. (informal) To eat or drink something extremely quickly.
items.ex_en: The hungry teenager managed to inhale three large slices of pizza within minutes.
items.ex_zh: 那个饥肠辘辘的少年不出几分钟就狼吞虎咽地吃下了三块大披萨。

items.def_en: breathe with a whistling, rattling sound, resulting from obstructed airways
items.ex_en: His chest felt tight, causing him to wheeze with every laboured breath.
items.ex_zh: 他感到胸口发闷，每一次吃力的呼吸都伴随着哮鸣声。

items.def_zh: 过度通气，极度急促呼吸
items.def_en: breathe at an abnormally rapid rate, typically induced by panic or anxiety
items.ex_en: The terrified passenger began to hyperventilate during the severe mid-flight turbulence.
items.ex_zh: 在飞机遭遇剧烈颠簸期间，惊恐万状的乘客开始极度急促地呼吸。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify the physical manner and physiological conditions of respiration, including sudden sharp intakes due to shock or oxygen deficit (gasp), labored intermittent expulsion from exertion (puff), nasal inhalation related to irritation or crying (sniffle), and standard deep inhalation (inhale).
groups.summary_zh: 描绘呼吸的具体生理方式与状态，如急促喘气、吃力喷气或深吸气。
groups.desc_en: Manner-focused pulmonary intake and expulsion of air, modulated by physiological strain, emotion, or vocal distress, contrasting with quiescent metabolic breathing.
groups.desc_zh: 受生理负荷、情绪或咽喉阻滞影响而表现出的吸排气行为，区别于静止下的平稳呼吸。
groups.nuance_en: inhale: drawing air or substance into the lungs by negative pressure (air / smoke / medication) · exhale: expelling breath outwards, often deliberately or expressively (smoke / sigh / breath) · gasp: catching one's breath suddenly in sharp distress or shock (air / shock / pain) · pant: breathing rapidly and shallowly from extreme physical exertion or heat (exhaustion / exertion / breath) · puff: breathing heavily in short, forceful bursts while straining (cigar / hill / breath)
groups.nuance_zh: inhale: 靠负压将空气或气体深吸入肺 (air / smoke / medication) · exhale: 向外呼出气体，常带有情绪或刻意舒缓 (smoke / sigh / breath) · gasp: 因震惊、剧痛或缺氧猛然倒抽一口气 (air / shock / pain) · pant: 因剧烈运动或过热而急促浅短地喘气 (exhaustion / exertion / breath) · puff: 在重负荷下气喘吁吁地短促喷气 (cigar / hill / breath)

groups.name: Restore & Renew · 恢复与更新 (Rejuvenate, Revitalize, Regenerate)
groups.tip: 修整翻新使其重回最初状态

items.def_en: to return something or someone to a former good condition, health, or position
items.ex_en: Careful conservation efforts helped restore the ancient fresco to its former glory.
items.ex_zh: 精细的修复工作帮助这幅古老壁画恢复了往日的辉煌。

items.def_zh: 使恢复，使更新；延长……的有效期；重新开始
items.def_en: 1. To restore something to a new, fresh, or improved condition. 2. To extend the validity of an agreement or document. 3. To resume something after an interruption.
items.ex_en: The warm spring rains renew the dry soil after a harsh, barren winter.
items.ex_zh: 在严酷荒凉的冬日过后，温暖的春雨使干涸的土地恢复了生机。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to return someone or something to a previous healthy, active, or flourishing condition
items.ex_en: The new manager hoped to bring back the bakery's once flourishing reputation.
items.ex_zh: 新经理希望能够恢复这家面包店往昔繁荣的声誉。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make someone or something look, feel, or become cleaner, cooler, or more vigorous
items.ex_en: I need to wash my face and freshen up before the evening party.
items.ex_zh: 在晚会开始前，我得洗把脸，好让自己精神精神。
items.ex2_en: A cool breeze and fresh flowers freshened up the stuffy conference room.
items.ex2_zh: 一阵凉风和鲜花让沉闷的会议室空气焕然一新。

items.def_zh: 重振旗鼓；迅速恢复生机
items.def_en: to recover quickly from an illness, setback, exhaustion, or state of decline
items.ex_en: Local businesses expect to bounce back quickly after the devastating winter storm.
items.ex_zh: 当地企业期望在灾难性的冬季风暴过后迅速重振旗鼓。

items.def_zh: 使恢复精力，使振作；使想起，提示；刷新（网页等）
items.def_en: 1. To make someone feel less tired, hot, or weary. 2. (refresh someone's memory) To remind someone of something. 3. (computing) To update or reload a computer screen or display.
items.ex_en: Gentle twilight breezes arrived to refresh the weary wanderer beside the shadowed stream.
items.ex_zh: 黄昏的微风拂面而来，让幽暗溪流畔疲惫的游子顿觉心旷神怡。

items.def_zh: 恢复（原状），重回（旧习）；（财产等）归还原主
items.def_en: 1. (+ to) To return to a former state, habit, or condition. 2. (+ to) (law) (of property or rights) To return to the original owner or their heirs.
items.ex_en: Without strict administrative oversight, the department might revert to inefficient historical practices.
items.ex_zh: 若缺乏严格的行政监管，该部门可能会重蹈低效旧习。

items.def_zh: 使重获新生，注入新活力
items.def_en: to imbue something with new life, vigor, energy, or economic strength
items.ex_en: Substantial private investments helped revitalize the city's declining industrial waterfront district.
items.ex_zh: 大量的私人投资帮助重振了该市日趋衰落的滨水工业区。

items.def_zh: 使返老还童，使恢复活力
items.def_en: to make someone or something look, feel, or function much younger or more lively
items.ex_en: The relaxing spa retreat seemed to rejuvenate both her body and weary spirit.
items.ex_zh: 这次放松的水疗静修似乎使她的身心都焕发出青春与活力。

items.def_zh: 解压缩（数字文件或数据）
items.def_en: 1. (computing) To restore a compressed digital file or data back to its original full size.
items.ex_en: The software engineer used a dedicated script to uncompress the extensive archive.
items.ex_zh: 软件工程师使用专门的脚本将庞大的归档文件解压缩。

items.def_zh: 翻新（废旧轮胎）；重新使用（旧观念、旧素材等）
items.def_en: 1. To put a new tread on a worn tire. 2. (informal) To reuse or present old material or ideas in a slightly new form.
items.ex_en: The film studio decided to retread the same tired superhero plot once again.
items.ex_zh: 这家电影制片厂决定把那套早已过时的超级英雄剧情再次拿来翻炒。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote bringing an entity back to a previous functional condition, youthfulness, freshness, or original uncorrupted baseline.
groups.summary_zh: 消除损耗、疲惫或变化，使事物回归最初的精力充沛、全新运作或原始状态。
groups.desc_en: Reinfusing vigor, health, or pristine original capacity back into an exhausted, faded, or decayed state, contrasting with simple maintenance or creating brand-new qualities.
groups.desc_zh: 为衰退、疲惫或损耗的状态重新注入活力、生命力或恢复初始完好，区别于常规维护或创造全新事物。
groups.nuance_en: restore: bringing an impaired object, health, or right back to its former sound state (peace / sight / monument) · renew: revitalizing an expiring agreement, vigor, or commitment to extend duration (contract / vows / strength) · revitalize: injecting dynamic energy into a stagnant or declining entity (economy / neighborhood / team) · refresh: resting or cooling the body/mind to clear fatigue (memory / page / spirit) · bounce back: recovering resiliently and quickly from adversity or illness (defeat / recession / injury)
groups.nuance_zh: restore: 使受损的物件、健康或秩序恢复原有健全 (peace / sight / monument) · renew: 续签契约或使疲惫的心力重现充沛 (contract / vows / strength) · revitalize: 给停滞或衰颓的机体注入全新生机与动能 (economy / neighborhood / team) · refresh: 通过休整或凉爽清除疲劳与记忆模糊 (memory / page / spirit) · bounce back: 从逆境或重创中迅速且有弹性地复原 (defeat / recession / injury)

groups.name: Rot & Decompose · 腐烂与降解
groups.tip: 有机物质生物降解与腐朽

items.def_en: decay or rot with an offensive, foul odor via bacterial action
items.ex_en: The abandoned meat began to putrefy rapidly under the blazing desert sun.
items.ex_zh: 遗弃的肉类在烈日当头的沙漠下迅速腐烂发臭。
items.ex2_en: Deadly bacterial infections putrefied the damaged tissue inside the untreated wound.
items.ex2_zh: 致命的细菌感染使未处理伤口内的受损组织发生溃烂腐败。

items.def_en: decay gradually until nothing or very little remains
items.ex_en: The wooden fence posts will gradually rot away in the damp marshy ground.
items.ex_zh: 木质栅栏柱在潮湿的沼泽泥土中会逐渐腐烂殆尽。

items.def_en: decay or decompose biologically or chemically into simpler substances
items.ex_en: Organic waste materials break down naturally into nutrient-rich compost over several months.
items.ex_zh: 有机废料会在几个月内自然分解为富含养分的堆肥。
items.ex2_en: Beneficial soil microbes break down synthetic polymers into benign organic substances safely.
items.ex2_zh: 有益的土壤微生物将合成聚合物安全地分解为无害的有机物质。

items.def_en: (of food or drink) become stale, sour, or rotten and unfit to eat
items.ex_en: Don't drink that milk; it will go off if left outside the fridge.
items.ex_zh: 别喝那牛奶；放在冰箱外面它会变质的。

items.def_en: (of food) become unfit for eating through biological aging or contamination
items.ex_en: Fresh berries spoil very quickly unless they are stored in the refrigerator.
items.ex_zh: 新鲜浆果如果不存放在冰箱里，很快就会腐坏变质。
items.ex2_en: High humidity and scorching heat quickly spoiled the open cartons of milk.
items.ex2_zh: 高湿度和闷热迅速让开封的牛奶变质了。

items.def_en: rot or undergo gradual natural breakdown through fungal or microbial activity
items.ex_en: Fallen leaves decay on the forest floor, nourishing the roots of ancient trees.
items.ex_zh: 落叶在林间地面上腐烂分解，滋养着古树的根须。
items.ex2_en: Aggressive fungal microbes slowly decayed the damp cedar fence posts over time.
items.ex2_zh: 侵蚀性的真菌微生物随着时间的推移慢慢腐烂了潮湿的雪松栅栏柱。

items.def_en: undergo natural decomposition; become putrid and break down
items.ex_en: Untreated timber left exposed to rain will rot within a single season.
items.ex_zh: 未处理的原木经雨水浸泡，不到一个季节就会腐朽烂掉。
items.ex2_en: Continuous moisture and warm fungus rotted the unprotected wooden garden bridge completely.
items.ex2_zh: 持续的湿气和温暖环境下的真菌使未受保护的木制花园桥彻底腐烂了。

items.def_en: decay and break down into constituent physical and chemical elements
items.ex_en: Specialized microbes decompose organic matter into fundamental chemical nutrients in the soil.
items.ex_zh: 专门的微生物将有机物分解为土壤中最基础的化学养分。
items.ex2_en: Fallen autumn leaves decompose slowly into rich, fertile woodland soil over winter.
items.ex2_zh: 秋天的落叶在冬季慢慢分解成肥沃的林地土壤。

items.def_en: (chiefly British spelling of molder) To decay, rot, and crumble away slowly from neglect or disuse.
items.ex_en: Forgotten volumes moulder in the damp cellars of the abandoned Victorian manor.
items.ex_zh: 被遗忘的书卷在荒废的维多利亚庄园潮湿的地窖中逐渐霉烂腐朽。

items.def_en: (US spelling of moulder) To decay, rot, and crumble away slowly from neglect or disuse.
items.ex_en: Ancient tapestries molder into dust within the abandoned, shadow-haunted library chambers.
items.ex_zh: 古老的挂毯在荒废幽暗的藏书楼中逐渐化为尘土。

items.def_en: To break down naturally through the action of bacteria or other living organisms, or cause something to do this.
items.ex_en: These plant-based packing materials biodegrade safely in standard home compost bins.
items.ex_zh: 这些植物基包装材料可在标准的家庭堆肥箱中安全降解。
items.ex2_en: Naturally occurring soil microbes biodegrade synthetic agricultural mulch over several humid summer months.
items.ex2_zh: 天然土壤微生物在几个潮湿的夏月里生物降解了合成农用塑料薄膜。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to organic matter breaking down, deteriorating, or undergoing biochemical disintegration due to bacterial, fungal, or natural environmental action.
groups.summary_zh: 有机物在细菌、真菌或环境作用下逐渐崩解、腐败、分化分解。
groups.desc_en: Natural or organic deterioration where biological matter disintegrates into simpler, foul, or inert substances, contrasting with deliberate demolition or dry mechanical erosion.
groups.desc_zh: 有机生物体自然劣变分解释放出腐败物或还原为惰性物质，区别于机械磨损或人为拆解。
groups.nuance_en: rot: decomposing organically into a softened, foul, or ruined mass (fruit / timber / teeth) · decay: progressively declining, withering, or decomposing over time (teeth / corpse / vegetation) · decompose: breaking down chemically into constituent elemental compounds (matter / leaf / corpse) · putrefy: rotting with extreme foul odor due to bacterial anaerobic action (flesh / bodies / remains) · spoil: becoming unfit for consumption due to bacterial degradation (milk / food / meat)
groups.nuance_zh: rot: 有机物变质软烂并发出恶臭损毁 (fruit / timber / teeth) · decay: 随时间推移逐渐萎缩、蛀蚀或退化 (teeth / corpse / vegetation) · decompose: 发生化学分解还原为基础化合物 (matter / leaf / corpse) · putrefy: 动物肉体在厌氧细菌下发臭腐烂 (flesh / bodies / remains) · spoil: 食物因细菌作用而变味腐败不可食用 (milk / food / meat)

groups.name: Rouse, Excite & Inflame Emotions · 激发、激昂与煽动情绪 (Rouse, Excite & Inflame)
groups.tip: 调动积极热情或煽动情绪的行动

items.def_en: to arouse strong feelings, curiosity, or emotional engagement within someone
items.ex_en: The patriotic anthem never failed to stir profound pride in their hearts.
items.ex_zh: 这首爱国颂歌总能在他们心中激起强烈的自豪之情。
items.ex2_en: Old childhood memories stirred quietly within his heart as he walked through town.
items.ex2_zh: 当他走过城镇时，儿时的旧回忆在心中悄然泛起。

items.def_en: to arouse, inspire, or start building up a strong emotion, interest, or hope
items.ex_en: Her encouraging words kindle a quiet hope within his long-despairing heart.
items.ex_zh: 她鼓励的话语在他久经绝望的心中点燃了一丝微弱的希望。
items.ex2_en: A renewed sense of hope kindled quietly within her weary spirit overnight.
items.ex2_zh: 一夜之间，一种重新燃起的希望在她疲惫的心灵中悄然生起。

items.def_zh: 使兴奋，使激动；激发，引起
items.def_en: 1. To make someone feel enthusiastic, eager, or agitated. 2. To cause or provoke a particular reaction or feeling.
items.ex_en: The discovery of an ancient tomb will excite historians across the world.
items.ex_zh: 古墓的发现必将激起全世界历史学家的浓厚兴趣与兴奋。

items.def_zh: 鼓舞，激励，使振作；（与 away/off 连用）暗中带走，偷偷掳走
items.def_en: 1. (often spirit up) To animate, encourage, or fill with energy and enthusiasm. 2. (spirit away/off) To remove or carry off secretly and quickly.
items.ex_en: Eloquent speeches spirit the tired soldiers to face another dawn of battle.
items.ex_zh: 慷慨激昂的演说鼓舞着疲惫的士兵去迎接又一个战斗的黎明。

items.def_en: (+ sb) fill someone with intense enthusiasm, passion, or anger
items.ex_en: The coach's speech fired up the team before the final match.
items.ex_zh: 决赛前，教练的演讲彻底点燃了全队的斗志。

items.def_en: (+ sth) excite, stimulate, or provoke strong, often disruptive emotions or trouble in people
items.ex_en: Irresponsible rumors stir up unnecessary fear and hostility among the local residents.
items.ex_zh: 不负责任的谣言在当地居民中激起了不必要的恐慌与敌意。

items.def_en: (+ sth) deliberately excite and encourage very strong emotion or agitation among people
items.ex_en: Sensational headlines whip up public anger against the newly proposed tax hike.
items.ex_zh: 耸人听闻的头条新闻煽动起公众对新拟增税方案的极大愤怒。

items.def_zh: 激励，鼓舞；赋予灵感；引起，激起
items.def_en: 1. To fill someone with confidence, enthusiasm, or the desire to do something. 2. To stimulate someone's creative capacity or produce inspiration for something.
items.ex_en: Her courage continues to inspire young athletes to pursue their ambitious dreams.
items.ex_zh: 她的勇气继续激励着年轻运动员们去勇敢追寻宏大的梦想。

items.def_zh: 使激动，使兴奋；使电气化，使通电
items.def_en: 1. To fill someone with sudden excitement, thrill, or enthusiasm. 2. To equip a system or railway to operate using electric power; to charge with electricity.
items.ex_en: His breathtaking solo performance managed to electrify the entire concert hall audience.
items.ex_zh: 他惊艳的独奏表演令整个音乐厅的观众为之热血沸腾。

items.def_zh: 激起，煽动（强烈情绪或争端）；使发炎，使红肿
items.def_en: 1. To cause very strong feelings such as anger or passion, or to make an aggressive situation worse. 2. (medical) To cause a part of the body to become swollen, red, and painful.
items.ex_en: His provocative rhetoric served only to inflame bitter hatred among rival factions.
items.ex_zh: 他挑衅性的言辞只会进一步激化敌对派系间的刻骨仇恨。

items.def_en: to shock or stimulate someone into sudden, energetic action or heightened awareness
items.ex_en: The urgent warning galvanize community volunteers into swift and coordinated disaster response.
items.ex_zh: 紧急警告促使社区志愿者们立即行动起来，协调一致应对灾难。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers causing an emotional surge, inspiring deep passion, or stirring up agitation and intense feeling in people. Nuances range from constructive creative inspiration to thrilling excitement and vehement incendiary stimulation.
groups.summary_zh: 引起强烈心理激荡、点燃热情、鼓舞士气或煽动激烈情绪。
groups.desc_en: Igniting or aggressively aggravating dormant, latent, or subdued human passions and collective unrest, contrasting with calm rational persuasion or soothing pacification.
groups.desc_zh: 激发、催化或激化潜藏或低沉的情绪与群体骚动，区别于理性的说服或安抚平息。
groups.nuance_en: stir: nudging dormant emotions or memories into gentle awakeness (sympathy / curiosity / conscience) · kindle: igniting an initial spark of affection, hope, or hostility (interest / passion / hope) · fire up: enthusiastically energizing people for vigorous action (team / crowd / base) · whip up: deliberately contriving frenzied hysteria or anger in a populace (frenzy / enthusiasm / mob) · inspire: uplifting the spirit to produce creative or virtuous endeavors (confidence / loyalty / art)
groups.nuance_zh: stir: 拨动潜藏的情愫或良知使之萌动 (sympathy / curiosity / conscience) · kindle: 点燃爱慕、希望或敌意之火 (interest / passion / hope) · fire up: 激励人群热情，使其摩拳擦掌投入行动 (team / crowd / base) · whip up: 刻意煽动起暴怒、狂乱或非理性情绪 (frenzy / enthusiasm / mob) · inspire: 激荡心灵催生崇高品格或创造力 (confidence / loyalty / art)

groups.name: Rustle & Whirr · 杂音与摩擦作响 (Rustle, Whirr, Creak)
groups.tip: 器物摩擦或转动发低沉杂音

items.def_en: to make a continuous low, smooth, vibrating mechanical or electrical sound
items.ex_en: The massive electrical transformers hum softly in the quiet night air.
items.ex_zh: 巨大的变压器在寂静的夜空下发出低沉平稳的嗡嗡声。

items.def_zh: （使）发出沙沙声；偷盗（牛、马等牲畜）
items.def_en: 1. To make or cause to make a soft, light sound like dry leaves or paper rubbing together. 2. (informal) To steal cattle, horses, or other livestock.
items.ex_en: Dry autumn leaves rustle across the pavement whenever the chilly wind blows.
items.ex_zh: 每当寒风刮过，干燥的秋叶便在人行道上发出沙沙声响。
items.ex2_en: A gentle night breeze rustled the silk curtains across the open balcony.
items.ex2_zh: 一阵温柔的夜风拂动了敞开阳台上的丝绸窗帘。

items.def_zh: 发出尖细声音；尖声作响
items.def_en: make a sudden high-pitched sound or noise
items.ex_en: Suddenly, a tiny whistle pipe up from the back of the workshop.
items.ex_zh: 突然间，车间后头传出一声尖细短促的呼哨。

items.def_en: move along quickly while producing a series of sharp, knocking sounds
items.ex_en: The ancient diesel delivery trucks rattle along the cobblestone streets every morning.
items.ex_zh: 古旧的柴油送货卡车每天早晨都会在鹅卵石街道上咔嗒作响地疾驰而过。

items.def_en: to make a short, very high-pitched sound due to friction or movement
items.ex_en: The worn floorboards squeak whenever someone walks near the master bedroom door.
items.ex_zh: 每当有人走近主卧门口时，磨损的地板便会发出刺耳的吱吱声。

items.def_zh: 发出嘎吱声，发出咯吱声
items.def_en: 1. To make a harsh, high-pitched squeaking sound, especially when being moved or under pressure.
items.ex_en: The old wooden stairs creak loudly under the weight of heavy footsteps.
items.ex_zh: 老旧的木楼梯在沉重脚步的压迫下发出刺耳的嘎吱声。

items.def_zh: 发出呼呼声（或嗡嗡声、飕飕声）
items.def_en: 1. To make a continuous, low, soft buzzing or humming sound, like spinning blades or machinery.
items.ex_en: The powerful computer fans whirr steadily as demanding software processes complex data.
items.ex_zh: 当大型软件处理复杂数据时，强大的电脑风扇持续平稳地呼呼作响。

items.def_zh: 发出持续低沉的嗡嗡声；轻弹，拨弄（弦乐器）
items.def_en: 1. To make a continuous low, rhythmic humming or vibrating sound; to play idly or rhythmically on a stringed instrument.
items.ex_en: Distant boat engines thrum steadily against the quiet hush of the lake.
items.ex_zh: 远处的船用发动机在静谧的湖面上发出沉稳持续的嗡鸣声。

items.def_en: to make a rapid series of short, sharp, knocking sounds when vibrating
items.ex_en: The loose window panes rattle violently against the frame during fierce gales.
items.ex_zh: 狂风肆虐时，松动的窗玻璃在窗框上被震得格格乱响。
items.ex2_en: The terrifying earthquake rattled delicate china plates inside the antique display cabinet.
items.ex2_zh: 可怕的地震震得古董陈列柜里的精致瓷盘咯咯作响。

items.def_zh: 发出沉闷的金属撞击声，发出哐啷声
items.def_en: 1. To make a heavy, dull, metallic sound, or move with such a sound.
items.ex_en: The heavy iron gears clunk together noisily inside the ancient factory press.
items.ex_zh: 古老厂房冲压机内沉重的铁齿轮发出喧闹而沉闷的撞击声。

items.def_zh: 发出咔嗒声，隆隆作响；咔嗒咔嗒地奔跑
items.def_en: (dialect or literary) To make a loud, rattling or clattering sound; to run or move with a clatter.
items.ex_en: Fierce gusts of hail brattle fiercely against the frosted chapel windows.
items.ex_zh: 狂暴的冰雹噼里啪啦地猛烈敲打着结了霜的小教堂窗户。

groups.summary_en: Non-vocal acoustic sound emissions produced by friction, mechanical rotation, low-frequency resonance, or structural strain. Verbs depict the specific tactile textures and cadences producing the sound.
groups.summary_zh: 物体因摩擦、旋转、低频振动或受力变形所产生的特定微杂音。
groups.desc_en: Producing low-amplitude, continuous, dry, or friction-based auditory signatures indicative of mechanical movement or dry contact, contrasting with sharp loud percussive crashes.
groups.desc_zh: 发出由轻微连续摩擦或机械旋转产生的低响度音效，区别于剧烈高亢的撞击轰鸣。
groups.nuance_en: rustle: producing a crisp, whispering sound by moving dry, thin materials (leaves / paper / silk) · whirr: making a rapid continuous buzzing sound from spinning blades or motors (blades / motor / hard drive) · creak: emitting a harsh, grating sound from strained, unlubricated wood or metal (floorboards / stairs / door) · squeak: giving a short, high-pitched shrill noise from sharp friction (shoes / mouse / hinge) · thrum: emitting a steady, rhythmic low vibrational humming (engine / rain / guitar)
groups.nuance_zh: rustle: 干薄之物相互拂动发出沙沙细响 (leaves / paper / silk) · whirr: 叶片或马达极速旋转发出的呼呼转动声 (blades / motor / hard drive) · creak: 缺乏润滑的木板或金属受压发出吱呀摩擦声 (floorboards / stairs / door) · squeak: 尖锐摩擦发出的短促尖叫或吱吱声 (shoes / mouse / hinge) · thrum: 稳定低频有节律的震颤轰鸣 (engine / rain / guitar)

groups.name: Sate & Blase Deadening · 厌倦与麻木脱敏 (Pall, Cloy, Desensitize)
groups.tip: 腻烦生倦直至心神麻木

items.def_en: [I/T] to become tired of something, or cause someone to lose enthusiasm through repetition
items.ex_en: Endless petty bureaucratic squabbles weary even the most patient public servants.
items.ex_zh: 没完没了的官僚琐碎争执让哪怕最有耐心的公职人员也心生厌倦。
items.ex2_en: Tired travelers wear of long delays during hectic holiday airport journeys.
items.ex2_zh: 疲惫的旅客在繁忙的假日机场行程中对漫长的延误感到厌倦。

items.def_zh: 变得漠然；停止关注与感受
items.def_en: cease paying attention, lose interest, or emotionally detach from what is happening around one
items.ex_en: After a grueling week, she just wanted to switch off and read a novel.
items.ex_zh: 经历了一周的高压工作，她只想放空大脑、读本小说放松一下。

items.def_en: to exhaust interest or emotional energy gradually
items.ex_en: Relentless customer complaints finally jolly all enthusiasm out of the retail clerk.
items.ex_zh: 没完没了的客户投诉终于把这名零售店员的热情消耗殆尽。

items.def_en: (+ sb) gradually reduce someone's physical or emotional resistance, spirit, or enthusiasm through constant exposure
items.ex_en: Persistent negotiations finally wore down the opposition's resistance.
items.ex_zh: 旷日持久的谈判最终瓦解了反对派的抵抗意志。
items.ex2_en: The rubber soles will wear down quickly from running on rough asphalt.
items.ex2_zh: 在粗糙的沥青路面上跑步会导致橡胶鞋底迅速磨损变薄。

items.def_zh: 使人生厌，变得乏味，失去吸引力
items.def_en: To become uninteresting, boring, or tiresome, especially because of having had too much of something.
items.ex_en: The lavish parties soon began to pall on the exhausted young socialite.
items.ex_zh: 奢靡的派对很快让这位身心俱疲的年轻名媛感到索然无味。

items.def_zh: 使醒悟，使幻灭，使不再着迷
items.def_en: (usually passive) To free someone from false illusions so they feel disappointed with something or someone they once admired.
items.ex_en: Broken political promises deeply disenchant voters across many once-loyal suburban districts.
items.ex_zh: 违背的政治承诺让许多曾经忠诚的郊区选民感到无比失望和幻灭。

items.raw_cluster: 使麻木与冷漠 Numb & Harden
items.def_zh: 使麻木，使麻木不仁；脱敏，使减弱敏感性
items.def_en: 1. To make someone less emotionally sensitive or shocked by repeatedly exposing them to pain, violence, or suffering. 2. To reduce the physical or allergic sensitivity of an organism.
items.ex_en: Constant exposure to simulated media violence can gradually desensitize impressionable adolescent viewers.
items.ex_zh: 经常接触模拟的媒体暴力会使易受影响的青少年观众逐渐变得麻木不仁。

items.def_zh: （因过多而）使人生腻，倒胃口，使生厌
items.def_en: To become or cause someone to become sickened or bored through an excess of sweetness, richness, or sentimentality.
items.ex_en: Excessive compliments and artificial sentiment cloy after weeks of constant flattery.
items.ex_zh: 接连数周的奉承与过分虚伪的情话很快就让人腻烦透顶。
items.ex2_en: Overly rich creamy desserts cloy the delicate palates of the dinner guests.
items.ex2_zh: 过于浓郁的奶油甜点让晚宴客人的娇嫩味蕾感到腻烦。

items.def_en: become completely exhausted and lose motivation or emotional responsiveness through prolonged stress or overwork
items.ex_en: Long shifts without adequate rest caused dedicated nurses to burn out rapidly.
items.ex_zh: 长时间缺乏充足休息的轮班使敬业的护士们迅速陷入情绪耗竭。

items.def_zh: 使厌倦冷漠，使玩世不恭
items.def_en: to make someone dull, cynical, or indifferent through surfeit or overexposure
items.ex_en: Years of political corruption have jaded citizens against trusting any official announcements.
items.ex_zh: 多年的政治腐败让民众变得麻木而玩世不恭，不再相信任何官方声明。

items.def_zh: 使麻木，使失去一切知觉
items.def_en: to deaden physical feeling or completely paralyze emotional sensation
items.ex_en: The shocking tragedy seemed to benumb her senses, rendering her completely speechless.
items.ex_zh: 这场令人震惊的悲剧仿佛麻痹了她的所有知觉，使她彻底说不出话来。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the progressive loss of interest, pleasure, or emotional responsiveness due to overexposure, excessive sweetness, disillusionment, or repeated trauma.
groups.summary_zh: 表现因过度沉溺、幻灭或持续刺激而逐渐失去兴致直至情感麻木。
groups.desc_en: Diminishing interest, sensitivity, or pleasure due to over-exposure, excess indulgence, or relentless attrition, contrasting with innate indifference or acute trauma.
groups.desc_zh: 因过度暴露、过度沉溺或长期磨蚀而丧失兴趣、敏感度或愉悦感，区别于先天的冷漠或突发创伤。
groups.nuance_en: cloy: causing disgust or surfeit through excessive sweetness, sentimentality, or richness (sweetness / perfume / flattery) · pall: losing flavor, excitement, or attraction after long familiarity (novelty / routine / charm) · wear down: progressively eroding psychological resolve or resistance through attrition (resolve / opponent / patience) · desensitize: dulling emotional shock or pain through repeated exposure (violence / nerves / public) · disenchant: stripping away romanticized illusions to reveal bleak reality (voters / idealists / believers)
groups.nuance_zh: cloy: 因过分甘甜、腻人或肉麻而令人生腻 (sweetness / perfume / flattery) · pall: 因日久司空见惯而失去新奇与吸引力 (novelty / routine / charm) · wear down: 依靠长久消耗使意志或抵抗逐渐瓦解 (resolve / opponent / patience) · desensitize: 因反复暴露于刺激而对痛感或震惊脱敏 (violence / nerves / public) · disenchant: 打破浪漫幻象暴露出乏味现实 (voters / idealists / believers)

groups.name: Scurry & Dart Rapidly · 疾行与穿梭急走 (Scurry, Dash, Scoot)
groups.tip: 步伐急促短快的奔跑

items.def_zh: 小跑，快步走；（马）小跑疾驰
items.def_en: 1. (of a person) to run with quick, short steps. 2. (of a horse) to move at a speed between a walk and a canter
items.ex_en: The energetic pony began to trot gracefully down the winding country path.
items.ex_zh: 那匹精力充沛的小马开始沿着蜿蜒的乡村小道优雅地小跑起来。

items.def_en: to run away with quick, light, hurried steps, especially like a small child or animal
items.ex_en: The startled rabbits scamper away into the dense brush when hikers approach.
items.ex_zh: 当徒步旅行者靠近时，受惊的野兔纷纷飞快地蹦跳着溜进密林深处。

items.def_en: to leave or dart away very quickly in a hurry
items.ex_en: I must scoot off now before the evening rush hour traffic starts.
items.ex_zh: 在晚高峰交通拥堵开始之前，我现在必须赶紧溜了。

items.def_zh: 急促小跑离开；碎步溜走
items.def_en: to move away with quick, short, hurried steps
items.ex_en: The frightened mouse scuttled away beneath the wooden cupboard as soon as footsteps approached.
items.ex_zh: 脚步声一靠近，那只受惊的老鼠便碎步溜到了木柜下面。

items.def_zh: 仓促疾行，慌忙小跑；悬垂，突出
items.def_en: 1. (informal) to hurry or scurry away quickly like a beetle. 2. (of rocks, cliffs, etc.) to project or overhang
items.ex_en: Late for the train, Arthur beetled down the platform with his heavy leather suitcase.
items.ex_zh: 赶火车快迟到了，亚瑟提着沉重的皮箱沿站台慌忙小跑。

items.def_en: to run with quick, short steps, especially when escaping or hiding
items.ex_en: The crab scuttled across the wet sand to hide under a cluster of rocks.
items.ex_zh: 螃蟹在湿润的沙滩上急促横行，躲入了一堆岩石下面。

items.def_en: to move quickly with short, hurried, agitated steps
items.ex_en: Office workers scurried along the rainy street, eager to reach the shelter of the subway.
items.ex_zh: 上班族在雨中的街道上碎步疾行，急切地想躲进地铁站避雨。

items.def_zh: 疾行，快跑，溜走；挪动，移开
items.def_en: (informal) 1. to go or move somewhere very quickly. 2. to slide or move oneself along a surface (especially to make room for someone)
items.ex_en: I need to scoot over to the grocery store before it closes for the night.
items.ex_zh: 我得在杂货店今晚关门前赶紧快跑过去一趟。

items.def_zh: 欢闹蹦跳地跑；敏捷奔走
items.def_en: to run with quick light steps, especially playfully or timidly
items.ex_en: Two playful puppies scampered across the green lawn, chasing a brightly colored rubber ball.
items.ex_zh: 两只顽皮的小狗在绿茵茵的草地上欢闹奔跑，追逐一只鲜艳的皮球。

items.def_en: to start moving or running away in a sudden, rapid burst of speed
items.ex_en: Startled by the loud horn, the stray cat darted off into the dark alley.
items.ex_zh: 被刺耳的鸣笛声吓了一跳，那只流浪猫猛冲进了漆黑的巷子里。

items.def_en: to move suddenly and rapidly in a specific direction
items.ex_en: A frightened deer darted across the narrow highway and disappeared into the thick forest.
items.ex_zh: 一只受惊的鹿猛然穿过狭窄的公路，消失在密林深处。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame portray small, quick, or hurried foot movements, characterizing animate beings moving rapidly, often in short bursts or with a light, darting, or brisk gait.
groups.summary_zh: 描摹快速轻巧的碎步跑动、急行或短距离迅猛穿梭。
groups.desc_en: Rapid, agile, short-stepped locomotion driven by urgency, stealth, or alarm, contrasting with stately sustained distance running or steady marching.
groups.desc_zh: 出于紧迫、避险或隐蔽需求而采取的敏捷、碎步快速移动，区别于稳健的长跑或大步竞走。
groups.nuance_en: scurry: moving with quick, agitated, bustling short steps to escape or fetch (insects / mice / staff) · scuttle: running briskly with low, hurried steps, often evasively from threat (crab / beetle / away) · scamper: running light-heartedly, playfully, or dartingly like a small animal (children / squirrels / puppies) · scoot: darting away smoothly and instantaneously over a short distance (room / car / over) · trot: moving briskly with a steady, springing two-beat rhythm (horse / pony / toddler)
groups.nuance_zh: scurry: 迈着仓皇碎步慌乱穿行或奔忙 (insects / mice / staff) · scuttle: 压低身姿敏捷碎步逃遁避险 (crab / beetle / away) · scamper: 幼兽或孩童欢快、轻巧地小跑跳跃 (children / squirrels / puppies) · scoot: 倏地一下短距离平滑溜走或挪位 (room / car / over) · trot: 以轻快规整的颠步有节奏小跑 (horse / pony / toddler)

groups.name: Search & Seek · 寻找与搜寻 (Scour, Rummage, Hunt)
groups.tip: 四处探访找寻目标踪迹

items.def_en: search through things in a disordered or messy way to find something
items.ex_en: She rooted around in her deep leather purse trying to find the missing car keys.
items.ex_zh: 她在深大的皮包里翻来找去，试图找出弄丢的车钥匙。

items.def_zh: 寻购古董，搜寻淘宝；使显得陈旧，做旧
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To search for or shop for antiques. 2. To give an object or furniture the appearance of being antique or aged.
items.ex_en: We spent our entire Saturday antiquing through charming rural towns along the southern coast.
items.ex_zh: 我们整个周六都在南部海岸沿线的迷人乡村小镇淘购古董。

items.def_en: (+ for) to wander about widely searching for food or provisions
items.ex_en: During harsh winter months, hungry deer forage for tender twigs under the deep snow.
items.ex_zh: 在严酷的寒冬，饥饿的鹿群在深雪之下四处搜寻嫩树枝充饥。

items.def_en: (+ for) To search for underground water, minerals, or oil using a divining rod or dowsing rod.
items.ex_en: The local farmer used a split hazel branch to dowse for underground spring water.
items.ex_zh: 当地农夫用一根分叉的榛木枝探测地下的泉水。

items.def_en: (+ sth) search persistently until uncovering hidden or elusive information, things, or people
items.ex_en: The persistent journalist worked for months to ferret out the truth behind the scandal.
items.ex_zh: 那位执着的记者调查数月，终于查获了丑闻背后的真相。

items.def_en: 1. To examine a person, place, or thing carefully in order to find something or someone. 2. (+ for) To try to find something by looking carefully.
items.ex_en: Detectives arrived early in the morning to search the vacant warehouse for vital clues.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们大清早就赶到了那座空旷的仓库，搜查关键线索。

items.def_zh: 搜寻，搜查出（常与 out/around 连用）；用雪貂捕猎
items.def_en: 1. ('ferret out/around') To search persistently and thoroughly to find or uncover hidden things or information. 2. To hunt or drive out animals using ferrets.
items.ex_en: Investigators managed to ferret through dusty old archives to uncover the company's hidden liabilities.
items.ex_zh: 调查人员设法在尘封的旧档案中反复搜查，摸清了该公司的隐性债务。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ through/in) to search thoroughly and messily among a collection of things
items.ex_en: He rummaged through the dusty attic trunk in search of his grandfather's war medals.
items.ex_zh: 他在布满灰尘的阁楼皮箱里乱翻一通，寻找祖父的战争勋章。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) search for someone or something tenaciously until they are found or captured
items.ex_en: Detectives worked around the clock to hunt down the suspect.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们夜以继日地工作，力求将嫌疑人缉拿归案。

items.def_en: (+ for/through) to search a place meticulously looking for specific evidence or persons
items.ex_en: Search parties combed the dense mountain woods for any trace of the lost hikers.
items.ex_zh: 搜救队伍细致搜寻了茂密的山林，排查失踪登山者的任何蛛迹。

items.def_en: (+ for) to search an entire area systematically and thoroughly
items.ex_en: Police officers scoured the entire neighborhood for hours seeking the missing child's red bicycle.
items.ex_zh: 警察在整个街区地毯式搜索了数小时，寻找失踪孩子的那辆红色自行车。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the sensory or physical manner of actively seeking people, hidden objects, or resources, differing in physical technique, thoroughness, and domain (e.g., using divining tools, rummaging through clutter, or hunting antiquities).
groups.summary_zh: 指通过特定方式或手段搜求目标，包含翻找、探寻及专用勘搜。
groups.desc_en: Physically sifting, probing, or overturning an unorganized physical space or substrate to locate hidden items, contrasting with passive scanning or algorithmic lookup.
groups.desc_zh: 在杂乱无章的物理空间或基质中翻动、探寻以找出隐匿物品，区别于被动浏览或算法检索。
groups.nuance_en: rummage: thoroughly searching by turning over, displacing, and disarranging contents (drawers / attic / closet) · ferret out: tenaciously hunting down obscure or concealed facts through relentless tracing (truth / secrets / culprit) · forage: wandering and scouring an environment specifically to gather food or supplies (food / supplies / scraps) · root around: poking and probing into cluttered items or soil clumsily (box / papers / bag) · search: systematically looking through an area to find a missing entity (premises / luggage / wreckage)
groups.nuance_zh: rummage: 翻箱倒柜把东西弄乱地彻底搜寻 (drawers / attic / closet) · ferret out: 像雪貂搜洞般不依不饶地挖出隐秘信息 (truth / secrets / culprit) · forage: 在环境四周寻觅搜刮食物或给养 (food / supplies / scraps) · root around: 在杂物或泥土中胡乱掏摸翻找 (box / papers / bag) · search: 广泛而有组织地系统排查特定区域 (premises / luggage / wreckage)

groups.name: Search & Seek · 探求与寻索 (Seek, Scour, Rummage)
groups.tip: 多方寻觅目标线索

items.def_zh: （用搜索引擎）网络搜索，在网上查找
items.def_en: To search for information on the internet using a search engine (especially Google).
items.ex_en: If you don't know the exact recipe, just google the ingredients on your phone.
items.ex_zh: 如果你不知道确切的食谱，用手机在网上搜一下配料就行了。

items.def_zh: 搜罗出；发掘出（秘密或事实）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to discover information or facts by careful and diligent searching
items.ex_en: The media managed to dig up some scandalous details about his past.
items.ex_zh: 媒体设法翻出了他过去的一些丑闻细节。

items.def_zh: 搜出；查获（隐藏的信息或事物）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to search around persistently and uncover hidden secrets, details, or items
items.ex_en: Auditors were brought in to ferret out any hidden discrepancies within the financial ledgers.
items.ex_zh: 审计人员被请来查获财务账目中可能隐藏的任何出入。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to search quickly and untidily through a collection of things, papers, or a container
items.ex_en: The burglar rifled through the desk drawers, grabbing envelopes filled with emergency cash.
items.ex_zh: 窃贼翻乱了书桌抽屉，抓走了装满应急现金的信封。

items.def_zh: 寻找，寻觅；谋求，争取；试图
items.def_en: To attempt to find, obtain, or achieve something; to ask for advice or help.
items.ex_en: The diplomatic delegation will seek an immediate ceasefire during tomorrow morning's peace negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 外交代表团将在明天上午的和平谈判中谋求立即停火。

items.def_zh: 寻找，寻觅，谋求（seek 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of seek; to attempt to find or achieve something.
items.ex_en: Exhausted travelers sought shelter from the howling blizzard inside an abandoned wooden mountain cabin.
items.ex_zh: 筋疲力尽的旅客们在一间废弃的木屋里寻得庇护，躲避呼啸的风雪。

items.def_en: (+ for) to search widely for food or supplies
items.ex_en: Wild boars forage for fallen acorns and roots across the damp autumn forest floor.
items.ex_zh: 野猪在潮湿的秋季林间空地上四处觅食落下的橡果与植物根茎。

items.def_en: [I/T] to search untidily through a mass of things to find something
items.ex_en: She rummaged in her crowded drawer to locate a fresh pair of reading glasses.
items.ex_zh: 她在塞得满满当当的抽屉里乱翻，找一副新的老花镜。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to search exhaustively until a missing person, desired thing, or information is located
items.ex_en: Detectives worked around the clock to hunt down the suspect.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们夜以继日地工作，力求将嫌疑人缉拿归案。

items.def_en: to search thoroughly and systematically through a place or records
items.ex_en: Historians will comb through municipal archives to uncover early records of the coastal settlement.
items.ex_zh: 历史学者将梳理查阅市政档案，发掘该沿海定居点的早期记录。

items.def_en: to search a place or area thoroughly in order to find someone or something
items.ex_en: Rescue crews continued to scour the rocky shoreline for survivors following the shipwreck.
items.ex_zh: 海难发生后，救援队继续在岩石密布的海岸线上全面搜寻幸存者。

groups.summary_en: Cognizers actively scan locations, physical domains, or data systems to locate missing persons, facts, or desired objectives. Variations range from high-level aspirational pursuit to digital queries and exhaustive physical scouring.
groups.summary_zh: 为寻获特定人、物或信息而进行的系统查寻或全面翻找。
groups.desc_en: Investigatively unearthing, tracking, or acquiring obscure or concealed intellectual, digital, or physical data, contrasting with serendipitous discovery.
groups.desc_zh: 主动调查发掘、追踪并获取隐匿或难觅的信息与实体，区别于无意中的偶遇巧合。
groups.nuance_en: seek: pursuing an abstract, moral, or official objective through deliberate aspiration (refuge / counsel / truth) · dig up: unearthing buried relics or disinterring forgotten, damaging secrets (past / evidence / dirt) · rifle through: swiftly and disrespectfully searching through belongings or files with thieving intent (drawers / files / pockets) · google: searching for electronic information via search engines (name / symptom / recipe) · ferret out: uncovering well-hidden corruption or clandestine facts through persistence (facts / spies / anomalies)
groups.nuance_zh: seek: 执着追求抽象理想、庇护或建言 (refuge / counsel / truth) · dig up: 挖掘出被掩埋的实物或不堪的旧账丑闻 (past / evidence / dirt) · rifle through: 迅速且翻乱地乱翻他人抽屉或文件以求赃物 (drawers / files / pockets) · google: 通过搜索引擎快速获取网络知识与资讯 (name / symptom / recipe) · ferret out: 抽丝剥茧揪出深藏的间谍、弊案或真相 (facts / spies / anomalies)

groups.name: Sell & Trade Commercial Goods · 出售、外销与零售 (Sell, Retail, Vend)
groups.tip: 转让货品换取金钱

items.def_zh: 卖，出售；售出；推销，使接受
items.def_en: 1. To give or transfer something to someone in exchange for money. 2. To persuade someone to buy, accept, or support something.
items.ex_en: The family decided to sell their countryside cottage and move into a downtown apartment.
items.ex_zh: 这家人决定把乡间小屋卖掉，搬进市中心的一间公寓。
items.ex2_en: Her newly published mystery novel sells extremely well in major bookstores nationwide.
items.ex2_zh: 她新出版的悬疑小说在全国各大书店畅销。

items.def_zh: 卖，出售（sell的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense and past participle of sell: to exchange goods, property, or services for money.
items.ex_en: The merchant sold several crates of imported silk to local tailors yesterday afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 昨天下午，这位商人将数箱进口丝绸卖给了当地的裁缝。
items.ex2_en: Fresh organic strawberries sold remarkably fast at the bustling Saturday morning market.
items.ex2_zh: 新鲜的有机草莓在周六早晨繁忙的市场上卖得非常快。

items.def_en: 1. To sell goods directly to the public in small quantities. 2. (+ at/for) To be sold at a specified retail price. 3. (formal) To tell or recount a story or information in detail.
items.ex_en: The boutique will retail these handcrafted leather shoes for approximately three hundred dollars a pair.
items.ex_zh: 该精品店将以每双约三百美元的价格向公众零售这些手工皮鞋。
items.ex2_en: The premium wireless headphones retail for approximately two hundred dollars at electronics stores.
items.ex2_zh: 这款高端无线耳机在电子商店的零售价约为两百美元。

items.def_en: 1. To sell and send goods or services to another country. 2. (computing) To transfer data from one system or application to another.
items.ex_en: From ancient harbors, merchants export fragrant spices and rare cedar to distant kingdoms.
items.ex_zh: 商人们自古老的港口，将芬芳的香料与珍稀的雪松输出至遥远的王国。

items.def_zh: 廉价抛售；出脱（货物或资产）
items.def_en: (+ sth) dispose of goods, property, or stock rapidly, often at reduced prices
items.ex_en: The company had to sell off its non-core assets to pay off debts.
items.ex_zh: 该公司不得不变卖非核心资产以偿还债务。

items.def_en: (+ sth) sell something quickly, cheaply, or unwanted to someone
items.ex_en: He decided to flog off his old gaming consoles before moving across the country.
items.ex_zh: 他决定在搬到全国另一端之前，把旧游戏机全廉价卖掉。

items.def_en: (+ sth) exchange or sell commercial assets or items for money or another advantage
items.ex_en: Commuters often trade off a longer travel time for cheaper housing.
items.ex_zh: 通勤者往往以更长的路途时间换取更便宜的住房成本。

items.def_en: to promote or sell goods in a systematic commercial way, often using specialized display
items.ex_en: The studio plans to merchandise action figures and apparel ahead of the summer blockbuster.
items.ex_zh: 制片厂计划在暑期大片上映前，大举推销其角色手办与服饰周边。

items.def_en: to sell commodities in large quantities at reduced prices to retailers rather than consumers
items.ex_en: Our family company wholesales organic grain directly to regional supermarkets across the Midwest.
items.ex_zh: 我们家族公司直接将有机谷物批发给中西部各地的区域超市。

items.def_en: (formal) to offer goods for sale, especially in a street market or through automated means
items.ex_en: Licensed merchants vend fresh hot chestnuts along the bustling holiday markets every December.
items.ex_zh: 每年十二月，持证摊贩都会在熙熙攘攘的节日集市上摆摊出售热板栗。

items.def_en: to go from place to place selling small goods, ideas, or illicit items
items.ex_en: Dishonest brokers tried to peddle worthless financial investments to inexperienced elderly clients.
items.ex_zh: 不道德的经纪人试图向缺乏经验的老年客户兜售毫无价值的金融投资。

groups.summary_en: A seller transfers goods or commodities to a buyer in exchange for money, operating across retail channels, wholesale distribution, or international export markets.
groups.summary_zh: 通过零售、分销或国际贸易将商品与货物出售给买方。
groups.desc_en: Transferring ownership of commodities or commercial inventory in exchange for financial consideration, contrasting with bartering, donating, or leasing.
groups.desc_zh: 通过商业交易让渡商品或存货的所有权以换取金钱报酬，区别于以物易物、赠与或租赁。
groups.nuance_en: sell: transferring goods, services, or properties for monetary compensation generally (house / shares / services) · retail: selling merchandise directly to ultimate consumers in small quantities (goods / clothes / products) · export: shipping and selling domestic merchandise to foreign jurisdictions (grain / machinery / software) · sell off: liquidating surplus or distressed assets at discounted rates (assets / stock / land) · merchandise: actively promoting and displaying products to stimulate retail turnover (toys / branding / items)
groups.nuance_zh: sell: 广义上以货币为对价出让物品或服务 (house / shares / services) · retail: 将商品分件零卖给最终个人消费者 (goods / clothes / products) · export: 将本国商品成批外销至海外市场 (grain / machinery / software) · sell off: 削价清仓变卖多余或不良资产 (assets / stock / land) · merchandise: 对商品进行宣介与摆放以刺激终端销路 (toys / branding / items)

groups.name: Sever & Divide by Cutting · 切断与截半 (Bisect, Chop, Sever)
groups.tip: 锋利外力割裂或击穿孔洞

items.def_en: (+ sth) to divide or bisect a solid object completely into two separate parts with a cutting edge
items.ex_en: The chef used a cleaver to cut the melon cleanly in two halves.
items.ex_zh: 厨师用菜刀利落地将甜瓜一分为二切成两半。

items.def_zh: 在……上击穿缺口，使裂开；豁开
items.def_en: To make a breach, hole, or gap in something.
items.ex_en: The iron battering ram gapped the fortress wall after hours of brutal bombardment.
items.ex_zh: 铁铸撞槌在经过数小时的猛烈撞击后，终于在堡垒城墙上撞开一道豁口。

items.def_en: To cut something into pieces by hitting it repeatedly with a sharp tool such as an axe or heavy knife.
items.ex_en: He went outside with a heavy axe to chop dry firewood for tonight.
items.ex_zh: 他带着一把沉重的斧头走到室外，劈砍今晚要用的干柴。

items.def_en: to cut off branches or limbs cleanly from a trunk or body
items.ex_en: We need to lop these overgrown branches before they touch the electric wires overhead.
items.ex_zh: 我们得把这些疯长的枝条砍掉，免得碰到头顶上的电线。

items.def_en: to strike or chop forcefully with an axe or heavy cutting tool
items.ex_en: Stout woodsmen hewed ancient oak trunks to furnish sturdy timbers for the castle gate.
items.ex_zh: 壮实的伐木工挥斧砍倒古老的橡树，为城堡大门提供结实的木料。

items.def_zh: 二等分，一分为二；横切，穿过
items.def_en: To divide a line, shape, or area into two completely equal parts; to cross or intersect.
items.ex_en: A wide paved avenue bisects the historic district into distinct eastern and western sectors.
items.ex_zh: 一条宽阔的柏油大道横穿历史街区，将其二等分为东西两部分。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to sever or remove a part of something with a sharp blow using a knife, axe, or tool
items.ex_en: The butcher used a heavy cleaver to chop off the thick beef bones cleanly.
items.ex_zh: 屠夫用一把沉重的砍刀利落地剁下了粗壮的牛骨。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to cut or sever a piece off something roughly, clumsily, or with repeated heavy blows
items.ex_en: He carelessly used a blunt saw to hack off the damaged tree limb.
items.ex_zh: 他笨拙地用一把钝锯粗暴地锯砍下了受损的树枝。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to cut off an unwanted part, such as a branch or limb, with a single cutting blow
items.ex_en: The gardener used long shears to lop off the withered rose stems after blooming.
items.ex_zh: 花期过后，园丁用长修枝剪一刀剪去了枯萎的玫瑰茎枝。

items.def_en: to cut or chop roughly and violently with repeated strokes
items.ex_en: The expedition crew had to hack their way through thick jungle vines for miles.
items.ex_zh: 探险队员不得不挥刀劈开数英里密密麻麻的丛林藤蔓艰难前行。

items.def_en: to cut off a part completely from a whole, especially with a sharp stroke
items.ex_en: The sharp guillotine blade severed the heavy hemp rope in a single rapid strike.
items.ex_zh: 锋利的断头台刀刃迅疾一击，将粗重的麻绳彻底切断。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate completely partitioning, cleaving in two, or opening an aperture in a solid object by striking or cutting across its breadth. Actions range from orderly geometric bisection to aggressive chopping.
groups.summary_zh: 指斩断、平分或破开实体造成间隙或两段的动作。
groups.desc_en: Using a bladed or sharp-edged instrument to forcefully cleave, split, or dismember an object into distinct parts, contrasting with tearing, burning, or snapping.
groups.desc_zh: 借助锋利刃具施加外力将物体切开、劈分或截断，区别于撕裂、烧灼或折断。
groups.nuance_en: sever: cutting clean through a connection, extremity, or rope completely (head / link / ties) · bisect: dividing a plane, line, or object into two equal geometric halves (angle / line / territory) · chop: striking forcefully downwards with an axe or blade to break apart (wood / meat / onions) · lop: cutting away unwanted projecting branches, twigs, or members (branches / ears / overheads) · hew: forcefully carving, shaping, or chopping heavy timber or stone (stone / logs / timber)
groups.nuance_zh: sever: 彻底斩断肢体、绳缆或斩断人际联系 (head / link / ties) · bisect: 在几何或物理上均等地一分为二截半 (angle / line / territory) · chop: 挥舞利刃向下重砍劈碎 (wood / meat / onions) · lop: 剪除修剪多余突出的枝丫或枝蔓 (branches / ears / overheads) · hew: 挥斧凿砍巨木或劈削坚硬石料 (stone / logs / timber)

groups.name: Signal & Nonverbally Cue · 示意与发信号 (Gesture, Cue, Telegraph)
groups.tip: 用动作或暗号非言语传达信息

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ to/at) to lower and raise the head slightly to acknowledge, greet, or cue someone
items.ex_en: The chairman gave a discreet nod toward the speaker to signal her allotted time.
items.ex_zh: 主席向发言人微微点头示意，提醒她发言时间已到。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to make a gesture with the hand, arm, or head to tell someone to do something or go somewhere
items.ex_en: The security guard motioned to the visitors to step through the metal detector doorway.
items.ex_zh: 保安打手势示意访客们穿过安检门。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ to) to use gestures or sign language to indicate meaning or directions
items.ex_en: The traffic officer signed to oncoming drivers to slow down near the accident zone.
items.ex_zh: 交警打手势示意迎面驶来的司机在事故区域附近减速慢行。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ to) to direct or indicate by a movement of the hand, head, or eye
items.ex_en: The usher motioned toward the empty seats near the front row of the theater.
items.ex_zh: 引座员用手势指向剧场前排附近的空座位示意入座。

items.def_zh: 做手势，打手势；用动作示意
items.def_en: 1. (+ to/toward/at) To move your hands, arms, or head to express an idea, instruction, or feeling.
items.ex_en: The director gestured frantically toward the stage curtains, signaling the actors to take places.
items.ex_zh: 导演拼命朝舞台幕布打手势，示意演员们赶紧各就各位。

items.def_zh: 流露，（不自觉地）露出……企图；打电报
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To give an unintentional signal or advance warning of what you are about to do, allowing an opponent to anticipate it. 2. (historical) To send a message by telegraph.
items.ex_en: The novice boxer unintentionally telegraphed his right hook by dropping his left guard beforehand.
items.ex_zh: 这名新手拳击手在出右勾拳前放低了左手防守，无意中露出了企图。

items.def_zh: 暗示，提示；给（演员等）提示
items.def_en: 1. To give someone a signal to do or say something, especially in a performance or broadcast.
items.ex_en: The floor manager waited in the wings to cue the host for the interview.
items.ex_zh: 现场编导在侧幕候着，准备给主持人发信号开始采访。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ to/at) to make a gesture with the hand or head calling someone to approach
items.ex_en: The elderly gentleman raised his walking cane to beckon to the young waiter nearby.
items.ex_zh: 那位老绅士举起手杖，示意身旁的年轻侍者走近身来。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to signal to someone with a wave of the hand or nod to approach or come closer
items.ex_en: The detective quietly beckoned over his partner to inspect the fresh muddy footprints closely.
items.ex_zh: 侦探悄悄招手叫来搭档，仔细查看那串新踩出的泥泞脚印。

items.def_zh: 挥手示意前进；挥手放行
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to signal to a person or driver with a hand motion to proceed or move past
items.ex_en: After briefly inspecting the passport, the border official waved on the exhausted tourist truck.
items.ex_zh: 简单查验护照后，边检官员挥手放行了那辆风尘仆仆的旅游卡车。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to wave one's arms or a signal to cause an approaching vehicle or driver to stop
items.ex_en: Stranded along the desert road, the traveler managed to flag down a passing truck.
items.ex_zh: 受困于荒漠公路边的旅客设法挥手拦下了一辆路过的卡车。

groups.summary_en: An agent deliberately or inadvertently transmits information, intent, or timing through gestures, subtle bodily motions, or intentional promptings without full verbal articulation.
groups.summary_zh: 通过手势、暗号或不经意的肢体动作向对方传递指示或预告意图。
groups.desc_en: Conveying an instruction, warning, or intention through body language, kinesic movement, or prearranged indicators without speech, contrasting with overt verbal discourse.
groups.desc_zh: 通过身体语言、肢体动作或预设暗号无声地传达指令、预警或意图，区别于显式言语交流。
groups.nuance_en: gesture: using expressive movements of the hands or head to emphasize meaning (hands / directions / impatience) · motion: directing someone to move or act via a directional wave of the hand (toward / exit / waiter) · nod: tipping the head downward to signify affirmation, greeting, or assent (head / agreement / assent) · beckon: summoning someone closer using an inviting finger or hand gesture (stranger / waiter / closer) · telegraph: unintentionally or prominently signaling one's future moves in advance (punches / intentions / moves)
groups.nuance_zh: gesture: 运用手势或身势语生动传情达意 (hands / directions / impatience) · motion: 挥手示意指示他人走向某处或做出行动 (toward / exit / waiter) · nod: 点头以表示赞同、招呼或应允 (head / agreement / assent) · beckon: 招手或屈指勾唤对方走近 (stranger / waiter / closer) · telegraph: 动作幅度过大而提前走漏破绽或暴露预图 (punches / intentions / moves)

groups.name: Sing & Chant · 歌唱与咏唱 (Sing, Croon, Belt)
groups.tip: 伴随旋律或节奏发声吟咏

items.def_en: join in singing or chanting in harmony or unison with others
items.ex_en: The audience smiled warmly as the children chimed in for the uplifting chorus.
items.ex_zh: 当孩子们合唱起那段振奋人心的副歌时，观众们露出了温暖的笑容。

items.def_zh: 咏唱，诵唱（单调而富有韵律）
items.def_en: [I/T] to sing or utter rhythmic words or phrases in a repetitive, monotone cadence
items.ex_en: Monks gathered inside the dim sanctuary to chant sacred verses in solemn unison daily.
items.ex_zh: 僧侣们每天齐聚在幽暗的圣所内，肃穆齐声诵唱神圣的经文。

items.def_en: [I/T] to recite or sing in a solemn, sonorous, slowly modulated voice
items.ex_en: The priest began to intone the ancient Latin liturgy in a solemn, sonorous voice.
items.ex_zh: 神父以庄严浑厚的嗓音，开始吟诵古老的拉丁语礼拜经文。

items.def_zh: 吟唱，作为吟游诗人演出
items.def_en: 1. (historical) To sing and play music as a traveling medieval entertainer.
items.ex_en: A lone bard wandered from castle to hall, minstrels ancient ballads to noble audiences.
items.ex_zh: 一位孤独的游吟诗人走遍座座城堡宫厅，向贵族听众吟唱古老歌谣。

items.def_en: 1. To sing or hum a gentle song in a soft, low voice.
items.ex_en: The mother began to croon a soothing lullaby until her baby fell peacefully asleep.
items.ex_zh: 母亲轻声哼唱起舒缓的摇篮曲，直到小婴儿恬静地进入梦乡。

items.def_en: (+ sth) begin to sing or play a tune or chant, often leading others
items.ex_en: The campfire leader struck up a cheerful folk tune that everyone gladly joined in.
items.ex_zh: 营火晚会的领队唱起了一支欢快的民谣，引得大家纷纷高兴地跟唱。

items.def_en: 1. To sing or play a romantic song to someone, especially outdoors beneath a window.
items.ex_en: Under the balcony, the romantic student played his acoustic guitar to serenade his beloved.
items.ex_zh: 在阳台之下，那位浪漫的学生弹奏着木吉他，为他的心上人献唱小夜曲。

items.def_zh: 用真假声交替歌唱（约德尔唱法）
items.def_en: [I/T] to sing by alternating rapidly between normal voice and falsetto
items.ex_en: The alpine guide began to yodel across the valley, his voice echoing between the peaks.
items.ex_zh: 高山向导开始对着山谷用约德尔唱法歌唱，歌声在山峰间回荡。

items.def_en: 1. (of a bird) To sing with a continuous, gentle trilling sound. 2. (of a person) To sing with a warbling or trilling voice.
items.ex_en: A lone nightingale continued to warble its sweet tune amid the moonlit garden foliage.
items.ex_zh: 一只孤独的夜莺在月光笼罩的花园枝叶间继续婉转啼鸣。

items.def_en: (+ sth) sing a song or musical passage very loudly, forcefully, and with great energy
items.ex_en: The tipsy crowd loved to belt out classic rock anthems until the bar closed.
items.ex_zh: 微醺的人群喜欢大声高唱经典摇滚金曲，直到酒吧打烊。

items.def_zh: 高声歌唱，大声唱出（尤作 belt out）；猛击；飞驰
items.def_en: 1. (especially 'belt out') To sing a song loudly and forcefully. 2. (informal) To hit someone or something hard. 3. (informal) To move very fast.
items.ex_en: The lead singer grabbed the microphone and began to belt throughout the packed arena.
items.ex_zh: 主唱抓起麦克风，在挤满观众的场馆里扯开嗓子高歌起来。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail specific vocal production techniques used in musical singing, differentiated by volume, timbre, melodic inflection, and theatrical style.
groups.summary_zh: 体现声乐发声法、情感基调与演唱风格（如低吟、高亢鸣唱）。
