groups.desc_en: Modulating the vocal apparatus to emit melodic, rhythmic, or ritualized pitch patterns, contrasting with normal discursive speaking or inarticulate shouting.
groups.desc_zh: 调动发声器官发出具有旋律、节奏或仪式感的高低音调，区别于常规口语叙述或失控嘶吼。
groups.nuance_en: chant: rhythmically intoning repetitive slogans, prayers, or mantras (mantras / slogans / spells) · croon: singing gently, softly, and intimately in a low, soothing tone (lullaby / ballad / softly) · intone: chanting words solemnly with slow, flat, church-like resonance (prayer / liturgy / verse) · serenade: singing affectionately to an individual as an expression of courtship (lover / maiden / songs) · yodel: singing with rapid and continuous alternation between chest voice and falsetto (mountains / tune / peaks)
groups.nuance_zh: chant: 有节奏地反复咏诵口号、经文或咒语 (mantras / slogans / spells) · croon: 用低沉柔美的嗓音亲昵轻哼催眠曲或抒情歌 (lullaby / ballad / softly) · intone: 庄严肃穆、平板悠长地吟诵祷词 (prayer / liturgy / verse) · serenade: 专门向爱慕之人献唱求爱小夜曲 (lover / maiden / songs) · yodel: 极速在真声与假声之间上下倒嗓换调高歌 (mountains / tune / peaks)

groups.name: Slide, Roll & Acrobatic Motion · 滑行、滚转与特技翻滚 (Slide, Roll & Tumble)
groups.tip: 在表面滚动、滑行或身体翻滚

items.def_en: turn over one or more times by rotating one's body along a surface
items.ex_en: The tired dog decided to roll over onto its back to beg for belly rubs.
items.ex_zh: 那只疲倦的狗决定翻过身仰面躺着，讨要抚摸肚子。

items.def_en: move across a smooth, slippery surface in varied or uncontrolled directions
items.ex_en: Unsecured boxes began to slide around the truck bed during the sharp mountain turn.
items.ex_zh: 在急转山路时，未固定的箱子开始在卡车车斗里滑来滑去。

items.def_en: 1. To roll or move along slowly and heavily, especially on wheels, or to push something in this manner.
items.ex_en: He watched the rusted baggage cart trundle slowly down the deserted train platform.
items.ex_zh: 他看着那辆生锈的行李手推车在空旷的站台上缓缓沉重地滚过。
items.ex2_en: The tired porter trundled a heavy metal cart across the cobblestone station.
items.ex2_zh: 疲倦的搬运工推着沉重的金属推车穿过铺满鹅卵石的车站。

items.def_en: fall or roll down rapidly and acrobatically or clumsily
items.ex_en: Loose pebbles caused the unwary climber to tumble down the steep rocky slope.
items.ex_zh: 松散的碎石导致那个大意的登山者从陡峭的岩坡上翻滚跌落下来。

items.def_en: to move smoothly over an icy or smooth surface wearing skates
items.ex_en: Children love to skate gracefully across the frozen neighborhood pond every winter morning.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们每年冬天的早晨都喜欢在附近结冰的池塘上优雅地滑冰。

items.def_en: to roll end over end or perform gymnastic rolls and somersaults along the ground
items.ex_en: The gymnast managed to tumble across the padded mat with astonishing balance and speed.
items.ex_zh: 体操运动员以惊人的平衡感和速度在厚垫子上连续翻滚前行。

items.def_en: 1. To perform a sideways handspring with arms and legs spread out like the spokes of a wheel.
items.ex_en: Energetic children cartwheel joyfully across the lawn during the warm summer afternoon picnic.
items.ex_zh: 在温暖的夏日午后野餐中，精力充沛的孩子们欢快地在草坪上翻侧筋斗。

items.def_en: 1. To roll or leap completely head over heels in the air or on the ground.
items.ex_en: The acrobatic performer can somersault backward effortlessly from the elevated platform into the pool.
items.ex_zh: 杂技演员可以毫不费力地从高台上向后翻筋斗跃入泳池。

items.def_en: 1. To skate using inline skates with a single row of wheels.
items.ex_en: Teenagers often rollerblade along the beachfront promenade while listening to upbeat music.
items.ex_zh: 青少年经常一边听着欢快的音乐，一边沿着海滨步道滑单排轮旱冰。

items.def_zh: （滑雪时）作双板平行摆动转弯滑
items.def_en: 1. (in skiing) To ski downhill making a rapid series of short, parallel turns.
items.ex_en: The expert skier began to wedel down the pristine powder with breathtaking rhythm.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的滑雪者以令人惊叹的节奏，做着双板平行短转弯滑下未踩踏的粉雪。

items.def_en: to perform a complete rotation along the longitudinal axis while moving forward
items.ex_en: The stunt pilot executed a flawless barrel-roll high above the cheering airfield crowd.
items.ex_zh: 特技飞行员在欢呼的机场人群上方完美地完成了一次桶滚机动动作。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers bodily or wheeled movement involving rolling, tumbling acrobatically, or sliding in specific rhythmic or wheeled patterns across a surface. Nuances range from heavy slow rolling to agile acrobatic rotations and specialized sporting maneuvers.
groups.summary_zh: 描述身体翻转、杂技空翻或依靠轮滑、滑雪技巧进行的特种滑滚位移。
groups.desc_en: Denotes continuous surface-contact translation involving rotation, low-friction gliding, or end-over-end rotational dynamics, distinguishing structured physical or acrobatic movement from simple bipedal walking.
groups.desc_zh: 指沿表面进行的连续滑移、低摩擦滑行或身体翻转腾挪运动，区别于普通的双足平地步行。
groups.nuance_en: tumble: uncontrolled falling roll (downhill / acrobatics) · trundle: heavy, slow rolling on wheels (cart / luggage) · somersault: full 360-degree head-over-heels flip (gymnast / diver) · cartwheel: sideways rotational flip supported by hands (child / gymnast) · skate: smooth gliding on a low-friction edge (ice / pavement)
groups.nuance_zh: tumble: 失控跌落翻滚或杂技翻滚 (downhill / acrobatics) · trundle: 沉重缓慢地滚转移动 (cart / luggage) · somersault: 前后360度头足翻筋斗 (gymnast / diver) · cartwheel: 侧向手足支撑侧手翻 (child / gymnast) · skate: 借助冰刃或滑轮顺畅滑行 (ice / pavement)

groups.name: Smooth & Polish · 平整与打磨 (Buff, Burnish, Sandpaper)
groups.tip: 去除粗糙使外表光滑整洁

items.def_en: (+ sth) polish, smooth, or clean a surface thoroughly by friction or using an abrasive
items.ex_en: You must rub down the wooden frame thoroughly before applying the fresh paint coat.
items.ex_zh: 在涂抹新漆层之前，你必须彻底将木制框架擦拭打磨光滑。

items.def_en: (+ sth) make a surface level and smooth by scouring it with sandpaper
items.ex_en: The carpenter will sand down the tabletop until all splintered edges completely vanish.
items.ex_zh: 木匠会用砂纸打磨平整桌面，直到所有粗糙毛刺彻底消失。

items.def_en: (+ sth) flatten or remove wrinkles, bumps, or irregularities from a surface
items.ex_en: She used both hands to smooth out the wrinkled tablecloth before dinner guests arrived.
items.ex_zh: 在晚宴客人到达之前，她用双手抚平了皱巴巴的桌布。

items.def_en: To make clothes or fabric smooth using an iron.
items.ex_en: He took ten minutes to iron his cotton dress shirt for the morning interview.
items.ex_zh: 他花了十分钟熨平棉质正装衬衫，以备参加早晨的面试。

items.def_en: 1. To make a wooden surface flat and smooth using a plane. 2. To skim along or glide over the surface of water.
items.ex_en: The craftsman took time to plane the rough oak board to an even thickness.
items.ex_zh: 工匠花时间用刨子刨平粗糙的橡木板，使其厚度均匀一致。

items.def_zh: 用砂纸打磨，磨光；撒沙于
items.def_en: 1. To make something smooth by rubbing it with sandpaper or a mechanical sander. 2. To cover or sprinkle something with sand.
items.ex_en: Be sure to sand each wooden banister before brushing on the protective glossy varnish.
items.ex_zh: 在刷上光泽保护漆之前，务必用砂纸打磨每一个木制楼梯栏杆。

items.def_en: [I/T] to drag a hard, sharp edge across a surface to make it smooth or clean
items.ex_en: He used a putty knife to scrape old paint from the exterior window frame.
items.ex_zh: 他用一把油灰刀刮净室外窗框上的旧油漆。

items.def_zh: 整理，使整洁；使显出一本正经的神态
items.def_en: 1. To make clothes, appearance, or hair neat and tidy. 2. To compress one's face or lips into a formal, overly proper expression.
items.ex_en: The governess paused to prim her lace collar before entering the formal drawing room.
items.ex_zh: 女家庭教师在步入正式客厅之前停下脚步，整理了一下蕾丝衣领。

items.def_en: (+ down) to smooth or shape an edge using a rough metal file
items.ex_en: The metalworker had to file down the jagged edge to ensure user safety.
items.ex_zh: 金工师傅不得不挫平锯齿状边缘，以确保使用者的安全。

items.def_en: to polish something with a piece of soft material or a mechanical buffer
items.ex_en: Use a microfiber cloth to buff the silver teapot until it shines brilliantly.
items.ex_zh: 用超细纤维布将银质茶壶擦亮抛光，直到它闪耀出夺目光彩。

items.def_en: to smooth and shine a metal or leather surface by rubbing friction
items.ex_en: Ancient smiths would burnish ceremonial bronze shields until they mirrored the midday sun.
items.ex_zh: 古代铁匠会把仪仗铜盾打磨发亮，直到其能映照出正午的艳阳。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail physical manipulation techniques used to make a surface flat, smooth, or free of wrinkles, using heat, abrasives, or specialized hand tools.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过工具切削、砂纸打磨或高温熨平来消除粗糙与褶皱的工艺过程。
groups.desc_en: Specifies physical abrasion, compression, or scraping to eliminate irregularities and achieve an even, frictionless surface, unlike mere cleaning or superficial washing.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过物理打磨、加压刮削等机械手段去除表面凹凸与毛刺，区别于单纯的清洗或表面拂拭。
groups.nuance_en: sand: abrasive smoothing using sandpaper or grit (wood / floor / drywall) · plane: shaving flat using an edged blade tool (board / door / timber) · iron: smoothing wrinkles through heat and pressure (shirt / linen) · scrape: removing surface coats or rough patches with a rigid edge (paint / rust / hide)
groups.nuance_zh: sand: 用砂纸或磨料打磨平整 (wood / floor / drywall) · plane: 用刨刀削平木料凸起 (board / door / timber) · iron: 利用热力和重压熨平褶皱 (shirt / linen) · scrape: 用硬质边缘刮除表面粗糙层或附着物 (paint / rust / hide)

groups.name: Sneak & Creep · 潜行与匿踪 (Stealthy Undetected Movement)
groups.tip: 如幽灵般无声无息滑移潜行

items.def_en: to walk quietly on the tips of the toes
items.ex_en: She had to tiptoe past the nursery door to avoid waking the sleeping infant.
items.ex_zh: 她不得不踮着脚尖走过育儿室门口，以免吵醒熟睡的婴儿。

items.def_zh: 蹑手蹑脚地走动；悄悄潜行
items.def_en: move around quietly and cautiously, trying to escape notice
items.ex_en: The mischievous kids like to creep around the basement pretending to be stealthy detectives.
items.ex_zh: 淘气的孩子们喜欢在地下室里蹑手蹑脚地走动，假装自己是隐秘的侦探。

items.def_zh: 鬼鬼祟祟地走动；偷偷摸摸活动
items.def_en: move furtively or secretly in an area to avoid being seen or heard
items.ex_en: Security guards caught a shadowy trespasser trying to sneak around the warehouse perimeter.
items.ex_zh: 保安抓获了一名试图在仓库外围鬼鬼祟祟走动的可疑潜入者。

items.def_zh: 踮着脚走动；小心翼翼地潜行
items.def_en: walk very quietly on one's toes to avoid making any sound
items.ex_en: We had to tiptoe around the dark hallway so nobody would hear our entrance.
items.ex_zh: 我们只得在昏暗的走廊里轻手轻脚地潜行，以免有人察觉我们进来。

items.def_zh: 如幽灵般无声潜行，悄悄滑过；突然断绝与……的联系（玩失踪）；代人写作（做枪手）
items.def_en: 1. To move silently, smoothly, or stealthily like a ghost. 2. (informal) To suddenly cut off all communication with someone. 3. To ghostwrite a book or article.
items.ex_en: The agile thief seemed to ghost through the heavily guarded mansion without a trace.
items.ex_zh: 敏捷的窃贼宛如幽灵般穿过戒备森严的宅邸，没有留下丝毫痕迹。

items.raw_cluster: 潜行与蹑手蹑脚 Sneak & Creep
items.def_zh: 悄悄潜行，鬼鬼祟祟地走动；窥探，搜寻；捕鼠
items.def_en: 1. To move stealthily, quietly, or furtively. 2. (+ around/about) To prowl or search around quietly. 3. To hunt or catch mice.
items.ex_en: The old clerk would mouse about the dim library aisles, searching for forgotten manuscripts.
items.ex_zh: 年迈的职员常在昏暗的图书馆书架间悄悄搜寻，寻找被遗忘的古老手稿。

items.def_zh: 蹑手蹑脚地走；悄悄前行
items.def_en: to move slowly and quietly with the body close to the ground
items.ex_en: The hunting leopard began to creep silently through tall grass toward its unsuspecting prey.
items.ex_zh: 捕猎的花豹贴近地面蹑手蹑脚地穿过高草丛，靠近毫无防备的猎物。

items.def_zh: 悄悄接近；蹑手蹑脚地靠近（某人）
items.def_en: (+ sb) approach someone quietly and stealthily without their knowledge
items.ex_en: The playful kitten tried to sneak up on the resting crow from behind.
items.ex_zh: 顽皮的小猫试图从背后悄悄接近那只正在栖息休息的乌鸦。

items.def_en: to go stealthily and furtively so as to evade being seen or heard
items.ex_en: He decided to sneak out the back door while everyone was distracted by dessert.
items.ex_zh: 在大家被甜点分散注意力的时候，他决定从后门偷偷溜走。

items.def_zh: 潜行；偷偷溜出（常带愧疚胆怯感）
items.def_en: to move smoothly and quietly with a guilty, furtive, or cowardly posture
items.ex_en: The guilty student attempted to slink into the classroom unnoticed after the bell rang.
items.ex_zh: 铃声响过之后，心虚的学生试图神不知鬼不觉地溜进教室。

items.def_en: to keep out of sight and move stealthily, especially with sinister intent
items.ex_en: Suspicious figures often skulk in dark alleyways waiting for unaware targets after midnight.
items.ex_zh: 可疑的身影经常在午夜后鬼鬼祟祟地潜伏在昏暗小巷里，伺机盯梢防备松懈的目标。

groups.summary_en: An agent moves in an extremely cautious, quiet, or surreptitious manner specifically designed to avoid sensory detection or identification by observers.
groups.summary_zh: 压低声响动作、极力隐藏行踪以躲避觉察的潜行移动。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on stealthy, deliberately silenced locomotion intended to evade auditory or visual detection, contrasting with standard, carefree walking.
groups.desc_zh: 强调刻意压低声音、隐匿行踪的潜行与蹑足移动，以逃避听觉或视觉察觉，区别于无拘无束的普通行走。
groups.nuance_en: tiptoe: walking gingerly on toes to prevent noise (hallway / bedroom) · creep: slow, low-profile, deliberate crawl-like advance (shadows / stairs) · sneak: covert, evasive maneuvering to bypass vigilance (past guards / out of the house) · ghost: sudden, silent departure or disappearance without trace (party / meeting)
groups.nuance_zh: tiptoe: 踮起脚尖轻声行走以防发出声响 (hallway / bedroom) · creep: 压低身姿、缓慢而蓄意地潜行 (shadows / stairs) · sneak: 避开他人警惕的溜进溜出 (past guards / out of the house) · ghost: 悄然离席或不告而别消失 (party / meeting)

groups.name: Specialized Culinary Preparation · 专业烹饪与酿造技艺 (Spatchcock, Confection, Brew)
groups.tip: 发酵与私酿烈酒的过程

items.def_en: to boil food briefly until it is partly cooked as a preparatory step
items.ex_en: The chef decided to parboil the diced potatoes before roasting them in garlic butter.
items.ex_zh: 厨师决定在大蒜黄油中烘烤切好的土豆之前，先将其半煮变软。

items.def_en: (+ sth) prepare a beverage such as beer, tea, or cider by boiling, infusion, or fermentation
items.ex_en: I can brew up a hot pot of herbal tea while you unpack bags.
items.ex_zh: 趁着你拆行李，我可以去沏上一壶滚烫的花草茶。

items.def_en: (+ sth) reduce the volume and concentrate the flavor of a culinary liquid by gentle boiling
items.ex_en: Let the marinara simmer on low heat to cook down into rich sauce.
items.ex_zh: 用小火煨炖番茄罗勒沙司，将其熬浓成醇厚可口的浓稠酱汁。
items.ex2_en: The experienced chef cooked down the rich broth into a glossy glaze.
items.ex2_zh: 经验丰富的大厨将浓郁的高汤慢熬成光亮的浓汁。

items.def_en: (+ sth) beat cream, eggs, or batter vigorously into a froth, or craft a dish quickly
items.ex_en: She managed to whip up a delicious pasta dinner using only leftover pantry ingredients.
items.ex_zh: 她仅用食品柜里剩下的几种食材，就麻利地调配出了一顿可口的意大利面晚餐。

items.def_en: to undergo or cause to undergo a chemical change catalyzed by enzymes or yeasts
items.ex_en: Vintners let crushed grapes ferment inside French oak barrels for several consecutive months.
items.ex_zh: 酿酒师让压榨后的葡萄在法国橡木桶内连续发酵数月之久。
items.ex2_en: Crushed grapes ferment naturally inside clean wooden casks during late autumn months.
items.ex2_zh: 压榨过的葡萄在深秋数月于干净的木桶中自然发酵。

items.def_en: 1. (informal) To distill or brew alcoholic liquor illegally.
items.ex_en: Mountain outlaws used hidden copper stills deep in the forest to moonshine potent whiskey.
items.ex_zh: 深山法外狂徒在森林深处使用隐蔽的铜蒸馏器私酿高纯度烈性威士忌。

items.def_en: to fry food lightly and then stew it slowly in a closed container
items.ex_en: The recipe calls on home cooks to braise the beef brisket in red wine.
items.ex_zh: 这份食谱要求家庭厨师将牛胸肉浸入红葡萄酒中用文火慢炖。

items.def_zh: 调制（甜食、糕点）；配制（药剂）
items.def_en: 1. To make or prepare something (especially a sweet dish, candy, or pastry) by combining ingredients.
items.ex_en: The master baker proceeded to confection delicate chocolate figurines filled with fruit liqueur.
items.ex_zh: 糕点大师着手精心配制注入了水果利口酒的精美巧克力小塑像。

items.def_en: to produce liquor or essential liquids by vaporization and condensation
items.ex_en: The historic artisan distillery continues to distill fine botanical gin in small copper batches.
items.ex_zh: 这家历史悠久的工匠蒸馏厂继续用小批量的铜锅蒸馏精制草本金酒。

items.def_en: 1. To cook or grill food on a small portable charcoal brazier.
items.ex_en: We love to hibachi fresh skewered chicken and scallions on the backyard patio.
items.ex_zh: 我们喜欢在后院露台上用日式炭炉烤新鲜的葱肉鸡肉串。

items.def_zh: 沿脊骨剖平（家禽以便烤制）；强行塞入
items.def_en: 1. (cooking) To split a whole chicken or bird open flat along the backbone so it cooks faster and more evenly. 2. To insert or force something into a text or plan where it does not naturally belong.
items.ex_en: It is best to spatchcock the turkey so that it roasts much more evenly.
items.ex_zh: 最好顺着脊骨把整只火鸡剖开压平，这样烤制时受热更均匀。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this domain describe specialized, artisanal culinary preparations, preservation, and distillation methods. They emphasize specific technical actions—such as splitting poultry, crafting confections, or fermenting and distilling beverages.
groups.summary_zh: 描述特定的专业料理处理手法与自酿、熬糖等专门烹饪技术行为。
groups.desc_en: Encompasses specialized, transformative culinary or biochemical preparation techniques, contrasting with generic, rudimentary heating or frying.
groups.desc_zh: 指具有特定工艺规范或生物化学转化机制的专业烹饪与酿造技法，区别于基础的笼统加热或炒煮。
groups.nuance_en: braise: searing then simmering slowly in closed liquid (short ribs / shanks) · parboil: partially boiling food as a preliminary step (potatoes / rice) · ferment: biochemical breakdown via microbes or yeast (beer / cabbage / dough) · confection: compounding sweet ingredients into elaborate delicacies (sweets / pastries)
groups.nuance_zh: braise: 先煎炒后在密闭容器中加汁慢炖 (short ribs / shanks) · parboil: 预先焯烫或半熟煮制 (potatoes / rice) · ferment: 利用微生物发酵转化风味 (beer / cabbage / dough) · confection: 精工调制糖果蜜饯或甜点 (sweets / pastries)

groups.name: Speculate & Assume · 推测与假定 (Hazard, Hypothesize, Postulate)
groups.tip: 依据有限线索进行推测

items.def_en: (+ sth) use information, clues, or assumptions as the basis for an opinion or conjecture
items.ex_en: We have very little evidence to go on regarding the suspect's true motive.
items.ex_zh: 关于嫌疑人的真正动机，我们几乎没有什么确凿线索可以作为推断依据。

items.def_en: (+ sth) expect, assume, or calculate that something will happen without certain proof
items.ex_en: Never reckon on good weather when planning an autumn hike through the Scottish Highlands.
items.ex_zh: 在计划苏格兰高地的秋季徒步旅行时，切莫指望能碰上好天气。

items.def_zh: 大胆猜测，冒昧提出；使冒危险，冒……的险
items.def_en: 1. To risk putting forward a guess, suggestion, or opinion that might be wrong. 2. To put something at risk of danger or loss.
items.ex_en: I dare not hazard an opinion without examining the experimental data in full detail.
items.ex_zh: 在未详细审查全部实验数据之前，我不敢冒昧提出任何意见。

items.def_zh: 假定，推定，认为；擅自，冒昧
items.def_en: 1. To suppose that something is true on the basis of probability, without definite proof. 2. (formal) To be bold enough to do something without right or permission.
items.ex_en: The investigators presume that the sudden electrical surge triggered the massive factory fire.
items.ex_zh: 调查人员推定，突发的电压骤增引发了那场巨大的工厂火灾。

items.def_en: 1. To form opinions or theories about something without having complete information. 2. To buy and sell goods or assets hoping to make a quick profit from market fluctuations.
items.ex_en: Financial analysts speculate that interest rates may drop significantly before the fiscal year ends.
items.ex_zh: 金融分析师推测，在本财年结束前基准利率可能会大幅下调。

items.def_en: 1. To suggest a possible explanation or theory for something that has not yet been proved.
items.ex_en: Biologists hypothesize that the strange plumage evolved primarily to attract selective mating partners.
items.ex_zh: 生物学家提出假设，认为这种奇特的羽毛演化主要用于吸引挑剔的配偶。

items.def_zh: 以……为前提；假定，预先设定
items.def_en: 1. To base an argument, theory, or statement on a particular premise or assumption.
items.ex_en: Modern economists premise their market models on the core belief that buyers act rationally.
items.ex_zh: 现代经济学家以买家行为理性这一核心假定为前提，构建其市场模型。

items.def_en: to form an opinion or supposition based on incomplete evidence
items.ex_en: Scholars can only conjecture the original layout of the ruined temple from fragmented stones.
items.ex_zh: 学者们只能根据残缺的石块遗迹，去推测这座残毁神庙的原始布局。

items.def_zh: 假定，假设；要求，视……为必要条件
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To suggest or accept that something is true as the basis for a theory, argument, or calculation.
items.ex_en: Theoretical physicists postulate the existence of extra spatial dimensions to reconcile quantum gravity.
items.ex_zh: 理论物理学家假定存在额外的空间维度，以此来调和解释量子引力。

items.def_en: to guess that something is true using circumstantial clues without certainty
items.ex_en: From the wet umbrellas, we can easily surmise that heavy rain started outside.
items.ex_zh: 从湿漉漉的雨伞上，我们可以轻易揣测出外面已经下起了大雨。

items.def_en: to suggest or assume a fact or principle as the basis for an argument or theory
items.ex_en: Philosophers often posit that moral values are deeply rooted in evolved human empathy.
items.ex_zh: 哲学家们常常假定，道德价值观深深扎根于人类进化出的同理心之中。

groups.summary_en: A cognizer adopts a provisional belief or theoretical proposition without conclusive proof, varying from tentative, risky guesses to rigorous foundational premises in philosophical or scientific argumentation.
groups.summary_zh: 在缺乏确凿证据下提出假设、推断或前置命题以供论证。
groups.desc_en: Articulates cognitive conjectures formulated with varying degrees of epistemic uncertainty or formal theoretical rigor, contrasting with factual knowledge or verified observation.
groups.desc_zh: 表示基于不完全证据或理论推导所作出的假设与推想，带有不同程度的不确定性，区别于确凿认知或既成事实。
groups.nuance_en: hazard: venturing an uncertain guess despite risk of error (guess / opinion / estimate) · hypothesize: formulating a structured, testable scientific proposal (cause / mechanism / outcome) · postulate: claiming an foundational premise assumed true for an argument (principle / axiom / theory) · conjecture: intuitive guessing based on incomplete clues (motive / outcome)
groups.nuance_zh: hazard: 冒着失误风险大胆提出揣测 (guess / opinion / estimate) · hypothesize: 提出有待验证的科学假说 (cause / mechanism / outcome) · postulate: 预设某项基本假定作为论证基石 (principle / axiom / theory) · conjecture: 凭不充分线索做出的推想猜测 (motive / outcome)

groups.name: Spend & Splurge Money · 消费与挥霍金钱 (Spend, Splurge, Lavish)
groups.tip: 支出金钱或耗费资源

items.def_en: to spend or give away large amounts of money freely
items.ex_en: Generous benefactors continue to dish out huge sums of funding to local animal shelters.
items.ex_zh: 慷慨的捐助者们继续大把掏出巨额资金，无偿资助当地的动物收容所。

items.def_zh: 勉强掏出；舍得拿出（钱款）
items.def_en: (+ sth) provide or spend money reluctantly, often under pressure
items.ex_en: The landlord pressured the reluctant tenant to cough up overdue rent by tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 房东施加压力，要求那名不情愿的租客在明早之前勉强掏出逾期房租。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ for/on) to spend a substantial amount of money, usually with reluctance
items.ex_en: He hated having to fork out five hundred dollars on emergency brake repairs.
items.ex_zh: 他非常痛恨自己不得不为了紧急修理刹车而破费五百美元。

items.def_en: (+ sth) spend an amount of money, usually an expensive one
items.ex_en: The CEO laid out an ambitious five-year growth strategy.
items.ex_zh: 首席执行官详细阐述了一项雄心勃勃的五年增长战略。

items.def_en: (+ sth) pay a large or unwelcome amount of money for something
items.ex_en: Shoppers had to shell out extra money for organic vegetables at the market.
items.ex_zh: 购物者们不得不在菜市场上掏大笔额外花销来购买有机蔬菜。

items.def_zh: 花钱，花费；花费（时间、精力）；消耗
items.def_en: To pay out money, or use up time, effort, or resources for a particular purpose.
items.ex_en: Families often spend hundreds of dollars on gifts during the busy holiday season.
items.ex_zh: 在忙碌的节日期间，许多家庭常常会在礼品上花销数百美元。

items.def_zh: 花钱，花费（spend的过去式与过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of spend.
items.ex_en: She spent her entire summer savings on a reliable second-hand laptop for college.
items.ex_zh: 她把整个暑假的全部积蓄都花在了一台靠谱的大学二手笔记本电脑上。

items.def_zh: 挥霍；花大笔钱（在奢华物品上）
items.def_en: spend a substantial amount of money freely or extravagantly
items.ex_en: We decided to splash out on a luxury cruise for our anniversary.
items.ex_zh: 我们决定在结婚纪念日挥霍一番，去坐豪华游轮。

items.def_en: to spend all of one's money rapidly and carelessly on temporary pleasures
items.ex_en: He managed to blow his entire weekly paycheck in just one night.
items.ex_zh: 他竟然只用一个晚上就把整周的薪水挥霍一空。

items.def_en: to waste money, wealth, or resources foolishly and recklessly
items.ex_en: The reckless heir squandered his vast family fortune on reckless speculative ventures.
items.ex_zh: 这个鲁莽的继承人将巨额家产肆意挥霍在投机冒险之中。

items.def_en: (+ on) (informal) To spend a large amount of money extravagantly, especially on something luxurious.
items.ex_en: She decided to splurge on a designer handbag to reward herself today.
items.ex_zh: 她今天决定犒劳一下自己，大手笔买了一个名牌包。

groups.summary_en: An agent expends monetary resources, ranging from routine buying to excessive, self-indulgent, or unrestrained spending. Patterns include spending money on goods or splurging on luxuries.
groups.summary_zh: 个体支出金钱，从日常平稳花费到大手大脚奢靡挥霍。
groups.desc_en: Emphasizes the manner of disbursing financial resources, distinguishing voluntary lavish spending or grudging surrender from neutral, non-evaluative purchasing.
groups.desc_zh: 强调金钱支出的主观态度与消费力度，聚焦于被迫掏钱或豪放挥霍，区别于中性的付账结算。
groups.nuance_en: splash out: extravagant, indulgent celebratory expenditure (vacation / luxury car / party) · fork out: paying reluctantly, typically for hefty expenses (cash / fees / repairs) · cough up: surrendering money under external duress or obligation (ransom / back taxes / dues) · shell out: expending sizable sums repeatedly or resentfully (millions / fortunes / tuition)
groups.nuance_zh: splash out: 挥金如土般犒劳式消费 (vacation / luxury car / party) · fork out: 极不情愿地支付大笔开销 (cash / fees / repairs) · cough up: 在逼迫或义务下勉强吐出款项 (ransom / back taxes / dues) · shell out: 怨声载道地掏出巨额现钱 (millions / fortunes / tuition)

groups.name: Spin & Swirl · 旋转与涡流 (Spin, Whirl, Swirl)
groups.tip: 围绕轴心打转旋动

items.def_en: (+ sth) move or cause to move around in a graceful, twisting or whirling eddying pattern
items.ex_en: Golden autumn leaves swirl around the courtyard whenever the chill wind blows.
items.ex_zh: 每当寒风吹过，金黄的秋叶便在院子里打旋飞舞。
items.ex2_en: The graceful dancer swirled her colorful silk skirt around the bright stage.
items.ex2_zh: 优雅的舞者在明亮的舞台上旋转起她色彩斑斓的丝绸裙摆。

items.def_en: (of water, wind, or smoke) To move in a circular motion, forming a whirlpool or whirlwind.
items.ex_en: Wisps of fragrant blue smoke eddy lazily toward the vaulted stone ceiling.
items.ex_zh: 缕缕芬芳的青烟打着旋儿，慵懒地升向拱形石顶。

items.def_zh: 脚尖旋转，原地轻快旋舞
items.def_en: to perform a rapid, controlled spin on one foot or on the points of the toes
items.ex_en: The prima ballerina performed a flawless pirouette before landing softly on stage.
items.ex_zh: 首席芭蕾舞演员完成了一个毫无瑕疵的单脚旋转，随后轻巧落地。

items.def_en: (physics, astronomy) To undergo precession; (of a rotating body's axis) to wobble or rotate slowly in a conical pattern.
items.ex_en: The spinning gyroscope began to precess slowly as its rotational momentum decayed.
items.ex_zh: 随着转动动量衰退，旋转的陀螺开始缓慢地作旋进运动。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) turn or cause to turn around rapidly in a full circle
items.ex_en: She heard her name called and spun around to face the newcomer.
items.ex_zh: 听到有人叫自己的名字，她迅速转过身面对来人。
items.ex2_en: He playfully spun his giggling little sister around across the grassy yard.
items.ex2_zh: 他开玩笑地抱起咯咯笑的小妹妹在草地上转了一圈。

items.def_en: rotate or spin very quickly in a circle or vortex
items.ex_en: Fallen red petals whirl around in the sudden gust outside the temple.
items.ex_zh: 庙门外的阵阵突风中，落红的花瓣飞旋打转。

items.def_en: To move or cause to move with a twisting, circular, or spinning motion.
items.ex_en: He gently swirled the vintage wine in his glass to release its aroma.
items.ex_zh: 他轻轻摇晃杯中的陈年佳酿，使其香气四溢。
items.ex2_en: Thick grey smoke swirled gracefully above the chimney on the cold evening.
items.ex2_zh: 寒冷的傍晚，浓密的灰色烟雾在烟囱上方优雅地盘旋。

items.def_zh: 剧烈翻腾，搅动；搅拌（奶制黄油）；大量炮制（churn out）
items.def_en: 1. To move violently and turbulently, or agitate a liquid vigorously. 2. To shake cream in a churn to produce butter. 3. ('churn out') To produce large quantities of something rapidly.
items.ex_en: Violent white waves churn against the rugged black cliffs during the storm.
items.ex_zh: 暴风雨中，汹涌的白色巨浪在崎岖的黑崖边剧烈翻腾。
items.ex2_en: The old wooden machine churns fresh dairy cream into rich yellow butter.
items.ex2_zh: 这台老旧的木制机器将新鲜奶油搅拌成浓郁的黄油。

items.def_en: to move in a rapidly spiraling vortex or whirlpool formation
items.ex_en: Dark gathering clouds vortex across the autumn sky before the torrential downpour.
items.ex_zh: 倾盆大雨倾泻之前，浓重的乌云在秋日的天空盘旋成涡。

items.def_en: [I/T] to rotate or turn around rapidly in a circle or spiral
items.ex_en: Couples whirled happily across the wooden dance floor to the lively waltz.
items.ex_zh: 伴着轻快的华尔兹舞曲，一对对伴侣在木质舞池中飞旋起舞。
items.ex2_en: The lively carnival dancer whirled her brightly patterned skirt around the plaza.
items.ex2_zh: 活泼的嘉年华舞者在广场上旋转起她图案鲜艳的裙子。

items.def_zh: 旋转，回旋；（尤指跳舞时）扭动身体
items.def_en: To spin or rotate quickly in circles or spirals; to move one's body or hips in a circular motion.
items.ex_en: The celestial bodies gyrate continuously through the deep silence of outer space.
items.ex_zh: 天体在幽深寂静的外太空之中持续回旋运转。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe circular, vortex-like, or oscillatory fluid/rotational motion, distinguishing smooth revolving, chaotic swirling, and turbulent churning.
groups.summary_zh: 描述环状旋转、涡旋打转或伴随紊流剧烈翻滚的运动方式。
groups.desc_en: Describes rapid circular rotation around an axis or chaotic turbulent vortex motion, contrasting with straightforward linear trajectory or static oscillation.
groups.desc_zh: 描述围绕轴心的急剧旋转或流体形成的湍急旋涡运动，区别于直线运动或平面摆动。
groups.nuance_en: swirl: fluid, curving vortex motion (cream / smoke / skirt) · pirouette: precise, rapid body spin balanced on toes (dancer / skater) · eddy: circular backward-flowing current behind obstacles (water / wind / dust) · churn: violent, frothing rotational agitation (sea / stomach / mud)
groups.nuance_zh: swirl: 流体或轻柔织物盘旋翻卷成涡 (cream / smoke / skirt) · pirouette: 依靠脚尖进行的芭蕾式利落自转 (dancer / skater) · eddy: 绕着障碍物形成的微型逆旋风或逆流 (water / wind / dust) · churn: 剧烈翻腾、搅动或泛起泡沫 (sea / stomach / mud)

groups.name: Splash & Sluice · 飞溅与冲刷 (Slosh, Spatter, Sluice)
groups.tip: 液体晃动飞溅、喷洒或冲刷

items.def_en: (+ sth) move or cause a liquid to move violently and noisily inside or over a container or surface
items.ex_en: Water sloshed around in the heavy plastic bucket as she carried it.
items.ex_zh: 她提着沉重的塑料桶时，里面的水哗哗乱晃乱泼。
items.ex2_en: Careless painters sloshed soapy water around the wooden kitchen floor while scrubbing.
items.ex2_zh: 粗心的粉刷工在擦洗时把肥皂水溅得木质厨房地板上到处都是。

items.def_en: move around noisily in water or another liquid, causing it to spray in all directions
items.ex_en: The cheerful children loved to splash about in the warm garden pool.
items.ex_zh: 快活的孩子们喜欢在温暖的花园泳池里戏水打闹。

items.def_en: to cause liquid to fly in drops by striking it, or to fall in scattered drops
items.ex_en: A passing truck splashed muddy water all over my clean white trousers.
items.ex_zh: 一辆驶过的卡车把泥水溅得我白裤子上到处都是。
items.ex2_en: Cool mountain water splashed noisily over the slippery mossy stones all afternoon.
items.ex2_zh: 清凉的山泉水整个下午哗哗地溅在湿滑的苔藓石头上。

items.def_zh: （使液体）晃荡飞溅，泼洒；涉（水、泥）走
items.def_en: 1. (of a liquid) To move around or splash noisily, or to make liquid do this. 2. To walk noisily or clumsily through water or mud.
items.ex_en: We had to slosh through deep muddy puddles after the heavy rain.
items.ex_zh: 大雨过后，我们不得不涉着泥水坑啪嗒啪嗒地前行。
items.ex2_en: He inadvertently sloshed hot black coffee over the clean tablecloth during breakfast.
items.ex2_zh: 他在吃早餐时不小心把热黑咖啡泼洒在干净的桌布上。

items.def_zh: 用大量水冲洗；冲刷干净
items.def_en: (+ sth) clean a large surface or object thoroughly by pouring or sluicing copious water over it
items.ex_en: He washed down the spicy tacos with a cold glass of lemonade.
items.ex_zh: 他喝了一大口冰柠檬水，咽下了辛辣的墨西哥卷饼。

items.def_en: to splash with continuous noisy impact, sending viscous or liquid spots everywhere
items.ex_en: Hot tomato sauce splattered across the white kitchen counter while simmering vigorously.
items.ex_zh: 热番茄酱在剧烈炖煮时乱溅，弄脏了白色的厨房台面。
items.ex2_en: Careless painters splattered dark green paint all over the polished hardwood floor.
items.ex2_zh: 粗心的油漆工将深绿色油漆泼溅在抛光的硬木地板上。

items.def_en: To cover someone or something with drops of liquid, mud, etc., or to fall and splash in small drops.
items.ex_en: Tiny drops of black grease spattered over his apron during the frying.
items.ex_zh: 油炸过程中，细小的黑色油星飞溅在他的围裙上。
items.ex2_en: The speeding sports car spattered thick wet mud all over our coats.
items.ex2_zh: 飞驰的跑车把厚厚的湿泥溅得我们外套上到处都是。

items.def_zh: （水或波浪）哗哗作响地冲击，冲刷；飞溅
items.def_en: (of water or waves) To splash, wash, or surge noisily against something; to pour or dash water violently.
items.ex_en: Foamy grey ocean waves swash ceaselessly against the cold granite pier.
items.ex_zh: 泛着白沫的灰色海浪不知疲倦地拍打冲刷着冰冷的花岗岩码头。
items.ex2_en: Sailors swashed buckets of seawater across the wooden deck to clean it.
items.ex2_zh: 水手们将一桶桶海水冲刷在木甲板上进行清理。

items.def_zh: （在泥水中）扑通啪嗒地飞溅，涉水溅水
items.def_en: To splash noisily through water, mud, or another liquid.
items.ex_en: The boy put on his boots and sploshed merrily through every puddle.
items.ex_zh: 小男孩套上靴子，欢快地在每个水洼里扑通扑通涉水玩耍。

items.def_zh: 喷洒，喷淋；（酿造中）冲洗（麦糟）
items.def_en: To spray or sprinkle a liquid; in brewing, to rinse the mashed grains with hot water to extract sugars.
items.ex_en: The brewer carefully sparged the mashed barley with hot steaming water.
items.ex_zh: 酿酒师用滚烫的热水仔细冲淋麦芽糟以萃取糖分。

items.def_en: 1. To wash or rinse something by pouring a large quantity of water over it. 2. (of water) To pour or flow rapidly and in large amounts.
items.ex_en: Workers used high-pressure hoses to sluice the muddy deck after docking.
items.ex_zh: 靠岸后，工人们用高压水管把满是泥泞的甲板冲洗干净。
items.ex2_en: Torrential mountain rain sluiced down the steep rocky slopes during the thunderstorm.
items.ex2_zh: 雷雨期间，倾盆山雨顺着陡峭的岩石斜坡奔流直下。

groups.summary_en: Liquids surge, strike surfaces in droplets, or are dashed/poured in volume over objects. Manner varies from noisy agitation inside vessels to violent droplet scattering, industrial distribution, and torrential washing.
groups.summary_zh: 液体晃荡溢出、以水花飞溅沾染，或引大水漫浇冲刷。
groups.desc_en: Depicts violent agitation, dispersion, or directed torrents of liquid hitting or sloshing against surfaces, differing from calm immersion or slow soaking.
groups.desc_zh: 描述液体受剧烈扰动而晃荡、四散飞溅或强力冲淋表面的动态，区别于静止浸润或缓慢渗透。
groups.nuance_en: slosh: noisy liquid swaying and spilling within a vessel (bucket / puddle / boots) · spatter: scattering droplets haphazardly in small bursts (grease / mud / drops) · splatter: messy impact scattering large, wet patches (blood / paint / food) · sluice: pouring or channeling heavy volumes of liquid to flush (deck / gate / dirt)
groups.nuance_zh: slosh: 液体在容器内晃荡溢出或踏水作响 (bucket / puddle / boots) · spatter: 细密水珠或油点点滴飞溅 (grease / mud / drops) · splatter: 大片液体砸在表面溅出凌乱痕迹 (blood / paint / food) · sluice: 引导强力水流冲刷淘洗 (deck / gate / dirt)

groups.name: Spoil & Pamper Excessively · 溺爱与过分姑息 (Pamper, Cosset, Mollycoddle)
groups.tip: 自我沉溺或无底线宠溺

items.def_zh: 过分呵护关照；对…小题大做娇宠
items.def_en: (+ sb) pay excessive, overprotective, or anxious attention to someone's comfort and needs
items.ex_en: Grandmother always fusses over the children whenever they catch a slight cold.
items.ex_zh: 每当孩子们稍微有点着凉，祖母总是对他们过分关照呵护。

items.def_en: (+ sb) shower someone with excessive, uncritical love, affection, and indulgence
items.ex_en: The proud parents dote on their newborn daughter with unconditional devotion.
items.ex_zh: 骄傲的父母全心全意地溺爱着他们刚出生的女儿。

items.def_en: to treat an older person as if they were a delicate, helpless infant
items.ex_en: Stop babying him; he is twenty years old and completely capable now.
items.ex_zh: 别再把他当婴儿护着了，他都二十岁了，完全能自理。

items.def_en: to harm someone's character through excessive leniency or yielding to every wish
items.ex_en: Grandparents often spoil their grandchildren by granting every whimsical wish they make.
items.ex_zh: 祖父母往往百依百顺，容易把孙辈给惯坏。
items.ex2_en: Fresh raw milk spoils remarkably quickly if left unrefrigerated on warm afternoons.
items.ex2_zh: 新鲜生牛奶在温暖的午后若不冷藏，变质得非常快。

items.def_en: to treat someone with excessive luxury, comfort, and attentive care
items.ex_en: She spent her entire Sunday afternoon pampering herself at the luxury spa.
items.ex_zh: 她在豪华水疗中心悉心放松享受了一整个周日下午。

items.def_zh: 沉溺，沉迷（于情绪或快感中）；（动物在泥水中）打滚
items.def_en: 1. (+ in) To indulge excessively in an emotion, condition, or sensation. 2. (of animals) To roll about or lie in mud or water.
items.ex_en: After the bitter breakup, he continued to wallow in self-pity for weeks.
items.ex_zh: 经历痛苦的分手后，他连续数周沉溺于自怜自哀之中。

items.def_zh: 迎合；纵容（不良嗜好或无理要求）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) indulge or gratify weak, unreasonable, or selfish desires and demands
items.ex_en: Sensational tabloid newspapers constantly pander to the public's thirst for cheap scandals.
items.ex_zh: 耸人听闻的小报不断迎合公众对低俗丑闻的猎奇嗜好。

items.def_en: to protect and care for someone in an overindulgent, protective way
items.ex_en: The frail prince was cosseted from every harsh reality within the palace.
items.ex_zh: 体弱多病的王子在深宫内备受呵护，免受外界一切残酷现实的侵扰。

items.def_zh: 溺爱，宠爱（常与 on/upon 连用）；昏聩
items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To be extremely and uncritically fond of someone; show excessive love and affection.
items.ex_en: The elderly couple dote on their golden retriever as their own child.
items.ex_zh: 这对老夫妇把他们的金毛猎犬当成亲生孩子一般疼爱。

items.def_zh: 过度放纵，过度沉溺；过分溺爱，纵容
items.def_en: 1. To indulge oneself too much, especially in food or drink. 2. To give someone, especially a child, too much of what they want; spoil excessively.
items.ex_en: Wealthy patrons must not overindulge their children with lavish unearned privileges.
items.ex_zh: 富有的长辈绝不可给孩子过多不劳而获的特权而过度纵容他们。
items.ex2_en: Holiday visitors frequently overindulge on rich gourmet pastries during the festive winter season.
items.ex2_zh: 节日游客在欢快的冬季常常过量享用美味的精制糕点。

items.def_en: (disapproving) To treat someone with excessive indulgence, care, or protection.
items.ex_en: You will ruin his independence if you keep mollycoddling him like that.
items.ex_zh: 如果你继续那样对他过分娇惯，迟早会毁掉他的独立性。

groups.summary_en: Treating a dependent, child, or oneself with extreme indulgence, shielding them from hardship, or lingering self-indulgently in an emotional state. Verbs contrast maternal softness, overprotection, and self-absorbed wallowing.
groups.summary_zh: 无节制地迁就、庇护溺爱他人或沉溺于自我心绪
groups.desc_en: Denotes excessive indulgence, shielding, or catering to someone's whims in a manner that fosters dependency or weakness, beyond balanced, healthy care.
groups.desc_zh: 指对他人提供过度的娇惯、溺爱或百依百顺，往往导致其软弱任性，区别于正常的关怀与爱护。
groups.nuance_en: pamper: treating to luxurious comfort and physical indulgence (guests / spa-goers / body) · cosset: overprotectively shielding from hardship or cold (child / invalid / pet) · dote on: displaying blind, uncritical, loving adoration (grandchild / darling / daughter) · pander to: base appeasement of someone's degraded tastes or whims (fears / audience / tastes)
groups.nuance_zh: pamper: 提供极度舒适与奢华的悉心呵护 (guests / spa-goers / body) · cosset: 像温室花朵般过度娇惯与庇护 (child / invalid / pet) · dote on: 满腔偏爱、溺爱到盲目的地步 (grandchild / darling / daughter) · pander to: 毫无底线地迎合低俗趣味或偏狭诉求 (fears / audience / tastes)

groups.name: Stack & Arrange · 堆叠与排列 (Order, Layer, Heap)
groups.tip: 按顺序层叠或摆列整齐

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) arrange people or objects into a straight and orderly sequence
items.ex_en: The drill sergeant ordered the nervous young recruits to line up immediately.
items.ex_zh: 训练教官命令那些紧张的新兵立刻站成整齐的一排。
items.ex2_en: The diligent teacher lined up the excited schoolchildren along the painted corridor.
items.ex2_zh: 勤勉的老师把兴奋的小学生们在粉刷过的走廊边排成一列。

items.def_en: (+ sth) arrange objects neatly one on top of another in vertical layers
items.ex_en: Please stack up the folding chairs against the back wall after class.
items.ex_zh: 下课后请将折叠椅整齐地堆叠在后墙边。
items.ex2_en: Heavy unpaid medical bills stack up rapidly on the crowded kitchen counter.
items.ex2_zh: 大笔未付的医疗账单在拥挤的厨房柜台上迅速堆积起来。

items.def_zh: 堆成土堆；把（土）培在……周围
items.def_en: To form into a mound or heap; to draw earth up around the roots of plants.
items.ex_en: The seasoned gardener carefully hilled the rich loam around the potato vines.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的园丁将肥沃的壤土仔细培在马铃薯藤蔓的根部四周。

items.def_zh: 分层堆放，把……分层排列；用压条法培育
items.def_en: To arrange, stack, or place things in layers.
items.ex_en: The chef layered thin slices of eggplant with mozzarella and fresh basil.
items.ex_zh: 厨师将茄子薄片与马苏里拉奶酪及新鲜罗勒逐层叠放。

items.def_en: to arrange things neatly in an orderly, vertical pile
items.ex_en: Workers stack heavy crates of fresh oranges neatly into the cold storage.
items.ex_zh: 工人们把装满鲜橙的沉重板条箱整齐地码放在冷库里。
items.ex2_en: Neat wooden storage boxes stack safely together inside the cramped attic corner.
items.ex2_zh: 整齐的木制储物箱在狭窄的阁楼角落里稳稳地叠放起来。

items.def_en: (+ sth) accumulate or gather things into a high heap or mound
items.ex_en: Discarded autumn leaves pile up along the brick pathway through the garden.
items.ex_zh: 飘落的秋叶在穿过花园的砖石小径旁积成了厚厚的一堆。
items.ex2_en: Warehouse workers pile up heavy cardboard boxes near the main loading dock.
items.ex2_zh: 仓库工人们在主装卸码头附近堆起沉重的纸箱。

items.def_zh: 排列，整理，布置；安排，筹划；改编（乐曲）
items.def_en: 1. To put things in a neat, attractive, or particular order. 2. To plan, prepare, or organize something in advance. 3. To adapt a piece of music for different instruments or voices.
items.ex_en: She carefully arranged the colorful wild blossoms in the tall ceramic vase.
items.ex_zh: 她精心将五颜六色的野花插在那个高高的陶瓷花瓶里。

items.def_zh: 按顺序排列，按次序排好；测定（基因或蛋白质等的）序列
items.def_en: 1. To arrange things in a particular order or series. 2. To determine the order of chemical components in (a gene, DNA, or protein).
items.ex_en: Researchers managed to sequence the entire viral genome within a few days.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员在几天之内就成功测定了该病毒的完整基因序列。

items.def_zh: 堆积，叠放；拥挤，蜂拥而入（或出）
items.def_en: 1. To put things one on top of another to form a heap; to arrange in stacks. 2. To crowd or push together in a disorganized way.
items.ex_en: He piled the dry firewood neatly beneath the wooden porch before sunset.
items.ex_zh: 他在日落前把干燥的木柴整齐地堆在木质门廊下方。
items.ex2_en: Freshly fallen snow piled high against the rustic wooden barn door overnight.
items.ex2_zh: 新下的雪一夜之间在质朴的木谷仓门前堆得很高。

items.def_en: to gather or place things loosely together in a large mass or mound
items.ex_en: Volunteers heaped old winter clothes onto the center of the wooden table.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者们把旧冬衣胡乱堆聚在木桌的正中央。

items.def_en: to arrange or organize items in progressive rows, levels, or stepped ranks
items.ex_en: The baker tiered the magnificent wedding cake with elaborate sugar rose decorations.
items.ex_zh: 面包师把华丽的婚礼蛋糕做成分层结构，并缀以精美的糖玫瑰花。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote placing physical items or data into organized spatial arrays, stratified layers, or vertical accumulation according to a deliberate system or pattern.
groups.summary_zh: 按特定顺序、层级或空间系统将物体逐一摆放、层叠或聚积成堆。
groups.desc_en: Involves structuring, organizing, or vertical accumulation of discrete items into an orderly hierarchy or neat formation, unlike haphazard scattering or messy dropping.
groups.desc_zh: 指将独立物品按次序、层次或垂直向上规整堆叠摆放，区别于杂乱无章的散落或胡乱弃置。
groups.nuance_en: stack: neat vertical layering on top of one another (boxes / plates / wood) · layer: arranging strata horizontally or sequentially (cake / soil / clothing) · sequence: ordering items logically or chronologically (events / genes / data) · line up: arranging multiple items into a straight line or queue (bottles / cars / soldiers)
groups.nuance_zh: stack: 垂直规整叠放成垛 (boxes / plates / wood) · layer: 将物料分层平铺或交叠布置 (cake / soil / clothing) · sequence: 按时序或严密逻辑先后排序 (events / genes / data) · line up: 排成整齐的一行或纵列 (bottles / cars / soldiers)

groups.name: Store & House · 入库装桶与仓储 (Warehouse, Bin, Garage)
groups.tip: 将物资装箱并存入库房保存

items.def_en: 1. To put or pack liquid, food, or goods into barrels. 2. (informal) To move very fast in a particular direction.
items.ex_en: The vintage sports car barreled down the narrow country road at high speed.
items.ex_zh: 那辆老式跑车在狭窄的乡间小路上高速飞驰而去。

items.def_zh: 存入仓（箱）中；扔进垃圾箱
items.def_en: 1. To store or put items into bins or large storage containers. 2. (informal, chiefly British) To throw something away into a rubbish bin.
items.ex_en: I decided to bin the broken electronic toys instead of repairing them.
items.ex_zh: 我决定把坏掉的电动玩具直接扔进垃圾箱，而不是拿去修理。

items.def_zh: 把（车）存放在车库中，停入车库
items.def_en: 1. To put, keep, or store a motor vehicle in a garage.
items.ex_en: He always garages his classic convertible whenever heavy hail is officially forecast.
items.ex_zh: 只要气象预报有大冰雹，他总会把老爷敞篷车停入车库保管。

items.def_en: to store grain, bulk material, or data in a silo or separate container
items.ex_en: The agricultural cooperative silos surplus wheat to stabilize grain prices during winter.
items.ex_zh: 农业合作社将过剩的小麦储存在筒仓内，以稳定冬季粮价。

items.def_en: to place goods or equipment in a storehouse or transport base
items.ex_en: The shipping firm depots newly arrived containers at the regional logistics facility.
items.ex_zh: 货运公司将新到的集装箱就地储存在区域物流中心的储运库内。

items.def_en: (+ sth) pack or store goods, luggage, or equipment neatly in an allocated space
items.ex_en: Passengers must stow away their bulky carry-on bags before takeoff takes place.
items.ex_zh: 起飞之前，乘客必须将笨重的手提行李妥善收纳进上方行李舱。

items.def_en: (+ sth) store or put something away safely and securely in an out-of-the-way spot
items.ex_en: She tucked away the vintage jewelry inside a hidden drawer for safekeeping.
items.ex_zh: 她把复古首饰藏在一个隐秘的抽屉深处妥善保管。

items.def_en: (+ sth) put items away into storage containers, boxes, or cupboards until needed again
items.ex_en: We pack away all winter quilts into sealed boxes during early spring.
items.ex_zh: 初春时节，我们会把所有冬被收拾封存进密封箱内。

items.def_en: 1. To store large quantities of goods or materials in a warehouse.
items.ex_en: The international retailer warehouses bulk electronic components inside automated distribution centers.
items.ex_zh: 这家跨国零售商将大批电子元器件仓储在自动化配送中心。

items.def_en: to pack items into a large wooden or plastic container for transport or storage
items.ex_en: Farm workers crate fresh crisp apples for long-distance transport to coastal cities.
items.ex_zh: 农场工人把新鲜清脆的苹果装进板条箱，以便长途运往沿海城市。

items.def_en: to pack or store something carefully and neatly in a safe or compact place
items.ex_en: Sailors carefully stow heavy ropes and deck equipment inside the ship's hold.
items.ex_zh: 水手们把沉重的绳索和甲板装备小心地收纳进船舱固定处。

groups.summary_en: An agent deposits goods, vehicles, or bulk materials into specialized storage containers, bays, or commercial facilities for safekeeping or inventory holding.
groups.summary_zh: 将物品或车辆置入专用的容器、车库或仓储设施以供保存。
groups.desc_en: Refers to placing, securing, or compartmentalizing goods into specific designated receptacles or spaces for protected holding, differing from ordinary casual placement.
groups.desc_zh: 指将物资或设备分类安放进特定容器、库房或隔离空间中妥善贮藏，区别于随手搁置。
groups.nuance_en: silo: sequestering resources, ideas, or data into isolated units (data / departments / grain) · barrel: packing or aging liquid commodities inside wooden casks (whiskey / crude / wine) · stow away: neatly packing objects into compact, secure storage (luggage / gear / supplies) · garage: parking and sheltering a vehicle inside a dedicated structure (car / plane / bus)
groups.nuance_zh: silo: 将数据、部门或物资隔离存入孤立筒仓 (data / departments / grain) · barrel: 灌入木桶熟化或密封封存 (whiskey / crude / wine) · stow away: 规整稳妥地收纳进紧凑储物空间 (luggage / gear / supplies) · garage: 将车辆停放收入车库掩蔽 (car / plane / bus)

groups.name: Strengthen & Consolidate · 增强与巩固 (Fortify, Shore Up, Bolster)
groups.tip: 使状态稳定牢靠、增强坚固度

items.def_en: To make or become stronger, firmer, or more effective.
items.ex_en: Daily morning exercise helps strengthen your immune system against common winter illnesses.
items.ex_zh: 每天晨练有助于增强你的免疫系统，抵御常见的冬季疾病。
items.ex2_en: The offshore coastal winds strengthened considerably as the dense storm clouds approached.
items.ex2_zh: 随着浓密的乌云逼近，离岸海风明显增强了。

items.def_zh: 使稳定，使稳固；稳住，平静下来；变得稳固
items.def_en: To make or become steady, firm, calm, or balanced.
items.ex_en: She took a deep breath to steady her trembling hands before surgery.
items.ex_zh: 手术前她深吸了一口气，以稳住自己颤抖的双手。
items.ex2_en: His uneven pulse steadied gradually after resting quietly on the comfortable sofa.
items.ex2_zh: 在舒适的沙发上静静休息后，他不规则的脉搏逐渐平稳下来。

items.def_zh: 支撑，加固（摇摇欲坠的结构、经济或体制）
items.def_en: to support or hold up something weak or failing, preventing it from collapsing
items.ex_en: The central bank intervened aggressively to shore up the rapidly depreciating currency.
items.ex_zh: 央行果断出手干预，以支撑持续快速贬值的本国货币。

items.def_en: (+ sth) make something stronger, larger, or more substantial and effective
items.ex_en: Local authorities plan to beef up subway security ahead of the festival.
items.ex_zh: 地方当局计划在节日来临前大力加强地铁的安保力量。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) provide physical support or financial/moral backing to keep something from collapsing
items.ex_en: Emergency government loans helped prop up the struggling regional airline during crisis.
items.ex_zh: 政府发放的紧急贷款在危机期间支撑住了这家举步维艰的区域航空公司。

items.def_en: (+ sth) increase, reinforce, or strengthen something incrementally over time
items.ex_en: Regular physical workouts will gradually build up your stamina and muscular endurance.
items.ex_zh: 规律的体能锻炼会逐步增强你的体力和肌肉耐力。
items.ex2_en: Dense toxic smog built up dangerous levels over the industrial city basin.
items.ex2_zh: 浓重有毒的雾霾在工业城市盆地上空积聚到了危险的程度。

items.def_zh: 加强，巩固，加固；强化（观点、感觉等）；增援
items.def_en: 1. To make a structure or material stronger. 2. To make an idea, feeling, or belief stronger. 3. To send more soldiers, equipment, or staff to strengthen a group.
items.ex_en: Engineers used thick steel girders to reinforce the aging concrete bridge spans.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们使用粗大的钢梁来加固老化的混凝土桥跨结构。

items.def_en: 1. To make a position of power, success, etc. stronger and more secure. 2. To combine several things, especially businesses or debts, into a single, more effective whole.
items.ex_en: The newly elected prime minister moved quickly to consolidate her political authority across parliament.
items.ex_zh: 新当选的首相迅速采取行动，以巩固自己在议会中的政治权威。
items.ex2_en: The newly merged regional offices consolidated smoothly into a single efficient headquarters.
items.ex2_zh: 新合并的区域办事处顺利合并为一个高效的总部。

items.def_zh: 筑防加固；增强（体制、营养或意志）
items.def_en: to strengthen a place against attack, or to make a person, substance, or system stronger and more enduring
items.ex_en: Engineers worked around the clock to fortify the aging levee against catastrophic flooding.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们夜以继日地加固老化的防洪堤，以抵御灾难性的洪水。

items.def_zh: 支撑，支持并加强（士气、信心或论点）
items.def_en: to support or strengthen something that is weak or declining, such as morale, confidence, or an argument
items.ex_en: Recent economic indicators helped bolster investor confidence following months of market volatility.
items.ex_zh: 在经历了数月的市场动荡之后，近期的经济指标有助于提振投资者信心。

items.def_zh: 支撑；强力支持（论据、体系）
items.def_en: to build a buttress for support, or figuratively to lend decisive strength and credibility to a claim or institution
items.ex_en: The defense attorney presented credible forensic evidence to buttress her client's alibi.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师出示了可靠的法医证据，以有力支持其当事人不在犯罪现场的辩解。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to making an existing structure, position, system, or bond more robust, secure, and resilient against pressure or decline. They range from everyday physical or metaphorical reinforcement (strengthen, bolster) to formal structural stabilization and military fortifying (consolidate, shore up, fortify).
groups.summary_zh: 使既有结构、地位或力量更加稳固坚实，抵御削弱或动摇。
groups.desc_en: Involves applying physical bracing, resource expansion, or structural reinforcements to prevent collapse and boost stability, contrasting with initiating or creating something anew.
groups.desc_zh: 通过施加外力支撑、扩充资源或内部结构加固来防止倾颓并强化稳定性，区别于白手起家的建设或初生创制。
groups.nuance_en: shore up: providing urgent external bracing to sagging stability (economy / defenses / balance sheet) · beef up: amplifying strength, quantity, or density significantly (security / presence / staff) · reinforce: adding internal or physical backing to bear load (concrete / bridge / troops) · consolidate: uniting disparate parts into a firmer, cohesive whole (power / gains / holdings)
groups.nuance_zh: shore up: 紧急从外部支垫以防摇摇欲坠 (economy / defenses / balance sheet) · beef up: 大幅充实力量、人员或规模以增强实力 (security / presence / staff) · reinforce: 增设支撑结构或后援力量分担压力 (concrete / bridge / troops) · consolidate: 整合零散部分使权力或基业紧凑稳固 (power / gains / holdings)

groups.name: Strip & Detach · 脱解与剥除 (Doff, Unpin, Debone)
groups.tip: 解开扣件或剥离外层

items.def_zh: 剥下，脱掉（紧身衣物或附着层）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to remove a tight layer of clothing, skin, or covering by pulling it away
items.ex_en: He peeled off his soaked wetsuit as soon as he reached the shore.
items.ex_zh: 他一到达岸边就脱掉了浸透的潜水服。
items.ex2_en: Sunburned dry skin peels off painlessly after several soothing cooling lotion applications.
items.ex2_zh: 涂抹了几次舒缓清凉乳液后，晒伤的干燥皮肤毫无痛感地剥落了。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to remove a piece of clothing or an accessory from one's body
items.ex_en: Please remember to take off your muddy shoes before entering the living room.
items.ex_zh: 进客厅之前请记得脱掉沾满泥巴的鞋子。

items.def_en: [I/T] To open or release a clasp, buckle, or grip
items.ex_en: She gently unclasped the delicate gold necklace and placed it in the velvet box.
items.ex_zh: 她轻轻解开精致的金项链，将其放入天鹅绒盒中。
items.ex2_en: The tarnished brass buckle unclasped easily with a single sharp metallic click.
items.ex2_zh: 生锈的黄铜扣随着一声清脆的金属咔哒声轻易解开了。

items.def_en: [I/T] To undo the buttons of a garment
items.ex_en: He unbuttoned his collar to relieve the suffocating heat of the crowded room.
items.ex_zh: 他解开了衣领，以缓解拥挤房间里的闷热。
items.ex2_en: Her fitted woolen jacket unbuttons smoothly down the front with delicate pulls.
items.ex2_zh: 她合身的羊毛夹克随着轻轻拉动便顺畅地从前面解开了纽扣。

items.def_en: [I/T] To make or become loose, open, or unattached by undoing a fastening
items.ex_en: Passengers were strictly instructed not to unfasten their seat belts until the plane stopped.
items.ex_zh: 乘客被严格指示在飞机完全停稳之前不得解开安全带。
items.ex2_en: The old window latch unfastened suddenly in the fierce nighttime gust of wind.
items.ex2_zh: 旧窗栓在夜间猛烈的阵风中突然松开了。

items.def_en: (dated or formal) To remove or take off an item of clothing, especially a hat as a greeting or sign of respect.
items.ex_en: The gentleman doffed his velvet cap in humble reverence before the sovereign passed.
items.ex_zh: 在那位君主经过之前，绅士谦恭地摘下丝绒帽以示敬意。

items.def_zh: 拔掉……的别针（或大头针）；解开，拔去销子
items.def_en: To unfasten, detach, or free something by removing pins.
items.ex_en: The seamstress carefully unpinned the paper pattern from the fine silk fabric.
items.ex_zh: 女裁缝小心翼翼地把纸样从精美的丝绸面料上拔下大头针取下来。

items.def_zh: 拉开……的门闩，启开；去除障碍
items.def_en: To remove a bar or fastenings from a door, gate, or window; unlock.
items.ex_en: With trembling hands, the old keeper unbarred the heavy wooden gates at dawn.
items.ex_zh: 拂晓时分，老看守颤抖着双手拉开了沉重木门的门闩。

items.def_zh: 脱去（全部或大部分衣物）；剥去
items.def_en: (+ sth) to remove all or most of one's clothes, or peel away an outer covering
items.ex_en: Exhausted after the marathon, he stripped off his sweaty jersey and collapsed.
items.ex_zh: 跑完马拉松筋疲力尽的他脱掉了汗湿的运动衫，瘫倒在地。

items.def_en: To remove the bones from meat, poultry, or fish.
items.ex_en: The chef demonstrated how to debone a whole chicken in under two minutes.
items.ex_zh: 主厨现场演示了如何在两分钟之内将整只鸡剔骨。

items.def_en: To remove the internal organs and entrails of an animal before cooking
items.ex_en: The fisherman showed the young boy how to scale and gut the trout.
items.ex_zh: 渔夫向小男孩展示了如何给鳟鱼刮鳞并掏出内脏。

groups.summary_en: An agent removes a fastener, garment, bone, or barrier from an entity to free it, open it, or prepare it for consumption/use.
groups.summary_zh: 解除扣件、除去衣帽障碍或剔除体内特定部件以使其脱解。
groups.desc_en: Signifies disengaging, unfastening, or stripping away an exterior covering, garment, or binding piece by piece, contrasting with generic attachment or sudden severing.
groups.desc_zh: 指有步骤地解开、褪去或脱除身体附着物、外层衣物或紧固连接件，区别于一般的固定或粗暴切断。
groups.nuance_en: doff: respectfully removing a hat or article of headwear (hat / cap / gloves) · unbutton: undoing button fasteners on a garment (coat / shirt / collar) · unclasp: unfastening a mechanical latch, clasp, or grasp (necklace / bracelet / hands) · peel off: removing a tightly adhering layer or stripping away outer wear (skin / wetsuit / sticker)
groups.nuance_zh: doff: 礼貌地脱下帽子或褪去饰件 (hat / cap / gloves) · unbutton: 解开衣物的纽扣约束 (coat / shirt / collar) · unclasp: 解开搭扣、饰针或松开紧握的双手 (necklace / bracelet / hands) · peel off: 剥除紧贴的附着层或脱掉紧身衣 (skin / wetsuit / sticker)

groups.name: Stumble & Hobble · 蹒跚与跛行 (Totter, Dodder, Hobble)
groups.tip: 步伐不稳、摇晃或跛行的走法

items.def_en: to walk lamely or with a favoring of one leg because of injury or disability
items.ex_en: He had to limp back to the locker room after twisting his ankle.
items.ex_zh: 扭伤脚踝后，他不得不一瘸一拐地走回更衣室。

items.def_zh: 拖着脚慢吞吞地走；蹒跚慢行
items.def_en: to walk with a slow, heavy, shuffling, and awkward motion
items.ex_en: The weary vagrant shambled down the deserted alley, dragging his worn leather boots.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的流浪汉拖着破旧的皮靴，在空旷无人的小巷里蹒跚慢行。

items.def_zh: （如鸭子般）摇摇摆摆地走，蹒跚而行
items.def_en: (+ along/away) To walk with short steps while swaying clumsily from side to side like a duck.
items.ex_en: A flock of plump ducks waddled across the muddy path toward the pond.
items.ex_zh: 一群肥嘟嘟的鸭子摇摇摆摆地穿过泥泞的小径，朝池塘走去。

items.def_en: (+ along/around) To walk or stand unsteadily as if about to fall; to be close to collapsing.
items.ex_en: The exhausted marathon runner began to totter as she approached the finish line.
items.ex_zh: 精疲力竭的马拉松选手在接近终点线时步履开始摇摇晃晃。

items.def_en: (+ along/around) To walk slowly and unsteadily with small trembling steps, especially from old age.
items.ex_en: The frail scholar doddered across the grand library, clutching an ancient leather manuscript.
items.ex_zh: 虚弱的学者紧抱着一本古老的羊皮手稿，颤巍巍地穿过宏伟的图书馆。

items.def_zh: 一瘸一拐地走；艰难前行
items.def_en: to walk slowly and with difficulty because one leg or foot is injured
items.ex_en: Despite a strained hamstring, the determined athlete managed to limp along the track.
items.ex_zh: 尽管腿筋拉伤，这位意志坚定的运动员依然咬牙在跑道上一瘸一拐地前行。

items.def_en: to walk unsteadily and awkwardly, tripping or nearly falling frequently
items.ex_en: Dazed by the blast, the survivor stumbled along the dark, debris-filled corridor.
items.ex_zh: 被爆炸震得晕头转向的幸存者在充满碎石的黑暗走廊里跌跌撞撞地前行。

items.def_zh: 踉踉跄跄地走；摇摇晃晃地前行
items.def_en: to walk in an unsteady, staggering manner, especially due to weakness or age
items.ex_en: The sick old beggar tottered along the cobblestone street under the pouring rain.
items.ex_zh: 患病的老乞丐在大雨倾盆的鹅卵石街道上踉踉跄跄地前行。

items.def_en: to trip or momentarily lose balance while walking, or to walk unsteadily
items.ex_en: She stumbled over a hidden tree root while running through the dense forest.
items.ex_zh: 她在穿越茂密的森林奔跑时被一根暗藏的树根绊了一下。

items.def_en: to walk with a limp or in an awkward, halting way because of injured or sore feet or legs
items.ex_en: With a fractured toe, he could only hobble around his small apartment.
items.ex_zh: 脚趾骨折后，他只能在他那间狭小的公寓里一瘸一拐地走动。

items.def_zh: 跛行，一瘸一拐地走；用镶边带装饰
items.def_en: 1. (informal, offensive) To walk with a limp. 2. To trim or edge with gimp cord.
items.ex_en: Ever since the motorcycle accident, he gimped around with a noticeable hitch.
items.ex_zh: 自从那场摩托车事故后，他走路就明显一瘸一拐的。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe walking with an unsteady, awkward, or labored gait owing to infirmity, injury, old age, or natural body mechanics. They differ by manner: side-to-side duck-like movement, trembling fragility, halting limp, or acute loss of balance.
groups.summary_zh: 因身体虚弱、伤病或体型原因导致的步履不稳、跛行或颤巍行走。
groups.desc_en: Describes labored, unsteady, or structurally impaired human locomotion caused by injury, infirmity, or loss of equilibrium, distinguishing impaired progress from a brisk, functional gait.
groups.desc_zh: 描写因受伤、衰老或失去平衡导致的步态不稳、蹒跚或跛行，区别于平稳流畅的正常行进。
groups.nuance_en: limp: favored-leg gait due to pain or injury (leg / foot / injury) · totter: trembling, top-heavy swaying threatening a fall (baby / drunk / heels) · dodder: feeble, shaky ambulation characteristic of advanced age (old man / veteran / grandfather) · waddle: clumsy, duck-like side-to-side rocking gait (duck / toddler / obese person)
groups.nuance_zh: limp: 因肢体疼痛或偏瘫导致的跛足拖行 (leg / foot / injury) · totter: 头重脚轻、摇摇晃晃濒临摔倒 (baby / drunk / heels) · dodder: 衰老虚弱、颤颤巍巍的碎步缓行 (old man / veteran / grandfather) · waddle: 左右倾侧如鸭行般的蹒跚踱步 (duck / toddler / obese person)

groups.name: Support & Champion · 支持与拥护 (Support, Endorse, Champion)
groups.tip: 从赞同到出资力挺

items.def_zh: 团结在……周围支持，齐心相助
items.def_en: (+ sb) to unite and come together to give help and support to someone in a difficult situation
items.ex_en: The whole neighborhood rallied round the grieving family after the tragic house fire.
items.ex_zh: 那场悲惨的火灾发生后，整个社区都团结起来支持这个悲痛的家庭。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to give loyal support or backing to someone or their decision
items.ex_en: The board of directors pledged to stand behind the chief executive's controversial decision.
items.ex_zh: 董事会承诺坚决支持首席执行官这一颇具争议的决定。

items.def_zh: 支持，拥护，资助；（使）后退，倒退
items.def_en: 1. To give financial, material, or moral support to someone or something. 2. To move backward or cause something to move backward.
items.ex_en: Several prominent venture capitalists agreed to back the ambitious clean-energy startup.
items.ex_zh: 几位知名的风险投资家同意出资支持这家雄心勃勃的清洁能源初创公司。

items.def_en: To formally support or endorse a proposal, motion, or candidate in a meeting or debate.
items.ex_en: The senior councilor rose promptly to second the motion for environmental reform.
items.ex_zh: 这位资深议员随即起身附议环境改革的提案。

items.def_zh: 支持，拥护；支撑；赡养，供养；证实
items.def_en: 1. To encourage, assist, or advocate for someone or something. 2. To hold up the weight of something; to provide financial maintenance for someone.
items.ex_en: The company pledged to support local communities by investing heavily in educational programs.
items.ex_zh: 该公司承诺通过大力投资教育项目来支持当地社区。

items.def_en: (+ with/against) To support or ally oneself with one person or group in an argument or dispute.
items.ex_en: Independent voters chose to side with the moderate candidate in the heated debate.
items.ex_zh: 在这场激烈的辩论中，独立选民选择站在温和派候选人一边。

items.def_en: To help something develop, progress, or be successful; advance.
items.ex_en: She worked diligently to further international cooperation through diplomatic cultural exchanges.
items.ex_zh: 她通过外交文化交流勤奋工作，以促进国际合作。

items.def_en: to declare one's public, official approval or support of someone or something
items.ex_en: The prominent trade union officially voted to endorse the senator's reelection campaign.
items.ex_zh: 该知名工会正式投票支持这位参议员的连任竞选。

items.def_en: to choose to adopt, take up, or support an idea, belief, or cause
items.ex_en: Throughout his academic career, the professor espoused the principles of classical liberalism.
items.ex_zh: 在其整个学术生涯中，这位教授始终信奉古典自由主义的原则。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to defend or support someone or something that is being criticized or attacked
items.ex_en: True friends will always stick up for you when unfair rumors spread.
items.ex_zh: 当不公正的谣言四起时，真正的朋友总会为你挺身而出。

items.def_en: to vigorously fight for, defend, or advocate on behalf of a person or cause
items.ex_en: The young lawyer dedicated her career to champion human rights across developing nations.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻的律师毕生致力于在发展中国家捍卫人权。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote lending approval, practical assistance, or public backing to a person, cause, motion, or proposal, ranging from passive alignment to aggressive advocacy.
groups.summary_zh: 表达对人、动议或事业的赞成、声援、支持与极力拥护。
groups.desc_en: Denotes committing advocacy, political capital, or strategic resources behind an entity, bill, or candidate, contrasting with indifferent neutrality or outright opposition.
groups.desc_zh: 指主动调动政治资源、舆论声势或物资来支持、赞同特定方案或候选人，区别于冷眼旁观的中立或反对。
groups.nuance_en: champion: proactively fighting for and spearheading a cause (rights / reforms / legislation) · endorse: formally approving or ratifying a candidate or brand (candidate / product / proposal) · back: providing crucial material, financial, or moral backing (venture / plan / nominee) · rally round: joining forces collectively to assist someone in a crisis (leader / comrade / cause)
groups.nuance_zh: champion: 充当先锋积极倡导并捍卫某项事业 (rights / reforms / legislation) · endorse: 权威机构或名人正式背书表态认可 (candidate / product / proposal) · back: 提供实质性的财力、资源或声援 (venture / plan / nominee) · rally round: 在危机时刻群起集结以合力支援 (leader / comrade / cause)

groups.name: Suppress & Thwart · 镇压与阻截 (Block, Quell, Crush)
groups.tip: 阻挠行动并强势压制

items.def_en: To prevent movement through something, or to stop an action, process, or opponent from making progress.
items.ex_en: Fallen trees blocked the narrow mountain pass, preventing rescue vehicles from getting through.
items.ex_zh: 倒下的树木阻断了狭窄的山口，导致救援车辆无法通过。

items.def_zh: 使陷入绝境，逼入困境；（把动物等）赶上树
items.def_en: To drive someone into a desperate situation or corner from which they cannot escape; to force an animal up a tree.
items.ex_en: The relentless investigative reporters finally treed the corrupt politician with undeniable evidence.
items.ex_zh: 穷追不舍的调查记者终于用无可辩驳的证据将这个腐败政客逼入了绝境。

items.def_zh: 挫败，阻挠；使沮丧，使懊恼
items.def_en: 1. To prevent someone's plans, efforts, or desires from succeeding. 2. To cause someone to feel annoyed or impatient by hindering progress.
items.ex_en: Bad weather and bureaucratic delays conspired to frustrate their plans for rapid expansion.
items.ex_zh: 恶劣的天气和官僚主义的拖延共同挫败了他们快速扩张的计划。

items.def_en: to prevent something from developing, functioning, or being expressed freely
items.ex_en: Excessive governmental regulations could stifle innovation and harm newly established tech startups.
items.ex_zh: 过度的政府规管可能会扼杀创新，并对新成立的科技初创企业造成损害。

items.def_zh: 强行压制，实行严厉限制
items.def_en: (+ on sb/sth) to take forceful and restrictive action to stop or control illicit activities
items.ex_en: Authorities announced strict new measures to clamp down on unlicensed financial institutions.
items.ex_zh: 当局公布了严厉的新措施，以强行打击无照金融机构。

items.def_en: (+ on sb/sth) to take severe disciplinary or punitive measures against someone or something
items.ex_en: Police vowed to crack down on reckless speeding near all elementary schools.
items.ex_zh: 警方发誓要严厉打击所有小学附近的危险超速驾驶行为。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to eliminate or suppress something unwanted or rebellious completely by force
items.ex_en: The public health agency launched an aggressive campaign to stamp out malaria.
items.ex_zh: 公共卫生机构发起了一场强有力的运动，以彻底根除疟疾。

items.def_zh: 镇压，压垮，击溃；压碎，碾碎
items.def_en: 1. To use force to suppress or defeat a rebellion, opposition, or spirit completely. 2. To press or squeeze something hard so that it breaks or loses shape.
items.ex_en: Government troops mobilized rapidly to crush the armed uprising before dawn broke.
items.ex_zh: 政府军在破晓前迅速动员，以镇压这场武装起义。

items.def_zh: 镇压，平定；抑制，忍住；查禁，隐瞒
items.def_en: 1. To end something, such as a protest or rebellion, by using force or authority. 2. To prevent an emotion, reaction, or information from being expressed or revealed.
items.ex_en: The authoritarian regime deployed riot police to suppress peaceful demonstrations across the capital.
items.ex_zh: 该专制政权出动防暴警察，镇压了首都各地的和平示威活动。

items.def_en: to suppress or extinguish an uprising, expression, or activity completely
items.ex_en: The dictator acted swiftly to smother dissent before widespread protests could erupt.
items.ex_zh: 独裁者迅速采取行动彻底扼制异议，以防爆发大规模抗议活动。

items.def_en: to suppress or extinguish disorder, rebellion, or intense feelings by force
items.ex_en: Military forces were dispatched to quell the escalating riots in the industrial district.
items.ex_zh: 军队被派去平息工业区不断升级的暴乱。

groups.summary_en: An authority or opposing agent forcefully restricts, neutralizes, or suffocates an adversary, uprising, or plan, progressing from spatial blockage and strategic disruption to coercive, violent pacification.
groups.summary_zh: 从空间物理设障到策略挫败，再到强力压制与粉碎。
groups.desc_en: Applies decisive coercive force, regulatory intervention, or physical barriers to curb, extinguish, or frustrate an active development, contrasting with yielding permission or passive tolerance.
groups.desc_zh: 指运用强制手段、严苛监管或外力阻挠来平息、掐灭或打压某种发展态势，区别于放任自流或妥协纵容。
groups.nuance_en: crack down: enforcing harsh, punitive regulatory or police measures (on crime / on dissent / on corruption) · stifle: choking off breath, dissent, or creativity before it spreads (laughter / debate / initiative) · stamp out: entirely obliterating or eradicating an illicit practice (disease / rebellion / fire) · crush: using overwhelming, brutal force to pulverize resistance (protests / rebellion / opposition)
groups.nuance_zh: crack down: 采取严厉的执法或纪律手段严打整治 (on crime / on dissent / on corruption) · stifle: 扼制言论、扼杀创意或窒息笑意于萌芽 (laughter / debate / initiative) · stamp out: 彻底踩灭、扑灭恶疾陋习或反叛火苗 (disease / rebellion / fire) · crush: 凭借压倒性的暴力铁腕粉碎反抗 (protests / rebellion / opposition)

groups.name: Surprise & Astound · 惊奇与震撼 (Surprise, Astonish, Stun)
groups.tip: 从出乎意料到目瞪口呆的吃惊程度

items.def_en: (+ sb) to surprise or startle someone so much that they are momentarily uncertain how to react
items.ex_en: I was taken aback by how bluntly she criticized the proposal.
items.ex_zh: 她对提案批评得如此直白，令我深感震惊。

items.raw_cluster: 使惊奇与震惊 Surprise & Astound
items.def_zh: 使惊奇，使感到意外；突袭
items.def_en: 1. To cause someone to feel wonder, astonished, or caught off guard by an unexpected event. 2. To come upon or attack someone without warning.
items.ex_en: Her unexpected early arrival managed to surprise everyone gathered at the party.
items.ex_zh: 她的意外提前到来让聚会上的每个人都感到惊喜万分。

items.def_en: to surprise someone very greatly with something difficult to believe
items.ex_en: The child prodigy's complex piano performance astonished the seasoned music critics.
items.ex_zh: 这位神童复杂的钢琴演奏让经验丰富的乐评人们大为震惊。

items.def_zh: 使极其震惊；令……佩服得五体投地
items.def_en: (+ sb) to astonish, impress, or shock someone deeply
items.ex_en: Her extraordinary vocal range and stage presence completely blew away the audience.
items.ex_zh: 她非凡的音域和舞台表现力彻底征服了在场的所有观众。

items.def_zh: 使大吃一惊，使震撼得不知所措
items.def_en: (+ sb) to surprise, astonish, or overwhelm someone immensely
items.ex_en: The sheer scale of the unexpected scholarship offer completely bowled her over.
items.ex_zh: 这份意想不到的高额奖学金让她震惊得不知所措。

items.raw_cluster: 使惊奇与震惊 Surprise & Astound
items.def_en: To surprise someone very much, especially by being extraordinarily impressive or unexpected.
items.ex_en: The magician's impossible sleight of hand never failed to amaze the spectators.
items.ex_zh: 魔术师神乎其技的手法总能令在场的观众赞叹不已。

items.def_zh: 使彻底震惊，使目瞪口呆；击倒
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To surprise, shock, or confuse someone so thoroughly that they do not know what to say or do. 2. To knock someone down to the ground.
items.ex_en: The sudden announcement of the CEO's abrupt resignation floored the entire company.
items.ex_zh: 首席执行官突然辞职的声明让整个公司上下目瞪口呆。

items.def_zh: 使震惊，使感到惊愕；使触电
items.def_en: 1. To surprise and upset someone greatly with something unpleasant, offensive, or startling. 2. To give an electric shock to someone.
items.ex_en: The gruesome details revealed during the murder trial deeply shocked the jurors.
items.ex_zh: 谋杀案审理过程中披露的令人毛骨悚然的细节深深震惊了陪审员们。

items.def_zh: 使目瞪口呆，使震惊而发懵
items.def_en: to shock or surprise someone so intensely that they are temporarily unable to think or speak
items.ex_en: The unexpected election results stunned political analysts and pollsters across the country.
items.ex_zh: 出人意料的选举结果让全美的政治分析家和民意测验专家目瞪口呆。

items.def_en: to shock or surprise someone so much that they are unable to react quickly
items.ex_en: The sheer speed of the company's financial collapse astounded industry observers.
items.ex_zh: 这家公司财务崩溃的速度之快让行业观察人士极其震惊。

items.def_zh: 使目瞪口呆，使彻底惊呆
items.def_en: to overwhelm someone with astonishment to the point of complete disbelief
items.ex_en: His bizarre explanation for losing the missing company funds completely flabbergasted us.
items.ex_zh: 对于公司资金失踪一事，他那匪夷所思的解释让我们彻底惊呆了。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe an unexpected event or revelation striking someone mentally, ranging from mild unexpectedness to overwhelming speechlessness or cognitive paralysis.
groups.summary_zh: 描述出乎意料的事物对人造成心理冲击，从轻微意外到震惊失语。
groups.desc_en: Captures cognitive disorientation or astonishment triggered by the sudden arrival of unanticipated or extraordinary occurrences, contrasting with expected, predictable reactions.
groups.desc_zh: 描述因出乎意料或超乎寻常的事件降临而产生的认知空白与强烈惊愕震撼，区别于波澜不惊的心理预期。
groups.nuance_en: astonish: striking with profound, disbelieving wonder (audience / crowd / researchers) · take aback: momentarily disconcerting or catching off guard (critic / host / mother) · floor: rendering speechless through utter shock or revelation (jury / board / fans) · blow away: deeply impressing or overwhelming with sheer brilliance (audience / critics / judges)
groups.nuance_zh: astonish: 令人难以置信地深感诧异与惊奇 (audience / crowd / researchers) · take aback: 猝不及防令人一时语塞或心生错愕 (critic / host / mother) · floor: 巨大的震撼使人目瞪口呆、无言以对 (jury / board / fans) · blow away: 精彩绝伦或震撼至极令人叹服倾倒 (audience / critics / judges)

groups.name: Talk Incessantly or Trivially · 闲聊与唠叨 (Chatter, Babble, Yap)
groups.tip: 嘴碎胡扯东拉西扯，喋喋不休说空话废话

items.def_en: to talk rapidly and continuously about unimportant things
items.ex_en: The excited teenagers continued to chatter endlessly about their favorite pop stars.
items.ex_zh: 兴奋的青少年们继续没完没了地唠叨着他们最喜欢的流行歌星。

items.def_zh: 东拉西扯；漫无边际地聊
items.def_en: (+ on/about) to talk for a long time in a confused and disorganised way
items.ex_en: Nervous speakers often ramble incoherently instead of addressing the central thesis directly.
items.ex_zh: 紧张的演讲者常常会语无伦次地东拉西扯，而不是直接切入核心论点。

items.def_zh: 喋喋不休，胡言乱语；牙牙学语；（溪水等）潺潺作响
items.def_en: 1. To talk quickly, foolishly, or incoherently. 2. To make the quiet continuous murmuring sound of a baby or a stream.
items.ex_en: In his panic, the frightened suspect could only babble incoherent excuses.
items.ex_zh: 惊慌失措之中，惊恐的嫌疑人只能语无伦次地胡乱找借口。

items.def_en: 1. To talk continuously and annoyingly about unimportant things. 2. (of a small dog) To bark in a sharp, high-pitched way.
items.ex_en: Please stop yapping about your minor grievances and get back to work.
items.ex_zh: 别再为你那些鸡毛蒜皮的委屈瞎扯了，赶紧回去工作吧。

items.def_en: To talk for a long time in a silly, rambling, or nonsensical way.
items.ex_en: He blathered on about obscure conspiracy theories until everyone left the room.
items.ex_zh: 他没完没了地胡扯那些晦涩的阴谋论，直到大家都离开了房间。

items.def_en: (+ about/on) to talk at length in a foolish or inconsequential manner
items.ex_en: The young aristocrat prattled foolishly about trivial court gossip throughout the lavish banquet.
items.ex_zh: 在整场奢华的宴会上，年轻的贵族一直在愚蠢地絮叨着微不足道的宫廷八卦。

items.def_zh: 唠唠叨叨，单调乏味地长篇大论
items.def_en: to talk for a long time in a monotonous and boring tone
items.ex_en: The boring lecturer continued to drone on about ancient taxation laws for hours.
items.ex_zh: 那位枯燥的讲师几个小时里一直在单调乏味地长篇大论古代税法。

items.def_zh: 絮絮叨叨，漫无边际地瞎扯
items.def_en: to talk for a long time in an aimless, confusing, or disorganized way
items.ex_en: The professor tended to ramble on about unrelated historical trivia during every lecture.
items.ex_zh: 这位教授每次上课都喜欢漫无边际地瞎扯一些无关紧要的历史琐事。

items.def_en: to talk rapidly, continuously, and casually about unimportant matters
items.ex_en: She continued to rattle on about office politics while everyone tried to work.
items.ex_zh: 当大家都试图专心工作时，她还在喋喋不休地高谈阔论办公室政治。

items.def_en: To talk continuously and trivially, especially for a long time.
items.ex_en: Those guys will yak on their phones for hours without doing any work.
items.ex_zh: 那帮家伙能拿着手机胡扯几个小时，什么活儿都不干。

items.def_zh: 叽里呱啦地说；急促含混地说话
items.def_en: to talk rapidly, excitedly, and unintelligibly
items.ex_en: Nervous tourists began to jabber excitedly when the unexpected storm rocked the boat.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的暴风雨摇晃船身时，紧张的游客们开始激动地叽里呱啦乱叫。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict speakers talking rapidly, incessantly, and casually about trivial or nonsensical matters, often annoying listeners.
groups.summary_zh: 喋喋不休、琐碎无聊地闲扯或唠叨，常含厌烦色彩。
groups.desc_en: Portrays trivial, prolonged, or disorganized verbal output characterized by superficiality or lack of substance, contrasting with succinct, meaningful communicative discourse.
groups.desc_zh: 描写漫无边际、浅薄琐碎或喋喋不休的话语输出，缺乏实质内容与逻辑节制，区别于言简意赅的有效对话。
groups.nuance_en: prattle: childish, naive, and frivolous ceaseless chatter (nonsense / gossip / hours) · blather: nonsensical, foolish, and irritating volubility (on and on / politics / trivia) · drone on: speaking endlessly in a monotonous, sleep-inducing tone (lecturer / speaker / voice) · ramble: wandering aimlessly across topics without coherent focus (speech / speaker / interview)
groups.nuance_zh: prattle: 孩子气或轻佻琐碎地絮叨不休 (nonsense / gossip / hours) · blather: 颠三倒四、废话连篇地胡扯 (on and on / politics / trivia) · drone on: 单调平缓、令人昏昏欲睡地长篇大论 (lecturer / speaker / voice) · ramble: 漫无边际地离题发散、语无伦次 (speech / speaker / interview)

groups.name: Thwack & Whomp · 钝击与重打 (Thwack, Whomp, Drub)
groups.tip: 模拟不同声响与力道的拍击殴打

items.def_zh: 敲打，碰击，轻击（尤指打在头上）；（英，俚）与……发生性关系
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To hit or bump against something, especially on the head. 2. (British informal) To have sexual intercourse with someone. 3. (endurance sports) To suffer sudden extreme exhaustion.
items.ex_en: He accidentally bonked his forehead against the low basement beam while carrying boxes.
items.ex_zh: 他搬箱子时，额头不小心重重碰在地下室低矮的大梁上。

items.def_en: to hit somebody or something violently with a sharp, noisy, cracking blow
items.ex_en: The coach whacked the dusty dugout bench with his heavy wooden baseball bat.
items.ex_zh: 教练用他那根沉重的木质棒球棒，啪地一声猛击满是灰尘的球员休息椅。

items.def_en: to hit someone or something heavily with a fist or heavy object, making a dull sound
items.ex_en: The angry driver thumped his steering wheel repeatedly as the traffic ground completely.
items.ex_zh: 交通彻底瘫痪时，愤怒的司机砰砰地连连捶打方向盘。

items.def_zh: （用扁平物）砰然敲击，使劲拍打，重打
items.def_en: To hit someone or something hard with a flat object, making a loud, sharp slapping sound.
items.ex_en: She thwacked the kitchen counter with a rolled magazine to squash the giant bug.
items.ex_zh: 她用卷成筒的杂志使劲拍打厨房台面，拍死那只大虫子。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to strike someone repeatedly and violently, inflicting physical injury
items.ex_en: Don't beat yourself up over an honest mistake.
items.ex_zh: 不要因为一次无心之失而过度自责。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to attack someone forcefully with heavy blows
items.ex_en: The bouncer suddenly laid into the disorderly patron with a series of punches.
items.ex_zh: 保镖突然对那名闹事的顾客大打出手，挥拳痛殴。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to strike someone repeatedly with hard, violent blows
items.ex_en: Two rowdy guys started to wail on each other outside the crowded bar.
items.ex_zh: 两个闹事的家伙在拥挤的酒吧外开始对彼此连番暴揍。

items.def_en: to hit someone or something with tremendous, uncoordinated blunt force
items.ex_en: The prizefighter walloped his staggering opponent across the jaw, ending the bloody bout.
items.ex_zh: 职业拳手狠狠猛揍摇晃对手的下巴，结束了这场血腥的比赛。

items.def_en: (informal) to strike someone or something very hard, inflicting severe damage
items.ex_en: A falling branch clobbered him on the shoulder during the fierce midnight storm.
items.ex_zh: 午夜猛烈的暴风雨中，一根掉落的树枝狠狠痛击在他的肩膀上。

items.def_zh: （用棍棒）痛打，殴打；彻底击溃，重创
items.def_en: 1. To beat or thrash someone thoroughly, especially with a stick. 2. (informal) To defeat an opponent heavily in a game, contest, or fight.
items.ex_en: The highway bandits drubbed the merchant mercilessly with heavy clubs before stealing everything.
items.ex_zh: 路匪在洗劫一空之前，用粗重木棒将那名商人狠狠痛打了一顿。

items.def_en: 1. (informal) To hit someone or something heavily with a loud thud. 2. (informal) To defeat an opponent decisively.
items.ex_en: He whomped the malfunctioning television with the flat of his hand until it worked.
items.ex_zh: 他用巴掌猛砸那台失灵的电视机，直到它恢复正常。

groups.summary_en: An agent forcefully strikes a surface or opponent with a flat or heavy blunt implement, producing a distinctive dull or loud smacking sound and causing substantial impact.
groups.summary_zh: 用钝器、手掌或重物沉重击打或拍打，发出钝响并造成强力冲击。
groups.desc_en: Inflicting blunt, heavy, or resounding physical strikes on a target, distinguished from sharp cutting or delicate tapping by auditory resonance and crushing force.
groups.desc_zh: 对目标施加沉重、钝性或回响剧烈的物理打击，与锋利的刺割或轻微的轻叩相比，强调钝器撞击声感与沉重破坏力。
groups.nuance_en: whack: sharp, forceful blow with a flat or blunt object (ball / weeds / head) · thump: heavy, dull-sounding impact (table / back / chest) · thwack: sharp, resonant slap or strike with a flexible or flat implement (stick / paddle / thigh) · wallop: mighty, crushing blow delivered with sweeping force (opponent / ball / rival) · lay into: aggressive, sustained physical or verbal assault (critic / attacker / subordinate)
