groups.nuance_zh: whack: 挥动钝物或扁平物快速重击 (ball / weeds / head) · thump: 发出沉闷钝响的重击或拳捶 (table / back / chest) · thwack: 扁平或有弹性器具抽击发出清脆破空钝响 (stick / paddle / thigh) · wallop: 挟带巨大势能的猛烈痛击或狠揍 (opponent / ball / rival) · lay into: 劈头盖脸地痛打或痛骂 (critic / attacker / subordinate)

groups.name: Tolerate & Endure · 容忍与忍受 (Tolerate, Endure, Brook)
groups.tip: 克制不满，默默承受逆境痛苦

items.def_zh: 忍受，经受（常与 can/cannot 连用）
items.def_en: (informal, usually negative) to endure or tolerate someone or something frustrating or disagreeable
items.ex_en: I honestly cannot stand his passive-aggressive comments in our daily morning meetings.
items.ex_zh: 我实在是无法忍受他在每日早会上的阴阳怪气。

items.def_zh: 承受，担负（痛苦、悲伤或压力）
items.def_en: to accept, tolerate, or endure heavy pain, misfortune, or emotional strain
items.ex_en: She had to bear the crushing grief of losing her ancestral family home.
items.ex_zh: 她不得不承受失去祖传家园的沉重悲痛。

items.def_en: 1. (usually in negative) To accept, tolerate, or bear something unpleasant. 2. (usually in negative) To eat or digest something without feeling sick.
items.ex_en: He could not stomach their sheer hypocrisy throughout the entire bitter contract negotiation.
items.ex_zh: 在整场艰难的合同谈判中，他实在无法容忍他们那赤裸裸的虚伪。

items.def_zh: 忍耐，忍受（令人厌烦之人或事）
items.def_en: (informal) to tolerate or accept an unpleasant person or situation without complaining
items.ex_en: I can't put up with his constant complaining any longer.
items.ex_zh: 我再也无法容忍他没完没了的抱怨了。

items.def_zh: 忍住，经受住（苦难或悲痛）
items.def_en: to remain brave, resolute, or capable of enduring great hardship or grief
items.ex_en: She is bearing up remarkably well under the enormous pressure of the public inquiry.
items.ex_zh: 在公开调查的巨大压力之下，她展现出了极强的承受力。

items.def_zh: 硬着头皮熬过，咬牙忍受
items.def_en: (+ sth) to endure an extremely difficult or unpleasant experience with fortitude
items.ex_en: The stranded hikers decided to tough out the freezing night inside their cave.
items.ex_zh: 滞留的徒步者决定咬牙在洞穴里熬过这个严寒的夜晚。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to endure a painful or difficult situation until the end
items.ex_en: Despite the grueling hours, she chose to stick out the miserable corporate internship.
items.ex_zh: 尽管工时折磨人，她还是选择硬着头皮坚持熬完这份痛苦的公司实习。

items.def_zh: 容忍，忍受，容许（通常用于否定句）
items.def_en: (formal, usually in negative) To tolerate or allow something, especially dissent, interference, or delay.
items.ex_en: The strict commander would brook no interference with his established tactical deployment plans.
items.ex_zh: 这位严厉的指挥官决不容许任何人干涉他既定的战术部署计划。

items.def_zh: 忍受，忍耐，经受；持久，持续
items.def_en: 1. To suffer or undergo pain, hardship, or difficulty patiently. 2. To continue to exist or last for a long time.
items.ex_en: Frontline healthcare workers had to endure extreme physical exhaustion throughout the prolonged crisis.
items.ex_zh: 在持久的危机中，一线医护人员不得不忍受极度的身体透支。

items.def_zh: 容忍，忍受；容许，放任；耐受（药物、恶劣环境等）
items.def_en: 1. To allow or accept behavior, beliefs, or conditions that one dislikes without protesting. 2. To bear or endure pain, hardship, or an unpleasant situation. 3. (biology/medicine) To be able to withstand a substance or condition without adverse effects.
items.ex_en: The head librarian refused to tolerate disruptive phone calls inside the study hall.
items.ex_zh: 图书馆馆长拒绝容忍自习室内破坏秩序的电话声。

items.def_zh: 容忍，受得住（常用于否定句或疑问句）
items.def_en: (mostly in negative/questions with 'can/could') to tolerate or accept someone or something unpleasant
items.ex_en: The proud monarch could not abide even the slightest hint of cowardly treason.
items.ex_zh: 骄傲的君王容不得哪怕一丝一毫懦弱背叛的迹象。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict bearing, accepting, or enduring unpleasant behaviors, physical hardship, pain, or objectionable demands without outward rebellion or rejection. They range from everyday passive allowance (tolerate, put up with) to gut-level acceptance (stomach) and austere refusal to permit opposition (brook, usually negative).
groups.summary_zh: 在面对逆境、冒犯或不快时加以容受与忍耐，不予反抗或制止。
groups.desc_en: Withstanding distressing, painful, or adverse conditions without yielding, differing from passive reception by requiring conscious fortitude or restrictive permission.
groups.desc_zh: 在痛苦、艰难或冒犯的逆境中坚持承受而不退让崩溃，不同于被动接纳，它强调主观毅力抵御或权威层面的容忍许可。
groups.nuance_en: stand: experiential capacity to endure distress without emotional collapse (pain / nonsense / sight) · bear: carrying heavy psychological or physical burdens over time (weight / grief / responsibility) · stomach: visceral tolerance of revolting or offensive reality (injustice / violence / thought) · brook: formal refusal to tolerate infringement, almost exclusively negative (interference / dissent / delay) · tough out: gritty persistence through an arduous ordeal (storm / recession / injury)
groups.nuance_zh: stand: 心理或生理抗压承受能力 (pain / nonsense / sight) · bear: 长期肩负沉重身心负担 (weight / grief / responsibility) · stomach: 在心理反感下勉强咽下或容忍恶劣事实 (injustice / violence / thought) · brook: 容许、容纳相悖意见或干涉（几全用于否定句） (interference / dissent / delay) · tough out: 咬牙硬抗熬过苦难考验 (storm / recession / injury)

groups.name: Torment & Persecute · 折磨与迫害 (Harass, Afflict, Martyr)
groups.tip: 身心遭受严刑拷打与摧残

items.def_en: to trouble, worry, or annoy someone repeatedly with intrusive demands or unpleasantness
items.ex_en: Aggressive debt collectors continued to harass the struggling family with frequent late-night phone calls.
items.ex_zh: 激进的讨债人频繁在深夜打电话，不断骚扰这个陷入困境的家庭。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to single someone out for unfair, cruel, or harassing treatment
items.ex_en: Why do the older kids always pick on him during recess?
items.ex_zh: 为什么大孩子们课间总爱找他茬、欺负他？

items.def_en: (+ sb) to direct intense criticism, harassment, or hostility exclusively at someone
items.ex_en: Trolls on social media quickly zeroed in on the rookie politician after her slip.
items.ex_zh: 社交媒体上的喷子在那位新手政客口误后，迅速锁定她进行集中抨击。

items.def_en: to cause serious physical or mental pain and suffering to someone
items.ex_en: Severe droughts continually afflict the farming communities living across the arid southern valley.
items.ex_zh: 严重的干旱持续折磨着生活在干旱南部山谷的农业社区。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to unite as a group to harass, attack, or bully a single target
items.ex_en: Older neighborhood kids used to gang up on the quiet boy after school.
items.ex_zh: 街区里年纪稍大的孩子们过去常在放学后结伙围攻那个安静的男孩。

items.def_en: 1. To cause someone or something continual distress, trouble, or suffering over a long period. 2. To annoy or bother someone persistently.
items.ex_en: Chronic knee injuries continued to plague the star athlete throughout his senior season.
items.ex_zh: 慢性膝伤在明星运动员的高年级赛季中持续折磨着他。

items.def_en: to deliberately cause persistent severe physical or mental suffering to someone
items.ex_en: Guilt and haunting memories continued to torment the exiled general every waking hour.
items.ex_zh: 愧疚与难忘的记忆在每一个清醒的时刻都极度折磨着这位流亡将军。

items.def_en: 1. To treat someone cruelly and unfairly over a long period, especially because of their race, religion, or political beliefs. 2. To harass or torment someone persistently.
items.ex_en: Corrupt state authorities ruthlessly persecuted religious minorities throughout the dark turbulent decade.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的国家当局在那动荡黑暗的十年里残酷迫害宗教少数群体。

items.def_en: to cause continuous trouble, worry, or distress to someone or something.
items.ex_en: Unexpected bureaucratic delays continue to bedevil the historic palace restoration project for years.
items.ex_zh: 意料之外的官僚延误多年来持续困扰着这座历史宫殿的修复项目。

items.def_zh: 拷打，折磨，使剧烈痛苦；曲解
items.def_en: 1. to deliberately inflict severe pain on someone as a punishment or to force them to reveal information. 2. to cause someone extreme mental or physical suffering.
items.ex_en: Enemy interrogators prepared to torture the captured rebel spy for sensitive operational codes.
items.ex_zh: 敌方审讯人员准备严刑拷打被俘的叛军间谍以获取机密作战密码。

items.def_zh: 残酷对待，残暴折磨；使残忍，使麻木不仁
items.def_en: 1. to treat someone with extreme cruelty and violence. 2. to make someone violent, cruel, or callous.
items.ex_en: The ruthless warlord continued to brutalize innocent civilian villages without showing any mercy.
items.ex_zh: 冷酷的军阀毫无怜悯地继续残酷对待并折磨无辜的平民村庄。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote subjecting a victim to sustained physical agony, targeted systematic oppression, or severe psychological harassment, scaling up to extreme, agonizing cruelty.
groups.summary_zh: 持续给受害者施加精神重压、系统性政治宗教迫害或残暴肉体酷刑折磨。
groups.desc_en: Inflicting persistent, distressing, and systematic suffering upon another, contrasting with incidental harm by its deliberate malice, focus, or protracted duration.
groups.desc_zh: 对受害者施加持续、折磨性且系统性的痛苦，与偶然伤害不同，它强调蓄意恶意、针对性纠缠或长时间的折磨。
groups.nuance_en: harass: persistent, vexatious badgering or intimidation (workers / tenants / protestors) · persecute: systematic, state- or group-level oppression based on identity or belief (minorities / dissidents / christians) · torment: inflicting severe, agonizing mental or bodily anguish (prisoner / soul / captive) · afflict: burdening impersonally with disease, calamity, or distress (nation / patient / community) · gang up on: collective, predatory bullying of a vulnerable target (peer / rival / victim)
groups.nuance_zh: harass: 频繁骚扰、纠缠或恐吓他人 (workers / tenants / protestors) · persecute: 因信仰、身份等发起的系统性迫害或镇压 (minorities / dissidents / christians) · torment: 使身心经受惨烈折磨与煎熬 (prisoner / soul / captive) · afflict: 疾病、灾祸等无情折磨或笼罩 (nation / patient / community) · gang up on: 结伙针对并孤立欺凌弱者 (peer / rival / victim)

groups.name: Transport & Convey · 运送与传送 (Transport, Convey, Teleport)
groups.tip: 通过载具或人力转移物体

items.def_zh: 往返穿梭运送；往返穿梭
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to transport or travel frequently between two specific destinations
items.ex_en: A private minibus shuttled passengers back and forth between the remote terminal stations.
items.ex_zh: 一辆私人小型巴士在偏远的航站楼站点之间往返穿梭运送乘客。
items.ex2_en: The dedicated courier shuttled back and forth between the two regional government offices.
items.ex2_zh: 专职信使在两个地区政府办公室之间频繁穿梭往返。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to transport someone or something instantaneously via an energy beam
items.ex_en: The starship captain ordered the chief engineer to beam up the landing party.
items.ex_zh: 星舰舰长命令总工程师立刻将着陆小队光波传送回船。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to convey people or cargo across a body of water or gap
items.ex_en: Local boatmen volunteered to ferry across stranded villagers during the sudden flash flood.
items.ex_zh: 突发山洪期间，当地船夫自愿摆渡运送受困村民过河。

items.def_zh: 渡运；来回穿梭运送（人或车）
items.def_en: to carry or transport people or goods on regular short journeys across water or space
items.ex_en: Helicopters will ferry essential medical supplies directly to the isolated mountain rescue base.
items.ex_zh: 直升机将往返穿梭，直接向孤立的高山救援基地运送必需的医疗物资。

items.def_en: to transport or carry goods or passengers from one place to another along a route
items.ex_en: Specially designed pipelines convey crude oil safely across hundreds of miles of wilderness.
items.ex_zh: 专门设计的管道安全地将原油沿线输送穿过数百英里的荒野。

items.def_en: to travel or transport someone back and forth frequently between two set locations
items.ex_en: Electric vans shuttle airport personnel directly between the parking lots and departure gates.
items.ex_zh: 电动货车在停车场和登机口之间频繁穿梭运送机场工作人员。
items.ex2_en: Busy corporate executives shuttle constantly between New York and London for monthly meetings.
items.ex2_zh: 忙碌的企业高管为了每月例会频繁往返于纽约和伦敦之间。

items.def_en: (historical or literary) To convey or carry someone or something in a chariot.
items.ex_en: Golden steeds charioted the proud sun god across the radiant morning celestial sky.
items.ex_zh: 金色骏马驾驭战车，载着骄傲的太阳神穿过灿烂的晨曦天宇。

items.def_zh: 开车运送，为……当司机；开车
items.def_en: To drive someone in a car, especially as a hired driver or as a favor.
items.ex_en: The generous neighbor volunteered to chauffeur elderly residents to their weekly clinic appointments.
items.ex_zh: 热心的邻居自愿开车运送老年住户前往诊所进行每周的就诊。

items.def_en: (science fiction) To transport a person or object instantaneously across space without physical travel.
items.ex_en: The alien device could instantly teleport heavy cargo across thousands of light-years.
items.ex_zh: 这台外星设备能够跨越数千光年瞬间传送重型货物。
items.ex2_en: The daring astronaut teleported instantly across the galaxy through the glowing portal.
items.ex2_zh: 勇敢的宇航员通过发光的传送门瞬间跨越银河系完成瞬移。

items.def_zh: 派遣，运送，发送；迅速处理
items.def_en: (chiefly UK) To send someone or something somewhere quickly for a particular purpose; to deal with or finish a task rapidly.
items.ex_en: Headquarters decided to despatch specialized disaster response teams directly to the quake zone.
items.ex_zh: 总部决定迅速派遣专业救灾应急小组直奔地震灾区。

items.def_zh: 空运（尤指在紧急或险要地带）
items.def_en: to transport people, medical supplies, or provisions by aircraft in an emergency
items.ex_en: Military helicopters rushed to airlift injured mountaineers down to the regional base hospital.
items.ex_zh: 军用直升机紧急赶来，将受伤的登山者空运送往区域基地医院。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote moving passengers, goods, or messages from one destination to another across physical or conceptual space using specific transport roles, logistical channels, or instantaneous sci-fi transfer.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过专职载具、护送角色、物流派发或即时传送机制运送人员或货物。
groups.desc_en: Moving persons or payloads between points via dedicated mechanical or specialized transit protocols, distinct from manual carrying by reliance on logistical shuttling.
groups.desc_zh: 通过专门的机动载具或特殊中继协议在两点间定线转运人员或载荷，区别于单兵搬运，强调短途穿梭或摆渡运作。
groups.nuance_en: shuttle: repetitive transit back and forth over a fixed route (passengers / commuters / diplomats) · ferry: moving across a natural barrier like water or air (vehicles / supplies / stranded travelers) · convey: general transit or mechanical movement through conduits (goods / luggage / water) · beam up: instantaneous dematerialized teleportation (crew / specimen / target) · chauffeur: driving someone attentively in a private luxury conveyance (vip / dignitary / executive)
groups.nuance_zh: shuttle: 定线定点频繁往返穿梭接送 (passengers / commuters / diplomats) · ferry: 跨越水体或空隙提供摆渡转运 (vehicles / supplies / stranded travelers) · convey: 管道、传送带或交通工具的一般性运送输送 (goods / luggage / water) · beam up: 科幻式的能量光束分解传送 (crew / specimen / target) · chauffeur: 专职驱使豪华座驾侍候接送 (vip / dignitary / executive)

groups.name: Transport & Convey · 运送与转运 (Ship, Ferry, Airlift)
groups.tip: 通过交通工具转移

items.def_zh: （用船、飞机、卡车等）运送，运输；装运；上市，交付
items.def_en: to send or transport goods by ship, plane, train, or truck
items.ex_en: The global manufacturer will ship ten thousand new consoles to retail stores tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 这家全球制造商明天将向各大零售店发货装运一万台新主机。

items.def_zh: 运出，装运发货；（人员）乘船/飞机出发
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to send goods or transport personnel away by sea, air, or freight
items.ex_en: The deployed combat brigade will ship out for overseas duties early next morning.
items.ex_zh: 这支部署的作战旅将于明早乘船出发前往海外执行任务。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to bring supplies, cargo, or personnel into a place by aircraft
items.ex_en: International relief organizations managed to fly in essential water purifiers to the capital.
items.ex_zh: 国际救援组织设法通过飞机将急需的净水设备空运送入首都。
items.ex2_en: Medical specialists flew in from abroad to assist with the complex operation.
items.ex2_zh: 医学专家从国外乘飞机赶来协助进行这项复杂的手术。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to convey or haul goods or prisoners away, especially roughly or abruptly
items.ex_en: Armed federal agents arrived unexpectedly to cart off the confiscated financial corporate documents.
items.ex_zh: 全副武装的联邦特工突然赶到，用车载走了查封的企业财务文件。

items.def_en: to pull or transport large quantities of materials or cargo over long distances
items.ex_en: Giant freight diesel trucks haul tons of industrial steel across the mountainous interstate.
items.ex_zh: 巨型柴油货车在穿山州际公路上长途拉运数吨工业钢材。

items.def_en: (nautical) to transport cargo using a lighter (flat-bottomed barge)
items.ex_en: Harbor dockers worked through dawn to lighter crates from the anchored merchant vessel.
items.ex_zh: 港口码头工人们忙碌至天明，用平底驳船从锚泊商船上过驳装运货箱。

items.def_zh: （乘船或机动车）运送，摆渡；往返运送
items.def_en: To transport people, vehicles, or goods regularly by boat or other vehicle, especially across a short distance.
items.ex_en: A small wooden barge ferries local commuter vehicles across the wide estuary daily.
items.ex_zh: 一艘小型木制驳船每天运送当地通勤车辆往返渡过宽阔的河口。

items.def_en: to transport heavy or cumbersome items in a cart or vehicle, often with effort
items.ex_en: Workers spent the morning carting heavy bags of wet cement up the steep hill.
items.ex_zh: 工人们花了一上午时间，费力用车将沉重的湿水泥袋运上陡坡。

items.def_en: to transport bulk commercial goods by water, air, train, or truck
items.ex_en: Logistics companies freight bulk agricultural commodities across the continent by regional railway networks.
items.ex_zh: 物流公司通过区域铁路网络将大宗农产品进行大规模陆路货运。

items.def_zh: （尤指在紧急情况下）空运，飞机疏散
items.def_en: To transport people or supplies by aircraft, especially in an emergency or during a conflict.
items.ex_en: The air force scrambled transport planes to airlift stranded refugees from the floodzone.
items.ex_zh: 空军紧急调动运输机，将受困难民从洪水泛滥区空运疏散出来。

items.def_en: To transport commercial cargo or goods by aircraft.
items.ex_en: Exporters airfreight delicate fresh flowers directly to European wholesale markets overnight for freshness.
items.ex_zh: 出口商连夜将娇嫩的鲜花直接空运至欧洲批发市场以保证新鲜。

groups.summary_en: Freight, passengers, or emergency supplies are conveyed between locations via specialized modes of transport such as watercraft, aircraft, or intermediate feeder vessels. Verbs vary by the vehicle, navigational medium, and operational urgency.
groups.summary_zh: 运用舟楫、航空器等特定载具进行货物与人员转运。
groups.desc_en: Dispatching and hauling heavy or bulk commodities over logistical distances, contrasting with personal conveyance by its industrial, freight-oriented scale.
groups.desc_zh: 依托物流网络远距离转运大宗货物或重载物资，与私人乘载不同，聚焦于货运、重型拖拉与外运调配。
groups.nuance_en: ship: commercial dispatch via freight networks over land or sea (cargo / merchandise / orders) · haul: pulling heavy loads over distance with notable mechanical effort (timber / freight / gravel) · cart: transporting informally or unceremoniously in simple conveyances (debris / groceries / luggage) · cart off: forcible or abrupt removal from a scene (protesters / suspect / wreckage) · fly in: rapid aerial introduction of needed personnel or materials (experts / aid / reinforcements)
groups.nuance_zh: ship: 商业物流网络统筹海陆空托运外发 (cargo / merchandise / orders) · haul: 拖运、卡车拉运大宗笨重物资 (timber / freight / gravel) · cart: 用简易板车或小车随手装运 (debris / groceries / luggage) · cart off: 强制收缴拖走或粗暴带离现场 (protesters / suspect / wreckage) · fly in: 紧急空运调派紧缺人员或物资入场 (experts / aid / reinforcements)

groups.name: Trivial & Foolish Prattle · 琐碎与愚蠢的唠叨 (Prattle, Prate, Blabber)
groups.tip: 语速飞快且口齿不清地嘟囔唠叨

items.def_zh: 含糊不清地碎碎念，絮叨个不停
items.def_en: to speak rapidly, continuously, and incoherently or foolishly
items.ex_en: The frightened hostage began to babble on hysterically after the long tense ordeal.
items.ex_zh: 在漫长紧张的折磨过后，受惊的人质开始歇斯底里地含混碎碎念。

items.def_zh: 童言无忌地唠叨；天真琐碎地扯个没完
items.def_en: to talk at length in a foolish, trivial, or childish way
items.ex_en: She would prattle on about childhood memories whenever old photo albums were opened.
items.ex_zh: 每当翻开旧相册，她总会天真琐碎地扯个没完那些童年往事。

items.def_en: to talk rapidly, foolishly, or incoherently, uttering meaningless syllables
items.ex_en: The toddler began to babble happily while playing with colorful blocks during playtime.
items.ex_zh: 幼儿在玩耍时间一边摆弄彩色积木，一边开心地咿呀学语。

items.def_zh: 闲聊，喋喋不休，瞎扯（像小孩般没完没了地说琐事）
items.def_en: To talk foolishly and continuously for a long time about unimportant things.
items.ex_en: Idle courtiers would prattle about minor royal scandals instead of addressing national governance.
items.ex_zh: 无所事事的朝臣们只顾喋喋不休地闲聊王室微末丑闻，而不关心国家治理。

items.def_en: (Scottish / Northern English) To gossip, chat idly, or talk foolishly.
items.ex_en: Old villagers loved to claver by the tavern hearth over pints of ale.
items.ex_zh: 老村民们喜欢聚在酒馆壁炉旁喝着麦芽酒，闲聊八卦扯闲篇。

items.def_zh: 喋喋不休地胡扯，信口开河
items.def_en: to talk foolishly, incoherently, or indiscreetly for an extended period
items.ex_en: After two drinks, he would blabber on carelessly about confidential office projects.
items.ex_zh: 两杯酒下肚后，他就会信口开河、喋喋不休地扯起办公室的保密项目。

items.def_en: to talk foolishly, senselessly, or childishly
items.ex_en: Don't pay attention when conspiracy theorists drivel about microchips inside the tap water.
items.ex_zh: 当阴谋论者满嘴胡扯自来水里含有微芯片时，别理他们。

items.def_en: to talk long-windedly without making much sense
items.ex_en: The panelist began to blather endlessly instead of offering a direct substantive answer.
items.ex_zh: 那名专家嘉宾开始没完没了地夸夸其谈，而没有给出直接实质性的回答。

items.def_zh: 急促而含糊地说话，喋喋不休；叽里呱啦地说
items.def_en: To talk very rapidly, excitedly, and indistinctly so that it is difficult to understand.
items.ex_en: Panicked passengers started to jabber unintelligibly when the cabin lights suddenly went out.
items.ex_zh: 客舱灯光骤然熄灭时，恐慌的乘客们开始急促而含糊地哇哇乱叫。

items.def_zh: 喋喋不休，信口开河；走漏风声
items.def_en: (informal) To talk foolishly or excessively without stopping, often letting out secrets.
items.ex_en: Be careful around Jake because he will blabber sensitive details to anyone listening.
items.ex_zh: 在杰克身边小心点，因为他嘴上没把门，会向任何人泄露敏感细节。

items.def_zh: 唠叨，空谈，高谈阔论，瞎扯
items.def_en: (dated / disapproving) To talk foolishly and at great length about trivial matters.
items.ex_en: The pompous guest began to prate endlessly about his trivial social triumphs.
items.ex_zh: 那位自命不凡的客人开始滔滔不绝地吹嘘起自己那些微不足道的社交成就。

groups.summary_en: Verbs highlighting the inconsequential, silly, childish, or indiscreet nature of continuous and senseless vocal chatter.
groups.summary_zh: 无节制、空洞可笑、幼稚或泄露秘密的愚蠢喋喋不休。
groups.desc_en: Emitting continuous, inconsequential, or nonsensical vocal output, differing from purposeful discourse by lacking depth, coherence, or restraint.
groups.desc_zh: 持续发出无休止、琐碎或语无伦次的废话闲扯，与严肃交谈相比，缺乏逻辑深度、实质信息或克制力。
groups.nuance_en: prattle: childish, harmless, and incessantly light chatter (toddler / enthusiast / guests) · babble: incoherent, rapid, or indistinct vocalization (infant / stream / lunatic) · blather: tedious, foolish, and long-winded rambling (politician / blowhard / pundit) · drivel: utterly idiotic, nonsensical, or contemptible talk (critic / crank / bore) · claver: gossipy, idle, and noisy neighborhood nattering (neighbors / villagers / old friends)
groups.nuance_zh: prattle: 孩子气、漫无边际且轻浮琐碎的喋喋不休 (toddler / enthusiast / guests) · babble: 语无伦次、含糊不清的胡说或胡话 (infant / stream / lunatic) · blather: 空洞冗长、惹人生厌的胡诌闲扯 (politician / blowhard / pundit) · drivel: 极度愚蠢无稽、毫无营养的废话滥调 (critic / crank / bore) · claver: 乡邻间的市井八卦闲谈唠嗑 (neighbors / villagers / old friends)

groups.name: Unite & Ally · 结盟与联合 (Band together, Confederate, Ally)
groups.tip: 各方聚结形成同盟

items.def_zh: 联合，集合（常与 together 连用）；用棍棒击打
items.def_en: (also 'club together') To join together with other people to do or pay for something.
items.ex_en: The neighbors decided to club together and buy a shared lawn mower.
items.ex_zh: 邻居们决定凑钱合买一台公用的割草机。

items.def_en: To join together in an alliance or league with someone or another group.
items.ex_en: Several northern principalities chose to league together against the expanding imperial army.
items.ex_zh: 北方的几个公国选择结成联盟，共同对抗不断扩张的帝国军队。

items.def_zh: 联合，团结（常与 together 连用）；给……绑上带子（或环）
items.def_en: (also 'band together') To unite or form a group in order to achieve a common purpose.
items.ex_en: Local merchants decided to band together to resist the predatory corporate buyout.
items.ex_zh: 当地商户决定联合起来，抵制大企业掠夺性的收购。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ with) To combine resources or enter into a formal mutual-defense or supportive pact
items.ex_en: The smaller republic sought to ally with its neighbor for mutual security.
items.ex_zh: 该小共和国寻求与邻国结盟，以确保共同安全。
items.ex2_en: The charismatic diplomat successfully allied several rival factions under one common banner.
items.ex2_zh: 这位有魅力的外交官成功将几个敌对派系联合在同一面旗帜下。

items.def_en: (+ with) To join together with someone to perform a specific task
items.ex_en: The two rival tech companies decided to team up to develop the open-source platform.
items.ex_zh: 这两家相互竞争的科技公司决定联手合作，共同开发该开源平台。

items.def_en: To unite as a group in order to resist an adversary or achieve a shared aim
items.ex_en: Discontented workers banded together to demand fair wages from the management.
items.ex_zh: 不满的工人们团结起来，要求管理层给予合理的工资待遇。

items.def_en: to combine efforts or resources with someone else to achieve a common goal
items.ex_en: Both charities decided to join forces to launch a nationwide relief campaign.
items.ex_zh: 两家慈善机构决定联合力量，在全国发起一项救灾行动。

items.def_en: (+ with sb) to connect or combine with an ally to act together
items.ex_en: The two railway networks are scheduled to link up by the end of next year.
items.ex_zh: 这两条铁路网计划于明年年底实现连通。
items.ex2_en: Engineers linked up the two separate optical fibers across the mountain gorge.
items.ex2_zh: 工程师们将穿过山峡的两条独立光纤连接了起来。

items.def_en: (+ with sb) to form a partnership or team with another person or entity
items.ex_en: The teacher instructed each student to pair up with a reliable partner.
items.ex_zh: 老师要求每位学生都找一个可靠的搭档结对。
items.ex2_en: The dance instructor paired up the nervous beginners for the opening waltz.
items.ex2_zh: 舞蹈教练把紧张的初学者配成对来跳开场华尔兹。

items.def_en: (formal) To bring states, groups, or people into an alliance, or to form an alliance.
items.ex_en: The sovereign cantons voted to confederate into a unified defense community.
items.ex_zh: 各独立邦联投票表决联合成立一个统一的防御同盟。
items.ex2_en: The visionary stateswoman confederated scattered tribal territories into an enduring trade union.
items.ex2_zh: 这位有远见的女政治家将分散的部落领地结盟成一个持久的贸易联盟。

items.def_en: [I/T] To organize into or join a formal political federation or governing league
items.ex_en: The independent colonies agreed to federate under a single constitutional government.
items.ex_zh: 各独立殖民地同意在一个单一宪政政府下结成联邦。
items.ex2_en: The national leadership federated independent local utilities into a unified power grid.
items.ex2_zh: 国家领导层将独立的当地公用事业单位联合成一个统一的电网。

items.def_en: To join with several people to collect a shared sum of money for a common purchase
items.ex_en: All the office staff decided to club together to buy a retirement gift.
items.ex_zh: 办公室的所有员工决定凑钱买一份退休礼物。

groups.summary_en: Parties, states, or individuals combine forces, form a coalition, or unite their resources to achieve a common goal or defend shared interests.
groups.summary_zh: 个人、团体或政体为共同目标结成同盟或组合联队。
groups.desc_en: Uniting separate actors or organizations into a coordinated cooperative entity, contrasting with casual socialization by targeting mutual defense or strategic goals.
groups.desc_zh: 将分散的个体或组织结成利益协调的一体化合作实体，不同于普通社交聚集，强调攻守同盟或战略利益捆绑。
groups.nuance_en: ally: forge formal mutual strategic or geopolitical ties (nations / factions / corporations) · band together: spontaneous grassroots cohesion against shared threats (citizens / survivors / rebels) · team up: informal pairing or partnering to execute a joint project (investigators / athletes / colleagues) · league: formally confederate in an ongoing pact or confederacy (states / cities / barons) · join forces: pooling combined resources to achieve common victory (armies / rivals / agencies)
groups.nuance_zh: ally: 正式缔结政治、战略或军事同盟 (nations / factions / corporations) · band together: 弱势群体自发抱团联合抗敌 (citizens / survivors / rebels) · team up: 搭班子合作执行具体任务项目 (investigators / athletes / colleagues) · league: 建立条约性质的联盟或联合会 (states / cities / barons) · join forces: 整合两方兵力或关键资源合兵一处 (armies / rivals / agencies)

groups.name: Walk & Trudge · 步行与跋涉 (Walk, Wade, Trudge)
groups.tip: 双脚着地步态各异

items.def_zh: （行走或站立时）脚尖朝向；用脚尖触碰（或踢）
items.def_en: 1. To walk or stand with the toes pointing in a specified direction. 2. To touch, reach, or kick with the toes.
items.ex_en: The sergeant ordered the tired recruit to toe the chalked line squarely.
items.ex_zh: 军士命令疲惫的新兵脚尖对齐白线站好。

items.def_zh: 沉重缓慢地向前走，迈着沉重步伐赶路
items.def_en: to walk slowly, heavily, and with weary steps over a distance
items.ex_en: Exhausted after the long shift, the miners plodded along the dusty track.
items.ex_zh: 漫长的一班结束后，筋疲力尽的矿工们沿着尘土飞扬的小道沉重缓慢地向前走。

items.def_en: to continue walking slowly and heavily due to great fatigue or adverse conditions
items.ex_en: Despite the freezing winds, the lost hikers had to trudge on.
items.ex_zh: 尽管寒风刺骨，迷路的徒步者们仍不得不吃力地继续迈步前行。

items.def_zh: 蹚（水、泥等），跋涉；艰难费力地处理（wade through）
items.def_en: 1. (+ through/into/across) To walk with effort through water, mud, or deep snow. 2. ('wade through') To read or work slowly through something tedious.
items.ex_en: The soldiers had to wade across the icy river under heavy fire.
items.ex_zh: 士兵们不得不在猛烈炮火下蹚过冰冷的河流。

items.def_en: 1. To step or walk on, in, or along something. 2. To press, crush, or injure by stepping on.
items.ex_en: He feared to tread upon the delicate fallen leaves of the forest.
items.ex_zh: 他不敢踏在森林中脆弱的落叶之上。

items.def_en: [I/T] to walk heavily or noisily, or to travel over long distances on foot
items.ex_en: The weary travelers tramped along the stony trail until sunset approached.
items.ex_zh: 疲倦的旅行者们沿着石子路一路重步行进，直至日落时分。

items.def_zh: （因疲劳、负重而）步履艰难地走，沉重慢行
items.def_en: 1. (+ through/along/up) To walk slowly and with heavy, tired steps, especially through mud, snow, or uphill.
items.ex_en: The rescue team trudged through deep snowdrifts to reach the remote cabin.
items.ex_zh: 救援队吃力地穿过厚厚的积雪，赶往那座偏远的小屋。

items.def_zh: 沉重而缓慢地迈步，步履蹒跚地走
items.def_en: to walk slowly and with heavy, labored steps, typically from weariness
items.ex_en: The old farmer plodded homeward after spending hours digging in the field.
items.ex_zh: 老农在田里劳作数小时后，迈着沉重的步伐往家走去。

items.def_zh: 在（泥淖、雨雪中）艰难跋涉
items.def_en: (+ sth) to walk laboriously through mud, snow, or tough terrain
items.ex_en: We had to slog through thick swamp mud to retrieve the equipment.
items.ex_zh: 我们不得不艰难地在厚厚的沼泽泥浆中跋涉以取回设备。

items.def_en: 1. (+ across/through/to) To make a long, difficult journey on foot, especially across wild country.
items.ex_en: The research expedition prepared to trek across the vast, arid plateau.
items.ex_zh: 考察队准备长途跋涉，穿越那片辽阔而干旱的高原。

items.def_en: (+ through) to walk or make one's way with difficulty through mud, deep snow, or rough terrain
items.ex_en: The exhausted hikers had to slog up the steep, muddy mountain slope.
items.ex_zh: 精疲力竭的登山者们不得不艰难地爬上陡峭泥泞的山坡。

groups.summary_en: This frame characterizes methods of terrestrial foot locomotion constrained by physical drag, difficult substrates (mud, water, snow), or exhaustive fatigue.
groups.summary_zh: 因地形阻力（水、泥、冰雪）或体力耗竭而形成的艰难步态。
groups.desc_en: Moving on foot through challenging, resistant, or exhausting terrain, contrasting with unencumbered walking by the heavy physical toll and sluggish friction involved.
groups.desc_zh: 徒步穿行于阻力大、湿滑或疲惫的险恶地面，与普通漫步相比，强调足底沉重摩擦感、疲劳感与艰难推进阻力。
groups.nuance_en: trudge: weary, laborious stepping through mud, snow, or fatigue (snow / miles / uphill) · plod: slow, rhythmic, unimaginative, and heavy-footed progression (path / field / road) · wade: walking forward through liquid, deep snow, or resistive volume (water / marsh / paperwork) · tramp: heavy, purposeful, and long-distance cross-country marching (forest / hills / streets) · tread: careful, deliberate footfalls placing weight cautiously (board / path / water)
groups.nuance_zh: trudge: 踏着泥泞或积雪拖着疲惫身躯艰难跋涉 (snow / miles / uphill) · plod: 步伐沉重乏味、缓慢但不停歇地挪步前行 (path / field / road) · wade: 费力趟过水流、淤泥或深阻物 (water / marsh / paperwork) · tramp: 脚步沉实有力的长途越野远足 (forest / hills / streets) · tread: 谨慎踩踏、轻触落脚于特定表面 (board / path / water)

groups.name: Wander, Stray & Roam · 漫步、漫游与漂泊迷失 (Wander, Stray & Roam)
groups.tip: 无特定目的地信步漫游

items.def_zh: 随波逐流；漫无目的地走动
items.def_en: to move aimlessly, slowly, or passively from one place or situation to another
items.ex_en: After graduating, he drifted aimlessly from one low-paying retail job to another.
items.ex_zh: 毕业后，他漫无目的地随波逐流，换了一份又一份低薪的零售工作。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to travel or move through an area freely without a specific destination
items.ex_en: Stray cats often roam around the quiet streets late at night.
items.ex_zh: 流浪猫经常在深夜里四处闲逛于安静的街道上。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to wander away or deviate from the proper route, place, or group
items.ex_en: Hikers must take great care not to stray from the designated path.
items.ex_zh: 徒步旅行者必须格外小心，切勿偏离指定路线。

items.def_zh: 漫步走开，走失，溜达离开
items.def_en: to walk away aimlessly from a group, designated area, or established path
items.ex_en: The curious toddler wandered off from the playground while his mother blinked.
items.ex_zh: 母亲一眨眼的工夫，那个好奇的幼儿就漫步走离了游乐场。

items.def_zh: 闲逛，漫游；神气活现地走动
items.def_en: 1. (informal, chiefly British) To move or wander about in a relaxed, carefree, or dramatic manner.
items.ex_en: She decided to swan around the art gallery in her luxurious fur.
items.ex_zh: 她决定身披奢华皮草，神气活现地在美术馆里漫步闲逛。

items.def_zh: 走散，走失，离开；偏离（主题等）
items.def_en: 1. (+ from/into) To wander away from a group, path, or place where one should remain. 2. To move away from the main subject or point.
items.ex_en: A few sheep strayed away from the main flock into the ravine.
items.ex_zh: 几只羊脱离了主羊群，走失进了山谷。

items.def_en: 1. To walk or travel around a large area without a fixed purpose or direction.
items.ex_en: Wild horses roam freely across the wide and open desert plains.
items.ex_zh: 野马在开阔广袤的荒漠平原上自由自在地漫游。

items.def_zh: 踱步，巡行，漫步走过（正式）
items.def_en: to walk through or around an area in a leisurely, deliberate, or inspectional manner
items.ex_en: The venerable squire perambulated the estate grounds every morning without fail.
items.ex_zh: 那位德高望重的乡绅每天清晨都会风雨无阻地巡视庄园。

items.def_en: to walk for pleasure across countryside without a strict predetermined route
items.ex_en: We spent Sunday morning rambling through the picturesque hills of the countryside.
items.ex_zh: 我们整个周日早晨都在风景如画的乡村丘陵间漫步闲游。

items.def_zh: 漫步，闲逛；（河流、道路等）蜿蜒曲折
items.def_en: 1. To walk slowly and without a clear direction. 2. (of a river, road, etc.) To follow a winding, turning course.
items.ex_en: The young tourists loved to meander through the winding cobblestone alleyways.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的游客们喜欢在蜿蜒曲折的鹅卵石小巷中随心漫步。

items.def_zh: 漫游，漫步，流浪；（目光）转动，环顾
items.def_en: 1. (literary) To travel or wander across an area without a fixed destination. 2. (of eyes) To look in all directions.
items.ex_en: Lonesome bards used to rove the misty highlands, singing ancient forgotten ballads.
items.ex_zh: 孤寂的游吟诗人曾漫步在薄雾弥漫的高地，吟唱古老遗忘的歌谣。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict moving without a fixed destination, deviating from a course, or traversing large spaces casually or aimlessly. They differentiate between aimless meandering, deviation from safety, ostentatious wandering, and wide-ranging roaming.
groups.summary_zh: 无固定目的地或偏离路线的漫行、流浪、漫游或四处游荡。
groups.desc_en: Moving continuously over an expanse without a fixed route or purpose, contrasting with goal-oriented travel through spatial freedom, divergence, or aimless drifting.
groups.desc_zh: 在广阔空间内无固定路线或明确目的地随性漫游，与定点出行相比，突出游荡的随性、偏离正道或无拘漂泊。
groups.nuance_en: roam: expansive, unrestricted exploration over vast open spaces (hills / cattle / predator) · stray: unintentional drifting away from a safe group, line, or moral bounds (child / sheep / topic) · wander: leisurely, meandering locomotion governed by whim (gardens / thoughts / streets) · drift: passive, aimless flotation or unanchored relocation (current / crowd / sleep) · perambulate: stately, formal walking around a boundary or space (estate / park / perimeter)
groups.nuance_zh: roam: 广袤原野上的无拘探索或四处巡行游荡 (hills / cattle / predator) · stray: 偏离路线、失散脱群或误入歧途 (child / sheep / topic) · wander: 闲散漫步，或神思游离地信步闲逛 (gardens / thoughts / streets) · drift: 随波逐流无根漂泊，随势流转 (current / crowd / sleep) · perambulate: 规整从容地巡视周界或在庭园中踱步 (estate / park / perimeter)

groups.name: Wobble & Sway · 摆荡与失衡晃动 (Unstable, Oscillating Motion)
groups.tip: 失去平衡或左右摇摆震颤

items.def_en: to swing back and forth rhythmically across a central axis
items.ex_en: The pendulum began to oscillate steadily between the two fixed magnetic points.
items.ex_zh: 钟摆开始在两个固定的磁极点之间平稳地来回摆动。

items.def_en: to walk or move with shaky, unsteady steps as if about to fall
items.ex_en: The toddler began to totter across the living room on shaky legs.
items.ex_zh: 幼儿迈着发抖的双腿，晃晃悠悠地走过客厅。

items.def_en: To move or cause to move with short, quick movements from side to side or up and down.
items.ex_en: The playful puppy began to waggle its tiny tail in pure excitement.
items.ex_zh: 那只活泼的小狗兴奋极了，开始欢快地左右摇摆小尾巴。
items.ex2_en: The bird's long tail feathers waggled rhythmically as it hopped across branches.
items.ex2_zh: 当鸟在树枝间跳跃时，它长长的尾羽有节奏地摆动。

items.def_en: to suddenly change direction or swerve away from a straight path
items.ex_en: The distracted driver suddenly veered off the road and hit the guardrail.
items.ex_zh: 分心的司机突然偏离了车道，撞上了护栏。

items.def_en: to move unsteadily from side to side in an uncontrolled manner
items.ex_en: The loose wheel wobbled about wildly as the cart picked up speed.
items.ex_zh: 随着马车加速，松动的手推车轮子剧烈地晃荡起来。

items.def_zh: 突然转向；猛打方向变道
items.def_en: [I/T] to change direction abruptly, often while moving fast
items.ex_en: The speeding taxi had to swerve sharply to avoid a stray dog.
items.ex_zh: 疾驰的出租车不得不猛打方向拐开，以避开一只流浪狗。
items.ex2_en: The panicking driver swerved his heavy truck sharply onto the gravel shoulder.
items.ex2_zh: 惊慌失措的司机猛然把沉重的卡车急转到碎石路肩上。

items.def_zh: 摇晃，踉跄；摇摇欲坠，处于岌岌可危的境地
items.def_en: To stand, move, or balance unsteadily; to be on the edge of falling or collapse.
items.ex_en: The stacked wooden boxes began to teeter dangerously in the strong wind.
items.ex_zh: 叠放的木箱在强风中开始摇晃起来，显得岌岌可危。

items.def_zh: （车尾或机尾）摆尾，甩尾，左右摆动
items.def_en: (of a vehicle or aircraft) To slide or swing the rear end wildly from side to side out of control.
items.ex_en: The sports car began to fishtail across the slippery icy roadway.
items.ex_zh: 那辆跑车在湿滑结冰的路面上开始左右甩尾失控。

items.def_en: (of a voice) To shake or tremble unsteadily because of fear, emotion, or age; to utter with a trembling voice.
items.ex_en: Her voice began to quaver as she recounted the harrowing childhood memory.
items.ex_zh: 当她讲述那段痛苦的童年回忆时，声音开始颤抖起来。
items.ex2_en: She quavered an emotional apology through heavy tears to her estranged family.
items.ex2_zh: 她泪流满面，用颤抖的声音向疏远的家人表达了深切的歉意。

items.def_en: to stand or balance unsteadily on the brink or edge of something, threatening to fall
items.ex_en: The old stone vase seemed to teeter on the narrow mantle edge.
items.ex_zh: 那只古老的石瓶在狭窄的壁炉边缘摇摇欲坠。

items.def_zh: 疾驰颠簸，摇晃狂奔；（船只）倾侧
items.def_en: 1. To rush forward swiftly and erratically, swaying or tilting from side to side out of control. 2. (nautical) To tilt a ship onto its side for cleaning or repair.
items.ex_en: The heavily laden schooner careened through the wild, foam-streaked ocean swell.
items.ex_zh: 满载货物的帆船在翻滚着白沫的狂暴海浪中倾侧颠簸向前。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail non-linear physical instability, including erratic vehicle swerving, unsteady balance teetering on an edge, and vibratory vocal/physical trembling.
groups.summary_zh: 描述物体或肢体失衡、左右摆动、偏航甩尾或颤巍颤抖的不稳定动态方式。
groups.desc_en: Moving with unsteady, alternating angular displacement or losing directional equilibrium, differing from smooth rotation by unpredictable, precarious oscillation.
groups.desc_zh: 因重心失稳或外力扰动呈现交替摆动或航向偏移，不同于平稳旋转，强调摇摇欲坠的失衡与不规则晃动。
groups.nuance_en: wobble: unsteadiness with rapid, irregular lateral shaking (wheel / jelly / knees) · teeter: precarious balancing on the brink of falling (edge / brink / heels) · totter: feeble, unsteady stepping as if about to collapse (toddler / regime / drunkard) · fishtail: rapid, hazardous lateral skidding of a vehicle's rear (car / trailer / aircraft) · swerve: abrupt, sudden veering to evade collision (vehicle / driver / missile)
groups.nuance_zh: wobble: 失去重心时的晃荡、抖动或摇晃 (wheel / jelly / knees) · teeter: 在悬崖边缘或失衡临界点前后摇摆不定 (edge / brink / heels) · totter: 步履蹒跚、老态龙钟或摇摇欲坠 (toddler / regime / drunkard) · fishtail: 车尾左右甩尾摆动的剧烈失控状态 (car / trailer / aircraft) · swerve: 为避让障碍物突然急打方向转向 (vehicle / driver / missile)

groups.name: Write & Compose · 书写与创作 (Pen, Draft, Inscribe)
groups.tip: 动笔书写形成文字篇章

items.def_en: to write something down quickly and briefly
items.ex_en: Please jot down her phone number before you forget the details completely.
items.ex_zh: 请在她把细节说完之前草草记下她的电话号码，以免彻底忘记。

items.def_en: to write something on paper so that you remember or document it
items.ex_en: The detective carefully put down every relevant detail on his notepad.
items.ex_zh: 侦探把每一个相关细节都认真记录在记事本上。

items.def_en: to record thoughts, words, or facts in writing for formal preservation
items.ex_en: The historian sought to set down the oral accounts of surviving witnesses.
items.ex_zh: 这位历史学家试图将幸存目击者的口述记录成文以供保存。

items.def_zh: （用手）写字，印上字母；用字母标明
items.def_en: To write or mark letters on something by hand or with a special tool.
items.ex_en: The artisan carefully lettered the graduate's name on the leather diploma cover.
items.ex_zh: 工匠小心翼翼地在皮革文凭封面上手写印上毕业生的名字。

items.def_en: to prepare a preliminary version of a piece of writing or document
items.ex_en: The junior attorney was tasked to draft a revised merger proposal immediately.
items.ex_zh: 初级律师被委派立即起草一份修订后的合并提案。

items.def_zh: 动笔写，写作；关入栏中，圈养
items.def_en: 1. To write or compose something by hand. 2. To shut up or enclose animals or people in a pen or small space.
items.ex_en: In solitary exile, the poet penned haunting verses about his beloved homeland.
items.ex_zh: 在孤寂的流亡生活中，诗人动笔写下了关于挚爱故土的动人诗句。

items.def_en: to write or formulate text, speech, or music with careful thought
items.ex_en: The diplomat spent the evening composing an official formal diplomatic response.
items.ex_zh: 那位外交官花了一整晚撰写一份正式的外交答复。

items.def_zh: 快速炮制出（草稿或文稿）
items.def_en: to produce a piece of writing, draft, or creative work rapidly and informally
items.ex_en: Our team was knocked out of the tournament in the quarter-finals.
items.ex_zh: 我们队在四分之一决赛中被淘汰出局。

items.def_en: To write or be the author of a book, article, report, or other work.
items.ex_en: The prominent economist authored several groundbreaking books on post-crisis monetary policy.
items.ex_zh: 这位著名经济学家撰写了几本关于危机后货币政策的开创性著作。

items.def_en: To write the script for a film, play, television show, or speech.
items.ex_en: She was hired to script an adaptation of the famous historical biography.
items.ex_zh: 她受聘为这部著名的历史传记编写电影剧本。

items.def_en: to write or carve words or symbols formally onto a surface or in a book
items.ex_en: The jeweler agreed to inscribe their initials inside the platinum wedding band.
items.ex_zh: 珠宝匠同意将他们的首字母题刻在白金结婚戒圈的内侧。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate the physical or intellectual act of writing, drafting, or formally setting down text in letters, documents, or literary works.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过物理书写或构思撰写文本、书信或文学著作的创作方式与手段。
groups.desc_en: Inscribing or orchestrating linguistic symbols and conceptual structures into written form, contrasting with mere copying by involving creative formulation and recording.
groups.desc_zh: 通过文字符号将思想构思成文并落于纸面介质，区别于被动誊写，强调主动的遣词造句与文本构思过程。
groups.nuance_en: pen: authoring with conscious literary or personal flair (letter / memoir / verse) · draft: preparing a working preliminary outline or legislative text (contract / proposal / speech) · jot down: hasty, brief recording of facts or thoughts for reference (note / number / address) · compose: deliberate, artistic arrangement of sophisticated expression (essay / symphony / response) · knock out: rapidly producing written material without meticulous polish (article / chapter / review)
groups.nuance_zh: pen: 亲笔挥毫，带有个人文风或诚挚色彩的撰写 (letter / memoir / verse) · draft: 拟定方案、法案或文稿的第一版初稿 (contract / proposal / speech) · jot down: 匆忙快速随手记下备忘要点 (note / number / address) · compose: 沉思斟酌、精细构制典雅篇章 (essay / symphony / response) · knock out: 仓促赶工快速炮制写就文稿 (article / chapter / review)

groups.name: Accumulate & Amass · 积聚与累积 (Accumulate, Amass, Accrue)
groups.tip: 随着时间推移聚沙成塔渐增

items.def_en: [I/T] to increase gradually in amount, pressure, or size
items.ex_en: Dark storm clouds began to build up menacingly along the western horizon.
items.ex_zh: 乌云密布的风暴云开始在西边地平线上逐渐聚拢积蓄。
items.ex2_en: Consistent physical training will gradually build up your cardiovascular health over several months.
items.ex2_zh: 坚持体育锻炼将在数月内逐渐增强你的心血管健康。

items.def_en: [I/T] to accumulate in a growing, often disorganized heap or quantity
items.ex_en: Unanswered emails continued to pile up quickly while she was on vacation.
items.ex_zh: 她度假期间，未回复的电子邮件继续迅速堆积如山。
items.ex2_en: The careless tenant piled up empty cardboard boxes behind the apartment building.
items.ex2_zh: 粗心的租客在公寓楼后堆积起空纸箱。

items.def_zh: 积欠，迅速积累（债务、账单等）
items.def_en: to allow a large amount of debt, bills, or arrears to accumulate rapidly
items.ex_en: He managed to run up thousands of dollars in credit card debt.
items.ex_zh: 不知不觉中，他积欠了数千美元的信用卡债务。

items.def_zh: 累积获得（分数、利润、债务等）
items.def_en: to gradually collect, achieve, or amass an impressive or large total quantity of something
items.ex_en: The championship team managed to rack up twelve consecutive victories this season.
items.ex_zh: 这支冠军球队本赛季成功累积获得了十二场连胜。

items.def_en: to accumulate and store large quantities of goods or supplies for future use
items.ex_en: Residents rushed to stock up on canned food before the blizzard arrived.
items.ex_zh: 居民们赶在暴风雪来临之前冲去大量囤积罐头食品。

items.def_en: [I/T] to collect, gather, or increase gradually in quantity over time
items.ex_en: Over decades of study, the scholar accumulated an astonishing array of manuscripts.
items.ex_zh: 经过几十年的学术研究，这位学者累积了惊人数量的手稿。
items.ex2_en: Harmful environmental contaminants accumulate gradually inside living tissues over decades of exposure.
items.ex2_zh: 有害的环境污染物在数十年的暴露中逐渐在活组织中积累。

items.def_en: [I/T] to amass and store away valued goods greedily or secretly
items.ex_en: The greedy miser loved to hoard gold coins inside a subterranean vault.
items.ex_zh: 那个贪婪的守财奴喜欢在地窖里囤积金币。

items.def_en: 1. To collect or accumulate a large amount of wealth, information, or objects over time.
items.ex_en: Through shrewd property investments, the investor amassed an enormous personal fortune.
items.ex_zh: 通过精明的房地产投资，该投资者积聚了巨额的个人财富。

items.def_zh: （利益、利息等）自然增加，逐渐累积；生息
items.def_en: 1. (+ to/from) (finance / formal) To accumulate or increase gradually over a period of time, especially of interest, benefits, or debts.
items.ex_en: Considerable interest will accrue to your savings account by year's end.
items.ex_zh: 到了年底，可观的利息将自然计入你的储蓄账户。
items.ex2_en: Savvy financial investments accrue substantial monetary dividends over long retirement periods.
items.ex2_zh: 精明的金融投资在漫长的退休期内积累了可观的金钱分红。

items.def_en: 1. To accumulate an excessive amount of unfinished work, orders, or tasks that need to be processed.
items.ex_en: The warehouse began to backlog hundreds of unprocessed orders during peak season.
items.ex_zh: 旺季期间，仓库开始积压数百份未处理的订单。
items.ex2_en: Customer service inquiries backlog alarmingly during major nationwide holiday shopping weekends.
items.ex2_zh: 在全国大型假日购物周末期间，客户服务咨询积压得惊人。

groups.summary_en: Quantities of material goods, money, interest, or unresolved tasks collect and build up gradually over time, either deliberately through collection or incrementally by natural progression.
groups.summary_zh: 资金、物资或未结事务随时间逐渐累积增长或汇聚堆积。
groups.desc_en: Gathering and growing a quantity of resources or items gradually over time, contrasting with sudden windfalls by the cumulative, escalating volume involved.
groups.desc_zh: 随时间推移将资源或物品逐步汇集增多，不同于突发意外横财，强调数量梯次递增与蓄积过程。
groups.nuance_en: accumulate: progressive, continuous collection over time (wealth / dust / evidence) · amass: accumulating enormous, impressive quantities of wealth or power (fortune / data / collection) · hoard: secretive, obsessive stockpiling driven by fear of scarcity (supplies / cash / grain) · rack up: steadily scoring or registering high counts (points / debts / victories) · stock up: deliberate bulk purchasing to anticipate future needs (pantry / medicine / groceries)
groups.nuance_zh: accumulate: 自然递进、日积月累地聚积 (wealth / dust / evidence) · amass: 聚拢积累海量惊人的财富、实力或资料 (fortune / data / collection) · hoard: 恐惧短缺而囤积居奇、秘藏不舍 (supplies / cash / grain) · rack up: 连番累积并记下惊人成绩或负债 (points / debts / victories) · stock up: 为备后用有计划地集中采购囤储 (pantry / medicine / groceries)

groups.name: Administer Medicine & Immunize · 给药与免疫注射 (Medicate, Dose, Vaccinate)
groups.tip: 按剂量给药以治疗病症

items.def_zh: 给……服药，配药；服药；在……中掺入（化学品）
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To give a measured amount of medicine or a drug to someone. 2. To add a chemical or substance to something.
items.ex_en: The nurse had to dose the restless patient with a mild sedative.
items.ex_zh: 护士不得不给躁动不安的病人配服适量的温和镇静剂。

items.def_en: (archaic) to administer medicine or purges to a person or animal
items.ex_en: The village apothecary was summoned to physic the ailing count with bitters.
items.ex_zh: 村里的药剂师被召来，用苦味药剂为生病的伯爵医治下药。

items.def_en: to give someone or oneself substantial doses of medicine to treat an ailment
items.ex_en: I need to dose up on cold medicine before heading into the office.
items.ex_zh: 去办公室之前，我得给自己灌点感冒药。

items.def_en: to inject a recipient with a vaccine or medication using a hypodermic needle
items.ex_en: The nurse jabbed him with the flu shot before he could even flinch.
items.ex_zh: 他还来不及缩手，护士就一针把流感疫苗扎进了他的胳膊。

items.def_zh: 给……大剂量灌注（药物/镇静剂）
items.def_en: to continuously administer large amounts of medicine, drugs, or fluids into someone's body
items.ex_en: They pumped the injured horse full of painkillers to calm it down.
items.ex_zh: 他们给受伤的马注入了大量止痛药以让它平静下来。

items.def_zh: 给……下药（或服用兴奋剂、镇静剂）；服用兴奋剂；吸毒
items.def_en: 1. To give medicine, a sedative, or performance-enhancing drugs to a person or animal. 2. (informal) To take illegal recreational drugs or doping substances.
items.ex_en: The trainer was caught trying to dope the racehorse before the championship.
items.ex_zh: 练马师在锦标赛前试图给赛马服用兴奋剂时被当场抓获。

items.def_zh: 给……接种疫苗，给……打预防针
items.def_en: 1. (+ against) To inject a person or animal with a vaccine to protect against a disease.
items.ex_en: Parents are strongly advised to vaccinate their children against measles and rubella.
items.ex_zh: 强烈建议家长为孩子接种麻疹和风疹疫苗。

items.def_en: to treat a patient or condition with medicinal substances
items.ex_en: Physicians rarely medicate mild behavioral symptoms without comprehensive psychological evaluation beforehand.
items.ex_zh: 在事先进行全面心理评估之前，医生极少对轻微行为症状用药治疗。

items.def_zh: 给……接种疫苗；给……预防注射
items.def_en: to treat an individual with a vaccine or antigenic substance to produce immunity against a disease
items.ex_en: Health authorities moved swiftly to inoculate the entire population against the emerging pathogen.
items.ex_zh: 卫生当局迅速采取行动，为全体民众接种针对新病原体的疫苗。

items.def_zh: 使免疫；给……接种以产生免疫力
items.def_en: to make someone immune to an infectious illness, especially by vaccination
items.ex_en: The global initiative aimed to immunize every vulnerable infant against polio.
items.ex_zh: 这项全球倡议旨在使每名易感婴儿都获得脊髓灰质炎免疫力。

groups.summary_en: This scenario frame encompasses administering therapeutic substances, pharmaceuticals, or immunizing biologics to human or animal recipients. Verbs distinguish between routine pharmacological dosing (dose, medicate), prophylactic antibody induction (vaccinate, inoculate), and illicit drug administration (dope).
groups.summary_zh: 指给人体或动物施用药物、计量配药、接种疫苗或违禁给药的医疗/生理行为。
groups.desc_en: Delivering pharmacologically active agents or antigens into an organism to treat illness or confer immunity, contrasting with ordinary feeding by clinical intent.
groups.desc_zh: 向生物体输入活性药物或抗原以治病、调理或赋予免疫力，区别于日常饮食摄入，强调临床调剂干预与防御目的。
groups.nuance_en: dose: measuring and administering a specific quantity of medication (patient / child / medicine) · medicate: prescribing or managing therapeutic pharmaceutical treatment (condition / symptoms / elder) · vaccinate: injecting biological preparations to stimulate pathogen immunity (population / infants / herd) · jab with: abrupt or informal administering of an injection via needle (needle / syringe / vaccine) · dope: illicitly administering performance-enhancing or sedative compounds (athlete / horse / drink)
groups.nuance_zh: dose: 按规定计量下药配药 (patient / child / medicine) · medicate: 采用药物进行医疗干预或对症下药 (condition / symptoms / elder) · vaccinate: 接种疫苗以刺激产生病原免疫屏障 (population / infants / herd) · jab with: 用注射针头快速戳刺给药接种 (needle / syringe / vaccine) · dope: 为提升表现或催眠而违规注射兴奋剂/药剂 (athlete / horse / drink)

groups.name: Admire & Worship · 敬佩与崇拜 (Admire, Venerate, Worship)
groups.tip: 从由衷赞赏上升为狂热神化膜拜

items.def_en: to regard someone or something with respect, pleasure, and approval
items.ex_en: I truly admire her ability to stay calm under intense pressure.
items.ex_zh: 我由衷钦佩她在巨大压力下依然保持冷静的能力。

items.def_en: (+ sb) have great respect and admiration for someone regarded as an exemplar
items.ex_en: Young athletes around the world look up to her as an inspirational leader.
items.ex_zh: 全世界的年轻运动员都视她为鼓舞人心的榜样并敬佩她。

items.def_en: to feel deep respect, veneration, or awe for someone or something
items.ex_en: Scholars worldwide revere the philosopher for his profound contributions to ethics.
items.ex_zh: 全世界的学者都因这位哲学家对伦理学的深远贡献而尊崇他。

items.def_en: (+ at) To be filled with wonder, astonishment, or deep admiration.
items.ex_en: Travelers stood motionless upon the summit to marvel at the celestial dawn.
items.ex_zh: 旅人们伫立于山巅，凝神赞叹那宛若天境的破晓晨曦。

items.def_en: To respect and admire someone or something greatly.
items.ex_en: The board members esteem his professional judgment and integrity above all others.
items.ex_zh: 董事会成员格外敬重他的专业判断力和高尚品格。

items.def_zh: 崇奉，膜拜（因圣洁或智慧）
items.def_en: to regard with profound and solemn respect, often associated with sanctity or antiquity
items.ex_en: Pilgrims gather annually to venerate the sacred relics preserved within the ancient cathedral.
items.ex_zh: 朝圣者每年齐聚古老的大教堂，膜拜其中保存的神圣遗物。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) display deep reverence, worship, or absolute submission to someone or a deity
items.ex_en: The rebels refused to bow down to the authoritarian regime.
items.ex_zh: 叛军拒绝向独裁政权低头屈服。

items.def_zh: 崇拜，敬奉；崇拜，爱慕；做礼拜
items.def_en: 1. To show deep reverence and adoration for a deity or sacred object. 2. To admire, love, or venerate someone intensely.
items.ex_en: Millions of devoted followers worship at the ancient temple during the festival.
items.ex_zh: 节日期间，数以百万计的虔诚信徒来到古庙敬奉参拜。

items.def_zh: 把……当作偶像崇拜，极度崇拜
items.def_en: To admire, revere, or love someone or something to an excessive degree.
items.ex_en: Young aspiring musicians often idolize rock stars and imitate their reckless lifestyles.
items.ex_zh: 心怀抱负的年轻音乐人往往把摇滚明星当偶像崇拜，并模仿他们放纵的生活方式。

items.def_zh: 奉为神明，神化，极度推崇
items.def_en: To treat or worship someone or something as a god; to idolize.
items.ex_en: Ancient citizens would deify their deceased emperors and erect temples in their honor.
items.ex_zh: 古代百姓常将逝世的帝王奉为神明，并为之修建庙宇以示纪念。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers affective evaluations of profound respect and reverence, progressing from intellectual high regard and wonder to complete adulation and divine attribution.
groups.summary_zh: 从内心的赞赏敬重逐步递进到狂热崇拜乃至神格化奉若神明。
groups.desc_en: Holding a subject in exceptionally high esteem, reverence, or adoration, contrasting with mild liking by the profound moral, aesthetic, or sacred elevation attributed.
groups.desc_zh: 对客体怀有极高敬重、膜拜或景仰之情，不同于普通喜爱，具有深刻的精神崇敬、超凡评价乃至神圣化色彩。
groups.nuance_en: admire: viewing excellence or beauty with warm approval and delight (courage / artwork / leader) · venerate: revering deeply on grounds of sacredness, age, or historical status (relics / elders / saint) · worship: devotional adoration treating the object as divine or supreme (deity / hero / idol) · look up to: aspiring emulation of an elder or role model (mentor / parent / coach) · revere: regarding with awe-infused, solemn deference (memory / master / constitution)
groups.nuance_zh: admire: 对他人卓越品行或美好事物怀抱赞赏与钦佩 (courage / artwork / leader) · venerate: 因神圣性、资历或道德极高而肃穆尊崇 (relics / elders / saint) · worship: 将客体视若神明般虔信膜拜或个人崇拜 (deity / hero / idol) · look up to: 晚辈对楷模长辈的钦慕仿效 (mentor / parent / coach) · revere: 怀有敬畏与庄严之心的景仰深崇 (memory / master / constitution)

groups.name: Affirm & Formalize · 确认与正式化证明 (Confirm, Validate, Attest)
groups.tip: 提供证据以核实查证

items.def_en: to state definitively that something is true, or make an arrangement certain
items.ex_en: The laboratory tests confirm the presence of toxic chemicals in the groundwater.
items.ex_zh: 化验结果证实地下水中确实存在有毒化学物质。

items.def_en: to tell someone that you have received something they sent, such as a letter or payment
items.ex_en: Please acknowledge receipt of this formal letter by signing the attached slip.
items.ex_zh: 请在随附的回执上签字，以确认收到这封正式信函。

items.def_en: to give official or formal approval to an agreement, statement, or document
items.ex_en: The manager agreed to sign off on our proposed marketing budget today.
items.ex_zh: 经理同意今天正式批准我们提出的营销预算。

items.def_en: to assert, confirm, or give personal assurance about the truth, accuracy, or integrity of something or someone
items.ex_en: I can personally vouch for his honesty and exceptional work ethic.
items.ex_zh: 我可以用个人名誉担保他的诚实和卓越的职业操守。

items.def_en: to support, confirm, or substantiate a claim, fact, or prediction
items.ex_en: The final audit results bore out all our initial suspicions about financial mismanagement.
items.ex_zh: 最终的审计结果证实了我们最初对财务管理不善的所有怀疑。

items.def_zh: 作证，提供证词；证实，证明，表明
items.def_en: 1. To make a formal statement of what is true, especially in a court of law. 2. (+ to) To show, confirm, or give clear evidence that something is true.
items.ex_en: Three key witnesses appeared in court to testify against the corrupt official.
items.ex_zh: 三名关键证人出庭作证，指控这名腐败官员。

items.def_zh: 开具收据，在（账单等上）注明已收到或已付讫；确认收到
items.def_en: To mark a bill or invoice as paid, or to write or issue an official receipt acknowledging payment or receipt of goods.
items.ex_en: The cashier will receipt your invoice as soon as the funds clear.
items.ex_zh: 一旦款项到账，出纳员就会在您的发票上注明已付讫。

items.def_en: to check or prove the validity or accuracy of something, especially formally or legally
items.ex_en: Border authorities must validate your entry visa before allowing you to cross.
items.ex_zh: 边境当局必须先核实确认你的入境签证有效，方可准许通行。

items.def_en: (+ to) to declare or show firmly that something is true, genuine, or authentic
items.ex_en: The newly discovered historical records attest to the treaty's enduring significance.
items.ex_zh: 新发现的历史档案证实了该条约深远持久的意义。

items.def_en: To confirm something again, such as a booking, flight, or agreement, to ensure it is definite.
items.ex_en: Passengers are advised to reconfirm their return flights forty-eight hours prior to departure.
items.ex_zh: 建议旅客在起飞前四十八小时再次确认回程航班。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe providing formal acknowledgment, legal testimony, or administrative re-verification of receipt, agreements, or established statements.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过法律作证、回执确认或再度核准来确证事实、交易或陈述的有效性。
groups.desc_en: Attesting to the truth, authenticity, or formal validity of an assertion or transaction, contrasting with raw claim by using institutional validation or verifiable proof.
groups.desc_zh: 对主张、事实或手续的真实性、合法性作出正式背书与确证，区别于空泛陈述，强调制度化确证与证据效力。
groups.nuance_en: confirm: establishing indisputable certainty of a suspected fact (appointment / diagnosis / rumors) · validate: certifying legal, technical, or objective legitimacy (passport / ticket / hypothesis) · vouch for: staking personal credibility on someone's integrity or claim (character / reliability / friend) · bear out: empirical corroboration demonstrated by subsequent results (theory / prediction / claim) · sign off on: granting final administrative or official authorization (budget / proposal / release)
groups.nuance_zh: confirm: 彻底敲定或印证此前尚存悬念的真伪 (appointment / diagnosis / rumors) · validate: 确认在法理、技术或逻辑上合法有效 (passport / ticket / hypothesis) · vouch for: 以个人信誉出面担保其为人或事实真实性 (character / reliability / friend) · bear out: 后续事实或实证数据完全印证预测 (theory / prediction / claim) · sign off on: 官方或管理层签字正式审批放行 (budget / proposal / release)

groups.name: Aggregate & Cohere · 聚合与凝结 (Flocculate, Agglomerate, Agglutinate)
groups.tip: 微小颗粒或纤维凝结成块

items.def_zh: （使纤维等）聚结成毡，缠结；制成毛毡
items.def_en: To mat or compress fibers together into felt, or to become matted and compacted together.
items.ex_en: The wet wool fibers will felt together under continuous heat and friction.
items.ex_zh: 潮湿的羊毛纤维在持续的受热和摩擦下会聚结成毡。
items.ex2_en: The skilled craftsperson felted wet raw wool fibers into durable warm hats.
items.ex2_zh: 熟练的手艺人将湿润的原羊毛纤维压实制成结实保暖的帽子。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ together) To form into or collect into a compact mass or cluster
items.ex_en: Damp flour particles tend to clump if you do not stir constantly.
items.ex_zh: 如果不及时的持续搅拌，受潮的面粉微粒容易凝集成块。
items.ex2_en: Careless handling will quickly clump the moist brown sugar inside the glass jar.
items.ex2_zh: 粗心的处理会迅速使玻璃罐里潮湿的红糖结块。

items.def_en: to hold or fuse individual components firmly into a cohesive physical unit
items.ex_en: Water and lime act together to bind the sand particles firmly together.
items.ex_zh: 水和石灰共同作用，将沙粒牢固地粘结在一起。
items.ex2_en: Damp clay soil particles bind together naturally under continuous heavy pedestrian traffic.
items.ex2_zh: 潮湿的粘土颗粒在持续的人流踩踏下自然粘结在一起。

items.def_en: to form into a dense mass or cluster, or cause individual particles to adhere together
items.ex_en: The moist soil particles clump together into heavy mounds during the rainstorm.
items.ex_zh: 暴雨期间，潮湿的泥土颗粒凝聚成厚重的土块。
items.ex2_en: Cold weather will quickly clump together the melted cooking fat inside storage.
items.ex2_zh: 寒冷的天气很快会使储藏室里融化的食用油结成一团。

items.def_en: to tangle or press fibers and particles together into a thick, felted mass
items.ex_en: Fallen leaves and twigs mat together on the forest floor after rain.
items.ex_zh: 雨后，落叶和细枝在林地上板结缠绕成厚厚的一层。
items.ex2_en: Continuous damp footwear friction matted together the loose strands of wool carpet.
items.ex2_zh: 潮湿鞋履的持续摩擦使羊毛地毯松散的绒头缠结在一起。

items.def_en: [I/T] To solidify or coagulate, especially by cooling
items.ex_en: The melted beef fat began to congeal on the cold porcelain plate.
items.ex_zh: 融化的牛油在冰冷的瓷盘上开始凝固。
items.ex2_en: Chilly winter air congealed the warm melted grease along the metal gutters.
items.ex2_zh: 寒冷的冬日空气使金属排水沟里温热的油脂凝结了。

items.def_en: [I/T] To change from a fluid into a thickened, semi-solid mass
items.ex_en: Certain snake venoms cause the victim's blood to coagulate within minutes.
items.ex_zh: 某些蛇毒会在数分钟内导致受害者的血液凝固。
items.ex2_en: The concentrated chemical solution coagulated the fresh liquid milk within seconds.
items.ex2_zh: 浓缩的化学溶液在数秒内使新鲜液体牛奶凝结成了固体。

items.def_en: To collect, cluster, or gather together into a dense mass or ball.
items.ex_en: Fine powder particles agglomerate into dense pellets during the industrial compression process.
items.ex_zh: 在工业压制过程中，微细粉末颗粒聚结成了致密的丸状物。
items.ex2_en: The industrial machine agglomerates dry powdery chemicals into uniform agricultural fertilizer granules.
items.ex2_zh: 这台工业机器将干燥的粉状化学品团聚成均匀的农用肥料颗粒。

items.def_en: 1. (biology) To clump or stick together into a mass, as red blood cells or bacteria. 2. (linguistics) To combine morphemes into words.
items.ex_en: The ancient antibodies agglutinate foreign cells into fragile rafts upon microscopic inspection.
items.ex_zh: 在显微观察下，古老的抗体使外来细胞凝集成脆弱的团块。
items.ex2_en: Incompatible red blood cells agglutinate instantly when mixed in test tubes.
items.ex2_zh: 不相容的红细胞在试管中混合时会立即发生凝集。

items.def_en: To form or cause to form into aggregate clumps or fluffy tufts, especially fine particles suspended in a liquid.
items.ex_en: Suspended sediment began to flocculate into soft, gossamer plumes within the twilight water.
items.ex_zh: 悬浮的沉淀物在昏暗的水中开始絮凝成轻柔如薄纱的团块。
items.ex2_en: The municipal water treatment facility flocculates suspended river clay before filtration.
items.ex2_zh: 市政水处理厂在过滤前对悬浮的河流粘土进行絮凝处理。

groups.summary_en: Individual particles, suspended solids, or distinct matter clump, bind, or mat together into clusters, masses, or larger physical matrices.
groups.summary_zh: 微细颗粒或纤维物聚团、黏连或絮凝成致密结构。
groups.desc_en: Coalescing dispersed particles or fluids into a unified, viscous, or solid mass, contrasting with simple mixing by the formation of cohesive structural bonds.
groups.desc_zh: 使原本分散的细微颗粒或流体介质抱团聚集成粘稠块状物，区别于普通混合，强调凝集变稠的物理结构交联。
groups.nuance_en: coagulate: transition of biological fluid into a gel or soft clot (blood / milk / protein) · clump: aggregating loosely into discrete irregular bunches (cells / hair / soil) · agglomerate: collecting or fusing into a jumbled solid cluster (particles / corporations / ores) · congeal: solidifying or thickening into a jelly-like mass through cooling (grease / blood / soup) · felt: tangling and fusing fibrous strands into an interlocking composite (fibers / wool / hair)
groups.nuance_zh: coagulate: 生物胶体或液体受生物化学反应凝固成块 (blood / milk / protein) · clump: 不规则地团聚成簇状或聚成小团 (cells / hair / soil) · agglomerate: 工业颗粒烧结聚结或杂乱附聚 (particles / corporations / ores) · congeal: 随温度降低油脂胶质遇冷凝固结冻 (grease / blood / soup) · felt: 织物纤维无序交错毡化缩绒 (fibers / wool / hair)

groups.name: Alighting & Vehicle Disembarkation · 下车与离机下船 (Disembark, Alight, Dismount)
groups.tip: 自载具或空中降落停驻

items.def_en: to leave a vehicle or platform by taking a step downward
items.ex_en: Watch your footing carefully as you step off the crowded commuter bus.
items.ex_zh: 跨步走下拥挤的通勤公交车时，请格外注意脚下。

items.def_zh: 下火车；使（部队等）下火车
items.def_en: to leave or cause passengers to leave a railway train
items.ex_en: The general ordered the armed battalion to detrain at the border checkpoint.
items.ex_zh: 将军命令武装营在边境检查站全员下火车。
items.ex2_en: Weary rail commuters detrained quickly into the brisk, foggy morning air.
items.ex2_zh: 疲惫的火车通勤族迅速走下火车，融入清冽多雾的晨气中。

items.def_zh: 从（公交车、火车、飞机、船等）下来
items.def_en: to exit or disembark from a bus, train, aircraft, or ship
items.ex_en: We need to get off at the next subway station for the museum.
items.ex_zh: 去博物馆的话，我们需要在下一站地铁站下车。

items.def_zh: 跳下（自行车、马匹、公共汽车等）
items.def_en: to step or jump lightly off a vehicle, conveyance, or animal
items.ex_en: He hopped off his bike and leaned it gently against the old lamppost.
items.ex_zh: 他轻巧地跳下自行车，将其轻轻靠在旧路灯杆上。

items.def_zh: 从（马背、高大车辆）爬下，下来
items.def_en: to descend carefully from an elevated vehicle, carriage, or steed to the ground
items.ex_en: The minister was forced to climb down after intense public backlash.
items.ex_zh: 在强烈的公众反对声中，部长被迫让步。

items.def_zh: （鸟或昆虫）飞落，栖息；（从公共汽车、火车等）下来，下车
items.def_en: 1. (+ on/upon) (of a bird or insect) To land and rest on something. 2. (+ from) (formal) To step down or get off a bus, train, or other vehicle.
items.ex_en: Distinguished foreign delegates alighted from the diplomatic motorcade before entering the palace.
items.ex_zh: 尊贵的外宾在步入宫殿前从外交车队上缓步走下。

items.def_en: 1. (+ from) (formal) To leave a ship, aircraft, or train at the end of a journey.
items.ex_en: Passengers were strictly instructed to disembark from the cruise vessel in orderly groups.
items.ex_zh: 乘客接到严格指令，须分批有序地从游轮上下船。
items.ex2_en: The ship captain disembarked hundreds of stranded passengers safely onto the dock.
items.ex2_zh: 船长把数百名滞留旅客安全送下了船，安置在码头上。

items.def_zh: 下马，下车（自行车、摩托车等）；拆卸
items.def_en: 1. (+ from) To get down off a horse, bicycle, or motorcycle. 2. To remove something from its support or frame.
items.ex_en: The mounted officer chose to dismount before approaching the nervous stray animal.
items.ex_zh: 骑警选择先从马上下骑，然后才走近那只受惊的流浪动物。

items.def_en: to disembark from an airplane after landing
items.ex_en: Tired travelers finally prepared to deplane after sixteen exhausting hours in the air.
items.ex_zh: 在空中飞行了疲惫的十六个小时后，劳累的旅客终于准备下飞机。

items.def_en: to leave a ship or aircraft and go ashore
items.ex_en: Sailors prepared their heavy gear to debark onto the rocky shoreline at dawn.
items.ex_zh: 水手们备好沉重的装备，准备于黎明时分下船登上多石的海岸。
items.ex2_en: The amphibious navy landing craft debarked fresh troops directly onto the beachhead.
items.ex2_zh: 海军两栖登陆艇直接将生力军运送下船登上滩头。

groups.summary_en: This motion frame depicts an agent exiting and stepping down from a conveyance, animal mount, or craft to the ground or platform. Verbs split along vehicle type and stylistic register: dismount for steeds and two-wheelers, disembark for passenger ships and aircraft, step down/off for public transport, and the literary alight for alighting onto a surface.
groups.summary_zh: 乘客或骑手脱离交通工具（车辆、船舶、飞机或坐骑）走下踏足地面的过程。
groups.desc_en: Exiting and setting foot on ground from a transit conveyance or mount, contrasting with generic exit by the specific biomechanics of descending from a vehicle platform.
groups.desc_zh: 从机动交通载具、机舱或乘骑牲畜上下离步入地面，不同于普通离去，强调脱离乘载平台的降落与落脚动作。
groups.nuance_en: disembark: formal, mass departure from a ship, plane, or train (passengers / troops / crew) · alight: graceful or formal stepping down from an elevated transport (carriage / bus / steed) · dismount: getting off the back of a horse, bicycle, or motorcycle (horse / bike / platform) · detrain: military or rail-specific unloading of passengers from trains (regiment / commuters / cargo) · get off: common everyday exit from a public conveyance (bus / train / elevator)
groups.nuance_zh: disembark: 离船登岸、走下机舱或客运终点下客 (passengers / troops / crew) · alight: 仪态庄重从容地下车、步下车厢 (carriage / bus / steed) · dismount: 从马背、单车或两轮车座上下翻落地面 (horse / bike / platform) · detrain: 军队或旅客依序走出火车车厢 (regiment / commuters / cargo) · get off: 日常下公交、下地铁最通俗表达 (bus / train / elevator)

groups.name: Align & Order · 整饬与配列 (Neaten, Disarrange, Parallelize)
groups.tip: 调整次序使规整或紊乱

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make a place or collection of things neat and orderly
items.ex_en: You should straighten up the living room before our guests arrive tonight.
items.ex_zh: 在今晚客人到来之前，你真该把客厅收拾整齐。
items.ex2_en: The unruly classroom straightens up quickly once the strict headmaster enters unexpectedly.
items.ex2_zh: 一旦严厉的校长出其不意地走进来，杂乱的教室很快就整洁了。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to put things into their proper places and make an area neat
items.ex_en: The children helped tidy up their scattered toys before getting ready for bed.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们在准备睡觉前帮忙收拾好了散落一地的玩具。
items.ex2_en: The chaotic art studio tidies up nicely after every student leaves today.
items.ex2_zh: 在今天所有学生离开后，混乱的艺术工作室变得格外整洁。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ out/up) To make neat, orderly, or tidy by adjusting alignment
items.ex_en: He paused at the mirror to straighten his collar and adjust his tie.
items.ex_zh: 他在镜子前停下脚步，理直衣领并整理好了领带。
items.ex2_en: His slouching posture straightened immediately as the drill instructor approached the barracks.
items.ex2_zh: 当训练教官走近营房时，他驼背的姿势立刻挺直了。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ up) To bring order and neatness to a place or group of items
items.ex_en: She spent the morning tidying her crowded workshop and organizing various scattered tools.
items.ex_zh: 她花了一上午时间收拾拥挤的工作室，归拢各种散落的工具。
items.ex2_en: The messy attic room tidies easily with just thirty minutes of effort.
items.ex2_zh: 只要花上三十分钟的功夫，凌乱的阁楼房间就能轻松收拾整洁。

items.def_en: (+ up) To make a room, desk, or appearance neat and tidy.
items.ex_en: He took a minute to neaten his messy desk before the meeting began.
items.ex_zh: 开会前，他花了一分钟整理自己杂乱的办公桌。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make something untidy, disordered, or dirty
items.ex_en: The playful puppy managed to mess up the clean laundry on the bed.
items.ex_zh: 那只淘气的小狗把床上叠得整整齐齐的干净衣物全都弄乱了。

items.def_en: [I/T] To arrange things in a straight line or into correct relative position
items.ex_en: Carefully align the edge of the printed poster with the display frame.
items.ex_zh: 请将印制海报的边缘与展框仔细对齐排列好。
items.ex2_en: The wheels of the vehicle align smoothly after the mechanic adjusts the steering system.
items.ex2_zh: 技工调整转向系统后，车辆的轮子平顺地对齐了。

items.def_zh: 弄乱，扰乱，打乱（次序或布局）
items.def_en: To disturb the neat order or arrangement of something.
items.ex_en: A sudden gust of autumn wind threatened to disarrange her meticulously styled hair.
items.ex_zh: 一阵突如其来的秋风差点吹乱了她精心打理好的发型。

items.def_zh: 使平行，平行排列；（计算中）使并行化
items.def_en: 1. To arrange in a parallel order or direction. 2. (computing) To divide a computational task so that parts run simultaneously across multiple processors.
items.ex_en: The engineer sought to parallelize the core processing threads across the computing grid.
items.ex_zh: 工程师试图使整个计算网格中的核心处理线程并行化。

items.def_zh: 扰乱，破坏（原有的排列或秩序）
items.def_en: To throw into confusion or completely disturb the normal order and arrangement of
items.ex_en: The catastrophic logistical failure threatened to derange the entire national distribution schedule completely.
items.ex_zh: 灾难性的后勤失误势必彻底打乱并瘫痪整套国家配送日程。

groups.summary_en: An agent imposes geometric order, neat alignment, or intentional disruption upon physical items. Verbs describe precise physical arrangement into tidy arrays or, conversely, disturbing that spatial order.
groups.summary_zh: 整理、顺应几何方向配列物品，或打乱既有整齐秩序。
groups.desc_en: Arranging dispersed or messy items into ordered, parallel, or aesthetically clean alignment, contrasting with chaotic scattering by deliberate geometric tidiness.
groups.desc_zh: 将杂乱无序的物品整理为整洁整齐、对齐平行的秩序状态，与混乱散落相对，突出几何对齐或条理化整治。
groups.nuance_en: align: adjusting parts or principles into a straight parallel line or harmonious relation (wheels / margins / goals) · tidy: making a space neat by returning stray items to proper stations (room / desk / hair) · neaten: making small trimming adjustments to improve crispness (appearance / borders / pile) · straighten up: restoring a slouching posture or an untidy room to order (spines / apartment / shelves) · disarrange: upsetting a previously ordered layout into confusion (hair / papers / plans)
groups.nuance_zh: align: 使边缘成一直线平行对齐，或使立场高度一致 (wheels / margins / goals) · tidy: 收拾杂物归位使空间整洁清爽 (room / desk / hair) · neaten: 细微修整边缘使外观更规整齐当 (appearance / borders / pile) · straighten up: 直起身板，或全面顺带把凌乱房间归整好 (spines / apartment / shelves) · disarrange: 扰乱原本有序的布局打乱排列 (hair / papers / plans)

groups.name: Animal Vocalization & Mimicry · 动物啼鸣与仿声 (Purr, Bray, Mew)
groups.tip: 如驴般刺耳长鸣，粗厉高声啼叫

items.def_zh: （猫）发出呼噜声；（机器等）发出平稳低沉的运转声；娇声低语
items.def_en: 1. (of a cat) To make a low, continuous vibrating sound showing contentment. 2. (of an engine or machine) To make a soft, smooth, continuous sound. 3. To speak in a soft, low, pleasant voice.
items.ex_en: The contented kitten curled onto my lap and began to purr softly.
items.ex_zh: 心满意足的小猫蜷缩在我的膝盖上，开始轻柔地发出呼噜声。

items.def_zh: （动物或人发出尖细的声音）啼叫，尖声插话
items.def_en: Begin to speak or make a high-pitched cry or chirping sound
items.ex_en: Suddenly, a tiny, piping voice piped up from the back of the classroom.
items.ex_zh: 突然，教室后排传来一声尖细稚嫩的插话。

items.def_en: [I/T] make a short, high-pitched sound characteristic of small birds or insects
items.ex_en: Dozens of colorful finches chirp merrily amidst the blossoming almond branches each dawn.
items.ex_zh: 每逢清晨，成群色彩斑斓的雀鸟在盛开的杏花枝头欢快地鸣叫。

items.def_en: 1. (of a cuckoo bird) To make its characteristic two-note call. 2. To repeat something constantly like a cuckoo.
items.ex_en: Far off in the misty valley, a solitary bird began to cuckoo softly.
items.ex_zh: 在薄雾笼罩的远山幽谷中，一只孤鸟开始轻轻地咕咕啼鸣。

items.def_zh: （猫、海鸥等）咪咪叫，鸣叫；轻声哀啼
items.def_en: (of a cat, kitten, or gull) To make a characteristic high-pitched, soft cry.
items.ex_en: High above the coastal rocks, circling seagulls mew plaintively against the twilight gale.
items.ex_zh: 海岸礁石上空，盘旋的海鸥迎着薄暮狂风发出凄切的鸣叫。

items.def_zh: （蛙、鸦等）发出低哑叫声；哑声说
items.def_en: [I/T] make a rough low sound, like the sound a frog or crow makes
items.ex_en: Old bullfrogs croak mournfully by the edge of the stagnant swamp after dusk.
items.ex_zh: 黄昏之后，老牛蛙在死水沼泽边缘发出低哑凄楚的叫声。

items.def_zh: 厉声喊出，像吠叫般发出短促声音
items.def_en: (+ sth) Utter a command, order, or sound abruptly and harshly, like a dog
items.ex_en: The drill sergeant began to bark out commands to the exhausted new recruits.
items.ex_zh: 训练军士开始厉声向筋疲力尽的新兵连连吼出指令。

items.def_en: [I/T] emit a sharp, explosive cry characteristic of a dog or shout harshly
items.ex_en: Fierce watchdogs bark loudly whenever an unfamiliar vehicle enters the long private driveway.
items.ex_zh: 每当陌生车辆开进这条长长的私家车道，凶猛的看门狗就会狂吠不止。

items.def_en: utter the high-pitched, whinnying cry characteristic of a horse
items.ex_en: The restless black stallion began to neigh loudly inside the locked wooden stable.
items.ex_zh: 那匹躁动的黑种马在紧锁的木质马厩里长嘶起来。

items.def_zh: （驴）嘶叫；粗声大叫，刺耳地大笑
items.def_en: 1. (of a donkey) To make its loud, harsh cry. 2. (disapproving) To speak or laugh in a loud, harsh, and unpleasant way.
items.ex_en: Across the desolate quarry, a solitary mule lifted its head to bray hoarsely.
items.ex_zh: 在荒凉的采石场那头，一只孤零零的骡子仰起头，粗声嘶叫起来。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate the acoustic production of characteristic animal sounds, expressing particular emotional states (purr for feline contentment, bray for harsh donkey calls, mew for plaintive cat cries, cuckoo for avian mimicry/repetition), or human mimicry thereof.
groups.summary_zh: 指特定动物发出的特征性鸣叫，或人类对动物声音的生动模拟。
groups.desc_en: Emitting distinctive non-human creature sounds or metaphorically transposing their characteristic acoustic textures (low rumble, sharp cry, rasp) onto human speech, contrasting with plain speaking or shouting.
groups.desc_zh: 发出动物特有的啼鸣声，或将其声学质感（低鸣、尖叫、嘶哑等）隐喻性地移用于人类话语，区别于普通说话或喊叫。
groups.nuance_en: purr: low, vibrating sound of feline pleasure or seductive speech (cat / engine / voice) · mew: faint, high-pitched plaintive cry (kitten / gull / child) · croak: deep, hoarse, dry guttural sound (frog / raven / invalid) · bark: abrupt, explosive, aggressive vocalization or command (dog / sergeant / officer) · chirp: cheerful, shrill, rapid high note (bird / cricket / optimist)
groups.nuance_zh: purr: 猫科惬意低哼或娇媚低语 (cat / engine / voice) · mew: 细弱哀怨的幼猫啼声或低泣 (kitten / gull / child) · croak: 低沉干瘪嘶哑的蛙鸣或断续低语 (frog / raven / invalid) · bark: 粗暴短促的犬吠或厉声喝令 (dog / sergeant / officer) · chirp: 欢快清脆的鸟鸣或唧唧喳喳 (bird / cricket / optimist)

groups.name: Arrive & Reach Destination · 到达与抵达 (Arrive, Reach, Make It)
groups.tip: 终点到达或靠近

items.def_zh: 来，来到，到达（come 的过去式）
items.def_en: (past tense of come) Arrived at or moved toward a place.
items.ex_en: My older sister came home yesterday evening after completing her final semester abroad.
items.ex_zh: 我姐姐在完成了国外的最后一学期学业后，于昨晚回到了家中。

items.def_en: (informal) to arrive at a particular place or level during a journey
items.ex_en: We should hit the border town before dusk if the traffic clears up.
items.ex_zh: 如果路况转好，我们应该能在黄昏前抵达那座边境小镇。

items.def_en: 1. To arrive at a place, level, or situation. 2. To stretch out your hand or arm in order to touch or take something.
items.ex_en: The exhausted hikers finally reached the summit after six grueling hours of climbing.
items.ex_zh: 经过六个小时艰难的攀登，疲惫的徒步者终于到达了山顶。

items.def_en: To reach a destination; to come or happen.
items.ex_en: The international delegates arrived at the conference center precisely on schedule this morning.
items.ex_zh: 国际代表们今天早晨准时抵达了会议中心。

items.def_en: to arrive or appear somewhere, often unexpectedly or late
items.ex_en: Several uninvited guests turned up at the dinner party late last night.
items.ex_zh: 昨晚深夜，几位未受邀请的客人意外出现在晚宴上。
items.ex2_en: The gardener turned up the damp soil to prepare the flower bed for spring.
items.ex2_zh: 园丁翻起潮湿的泥土，为春季的花坛做准备。

items.def_en: (+ to) to manage to arrive at a place, especially under challenging circumstances
items.ex_en: Despite the torrential rain, we managed to make it to the terminal.
items.ex_zh: 尽管下着倾盆大雨，我们还是成功赶到了航站楼。

items.def_en: (+ in/at) to arrive somewhere eventually, often unexpectedly after wandering
items.ex_en: After wandering through unfamiliar streets for hours, they fetched up in an alley.
items.ex_zh: 在陌生的街道上游荡数小时后，他们最终落脚在一条小巷里。

items.def_zh: 进站，到达（指车辆或列车）
items.def_en: (of a train or vehicle) to arrive at a station, stop, or destination
items.ex_en: The commuter train pulled in right on time despite the dense fog.
items.ex_zh: 尽管大雾弥漫，那列通勤火车还是准时进站了。

items.def_en: to arrive at a place or event, especially casually or unexpectedly
items.ex_en: Jack casually showed up at the meeting an hour after it started.
items.ex_zh: 杰克在会议开始一个小时后才漫不经心地赶到。

items.def_en: to arrive in a steady, casual, or substantial flow
items.ex_en: Donations began to roll in as soon as the charity appeal aired.
items.ex_zh: 慈善募捐呼吁一播出，捐款便开始大批涌来。
