groups.nuance_en: frame: construct a cognitive narrative context to bias interpretation (argument / narrative / question) · couch: wrap sensitive meaning in euphemistic or cautious terms (terms / apology / criticism) · word: select precise phrasing to match formality or legal caution (complaint / statement / contract) · spell out: explain explicitly in granular, unmistakable detail (details / consequences / policy) · dress up: embellish plain or ugly facts to make them appealing (figures / truth / reality)
groups.nuance_zh: frame: 构建认知预设框架以引导解读走向 (argument / narrative / question) · couch: 用委婉谨慎或隐晦的辞令包裹真实含义 (terms / apology / criticism) · word: 斟酌字句以求精确或合乎法度 (complaint / statement / contract) · spell out: 极其详尽、毫无歧义地和盘托出 (details / consequences / policy) · dress up: 粉饰掩盖粗陋事实以迎合受众 (figures / truth / reality)

groups.name: Frolic & Prance · 欢蹦与雀跃 (Frolic, Gambol, Prance)
groups.tip: 欢快起舞或得意跳步

items.def_en: act in a comical, exaggeratedly silly, or high-spirited way
items.ex_en: Stop clowning around in the hallway and get back to your assigned desk.
items.ex_zh: 别在走廊里打闹耍宝了，赶快回到你指定的课桌前。

items.def_en: play in a boisterous, playful, or silly manner
items.ex_en: The bored teenagers fool around outside the closed shopping mall every Friday night.
items.ex_zh: 无聊的青少年们每个周五晚上都会在歇业的商场外瞎闹嬉戏。

items.def_zh: 欢跃，雀跃奔跳（尤指幼兽）
items.def_en: to jump or skip about happily and playfully, like a young animal
items.ex_en: Newborn lambs gamboled happily across the lush green meadows in the spring sunshine.
items.ex_zh: 初生的小羊在春日阳光下欢跃地奔跳穿过郁郁葱葱的绿草甸。

items.def_en: to play or move about in a happy, lively, and energetic way
items.ex_en: Young wild sea otters frolicked together playfully amid the cool ocean waves.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的野生海獭在清凉的海浪间欢闹嬉戏，四处蹦跳。

items.def_en: engage in rough, energetic, and boisterous play
items.ex_en: The boys were horsing around in the living room and broke a lamp.
items.ex_zh: 男孩子们在客厅里胡闹嬉戏，结果把一盏台灯打破了。

items.def_en: to skip or dance about in a lively or playful, exaggerated manner
items.ex_en: The excited children capered around the decorated evergreen tree with boundless festive joy.
items.ex_zh: 兴奋的孩子们带着无尽的节日喜悦，围着装饰一新的常青树欢欣蹦跳。

items.def_en: 1. To dance energetically to swing or rock and roll music. 2. (informal) to talk insincerely, tease, or deceive.
items.ex_en: Dressed in vintage clothes, couples jived enthusiastically across the retro dance hall floor.
items.ex_zh: 身穿复古服装的情侣们在怀旧舞池里兴致勃勃地跳着摇摆舞。

items.def_zh: 嬉闹，欢蹦乱跳；轻而易举地取胜（romp home/in）
items.def_en: 1. (+ around/about) To play, run, or jump in a lively, boisterous way. 2. (romp home/in) to win a race or contest easily.
items.ex_en: The playful golden retriever loves to romp around the yard with my daughter.
items.ex_zh: 那只贪玩的金毛寻回犬喜欢跟我女儿在院子里欢蹦乱跳地嬉闹。

items.def_zh: 昂首阔步，欢跃；（马）昂首腾跃
items.def_en: 1. To walk or dance around with exaggerated, bouncy movements to attract attention. 2. (of a horse) to move with high, springing steps.
items.ex_en: The arrogant actor pranced across the stage while demanding applause from the audience.
items.ex_zh: 那位傲慢的演员在舞台上夸张地昂首阔步，要求观众鼓掌喝彩。

items.def_zh: 跳斯卡舞（随斯卡乐节奏狂乱摆动身体跳舞）
items.def_en: To dance energetically to ska or reggae music by bending the knees and swinging the arms.
items.ex_en: Enthusiastic fans skanked wildly near the front stage during the upbeat ska performance.
items.ex_zh: 在欢快的斯卡乐演奏中，热情的歌迷们在舞台前方疯狂地跳起斯卡舞。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe lively, high-spirited, bouncing, or dance-like bodily movements expressing playfulness, arrogance, or rhythmic celebration.
groups.summary_zh: 以雀跃、跳跃或富有节奏的舞动姿态展现欢闹或得意。
groups.desc_en: Denotes high-spirited, uninhibited bodily movement characterized by playfulness, joy, or tomfoolery, contrasting with disciplined 'exercising' through erratic kinetic levity.
groups.desc_zh: 指因精力过剩或兴高采烈而做出的嬉戏狂欢与跳跃打闹，与规律‘运动’相比，强调毫无拘束的轻快滑稽与孩童般活力。
groups.nuance_en: gambol: leap and skip playfully with carefree grace (lambs / children / colts) · frolic: play lightheartedly in outdoor or buoyant celebration (dolphins / revelers / puppies) · prance: strut or leap with exaggerated, prideful, or springy steps (stallion / dancer / model) · clown around: engage in silly buffoonery or antics (kids / classmates / performers) · caper: skip or jump about in a fanciful, manic manner (goat / jester / actor)
groups.nuance_zh: gambol: 欢快轻盈地蹦跳嬉戏 (lambs / children / colts) · frolic: 阳光洒脱地纵情玩闹 (dolphins / revelers / puppies) · prance: 昂首阔步、得意洋洋地昂首跃步 (stallion / dancer / model) · clown around: 装疯卖傻、插科打诨做滑稽动作 (kids / classmates / performers) · caper: 雀跃狂跳、做出异想天开的滑稽跳步 (goat / jester / actor)

groups.name: Gesture & Posture · 体态与神情 (Expressive Bodily Signals)
groups.tip: 故作姿态以虚张声势或表态

items.def_en: to purse or tighten one's lips together into wrinkles as an expressive facial gesture
items.ex_en: The affectionate aunt told her little nephew to pucker up for a kiss.
items.ex_zh: 慈爱的姑姑叫她的小侄子瘪起小嘴来亲一下。
items.ex2_en: Sour lemon candy puckered up the curious child's mouth almost instantaneously.
items.ex2_zh: 酸柠檬糖几乎瞬间让那个好奇的孩子撅起了嘴皱起了脸。

items.def_en: to adopt an upright posture by raising one's spine and squaring shoulders
items.ex_en: The drill sergeant ordered the tired recruit to straighten up immediately during inspection.
items.ex_zh: 训练教官在检阅期间命令那名疲惫的新兵立刻挺直身子端正体态。
items.ex2_en: The teacher gently straightened up the slumping student before class started properly.
items.ex2_zh: 老师在正式上课前轻轻扶正了那位弯腰驼背的学生。

items.def_en: to lower and raise the head quickly as a sign of agreement or acknowledgment
items.ex_en: The manager nodded silently to confirm that he agreed with the proposal's terms.
items.ex_zh: 经理默默点头，表示他同意该方案中的各项条款。

items.def_zh: 耸肩（以表不知道、不在乎或无奈）；对……不予理睬（shrug off）
items.def_en: To raise and lower your shoulders to express doubt, indifference, or ignorance; ('shrug off') to dismiss something as unimportant.
items.ex_en: He simply shrugged when I asked where he had left the front keys.
items.ex_zh: 当我问他把前门钥匙落在哪儿时，他只是无所谓地耸了耸肩。

items.raw_cluster: 示意与做手势 Gesture & Signal
items.def_en: 1. To close and open one eye quickly as a signal, greeting, or sign of shared secrecy. 2. To shine with an unsteady or flashing light; twinkle.
items.ex_en: The clever uncle winked at the children to signal that dessert was coming.
items.ex_zh: 那位聪明的叔叔向孩子们眨眼使了个眼色，示意甜点马上就来。

items.def_en: To bring your eyebrows together in anger, worry, or concentration; ('frown on/upon') to disapprove of something.
items.ex_en: The strict librarian frowned visibly when loud teenagers walked into the quiet room.
items.ex_zh: 当吵闹的青少年走进安静的房间时，严厉的图书管理员明显皱起了眉头。

items.def_en: to smile in an unpleasant, smug, or self-satisfied manner
items.ex_en: The arrogant champion smirked across the table before making his winning chess move.
items.ex_zh: 那位傲慢的冠军在下出制胜一着之前，隔着棋桌露出了得意的假笑。

items.def_zh: 装模作样，故作姿态，摆姿态
items.def_en: (disapproving) To behave in an artificial or exaggerated way intended to impress, deceive, or gain advantage.
items.ex_en: Cynical politicians continue to posture endlessly rather than implement real legislative reforms.
items.ex_zh: 愤世嫉俗的政客们不断故作姿态摆架子，却不去推行切实的立法改革。

items.def_zh: 做鬼脸；因痛苦而龇牙咧嘴
items.def_en: to contort the face to express disgust, disapproval, or pain
items.ex_en: The wounded soccer player grimaced in obvious agony after twisting his left ankle.
items.ex_zh: 那名受伤的足球运动员扭伤左脚踝后，痛苦得龇牙咧嘴。

items.def_en: to frown in an angry, bad-tempered, or menacing way
items.ex_en: The angry landlord scowled darkly at the noisy tenants standing in the hallway.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的房东阴沉地怒视着站在走廊里的那些吵闹租客。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote voluntary or involuntary physical movements of the face, shoulders, or body used to project attitudes, emotions, or social signals.
groups.summary_zh: 利用面部神态、耸肩或摆姿势等肢体动作传达情绪或社会信号。
groups.desc_en: Denotes non-verbal bodily and facial kinesics signaling psychological states, status, or intent, contrasting with purely functional movement through communicational semiotics.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过脸部微表情或肢体形态传达心理反应、阶层地位或微言大义，与纯粹的生理活动相比，具有强烈的非言语符号沟通属性。
groups.nuance_en: shrug: raise shoulders to signal indifference, helplessness, or ignorance (shoulders / indifference / response) · smirk: smile in an arrogant, smug, or insolent manner (triumph / satisfaction / contempt) · posture: adopt an affected physical or moral stance for public display (politicians / candidates / rivals) · nod: tilt head to express agreement, affirmation, or greeting (approval / assent / head) · frown: knit brows to convey disapproval, confusion, or displeasure (disapproval / concentration / face)
groups.nuance_zh: shrug: 耸肩表示无奈、漠然或不知所措 (shoulders / indifference / response) · smirk: 露出自鸣得意、傲慢轻蔑的冷笑 (triumph / satisfaction / contempt) · posture: 摆架子作态，或在公众前虚张声势 (politicians / candidates / rivals) · nod: 点头致意或表示首肯认可 (approval / assent / head) · frown: 蹙眉以示不悦、疑虑或专注深思 (disapproval / concentration / face)

groups.name: Grapple & Clash · 搏斗与交锋 (Wrestle, Clash, Spar)
groups.tip: 言辞争吵到切磋性拳脚交锋

items.def_en: 1. To practice boxing with light punches without trying to hurt each other. 2. (+ with) To argue or disagree in a lively but usually harmless way.
items.ex_en: The two skilled heavyweight boxers sparred lightly for three rounds during morning training.
items.ex_zh: 两位老练的重量级拳击手在晨练中轻松切磋对练了三个回合。

items.def_zh: 小规模交火；发生小冲突
items.def_en: to fight briefly and irregularly on the fringes of a larger contest
items.ex_en: Opposing infantry reconnaissance units skirmished briefly near the dense tree line at dusk.
items.ex_zh: 敌对双方的步兵侦察分队在黄昏时分于茂密的林木线附近发生了短暂交火。

items.def_en: to engage in a short, confused, relatively disordered physical fight
items.ex_en: Security guards quickly stepped in when two angry protesters scuffled outside the building.
items.ex_zh: 当两名愤怒的抗议者在楼外扭打起来时，安保人员迅速介入。

items.def_en: engage in a close, forceful confrontation or physical grapple
items.ex_en: The two massive male stags locked horns aggressively to establish dominance over territory.
items.ex_zh: 两只体型庞大的雄鹿激烈地交锋扭打在一起，以确立领地的主导权。

items.def_en: get involved in a physical fight, skirmish, or brawl
items.ex_en: The two rowdy drunks stepped outside the bar to mix it up.
items.ex_zh: 那两个吵闹的酒鬼走出酒吧，在外面动手扭打起来。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) engage in direct physical struggle or combat against an opponent
items.ex_en: The guard had to wrestle with the intruder until backup finally arrived.
items.ex_zh: 警卫不得不与入侵者肉搏扭打，直到增援人员最终赶到。

items.def_zh: 摔跤，角力；扭打，搏斗；努力解决，竭力对付
items.def_en: 1. To fight someone by holding them and trying to push or throw them to the ground. 2. (+ with) To struggle hard to deal with or solve a difficult problem.
items.ex_en: He managed to wrestle his attacker to the muddy ground with great effort.
items.ex_zh: 他费了很大力气，终于把袭击者按倒在泥泞的地上。

items.def_en: (+ with/over) to struggle vigorously or wrestle roughly with someone
items.ex_en: Two young boys began to tussle over the deflated leather ball outside.
items.ex_zh: 两个小男孩在外面为了那个泄了气的皮球扭打争夺起来。

items.def_zh: 发生打斗，发生冲突；争执，发生分歧；（颜色、时间等）不协调，抵触
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To fight or argue violently with an opposing group or person. 2. (+ with) To disagree strongly, or to look bad together or occur at the same time.
items.ex_en: Rival protesters began to clash violently with riot police near the main gate.
items.ex_zh: 对立的抗议者开始在正门附近与防暴警察发生激烈冲突。

items.def_en: (+ with) to engage in a close, forceful struggle or hand-to-hand fight
items.ex_en: The officer had to grapple with the suspect inside the narrow alleyway.
items.ex_zh: 警官不得不在这条狭窄的小巷里与嫌疑人格斗扭打。

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote engaging in direct, forceful physical combat or competitive struggle against an opponent. They range from light, exploratory practice or skirmishing to intense, exhaustive physical locking of bodies.
groups.summary_zh: 强调双方直接的肢体搏击、对抗较量或激烈交锋。
groups.desc_en: Denotes intense physical grappling or stubborn intellectual contention between opposing forces, contrasting with formal 'competing' through grueling, tangled friction.
groups.desc_zh: 指双方势均力敌、贴身互搏或在思想层面进行旷日持久的顽强较量，与文明‘竞赛’相比，突出胶着对抗与摔跤式角力。
groups.nuance_en: wrestle with: struggle intensely with a heavy physical foe or mental burden (dilemma / conscience / problem) · lock horns: engage in an obstinate, head-to-head deadlock (factions / rivals / regulators) · spar: engage in non-lethal practice fighting or verbal banter (opponents / debate / candidate) · tussle: short vigorous contest or physical scramble for dominance (possession / control / rivals) · grapple: lock limbs in close-contact struggle to overpower (intruder / issues / crisis)
groups.nuance_zh: wrestle with: 与棘手困境、内心良知或重负苦苦相搏 (dilemma / conscience / problem) · lock horns: 针锋相对、毫不退让地陷入僵局 (factions / rivals / regulators) · spar: 拳击实战练习，或唇枪舌剑的小规模言语交锋 (opponents / debate / candidate) · tussle: 为争夺控制权而爆发的短暂激烈拉扯 (possession / control / rivals) · grapple: 抱头扭打或直面重大系统性危机 (intruder / issues / crisis)

groups.name: Grievance & Lamentation · 抱怨与哀叹 (Gripe, Moan, Lament)
groups.tip: 从日常口头抱怨到深沉悲鸣

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) complain continuously, spitefully, or petulantly about something
items.ex_en: He will constantly bitch about his low wages to anyone willing to listen.
items.ex_zh: 他总是向任何愿意听的人没完没了地抱怨自己微薄的薪水。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) complain in a feeble, irritable, or high-pitched manner
items.ex_en: The tired child started to whine about the long walk home through town.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的孩子开始哀怨嘟囔，嫌穿过小镇回家的路太漫长。

items.def_en: 1. (+ about) To complain or grumble persistently and annoyingly. 2. To make a low, prolonged sound expressing pain, grief, or pleasure.
items.ex_en: Discontented commuters continued to moan about the endless train delays all morning.
items.ex_zh: 不满的通勤族整个上午都在不停抱怨无休止的列车延误。

items.def_en: (+ about) to complain in an annoying, petulant, high-pitched tone
items.ex_en: My little brother began to whine that nobody ever played games with him.
items.ex_zh: 我弟弟开始烦人地抽搭抱怨，说从来没有人陪他玩游戏。

items.def_en: (+ about) to express persistent, irritating complaints about petty matters
items.ex_en: The workers began to gripe about the broken coffee machine in the breakroom.
items.ex_zh: 工人们开始对休息室里坏掉的咖啡机抱怨连连。

items.def_zh: 哀叹，悲叹，对……表示惋惜或不满
items.def_en: To express deep sorrow, regret, or dissatisfaction over something.
items.ex_en: The old poet would often bemoan the tragic decline of traditional craftsmanship.
items.ex_zh: 这位老诗人常常哀叹传统手工艺的悲剧性衰落。

items.def_en: utter a loud, mournful, or agonized vocalization of distress or grief
items.ex_en: The injured soldier began to cry out in terrible agony after the blast.
items.ex_zh: 爆炸过后，受伤的士兵在极度痛苦中凄厉地哀号起来。

items.def_en: (+ over/for) To express deep regret, grief, or sorrow about something.
items.ex_en: Historians lament the tragic loss of priceless ancient manuscripts in the fire.
items.ex_zh: 历史学家们对大火中无价古代手稿的惨痛损失痛惜不已。

items.def_en: (+ for/over) to feel or show deep sorrow for a serious death or loss
items.ex_en: The entire nation gathered in solemn silence to mourn for the fallen peacekeepers.
items.ex_zh: 全国人民肃穆集会，沉痛悼念牺牲的维和人员。

items.def_en: to make a long, loud cry of pain, grief, or impassioned complaint
items.ex_en: The distraught widow began to wail aloud in sudden, overwhelming anguish.
items.ex_zh: 悲痛欲绝的寡妇在突如其来的巨大痛苦中放声号啕大哭。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify vocalizing dissatisfaction, distress, or grief, escalating from trivial, petulant griping to profound, sorrowful lamentation over loss or misfortune.
groups.summary_zh: 表达不满、委屈或痛苦，从琐屑发牢骚升格至沉痛哀叹悲挽。
groups.desc_en: Denotes vocal expressions of dissatisfaction, resentment, or sorrow, progressing from petty, petulant nagging to solemn, profound grief, contrasting with objective 'critique'.
groups.desc_zh: 指宣泄不满、怨怼或悲戚的情感流露，跨度从琐碎任性的抱怨到深沉悲恸的哀悼，与客观‘批评’相比具有主观情绪宣泄性。
groups.nuance_en: whine: emit high-pitched, childish, irritating complaints (toddler / critic / grievance) · gripe: persistently grumble over petty everyday annoyances (taxes / boss / routine) · moan: give low vocal groans of pain or habitual discontent (pain / economy / conditions) · lament: mourn deeply and publicly over tragic loss or decline (fate / tragedy / passing) · bemoan: express sorrow, regret, or disappointment over an unfortunate condition (decline / fate / lack)
groups.nuance_zh: whine: 带有哭腔或孩童般的絮絮叨叨与无理取闹 (toddler / critic / grievance) · gripe: 针对琐事日复一日的私下抱怨牢骚 (taxes / boss / routine) · moan: 痛苦呻吟，或对客观状况习惯性哀声叹气 (pain / economy / conditions) · lament: 针对重大悲剧或时代衰落发出的深沉哀叹 (fate / tragedy / passing) · bemoan: 对无可奈何的现状表达惋惜与怨怼 (decline / fate / lack)

groups.name: Groom & Spruce Up · 梳理修饰与精心打扮 (Preen, Primp, Groom)
groups.tip: 精细修整趾甲或打理羽毛

items.def_zh: 梳理清洗干净，收拾体面
items.def_en: (+ sb/oneself) wash, groom, and make oneself or someone presentable
items.ex_en: Go wash your face and clean up before our dinner guests arrive tonight.
items.ex_zh: 今晚宴请的客人到来之前，快去洗把脸收拾体面些。

items.def_en: (+ sb/oneself) improve one's personal appearance, neatness, or grooming
items.ex_en: You ought to smarten up yourself before walking into that important job interview.
items.ex_zh: 去参加那场重要的求职面试之前，你应该好好整饬一下仪容。
items.ex2_en: His scruffy appearance smartened up considerably after an expensive professional haircut.
items.ex2_zh: 在做了一次昂贵的专业理发后，他邋遢的形象大为改观。

items.def_en: [T/I] Make oneself or someone else neat, smart, and presentable in dress and appearance
items.ex_en: He combed his messy hair to spruce up before meeting his new in-laws.
items.ex_zh: 他梳理了乱糟糟的头发，把自己收拾齐整去见未来的岳父母。

items.def_en: [T/I] Brush, clean, and make neat the coat, hair, or appearance of oneself or an animal
items.ex_en: The stable hand took great care to groom the thoroughbred horse each morning.
items.ex_zh: 马夫每天早晨都十分细心地给那匹纯种马刷洗梳理毛发。

items.def_en: 1. To trim, clean, and care for feet and toenails cosmetically.
items.ex_en: The technician used soothing scented oils to carefully pedicure her client's tired feet.
items.ex_zh: 美甲师使用舒缓的香精油为客户疲惫的双脚细心做足部护理。

items.def_zh: （鸟）用喙理（羽毛）；打扮，精心修饰；自鸣得意
items.def_en: 1. (of a bird) To clean and smooth its feathers with its beak. 2. To spend time making oneself look neat and attractive. 3. ('preen oneself') To feel proud or smug about oneself.
items.ex_en: The graceful swan paused on the calm riverbank to preen its white feathers.
items.ex_zh: 优雅的天鹅在平静的河岸边驻足，用喙梳理洁白的羽毛。

items.def_zh: 精心打扮，修饰（发型、容貌等）
items.def_en: 1. (+ up) To spend time carefully arranging your hair, clothes, and makeup to look neat and attractive.
items.ex_en: She spent twenty full minutes in the small restroom to primp her hair.
items.ex_zh: 她在狭小的洗手间里足足花了二十分钟精心修饰发型。

items.def_en: (+ sb/oneself) dress and groom oneself or another in a showy, meticulous way
items.ex_en: They decided to doll up the birthday girl in a sparkling pink dress.
items.ex_zh: 他们决定给小寿星盛装打扮，为她穿上一件闪亮的粉色洋装。

items.def_zh: 打扮，精心修饰（尤指对着镜子）
items.def_en: [I/T] Spend time adorning oneself or fussing with clothing and cosmetics in front of a glass
items.ex_en: The vain noblewoman paused to prink before the polished gilded parlor glass.
items.ex_zh: 爱虚荣的贵妇驻足在客厅光亮的镀金镜前，精心修饰仪容。

items.def_en: Treat, trim, and polish the fingernails and skin of the hands cosmetically
items.ex_en: The skilled salon specialist took extra time to manicure the bride's delicate nails.
items.ex_zh: 沙龙里熟练的技师特意多花了些时间为新娘修剪护理指甲。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict the deliberate, meticulous cleaning, neatening, or adorning of oneself, someone else, or an animal. Nuances emphasize self-absorbed fussing before a mirror, dedicated cosmetic maintenance of specific bodily parts, or meticulous hygienic grooming.
groups.summary_zh: 指对自身容貌、毛发或身体部位进行细致梳理、修饰或精心修饰。
groups.desc_en: Denotes tidying, beautifying, or refining the physical appearance of oneself, animals, or objects, contrasting with functional 'washing' through aesthetic polish and vanity.
groups.desc_zh: 指打理身体、宠物或环境以展现整洁、光鲜与魅力，与基础的‘洗涤清洁’相比，侧重审美修饰、仪容端庄或自恋式装扮。
groups.nuance_en: preen: clean feathers (animals) or admire and primp oneself self-consciously (feathers / vanity / mirror) · primp: make minute adjustments to hair, makeup, or attire in front of a mirror (hair / makeup / appearance) · groom: brush, clean, and maintain hygiene, or cultivate someone for a role (coat / dog / successor) · spruce up: rapidly renovate, tidy, or freshen appearance (room / house / wardrobe) · doll up: dress lavishly and apply heavy makeup for a special outing (outfit / gala / date)
groups.nuance_zh: preen: 水禽理羽，或对镜自恋顾影自怜 (feathers / vanity / mirror) · primp: 临行前对镜对发型妆容进行琐碎修整 (hair / makeup / appearance) · groom: 梳理皮毛打理仪容，或深度培养接班人 (coat / dog / successor) · spruce up: 快速打扫粉刷以焕然一新 (room / house / wardrobe) · doll up: 盛装打扮以奔赴社交晚宴 (outfit / gala / date)

groups.name: Guide & Impart Instruction · 指导与训诫 (Mentor, Preach, Tutor)
groups.tip: 传道授业与悉心指导

items.def_zh: 辅导，训练（通过针对性练习提升表现）
items.def_en: [I/T] To train and give focused instruction to someone for an exam, performance, or sport
items.ex_en: The retired champion agreed to coach the young tennis prodigy every weekend.
items.ex_zh: 这位退役冠军同意在每个周末指导训练那位年轻的网球神童。

items.def_zh: 劝告，提供心理或专业咨询
items.def_en: [I/T] To give professional advice and guidance to someone resolving personal or social difficulties
items.ex_en: The therapist was hired to counsel troubled adolescents experiencing severe anxiety and stress.
items.ex_zh: 这位治疗师受聘为承受严重焦虑与压力的困扰青少年提供专业心理辅导。

items.def_en: (+ on/about) To deliver a didactic or moralizing lecture to someone in an intrusive way
items.ex_en: My uncle loves to sermonize about discipline whenever we visit his house.
items.ex_zh: 每当我们去叔叔家拜访，他总喜欢居高临下地对我们大谈纪律。

items.def_en: (+ sb) train and instruct someone gradually into a new role or skill
items.ex_en: The veteran clerk was assigned to break in the nervous new apprentice today.
items.ex_zh: 这位老店员今天被指派去训练指导那位紧张的初学徒弟入门。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) guide someone through a process or instruction step by step
items.ex_en: Let me walk you through the new software setup process step by step.
items.ex_zh: 让我带你一步一步熟悉这款新软件的安装配置流程。

items.def_en: (+ sth) authoritatively formulate and prescribe rules, principles, or moral guidance
items.ex_en: The government has laid down strict safety guidelines for the industry.
items.ex_zh: 政府为该行业制定了严格的安全指南。

items.def_zh: 指导，辅导（提供长期建议与培训）
items.def_en: To advise, guide, and train a younger or less experienced person over a period of time.
items.ex_en: Senior engineers volunteered their time to mentor junior programmers throughout the apprenticeship.
items.ex_zh: 资深工程师在整个学徒期间自愿抽出时间指导初级程序员。

items.def_en: 1. To deliver a sermon or religious address to an audience. 2. To earnestly advocate or urge a moral standard or belief.
items.ex_en: The local pastor visited the community center to preach about compassion and forgiveness.
items.ex_zh: 当地牧师前往社区中心，向大家宣讲关怀与宽恕之道。

items.def_zh: 教授，指导（系统传授技能或知识）
items.def_en: (+ in/on) To teach someone a subject or how to do something systematically
items.ex_en: The veteran master craftsman will instruct the apprentices in traditional Japanese woodworking techniques.
items.ex_zh: 这位资深大师傅将系统地向学徒们传授传统日式木工技艺。

items.def_zh: 辅导，个别指导；当家庭教师
items.def_en: To teach or coach an individual student or small group.
items.ex_en: She earns extra income by offering to tutor university students in advanced calculus.
items.ex_zh: 她通过给大学生辅导高等微积分来赚取额外收入。

groups.summary_en: An authority or experienced figure transmits specialized knowledge, moral doctrine, or practical skills to individuals or an audience, ranging from personal guidance to pedagogical drilling or dogmatic preaching.
groups.summary_zh: 师长或专业人士对受众进行个别指导、学业辅导或教义布道。
groups.desc_en: Denotes imparting instruction, doctrine, or vocational competence, varying in tone from collaborative apprenticeship to moralizing dogmatism, contrasting with detached 'teaching'.
groups.desc_zh: 指传授技艺、职业本领或道德规训，在情境上涵盖从亦师亦友的传帮带到居高临下的布道说教，与客观的‘教学’相比情境化色彩极浓。
groups.nuance_en: mentor: guide a younger individual through sustained personal wisdom and sponsorship (protégé / youth / startup) · coach: train intensively on mechanics, tactics, or execution (athlete / executive / team) · preach: deliver moral or religious doctrine with fervent authority (gospel / moderation / virtue) · sermonize: lecture others tiresomely with unsolicited moralizing (conduct / duties / morality) · break in: accustom a novice or equipment to working conditions (recruit / shoes / horse)
groups.nuance_zh: mentor: 长期言传身教引领后辈成长 (protégé / youth / startup) · coach: 紧盯战术、短板与执行力的集训辅导 (athlete / executive / team) · preach: 庄严或狂热地布道、宣扬某种信条 (gospel / moderation / virtue) · sermonize: 居高临下令人厌烦地道德训诫 (conduct / duties / morality) · break in: 调教新手使其适应岗位，或磨合驯化新器物 (recruit / shoes / horse)

groups.name: Halt & Extinguish Flow · 压制流转与彻底终止 (Stagnate, Stanch, Deactivate, Kibosh)
groups.tip: 切断运转进程，直接戛然而止

items.def_en: to stop, check, or slow down the progress or spread of a development or disease
items.ex_en: The newly formulated medication successfully acted to arrest the spread of the infection.
items.ex_zh: 这种新配制的药物成功遏止了感染的进一步蔓延。

items.def_zh: 使停止运转，停用，使无效；解除（军事单位等）编制
items.def_en: To make something stop functioning or to deactivate a device, account, or chemical.
items.ex_en: Technicians were ordered to deactivate the nuclear cooling subsystem before the scheduled inspection.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员接到命令，在预定检查前停用核冷却子系统。

items.def_zh: 停滞，不发展；（水等）停止流动，变污浊
items.def_en: To stop developing, progressing, or flowing, and therefore become inactive or stale.
items.ex_en: Without fresh water inflow, the marsh began to stagnate under the blistering sun.
items.ex_zh: 由于缺乏活水注入，这片沼泽在酷热烈日下停止流动变浊。

items.def_en: To stop the flow of liquid, especially blood, or to bring an end to something undesirable.
items.ex_en: The field medic applied heavy pressure to stanch the deep arterial wound.
items.ex_zh: 战地医护人员施加重压，以止住那道很深的动脉伤口流血。

items.def_en: (+ sth) cut off, obstruct, or halt the supply, flow, or progress of something
items.ex_en: A severe shortage of raw materials threatened to choke off vehicle production nationwide.
items.ex_zh: 原材料的严重短缺极有可能彻底掐断全国的汽车生产链。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) stop the flow, operation, or functioning of a system or activity completely
items.ex_en: The company decided to shut down the aging factory due to mounting losses.
items.ex_zh: 由于亏损不断增加，公司决定彻底关闭这家老化的工厂。
items.ex2_en: The electrical grid shut down completely during the violent coastal windstorm.
items.ex2_zh: 在猛烈的沿海风暴期间，电网完全停止了运转。

items.def_en: (+ sth) extinguish a fire, flow, or movement forcefully and entirely
items.ex_en: Firefighters scrambled through the brush to stamp out the lingering forest embers.
items.ex_zh: 消防队员在灌木丛中奔走，合力扑灭残留的森林余火。

items.def_en: to cause something to cease burning, existing, or functioning entirely
items.ex_en: A single torrential rainstorm managed to extinguish the raging mountain wildfire overnight.
items.ex_zh: 一场倾盆暴雨在一夜之间彻底熄灭了肆虐的山火。

items.def_en: to suppress or extinguish something completely by forceful authority
items.ex_en: Armed state troopers were mobilized to quash the violent rebellion within hours.
items.ex_zh: 武装州警迅速集结，在数小时内彻底镇压了这场暴力叛乱。

items.def_zh: 使终止，破坏，废除（常用于 put the kibosh on）
items.def_en: (informal, usually in 'put the kibosh on') To put an end to something or prevent it from happening.
items.ex_en: The torrential weekend rainstorm finally put the kibosh on our planned picnic.
items.ex_zh: 周末那场倾盆暴雨彻底破坏了我们原本计划好的野餐活动。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail stopping progress, flow, or system operations, varying dramatically in force and permanence. From inert cessation of movement ('stagnate') and sealing an active fluid leak ('stanch') to formal systematic de-energizing ('deactivate') and abrupt, decisive destruction of a plan ('put the kibosh on / kibosh').
groups.summary_zh: 阻遏流动、停顿进展乃至通过果断手段强行终结事物运转。
groups.desc_en: Denotes suppressing, choking, or entirely terminating an ongoing motion, flow, or system, contrasting with gradual 'slowing' through aggressive intervention or total cessation.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过强力干涉或阻断手段切断流动、掐死萌芽或令整个系统彻底停摆，与温和的‘减速’相比，强调强力窒息性与绝对终止。
groups.nuance_en: stanch: physically stop the outward flow of blood or resources (blood / wound / losses) · choke off: strangle or constrict supply lines to starve a process (supply / credit / funding) · stamp out: crush decisively underfoot before it spreads (fire / rebellion / dissent) · extinguish: put out a flame or wipe out completely (flame / hope / debt) · arrest: halt a pathological or developmental process in its tracks (development / decline / growth)
groups.nuance_zh: stanch: 止住伤口喷涌的血液，或止住财务失血 (blood / wound / losses) · choke off: 掐断脖颈般阻断补给线或信贷流动 (supply / credit / funding) · stamp out: 跺脚踩灭星火或彻底扑灭叛乱火苗 (fire / rebellion / dissent) · extinguish: 扑灭物理火焰，或彻底断绝希望 (flame / hope / debt) · arrest: 当场扼制病理恶化或使发展进程骤停 (development / decline / growth)

groups.name: Handcraft & Shape Artfully · 精制与塑形 (Handcraft, Confect, Mold)
groups.tip: 手工精心打造精致作品

items.def_en: (+ sth) assemble or handcraft an object by carefully joining separate parts
items.ex_en: The artisan managed to piece together the delicate wooden model ship by hand.
items.ex_zh: 这位工匠亲手把精致的木制模型帆船精细地拼装完成。

items.def_en: to carve an object bit by bit by cutting small slices from wood
items.ex_en: He sat upon the porch steps to whittle a smooth pine branch.
items.ex_zh: 他坐在门廊的台阶上，用小刀削制一根光滑的松树枝。

items.def_en: To shape a material roughly in advance before final molding or finishing.
items.ex_en: The glassblower must carefully preform the molten gob before blowing the decorative vase.
items.ex_zh: 吹玻璃工人在吹制装饰花瓶之前，必须先将熔融玻璃料粗略预塑形。

items.def_en: (+ sth) shape an artistic form or object by cutting away material manually
items.ex_en: The sculptor used a sharp chisel to carve out an expressive marble face.
items.ex_zh: 雕刻家用锋利的凿子在坚硬的大理石上雕刻出一副传神的面庞。

items.def_en: (+ sth) shape, flatten, or fashion metal or material through deliberate manual striking
items.ex_en: The blacksmith worked tirelessly all morning to hammer out a curved ornamental sword.
items.ex_zh: 铁匠整个上午不知疲倦地工作，敲制出一把弯曲的装饰宝剑。

items.def_en: to create an object by pouring hot liquid material into a hollow matrix
items.ex_en: The foundery workers prepared molten bronze to cast a magnificent monumental cathedral bell.
items.ex_zh: 铸造工人们备好青铜熔液，准备倒模浇铸一座宏伟的主教堂大钟。

items.def_en: to give a particular shape or form to soft or molten substance using a mold
items.ex_en: The skilled potter used wet hands to mold the lump of wet clay.
items.ex_zh: 熟练的陶艺家用湿润的双手给那块湿黏土塑模定型。

items.def_en: To make an object skillfully by hand rather than by machine.
items.ex_en: Local craftsmen handcraft each rustic walnut chair using only ancient joinery methods.
items.ex_zh: 当地工匠仅使用古老的榫卯工艺手工制作每一把质朴的核桃木椅。

items.def_zh: 配制，精制（甜食或药品）；虚构，编造
items.def_en: (formal) To prepare, make, or assemble something, especially sweet foods or an elaborate story.
items.ex_en: The famous French pastry chef labored to confect an exquisite chocolate tower.
items.ex_zh: 这位著名的法国糕点师费尽心力精制出了一座精致的巧克力糖塔。

items.def_en: to shape or carve clay, stone, or other material into artistic forms
items.ex_en: She spent weeks trying to sculpt a realistic bust from white Italian marble.
items.ex_zh: 她花了数周时间尝试用白色意大利大理石雕塑出一尊逼真的半身像。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame emphasize the customized, artistic, or meticulous fashioning of physical materials into finished goods, ornamental pieces, or confections, contrasting industrial mass-production with manual finesse.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过双手或专用模具精工细作、调制或塑造成型的动作。
groups.desc_en: Denotes giving bespoke physical or conceptual form through deliberate manual craftsmanship, sculptural reduction, or metallurgy, contrasting with automated 'production' through artisanal labor.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过双手雕刻、锻造或塑型，赋予原材料精美实体或凝练概念，与机械化流水线‘生产’相比，突出工匠精神与由质化形的精雕细琢。
groups.nuance_en: whittle: pare away slivers of wood or reduce scale gradually (wood / staff / costs) · carve out: hollow out solid material or laboriously secure a niche (niche / career / sculpture) · hammer out: forge metal through beating, or grind out an agreement through arduous debate (deal / compromise / agreement) · cast: shape liquid substance into rigid form using a mold (bronze / mold / statue) · handcraft: produce meticulously by hand with bespoke artistry (furniture / jewelry / beer)
groups.nuance_zh: whittle: 用小刀削木雕，或逐步削减预算成本 (wood / staff / costs) · carve out: 凿刻成型，或历经艰辛在市场中开辟出立足之地 (niche / career / sculpture) · hammer out: 锤炼金属，或在艰难谈判中敲定妥协协议 (deal / compromise / agreement) · cast: 将熔融液态材料浇铸入模具成型 (bronze / mold / statue) · handcraft: 坚持手工精雕细作打造非标品 (furniture / jewelry / beer)

groups.name: Harden & Strengthen Material · 硬化与抗性加固 (Fortify, Toughen, Temper)
groups.tip: 增强结构坚固度与耐受力

items.def_en: (+ sth) strengthen or support a physical structure to prevent collapse or weakness
items.ex_en: Workers used heavy timber beams to shore up the crumbling stone retaining wall.
items.ex_zh: 工人们用沉重的粗木梁来支撑加固那座即将倒塌的石质挡土墙。

items.def_en: (+ sth) reinforce, thicken, or strengthen a material or physical framework
items.ex_en: They had to build up the earthen dike before the seasonal river flood.
items.ex_zh: 在季节性河水暴涨之前，他们必须加厚培高这条泥土堤防。
items.ex2_en: Thick layers of ice built up steadily along the frigid north ridge.
items.ex2_zh: 厚厚的冰层在寒冷的北侧山脊上持续积聚增厚。

items.def_en: (+ sth) make a material, barrier, or structure substantially thicker or stronger
items.ex_en: Engineers decided to beef up the steel frame before adding the upper floors.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们决定在加盖上部楼层之前，大幅加固底部的钢结构框架。

items.def_zh: 加固；用额外材料增强结构
items.def_en: to strengthen a physical structure or material by adding extra support or materials
items.ex_en: Builders used thick steel mesh to reinforce the building's concrete foundation slabs.
items.ex_zh: 施工人员使用厚钢筋网来加固大楼的混凝土基础底板。

items.def_en: to improve the hardness and elasticity of metal or glass by heating and cooling processes
items.ex_en: The artisan learned how to temper the carbon steel blade in cold oil.
items.ex_zh: 手艺人学会了如何在冷油中对高碳钢刀刃进行回火增韧。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make a substance rigid, tough, and resistant to wear or impact, or become so
items.ex_en: The workers left the fresh cement mixture out in the sun to harden.
items.ex_zh: 工人们把刚拌好的新鲜水泥浆留在烈日下使其硬化凝固。
items.ex2_en: Cold weather will quickly harden the molten wax into solid decorative shapes.
items.ex2_zh: 寒冷的天气会迅速使熔化的蜡硬化成坚固的装饰形状。

items.def_en: to treat an item or surface so that water cannot penetrate it
items.ex_en: You need to waterproof the outer leather hiking boots before crossing wet terrain.
items.ex_zh: 在穿越潮湿地形之前，你需要给外层的皮质登山靴做好防水处理。

items.def_en: to provide a building or defensive structure with defenses to withstand assault
items.ex_en: The military decided to fortify the frontier outpost with thick concrete blast barriers.
items.ex_zh: 军方决定用厚重的混凝土防爆屏障加固设防这座边境前哨站。

items.def_zh: （使）变坚韧，（使）坚强；使（制度、法律等）更严厉
items.def_en: 1. To make something stronger or more resilient, or to become stronger. 2. To make rules, laws, or policies stricter or harsher.
items.ex_en: Special thermal treatment is utilized to toughen the structural glass against storm winds.
items.ex_zh: 特殊的加热处理被用来增强这种建筑玻璃的韧度以抵御狂风暴雨。
items.ex2_en: Young seedlings toughen noticeably after surviving a few dry summer weeks outside.
items.ex2_zh: 幼苗在室外度过几周干旱的夏季后，明显变得更加坚韧。

items.def_zh: 对……进行防火处理，使防火
items.def_en: To treat a material, fabric, or building with substances so that it resists catching fire.
items.ex_en: City regulations require builders to fireproof all internal wooden beams before final inspection.
items.ex_zh: 城市法规要求建筑商在最终验收前对所有内部木梁做防火处理。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate physical, chemical, or structural modifications to an inanimate material, substance, or structure to make it resistant to damage, heat, stress, or attack. They differ according to the exact vulnerability addressed.
groups.summary_zh: 通过物理或化学加工提升物料、结构的坚固度、韧性或防护抗性。
groups.desc_en: Denotes imparting structural density, physical endurance, or defensive resilience to an entity, contrasting with mere enlargement (growing) or basic repair (fixing).
groups.desc_zh: 指赋予实体结构密度、物理耐受力或防御韧性，与单纯扩大体量（如增加）或基础修复（如修补）形成对比。
groups.nuance_en: reinforce: structurally strengthen via external additions or supports (concrete / defenses / arguments) · fortify: defensively augment against assault or adversity (city / border / morale) · temper: moderate hardness through heat treatment or adversity to impart resilience (steel / enthusiasm / justice) · harden: increase physical or psychological rigidity and resistance (steel / hearts / attitude) · beef up: colloquially augment bulk, firepower, or capacity (security / budget / staff) · shore up: prop up something weak or precarious from collapsing (confidence / currency / system)
groups.nuance_zh: reinforce: 通过外加构件或支护增强结构强度 (concrete / defenses / arguments) · fortify: 筑垒设防以抵御攻击或逆境 (city / border / morale) · temper: 经热处理或历练调和以获得刚韧兼备的性能 (steel / enthusiasm / justice) · harden: 提升物理或心理上的硬度与抗力 (steel / hearts / attitude) · beef up: 口语化地扩充体量、火力或规格 (security / budget / staff) · shore up: 从底部或侧面支撑濒临垮塌之物 (confidence / currency / system)

groups.name: Heavy & Dragging Gait · 拖沓与沉重步行 (Shuffle, Lumber, Limp)
groups.tip: 拖着脚步懒散挪动

items.def_zh: 一瘸一拐地往前走；蹒跚而行
items.def_en: Walk forward with an awkward, uneven gait because of pain or an injured foot or leg
items.ex_en: Nursing a sprained ankle, he managed to hobble along the quiet sidewalk slowly.
items.ex_zh: 他忍着脚踝扭伤的剧痛，在宁静的人行道上一瘸一拐地缓慢前行。

items.def_zh: 沉重缓慢地向前走；步履蹒跚地前行
items.def_en: Walk slowly with heavy, labored steps
items.ex_en: Exhausted after the hike, we continued to plod along the muddy country lane.
items.ex_zh: 徒步后疲惫不堪的我们继续沿着泥泞的乡间小道沉重缓慢地前行。

items.def_zh: 拖着脚步走；缓步向前挪动
items.def_en: Walk slowly while dragging one's feet along the ground without lifting them fully
items.ex_en: The elderly man began to shuffle along the hallway in his worn slippers.
items.ex_zh: 老人穿着破旧的拖鞋，开始沿着走廊拖着脚步缓慢向前挪动。

items.def_zh: 拖着脚走；洗（牌）；变换位置，挪动
items.def_en: 1. to walk by dragging one's feet along the ground without lifting them fully 2. to mix playing cards together in random order
items.ex_en: He had to shuffle across the icy pavement to keep from falling down.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不在结冰的人行道上拖着步子挪动，以免摔倒。

items.def_en: to walk slowly and with heavy, deliberate steps over an extended duration
items.ex_en: The tired travelers had to plod through deep snow for several agonizing hours.
items.ex_zh: 疲倦的旅行者们不得不在深雪中吃力地跋涉了难熬的数小时。

items.def_zh: 吃力地往前走；艰难跋涉
items.def_en: Continue walking slowly and with heavy effort, typically when tired or in harsh conditions
items.ex_en: Despite the blinding snowstorm, the weary mountaineers chose to trudge on toward base.
items.ex_zh: 尽管暴风雪令人目不能视，疲惫的登山队员仍选择艰难跋涉朝基地走去。

items.raw_cluster: 蹒跚与缓慢移动 Plod & Lumber
items.def_zh: 缓慢笨拙地移动；迫使承担（烦人责任等）
items.def_en: 1. to move in a slow, heavy, and awkward way 2. (informal) to burden someone with an unwanted duty or responsibility
items.ex_en: I watched the huge bear lumber slowly out of the thick mountain woods.
items.ex_zh: 我看着那只庞大的熊慢吞吞、笨拙地走出茂密的林子。

items.def_zh: 一瘸一拐地走，跛行；艰难前行
items.def_en: to walk slowly and unevenly because of an injured leg or foot; proceed with difficulty
items.ex_en: After twisting his ankle, the striker had to limp off the soccer field.
items.ex_zh: 扭伤脚踝后，前锋只得一瘸一拐地走下足球场。

items.def_en: to walk awkwardly with a dragging, slow, and uncoordinated movement of the feet
items.ex_en: The gaunt figure began to shamble down the dim corridor into darkness.
items.ex_zh: 那个憔悴的身影拖着凌乱蹒跚的步子走下昏暗的长廊，没入黑暗。

items.def_en: to walk slowly and heavily with great effort, especially when exhausted or through difficult ground
items.ex_en: We had to trudge uphill through thick mud after the heavy afternoon rain.
items.ex_zh: 午后下了一场暴雨，我们不得不踩着厚厚的稀泥吃力地上山。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe walking with compromised mechanics, characterized by scraping feet, lumbering body mass, or uneven cadence caused by pain.
groups.summary_zh: 指因身体沉重、虚弱或受伤而表现出的拖脚慢行或沉重缓行步态。
groups.desc_en: Denotes locomotion marked by laboriousness, impaired mechanics, or dragging weight, contrasting with effortless walking or agile marching.
groups.desc_zh: 指带有劳顿感、力学障碍或拖沓沉重感的步态，与轻盈的行走或敏捷的行进形成对比。
groups.nuance_en: plod: slow, heavy-footed, and doggedly persistent walking (mud / field / routine) · trudge: weary, laborious progress against physical resistance (snow / uphill / miles) · lumber: clumsy, ponderous locomotion typical of bulky bodies (bear / elephant / vehicle) · shuffle: drag the feet without lifting them fully off the ground (feet / slippers / corridor) · limp: uneven, asymmetrical walking due to injury or disability (leg / cane / sideline)
groups.nuance_zh: plod: 步履沉重、迟缓而顽强机械地迈步 (mud / field / routine) · trudge: 顶着阻力疲惫艰难地跋涉 (snow / uphill / miles) · lumber: 笨拙、体量庞大且沉重地蹒跚移动 (bear / elephant / vehicle) · shuffle: 脚掌不完全离地拖曳缓行 (feet / slippers / corridor) · limp: 因伤残导致步态高低不平地跛行 (leg / cane / sideline)

groups.name: Help & Support · 帮助与支援 (Assist, Aid, Succor, Back)
groups.tip: 伸出援手共渡难关

items.def_en: to provide moral, financial, or political backing for a person or proposal
items.ex_en: Several prominent investors agreed to back the ambitious green energy project this year.
items.ex_zh: 数位知名投资人同意在今年为这项雄心勃勃的绿色能源项目提供支持。

items.def_zh: 帮助，协助；改善，缓解；避免，忍住
items.def_en: 1. to make it easier or possible for someone to do something; assist 2. to improve or relieve a situation or condition 3. to prevent or avoid doing something
items.ex_en: A hot cup of herbal tea will help soothe your irritated throat immediately.
items.ex_zh: 一杯热草药茶会立即帮助缓解你发炎的喉咙。

items.def_en: (+ in/with) to give help or support, typically in a professional or subordinate capacity
items.ex_en: The research fellow was hired to assist the senior professor with clinical trials.
items.ex_zh: 这名助理研究员受聘协助资深教授开展临床试验。

items.def_en: to provide necessary money, food, or material relief in time of need
items.ex_en: The international agency stepped in to aid displaced families after the severe earthquake.
items.ex_zh: 大地震发生后，该国际机构介入，向流离失所的家庭提供物资援助。

items.def_en: to give immediate aid, comfort, or relief to someone in severe distress
items.ex_en: Kind volunteers arrived to succor the wounded victims in their darkest hour.
items.ex_zh: 好心的志愿者们赶来，在受伤灾民最绝望的时刻给予他们救助与抚慰。

items.def_en: (+ sb) Help someone, especially by giving them money or doing work for them
items.ex_en: Could you help out with the dishes while I prepare dinner?
items.ex_zh: 我做晚饭的时候你能帮忙洗下碗吗？

items.def_en: (+ sb) Support or encourage someone, especially in a confrontation or difficult situation
items.ex_en: My colleagues promised to back me up during the contentious board meeting today.
items.ex_zh: 同事们答应在今天充满争议的董事会会议上全力支持我。

items.def_en: Join in and help with a job, task, or collective effort
items.ex_en: If we all pitch in, we can finish clearing the yard in an hour.
items.ex_zh: 如果我们大家齐心协力，一个小时就能把院子清理干净。

items.def_en: (+ sb) Help someone get through a difficult period, usually by providing money or sustenance
items.ex_en: This emergency loan should tide the family over until next month's harvest begins.
items.ex_zh: 这笔紧急贷款应该能帮这一家人渡过难关，撑到下个月收割开始。

items.def_zh: 帮助（某人）渡过难关（常与 over 连用）；随潮漂流，顺潮行驶
items.def_en: 1. (tide someone over) to help someone get through a difficult period, especially with money or food 2. to drift or float with the tide
items.ex_en: A modest gift of grain would tide the starving villagers until spring arrived.
items.ex_zh: 少量的粮食赠予将帮助饥饿的村民们渡过难关，直到春日到来。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict providing resources, physical aid, or moral backing to relieve another's difficulty or enable them to achieve an objective. They range from ubiquitous assistance ('help', 'assist') to financial and emergency rescue ('tide over', 'succor').
groups.summary_zh: 指通过提供资源、行动或财物协助他人渡过难关或达成目标。
groups.desc_en: Denotes providing external resources, physical intervention, or moral reinforcement to relieve another's burden, contrasting with solitary execution or mere delegation.
groups.desc_zh: 指提供外部资源、物理介入或道义声援以减轻他人负担，与独自承担或单纯分派任务形成对比。
groups.nuance_en: assist: formally or systematically facilitate another's primary action (doctor / investigation / passenger) · aid: furnish substantial or institutional relief in distress (refugees / recovery / victim) · succor: promptly relieve acute suffering or mortal peril (wounded / needy / soul) · back: sponsor, endorse, or defensively support an initiative or person (candidate / proposal / claim) · pitch in: join cooperatively to share collective work (funds / effort / chores)
groups.nuance_zh: assist: 正式、系统性地作为辅助者协助主行动方 (doctor / investigation / passenger) · aid: 在危难中提供实质性或机构化的救助 (refugees / recovery / victim) · succor: 紧急驰援处于极端痛苦或危难中的对象 (wounded / needy / soul) · back: 在背后提供背书、资助或道义防御支撑 (candidate / proposal / claim) · pitch in: 众人主动参与协作以分担集体劳务 (funds / effort / chores)

groups.name: Hesitate & Refuse · 畏葸停步与退缩不前 (Balk, Blench, Funk)
groups.tip: 临阵犹豫与本能畏缩后退

items.def_en: to express hesitation, doubt, or mild objection before acting
items.ex_en: The senior diplomat felt compelled to demur at the proposed terms of negotiation.
items.ex_zh: 资深外交官觉得不得不对所提议的谈判条款提出异议与迟疑。

items.def_en: Retreat or show unwillingness to become involved or proceed with an undertaking
items.ex_en: Fearing public backlash, the developers decided to back away from the controversial proposal.
items.ex_zh: 由于害怕公众的强烈反对，开发商决定对这项饱受争议的提案畏难却步。

items.def_en: Hesitate or show reluctance to act or proceed
items.ex_en: She seemed to hold back for a moment before answering the judge's question.
items.ex_zh: 在回答法官的问题之前，她似乎犹豫迟疑了片刻。

items.def_en: (+ from) to avoid doing something because you are nervous or frightened
items.ex_en: Introverted students often shy away from speaking during large group discussion sessions.
items.ex_zh: 性格内向的学生在大组讨论环节常常会因胆怯而退缩避开发言。

items.def_en: (+ from) to show unwillingness to do something because it is frightening or unpleasant
items.ex_en: A dedicated doctor must never shrink from performing arduous duties during emergencies.
items.ex_zh: 一名恪尽职守的医生在紧急关头绝不能畏缩逃避艰巨的职责。
items.ex2_en: Extreme heat will shrink the delicate wool sweater if you wash it.
items.ex2_zh: 如果清洗这件娇贵的羊毛衫，极高的热度会使其缩水。

items.def_zh: 畏缩不前；因顾虑而拒绝
items.def_en: (+ sth) Hesitate or refuse stubbornly to proceed with a course of action
items.ex_en: Conservative consumers usually balk at the excessive subscription prices demanded by modern apps.
items.ex_zh: 保守的消费者通常对现代软件索要的高昂订阅费犹豫不决、望而却步。

items.def_zh: 畏避；回避（困难或危险的事）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Reluctantly hesitate or decline to do something because of fear, distaste, or lack of confidence
items.ex_en: True leaders do not shrink from difficult decisions during times of national peril.
items.ex_zh: 真正的领导者在国家危难之时绝不会回避艰难的抉择。

items.def_zh: 畏缩不前，犹豫推诿；阻止，挫败
items.def_en: 1. (+ at) To hesitate and refuse to accept or do something difficult, unpleasant, or expensive. 2. To prevent someone from doing what they intended; thwart.
items.ex_en: Many small business owners balk at taking on substantial debt during recessions.
items.ex_zh: 许多小企业主在经济衰退期间都畏缩不前，拒绝承担大笔债务。

items.def_en: (+ at/from) To flinch, draw back, or turn pale suddenly from fear, pain, or shock.
items.ex_en: The veteran soldier did not blench at the terrifying sound of incoming shells.
items.ex_zh: 这位老兵在来袭炮弹那骇人的呼啸声前毫无畏缩退却之意。

items.def_en: (informal) to avoid doing something challenging or terrifying because of cowardice
items.ex_en: He promised to confront his boss, but then funked it at the last minute.
items.ex_zh: 他答应过要去跟老板对质，却在最后一刻临阵退缩了。

groups.summary_en: An agent halts abruptly, winces inwardly, or obstinately refuses to proceed due to fear, moral qualms, or intimidation. Verbs emphasize moral hesitance, mental recoiling, or balking at an obstacle.
groups.summary_zh: 出于畏难、胆怯或道德顾忌而在关键节点止步不前、临阵退缩。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an abrupt arrest of motion or refusal to advance triggered by fear, distaste, or scrupulous doubt, contrasting with neutral pausing or planned cessation.
groups.desc_zh: 指因恐惧、嫌恶或顾虑而骤然止步或退缩不前，与中性的停顿或计划性中止形成对比。
groups.nuance_en: balk: stop short and obstinately refuse to proceed (horse / prospect / cost) · shrink from: recoil aversionally or cowardly from an unpleasant duty (responsibility / violence / challenge) · shy away: avoid commitment or contact out of timidity or wariness (publicity / conflict / commitment) · demur: raise polite, principled objections or voice hesitation (invitation / proposal / verdict) · back away: physically retreat or tactically disengage from a confrontation (threat / deal / edge)
groups.nuance_zh: balk: 骤然止步并顽固拒绝继续推进 (horse / prospect / cost) · shrink from: 因畏难、嫌恶或怯懦而本能退避 (responsibility / violence / challenge) · shy away: 因羞怯、戒备或警惕而刻意回避 (publicity / conflict / commitment) · demur: 委婉、讲究原则地提出异议或表示保留 (invitation / proposal / verdict) · back away: 物理后退或在对峙中策略性抽身 (threat / deal / edge)

groups.name: Hesitate & Stammer · 犹疑吞吐与支吾 (Hesitate, Waver, Hem and Haw)
groups.tip: 言语支吾吞吐拿不定主意

items.def_en: (+ sth) hesitate, pause, and struggle awkwardly to find the right words
items.ex_en: Nervous on stage, the novice speaker began to fumble for the right words.
items.ex_zh: 在台上感到紧张的新手演讲者开始语塞，支支吾吾地寻找合适的措辞。

items.def_en: to hesitate extensively and avoid giving a direct answer through vague noises and pauses
items.ex_en: Stop trying to hem and haw, and just tell us your final answer.
items.ex_zh: 别再吞吞吐吐支支吾吾了，直接告诉我们你的最终答复。

items.def_en: (+ over/through) to make frequent speech errors or pauses while trying to speak
items.ex_en: The flustered witness began to stumble over his words under harsh cross-examination.
items.ex_zh: 在严厉的交叉盘问下，心慌意乱的证人讲话开始结巴打绊。

items.def_zh: 犹豫吞吐，支吾其词（常作 hem and haw）；（使牲口）向左转
items.def_en: To hesitate and speak unclearly, especially in the phrase 'hem and haw'.
items.ex_en: The politician began to hem and haw when pressed about the leaked budget.
items.ex_zh: 当被追问泄露的预算案细节时，那位政客开始吞吞吐吐、支吾其词。

items.def_zh: 结结巴巴地说；口吃吞吐
items.def_en: [I/T] to speak with involuntary pauses and rapid repetitions of syllables, often from nervousness
items.ex_en: Whenever he feels intimidated, he begins to stammer uncontrollably in front of people.
items.ex_zh: 每当感到受威吓时，他就会在人前难以自控地结结巴巴起来。

items.def_en: (+ sth) falter or hesitate in vocal delivery due to emotional stress or reluctance
items.ex_en: Overcome with sorrow, she had to choke back her grief before continuing her statement.
items.ex_zh: 悲痛欲绝的她只得哽咽着忍住悲伤，然后才继续作陈述。

items.def_en: (+ sth) utter words haltingly with involuntary pauses or repeated syllables
items.ex_en: Terrified by the thunder, the child could only stammer out a brief apology.
items.ex_zh: 被雷声吓坏的孩子只能结结巴巴地吐出一句简短的道歉。

items.def_en: to lose strength or confidence in speaking, causing one's voice to hesitate or waver
items.ex_en: The young witness's voice began to falter as painful memories resurfaced in court.
items.ex_zh: 当痛苦的记忆在法庭上再次浮现时，年轻证人的声音开始颤抖发涩。

items.def_zh: 犹豫不决，摇摆；摇晃，摇曳，颤抖
items.def_en: 1. To hesitate between choices or be unable to make a decision. 2. To flicker, tremble, or shake unsteadily.
items.ex_en: He began to waver between accepting the job offer or continuing his research.
items.ex_zh: 在接受这份工作录用与继续做研究之间，他开始犹豫摇摆起来。

items.def_zh: 说模棱两可的话；含糊推诿
items.def_en: to speak ambiguously or noncommittally in order to mislead or avoid commitment
items.ex_en: The slippery spokesperson tried to equivocate rather than address the direct corruption allegations.
items.ex_zh: 那位圆滑的发言人试图含糊其辞，而不是直接正面回应腐败指控。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe vocal hesitation, pausing, or faltering delivery in speech caused by indecision, nervousness, or evasion, often involving pauses, filler sounds, or repeated syllables.
groups.summary_zh: 指说话时因犹豫、紧张或推诿而吞吞吐吐、支吾停顿。
groups.desc_en: Denotes vocal vacillation, awkward pauses, or stumbling articulation caused by internal indecision, embarrassment, or evasiveness, contrasting with fluent speech or physical muteness.
groups.desc_zh: 指因内心犹疑、尴尬或闪烁其词导致的言语支吾吞吐、节律中断，与流利表达或生理失语形成对比。
groups.nuance_en: hem and haw: stall, hedge, and avoid giving a direct answer (indecision / question / committee) · stammer: spasmodically repeat or pause on syllables due to nervousness (apology / excuse / fear) · falter: lose momentum, pitch, or steadiness mid-speech from sudden hesitation (voice / courage / words) · stumble: trip verbally over syllables or lose coherence (line / phrase / tongue) · fumble for: grasp awkwardly and hesitantly for expression (words / answer / phrase)
groups.nuance_zh: hem and haw: 吞吞吐吐、支吾其词以拖延或回避正面答复 (indecision / question / committee) · stammer: 因神经紧张等情绪剧烈波动而抽搐性卡顿、重音 (apology / excuse / fear) · falter: 话语中途因气馁或犹疑而动摇、断续 (voice / courage / words) · stumble: 出现口误磕绊或失去言语连贯性 (line / phrase / tongue) · fumble for: 笨拙犹疑地在脑中摸索措辞 (words / answer / phrase)

groups.name: Hoard & Stockpile · 囤积与储备 (Hoard, Stockpile, Stash)
groups.tip: 持续积攒聚集大量物资

items.def_en: (+ sth) Put something away in a container or storage space until needed
items.ex_en: We will pack away the thick winter blankets until the weather cools down.
items.ex_zh: 我们会把厚厚的冬毯收存起来，直到天气再次转凉。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Accumulate or cause something to accumulate into a large quantity
items.ex_en: Unanswered emails continued to pile up in her inbox throughout the busy week.
items.ex_zh: 在忙碌的一周里，未回复的电子邮件在她的收件箱中不断积压成堆。
items.ex2_en: The careless warehouse staff piled up heavy boxes against the emergency exit.
items.ex2_zh: 粗心的仓库员工将沉重的箱子堆放在了紧急出口旁。

items.def_en: to save or put away money or valuables for the future, often secretly
items.ex_en: He managed to salt away a modest nest egg for his quiet retirement.
items.ex_zh: 他设法悄悄存下了一小笔私房钱，供自己安稳养老。

items.def_en: to store or hide money or goods in a secure place for future use
items.ex_en: She managed to squirrel away a portion of her paycheck each single month.
items.ex_zh: 她设法把每个月的薪水都攒下一部分偷偷存起来。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Store or hide something away in a safe, secluded place
items.ex_en: The thief managed to stash away the stolen jewelry inside a hollow floorboard.
items.ex_zh: 小偷设法把盗来的珠宝藏匿在了一块空心的地板下面。

items.def_en: Acquire and store a large quantity of something for future use
items.ex_en: Local residents rushed to stock up on bottled water before the massive hurricane.
items.ex_zh: 在强飓风来临之前，当地居民纷纷涌去大量囤购瓶装水。

items.def_en: (+ away) to store something secretly and safely in a hidden place
items.ex_en: He chose to stash the emergency cash inside a secret compartment behind the painting.
items.ex_zh: 他选择将应急现金暗中藏匿在挂画后面的秘密夹层里。

items.def_en: to accumulate a large amount of wealth, resources, or items over time
items.ex_en: Over three decades, the visionary entrepreneur managed to amass an extraordinary personal fortune.
items.ex_zh: 三十年来，这位有远见的企业家成功积聚了惊人的巨额个人财富。

items.def_en: 1. To collect and store a large reserve of goods, supplies, or weapons for future use.
items.ex_en: The government decided to stockpile essential medical supplies in preparation for potential crises.
items.ex_zh: 政府决定储备大量的关键医疗物资，以防备可能出现的危机。

items.def_en: 1. To collect and store large amounts of food, money, or items secretly, often beyond one's immediate needs.
items.ex_en: During the embargo, some greedy merchants tried to hoard fuel for huge profits.
items.ex_zh: 在禁运期间，一些贪婪的商人企图囤积燃油以牟取暴利。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate collecting, accumulating, and storing large quantities of supplies, valuables, or resources—often excessively, secretly, or in anticipation of future scarcity.
groups.summary_zh: 出于备荒或贪婪而大量聚敛、贮存物资或隐匿财物。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the deliberate, surreptitious, or prudential accumulation and concealment of goods for future scarcity, contrasting with ordinary buying or transient holding.
groups.desc_zh: 指为应对短缺而刻意、隐秘或谨慎地聚敛并藏匿物资，与常规采买或暂时保管形成对比。
groups.nuance_en: hoard: greedily amass and guard supplies excessively beyond need (gold / grain / supplies) · stockpile: systematically build up a designated reserve for future crises (weapons / medicine / fuel) · stash: hastily or secretly hide valuables in a safe spot (cash / loot / documents) · squirrel away: frugally hoard bit by bit in small, hidden caches (savings / food / earnings) · amass: accumulate grand, impressive quantities over time (wealth / fortunes / data)
groups.nuance_zh: hoard: 贪婪、过度囤积并戒备性守匿物资 (gold / grain / supplies) · stockpile: 为防范未来危机系统化建立官方或战略储备 (weapons / medicine / fuel) · stash: 将贵重或违禁之物匆匆隐匿于安全秘处 (cash / loot / documents) · squirrel away: 如松鼠般细水长流、零星藏匿备用积蓄 (savings / food / earnings) · amass: 历经时日积聚极其庞大客观的规模 (wealth / fortunes / data)

groups.name: Hold & Grasp · 抓握与持有 (Palm, Grip, Seize)
groups.tip: 从轻握掌持到用力握紧抓牢

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Keep one's hands firmly gripping or supporting something
items.ex_en: Be sure to hold on to the railing while descending the steep stairs.
items.ex_zh: 走下陡峭的台阶时，务必要牢牢抓住扶手。

items.def_zh: 将……藏于手心；偷偷拿走（或藏匿）；用手抚弄
items.def_en: 1. To conceal or hold something in the palm of the hand, especially in a sleight of hand or theft. 2. To touch, hold, or handle with the palm.
items.ex_en: The sly conjurer managed to palm the gold coin right before our eyes.
items.ex_zh: 那个狡黠的魔术师就在我们眼皮底下偷偷将金币藏在了手心。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Seize or take hold of someone or something quickly and firmly
items.ex_en: The startled swimmer managed to grab on to the wooden edge of the raft.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的游泳者设法一把猛然抓住了木筏的边缘。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Hold something firmly or tenaciously with the hands
items.ex_en: You must hang on to the safety rope tightly during this fierce squall.
items.ex_zh: 在这场强狂风中，你必须紧紧抓牢安全绳不放。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Take hold of and grip firmly onto someone or something
items.ex_en: The frightened kitten managed to latch on to my woolen jacket with its claws.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的小猫用爪子死死攀住我的羊毛夹克不放。

items.def_en: to take a firm, steady hold of something with the hand
items.ex_en: He leaned forward to grasp the bronze door handle with his trembling hand.
items.ex_zh: 他倾身上前，用颤抖的手紧紧握住了铜门把手。

items.def_zh: 抓住，夺取；没收，扣押；捉拿，逮捕
items.def_en: 1. To take hold of suddenly, forcefully, or violently; grab. 2. To take official possession of something by legal authority.
items.ex_en: Customs agents acted swiftly to seize the illegal cargo at the international border.
items.ex_zh: 海关官员在国际边境处迅速采取行动，依法查扣了这批非法货物。

items.def_zh: 紧握，抓牢；吸引，强烈影响；控制
items.def_en: 1. To hold or grasp tightly and firmly. 2. To capture the interest or attention of someone intensely; to take a firm hold on emotionally.
items.ex_en: The terrified passenger continued to grip the steering wheel with white, rigid knuckles.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的乘客指节发白、僵硬，继续死死握紧方向盘。

items.def_en: [I/T] to grasp or hold someone or something tightly, often with anxiety, eagerness, or fear
items.ex_en: The scared child would clutch his mother's skirt tightly whenever strangers approached them.
items.ex_zh: 每当有陌生人靠近，害怕的孩子就会紧紧攥住妈妈的裙子。

items.def_en: to seize or grab something quickly, abruptly, or aggressively
items.ex_en: The brazen pickpocket tried to snatch the tourist's handbag and run through the crowd.
items.ex_zh: 那个猖獗的扒手企图夺走游客的手提包，然后穿过人群逃跑。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame cover manual contact and physical control over an object using the hands. They range in force and speed from stealthy handling ('palm') to steady, firm clutching ('grip') and sudden, forceful apprehension ('seize', 'snatch').
groups.summary_zh: 指用手操控、抓取或牢牢握持，从隐秘按抚递进至强力抓夺。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the application of mechanical manual force to seize, clasp, or retain physical possession, arranged across axes of control and suddenness, contrasting with passive touching or releasing.
groups.desc_zh: 指施加机械性手部握力以抓取、紧扣或保持对实体的控制，按突发性与控制强度区分，与轻触或释放形成对比。
groups.nuance_en: grip: hold firmly with sustained, strong friction and tenacity (handle / racket / hand) · grasp: enclose firmly with fingers, implying complete manual purchase (hand / throat / opportunity) · seize: take hold of suddenly, forcibly, and assertively (weapon / power / initiative) · palm: conceal or manipulate an object within the hollow of the hand (coin / card / ball) · hang on to: retain tenaciously against pulling forces or loss (railing / rope / possession)
groups.nuance_zh: grip: 以高摩擦力和持续张力死死握牢 (handle / racket / hand) · grasp: 手指完全合拢形成充沛掌控 (hand / throat / opportunity) · seize: 猝不及防地猛然夺取、强行扣压 (weapon / power / initiative) · palm: 用手心掩盖、偷换或暗中操控 (coin / card / ball) · hang on to: 顶着拉扯力或丧失风险紧抓不放 (railing / rope / possession)

groups.name: Hope & Wish · 希望与期盼 (Long, Yearn, Aspire, Crave)
groups.tip: 对未来美好事物的心怀向往

items.def_en: (+ for/to do) to have an intense, sustained desire for something distant or missing
items.ex_en: Exiled for many years, the lonely poet continued to long for his native land.
items.ex_zh: 流亡多年，孤独的诗人依然深切渴盼着回到自己的故土。

items.def_en: to want something to happen and reasonably believe that it is possible
items.ex_en: We sincerely hope that the delicate peace talks will yield fruitful results soon.
items.ex_zh: 我们真诚地期盼这场微妙的和谈很快能结出富有成效的硕果。

items.def_zh: 希望，想要，愿望；祝愿，祈愿
items.def_en: 1. to want something to happen or be true, even if it is unlikely 2. to express a hope or desire for someone's well-being or success
items.ex_en: I sometimes wish I could turn back time and correct those foolish errors.
items.ex_zh: 我有时多么希望自己能够时光倒流，去修正那些愚蠢的过失。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Yearn intensely for or want something very much
items.ex_en: She longed for the peaceful days she had spent in the countryside.
items.ex_zh: 她十分渴望能重温曾经在乡村度过的宁静岁月。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Feel a persistent, strong craving or yearning for something
items.ex_en: Tired of corporate life, he began to hanker after a simple cabin in mountains.
items.ex_zh: 厌倦了职场生活的他，开始热切向往山间一栋简朴的林中木屋。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Feel intensely sad while missing and wishing deeply for someone or something
items.ex_en: Locked in the lonely tower, the sorrowful captive would pine for her distant home.
items.ex_zh: 深锁在孤塔之中的悲伤囚徒，日日苦苦思念着她遥远的家园。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Await a future event with anticipation and pleasure
items.ex_en: We are all looking forward to our annual summer vacation.
items.ex_zh: 我们大家都十分期盼一年一度的暑假。

items.def_en: to feel an overpowering, visceral appetite or desire for something
items.ex_en: After hiking all day without water, the dry hikers began to crave cold drinks.
items.ex_zh: 在缺水的情况下徒步一整天后，口渴的行者极度渴求冰凉的饮品。

items.def_en: (+ to/to do) to direct one's hopes and ambitious efforts toward a noble goal
items.ex_en: Many young, ambitious musicians aspire to perform on famous international concert stages someday.
items.ex_zh: 许多有抱负的青年音乐家立志有朝一日登上国际知名音乐厅的舞台。

items.def_en: (+ for/to do) to feel an aching, poignant desire for something hard to attain
items.ex_en: In the cold winter night, she seemed to yearn for the comforting touch of spring.
items.ex_zh: 在清冷的冬夜里，她似乎无比热切地怀想着春日那抚慰人心的抚触。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on desire and anticipation for a specific future outcome or unfulfilled state. While 'hope' carries realistic expectation of fulfillment and 'wish' often leans toward hypotheticals or regrets, richer verbs encode yearning and aspiration.
groups.summary_zh: 表达对未来可能实现或难以触及之事的向往、期盼与渴求心理。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an intense, emotionally invested yearning directed toward an absent or idealized desire, contrasting with idle wishing or immediate demands.
groups.desc_zh: 指针对未获得或理想化客体投射的强烈情感期盼，与随意的空想或当下索取形成对比。
groups.nuance_en: long: suffer a deep, enduring, heartfelt desire for what is distant (peace / home / touch) · crave: suffer an urgent, visceral, almost physical appetite (attention / sugar / drugs) · yearn: experience a tender, deeply wistful longing tinged with melancholy (freedom / past / acceptance) · pine for: waste away emotionally longing for a lost or unattainable love (homeland / lover / youth) · hanker after: harbor a persistent, restless itch or recurring whim (adventure / power / luxury)
groups.nuance_zh: long: 对遥不可及或久违之物抱有持久深沉的渴盼 (peace / home / touch) · crave: 体验近乎生理本能、焦渴难耐的剧烈嗜求 (attention / sugar / drugs) · yearn: 怀抱伴随感伤、惆怅的温存向往 (freedom / past / acceptance) · pine for: 因思念失去或无法企及之物而憔悴消沉 (homeland / lover / youth) · hanker after: 周期性浮现躁动难耐的渴望或念想 (adventure / power / luxury)

groups.name: Imagine & Envision · 想象与构想 (Conceive, Picture, Visualize)
groups.tip: 在脑中构想未来或画面

items.def_en: 1. To imagine or form a mental image of something. 2. To represent or show someone or something in a picture, painting, or description.
items.ex_en: I can easily picture the quaint cottage nestled deep inside that quiet valley.
items.ex_zh: 我可以轻松地想象出那座坐落在静谧山谷深处的古雅小屋。

items.def_en: 1. To imagine something that you would very much like to happen. 2. To experience images, thoughts, or emotions during sleep.
items.ex_en: Many ambitious young musicians dream of performing at prestigious international concert halls.
items.ex_zh: 许多有抱负的年轻音乐家梦想着在知名国际音乐厅登台演出。

items.def_en: 1. To form a mental picture or concept of something in your mind. 2. To believe or suppose that something is the case.
items.ex_en: You cannot imagine the tremendous relief we felt after receiving the test results.
items.ex_zh: 你无法想象我们在收到检测结果后感到的巨大解脱。

items.def_zh: 在脑海中浮现出，构想出
items.def_en: (+ sth) evoke or form a clear mental picture or sensory impression in the mind
items.ex_en: The distinct aroma of roasting coffee conjured up fond memories of my hometown.
items.ex_zh: 烤咖啡独特的香气在脑海中唤起了我对家乡的美好记忆。

items.def_en: (+ sth) conceive an inventive, elaborate, or unusual mental scenario or plan
items.ex_en: Leave it to Sarah to dream up such a wild and eccentric fundraising plan.
items.ex_zh: 也就萨拉能想出如此离奇古怪的募捐计划。

items.def_zh: 在大脑中回忆起，勾勒出
items.def_en: (+ sth) summon an image or memory into conscious contemplation
items.ex_en: The elderly veteran paused to call up painful memories from his harrowing wartime service.
items.ex_zh: 这位老兵停顿了一下，努力在脑海中回忆起艰难战役里的痛苦往事。

items.def_en: (+ of) to form an idea, concept, or plan in the mind
items.ex_en: Philosophers struggled to conceive of a society devoid of any systemic moral principles.
items.ex_zh: 哲学家们难以设想出一个完全不存在任何体系化道德原则的社会。

items.def_en: 1. To imagine or picture a future situation, plan, or possibility in your mind.
items.ex_en: Urban planners envision a greener metropolis powered entirely by reliable renewable energy sources.
items.ex_zh: 城市规划者设想未来建起一座完全由可靠可再生能源驱动的绿色大都市。

items.def_zh: 想象，设想；使显现，使形象化
items.def_en: 1. To form a clear mental picture of something. 2. To make something visible to the eye.
items.ex_en: Athletes often visualize their precise movements before stepping onto the competitive track.
items.ex_zh: 运动员在踏上赛道前，往往会在脑海中清晰设想自己的精准动作。

items.def_en: to develop an abstract concept, model, or systemic mental formulation of something
items.ex_en: The research team struggled to conceptualize the complex economic relationship into a working model.
items.ex_zh: 研究小组难以将复杂的经济关系概念化并建立可行的分析模型。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote generating internal sensory imagery, anticipating future possibilities, or mentally contemplating scenarios not currently perceived through the senses.
groups.summary_zh: 在大脑中构建形象、在心理上预想未来情形或对未见之物形成具体意象。
groups.desc_en: Denotes forming an internal mental image, scenario, or creative construct of that which is not physically present, contrasting with sensory perception or abstract logical calculation.
groups.desc_zh: 指在心智内部构建非当前所见的意象、场景或创造性构想，与即时感官知觉或抽象数理推演形成对比。
groups.nuance_en: conceive: originate an abstract idea, systematic plan, or creative seed (plan / baby / system) · envision: project a vivid, future-oriented possibility or ideal scenario (future / society / success) · picture: form a clear, static, or descriptive visual image in the mind (scene / face / outcome) · conjure up: invoke or evoke an illusion or vivid memory out of nothing (image / memory / ghost) · dream up: invent something fanciful, eccentric, or unrealistic (scheme / excuse / invention)
groups.nuance_zh: conceive: 孕育抽象思想、系统方案或创意雏形 (plan / baby / system) · envision: 前瞻性地构想未来的蓝图或可能性 (future / society / success) · picture: 在脑海中形成逼真清晰的静态或场景画面 (scene / face / outcome) · conjure up: 如施法般凭空召唤出逼真记忆或意象 (image / memory / ghost) · dream up: 凭天马行空的想象编造奇想或借口 (scheme / excuse / invention)

groups.name: Imitate & Emulate · 模仿与效法 (Imitate, Emulate, Parody)
groups.tip: 以他人为榜样学习效法模仿

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) fashion one's behavior, style, or work in direct emulation of another
items.ex_en: The young entrepreneur modeled his new management style on his mentor's successful framework.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻的企业家仿照导师的成功管理架构确立了自己的管理风格。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) mock or parody someone or something by exaggeratedly imitating them
items.ex_en: The late-night comedy show brilliantly sent up the politician's overly dramatic campaign speeches.
items.ex_zh: 深夜喜剧节目极尽夸张地调侃戏仿了那位政客过于戏剧化的竞选演说。

items.def_en: (+ sb) mimic or caricature someone's voice, gestures, or mannerisms for amusement
items.ex_en: The comedian loved to take off local news anchors during his lively standup routine.
items.ex_zh: 这位喜剧演员喜欢在热闹的单口脱口秀中惟妙惟肖地戏仿当地新闻主播。

items.def_zh: （滑稽、讽刺地）模仿；对……进行滑稽模仿
items.def_en: To copy the style of a person, writer, or piece of art in an exaggerated way to make people laugh.
items.ex_en: The satirist published a witty novel that parodied traditional nineteenth-century Gothic thrillers.
items.ex_zh: 这位讽刺作家出版了一部诙谐小说，滑稽戏仿了19世纪传统的哥特惊悚作品。

items.def_en: to copy someone's speech, behavior, or style in an unoriginal or clumsy way
items.ex_en: The junior clerk constantly aped his manager's haughty gestures around the office.
items.ex_zh: 那个初级文员在办公室里总是笨拙地盲目模仿经理傲慢的举止。

items.def_zh: （戏谑或惟妙惟肖地）摹仿，学样
items.def_en: to copy the way someone speaks, moves, or behaves, especially to entertain
items.ex_en: The clever mimic amused the party guests by perfectly matching the professor's accent.
items.ex_zh: 那个聪明的模仿者惟妙惟肖地学着教授的口音，逗乐了聚会上的客人。

items.def_en: 1. To copy someone's speech, behavior, or style. 2. To copy something as a model.
items.ex_en: Young children naturally imitate their parents' daily habits and everyday conversational phrases.
items.ex_zh: 年幼的孩子会自然而然地模仿父母的日常生活习惯和日常对话用语。

items.def_zh: 用手势示意；通过哑剧动作表演；模拟动作
items.def_en: To use movements of your body and hands without speaking to tell a story or pretend to do something.
items.ex_en: The expressive street artist mimed opening a locked door using subtle hand gestures.
items.ex_zh: 这位富有表现力的街头艺人用微妙的手势通过哑剧动作模拟开锁的动作。

items.def_zh: 效仿，努力赶上；（计算机）仿真
items.def_en: 1. To try to do something as well as or better than someone else by imitating them. 2. (computing) to imitate the function of another system.
items.ex_en: The aspiring scholar strove tirelessly to emulate the groundbreaking achievements of her forebears.
items.ex_zh: 这位有抱负的学者孜孜不倦地努力效法先辈所取得的开创性成就。

items.def_zh: 以讽刺画法夸张表现，滑稽地歪曲模仿
items.def_en: to represent someone in a way that emphasizes their distinctive traits comically
items.ex_en: The editorial column caricatured the pompous senator as an out-of-touch Victorian aristocrat.
items.ex_zh: 社论专栏极尽夸张地将那位自命不凡的参议员刻画成脱离现实的维多利亚时代贵族。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe copying the appearance, speech, behavior, or style of someone or something, either to learn from them, mock them, or reproduce their characteristics.
groups.summary_zh: 临摹、模仿或抄袭言行举止与风格，旨在学习、再现或讽刺。
groups.desc_en: Denotes copying, reproducing, or taking inspiration from another's behavior, style, or performance, ranging from respectful emulation to mocking caricature, contrasting with creating de novo.
groups.desc_zh: 指模仿、再现他人举止、风格或行为，跨度从致敬效法到讽刺丑化，与独立原创形成对比。
groups.nuance_en: imitate: reproduce actions, voice, or style closely as a model (master / behavior / style) · emulate: strive consciously to equal or surpass an admirable exemplar (hero / success / model) · mimic: copy voice, gestures, or mannerisms accurately, often for entertainment (accent / bird / teacher) · ape: uncritically, clumsily, or absurdly duplicate someone's manner (mannerisms / superiors / elite) · parody: satirically exaggerate stylistic traits for comedic critique (genre / politician / song)
groups.nuance_zh: imitate: 遵循样本以复制其声调、姿态或风格 (master / behavior / style) · emulate: 出于景仰而见贤思齐，力求赶超楷模 (hero / success / model) · mimic: 惟妙惟肖地摹仿声音动作以取乐或表演 (accent / bird / teacher) · ape: 笨拙、缺乏辨别力且滑稽可笑地东施效颦 (mannerisms / superiors / elite) · parody: 极尽夸张某一风格特征进行戏谑嘲弄 (genre / politician / song)

groups.name: Impact & Violently Strike · 碰撞与冲击 (Collide, Cannon, Thud)
groups.tip: 物体猛烈相撞发生冲击

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ against/into) to strike lightly or accidentally against an obstacle
items.ex_en: Distracted by his smartphone, the tourist bumped against a heavy concrete lamp post.
items.ex_zh: 由于看手机分心，那名游客不小心撞到了粗重的混凝土路灯柱上。

items.def_zh: 砰的一声撞击，沉重地撞击（或掉落）
items.def_en: 1. (+ into/against/onto) To hit or fall onto a surface with a dull, heavy sound.
items.ex_en: The heavy wooden chest fell off the truck and thudded onto the pavement.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的木箱从卡车上掉落，砰的一声重重砸在人行道上。

items.def_en: (+ sth) collide violently with an entity or barrier, producing damage or loud noise
items.ex_en: The speeding driver lost complete control and crashed into a sturdy roadside barrier.
items.ex_zh: 那辆超速行驶的汽车完全失控，猛烈撞上了坚固的路边护栏。

items.def_en: to crash forcefully into someone or something with relentless forward momentum
items.ex_en: The runaway delivery truck plowed into several parked motorcycles along the narrow street.
items.ex_zh: 失控的送货卡车顺着狭窄的街道猛冲撞上了几辆停放的摩托车。

items.def_en: (+ sth) strike or collide with another object or body with immense, violent force
items.ex_en: A ferocious ocean wave slammed into the rocky cliff with deafening explosive power.
items.ex_zh: 汹涌的海浪带着震耳欲聋的巨大冲击力重重撞击在岩石峭壁上。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ into/against) to strike or cause something to strike with great violence and noise
items.ex_en: Gusty winter winds caused the heavy wooden shutter to slam violently against the frame.
items.ex_zh: 冬日阵阵狂风导致沉重的木制百叶窗猛烈地撞向窗框。
items.ex2_en: The furious resident slammed the front door shut to dismiss the salesman.
items.ex2_zh: 愤怒的住户砰地关上前门，将推销员拒之门外。

items.def_zh: （疾行中猛烈地）撞击，相撞；（台球中）击中两球得分
items.def_en: 1. (+ into/against) (chiefly British) To collide violently with something or someone, especially while moving fast and rebounding. 2. (billiards) To hit two balls in succession.
items.ex_en: The runaway cyclist cannoned into the startled pedestrian at the bottom of the slope.
items.ex_zh: 失控的骑车人在坡底疾行中猛烈撞上了一脸错愕的行人。

items.def_zh: 碰撞，互撞；（观点、利益等）冲突，抵触
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To crash violently into someone or something, or to crash into each other while moving. 2. (+ with) (of opinions, interests, or principles) To clash or come into direct opposition.
items.ex_en: Two passenger trains collided during dense morning fog near the bustling regional junction.
items.ex_zh: 清晨浓雾中，两列客运列车在繁忙的区域交叉道口附近猛烈相撞。

items.def_en: (+ sth) impact an obstacle or vehicle violently, causing destructive damage
items.ex_en: The out-of-control vehicle smashed into the store window, shattering glass across the floor.
items.ex_zh: 失控的车辆猛烈冲撞进商店橱窗，碎玻璃撒得满地都是。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ into) to hit an obstacle violently, often causing severe damage or destruction
items.ex_en: The private jet crashed into the dense pine forest during a violent thunderstorm.
items.ex_zh: 那架私人飞机在猛烈的雷暴天气中撞毁在茂密的松树林里。
items.ex2_en: The distracted driver crashed his brand new sports car into a lamppost.
items.ex2_zh: 心不在焉的司机将他崭新的跑车撞上了一根路灯柱。

groups.summary_en: Objects or bodies move forcefully and impact another surface or entity, distinguished by the physical mechanics, momentum transfer, and sensory acoustic result of the strike.
groups.summary_zh: 物体或人带着动能猛烈撞击或反弹碰撞，伴随沉重声响或冲击力。
groups.desc_en: Denotes sudden, energetic, dynamic physical contact between bodies marked by acoustic violence and mechanical disruption, contrasting with gentle contact or frictionless passage.
groups.desc_zh: 指物体之间突发、强劲并伴有声响破坏的剧烈力学撞击，与温和轻触或无阻穿行形成对比。
groups.nuance_en: collide: strike each other while in mutual, forceful opposing motion (cars / particles / interests) · slam into: hit a surface with high speed and violent, loud percussion (wall / breaks / tree) · crash into: smash into an obstacle resulting in structural wreck or damage (barrier / car / rocks) · plow into: barrel into and displace an obstacle with relentless inertia (crowd / barricade / snow) · thud: strike a surface producing a dull, heavy, non-resonant acoustic impact (floor / ground / chest)
groups.nuance_zh: collide: 在相对运动中猛烈迎头相撞 (cars / particles / interests) · slam into: 以极高速度重重摔碰并发出震耳钝响 (wall / breaks / tree) · crash into: 猛撞障碍物并伴随解体与严重损毁 (barrier / car / rocks) · plow into: 携不可逆转的冲力强行碾过、推入障碍 (crowd / barricade / snow) · thud: 撞击表面发出低沉、浑厚的闷响 (floor / ground / chest)

groups.name: Impair Integrity to Total Fracture · 损伤、打破与折断 (Damage, Break)
groups.tip: 受力破裂或使物体受损

items.def_en: to cause mild physical injury, damage, or negative consequence to an object or living thing
items.ex_en: Excessive direct exposure to bright sunlight may easily harm delicate electronic display screens.
items.ex_zh: 过度直接暴露在强烈阳光下很容易损害娇贵的电子显示屏。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to separate or cause sth to separate into several smaller pieces or parts through force
items.ex_en: Construction workers used heavy pneumatic drills to break up the thick concrete pavement.
items.ex_zh: 建筑工人使用重型风钻将厚厚的混凝土路面打碎拆除。
items.ex2_en: Thick winter ice breaks up naturally when warmer spring currents flow north.
items.ex2_zh: 当温暖的春季洋流向北流动时，厚厚的冬冰会自然碎裂。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to develop structural fractures or crash and severely damage a vehicle or structure
items.ex_en: Her impression of the boss made everyone in the room crack up.
items.ex_zh: 她模仿老板的样子让屋里的所有人都笑得前仰后合。
items.ex2_en: The reckless driver managed to crack up his father's expensive luxury car.
items.ex2_zh: 那个鲁莽的司机把他父亲昂贵的豪华轿车给撞毁了。

items.def_zh: 打破，弄碎，损坏；（使）破裂；违犯；中断，暂停
items.def_en: to separate into pieces, or cause something to do so; to damage or destroy something; to violate a rule or promise.
items.ex_en: Careless handling could easily break the fragile ceramic vase during the long move.
items.ex_zh: 在漫长的搬家过程中，粗心搬运很容易摔碎脆弱的陶瓷花瓶。
items.ex2_en: The old wooden floorboard broke under the unexpected weight of the bookcase.
items.ex2_zh: 旧木地板在书架意想不到的重量重压下折断了。

items.def_en: to harm, spoil, or break something so that it is less valuable or useful.
items.ex_en: The fierce hail storm severely damaged the ripe crops across the entire valley.
items.ex_zh: 猛烈的冰雹风暴严重毁坏了整个山谷中成熟的庄稼。

items.def_zh: 打破，弄碎，损坏（break的过去分词）
items.def_en: (past participle of break) to separate into pieces, damage, or cause to fail.
items.ex_en: The clumsy intern found that the expensive glass lens was broken beyond repair.
items.ex_zh: 笨手笨脚的实习生发现昂贵的光学玻璃镜片已经破碎得无法修复了。
items.ex2_en: The clumsy intern had broken the expensive lens before the photographer arrived.
items.ex2_zh: 笨手笨脚的实习生在摄影师到达前就打碎了昂贵的镜头。

items.def_zh: 打破，弄碎，损坏（break的过去式）
items.def_en: (past tense of break) to separate into pieces, damage, or fracture.
items.ex_en: He accidentally dropped his favorite porcelain mug and broke the fragile handle off.
items.ex_zh: 他不小心摔落了心爱的瓷杯，把易碎的手柄摔断了。
items.ex2_en: The rusted suspension bridge broke suddenly during the torrential midnight rainstorm.
items.ex2_zh: 生锈的吊桥在午夜倾盆暴雨中突然断裂坍塌。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to smash, damage, or severely fracture something by violent physical force
items.ex_en: The violent bar brawl threatened to bust up all the antique wooden furniture.
items.ex_zh: 激烈的酒吧群殴几乎要将里面所有的古董木制家具彻底砸烂。

items.def_en: [I/T] to crack, break, or split a hard substance or bone so that cracks appear
items.ex_en: Intense mechanical stress caused the thick metal beam to fracture across its base.
items.ex_zh: 巨大的机械应力导致厚重的金属横梁在其基底部位出现了断裂。
items.ex2_en: The sudden heavy impact fractured the athlete's right leg during the match.
items.ex2_zh: 比赛中突如其来的沉重撞击导致该运动员的右腿骨折。

items.def_en: [I/T] to break violently into numerous small, sharp pieces under sudden impact
items.ex_en: The crystal bowl slipped from her hands and shattered completely on the tile floor.
items.ex_zh: 水晶碗从她手中滑落，在瓷砖地板上被摔得粉碎。
items.ex2_en: The stray baseball shattered the bedroom window into countless tiny jagged fragments.
items.ex2_zh: 飞来的棒球将卧室窗户打得粉碎，化作无数锋利的碎片。

groups.summary_en: This core physical-integrity frame spans verbs indicating loss of structural soundness, escalating from surface harm and functional impairment to clean separation, fracturing into pieces, and irreversible destruction. Note: non-standard lexical entries are aligned according to grammatical baseline.
groups.summary_zh: 从功能受损、物理裂损递增至彻底断裂或破碎。
