groups.desc_en: Denotes breaching structural integrity, advancing from surface detriment to complete rupture or shattering of cohesion, contrasting with wear-and-tear or restorative reshaping.
groups.desc_zh: 指破坏物体的结构完整性，由浅层损伤递进至断裂崩解，与自然磨损或可塑重构形成对比。
groups.nuance_en: damage: inflict physical impairment that reduces functional value without total destruction (goods / reputation / building) · break: sever or fracture an object into pieces under stress (bone / glass / seal) · break up: dissolve, disintegrate, or fragment into scattered constituent parts (ice / crowd / marriage) · crack up: develop extensive fissures or collapse emotionally/structurally (concrete / aircraft / mind) · bust up: violently smash, fracture, or raucously terminate (furniture / party / fight)
groups.nuance_zh: damage: 造成削弱效用价值的局部受损但未全毁 (goods / reputation / building) · break: 在应力下断裂、折断或碎成数截 (bone / glass / seal) · break up: 瓦解、离散或碎裂为若干零散碎片/群体 (ice / crowd / marriage) · crack up: 裂纹丛生、崩裂，或在精神/机能上彻底崩溃 (concrete / aircraft / mind) · bust up: 蛮横暴力地砸烂、打碎或彻底掀翻砸场 (furniture / party / fight)

groups.name: Impeded & Incoherent Utterance · 结巴含糊与语无伦次 (Stammer, Splutter, Gibber)
groups.tip: 口齿不清、结巴或语声沙哑

items.def_zh: 咕哝，嘟囔（声音低且口齿不清）
items.def_en: [I/T] to speak quietly and unclearly so that words cannot be understood easily
items.ex_en: Nervous and embarrassed, he could only mumble a barely audible excuse to everyone.
items.ex_zh: 他又紧张又尴尬，只能向大家含糊低声咕哝出一句几乎听不清的借口。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to say something suddenly and incoherently without thinking, especially when nervous
items.ex_en: Caught completely off guard, she blurted out the secret before she could reconsider.
items.ex_zh: 由于措手不及，她还没来得及多想就冒失地脱口说出了秘密。

items.def_zh: 结结巴巴地说（重复词首音节）
items.def_en: [I/T] to speak with involuntary pauses and rapid repetitions of syllables
items.ex_en: The terrified boy began to stutter nervously whenever the strict headmaster approached him.
items.ex_zh: 每当严厉的校长走近时，吓坏了的男孩就紧张得结结巴巴。

items.def_en: To speak with involuntary pauses, repeated sounds, or blocks, especially due to nervousness or embarrassment.
items.ex_en: He started to stammer badly under the relentless pressure of the courtroom interrogation.
items.ex_zh: 在法庭审讯的无情压力下，他开始严重结巴起来。

items.def_zh: 结结巴巴地说出；勉强吐出
items.def_en: (+ sth) to manage to utter or stammer words when flustered, hesitant, or angry
items.ex_en: The flustered witness finally managed to spit out the suspect's real name under interrogation.
items.ex_zh: 在严密盘问下，慌乱的证人终于勉强吐出了嫌疑人的真名。

items.raw_cluster: 粗声与嘶哑 Speak Harshly & Rasp
items.def_zh: 粗声粗气地说；发出刺耳刺刮声；用粗锉刀锉
items.def_en: 1. To speak or utter something in a harsh, grating, raspy voice. 2. To make a harsh, scraping sound. 3. To scrape or smooth something with a rough file.
items.ex_en: The exhausted old sailor rasped a grim warning through his smoke-damaged, gravelly throat.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的老水手用被烟雾熏坏的沙哑喉咙粗声粗气地发出了严酷警告。

items.def_zh: 急促而语无伦次地说（伴有飞沫）；发出噼啪声，发出噗噗声
items.def_en: 1. To speak quickly, confusedly, and unclearly while spitting out small drops of saliva, especially when angry or surprised. 2. To make a series of short popping or spitting noises.
items.ex_en: Furious at the sudden accusation, the manager spluttered incoherently in front of everyone.
items.ex_zh: 面对突如其来的指控，经理气得暴跳如雷，当众语无伦次地乱喷唾沫。

items.def_zh: 哽咽着说出；勉强挤出（话语）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to utter words with difficulty due to breathlessness or overwhelming emotion
items.ex_en: Overcome by grief at the funeral, the widow barely choked out a farewell.
items.ex_zh: 在葬礼上悲痛欲绝的寡妇几乎无法呼吸，艰难地哽咽着吐出道别。

items.def_zh: 胡言乱语，喋喋不休地胡扯
items.def_en: [I/T] to talk rapidly and continuously in a foolish, excited, or incomprehensible way
items.ex_en: High fever caused the delirious patient to babble ceaselessly throughout the restless night.
items.ex_zh: 高烧导致神志不清的病人在不安宁的夜里喋喋不休地胡言乱语。

items.def_zh: 急促而胡言乱语，喋喋不休地胡扯
items.def_en: To speak rapidly and unintelligibly, especially through fear, shock, or madness.
items.ex_en: The terrified prisoner could only gibber in sheer panic within the dark dungeon.
items.ex_zh: 吓破了胆的囚犯在阴暗的地牢中陷入极度恐慌，只能语无伦次地狂呼乱叫。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate speech delivery impaired by physiological impediment, intense emotion, breathlessness, or panic, ranked by incoherence and vocal distortion.
groups.summary_zh: 依语流阻碍与混乱程度排列，表现受情绪、呼吸或心智失常影响的言语表达。
groups.desc_en: Denotes vocal delivery impaired by physical constriction, explosive emotional agitation, or motor dysfluency, contrasting with clear diction or silent withdrawal.
groups.desc_zh: 指因生理梗阻、极端情绪激动或神经运动受阻导致的含混断续吐字，与吐字清晰或缄默形成对比。
groups.nuance_en: stutter: involuntarily repeat or prolong consonants due to motor disruption (syllables / excuse / boy) · stammer: halt, stumble, and repeat words under emotional strain or guilt (apology / defense / witness) · splutter: spit out words explosively accompanied by spitting sounds or rage (indignation / water / rage) · mumble: articulate indistinctly with low volume and teeth/lips closed (reply / prayer / breath) · choke out: vocalize with extreme constriction and strained breath due to weeping or trauma (words / goodbye / truth)
groups.nuance_zh: stutter: 因发音运动障碍而不由自主重复音节、拖长字音 (syllables / excuse / boy) · stammer: 在情绪紧张或愧疚下言语受阻、结巴吐字 (apology / defense / witness) · splutter: 暴怒或呛咳中伴随唾沫星子喷薄出语 (indignation / water / rage) · mumble: 唇齿闭合、低语含混嘟囔 (reply / prayer / breath) · choke out: 因哽咽、受掐或剧烈悲痛极其艰难地挤出只言片语 (words / goodbye / truth)

groups.name: Implement & Enforce · 实施与践行 (Implement, Execute, Enforce)
groups.tip: 将理论付诸实际行动

items.def_zh: 实践，践行，实行；练习，训练；从事（医务、法律等职业）
items.def_en: 1. To carry out, apply, or put into action a theory, belief, or custom. 2. To do an activity repeatedly to gain or improve a skill. 3. To work professionally as a doctor, lawyer, etc.
items.ex_en: The international firm vowed to practice rigorous ethical standards across all overseas subsidiaries.
items.ex_zh: 这家跨国企业誓言要在所有海外子公司严格践行高标准的职业道德规范。

items.def_zh: 应用，运用，实施；适用；申请；涂抹；专心致力于
items.def_en: 1. To use or put something, such as a rule, method, or theory, into practical operation. 2. (+ to) To be relevant to or have an effect on someone or something. 3. (+ for) To make a formal request for something, such as a job. 4. To spread or rub a substance onto a surface. 5. ('apply oneself') To work hard and dedicate oneself to a task.
items.ex_en: The judicial panel must carefully apply statutory regulations to this complex intellectual property dispute.
items.ex_zh: 司法审判小组必须将成文法规审慎应用于这起复杂的知识产权争议。
items.ex2_en: These strict safety regulations apply equally to all chemical factories across Europe.
items.ex2_zh: 这些严格的安全规定同样适用于全欧洲所有的化工厂。

items.def_en: To put a plan, decision, policy, or agreement into effect.
items.ex_en: The city council agreed to implement comprehensive environmental reforms starting next fiscal quarter.
items.ex_zh: 市议会同意从下个财政季度开始全面贯彻实施环保改革措施。

items.def_zh: 执行，贯彻，实施；处死，处决；（计算机）运行
items.def_en: 1. To carry out, perform, or put into effect a plan, order, or course of action. 2. To kill someone as a legal punishment. 3. (computing) To run a program or set of instructions.
items.ex_en: The military commander ordered his loyal unit to execute the emergency contingency plan.
items.ex_zh: 军事指挥官命令其忠诚的部队坚决贯彻执行紧急应急预案。

items.def_zh: 强制执行，督促遵循（法律、规定）
items.def_en: to make people obey a rule, law, or decision, often through institutional authority or penalty
items.ex_en: Local authorities deployed extra police officers to enforce strict traffic safety regulations downtown.
items.ex_zh: 地方当局增派警力，在市中心严格强制执行交通安全法规。

items.def_zh: 执行，落实（任务、指令或计划）
items.def_en: to perform, conduct, or complete an instruction, task, promise, or planned project
items.ex_en: The hospital is carrying out tests to determine the cause of the infection.
items.ex_zh: 医院正在进行检测，以查明感染原因。

items.def_en: to continue an action or policy to its conclusion, completing what was planned
items.ex_en: The committee promised to follow through on all ambitious promises made during negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 委员会承诺将贯彻落实谈判期间做出的所有雄心勃勃的承诺。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to cause a law, rule, or plan to begin operating or being applied
items.ex_en: The government aims to put into effect new trade tariffs by late December.
items.ex_zh: 政府计划在12月下旬正式颁布实施新的贸易关税政策。

items.def_en: to take severe legal or authoritative measures against bad conduct or to strictly enforce a rule
items.ex_en: City officials decided to crack down hard on illegal street racing this summer.
items.ex_zh: 市政府官员决定在今年夏天对非法街头飙车行为进行严厉打击。

items.def_zh: 颁布实施，通过（法律或改革政策）
items.def_en: (formal) to pass a law officially, or to put a specified policy or decree into legal force
items.ex_en: Parliament voted overwhelmingly to enact comprehensive privacy legislation safeguarding consumer personal data.
items.ex_zh: 议会以压倒性多数投票通过并颁布实施了一项保护消费者个人数据的综合隐私法。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to carrying out, enforcing, or putting into practical effect an abstract policy, legal regulation, plan, or established conviction. Nuances range from routine pragmatic habits (practice, apply) to authoritative executive actuation (implement, execute, enforce).
groups.summary_zh: 将规章、政策、决定或惯例付诸具体执行、落实与实践。
groups.desc_en: Denotes translating an abstract policy, mandate, or design into operational reality backed by administrative or coercive authority, contrasting with formulating plans or passively obeying.
groups.desc_zh: 指将抽象政策、指令或设计转化为具备行政或强制力保障的实践落地，与仅停留在规划制定或被动服从形成对比。
groups.nuance_en: implement: systematically operationalize an established plan, tool, or policy (reform / system / plan) · enforce: compel compliance through legal authority, sanctions, or threat (law / rules / ban) · execute: carry through an operational plan, order, or technical task completely (order / strategy / command) · carry out: diligently conduct and complete an assignment or procedure (survey / research / duties) · put into effect: formally enact and activate a regulation or measure (law / policy / decree)
groups.nuance_zh: implement: 系统性地推行并落地既定的规划、工具或政策 (reform / system / plan) · enforce: 凭借法律权威或惩处威慑强制促使遵从 (law / rules / ban) · execute: 精准、严谨地执行具体战略、技术指令或任务 (order / strategy / command) · carry out: 认真贯彻落实一项程序、调查或职责 (survey / research / duties) · put into effect: 使法令、规章正式生效并投入运转 (law / policy / decree)

groups.name: Impoverish & Exhaust · 竭尽与使赤贫 (Deplete, Impoverish, Beggar)
groups.tip: 底气逐渐耗尽，实力大打折扣

items.def_en: (+ of) to gradually reduce or use up completely a supply of money, energy, or resources
items.ex_en: Years of ongoing medical bills slowly drained the family of their savings reserves.
items.ex_zh: 多年来持续不断的医疗开支逐渐耗空了该家庭所有的积蓄储备。
items.ex2_en: Financial reserves drained rapidly during the prolonged economic recession and high unemployment.
items.ex2_zh: 在旷日持久的经济衰退和高失业率期间，财政储备迅速耗尽。

items.def_en: to greatly reduce the amount of an essential resource, fund, or supply
items.ex_en: Extensive industrial irrigation projects severely deplete local underground freshwater reserves during summer droughts.
items.ex_zh: 广泛的工业灌溉工程在夏季干旱期间严重耗竭了当地的地下淡水储备。

items.def_zh: 逐渐消耗；蚕食（财富、资源）
items.def_en: to gradually deplete or reduce financial reserves, land, or resources over time
items.ex_en: Steep inflation rates steadily eat away at the retirement savings of senior citizens.
items.ex_zh: 高企的通货膨胀率正在持续蚕食老年群体的养老储蓄储备。

items.def_en: to use up entirely so that nothing remains, especially funds, reserves, or fertility
items.ex_en: Prolonged intensive farming practices will rapidly exhaust the natural fertility of the soil.
items.ex_zh: 长期集约化耕作方式将迅速耗尽土地自然蕴含的土壤肥力。

items.def_zh: 快速挥霍；迅速耗尽（资金）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to spend or deplete large amounts of money or resources very rapidly
items.ex_en: The startup burned through five million dollars of venture capital in six months.
items.ex_zh: 该初创公司在六个月内就烧光了五百万美元的风险投资。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to completely deprive someone or an account of all money or supplies
items.ex_en: The dishonest financial adviser managed to clean out the widow's entire life savings.
items.ex_zh: 那个不讲信用的财务顾问竟设法洗劫并掏空了这位寡妇毕生的积蓄。

items.def_en: to deplete someone or an entity of all financial means, rendering them legally or materially ruined
items.ex_en: Catastrophic product recalls threatened to bankrupt the historic manufacturing corporation within months.
items.ex_zh: 灾难性的产品召回事件可能在几个月内让这家历史悠久的制造企业彻底破产。

items.def_zh: 使破产，使沦为赤贫；使无法（相信或描述，如 beggar belief/description）
items.def_en: 1. To make someone extremely poor. 2. (beggar belief/description) To be too extreme, unusual, or shocking to be believed or described.
items.ex_en: The protracted legal battle threatened to beggar the modest estate left behind.
items.ex_zh: 旷日持久的法律纠纷势必将那笔所剩无几的微薄遗产彻底掏空耗尽。

items.def_zh: 使贫穷，使赤贫；耗尽……的资源（或养分），削弱
items.def_en: To make someone or something extremely poor, or to make land, soil, or a system worse in quality.
items.ex_en: Decades of intensive farming threatened to impoverish the once fertile topsoil across the valley.
items.ex_zh: 数十年的集约化耕作极易耗尽整座山谷曾经肥沃的表层土壤养分。

items.def_en: to reduce an individual or class of people to absolute, degrading poverty
items.ex_en: The predatory loans threatened to pauperize entire communities of hardworking factory laborers.
items.ex_zh: 掠夺性贷款有可能使整个辛勤劳作的工厂工人社群沦为赤贫阶层。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the severe or total drainage of financial resources, land fertility, or material assets. They scale from progressively draining supplies (deplete) to reducing individuals, estates, or nations to utter insolvency and destitution (beggar).
groups.summary_zh: 使资财、地力或给养消耗殆尽并陷入彻底赤贫。
groups.desc_en: Denotes draining resources, capital, or vitality to the point of complete exhaustion or economic destitution, contrasting with moderate spending or controlled downsizing.
groups.desc_zh: 指将资产、资源或体力抽吸榨取直至枯竭见底或陷入赤贫，与适度开支或受控缩容形成对比。
groups.nuance_en: deplete: gradually reduce reserves, abundance, or stock to low levels (supplies / reserves / resources) · exhaust: use up completely, leaving nothing of energy, patience, or options (energy / patience / funds) · drain: continuously siphon away liquid assets, energy, or strength (economy / account / resources) · beggar: reduce to utter poverty or exceed the explanatory power of something (family / nation / description) · bankrupt: render financially insolvent or devoid of moral value (company / state / soul)
groups.nuance_zh: deplete: 使储备、储量或资源存量逐渐走低消耗 (supplies / reserves / resources) · exhaust: 彻底耗竭体能、耐心或解决手段，不留余地 (energy / patience / funds) · drain: 如抽水般源源不断抽空液体、资金或元气 (economy / account / resources) · beggar: 使彻底陷入赤贫乞食之境，或使某种手段彻底失灵 (family / nation / description) · bankrupt: 使破产倒闭或使品格彻底丧失 (company / state / soul)

groups.name: Improve & Perfect · 改善与臻于至善 (Improve, Ameliorate, Perfect)
groups.tip: 由逐步改善直至趋于完美

items.def_en: (+ on sth) to improve or refresh one's existing knowledge, condition, or skill
items.ex_en: I need to brush up on my conversational Spanish before heading to Madrid next month.
items.ex_zh: 下个月去马德里之前，我得把西班牙语口语再好好温习一下。

items.def_en: to raise something to a higher standard or newer version
items.ex_en: The company decided to upgrade its accounting software to enhance overall operational efficiency.
items.ex_zh: 公司决定升级其财务软件，以提升整体运营效率。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to improve the appearance, efficiency, or operational standard of something
items.ex_en: We should really smarten up the reception area before the regional inspectors arrive tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 明早区域检查员到来之前，我们真该把接待区好好收拾齐整一下。
items.ex2_en: The aging historic downtown smartened up considerably following municipal infrastructure investments.
items.ex2_zh: 在市政基础设施投资之后，老旧的历史街区面貌焕然一新。

items.def_en: To make something better, or to become better.
items.ex_en: Consistent physical therapy helped improve her joint mobility after the major knee surgery.
items.ex_zh: 持续的物理治疗有助于在膝关节大手术后改善她的关节活动度。
items.ex2_en: Her speech and walking ability improved significantly following intensive neurological rehabilitation.
items.ex2_zh: 在接受强化神经康复治疗后，她的语言和行走能力显著改善。

items.def_zh: 更新，完善；使现代化；向……提供最新信息
items.def_en: 1. To make something more modern or suitable by adding the latest information or features. 2. To give someone the most recent news or facts.
items.ex_en: The editors worked late to update the handbook with the latest regulatory guidelines.
items.ex_zh: 编辑们工作到深夜，以便用最新的监管指导方针更新该手册。

items.def_zh: 改善，改良，缓解（不良状况）
items.def_en: (formal) To make a bad, unpleasant, or difficult situation better.
items.ex_en: The newly elected council introduced substantial subsidies to ameliorate severe urban poverty.
items.ex_zh: 新当选的理事会推出了大额补贴，以缓解严峻的城市贫困问题。
items.ex2_en: Working conditions ameliorated noticeably after the union concluded negotiations with management.
items.ex2_zh: 在工会与管理层完成谈判后，工作条件有了显著改善。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to refine, perfect, or add finishing touches to a performance, text, or skill
items.ex_en: I need to polish up my Spanish before travelling to Madrid.
items.ex_zh: 去马德里之前，我需要重新温习一下我的西班牙语。

items.def_zh: 使完美，完善，使熟练精通
items.def_en: To make something completely free from faults, or to improve something until it is as good as it can be.
items.ex_en: The renowned pastry chef spent years trying to perfect his signature chocolate soufflé recipe.
items.ex_zh: 这位著名糕点师耗费数年心血，力求完善其招牌巧克力舒芙蕾的配方。

items.def_en: to improve something by making subtle, delicate adjustments to remove defects
items.ex_en: Acoustic engineers worked tirelessly to refine the auditorium's sound profile before opening night.
items.ex_zh: 声学工程师不知疲倦地工作，在首演之夜前精细调整礼堂的音响效果。

items.def_zh: 磨砺；提升（技巧）至高水平
items.def_en: to refine or sharpen a skill or instrument over time to peak precision
items.ex_en: The young violinist practiced daily to hone her intricate fingering techniques before the concert.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的小提琴家每天刻苦练习，以在音乐会前磨砺她繁复的指法技巧。

groups.summary_en: These verbs describe a scalar gradient of positive change, advancing from simple updating and baseline improvement of flaws to formal rectification and the absolute pinnacle of flawless execution.
groups.summary_zh: 表示事物从初步改进、修正不良状态递进到极致完美程度。
groups.desc_en: Denotes positive alteration along a scale of quality, refinement, or functional efficacy toward a state of optimal performance, contrasting with baseline maintenance or cosmetic disguise.
groups.desc_zh: 指沿质量、精细度或效能阶梯向上提升以臻于优良或极致，与日常维保或表面粉饰形成对比。
groups.nuance_en: improve: raise the standard, condition, or performance of something overall (skills / health / quality) · ameliorate: make a tolerable improvement in an otherwise bad or painful situation (conditions / poverty / suffering) · perfect: refine something until it is entirely devoid of defect or flaw (technique / craft / art) · polish up: make minor, stylish refinements or refresh rusty proficiencies (essay / skills / act) · upgrade: substitute or convert to a distinctly higher standard or hardware generation (software / system / flight)
groups.nuance_zh: improve: 全面提升某事物的水平、状况或综合性能 (skills / health / quality) · ameliorate: 在恶劣或受苦处境中做出实质性改良舒缓 (conditions / poverty / suffering) · perfect: 持续精进雕琢至绝无瑕疵或臻于化境 (technique / craft / art) · polish up: 对生疏技能或粗糙细节进行润色抛光 (essay / skills / act) · upgrade: 迭代置换为更高规格或档次 (software / system / flight)

groups.name: Industrial Production & Fabrication · 工业制造与产出 (Manufacture, Machine, Fabricate)
groups.tip: 工农业规模化产出物品

items.def_zh: 生产，制造；产出，产生；出示，提出；制作（影视等）
items.def_en: 1. To make, grow, or manufacture goods or materials. 2. To cause a reaction, result, or effect. 3. To show or present something.
items.ex_en: This modernized local facility can produce thousands of high-efficiency solar panels each week.
items.ex_zh: 这座现代化的本地工厂每周能够生产数千块高效太阳能电池板。

items.def_zh: 用机器加工，用机床切削制造
items.def_en: 1. To cut, shape, or finish metal, wood, or other materials using a machine.
items.ex_en: The artisan carefully machined the brass cylinder until it gleamed with quiet, industrial beauty.
items.ex_zh: 工匠精细切削着黄铜圆柱，直至它泛出静谧而工业质感的美泽。

items.def_en: to make goods in large numbers, usually in a factory using machines
items.ex_en: The automotive giant plans to manufacture electric utility vehicles at this sprawling new plant.
items.ex_zh: 这家汽车巨头计划在这座占地广阔的新工厂制造电动多用途车。

items.def_en: to manufacture goods in large quantities using standardized techniques and assembly lines
items.ex_en: Automated assembly plants can mass-produce affordable consumer electronics with remarkable consistency and speed.
items.ex_zh: 自动化组装厂能以卓越的稳定性与速度大批量生产廉价消费电子产品。

items.def_zh: 大量粗制滥造，流水线式大量产出
items.def_en: to produce large quantities of something rapidly and automatically, often with reduced quality
items.ex_en: The studio began to churn out cheap holiday sequels purely for fast cash.
items.ex_zh: 该制片厂开始大肆粗制滥造廉价的节日档续集，纯粹为了快钱。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to manufacture or fabricate goods in specific quantities, usually using machinery
items.ex_en: The industrial plant can turn out several hundred heavy tractor parts per shift.
items.ex_zh: 该工业厂房每班次能够生产出数百件重型拖拉机零部件。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to manufacture or produce large amounts of items mechanically and routinely
items.ex_en: The busy bakery workers crank out hundreds of identical frosted donuts every single morning.
items.ex_zh: 繁忙的面包店工人每天早晨机械化地快速生产出数百个一模一样的糖霜甜甜圈。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to complete the industrial manufacture and release of a new product line
items.ex_en: The manufacturing team will roll out the latest electric crossover models next quarter.
items.ex_zh: 制造团队将于下季度正式下线推出最新的电动跨界车型。

items.def_zh: 装配制造；加工制作（构件）
items.def_en: to construct or manufacture an industrial product or structure from standardized parts
items.ex_en: Specialized industrial welders fabricate massive steel girders for large suspension bridges.
items.ex_zh: 专业的工业焊工负责为大型悬索桥加工制作巨大的钢大梁。

items.def_en: 1. To manufacture or grow more goods or food than customers want or can buy.
items.ex_en: Subsidized dairy farmers inevitably tend to overproduce milk during the peak spring season.
items.ex_zh: 享有补贴的奶农在春季高峰期往往难免会过量生产牛奶。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the industrial or systematic creation of physical goods, parts, or commodities using machinery, tools, and organized labor. Verbs range from general output generation (produce) to precise mechanical shaping (machine) and industrial fabrication (manufacture).
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖利用机器、车床或流水线规模化加工、成型与制造工业产品的全过程。
groups.desc_en: Denotes shaping raw material into finished goods via industrial mechanisms, standardized factory tooling, and volume output, contrasting with artisanal hand-crafting or agricultural harvesting.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过工业机械设备、标准化车间工艺及规模化装配产出工业品，与手工艺制作或农业收割形成对比。
groups.nuance_en: manufacture: produce standardized physical goods systematically on an industrial scale (goods / cars / chips) · machine: cut, shape, or finish metal/parts using precision mechanical tooling (parts / metal / surface) · mass-produce: fabricate in uniform, high-volume assembly-line quantities (products / clothing / copies) · churn out: produce mechanically in large quantities with uncritical, routine velocity (novels / graduates / content) · roll out: inaugurate and bring a newly produced model or line to the market (model / product / update)
groups.nuance_zh: manufacture: 在工业规模下系统性制造标准化成品物资 (goods / cars / chips) · machine: 利用机床、精密刀具对零件进行机械切削加工 (parts / metal / surface) · mass-produce: 依托流水线大批量、均质化生产 (products / clothing / copies) · churn out: 机械化、缺乏鉴别力且高速量产出笼 (novels / graduates / content) · roll out: 将新下线的产品或版本正式铺开推向市场 (model / product / update)

groups.name: Inscribe Typographic & Symbolic Markers · 符号标记与指示 (Mark, Asterisk, Check)
groups.tip: 签字署名或做记号以示确认

items.def_en: mark an item on a list with a checkmark (tick) to show verification
items.ex_en: Please check each completed task on the printed itinerary before moving forward.
items.ex_zh: 在继续下一步之前，请在打印的行程单上给每项已完成的任务打勾标记。

items.def_en: (+ off/out) mark with a cross to cancel or distinguish
items.ex_en: Remember to cross the canceled appointments on the wall calendar in red ink.
items.ex_zh: 记得用红墨水在挂历上给取消的预约画叉标记。

items.def_en: (+ off) place a tick mark beside a listed item
items.ex_en: The customs officer continued to tick the verified items on her clipboard methodically.
items.ex_zh: 海关官员继续有条不紊地在她写字板上的已核验物品旁打勾。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to draw a line or symbolic cross through an item on a list to mark it as dealt with
items.ex_en: You can cross off that errand because I already visited the local pharmacy.
items.ex_zh: 你可以划掉那件差事了，因为我已经去过当地药房了。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to indicate boundaries or specific items by making typographic lines or marks
items.ex_en: The surveyors used vibrant orange stakes to mark off the property boundary clearly.
items.ex_zh: 测量员使用醒目的橙色木桩清晰地标出这处地产的边界。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to put a check mark beside an item on a written list to verify or identify it
items.ex_en: Let's tick off each attendee on the clipboard as they enter the auditorium.
items.ex_zh: 参会人员进入礼堂时，我们就在写字板上逐个勾选核对吧。

items.def_zh: 签字，署名；做手势，用手语示意；签约聘用
items.def_en: 1. To write your name on a document to show approval, agreement, or authorship. 2. To communicate using gestures or sign language. 3. To employ or be employed by signing a contract.
items.ex_en: Both business partners must sign the commercial lease before the keys are released.
items.ex_zh: 在交付钥匙之前，两名商业合伙人都必须在该商业租赁合同上签字。

items.def_zh: 做记号于，标示；给……打分；标志着，纪念；留意
items.def_en: 1. To write, draw, or leave a symbol or line on something to identify or distinguish it. 2. To indicate, signify, or celebrate an important event. 3. (chiefly British) To grade or correct an exam or piece of work.
items.ex_en: The quality inspector will mark any defective ceramic tiles with a bright sticker.
items.ex_zh: 质量检验员会用鲜艳的贴纸在所有有缺陷的瓷砖上做记号。

items.def_en: attach a label or marker to identify or classify
items.ex_en: The librarian helped me tag the newly donated mystery novels with category stickers.
items.ex_zh: 图书管理员帮我用分类标签给新捐赠的悬疑小说做标记。

items.def_zh: 加星号标出，用星号注明
items.def_en: 1. To mark a word, item, or footnote with a star-shaped symbol (*).
items.ex_en: Please asterisk any mandatory fields on the registration form to guide new users.
items.ex_zh: 请在注册表单上的所有必填字段旁加星号标出，以引导新用户。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe affixing specific visual, typographical, or symbolic notations onto a surface or text to single out, annotate, or signify approval/identity. They differ according to the concrete shape or technical nature of the mark made.
groups.summary_zh: 指在文本或物体上添加特定符号、记号或星号以作标示。
groups.desc_en: Denotes inscribing distinct graphic symbols, ticks, or glyphs on a record to track status, certify validity, or demarcate items, contrasting with narrative writing or unstructured drawing.
groups.desc_zh: 指在记录上勾画特征图形标记以追踪状态、认证有效性或区分条目，与通篇文字书写或无规则乱涂形成对比。
groups.nuance_en: mark: place a visible sign or spot on a surface to designate identity or position (spot / boundary / paper) · tick: place a checkmark (tick) beside an item to verify completion (box / item / name) · cross off: draw an obliterating line through an entry to denote disposal or completion (list / name / item) · check: inspect and place an affirmative glyph indicating correctness or compliance (box / luggage / record) · sign: append an authenticating personal signature to validate a document (treaty / contract / document)
groups.nuance_zh: mark: 在表面打上明显记号以标示身份或位置 (spot / boundary / paper) · tick: 在条目旁打勾以示核对无误或已完成 (box / item / name) · cross off: 画线划掉条目以示已处理或剔除 (list / name / item) · check: 核对并标记勾选以示合规确认 (box / luggage / record) · sign: 亲笔签署特定名字印记以确立法律效力 (treaty / contract / document)

groups.name: Inspect & Verify · 检查与复核 (Check, Inspect, Review)
groups.tip: 仔细查验以防出错

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to investigate, inspect, or verify the authenticity or status of sth
items.ex_en: We need to check out of the hotel by noon, but let's check out the local market first.
items.ex_zh: 我们需要在中午前结账退房，不过先去看看当地的集市吧。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to examine or inspect something quickly to assess its general quality or validity
items.ex_en: Could you look over this draft contract before I forward it to legal?
items.ex_zh: 在我将这份合同草案转交给法务部门之前，你能快速看一下吗？

items.def_zh: 检查，核对，查验；制止，抑制；寄存，托运
items.def_en: 1. To examine something to determine its accuracy, quality, condition, or presence. 2. To stop, slow down, or prevent something undesirable from progressing. 3. (North American) To leave luggage, coats, etc., for temporary safekeeping.
items.ex_en: The maintenance engineer arrived promptly to check the heating system before harsh winter.
items.ex_zh: 维修工程师准时赶到，在严冬来临之前检查供暖系统。

items.def_zh: 复查，审查，审视；温习，复习；写评论；检阅
items.def_en: 1. To examine or assess something again carefully in order to verify it, make changes, or improve it. 2. To write a critical evaluation of a book, film, play, etc. 3. (chiefly US) To look over material again in study.
items.ex_en: The curriculum committee met yesterday to review the proposed changes to the syllabus.
items.ex_zh: 课程委员会昨天开会，仔细复查了教学大纲的拟议修改。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to examine or inspect the details of a document or process thoroughly
items.ex_en: Let's go over the financial report together to ensure no errors were missed.
items.ex_zh: 我们一起仔细核查一下财务报告，确保没有任何疏漏。

items.def_zh: 测试，检验，检测；考验；测验（某人）
items.def_en: 1. To examine or experiment on something to determine its quality, performance, or composition. 2. To give a test to someone to measure their knowledge or skill. 3. To severely strain or challenge patience, strength, or resolve.
items.ex_en: Engineers must rigorously test the braking system under extreme subzero weather conditions.
items.ex_zh: 工程师必须在极寒的零下天气条件下严格测试制动系统。

items.def_zh: 审查，核查（背景或适任性）
items.def_en: Investigate someone or something thoroughly to check suitability, accuracy, or loyalty
items.ex_en: The ethics committee will thoroughly vet each political candidate before endorsing their campaign.
items.ex_zh: 伦理委员会在支持各位候选人的竞选活动之前，将对其背景进行彻底审查。

items.def_en: Look at closely and systematically to assess condition, detect flaws, or ensure standards
items.ex_en: Federal officials arrived this morning to inspect the pharmaceutical plant for hygiene violations.
items.ex_zh: 联邦官员今早抵达，视察该制药厂是否存在违反卫生标准的行为。

items.def_en: [T/I] Verify the accuracy of information by comparing it with another independent source
items.ex_en: Researchers must cross-check their experimental data against archived historical records to verify accuracy.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员必须将实验数据与归档的历史记录进行交叉核对以确保准确。

items.def_en: Conduct an official, systematic examination and verification of accounts, records, or procedures
items.ex_en: Independent forensic accountants arrived early to audit the firm's confidential investment ledgers.
items.ex_zh: 独立的法务会计师很早就到了，负责对该公司的机密投资账目进行审计。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate cognitive actions aimed at examining, inspecting, or appraising an object, process, or document to establish accuracy, quality, or functional validity. Nuances vary from routine verification to systematic institutional scrutiny.
groups.summary_zh: 指为确认无误、符合标准或处于完好状态而进行的检验、复查与审读。
groups.desc_en: Appraising an object, document, or person methodically against standards or for defects, distinct from mere casual looking or passive observing.
groups.desc_zh: 对照特定标准或排查缺陷而对对象、文件或人员进行方法性查验，区别于随意张望或被动观察。
groups.nuance_en: check: fast basic verification (facts / tires / boxes) · inspect: official critical examination for defects or compliance (factory / pipeline / weapon) · review: systematic evaluative reappraisal (policy / manuscript / performance) · vet: deep background screening for fitness (candidates / manuscripts / intelligence) · test: trial under operational stress (hypothesis / brakes / blood)
groups.nuance_zh: check: 快速基础核实 (facts / tires / boxes) · inspect: 针对合规性与缺陷的官方细查 (factory / pipeline / weapon) · review: 系统性的回溯评估 (policy / manuscript / performance) · vet: 资格与背景的严格审查 (candidates / manuscripts / intelligence) · test: 操作负荷下的试验检测 (hypothesis / brakes / blood)

groups.name: Joke & Jest · 玩笑与戏谑 (Joke, Jest, Quip, Banter)
groups.tip: 说话风趣打趣，以轻松玩笑幽默互动

items.def_zh: 装疯卖傻；插科打诨逗乐
items.def_en: to act silly or make wisecracks to amuse other people
items.ex_en: The boys love to clown around after lunch instead of finishing their assigned homework.
items.ex_zh: 男孩子们午饭后喜欢插科打诨瞎胡闹，而不去完成布置的作业。

items.def_en: to engage in playful, joking behavior or nonserious banter
items.ex_en: Stop kidding around with your sister and help me unpack these heavy groceries.
items.ex_zh: 别跟你妹妹开玩笑了，快来帮我把这些沉甸甸的杂物卸下来。

items.def_en: to behave in a silly, joking, or unserious way with others
items.ex_en: The coach warned the bench players not to mess around during crucial timeouts.
items.ex_zh: 教练警告替补席上的球员们，在关键暂停期间不要嬉皮笑脸地胡闹。

items.def_en: (+ with/about) to say funny things or speak not seriously
items.ex_en: My grandfather loves to joke about his terrible golfing skills during family reunions.
items.ex_zh: 我祖父在家庭聚会上特别喜欢拿自己糟糕的高尔夫球技开玩笑。

items.def_en: (+ with) to exchange playful, teasing, and witty remarks in good humor
items.ex_en: The old colleagues continued to banter easily about their chaotic rookie years together.
items.ex_zh: 老同事们继续轻松地互相打趣，谈论起当年初入职场时的手忙脚乱。

items.def_en: To make a quick, clever, and amusing remark.
items.ex_en: “Punctuality is the virtue of the bored,” the speaker quipped to appreciative laughter.
items.ex_zh: “守时是无聊之人的美德，”演讲者打趣道，引来一阵会心的笑声。

items.def_en: To say something as a joke rather than seriously; to tease or joke.
items.ex_en: Do not take my harsh critique to heart, for I only spoke in jest.
items.ex_zh: 莫将我严苛的批评放在心上，我不过是说了句玩笑话罢了。

items.def_en: [I/T] to tease someone in a gentle, friendly, good-natured way
items.ex_en: The jovial host liked to chaff his timid guests until they felt completely welcome.
items.ex_zh: 这位快活的主人喜欢善意地逗弄拘谨的客人，直到他们彻底放松下来。

items.def_en: to make a quick, clever, and often sarcastic joke
items.ex_en: Leave it to Dave to wisecrack sarcastically during our serious team planning meeting.
items.ex_zh: 在我们严肃的团队规划会议上，也就戴夫会忍不住冷嘲热讽地说俏皮话。

items.def_en: [I/T] to laugh at someone and make playful or slightly annoying jokes about them
items.ex_en: Older siblings frequently tease the youngest child about his eccentric collection of comic books.
items.ex_zh: 哥哥姐姐们经常拿最小的弟弟收集那些古怪漫画书的事来取笑他。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate communicating in a humorous, teasing, or witty manner rather than in earnest, varying by whether the speech is a brief remark, playful back-and-forth, or light mockery.
groups.summary_zh: 指非严肃地插科打诨、幽默妙语、互相打趣或开玩笑戏谑。
groups.desc_en: Engaging in speech or behavior intended to amuse and not be taken seriously, contrasting with earnest communication or malicious mockery.
groups.desc_zh: 通过言行引发欢笑且不求被严肃对待，区别于一本正经的沟通或恶意的中伤讽刺。
groups.nuance_en: joke: deliver punchlines or humorous remarks playfully (crowd / friends) · banter: exchange light, teasing remarks reciprocally (colleagues / hosts) · quip: deliver a spontaneous witty or sarcastic one-liner (critic / politician) · jest: archaic or formal playful speaking (courtier / philosopher) · clown around: physically act foolish or boisterous (kids / performers)
groups.nuance_zh: joke: 讲笑话或开玩笑以逗乐 (crowd / friends) · banter: 双向轻松诙谐的打趣互损 (colleagues / hosts) · quip: 机智即兴的妙语或俏皮话 (critic / politician) · jest: 偏书面古雅的诙谐戏言 (courtier / philosopher) · clown around: 动作夸张的扮小丑式胡闹 (kids / performers)

groups.name: Know, Realize & Deeply Comprehend · 知晓、领会与透彻理解 (Know & Comprehend)
groups.tip: 从初步知晓到深入透彻理解

items.def_en: to understand or realize something after an initial period of confusion
items.ex_en: The new fashion trend quickly caught on among teenagers.
items.ex_zh: 这种新的时尚潮流迅速在青少年中流行开来。

items.def_en: (+ to sth) to begin to understand or realize a fact or secret that was not obvious
items.ex_en: The detective finally began to cotton on to the suspect's clever financial scheme.
items.ex_zh: 侦探终于开始察觉并明白了嫌疑人精密的洗钱计划。

items.def_zh: 突然明白，恍然大悟；懂得，理解
items.def_en: (British English, informal) to suddenly understand or realize what is happening or being said
items.ex_en: It took him several minutes to twig that the entire conversation was a setup.
items.ex_zh: 他花了好几分钟才恍然大悟，整场对话其实是个预先设下的圈套。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to succeed in solving, comprehending, or calculating something complex
items.ex_en: Scientists are trying to figure out why the virus mutated so rapidly.
items.ex_zh: 科学家们正试图弄明白这种病毒为何变异得如此之快。

items.def_zh: 知道，了解；认识，熟悉；确信
items.def_en: to have information in your mind; to be familiar with someone or something
items.ex_en: Experienced local guides know these treacherous mountain passes far better than foreign tourists.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的本地向导对这些险峻山口的了解远胜于外国游客。

items.def_zh: 理解，懂得（understand 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: past tense and past participle of understand; to have known or grasped the meaning of something
items.ex_en: She understood the complex technical manual after reading through the introductory chapter twice.
items.ex_zh: 把导论章节读了两遍之后，她理解了那本繁复的技术手册。

items.def_en: to achieve a clear, solid mental hold of a concept, fact, or situation
items.ex_en: Novice students often struggle to grasp the core mathematical principles behind quantum mechanics.
items.ex_zh: 初学者往往很难领会量子力学背后的核心数学原理。

items.def_zh: 弄懂，理解（尤用于否定句）；测出（水的）深度
items.def_en: 1. to understand someone or something after thinking carefully (chiefly negative) 2. to measure the depth of water
items.ex_en: I cannot fathom why he abruptly resigned from such a prestigious academic post.
items.ex_zh: 我实在无法弄懂他为何突然辞去如此享有盛誉的学术职位。

items.def_en: to understand fully and deeply the nature, significance, or meaning of something
items.ex_en: The jury struggled to comprehend the full magnitude of the defendant's white-collar crimes.
items.ex_zh: 陪审团难以完全理解被告所犯白领犯罪行为的全部严重性。

items.def_en: to see into and thoroughly decipher a profound mystery, complex truth, or motive
items.ex_en: Her keen sociological analysis helped penetrate the hidden motives behind the prolonged civil unrest.
items.ex_zh: 她敏锐的社会学分析有助于洞察这场旷日持久的内乱背后的深层动机。

groups.summary_en: This intensity scale progresses from mere factual awareness and sudden colloquial realization to solid intellectual grasp and ultimately penetrating, exhaustive comprehension of profound or elusive truths.
groups.summary_zh: 从基本知晓、忽然领悟到全面理解、洞悉透彻的认知深度递进。
groups.desc_en: Cognitively grasping external truth or underlying mechanics along an axis from initial realization to profound conceptual penetration, unlike superficial familiarity.
groups.desc_zh: 在认知上由浅入深地领悟外部事实或底层机制，区别于浮于表面的了解或死记硬背。
groups.nuance_en: know: possess verified facts or familiar acquaintance (truth / answer / rules) · figure out: deduce a solution through deliberate reasoning (puzzle / motive / schedule) · catch on: belatedly realize an implied trend or joke (slang / trick / concept) · grasp: mentally seize a complex abstract principle (significance / magnitude / theory) · fathom: probe and mentally measure unfathomable depths (motives / mystery / depths)
groups.nuance_zh: know: 掌握确证的事实或信息 (truth / answer / rules) · figure out: 经由推理揣摩得出解法 (puzzle / motive / schedule) · catch on: 迟缓但最终领会暗含之意 (slang / trick / concept) · grasp: 牢固掌握复杂抽象原理 (significance / magnitude / theory) · fathom: 彻底测度理解深奥难测之事 (motives / mystery / depths)

groups.name: Lavishly Decorate & Adorn · 盛装与华饰点缀 (Gild, Bedeck, Garland)
groups.tip: 镀金、挂花环等手法装点表面

items.def_zh: 给……镀金；给……敷上金色；粉饰，虚饰
items.def_en: 1. To cover something with a thin layer of gold or gold paint. 2. To make something look attractive, valuable, or better than it really is.
items.ex_en: The morning sun seemed to gild the ancient cathedral spire in radiant amber light.
items.ex_zh: 晨曦仿佛给古老的大教堂尖顶敷上了一层耀眼的琥珀金光。

items.def_zh: 打扮得花枝招展；盛装打扮
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to dress someone in very fancy, attractive, or ornamental clothes
items.ex_en: She decided to doll up in her best vintage gown for the charity banquet.
items.ex_zh: 她决定换上自己最华丽的复古礼服，盛装打扮出席慈善晚宴。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to furnish, accessorize, or ornament something in an elaborate or stylish manner
items.ex_en: Car enthusiasts love to trick out their sports coupes with custom neon underglow.
items.ex_zh: 汽车发烧友喜欢用定制的底盘霓虹灯把他们的双门跑车装点得酷炫十足。

items.def_zh: 装饰，装点，打扮；给……装上甲板；击倒
items.def_en: 1. (+ out/with) To decorate someone or something, especially for a celebration or special occasion. 2. (informal) To hit someone so hard that they fall to the ground.
items.ex_en: The family gathered early to deck their living room with festive holiday greenery.
items.ex_zh: 全家人早早聚在一起，用喜庆的节日绿植装点起他们的起居室。

items.def_en: to make someone or something more attractive by adding ornaments
items.ex_en: Elaborate antique tapestries adorned the cold stone walls of the medieval banquet hall.
items.ex_zh: 精美繁复的古典挂毯装点着中世纪宴会厅冰冷的石墙。

items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To decorate or crown someone or something with wreaths or garlands of flowers and leaves.
items.ex_en: Villagers gathered to garland the ancient stone fountain with fresh fragrant spring blossoms.
items.ex_zh: 村民们聚拢过来，用散发芳香的初春鲜花为那座古老的石泉戴上花环。

items.def_en: to decorate an object or surface with beautiful artistic details
items.ex_en: Skilled artisans used fine mother-of-pearl inlays to embellish the wooden jewelry casket.
items.ex_zh: 熟练的工匠使用精致的珍珠母贝镶嵌物来美化这只木质首饰盒。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to dress someone or decorate a space lavishly, often for a special event
items.ex_en: They deck out the entire backyard with colorful lights for every birthday party.
items.ex_zh: 每次举办生日聚会，他们都会用彩灯把整个后院精心装点一番。

items.def_en: to decorate an area with strings of flowers, lights, or ribbons hanging in curves
items.ex_en: Twinkling garlands festoon the ancient stone arches along the palace courtyard.
items.ex_zh: 闪烁的花环如彩带般悬垂在宫殿庭院中古老的石拱门上。

items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To decorate a person or thing lavishly with decorations, flowers, jewels, or ribbons.
items.ex_en: Maidens bedeck the bridal chamber with fresh jasmine blossoms before dusk.
items.ex_zh: 黄昏前，少女们用新鲜的茉莉花朵盛装装点新娘的居室。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve enhancing physical surfaces, garments, or spaces with opulent ornaments, wreaths, or decorative layers, often imparting ceremonial splendor or artificial prestige.
groups.summary_zh: 指运用花环、金箔、彩饰等繁复华丽饰物精心装点或铺陈美化。
groups.desc_en: Superimposing ornate, festive, or glittering elements onto an entity to heighten aesthetic grandeur, far exceeding functional utility or plain tidying.
groups.desc_zh: 在实体上叠加华丽、节庆或闪亮的装饰以拔高审美气派，远超实用功能或简单的归置美化。
groups.nuance_en: adorn: elevate beauty through graceful placement (walls / temple / body) · gild: coat superficially in gold or deceptive luster (lily / frame / truth) · deck out: lavishly outfit in striking finery (halls / bride / floats) · garland: encircle ceremonially with wreaths or flowers (statue / winner / altar) · embellish: add elaborate decorative details or exaggerations (tales / garments / facade)
groups.nuance_zh: adorn: 借雅致饰物提升优美感 (walls / temple / body) · gild: 镀金或施加虚饰浮华 (lily / frame / truth) · deck out: 盛装打扮或披红挂彩 (halls / bride / floats) · garland: 用花环花饰环绕装点 (statue / winner / altar) · embellish: 增添繁复细节或润色修饰 (tales / garments / facade)

groups.name: Lay Waste & Demolish · 摧毁与夷平 (Raze, Demolish, Devastate)
groups.tip: 从物理损坏到彻底夷平

items.def_en: to deliberately dismantle or demolish a building or structure
items.ex_en: The old factory was torn down to make way for a modern shopping mall.
items.ex_zh: 那座旧工厂被拆除，以便改建现代化的购物中心。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to demolish, raze, or collapse a building or structure completely
items.ex_en: The old factory was knocked down to make way for a modern shopping center.
items.ex_zh: 旧工厂被拆除，为一座现代化的购物中心腾出了空间。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to intentionally demolish or tear down a building or large structure
items.ex_en: The council decided to pull down the derelict warehouse behind the station.
items.ex_zh: 市政厅决定拆除火车站后面那座废弃已久的仓库。

items.def_zh: 拆毁，拆除；摧毁，彻底驳倒
items.def_en: 1. To knock down or destroy a building completely. 2. To defeat an opponent or disprove an argument thoroughly.
items.ex_en: Engineers plan to demolish the unstable viaduct using controlled precision explosives.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们计划使用定向精密炸药彻底拆除那座不稳固的高架桥。

items.def_en: to completely level or destroy a structure or landscape
items.ex_en: A ferocious tornado threatened to flatten the entire farming hamlet overnight.
items.ex_zh: 一场凶猛的龙卷风眼看就要在一夜之间将整个农庄夷为平地。
items.ex2_en: The rolling hills flatten gradually into endless prairies toward the western border.
items.ex2_zh: 连绵起伏的丘陵向着西部边界逐渐平缓延展为无垠的草原。

items.def_zh: 使成废墟，荒废；使感到极度悲伤孤独
items.def_en: 1. (formal / literary) To devastate or lay waste to a place, leaving it empty and ruined. 2. To make someone feel utterly sad and lonely.
items.ex_en: Relentless winter storms desolate the windswept plains, leaving every farmhouse abandoned.
items.ex_zh: 无情的冬日暴风雪使迎风的平原化为荒原，农舍尽数废弃。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to destroy or demolish something completely by using explosives
items.ex_en: Combat engineers were ordered to blow up the bridge behind retreating units.
items.ex_zh: 工兵们奉命炸毁撤退部队身后的桥梁。
items.ex2_en: The abandoned fireworks factory blew up with a deafening roar yesterday morning.
items.ex2_zh: 废弃的烟花制造厂在昨天早晨伴随着震耳欲聋的巨响发生了爆炸。

items.def_zh: 严重破坏，彻底摧毁；使极为震惊悲痛
items.def_en: 1. To destroy or ruin something completely or cause severe damage to it. 2. To make someone feel extremely shocked, upset, or devastated.
items.ex_en: Severe flash floods devastate low-lying agricultural communities across the river valley.
items.ex_zh: 严重的突发山洪给整个河谷地势低洼的农业社区带来了毁灭性破坏。

items.def_en: to destroy something so completely that no trace or sign of it remains
items.ex_en: A single tactical missile strike can obliterate the remote military outpost.
items.ex_zh: 一枚战术导弹的袭击就能彻底抹去那座偏远的军事哨所。

items.def_en: to completely level a building, town, or settlement to the ground
items.ex_en: Invading armies raze historic villages to break the civilian population's morale.
items.ex_zh: 侵略军将历史悠久的村庄彻底夷平，以瓦解平民的士气。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the complete physical destruction or catastrophic ruin of structures, areas, or systems. They range from orderly or mechanical demolition to wide-scale ruinous devastation.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过物理撞击或浩劫将建筑物、城镇彻底夷平、摧毁或破坏殆尽。
groups.desc_en: Subjecting structures, landscapes, or strongholds to violent structural annihilation or complete leveling, going far beyond localized damage.
groups.desc_zh: 对建筑物、地貌或据点施加毁灭性的暴力拆毁或彻底铲平，远超局部的物理损坏。
groups.nuance_en: demolish: purposefully tear down a heavy structure (building / stadium / arguments) · raze: level completely to ground level (village / fort / city) · flatten: compress or knock flat across an expanse (forest / neighborhood / opponent) · tear down: systematically dismantle or pull down (wall / shacks / monument) · devastate: inflict catastrophic ruin across a broad region (countryside / ecosystem / economy)
groups.nuance_zh: demolish: 有计划地整体爆破或拆毁大型构造物 (building / stadium / arguments) · raze: 将建筑或聚落彻底夷为平地 (village / fort / city) · flatten: 撞平、拍扁或整体推平 (forest / neighborhood / opponent) · tear down: 人工或机械性拆卸拉倒 (wall / shacks / monument) · devastate: 带来大范围灾难性摧毁与荒废 (countryside / ecosystem / economy)

groups.name: Legalize & License · 官方核准与法定确权 (Authorize, Patent, License)
groups.tip: 官方或法律赋予权利

items.def_zh: 取得……的专利权；授予……专利权
items.def_en: to obtain a government patent for an invention or process, or grant a patent on.
items.ex_en: The research institute intends to patent its newly synthesized chemical catalyst.
items.ex_zh: 该研究所打算为其新合成的化学催化剂申请国家专利。

items.def_zh: 授予特许经营权；赋予公民权（尤指选举权）
items.def_en: 1. to grant a franchise to market goods or commercial services. 2. to grant the right to vote to.
items.ex_en: The beverage corporation agreed to franchise retail distribution across northern regions.
items.ex_zh: 这家饮料公司同意在北部各地区授予零售分销的特许经营权。

items.def_en: to grant a formal charter establishing a city, company, or university
items.ex_en: The royal decree sought to charter an independent technical university downtown.
items.ex_zh: 这项皇家法令旨在特许在市中心建立一所独立的理工大学。

items.def_zh: 获得……的版权；保护……的著作权
items.def_en: to secure the exclusive legal copyright on a piece of written, artistic, or musical work.
items.ex_en: Composers must promptly copyright their original orchestral scores to prevent plagiarism.
items.ex_zh: 作曲家必须及时为自己的原创管弦乐谱取得版权，以防止抄袭。

items.def_en: to provide with official credentials or license signifying qualified professional status
items.ex_en: State medical boards strictly credential specialized surgeons before authorizing hospital privileges.
items.ex_zh: 州医疗委员会在授予医生执业权限之前，会对专科外科医生严格核发资质。

items.def_en: (+ on sth) to give formal or statutory approval to sth
items.ex_en: The legal department must sign off on the draft agreement tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 法务部门必须在明天对这份协议草案正式签署批准。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to officially authorize and clear sb/sth through regulatory checks
items.ex_en: The urgent shipment took over twenty-four hours to clear through customs inspections.
items.ex_zh: 那批紧急货物花了一整天多的时间才通过海关检验。

items.def_zh: 在（护照等）上签注；为……签发签证
items.def_en: to endorse or issue an official visa on a passport or travel document.
items.ex_en: Consular officers will visa diplomatic passports following expedited background verification procedures.
items.ex_zh: 在完成加急背景审查程序后，领事官员将为外交护照办理签证签注。

items.def_zh: 批准，认可，准许；对……实施制裁
items.def_en: 1. to give official authorization or approval to. 2. to impose punitive sanctions against.
items.ex_en: Regulatory agencies refuse to sanction corporate mergers that undermine market competition.
items.ex_zh: 监管机构拒绝正式批准有损市场公平竞争的企业合并。

items.def_en: to register a name, phrase, or logo as an official trademark
items.ex_en: Tech startups often trademark unique product names before launching marketing campaigns.
items.ex_zh: 科技初创公司通常在开展营销推广前将独特的产品名称注册为商标。

groups.summary_en: This scenario covers formal governmental or commercial acts that confer exclusive legal monopoly, statutory permission, or official immigration/regulatory clearance to individuals, products, or entities.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及政府或权威机构通过法定程序授予特许权、知识产权排他权或准入资质。
groups.desc_en: Conferring institutional, state, or proprietary legal legitimacy and operational privileges, unlike informal social approval or permissive consent.
groups.desc_zh: 由机构、国家或知识产权法赋予排他性合法权与经营权，区别于非正式的社会默许或口头许可。
groups.nuance_en: patent: secure exclusive intellectual ownership over an invention (device / formula / design) · copyright: register exclusive artistic or textual publication rights (song / book / software) · charter: grant constitutional rights or officially hire transport (bank / flight / vessel) · franchise: grant commercial operating privileges to an operator (dealership / restaurant / brand) · sign off: officially endorse or execute final sign-off (budget / proposal / release)
groups.nuance_zh: patent: 为发明创见取得专利确权 (device / formula / design) · copyright: 为艺术或文本作品确立版权 (song / book / software) · charter: 颁发特许状立案或特惠包租 (bank / flight / vessel) · franchise: 授予商业特许经营特权 (dealership / restaurant / brand) · sign off: 签字批准予以最终认可 (budget / proposal / release)

groups.name: Linger & Loiter · 逗留与磨蹭 (Loiter, Dally, Tarry)
groups.tip: 拖延时间、停留逗留或停滞

items.def_en: to linger, wait, or spend time in a place without doing much
items.ex_en: Bored teenagers often hang around the convenience store parking lot after sunset.
items.ex_zh: 百无聊赖的青少年们日落后常常在便利店的停车场附近闲荡。

items.def_en: to linger idly or stand around in an area without obvious purpose
items.ex_en: Suspicious figures loiter about the dimly lit pedestrian underpass every evening.
items.ex_zh: 每天傍晚，总有可疑人员在昏暗的人行地下通道里游荡徘徊。

items.def_en: to remain in a place rather than leave, often waiting for something
items.ex_en: You should stick around until the band plays their final encore.
items.ex_zh: 你应该留下来不走，等乐队演奏完最后一首返场曲目。

items.def_en: (+ on/around) to stay in a place longer than necessary, typically out of reluctance to leave
items.ex_en: Nostalgic alumni linger around the campus garden long after graduation ceremonies.
items.ex_zh: 毕业典礼结束许久后，怀旧的校友们依然流连在校园花园里不愿离去。

items.def_zh: 闲逛；游荡；虚度时间逗留
items.def_en: to stand or wait around idly with no apparent purpose
items.ex_en: Municipal bylaws forbid unauthorized individuals to loiter outside government installations.
items.ex_zh: 市政法规禁止未获授权的人员在政府设施外游荡逗留。

items.def_zh: 磨蹭；延误；漫不经心地闲荡
items.def_en: (+ over) to act or move slowly, wasting time
items.ex_en: Do not dally over minor matters when critical deadlines approach swiftly.
items.ex_zh: 临近紧要期限时，切莫在细枝末节上磨蹭浪费时间。

items.def_en: (archaic or literary) To stay longer than intended, delay leaving, or linger.
items.ex_en: Weary pilgrims tarry beneath the monastery walls as twilight darkens across valleys.
items.ex_zh: 暮色笼罩山谷之际，疲惫的朝圣者在修道院高墙下迟迟未行。

items.def_en: 1. To move slowly or take much longer than necessary to do something, especially by lingering or wasting time.
items.ex_en: Schoolchildren often dawdle along the garden path, ignoring their morning bells.
items.ex_zh: 学童们经常在花园小径上磨磨蹭蹭，对早读铃声充耳不闻。

items.def_en: to hesitate to proceed or stay behind the main group out of reluctance
items.ex_en: Timid recruits hang back while seasoned veterans advance into the woods.
items.ex_zh: 胆怯的新兵畏缩不前，经验丰富的老兵则率先向树林挺进。

items.def_zh: 踌躇不前，止步不前；抗拒，不情愿做（jib at）
items.def_en: 1. (especially of an animal) To stop suddenly and refuse to go forward; (+ at) to be unwilling to do or accept something.
items.ex_en: The nervous pack horse would jib at crossing the swollen torrent.
items.ex_zh: 那匹紧张的驮马在汹涌的激流前踌躇止步，不肯向前。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict an agent staying in a place longer than necessary, moving reluctantly, or idling aimlessly rather than departing promptly.
groups.summary_zh: 指在某处过久逗留、步调拖沓磨蹭或不愿前行而迟滞耽搁的行为。
groups.desc_en: Protracted, aimless physical presence or sluggish progression in an area without urgent purpose, contrasting with decisive movement or punctuality.
groups.desc_zh: 在某处无急迫目的、拖拉而漫无目的地逗留或迟延行动，区别于果断行进或准时赴约。
groups.nuance_en: linger: remain reluctantly as though unwilling to leave (aroma / memory / guests) · loiter: hang around a public place without clear lawful intent (suspects / youths / corner) · dally: waste time flirtatiously or frivolously (with lovers / on the way / with ideas) · dawdle: advance with sluggish, wasteful slowness (children / pedestrian / pace) · tarry: literary delay in departure or stay temporarily (in town / journey)
groups.nuance_zh: linger: 依依不舍或经久未散地徘徊留恋 (aroma / memory / guests) · loiter: 在公共场所无明确合法意图地闲逛游荡 (suspects / youths / corner) · dally: 调情或漫不经心地耽搁蹉跎 (with lovers / on the way / with ideas) · dawdle: 磨蹭拖拉、步调拖沓 (children / pedestrian / pace) · tarry: 文雅用语中的暂作歇息或延误启程 (in town / journey)

groups.name: Liquid Discharge: Trickle to Deluge · 细淌与奔涌 (Trickle, Cascade, Deluge)
groups.tip: 水量过满而向外漫溢

items.def_zh: 细细地流，滴流；使缓缓流淌；缓慢移动
items.def_en: 1. (+ down/into/out) When liquid, people, or money trickle, they flow slowly in a very thin stream or small numbers. 2. To make a liquid flow in a thin stream.
items.ex_en: Melted snow begins to trickle down the mossy hillside during early spring.
items.ex_zh: 初春时节，融化的雪水开始顺着长满苔藓的山坡细细流淌。
items.ex2_en: The careful bartender trickled sweet syrup slowly along the interior glass edge.
items.ex2_zh: 细心的调酒师将甜糖浆缓缓沿着玻璃杯内壁滴下。

items.def_en: to trickle or fall out slowly in small, intermittent drops
items.ex_en: Dark motor oil continued to dribble out through a hairline crack.
items.ex_zh: 黑色的机油继续顺着一道细微的发丝裂缝点滴流出。

items.def_en: Flow or run over the edge, margin, or boundary of a receptacle
items.ex_en: Boiling tea began to spill over the porcelain rim onto linoleum.
items.ex_zh: 沸腾的茶水开始漫过瓷壶边缘，溢流到了油毡桌面上。

items.def_en: to spurt or flow out suddenly and in large quantities
items.ex_en: Pressurized water would gush out whenever maintenance crews adjusted that valve.
items.ex_zh: 每当维修人员调节那个阀门时，带压的水便猛烈喷涌而出。

items.def_en: to flow, gush, or stream rapidly and abundantly from an opening
items.ex_en: She poured out her troubles to her best friend over coffee.
items.ex_zh: 她一边喝咖啡一边向闺蜜倾诉自己的烦恼。
items.ex2_en: Tearful grievances poured out uncontrollably as she confronted her estranged family members.
items.ex2_zh: 当她面对疏远的家人时，满腹委屈泪如雨下地倾泻而出。

items.def_en: 1. (+ with) When a container, river, or sink overflows, liquid spills over its edges; to be filled beyond capacity. 2. To be full of strong emotion.
items.ex_en: Torrential rain caused mountain streams to overflow their banks within minutes.
items.ex_zh: 倾盆大雨导致山间溪流在数分钟内便泛滥漫过堤岸。
items.ex2_en: The municipal drainage basin overflowed continuously after several days of relentless downpours.
items.ex2_zh: 经过几天的倾盆大雨，市政蓄水池水满外溢个不停。

items.def_zh: 如瀑布般倾泻，大量涌出
items.def_en: (+ down/over) When water, hair, or information cascades, it falls or flows rapidly downward in large quantities.
items.ex_en: Crystal waters cascade over jagged rocks into the tranquil forest basin below.
items.ex_zh: 清澈的泉水如瀑布般从参差的岩石倾泻而下，汇入下方的幽静林潭。

items.def_en: [I/T] Discharge or issue forcefully out in a concentrated stream or jet
items.ex_en: Ruptured pipes spout boiling coolant across the automated factory assembly line.
items.ex_zh: 破裂的管道将滚烫的冷却液猛烈喷射在自动化工厂的装配线上。
items.ex2_en: Geysers spout high into the air along the volcanic thermal rift zone.
items.ex2_zh: 间歇泉沿着火山地热断裂带向高空喷涌而出。

items.def_en: [I/T] Flow out suddenly, rapidly, and in copious volume
items.ex_en: Sudden geysers gush scalding steam into chilly morning air along faults.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的间歇泉顺着地质断层向清冽的晨空中喷涌出滚烫的蒸汽。
items.ex2_en: Cold spring water gushed continuously from deep fissures within the limestone cave.
items.ex2_zh: 冰凉的泉水从石灰岩洞穴深处的裂隙中源源不断地涌出。

items.def_en: Inundate or overwhelm completely with a massive rush of water
items.ex_en: Severe storms deluge coastal villages with immense volumes of tidal saltwater.
items.ex_zh: 狂烈的风暴以滔滔潮水彻底淹没了沿海的渔村。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this manner frame depict liquids (or granular substances) pouring, discharging, and overflowing. The manner varies from a tenuous, slow dribble through breached containers, to steep cascading, and finally explosive, overwhelming surges.
groups.summary_zh: 描述液体或流体从细流缓滴、外溢漫出到如瀑布般倾泻与奔涌的不同形态。
groups.desc_en: Discharging fluids across a dynamic gradient from minute sluggish seepage to violent turbulent surges, contrasting with steady laminar conduit flow.
groups.desc_zh: 液体从微弱渗沥到狂暴奔涌的动态排放表征，区别于管道内平稳的层流输送。
groups.nuance_en: trickle: flow in a thin, intermittent drops or stream (sweat / tears / tap) · gush out: erupt with explosive sudden volumetric force (oil / blood / torrent) · cascade: tumble downward across layered heights (waterfall / locks / silk) · spout: shoot forth in a focused pressurized jet (whale / fountain / geyser) · spill over: slosh past borders from excessive volume (brim / soup / banks)
groups.nuance_zh: trickle: 细若游丝、断断续续地滴淌 (sweat / tears / tap) · gush out: 承压瞬间猛烈喷涌迸出 (oil / blood / torrent) · cascade: 沿阶梯层层跌落飞泻 (waterfall / locks / silk) · spout: 呈柱状定向受压喷射 (whale / fountain / geyser) · spill over: 超出承载边际而溢出翻滚 (brim / soup / banks)

groups.name: Load & Store Bulk Cargo · 散装装载与入罐贮存 (Load, Bunker, Discharge)
groups.tip: 将物品装入容器或运输工具

items.def_zh: 装载，装上（货物或乘客）；装填（弹药等）；（使）担负；（计算机）加载
items.def_en: 1. To put a large quantity of things or people into a vehicle or container. 2. To put ammunition into a gun or film into a camera. 3. (computing) To copy data or a program into a computer's memory.
items.ex_en: Stevedores load heavy wooden crates onto freight vessels along foggy wharves.
items.ex_zh: 码头工人在雾气笼罩的泊位边把沉重的木箱装载到货船上。
items.ex2_en: The heavy freight train loaded smoothly under the supervision of dock officials.
items.ex2_zh: 在码头官员的监督下，重型货运列车的装货过程进行得很顺利。

items.def_zh: 把……储存在储罐（或大容器）中；把（液体）注入容器；彻底失败，暴跌
items.def_en: 1. To store a liquid or substance in a tank or large container. 2. (informal) To fail completely or fall rapidly in value.
items.ex_en: Refinery workers tank excess biofuel before closing valves for routine maintenance.
items.ex_zh: 炼油厂工人在关闭阀门进行日常维护前，把多余的生物燃料注入储罐。

items.def_en: to place and seal grain or bulk materials into a silo for storage
items.ex_en: Farmers silo newly harvested corn to preserve livestock feed throughout winter.
items.ex_zh: 农民把刚收获的玉米存入筒仓中密封，以备整个冬季作牲畜饲料。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to fill a vehicle, ship, or container fully with cargo or fuel
items.ex_en: Truck drivers load up refrigerated trailers before departing on cross-country routes.
items.ex_zh: 卡车司机在踏上跨国运输路线前，将冷藏挂车装满货物。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to remove bulk liquid or sludge from a tank, bilge, or vessel using a pump
items.ex_en: The studio continues to pump out low-budget sequels every summer.
items.ex_zh: 该制片厂每年夏天都持续大量炮制低成本续集。

items.def_zh: 妥善存放，把（货物或物品）码放收藏好
items.def_en: (+ sth) to pack or store cargo neatly and securely in its proper place
items.ex_en: Crew members stow away emergency rations neatly inside waterproof deck lockers.
items.ex_zh: 船员们将应急口粮整齐地稳妥存放在甲板上的防水储物箱内。

items.def_zh: 卸载（大宗货物/流体）；倒空
items.def_en: [I/T] to unload bulk cargo, liquids, or passengers from a ship or conveyance
items.ex_en: Tankers discharge thousands of barrels of crude oil at maritime terminals.
items.ex_zh: 油轮在海运码头卸载数以千计桶的原油。

items.def_zh: 给（船等）注油；装入燃料舱
items.def_en: [I/T] to load fuel oil or coal into a ship's bunkers or storage reservoirs
items.ex_en: Deep-sea vessels bunker heavy marine fuel amidst howling gales at midnight.
items.ex_zh: 远洋船只在午夜的呼啸风暴中向燃料舱注入重型船用燃料油。

items.def_zh: 卸（货），从……卸下货物；脱手，倾销；摆脱（负担），倾诉
items.def_en: 1. To remove goods, cargo, or passengers from a vehicle, ship, or container. 2. To get rid of unwanted goods, assets, or responsibilities by selling or passing them on to someone else. 3. To remove ammunition from a weapon.
items.ex_en: Dockers work swiftly to unload container ships arriving from international ports.
items.ex_zh: 码头工人迅速作业，从国际港口抵港的集装箱船上卸下货物。
items.ex2_en: The enormous cargo vessel unloads quickly when automated crane systems operate properly.
items.ex2_zh: 当自动化起重系统正常运转时，庞大的货轮卸货非常迅速。

items.def_en: (+ away/in) to pack or store cargo securely in a specific compartment or hold
items.ex_en: Sailors stow bulky canvas sails securely in forward holds before storms.
items.ex_zh: 水手们在风暴来临前将笨重的帆布风帆妥善存放在前舱内。

groups.summary_en: Cargo handlers or logistics operators fill vessels, holds, tanks, or bulk storage facilities with bulk liquid, fuel, or freight, or conversely pump/empty it out.
groups.summary_zh: 在大型储罐、船舱或货台进行大宗货品与燃料的装卸与贮存。
groups.desc_en: Handling, transferring, and warehousing large-scale bulk commodities or fuels into heavy logistics containers, unlike parcel packing or home storage.
groups.desc_zh: 对大宗散装货品或燃料进行装载、转运与专业容器仓储，不同于件杂货打包或日常家用收纳。
groups.nuance_en: load: transfer cargo or freight into a transport vessel (freight / container / grain) · bunker: refuel ships with heavy marine oil supplies (vessel / fleet / coal) · silo: deposit grain or isolate materials in tall towers (grain / wheat / data) · discharge: systematically unload bulk freight at port (cargo / ballast / tanker) · pump out: evacuate liquids mechanically through suction pipes (bilge / sumps / tanks)
groups.nuance_zh: load: 将大宗货物装上运输运载器 (freight / container / grain) · bunker: 船舶配注大宗燃料油或配煤 (vessel / fleet / coal) · silo: 筒仓封闭贮存散粮或孤立存储 (grain / wheat / data) · discharge: 码头卸除散装海运物资 (cargo / ballast / tanker) · pump out: 机械抽吸排空积液 (bilge / sumps / tanks)

groups.name: Marginalize & Ostracize · 排斥与孤立 (Social Exclusion & Isolation)
groups.tip: 群体将边缘人物排挤孤立

items.def_en: to separate someone or something physically or socially from others
items.ex_en: Quarantine officers isolate contagious patients to prevent municipal transmission during outbreaks.
items.ex_zh: 防疫官员在疫情期间将传染病患者隔离开来，以防止在市内传播。

items.def_en: to cause someone to stop supporting you or to feel isolated from their environment
items.ex_en: Unreasonable executive policies alienate dedicated employees across several regional branch offices.
items.ex_zh: 不合理的管理政策让几个区域分公司的敬业员工深感疏远寒心。

items.def_zh: 排挤，使边缘化，使处于次要地位
items.def_en: To treat a person, group, or viewpoint as insignificant and push them to the fringes of society or an organization.
items.ex_en: Biased institutional practices marginalize minority applicants seeking leadership positions within firms.
items.ex_zh: 带有偏见的制度性做法将寻求公司领导职位的少数群体申请人边缘化。

items.def_en: (+ from) (often passive) To cause someone to become distant, unfriendly, or alienated from friends, family, or society.
items.ex_en: Prolonged financial disputes estrange the stubborn brothers from remaining family members.
items.ex_zh: 旷日持久的财产纠纷让这对倔强的兄弟与其余家族成员日渐疏远。

items.def_zh: 使隔离，使隐居，使与外界隔绝
items.def_en: (also 'seclude oneself') To keep someone or oneself apart from other people in a quiet, isolated, or private place.
items.ex_en: Monks seclude themselves within remote mountain hermitages for silent seasonal contemplation.
items.ex_zh: 僧人们隐居在偏远的山间草庵内，进行长达数月的静默静修。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to deliberately exclude or marginalize someone through hostile or cold treatment
items.ex_en: Envious colleagues conspire to freeze out competent newcomers from important projects.
items.ex_zh: 心怀嫉妒的同事们串通一气，在重要项目中排挤有能力的新人。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to exclude someone deliberately from social participation, intimacy, or belonging
items.ex_en: Clicks within high schools often shut out newcomers from social gatherings.
items.ex_zh: 高中里的小圈子往往把新来的同学拒之门外，不让他们参与聚会。

items.def_en: to intentionally exclude someone from a society, community, or group
items.ex_en: Village elders ostracize anyone who defies traditional agrarian customs without remorse.
items.ex_zh: 村里的长辈们会集体排挤孤立任何毫无悔意违抗传统农耕习俗的人。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to expel or banish someone forcibly from a group, community, or society
items.ex_en: Tribal leaders cast out rebellious heretics into unforgiving desert wastes alone.
items.ex_zh: 部落领袖将叛逆的异端分子驱逐流放到荒无人烟的严酷沙漠中。

items.def_en: to officially send someone away from a country or community as an authoritative punishment
items.ex_en: Courts banish corrupt officials from borders under ancient legal penal doctrines.
items.ex_zh: 法院依据古代刑法法理将贪官污吏永远驱逐出边境之外。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate pushing an individual or group away from mainstream social participation, affection, or community standing. They range along an intensity continuum from pushing someone to social margins or withdrawing into privacy, through emotional alienation, up to total formal expulsion or banishment.
groups.summary_zh: 从社交圈或权力中心推开、疏远乃至彻底放逐孤立。
groups.desc_en: Systematically banishing, pushing to boundaries, or freezing out an individual or cohort from communal belonging, unlike physical containment or equal dispute.
groups.desc_zh: 系统性地将个体或群体排挤至外围、断绝交往或逐出集体，区别于单纯人身拘禁或平等的争执交锋。
groups.nuance_en: isolate: separate completely from contact or support (patients / country / prisoners) · ostracize: collectively banish socially by consensus (defector / outcast / dissident) · marginalize: relegate to an powerless social periphery (minorities / voices / elders) · freeze out: cold-shoulder someone deliberately out of a clique or deal (rival / newcomer / partner) · estrange: destroy affectionate ties through alienation (family / spouse / friends)
groups.nuance_zh: isolate: 物理或联系上彻底隔绝 (patients / country / prisoners) · ostracize: 群体一致裁决予以放逐与排斥 (defector / outcast / dissident) · marginalize: 将群体边缘化并剥夺话语权 (minorities / voices / elders) · freeze out: 用冷漠手段将人排挤出圈 (rival / newcomer / partner) · estrange: 离间破坏亲近的情感关系 (family / spouse / friends)

groups.name: Mastication & Auditory Chewing · 咀嚼与咬碎声响 (Masticate, Chomp, Cranch)
groups.tip: 牙齿用力磨碎食物的动作

items.def_en: (+ on) to chew steadily and audibly, often with pleasure
items.ex_en: Spectators happily munch on buttery popcorn while watching evening football matches.
items.ex_zh: 观众们一边观看晚间的足球比赛，一边津津有味地嚼着黄油爆米花。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to crush and grind solid food thoroughly using one's teeth
items.ex_en: Toddlers must chew up roasted carrots thoroughly before attempting to swallow.
items.ex_zh: 幼儿在尝试吞咽之前，必须把烤胡萝卜彻底嚼碎。

items.def_zh: 大口咀嚼，用力咬（通常后接 on）
items.def_en: (+ on sth) to bite down noisily, forcefully, and repeatedly on food
items.ex_en: Hungry campers chomp down on grilled sausages beside the glowing fire.
items.ex_zh: 饥肠辘辘的露营者在微红的篝火旁大口用力嚼着烤香肠。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to chew hard, crisp food with a loud crushing sound
items.ex_en: Children crunch on crisp potato wafers during late afternoon study breaks.
items.ex_zh: 傍晚课间休息时，孩子们嘎吱嘎吱地咬嚼着香脆的薯片。

items.def_en: to chew or bite on something vigorously, noisily, and repeatedly
items.ex_en: Restless stallions champ their iron bits while waiting near starting gates.
items.ex_zh: 焦躁不安的种马在起跑门旁等待时，响亮地用力咬着嘴里的铁嚼子。

items.def_en: to crush and chew crisp food noisily between the teeth
items.ex_en: Diners crunch fresh celery stalks accompanied by savory homemade blue cheese.
items.ex_zh: 食客们嘎吱嘎吱地咬碎新鲜的芹菜梗，配上风味浓郁的自制蓝纹奶酪。

items.def_zh: 大声咀嚼，使劲地嚼，用力咬
items.def_en: To bite and chew food noisily and energetically.
items.ex_en: Tired hikers sit down and chomp juicy apples beside forest brooks.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的徒步旅行者在林间溪水旁坐下，大声使劲地嚼着多汁的苹果。

items.def_zh: 嘎吱嘎吱地咬嚼；咬碎，嚼碎
items.def_en: To crush, grind, or chew noisily between the teeth.
items.ex_en: The child loved to cranch candied apples until sugar coated his teeth.
items.ex_zh: 那个孩子喜欢嘎吱嘎吱地嚼着太妃糖苹果，直到牙齿上沾满糖浆。

items.def_en: To chew food thoroughly with the teeth before swallowing.
items.ex_en: Patients are advised to masticate their meals thoroughly before attempting to swallow.
items.ex_zh: 建议患者在尝试吞咽前先将食物充分咀嚼碎。

items.def_en: (+ on/at) to bite or chew persistently at something hard
items.ex_en: The puppy began to gnaw on the tough wooden leg of the chair.
items.ex_zh: 小狗开始执着地啃咬坚硬的木质椅子腿。

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies the mechanical crushing and chewing of solid food in the mouth, often marked by distinctive crunching or noisy gnawing sounds.
groups.summary_zh: 指口腔粉碎食物的咀嚼动作，多伴有咯吱、大口咀嚼等听觉质感。
groups.desc_en: Crushing and grinding solid food between teeth accompanied by acoustic chewing textures, contrasting with passive swallowing or silent sipping.
groups.desc_zh: 用上下牙齿粉碎研磨坚硬或脆性食物并伴随明显声响，区别于无声啜饮或直接吞咽。
groups.nuance_en: munch: chew steadily and audibly with pleasant rhythmic cadence (popcorn / chips / apples) · chomp: bite down aggressively and vigorously with open jaws (cigar / bit / burger) · crunch: crush brittle or crisp material with distinct cracking sound (carrots / gravel / bones) · champ: bite restlessly or noisily in impatience (bit / oats / jaws) · chew up: masticate thoroughly into pulp (meat / cud / foliage)
groups.nuance_zh: munch: 规律有味且津津有味地咀嚼 (popcorn / chips / apples) · chomp: 张大嘴大力使劲大嚼大咬 (cigar / bit / burger) · crunch: 咬碎嘎吱作响的酥脆之物 (carrots / gravel / bones) · champ: 躁动不耐烦地吧唧咀嚼或咬住 (bit / oats / jaws) · chew up: 充分细嚼咬烂至糊状 (meat / cud / foliage)

groups.name: Match & Correspond in Accordance · 契合与对应 (Match, Fit, Correspond)
groups.tip: 两事互相吻合相称

items.def_en: (+ with) to be in complete agreement or harmony with a rule, principle, or fact
items.ex_en: The committee's recommendations accord fully with the newly introduced corporate policies.
items.ex_zh: 委员会的建议完全符合新出台的公司政策。

items.def_zh: 相匹配，相符合；与……相称；比得上，敌得过
items.def_en: 1. To be equal to, identical with, or suitable for something else. 2. To find something that corresponds to or goes well with another.
items.ex_en: His description of the suspect does not match the security camera footage.
items.ex_zh: 他对嫌疑人的描述与监控录像并不相符。

items.def_zh: 合适，合身；与……相契合，符合；安装
items.def_en: 1. To be of the right shape and size for someone or something. 2. To be suitable, compatible, or in agreement with something.
items.ex_en: These experimental findings fit the theoretical framework proposed by the research team.
items.ex_zh: 这些实验结果与该研究团队提出的理论框架相契合。
items.ex2_en: The tailor carefully fitted the bespoke wedding suit to the groom's measurements.
items.ex2_zh: 裁缝根据新郎的尺寸精心调整并试穿了定制的婚礼西服。

items.def_zh: 适合，适宜；与……相配，衬托；使适应
items.def_en: 1. To be convenient, appropriate, or acceptable for someone. 2. (of clothes, colors, or hairstyles) To make someone look attractive. 3. To be right for a particular purpose or situation.
items.ex_en: The proposed schedule will suit both teams perfectly for the upcoming tournament.
items.ex_zh: 拟定的时间表完全适合即将参赛的两支队伍。

items.def_zh: 相符，一致；相当，相对应；通信
items.def_en: 1. To match, be consistent, or be similar to something. 2. To communicate by exchanging letters, emails, or messages.
items.ex_en: The recorded inventory figures correspond exactly to the physical count conducted yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 记录在册的库存数据与昨天进行的实物盘点完全吻合。

items.def_zh: 相吻合，相契合，保持一致
items.def_en: to correspond closely, agree, or be equal to something else
items.ex_en: The suspect's fingerprints did not match up with those found at the crime scene.
items.ex_zh: 嫌疑人的指纹与案发现场提取的指纹并不吻合。
items.ex2_en: The forensic investigator matched up the bullet casings with the seized weapon.
items.ex2_zh: 法医调查员将弹壳与缴获的凶器进行了比对吻合。

items.def_en: (+ with sth) to be suitable, harmonious, or consistent with other things
items.ex_en: Her innovative strategy did not fit in with the conservative company culture.
items.ex_zh: 她的创新策略与保守的公司文化并不合拍。

items.def_en: (+ with sth) to align or agree precisely with facts, expectations, or standards
items.ex_en: The actual sales figures line up with our optimistic quarterly financial projections.
items.ex_zh: 实际销售数据与我们乐观的季度财务预测相契合。
items.ex2_en: The analyst lined up the quarterly revenue statistics with the revised forecast.
items.ex2_zh: 分析师将季度收入统计数据与修正后的预测对齐吻合。

items.def_en: (+ with) to match or agree closely with another set of records or facts
items.ex_en: The suspect's statement did not tally with the detailed records of the bank.
items.ex_zh: 嫌疑人的供词与银行的详细记录并不吻合。
items.ex2_en: The accountant tallies the receipts every evening to confirm the total balance.
items.ex2_zh: 会计每天晚上核对收据，以确认总账目相符。

items.def_en: (+ to/with) to behave according to or match an established rule, pattern, or standard
items.ex_en: All manufactured vehicles must conform to the strict environmental emission regulations.
items.ex_zh: 所有制造的车辆都必须符合严格的环保排放标准。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe two or more entities being congruent, compatible, or equivalent in dimension, pattern, requirements, or functional role.
groups.summary_zh: 指事物之间在尺寸、属性、模式或规范上相互一致、吻合或对应。
groups.desc_en: Exhibiting structural, aesthetic, or qualitative congruence between complementary parts, distinct from establishing absolute identity or transformation.
groups.desc_zh: 互补成分之间在结构、美学或性质上表现出的吻合呼应，区别于变为完全同一或单向转化。
groups.nuance_en: match: pair identically or harmonize symmetrically (socks / colors / serials) · fit: meet exact physical dimensions or qualifications (shoe / puzzle / description) · correspond: correlate point-by-point in logic or mapping (records / numbers / signals) · accord: exist in complete harmonized agreement or treaty (treaties / views / behavior) · suit: flatter personal traits or satisfy distinct convenience (lifestyle / tastes / schedule)
groups.nuance_zh: match: 形式质感配对成双或视觉协调 (socks / colors / serials) · fit: 物理尺寸严密扣合或条件吻合 (shoe / puzzle / description) · correspond: 逻辑、映射或点对点呼应 (records / numbers / signals) · accord: 条款或精神高度协同一致 (treaties / views / behavior) · suit: 契合个性偏好或符合便利需求 (lifestyle / tastes / schedule)

groups.name: Mathematical Computation & Re-computation · 数学运算与重算校核 (Compute, Tot, Recalculate)
groups.tip: 按公式数字精细核算

items.def_en: (+ sth) to calculate the total of two or more numbers or amounts
items.ex_en: She sat down quietly to add up the receipts from her business trip.
items.ex_zh: 她静静地坐下来，把出差的收据金额加在一起。

items.def_zh: 结算；清点并计算出总数
items.def_en: (+ sth) to calculate the final total of points, figures, or items
items.ex_en: Let me tally up your grocery items before you swipe your card.
items.ex_zh: 在你刷卡之前，让我先结算出你所购杂货的总数。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to add numbers together to find the total amount
items.ex_en: We need to tot up the final scores before announcing the winner.
items.ex_zh: 我们需要在公布获胜者之前合计出最终的分数。

items.def_en: (+ up) to calculate the total sum of multiple numbers or quantities
items.ex_en: The accountant will sum up the daily transactions at the close of business.
items.ex_zh: 会计将在营业结束时计算出每日交易的总额。

items.def_en: (also 'tot up') (chiefly British informal) To add numbers or amounts together to find the total sum.
items.ex_en: Wait a moment while I tot up the bill for our dinner.
items.ex_zh: 等一会儿，我把我们晚餐的账单合计一下。

items.def_zh: 算错，误算；误判，估计错误
items.def_en: 1. To calculate a number or amount incorrectly. 2. To judge or estimate a situation or risk wrongly.
items.ex_en: The engineers miscalculated the structural load, resulting in a dangerous roof crack.
items.ex_zh: 工程师算错了结构荷载，导致屋顶出现了危险的裂缝。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to calculate an amount, cost, or value mathematically
items.ex_en: We must work out the total repair costs before signing the contractor agreement.
items.ex_zh: 在签署承包合同之前，我们必须计算出总维修费用。

items.def_zh: 计算，估算；（计算机）处理，运算
items.def_en: 1. To calculate an amount or number mathematically, especially using a computer.
items.ex_en: The supercomputer took several hours to compute the complex orbital trajectory paths.
items.ex_zh: 超级计算机花费了数小时来计算复杂的轨道运行轨迹。

items.def_en: to arrange numbers, figures, or data into systematic columns or tables
items.ex_en: Researchers carefully tabulate the survey responses into organized, easy-to-read statistical columns.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员仔细地将调查问卷的回答制表列联，整理成清晰易读的统计列。

items.def_en: 1. To calculate a figure, cost, or amount again, especially to correct errors or update data.
items.ex_en: Analysts must recalculate the project estimates after the sudden surge in raw material costs.
items.ex_zh: 在原材料成本激增后，分析师必须重新核算项目估算。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this procedural frame describe executing arithmetic operations, aggregating sums, or running mathematical calculations again to correct errors or update quantitative figures.
groups.summary_zh: 指执行算术求和、公式运算或重新验算校正数值结果。
groups.desc_en: Applying methodical numerical calculation, running sums, or arithmetic reckoning to reconcile totals, distinct from speculative guessing.
groups.desc_zh: 通过系统的数理规则、跑和汇总或算术验算得出总数，不同于主观的模糊揣度。
groups.nuance_en: compute: process mathematical data methodically via algorithms (taxes / trajectory / risk) · add up: combine numbers into a sum or make cumulative sense (figures / expenses / clues) · tally up: record running counts against actual tallies (scores / votes / receipts) · tot up: aggregate quickly into an informal total (bill / damage / points) · work out: calculate a numerical result through progressive steps (cost / average / equation)
groups.nuance_zh: compute: 借算法程序进行精密计算 (taxes / trajectory / risk) · add up: 累加求和或在逻辑上说得通 (figures / expenses / clues) · tally up: 依计分或清单逐笔核算总计 (scores / votes / receipts) · tot up: 口语化地快速划算总账 (bill / damage / points) · work out: 循序推演解出运算数值 (cost / average / equation)

groups.name: Mechanical Fastening & Joining · 紧固与机械连接 (Fasten, Staple, Rivet)
groups.tip: 铆接或拉链加固物体

items.def_en: to fasten or hold together with a clip, clasp, or pin
items.ex_en: She used a polished silver pin to clip the identification badge to her lapel.
items.ex_zh: 她用一枚亮银色的别针将身份胸牌别在翻领上。

items.def_zh: 用订书钉钉住，用订书机订上
items.def_en: To attach or fasten things together using staples.
items.ex_en: Please staple these reference sheets together so none of the pages get lost.
items.ex_zh: 请把这些参考资料订在一起，以免遗失任何一页。

items.def_en: (chiefly North American) To fasten or close something with a zipper.
items.ex_en: He stepped outside into the chilly wind and paused to zipper his heavy jacket.
items.ex_zh: 他走到寒风凛冽的室外，停下脚步拉上了厚夹克的拉链。

items.def_zh: 用螺栓紧固；把……用螺栓固定在地上
items.def_en: (+ sth) to fasten something firmly to a floor or structure using heavy bolts
items.ex_en: Technicians must bolt down the heavy generator to the concrete foundation for safety.
items.ex_zh: 出于安全考虑，技术人员必须用螺栓将沉重的发电机牢牢固定在混凝土基座上。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to hold or fasten something firmly in place using a mechanical clamp
items.ex_en: The carpenter used two sturdy vices to clamp down the wooden beam securely.
items.ex_zh: 木工使用两个结实的台虎钳将木梁牢牢夹紧固定。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to secure something firmly in place using straps, ties, or fasteners
items.ex_en: The sailors worked quickly to fasten down the cargo tarpaulins before the storm.
items.ex_zh: 水手们赶在风暴来临前迅速行动，把货物的防水帆布牢牢绑住。

items.def_zh: 用螺丝拧紧；把……用螺丝固定
items.def_en: (+ sth) to fasten something securely to a surface using screws
items.ex_en: Make sure you screw down the metal plate tightly onto the wooden floorboard.
items.ex_zh: 务必用螺丝把这块金属板紧紧地固定在木地板上。
