items.def_en: to fasten firmly to something with heavy threaded metal bolts
items.ex_en: Workers will bolt the steel framework securely to prevent any vibration during operation.
items.ex_zh: 工人们将用重型螺栓紧固钢框架，以防止运转时发生任何晃动。

items.def_en: to secure a nail or rivet by flattening or bending the protruding point
items.ex_en: The blacksmith struck the protruding iron nail hard to clinch it against the wood.
items.ex_zh: 铁匠用力敲击突出的铁钉，将其敲弯紧扣在木头上。

items.def_zh: 用铆钉固定；牢牢吸引（注意力），使目不转睛
items.def_en: 1. To fasten metal plates or other parts together with rivets. 2. (often passive) To attract and hold someone's attention completely.
items.ex_en: The shipbuilders used heavy hammers to rivet the thick iron plates together securely.
items.ex_zh: 造船工人用重锤将厚铁板牢固地铆接在一起。

groups.summary_en: An agent secures, binds, or joins materials firmly together using specific mechanical closures, fasteners, or structural bindings.
groups.summary_zh: 借助五金或专门扣具将物体机械式连接并固定，防止分离。
groups.desc_en: Securing adjoining solid components mechanically using dedicated hardware or fasteners to immobilize them, contrasting with chemical bonding or loose resting.
groups.desc_zh: 使用五金件或机械连接件将构件固定闭合以防止位移，区别于化学胶结或自然搭放。
groups.nuance_en: bolt: fasten rigidly with threaded bolts and nuts (engine / chassis / armor) · screw down: secure tightly using spiral screws (floorboards / lid / brackets) · staple: pin sheets or thin boards with wire staples (papers / insulation / carton) · clamp down: bind immobile with heavy gripping vices (workpiece / timber / pipe) · clip: attach quickly with resilient spring clips (wire / hair / coupons)
groups.nuance_zh: bolt: 用高强度螺栓与螺母死死锚固 (engine / chassis / armor) · screw down: 用螺丝钉旋紧锁死 (floorboards / lid / brackets) · staple: 用订书钉或骑马钉订合 (papers / insulation / carton) · clamp down: 用夹具、台虎钳死死夹紧 (workpiece / timber / pipe) · clip: 用弹性回形夹快速卡夹固定 (wire / hair / coupons)

groups.name: Mechanical Obstruction & Sealing · 封堵与填塞 (Plug, Dam, Block)
groups.tip: 填塞缝隙或阻断孔道与通道

items.def_zh: 填塞，衬垫；虚报，夸大（账目、文章等）；放轻脚步走
items.def_en: 1. To fill, cover, or protect something with soft material. 2. To add unnecessary or dishonest material to something to make it larger. 3. To walk with soft, quiet steps.
items.ex_en: Workers pad the wooden shipping crates with foam to protect fragile antique vases.
items.ex_zh: 工人们在木质包装箱内衬垫泡沫，以保护脆弱的古董花瓶。

items.def_en: (+ up) to close or seal a receptacle aperture with a bung or stopper
items.ex_en: The cellar master hurried to bung up the wooden barrel with a mallet.
items.ex_zh: 酒窖主管赶紧用木槌将木桶的孔口紧紧塞住。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to close an entrance, passage, or opening so that nothing can pass through
items.ex_en: Police used metal barricades to block off the narrow alley after the incident.
items.ex_zh: 事件发生后，警方用金属路障封闭了狭窄的巷道。

items.def_en: to block, restrict, or completely cut off the flow or access of something
items.ex_en: A buildup of sediment threatened to choke off the supply of fresh water.
items.ex_zh: 沉淀物的堆积眼看就要彻底切断新鲜水源的供应。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to block an opening, hole, or pipe completely by inserting a stopper or material
items.ex_en: He grabbed some sticky sealant to plug up the small hole in the pipe.
items.ex_zh: 他抓起一些粘稠的密封胶，塞住了管道上的小洞。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to fill or close a hole or opening so that it is completely blocked
items.ex_en: The plumber used specialized waterproof putty to stop up the leaking crack completely.
items.ex_zh: 水管工使用专用的防水油灰将漏水裂缝彻底堵住。

items.def_zh: 堵住，塞住；宣传，推销；射中
items.def_en: 1. To fill or block a hole or opening tightly with something. 2. (informal) To promote or advertise a product, book, or show publicly. 3. (informal) To shoot someone with a bullet.
items.ex_en: He used a piece of soft clay to plug the small gap in the brick.
items.ex_zh: 他用一块软黏土堵住了砖头上的小缝隙。

items.def_zh: 筑坝拦住，阻拦；控制，抑制
items.def_en: To build a dam across a river or stream to stop or control the flow of water; to hold back or suppress something.
items.ex_en: Engineers plan to dam the rapid river to generate electricity for the region.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们计划在这条湍急的河流上筑坝，为该地区发电。

items.def_en: to make seams watertight or airtight by packing with filler or sealant
items.ex_en: Old sailors would calk the timber seams with oakum and pitch against leaks.
items.ex_zh: 老水手们会用麻丝和沥青填塞木缝，以防漏水。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to stop or restrict the flow of water or liquid by building a barrier across it
items.ex_en: The beavers used branches and mud to dam up the flowing forest brook.
items.ex_zh: 海狸用树枝和泥土筑起一道坝，阻挡了流淌的森林小溪。

groups.summary_en: An agent seals or obstructs an opening, cavity, or flow of material by inserting or imposing a physical barrier. The methods range from stuffing with soft material to building rigid impediments or inserting tightly fitted stoppers.
groups.summary_zh: 塞入填充物或筑起屏障以封死通道或截断流动，强调物理封堵手段。
groups.desc_en: Inserting material into an orifice or barrier across a passage to completely halt the traversal of substances, unlike porous filtering or opening.
groups.desc_zh: 在孔洞塞入物质或在通道设阻，以彻底阻隔流体或杂质通过，区别于多孔过滤或开启通路。
groups.nuance_en: plug: jam an opening with a snug insert or stopper (leak / hole / socket) · dam: construct a barrier across fluid flow to stem currents (river / stream / tears) · block off: erect physical boundaries to prevent entry or passage (road / street / exit) · bung: seal casks or pipes with a heavy tapered plug (barrel / vent / bung-hole) · choke off: constrict a conduit tightly to suffocate passage (supply / breath / access)
groups.nuance_zh: plug: 用塞子严密填堵孔洞缝隙 (leak / hole / socket) · dam: 筑坝截断水流或情感宣泄 (river / stream / tears) · block off: 设立路障封锁通路 (road / street / exit) · bung: 用桶塞密封桶口或管孔 (barrel / vent / bung-hole) · choke off: 掐断扼杀咽喉通道使其窒息断流 (supply / breath / access)

groups.name: Medically Sedate & Numb · 麻醉与镇静 (Anesthetize, Sedate, Dope)
groups.tip: 医学手术中的用药镇静麻醉

items.def_en: to cause someone to lose consciousness or fall heavily asleep through a drug
items.ex_en: Our team was knocked out of the tournament in the quarter-finals.
items.ex_zh: 我们队在四分之一决赛中被淘汰出局。

items.def_en: to render unconscious or insensitive to pain by administering ether
items.ex_en: The surgeon prepared to etherize the patient before initiating the complex operative procedure.
items.ex_zh: 在开始复杂的手术程序前，外科医生准备用乙醚对病人进行麻醉。

items.def_zh: 对……施用麻醉药使其昏迷
items.def_en: (+ sb) to render someone unconscious before surgery using an anesthetic
items.ex_en: The anesthesiologist will put under the nervous patient before the surgical procedure begins.
items.ex_zh: 麻醉师会在手术开始前对紧张的患者施用麻醉使其昏迷。

items.def_zh: 使昏睡，麻醉使失去知觉
items.def_en: (+ sb) to cause someone to lose consciousness using drugs or anesthesia
items.ex_en: The doctor decided to put out the injured animal before cleaning its wounds.
items.ex_zh: 医生决定先将受伤的动物麻醉使其失去知觉，然后再清理伤口。

items.def_zh: 用镇静药或毒品麻醉（某人）
items.def_en: (+ sb) to administer heavy sedatives, narcotics, or drugs to dull someone's senses
items.ex_en: The illicit gang tried to dope up the guard with a sleeping potion.
items.ex_zh: 这帮不法分子企图用安眠药将警卫麻醉倒。

items.def_en: to give someone a drug to make them sleepy, confused, or unconscious
items.ex_en: The kidnapper tried to dope the guard's coffee with a strong tasteless sedative.
items.ex_zh: 绑匪企图在警卫的咖啡中掺入强效无味的镇静药使其昏睡。

items.def_en: to give a patient or animal drugs to make them calm, sleepy, or unconscious.
items.ex_en: The veterinarian had to sedate the agitated leopard before treating its infected paw.
items.ex_zh: 兽医不得不给躁动不安的豹子注射镇静剂，然后再治疗它感染的爪子。

items.def_en: to make someone unconscious or kill them with chloroform vapor.
items.ex_en: In old mysteries, the intruder would chloroform his unsuspecting victim from behind.
items.ex_zh: 在古老的悬疑故事中，闯入者常常从背后用氯仿将毫无戒备的受害者麻醉倒。

items.def_zh: 给……施麻醉，使麻醉；使麻木，使失去知觉
items.def_en: 1. to give an anesthetic to a patient so they feel no pain during a medical procedure. 2. to make someone unable to feel normal emotions or sensations.
items.ex_en: The dentist applied a topical numbing spray to anesthetize the patient's sensitive gums.
items.ex_zh: 牙医涂抹了一种局部麻醉喷雾，以麻醉患者敏感的牙龈。

items.def_en: to make a person or animal calm or unconscious by administering a drug
items.ex_en: Wildlife rangers used a dart rifle to tranquilize the stray bear safely.
items.ex_zh: 野生动物巡逻员用麻醉枪发射飞镖，安全地使这只走失的熊陷入昏睡。

groups.summary_en: Medical professionals or captors administer chemical substances to render a person or animal calm, unconscious, or insensible to pain. Verbs range from general clinical procedures ('anesthetize') to specific pharmacologic agents or colloquial administration ('dope', 'etherize').
groups.summary_zh: 通过施用药物使人或动物镇静、昏睡或失去知觉。
groups.desc_en: Chemically dulling the central nervous system to induce calm, analgesia, or complete unconsciousness, unlike natural sleep or homeopathic relaxation.
groups.desc_zh: 通过药物抑制中枢神经系统以诱导镇痛、镇静或意识丧失，区别于自然入眠或生理性放松。
groups.nuance_en: sedate: calm anxious agitation or excitability with clinical sedatives (patient / animal / child) · put under: administer full clinical general anesthesia (patient / surgical subject) · knock out: render instantaneously unconscious via drug or concussive blow (boxer / pain / dose) · etherize: anesthetize specifically via inhaled ether vapors (patient / clinic) · dope up: heavily medicate or numb with tranquilizers or illicit drugs (racehorse / patient / athlete)
groups.nuance_zh: sedate: 临床注射镇静剂以消除躁动亢奋 (patient / animal / child) · put under: 实施全身麻醉令其丧失知觉 (patient / surgical subject) · knock out: 强力药剂或重击使其瞬时昏厥 (boxer / pain / dose) · etherize: 吸入乙醚实施全麻 (patient / clinic) · dope up: 施加麻醉剂或违禁药令其麻木迟钝 (racehorse / patient / athlete)

groups.name: Mock & Taunt · 嘲弄与挑衅 (Jeer, Gibe, Taunt)
groups.tip: 言语奚落并蓄意挑衅对方

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to tease or mock someone in a teasing or derisive manner
items.ex_en: The older students liked to poke fun at his eccentric vintage clothing choices.
items.ex_zh: 高年级学生喜欢拿他古怪的复古着装开玩笑。

items.def_en: (+ at) to express derisive disbelief or scornful contempt
items.ex_en: Skeptics would scoff whenever the ambitious inventor described his wild futuristic flying machine.
items.ex_zh: 每当这位雄心勃勃的发明家描绘他天马行空的未来飞行器时，怀疑论者总会嗤之以鼻。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to treat someone or something with derision, mocking vocal sounds, or scorn
items.ex_en: It is cruel and unnecessary to laugh at a novice making harmless mistakes.
items.ex_zh: 嘲笑一个初学者犯下无伤大雅的错误既残忍又毫无必要。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to talk about or mock someone or something with derisive contempt
items.ex_en: Critics continue to scoff at her revolutionary theories regarding deep space travel.
items.ex_zh: 批评家们依然对她关于深空旅行的开创性理论嗤之以鼻。

items.def_zh: （轻蔑或愤怒地）哼鼻子，嗤之以鼻；喷鼻息；（通过鼻子）吸入（毒品）
items.def_en: 1. To force air loudly through your nose to express contempt, anger, or amusement; to say something while doing this. 2. (informal) To inhale a powdered drug through the nose.
items.ex_en: The arrogant nobleman gave a disdainful snort at the commoner's humble plea.
items.ex_zh: 傲慢的贵族对平民谦卑的恳求轻蔑地哼了一声。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ at) to shout loud, rude, and mocking remarks at someone publicly
items.ex_en: The disappointed spectators began to jeer loudly when the striker missed the goal.
items.ex_zh: 眼前前锋射失球门，失望的观众开始大声喝倒彩。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ at) to utter taunting, sneering, or sarcastic remarks
items.ex_en: Cynics in the dark corner loved to gibe at the poet's heartfelt verses.
items.ex_zh: 坐在阴暗角落里的愤世嫉俗者总喜欢对诗人由衷的诗篇讥诮一番。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to laugh at or shout rude, insulting, derisive remarks at someone
items.ex_en: Unruly fans gathered outside the stadium to jeer at the opposing team bus.
items.ex_zh: 不守规矩的球迷聚集在体育场外，对着客队的巴士起哄嘲弄。

items.def_en: to deliberately provoke or tease someone with persistent cruel remarks to make them angry
items.ex_en: The bully tried to bait his quiet classmate into a pointless fistfight.
items.ex_zh: 那个恶霸试图故意激怒他安静的同学，挑起一场毫无意义的打斗。

items.def_en: 1. To mock, insult, or provoke someone intentionally with unkind words in order to make them angry.
items.ex_en: The hostile crowd continued to taunt the visiting goalkeeper after every single shot.
items.ex_zh: 充满敌意的观众在每一次射门后都继续挑衅奚落客队门将。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote intentionally provoking, disparaging, or mocking someone to their face through derisive vocal sounds, insults, or insulting challenges. They typically take a personal direct object or take prepositions like 'at'.
groups.summary_zh: 当面发出嘲弄、嗤笑或挑衅性言语以激怒对方。
groups.desc_en: Directing vocal scorn, sarcastic mimics, or offensive provocations toward a victim to demean and incite, contrasting with good-natured teasing.
groups.desc_zh: 用轻蔑言辞、嘲讽表情或恶性挑衅贬损侮辱对方，区别于善意的嬉闹打趣。
groups.nuance_en: jeer: shout derisive, abusive vocal insults in public crowds (crowd / mob / speaker) · taunt: intentionally provoke with humiliating personal jabs (rival / captive / loser) · scoff: utter disdainful dismissal showing utter disbelief (critics / elders / idea) · gibe: hurl biting, sarcastic verbal sneers (opponents / heckler / courtier) · poke fun at: lampoon or tease weaknesses good-humoredly or slyly (friend / accent / habits)
groups.nuance_zh: jeer: 聚众起哄发出刺耳嘘声与恶声 (crowd / mob / speaker) · taunt: 揭短痛处恶意挑衅激怒对方 (rival / captive / loser) · scoff: 嗤之以鼻、不屑一顾地哂笑 (critics / elders / idea) · gibe: 抛出尖酸刻薄的冷嘲热讽 (opponents / heckler / courtier) · poke fun at: 善意或狡黠地拿人短处开涮调侃 (friend / accent / habits)

groups.name: Move & Translocate · 移动与行进 (Go, Come, Move)
groups.tip: 基础位移动词

items.def_zh: 去，走，行进；离开；运转，进行
items.def_en: 1. To move or travel from one place to another. 2. To depart or leave a place. 3. To operate, proceed, or progress.
items.ex_en: We must go to the train station before the evening rush hour begins.
items.ex_zh: 在晚高峰开始之前，我们必须动身前往火车站。

items.def_zh: 来，来到；发生；达到（某种状态）
items.def_en: 1. To move toward, reach, or arrive at a place or person. 2. To occur or happen. 3. To reach a particular stage, position, or condition.
items.ex_en: Many travelers come to the ancient village to admire the historic stone bridges.
items.ex_zh: 许多旅客来到这座古老的村庄，欣赏具有历史意义的石桥。

items.def_zh: 移动，搬移；行动，行进；搬家；感动
items.def_en: 1. To change position, or cause someone or something to change position. 2. To travel, advance, or proceed. 3. To change one's home or office. 4. To evoke strong emotion in someone.
items.ex_en: The security guard told the crowd to move away from the emergency exit.
items.ex_zh: 保安人员告诉人群从紧急出口处移开。
items.ex2_en: Strong moving crewmen easily moved the heavy oak desk into the office.
items.ex2_zh: 强壮的搬家工人轻松地把沉重的橡木桌子搬进了办公室。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ through/by) to move past or across a location
items.ex_en: Tourists pass through the bustling market alley admiring the vibrant local craft stalls.
items.ex_zh: 游客穿行在熙熙攘攘的集市小巷中，欣赏着当地充满生机的工艺品摊位。
items.ex2_en: The helpful customs officer passed the nervous traveler through the international gate.
items.ex2_zh: 乐于助人的海关官员放行了那位紧张的旅客穿过国际闸口。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make a journey or move across an expanse of distance
items.ex_en: We decided to travel across the continent by train during our summer vacation.
items.ex_zh: 我们决定在暑假乘火车横穿整个大陆。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ on/towards) to move forward in a purposeful or organized manner
items.ex_en: The infantry battalions continued to advance towards the enemy fortifications under heavy fire.
items.ex_zh: 步兵营在猛烈炮火下继续向敌军防御工事推进。
items.ex2_en: The general decided to advance his armored forces deeper into enemy territory.
items.ex2_zh: 将军决定将他的装甲部队推向敌方领土更深处。

items.def_en: (+ to/along) to move forward in a particular direction, often in a formal manner
items.ex_en: Passengers holding boarding passes may now proceed to gate twenty-four immediately.
items.ex_zh: 持有登机牌的乘客现在可以立即前往二十四号登机口。

items.def_en: to continue traveling forward or change one's position to keep going
items.ex_en: The police officer instructed the gathered spectators to move along the sidewalk.
items.ex_zh: 警官指示聚集的围观人群沿着人行道往前走。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to travel past a place, landmark, or person
items.ex_en: We pass by the historic town hall every morning on our way to work.
items.ex_zh: 我们每天早上去上班的路上都会路过那座历史悠久的市政厅。

items.def_en: to depart or begin moving away in a particular direction
items.ex_en: We should pack our gear and head off before the weather turns bad.
items.ex_zh: 我们应该收拾好装备，在天气变坏之前动身出发。

groups.summary_en: Core verbs denoting basic physical translation across space, fundamentally differentiated by deictic direction relative to the speaker, procedural travel, or general change of physical position.
groups.summary_zh: 空间位置的基本位移与行进，区别在于视点朝向、行进方式及概括性。
groups.desc_en: Basic physical spatial dislocation and progressive change of coordinates across terrain, contrasting with static rest or rotational in-place posture.
groups.desc_zh: 最基本的实体空间位移与沿路径的坐标变迁，区别于静止伫立或原地转动姿态。
groups.nuance_en: move: change physical location or position generally (furniture / troops / pieces) · go: depart along a vector toward a destination away from here (home / school / abroad) · come: transit toward the speaker's current location (here / near / back) · travel: journey across extensive geographical distances (world / highway / abroad) · advance: move forward deliberately in rank or development (army / agenda / career)
groups.nuance_zh: move: 泛指改变物体所处的物理空间位置 (furniture / troops / pieces) · go: 背离当前发话点朝目的地移动 (home / school / abroad) · come: 朝说话者所在参照系靠近而来 (here / near / back) · travel: 跨越广阔地理距离的长途旅行 (world / highway / abroad) · advance: 迎着阻力有组织地向前推进挺进 (army / agenda / career)

groups.name: Nurture & Tend · 抚育与照料 (Parent, Mother, Nurture)
groups.tip: 以父母之责养育照护

items.def_en: (+ to) to care for the physical needs or health of someone
items.ex_en: The volunteer nurse stayed behind to tend to the wounded civilians in the clinic.
items.ex_zh: 志愿护士留下来在诊所里照料受伤的平民。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to look after someone vulnerable and provide for their needs
items.ex_en: She took a leave of absence to care for her ailing grandmother at home.
items.ex_zh: 她请了假回老家照顾生病的祖母。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to attend to the physical and emotional welfare or safety of someone
items.ex_en: Could you look after our golden retriever while we are away on business?
items.ex_zh: 我们出差期间你能照看好我们的金毛猎犬吗？

items.def_en: To raise, care for, or act as a parent to a child.
items.ex_en: They strive to parent their adopted twins with patience, empathy, and consistent boundaries.
items.ex_zh: 他们努力以耐心、同理心和明确的规矩来抚养这对领养的双胞胎。

items.def_zh: 悉心照料，像母亲般呵护；生下，生育
items.def_en: 1. To treat or care for someone with affection, overprotectiveness, or maternal attention. 2. To give birth to or produce.
items.ex_en: He hated the way his older sister tried to mother him in front of guests.
items.ex_zh: 他讨厌姐姐在客人面前像个母亲一样对他过度关照。

items.def_zh: 照料，伺候，照顾；主持圣事
items.def_en: (+ to) 1. To attend to the needs, comfort, or care of someone. 2. To perform the functions of a religious minister.
items.ex_en: The hospice staff gently ministered to the physical and spiritual needs of the dying patients.
items.ex_zh: 临终关怀人员悉心关照临终患者的身体和精神需求。

items.def_en: to bring up and care for children until they are fully grown
items.ex_en: She worked two jobs to rear four children in a modest countryside cottage.
items.ex_zh: 她打了两份工，在简朴的乡间小屋里把四个孩子抚养成人。

items.def_en: to bring up a child who is not one's own by birth
items.ex_en: The couple decided to foster vulnerable children whose families were undergoing severe crises.
items.ex_zh: 这对夫妇决定代养那些家庭遭遇严重危机的弱势儿童。

items.def_en: to feed and care for a young child or vulnerable person while they grow
items.ex_en: The dedicated sanctuary staff worked tirelessly to nurture the orphaned cubs back to health.
items.ex_zh: 保护区的工作人员不辞辛劳，精心抚育这些孤儿幼崽恢复健康。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to care for and educate a child until they are grown up
items.ex_en: His grandparents stepped in to bring him up after his parents passed away suddenly.
items.ex_zh: 在他父母意外离世后，他的祖父母承担起抚养他长大的责任。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify providing protective physical care, developmental upbringing, or emotional safeguarding to a child, dependent, or vulnerable charge, differentiated by parental manner and formal ministry.
groups.summary_zh: 指对子女或被照料者施以养育、母爱呵护或侍奉看顾。
groups.desc_en: Denotes ongoing, sustained protective care and stewardship invested in the growth, health, or flourishing of a dependent, contrasting with momentary assistance or mechanical maintenance.
groups.desc_zh: 指对受照料者（人、动植物或事物）施加持续性、保护性的抚育与关怀以助其成长或康复，区别于偶发性的帮助或机械性的维护。
groups.nuance_en: tend: attentive ongoing oversight and servicing (flock / garden / wounds) · rear: long-term biological or social raising until maturity (children / livestock) · foster: nurturing development in a surrogate or supportive capacity (talent / child / relations) · mother: protective, instinctively caring, sometimes smothering oversight (child / subordinates) · minister: meeting essential physical or spiritual needs (to the sick / to the dying)
groups.nuance_zh: tend: 细心照料、看顾与维护 (flock / garden / wounds) · rear: 抚养、养育至成熟或成年 (children / livestock) · foster: 寄养或以支持性方式培育 (talent / child / relations) · mother: 如母亲般本能呵护，偶含过度关照 (child / subordinates) · minister: 救助、侍奉并满足身心急需 (to the sick / to the dying)

groups.name: Observe & Surveil · 观察与监视 (Monitor, Stake Out, Wiretap)
groups.tip: 长期持续观察与系统监测

items.def_en: to observe and check the progress or quality of someone or something over a period of time
items.ex_en: Engineers monitor the pressure levels inside the pipeline through a sophisticated digital system.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们通过精密的数字化系统持续监测管道内的压力水平。

items.def_en: to follow someone closely and secretly in order to watch what they do
items.ex_en: The private detective was hired to tail the suspect through the crowded subway.
items.ex_zh: 私家侦探受雇在拥挤的地铁里暗中尾随该嫌疑人。

items.def_en: to keep a place or person under continuous surveillance, especially by police or detectives
items.ex_en: Undercover agents were ordered to stake out the abandoned warehouse by the docks.
items.ex_zh: 便衣特工奉命对码头旁那座废弃仓库进行设伏盯梢。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to secretly watch someone or their activities over an extended period
items.ex_en: He was caught trying to spy on rival companies' meetings.
items.ex_zh: 他因企图窃听竞争对手公司的会议而当场被抓。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to monitor or track the movements, activities, or status of someone continuously
items.ex_en: The agency assigned two field operatives to keep tabs on his daily movements.
items.ex_zh: 该机构指派了两名外勤人员密切监视他的日常行踪。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to observe someone or something continuously to maintain supervision or security
items.ex_en: She asked her neighbor to watch over the children while she ran an errand.
items.ex_zh: 她外出办事时请邻居照看一下孩子们。

items.def_en: to secretly connect a listening device to someone's phone or communications line
items.ex_en: Federal agents obtained a warrant to wiretap the syndicate leader's private telephone line.
items.ex_zh: 联邦特工获得了搜查令，以窃听该犯罪团伙头目的私人电话线路。

items.def_en: To observe and identify wild birds in their natural environment as a hobby.
items.ex_en: They often birdwatch along the coastal wetlands during the peak autumn migration season.
items.ex_zh: 他们经常在秋季迁徙高峰期前往沿海湿地观鸟。

items.def_en: To keep someone, a building, or an area under close, continuous observation or surveillance.
items.ex_en: The intelligence team used satellite cameras to surveil the perimeter of the compound.
items.ex_zh: 情报小组利用卫星摄像头对大院周边进行严密监视。

items.def_zh: 监视，对……实施严密监视（surveil 的过去式及过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of surveil: to keep under close and continuous surveillance.
items.ex_en: The suspected foreign diplomat had been surveilled by security forces for several months.
items.ex_zh: 那名涉嫌间谍活动的外国外交官已被安全部门严密监视了数月。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote systematically watching or tracking individuals, wildlife, or targets over an extended period, ranging from recreational field observation to clandestine intelligence-gathering.
groups.summary_zh: 指对人员、野生动植物或目标进行系统性、长期的观察与暗中监视。
groups.desc_en: Involves sustained, targeted sensory tracking and intelligence gathering on an unaware target, contrasting with casual seeing or passive supervision.
groups.desc_zh: 指对不知情的受众或对象进行持续性、定向的跟踪、监听与情报收集，区别于漫不经心的注视或单纯的被动监管。
groups.nuance_en: monitor: systematic tracking of status or signals over time (screen / progress / communications) · tail: stealthily following a moving target physically (suspect / car) · stake out: maintaining concealed surveillance over a fixed location (hideout / house) · wiretap: covert electronic interception of auditory signals (phone / line / calls) · spy on: covert hostile intelligence gathering (neighbor / competitor)
groups.nuance_zh: monitor: 制度化、持续性地监测或跟踪状态 (screen / progress / communications) · tail: 隐蔽跟踪移动目标 (suspect / car) · stake out: 对固定据点进行设伏监视 (hideout / house) · wiretap: 窃听电子通讯信号 (phone / line / calls) · spy on: 暗中刺探敌对或隐秘情报 (neighbor / competitor)

groups.name: Oppose & Repudiate · 规劝反对与坚决拒斥 (Deprecate, Rebuff, Disavow)
groups.tip: 表明异议、坚决拒绝或抵赖

items.def_en: to reject or refuse to consider a proposal, request, or applicant
items.ex_en: The board decided to turn down the acquisition proposal due to financial concerns.
items.ex_zh: 出于对财务状况的担忧，董事会决定回绝这项收购提案。

items.def_zh: 轻蔑地拒绝或不理睬某人/某事
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to reject, dismiss, or refuse to listen to someone or their ideas in a curt or offhand manner
items.ex_en: He tried to brush off the criticism as petty jealousy.
items.ex_zh: 他试图对这些批评不予理会，将其归咎于小人的嫉妒。

items.def_zh: 挡开，回避，回绝（批评、质问或不受欢迎的要求）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to successfully defend oneself against or ward off unwanted questions, requests, or criticisms
items.ex_en: The spokesperson struggled to fend off sharp questions from hostile reporters regarding the scandal.
items.ex_zh: 发言人极力挡开敌对记者针对该丑闻提出的尖锐质问。

items.def_en: 1. To express strong disapproval of something; to make something seem unimportant or of little value.
items.ex_en: Conservative scholars openly deprecate the trend toward superficial social media commentary in academia.
items.ex_zh: 保守派学者公开贬低学术界流于浅薄的社交媒体评论之风。

items.def_zh: 坚决抛弃，断然背弃（立场、关系或信仰）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to repudiate, abandon, or discard someone or something completely
items.ex_en: He chose to cast aside his family traditions to pursue an independent destiny.
items.ex_zh: 他毅然抛弃了家族传统，去追寻一条属于自己的独立道路。

items.def_en: 1. To reject an offer, request, or friendly approach abruptly and unkindly.
items.ex_en: The embattled chairman chose to rebuff all overtures from the rival corporation.
items.ex_zh: 四面楚歌的董事长断然拒绝了竞争对手公司伸出的所有橄榄枝。

items.def_zh: 否认，拒不承认，否认与……有关系
items.def_en: 1. To state publicly that you have no knowledge of, connection with, or responsibility for something.
items.ex_en: The political party moved swiftly to disavow the extremist comments made by the candidate.
items.ex_zh: 该政党迅速发表声明，拒不承认该候选人发表的极端言论。

items.def_en: to refuse or reject an offer, person, or suggestion with contempt or scorn
items.ex_en: The proud duchess chose to spurn his desperate proposal with cold disdain.
items.ex_zh: 傲慢的公爵夫人带着冰冷的轻蔑断然拒绝了他的苦求表白。

items.def_en: to declare that one no longer has any relationship with or responsibility for someone
items.ex_en: The wealthy patriarch threatened to disown anyone who challenged his final business decisions.
items.ex_zh: 富有的家族族长威胁要与任何质疑他最终商业决策的人断绝关系。

items.def_zh: 断然否认或坚决割席绝交
items.def_en: to reject the authority or validity of something forcefully; to renounce an association
items.ex_en: The former minister used the press conference to repudiate all allegations of corruption.
items.ex_zh: 这位前部长利用新闻发布会坚决否认了所有腐败指控。

groups.summary_en: A speaker communicates rejection, mild disapproval, or explicit repudiation of a request, stance, or connection, ranging from gentle deprecation to snubbing refusal and public denial.
groups.summary_zh: 从委婉表态不赞成，升级至生硬回绝以及公开断绝关系。
groups.desc_en: Signifies active, often dismissive or moralized rejection and distancing from a person, proposal, or claim, exceeding neutral non-acceptance.
groups.desc_zh: 指带有明确立场、斥责或轻蔑态度的拒绝、抵制与割席，远强于中性的不予接受。
groups.nuance_en: rebuff: blunt, sharp refusal of an advance or overture (offer / advance / bid) · spurn: contemptuous, disdainful rejection (advances / help / lover) · disavow: public denial of connection, responsibility, or belief (statement / ties / knowledge) · deprecate: mild to severe moral disapproval or belittling (conduct / violence / self) · fend off: active deflection of unwelcome pressure or attacks (criticism / blows / attackers)
groups.nuance_zh: rebuff: 生硬、断然地回绝主动提议 (offer / advance / bid) · spurn: 傲慢鄙夷地唾弃与拒绝 (advances / help / lover) · disavow: 公开声明割席或否认关联 (statement / ties / knowledge) · deprecate: 规劝性反对或贬损 (conduct / violence / self) · fend off: 挡开、回击外部压力或进犯 (criticism / blows / attackers)

groups.name: Order, Align & Configure · 整理、排列与布设 (Array, Align, Configure, Tidy)
groups.tip: 将杂乱物体理顺排齐、布置就位

items.def_en: [I/T] to form or arrange a series of people or objects into a straight continuous row
items.ex_en: The coach told the soccer players to line up along the goal line.
items.ex_zh: 教练让足球队员们沿着球门线排成一排。
items.ex2_en: The organized teacher lined up the eager students neatly along the hallway.
items.ex2_zh: 有条不紊的老师让热切的学生们沿着走廊整齐地排好队。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to arrange or display things systematically and attractively in a particular space
items.ex_en: Volunteers arrived early to set out chairs and promotional materials in the auditorium.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者们早早赶到礼堂，整齐摆放椅子和宣传资料。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to arrange things into a structured order by categorizing or separating them
items.ex_en: She spent the entire weekend trying to sort out her chaotic tax documents.
items.ex_zh: 她花了一整个周末来分拣整理混乱的税务文件。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make a place or collection of things neat, clean, and well arranged
items.ex_en: Please tidy up the living room before our guests arrive this afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 请在今天下午客人到达之前把客厅收拾整洁。
items.ex2_en: The cluttered nursery tidied up quickly once the organized storage bins arrived.
items.ex2_zh: 井然有序的储物箱一送达，杂乱的育儿室很快就收拾整齐了。

items.def_en: (chiefly British) (often tidy up) to make a room or items neat by putting things in order.
items.ex_en: He took twenty minutes to tidy his desk after finishing the final project.
items.ex_zh: 完成最后的项目后，他花了二十分钟整理自己的办公桌。
items.ex2_en: The cluttered workshop tidies easily whenever the apprentices put away their tools.
items.ex2_zh: 每当学徒们收好工具时，杂乱的车间就很容易收拾整洁。

items.def_zh: 部署，排列，整齐排布；打扮，盛装装扮
items.def_en: (often passive) to arrange things or people in an attractive, orderly, or impressive display or formation.
items.ex_en: Thousands of royal guards stood in array before the gates of the palace.
items.ex_zh: 数以千计的皇家卫兵整齐列阵在王宫大门之前。

items.def_zh: 使排成一行，对齐；使一致；结盟
items.def_en: to place things in a straight line or in correct relative positions; to bring into agreement or close alignment.
items.ex_en: Ensure that the margins align perfectly before sending the document to the printer.
items.ex_zh: 在将文件发送至打印机之前，请确保边距完全对齐。
items.ex2_en: The carpenter carefully aligned the wooden panels before drilling the pilot holes.
items.ex2_zh: 木匠在钻导孔之前仔细地将木板对齐排直。

items.def_en: to organize people, assets, or ideas into a deliberate, orderly formation for action
items.ex_en: The campaign manager worked overnight to marshal resources for the upcoming general election.
items.ex_zh: 竞选经理通宵工作，为即将举行的大选统筹调配资源。

items.def_en: to arrange, set up, or configure the parts, structure, or settings of a system or device.
items.ex_en: The technician helped configure the network settings to improve overall office security.
items.ex_zh: 技术员协助配置了网络参数，以提高整个办公室的安全性。

items.def_en: to collect, compare, and arrange texts or pages in strict, logical sequence
items.ex_en: The administrative assistant was hired to collate the legal briefs in chronological sequence.
items.ex_zh: 行政助理受雇按照时间先后顺序核对并整理这些法律文书。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe organizing components or physical entities into deliberate, structured geometric lines, coherent spatial patterns, or systematic functional configurations. Nuances differentiate between making an area clean/orderly, drawing elements into a straight linear axis, or setting up complex systemic parts.
groups.summary_zh: 按特定几何轴线、功能结构或整洁规律排布整理诸要素。
groups.desc_en: Entails imposing deliberate spatial, structural, or functional order onto disorganized elements, contrasting with simple relocation or haphazard gathering.
groups.desc_zh: 指对杂乱或松散的要素施加空间、逻辑或功能上的规整与编排，区别于普通的搬动或无序的堆放。
groups.nuance_en: align: adjusting into precise co-linear or ideological conformity (wheels / interests / strategy) · array: displaying a collection in an orderly, often impressive formation (troops / goods / data) · marshal: systematically assembling and directing resources or arguments for action (evidence / resources / thoughts) · tidy up: restoring neatness and cleanliness to an immediate space (room / desk) · sort out: disentangling confusion and categorizing items (mess / problems / documents)
groups.nuance_zh: align: 物理对齐或思想利益上的协调一致 (wheels / interests / strategy) · array: 严密且具威势地陈列或部署 (troops / goods / data) · marshal: 系统化整合调度资源以备使用 (evidence / resources / thoughts) · tidy up: 清理杂物使局部空间整洁 (room / desk) · sort out: 理顺混乱并归类分流 (mess / problems / documents)

groups.name: Oust & Depose · 罢免与废黜
groups.tip: 剥夺权力赶出宝座

items.def_en: formally order or allow someone to leave high office or official employment
items.ex_en: The cabinet decided to dismiss the controversial minister following widespread public outrage.
items.ex_zh: 在公众强烈抗议后，内阁决定免去那位备受争议的部长的职务。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to forcibly or unceremoniously expel someone from an office, organisation, or position of authority
items.ex_en: The rebellious director was booted out of the company by angry major shareholders.
items.ex_zh: 那位不服管束的董事被愤怒的大股东们毫不客气地逐出了公司。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to defeat an incumbent politician or leadership in an election, thereby removing them from office
items.ex_en: The ruling party was decisively voted out of office after the scandal.
items.ex_zh: 丑闻爆发后，执政党在选举中被果断赶下了台。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to dismiss or oust someone abruptly and forcibly from an institutional role
items.ex_en: He was kicked out of the university for repeatedly cheating on exams.
items.ex_zh: 他因多次考试作弊被大学开除。

items.def_en: remove forcibly from power, especially through revolution or rebellion
items.ex_en: Rebel forces united with armed citizens to overthrow the brutal military dictatorship.
items.ex_zh: 叛乱武装与武装民众联手推翻了残暴的军事独裁统治。

items.def_en: drive out or expel someone from a position of power, office, or territory
items.ex_en: The coalition conspired to oust the prime minister in an unexpected parliamentary vote.
items.ex_zh: 执政联盟密谋在一场突如其来的议会投票中罢黜首相。

items.def_zh: 废黜，免去……的职务；（法律）宣誓作证
items.def_en: 1. To remove a powerful leader, monarch, or official forcibly from office or power. 2. (law) To give sworn evidence or testimony under oath.
items.ex_en: Disillusioned generals plotted secretly to depose the aging monarch before dawn arrived.
items.ex_zh: 大失所望的将军们暗中密谋在破晓前废黜这位年迈的君主。

items.def_en: cause a government, regime, or autocrat to fall from power
items.ex_en: Months of massive street demonstrations finally helped topple the corrupt regime.
items.ex_zh: 持续数月的大规模街头示威终于促使这个腐败政权垮台。
items.ex2_en: The tall stack of delicate porcelain bowls toppled violently onto the floor.
items.ex2_zh: 高高叠起的一摞精致瓷碗猛烈地摔倒在地。

items.def_zh: 罢免，剥夺……的席位（或权力）；使从马上（或座上）摔下
items.def_en: 1. To remove someone from a position of authority or political office, especially by defeating them in an election. 2. To cause someone to fall off a horse, bicycle, or seat.
items.ex_en: The young challenger campaigned relentlessly to unseat the long-serving incumbent senator.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻的挑战者全力开展竞选，以期在大选中击败那位连任多年的现任参议员。

items.def_zh: 废黜（君主）；剥夺（领袖或冠军的）统治地位
items.def_en: To remove a monarch from the throne, or to depose a prominent leader or champion from their top position.
items.ex_en: The fearless contender fought tenaciously to dethrone the reigning world chess champion.
items.ex_zh: 这位无畏的挑战者顽强拼搏，誓要夺取现任国际象棋世界冠军的宝座。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe forcibly, politically, or legally removing someone from a position of sovereign, political, or institutional power. Nuances vary from legal dismissal and electoral removal to revolutionary toppling.
groups.summary_zh: 通过政治手段、法律程序或暴力强制剥夺当权者的统治或领导职务。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the forceful, formal, or unceremonious removal of an incumbent from power or office, contrasting with voluntary resignation or routine expiration of term.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过强力、程序或施压手段将掌权者从职位或统治地位上废黜、驱逐，区别于正常任期届满或自愿离职。
groups.nuance_en: oust: displacing or ejecting from an entrenched position (rival / dictator / CEO) · depose: formal, top-down removal of a ruler or dignitary (monarch / bishop / president) · topple: bringing about the collapse of an entire regime or leader (government / dictatorship / statue) · overthrow: violently subverting and replacing authority (regime / tyrant / monarchy) · boot out: ignominiously and forcefully expelling (member / tenant / employee)
groups.nuance_zh: oust: 排挤、逼退或逐出要职 (rival / dictator / CEO) · depose: 依正式程序或高压罢免统治者 (monarch / bishop / president) · topple: 瓦解推翻政权或领袖 (government / dictatorship / statue) · overthrow: 武力颠覆并推翻既有政权 (regime / tyrant / monarchy) · boot out: 屈辱、粗暴地开除或逐出 (member / tenant / employee)

groups.name: Overstate & Exaggerate · 夸大与夸张 (Overstate, Overplay, Exaggerate)
groups.tip: 言过其实夸大其词，有意渲染夸张事实

items.def_en: to make a story or statement more interesting by adding fictitious details
items.ex_en: The travel writer tends to embellish ordinary anecdotes with colorful fictitious details.
items.ex_zh: 这位旅行作家往往会在平淡的趣闻中添加生动的虚构细节以作润色。

items.def_zh: 渲染，刻意夸大……的重要性
items.def_en: (+ sth) to emphasize or exaggerate the value, importance, or drama of something
items.ex_en: Sensational headlines always play up minor political conflicts to attract more online clicks.
items.ex_zh: 耸人听闻的头条新闻总是刻意夸大微小的政治冲突，以吸引更多网民点击。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to describe someone or something in a way that makes them sound better, more valuable, or more successful than they actually are
items.ex_en: The company talked up the new phone, but users found it quite ordinary.
items.ex_zh: 公司对那款新手机大加吹捧，但用户发现它其实平平无奇。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make something seem larger, better, worse, or more important than it really is
items.ex_en: The tabloid was accused of attempting to exaggerate the severity of the crisis.
items.ex_zh: 该小报被指责试图夸大此次危机的严重程度。

items.def_zh: 夸大（重要性），夸张；表演过火；过分利用
items.def_en: 1. To exaggerate the importance or significance of something. 2. To act a dramatic role with too much emotion or exaggeration.
items.ex_en: Critics argued that the administration chose to overplay the threat of economic sanctions.
items.ex_zh: 批评人士认为，政府在对待经济制裁威胁时存在过分夸大的倾向。

items.def_zh: 夸大，把……渲染得过分严重
items.def_en: (+ sth) to make something seem much bigger, worse, or more important than it really is
items.ex_en: Sensational media outlets always blow up minor domestic disputes into nationwide scandals.
items.ex_zh: 耸人听闻的媒体总是把微不足道的内部纷争夸大成举国哗然的丑闻。
items.ex2_en: The minor neighborhood disagreement blew up into a bitter and protracted lawsuit.
items.ex2_zh: 一场轻微的邻里分歧演变成了一场激烈而旷日持久的官司。

items.def_zh: 过分渲染，大肆夸张（通常作 lay it on thick）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to exaggerate praise, flattery, or an excuse in an excessive, obvious way
items.ex_en: He tended to lay on the flattery whenever he needed a huge favour.
items.ex_zh: 每当需要别人帮大忙时，他往往会过分肉麻地大肆恭维。

items.def_en: to make a problem, difficulty, or danger seem far greater or more serious than it is
items.ex_en: Sensationalist journalists tend to magnify minor flaws into massive political scandals.
items.ex_zh: 追求轰动效应的记者往往会将微不足道的瑕疵无限放大为巨大的政治丑闻。

items.def_zh: 夸大，言过其实，过分强调
items.def_en: To state or describe something in terms that make it seem more important, serious, or extreme than it really is.
items.ex_en: Scientists cautioned that the media report chose to overstate the drug's immediate effectiveness.
items.ex_zh: 科学家警告称，媒体报道夸大了该药物的立竿见影效果。

items.def_en: [I/T] to speak or write using extreme rhetorical exaggeration
items.ex_en: The politician loved to hyperbolize regarding the unprecedented successes of his tax reform.
items.ex_zh: 那位政客喜欢大肆吹嘘其税制改革所取得的空前成就。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe portraying something as greater, more significant, or more dramatic than it actually is, ranging from slight embellishment to gross distortion.
groups.summary_zh: 描述言语中言过其实、夸大重要性或戏剧性渲染的程度递增行为。
groups.desc_en: Consists in amplifying, embellishing, or dramatizing reality beyond factual bounds to manipulate perception, contrasting with objective reporting.
groups.desc_zh: 指在表述中越过事实边界，对其规模、重要性或情节进行渲染与扩大以影响受众认知，区别于客观陈述。
groups.nuance_en: exaggerate: general overstatement of size, truth, or degree (importance / threat / symptoms) · overplay: overemphasizing a point or role, risking credibility (hand / importance / role) · embellish: adding decorative, often fabricated fictional details (story / truth / account) · talk up: deliberately hyping or promoting value (stock / chances / prospect) · magnify: making something appear disproportionately larger or graver (problem / faults / effect)
groups.nuance_zh: exaggerate: 一般性地夸大事实、程度或数量 (importance / threat / symptoms) · overplay: 过度着墨渲染反而适得其反 (hand / importance / role) · embellish: 添枝加叶进行文学性或虚构性润色 (story / truth / account) · talk up: 刻意吹捧、宣传以造势 (stock / chances / prospect) · magnify: 成倍放大严重性或规模 (problem / faults / effect)

groups.name: Paddle & Manually Propel Watercraft · 划桨与荡舟 (Row, Paddle, Canoe)
groups.tip: 乘船驾筏的水上运动

items.def_en: to propel a boat across water using oars mounted in rowlocks
items.ex_en: The exhausted fishermen took turns to row the heavy wooden skiff ashore.
items.ex_zh: 精疲力竭的渔民们轮流荡桨，把沉重的木质平底艇划向岸边。

items.def_en: to row or propel forward across water as if with oars (literary)
items.ex_en: The solemn boatman began to oar his craft across the mist-shrouded river.
items.ex_zh: 神情肃穆的船夫荡起双桨，驾舟穿行在浓雾笼罩的河流之上。

items.def_en: to move a rowing boat away from shore by rowing vigorously
items.ex_en: The team pulled away from the dock with powerful, perfectly synchronized strokes.
items.ex_zh: 赛艇队以强劲而整齐划一的桨频划桨驶离了码头。

items.def_en: to propel a small boat smoothly forward through the water with steady paddle strokes
items.ex_en: The kayakers were content to paddle along the quiet river under the trees.
items.ex_zh: 划皮艇的人心满意足地在林荫遮蔽的静谧河面上荡桨漫游。

items.def_en: 1. To propel or steer a small boat with a paddle. 2. To walk or play barefoot in shallow water.
items.ex_en: They grabbed their gear and proceeded to paddle their canoe across the lake.
items.ex_zh: 他们带上装备，接着划着独木舟穿过了整座湖泊。

items.def_zh: 划独木舟，乘独木舟旅行；用独木舟运送
items.def_en: To travel in or paddle a canoe; to transport by canoe.
items.ex_en: We decided to canoe down the tranquil river during our summer vacation in Maine.
items.ex_zh: 在缅因州度暑假期间，我们决定乘独木舟顺着宁静的河流顺流而下。

items.def_zh: 乘筏漂流，乘筏运送；扎成筏子
items.def_en: To travel or transport goods on a raft; to fasten together into a raft.
items.ex_en: Local villagers frequently raft heavy logs down the rushing mountain river after storms.
items.ex_zh: 暴风雨过后，当地村民经常用木筏将沉重的原木顺着湍急的山溪运下山。

items.def_en: to propel a flat-bottomed boat by pushing against the riverbed with a long pole
items.ex_en: Tourists love to punt slowly along the scenic river running through the university campus.
items.ex_zh: 游客们喜欢撑着平底船，沿着穿过大学校园的秀丽河流缓缓前行。

items.def_en: To travel or paddle in a kayak.
items.ex_en: He likes to kayak along the rugged shoreline every morning before starting work.
items.ex_zh: 每天早晨开始工作之前，他都喜欢划着皮划艇沿着崎岖的海岸线穿行。

items.def_en: to propel a boat with a single stern oar moved side to side, or using a pair of light oars
items.ex_en: The lone rower continued to scull smoothly across the glassy lake at dawn.
items.ex_zh: 破晓时分，那位孤独的划手继续在平静如镜的湖面上平稳地划着双桨赛艇。

groups.summary_en: Propelling, navigating, or steering small non-motorized watercraft across water using handheld oars, paddles, or poles. Differentiated by vessel type, blade type, and whether the motion is recreation, transit, or sport.
groups.summary_zh: 使用桨板人工驱动或驾驭小型船艇划行水上
groups.desc_en: Describes the human-powered kinetic propulsion of unmotorized watercraft across a liquid surface, distinguished from wind sailing or automated engine cruising.
groups.desc_zh: 指依靠人力操作桨具在水面推动非机动舟船前行，区别于风帆航海或机械动力航行。
groups.nuance_en: row: pulling fixed oars with linear leverage, typically facing backward (boat / dinghy / scull) · paddle: manipulating a handheld, unpivoted blade facing forward (canoe / kayak / board) · punt: propelling a flat-bottomed boat using a long pole thrust against the riverbed (boat / river) · canoe: navigating specifically via canoe technique (river / lake / waters) · raft: traversing turbulent or flat water on an inflatable or lashed raft (rapids / river)
groups.nuance_zh: row: 利用与船体固定的双桨背向拉拽前进 (boat / dinghy / scull) · paddle: 手持无支点桨叶面朝前方划行 (canoe / kayak / board) · punt: 用长篙撑实水底推动平底船 (boat / river) · canoe: 驾划独木舟或皮艇航行 (river / lake / waters) · raft: 乘筏漂流或渡水 (rapids / river)

groups.name: Pare & Finely Trim · 切削修整与微切 (Pare, Manicure, Mince)
groups.tip: 动刀细致切削碎化或切薄

items.def_en: (+ sth) to remove small or protruding pieces from something with quick, fine cuts using scissors or shears
items.ex_en: The gardener used sharp shears to snip off the dead stems from the rosebushes.
items.ex_zh: 园丁用锋利的剪刀利落地剪掉了玫瑰丛上的枯茎。

items.def_zh: 修整切除，削掉多余边缘
items.def_en: (+ sth) to remove unwanted outer edges, fat, or excess material by careful slicing or cutting
items.ex_en: The butcher used a sharp knife to trim away excess fat from the pork loin.
items.ex_zh: 屠夫用一把锋利的刀削掉了猪里脊肉上多余的脂肪。

items.def_en: [I/T] to cut very thin layers, slivers, or fibers from the surface of an object
items.ex_en: The carpenter carefully shaved thin curls of cedar from the edge of the door.
items.ex_zh: 木匠小心翼翼地从门边缘刮下薄薄的雪松木卷片。

items.def_en: [I/T] to cut small bits off something using rapid, light strokes of scissors or shears
items.ex_en: She carefully snipped the loose threads protruding from the sleeve of her silk blouse.
items.ex_zh: 她小心地剪掉了丝绸衬衫袖子上伸出来的零星线头。

items.def_zh: 修整（指甲）；精细修剪，精心护理（草坪、庭院等）
items.def_en: To trim, clean, and polish fingernails neatly; to groom or trim lawns and gardens with meticulous care.
items.ex_en: The groundskeeper took great pride in manicuring the vast estate lawns every Saturday morning.
items.ex_zh: 庄园管理员非常引以为傲的是，每周六早晨都将宽阔的草坪精细修剪一番。

items.def_en: [I/T] to carve or shape wood by repetitively slicing small slivers off surface edges
items.ex_en: Grandfather sat on the porch and whittled small wooden figures for the neighborhood children.
items.ex_zh: 祖父坐在门廊上，为邻里的小孩削制小木雕人偶。

items.def_zh: 削，削去（表皮、指甲等）；削减，缩减（开支、人员等）
items.def_en: 1. To cut away the thin outer skin or edge of something with a sharp knife. 2. (+ down/back) To gradually reduce the size, amount, or cost of something.
items.ex_en: The chef demonstrated how to pare the tough outer skin from fresh winter squash.
items.ex_zh: 主厨现场示范了如何用锋利的刀削去新鲜冬南瓜坚硬的外皮。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to gradually reduce the size, thickness, or outer edges of something by cutting or paring
items.ex_en: He used a hand plane to pare down the swollen wooden door until it closed.
items.ex_zh: 他用手刨慢慢削修这扇受潮膨胀的木门，直到它能够合上。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to cut or carve fine pieces off something to shape it or progressively reduce its size
items.ex_en: The craftsman whittled down the thick block of cedar into a delicate miniature horse.
items.ex_zh: 手艺人把那块厚实的雪松木不断削切，雕成了一匹精致的微型小马。

items.def_zh: 切碎，剁碎（肉或蔬菜）；装腔作势地迈碎步走；委婉含蓄地说
items.def_en: 1. To cut meat or other food into very small pieces. 2. To walk with short, quick, affected steps. 3. ('not mince words') To express thoughts directly without softening them.
items.ex_en: Please mince the fresh garlic and parsley finely before stirring them into the sauce.
items.ex_zh: 在将新鲜大蒜和欧芹拌入酱汁前，请把它们切碎。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express meticulous, controlled reductive cutting, trimming, or shaving of edges and layers to groom aesthetic form or achieve minute culinary particle sizes.
groups.summary_zh: 精细切削边缘外层、微切或修整外形以达工整。
groups.desc_en: Refers to the micro-reductive removal of outer surfaces, edges, or excesses with a blade to refine, shape, or economize, contrasting with coarse chopping or hacking.
groups.desc_zh: 指用刃具对物体的外皮、边缘或多余部分进行精细削刮剥除以整饬、塑形或缩减，区别于粗暴的砍剁或大块切割。
groups.nuance_en: pare: shaving off the thin skin, rind, or excess margin (apple / fingernails / costs) · whittle: repeatedly carving small wood chips to sculpt, or progressively reducing (wood / stick / debt) · manicure: meticulously trimming and grooming for aesthetic neatness (lawn / nails / hedges) · snip: making quick, delicate scissor cuts (thread / herbs / hair) · shave: slicing off ultra-thin surface layers or small fractions (slices / whiskers / points)
groups.nuance_zh: pare: 削去表皮、修整边缘或微幅压缩 (apple / fingernails / costs) · whittle: 削木塑形，或一点点蚕食减少 (wood / stick / debt) · manicure: 极度精细地修剪以求美观工整 (lawn / nails / hedges) · snip: 用小剪刀轻快剪下 (thread / herbs / hair) · shave: 极薄地刮削表层或微量缩减 (slices / whiskers / points)

groups.name: Partition & Segregate · 切分与隔断 (Partition, Chunk, Disconnect)
groups.tip: 切割成块并划分配额

items.def_en: (+ sth) to separate or block off a specific section or enclosure by enclosing it with ropes
items.ex_en: Museum staff had to rope off the fragile mosaic floor during the grand exhibition.
items.ex_zh: 盛大展览期间，博物馆工作人员不得不将脆弱的马赛克地面用绳索圈隔开。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to divide or hide a part of a room or space by placing a partition or screen in front of it
items.ex_en: They used decorative wooden panels to screen off the dining nook from the corridor.
items.ex_zh: 他们用装饰性木质屏风把用餐小隔间与走廊分隔开来。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to divide a larger space or whole into separate, distinct functional sections
items.ex_en: Police sectioned off the street with tape while detectives examined the crime scene.
items.ex_zh: 当刑警勘查犯罪现场时，警方用警戒线将整条街道隔离开来。

items.def_zh: 把……分成大块；把（信息、任务等）分段组块
items.def_en: To divide or break data, tasks, or materials into thick pieces or manageable chunks.
items.ex_en: The teacher showed students how to chunk large study materials into manageable revision sets.
items.ex_zh: 老师向学生们展示了如何将大量的学习资料分段组块成易于复习的单元。

items.def_en: to divide something previously whole into smaller parcels, tracts, or organizational units
items.ex_en: The developer obtained municipal approval to subdivide the expansive farm into twelve residential lots.
items.ex_zh: 开发商获得了市政许可，将这片广阔的农场再细分为十二个住宅地块。
items.ex2_en: The original organization subdivided smoothly into three independent regional commercial operating branches.
items.ex2_zh: 原机构顺利地细分成了三个独立的区域商业运营分支。

items.def_zh: 用警戒线隔开，封闭隔离
items.def_en: (+ sth) to separate and isolate an area using a physical boundary, tape, or line of guards
items.ex_en: Police officers rushed to cordon off the downtown intersection following the sudden gas leak.
items.ex_zh: 发生突发瓦斯泄漏后，警员们迅速赶到现场用警戒线封闭了闹市交叉路口。

items.def_zh: 隔开，分割；把（国家等）分裂，划分
items.def_en: To divide a room, space, or country into separate parts, especially by walls or borders.
items.ex_en: The architect suggested we partition the expansive master suite with a soundproof drywall.
items.ex_zh: 建筑师建议我们用隔音轻质隔墙将宽敞的主卧套房隔开。

items.def_zh: 切断，断开（连接、电源或供应）；使分离，使脱节
items.def_en: To separate or unfasten something from a power supply, larger system, or another object.
items.ex_en: Always remember to disconnect the appliance from the wall socket before attempting any cleaning.
items.ex_zh: 在尝试进行任何清洁之前，切记先将电器与墙上插座断开。
items.ex2_en: The wireless headset disconnected abruptly while she was hosting an important presentation.
items.ex2_zh: 无线耳机在她主持重要演讲时突然断开了连接。

items.def_en: to divide into completely discrete, mutually isolated sections or cognitive categories
items.ex_en: Surgeons often learn to compartmentalize personal grief during grueling, hours-long emergency operations.
items.ex_zh: 外科医生往往学会在长达数小时筋疲力竭的急诊手术中将个人悲伤隔绝开来。

items.def_en: to separate an area physically or organizationally from its surroundings using a barrier
items.ex_en: Part of the courtyard was walled off to create a private garden.
items.ex_zh: 院子的一部分被砌墙隔开，改造成了一个私人花园。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the spatial, infrastructural, or computational division of a continuous entity into distinct partitions, isolated blocks, or decoupled functional units.
groups.summary_zh: 将连续空间、结构或系统切分为独立块区或断开连接。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the intentional spatial, architectural, or informational division of a unified entity into isolated enclosures or discrete segments, contrasting with total destruction.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过物理屏障或逻辑断开，将原本连贯的整体切分划界为封闭单元或离散块体，区别于彻底拆毁。
groups.nuance_en: partition: creating permanent or semi-permanent internal dividers (room / office / hard drive) · cordon off: establishing a protective or restrictive security perimeter (street / crime scene / area) · screen off: blocking line of sight with a temporary barrier (alcove / bed / area) · subdivide: breaking a larger unit into smaller legal, spatial, or structural plots (land / lot / categories) · rope off: using ropes to restrict public access (area / VIP section / exhibit)
groups.nuance_zh: partition: 砌筑或设置隔断分出独立空间 (room / office / hard drive) · cordon off: 拉设警戒线隔离特定区域 (street / crime scene / area) · screen off: 用屏风等遮挡物隔断视线 (alcove / bed / area) · subdivide: 将大宗地产或单元二次切分细分 (land / lot / categories) · rope off: 用绳索拦起以限制出入 (area / VIP section / exhibit)

groups.name: Pay Out & Disburse · 支出与出纳支付 (Disburse, Pay out, Defray)
groups.tip: 机构官方拨付款项或过度支出

items.def_en: to distribute or pay a large sum of money from a fund, policy, or account
items.ex_en: The insurance firm will pay out millions in compensation to families affected by floods.
items.ex_zh: 保险公司将向受洪水影响的家庭支付数百万巨额赔偿金。

items.def_en: [I/T] (informal) (+ for) to reluctantly pay a large amount of money
items.ex_en: I really hated having to shell out fifty dollars just for overnight airport parking.
items.ex_zh: 我真不情愿为了在机场停个通宵就硬掏五十美元。

items.def_en: (+ for sth) to spend or disburse an amount of money, usually unwillingly or under obligation
items.ex_en: We reluctantly had to fork out hundreds of dollars to repair the broken furnace.
items.ex_zh: 我们不得不心不甘情不愿地大掏数百美元来修缮坏掉的暖气炉。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to surrender or pay out money, especially reluctantly after pressure
items.ex_en: The landlord pressured the delinquent tenant until he finally agreed to cough up rent.
items.ex_zh: 房东不断向欠租的房客施压，直到他最终勉强同意掏钱补交房租。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to spend or disburse a substantial sum of money on something
items.ex_en: The CEO laid out an ambitious five-year growth strategy.
items.ex_zh: 首席执行官详细阐述了一项雄心勃勃的五年增长战略。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to pay money owed or cover an expenditure
items.ex_en: The gamblers knew they had to pony up their lost wagers before dawn arrived.
items.ex_zh: 赌徒们心知肚明，天亮之前他们必须把输掉的赌资全部付清。

items.def_en: 1. To pay out money, especially from a public or official fund.
items.ex_en: The municipal committee will disburse emergency relief grants to qualified small businesses next week.
items.ex_zh: 市政委员会将于下周向符合资格的小型企业拨付紧急救济补助款。

items.def_zh: 多付，多给报酬；付出过高代价
items.def_en: 1. To pay someone too much money, or pay more than the correct or reasonable amount for something.
items.ex_en: The payroll department accidentally managed to overpay several part-time employees this month.
items.ex_zh: 薪资部门这个月不小心给好几位兼职员工多付了报酬。

items.def_en: 1. To spend more money than is planned, budgeted, or affordable.
items.ex_en: If we overspend on marketing initiatives, we will surely face severe cash shortages.
items.ex_zh: 如果我们过度超支营销费用，就必定会面临严重的现金短缺。

items.def_en: to provide money to pay for a particular cost or expense
items.ex_en: The generous travel grant helped defray the student's living expenses throughout the symposium.
items.ex_zh: 那笔丰厚的差旅资助帮助该学生承担了整场研讨会期间的生活开销。

groups.summary_en: Financial transaction scenario dealing with releasing, expending, or covering funds—often from institutional reserves, budgets, or dedicated accounts, as well as exceeding acceptable payment thresholds.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及机构拨款拨付、费用报销冲抵或超出预算限额的资金支出情境。
groups.desc_en: Covers the formal, transactional, or reluctant transferring of substantial monetary funds out of an account or pocket, contrasting with casual buying or inward receiving.
groups.desc_zh: 指经由正式出纳规程或在非情愿压力下大笔拨付、结清款项，区别于日常零售消费或资金收入。
groups.nuance_en: disburse: formally paying out institutional funds according to policy (funds / grant / loan) · fork out: parting with significant money unwillingly (cash / fee / sum) · shell out: paying an unexpectedly high price or exorbitant amount (fortune / millions / money) · cough up: surrendering money under coercion, pressure, or overdue demand (ransom / fine / cash) · pony up: settling a debt or contributing one's required share (money / cash / dues)
groups.nuance_zh: disburse: 官方或机构按章拨款、支付 (funds / grant / loan) · fork out: 勉为其难地掏钱大笔支出 (cash / fee / sum) · shell out: 不情愿地承担昂贵费用 (fortune / millions / money) · cough up: 在逼迫或催缴下勉强交出钱款 (ransom / fine / cash) · pony up: 结清分摊份额或付清欠账 (money / cash / dues)

groups.name: Permeate & Filter Through · 渗透与漫溢 (Permeate, Percolate, Infiltrate)
groups.tip: 分子或液体在介质中蔓延

items.def_en: (+ into/through sth) to flow or spread extremely slowly through tiny openings, cracks, or pores
items.ex_en: Rainwater began to seep through microscopic cracks in the aging basement foundation wall.
items.ex_zh: 雨水开始穿过地下室老化地基墙体上极细微的裂痕慢慢渗入。

items.def_en: (+ into/through sth) to gradually pass, spread, or disperse through a medium, barrier, or population
items.ex_en: Sunlight filtered through the dense canopy of trees.
items.ex_zh: 阳光透过茂密的树冠洒了下来。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to completely penetrate and saturate a porous material or fabric with liquid
items.ex_en: The driving freezing rain quickly soaked through his thick woolen coat and scarf.
items.ex_zh: 倾盆而下的冻雨很快就完全湿透了他厚重的羊毛大衣和围巾。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to slowly seep, spread, or run into an adjacent area or material
items.ex_en: Red ink from the fresh stamp began to bleed into the adjacent text.
items.ex_zh: 新印章上的红色印泥开始慢慢渗透蔓延到了邻近的正文中。

items.def_zh: 使湿透、使浸透、使彻底充满
items.def_en: to fill or soak something so completely that no more can be absorbed
items.ex_en: Torrential monsoon rains will quickly saturate the clay soil and cause severe landslides.
items.ex_zh: 倾盆的季风暴雨将迅速使黏土土壤彻底饱和浸透，并引发严重山体滑坡。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ into/through) to pass gradually into a substance through small openings, or secretly enter an organization
items.ex_en: Undercover agents managed to infiltrate the criminal syndicate without raising any direct suspicion.
items.ex_zh: 卧底探员设法悄悄潜入了该犯罪辛迪加内部，未引起任何直接怀疑。

items.def_en: (+ through/into) to trickle or pass slowly through fine pores or small crevices
items.ex_en: Thick crude oil began to seep slowly through microscopic fissures in the pipeline.
items.ex_zh: 浓稠的原油开始穿过管道上的细微裂隙缓缓漏出。

items.def_en: To spread or diffuse through every part of something, especially of a liquid, gas, smell, or influence.
items.ex_en: The aromatic scent of roasted coffee beans will permeate every corner of the cafe.
items.ex_zh: 烘焙咖啡豆的浓郁香气会弥漫渗透到咖啡馆的每一个角落。

items.def_zh: 弥漫于、布满（光彩、情感等）
items.def_en: (+ with) to spread gradually through or over something with liquid, color, or emotional light
items.ex_en: A soft golden glow suffused the quiet valley as the morning sun emerged.
items.ex_zh: 随着晨曦初现，一抹柔和的金色霞光渐渐弥漫洒满了整座寂静的山谷。

items.def_zh: 过滤，渗透；（思想、消息等）逐渐传开；滤煮（咖啡）
items.def_en: 1. (of a liquid) To filter or seep gradually through a porous surface or substance. 2. (of ideas, feelings, or news) To spread slowly through a group or community. 3. To brew coffee using a percolator.
items.ex_en: Hot boiling water began to percolate gently through the freshly ground espresso beans.
items.ex_zh: 沸腾的热水开始慢慢滤过新研磨好的意式浓缩咖啡粉。
items.ex2_en: She gently percolated fresh rainwater through layers of charcoal and coarse sand.
items.ex2_zh: 她让新鲜的雨水缓缓滤过一层层的木炭和粗砂。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe fluids, vapors, or figurative elements (such as ideas, moods, and qualities) gradually moving through pores, small spaces, or an entire substance/community until fully spread.
groups.summary_zh: 指液体、气体或抽象观念透过孔隙、网络逐步穿透并散布全局。
groups.desc_en: Captures the gradual, molecular-level capillary invasion of fluids, gases, or ideas through porous boundaries into an entire medium, contrasting with sudden pouring or localized surface wetting.
groups.desc_zh: 指流体、气体或观念经由多孔介质细微孔隙发生毛细渗透、浸润直至弥散整体，区别于倾泻或局部表面打湿。
groups.nuance_en: permeate: thoroughly diffusing throughout and pervading every part (smell / influence / water) · seep: slowly oozing through fine pores or tiny cracks (liquid / blood / through soil) · infiltrate: stealthily or insidiously penetrating across boundaries (enemy lines / culture / water) · saturate: soaking to complete volumetric holding capacity (soil / market / fabric) · percolate: filtering downward through porous matter or slowly germinating socially (coffee / water / ideas)
groups.nuance_zh: permeate: 全面弥漫渗透进每一寸空间 (smell / influence / water) · seep: 从微孔或缝隙中缓慢渗漏出 (liquid / blood / through soil) · infiltrate: 隐蔽渗透进入严密防线或组织 (enemy lines / culture / water) · saturate: 彻底浸透达饱和吸附上限 (soil / market / fabric) · percolate: 经由滤网沥下，或思想慢慢酝酿发酵 (coffee / water / ideas)

groups.name: Persevere & Endure · 咬牙坚持与挺过 (Weather, Soldier on, Stick it out)
groups.tip: 顶住压力逆风死撑

items.def_en: to continue surviving, persevering, or refusing to quit during an ordeal or hostile situation
items.ex_en: Hang on a second, let me grab a pen to write that down.
items.ex_zh: 稍等一下，我拿支笔把它记下来。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to continue supporting or doing something challenging until its complete conclusion
items.ex_en: The dedicated project manager vowed to see through the arduous contract despite delays.
items.ex_zh: 那位尽职的项目经理誓要将这份繁重的合同坚持执行到底，尽管屡遭延误。

items.def_en: to continue doing something with grit and determination despite facing pain, fatigue, or difficulty
items.ex_en: Despite nursing a sprained ankle, the runner resolved to soldier on towards the finish.
items.ex_zh: 尽管脚踝扭伤隐隐作痛，那名长跑选手仍决意咬紧牙关坚毅挺进终点。

items.def_zh: 坚持到底；硬着头皮熬下去
items.def_en: to continue doing something difficult, unpleasant, or painful to the very end
items.ex_en: The work environment was miserable, but she chose to stick it out until winter.
items.ex_zh: 工作环境虽令人痛苦，但她还是选择硬着头皮熬到入冬。

items.def_zh: 坚持下去，硬挺下去，顽强坚持（常与 on 连用）；当兵，服兵役
items.def_en: (also 'soldier on') To persevere and continue doing something despite difficulty, pain, or tiredness.
items.ex_en: The exhausted rescue workers had no choice but to soldier through the bitter cold.
items.ex_zh: 筋疲力尽的救援人员别无选择，只能在刺骨的严寒中顽强坚持下去。

items.def_zh: 经受住，平安度过（难关、风暴等）；（使）风化，（受风雨侵蚀）褪色变质
items.def_en: 1. To endure, survive, or come through a difficult situation or storm safely. 2. To change in color, shape, or condition as a result of exposure to the elements.
items.ex_en: The historic stone lighthouse managed to weather the fierce Atlantic storm without damage.
items.ex_zh: 那座历史悠久的石砌灯塔安然经受住了大西洋猛烈风暴的考验，毫发无损。

items.def_en: to experience and bear continuing hardship, pain, or misfortune without giving in
items.ex_en: Prisoners in the isolated camp had to endure freezing temperatures and scarce rations daily.
items.ex_zh: 身处偏远营地的囚犯每天都必须默默忍受严寒的天气和微薄的口粮。

items.def_en: to continue to resist or survive under attack or deprivation
items.ex_en: The besieged garrison managed to hold out against enemy attacks for three weeks.
items.ex_zh: 被包围的守军设法坚守阵地，顽强抵挡住了敌军长达三周的猛烈进攻。

items.def_zh: 安然挺过，平安度过（风波、危机）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to survive or manage to get through a dangerous, tumultuous, or difficult period unharmed
items.ex_en: The small company managed to ride out the recession without laying off any staff.
items.ex_zh: 这家小公司成功渡过了经济衰退期，且没有裁掉任何员工。

items.def_en: to endure a difficult, painful, or confrontational period with grim determination
items.ex_en: During the intense audit, the executives were determined to tough it out together.
items.ex_zh: 在紧张严苛的审计期间，高管们下定决心咬牙携手硬挺过去。

groups.summary_en: An agent continues forward through adversity, exhaustion, or hostile conditions, showing fortitude and refusing to surrender. Verbs differ in whether the emphasis is on stoic continuation despite pain or surviving an acute storm of events.
groups.summary_zh: 面对逆境、疲劳或严酷打击仍咬牙坚持、经受考验而不倒。
groups.desc_en: Involves maintaining grit, composure, and continuous function through severe, exhausting adversity until the hardship passes, contrasting with giving up or easily bypassing the trial.
groups.desc_zh: 指在极端恶劣或旷日持久的困境中咬牙苦撑、坚忍不拔直至度过难关，区别于中途放弃或侥幸规避。
groups.nuance_en: weather: withstanding a destructive storm or crisis without succumbing (storm / crisis / recession) · endure: tolerating painful or grueling conditions over prolonged time (pain / hardship / abuse) · soldier on: stoically continuing one's duty despite fatigue or sickness (despite pain / through cold) · stick it out: resolutely staying in an unpleasant situation to the bitter end (job / winter / course) · hold out: maintaining resistance against siege, pressure, or dwindling resources (against attackers / for better terms)
groups.nuance_zh: weather: 经受住风暴或危机而不倒 (storm / crisis / recession) · endure: 长期默默忍耐痛苦与磨难 (pain / hardship / abuse) · soldier on: 克服伤病疲惫像士兵般继续挺住履职 (despite pain / through cold) · stick it out: 哪怕境遇极糟也咬牙硬撑到底 (job / winter / course) · hold out: 坚守阵地抗击围困，或坚持要求不妥协 (against attackers / for better terms)

groups.name: Personal Attendance & Domestic Service · 侍奉与随侍服务 (Attend, Valet, Wait on)
groups.tip: 到场出席参与其中

items.def_zh: 照料，服侍，照料……的起居需求
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to attend to the needs, comfort, or physical welfare of a person
items.ex_en: The hospice nurse continued to look after the elderly patient with exceptional tenderness.
items.ex_zh: 临终关怀护士继续以无比体贴的温柔照料着那位年长患者的起居。

items.def_zh: 照料伺候，满足……的个人需要
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to attend to the practical needs or personal requirements of someone
items.ex_en: Don't worry about the catering for the party; I'll see to it.
items.ex_zh: 别担心聚会的餐饮问题，我会负责照料妥当的。

items.def_zh: 为……服务，服侍；任职，服役；端上，供应（饭菜）；起作用
items.def_en: 1. To perform duties or work for a person, organization, or country. 2. To provide food or drink to guests or customers. 3. (+ as) To be useful for a particular purpose or function.
items.ex_en: The loyal butler continued to serve the aristocratic family for over thirty years.
items.ex_zh: 这位忠诚的管家在这座贵族家庭中恪尽职守服侍了三十余年。

items.def_en: to accompany and supervise an individual or group as a protective social attendant
items.ex_en: Two experienced teachers agreed to chaperone the enthusiastic high school students on their trip.
items.ex_zh: 两位经验丰富的老师同意在高中生的游学旅行中充当陪同监护人。

items.def_zh: 代客泊车；伺候，照看（客人衣物等）；彻底清洗（汽车）
items.def_en: 1. To park cars for customers (as a valet). 2. To act as a personal attendant to someone, especially by caring for their clothes. 3. (chiefly British) To clean the inside and outside of a vehicle thoroughly.
items.ex_en: The hotel staff will valet your rental car as soon as you arrive.
items.ex_zh: 只要您一抵达，酒店工作人员就会立即为您代客泊车。

items.def_zh: 奉承侍奉，奴颜婢膝地巴结伺候
items.def_en: (+ sb) to attend to someone with excessive, servile, or ingratiating attentiveness
items.ex_en: Ambitious courtiers would constantly fawn on the monarch in hopes of receiving titles.
items.ex_zh: 野心勃勃的廷臣们总是对君主奴颜婢膝地阿谀奉承，以期博得封号。

items.def_en: (+ hand and foot) to act as an attendant to someone, providing food, drink, or personal care
items.ex_en: The devoted servants continued to wait on the bedridden duke hand and foot.
items.ex_zh: 忠心耿耿的仆人们继续无微不至地服侍着卧病在床的公爵起居。

items.def_zh: 出席，参加；照料，侍候；专心于，处理（attend to）
items.def_en: 1. To be present at an event, meeting, or ceremony, or regularly go to a school or church. 2. (+ to) To pay attention to, deal with, or care for someone or something.
items.ex_en: Two royal ladies-in-waiting were specifically appointed to attend the young queen at court.
items.ex_zh: 宫廷特意指派了两位高贵的侍从女官在内廷服侍年轻的女王。

items.def_en: to escort or attend someone gallantly or solicitously in public
items.ex_en: The dashing diplomat offered to squire the foreign ambassador through the bustling ballroom.
items.ex_zh: 那位风度翩翩的外交官主动殷勤护送外国大使穿过熙熙攘攘的舞厅。

items.def_zh: 照料；伺候（病弱或需要者）
items.def_en: to attend carefully to the personal, spiritual, or physical needs of someone
items.ex_en: The devoted nuns worked tirelessly to minister to the desperate sick during the epidemic.
items.ex_zh: 疫情肆虐期间，虔诚的修女们不知疲倦地悉心照料那些无助的病患。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe personal ministering, domestic attendance, or bespoke care provided to an individual, varying in formality, subservience, and the exact physical domain of personal service.
groups.summary_zh: 描述为他人提供个人照料、随侍或专业管家式服务的行为与方式。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on providing deferential, meticulous personal bodily care, hospitality, or domestic retinue service to a dignitary, patient, or employer, contrasting with reciprocal socializing.
groups.desc_zh: 指为尊贵长官、病患或主人提供服侍、随侍或家政照料，带有服侍性与依附性，区别于平等的社交互动。
groups.nuance_en: wait on: serving domestic and dining needs attentively hand and foot (master / guests / tables) · attend: accompanying, providing professional assistance or formal retinue to (patient / VIP / monarch) · valet: caring for garments and vehicle/personal grooming needs as an intimate valet (gentleman / car / clothes) · chaperone: supervising a vulnerable person or ward for propriety and safety (dancers / children / group) · fawn on: servilely flattering or showering cloying attention to curry favor (patron / superior)
groups.nuance_zh: wait on: 鞍前马后伺候起居饮食 (master / guests / tables) · attend: 作为侍从或专业随从服侍、照看 (patient / VIP / monarch) · valet: 作为私人贴身男仆照料衣着、行装或车辆 (gentleman / car / clothes) · chaperone: 作为监护人陪同随行以护安全品行 (dancers / children / group) · fawn on: 谄媚逢迎、巴结服侍以讨好 (patron / superior)

groups.name: Physical Confinement & Seclusion · 禁闭与关押 (Cage, Closet, Confine)
groups.tip: 关入封闭狭小空间限制自由

items.def_zh: 把（人或牲畜）关入栏圈中
items.def_en: to put or keep animals or people in a small enclosed area
items.ex_en: At dusk, the shepherd hurried to pen his flock safely inside the fold.
items.ex_zh: 黄昏时分，牧羊人赶忙将他的羊群安全地关入羊圈之中。

items.def_en: to put someone in a prison, cell, or locked room
items.ex_en: Guards will lock up unruly inmates in solitary confinement for violating the rules.
items.ex_zh: 狱警会将违规闹事的犯人锁入禁闭室单独拘禁。

items.def_en: to keep someone or something confined in a small or restricted space
items.ex_en: The energetic kids hated being cooped up inside the tiny apartment on rainy weekends.
items.ex_zh: 精力充沛的孩子们非常讨厌在阴雨的周末被禁锢在狭小的公寓里。

items.def_en: to close doors or boundaries so as to prevent someone or something from leaving
items.ex_en: They had to shut in the barking dog whenever evening visitors rang the doorbell.
items.ex_zh: 每当傍晚访客按响门铃时，他们都必须把狂吠的狗关在屋内。

items.def_zh: 把……幽闭/关押起来，使其与外界隔绝
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to confine a person or animal in an enclosed room or secluded space away from others
items.ex_en: The tyrannical king chose to shut away his political rivals in the dark dungeon.
items.ex_zh: 残暴的国王选择将自己的政敌幽闭关押在暗无天日的地下地牢中。

items.def_zh: 圈闭，关在围栏/狭小空间内
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to trap or confine a person or animal in an enclosed physical space
items.ex_en: Farmers built a sturdy wooden corral to pen in the unruly young calves.
items.ex_zh: 农夫们搭建了一个结实的木栅栏，将那群乱蹦乱跳的小牛圈闭在里面。

items.def_zh: 严密围困，把……禁闭在狭小空间内
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to restrict someone's movement by trapping them in a confined area with no way out
items.ex_en: My car was boxed in by two huge delivery trucks, and I couldn't pull out.
items.ex_zh: 我的车被两辆大卡车死死卡在中间，根本开不出来。

items.def_en: to put or confine someone or an animal in a cage.
items.ex_en: The rescue workers were horrified to find poachers attempting to cage wild leopards illegally.
items.ex_zh: 救援人员惊骇地发现，偷猎者正企图将野生花豹非法关入铁笼监禁。

items.def_zh: 把……关入密室（商谈）；把……藏在小房间中
items.def_en: (chiefly passive) to shut someone away in a private room for a confidential discussion or intense work.
items.ex_en: The prime minister was closeted with top advisors to finalize the emergency budget.
items.ex_zh: 首相与高级顾问们把自己关在密室里，以敲定紧急预算案。

items.def_en: (+ to) to keep someone within certain limits or enclose them in a room or prison
items.ex_en: The court ordered that the convict be confined to his cell for thirty days.
items.ex_zh: 法院下令将该犯人关押在其牢房内三十天。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on physically shutting a person or creature into a small, enclosed container or interior space, restricting their physical liberty. Registers vary from everyday literal confinement to literary or metaphorical seclusion.
groups.summary_zh: 将人或动物封闭在狭小实体空间或房间内限制其人身自由。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the restrictive physical immurement or spatial containment of a living being within narrow, barred boundaries, depriving freedom of movement, contrasting with open detention.
groups.desc_zh: 指将人或动物强行封锁在狭窄、受限的笼舍或房间内以剥夺其行动自由，区别于开阔范围内的普通拘留。
groups.nuance_en: cage: confining behind metallic bars or in a literal wire cage (animal / bird / prisoner) · coop up: cramming into uncomfortably cramped, stuffy quarters (kids / chickens / inside) · lock up: securing someone behind locked doors in a penal or formal setting (criminal / inmate / jewels) · pen in: restricting movement by encircling with fencing or barriers (sheep / cattle / protesters) · shut away: isolating someone away from society or public sight (monk / patient / self)
groups.nuance_zh: cage: 关入带铁栅的笼中 (animal / bird / prisoner) · coop up: 憋屈地挤在狭窄闷热的空间里 (kids / chickens / inside) · lock up: 锁在牢房或密室内 (criminal / inmate / jewels) · pen in: 围入栏圈中或封死行动路线 (sheep / cattle / protesters) · shut away: 禁闭或深锁起来隔绝世人视线 (monk / patient / self)

groups.name: Physical Evasion & Quick Dodging · 敏捷躲闪与闪避 (Dodge, Duck, Shy)
groups.tip: 迅速侧身避开障碍

items.def_en: to quickly lower your head or body to avoid being struck or seen
items.ex_en: The soldier quickly ducked down behind the low wall to escape enemy sniper fire.
items.ex_zh: 士兵迅速蹲伏在矮墙后，以躲避敌方狙击手的火力。

items.def_en: (+ from sb/sth) to make a sudden nervous movement away from something due to fright or sudden alarm
items.ex_en: The skittish horse shied away from the fluttering plastic bag on the trail.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的马猛然躲开了小路上飘动的塑料袋。

items.def_en: [I/T] to quickly lower the head or body to avoid being hit or seen
items.ex_en: He had to duck swiftly to avoid being hit by the flying baseball.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不迅速低下头，以避免被飞来的棒球击中。

items.def_zh: （因畏惧或惊吓而）退缩，退避；（马）惊跳后退
items.def_en: 1. (+ away from) To avoid doing something because you feel nervous, reluctant, or fearful. 2. (of a horse) To jump suddenly aside in fright.
items.ex_en: The young mare shied violently at the sudden sound of loud thunder.
items.ex_zh: 那匹年轻的母马听到突如其来的巨响雷声，惊吓得猛然退避。

items.def_en: [I/T] to step quickly to one side to avoid an oncoming blow or obstacle
items.ex_en: The boxer side-stepped a fierce jab and countered with a swift blow.
items.ex_zh: 拳击手横跨一步躲开了一记凶猛的刺拳，随即展开迅速的反击。

items.def_en: to make a quick, nervous movement of the face or body as an instinctive reaction to pain or fear
items.ex_en: He did not flinch even when the doctor pressed firmly on the deep wound.
items.ex_zh: 即便医生用力按压那道深伤口，他也丝毫没有退缩畏怯。

items.def_en: to make a sudden spring backward to avoid an immediate physical hazard or blow
items.ex_en: She jumped back in horror when she noticed the coiled snake beside her foot.
items.ex_zh: 当注意到脚边盘绕着一条蛇时，她惊恐地猛然跳退。

items.def_zh: 猛转方向避开，急转闪开
items.def_en: (+ from sb/sth) to change direction abruptly and sharply to avoid colliding with an oncoming obstacle
items.ex_en: The speeding motorist had to swerve away from the stray deer on the highway.
items.ex_zh: 超速行驶的车主不得不急转方向，避开高速公路上的迷途野鹿。

items.def_zh: 闪避，躲开；故意回避，躲闪（问题、责任等）
items.def_en: 1. To move quickly aside to avoid hitting or being hit by something. 2. To evade a duty, responsibility, or question cleverly or dishonestly.
items.ex_en: The pedestrian managed to dodge the out-of-control cyclist just in the nick of time.
items.ex_zh: 行人及时敏捷地闪避开了一辆失控的自行车。

items.def_en: to change direction abruptly, especially while moving, in order to avoid a collision
items.ex_en: The driver swerved sharply into the adjacent lane to avoid hitting the stalled truck.
items.ex_zh: 司机猛转方向驶入相邻车道，以避免撞上抛锚的卡车。
items.ex2_en: The stunt driver deliberately swerved the speeding car across the empty track.
items.ex2_zh: 特技车手故意让飞驰的汽车在空旷的跑道上突然转向。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe sudden, instinctive, or agile physical movements used to evade an oncoming object, blow, or unexpected obstacle, or backing away out of sudden alarm.
groups.summary_zh: 以迅捷或条件反射式的肢体动作避开物理冲击或突然的威胁。
groups.desc_en: Highlights reflexive, agile somatic adjustments—lowering, twisting, or leaping aside—to evade an incoming projectile, blow, or confrontation, contrasting with pre-planned withdrawal.
groups.desc_zh: 指身体因本能或敏捷反应做出的低头、侧身、回缩等快速位移动作以避开物理撞击或对抗，区别于从容撤退。
groups.nuance_en: duck: dropping the head or upper body suddenly below an obstacle (head / blow / under fence) · dodge: abruptly shifting lateral position to evade a moving hazard (bullet / blow / question) · side-step: stepping sideways to let something pass, literally or politically (tackle / blow / issue) · flinch: involuntary, micro-recoil triggered by pain, fear, or loud noise (from blow / at sight) · shy: leaping or swerving aside in sudden startled fright (horse / from contact)
groups.nuance_zh: duck: 迅速低头或猫腰避开上方来物 (head / blow / under fence) · dodge: 疾速侧身闪躲迎面飞来之物或追击 (bullet / blow / question) · side-step: 侧移一步闪过冲击，或巧妙绕开难题 (tackle / blow / issue) · flinch: 因疼痛或受惊产生不可自抑的缩跳 (from blow / at sight) · shy: 动物或人因惊吓骤然侧闪避退 (horse / from contact)

groups.name: Piercing High-Volume Screaming · 尖声呼喊与号叫 (Shrill, Bawl, Squall)
groups.tip: 大声叫唤直至刺耳凄厉嘶喊

items.def_en: to make a shrill, discordant, or wailing cry like that of a cat
items.ex_en: Stray cats caterwauled outside my bedroom window, piercing the silence of the dark night.
items.ex_zh: 流浪猫在我的卧室窗外凄厉嚎叫，撕破了黑夜的寂静。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to utter, sing, or scream something with forceful, unrestrained vocal volume
items.ex_en: At the karaoke bar, my sister belted out that classic rock anthem with gusto.
items.ex_zh: 在卡拉OK酒吧里，我姐姐热情洋溢地大声高唱那首经典摇滚金曲。

items.def_en: to shout loudly or make an unrestrained, piercing vocal sound from pain, fear, or excitement
items.ex_en: The injured climber cried out in agony when his foot slipped off the ledge.
items.ex_zh: 当脚从岩架上滑脱时，受伤的登山者痛苦地大叫了一声。

items.def_en: to make a harsh, grating, and high-pitched scream or outcry
items.ex_en: Gulls screeched loudly overhead as fishing boats returned to the crowded harbor.
items.ex_zh: 当渔船返回拥挤的港口时，海鸥在头顶发出刺耳的怪叫。

items.def_zh: 放声痛哭；大声叫嚷，怒吼
items.def_en: To shout, call out, or cry very loudly and noisily; to scold angrily.
items.ex_en: The sergeant bawled furious orders at the fresh recruits across the muddy drill ground.
items.ex_zh: 军士长在泥泞的操场上隔空对新兵愤怒地高声吼出命令。

items.def_zh: 尖声喊出；发出尖锐刺耳的声音
items.def_en: To make or utter with a loud, high-pitched, piercing sound or cry.
items.ex_en: A sudden gust of wind shrilled through the narrow cracks of the ruined castle.
items.ex_zh: 一阵突如其来的狂风在废弃城堡的狭窄缝隙中发出尖锐刺耳的呼啸。

items.def_zh: 嚎啕大哭，凄厉尖叫；（风等）起飑，呼啸
items.def_en: To cry or scream loudly and harshly, especially of a baby or bird; to blow in sudden violent gusts.
items.ex_en: The restless infant squalled unceasingly throughout the long, turbulent transatlantic flight.
items.ex_zh: 在漫长而颠簸的跨大西洋航程中，那不安的婴儿不停地嚎啕大哭。

items.def_zh: 发出刺耳尖叫，尖锐嘶喊
items.def_en: (+ sth) to produce a harsh, high-pitched scream or shout with high vocal intensity
items.ex_en: The panicked woman screeched out a warning as the falling scaffold collapsed nearby.
items.ex_zh: 当旁边的脚手架倒塌时，惊恐的女子尖锐嘶喊着发出了警告。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to utter a shrill, piercing, high-volume cry or utterance
items.ex_en: She shrieked out the intruder's name before dashing toward the emergency exit door.
items.ex_zh: 在冲向紧急出口门之前，她尖声喊出了入侵者的名字。

items.def_en: to utter a sudden, sharp, high-pitched, and piercing scream
items.ex_en: Terrified passengers shrieked in terror as the turbulent aircraft suddenly lost altitude.
items.ex_zh: 当颠簸的飞机突然下坠时，惊恐万状的乘客们发出了尖叫。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers vociferous, piercing, or unrestrained shouting and crying characterized by sharp timbre and extreme acoustic intensity.
groups.summary_zh: 指高音调、刺耳或声嘶力竭的高分贝嘶喊与啼哭号叫。
