groups.desc_en: Captures the production of harsh, strident, high-frequency vocal bursts driven by extreme panic, agony, or rage, sharply distinct from guttural murmurs or melodic speech.
groups.desc_zh: 指在极度惊恐、剧痛或狂怒之下发出的尖锐、高频且撕心裂肺的呼号叫嚷，区别于低沉呢喃或正常的朗声述说。
groups.nuance_en: screech: emitting an ear-splitting, piercing, metallic scream (alarm / brakes / bird) · shrill: uttering in a distinctively thin, piercingly high-pitched timber (voice / whistle / cry) · bawl: crying out loudly, hoarsely, and boisterously, often with tears (baby / sergeant / tears) · squall: loud, abrasive wailing, characteristic of infants in distress (infant / baby) · caterwaul: producing a discordant, harsh, screeching yowl (cats / singer / crowd)
groups.nuance_zh: screech: 发出刺耳裂帛般的刺裂尖叫 (alarm / brakes / bird) · shrill: 发出尖细尖利的高八度呼号 (voice / whistle / cry) · bawl: 嚎啕大哭或声嘶力竭地粗暴怒吼 (baby / sergeant / tears) · squall: 婴儿般扯着嗓子大哭号啕 (infant / baby) · caterwaul: 像发情野猫般发出刺耳难听的号叫 (cats / singer / crowd)

groups.name: Pillage & Plunder · 掠夺与抢劫 (Plunder, Loot, Pillage)
groups.tip: 动用暴力强行掠夺财物

items.def_en: (+ sth) to steal and escape with valuable property or plundered goods
items.ex_en: Thieves broke into the gallery and made off with three priceless paintings.
items.ex_zh: 盗贼闯入画廊，盗走了三幅无价的名画。

items.def_en: [T/I] to steal goods from shops or homes during a riot, war, or natural disaster
items.ex_en: Opportunistic thieves looted several downtown electronics stores during the widespread civil unrest.
items.ex_zh: 在广泛的社会动荡期间，投机盗贼洗劫了市中心的几家电子产品商店。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to seize, loot, and remove valuable goods or property by force
items.ex_en: It was a daring speech, but she carried it off with remarkable poise.
items.ex_zh: 那是一场极具挑战的演讲，但她举止从容，完成得极为出色。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to forcibly dispossess someone or a location of all possessions, clothing, or valuables
items.ex_en: Armed highway bandits stopped the coach and stripped the travelers of their jewelry.
items.ex_zh: 武装公路劫匪拦下了马车，抢光了旅客们随身携带的首饰。

items.def_en: [T/I] to steal goods violently from a place or person, especially in wartime
items.ex_en: Invading armies plundered priceless relics from the ancient coastal cathedral during the siege.
items.ex_zh: 围城期间，入侵的军队从沿海古大教堂中掠夺了无价的文物。

items.def_en: [T/I] to rob a place using violence, especially during warfare
items.ex_en: Vicious raiders pillaged the defenseless farming hamlet before setting every barn ablaze.
items.ex_zh: 凶残的突袭者洗劫了毫无防备的农庄，随后将所有谷仓付之一炬。

items.def_en: [I/T] to roam around in search of things to steal or people to attack
items.ex_en: Lawless bands marauded through the chaotic countryside, spreading terror among the terrified peasants.
items.ex_zh: 不法之徒在混乱的乡间四处劫掠，在吓坏的农民中间散布恐怖。

items.def_en: (archaic / literary) To plunder, rob, or carry away by force.
items.ex_en: Fierce northern barbarians reaved the coastal settlements and sailed away with their plunder.
items.ex_zh: 凶悍的北方蛮族抢掠了沿海聚落，随后携战利品扬帆而去。

items.def_en: (literary) To steal valuables from a place or strip something of its riches or beauty.
items.ex_en: Greedy treasure hunters systematically despoiled the sacred tombs of their gold and artifacts.
items.ex_zh: 贪婪的寻宝者蓄意洗劫了这些神圣墓葬中的黄金和文物。

items.def_en: To steal a car by forcing the driver out using violence or threats.
items.ex_en: Two masked men attempted to carjack a luxury sedan at the quiet intersection.
items.ex_zh: 两名蒙面男子试图在僻静的十字路口劫持一辆豪华轿车。

groups.summary_en: Actors forcibly seize valuable property or resources from people, settlements, or vehicles, typically during wartime, lawless disorder, or through violent assault. These verbs emphasize aggressive, unauthorized dispossession ranging from battlefield pillaging to armed vehicular hijacking.
groups.summary_zh: 强调战乱或无序状态下暴力洗劫财物、掠夺资源的强取行为。
groups.desc_en: Describes the violent, predatory stripping and ransacking of goods, territory, or settlements during warfare or total lawlessness, contrasting with stealthy individual theft.
groups.desc_zh: 指在战争或无政府混乱状态下对聚落、据点进行暴力、掠夺性的洗劫与搜刮，区别于悄无声息的个人偷窃。
groups.nuance_en: plunder: comprehensively seizing valuables and wealth by wartime force (city / treasury / resources) · loot: ransacking shops or homes amidst rioting, disaster, or chaos (stores / museums / village) · pillage: ravaging and violently stripping a conquered site of all goods (countryside / town / monastery) · maraud: roving over an expanse of land looking for plunder and destruction (bands / soldiers / raiders) · strip of: totally denuding a place or person of possessions or covering (bare / wealth / bark)
groups.nuance_zh: plunder: 战时掠夺性地洗劫财富与资源 (city / treasury / resources) · loot: 借骚乱、兵灾或灾难破门趁火打劫 (stores / museums / village) · pillage: 暴力洗劫攻破的聚落或修道院 (countryside / town / monastery) · maraud: 匪团四处流窜袭扰劫掠 (bands / soldiers / raiders) · strip of: 彻底剥光或掳尽财物使之空空如也 (bare / wealth / bark)

groups.name: Placate & Pacify · 安抚与平息 (Placate, Pacify, Mollify)
groups.tip: 平息怒火化解焦躁不安

items.def_en: (+ sb) to cause an angry, agitated, or hostile person to become peaceful and composed
items.ex_en: The manager managed to calm down the furious client with a polite explanation.
items.ex_zh: 经理用礼貌的解释成功平息了那位愤怒客户的怒火。
items.ex2_en: The panicked crowd finally calmed down once emergency officials issued clear instructions.
items.ex2_zh: 应急官员发布明确指示后，恐慌的人群终于平静了下来。

items.def_zh: 化解（争端），抚平（愤怒），息事宁人
items.def_en: (+ sth) to mitigate hostility, soothe ruffled feelings, or minimize the seriousness of a dispute
items.ex_en: The seasoned diplomat worked diligently to smooth over tensions between both rival delegations.
items.ex_zh: 这位经验丰富的外交官努力调解，以抚平两个对立代表团之间的紧张关系。

items.def_zh: 使冷静下来，消除敌意或激愤
items.def_en: (+ sb) to pacify someone's violent temper or hostile agitation
items.ex_en: Give him a few minutes to cool down before discussing the issue.
items.ex_zh: 在讨论这个问题之前，先给他几分钟冷静一下。
items.ex2_en: A cold drink will cool down the exhausted marathon runners after finishing.
items.ex2_zh: 一杯冷饮会让跑完马拉松后筋疲力竭的跑者们冷静降温。

items.def_zh: 姑息，抚慰（通过妥协或满足要求平息怨怒）
items.def_en: to pacify or placate someone by acceding to their demands, often at the expense of principles
items.ex_en: The government refused to appease the radical rebels by granting their unreasonable demands.
items.ex_zh: 政府拒绝通过答应激进叛军的不合理要求来对他们进行姑息妥协。

items.def_zh: 平息（怒气）；抚慰；平定（动乱）
items.def_en: to make someone calm and less angry, or to bring peace to an agitated or rebellious crowd
items.ex_en: The local mayor spoke calmly to pacify the outraged crowd outside city hall.
items.ex_zh: 当地市长沉着发言，以平息市政厅外愤怒群众的怒气。

items.def_en: To make someone less angry or hostile, especially by doing or saying things to please them.
items.ex_en: The airline offered travel vouchers to placate travelers stranded by the storm delays.
items.ex_zh: 航空公司提供了旅行代金券，以安抚因暴风雨延误而滞留的旅客。

items.def_zh: 缓和，减轻，平息（痛苦、内疚、恐惧等）；使满足
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To make an unpleasant feeling, such as pain, guilt, or fear, less severe. 2. (formal) To satisfy a physical need or appetite.
items.ex_en: The company president issued a sincere apology to assuage growing public concerns.
items.ex_zh: 公司总裁发表了真诚的道歉，以缓和日益加剧的公众担忧。

items.def_zh: 平息，安抚，使平静；缓和，减轻
items.def_en: To make someone who is angry or upset feel calmer and less annoyed.
items.ex_en: A partial cash refund helped mollify the disgruntled diner after the long delay.
items.ex_zh: 在漫长的等待之后，部分现金退款有助于平息不满食客的怒气。

items.def_zh: 调和，安抚（怀有敌意或争执的各方）
items.def_en: to stop someone from being angry or discontented by showing goodwill and seeking agreement
items.ex_en: The arbitrator sought to conciliate the striking factory workers before talks broke down.
items.ex_zh: 在谈判破裂前，仲裁员试图安抚罢工的工厂工人以促成和解。

items.def_zh: 使息怒，取悦，求得……的原谅（或好感）
items.def_en: (formal) To win the favor or calm the anger of a god, spirit, or powerful person by doing or saying something pleasing.
items.ex_en: Pious priests offered solemn sacrifices on the stone altar to propitiate angry deities.
items.ex_zh: 虔诚的祭司在石祭坛上献上庄严的祭品，以求得愤怒神明的主动宽宥。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe neutralizing anger, hostility, resentment, or violent unrest by conceding demands, offering conciliatory words, or making amends. They emphasize subduing hostility and grievance rather than offering sympathetic grief counseling.
groups.summary_zh: 平息他人的怒气、敌意或不满情绪，使局势转为缓和顺从。
groups.desc_en: Entails reducing the anger, grievance, or hostility of an agitated party through concessions, gentle gestures, or soothing intervention, contrasting with forceful suppression.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过让步、安抚或柔和举动平息当事者的怒火、怨气或敌意，区别于施加强力弹压。
groups.nuance_en: appease: buying off or yielding demands to satisfy a belligerent party (aggressor / public / critic) · placate: soothing an offended or hostile person with conciliatory actions (critics / customer / mob) · pacify: restoring calm and subduing active agitation or unrest (territory / rebellion / infant) · mollify: softening someone's anger or wounded pride through gentle words (tone / anger / critics) · assuage: mitigating the sharpness of guilt, grief, or physical suffering (guilt / fears / hunger)
groups.nuance_zh: appease: 妥协让步以姑息平息侵略者或愤怒者 (aggressor / public / critic) · placate: 通过怀柔策略平抚被冒犯者的敌对情绪 (critics / customer / mob) · pacify: 镇定暴动平复混乱重塑安宁 (territory / rebellion / infant) · mollify: 软化受伤的自尊或火气 (tone / anger / critics) · assuage: 缓解消减内疚、恐惧或生理饥渴 (guilt / fears / hunger)

groups.name: Place & Settle · 安放与安置 (Secure & Specialized Placement)
groups.tip: 稳妥安置并固定在特定位置

items.def_zh: 将……安放/藏置于隐秘稳妥处
items.def_en: (+ sth) to put something away in a secure, snug, or sheltered place
items.ex_en: Grandmother tucked away the family heirlooms in a velvet box behind her wardrobe.
items.ex_zh: 祖母将传家宝妥善收藏在衣柜后面的丝绒盒子里。

items.def_zh: 把……塞入（舒适或稳妥的位置）；给……盖好被子
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to place or push something neatly and snugly into a safe or comfortable position, especially sheets around someone in bed
items.ex_en: She lovingly tucked in her sleepy daughter before turning off the bedside lamp.
items.ex_zh: 在关掉床头灯之前，她充满爱意地为昏睡的女儿掖好了被子。

items.def_en: to set or balance sb/sth securely on a high or narrow edge
items.ex_en: The old stone monastery was perched precariously on the edge of the cliff.
items.ex_zh: 古老的石砌修道院危险地坐落在悬崖的边缘上。
items.ex2_en: The careful architect perched the glass pavilion delicately atop the steep hillside.
items.ex2_zh: 细心的建筑师将玻璃亭巧妙地安放在陡峭的山坡顶端。

items.def_en: to settle or place sth comfortably and sheltered warmly inside or against sth
items.ex_en: A quaint little stone cottage nestled peacefully among the rolling green wooded hills.
items.ex_zh: 一座古朴的石头小屋静静地掩映在连绵起伏的绿色树林丘陵之中。
items.ex2_en: The mother gently nestled the sleeping infant into the soft woolen blanket.
items.ex2_zh: 母亲轻轻地将睡着的小婴儿安顿在柔软的羊毛毯里。

items.def_zh: 使安顿，安置（常作 ensconce oneself，安顿下来，舒适地坐下）
items.def_en: (usually ensconce oneself) To settle comfortably and securely in a place.
items.ex_en: He ensconced himself comfortably in the plush armchair beside the crackling stone fireplace.
items.ex_zh: 他惬意地在噼啪作响的石头壁炉旁的豪华扶手椅上安顿坐下。

items.def_zh: 躲避；安顿隐蔽在安全之处
items.def_en: to hide or settle oneself in a secure, secluded place
items.ex_en: The fugitive gang holed up in an abandoned cabin deep within the mountains.
items.ex_zh: 逃亡的团伙藏身在深山里一座废弃的小木屋中躲避。

items.def_en: to put sb/sth in a specific position, seat, or home, often comfortably or formally
items.ex_en: The hostess installed her distinguished guest in the finest suite of the manor.
items.ex_zh: 女主人把尊贵的客人安置在庄园最豪华的套房中住下。

items.def_zh: 安置，安放（大炮、设备等）；使就位
items.def_en: To put something, especially a heavy weapon or piece of equipment, firmly into position.
items.ex_en: The artillery brigade emplaced three heavy howitzers on the strategic hilltop overnight.
items.ex_zh: 炮兵旅连夜在具有战略意义的山顶上安放就位了三门重型榴弹炮。

items.def_zh: 掘壕固守；稳固防守阵地
items.def_en: to establish a secure, fortified, or entrenched defensive position
items.ex_en: The defending infantry dug in along the riverbank to repel incoming enemy advances.
items.ex_zh: 防守步兵沿着河岸掘壕固守，以击退正在逼近的敌军攻势。

items.def_en: to establish sth firmly and securely so that change or removal is difficult
items.ex_en: Generations of tradition have entrenched conservative social values deep within the remote community.
items.ex_zh: 数代相传的传统让保守的社会价值观在这个偏远社区中根深蒂固。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express placing or settling a person or object into a sheltered, snug, strategic, or fortified resting position with stability and comfort.
groups.summary_zh: 以稳固、舒适、隐蔽或战略性的特定方式安置或固定人与物。
groups.desc_en: Denotes deliberately placing or establishing an entity into a protected, comfortable, or firmly grounded state, contrasting with generic, indifferent putting down by emphasizing shelter, snugness, or calculated isolation.
groups.desc_zh: 指将人或物安置于受保护、舒适或稳固隐蔽的状态中，与一般的随意放置相比，强调遮蔽性、贴合感或特意的隐匿安置。
groups.nuance_en: nestle: settle snugly into a soft or sheltered recess (valley / cottage / head) · ensconce: establish securely and comfortably in a safe retreat (oneself / armchair / library) · perch: balance precariously or temporarily atop a high vantage point (bird / cliff / edge) · hole up: hide away stubbornly in a secure refuge (suspect / cabin / winter) · emplace: formally fix in an operational military or heavy position (artillery / sensor / battery)
groups.nuance_zh: nestle: 舒适依偎安卧于凹隐遮蔽处 (valley / cottage / head) · ensconce: 安稳舒适地定居或隐匿 (oneself / armchair / library) · perch: 高踞或栖息于狭窄高处边缘 (bird / cliff / edge) · hole up: 蜷伏躲藏于庇护所避风头 (suspect / cabin / winter) · emplace: 正式布署或架设重型装备 (artillery / sensor / battery)

groups.name: Plan & Intend · 意图与规划 (Plan, Aim, Propose)
groups.tip: 心中抱有目标与蓝图

items.def_en: to decide on and arrange in advance a set of actions for achieving a specific outcome
items.ex_en: The committee plans to unveil the new environmental policy early next spring.
items.ex_zh: 委员会计划在明年早春正式公布新的环保政策。

items.def_en: (formal) To intend or resolve to do something; to have as an aim or plan.
items.ex_en: The noble general purposed to defend the besieged mountain fortress at all costs.
items.ex_zh: 这位高贵的将军决意不惜一切代价捍卫那座被围困的山区要塞。

items.def_zh: 安排，预定，将……列入时间表
items.def_en: To arrange or plan for an event or activity to happen at a particular time.
items.ex_en: The coordinator scheduled the inaugural board meeting for next Tuesday morning at nine.
items.ex_zh: 协调员将首次董事会议预定安排在下周二上午九点举行。

items.def_en: (+ to-inf / at) to have the clear objective, purpose, or intention of achieving something
items.ex_en: The young medical student aims to specialize in pediatric cardiology after graduation.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻的医学生旨在毕业后专攻小儿心脏病学方向。

items.def_en: to form an intention in one's mind (+ to-inf / -ing)
items.ex_en: The ambitious prime minister proposes to introduce comprehensive tax reforms before next autumn.
items.ex_zh: 雄心勃勃的首相打算在明年秋天之前推行全面的税制改革。

items.def_zh: 打算，计划，意图；打算使……成为（或用于）；意指
items.def_en: 1. To have something in mind as a plan or purpose; to plan to do something. 2. To design, designate, or mean something for a specific person, purpose, or use.
items.ex_en: We intend to renovate the historic downtown theater within the next two years.
items.ex_zh: 我们打算在未来两年内对这座历史悠久的市中心剧院进行翻修。

items.def_en: to formulate strategic plans or decisions deliberately in advance of future events
items.ex_en: It's always wise to plan ahead when traveling during peak holiday seasons.
items.ex_zh: 在节假日旅游旺季出行时，提前规划总是明智的。

items.def_zh: 周密规划，详尽制定（计划/未来方向）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to plan, outline, or organize a detailed program of action for the future
items.ex_en: The committee met to map out a clear strategy for the next five years.
items.ex_zh: 委员会开会为接下来的五年详细制定了清晰的战略规划。

items.def_zh: 立志打算，着手计划（做某事）
items.def_en: (+ do sth) to intend or consciously undertake a deliberate course of action with a specific aim
items.ex_en: The young investigator set out to uncover the truth behind the suspicious bankruptcy.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的调查员立志要查明这起可疑破产事件背后的全部真相。

items.def_en: to consider something as a possible course of future action
items.ex_en: The aging CEO contemplated early retirement after forty years of dedicated corporate leadership.
items.ex_zh: 在奉献了四十年的企业领导生涯后，这位年迈的首席执行官开始考虑提前退休。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express mental resolve, forward planning, or programmatic scheduling to bring about a deliberate future action.
groups.summary_zh: 指在心中拟定意图、设定目标或系统性排定未来行动步骤。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the forward-looking mental formulation of actions, schemes, or deliberate objectives, contrasting with spontaneous impulse or sheer wishing by emphasizing structured intent and prospective execution.
groups.desc_zh: 指对未来行动或目标的构想、拟定与意图确立，与一时冲动或单纯愿望相比，强调预先性、结构性与执行企图。
groups.nuance_en: plan: formulate organized steps toward a projected goal (budget / event / future) · map out: detail a comprehensive itinerary or strategic trajectory (career / route / strategy) · intend: hold a conscious, directed mental purpose (harm / meaning / outcome) · schedule: assign specific calendar time or sequencing (meeting / launch / appointment) · propose: formally advance an intended scheme for approval or adoption (amendment / merger / plan)
groups.nuance_zh: plan: 制定条理化的预先规划 (budget / event / future) · map out: 详尽绘制路线或宏观长远规划 (career / route / strategy) · intend: 怀有明确的内在企图或意志 (harm / meaning / outcome) · schedule: 将事项排定于具体日程表中 (meeting / launch / appointment) · propose: 正式提出意图方案供审议采纳 (amendment / merger / plan)

groups.name: Pledge & Swear Bindingly · 保证与发誓立誓 (Guarantee, Vow, Swear)
groups.tip: 立下誓约并提供担保承诺

items.def_zh: 担保，以信誉担保（真实性或人品）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to assert or guarantee the good character, accuracy, or reliability of someone or something
items.ex_en: Several respected professors happily agreed to vouch for the applicant’s academic integrity.
items.ex_zh: 几位受人尊敬的教授欣然同意为该申请人的学术诚信出具担保。

items.def_en: to make a serious, formal, and public promise to do or provide something
items.ex_en: The allied leaders pledged five billion dollars to assist post-war reconstruction efforts.
items.ex_zh: 盟国领导人正式承诺提供五十亿美元，以援助战后重建工作。

items.def_zh: 庄严承诺，立约使自己受约束
items.def_en: (+ sth) to commit oneself irrevocably to a solemn promise, duty, or oath
items.ex_en: Every new knight bound himself to the sovereign with a sacred lifelong oath.
items.ex_zh: 每位新晋骑士都以神圣的终生誓约立约效忠于君主。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to state firmly or take an oath affirming the absolute truth of something
items.ex_en: The eyewitness was prepared to swear to the suspect's identity in open court.
items.ex_zh: 目击证人准备在法庭上公开宣誓证明嫌疑人的身份属实。

items.def_zh: 保证，担保；肯定，必然导致
items.def_en: 1. To make a formal promise that something will happen, be done, or meet a certain standard. 2. To make something certain to happen.
items.ex_en: The electronics manufacturer guarantees all replacement parts against manufacturing defects for two years.
items.ex_zh: 该电子制造商保证所有替换零部件在两年内无制造缺陷。

items.def_en: To make a serious, solemn promise or commitment to do something or that something is true.
items.ex_en: The new governor solemnly vowed to root out systemic corruption in public office.
items.ex_zh: 新任州长庄严起誓，决心彻底铲除公职部门中的体制性腐败。

items.def_zh: 发誓，起誓；诅咒，说脏话（swear 的过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past participle of swear; to make a solemn promise or oath. 2. Past participle of swear; to use offensive or profane language.
items.ex_en: The veteran officer had sworn an oath to uphold and protect the constitution.
items.ex_zh: 这位资深军官曾庄严宣誓，立誓恪守并捍卫国家宪法。

items.def_zh: 发誓，起誓；诅咒，说脏话（swear 的过去式）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense of swear; to make a solemn promise or oath. 2. Past tense of swear; to use offensive or profane language.
items.ex_en: The key witness swore under oath that she saw the vehicle flee south.
items.ex_zh: 关键证人宣誓证明，她确实看见那辆车朝着南方逃逸了。

items.def_zh: 宣誓保证，以死约定（誓言、婚约）
items.def_en: (archaic/formal) to give solemn pledge of fidelity or marry by solemn vow
items.ex_en: The young knight plighted his eternal troth to the lady beneath the ancient oak.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的骑士在古老的橡树下向那位女士立下永恒的婚誓。

items.def_en: to command or entreat someone earnestly and solemnly, as if under oath
items.ex_en: The high priest adjured the trembling witness to speak only the absolute truth.
items.ex_zh: 大祭司严令颤抖的证人起誓，只准说出绝对的真相。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe making commitments of varying solemnity and binding force, moving from commercial or practical assurance to sacred oaths.
groups.summary_zh: 按庄严度与约束力递增，体现从常规担保到立下重誓的言语行为。
groups.desc_en: Denotes assuming a solemn, morally or legally binding obligation of truth or performance, contrasting with casual promising by invoking high liability, honor, or irrevocable commitment.
groups.desc_zh: 指立下具有道德或法律强约束力的保证与誓言，与普通随口答应相比，强调不可撤销性、名誉赌注及违背后果的严重性。
groups.nuance_en: swear: invoke sacred truth or absolute loyalty under solemn sanction (allegiance / oath / secrecy) · vow: dedicate oneself to a deeply personal or sacred commitment (poverty / revenge / silence) · pledge: offer a formal, binding public guarantee or resource commitment (support / donation / loyalty) · guarantee: legally or commercially underwrite certainty of outcome (loan / quality / safety) · vouch for: stake personal credibility on another's integrity or truth (character / credentials / friend)
groups.nuance_zh: swear: 庄严立誓确认忠诚或事实真实性 (allegiance / oath / secrecy) · vow: 立下深刻的个人或神圣誓愿 (poverty / revenge / silence) · pledge: 公开郑重承诺物资或政治支持 (support / donation / loyalty) · guarantee: 提供法律或商业层面的兜底担保 (loan / quality / safety) · vouch for: 以个人信誉为他人品行或真实性背书 (character / credentials / friend)

groups.name: Plunder & Raid · 掠夺与劫掠 (Predatory Incursions & Looting)
groups.tip: 突袭扫荡洗劫财物

items.def_en: to plunder and destroy a captured town or city in wartime
items.ex_en: The drunken mercenaries broke into the citadel and sacked the entire treasury overnight.
items.ex_zh: 醉醺醺的雇佣兵闯入城堡，连夜洗劫了整座金库。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to launch a sudden, predatory raid or surprise attack on an enemy or target settlement
items.ex_en: Bandits swooped down on the isolated farming hamlet just before the morning dawn.
items.ex_zh: 匪徒在黎明破晓前猛扑突袭了那座孤立的农庄。

items.def_zh: 席卷侵袭，毁灭性地横扫
items.def_en: (+ sth) to tear through a place causing massive devastation, pillage, or violence
items.ex_en: The fierce tornado ripped through the coastal town in less than an hour.
items.ex_zh: 凶猛的龙卷风在不到一小时内席卷并重创了这座沿海小镇。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to move rapidly across an area or territory while invading, looting, or destroying
items.ex_en: The invading vanguard swept through the peaceful valley, leaving ruined barns behind.
items.ex_zh: 入侵的先头部队席卷了宁静的山谷，身后只留下一片废墟。

items.def_en: [I/T] to steal goods from private homes or stores during a riot, war, or catastrophe
items.ex_en: Rioters broke the storefront windows to loot high-end electronics during the blackout.
items.ex_zh: 暴徒在停电期间砸碎临街橱窗，洗劫高端电子产品。

items.def_en: [I/T] to steal goods from a place or person, typically using force and in a time of war or civil disorder
items.ex_en: Fierce conquerors plundered the sacred coastal temples and seized all their gold.
items.ex_zh: 凶悍的征服者洗劫了神圣的海滨庙宇，抢走了所有的黄金。

items.def_en: (+ into) To make a brief, sudden raid into an enemy territory to plunder; to venture into an unfamiliar field.
items.ex_en: The raiders made a daring foray into hostile territory to steal livestock.
items.ex_zh: 袭击者大胆突入敌方领地，大肆掠夺牲畜。

items.def_en: To violently steal goods, plunder, and ransack property from a place during a war or conflict.
items.ex_en: Rebel soldiers pillaged the historic province, sparing neither royal estates nor humble cottages.
items.ex_zh: 叛军士兵洗劫了这处历史名省，王室庄园和平民茅舍皆未幸免。

items.def_en: (literary) To roam around in search of things to steal or people to attack.
items.ex_en: Armies of marauding horsemen roamed the frontier, terrorizing unguarded border settlements.
items.ex_zh: 成群的劫掠骑兵在边境游荡，恐吓那些无人守卫的村落。

items.def_en: to violently strip a place of possessions, resources, or natural beauty
items.ex_en: Ruthless mining conglomerates despoiled the pristine mountainside of its ancient forest cover.
items.ex_zh: 无情的采矿集团洗劫了原本原始的山坡，剥夺了古老的森林植被。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame evoke the violent scenario of armed raiders or marauders penetrating territory or premises to seize property, sack settlements, and cause havoc. They differ between sudden swift incursions, roaming banditry, and widespread systematic sacking of towns during war.
groups.summary_zh: 武装突袭越界入室，大肆劫掠财物并破坏城镇。
groups.desc_en: Denotes violent, predatory incursions into territory or property to seize wealth and cause devastation, contrasting with clandestine theft by emphasizing overt force, havoc, and systematic despoliation.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过武力突袭侵入敌方领地以洗劫财物、肆意破坏，与秘密盗窃相比，强调公开暴力、破坏性扫荡与战利品掠夺。
groups.nuance_en: plunder: strip wealth and goods comprehensively during warfare or disorder (city / treasury / temple) · pillage: violently ravage and rob a conquered place (village / countryside / settlement) · sack: capture and thoroughly destroy/loot a conquered city (capital / fortress / town) · loot: opportunistically steal goods amid chaos or riot (store / museum / ruins) · swoop down on: make a swift, predatory surprise descent upon prey (enemy / camp / convoy)
groups.nuance_zh: plunder: 在战乱或失序中彻底掠夺财富 (city / treasury / temple) · pillage: 暴力洗劫并蹂躏被占领地 (village / countryside / settlement) · sack: 攻克并彻底洗劫、毁灭整座城镇 (capital / fortress / town) · loot: 趁乱洗劫商铺或废墟财物 (store / museum / ruins) · swoop down on: 迅猛突袭扑向防备不足的目标 (enemy / camp / convoy)

groups.name: Position & Fit · 定位与安嵌 (Install, Emplace, Embed)
groups.tip: 将设备放置就位并完成装配

items.def_zh: 嵌合；把……安放到合适位置
items.def_en: (+ sth) to put or settle something securely into the correct space or position
items.ex_en: Carefully fit the new replacement valve in before tightening the main bracket screws.
items.ex_zh: 在拧紧主支架螺丝之前，仔细将新的替换阀安放到位。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to fit or slide easily into a designated narrow opening or space
items.ex_en: You can slot the backup battery in without turning off the device completely.
items.ex_zh: 你可以在不完全关闭设备的情况下将备用电池滑入槽中。
items.ex2_en: The replacement memory card slots in smoothly without requiring any excessive force.
items.ex2_zh: 备用存储卡可以顺畅地插进去，不需要用太大力气。

items.def_zh: 使落座；使（零件）卡紧到位
items.def_en: to position a mechanical component firmly and accurately into its housing or socket
items.ex_en: Make sure to seat the gasket evenly before torquing down the engine head.
items.ex_zh: 在拧紧发动机气缸盖前，确保垫片已平整卡紧到位。

items.def_zh: 把（子弹）装入枪膛；把……关在房间内
items.def_en: 1. To load a round of ammunition into the chamber of a firearm. 2. (literary) To place or confine in a room or chamber.
items.ex_en: The nervous sentry quietly chambered a heavy cartridge into his bolt-action rifle.
items.ex_zh: 紧张的哨兵悄悄将一枚沉重的子弹推进了栓动步枪的枪膛。

items.def_zh: 放置，安放；存放，储存；使沉积
items.def_en: 1. To put or set down someone or something in a specific place. 2. To put money or valuables into a bank or safe place. 3. To leave a layer of a substance behind.
items.ex_en: The courier will deposit the sensitive blueprint inside the secure lockbox downstairs.
items.ex_zh: 信使会把这份机密图纸存放到楼下的安全保险箱内。

items.def_zh: 给……装上格栅；磨碎，擦成丝；发出刺耳的摩擦声；使人烦躁
items.def_en: 1. To furnish or fit with a grate or grates. 2. To shred food into small pieces by rubbing it against a grater. 3. To make an unpleasant scraping or rasping sound. 4. To annoy or irritate someone.
items.ex_en: Workers came to grate the deep storm drain to prevent debris blockages.
items.ex_zh: 工人们前去给那处深风暴排水沟装上格栅，以防杂物堵塞。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to fix or fasten something firmly and immovably into a particular place or position
items.ex_en: Push the adapter firmly until both locking tabs lock into the frame.
items.ex_zh: 用力推入适配器，直至两个卡扣都稳固锁入支架中。

items.def_zh: 安装，安设；安置；使正式就职
items.def_en: 1. To put a piece of equipment, system, or software into place and connect it so that it is ready for use. 2. To put someone into an official position or job with a formal ceremony.
items.ex_en: Technicians will install the advanced filtration unit behind the main laboratory counter.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员将把先进的过滤装置安装在主实验室工作台后面。

items.def_zh: 把……安放在规定位置（尤指重型仪器或武器）
items.def_en: to put an instrument, weapon, or heavy structural element into a prepared position for use
items.ex_en: Artillery crews worked tirelessly to emplace the coastal defense cannon atop the cliff.
items.ex_zh: 炮兵小队不知疲倦地工作，将岸防重炮安置在悬崖顶端的预定阵地上。

items.def_zh: 嵌入，牢牢装入（深嵌在周围介质中）
items.def_en: to fix an object firmly and deeply in a surrounding solid mass
items.ex_en: The specialist embedded a tracking sensor into the thick concrete foundation wall.
items.ex_zh: 专家将一枚追踪传感器牢牢嵌入厚重的混凝土基础墙中。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe placing, fitting, inserting, or locking an object securely into an allocated compartment, frame, apparatus, or physical setting designed to receive it. Nuances involve precise mechanical containment (chamber), structural installation (install), or setting down in a designated depository (deposit).
groups.summary_zh: 将物品或设备安放、固定或装配至专用的槽位、结构与基座中。
groups.desc_en: Denotes precisely seating or embedding a component into a designated structural recess or mechanism, contrasting with loose placement by emphasizing geometric alignment, mechanical fit, and operational readiness.
groups.desc_zh: 指将部件精准嵌入或卡入特定机械槽口与结构孔位中，与随手放置相比，强调几何契合度、紧密公差与功能就位。
groups.nuance_en: seat: press firmly into a tailored mechanical recess or base (valve / gasket / bearing) · slot in: slide smoothly into an exact designated aperture (card / module / peg) · lock into: snap or mechanically engage securely into place (position / gear / socket) · chamber: insert ammunition precisely into the firing cavity of a weapon (round / bullet / cartridge) · install: assemble and connect a permanent fixture or apparatus (software / fixture / system)
groups.nuance_zh: seat: 使零件紧密平稳落座于基座凹槽 (valve / gasket / bearing) · slot in: 顺畅滑入狭长嵌槽或孔位 (card / module / peg) · lock into: 机械卡位锁死进入固定状态 (position / gear / socket) · chamber: 将弹药推入枪膛就位 (round / bullet / cartridge) · install: 正式安装并接通固定设施或系统 (software / fixture / system)

groups.name: Position & Relocate · 定位与重置 (Position, Tee, Repot, Reseat)
groups.tip: 精准定位或调整摆放朝向

items.def_en: (+ sth) to arrange things in a straight row or into precise spatial alignment
items.ex_en: Line up the wooden planks precisely before driving the galvanized nails home.
items.ex_zh: 在彻底钉入镀锌钉之前，先把这些木板对齐排列整齐。
items.ex2_en: Dozens of eager shoppers lined up patiently outside the department store doors.
items.ex2_zh: 数十名热切的顾客在百货商店门外耐心地排起了长队。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to support something physically by placing an object under or against it to keep it in position
items.ex_en: Use this sturdy wooden wedge to prop up the sagging bookshelf corner.
items.ex_zh: 用这个结实的木楔把下垂的书架角落支撑起来。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to adjust or place something so that it is straight, level, or at right angles
items.ex_en: Take a minute to square up the framing timber before fastening it.
items.ex_zh: 在固定之前，花一分钟把框架木料摆正对齐。
items.ex2_en: The uneven paving stones squared up nicely after the mason adjusted them.
items.ex2_zh: 泥瓦匠调整之后，不平整的铺路石对得非常方正齐整。

items.def_zh: 安置，放置；使处于特定位置
items.def_en: To put someone or something in a particular place or position.
items.ex_en: Carefully position the heavy ceramic vase in the exact center of the table.
items.ex_zh: 小心地将沉重的陶瓷花瓶摆放在桌子正中央的位置。

items.def_en: to place or arrange things in a straight line or in correct relative position
items.ex_en: Mechanics must align the optical sensors so the automated conveyor operates smoothly.
items.ex_zh: 机械师必须将光学传感器对准成一线，以确保自动传送带顺畅运转。
items.ex2_en: The wheels must align properly before the vehicle can be safely driven.
items.ex2_zh: 车轮必须正确对齐，车辆才能安全行驶。

items.def_zh: 搁在球座上；（tee up）准备好
items.def_en: (often + up) To place a ball on a tee in golf; to make preparations or set something up.
items.ex_en: The veteran golfer stepped onto the turf to tee his ball up.
items.ex_zh: 这位资深高尔夫球手走上草坪，把球搁在球座上准备击球。

items.def_en: [I/T] to place or balance something precariously on a high or narrow surface
items.ex_en: The playful kitten loved to perch precariously on the narrow wooden railing.
items.ex_zh: 这只调皮的小猫喜欢悬悬地栖在狭窄的木栏杆上。
items.ex2_en: She perched the fragile glass figurine on the narrow corner shelf.
items.ex2_zh: 她把易碎的玻璃小雕像稳稳放在狭窄的转角架上。

items.def_zh: 将（植物）换盆，移植到新盆中
items.def_en: To move a growing houseplant into a larger or different pot.
items.ex_en: Spring is usually the best season to repot root-bound indoor tropical plants.
items.ex_zh: 春季通常是给盘根错节的室内热带植物换盆的最佳时节。

items.def_zh: 使重新就座；使复位，重新安装；给……换座底
items.def_en: 1. To provide new seats for, or seat someone in a new position. 2. To fit something back into its proper position.
items.ex_en: The technician had to reseat the loose memory module inside the motherboard.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员不得不把主板上松动的内存模块重新插好复位。

items.def_zh: 使平衡；置于悬停待发位置
items.def_en: to balance or hold steady in readiness for a particular movement
items.ex_en: The diver stood motionless, expertly poised on the edge of the highest platform.
items.ex_zh: 跳水运动员纹丝不动地站着，沉稳悬停在最高跳台的边缘待发。

groups.summary_en: These verbs describe manipulating an item into an exact spatial orientation, specialized fixture, or new container to serve an impending operational function. They emphasize precise geometric realignment, support, or transfer.
groups.summary_zh: 根据功能需要，将物品置于特定方位、承托架或重置至新容器中。
groups.desc_en: Denotes adjusting, realigning, or transferring an object into a specific functional posture or fresh medium, contrasting with random relocation by emphasizing precise orientation, baseline leveling, or developmental reset.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过微调、校准或转移使物体进入特定的功能姿态或新环境，与一般挪动相比，强调方位找正、基准对齐或生长环境重置。
groups.nuance_en: align: bring into a straight, parallel, or harmonized spatial relationship (wheels / sights / text) · prop up: support structurally from leaning or collapsing (ladder / beam / chin) · square up: orient at exact right angles or confront squarely (edges / shoulders / timbers) · repot: transplant into a larger or fresh container for growth (plant / orchid / seedling) · tee: balance an object on a peg ready for launching (ball / shot / drive)
groups.nuance_zh: align: 校准使处于一条直线或几何平行 (wheels / sights / text) · prop up: 从下方或侧面支撑防倾斜倒塌 (ladder / beam / chin) · square up: 摆正成直角或正面端正对准 (edges / shoulders / timbers) · repot: 将植物移栽换入新盆 (plant / orchid / seedling) · tee: 将球置于球座上准备击打 (ball / shot / drive)

groups.name: Position & Settle · 放置与安放 (Put, Place, Set)
groups.tip: 将物体放在特定位置上

items.def_zh: 放置，安放；安置，任命；寄托
items.def_en: 1. To put something in a particular position or place; to assign a role, duty, or value to someone or something.
items.ex_en: Please place the fragile crystal decanter carefully on the polished walnut sideboard.
items.ex_zh: 请将那只易碎的水晶酒壶小心地放置在抛光的胡桃木餐具柜上。

items.def_zh: 放，安放；使处于（某种状态）；表达，陈述
items.def_en: 1. To move something into a particular position or location; to cause someone or something to be in a certain state; to express in words.
items.ex_en: She gently put the sleeping baby into the crib beside the window.
items.ex_zh: 她轻轻地把熟睡的婴儿放在靠窗的婴儿床里。

items.def_zh: 放置，安放；设定，确定；摆放（餐具）；凝固；（日月）落山
items.def_en: 1. To put or place someone or something in a particular position; to establish or adjust a value, limit, or rule; 2. to become solid or firm; (of the sun or moon) to sink below the horizon.
items.ex_en: The butler set the ornate silver candlesticks along the formal banquet table.
items.ex_zh: 管家将华丽的银烛台摆放在正式的宴会长桌上。

items.def_en: To put someone or something in a particular calculated place or posture
items.ex_en: Surveyors must carefully position their tripod markers on stable and level ground.
items.ex_zh: 测量员必须将三脚架标标精准安放在平稳坚实的地面上。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ against/on) To place or lean something so that it is supported
items.ex_en: He decided to rest his tired back against the trunk of the oak.
items.ex_zh: 他决定把疲惫的背部倚靠在那棵橡树的树干上。
items.ex2_en: His heavy head rested comfortably against the soft goose down pillow.
items.ex2_zh: 他沉重的脑袋舒服地靠在柔软的鹅绒枕头上。

items.def_en: To put something down gently or carefully into a flat horizontal position
items.ex_en: The curator laid the delicate parchment flat across the clean velvet mat.
items.ex_zh: 馆长将那张脆弱的羊皮纸平展地搁在干净的天鹅绒垫上。

items.def_zh: 放下，放置（常较正式或指卸下重物）
items.def_en: To put or set down something, especially gently or carefully, in a formal or deliberate manner
items.ex_en: The couriers formally deposited the tribute chests before the high throne of state.
items.ex_zh: 使节们庄重地将朝贡箱呈放在威严的国家王座前。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to place something onto a flat surface or the floor
items.ex_en: The exhausted mover put down the heavy sofa on the polished floor.
items.ex_zh: 筋疲力尽的搬运工把沉重的沙发放在光亮的地板上。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to place something flat on a surface with care
items.ex_en: The government has laid down strict safety guidelines for the industry.
items.ex_zh: 政府为该行业制定了严格的安全指南。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to place an object carefully on a surface or in an upright position
items.ex_en: The monk set down the ceramic tea bowl with deliberate, mindful precision.
items.ex_zh: 僧人小心翼翼、全神贯注地将陶瓷茶碗安放在桌上。

groups.summary_en: An agent moves an object to rest in a specific location or posture. Put is the most generic everyday verb, place implies conscious deliberation or care, and set implies positioning firmly into a designated, upright, or prepared state.
groups.summary_zh: 将物品置于特定位置，涵盖从随意放置到审慎安放。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the fundamental spatial relocation and settling of an entity onto a supporting surface, serving as the unmarked baseline for physical contact and positional stability against which specialized placement verbs contrast.
groups.desc_zh: 指将实体放置在支撑平面上的基础物理位移动作，是空间定位的基准范畴，与各类强调特殊姿态或力道的操作相对照。
groups.nuance_en: put: generic transfer to an unspecified surface or resting state (book / hand / key) · place: deliberately and carefully settle into an intentional position (order / vase / trust) · lay: rest horizontally or flat along a supporting plane (carpet / foundation / baby) · rest: allow to settle without ongoing support or pressure (head / elbow / weight) · deposit: set down securely, heavily, or for safekeeping (funds / sediment / luggage)
groups.nuance_zh: put: 最通用的放置移动，不强调姿态 (book / hand / key) · place: 审慎、精确且有目的地安放 (order / vase / trust) · lay: 水平平放或铺展在平面上 (carpet / foundation / baby) · rest: 倚靠或使重量完全歇息支撑于某处 (head / elbow / weight) · deposit: 沉降析出或稳妥存放、卸下 (funds / sediment / luggage)

groups.name: Possess & Retain · 拥有与留存保留 (Have, Own, Retain)
groups.tip: 掌握和占有某物

items.def_zh: 有，拥有；占有，持有；经历；吃，喝；使，让
items.def_en: 1. To own, hold, or possess something; 2. to experience or undergo; 3. to consume food or drink.
items.ex_en: The wealthy landowner continues to have several sprawling estates across the countryside.
items.ex_zh: 那位富有的地主在乡间依然拥有数处辽阔的庄园。

items.def_zh: 拥有，具有……的所有权；承认 (own up to)
items.def_en: 1. To possess or have legal ownership of something; 2. to admit or acknowledge something.
items.ex_en: Private investors currently own most of the historic commercial buildings downtown.
items.ex_zh: 私人投资者目前拥有市中心大多数具有历史价值的商业建筑。

items.def_zh: 保有，保留；保存，保管；保持；遵守
items.def_en: 1. To retain possession of; to continue to have or hold; 2. to remain in a particular state or condition.
items.ex_en: He chose to keep his grandfather’s vintage mechanical wristwatch despite tempting offers.
items.ex_zh: 尽管有人出高价，他仍选择保留祖父传下来的那块老式机械手表。

items.def_en: to maintain possession, custody, or control of property, title, or position
items.ex_en: The founding family still holds the controlling shares in the international corporation.
items.ex_zh: 创始人家族仍持有这家跨国公司的控股权。

items.def_zh: 保留，保有；保存，保管；保持（keep 的过去式及过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of keep: to have retained possession of, held, or maintained.
items.ex_en: She kept the ancestral family farm despite persistent offers from aggressive developers.
items.ex_zh: 尽管进取的开发商屡次出价收购，她仍保有了祖传的家庭农场。

items.def_en: to continue to have, keep, or hold onto something rather than losing or relinquishing it
items.ex_en: The company managed to retain complete ownership of all its proprietary software patents.
items.ex_zh: 该公司成功保留了其所有专有软件专利的完整所有权。

items.def_en: to have or own something tangible, or to be endowed with a quality (formal)
items.ex_en: The university library possesses rare illuminated manuscripts dating back to the Middle Ages.
items.ex_zh: 大学图书馆藏有可追溯至中世纪的珍稀泥金装饰手抄本。

items.def_zh: 保留；保住（所有权或控制权）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to keep possession of something and refuse to give or sell it to others
items.ex_en: The collector refused to sell, choosing to hold onto the rare painting.
items.ex_zh: 这位收藏家拒绝出售，选择继续保住这幅罕见名画的所有权。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to reserve a portion of something rather than giving it away or using it all
items.ex_en: Farmers wisely keep back a portion of their grain harvest for sowing.
items.ex_zh: 农民明智地留存了一部分收获的谷物以备来年播种。

items.def_zh: 继续保留；留着（物品或财产）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to retain possession of something instead of parting with it
items.ex_en: You should hang on to those original documents until the legal dispute concludes.
items.ex_zh: 在法律纠纷结束之前，你应该一直留着那些原始文件。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe entering or remaining in a state of holding legal ownership, physical custody, or non-relinquishment of an entity, ranging from basic possession to formal custody and retention.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖对财物、权利或属性的事实持有、法定所有与持续保留。
groups.desc_en: Denotes maintaining legal, physical, or cognitive dominion over an entity over time, contrasting with momentary touching or acquiring by emphasizing enduring custody, ownership, and resistance to loss.
groups.desc_zh: 指在时间维度上对实体保持法律所有权、物理看管或认知掌控，与瞬时触碰或初次获取相比，强调持续占有与不易丧失性。
groups.nuance_en: possess: exert complete internal or external dominion and ownership (property / wealth / qualities) · own: hold legitimate legal title or exclusive personal right (land / business / shares) · retain: keep possession of despite external change or passage of time (control / composure / staff) · hold onto: physically grasp or stubbornly preserve against parting (lead / asset / memory) · keep: preserve in one's continuous care or custom (promise / record / pet)
groups.nuance_zh: possess: 拥有并完全掌控财产、特质或心智 (property / wealth / qualities) · own: 享有无可争议的法定所有权 (land / business / shares) · retain: 经受变动后依然保留维持 (control / composure / staff) · hold onto: 紧抓不放或极力挽留资产优势 (lead / asset / memory) · keep: 持续留存保管或遵守恪守 (promise / record / pet)

groups.name: Press & Compress · 挤压与压缩 (Physical Compression)
groups.tip: 施力挤压使物体体积变小

items.def_en: (+ sth) to apply downward physical force to flatten or compact an object
items.ex_en: Press down the lid firmly until you hear the silicone seal snap shut.
items.ex_zh: 用力向下按压盖子，直到听到硅胶密封圈咔哒一声扣紧。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make or become level, smooth, or flat by applying downward pressure
items.ex_en: Use a rolling pin to flatten the dough into a smooth circle.
items.ex_zh: 用擀面杖将面团压平成一个光滑的圆形。
items.ex2_en: The dense tall grass flattened under the intense weight of snow.
items.ex2_zh: 茂密的杂草在厚重积雪的压力下平贴在地上。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to crush or compress something forcefully into a smaller or flatter shape
items.ex_en: Workers squash down empty cardboard boxes to save space in recycling bins.
items.ex_zh: 工人们把空纸箱踩扁压塌，以节省回收箱里的空间。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to press two or more parts or objects tightly against each other
items.ex_en: Squeeze the two adhesive strips together tightly to ensure a waterproof bond.
items.ex_zh: 将两条胶条紧紧夹紧压合在一起，以确保防水粘合。

items.def_en: 1. To press something firmly from opposite sides, often to extract liquid or change its shape. 2. To force one's way into a tight space.
items.ex_en: Firmly squeeze the fresh lemon over the grilled salmon before serving dinner.
items.ex_zh: 在开饭前，用力挤压新鲜柠檬，将汁水淋在烤三文鱼上。

items.def_en: To press something firmly together so that it becomes dense, solid, and tightly packed.
items.ex_en: Heavy road rollers must compact the loose gravel bed before laying asphalt.
items.ex_zh: 在铺设沥青之前，重型压路机必须先将松散的碎石基底彻底压实。
items.ex2_en: The loose soil will compact naturally under regular heavy rainfall.
items.ex2_zh: 松散的土壤在频繁的暴雨冲刷下会自然压实。

items.def_en: to crush or squeeze something with force, making it flat or soft
items.ex_en: Someone carelessly stepped on my lunch bag and squashed the ripe peaches.
items.ex_zh: 有人不小心踩到了我的午餐袋，把熟透的桃子都挤扁了。
items.ex2_en: Ripe tomatoes squash easily when placed under heavy grocery items.
items.ex2_zh: 成熟的番茄放在重物下面时很容易被压烂。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make or become narrower or tighter, especially by encircling pressure
items.ex_en: The powerful constricting band squeezed the fuel line, severely restricting liquid flow.
items.ex_zh: 那根强力的束带压缩了燃油管路，严重限制了液体的流动。
items.ex2_en: Her pupils constricted immediately when exposed to the intense flashlight beam.
items.ex2_zh: 她的瞳孔一接触到强烈的手电筒光束就立刻收缩了。

items.def_en: to press or squeeze something with such force that it breaks or loses its natural shape
items.ex_en: The heavy hydraulic press can easily crush discarded scrap metal into dense cubes.
items.ex_zh: 重型液压机可以轻而易举地将废弃金属压碎成密实的正方体。

items.def_en: 1. To press or squeeze something into a smaller space. 2. To reduce data or text in size or duration.
items.ex_en: Industrial machines compress raw plant fibers into dense, eco-friendly acoustic insulation panels.
items.ex_zh: 工业机器将原始植物纤维压紧压缩成致密的环保隔音板。
items.ex2_en: The soft foam cushion compresses smoothly under the weight of passengers.
items.ex2_zh: 柔软的泡沫坐垫在乘客的重量下平缓地被压缩。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve applying inward physical force to an object or substance to reduce its volume, increase its density, or expel liquid. They range from gentle manual flattening to heavy mechanical compaction.
groups.summary_zh: 向内施力以缩小体积、增加密度或压出液体。
groups.desc_en: Denotes applying forceful inward or downward pressure to reduce an object's volume or flatten its form, contrasting with gentle touching by emphasizing mechanical force, spatial constriction, and material deformation.
groups.desc_zh: 指施加向内或向下的机械压力以缩小体积或压扁形态，与轻柔接触相比，强调空间收缩、受力压紧与形态形变。
groups.nuance_en: compact: consolidate loose particles or soil into a dense mass (soil / waste / snow) · squeeze: compress from opposing sides to extract fluid or fit into tight space (lemon / hand / trigger) · squash: crush completely flat or out of shape through heavy impact (bug / box / rebellion) · constrict: tighten circularly to narrow an opening or choke flow (airway / blood vessels / pupils) · flatten: eliminate elevation to make completely horizontal or level (curve / dough / structure)
groups.nuance_zh: compact: 压实松散颗粒使结构紧密坚实 (soil / waste / snow) · squeeze: 两侧挤压以榨汁或挤入狭窄空间 (lemon / hand / trigger) · squash: 重压彻底压扁变形或压碎 (bug / box / rebellion) · constrict: 环状收紧使管径通道变窄 (airway / blood vessels / pupils) · flatten: 施压彻底展平消除凹凸起伏 (curve / dough / structure)

groups.name: Protect from Attack or Harm · 防御与护卫 (Defend, Guard, Shield)
groups.tip: 抵御外敌并守护安危

items.def_en: (+ from/against) to keep someone or something safe from harm, damage, or attack
items.ex_en: These specialized safety goggles protect your eyes from hazardous airborne chemical splashes.
items.ex_zh: 这些专用护目镜能保护你的眼睛免受空气中危险化学品飞溅的伤害。

items.def_zh: 守护，保卫；看守；警惕，防范
items.def_en: 1. To protect a person, place, or object from attack or danger. 2. To watch over prisoners to prevent escape. 3. (+ against) To take precautions to prevent something bad.
items.ex_en: Armed security officers guard the perimeter gate against unauthorized intruders all night.
items.ex_zh: 荷枪实弹的安保人员整夜守护着外围大门，防止未授权人员闯入。

items.def_en: 1. To protect someone or something against attack, harm, or danger. 2. To speak or write in support of someone or something against criticism.
items.ex_en: The courageous garrison defended the frontier fortress against relentless enemy siege attacks.
items.ex_zh: 英勇的守军保卫着边境要塞，抵御敌人接连不断的围攻。

items.def_en: To protect someone or something from danger, harm, or unpleasant experiences.
items.ex_en: The mother instinctively raised her arms to shield the child from flying glass.
items.ex_zh: 母亲本能地抬起双臂，护住孩子免受飞溅碎玻璃的伤害。

items.def_zh: 使入病房, 守护, 保卫
items.def_en: watch over or shield from danger or harm; protect
items.ex_en: Ancient deities were believed to ward the sacred grove against malicious mortal wanderers.
items.ex_zh: 人们相信古老的神灵在守护着这片圣林，庇护它免受邪恶凡人入侵。

items.def_en: to prevent someone or something unpleasant or hostile from coming near or harming you
items.ex_en: She drank warm lemon tea with honey to ward off an impending winter cold.
items.ex_zh: 她喝了加蜂蜜的温柠檬茶，以预防即将来袭的冬季感冒。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to defend or support someone or something that is being criticized or attacked
items.ex_en: It is essential to stand up for your beliefs even when others disagree.
items.ex_zh: 即使别人不同意，也要勇于捍卫自己的信念。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to defend yourself against an attack or hostile approach by pushing the attacker away or resisting them
items.ex_en: The politician used sharp humor to fend off hostile questions from the aggressive reporters.
items.ex_zh: 这位政客用敏锐的幽默击退了咄咄逼人的记者们提出的充满敌意的问题。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to guard and protect someone or something to ensure they remain safe from harm
items.ex_en: She asked her neighbor to watch over the children while she ran an errand.
items.ex_zh: 她外出办事时请邻居照看一下孩子们。

items.def_en: (+ against) to protect rights, security, or welfare with formal measures
items.ex_en: The treaty established new international regulations to safeguard against intellectual property theft.
items.ex_zh: 该条约确立了新的国际法规，以防范知识产权盗窃。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve acting to prevent an entity from being attacked, invaded, damaged, or injured by taking defensive postures or providing protective cover.
groups.summary_zh: 抵御外来侵犯，或通过遮挡、站岗等方式提供人身与安全防护。
groups.desc_en: Denotes actively repelling hostility, hazards, or damage away from a vulnerable entity, contrasting with passive endurance by emphasizing vigilance, barrier creation, or counter-resistance.
groups.desc_zh: 指主动抵御外界敌意、危害或创伤以庇护脆弱目标，与消极承受相比，强调戒备防卫、设置屏障或反击抵挡。
groups.nuance_en: defend: resist active armed or verbal assaults to preserve an entity (territory / title / reputation) · shield: serve as a physical or institutional barrier blocking direct blows (eyes / suspect / industry) · guard: keep watchful vigil at a perimeter to deter intrusion (gate / prisoner / secret) · ward off: proactively deflect or deter an impending threat or sickness (blow / infection / disaster) · fend off: fight off multiple persistent or close-quarter attacks (critics / attackers / takeover)
groups.nuance_zh: defend: 抗击武装进攻或言论攻击以守住目标 (territory / title / reputation) · shield: 充当遮蔽屏障直接替其挡枪受袭 (eyes / suspect / industry) · guard: 在边界严密驻守警戒以防入侵 (gate / prisoner / secret) · ward off: 防范于未然，预先化解并挡开威胁 (blow / infection / disaster) · fend off: 勉力抵挡连番近身攻势或逼迫 (critics / attackers / takeover)

groups.name: Protrude & Stick Out · 突出与伸出 (Protrude, Jut, Cantilever)
groups.tip: 表面向外凸出或显露出来

items.def_en: to protrude or emerge slightly through an opening or past a surface
items.ex_en: A few wisps of gray hair began to poke out from under his woolen cap.
items.ex_zh: 几缕灰发从他的毛线帽下冒了出来。
items.ex2_en: The playful puppy poked its head out through the garden fence.
items.ex2_zh: 那只顽皮的小狗把头从花园栅栏里探了出来。

items.def_en: to project or be physically raised from an adjacent background or surface
items.ex_en: Her innovative approach made her application stand out from hundreds of others.
items.ex_zh: 她创新的方法使她的申请在数百人中脱颖而出。

items.def_en: (+ of/from) to extend outward past the surface or edge of something
items.ex_en: Several colorful brochures were sticking out of her overloaded leather handbag on the train.
items.ex_zh: 在火车上，几份彩色的宣传册从她装得过满的皮手提包里探了出来。

items.def_en: 1. (+ from/into) To stick out beyond an edge or surface; to project outward.
items.ex_en: Ancient iron reinforcement rods protrude dangerously from the crumbling concrete foundation of the bridge.
items.ex_zh: 古老的铁质加固钢筋危险地从桥梁破损的混凝土底座中伸出。

items.def_zh: （建筑等）以悬臂伸出，用悬臂梁支撑
items.def_en: 1. (architecture / engineering) To project outward like a cantilever, or to support a structure using cantilevers.
items.ex_en: The architect designed the dramatic glass terrace to cantilever gracefully over the steep ravine.
items.ex_zh: 建筑师将这座引人注目的玻璃露台设计成优雅地悬挑在陡峭的峡谷之上。
items.ex2_en: Engineers cantilevered the concrete roof ten meters out over the open courtyard.
items.ex2_zh: 工程师们将混凝土屋顶向外挑出十米，悬挑在露天院落上方。

items.def_en: to extend sharply outward beyond the main body or edge of something
items.ex_en: Sharp limestone rocks jut out into the bay, making navigation treacherous for small boats.
items.ex_zh: 锋利的石灰岩礁石向海湾中突出，使小型船只的航行变得危险重重。

items.def_en: (+ from) to stick out beyond an edge or surface
items.ex_en: Massive decorative stone gargoyles project from the upper ledges of the medieval cathedral.
items.ex_zh: 巨大的装饰性石雕滴水嘴兽从中世纪大教堂的上层窗台向外伸出。

items.def_en: (+ with) to swell or protrude outward in a rounded shape
items.ex_en: His battered leather briefcase bulged with thick legal briefs and disorganized reference files.
items.ex_zh: 他破旧的皮质公文包被厚厚的法律诉状和凌乱的参考档案塞得鼓鼓囊囊。

items.def_zh: 悬垂于…之上；向外伸出悬挂
items.def_en: [I/T] to project outward over something below
items.ex_en: Ancient oak branches overhang the narrow footpath, casting deep shadows in the afternoon sun.
items.ex_zh: 古老的橡树枝悬垂在狭窄的小路上，在午后的阳光下投下浓重的阴影。

items.def_en: 1. (+ out/into/over) To project or extend outward beyond the main line or body of something.
items.ex_en: Jagged volcanic cliffs jut into the turbulent sea, defying the relentless pounding waves.
items.ex_zh: 参差不齐的火山悬崖伸入波涛汹涌的大海，傲然迎击着无休止拍打的巨浪。

groups.summary_en: A structure, physical body, or architectural element extends outward or upward beyond an adjacent boundary or flat surface, either naturally or by cantilevered engineering.
groups.summary_zh: 物体或建筑构件向外、向上突出或挑出原有表面或边界。
groups.desc_en: Denotes extending outward beyond a normal surface plane, boundary, or baseline profile, contrasting with flush or recessed features by emphasizing conspicuous dimensional extrusion.
groups.desc_zh: 指从原本平齐的表面、边缘或基准轮廓向外伸展突出，与平齐或凹陷形态相比，强调外凸突起的三维显著性。
groups.nuance_en: protrude: push outward noticeably past an established surface (bone / tongue / pipe) · jut out: project angularly and steeply over an edge or space (chin / cliff / pier) · bulge: swell outward roundedly due to internal pressure (pocket / vein / eyes) · cantilever: extend horizontally outward supported only at one anchored end (beam / balcony / roof) · poke out: emerge partially, tip-first, through an aperture or concealment (head / toes / weed)
groups.nuance_zh: protrude: 显著穿出或隆起超越平齐表面 (bone / tongue / pipe) · jut out: 尖锐棱角分明地悬伸突起 (chin / cliff / pier) · bulge: 因内部压力而向外圆弧形膨胀 (pocket / vein / eyes) · cantilever: 单端固定横向悬挑伸出 (beam / balcony / roof) · poke out: 尖端部分探出开口或遮蔽物 (head / toes / weed)

groups.name: Publish & Release · 公布与发行 (Publish, Issue, Post)
groups.tip: 对外公布消息或公开发表

items.def_en: To display or publish information publicly, especially on a noticeboard or online; to send by mail.
items.ex_en: The university will post the final examination schedule on the student portal tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 大学将于明天上午在学生门户网站上发布期末考试日程。

items.def_zh: 发布，颁布；发行；配发；流出
items.def_en: To officially publish, produce, or announce something for the public; to distribute or flow out.
items.ex_en: The meteorological bureau will issue a severe storm warning before midnight tonight.
items.ex_zh: 气象局将在今晚午夜前发布严重风暴预警。
items.ex2_en: Thick black smoke began to issue rapidly from the broken chimney.
items.ex2_zh: 浓厚的黑烟开始从受损的烟囱中迅速冒出。

items.def_zh: 公开发售或公开发布（电影、产品、声明）
items.def_en: to make a film, record, software, or news available for public consumption
items.ex_en: The studio plans to release the highly anticipated documentary film in theaters next Friday.
items.ex_zh: 制片厂计划于下周五在各大影院公开发行这部备受期待的纪录片。

items.def_zh: 出版，发行；公开发表，公布
items.def_en: To prepare and produce a book, magazine, or document for sale or public distribution; to make information widely known.
items.ex_en: The academic press will publish her groundbreaking historical research paper in next month's journal.
items.ex_zh: 该学术出版社将在下个月的期刊上发表她开创性的历史研究论文。

items.def_zh: 发布消息或出版出版物
items.def_en: to produce or broadcast something for public notice
items.ex_en: The government ministry put out a detailed press statement regarding the latest trade negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 政府部门就最新的贸易谈判发布了一份详尽的新闻声明。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make a new publication, product, or official policy available to the public for the first time
items.ex_en: The tech company will roll out its updated operating system to consumers next week.
items.ex_zh: 这家科技公司将于下周向消费者正式推出其更新后的操作系统。

items.def_zh: 分发；分发寄出（通知或材料）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to distribute copies of a document, announcement, or newsletter to many recipients
items.ex_en: The committee decided to send out informational brochures to every registered resident this week.
items.ex_zh: 委员会决定本周向每位登记居民分发寄出信息宣传册。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to publish or release a book, magazine, or recorded piece of work to the public
items.ex_en: The independent record label will bring out the band's debut vinyl album this autumn.
items.ex_zh: 这家独立唱片厂牌将于今年秋季发行该乐队的首张黑胶唱片。

items.def_en: [I/T] to pass from person to person or disseminate a document widely
items.ex_en: The secretary began to circulate the confidential draft among the board members for review.
items.ex_zh: 秘书开始在董事会成员之间分发传阅机密草案以供审阅。
items.ex2_en: Fresh air circulated freely through the wide open windows all morning.
items.ex2_zh: 一整个上午，新鲜空气都在敞开的窗户间自由流通。

items.def_zh: 正式颁布法令或公开宣布
items.def_en: to make a law, decree, or new principle publicly and officially known
items.ex_en: The president will promulgate the constitutional amendment during a formal ceremony in the capital.
items.ex_zh: 总统将在首都举行的一场正式仪式上颁布宪法修正案。

groups.summary_en: An author, institution, or administrator puts text, announcements, or creative content into the public sphere through digital, print, or formal channels.
groups.summary_zh: 个人或官方机构借网络、书刊或公告将信息向公众发布。
groups.desc_en: Denotes officially disseminating information, media, or products to the general public or designated audience, contrasting with private creation or restricted storage by emphasizing formal distribution and public availability.
groups.desc_zh: 指正式将信息、媒体或产品推向公众或指定受众，与私下创作或内部留存相比，强调权威发布、法定流通与公开面世。
groups.nuance_en: publish: print and issue textual, academic, or musical material commercially (book / findings / journal) · issue: deliver an authoritative statement, currency, or permit officially (statement / passport / warning) · release: unlock and deliver for public consumption after withholding (film / album / report) · post: display publicly on a board or digital network (notice / update / bail) · roll out: introduce a new product or policy across markets progressively (vaccine / feature / network)
groups.nuance_zh: publish: 经编审正式印刷出版学术或文艺作品 (book / findings / journal) · issue: 官方权威颁布政令、证件或许可 (statement / passport / warning) · release: 经解禁或审核后公开发布影视作品 (film / album / report) · post: 在公告板或网络平台张贴展示 (notice / update / bail) · roll out: 分阶段全面铺开推广新产品或策略 (vaccine / feature / network)

groups.name: Pursue & Shadow · 追踪与尾随 (Follow, Track, Dog)
groups.tip: 紧跟或追随在后

items.def_zh: 跟随，追随；遵循，服从；理解，领会
items.def_en: 1. to travel or move behind someone or something 2. to obey rules or follow instructions 3. to understand or keep up with
items.ex_en: The tourists decided to follow their knowledgeable guide through the labyrinth of narrow alleys.
items.ex_zh: 游客们决定跟着经验丰富的向导穿过迷宫般狭窄的小巷。

items.def_en: to follow someone closely and continually; to cause problems for someone over a long period
items.ex_en: Persistent financial troubles and health issues dog him throughout his long artistic career.
items.ex_zh: 持续不断的财务困扰与健康问题在他漫长的艺术生涯中一直纠缠着他。

items.def_en: to follow the trail, movements, or progress of someone or something
items.ex_en: Wildlife biologists use sophisticated GPS collars to track the movements of wild wolves.
items.ex_zh: 野生动物生物学家使用精密的GPS项圈来追踪野狼的行动轨迹。

items.def_en: to follow behind someone by tracking clues, footprints, or scents
items.ex_en: The skilled hunting hound trailed the wounded deer through the damp pine forest.
items.ex_zh: 那只训练有素的猎犬循着气味，穿过潮湿的松林追踪受伤的鹿。

items.def_zh: 隐秘尾随，如影随形地跟着
items.def_en: to follow someone very closely, keeping watch without being detected
items.ex_en: Undercover agents continued to shadow the suspect through the crowded downtown subway stations.
items.ex_zh: 便衣特工在拥挤的市中心地铁站内继续隐秘尾随嫌疑人。

items.def_en: to follow someone closely and secretly in order to watch their movements
items.ex_en: Private investigators hired by the firm tailed the rogue executive to an underground garage.
items.ex_zh: 受公司雇佣的私家侦探盯梢那个叛变的高管，一路跟到了地下车库。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to chase or pursue someone in order to catch them
items.ex_en: Two patrol officers quickly went after the fleeing suspect down the dark alleyway.
items.ex_zh: 两名巡警迅速顺着黑暗的小巷追击那名逃窜的嫌疑人。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to follow clues or footprints until a target is located
items.ex_en: The police managed to track down the suspect after weeks of investigation.
items.ex_zh: 经过数周的调查，警方终于追查到了嫌疑人的下落。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to follow closely behind someone wherever they go
items.ex_en: The stray dog began to tail after the kind stranger all the way home.
items.ex_zh: 那只流浪狗开始一路尾随那位善良的陌生人，一直跟到了家门口。

items.def_zh: 紧追不舍，不断纠缠追逐
items.def_en: to pursue someone relentlessly and persistently without giving them rest
items.ex_en: Aggressive paparazzi continued to hound the famous actress outside her private residence for weeks.
items.ex_zh: 咄咄逼人的狗仔队在著名女演员的私人住所外连续数周纠缠不休。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe maintaining surveillance or physical pursuit of an entity along a path, differing by persistence, visibility, and legal/hostile intent.
groups.summary_zh: 描述沿路径追随、暗中盯梢或持续追捕某人或某物，语域与敌意程度不同。
groups.desc_en: Denotes maintaining continuous surveillance, covert proximity, or pursuit along the path of an entity, contrasting with casual trailing by emphasizing focused target tracking and intent to monitor or capture.
groups.desc_zh: 指沿目标的运动轨迹保持持续监视、隐蔽靠近或步步紧逼，与普通跟随相比，强调针对性追踪、尾随监视或最终缉捕企图。
groups.nuance_en: track: follow physical spoors, telemetry, or data traces methodically (prey / shipment / storm) · shadow: secretly and closely trail a suspect without being detected (agent / suspect / politician) · dog: hound relentlessly and persistently without relenting (steps / footsteps / failure) · tail: follow a vehicle or person closely in transit (car / courier / target) · track down: pursue tirelessly until the quarry is located or apprehended (criminal / lead / fugitive)
groups.nuance_zh: track: 沿物理足迹、遥测或数据链系统追溯 (prey / shipment / storm) · shadow: 隐蔽且步步贴身尾随进行反侦查监视 (agent / suspect / politician) · dog: 如影随形般顽固纠缠困扰 (steps / footsteps / failure) · tail: 在移动交通中紧咬车尾或人身尾随 (car / courier / target) · track down: 历尽周折终于搜寻并缉捕归案 (criminal / lead / fugitive)

groups.name: Rebel & Defy · 抗拒、叛乱与背叛 (Defy, Riot, Defect)
groups.tip: 街头骚乱升级为武装暴动

items.def_en: [I/T] to fight back against or oppose something or someone actively
items.ex_en: Local villagers united bravely to resist the corrupt corporation's illegal land reclamation plans.
items.ex_zh: 当地村民勇敢地团结起来，抵制那家腐败公司非法的土地开垦计划。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to resist or confront a powerful opponent or bully with courage and defiance
items.ex_en: These materials are designed to stand up to extreme weather conditions.
items.ex_zh: 这些材料旨在经受住极端天气的考验。

items.def_en: to openly disregard a law, rule, or convention with contempt
items.ex_en: The rogue industrial facility chose to openly flout environmental regulations despite severe warnings.
items.ex_zh: 那家无良工业企业不顾严厉警告，公然藐视环境法规。

items.def_en: to act collectively against an oppressive government or authority by taking up resistance
items.ex_en: The citizens rose up against the corrupt military regime.
items.ex_zh: 市民们揭竿而起，反抗腐败的军事政权。

items.def_zh: 背叛；反目成仇；倒戈抵抗
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to stop being friendly or loyal to someone and start opposing or defying them
items.ex_en: Disillusioned by broken promises, former loyal supporters began to turn against the populist mayor.
items.ex_zh: 因承诺屡屡落空而大失所望，昔日忠诚的支持者们开始倒戈反对这位民粹市长。

items.def_en: (+ against) to rise in opposition or take up arms against an established ruler or authority
items.ex_en: Underground militant groups decided to rebel against the oppressive military regime last winter.
items.ex_zh: 地下武装团体在去年冬天决定起义反抗残暴的军政府政权。

items.def_en: 1. To take part in a violent and uncontrolled public disturbance.
items.ex_en: Furious crowds began to riot in the downtown streets after the controversial court verdict.
items.ex_zh: 在极具争议的法庭判决下达后，愤怒的人群开始在市中心街头骚乱暴动。

items.def_zh: 背叛，叛逃，变节（投奔敌对阵营）
items.def_en: 1. (+ from/to) To leave your own country, political party, or organization in order to join an opposing one.
items.ex_en: A disillusioned intelligence officer managed to defect to an allied nation during the conference.
items.ex_zh: 一名大失所望的情报官员在会议期间成功叛逃至一个盟国。

items.def_zh: 违抗，反抗，藐视；使无法（相信、解释等）
items.def_en: 1. To refuse openly to obey a person, rule, or law. 2. To be impossible to explain, describe, or believe.
items.ex_en: Courageous activists chose to defy the midnight curfew by staging a silent street protest.
items.ex_zh: 勇敢的活动人士举行无声街头抗议，公然违抗午夜宵禁令。

items.def_en: to refuse openly to obey the orders of officers in military or maritime service
items.ex_en: Starving crew members conspired to mutiny against their tyrannical captain in the open sea.
items.ex_zh: 忍饥挨饿的船员们在公海上密谋哗变，抗击专横残暴的船长。

groups.summary_en: Agents actively challenge authority, rising from insolent defiance to violent public insurrection or total treasonous abandonment.
groups.summary_zh: 对抗权威，从藐视抗命上升至街头暴动与叛逃倒戈。
groups.desc_en: Denotes overtly rising up against established authority, laws, or political allegiance, contrasting with passive noncompliance by emphasizing defiant challenge, collective upheaval, or ideological breach.
groups.desc_zh: 指公然起事反抗既有政权、权威或背离组织效忠，与消极抵制相比，强调正面的挑衅颠覆、群体暴动或彻底阵营背叛。
groups.nuance_en: rebel: actively fight against an established government or authority (subjects / teenagers / forces) · flout: openly and scornfully disregard a law or convention (rules / ban / authority) · rise up: mobilize collectively in armed or open rebellion (masses / citizens / workers) · riot: engage in public, chaotic, and violent civil disruption (crowd / inmates / fans) · defect: abandon one's nation, party, or cause to join the opposition (spy / diplomat / officer)
groups.nuance_zh: rebel: 举旗反抗统治阶级或既定权威 (subjects / teenagers / forces) · flout: 公然藐视并公然违反法纪习俗 (rules / ban / authority) · rise up: 广大民众揭竿而起发动起义 (masses / citizens / workers) · riot: 群体性失控并在公共场所暴乱滋事 (crowd / inmates / fans) · defect: 叛逃投敌或彻底背叛所属阵营 (spy / diplomat / officer)

groups.name: Rend & Cleave · 撕裂与劈开 (Rend, Rive, Crosscut)
groups.tip: 用力劈开木石断绝连接

items.def_en: (+ sth) to tear something completely into small shreds or fragments
items.ex_en: He was so furious that he threatened to rip up the partnership agreement.
items.ex_zh: 他非常愤怒，甚至威胁要撕毁合伙协议。

items.def_en: [I/T] to pull or sever apart quickly and forcefully with rough edges
items.ex_en: A sharp hidden nail ripped the fragile silk lining of her expensive designer jacket.
items.ex_zh: 一颗隐蔽的尖钉撕破了她昂贵设计师外套那层脆弱的丝绸内衬。
items.ex2_en: The thin paper ripped apart instantly under the heavy rushing water.
items.ex2_zh: 在湍急水流的重压下，薄纸瞬间被撕裂了。

items.def_zh: 横切，横截（木材）；（电影中）交叉剪辑
items.def_en: 1. To saw or cut wood across the grain. 2. (in film editing) To alternate between two or more different scenes.
items.ex_en: The director chose to crosscut between the intense interrogation and the impending heist.
items.ex_zh: 导演选择在激烈的审讯与即将发生的抢劫案两个场景间进行交叉剪辑。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to tear or split something violently into pieces or separate parts
items.ex_en: Violent internal conflicts threatened to rip apart the newly formed political coalition within months.
items.ex_zh: 激烈的内部冲突在数月内几乎将新组建的政治联盟彻底撕裂。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to pull or rend something into pieces using severe, violent force
items.ex_en: The civil war threatens to tear the entire country apart.
items.ex_zh: 内战有让整个国家分崩离析的危险。

items.def_en: [I/T] to split or sever something sharply along a natural line or grain
items.ex_en: With one swift stroke of his axe, the woodsman cleaved the thick timber cleanly.
items.ex_zh: 樵夫挥起斧头利落地一击，便顺着纹理将粗大的木料整齐地劈开。
items.ex2_en: The brittle slate cleaved neatly along its natural geological grain lines.
items.ex2_zh: 易碎的板岩顺着其天然的地质纹理整齐地裂开了。

items.def_zh: 撕裂，撕碎，猛力劈开；使心碎
items.def_en: 1. (literary) To tear or split something apart violently. 2. To cause deep sorrow or grief to someone.
items.ex_en: Fierce artillery bombardments rend the tranquil silence of the ancient mountainous valley at dawn.
items.ex_zh: 猛烈的炮火轰击在黎明时分撕裂了古老山谷宁静的死寂。

items.def_zh: 撕裂，分裂，劈开（rive的过去分词）
items.def_en: (literary) Past participle of rive: violently split, torn apart, or divided.
items.ex_en: The ancient kingdom stood hopelessly riven by endless tribal warfare and bitter royal feuds.
items.ex_zh: 古老的王国陷于无休止的部落战争与激烈的王室宿怨中，四分五裂。
items.ex2_en: The violent civil dispute has riven countless peaceful families across the country.
items.ex2_zh: 这场激烈的内部分争已经分裂了全国无数和睦的家庭。

items.def_en: (literary) To tear or split something apart violently; to divide into pieces or factions.
items.ex_en: Severe philosophical disagreements began to rive the once united research team into warring factions.
items.ex_zh: 严重的理念分歧开始将曾经团结的科研团队撕裂成对立的阵营。
items.ex2_en: The brittle limestone can rive cleanly when subjected to freezing winter frost.
items.ex2_zh: 易碎的石灰岩在遭遇严冬霜冻时会整齐地开裂。

items.def_en: to break or split apart violently into pieces; sever cleanly
items.ex_en: A catastrophic earthquake threatened to sunder the coastal highway into two impassable concrete halves.
items.ex_zh: 一场灾难性的地震几乎把沿海公路猛烈震裂成了两截无法通行的水泥断层。
items.ex2_en: The massive ancient granite monolith sundered during the violent seismic event.
items.ex2_zh: 巨大的古老花岗岩独石在剧烈的地震中裂成了两半。

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote the violent splitting, fracturing, or tearing apart of solid material along or across grain lines. They distinguish mechanical transverse cutting from archaic, highly dramatic or violent fracturing and wrenching apart.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重沿纹理或横向实施剧烈、深度的劈裂、撕开或切断。
groups.desc_en: Denotes violently splitting or lacerating a material or entity into separated pieces along fibers or structural planes, contrasting with clean cutting by emphasizing destructive force, jagged ruptures, and severe trauma.
groups.desc_zh: 指沿纤维或组织构造以暴力生拉硬拽撕裂或劈开物体，与平整切削相比，强调破坏性力道、撕裂创口与断裂参差感。
groups.nuance_en: cleave: split cleanly and forcefully along natural grain or fissure (rock / wood / skull) · rip: tear fibrous material apart with swift violent tensile pulling (fabric / seams / muscle) · rend: tear violently into fragments with primeval, agonizing force (garments / heart / earth) · tear apart: dismember or separate ruthlessly into distinct pieces (car / family / prey) · crosscut: saw across the natural grain of timber or structure (timber / vein / board)
groups.nuance_zh: cleave: 沿天然纹理裂隙干脆利落地劈开 (rock / wood / skull) · rip: 施加迅猛拉力撕破织物或缝合线 (fabric / seams / muscle) · rend: 以狂暴痛苦之力撕裂衣衫或心扉 (garments / heart / earth) · tear apart: 残酷分尸或彻底拆毁解构 (car / family / prey) · crosscut: 横截垂直于木材纹理进行锯切 (timber / vein / board)

groups.name: Renovate & Modernize · 改造与翻新 (Redo, Retrofit, Redevelop)
groups.tip: 在旧基础上进行更新重塑

items.def_en: (+ sth) to renovate, redecorate, or put something into a state of good repair
items.ex_en: We spent all summer working to fix up that ramshackle cottage near the lake.
items.ex_zh: 我们花了一整个夏天的时间来整修湖边那座破烂不堪的小木屋。

items.def_en: 1. To redecorate, renovate, or remodel a room or building; to do something again.
items.ex_en: They hired an experienced designer to completely redo their outdated kitchen and guest bathroom.
items.ex_zh: 他们聘请了一位经验丰富的设计师，将过时的厨房和客卫彻底重新装修。

items.def_zh: 翻新，修缮（房屋或建筑物）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to repair, redecorate, or modernize an old building, room, or vehicle
items.ex_en: The young couple bought a neglected Victorian flat and decided to do up thoroughly.
items.ex_zh: 这对年轻夫妇买下了一套年久失修的维多利亚式公寓，并决定彻底翻新。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to structurally, visually, or functionally overhaul and improve something
items.ex_en: The television team arrived yesterday to make over the community library into modern workspace.
items.ex_zh: 电视台团队昨天抵达，着手将社区图书馆全面改造成现代化办公空间。

items.def_zh: 翻新，修葺（使建筑等恢复良好状态）
items.def_en: To restore a room or building to a good state of repair
items.ex_en: The city allocated five million dollars to renovate the historic municipal opera house safely.
items.ex_zh: 市政府拨款五百万美元，以妥善修葺这座具有历史意义的市立歌剧院。

items.def_en: To give new and improved form, structure, or appearance to something
items.ex_en: The struggling company decided to revamp its entire online marketing campaign this autumn season.
items.ex_zh: 这家陷入困境的公司决定在今年秋季对其整个线上营销方案进行全面改版。

items.def_zh: 整修，重新装饰（改善外观或功能）
items.def_en: To redecorate and revamp a building or item to improve its appearance and utility
items.ex_en: Contractors will thoroughly refurbish the dilapidated public library over the coming three winter months.
items.ex_zh: 承包商将在接下来的三个冬月里对这座破旧的公共图书馆进行全面整修翻新。

items.def_zh: 翻新，对……进行技术改造，加装新部件
items.def_en: 1. To install newer parts, equipment, or features into an older building, vehicle, or machine.
items.ex_en: Engineers plan to retrofit the aging coal plant with advanced carbon capture technology soon.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们计划尽快用先进的碳捕集技术对这座老化的燃煤电厂进行改造。

items.def_zh: 重新开发，改造，重建（旧区或建筑）
items.def_en: 1. To rebuild, modernize, or develop an urban area, building, or land for a new purpose.
items.ex_en: Urban planners want to redevelop the abandoned industrial waterfront into a thriving public park.
items.ex_zh: 城市规划者希望将废弃的工业滨水区重新开发为繁华的公共公园。
items.ex2_en: The rundown historic district redeveloped rapidly into a trendy shopping hub.
items.ex2_zh: 破败的历史街区迅速改造转型为一个时尚的购物中心。

items.def_en: To thoroughly examine and repair an entire machine, system, or organization
items.ex_en: The new administration promised to overhaul the outdated tax system within its first year.
items.ex_zh: 新一届政府承诺在其执政第一年内彻底改革陈旧的税收制度。

groups.summary_en: An agent modifies, upgrades, or structurally overhauls existing buildings, systems, or areas to improve functionality, conform to new standards, or give them a modern form.
groups.summary_zh: 对既有建筑、设施或区域进行改造、升级与更新。
groups.desc_en: Denotes restoring, upgrading, or restructuring a degraded, obsolete, or worn facility or product, contrasting with basic maintenance by emphasizing substantial enhancement, modernized systems, or renewed aesthetics.
groups.desc_zh: 指对老旧、磨损或过时的设施或产品进行更新、升级与再造，与简单日常维护相比，强调功能大幅改善、系统现代化与面貌焕新。
groups.nuance_en: renovate: restore an aging building or structure to good sound condition (house / hotel / theatre) · retrofit: install advanced parts or technology onto an existing older system (fleet / factory / aircraft) · revamp: thoroughly revise and modernize the style or structure of something (image / website / curriculum) · refurbish: redecorate, clean, and re-equip an interior or device (office / suite / hardware) · do up: paint, repair, and cosmetically freshen up a space (flat / cottage / room)
groups.nuance_zh: renovate: 修复老旧建筑使其恢复稳固良好状态 (house / hotel / theatre) · retrofit: 给旧有设备加装高新技术或改装配件 (fleet / factory / aircraft) · revamp: 全面改版、重构陈旧的系统或形象 (image / website / curriculum) · refurbish: 翻修、清洁并重新装配室内或硬件 (office / suite / hardware) · do up: 对老屋进行装饰性修缮刷新 (flat / cottage / room)

groups.name: Reorient & Route Around · 换向与环行 (Pronate, Reorient, Circumnavigate)
groups.tip: 围绕轴线旋转、转动或环绕

items.def_en: (+ sth) to travel along a curved path around an obstruction or perimeter
items.ex_en: The hikers had to go around the massive fallen tree blocking the forest trail.
items.ex_zh: 徒步旅行者们不得不绕开那棵横挡在森林小道上的巨大倒木。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to direct movement or travel around an obstacle or perimeter
items.ex_en: The attentive driver managed to steer around the deep potholes in the unpaved country lane.
items.ex_zh: 专注的司机成功绕过了未铺柏油的乡村小道上的那些深坑。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to change bodily orientation or bearing to face the opposite direction
items.ex_en: Hearing his name called in the crowd, the officer quickly turned around to look.
items.ex_zh: 听到人群中有人喊自己的名字，警官迅速转过身去看。
items.ex2_en: The nurse gently turned the elderly patient around in the bed.
items.ex2_zh: 护士轻轻地在床上把老病人翻过身来。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ on/around) To turn or balance on a central point or pin
items.ex_en: The robotic camera can smoothly pivot around its sturdy central base to film everything.
items.ex_zh: 这台机器摄像机能够围绕其坚固的中央底座顺畅转动，拍摄全方位画面。
items.ex2_en: The worker pivoted the crane arm to place the steel beam.
items.ex2_zh: 工人转动起重机吊臂以放置钢梁。

items.def_zh: 旋后（使手掌或足底向上或向外翻转）
items.def_en: [I/T] To turn or rotate the hand, forearm, or foot so that the palm or sole faces upward or outward
items.ex_en: The physical therapist instructed the injured athlete to slowly supinate his sprained wrist upward.
items.ex_zh: 理疗师指导受伤的运动员慢慢将扭伤的手腕向上旋后翻转。
items.ex2_en: The runner's foot will naturally supinate slightly during each forward step.
items.ex2_zh: 跑者的脚在向前迈步时自然会轻微外翻。

items.def_zh: 旋前，前旋（使手掌朝下或足内翻）
items.def_en: (anatomy) To turn the forearm so the palm faces downward or backward, or to roll the foot inward during movement.
items.ex_en: Improper running shoes often cause marathon runners to pronate their feet excessively while running.
items.ex_zh: 不合适的跑鞋往往会导致马拉松运动员在跑步过程中双足过度前旋。
items.ex2_en: His wrists pronate automatically whenever he lifts heavy barbells during training.
items.ex2_zh: 他在训练中举起重杠铃时，手腕会自动内旋。

items.def_en: [I/T] To go around the edge or periphery of an area rather than through it
items.ex_en: The adventurous travelers decided to skirt the dense swamp rather than wading through it.
items.ex_zh: 冒险旅行者们决定沿着茂密的沼泽边缘绕行，而不是涉水横穿过去。

items.def_en: To go past or around an obstacle or town using an alternate route
items.ex_en: A newly constructed ring road allows heavy trucks to bypass the congested town center.
items.ex_zh: 一条新建的环城公路使重型卡车得以绕开拥堵的城镇中心。

items.def_zh: 重新调整方向，重新定位；使重新适应
items.def_en: To change the direction, orientation, focus, or purpose of something or someone.
items.ex_en: The university decided to reorient its curriculum toward artificial intelligence and data science.
items.ex_zh: 该大学决定将其课程体系重新调整到人工智能与数据科学方向。
items.ex2_en: The migratory birds reoriented quickly when strong crosswinds pushed them off course.
items.ex2_zh: 当强劲的侧风偏离路线时，候鸟们迅速调整了方向。

items.def_en: To sail, fly, or travel completely around something, especially the earth or an island.
items.ex_en: The intrepid explorer set sail alone to circumnavigate the globe within eight months.
items.ex_zh: 这位勇敢的探险家独自扬帆起航，计划在八个月内环航地球。

groups.summary_en: An entity adjusts its anatomical or spatial orientation, pivots relative to bearings, or navigates completely around a perimeter or globe.
groups.summary_zh: 调整解剖学或空间朝向、方位重定向，或绕周界环行。
groups.desc_en: Denotes altering rotational orientation or maneuvering along a curved path around an obstacle or boundary, contrasting with straight-line motion by emphasizing directional detour, rotational realignment, or evasion.
groups.desc_zh: 指改变旋转朝向或沿弧形轨迹绕行障碍物及边界，与直线运动相比，强调方向偏转、轴向翻转或迂回规避。
groups.nuance_en: bypass: route completely around an obstruction or bureaucratic hurdle (city / checkpoint / regulations) · skirt: travel along the outer edge or evasively touch on an issue (border / coastline / controversy) · pivot: rotate decisively on a fixed central point or switch strategy (heel / axis / business model) · pronate: rotate a limb downward or inward mechanically (forearm / wrist / foot) · supinate: rotate a limb outward or upward to face anteriorly (palm / foot / forearm)
groups.nuance_zh: bypass: 完全绕开堵塞路段或层级繁冗程序 (city / checkpoint / regulations) · skirt: 沿边缘绕行或在谈话中回避敏感实质 (border / coastline / controversy) · pivot: 以固定轴心自旋或果断转舵换赛道 (heel / axis / business model) · pronate: 肢体沿解剖轴向内向下旋前 (forearm / wrist / foot) · supinate: 肢体向外向上旋后使掌心朝上 (palm / foot / forearm)

groups.name: Resonate with Metallic or Ringing Sound · 震响与清脆鸣响 (Jangle, Twang, Knell)
groups.tip: 弦震或钟鸣产生的特殊声

items.def_en: to ring harmoniously or strike to signal time, as a clock or set of bells
items.ex_en: The antique clock in the hall began to chime in the late afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 大厅里的古董钟在傍晚时分开始敲响报时。

items.def_en: to make a clear, musical, ringing sound like small bells or a clock
items.ex_en: Delicate glass wind chimes softly chime on the porch whenever a breeze passes.
