items.def_en: to leave a person, dependent, or post permanently without intending to return
items.ex_en: The heartless man abandoned his wife and infants without any financial support.
items.ex_zh: 那个狠心的男人抛弃了妻儿，且没有留下任何经济支持。

items.def_en: 1. To abandon someone or leave someone without help or support. 2. To leave an armed force or post without permission.
items.ex_en: The coward deserted his comrades during the heat of the midnight ambush.
items.ex_zh: 那个胆小鬼在午夜伏击战最激烈的时刻开小差抛下了战友。

items.def_en: to leave someone isolated and trapped without means of escape
items.ex_en: The shipwreck marooned several surviving sailors on an uninhabited, desolate island.
items.ex_zh: 海难将几名幸存的水手孤立无援地弃置在一座荒无人烟的孤岛上。

items.def_en: to renounce or leave entirely someone or something one has a duty toward
items.ex_en: She could never forsake her ailing sister during her darkest moments.
items.ex_zh: 在她姐姐人生最晦暗的时刻，她决不会将其抛弃不顾。

items.def_zh: 抛弃（情人），（尤指婚礼前）甩掉
items.def_en: To suddenly end a romantic relationship with a lover or fiancé(e), especially unfeelingly or right before marriage.
items.ex_en: The runaway groom heartlessly jilted his crying fiancee at the church altar.
items.ex_zh: 逃跑的新郎在教堂圣坛前狠心地甩掉了痛哭流涕的未婚妻。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe leaving a dependent, spouse, partner, or committed cause behind, abrogating moral or relational duty, ranging from abrupt romantic rejection to outright permanent abandonment.
groups.summary_zh: 指背弃职责或感情承诺，彻底遗弃依附者、伴侣或原有的责任。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves severing emotional, moral, or legal ties by physically walking away and leaving a dependent or bonded party stranded, contrasting with mutual parting by its unilateral breach of loyalty or duty.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为单方面决绝地离开负有道德、法律或情感责任的依附方并任其自生自灭，与普通的和平分手不同，它带有单方违背信义与抚育职责的色彩。
groups.nuance_en: abandon: completely desert a vulnerable person leaving them without support (family / baby / post) · desert: treacherously or unlawfully abandon a duty or partner (post / army / spouse) · forsake: renounce or leave behind someone beloved, often in distress (friends / homeland / vows) · walk out on: abruptly leave a partner or domestic arrangement in anger or exhaustion (spouse / children / family) · maroon: leave stranded and isolated in a remote or helpless state (island / wilderness / traveler)
groups.nuance_zh: abandon: 完全丢下缺乏保护的弱小依附者 (family / baby / post) · desert: 违纪背信或擅离职守与家庭 (post / army / spouse) · forsake: 决绝抛弃誓约或危难中的亲密之人 (friends / homeland / vows) · walk out on: 负气、冲动或决绝地摔门弃家而去 (spouse / children / family) · maroon: 将人孤立并遗弃在绝境或荒野 (island / wilderness / traveler)

groups.name: Abolish & Annul Laws · 废止与撤销制度 (Abrogate, Repeal, Annul)
groups.tip: 正式废除法律或撤销制度

items.def_zh: 裁定（法律、制度等）无效；废止
items.def_en: (+ sth) Rule that a law, regulation, or statute is illegal or unconstitutional and no longer in force
items.ex_en: The Supreme Court voted to strike down the unconstitutional surveillance statute entirely.
items.ex_zh: 最高法院投票决定全盘裁定废止那项违宪的监控法令。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Put an end to or formally abolish an established practice, rule, or system
items.ex_en: The new administration plans to do away with outdated trade tariffs.
items.ex_zh: 新一届政府计划废除那些早已过时的贸易关税制度。

items.def_zh: 废止，从法典中删除（法律等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Formally remove a law or provision from the statute books
items.ex_en: Parliament voted to wipe off the archaic sedition statute from national law.
items.ex_zh: 议会投票决定从国家法典中彻底删除并废止那部陈旧的煽动罪法令。

items.def_en: (of a legislative body) to officially rescind or withdraw an existing law by an act of legislature
items.ex_en: The legislative assembly moved quickly to repeal the highly controversial property tax.
items.ex_zh: 立法机构迅速采取行动，正式废止了极具争议的财产税法案。

items.def_en: to formally put an end to an institution, practice, or legal system
items.ex_en: Activists fought tirelessly for decades to abolish the inhumane penal institution.
items.ex_zh: 社会活动家们数十年不知疲倦地抗争，以彻底废除这一不人道的刑罚体制。

items.def_en: to make a law, contract, or official decision void by executive or legal authority
items.ex_en: The regulatory board acted decisively to rescind the fraudulent company's operating license.
items.ex_zh: 监管委员会果断采取行动，依法撤销了那家欺诈公司的营业执照。

items.def_en: to declare officially that a statute, decree, or marriage is legally invalid from the beginning
items.ex_en: The civil court declared the coerced marriage legally annulled from inception.
items.ex_zh: 民事法庭正式宣告这桩受强迫的婚姻自始便不具有法律效力。

items.def_zh: 废除，撤销（法律、条约或协议）
items.def_en: (formal) to officially end or cancel a law, treaty, right, or formal agreement
items.ex_en: The newly elected government opted to abrogate the international boundary agreement.
items.ex_zh: 新当选的政府选择单方面正式废止并终止该项国际边境协议。

items.def_zh: 终止……的国教地位；废除，取消（某机构的法定地位）
items.def_en: 1. to end the official or legal status of a national church 2. to deprive an organization of its established public position
items.ex_en: Radical reformers sought to disestablish the state church during the revolution.
items.ex_zh: 激进的改革者们在革命期间试图剥夺并终止国教会的法定官方地位。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to legislative, constitutional, or institutional authorities formally revoking, abolishing, or taking off the books established statutes, treaties, or state institutions.
groups.summary_zh: 官方权力机构依职权正式废止、废除法律、条约或制度。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves an authoritative, legislative, or judicial act that deprives an existing law, treaty, or institution of legal force, contrasting with routine modification by effecting complete nullification.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为运用立法、司法或最高权威宣布既有法规、条约或制度彻底失效，与一般的条款修订不同，其本质是自顶向下的彻底废除与清零。
groups.nuance_en: repeal: formally revoke a legislative act or statute by vote (law / act / statute) · abolish: completely put an end to an established system, institution, or tax (slavery / death penalty / monarchy) · rescind: cancel or revoke a decree, contract, or decision from a position of authority (offer / policy / order) · annul: declare a law, contract, or marriage legally void and non-existent ab initio (marriage / contract / election) · abrogate: officially repudiate or abolish a formal treaty, law, or right (treaty / agreement / law)
groups.nuance_zh: repeal: 立法机关经表决正式废止制定法 (law / act / statute) · abolish: 彻底终结历史性制度、体制或苛税 (slavery / death penalty / monarchy) · rescind: 上级或发令方撤销已作出的指令或协议 (offer / policy / order) · annul: 司法裁定宣布某法律关系自始无效 (marriage / contract / election) · abrogate: 正式单方废除条约、特权或法律协定 (treaty / agreement / law)

groups.name: Acceleration & Velocity Increase · 加速与提速 (Quicken, Accelerate, Floor it)
groups.tip: 运动速度逐步提升

items.def_en: Increase in speed, pace, or intensity
items.ex_en: Business usually picks up in the spring, and sales figures improve rapidly.
items.ex_zh: 生意通常在春季好转，销售额也会迅速回升。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make pace, gait, or movement faster, or become faster
items.ex_en: Hearing footsteps behind him in the dark alleyway, he quickened his stride.
items.ex_zh: 听到黑暗小巷身后传来的脚步声，他不由自主地加快了步伐。

items.def_en: Begin to move faster and faster
items.ex_en: The roller coaster began to gather speed as it plunged down steeply.
items.ex_zh: 过山车在沿陡坡急速俯冲时开始变得越来越快。

items.def_en: [I/T] to move faster or cause a vehicle or motion to increase its speed
items.ex_en: The express train must speed up to reach the junction on time.
items.ex_zh: 这列特快列车必须提速行驶才能按时抵达铁路枢纽。

items.def_zh: （使发动机）加速运转；（使）加速，活跃起来（常与 up 连用）
items.def_en: 1. To make an engine run quickly, or to run quickly. 2. (rev up) To become or cause something to become more active, lively, or faster.
items.ex_en: He revved the motorcycle engine loudly before speeding down the empty avenue.
items.ex_zh: 他在空旷的大街上疾驰前，猛踩油门让摩托车引擎轰鸣加速运转。

items.def_en: 1. To start to go faster, or make a vehicle go faster. 2. To happen or make something happen faster or earlier than expected.
items.ex_en: The driver pressed the pedal hard to accelerate past the slow truck.
items.ex_zh: 司机猛踩油门踏板提速超车，超过了前方行驶缓慢的卡车。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Make an engine run much faster by pressing the accelerator, or accelerate rapidly
items.ex_en: He loved to rev up his sports car at traffic lights to impress people.
items.ex_zh: 他喜欢在等红灯时猛轰跑车油门，以此吸引大家的目光。

items.def_en: (informal) to depress the accelerator pedal firmly to make a vehicle travel much faster
items.ex_en: We are running very late for the flight, so please step on it.
items.ex_zh: 我们赶飞机快要迟到了，请踩下油门开快点。

items.def_en: (informal) to push an automobile's accelerator pedal flat to the floor to accelerate at maximum power
items.ex_en: Seeing the open highway ahead, the getaway driver decided to floor it.
items.ex_zh: 看到前方空旷的公路，逃跑的司机决定将油门踩到底极速狂飙。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scale describe physical increase in the rate of motion, engine operation, or vehicular travel, progressing from slight incremental pacing to maximum engine throttle.
groups.summary_zh: 机动车或物体运行速度逐步提升乃至轰踩油门极速飞驰的动作梯度。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves transitioning from a lower rate of motion or activity to a markedly higher one, contrasting with constant high speed by emphasizing the dynamic rate of change.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为从较低速度向极高速度的动态过渡与阶跃，与持续的高速状态不同，它强调的是速率变化率（加速度）的激增过程。
groups.nuance_en: accelerate: increase physical velocity or process pace in a measurable manner (car / growth / process) · quicken: make or become faster, brisker, or more lively (pace / pulse / breath) · speed up: common phrasing for boosting pace or transit time (production / journey / recovery) · rev up: vigorously increase engine revolutions or induce heightened excitement (engine / crowd / economy) · floor it: forcefully depress an accelerator to maximum capacity (accelerator / gas / pedal)
groups.nuance_zh: accelerate: 速度或进程发生客观可测的提速 (car / growth / process) · quicken: 步伐、脉搏或生机等转向敏捷活跃 (pace / pulse / breath) · speed up: 最常用的提升日常进度或运速 (production / journey / recovery) · rev up: 猛轰油门提升转速或大幅激发亢奋状态 (engine / crowd / economy) · floor it: 将油门踏板踩到底以极速狂飙 (accelerator / gas / pedal)

groups.name: Achieve & Attain Goals · 达标与斩获 (Achieve, Attain, Reach)
groups.tip: 达到目标赢得成果

items.def_zh: 达到（协议、水平、目标阶段）
items.def_en: To get to a particular point, level, or stage over time
items.ex_en: After hours of intense negotiation, both parties finally managed to reach an agreement.
items.ex_zh: 经过数小时的激烈谈判，双方终于达成了一项协议。

items.def_zh: 赢得，获取（重大胜利、成功）
items.def_en: [I/T] To gain or achieve a major success, victory, or advantage
items.ex_en: The opposition party scored a massive political victory in the recent municipal elections.
items.ex_zh: 反对党在最近的市政选举中赢得了一场巨大的政治胜利。

items.def_zh: （经努力）实现，达到，完成；取得成功
items.def_en: To succeed in reaching a particular goal, status, or result, especially by effort or skill.
items.ex_en: Through relentless determination, she managed to achieve all her professional goals this year.
items.ex_zh: 凭借不懈的毅力，她今年成功实现了所有的职业目标。

items.def_en: To succeed in achieving something difficult or unexpected
items.ex_en: No one believed they could win the championship, but they actually pulled it off.
items.ex_zh: 没有人相信他们能赢得总冠军，但他们竟然成功做到了。

items.def_en: To achieve or record a success, win, or high score
items.ex_en: The veteran tennis player managed to notch up another impressive tournament victory yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 这位经验丰富的网球选手昨天又斩获了一场令人瞩目的锦标赛胜利。

items.def_zh: 成功赢得；摘得（奖项或胜利）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Win a prize, award, or competition successfully
items.ex_en: It was a daring speech, but she carried it off with remarkable poise.
items.ex_zh: 那是一场极具挑战的演讲，但她举止从容，完成得极为出色。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Achieve, record, or score a victory, success, or milestone
items.ex_en: The startup chalked up its first major profit after six months of operation.
items.ex_zh: 这家初创公司在运营六个月后取得了第一笔重大盈利。

items.def_zh: 达到；累积达到（某数目或里程碑）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Reach or accumulate a specific benchmark, quantity, or distance
items.ex_en: By the end of the year, our delivery van will clock up ten thousand miles.
items.ex_zh: 到今年年底，我们的送货货车行驶里程将累计达到一万英里。

items.def_en: (formal) To succeed in reaching or achieving a particular goal, standard, or age.
items.ex_en: Candidates must attain a high level of academic excellence to secure the scholarship.
items.ex_zh: 候选人必须达到极高的学业水平才能获得这项奖学金。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers reaching desired outcomes, statuses, or benchmarks through sustained effort, ability, or progress. 'Achieve' focuses on earning results through deliberate labor, while 'attain' carries a higher register emphasizing lofty status, age milestones, or ambitious targets.
groups.summary_zh: 描述凭借努力、进步或历练，成功达到预期高度、地位或目标。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves converting directed effort, ambition, or skill into concrete, measurable completions or triumphs, contrasting with mere serendipitous gain by emphasizing intentional accomplishment.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为通过目标明确的努力与技巧攻坚，将企图转化为清晰客观的战果或指标，与纯粹的机缘获益不同，它突出了目标导向的克服与兑现。
groups.nuance_en: achieve: reach a coveted goal or high standard through persistent exertion (success / goal / results) · attain: arrive at an elevated state, rank, or measurable age/level (status / age / perfection) · pull off: succeed in doing something unexpectedly difficult or precarious (deal / stunt / upset) · notch up: register or chalk up an increment in a series of victories or tallies (win / victory / points) · clock up: accumulate a substantial recorded figure over time (miles / hours / record)
groups.nuance_zh: achieve: 经持续努力终达目标或成就 (success / goal / results) · attain: 达到极高造诣、阶段、地位或指标 (status / age / perfection) · pull off: 奇迹般成功搞定险局或高难度事务 (deal / stunt / upset) · notch up: 斩获并计入一系列胜局或进球 (win / victory / points) · clock up: 随着时间累积达成庞大里程或数值 (miles / hours / record)

groups.name: Act & Execute · 执行与作为 (Act, Do, Perform)
groups.tip: 落到实处付诸行动

items.def_zh: 做，执行，实施；完成，处理；行动；（助动词）用于构成疑问、否定或强调
items.def_en: 1. To perform, execute, or carry out an action, task, or activity. 2. Used as an auxiliary verb to form questions, negatives, or to add emphasis.
items.ex_en: She promised to do all the assigned chores before leaving for the party.
items.ex_zh: 她答应在去参加派对之前做完所有分配的家务。

items.def_zh: 行动，作为；扮演，表演；起作用，见效
items.def_en: 1. To take action or perform a function. 2. To perform a role in a play, film, etc.; to behave in a specified way.
items.ex_en: The government must act immediately to prevent further economic collapse in the region.
items.ex_zh: 政府必须立即采取行动，以防止该地区经济进一步崩溃。

items.def_zh: 执行，履行，实施；表演，演出；运转，表现
items.def_en: 1. To carry out, execute, or accomplish an action, task, or duty. 2. To entertain an audience by acting, singing, dancing, or playing music.
items.ex_en: Surgeons perform complex operations under immense psychological and physical pressure every day.
items.ex_zh: 外科医生每天都在承受巨大的心理和生理压力下执行复杂的手术。

items.def_en: to carry out fully a legal instrument, order, plan, or official decision
items.ex_en: The military commander was ordered to execute the tactical plan without any delay.
items.ex_zh: 军事指挥官接到命令，必须毫不拖延地执行该战术计划。

items.def_en: to put into practice or complete a plan, order, or instruction
items.ex_en: The hospital is carrying out tests to determine the cause of the infection.
items.ex_zh: 医院正在进行检测，以查明感染原因。

items.def_en: (+ with sth) Continue an action or duty until it is fully completed
items.ex_en: Leaders must follow through with their promises if they wish to retain public trust.
items.ex_zh: 领导人若想保持公众信任，就必须贯彻落实自己的承诺。

items.def_zh: 付诸实施；贯彻实行（尤指艰难决定）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Complete a planned action or promise despite difficulties or opposition
items.ex_en: Despite her family's objections, she went through with the divorce.
items.ex_zh: 尽管家里人反对，她还是坚持办完了离婚手续。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Take action in accordance with instructions, advice, or official duty
items.ex_en: Police detectives decided to act on an anonymous tip received earlier that morning.
items.ex_zh: 警探们决定根据当天清晨收到的一条匿名线索采取行动。

items.def_en: to perform a task, duty, or responsibility that one is obligated to do
items.ex_en: The executor had a legal obligation to discharge his duties with utmost integrity.
items.ex_zh: 遗嘱执行人有法律义务以极高的诚信度履行其职责。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate taking action, carrying out tasks, or executing duties and social responsibilities. 'Do' functions as the foundational everyday verb, 'act' underlines agency and taking initiative, while 'perform' and 'execute' emphasize structured delivery or official implementation.
groups.summary_zh: 指主体采取行动、履行职责或贯彻执行具体任务及法令。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves translating intention, duty, or an abstract plan into external physical or administrative reality, contrasting with mere contemplation or passive reflex by requiring purposeful agency.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为将主观意图、命令或既定方案转化为外在实在的行为与行政落地，与空想或被动反应不同，它强调意志的见诸行动与赋形落实。
groups.nuance_en: execute: carry out a plan, legal decree, or technical design with precision (plan / order / maneuver) · carry out: general execution of tasks, research, or directives (investigation / research / duties) · perform: stage, execute, or discharge an artistic, surgical, or routine operational role (surgery / play / ritual) · act on: take concrete steps based on advice, information, or impulse (tip / information / impulse) · follow through: continue an initiated action or promise until fully consummated (swing / commitment / project)
groups.nuance_zh: execute: 精确按照计划、指令或死刑判决执行 (plan / order / maneuver) · carry out: 落实并推进具体任务、调查或职责 (investigation / research / duties) · perform: 履行职责、实施精密外科手术或登台演艺 (surgery / play / ritual) · act on: 根据掌握的情报、建议或冲动采取行动 (tip / information / impulse) · follow through: 坚持到底完成已开头的动作或承诺 (swing / commitment / project)

groups.name: Adjust by Dial & Lever · 旋钮操纵与转控 (Crank, Dial, Maneuver)
groups.tip: 按键拨动以调控机械

items.def_en: (+ sth) to reduce the setting, intensity, or level of something by turning a dial or control
items.ex_en: You need to dial down the air conditioning because the room is freezing.
items.ex_zh: 你得把空调开小一点，因为房间里冷极了。

items.def_en: (+ to sth) to change from one mechanism, channel, or setting to another using a switch or lever
items.ex_en: The hospital will switch over to a completely digital record system next month.
items.ex_zh: 下个月该医院将全面切换至数字化病历系统。

items.def_en: to turn a knob, dial, or control with a rotational hand movement
items.ex_en: He carefully twisted the volume knob until the music reached a comfortable level.
items.ex_zh: 他小心地旋动音量旋钮，直到音乐达到舒适的音量。

items.def_zh: 拨（电话号码）；（通过转盘或旋钮）调节
items.def_en: 1. To call a telephone number by pressing buttons or turning a disc; to adjust a control using a dial.
items.ex_en: She had to dial the emergency number twice because of the poor signal.
items.ex_zh: 由于信号不好，她不得不拨了两次紧急求助电话。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ between) to switch a lever or setting between two alternating states
items.ex_en: Users can toggle between light and dark modes by clicking this simple icon.
items.ex_zh: 用户只需点击这个简单的图标，即可在浅色和深色模式之间切换。

items.def_zh: 转动旋钮调高（音量、暖气等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to increase the level, volume, or setting of a mechanical or electrical control
items.ex_en: Whenever his favorite song came on, he would crank up the car radio.
items.ex_zh: 每当响起他最喜欢的歌，他就会把车载收音机的音量调大。

items.def_zh: 用曲柄转动；调大（音量等，常与up连用）
items.def_en: 1. To turn a crank handle to start or operate a machine; (crank up) to increase the volume, level, or intensity of something.
items.ex_en: He had to crank the heavy iron handle repeatedly to lift the gate.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不反复转动沉重的铁把手以抬起大门。

items.def_en: to move or actuate something using a lever or lever-like handle
items.ex_en: The technician had to lever the heavy metal switch downward to cut power.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员不得不向下扳动沉重的金属开关以切断电源。

items.def_zh: 操纵，控制；使巧妙移动；耍花招，用策略调动
items.def_en: 1. To move, guide, or manipulate skillfully; to use clever tactics or deceit to achieve a goal.
items.ex_en: The driver managed to manoeuvre the bulky truck through the narrow alleyway safely.
items.ex_zh: 司机熟练地操纵着庞大的卡车，安全穿过了狭窄的小巷。

groups.summary_en: An agent physically operates mechanical controls, dials, handles, or navigational mechanisms using specific rotational or guided manual force to adjust settings or direct movement.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过旋转旋钮、摇动手柄或技巧性拨动仪器以精准操纵机械或设备。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves manipulating mechanical dials, levers, or switches to modulate physical inputs or state variables, contrasting with continuous manual pushing by relying on fixed mechanical interfaces.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为通过旋动刻度盘、扳动操纵杆或拨动开关来渐进或分级调节设备参数，与平滑的手力推移不同，它依附于离散或受约束的机械控制界面。
groups.nuance_en: crank up: vigorously turn a handle or drastically boost volume/intensity (volume / engine / production) · dial down: rotate a control knob to reduce output or temper tension (rhetoric / intensity / volume) · toggle: switch back and forth between two distinct states using a lever or key (switch / mode / screen) · lever: use physical leverage to pry, move, or manipulate an object (lid / stone / bar) · twist: rotate manually around an axis to tighten, adjust, or loosen (cap / knob / dial)
groups.nuance_zh: crank up: 转动曲柄摇把或大幅拉满声量与产力 (volume / engine / production) · dial down: 旋转旋钮调低数值或主动缓和局势 (rhetoric / intensity / volume) · toggle: 拨动按键在两种预设状态间交替切换 (switch / mode / screen) · lever: 运用杠杆原理撬起或转动机构 (lid / stone / bar) · twist: 沿轴心拧动转盘或瓶盖以进行微调与启闭 (cap / knob / dial)

groups.name: Adjust to Environment · 适应与顺应 (Adapt, Acclimate, Adjust)
groups.tip: 逐步调整身心以融于新环境

items.def_en: to adapt or become used to a new situation or condition
items.ex_en: It took several months for the foreign exchange students to adjust to campus life.
items.ex_zh: 这些外国交换生花了几个月的时间才适应了校园生活。
items.ex2_en: The driver adjusted the rearview mirror before backing the car out of garage.
items.ex2_zh: 司机在倒车出车库前调整了后视镜。

items.def_en: 1. (+ to) To change your behavior or ideas in order to suit a new condition or environment. 2. To modify something for a new use, purpose, or medium.
items.ex_en: Animals must adapt to changing climatic patterns if they are to survive long-term.
items.ex_zh: 动物若想长期生存，就必须适应不断变化的气候模式。

items.def_zh: 使水土服从；习惯新气候
items.def_en: to accustom or become accustomed to a new climate or environment
items.ex_en: Climbers usually spend several days at base camp to acclimatize to high altitudes.
items.ex_zh: 登山者通常会在大本营停留数天，以适应高海拔气候。

items.def_en: to make accustomed to something through prolonged or frequent exposure
items.ex_en: The laboratory mice were slowly habituated to human handling over several weeks.
items.ex_zh: 经过数周时间，实验小鼠逐渐习惯了人类的抓取触摸。

items.def_en: to become familiar with and feel comfortable in a new environment, home, or job
items.ex_en: It took the new family several weeks to settle in their quiet suburban neighborhood.
items.ex_zh: 这个新家庭花了几个星期才在安静的郊区社区中安顿下来。
items.ex2_en: The nurse settled the frail patient in the comfortable armchair near the sunny window.
items.ex2_zh: 护士把体弱的病人安顿在阳光明媚的窗边那把舒适的扶手椅上。

items.def_en: (+ with sb/sth) to adapt visually or socially so as to look natural or unremarkable within surroundings
items.ex_en: The chameleon changed its skin tone to blend in with the surrounding foliage.
items.ex_zh: 变色龙改变了肤色，以便融入周围的树叶环境中。

items.def_en: (+ with sb/sth) to feel accepted and live or work harmoniously in an environment
items.ex_en: The transfer student worked hard to fit in with her new peer group.
items.ex_zh: 这名转学生努力融入她的新同龄人圈子。

items.def_en: to adapt or fit oneself to someone or something
items.ex_en: The corporation had to accommodate itself to increasingly strict environmental regulations.
items.ex_zh: 该企业不得不顺应日益严格的环保法规。

items.def_zh: 使适应，使服水土；适应新环境
items.def_en: (+ to) (chiefly North American) To adjust or adapt to a new climate, altitude, or unfamiliar environment.
items.ex_en: Athletes arrived early in Mexico City to acclimate to the thin mountain air.
items.ex_zh: 运动员们早早抵达墨西哥城，以适应稀薄的高山空气。

groups.summary_en: An entity or organism alters its behavior, physiology, or habits to fit novel conditions or climatic environments. Verbs range from broad situational modification to strict environmental acclimatization.
groups.summary_zh: 个体或系统调整内部机能或行为模式以契合新环境与新条件。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves modifying one's internal state, behavior, or physiological systems to re-establish functional harmony with an altered external milieu, contrasting with changing the environment itself.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为主动或被动调整内部生理机能、行为方式以重新与外部新环境融洽，与直接改变外部客体不同，它侧重于自身的顺应与契合。
groups.nuance_en: adapt: change structure or behavior over time to survive new conditions (species / strategy / environment) · adjust: make fine personal or mechanical calibrations to fit a new context (seat / life / expectations) · acclimatize: undergo physiological or psychological adjustment to a new climate or altitude (altitude / climate / conditions) · habituate: become gradually accustomed to a recurring stimulus through prolonged exposure (stress / noise / stimulus) · accommodate: modify beliefs or habits to align with external demands or parties (demands / needs / views)
groups.nuance_zh: adapt: 做出结构性或行为重构以适应生存条件 (species / strategy / environment) · adjust: 调整心态、细部或习惯以匹配新境遇 (seat / life / expectations) · acclimatize: 身体在气候、海拔等自然环境下的生理适应 (altitude / climate / conditions) · habituate: 因反复经受刺激而逐渐习惯或脱敏 (stress / noise / stimulus) · accommodate: 调整自我以顺应他人的利益与外部诉求 (demands / needs / views)

groups.name: Adorn with Embedded Ornaments · 镶饰与缀缀 (Stud, Jewel, Bejewel)
groups.tip: 用饰物点缀外表以增添美感

items.def_zh: 镶嵌以，缀以（宝石或金属）
items.def_en: to mount, embed, or stud precious stones or decorative metals onto a surface
items.ex_en: The ceremonial sword was delicately set with rows of tiny sparkling diamonds.
items.ex_zh: 这柄礼仪宝剑上精美地镶嵌着一排排细小的闪亮钻石。

items.def_zh: 为……加饰边，为……加穗；沿着……的边缘形成边界
items.def_en: 1. To decorate something with a fringe or decorative border. 2. To form a border or edge along something.
items.ex_en: Wild blooming lavender and tall grasses fringed both sides of the mountain path.
items.ex_zh: 盛开的野薰衣草和高高的杂草沿着山路两侧形成了边缘。

items.def_en: to decorate or furnish an object or surface elaborately with ornamental pieces
items.ex_en: The ballroom was decked out with glittering crystals and golden ribbons for tonight.
items.ex_zh: 宴会厅今晚用闪闪发光的水晶和金色丝带装点得格外华丽。

items.def_en: (often passive) To decorate or mark a surface with many small ornaments, studs, or prominent objects.
items.ex_en: The night sky was stud with countless brilliant stars across the desert horizon.
items.ex_zh: 荒漠的地平线上，无垠的夜空点缀着无数璀璨的繁星。

items.def_en: To adorn or decorate something with jewels or precious stones.
items.ex_en: The ancient monarch wore a regal crown jeweled with rare emeralds and rubies.
items.ex_zh: 这位古代君王佩戴着一顶用罕见祖母绿和红宝石装饰的华丽王冠。

items.def_zh: 缀满发光小饰物；点缀亮片
items.def_en: to cover or decorate glittering spangles, stars, or shiny ornaments across a surface
items.ex_en: Dewdrops bespangled the delicate spiderwebs hanging between the morning rose bushes.
items.ex_zh: 清晨玫瑰花丛间悬挂的精致蛛网缀满了晶莹的露珠。

items.def_zh: 嵌花；将装饰物嵌入表面
items.def_en: (+ with) to set pieces of wood, metal, or stone flush into the surface of an object
items.ex_en: The antique mahogany dining table was finely inlaid with delicate mother-of-pearl patterns.
items.ex_zh: 这张复古红木餐桌上精巧地镶嵌着精致的珍珠母图案。

items.def_zh: 缀满珠宝；用宝石华美镶嵌
items.def_en: to ornament or encrust lavishly with precious stones or jewels
items.ex_en: The queen wore an ornate silk gown bejeweled with sapphires and fine pearls.
items.ex_zh: 女王身着一件用蓝宝石和精美珍珠华丽缀饰的华美丝绸礼服。

items.def_zh: 在表面镶嵌/结上一层装饰物
items.def_en: (+ with) to cover a surface with a hard crust or dense embedded coating of jewels or decorative elements
items.ex_en: The ancient chalice was heavily encrusted with glittering rubies and raw gold filigree.
items.ex_zh: 这个古老的圣杯表面密密麻麻地镶嵌着闪烁的红宝石和原生金丝。

groups.summary_en: A craftsman or decorator embellishes a surface, garment, or object by attaching, scattering, or embedding decorative borders, raised metal studs, or glittering gems across it.
groups.summary_zh: 在器物或织物表面镶嵌宝石、布满饰钮或边缘装饰流苏。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves fixing raised, sparkling, or decorative physical items onto a base surface, contrasting with surface-level painting or dyeing by producing a tactile, composite relief.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为将凸起、璀璨或不同质地的装饰物嵌接、缀附在基底表面，与平面性的喷涂不同，它构成了富于立体触感与反光质地的复合镶嵌。
groups.nuance_en: stud: scatter solid, raised decorative nodules or points across a surface (leather / sky / belt) · inlay: embed contrasting decorative materials flush into carved recesses of a surface (ivory / wood / marble) · bejewel: profusely cover or embellish with radiant gems (crown / dress / dagger) · bespangle: cover densely with tiny glittering objects or light points (stars / sequins / sky) · fringe: decorate or border along an outer perimeter (rug / scarf / town)
groups.nuance_zh: stud: 在表面密集缀满突出的金属铆钉或凸起 (leather / sky / belt) · inlay: 将异质纹样材料严丝合缝嵌平在凹槽中 (ivory / wood / marble) · bejewel: 极其奢华地通体嵌满宝玉钻石 (crown / dress / dagger) · bespangle: 漫天洒满亮片或闪烁光斑 (stars / sequins / sky) · fringe: 沿织物或边缘缀以流苏或形成环绕饰边 (rug / scarf / town)

groups.name: Advertise & Promote · 宣传与推广
groups.tip: 商业营销炒作与公关推广

items.def_en: to actively encourage the sales, popularity, or public awareness of a product or event
items.ex_en: The company launched an aggressive marketing campaign to promote its new smartphone line.
items.ex_zh: 该公司开展了一场声势浩大的营销活动，以推广其新款智能手机系列。

items.def_en: to mention or recommend a product, book, or show publicly in an informal context
items.ex_en: The popular author appeared on the talk show to plug his latest novel.
items.ex_zh: 这位知名作家亮相脱口秀节目，为自己的最新小说做宣传。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to praise or promote something enthusiastically to generate positive public reception
items.ex_en: The company talked up the new phone, but users found it quite ordinary.
items.ex_zh: 公司对那款新手机大加吹捧，但用户发现它其实平平无奇。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to distribute and aggressively publicize commercial products or promotional material to the public
items.ex_en: The founder was gradually pushed out of the company by the board.
items.ex_zh: 创始人逐渐被董事会排挤出了公司。

items.def_zh: 虚夸宣传；过度夸大推广
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to praise or advertise something with exaggerated, boastful puffery
items.ex_en: The promoter tried to puff up the amateur boxer as an undefeated champion.
items.ex_zh: 推广人极力虚夸吹捧这位业余拳击手，称他为不败冠军。

items.def_en: (informal) To advertise or promote a product, person, or event extravagantly to create intense public excitement.
items.ex_en: Tech bloggers continue to hype the upcoming release of the revolutionary virtual headset.
items.ex_zh: 科技博主们继续大肆炒作即将发布的革命性虚拟现实头显。

items.def_en: to praise or publicize something energetically, especially to persuade people of its merit
items.ex_en: The vendor stood outside the station to tout cheap electronic accessories to commuters.
items.ex_zh: 摊贩站在车站外，向通勤者竭力兜售廉价的电子配件。

items.def_en: to make information about something widely known to the public
items.ex_en: The charity organized a marathon to publicize its global clean water initiative effectively.
items.ex_zh: 该慈善机构组织了一场马拉松，以有效地向公众宣传其全球清洁饮水计划。

items.def_zh: 为……做广告，宣传（advertise 的变体）
items.def_en: A variant spelling of advertise; to promote or publish advertisements for something.
items.ex_en: Local merchants decided to advertize their upcoming seasonal discounts in the weekend newspaper.
items.ex_zh: 当地商家决定在周末报纸上为即将到来的季节性折扣做广告宣传。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe publicizing commercial goods, services, or events to capture audience attention, stimulate demand, and persuade buyers. They vary from conventional commercial paid promotion ('advertise') to high-pressure public relations or sensational puffery ('hype', 'plug', 'tout').
groups.summary_zh: 通过媒体宣传、造势或推介来吸引受众并促进销售。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves aggressively pushing information, goods, or personalities into public consciousness through deliberate marketing or praise, contrasting with impartial factual reporting by its self-interested promotional intent.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为出于商业或声誉利益，运用传播手段与夸饰措辞将商品、议题或个人强推至公众视线，与客观中立的新闻报道不同，它带有强烈的推销与吹捧色彩。
groups.nuance_en: promote: systematically encourage the growth, awareness, or sale of something (product / brand / welfare) · plug: give an overt commercial mention or endorsement, often casually (book / film / single) · hype: stimulate public interest through exaggerated, sensational publicity (movie / match / talent) · tout: persistently and boastfully hawk or recommend something's merits (shares / benefits / credentials) · publicize: draw public or media attention to an event or fact (trial / findings / event)
groups.nuance_zh: promote: 系统化地促进品牌的知晓度、销售或发展 (product / brand / welfare) · plug: 在访谈等场合顺带见缝插针推介某作品 (book / film / single) · hype: 通过噱头或过度包装进行大肆炒作 (movie / match / talent) · tout: 极力标榜、招徕吹捧某物的过人长处 (shares / benefits / credentials) · publicize: 面向公众与媒体广泛发布并公开引流 (trial / findings / event)

groups.name: Advocate & Champion · 倡导支持与助力 (Espouse, Champion, Abet)
groups.tip: 从政见认同拥护到合谋协助服务

items.def_en: to give financial, material, or moral support to a person, plan, or campaign
items.ex_en: Several prominent business leaders agreed to back the mayor's ambitious transit expansion plan.
items.ex_zh: 几位杰出的商界领袖同意支持市长雄心勃勃的交通扩张计划。

items.def_en: to vigorously fight for, promote, or defend a cause, idea, or principle
items.ex_en: The retired judge continued to champion civil liberties and judicial independence throughout retirement.
items.ex_zh: 这位退休法官在整个退休期间继续积极捍卫公民自由和司法独立。

items.def_en: to accept, support, or tolerate a particular practice or proposal
items.ex_en: The conservative board refused to countenance such radical revisions to the company policies.
items.ex_zh: 保守的董事会拒绝赞同对公司政策进行如此激进的修改。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to support, advocate, or publicly defend a person, right, or cause
items.ex_en: It is essential to stand up for your beliefs even when others disagree.
items.ex_zh: 即使别人不同意，也要勇于捍卫自己的信念。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to state your support or advocacy publicly for someone or their cause
items.ex_en: Several colleagues chose to speak up for her during the tense internal investigation.
items.ex_zh: 在紧张的内部调查期间，几位同事选择站出来为她公开发言辩护。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to defend or champion someone or their principles when they are criticized
items.ex_en: True friends will always stick up for you whenever unfair rumors circulate around.
items.ex_zh: 无论何时周围流传不公正的谣言，真正的朋友都会坚定地维护你。

items.def_zh: 支持，拥护（观点、信条等）；嫁，娶
items.def_en: 1. To give support to a belief, cause, or way of life; (archaic) to marry.
items.ex_en: The university professor continued to espouse the core values of democratic socialism.
items.ex_zh: 这位大学教授继续公开拥护民主社会主义的核心价值观。

items.def_en: 1. (usually in 'aid and abet') To encourage, assist, or support someone in committing a crime or wrongdoing.
items.ex_en: He was convicted of attempting to aid and abet a federal prison escape.
items.ex_zh: 他因企图协助和唆使联邦监狱越狱而被定罪。

items.def_zh: 当球童，为高尔夫球手当球童
items.def_en: 1. To work as a caddy carrying a golfer's clubs and giving advice during a round.
items.ex_en: He worked weekends to caddy for wealthy club members across eighteen holes.
items.ex_zh: 他周末去打工，在18洞的高尔夫球场上为富有的俱乐部会员当球童。

groups.summary_en: Social and collaborative alignment where an agent endorses, champions, or actively facilitates another party's doctrines, enterprises, or illicit schemes.
groups.summary_zh: 指在思想、立场上拥护倡导，或在行动上作为同谋/助手给予协助支持。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves publicly endorsing, defending, or vigorously advancing a cause, doctrine, or vulnerable party against opposition, contrasting with neutral observation by its militant, committed solidarity.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为挺身而出公开站队、极力申辩或不遗余力地支持某种主张或弱势群体，与中立旁观不同，它具有鲜明的立场认同与担责斗争性。
groups.nuance_en: champion: vigorously fight for or defend a cause or marginalized group (cause / rights / underdog) · espouse: publicly adopt, embrace, and declare belief in a doctrine or cause (doctrine / ideology / theory) · back: provide essential financial, political, or moral reinforcement (candidate / venture / proposal) · stand up for: actively resist opposition to defend rights, principles, or an individual (principles / rights / friends) · abet: encourage or assist another, particularly in doing wrong (crime / offender / rebellion)
groups.nuance_zh: champion: 以斗士之姿挺身为某种权益或弱势群体争辩 (cause / rights / underdog) · espouse: 正式且公开地接纳、奉行并宣扬某主义或信条 (doctrine / ideology / theory) · back: 提供财力、政治资本或精神上的实质背书 (candidate / venture / proposal) · stand up for: 不畏强权勇于站出来捍卫原则或护短 (principles / rights / friends) · abet: 纵容、教唆或协同他人违法作乱 (crime / offender / rebellion)

groups.name: Agile & Sudden Rapid Motion · 飞奔与疾闪 (Dart, Zoom, Dash)
groups.tip: 极速移动呼啸而过

items.def_en: to move quickly with short, rapid steps like a small animal
items.ex_en: Mice scurry across the kitchen floor the moment the lights are switched off.
items.ex_zh: 灯一关，老鼠就碎步急跑穿过厨房地板。

items.def_en: to move swiftly, lightly, and somewhat erratically from place to place
items.ex_en: Bright yellow butterflies flit gracefully among the blooming flowers in the sunny garden.
items.ex_zh: 明黄色的蝴蝶在阳光明媚的花园中盛开的花丛间轻巧地掠过。

items.def_en: to move abruptly, suddenly, and rapidly outwards from a concealed or stationary position
items.ex_en: A frightened squirrel darted out from the thick bushes directly onto the sidewalk.
items.ex_zh: 一只受惊的松鼠突然从茂密的灌木丛中迅猛冲到了人行道上。

items.def_en: (+ into/out of) to run suddenly and rapidly over a short distance
items.ex_en: He had to dash into the convenience store to grab an umbrella quickly.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不急匆匆猛冲进便利店快速买一把伞。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to move past someone or something with extremely high speed and suddenness
items.ex_en: A speeding sports motorcycle shot past our stationary car on the narrow highway.
items.ex_zh: 一辆超速行驶的运动摩托车在狭窄的高速公路上从我们静止的车旁飞驰而过。

items.def_en: to leave or dash away suddenly and with great speed
items.ex_en: The terrified suspect tore off down the alley before the police could intervene.
items.ex_zh: 在警察来得及干预之前，吓坏了的嫌疑人猛冲疾奔溜进了小巷。

items.def_en: (+ past/across) to move at tremendous speed leaving an impression of a streak
items.ex_en: Bright shooting stars streak across the clear midnight sky during the meteor shower.
items.ex_zh: 流星雨期间，明亮的流星划破晴朗的午夜天空，飞掠成线。

items.def_zh: 飞驰，极速移动；（镜头）变焦，急速拉近或推远
items.def_en: 1. To move or travel very fast, often with a loud humming noise. 2. (zoom in/out) To adjust a camera lens or digital view so a subject appears much closer or farther away.
items.ex_en: The sports car zoomed past us on the highway with an ear-splitting roar.
items.ex_zh: 那辆跑车伴着震耳欲聋的轰鸣声在公路上从我们身旁飞驰而过。

items.def_zh: 飞奔，猛冲，疾驰；飞快地投向（目光等）
items.def_en: 1. To move suddenly and very quickly in a particular direction. 2. To cast a quick, sharp glance or look at someone.
items.ex_en: A frightened rabbit darted across the narrow dirt road and vanished into the bushes.
items.ex_zh: 一只受惊的野兔猛冲过狭窄的土路，消失在灌木丛中。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this manner frame highlight sudden acceleration, lightness, or sharp changes of direction, contrasting rapid straight-line bursts with abrupt, evasive leaps.
groups.summary_zh: 强调步伐敏捷轻快、方向突然转换或骤然提速飞奔的运动方式。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves executing an abrupt, lightweight, and exceptionally rapid motion along a short or focused trajectory, contrasting with steady running or lumbering transit by its erratic velocity and swift evasion.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为突发、轻巧且瞬时爆发的短距离变向或极速穿梭，与平稳的长跑或笨重位移不同，它强调的是电光石火般的机动敏捷性与突发性。
groups.nuance_en: dart: move suddenly, swiftly, and sharply in an unexpected direction (glance / fish / tongue) · dash: sprint violently and precipitously over a short distance (room / door / street) · zoom: move with extreme rapid speed, often accompanied by an engine hum (car / drone / camera) · streak: flash past at immense velocity leaving an apparent blur or trail (meteor / runner / across) · flit: move lightly, swiftly, and erratically from one station to another (butterfly / shadow / bird)
groups.nuance_zh: dart: 如箭般猛然敏捷蹿出或闪烁 (glance / fish / tongue) · dash: 因紧急情况短距离急奔狂冲 (room / door / street) · zoom: 极速呼啸掠过或镜头瞬间拉近 (car / drone / camera) · streak: 宛如流光般一闪而过留下残影 (meteor / runner / across) · flit: 极其轻盈飘忽地在各处穿梭游移 (butterfly / shadow / bird)

groups.name: Agree & Concur · 意见一致与赞同 (Agree, Concur, Assent)
groups.tip: 表达赞成认同并达成一致

items.def_zh: 赞同，同意；意见一致；商定
items.def_en: 1. To have the same opinion as someone else. 2. To say yes to a suggestion, request, or proposal; to accept or arrange.
items.ex_en: Both parties agreed to the proposed terms and signed the contract yesterday morning.
items.ex_zh: 双方昨天上午都同意了拟定的条款并签署了合同。

items.def_en: (+ with/on) to share the same views and agree fully with someone
items.ex_en: My brother and I rarely see eye to eye on family financial matters.
items.ex_zh: 我和弟弟在家庭财务问题上很少能看法一致。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to agree with or accept a decision, opinion, or proposal
items.ex_en: I don't entirely agree, but I'll go along with the majority's decision.
items.ex_zh: 我并不完全赞同，但我会服从多数人的决定。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to align oneself with and support one person or party in a dispute
items.ex_en: The judge ultimately sided with the defense and dismissed the charges.
items.ex_zh: 法官最终支持了辩方的意见，驳回了指控。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to accept and agree with someone's plan, opinion, or suggestion
items.ex_en: The committee readily fell in with the chairperson's suggestion to postpone the vote.
items.ex_zh: 委员会欣然赞成了主席推迟表决的建议。

items.def_en: (+ to) to agree with or support an opinion, belief, or theory
items.ex_en: Few modern economists subscribe to that outdated theory of market equilibrium.
items.ex_zh: 很少有现代经济学家赞同那种过时的市场均衡理论。

items.def_en: (formal) 1. To agree with someone or share an opinion. 2. To happen at the same time; coincide.
items.ex_en: Several prominent scientists concurred with the findings published in the medical journal.
items.ex_zh: 数位著名科学家赞同发表在该医学期刊上的研究结果。

items.def_en: (+ to) to officially or formally express agreement with a plan, request, or proposal
items.ex_en: The shareholders formally assented to the merger proposal after a lengthy discussion.
items.ex_zh: 经过长时间的讨论，股东们正式批准了合并提案。

items.def_en: (+ to) to agree to a demand, request, or proposal, especially after initial reluctance
items.ex_en: The management finally acceded to the union's demands for safer working conditions.
items.ex_zh: 管理层最终答应了工会关于改善工作安全条件的要求。

groups.summary_en: Speakers express mutual consensus or align with another party's judgment, proposal, or conclusion. Verbs range from general conversational agreement ('agree') to formal, institutional, or deliberative harmony ('concur', 'assent', 'subscribe').
groups.summary_zh: 表达意见一致、赞成提议或在立场与结论上形成共识，涵盖日常赞同与正式决议。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves synchronizing subjective views, ethical judgments, or formal wills with another party, contrasting with enforced obedience by being an autonomous convergence of perspective.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为主体间在看法、道德判断或裁决上达成自愿的心智同步与共鸣，与被动屈从不同，它属于自主立场的契合与会聚。
groups.nuance_en: agree: reach a shared opinion or consensus with another (terms / principle / decision) · concur: formally share the same opinion or arrive at a concurrent finding (opinion / court / finding) · assent: express official or formal compliance with a proposal or request (proposal / bill / request) · side with: actively align with one faction or viewpoint in a dispute (plaintiff / faction / winner) · see eye to eye: share an intuitive, mutual accord on viewpoints (colleagues / issues / partner)
groups.nuance_zh: agree: 观点自然相同或就事项达成协议 (terms / principle / decision) · concur: 经独立判断后得出与他方相符的正式共识 (opinion / court / finding) · assent: 对提议或法案表示赞许、认可或恩准 (proposal / bill / request) · side with: 在论战中倒向并支持某一方 (plaintiff / faction / winner) · see eye to eye: 两人在深层看法与价值观上高度一致 (colleagues / issues / partner)

groups.name: Allocate & Earmark · 划拨与指派 (Allot, Earmark, Apportion)
groups.tip: 把特定份额指派给各方

items.def_en: to formally set aside money for a specific official purpose through legislation or committee action
items.ex_en: Congress voted to appropriate fifty million dollars for regional flood control projects.
items.ex_zh: 国会投票决定拨出五千万美元专款用于区域防洪工程。

items.def_en: to give a specific task, role, or asset to someone
items.ex_en: The manager assigned the most challenging marketing campaign to her top strategist.
items.ex_zh: 经理把最具挑战性的营销活动指派给了她的首席策划师。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to reserve or earmark an amount of money, time, or supplies for a particular purpose
items.ex_en: We should set aside extra funds each month for unexpected home repairs.
items.ex_zh: 我们每月应该留出额外资金以应对突发的房屋维修。

items.def_zh: 划拨出；分出（资金或份额）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to allocate or set aside a portion of resources or a budget specifically from a larger pool
items.ex_en: The agency carved out a portion of its annual budget for employee training.
items.ex_zh: 该机构从年度预算中划拨出了一部分用于员工培训。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to distribute, allocate, or hand out resources or tasks among people
items.ex_en: The supervisor dished out the remaining shifts without asking for our preferences.
items.ex_zh: 主管根本没问我们的偏好，就分派了剩下的班次。

items.def_en: to designate officially that an amount of money or resources should be used for a particular purpose
items.ex_en: The city council allocated significant municipal resources to the renewable energy initiative.
items.ex_zh: 市议会将大笔市政资源划拨给了可再生能源项目。

items.def_en: To give or assign a particular share of time, money, space, or tasks to someone or for a purpose.
items.ex_en: The conference organizers allotted fifteen minutes to each speaker for questions.
items.ex_zh: 会议组织者为每位发言者分配了十五分钟的提问时间。

items.def_zh: 指定……作特定用途，拨出（款项等）；在（牲畜）耳朵上打记号
items.def_en: 1. To designate or set aside funds, resources, or time for a specific purpose. 2. To mark the ear of an animal to identify ownership.
items.ex_en: The state legislature earmarked twenty million dollars exclusively for bridge repairs.
items.ex_zh: 州立法机构专门拨出两千万美元用于桥梁维修。

items.def_en: to divide resources, responsibilities, or blame among a group according to a calculated plan
items.ex_en: The court apportioned the accident damages equally between the two negligent drivers.
items.ex_zh: 法院将事故赔偿金平摊给了两名有过失的司机。

groups.summary_en: An authoritative source sets aside or distributes money, resources, or duties for a designated recipient or specific purpose. Register ranges from official institutional designation to exact mathematical rationing.
groups.summary_zh: 机构或当局将资金、配额或资源按规定划拨、指派或专款专用。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves intentionally partitioning an aggregate pool of resources and assigning specific subsets to designated uses or beneficiaries, contrasting with haphazard dispersal by its regulated, bounded division.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为对整宗资源总量进行按规划分，并专款专用或按额定配给指定对象，与杂乱分配不同，它具有严格的限额与针对性。
groups.nuance_en: allocate: officially distribute a designated share of resources for a specified goal (funds / resources / time) · earmark: designate or reserve specific assets exclusively for a singular purpose (funds / grant / tax) · assign: delegate a concrete task, post, or property to a specific agent (task / role / seat) · allot: measure out and dispense a limited entitlement or quota among claimants (quota / shares / time) · appropriate: legislatively set aside public money for authorized spending (funds / budget / sum)
groups.nuance_zh: allocate: 官方经研判后按配额划拨资产或时间 (funds / resources / time) · earmark: 特殊指定某笔资金只能专项专用于特定项目 (funds / grant / tax) · assign: 将特定任务、配额或所有权派发给具体对象 (task / role / seat) · allot: 将有限名额或份额公平分配给各方 (quota / shares / time) · appropriate: 经议会或预算机关法定拨款供政府使用 (funds / budget / sum)

groups.name: Amputate & Excise · 截肢与外科切除 (Amputate, Excise, Resect)
groups.tip: 外科手术割除特定组织

items.def_en: to remove a tumor, organ, or eyeball cleanly from its surrounding capsule or socket
items.ex_en: The surgeon deftly enucleated the fibrous tumor without rupturing its delicate capsule.
items.ex_zh: 外科医生娴熟地将纤维瘤自其包膜中完整摘除，未发生破裂。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to sever or surgically remove an anatomical limb or growth from the body
items.ex_en: Heavy snow cut off several remote villages for days.
items.ex_zh: 大雪将几个偏远村庄阻隔了数天之久。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to surgically amputate or remove a diseased limb or body part
items.ex_en: Doctors decided to take off the patient's severely infected left toe.
items.ex_zh: 医生们决定切除该患者严重感染的左脚趾。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to surgically excise an organ, growth, or diseased tissue from the body
items.ex_en: He decided to cut out caffeine completely to improve his sleep.
items.ex_zh: 为了改善睡眠，他决定彻底戒掉咖啡因。

items.def_en: to surgically cut out an organ, tumor, or tissue sample from the body
items.ex_en: The specialist successfully excised the malignant growth during a three-hour procedure.
items.ex_zh: 专家在历时三小时的手术中成功切除了恶性肿瘤。

items.def_en: To cut off an arm, leg, finger, or toe by surgical operation.
items.ex_en: Surgeons were forced to amputate his crushed leg to save his life.
items.ex_zh: 为了保住他的性命，外科医生不得不截除了他被压碎的腿。

items.def_en: To cut off the foreskin of a male, typically for medical reasons or as a religious rite.
items.ex_en: The doctor circumcised the healthy infant according to traditional religious customs.
items.ex_zh: 医生按照传统宗教习俗为这个健康的男婴施行了割礼。

items.def_en: to surgically excise and completely eradicate a diseased organ or pathological structure
items.ex_en: The surgical team resolved to extirpate the deep-seated malignancy entirely.
items.ex_zh: 手术团队决心将那处深部恶性病变彻底根除。

items.def_en: to surgically remove a portion of an organ, bone, or other body structure
items.ex_en: The clinical team planned to resect a small diseased section of the intestine.
items.ex_zh: 临床团队计划切除该患者一小段发生病变的肠道。

groups.summary_en: A medical professional surgically removes a diseased limb, organ, growth, or anatomical tissue from a living patient.
groups.summary_zh: 外科手术中切除病变肢体、组织、器官或增生物。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves the deliberate surgical or physical removal of a body part, diseased tissue, or organ, contrasting with accidental severance or blunt injury by being an intentional, clinical intervention.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为出于医学救治或病理清除需要，使用外科手段严谨地切断、挖除身体器官或病变组织，与外伤撕脱不同，它属于受控的手术切除。
groups.nuance_en: amputate: surgically sever an entire limb or digit from the body (leg / arm / limb) · excise: surgically cut out a tumor, lesion, or specific piece of tissue cleanly (tumor / tissue / lesion) · cut off: broadly remove by severance either surgically or violently (circulation / limb / supply) · extirpate: surgically root out or entirely destroy an organ, tissue, or diseased growth (tumor / organ / pest) · circumcise: surgically excise the foreskin or prepuce (infant / boy / male)
groups.nuance_zh: amputate: 外科手术切除全部肢体或指趾 (leg / arm / limb) · excise: 整块精准切除体内肿瘤或病变软组织 (tumor / tissue / lesion) · cut off: 截断、切断供血通路或肢体 (circulation / limb / supply) · extirpate: 斩草除根般地将病变脏器或异物根除 (tumor / organ / pest) · circumcise: 环切切除包皮 (infant / boy / male)

groups.name: Annotate & Expound Texts · 注释、阐发与诠释 (Annotate, Commentate, Paraphrase)
groups.tip: 解释原因由来说明事实真相

items.def_en: 1. (+ for) To explain the cause or reason of something, or give an explanation of what happened. 2. (+ for) To form or make up a specified proportion or amount.
items.ex_en: The finance director struggled to account for the sudden shortfall in quarterly revenue.
items.ex_zh: 财务主管难以解释季度营收突然出现亏空的原因。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to explain something in a very clear, explicit, and detailed manner
items.ex_en: You don't need to spell out every detail; we get the general idea.
items.ex_zh: 你不需要把每个细节都阐释得那么细，我们明白大意。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to add more details, explanation, or substance to a text or idea
items.ex_en: The novelist spent months fleshing out the preliminary draft of the opening chapter.
items.ex_zh: 小说家花了数月时间来充实开头章节的初步草稿。

items.def_en: to provide a brief explanatory note or definition for a difficult word or phrase in a text
items.ex_en: The editor glossed several archaic idioms in the margins of the manuscript.
items.ex_zh: 编辑在手稿的页边空白处注释了几个古语成语。

items.def_zh: 意译，释义，用别的话改述
items.def_en: 1. To express the meaning of something written or spoken using different words, especially to make it easier to understand.
items.ex_en: Students were instructed to paraphrase the author's central thesis in simple words.
items.ex_zh: 学生们被要求用浅显的语言改述作者的核心论点。

items.def_en: 1. To add explanatory notes or comments to a book, text, or drawing.
items.ex_en: The scholar carefully annotated the medieval manuscript with extensive historical commentary.
items.ex_zh: 学者对这份中世纪手稿进行了细致的注释，并附上了大量历史评注。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ on) to present and explain a theory, belief, or doctrine systematically and thoroughly
items.ex_en: The professor expounded on Kant's moral philosophy during the two-hour lecture.
items.ex_zh: 教授在两小时的讲座中系统阐述了康德的道德哲学。

items.def_en: 1. (+ on) To provide a spoken running commentary and analysis on a sports event or public occasion, especially for television or radio.
items.ex_en: A veteran journalist was hired to commentate on the national championship game.
items.ex_zh: 一位资深记者受聘对全国锦标赛进行了实况解说。

items.def_zh: 详尽剖析，阐释（理论、文本）
items.def_en: to explain, interpret, and unfold the meaning of a complex text or principle in detail
items.ex_en: The critic sought to explicate the dense symbolism within the modern poem.
items.ex_zh: 批评家试图详尽剖析这首现代诗中密集的象征意象。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this communicative frame denote analyzing, rewording, or providing explanatory critical commentary on written texts, events, or data to make their meaning transparent to an audience.
groups.summary_zh: 指对文本或事件进行意译、添加注释、解读分析或阐明原委。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves expanding upon, clarifying, or critically glossing an existing text through external interpretive prose, contrasting with pure translation or summarizing by adding analytical depth or semantic context.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为在既有文本框架下，增添旁注、考据或深度理论阐述以帮助解读，与原样直译或精简摘要不同，它侧重于释义的深化与背景拆解。
groups.nuance_en: annotate: add critical, explanatory notes or citations directly to a text (text / edition / manuscript) · expound: present and explain a theory, doctrine, or complex text systematically and in detail (doctrine / view / theory) · paraphrase: restate an original passage using different words to achieve clarity (passage / author / quote) · gloss: provide brief marginal explanations for difficult words, or explain away flaws (word / text / over) · commentate: provide live descriptive or analytical commentary upon a text or event (match / text / proceedings)
groups.nuance_zh: annotate: 为底本添加考订批注、引证或校勘 (text / edition / manuscript) · expound: 体系化、逻辑严密地深入阐述大经大法或理论 (doctrine / view / theory) · paraphrase: 换用浅近直白的另一套词语重述原义 (passage / author / quote) · gloss: 作简要训诂释词，或轻描淡写地掩饰瑕疵 (word / text / over) · commentate: 对文本或进行中的实况赛事进行同步点评 (match / text / proceedings)

groups.name: Anticipate & Await · 期待与预见 (Anticipate, Await, Foresee)
groups.tip: 预见可能情况并提早准备

items.def_en: to await an upcoming event with eager pleasure and anticipation
items.ex_en: We are all looking forward to our annual summer vacation.
items.ex_zh: 我们大家都十分期盼一年一度的暑假。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to await an expected outcome or decision before proceeding
items.ex_en: The research team must wait on the ethics committee's final approval before starting.
items.ex_zh: 研究团队在启动前必须等候伦理委员会的最终批复。

items.def_en: to regard something as likely to happen
items.ex_en: Meteorologists expect heavy snowfall across the northern regions throughout this weekend.
items.ex_zh: 气象学家预计本周末北部地区将普降大雪。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to expect something to happen with high confidence and base plans on it
items.ex_en: I wouldn't bank on getting a promotion this year given the company's financial state.
items.ex_zh: 考虑到公司的财务状况，我不会指望今年能获得晋升。

items.def_zh: 预备防范；为……做好心理准备
items.def_en: (+ sth) to prepare cognitively or physically for an impending, typically unpleasant event
items.ex_en: Coastal communities are bracing for severe flooding as the hurricane approaches.
items.ex_zh: 随着飓风逼近，沿海社区正严阵以待防范严重洪灾。

items.def_zh: 预料，预期；期望，盼望；先于……行动
items.def_en: 1. To expect something to happen and prepare for it. 2. To look forward to something with pleasure.
items.ex_en: The company anticipated supply chain disruptions and secured alternative component vendors.
items.ex_zh: 公司预料到了供应链中断的可能，并锁定了替代零部件供应商。

items.def_zh: 等待，期待；将降临于，在等待着
items.def_en: 1. To wait for something or someone. 2. To be in store for or about to happen to someone.
items.ex_en: An enthusiastic crowd eagerly awaited the arrival of the foreign delegation.
items.ex_zh: 热情的群众急切地等待着外国代表团的到来。

items.def_en: to contemplate or visualize as a future possibility
items.ex_en: Urban planners envisage a carbon-neutral public transport system by the next decade.
items.ex_zh: 城市规划者设想到下一个十年实现碳中和的公共交通系统。

items.def_en: to be aware of or realize beforehand that something will happen
items.ex_en: None of the market analysts could foresee the abrupt collapse of the bank.
items.ex_zh: 没有任何市场分析师能够预见到这家银行的突然倒闭。

groups.summary_en: An agent cognitively looks forward to a prospective future event, whether bracing for it practically, waiting with expectancy, or envisaging its unfolding.
groups.summary_zh: 对即将到来的事件保持心理期待、提前预想或准备。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves projecting consciousness forward onto an upcoming event while adjusting internal preparedness, contrasting with spontaneous reaction by its predictive temporal orientation.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为意识提前投向尚未发生的未来时点，并据此调控期待心理或备战措施，与事发后的应激反应不同，它带有鲜明的时间前瞻性。
groups.nuance_en: anticipate: foresee an event and take proactive mental or practical measures (needs / backlash / trouble) · await: wait expectantly for an impending event or outcome with patience (verdict / arrival / fate) · expect: believe with high probability that something will arrive or transpire (guests / delivery / change) · brace for: steel oneself physically or mentally to withstand an impending impact (impact / storm / shock) · look forward to: eagerly anticipate a future occasion with genuine pleasure (vacation / reunion / weekend)
groups.nuance_zh: anticipate: 预见到来势并提前采取应对或布局 (needs / backlash / trouble) · await: 静观、等候某一判决或结局的降临 (verdict / arrival / fate) · expect: 基于大概率推断某事某人理当发生或到来 (guests / delivery / change) · brace for: 咬紧牙关做好迎击风暴或沉重打击的心理准备 (impact / storm / shock) · look forward to: 满怀欣喜与愉悦之情翘首以盼 (vacation / reunion / weekend)

groups.name: Apportion & Regulate Distribution · 配额与配给分发 (Ration, Dispense, Syndicate)
groups.tip: 按规则分发物资或配额

items.def_en: to distribute food, money, or supplies in strict, often begrudging or limited quantities
items.ex_en: The clerk doled out tiny portions of soup to the weary survivors.
items.ex_zh: 店员把少得可怜的热汤微量分发给疲惫的幸存者。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to divide something into shares or portions and distribute them
items.ex_en: The volunteer portioned out the remaining bread loaves equally among the families.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者把剩下的几条面包按份额平均分发给各个家庭。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to carefully administer or give out measured amounts of something
items.ex_en: The administrator metered out the scarce medical supplies strictly according to urgency.
items.ex_zh: 管理人员严格按照紧急程度定量配发紧缺的医疗物资。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to divide something into smaller parts or portions and allocate them to different recipients
items.ex_en: The elderly farmer parceled out his remaining acreage among his three children.
items.ex_zh: 这位年迈的农夫将剩下的土地分摊给了他的三个孩子。

items.def_en: to officially designate or set apart a specific share of resources for a defined purpose
items.ex_en: The federal agency allocated fuel quotas to regional distribution hubs nationwide.
items.ex_zh: 联邦机构向全国各区域配送枢纽划拨了燃油配额。

items.def_zh: （通过辛迪加组织向多家媒体）联合分发，同时出售；组成辛迪加
items.def_en: To sell articles, television programmes, or photographs to many different newspapers or broadcasters simultaneously.
items.ex_en: The independent agency syndicates weekly feature columns to dozens of regional newspapers.
items.ex_zh: 该独立机构每周向数十家地方报纸联合分发专栏特稿。

items.def_zh: 配给，定量供应；按配额分发
items.def_en: To limit the amount of food, fuel, or supplies each person is allowed to receive during a shortage.
items.ex_en: During the drought, the local authorities rationed potable water strictly to households.
items.ex_zh: 干旱期间，地方当局对各家各户的饮用水进行了严格的配额供应。

items.def_zh: 分发，分配；配药；施予；（dispense with）省去，免除
items.def_en: 1. To distribute or give out supplies, medicine, or justice to people. 2. ('dispense with') To manage without or get rid of something.
items.ex_en: The field clinic dispensed emergency antibiotics to hundreds of displaced refugees.
items.ex_zh: 战地诊所向数百名流离失所的难民分发了应急抗生素。

items.def_en: to assign a fixed portion, quota, or share of something to a designated recipient
items.ex_en: The commission allotted specific fishing quotas to each commercial maritime vessel.
items.ex_zh: 委员会向每艘商用渔船分配了具体的捕捞配额。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve the systematic division and allocation of commodities, funds, or broadcast rights according to institutional quotas, mechanical controls, or contractual licensing.
groups.summary_zh: 依定量配额、特定机制或商业授权进行控制性分发与划拨。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the measured, regulated partitioning and dispensing of limited resources, differing from generic 'distribute' or 'give' through strict quantitative limits, systematic division, or cautious stinting.
groups.desc_zh: 指对有限资源进行有度量、受管制的配额划分与分发，与普通的“分发/给予”相比，强调严格的数量限制、系统性分割或刻意节制。
groups.nuance_en: allocate: formal administrative assignment of shares (budget / funds / resources) · ration: strictly restrict and apportion scarce goods (fuel / food / water) · dole out: grudging or meager distribution of small amounts (aid / cash / advice) · parcel out: divide land or portions among several recipients (land / territory / duties) · dispense: systematic or authoritative distribution (justice / medicine / permits)
groups.nuance_zh: allocate: 官方正式的预算或资源划拨 (budget / funds / resources) · ration: 战时或匮乏时的严苛配给管制 (fuel / food / water) · dole out: 少量、吝啬或施舍般发放 (aid / cash / advice) · parcel out: 瓜分或划片分发大块整体 (land / territory / duties) · dispense: 制度化、权威性地配发或施予 (justice / medicine / permits)

groups.name: Argue & Dispute by Manner · 争吵与辩驳 (Quibble, Bicker, Debate)
groups.tip: 唇枪舌剑、为琐事吵闹或正式辩论

items.def_en: To argue with someone about petty or unimportant things.
items.ex_en: The two roommates constantly bicker over trivial household chores like doing dishes.
items.ex_zh: 那两个室友经常为洗碗这类琐碎的家务事斗嘴。

items.def_en: to argue noisily about something that is not important
items.ex_en: The children squabbled loudly over whose turn it was to play the video game.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们大声争吵着轮到谁玩电子游戏。

items.def_zh: 吹毛求疵，为微不足道的小事争辩；诡辩
items.def_en: To argue, complain, or make trivial objections about minor, unimportant details.
items.ex_en: The lawyers quibbled for hours over minor phrasing details in the agreement.
items.ex_zh: 律师们为了协议中细枝末节的措辞问题争辩了数小时。

items.def_en: to engage in a quarrel or dispute and damage a relationship as a result
items.ex_en: The two business partners fell out over money and dissolved their firm.
items.ex_zh: 那两位商业合伙人因钱财问题彻底吵翻，并解散了公司。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to engage in a minor, irritable argument, spat, or squabble with someone
items.ex_en: He frequently scraps with his younger brother over trivial remote control privileges.
items.ex_zh: 他经常为了遥控器的使用权这种琐事与弟弟拌嘴。

items.def_en: 1. To discuss or argue a subject in a formal manner. 2. To consider or ponder something carefully.
items.ex_en: Lawmakers debated the contentious environmental policy late into the evening.
items.ex_zh: 议员们就这项备受争议的环境政策一直辩论到深夜。

items.def_en: to argue with someone in a sharp but often friendly or testing manner
items.ex_en: The rival candidates sparred verbally over tax cuts during the televised debate.
items.ex_zh: 竞争对手在电视辩论中就减税议题展开了唇枪舌剑。

items.def_en: to discuss or argue about a disagreement openly and completely with someone to resolve it
items.ex_en: I finally decided to have it out with my roommate about the unpaid bills.
items.ex_zh: 我最终决定就未缴账单的事情与室友彻底摊牌争辩清楚。

items.def_en: [I/T] to argue against or formally question the truth or validity of a statement
items.ex_en: The defense attorney disputed the validity of the forensic evidence presented in court.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师对法庭上出示的法医证据的有效性提出了辩驳。

groups.summary_en: Participants engage in verbal opposition, ranging from petty, irritable bickering over trifles to structured, formal forensic debate.
groups.summary_zh: 从为细枝末节琐碎争吵，到严肃、规范地展开辩论交锋。
groups.desc_en: Covers disputatious exchanges categorized by interpersonal friction, petty focus, or sparring format, distinguishing itself from constructive 'discuss' by emotional irritation, triviality, or confrontation.
groups.desc_zh: 涵盖因人际摩擦、琐碎焦点或对攻形态展开的争吵辩驳，与建设性的“讨论”不同，带有明显的烦躁情绪、鸡毛蒜皮或对抗性。
groups.nuance_en: bicker: petulant, persistent wrangling over trivialities (siblings / spouses / details) · squabble: noisy, petty, often public spat (politicians / neighbors / turf) · quibble: nitpick tiny flaws to avoid the main point (definitions / terms / wording) · spar: exchange brisk blows or verbal jabs playfully or experimentally (rivals / reporters / opponents) · debate: formal or structured contest of arguments (motion / policy / bill)
groups.nuance_zh: bicker: 为鸡毛蒜皮持续闹别扭斗嘴 (siblings / spouses / details) · squabble: 吵闹、失态的琐事口角或争夺 (politicians / neighbors / turf) · quibble: 吹毛求疵、抓字眼逃避核心 (definitions / terms / wording) · spar: 试探性或半开玩笑的口头交锋 (rivals / reporters / opponents) · debate: 正式有序的论辩与政策辩论 (motion / policy / bill)

groups.name: Arrange & Align · 排列与对齐 (Geometric Placement & Alignment)
groups.tip: 校准位置使其整齐排成行

items.def_en: (+ sth) to arrange objects in a straight row or ensure they are properly aligned
items.ex_en: Please line up these folding chairs neatly along the back wall of the hall.
items.ex_zh: 请把这些折叠椅沿着大厅后墙整齐地排成一行。
items.ex2_en: The planets will line up directly across the night sky early tomorrow morning.
items.ex2_zh: 明晨清早，行星将在夜空中径直排列成一条线。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to align something so its edges, corners, or surfaces form right angles or sit evenly
items.ex_en: The carpenter squared up the wooden picture frame before driving in the nails.
items.ex_zh: 木匠在钉钉子之前先把木质相框校正成了直角。
items.ex2_en: The two corner beams squared up perfectly against the newly built stone wall.
items.ex2_zh: 两根拐角梁与新砌的石墙完美对齐呈直角。

items.def_en: [I/T] to place or arrange things in a straight line or in correct relative positions
items.ex_en: Make sure to align the margin markers precisely with the printed guidelines.
items.ex_zh: 请确保将页边距标记与打印的辅助线精确对齐。
items.ex2_en: The wheels align automatically whenever the smart electronic steering system resets itself.
items.ex2_zh: 每当智能电子转向系统重置时，车轮都会自动校准对齐。

items.def_en: [I/T] to arrange rectangular or polygonal shapes side-by-side across a surface without gaps
items.ex_en: The mason carefully tiled the bathroom floor with smooth ceramic squares.
items.ex_zh: 泥瓦匠用光滑的正方形瓷砖整齐地平铺在浴室地面上。

items.def_zh: 核对并按序排列（纸张等）
items.def_en: to assemble, sort, and order sheets or components in proper numerical or logical sequence
items.ex_en: The secretary collated the printed reports in numerical order before binding them.
items.ex_zh: 秘书在装订前按数字顺序核对并整理好了打印出的报告。

items.def_zh: 重新对齐，重新排列；重新调整（方向或关系）
items.def_en: To put things back into a straight line or correct position; to reorganize or adjust relationships, policies, or alliances.
items.ex_en: The mechanic realigned the front wheels to prevent uneven tire wear.
items.ex_zh: 机械师重新校正了前轮，以防止轮胎出现不均匀磨损。
items.ex2_en: The shifted spinal discs realigned naturally after several weeks of guided physical therapy.
items.ex2_zh: 移位的椎间盘在经过几周的指导物理治疗后自然复位对齐了。

items.def_en: (+ up) to bring an object, wheel, or frame into accurate alignment, flatness, or balance
items.ex_en: The wheelwright carefully trued up the bicycle rim until it spun without wobble.
items.ex_zh: 修车师傅仔细校正了自行车车圈，直到它旋转时不再晃动。

items.def_en: (variant of align) To arrange elements into a straight line or into correct relative positioning.
items.ex_en: The mason strove to aline the ancient stones precisely with the northern star.
items.ex_zh: 石匠努力将古老的石块与北极星精准地校准在一条线上。
items.ex2_en: The ancient stone columns aline perfectly with the setting sun during the winter solstice.
items.ex2_zh: 古老的石柱在冬至日与落日完美排成一线。

items.def_zh: 以嵌花式铺砌，用几何形状无缝拼接
items.def_en: To cover a surface completely with repeated geometric shapes fitted closely together without gaps or overlaps.
items.ex_en: Intricate marble tiles tessellate the sanctuary floor without leaving a single visible crevice.
items.ex_zh: 错综复杂的几何大理石砖铺满了圣殿地面，没有留下一丝缝隙。
items.ex2_en: Regular geometric hexagons tessellate easily across the floor without leaving empty space.
items.ex2_zh: 规则的几何六边形很容易在地面上拼嵌密铺而不留任何空隙。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve positioning objects, lines, or geometric patterns into orderly, straight, or precisely fitting configurations relative to an axis, grid, or neighboring elements. Nuances vary between linear alignment, fitting tiles seamlessly, or reorienting relative positions.
groups.summary_zh: 使物体沿轴线对齐、重整或拼嵌成几何无缝图形。
groups.desc_en: Involves adjusting objects into precise geometric coplanarity, symmetry, or rectangular conformity, unlike general 'place' or 'put' which lacks strict dimensional accuracy.
groups.desc_zh: 强调将物体调整至严格的几何共面、对称、平直或直角对准状态，不同于缺乏精确几何公差要求的普通“摆放”。
groups.nuance_en: align: bring into precise parallel or straight-line position (wheels / text / margins) · true: mechanically correct or adjust an edge/wheel to perfect flatness or center (wheel / frame / edge) · square up: set at exact right angles or make even (edges / corners / timber) · collate: assemble sheets into exact logical sequence (pages / data / reports) · tile: arrange repeating units in a non-overlapping planar grid (windows / textures / images)
groups.nuance_zh: align: 沿基准线精确定齐或平直共线 (wheels / text / margins) · true: 机械校正使其平整圆正无偏心 (wheel / frame / edge) · square up: 校准直角或使端面工整 (edges / corners / timber) · collate: 按序核对整理并排定页码 (pages / data / reports) · tile: 像贴瓷砖般无重叠平铺平列 (windows / textures / images)

groups.name: Arrange in Line & Sequence · 排列与整齐成行 (Line, Space, Array)
groups.tip: 使多个物体沿线对齐成列

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to arrange people or items in a straight line, or to form a queue yourself
items.ex_en: The teacher told the excited children to line up quietly beside the door.
items.ex_zh: 老师让兴奋的孩子们在门旁安静地排成一行。
items.ex2_en: The librarian lined up the returned novels neatly on the wooden cart.
items.ex2_zh: 图书管理员把归还的小说整齐地排在木制推车上。

items.def_en: to line up or wait in a row behind one another
items.ex_en: Dozens of eager customers queue up outside the bakery every morning for fresh bread.
items.ex_zh: 每天早晨，几十名热切的顾客在面包店外排队等候刚出炉的面包。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to arrange items or people with calculated, uniform intervals between them
items.ex_en: I'm sorry, I spaced out for a second—what did you say?
items.ex_zh: 对不起，我刚才走神了一小会儿——你刚才说什么？

items.def_zh: 沿……排列成行；排队，成行排列；给……加衬里
items.def_en: 1. To form a row or rows along the side or edge of something. 2. (usually 'line up') To stand or arrange in a row or line. 3. To cover the inside surface of something with a protective layer.
items.ex_en: Hundreds of enthusiastic spectators line the narrow street to cheer for the marathon runners.
items.ex_zh: 成百上千热情的观众沿狭窄的街道排开，为马拉松选手加油。

items.def_en: (+ out/apart) To arrange or place things at regular intervals or with a certain distance between them.
items.ex_en: The gardener took care to space the young rose bushes evenly along the fence.
items.ex_zh: 园丁细心地把幼小的玫瑰花丛沿着篱笆等距隔开栽种。

items.def_zh: 鱼贯而行，排成单列行进
items.def_en: (+ in/out/past) To march or walk in a single line one behind the other
items.ex_en: The weary workers began to file out through the factory gates at dusk.
items.ex_zh: 黄昏时分，疲倦的工人们开始排成单列鱼贯走出工厂大门。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ up) To form or arrange people or vehicles into a sequential line
items.ex_en: Commuters queue patiently on the platform while waiting for the delayed morning train.
items.ex_zh: 通勤者们在站台上耐心地排成长队，等待晚点的早班列车。

items.def_zh: 整齐排列，布阵（成有秩序的行列）
items.def_en: To place things or people in an orderly, impressive, or strategic arrangement
items.ex_en: The warlord ordered his loyal generals to array the battalions across the open plain.
items.ex_zh: 军阀命令忠诚的将领们将各个营队整齐列阵于开阔平原之上。

items.def_en: To arrange objects or seating in ascending rows or layers
items.ex_en: The architects decided to tier the auditorium seats to ensure everyone has clear sightlines.
items.ex_zh: 建筑师们决定将礼堂的座位设计成阶梯状层叠排列，以确保视线清晰。

groups.summary_en: This manner frame denotes arranging items, people, or intervals in straight lines, uniform files, or calculated spatial intervals. Gradations capture the strictness of geometric placement, from simple single-file lining to precision spacing and formal strategic arrays.
groups.summary_zh: 指按照直线、间距或队形将物体或人整齐排开、均匀分布或陈列。
groups.desc_en: Refers to ordering items or people into continuous linear files or evenly spaced queues, distinguished from generic 'gather' by strict sequential longitudinal progression.
groups.desc_zh: 指将人或物组织成纵向队列、单行连续排列或保持特定间距，与宽泛的“聚集”相比，强调单向直线或严格纵深秩序。
groups.nuance_en: queue: form or wait in an orderly succession for turn (commuters / shoppers / vehicles) · file: march or walk in a single-file column (soldiers / students / mourners) · space out: separate units by regular intervals (chairs / seedlings / intervals) · line up: form a straight row or queue (candidates / bottles / schoolchildren) · array: arrange forces or items in impressive, systematic battle/display formation (troops / solar panels / figures)
groups.nuance_zh: queue: 依次排队等候轮次 (commuters / shoppers / vehicles) · file: 鱼贯成单列缓步前行 (soldiers / students / mourners) · space out: 留出等距离间隔展开 (chairs / seedlings / intervals) · line up: 靠边列队或排成整齐一字排 (candidates / bottles / schoolchildren) · array: 展开成阵列或具威慑力的方阵 (troops / solar panels / figures)

groups.name: Assent & Comply · 赞同与应允 (Assent, Acquiesce, Consent)
groups.tip: 对他人提议表示赞许与首肯

items.def_en: (+ to) To give official or formal permission for something to happen
items.ex_en: The board refused to consent to the proposed merger without further financial guarantees.
items.ex_zh: 在没有进一步财务担保的情况下，董事会拒绝准许拟议的合并案。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to agree with or accept a decision, rule, or suggestion
items.ex_en: I don't entirely agree, but I'll go along with the majority's decision.
items.ex_zh: 我并不完全赞同，但我会服从多数人的决定。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to finally agree to something that one previously resisted or opposed
items.ex_en: Try not to give in to the temptation of snacking between meals.
items.ex_zh: 尽量克制，不要向两餐之间吃零食的诱惑妥协。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to accept and support someone else's plan, views, or suggestions
items.ex_en: Most committee members readily fall in with the chairman's recommendation regarding the budget.
items.ex_zh: 大多数委员会成员欣然赞同并顺从主席有关预算的建议。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to suddenly cease all resistance and accept demands or pressure
items.ex_en: The stubborn manager finally caved in to the relentless demands of the union.
items.ex_zh: 固执的经理最终向工会毫不退让的要求全面妥协了。

items.def_en: (+ with) To express an opinion identical to another person's; agree formally
items.ex_en: The chief economist strongly concurred with the findings presented in the comprehensive report.
items.ex_zh: 首席经济学家对这份详尽报告中提出的研究结论表示极为赞同。

items.def_en: (+ to) To formally express agreement or approval regarding an opinion, proposal, or request.
items.ex_en: The governor formally assented to the legislative bill during yesterday's press conference.
items.ex_zh: 州长在昨天的记者会上正式签署同意了该项立法法案。

items.def_en: (+ to) To agree to a demand, request, or proposal, especially after initial reluctance
items.ex_en: After hours of deliberation, the ministry chose to accede to the diplomats' requests.
items.ex_zh: 经过数小时的商议，该部最终决定应允外交官们的请求。

items.def_en: (+ in/to) To accept, comply with, or agree to something reluctantly without protest.
items.ex_en: The weary homeowner felt compelled to acquiesce in the stringent terms of settlement.
items.ex_zh: 心力交瘁的房主感到被迫默许了严苛的和解条款。

groups.summary_en: An agent yields, agrees, or officially concedes to a proposal, decision, or demand made by another. Verbs contrast between active intellectual agreement ('assent'), passive non-resistance without enthusiasm ('acquiesce'), and formal grant of permission ('consent').
groups.summary_zh: 对他人提议或要求表示同意、顺从或准许，含被动默许与正式批准之别。
groups.desc_en: Describes capitulating or signaling formal agreement to proposals, demands, or opinions, differing from active 'collaborate' by an asymmetry of initiative or grudging acceptance.
groups.desc_zh: 描述对提议、诉求或观点的应允、认同或妥协屈从，与积极的“合作”不同，往往体现出主动权的倾斜或被动顺从。
groups.nuance_en: consent: give explicit formal permission, often hierarchical (parents / patient / authority) · assent: express intellectual concurrence or official sanction (committee / monarch / shareholder) · accede: yield to a persistent demand or treaty (request / treaty / demand) · cave in to: collapse under pressure and abandon resistance (demands / blackmailer / threats) · acquiesce: silently submit without protest (demands / decisions / status quo)
groups.nuance_zh: consent: 拥有权利者正式许可应允 (parents / patient / authority) · assent: 赞同观点或官方正式认可批准 (committee / monarch / shareholder) · accede: 经请求或施压后应允加入 (request / treaty / demand) · cave in to: 顶不住高压彻底屈服瓦解 (demands / blackmailer / threats) · acquiesce: 虽有保留但默许顺从 (demands / decisions / status quo)

groups.name: Attach with Adhesive · 粘贴与黏附 (Paste, Stick, Gum)
groups.tip: 抹上胶水让物体牢贴不落

items.def_en: (+ sth) to attach posters, paper, or notices onto a surface with paste
items.ex_en: Volunteers helped paste up bright campaign flyers all over the wooden construction boards.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者们帮忙把色彩鲜艳的竞选传单贴满了木质施工围栏。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to fasten or secure something to a surface using adhesive substance
items.ex_en: Please stick down the loose corners of the wallpaper using a little adhesive.
items.ex_zh: 请用一点胶水将壁纸翘起的边角粘贴固定好。

items.def_zh: 用胶水粘合，涂胶于；使黏结，堵塞（与 up 连用）
items.def_en: 1. To stick or seal something together using gum or glue. 2. (gum up) To clog or make something sticky so that it cannot work properly.
items.ex_en: The postal clerk gummed the heavy envelope securely before tossing it into transit.
items.ex_zh: 邮政职员把厚重的信封牢牢涂胶封好，随后扔进了运输箱。

items.def_en: (+ to) To stick firmly to a surface or substance (formal register)
items.ex_en: The protective film must adhere completely to the glass surface to prevent scratching.
items.ex_zh: 保护膜必须紧密黏附在玻璃表面以防止刮花。

items.def_en: (+ to) To hold on tightly to or adhere naturally to a contact surface
items.ex_en: Wet autumn leaves cling stubbornly to the cold, damp windshield of the car.
items.ex_zh: 潮湿的秋叶顽固地贴在汽车冰冷湿润的挡风玻璃上。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to firmly attach something onto a surface using glue
items.ex_en: The carpenter carefully glued down the veneer strips to ensure an enduring bond.
items.ex_zh: 木匠仔细地将饰面板条用胶水牢牢粘在底板上以确保持久固定。

items.def_zh: 粘贴，黏附；刺，戳；伸出；卡住
items.def_en: 1. To attach or become fastened to something, especially with glue or a sticky substance. 2. To push something pointed into or through something; insert. 3. To become trapped or fixed in one position.
items.ex_en: She used clear tape to stick the colorful postcard onto her bedroom mirror.
items.ex_zh: 她用透明胶带把那张绚丽的明信片粘在卧室的镜子上。
items.ex2_en: The suction cup will stick securely to the smooth glass tile surface.
items.ex2_zh: 吸盘会牢固地粘在光滑的玻璃砖表面上。

items.def_zh: 用浆糊（或胶水）粘贴，黏合；（计算机）粘贴
items.def_en: 1. To stick something to a surface using paste or glue. 2. (computing) To insert copied text, an image, or data into a document or file.
items.ex_en: The lonely poet pasted the faded love letters onto his dark study wall.
items.ex_zh: 孤独的诗人将那些褪色的情书用浆糊粘在阴暗书斋的墙上。

items.def_en: (+ to/together) To fasten or join firmly with glue or adhesive
items.ex_en: He carefully glued the fractured porcelain pieces back together with high-strength resin.
items.ex_zh: 他用高强度树脂仔细地将破碎的瓷片粘接复原。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote joining or attaching surfaces together using a sticky, viscous, or adhesive substance, or remaining fixed onto a surface through natural adherence. They contrast by the type of adhesive medium, permanency, and physical application.
groups.summary_zh: 指借助黏稠介质或自身粘性将物体附着、固定在另一表面上。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on joining surfaces through adhesive substances or interfacial tackiness, contrasting with mechanical 'fasten' (bolts, clips) by surface contact and molecular cohesion.
groups.desc_zh: 专指依靠黏结剂或表面吸附张力将面与面粘合，区别于依靠机械外力卡扣固定（如螺栓、夹具）的“紧固”。
