groups.nuance_en: stick: attach via tackiness, pressure-sensitive adhesive, or natural adherence (label / stamp / poster) · paste: fix flat paper/sheets onto a backing using liquid starch/paste (wallpaper / bill / photo) · gum: coat or fix firmly with gummy mucilage (flap / label / wrapper) · adhere: bind firmly at molecular/material surface interfaces (tape / coating / plaque) · cling: adhere tenaciously by static, moisture, or close contour (dress / film / dust)
groups.nuance_zh: stick: 简便按压粘贴或黏合 (label / stamp / poster) · paste: 用浆糊/胶水将薄面刷平糊贴 (wallpaper / bill / photo) · gum: 用树胶胶水涂封或黏结 (flap / label / wrapper) · adhere: 物理学或医学层面的界面附着 (tape / coating / plaque) · cling: 紧密附着、紧贴或靠静电水分吸附 (dress / film / dust)

groups.name: Audible High-Speed Motion · 呼啸疾掠 (Whiz, Whoosh, Zip)
groups.tip: 极速冲刺带风呼啸而过

items.def_en: (+ past/by) to speed rapidly with a light humming or hissing sound
items.ex_en: The sleek sports car zipped past the pedestrians with an exhilarating high-pitched hum.
items.ex_zh: 那辆流线型跑车带着令人兴奋的尖细嗡鸣声从行人身旁呼啸疾驰而过。
items.ex2_en: He quickly zipped his warm winter jacket before walking into the biting wind.
items.ex2_zh: 在走进刺骨的寒风之前，他迅速拉上了保暖冬衣的拉链。

items.def_zh: 飕飕掠过；作沙沙声甩动
items.def_en: [I/T] to move swiftly through the air with a soft hissing or rustling sound
items.ex_en: The ceremonial sword swished through the crisp air during the master's swift demonstration.
items.ex_zh: 在那位大师的利落演练中，仪式佩剑在清冷的空气中飕飕掠过。
items.ex2_en: The excited puppy swished its bushy tail happily when its owner returned home.
items.ex2_zh: 当主人回到家时，兴奋的小狗欢快地甩动着蓬松的尾巴。

items.def_en: to move past very rapidly while producing a rushing or whistling sound
items.ex_en: Several high-speed trains whiz by our tranquil village throughout the noisy afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 一下午的时间里，几列高速列车呼啸疾驰掠过我们宁静的村庄。

items.def_en: to rush past swiftly with a loud displacement or gust of air
items.ex_en: A heavy gust of freezing wind whooshed past the travelers on the bridge.
items.ex_zh: 一阵冰冷的狂风嗖的一声掠过桥上的行人们。

items.def_en: to travel past someone or somewhere extremely quickly with a sharp, swift rush of air
items.ex_en: A flock of startled swallows zipped by our heads toward the ancient barn.
items.ex_zh: 一群受惊的燕子飞驰掠过我们的头顶，朝古旧的谷仓飞去。

items.def_en: (+ past/through) to move rapidly producing a shrill whistling sound from air friction
items.ex_en: A stray bullet whistled past the soldier's helmet during the intense nighttime skirmish.
items.ex_zh: 在激烈的夜战中，一颗流弹尖啸着贴着士兵的钢盔穿空而过。

items.def_en: (+ down/upon) to move rapidly downwards through the air with a rushing sound
items.ex_en: The hungry hawk swooped down upon the unsuspecting field mouse in the grass.
items.ex_zh: 饥饿的雄鹰呼啸着俯冲而下，扑向草丛中毫无防备的田鼠。

items.def_en: To move very quickly with a rushing or hissing sound of air or water, or make something do this.
items.ex_en: The express train whooshed through the dark tunnel at terrifying, uncontrollable speeds.
items.ex_zh: 特快列车以令人心悸的飞快速度呼啸着穿过了黑暗的隧道。
items.ex2_en: The sudden gust of coastal wind whooshed dry leaves across the garden lawn.
items.ex2_zh: 突如其来的沿海阵风呼啸着把枯叶吹散在花园草坪上。

items.def_zh: 呼啸疾驰，嗖嗖地飞驰；飕飕作声
items.def_en: To move very quickly through the air or past someone, often with a buzzing or whistling sound.
items.ex_en: Children cheered as the colorful toy rockets whizzed across the open meadow.
items.ex_zh: 当五颜六色的玩具火箭嗖嗖飞驰过开阔的草地时，孩子们欢呼起来。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate high-speed translation that generates a prominent rush of displaced air, humming friction, or distinctive aerodynamic sound.
groups.summary_zh: 特指伴随明显风声、破空声或气流呼啸的高速移动方式。
groups.desc_en: Denotes high-velocity motion that produces an unmistakable rush of displaced air, contrasting with silent 'pass' or unhurried 'move' through characteristic aerodynamic acoustics.
groups.desc_zh: 指物体因极高运动速度推开空气而发出呼啸撕裂声的飞掠动态，通过特有的气动声响区别于无声的“掠过”或从容的“移动”。
groups.nuance_en: whoosh: rush rapidly with a heavy, soft, voluminous gust of air (flames / train / gust) · whiz: fly through the air with a high-pitched buzzing or whistling hiss (bullet / projectile / scooter) · zip: dart with crisp, energetic, lightning-fast speed (car / bullet / insect) · swish: sweep past with a soft rustling or whistling whisper (scythe / skirt / blade) · whistle: shoot through air emitting a piercing aerodynamic pitch (shrapnel / wind / projectile)
groups.nuance_zh: whoosh: 伴随大量空气猛烈涌动的呼啸穿过 (flames / train / gust) · whiz: 带有尖锐蜂鸣或破空嘶声的疾飞 (bullet / projectile / scooter) · zip: 轻快迅捷、倏忽一下蹿过 (car / bullet / insect) · swish: 伴随嗖嗖柔和风声或沙沙声擦过 (scythe / skirt / blade) · whistle: 撕裂空气产生尖利哨鸣声飞过 (shrapnel / wind / projectile)

groups.name: Avow & Assert · 断言与主张 (Earnest Open Claim and Commitment)
groups.tip: 公开宣誓并坚定不移确证主张

items.def_zh: 公开表明；声称（信仰/态度）
items.def_en: to claim or declare a feeling, opinion, or faith openly, sometimes insincerely
items.ex_en: He continues to profess sincere admiration for classical literature despite his modern habits.
items.ex_zh: 尽管生活习惯非常现代，他仍公开声称自己对古典文学抱有真挚钦佩。

items.def_en: (+ sth) State or declare an assertion or belief openly and publicly
items.ex_en: The politician suddenly came out with bold assertions regarding impending radical tax reforms.
items.ex_zh: 那位政客突然公开宣称将进行激进的重大税制改革。

items.def_en: State one's beliefs, convictions, or objections openly and without fear
items.ex_en: Activists took to the streets to speak out against human rights abuses.
items.ex_zh: 活动人士走上街头，大声疾呼反对侵犯人权的行为。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Assert and defend a belief, principle, or claim firmly when challenged
items.ex_en: It is essential to stand up for your beliefs even when others disagree.
items.ex_zh: 即使别人不同意，也要勇于捍卫自己的信念。

items.def_en: to state a fact or belief firmly and with positive confidence
items.ex_en: The lead defense attorney asserted the client's total innocence with supreme, unyielding confidence.
items.ex_zh: 首席辩护律师以坚定不移的自信坚称委托人完全无罪。

items.def_en: to state positively or validate emphatically as true or valid
items.ex_en: The research scientist affirmed the integrity of the clinical trial results before regulators.
items.ex_zh: 该研究科学家在监管机构面前坚决证实了临床试验结果的真实有效性。

items.def_en: (+ that) to argue or assert earnestly in the course of an adversarial debate
items.ex_en: The prosecutor contended that the suspect deliberately destroyed vital evidence before his arrest.
items.ex_zh: 检察官在辩论中力主嫌疑人在被捕前故意销毁了关键证据。

items.def_zh: 重申，再次坚称；再次确立（权威等）
items.def_en: 1. To state a claim, belief, or fact firmly again, or re-establish one's control or authority.
items.ex_en: The president sought to reassert his legitimate constitutional authority over the divided cabinet.
items.ex_zh: 总统试图对分裂的内阁再次确立其合法的宪法权威。

items.def_zh: 公开承认，明确声明，坦承
items.def_en: 1. (+ that) (formal) To state, admit, or claim something openly and firmly in public.
items.ex_en: The disgraced executive avowed his past financial mistakes before the crowded shareholder tribunal.
items.ex_zh: 这位名誉扫地的高管在拥挤的股东听证会前公开坦承了过去的财务失误。

groups.summary_en: A speaker declares a belief, identity, or commitment openly and resolutely in the face of skepticism, holding themselves personally accountable for the claim's integrity.
groups.summary_zh: 公开坚决地承认信念、身份或明确主张立场。
groups.desc_en: Involves public, explicit, and earnest proclamations of belief, entitlement, or fact, moving beyond neutral 'state' by putting personal credibility and moral conviction on the line.
groups.desc_zh: 指公开、明确且郑重地声明信念、权利或事实，区别于中立平淡的“陈述”，押上了个人信誉与道德立场。
groups.nuance_en: assert: state firmly and positively with confident authority (rights / innocence / authority) · profess: openly declare a personal faith, feeling, or allegiance, sometimes insincerely (love / faith / ignorance) · affirm: validate, uphold, or solemnly confirm truth or validity (commitment / loyalty / verdict) · contend: argue forcefully against opposition in legal or intellectual debates (theory / innocence / point) · reassert: state again emphatically to regain lost authority or clarity (control / dominance / independence)
groups.nuance_zh: assert: 坚定、权威性地宣示与主张 (rights / innocence / authority) · profess: 公开表白信仰、心迹或假托声称 (love / faith / ignorance) · affirm: 庄严确认、断定或重申合法性 (commitment / loyalty / verdict) · contend: 在争辩或诉讼中据理力争主张 (theory / innocence / point) · reassert: 重新确立或再度强调权威与支配权 (control / dominance / independence)

groups.name: Awe & Greatly Impress · 强烈打动与叹服 (Impress, Wow, Dazzle)
groups.tip: 直击心灵、留下深刻的情感印记

items.def_zh: 使惊叹，给……留下极深刻印象，轰动
items.def_en: (informal) To impress someone enormously; to delight or entertain an audience greatly.
items.ex_en: The young magician completely wowed the enthusiastic audience with his flawless sleight tricks.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的魔术师用他毫无破绽的巧妙手法彻底让热情的观众惊叹不已。

items.def_zh: 给……留下深刻印象，使钦佩；使意识到，使铭记
items.def_en: 1. To make someone feel admiration, respect, or deep emotional impact. 2. (+ on/upon) To emphasize firmly so that someone realizes the importance of something.
items.ex_en: Her deep technical knowledge and articulate presentation impressed every interviewer on the panel.
items.ex_zh: 她深厚的专业知识和清晰的表达给评审团的每位面试官留下了深刻印象。

items.def_zh: 使极其震撼，使叹为观止
items.def_en: (+ obj) to amaze, surprise, or impress someone enormously
items.ex_en: The breathtaking panoramic view from the summit simply blew away the exhausted hikers.
items.ex_zh: 山顶那片令人屏息的壮丽全景让精疲力竭的登山客们叹为观止。

items.def_en: (+ sb) Astonish, dazzle, or greatly impress someone
items.ex_en: Her breathtaking performance on the violin bowled over even the harshest veteran critics.
items.ex_zh: 她动人心魄的小提琴演奏让哪怕最严苛的资深乐评人都大为震撼。

items.def_en: (+ sb) Impress or captivate someone immensely with exceptional quality or beauty
items.ex_en: Our team was knocked out of the tournament in the quarter-finals.
items.ex_zh: 我们队在四分之一决赛中被淘汰出局。

items.def_zh: 完全吸引；强烈打动（通常作 sweep off one's feet）
items.def_en: (+ sb) Completely captivate or overwhelm someone with charm or admiration
items.ex_en: His dazzling wit and gentle courtesy managed to sweep her off her feet.
items.ex_zh: 他过人的机智与温柔的绅士风度完全征服并深深打动了她。

items.def_en: to fill someone with deep admiration, respect, or reverential wonder
items.ex_en: The majestic, towering spires of the ancient cathedral awed the silent pilgrim crowd.
items.ex_zh: 那座古老大教堂雄伟耸立的尖塔令静默的朝圣人群肃然起敬。

items.def_en: to greatly impress or overwhelm someone with brilliance, skill, or beauty
items.ex_en: The gymnast dazzled the international judges with an astonishing display of aerial balance.
items.ex_zh: 这位体操选手凭借令人惊叹的空中平衡展示令国际裁判们倾倒赞叹。

items.def_en: to hold someone's intense interest or admiration through charm or excellence
items.ex_en: The singer's velvety voice captivatingly held the whole theater in complete stillness.
items.ex_zh: 歌唱家那天鹅绒般的迷人嗓音深深吸引了全场，令整个剧场肃穆凝神。

groups.summary_en: Denotes an agent, performance, or display creating a strong, deeply positive, and admiring emotional impact on an observer. Nuances range from dignified approval ('impress') to overwhelming, flashy sensory admiration ('dazzle', 'wow').
groups.summary_zh: 指凭借卓越表现或魅力令他人产生深刻印象、赞叹或叹服。
groups.desc_en: Captures the psychological overwhelming of an observer by spectacular brilliance, scale, or skill, surpassing basic 'please' through profound disorientation or dumbfounded admiration.
groups.desc_zh: 指凭借极其壮丽、巨大或绝伦的技艺在心理上彻底震撼、折服观者，区别于普通的“取悦”，带有击穿感官的叹服。
groups.nuance_en: wow: delight and impress an audience spontaneously with spectacle (audience / judges / crowds) · dazzle: blind or bewilder with stunning brilliance, glamour, or skill (critics / onlookers / spectators) · bowl over: overwhelm someone completely with surprise or admiration (interviewer / fans / guests) · blow away: deeply astonish and leave someone utterly speechless (listeners / judges / crowd) · awe: instill reverent fear and profound wonder (worshippers / visitors / public)
groups.nuance_zh: wow: 以惊艳表现博得满堂喝彩与惊叹 (audience / judges / crowds) · dazzle: 以耀眼光彩、华丽或高超技巧晃花人眼 (critics / onlookers / spectators) · bowl over: 惊喜交加令人完全被折服击倒 (interviewer / fans / guests) · blow away: 极大超越预期令人目瞪口呆 (listeners / judges / crowd) · awe: 使人肃然起敬、产生敬畏与震撼 (worshippers / visitors / public)

groups.name: Balance & Offset · 均等与抵消 (Balance, Offset, Counterbalance)
groups.tip: 力量相互抵消达到均等与平衡

items.def_en: [I/T] to put opposing forces, weights, or accounts in equal proportion or equilibrium
items.ex_en: The accountant worked late into the evening to balance the firm's ledgers properly.
items.ex_zh: 会计工作到深夜，以便将公司的账目彻底轧平核算清楚。
items.ex2_en: The seesaw will balance evenly once both children sit at equal distances.
items.ex2_zh: 一旦两个孩子坐在相等的距离上，跷跷板就会平稳平衡。

items.def_en: to act as an equal weight or power that holds another in exact balance
items.ex_en: The wisdom of the elderly statesman counterpoised the reckless ambitions of youthful ministers.
items.ex_zh: 那位老政治家的深沉睿智恰好制衡了年轻部长们鲁莽的野心。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Become equal in amount, value, or influence, or make two opposing elements balance each other
items.ex_en: Rising transport costs and substantial bulk discounts usually balance out in international trade.
items.ex_zh: 上涨的运输成本与可观的大宗折扣在国际贸易中通常能够相互抵消。
items.ex2_en: A generous tax refund will balance out our unexpected moving expenses this spring.
items.ex2_zh: 一笔丰厚的退税将抵消我们今年春天意料之外的搬家开支。

items.def_zh: 使均等；使相等消除差距
items.def_en: (+ sth) Become equal or balanced, or make opposing amounts equal and level
items.ex_en: The referee's strict decisions helped even out the fierce advantages between both teams.
items.ex_zh: 裁判严格的判罚帮助消除了两队之间的不平衡优势。
items.ex2_en: Scores between the rival teams evened out during the final minutes of play.
items.ex2_zh: 两支对手队伍之间的得分在比赛的最后几分钟持平了。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Have an equal but opposite effect to something else, nullifying any net disparity
items.ex_en: The extra revenue from new sales was canceled out by rising operational costs.
items.ex_zh: 新销售带来的额外收益被不断上升的运营成本抵消了。
items.ex2_en: Their opposing political votes will cancel out during the final committee ballot count.
items.ex2_zh: 在委员会最终计票时，他们相反的政治选票将相互抵消。

items.def_en: to compensate for or counteract something by having an equal and opposite effect
items.ex_en: The company used profits from commercial sales to offset hefty losses in manufacturing.
items.ex_zh: 公司利用商业销售所获的利润来弥补制造业上的巨额亏损。

items.def_en: to render an opposing force, effect, or substance harmless and ineffective by equal counteraction
items.ex_en: Quick diplomatic talks effectively neutralized the rising military tension along the disputed border.
items.ex_zh: 迅速展开的外交谈判有效化解并消除了争议边界上不断上升的军事紧张局势。

items.def_zh: （使）平衡，（使）均等；（比赛中）扳平比分
items.def_en: 1. to make things equal, balanced, or uniform across a group 2. (in sports) to score a goal or point that ties the match
items.ex_en: The substitute striker scored a dramatic header to equalise just before the whistle.
items.ex_zh: 替补前锋在终场哨响前用一记戏剧性的头球破门扳平了比分。
items.ex2_en: The central government aims to equalise funding between metropolitan and rural public schools.
items.ex2_zh: 中央政府旨在平衡大都市和乡村公立学校之间的资金投入。

items.def_en: to offset or balance the weight, power, or effect of something with an equal opposing force
items.ex_en: A heavy lead weight was installed to counterbalance the massive crane's extended arm.
items.ex_zh: 安装了一个沉重的铅块以平衡这台巨型起重机伸展的长臂。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve establishing numerical, financial, or mechanical equilibrium between opposing weights, forces, or liabilities so that net disparity is eliminated.
groups.summary_zh: 在力量、数值、收支或利弊之间实现对冲、平衡或抵消。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an equilibrium state where opposing quantities, weights, or forces cancel each other out, differing from simple 'match' by an active counteractive neutralization.
groups.desc_zh: 指相对立的分量、重力或势能相互抵消达成中和平衡，不同于单纯的“相配”，强调双向对冲与化解。
groups.nuance_en: offset: counterbalance an expenditure or deficit with a compensating value (costs / gains / emissions) · balance: bring conflicting factors or physical weights into stable equilibrium (budget / weights / accounts) · cancel out: negate the effect of each other completely to zero (advantages / errors / effects) · neutralize: disarm or render a threat or chemical completely inert (threat / poison / advantage) · counterpoise: set an equal physical or moral weight against another (power / influence / weights)
groups.nuance_zh: offset: 用一侧的收益弥补或冲销另一侧的损失 (costs / gains / emissions) · balance: 使收支、重量或力量维系稳定平衡 (budget / weights / accounts) · cancel out: 双方效果相反，彻底相克归零 (advantages / errors / effects) · neutralize: 中和毒性或使威胁化为乌有 (threat / poison / advantage) · counterpoise: 设置同等重量或制衡力量以相对峙 (power / influence / weights)

groups.name: Balance & Offset · 平衡与对冲
groups.tip: 拉平各方差距或相互抵消平衡

items.def_zh: 均分，使平均，平均分摊；平均为，平均达到；算出……的平均数
items.def_en: 1. To balance out or distribute evenly among several items or people. 2. To have as an average; amount to an average rate or number. 3. To calculate the numerical average of.
items.ex_en: The restaurant manager averaged the weekly earnings across all kitchen and service staff.
items.ex_zh: 餐厅经理将每周的收益在所有后厨及前厅员工之间进行了平均分摊。

items.def_zh: 使平衡；以同等力量制衡
items.def_en: to bring into perfect equilibrium by applying an opposing weight or influence
items.ex_en: Philosophers seek pure virtue to counterpoise the corrupting appetites of mortal vanity.
items.ex_zh: 哲学家们寻求纯正的美德，以制衡凡俗虚荣那令人堕落的欲望。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Compensate for a deficit, loss, or shortcoming so as to restore balance
items.ex_en: He worked overtime all weekend to make up for the lost hours.
items.ex_zh: 他整个周末都在加班，以弥补损失的工时。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Result in an even average rate or balance over time
items.ex_en: Prices fluctuate month to month, but they usually average out over the year.
items.ex_zh: 物价每月都在波动，但全年月度平均下来通常是持平的。
items.ex2_en: The financial software can average out your monthly utility payments across twelve months.
items.ex2_zh: 这款财务软件可以将你十二个月的公共事业支出拉平计算出月均值。

items.def_en: (+ with sb) Settle debts or differences so that balances are equalized
items.ex_en: Let me square up with you for the shared hotel room before departing.
items.ex_zh: 出发之前，让我先把合住酒店房间的账目跟你结清吧。
items.ex2_en: The bank manager squared up the mismatched currency ledgers before leaving the office.
items.ex2_zh: 银行经理在离开办公室前结清核平了不一致的货币账目。

items.def_en: 1. To balance, compensate for, or counteract something so that the overall effect is reduced or neutralized. 2. (printing) To print using the offset lithography process.
items.ex_en: Renewable energy credits help offset the carbon emissions produced by our industrial operations.
items.ex_zh: 可再生能源配额有助于抵消我们工业生产运营中产生的碳排放。

items.def_en: (+ for) to provide an offsetting balance against a deficit, loss, or defect
items.ex_en: Higher annual bonuses cannot compensate for the hazardous conditions inside the chemical plant.
items.ex_zh: 更高的年度奖金也无法弥补化工厂内部危险恶劣的工作环境。

items.def_zh: 使对等，使平衡，使均等；（体育比赛中）扳平比分
items.def_en: 1. To make amounts, opportunities, or conditions equal, or to become equal. 2. (sports) To score a goal or point that levels the score with the opponent.
items.ex_en: The new social program seeks to equalize educational opportunities across rural regional schools.
items.ex_zh: 这项新的社会计划旨在使广大乡村地区学校的受教育机会趋于均等。
items.ex2_en: Test scores across both student groups equalized steadily after the new curriculum arrived.
items.ex2_zh: 引入新课程后，两组学生的考试成绩稳步趋向平等。

items.def_en: to exert an equal and opposite force or influence against something
items.ex_en: Judicial independence serves to counterbalance the formidable power of the legislative branch.
items.ex_zh: 司法独立旨在抗衡并制约立法部门拥有的巨大权力。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe compensating for or counterbalancing one amount, influence, or disparity against another so as to achieve parity, equilibrium, or a fair midpoint. 'Offset' counters an effect with an opposing force, 'equalize' brings quantities into equality, and 'counterbalance' maintains stable equilibrium.
groups.summary_zh: 通过两相对照抵偿或调节比例，达到数值或效果的平衡对等。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on commercial, financial, or statistical leveling mechanisms where fluctuations, deficits, or damages are rectified, differing from static balance by an active compensatory accounting action.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重商业、金融或统计学中抹平波动、弥补赤字或赔偿损失的补偿对冲机制，与静态平衡相比，强调整体平摊或偿补举动。
groups.nuance_en: compensate: provide an equivalent recompense for loss, injury, or effort (victims / workers / loss) · average out: level out extreme peaks and troughs over time into a median (costs / returns / fluctuations) · make up for: supply what is lacking or redeem a mistake through extra merit (delay / loss / deficiency) · square up: settle debts or reconcile outstanding financial differences (tab / bill / balance) · equalize: render disparate groups, taxes, or scores uniform (opportunities / tax / income)
groups.nuance_zh: compensate: 经济上给予损害赔偿或报酬偿付 (victims / workers / loss) · average out: 经长期平摊使波动的极值归于平均 (costs / returns / fluctuations) · make up for: 亡羊补牢，以额外优势弥补缺陷 (delay / loss / deficiency) · square up: 结清欠款、还清债务或两清 (tab / bill / bill) · equalize: 使收入、税率或分歧均等化 (opportunities / tax / income)

groups.name: Bend & Angle Shapes · 弯曲与折折 (Bend, Crook, Fold)
groups.tip: 使纸张或软物对称对折

items.def_en: to bend a joint or muscle, or to bend slightly under stress without snapping
items.ex_en: The physical therapist asked him to gently flex his injured knee after the workout.
items.ex_zh: 理疗师让他在锻炼后轻轻屈曲受伤的膝盖。
items.ex2_en: The flexible fiberglass pole flexed smoothly under the strong force of the gale.
items.ex2_zh: 柔韧的玻璃纤维杆在狂风的强力下平缓地弯曲屈伸。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Curve or angle an object or limb backward from its straight position
items.ex_en: Be careful not to bend back the plastic tab too far, or it will break.
items.ex_zh: 小心别把塑料拉片向后折得太厉害，否则会断掉。
items.ex2_en: The flexible pine branches bent back naturally against the howling mountain winds yesterday.
items.ex2_zh: 柔韧的松树枝昨天在呼啸的山风中自然向后弯折。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Bend a part flat against another surface by folding
items.ex_en: You can fold down the rear seats to create more luggage space for traveling.
items.ex_zh: 你可以折下后排座椅，为出行腾出更多行李空间。
items.ex2_en: The tray table folds down neatly from the back of the airplane seat.
items.ex2_zh: 托盘小桌板从飞机座椅靠背上整齐地向下翻折下来。

items.def_zh: 折叠，对折；抱拢，交叉（双臂）；（企业等）倒闭
items.def_en: 1. to bend a piece of paper, cloth, etc., so that one part lies flat on another. 2. to cross one's arms, or wrap something. 3. (informal) to close down or go out of business
items.ex_en: Just fold the paper in half and slip it into your front pocket quickly.
items.ex_zh: 直接把纸对折，赶紧塞进你的前口袋里就行。
items.ex2_en: The folding camping chairs fold easily for storage in small car trunks.
items.ex2_zh: 这种折叠露营椅很容易折叠起来存放在小汽车后备箱中。

items.def_zh: （使）弯曲，折弯；俯身，弯腰；屈服，服从
items.def_en: 1. to curve something straight, or become curved or folded. 2. to move the body or part of the body downwards and forwards. 3. to submit or yield to someone's wishes
items.ex_en: He had to bend his head slightly to walk through the low wooden doorway.
items.ex_zh: 穿过那扇低矮的木门时，他不得不微微低头。
items.ex2_en: The tall plastic street sign bent sharply under the force of the typhoon.
items.ex2_zh: 高高的塑料路标在台风的威力下急剧弯曲了。

items.def_zh: 使弯曲，弯成钩状（如手臂或手指）
items.def_en: to bend a finger, arm, or leg so that it forms a curved or hooked shape
items.ex_en: The old woman crooked her finger, beckoning the hesitant child to come closer to her.
items.ex_zh: 老妇人弯了弯手指，示意那个犹豫不决的孩子走到她身旁。

items.def_en: to make lines or folds in cloth or paper by pressing or bending
items.ex_en: Careless packing will easily crease your linen shirts during the long business trip.
items.ex_zh: 在漫长的商务旅行中，随意打包很容易弄皱你的亚麻衬衫。
items.ex2_en: These thin cotton sheets crease easily whenever you wash them in warm water.
items.ex2_zh: 这些薄棉床单只要用温水洗涤就很容易起褶皱。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Bend sharply in half or bend the body sharply forward at the waist
items.ex_en: The boxer doubled over in agony after taking a sharp blow to the abdomen.
items.ex_zh: 腹部遭受重击后，拳击手痛苦地弓下了身子。
items.ex2_en: A severe stomach cramp doubled the runner over right near the finish line.
items.ex2_zh: 剧烈的胃痉挛使那名跑步者就在终点线附近疼得弓弯了身子。

items.def_en: to bend or warp severely out of shape under excessive heat, weight, or force
items.ex_en: The metal support beams began to buckle under the intense heat of the blaze.
items.ex_zh: 金属支撑梁在大火的高温炙烤下开始发生弯曲变形。
items.ex2_en: The immense cargo weight buckled the metal roof of the old delivery truck.
items.ex2_zh: 沉重的货物重量压垮压弯了老旧货车的金属车顶。

groups.summary_en: Manner verbs of physical shaping denoting altering an object or body part from a straight to a curved, sharply angled, or doubled-over position.
groups.summary_zh: 施加外力使物体或肢体由直变弯、折叠或成特定角度。
groups.desc_en: Denotes forcing a flexible or sheet-like material into crisp angles, creases, or sharp planar turns, distinguishing itself from gentle curving by localized structural deformation.
groups.desc_zh: 指将柔软或薄片状材质折压出鲜明夹角、折痕或锐利的转折，与平滑的弧形弯曲不同，强调局部的结构性折叠变褶。
groups.nuance_en: fold: bend a flexible sheet back over itself along a defined line (paper / towel / arms) · crease: produce a sharp, permanent structural line by pressing (trousers / paper / fabric) · crook: bend a limb or finger at a sharp joint angle (finger / elbow / arm) · flex: deliberately contract a muscle or bend an elastic element without breaking (muscle / joints / limb) · double over: bend one's torso sharply forward, typically from acute pain (laughing / pain / agony)
groups.nuance_zh: fold: 将平展的材料对折或翻折叠起 (paper / towel / arms) · crease: 挤压或熨烫出死褶与清晰折印 (trousers / paper / fabric) · crook: 关节向内勾起、曲起手指或胳膊 (finger / elbow / arm) · flex: 有意绷紧肌肉或微曲有弹性的肢体 (muscle / joints / limb) · double over: 因剧痛或大笑使躯干骤然向前折弯成大虾状 (laughing / pain / agony)

groups.name: Bend & Arc Smoothly · 弯曲与弧形折曲 (Curve, Arch, Bend)
groups.tip: 由平直变弯曲或拱起弧度

items.def_zh: 拱起成弧状；弯成拱形覆盖
items.def_en: (+ sth) Form a curved, graceful arch extending across or above something
items.ex_en: Ancient weeping willows arch over the quiet canal, casting deep shadows on the water.
items.ex_zh: 古老的垂柳在静谧的运河上方弯成拱形，在水面投下浓荫。

items.def_zh: 沿弧形绕过；形成平滑曲线
items.def_en: (+ sth) Bend or sweep in a smooth continuous arc around something
items.ex_en: The scenic coastal highway curves around the steep cliffs, offering breathtaking ocean views.
items.ex_zh: 风景优美的沿海公路沿着陡峭的悬崖蜿蜒绕行，展现出壮阔的海景。

items.def_en: Follow or form an elongated, smooth curving trajectory or line
items.ex_en: The train swept round the hillside bend, revealing a sparkling lake below in the valley.
items.ex_zh: 列车大弧度绕过山坡弯道，山谷下方波光粼粼的湖泊映入眼帘。

items.def_en: to form a curve, or to bend or shape something into a curve
items.ex_en: The artisan carefully heated the glass rod until it started to curve into shape.
items.ex_zh: 工匠仔细加热玻璃棒，直到它开始弯成理想的弧度。
items.ex2_en: The glassblower curves the hot glowing tube into an elegant spiral vase shape.
items.ex2_zh: 玻璃吹制工把炙热发光的管子弯成优雅的螺旋花瓶形状。

items.def_en: to force an object out of a straight line into a curve, or to naturally flex
items.ex_en: The strong wind bent the slender bamboo stalks until they nearly touched the ground.
items.ex_zh: 强风将纤细的竹竿压弯，几乎触碰到了地面。
items.ex2_en: The heated copper pipe bent easily around the corner of the brick wall.
items.ex2_zh: 加热后的铜管沿着砖墙拐角很容易就弯了过去。

items.def_en: to form an arch, or to curve something into an arch shape (such as one's back, eyebrows, or feet)
items.ex_en: The frightened black cat arched its back and hissed defensively at the barking dog.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的黑猫弓起后背，戒备地对着狂吠的狗发出嘶嘶声。
items.ex2_en: The ancient stone bridge arches gracefully across the rushing mountain river below.
items.ex2_zh: 古老的石桥优雅地横跨拱立在下方奔腾的山涧之上。

items.def_en: to bend a limb, joint, or pliable material temporarily without breaking
items.ex_en: The dancer flexed her pointed feet smoothly before stepping onto the brightly lit stage.
items.ex_zh: 舞者在步入明亮的舞台之前，流畅地屈伸绷紧的双脚。
items.ex2_en: The durable composite pole flexed without breaking under the athlete's heavy body weight.
items.ex2_zh: 那根耐用的复合撑杆在运动员沉重的体重下弯曲而未折断。

items.def_en: to bend into a curved shape under pressure, weight, or tension
items.ex_en: The wooden floorboards bowed under the heavy weight of the massive antique bookcase.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的仿古大书柜压得木地板微微向下凹陷弯曲。
items.ex2_en: The massive snow accumulation bowed the sturdy branches of the pine trees outside.
items.ex2_zh: 厚重的积雪压弯了外面松树粗壮的枝条。

items.def_en: 1. to form into a curved or spiral shape, or cause hair, paper, etc. to do so. 2. (curl up) to sit or lie in a comfortable position with legs drawn up
items.ex_en: Dry autumn leaves curled at the edges as the hot sun beat down relentlessly.
items.ex_zh: 在烈日的无情暴晒下，干燥的秋叶边缘渐渐卷曲起来。
items.ex2_en: The hairdresser curled the bride's long brown hair with a hot iron yesterday.
items.ex2_zh: 美发师昨天用卷发棒烫卷了新娘的长棕发。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical objects, bodies, or trajectories forming a smooth, continuous curve or rounded deflection away from a straight line without buckling or tangling.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体或身体呈现平滑连贯的弧形或弯度，无断折或扭结。
groups.desc_en: Involves deviating continuously from a straight line into a smooth, unbroken arc or vaulted trajectory, differing from angular bending by the absence of sharp vertices.
groups.desc_zh: 指物体沿连续平滑的轨迹偏离直线形成弧度或拱顶，与带棱角的折弯不同，其形态圆融、无锐折顶点。
groups.nuance_en: curve: follow or describe a continuous, smooth sweeping deviation from straightness (road / spine / trajectory) · arch: bend into a convex, vaulted, or semi-circular upward curve (eyebrow / bridge / back) · bow: incline the head or body forward in deference, or bend under load (head / knees / weight) · sweep round: curve grandly and broadly in space (river / road / staircase) · bend: flex gently away from linearity without angular rupture (beam / branch / river)
groups.nuance_zh: curve: 呈现自然流畅的曲线或沿弧度延展 (road / spine / trajectory) · arch: 向上弓起或跨越呈优美的拱门状 (eyebrow / bridge / back) · bow: 恭敬鞠躬垂首，或受重压向下弯拱 (head / knees / weight) · sweep round: 宏大而气派地大弧度蜿蜒绕过 (river / road / staircase) · bend: 树枝或梁柱受力柔性下弯 (beam / branch / river)

groups.name: Betray & Defect · 背叛与变节 (Betray, Defect, Sell out)
groups.tip: 倒戈叛变出卖信任

items.def_en: [I/T] to compromise one's principles or betray friends for personal gain
items.ex_en: Tickets sold out within minutes; fans later accused the band of selling out to commercial sponsors.
items.ex_zh: 门票几分钟内便售罄；乐迷们随后指责该乐队向商业赞助商出卖了艺术灵魂。

items.def_en: (+ sb) Betray someone's secrets or misdeeds to authorities
items.ex_en: The terrified suspect decided to rat out his accomplices to secure a reduced sentence.
items.ex_zh: 惊恐万状的嫌疑人决定向警方供出同伙，以争取获得减刑。

items.def_en: to deliberately deceive or betray an associate after pledging cooperation
items.ex_en: He tried to double-cross his business partners by secretly selling the company shares abroad.
items.ex_zh: 他企图通过暗中向海外变卖公司股份，来坑害背叛自己的合伙人。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Defect to an opposing faction, nation, or ideological camp
items.ex_en: Several prominent party members chose to go over to the opposition during the debate.
items.ex_zh: 辩论期间，几位重量级党员选择倒戈投靠反对派。

items.def_zh: 反目背叛；掉头对付（同伴）
items.def_en: (+ sb) Suddenly attack, betray, or show hostility toward a former friend or ally
items.ex_en: The stray dog suddenly turned on the feeder when he reached for its bowl.
items.ex_zh: 当喂食者伸手去拿食盆时，那只流浪狗突然反目扑了上来。

items.def_en: (+ from/to) to abandon one's country, party, or cause in favor of an opposing one
items.ex_en: The senior intelligence officer managed to defect to the neighboring country under heavy cover.
items.ex_zh: 那名高级情报官在严密掩护下成功叛逃到了邻国。

items.def_zh: 背叛，出卖；辜负；流露，暴露
items.def_en: 1. To be disloyal to someone who trusts you, or hand over your country or friends to an enemy. 2. To show or reveal feelings, thoughts, or information unintentionally.
items.ex_en: A slight tremor in her voice betrayed the deep anxiety she tried to conceal.
items.ex_zh: 她声音中轻微的颤抖流露出了她极力掩饰的深切焦虑。

items.def_zh: 背叛，叛变，脱离（信仰或组织）
items.def_en: (formal / dated) To abandon or renounce a religion, cause, or group, especially to become a traitor.
items.ex_en: Driven by bitter pride, the exiled knight chose to renegade from his sacred order.
items.ex_zh: 在痛苦自尊的驱使下，那位被流放的骑士选择背叛了他神圣的骑士团。

items.def_en: (formal) to renounce completely a religious, political, or ideological belief
items.ex_en: Under intense political persecution, the philosopher firmly refused to apostatize from his core beliefs.
items.ex_zh: 在严酷的政治迫害下，那位哲学家坚决拒绝背弃自己的核心信仰。

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote the violation of trust, sworn allegiance, or national loyalty. They scale in severity from surrendering comrades or transactional selling out to absolute geopolitical defection and high treason.
groups.summary_zh: 违背信任、背弃祖国或团体盟约，乃至变节叛国。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to the treacherous breach of allegiance, trust, or confidentiality to an ally or nation, separated from mere 'abandon' by active, hostile alignment with the opposing side.
groups.desc_zh: 指背弃对盟友、组织或国家的忠诚与信任，与单纯的“放弃”不同，往往伴随着投向敌对阵营或出卖核心利益的主动背刺。
groups.nuance_en: betray: violate fundamental trust, secrets, or loyalty to harm an ally (trust / secrets / country) · defect: renounce allegiance to one state or faction to join a rival (agent / diplomat / pilot) · sell out: betray integrity, comrades, or principles for monetary or selfish gain (cause / friends / principles) · rat out: inform on an associate to authorities to save oneself (accomplice / partner / gang) · double-cross: deceive and betray a co-conspirator after making a pact (partner / associates / ally)
groups.nuance_zh: betray: 辜负深层信任或出卖机密致盟友于死地 (trust / secrets / country) · defect: 叛逃投敌、脱离本国投奔敌对阵营 (agent / diplomat / pilot) · sell out: 为蝇头私利出卖组织、同志或原则 (cause / friends / principles) · rat out: 向当局告密出卖同伙自保 (accomplice / partner / gang) · double-cross: 表面与同谋结盟暗中设局黑吃黑 (partner / associates / ally)

groups.name: Bind & Restrict Physically · 捆绑与束缚 (Tighten, Blinker, Shackle)
groups.tip: 戴眼罩限制视野与行动

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Tie up tightly with rope, cord, or bandages so mobility is restricted
items.ex_en: The paramedic carefully bound up the deep wound to stem the bleeding.
items.ex_zh: 医护人员小心地包扎好深伤口以止血。

items.def_zh: 按倒制服；压制使其动弹不得
items.def_en: (+ sb) Hold someone firmly against a surface so they cannot move freely
items.ex_en: Two burly security guards rushed forward and pinned down the intruder on the carpet.
items.ex_zh: 两名身材魁梧的保安冲上前去，将闯入者死死按在地上动弹不得。

items.def_zh: （使）勒紧，绑紧，变紧；加强，收紧（管制等）
items.def_en: 1. To make something firmer, tighter, or more secure, or to become tighter. 2. To make rules, laws, or controls more strict.
items.ex_en: The mountaineer paused to tighten the leather straps on his heavy traveling backpack securely.
items.ex_zh: 登山者停下脚步，牢牢勒紧了沉重旅行背包上的皮带。
items.ex2_en: The steel mooring rope tightened visibly as the ferry drifted away from shore.
items.ex2_zh: 随着渡轮驶离岸边，钢系泊绳明显收紧了。

items.def_zh: 严密捆绑（使四肢无法活动）
items.def_en: (+ up) to tie up tightly with rope, securing the wings or limbs to prevent movement
items.ex_en: The chef demonstrated how to truss the chicken with kitchen twine before roasting it.
items.ex_zh: 厨师演示了在烘烤前如何用厨房棉绳将整只鸡紧紧捆绑固定。

items.def_zh: 给（马）戴眼罩；限制……的眼界，使目光狭隘
items.def_en: To put blinkers on a horse; to narrow someone's outlook or prevent them from seeing the full picture.
items.ex_en: Years of rigid ideological education had blinkered his view of the outside world completely.
items.ex_zh: 多年僵化的意识形态教育彻底限制了他的视野，使他目光狭隘。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Tie up someone's arms and legs tightly to immobilize them completely
items.ex_en: The captured burglars were found trussed up on the warehouse floor awaiting the police.
items.ex_zh: 被擒获的窃贼被发现五花大绑在仓库地面上，等待警察前来进行处理。

items.def_en: to fasten metal bands around someone's ankles or wrists to severely limit movement
items.ex_en: Prison guards shackled the dangerous convict's ankles before escorting him to the courtroom.
items.ex_zh: 狱警在押送这名危险囚犯前往法庭前，给他戴上了脚镣。

items.def_en: to place metal shackles or handcuffs upon someone's wrists
items.ex_en: Cold iron bands manacled the captive's slender wrists within the damp stone dungeon.
items.ex_zh: 潮湿阴暗的石牢里，冰冷的铁箍紧紧铐住了俘虏纤细的手腕。

items.def_en: to restrain with chains or manacles around the feet, totally immobilizing
items.ex_en: Heavy rusted chains fettered the doomed prisoner securely to the damp subterranean wall.
items.ex_zh: 沉重生锈的铁链将万劫不复的囚犯死死锁在潮湿的地下墙壁上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote applying physical restraints, bindings, or narrowing apparatuses to an entity to curtail its freedom of movement, field of view, or flexibility. They range from merely constricting bands to completely immobilizing joints with heavy gear.
groups.summary_zh: 使用绳索、镣铐或装置勒紧并限制人或动物的躯体自由。
groups.desc_en: Involves physically immobilizing someone using cords, bindings, or severe mechanical constraints, differing from abstract 'stop' by immediate corporeal incapacitation.
groups.desc_zh: 指使用绳索、布带或外部器械对肢体进行强行捆扎使其动弹不得，不同于抽象的“阻止”，是肉体层面的强制瘫痪。
groups.nuance_en: truss up: tie up tightly and helplessly, like poultry prepared for cooking (prisoner / hostage / limbs) · pin down: hold someone firmly against a surface to prevent movement, or suppress (opponent / soldier / arms) · shackle: fasten with metal bonds or heavily impede liberty (hands / legs / prisoner) · blinker: fit with side-blinders, or severely constrain visionary focus (horse / perspective / thinking) · bind up: wrap securely with cord, bandage, or ligature (wounds / hands / prisoner)
groups.nuance_zh: truss up: 像捆鸡鸭般五花大绑彻底剥夺反抗力 (prisoner / hostage / limbs) · pin down: 死死压制在地面或掩体下令其动弹不得 (opponent / soldier / arms) · shackle: 戴上铁铐脚镣或极度扼杀自由 (hands / legs / prisoner) · blinker: 戴上遮眼罩，比喻限制视野与偏狭固步 (horse / perspective / thinking) · bind up: 用绳带或绷带结结实实紧紧捆裹 (wounds / hands / prisoner)

groups.name: Block & Congest Physical Flow · 堵塞与淤塞 (Clog, Bottleneck, Congest)
groups.tip: 交通狭窄造成移动拥堵

items.def_en: to crowd into a tight space, or wedge something so tightly that flow or movement ceases
items.ex_en: Thousands of excited holiday shoppers jammed into the narrow entrance of the department store.
items.ex_zh: 成千上万兴奋的假日购物者把百货大楼狭窄的入口挤得水泄不通。
items.ex2_en: He jammed the emergency brake lever downward to avoid hitting the crossing pedestrian.
items.ex2_zh: 他猛力向下扳紧紧急制动手柄，以避免撞到过马路的行人。

items.def_en: to block, close up, or obstruct an opening or cavity (formal/technical)
items.ex_en: The surgeon used a specialized synthetic plug to obturate the abnormal vascular opening.
items.ex_zh: 外科医生使用特制的合成栓塞封堵了那处异常的血管孔道。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Become blocked with an accumulation of matter, or cause fluid or traffic to stop flowing
items.ex_en: Fallen autumn leaves can easily clog up the storm drains along the suburban streets.
items.ex_zh: 秋天的落叶很容易堵塞郊区街道两侧的雨水排水管道。
items.ex2_en: The kitchen sink will clog up if hair and grease accumulate inside constantly.
items.ex2_zh: 如果厨房水槽里持续堆积毛发和油脂，就会堵塞住。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Block a passage, machine, or channel completely through overcrowding or accumulation
items.ex_en: A single stalled car jammed up traffic for miles.
items.ex_zh: 一辆抛锚的车导致后方交通堵塞了数英里。
items.ex2_en: The office paper shredder jammed up when someone inserted heavy cardboard by mistake.
items.ex2_zh: 当有人误塞入厚纸板时，办公室碎纸机卡死了。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Obstruct or restrict the passage, supply, or flow of something severely
items.ex_en: The sudden military blockade threatened to choke off essential fuel shipments to the port.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的军事封锁面临着彻底切断港口关键燃油供应的危险。

items.def_en: (+ with/up) to fill a passage or system completely so that movement stops or slows dramatically
items.ex_en: The main highway was choked with bumper-to-bumper morning commuters during the heavy snowstorm.
items.ex_zh: 在大暴风雪中，主干道被早高峰接踵摩肩的通勤车辆堵得动弹不得。
items.ex2_en: Fallen leaves and twigs choked the narrow drainage pipe behind the garden shed.
items.ex2_zh: 落叶和细树枝堵塞了花园棚屋后面的狭窄排水管。

items.def_en: (often + up) To block or become blocked so that movement or flow is prevented or restricted.
items.ex_en: Grease and food scraps will inevitably clog the kitchen sink if not disposed properly.
items.ex_zh: 若不妥善处理，油脂和食物残渣难免会堵塞厨房的水槽。
items.ex2_en: The narrow mountain road clogs completely with tourist buses every single autumn weekend.
items.ex2_zh: 每个秋季周末，狭窄的山路都会被旅游大巴堵得水泄不通。

items.def_zh: 造成阻塞，成为瓶颈；受阻
items.def_en: To slow down, delay, or block movement, traffic, or progress by causing a bottleneck.
items.ex_en: Ongoing road repairs bottleneck the daily morning commute near the bridge every single week.
items.ex_zh: 持续的道路维修工程每周都会在该大桥附近造成严重的早高峰拥堵。
items.ex2_en: Traffic bottlenecks severely at the toll plaza during peak evening rush hours daily.
items.ex2_zh: 每天傍晚高峰时段，交通都会在收费广场严重形成瓶颈堵塞。

items.def_en: (often passive) To overcrowd or block a road, passage, or bodily organ so that movement or flow is hindered.
items.ex_en: Excessive seasonal traffic continues to congest the narrow historical streets of the coastal town.
items.ex_zh: 过量的旺季车流持续堵塞着这座沿海小镇狭窄的历史街区。
items.ex2_en: Commuter traffic congests heavily near the central train station every weekday morning.
items.ex2_zh: 每个工作日早晨，通勤车流都会在中央火车站附近严重拥堵。

groups.summary_en: Verbs describing the physical or infrastructural constriction of fluid, vehicular, or logistical passage caused by buildup, narrowing, or overwhelming volume.
groups.summary_zh: 指因杂物堆积、通道变窄或负荷过大导致物理或交通流动受阻。
groups.desc_en: Describes the occlusion or slowing of a conduit's fluid or traffic flow by an accumulation of debris or narrowing of apertures, distinguishing itself from total 'close' by progressive stoppage.
groups.desc_zh: 指管道或通道因杂物堆积淤塞或孔径缩紧导致流体、人流淤滞，区别于干净利落的“关闭”，是渐进式的阻滞梗阻。
groups.nuance_en: clog: choke a passage or filter with viscous, sticky, or tangled waste (pipes / arteries / drains) · jam: wedge or crowd into a confined space until motion becomes impossible (mechanism / gears / traffic) · bottleneck: constrict a broader flow into a narrow point, stalling movement (traffic / production / supply chain) · choke off: strangle or throttle a supply or channel completely (supply / funds / trade) · obturate: medically or technically plug or seal an orifice tightly (aperture / artery / cavity)
groups.nuance_zh: clog: 粘稠碎屑或污垢堵塞滤网管道 (pipes / arteries / drains) · jam: 物件卡壳或拥挤不堪致使机构卡死动不了 (mechanism / gears / traffic) · bottleneck: 通道由宽变窄形成瓶颈节点压车阻滞 (traffic / production / supply chain) · choke off: 掐断供应链或资金输送渠道 (supply / funds / trade) · obturate: 医学或军工上严实封闭孔道或闭锁管腔 (aperture / artery / cavity)

groups.name: Blur & Obscure · 模糊与遮蔽 (Blur, Mist, Obscure)
groups.tip: 轮廓边界不清难以辨认

items.def_zh: 使蒙上阴影；使混浊/模糊
items.def_en: to make something less transparent, clear, or easy to understand
items.ex_en: Bitter jealousy began to cloud his professional judgment when dealing with his rival's proposal.
items.ex_zh: 在处理竞争对手的方案时，强烈的嫉妒心开始扰乱他的专业判断。
items.ex2_en: The clear mountain lake waters clouded rapidly after heavy rain washed soil down.
items.ex2_zh: 大雨冲刷下泥土后，清澈的高山湖水迅速变得浑浊。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Become covered with mist, steam, or moisture so as to obscure vision
items.ex_en: His spectacles fogged up immediately as soon as he stepped into the warm kitchen.
items.ex_zh: 他刚踏进温暖的厨房，眼镜片上立刻蒙上了一层水汽。
items.ex2_en: Boiling pasta on the stove quickly fogged up the cold kitchen window glass.
items.ex2_zh: 在炉子上煮意面很快使冰冷的厨房窗玻璃蒙上了水汽。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Become hazy, obscure, or indistinct in transparency or clarity
items.ex_en: The clear afternoon sky began to cloud over, hinting at an approaching summer thunderstorm.
items.ex_zh: 午后晴朗的天空开始阴沉下来，预示着一场夏季雷阵雨即将到来。
items.ex2_en: Sadness and grief clouded over her cheerful expression during the somber memorial service.
items.ex2_zh: 在肃穆的追悼会期间，悲伤和痛苦阴郁地笼罩了她开朗的表情。

items.def_zh: 将…模糊处理；使轮廓模糊不清
items.def_en: (+ sth) Make an image or boundary indistinct and indistinctly defined
items.ex_en: The editor had to blur out sensitive license plate numbers before broadcasting the video.
items.ex_zh: 在播出视频之前，剪辑师必须对敏感的车牌号码进行模糊处理。

items.def_en: to make something difficult to see, hear, or understand by covering or clouding it
items.ex_en: Thick drifting smoke from the nearby factory obscured the historic church tower from view.
items.ex_zh: 附近工厂飘出的浓烟遮挡住了那座历史悠久的教堂钟楼。

items.def_en: to cover a surface with condensed vapor or make a situation confusing and unclear
items.ex_en: Cold ocean moisture quickly fogged the car windshield as night fell over the coast.
items.ex_zh: 夜幕降临海岸，冰冷的海面湿气迅速让汽车挡风玻璃起了一层雾。
items.ex2_en: The bathroom mirror fogged immediately when hot water poured from the shower head.
items.ex2_zh: 当热水从花洒喷出时，浴室镜子立刻起雾了。

items.raw_cluster: 使模糊与遮蔽 Blur & Obscure
items.def_zh: （使）变模糊，（使）看不清；（使）界限不清
items.def_en: 1. To become, or make something become, unclear, indistinct, or hard to see and distinguish.
items.ex_en: Fatigue caused the printed words on the textbook page to blur before her eyes.
items.ex_zh: 过度疲劳导致课本页面上的印刷字迹在她眼前变得模糊不清。
items.ex2_en: Pouring heavy rain blurred the street lights outside his bedroom window tonight.
items.ex2_zh: 今晚倾盆大雨模糊了他卧室窗外的街灯。

items.def_zh: （使）蒙上雾气，（使）视线模糊；下薄雾
items.def_en: 1. (often + over/up) To become, or make something become, covered with tiny drops of moisture so that vision or a surface is blurred.
items.ex_en: Hot rising steam from the boiling kettle quickly misted the nearby window panes completely.
items.ex_zh: 水壶沸腾升起的热蒸汽迅速使附近的所有窗玻璃蒙上了一层水雾。
items.ex2_en: The bathroom mirror misted quickly from the hot steam of the morning shower.
items.ex2_zh: 浴室镜子在晨浴的热蒸汽中迅速蒙上了雾气。

items.def_en: to make or become less bright, clear, or distinct
items.ex_en: The theater staff slowly dimmed the chandelier lights as the evening performance finally began.
items.ex_zh: 随着晚间演出正式开始，剧院工作人员缓缓调暗了吊灯的灯光。
items.ex2_en: The room lights dimmed gradually as evening shadows stretched across the quiet library.
items.ex2_zh: 随着暮色阴影蔓延在安静的图书馆，室内的灯光渐渐暗了下来。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to optical, physical, or cognitive processes that make an image, shape, distinction, or meaning indistinct, hazy, or impossible to perceive clearly.
groups.summary_zh: 指由于薄雾、阻挡或混淆使轮廓、视线或认知变得模糊不清。
groups.desc_en: Refers to degrading the visual clarity, sharpness, or cognitive discernibility of an image or thought through vapor, lack of focus, or screening, contrasting with complete 'hide' by diminished visibility rather than disappearance.
groups.desc_zh: 指借助水汽、失焦或遮蔽物降低图像或思维的轮廓清晰度与可辨识度，不同于彻底的“隐藏”，是让轮廓变得昏暗虚蒙。
groups.nuance_en: blur: make indistinct or smudged along edges, losing sharp optical or conceptual focus (vision / lines / distinction) · obscure: conceal or make difficult to perceive clearly by blocking light or meaning (view / sun / truth) · fog up: cover a glass surface with tiny condensed moisture droplets (windshield / glasses / mirror) · cloud: darken or render turbid with particulate matter or brooding doubt (liquid / judgment / issue) · mist: cover with a fine diffuse spray, or grow gently dim (eyes / windshield / lens)
groups.nuance_zh: blur: 边界失焦化开，使线条或概念界限模糊 (vision / lines / distinction) · obscure: 挡住视线、遮蔽光亮或使事实晦涩难明 (view / sun / truth) · fog up: 玻璃遇温差起热气凝结白茫茫一层水雾 (windshield / glasses / mirror) · cloud: 浮悬物使液体浑浊，或阴云笼罩心智判断 (liquid / judgment / issue) · mist: 笼罩上一层薄薄细雾或泪眼迷蒙 (eyes / windshield / lens)

groups.name: Bodily Restraint & Physical Shackling · 械具拘禁与强力束缚 (Manacle, Straiten)
groups.tip: 戴上手铐限制人身自由

items.def_en: (+ sb) Confine someone securely in a prison cell or under physical restraint
items.ex_en: The local authorities decided to lock up the violent offender until his trial date.
items.ex_zh: 地方当局决定将这名暴力犯罪分子关押起来，直至受审之日。

items.def_en: (+ sb) Restrict someone's physical freedom by fastening them securely with ropes or straps
items.ex_en: He didn't want to buy a house because he hated being tied down to one location.
items.ex_zh: 他不想买房，因为讨厌被束缚在同一个地方。

items.def_en: to fasten someone's hands together using a pair of metal rings joined by a chain
items.ex_en: The arresting officer quickly handcuffed the unruly suspect behind his back without any resistance.
items.ex_zh: 逮捕人员迅速将这名抗拒执法的嫌疑人双手反铐在背后，未遇抵抗。

items.def_zh: 限制，束缚；使陷入困境，使贫困
items.def_en: To restrict someone's freedom or scope; to cause severe financial hardship or distress to.
items.ex_en: Harsh economic conditions straitened the once-prosperous merchant family into living in severe poverty.
items.ex_zh: 严峻的经济形势使这个曾经显赫的商人家族陷入困顿，过着极度贫苦的生活。

items.def_en: (+ sb) Fasten or restrain someone securely to a fixed point using chains
items.ex_en: The captive giant was chained down to the stone pillars with massive iron links.
items.ex_zh: 被俘的巨人被巨大的铁链牢牢地锁在石柱上，动弹不得。

items.def_en: to put physical metal shackles on someone's limbs to prevent movement
items.ex_en: The guards shackled the prisoner before marching him through the courtyard toward the cell.
items.ex_zh: 卫兵在押送囚犯穿过院子前往牢房前，给他套上了沉重的枷锁。

items.def_en: to bind the feet or body of a prisoner with heavy chains or shackles
items.ex_en: Cruel tyrants fettered the rebellious poet, leaving him to wither away in the darkness.
items.ex_zh: 残暴的统治者给这位叛逆的诗人套上沉重的脚镣，任由他在黑暗中枯萎消逝。

items.def_zh: 给……戴上手铐（或镣铐）；束缚，限制
items.def_en: To fasten someone's hands or ankles with metal chains or handcuffs; to severely restrict freedom.
items.ex_en: The royal guards ruthlessly manacled the rebel leader and dragged him before the throne.
items.ex_zh: 皇家卫兵无情地铐住叛军首领的双手，将他一路拖到了王座面前。

items.def_en: to restrain violently agitated persons by securing them in a strong canvas jacket
items.ex_en: Medical orderlies had to straitjacket the violently thrashing patient for everyone's mutual safety.
items.ex_zh: 为了大家的安全，医护人员不得不给剧烈挣扎的病人穿上拘束衣。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the physical constriction or immobilization of a person using mechanical restraints, chains, or confining garments, severely limiting their bodily mobility.
groups.summary_zh: 使用手铐、脚镣或紧身拘束衣等物理械具对人身体进行强制拘禁与活动限制。
groups.desc_en: Focuses specifically on the punitive or formal law-enforcement application of ironmongery, handcuffs, or carceral restraint to limbs, distinguishing from casual tying by rigid, mechanical, institutional immobilization.
groups.desc_zh: 专指执法、司法语境下使用金属械具对罪犯肢体施加的机械式禁锢，区别于随意的绳绑，具有刚性、制式与剥夺权利的特征。
groups.nuance_en: handcuff: secure a person’s wrists together using keyed metal clasps (suspect / prisoner / wrists) · shackle: bind a prisoner's ankles or wrists with iron loops and chain (inmates / legs / hands) · manacle: lock metal cuffs onto the hands or wrists authoritatively (hands / feet / captives) · fetter: chain someone's feet to severely restrict walking stride (slaves / prisoners / movement) · tie down: anchor firmly to an immovable object with ropes or obligations (cargo / patient / resources)
groups.nuance_zh: handcuff: 警察使用制式手铐拷住手腕 (suspect / prisoner / wrists) · shackle: 用沉重脚镣手枷锁死囚徒肢体 (inmates / legs / hands) · manacle: 官方用金属枷锁扣紧犯人手脚 (hands / feet / captives) · fetter: 锁住足踝使步幅受限无法奔跑 (slaves / prisoners / movement) · tie down: 紧紧栓缚固定在物体上动弹不得 (cargo / patient / resources)

groups.name: Bottle, Can & Package · 装瓶、装罐与封装
groups.tip: 把散装物料装入瓶罐封装

items.def_zh: 把（食物或饮料）装罐保存
items.def_en: to preserve fruit, vegetables, or drinks by sealing them in airtight metal cans
items.ex_en: Every autumn, the family works together to can freshly harvested peaches for the winter.
items.ex_zh: 每年秋天，这家人都会一起动手把新采摘的桃子装罐，以备过冬。

items.def_en: to put items into bags or pouches for retail packaging or storage
items.ex_en: Cashiers carefully bag fragile groceries into reusable canvas sacks at the checkout counter.
items.ex_zh: 收银员在结账台仔细地将易碎食品装入可重复使用的帆布购物袋中。

items.def_zh: 把……装瓶；抑制，压抑（感情，通常作 bottle up）
items.def_en: 1. To put liquid or other products into bottles. 2. (bottle up) To repress or conceal strong emotions.
items.ex_en: The traditional winery bottles thousands of liters of premium vintage red wine each season.
items.ex_zh: 这家传统酒庄每个季度都会将数千升优质陈年红葡萄酒灌装入瓶。

items.def_zh: 包装，把……打包；把……组合包装销售
items.def_en: 1. To put something into a box, bag, or wrapping, especially for sale or transport. 2. To present or sell a set of things together as a unit.
items.ex_en: Workers carefully package the delicate handmade ceramics using thick protective bubble wrap for shipping.
items.ex_zh: 工人们用厚厚的保护性气泡膜仔细包装精致的手工陶瓷，以备运输。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Put liquid into bottles for preservation or sale
items.ex_en: The craft brewery bottles up the freshly fermented cider before shipping it to stores.
items.ex_zh: 这家精酿酒厂在将新发酵的苹果酒运往商店前，先将其装入瓶中。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Put items or goods into boxes ready for storage, transport, or sale
items.ex_en: Before moving out, we spent three days boxing up all our books and clothes.
items.ex_zh: 搬家前，我们花了三天时间把所有的书和衣服打包入箱。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Put goods or belongings into containers or parcels ready for dispatch
items.ex_en: It's five o'clock—let's pack up and go home.
items.ex_zh: 已经五点了——咱们收拾收拾回家吧。

items.def_zh: 把（果酱、蜂蜜等）装入玻璃罐中
items.def_en: to put food or preserves into glass jars for storage or sale
items.ex_en: She spent the sunny afternoon jarring homemade strawberry jam in the rustic farmhouse kitchen.
items.ex_zh: 在阳光明媚的下午，她在质朴的农舍厨房里把自制草莓酱装进玻璃罐中。

items.def_en: chiefly BrE to preserve food by putting it into airtight tins
items.ex_en: Local processing factories tin fresh sardines right after the fishing boats dock each morning.
items.ex_zh: 每天早晨渔船靠岸后，当地加工厂便立即将新鲜沙丁鱼制成罐头保存。

groups.summary_en: Refers to processing liquids or processed goods into retail-ready containers such as bottles, cans, or pre-measured sealed packets for distribution and sale.
groups.summary_zh: 将液体或加工商品分装入瓶、罐或预装包中以备销售。
groups.desc_en: Enclosing, sealing, or packaging commodities into rigid or flexible receptacles for preservation, retail, or storage, contrasting with generic filling or wrapping.
groups.desc_zh: 将物品装入刚性或柔性容器并封装以供储存、保鲜或销售，区别于宽泛的填充或包扎。
groups.nuance_en: bottle: seal liquids into glass or plastic flasks (wine / beer / sauce) · can: hermetically preserve food or drink in metal tins (fruit / soup / beer) · bag: put loose items into flexible sacks or pouches (groceries / flour / leaves) · package: assemble and wrap goods for commercial distribution (products / kits / bundles) · jar: seal preserves or viscous foods into glass pots (jam / pickles / honey)
groups.nuance_zh: bottle: 将液体装入玻璃或塑料瓶中密封 (wine / beer / sauce) · can: 将食品或饮料灌入金属罐密封保鲜 (fruit / soup / beer) · bag: 将散装物品装入纸袋或塑料袋 (groceries / flour / leaves) · package: 将货品封装打包以便商业流通 (products / kits / bundles) · jar: 将果酱或腌菜装入玻璃广口罐 (jam / pickles / honey)

groups.name: Broadcast & Transmit via Media · 广播与媒介传播 (Broadcast, Air, Stream)
groups.tip: 电台与电视信号的远距离播送

items.def_en: to broadcast a programme on television or radio
items.ex_en: The national network will air the investigative documentary tomorrow night at eight.
items.ex_zh: 国家电视网将于明晚八点播出这部调查纪录片。
items.ex2_en: The popular historical drama airs weekly on television across the entire country.
items.ex2_zh: 这部热播历史剧每周都在全国各地的电视上播出。

items.def_zh: 在线流媒体播放，网络直播
items.def_en: to transmit or receive continuous video or audio data over the internet
items.ex_en: Millions of dedicated fans stream the championship matches live on their mobile devices.
items.ex_zh: 数百万狂热球迷在他们的移动设备上在线观看锦标赛直播。
items.ex2_en: The live concert streams flawlessly over fast broadband connections without any lag.
items.ex2_zh: 现场音乐会通过高速宽带连接流畅推流播放，没有任何卡顿。

items.def_zh: 广播，播放（电视或电台节目）；散播，广而告之；播撒（种子）
items.def_en: 1. To transmit programmes or information by radio or television. 2. To tell a large number of people about something. 3. To scatter seeds widely over the ground.
items.ex_en: Radio stations nationwide broadcast emergency weather alerts during the severe winter storm.
items.ex_zh: 在严重的冬季风暴期间，全国各地的广播电台播送了紧急天气预警。
items.ex2_en: The radio station broadcasts continuously throughout the quiet nighttime hours without commercial interruptions.
items.ex2_zh: 该广播电台在寂静的夜间持续播出，没有商业广告插播。

items.def_en: to broadcast a program simultaneously across multiple channels or media
items.ex_en: The charity concert will simulcast across several major television networks and digital platforms.
items.ex_zh: 这场慈善音乐会将在几大主要电视网络和数字平台同步联播。

items.def_zh: 播送；发射（无线电或电视信号）
items.def_en: (+ sth) transmit a radio, television, or digital signal over a wide area
items.ex_en: The orbital satellite will beam out digital television signals to remote rural communities.
items.ex_zh: 这颗轨道卫星将向偏远农村社区发射数字电视信号。

items.def_en: (+ sth) broadcast or issue a program, statement, or media message to the public
items.ex_en: The public broadcaster put out a special news bulletin regarding the unexpected crisis.
items.ex_zh: 公共广播电台就这起突发危机播发了一份特别新闻公报。

items.def_en: to receive a broadcast signal and transmit it onward to a broader audience
items.ex_en: Local affiliate stations will relay the national feed directly to regional household viewers.
items.ex_zh: 地方附属电台将把全国信号直接转播给各地区的家庭观众。

items.def_en: To broadcast an event, sports match, or programme on television.
items.ex_en: Broadcasters agreed to televise the international rugby final to over fifty different countries.
items.ex_zh: 广播公司同意向五十多个国家电视转播国际橄榄球决赛。

items.def_zh: 通过电视播送，电视转播
items.def_en: To broadcast a programme or event on television.
items.ex_en: The sports channel will telecast every game of the tournament in high definition.
items.ex_zh: 该体育频道将以高清画质电视播送该锦标赛的每一场比赛。

groups.summary_en: Verbs referring to transmitting audio, video, or electronic signals to a public audience via radio, television, or digital networks.
groups.summary_zh: 通过无线电、电视或网络向公众播送音视频内容。
groups.desc_en: Transmitting audiovisual signals or content across electronic or digital networks to mass audiences, contrasting with one-on-one telecommunication or private screening.
groups.desc_zh: 通过电子或数字网络向大众受众分发视听内容，区别于点对点通信或私人放映。
groups.nuance_en: broadcast: distribute widely via terrestrial radio or TV airwaves (news / speech / program) · air: transmit a scheduled radio or television broadcast (episode / interview / commercial) · stream: deliver continuous digital media over the internet in real time (content / music / concert) · televise: capture and broadcast an event specifically via television (game / trial / ceremony) · relay: receive a broadcast signal and retransmit it onward (signal / feed / broadcast)
groups.nuance_zh: broadcast: 通过无线电或电视电波广域公开发送 (news / speech / program) · air: 排播或公映广播电视节目 (episode / interview / commercial) · stream: 通过互联网实时流式传输数字媒体 (content / music / concert) · televise: 专门通过电视媒介摄录并转播现场 (game / trial / ceremony) · relay: 接收广播信号并向外中继转播 (signal / feed / broadcast)

groups.name: Browse & Flip Through · 浏览与翻阅 (Scan, Thumb, Leaf through)
groups.tip: 随性浏览视线快速掠过

items.def_en: to turn the pages of a book, magazine, or document quickly, reading only fragments
items.ex_en: She sat quietly in the waiting room to leaf through the colorful fashion magazines.
items.ex_zh: 她静静地坐在候诊室里，匆匆翻阅着色彩斑斓的时尚杂志。

items.def_zh: 浏览，翻阅；随意翻看（商品等）；（动物）吃草
items.def_en: 1. (+ through) To look casually through books, shops, or websites without searching for anything specific. 2. (zoology) (of animals) To feed on leaves, twigs, or other vegetation.
items.ex_en: Customers often browse through the vintage record collections on lazy Sunday afternoons.
items.ex_zh: 顾客们经常在慵懒的周日下午随手翻看那些复古黑胶唱片。

items.def_en: (+ sth) read, listen to, or examine short parts of a book or collection casually without reading the whole
items.ex_en: Whenever she has a spare moment, she likes to dip into poetry collections.
items.ex_zh: 只要有空闲时间，她就喜欢随便翻翻诗集。

items.def_en: to turn over pages or glance through items in rapid succession
items.ex_en: I flipped through the magazine while waiting for my coffee.
items.ex_zh: 在等咖啡的时候，我随手翻了翻杂志。

items.def_en: to read or examine something very quickly and cursorily
items.ex_en: The manager agreed to glance through the financial summary before the afternoon presentation.
items.ex_zh: 经理同意在下午的汇报之前大略扫视一遍财务摘要。

items.def_en: (+ sth) examine or flip through written materials, documents, or a collection quickly
items.ex_en: Investigators carefully look through old municipal archives to find the missing property deeds.
items.ex_zh: 调查人员快速翻阅旧市政档案，以寻找失踪的产权契约。

items.def_zh: 翻阅，随手翻看；竖起拇指要求搭车
items.def_en: (also 'thumb through') To turn the pages of a book or magazine quickly and casually with your thumb.
items.ex_en: Bored commuters thumb through glossy promotional catalogs while waiting for the morning train.
items.ex_zh: 无聊的通勤者在等早班火车时随手翻看着光鲜的宣传手册。

items.def_zh: 略读，浏览；掠过，擦过；撇去（浮沫等）
items.def_en: 1. (+ through/over) To read a text quickly to get the main idea. 2. To move lightly and quickly just above or over a surface. 3. To remove cream, scum, or fat from the surface of a liquid.
items.ex_en: Students skim through the introductory chapter to understand the core arguments of the book.
items.ex_zh: 学生们略读导言章节，以了解该书的核心论点。

items.def_en: to look through a text rapidly to locate specific information or grasp key points
items.ex_en: He had to scan the lengthy flight roster to spot his client's name quickly.
items.ex_zh: 他必须快速扫读冗长的航班名单，以便迅速找到客户的名字。

items.def_en: Turn pages of a publication quickly with one's thumb while browsing
items.ex_en: Passengers often thumb through glossy travel magazines while waiting at the airport gate.
items.ex_zh: 乘客在机场登机口候机时经常随手翻阅精美的旅游杂志。

groups.summary_en: An agent inspects written, printed, or visual material rapidly and superficially without reading exhaustively, often turning pages casually or searching for specific items. Verbs vary in whether physical pages are manipulated (thumb, flip) or text is visually glanced over (skim, scan).
groups.summary_zh: 不作通读地快速扫视文本或翻阅书页。
groups.desc_en: Examining text, merchandise, or media cursorily and selectively without sustained, rigorous absorption, contrasting with methodical reading or deep study.
groups.desc_zh: 走马观花式地粗略翻阅或随性挑选文本、商品或媒体，区别于系统研读或精读。
groups.nuance_en: browse: wander casually through items or pages with open-ended interest (shelves / racks / websites) · leaf through: turn pages rapidly and sequentially, glancing briefly (magazine / catalog / book) · thumb: turn pages rapidly using the thumb, often seeking something specific (pages / dictionary / manuscript) · skim: read surface text swiftly to glean the main gist (report / headlines / article) · dip into: sample small portions of a text intermittently (novel / poetry / essay)
groups.nuance_zh: browse: 漫无目的地闲看商品或随意浏览网页 (shelves / racks / websites) · leaf through: 飞快地翻动书页走马观花 (magazine / catalog / book) · thumb: 用大拇指快速翻阅查找 (pages / dictionary / manuscript) · skim: 快速略读以抓取大意主旨 (report / headlines / article) · dip into: 浮光掠影地浅尝翻读片断 (novel / poetry / essay)

groups.name: Bungle & Botch · 笨拙搞砸 (Bungle, Botch, Muff)
groups.tip: 笨手笨脚把事情彻底搞砸

items.def_zh: 手足无措地漏接；笨拙失误
items.def_en: [I/T] to handle something clumsily, especially dropping a ball or mismanaging an open opportunity
items.ex_en: The rookie receiver managed to fumble the ball near the opponent's goal line.
items.ex_zh: 这名新秀接球手在对手球门线附近笨手笨脚地漏掉了球。

items.def_en: to fail to perform or speak smoothly, especially forgetting lines or miscueing a shot
items.ex_en: The nervous young actor fluffed his opening lines in front of the audience.
items.ex_zh: 这位紧张的年轻演员在观众面前念错了开场台词。

items.def_zh: 弄糟，搞砸；错失（良机、接球等）
items.def_en: to mishandle, bungle, or ruin something through clumsiness, such as a catch, shot, or opportunity
items.ex_en: The striker muffed an easy chance to score the winning goal in stoppage time.
items.ex_zh: 那名前锋在补时阶段错失了一个打进致胜一球的绝佳良机。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Thoroughly ruin or botch something through incompetence or carelessness
items.ex_en: The inexperienced project manager managed to cock up the entire production schedule.
items.ex_zh: 缺乏经验的项目经理把整个生产进度搞得一团糟。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Mismanage or bungle an operation, plan, or system completely
items.ex_en: A single minor accounting error can foul up the entire company payroll system.
items.ex_zh: 一个微小的会计差错就可能彻底搞乱整个公司的薪资系统。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Spoil, botch, or handle an opportunity or task badly
items.ex_en: Don't mess up this valuable job interview by arriving twenty minutes late.
items.ex_zh: 别因为迟到二十分钟而搞砸了这次宝贵的求职面试。

items.def_zh: 搞砸，笨手笨脚地把…弄糟
items.def_en: to do something badly, clumsily, or carelessly, often ruining an attempt or task
items.ex_en: The clumsy thieves bungled the bank robbery and fled empty-handed into the night.
items.ex_zh: 笨手笨脚的盗贼们搞砸了抢劫银行的计划，两手空空地逃入夜色中。

items.def_en: [I/T] to mismanage or ruin a situation completely through stupidity or carelessness
items.ex_en: He knew that one wrong step during the negotiation would screw up everything.
items.ex_zh: 他知道在谈判中走错一步就会把一切都彻底搞砸。

items.def_en: to spoil something completely through poor workmanship, carelessness, or lack of skill
items.ex_en: The dishonest mechanics botched the engine repair and charged exorbitant rates anyway.
items.ex_zh: 那些黑心修理工拙劣地修坏了发动机，却仍然收取了过高的费用。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe spoiling a task, chance, or project through incompetence, clumsiness, or poor coordination. 'Muff' emphasizes mishandling a fleeting opportunity or simple physical execution, whereas 'bungle' and 'botch' imply thoroughly mishandling a complex operation or repair.
groups.summary_zh: 指因愚笨、笨拙或失职而彻底弄糟任务或错失良机。
groups.desc_en: Failing to execute an action properly due to clumsiness, poor judgment, or incompetence, contrasting with unavoidable external misfortune.
groups.desc_zh: 因笨拙、失误或无能而将原本可行的事情办砸弄糟，区别于不可抗的外在厄运。
groups.nuance_en: bungle: ruin an operation or task through sheer ineptitude (investigation / raid / negotiation) · botch: execute a repair or constructive task clumsily and defectively (job / surgery / repair) · muff: miss or spoil a golden physical or opportunistic chance (catch / line / opportunity) · fumble: handle awkwardly or drop physically or metaphorically (ball / answer / key) · screw up: make a serious, blundering mess of a situation (schedule / relationship / life)
groups.nuance_zh: bungle: 因愚蠢拙劣或无能而搞砸事务 (investigation / raid / negotiation) · botch: 做工粗劣将修造任务弄成残次品 (job / surgery / repair) · muff: 笨手笨脚地错失良机或失误 (catch / line / opportunity) · fumble: 笨拙摸索或掉落失误 (ball / answer / key) · screw up: 彻底把局势弄得一团糟 (schedule / relationship / life)

groups.name: Burn to Destruction · 焦灼与焚毁 (Singe, Ash, Incinerate)
groups.tip: 火焰灼烧最终化为灰烬

items.def_zh: 烧焦，烤焦（表面）；轻微烧灼
items.def_en: To burn something slightly, especially on the surface or edge.
items.ex_en: Be careful near the campfire so you do not singe your wool jacket.
items.ex_zh: 在篝火旁要小心，别烤焦了你的羊毛夹克。

items.def_en: [T/I] to damage a surface with heat, changing its color or texture without destroying it
items.ex_en: The hot iron accidentally scorched the delicate silk fabric of her favorite blouse.
items.ex_zh: 滚烫的熨斗不小心灼焦了她最喜爱的衬衫那娇贵的丝绸面料。
items.ex2_en: The delicate cotton cloth scorched quickly when it touched the glowing metal coil.
items.ex2_zh: 轻柔的棉布碰到发热发红的金属线圈时迅速烧焦了。

items.def_en: [T/I] to burn something until it becomes black carbon throughout its surface or structure
items.ex_en: The intense grill heat began to char the seasoned wooden skewers quite rapidly.
items.ex_zh: 烤架的高温很快便开始将调好味的竹签表面烧成焦炭。
items.ex2_en: The crust of the artisanal sourdough bread charred pleasantly inside the wood-fired oven.
items.ex2_zh: 手工酵母面包的外皮在柴火烤箱里烧烤出令人愉悦的焦黑酥皮。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Remove or destroy something completely through the action of heat or flames
items.ex_en: Acid had burned away part of the metal surface.
items.ex_zh: 酸液腐蚀烧掉了部分金属表面。
items.ex2_en: The morning mist gradually burned away as bright sunlight warmed the valley.
items.ex2_zh: 随着明媚的阳光温暖山谷，晨雾逐渐消散了。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Destroy the interior of a structure or machine completely by fire
items.ex_en: Arsonists set fire to the warehouse and completely burned out the interior structures.
items.ex_zh: 纵火犯点燃了仓库，将内部结构彻底烧成了空壳。

items.def_zh: 使化为灰烬；弹（香烟等）灰
items.def_en: 1. To burn or reduce something to ashes. 2. To flick ash from a cigarette or cigar.
items.ex_en: He stood by the balcony rail to ash his cigar into the garden.
items.ex_zh: 他站在阳台栏杆旁，把雪茄烟灰弹进了花园里。

items.def_en: to burn a dead body completely to ashes in a furnace
items.ex_en: The family decided to cremate the deceased according to his explicit final wishes.
items.ex_zh: 家属决定按照逝者生前的明确遗愿将其遗体火化。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Destroy or be destroyed completely by fire down to the ground
items.ex_en: Faulty electrical wiring caused the historic timber barn to burn down completely overnight.
items.ex_zh: 老化的电线导致这座历史悠久的木结构谷仓在一夜之间被彻底焚毁。
items.ex2_en: Reckless rioters burned down several abandoned commercial buildings during the midnight protest.
items.ex2_zh: 不计后果的暴徒在午夜抗议期间烧毁了几座废弃的商业建筑。

items.def_en: to burn waste or material completely until nothing remains but ash
items.ex_en: The municipal plant must incinerate hazardous hospital waste at extremely high temperatures.
items.ex_zh: 市政处理厂必须在极高温度下焚毁危险的医院垃圾。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate destructive thermal destruction, progressing in severity from superficial singeing of outer edges to total consumption and reduction to ash.
groups.summary_zh: 热能毁灭性破坏程度的递增，从仅燎焦边缘表面到化为灰烬或彻底焚毁。
groups.desc_en: Subjecting matter to progressive thermal damage culminating in partial blackened transformation or total reduction to ash, contrasting with mere warming or controlled cooking.
groups.desc_zh: 使物体遭受渐进的热力破坏，直至表面焦黑或彻底化为灰烬，区别于温和加热或受控烹饪。
groups.nuance_en: singe: burn superficially, especially the surface fibers, hair, or edges (eyebrows / feather / edge) · scorch: discolor, dry out, or burn a surface with brief intense heat (earth / iron / grass) · char: blacken and convert partially into carbon by heat (wood / meat / ruins) · burn down: consume a structure entirely by fire to ground level (building / house / forest) · cremate: incinerate a dead body to ashes ceremonially (corpse / remains / body)
groups.nuance_zh: singe: 浅表性微灼烧焦边缘或毛发 (eyebrows / feather / edge) · scorch: 短暂高温烤焦物体表面致其发黄变脆 (earth / iron / grass) · char: 烧焦碳化使其变黑成炭 (wood / meat / ruins) · burn down: 将建筑物完全焚毁倒塌至地基 (building / house / forest) · cremate: 庄严地火化焚化遗体 (corpse / remains / body)

groups.name: Calm & Pacify · 平息与抚慰 (Soothe, Placate, Appease, Mollify)
groups.tip: 安抚躁动情绪以恢复内心的宁静

items.def_en: to make someone or something calm and peaceful, or to become calm
items.ex_en: Soft classical melodies usually calm anxious passengers during turbulent commercial flights.
items.ex_zh: 柔和的古典旋律通常能在商业航班颠簸时抚平焦虑乘客的情绪。
items.ex2_en: After hours of raging wind, the stormy sea finally began to calm.
items.ex2_zh: 狂风肆虐数小时后，汹涌的大海终于开始平静下来。

items.def_en: (+ sb) Make someone less angry, excited, or agitated, or become quiet and relaxed
items.ex_en: The teacher gently urged the excited children to calm down before class began.
items.ex_zh: 老师温和地催促兴奋的孩子们在开始上课前平静下来。
items.ex2_en: A cup of warm chamomile tea can quickly calm down stressed office workers.
items.ex2_zh: 一杯温热的洋甘菊茶能迅速让压力沉重的上班族平静下来。

items.def_en: (+ sb) Become or cause someone to become less excited, angry, or emotional
items.ex_en: Give him a few minutes to cool down before discussing the issue.
items.ex_zh: 在讨论这个问题之前，先给他几分钟冷静一下。
items.ex2_en: A cold drink will cool down the exhausted marathon runners after finishing.
items.ex2_zh: 一杯冷饮会让跑完马拉松后筋疲力竭的跑者们冷静降温。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Become or cause to become calmer, less noisy, or less agitated
items.ex_en: The noisy puppy eventually began to quiet down as midnight approached outside.
items.ex_zh: 随着午夜临近，外面喧闹的小狗终于开始安静了下来。
items.ex2_en: The soothing lullaby quickly quieted down the crying baby in the nursery.
items.ex2_zh: 舒缓的摇篮曲迅速使育儿室里哭闹的婴儿安静了下来。

items.def_en: to gently calm feelings of distress, pain, or irritation
items.ex_en: Her gentle whisper managed to soothe the frightened toddler after the loud thunderstorm.
items.ex_zh: 在轰鸣的雷暴过后，她温柔的轻语安抚了受惊的幼儿。

items.def_zh: 姑息，平息（通让步满足要求）
items.def_en: to pacify or placate someone by acceding to their demands
items.ex_en: The prime minister refused to appease hostile foreign dictators through diplomatic concessions.
items.ex_zh: 首相拒绝通过外交让步来姑息怀有敌意的外国独裁者。

items.def_zh: 抚慰，平息，安抚；平定，平息（叛乱等）
items.def_en: 1. to make an angry, upset, or agitated person become calm and quiet 2. to bring peace to a violent or rebellious region, often by force
items.ex_en: Peacekeeping troops deployed to pacify the volatile border region after weeks of fighting.
items.ex_zh: 在数周的交火之后，维和部队进驻以平定动荡的边境地区。

items.def_en: to stop someone from feeling angry or hostile by making concessions
items.ex_en: The airline offered travel vouchers to placate furious customers stranded by cancellations.
items.ex_zh: 航空公司提供旅行代金券，以安抚因航班取消而滞留的愤怒旅客。

items.def_en: to appease the anger, hurt, or anxiety of someone through conciliatory words
items.ex_en: A polite apology helped mollify the customer after the unexpected delivery delay.
items.ex_zh: 在发生意外的配送延误后，一番礼貌的道歉有助于平息客户的怨气。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote acting upon an agitated, anxious, or angry individual or crowd to restore peace and emotional balance. Registers vary from affectionate physical soothing ('soothe') to formal concession and mediation ('pacify', 'mollify', 'appease').
groups.summary_zh: 抚平他人焦躁、怒气或恐慌情绪，使其恢复宁静与平和状态。
groups.desc_en: De-escalating emotional agitation, hostility, or civic unrest toward tranquility or neutrality, contrasting with forcefully suppressing or completely subduing.
groups.desc_zh: 化解激化的情绪、敌意或动荡使之归于平静，区别于武力压制或彻底降服。
groups.nuance_en: calm: steady someone's ruffled emotions or anxiety (nerves / patient / crowd) · soothe: gently relieve physical pain or psychological distress (pain / baby / irritation) · placate: take active steps to lessen anger through concessions or tact (critics / voters / customer) · appease: yield to aggressive demands to avert conflict (dictator / enemy / faction) · pacify: restore peace or order to a rebellious or riotous population (rebels / territory / crowd)
groups.nuance_zh: calm: 使焦躁或受惊的情绪平复镇定 (nerves / patient / crowd) · soothe: 抚慰创痛、减轻身心不适 (pain / baby / irritation) · placate: 通过迁就或安抚姿态平息愤怒 (critics / voters / customer) · appease: 姑息让步以求苟安避战 (dictator / enemy / faction) · pacify: 绥靖平息叛乱或骚乱以恢复秩序 (rebels / territory / crowd)

groups.name: Catch & Secure Quarry · 捕获与擒拿 (Bag, Catch, Snare)
groups.tip: 追逐并抓住逃窜目标

items.def_en: to catch fish or game in a net, or succeed in capturing a criminal
items.ex_en: Local fishermen managed to net dozens of large salmon in the coastal shallows.
items.ex_zh: 当地渔民设法在近岸浅滩处用网捕获了数十条大马哈鱼。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Gather or herd fugitives, suspects, or animals together for capture
items.ex_en: The police rounded up several suspects following the robbery.
items.ex_zh: 抢劫案发生后，警方搜捕了几名嫌疑人。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Find and catch a fugitive, animal, or quarry after thorough searching
items.ex_en: The police managed to track down the suspect after weeks of investigation.
items.ex_zh: 经过数周的调查，警方终于追查到了嫌疑人的下落。

items.def_zh: 猎获，捕杀；抢占，占有；把……装袋
items.def_en: 1. To catch or kill an animal while hunting. 2. To succeed in getting or capturing something before others do.
items.ex_en: The experienced hunter managed to bag a prize stag before dusk fell today.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的老猎人赶在今天黄昏前成功猎获了一头优质牡鹿。

items.def_zh: 捉住，抓到；接住（catch 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of catch: to capture, seize, or intercept.
items.ex_en: Border patrol agents caught several fugitive suspects attempting to cross the remote valley.
items.ex_zh: 边境巡逻人员抓获了几名企图穿越偏远山谷的在逃嫌疑人。

items.def_zh: 用罗网捕捉，设陷阱逮住
items.def_en: to catch an animal or person using a trap, wire, or net
items.ex_en: Poachers used hidden wire loops to snare endangered leopards in the dense forest.
items.ex_zh: 盗猎者利用隐蔽的铁丝圈套在密林中设陷阱捕猎濒危花豹。

items.def_en: to collect or gather wild animals or people together and pen them in
items.ex_en: Ranchers worked together all morning to corral the stray cattle back into pens.
items.ex_zh: 牧民们忙碌了整个上午，合力将走散的牛群合围赶回圈中。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Pursue a target or wild animal relentlessly until captured or killed
items.ex_en: Detectives worked around the clock to hunt down the suspect.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们夜以继日地工作，力求将嫌疑人缉拿归案。

items.def_en: to seize or arrest someone suspected of committing a crime
items.ex_en: Federal marshals acted swiftly to apprehend the escaped felon outside the train station.
items.ex_zh: 联邦法警迅速行动，在火车站外将那名逃犯缉拿归案。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the successful tracking, entrapping, or seizing of game, targets, or fugitives into one's grasp or custody. Nuances distinguish simple interception from netting, trapping, or claiming a prize.
groups.summary_zh: 通过追捕、陷阱或抓握将猎物或目标截获并收入囊中。
groups.desc_en: Pursuing, entrapping, and securing evasive quarry, suspects, or fugitives into custody or possession, contrasting with static holding or effortless picking up.
groups.desc_zh: 经由追缉、设伏或诱捕将逃逸的猎物或嫌犯擒获归案，区别于静态持有或轻巧拿取。
groups.nuance_en: snare: trap an animal or person using a noose, wire, or deceptive trap (rabbit / prey / victim) · net: catch with a mesh or successfully secure a valuable prize (fish / suspect / profit) · bag: successfully capture, kill, or secure as game or loot (buck / title / suspect) · round up: gather scattered animals or suspects systematically into one place (cattle / suspects / dissidents) · track down: locate and capture an elusive target after persistent following (fugitive / killer / lead)
groups.nuance_zh: snare: 下套设陷阱诱捕猎物或使人落套 (rabbit / prey / victim) · net: 用网捕捞或经谋划最终收网捕获 (fish / suspect / profit) · bag: 猎获动物或将战果、嫌犯收入囊中 (buck / title / suspect) · round up: 驱赶并集中围捕散落的人畜 (cattle / suspects / dissidents) · track down: 循线追踪并最终抓获潜逃目标 (fugitive / killer / lead)

groups.name: Cause & Bring About Outcomes · 致使与实现结果 (Cause, Effect, Bring About)
groups.tip: 带来或引起某种结果变化

items.def_en: to make something happen, especially something bad, unpleasant, or unexpected
items.ex_en: Sudden heavy downpours can cause flash floods across low-lying residential streets.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的暴雨可能会导致地势低洼的居民区街道暴发山洪。

items.def_en: (formal) to bring about or achieve; to cause a change or result to happen
items.ex_en: The new administration hopes to effect sweeping reforms throughout the tax system.
items.ex_zh: 新一届政府希望在整个税收体系中实现大刀阔斧的改革。

items.def_en: to generate or lead directly to a specific outcome, effect, or response
items.ex_en: The experimental treatment failed to produce any measurable improvement in the patients.
items.ex_zh: 这种试验性疗法未能在患者身上产生任何明显的改善效果。

items.def_en: to make something happen, especially a meaningful change or historical turn
items.ex_en: The widespread adoption of AI is likely to bring about major changes in the job market.
items.ex_zh: 人工智能的广泛应用可能会给就业市场带来重大变革。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Cause something to happen, begin, or exist
items.ex_en: Rapid currency inflation will inevitably give rise to widespread civil discontent nationwide.
items.ex_zh: 货币快速贬值将不可避免地在全国范围内引起广泛的民间不满。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Result in or act as the direct precursor causing a specific outcome
items.ex_en: Reckless financial speculation can quickly lead to severe economic turmoil across industries.
items.ex_zh: 鲁莽的金融投机可能很快会导致各行业出现严重的经济动荡。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Cause an event, conflict, or reaction to start suddenly
items.ex_en: The controversial new tax law spark off violent protests across urban centers.
items.ex_zh: 这项饱受争议的新税法在各城市中心引发了激烈的抗议活动。

items.def_zh: 造成，促成，引起（变化、灾祸等）；精工制作，锻造
items.def_en: (literary/archaic past tense and past participle of work) to cause or bring about something, especially a change, destruction, or havoc
items.ex_en: The terrible natural disaster wrought unimaginable destruction upon the entire seaside town.
items.ex_zh: 这场可怕的自然灾害给整座海滨小镇带来了难以想象的破坏。

items.def_en: to be the underlying condition that produces or generates a situation or feeling
items.ex_en: Dishonest political rhetoric will inevitably engender deep mistrust among the voting public.
items.ex_zh: 虚伪的政治说辞必将在广大选民群体中滋生深深的不信任感。

groups.summary_en: Verbs signifying operating as an effective agent or underlying driver that produces a tangible result, transformation, or state of affairs.
groups.summary_zh: 作为施因者发挥作用，促成某种既定结果或重大改变。
groups.desc_en: Operating as the active antecedent, catalyst, or primary driver that produces an outcome, contrasting with merely permitting, witnessing, or following a phenomenon.
groups.desc_zh: 作为起因、催化剂或驱动力诱发并实现结果，区别于仅仅允许、见证或在时间上随后发生。
