groups.nuance_en: cause: serve as the direct reason or physical origin of an event (damage / delay / accident) · effect: successfully achieve or implement a desired change against resistance (change / cure / reforms) · bring about: induce or facilitate a gradual development or transformation (collapse / transition / resolution) · spark off: ignite a sudden, explosive series of reactions (riot / controversy / debate) · give rise to: serve as the conceptual or fertile ground generating something (suspicion / speculation / fears)
groups.nuance_zh: cause: 作为直接成因导致某事件发生 (damage / delay / accident) · effect: 排除阻力促成或落实变革 (change / cure / reforms) · bring about: 推动并促成阶段性转变或事态演变 (collapse / transition / resolution) · spark off: 如火星般骤然引爆舆波或冲突 (riot / controversy / debate) · give rise to: 作为土壤滋生或衍生出某种现象 (suspicion / speculation / fears)

groups.name: Chat, Babble & Schmooze · 闲聊、漫谈与套近乎 (Yarn, Waffle, Schmooze)
groups.tip: 讲故事侃大山，或社交套近乎

items.def_en: to converse informally about trivial, everyday topics
items.ex_en: We sat by the kitchen counter to chitchat about local neighborhood gossip.
items.ex_zh: 我们坐在厨房吧台旁闲聊着附近社区的八卦琐事。

items.def_en: Talk in a friendly, informal, and continuous manner
items.ex_en: The cheerful old friends continued to chat away over hot cups of coffee.
items.ex_zh: 那几位兴高采烈的老朋友端着热咖啡畅谈闲聊个不停。

items.def_zh: 讲长篇故事，闲扯，侃大山
items.def_en: (informal) To tell long, often exaggerated stories, or chat leisurely.
items.ex_en: The old sailors liked to yarn about terrifying sea monsters beside the campfire.
items.ex_zh: 老水手们喜欢坐在营火旁闲扯侃大山，讲述可怕的海怪故事。

items.def_zh: 胡扯，瞎扯，喋喋不休；犹豫不决，摇摆不定
items.def_en: 1. (+ on/about) (chiefly British informal) To talk or write a lot without saying anything clear or important. 2. (chiefly North American informal) To be unable to make a clear decision; waver.
items.ex_en: The politician began to waffle on for hours without answering the journalist's question.
items.ex_zh: 那位政客开始漫无边际地胡扯数小时，却未回答记者的提问。

items.def_en: to talk continuously about trivial matters, especially with acquaintances
items.ex_en: The neighbors love to gab over the garden fence every single Saturday morning.
items.ex_zh: 邻居们喜欢在每个周六早晨隔着花园篱笆滔滔不绝地闲扯。

items.def_zh: （为谋利或交际而）套近乎，热络闲聊
items.def_en: (+ with) (informal) To talk socially and casually with people, especially to gain an advantage or make useful contacts.
items.ex_en: Ambitious junior executives often schmooze with potential investors during lavish corporate parties.
items.ex_zh: 雄心勃勃的初级主管经常在奢华的企业聚会上与潜在投资者套近乎。

items.def_zh: 漫无边际地闲扯；絮絮叨叨
items.def_en: Talk at length in a foolish, inconsequential, or childish way
items.ex_en: The excited little boy continued to prattle on about his new toy train.
items.ex_zh: 那个兴奋的小男孩一直在那里絮絮叨叨地讲着他的新玩具火车。

items.def_en: Continue talking for a long time about trivial or uninteresting matters
items.ex_en: My talkative coworker will rabbit on about his weekend plans if nobody interrupts.
items.ex_zh: 要是不打断他，我那位健谈的同事能就他的周末计划唠叨个没完。

items.def_en: (+ on/about) to talk at length in a foolish, inconsequential, or childish way
items.ex_en: Carefree children often prattle amidst the blooming meadow without a single worldly care.
items.ex_zh: 无忧无虑的孩子们在繁花盛开的草甸上信口开河地闲扯，浑无世俗烦恼。

groups.summary_en: Verbs detailing informal vocal engagement characterized by personal storytelling, verbose rambling, or socializing calculated for advantage rather than structured debate.
groups.summary_zh: 指非正式的交流方式，涵盖吹牛漫谈、冗长空谈或目的性套近乎。
groups.desc_en: Engaging in informal, loquacious, or strategic vocalizing devoid of solemn deliberation, contrasting with formal debate, public oratory, or technical exposition.
groups.desc_zh: 进行非正式、漫无边际或具社交功利性的闲谈碎语，区别于庄重辩论、公开演讲或严谨阐述。
groups.nuance_en: chitchat: exchange trivial, pleasant social small talk (neighbors / weather / gossip) · yarn: tell long, colorful, rambling anecdotal stories (sailors / memories / tales) · waffle: speak or write evasively, vaguely, and at length without substance (politician / answer / statement) · schmooze: converse ingratiatingly with influential people for personal advantage (clients / donors / executives) · prattle on: chatter childishly or inconsequentially at irritating length (nonsense / details / day)
groups.nuance_zh: chitchat: 轻松随意地拉家常、聊琐事 (neighbors / weather / gossip) · yarn: 绘声绘色地大摆龙门阵、讲轶事 (sailors / memories / tales) · waffle: 啰里啰唆、含糊其辞地大放空话 (politician / answer / statement) · schmooze: 为博取利益而与权贵套近乎、搞社交逢迎 (clients / donors / executives) · prattle on: 没完没了地唠叨幼稚琐碎的废话 (nonsense / details / day)

groups.name: Choose & Select · 挑选与甄选 (Pick, Choose, Select)
groups.tip: 在多个选项中作出挑选

items.def_en: 1. To choose someone or something from a group; 2. to gather fruit or flowers; 3. to remove unwanted bits from.
items.ex_en: You can pick fresh strawberries from the patch behind our old farmhouse tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 你明天可以从我们老农舍后面的地里采摘新鲜草莓。

items.def_en: To decide on and take someone or something from a number of possibilities.
items.ex_en: After browsing the menu, she decided to choose the grilled salmon for dinner.
items.ex_zh: 浏览菜单后，她决定选烤三文鱼作为晚餐。

items.def_en: To carefully choose someone or something as the most suitable or best from a group.
items.ex_en: The committee will select the most qualified candidate based on academic excellence.
items.ex_zh: 委员会将根据优异的学术表现选拔出最合格的候选人。

items.def_en: [I/T] to choose to do something (formal), or select someone by vote
items.ex_en: The citizens will elect a new mayor during the upcoming municipal ballot.
items.ex_zh: 市民们将在即将举行的地方选举中选出一名新市长。

items.def_en: to choose one person or thing from a group for special attention, praise, or criticism
items.ex_en: It is unfair to single out one player when the whole team performed poorly.
items.ex_zh: 在全队表现都很差的情况下，单单挑出一名球员来责备是不公平的。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) choose one or more people or things from a larger group
items.ex_en: The victim was able to pick out the attacker from a lineup of suspects.
items.ex_zh: 受害者能够从一排嫌疑人中指认出袭击者。

items.def_en: (+ sth) choose or decide on something after considering several possibilities
items.ex_en: After touring five properties, the couple finally settled on a quiet suburban cottage.
items.ex_zh: 看了五处房产后，这对夫妇终于选定了一栋安静的郊区小屋。

items.def_zh: 把注意力集中于；选定目标
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) direct all your attention toward or select a specific target or choice
items.ex_en: Investigators quickly zeroed in on the faulty wiring as the primary cause.
items.ex_zh: 调查人员迅速把注意力集中在有缺陷的线路上，认定其为主要原因。

items.def_en: (+ for/to do) to make a conscious choice or decision from a range of possibilities
items.ex_en: Many consumers opt for renewable energy sources to reduce their household utility bills.
items.ex_zh: 许多消费者选择可再生能源以减少家庭公用事业开销。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate opting for one or more items out of a set of possibilities, varying from everyday informal picking to rigorous, criteria-based evaluation.
groups.summary_zh: 从多个备选项中做出取舍，涵盖口语随选至专业严谨的甄选。
groups.desc_en: Discriminating among competing alternatives to designate one or more for a specific role, contrasting with accepting default options or acting at random.
groups.desc_zh: 在多个备选项中审慎权衡并圈定特定对象，区别于听任默认选项或随意处置。
groups.nuance_en: choose: exercise mental preference or volition among possibilities (career / partner / path) · select: pick out carefully according to distinct fitness or standards (candidates / sample / team) · pick: choose casually, instinctively, or physically by taking (apple / winner / side) · single out: separate one entity from a group for special treatment or praise (hero / culprit / achievement) · settle on: decide upon a choice after prolonged hesitation or debate (name / date / design)
groups.nuance_zh: choose: 基于个人意志与偏好做出生死或方向抉择 (career / partner / path) · select: 依据明确指标在同类中严加精选 (candidates / sample / team) · pick: 凭借直觉或眼力随手选定或挑中 (apple / winner / side) · single out: 从群体中单独挑出加以褒贬 (hero / culprit / achievement) · settle on: 经反复权衡后最终敲定某选项 (name / date / design)

groups.name: Circle & Loop · 环行与回绕 (Circle, Loop, Orbit, Encircle)
groups.tip: 沿环形或闭合轨迹盘旋绕行

items.def_en: travel in a loop or curved path that returns to the starting point
items.ex_en: We got lost along the trail but eventually circled back to our campsite.
items.ex_zh: 我们在小径上迷了路，但最终绕回了露营地。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) turn or travel around in a circle or curve
items.ex_en: The startled deer wheeled around the clearing before vanishing into the dense trees.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的鹿在林间空地上转了一圈，随后消失在茂密的树林中。
items.ex2_en: The driver quickly wheeled around his car to avoid the oncoming obstacle.
items.ex2_zh: 司机迅速打方向盘调转车头，以避开前方的障碍物。

items.def_en: to fly or move in wide sweeping circles or arcs
items.ex_en: A flock of gulls wheeled above the harbor in search of discarded fish.
items.ex_zh: 一群海鸥在海港上空盘旋，寻找被丢弃的鱼。
items.ex2_en: The nurse wheeled the injured patient into the emergency room for treatment.
items.ex2_zh: 护士推着受伤的病人进入急诊室接受治疗。

items.def_en: [I/T] to move completely around something in a circular path
items.ex_en: The passenger plane circled the airport while waiting for clearance from air control.
items.ex_zh: 客机在机场上空盘旋，等待空中管制员的放行许可。

items.def_en: To move completely around something in a circular path or loop.
items.ex_en: Solemn pilgrims circuited the ancient stone temple beneath the shimmering midnight stars.
items.ex_zh: 庄重的朝圣者在闪烁的午夜繁星下，绕着古老的石庙环行。

items.def_zh: 成圈移动，成环状运行；使成环，成圈套住
items.def_en: 1. To move in a loop or curved path. 2. To form something into a loop or fasten with a loop.
items.ex_en: The winding river loops through the green valley before reaching the quiet lake.
items.ex_zh: 蜿蜒的河流在穿过这片翠绿的山谷后，注入了宁静的湖泊。
items.ex2_en: The climber looped the sturdy nylon rope securely around a thick branch.
items.ex2_zh: 登山者将结实的尼龙绳牢牢地圈在一根粗树枝上。

items.def_en: [I/T] to move along or around the outer edge or boundary of an area
items.ex_en: The hikers chose to skirt the marsh rather than wade across deep mud.
items.ex_zh: 徒步旅行者选择沿沼泽边缘绕行，而不愿趟过深厚的淤泥。

items.def_en: [I/T] to move in a curved path around a celestial or central body
items.ex_en: The weather satellite orbits the planet every ninety minutes to monitor storm patterns.
items.ex_zh: 该气象卫星每九十分钟绕地球运行一周，以监测风暴动态。

items.def_en: to move in a circle or spiral around a central point, often rapidly
items.ex_en: The turbulent waters gyrate fiercely around the central drainage vortex during heavy floods.
items.ex_zh: 大洪水期间，湍急的水流围绕着中央排水漩涡剧烈旋转。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey traveling in a curved, circular, or closed-loop path around a central pivot point or back to the point of origin, either freely or enclosing a focal entity.
groups.summary_zh: 指沿着弯曲、闭合环形或椭圆轨迹回绕行进或环绕某物运动。
groups.desc_en: Moving in a curvilinear, rotational, or closed path around a central pivot, perimeter, or orbit, contrasting with linear, unidirectional translation.
groups.desc_zh: 沿着环形、弧线或闭合轨迹绕中心轴或边缘运动，区别于线性的单向位移。
groups.nuance_en: circle: move around a center or focal point in a curved path (prey / airport / drain) · orbit: travel in a regular, gravitationally bound elliptical circuit around a body (planet / sun / Earth) · loop: curve back on a path to cross or form an enclosed ring (rope / track / plane) · wheel: turn or pivot sharply or sweep around in a dramatic arc (birds / chariot / vehicle) · skirt: travel along the perimeter or edge without entering (border / lake / city)
groups.nuance_zh: circle: 围绕某焦点或区域作弧线盘旋 (prey / airport / drain) · orbit: 沿天体物理引力轨道周转运行 (planet / sun / Earth) · loop: 绕成闭合圆环状或回旋折返 (rope / track / plane) · wheel: 大角度回转或成群鸟兽齐整盘旋 (birds / chariot / vehicle) · skirt: 沿外围边缘绕行而不深入内部 (border / lake / city)

groups.name: Cleanse & Wash · 清洁与洗涤 (Rinse, Launder, Scour)
groups.tip: 冲洗涂香波深度清洗

items.def_en: (+ sth) remove dirt, soap, or residue from a surface using clean water
items.ex_en: Make sure to rinse off the soapy foam before drying your hands thoroughly.
items.ex_zh: 彻底擦干双手之前，一定要把肥皂泡沫冲洗干净。

items.def_en: (+ off/out) To wash something quickly with clean water to remove soap, dirt, or food.
items.ex_en: She quickly rinsed the fresh tomatoes under running water before slicing them up.
items.ex_zh: 切片之前，她在自来水下迅速冲洗了新鲜番茄。

items.def_zh: 用洗发剂洗（头发）；用专用清洗剂洗（地毯等）
items.def_en: To wash your hair, a carpet, or an animal using shampoo or a special cleaning substance.
items.ex_en: The groomer shampooed the muddy golden retriever until its thick coat gleamed clean.
items.ex_zh: 宠物美容师用香波清洗了浑身泥泞的金毛寻回犬，直到它浓密的毛发焕然一新。

items.def_en: (+ out/down) to pour water generously over or through something to wash it out quickly
items.ex_en: The deckhands swilled down the wooden boards with buckets of fresh sea water.
items.ex_zh: 水手们用水桶舀起新鲜海水，大肆冲洗着木质甲板。

items.def_en: (+ sth) clean a large surface thoroughly by spraying or splashing it with water
items.ex_en: He washed down the spicy tacos with a cold glass of lemonade.
items.ex_zh: 他喝了一大口冰柠檬水，咽下了辛辣的墨西哥卷饼。

items.def_zh: 洗涤，洗烫（衣物）；洗钱（洗黑钱）
items.def_en: 1. To wash and iron clothes, sheets, or linen. 2. To move illegal money through legitimate businesses so that its criminal origins are hidden.
items.ex_en: Hotel staff must launder thousands of bed sheets and cotton towels every week.
items.ex_zh: 酒店员工每周必须清洗并熨烫数千张床单和棉毛巾。

items.def_en: (+ sth) clean a large surface or object thoroughly by rubbing it hard with a brush and water
items.ex_en: We spent Saturday morning scrubbing down the greasy walls behind the kitchen stove.
items.ex_zh: 我们周六上午花时间彻底擦洗了厨房炉灶后面油腻的墙面。

items.def_en: to rub a surface hard with a stiff brush and water to remove stubborn dirt
items.ex_en: He scrubbed the stained tile floor vigorously with a stiff nylon bristle brush.
items.ex_zh: 他用硬尼龙鬃毛刷使劲擦洗着布满污渍的瓷砖地板。

items.def_zh: 彻底擦亮，用研磨剂刷洗
items.def_en: to clean a dirty surface thoroughly by hard rubbing with an abrasive agent
items.ex_en: She scoured the burnt copper pan using an abrasive sponge and baking soda.
items.ex_zh: 她用百洁布配上小苏打，彻底刷亮了那只烧糊的铜锅。

groups.summary_en: An agent cleans fabrics, surfaces, or hair by applying water, solvent, or soap to dislodge grime. Verbs specify whether the action is light water flushing (rinse), textile treatment (launder), specialized hair cleansing (shampoo), or vigorous abrasive scrubbing (scour, scrub).
groups.summary_zh: 使用水或洗涤剂冲洗织物、发丝或硬质表面。
groups.desc_en: Applying water, solvents, and mechanical friction to dislodge soils, residues, and impurities from surfaces, contrasting with dry brushing or chemical sterilizing.
groups.desc_zh: 利用水流、洗涤剂及机械摩擦清除表面污渍和残留物，区别于干刷或单纯化学灭菌。
groups.nuance_en: wash down: clean a large or vertical surface thoroughly with copious water (deck / wall / car) · rinse: flush or dip quickly in clean water to wash out soap or dirt (mouth / hair / vegetables) · scrub: rub forcefully with a stiff brush or abrasive to remove grime (floors / pots / hands) · launder: wash, dry, and iron clothing or domestic textiles (linen / sheets / clothes) · swill: pour large amounts of water over an area to flush it clean (yard / gutters / floor)
groups.nuance_zh: wash down: 用大量水柱冲洗大型垂直或水平表面 (deck / wall / car) · rinse: 用清水漂洗或漱洗以带走泡沫杂质 (mouth / hair / vegetables) · scrub: 用硬刷或磨料用力刷洗顽垢 (floors / pots / hands) · launder: 专门清洗、烘干并熨烫衣物织品 (linen / sheets / clothes) · swill: 泼大水冲涮地面或沟槽 (yard / gutters / floor)

groups.name: Clear & Take Away · 清理与移走 (Clear, Remove, Eliminate)
groups.tip: 清理障碍以恢复原位空旷

items.def_zh: 清除，清理；使畅通；放晴，变清澈；批准
items.def_en: 1. To remove things that are blocking, dirtying, or cluttering a place. 2. To become free from clouds, fog, or obscurity; become transparent. 3. To officially give approval or authorization to.
items.ex_en: Volunteers worked through the morning to clear fallen timber from the hiking paths.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者们忙活了一上午，清理徒步小径上的倒木。
items.ex2_en: The thick gray clouds finally cleared as warm afternoon sunshine broke through.
items.ex2_zh: 随着温暖的午后阳光穿透云层，厚厚的乌云终于散去了。

items.def_zh: 移走，拿开；去除，消除；脱掉（衣帽等）；免职
items.def_en: 1. To take something or someone away from a place, position, or surface. 2. To get rid of or eliminate something unwanted. 3. To dismiss someone from a job or post.
items.ex_en: The technician used tweezers to remove the tiny plastic fragment from the machine.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员用镊子从机器中移出了微小的塑料碎片。

items.def_en: to carry or move an object from one place to another
items.ex_en: The waiter stepped forward to take away our empty plates between dinner courses.
items.ex_zh: 在每道菜之间，服务生走上前来拿走了我们吃空的盘子。

items.def_en: to empty a room or container completely by removing all unwanted objects
items.ex_en: We need to clear out the attic before the new tenants arrive tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 在新租客明天到达之前，我们需要把阁楼彻底清理干净。

items.def_en: to transport heavy, bulky debris or waste away from a location
items.ex_en: The construction crew hired a heavy truck to haul away the concrete rubble.
items.ex_zh: 施工队雇了一辆重型卡车来清运混凝土废料。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) take someone or something away from a place
items.ex_en: It was a daring speech, but she carried it off with remarkable poise.
items.ex_zh: 那是一场极具挑战的演讲，但她举止从容，完成得极为出色。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) take someone or unwanted items away, especially by vehicle or with effort
items.ex_en: The landlord threatened to cart off the abandoned furniture left along the hallway.
items.ex_zh: 房东威胁要用推车把丢在走廊里的废弃家具拉走。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) make an animal or person leave a place by shouting or waving your hands
items.ex_en: The gardener waved his broom vigorously to shoo away the pesky wild pigeons.
items.ex_zh: 园丁使劲挥动扫帚，赶走了讨厌的野鸽子。

items.def_zh: 移开、逐出（卡住或稳固的东西）
items.def_en: (+ from) to forcibly move or knock something out of its established position
items.ex_en: The surging floodwaters dislodged several heavy boulders from the crumbling river embankment yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 汹涌的洪水昨天从坍塌的河堤上冲脱了几块沉重的巨石。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express causing an obstruction, item, or unwanted presence to be taken away from a particular location or receptacle, rendering the space free, vacant, or unburdened.
groups.summary_zh: 指将人、物或阻碍移走，以使场地空出或恢复通畅、无碍。
groups.desc_en: Purging an area of unwanted occupants, obstacles, or clutter and carting them offsite, contrasting with simply organizing, shifting positions, or dropping objects.
groups.desc_zh: 排查并搬走阻碍物或冗余物以腾出空间，区别于就地整理、小幅挪动或随意丢弃。
groups.nuance_en: clear: free an area of obstructions or clutter to make it open (table / snow / path) · remove: take something away from a specific location or post (stain / tumor / obstacle) · clear out: empty an interior completely by discarding obsolete contents (attic / closet / desk) · haul away: transport heavy, bulky debris away by vehicle (trash / wreckage / debris) · cart off: carry away items or persons forcibly or en masse (looters / furniture / suspects)
groups.nuance_zh: clear: 清理障碍物或积物以还原空旷畅通 (table / snow / path) · remove: 将特定附着物或阻碍彻底移走或切除 (stain / tumor / obstacle) · clear out: 将内部旧物杂物彻底倒空腾出 (attic / closet / desk) · haul away: 用卡车运走沉重庞大的瓦砾废料 (trash / wreckage / debris) · cart off: 用车将大批物资或人员强行拉走 (looters / furniture / suspects)

groups.name: Clinical Treatment & Administration · 药物治疗与医护 (Medicate, Hospitalise, Treat)
groups.tip: 就医服药与临床治疗

items.def_en: Give medical care or attention to a person, an injury, or an illness
items.ex_en: Local paramedics rushed across the stadium floor to treat the injured soccer player.
items.ex_zh: 当地急救人员冲过体育场地面，救治受伤的足球运动员。

items.def_en: Allow or arrange for a patient to enter a hospital or clinic for treatment
items.ex_en: The emergency clinic decided to admit the elderly patient for overnight cardiac monitoring.
items.ex_zh: 急诊诊所决定接收这位老年患者入院进行通宵心脏监测。

items.def_en: (formal or archaic) To treat someone or an illness with medicine; to give medicine to.
items.ex_en: The ancient herbalist attempted to medicine the dying warrior with rare forest extracts.
items.ex_zh: 古老的草药师试图用稀有的森林萃取物给奄奄一息的勇士施药救治。

items.def_en: Administer a measured quantity of medicine or a drug to someone
items.ex_en: The nurse will dose each feverish patient according to their specific body weight.
items.ex_zh: 护士将根据发烧患者的具体体重分别配给适量药物。

items.def_en: Treat or purge with medicine or medicinal remedies, especially archaically
items.ex_en: Old village doctors would often physic the sickly child with bitter herbal draughts.
items.ex_zh: 老村医过去常常用苦涩的草药汤给体弱多病的孩子服药医治。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) administer a substantial dose of medication to someone to treat symptoms
items.ex_en: She had to dose up on painkillers before taking the long transatlantic flight.
items.ex_zh: 在搭乘漫长的跨大西洋航班之前，她不得不服用了大剂量的止痛药。

items.def_en: (+ sb) give medical treatment to someone injured, especially basic or emergency care
items.ex_en: The field medic managed to patch up the wounded soldier behind safe cover.
items.ex_zh: 战地医护人员在安全的掩蔽体后为伤员包扎救治。

items.def_zh: 用药物治疗，给……用药；给（自己）服药
items.def_en: To treat a patient or condition with medicine or drugs.
items.ex_en: Psychiatrists frequently medicate chronic clinical depression using modern selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors.
items.ex_zh: 精神科医生经常使用现代选择性5-羟色胺再摄取抑制剂来药物治疗慢性抑郁症。

items.def_en: (British English spelling of hospitalize) To admit a sick or injured person to a hospital for treatment.
items.ex_en: Doctors decided to hospitalise the elderly woman when her pneumonia symptoms worsened significantly.
items.ex_zh: 当老妇人的肺炎症状明显恶化时，医生决定送她住院治疗。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame concern delivering clinical interventions, administering drugs, or admitting individuals to medical facilities to manage illness, trauma, or psychiatric conditions.
groups.summary_zh: 指实施临床照料、开药用药或收治入院以进行医疗干预。
groups.desc_en: Administering pharmacological substances, regimens, or medical protocols to heal or palliate physiological and psychological disorders, contrasting with domestic feeding or non-therapeutic bodily care.
groups.desc_zh: 实施药物、疗程或诊疗手段以治愈或缓解身心疾患，区别于日常哺育或非医疗性身体护理。
groups.nuance_en: treat: apply medical therapy or care to heal an ailment (patient / infection / cancer) · medicate: administer pharmaceutical drugs to manage symptoms (pain / patient / anxiety) · dose: give a measured, specific quantity of medication (child / patient / medicine) · admit: check a patient officially into a hospital or clinic for care (patient / casualty / case) · patch up: treat minor injuries quickly and temporarily (wounds / patient / cuts)
groups.nuance_zh: treat: 针对病灶或患者进行专业医学诊治 (patient / infection / cancer) · medicate: 施用药剂以控制症状或镇痛 (pain / patient / anxiety) · dose: 按规定剂量配药或给药 (child / patient / medicine) · admit: 正式收治并办理住院手续 (patient / casualty / case) · patch up: 快速进行临时性包扎或应急处理 (wounds / patient / cuts)

groups.name: Coat & Encrust Surfaces · 饰面覆盖与结壳覆层 (Veneer, Encrust, Overlay)
groups.tip: 从表面封盖以遮掩内里

items.def_en: to cover the surface of something with a continuous thin layer of a substance
items.ex_en: He used a wide sponge brush to coat the raw timber with sealant.
items.ex_zh: 他用一把宽海绵刷在原木表面涂上了一层密封胶。

items.def_zh: 用薄板镶饰（家具表面）；虚饰，给……涂上伪装的一层
items.def_en: 1. To cover a piece of wood or furniture with a thin decorative layer of fine wood or plastic. 2. To conceal unpleasant truths with an attractive or polite appearance.
items.ex_en: Craftsmen veneer cheap particle boards with thin sheets of genuine imported walnut wood.
items.ex_zh: 工匠们用纤薄的进口真胡桃木板来镶饰廉价的刨花板表面。

items.def_en: (+ sth) apply an excessively thick layer of a substance onto a surface so it dries hard
items.ex_en: The actress had to cake on heavy foundation before going under bright stage lights.
items.ex_zh: 女演员在走向明亮的舞台灯光前，不得不厚厚地抹上一层粉底。

items.def_zh: 表面结壳；覆上一层硬皮
items.def_en: form or become covered with a hard, solid outer layer or crust
items.ex_en: The fresh snow began to crust over as night temperatures dropped well below freezing.
items.ex_zh: 随着夜间气温降至冰点以下，新下的积雪表面开始结起硬皮。

items.def_zh: （在影视或摄影中）用遮罩遮蔽（或合成）；使表面无光泽
items.def_en: 1. (film / photography) To mask out or combine areas of an image or film shot using a matte. 2. To make a surface dull or matte.
items.ex_en: Morning mist seemed to matte the shimmering bronze statue in the courtyard garden.
items.ex_zh: 晨雾似乎消去了庭院花园中那尊闪亮青铜雕像的光泽。

items.def_en: to cover a metal object with a thin protective or decorative layer of another metal
items.ex_en: Jewelers frequently plate inexpensive brass ornaments with a durable layer of genuine gold.
items.ex_zh: 珠宝商经常在廉价的黄铜饰品表面电镀一层耐用的真金。

items.def_en: to cover a flat surface with a protective plastic or bonded layer
items.ex_en: The company decided to laminate important security badges to prevent premature surface wear.
items.ex_zh: 公司决定对重要安保胸卡进行过塑压膜，以防止表面过早磨损。

items.def_zh: 覆盖，覆在……表面；重叠（overlay的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense and past participle of overlay: covered the surface of something with a layer or coating.
items.ex_en: Delicate gold leaves overlaid the intricate carvings along the cathedral's wooden sanctuary doors.
items.ex_zh: 精美的金箔覆在大教堂木质圣所门扉的繁复雕花表面。

items.def_zh: 使表面结壳；在表面镶嵌，覆以硬层
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) (often passive) To cover a surface with a hard layer or crust of something, or to decorate it richly with jewels.
items.ex_en: Ancient limestone cliffs were encrusted with thick layers of sparkling salt and mineral crystals.
items.ex_zh: 古老的石灰岩悬崖表面结满了一层厚厚的闪亮盐层与矿物晶体。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe mechanically or chemically applying a distinct outer crust, facing, or decorative layer onto a substrate, changing its texture, finish, or external appearance.
groups.summary_zh: 指在基底表面贴面、加盖覆层或硬壳沉积极以改变质感与外观。
groups.desc_en: Applying, adhering, or hardening an external overlay onto a substrate for protection, ornament, or structural reinforcement, contrasting with penetrating saturation or internal alloying.
groups.desc_zh: 在基材表面附着、结壳或覆合保护性或装饰性外层，区别于内部渗透或整体合金化。
groups.nuance_en: coat: cover a surface evenly with a layer of substance (dust / chocolate / paint) · plate: deposit a thin layer of metal electrochemically onto an object (gold / silver / steel) · veneer: overlay a cheaper wood or structure with a fine decorative surface (furniture / teeth / panel) · laminate: bond multiple thin layers together with adhesive or film (dough / glass / document) · cake on: accumulate into a thick, dry, crusty outer layer (mud / makeup / grime)
groups.nuance_zh: coat: 在物体表面均匀涂布或覆上一层物质 (dust / chocolate / paint) · plate: 通过电镀等在表面沉积薄层金属 (gold / silver / steel) · veneer: 用高级薄木或贴面贴覆廉价基底 (furniture / teeth / panel) · laminate: 将多层板材或塑料膜胶合压制成层压件 (dough / glass / document) · cake on: 泥浆或浓妆在表面结成厚而硬的干壳 (mud / makeup / grime)

groups.name: Coat & Lubricate · 涂抹与润滑 (Grease, Varnish, Oil)
groups.tip: 涂上润滑油以减轻摩擦力

items.def_en: (+ sth) rub or smear grease over mechanical parts or a surface to lubricate or protect it
items.ex_en: The mechanic told me to grease down the squeaky bicycle chains right away.
items.ex_zh: 机械师让我马上涂抹油脂把吱吱作响的自行车链条润滑一下。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) apply oil thoroughly to a surface or mechanical device to lubricate or soften it
items.ex_en: He spent the morning cleaning and oiling up his power tools.
items.ex_zh: 他花了一上午时间清理并润滑他的电动工具。

items.def_en: to apply mineral or synthetic oil to moving parts for smooth operation
items.ex_en: You should regularly oil the moving steel parts to ensure smooth long-term operation.
items.ex_zh: 你应该定期给活动的钢制部件注油，以确保长期运转顺畅。

items.def_en: 1. To coat wood, metal, or a painting with clear liquid varnish to give it a hard, shiny finish. 2. To disguise or make something look more attractive than it really is.
items.ex_en: The artisan will varnish the restored oak tabletop to bring out its natural grain.
items.ex_zh: 工匠将给修复后的橡木桌面涂上清漆，以衬托出它的天然纹理。

items.def_en: (informal) To apply oil or grease to machine parts to lubricate them.
items.ex_en: I need to lube the stiff door hinges before they start screeching loudly again.
items.ex_zh: 我得给发硬的门铰链涂点润滑油，免得它们又刺耳地尖叫。

items.def_zh: 给……加润滑油，使润滑；使顺畅运转
items.def_en: To put oil or grease on moving machine parts so they slide smoothly with less friction.
items.ex_en: Engineers strictly lubricate industrial bearings with heat-resistant synthetic grease to minimize component friction.
items.ex_zh: 工程师严格使用耐热合成润滑脂润滑工业轴承，以最大程度减少部件摩擦。

items.def_en: to smear or coat an object or machine part with thick grease to reduce friction
items.ex_en: Always grease the mechanical wheel axles before taking the heavy trailer out again.
items.ex_zh: 再次把重型挂车开出去之前，一定要给机械轮轴涂上黄油润滑。

items.def_en: to coat a surface with lacquer to form a hard, shiny protective shell
items.ex_en: The artisan carefully lacquered the wooden decorative box to produce an exquisite mirror finish.
items.ex_zh: 工匠细致地为木质装饰盒涂上罩光漆，呈现出精美的镜面效果。

items.def_en: to smear or rub with oil, traditionally in a sacred or formal ritual context
items.ex_en: The high priest stepped forward to anoint the chosen monarch with consecrated fragrant oils.
items.ex_zh: 大祭司走上前去，用神圣的香油为选定的君主施涂油礼。

groups.summary_en: An agent applies an oily, viscous, or protective liquid/substance onto a surface or mechanism to reduce friction, prevent wear, or provide a protective finish. Verbs contrast mechanical lubrication (grease, oil) with protective surface coating (varnish, lacquer).
groups.summary_zh: 在表面涂敷润滑剂或保护层以减阻防损。
groups.desc_en: Spreading oily, fatty, or resinous substances over moving parts or finishes to diminish friction or create a sealed barrier, contrasting with water washing or abrasive polishing.
groups.desc_zh: 在部件表面涂抹油脂或树脂类介质以减少摩擦或形成防护亮光层，区别于水洗或打磨抛光。
groups.nuance_en: lubricate: apply an oil or fluid to moving mechanical parts to minimize friction (engine / joints / machinery) · oil: apply mineral or synthetic oil specifically to keep parts moving or protected (hinges / chain / hair) · grease: spread thick animal or synthetic fat over an area (pan / axle / gears) · varnish: apply a resin solution that dries into a hard, glossy protective coat (wood / table / painting) · lacquer: coat with a hard, shiny cellulose or natural lacquer varnish (cabinet / box / wood)
groups.nuance_zh: lubricate: 在机械活动接头处注入润滑剂以减阻 (engine / joints / machinery) · oil: 滴加机油以防止生锈或运转滞涩 (hinges / chain / hair) · grease: 抹上厚重的润滑脂或油脂 (pan / axle / gears) · varnish: 涂刷清漆使木材表面硬化光亮 (wood / table / painting) · lacquer: 涂覆快干亮漆或天然大漆形成平滑硬面 (cabinet / box / wood)

groups.name: Coerce & Strong-arm · 强行逼迫 (Dragoon, Railroad, Coerce)
groups.tip: 违背意愿施压使顺从

items.def_zh: 强迫……仓促行事；强行通过（提案等）；陷害
items.def_en: 1. (railroad into) To force or rush someone into doing something, often against their will. 2. To push a bill, decision, or project through very quickly without proper discussion.
items.ex_en: Corrupt politicians tried to railroad the controversial fiscal bill through parliament without open debate.
items.ex_zh: 腐败政客企图在未经公开辩论的情况下，强行在议会通过这项争议财政法案。

items.def_en: force someone to accept an idea, plan, or policy by overwhelming opposition or ignoring proper debate
items.ex_en: The board attempted to steamroller the unpopular redevelopment plan over loud local resident objections.
items.ex_zh: 董事会试图无视当地居民的强烈反对，硬推那项不得人心的重建计划。

items.def_en: (+ sb into doing sth) use intimidation or physical force to compel someone to do something
items.ex_en: Corrupt union bosses tried to strong-arm the independent contractors into signing unfavorable deals.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的工会头目企图使用强硬手段胁迫独立承包商签署不利协议。

items.def_en: (+ sb into sth) force or bully someone into doing something hastily without due consideration
items.ex_en: Management attempted to railroad workers into accepting the revised retirement package without proper consultation.
items.ex_zh: 管理层企图在未经妥善协商的情况下，施压迫使员工仓促接受修改后的退休方案。

items.def_zh: 迫使……进入；强迫（某人做某事）
items.def_en: (+ sb into sth) compel someone into an action, decision, or situation against their will
items.ex_en: The sudden economic crisis forced many young graduates into poorly paying temporary employment.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的经济危机迫使许多年轻毕业生不得不从事薪酬微薄的临时工作。

items.def_en: (+ sth) use force, intimidation, or aggressive pressure to involve oneself in an affair or organization
items.ex_en: Ruthless outside investors tried to muscle into the profitable local family retail business.
items.ex_zh: 无情的外来投资者企图硬挤进这家利润丰厚的地方家族零售企业。

items.def_en: (+ sb into sth) persuade an unwilling person to do something by using threats or force
items.ex_en: The corrupt officer attempted to coerce vulnerable witnesses into giving false sworn testimony.
items.ex_zh: 那名腐败官员企图胁迫弱势证人提供虚假的宣誓证词。

items.def_zh: 强迫，迫使（常与 into 连用）；弹压
items.def_en: (dragoon into) To force or coerce someone into doing something against their will.
items.ex_en: The tyrant sought to dragoon reluctant villagers into joining his brutal militia.
items.ex_zh: 暴君企图强迫不情愿的村民加入他残暴的民兵队伍。

items.def_en: (+ sb into doing sth) intimidate someone with stern words or looks into doing something
items.ex_en: The aggressive prosecutor attempted to browbeat the nervous witness into signing the false confession.
items.ex_zh: 咄咄逼人的检察官企图威逼紧张的证人签署虚假供词。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers coercing, manipulating, or bullying someone into taking an action, accepting a decision, or passing legislation against their will or without due consideration. Verbs emphasize institutional pressure, rush tactics, or high-handed intimidation.
groups.summary_zh: 运用权力、强硬手段或仓促程序逼迫他人顺从或通过决议。
groups.desc_en: Compelling someone toward compliance or concession through overwhelming institutional pressure, threats, or aggressive leverage, contrasting with voluntary persuasion or reasoned negotiation.
groups.desc_zh: 借助体制压迫、威逼或压倒性手段迫使他人顺从或退让，区别于说理协商或自愿合作。
groups.nuance_en: coerce: compel an unwilling party through threats, intimidation, or force (witness / employee / confession) · strong-arm: use overt physical force or ruthless intimidation to dominate (rivals / merchants / victim) · railroad: rush a person into action or conviction without fair process (legislation / suspect / defendant) · dragoon: conscript, bully, or force someone into doing an unwanted task (volunteers / workers / staff) · steamroller: crush opposition or override objections relentlessly by sheer weight (opposition / bill / dissent)
groups.nuance_zh: coerce: 以威胁或胁迫手段强逼他人就范 (witness / employee / confession) · strong-arm: 动用野蛮武力或霸道威吓横行霸道 (rivals / merchants / victim) · railroad: 剥夺合法程序仓促定罪或强推通过 (legislation / suspect / defendant) · dragoon: 强行征调或逼迫他人从事不愿干的苦差 (volunteers / workers / staff) · steamroller: 凭借压倒性权势如压路机般碾压异见 (opposition / bill / dissent)

groups.name: Cognitive Grasp & Mental Comprehension · 领会与理解 (Understand, Comprehend, Grasp)
groups.tip: 掌握事实与事理认知

items.def_zh: 理解，懂得，明白；获悉，听闻
items.def_en: 1. To know or realize the meaning, reason, or nature of something. 2. To know or be informed about a fact.
items.ex_en: I understand the basic principles behind the policy, but I question its implementation.
items.ex_zh: 我理解该政策背后的基本原则，但我对其执行方式存疑。

items.def_en: 1. To know, understand, or possess knowledge of something (used as the past participle of know).
items.ex_en: The elusive truth was finally known to the public after months of quiet investigation.
items.ex_zh: 经过数月的低调调查，难以捉摸的真相终于为公众所知晓。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) successfully understand someone, or solve and comprehend the meaning of something
items.ex_en: Scientists are trying to figure out why the virus mutated so rapidly.
items.ex_zh: 科学家们正试图弄明白这种病毒为何变异得如此之快。

items.def_en: understand or realize the meaning, nature, or point of something, especially after some delay
items.ex_en: The new fashion trend quickly caught on among teenagers.
items.ex_zh: 这种新的时尚潮流迅速在青少年中流行开来。

items.def_en: (+ to sth) begin to grasp or understand a situation or fact
items.ex_en: It took him several awkward minutes to cotton on to their inside joke.
items.ex_zh: 他花了尴尬的几分钟才领悟出他们之间那个心照不宣的玩笑。

items.def_zh: 领悟，充分理解（复杂概念）
items.def_en: to completely understand a difficult concept, principle, or situation
items.ex_en: Few undergraduate students could fully grasp the subtle intricacies of quantum mechanics.
items.ex_zh: 很少有本科生能够完全领悟量子力学的精妙复杂之处。

items.def_en: 1. To understand something fully and completely. 2. (formal) To include or comprise something.
items.ex_en: The elderly scholar struggled to comprehend the ethical dilemmas posed by modern genetic engineering.
items.ex_zh: 这位年迈的学者难以彻底理解现代基因工程带来的伦理困境。

items.def_en: (formal) to understand or grasp mentally the meaning or significance of something
items.ex_en: The philosopher sought to apprehend the deeper spiritual significance of human mortality.
items.ex_zh: 这位哲学家试图在精神层面上领会人类终有一死的深层意义。

items.def_zh: 深究，彻底领悟/看透（深奥之事）
items.def_en: (chiefly in negative contexts) to understand after much contemplation; to penetrate the true meaning of
items.ex_en: I simply cannot fathom why she chose to abandon her brilliant diplomatic career.
items.ex_zh: 我实在无法参透她为何选择放弃自己光辉的辉煌外交生涯。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this core cognitive frame represent an agent successfully processing, interpreting, and mastering the meaning, nature, or implications of an idea, fact, or situation. They scale from basic recognition and cognitive familiarity (know, known) and common sense assimilation (understand) to formal intellectual mastery (comprehend, fathom, grasp).
groups.summary_zh: 主体对概念、事实、语言或原理在心智上完成解析、认知并领悟其本质。
groups.desc_en: Attaining clear internal mental representation, structural logic, or conceptual mastery over previously opaque phenomena, contrasting with rote memorization or surface perception.
groups.desc_zh: 在思维中建立起对未知事物的逻辑结构与深层机理的准确把握，区别于死记硬背或表象感知。
groups.nuance_en: understand: have clear knowledge of the meaning, nature, or explanation of something (concept / instructions / motives) · comprehend: fully grasp the scope, complex significance, or profundity of a reality (scale / implications / text) · grasp: mentally seize a subtle concept or underlying principle firmly (basics / point / concept) · figure out: solve or deduce a confusing puzzle or mechanism through active thinking (problem / clue / math) · catch on: suddenly realize, perceive, or understand the drift of what is happening (trend / joke / trick)
groups.nuance_zh: understand: 明晓事理、内涵或指令含义 (concept / instructions / motives) · comprehend: 完全透彻理解宏大复杂的意义或后果 (scale / implications / text) · grasp: 牢牢领悟并吃透抽象概念或关键要害 (basics / point / concept) · figure out: 经积极思索推演出谜底或门道 (problem / clue / math) · catch on: 恍然醒悟、领会弦外之音或看破玄机 (trend / joke / trick)

groups.name: Coil & Furling · 卷绕与卷起收束 (Coil, Wind, Furl, Reef)
groups.tip: 收缩卷起帆面或织物

items.def_en: (+ sth) roll or fold up a sail, flag, or umbrella securely
items.ex_en: The sailors hastened on deck to furl up the heavy mainsail before twilight fell.
items.ex_zh: 暮色降临前，水手们赶紧在甲板上将沉重的主帆收拢起来。
items.ex2_en: The delicate flower petals furled up as the chilly evening air arrived.
items.ex2_zh: 随着寒冷的晚风袭来，娇嫩的花瓣卷缩了起来。

items.def_en: (+ sth) make something into the shape of a cylinder or ball by folding it over and over
items.ex_en: Please roll up the woolen rug carefully and place it beside the cabinet.
items.ex_zh: 请把那块羊毛地毯仔细卷起来，放在柜子旁边。
items.ex2_en: The startled hedgehog rolled up into a tight defensive ball among leaves.
items.ex2_zh: 受惊的刺猬在树叶堆里蜷缩成一个紧密的防御球。

items.def_en: (+ sth) turn or coil a length of rope, wire, or mechanism into a compact roll or state
items.ex_en: Help me wind up this messy extension cord before someone trips over it.
items.ex_zh: 在有人被绊倒之前，帮我把这根乱糟糟的延长线卷紧缠好。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ around/up) to twist or turn something flexible repeatedly around an axis or into a roll
items.ex_en: She began to wind the thick copper wire securely around the wooden spool.
items.ex_zh: 她开始把粗铜线牢牢地缠绕在木制线轴上。
items.ex2_en: The narrow cobblestone road wound slowly around the steep mountain slope.
items.ex2_zh: 狭窄的鹅卵石路沿着陡峭的山坡蜿蜒盘旋。

items.def_en: 1. (nautical) To roll or fold up a portion of a sail to reduce its surface area in strong winds.
items.ex_en: The seasoned captain ordered the crew to reef the topsails against rising gales.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的船长命令船员迎着渐起的狂风收紧上桅帆。

items.def_en: [I/T] to wind yarn, film, wire, or magnetic tape onto a cylinder or reel
items.ex_en: The automated machine began to spool the delicate fiber-optic cable onto metal drums.
items.ex_zh: 自动化机器开始将精细的光纤电缆卷绕到金属线筒上。
items.ex2_en: The loose magnetic tape began to spool smoothly onto the rotating wheel.
items.ex2_zh: 松散的磁带开始顺畅地卷绕到旋转的卷轴上。

items.def_en: 1. (+ around/up) To wind or twist into loops or spirals, or curl into a spiral shape.
items.ex_en: The garden hose will easily crack unless you coil it neatly after use.
items.ex_zh: 用完后若不整齐地盘卷起来，这根花园水管很容易破裂。
items.ex2_en: The venomous rattlesnake coiled tightly in the shade behind the dry rock.
items.ex2_zh: 有毒的响尾蛇紧紧盘绕在干燥岩石背后的阴凉处。

items.def_en: [I/T] to roll up and bind securely, especially a sail, banner, or umbrella
items.ex_en: The ceremonial guards solemnly furled the battle flag as evening bugles echoed across camp.
items.ex_zh: 随着傍晚的军号在营地上空回荡，仪仗兵庄严地卷起了战旗。
items.ex2_en: The white ship sails furled automatically against the mast before the squall.
items.ex2_zh: 在飑风来临前，白色船帆自动收拢紧贴在桅杆上。

items.def_en: (+ up/down) to fasten or tighten securely with a strap, belt, or rope
items.ex_en: Make sure you cinch up the luggage straps tightly before loading the roof rack.
items.ex_zh: 装上车顶行李架之前，一定要确保把行李带勒紧系好。

groups.summary_en: An agent winds a flexible line, sheet, sail, or strip into concentric rings, rolls, or reduced folded formations to secure or shorten it.
groups.summary_zh: 将缆绳、帆布、软管等卷绕成圈或折叠收紧以固定/收拢。
groups.desc_en: Involves drawing flexible, elongated, or sheet-like materials into tight concentric rings, spools, or compact gathered states, contrasting with simple folding by relying on continuous winding or nautical rolling.
groups.desc_zh: 指将柔软、修长或片状物料通过连续缠绕、盘卷或航海卷折方式收拢成环状或紧凑状态，区别于单次折叠。
groups.nuance_en: coil: wind into concentric circular loops or rings (rope / snake / wire) · wind: continuously wrap around a core or axis (thread / clock / bandage) · furl: roll and bind tightly, especially sails or flags (sail / flag / umbrella) · reef: reduce sail area by rolling or gathering part of it (mainsail / canvas) · spool: wind onto a cylindrical holder or reel (thread / tape / cable)
groups.nuance_zh: coil: 盘绕成环形或同心圆圈 (rope / snake / wire) · wind: 绕轴心连续缠绕收紧 (thread / clock / bandage) · furl: 卷起并收紧捆扎布面 (sail / flag / umbrella) · reef: 航海中收卷部分帆面以减风阻 (mainsail / canvas) · spool: 规整绕于卷轴或线轴上 (thread / tape / cable)

groups.name: Collapse & Disintegrate · 瓦解与崩塌 (Crumble, Collapse, Implode, Disintegrate)
groups.tip: 内部失稳，整体瓦解倒塌

items.def_en: [I/T] to break or cause something to fall apart gradually into small pieces
items.ex_en: The ancient limestone wall started to crumble under the constant battering of stormy waves.
items.ex_zh: 在暴风巨浪的持续拍打下，那堵古老的石灰岩墙开始碎裂崩解。
items.ex2_en: The chef crumbled dry goat cheese over the freshly tossed green salad.
items.ex2_zh: 厨师将干山羊奶酪捏碎撒在刚拌好的蔬菜沙拉上。

items.def_en: break into pieces because of weakness, decay, or extreme structural strain
items.ex_en: The antique wooden chair began to fall apart under the heavyweight guest's sudden movement.
items.ex_zh: 那位体型庞大的客人突然一动，这把古董木椅便散架了。

items.def_en: collapse to the ground as a result of structural weakness or damage
items.ex_en: The abandoned factory chimney finally fell down during the ferocious midnight gale.
items.ex_zh: 那根废弃的工厂烟囱终于在午夜的一场狂暴大风中倒塌了。

items.def_en: to break down, sink, or fail completely through structural defeat
items.ex_en: The ambitious peace negotiations foundered entirely over disagreements regarding disputed border territories.
items.ex_zh: 这项雄心勃勃的和平谈判因争议边界领土的分歧而彻底瓦解。

items.def_en: to fall down or fall inward suddenly because of lack of structural support
items.ex_en: The derelict warehouse roof suddenly collapsed beneath the unprecedented weight of wet snow.
items.ex_zh: 在暴雪超乎寻常的重压下，那座废弃仓库的屋顶突然坍塌了。
items.ex2_en: The demolition crew collapsed the abandoned chimney safely using controlled industrial explosives.
items.ex2_zh: 拆除队使用受控工业炸药安全地炸塌了废弃的烟囱。

items.def_en: [I/T] to disintegrate, disperse, or cause an organizational body to end completely
items.ex_en: The prime minister decided to dissolve the deadlocked parliament and call snap elections.
items.ex_zh: 首相决定解散陷入僵局的议会，并提前举行大选。
items.ex2_en: The effervescent vitamin tablet dissolved quickly in the glass of cold water.
items.ex2_zh: 泡腾维生素片在一杯凉水中迅速溶解了。

items.def_en: fall inward suddenly; collapse inward under weight or pressure
items.ex_en: The old mine shaft threatened to cave in following the unexpected seismic tremor.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的地震震颤过后，那座老旧矿井随时有坍塌的危险。

items.def_zh: （使）瓦解，（使）崩溃；（使）碎裂，（使）分解
items.def_en: 1. To break up into small pieces or fragments. 2. To become much weaker or collapse completely.
items.ex_en: The asteroid began to disintegrate into fiery fragments as it entered the atmosphere.
items.ex_zh: 小行星在进入大气层时开始碎裂成炽热的碎片。
items.ex2_en: Extreme heat and pressure can quickly disintegrate durable plastic waste into molecules.
items.ex2_zh: 极度的高温和高压能迅速将耐用的塑料废料分解为分子。

items.def_zh: 内爆，向内坍塌；（组织、系统等）崩溃，瓦解
items.def_en: 1. To collapse or burst violently inward under external pressure. 2. (of an organization or system) To fail suddenly and completely.
items.ex_en: The fraudulent investment bank began to implode amid mounting regulatory scrutiny and panic.
items.ex_zh: 在日益严厉的监管审查和恐慌情绪中，这家欺诈性投资银行开始崩盘。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail structural or organizational breakdown, contrasting inward collapses, gradual crumbling into dust, and the complete loss of cohesive structure into dispersed fragments.
groups.summary_zh: 指结构、物体或体制因丧失凝聚力而向内塌缩、剥蚀碎解或彻底粉碎瓦解。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the sudden or progressive structural failure and fragmentation of a unified physical or organizational entity, contrasting with mere cracking or dismantling through internal loss of cohesion.
groups.desc_zh: 指实体或组织因内部凝聚力丧失而发生突发性或渐进式的结构崩溃与碎裂解体，区别于局部开裂或人为拆卸。
groups.nuance_en: collapse: sudden falling inward or breakdown of supporting structure (building / economy / lung) · crumble: break down progressively into small fragments (cliff / bread / empire) · disintegrate: completely lose cohesion and break into constituent particles (comet / alliance / society) · cave in: buckle and collapse downward or inward under weight (roof / mine / demands) · founder: fill with water, sink, or stumble to total failure (ship / business / negotiations)
groups.nuance_zh: collapse: 支承结构突然下塌或体系崩溃 (building / economy / lung) · crumble: 碎裂成细屑或逐步瓦解 (cliff / bread / empire) · disintegrate: 彻底丧失聚合力解体为粉末质点 (comet / alliance / society) · cave in: 受重压或逼迫向内向下塌陷 (roof / mine / demands) · founder: 进水沉没或彻底停滞搁浅 (ship / business / negotiations)

groups.name: Commercial Rental & Charter · 租赁与包租 (Rent, Lease, Charter)
groups.tip: 定期付租或出租营利

items.def_en: (chiefly BrE) to pay money to borrow something for a short period
items.ex_en: We decided to hire a sturdy van to transport our camping gear north.
items.ex_zh: 我们决定租用一辆结实的面包车，把露营装备运到北方。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ from/to) to pay someone for the use of something, or to grant use in return for regular payments
items.ex_en: The young couple opted to rent a modest apartment near the railway station.
items.ex_zh: 这对年轻夫妇选择在火车站附近租住一套简朴的公寓。

items.def_en: 1. to allow someone to use land, a building, or equipment in return for regular payments. 2. to use property or equipment under an agreement to pay regular sums of money.
items.ex_en: The enterprise negotiated a contract to lease office space in the new financial tower.
items.ex_zh: 该企业协商签订了在新金融大厦租用办公场地的合同。

items.def_zh: 包租，租用（飞机、船只、车辆等）；特许成立，发特许状
items.def_en: 1. to hire a vehicle, aircraft, or ship for special, private use. 2. to grant a charter or official rights to an institution or organization.
items.ex_en: The wealthy delegation decided to charter a private jet for their urgent international trip.
items.ex_zh: 富有的代表团决定包租一架私人飞机以执行紧急的国际行程。

items.def_en: to hire out an aircraft, ship, or vehicle under a specific contract
items.ex_en: The shipping company agreed to charter out its newest vessel to foreign transport operators.
items.ex_zh: 这家船运公司同意将其最新的船只特许包租给外国运输营运商。

items.def_en: (+ sth) allow someone to use property, vehicles, or equipment in exchange for regular payments
items.ex_en: They decided to rent out their spare room on weekends for extra income.
items.ex_zh: 他们决定在周末把空置的房间租出去以赚取额外收入。

items.def_en: (+ sth) grant the possession and use of land, property, or equipment under a formal lease agreement
items.ex_en: The municipal authority decided to lease out surplus warehouse space to local logistics companies.
items.ex_zh: 市政当局决定将多余的仓库空间长期出租给当地物流公司。

items.def_zh: 受雇；出借（车辆、设备等以收取租金）
items.def_en: (+ sth) provide goods, equipment, or vehicles for temporary use in return for payment
items.ex_en: The company hires out heavy machinery for construction projects.
items.ex_zh: 该公司为建筑工程提供重型机械租赁服务。

items.def_en: [I/T] to lease property to another person while renting it from the primary owner
items.ex_en: Tenants are strictly forbidden to sublet their apartments without written consent from management.
items.ex_zh: 未经物业管理方书面许可，租户严禁转租其公寓。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote granting or acquiring temporary use of property, vessels, vehicles, or land in exchange for payment. Nuances depend on the object (vehicles/ships vs. real estate) and contract duration.
groups.summary_zh: 支付对价租用或出租房屋、土地、交通工具及大型设备。
groups.desc_en: Covers temporary commercial transfers of property, equipment, or transport for payment, contrasting with outright purchase or permanent alienation.
groups.desc_zh: 指支付对价以换取财产、设备或交通工具的限期使用权，区别于产权买断或永久转让。
groups.nuance_en: rent: pay short- or medium-term fees for property or housing (apartment / car / equipment) · lease: secure contractually for a long, fixed period (office space / fleet / land) · charter: hire an entire transport vessel or vehicle for a dedicated trip (yacht / aircraft / flight) · hire: pay for temporary short-term use, often UK English (tuxedo / bicycle / skip)
groups.nuance_zh: rent: 支付常态化租金获取中短期使用权 (apartment / car / equipment) · lease: 通过严格合同长期租赁大额资产 (office space / fleet / land) · charter: 包租整架/整艘专有交通工具出行 (yacht / aircraft / flight) · hire: 短期小额雇租，英式多用 (tuxedo / bicycle / skip)

groups.name: Compare & Contrast · 比较与对照 (Compare, Contrast, Collate)
groups.tip: 比同求异辨析事物异同

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) compare someone or something against a standard or competitor
items.ex_en: Our current sales performance does not measure up against the ambitious targets established earlier.
items.ex_zh: 我们目前的销售业绩与此前设立的宏伟目标相比仍有差距。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) compare favorably or unfavorably when placed alongside another entity
items.ex_en: Their cheap knockoff simply cannot stack up against the quality of our handcrafted original.
items.ex_zh: 他们廉价的仿制品根本无法与我们手工原版的品质相提并论。

items.def_zh: 比较，对照；把……比作；相比，比得上
items.def_en: 1. To examine people or things to see how they are similar or different. 2. (+ to) To represent as similar; liken. 3. (+ with/to) To be similar to or of equal quality.
items.ex_en: The consumer agency tested both vehicles thoroughly to compare their overall fuel efficiency.
items.ex_zh: 消费者机构对这两款车进行了全面测试，以比较它们的综合燃油效率。

items.def_en: to draw a direct comparison between two things or show how one resembles another
items.ex_en: The historian sought to parallel modern geopolitical tensions with the events of 1914.
items.ex_zh: 这位历史学家试图将当今的地缘政治紧张局势与1914年的事件作类比。

items.def_zh: 校勘，核对对照（多份文本或数据）
items.def_en: to gather and examine different pieces of texts or data to compare differences
items.ex_en: Archivists worked tirelessly to collate surviving manuscript versions of the medieval epic poem.
items.ex_zh: 档案研究员不知疲倦地工作，以校勘这部中世纪史诗流传下来的各手抄版本。

items.def_zh: 对比，对照；形成对比，显出差异
items.def_en: 1. To compare two things in order to show their differences. 2. (+ with) To show a clear difference when compared.
items.ex_en: Her latest scholarly essay seeks to contrast classical political doctrine with modern democratic theory.
items.ex_zh: 她最新的学术论文旨在将古典政治学说与现代民主理论进行对照。

items.def_zh: 把……视作等同，使等同；等同于
items.def_en: (+ with/to) To consider or make one thing equivalent or identical to another.
items.ex_en: One must not simply equate academic qualification with genuine professional competence in leadership.
items.ex_zh: 人们绝不能简单地把学历背景等同于领导层中真正的专业能力。

items.def_zh: 衬托，形成对比；为……作对位配乐
items.def_en: (+ with) To emphasize or contrast by juxtaposing different elements; to add a counterpoint to.
items.ex_en: The author used harsh city sounds to counterpoint the protagonist's serene inner monologue.
items.ex_zh: 作者用粗粝喧嚣的城市声浪来衬托主角宁静的内心独白。

items.def_en: to place things or people close together in order to show their contrast
items.ex_en: The exhibition cleverly juxtaposed industrial rust with pristine polished marble to highlight decadence.
items.ex_zh: 展览巧妙地将工业铁锈与光洁的大理石并置，以凸显颓废感。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe intellectually placing two or more entities side by side to evaluate similarities, illuminate striking differences, or assert equivalence.
groups.summary_zh: 在智力上将两事物并置，以评估同异、突显反差或等同视之。
groups.desc_en: Signifies setting two or more entities side by side to evaluate similarities, differences, relative merits, or structural parallels, contrasting with isolated qualitative appraisal.
groups.desc_zh: 将两个或多个对象并置以审视其异同、优劣或对应结构，区别于孤立的单体评估。
groups.nuance_en: compare: examine to identify similarities or relative worth (prices / notes / performances) · contrast: juxtapose specifically to highlight sharp differences (styles / colors / attitudes) · collate: assemble and critically verify texts or data side-by-side (data / manuscripts / evidence) · equate: treat or consider as distinctly identical or equal (success / wealth / silence)
groups.nuance_zh: compare: 广泛比对相似点或相对优劣 (prices / notes / performances) · contrast: 专门对照以凸显鲜明差异 (styles / colors / attitudes) · collate: 并排核对文献、页码或实证数据 (data / manuscripts / evidence) · equate: 将二者主观等同或相提并论 (success / wealth / silence)

groups.name: Compete & Vie · 竞争与角逐 (Compete, Vie, Jockey)
groups.tip: 各显身手争夺优势与地位

items.def_en: (+ with/against, for) to strive against another for an objective or advantage
items.ex_en: Dozens of elite athletes arrived to compete for the prestigious national marathon trophy.
items.ex_zh: 数十名顶尖运动员齐聚一堂，争夺享有盛誉的全国马拉松奖杯。

items.def_en: to be comparable to or compete on equal terms with someone or something
items.ex_en: Few modern commercial aircraft can rival the remarkable fuel efficiency of this newly developed jetliner.
items.ex_zh: 鲜有现代商用飞机能够与这款新研制客机出色的燃油效率相媲美。

items.def_en: (+ sth) compete eagerly with rivals to secure or achieve something desirable
items.ex_en: Several prominent international corporations vie for lucrative commercial rights across developing markets.
items.ex_zh: 几家知名跨国公司正竭力角逐发展中市场的丰厚商业权益。

items.def_en: confront or enter into direct competition or conflict with a rival
items.ex_en: The two veteran heavyweights will face off in the boxing ring tonight.
items.ex_zh: 两位经验丰富的重量级选手将于今晚在拳击台上展开对决。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) compete directly against a formidable opponent or rival
items.ex_en: Our small startup must boldly go up against entrenched industry giants to survive.
items.ex_zh: 我们这家小型初创公司必须勇于与根深蒂固的行业巨头较量才能生存。

items.def_en: (+ with/for) to compete earnestly or struggle in rivalry for something
items.ex_en: Three rival political factions contend fiercely for absolute parliamentary control this coming autumn.
items.ex_zh: 三个对立的政治派别将在今年秋天为争夺议会的绝对控制权展开激烈争夺。

items.def_en: (+ for) to struggle disorderly or competitively to gain an advantage
items.ex_en: Panicked shoppers began to scramble for discounted electronics when the holiday doors opened.
items.ex_zh: 假日商场大门一开，惊惶拥挤的顾客便开始哄抢打折电子产品。

items.def_zh: 运用手段谋利，角逐；巧妙操纵；当赛马骑师
items.def_en: 1. (+ for) To compete or maneuver skillfully and aggressively to gain an advantage or position. 2. To ride a horse as a professional jockey in a race.
items.ex_en: Ambitious junior executives often jockey for promotion by undermining their peers behind closed doors.
items.ex_zh: 雄心勃勃的初级主管往往私下拆同僚的台，以此明争暗斗谋求升职。

items.def_en: (+ with/for) To compete intensely with others in order to win, gain, or achieve something.
items.ex_en: Renowned researchers constantly vie to secure vital funding from international scientific foundations.
items.ex_zh: 知名学者们不断展开激烈竞争，以争取国际科学基金会的关键资金支持。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe striving against one or more rivals to secure superiority, prestige, office, or scarce advantage.
groups.summary_zh: 指为争夺优势地位、控制权或荣誉而与对手展开持续比拼与角逐。
groups.desc_en: Describes striving against rivals for superiority, scarce resources, or victory under established constraints, contrasting with violent conflict or cooperative pursuit.
groups.desc_zh: 指在既定规则或环境下与对手争夺优势、稀缺资源或胜利，区别于暴力冲突或合作共谋。
groups.nuance_en: compete: engage in an open contest or market rivalry (athletes / companies / bids) · vie: contend eagerly and tenaciously for a prized objective (influence / dominance / attention) · contend: struggle assertively against rivals or adverse odds (title / supremacy / seat) · jockey: maneuver skillfully and strategically for position (position / advantage / power)
groups.nuance_zh: compete: 依规则展开正规竞赛或商海角逐 (athletes / companies / bids) · vie: 激烈争夺稀缺的目标或荣誉 (influence / dominance / attention) · contend: 顽强拼搏以力争头衔或优势 (title / supremacy / seat) · jockey: 巧妙运用策略手段抢占有利身位 (position / advantage / power)

groups.name: Complete & Finish · 结束与完成 (Complete, Finish, Conclude)
groups.tip: 彻底做完达到终点

items.def_zh: 完成，使完满，结束；填写（表格）
items.def_en: 1. To finish making or doing something. 2. To provide the last part needed to make something whole.
items.ex_en: The contractors worked overtime to complete the bridge construction before the winter freeze.
items.ex_zh: 承包商们加班加点，以便在冬季封冻前完成桥梁施工。

items.def_zh: 完成，结束，终结；用完，耗尽
items.def_en: 1. To bring something to an end, or to come to an end. 2. To consume or use up the last part of something.
items.ex_en: You need to finish your remaining laboratory experiments before writing the final report.
items.ex_zh: 在撰写最终报告之前，你需要完成余下的实验室检测。
items.ex2_en: The captivating classical piano concert finished promptly at ten o'clock sharp tonight.
items.ex2_zh: 扣人心弦的古典钢琴音乐会今晚十点整准时结束。

items.def_zh: 结束，终了（会议、演讲、程序）
items.def_en: [I/T] To bring or come to a formal end or close
items.ex_en: The ambassador rose gracefully to conclude his address with a passionate appeal for peace.
items.ex_zh: 大使优雅地起身，以对和平的热切呼吁结束了他的演说。

items.def_zh: 圆满收官，利索结束（项目、会议）
items.def_en: [I/T] To conclude or summarize an event, meeting, or deal successfully
items.ex_en: Let's wrap up this meeting so everyone can catch their flights.
items.ex_zh: 我们结束这次会议吧，这样大家都能赶上航班。

items.def_zh: 给……收尾，结束（商业运营、事务）
items.def_en: [I/T] To bring an activity, business, or speech gradually to an orderly end
items.ex_en: Let us wind up the debate now so everyone can catch the train.
items.ex_zh: 我们现在给辩论收尾吧，好让大家都能赶上火车。

items.def_en: (+ sth) finish or complete an activity or event in a pleasing or suitable way
items.ex_en: We rounded off the evening with a glass of champagne.
items.ex_zh: 我们喝了一杯香槟，为这个美妙的夜晚画上了圆满的句号。

items.def_en: (+ sth) complete the last remaining part of an ongoing task or consumption
items.ex_en: A glass of warm milk helped finish off the night.
items.ex_zh: 一杯热牛奶为这个夜晚画上了圆满的句号。

items.def_zh: 结束；圆满了结（交易、账目或事件）
items.def_en: (+ sth) bring an accounting period, business deal, or process to a formal end
items.ex_en: The financial accountants stayed late tonight to close out the fourth-quarter ledger accounts.
items.ex_zh: 财务会计们今晚加班很晚，以结清第四季度的账目记录。

items.def_en: To produce or agree on the finished, unalterable form of something
items.ex_en: The legal teams plan to meet tomorrow morning to finalize the merger agreement.
items.ex_zh: 法务团队计划于明早会面，以最终敲定合并协议。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on bringing an ongoing activity, project, or process to its termination. 'Finish' is the general term for exhausting or ending an action, whereas 'complete' emphasizes supplying whatever is remaining to make the item fully whole or intact.
groups.summary_zh: 指将进行中的活动或事务推向终点，着重完结或补全使其完备。
groups.desc_en: Involves bringing an activity, cycle, or project to its full designated termination or operational state, contrasting with abrupt cessation or passive lingering.
groups.desc_zh: 使活动、周期或工程达到预期的终结状态或圆满收尾，区别于中途废弃或无序拖延。
groups.nuance_en: complete: finish every required part to achieve wholeness (task / questionnaire / project) · finish: reach the terminal end of an action (meal / homework / race) · conclude: formally or decisively bring to an end (speech / treaty / investigation) · wrap up: informally bring remaining details to a tidy close (deal / meeting / shoot) · close out: systematically liquidate or terminate completely (position / fiscal year / account)
groups.nuance_zh: complete: 补全所有要素达到完整无缺 (task / questionnaire / project) · finish: 消耗完毕或抵达行动终点 (meal / homework / race) · conclude: 正式、具决断性地宣布告终 (speech / treaty / investigation) · wrap up: 口语化地顺畅收场或圆满落幕 (deal / meeting / shoot) · close out: 清理扫尾、平仓或终结账目 (position / fiscal year / account)

groups.name: Comply & Conform to Rules · 遵守与顺从 (Abide, Adhere, Conform)
groups.tip: 顺应社会规章与既定规范

items.def_en: to obey or conform to a formal law, principle, custom, or religious duty
items.ex_en: Devout pilgrims travel great distances to observe sacred religious rites at the shrine.
items.ex_zh: 虔诚的朝圣者不远万里前来，在圣殿恪守并奉行神圣的宗教仪式。

items.def_en: to strictly conform to the policies or demands of an organization or group, often reluctantly
items.ex_en: Cabinet ministers are expected to toe the line regardless of their private misgivings.
items.ex_zh: 内阁部长们无论私下有何疑虑，都必须服从指令听从指挥。

items.def_en: (+ sth) accept, obey, or conform to a rule, decision, or recommendation
items.ex_en: Both sovereign nations agreed to abide by the binding ruling of the arbitration tribunal.
items.ex_zh: 两个主权国家均同意服从仲裁庭具有约束力的裁决。

items.def_zh: 恪守；坚持遵循（规则、准则）
items.def_en: (+ sth) adhere strictly to an agreement, rule, plan, or promise
items.ex_en: The project manager urged all team members to stick to the original schedule.
items.ex_zh: 项目经理敦促所有团队成员严格恪守原定的时间进度表。

items.def_en: (+ sth) accept and comply with someone else's views, plans, or standard practices
items.ex_en: The new employee chose to fall in with the established office routine quickly.
items.ex_zh: 这位新员工选择迅速顺从并融入既定的办公室日常规范中。

items.def_en: (+ with) to act in accordance with an explicit wish, order, or official regulation
items.ex_en: All chemical manufacturing plants must comply with strict national emissions standards without exception.
items.ex_zh: 所有化工厂都必须毫无例外地遵守严格的国家排放标准。

items.def_zh: 遵守，服从（与by连用）；容忍，忍受
items.def_en: (also 'abide by') To accept and obey a rule, decision, or agreement.
items.ex_en: The old knight pledged that he would faithfully abide by his solemn chivalric vows.
items.ex_zh: 这位老骑士立誓，他必将忠实地遵从自己庄严的骑士誓约。

items.def_zh: 遵守，坚持（与to连用）；黏附，附着（与to连用）
items.def_en: 1. (+ to) To follow or obey a rule, belief, or agreement strictly. 2. (+ to) To stick firmly to a surface or object.
items.ex_en: All laboratory personnel must strictly adhere to the established chemical safety protocols.
items.ex_zh: 所有实验室人员都必须严格遵守既定的化学安全规程。

items.def_zh: 顺从，遵守（规范或规则）；相符合，相吻合
items.def_en: (+ to/with) To behave according to accepted rules, laws, or social standards; to match or fit a required standard or shape.
items.ex_en: The proposed architectural plans must fully conform to local environmental building regulations.
items.ex_zh: 拟议的建筑规划必须完全符合当地的环保建筑法规。

groups.summary_en: Verbs focusing on an actor aligning their conduct, beliefs, or practices with established laws, norms, standards, or agreements, taking prepositions like 'by', 'to', or 'with'.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动或依规使自身行为、标准契合既定法律、规范或协议。
groups.desc_en: Covers aligning behavior, procedure, or form with explicit external rules, orders, or established standards, contrasting with defiant autonomy or arbitrary improvisation.
groups.desc_zh: 使行为、程序或规格符合外部既定的明文规定、指令或规范，区别于任意妄为或抗命对抗。
groups.nuance_en: comply: submit action to explicit orders, requests, or regulations (regulations / court order / request) · adhere: stick unswervingly to a rule, doctrine, or plan (standards / principles / guidelines) · abide by: accept and submit loyally to a decision or agreement (terms / ruling / contract) · conform: adapt conduct or structure to prevailing norms (standards / expectations / specifications) · toe the line: reluctantly or strictly obey official party rules (party line / policy / consensus)
groups.nuance_zh: comply: 顺从屈从于外在条令、判决或规制 (regulations / court order / request) · adhere: 坚定不移地恪守原则、规程或信念 (standards / principles / guidelines) · abide by: 忠实遵照裁决、合约或诺言 (terms / ruling / contract) · conform: 顺应并趋同于主流标准与社会规范 (standards / expectations / specifications) · toe the line: 被动或规矩地服从官方路线与纪律 (party line / policy / consensus)

groups.name: Comprehend & Grasp · 领悟与渐悟 (Intuit, Grasp, Dawn)
groups.tip: 由模糊感知到顿悟理解

items.def_en: to begin to be perceived faintly or unclearly in the mind
items.ex_en: The correct answer began to glimmer faintly in the student's mind.
items.ex_zh: 正确的答案开始在学生心中隐约浮现。

items.def_en: understand or realize what is happening after initial confusion
items.ex_en: The new fashion trend quickly caught on among teenagers.
items.ex_zh: 这种新的时尚潮流迅速在青少年中流行开来。

items.def_zh: （逐渐）被领悟，开始被明白；破晓，拂晓
items.def_en: 1. (+ on/upon) To gradually become clear or understood by someone. 2. To begin to grow light as the sun rises.
items.ex_en: The profound significance of the decision began to dawn upon the committee.
items.ex_zh: 这项决定的深远意义开始被委员会逐渐领悟。

items.def_zh: 使逐渐明白；让人忽然省悟
items.def_en: (+ sb) become suddenly or gradually evident and understood by someone
items.ex_en: It finally began to dawn on Mark that his colleagues were teasing him.
items.ex_zh: 马克终于开始明白，原来同事们一直是在拿他开玩笑。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) successfully understand, solve, or deduce the meaning of something
items.ex_en: Scientists are trying to figure out why the virus mutated so rapidly.
items.ex_zh: 科学家们正试图弄明白这种病毒为何变异得如此之快。

items.def_en: to understand a difficult problem, idea, or fact clearly
items.ex_en: Few undergraduate students could readily grasp the intricate theoretical mathematical concept.
items.ex_zh: 很少有本科生能迅速领悟这个复杂的理论数学概念。

items.def_en: 1. To understand, know, or sense something by intuition rather than conscious reasoning.
items.ex_en: Experienced clinicians often intuit subtle patient distress before overt symptoms appear.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的临床医生往往在明显症状出现前，就能凭直觉察觉患者微妙的不适。

items.def_en: to penetrate to the truth of or comprehend thoroughly after deep consideration
items.ex_en: The senior board members struggled to fathom the motives behind his sudden resignation.
items.ex_zh: 资深董事会成员们绞尽脑汁也难以彻底理解他突然辞职的动机。

items.def_en: to incorporate concepts or values deeply into one's mind so that they become second nature
items.ex_en: Medical students must deeply internalize these professional ethical values during clinical training.
items.ex_zh: 医学生在临床实习期间必须将这些职业道德准则深度内化于心。

groups.summary_en: A cognizer comes to understand a truth, principle, or situation, ranging from intuitive inkling to sudden cognitive illumination or deep mental grasp.
groups.summary_zh: 从潜意识直觉到突然醒悟，进而深刻理解事物本质。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on the cognitive progression from partial awareness to profound internal mastery of meaning, contrasting with rote mechanical memorization.
groups.desc_zh: 强调心智从蒙昧或局部知觉跃迁至深层领悟内省的过程，区别于机械记忆。
groups.nuance_en: grasp: mentally seize the core meaning or full significance (concept / significance / basics) · fathom: probe deeply to make sense of something baffling (motive / mystery / depth) · intuit: perceive or know instinctively without conscious reasoning (truth / intention / danger) · figure out: solve or deduce through step-by-step thinking (problem / puzzle / route) · dawn on: realize suddenly and spontaneously after latency (realization / truth / irony)
groups.nuance_zh: grasp: 牢牢抓住事物的核心精髓与要旨 (concept / significance / basics) · fathom: 彻底测透或洞悉费解玄奥之物 (motive / mystery / depth) · intuit: 无需推演直觉顿悟真相 (truth / intention / danger) · figure out: 经过摸索推导逐步解出答案 (problem / puzzle / route) · dawn on: 潜伏期后真相突然在心头明朗 (realization / truth / irony)

groups.name: Compress & Knead · 揉捏与按挤 (Knead, Squeeze, Compress)
groups.tip: 手指用力按摩或揉捏

items.def_en: (+ sth) apply localized pressure to flatten, smooth, or extract moisture from malleable material
items.ex_en: The baker used a wooden roller to press out excess moisture from the dough.
items.ex_zh: 面包师用木擀面杖压平生面团，挤出多余的水分。

items.def_en: to crush or squeeze something into a compact, crumpled shape
items.ex_en: He angrily scrunched up the poorly written draft and tossed it away.
items.ex_zh: 他气愤地把那篇写得很差的草稿揉成一团扔掉了。

items.def_zh: 按摩，揉捏；篡改，美化（数据等）
items.def_en: 1. To rub, press, and knead muscles or body parts to relieve tension or pain. 2. (informal) To manipulate or alter facts, figures, or data to make them more acceptable.
items.ex_en: The accountant attempted to massage the quarterly financial figures before the big audit.
items.ex_zh: 会计在重大审计之前试图篡改美化季度的财务数据。

items.def_en: (+ sth) press malleable or soft materials tightly against one another using pressure
items.ex_en: Carefully squeeze together the edges of the pastry dough to seal the filling completely.
items.ex_zh: 小心地将油酥面团的边缘捏紧在一起，以完全封住馅料。

items.def_en: (+ sth) compress paper, fabric, or other soft material tightly into a small ball
items.ex_en: She decided to wad up the failed sketch and toss it into the bin.
items.ex_zh: 她决定把画废的素描草稿揉成一团扔进垃圾桶。

items.def_en: [T/I] to press something firmly together with your fingers or hand
items.ex_en: You need to squeeze the ripe lemon firmly to extract all its juice.
items.ex_zh: 你需要用力挤压成熟的柠檬，以榨出所有汁水。

items.def_zh: 捏，掐，拧；夹痛，挤压；（俚语）偷窃；逮捕
items.def_en: 1. To squeeze someone's skin or an object tightly between your thumb and finger. 2. To squeeze painfully or hurt by being too tight. 3. (informal) To steal; to arrest.
items.ex_en: My little brother playfully pinched my arm when our mother wasn't looking.
items.ex_zh: 趁妈妈不注意，我弟弟开玩笑地掐了我的胳膊一下。

items.def_zh: 揉成一团，揉拢；用软物填塞
items.def_en: To roll, compress, or fold paper, cloth, or soft material into a tight ball or pad; to pad or stuff with soft material.
items.ex_en: The mechanic had to wad several cotton rags tightly into the leaking pipe.
items.ex_zh: 修理工不得不将几块棉布紧紧揉成一团塞进漏水的管道中。

items.def_en: to press and stretch dough or muscles firmly and repeatedly with the hands
items.ex_en: You must vigorously knead the bread dough on a floured surface for ten minutes.
items.ex_zh: 你必须在撒了面粉的案板上有力地揉捏面包生面团十分钟。

groups.summary_en: Agents apply localized compressive pressure to malleable, flexible, or soft material or body parts using fingers, hands, or tools. Actions range from therapeutic rubbing to compacting material into a tight mass.
groups.summary_zh: 用手或工具对柔软、可塑物体进行按压、挤捏或搓压变形。
groups.desc_en: Denotes applying inward pressure, manual force, or manipulation to condense, soften, or misshape malleable matter, contrasting with cutting, tearing, or rigid crushing.
groups.desc_zh: 对具延展性或软质物体施加向心压力、揉搓或挤压以促其紧缩或变形，区别于刚性砸碎或撕裂裂解。
groups.nuance_en: knead: systematically press, fold, and stretch a malleable mass (dough / clay / muscles) · squeeze: exert pressing force inward from opposite sides (lemon / trigger / hand) · compress: reduce physical volume or data density through pressure (gas / spring / files) · pinch: squeeze tightly between two fingertips or sharp jaws (skin / salt / cheek) · wad: roll or cram pliable material into a small dense lump (paper / cash / fabric)
groups.nuance_zh: knead: 系统性揉折、推挤以形成匀质团块 (dough / clay / muscles) · squeeze: 两侧施压向内紧挤出汁液或握紧 (lemon / trigger / hand) · compress: 借助外力大幅压低体积或密实体量 (gas / spring / files) · pinch: 用双指或夹具锐角局部紧捏 (skin / salt / cheek) · wad: 将纸织等物揉挤压成紧密小球 (paper / cash / fabric)

groups.name: Confer & Bestow Formally · 恩赐与赠予 (Grant, Gift, Contribute)
groups.tip: 自愿出资捐献做贡献

items.def_en: (+ sth) officially pass control, custody, or possession of property or rights to another
items.ex_en: The outgoing director agreed to hand over all company assets to the new management.
items.ex_zh: 即将卸任的董事同意将所有公司资产移交给新管理层。

items.def_zh: 正式过户；立约转让（财产）
items.def_en: (+ sth to sb) legally transfer ownership of property, title, or funds to a recipient
items.ex_en: The elderly gentleman decided to make over his entire estate to his sole surviving niece.
items.ex_zh: 那位老绅士决定将自己的全部地产正式过户给他唯一在世的侄女。

items.def_en: 1. To officially give, allow, or bestow something, such as money, permission, or a right. 2. To admit or accept that something is true.
items.ex_en: The municipal authority refused to grant permission for the controversial construction project.
items.ex_zh: 市政当局拒绝为这一备受争议的建设项目授予许可。

items.def_en: 1. To give something to someone as a gift or present. 2. (usually passive: be gifted with) To naturally endow someone with a special quality or talent.
items.ex_en: The wealthy patron chose to gift the museum several rare eighteenth-century oil paintings.
items.ex_zh: 那位富有的赞助人选择向博物馆赠送几幅珍贵的18世纪油画。

items.def_zh: 捐助，捐献，贡献；促成，起作用；投稿
items.def_en: 1. To give money, goods, time, or assistance toward a common fund or cause. 2. (+ to) To be one of the causes of an event or situation. 3. To write articles or stories for a publication.
items.ex_en: Several prominent philanthropic organizations agreed to contribute substantial funding toward the medical research.
items.ex_zh: 几家著名的慈善机构同意为这项医学研究捐助大笔资金。

items.def_en: (+ to) To give money, goods, or services voluntarily to a cause or charity
items.ex_en: The tech entrepreneur chose to donate ten million dollars to the children's hospital foundation.
items.ex_zh: 这位科技企业家决定向儿童医院基金会捐赠一千万美元。

items.def_en: (+ sth) formally transfer ownership of rights, property, or claims to another by signature
items.ex_en: He inadvertently signed away the copyright to his debut novel.
items.ex_zh: 他不慎签字放弃了自己处女作小说的版权。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To confer an honor, gift, or right ceremoniously from a position of authority
items.ex_en: The reigning monarch decided to bestow a prestigious honorary title upon the distinguished scientist.
items.ex_zh: 在位君主决定将一项显赫的荣誉头衔赐予这位杰出的科学家。

items.def_en: (+ with) To provide an institution or person with a permanent fund or source of income
items.ex_en: A generous anonymous benefactor offered to endow the university with a permanent research fund.
items.ex_zh: 一位慷慨的匿名恩人提议为该大学资助一笔永久性研究基金。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate transferring ownership of property, rights, funds, or privileges to a recipient without receiving commercial payment in return. They typically emphasize formal authorization, donor generosity, or voluntary societal philanthropy.
groups.summary_zh: 指不求对价地正式让渡财产、权力或向公益团体捐赠捐助。
groups.desc_en: Emphasizes the deliberate, legally binding, or ceremonial transfer of honors, rights, assets, or gifts, contrasting with informal handoffs or transactional barters.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过庄严仪式、权威法令或慷慨善举转让荣誉、权利或财产，区别于私下随手递交或等价买卖。
groups.nuance_en: bestow: graciously present an honor, gift, or authority from a superior standing (honor / title / blessing) · grant: officially concede or bestow a formal right, fund, or permission (permission / scholarship / amnesty) · donate: give money, blood, or goods charitably to a cause (funds / organs / clothes) · contribute: furnish an asset or effort alongside others toward a collective pool (ideas / money / shares)
groups.nuance_zh: bestow: 居高临下恩赐或颁发殊荣、福祉 (honor / title / blessing) · grant: 官方或权威机构特批拨款、权利或许可 (permission / scholarship / amnesty) · donate: 旨在慈善公益的自愿捐赠 (funds / organs / clothes) · contribute: 与他人共同向资金池或目标认捐投入 (ideas / money / shares)

groups.name: Confuse & Bewilder · 迷惑与困惑 (Confuse, Mystify, Bewilder)
groups.tip: 认知不清陷入迷茫

items.def_en: (+ sb) to confuse someone or make them unable to think clearly
items.ex_en: These overly complicated tax instructions completely mix up ordinary taxpayers every single year.
items.ex_zh: 这些极其复杂的报税说明每年都会把普通纳税人彻底搞糊涂。

items.def_en: to cause someone confusion because something is hard to understand or explain
items.ex_en: The mysterious disappearance of the ancient manuscript continues to puzzle modern historians.
items.ex_zh: 这份古代手稿的神秘失踪至今仍令现代历史学家大惑不解。

items.def_en: (+ sb + into doing sth) to thoroughly confuse or mystify someone, often to manipulate them
items.ex_en: The slick salesman managed to bamboozle the elderly couple into buying useless insurance.
items.ex_zh: 那个圆滑的推销员设法把那对老夫妇搞糊涂，诱使他们购买了毫无用处的保险。

items.def_zh: 使困惑，弄糊涂；混淆，把……混同
items.def_en: 1. To make someone unable to think clearly or understand something. 2. To mistake one person or thing for another.
items.ex_en: The identical twins deliberately tried to confuse their teachers during the practical exam.
items.ex_zh: 这对同卵双胞胎在实操考试中故意试图把老师弄糊涂。

items.def_en: (often passive) To confuse or puzzle someone, especially as a result of drinking alcohol.
items.ex_en: Too much heavy wine served to fuddle the old scholar's scholarly senses.
items.ex_zh: 过量的烈酒使这位老学者的治学头脑变得昏昏沉沉、一片迷糊。

items.def_en: to completely bewilder or frustrate someone by being inexplicable
items.ex_en: The strange mechanical failure of the brand-new engine continued to baffle experienced engineers.
items.ex_zh: 这台全新发动机发生的奇怪机械故障让经验丰富的工程师们百思不得其解。

items.def_en: to thoroughly perplex or daze someone with a mass of conflicting information or complexity
items.ex_en: A barrage of contradictory data threatened to completely bewilder the newly appointed analyst.
items.ex_zh: 铺天盖地的矛盾数据让新任命的分析师彻底不知所措。

items.raw_cluster: 使困惑与迷惑 Confuse & Mystify
items.def_zh: 使迷惑，使困惑不解；使神秘化
items.def_en: To confuse or puzzle someone completely, often because something is impossible to understand or explain.
items.ex_en: The sudden disappearance of the airplane into thin air continues to mystify investigators worldwide.
items.ex_zh: 飞机凭空突然消失的事件至今仍让全球调查人员大惑不解。

items.def_zh: 使目瞪口呆；使思维迟钝麻木
items.def_en: to astonish or daze someone so intensely that they are unable to think or react clearly
items.ex_en: The shocking revelation about the embezzlement scheme served to stupefy the entire board.
items.ex_zh: 挪用公款阴谋的惊人揭露使整个董事会目瞪口呆、思维僵滞。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe cognitive disruption where someone's mental clarity is impaired, ranging from mild disorienting mix-ups to profound, insoluble bafflement.
groups.summary_zh: 描述认知受到干扰与困惑，从轻微混乱到深度迷惑。
groups.desc_en: Captures the disruption of cognitive clarity through complexity, ambiguity, or deception, leaving the subject unable to discern order or make sense of reality, contrasting with mere ignorance.
groups.desc_zh: 因繁复、扑朔迷离或狡黠诡计破坏认知清晰度，使人陷入迷惘，区别于单纯的无知。
groups.nuance_en: confuse: impair clarity by mixing things up or being obscure (identities / issues / audience) · bewilder: thoroughly disorient with an overwhelming maze of impressions (passerby / tourists / crowd) · baffle: frustrate completely by defying logical comprehension (experts / investigators / scientists) · mystify: perplex by appearing profoundly inexplicable or occult (critics / audience / detectives) · bamboozle: deceive or thoroughly confound through cunning trickery (voters / investors / regulators)
groups.nuance_zh: confuse: 混淆视听或颠倒是非使人发懵 (identities / issues / audience) · bewilder: 纷繁杂乱的信息排山倒海使人迷失方向 (passerby / tourists / crowd) · baffle: 毫无破绽地完全难倒逻辑推演 (experts / investigators / scientists) · mystify: 因神秘莫测、不可思议而令人费解 (critics / audience / detectives) · bamboozle: 凭借狡诈伎俩蒙骗并愚弄他人 (voters / investors / regulators)

groups.name: Contain & Entail Components · 包含与牵涉 (Contain, Include, Entail)
groups.tip: 整体内纳入各个要素

items.def_zh: 包含，包括；把……列入（或计算在内）
items.def_en: To contain something as a part of a larger whole, or to make someone or something part of a group, list, or calculation.
items.ex_en: The revised conference schedule will include two comprehensive keynote lectures by visiting experts.
items.ex_zh: 修改后的会议日程将包含客座专家带来的两场全面的主题演讲。

items.def_zh: 包含，需要；涉及，牵涉；使参与，使卷入
items.def_en: 1. To include or require something as an essential, necessary, or unavoidable part. 2. To affect or concern someone or something. 3. To cause someone to participate in an activity.
items.ex_en: Implementing this aggressive marketing strategy will inevitably involve considerable financial risks for everyone.
items.ex_zh: 实施这一激进的营销策略必将不可避免地给每个人带来巨大的财务风险。

items.def_zh: 包含，容纳；抑制，控制（情绪或局势）
items.def_en: 1. To have something inside or comprise something as an element or part. 2. To control or restrain a feeling or an escalating situation.
items.ex_en: The newly discovered historical archives contain invaluable primary documents about the civil war.
