items.ex_zh: 这处新发现的史料档案馆包含关于内战的珍贵一手文献。

items.def_en: to include something as part of a larger system, plan, or whole
items.ex_en: The software development team plans to incorporate robust security measures into the next update.
items.ex_zh: 软件开发团队计划将强大的安全机制纳入下一次系统更新中。

items.def_en: to consist of or be made up of particular parts or members
items.ex_en: The newly formed independent advisory committee will comprise ten prominent international legal experts.
items.ex_zh: 新成立的独立顾问委员会将由十位著名的国际法律专家组成。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to include or encompass a range of things or ideas
items.ex_en: The expansive survey course aims to take in modern European art and literature.
items.ex_zh: 这门内容广泛的概论课程旨在涵盖现代欧洲艺术与文学。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to entail or carry along as an inevitable consequence or accompaniment
items.ex_en: Rapid corporate expansion often tends to bring along serious organizational communication issues.
items.ex_zh: 企业的快速扩张往往不可避免地连带引起严重的组织沟通问题。

items.def_zh: 包罗，囊括（范围广泛的事物）
items.def_en: to include a wide range of ideas, subjects, or areas completely
items.ex_en: The comprehensive textbook aims to encompass the full spectrum of quantum physics theories.
items.ex_zh: 这本详尽的教材旨在完整囊括量子物理学理论的各个领域。

items.def_en: To involve or require something as a necessary or inevitable part or consequence.
items.ex_en: Undertaking such a massive restructuring program will necessarily entail significant financial investment and layoffs.
items.ex_zh: 启动如此庞大的重组计划必然会牵涉巨大的资金投入和裁员。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express mereological or implicational containment, describing what a whole incorporates as a physical part, constituent member, or necessary logical consequence.
groups.summary_zh: 表示整体对局部的物理包容、构成包含或逻辑上的必然伴随。
groups.desc_en: Highlights compositional or logical encompassment, specifying what elements reside within a boundary, list, or consequence, contrasting with external adjacency or exclusion.
groups.desc_zh: 强调构成要件或逻辑推导上的涵盖收摄，界定边界、列表或因果链内的事物，区别于外部邻近或排斥。
groups.nuance_en: contain: hold within a physical receptacle or defined scope (liquid / contents / crowd) · include: count an item as part of an aggregate whole (breakfast / clause / fee) · comprise: consist of or constitute as whole elements (departments / nations / chapters) · encompass: broad thematic, temporal, or spatial envelopment (range / issues / area) · entail: involve unavoidably as a necessary logical consequence (risk / sacrifice / costs)
groups.nuance_zh: contain: 物理容器容纳或范围界定容纳 (liquid / contents / crowd) · include: 将某项算作大集合整体的一部分 (breakfast / clause / fee) · comprise: 由哪些部分组合构成整体，或整体包含诸部 (departments / nations / chapters) · encompass: 广泛跨越、包揽空间、时间或议题 (range / issues / area) · entail: 逻辑上不可避免地伴随必然代价或后果 (risk / sacrifice / costs)

groups.name: Contest & Squabble · 锦标比拼与琐事争执 (Tourney, Squabble)
groups.tip: 赛场竞技或口舌纷争

items.def_en: (+ sb) engage in an angry dispute or petty argument with someone
items.ex_en: The foreign minister refused to quarrel with domestic political critics over minor foreign policy details.
items.ex_zh: 外交部长拒绝就微小的外交政策细节与国内政治批评者进行争执。

items.def_en: quarrel or disagree sharply with someone, ending friendly relations
items.ex_en: The two business partners would fall out irreparably over how to distribute profits.
items.ex_zh: 这两位商业伙伴最终会因为如何分配利润而彻底闹翻失和。

items.def_zh: 坦诚摊牌；当面争辩了结争端
items.def_en: argue openly with someone to resolve a contentious grievance or quarrel
items.ex_en: I finally decided to have it out with my roommate about unpaid household utility bills.
items.ex_zh: 我最终决定就拖欠的水电费问题与我的室友当面坦诚摊牌。

items.def_zh: 参加（比武）锦标赛，比武竞逐
items.def_en: 1. (historical) To participate or compete in a tournament, especially a medieval joust.
items.ex_en: Brave young knights assembled from across the realm to tourney for the king's favor.
items.ex_zh: 来自王国各地的英勇青年骑士齐聚一堂，在比武场上一决高下以争夺国王的青睐。

items.def_en: (+ about/over) to argue incessantly about petty and trivial matters
items.ex_en: The bored siblings continued to bicker endlessly over minor rules during the rainy afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 无聊的兄妹俩在下雨的午后不停地为微不足道的游戏规则斗嘴。

items.def_en: 1. (+ over/about/with) To argue noisily over trivial, unimportant matters.
items.ex_en: The young heirs began to squabble loudly over their late grandfather's remaining antique furniture.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的继承人们开始为已故祖父留下的一件旧家具大声争吵起来。

items.def_en: (+ over/about) to argue or dispute aggressively and at length
items.ex_en: Lawyers for both corporate factions continued to wrangle aggressively over the proprietary patent terms.
items.ex_zh: 双方企业的律师继续就专有专利条款展开冗长激烈的争端。

items.def_zh: 骑枪比武，言语交锋抗衡
items.def_en: (+ with) to engage in a formal chivalric combat or compete fiercely for power/prestige
items.ex_en: Armored champions rode forward boldly to joust before the royal pavilion at noon.
items.ex_zh: 身披重甲的骑士们在正午时分毅然向前骑行，在皇家看台前举行骑枪比武。

items.def_en: (+ into/out of) to obtain an advantage or overcome a dispute through scheming
items.ex_en: He managed to wangle an exclusive VIP pass into the sold-out concert venue.
items.ex_zh: 他设法靠小手段谋得了一张进入这场爆满演唱会场馆的专属贵宾通行证。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe scenarios of rivalry and petty disputes, contrasting formal organized combat or competition with noisy, trivial bickering between parties.
groups.summary_zh: 参加竞技锦标赛比试，或就琐碎小事口角争吵。
groups.desc_en: Spans oppositional encounters ranging from petty verbal friction over trivialities to codified ritualized tournament combat, contrasting with cooperative dialogue or total war.
groups.desc_zh: 涵盖从生活琐碎口角争闹到规则严整的骑士打擂比试，区别于合作性对话或全面死斗。
groups.nuance_en: squabble: argue noisily and childishly over trivial matters (heirs / children / politicians) · bicker: bad-tempered, petty, and persistent nagging dispute (couple / siblings / committee) · wrangle: engage in a protracted, complicated, and noisy dispute (lawyers / regulators / factions) · joust: engage in ritualized combat on horseback, or sharp debate (knights / rivals / debaters) · tourney: compete formally in a tournament or medieval pageant (champions / contestants / knights)
groups.nuance_zh: squabble: 因鸡毛蒜皮琐事喧闹撕破脸争吵 (heirs / children / politicians) · bicker: 夫妻或密友间无休止的挑剔抬杠斗嘴 (couple / siblings / committee) · wrangle: 牵扯利益且冗长复杂的吵闹纠纷 (lawyers / regulators / factions) · joust: 马上骑矛比武，亦指唇枪舌剑的针锋相对 (knights / rivals / debaters) · tourney: 参加中世纪擂台演武或大型锦标角逐 (champions / contestants / knights)

groups.name: Continuous Fluid Outpouring · 涌流与喷溢 (Gush, Spout, Spew)
groups.tip: 液体或气体喷薄涌出之态

items.def_en: to discharge or emanate in an abundant, continuous stream
items.ex_en: She poured out her troubles to her best friend over coffee.
items.ex_zh: 她一边喝咖啡一边向闺蜜倾诉自己的烦恼。
items.ex2_en: Tearful grievances poured out uncontrollably as she confronted her estranged family members.
items.ex2_zh: 当她面对疏远的家人时，满腹委屈泪如雨下地倾泻而出。

items.def_en: to rise to the surface and overflow copiously from within
items.ex_en: Deep sorrow began to well up inside her upon hearing the tragic announcement.
items.ex_zh: 一听到这则悲惨的宣告，深切的悲伤便从她心底奔涌而上。

items.def_en: (+ sth) burst forth or gush rapidly and forcefully from an aperture
items.ex_en: A violent blast of pressurized steam began to spurt out from the cracked boiler pipe.
items.ex_zh: 一股强劲的高压蒸汽开始从开裂的锅炉管道中喷射而出。
items.ex2_en: The damaged pressurized tank spurted out dangerous toxic chemicals into the factory.
items.ex2_zh: 受损的压力罐向工厂内喷射出危险的有毒化学品。

items.def_en: flow out suddenly and in massive, overpowering quantities
items.ex_en: Massive waves of icy seawater would surge out whenever the floodgate was slightly opened.
items.ex_zh: 只要水闸稍微打开一点，冰冷海水的滔天巨浪就会暴涌而出。

items.def_zh: 喷出，涌出；滔滔不绝地说，高谈阔论
items.def_en: 1. To shoot or pour out forcefully in a stream. 2. (informal, disapproving) To speak lengthily and tediously about something.
items.ex_en: Freezing geyser water began to spout upward into the frosty morning air suddenly.
items.ex_zh: 冰凉的间歇泉水突然开始向上喷涌进寒冷的清晨空气中。
items.ex2_en: The broken garden pipe spouted cold murky water over the manicured lawn.
items.ex2_zh: 破裂的花园水管向修剪整齐的草坪上喷射出浑浊的冷水。

items.def_en: (+ sth) expel large volumes of liquid, gas, or matter forcefully and continuously
items.ex_en: Broken industrial chimneys began to spew out thick black toxic smoke across the quiet valley.
items.ex_zh: 破损的工业烟囱开始向宁静的山谷喷涌出浓厚的黑色有毒烟尘。
items.ex2_en: Scalding volcanic ash spewed out continuously from the deep crater during eruption.
items.ex2_zh: 火山喷发期间，滚烫的火山灰持续从深火山口中喷涌而出。

items.def_en: 1. To flow out or spit out in large quantities and with great force. 2. To vomit.
items.ex_en: Active geothermal vents regularly spew scalding sulfur steam into the rocky mountain air.
items.ex_zh: 活跃的地热喷孔定期向岩石山区的空气中喷出滚烫的硫磺蒸汽。
items.ex2_en: Thick black diesel exhaust spewed relentlessly into the congested city street air.
items.ex2_zh: 浓黑的柴油废气不断涌入拥堵的城市街道空气中。

items.def_zh: 涌出，迸出；滔滔不绝地说，过分热情地赞扬
items.def_en: 1. To flow out suddenly and in large amounts in a rapid stream. 2. To express great enthusiasm or praise in an exaggerated way.
items.ex_en: Cool mountain spring water began to gush rapidly from the newly opened rock crevice.
items.ex_zh: 清凉的山泉水开始从新裂开的岩石缝隙中急速喷涌而出。
items.ex2_en: The ruptured main pipeline gushed gallons of contaminated water onto the pavement.
items.ex2_zh: 破裂的主管道向路面上喷涌出数加仑受污染的水。

items.def_en: to violently erupt or eject large masses of smoke, fire, or fumes into the air
items.ex_en: The roaring industrial chimneys continued to belch thick dark clouds of smoke into the sky.
items.ex_zh: 轰鸣的工业烟囱不断向空中喷吐出阵阵浓黑的滚滚烟云。

groups.summary_en: Large volumes of liquid, gas, or debris are discharged continuously or copiously from an opening or conduit. Nuances differ by whether the outflow is driven by an upward/pressurized orifice (spout), an overwhelming volume (gush), or an uncontrolled, often repulsive ejection (spew).
groups.summary_zh: 大量流体或杂物自孔口汹涌倾泻、喷出或狂涌，突出流态与流向。
groups.desc_en: Depicts pressurized, copious, or continuous fluid and matter escaping rapidly outward from an aperture or internal reserve, contrasting with stagnant containment or slow, gentle dripping.
groups.desc_zh: 描绘流体或物质在压力作用下从孔隙或深层大量、持续喷涌宣泄而出，区别于静止蓄积或温和滴沥。
groups.nuance_en: gush: flow forth suddenly, copiously, and with great velocity (oil / water / blood) · spout: discharge forcefully in a focused jet or tube (whale / volcano / fountain) · spew: violently and indiscriminately eject vast messy quantities (ash / smoke / lava) · well up: rise gradually to a surface from deep within (tears / emotions / springwater) · spurt: burst out suddenly in short, intermittent pressurized jets (artery / fuel / steam)
groups.nuance_zh: gush: 大量流体疾速、汹涌奔泻而出 (oil / water / blood) · spout: 呈管状或水柱状强力喷出 (whale / volcano / fountain) · spew: 杂乱、猛烈且粗暴地喷吐倾泻脏物 (ash / smoke / lava) · well up: 从渊薮深处缓缓盈溢升腾涌现 (tears / emotions / springwater) · spurt: 受脉冲压力间歇性猝然喷射 (artery / fuel / steam)

groups.name: Copulate & Fornicate · 媾和与寻欢 (Screw, Fornicate, Wench)
groups.tip: 动物或人类的交配交媾行为

items.def_en: (slang) to have sexual intercourse with someone
items.ex_en: He bragged that he managed to lay a foreign tourist during the summer festival.
items.ex_zh: 他吹嘘说自己在夏季狂欢节期间与一名外国游客上床了。

items.def_zh: 与……性交；用螺钉固定，拧紧；欺骗，坑害
items.def_en: 1. (slang) To have sexual intercourse with someone. 2. To fasten or tighten something with screws. 3. (informal) To cheat or treat someone unfairly.
items.ex_en: He made a crude remark suggesting they should screw after leaving the late-night bar.
items.ex_zh: 他粗鲁地提议在离开深夜酒吧后一起去鬼混上床。

items.def_en: to have sexual intercourse with someone (common polite euphemism)
items.ex_en: She admitted to her best friend that she did sleep with him last night.
items.ex_zh: 她向最好的朋友坦承，自己昨晚确实和他发生了性关系。

items.def_zh: （尤指偶然或随便地）发生性关系，亲热
items.def_en: (+ with sb) to engage in sexual activity or intercourse with someone, often casually
items.ex_en: Can you help me hook up the sound system to my laptop?
items.ex_zh: 你能帮我把音响系统连接到笔记本电脑上吗？

items.def_zh: 同居，搭伙过日子（常带贬义或非婚色彩）
items.def_en: (+ with sb) to live and have a sexual relationship with someone without being married
items.ex_en: His family was genuinely shocked when he decided to shack up with his new partner.
items.ex_zh: 当他决定和新伴侣未婚同居搭伙过日子时，他的家人感到非常震惊。

items.def_zh: 搞暧昧，发生不正当性关系；鬼混
items.def_en: (+ with sb) to engage in casual sexual activity or have an illicit affair
items.ex_en: Rumors spread that he had been fooling around with his secretary after work.
items.ex_zh: 有传言说他下班后一直与自己的秘书乱搞男女关系。

items.def_en: (archaic) To associate promiscuously with women or frequent prostitutes.
items.ex_en: The disgraced nobleman spent his fortune to drink and wench in cheap taverns.
items.ex_zh: 那位身败名裂的贵族挥霍家财，在廉价小酒馆里饮酒宿娼。

items.def_en: (+ with) to live together and have a sexual relationship without being married
items.ex_en: The state law still prohibited unmarried couples from cohabiting in government housing.
items.ex_zh: 该州法律仍然禁止未婚情侣在政府公租房内同居。

items.def_zh: 私通，通奸，（男女非婚）性交
items.def_en: (formal or dated) To have sexual intercourse with someone to whom one is not married.
items.ex_en: The puritan preacher warned that those who fornicate shall face severe divine judgment.
items.ex_zh: 清教徒传教士警告说，行私通之淫乱者必将面临严酷的神罚。

groups.summary_en: Human participants engage in sexual intercourse, differentiated by taboo registers, moral/archaic censure, or vulgar euphemism.
groups.summary_zh: 多指人类性交行为，区别在于粗俗用语、宗教道德谴责或古风寻欢。
groups.desc_en: Denotes engaging in sexual intercourse or transient hedonistic hookups across various registers from vulgar slang to archaic profligacy, contrasting with romantic celibacy or pure spiritual affection.
groups.desc_zh: 指发生肉体性交或短暂寻欢作乐，跨越从俚俗粗鄙到古体放荡的不同语域，区别于柏拉图式恋爱或禁欲守贞。
groups.nuance_en: screw: engage in sexual intercourse, often vulgar or casual (stranger / partner / escort) · hook up: modern colloquial casual sexual encounter or making out (classmate / acquaintance / ex) · fornicate: formal or theological consensual sex outside marriage (sinners / adulterers / youth) · wench: archaically associate with prostitutes or wanton women (sailors / gallants / knaves) · cohabit: live together without marriage, often sexual (partners / couple / lovers)
groups.nuance_zh: screw: 粗俗或口语化指发生肉体交媾 (stranger / partner / escort) · hook up: 当代口语中模糊指代搭戏、上床或亲热 (classmate / acquaintance / ex) · fornicate: 宗教戒律或文雅语境下的非婚通奸 (sinners / adulterers / youth) · wench: 历史古体词，指男子四处寻花问柳狎妓 (sailors / gallants / knaves) · cohabit: 未婚同居并保持性关系 (partners / couple / lovers)

groups.name: Corrode & Decay · 腐蚀与变质 (Corrode, Oxidize, Ret)
groups.tip: 化学作用导致质地瓦解

items.def_en: (+ at) to progressively consume or dissolve a substance by chemical degradation
items.ex_en: The concentrated acid continued to eat away at the heavy protective metal plate.
items.ex_zh: 浓酸继续不断蚕食并腐蚀着厚重的金属防护板。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to gradually become thinner, smoother, or eroded through friction, moisture, or chemical action
items.ex_en: Centuries of footsteps gradually wore away the soft surface of the marble stairs.
items.ex_zh: 数个世纪的踩踏逐渐磨损了大理石台阶柔软的表面。
items.ex2_en: The ancient stone stairs gradually wore away under millions of tourist footsteps.
items.ex2_zh: 古老的石阶在数百万游客的脚步下逐渐磨损剥落。

items.def_en: to decay slowly and completely through natural or bacterial action until disintegrated
items.ex_en: Abandoned in the damp forest, the wooden fence began to slowly rot away.
items.ex_zh: 那道木栅栏被遗弃在潮湿的森林中，开始慢慢腐朽殆尽。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to corrode completely or form holes as a result of rusting
items.ex_en: Road salt caused the steel frame of the truck to completely rust out.
items.ex_zh: 融雪盐导致那辆卡车的钢制底盘框架被彻底锈穿。
items.ex2_en: Prolonged exposure to seawater will eventually rust out the old iron chains.
items.ex2_zh: 长期暴露在海水中最终会彻底锈蚀这些旧铁链。

items.def_en: [I/T] to undergo oxidation resulting in the formation of reddish-brown iron oxide
items.ex_en: The old iron tools left out in the rain will surely begin to rust.
items.ex_zh: 遗留在雨水中的旧铁制工具肯定会开始生锈。
items.ex2_en: Salty ocean air will quickly rust untreated metal fixtures along the coastline.
items.ex2_zh: 咸湿的海洋空气会迅速锈蚀海岸线附近未经处理的金属构件。

items.def_en: [I/T] to lose or cause to lose metallic luster through exposure to air or moisture
items.ex_en: Exposure to industrial sulfur caused the polished silver candlesticks to tarnish very quickly.
items.ex_zh: 暴露在工业硫化物中导致抛光的银烛台极快地氧化变暗。
items.ex2_en: Damp industrial smog will gradually tarnish delicate bronze sculptures in the courtyard.
items.ex2_zh: 潮湿的工业烟雾会逐渐使庭院中精致的青铜雕塑失去光泽。

items.def_en: (chemistry) To combine with oxygen, or cause to combine with oxygen; to undergo or cause to undergo a reaction in which electrons are lost.
items.ex_en: When copper exposed to ambient air oxidizes, a delicate green patina slowly emerges.
items.ex_zh: 当铜暴露在周围空气中发生氧化时，一层细腻的铜绿便会悄然显现。
items.ex2_en: Excessive heat during roasting can easily oxidize delicate aromatic oils in coffee.
items.ex2_zh: 烘焙过程中过高的热量容易使咖啡中微妙的芳香油氧化。

items.def_zh: 沤（麻等），沤制；使受潮腐解
items.def_en: To soak flax, hemp, or other plant stalks in water or expose them to moisture to loosen the fibers by rotting the outer tissue.
items.ex_en: The harvest hands bundled the harvested flax stalks to ret in the river.
items.ex_zh: 收割工人把割下的亚麻秆扎成捆，放入河中沤制。

items.def_en: [I/T] to slowly wear away or destroy a metal, stone, or surface by chemical action
items.ex_en: Industrial emissions can severely corrode stone monuments throughout the historical city center.
items.ex_zh: 工业废气排放会严重腐蚀整个历史城市中心的大理石古迹。
items.ex2_en: Submerged bronze artifacts slowly corroded under the salty waters of the harbor.
items.ex2_zh: 沉没的青铜器物在海港的咸水中慢慢遭到了腐蚀。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scenario cover natural, chemical, and biochemical processes where moisture, oxygen, acid, or bacterial soaking slowly break down material integrity. Registers range from industrial chemistry to agricultural soaking and elemental rust.
groups.summary_zh: 材料在化学反应、氧气或微生物浸泡作用下逐渐侵蚀、分解及变质。
groups.desc_en: Governs the chemical, electrochemical, or biological deterioration of materials caused by exposure to natural environments or agents, contrasting with instantaneous mechanical breakage.
groups.desc_zh: 指物体因自然环境浸润、电化学作用或生物分解而缓慢发生质变腐蚀衰亡，区别于瞬时机械碎裂。
groups.nuance_en: corrode: chemically eat away the surface of metals or stone (iron / acid / credibility) · rust: oxidize iron or its alloys producing reddish-brown flakes (metal / pipes / chain) · tarnish: lose luster or discolor through surface chemical reaction (silver / reputation / brass) · oxidize: undergo chemical reaction with oxygen at the atomic level (wine / surface / lipids) · ret: soak natural plant fibers to rot away soft cellular tissues (flax / hemp / straw)
groups.nuance_zh: corrode: 酸碱或化学作用由表及里蚕食损毁 (iron / acid / credibility) · rust: 铁基合金氧化生成红褐色锈斑 (metal / pipes / chain) · tarnish: 金属表层氧化失去光泽，亦指名誉蒙尘 (silver / reputation / brass) · oxidize: 原子层面上与氧发生氧化反应 (wine / surface / lipids) · ret: 浸渍沤麻利用微生物分解植物软组织 (flax / hemp / straw)

groups.name: Course Deviation & Directional Shifting · 航向偏转与走向漂移 (Veer, Trend, Port)
groups.tip: 突然偏离既定航线

items.def_en: to move slowly and unintentionally away from a course or designated line
items.ex_en: The tired helmsman allowed the small fishing boat to drift off its course.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的舵手让这艘小渔船逐渐偏离了既定航线。

items.def_zh: （舵、船等）转向左舷，向左转舵；持（枪）
items.def_en: 1. (nautical) To turn or steer a ship or aircraft to the left or port side. 2. (military) To carry a weapon diagonally across the body.
items.ex_en: The captain ordered the seasoned helmsman to port the helm before entering the bay.
items.ex_zh: 进湾之前，船长命令那位经验老到的舵手向左舷转舵。
items.ex2_en: The heavy cargo ship ported smoothly as the harbor pilot took control.
items.ex2_zh: 当港口引航员接管控制时，重型货船平稳地向左转向。

items.def_zh: （朝某一方向）偏向，转向；显现……倾向；（在社交媒体上）流行
items.def_en: 1. To change direction or veer sharply in a particular course. 2. To show a general tendency or development. 3. To be currently popular on social media.
items.ex_en: The coastline trends southward before bending eastward toward the open ocean.
items.ex_zh: 这条海岸线先是向南偏向，随后向东折向浩瀚的大洋。

items.def_en: (of a ship, aircraft, or vehicle) to turn temporarily off course to the left or right
items.ex_en: Caught in the violent crosswinds, the vessel began to yaw dangerously off track.
items.ex_zh: 陷入猛烈的侧风之中，船只开始危险地左右偏航。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to change heading or orientation quickly toward another direction
items.ex_en: The captain ordered the crew to swing around the ship toward open water.
items.ex_zh: 船长命令船员迅速调转船头，驶向开阔海域。
items.ex2_en: The massive radar antenna swung around continuously to track incoming civilian aircraft.
items.ex2_zh: 巨大的雷达天线不断旋转以追踪飞来的民航飞机。

items.def_en: to suddenly or noticeably turn away from an intended path, course, or direction
items.ex_en: The sleepy driver allowed the car to veer off the marked country lane.
items.ex_zh: 昏昏欲睡的司机任由汽车偏离了画线的乡村小道。

items.def_en: to change the course of a boat by turning its head into the wind so the sails shift
items.ex_en: The sailors had to tack constantly to make progress against the fierce wind.
items.ex_zh: 水手们必须不断抢风调向，才能逆着强劲的风力前进。

items.def_en: (+ from) to depart from an established course, standard, or path
items.ex_en: The pilot was not permitted to deviate from the designated flight path tonight.
items.ex_zh: 飞行员今晚未被允许偏离既定的飞行航线。

items.def_en: to change direction smoothly or suddenly, especially of wind, a vehicle, or course
items.ex_en: The gusty wind veered toward the north as the autumn storm rolled in.
items.ex_zh: 随着秋季风暴的来临，阵风突然转而刮向北方。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe gradual or prescribed changes in direction, heading, or orientation, whether driven by mechanical navigation (nautical/aeronautical) or dynamic momentum.
groups.summary_zh: 交通工具或运动物体的偏转、航向调整或宏观走向的漂移。
groups.desc_en: Concerns directional alterations, course deviations, or systematic shifts in trajectory or statistical movement, contrasting with straight-line forward advance.
groups.desc_zh: 指移动航线、受力轨迹或统计走势发生偏离或渐进转移，区别于正向直线推进。
groups.nuance_en: veer: change direction suddenly or unpredictably (wind / car / discussion) · trend: change or develop in a general progressive direction (market / data / opinion) · deviate: depart measurably from an established norm, course, or standard (path / protocol / baseline) · tack: change ship course by turning bow through the wind; shift strategy (sailboat / policy / course) · yaw: swerve or oscillate erratically off course around a vertical axis (ship / aircraft / vehicle)
groups.nuance_zh: veer: 突发性或不可预测地急剧转弯偏航 (wind / car / discussion) · trend: 呈现出渐进的宏观走向与势头 (market / data / opinion) · deviate: 偏离既定轨道、常规基准或规范 (path / protocol / baseline) · tack: 帆船迎风抢风之字拐弯，比喻变招 (sailboat / policy / course) · yaw: 船舶或飞行器绕垂直轴左右失稳偏航晃荡 (ship / aircraft / vehicle)

groups.name: Court & Woo · 追求与求爱 (Court, Romance, Woo)
groups.tip: 男女恋爱关系中的倾心追求场景

items.def_zh: 追求，向……求爱；设法取悦，拉拢；招致
items.def_en: 1. To pursue a romantic relationship with someone, especially with a view to marriage. 2. To try to gain the favor or support of someone. 3. To invite or risk causing something unpleasant.
items.ex_en: The young gentleman spent many quiet months courting the wealthy merchant's eldest daughter.
items.ex_zh: 那位年轻绅士花费了数月安静的时光，追求那位富商的长女。

items.def_en: (archaic) to act as a suitor; court someone
items.ex_en: He came to the manor to suit her with earnest promises of devotion.
items.ex_zh: 他来到庄园向她求爱，并许下了真挚忠诚的诺言。

items.def_en: to try to start a sexual or romantic relationship with someone
items.ex_en: He decided to pursue her after they met at the annual charity gala.
items.ex_zh: 在年度慈善晚会上相识之后，他决定正式追求她。

items.def_zh: 追求，向……求爱；讨好，拉拢；虚构
items.def_en: 1. To court someone or show romantic affection toward them. 2. To try to win the favor, business, or support of someone. 3. To invent or exaggerate stories.
items.ex_en: He tried to romance his colleague with expensive dinners and bouquets of lilies.
items.ex_zh: 他试图用昂贵的晚餐和百合花束来向那位女同事示好求爱。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to invite someone out on a date with romantic intent
items.ex_en: He finally gathered the courage to ask her out for a movie.
items.ex_zh: 他终于鼓起勇气约她出去看电影。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to talk flirtatiously to someone with the aim of attracting them romantically
items.ex_en: He tried to chat up the bartender while waiting for his evening drinks.
items.ex_zh: 他在等晚间酒水时，试图向那位调酒师搭讪示好。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to demonstrate sexual or romantic interest in someone through forward words or actions
items.ex_en: He boldly hit on the attractive tourist sitting at the hotel lounge counter.
items.ex_zh: 他大胆地向坐在酒店大堂吧台前的那位迷人游客搭讪挑逗。

items.def_en: to seek the affection or favor of someone, especially with a view to marriage
items.ex_en: He wooed the brilliant scholar with handwritten letters and sweet bouquets of wildflowers.
items.ex_zh: 他用手写书信和甜美的野花花束追求那位才华横溢的学者。

items.def_en: to sing or play a song for someone in a romantic manner
items.ex_en: He stood under her balcony to serenade her with an old acoustic guitar.
items.ex_zh: 他站在她的阳台下，用一把老旧的木吉他为她弹唱情歌。

groups.summary_en: A suitor makes romantic overtures to someone with the aim of winning affection, initiating a relationship, or securing marriage. Verbs range from romantic attentiveness to formal traditional wooing.
groups.summary_zh: 向心仪之人示好、献殷勤以博取芳心并结为伴侣的情感追求过程。
groups.desc_en: Covers romantic overtures and seduction rituals aimed at winning affection, dating, or marriage, contrasting with platonic friendship or abrupt sexual solicitation.
groups.desc_zh: 指为赢得爱慕、建立恋爱关系或缔结婚约而展开的追求与示好仪轨，区别于纯洁友谊或唐突肉欲招揽。
groups.nuance_en: court: deliberately seek favor and affection, often aiming at marriage or alliance (bride / voters / investor) · woo: seek earnest romantic love or political/business patronage with charm (voters / suitor / customer) · romance: court attentively with flowers, dates, and romantic gestures (partner / lover / date) · chat up: strike up flirtatious conversation casually to gauge interest (stranger / bartender / patron) · hit on: make direct, unambiguous sexual or romantic advances toward (colleague / girl / tourist)
groups.nuance_zh: court: 传统正式地追求以求成婚，或游说拉拢 (bride / voters / investor) · woo: 竭尽魅力深情求爱，或争取支持与赞助 (voters / suitor / customer) · romance: 用鲜花、烛光晚餐等浪漫手段殷勤示爱 (partner / lover / date) · chat up: 英式口语，搭讪套近乎以期调情 (stranger / bartender / patron) · hit on: 目的极明确、露骨地开撩或搭讪求爱 (colleague / girl / tourist)

groups.name: Cover Surface with Sheet Material · 贴纸与薄层敷裹覆盖
groups.tip: 盖覆于表层以掩蔽或护底

items.def_zh: 用壁纸裱糊，用纸张遮盖
items.def_en: (+ sth) to cover a wall or damaged surface with wallpaper or paper sheeting
items.ex_en: The joint statement merely papered over deep disagreements between the two leaders.
items.ex_zh: 这份联合声明只是粉饰了两位领导人之间的深刻分歧。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to fix paper, posters, or sheeting onto a wall or surface using adhesive
items.ex_en: The activists paste up colorful posters across the concrete walls of the plaza.
items.ex_zh: 活动人士在广场的水泥墙上贴覆五颜六色的宣传海报。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to fasten or hang wallpaper or notices onto a wall or flat surface
items.ex_en: They decided to put up patterned wallpaper in the refurbished master bedroom today.
items.ex_zh: 他们今天决定在翻新后的主卧张贴带有花纹的壁纸。

items.def_en: to put a layer of protective paper, foil, or fabric on the inner surface of an item
items.ex_en: Be sure to line the cake pan with parchment paper before baking.
items.ex_zh: 烘烤前务必在蛋糕模具内表面衬上一层烘焙油纸。

items.def_zh: 覆盖，遮盖；掩蔽，保护；包含，涉及
items.def_en: 1. To place something over or upon something else in order to protect, conceal, or decorate it. 2. To deal with, include, or provide for something.
items.ex_en: She decided to cover the worn tabletop with a layer of waterproof film.
items.ex_zh: 她决定用一层防水薄膜覆盖住那块磨损的桌面。

items.def_zh: 给（墙壁等）贴壁纸；用纸包装，用纸覆盖
items.def_en: 1. To apply wallpaper to a wall or room. 2. To cover or wrap something with paper.
items.ex_en: The decorators worked all weekend to paper the large guest bedroom with damask.
items.ex_zh: 装修工人忙活了整个周末，用锦缎花纹纸给宽敞的客房贴壁纸。

items.def_en: to apply decorative paper to the interior walls of a room
items.ex_en: We hired professional decorators to wallpaper the entire downstairs dining room this week.
items.ex_zh: 我们本周聘请了专业的粉刷工给楼下整个餐厅贴壁纸。

items.def_en: (+ with/in) to hang cloth or a covering loosely and casually over an object
items.ex_en: They chose to drape the dusty furniture with large sheets of protective plastic.
items.ex_zh: 他们选择用大张的防护塑料膜将落满灰尘的家具覆挂起来。

items.def_zh: 用外皮或护套紧密包覆
items.def_en: to enclose a surface or structure tightly within a protective casing or skin
items.ex_en: The craftsmen sheathed the wooden hull with thin protective copper sheeting against worms.
items.ex_zh: 工匠们用轻薄的铜皮紧密包覆木质船体，以防虫蛀。

groups.summary_en: Denotes the physical action of spreading an exterior layer over a surface, particularly applying wallpaper, protective paper, or general sheeting over walls or furniture.
groups.summary_zh: 通过张贴墙纸、蒙纸或敷层等方式将物体表面彻底遮覆。
groups.desc_en: Applies flexible sheet materials, paper, or textiles across a surface to line, conceal, or decorate it, differing from liquid coating or solid cladding by involving pliable layering.
groups.desc_zh: 指使用柔性片材、纸张或织物贴附于表面以起到衬垫、遮蔽或装饰作用，区别于液体涂刷或刚性包层，强调轻薄延展层的敷裹。
groups.nuance_en: paper: paste wallcoverings over an interior surface (walls / bedroom) · line: apply an interior layer for protection or backing (drawers / shelves / coats) · drape: loosely hang fabric in soft folds across something (curtains / sheets / furniture) · paper over: superficially conceal flaws or disputes (cracks / differences / cracks in unity)
groups.nuance_zh: paper: 张贴壁纸装潢墙面 (walls / bedroom) · line: 内部铺垫衬里以防磨损或装饰 (drawers / shelves / coats) · drape: 将布料织物自然悬垂覆搭 (curtains / sheets / furniture) · paper over: 敷衍粉饰分歧或瑕疵 (cracks / differences / cracks in unity)

groups.name: Creative Art & Music Making · 艺术与音乐创作 (Compose, Improvise, Stylize)
groups.tip: 构思谱写作品或登台演绎

items.def_en: to write or arrange music for a film, play, or specific set of instruments
items.ex_en: The celebrated composer agreed to score the upcoming historical drama for the studio.
items.ex_zh: 这位著名作曲家同意为制片厂即将推出的历史剧配乐。

items.def_en: To write lyrics for a piece of music or song.
items.ex_en: The poet was commissioned to lyric several choral pieces for the summer festival.
items.ex_zh: 这位诗人受委托为夏季音乐节的数支合唱曲目作词。

items.def_en: [I/T] to write or create a piece of music, poetry, or literature
items.ex_en: The maestro struggled to compose a grand symphony for the national centennial celebrations.
items.ex_zh: 这位大师艰难地为国家百年庆典谱写一部宏大的交响曲。

items.def_zh: 演奏爵士乐；跳爵士舞；使生动活泼 (jazz up)
items.def_en: 1. To play music in the style of jazz. 2. ('jazz up') To make something more lively, interesting, or colorful.
items.ex_en: The house band started to jazz loudly as the late patrons filed in.
items.ex_zh: 当深夜的顾客陆续入场时，驻场乐队便开始欢快地演奏爵士乐。

items.def_zh: （在音乐或艺术上）对……即兴发挥
items.def_en: (+ sth) to play or produce an artistic or musical improvisation based on an existing theme or idea
items.ex_en: The saxophonist started to riff on a classic melody with dazzling technical skill.
items.ex_zh: 那位萨克斯手以令人炫目的技巧，对一段经典旋律展开了即兴发挥。

items.def_en: to improvise music casually alongside other musicians or a recording
items.ex_en: The guest guitarist was invited to jam along with the resident rhythm section.
items.ex_zh: 特邀吉他手受邀跟着常驻节奏声部一起进行即兴合奏。

items.def_en: [I/T] to create or perform music, poetry, or drama spontaneously without preparation
items.ex_en: When the sheet music went missing, the pianist had to improvise onstage.
items.ex_zh: 当乐谱不翼而飞时，钢琴家只得在舞台上当场即兴演奏。

items.def_zh: 将……改编为剧本；戏剧化表现
items.def_en: to adapt a novel, event, or story into a theatrical or broadcast drama
items.ex_en: The network plans to dramatize the real-life political scandal into a miniseries.
items.ex_zh: 该电视台计划将这起真实的政治丑闻改编成一部电视迷你剧。

items.def_zh: 把……改编成小说（或戏剧、电影），使虚构化
items.def_en: To write a novel, play, or film based on real events or people with invented details.
items.ex_en: The author decided to fictionalize her family history for her debut literary novel.
items.ex_zh: 这位作家决定将自己的家族史虚构化，写进她的处女作文学小说。

groups.summary_en: An artist, writer, or musician crafts creative material or adapts subject matter into a particular expressive or musical style. Typical constructions include writing words for music, improvising on an instrument, or reshaping reality into art.
groups.summary_zh: 艺术家或创作者创作艺术品、谱写词曲或对现实进行艺术化风格加工。
groups.desc_en: Covers intentional compositional, lyrical, or improvisational music-making and artistic adaptation, contrasting with mere passive listening or mechanical audio reproduction.
groups.desc_zh: 指音乐与艺术的构思创作、即兴发挥或形式转化，区别于被动的聆听或机械性的音频重放。
groups.nuance_en: compose: formally craft structured music or text (symphony / piece / sonnet) · score: arrange or orchestrate music for a specific medium (film / orchestra / play) · improvise: invent and perform extemporaneously (melody / solo / chords) · riff on: spontaneously iterate or playfully adapt a motif or idea (theme / classic song / concept)
groups.nuance_zh: compose: 严谨构思创作乐曲或文本 (symphony / piece / sonnet) · score: 为特定影视或剧场配乐编曲 (film / orchestra / play) · improvise: 毫无准备地即兴演奏发挥 (melody / solo / chords) · riff on: 基于某主题或动机即兴变奏推演 (theme / classic song / concept)

groups.name: Creep & Advance Slowly · 挪动与缓行 (Inch, Edge, Sidle)
groups.tip: 一点一滴艰难挪移

items.def_zh: 缓慢移动，艰难挪动；使缓慢挪动
items.def_en: To move very slowly or carefully in a particular direction, or make something do this.
items.ex_en: The truck driver managed to inch the heavy vehicle through the narrow archway.
items.ex_zh: 货车司机设法让这辆沉重的车辆缓缓挪过狭窄的拱门。
items.ex2_en: The long freight train inched cautiously across the precarious old wooden bridge.
items.ex2_zh: 长长的货运列车小心翼翼地慢慢驶过危险的旧木桥。

items.def_en: (+ around/past) to walk softly on one's toes to proceed quietly and unobtrusively
items.ex_en: The children had to tiptoe past their father's study during his afternoon meeting.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们在父亲举行下午会议时，不得不踮着脚尖走过他的书房。

items.def_en: (+ on sb/sth) to approach someone or something slowly, silently, and imperceptibly
items.ex_en: The stray cat began to creep up on the unsuspecting pigeon outside.
items.ex_zh: 那只流浪猫开始悄悄逼近外面毫无防备的鸽子。

items.def_zh: 悄悄挪开，蹑手蹑脚退开
items.def_en: to move slowly, quietly, and cautiously away from someone or something
items.ex_en: The witness began to edge away from the angry crowd gathering near the door.
items.ex_zh: 证人开始悄悄挪开，避开门口聚集的愤怒人群。

items.def_en: to move ahead very slowly, gradually, and by tiny degrees
items.ex_en: The long queue began to inch forward as the gates finally opened wide.
items.ex_zh: 随着大门终于敞开，长长的队伍开始寸步缓缓前挪。

items.def_zh: 缓缓移动，徐徐挪动；给……镶边；微弱胜过
items.def_en: 1. To move slowly and carefully in a specified direction, or make something move this way. 2. To give a border or edge to something.
items.ex_en: She carefully edged her luggage along the narrow corridor between the train seats.
items.ex_zh: 她小心翼翼地把行李沿着列车座位之间狭窄的过道缓缓挪动。
items.ex2_en: The cautious mountain climber edged slowly along the narrow icy cliff ledge.
items.ex2_zh: 谨慎的登山者沿着狭窄结冰的悬崖边缘缓慢挪动。

items.def_zh: 蹑手蹑脚移动，悄然蠕动前进
items.def_en: (+ along/up) to move slowly, quietly, and carefully, usually to avoid notice
items.ex_en: The burglar tried to creep along the darkened hallway toward the secure room.
items.ex_zh: 窃贼试图蹑手蹑脚地穿过漆黑的走廊，摸向保密室。

items.def_en: (+ up to/toward) to walk or move in a secretive, timid, or sideways manner
items.ex_en: The shy applicant sidled up to the reception desk to state his business.
items.ex_zh: 那个腼腆的求职者侧身悄悄贴近前台，说明了自己的来意。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ into/through) to move with difficulty through a narrow space by writhing or creeping
items.ex_en: The mechanic managed to worm into the tight opening beneath the car engine.
items.ex_zh: 修理工设法蠕动身躯，挤进了汽车引擎下方的逼仄缝隙中。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify moving forward, sideways, or through a tight space in tiny, cautious, or imperceptible increments. The motion is deliberate, often guarded or furtive, emphasizing fractional displacement.
groups.summary_zh: 极其缓慢、谨慎或隐秘地逐步挪动移位。
groups.desc_en: Involves advancing by tiny, cautious, stealthy, or lateral increments, distinguishing itself from brisk locomotion by its deliberate slowness and intent to avoid disturbance.
groups.desc_zh: 指极微小、谨慎、悄声或侧向地寸步挪动，区别于正常的迈步疾行，强调极慢的节奏与规避惊扰的意图。
groups.nuance_en: inch: advance by barely perceptible tiny increments (traffic / mercury / glacier) · edge: move sideways or gingerly with watchful caution (toward the door / along the cliff) · creep: advance silently, low, or stealthily over time (shadows / doubts / predator) · sidle: walk obliquely or inconspicuously, often furtively (up to someone / away)
groups.nuance_zh: inch: 极其微小缓慢地寸进挪动 (traffic / mercury / glacier) · edge: 谨慎侧身、戒备地试探缓行 (toward the door / along the cliff) · creep: 潜行蹑足、悄然逼近或蔓延 (shadows / doubts / predator) · sidle: 鬼祟或难为情地悄悄侧行凑近 (up to someone / away)

groups.name: Crowd & Huddle · 拥挤与簇拥 (Mass, Huddle, Cluster)
groups.tip: 由散到齐合聚一处

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ around/together) to gather or arrange closely in a small, compact group
items.ex_en: Anxious passengers began to cluster around the boarding gate awaiting the delayed announcement.
items.ex_zh: 焦虑的乘客们开始聚集在登机口周围，等待延误通知。
items.ex2_en: The museum curator clustered colorful glass vases together on the display table.
items.ex2_zh: 博物馆策展人把五颜六色的玻璃花瓶集中摆在展台上。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ against/into) to settle snugly and closely against one another
items.ex_en: The cold puppies nestled against each other in the corner of their warm basket.
items.ex_zh: 受冻的小狗们在温暖的篮子角落里紧紧依偎在一起。
items.ex2_en: The mother gently nestled the sleeping infant into the warm woolen crib.
items.ex2_zh: 母亲轻轻地将睡着的小婴儿安放在温暖的羊毛婴儿床里。

items.def_zh: 团团围住，蜂拥聚在周围
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to gather closely together around a person, object, or focal point in large numbers
items.ex_en: Excited tourists crowd around the museum entrance waiting for the morning tours to begin.
items.ex_zh: 兴奋的游客们团团围在博物馆入口处，等待晨间游览开始。

items.def_zh: 蜷缩挤作一团，簇拥在一起
items.def_en: to press closely together in a tight, compact group for warmth or security
items.ex_en: The shivering refugees huddle together inside the small shelter to escape the frost.
items.ex_zh: 瑟瑟发抖的难民们蜷缩挤作一团在狭小的避难所里以躲避严寒。

items.def_en: To gather or bring together into a large mass, crowd, or group.
items.ex_en: Dark clouds began to mass along the horizon before the fierce thunderstorm struck.
items.ex_zh: 在猛烈的雷暴来袭之前，乌云开始在地平线上大量集结。
items.ex2_en: The general quickly massed elite armored troops along the disputed northern border.
items.ex2_zh: 将军迅速在争议激烈的北部边境集结了精锐装甲部队。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ into/around) to pack closely together in large numbers into a tight space
items.ex_en: Hundreds of commuters crowded into the tiny subway station during the heavy rainstorm.
items.ex_zh: 在暴雨期间，数百名通勤者挤进了狭小的地铁站内。
items.ex2_en: Organizers crowded thousands of enthusiastic music fans into the compact indoor auditorium.
items.ex2_zh: 组织者把数千名热情的乐迷塞进了紧凑的室内礼堂。

items.def_zh: 挤作一团，拥挤；蜷缩；把……聚集在一起；碰头密谈
items.def_en: 1. (+ together) To crowd or cause to crowd closely together in a small group. 2. (+ up) To curl one's body closely up for warmth or comfort. 3. To gather privately to discuss something.
items.ex_en: The players huddle closely to discuss their final strategy for the crucial play.
items.ex_zh: 球员们紧密地挤在一起碰头密谈，商讨关键一攻的最终策略。
items.ex2_en: The shepherd quickly huddled the frightened sheep together inside the wooden barn.
items.ex2_zh: 牧羊人迅速把受惊的羊群聚拢在木制谷仓内。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to enter and fill a space tightly and in very large numbers
items.ex_en: Eager fans tried to pack into the tiny hall to hear the speech.
items.ex_zh: 狂热的粉丝们试图挤进那个狭小的礼堂去听这场演讲。

items.def_en: [I/T] to fill or press into a place in a dense, bustling mass
items.ex_en: Thousands of excited pilgrims throng the narrow stone streets leading to the sanctuary.
items.ex_zh: 成千上万兴奋的朝圣者摩肩接踵地拥向通往圣殿的狭窄石街。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict people or entities packing tightly together in a constrained physical arrangement. Nuances contrast sprawling bulk buildup with crouched or protective spatial compression.
groups.summary_zh: 以挤压、紧抱或密集堆叠的方式簇拥挤拢在一起。
groups.desc_en: Denotes aggregating closely into a tight pack or protective cluster, contrasting with orderly dispersal or spacious gathering by its physical density and mutual proximity.
groups.desc_zh: 指密集聚集、蜷缩拥挤成团，区别于松散的分散或规整站立，强调物理空间上的极高密度与互相依傍。
groups.nuance_en: crowd: pack together in high, pressing numbers (streets / platform / fans) · huddle: gather tightly together for warmth, fear, or secrecy (around the fire / in corners / players) · cluster: form an organic, loose gathering around a focal point (stars / tourists / buildings) · mass: gather into a large, dense, often imposing collective body (troops / clouds / protesters)
groups.nuance_zh: crowd: 人群密集涌入、拥挤推搡 (streets / platform / fans) · huddle: 因寒冷、恐惧或密谋而紧缩成一团 (around the fire / in corners / players) · cluster: 围绕中心自然簇生、群聚 (stars / tourists / buildings) · mass: 聚集汇聚成庞大有威慑力的大群 (troops / clouds / protesters)

groups.name: Crumble & Splinter · 碎裂与崩解 (Crumb, Splinter, Flake)
groups.tip: 外力撞击，由裂缝至成碎末

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ off/away) to come off or shed in small, thin, flat pieces
items.ex_en: The dry whitewash began to flake away from the cottage wall after the harsh frost.
items.ex_zh: 严霜过后，小屋墙壁上干燥的石灰层开始呈薄片剥落。
items.ex2_en: The pastry chef gently flaked the crisp pastry dough using cold fingers.
items.ex2_zh: 糕点师用冰凉的手指轻轻剥碎酥脆的面皮。

items.def_en: break down into small crumbs or brittle particles
items.ex_en: The stale cornbread will crumb up completely if you slice it with a dull knife.
items.ex_zh: 如果你用钝刀切这块不新鲜的玉米面包，它会彻底碎成残屑。

items.def_en: come off a surface in thin, dry layers or small flakes
items.ex_en: Layers of old enamel paint started to flake off the rusted iron garden gate.
items.ex_zh: 生锈的花园铁门上，层层旧搪瓷漆开始剥落。

items.def_en: [I/T] to break a small piece off the edge or surface of something hard
items.ex_en: Be careful washing that delicate antique teacup so you do not accidentally chip the rim.
items.ex_zh: 清洗那个精致的古董茶杯时小心点，别不小心磕破了杯沿。
items.ex2_en: The brittle porcelain plate chipped easily when it hit the granite counter.
items.ex2_zh: 脆弱的瓷盘撞到花岗岩台面时容易磕掉碎片。

items.def_en: [I/T] to break or cause to break into small fragments or powder, especially through dryness or decay
items.ex_en: The ancient sandstone pillars began to crumble into fine dust under centuries of weathering.
items.ex_zh: 历经数个世纪的风化，古老的砂岩石柱开始碎裂成细尘。
items.ex2_en: The baker crumbled fresh yeast between her fingers into the warm milk.
items.ex2_zh: 面包师在手指间将新鲜酵母搓碎放入温牛奶中。

items.def_zh: 弄碎，捏碎（面包等）；裹上面包屑；清理桌面面包屑
items.def_en: 1. to break something (especially bread or cake) into small fragments or crumbs. 2. to coat food with breadcrumbs before cooking. 3. to brush crumbs off a table.
items.ex_en: The chef demonstrated how to crumb the dry toast evenly over the fresh baked casserole.
items.ex_zh: 主厨示范了如何把干吐司捏碎并均匀撒在刚烤好的焙盘菜上。

items.def_en: (+ sth) break a small, hard fragment off the edge or surface of something, or break away in such a manner
items.ex_en: The falling hammer managed to chip off a corner of the expensive marble hearthstone.
items.ex_zh: 掉落的锤子把昂贵的大理石壁炉台石磕掉了一个角。

items.def_zh: （使）裂成碎片，分裂成小块；（使组织等）分裂
items.def_en: 1. to break or cause something to break into thin, sharp pieces. 2. (of a group, political party, etc.) to split or divide into smaller, opposing factions.
items.ex_en: The dry cedar floorboard began to splinter under the heavy weight of the iron safe.
items.ex_zh: 干燥的雪松地板在沉重铁制保险柜的重压下开始崩裂成尖锐碎片。
items.ex2_en: The powerful blast splintered thick wooden window frames into thousands of shards.
items.ex2_zh: 强烈的爆炸将厚实的木窗框炸裂成数千块碎片。

items.def_zh: 碎裂裂开成尖碎片；脱落崩裂
items.def_en: break or split away from a larger mass in sharp, slender fragments
items.ex_en: Sharp shards of glass splintered off the windshield during the sudden head-on collision.
items.ex_zh: 在突然发生的正面碰撞中，锋利的玻璃尖片从挡风玻璃上碎裂飞脱。

groups.summary_en: A brittle or dry substance breaks or sheds into tiny crumbs, fragments, or sharp slithers due to dryness, structural weakness, or mechanical stress. Scale progresses from minor flaking/crumbling to violent longitudinal splintering.
groups.summary_zh: 干燥脆性物体脱落碎屑，或受力迸裂成细小锐利的碎片。
groups.desc_en: Marks brittle structural failure breaking down into small particles, shards, or thin layers, contrasting with ductile bending or clean, uniform cleavage.
groups.desc_zh: 指脆性材质崩解破碎为细小碎屑、裂片或薄层，区别于韧性弯折或规整平整的切断，强调结构碎散解体。
groups.nuance_en: crumble: disintegrate into soft tiny fragments under gentle pressure (bread / cookies / empire) · splinter: break into sharp, slender, jagged shards (wood / bone / faction) · flake: peel off or separate in thin flat shavings (paint / pastry / skin) · chip: detach a small piece from an edge or hard surface (mug / stone / tooth)
groups.nuance_zh: crumble: 受压碎散成酥脆小碎屑或崩溃瓦解 (bread / cookies / empire) · splinter: 脆硬材质裂成尖锐细长的碎片 (wood / bone / faction) · flake: 呈薄片状剥落或起皮 (paint / pastry / skin) · chip: 边缘被磕碰出小缺口或碎块 (mug / stone / tooth)

groups.name: Cry & Weep · 哭泣与抽泣 (Cry, Weep, Sob)
groups.tip: 从无声默默垂泪到放声痛哭流涕

items.def_en: to make weak, low, broken crying sounds of hurt or fear
items.ex_en: The frightened puppy began to whimper softly in the corner during the violent thunderclap.
items.ex_zh: 剧烈的雷声中，受惊的小狗开始在角落里低声呜咽。

items.def_zh: 抽泣，啜泣；哭诉，抽抽搭搭地哭
items.def_en: 1. To cry and complain in a weak, whining, self-pitying way while sniffling.
items.ex_en: Stop sniveling about your minor scraped knee and put a simple bandage on it.
items.ex_zh: 别再为擦破点膝盖抽抽搭搭地抱怨了，贴个普通的创口贴就行。

items.def_en: to utter a loud, tearful, or anguished sound caused by grief, distress, or pain
items.ex_en: The injured hiker could only cry out in agony when he shifted his broken ankle.
items.ex_zh: 受伤的徒步者挪动摔断的脚踝时，忍不住痛苦地哭喊出声。

items.def_en: to cry noisily while taking sudden, convulsive breaths
items.ex_en: Overcome by bitter grief, the widow began to sob uncontrollably beside the stone grave.
items.ex_zh: 沉浸在极度悲痛中的寡妇在石墓旁难以自抑地抽噎起来。

items.def_zh: 痛哭失声，情绪崩溃落泪
items.def_en: to lose control of one's emotions and begin weeping bitterly
items.ex_en: He managed to stay calm until the memorial ended, then completely broke down in tears.
items.ex_zh: 他一直强撑着保持镇定直到追悼会结束，随后便彻底失控痛哭。
items.ex2_en: The intensive cross-examination finally broke down the stubborn witness on the stand.
items.ex2_zh: 激烈的盘问终于让出庭作证的顽固证人情绪崩溃了。

items.def_zh: 潸然泪下，突然嚎啕大哭
items.def_en: to suddenly begin crying passionately or copiously
items.ex_en: She suddenly burst into tears upon reading the heartbreaking news from her hometown newspaper.
items.ex_zh: 读到家乡报纸上那则令人心碎的消息时，她突然泣不成声。

items.def_zh: 哭泣，流泪；（伤口等）渗出液体
items.def_en: 1. (formal or literary) To cry tears because of deep sadness, pain, or joy. 2. When a wound or sore weeps, liquid oozes slowly from it.
items.ex_en: The sorrowful queen could only weep in solitary silence as her ruined kingdom fell.
items.ex_zh: 当残破的王国覆灭时，哀伤的王后只能在孤寂的沉默中暗自垂泪。

items.def_en: to cry very loudly and unrestrainedly, like an upset child
items.ex_en: The exhausted toddler started to bawl loudly in the middle of the crowded supermarket.
items.ex_zh: 那个疲惫不堪的幼儿在拥挤的超市中央开始扯着嗓子号啕大哭。

items.def_en: to utter long, high-pitched cries of pain, grief, or distress
items.ex_en: The desolate mourners began to wail aloud beneath the desolate midnight winter sky.
items.ex_zh: 凄苦的哀悼者们在萧瑟的冬夜天空下放声痛哭。

groups.summary_en: An individual sheds tears and produces vocalizations in reaction to sadness, relief, pain, or overwhelm. Verbs describe specific physiological manners such as convulsive chest heaves, audible wailing, or whiny complaints.
groups.summary_zh: 因悲伤、委屈或痛苦而流泪抽噎，区分眼泪流淌的剧烈度、声响及情绪控制力。
groups.desc_en: Covers vocal and lacrimal expressions of grief, distress, pain, or overwhelming emotion, differing from stoic composure or quiet sorrow through audible or visible weeping.
groups.desc_zh: 指因悲伤、痛苦或激动而流泪哽咽或发出哭泣啼声，区别于隐忍克制或无声哀悼，强调泪水与哭声的外显表达。
groups.nuance_en: cry: shed tears aloud in grief or pain (in pain / for help / child) · weep: shed tears quietly, deeply, or formally over grief (tears of joy / sorrow / mourners) · sob: weep convulsively with gasping, ragged intakes of breath (uncontrollably / into a pillow) · bawl: weep loudly and unrestrainedly, often noisily or angrily (baby / child / drunkard)
groups.nuance_zh: cry: 最普遍的发声啼哭、落泪 (in pain / for help / child) · weep: 肃穆深沉或无声哀泣、潸然泪下 (tears of joy / sorrow / mourners) · sob: 伴随剧烈抽噎与喘不上气的痛哭 (uncontrollably / into a pillow) · bawl: 放声号啕大哭、撕心裂肺地嚎哭 (baby / child / drunkard)

groups.name: Cuddle & Nestle · 依偎与贴近 (Snuggle, Nestle, Nuzzle)
groups.tip: 亲昵舒适地紧挨靠拢依偎

items.def_en: (+ to sb) to sit or lie very close to someone in an affectionate, comfortable way
items.ex_en: On cold winter evenings, the children love to cuddle up to their grandmother on the sofa.
items.ex_zh: 在寒冷的冬夜，孩子们喜欢在沙发上蜷身依偎在祖母身旁。

items.def_en: to settle comfortably, warmly, and snugly into a resting place
items.ex_en: The weary traveler watched the woodland creature nestle down amid the soft autumn leaves.
items.ex_zh: 疲倦的旅人看着林间小兽在柔软的秋叶堆里舒坦地蜷伏躺下。

items.def_zh: 依偎，偎依（以取暖或示爱）
items.def_en: (+ to/against sb) to move into a warm, comfortable, and close position against someone
items.ex_en: The sleepy child began to snuggle up against her mother under the thick wool blanket.
items.ex_zh: 困倦的孩子在厚厚的羊毛毯下紧紧偎依着母亲。

items.def_en: [I/T] to hold someone close in an affectionate way, or to lie close together comfortably
items.ex_en: They like to cuddle on the porch swing while watching the orange sunset fade away.
items.ex_zh: 他们喜欢在门廊秋千上相互依偎着，看着橙色的落日渐渐隐去。

items.def_zh: 依偎，偎靠；半隐半现地坐落，依傍；抱，抱在怀里
items.def_en: 1. (+ into/against/in) To settle comfortably and warmly against someone or in a sheltered place. 2. (of a place or building) To be situated half-hidden or pleasantly sheltered.
items.ex_en: The weary child nestled into her father's sturdy shoulder as twilight enveloped the valley.
items.ex_zh: 暮色笼罩山谷之际，疲倦的孩子依偎在父亲结实的肩膀上。
items.ex2_en: The grandmother nestled the exhausted toddler gently into the soft feather pillows.
items.ex2_zh: 祖母轻轻地把疲惫不堪的蹒跚幼童安放在柔软的羽绒枕头上。

items.def_zh: 依偎，蜷伏，紧挨；使依偎，紧抱入怀
items.def_en: (+ up/against/into) To settle or move into a warm, comfortable position, especially by curling up or pressing closely against someone.
items.ex_en: The tired kittens would snuggle against each other inside the warm wicker basket all night.
items.ex_zh: 疲倦的小猫们整夜都紧紧挨在一起，蜷伏在温暖的柳条筐里。

items.def_en: [I/T] to touch, rub, or press gently with the nose or face against someone or something
items.ex_en: The gentle horse lowered its velvet muzzle to nuzzle my coat pocket for fresh sugar.
items.ex_zh: 温顺的马低下柔软的口鼻，轻蹭我的外套口袋讨要新鲜方糖。

items.def_en: to sit or lie in a comfortable position with your legs drawn up close to your body
items.ex_en: She liked to curl up in the deep armchair with a hot cup of tea.
items.ex_zh: 她喜欢蜷坐在宽大的扶手椅里，手里端着一杯热茶。

items.def_en: to settle oneself deeply and cozily into a bed or warm wrapping
items.ex_en: He decided to snuggle down beneath the heavy goose-down duvet and forget the bitter frost.
items.ex_zh: 他决定缩进厚实的鹅绒被窝里，忘掉外面的刺骨严霜。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe settling closely, comfortably, and affectionately against someone or into a cozy place. They differ in physical focal points, such as pressing with the nose/face versus curling up one's entire body.
groups.summary_zh: 指亲昵、舒适地紧挨他人或蜷入温暖处，侧重身体依偎或面部蹭抚。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on affectionate, protective, or warmth-seeking bodily settling against another person or snug space, unlike formal embraces or detached physical proximity.
groups.desc_zh: 指为了依恋、温暖或安全感而将身体蜷伏依偎在他人或舒适角落，区别于礼节性拥抱或疏离的接触。
groups.nuance_en: cuddle: hold closely in an affectionate, loving embrace (baby / partner / puppy) · snuggle: curl up cozily and warmly against someone or inside bedding (under the covers / close) · nestle: settle snugly and securely into a warm, sheltered niche (into bed / against chest / village) · nuzzle: gently rub or push with the nose or face affectionately (dog / pony / cheek)
groups.nuance_zh: cuddle: 亲密温柔地搂抱抚慰 (baby / partner / puppy) · snuggle: 蜷缩钻进被窝或依偎于他人怀中取暖 (under the covers / close) · nestle: 安然舒适地伏在或隐于温润角落 (into bed / against chest / village) · nuzzle: 用鼻吻或脸颊亲昵爱抚地轻蹭 (dog / pony / cheek)

groups.name: Cultivate & Discipline · 育人与培养 (School, Train, Educate)
groups.tip: 循循善诱言传身教

items.def_en: (+ sb) to care for and educate a child until they are fully grown
items.ex_en: Her dedicated parents worked two exhausting shifts to bring up four successful, polite children.
items.ex_zh: 她尽职的父母打两份辛苦的工，将四个孩子教养得彬彬有礼、事业有成。

items.def_zh: 教育，训练，培养；成群游动
items.def_en: 1. To educate, train, or discipline someone in a particular skill or habit. 2. (of fish) To swim together in a school.
items.ex_en: From early childhood, the austere father schooled his young daughter in classical Latin grammar.
items.ex_zh: 从幼年起，严厉的父亲便严格训练小女儿学习古典拉丁语语法。

items.def_zh: 训练，培养；接受训练，锻炼；瞄准，对准
items.def_en: 1. To teach a person or animal a particular skill or behavior through sustained practice. 2. To prepare for a sport or job by practicing. 3. To aim or point something at an object.
items.ex_en: The veteran officer helped train recruit volunteers for strenuous wilderness rescue missions in winter.
items.ex_zh: 那位老警官帮助训练新入伍的志愿者，以应对冬季艰苦的野外救援任务。

items.def_en: To provide with knowledge, skills, or training through formal instruction or schooling.
items.ex_en: The charitable foundation was established to educate underprivileged youths in modern scientific disciplines.
items.ex_zh: 该慈善基金会的设立旨在现代科学学科领域对贫困青少年进行正规教育。

items.def_zh: 培养，陶冶（品格、素养或才能）
items.def_en: To foster the growth, refinement, and development of a quality, skill, or person
items.ex_en: The rigorous liberal arts curriculum seeks to cultivate intellectual curiosity and critical thought.
items.ex_zh: 严格的通识教育课程旨在培养求知欲和批判性思维。

items.def_zh: 悉心养育，培育（促进成长）
items.def_en: To care for and encourage the growth or development of someone or something
items.ex_en: Passionate mentors help nurture budding artistic talent within local low-income community centers.
items.ex_zh: 热心的导师们在当地低收入社区中心悉心培养初露头角的艺术才能。

items.def_zh: 向……灌输；通过反复操练使掌握
items.def_en: (+ sth + into sb) to impart habits, facts, or discipline into someone through rigorous repetition
items.ex_en: The strict drill sergeant tried to drill absolute punctuality into every nervous recruit.
items.ex_zh: 严厉的教官试图通过反复操练，把绝对守时的纪律灌输给每位紧张的新兵。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ in) To instruct or train someone thoroughly by repeating an exercise or routine strictly
items.ex_en: The coach spent hours to drill the young defenders in basic positioning and communication.
items.ex_zh: 教练花了数小时严格操练年轻后卫的基础站位与沟通配合。

items.def_zh: 训导，管教（使守规矩、受纪律约束）
items.def_en: To train someone to obey rules or a code of behavior, often using punishment
items.ex_en: The headmaster had to discipline several rowdy students for breaking the dormitory curfew rules.
items.ex_zh: 校长不得不对几名违反宿舍宵禁规定的吵闹学生进行严肃训诫管教。

groups.summary_en: An institutional or familial agent develops a person's intellect, character, or professional habits over an extended developmental timeframe, moving from routine conditioning to formal schooling and holistic cultivation.
groups.summary_zh: 通过体制化、长周期的教育、训练与规训塑造个体。
groups.desc_en: Denotes molding, disciplining, and developing the mind, manners, or skills of a human being, distinguishing itself from genetic growth by its deliberate, structured intervention.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过系统教育、规训或熏陶塑造人的心智、教养与专业技能，区别于生理上的自然生长，强调人为的引导与塑造。
groups.nuance_en: educate: provide comprehensive intellectual and academic development (children / public / workforce) · train: instill practical skills or conditioned responses through practice (athletes / dogs / soldiers) · school: rigorously discipline and habituate in specific behavior or temper (instincts / emotions / pupils) · drill: instill automatic habits through repetitive, strict exercise (cadets / grammar / procedures)
groups.nuance_zh: educate: 进行系统的通识教育与心智启蒙 (children / public / workforce) · train: 传授实操技能并进行针对性训练 (athletes / dogs / soldiers) · school: 严格规训习惯、心性或控制本能 (instincts / emotions / pupils) · drill: 通过高强度机械重复深植肌肉记忆或规则 (cadets / grammar / procedures)

groups.name: Cultivate & Plant · 播种与栽种 (Plant, Sow, Seed)
groups.tip: 重新种植花木培育新生

items.def_en: to put a plant, tree, or seed into the ground so that it will grow
items.ex_en: Every sunny spring, local gardeners plant rows of colorful tulips along the main walkways.
items.ex_zh: 每年晴朗的春天，当地园丁都会在主步道旁栽种成排五彩缤纷的郁金香。

items.def_en: [I/T] to plant seeds in an area of ground
items.ex_en: The groundskeeper will seed the bare patches of the lawn before the autumn rains.
items.ex_zh: 在秋雨来临之前，场地管理员会在草坪裸露的斑块上重新撒播草籽。

items.def_zh: 将（幼苗）移栽入户外露地
items.def_en: (+ sth) to plant seedlings or young plants into open soil outdoors to grow
items.ex_en: Wait until after the last spring frost before you plant out the tender tomato seedlings.
items.ex_zh: 等到春季最后一场霜冻过后再把娇嫩的番茄幼苗移栽到露地。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to transplant young plants or flowers into an outdoor bed or garden plot
items.ex_en: The gardeners began bedding out the summer annuals as soon as the frost risk passed.
items.ex_zh: 霜冻危险一过，园丁们便开始把夏季一年生花苗移栽到花坛中。

items.def_zh: 栽下，播种（花卉/蔬菜/庄稼）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to place seeds, bulbs, or seedlings into the soil to grow
items.ex_en: We should put in the daffodil bulbs now so they produce blooms next spring.
items.ex_zh: 我们现在该把水仙花鳞茎栽下，这样它们来年春天就能开花了。

items.def_en: to move a growing plant from one place to another to grow it elsewhere
items.ex_en: Gardeners transplant fragile orchid sprouts into larger ceramic containers to stimulate healthy growth.
items.ex_zh: 园艺工人把娇弱的兰花幼苗移植到更大的陶瓷容器中以促进健康生长。

items.def_en: [I/T] to plant seeds in the ground, often by scattering them
items.ex_en: Local farmers sow winter wheat seeds evenly across the vast fields before early November.
items.ex_zh: 十一月初之前，当地农民在广阔的田野上均匀播种冬小麦种子。

items.def_en: To plant crops, trees, or flowers again in an area, or to dig up a plant and put it in a new place.
items.ex_en: Conservation workers plan to replant native spruce trees across the burned mountain slope tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 环保工作人员计划明天在烧毁的山坡上重新种植本土云杉树木。

items.def_en: To sow seeds again on land or a lawn, especially where vegetation has been damaged.
items.ex_en: The greenskeeper had to reseed the damaged sections of the golf course fairway quickly.
items.ex_zh: 草坪管理员必须迅速在受损的高尔夫球道区域补种草籽。

groups.summary_en: A cultivator places seeds, seedlings, or plants into soil or an agricultural substrate to grow crops or restore vegetation. Verbs range from general planting to scattering seeds ('sow') or refreshing a depleted area ('replant', 'reseed').
groups.summary_zh: 在土壤或苗圃中播撒种子或栽植苗木以促其生长。
groups.desc_en: Encompasses the act of inserting seeds, bulbs, or seedlings into the soil to establish root growth, contrasting with harvesting or soil preparation alone.
groups.desc_zh: 指将种子、幼苗或植株植入土壤使其生根立苗，区别于耕地整畦或后期收获，聚焦于立苗栽植本身。
groups.nuance_en: plant: place a seed, bulb, or juvenile plant firmly in the ground (trees / bulbs / vegetables) · sow: scatter or deposit seeds broadly in or over soil (seeds / wheat / discord) · transplant: relocate an established plant to another bed or pot (seedlings / shrubs / organs) · seed: distribute seeds intentionally over an expanse of ground (lawn / pasture / clouds)
groups.nuance_zh: plant: 挖穴栽种幼苗、球茎或植株 (trees / bulbs / vegetables) · sow: 播撒或点播各类农作物种子 (seeds / wheat / discord) · transplant: 将育好的幼苗移栽定植到他处 (seedlings / shrubs / organs) · seed: 在开阔地面大面积播种草籽等 (lawn / pasture / clouds)

groups.name: Cultivate & Raise Crops · 耕作与栽培
groups.tip: 农耕园艺与动植物培育

items.def_en: nurture and raise crops, vegetables, or plants from seeds or shoots
items.ex_en: They grow crisp organic lettuce and plump red peppers inside a solar-heated greenhouse.
items.ex_zh: 他们在太阳能温室里种植脆嫩的有机生菜和饱满的红椒。
items.ex2_en: Sunflowers grow rapidly in fertile soil when provided with plenty of water.
items.ex2_zh: 在水分充足的情况下，向日葵在肥沃的土壤中生长迅速。

items.def_en: breed or grow crops, plants, or livestock on an agricultural scale
items.ex_en: Many commercial farmers in this river valley raise premium feed corn for dairy cattle.
items.ex_zh: 该河谷流域的许多商业农户大规模种植供奶牛食用的优质饲料玉米。

items.def_en: To grow or cultivate cells, bacteria, or tissues in a specially prepared artificial medium.
items.ex_en: Laboratory technicians culture bacterial samples inside sterile petri dishes under precisely regulated temperatures.
items.ex_zh: 实验技术人员在严格调控的温度下，在无菌培养皿中培养细菌样本。

items.def_zh: 耕作，务农；经营（农场），饲养，种植
items.def_en: 1. To grow crops or raise animals on land or in water, especially for commercial production. 2. To use a piece of land for agriculture.
items.ex_en: His hardworking family has farmed these fertile delta lands for three consecutive generations.
items.ex_zh: 他勤劳的家族已在这片肥沃的三角洲土地上连续耕作了三代人。

items.def_zh: 从事园艺，照料花园；种植花木
items.def_en: To work in a garden, growing plants, flowers, or vegetables.
items.ex_en: My retired uncle loves to garden in his sunny backyard every Saturday morning.
items.ex_zh: 我退休的叔叔喜欢每周六早晨在充满阳光的后院里侍弄花木。

items.def_zh: 促使（作物或幼苗）快速生长
items.def_en: (+ sth) to encourage plants or crops to grow or mature more quickly
items.ex_en: The artificial warming lights helped bring on the early strawberry shoots several weeks ahead.
items.ex_zh: 人工增温补光灯促使早期草莓幼苗提前数周快速生长。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to plant a growing seedling or cutting into a pot with soil
items.ex_en: You should pot up these rooted geranium cuttings before their delicate root systems wither.
items.ex_zh: 你应该在这批生根的天竺葵插条脆弱的根系枯萎前将它们移栽入盆。

items.def_en: raise and nurture plants or crops for human sustenance or commercial use
items.ex_en: Indigenous communities have cultivated hardy grain varieties across these dry highlands for centuries.
items.ex_zh: 千百年来，当地土著社区一直在这片干旱高地上培育耐旱的谷物品种。

items.def_en: breed specimens of a plant naturally or artificially from the parent stock
items.ex_en: Botanists frequently propagate rare woodland fern varieties using stem cuttings in humid greenhouses.
items.ex_zh: 植物学家经常在湿润温室中利用茎段扦插繁殖稀有的林地蕨类品种。
items.ex2_en: Wild ivy plants propagate naturally across damp forest floors through creeping stolons.
items.ex2_zh: 野生常春藤通过匍匐茎在潮湿的森林地面上自然繁衍。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate the broader biological and agricultural process of raising, managing, and nurturing plants, crops, or microorganisms from germination through harvest.
groups.summary_zh: 从播种到收获全程培植作物、果蔬或微生物的农艺生长管理活动。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to sustained agricultural or horticultural nurturing to bring crops and plants to mature yield, contrasting with mere planting by spanning the full vegetative cycle.
groups.desc_zh: 指从播种到成熟期对作物或植物进行长期的田间管理与培育养护，区别于单次播种，涵盖完整的生长周期。
groups.nuance_en: grow: nurture vegetation toward development and yield (crops / tomatoes / flowers) · cultivate: prepare land and systematically manage crop growth (soil / grapes / land) · farm: operate land commercially to produce crops or livestock (acreage / land / salmon) · raise: bring agricultural produce or stock through maturation to market (cattle / corn / chickens)
groups.nuance_zh: grow: 种植、照料植物使其成长收获 (crops / tomatoes / flowers) · cultivate: 精耕细作土地并系统栽培作物 (soil / grapes / land) · farm: 进行规模化农业经营与耕作 (acreage / land / salmon) · raise: 养育、种植供市场销售的作物或禽畜 (cattle / corn / chickens)

groups.name: Cultivate & Sow · 耕作与播种 (Cultivate, Sow, Till)
groups.tip: 农耕播种与精心培植

items.def_en: [I/T] to place seeds, bulbs, or seedlings in the ground so that they will grow
items.ex_en: Villagers gather every April to plant native saplings along the eroding river bank.
items.ex_zh: 村民们每年四月齐聚一堂，在受侵蚀的河岸边栽种本土树苗。

items.def_en: to prepare and cultivate land for crops by plowing or harrowing
items.ex_en: The stubborn farmer used a diesel tractor to till the rocky soil thoroughly.
items.ex_zh: 那位执着的农民用柴油拖拉机将多石的土地进行了彻底翻耕。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to bury growing crops, stubble, or plants into the soil by plowing
items.ex_en: The farmer decided to plow under the leftover clover crop to enrich the soil naturally.
items.ex_zh: 农民决定将残留的三叶草翻入土中掩埋，以此自然增加土壤肥力。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to dig up and invert soil with a spade or plow to prepare it for planting
items.ex_en: You need to turn over the garden dirt before spreading rich compost over it.
items.ex_zh: 在撒上肥沃的堆肥之前，你需要先把花园里的泥土翻整一遍。

items.def_zh: 全面播种（使成草地或覆盖物）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to plant an area of land with grass or a crop to establish vegetative cover
items.ex_en: The forestry team decided to sow down the barren logging track with clover.
items.ex_zh: 林业队决定在这条废弃的伐木便道上全面播种三叶草以建立植被覆盖。

items.def_zh: 耕作，耕耘；培育，培植；培养，建立（关系）
items.def_en: 1. To prepare and use land for growing crops, or to grow plants and crops. 2. To develop or improve an attitude, skill, or relationship deliberately.
items.ex_en: Generations of tenant farmers strove to cultivate this stony hillside despite the harsh climate.
items.ex_zh: 尽管气候恶劣，几代佃农仍努力在这片多石的山坡上耕作土地。

items.def_zh: 播种，散播（种子）；散布，激起（怀疑、争端等）
items.def_en: 1. To plant seeds in or on the ground. 2. To introduce or spread feelings, ideas, or doubts that cause problems later.
items.ex_en: Careful farmers sow their bean seeds in uniform furrows after the spring frost passes.
items.ex_zh: 细心的农民会在春霜过后将豆种播撒在整齐划一的垄沟里。

items.def_en: [I/T] to turn up the earth with a plow before sowing seeds
items.ex_en: Heavy tractors began to plow the sprawling acreage immediately after the dawn mist lifted.
items.ex_zh: 晨雾刚一散去，重型拖拉机便开始翻耕这片辽阔的田地。

items.def_en: to break up and level plowed ground using a harrow
items.ex_en: After plowing the stubborn field, he must harrow the packed soil before planting barley.
items.ex_zh: 翻耕顽硬的田地后，他必须在播种大麦前把板结的泥土耙碎平整。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe agricultural preparation and planting, where a farmer or gardener prepares soil, deposits seeds, or tends growing crops. They range from breaking and turning earth to planting and nurturing.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及农事准备、整地翻土、播种与作物培植的全套农耕动作。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on the mechanical disruption and turning over of arable soil combined with the sowing of field crops, contrasting with small-scale gardening through broad agronomic fieldwork.
groups.desc_zh: 指使用农机或犁铧翻土、松土并播散大田作物的耕作活动，区别于小规模园艺，强调大田农耕的土壤准备与播种。
groups.nuance_en: plow: break up and turn over soil using a heavy blade (fields / snow / earth) · till: cultivate and aerate arable land to prepare a seedbed (soil / land / ground) · sow: distribute agricultural seed over prepared earth (wheat / barley / field) · plow under: bury green crop residues beneath the soil by turning it over (stubble / clover / remains)
groups.nuance_zh: plow: 用犁大面积翻开破硬土壤 (fields / snow / earth) · till: 细耕、松土以整饬播种床 (soil / land / ground) · sow: 向平整田垄播撒大宗作物种子 (wheat / barley / field) · plow under: 翻耕将作物残余或绿肥埋入地下 (stubble / clover / remains)

groups.name: Curse & Swear · 咒骂与爆粗 (Curse, Swear, Blaspheme)
groups.tip: 情绪失控时用脏话咒骂

items.def_en: to use rude or offensive language, especially because you are angry
items.ex_en: He hit his thumb with the hammer and began to swear loudly in frustration.
items.ex_zh: 他用锤子砸到了拇指，气急败坏地大声咒骂起来。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to direct offensive, taboo, or profane words angrily at someone
items.ex_en: He lost his temper and swore at the referee during the match.
items.ex_zh: 比赛中他一时失控，冲裁判爆了粗口。

items.def_en: [I/T] to use offensive words against someone or to wish evil upon them
items.ex_en: Frustrated commuters began to curse the reckless driver who caused the massive highway delay.
items.ex_zh: 恼怒的通勤者们开始咒骂那个造成公路大堵车的鲁莽司机。

items.def_zh: 咒骂，说粗话（fuck 的委婉说法，常与 off 连用）
items.def_en: (slang, euphemistic) to curse or swear, used as a substitute for 'fuck'
items.ex_en: He dropped his wrench, started to eff and blind, and stormed out the garage.
items.ex_zh: 他摔下扳手，满嘴粗话骂骂咧咧地冲出了车库。

items.def_en: (informal, chiefly North American) to swear, curse, or use offensive language
items.ex_en: He hit his thumb with the hammer and began to cuss loudly.
items.ex_zh: 他的锤子砸到了大拇指，随即大声咒骂起来。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to berate someone using explicit insults and foul language
items.ex_en: The furious customer began to curse out the cashier over a small mistake.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的顾客因为一点小错开始痛骂收银员。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to yell profanities at someone in an outburst of anger
items.ex_en: He lost his temper completely and cussed out his boss in the office.
items.ex_zh: 他彻底发了脾气，在办公室里用脏话痛斥老板。

items.def_en: [I/T] to speak disrespectfully about God or sacred things, often using religious oaths
items.ex_en: The preacher warned that anyone who dared to blaspheme would face divine retribution.
items.ex_zh: 传教士警告说，任何胆敢亵渎神明的人都将面临天谴。

items.def_en: to express extreme hatred or denounce someone with venomous curses
items.ex_en: Citizens gathered in the square to execrate the brutal actions of the dictator.
items.ex_zh: 市民聚集在广场上，痛斥并诅咒独裁者的残暴行径。

groups.summary_en: Speakers utter profane, taboo, or offensive words to vent intense anger, frustration, or hostility toward someone or something. Verbs range from mild colloquial profanity to explicit, venomous cursing.
groups.summary_zh: 通过使用亵渎性、禁忌或粗俗词语发泄愤怒与不满，由口语爆粗延伸至恶毒咒骂。
groups.desc_en: Expresses anger, malice, or contempt using profane, vulgar, or taboo language, or invoking supernatural harm, unlike polite rebuke or formal censure.
groups.desc_zh: 指使用污言秽语、渎神之词发泄暴怒或咒求超自然灾祸降临他人，区别于文明谴责或克制训斥，具有禁忌与冒犯性。
groups.nuance_en: swear: use vulgar or profane swearwords in anger or shock (profanities / oaths / loudly) · curse: utter foul oaths or invoke damnation upon someone (enemies / fate / the referee) · cuss: informal, habitual usage of profane expletives (freely / incessantly / out loud) · blaspheme: speak irreverently or sacrilegiously of sacred things (God / religion / church)
groups.nuance_zh: swear: 因震惊或愤怒脱口说脏话 (profanities / oaths / loudly) · curse: 痛骂、咒骂他人遭殃或诅咒厄运 (enemies / fate / the referee) · cuss: 口语中口无遮拦地爆粗口 (freely / incessantly / out loud) · blaspheme: 亵渎神明或亵渎神圣事物 (God / religion / church)

groups.name: Cut & Sever · 切割与截断 (Saw, Sever, Section)
groups.tip: 用刀刃等工具斩断分割

items.def_zh: 切片，分段；把……分成部分；依法强行送入精神病院
items.def_en: 1. To cut or divide something into sections, slices, or segments. 2. (British English, law) To commit someone compulsorily to a psychiatric hospital.
items.ex_en: The pathologist will section the tissue sample thinly for detailed microscopic analysis.
items.ex_zh: 病理学家会将该组织样本切成薄片，以进行详细的显微分析。

items.def_en: to cut, slice, or divide something precisely into two equal parts
items.ex_en: A new high-speed railway will bisect the fertile valley into two equal halves.
items.ex_zh: 一条新建的高速铁路将把这片肥沃的山谷平分为两半。

items.def_en: (+ sth) pierce and divide an object completely using a sharp blade
items.ex_en: The sharp scalpel can easily cut through several thick layers of leather.
items.ex_zh: 锋利的手术刀能够轻而易举地割穿数层厚皮革。

items.def_en: (+ sth) slice or cut away an unwanted part, such as a branch, with a swift stroke
items.ex_en: The gardener used heavy shears to lop off the dead branches quickly.
items.ex_zh: 园丁用重型剪刀利落地剪掉了枯死的枝条。

items.def_en: (+ sth) remove or sever a portion of an object by cutting through it with a saw
items.ex_en: He climbed the tree and sawed off the dead branches.
items.ex_zh: 他爬上树，把枯枝锯了下来。

items.def_en: (+ through/off) to cut wood, metal, or stone using a back-and-forth serrated blade
items.ex_en: He had to saw through the rusted iron pipe with a hacksaw.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不拿钢锯锯断那根生锈的铁管。

items.def_en: (+ off) to chop or cut off branches, limbs, or protruding parts with a decisive stroke
items.ex_en: Grab those heavy clippers and lop off those thick lower branches today.
items.ex_zh: 拿上那把大剪刀，今天把下面那些粗树枝砍掉。

items.def_en: (+ sth) sever a part or piece from something with a heavy, sharp blow
items.ex_en: The butcher used a heavy cleaver to chop off the pig's foot.
items.ex_zh: 屠夫用一把沉重的剁肉刀斩断了猪蹄。

items.def_en: (+ from) to divide or cut completely through something, detaching one part from another
items.ex_en: A sudden explosion severed the crucial communication cables from the mainland base.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的爆炸切断了与大陆基地相连的关键通信电缆。

groups.summary_en: An agent separates physical material into distinct pieces or cuts completely through an object using a blade, saw, or specialized cutting implement.
groups.summary_zh: 利用锯子、刀刃或切割工具截断、锯断或切分实体。
groups.desc_en: Involves dividing, bisecting, or separating an object using a sharp-edged cutting tool, contrasting with tearing or chemical dissolving through mechanical shearing.
groups.desc_zh: 指使用锋利刃具或锯齿将物体截断、切开或分离，区别于撕扯或化学消融，强调机械剪切作用。
groups.nuance_en: sever: cut completely through, permanently separating two parts (rope / ties / arteries) · saw: cut through hard materials using a toothed serrated blade (logs / bone / wood) · lop: prune or chop off protruding limbs or branches cleanly (branches / off limbs / ears) · bisect: divide geometrically into two equal halves (angle / line / plane)
groups.nuance_zh: sever: 彻底切断、斩断或切断联系 (rope / ties / arteries) · saw: 用带锯齿的工具往复锯断 (logs / bone / wood) · lop: 利索削掉、剪除凸出枝桠或肢体 (branches / off limbs / ears) · bisect: 几何意义上的平分、二等分切开 (angle / line / plane)

groups.name: Daily Meals & Eating Regimens · 日常进餐与膳食习惯 (Dine, Feast, Sup)
groups.tip: 一日三餐早午餐进食用餐

items.def_en: To eat lunch, the midday meal.
items.ex_en: We usually lunch together at the Italian bistro near the office building.
items.ex_zh: 我们通常在办公楼附近的意大利小餐馆一起吃午餐。

items.def_en: To restrict one's intake of food or eat prescribed foods, especially to lose weight or for medical reasons.
items.ex_en: Her physician advised her to diet strictly to reduce high blood pressure.
items.ex_zh: 她的医生建议她严格节食以降低高血压。

items.def_en: eat the first meal of the day
items.ex_en: The diplomats will breakfast privately before commencing their formal bilateral negotiations today.
items.ex_zh: 外交官们将在今日正式双边谈判开始前进用私人早餐。

items.def_en: to have a meal in a restaurant rather than at home
items.ex_en: With their busy work schedules, they tend to eat out several times a week.
items.ex_zh: 由于工作繁忙，他们每周往往会在外就餐好几次。

items.def_zh: 外出赴宴；在餐馆进晚餐
items.def_en: to eat an evening meal away from home, especially at a formal restaurant
items.ex_en: We usually dine out on Friday evenings to celebrate the end of the workweek.
items.ex_zh: 我们通常在周五晚上去餐馆吃饭，庆祝一周工作的结束。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) eat large quantities of rich food with great enjoyment
items.ex_en: The victorious soldiers returned home to feast upon roasted meats and wine.
items.ex_zh: 凯旋的士兵们回到家中，尽情享用烤肉与美酒盛宴。

items.def_zh: 吃晚饭（文雅或旧式用法）
items.def_en: eat supper, especially in a quiet or traditional context
items.ex_en: The weary travelers gathered by the hearth to sup on simple broth.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的旅人们围坐在壁炉旁，安静地喝着清汤用晚餐。

items.def_en: eat dinner, especially in a formal or leisurely setting
items.ex_en: The visiting ambassadors will dine with the prime minister at the palace.
items.ex_zh: 来访的大使们将在王宫与首相共进正式晚餐。

items.def_en: To eat brunch, a meal eaten late in the morning as a combination of breakfast and lunch.
items.ex_en: We love to brunch on Sundays with fresh pastries and hot coffee.
items.ex_zh: 我们喜欢在周日吃早午餐，享用新鲜糕点和热咖啡。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the routine act of eating specific daily meals (such as lunch or dinner) or adhering to a structured dietary regimen. They differ primarily by the specific meal referenced and the degree of social formality or nutritional restriction involved.
groups.summary_zh: 指按日常时段享用正餐或依特定膳食规则进食。
groups.desc_en: Encompasses participating in designated daily meals, dietary schedules, or experiential dining occasions, contrasting with raw biological food consumption (eating).
groups.desc_zh: 指按日常时序规律进餐、就餐或遵循特定的膳食养生规则，区别于生理性的摄食吞咽，具有生活作息与社交色彩。
groups.nuance_en: dine: eat an evening meal, typically in a formal or relaxed setting (out / at an upscale restaurant / with clients) · feast: eat large quantities of rich, celebratory food indulgently (on roast / eyes / at banquets) · lunch: partake in a midday meal (with colleagues / on salad / at noon) · diet: restrict one's food intake systematically for health or weight (on low-carb / strictly / to slim down)
groups.nuance_zh: dine: 正式、从容地享用正餐或晚宴 (out / at an upscale restaurant / with clients) · feast: 尽情大吃大喝享用饕餮盛宴 (on roast / eyes / at banquets) · lunch: 享用午餐 (with colleagues / on salad / at noon) · diet: 按食谱节食或调节膳食结构 (on low-carb / strictly / to slim down)

groups.name: Dart & Whisk · 飞掠与轻盈拂动 (Dart, Whisk, Flit)
groups.tip: 轻盈迅速地掠过移动

items.def_en: to make rapid, light, irregular fluttering movements
items.ex_en: The candle flames began to flicker softly in the cool evening breeze.
items.ex_zh: 烛光在凉爽的晚风中开始轻轻摇曳。

items.def_zh: 轻盈敏捷地四处飞掠或穿梭
items.def_en: move swiftly, lightly, and erratically from one place to another
items.ex_en: Colorful butterflies flit about the blooming garden under the warm morning sun.
items.ex_zh: 五彩斑斓的蝴蝶在温暖的晨光中穿梭飞掠于盛开的花园。

items.def_en: [I/T] to move quickly and lightly over or close to a surface without touching it heavily
items.ex_en: We watched the swallows skim across the calm surface of the lake.
items.ex_zh: 我们注视着燕子轻快地掠过平静的湖面。

items.def_zh: 嗖地掠过，嗖地挥动；（使）发出嗖嗖声
items.def_en: 1. To move quickly through the air or water making a soft whistling or rushing sound, or to make something move in this way.
items.ex_en: The horse began to swish its tail to keep the flies away.
items.ex_zh: 马儿开始嗖嗖地甩动尾巴以赶走苍蝇。
items.ex2_en: The silk curtains swished softly in the gentle summer breeze tonight.
items.ex2_zh: 今晚丝绸窗帘在夏日微风中沙沙作响。

items.raw_cluster: 掠过与飞快移动 Dart & Flit
items.def_zh: 轻快掠过，轻捷移动；（轻快地）飞来飞去
items.def_en: 1. To move lightly and swiftly from one place or subject to another.
items.ex_en: Fleeting shadows flit across the darkened bedroom wall as cars pass outside.
items.ex_zh: 随着外面的车辆驶过，转瞬即逝的阴影掠过昏暗的卧室墙壁。

items.def_zh: 突然飞快地跑开或冲走
items.def_en: run or move away suddenly and rapidly
items.ex_en: The frightened rabbit darted off into the dense bushes across the road.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的兔子猛地冲进了马路对面的茂密灌木丛中。

items.def_zh: 迅速轻巧地带走或移开
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) take or carry someone or something away very quickly and smoothly
items.ex_en: Bodyguards whisked away the VIP guest before the journalists could approach him.
items.ex_zh: 保镖在记者能够靠近之前迅速护送要客离开了现场。

items.def_en: [I/T] to move suddenly and rapidly in a particular direction
items.ex_en: A sleek black cat darted across the narrow alley before disappearing completely.
items.ex_zh: 一只油光水滑的黑猫猛地蹿过狭窄的小巷，随后消失不见。

items.def_en: [T/I] to brush or sweep lightly and quickly, or move someone away abruptly
items.ex_en: She used a dry towel to whisk the snow off her coat.
items.ex_zh: 她用干毛巾迅速拂去了大衣上的积雪。

groups.summary_en: An entity moves rapidly, lightly, and suddenly from place to place, often making a light whishing sound or fluttering sweep.
groups.summary_zh: 轻捷快速地闪掠、穿梭或轻抚而过。
groups.desc_en: Depicts rapid, light, sudden, or zigzagging spatial motion resembling a bird, insect, or flick of a wrist, contrasting with heavy, plodding movement.
groups.desc_zh: 指轻巧灵动、猝然突进或如鸟雀般闪烁飞掠的动作，区别于沉重笨拙的位移，强调轻盈与瞬时变向。
groups.nuance_en: dart: move suddenly, straight, and rapidly in a specific direction (eyes / glance / into the doorway) · flit: move lightly, erratically, and rapidly from place to place (butterfly / bird / from topic to topic) · whisk: sweep or move someone or something away rapidly and smoothly (away tears / into a car / eggs) · skim: glide smoothly, quickly, and lightly over a liquid or surface (surface / water / text)
groups.nuance_zh: dart: 倏地飞奔、目光或身影猛然一闪 (eyes / glance / into the doorway) · flit: 如蝶雀般轻快飘忽地掠过或变动 (butterfly / bird / from topic to topic) · whisk: 飞快利落地拂过、迅速带走 (away tears / into a car / eggs) · skim: 贴着水面或表层轻盈掠过 (surface / water / text)

groups.name: Dash & Bolt · 飞奔与疾驰 (Dash, Bolt, Sprint)
groups.tip: 如箭离弦短促飞驰

items.def_en: to move hurriedly with short, rapid steps
items.ex_en: Mice scurry across the dusty basement floor whenever the lights go out.
items.ex_zh: 每当灯熄灭时，老鼠就会在布满灰尘的地下室地板上碎步急跑。

items.def_en: leave a place very hurriedly
items.ex_en: I must dash off right now, or I will miss my train.
items.ex_zh: 我必须马上赶着走了，否则就会赶不上火车。

items.def_zh: 猝然疾驰逃窜；拔腿飞奔
items.def_en: suddenly rush away in a burst of speed, often out of fright or urgency
items.ex_en: The stray dog bolted off the moment it heard the loud thunder.
items.ex_zh: 那只流浪狗一听到巨大的雷声就吓得拔腿飞奔逃窜。

items.def_en: leave or run away at tremendous speed
items.ex_en: The getaway car tore off down the highway at a terrifying speed.
items.ex_zh: 那辆逃逸车辆沿着公路以惊人的速度狂奔而去。

items.def_zh: 脱缰疾走，突然夺路而逃
