items.ex_en: The company offered massive signing bonuses to entice top engineers from rival firms.
items.ex_zh: 该公司开出巨额签约奖金，以诱使竞争对手的顶尖工程师跳槽。

items.def_zh: 勾引，诱惑（使人误入歧途或发生关系）
items.def_en: to attract powerfully and lead someone into sexual activity or a disastrous course of action
items.ex_en: The promise of easy wealth seduced many honest citizens into the financial scheme.
items.ex_zh: 轻松致富的许诺诱惑了许多诚实的市民陷入这场金融骗局。

items.def_en: (+ into) to persuade or entice someone to do something by deception or flattery
items.ex_en: The salesman tried to inveigle the elderly couple into signing a bad contract.
items.ex_zh: 推销员试图诱骗那对老夫妇签署一份糟糕的合同。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe playfully teasing, alluring, or enticing someone, whether to attract romantic attention or tempt them toward a specific, often dangerous or undesirable, course of action. They range from playful romantic overtures to calculated entrapment.
groups.summary_zh: 以言行挑逗、吸引或诱惑他人产生好感或落入圈套。
groups.desc_en: Using playful charm, seductive hints, or alluring bait to draw someone into emotional or sexual entanglement, contrasting with overt coercion or transparent courtship.
groups.desc_zh: 以挑逗身段、暧昧言行或诱饵吸引他人陷入情网或圈套，不同于直接胁迫或坦荡追求。
groups.nuance_en: flirt: behave playfully to convey sexual/romantic interest without serious intent (colleague / stranger) · hit on: make direct, unambiguous sexual or romantic advances toward someone (patron / friend) · seduce: entice someone into sexual activity or moral surrender (voter / lover) · entice: attract by offering pleasure, reward, or advantage (customer / investor) · lead on: falsely encourage romantic expectations with no genuine intention (admirer / suitor)
groups.nuance_zh: flirt: 半真半假地调情或暗送秋波 (colleague / stranger) · hit on: 目的明确、直接地搭讪撩拨 (patron / friend) · seduce: 诱使发生性关系或放弃原则 (voter / lover) · entice: 以利益或诱惑物引人入彀 (customer / investor) · lead on: 虚假给予希望吊人胃口 (admirer / suitor)

groups.name: Float & Waft · 飘浮与升腾 (Float, Waft, Levitate)
groups.tip: 无重量感地升起浮空

items.def_zh: 飘浮，随气流/水流漫无目的地漂荡
items.def_en: to drift gently through the air or on water without a fixed course
items.ex_en: Colorful dandelion seeds floated around gently in the warm spring breeze across fields.
items.ex_zh: 色彩斑斓的蒲公英种子在拂过田野的温暖春风中漫无目的地轻轻飘浮。

items.def_en: to float or rise rapidly and lightly to the surface of a liquid
items.ex_en: The cork bobbed up to the surface as soon as it was released.
items.ex_zh: 软木塞一松手就立刻浮上了水面。

items.def_zh: 漂移，随风或水流缓缓冲走/飘荡
items.def_en: to be carried gently along by the natural motion of wind or water
items.ex_en: The wooden canoe drifted along with the lazy current toward the open lake.
items.ex_zh: 独木舟顺着缓慢的水流缓缓漂移，驶向开阔的湖泊。

items.def_en: to be carried along gently and aimlessly by currents of air or water
items.ex_en: Clouds of gray smoke drifted lazily above the silent rooftops at dawn.
items.ex_zh: 黎明时分，缕缕灰烟在寂静的屋顶上空缓缓漂移。

items.def_en: to move smoothly, quietly, and seemingly without effort through air
items.ex_en: A graceful hawk glided smoothly on thermal currents high above the canyon rim.
items.ex_zh: 一只优雅的鹰在峡谷边缘上方的高空热气流中平稳滑行。

items.def_en: 1. To float, move, or cause to move gently through the air or over water.
items.ex_en: Sweet aromas of freshly baked bread wafted from the kitchen into every room.
items.ex_zh: 刚出炉面包的诱人香气从厨房飘荡出来，弥漫进每个房间。
items.ex2_en: A gentle evening breeze wafted the smell of barbecue across the neighborhood.
items.ex2_zh: 柔和的晚风将烤肉的香气吹送到了整个街区。

items.def_en: to remain suspended in one place in the air
items.ex_en: A tiny hummingbird hovered motionless above the blooming jasmine flower for several seconds.
items.ex_zh: 一只小巧的蜂鸟在盛开的茉莉花上方悬停了数秒，纹丝不动。

items.def_en: to keep an object afloat or supported in a fluid medium
items.ex_en: The dense salt water will easily buoy any swimmer trying to stay afloat.
items.ex_zh: 高盐度的水能轻易浮托起任何试图保持漂浮的游泳者。

items.def_en: 1. To rise and float in the air without physical support, especially by magic or special power, or to cause something to do this.
items.ex_en: The stage magician appeared to levitate several feet above the polished wooden floor.
items.ex_zh: 舞台魔术师似乎悬空升起，漂浮在光洁的木地板上方数英尺处。
items.ex2_en: The mysterious guru claimed he could levitate heavy stones with mental energy alone.
items.ex2_zh: 这位神秘的宗师声称他单凭精神力量就能使沉重的石头悬浮起来。

groups.summary_en: An entity is suspended in or carried gently through the air or on liquid, either drifting with air currents or suspended defying gravity.
groups.summary_zh: 物体在空气中轻盈漂移、受气流托运或悬空升腾。
groups.desc_en: Sustained suspension or gentle propulsion in a fluid medium (liquid/air) without active grounding, contrasting with powered flight or downward sinking.
groups.desc_zh: 在流体（液体或空气）中悬停或顺势轻缓漂移，区别于主动动力飞行或向下沉没。
groups.nuance_en: float: stay on the surface of a fluid or suspended in air without sinking (debris / boat / cloud) · waft: pass gently through air like a scent or breeze (scent / smoke / melody) · drift: be carried along aimlessly by currents or wind (vessel / current / snow) · hover: remain suspended stably in one place in the air (helicopter / hawk / spirit) · buoy: keep afloat physically, or uplift spirits figuratively (spirits / confidence / swimmer)
groups.nuance_zh: float: 漂浮于液面或悬浮空中不致沉没 (debris / boat / cloud) · waft: 如香气、轻烟般随风轻柔飘荡 (scent / smoke / melody) · drift: 顺水或随风无目标地漂流 (vessel / current / snow) · hover: 在半空中定点悬停徘徊 (helicopter / hawk / spirit) · buoy: 使浮起，比喻振奋士气或支撑 (spirits / confidence / swimmer)

groups.name: Fluster & Perturb · 慌乱与使心烦意乱 (Agitate or Destabilize Mental Composure)
groups.tip: 心绪大乱失常且坐立不安

items.raw_cluster: 使慌乱与骚动 Agitate & Fluster
items.def_zh: 使慌乱，使心烦意乱；慌张忙乱；（雪、尘等）纷飞
items.def_en: 1. To agitate, confuse, or fluster someone. 2. To move in an excited, hurried, or confused manner. 3. (of snow, wind, or dust) To swirl around in light gusts.
items.ex_en: Sudden unexpected questions from reporters flurried the young spokesperson during the press conference.
items.ex_zh: 新闻发布会上，记者们突然提出的意外问题让这位年轻发言人手忙脚乱。
items.ex2_en: Pigeons flurried in panic as the loud construction truck approached the fountain.
items.ex2_zh: 当吵闹的施工卡车靠近喷泉时，鸽子惊惶失措地乱飞。

items.def_en: to make someone nervous, confused, and prone to mistakes
items.ex_en: The harsh interruptions completely flustered the nervous candidate during her public speech.
items.ex_zh: 刺耳的打断让这位紧张的候选人在公开演讲中彻底慌了神。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to disturb someone's mental calm or fluster them with sudden agitation
items.ex_en: The unexpected arrival of the inspectors really rattled up the store manager.
items.ex_zh: 检查员的不期而至着实让店长慌了神。

items.def_zh: 使震惊，使心烦意乱，打破心境安宁
items.def_en: (+ sb) to upset, agitate, or unsettle someone emotionally
items.ex_en: The new CEO plans to shake up the entire management structure.
items.ex_zh: 新任首席执行官计划对整个管理架构进行大洗牌。

items.def_zh: 使心慌意乱，打乱心绪，使慌乱
items.def_en: (+ sb) to confuse, perturb, or disconcert someone so that they lose their concentration or composure
items.ex_en: That sudden hostile question from the reporter completely threw off the candidate.
items.ex_zh: 记者突然提出的敌意问题彻底打乱了候选人的阵脚。

items.def_zh: 使仓皇失措，使窘迫不安
items.def_en: to disturb the composure of someone; make someone feel unsettled or confused
items.ex_en: His abrupt shift in tone visibly disconcerted the foreign diplomats during negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 在谈判中，他语气的突然转变明显使外国外交官们感到局促不安。

items.def_en: to make someone worried, anxious, or uneasy in mind
items.ex_en: The persistent rumors of layoffs perturb the senior staff members across departments.
items.ex_zh: 裁员的流言持续不断，令各部门的资深员工心神不宁。

items.def_zh: 使气馁，使不知所措/丧失胆量
items.def_en: to make someone lose confidence, composure, or determination
items.ex_en: The eerie silence inside the abandoned hospital began to unnerve the investigators.
items.ex_zh: 废弃医院内怪异的死寂开始让调查员们心慌失措。

items.raw_cluster: 扰乱与使不安 Perturb & Unhinge
items.def_zh: 使心神错乱，使精神失常；取下……的铰链
items.def_en: 1. (often passive) To make someone mentally disordered, distraught, or emotionally unstable. 2. To remove a door, gate, or lid from its hinges.
items.ex_en: The sudden tragedy threatened to unhinge his fragile and deeply troubled mind.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的悲剧几乎要击垮他脆弱而极度痛苦的精神。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on causing someone to lose emotional equilibrium, focus, or calm. While 'flurry' and 'fluster' imply hurried confusion and embarrassment, 'perturb' and 'unhinge' strike deeper into psychological stability, potentially causing total derangement.
groups.summary_zh: 指打乱人的心绪平静，使其神情慌乱甚至精神失常。
groups.desc_en: Disrupting an individual's mental composure through sudden shock, noise, or pressure, contrasting with deepening chronic depression or calming.
groups.desc_zh: 因突发变故、惊吓或施压打乱心智镇定，区别于慢性抑郁加深或平抚情绪。
groups.nuance_en: fluster: make nervous, confused, and agitated by haste or confusion (speaker / candidate) · perturb: deeply agitate someone's inner equilibrium or peace of mind (official / parent) · unnerve: deprive of courage, confidence, or composure (witness / athlete) · disconcert: disturb self-possession through unexpected embarrassment or oddity (rival / host) · throw off: confuse or deflect someone's concentration or timing (rhythm / balance / investigator)
groups.nuance_zh: fluster: 因匆忙或混乱令人手忙脚乱、心慌意乱 (speaker / candidate) · perturb: 深刻打破内心平静、引起深层不安 (official / parent) · unnerve: 剥夺其勇气与定力，使之心惊肉跳 (witness / athlete) · disconcert: 因突兀或窘迫使人局促尴尬、不知所措 (rival / host) · throw off: 打乱节奏、注意力或使其失去常态 (rhythm / balance / investigator)

groups.name: Fly & Soar · 飞翔与振翅 (Fly, Soar, Flitter)
groups.tip: 在空中飞翔、翱翔或轻快振翅

items.def_en: to depart or escape through the air by flight
items.ex_en: Startled by the gunshot, hundreds of pigeons flew away from the square.
items.ex_zh: 数百只鸽子被枪声惊吓，纷纷从广场展翅飞离。

items.def_en: to leave the ground and begin to fly through the air
items.ex_en: The heavy cargo aircraft took off smoothly despite the severe crosswinds yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 尽管昨天遭遇强烈侧风，那架重型货机依然平稳起飞。

items.def_en: [I/T] to flap wings quickly and lightly without flying far
items.ex_en: The wounded sparrow fluttered its wings desperately against the cold wire mesh.
items.ex_zh: 那只受伤的麻雀在冰冷的铁丝网上绝望地扇动着翅膀。
items.ex2_en: The colorful flags fluttered wildly in the strong autumn wind above the stadium.
items.ex2_zh: 五颜六色的旗帜在体育场上方的凛冽秋风中剧烈飘扬。

items.def_zh: 轻快振翅，飞来飞去，扇翅
items.def_en: 1. To fly or move quickly, lightly, and erratically from place to place.
items.ex_en: Bright butterflies flittered restlessly among the blossoms in the sunlit afternoon garden.
items.ex_zh: 斑斓的蝴蝶在午后阳光明媚的花园花丛间轻快翻飞。

items.def_en: to fly upwards high into the air smoothly and effortlessly
items.ex_en: We watched the majestic falcon soar up gracefully into the cloudless sky.
items.ex_zh: 我们注视着那只威风凛凛的猎鹰轻盈地翱翔升入晴空。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ one's way) to travel on wings or fly swiftly toward a destination
items.ex_en: Weary migratory swallows winged their way toward warmer southern shores before nightfall.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的候鸟燕子在夜幕降临前展翅飞往温暖的南方海岸。

items.def_en: to stay in the air in one place by flapping wings rapidly
items.ex_en: The tiny hummingbird hovered effortlessly while sipping nectar from the crimson flower.
items.ex_zh: 这只小小的蜂鸟一边轻松地悬停在空中，一边吮吸着深红花朵的花蜜。

items.def_zh: 乘水上飞机飞行（或旅行）
items.def_en: 1. To fly or travel in a seaplane.
items.ex_en: We decided to seaplane across the remote fjord to reach the lodge.
items.ex_zh: 我们决定乘水上飞机横跨偏远的峡湾前往度假小屋。

items.def_en: to fly high in the air without moving wings or using power
items.ex_en: Vast mountain eagles soar effortlessly upon the warm rising thermals above peaks.
items.ex_zh: 巨大的山鹰乘着山峰上方上升的暖气流毫不费力地翱翔。

groups.summary_en: A creature or vehicle navigates through the air via flapping wings, mechanical propulsion, or gliding effortlessly aloft.
groups.summary_zh: 鸟类或飞行器在空中振翅振荡、展翅翱翔或航行。
groups.desc_en: Moving through the air utilizing aerodynamic lift, propulsion, or gliding currents, contrasting with surface locomotion or ballistic falling.
groups.desc_zh: 利用空气动力、振翅或气流在空中穿行，区别于地面移动或抛物线下坠。
groups.nuance_en: fly: general aerodynamic travel through the air (bird / plane / flag) · soar: glide effortlessly upward on rising thermals or high in the sky (eagle / temperature / spirit) · flutter: flap wings or move rapidly and lightly back and forth (butterfly / leaf / pulse) · flitter: dart quickly and erratically from place to place (moth / shadow) · take off: leave the ground and begin aerial flight (aircraft / career)
groups.nuance_zh: fly: 通用空域飞行与翱翔 (bird / plane / flag) · soar: 乘上升气流毫不费力地高飞或急剧飙升 (eagle / temperature / spirit) · flutter: 振翅微颤或轻快抖动 (butterfly / leaf / pulse) · flitter: 轻捷且不规则地忽飞忽落 (moth / shadow) · take off: 离地起飞，比喻事业起飞 (aircraft / career)

groups.name: Forceful Striking & Kicking · 重击与蹬踹 (Kick, Pound, Boot)
groups.tip: 用手足施加物理冲击力

items.def_en: To hit or drive something forcefully with the foot; to recoil.
items.ex_en: The midfielder kicked the ball forcefully toward the top corner of the goal.
items.ex_zh: 中场球员用力一脚把球踢向了球门的死角。

items.def_en: to strike someone forcefully with the knee, typically in close combat
items.ex_en: The martial artist managed to knee his opponent hard in the stomach.
items.ex_zh: 这位武术运动员成功用膝盖狠狠顶撞了对手的腹部。

items.def_en: (+ sb) violently assault someone by delivering repeated punches or kicks
items.ex_en: Don't beat yourself up over an honest mistake.
items.ex_zh: 不要因为一次无心之失而过度自责。

items.def_en: (+ sth) break or force open a door or structure by striking it violently with the foot
items.ex_en: The tactical squad kicked in the barricaded door within a few seconds.
items.ex_zh: 特警战术小队在几秒钟之内踹开了被路障封堵的大门。

items.def_en: (+ sb) attack someone physically with forceful, aggressive blows
items.ex_en: The furious customer began to lay into the security guard with fists.
items.ex_zh: 怒不可遏的顾客抡起拳头，开始痛击那名保安。

items.def_zh: 连续重击，猛打；捣碎，捣烂；心怦怦跳
items.def_en: To hit something repeatedly and heavily with a fist or heavy instrument; to crush or grind into smaller pieces.
items.ex_en: The chef pounded the garlic cloves into a smooth paste using mortar.
items.ex_zh: 厨师用研钵将大蒜瓣连续捣压成细腻的蒜泥。

items.def_zh: 猛踢，用力踢；启动（计算机）；踢开，解雇
items.def_en: 1. To kick someone or something forcefully. 2. To start up a computer system. 3. (informal) To dismiss or expel someone.
items.ex_en: He booted the stubborn rusted gate until the latch finally broke open.
items.ex_zh: 他猛踢那扇生锈顽固的大门，直到门闩终于被踹断打开。

items.def_en: to strike repeatedly and violently with the fists or heavy repeated blows
items.ex_en: The boxer pummeled his groggy rival along the ropes without any mercy.
items.ex_zh: 拳击手毫不留情地在围绳旁连续猛击头晕目眩的对手。

items.def_en: (informal) to strike someone or something with immense physical force
items.ex_en: The bouncer clobbered the unruly troublemaker with a single, devastating punch.
items.ex_zh: 保镖一记势大力沉的重拳，狠狠揍翻了那个胡闹的闹事者。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail blunt, high-impact mechanical strikes delivered via feet, heavy blunt tools, or repetitive physical blows, categorized by impact trajectory, limb usage, and destructive intent.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过重拳、钝击或脚部蹬踹施加的强力机械性撞击。
groups.desc_en: Delivering sudden, forceful kinetic blows using feet, knees, or fists, contrasting with gentle touching, slashing with blades, or continuous crushing.
groups.desc_zh: 使用腿、膝、拳等肢体部位进行突发性的重击或踢端，区别于抚摸、利器割削或持续碾压。
groups.nuance_en: kick: strike forcefully with the foot (ball / door / habit) · boot: strike or kick roughly with a heavy shoe, or eject (ball / intruder) · pound: deliver repeated heavy, bludgeoning blows (fist / anvil / shore) · pummel: beat repeatedly and rapidly with fists (opponent / body) · knee: strike someone sharply using the bent knee (groin / attacker)
groups.nuance_zh: kick: 用脚踢击或踹 (ball / door / habit) · boot: 用重靴猛踹，引申为粗暴开除 (ball / intruder) · pound: 连续重拳或重物连续砸击 (fist / anvil / shore) · pummel: 用双拳极快地连续痛击 (opponent / body) · knee: 用弯曲的膝盖猛顶攻击 (groin / attacker)

groups.name: Forgive & Pardon · 宽恕与赦免 (Absolve, Exonerate, Amnesty)
groups.tip: 从心灵原谅到官方赦免

items.def_en: to overlook or forgive a minor fault or social breach politely
items.ex_en: The host excused his young guest for accidentally spilling tea onto the tablecloth.
items.ex_zh: 主人包涵了年轻客人不慎把茶水洒在桌布上的失礼行为。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Relinquish grievance, grudge, or bitter resentment against someone
items.ex_en: It took him several years to finally let go of that bitter resentment.
items.ex_zh: 他花了好几年时间，才最终放下了那段刻骨的怨恨。

items.def_en: to accept or tolerate morally wrong behavior without censure
items.ex_en: The university ethics committee cannot condone academic dishonesty under any conceivable circumstances.
items.ex_zh: 大学道德委员会在任何可以想见的情况下都绝不纵容学术不端行为。

items.def_en: (+ sb) Excuse, pardon, or refrain from punishing an offender
items.ex_en: The lenient traffic officer decided to let off the speeding driver with warning.
items.ex_zh: 宽容的交警决定免予处罚这位超速司机，仅给予口头警告。

items.def_en: 1. To stop feeling angry or resentful toward someone for an offense or mistake. 2. To officially cancel a debt or financial obligation.
items.ex_en: She learned to forgive her brother for his reckless actions long ago.
items.ex_zh: 她很久以前就学会了原谅弟弟当年的鲁莽行径。

items.def_en: 1. (law) To officially forgive a person and release them from punishment for a crime. 2. To forgive someone for a fault, bad behavior, or impoliteness.
items.ex_en: The outgoing governor pardoned several nonviolent prisoners on his last official day.
items.ex_zh: 即将卸任的州长在公职任期的最后一天赦免了数名非暴力囚犯。

items.def_en: (+ from/of) to officially or sacramentally declare free from guilt, blame, or sin
items.ex_en: The priest pronounced words of solemn absolution to absolve him from guilt.
items.ex_zh: 神父念诵神圣的赦罪经文，免除了他的罪咎。

items.def_en: (+ from) to officially clear someone from an accusation of wrongdoing after investigation
items.ex_en: The forensic DNA analysis completely exonerated the innocent man from the wrongful charge.
items.ex_zh: 法医的DNA分析彻底免除了这名无辜男子的不白之冤。

items.def_en: to grant an official sovereign pardon to a group of political or criminal offenders
items.ex_en: The revolutionary government decided to amnesty all political exiles following the peace treaty.
items.ex_zh: 和平条约签署后，革命政府决定特赦所有政治流亡者。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote ceasing to harbor resentment toward someone for an offense or officially releasing an offender from legal culpability and punishment, scaling from interpersonal forbearance to formal sovereign absolution.
groups.summary_zh: 指免除他人罪责或法律惩罚，由人际宽恕升至官方赦免。
groups.desc_en: Relinquishing resentment, legal blame, or punishment against an offender, contrasting with exacting retribution, prosecuting, or condemning.
groups.desc_zh: 放弃对过错方的怨恨、罪责或惩处，与实施报复、起诉或定罪相对立。
groups.nuance_en: forgive: cease feeling resentment for a personal offense (debt / transgression / friend) · pardon: officially excuse a convicted criminal from punishment (convict / prisoner) · absolve: pronounce someone free from guilt, sin, or solemn obligation (sinner / blame / duty) · exonerate: formally clear someone of blame after investigation (suspect / defendant) · condone: treat an offense as acceptable or overlook it implicitly (behavior / violence)
groups.nuance_zh: forgive: 个人层面上原谅过失、消解怨恨 (debt / transgression / friend) · pardon: 司法或主权层面上正式赦免罪刑 (convict / prisoner) · absolve: 宗教或伦理上免除罪愆、洗脱罪名 (sinner / blame / duty) · exonerate: 经过调查正式洗清冤屈或排除嫌疑 (suspect / defendant) · condone: 默许、纵容不良过错行为 (behavior / violence)

groups.name: Form Coalition & Unify · 结盟与联合 (Ally, Federate, Gang up)
groups.tip: 缔结同盟携手应对外部挑战

items.def_en: (+ with/together) To unite in a pact, league, or mutual protective covenant
items.ex_en: The smaller principalities resolved to league together against the expanding imperial army.
items.ex_zh: 各小公国决意联合结盟，共同抵御不断扩张的帝国军队。

items.def_en: To join or unite with another person, group, or country for mutual support or a common purpose.
items.ex_en: The two democratic nations formally allied to protect critical international shipping corridors.
items.ex_zh: 这两个民主国家正式结盟，以保护关键的国际航运通道。
items.ex2_en: Small rebel factions allied closely against the oppressive authoritarian regime in the capital.
items.ex2_zh: 几个反抗小派系紧密结盟，共同对抗首都的专制政权。

items.def_zh: 结伙，联合（常与 up 连用）；结伙对付（与 up on/against 连用）
items.def_en: (usually gang up) To unite or join together in a group, especially to oppose or intimidate someone.
items.ex_en: Several rebellious lawmakers ganged together to defeat the controversial new tax proposal.
items.ex_zh: 数名反叛议员结伙串联，旨在击败这项备受争议的新税收提案。

items.def_en: (+ with) To join together to form a political or functional coalition
items.ex_en: The moderate factions chose to coalise with environmentalists to secure a majority.
items.ex_zh: 温和派阵营选择与环保主义者组建联合联盟，以锁定多数席位。

items.def_en: (+ on/against sb) form a group or alliance to oppose, intimidate, or attack someone
items.ex_en: Older schoolchildren often gang up against newcomers in the crowded school playground.
items.ex_zh: 高年级学生经常在拥挤的操场上结伙欺负新入学的同学。

items.def_en: (+ with sb) join together with another person or group to work toward a common goal
items.ex_en: The two rival tech companies decided to team up to develop the open-source platform.
items.ex_zh: 这两家相互竞争的科技公司决定联手合作，共同开发该开源平台。

items.def_en: unite as a group to achieve a shared objective or face a mutual adversary
items.ex_en: Local shop owners banded together to combat rising retail crime along the avenue.
items.ex_zh: 当地店主们团结起来，共同打击这条大街上日益猖獗的零售犯罪。

items.def_en: To bring people, parties, or states into an alliance or confederacy
items.ex_en: The disparate northern territories confederated to establish a unified border defense network.
items.ex_zh: 各自独立的北方领地结成邦联，以建立统一的边界防御网络。
items.ex2_en: The independent regional clans confederated peacefully to defend against foreign maritime invaders.
items.ex2_zh: 各独立的地方氏族和平结成同盟，以抵御外来海上入侵者。

items.def_en: To join together to form a federation, or to cause states or organizations to unite in a federation.
items.ex_en: The formerly autonomous provinces federated to establish a centralized democratic republic.
items.ex_zh: 此前自治的各省结成联邦，建立起一个中央集权的民主共和国。
items.ex2_en: The fragmented labor unions federated smoothly into a powerful national bargaining organization.
items.ex2_zh: 分散的工会顺利联合成一个强大的全国性谈判组织。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame cover sovereign entities, factions, or individuals entering into mutual pacts, treaties, or coalitions to achieve collective strength or political consolidation. They vary from formal legal federations to informal, often adversarial banding together.
groups.summary_zh: 指国家、团体或个人通过协议缔结同盟或结成联合体。
groups.desc_en: Uniting separate groups or agents into a unified bloc or collaborative faction, contrasting with individual divergence, secession, or conflict.
groups.desc_zh: 将分离的实体、派系或个人结成同盟阵营，区别于各自为政、分裂退群或内部对抗。
groups.nuance_en: ally: enter a formal mutual-defense or strategic pact (nation / power / state) · team up: join with another casually or professionally for a shared project (partner / rival) · band together: unite spontaneously to confront a common threat or goal (residents / rebels) · gang up: combine against a single vulnerable target aggressively (bullies / critics) · confederate: unite states or groups in a loose political union (states / provinces)
groups.nuance_zh: ally: 国家或政治势力结成正式战略同盟 (nation / power / state) · team up: 为具体项目临时或专业联手搭档 (partner / rival) · band together: 面对共同威胁自发抱团抗敌 (residents / rebels) · gang up: 结伙联合围攻、欺凌弱小单体 (bullies / critics) · confederate: 联邦化组建较为松散的政治联盟 (states / provinces)

groups.name: Formally Request & Solicit · 请求与呼吁 (Request, Appeal, Solicit)
groups.tip: 从客气礼貌请求到极力恳求

items.def_en: to state that one wants someone to give them something or do something
items.ex_en: She asked her neighbor politely for assistance moving the heavy dining table.
items.ex_zh: 她客气地请求邻居帮忙挪动那张沉重的餐桌。

items.def_en: (+ sth) make an official or formal request for something such as leave, a transfer, or a pay raise
items.ex_en: Jack intends to put in for three weeks of annual leave next Monday.
items.ex_zh: 杰克打算下周一正式申请休三周的年假。

items.def_en: to ask for something politely or formally
items.ex_en: The defense attorney formally requested an extension from the presiding magistrate yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师昨天正式向主审法官请求延长审限。

items.def_en: (+ sb) make a formal or earnest request to a person or authority for assistance or a decision
items.ex_en: Humanitarian agencies appeal to international donors for urgent relief supplies and medicine.
items.ex_zh: 人道主义机构向国际捐赠者发出呼吁，恳求提供紧急救援物资和药品。

items.def_en: (+ sth) publicly demand or appeal for a specific action, policy, or remedy
items.ex_en: Angry labor unions called for an immediate independent inquiry into factory safety.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的工会公开呼吁，要求对工厂安全展开即刻的独立调查。

items.def_zh: 呼吁，恳求；上诉，申诉；有吸引力
items.def_en: 1. to make a serious, urgent, or formal request for help, money, or information 2. to ask a higher court to reconsider a legal decision 3. to be attractive or interesting to someone
items.ex_en: The famine charity appealed for generous public contributions to feed displaced families.
items.ex_zh: 饥荒救济慈善组织紧急呼吁公众慷慨捐助，以救济流离失所的家庭。

items.def_en: to formally ask someone for money, information, or help
items.ex_en: The environmental nonprofit organization actively solicits donations from corporations across the country.
items.ex_zh: 该环保非营利组织积极向全国各地的企业恳请捐款。

items.def_en: (+ object + to do) to formally urge or invite someone to take a particular action
items.ex_en: The president called on all citizens to conserve energy throughout the harsh winter.
items.ex_zh: 总统号召全体市民在严寒的冬季厉行节约能源。

items.def_en: to make a formal, written application to an authority or court
items.ex_en: Residents gathered signatures to petition the municipal council for a new pedestrian crossing.
items.ex_zh: 居民们募集签名，正式向市议会请愿增设一条人行横道。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote making a polite, formal, or public application for help, action, or a decision, without necessarily implying emotional abjection. They scale upward from standard polite inquiries to pressing institutional or public calls for action.
groups.summary_zh: 正式、礼貌或公开地提出申请、呼吁与请求。
groups.desc_en: Transmitting an overt demand, petition, or entreaty to an authority, counterparty, or the public, contrasting with casual asking or command imposition.
groups.desc_zh: 向权力机构、交易方或公众正式提出呼吁、诉求或募集，区别于日常闲聊询问或强制施令。
groups.nuance_en: request: formally and politely express a wish for something (information / assistance / permission) · appeal: make an earnest, urgent, or public plea (verdict / donation / conscience) · solicit: actively and persistently seek funds, business, or opinions (funds / opinions / votes) · call for: publicly demand as necessary or appropriate (reform / resignation / boycott) · call on: publicly summon or urge someone to act (government / leaders / citizens)
groups.nuance_zh: request: 正式且礼貌地提出诉求或申请 (information / assistance / permission) · appeal: 恳切、紧急地上诉或面向公众呼吁 (verdict / donation / conscience) · solicit: 主动、持续地招揽筹集资金、拉选票 (funds / opinions / votes) · call for: 明确要求或公开敦促某项变动 (reform / resignation / boycott) · call on: 庄重号召某人某组织采取行动 (government / leaders / citizens)

groups.name: Formally Submit & Lodge Documents · 呈交与递交 (Submit, Lodge, Tender)
groups.tip: 向有关机构再次呈交审查材料

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ to) to present a proposal, document, or form to an authority for consideration or judgment
items.ex_en: The architectural firm submitted their ambitious restoration plans to the planning committee.
items.ex_zh: 建筑事务所向规划委员会呈交了他们宏大的修复方案。

items.def_en: (+ with/against) to make a formal statement of a complaint, objection, or claim to an official body
items.ex_en: The dissatisfied passenger decided to lodge a formal complaint against the airline company.
items.ex_zh: 不满的乘客决定就航空公司的不良服务正式提出申诉。
items.ex2_en: A small pebble lodged firmly in the tread of his running shoe.
items.ex2_zh: 一颗小石子紧紧地卡在了他的跑鞋底花纹里。

items.def_en: to deliver a document, assignment, or notice to a person in authority
items.ex_en: Every undergraduate must hand in their research paper before Friday afternoon at noon.
items.ex_zh: 所有本科生都必须在周五中午十二点之前上交研究论文。

items.def_zh: 正式提出，呈交（申请、索赔等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) submit an official claim, proposal, or application to an authority
items.ex_en: The homeowner quickly put in an insurance claim for the severe roof damage.
items.ex_zh: 房主迅速就严重的屋顶损坏向保险公司正式提出了索赔申请。

items.def_en: (+ sth) deliver or mail completed documents, forms, or applications to an organization
items.ex_en: Applicants should send in all certified identity documents to the registry office promptly.
items.ex_zh: 申请人应迅速将所有经过公证的身份文件寄送到登记处。

items.def_zh: 交出，呈缴（作业、报告、证件）
items.def_en: (+ sth) give a completed document, assignment, or formal item to a teacher, employer, or official
items.ex_en: The detective ordered the suspect to turn in his passport to the authorities.
items.ex_zh: 侦探勒令犯罪嫌疑人将护照交出并呈缴给有关部门。

items.def_zh: 正式提出，递交（辞呈、申请等）
items.def_en: to offer or present something formally, such as a resignation, bid, or payment
items.ex_en: The chief executive officer tendered his unexpected resignation to the board this morning.
items.ex_zh: 首席执行官今天上午向董事会正式递交了令人意外的辞呈。

items.def_en: to submit something again, especially after making revisions or corrections
items.ex_en: The author must resubmit the corrected chapter to the editorial board tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 作者明天必须将修改后的章节重新提交给编辑部审阅。

items.def_zh: 重新呈交，再次提交（resubmit 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: past tense and past participle of resubmit; to have submitted something again for review or approval.
items.ex_en: The engineering team resubmitted the revised budget to the board for immediate approval.
items.ex_zh: 工程团队已将修改后的预算方案重新呈交董事会，以期立即获批。

groups.summary_en: An individual officially hands over, tenders, or deposits documents, proposals, or formal notices to an authority or designated recipient for approval or processing.
groups.summary_zh: 向当局或官方机构正式呈送、递交文件、方案或辞呈。
groups.desc_en: Depositing official paperwork, claims, or formal tenders to a designated receiving authority, contrasting with casual sharing or receiving files.
groups.desc_zh: 向主管机关或法定接收方正式呈递、交存文件或申请，区别于非正式传阅或被动接收。
groups.nuance_en: submit: formally present for review, approval, or judgment (application / proposal / report) · lodge: formally register a complaint, protest, or legal document with authorities (complaint / protest / appeal) · tender: formally proffer or offer for acceptance, like bids or resignations (resignation / bid / payment) · hand in: physically or digitally turn in completed work to a supervisor/teacher (notice / paper / badge) · turn in: submit an assignment, or surrender an item or suspect to authorities (assignment / contraband / suspect)
groups.nuance_zh: submit: 提交文件、方案待上级或权威审议 (application / proposal / report) · lodge: 向官方机构正式提起申诉、抗议或立案 (complaint / protest / appeal) · tender: 正式递交辞呈或投标 (resignation / bid / payment) · hand in: 向负责人或老师上交作业、证件 (notice / paper / badge) · turn in: 上缴指定作业，或向警方自首、移交物品 (assignment / contraband / suspect)

groups.name: Formulate & Conceptualize Idea · 构想与设想 (Conceive, Formulate, Envisage)
groups.tip: 深思熟虑酝酿想法

items.def_en: form an idea, concept, or mental image in one's mind
items.ex_en: Designers gathered around the whiteboard to ideate new solutions for urban mobility.
items.ex_zh: 设计师们围聚在白板周围，构想有关城市出行方式的新方案。

items.def_en: (+ sth) think of or formulate an idea, plan, solution, or hypothesis
items.ex_en: The clever research team came up with an ingenious solution to the problem.
items.ex_zh: 这个聪慧的研发团队构想出了一个解决该难题的精妙方案。

items.def_en: (+ sth) invent or formulate an unusual, creative, or impractical idea or plan
items.ex_en: Marketing executives dreamed up an absurd publicity stunt to boost sluggish shoe sales.
items.ex_zh: 营销主管们异想天开地设计出一场荒谬的宣传噱头，以提振疲软的鞋类销量。

items.def_en: (+ sth) use one's imagination or intellect to originate an idea, story, or plan
items.ex_en: He had to think up a plausible excuse for arriving two hours late.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不编出一个合理的借口来解释迟到两个小时的原因。

items.def_zh: 构想，设想，构思；认为；怀（胎），怀孕
items.def_en: 1. To form an idea, plan, or concept in your mind; (+ of) to imagine or envisage something. 2. To become pregnant with a child.
items.ex_en: The visionary architect conceived a revolutionary design for the sustainable coastal city.
items.ex_zh: 这位富有远见的建筑师为这座可持续沿海城市构想出革命性的设计。

items.def_en: plan or invent a complex method, system, or mechanism from thought
items.ex_en: Engineers devised a sophisticated cryptographic protocol to safeguard delicate personal healthcare records.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们设计出一套复杂的密码学协议，以保障敏感情感的个人医疗档案安全。

items.def_zh: 构想，制订，规划；确切阐述，明确表达
items.def_en: 1. To invent, design, or develop a plan, policy, or theory carefully in detail. 2. To express an idea or opinion in a clear and precise way.
items.ex_en: The finance ministry carefully formulated a comprehensive economic policy to curb inflation.
items.ex_zh: 财政部精心制订了一项全面的经济政策以抑制通货膨胀。

items.def_en: contemplate or visualize a desirable or realistic future possibility
items.ex_en: Economists envisage a gradual resurgence in commercial investment over the coming fiscal decade.
items.ex_zh: 经济学家展望在未来的财政十年中，商业投资将呈现逐步复苏的态势。

items.def_zh: 使概念化，将……形成概念，构想
items.def_en: 1. To form a concept, idea, or mental model of something.
items.ex_en: The committee struggled to conceptualize a comprehensive framework for sustainable economic development.
items.ex_zh: 委员会难以构想出一个综合性的可持续经济发展框架。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the mental process of originating, visualizing, or systematically structuring ideas, theories, or forward-looking plans. They vary in whether they emphasize the initial spark of creation, abstract modeling, or concrete articulation.
groups.summary_zh: 指在头脑中酝酿设想、构建概念或系统性地拟定方案。
groups.desc_en: Originating, structuring, and mentally generating a novel concept, strategy, or plan from nothing, contrasting with mere execution or passive understanding.
groups.desc_zh: 在脑海中从无到有地构思、推演并形成创新概念或构想，不同于落地执行或被动理解。
groups.nuance_en: conceive: originate an embryonic idea, principle, or mental image (idea / plan / baby) · formulate: systematically articulate an idea into a precise structure or plan (policy / strategy / theory) · devise: invent or engineer an ingenious plan, mechanism, or scheme (plan / plot / method) · envisage: visualize a concrete future possibility or scenario (future / outcome / scenario) · dream up: invent an imaginative, bizarre, or impractical notion (scheme / excuse / scenario)
groups.nuance_zh: conceive: 酝酿提出开创性的胚胎构想 (idea / plan / baby) · formulate: 严密系统地拟定政策、理论或方案 (policy / strategy / theory) · devise: 巧妙发明出复杂的方案、计策或机械 (plan / plot / method) · envisage: 在脑海中设想、展望未来情境 (future / outcome / scenario) · dream up: 凭空异想天开地编造出奇思妙想或借口 (scheme / excuse / scenario)

groups.name: Forward Motion & March · 前进与行进 (Advance, March)
groups.tip: 整齐或坚定地向前

items.def_en: (+ into/out of) to walk or march together in a crowd, group, or body
items.ex_en: Hundreds of excited tourists trooped out of the museum into the square.
items.ex_zh: 数百名兴奋的游客成群结队地走出博物馆，步入广场。

items.def_en: move forward rapidly and purposefully despite obstacles
items.ex_en: The engineering team continued to forge ahead despite severe delays in funding.
items.ex_zh: 尽管资金严重延误，工程团队仍顶住阻碍迅猛推进。

items.def_en: continue moving forward determinedly, especially despite fatigue, difficulties, or resistance
items.ex_en: Exhausted and freezing, the hikers resolved to press on through the blizzard.
items.ex_zh: 尽管精疲力竭且浑身冰冷，徒步者们仍决心顶着暴风雪坚定前行。

items.def_en: advance toward an objective or enemy territory with momentum and intent
items.ex_en: Despite the budget cuts, the team decided to push forward with the research.
items.ex_zh: 尽管预算遭到削减，团队仍决定继续推进该项研究。
items.ex2_en: The general ordered his armored divisions to push forward despite the severe winter storm.
items.ex2_zh: 尽管遭遇严冬暴风雪，将军还是命令他的装甲师全力向前推进。

items.def_zh: 齐步走，行军；坚定地走，挺进；迫使……同行
items.def_en: 1. To walk with stiff, regular steps, especially like soldiers. 2. To walk somewhere quickly and with determination. 3. To force someone to walk somewhere with you.
items.ex_en: The determined demonstrators marched through the city center toward the parliament building.
items.ex_zh: 坚定的示威者们迈着坚决的步伐穿过市中心，向议会大楼挺进。
items.ex2_en: The stern guards marched the captured prisoners swiftly into the secure fortress courtyard.
items.ex2_zh: 严厉的警卫押解着被俘的囚犯迅速走入坚固的堡垒庭院。

items.def_en: (+ on/forward) to continue moving rapidly or determinedly toward a destination or objective
items.ex_en: The regiment pressed forward under heavy fire to secure the strategic ridge.
items.ex_zh: 该团在猛烈炮火下竭力向前挺进，以占领这一战略山脊。

items.def_zh: 前进，进军；推进，促进；提前；提出（观点）
items.def_en: 1. To move forward towards someone or something, especially in a military attack. 2. To develop, progress, or cause something to progress. 3. To bring forward a date, or pay money beforehand.
items.ex_en: Allied infantry units advanced cautiously toward the enemy's fortified perimeter at dawn.
items.ex_zh: 盟军步兵部队在黎明时分谨慎地向敌方防御严密的阵地推进。
items.ex2_en: The tech company advanced the product release date by three full months.
items.ex2_zh: 这家科技公司将产品发布日期提前了整整三个月。

items.def_en: (+ ahead/on) to move forward steadily and purposefully, often despite resistance or obstacles
items.ex_en: The heavy icebreaker forged steadily ahead through the frozen polar waters.
items.ex_zh: 重型破冰船在封冻的极地海域中稳步艰难地向前破浪前行。

items.def_en: (+ forward) to move forward suddenly and powerfully like a tidal wave
items.ex_en: The angry crowd surged forward against the police barricades outside city hall.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的群众如潮水般向前涌向市政厅外的警察警戒线。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify intentional forward directional movement toward a goal or enemy position. They differ by formation, pace, and purpose—from formal military steps (march) to strategic or progressive forward momentum (advance, surge).
groups.summary_zh: 步调一致或有既定目标地向前推进与行军。
groups.desc_en: Relentlessly progressing forward through physical space, opposition, or logistical friction, contrasting with retreat, sideways drifting, or static holding.
groups.desc_zh: 克服阻力或关山险阻坚定向前挺进，与退缩撤退、横向偏移或驻足固守相对立。
groups.nuance_en: advance: make structured, forward progress, often militarily (troops / technology / boundary) · march: walk with measured, disciplined, or rhythmic steps (soldiers / protesters / band) · forge ahead: advance aggressively and steadily through adversity (project / reform / pioneer) · press on: persist forward despite exhaustion or obstacle (journey / campaign / runner) · push forward: exert active force to gain ground or territory (offensive / frontline / initiative)
groups.nuance_zh: advance: 步步推进向前行进，常具军事意象 (troops / technology / boundary) · march: 步调一致、富于纪律地行军或游行 (soldiers / protesters / band) · forge ahead: 迎着困难锐意进取、笃定开拓 (project / reform / pioneer) · press on: 顶住疲惫险阻坚定不移继续前行 (journey / campaign / runner) · push forward: 施加巨大推力向前开拓战线或进展 (offensive / frontline / initiative)

groups.name: Fragmentation & Structural Rupture · 碎裂与断裂 (Fracture, Fragment, Shatter)
groups.tip: 受力碎裂成细小碎片

items.def_en: develop a network of cracks or cause a solid surface to fracture
items.ex_en: Her impression of the boss made everyone in the room crack up.
items.ex_zh: 她模仿老板的样子让屋里的所有人都笑得前仰后合。
items.ex2_en: The reckless driver managed to crack up his father's expensive luxury car.
items.ex2_zh: 那个鲁莽的司机把他父亲昂贵的豪华轿车给撞毁了。

items.def_en: to break or fall apart into small fragments or powder gradually
items.ex_en: The ancient stone statues crumbled into fine dust after centuries of weathering.
items.ex_zh: 历经数世纪的风化，古代石雕逐渐崩塌碎裂成了细屑。
items.ex2_en: The baker crumbled fresh goat cheese over the steaming roasted vegetable salad.
items.ex2_zh: 面包师在热气腾腾的烤蔬菜沙拉上撒碎了新鲜的山羊奶酪。

items.def_en: separate or cause a solid object to separate into smaller parts or fragments
items.ex_en: The massive iceberg began to break up into small floes upon entering warm water.
items.ex_zh: 巨大的冰山在进入温暖水域后开始碎裂解体成小浮冰。
items.ex2_en: The road crew used hydraulic jackhammers to break up the old concrete sidewalk.
items.ex2_zh: 筑路工人用液压镐砸碎了旧的水泥人行道。

items.def_en: break into pieces because of structural weakness, strain, or decay
items.ex_en: The derelict wooden bridge finally fell apart under the weight of the truck.
items.ex_zh: 那座年久失修的木桥终因结构老化而在卡车的重量下彻底散架。

items.def_en: 1. To break or split into many small, separate pieces or disconnected parts.
items.ex_en: The high-impact collision caused the ceramic shield to fragment into countless shards.
items.ex_zh: 强烈的撞击导致陶瓷护盾碎裂成了无数碎片。
items.ex2_en: The delicate crystal vase fragmented into tiny glittering pieces on the hard floor.
items.ex2_zh: 精致的水晶花瓶在坚硬的地板上碎裂成了细小的闪光碎片。

items.def_zh: （使）破裂，（使）断裂，（使）骨折；（使关系等）分裂
items.def_en: 1. To break, crack, or split, especially of a bone, rock, or hard object. 2. (of a group, organization, or relationship) To split or break apart.
items.ex_en: The intense subterranean seismic tremor caused the bedrock to fracture deeply.
items.ex_zh: 强烈的地下地震震颤导致基岩发生了深层断裂。
items.ex2_en: The sudden jarring collision fractured his left forearm bone in two separate places.
items.ex2_zh: 突如其来的剧烈碰撞导致他的左前臂骨在两处断裂。

items.def_zh: 打碎，破碎；（化）把……分馏，分成各个组分
items.def_en: 1. (archaic) To break or split into fragments. 2. (chemistry) To separate a mixture into different components or fractions, especially by distillation.
items.ex_en: Ancient earthquakes did fraction the granite core, severing the sacred mountain path.
items.ex_zh: 远古的地震震碎了花岗岩核心，截断了神圣的山路。

items.def_zh: （使木头、骨骼等）裂成碎片/刺状断裂
items.def_en: to break or cause to break into thin, sharp, jagged pieces
items.ex_en: The rotten wooden beam splintered loudly when the heavy crate fell on it.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的板条箱砸在朽木梁上时，木梁发出巨响并裂成尖锐的木刺碎片。
items.ex2_en: The heavy industrial hammer splintered the dry cedar plank into sharp pointed pieces.
items.ex2_zh: 沉重的工业铁锤将干燥的雪松木板砸成了尖锐的小碎片。

items.def_en: to break suddenly and violently into many small pieces
items.ex_en: The stray baseball hit the plate-glass window and shattered it into tiny fragments.
items.ex_zh: 乱飞的棒球击中了平板玻璃窗，瞬间将其砸得粉碎。
items.ex2_en: The thin ice shattered abruptly when the heavy snowmobile drove onto the frozen lake.
items.ex2_zh: 当重型雪地摩托驶上冰湖时，薄冰瞬间破裂成碎片。

groups.summary_en: This manner frame denotes solid physical objects rupturing under stress, breaking into pieces, or losing structural continuity without total vaporization. Verbs distinguish whether the break is a fissure/crack in hard matter (fracture), disintegration into numerous detached shards (fragment, shatter), or splitting into segments (fraction).
groups.summary_zh: 坚硬实体受外力发生破裂、裂开骨折或散裂为无数细小碎块的过程。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote the structural disintegration of a unified entity into detached shards or sub-units, contrasting with general 'breaking' by emphasizing loss of internal coherence and multiplication of fragments.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指一体化结构丧失内在聚合力而碎裂瓦解为离散碎块，区别于普通的“打碎”，侧重于结构的粉碎性解体与碎片化。
groups.nuance_en: fracture: structural cracking under stress (bone / rock / alliance) · splinter: splitting into thin, sharp longitudinal shards (wood / bone / faction) · crumble: disintegrating into minute friable particles (cookie / masonry / empire) · fragment: breaking up into discrete, disparate sub-units (society / market / population) · fall apart: complete structural collapse through weakness (machinery / marriage / plan)
groups.nuance_zh: fracture: 承压开裂或结构性断裂 (bone / rock / alliance) · splinter: 顺纹崩解出尖锐细片 (wood / bone / faction) · crumble: 酥化粉解为碎屑 (cookie / masonry / empire) · fragment: 碎裂并解构为割裂的子单元 (society / market / population) · fall apart: 因内在脆弱而彻底散架瘫痪 (machinery / marriage / plan)

groups.name: Fret & Preoccupy · 担忧与挂虑 (Worry, Concern, Fret)
groups.tip: 因不确定性而引发的焦虑不安

items.def_zh: 使担忧，使挂念；涉及，与……有关
items.def_en: 1. To make someone feel worried, anxious, or troubled. 2. To relate to, affect, or be about something.
items.ex_en: The sudden volatility in international crude oil prices greatly concerns financial analysts.
items.ex_zh: 国际原油价格的突然波动令金融分析师深感担忧。

items.def_zh: 使担忧，使发愁；担忧，发愁；撕咬
items.def_en: 1. To feel anxious or troubled about actual or potential problems, or cause someone to feel this way. 2. To repeatedly bite or shake something with the teeth.
items.ex_en: She began to worry about her daughter walking home alone in the dark.
items.ex_zh: 她开始为女儿独自在黑暗中走回家而担忧发愁。

items.def_en: to cause someone mental disquiet, grief, or persistent anxiety
items.ex_en: These recurring budget deficits trouble the board members deeply every single quarter.
items.ex_zh: 这些反复出现的预算赤字每个季度都让董事会成员深感烦恼与不安。

items.def_zh: 使心烦，使担忧；打扰，打扰别人；操心，费事
items.def_en: 1. To make someone feel worried, annoyed, or anxious. 2. To disturb, interrupt, or trouble someone. 3. To take the time or trouble to do something.
items.ex_en: Does it bother you that we will have to reschedule our appointment?
items.ex_zh: 我们不得不重新安排会面时间，这会让你感到心烦或困扰吗？

items.def_en: to interfere with someone's peace of mind, causing anxiety or unease
items.ex_en: Strange nocturnal scratching noises in the attic began to disturb her peace of mind.
items.ex_zh: 阁楼里夜间奇怪的抓刮声开始扰乱她的心绪，让她深感不安。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) worry constantly or brood anxiously about an ongoing or potential problem
items.ex_en: He continues to fret about minor logistical details instead of focusing on strategy.
items.ex_zh: 他一直在为细枝末节的后勤问题烦躁忧虑，而不是专注于战略。

items.def_en: (+ sb) cause continuous emotional distress or persistent, gnawing worry to someone
items.ex_en: The unresolved guilt continued to eat away at him for years.
items.ex_zh: 那份未解的内疚感多年来持续折磨着他的内心。

items.def_zh: 使人忧心忡忡，沉重压在心头
items.def_en: (+ sb) make someone feel anxious, burdened, or persistently troubled
items.ex_en: The grave responsibility of leading the expedition began to weigh on him heavily.
items.ex_zh: 领导远征队的沉重责任开始像重担一样沉重地压在他的心头。

items.def_en: (+ about/over) to be constantly anxious and agitated about something
items.ex_en: There is really no reason to fret over things beyond your immediate control.
items.ex_zh: 为那些超出你直接控制范围的事情发愁苦恼实在毫无意义。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to feeling or causing anxious mental unease about real or anticipated troubles, spanning introspective brooding (fret), gentle interpersonal unease (concern), and intrusive distress (trouble).
groups.summary_zh: 对实际或预期的负面事由产生心神不安、挂念或困扰。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe cognitive or affective distress actively gnawing at one's peace of mind, contrasting with static 'fear' through persistent preoccupation and psychological friction.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指持续侵蚀心神、引发烦躁与不安的认知与情绪状态，区别于静态的“恐惧”，侧重思绪反复受扰与内耗。
groups.nuance_en: worry: active mental dwelling on potential misfortune (parent / future / health) · fret about: restless, visible agitation over minor matters (details / appearance / delay) · weigh on: oppressive psychological burden pressing down over time (conscience / guilt / mind) · eat away at: corrosive, chronic emotional depletion (remorse / doubt / anxiety) · concern: intellectual or compassionate unease (trend / welfare / development)
groups.nuance_zh: worry: 针对潜在祸患的主动焦虑与思虑 (parent / future / health) · fret about: 为琐事焦躁不安且形于外 (details / appearance / delay) · weigh on: 心理重负长期沉重压迫 (conscience / guilt / mind) · eat away at: 负面思绪像毒素般持续噬咬内心 (remorse / doubt / anxiety) · concern: 出于理性或关怀引发的关切担忧 (trend / welfare / development)

groups.name: Frolic & Play · 嬉戏与戏闹 (Boisterous / Carefree Play)
groups.tip: 无拘无束地嬉闹打闹作乐

items.def_en: engage in playful, silly, or boisterous activity purely for amusement
items.ex_en: The mischievous boys fool around in the backyard instead of completing their chores.
items.ex_zh: 淘气的男孩们在后院嬉戏胡闹，而不是去完成他们的家务。

items.def_en: spend time playing or behaving playfully without any serious intention
items.ex_en: Quit messing around in the kitchen and help me set the dining table.
items.ex_zh: 别在厨房里瞎闹了，快来帮我摆好餐桌。

items.def_en: to run, jump, or skip playfully, typically used of animals or young children
items.ex_en: Young lambs gambolled playfully across the lush green meadow in early spring.
items.ex_zh: 初春时节，幼小的羊羔在郁郁葱葱的绿草地上欢快地雀跃蹦跳。

items.def_zh: 嬉戏，闹着玩（常与 about 或 around 连用）
items.def_en: (informal, lark about/around) To behave in a silly, playful, or mischievous way.
items.ex_en: The boys spent the entire afternoon larking around by the abandoned quarry.
items.ex_zh: 男孩们整个下午都在废弃采石场旁嬉戏打闹、寻欢作乐。

items.def_en: to play and move about happily, quickly, and energetically
items.ex_en: Golden retriever puppies frolicked joyfully in the freshly fallen autumn leaves.
items.ex_zh: 金毛幼犬在刚落下的秋叶堆里欢闹嬉戏、四处奔跳。

items.def_en: (dated) To play around noisily and mischievously for fun.
items.ex_en: Sailors were skylarking in the ship rigging during their brief off-duty hours.
items.ex_zh: 水手们在短暂的下班时间里在船帆缆绳间吵吵闹闹地嬉戏戏耍。

items.def_en: engage in rough, noisy, or energetic physical play
items.ex_en: The teenagers horse around constantly, knocking over lamps and breaking cheap ornaments.
items.ex_zh: 那些青少年整天打闹喧闹，撞翻台灯，还打破了廉价摆件。

items.def_en: to play about roughly, boisterously, and energetically
items.ex_en: The energetic children romped through the playground until the evening bells rang.
items.ex_zh: 精力充沛的孩子们在操场上尽情蹦跳打闹，直到晚钟敲响。

items.def_en: to jump or dance around excitedly and exuberantly, often in an uninhibited manner
items.ex_en: Costumed revellers cavorted wildly down the illuminated streets during the annual carnival.
items.ex_zh: 身着奇装异服的狂欢者在年度狂欢节上沿着灯火辉煌的街道肆意欢跃舞动。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict moving, running, or playing about in a carefree, spirited, or mischief-making manner, varying from energetic gamboling to rebellious prankish antics.
groups.summary_zh: 欢快跳跃、无拘无束地嬉戏或淘气打闹，体现嬉戏的方式与动感。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame signify boisterous, lighthearted, and unstructured physical diversion, contrasting with rule-bound 'competing' or serious 'practicing' through exuberant, aimless merriment.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指喧闹、欢跃且缺乏既定规则的肢体嬉戏，区别于受规则约束的“竞技”或严肃练习，强调无拘无束的喧闹与放纵。
groups.nuance_en: frolic: lighthearted, graceful, and carefree romping (lamb / child / kitten) · romp: spirited, boisterous, and physically vigorous tumbling (puppy / dog / toddler) · gambol: playful leaping and skipping denoting youthful innocence (lamb / fawn / dancer) · horse around: crude, noisy, and potentially disruptive roughhousing (teenager / boy / classmate) · lark: mischievous, adventurous merrymaking (youth / student / rascal)
groups.nuance_zh: frolic: 轻松欢快、无忧无虑的跃跃嬉游 (lamb / child / kitten) · romp: 充满活力的大闹腾与翻滚 (puppy / dog / toddler) · gambol: 活泼天真地蹦蹦跳跳 (lamb / fawn / dancer) · horse around: 喧闹粗野、易出格的推搡胡闹 (teenager / boy / classmate) · lark: 淘气冒险且略带调皮的玩闹 (youth / student / rascal)

groups.name: Froth & Billow · 起泡与鼓胀 (Foam, Belly, Billow)
groups.tip: 体积向外鼓出膨大

items.def_en: swell outward or cause something to swell or billow with air or wind
items.ex_en: A sudden gust of wind puffed out the curtains into the bedroom.
items.ex_zh: 一阵突如其来的阵风吹拂，使窗帘向卧室里面鼓胀开来。
items.ex2_en: The massive ship sails puffed out dramatically when the sudden ocean gale struck.
items.ex2_zh: 突如其来的海上大风袭来时，巨大的船帆剧烈鼓起。

items.def_zh: 起泡沫，泛起泡沫；（口角）吐白沫；大怒
items.def_en: 1. To produce or form a mass of small bubbles on the surface of a liquid. 2. To have foam come out of the mouth, or be extremely angry.
items.ex_en: The agitated chemical solution began to foam rapidly inside the glass beaker.
items.ex_zh: 受到搅动的化学溶液在玻璃烧杯内迅速泛起大量泡沫。

items.def_en: [I/T] to produce or gather a mass of small bubbles on a liquid surface
items.ex_en: Steam wand gently froths cold milk into thick, velvety foam for cappuccino.
items.ex_zh: 蒸汽棒轻轻地将冷牛奶打起丰富泡沫，制成制作卡布奇诺的浓厚绵密奶泡。
items.ex2_en: The warm bath water frothed luxuriously as fragrant lavender soap was added.
items.ex2_zh: 加入芳香的薰衣草皂后，温热的洗澡水泛起了奢华的泡沫。

items.def_en: to give off bubbles of gas as a chemical liquid swells and fizzes
items.ex_en: The calcium tablet began to effervesce vigorously when dropped into warm water.
items.ex_zh: 钙片掉入温水中后，立即开始剧烈嘶嘶冒泡并释放出气体。

items.def_en: expand or billow outward under the force of wind or gas pressure
items.ex_en: Strong internal pressure caused the heavy canvas tent to blow out noticeably.
items.ex_zh: 强大的内部气压导致厚重的帆布帐篷明显向外鼓胀凸起。

items.def_en: produce a frothy layer of bubbles that swells and spills over the rim of a container
items.ex_en: The boiling herbal brew foamed over the rim of the stainless saucepan.
items.ex_zh: 沸腾的草药汤起泡翻滚，溢出了不锈钢炖锅的边缘。

items.def_en: 1. (+ out) To swell out or cause something (such as a sail) to swell outward with air or pressure. 2. (informal) To crawl forward on one's belly.
items.ex_en: The spinnaker bellying out in the gale propelled the yacht forward quickly.
items.ex_zh: 大三角帆在大风中高高鼓起，推动帆船迅速向前疾驰。
items.ex2_en: A stiff sea breeze bellied the canvas sails as the schooner departed harbor.
items.ex2_zh: 纵帆船离港时，强劲的海风将帆布船帆吹得鼓胀起来。

items.def_zh: 鼓起，如波浪般翻腾涌起
items.def_en: to swell outward or rise in large rolling, wave-like masses of fabric or smoke
items.ex_en: Thick black smoke billowed majestically from the chimney of the ancient foundry.
items.ex_zh: 浓密翻滚的黑烟如巨浪般从古老铸造厂的烟囱中翻腾涌出。

items.def_zh: 如气球般鼓胀，急剧膨胀
items.def_en: (+ out) to swell out or puff up rapidly in spherical fullness
items.ex_en: His waterproof jacket ballooned out dramatically as the coastal squall struck him.
items.ex_zh: 当海滨飑风袭来时，他的防水夹克瞬间像气球一样急剧鼓胀开来。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this manner frame capture dynamic swelling characterized by bubbly effervescence or aerated curvature (like sails or curtains filling with wind). They foreground the specific physical texture of bubbling or curved out-pocketing.
groups.summary_zh: 特指如波涛泛起泡沫般膨胀，或如风帆、布料受气流充斥向外鼓起膨出。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame express convex swelling, aeration, or bubbling outward caused by internal fluid pressure or gas, contrasting with simple 'expanding' by emphasizing frothy surface turbulence or billowing contours.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指流体或气体由内向外顶托导致的翻滚起泡或鼓胀隆起，区别于平缓的“膨胀”，强调表面泛泡的湍动或大面积鼓起的轮廓。
groups.nuance_en: froth: producing a mass of fine, turbulent bubbles (milk / beer / mouth) · foam: generating dense, soapy, or churning bubbly substance (wave / sea / detergent) · billow: swelling or undulating outward in massive rolling folds (sail / smoke / curtain) · belly: bulging convexly under lateral pressure (sail / sailcloth / shirt) · effervesce: releasing lively, hissing gas bubbles (champagne / soda / solution)
groups.nuance_zh: froth: 产生细密翻滚的白色泡沫 (milk / beer / mouth) · foam: 液体翻腾形成浓密黏聚之沫 (wave / sea / detergent) · billow: 呈巨幅波浪状层层向外鼓胀翻滚 (sail / smoke / curtain) · belly: 在风力推顶下向外鼓起大肚 (sail / sailcloth / shirt) · effervesce: 液体内部欢快析出细碎汽泡并滋滋作响 (champagne / soda / solution)

groups.name: Fulfill & Discharge Obligations · 履行与践行 (Fulfill, Discharge, Honor)
groups.tip: 顺利达成预定目标与职责

items.def_zh: 信守，践行（诺言、协议或支票）
items.def_en: To respect and keep a commitment, contract, or promise
items.ex_en: Both sovereign nations agreed to honor all terms of the historic treaty.
items.ex_zh: 两个主权国家均同意恪守并履行该历史性条约的所有条款。

items.def_zh: 满足，符合（要求、条件、规定）
items.def_en: To meet the requirements, conditions, or standards demanded
items.ex_en: The new commercial building must satisfy all municipal fire safety regulations completely.
items.ex_zh: 该新建商业楼宇必须完全满足所有市政消防安全规范。

items.def_en: To succeed in doing or completing something successfully.
items.ex_en: Through relentless perseverance, she accomplished her lifelong goal of summiting Mount Everest.
items.ex_zh: 凭借不懈的毅力，她成功达成了登顶珠穆朗玛峰的毕生目标。

items.def_en: (+ sth) fulfill an obligation, pledge, or expectation to the expected standard
items.ex_en: The concert didn't quite live up to our high expectations.
items.ex_zh: 这场音乐会并没能完全达到我们很高的期望。

items.def_en: (+ sth) remain faithful to and uphold a promise, agreement, or decision
items.ex_en: I will stand by my decision regardless of public criticism.
items.ex_zh: 无论外界如何批评，我都会坚持自己的决定。

items.def_en: (+ sth) successfully carry out a promise or repay a debt or obligation
items.ex_en: The contractor promised to make good on his commitment to rebuild the roof.
items.ex_zh: 承包商承诺一定兑现重修屋顶的诺言。

items.def_zh: 履行，履行（职责、债务、法律义务）
items.def_en: To perform or satisfy a formal duty, responsibility, or legal debt
items.ex_en: The executor has a strict legal obligation to discharge all estate duties faithfully.
items.ex_zh: 遗嘱执行人负有忠实履行所有遗产相关法定职责的严格法律义务。

items.def_zh: 履行，完成（职责、承诺）；实现（愿望、目标）；满足（要求、条件）
items.def_en: To do or achieve what was promised, required, or expected; to satisfy or meet a condition or need.
items.ex_en: The company strives to fulfill customer orders within twenty-four hours of receipt.
items.ex_zh: 该公司力求在收到客户订单后的二十四小时内完成交付履行。

items.def_en: To fulfill or carry out a pledge, promise, or obligation
items.ex_en: The newly elected governor worked diligently to redeem her core campaign pledge.
items.ex_zh: 新当选的州长勤勉工作，以践行其核心竞选承诺。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe satisfying binding duties, promises, conditions, or expectations set by contracts, moral codes, or formal roles. While 'accomplish' stresses bringing a planned task to a successful close, 'fulfill' and related verbs specifically emphasize meeting pre-existing obligations or requirements.
groups.summary_zh: 强调按规定、誓约或责任要求，圆满履行义务、践约或满足条件。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote bringing pledges, standards, or moral expectations into full factual reality, contrasting with mere 'obeying' by underscoring ethical fidelity and vindication.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指将承诺、契约或期望完全付诸实现并证明其价值，区别于被动的“听从”，侧重信义的践行与期望的圆满达成。
groups.nuance_en: fulfill: realizing promises or reaching expected benchmarks completely (prophecy / dream / contract) · honor: upholding commitments with integrity and deference (pledge / agreement / check) · satisfy: meeting specific external criteria or demands sufficiently (requirement / condition / debt) · live up to: matching an elevated standard, expectation, or reputation (standard / expectation / name) · discharge: fully settling a binding duty or liability (debt / obligation / trust)
groups.nuance_zh: fulfill: 使诺言、愿望或契约完全变为现实 (prophecy / dream / contract) · honor: 恪守信义、予以承兑或照办 (pledge / agreement / check) · satisfy: 充分达到或符合客观标准条件 (requirement / condition / debt) · live up to: 达到不负盛名、契合期望的高标准 (standard / expectation / name) · discharge: 彻底清结并卸除法定责任或负债 (debt / obligation / trust)

groups.name: Fulfill & Discharge Obligations · 履行职责与义务 (Execute, Perform, Honor)
groups.tip: 按约定或职责付诸实行

items.def_en: to carry out a required task, ceremony, or official duty
items.ex_en: The military honor guard performed its ceremonial duties with remarkable solemnity.
items.ex_zh: 仪仗队以高度的庄严感履行了其官方礼仪职责。

items.def_en: to keep a promise or fulfill the terms of an agreement
items.ex_en: The reputable shipping corporation honors all terms of maritime transit contracts unconditionally.
items.ex_zh: 这家信誉卓著的航运公司无条件信守海上运输合同的所有条款。

items.def_zh: 执行，贯彻（法令、计划或职务）
items.def_en: to carry out fully or perform a formal order, contract, or legal duty
items.ex_en: Federal agents were strictly mandated to execute the judicial search warrant immediately.
items.ex_zh: 联邦特工接到严格命令，必须立即执行这项司法搜查令。

items.def_zh: 实施，执行（命令、调查或职责）
items.def_en: to execute or complete a specific task, instruction, or duty
items.ex_en: The hospital is carrying out tests to determine the cause of the infection.
items.ex_zh: 医院正在进行检测，以查明感染原因。

items.def_en: (+ sth) complete or execute an action, duty, or commitment that one started or pledged to do
items.ex_en: Management firmly intends to follow through on its promised restructuring plans this winter.
items.ex_zh: 管理层坚定地打算在今年冬天贯彻落实其此前承诺的重组计划。

items.def_zh: 把……进行到底，坚持完成（任务、责任）
items.def_en: (+ sth) continue working on a duty, obligation, or undertaking until it is fully finished
items.ex_en: She resolved to see the challenging archaeological project through to its conclusion.
items.ex_zh: 她下定决心要把这项充满挑战的考古项目坚持完成到底。

items.def_zh: 遵照……行动，履行（指令、职责）
items.def_en: (+ sth) take direct action in accordance with instructions, duties, or advice
items.ex_en: Paramedics must act on physician directives immediately during critical emergency room interventions.
items.ex_zh: 在急诊室的关键抢救中，急救护理人员必须立即遵照医生的指令行动。

items.def_zh: 履行，执行（职责、诺言）；清偿（债务）；准许离开，释放，免职；排出，流出；放电
items.def_en: 1. To carry out or fulfill a duty, task, or obligation; to settle or pay off a debt. 2. To officially allow or order someone to leave a place (such as a hospital, prison, or military service). 3. To release or emit a liquid, gas, or electrical charge.
items.ex_en: The seasoned diplomat discharged her diplomatic functions with exceptional tact and grace.
items.ex_zh: 这位经验丰富的外交官以非凡的机智与优雅履行了自己的外交职责。

items.def_zh: 履行，实行（诺言、职责）；达到，实现（愿望、目标）；满足（要求、条件）
items.def_en: To carry out or do what is required, promised, or expected; to achieve or satisfy a desire, hope, or requirement.
items.ex_en: The organization works hard to fulfil its humanitarian mission in conflict regions.
items.ex_zh: 该组织竭尽全力在冲突地区践行并实现其人道主义使命。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe an agent meeting, completing, or carrying out formal duties, promises, contracts, or civic responsibilities. While 'fulfil' focuses on satisfying expectations or pledges, 'discharge' and 'execute' carry formal or legal weight in executing sworn duties.
groups.summary_zh: 强调按约定、法律或职责要求践行承诺、完成既定任务或义务。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote the procedural execution and completion of assigned roles, tasks, or mandates, contrasting with conceptual 'planning' by focusing on operative delivery and closure.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指把既定职责、法定义务或指派任务程序性地落实并画上句号，区别于前期的“谋划”，侧重操作层面的执行与完结。
groups.nuance_en: execute: technical, formal, and precise enactment of a plan or order (order / plan / maneuver) · discharge: lawful or formal release through fulfilling duties (responsibility / duty / function) · perform: enacting operative tasks, often before observers (procedure / surgery / task) · carry out: pragmatic, practical execution of instructions (investigation / survey / experiment) · follow through on: persevering until a committed initiative is fully realized (promise / threat / plan)
groups.nuance_zh: execute: 严谨、规范且具备法律效力地实施 (order / plan / maneuver) · discharge: 依法完结职责以卸除担子 (responsibility / duty / function) · perform: 履职操盘、展现过程性动作 (procedure / surgery / task) · carry out: 务实地将指令方案贯彻到底 (investigation / survey / experiment) · follow through on: 一抓到底、决不半途而废 (promise / threat / plan)

groups.name: Fund & Underwrite · 出资与承保 (Fund, Underwrite, Sponsor)
groups.tip: 提供融资支持并承担风险

items.def_en: to provide money for an event, activity, or project
items.ex_en: The philanthropic trust agreed to fund the university's cancer research program.
items.ex_zh: 该慈善信托基金同意出资资助这所大学的癌症研究项目。

items.def_en: to support an event or project financially, often in return for commercial publicity
items.ex_en: A local telecommunications giant volunteered to sponsor the annual international marathon tournament.
items.ex_zh: 一家当地电信巨头自愿赞助了一年一度的国际马拉松赛事。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) provide financial assistance or emergency capital to rescue an enterprise from collapse
items.ex_en: The government refused to bail out the reckless commercial airline with public funds.
items.ex_zh: 政府拒绝动用公共资金来紧急注资救助这家经营鲁莽的商业航空公司。

items.def_en: (+ sth) supply a sum of money required to finance a business, project, or venture
items.ex_en: Several angel investors put up initial seed capital for the promising biotech venture.
items.ex_zh: 几位天使投资人为这家极具前景的生物技术初创公司垫付了初始启动资金。

items.def_zh: 向……提供启动资金（或入股支持）
items.def_en: (+ sb) supply someone with financial capital or resources to establish a venture
items.ex_en: His wealthy uncle offered to stake out the ambitious entrepreneur in retail expansion.
items.ex_zh: 他富有的叔叔主动提出为这位雄心勃勃的企业家提供启动资金以拓展零售业务。

items.def_en: to pay part of the cost of something to keep the selling price low or ensure survival
items.ex_en: The regional administration continues to subsidize public commuter rail fares heavily.
items.ex_zh: 区域行政当局继续对公共通勤铁路票价给予巨额财政补贴。

items.def_zh: 为……再融资，重新筹资（以借新债还旧债）
items.def_en: to replace an existing loan or mortgage with a new one under different terms or interest rates
items.ex_en: The board resolved to refinance company debt to capitalize on lower interest rates.
items.ex_zh: 董事会决定为公司债务进行再融资，以充分利用更低的借贷利率。

items.def_zh: 承保，为……投保；包销（证券）；资助，为……提供资金担保
items.def_en: 1. (finance) to accept financial responsibility for an insurance policy, bond issue, or loan. 2. to support a project financially by agreeing to cover losses.
items.ex_en: Wealthy patrons agreed to underwrite the perilous voyage across the uncharted western seas.
items.ex_zh: 富有的赞助人同意为横渡未知西方海域的危险航行提供资金担保。

items.def_zh: 全额出资包揽，提供财务后盾
items.def_en: to supply all the necessary funds for an ambitious or risky venture
items.ex_en: His wealthy uncle agreed to bankroll the entire risky restaurant venture downtown.
items.ex_zh: 他富有的叔叔同意全额出资包揽市中心那家风险颇大的餐馆。

groups.summary_en: Actors in this commercial/financial frame provide capital, assume liability, or guarantee financial backing for an enterprise, loan, debt, or venture.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及金融机构或个人为项目、贷款或风险提供资金供给、责任承保或担保支持。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote providing financial capital, guarantees, or subsidies to sustain an enterprise, contrasting with routine 'buying' by highlighting risk-bearing patronage and fiscal backing.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指为某实体或项目提供资本、担保或无偿资助以促成其存续，区别于普通“购买”，强调承担风险的资本运作与财政背书。
groups.nuance_en: underwrite: assuming financial risk or guaranteeing capital liability (insurance / offering / loan) · fund: allocating direct capital for an operation or venture (research / project / startup) · subsidize: offsetting costs with partial institutional aid (industry / farming / housing) · bail out: rescuing a failing entity with emergency capital (bank / airline / economy) · sponsor: financing in exchange for promotional goodwill or social benefit (event / program / athlete)
groups.nuance_zh: underwrite: 承担底层财务风险或全额包销担保 (insurance / offering / loan) · fund: 为特定项目足额划拨运营资金 (research / project / startup) · subsidize: 官方或机构予以财政贴息减压 (industry / farming / housing) · bail out: 在破产危局时实施紧急注资救援 (bank / airline / economy) · sponsor: 出资赞助以换取名誉推广或公益价值 (event / program / athlete)

groups.name: Gamble & Risk · 赌博与投机 (Wager, Gamble, Speculate, Stake)
groups.tip: 下注押宝承担未知风险

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ on) to risk a sum of money against an outcome, such as the result of a race or match
items.ex_en: He decided to bet fifty dollars on the underdog in tonight's championship race.
items.ex_zh: 他决定在今晚的锦标赛中押五十美元在不被看好的一方身上。

items.def_zh: 下赌注，拿……冒险；资助；用桩支撑
items.def_en: 1. To risk money or something valuable on the result of an event, race, or competition. 2. To risk or jeopardize something important. 3. To support financially or with stakes.
items.ex_en: The reckless commander chose to stake his entire military fortune on one battle.
items.ex_zh: 这位鲁莽的指挥官选择把自己的整个军事前程押在一场战役上。

items.def_en: 1. To risk money on a game of chance or bet on the outcome of a race or event. 2. To take risks in the hope of achieving success or a favorable result.
items.ex_en: Investors should never gamble with money they cannot afford to lose completely.
items.ex_zh: 投资者绝不应该拿自己完全输不起的资金去冒险。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Risk money or resources on the outcome of a contest or uncertain event
items.ex_en: Many venture capitalists chose to bet on the success of the new battery.
items.ex_zh: 许多风险投资家选择把赌注押在新型电池的成功上。

items.def_zh: 就……冒险投机；在……上赌一把
items.def_en: (+ sth) Take a major risk in the hope of gaining an advantage from a particular outcome
items.ex_en: The board decided not to gamble on such an untested marketing strategy.
items.ex_zh: 董事会决定不在这种未经检验的营销策略上冒险一搏。

items.def_en: (+ sth on sth) Risk something valuable, such as money or reputation, on an uncertain result
items.ex_en: The scientist chose to stake his professional reputation on the radical new theory.
items.ex_zh: 这位科学家选择拿自己的专业声誉做赌注押在这一激进的新理论上。

items.def_en: to put something vital such as reputation or life at risk on a dangerous chance
items.ex_en: Few officers were willing to hazard their men on such an ill-conceived raid.
items.ex_zh: 几乎没有军官愿意冒着部下的生命危险去进行如此草率的突袭。

items.def_en: (+ in/on) to engage in risky financial transactions in the hope of making huge profit from market fluctuations
items.ex_en: He made an immense fortune after choosing to speculate in volatile tech shares.
items.ex_zh: 他在选择投机波动剧烈的科技股后发了一大笔横财。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ on/that) to risk a specific amount of money or valuable on an uncertain outcome (more formal than bet)
items.ex_en: He was willing to wager a substantial fortune on the election outcome.
items.ex_zh: 他愿意押上一大笔巨资来赌这场选举的结果。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame relate to wagering money, assets, or outcomes on uncertain events, spanning recreational gaming, calculated financial speculation, and existential risk-taking.
groups.summary_zh: 在不确定性情境下押上金钱、利益或命运进行博弈、投注与金融投机。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame signify committing tangible assets or prestige to an uncertain outcome in the hope of gain, contrasting with prudent 'investing' through high dependency on contingency and peril.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指将资产、声誉押注于不确定结局以博取收益，区别于稳健的“投资”，侧重对偶然运气的极高依赖与重大暴露风险。
groups.nuance_en: gamble: hazarding resources on uncertain, high-risk chances (future / money / career) · stake: pledging a specific valuable asset on an outcome (reputation / fortune / claim) · bet: pledging money on a predicted contingency (horse / outcome / team) · speculate: entering risky market transactions aiming for capital gain (market / stock / land) · hazard: exposing precious assets to imminent danger or jeopardy (life / guess / opinion)
groups.nuance_zh: gamble: 盲目下注或孤注一掷地博弈 (future / money / career) · stake: 压上切身核心利益作为筹码 (reputation / fortune / claim) · bet: 针对特定赛果或结局出资赌输赢 (horse / outcome / team) · speculate: 依仗行情波动进行的商业投机 (market / stock / land) · hazard: 冒着极高灭失危险亮出赌注或观点 (life / guess / opinion)

groups.name: Gather & Converge · 聚集与汇拢 (Flock, Converge, Congregate)
groups.tip: 从各方向成群涌向一点

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ around/to) to come together or bring people together for a concerted effort
items.ex_en: Supporters began to rally around the new candidate as the crucial vote approached.
items.ex_zh: 随着关键投票临近，支持者们开始集结在新人候选人周围。
items.ex2_en: The charismatic community leader rallied neighborhood volunteers to clean up the polluted park.
items.ex2_zh: 富有魅力的社区领袖召集邻里志愿者清理被污染的公园。

items.def_zh: 向…汇合，从四面八方涌向
items.def_en: to move toward and meet at a common destination or focal point
items.ex_en: Thousands of passionate demonstrators began to converge on the historic parliament building.
items.ex_zh: 数以千计慷慨激昂的示威者开始从四面八方涌向这座历史悠久的议会大厦。

items.def_zh: 蜂拥而至；成群结队走向
items.def_en: (+ sth) Move in large numbers toward a specific place or event
items.ex_en: Thousands of excited music lovers flock to the outdoor arena every single summer.
items.ex_zh: 每年夏天，成千上万兴奋的乐迷都会蜂拥至这个户外场馆。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Gather and enter a confined space together in very large numbers
items.ex_en: Frustrated commuters pushed forward to crowd into the packed subway carriage this morning.
items.ex_zh: 焦躁的通勤者今天早上拼命往前挤，涌入拥挤的地铁车厢。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Move into a place quickly and in immense, dense crowds like insects
items.ex_en: Eager bargain hunters swarm into the department store the moment doors slide open.
items.ex_zh: 大门刚刚滑开，急切抢购特价品的人潮便蜂拥涌入百货公司。

items.def_zh: 成群结队地去，蜂拥而至；聚集
items.def_en: (+ to/together) To go or gather together in large numbers.
items.ex_en: Hundreds of curious tourists flock together outside the palace gates every single morning.
items.ex_zh: 每天早晨，数以百计好奇的游客都会聚集在王宫门外。

items.def_en: (+ into/to) to move in large, dense, active multitudes
items.ex_en: Protesters began to swarm into the public square before the police arrived.
items.ex_zh: 在警察赶到之前，抗议者们已经成群结队地涌入公共广场。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To move toward or meet at the same point from different directions; to become more similar.
items.ex_en: Diplomats from across the continent converge upon the capital for vital peace negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 来自整个大陆的外交官齐聚首都，参加至关重要的和平谈判。

items.def_en: to come together in large numbers into a crowd or group
items.ex_en: Parishioners congregate outside the ancient stone chapel before Sunday morning services commence.
items.ex_zh: 教区居民在周日晨祷开始前聚集在古老的石砌小教堂外。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe multiple people, animals, or objects traveling from different directions toward a single focal point. They emphasize movement toward a shared location, ranging from organic gathering to focused geometric heading.
groups.summary_zh: 人或事物从各处朝单一目标汇聚、涌向特定地点。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe distributed entities migrating from distinct origins toward a shared focal point, contrasting with static 'gathering' through dynamic, targeted directional influx.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指原本分散的群体从四面八方向单一焦点运动并聚拢，区别于静态的“聚合”，侧重动态、带有明确趋向性的合流涌入。
groups.nuance_en: converge: moving from different directions to meet at a common node (road / opinion / crowd) · flock: mass movement of eager, like-minded people (fan / tourist / shopper) · swarm: chaotic, dense mass movement suggestive of insects (protester / bee / shopper) · crowd: pressing tightly into a confined perimeter (room / platform / street) · rally: reforming and assembling behind a collective cause (supporter / troop / market)
groups.nuance_zh: converge: 从不同路径朝同一汇聚点精准靠拢 (road / opinion / crowd) · flock: 如候鸟般心照不宣、成群结队蜂拥而至 (fan / tourist / shopper) · swarm: 如蜂群般密集、喧嚷且无序地涌入 (protester / bee / shopper) · crowd: 摩肩接踵挤占狭窄空间 (room / platform / street) · rally: 闻风响应号召、重整旗鼓大集结 (supporter / troop / market)

groups.name: Gleam & Sparkle · 闪烁与闪耀 (Flicker, Shimmer, Glitter)
groups.tip: 光芒细碎跳跃忽明忽暗

items.def_en: To shine or burn with an unsteady, wavering light; to appear briefly or faintly.
items.ex_en: The dying candle flame began to flicker weakly in the chilly night breeze.
items.ex_zh: 在冰冷的晚风中，微弱的烛火开始摇曳闪烁。

items.def_zh: 闪烁，闪闪发光；（眼睛）闪亮，露出笑意
items.def_en: To shine with quick, small flashes of light; (of eyes) to shine with pleasure or amusement.
items.ex_en: His lively eyes began to twinkle with genuine amusement at her witty remark.
items.ex_zh: 听到她机智的妙语，他生动的双眼泛起了会心的笑意。

items.def_zh: 闪烁，微微发亮，泛起微光
items.def_en: To shine with a soft, slightly wavering or trembling light.
items.ex_en: The calm lake waters seemed to shimmer softly beneath the pale full moon.
items.ex_zh: 平静的湖水在苍白的满月下泛起柔和的微光。

items.def_en: To shine with a sparkling or reflective light, especially from a wet or oily surface.
items.ex_en: Fresh droplets of morning dew glisten brightly upon the delicate rose petals.
items.ex_zh: 清晨的新鲜露珠在娇嫩的玫瑰花瓣上闪烁着晶莹的光芒。

items.def_en: (+ sth) emit a radiant or intermittent stream of bright light
items.ex_en: The coastal lighthouse continued to beam out bright light through the thick fog.
items.ex_zh: 海岸边的灯塔继续透过浓雾辐射出明亮的光芒。

items.def_en: reflect light in sudden bright or brilliant gleams
items.ex_en: Hearing the siren made his mind flash back to the day of the explosion.
items.ex_zh: 听到警报声，他的思绪一下子闪回到了爆炸发生的那一天。

items.def_en: To shine brightly with many small, quick flashes of reflected light.
items.ex_en: Her elegant evening dress seemed to glitter brightly under the dazzling chandelier lights.
items.ex_zh: 她优雅的晚礼服在耀眼的水晶吊灯下闪烁着夺目的光芒。

items.def_en: to give out brief, sharp flashes of reflected light from a hard surface
items.ex_en: The sharp blade began to glint menacingly in the dim cellar light.
items.ex_zh: 锋利的刀刃在昏暗的地窖光线下闪现出一丝令人不安的寒光。

items.def_zh: 闪耀，闪闪发光（明亮锐利）
items.def_en: to shine brightly with points of flashing light through refraction or reflection
items.ex_en: The diamond ring seemed to sparkle with exceptional brilliance under the jewelry display.
items.ex_zh: 那枚钻戒在珠宝展柜下折射出格外绚丽耀眼的光芒。

groups.summary_en: A light source or reflective surface emits unstable, intermittent, or reflected luminescence. Distinctions turn on whether the optical effect is wavering and faint (flicker), soft on wet/smooth surfaces (shimmer, glisten), or sharp and brilliant (glitter, sparkle).
groups.summary_zh: 光源或反光面呈现微弱颤动、温润泛光或耀眼折射。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe emitting brief, unsteady, or reflected light, contrasting with continuous 'shining' through intermittent intensity, surface modulation, or optical wavering.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指光线呈现出短暂、闪动或依托表面折射的状态，区别于平稳长明的“发光”，强调光芒的明灭跃动与质感细节。
groups.nuance_en: glimmer: faint, wavering, emergent luminous glow (hope / dawn / lantern) · shimmer: soft, trembling, tremulous reflected glow across a surface (silk / heat / water) · glisten: moist, slick reflection from a wet or polished exterior (sweat / tear / dew) · glitter: bright, hard, sparkling flashes from faceted points (diamond / gold / eye) · flicker: unstable, fluttering, rapidly extinguishing light (flame / shadow / candle)
groups.nuance_zh: glimmer: 微弱若隐若现、透着生机的一线微光 (hope / dawn / lantern) · shimmer: 如波光绸缎般柔和颤动的碎光 (silk / heat / water) · glisten: 潮湿或油亮表面映出的反光 (sweat / tear / dew) · glitter: 坚硬刻面折射出的冷艳夺目星芒 (diamond / gold / eye) · flicker: 摇曳不定、明灭不休的颤颤火苗 (flame / shadow / candle)

groups.name: Govern & Steer Operations · 掌控与督导 (Manage, Mismanage, Direct)
groups.tip: 协调运作或暗中操控

items.def_zh: 主持，实施（管理运作过程）
items.def_en: to organize and carry out a particular activity, inquiry, or operational procedure
items.ex_en: The independent committee will conduct a formal inquiry into the company's financial practices.
items.ex_zh: 独立委员会将对该公司的财务运作展开正式调查。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Mishandle or mismanage an affair, operation, or plan so that it fails
items.ex_en: The careless new manager managed to mess up the entire shipping schedule completely.
items.ex_zh: 那个粗心的新经理把整个发货日程彻底搞得一团糟。

items.def_zh: 挥霍尽；败光（资源或资金）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Wastefully or carelessly exhaust a supply of money, resources, or estate
items.ex_en: The foolish heir managed to run through his entire trust fund in months.
items.ex_zh: 那个愚蠢的继承人竟然在几个月内把自己的整笔信托基金挥霍殆尽。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Assume managerial control or administrative direction of an operation or organization
items.ex_en: The senior partner will take over the struggling branch starting next Monday morning.
items.ex_zh: 高级合伙人将从下周一早晨开始正式接管这家陷入困境的分部。

items.def_en: to supervise, govern, or control the operations, staff, or course of an organization
items.ex_en: A seasoned director was hired to direct the operational strategy of the firm.
items.ex_zh: 公司聘请了一位经验丰富的总监来领导公司的运营策略。

items.def_zh: 管理，掌管；设法做到，应付；控制，操纵
items.def_en: 1. To be in charge of or run a business, organization, or project. 2. To succeed in doing or dealing with something difficult. 3. To control or manipulate someone or something.
items.ex_en: She was chosen to manage the international expansion project for the retail chain.
items.ex_zh: 她被选中负责掌管该零售连锁品牌的国际扩张项目。

items.def_en: to manage and be responsible for the running of a business, institution, or legal affairs
items.ex_en: Trustees were officially appointed to administer the charitable foundation's considerable financial assets.
items.ex_zh: 受托人被正式任命负责管理该慈善基金会数额庞大的资产。

items.def_en: To manage or handle a situation, organization, or resource badly or incompetently.
items.ex_en: Incompetent executives continue to mismanage the vital pension funds of hardworking employees.
items.ex_zh: 无能的高管们继续处置不善，挥霍勤劳员工赖以生存的养老基金。

items.def_zh: 精心策划并调度，协调操办
items.def_en: to arrange, plan, and direct a complex situation or event to achieve a desired result
items.ex_en: The senior strategist worked tirelessly to orchestrate the complex corporate merger seamlessly.
items.ex_zh: 资深策略师不知疲倦地工作，以精心协调调度这场复杂的企业并购。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame relate to the systematic control, administration, and executive direction of resources, organizations, or affairs. The manner ranges from competent orchestration to neglectful blundering.
groups.summary_zh: 主导、调控与组织人力、事务或机构的日常运转。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote regulating, steering, and deploying organizational resources to keep operations functional, contrasting with abstract 'leading' through practical coordination and procedural control.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指调度资源、协调流程以维持组织机构正常运转的业务管控，区别于宏观务虚的“领导”，强调具体的运营打理与程序掌舵。
groups.nuance_en: administer: routine institutional execution of rules and operations (estate / justice / program) · manage: day-to-day coordination of personnel, budgets, and operational friction (budget / business / team) · direct: authoritative technical or artistic steering (traffic / film / operation) · mismanage: squandering resources through inept supervision (economy / crisis / funds) · conduct: regulating the formal procedure of an inquiry or business (inquiry / experiment / orchestra)
