groups.nuance_zh: administer: 依章程推行程序化政务与业务管理 (estate / justice / program) · manage: 在资源约束下搞定具体人财物运营 (budget / business / team) · direct: 具有绝对定夺权的专业指挥与导向 (traffic / film / operation) · mismanage: 因无能或疏失致使管理崩盘 (economy / crisis / funds) · conduct: 主持并推进严肃调查、仪式或试验 (inquiry / experiment / orchestra)

groups.name: Govern, Regulate & Oversee · 治理、立法与监督 (Govern, Legislate, Oversee)
groups.tip: 行使公权力进行立法治理

items.def_en: [I/T] to conduct the policy, actions, and affairs of a state, organization, or people with authoritative direction
items.ex_en: The newly elected council must govern the restless province with justice and wisdom.
items.ex_zh: 新当选的委员会必须以公正和智慧来治理这个动荡不安的省份。

items.def_en: to control or maintain the rate or speed of a process or supervise by means of rules and regulations
items.ex_en: The central agency was created to regulate emission standards across heavy industrial plants.
items.ex_zh: 该中央机构的设立旨在管控重工业工厂的排放标准。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Exercise sovereign political authority or administrative dominion over a people or realm
items.ex_en: The emperor sought to rule over his sprawling empire with absolute unquestioned power.
items.ex_zh: 皇帝试图以不容置疑的绝对权力统领他那辽阔的帝国。

items.def_zh: 主持；掌管（体制、委员会或时期）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Hold formal institutional authority over a meeting, system, or transformative era
items.ex_en: The respected judge will preside over the contentious high-profile constitutional tribunal tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 受人尊敬的法官明天将主持这场备受瞩目且充满争议的宪法法庭审理。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Enforce strict regulatory or police measures against illicit conduct or violators
items.ex_en: The police announced a new campaign to crack down on reckless driving.
items.ex_zh: 警方宣布开展一项新行动，严厉打击危险驾驶行为。

items.def_en: to manage and be responsible for the running of a business, organization, or system of laws
items.ex_en: Civil servants must faithfully administer the nation's environmental protection statutes without bias.
items.ex_zh: 公务人员必须公正无私地忠实执行国家的环境保护法律。

items.def_en: 1. To watch over and direct people, work, or activities to make sure they are done correctly and safely.
items.ex_en: Senior foremen are assigned to supervise construction work and enforce rigorous safety protocols.
items.ex_zh: 资深领班被指派监督施工现场并强制执行严格的安全规程。

items.def_en: to watch over and manage an activity or workers, especially in an official supervisory role
items.ex_en: A senior inspector was appointed to oversee the complex audit of government expenditures.
items.ex_zh: 一名高级审计官被任命监管这项复杂的政府开支审查工作。

items.def_zh: 制定法律，立法；通过立法规定（或实现）
items.def_en: 1. To make or pass laws. 2. To bring about, determine, or control something by passing laws.
items.ex_en: Parliament intends to legislate against hazardous emissions produced by heavy chemical factories.
items.ex_zh: 议会打算通过立法来制约重化工企业排放有害废气的行为。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote institutional actions that steer public affairs, establish statutory frameworks, enforce compliance, or exercise administrative oversight over organizations and citizens.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖立法立规、行政管理及合规监管等国家与社会治理行为。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe the exercise of sovereign, regulatory, or institutional power over individuals or jurisdictions, contrasting with loose 'influencing' by emphasizing legitimate dominion and policing.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指行使主权、法规或监察权力以维系法治与秩序，区别于柔性的“影响”，强调具有强制力的统治、立规与监督。
groups.nuance_en: govern: authoritative systemic control over a polity or jurisdiction (nation / state / people) · regulate: adjusting commercial or legal conduct via codified limits (market / industry / price) · oversee: high-level observational scrutiny to ensure compliance (operation / transition / work) · preside over: occupying the sovereign seat or leading a formal proceeding (meeting / tribunal / court) · crack down on: harsh, coercive suppression of illicit activity (crime / dissent / corruption)
groups.nuance_zh: govern: 对政治实体施行全面的公权力治理 (nation / state / people) · regulate: 依据法条细则调控规范市场行为 (market / industry / price) · oversee: 居于上位进行全局视察与合规监督 (operation / transition / work) · preside over: 以首席或主席地位主持大局与典章 (meeting / tribunal / court) · crack down on: 动用雷霆手段依法实施铁腕镇压 (crime / dissent / corruption)

groups.name: Graphic Delineation & Visual Rendering · 绘制与描图 (Sketch, Graph, Cartoon)
groups.tip: 勾勒线条绘制图画形象

items.def_en: (+ sth) Delineate and render a formal visual plan, diagram, or blueprint
items.ex_en: The legal team drew up a comprehensive contract for the acquisition.
items.ex_zh: 法律团队为此次收购拟定了一份详尽的合同。

items.def_zh: 标绘；在坐标/图纸上标示出
items.def_en: (+ sth) Mark coordinates, paths, or points systematically on a chart or map
items.ex_en: The navigator worked carefully to plot out the vessel's precise oceanic coordinates.
items.ex_zh: 领航员仔细在海图上标绘出船只准确的航行坐标。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Draw a rough or preliminary outline of a picture or diagram quickly
items.ex_en: The architect began to sketch out preliminary floor plans for the new hospital.
items.ex_zh: 建筑师开始为新医院快速勾勒出初步的平面布局草图。

items.def_zh: 画素描，画速写，画草图；简述，概述
items.def_en: 1. To make a quick, rough drawing of someone or something without many details. 2. (often sketch out) To give a brief or general description of something.
items.ex_en: The street artist decided to sketch the bustling harbor from the wooden pier.
items.ex_zh: 街头艺术家决定在木制码头上素描熙熙攘攘的港口景象。

items.def_en: To draw a cartoon of someone or something, or to work as a cartoonist.
items.ex_en: Satirical illustrators often cartoon pompous politicians with grotesquely exaggerated facial expressions.
items.ex_zh: 讽刺插画家经常用极度夸张的面部表情把自命不凡的政客画成漫画。

items.def_zh: 用图表（或坐标图）表示，绘制图表
items.def_en: To plot or represent mathematical data, functions, or relationships on a graph or chart.
items.ex_en: The software allows researchers to graph complex economic fluctuations across several decades easily.
items.ex_zh: 该软件使研究人员能够轻松地将数十年来复杂的经济波动绘制成图表。

items.def_en: To mark coordinates or draw a curve on a graph or chart
items.ex_en: Engineers carefully plot the data points across the graph to track temperature shifts.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们在图表上仔细标绘数据点，以追踪温度的变化趋势。

items.def_en: To describe or portray the outline or exact form of something visually
items.ex_en: The draftsperson used fine ink lines to delineate the precise architectural structure visually.
items.ex_zh: 绘图员用细腻的墨线清晰勾勒出精细的建筑轮廓。

items.def_en: To represent in an exaggerated or distorted graphic depiction for comic effect
items.ex_en: The artist loved to caricature prominent ministers with ridiculous features in weekly periodicals.
items.ex_zh: 这位画家喜欢在周刊上把显赫的部长们画成滑稽夸张的讽刺形象。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on rendering shapes, concepts, or datasets visually onto a two-dimensional surface using drawing implements. The actions range from freehand preliminary outlining and satirical caricature to mathematically plotting coordinate functions.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过线条勾勒、图表绘制或讽刺漫画化等手段在平面上描绘。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame signify capturing physical forms or abstract schemas through visual, linear draftsmanship, contrasting with aesthetic 'painting' through emphasis on structural outlines, projection, and planning.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指用线条勾画、投影图表以呈现物象轮廓或规划方案，区别于色彩斑斓的“绘画”，强调骨架提炼、结构测绘与草图拟定。
groups.nuance_en: delineate: tracing crisp, exact boundary outlines or structural distinctions (border / character / scope) · sketch: making a rapid, preliminary, freehand visual representation (scene / portrait / idea) · plot: mathematically mapping points onto coordinates or formulating a schematic (curve / course / data) · graph: rendering functional relationships visually via charts (equation / trend / growth) · cartoon: exaggerating visual features satirically (politician / figure / subject)
groups.nuance_zh: delineate: 严整精细地勾勒轮廓线或界限 (border / character / scope) · sketch: 快速抓取神采特征的即兴草描 (scene / portrait / idea) · plot: 将数据点标定在坐标系中或测绘航线 (curve / course / data) · graph: 以折线图或数据图表形式直观呈现 (equation / trend / growth) · cartoon: 用夸张变形的漫画像手法描绘 (politician / figure / subject)

groups.name: Grasp & Clasp Tightly · 握持与紧抱 (Hold, Grasp, Clutch, Clasp)
groups.tip: 伸手牢牢抓紧或握住

items.def_en: (+ to sth/sb) keep a firm grip on something or someone
items.ex_en: You must hold on to the safety railing while descending the steep staircase.
items.ex_zh: 在走下陡峭的楼梯时，你必须紧紧抓住安全扶手。

items.def_en: (+ to sth/sb) grasp or hold something tightly for support or safety
items.ex_en: Hang on a second, let me grab a pen to write that down.
items.ex_zh: 稍等一下，我拿支笔把它记下来。

items.def_en: (+ to sth/sb) take hold of or attach oneself firmly onto someone or something
items.ex_en: The frightened kitten managed to latch on to my sweater with its claws.
items.ex_zh: 那只受惊的小猫用爪子死死抓牢了我的毛衣。

items.def_en: to hold something very tightly and securely with the hand
items.ex_en: The nervous driver continued to grip the steering wheel with sweaty white knuckles.
items.ex_zh: 紧张的司机继续用出汗发白的指节死死抓牢方向盘。

items.def_en: to hold someone or something tightly in your hands or arms
items.ex_en: She could only clasp his trembling hands tightly in the cold autumn gloom.
items.ex_zh: 在清冷的秋日暗影中，她只能紧紧握住他颤抖的双手。

items.def_en: (+ to sth/sb) hold on to something or someone with great effort or tenacity
items.ex_en: The stranded climber managed to cling on to the icy ledge until rescued.
items.ex_zh: 受困的登山者拼尽全力死死抓牢冰冷的岩壁凸起，直到获救。

items.def_en: 1. To take a firm hold of someone or something with your hand. 2. To completely understand a fact or an idea.
items.ex_en: The child rushed forward to grasp his mother's outstretched hand in the crowd.
items.ex_zh: 孩子从人群中冲上前去，紧紧抓住了母亲伸出的手。

items.def_zh: 抓紧，紧握；企图抓住（clutch at）
items.def_en: 1. To hold something tightly, usually because you are cold, frightened, or in pain. 2. (+ at) To try very hard to grab something.
items.ex_en: The shivering traveler managed to clutch the heavy woolen blanket tightly for warmth.
items.ex_zh: 冻得瑟瑟发抖的旅客紧紧裹住厚厚的羊毛毯以取暖。

items.def_en: (+ to) to hold on tightly to somebody or something, especially from fear or desperation
items.ex_en: Desperate survivors continued to cling to the capsized boat amid the heavy swells.
items.ex_zh: 绝望的幸存者们在汹涌的波涛中继续紧抓着倾覆的小船不放。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe taking hold of and maintaining a firm, tight, or anxious manual or bodily grip on an object or person.
groups.summary_zh: 用手或双臂牢固、紧密或因恐惧/保护欲而紧紧抓住并握持。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe securing an object or person with a forceful, tension-filled digital or bodily hold, contrasting with neutral 'touching' or 'holding' by highlighting compressive pressure and resistance to slipping.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指手指或肢体施加重压紧紧钳制目标以防脱落，区别于平淡的“触摸”或普通抓握，强调咬合般的加压与对抗脱离的紧张力。
groups.nuance_en: clasp: enclosing securely and tenderly with fingers or arms (hand / baby / amulet) · clutch: frantic, desperate grip driven by panic or pain (chest / purse / rail) · grip: firm, muscular, mechanical hold securing against slip (tool / handle / tennis racket) · grasp: assertive, deliberate closure of the hand around something (rope / throat / hand) · latch on: attaching tenaciously and locking onto an anchor point (nipple / concept / host)
groups.nuance_zh: clasp: 紧扣双合、稳妥且带着温情地抱持 (hand / baby / amulet) · clutch: 绝望、恐慌或痛苦促使下的死命抓抠 (chest / purse / rail) · grip: 肌肉灌注咬合力以防滑动的铁钳式握持 (tool / handle / tennis racket) · grasp: 目标明确、稳健迅速地一把抓取 (rope / throat / hand) · latch on: 如暗扣般紧紧咬合附着于锚点 (nipple / concept / host)

groups.name: Grieve & Mourn · 悲哀与悼念 (Sadden, Grieve, Mourn)
groups.tip: 内心极度悲痛并寄托哀思

items.def_zh: 憔悴消沉；因悲哀相思而衰弱
items.def_en: Become progressively weak and despondent through intense, prolonged grief or longing
items.ex_en: The grieving widow began to pine away in the silent, shadowed family estate.
items.ex_zh: 痛失挚爱的寡妇在那座寂静昏暗的家族庄园中日渐憔悴消沉。

items.def_en: (+ for/away) to become weak with intense, unfulfilled grief or longing
items.ex_en: The solitary exile would sit and pine for his lost homeland every evening.
items.ex_zh: 形单影只的流亡者每天傍晚都会枯坐着，为失去的故土哀思憔悴。

items.raw_cluster: 使悲伤与使忧伤 Sadden & Grieve
items.def_en: To make someone feel sad, unhappy, or sorrowful.
items.ex_en: Such tragic environmental reports never fail to sadden thoughtful conservationists across the country.
items.ex_zh: 如此悲惨的环境报告总是令全国深具远见的环保人士倍感痛心。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Experience or express profound sorrow over the death or tragic loss of someone
items.ex_en: The heartbroken community gathered solemnly to grieve for the fallen young rescue workers.
items.ex_zh: 心碎的社区居民庄严集会，共同哀悼那些牺牲的年轻救援人员。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Show solemn, outward bereavement and grief over a departed person
items.ex_en: The entire nation gathered in solemn silence to mourn for the fallen leader.
items.ex_zh: 全国人民肃穆静立，为逝世的领导人哀悼。

items.def_zh: 感到极度悲痛，哀悼；使悲痛，使伤心
items.def_en: 1. (+ for/over) To feel deep sadness, especially because someone has died. 2. To make someone feel very sad.
items.ex_en: She needed time to grieve alone after receiving the heartbreaking news.
items.ex_zh: 收到这个令人心碎的消息后，她需要时间独自哀悼。

items.def_en: [I/T] to express deep sorrow, regret, or grief for someone who died or for an unfortunate situation
items.ex_en: Historians lament the tragic loss of irreplaceable manuscripts destroyed in the fire.
items.ex_zh: 历史学家们痛惜在大火中被焚毁的不可替代的珍贵手稿。

items.def_zh: 哀悼，哀痛，悼念；感到痛惜
items.def_en: (+ for/over) To feel and express deep sorrow or grief, especially for someone who has died.
items.ex_en: Family members wore black as they gathered to mourn their beloved grandmother.
items.ex_zh: 家人身着黑衣聚集在一起，哀悼他们挚爱的祖母。

items.def_en: [I/T] to wail in high-pitched grief over a dead body, especially in traditional lamentation
items.ex_en: The grieving widows began to keen loudly over the fallen warrior's shroud.
items.ex_zh: 悲痛的遗孀们在阵亡勇士的寿衣旁放声号啕恸哭。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express profound psychological sorrow or ritualized bereavement over a death, tragic loss, or misfortune. 'Sadden' represents general despondency, 'grieve' conveys acute internal anguish, while 'mourn' and 'lament' signify formal, outward expressions of bereavement.
groups.summary_zh: 指因死亡或巨大不幸而产生的深切哀伤与外在悼念悼唁。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote manifesting profound sorrow, emotional desolation, or ritualized lament over loss, contrasting with transient 'sadness' by highlighting prolonged bereavement and conscious mourning.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指因永诀或重大丧失而在内心体验或仪式上表露出的深切哀恸，区别于短暂的“难过”，强调长期的心神碎裂与守丧悼念。
groups.nuance_en: mourn: expressing formal, deep-seated grief, often publicly or ritually (loss / death / casualty) · grieve: enduring acute internal psychological pain from bereavement (loss / child / parent) · lament: vocal, sorrowful decrying of misfortune or decline (fate / passing / decline) · pine: withering away slowly through yearning for the lost or absent (lover / home / past) · sadden: inducing or sinking into a state of quiet melancholy (news / departure / friend)
groups.nuance_zh: mourn: 遵循礼俗沉痛哀悼、志哀于公开死难 (loss / death / casualty) · grieve: 经历内心痛彻心扉的哀伤折磨 (loss / child / parent) · lament: 捶胸顿足般的悲叹与痛陈 (fate / passing / decline) · pine: 因刻骨思恋逝者或故地而日渐消瘦憔悴 (lover / home / past) · sadden: 令人心境低落、涌上几分清愁 (news / departure / friend)

groups.name: Grind & Pulverize · 研磨与粉碎 (Powder, Pulverize, Mill)
groups.tip: 施加外力碾压磨成细小粉末

items.def_zh: （使）成颗粒，（使）粉碎成粒状；使表面成粗粒状
items.def_en: 1. To form into grains, or reduce something into small grains or granules. 2. To give a granular surface or wood-grain finish to something.
items.ex_en: The machine helps grain the raw mineral into uniform particles for processing.
items.ex_zh: 这台机器有助于将矿物原料粉碎成均匀的颗粒以供加工。
items.ex2_en: The sweet syrup grained quickly into coarse crystals as it cooled down.
items.ex2_zh: 随着温度降低，甜糖浆迅速结晶形成了粗糙的颗粒。

items.def_en: to crush or grind a substance into powder using a pestle
items.ex_en: The apothecary carefully used a stone bowl to pestle the dried petals.
items.ex_zh: 药剂师小心翼翼地用石臼将风干的花瓣研磨成粉。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Press or smash a substance until it is completely reduced to fragments or powder
items.ex_en: Crush up the dried herbs finely before adding them to the stew.
items.ex_zh: 把干香草碾碎后再加入炖菜中。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Reduce solid matter to small particles or smooth its surface by friction
items.ex_en: He used a heavy stone to grind down the mineral into fine dust.
items.ex_zh: 他用一块重石头将矿物研磨成了细微的粉末。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Beat a solid repeatedly with a pestle or blunt implement until pulverized
items.ex_en: The chef used a heavy wooden mallet to pound down the spices.
items.ex_zh: 厨师用沉重的木槌把香料彻底捣碎成末。

items.def_en: to crush grain or other solid material into flour or powder in a mill
items.ex_en: The historic waterwheel continues to mill wheat into soft flour every morning.
items.ex_zh: 古老的水车每天清晨依旧持续运转，把小麦碾磨成松软的面粉。

items.def_zh: 研碎，磨成粉末；往……上撒粉，擦粉
items.def_en: 1. To crush or grind something into a fine powder, or become powder. 2. To apply powder to skin or sprinkle powder over something.
items.ex_en: The pharmacist used a marble mortar to powder the dry herbal tablets.
items.ex_zh: 药剂师用大理石臼将干燥的草药片研碎成粉。
items.ex2_en: The dry chalk powdered instantly when the heavy iron boot stepped on it.
items.ex2_zh: 当沉重的铁靴踩上去时，干燥的粉笔瞬间化成了粉末。

items.def_zh: 磨成细粉；研碎（专用于医药、科研等）
items.def_en: to grind or rub something to a very fine powder, especially in pharmacy or science
items.ex_en: The chemist prepared to triturate the crystalline compound into an impalpable powder.
items.ex_zh: 化学家准备将该结晶化合物研磨成极细的微粉。

items.def_en: to crush, grind, or pound something into fine powder or dust
items.ex_en: Just toss those stale crackers into the blender and pulverize them completely.
items.ex_zh: 直接把那些受潮的饼干扔进搅拌机里彻底打成碎末。

groups.summary_en: An agent mechanically reduces solid materials into fine particles, granules, or dust using friction, pressure, or machinery. Verbs distinguish between milling into coarse granules, pounding into impalpable dust, or pulverizing completely.
groups.summary_zh: 通过机械力将固体物质碾磨、粉碎成细粉或颗粒。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame signify subjecting solid substances to mechanical attrition, pounding, or shear to reduce them to minute grains, contrasting with simple 'cutting' through complete destructive comminution.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指运用机械挤压、碾磨或撞击将固态物料碎解为细碎粉末，区别于利刃的“切割”，强调粉碎性降解与颗粒极小化。
groups.nuance_en: grind down: wearing down or reducing into particles via heavy abrasive friction (grain / tooth / metal) · pulverize: completely obliterating into fine airborne powder or dust (rock / coal / defense) · mill: processing bulk grain or timber mechanically in industrial plants (wheat / grain / steel) · triturate: rubbing to extremely fine, intimate powder, as in pharmaceuticals (chemical / powder / herb) · pestle: crushing and grinding in a mortar (spice / herb / ingredient)
groups.nuance_zh: grind down: 经受持续沉重的磨料摩擦而损耗成粉 (grain / tooth / metal) · pulverize: 彻底击碎齑粉化、化作尘埃 (rock / coal / defense) · mill: 在工矿碾磨厂进行工业化加工 (wheat / grain / steel) · triturate: 医药级精细研和与超微粉碎 (chemical / powder / herb) · pestle: 用研杵在臼钵中手力捣碎 (spice / herb / ingredient)

groups.name: Guarantee & Ensure · 担保与确保 (Make Certain or Underwrite an Outcome)
groups.tip: 提供保证以杜绝意外风险

items.def_en: to succeed in obtaining or making certain that an outcome or asset is safe
items.ex_en: The administration implemented stringent measures to secure the stability of the power grid.
items.ex_zh: 管理部门实施了严格的措施以确保电网的稳定。

items.def_en: To make certain that something will happen or that something is safe and guaranteed.
items.ex_en: Rigorous quality controls ensure that all manufactured units meet the highest standards.
items.ex_zh: 严格的质量监控确保所有出厂产品均符合最高标准。

items.def_en: to promise formally that certain conditions will be fulfilled, or that a product has quality
items.ex_en: The manufacturer refuses to guarantee the performance of the device without proper installation.
items.ex_zh: 若未正确安装，制造商拒绝保证该设备的运行性能。

items.def_en: to tell someone something positively to dispel doubt; to make something certain
items.ex_en: The lead engineer sought to assure the committee that the structure was sound.
items.ex_zh: 首席工程师试图向委员会保证该建筑结构绝对稳固。

items.def_en: to officially attest to or guarantee that a fact, condition, or product is genuine
items.ex_en: The rare collector warrants the authenticity of the ancient royal seal.
items.ex_zh: 这位珍品收藏家正式为这枚古代皇家印章的真伪作保。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Deal with a matter so as to make absolutely certain that an action or outcome occurs
items.ex_en: Don't worry about the catering for the party; I'll see to it.
items.ex_zh: 别担心聚会的餐饮问题，我会负责照料妥当的。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Express certainty or personal guarantee concerning someone's integrity or accuracy
items.ex_en: My former supervisor agreed to vouch for my integrity during the security clearance.
items.ex_zh: 在前单位的安全审查中，我的前主管同意为我的品行作保。

items.def_zh: 锁定；确保获得（利率、条件）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Make an advantageous contractual term, rate, or outcome permanently secured
items.ex_en: Borrowers rushed to lock in low mortgage rates before the announced hike.
items.ex_zh: 借款人赶在宣布加息前抢先锁定较低的抵押贷款利率。

items.def_zh: 给……投保，承保；确保，保证（尤美，同 ensure）
items.def_en: 1. To buy or provide insurance for someone or something against loss, damage, or death. 2. (especially US) To make sure or certain that something happens.
items.ex_en: They decided to insure their seaside property against potential flood damage this autumn.
items.ex_zh: 他们决定在今年秋天为海边房产投保，以防潜在的洪水损失。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on establishing certainty, securing contractual indemnity, or guaranteeing a condition or outcome, differentiated by legal formality and operational directness.
groups.summary_zh: 确认结果必然发生或承担担保责任，涉及法律保障、商业承保到一般保证。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe taking decisive measures to eliminate contingency and make an outcome foolproof, contrasting with optimistic 'hoping' by introducing certainty, collateral, or contractual safeguards.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指采取铁板钉钉的排他手段消除偶然性、锁定确凿无疑的结果，区别于被动的“期望”，强调提供担保与万无一失。
groups.nuance_en: ensure: taking definitive, active steps to make an event certain to happen (safety / compliance / success) · guarantee: issuing a binding pledge or legal assurance of quality/outcome (loan / right / success) · warrant: providing justification or formal commercial certification of fitness (arrest / attention / product) · secure: getting firm possession or nailing down an outcome against loss (deal / border / victory) · lock in: definitively fixing parameters so they cannot be altered (rate / profit / gain)
groups.nuance_zh: ensure: 采取周密务实步骤确保结果必然发生 (safety / compliance / success) · guarantee: 提供法理契约担保或包退包换之诺 (loan / right / success) · warrant: 具备充分正当理由或出具品质明保 (arrest / attention / product) · secure: 扫除一切外围危险而稳稳锁定胜果 (deal / border / victory) · lock in: 彻底敲定锁定、防止出现任何回撤 (rate / profit / gain)

groups.name: Halt Activity & Forbear · 终止与罢手 (Cheese, Desist, Cease)
groups.tip: 动作暂时打住或彻底终结消退

items.def_zh: （航海或指令用语）停止，取消行动
items.def_en: nautical/colloquial: to cancel or halt an order or immediate ongoing activity
items.ex_en: Belay that last order immediately and hold your positions until dawn breaks.
items.ex_zh: 立刻取消方才的命令，原地待命直到黎明破晓。

items.def_en: (+ sth) stop doing something or discontinue an action
items.ex_en: Let us leave off arguing about money and enjoy our dinner together.
items.ex_zh: 我们别再为钱争吵了，好好一起吃顿晚饭吧。

items.def_zh: 停止；住手（常用于祈使句）
items.def_en: (+ sth) stop doing or saying something irritating or disruptive
items.ex_en: He decided to cut out caffeine completely to improve his sleep.
items.ex_zh: 为了改善睡眠，他决定彻底戒掉咖啡因。

items.def_en: (+ sth) stop doing something, especially an annoying or tiring activity or work
items.ex_en: Let's knock off for the day and grab some dinner together.
items.ex_zh: 我们今天就收工吧，一起去吃顿晚餐。

items.def_en: (+ sth) stop doing an activity, job, or annoying behavior
items.ex_en: He decided to pack in his office job to travel the world.
items.ex_zh: 他决定辞去办公室的工作去环游世界。

items.def_zh: 停止，罢休（尤用于命令句 cheese it）；使恼怒（cheese off）
items.def_en: (slang, chiefly imperative) To stop doing something, run away, or be quiet (especially in 'cheese it').
items.ex_en: Cheese it, the night guard is heading straight toward our hideout!
items.ex_zh: 快停手扯呼，夜班警卫正径直朝我们的藏身处走来！

items.def_zh: 停止，中断（长期、系统性活动或供应）
items.def_en: to stop doing, providing, or maintaining a regular practice or production
items.ex_en: The pharmacy chose to discontinue selling the outdated medication to prevent complications.
items.ex_zh: 为防止出现并发症，该药房决定停止销售这种过时的药物。

items.def_zh: 停止，打住，终止（尤指停止令人不快或非法的行为）
items.def_en: (formal) To stop doing something, especially an annoying or unlawful activity (often + from).
items.ex_en: The court ordered the company to desist from using misleading promotional slogans.
items.ex_zh: 法院责令该公司停止使用误导性的宣传口号。

items.def_zh: 停止，终结（较为庄重的书面通用词）
items.def_en: (+ from/to inf) to come to an end or bring an ongoing state/action completely to an end
items.ex_en: Hostilities must cease immediately so humanitarian aid can reach the besieged town.
items.ex_zh: 敌对行动必须立即终止，以便人道主义援助能够送达被围困的城镇。
items.ex2_en: The university decided to cease all outdoor athletic activities during the hazardous storm.
items.ex2_zh: 在危险的风暴期间，大学决定停止所有室外体育活动。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this cessation frame specify halting an ongoing action or annoying behavior. Register and intensity progress from informal/archaic imperatives to break off an annoying act (cheese, belay), through formal/legal commands to deliberately forbear (desist), to universal and categorical stoppage (cease, discontinue).
groups.summary_zh: 描述中止或放弃正在进行的特定行为，从口语警告停手递进到法律严正勒令罢手。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote intentionally interrupting or abandoning an ongoing activity or forbearance from a course of action, contrasting with passive 'stopping' by emphasizing volitional cessation, command, or self-restraint.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指主动悬崖勒马、叫停现行运作或克制不再继续，区别于客观运动的“停顿”，强调凭借主观意志、口令或克制力彻底罢手。
groups.nuance_en: desist: formally forbearing or holding oneself back from an objectionable action (activity / behavior / trespass) · discontinue: systematically stopping a routine practice, product line, or service (treatment / service / model) · leave off: quitting an ongoing endeavor where it stands (work / reading / talk) · cut out: sharply eliminating or silencing an annoying behavior (noise / habit / nonsense) · belay: nautically cancelling, freezing, or disregarding a previous order or operation (order / line / action)
groups.nuance_zh: desist: 悬崖勒马、律己罢手、停下侵权或越轨之举 (activity / behavior / trespass) · discontinue: 制度化叫停原本常规的业务、疗程或生产 (treatment / service / model) · leave off: 手头工作暂告一段落就地搁置 (work / reading / talk) · cut out: 厉声喝止讨人嫌的不当恶习或噪声 (noise / habit / nonsense) · belay: 航海指令中的立正叫停、前令作废 (order / line / action)

groups.name: Hammer & Slam · 敲击与重击 (High-Force Destructive or Forceful Impact)
groups.tip: 从用力敲打到猛烈撞击或摔砸

items.def_en: to strike something forcefully with a sharp, sounding blow
items.ex_en: He took a heavy branch and managed to whack the rusty gate open.
items.ex_zh: 他拿起一根粗树枝，狠狠敲打着把生锈的大门给弄开了。

items.def_zh: 不停地敲打；重重连续敲击
items.def_en: (+ at sth) Strike something forcefully and repetitively with heavy, relentless blows
items.ex_en: The blacksmith continued to hammer away at the red-hot steel anvil.
items.ex_zh: 铁匠在通红的钢砧上不停地猛烈敲打。

items.def_zh: 砰的一声重重放下；用力摔下
items.def_en: (+ sth) Put or throw something down onto a surface with tremendous violent force and noise
items.ex_en: In a sudden fit of rage, he slam down his briefcase on the desk.
items.ex_zh: 在一阵突如其来的怒火中，他把公文包重重摔在桌上。

items.def_zh: 猛击，重摔；砰地关上；猛烈抨击
items.def_en: 1. To shut, hit, or put something down with great force and a loud noise. 2. (informal) To criticize severely.
items.ex_en: A sudden gust of wind caused the heavy wooden door to slam shut.
items.ex_zh: 一阵突如其来的狂风把沉重的木门砰的一声关上了。
items.ex2_en: The angry tenant slammed the heavy front door to show his utter frustration.
items.ex2_zh: 愤怒的房客砰地一声关上了沉重的大门以宣泄内心的沮丧。

items.def_zh: 锤打，敲打；反复击打；狠批
items.def_en: 1. To hit or beat repeatedly with or as if with a hammer.
items.ex_en: The carpenter used all his strength to hammer the thick iron nail deeper.
items.ex_zh: 木匠使出全身力气敲打这根粗铁钉，让它钉得更深。

items.def_en: to hit repeatedly with hard, injurious blows so as to damage or shatter
items.ex_en: Fierce gale winds continued to batter the fragile coastal fortifications all night.
items.ex_zh: 整夜的狂风不断重击着脆弱的海岸防御工事。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Inflict devastating forceful blows on an object until it is heavily damaged or destroyed
items.ex_en: Vandals broke into the warehouse overnight to smash up the stored electronics.
items.ex_zh: 破坏分子连夜闯入仓库，捣毁了存放在那里的电子设备。

items.def_en: (+ into/against) to break violently into pieces by heavy impact, or strike with crushing violence
items.ex_en: The out-of-control vehicle continued forward and smashed violently into the concrete barricade.
items.ex_zh: 失控的车辆继续前冲，猛烈砸向混凝土路障并撞得粉碎。
items.ex2_en: The reckless vandal smashed the store display window with a heavy metal wrench.
items.ex2_zh: 鲁莽的破坏分子用一把沉重的金属扳手砸碎了商店的橱窗。

items.def_en: to hit someone or something repeatedly with a heavy club or blunt instrument
items.ex_en: The intruder attempted to bludgeon the guard with a heavy brass pipe.
items.ex_zh: 闯入者企图用一根沉重的黄铜管猛击警卫。

groups.summary_en: An agent exerts forceful, aggressive blows on a target using a heavy tool, body mass, or swift momentum. The frame extends from repetitive heavy bludgeoning to single violent closures.
groups.summary_zh: 以极大力量重击、锤击或猛烈闭合碰撞。
groups.desc_en: Involves delivering repeated or sudden high-velocity violent blows, contrasting with plain 'hit' through devastating momentum, destructive intent, or deafening impact.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及施加高动能、爆发性或破坏性的剧烈击打，与普通“击打”相比，强调极具破坏力的冲击惯性或震耳欲聋的势头。
groups.nuance_en: hammer: relentless, pounding blows or figurative persistence (nail / anvil / competitor) · slam: forceful, noisy impact through sudden acceleration (door / phone / brakes) · batter: repeated, punishing strikes causing progressive structural damage (wall / coastline / victim) · smash: catastrophic, shattering impact breaking an object into fragments (window / record / vase) · whack: sharp, resounding, often informal swing or strike (ball / mole / weed)
groups.nuance_zh: hammer: 连续猛烈捶打或引申为顽强施压 (nail / anvil / competitor) · slam: 骤然加速、制造巨响的重击或摔碰 (door / phone / brakes) · batter: 造成渐进性结构损毁的反复惩罚性重击 (wall / coastline / victim) · smash: 使物体粉碎解体的毁灭性猛撞 (window / record / vase) · whack: 带有呼啸声的重力挥击或敲打 (ball / mole / weed)

groups.name: Hand & Deliver by Manner · 递交与转送 (Hand, Forward, Deliver)
groups.tip: 亲手交付或递送物件

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ to) to pick up or take something and give it into someone's hand
items.ex_en: Could you please pass that bowl of roasted potatoes to the children?
items.ex_zh: 你能把那碗烤土豆递给孩子们吗？
items.ex2_en: Several freight trains pass quietly through this small industrial town every single night.
items.ex2_zh: 每天夜里都有几列货运列车悄然穿过这个工业小镇。

items.def_zh: 顺道送达；把……送到下车处
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Deliver someone or something to a destination while en route
items.ex_en: I can drop you off at the station on my way to work.
items.ex_zh: 我上班顺路可以把你送到车站下车。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Distribute items directly by hand to each individual in a group
items.ex_en: The volunteer stood near the doorway to hand out informative flyers to visitors.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者站在门旁，向每位来访者逐一分发信息传单。

items.def_en: (+ sth to sb) Transmit or deliver an item, message, or document onward to another recipient
items.ex_en: Please read the updated safety manual and pass it on to your colleagues.
items.ex_zh: 请阅读这份更新后的安全手册，并将其转交给你的同事们。

items.def_en: To give or pass something to someone using your hands.
items.ex_en: She smiled warmly and handed the car keys to her excited daughter.
items.ex_zh: 她温暖地微笑着，把车钥匙递给了兴奋的女儿。

items.def_en: to pass responsibility or physical custody of something to someone else formally
items.ex_en: The retiring commander agreed to hand over his authority to the deputy chief.
items.ex_zh: 即将退休的指挥官同意正式将权力移交给副主管。

items.def_zh: 转寄，转发；运送，转运；促进，推进
items.def_en: 1. To send a letter, package, or electronic message on to another address or person. 2. (formal) To help something to advance or make progress.
items.ex_en: The secretariat will forward the confidential diplomatic dossier to the ambassador tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 秘书处将于明日将这份机密外交卷宗转交至大使手中。

items.def_zh: 投递，递送；兑现，履行；发表（演说等）；接生
items.def_en: 1. To take goods, letters, or parcels to people's houses or places of work. 2. To achieve, produce, or fulfill what has been promised. 3. To give a speech, talk, or statement.
items.ex_en: The courier promised to deliver the critical parcels before noon without delay.
items.ex_zh: 快递员承诺会在中午前毫不耽搁地将这批关键包裹送达。

items.def_en: (+ to) to transport goods physically or carry a message from one person to another
items.ex_en: The merchant used a secure carriage to convey the precious silk to court.
items.ex_zh: 商人用一辆坚固的马车将珍贵的丝绸运送到宫廷。

groups.summary_en: An agent transfers an object or communication to a recipient, progressing from direct physical manual passing to onward transmission and formal arrival.
groups.summary_zh: 从亲手递交物品，到中转转寄，再到送达指定接收方手中。
groups.desc_en: Encodes transferring physical possession or informational custody from one agent to another along an interpersonal or procedural chain, distinguishing itself from general 'give' through specified trajectory, agency, or physical reach.
groups.desc_zh: 指在人际或程序链条中转移实体或信息的控制权，与宽泛的“给予”不同，侧重交接轨迹、传递手势或特定流转流程。
groups.nuance_en: hand: direct manual transfer across immediate physical reach (note / keys / wallet) · pass: sequential lateral relay across a line or group (salt / baton / puck) · deliver: transport of items to an intended end destination or recipient (parcel / mail / speech) · hand over: formal or compelled surrender of control or custody (power / suspect / documents) · forward: routing received items onward to a third party (email / mail / application)
groups.nuance_zh: hand: 近距离由手到手的直接递交 (note / keys / wallet) · pass: 队伍或横向序列中的顺次传递 (salt / baton / puck) · deliver: 将物品送达终端目的地或目标收件人 (parcel / mail / speech) · hand over: 正式或被迫移交控制权、监护权 (power / suspect / documents) · forward: 将收到的邮件或申请转寄给第三方 (email / mail / application)

groups.name: Hang & Suspend · 悬挂与吊起 (Hang, Suspend, Dangle)
groups.tip: 由上至下垂挂悬空物体

items.def_en: 1. To attach or be fastened to something from above so that the lower part is free; to suspend. 2. To kill someone, or die, by dropping with a rope around the neck.
items.ex_en: They decided to hang the decorative wreath right above the living room fireplace.
items.ex_zh: 他们决定把装饰花环悬挂在客厅壁炉的正上方。

items.def_zh: 悬挂，吊；暂停，中止；使停职（或停学）
items.def_en: 1. To hang something from a high place. 2. To officially stop something for a period of time. 3. To temporarily prevent someone from working or attending school.
items.ex_en: Workers prepared to suspend the massive glass sculpture directly from the high ceiling.
items.ex_zh: 工人们准备将这件巨大的玻璃雕塑直接从高高的天花板上悬挂下来。

items.def_en: to hang something high up by cords or wires
items.ex_en: The kids helped their father string up colorful lanterns across the patio.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们帮父亲用绳子在露台上挂起一串串彩灯。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Suspend an item from a hook, peg, or hanger so it hangs freely
items.ex_en: Don't hang up on me while I'm still explaining what happened.
items.ex_zh: 我还在解释发生了什么，先别挂我电话。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Fasten and suspend an object using an elevated hook or clasp
items.ex_en: Can you help me hook up the sound system to my laptop?
items.ex_zh: 你能帮我把音响系统连接到笔记本电脑上吗？

items.def_en: (+ sth) Hang loosely and sway freely from an overhead anchor point
items.ex_en: Old rusted chains still dangle from the damp wooden beams in the cellar.
items.ex_zh: 地窖潮湿的木梁上依然吊垂着摇晃的生锈旧铁链。

items.def_zh: 悬挂，吊；垂挂（hang 的过去式和过去分词，绞刑除外）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of hang (used for suspending objects, not execution).
items.ex_en: She hung her winter coat neatly inside the dark oak closet near the entrance.
items.ex_zh: 她将冬大衣整齐地挂在玄关附近深色橡木衣柜里。
items.ex2_en: A heavy blanket of grey fog hung over the silent valley all morning.
items.ex2_zh: 一整个上午，一层厚厚的灰雾都笼罩在寂静的山谷上方。

items.def_en: [I/T] to hang or swing loosely, or hold something so that it swings freely
items.ex_en: The playful kitten watched a silver charm dangle gracefully from her bracelet.
items.ex_zh: 调皮的小猫盯着从她手链上轻轻晃动的银色吊坠。
items.ex2_en: She dangled a shiny brass key ring in front of the playful puppy.
items.ex2_zh: 她在爱玩的小狗面前晃悠着一串锃亮的黄铜钥匙扣。

items.def_en: to hang or suspend something loosely between two points or over the shoulder
items.ex_en: He chose to sling the heavy canvas bag carelessly across his left shoulder.
items.ex_zh: 他随意地把那个沉重的帆布包挎挂在左肩上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe attaching an object from above so that it is supported without direct support from below, swinging or resting freely in the air. 'Hang' is the general term, 'suspend' is more formal or technical, while verbs like 'dangle' emphasize loose, swaying pendant movement.
groups.summary_zh: 指自上方固定物体使其下垂、无托底地悬于空中。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an object being attached from an elevated point and suspended without base support, contrasting with static 'rest' through tension, verticality, and susceptibility to gravitational swing.
groups.desc_zh: 指将物体自高处附着并使其脱离底部支撑悬垂，与静态的“放置”不同，强调重力牵拉、垂直度及随风摇曳的不稳定状态。
groups.nuance_en: hang: general suspension from an upper support point (coat / painting / pendant) · suspend: deliberate, often mechanical hanging or buoyant holding in medium (chandelier / cable / particles) · dangle: loose, unrestrained swinging or hanging limply (legs / bait / strings) · string up: informal or grim suspension by cords, often retributive (lanterns / decorations / victim) · hook up: attaching by means of a curved clasp or coupling (trailer / hammock / harness)
groups.nuance_zh: hang: 悬挂的最通用表达，固定于上方支撑点 (coat / painting / pendant) · suspend: 有意的机械吊装或在介质中悬浮 (chandelier / cable / particles) · dangle: 松散晃荡、无约束地垂悬摆动 (legs / bait / strings) · string up: 用绳索挂起，常带随意性或惩治色彩 (lanterns / decorations / victim) · hook up: 用钩子或搭扣连接悬吊 (trailer / hammock / harness)

groups.name: Harass & Provoke · 骚扰与挑衅刺激 (Bait, Harass, Taunt)
groups.tip: 反复纠缠侵犯令人不安

items.def_en: (+ sb) Provoke and urge someone persistently to act rashly or foolishly
items.ex_en: His foolish friends continued to egg him on to climb the fragile roof.
items.ex_zh: 那些狐朋狗友继续煽动怂恿他去爬那座摇摇欲坠的屋顶。

items.def_en: (+ sb) Repeatedly harass, tease, or criticize someone unfairly
items.ex_en: Why do the older kids always pick on him during recess?
items.ex_zh: 为什么大孩子们课间总爱找他茬、欺负他？

items.def_zh: 故意挑衅，激怒，逗弄；在……装诱饵
items.def_en: 1. To deliberately annoy, taunt, or provoke someone into reacting angrily. 2. To place bait on a hook or in a trap.
items.ex_en: The heckler tried to bait the speaker into losing his professional composure.
items.ex_zh: 起哄者故意挑衅演讲者，企图激怒他使其失去专业风度。

items.def_en: (+ into) to repeatedly bother or pester someone with questions or demands
items.ex_en: Reporters continued to badger the stressed spokesperson for classified details about the scandal.
items.ex_zh: 记者们不断纠缠那位压力重重的发言人，索要有关丑闻的机密细节。

items.def_en: to provoke or challenge someone with insulting, sarcastic, or contemptuous remarks
items.ex_en: The bullies began to taunt the smaller boy with cruel remarks after class.
items.ex_zh: 下课后，那些恶霸开始用残酷的话语羞辱挑衅那个瘦弱的男孩。

items.def_en: to interrupt a public speaker or performer with aggressive comments or abusive shouts
items.ex_en: Angry protestors attempted to heckle the mayor during his annual budget presentation.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的抗议者企图在市长作年度预算汇报时大声起哄捣乱。

items.def_en: (+ at sb) Deliver an aggressive verbal attack or physical blow in angry retaliation to provocation
items.ex_en: Cornered by cruel critics, the stressed artist chose to lash out at reporters.
items.ex_zh: 在被刻薄的批评家逼入绝境后，这位压力巨大的艺术家猛烈反击记者。

items.def_zh: 骚扰，侵扰；不断困扰，烦扰
items.def_en: 1. To annoy, worry, or trouble someone repeatedly through unpleasant or threatening behavior.
items.ex_en: The firm was sued after managers began to harass junior staff through intimidation.
items.ex_zh: 在管理人员开始通过恐吓手段骚扰初级员工后，该企业遭到了起诉。

items.def_en: (+ into) to deliberately annoy or incite someone until they react emotionally or aggressively
items.ex_en: His rude insults were intended to goad his rival into an open brawl.
items.ex_zh: 他的粗鄙侮辱旨在激怒他的对手，使其卷入一场公开斗殴。

groups.summary_en: An instigator deliberately pesters, mocks, or badgers a victim to annoy them, wear them down, or goad them into an angry or irrational reaction. 'Bait' focuses on enticing a furious counterstrike, while 'harass' emphasizes persistent distressing pressure.
groups.summary_zh: 故意持续滋扰、嘲弄或言语相激以激怒对方或造成精神折磨。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on intentional, persistent antagonism or sharp verbal torment designed to destabilize, distress, or elicit an emotional reaction, contrasting with neutral 'annoy' through targeted malice or persistence.
groups.desc_zh: 指蓄意、持续地进行敌对挑衅或言语折磨以扰乱心神或激起过激反应，与单纯的“打扰”相比，带有明显的针对性恶意与纠缠性。
groups.nuance_en: harass: systematic, unremitting persecution creating anxiety or fatigue (dissident / employee / tenant) · taunt: cruel, mocking provocation intended to humiliate or trigger anger (rival / bully / opponent) · bait: cunningly deliberate provocation to trap someone into an overreaction (politician / crowd / witness) · badger: persistent, nagging pressure through repeated requests (official / parent / editor) · heckle: disruptive public interjection aimed at embarrassing a performer (speaker / comedian / politician)
groups.nuance_zh: harass: 系统性、不间断的侵扰与恐吓折磨 (dissident / employee / tenant) · taunt: 意在羞辱或激怒对方的尖酸嘲讽 (rival / bully / opponent) · bait: 故意设局激怒对方以诱其犯错 (politician / crowd / witness) · badger: 纠缠不休的苦求施压或连环盘问 (official / parent / editor) · heckle: 在公共集会中喝倒彩、插话起哄以搅局 (speaker / comedian / politician)

groups.name: Harm & Inflict · 加害与危及 (Endanger, Imperil, Inflict)
groups.tip: 造成危险伤害与破坏受损

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to cause damage, punishment, or destruction to afflict someone (formal/literary)
items.ex_en: Famine seemed to visit widespread devastation upon the drought-stricken agricultural community.
items.ex_zh: 饥荒似乎将普遍的毁灭与灾难降祸于遭受严重干旱的农业社区。

items.def_zh: 强加于；把（伤害/痛苦）施加给
items.def_en: (+ sth on sb/sth) Force someone to endure suffering, injury, or painful hardship
items.ex_en: The ruthless warlord attempted to inflict severe punishment on the rebellious villagers.
items.ex_zh: 冷酷的军阀企图将严厉的惩罚强加给那些反叛的村民。

items.def_en: (+ sth upon sb/sth) Cause misfortune, peril, or adversity to affect someone or oneself
items.ex_en: His reckless gambling debts threaten to bring financial ruin upon his innocent family.
items.ex_zh: 他鲁莽赌博欠下的债务恐将给无辜的家庭招致灭顶的经济灾祸。

items.def_en: (+ sth on sb/sth) Inflict immense damage, havoc, or destructive vengeance directly on a target
items.ex_en: The catastrophic hurricane threatened to wreak total havoc on the vulnerable coastline.
items.ex_zh: 这场灾难性的飓风恐将给脆弱的海岸线带来彻底的浩劫毁灭。

items.def_en: 1. To put someone or something in a situation where they could be harmed, damaged, or destroyed.
items.ex_en: Discharging toxic chemicals into local streams will endanger the entire regional ecosystem.
items.ex_zh: 向当地溪流排放有毒化学物质将危及整个区域的生态系统。

items.def_zh: 予以（打击），使遭受（痛苦、损害等）
items.def_en: 1. (+ on/upon) To force someone or something to experience something very unpleasant, such as pain, damage, or defeat.
items.ex_en: The sudden economic collapse threatened to inflict massive losses upon local investors.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的经济崩溃势必会给当地投资者带来巨大的损失。

items.def_en: to do something that could damage or destroy an enterprise, plan, or safety
items.ex_en: Careless operational mistakes could seriously jeopardize the future success of this joint enterprise.
items.ex_zh: 粗心大意引发的操作失误可能会严重危害这家合资企业未来的成功。

items.def_en: to cause or inflict massive damage, destruction, or vengeance upon something
items.ex_en: The catastrophic hurricane threatened to wreak unprecedented devastation across coastal communities.
items.ex_zh: 这场灾难性的飓风恐将对沿海社区造成前所未有的破坏。

items.def_en: to put someone or something in a situation where they might be harmed, destroyed, or lost
items.ex_en: Such reckless financial decisions could seriously imperil the company's long-term survival.
items.ex_zh: 这种鲁莽的财务决策可能会严重危及公司的长期生存。

groups.summary_en: An agent, policy, or hazard introduces peril or imposes physical damage, suffering, or hardship directly onto a target entity.
groups.summary_zh: 主干框架为对目标施加损害、创伤或使之陷入危险境地。
groups.desc_en: Highlights the direct, often devastating imposition of pain, destruction, or existential hazard onto a recipient, differing from generic 'damage' through an external active agent dealing a severe blow.
groups.desc_zh: 强调外部施加者将痛苦、破坏或存亡危机强行降临于受体，与通用的“损坏”不同，突显加害的主动性与灾难性烈度。
groups.nuance_en: inflict: directly impose suffering, penalty, or physical trauma (pain / damage / defeat) · wreak: unleash wide-scale, chaotic devastation or fury (havoc / vengeance / destruction) · jeopardize: place an outcome or existence in critical exposure to loss (safety / career / stability) · endanger: expose directly to acute, tangible physical peril (species / life / public) · visit: formal imposition of retributive affliction or divine calamity (plague / judgment / wrath)
groups.nuance_zh: inflict: 直接施加痛苦、严惩或身体创伤 (pain / damage / defeat) · wreak: 大规模肆虐宣泄混乱或毁灭 (havoc / vengeance / destruction) · jeopardize: 使前途、成果等处于危殆境地 (safety / career / stability) · endanger: 使生命或物种直接暴露于实体危险中 (species / life / public) · visit: 正式或具天谴色彩的惩戒与苦难降临 (plague / judgment / wrath)

groups.name: Heave & Haul with Effort · 提举与重力拉拽 (Heave, Heft, Haul)
groups.tip: 费力拉起或用力收紧

items.def_en: (+ at) to pull something hard, quickly, or repeatedly
items.ex_en: The frightened little boy began to tug desperately at his mother's sleeve.
items.ex_zh: 那个受惊的小男孩开始拼命拉拽母亲的衣袖。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Lift a heavy load into the air using ropes, pulleys, or mechanical tackle
items.ex_en: The dockworkers used a pulley system to hoist up the heavy crate.
items.ex_zh: 码头工人用滑轮系统把那个沉重的板条箱吊了起来。

items.def_en: to pull or drag something very heavy with continuous hard effort
items.ex_en: Three powerful draft horses had to haul the loaded wagon up the slope.
items.ex_zh: 三匹强壮的挽马不得不使劲将装满货物的马车拉上斜坡。

items.def_en: to raise or pull up something heavy, often using ropes or mechanical gear
items.ex_en: The sailors worked together to hoist the heavy cargo onto the upper deck.
items.ex_zh: 水手们齐心协力将沉重的货物吊到上层甲板上。

items.def_zh: 举起（试重量）；用力举起，抬起
items.def_en: 1. To lift or hold something heavy, especially to test or estimate its weight. 2. To heave or lift up with effort.
items.ex_en: He had to heft the heavy stone block to test its balance.
items.ex_zh: 他必须把那块沉重的石料掂一掂，以测试它的平衡度。

items.def_zh: （用绳索）收起帆角；把……绕成线球
items.def_en: 1. (nautical) To haul up the lower corners of a sail to its yard using ropes. 2. (archaic) To roll or wind thread or yarn into a ball.
items.ex_en: The weary mariners hastened aloft to clew the mainsail before the gale struck.
items.ex_zh: 疲倦的水手们赶忙爬上高处，在大风袭来前收起主帆帆角。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Pull something weighty upward using ropes, rigging, or sheer muscular force
items.ex_en: The exhausted miners managed to haul up the loaded cart from the shaft.
items.ex_zh: 精疲力竭的矿工们终于把装满货物的矿车从井下拽了上去。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Raise or haul a very heavy burden upward with tremendous physical effort
items.ex_en: Together, the rescue team managed to heave up the massive timber beam.
items.ex_zh: 搜救团队齐心协力，终于将沉重的巨型木梁抬了起来。

items.def_zh: 用力拉（或举、推、掷）；（沉重地）起伏；喘息，叹气
items.def_en: 1. To lift, haul, or pull something heavy with great physical effort. 2. To throw or fling something with effort. 3. To rise and fall rhythmically or breathlessly.
items.ex_en: Four laborers had to heave the massive granite slab into the truck bed.
items.ex_zh: 四名劳工不得不使出浑身解数，把沉重的花岗岩石板抬上卡车车厢。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote lifting, hoisting, or pulling substantial physical burdens with muscular exertion or nautical rigging, characterized by weight evaluation, strenuous effort, and mechanical leverage.
groups.summary_zh: 借助肌力或绳索装置竭力提举、掂量或拖拉沉重物体。
groups.desc_en: Captures the intense, biomechanically demanding manual labor of lifting or dragging extremely dense loads against friction and gravity, contrasting with basic 'pull' through exhausting physical exertion.
groups.desc_zh: 特指对抗摩擦力与重力、竭尽体力搬运极重物体的苦力劳动，与普通的“拉/提”相比，带有显著的沉重窒息感与体力透支感。
groups.nuance_en: haul: dragging or transporting heavy freight across distance with sustained strain (cargo / timber / nets) · heave: powerful, coordinated upward or onward lunging motion with total bodily effort (anchor / sack / weight) · heft: testing, appraising, or lifting bulk primarily through raw arm strength (axe / luggage / rock) · hoist: raising substantial loads aloft, often with mechanical advantage or rigging (sail / flag / crate) · tug: sharp, intermittent pulls against stubborn resistance (rope / sleeve / boat)
groups.nuance_zh: haul: 承受持续拉力沿地面长距离拖运重物 (cargo / timber / nets) · heave: 调动全身气力向上或向前猛力爆发性抛举 (anchor / sack / weight) · heft: 凭臂力掂量、试探或艰难搬动重物 (axe / luggage / rock) · hoist: 借助索具或机械优势将重物高高吊起 (sail / flag / crate) · tug: 针对阻力进行的短促、反复用力拉拽 (rope / sleeve / boat)

groups.name: Heavy-Handed Domination & Batter · 强权碾压与残酷摧残 (Batter, Steamroll, Trample)
groups.tip: 以绝对优势强行碾压折磨对手

items.def_en: to strike repeatedly with hard blows so as to damage, bruise, or weaken severely
items.ex_en: Relentless artillery fire continued to batter the fortified walls throughout the cold night.
items.ex_zh: 无情的炮火在寒夜中持续猛烈轰击着那道坚固的防御墙。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ on/over) to step heavily upon someone or ignore rights and feelings in a harsh, callous way
items.ex_en: The corrupt regime continued to trample on the fundamental liberties of its citizens.
items.ex_zh: 该腐败政权继续肆意践踏其公民的基本自由。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Subdue or repress opposition completely and forcibly
items.ex_en: The military dictatorship acted swiftly to crush down any sign of popular resistance.
items.ex_zh: 军政府迅速采取行动，彻底粉碎了民众的一切抵抗苗头。

items.def_zh: 蛮横践踏；横暴无视（他人权利或意见）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Act without caring about or respecting the rights, wishes, or feelings of others
items.ex_en: Management decided to ride roughshod over the workers' clearly stated safety concerns.
items.ex_zh: 管理层竟然决定蛮横无视工人们明确提出的安全诉求。

items.def_zh: 践踏，肆意摧残（权利、自由或感情）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Treat feelings, rights, or laws with cruel or arrogant disregard
items.ex_en: The authoritarian governor attempted to trample on local democratic institutions without remorse.
items.ex_zh: 该独裁州长企图肆无忌惮地摧残地方民主制度。

items.def_zh: 强行推进，霸道碾压（反对意见）
items.def_en: to force people or plans forward arrogantly, brushing aside objections by brute weight
items.ex_en: The mayor used his political leverage to bulldoze the controversial zoning reform.
items.ex_zh: 市长利用自己的政治影响力，霸道推进了这项备受争议的规划改革。

items.def_zh: 强行推进，暴力压制；以势不可当之势击败，彻底击溃
items.def_en: 1. (North American variant of steamroller) To force an idea, plan, or measure through ruthlessly without regard for opposition. 2. To defeat someone overwhelmingly and decisively.
items.ex_en: The ruling coalition attempted to steamroll the contested budget bill through parliament.
items.ex_zh: 执政联盟企图在议会中强行推进那项饱受争议的预算案。

items.def_zh: 使遭受重创；使陷入两难夹击；彻底击溃
items.def_en: To subject someone or something to two opposing forces, losses, or pressures at once; to defeat or damage severely.
items.ex_en: Rising interest rates and plummeting demand threatens to whipsaw the domestic manufacturing sector.
items.ex_zh: 利率上升和需求骤降构成的双重夹击，恐将重创国内制造业。

items.def_en: to destroy opposition, rebellion, or spirits entirely by extreme and overwhelming force
items.ex_en: The imperial army moved in swiftly to crush the armed rebellion overnight.
items.ex_zh: 帝国军队迅速出动，连夜彻底粉碎了武装叛乱。

groups.summary_en: A powerful entity systematically crushes opposition or subjects individuals to punishing, disorienting force, moving from severe physical battering to ruthless institutional steamrolling.
groups.summary_zh: 从持续重击摧残递进至以压倒性霸权残酷碾压与摆布。
groups.desc_en: Metaphorizes overwhelming, ruthless institutional or physical might that completely flattens opposition, differing from civil 'defeat' through brutal, non-negotiable disregard for rights and norms.
groups.desc_zh: 以不可抗拒的暴力或强权隐喻彻底碾压对手，与常规的“击败”不同，强调专横独断、将规则与权利践踏于脚下的暴虐性。
groups.nuance_en: steamroll: crushing dissent through sheer, unyielding momentum and superior force (opposition / legislature / competitors) · trample: disregard or destroy vulnerable rights and autonomy underfoot (rights / liberties / crops) · bulldoze: aggressively pushing through obstacles without regard for friction or consent (bill / critics / resistance) · ride roughshod over: arrogant, tyrannical neglect of others' legitimate interests (protocol / subordinates / feelings) · batter: subjecting a system, entity, or morale to sustained, punishing degradation (economy / coastline / morale)
groups.nuance_zh: steamroll: 凭压倒性势头和资源强行碾平所有异见 (opposition / legislature / competitors) · trample: 如踏足踩踏般肆意蹂躏弱小权益或自由 (rights / liberties / crops) · bulldoze: 粗暴强推政策，完全无视抵触与阻力 (bill / critics / resistance) · ride roughshod over: 专横傲慢地践踏规章、公理或下级感受 (protocol / subordinates / feelings) · batter: 使某一系统或实体遭受摧残性的连环重创 (economy / coastline / morale)

groups.name: Heed & Overhear · 倾听、聆听与旁听 (Hearken, Eavesdrop, Overhear)
groups.tip: 侧耳留心捕捉听觉声音

items.def_en: (+ on) to secretly or intentionally listen to a conversation that does not involve you
items.ex_en: The mischievous boy crept quietly into the hallway to listen in on their conversation.
items.ex_zh: 淘气的男孩悄悄溜进走廊，偷听他们的谈话。

items.def_en: (+ to sth) direct one's auditory attention attentively toward a broadcast or sound
items.ex_en: Millions of anxious citizens decided to tune in to the president's emergency broadcast.
items.ex_zh: 数以百万计焦虑的市民决定收听总统的紧急广播。

items.def_en: (+ one's ears) listen intently and alertly to a faint or sudden sound
items.ex_en: The startled watchdog seemed to prick up its ears at the distant footsteps.
items.ex_zh: 那只受惊的看门狗听到远处传来的脚步声，立刻竖起了耳朵。

items.def_en: to pay careful attention to somebody's advice, warning, or instructions and act accordingly
items.ex_en: The inexperienced climbers failed to heed the urgent storm warnings from local rangers.
items.ex_zh: 经验不足的登山者没有听从当地护林员发出的紧急风暴警告。

items.def_en: 1. (+ on) To secretly listen to someone else's private conversation without their knowledge.
items.ex_en: It is impolite and unethical to eavesdrop on confidential business negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 偷听保密的商务谈判既不礼貌也不道德。

items.def_zh: 倾听，留神听（多用于祈使句）；追溯，重提（与 back 连用）
items.def_en: 1. (old-fashioned, used in orders) To listen carefully and pay attention. 2. ('hark back to') To recall, return to, or resemble an earlier time or topic.
items.ex_en: Hark to the mournful wind howling through the deserted mountain pass.
items.ex_zh: 静听那凄厉的寒风，正呼啸着穿过荒芜的山口。

items.def_en: to hear what other people are saying without their knowing and often without intending to
items.ex_en: She happened to overhear the committee members discussing the unannounced layoffs.
items.ex_zh: 她偶然听到了委员会成员在私下讨论尚未公布的裁员消息。

items.def_zh: 倾听，留神听；追溯，回溯（与 back 连用）
items.def_en: 1. (literary or archaic) To listen attentively and pay attention. 2. ('harken back to') To recall or return to an earlier subject or time.
items.ex_en: The solemn chronicler bade the gathered elders harken to the ancient prophecy.
items.ex_zh: 庄严的编年史官吩咐聚集的长者们用心倾听古老的预言。

items.def_zh: 倾听，留心听（多用于古体或文学语言）
items.def_en: 1. (literary or archaic) To listen carefully and pay attention to what someone says.
items.ex_en: Hearken to the solemn words spoken by the dying king.
items.ex_zh: 请细心聆听垂死国王所说的庄严遗言。

groups.summary_en: An agent attentively directs their hearing toward a sound or speaker, ranging from archaic or poetic invocations to listen and heed, to covertly listening in on private conversations.
groups.summary_zh: 侧耳细听、听从教诲，或在暗中偷听他人交谈。
groups.desc_en: Encompasses modes of auditing auditory signals—ranging from deliberate covert interception to sudden accidental capture or compliance-oriented attending—contrasting with passive 'hear' through attentional posture.
groups.desc_zh: 涵盖对听觉信号的不同接收姿态（从隐秘窃听到偶发截获，再到敬畏顺服），与被动的“听见”相比，突显注意力倾向与信息伦理意图。
groups.nuance_en: heed: paying serious, compliant attention to advice or warnings (warning / advice / counsel) · eavesdrop: covertly listening in on private conversations without consent (neighbors / call / doorway) · overhear: accidentally hearing a remark not addressed to oneself (conversation / gossip / remark) · listen in: intentionally joining an audio stream or monitoring a dialogue (frequency / lecture / meeting) · hark: literary or deliberate directing of auditory focus backward or outward (past / voice / sound)
groups.nuance_zh: heed: 谨遵、重视并听从警告或忠告 (warning / advice / counsel) · eavesdrop: 隐秘窃听未经授权的私人谈话 (neighbors / call / doorway) · overhear: 无意中偶然旁听到他人的私聊 (conversation / gossip / remark) · listen in: 故意接入音频回路或监听对话 (frequency / lecture / meeting) · hark: 侧耳倾听或回溯注意某种声音 (past / voice / sound)

groups.name: Hinder & Impede · 阻碍牵制与掣肘羁绊 (Cumber, Hamper, Militate)
groups.tip: 拖泥带水给前行增加负担

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) impede the progress, development, or success of someone or something
items.ex_en: A chronic lack of funding continues to hold back our clinical research program.
items.ex_zh: 长期缺乏资金一直在阻碍我们临床研究项目的进展。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) restrict someone's freedom of action or movement with commitments or obstacles
items.ex_en: He didn't want to buy a house because he hated being tied down to one location.
items.ex_zh: 他不想买房，因为讨厌被束缚在同一个地方。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) burden or encumber someone or something so as to hinder smooth action or progress
items.ex_en: She felt weighed down by domestic responsibilities and work pressures.
items.ex_zh: 她感到家庭责任和工作压力压得自己喘不过气来。

items.def_en: to severely disrupt or hinder the movement, progress, or effective operation of someone
items.ex_en: Severe blizzards could severely hamper relief efforts across the isolated northern province.
items.ex_zh: 猛烈的暴风雪可能会严重妨碍偏远北部省份的救援工作。

items.def_en: to weigh down someone or something with physical, legal, or financial burdens
items.ex_en: Excessive bureaucracy should not encumber the delivery of urgent humanitarian aid.
items.ex_zh: 繁琐的官僚程序不应阻碍紧急人道主义援助的分发。

items.def_en: 1. (formal / literary) To weigh down, hinder, or burden someone or something.
items.ex_en: Superfluous worldly possessions only cumber the pilgrim on his solitary journey.
items.ex_zh: 多余的世俗财物只会拖累朝圣者孤独前行的脚步。

items.def_zh: 阻碍，不利于，对……产生负面影响
items.def_en: (also 'militate against') (formal) To be a powerful factor in preventing something from happening or succeeding.
items.ex_en: His complete lack of diplomatic experience might militate against his promotion.
items.ex_zh: 他完全缺乏外交经验，这可能会对他的晋升产生不利影响。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) prevent someone or something from making progress or moving forward
items.ex_en: Endless procedural arguments threaten to bog down the treaty negotiations indefinitely.
items.ex_zh: 无休止的程序性争端恐将使条约谈判无限期陷入停滞。
items.ex2_en: The heavy military vehicles bogged down in the thick mud during spring rains.
items.ex2_zh: 春雨期间，沉重的军用车辆陷入了厚厚的烂泥中无法前行。

items.def_en: to severely restrict freedom of decision, action, or governance like putting in chains
items.ex_en: Outdated industry regulations continue to shackle domestic entrepreneurs striving to innovate.
items.ex_zh: 过时的行业规章仍在严密束缚着努力创新的本土创业者。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe factors, burdens, or actions that actively restrict progress, weigh down operational capacity, or operate forcefully as a structural barrier against success.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过增加沉重负担、羁绊或外部不利条件阻碍行动进展、掣肘成事。
groups.desc_en: Depicts physical weights, drag, or systemic encumbrances that paralyze forward momentum and free agency, distinct from overt 'stop' by working through friction, entanglement, and burden.
groups.desc_zh: 描摹通过物理负重、牵制缠绕或体制性阻滞拖慢前进势头，与绝对的“停止”不同，侧重摩擦力与累赘造成的行动受阻。
groups.nuance_en: hamper: restricting fluid progress or functional efficiency through obstacles (rescue / growth / movement) · encumber: burdening with physical baggage, debt, or regulatory overload (estate / hiker / system) · weigh down: depressing movement or spirits through heavy deadweight (branches / economy / conscience) · tie down: immobilizing resources or personnel to a single commitment (troops / capital / schedule) · militate: actively working as a strong argumentative factor against an outcome (circumstances / precedent / facts)
groups.nuance_zh: hamper: 因外界干扰或束缚导致运转不畅与受阻 (rescue / growth / movement) · encumber: 因背负过多债务、包裹或繁文缛节而难以脱身 (estate / hiker / system) · weigh down: 实体负重下沉或精神被重压压垮 (branches / economy / conscience) · tie down: 牵制并锁定资源、兵力或日程自由 (troops / capital / schedule) · militate: （事实/环境）构成强烈不利因素阻碍结果实现 (circumstances / precedent / facts)

groups.name: Hinder & Obstruct Actions · 阻碍与妨害 (Inconvenience, Hinder, Obstruct)
groups.tip: 制造障碍妨碍行动顺利开展

items.def_en: to put an obstacle in the way of someone or something, stopping progress
items.ex_en: Fallen trees and thick mud continue to block the mountain pass completely.
items.ex_zh: 倒塌的树木和厚厚的淤泥继续完全阻挡着山口。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Delay or impede the progress or operation of someone or something
items.ex_en: Unexpected transport delays will surely hold up our production schedule this week.
items.ex_zh: 意料之外的运输延误肯定会耽误我们本周的生产进度。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Obstruct access or passage through a route or opening entirely
items.ex_en: Riot police moved in quickly to block off the main commercial avenue.
items.ex_zh: 防暴警察迅速行动，将主要商业大街封锁了起来。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Prevent or hinder someone from moving, working, or progressing freely
items.ex_en: These towering storage boxes constantly get in the way of the warehouse workers.
items.ex_zh: 这些堆得高高的储物箱经常挡住仓库工人的去路。

items.def_en: to delay or slow down the development, growth, or progress of something
items.ex_en: Severe water shortages will undoubtedly retard agricultural development throughout the arid region.
items.ex_zh: 严重的缺水问题无疑会延缓整个干旱地区的农业发展。

items.def_en: To cause trouble, difficulty, or discomfort to someone.
items.ex_en: We sincerely regret any delay that might inconvenience our valued passengers today.
items.ex_zh: 我们对今天可能给尊贵旅客带来不便的任何延误深表歉意。

items.def_en: To make it difficult for someone to do something or for something to develop or progress.
items.ex_en: Dense fog and icy roads will seriously hinder rescue operations this evening.
items.ex_zh: 浓雾和结冰的道路将严重妨碍今晚的搜救行动。

items.def_zh: 阻塞，堵塞；阻碍，妨碍；遮挡（视线等）
items.def_en: 1. To block a road, passage, or entrance with obstacles. 2. To prevent or hinder the progress or accomplishment of something. 3. To block someone's view.
items.ex_en: Protesters gathered at the gate to obstruct vehicular traffic into the complex.
items.ex_zh: 抗议者聚集在大门口，阻碍车辆驶入该建筑群。

items.def_en: to weigh down or burden someone or something so that free movement or action is restricted
items.ex_en: Heavy survival gear served only to encumber the exhausted hikers during the climb.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的求生装备在攀登途中只会拖累精疲力竭的徒步者。

groups.summary_en: Verbs marking interpersonal, legal, or physical friction that slows someone down, imposes logistical difficulty, or bars their smooth path or operation.
groups.summary_zh: 指给他人制造麻烦、拖延进度或阻挡通路以妨害正常行动。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on setting barriers or intervening in a path or timeline to delay, jam, or prevent an action from executing, differing from internal restraint through external blocking friction.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重在通道或时间线上设置关卡或障碍以延宕、阻绝或破坏行动的推进，与内在克制不同，强调外部横加的阻断阻力。
groups.nuance_en: obstruct: creating a solid physical or procedural barricade that halts traversal (traffic / justice / airway) · hinder: making an activity slower or harder to achieve via friction (investigation / development / recovery) · block: shutting off an access route, signal, or initiative completely (road / passage / view) · hold up: introducing an unwelcome operational delay or bottleneck (traffic / production / schedule) · get in the way of: functioning as an inconvenient physical or personal impediment (progress / light / career)
groups.nuance_zh: obstruct: 筑起实体路障或程序性关卡以彻底切断通行 (traffic / justice / airway) · hinder: 制造阻滞，使事物发展拖沓受困 (investigation / development / recovery) · block: 完全封闭通道、视线或封锁推进 (road / passage / view) · hold up: 造成不情愿的业务延误或中途停摆 (traffic / production / schedule) · get in the way of: 成为碍手碍脚的现实阻碍或羁绊 (progress / light / career)

groups.name: Hoist & Lift Mechanically · 吊起与升起 (Lift, Hoist, Trice)
groups.tip: 拉绳滑轮将重物向上吊起

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ up) to pull or drag something heavy upwards with prolonged effort
items.ex_en: The fishermen combined their strength to haul the loaded net into the boat.
items.ex_zh: 渔民们合力将沉甸甸的渔网拉上了船。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Pull or drag someone or something upward with considerable mechanical or physical effort
items.ex_en: Firefighters used heavy nylon cords to haul up the trapped climber safely.
items.ex_zh: 消防员使用粗尼龙绳将受困的登山者安全地拉了上来。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Lift or raise something heavy upward with effort
items.ex_en: The mechanical crane managed to heave up the massive engine out of the hull.
items.ex_zh: 机械起重机终于把巨大的发动机从船舱里吊了起来。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Hoist or pull someone or something upwards using a winch mechanism
items.ex_en: The rescue helicopter lowered a cable to winch up the stranded sailor.
items.ex_zh: 救援直升机放下一根缆绳，将搁浅的水手绞车吊了上去。

items.def_en: to raise or pull something up to a higher position, especially using ropes or mechanical gear
items.ex_en: Dockside workers used an industrial crane to hoist the heavy containers onto the vessel.
items.ex_zh: 码头工人用工业起重机将沉重的集装箱吊上了货船。

items.def_en: (+ up/out) to lift or haul something using a mechanical winch
items.ex_en: The crew used an electric motor to winch the heavy lifeboat back onboard.
items.ex_zh: 船员使用电动机将沉重的救生艇绞拉回船上。

items.def_en: (usually trice up) to haul up and lash or fasten something securely with a rope
items.ex_en: The boatswain ordered the sailors to trice up the heavy yardarm at once.
items.ex_zh: 水手长命令船员立即将沉重的桁端吊起并系紧。

items.def_en: to lift or raise something up into a higher position
items.ex_en: The priest seemed to upraise the golden chalice toward the radiant morning light.
items.ex_zh: 祭司迎着灿烂的晨曦，庄严地将金圣杯高高举起。

items.def_en: to lift or move heavy goods using a crane
items.ex_en: The construction crew will crane the bulky steel girders into place tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 施工队明天将用起重机把庞大的钢梁吊装到位。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify raising an object or weight upwards, frequently employing ropes, pulleys, tackles, or dedicated lifting mechanisms. They differ according to the mechanism used (slings, halyards, tackles) and the height reached.
groups.summary_zh: 指借由绳索、滑轮组或机械力量将重物、帆或物体向上吊起、提升。
groups.desc_en: Specifies raising massive burdens vertically against gravitational pull using tackle, cables, winches, or dedicated apparatus, contrasting with plain 'lift' via mechanical advantage and nautical/industrial scale.
groups.desc_zh: 专指利用滑轮、钢缆、卷扬机或特定装置将沉重负荷沿垂直方向提拉升高，与普通“举起”相比，凸显机械力学与工程重装语境。
groups.nuance_en: hoist: elevating heavy freight or maritime gear using pulleys, ropes, or cranes (cargo / flag / sail) · winch: hauling or raising via a mechanical spool turned by a crank or motor (vehicle / boat / glider) · haul up: dragging a heavy mass upward along an incline or rope line (anchor / nets / ore) · heave up: muscular, surging effort to raise heavy gear manually aboard (anchor / chest / tackle) · trice: maritime hoisting and lashing up snugly using a small tackle (sail / bunk / yard)
groups.nuance_zh: hoist: 利用滑车、起重臂或索具垂直吊起大型重物 (cargo / flag / sail) · winch: 通过手摇或电动绞盘卷绕钢缆拖吊 (vehicle / boat / glider) · haul up: 费力将水下或深坑中的重物沿索拉出 (anchor / nets / ore) · heave up: 水手合力以爆发性肌肉力量拉起沉重船具 (anchor / chest / tackle) · trice: 航海术语，用绳索滑轮将帆具或吊床吊起收固 (sail / bunk / yard)

groups.name: House & Shelter · 安置与庇护 (Providing Lodging & Quarters)
groups.tip: 为人员调配居所与容身之地

items.def_en: to provide residential accommodation, shelter, or storage space for sb/sth
items.ex_en: The new facility is specifically designed to house displaced families during severe disasters.
items.ex_zh: 该新设施专门用于在严重灾害期间安置流离失所的家庭。

items.def_zh: 安置，为……提供住处；驻扎；把……分成四等份
items.def_en: 1. To provide someone, especially military personnel, with accommodation. 2. (of troops) To stay in a particular place. 3. To cut or divide something into four equal parts.
items.ex_en: The command decided to quarter the exhausted regiment in nearby abandoned farmhouses.
items.ex_zh: 指挥部决定将精疲力竭的团部官兵安置在附近废弃的农舍中。

items.def_zh: 把（马等）关在马厩中，为（马）提供马厩
items.def_en: To keep or put a horse or other animal in a stable.
items.ex_en: The wealthy breeder decided to stable his prized thoroughbred horses during the storm.
items.ex_zh: 暴风雨期间，这位富有的育马者决定将他珍贵的纯种马关进马厩。

items.def_en: to protect sb/sth from danger, bad weather, or attack by giving them safe cover
items.ex_en: The concrete overhang helped shelter the stranded tourists from the sudden torrential downpour.
items.ex_zh: 混凝土挑檐帮助滞留的游客躲避了突如其来的倾盆大雨。
items.ex2_en: The travelers sheltered beneath the wide stone archway until the thunderstorm passed.
items.ex2_zh: 旅客们在宽阔的石拱下躲避，直到雷暴过去。

items.def_en: (+ sb) Provide someone with temporary food and lodging in one's home
items.ex_en: My generous aunt agreed to put up my roommate for the entire weekend.
items.ex_zh: 我慷慨的姑姑同意留宿我的室友度过整个周末。

items.def_zh: 收留；接纳（庇护者、孤儿等）
items.def_en: (+ sb) Allow someone without a home or in need of shelter to live in one's home
items.ex_en: The generous elderly couple decided to take in the destitute refugee family immediately.
items.ex_zh: 那对慷慨的老夫妇决定立即收留那个无家可归的难民家庭。

items.def_en: (+ sb) Quarter or lodge soldiers in a civilian house or community
items.ex_en: The occupying commander chose to billet his infantry on the reluctant townsfolk.
items.ex_zh: 占领军指挥官选择强行将他的步兵安置在勉为其难的市民家中借宿。

items.def_en: to give secret refuge or shelter to someone wanted by the authorities
items.ex_en: It remains a federal crime to knowingly harbor an escaped federal fugitive.
items.ex_zh: 明知故犯地窝藏在逃的联邦通缉犯仍属于联邦重罪。

items.def_en: (+ on / with) to lodge soldiers temporarily in a private home or designated station
items.ex_en: The army officers arranged to billet the troops in local school auditoriums.
items.ex_zh: 陆军军官们安排将部队临时安置在当地学校的礼堂里借宿。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote supplying living accommodations, quarters, or protective sanctuary for people, refugees, military personnel, or animals.
groups.summary_zh: 为人员、部队或动物提供住所、营房、避难处或安置设施。
groups.desc_en: Concerns the provision of domestic shelter, temporary lodging, or secure containment for individuals, animals, or items, differing from 'hide' by foregrounding hospitality or logistical custody.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及为人员、动物或物品提供居住庇护、暂时驻扎或妥善收容，与“隐藏”不同，重点在于安顿食宿、后勤包容或收留安置。
groups.nuance_en: house: providing permanent or organizational structural accommodation (refugees / collection / inmates) · shelter: protecting vulnerable entities from weather, attack, or catastrophe (homeless / victims / livestock) · quarter: billeting troops or personnel into specific living accommodations (troops / officers / workers) · harbor: providing illicit refuge or secretly keeping sentiments (fugitive / criminal / grudges) · put up: accommodating a guest temporarily in one's home (guest / friend / traveler)
groups.nuance_zh: house: 长期在建筑物中容纳、安置或典藏 (refugees / collection / inmates) · shelter: 遮风挡雨，庇护弱者免受灾祸摧残 (homeless / victims / livestock) · quarter: 将军队、人员分配进特定营房或居所驻扎 (troops / officers / workers) · harbor: 窝藏逃犯、包庇罪犯或心怀恶意积怨 (fugitive / criminal / grudges) · put up: 腾出私人住宅暂且留宿亲朋好友 (guest / friend / traveler)

groups.name: Humiliate & Degrade · 贬低与羞辱 (Belittle, Humiliate, Dehumanize)
groups.tip: 剥夺人格尊严乃至非人化侮辱

items.def_zh: 轻视，贬低（使人感觉无足轻重）
items.def_en: to dismiss someone or their efforts as unimportant or small
items.ex_en: The arrogant director continued to belittle his junior assistant's hard work publicly.
items.ex_zh: 那位傲慢的主管不断公开贬低初级助理的辛勤工作。

items.def_zh: 居高临下地对待；鄙视地对……说话
items.def_en: (+ sb) Speak to someone in a patronizing, condescending way as if they are inferior
items.ex_en: You shouldn't talk down to your colleagues simply because they are inexperienced.
items.ex_zh: 你不应该仅仅因为同事们缺乏经验就居高临下地对待他们。

items.def_en: to cause someone to lose respect or lower their perceived moral/social standing
items.ex_en: The manager refused to demean herself by engaging in petty workplace gossip.
items.ex_zh: 这位经理不屑于参与琐碎的职场八卦来贬低自己的身份。

items.def_en: (+ sb) Regard or treat someone as vastly inferior, worthless, or beneath oneself
items.ex_en: She never looks down on anyone just because they come from a humble background.
items.ex_zh: 她绝不会仅仅因为别人出身平凡而看不起对方。

items.def_en: (+ sb) Criticize, mock, or belittle someone in a way that deflates their self-esteem or dignity
items.ex_en: He constantly put down his colleagues in meetings to boost his own fragile ego.
items.ex_zh: 他经常在会议上贬低同事，以满足自己脆弱的虚荣心。

items.def_en: to make someone feel deeply ashamed, foolish, or publicly disgraced
items.ex_en: The coach did not mean to humiliate the young player before the entire team.
items.ex_zh: 教练并无意在全队面前让这位年轻队员难堪丢脸。

items.def_en: to treat someone with complete disrespect, lowering their moral condition or human dignity
items.ex_en: Such abhorrent prison conditions degrade human beings and strip away their fundamental dignity.
items.ex_zh: 如此恶劣的监狱环境贬抑了人类尊严，剥夺了基本体面。

items.def_zh: 使蒙羞，玷污……的名誉；拒绝承兑（支票、汇票等）
items.def_en: 1. to bring shame, disgrace, or loss of honor upon someone or something 2. to refuse or fail to pay an accepted check, bill, or promissory note
items.ex_en: His treasonous conduct threatened to dishonor the memory of fallen soldiers.
items.ex_zh: 他的叛国行径可能会玷污阵亡将士留下的崇高英名。

items.def_zh: 使失去人性，剥夺……的人性尊严，使非人化
items.def_en: to treat people so badly that they lose their human qualities, individuality, or dignity
items.ex_en: Extreme poverty and systemic exploitation dehumanize vulnerable workers across the region.
items.ex_zh: 极度贫困和体制性剥削剥夺了该地区弱势劳工的人性尊严。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote treating individuals or groups in ways that crush their dignity, pride, or human status, escalating from verbal deflation of worth to total deprivation of human identity.
groups.summary_zh: 由轻及重剥夺个人或群体的尊严与体面，直至剥离其作为人的基本属性。
groups.desc_en: Describes systematically stripping an individual of dignity, moral worth, or human status in the eyes of others, contrasting with simple 'criticize' by destroying self-esteem and status.
groups.desc_zh: 指自尊与社会人格维度的摧毁，通过言行剥夺个体的尊严与人道地位，与单纯的“批评”相比，具有践踏人格、蓄意折辱的破坏力。
groups.nuance_en: humiliate: mortifying an individual's pride and self-worth publicly (rival / student / opponent) · demean: lowering personal dignity or moral standing through degrading conduct (profession / self / office) · degrade: systematically debasing conditions or status to subhuman levels (prisoners / environment / quality) · belittle: dismissively minimizing someone's worth, work, or achievements (effort / achievement / contribution) · talk down to: addressing another condescendingly as an intellectual inferior (staff / audience / partner)
groups.nuance_zh: humiliate: 在众人面前狠狠挫伤对手自尊使其难堪受辱 (rival / student / opponent) · demean: 自贬身价或用失态言行降低人格声誉 (profession / self / office) · degrade: 将人降格至非人待遇或破坏系统生态品质 (prisoners / environment / quality) · belittle: 刻意贬低、轻视他人的功绩或努力 (effort / achievement / contribution) · talk down to: 居高临下、盛气凌人地对人说话 (staff / audience / partner)

groups.name: Humiliate & Disgrace · 羞辱与贬损 (Shame, Humiliate, Disgrace)
groups.tip: 践踏尊严，使其名誉扫地蒙羞

items.def_en: To cause someone to feel guilt, distress, or embarrassment by exposing a fault
items.ex_en: The teacher tried not to shame the boy when pointing out his error.
items.ex_zh: 老师在指出那个小男孩的错误时，尽量不让他感到羞愧。

items.def_en: (+ sb) Lower someone's pride, spirits, or standing severely
items.ex_en: The sudden defeat cast down the ambitious general, crushing his long-cherished military pride.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的溃败击溃了那位野心勃勃的将军，彻底粉碎了他的骄傲。

items.def_zh: 拉下水；贬损尊严与品格
items.def_en: (+ sb) Corrupt someone or cause their moral reputation or dignity to degenerate
items.ex_en: Rising energy costs could drag down the entire manufacturing sector.
items.ex_zh: 不断上涨的能源成本可能会拖垮整个制造业。

items.def_en: To reduce the quality, value, or moral standing of someone or something
items.ex_en: Sordid political compromises often debase the moral integrity of newly elected leaders.
items.ex_zh: 肮脏的政治妥协往往会贬低新当选领导人的道德操守。

items.def_zh: 使名誉扫地；使垮台蒙羞
items.def_en: (+ sb) Cause an esteemed person or institution to fall from power or suffer public disgrace
items.ex_en: The corruption scandal threatened to bring down the prime minister in total disgrace.
items.ex_zh: 那桩腐败丑闻眼看就要让首相垮台，并让他彻底名誉扫地。

items.def_zh: 使蒙羞，使丢脸，使失去体面
items.def_en: To bring shame, dishonor, or discredit upon someone or a group through bad behavior.
items.ex_en: The athlete's doping confession will surely disgrace the national team on the world stage.
items.ex_zh: 这名运动员承认服用兴奋剂，必将使国家队在国际舞台上蒙羞。

items.def_en: To make someone feel very ashamed, foolish, or humiliated, especially in front of others.
items.ex_en: She felt awful when her supervisor chose to humiliate her during the staff presentation.
items.ex_zh: 当主管选择在员工汇报时当众羞辱她，她感到非常难过。

items.def_en: To treat someone with disrespect and make them lose their self-respect
items.ex_en: Cruel interrogation tactics degrade suspects and violate basic universal human rights.
items.ex_zh: 残忍的审讯手段侮辱了嫌疑人的人格，并侵犯了基本人权。

items.def_zh: 使深感屈辱，使极为难堪
items.def_en: To cause someone to feel deeply ashamed, severely embarrassed, or wounded in pride
items.ex_en: The unexpected blunder seemed to mortify the ambassador in front of foreign dignitaries.
items.ex_zh: 这个意外失误令大使在外宾面前深感屈辱，极为难堪。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express causing someone to experience acute shame, lowering their dignity, or stripping away their public honor. They escalate from causing personal embarrassment or loss of face to stripping a person or group of their moral standing and societal reputation.
groups.summary_zh: 剥夺尊严、名誉，使其承受强烈的羞耻与公众贬损。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on inflicting public infamy, institutional loss of honor, or ethical tainting on a person or lineage, differing from internal 'regret' by invoking collective social ostracism.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重于招致公共污名、体制性褫夺荣誉或道德玷污，与内心的“懊悔”不同，诉诸于社会性耻辱与身败名裂的公愤机制。
groups.nuance_en: disgrace: stripping someone of social esteem, office, or standing through scandalous conduct (family / uniform / institution) · shame: subjecting someone to acute moral remorse and collective censure (guilt / community / nation) · debase: corrupting intrinsic purity, coin value, or cultural standards (currency / standards / language) · drag down: pulling others down into equivalent corruption, failure, or misery (reputation / allies / colleagues) · cast down: deeply dejecting one's spirits or toppling from an exalted post (eyes / leader / spirit)
groups.nuance_zh: disgrace: 因丑闻而使家族、职业或头衔蒙羞受辱 (family / uniform / institution) · shame: 唤起道德羞愧感并施加社群谴责 (guilt / community / nation) · debase: 掺假、降低货币成色或贬损文化水准 (currency / standards / language) · drag down: 堕落时拖人下水，拉低他人声誉或前程 (reputation / allies / colleagues) · cast down: 使人神情沮丧垂头丧气，或推翻显赫地位 (eyes / leader / spirit)

groups.name: Hypothesize & Postulate · 理论假设与前提设定 (Posit, Predicate, Postulate)
groups.tip: 从初步假设到确立公理

items.def_en: [I/T] to put forward an unproven idea or tentative explanation to be tested
items.ex_en: Astrophysicists hypothesize that an undetected planet orbits on the edge of the solar system.
items.ex_zh: 天体物理学家假设太阳系边缘存在一颗尚未被探测到的行星。

items.def_zh: 提出（假说、设想或理论依据）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Propose an idea, theory, or hypothesis for consideration or discussion
items.ex_en: The committee put forward an alternative hypothesis to explain the unexpected experimental results.
items.ex_zh: 委员会提出了一个替代假说，用以解释反常的实验结果。

items.def_zh: 陈述，阐明（理论假设或命题）
items.def_en: (+ sth) State, propose, or outline a hypothesis, proposition, or theoretical framework clearly
items.ex_en: The philosopher set forth a revolutionary premise regarding the nature of human consciousness.
items.ex_zh: 这位哲学家就人类意识的本质阐明了一项革命性的前提假说。

items.def_zh: 以……为先决条件，预先假定
items.def_en: to require or take something as an implicit prerequisite or given truth
items.ex_en: True democratic reform must presuppose the existence of a free, independent press.
items.ex_zh: 真正的民主改革必须预先假定存在自由且独立的新闻媒体。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Formulate a theoretical premise or assumption grounded in a principle
