groups.nuance_en: bite: single sharp clamping or severing with teeth (apple / lip / bullet) · nibble: take repetitive, tiny, cautious bites (cheese / ear / snack) · chew: rhythmic repeated grinding before swallowing (food / cud / gum) · chomp: bite down vigorously and noisily (cigar / bit / food) · gnaw at: persistent scraping wear over prolonged time (bone / conscience / anxiety)
groups.nuance_zh: bite: 牙齿利落咬入或切断 (apple / lip / bullet) · nibble: 细碎轻柔的小口慢啃 (cheese / ear / snack) · chew: 吞咽前的反复节律性咀嚼 (food / cud / gum) · chomp: 粗暴、用力且大声地大口咀嚼 (cigar / bit / food) · gnaw at: 持续磨损性啃啮，常引申为心神折磨 (bone / conscience / anxiety)

groups.name: Mean & Signify · 意指与象征 (Convey Sense or Indicate)
groups.tip: 表示特定含意与象征深意

items.def_zh: 表示……的意思，意指；意图，打算；意味着
items.def_en: 1. To signify, denote, or express an idea or thing. 2. To have as an intention or purpose. 3. To have something as a necessary result or consequence.
items.ex_en: In traffic regulations, a solid red light always means that drivers must stop.
items.ex_zh: 在交通法规中，红灯常亮始终意味着驾驶员必须停车。

items.def_en: to be a sign of something; show that something exists or is likely true
items.ex_en: Recent economic indicators indicate that consumer confidence has begun to rebound steadily.
items.ex_zh: 近期的经济指标表明，消费者信心已经开始稳步回升。

items.def_en: (+ sth) indicate or signify a particular meaning, consequence, or overall truth
items.ex_en: All these scattered clues add up to a deliberate attempt at corporate fraud.
items.ex_zh: 所有这些零散的线索意味着这是一场蓄意策划的企业欺诈案。

items.def_en: (+ sth) mean or lead to a certain inevitable outcome, often a negative one
items.ex_en: You don't need to spell out every detail; we get the general idea.
items.ex_zh: 你不需要把每个细节都阐释得那么细，我们明白大意。

items.def_en: (+ sth) represent or denote a specific word, concept, or symbol
items.ex_en: The school management will not stand for any form of bullying on campus.
items.ex_zh: 学校管理层绝不容忍校园内出现任何形式的霸凌行为。

items.def_en: (+ sth) indicate that something is likely to be true or will happen
items.ex_en: Preliminary findings from the survey strongly point to a major shift in public opinion.
items.ex_zh: 这项调查的初步结果有力地预示了公众舆论的重大转变。

items.def_zh: 表示，标志（字面或直接含义）
items.def_en: to be a mark, symbol, or literal sign of something
items.ex_en: On this nautical map, the dashed lines denote hazardous shallow waters along the coast.
items.ex_zh: 在这幅航海图上，虚线标示出沿海危险的浅水区域。

items.def_zh: 表示，象征，意味；具有重要性，要紧
items.def_en: 1. To be a sign, symbol, or indication of something; to mean. 2. (formal) To be important, consequential, or of matter.
items.ex_en: The white flag has long been recognized to signify surrender across battlefield conflicts.
items.ex_zh: 长期以来，在各战场的武装冲突中，白旗一直被用来象征投降。

items.def_en: to suggest an idea, feeling, or association in addition to literal meaning
items.ex_en: To many readers, the author's austere tone connotes deep emotional detachment.
items.ex_zh: 对许多读者而言，作者冷峻的笔调含蓄地意味着内心深处的情感疏离。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on symbols, words, signs, or events conveying a particular sense, value, or implication. 'Mean' is the neutral default verb, whereas 'signify', 'denote', and 'portend' lean towards formal, semiotic, or omen-like indication.
groups.summary_zh: 指符号、语言或迹象传达特定含义、象征或暗示。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame convey semantic reference, symbolic standing, or diagnostic implication, distinct from direct verbal utterance by treating words, gestures, or signs as representations of underlying ideas or consequences.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词表示语义指涉、象征代表或预示后果，不同于直接说出某事，而是将语言、符号或迹象作为深层概念或现实的映射。
groups.nuance_en: mean: generic linguistic sense or intended message (words / gesture / silence) · denote: precise literal dictionary designation (concept / term / category) · signify: embody substantial symbolic or cultural weight (change / victory / status) · stand for: serve as an accepted proxy or acronym (freedom / party / abbreviation) · point to: present evidential clues for a conclusion (trend / guilt / recovery)
groups.nuance_zh: mean: 基础通用词，表字面涵义或潜在线索 (words / gesture / silence) · denote: 精确的外延、字面指定含义 (concept / term / category) · signify: 具有象征意义或预示深远含义 (change / victory / status) · stand for: 作为公认缩写、符号或理念的代表 (freedom / party / abbreviation) · point to: 迹象表明、指向某种推论 (trend / guilt / recovery)

groups.name: Mechanical Easing & Tension Release · 机械减张与松弛解脱 (Loosen, Slacken)
groups.tip: 由紧绷状态转向松散

items.def_zh: 放松（肌肉、握力等机械张力）
items.def_en: [I/T] to make a physical hold, tension, or muscle strain less firm or tight
items.ex_en: The physical therapist told him to relax his grip on the parallel bars.
items.ex_zh: 理疗师让他放松抓着双杠的手劲。
items.ex2_en: His tight muscles relaxed gradually as he stepped into the hot bath.
items.ex2_zh: 当他走进热水浴缸时，紧绷的肌肉逐渐放松下来。

items.def_zh: 微调放松；缓释（机械紧力）
items.def_en: [I/T] (+ off/up) to gently reduce tension, pressure, or tightness on an object
items.ex_en: Carefully ease off the pressure valve before attempting to remove the outer metal casing.
items.ex_zh: 在尝试拆下金属外壳之前，请小心微调泄压阀。
items.ex2_en: The intense pressure on the valve will ease off after shutoff.
items.ex2_zh: 关闭后，阀门上的巨大压力就会逐渐缓解。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make something that has been tightened less firm or loose
items.ex_en: The technician had to untighten the corroded bolts using a long socket wrench.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员不得不使用长套筒扳手拧松生锈的螺栓。
items.ex2_en: The wooden guitar pegs untighten naturally when the room gets humid.
items.ex2_zh: 当房间变得潮湿时，吉他的木制琴栓会自然松动。

items.def_zh: 放松；减小（张力、拉力或压力）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to reduce tension, pressure, or physical tightness gradually
items.ex_en: Slowly ease off the winch cable to lower the heavy steel beam safely.
items.ex_zh: 缓慢放松绞盘钢缆，以安全降下沉重的钢梁。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to loosen a rope, tether, or fastener so that it is less taut
items.ex_en: Hey, slack off that mooring line a bit before the rising tide snaps it.
items.ex_zh: 嘿，在涨潮把缆绳崩断之前，把它稍微放松一点。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make a rope, tether, or garment looser or longer by releasing tension
items.ex_en: The sailor had to let out several yards of rope during the squall.
items.ex_zh: 在暴风雨中，水手不得不放长数码缆绳。

items.def_en: 1. To loosen or ease tension on something tight. 2. (often 'slack off') To work with less energy, care, or speed.
items.ex_en: The crane operator had to slack the steel cable before unhooking the container.
items.ex_zh: 起重机操作员在解开集装箱吊钩前必须先放松钢缆。
items.ex2_en: The tight mooring lines slacked noticeably as the incoming tide rose.
items.ex2_zh: 随着潮水上涨，紧绷的系泊绳明显松弛了下来。

items.def_en: To make or become less tight, firm, or strict, or to relax.
items.ex_en: He had to loosen his tight safety harness after sitting in the harness for hours.
items.ex_zh: 在安全带里坐了几个小时后，他不得不把勒紧的背带调松一些。
items.ex2_en: The knot loosened slowly until the heavy luggage slid off the cart.
items.ex2_zh: 绳结慢慢松动，直到沉重的行李从推车上滑落下来。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make or become less tight, taut, or rigid (esp. ropes or cables)
items.ex_en: The crew must slacken the suspension stays to avoid structural distortion under thermal stress.
items.ex_zh: 机组人员必须放松悬索撑条，以防止热应力导致结构变形。
items.ex2_en: The taut anchor cables slackened as the ship entered the quiet bay.
items.ex2_zh: 当船驶入平静的海湾时，紧绷的锚缆松弛了下来。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this physical frame denote reducing the structural tightness, tautness, or rigidity of a tether, knot, fastener, or grip, causing it to become lax, free, or less taut.
groups.summary_zh: 减弱缆绳、扣件或握持的张力与紧度，使物体变得松弛或便于拆解。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame indicate reducing physical, mechanical, or structural tautness, contrasting with total detachment by shifting an object or mechanism from a state of strain into one of reduced constriction or slack.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词表示减弱物理、机械或结构上的紧绷张力，不同于彻底解开或断开，侧重从高应力状态转入松弛、减压的相对状态。
groups.nuance_en: loosen: reduce tightness or grip without full removal (grip / collar / bolt) · slacken: reduce tautness or dynamic speed/vigor (rope / pace / discipline) · ease off: gradually reduce applied mechanical or figurative pressure (throttle / pressure / tension) · untighten: reversibly unscrew or unbind a tightened fitting (screw / nut / strap) · let out: enlarge dimensions by releasing spare material (seam / rope / garment)
groups.nuance_zh: loosen: 调松紧度或松开握力 (grip / collar / bolt) · slacken: 绳索或节奏力度上的放缓减力 (rope / pace / discipline) · ease off: 渐进式减轻外力、油门或紧张感 (throttle / pressure / tension) · untighten: 旋松或解开此前拧紧的构件 (screw / nut / strap) · let out: 放出余料以放宽衣物或放出绳索 (seam / rope / garment)

groups.name: Mediate & Reconcile · 调解与斡旋 (Mediate, Arbitrate, Intercede)
groups.tip: 第三方介入化解分歧冲突

items.def_en: to intervene in a dispute or difficult situation in order to help solve it
items.ex_en: The government had to step in to prevent the bank from collapsing.
items.ex_zh: 政府不得不出手干预，以防止该银行倒闭。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to settle a quarrel, dispute, or broken relationship between people
items.ex_en: The two roommates managed to patch up their differences over a couple of beers.
items.ex_zh: 这两个室友喝了几杯啤酒，终于重修旧好了。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to resolve differences, disputes, or difficulties through discussion
items.ex_en: The negotiating teams met again this afternoon to iron out the remaining contractual disputes.
items.ex_zh: 谈判小组今天下午再次会面，以化解剩余的合同争议。

items.def_zh: 居中调解，斡旋；起媒介作用
items.def_en: to act as an intermediary or mediator between opposing parties to resolve a conflict
items.ex_en: Neutral diplomats arrived swiftly to intermediate between the two hostile border forces.
items.ex_zh: 中立国外交官迅速赶到，在交战的两国边防军之间斡旋调停。

items.def_zh: 调解，斡旋；促成（协议、和平等）
items.def_en: 1. to intervene between people or parties in a dispute to help them reach an agreement 2. to bring about an agreement or settlement through mediation
items.ex_en: A seasoned ombudsman was chosen to mediate the fierce labor dispute at the port.
items.ex_zh: 一名经验丰富的调解员被选派去斡旋港口激烈的劳资纠纷。

items.def_en: (+ with/to) to restore friendly relations between estranged people or harmonise conflicting viewpoints
items.ex_en: The ambassador attempted to reconcile the estranged factions before the impending peace summit.
items.ex_zh: 大使试图在即将召开的和平峰会前让决裂的派系恢复和好。

items.def_en: (+ with/between) to act as a formal link between groups to promote cooperation and resolve friction
items.ex_en: The senior officer will liaise between the municipal council and aggrieved community leaders.
items.ex_zh: 高级官员将在市议会与愤怒的社区领袖之间进行沟通斡旋。

items.def_en: (+ for/with) to intervene on behalf of another party to settle a dispute or obtain mercy
items.ex_en: The church elder offered to intercede with the governor on the prisoner's behalf.
items.ex_zh: 教会长老提议代囚犯向州长求情调解。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ between/on) to officially judge and settle a dispute between two opposing parties as an appointed neutral judge
items.ex_en: An independent panel was formally appointed to arbitrate between the union and management.
items.ex_zh: 一个独立小组被正式指派在工会与管理层之间进行仲裁。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe a neutral third party stepping between disputing factions to facilitate negotiation, settle conflicts, or reconcile broken relations. They range from neutral diplomatic facilitation to legally binding resolution or personal plea-making.
groups.summary_zh: 第三方介入冲突各方之间进行斡旋、居中调解或劝和，以达成共识或和解。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame encompass diplomatic or interpersonal intervention to settle disputes and restore harmony, distinguishing themselves from partisan confrontation by positioning an agent as a neutral conduit or pacifier.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词涵盖调解争议、修复关系的中立干预行为，与选边站队的对抗不同，侧重扮演中介者、润滑剂或和解推手角色。
groups.nuance_en: step in: decisively intervene to halt an escalating crisis (crisis / brawl / fight) · mediate: formally facilitate negotiation between warring factions (dispute / truce / settlement) · reconcile: restore harmony between estranged parties or doctrines (differences / factions / accounts) · intercede: plead or intervene on behalf of an endangered party (on behalf of / with authorities / for a victim) · iron out: smooth away minor residual obstacles or disagreements (differences / details / wrinkles)
groups.nuance_zh: step in: 关键时刻果断介入制止恶化 (crisis / brawl / fight) · mediate: 正式以中立身份促成协商 (dispute / truce / settlement) · reconcile: 弥合两极对立或消解差异使之调和 (differences / factions / accounts) · intercede: 为处于弱势的第三方求情斡旋 (on behalf of / with authorities / for a victim) · iron out: 熨平成熟协议前残留的细小摩擦 (differences / details / wrinkles)

groups.name: Melodic & Folk Vocalization · 吟唱与民歌欢唱 (Lilt, Yodel, Carol)
groups.tip: 欢快吟咏或用约德尔调高亢歌唱

items.def_en: to sing in accompaniment with another singer, recording, or group
items.ex_en: The whole audience began to sing along with the cheerful chorus of the ballad.
items.ex_zh: 全场观众都开始跟着这首民谣欢快的副歌一起合唱。

items.def_en: To sing madrigals, especially unaccompanied secular part-songs from the Renaissance period.
items.ex_en: Voices madrigaled softly under the stone arches, evoking the grace of the Renaissance.
items.ex_zh: 歌声在石拱门下悠悠唱和，唤起了文艺复兴时期的优雅。

items.def_zh: 轻快地哼唱；欢快地唱出；轻快地跳动
items.def_en: To speak or sing with a pleasant, gentle, rising-and-falling rhythm.
items.ex_en: The maid would lilt an airy mountain melody while gathering fresh morning blossoms.
items.ex_zh: 少女采摘清晨鲜花时，总会轻快地哼唱起空灵的山调。

items.def_en: to hum or sing softly in a low, gentle, and soothing tone
items.ex_en: The mother began to croon a soothing lullaby until the baby fell asleep.
items.ex_zh: 母亲轻声低唱起舒缓的摇篮曲，直到婴儿安然入睡。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to sing a song vigorously, loudly, and with great spirit
items.ex_en: We watched the rock star belt out his greatest hits with incredible energy.
items.ex_zh: 我们看着这位摇滚巨星充满活力地放声高歌他的成名曲。

items.def_en: to sing joyful songs or carols, especially happily or house-to-house at Christmas
items.ex_en: Villagers gathered in the snowy square to carol joyful hymns under flickering lanterns.
items.ex_zh: 村民们聚集在白雪皑皑的广场上，在摇曳的灯笼下欢唱赞美诗。

items.def_en: to sing or play an amorous piece of music specifically for someone
items.ex_en: He brought his acoustic guitar to serenade his beloved beneath her open balcony.
items.ex_zh: 他带着原声吉他来到心上人敞开的阳台下为她唱小夜曲。

items.def_en: to sing or utter with a rapid, vibratory alternation between adjacent vocal pitches
items.ex_en: The prima donna began to trill the intricate notes with astonishing, effortless clarity.
items.ex_zh: 歌剧女主角以令人惊叹的自如与清晰婉转唱出繁复的颤音。

items.def_zh: 用约德尔调歌唱（真假嗓音反复变换地唱）
items.def_en: To sing a tune while switching rapidly between a normal chest voice and a high falsetto voice.
items.ex_en: The Alpine guide showed the tourists how to yodel across the misty valley.
items.ex_zh: 阿尔卑斯山向导向游客们示范如何用约德尔唱腔呼应穿过雾气弥漫的山谷。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures stylized, melodic, or traditional folk singing techniques, highlighting distinctive rhythms, vocal shifts, and festive performances.
groups.summary_zh: 指带有特定旋律律动、民俗技巧或欢庆性质的歌唱与吟咏方式。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe musical vocal performance characterized by specific rhythmic inflection, traditional folk stylization, or atmospheric delivery, contrasting with speech or plain singing via distinct vocal timbre and festive intent.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词特指带有特定节奏律动、传统民俗色彩或特定氛围的发声歌唱，与常规口语或平白唱歌不同，强调独特音色、曲调与欢唱语境。
groups.nuance_en: lilt: sing or speak with a buoyant, swinging cadence (melody / song / tune) · croon: hum or sing softly in a low, intimate, sentimental tone (ballad / lullaby / tune) · belt out: project a song with tremendous, raw vocal volume (anthem / hit / tune) · carol: sing joyfully, especially festive or Christmas songs (carols / praise / hymns) · trill: produce rapid musical vibrato or warbling notes (voice / song / laugh)
groups.nuance_zh: lilt: 带有轻快跳跃的节律吟唱 (melody / song / tune) · croon: 轻柔低回、温情脉脉地低吟浅唱 (ballad / lullaby / tune) · belt out: 扯开嗓门大声高歌放声唱 (anthem / hit / tune) · carol: 欢欣雀跃地齐声歌唱，尤指节日颂歌 (carols / praise / hymns) · trill: 快速颤音发声或如鸟鸣般婉转清脆 (voice / song / laugh)

groups.name: Melt & Coalesce · 熔聚与融合 (Fuse, Bead)
groups.tip: 熔融一体合二为一

items.def_en: to blend or coalesce into a single combined mass or stream, especially through melting or flowing
items.ex_en: The bright wax crayons melted under the hot sun and began to run together.
items.ex_zh: 鲜艳的蜡笔在烈日下融化，开始流淌汇合到一起。

items.def_zh: （液体）聚集成珠，形成珠状；用珠子装饰
items.def_en: 1. (of liquid) To gather or condense into small, round drops on a surface. 2. To decorate or adorn something with beads.
items.ex_en: Droplets of condensation started to bead on the cold surface of the pitcher.
items.ex_zh: 凝结的水汽开始在冰冷的水壶表面聚成一颗颗水珠。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to join permanently into a single mass through intense heat or chemical cohesion
items.ex_en: The intense heat caused the adjoining alloy plates to fuse together permanently.
items.ex_zh: 高温致使相邻的合金板永久熔合为一体。
items.ex2_en: The welder fused together the two metal pipes using an oxyacetylene torch.
items.ex2_zh: 焊工用氧乙炔喷炬将两根金属管熔接在一起。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to melt a metal or substance completely so that it forms a molten mass
items.ex_en: The silversmith intends to melt down the damaged antique cutlery to make jewelry.
items.ex_zh: 银匠打算把破损的古董餐具全部熔炼成液体以制作首饰。
items.ex2_en: The huge block of ice melted down completely under the hot sun.
items.ex2_zh: 巨大的冰块在炽热的阳光下完全融化了。

items.def_en: to blend smoothly or merge distinct substances into a harmonious whole
items.ex_en: The molten colors melded into a singular, gleaming sunset across the evening sky.
items.ex_zh: 融化的色彩在黄昏的天空中相融交织，化为一片璀璨的晚霞。
items.ex2_en: The talented director melded classic theater with modern cinematic effects seamlessly.
items.ex2_zh: 这位才华横溢的导演将古典戏剧与现代电影特效无缝融合。

items.def_en: to come together to form one larger mass or whole
items.ex_en: Separate molten droplets began to coalesce into a single mercury pool upon the glass.
items.ex_zh: 分散的熔融水银珠开始在玻璃表面凝聚成一个整体。

items.def_zh: （使）熔合，（使）融合；（因保险丝熔断而）断电
items.def_en: 1. To join or blend together into a single whole, especially by melting. 2. To stop working, or make an electrical device stop working, because a fuse has melted.
items.ex_en: Extreme heat from the blast furnace caused the surrounding metal fragments to fuse.
items.ex_zh: 高炉产生的极度高温使周围的金属碎片熔合在一起。
items.ex2_en: The technician fused the electric wires together using a specialized soldering tool.
items.ex2_zh: 技术人员用专用焊接工具将电线熔接在一起。

items.def_en: to alloy with mercury, or combine physically into a unified body
items.ex_en: The chemist attempted to amalgamate the fine gold dust with pure liquid mercury.
items.ex_zh: 化学家试图将纯净的液态水银与极细的黄金粉末混汞齐化。
items.ex2_en: The two competing corporations amalgamated into an industry powerhouse last year.
items.ex2_zh: 两家竞争的公司于去年合并为一家行业巨头。

items.def_en: to bond powdered material into a coherent mass by heating without melting
items.ex_en: Fiery kilns sinter the crushed mineral grains into smooth, enduring slabs of stone.
items.ex_zh: 炽热的窑炉将粉碎的矿石微粒烧结成平整而坚固的石板。
items.ex2_en: Fine ceramic powder will sinter into durable tiles at elevated temperatures.
items.ex2_zh: 精细的陶瓷粉末在高温下会烧结成耐用的瓷砖。

groups.summary_en: These verbs describe physical particles or separate elements combining into a single mass through heating, surface tension, or cohesive pressure. 'Bead' focuses on surface-tension droplet cohesion, whereas 'fuse' denotes joining permanently into a continuum under heat or metallurgical bonding.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过熔解、张力或热力凝聚使分离部分熔合为一体。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame express the blending, melting, or molecular bonding of disparate elements into a unified whole, differing from mechanical mixture because the constituent boundaries liquefy, dissolve, or permanently integrate.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词指不同组分熔合、凝并或分子级接合为统一整体，与机械混合不同，侧重原边界消融、液化或永久性一体化。
groups.nuance_en: fuse: bind tightly into one via extreme heat or pressure (metal / factions / elements) · melt down: liquefy solid metal/ore, often to reuse (scrap / gold / reactor) · coalesce: gradually merge distinct parts into a coherent entity (ideas / interests / groups) · meld: smoothly combine qualitative traits into a harmonious blend (tradition / flavors / styles) · amalgamate: formally merge organizations, substances, or populations into a body (companies / unions / assets)
groups.nuance_zh: fuse: 借由高温或压力烧结、熔合为一体 (metal / factions / elements) · melt down: 彻底熔毁为液态以重塑 (scrap / gold / reactor) · coalesce: 分散的力量或碎片自发凝聚聚拢 (ideas / interests / groups) · meld: 和谐顺滑地使风格或特性交融 (tradition / flavors / styles) · amalgamate: 正式整合或合并机构实体 (companies / unions / assets)

groups.name: Mental Disorientation & Perplexity · 困惑与迷惘 (Confuse, Perplex, Bewilder)
groups.tip: 思维混乱令人头昏脑胀

items.def_en: (+ sb) to confuse someone cognitively so they cannot think clearly or understand
items.ex_en: All those complicated tax equations always mix up the new accountant completely.
items.ex_zh: 所有那些复杂的税务计算公式总把那位新会计彻底搞糊涂。

items.def_zh: 使困惑；打乱（心神或思路）
items.def_en: (+ sb) to confuse, perplex, or disorient someone unexpectedly
items.ex_en: Her sudden change of topic completely threw off the speaker mid-sentence.
items.ex_zh: 她突然转换话题，彻底打乱了演讲者说到一半的思路。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to confuse or perplex someone so that they make a mistake or become bewildered
items.ex_en: The unexpected logic riddle was clearly designed to trip up even smart candidates.
items.ex_zh: 这道出人意料的逻辑谜题显然是为了把聪明的应聘者也难倒。

items.def_en: to completely puzzle or defeat comprehension by being inscrutable or complex
items.ex_en: The sudden disappearance of the cargo ship continues to baffle naval investigators.
items.ex_zh: 货船的突然失踪仍让海军调查人员感到极其困惑。

items.def_zh: 使发昏，使茫然，使不知所措
items.def_en: (often passive) To make someone unable to think clearly, especially because of a shock, blow, or surprise.
items.ex_en: The blunt blow to his helmet left the linebacker utterly dazed for minutes.
items.ex_zh: 头盔上遭受的一记重击让这名线卫整整发懵了好几分钟。

items.def_en: To confuse and worry someone by being complicated or difficult to understand.
items.ex_en: These contradictory financial figures will surely perplex the board of directors tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 这些相互矛盾的财务数据明天肯定会让董事会深感困惑。

items.def_en: to utterly bewilder someone by being curious, inexplicable, or secretive
items.ex_en: The magician's impossible vanishing trick continued to mystify everyone in the crowded theater.
items.ex_zh: 魔术师神乎其技的消失魔术让剧场里挤满的观众百思不得其解。

items.def_zh: 使迷惑，使不知所措，使昏头转向
items.def_en: (often passive) To confuse someone completely, especially by being complicated, unexpected, or chaotic.
items.ex_en: The convoluted subway map in Tokyo can easily bewilder first-time international visitors.
items.ex_zh: 东京错综复杂的地铁线路图极易使初次来访的外国游客昏头转向。

items.def_en: to confuse the mind or senses of someone so they cannot think clearly
items.ex_en: The dense legal jargon served only to befuddle the elderly plaintiffs in court.
items.ex_zh: 晦涩难懂的法律行话只会让法庭上年迈的原告们更加糊涂。

groups.summary_en: A situation or stimulus compromises an agent's cognitive clarity, rendering them unable to comprehend, reason, or react. The frame ranges from intellectual bafflement to overwhelming, dizzying disorientation.
groups.summary_zh: 使人陷入理解障碍、认知混乱或思维茫然，强调心智紊乱程度。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame detail cognitive dislocation, epistemic paralysis, or tactical disorientation, differing from simple ignorance by emphasizing the disorienting breakdown of comprehension against complex or contradictory data.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词刻画认知错乱、理解受阻或战术困惑，与单纯的“无知”不同，强调面对复杂或矛盾信息时认知机制的宕机与迷惘。
groups.nuance_en: confuse: scramble mental clarity or blur categorical distinctions (facts / issues / audience) · baffle: completely stump intellect with no apparent solution (detectives / scientists / logic) · perplex: induce anxious cognitive entanglement with complicated puzzles (experts / minds / question) · bewilder: deeply disorient and overwhelm senses or judgment (tourists / crowds / onlookers) · mystify: obscure comprehension behind an aura of deliberate inscrutability (critics / audience / investigators)
groups.nuance_zh: confuse: 造成认知混乱或混淆范畴 (facts / issues / audience) · baffle: 完全超出理智理解范围令人束手无策 (detectives / scientists / logic) · perplex: 因复杂因果令人陷入焦虑冥思 (experts / minds / question) · bewilder: 令人眼花缭乱、晕头转向不知所措 (tourists / crowds / onlookers) · mystify: 神秘莫测难以捉摸让人百思不解 (critics / audience / investigators)

groups.name: Mention & Allude · 提及与引述 (Cite, Mention, Allude)
groups.tip: 口头顺带提及或特意指出

items.def_en: to introduce a subject or topic for discussion in conversation
items.ex_en: She decided to bring up the budget deficit during the weekly staff meeting.
items.ex_zh: 她决定在每周员工例会上提出预算赤字的问题。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to mention or refer to a fact or situation as evidence or an example
items.ex_en: Economists constantly point to rising commodity prices as evidence of ongoing inflation.
items.ex_zh: 经济学家们经常列举不断上涨的大宗商品价格作为当前通胀的证据。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to mention or speak about someone or something briefly or directly
items.ex_en: In his opening remarks, the chairman did not refer to the recent scandal.
items.ex_zh: 董事长在开场白中并未提及最近的丑闻。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to mention or discuss a subject briefly or indirectly
items.ex_en: The speaker only touched on the budget deficit without providing any concrete solutions.
items.ex_zh: 发言人只是简略提到了财政赤字，并未给出任何具体解决方案。

items.def_zh: 提及，指出；注意，留意；记录
items.def_en: 1. To mention or point out something. 2. To pay attention to or notice something. 3. To record or write down something.
items.ex_en: The committee report was careful to note several major flaws in the design.
items.ex_zh: 委员会的报告特别指出了设计中的几处重大缺陷。

items.def_zh: 谈及，提及；参考，查阅；转介，推荐
items.def_en: 1. (+ to) To mention, talk about, or direct attention to someone or something. 2. (+ to) To consult or look at something for information. 3. (+ to) To send or direct someone to a person or place for help or advice.
items.ex_en: The lecturer did not refer to the historical context of the novel today.
items.ex_zh: 讲师今天没有提及这部小说的历史背景。

items.def_zh: 引用，引证；附参考资料，提及
items.def_en: To mention, refer to, or cite sources or references in a work.
items.ex_en: Scholars must properly reference all archival primary documents in their published dissertations.
items.ex_zh: 学者必须在出版的论文中规范引用所有档案一手文献。

items.def_en: (+ to) to mention someone or something in a brief or indirect way
items.ex_en: The editorial seemed to allude to corrupt practices within the municipal department.
items.ex_zh: 这篇社论似乎在暗指市政部门内部存在的腐败行为。

items.def_en: to mention something as proof, an example, or authority in academic discourse
items.ex_en: The defense attorney will cite three historical Supreme Court precedents to support her argument.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师将援引三项最高法院的历史判例来支持她的论点。

groups.summary_en: Speakers or writers introduce a topic, text, or person into discourse briefly, directly or indirectly. The spectrum spans brief conversational mentions to formal academic citations and oblique allusions.
groups.summary_zh: 在言谈或文本中简略引出、援引或间接影射某人某事。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame represent directing discourse or attention fleetingly or deliberately toward a subject, differing from exhaustive exposition by their brevity, secondary relevance, or indirect pointer function.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词指在话语中将注意力短暂或刻意引向某主题，与详尽阐述不同，侧重简要提及、次要关联或间接线索指向。
groups.nuance_en: mention: name or state casually and briefly in passing (name / incident / matter) · bring up: introduce a sensitive or new topic into dialogue (subject / point / past) · touch on: treat a theme only cursorily without full analysis (topic / themes / issue) · refer to: explicitly denote, direct to, or cite an entity (manual / individual / passage) · allude: refer to something obliquely or playfully without overt naming (events / poetry / scandal)
groups.nuance_zh: mention: 顺带顺口提及、轻描淡写点到 (name / incident / matter) · bring up: 主动提出敏感或全新议题 (subject / point / past) · touch on: 仅作浮光掠影的浅显触及 (topic / themes / issue) · refer to: 明确指称、查阅或引述 (manual / individual / passage) · allude: 暗指、不指名道姓地含蓄影射 (events / poetry / scandal)

groups.name: Meter & Gauge Instruments · 仪表测度与计量 (Meter, Gauge, Calibrate)
groups.tip: 借助标尺衡量尺度

items.def_zh: 用仪器测出；测得（速度或时间）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to register or measure a specific speed, time, or rate using a timing or measuring instrument
items.ex_en: The sports sedan clocked in at over two hundred miles per hour on radar.
items.ex_zh: 雷达测速仪测出这辆运动轿车的时速超过了两百英里。

items.def_zh: 用量规测定；依仪表校量
items.def_en: (+ sth) to determine dimensions, clearances, or levels against a standard gauge or dial
items.ex_en: The machinist used a micrometer to gauge off the precise clearance between gears.
items.ex_zh: 机械师用千分尺比照量规测定了齿轮之间的精确间隙。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to measure a specific quantity of something using an instrument or container
items.ex_en: The chef carefully measured out the spices for the recipe.
items.ex_zh: 大厨仔细称量出食谱所需的香料。

items.def_zh: 按比例测量，按比例绘制；衡量，过秤称；攀登；刮去……的鳞片（或水垢）
items.def_en: 1. to measure, estimate, or draw according to a scale 2. to weigh something on a scale 3. to climb up or over a steep surface 4. to remove scales or incrustations from
items.ex_en: The structural architect had to scale the blueprint dimensions carefully before construction began.
items.ex_zh: 在开工前，结构建筑师必须仔细按比例测量蓝图的尺寸。

items.def_zh: 用仪表计量，用仪器测量；按定量供给
items.def_en: 1. to measure or record the amount of something using an instrument or meter 2. to release or distribute something in measured amounts
items.ex_en: Advanced flow sensors meter the chemical volume delivered to the main mixing chamber.
items.ex_zh: 先进的流量传感器通过仪表计量输送至主混合室的化学药剂体积。

items.def_en: to measure the speed, time, or mileage of a moving object using a stopwatch or instrument
items.ex_en: A handheld radar gun clocked the speeding motorcycle at ninety miles per hour.
items.ex_zh: 手持雷达测速枪测出超速摩托车的速度为每小时九十英里。

items.def_en: to measure dimensions, pressure, or liquid volume accurately using a gauge or device
items.ex_en: The technician used a pressure dial to gauge the gas level accurately.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员用压力表精准测量了气体压力值。

items.def_en: to determine or express the exact operational value or magnitude in numerical terms
items.ex_en: The automated diagnostic software can precisely quantify the exact loss in signal strength.
items.ex_zh: 该自动化诊断软件能够精确量化信号强度的确切损耗数值。

items.def_en: to adjust or mark an instrument so that its measurements strictly match a standard
items.ex_en: The master astronomer calibrated the brass astrolabe against the unchanging celestial spheres.
items.ex_zh: 博学的天文学家参照恒定不变的天球细细标定了黄铜星盘的刻度。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote determining quantities, dimensions, or discharge rates using standardized instruments, scales, dials, or calibrated metering mechanisms.
groups.summary_zh: 使用仪表、仪器或标准刻度来定量测定与校准。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe determining physical, temporal, or spatial quantities using calibrated instruments or calculated indices, contrasting with subjective guessing through its reliance on standardized metrics and readouts.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词指借助校准仪器或量化指标测定物理、时间或空间数值，与主观揣测不同，强调依托标准化度量衡与示数。
groups.nuance_en: gauge: measure dimensions, capacity, or qualitative sentiment (pressure / depth / reaction) · meter: measure and regulate fluid or energy flow via continuous counter (water / electricity / gas) · clock: record precise speed or elapsed operating time using chronometer (speed / sprint / laps) · quantify: convert qualitative data into precise numerical values (risks / benefits / damage) · scale: measure or adjust dimensions according to proportional ratio (drawings / model / heights)
groups.nuance_zh: gauge: 用量规测量物理量或评估情绪反应 (pressure / depth / reaction) · meter: 仪表连续计量并调控流体或能耗 (water / electricity / gas) · clock: 用计时器精准测定速度或耗时 (speed / sprint / laps) · quantify: 将定性事实转化为精准数值指标 (risks / benefits / damage) · scale: 按比例尺测算或等比例缩放尺寸 (drawings / model / heights)

groups.name: Minor Joint & Extremity Trauma · 扭伤与末端挫伤 (Sprain, Stub, Tweak)
groups.tip: 踢撞脚趾或运动扭伤关节

items.def_en: to slightly pull, twist, or injure a joint, ligament, or muscle
items.ex_en: I think I tweaked my shoulder while lifting that heavy wooden crate yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 我想我昨天搬那个沉重的木箱时不小心微扭了一下肩膀。

items.def_en: to injure a muscle or tendon by overextending or overexerting it
items.ex_en: The sprinter was devastated to strain his hamstring during the preliminary heats.
items.ex_zh: 短跑运动员在预赛中拉伤了腘绳肌，感到十分沮丧。

items.def_zh: 碰伤，踢伤（脚趾）；掐灭（烟头）
items.def_en: 1. To hurt your toe by accidentally striking it against a hard object. 2. (stub out) To extinguish a cigarette by pressing the end against a surface.
items.ex_en: He cursed loudly when he stubbed his bare toe against the door frame.
items.ex_zh: 当他的光脚趾踢在门框上碰伤时，他大声咒骂了起来。

items.def_en: To injure a joint such as your ankle or wrist by suddenly twisting it, causing swelling and pain without breaking bone.
items.ex_en: She slipped on the icy sidewalk and managed to sprain her left wrist.
items.ex_zh: 她在结冰的人行道上滑倒，不慎扭伤了左手腕。

items.def_zh: 拉伤；使（关节或韧带）扭伤错位
items.def_en: (+ sth) to injure a muscle, tendon, or extremity by wrenching or overstretching
items.ex_en: The multinational corporation decided to pull out of the unprofitable market.
items.ex_zh: 该跨国公司决定退出这一无利可图的市场。

items.def_zh: 使（关节等）脱臼；扭伤（肢体）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to dislocate or slightly wrench a joint, bone, or muscle in the body
items.ex_en: The awkward fall during gymnastics practice managed to put out his elbow joint.
items.ex_zh: 体操训练中的一次别扭跌落导致他的肘关节脱臼了。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to wrench or sprain a joint or extremity by sudden turning or twisting
items.ex_en: He slipped on the icy pavement and managed to twist around his left ankle painfully.
items.ex_zh: 他在结冰的人行道上滑了一下，结果痛苦地扭伤了左脚踝。

items.def_en: to injure a joint or limb through a sudden, violent twisting motion
items.ex_en: The awkward tackle caused him to wrench his knee during the final minutes of play.
items.ex_zh: 在比赛最后几分钟里，那次别扭的抢断导致他猛扭了膝盖。

items.def_en: to force a bone out of its normal position at a joint
items.ex_en: The heavy impact against the dashboard threatened to dislocate the driver's right shoulder.
items.ex_zh: 撞向仪表盘的巨大冲击力险些使司机的右肩脱臼。

groups.summary_en: Covers accidental physical injury to joints, tendons, toes, or fingers caused by sudden twisting, wrenching, or colliding with a blunt obstacle, falling short of bone fractures.
groups.summary_zh: 指关节、韧带或脚趾等因扭转、撞击而发生的非骨折性损伤。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame signify acute, non-lethal mechanical injury to joints, tendons, or peripheral extremities caused by sudden unnatural bending, pulling, or striking, distinct from deep fractures or lacerations.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词特指关节、肌腱或肢体末端因突发性扭曲、牵拉或撞击导致的急性非致命轻度创伤，与骨折或贯穿创伤不同。
groups.nuance_en: sprain: violently twist a joint, stretching or tearing ligaments (ankle / wrist / joint) · strain: overexert or tear muscle fibers/tendons through excess tension (back / hamstring / muscle) · stub: strike a toe or finger painfully against a hard blunt obstacle (toe / finger / foot) · tweak: lightly wrench, twist, or irritate a joint or muscle (hamstring / knee / back) · wrench: violently and painfully pull or twist a joint out of position (shoulder / knee / neck)
groups.nuance_zh: sprain: 关节扭扭撕拉韧带 (ankle / wrist / joint) · strain: 过度牵拉导致肌肉肌腱劳损拉伤 (back / hamstring / muscle) · stub: 末端指/趾踢到钝物发生挫撞 (toe / finger / foot) · tweak: 肌肉或关节轻微别扭挫痛 (hamstring / knee / back) · wrench: 强力猛烈扭拽错位 (shoulder / knee / neck)

groups.name: Misunderstand & Misjudge · 误解与误判 (Misinterpret, Misread, Misjudge)
groups.tip: 从读错细节到全盘误判

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to confuse one person or thing with another, or mistake the meaning of something
items.ex_en: I always mix up those identical twins whenever they wear matching school uniforms.
items.ex_zh: 每当那对同卵双胞胎穿一模一样的校服时，我总是把他们搞混。

items.def_en: 1. To misunderstand or misjudge a situation, person, or intention. 2. To read words, figures, or symbols incorrectly.
items.ex_en: The rookie detective completely misread the suspect's calm demeanor during the tense interrogation.
items.ex_zh: 在紧张的审讯中，这名新警察完全误判了嫌疑人平静的神态。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to fail to understand or misinterpret a person, statement, or fact
items.ex_en: Don't get me wrong; I really appreciate your help despite my initial hesitation.
items.ex_zh: 别误会我；尽管起初有所犹豫，但我真的很感激你的帮助。

items.def_en: To fail to understand someone or something correctly, especially words, intentions, or true meaning.
items.ex_en: Foreign tourists often misunderstand local dining customs without clear guidance from bilingual menus.
items.ex_zh: 如果没有双语菜单的明确引导，外国游客常常会误解当地的就餐习俗。

items.def_zh: 误解（misunderstand的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of misunderstand; to have failed to understand someone or something correctly.
items.ex_en: The quiet employee felt deeply misunderstood by his manager after the sudden performance review.
items.ex_zh: 在突如其来的绩效考评之后，这位沉默寡言的员工觉得经理极大地误解了自己。

items.def_en: To understand, explain, or translate something wrongly.
items.ex_en: Critics argued that the commentator chose to deliberately misinterpret the politician's economic remarks.
items.ex_zh: 批评人士认为，这位评论员蓄意曲解了那位政客的经济言论。

items.def_en: to interpret words, gestures, or actions in an unintended and often unfavorable way
items.ex_en: The diplomat worried that foreign delegates might misconstrue his firm stance as open hostility.
items.ex_zh: 这位外交官担心外国代表可能会将他的坚定立场曲解为公然的敌意。

items.def_zh: 看错；错误评判（人品或形势）
items.def_en: to form an incorrect or unfair opinion of a person's character or the scale of an event
items.ex_en: Experienced investors can still misjudge market sentiment when sudden geopolitical tensions arise unexpectedly.
items.ex_zh: 当地缘政治局势出人意料地骤然紧张时，经验丰富的投资者也可能会误判市场情绪。

items.def_zh: 算错；对局势做出错误推断或预估
items.def_en: to assess a situation or future risk incorrectly, leading to tactical or strategic error
items.ex_en: Military leadership severely miscalculated the adversary's technological capabilities prior to the costly offensive.
items.ex_zh: 在发起损失惨重的攻势之前，军方领导层严重误判了敌方的技术实力。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe cognitive failure to correctly grasp, interpret, or evaluate meaning, intentions, or situations. They range from innocent cognitive lapses in comprehension to severe errors in appraisal and flawed strategic judgment.
groups.summary_zh: 未能正确理解、释读或评估信息与局势，程度由浅层误解递增至严重误判。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame detail failures in cognitive decoding, textual interpretation, or interpersonal appraisal, moving from simple oversight to active erroneous conceptualization of meaning or character.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词表述认知解码、文本阐释或人际研判上的偏差与错误，从轻微疏忽递进到对内涵或人格的完全误读与误判。
groups.nuance_en: misunderstand: fail to grasp correct meaning or intent (intentions / words / concept) · misread: decode text, body language, or situations incorrectly (situation / signs / room) · misinterpret: construct an erroneous analytical meaning from data (data / results / silence) · misconstrue: distort meaning toward an unfair, uncharitable interpretation (words / motives / actions) · misjudge: appraise character, capability, or distance inaccurately (character / distance / opponent)
groups.nuance_zh: misunderstand: 基础语义上的理解不准或产生误会 (intentions / words / concept) · misread: 察言观色或读物解读错误 (situation / signs / room) · misinterpret: 对数据、事实作出错误的逻辑阐释 (data / results / silence) · misconstrue: 带有曲解、恶意揣测意图意味的误读 (words / motives / actions) · misjudge: 对人品能力、距离态势作出失准判断 (character / distance / opponent)

groups.name: Mitigate Pain or Severity · 缓解与减轻 (Alleviate, Soften)
groups.tip: 降低硬度或缓和剧烈冲突

items.def_en: to make pain, tension, or a burdensome situation less severe
items.ex_en: A warm bath and herbal tea helped ease the persistent tension in her shoulders.
items.ex_zh: 温水浴和草药茶有助于缓解她肩部持续的紧绷感。
items.ex2_en: Her severe headache eased noticeably after she rested in a dark room.
items.ex2_zh: 在黑暗的房间里休息后，她的严重头痛明显减轻了。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make something less forceful, harsh, painful, or severe
items.ex_en: The editor advised the young author to tone down the harsher criticism in chapter three.
items.ex_zh: 编辑建议这位年轻作者缓和第三章中过于尖锐的批评。

items.def_zh: 减轻（冲击、损失）；为……提供缓冲
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to protect someone or reduce the painful impact or severity of a blow or shock
items.ex_en: Government emergency subsidies were designed to cushion vulnerable households against sudden price surges.
items.ex_zh: 政府的紧急补贴旨在为困难家庭提供缓冲，以减轻物价突涨带来的冲击。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to reduce the sharpness, pain, or severity of something (as in taking the edge off)
items.ex_en: A couple of pain relievers will quickly take off the worst of the headache.
items.ex_zh: 吃几片止痛药能迅速减弱最剧烈的头痛。

items.def_en: to remove or significantly reduce unpleasant feelings, discomfort, or pressure
items.ex_en: Regular physical therapy sessions helped relieve the intense chronic pressure in his lower back.
items.ex_zh: 定期的物理治疗帮助他纾解了腰部强烈的慢性压迫感。

items.def_en: (formal) to make the harmful effects of something bad, harsh, or serious less severe
items.ex_en: Extensive reforestation programs were implemented to mitigate the catastrophic severity of recurring seasonal floods.
items.ex_zh: 大规模的植树造林计划得以推行，以减轻季节性洪水反复肆虐的严重危害。

items.def_en: 1. To become less severe, harsh, or violent, or to make something so. 2. To become soft, or to make something soft.
items.ex_en: The defense attorney hoped that community service records would soften the judge's impending verdict.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师希望社区服务记录能够促使法官在即将宣判时量刑从轻。
items.ex2_en: The butter softened on the kitchen counter within fifteen minutes.
items.ex2_zh: 黄油在厨房台面上十五分钟内就变软了。

items.def_en: 1. (formal) To make pain, suffering, or a difficult problem less severe.
items.ex_en: International relief organizations worked tirelessly to alleviate starvation across the war-torn border territories.
items.ex_zh: 国际救援组织孜孜不倦地工作，以缓解饱受战火蹂躏的边境地区的饥荒。

items.def_en: (formal) to soothe or make an unpleasant feeling, anxiety, or grief less intense
items.ex_en: Kind words from old friends could scarcely assuage the grieving widow's profound sorrow.
items.ex_zh: 老朋友们的贴心抚慰，几乎无法平息这位悲痛遗孀心中的巨大悲伤。

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote reducing the severity, harshness, or painful impact of a problem, blow, grief, or physical discomfort without necessarily curing it entirely. 'Soften' emphasizes damping physical impact or harsh tone, while 'alleviate' centers on making suffering, distress, or symptoms more bearable.
groups.summary_zh: 使疼痛、困境、严苛冲击等在程度上减轻或变得可承受。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe lessening the sharpness, intensity, or painful consequence of an affliction or harsh condition, differing from complete curing or eradication by offering partial relief and abatement.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词指减轻痛苦、严苛环境或不利后果的剧烈程度，与彻底根治或铲除不同，侧重提供部分解脱、缓冲与降温降阻。
groups.nuance_en: alleviate: make suffering or shortage less severe and more bearable (poverty / pain / suffering) · relieve: free an agent from distress, pressure, or duty (pain / stress / symptoms) · mitigate: reduce the damaging severity or legal culpability of an outcome (impact / risk / damage) · ease: soothe physical discomfort or smooth friction into calm (burden / tension / pain) · soften: temper the blunt harshness or violent shock of something (blow / impact / stance)
groups.nuance_zh: alleviate: 使深重痛苦或短缺得到显著缓解 (poverty / pain / suffering) · relieve: 卸下痛苦、重压或轮班之苦 (pain / stress / symptoms) · mitigate: 降低风险、恶果危害性或法律从轻减轻 (impact / risk / damage) · ease: 舒缓身心不适或平抑社会张力 (burden / tension / pain) · soften: 缓冲直接冲击力度或放软强硬立场 (blow / impact / stance)

groups.name: Mix into Disorder or Union · 混杂与合并 (Jumble, Recombine, Muddle)
groups.tip: 搅混掺杂混杂一团

items.def_en: (+ sth) to combine different substances, elements, or items into a single mixture
items.ex_en: Carefully mix together the flour, cocoa powder, and sugar before adding melted butter.
items.ex_zh: 在加入融化的黄油之前，将面粉、可可粉和糖仔细混合在一起。
items.ex2_en: Oil and vinegar do not mix together easily without an emulsifier.
items.ex2_zh: 油和醋如果没有乳化剂就不容易混合在一起。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ with) to mix or become mixed together while keeping some distinct identities
items.ex_en: The savory aromas of roasting meats mingle freely with fragrant spices throughout the marketplace.
items.ex_zh: 烤肉的扑鼻香气与浓郁的香料味在整个市集里交织弥漫。
items.ex2_en: The bartender mingled fresh fruit juices with sparkling water to make punch.
items.ex2_zh: 调酒师将新鲜果汁与苏打水混合调制出混合果汁饮料。

items.def_zh: 使混杂、把…弄得乱七八糟
items.def_en: (+ up) to mix things together in a confusing, untidy way
items.ex_en: Rushing through the filing cabinet will only muddle the documents into complete chaos.
items.ex_zh: 匆忙翻找文件柜只会把那些文件搞得乱七八糟。

items.def_zh: 把……搞乱；杂乱地混在一起
items.def_en: (+ sth) to mix things together in a confused, disordered, or untidy way
items.ex_en: The careless postal worker managed to jumble up the numbered delivery parcels completely.
items.ex_zh: 那个粗心的邮递员把标了号码的投递包裹彻底弄混了。

items.def_zh: 使混乱；混杂（物品或次序）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to mix things up into confusion or disorder so their proper order is lost
items.ex_en: My toddler loves to muddle up the keys whenever I leave my purse open.
items.ex_zh: 只要我的手提包没拉上，我家小家伙就特别喜欢把钥匙弄得一团糟。

items.def_en: to mix up elements, order, or signals so that they are disordered or unintelligible
items.ex_en: Severe atmospheric interference began to scramble the emergency radio signals across the valley.
items.ex_zh: 强烈的大气干扰开始打乱穿过山谷的紧急无线电信号。

items.def_zh: 大杂烩般拼凑（口语/变体作动词）
items.def_en: to blend disparate ingredients or objects together without plan or pattern
items.ex_en: Amateur cooks often hodgepodge leftover pantry ingredients together into unpalatable evening stews.
items.ex_zh: 厨艺生疏的人往往把储藏室里剩下的食材胡乱拼凑在一起，炖出一锅难以下咽的晚饭。

items.def_zh: 使混乱，混杂，杂乱地堆放
items.def_en: To mix things together in a confused, disordered, or untidy way.
items.ex_en: Strong crosswinds jumble fallen autumn leaves and discarded wrappers into untidy sidewalk corners.
items.ex_zh: 强劲的侧风将秋天的落叶和废弃的包装纸乱七八糟地堆在人行道拐角处。

items.def_zh: （使）再结合，（使）重新组合，（使）复合
items.def_en: To combine again or in a different way, especially of genetic material or chemical compounds.
items.ex_en: Geneticists carefully recombine distinct viral sequences to study evolving mechanisms of cellular immunity.
items.ex_zh: 遗传学家们谨慎地重组不同的病毒序列，以研究细胞免疫的演化机制。
items.ex2_en: The separated chemical compounds recombined spontaneously when the temperature dropped.
items.ex2_zh: 当温度下降时，分离的化合物自发地重新化合。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe manipulating distinct components by physically scrambling them into confusion or bringing them together into a new combination. 'Jumble' emphasizes disorder and chaos, whereas combinations like 'recombine' and 'scramble' alter configuration.
groups.summary_zh: 强调通过搅乱次序或整合要素，使事物混杂无序或重新结合。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame capture the chaotic mixing, entangling, or disordering of items or thoughts into an indistinguishable scramble, contrasting with organized integration by its chaotic entropy and lost distinctiveness.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词捕捉将物品或思绪混杂、缠结导致的杂乱无章状态，与有序融合不同，强调混乱无序的熵增及个体特征的丧失。
groups.nuance_en: jumble: toss diverse items into a cluttered, disorganized heap (clothes / thoughts / letters) · muddle: confuse, disorient, or clumsily botch order or thought (thoughts / facts / affair) · scramble: throw orderly sequence into frantic disarray or encrypt (signals / codes / eggs) · mingle: associate or mix socially without losing separate identities (guests / scents / crowd) · mix up: confuse one entity with another due to superficial resemblance (names / dates / identities)
groups.nuance_zh: jumble: 堆叠杂乱无章、杂碎混乱 (clothes / thoughts / letters) · muddle: 搞糊涂、将思路或事态弄成一团糟 (thoughts / facts / affair) · scramble: 打乱原本次序使其混乱或加密 (signals / codes / eggs) · mingle: 在社交或环境中有机相融但保留主体 (guests / scents / crowd) · mix up: 因外形或特征相似而张冠李戴搞混 (names / dates / identities)

groups.name: Modernize & Revitalize · 更新与改造 (Modernize, Revamp, Overhaul)
groups.tip: 重焕生机或技术现代升级

items.def_en: bring up to date by incorporating the latest features or standards
items.ex_en: IT administrators decided to update the internal network protocols across all regional branch offices.
items.ex_zh: IT管理员决定在所有区域分支机构更新内部网络协议。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to improve or modernize the appearance or condition of something
items.ex_en: A vibrant coat of yellow paint will freshen up this gloomy basement hallway.
items.ex_zh: 刷上一层亮丽的黄漆能让这条阴暗的地下室走廊焕然一新。
items.ex2_en: The stuffy meeting room freshened up quickly once they opened the windows.
items.ex2_zh: 他们一打开窗户，闷热的会议室很快就恢复了清新。

items.def_en: restore something to a good or modern state of repair
items.ex_en: The municipal council secured funding to renovate the historic municipal library downtown.
items.ex_zh: 市议会获得了资金，用以整修位于市中心的历史悠久的市立图书馆。

items.def_en: give new and improved form, structure, or appearance to something
items.ex_en: The marketing department plans to revamp the company's brand identity before next spring.
items.ex_zh: 市场部门计划在明年春天之前对公司的品牌形象进行全面翻新重塑。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to repair, redecorate, and modernize an old building or item
items.ex_en: They bought a dilapidated country cottage intending to do it up completely.
items.ex_zh: 他们买下了一座破旧的乡间小屋，打算对其进行彻底的修缮与翻新。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to officially renovate, update, or completely alter the appearance or structure of something
items.ex_en: The television crew arrived early to make over the community youth recreation center.
items.ex_zh: 电视台摄制组早早赶来，准备全面改造社区青年活动中心。

items.def_en: thoroughly examine and make necessary structural repairs or modernizations
items.ex_en: Technicians will overhaul the aircraft's propulsion system before issuing full flight clearance certificates.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员将在签发全面飞行许可证之前彻底检修该飞机的推进系统。

items.def_en: To make or become modern, adopting modern equipment, techniques, or concepts.
items.ex_en: The manufacturing plant invested heavily to modernize its assembly lines with advanced robotics.
items.ex_zh: 这家制造厂投入巨资，采用先进的机器人技术来实现装配线的现代化。
items.ex2_en: Traditional agricultural communities modernized rapidly following the construction of paved roads.
items.ex2_zh: 铺好柏油路后，传统农业社区迅速实现了现代化。

items.def_zh: 革新，赋能再兴；（使）再生，（使）重生
items.def_en: 1. To revive, reform, or revitalize an area, organization, or system. 2. (biology) To regrow or cause new tissue or organs to form.
items.ex_en: Civic leaders sought visionary investments to regenerate the decaying post-industrial riverfront district.
items.ex_zh: 城市领袖们寻求前瞻性投资，以赋能再兴这片衰败的后工业滨水区。
items.ex2_en: The damaged nerve tissue regenerated completely over several months of rehabilitation.
items.ex2_zh: 受损的神经组织在数月的康复治疗中完全再生了。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe transforming outdated systems, physical assets, or communities by bringing them up to contemporary standards or revitalizing their inner vitality. They range from superficial contemporary styling to exhaustive structural renewal.
groups.summary_zh: 指对过时结构或系统进行现代化更新、全面检修或重塑生机。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe updating, restructuring, or renovating physical objects or systemic structures to conform with contemporary standards, differing from mere fixing by conferring renewed vitality and forward progress.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词指对物理实体或系统结构进行升级改造与重构，使其符合时代标准，与普通修补不同，侧重赋予新生与现代化生机。
groups.nuance_en: modernize: bring antiquated systems or plants up to contemporary standards (infrastructure / equipment / army) · revamp: substantially reconstruct appearance, marketing, or layout (image / system / lineup) · renovate: restore a building or room to good repair and freshness (apartments / houses / facades) · overhaul: dismantle, thoroughly inspect, and rebuild a system or mechanism (engine / economy / tax system) · update: bring up to date with the latest data, versions, or fashion (software / files / look)
groups.nuance_zh: modernize: 推进现代化、跟上当代标准 (infrastructure / equipment / army) · revamp: 翻新面貌、大幅改良重整 (image / system / lineup) · renovate: 对建筑物修葺一新、整修出新 (apartments / houses / facades) · overhaul: 彻底拆解大修、全盘检修革新 (engine / economy / tax system) · update: 更新版本、载入最新数据 (software / files / look)

groups.name: Moisten & Desiccate · 润燥与湿润控制 (Hydrate, Dampen, Dehydrate, Dry)
groups.tip: 增湿或除水的湿度调控

items.def_en: to increase the level of moisture in the air or a closed space
items.ex_en: Museum conservators carefully humidify sensitive exhibition galleries to preserve priceless antique parchment scrolls.
items.ex_zh: 博物馆藏品保护人员精心为敏感的展厅增湿，以保护珍贵的古老羊皮纸画卷。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to become completely dry or make something lose all moisture or moisture content
items.ex_en: Leaving fresh lumber in direct afternoon sun will quickly dry out the exterior.
items.ex_zh: 将新鲜木材直接暴露在午后烈日下，会使表层迅速干透。
items.ex2_en: The wet clay sculptures will dry out quickly near the window.
items.ex2_zh: 湿黏土雕塑在窗户旁很快就会彻底变干。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to lose all water or moisture until parched or empty
items.ex_en: Prolonged summer droughts caused seasonal irrigation ponds to dry up across the valley.
items.ex_zh: 持续的夏季干旱导致整个山谷中的季节性灌溉水塘全部干涸。
items.ex2_en: Scorching heat waves dried up the small garden stream within two weeks.
items.ex2_zh: 酷热的热浪在两周内抽干了花园里的小溪。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make a surface or material slightly moist or humid by adding water
items.ex_en: The tailor used a spray bottle to damp down the linen trousers before ironing.
items.ex_zh: 裁缝在熨烫亚麻裤子之前，先用喷雾瓶把面料弄得微湿。

items.def_en: to cause something to absorb water or moisture
items.ex_en: Marathon runners must hydrate thoroughly during long training sessions under harsh desert conditions.
items.ex_zh: 马拉松跑者在酷热沙漠环境下的长距离训练中，必须充分补充水分。
items.ex2_en: Drinking electrolyte solutions will hydrate dehydrated patients faster than plain tap water.
items.ex2_zh: 饮用电解质溶液给脱水病人补水比喝普通自来水更快。

items.def_en: to remove water completely from food or biological tissue
items.ex_en: Commercial food producers dehydrate organic apple slices to maximize shelf life without preservatives.
items.ex_zh: 商业食品生产商将有机苹果片完全脱水，以在不添加防腐剂的情况下延长保质期。
items.ex2_en: Hikers can dehydrate rapidly without drinking enough water in direct sunlight.
items.ex2_zh: 徒步旅行者在阳光直射下若不喝足够的水就会迅速脱水。

items.def_en: to make something slightly wet or moist
items.ex_en: The nurse used a sterile gauze pad to dampen the edges of the dressing.
items.ex_zh: 护士用无菌纱布块轻轻打湿敷料的边缘。

items.def_en: to add moisture to or increase the humidity of (the air or an environment)
items.ex_en: Specialized HVAC systems work around the clock to humidifier the hospital's pediatric ward.
items.ex_zh: 专用的暖通空调系统全天候运行，为医院的儿科病房持续加湿。

items.def_zh: （彻底）去除水分，使脱水，使干燥；（使）枯竭
items.def_en: 1. to remove all the moisture from something, especially to dry and preserve it 2. to cause something to become dry, lifeless, or drained of vitality
items.ex_en: Fierce desert gales desiccate unprotected crops within hours during extreme midsummer heat waves.
items.ex_zh: 在盛夏极度高温期间，肆虐的荒漠狂风会在数小时内让毫无防护的庄稼彻底枯竭脱水。
items.ex2_en: Delicate flower petals desiccate rapidly under the harsh, unshaded desert sun.
items.ex2_zh: 娇嫩的花瓣在沙漠烈日的暴晒下迅速干枯。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scenario denote altering the moisture content of an object, air, or biological tissue, encompassing adding moisture (humidifying, moistening) or removing moisture until parched (desiccating, dehydrating).
groups.summary_zh: 描述对环境或物质水分含量的调控，涵盖增湿湿润与脱水烘干两侧过程。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame cover the physical transition along the moisture spectrum from liquid saturation to total moisture extraction, contrasting with general washing by focusing squarely on hydration levels and dry states.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词涵盖在湿度谱系上的物理相变过程（从浸润补水到彻底脱水），与普通清洗不同，聚焦于含水量调控与干湿状态演变。
groups.nuance_en: hydrate: introduce water into biological cells or chemical tissue (skin / body / crystals) · dampen: make slightly wet or suppress energy/enthusiasm (cloth / spirits / sound) · humidify: increase atmospheric water vapor in an enclosed air volume (air / room / lungs) · dehydrate: remove virtually all moisture from food or physiological bodies (food / fruit / body) · dry out: allow residual moisture to completely evaporate over time (soil / clothes / timber)
groups.nuance_zh: hydrate: 为细胞生理或组织补充水分 (skin / body / crystals) · dampen: 轻微沾湿打潮，亦指压低气焰情绪 (cloth / spirits / sound) · humidify: 提高密闭空间的空气湿度 (air / room / lungs) · dehydrate: 深度脱水、拔除水分 (food / fruit / body) · dry out: 放置使残留水分完全蒸发干燥 (soil / clothes / timber)

groups.name: Moral Decline & Degradation · 堕落与道德败坏 (Backslide, Debauch, Deprave)
groups.tip: 道德品行或状态滑坡倒退

items.def_en: (+ into) to pass gradually into an inferior, weaker, or less moral state
items.ex_en: Without strict personal discipline, he began to lapse into careless, dissolute habits again.
items.ex_zh: 缺乏严格的自律，他开始再次陷入放纵散漫的不良恶习。

items.def_en: to abandon one's former moral standards, religious faith, or allegiance
items.ex_en: Disillusioned followers began to fall away from the radical movement after recent scandals.
items.ex_zh: 在近期的丑闻曝光后，心灰意冷的信徒们开始背离这个激进运动。

items.def_en: to start behaving in an immoral, unlawful, or socially unacceptable way
items.ex_en: Deprived of parental supervision, several local youths began to go astray into petty theft.
items.ex_zh: 由于缺乏父母的管教，当地几个年轻人开始误入歧途，干起了小偷小摸的勾当。

items.def_en: (+ into) to decline in moral qualities, character, or standards from a former state
items.ex_en: The bitter political debate quickly threatened to degenerate into vulgar personal attacks.
items.ex_zh: 这场激烈的政治辩论很快面临蜕变为粗俗人身攻击的危险。

items.def_en: To relapse into bad habits, sin, or lower moral standards after having made improvements.
items.ex_en: The recovering addict feared stressful environments would tempt him to backslide into substance abuse.
items.ex_zh: 这位正在康复的成瘾者担心，压力重重的环境会诱使他倒退堕落，重染毒瘾恶习。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to gradually decline into an undesirable, depraved, or debased state of behavior
items.ex_en: Unchecked greed caused the corrupt financier to sink into irredeemable moral turpitude.
items.ex_zh: 未加克制的贪婪导致这位腐败的金融家逐渐陷入了无可救药的道德败坏深渊。

items.def_en: to cause someone to turn from honesty or purity to evil or immoral practices
items.ex_en: Unscrupulous cartels often corrupt honest public officials through massive clandestine bribery schemes.
items.ex_zh: 肆无忌惮的犯罪集团常常通过巨额秘密行贿计划来腐化正直的公职人员。
items.ex2_en: Old computer files can corrupt if power shuts off during saving.
items.ex2_zh: 如果在保存过程中断电，旧计算机文件可能会损坏。

items.def_zh: 使堕落，诱导……放荡；败坏，糟蹋
items.def_en: To corrupt someone morally, especially by leading them into excessive sensual pleasures or indulgence.
items.ex_en: Seductive imperial luxuries began to debauch the once austere virtues of the legion commanders.
items.ex_zh: 极尽诱惑的帝国奢靡之风，开始败坏军团指挥官们曾经简朴自持的美德。

items.def_en: to make someone utterly wicked, morally perverted, or completely corrupt
items.ex_en: Cynics believed absolute unchecked political power would inexorably deprave even the purest ruler.
items.ex_zh: 愤世嫉俗者认为，绝对不受约束的政治权力势必会彻底腐蚀哪怕最纯洁的统治者。

groups.summary_en: A person lapses from moral rectitude into indulgence, or an external influence corrupts someone's ethics and purity. Verbs range from mild relapses in behavior to active, ruinous moral corruption.
groups.summary_zh: 主体在道德修养上倒退、滑坡，或受到外界引诱而败坏、沉沦。
groups.desc_en: Denotes downward deviation from ethical standards or virtue, distinguishing moral decay from general physical deterioration through an inherent loss of rectitude, discipline, or spiritual integrity.
groups.desc_zh: 指脱离道德准则或美德的下行堕落，与一般的物理衰退不同，它特指品行、操守或精神操练上的丧失与沉沦。
groups.nuance_en: lapse: brief or unintentional slip from standards (judgment / virtue / concentration) · backslide: relapse into abandoned sinful or bad habits (faith / addiction / progress) · degenerate: progressive decline into an inferior moral or physical state (society / conditions / standards) · corrupt: deliberate subversion of another's integrity (officials / youth / morals) · debauch: lead into sensual dissipation and depravity (innocence / mind / senses)
groups.nuance_zh: lapse: 短暂失足或偶然偏离操守 (judgment / virtue / concentration) · backslide: 倒退回旧有恶习或背弃信仰 (faith / addiction / progress) · degenerate: 逐步恶化退化至低劣状态 (society / conditions / standards) · corrupt: 蓄意腐蚀与带坏他人操守 (officials / youth / morals) · debauch: 诱使沉溺于纵欲荒淫 (innocence / mind / senses)

groups.name: Mourn & Lament · 哀悼与哀泣 (Mourn, Lament, Bewail)
groups.tip: 以泪洗面与长吁短叹

items.def_en: (+ sth) to weep, mourn, or express sorrow regarding an unfortunate event or loss
items.ex_en: It does no good to cry over broken promises once the business has failed.
items.ex_zh: 一旦生意失败，再去为违背的承诺哭泣悲叹也无济于事。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ for) to feel or show great sadness, especially because someone has died
items.ex_en: Townsfolk gathered peacefully at the historic cathedral to mourn for fallen emergency responders.
items.ex_zh: 镇民们平静地聚集在历史悠久的大教堂前，为殉职的紧急救援人员哀悼。

items.def_zh: 深切悲伤，感到极度痛苦
items.def_en: [I/T] (+ for/over) to suffer deep mental anguish resulting from a grave loss
items.ex_en: Families need adequate time and compassionate community support to grieve over heartbreaking losses.
items.ex_zh: 各个家庭都需要充足的时间和充满关怀的社区支持，来度过令人心碎的深切悲伤。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to feel or express deep sadness and distress over someone's death or loss
items.ex_en: The entire nation paused in solemn silence to grieve for victims of natural disasters.
items.ex_zh: 全国人民在肃穆的沉寂中驻足，为自然灾害中的遇难者深切哀痛。

items.def_zh: 因哀伤憔悴而死，郁郁寡欢
items.def_en: to become physically weak, waste away, or die from prolonged, intense sorrow or grief
items.ex_en: The forsaken princess retreated into solitary chambers, slowly choosing to pine away in sorrow.
items.ex_zh: 被遗弃的公主退居孤室，任由自己在长期的哀痛中郁郁消瘦憔悴。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ over/for) to express sorrow, regret, or complaint aloud or publicly
items.ex_en: Elders gathered in the village square to lament over the loss of ancient customs.
items.ex_zh: 长辈们聚集在村庄广场上，公开悲叹古老习俗的遗失消亡。

items.def_en: 1. (informal, disapproving) To cry noisily and uncontrollably while talking.
items.ex_en: The frightened little child began to blubber uncontrollably when he lost his favorite toy.
items.ex_zh: 当丢失了最心爱的玩具时，那个受惊的小孩开始语无伦次地号啕大哭。

items.def_en: 1. (literary) To express deep sorrow, grief, or regret over a loss or misfortune.
items.ex_en: Ancient bards sang mournful ballads to bewail the tragic downfall of noble heroes.
items.ex_zh: 古代吟游诗人吟唱凄婉的民谣，哀叹高贵英雄们悲惨的陨落命运。

items.def_zh: 为死者号啕痛哭，作哀歌
items.def_en: [I/T] (+ over) to make a loud, high-pitched vocal cry of intense grief over a dead body
items.ex_en: The elderly mourner began to keen over the fallen soldier's cold body.
items.ex_zh: 那位年迈的送葬者开始对着阵亡士兵冰冷的遗体号啕痛哭。

groups.summary_en: Someone expresses profound sorrow, grief, or regret over a death, personal tragedy, or irrevocable loss. Verbs vary from silent, dignified grieving to overt, vocal, or tearful desolation.
groups.summary_zh: 对死亡、灾祸或不可逆的丧失表达深切悲痛，从静默沉哀到放声嚎啕、痛切悼惜。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the affective or vocal expression of deep sorrow and loss, distinguishing affective grieving from ordinary crying through existential gravity, ritual mourning, or vocalized lamentation.
groups.desc_zh: 指对深切哀痛与丧失的情感流露或悲声宣泄，与普通哭泣相比，更具存在性的沉重感、礼仪性哀悼或怨叹色彩。
groups.nuance_en: mourn: observe sorrow for a bereavement or loss, often culturally or inwardly (death / loss / dead) · grieve: experience deep, pervasive internal anguish (loss / tragedy / passing) · lament: express vocal grief, regret, or complaint openly (fate / tragedy / decline) · bewail: weep aloud over or bitterly bemoan misfortune (fate / misfortune / destiny) · pine away: waste away physically from unrequited longing or sorrow (grief / love / despair)
groups.nuance_zh: mourn: 为逝者或丧失举行哀悼或在内心致哀 (death / loss / dead) · grieve: 承受深沉持久的内心剧痛 (loss / tragedy / passing) · lament: 公开痛惜、叹息或诉说悲伤悔恨 (fate / tragedy / decline) · bewail: 为不幸痛哭流涕或大声哀叹 (fate / misfortune / destiny) · pine away: 因相思或悲恸过度而日渐消瘦憔悴 (grief / love / despair)

groups.name: Move Forward & Traverse · 推进与穿行 (Proceed, Troop, Transit)
groups.tip: 步步为营推进前行

items.def_zh: 鱼贯而出，排成纵队走出
items.def_en: to leave a room or enclosure walking one behind another in an orderly line
items.ex_en: The audience began to file out of the theater after the performance ended.
items.ex_zh: 演出结束后，观众开始排成纵队鱼贯走出剧场。

items.def_zh: 鱼贯而行，排成单行前进
items.def_en: (+ in/out/past) to walk in a single line or orderly queue in a specific direction
items.ex_en: The schoolchildren were instructed to file quietly into the auditorium for assembly.
items.ex_zh: 学童们被要求排成单行安静地走进礼堂参加早会。

items.def_zh: 成群结队地走，列队行进
items.def_en: (+ adv./prep.) To walk or march somewhere together in a large group.
items.ex_en: The exhausted tourists trooped into the hotel lobby after a very long bus journey.
items.ex_zh: 经过漫长的巴士车程后，筋疲力尽的游客们成群结队地走进酒店大堂。

items.def_en: to continue moving forward forcefully along a route despite obstacles or difficulties
items.ex_en: Despite the heavy blizzard, the mountaineers decided to press ahead toward the summit.
items.ex_zh: 尽管暴风雪肆虐，登山队员们仍决定坚决向前挺进，直指顶峰。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make one's way forward through a crowd, obstacle, or difficult terrain
items.ex_en: The government managed to push through the controversial reform bill.
items.ex_zh: 政府设法强行通过了这项有争议的改革法案。

items.def_en: 1. (formal) To move forward or travel in a particular direction. 2. To continue doing something that has already started.
items.ex_en: The delegates proceeded quietly toward the conference chamber to commence the treaty discussions.
items.ex_zh: 代表们肃静地走向会议大厅，开始条约商讨。

items.def_en: To pass through or across an area; to transport people or goods.
items.ex_en: Several foreign cargo vessels transited the narrow maritime strait under close military escort.
items.ex_zh: 数艘外国货轮在严密的军方护航下穿过了狭窄的海峡。

items.def_en: to travel across, over, or through an expansive area, terrain, or obstacle
items.ex_en: The expedition spent three challenging weeks traversing the arid desert plateau.
items.ex_zh: 探险队花了艰难的三周时间横穿这片干旱的荒漠高原。

items.def_en: (+ ahead/forward/on) to advance steadily, determinedly, or with heavy momentum
items.ex_en: The heavy icebreaker forged ahead steadily through the thick Arctic pack ice.
items.ex_zh: 重型破冰船在厚重的北极浮冰中稳步向前挺进。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate collective or directional forward motion and passage along a route or across an area, differing by group cohesion, formality, and navigational passage.
groups.summary_zh: 指按既定方向或队形向前推进行进，或穿过特定区域与通道。
groups.desc_en: Denotes moving forward across a space or obstacle with disciplined progress, collective formation, or physical endurance, contrasting with aimless wandering through directed, persistent displacement.
groups.desc_zh: 指依序、结队或克服障碍向前推进与穿行，与漫无目的的闲逛相对，强调有方向、有秩序或坚韧的位移。
groups.nuance_en: proceed: continue forward in an orderly, formal sequence (journey / plan / route) · troop: move forward as an organized crowd or unified body (into room / down stairs / out) · press ahead: push forward with urgent determination despite obstacles (initiative / journey / campaign) · traverse: travel across or pass over a wide or rugged expanse (terrain / continent / slope) · transit: pass across or through an intermediate zone (canal / airspace / system)
groups.nuance_zh: proceed: 依序、合乎规范地继续前行 (journey / plan / route) · troop: 成群结队或整齐行进 (into room / down stairs / out) · press ahead: 顶着阻力或困难坚决推进 (initiative / journey / campaign) · traverse: 穿过或横越广袤艰难地域 (terrain / continent / slope) · transit: 中转、通过或过境特定区域 (canal / airspace / system)

groups.name: Mundane Roaming & Prowling · 穿梭闲逛与游荡 (Public Social Drifting)
groups.tip: 无固定目标信步游荡漫步

items.def_en: (+ sth) to spend time in a place waiting or roaming casually without clear purpose
items.ex_en: A few teenagers like to hang around outside the corner convenience store after school.
items.ex_zh: 几个青少年放学后喜欢在街角的便利店外面闲晃逗留。

items.def_zh: 徘徊游荡，挤在一起乱走
items.def_en: to move around a particular area aimlessly or in a confused, unstructured crowd
items.ex_en: Confused commuters milled about on the platform after the express train was canceled.
items.ex_zh: 特快列车被取消后，茫然的通勤者们在站台上四处乱转。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to walk slowly around a place without any definite direction or hurry
items.ex_en: We spent the quiet morning wandering around the historic cobblestone alleys of the town.
items.ex_zh: 我们用了一个宁静的早晨漫步闲逛于小镇古老的鹅卵石巷道之间。

items.def_zh: （人群等）四处游荡，兜圈子，乱转；碾磨，磨碎
items.def_en: 1. (+ around/about) (of a crowd) To move around in a confused or aimless mass. 2. To crush or grind grain, ore, etc. into powder or small pieces.
items.ex_en: Anxious passengers continued to mill around the departures hall awaiting further delay announcements.
items.ex_zh: 焦急的乘客继续在出发大厅里漫无目的地兜圈子，等待进一步的延误通知。

items.def_zh: 漫游，缓行闲逛；以舒适速度平稳行进；乘船巡游，巡航
items.def_en: 1. To travel or drive around slowly and aimlessly, especially for pleasure. 2. To travel at a steady, efficient speed. 3. To sail around many places on a holiday cruise.
items.ex_en: On warm summer evenings, locals often cruise slowly along the oceanfront boulevard.
items.ex_zh: 在温暖的夏夜，当地人经常驾车沿着海滨大道慢悠悠地兜风闲逛。

items.def_en: [I/T] to travel unsystematically through an area or space
items.ex_en: Wild herds of bison roam freely across the expansive grasslands of the reserve.
items.ex_zh: 成群的野水牛在保护区辽阔的草原上自由地漫游闲荡。

items.def_en: to stand or wait around idly in a public place without clear purpose
items.ex_en: Security officers warned the suspicious youth not to loiter outside the bank entrance.
items.ex_zh: 安保人员警告那名可疑青年不要在银行入口外徘徊闲荡。

items.def_zh: 应酬穿梭；融于人群走动
items.def_en: to move around and talk to different people at a social gathering
items.ex_en: The diplomat skillfully mingled with overseas guests throughout the lively evening reception.
items.ex_zh: 这位外交官在热闹的晚间招待会上巧妙地穿梭于各国宾客之间应酬交际。
items.ex2_en: The barista mingled steamed milk with espresso to create latte art.
items.ex2_zh: 咖啡师将热牛奶与意式浓缩咖啡混合制作出拿铁拉花。

items.def_en: [I/T] to move restlessly or stealthily through an area as if searching for something
items.ex_en: A hungry stray cat prowled the dark alleys searching for scraps of food.
items.ex_zh: 一只饥饿的流浪猫在黑暗的小巷中潜行巡觅，寻找残羹剩饭。

groups.summary_en: People circulate or drift among others in public social areas, either swarming randomly in crowds or navigating spaces purposefully looking for encounters or amusement.
groups.summary_zh: 在公共空间或人群中漫无目的地走动、穿梭或寻觅社交接触。
groups.desc_en: Denotes casual, unstructured drifting in public or social spaces, distinguishing idle lingering and mingling from purposeful transit or solitary strolling.
groups.desc_zh: 指在公共或社交场所随意漫游、流连穿梭，与目的明确的通行或独自漫步相对，强调闲散徘徊与人际穿插。
groups.nuance_en: mill around: move aimlessly in a disorganized crowd (crowd / passengers / guests) · loiter: linger idly without legitimate purpose in a public space (corner / doorway / station) · roam: wander freely over a broad spatial area (streets / countryside / hills) · cruise: wander slowly looking for leisure, partners, or opportunity (streets / clubs / area) · mingle: circulate socially among people to converse (guests / crowd / delegates)
groups.nuance_zh: mill around: 人群盲目乱转或漫无目的地攒动 (crowd / passengers / guests) · loiter: 在公共场所无端滞留游荡 (corner / doorway / station) · roam: 在广阔区域内自由闲逛漫步 (streets / countryside / hills) · cruise: 缓缓巡游寻觅玩乐、对象或机会 (streets / clubs / area) · mingle: 在人群中穿梭交际寒暄 (guests / crowd / delegates)

groups.name: Muster & Impose Rigorous Order · 整编与排布 (Marshal, Regiment, Brigade)
groups.tip: 像军队般系统编制与调动

items.def_en: to form into disciplined military lines or orderly ranks
items.ex_en: The sergeant commanded the fresh recruits to fall in before the morning inspection.
items.ex_zh: 中士命令新兵们在晨检前迅速按队列集合排好。

items.def_zh: 把……整编/规训成，迫使……遵守纪律
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to bring a group quickly into rigorous order, discipline, or specific formation
items.ex_en: The tough coach managed to whip the unruly players into an orderly squad.
items.ex_zh: 这位严厉的教练成功将那些不受管教的队员整编成一支纪律严明的队伍。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to arrange troops, vehicles, or personnel into formal or orderly formation
items.ex_en: The legal team drew up a comprehensive contract for the acquisition.
items.ex_zh: 法律团队为此次收购拟定了一份详尽的合同。

items.def_en: To bring components or groups into precise systematic line or agreement
items.ex_en: The soldiers were instructed to align their boots and helmets in perfectly straight lines.
items.ex_zh: 士兵们奉命将靴子和头盔摆成完全笔直整齐的线条。
items.ex2_en: The wheels align automatically when you calibrate the front steering mechanism.
items.ex2_zh: 校准前转向机构时，车轮会自动对齐。

items.def_zh: 严密编组，严格管制；把……编成团
items.def_en: To organize and control people, their work, or their lives strictly and rigidly; to form people or troops into military regiments.
items.ex_en: The strict boarding school regimented the students' daily routines with uncompromising precision.
items.ex_zh: 这所严苛的寄宿学校以不容妥协的精确度严格管制着学生们的日常生活。

items.def_en: To organize people, soldiers, or units into brigades or working groups.
items.ex_en: The municipal authority brigaded the civilian volunteers into efficient neighborhood rescue squads.
items.ex_zh: 市政当局将民间志愿者整编成高效的社区救援队。

items.def_zh: 集结，统整，组织（人员、军队或论据）；引领，安排
items.def_en: 1. To gather and organize people, soldiers, ideas, or facts in a systematic way for a particular purpose. 2. To lead or guide someone somewhere.
items.ex_en: The lead prosecutor marshaled compelling evidence to present before the supreme court panel.
items.ex_zh: 首席检察官系统地统整了极具说服力的证据，呈交给最高法院审判庭。

items.def_en: To assemble or summon troops, workers, or strength for inspection or service
items.ex_en: The general ordered his officers to muster the reserve troops for active combat.
items.ex_zh: 将军命令军官们召集预备役部队准备投入实战。
items.ex2_en: The frightened villagers mustered in the central square to hear the warning.
items.ex2_zh: 受惊的村民聚集在中央广场聆听警告。

items.def_en: To assemble and coordinate resources or personnel ready for active deployment
items.ex_en: The health agency mobilized medical staff and emergency supplies to combat the outbreak.
items.ex_zh: 卫生机构调动并动员医务人员与应急物资以抗击疫情。
items.ex2_en: Volunteer rescue teams mobilized quickly following reports of the sudden landslide.
items.ex2_zh: 接到突发滑坡报告后，志愿救援队迅速集结动员。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to organizing, structuring, or disciplining people, troops, or resources under strict, quasi-military coordination or systematic alignment. They emphasize disciplined grouping, logistical alignment, and regulatory control over constituent elements.
groups.summary_zh: 指仿照军事编制对人员、资源进行严格整编与统筹排布。
groups.desc_en: Denotes assembling and structuring personnel or resources into rigid military or administrative order, contrasting with casual grouping through the imposition of strict discipline and organizational hierarchy.
groups.desc_zh: 指将人员或资源集结并排布成严密的军事或管理序列，与一般聚合不同，强调严苛的纪律约束与等级架构。
groups.nuance_en: marshal: systematically organize and deploy scattered resources or forces (facts / forces / resources) · muster: summon and gather together troops or strength for duty (courage / support / troops) · regiment: subject strictly to uniform, inflexible discipline and routines (lives / workforce / daily schedule) · brigade: group units into organized large operational formations (forces / workers / battalions) · align: bring into precise spatial, ideological, or administrative agreement (forces / interests / priorities)
groups.nuance_zh: marshal: 统筹整合并有序调动分散资源或兵力 (facts / forces / resources) · muster: 召集军队或鼓起勇气力量以备调用 (courage / support / troops) · regiment: 实施刻板、高度统一的严格纪律编排 (lives / workforce / daily schedule) · brigade: 把零散单位编组成大旅或作业大队 (forces / workers / battalions) · align: 使在空间、思想或组织利益上整齐对齐 (forces / interests / priorities)

groups.name: Negotiate & Mediate · 协商排解与居中斡旋 (Negotiate, Mediate, Broker)
groups.tip: 磋商谈判以达成一致

items.def_en: [I/T] to confer with others in order to reach an agreement or formal treaty
items.ex_en: Envoys from both nations met secretly to negotiate a formal bilateral peace treaty.
items.ex_zh: 两国特使秘密会面，以就正式的双边和平条约展开谈判达成共识。

items.def_zh: 通过协商解决，消除分歧
items.def_en: (+ sth) to resolve differences, disagreements, or difficult points through discussion
items.ex_en: Senior executives held several meetings to iron out minor differences before signing the merger.
items.ex_zh: 高管们举行了数次会议，以在签署合并协议前消除细微分歧。

items.def_zh: 商定，艰难谈判达成（协议）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to reach an agreement, deal, or settlement after strenuous and detailed negotiation
items.ex_en: Diplomats worked tirelessly throughout the night to hammer out a lasting ceasefire agreement.
items.ex_zh: 外交官们通宵达旦地努力工作，艰难商定了一项持久的停火协议。

items.def_zh: 充分讨论协商，深入探讨达成一致
items.def_en: (+ sth) to discuss something extensively and in detail until a mutual agreement is reached
items.ex_en: Let's sit down this afternoon and hash out the final project budget details.
items.ex_zh: 我们今天下午坐下来，深入探讨并敲定最终的项目预算细节吧。

items.def_zh: 讨价还价；谈判，商讨条件
items.def_en: 1. (+ with/for/over) To discuss terms or negotiate the price of something in order to reach an agreement.
items.ex_en: The union representatives bargained hard with management over wages and overtime benefits.
items.ex_zh: 工会代表就工资及加班福利与管理层展开了激烈的商讨谈判。

items.def_zh: 居中协调，斡旋（达成协议或交易）
items.def_en: 1. To negotiate and arrange an agreement, treaty, or deal between opposing parties.
items.ex_en: The neutral ambassador successfully brokered a historic peace accord between the two warring factions.
items.ex_zh: 这位中立的大使成功居中斡旋，促成两个交战派系达成历史性和平协议。

items.def_en: [I/T] to act as an intermediary between two hostile parties to settle an argument or dispute
items.ex_en: A seasoned labor consultant was invited to mediate the bitter dispute between pilots and management.
items.ex_zh: 一位经验丰富的劳工顾问受邀出面调停飞行员与管理层之间的激烈争端。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make a formal judgment or decision on a disputed matter in an official or legal capacity
items.ex_en: The international tribunal was summoned to adjudicate the complex maritime boundary dispute.
items.ex_zh: 国际仲裁庭受召对这一复杂的海洋划界争议做出正式法律裁决。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make an official judgment in a dispute between two people or groups after hearing both sides
items.ex_en: An independent panel was formally appointed to arbitrate the commercial breach of contract claim.
items.ex_zh: 一个独立小组被正式指派来对这起商业违约索赔案件进行公断。

groups.summary_en: Parties or neutral intermediaries discuss terms, reconcile differences, and craft formal settlements, agreements, or commercial deals between opposing sides.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重通过正式谈判、居中调解或斡旋促成协议。
groups.desc_en: Denotes collaborative or intermediary communication to resolve disputes and formalize agreements, distinguishing conflict resolution from one-sided decree or raw confrontation.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过协作沟通或居中调解来化解分歧并促成协议，与单边命令或直接对抗相对，强调妥协商谈与程序性裁决。
groups.nuance_en: negotiate: confer with another party to reach formal terms (treaty / contract / deal) · mediate: intervene impartially between opposing sides to reconcile differences (dispute / talks / conflict) · broker: actively facilitate and engineer an agreement between parties (peace / agreement / compromise) · hammer out: resolve stubborn disagreements through grueling discussions (compromise / agreement / details) · adjudicate: act as a formal judge to resolve a legal dispute (claim / dispute / matter)
groups.nuance_zh: negotiate: 双方或多方正式磋商以达成条款 (treaty / contract / deal) · mediate: 作为中立第三方居中调停化解纠纷 (dispute / talks / conflict) · broker: 积极穿针引线促成重大协议 (peace / agreement / compromise) · hammer out: 经艰苦反复研商敲定方案细节 (compromise / agreement / details) · adjudicate: 依法行使裁判权对争议做出裁决 (claim / dispute / matter)

groups.name: Obliterate & Rub Out · 消除与抹去 (Efface, Erase, Expunge)
groups.tip: 用涂改液抹去擦除痕迹

items.def_en: to remove pencil marks or chalk by rubbing with an eraser
items.ex_en: She used a soft rubber eraser to carefully rub out the erroneous calculation.
items.ex_zh: 她用一块软橡皮小心翼翼地擦掉了那个错误的计算结果。

items.def_zh: 遮蔽、涂抹消除（字迹或痛苦记忆）
items.def_en: to obscure or cover completely with ink, or deliberately force an unpleasant memory from the mind
items.ex_en: He drank heavily in a vain attempt to blot out the painful memories.
items.ex_zh: 他大口灌酒，徒劳地试图从脑海中抹去那些痛苦的记忆。

items.def_zh: 彻底消除，抹去（印记、记忆、记录）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to completely destroy, erase, or obliterate traces, records, or memories
items.ex_en: The massive system crash managed to wipe out all stored transaction records instantly.
items.ex_zh: 严重的系统崩溃瞬间彻底抹去了所有已存储的交易记录。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to draw a line through an item on a list or record to eliminate it
items.ex_en: She grabbed her red pen and crossed off the completed items on the list.
items.ex_zh: 她拿起红笔，把清单上已完成的项目一一划掉勾销。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to delete or cancel recorded words or clauses by drawing a line through them
items.ex_en: The lawyer struck out the contentious clause before submitting the final contract draft.
items.ex_zh: 律师在提交最终合同草案前删去了那项引起争议的条款。

items.def_zh: 擦除、抹掉（字迹、数据或记忆）
items.def_en: to remove marks, text, or recorded data by rubbing or electronically clearing
items.ex_en: The IT technician helped the client erase all sensitive personal data from the hard drive.
