items.ex_zh: IT技术人员协助客户从硬盘中清除了所有敏感的个人数据。

items.def_zh: 删去、彻底抹杀（记录、指控或名字）
items.def_en: (+ from) to strike out, obliterate, or completely wipe away a name, record, or memory
items.ex_en: The federal judge ordered the clerk to expunge the wrongful arrest from his permanent record.
items.ex_zh: 联邦法官命令书记官从他的永久档案中彻底抹去那次错误逮捕记录。

items.def_zh: 抹去，擦掉；消除（痕迹或记忆）；使不引人注目（efface oneself）
items.def_en: 1. To rub out or remove a mark, memory, or feeling completely. 2. ('efface oneself') To intentionally behave in a modest way so as not to attract attention.
items.ex_en: Time and continuous exposure to harsh winds gradually effaced the ancient stone inscriptions.
items.ex_zh: 岁月与持续的风蚀逐渐磨灭了这些古老的石刻铭文。

items.def_zh: 用涂改液涂掉，涂白修正
items.def_en: To cover up a written or typed mistake using white correction fluid.
items.ex_en: The secretary quickly whiteouted the misplaced date and typed the correct year over it.
items.ex_zh: 秘书迅速用涂改液涂掉了填错的日期，并在上面打上了正确的年份。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote intentionally rubbing out, blotting out, or completely eradicating recorded marks, writing, memories, or traces. They range from physical removal of ink or chalk to literary and legal elimination of records.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过刮拭、涂改或物理消除手段抹去字迹、印记、记忆或记录。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the total eradication of markings, texts, or abstract traces, distinguishing destructive erasure from merely concealing or modifying through complete physical or cognitive removal.
groups.desc_zh: 指将痕迹、文字或抽象印记彻底抹杀铲除，与简单掩盖或修改不同，强调从物理或记忆中完全抹除归零。
groups.nuance_en: erase: scrape or wipe away physical marks or recorded data (mark / memory / data) · efface: make indistinct or wear away traces, memories, or presence (memory / inscription / difference) · expunge: strike out or eliminate definitively from an official record (conviction / record / name) · blot out: obscure completely from view or conscious memory (sun / landscape / memories) · rub out: remove surface markings by friction, or slangily eliminate (pencil marks / ink / traces)
groups.nuance_zh: erase: 擦除、抹去物理印迹或录制数据 (mark / memory / data) · efface: 使磨灭、淡化存在感或使记忆风化 (memory / inscription / difference) · expunge: 从官方记录或档案中彻底注销剔除 (conviction / record / name) · blot out: 彻底遮蔽视线或从记忆中强行屏蔽 (sun / landscape / memories) · rub out: 摩擦擦掉表面污痕笔迹，俚指除掉 (pencil marks / ink / traces)

groups.name: Official Enrollment & Legal Registration · 登记与入册 (Register, Enroll, Matriculate)
groups.tip: 法务或学籍的正式注册立案

items.def_en: to record an official name, event, or item on an official list or record
items.ex_en: Citizens must register their current residential address with the local district council.
items.ex_zh: 公民必须向当地管辖区议会登记其目前的居住地址。

items.def_en: to put one's name down to participate in an activity, course, or organization
items.ex_en: Over one hundred eager community members signed up for the advanced computer programming course.
items.ex_zh: 一百多名热心的社区成员报名参加了这门高级计算机编程课程。
items.ex2_en: The coach signed up twenty enthusiastic students for the weekend tournament.
items.ex2_zh: 教练给二十名热情的学生报名参加了周末的比赛。

items.def_en: to enter names onto an official roster or duty list
items.ex_en: The head nurse rostered four additional paramedics for the emergency weekend shift.
items.ex_zh: 护士长将四名额外护理人员列入了周末急诊排班表。

items.def_zh: 登记报到，办理登记手续
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to register one's arrival officially at a hotel, airport, clinic, or event
items.ex_en: Passengers are advised to check in at least two hours prior to departure.
items.ex_zh: 建议乘客至少在起飞前两小时办理登机手续。

items.def_zh: 登记入册，载入系统记录
items.def_en: (+ sth) to enter official data, identity, or names into a register or electronic roll
items.ex_en: The receptionist carefully logged in each visitor's passport details into the secure database.
items.ex_zh: 接待员认真地将每位访客的护照信息登记录入安全数据库。

items.def_zh: 把……记入名单，给……报名登记
items.def_en: (+ sb) to record someone's name onto an official list, roster, or membership sheet
items.ex_en: The organizer offered to put down my brother's name for the upcoming charity marathon.
items.ex_zh: 组织者主动提出把我弟弟的名字记入即将举办的慈善马拉松名单中。

items.def_en: 1. To register a name, symbol, or design as a trademark to legally protect it.
items.ex_en: The tech firm acted quickly to trademark its novel operating system logo internationally.
items.ex_zh: 该科技公司迅速采取行动，将其新型操作系统标识在国际上注册为商标。

items.def_zh: （使）登记，（使）注册，（使）入学，（使）入会
items.def_en: 1. (+ in/on/for) (chiefly US) To officially register yourself or someone else as a member of a course, school, or organization.
items.ex_en: She decided to enroll herself in an intensive French language program this semester.
items.ex_zh: 她决定本学期为自己报名参加一个高强度的法语培训课程。
items.ex2_en: Hundreds of freshman students enroll every semester in the introductory chemistry course.
items.ex2_zh: 每学期都有数百名大一新生注册入门化学课程。

items.def_zh: 被大学录取入学；注册成为大学生
items.def_en: to officially enroll as a student at a college or university
items.ex_en: Hundreds of ambitious scholars will formally matriculate at the university this coming autumn.
items.ex_zh: 数百名怀揣抱负的学者将于今年秋季正式办理入学注册并进入该大学。
items.ex2_en: The prestigious university matriculated twelve hundred qualified applicants into the freshman class.
items.ex2_zh: 这所名牌大学正式录取并接收了1200名合格新生入学。

groups.summary_en: This scenario frame covers entering a name, entity, course, or intellectual property into an official roll, directory, or state database to establish formal status. Verbs vary across institutional contexts such as universities (matriculate, enroll), statutory IP protection (trademark, copyright), or general public record-keeping (register).
groups.summary_zh: 按法定或组织程序将人名、组织或知识产权载入官方名册以确立合法资格。
groups.desc_en: Denotes entering identity or property onto an authorized public or administrative roster, contrasting with informal admission through legal validity and structured record-keeping.
groups.desc_zh: 指将个人身份或资产载入法定或权威名册，与非正式准入相对，强调法律效力与规范建档程序。
groups.nuance_en: register: record officially in an authorized institutional ledger (birth / trademark / vehicle) · enroll: officially incorporate a person into a school, course, or membership (student / program / course) · roster: enter personnel onto a scheduled duty or team roster (crew / players / staff) · sign up: commit voluntarily by entering one's name for an activity (course / service / volunteer) · trademark: legally register a proprietary commercial mark (name / brand / logo)
groups.nuance_zh: register: 在官方或法定登记簿上正式注册 (birth / trademark / vehicle) · enroll: 正式将人员招收或编入课程学校或组织 (student / program / course) · roster: 把人员排进值勤表或运动队花名册 (crew / players / staff) · sign up: 自主报名登记参加某项活动或服务 (course / service / volunteer) · trademark: 依法将商业标记注册为专属商标 (name / brand / logo)

groups.name: Official Investiture & Authority Delegation · 授职入职与下放职权 (Induct, Delegate, Invest)
groups.tip: 指定职务并授予权责

items.def_en: (+ with/in) to formally endow someone with rank, office, authority, or ceremonial power
items.ex_en: The constitution invests the supreme supreme commander with absolute wartime emergency authority.
items.ex_zh: 宪法正式授予最高统帅绝对的战时紧急处置权力。

items.def_en: to admit someone to public office by administering a formal oath
items.ex_en: The new president will be sworn in on January 20th.
items.ex_zh: 新总统将于1月20日宣誓就职。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to officially surrender or transfer authority, control, or office to another person
items.ex_en: The outgoing director will hand over executive control to his successor next Monday.
items.ex_zh: 即将离任的董事将于下周一将执行控制权移交给继任者。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to transfer an official task, administrative responsibility, or power to a deputy
items.ex_en: The chief accountant passed on the budgetary auditing duties to her junior assistant.
items.ex_zh: 总会计师将预算审计职责正式转交给了她的低级助理。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to appoint or recruit someone formally into a specific official role or leadership position
items.ex_en: The board decided to bring in an experienced crisis manager to lead the company.
items.ex_zh: 董事会决定引进一位经验丰富的危机管理者来正式领导公司。

items.def_zh: 分派，委派（任务、权力）；选派……为代表
items.def_en: 1. to give part of your work, duties, or authority to someone else. 2. to choose someone to represent a group.
items.ex_en: A successful manager must learn how to delegate challenging administrative tasks to capable team members.
items.ex_zh: 一个成功的管理者必须学会如何将具有挑战性的行政任务分派给能干的团队成员。

items.def_zh: 使举行就职典礼，正式任命
items.def_en: to introduce someone into an official position with a formal opening ceremony
items.ex_en: The nation will inaugurate its newly elected democratic president during an elaborate formal ceremony.
items.ex_zh: 该国将在盛大的正式典礼上为新当选的民主总统举行就职仪式。

items.def_zh: 使正式就职，任命；使入门，接纳（为会员）
items.def_en: (+ into) to formally introduce someone into a new job, position, or organization through an official ceremony.
items.ex_en: The esteemed scientific society formally inducted the brilliant physicist into its prestigious ranks.
items.ex_zh: 这家备受尊崇的科学学会正式接纳了这位才华横溢的物理学家加入其崇高行列。

items.def_en: (+ sb to do sth) to appoint or authorize someone to act as a representative or deputy
items.ex_en: The ambassador deputed his senior counselor to represent the mission at the summit.
items.ex_zh: 大使委派其高级参赞代表使团出席此次首脑会议。

groups.summary_en: Denotes the formal transfer of office, status, or administrative power. 'Induct' refers to formally admitting an appointee into a post, society, or hall of fame, whereas 'delegate' focuses on assigning specific authorities or responsibilities downstream.
groups.summary_zh: 通过既定程序授予职位、正式就任或下放法定权力责任。
groups.desc_en: Denotes formally conferring office, power, or authority upon a designated person, distinguishing institutional empowerment from casual task assignment through ritual, legality, or structural hierarchy.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过仪式、法定程序或层级结构正式授予某人职位或下放权力，与日常交代任务不同，强调建制赋权与责任转移。
groups.nuance_en: invest: formally endow someone with power, title, or authority (authority / powers / office) · inaugurate: formally admit someone into public office with civic ceremonies (president / governor / term) · swear in: administer an official oath upon assuming a post (witness / president / cabinet) · induct: formally introduce someone into a specialized hall, order, or office (hall of fame / recruit / member) · delegate: entrust authority or tasks downward to an agent (authority / duties / responsibilities)
groups.nuance_zh: invest: 正式赋予某人职位、权威或特权 (authority / powers / office) · inaugurate: 举行盛典正式举行就职就任仪式 (president / governor / term) · swear in: 主持就职宣誓或使之立誓履职 (witness / president / cabinet) · induct: 正式接纳吸纳进入名册或殿堂 (hall of fame / recruit / member) · delegate: 将职权或具体职责下放交予下属代理 (authority / duties / responsibilities)

groups.name: Officially Revoke & Nullify · 撤销与宣告无效 (Revoke, Annul, Repeal)
groups.tip: 官方推翻或废止既定决议

items.def_zh: 判决……无效，撤销废除（法规、判决）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to legally declare a law, regulation, or ruling invalid and null
items.ex_en: The constitutional court moved swiftly to strike down the contentious regional censorship law.
items.ex_zh: 宪法法院迅速采取行动，裁决撤销了那项备受争议的地区审查法规。

items.def_zh: 撤销，宣布无效（裁决、决定）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to officially overrule, annul, or invalidate a previous legal decision or agreement
items.ex_en: The appellate judge set aside the flawed arbitration decision due to procedural misconduct.
items.ex_zh: 上诉法官因程序不当而撤销了那个存在瑕疵的仲裁裁决。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to formally declare something inadmissible, unacceptable, or legally invalid
items.ex_en: The presiding judge ruled out the illegally obtained confession as inadmissible court evidence.
items.ex_zh: 审判长裁定排除那份通过非法手段获得的供词，宣布其不得作为法庭证据。

items.def_en: to officially cancel or withdraw a law, statute, or legislative act
items.ex_en: Parliament voted decisively to repeal the outdated trade tariff act enacted last century.
items.ex_zh: 议会果断投票正式废除了上世纪颁布的那项陈旧的贸易关税法案。

items.def_zh: 撤销，废除，取消（法令、执照、特权等）
items.def_en: To officially cancel the power or effect of a law, decision, license, or agreement so that it is no longer valid.
items.ex_en: The state licensing board chose to revoke his medical license following severe negligence.
items.ex_zh: 在该医生发生严重过失后，州执照委员会决定吊销其行医执照。

items.def_zh: 推翻，否决，撤销；比……更重要，优先于
items.def_en: 1. To use your authority to reject or cancel a decision, order, or rule made by someone else. 2. To be more important than something else.
items.ex_en: The committee voted to override the director's decision regarding the proposed budget cuts.
items.ex_zh: 委员会投票推翻了主管关于拟议削减预算的决定。

items.def_zh: 撤销；废止（命令、协议或政策）
items.def_en: to officially end a law, policy, or agreement, making it null and void
items.ex_en: The council decided to rescind the controversial policy after facing intense public backlash.
items.ex_zh: 在面临公众的强烈反对后，市议会决定废止这项有争议的政策。

items.def_en: to make something have no legal force or effect
items.ex_en: A serious procedural error threatens to nullify the entire contract between the parties.
items.ex_zh: 一项严重的程序性错误恐将使双方签署的整份合同彻底失效。

items.def_zh: 宣告无效；废除（契约、婚姻等）
items.def_en: to state officially that something such as a contract, marriage, or law is no longer legally valid
items.ex_en: The high court moved to annul the fraudulent marriage after reviewing the evidence.
items.ex_zh: 在审查相关证据后，高等法院判定宣告该欺诈性婚姻无效。

groups.summary_en: An authority or governing body formally cancels, invalidates, or overrides a previously granted law, license, ruling, or legal agreement so that it is no longer legally binding. 'Revoke' cancels privileges or decrees, while 'annul' declares something legally void ab initio, and 'repeal' specifically abolishes statutes.
groups.summary_zh: 主管机关依法正式废除、取消或推翻法规、许可及决定。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the formal cancellation or invalidation of a law, rule, or legal act by authoritative decree, contrasting with mere non-enforcement through total juridical erasure.
groups.desc_zh: 指权威主体通过法定程序撤销、废止或宣告某项法令协议无效，与消极不执行不同，强调在法理上的彻底废止与清零。
groups.nuance_en: repeal: formally revoke a legislative act by statutory vote (law / act / statute) · revoke: officially withdraw a grant, privilege, license, or decree (license / permit / citizenship) · rescind: cancel or abrogate an agreement, contract, or policy retroactively or authoritatively (contract / offer / decision) · nullify: render legally void and of no binding effect (contract / agreement / law) · strike down: declare a law unconstitutional or void through judicial review (statute / ban / legislation)
groups.nuance_zh: repeal: 立法机关依程序废除现行法律条文 (law / act / statute) · revoke: 官方下令收回、吊销已发放的许可或特许权 (license / permit / citizenship) · rescind: 主管方宣布废除合同、要约或行政决议 (contract / offer / decision) · nullify: 使丧失法律效力或归于完全无效 (contract / agreement / law) · strike down: 司法机关裁定违宪并予击落废止 (statute / ban / legislation)

groups.name: Operate Specific Wheeled Vehicles · 驾车与跨骑代步 (Automobile, Bicycle, Motorcycle)
groups.tip: 操纵载具或乘车出行

items.def_en: to ride a bicycle for transport or sport
items.ex_en: She prefers to cycle along the scenic coastal route during the warm summer.
items.ex_zh: 在温暖的夏季，她更喜欢沿着风景优美的沿海路线骑自行车出行。

items.def_en: to travel or tour comfortably in an automotive vehicle
items.ex_en: They plan to motor through the picturesque countryside during their upcoming holiday.
items.ex_zh: 他们计划在即将到来的假期里乘汽车游览风景如画的乡村。

items.def_en: to travel on a bicycle or motorbike
items.ex_en: He decided to bike to work every day instead of taking the bus.
items.ex_zh: 他决定每天骑车去上班，而不是挤公交。

items.def_en: to leave a place driving a motor vehicle
items.ex_en: The suspect jumped into his car and drove off at an alarming speed.
items.ex_zh: 嫌疑人跳上车，以惊人的速度猛踩油门开走了。

items.def_zh: （驾驶车辆）驶出，出站，开上主路
items.def_en: to drive a vehicle away from the side of the road or out of a parking space into traffic
items.ex_en: The multinational corporation decided to pull out of the unprofitable market.
items.ex_zh: 该跨国公司决定退出这一无利可图的市场。

items.def_en: to depart travelling on a bicycle or motorbike
items.ex_en: She adjusted her helmet, mounted her bicycle, and rode off down the lane.
items.ex_zh: 她扶正头盔，跨上自行车，顺着小巷骑车离去了。

items.def_en: to ride or travel on a motorcycle.
items.ex_en: They decided to motorcycle across the scenic mountain passes during the dry season.
items.ex_zh: 他们决定在旱季骑摩托车穿越风景优美的山口。

items.def_en: to ride a bicycle.
items.ex_en: The tourists chose to bicycle across the quiet island to enjoy the views.
items.ex_zh: 游客们选择骑自行车环游这座宁静的小岛，沿途欣赏风景。

items.def_en: (dated) to travel or ride in an automobile.
items.ex_en: In those halcyon days, gentlemen would automobile through the countryside on sunny afternoons.
items.ex_zh: 在那些美好的旧日时光里，绅士们常在晴朗的午后乘汽车漫游乡间。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe travelling by actively operating specific mechanized or pedal-driven wheeled vehicles (cars, pushbikes, or motorbikes), usually derived denominally from the vehicle itself.
groups.summary_zh: 由车辆名词直接派生的动词，指骑自行车、开汽车或骑摩托车代步。
groups.desc_en: Denotes propelling oneself by operating a specific wheeled vehicle, distinguishing vehicular mobility by mechanical mode, power source, or rider posture.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过操纵特定轮式载具进行位移代步，依据机械类型、动力源及骑乘姿态与一般交通出行相区分。
groups.nuance_en: cycle: travel by foot-pedaled two-wheeled bicycle (commute / route / countryside) · motor: travel by car or motor vehicle, often leisurely (along road / up coast / south) · bike: ride a bicycle or motorcycle informally (to work / trails / streets) · motorcycle: travel specifically on an engine-powered two-wheeler (cross-country / highway / roads) · pull out: maneuver a vehicle outward from a parking spot or lane into moving traffic (driveway / lane / traffic)
groups.nuance_zh: cycle: 骑脚踏双轮自行车出行 (commute / route / countryside) · motor: 驾机动车行驶，常带悠闲兜风色彩 (along road / up coast / south) · bike: 骑自行车或摩托车出行（口语常见） (to work / trails / streets) · motorcycle: 骑乘摩托车进行特定交通长途行驶 (cross-country / highway / roads) · pull out: 驾车自泊位或车道向外变道汇入主车流 (driveway / lane / traffic)

groups.name: Oscillate & Sway · 晃动与摆动 (Yaw, Jiggle, Flail)
groups.tip: 剧烈挥舞或失控晃荡

items.def_en: to move unsteadily from side to side, showing a lack of balance
items.ex_en: The old wooden stool began to wobble dangerously under the man's heavy weight.
items.ex_zh: 那张旧木凳在那名男子沉重的体重下开始危险地晃动起来。
items.ex2_en: A heavy gust wobbled the flimsy ladder while the painter worked.
items.ex2_zh: 油漆工工作时，一阵强风吹得脆弱的梯子晃晃悠悠。

items.def_zh: 起伏，呈波浪形摆动，波动
items.def_en: To move or rise and fall in a smooth, continuous wave-like motion.
items.ex_en: The golden wheat fields undulate gracefully under the force of the gentle breeze.
items.ex_zh: 金黄的麦田在轻柔微风的吹拂下泛起优雅的波浪。
items.ex2_en: The belly dancer undulated her hips rhythmically to the hypnotic music.
items.ex2_zh: 肚皮舞者随着催眠般的音乐有节奏地起伏摆动臀部。

items.def_en: To move or shake lightly and quickly from side to side or up and down, or to cause something to do this.
items.ex_en: You have to jiggle the rusty key slightly to unlock the front door.
items.ex_zh: 你得轻轻晃动这把生锈的钥匙才能把前门打开。
items.ex2_en: The loose door handle jiggles whenever someone walks across the floor.
items.ex2_zh: 每当有人走过地板时，松动的门把手都会轻轻晃动。

items.def_zh: （船只或飞机）偏航，左右偏荡摆动
items.def_en: (of a ship or aircraft) To swing or turn unsteadily from side to side off its straight course.
items.ex_en: The vessel began to yaw wildly as powerful crosswinds struck the open channel.
items.ex_zh: 强烈的侧风猛刮开阔航道，船只开始剧烈偏荡摆动。

items.def_en: to sway unsteadily back and forth as if about to fall
items.ex_en: The stack of delicate porcelain bowls teetered precariously before crashing onto the counter.
items.ex_zh: 那一摞精致的瓷碗摇摇欲坠地晃动了一下，随后砸在台面上摔得粉碎。

items.def_zh: 胡乱挥动肢体，无规则地乱扑乱甩
items.def_en: to wave or swing one's arms or legs about wildly and uncontrollably
items.ex_en: The drowning swimmer started to flail around in panic before the lifeguard arrived.
items.ex_zh: 在救生员赶到之前，溺水者惊恐地在水中胡乱挥动四肢。

items.def_zh: 剧烈翻腾，四处乱晃乱扑
items.def_en: to move wildly, violently, or erratically from side to side or back and forth
items.ex_en: The injured dolphin continued to thrash about violently in the shallow coastal waters.
items.ex_zh: 受伤的海豚在浅滩水域中持续剧烈翻腾扑打。

items.def_zh: 胡乱摆动，猛烈挥舞（四肢）；用连枷打（谷物）
items.def_en: 1. (+ around/about) To wave or swing wildly and uncontrollably, especially arms or legs. 2. To beat grain with a flail.
items.ex_en: His arms began to flail uncontrollably as he slipped on the icy patch.
items.ex_zh: 他在结冰的路面上一滑，双臂顿时不受控制地猛烈乱甩。
items.ex2_en: The aggressive swimmer flailed his arms wildy to stay above water.
items.ex2_zh: 那名游泳者疯狂挥舞双臂以保持浮在水面上。

items.def_en: [I/T] to move or swing wildly, violently, or convulsively
items.ex_en: The captured fish began to thrash its tail against the wooden boat deck.
items.ex_zh: 捕获的鱼开始在木质船板上猛烈抽打尾巴。

groups.summary_en: These verbs describe bodies or limbs undergoing irregular, rhythmic, or uncontrolled swinging, wave-like, or swaying movements. They distinguish subtle vibrations and smooth ripples from wide navigation deviations and violent, uncontrolled thrashing.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体或肢体呈现波浪起伏、轻微晃动或失控甩动摇摆。
groups.desc_en: Denotes irregular, erratic, or convulsive waving, shaking, or unbalancing movements, contrasting with rhythmic oscillation through mechanical instability or wild physical agitation.
groups.desc_zh: 指不规则、抖动、偏航或痉挛式的剧烈晃动，与平稳匀速的摆动不同，强调机械失稳、狂乱挥舞或失控失衡。
groups.nuance_en: wobble: rock unsteadily from side to side due to lack of balance (wheels / knees / balance) · yaw: deviate temporarily from a straight course around a vertical axis (ship / aircraft / vehicle) · teeter: sway precariously on the brink of falling or tipping over (brink / edge / heels) · jiggle: move up and down or side to side with quick, light jerks (handle / keys / cord) · flail: wave, swing, or thrash wildly and uncontrollably (arms / legs / limbs)
groups.nuance_zh: wobble: 因重心不稳而左右打晃、摇摆颤晃 (wheels / knees / balance) · yaw: 航行器绕垂直轴发生异常偏航晃摆 (ship / aircraft / vehicle) · teeter: 处于坠落边缘般摇摇欲坠地摆荡 (brink / edge / heels) · jiggle: 快速轻微地微颤、抖动或扯动 (handle / keys / cord) · flail: 肢体狂乱失控地抽打挥舞 (arms / legs / limbs)

groups.name: Oscillate & Sway · 晃动与摇摆 (Sway, Oscillate, Rock)
groups.tip: 上下轻浮或左右往复摇晃

items.def_en: to move quickly and rhythmically up and down, especially on the surface of liquid or along a pivot
items.ex_en: Several brightly colored buoys bob up and down on the harbor's choppy surface.
items.ex_zh: 几个色彩鲜艳的浮标在港口波涛起伏的水面上不停上下晃动。
items.ex2_en: Playful harbor waves bobbed the small wooden boat up and down.
items.ex2_zh: 港湾欢快的波浪使那只小木船上下起伏。

items.def_zh: 前后有节奏地摇晃，摆动
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to sway rhythmically to and fro between two points or along an axis
items.ex_en: The mother gently rocked back and forth to soothe her fussy, crying infant.
items.ex_zh: 母亲前后有节奏地轻轻摇晃，安抚怀中哭闹不休的婴儿。
items.ex2_en: The grandfather gently rocked his sleeping grandson back and forth until morning.
items.ex2_zh: 祖父轻轻地来回摇晃着熟睡的孙子直到清晨。

items.def_zh: 上下浮动，晃动；行屈膝礼
items.def_en: To move up and down quickly or repeatedly, especially on the surface of water.
items.ex_en: The small fishing boat bobbed gently upon the calm waves of the bay.
items.ex_zh: 那艘小渔船在海湾平静的波浪中轻轻上下浮动。
items.ex2_en: The playful girl bobbed her head to the catchy pop beat.
items.ex2_zh: 那个活泼的女孩随着朗朗上口的流行节奏上下晃动脑袋。

items.def_en: [I/T] to move slowly from side to side or backward and forward
items.ex_en: The tall pine trees sway gently whenever the brisk mountain wind sweeps through.
items.ex_zh: 每当凛冽的山风席卷而过，高大的松树便轻轻摇摆。
items.ex2_en: The passionate speaker swayed the indecisive voters with compelling statistical evidence.
items.ex2_zh: 这位热情的演讲者用令人信服的统计数据打动了犹豫不决的选民。

items.def_en: [I/T] to move unsteadily from side to side with a lack of balance
items.ex_en: The young toddler started to wobble unsteadily as she took her first steps.
items.ex_zh: 刚学步的小女孩迈出人生第一步时，身体摇晃不稳。
items.ex2_en: The earthquake wobbled tall bookshelves and rattled porcelain dishes across town.
items.ex2_zh: 地震震晃了高高的书架，并使全镇的瓷器餐具咔咔作响。

items.def_en: [I/T] to move backward and forward or from side to side in a steady, rhythmic way
items.ex_en: Huge ocean waves continued to rock the stranded vessel throughout the stormy night.
items.ex_zh: 在暴风雨之夜，巨大的海浪持续摇晃着搁浅的船只。
items.ex2_en: The empty wooden rocking chair rocked peacefully on the front porch.
items.ex2_zh: 空荡荡的木制摇椅在前廊上平静地摇晃着。

items.def_zh: 摇摆，摆动；挥舞；转动，突然转向
items.def_en: 1. To move or make something move back and forth or in an arc. 2. To turn or rotate suddenly. 3. To swing an arm or bat to hit something.
items.ex_en: The heavy pendulum swings back and forth with steady, uninterrupted precision every day.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的钟摆每天都以稳定连贯的精度来回摆动。
items.ex2_en: The playful child swung her legs happily while sitting on the dock.
items.ex2_zh: 爱玩的孩子坐在码头上开心地晃荡着双腿。

items.def_zh: 摇摆，摆动；挥舞；转向（swing 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of swing; to move back and forth in an arc, or to turn suddenly.
items.ex_en: The rusted gate swung wide open when the powerful gust struck the fence.
items.ex_zh: 强风猛烈冲击篱笆时，生锈的大门猛然晃荡开来。
items.ex2_en: The strong batter swung the wooden baseball bat with tremendous power.
items.ex2_zh: 强壮的击球手用极大的力量挥舞着木质棒球棒。

items.def_en: to move repeatedly from one position to another and back again with a steady rhythm
items.ex_en: The laboratory needle began to oscillate rapidly between positive and negative voltage readings.
items.ex_zh: 实验室仪器的指针开始在正负电压读数之间有规律地快速振荡。

groups.summary_en: Entities move back and forth, side to side, or up and down along an axis or pivot point. Verbs denote rhythmic, suspended, floating, or pivoting movements varying in speed, amplitude, and fluid dynamics.
groups.summary_zh: 围绕支点或轴线所进行的往复、摇晃或上下起伏运动。
groups.desc_en: Denotes repetitive back-and-forth or side-to-side rhythmic motion around a pivot or base, distinguishing pendular swaying from erratic shaking through periodic fluidity.
groups.desc_zh: 指围绕支点或基底进行的往复周期性摆动，与杂乱颤动不同，具有规律的摆幅、悬荡或节奏感。
groups.nuance_en: sway: lean or swing slowly and rhythmically from side to side (trees / hips / crowd) · rock: move gently or violently backward and forward or side to side (cradle / boat / baby) · swing: move freely back and forth suspended from a fixed point (pendulum / arms / gate) · bob: make a quick, short up-and-down movement on or in a liquid (cork / boat / head) · oscillate: swing back and forth across a median position with regular frequency (pendulum / needle / signal)
groups.nuance_zh: sway: 左右缓和有韵律地倾侧摆动 (trees / hips / crowd) · rock: 前后或左右轻柔摇晃或剧烈颠簸 (cradle / boat / baby) · swing: 绕固定悬挂点自如来回荡漾 (pendulum / arms / gate) · bob: 在液体表面或轻快地上下沉浮颠动 (cork / boat / head) · oscillate: 在中心位置两侧作规律的高频往复振荡 (pendulum / needle / signal)

groups.name: Ostracize & Marginalize · 排斥与隔绝 (Marginalize, Redline, Exclude)
groups.tip: 划定界限将弱势群体边缘化

items.def_en: (+ from) to intentionally prevent someone from joining, participating in, or entering a group
items.ex_en: The organizers decided to exclude unregistered participants from the final stages of competition.
items.ex_zh: 组织者决定将未注册的参赛者排除在最终决赛阶段之外。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to exclude someone deliberately from social participation, opportunities, or community life
items.ex_en: The elitist club deliberately shut out qualified applicants based purely on social background.
items.ex_zh: 该精英俱乐部仅仅依据社会背景，就故意将合格的申请者拒之门外。

items.def_zh: 将……列入黑名单，联合抵制
items.def_en: to put someone on a list of people viewed with suspicion or excluded from employment or commerce
items.ex_en: The corrupt studio executive threatened to blacklist the outspoken actor across the industry.
items.ex_zh: 这名腐败的制片厂高管威胁要在全行业封杀这位直言不讳的演员。

items.raw_cluster: 排斥与边缘化 Exclude & Marginalize
items.def_zh: 使边缘化，排斥，使处于非主流地位
items.def_en: To treat a person, group, or concept as insignificant or peripheral, pushing them to the margins of society.
items.ex_en: Mainstream economic policies continue to marginalise vulnerable indigenous communities across the country.
items.ex_zh: 主流经济政策继续使全国各地的弱势原住民群体边缘化。

items.raw_cluster: 排斥与边缘化 Exclude & Marginalize
items.def_zh: （尤指对特定社区）划红线排斥，拒绝提供贷款（或保险）；画红线标记修改
items.def_en: 1. To refuse loans, insurance, or mortgages to people living in particular disadvantaged areas. 2. To mark edits or changes on a document with red lines.
items.ex_en: Banks used discriminatory practices to redline minority neighborhoods, denying them home improvement loans.
items.ex_zh: 银行采取歧视性做法对少数族裔社区划红线排斥，拒绝向其发放房屋修缮贷款。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to banish or reject someone definitively from a community, society, or home
items.ex_en: The disgraced warrior was cast out from the clan and condemned to wander.
items.ex_zh: 这位蒙羞的勇士被氏族放逐驱逐，注定要在外漂泊流浪。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to force someone out of a social group, organization, or market through cold and hostile isolation
items.ex_en: Jealous colleagues conspired to freeze out the newcomer from all major project meetings.
items.ex_zh: 嫉妒的同事们串通一气，在所有重大项目会议中冷落排挤这位新人。

items.def_zh: 使集中于贫民窟，隔离聚居
items.def_en: to confine, isolate, or restrict a particular group to an isolated area or inferior status
items.ex_en: Discriminatory housing ordinances threaten to ghettoize recent immigrants into impoverished urban districts.
items.ex_zh: 歧视性的住房法令恐将新移民隔离聚居在贫困的城市街区中。

items.def_zh: 排挤，共同孤立（被社群放逐）
items.def_en: to deliberately exclude someone from a community, society, or social group
items.ex_en: The community chose to ostracize the defector, refusing to acknowledge him in public.
items.ex_zh: 社区居民选择共同孤立这名叛徒，在公共场合对其视而不见。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to systematically banishing, isolating, or pushing individuals, communities, or groups out of mainstream economic, legal, or social recognition. Nuances range from cultural alienation to structural institutional bans.
groups.summary_zh: 在社会、经济或体制层面排挤、孤立或边缘化特定群体。
groups.desc_en: Denotes systematically banishing, segregating, or socially isolating an individual or group, distinguishing social or economic ostracism from mere physical distance.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过制度或群体默契对个人或群体实施系统性排斥与隔离，与单纯物理疏离不同，强调社会性、经济性放逐与边缘化。
groups.nuance_en: marginalise: relegate an individual or demographic to an powerless outer fringe (communities / groups / voices) · exclude: bar someone definitively from access, membership, or consideration (applicants / members / possibilities) · blacklist: place an entity on a punitive roster of banned or untrustworthy agents (employees / actors / companies) · redline: deny financial or civil services systematically by geographic demographic boundaries (neighborhoods / communities / districts) · ghettoize: isolate a minority group into a restricted, degraded communal area (minorities / population / subcultures)
groups.nuance_zh: marginalise: 使某群体被边缘化、剥夺话语权 (communities / groups / voices) · exclude: 坚决排斥在门槛、群体或权益之外 (applicants / members / possibilities) · blacklist: 将某主体列入禁入或惩戒的黑名单 (employees / actors / companies) · redline: 按特定社区地理或种族边界系统性拒绝信贷服务 (neighborhoods / communities / districts) · ghettoize: 将弱势群体限制隔绝在贫困或封闭集中区 (minorities / population / subcultures)

groups.name: Overhaul & Reconfigure Infrastructure · 改造重组与改建产线 (Retool, Rewire, Reconfigure)
groups.tip: 调整内部构造与设备配置

items.def_en: to reset, rearrange, or adapt the elements or settings of a system, facility, or device
items.ex_en: Technicians must reconfigure the network routers to accommodate the sudden increase in traffic.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员必须重新配置网络路由器，以应对突然暴增的流量。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to equip or reconstruct a room, building, or vessel with specialized equipment and fittings
items.ex_en: The laboratory was fitted out with the latest analytical instruments.
items.ex_zh: 该实验室配备了最先进的分析仪器。

items.def_zh: 把……完全拆开（以便彻底检修改建）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to dismantle machinery, an engine, or a system down to its base components for overhaul
items.ex_en: The skilled mechanics will strip down the malfunctioning engine before rebuilding every part.
items.ex_zh: 熟练的机械师将在重构所有部件之前，先把故障发动机彻底拆解。

items.def_zh: 改换，转产，切换（系统或产线）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to alter or convert an industrial mechanism or operating setup to a new system or purpose
items.ex_en: The hospital will switch over to a completely digital record system next month.
items.ex_zh: 下个月该医院将全面切换至数字化病历系统。

items.def_en: to thoroughly inspect, repair, and rebuild a machine or system to improve performance
items.ex_en: The municipal authority hired specialists to completely overhaul the aging subway transit system.
items.ex_zh: 市政当局聘请专家彻底检修并全面改建老化的地铁运输系统。

items.def_en: to build or organize something again after damage or obsolescence
items.ex_en: Engineers worked around the clock to reconstruct the collapsed bridge following the disaster.
items.ex_zh: 灾害发生后，工程师们夜以继日地工作以重建坍塌的大桥。

items.def_en: to repair and fit out a ship, factory, or building with new parts and equipment
items.ex_en: The navy plans to refit the aging warship with advanced digital radar systems.
items.ex_zh: 海军计划对这艘老化军舰进行翻新改装，配备先进的数字雷达系统。

items.def_zh: 给……重新布线，更换电线；重构，改造（思维模式、神经回路等）
items.def_en: 1. To replace the electrical wiring in a building, vehicle, or piece of equipment. 2. To reorganize or alter the pathways or functions of a brain or system.
items.ex_en: Licensed contractors must rewire the historic estate to meet contemporary residential fire standards.
items.ex_zh: 持证承包商必须给这座历史悠久的庄园重新布线，以符合现代住宅防火标准。

items.def_zh: 重组，改组；给（工厂等）更换新设备
items.def_en: 1. To reorganize, update, or adapt an organization, system, or set of skills. 2. To equip a factory with new machinery and tools.
items.ex_en: The company invested millions to retool its manufacturing plant for electric vehicle production.
items.ex_zh: 该公司斥资数百万美元改造其制造工厂的设备，以用于生产电动汽车。
items.ex2_en: The legacy automotive factories retools gradually as modern technological demands evolve.
items.ex2_zh: 随着现代技术需求的发展，传统汽车制造厂逐步重组转型。

groups.summary_en: An organization or technical specialist restructures, adapts, or overhauls internal systems, manufacturing machinery, or physical wiring to adapt to new tasks. 'Retool' emphasizes adapting industrial machines and operational methods, while 'rewire' literally or metaphorically resets electrical or neural circuitry.
groups.summary_zh: 改换机床工具、重连线路或重新配置基础设施以革新技术。
groups.desc_en: Denotes comprehensively stripping, redesigning, and refitting physical or technical infrastructure, distinguishing complete industrial revamping from minor local repairs.
groups.desc_zh: 指对物理设施、机电架构或生产线进行彻底拆解、改建与重新装配，与小修小补不同，强调产业级的大修与配置重构。
groups.nuance_en: overhaul: thoroughly inspect, dismantle, and rebuild a complex mechanism or system (engine / system / economy) · reconfigure: alter the spatial arrangement or operational layout of components (layout / network / system) · refit: repair and equip a ship, factory, or vehicle with new machinery (vessel / fleet / plant) · retool: replace machinery and tooling in a factory to manufacture a different product (factory / plant / industry) · rewire: replace or alter the electrical circuitry or neural pathways of an entity (building / brain / circuits)
groups.nuance_zh: overhaul: 彻底检修拆解并重整复杂系统或机械 (engine / system / economy) · reconfigure: 变更组件的空间排布或运作架构 (layout / network / system) · refit: 为船舶或工厂加装换装新配件与设备 (vessel / fleet / plant) · retool: 更换车间工装模具以转产全新产品 (factory / plant / industry) · rewire: 重铺更换电气线路，或重塑神经联结 (building / brain / circuits)

groups.name: Overlay & Mulch Soil · 铺设保护层与覆盖覆土
groups.tip: 铺覆外层以掩盖真实面目

items.def_zh: 给（草坪或作物）施表土；施面肥
items.def_en: to apply fertilizer, compost, or sand uniformly over the surface of soil or turf
items.ex_en: The head greenskeeper will topdress the putting greens with fine sand this autumn.
items.ex_zh: 首席草坪管理员将在今年秋天用细沙给果岭表面施覆一层表土。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to cover a surface or soil completely with an outer protective layer
items.ex_en: Gardeners must cover up the exposed soil using durable tarps before storms hit.
items.ex_zh: 园丁们必须在暴风雨来临前用耐用的防水布将裸露的土壤完全盖住。

items.def_zh: 铺设（覆土、碎石、草皮等保护层）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to place a covering layer of turf, gravel, mulch, or laminate upon a surface
items.ex_en: The government has laid down strict safety guidelines for the industry.
items.ex_zh: 政府为该行业制定了严格的安全指南。

items.def_zh: 摊平铺开（覆盖物、土壤等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to distribute a material like mulch or gravel evenly over an underlying area
items.ex_en: The search team spread out across the forest to look for the missing hikers.
items.ex_zh: 搜救队在森林中分散开来寻找失踪的徒步旅行者。
items.ex2_en: The gardener spread out fresh wood mulch evenly across the flowerbeds.
items.ex2_zh: 园丁把新鲜的木屑均匀地铺撒在各个花坛上。

items.def_en: (+ with/in) to cover a broad surface with a dense, unbroken layer of snow, leaves, or mulch
items.ex_en: Landscapers decided to blanket the bare garden beds with organic pine needle mulch.
items.ex_zh: 景观工人们决定用一层厚厚的有机松针护根物覆盖裸露的花圃。

items.def_zh: 用碎石铺盖（道路或地表）
items.def_en: to spread loose stone or gravel across an expanse of earth or path
items.ex_en: The estate workers will gravel the muddy garden paths before the winter rains.
items.ex_zh: 庄园工人将在冬雨来临前用碎石铺盖泥泞的花园小径。

items.def_zh: 铺在……上面，在……上加饰层（或保护层）；在（图像或文本）上覆叠
items.def_en: (+ with) 1. To cover the surface of something with a layer of a different material. 2. To place a digital image, text, or pattern over another.
items.ex_en: The conservationist decided to overlay the depleted topsoil with nutrient-rich organic compost.
items.ex_zh: 环保人士决定在贫瘠的表土上覆铺一层富含养分的有机堆肥。

items.def_zh: 压膜；给…覆上塑料保护膜
items.def_en: to cover a flat surface with a thin protective layer of plastic or laminate
items.ex_en: Technicians will laminate the fragile ground maps to protect them from field moisture.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员将给脆弱的地面地图压膜，以保护其免受野外湿气的侵蚀。

items.def_en: (gardening) To cover the ground or soil around plants with mulch to retain moisture and suppress weeds.
items.ex_en: Be sure to mulch around the young saplings to keep the ground damp.
items.ex_zh: 务必在幼树周围铺上护根层，以保持土壤湿润。

groups.summary_en: Involves applying a distinct protective, agricultural, or decorative layer onto an underlying surface or soil, such as spreading mulch on flowerbeds or overlaying laminates.
groups.summary_zh: 在底层或土壤表面铺设防护层、树皮草屑或装饰板覆面。
groups.desc_en: Denotes applying a protective, leveling, or finishing stratum over soil or a substrate, distinguishing functional agrarian or structural layering from indiscriminate burying.
groups.desc_zh: 指在土壤或基底表面铺陈保护层、找平层或覆面层，与随意的深埋填埋不同，强调功能性覆土、护根或分层施用。
groups.nuance_en: topdress: apply fertilizer, loam, or sand as a top surface dressing to turf or crops (lawn / soil / turf) · overlay: place one protective or decorative layer on top of another surface (surface / laminate / graphics) · blanket: cover completely with a thick, uniform layer (snow / leaves / smoke) · spread out: scatter and distribute material evenly across an expansive ground (mulch / gravel / fertilizer) · laminate: bond multiple thin layers together into a composite sheet (sheets / wood / plastic)
groups.nuance_zh: topdress: 在草坪或耕地表层轻铺土肥或沙料进行追肥覆土 (lawn / soil / turf) · overlay: 在既有表面上覆盖一层保护或装饰层 (surface / laminate / graphics) · blanket: 像厚毯般致密均匀地完全覆盖 (snow / leaves / smoke) · spread out: 将覆土或碎石均匀摊平撒开于地面 (mulch / gravel / fertilizer) · laminate: 将多层薄料经胶合压制成复合层压板 (sheets / wood / plastic)

groups.name: Pacify & Suppress · 遏制与镇压 (Defuse, Quell, Crush, Stifle)
groups.tip: 从抚平缓和到强力压制

items.def_en: to prevent a violent situation or unrest from escalating or spreading
items.ex_en: Riot police deployed quickly to contain the growing civil unrest in the square.
items.ex_zh: 防暴警察迅速部署，以遏制广场上日益扩大的群体骚乱。

items.def_en: to forcibly put an end to an insurrection, rebellion, or protest
items.ex_en: The authoritarian regime sent troops to suppress the nationwide uprising with brutal force.
items.ex_zh: 专制政权派出军队，以残暴手段暴力镇压全国性的起义。

items.def_zh: 缓和，平息（紧张局势）；拆除（炸弹的）引信
items.def_en: 1. to make a tense, dangerous, or difficult situation calmer and less volatile 2. to remove the fuse from a bomb or explosive device
items.ex_en: Diplomats worked through the night to defuse the brewing crisis along the border.
items.ex_zh: 外交官们通宵达旦地工作，以平息边界上正在酝酿的紧张危机。

items.def_en: (+ on sb/sth) to take strict action to suppress, restrict, or stop something from developing
items.ex_en: The city government moved swiftly to clamp down on unlawful street demonstrations tonight.
items.ex_zh: 市政府今晚迅速采取行动，强行压制并取缔非法的街头示威。

items.def_en: (+ on sb/sth) to take severe or coercive disciplinary measures to suppress illegal behavior, unrest, or dissent
items.ex_en: Local police began to crack down on violent gang activity throughout the downtown district.
items.ex_zh: 当地警方开始在整个市中心区域严厉打击暴力团伙活动。

items.def_en: to eliminate or extinguish rebellion or unrest decisively
items.ex_en: The regional commander pledged to stamp out the armed insurgency within three months.
items.ex_zh: 地区指挥官誓言在三个月内彻底铲除这起武装叛乱。

items.def_zh: 平息，镇压（暴乱、叛乱）；平复，消除（恐惧、疑虑等）
items.def_en: 1. to stop or suppress a rebellion, violent protest, or disturbance by force 2. to calm or reduce strong unpleasant feelings such as fear or anger
items.ex_en: Armored security forces were deployed to quell the violent uprising in the capital.
items.ex_zh: 装甲安保部队被部署到首都，以武力平息那场暴力暴乱。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to suppress or stop a rebellion, riot, or strike by using physical or military force
items.ex_en: The state governor deployed the National Guard to put down the violent riot.
items.ex_zh: 州长调动国民警卫队，以武力镇压了这场暴力骚乱。

items.def_en: to defeat and destroy opposition or rebellion completely with severe violence
items.ex_en: The imperial army mobilized overnight to crush the rebellion before dawn arrived today.
items.ex_zh: 帝国军队连夜动员，在今天黎明到来之前彻底粉碎了叛乱。

groups.summary_en: This frame traces the continuum of neutralizing conflict, civil unrest, or rebellion. The scale moves from nonviolent de-escalation ('defuse') through firm administrative suppression ('quell') to overwhelming coercive force ('crush', 'stamp out').
groups.summary_zh: 平息遏制冲突或动乱，从温和化解逐步升级至暴力镇压摧垮。
groups.desc_en: Denotes subduing, extinguishing, or suppressing unrest, rebellion, or rising tensions through decisive authority or force, contrasting with negotiation by coercive pacification.
groups.desc_zh: 指凭借权威或强制力量强行压制、平息骚乱、危机或上升的紧张局势，与和平谈判相对，强调威慑平叛与铁腕遏制。
groups.nuance_en: suppress: put an end to rebellion or speech forcibly; hold down (rebellion / revolt / truth) · quell: subdue and extinguish active riots, panic, or disorder (riots / rebellion / fears) · defuse: render an explosive or hostile situation harmless before detonation (tension / crisis / bomb) · clamp down: impose severe, sudden restrictions to enforce discipline (crime / dissent / corruption) · stamp out: extinguish an emerging evil or rebellion completely by stamping on it (rebellion / disease / corruption)
groups.nuance_zh: suppress: 凭借暴力强行压制平叛或封杀言论 (rebellion / revolt / truth) · quell: 迅速平定骚乱、暴动或平息恐慌 (riots / rebellion / fears) · defuse: 在矛盾爆炸前拆除引信、缓和化解危机 (tension / crisis / bomb) · clamp down: 实行严厉突击的钳制与整肃 (crime / dissent / corruption) · stamp out: 像踩灭火星般彻底扑灭劣迹、叛乱或疾患 (rebellion / disease / corruption)

groups.name: Pack, Box & Crate · 装箱、装盒与打包运输
groups.tip: 将杂件物品码入箱匣收纳

items.def_en: 1. To put something into a box. 2. To fight someone in a boxing match.
items.ex_en: The warehouse staff will box these fragile crystal ornaments before loading the transport.
items.ex_zh: 仓库员工在装上运输车之前，会先把这些易碎的水晶饰品装箱入盒。

items.def_zh: 收拾行李，打包；挤满，塞满
items.def_en: 1. To put things into suitcases, boxes, or bags for travel or storage. 2. To fill a space tightly or crowd together.
items.ex_en: She hurriedly began to pack her leather bags for the unexpected business trip.
items.ex_zh: 她急忙开始收拾皮包行李，准备去进行这次突如其来的出差。

items.def_en: to collect one's belongings and pack them into cases or boxes
items.ex_en: It's five o'clock—let's pack up and go home.
items.ex_zh: 已经五点了——咱们收拾收拾回家吧。

items.def_en: to pack articles into cartons for shipment or handling
items.ex_en: Workers carefully carton the finished pharmaceutical goods for international freight shipment this afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 工人们今天下午细致地将成品药品装入大纸箱，以备国际货运。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to pack items securely into boxes for moving, storage, or transport
items.ex_en: Before moving out, we spent three days boxing up all our books and clothes.
items.ex_zh: 搬家前，我们花了三天时间把所有的书和衣服打包入箱。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to pack goods into large wooden crates, especially for shipping or freight transit
items.ex_en: The warehouse crew will crate up the antique machinery before shipping it overseas.
items.ex_zh: 仓库工作人员在将这些古董机械运往海外之前，会先把它们装入木箱。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to tie or wrap several items together securely into a compact bundle
items.ex_en: Just bundle up those old newspapers so we can toss them in recycling.
items.ex_zh: 把那些旧报纸扎成一捆，我们好扔去回收。
items.ex2_en: Loose dried twigs bundle up easily if you bind them tightly.
items.ex2_zh: 如果你把散落的干树枝绑紧，它们很容易打成捆。

items.def_en: (+ up) to tie or wrap several things together into a compact package
items.ex_en: The volunteers helped bundle the donated winter blankets for distribution to the shelters.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者们帮忙将捐赠的冬毯打包成捆，以便分发给避难所。

items.def_zh: 把…装入板条箱（以备装运）
items.def_en: to pack goods into large wooden crates for safe transport or shipping
items.ex_en: Workers carefully crate the delicate marble sculptures to ensure safe delivery across borders.
items.ex_zh: 工人们小心翼翼地将精致的大理石雕塑装入板条箱，以确保跨国安全运输。

groups.summary_en: Covers physical packing operations where items are arranged into cardboard boxes, cartons, or wooden crates for moving, storage, or freight transit.
groups.summary_zh: 将物品整理收纳进纸箱、板条箱或包裹以备搬迁与物流运输。
groups.desc_en: Denotes enclosing, binding, and consolidating goods into standard containers or rigid packages for storage and freight, distinguishing structured logistics packaging from loose gathering.
groups.desc_zh: 指将货品分类装入箱盒或捆扎固封，以便于仓储和物流运输，与零散归拢相对，强调规整容器化与防护捆包。
groups.nuance_en: box up: place articles methodically inside cardboard boxes for moving or storage (books / belongings / files) · pack: arrange items compactly inside a container, suitcase, or vehicle (suitcase / bags / trunk) · crate up: enclose heavy or fragile equipment inside wooden shipping crates (machinery / goods / art) · bundle: tie or wrap several distinct articles tightly together into a single unit (sticks / clothes / newspapers) · carton: pack commercial merchandise into protective corrugated cartons (goods / products / bottles)
groups.nuance_zh: box up: 将零碎杂物或书籍规整装入纸箱以便搬运 (books / belongings / files) · pack: 将物品紧密装塞入箱包或货箱准备启程 (suitcase / bags / trunk) · crate up: 将重型或易碎品订入木条箱进行长途货运 (machinery / goods / art) · bundle: 将散件物品紧密捆绑扎成一捆 (sticks / clothes / newspapers) · carton: 把流水线工业品装入瓦楞纸盒或包装箱中 (goods / products / bottles)

groups.name: Pave & Surface Thoroughfares · 铺设与构建道面 (Pave, Cobblestone, Surface)
groups.tip: 将零散部件拼搭回整体

items.def_en: to apply an outer protective layer of asphalt, tarmac, or concrete to a road
items.ex_en: Road crews will surface the highway with fresh asphalt early next Tuesday morning.
items.ex_zh: 修路工人将在下周二清晨用新沥青给这条公路铺设面层。

items.def_en: to cover a road or runway with tarmac or asphalt surfacing
items.ex_en: The contractors plan to tarmac the private driveway before the harsh winter arrives.
items.ex_zh: 承包商计划在严冬到来之前，用柏油铺好这条私人车道。

items.def_en: to cover or construct a road using crushed stone or macadam
items.ex_en: Pioneers metalled the muddy mountain track with crushed limestone to aid heavy wagons.
items.ex_zh: 拓荒者用碎石灰石铺设了泥泞的山道，以方便重型马车通行。

items.def_zh: 用混凝土、沥青等铺满道面
items.def_en: (+ sth) to cover an area of land or dirt completely with asphalt, concrete, or stone paving
items.ex_en: Developers decided to pave over the historic garden to construct an expansive parking lot.
items.ex_zh: 开发商决定把这座历史悠久的花园全部铺平，建成一个宽敞的停车场。

items.def_zh: 铺设（路面、铁轨或地基材料）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to place materials such as gravel, asphalt, or rails systematically along a ground route
items.ex_en: The government has laid down strict safety guidelines for the industry.
items.ex_zh: 政府为该行业制定了严格的安全指南。

items.def_en: to cover a path, road, or area with flat stones, bricks, or asphalt
items.ex_en: City masons will pave the pedestrian walkway with durable granite slabs this month.
items.ex_zh: 市政石匠本月将用耐磨的花岗岩石板铺设这条步行道。

items.def_zh: 重新组装，重新装配；重新聚集，重新召集
items.def_en: 1. to put the parts of a machine or object back together. 2. to come together again as a group, or bring people together again
items.ex_en: The technicians will reassemble the intricate turbine components once routine maintenance concludes.
items.ex_zh: 一旦例行维护结束，技术人员就会将复杂的涡轮机部件重新组装好。
items.ex2_en: The divided committee members will reassemble tomorrow to conclude the meeting.
items.ex2_zh: 各自散开的委员会成员将于明天重新集结以结束会议。

items.def_zh: 用鹅卵石（或圆石）铺（路等）
items.def_en: to pave a street, courtyard, or road with rounded stones (cobblestones)
items.ex_en: Artisans cobblestone the historic alleyway using weathered stones gathered from the riverbank.
items.ex_zh: 工匠们用从河岸边采集来的风化鹅卵石铺就了这条历史悠久的小巷。

items.def_zh: 用横木铺设（林间泥泞路）
items.def_en: to build a rough road across swampy or marshy ground by laying logs side by side across it
items.ex_en: Soldiers corduroy the sodden logging trail to allow heavy supply wagons passage through.
items.ex_zh: 士兵们用横木铺设了泥泞的伐木便道，以便沉重的补给车能够通行。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in civil construction describing laying materials (timber, cobblestones, asphalt, gravel) to form or reassemble durable roadways and pathways.
groups.summary_zh: 使用石块、原木、碎石等材料铺设、硬化道面或重构路基。
groups.desc_en: Applies a durable, compacted dressing or masonry layer to bare ground to create a functional thoroughfare, contrasting with simply laying floor coverings indoors or depositing raw aggregate.
groups.desc_zh: 指在裸露地表铺设坚固、压实的硬化层或石料以构建交通道面，区别于室内铺设地板或单纯堆积骨料。
groups.nuance_en: pave: create a continuous hard flat surface (road / courtyard / runway) · tarmac: apply bituminous macadam specifically (driveway / road) · cobblestone: lay rounded paving stones traditionally (street / alley) · surface: treat or finish an uppermost roadway layer (highway / track) · pave over: aggressively cover green space with concrete or asphalt (farmland / habitat)
groups.nuance_zh: pave: 整体铺设硬质平整路面 (road / courtyard / runway) · tarmac: 特指用沥青碎石铺设 (driveway / road) · cobblestone: 传统鹅卵石/块石铺路 (street / alley) · surface: 对道路最上层进行面层处理或翻新 (highway / track) · pave over: 粗暴硬化抹杀绿地 (farmland / habitat)

groups.name: Penetrate & Intrude · 穿透与闯入 (Penetrate, Infiltrate, Intrude)
groups.tip: 破开表面刺入内部

items.def_en: (+ to sth) to push past an outer boundary, line, or crowd to gain unauthorized entry
items.ex_en: Several impatient youths tried to push in past the velvet ropes without wristbands.
items.ex_zh: 几个心急的年轻人没有手环，企图强行挤过天鹅绒隔离绳闯入。

items.def_en: [I/T] to gain access to an organization or secure area gradually and secretly
items.ex_en: Undercover agents managed to infiltrate the extremist network after months of meticulous preparation.
items.ex_zh: 经过数月的精心准备，卧底特工成功潜入了该极端组织网络。

items.def_en: (+ on) to enter someone's land or property without permission
items.ex_en: Hikers must ensure they do not trespass on private farmland during the excursion.
items.ex_zh: 徒步旅行者在远足期间必须确保不擅自闯入私人农田。

items.def_en: (+ into/on/upon) To enter a private situation, conversation, or place where you are not invited, wanted, or expected.
items.ex_en: He felt uneasy about intruding on their intimate family discussion during dinner tonight.
items.ex_zh: 他觉得今晚在晚饭时打扰他们私密的家庭谈话很不自在。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to gradually intrude upon another's space, rights, or territory
items.ex_en: Commercial developments steadily encroach upon the natural habitats of several endangered bird species.
items.ex_zh: 商业开发正逐步侵蚀几种濒危鸟类的自然栖息地。

items.def_en: (+ to sth) to enter a building or secured space forcefully and without permission
items.ex_en: Masked thieves attempted to break in to the jewelry boutique around midnight yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 蒙面小偷昨天午夜前后企图强行闯入这家珠宝精品店。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to push or drive an object or body through an obstacle or barrier with sheer mechanical force
items.ex_en: Rescuers had to force in the steel pry bar to open the door.
items.ex_zh: 救援人员不得不硬把钢质撬棍塞进去，以撬开车门。

items.def_en: to break through a wall, barrier, or defense
items.ex_en: Enemy forces managed to breach the perimeter wall under the cover of fog.
items.ex_zh: 敌军在浓雾的掩护下成功冲破了外围防护墙。

items.def_zh: 刺入，穿透；渗入，打入；洞悉，看穿
items.def_en: 1. To force a way into or through something. 2. To enter and become established in an organization, group, or market. 3. To succeed in understanding something complicated or mysterious.
items.ex_en: The exploratory drill managed to penetrate the thick subterranean rock layer after hours.
items.ex_zh: 经过数小时的作业，勘探钻机终于穿透了厚厚的地下岩层。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve entering, breaking through, or encroaching upon a physical space, barrier, or territory without authorization or through sheer physical ingress.
groups.summary_zh: 指强行穿透防线或障碍，或未经准许擅自侵入特定空间的动作。
groups.desc_en: Breaches a spatial boundary, jurisdiction, or protected domain without permission or through surreptitious force, contrasting with welcomed entry or mutual crossing.
groups.desc_zh: 指未经许可或通过隐秘力量强行跨越空间边界、管辖权或防护领域，区别于合法获准进入或正常的穿行。
groups.nuance_en: infiltrate: covert gradual penetration into an organization or territory (cell / ranks / network) · trespass: enter private property unlawfully without force (land / grounds) · intrude: thrust oneself disruptively where uninvited (privacy / domain / meeting) · breach: forcibly rupture a barrier or defensive line (wall / defense / perimeter) · encroach: advance gradually beyond acceptable boundaries (territory / rights)
groups.nuance_zh: infiltrate: 隐秘逐步渗入组织或领地 (cell / ranks / network) · trespass: 非法踏足私人领地 (land / grounds) · intrude: 突兀擅闯私密空间或领域 (privacy / domain / meeting) · breach: 暴力攻破防线或屏障 (wall / defense / perimeter) · encroach: 逐步侵蚀蚕食边界或权益 (territory / rights)

groups.name: Perform & Enact · 扮演与戏剧重现 (Portray, Enact, Personify)
groups.tip: 在舞台或情景中搬演再现

items.def_en: to represent an incident, story, or emotion by actions, gestures, and words
items.ex_en: The children love to act out adventurous fairy tales during their drama class.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们喜欢在戏剧课上把充满冒险的童话故事表演出来。

items.def_zh: 戏剧性地演绎，重现（情节或事件）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to enact or perform a dramatic scenario, scene, or event
items.ex_en: Actors gathered to play out the tragic final scene before a mesmerized audience.
items.ex_zh: 演员们聚集在一起，在如痴如醉的观众面前演绎悲惨的最后一幕。
items.ex2_en: The unexpected political drama played out dramatically on national television yesterday.
items.ex2_zh: 这场出人意料的政治闹剧昨天在国家电视台戏剧性地上演了。

items.def_zh: 过火地表演，夸张做作地演戏
items.def_en: (+ sth) to perform a role with exaggerated, melodramatic, or unnatural theatricality
items.ex_en: He chose to ham up the villain role with exaggerated theatrical gestures.
items.ex_zh: 他决定用夸张做作的戏剧肢体动作来把反派角色演得过火一点。

items.def_en: to act the part of a character in a film, play, or television show
items.ex_en: She was chosen to portray the reclusive poet in the upcoming television series.
items.ex_zh: 她被选中在即将播出的电视剧中饰演那位深居简出的诗人。

items.def_en: to act out a role, story, or play on a stage or in front of an audience
items.ex_en: The troupe will enact the classical tragedy on the open-air stage this weekend.
items.ex_zh: 该剧团将于本周末在露天舞台上演出这部古典悲剧。

items.def_en: to pretend to be another person, either for entertainment or to deceive
items.ex_en: The con artist used forged credentials to impersonate a federal security officer convincingly.
items.ex_zh: 这个骗子使用伪造的证件逼真地冒充了一名联邦安全官员。

items.def_zh: 进行角色扮演，扮演……角色
items.def_en: To act out a particular role or scenario in training, therapy, or entertainment.
items.ex_en: New trainees will roleplay difficult customer negotiations during tomorrow morning's orientation workshop.
items.ex_zh: 新学员将在明天上午的新人培训工作坊中对困难的客户谈判进行角色扮演。

items.def_zh: 演哑剧；用手势动作再现
items.def_en: To express a story, action, or meaning entirely through silent gestures and movements.
items.ex_en: The silent performer could pantomime complex emotional struggles without uttering a single word.
items.ex_zh: 这位无声表演者无需吐露半个字，便能用哑剧动作展现复杂的内心挣扎。

items.def_zh: 再现，重新演练（历史事件或罪案）
items.def_en: To perform or act out an event from the past again, as in a drama, battle reenactment, or police investigation.
items.ex_en: Detectives asked the witness to reenact the fateful encounter step by step.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们要求目击者一步一步重演那次生死攸关的遭遇经过。

groups.summary_en: An actor or participant adopts a role, mimics actions without speech, or systematically dramatizes a past event or fictional scenario for instruction, therapy, or entertainment.
groups.summary_zh: 表演者扮演指定角色，通过肢体默剧或情境复现来演绎情节。
groups.desc_en: Renders an identity, fictional persona, or historical event visible through deliberate dramatic mimesis and physical embodiment, contrasting with genuine real-world conduct.
groups.desc_zh: 通过戏剧性摹拟与身躯化呈现，将虚构角色或历史事件具象化表演出来，区别于现实中的真实自然举止。
groups.nuance_en: portray: depict a character with interpretive depth (hero / villain / monarch) · enact: perform a script or recreate an event legally or theatrically (scene / ritual / pageant) · impersonate: mimic another real person deceptively or comically (officer / celebrity) · act out: translate fantasies or psychodramas into overt physical performance (fantasy / scenario) · ham up: overact extravagantly for theatrical effect (role / scene)
groups.nuance_zh: portray: 具象且有深度地刻画塑造角色 (hero / villain / monarch) · enact: 照剧本演繹或戏剧化重现 (scene / ritual / pageant) · impersonate: 仿冒、假扮具体人物 (officer / celebrity) · act out: 将心理剧或想象付诸外化表演 (fantasy / scenario) · ham up: 夸张过火地做戏表演 (role / scene)

groups.name: Permit & Authorize · 许可与批准 (Permit, Approve, Authorize, License)
groups.tip: 上级或官方正式认可与许可

items.def_en: To give official clearance or permission to proceed after review
items.ex_en: Customs officials will clear the international shipment after completing the thorough inspection protocol.
items.ex_zh: 海关官员在完成彻底的查验程序后，将对这批国际货物审核放行。
items.ex2_en: The dark storm clouds cleared slowly, revealing a bright blue sky.
items.ex2_zh: 乌云慢慢散去，露出了晴朗的蓝天。

items.def_en: 1. To give official or legal permission to someone to do, use, or own something.
items.ex_en: The regulatory board voted unanimously to license the newly developed medical diagnostic device.
items.ex_zh: 监管委员会一致投票批准许可这款新开发的医疗诊断设备。

items.def_zh: 批准，通过，核准；赞成，同意
items.def_en: 1. To officially agree to or accept a plan, proposal, or request. 2. To think that someone or something is good, right, or acceptable.
items.ex_en: The committee decided to approve the revised construction budget after a lengthy debate.
items.ex_zh: 经过长时间的辩论，委员会决定批准修改后的施工预算。

items.def_zh: 允许，准许；使成为可能，容许
items.def_en: 1. To officially allow someone to do something or allow something to happen. 2. To make something possible.
items.ex_en: Strict safety regulations do not permit unauthorized personnel inside the hazardous chemical lab.
items.ex_zh: 严格的安全规程不允许未经授权的人员进入危险化学品实验室。

items.def_en: (+ to) To give permission or express willingness for something to happen
items.ex_en: The patient must formally consent to the experimental surgical procedure before tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 患者必须在明天早上之前正式同意接受该实验性手术。

items.def_en: 1. To give official permission or legal authority for someone to do something or for something to happen.
items.ex_en: Only the chief executive officer may authorize expenditure requests exceeding ten thousand dollars.
items.ex_zh: 只有首席执行官有权批准超过一万美元的开支申请。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to give official or formal approval to a plan, document, or proposal
items.ex_en: The client will sign off on the architectural drawings by Friday afternoon, hopefully.
items.ex_zh: 不出意外的话，客户将在周五下午正式签字批准这些建筑图纸。

items.def_en: To give official, authoritative permission or approval for an action
items.ex_en: The governing council declined to sanction the proposed offshore oil drilling exploration project.
items.ex_zh: 理事会拒绝正式批准这项拟议中的近海石油钻探勘探项目。

items.def_zh: 使合法化；使非刑事化；免除……的刑事处罚
items.def_en: To change the law so that an activity is no longer treated as a crime.
items.ex_en: Lawmakers recently gathered to decriminalize the possession of small quantities of certain substances.
items.ex_zh: 立法者最近齐聚一堂，旨在免除对持有少量特定物质的刑事处罚。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this legal/administrative frame denote granting formal permission, legal capacity, or regulatory sanction to an individual or an activity.
groups.summary_zh: 官方或具权机构给予正当性认可，正式授予行事许可或合法化。
groups.desc_en: Formally or authoritatively grants clearance to perform an action or utilize a resource, contrasting with passive non-intervention or informal encouraging.
groups.desc_zh: 以权力、法律或权威身份正式签批或认可某项行动或资源使用，区别于消极不干预或非正式鼓励。
groups.nuance_en: authorize: endow with legal power or formal warrant (expenditure / strike / use) · permit: grant explicit clearance under rules (entry / access / visit) · license: confer certified statutory permission (operator / venue) · sanction: authoritatively ratify or endorse (policy / intervention) · sign off on: provide final administrative concurrence (plan / blueprint / project)
groups.nuance_zh: authorize: 赋权或正式特许 (expenditure / strike / use) · permit: 在章程下明确准许 (entry / access / visit) · license: 颁发法定许可执照 (operator / venue) · sanction: 官方正式批准或认可 (policy / intervention) · sign off on: 最终签字放行确认 (plan / blueprint / project)

groups.name: Physically Hold & Grasp · 握持与抓拿 (Hold, Grasp, Grip)
groups.tip: 用手掌握并保持稳定状态

items.def_zh: 握住，拿住，抱住；持有，容纳；保持；举行
items.def_en: 1. to carry, grasp, or support someone or something with your hands or arms. 2. to contain, maintain, or have in a particular position or state. 3. to organize or conduct an event
items.ex_en: She managed to hold the fragile crystal vase carefully with both steady hands.
items.ex_zh: 她用平稳的双手小心翼翼地拿稳了那个易碎的水晶花瓶。

items.def_zh: 握住，拿住（hold 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: past tense and past participle of hold; to grasp, carry, or support with the hands or arms
items.ex_en: He held the injured puppy gently against his chest until the veterinarian arrived.
items.ex_zh: 他轻轻地把受伤的小狗抱在胸前，直到兽医赶来。

items.def_en: [I/T] to hold something tightly and firmly with the hand
items.ex_en: Terrified by turbulence, the nervous passenger began to grip the armrests very tightly.
items.ex_zh: 由于被颠簸吓坏了，这名紧张的乘客开始死死抓住扶手。

items.def_en: (+ to sb/sth) to grasp or maintain physical hold of something tightly with the hands
items.ex_en: Please hold on to the safety railing while ascending the steep iron staircase.
items.ex_zh: 登上陡峭的铁楼梯时，请抓紧安全扶手。

items.def_en: (+ to sb/sth) to hold something firmly or tightly with one's hands or arms
items.ex_en: Hang on a second, let me grab a pen to write that down.
items.ex_zh: 稍等一下，我拿支笔把它记下来。

items.def_en: (+ on sb/sth) to grip or compress an object firmly using hands or an instrument so it cannot move
items.ex_en: The carpenter used heavy vices to clamp down on the glued wooden boards.
items.ex_zh: 木匠用重型虎钳死死夹住涂了胶的木板。

items.def_en: [I/T] to take a firm hold of somebody or something with the hand
items.ex_en: The toddler managed to grasp the colorful rattle and shook it with delight.
items.ex_zh: 蹒跚学步的孩子一把抓住了彩色手摇铃，开心地摇晃起来。

items.def_en: [I/T] to hold something tightly, often in fear, anxiety, or pain
items.ex_en: The frightened little boy began to clutch his mother's hand during the storm.
items.ex_zh: 暴风雨中，受惊的小男孩开始死死抓牢母亲的手。

items.def_en: [I/T] to hold someone or something tightly in your hands or arms
items.ex_en: She did clasp the precious pendant against her breast, whispering a silent prayer.
items.ex_zh: 她将珍贵的吊坠紧抱在胸前，低声默念着祈祷。

groups.summary_en: This frame involves securing and keeping an object or person with the hand, arms, or fingers. Verbs range from baseline holding to tight clutches and firm gripping.
groups.summary_zh: 指用手、手指或双臂控制、执持物体或人，涵盖从自然持握到紧紧抓牢。
groups.desc_en: Applies mechanical tension through fingers or extremities to secure possession and prevent detachment or falling, contrasting with mere touching or lifting.
groups.desc_zh: 通过手指或四肢施加机械夹力以维持对物体的控制并防止脱落，区别于单纯触碰或托举。
groups.nuance_en: hold: maintain physical support and custody in hands (baby / cup / hand) · grip: maintain tight, resolute friction against slipping (handle / racket / steering wheel) · grasp: seize firmly with fingers enclosing an object (rope / lapel / wrist) · clutch: cling frantically or possessively out of fear or greed (chest / pearls / purse) · clamp down: mechanically or forcefully lock tight onto something (jaw / vise)
groups.nuance_zh: hold: 双手托持或拿取保有 (baby / cup / hand) · grip: 用力紧握以防打滑 (handle / racket / steering wheel) · grasp: 伸手抓牢握紧 (rope / lapel / wrist) · clutch: 因恐惧或占有欲本能地死死抱紧 (chest / pearls / purse) · clamp down: 机械式或大力死死钳紧 (jaw / vise)

groups.name: Pierce & Penetrate · 穿透与刺入 (Skewer, Pierce, Ream)
groups.tip: 尖锐利物刺入内部

items.def_en: (+ sth) to pierce or push a pointed tip completely through an opening or barrier
items.ex_en: The sharp nail threatened to poke through the thin rubber sole of his sneaker.
items.ex_zh: 那枚锋利的钉子眼看就要刺穿他运动鞋那层薄薄的橡胶底。
items.ex2_en: The curious puppy poked its wet nose through the wooden picket fence.
items.ex2_zh: 好奇的小狗将湿漉漉的鼻子从木栅栏缝隙中探了出来。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to forcefully push a pointed object into something with a quick, sharp thrust
items.ex_en: The nurse will jab into the shoulder muscle with the vaccination syringe quickly.
items.ex_zh: 护士会迅速用疫苗注射器刺入肩膀的肌肉中。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to push a sharp or pointed object firmly into a surface or material
items.ex_en: Be careful not to stick that pointed screwdriver into the fragile electrical panel.
items.ex_zh: 当心不要把那把锋利的螺丝刀戳进脆弱的配电盘里。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make a hole in or through something using a sharp point
items.ex_en: A sharp rusted wire managed to pierce through the thick protective leather glove.
items.ex_zh: 一根锋利的生锈铁丝竟刺穿了厚重的防护皮手套。

items.def_zh: 刺穿；用签子串起；严厉批评，嘲讽
items.def_en: 1. To push a sharp skewer or pin through food (such as meat or vegetables). 2. (informal) To criticize or mock someone sharply and thoroughly.
items.ex_en: The chef began to skewer marinated chicken chunks alongside bell peppers for grilling.
items.ex_zh: 厨师开始用签子把腌好的鸡肉块与彩椒串在一起准备烧烤。

items.def_zh: 铰孔，扩孔；用榨汁器榨取（果汁）；严加斥责
items.def_en: 1. To enlarge, shape, or clear a hole using a rotating tool (reamer). 2. To squeeze juice from citrus fruit with a reamer. 3. (informal, chiefly US) To reprimand someone severely.
items.ex_en: The artisan did ream the brass barrel bore until it shone smooth.
items.ex_zh: 工匠扩铰着黄铜枪管的内孔，直至其光洁平滑。

items.def_en: to thrust through with or as if with a spear
items.ex_en: The seasoned fisherman intended to spear the giant tuna from the rocking boat.
items.ex_zh: 这位经验丰富的渔民打算从摇晃的小船上用矛刺中那条巨型金枪鱼。

items.def_en: (literary) to pierce through with a sharp weapon so as to fix in place
items.ex_en: A wicked iron shaft did transfix the fallen knight upon the muddy field.
items.ex_zh: 一根阴狠的铁箭将倒下的骑士钉死在泥泞的荒原上。

items.def_en: to pierce through with a sharp stake or instrument right through the body
items.ex_en: The fallen timber branch threatened to impale anyone reckless enough to stumble beneath.
items.ex_zh: 掉落的树枝极其危险，随时可能刺穿任何冒失摔倒在下方的过客。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate forcefully driving a pointed or sharp instrument entirely through or into an object, often impaling, boring, or widening the perforation.
groups.summary_zh: 指用尖锐或特定工具用力穿透、贯穿物体或扩大孔洞的动作。
groups.desc_en: Forces an elongated, pointed, or sharp implement through the structural skin of a body or medium, contrasting with non-penetrating blunt blows or superficial lacerations.
groups.desc_zh: 将细长尖锐器具完全穿透躯体或介质表层，区别于未入肉的钝击或表皮划伤。
groups.nuance_en: pierce: puncture smoothly through a barrier or tissue (ear / skin / armor) · skewer: drive an elongated spit entirely through multiple points (meat / prey) · spear: impale with a long thrusting weapon (fish / target) · transfix: pin completely through so as to immobilize (prey / limb) · ream: bore through and widen an existing cavity aggressively (hole / bore)
groups.nuance_zh: pierce: 锐器顺畅刺破穿透 (ear / skin / armor) · skewer: 如肉串般完全戳穿贯通 (meat / prey) · spear: 投枪或长矛刺中 (fish / target) · transfix: 贯穿并钉死使其无法动弹 (prey / limb) · ream: 强行深钻铰通并扩大孔穴 (hole / bore)

groups.name: Play Sport & Score · 竞技与得分 (Eagle, Birdie, Cricket)
groups.tip: 参与体育运动并争取得分

items.def_en: [I/T] to deliver the ball in cricket or roll the ball in bowling
items.ex_en: The star bowler stepped up to bowl a lightning-fast delivery past the crease.
items.ex_zh: 明星投球手走上前去，投出了一记越过击球线的闪电快球。

items.def_zh: （高尔夫球）打出低于标准杆两杆的成绩
items.def_en: (golf) To score an eagle by completing a hole in two strokes under par.
items.ex_en: With an astonishing approach shot, she did eagle the formidable eighteenth hole yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 凭借一记惊艳的攻岭击球，她昨天在难度极高的第十八洞打出了双鹰球。

items.def_en: To play the sport of cricket.
items.ex_en: Gentlemen would cricket on the sunlit village green throughout the languid English summers.
items.ex_zh: 在漫长闲适的英国夏天，绅士们常在阳光明媚的乡村草坪上打板球。

items.def_en: to hit the first shot from the tee in a round or hole of golf
items.ex_en: The championship contenders will tee off sharply at eight o'clock tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 锦标赛的竞争者们将于明天上午八点整准时开球。

items.def_zh: （板球中）击中三柱门将（击球员）淘汰出局
items.def_en: (+ sb) to dismiss a batsman in cricket by knocking down the wicket with the ball
items.ex_en: A spinning delivery managed to bowl out the rival team's star captain decisively.
items.ex_zh: 一记旋转球果断击中三柱门，将对方队伍的明星队长淘汰出局。

items.def_en: to finish playing a hole in golf by hitting the ball into the cup with a putter
items.ex_en: He did putt out from twenty paces, clinching his historic tournament triumph.
items.ex_zh: 他从二十步开外推球入洞，锁定了他在这场锦标赛中的历史性胜利。

items.def_en: to complete a golf hole in the standard number of strokes
items.ex_en: The skilled amateur managed to par the treacherous fourteenth hole despite fierce wind.
items.ex_zh: 尽管狂风大作，这位技术娴熟的业余选手还是在凶险的第十四洞保平了标准杆。

items.def_en: [I/T] to shoot one stroke under par on a golf hole
items.ex_en: She managed to birdie the final hole, sealing her victory in the tournament.
items.ex_zh: 她在最后一个球洞击出了小鸟球，锁定了锦标赛的胜局。

items.def_en: [I/T] to shoot one stroke over par on a golf hole
items.ex_en: A missed short putt caused the weary champion to bogey the final hole.
items.ex_zh: 一次近距离推杆失误导致这位疲惫的卫冕冠军在最后一洞吞下了柏忌。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scenario frame represent playing specific sporting matches or achieving distinctive game-specific scores and plays (such as golf or team athletics).
groups.summary_zh: 指参与特定体育项目比赛，或在运动竞技中取得特定计分或动作。
groups.desc_en: Executes prescribed athletic strokes, deliveries, or target shots to advance game status and record points within sporting rules, contrasting with casual playground recreation.
groups.desc_zh: 在严密竞技规则内实施击球、投掷或进洞动作以推进行程或获取积分，区别于日常无规则的嬉戏玩耍。
groups.nuance_en: tee off: play the opening stroke of a golf hole (round / drive) · birdie: score one stroke under par on a golf hole (hole / seventeenth) · eagle: score two strokes under par on a golf hole (hole / fifth) · bowl: propel the ball toward the wicket or pins (delivery / over) · bowl out: dismiss a batsman by hitting the wicket (batsman / side)
groups.nuance_zh: tee off: 高尔夫开球 (round / drive) · birdie: 高尔夫打出低于标准杆一杆 (hole / seventeenth) · eagle: 高尔夫打出低于标准杆两杆 (hole / fifth) · bowl: 板球/保龄球中投球 (delivery / over) · bowl out: 板球中击中三柱门使击球手出局 (batsman / side)

groups.name: Plead & Beseech · 请求与哀求 (Urgent and Desperate Entreaty)
groups.tip: 从诚恳恳请加剧为声泪俱下哀求

items.def_en: (+ sb) to make an earnest or formal request to someone for aid, sympathy, or a decision
items.ex_en: The prime minister will appeal to allied leaders for immediate humanitarian aid tonight.
items.ex_zh: 首相今晚将向盟国领导人呼吁，请求立即提供人道主义援助。

items.def_en: (+ for/to do) to ask someone earnestly or anxiously for something, showing vulnerability
items.ex_en: Desperate villagers gathered around the convoy to beg for clean drinking water.
items.ex_zh: 绝望的村民们聚集在车队周围，乞求获得干净的饮用水。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to make an earnest, urgent, and emotional appeal to someone for help or mercy
items.ex_en: The terrified hostage began to plead with the kidnappers for his life.
items.ex_zh: 惊恐万分的人质开始向绑匪央求饶他一命。

items.def_en: (+ with/for) to make a passionate, emotional appeal to someone for mercy or assistance
items.ex_en: Tearful family members continued to plead for clemency outside the high court.
items.ex_zh: 泪流满面的家属们继续在高等法院外哀求予以宽大处理。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to urgently and desperately plead or ask for help, mercy, or relief
items.ex_en: The entire healthcare system is crying out for urgent reform.
items.ex_zh: 整个医疗体系迫切需要紧急改革。

items.def_en: (+ to do) to beg someone desperately and movingly to do or refrain from doing something
items.ex_en: I implore you to reconsider your resignation before making a fatal mistake.
items.ex_zh: 我痛切恳求你在犯下致命错误之前重新考虑辞职一事。

items.def_en: to ask someone for something in an anxious and earnest way; to beg desperately
items.ex_en: On bended knee, the captive did beseech the king to spare his son.
items.ex_zh: 俘虏双膝跪地，哀求国王饶恕他的儿子。

items.def_en: to ask or beg someone earnestly and emotionally to do something
items.ex_en: The diplomat chose to entreat the committee to grant an emergency ceasefire.
items.ex_zh: 这位外交官郑重恳求委员会批准紧急停火。

items.def_en: (+ for) to ask humbly and submissively, often in prayer or on bended knee
items.ex_en: The penitent knelt in silent adoration to supplicate for divine forgiveness.
items.ex_zh: 忏悔者跪倒在静默的崇敬中，虔诚祈告神明的宽恕。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures speakers urgently imploring someone for help, mercy, or a concession, progressing in intensity from earnest appeals to emotional, desperate supplication.
groups.summary_zh: 出于紧迫需求或危局，向对方提出极度恳切的请求或哀告乞求。
groups.desc_en: Makes an urgent, humble, and emotionally charged petition to a person in power to avert catastrophe or gain mercy, contrasting with routine asking or claiming entitlements.
groups.desc_zh: 因绝境或深重危机向掌权者发出极其迫切、卑微且动之以情的心灵呼求，区别于日常索要或主张正当权益。
groups.nuance_en: beg: ask humbly or desperately for sustenance or mercy (mercy / pardon / food) · plead: offer impassioned, reasoning entreaty under crisis (case / cause / innocence) · implore: call upon someone with tearful, agonizing urgency (aid / forgiveness) · beseech: petition with reverent, high-register earnestness (favor / protection) · entreat: urge someone deeply through polite personal appeal (guest / sovereign)
groups.nuance_zh: beg: 卑微甚至乞讨般乞求怜悯或施舍 (mercy / pardon / food) · plead: 危机下苦苦辩解哀告 (case / cause / innocence) · implore: 痛彻心扉、声泪俱下地乞求 (aid / forgiveness) · beseech: 庄重且极尽虔敬地恳请 (favor / protection) · entreat: 郑重恳切地劝请求告 (guest / sovereign)

groups.name: Plot & Conspire · 密谋与图谋 (Plot, Scheme, Conspire)
groups.tip: 暗中图谋行事手段

items.def_zh: 密谋，暗中策划；在地图（或图表）上标出；为（小说等）设计情节
items.def_en: 1. To secretly plan something harmful or illegal. 2. To mark or draw a route, position, or points on a map or chart. 3. To plan the storyline or series of events for a book or play.
items.ex_en: Disgruntled junior officers gathered in secret to plot against the ruling general.
items.ex_zh: 心怀不满的下级军官们秘密集会，密谋推翻掌权的将军。

items.def_en: To make clever, deceitful, and secret plans to achieve something, especially to gain an advantage.
items.ex_en: Corrupt executives met after hours to scheme how to evade federal taxes.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的高管们在下班后碰头，暗中图谋如何逃避联邦税收。

items.def_zh: 密谋；捏造；谋划（阴谋诡计）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to invent or secretly concoct a plan, scheme, or story, typically deceitful or self-serving
items.ex_en: He had to cook up an excuse for being late to the morning briefing.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不编造一个早会迟到的借口。

items.def_zh: 结伙；联手对付（通常配合 on）
items.def_en: to join together in a group to oppose, bully, or conspire against someone
items.ex_en: The older boys decided to gang up on the newcomer during recess.
items.ex_zh: 大一些的男生们决定在课间休息时联手欺负那个新来的同学。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to conspire against someone by fabricating false evidence to make them appear guilty
items.ex_en: Corrupt detectives planted stolen diamonds in his apartment to frame him up.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的刑警把赃物钻石栽赃在他的公寓里，企图构陷他。

items.def_zh: 耍阴谋，暗中策划（宫廷、政治斗争中）
items.def_en: (+ against/with) To make secret plans to harm someone or gain advantage
items.ex_en: Ambitious courtiers continually intrigue against the chancellor to gain the monarch's favor.
items.ex_zh: 野心勃勃的廷臣们不断在暗中耍阴谋对付宰相，以博取君主的宠信。

items.def_zh: 策划，密谋（常与 plot/scheme 连用）
items.def_en: (often + plot/plan) To devise or concoct a secret plan or deception
items.ex_en: The rebel faction met in the shadows to hatch a treasonous plot.
items.ex_zh: 叛乱派系在暗处聚首，密谋策划一场叛国行动。

items.def_zh: 共谋，图谋（做非法或有害之事）
items.def_en: [I/T] (+ with/against/to do) To plan secretly with others to commit an unlawful act
items.ex_en: Several rogue traders decided to conspire to manipulate international currency markets.
items.ex_zh: 几名违规交易员决定共同谋划操纵国际货币市场。

items.def_zh: 串通，勾结（尤为欺诈或不正当目的）
items.def_en: (+ with/in) To cooperate secretly or unlawfully with others to deceive
items.ex_en: The pharmaceutical giant was found to collude with distributors to fix prices.
items.ex_zh: 这家制药巨头被发现与分销商暗中勾结以操纵价格。

groups.summary_en: This scenario frame details agents privately, craftily, and often illicitly concocting plans to bring about harmful, subversive, or self-serving ends. It typically collocates with clauses ('plot that/to do') or prepositions ('scheme/conspire against/with').
groups.summary_zh: 多指暗中策划狡黠、违规或图谋不轨的计划，多带贬义或神秘色彩。
groups.desc_en: Clandestinely devises and coordinates an illicit or deceitful mechanism to undermine a rival or overthrow order, contrasting with legitimate planning or open strategy.
groups.desc_zh: 暗中策划并串通非法、险恶机制以倾轧对手或颠覆秩序，区别于公开合法的筹划或正大光明的策略。
groups.nuance_en: conspire: join secretly with others to commit an unlawful act (treason / overthrow) · plot: methodically engineer a covert hostile operation (rebellion / downfall / revenge) · scheme: calculate devious stratagems for self-advancement (promotion / wealth) · hatch: secretly incubate an intricate plan from inception (conspiracy / scheme) · frame up: fabricate evidence to falsely incriminate someone (suspect / victim)
groups.nuance_zh: conspire: 结伙密谋违法害人勾当 (treason / overthrow) · plot: 有条不紊地谋划颠覆或暗算 (rebellion / downfall / revenge) · scheme: 诡计多端地为私利图谋 (promotion / wealth) · hatch: 暗中酝酿孵化阴谋 (conspiracy / scheme) · frame up: 捏造伪证构陷栽赃 (suspect / victim)

groups.name: Poke & Pierce · 戳刺与穿透 (Mechanical Contact Ranging to Puncture)
groups.tip: 从轻戳微刺到尖锐物穿透刺入

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to poke or thrust roughly and repeatedly at someone or something with a pointed object
items.ex_en: The angry protestor began to jab at the microphone with his umbrella.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的抗议者开始用雨伞对着麦克风猛戳。

items.def_en: 1. (+ at/into) To push a finger, stick, or sharp object quickly into or against someone or something. 2. To emerge or cause to project out from an enclosure or opening.
items.ex_en: He used a dry branch to poke at the dying embers.
items.ex_zh: 他用一根干树枝捅了捅快要熄灭的余烬。

items.def_en: [I/T] to push someone or something with a finger or a pointed object
items.ex_en: The veterinarian gently used a wooden instrument to prod the calf's shoulder.
items.ex_zh: 兽医用一根木质器具轻轻戳了戳牛犊的肩膀。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to pierce or push a pointed tip through a surface or opening
items.ex_en: A sharp metal spring began to poke through the worn leather armchair.
items.ex_zh: 一根锋利的金属弹簧开始从破旧的皮扶手椅中戳穿出来。
items.ex2_en: He poked his finger through the torn paper bag to investigate.
items.ex2_zh: 他把手指戳进撕破的纸袋里以一探究竟。

items.def_en: (+ sth/sb) to push a pointed object into someone or something
items.ex_en: The gardener carefully avoided the rusty nail she almost stuck into her foot.
items.ex_zh: 园丁小心翼翼地避开了那枚差点扎进她脚里的生锈铁钉。

items.def_en: to make a very small hole in something or cause mild pain with a sharp point
items.ex_en: The nurse used a sterile needle to prick my finger for blood.
items.ex_zh: 护士用无菌针头扎破了我的手指以采集血液。

items.def_zh: 刺穿，穿透；（光、声等）穿过，刺破
items.def_en: 1. To cut or make a hole through something with a sharp, pointed object. 2. (of light, cold, or sound) To penetrate through darkness, silence, or barriers.
items.ex_en: An icy winter wind seemed to pierce right through our thin jackets.
items.ex_zh: 刺骨的寒风似乎直接穿透了我们单薄的夹克。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make a hole in something with a sharp object, often causing deflation
items.ex_en: Scattered pieces of broken glass threaten to puncture your bicycle tires.
items.ex_zh: 散落的碎玻璃碎片随时可能刺破你的自行车轮胎。
items.ex2_en: The thin latex balloon punctured instantly when it hit the cactus.
items.ex2_zh: 薄薄的乳胶气球碰到仙人掌时立刻被刺破了。

items.def_en: to pierce through with or as if with a pointed weapon; impale completely
items.ex_en: The warrior's iron spear seemed to transfix his opponent through the chest.
items.ex_zh: 战士的铁矛似乎将对手的胸膛完全刺穿。
