groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail pointed contact against an object or body, scaling in force from light prodding to puncturing and deep perforation. 'Poke' initiates superficial contact, whereas 'pierce', 'prick', and 'transfix' penetrate surfaces or impale tissue entirely.
groups.summary_zh: 指以尖物从表层轻微轻戳、刺破直至彻底贯穿。
groups.desc_en: Makes pointed focal physical contact against a target, ranging from an inquisitive prod to mechanical perforation, contrasting with sweeping blows or crushing forces.
groups.desc_zh: 以尖状器具对准靶点施加微创接触，由轻微戳碰递增至机械穿孔，区别于大面积挥打或压碎碾压。
groups.nuance_en: poke: jab inquisitively or lightly with an end (finger / stick / fire) · prod: push firmly with a point to induce movement or reaction (cattle / rib / beast) · jab at: thrust sharply and aggressively with a short stroke (needle / elbow / weapon) · prick: make a tiny surface puncture causing a sharp sensation (finger / bubble / skin) · puncture: completely burst or pierce a pressurized or hollow vessel (tire / lung / balloon)
groups.nuance_zh: poke: 用手指或细物试探性戳动 (finger / stick / fire) · prod: 尖头用力顶戳以促动反应 (cattle / rib / beast) · jab at: 短促迅猛地猛刺猛戳 (needle / elbow / weapon) · prick: 针尖浅浅扎破并伴随锐痛 (finger / bubble / skin) · puncture: 戳破刺穿有张力或中空之物 (tire / lung / balloon)

groups.name: Portend & Herald Future Events · 预示与预兆 (Foreshadow, Portend, Presage)
groups.tip: 事情发生前显露征兆，预先提示未来

items.def_zh: 预示；表明（未来趋势或结果）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to suggest or make it likely that a particular situation or outcome will develop
items.ex_en: Recent economic indicators strongly point to a severe recession in the coming quarter.
items.ex_zh: 近期各项经济指标有力地预示着下一季度将出现严重衰退。

items.def_zh: 预示……的到来；宣告新时期的开始
items.def_en: (+ sth) to be a sign that a new period, event, or change is beginning
items.ex_en: These groundbreaking treaties could herald in a lasting era of mutual disarmament.
items.ex_zh: 这些开创性的条约可能宣告一个持久的共同裁军新时代的到来。

items.def_en: to be a sign that something good or significant is about to happen or arrive
items.ex_en: Golden daffodils emerging across the park herald the much-awaited arrival of spring.
items.ex_zh: 公园里破土而出的金黄水仙预示着人们期盼已久的春天的到来。

items.def_en: To act as a warning or sign of a future event, especially in a book or film.
items.ex_en: The ominous storm clouds foreshadow the violent tragedy at the novel's climax.
items.ex_zh: 不祥的风暴阴云预示着小说高潮部分那场暴烈的悲剧。

items.def_zh: 预示，预兆（常用于 bode well/ill）
items.def_en: (also 'bode well') To be a good or bad sign of what will happen in the future.
items.ex_en: The sudden collapse of negotiations does not bode well for regional stability.
items.ex_zh: 谈判的突然破裂对该地区的稳定而言并非好兆头。

items.def_en: (literary) To act as a sign or warning of something bad; to foreshadow or presage.
items.ex_en: The crow's mournful cries seemed to forebode a sudden and terrible disaster.
items.ex_zh: 乌鸦哀婉的啼叫似乎预示着一场突如其来的可怕灾难。

items.def_en: (+ well/ill) to be a sign, omen, or promise of a particularly good or bad outcome
items.ex_en: The unexpected surge in early bookings should augur well for tourism revenue.
items.ex_zh: 早期预订量的意外激增预示着旅游业收入将迎来良好势头。

items.def_en: (formal or literary) To be a sign or warning that something (especially something bad) is about to happen.
items.ex_en: Heavy morning mists frequently presage a violent thunderstorm later in the day.
items.ex_zh: 清晨的浓雾往往预示着当天晚些时候将有一场剧烈的雷阵雨。

items.def_en: to be a sign or warning that something momentous or calamitous is likely to happen
items.ex_en: Ancient astrologers claimed that comets portend the sudden downfall of kings.
items.ex_zh: 古代占星家声称，彗星的出现预示着君王将遭遇突如其来的陨落。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate that an event, circumstance, or omen serves as an advance sign of a future occurrence, often carrying fateful or ominous connotations.
groups.summary_zh: 事物作为征兆或预感，在事先显露出未来的势头或吉凶。
groups.desc_en: Serves as an early indicator, sign, or metaphysical warning of a future consequence, contrasting with retrospective reflection or concurrent observation.
groups.desc_zh: 作为早期预兆、信号或象征昭示未来的特定结局，区别于事后回溯或当下的平铺直叙。
groups.nuance_en: presage: intuitively or ominously foreshadow an impending event (doom / disaster / change) · herald: loudly announce or mark the arrival of a major epoch or change (era / arrival / dawn) · bode: serve as an intrinsic omen of specified fortune (ill / well) · augur: indicate a likely favorable or unfavorable outcome through signs (success / failure) · foreshadow: provide subtle narrative or real-world previews of later events (climax / tragedy)
groups.nuance_zh: presage: 直觉或凶险地预兆来临 (doom / disaster / change) · herald: 隆重昭示重大时代的到来 (era / arrival / dawn) · bode: 本身内蕴某种吉凶预兆 (ill / well) · augur: 通过迹象卜兆吉凶成败 (success / failure) · foreshadow: 文学或现实中伏笔铺垫后事 (climax / tragedy)

groups.name: Postpone & Put Off · 延后与推迟 (Postpone, Defer, Delay)
groups.tip: 推延时间延期办理

items.def_en: [I/T] to make something happen later than planned or cause someone to be late
items.ex_en: Severe blizzards will delay all scheduled international flights until tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 强烈的暴风雪将使所有原定国际航班延误至明早。

items.def_en: to change an arrangement, task, or meeting to a later date or time
items.ex_en: The board decided to put off the critical decision until next week.
items.ex_zh: 董事会决定将这项关键决议推迟到下周。

items.def_zh: 推迟，延期（时间表、会议等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to reschedule an event or deadline to a later date or time
items.ex_en: The studio had to push back the movie premiere by two months.
items.ex_zh: 制片厂不得不将电影首映礼向后推迟两个月。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to postpone an action, discussion, or decision until a future occasion
items.ex_en: Committee members agreed to hold over the controversial proposal until next month.
items.ex_zh: 委员会成员同意将这项颇具争议的提案延后到下个月再议。

items.def_zh: 延缓（议案等）至某时处理
items.def_en: (+ sth) to postpone formal discussion or consideration of a proposal until a later time
items.ex_en: The committee agreed to table the environmental proposal for next month's session.
items.ex_zh: 委员会同意将这项环保提案延至下个月的会议上再行审议。

items.def_en: To delay an event, plan, or decision so that it takes place at a later time or date.
items.ex_en: Organizers reluctantly chose to postpone the outdoor concert due to heavy rain.
items.ex_zh: 由于大雨倾盆，组织者不得不勉强决定推迟这场户外音乐会。

items.def_en: 1. (formal) To delay or postpone an action, decision, or payment until a later time. 2. (defer to) To yield politely to someone's wishes or authority.
items.ex_en: The judge will defer sentencing until a full psychological assessment is completed.
items.ex_zh: 法官将推迟宣判，直至全面的心理评估完成。

items.def_en: [I/T] to formally pause a trial, meeting, or parliamentary session until a specified later time
items.ex_en: The magistrate agreed to adjourn the court proceedings until ten tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 地方法官同意将法庭审理程序休会并延期至明天上午十点。
items.ex2_en: The parliamentary session will adjourn tomorrow after the final budget vote.
items.ex2_zh: 议会会议将在明天进行最终预算表决后休会。

items.def_en: to alter the scheduled timetable of an appointment or debt repayment
items.ex_en: The dental clinic called to reschedule my routine cleaning for Friday afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 牙科诊所打电话来，将我的常规洗牙时间改到了周五下午。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify rescheduling an event, payment, or decision to a later time rather than proceeding as initially planned, whether by necessity or choice.
groups.summary_zh: 人为安排将原本计划的事件、决定或付款推迟到更晚时间。
groups.desc_en: Shifts a planned agenda item or commitment chronologically backward into the future, contrasting with outright cancellation or immediate execution.
groups.desc_zh: 因外部原因将既定日程或承诺向后顺延至未来某一时间，区别于彻底取消或当即执行。
groups.nuance_en: postpone: reschedule a specific event to a definitive later date (match / election / hearing) · defer: intentionally yield execution to a future period out of judgment or courtesy (decision / payment / service) · delay: slow down or set back due to obstacles (flight / departure / process) · adjourn: formally suspend a parliamentary or legal session until later (meeting / court / session) · table: shelve a legislative motion indefinitely (motion / bill / proposal)
groups.nuance_zh: postpone: 正式将明确日程延后改期 (match / election / hearing) · defer: 基于审慎或礼让主动暂缓推迟 (decision / payment / service) · delay: 因受阻碍而被动耽搁滞后 (flight / departure / process) · adjourn: 休庭或会议正式暂时休会 (meeting / court / session) · table: 议案搁置暂不讨论 (motion / bill / proposal)

groups.name: Prejudice Judgment & Incline Unfairly · 偏见与先入为主 (Bias, Prejudice, Color)
groups.tip: 由施加影响到成见偏袒

items.def_en: to influence or skew someone's opinion or attitude, often subtly or unconsciously
items.ex_en: Personal grudges should never color an investigator's evaluation of the forensic evidence.
items.ex_zh: 个人恩怨绝不应影响调查员对法医物证的客观评估。
items.ex2_en: Her pale cheeks colored slightly when the teacher praised her painting.
items.ex2_zh: 当老师称赞她的画作时，她苍白的脸颊微微泛红。

items.def_zh: 使偏向；对……带有倾向性倾斜
items.def_en: (+ sth) to present information or frame judgments in a biased way favoring a particular side
items.ex_en: The editorial seemed to slant toward the ruling party's economic agenda.
items.ex_zh: 这篇社论在言辞上似乎偏向执政党的经济议程。

items.def_en: to present information from a particular angle so as to bias the audience
items.ex_en: Tabloid reporters deliberately slant the news to provoke an emotional public reaction.
items.ex_zh: 小报记者故意带倾向性地歪曲报道新闻，以激起公众的情绪反应。
items.ex2_en: The wooden roof beams slant downward to allow rainwater to drain.
items.ex2_zh: 木质屋顶横梁向下倾斜以便让雨水排走。

items.def_zh: 使预先倾向于，使对……产生偏好
items.def_en: (+ to/toward) to influence someone beforehand toward a particular judgment or state
items.ex_en: Early childhood hardships can predispose individuals toward severe anxiety in adulthood.
items.ex_zh: 童年早期的艰辛经历会使人预先倾向于在成年后产生严重焦虑。

items.def_zh: 不利于；使处于受偏见劣势
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to influence a judgment or decision unfavorably against someone or something
items.ex_en: Lack of field experience will weigh heavily against the candidate's promotion.
items.ex_zh: 缺乏一线经验将对该候选人的晋升极为不利。

items.def_zh: 使有偏见，使偏心，使偏袒
items.def_en: To influence someone or something in an unfair way so that they favor one side.
items.ex_en: Unconscious preconceptions can subtly bias an interviewer against qualified female applicants.
items.ex_zh: 无意识的先入之见可能会微妙地使面试官对合格的女性应聘者产生偏袒歧视。

items.def_zh: 使怀有偏见，使产生成见；对……不利，损害
items.def_en: 1. To influence someone so that they have an unfair, unreasonable opinion. 2. (formal/law) To harm or damage a right, claim, or legal case.
items.ex_en: Sensational media reports might prejudice potential jurors against the accused before trial.
items.ex_zh: 耸人听闻的媒体报道可能会在开庭前使潜在陪审员对被告产生成见。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to cause someone to feel hostility, distrust, or prejudice toward someone or something
items.ex_en: Slanderous rumors were spread intentionally to turn the town against the newcomer.
items.ex_zh: 有人故意散布诽谤性谣言，以使全镇居民对那个新来者产生敌意。

items.def_zh: 毒化（思想或人际判断），使产生根深蒂固的敌意偏见
items.def_en: to corrupt or permanently bias someone's mind or attitude against someone or something
items.ex_en: Bitter grievances continue to poison relations between the neighboring border communities.
items.ex_zh: 宿怨不断毒化着相邻边境社区之间的关系并加深敌意。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate influencing someone's judgment, perception, or decision unfairly before factual appraisal. Intensity escalates from subtle affective skewing (color, slant) to conscious partiality (bias), culminating in entrenched, damaging preconceptions that shut down fair consideration (prejudice, poison).
groups.summary_zh: 描述外力或先入为主观念破坏公平中立，使判断逐渐偏向某一侧乃至彻底扭曲。
groups.desc_en: Applies a distorting, asymmetrical cognitive or emotional skew to one's assessment of reality, contrasting with neutral, objective deliberation.
groups.desc_zh: 以不对称的情感或偏见扭曲对现实的客观评估，区别于公允中立的审视与权衡。
groups.nuance_en: bias: systematically skew judgment toward an unbalanced position (reporting / jury / view) · prejudice: induce preconceived hostile conclusions before facts are heard (mind / jury / case) · color: subtly influence perception or interpretation with emotion (view / memory / judgment) · slant: deliberately present information from an angled perspective (article / news / story) · predispose: condition an attitude or susceptibility in advance (mind / patient / voter)
groups.nuance_zh: bias: 系统性地造成判断失衡与偏向 (reporting / jury / view) · prejudice: 先入为主使产生不公断定 (mind / jury / case) · color: 夹带主观情绪从而渲染蒙蔽判断 (view / memory / judgment) · slant: 刻意带倾向性地偏颇剪裁 (article / news / story) · predispose: 预先使心智倾向于某种看法 (mind / patient / voter)

groups.name: Prepare & Prime · 准备、筹备与预置 (Prepare, Ready, Prime)
groups.tip: 预先做好安排使其就绪

items.def_en: 1. To make someone or something prepared or ready for use or action.
items.ex_en: The commander ordered his troops to ready their weapons for immediate departure.
items.ex_zh: 指挥官命令部队整理好武器，准备立即出发。

items.def_zh: 准备，预备；调制，配制；使做好心理准备
items.def_en: 1. To make or get someone or something ready for a future event, task, or purpose. 2. To make or cook food, or produce a mixture or medicine.
items.ex_en: The chef spent the entire afternoon helping us prepare the banquet dinner.
items.ex_zh: 主厨花了整个下午的时间帮助我们准备宴会晚餐。

items.def_en: (+ with/for) to supply with the necessary items or skills for a purpose
items.ex_en: The academy will equip students with essential practical skills for clinical research.
items.ex_zh: 学院将使学生掌握进行临床研究所需的关键实践技能。

items.def_zh: 使准备好；为……作好准备；灌注起动
items.def_en: (+ for/with) to make something or someone ready for a particular situation, operation, or question
items.ex_en: Spokespersons gathered behind closed doors to prime the minister for tough questions.
items.ex_zh: 发言人们闭门集会，为首相应对棘手提问做好充分准备。

items.def_zh: 做好准备；准备就绪（常接 for/to do）
items.def_en: to prepare oneself or an organization for an impending activity, event, or task
items.ex_en: Retail stores across the country gear up for the massive holiday rush.
items.ex_zh: 全国各地的零售商店都在积极做好准备，迎接庞大的假日购物狂潮。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to provide someone or something with all the necessary equipment, clothing, or fittings for a specific purpose
items.ex_en: The laboratory was fitted out with the latest analytical instruments.
items.ex_zh: 该实验室配备了最先进的分析仪器。

items.def_zh: 为迎接（困难、冲击等）做好准备
items.def_en: (+ sth) to physically or mentally ready oneself for something unpleasant, difficult, or shocking
items.ex_en: Coastal communities hastily evacuate as residents brace for the category five hurricane.
items.ex_zh: 居民们准备迎接五级飓风的冲击，沿海社区匆忙撤离。

items.def_zh: 预先调整，预先训练（使其适应某种状态）；预先设定条件
items.def_en: 1. To train, condition, or prepare someone or something in advance to behave or react in a desired way.
items.ex_en: Rigorous military drills precondition recruits to obey commands without hesitation under fire.
items.ex_zh: 严苛的军事演练预先训练新兵在炮火下毫不犹豫地服从命令。

items.def_zh: 准备好面对（困难或斗争）
items.def_en: (+ oneself for) to prepare oneself mentally or physically for conflict, challenge, or action
items.ex_en: The weary defenders began to gird themselves for the enemy's final onslaught.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的守军开始打起精神，准备迎接敌人的最后猛攻。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe actions taken in advance to put a person, equipment, or system into a fit, suitable state to perform, endure, or undergo a future event.
groups.summary_zh: 指事先对人员、装备或系统进行调适或训练，使其进入待命适任状态。
groups.desc_en: Performs preliminary tuning, equipping, or mental fortifying so that an agent or instrument is operational for imminent demands, contrasting with starting from scratch in crisis.
groups.desc_zh: 在需求临门前进行调试、武装或心理筑底以达至即刻可用状态，区别于临时仓促应战。
groups.nuance_en: prepare: make all necessary arrangements or baseline provisions (meal / student / plan) · ready: bring into immediate physical or tactical alertness (weapon / troops / defense) · prime: inject prerequisite substance or knowledge to maximize instant readiness (pump / witness / engine) · brace for: harden oneself physically or mentally against a severe impact (impact / shock / storm) · equip: furnish with specialized tools or capabilities (army / lab / team)
groups.nuance_zh: prepare: 进行广义的基础统筹准备 (meal / student / plan) · ready: 进入随时可打可发的临战状态 (weapon / troops / defense) · prime: 灌注前提物料或关键信息使立即可行 (pump / witness / engine) · brace for: 严阵以待准备咬牙硬扛冲击 (impact / shock / storm) · equip: 充实配备专业硬件器材或能力 (army / lab / team)

groups.name: Pressurized Liquid Ejection · 喷射与射流 (Spray, Spurt, Jet)
groups.tip: 液体受挤压猛烈喷涌喷溅

items.def_en: (+ sth) to eject or be ejected in a thin, rapid stream through a narrow opening
items.ex_en: I watched the thick red sauce squirt out onto my clean shirt.
items.ex_zh: 我眼看着那浓稠的红酱汁挤喷出来，溅到了我干净的衬衫上。
items.ex2_en: She squirted out some creamy lotion onto her dry winter hands.
items.ex2_zh: 她挤出一些乳霜涂在干燥的冬日双手上。

items.def_en: to force liquid out through a narrow opening in a sudden, thin stream
items.ex_en: Children giggled as they continued to squirt water at passersby on sidewalks.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们咯咯笑着，继续用玩具向人行道上的路人滋水。
items.ex2_en: Juicy lemon drops squirted unexpectedly when he bit into the fruit.
items.ex2_zh: 当他咬入水果时，多汁的柠檬汁水意外地喷射出来。

items.def_en: to gush or stream out suddenly and under pressure in a fast, intermittent jet
items.ex_en: Black crude oil began to spurt out from the damaged offshore pipeline.
items.ex_zh: 黑色的原油开始从破损的海底管道中喷涌而出。
items.ex2_en: The pressurized machine spurted out thick black grease across the workshop.
items.ex2_zh: 加压机器将浓稠的黑油脂喷射到了整个车间。

items.def_en: To force liquid out in a stream of very small drops, or to cover something with a fine shower of liquid.
items.ex_en: Farmers regularly spray the apple orchard to protect fruit against destructive pests.
items.ex_zh: 果农们定期向苹果园喷洒药剂，以保护果实免受害虫侵害。
items.ex2_en: Fine droplets spray continuously across the vegetables from the cooling nozzles.
items.ex2_zh: 微细水滴从降温喷嘴持续喷洒在蔬菜上。

items.def_en: to gush or shoot out suddenly in a powerful, intermittent stream
items.ex_en: Cold water would spurt in fierce bursts from the broken garden hose.
items.ex_zh: 冷水从破损的花园水管中猛烈而间歇地喷射出来。
items.ex2_en: The faulty pressure valve spurted boiling water into the crowded room.
items.ex2_zh: 损坏的压力阀向拥挤的房间内喷出了沸水。

items.def_en: (variant spelling of spurt) To shoot or gush out suddenly in a stream, or to force liquid out.
items.ex_en: Dark crimson blood began to spirt from the warrior's severed artery onto the cold stone floor.
items.ex_zh: 深红色的鲜血开始从勇士割断的动脉中喷涌而出，溅落在冰冷的石地上。
items.ex2_en: The broken high-pressure pump spirted dirty oil across the mechanic's boots.
items.ex2_zh: 损坏的高压泵把脏油喷溅到了机械师的靴子上。

items.def_en: to burst or be expelled rapidly and forcefully from a nozzle, orifice, or opening
items.ex_en: Scalding water began to shoot out from the cracked boiler pipe across the concrete floor.
items.ex_zh: 滚烫的热水开始从破裂的锅炉管道中疾射而出，洒在水泥地上。
items.ex2_en: The pressurized cannon shoots out bright confetti during the festival celebration.
items.ex2_zh: 加压礼炮在节日庆典期间喷射出明亮的五彩纸屑。

items.def_en: to discharge or be propelled outward with great suddenness and force
items.ex_en: A sudden burst of pressurized steam shot from the fractured metal valve without warning.
items.ex_zh: 一股高压蒸汽毫无预警地从破损的金属阀门中猛烈喷射出来。

items.def_zh: 喷出，喷射；乘喷气式飞机旅行
items.def_en: 1. To shoot out or squirt in a rapid, forceful stream. 2. To travel somewhere by jet aircraft.
items.ex_en: High-pressure water continuously jetted from the specialized cleaning nozzle to scour the dirty ship hull.
items.ex_zh: 高压水柱源源不断地从专用清洁喷嘴中喷射而出，冲刷着肮脏的船体。
items.ex2_en: The industrial machine jetted pressurized cleaning fluid onto the dirty concrete.
items.ex2_zh: 工业机器将加压清洗液喷射到脏污的混凝土上。

groups.summary_en: Liquids or fine particles are expelled forcibly under pressure in a directional stream, burst, or dispersed mist. The intensity ranges from diffuse misting to violent, high-velocity streams that burst out suddenly.
groups.summary_zh: 液体受压定向喷出或迸射，强度由弥散细雾递增至高压疾喷。
groups.desc_en: Forces fluid outward through a constrained orifice under pressure into the surrounding air, contrasting with passive leaking, spilling, or gentle pouring.
groups.desc_zh: 液体在内压驱使下自狭窄孔隙中猛烈喷射入空气中，区别于被动的渗漏、倾倒或平缓流淌。
groups.nuance_en: spray: disperse liquid into a broad mist or driven droplets (paint / perfume / water) · squirt: expel a thin, swift stream through a narrow opening (ink / juice / liquid) · spurt: gush out intermittently in sudden, pulsing bursts (blood / oil / flame) · shoot out: project violently forward like a projectile (jet / stream / flame)
groups.nuance_zh: spray: 雾化散布出弥散细沫 (paint / perfume / water) · squirt: 挤压狭缝呲出一股细流 (ink / juice / liquid) · spurt: 呈脉冲式、间歇性突发喷涌 (blood / oil / flame) · shoot out: 犹如炮弹般暴烈射出 (jet / stream / flame)

groups.name: Prevaricate & Equivocate · 含糊其辞与狡辩 (Prevaricate, Equivocate, Fudge)
groups.tip: 闪烁其词含糊推托事实

items.def_zh: 拐弯抹角，旁敲侧击而不切入正题
items.def_en: To discuss a matter without coming directly to the point, usually to avoid awkwardness
items.ex_en: Stop beating around the bush and just tell me if I still have a job.
items.ex_zh: 别再拐弯抹角了，直接告诉我我是否还有这份工作。

items.def_zh: 轻轻带过；回避关键细节
items.def_en: (+ sth) to mention or treat a difficult or embarrassing topic briefly and ambiguously to avoid dealing with it
items.ex_en: The spokesperson quickly skated over the embarrassing financial losses mentioned in the quarterly audit report.
items.ex_zh: 发言人对季度审计报告中提及的令人尴尬的财务亏损一笔带过。

items.def_zh: 含糊其词，拐弯抹角以避嫌
items.def_en: To avoid giving a direct answer, commitment, or firm opinion
items.ex_en: The politician continued to hedge when reporters asked whether taxes would increase next year.
items.ex_zh: 当记者问及明年是否会加税时，那位政客继续含糊其词以避嫌。

items.def_en: [I/T] To deal with a situation or issue in an ambiguous, evasive, or half-hearted way
items.ex_en: The committee tried to fudge the controversial deadline by drafting an intentionally vague agreement.
items.ex_zh: 委员会试图通过起草一份刻意含糊的协议来敷衍应付这个备受争议的截止期限。

items.def_zh: 掩盖；粉饰敷衍（问题或错误）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to deliberately treat an unpleasant fact or problem superficially to hide its true significance
items.ex_en: The official report attempted to gloss over significant structural flaws found within the new bridge.
items.ex_zh: 官方报告试图掩盖新桥梁中发现的重大结构缺陷。

items.def_zh: 绕开（关键问题）；避而不谈
items.def_en: (+ sth) to discuss a subject in an evasive, roundabout way to avoid addressing the central point directly
items.ex_en: The executives spent an hour talking around the severe budget deficit without offering solutions.
items.ex_zh: 高管们绕着严重的预算赤字空谈了一个小时，却没有给出任何解决方案。

items.def_en: To use ambiguous language conceal the truth or avoid committing oneself
items.ex_en: Under intense cross-examination, the corrupt witness continued to equivocate regarding his foreign bank accounts.
items.ex_zh: 在严厉的交叉盘问下，受贿证人对其海外银行账户的问题依然闪烁其词。

items.def_zh: 支吾其词，闪烁其词，搪塞
items.def_en: (formal) to speak or act in an evasive way; to avoid giving a direct, truthful answer
items.ex_en: The minister prevaricated when pressed for direct answers regarding the controversial diplomatic cables.
items.ex_zh: 当被追问关于具有争议的外交电报的明确答复时，部长支吾其词。

items.def_zh: 含糊其词，敷衍搪塞；讨价还价
items.def_en: (formal) to act or speak insincerely, deceitfully, or evasively; to bargain or haggle
items.ex_en: A principled statesman must never palter with the sacred truth for fleeting political convenience.
items.ex_zh: 有原则的政治家绝不可为了短暂的政治便利而对神圣的真相弄虚作假。

groups.summary_en: A speaker deliberately uses ambiguity, evasive statements, or shifting arguments to conceal the truth without uttering a direct, barefaced lie. The manner varies from misleading wording ('equivocate') and dodging direct answers ('prevaricate') to informal blurring ('fudge', 'hedging').
groups.summary_zh: 故意使用模棱两可、闪烁其词的话语回避真相、搪塞质问或拖延表态。
groups.desc_en: Deploys ambiguous phrasing, deliberate omissions, or deceptive shifts of topic to evade telling the direct truth, contrasting with frank honesty or direct lying.
groups.desc_zh: 运用模棱两可的说辞、闪烁其词或转移话题以规避正面真相，区别于坦白直言或直接撒谎捏造。
groups.nuance_en: prevaricate: deliberately evade the truth through shifting evasions (witness / minister) · equivocate: use terms of double meaning to mislead while avoiding an outright lie (politician / diplomat) · hedge: qualify commitments non-committally to avoid risk (bet / answer / statement) · fudge: manipulate, blur, or gloss over messy specifics dishonestly (figures / facts / issue) · skate over: mention a sensitive topic superficially to avoid dwelling on it (problem / controversy / scandal)
groups.nuance_zh: prevaricate: 顾左右而言他、狡猾支吾推诿 (witness / minister) · equivocate: 玩弄双关语或两可字眼浑水摸鱼 (politician / diplomat) · hedge: 说话留后路、含糊其辞防担责 (bet / answer / statement) · fudge: 敷衍粉饰、含混搪塞关键数据或事实 (figures / facts / issue) · skate over: 浮光掠影轻描淡写滑过痛点 (problem / controversy / scandal)

groups.name: Primary Harvest & Raw Material Curing · 原料初加工与熟化 (Process, Cure, Hay)
groups.tip: 物理或化学加工材料

items.def_zh: 加工，处理；审核，办理；（计算机）处理（数据）
items.def_en: 1. To perform a series of mechanical or chemical operations on something to change or preserve it. 2. To deal with documents, requests, or applications officially. 3. (computing) To perform operations on data.
items.ex_en: The solitary craftsman processed harvested flax through ancient rituals, transforming raw stalks into soft linen.
items.ex_zh: 那位孤独的匠人循着古老的仪轨加工收割的亚麻，将粗糙的秸秆化作柔软的布料。

items.def_en: to grind or crush grain, corn, or other raw crop seeds into flour or meal
items.ex_en: The traditional watermill mills organic wheat into fine flour for local artisan bakers.
items.ex_zh: 这座传统水磨坊为当地手艺面包师将有机小麦碾磨成精细的面粉。

items.def_zh: 腌制；熟化；晾制（烟草、肉类或木材）
items.def_en: [I/T] to preserve meat, fish, tobacco, or timber by drying, salting, or smoking
items.ex_en: The butcher cures high-quality pork belly with sea salt and aromatic herbs for months.
items.ex_zh: 屠夫用海盐和香草将优质五花肉腌制数月之久。
items.ex2_en: Salted cod cures naturally over several cold weeks in seaside warehouses.
items.ex2_zh: 腌鳕鱼在海边仓库经过几个寒冷的星期自然腌制风干。

items.def_zh: 烘干；晾干（使谷物、木材、饲草等脱水脱水变干）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to remove moisture from raw agricultural crops, timber, or forage as part of curing or storage preparation
items.ex_en: Farmers carefully dry out harvested barley under the hot sun before loading it into silos.
items.ex_zh: 农民们在将收割的大麦装入筒仓之前，先在烈日下仔细将其晒干。
items.ex2_en: The freshly harvested tobacco leaves will dry out slowly inside barns.
items.ex2_zh: 新收获的烟叶在谷仓内会慢慢烘干。

items.def_zh: 吊挂风干/腌熟（肉类、烟叶等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to suspend meat, tobacco, or game to allow it to cure, age, or dry properly
items.ex_en: Don't hang up on me while I'm still explaining what happened.
items.ex_zh: 我还在解释发生了什么，先别挂我电话。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to cure and preserve food products such as fish or meat by prolonged exposure to smoke
items.ex_en: The coastal villagers smoke out fresh salmon over fragrant alder wood to preserve winter supplies.
items.ex_zh: 沿海村民用芬芳的桤木熏制新鲜三文鱼，以储备过冬的口粮。

items.def_zh: 割晒牧草，制干草；供给干草
items.def_en: To cut grass and cure it to make hay; to feed or supply with hay.
items.ex_en: The diligent farmhands hayed the broad meadow throughout the dry and sunny July afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 勤劳的农工们在干燥晴朗的七月午后整整忙活了一天，在广阔的草地上割晒牧草。

items.def_en: to compress and bind hay, straw, or cotton into tight, manageable bundles
items.ex_en: The modern mechanical harvester baled golden straw into compact rectangular blocks across the field.
items.ex_zh: 现代化的机械收割机在田间将金黄的麦秸压缩打成紧凑的长方捆。

items.def_en: [I/T] to separate grain from the husks and straw of a plant by beating or mechanical processing
items.ex_en: Laborers gathered in the wooden barn to thresh golden wheat using traditional wooden flails.
items.ex_zh: 劳工们聚集在木制谷仓里，用传统的连枷给金黄的小麦脱粒。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the agricultural, culinary, or industrial initial handling and preserving of bulk natural commodities (crops, forage, timber, meat) to prepare them for storage or consumption.
groups.summary_zh: 对农作物、牧草、肉类等原材料进行脱水、腌制或熟化等初级加工处理。
groups.desc_en: Applies controlled physical, chemical, or drying interventions to raw organic yields to render them storable or usable, contrasting with fresh consumption or industrial manufacturing.
groups.desc_zh: 对初级农产或生鲜物料施加物理烘晒、化学熟化或发酵处理以使其可耐贮或可利用，区别于即摘即食或深加工工业制造。
groups.nuance_en: cure: treat flesh, tobacco, or concrete chemically or by salting/drying to preserve it (meat / tobacco / fish) · dry out: extract moisture naturally or artificially to halt decay (timber / grain / hay) · mill: grind, crush, or cut raw timber or grain into basic commodities (grain / timber / flour) · bale: bind harvested forage tightly into dense blocks (hay / straw / cotton) · hay: cut, dry, and harvest grass specifically as fodder (field / meadow)
groups.nuance_zh: cure: 盐渍、烟熏或熟化以防腐增效 (meat / tobacco / fish) · dry out: 脱水晾燥防止霉烂变质 (timber / grain / hay) · mill: 研磨脱壳或锯切初加工 (grain / timber / flour) · bale: 将散料高压打捆压块 (hay / straw / cotton) · hay: 刈割、晒制并收集干草备料 (field / meadow)

groups.name: Proliferate & Disperse · 散播与蔓延 (Unchecked Organic or Destructive Propagation)
groups.tip: 向四周散落或漫延开来

items.def_en: to extend over a progressively wider physical area or group of people
items.ex_en: The search team spread out across the forest to look for the missing hikers.
items.ex_zh: 搜救队在森林中分散开来寻找失踪的徒步旅行者。
items.ex2_en: The gardener spread out fresh wood mulch evenly across the flowerbeds.
items.ex2_zh: 园丁把新鲜的木屑均匀地铺撒在各个花坛上。

items.def_en: to spread out gradually in all directions through a gas, liquid, or group
items.ex_en: The heavy aroma of incense diffused slowly through the vaulted stone corridors of the cathedral.
items.ex_zh: 浓郁的熏香气息在大教堂拱形石质长廊中缓缓弥漫开来。
items.ex2_en: The frosted glass lampshade diffuses bright overhead light throughout the study.
items.ex2_zh: 磨砂玻璃灯罩将明亮的顶光散射到整个书房。

items.def_en: to spread outward in multiple directions from a central source or pathway
items.ex_en: The invasive fungal network quickly branched out beneath the forest floor in every conceivable direction.
items.ex_zh: 侵入性的真菌网络在林地地表下迅速向各个可能的方向分枝蔓延。

items.def_en: to expand over a larger area, population, or period
items.ex_en: The airborne contagion began to spread rapidly through crowded public transit systems across the city.
items.ex_zh: 这种经空气传播的传染病开始在全城拥挤的公共交通系统中迅速蔓延。
items.ex2_en: The baker spread rich strawberry jam evenly over the toasted bread.
items.ex2_zh: 面包师在烤面包上均匀地涂抹上浓郁的草莓酱。

items.def_en: to distribute or spread information, seeds, or doctrine widely
items.ex_en: Scholars gathered at the international summit to disseminate groundbreaking medical research to remote clinics.
items.ex_zh: 学者们齐聚国际峰会，向偏远诊所广泛传播具有突破性的医学研究成果。

items.def_en: 1. (+ across/over/with) To scatter things untidily over a surface or area.
items.ex_en: The furious autumn gale strewed crisp golden leaves across the deserted palace courtyard.
items.ex_zh: 狂暴的秋风将干脆的金黄落叶撒满了空旷荒凉的宫殿庭院。

items.def_zh: （疾病、暴力等）突然爆发并蔓延
items.def_en: to suddenly erupt or spread with renewed violence, pain, or contagion
items.ex_en: Violent street protests flared up unexpectedly across several major cities following the controversial election.
items.ex_zh: 在引发争议的选举之后，几座大城市街头毫无预警地爆发并蔓延起暴力抗议。

items.def_en: to reproduce rapidly and increase numbers exponentially
items.ex_en: Malignant cancer cells proliferate rapidly when essential regulatory signals within the tissue breakdown.
items.ex_zh: 当组织内关键的调控信号失常时，恶性癌细胞便会迅速增殖扩散。

items.def_zh: （癌细胞等）转移；（恶性事物）蔓延，扩散
items.def_en: 1. (medicine) To spread from the primary site of disease to other parts of the body. 2. (figurative) To spread and grow uncontrollably.
items.ex_en: Corrosive ideological malice metastasized quietly across the fragile republic, poisoning discourse and destabilizing institutions.
items.ex_zh: 具腐蚀性的意识形态恶意在这个脆弱的共和国中悄然蔓延，毒化了言论并动摇了体制。

groups.summary_en: An undesirable entity, disease, rumor, or chaotic element spreads progressively across an area or medium beyond containment. Verbs distinguish between systemic pathological propagation and pervasive outward dispersal.
groups.summary_zh: 恶性事物、疾病或细碎异物不受限地蔓延散播。
groups.desc_en: Transmits or expands matter, pathogens, or information across a broader surface or population via multi-directional propagation, contrasting with contained local confinement.
groups.desc_zh: 物质、病原体或信息向四周多维度呈发散式蔓延与扩散，区别于局部局限或定点封闭。
groups.nuance_en: spread: extend across an expanding surface area or group (disease / rumor / fire) · proliferate: multiply rapidly in volume, cellular units, or instances (cells / weapons / theories) · diffuse: disperse evenly through a surrounding medium until uniform (light / aroma / tension) · disseminate: distribute information or knowledge widely to seed minds (findings / propaganda / ideas) · strew: scatter loose items untidily over a surface (flowers / debris / litter)
groups.nuance_zh: spread: 向外围区域或群体无阻蔓延 (disease / rumor / fire) · proliferate: 单元激增、核裂变般无节制繁殖 (cells / weapons / theories) · diffuse: 在介质中均匀弥漫消解 (light / aroma / tension) · disseminate: 广为散播传布知识或思想 (findings / propaganda / ideas) · strew: 凌乱播撒四散覆盖表面 (flowers / debris / litter)

groups.name: Prop & Shore Up · 倚垫与支撑 (Support Structurally or Physically from Underneath/Behind)
groups.tip: 用支撑物支起或倚靠放置

items.def_en: (+ sth) to rest something or oneself in an inclined position against a solid surface for physical support
items.ex_en: The weary traveler leaned against the ancient stone fountain to catch his breath.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的旅人靠在古老的石喷泉上喘息片刻以恢复体力。

items.def_en: 1. To rest your head or an object on something soft as if on a pillow.
items.ex_en: She gently pillowed her aching forehead against the cool velvet of the armchair.
items.ex_zh: 她将隐隐作痛的前额轻轻枕在扶手椅冰凉的天鹅绒面料上。

items.def_zh: 用软垫垫住，给……垫上靠垫
items.def_en: to place something soft against or under something to support it and protect against shock
items.ex_en: She carefully cushioned the antique porcelain vase with bubble wrap before packing the crate.
items.ex_zh: 在将古董瓷瓶装箱之前，她小心翼翼地用气泡膜将其垫好以防震动。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to support the weight of a structure or object from underneath so it does not collapse
items.ex_en: These weathered wooden posts barely hold up the massive weight of the crumbling barn roof.
items.ex_zh: 这些风化的木柱勉强支撑着摇摇欲坠的谷仓屋顶的沉重分量。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to physically support an object or body part underneath or from behind to prevent it from falling or sagging
items.ex_en: The dedicated nurse used two soft pillows to prop up the elderly patient's fractured leg.
items.ex_zh: 尽责的护士用两个柔软的枕头垫起了那位年长患者骨折的腿。

items.def_en: 1. (+ against/up) To lean an object against something or support it from underneath so it does not fall.
items.ex_en: The gardener propped the heavy ladder securely against the thick trunk of the oak tree.
items.ex_zh: 园丁把沉重的梯子稳稳地架在橡树粗壮的树干上。

items.def_zh: 抵住，加固支撑（以防摇晃或受压）
items.def_en: to support or hold something firmly in position with a rigid reinforcement
items.ex_en: Workers braced the leaning concrete retaining wall with thick steel girders during the storm.
items.ex_zh: 暴风雨期间，工人们用厚重的钢梁抵住并加固了倾斜的混凝土挡土墙。

items.def_zh: 从底部加固，支撑（地基或结构）
items.def_en: to place masonry, concrete, or steel beneath a foundation to give it firm support
items.ex_en: Engineers plan to underpin the historic cathedral's sinking foundations with high-grade reinforced concrete.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们计划用高强度钢筋混凝土从底部加固那座历史悠久的大教堂正在下沉的地基。

items.def_zh: 用支柱撑住（摇摇欲坠之物）
items.def_en: to support a wall, building, or sagging structure with heavy timber or metal struts
items.ex_en: Emergency crews shored up the sagging mine ceiling with heavy timber posts after the collapse.
items.ex_zh: 坍塌事故发生后，紧急救援队用重型木桩撑住了下沉的矿井顶部。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify the physical manner of bracing or supporting an object or a person's body part with a wedge, pillar, cushion, or angled support to prevent collapse or promote comfort. 'Prop' covers angled mechanical or physical leaning, while 'pillow' specifically cushions softly.
groups.summary_zh: 使用斜撑、软垫或坚固支撑物将物体或身体垫起以防倒塌或提供倚靠。
groups.desc_en: Denotes providing external, auxiliary, or structural reinforcement from beneath or beside to prevent collapse, sagging, or impact, distinct from integral internal strength.
groups.desc_zh: 指从下方、后方或侧面施加外在辅助支撑以防倒塌、下坠或缓冲冲击，区别于物体自身内在的结构承重。
groups.nuance_en: prop up: prevent from falling or failing with an external brace (regime / economy / wall) · brace: secure against incoming stress or impact (impact / oneself / beam) · underpin: provide fundamental structural or evidentiary support from beneath (theory / foundation / currency) · cushion: soften an impact or shock with padding (blow / fall / blow)
groups.nuance_zh: prop up: 以外力支承濒临倾覆之物 (regime / economy / wall) · brace: 加固以抵御外力冲击 (impact / oneself / beam) · underpin: 从底部提供基础性或论据支撑 (theory / foundation / currency) · cushion: 垫衬缓冲以化解震荡 (blow / fall / blow)

groups.name: Proportion & Quantize Values · 量化与按比例分摊 (Quantize, Prorate, Apportion)
groups.tip: 校正量度、比例并依规调控

items.def_en: to measure or regulate the supply of a utility or resource using a meter
items.ex_en: The municipal authority precisely meters industrial clean water consumption to regulate municipal resource waste.
items.ex_zh: 市政管理部门用表精确计量工业清洁水消耗，以控制城市资源浪费。

items.def_zh: 按份分配；分成小块分派
items.def_en: (+ sth) to divide something measurable into specific portions or shares and distribute them
items.ex_en: The bankrupt company began to parcel out its remaining valuable assets to senior creditors.
items.ex_zh: 这家破产公司开始将剩余的有价值资产分批分配给优先债权人。

items.def_zh: 按量给予；定量分派（惩罚、配额等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to dispense or apportion measured amounts of punishment, rewards, or shares according to a rule
items.ex_en: The stern tribunal meted out severe retributive penalties to every participant in the conspiracy.
items.ex_zh: 严厉的法庭依法对该阴谋的每一位参与者定额分派了严酷的惩处。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to distribute measured or rationed amounts of food, money, or resources carefully
items.ex_en: Aid volunteers doled out meager portions of grain to the starving crowd every morning.
items.ex_zh: 援助志愿者每天清晨向饥饿的人群按限量分发微薄的口粮。

items.def_en: to distribute shares or amounts of something for a specific purpose
items.ex_en: The city council allocated significant additional funding to upgrade aging municipal drainage systems.
items.ex_zh: 市议会划拨了巨额专项附加资金用于升级老化的市政排水系统。

items.def_en: to allow someone only a fixed, limited amount of a scarce commodity
items.ex_en: The wartime administration strictly rationed essential gasoline reserves to maintain vital public emergency services.
items.ex_zh: 战时政府严格配给关键的汽油储备，以维持基本的公共应急服务。

items.def_en: to divide and allocate shares of resources, responsibilities, or costs according to a plan
items.ex_en: The central board apportioned project expenses fairly among all participating regional partners according to revenue.
items.ex_zh: 中央董事会根据收益在所有参与的地区合作伙伴之间公平分摊了项目费用。

items.def_zh: 使量子化；（信号处理中）量化
items.def_en: to restrict a variable quantity to a discrete set of specific values, especially in physics or digital signal processing
items.ex_en: Theoretical physicists demonstrated that subatomic energy fields quantize into indivisible discrete values at microscopic scales.
items.ex_zh: 理论物理学家证明了亚原子能场在微观尺度下会量子化为不可分割的离散数值。

items.def_zh: 按比例分配，按比例摊派（费用、时间等）
items.def_en: to calculate, divide, or distribute something proportionally according to a specific rate or fraction of time
items.ex_en: The rental agency prorated the final month's rent based on the tenant's early departure.
items.ex_zh: 租赁中介根据租客提前搬离的时间，按实际天数比例折算了最后一个月的房租。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe mathematically dividing, converting, or adjusting measurable values—such as discrete energy/signal steps, fractional costs, or proportional shares—according to a strict quantitative schema.
groups.summary_zh: 按照数学比例、分段规则或使用量进行量化与分摊。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on dividing, assigning, or measuring out resources or duties according to measured ratios or deliberate constraints, rather than indiscriminate distribution.
groups.desc_zh: 指按照严密计量、既定比例或定额限制来分割、派发资源或权责，区别于无节制的随性分发。
groups.nuance_en: ration: restrict supply systematically during scarcity (food / water / fuel) · apportion: distribute shares proportionally according to right or liability (blame / costs / seats) · mete out: dispense harsh treatment or justice deliberately (punishment / penalties / justice) · dole out: distribute in small, often stingy or charitable quantities (food / advice / cash) · parcel out: divide land or resources into distinct lots (land / assets / responsibilities)
groups.nuance_zh: ration: 匮乏时期按配额严格限供 (food / water / fuel) · apportion: 按比例合理分摊权利或责任 (blame / costs / seats) · mete out: 严肃裁决并施加惩戒或正义 (punishment / penalties / justice) · dole out: 少量施舍或零星分发 (food / advice / cash) · parcel out: 分块细化切分资产或土地 (land / assets / responsibilities)

groups.name: Provoke & Harass · 挑衅与烦扰 (Goad, Pester, Badger)
groups.tip: 言语激惹对方或反复纠缠

items.def_en: (+ sb) persistently scold, criticize, or urge someone to do something
items.ex_en: His mother constantly nagged at him about tidying up his terribly messy bedroom.
items.ex_zh: 他母亲总是为收拾乱七八糟的卧室一事对他唠叨个没完。

items.def_en: (+ sb) strongly encourage or urge someone to do something foolish or dangerous
items.ex_en: His reckless classmates egged him on to jump across the dangerously wide drainage ditch.
items.ex_zh: 他那些鲁莽的同学怂恿他跳过那条危险的宽排水沟。

items.def_en: (+ sb) repeatedly treat someone unkindly, unfairly, or critically
items.ex_en: Why do the older kids always pick on him during recess?
items.ex_zh: 为什么大孩子们课间总爱找他茬、欺负他？

items.def_zh: 用言语刺激；冷嘲热讽惹恼
items.def_en: to intentionally annoy or irritate someone by persistent petty teasing or stinging remarks
items.ex_en: Tom constantly needles his younger brother about his poor performance on the soccer team.
items.ex_zh: 汤姆总是拿弟弟在足球队表现差劲的事对他冷嘲热讽、故意挑刺。

items.def_en: to repeatedly and persistently ask someone questions or urge them to do something
items.ex_en: Aggressive reporters badgered the weary senator with relentless questions about the ongoing political scandal.
items.ex_zh: 咄咄逼人的记者们就正在发酵的政治丑闻反复追问纠缠那位疲倦的参议员。

items.def_en: To annoy someone by repeatedly asking them for something or bothering them.
items.ex_en: The unruly neighbor constantly pesters us for tools and never returns them on time.
items.ex_zh: 那个不守规矩的邻居老是缠着我们借工具，而且从不按时归还。

items.def_en: to deliberately provoke, mock, or annoy someone to elicit an angry response
items.ex_en: The rival candidate tried to bait the mayor into an angry public argument.
items.ex_zh: 竞争对手试图激怒市长，诱使他在公众面前陷入争吵。

items.def_en: to pursue, harass, or pester someone relentlessly without giving them peace
items.ex_en: Paparazzi hounded the reclusive actress relentlessly whenever she stepped outside her secluded residence.
items.ex_zh: 每当这位深居简出的女演员走出幽静的住宅，狗仔队就会死缠烂打地追踪骚扰她。

items.def_zh: 招惹，激怒，唆使；驱赶（牲畜）
items.def_en: To deliberately provoke, annoy, or urge someone into doing something, especially by saying unkind things.
items.ex_en: Cruel boys goaded the timid dog with long sticks until it barked frantically.
items.ex_zh: 残忍的男孩们用长木棍故意招惹那只胆小的狗，直到它狂吠不止。

groups.summary_en: An agent persistently irritates, nags, or taunts another person, either to annoy them incessantly or deliberately stimulate an aggressive reaction or compliant action. Nuance spans relentless whining to sharp, painful baiting.
groups.summary_zh: 持续烦扰纠缠某人，或用尖刻言行激惹对方做出反应。
groups.desc_en: Centers on persistent, intentional irritation or incitement aimed at goading someone into a negative reaction or compliance, contrasting with momentary disturbance.
groups.desc_zh: 强调持续、恶意或蓄意地骚扰、挑衅或纠缠，旨在激起对方反抗或迫使其顺从，区别于偶发性的打扰。
groups.nuance_en: badger: repeatedly pester with questions or demands (witness / officials / management) · bait: deliberately taunt to provoke an angry outburst (opponent / crowd / dog) · needle: continually prick with petty, irritating jabs (colleague / brother / rival) · hound: relentlessly pursue or harass without respite (celebrity / debtor / suspects) · egg on: incite someone to do something rash or foolish (friend / crowd / prankster)
groups.nuance_zh: badger: 一再纠缠盘问以逼迫就范 (witness / officials / management) · bait: 蓄意逗引挑衅以激怒对方 (opponent / crowd / dog) · needle: 夹枪带棒暗讽针砭以激恼他人 (colleague / brother / rival) · hound: 如影随形般穷追穷逼 (celebrity / debtor / suspects) · egg on: 煽动怂恿他人行鲁莽之事 (friend / crowd / prankster)

groups.name: Provoke to Fury · 激怒与使狂怒 (Madden, Enrage, Infuriate)
groups.tip: 怒火中烧达至歇斯底里狂怒

items.def_en: irritate and frustrate someone to the point of intense anger
items.ex_en: Constant bureaucratic delays completely exasperated the foreign investors trying to establish new commercial factories.
items.ex_zh: 层出不穷的官僚拖延彻底激怒了试图建立新商业工厂的外国投资者。

items.def_en: (+ sb) make someone angry or irritated
items.ex_en: His arrogant attitude during the team meeting really ticked off the project manager.
items.ex_zh: 他在团队会议上傲慢的态度着实把项目经理给惹火了。

items.def_zh: 怒发冲冠，（毛发）竖起；愤然作色
items.def_en: 1. (+ at/with) To react with sudden anger, indignation, or defensiveness. 2. (of hair or fur) To stand upright away from the skin.
items.ex_en: The proud senior officer bristled at the young recruit's rude and disrespectful behavior.
items.ex_zh: 这位心高气傲的高级军官对新兵粗鲁无礼的举止愤然作色。

items.def_en: (+ sb) thoroughly enrage or annoy someone
items.ex_en: Canceling the flight at the last minute really pissed off all the passengers.
items.ex_zh: 在最后一刻取消航班彻底惹毛了所有乘客。

items.def_en: (+ sb) deliberately tease, irritate, or agitate someone to anger
items.ex_en: Stop winding him up about his favorite sports team before he loses his temper.
items.ex_zh: 别再拿他最喜欢的球队故意惹他发火了，免得他真发脾气。

items.raw_cluster: 激怒与使狂怒 Enrage & Madden
items.def_en: To make someone extremely angry, irritated, or frantic.
items.ex_en: The endless howling of the winter wind maddened the isolated hermit within his cabin.
items.ex_zh: 寒冬狂风无休止的呼啸声使幽居在木屋里的隐士濒临发狂。

items.def_en: make someone very indignant or furiously wrathful
items.ex_en: The unlawful arrest of the honest journalist incensed the entire international human rights community.
items.ex_zh: 对这位正直记者的非法逮捕激起了整个国际人权界的强烈愤慨。

items.def_en: make someone extremely angry and agitated
items.ex_en: The airline's refusal to offer reasonable compensation infuriated hundreds of stranded holiday passengers.
items.ex_zh: 航空公司拒绝提供合理解偿，令数百名滞留的度假旅客极其愤怒。

items.raw_cluster: 激怒与使狂怒 Enrage & Infuriate
items.def_en: To make someone extremely angry or furious.
items.ex_en: The sudden cancellation of their pension benefits deeply enraged thousands of retired industrial workers.
items.ex_zh: 养老金福利的骤然取消激怒了数以千计的退休产业工人。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote inciting severe, uncontrolled wrath in another person or reacting with overt signs of indignation. They scale along an intensity continuum from showing bristling agitation to driving someone into irrational frenzy.
groups.summary_zh: 指将他人激惹至极度愤怒，或因愤怒而表现出应激反应。
groups.desc_en: Denotes driving someone past the limits of patience into explosive anger, righteous indignation, or temporary madness, surpassing ordinary irritation.
groups.desc_zh: 指将人彻底激惹至理智断线、暴跳如雷或暴怒发狂的状态，其烈度远超一般恼火或不悦。
groups.nuance_en: infuriate: make overwhelmingly and violently angry (public / voters / customer) · incense: arouse fierce, righteous wrath through injustice (community / moralists / readers) · madden: drive to frenzy or irrational frustration (crowd / thinker / critic) · exasperate: exhaust patience utterly through repeated annoyance (teacher / parent / diplomat)
groups.nuance_zh: infuriate: 极大激怒使人七窍生烟 (public / voters / customer) · incense: 因不义行为引起公愤与义愤 (community / moralists / readers) · madden: 令人狂躁不安或气急败坏 (crowd / thinker / critic) · exasperate: 反复折磨直至耗尽所有耐心 (teacher / parent / diplomat)

groups.name: Publish & Promulgate Publicly · 公示与系列出版 (Placard, Clarion, Serialise)
groups.tip: 面向大众正式公布与传播

items.def_en: to display a notice, placard, or message publicly in a designated place
items.ex_en: The property owner posted a clear eviction notice directly upon the broken front door.
items.ex_zh: 业主在破损的前门上直接张贴了一张清晰明了的驱逐通知。

items.def_en: to transmit a program, or tell a piece of news widely to many people
items.ex_en: The network will broadcast the presidential address live to millions across the nation.
items.ex_zh: 该网络将向全国数百万人现场直播总统讲话。
items.ex2_en: The radio signal broadcasts reliably across the mountainous region every night.
items.ex2_zh: 无线电信号每天晚上在整个山区都能可靠地播送。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to attach a notice, poster, or announcement in a public place where people can see it
items.ex_en: Management decided to put up an urgent safety notice on the employee board.
items.ex_zh: 管理层决定在员工公告栏上张贴一份紧急安全通告。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to broadcast or proclaim information loudly or conspicuously to a wide audience
items.ex_en: Loudspeakers began to blare out the evacuation warning across the crowded square.
items.ex_zh: 扬声器开始在拥挤的广场上大声播发疏散警告。
items.ex2_en: Loud rock music blared out through the open car windows.
items.ex2_zh: 震耳欲聋的摇滚乐从敞开的车窗里大声放了出来。

items.def_en: to announce officially and publicly a new law, decree, or doctrine
items.ex_en: The council gathered yesterday to promulgate the newly ratified environmental protection decree.
items.ex_zh: 委员会昨日齐聚一堂，正式颁布了新批准的环保法令。

items.def_zh: 重新发表，再版，重新发行
items.def_en: To publish a book, article, report, or other text again or in a new form.
items.ex_en: The academic press will republish the groundbreaking historical study in paperback next spring.
items.ex_zh: 学术出版社将于明年春季重新发行这部开创性历史著作的平装本。

items.def_zh: 张贴公告于，张贴海报公布；举告示牌抗议
items.def_en: 1. To post notices or posters in, on, or around a place. 2. To announce, advertise, or protest against something by means of placards.
items.ex_en: Activists resolved to placard the government quarter with slogans demanding immediate climate action.
items.ex_zh: 活动家们决定在政府辖区各处张贴海报，要求立即采取气候行动。

items.def_zh: 大声宣告，响亮地宣扬；吹响尖音喇叭
items.def_en: (literary) To proclaim, declare, or sound a call loudly and clearly.
items.ex_en: Prophets of old would clarion the dawn of righteous justice across desolate lands.
items.ex_zh: 昔日的先知们会在荒凉的土地上高声宣告公义的黎明。

items.def_en: (British English) To publish a book or broadcast a work in a succession of regular installments.
items.ex_en: The national broadcaster decided to serialise the gripping detective novel in four parts.
items.ex_zh: 国家广播公司决定将这部扣人心弦的侦探小说分四集连播。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote distributing, exhibiting, broadcasting, or sequencing informational media to the public via printed, posted, or serialized formats.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过张贴、刊载、连载或大肆宣讲等媒介方式将信息公之于众。
groups.desc_en: Refers to making information, edicts, or texts known broadly and officially across a public domain, contrasting with private dissemination or informal leaking.
groups.desc_zh: 强调通过法定程序、告示张贴或大众媒体向全社会公开发布法令、文告或作品，区别于私密通传或小众散发。
groups.nuance_en: promulgate: officially announce a law or decree to take effect (law / constitution / doctrine) · placard: publicly display notices on boards or walls (streets / notice / manifesto) · clarion: proclaim or call out loudly and resonantly (message / call / summons) · broadcast: transmit widely to a mass audience (news / interview / intentions)
groups.nuance_zh: promulgate: 依正式程序向公众颁布法令信条 (law / constitution / doctrine) · placard: 在公共场所张贴布告或标语 (streets / notice / manifesto) · clarion: 嘹亮高亢地号召或宣告 (message / call / summons) · broadcast: 借助大众媒介向广泛受众播放广播 (news / interview / intentions)

groups.name: Quiet & Suppressed Laughter · 咯咯笑与暗笑 (Giggle, Chuckle, Titter)
groups.tip: 从抿嘴微笑到咯咯发笑的不同神态

items.def_en: to laugh quietly to oneself in a contented or amused manner
items.ex_en: The grandfather sat reading by the fire, chuckling away at old childhood memories.
items.ex_zh: 祖父坐在炉火旁看书，回忆起童年往事时暗自咯咯轻笑。

items.def_en: To laugh repeatedly in a quiet, high-pitched, nervous, or silly way.
items.ex_en: The schoolgirls began to giggle nervously when the famous actor entered the room.
items.ex_zh: 当那位著名演员走进房间时，女学生们开始紧张地吃吃傻笑。

items.def_en: To smile broadly so that your teeth show, expressing amusement, pleasure, or mischief.
items.ex_en: He couldn't help but grin broadly when he saw the surprise birthday cake.
items.ex_zh: 看到那个惊喜的生日蛋糕时，他忍不住咧嘴露齿而笑。

items.def_zh: 轻声笑，咯咯笑；暗自发笑
items.def_en: To laugh quietly and softly to oneself, showing amusement or satisfaction.
items.ex_en: The professor paused during his lecture to chuckle softly at his own joke.
items.ex_zh: 教授在讲座中停顿了一下，为自己讲的笑话轻声笑了笑。

items.def_en: to give a smothered or half-suppressed laugh, often at someone else's misfortune
items.ex_en: Several naughty boys began to snicker quietly when the teacher dropped his books.
items.ex_zh: 老师把书掉在地上时，几个淘气的男孩开始暗暗偷笑。

items.def_en: to laugh quietly and disrespectfully, especially behind someone's back
items.ex_en: They continued to snigger behind her back after she mispronounced the foreign word.
items.ex_zh: 在她读错那个外来词后，他们继续在背后吃吃窃笑。

items.def_en: to give a short, nervous, or quiet laugh, typically in an effort to suppress it
items.ex_en: A few polite audience members began to titter behind their hands during silence.
items.ex_zh: 寂静之中，几位礼貌的听众开始掩口轻声窃笑。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to suppress or hold back a sudden burst of quiet laughter or tears with effort
items.ex_en: She had to choke back a sudden burst of laughter during the ceremony.
items.ex_zh: 在严肃的典礼上，她不得不竭力忍住突如其来的笑声。

items.def_en: to laugh in a breathy, gleeful, and snorting way, combining a chuckle and a snort
items.ex_en: The old captain began to chortle with genuine delight at the clever trick.
items.ex_zh: 老船长为这个巧妙的把戏发出了由衷开怀的咯咯欢笑。

groups.summary_en: Speakers describe quiet, light, or suppressed vocal expressions of amusement, ranging from low, private throat laughs to nervous, high-pitched vocalizations.
groups.summary_zh: 指轻声、克制或低音调的笑声，多带有私人愉悦或神经质特点。
groups.desc_en: Involves muted, stifled, or light vocal laughter produced by amusement, nervousness, or mockery, distinct from hearty, open laughter (laugh out loud).
groups.desc_zh: 指受到逗弄、由于紧张或出于嘲弄而发出的轻微、压抑或窃窃笑声，区别于放声大笑或朗声开怀笑。
groups.nuance_en: giggle: emit light, silly, high-pitched laughter from nervousness or amusement (schoolgirl / audience / child) · chuckle: laugh quietly inward with mild amusement (grandfather / reader / observer) · snicker: laugh disrespectfully and quietly behind closed lips (classmate / bully / spectator) · titter: laugh nervously or self-consciously in short restrained gasps (crowd / audience / congregation)
groups.nuance_zh: giggle: 因害羞、好笑而发出轻快咯咯笑 (schoolgirl / audience / child) · chuckle: 闭口自得其乐地轻声低笑 (grandfather / reader / observer) · snicker: 带有轻蔑或使坏意味的吃吃暗笑 (classmate / bully / spectator) · titter: 在拘谨尴尬场面下的神经质干笑 (crowd / audience / congregation)

groups.name: Raise & Elevate · 抬升与举起 (Move Upward in Space or Status)
groups.tip: 由低向高举起或昂首挺立

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to raise something in your hands so people can see it or support it high
items.ex_en: The proud champion decided to hold up the shining golden trophy for fans.
items.ex_zh: 骄傲的冠军决定把闪闪发光的金色奖杯高高举起给粉丝看。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to raise someone or something to a higher physical position
items.ex_en: Her encouraging message really lifted him up when he was feeling down.
items.ex_zh: 在他情绪低落时，她鼓励的话语确实让他振作了起来。

items.def_en: to raise something to a higher position or level using physical effort
items.ex_en: The workers cooperated together to lift the heavy steel beam into exact position.
items.ex_zh: 工人们通力合作，费力将沉重的钢梁举到了准确位置。
items.ex2_en: The dense morning fog lifted completely as the sun rose higher.
items.ex2_zh: 随着太阳升得更高，浓浓的晨雾完全消散了。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to haul or raise something upward toward yourself
items.ex_en: He bent over the edge to pull up the soaking wet canvas bag.
items.ex_zh: 他俯身探出边缘，用力将湿透的帆布包拉了上来。

items.def_zh: （马等）用后腿直立；举起，昂起，抬起；抚养，养育，饲养
items.def_en: 1. (of a horse or animal) To stand or rise up on its hind legs. 2. To lift or raise upright, especially the head. 3. To care for and educate children until fully grown; to breed animals.
items.ex_en: The frightened black stallion began to rear up violently against the stone wall.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的黑牡马开始对着石墙猛烈地用后腿直立起来。

items.def_zh: 举起，抬高；提升，提拔（职位、地位等）；振奋（情绪）
items.def_en: 1. To raise or lift something to a higher physical position. 2. To promote someone to a higher rank, status, or position.
items.ex_en: The board voted unanimously to elevate the hardworking director to chief executive officer.
items.ex_zh: 董事会一致投票决定提拔这位勤勉的主管为首席执行官。

items.def_en: to raise upwards physically or to elevate morally, spiritually, or culturally
items.ex_en: The priest hoped the inspiring sermon would uplift the downhearted spirits of parishioners.
items.ex_zh: 牧师希望这篇鼓舞人心的布道能够振奋教区居民低落的精神。

items.def_zh: 用机械/绳索吊起，用力举起
items.def_en: to raise or pull something up, often using ropes, pulleys, or considerable effort
items.ex_en: The crew used thick ropes to hoist the cargo crate onto the deck.
items.ex_zh: 船员们使用粗绳将货物板条箱用力吊升到了甲板上。

items.def_en: [I/T] to lift or pull something heavy with great effort
items.ex_en: The tired dockworkers had to heave heavy sacks of grain onto the barge.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的码头工人不得不把沉重的谷物麻袋费力搬上驳船。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe causing an entity to move higher or ascending upward, differing by physical posture, mechanical force, or metaphorical altitude.
groups.summary_zh: 指将物体或躯体推向更高垂直位置，包含自然竖起与机械/意象抬升。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on moving an entity vertically upward in physical space, dignity, or spirit, as an intentional elevating action rather than mechanical hoisting.
groups.desc_zh: 指在物理空间、社会地位或精神层面上将主体向上移拔或提升，强调尊严、高度与振奋，非单纯机械做功。
groups.nuance_en: elevate: raise to a higher status, moral level, or vertical height (status / debate / position) · uplift: morally or spiritually inspire to a higher plane (spirits / community / audience) · rear: raise upright or lift head/neck proudly (head / children / horse) · lift: general upward movement off a surface (box / curtain / trophy)
groups.nuance_zh: elevate: 提升职级地位、精神品格或物理高度 (status / debate / position) · uplift: 提振精神、鼓舞士气或开化民风 (spirits / community / audience) · rear: 高傲耸起头部或直立后躯 (head / children / horse) · lift: 将物体脱离支承面往上提举 (box / curtain / trophy)

groups.name: Raise with Effort or Mechanical Force · 举起与顶升 (Lift, Hoist, Jack)
groups.tip: 向上用力提升物体高度

items.def_zh: 用千斤顶托起（通常作 jack up）；抬高，大幅增加
items.def_en: (also 'jack up') To raise or lift something heavy using a jack; to raise prices or amounts sharply.
items.ex_en: The shady landlord planned to jack rents ridiculously high before the summer season.
items.ex_zh: 黑心房东打算在夏季来临前大幅抬高租金。

items.def_zh: 举起，抬起，升高；解除（限制）；（云、雾等）消散
items.def_en: 1. to raise someone or something to a higher position or level. 2. to remove a rule, tax, or restriction. 3. (of mist or clouds) to disperse.
items.ex_en: The government finally decided to lift strict trade restrictions on essential imported goods.
items.ex_zh: 政府终于决定解除对必需进口商品的严格贸易限制。
items.ex2_en: The heavy steel garage door lifted automatically upon pressing the remote.
items.ex2_zh: 按下遥控器后，沉重的钢制车库门自动升了起来。

items.def_zh: 吊起；升起（借助绳索、滑轮）
items.def_en: to raise or pull something heavy up into position, often using ropes or pulleys
items.ex_en: The construction crew used a sturdy pulley system to hoist the heavy stone.
items.ex_zh: 施工队使用坚固的滑轮系统将巨石吊升就位。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to lift something very heavy with great bodily effort
items.ex_en: Four muscular porters combined their strength to heave up the enormous wooden chest.
items.ex_zh: 四名健壮的搬运工合力将巨大的木箱吃力地举了起来。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to raise a heavy vehicle or structure off the ground using a jack
items.ex_en: The mechanic asked his assistant to jack up the car for inspection.
items.ex_zh: 机械师让助手用千斤顶把汽车顶起来以便检查。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to haul or lift a heavy load upward using a mechanical winch
items.ex_en: The rescue crew managed to winch up the damaged vehicle from the ravine.
items.ex_zh: 救援人员设法用绞车将受损车辆从山沟中绞了上来。

items.def_en: to lift or move heavy materials using a mechanical crane
items.ex_en: The builders had to crane heavy air conditioning units onto the high roof.
items.ex_zh: 建筑工人不得不使用起重机把重型空调机组吊到高高的屋顶上。

items.def_en: [I/T] to lift or haul something very heavy with immense physical exertion
items.ex_en: The sailors had to heave with all their might to secure the anchor.
items.ex_zh: 水手们不得不使出浑身力气用力拉起并固定锚链。

items.def_zh: 用绞车拉起；用摇把吊升
items.def_en: to haul, raise, or lower an object using a mechanical winch
items.ex_en: They had to winch the heavy lifeboat back onto the ship's main deck.
items.ex_zh: 他们不得不用机械绞车将沉重的救生艇拉回船的主甲板。

groups.summary_en: An agent applies bodily force or specialized machinery to elevate a heavy object from a lower position to a higher one. Verbs intensify from basic upward effort ('lift'), to heavy hauling with ropes/pulleys ('hoist', 'heave'), to mechanical tool-assisted lifting ('jack', 'winch').
groups.summary_zh: 施加人力或借助机械工具将重物从低处顶起或抬升。
groups.desc_en: Emphasizes the exertion of extreme muscular labor or the application of mechanical apparatus to vertically displace heavy, inert loads, contrasting with effortless upward movement.
groups.desc_zh: 强调运用庞大肌肉力量或机械装置（滑轮、千斤顶等）将沉重庞杂之物费力向上顶托或吊升，区别于轻松提拔。
groups.nuance_en: hoist: raise heavy cargo or flags via mechanical tackle or ropes (flag / cargo / sail) · jack up: raise vertically using a hydraulic or screw mechanism (car / trailer / house) · heave: lift and throw or drag with massive physical exertion (anchor / log / crate) · winch up: lift or haul via a winding cable drum (boat / vehicle / cage)
groups.nuance_zh: hoist: 动用绳索、吊臂或滑轮升起重物 (flag / cargo / sail) · jack up: 使用千斤顶等机械装置硬性顶升 (car / trailer / house) · heave: 倾注全身蛮力沉重地提拔搬动 (anchor / log / crate) · winch up: 操纵绞车钢缆牵引卷升 (boat / vehicle / cage)

groups.name: Rate Acceleration & Multiplicative Surge · 倍增与增幅 (Quicken, Treble, Quadruple)
groups.tip: 数量成倍增加或强度规模放大

items.def_en: to increase in speed, rate, or intensity
items.ex_en: Business usually picks up in the spring, and sales figures improve rapidly.
items.ex_zh: 生意通常在春季好转，销售额也会迅速回升。

items.def_en: to become, or make something, twice as great in size, amount, or value
items.ex_en: The ambitious company hopes to double its annual revenue within the next five years.
items.ex_zh: 这家雄心勃勃的公司希望在未来五年内使其年收入翻倍。
items.ex2_en: Within five years, the small firm's annual revenue will likely double.
items.ex2_zh: 五年之内，这家小公司的年收入很可能会翻倍。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to become much more active or productive, or to make something do so
items.ex_en: The marketing team worked hard to rev up production before the holiday season.
items.ex_zh: 营销团队努力工作，以便在假期来临前让生产大幅加速运转。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to move, happen, or cause something to happen much faster
items.ex_en: The factory introduced advanced automated machinery to speed up the slow assembly process.
items.ex_zh: 工厂引入了先进的自动化机械，以加快缓慢的装配流程。

items.def_en: to increase multiplicatively or intensify through sequential additions
items.ex_en: Persistent economic instability will only compound existing financial burdens for low-income vulnerable families.
items.ex_zh: 持续的经济不稳定只会使低收入弱势家庭现有的财务负担成倍加重。

items.def_zh: （使）加快，（使）加速；（使）变活跃，激起
items.def_en: To become quicker, faster, or more active, or to make something do so.
items.ex_en: Her delicate pulse began to quicken with sheer terror in the dark forest.
items.ex_zh: 在黑暗的森林里，她微弱的脉搏因纯粹的恐惧而开始加速跳动。

items.def_en: (chiefly British) To increase threefold, or to multiply an amount or number by three.
items.ex_en: Budget cuts could easily treble the current waiting times for basic medical services.
items.ex_zh: 预算削减很容易使目前基本医疗服务的等待时间增加至三倍。
items.ex2_en: Hospital waiting times could treble if government funding is abruptly reduced next year.
items.ex2_zh: 如果明年政府资助突然削减，医院的候诊时间可能会增加三倍。

items.def_en: To increase fourfold, or to multiply an amount or number by four.
items.ex_en: The successful startup managed to quadruple its active subscriber base in twelve months.
items.ex_zh: 这家成功的初创企业设法在十二个月内将其活跃订阅用户数翻了两番。
items.ex2_en: The startup's active subscriber base quadrupled within only twelve short months.
items.ex2_zh: 这家初创公司的活跃用户群在短短十二个月内增加了四倍。

items.def_en: to increase or multiply by a factor of five
items.ex_en: Analysts predict that renewable energy investments will quintuple over the next single decade.
items.ex_zh: 分析师预测，在未来十年内，可再生能源投资将增加到原来的五倍。
items.ex2_en: The national investment fund plans to quintuple its green energy budget by next spring.
items.ex2_zh: 国家投资基金计划在明年春天前将其绿色能源预算增加四倍（至五倍）。

groups.summary_en: A quantity, speed, or measure expands by a steep mathematical factor or accelerates sharply in pace. Verbs indicate specific arithmetic multiplication or brisk temporal acceleration.
groups.summary_zh: 数量按倍数翻增或节奏显著提速，重在跨越式的增幅与加速。
groups.desc_en: Specifies dynamic growth occurring via rapid mathematical multiplication or quickening velocity, contrasting with linear, arithmetic addition.
groups.desc_zh: 指数量、规模或速率以几何级数倍增或急剧提速，表现出动态增幅的乘数效应，区别于平缓的线性累加。
groups.nuance_en: double: multiply two-fold (profits / size / efforts) · treble: multiply three-fold (investment / value / output) · quicken: increase tempo or responsiveness (pace / pulse / recovery) · rev up: sharply accelerate activity or excitement as if revving an engine (engine / campaign / economy)
groups.nuance_zh: double: 使规模或数值翻番增至两倍 (profits / size / efforts) · treble: 使增至三倍 (investment / value / output) · quicken: 加快节奏、心率或周转速度 (pace / pulse / recovery) · rev up: 如发动机加踩油门般蓄势猛增 (engine / campaign / economy)

groups.name: Rearrange & Reconfigure Structures · 调整配置与重组结构 (Rejig, Reconfigure, Isomerize)
groups.tip: 重整分子结构或业务编排

items.def_en: to rearrange elements or settings of a system, software, or organization into a new pattern
items.ex_en: Engineers worked overnight to reconfigure the enterprise network following the severe cyberattack.
items.ex_zh: 在遭遇严重网络攻击后，工程师们通宵工作以重新配置企业网络。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make substantial structural changes to an organization or system to improve it
items.ex_en: The new CEO plans to shake up the entire management structure.
items.ex_zh: 新任首席执行官计划对整个管理架构进行大洗牌。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to alter the internal order or relative positions of things
items.ex_en: Let's switch around the furniture in the living room to make more space.
items.ex_zh: 我们把客厅里的家具调换一下位置，以腾出更多空间吧。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to scramble or rearrange the existing order or arrangement of items
items.ex_en: Please don't mix up the sorted folders on my tidy desk again.
items.ex_zh: 请不要再把我整洁书桌上分类好的文件夹顺序打乱了。

items.def_en: to fundamentally organize a company, system, or agreement in a different way
items.ex_en: The airline hired external consultants to restructure its failing business model after bankruptcy.
items.ex_zh: 这家航空公司在破产后聘请了外部顾问来重组其失败的商业模式。

items.def_zh: 打乱重组，调整（职位、卡片）
items.def_en: to change the order or position of things or personnel within a group
items.ex_en: The prime minister decided to shuffle several cabinet ministers to restore political stability.
items.ex_zh: 首相决定改组几位内阁部长，以恢复政治稳定。

items.def_en: to adjust components, resources, or policies into new or corrected positions relative to goals
items.ex_en: The corporation plans to realign marketing investments with its long-term sustainable growth goals.
items.ex_zh: 该企业计划重新调整营销投资，以契合其长期可持续增长目标。
items.ex2_en: Corporate priorities slowly realign as market demands shift toward sustainable products.
items.ex2_zh: 随着市场需求转向可持续产品，公司的重点业务逐渐重新调整。

items.def_zh: 重新调整，重组，重新规划
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To reorganize, rearrange, or alter something (such as a system, schedule, or workforce) to improve it.
items.ex_en: We need to rejig our daily production schedule to meet the tight deadline.
items.ex_zh: 我们需要重新调整日常生产时间表，以赶上紧迫的截止日期。

items.def_en: 1. (chemistry) To convert or be converted into an isomer, having the same molecular formula but different chemical structure.
items.ex_en: Under intense ultraviolet light, the organic compound begins to isomerize into different forms.
items.ex_zh: 在强紫外光的照射下，该有机化合物开始异构化为不同形式。
items.ex2_en: Carefully applied heat will isomerize the synthetic compound into a more stable molecule.
items.ex2_zh: 小心加热将使该合成化合物异构化为更稳定的分子。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote altering the internal arrangement, molecular structure, or organizational setup of an existing system, ranging from pragmatic operational tweaks to technical transformations.
groups.summary_zh: 重新调整或改变现有系统、布局或分子的内部结构与组成方式。
groups.desc_en: Refers to altering the internal alignment, component order, or operating architecture of an established system without necessarily creating entirely new elements.
groups.desc_zh: 指在不新增基本元素的前提下，打乱、调配或重新建构已有体系的内部关系与功能布局，区别于从零构建。
groups.nuance_en: reconfigure: change the software, hardware, or structural layout (system / network / layout) · restructure: thoroughly reorganize debts, management, or organizational hierarchy (company / debt / industry) · rejig: make informal tactical adjustments or reshuffles (schedule / lineup / priorities) · shake up: drastically disrupt an organization to root out complacency (cabinet / department / market)
groups.nuance_zh: reconfigure: 重新配置软硬件或功能空间布局 (system / network / layout) · restructure: 对企业组织架构或债务进行全面重组 (company / debt / industry) · rejig: 对日程、方案或排兵布阵做微调换位 (schedule / lineup / priorities) · shake up: 实施雷厉风行的重组变革以打破积弊 (cabinet / department / market)

groups.name: Recover & Convalesce · 康复与疗养 (Recover, Recuperate, Convalesce)
groups.tip: 患病或负伤后休养逐步复原

items.def_en: (+ from) to return to normal health, consciousness, or vigor after illness or injury
items.ex_en: The patient took nearly three months to recover from the complicated surgical procedure.
items.ex_zh: 这位病人在复杂的手术后花了将近三个月才完全康复。

items.def_en: to make a sudden resurgence of strength or health after severe weakness or decline
items.ex_en: The critically ill elderly patient started to rally miraculously after the new treatment.
items.ex_zh: 接受新疗法后，这位病危的高龄患者奇迹般地开始好转复苏。
items.ex2_en: The charismatic general rallied his exhausted troops for one final decisive counterattack.
items.ex2_zh: 富有魅力的将军重振了他筋疲力尽的部队，发起最后一次决定性的反击。

items.def_en: [I/T] to undergo or provide physical therapy or medical conditioning after an illness or injury
items.ex_en: The star athlete spent the winter in specialized clinics to rehab his shoulder.
items.ex_zh: 这位明星运动员在专业诊所度过了整个冬天，以接受肩部康复治疗。

items.def_en: to quickly recover one's health, energy, or spirits after illness or trauma
items.ex_en: Young healthy children usually bounce back remarkably quickly after catching a mild fever.
items.ex_zh: 健康的小孩在患上轻度发烧后通常能非常迅速地恢复元气。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to become or make someone more lively, energetic, and healthy after fatigue or illness
items.ex_en: A hot cup of strong black coffee helped perk him up instantly.
items.ex_zh: 一杯滚烫的浓黑咖啡立刻帮他振作起了精神。
items.ex2_en: The tired travelers quickly perked up after drinking a pot of fresh tea.
items.ex2_zh: 喝了一壶新鲜热茶后，疲惫的旅行者们很快振作起来。

items.def_zh: 渡过难关；（重病中）挺过来
items.def_en: (+ sth) to recover from a serious illness or injury, surviving against the odds
items.ex_en: The doctors were amazed that the patient pulled through after such severe injuries.
items.ex_zh: 医生们对患者受了如此重伤后仍能挺过来感到惊奇。

items.def_en: (of bones, wounds, or sick patients) to heal, knit together, or improve in health
items.ex_en: With proper rest and clean bandages, the nasty leg wound will soon mend.
items.ex_zh: 只要好好休息并使用干净绷带，那处严重的腿部伤口很快就会愈合。
items.ex2_en: The skilled doctor carefully mended the fractured leg with thin titanium pins.
items.ex2_zh: 医术高超的医生用细钛钉仔细接合好了骨折的腿骨。

items.def_zh: 康复，休养，恢复健康；恢复，挽回（损失等）
items.def_en: 1. to recover health, strength, or energy gradually after an illness, injury, or exhaustion 2. to recover or regain lost money or assets
items.ex_en: The tired diplomat went to a quiet seaside resort to recuperate completely.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的外交官前往一个安静的海滨胜地彻底休养康复。

items.def_en: to spend time resting and gradually recovering health and strength after an illness or medical operation
items.ex_en: She spent several peaceful quiet weeks in the countryside to convalesce after surgery.
items.ex_zh: 术后她在乡村度过了几个平静安详的星期来调养康复。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to bodily restoration toward health, strength, and vitality after disease, exhaustion, or surgical trauma through rest and medical care.
groups.summary_zh: 经过病痛、伤损或过度劳累后逐渐恢复健康与体力。
groups.desc_en: Encompasses the biological or bodily journey of regaining health, vitality, and functional normality following illness, injury, or severe ordeal, contrasting with instantaneous healing.
groups.desc_zh: 指经历疾病、创伤或耗竭后，身体逐步恢复体力、机能并重获健康的过程，强调阶段性疗养，区别于瞬间治愈。
groups.nuance_en: recuperate: rest to recover strength and energy after illness or exertion (patient / body / athlete) · convalesce: spend gradual time recovering health after major surgery or chronic illness (patient / invalid / child) · rally: revive sharply from depression, weakness, or downturn (spirits / patient / market) · bounce back: display resilience by recovering quickly from adversity (athlete / economy / team)
groups.nuance_zh: recuperate: 经调理休养以逐步恢复体力 (patient / body / athlete) · convalesce: 大病或重伤后遵医嘱长期静养康复 (patient / invalid / child) · rally: 在衰弱或低迷中突然精神转振、止跌回升 (spirits / patient / market) · bounce back: 具高度韧性从挫折中迅速反弹 (athlete / economy / team)

groups.name: Recover & Reclaim Lost Assets · 追回与收回损失 (Reclaim, Recoup, Recover)
groups.tip: 重新拿回失去的财产

items.def_en: to get back possession of something lost, stolen, or taken away
items.ex_en: The police managed to recover the stolen antique jewelry intact within twenty-four hours.
items.ex_zh: 警方设法在二十四小时内完好无损地追回了被盗的古董珠宝。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to recover possession of lost, stolen, or borrowed money or property
items.ex_en: She went straight to the police station hoping to get back her wallet.
items.ex_zh: 她径直去了警察局，希望能取回自己丢失的钱包。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to successfully regain an asset, position, or right after hard effort or conflict
items.ex_en: The brand is launching a loyalty program to win back lost customers.
items.ex_zh: 该品牌正在推出会员忠诚计划，以赢回流失的客户。

items.def_zh: 艰难追回；强行追回（款项）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to recover money or benefits that have already been paid out, often through strict measures
items.ex_en: The tax authorities vowed to claw back millions in improperly claimed stimulus payments.
items.ex_zh: 税务当局誓言要强行追回数百万不当领取的刺激救济金。

items.def_en: to find and bring back something from a place where it was left or held
items.ex_en: Investigators managed to retrieve critical deleted files from the damaged hard drive successfully.
items.ex_zh: 调查人员成功从受损的硬盘中找回了关键的被删文件。

items.def_en: to achieve or obtain something back that has been lost or taken
items.ex_en: The rebel army fought fiercely to regain control of the strategic border town.
items.ex_zh: 叛军激烈交战，试图重新夺回对这座战略边境城镇的控制权。

items.def_zh: 要求归还，收回；开垦，开拓（土地）；回收利用
items.def_en: 1. To get back something that was lost, taken, or given away. 2. To treat waste products or wasteland so they can be used again.
items.ex_en: The displaced royal family fought in international court to reclaim their seized estate.
items.ex_zh: 流亡的王室在国际法庭上抗争，要求收回他们被没收的庄园。

items.def_zh: 收回，追回（成本、损失等）；弥补，补偿
items.def_en: To get back money that you have spent, invested, or lost; to compensate for a loss.
items.ex_en: The film studio hopes to recoup its massive production budget from foreign box-office.
items.ex_zh: 电影制片厂希望能通过海外票房收回其庞大的制作预算。

items.def_en: to legally take back possession of goods or property because the buyer failed to pay for them
items.ex_en: The bank obtained a court order to repossess the defaulted debtor's luxury estate.
items.ex_zh: 银行获得了法院指令，依法收回该违约债务人的豪宅。

groups.summary_en: An entity regains possession, rights, or financial value that was previously lost, surrendered, confiscated, or spent. 'Reclaim' emphasizes demanding back rights or property by entitlement, 'recoup' emphasizes recovering monetary outlays or losses through subsequent gains, and 'recover' covers broad repossession.
groups.summary_zh: 依法要回所有权或通过运营弥补追回经济损失。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the legal, strategic, or forceful repossession of lost, stolen, or forfeited assets, expenses, or rights, contrasting with voluntary donation or initial acquisition.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过法律诉讼、策略追讨或强力措施将遗失、被夺或亏蚀的财物、权益重新收回，区别于主动赐予或初次获得。
groups.nuance_en: recoup: regain financially equivalent losses or expenditures (costs / losses / investment) · claw back: retrospectively reclaim funds or bonuses by regulatory right (bonuses / funds / profits) · reclaim: demand the return of rights, property, or wasteland (territory / rights / land) · retrieve: fetch back data, lost property, or memories from storage (data / files / luggage)
groups.nuance_zh: recoup: 靠后续收益弥补垫付的成本或填补亏损 (costs / losses / investment) · claw back: 依据监管条款强制追索已发款项 (bonuses / funds / profits) · reclaim: 依法或以主权之名申索领地、废土或权利 (territory / rights / land) · retrieve: 从遗失处或数据库中提取找回 (data / files / luggage)

groups.name: Refurbish, Rejuvenate & Renew · 翻新、重赋生机与修复 (Revitalize, Restore, Refurbish)
groups.tip: 恢复原有生机活力或样貌

items.def_en: (+ sth) to repair, redecorate, and modernize an old building or item
items.ex_en: We bought a dilapidated cottage and spent six months doing it up nicely.
items.ex_zh: 我们买下了一栋破旧的小屋，花了六个月时间把它精心整修一新。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to improve a surface or appearance by making minor repairs or painting over blemishes
items.ex_en: She spent a few minutes touching up her makeup before the live broadcast.
items.ex_zh: 在直播开始前，她花了几分钟补了补妆。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to make someone or something look cleaner, fresher, and more attractive
items.ex_en: A quick coat of paint really helped spruce up the tired old living room.
items.ex_zh: 快速刷上一层新油漆确实让原本陈旧的客厅焕然一新。

items.def_zh: 翻新；整修（建筑物或设备）
items.def_en: to clean up, redecorate, and restore a building or equipment to good condition
items.ex_en: The municipal authority allocated substantial funds to refurbish the historic administrative building.
items.ex_zh: 市政当局拨出大笔资金，用于翻新这座具有历史意义的行政大楼。

items.def_en: to impart new life, energy, or activity to an exhausted person, organization, or economy
items.ex_en: The strategic investment aimed to revitalize the region's struggling manufacturing sector.
items.ex_zh: 这项战略投资旨在重振该地区陷入困境的制造业。

items.def_zh: （加水等）使复原，使恢复原状；重组，重建
items.def_en: 1. To restore dried or condensed food or drink to its original liquid or solid form by adding water. 2. To reorganize, reconstruct, or re-establish an organization or system.
items.ex_en: Add three parts cold water to reconstitute the concentrated orange juice before serving.
items.ex_zh: 饮用前加入三份凉水，以使浓缩橙汁恢复原状。

items.def_zh: 使恢复元气，给……注入新的活力，使复兴
items.def_en: To give new energy, strength, or vitality to someone or something.
items.ex_en: The dynamic new chief executive managed to reinvigorate the demoralized corporate workforce.
items.ex_zh: 充满活力的新任首席执行官成功给士气低落的员工队伍注入了新活力。

items.def_zh: 修复；检修大修（使恢复良态）
items.def_en: to overhaul, repair, and put mechanical equipment back into working order
items.ex_en: Certified technicians will recondition the turbine engine before reissuing its flight certification.
items.ex_zh: 持证技术人员将在重新签发飞行合格证之前大修检修这台涡轮发动机。

items.def_zh: 给……重漆面漆，整修（家具或地板等）表面
items.def_en: To restore the surface of wooden or metal furniture or floors by stripping the old finish and applying a new one.
items.ex_en: He hired a specialist craftsman to refinish the antique oak dining table.
items.ex_zh: 他雇了一位专业工匠来为这张古董橡木餐桌重新打磨上漆。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote acts of bringing an exhausted organism, degraded material, or worn structure back to an intact, vigorous, or freshly finished state through targeted restoration or rejuvenation.
groups.summary_zh: 对劳损人身、降解物质或陈旧表面施加加工以恢复生机或新貌。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on repairing, redecorating, or infusing new life and vitality into decaying, worn-out structures or weary organizations, distinct from mere routine maintenance.
groups.desc_zh: 指对破旧老化的实体建筑、器物或低迷沉寂的机体组织进行翻新、再造与重新激活，区别于日常简单维护。
groups.nuance_en: refurbish: clean, renovate, and re-equip physical spaces or equipment (offices / hotel / equipment) · revitalize: inject fresh vitality, dynamism, and economic health (economy / neighborhood / brand) · recondition: overhaul mechanical equipment back to functional working order (engine / batteries / parts) · spruce up: quickly tidy or decorate to make look smarter (room / appearance / town)
groups.nuance_zh: refurbish: 彻底整修装潢房屋或重新配备设施 (offices / hotel / equipment) · revitalize: 注入新鲜生机与经济活力以再造繁荣 (economy / neighborhood / brand) · recondition: 对机械部件拆检翻修以恢复原厂性能 (engine / batteries / parts) · spruce up: 快速修饰打扮以显利落齐整 (room / appearance / town)

groups.name: Refute & Disprove Decisively · 否定与确凿驳倒 (Contradict, Gainsay, Confute, Disprove)
groups.tip: 断然否认并举证驳斥观点

items.def_en: to state the direct opposite of what someone has said, or imply their claim is wrong
