items.ex_en: The forensic findings directly contradict the narrative initially provided by the defendant.
items.ex_zh: 法医检验结果与被告最初提供的陈述完全相抵触。

items.def_en: to offer formal arguments, counter-evidence, or statements proving that an accusation is false
items.ex_en: Counsel presented compelling financial documentation to rebut allegations of unlawful insider trading.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师提交了令人信服的财务文件，以反驳有关非法内幕交易的指控。

items.def_en: To deny, contradict, or dispute the truth of a statement.
items.ex_en: No honest observer could gainsay the moral authority of the leader's impassioned plea.
items.ex_zh: 任何公正的旁观者都无法否认那位领导人慷慨陈词中的道德号召力。

items.def_zh: 彻底击碎；驳得体无完肤
items.def_en: (+ sth) to completely expose flaws in and disprove a claim or explanation
items.ex_en: Her detailed investigation blew apart the fraudulent claims made by the investment startup.
items.ex_zh: 她详尽的调查彻底击碎了那家初创投资公司编造的虚假说辞。

items.def_zh: 断然驳倒；击溃（论点或提案）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to decisively reject or demolish an argument, proposal, or theory
items.ex_en: The board quickly shot down his reckless expansion proposal during the morning meeting.
items.ex_zh: 董事会在上午的会议上断然驳回了他那个鲁莽的扩张提议。

items.def_zh: 逐一拆解驳倒；严厉批驳
items.def_en: (+ sth) to dissect and dismantle an argument by exposing all its logical weaknesses
items.ex_en: The civil war threatens to tear the entire country apart.
items.ex_zh: 内战有让整个国家分崩离析的危险。

items.def_en: to show with definitive evidence or logic that a statement, theory, or belief is false
items.ex_en: Extensive empirical research was conducted to disprove the prevailing epidemiological hypothesis.
items.ex_zh: 科学家开展了广泛的实证研究，以证明这一主流流行病学假说并不成立。

items.def_en: To prove an argument, claim, or person to be completely wrong or false.
items.ex_en: The scholar produced archival evidence that completely confuted the revisionist historical thesis.
items.ex_zh: 该学者拿出了档案证据，彻底驳倒了这一修正主义历史论题。

items.def_en: to completely defeat, tear apart, and expose as utterly false an opponent's argument
items.ex_en: The prosecutor used forensic evidence to demolish the defense's unconvincing alibi.
items.ex_zh: 检察官利用法医证据彻底推翻了辩方站不住脚的伪证。

groups.summary_en: A speaker denies or tears down an argument, progressing from simple verbal contradiction and gainsaying to rigorous, irrefutable factual disproof.
groups.summary_zh: 从口头否认违拗递进至以无可辩驳的证据彻底驳倒。
groups.desc_en: Involves decisively invalidating arguments, allegations, or hypotheses through undeniable evidence, superior logic, or crushing counter-proof, distinct from mere disagreement.
groups.desc_zh: 指运用无可辩驳的证据、严密逻辑或权威论据，确凿无疑地摧毁对方论点、指控或假说，区别于口舌之争。
groups.nuance_en: disprove: demonstrate the objective falsity of a proposition with facts (theory / myth / hypothesis) · confute: logically silence an opponent by completely demolishing their argument (argument / philosopher / claim) · rebut: formally refute charges or opposing claims in debate or court (allegations / testimony / charges) · shoot down: summarily reject or blow apart an idea or proposal (proposal / argument / theory)
groups.nuance_zh: disprove: 用确凿事实证伪假说或谬误 (theory / myth / hypothesis) · confute: 凭借严密逻辑驳得体无完肤哑口无言 (argument / philosopher / claim) · rebut: 在法庭或辩论中就指控逐条反驳 (allegations / testimony / charges) · shoot down: 毫无留情地将提案或设想全盘击碎 (proposal / argument / theory)

groups.name: Register & Archive Official Records · 归档与登记 (File, Accession, Archive)
groups.tip: 正式编目入库建档

items.def_zh: 归档，建档；正式提出（申请、诉讼等）；列队行进；用锉刀锉
items.def_en: 1. To place documents in an official archive or record, or submit an official application, lawsuit, or report. 2. To walk one behind another in a line. 3. To smooth or shape something with a file.
items.ex_en: The aggrieved employees decided to file a formal complaint with the labor board.
items.ex_zh: 受到不公待遇的员工决定向劳动仲裁委员会正式提出申诉。

items.def_en: [I/T] to record names, details, or transactions officially in an authoritative ledger or database
items.ex_en: All foreign entities must register their commercial transactions with the regulatory authority.
items.ex_zh: 所有外国实体必须向监管机构正式登记其商业交易。

items.def_en: to place or store official documents, records, or digital data in an archive
items.ex_en: IT specialists routinely archive inactive client records onto secure encrypted cloud servers.
items.ex_zh: IT专家定期将不活跃的客户档案归档到安全的加密云服务器中。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to systematically record official details, entries, or arrivals in a formal logbook
items.ex_en: The duty guard must log in every arriving vehicle at the checkpoint.
items.ex_zh: 值班警卫必须在检查站将每一辆抵达的车辆登记入册。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to enroll or formally register someone into an official list, organization, or activity
items.ex_en: Volunteers helped sign up local residents for the neighborhood disaster preparedness program.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者协助给本地居民报名参加社区备灾项目。
items.ex2_en: Dozens of eager volunteers signed up for the weekend coastal cleanup initiative.
items.ex2_zh: 数十名热情的志愿者报名参加了周末的海滩清洁倡议活动。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to enter someone's name or official details onto a formal list or record
items.ex_en: The receptionist will put you down for tomorrow's guided gallery tour.
items.ex_zh: 接待员会把你登记到明天画廊导览团的名单上。

items.def_en: to systematically list and describe items (such as books, art, or records) in a registry
items.ex_en: Librarians spent several months cataloging the rare manuscripts donated by the estate.
items.ex_zh: 图书管理员花了数月时间将庄园捐赠的珍贵手稿编目入库。

items.def_zh: （博物馆、图书馆等）正式登记入册，入藏编目
items.def_en: (formal) To formally record a book, artifact, or document as a new addition to an official collection.
items.ex_en: The curator carefully accessioned the newly acquired bronze artifact into the museum registry.
items.ex_zh: 策展人仔细地将新购得的青铜文物登记入藏并编入博物馆档案。

items.def_zh: 立案登记，编入案卷摘要
items.def_en: to enter a brief summary or title of a document or court case on a list or official docket
items.ex_en: The court clerk will docket the emergency appellate petition early tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 法院书记员将于明天清晨把紧急上诉申请立案登记入卷。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe formally recording, cataloging, or depositing documents, artifacts, or official data into an organized institutional repository or registry. 'File' applies broadly to office and legal records, whereas 'accession' is a specialized term for formally adding acquisitions to a museum or archival collection.
groups.summary_zh: 指将文档、资料或馆藏物品正式录入、归档或列入名册的行政行为。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on entering, depositing, and systematically classifying records, legal instruments, or acquisitions into an institutional archive or official registry for permanent custody.
groups.desc_zh: 指将正式文件、名册或入藏实物经过登记、编目纳入官方机构的永久性档案系统，区别于随手笔记或临时保存。
groups.nuance_en: file: submit or store official documents systematically into records (lawsuit / report / return) · archive: transfer historical records to secure long-term preservation (records / emails / data) · accession: record a new acquisition into a museum or library catalog (artifacts / collection / manuscript) · catalog: systematically list and describe items (collection / books / inventory)
groups.nuance_zh: file: 依规将公文、诉状或税务申报立卷归档 (lawsuit / report / return) · archive: 将过往数据或历史档案作长期封存 (records / emails / data) · accession: 博物馆或图书馆将新增藏品正式登记在册 (artifacts / collection / manuscript) · catalog: 按规则对典籍藏品逐项编目描述 (collection / books / inventory)

groups.name: Reinforce & Entrench · 巩固与牢固确立 (Bolster, Consolidate, Entrench)
groups.tip: 底部发力加固，维持结构稳固

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make something stronger, larger, or more effective by adding resources or personnel
items.ex_en: The airline decided to beef up security measures following the recent safety audit.
items.ex_zh: 在最近的安全审查之后，该航空公司决定加强安保措施。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to gradually reinforce, increase, or consolidate strength, defenses, or confidence
items.ex_en: Regular physical training helped him build up his endurance before the championship marathon.
items.ex_zh: 规律的体能训练帮助他在锦标马拉松赛前增强巩固了耐力。
items.ex2_en: Huge storm clouds built up along the southern horizon before the evening downpour.
items.ex2_zh: 傍晚倾盆大雨来临前，南方地平线上集结起了巨大的暴风雨云。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to support or strengthen a weak or failing institution, wall, or position
items.ex_en: Emergency fiscal aid was deployed to shore up the collapsing banking institution.
items.ex_zh: 紧急财政援助被调配到位，以支撑这家濒临倒闭的银行机构。

items.def_en: to make a structure, belief, or position stronger by adding support or substance
items.ex_en: Engineers added heavy steel braces to reinforce the bridge's aging central span.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们添加了重型钢质支撑梁，以加固大桥日渐老化的跨中结构。

items.def_en: [I/T] to strengthen a position of power, success, or control so that it becomes more stable
items.ex_en: The decisive electoral victory allowed the prime minister to consolidate his political authority.
items.ex_zh: 决定性的选举胜利使首相得以进一步巩固自己的政治权力。
items.ex2_en: The fragmented rebel factions slowly consolidated into a unified political organization.
items.ex2_zh: 零散的叛乱派系慢慢合并巩固为一个统一的政治组织。

items.def_zh: 支持，支撑；增强，加强，巩固
items.def_en: To improve, strengthen, or support something such as confidence, an argument, or a structure.
items.ex_en: New statistical data helped bolster public confidence in the efficacy of the vaccine.
items.ex_zh: 最新的统计数据有助于增强公众对该疫苗有效性的信心。

items.def_en: to make a place or position stronger and better protected against attack or decay
items.ex_en: Troops worked tirelessly to fortify the garrison against impending heavy artillery assaults.
items.ex_zh: 部队不知疲倦地修筑防御工事，以防备即将来临的重炮袭击。

items.def_zh: 使牢固确立，使根深蒂固；掘壕固守
items.def_en: 1. To establish something firmly so that change is very difficult or unlikely. 2. (military) To dig trenches to protect soldiers from enemy attack.
items.ex_en: Decades of political dominance entrenched systemic patronage throughout the administrative hierarchy.
items.ex_zh: 数十年的政治主导使得裙带关系在整个行政层级中根深蒂固。

items.def_en: to provide strong reinforcement or support for an argument, system, or structure
items.ex_en: The defense attorney cited historical precedents to buttress her constitutional argument.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师援引历史判例，为她的宪法论点提供强有力的支持。

groups.summary_en: An agent strengthens, stabilizes, or deeply establishes a position, defense, belief, or institutional power. Verbs progress in manner from buttressing from the outside ('bolster') to unifying and solidifying ('consolidate'), up to rooting something so firmly that change becomes almost impossible ('entrench', 'ingrain').
groups.summary_zh: 稳固充实基础或使权力地位深度根深蒂固。
groups.desc_en: Denotes making an existing physical position, power base, or belief substantially stronger, more resistant to attack, and deeply rooted, contrasting with initiating a new setup.
groups.desc_zh: 指对现有的阵地、权力基础或观念立场施加外力加固或深度驻防，使其不可动摇或难以攻破，区别于初设结构。
groups.nuance_en: entrench: firmly establish an idea or habit so it is almost impossible to dislodge (privilege / attitude / position) · fortify: strengthen militarily or chemically against assault or weakness (city / defenses / wine) · consolidate: combine and solidify gains or power into a secure whole (power / position / gains) · bolster: lend vital external support to boost confidence or credibility (confidence / economy / claim)
groups.nuance_zh: entrench: 使观念、特权等根深蒂固而牢不可破 (privilege / attitude / position) · fortify: 筑垒设防以御强敌或强化物质成分 (city / defenses / wine) · consolidate: 整合并巩固既得权力或利益版图 (power / position / gains) · bolster: 从外部予以强力提振支持 (confidence / economy / claim)

groups.name: Relax & Destress · 放松与解压 (Release Nervous Tension and Mental Strain)
groups.tip: 卸下心理压力以重获舒展轻松

items.def_zh: （使）放松，（使）缓解；休息；放宽（规则）
items.def_en: 1. To become or make someone less tense, anxious, or tired. 2. To make rules or control less strict.
items.ex_en: Listening to classical piano music helps her relax after a stressful workday.
items.ex_zh: 听古典钢琴音乐有助于她在紧张的工作日后放松身心。
items.ex2_en: Her stiff facial muscles visibly relaxed once the difficult interview concluded safely.
items.ex2_zh: 艰难的面试平安结束后，她僵硬的面部肌肉明显放松了下来。

items.def_zh: 放松肌肉；消除拘谨紧张
items.def_en: [I/T] to become less rigid, tense, or formal in body or demeanor
items.ex_en: Do some dynamic stretches before your routine to loosen up your tight muscles.
items.ex_zh: 在训练前做些动态拉伸，以放松你紧绷的肌肉。
items.ex2_en: The anxious speaker loosened up after hearing warm laughter from the audience.
items.ex2_zh: 听到观众温和的笑声后，焦急的演讲者放松了下来。

items.def_en: (informal) to thoroughly relax and stop being stressed or angry
items.ex_en: Stop stressing over minor details and just chill out for the weekend.
items.ex_zh: 别再为微不足道的细节焦虑了，周末好好彻底放松一下吧。

items.def_en: to gradually relax after a period of stress, excitement, or hard work
items.ex_en: I usually drink herbal tea and wind down before going to sleep.
items.ex_zh: 我通常会喝杯草药茶，在入睡前让自己慢慢放松下来。
items.ex2_en: The weary factory owners gradually wound down production before the upcoming winter holidays.
items.ex2_zh: 疲倦的工厂主们在即将到来的寒假前逐步缩减了生产。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to become or make someone quiet and relaxed after intense stress or anger
items.ex_en: The mediator asked both parties to calm down before resuming contract negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 调解人要求双方在恢复合同谈判之前先冷静下来。
items.ex2_en: The soothing classical melody calmed down the crying baby in a few minutes.
items.ex2_zh: 舒缓的古典旋律在几分钟内安抚了哭闹的婴儿。

items.def_en: to stop working and sit back to relax completely
items.ex_en: After finishing our final exams, we just want to kick back by the pool.
items.ex_zh: 期末考试结束后，我们只想在泳池边舒舒服服地彻底放松。

items.def_zh: 放松，舒缓身心（尤其在劳累之后）
items.def_en: to stop worrying and begin to relax after a long period of work or anxiety
items.ex_en: Taking a warm bath helps him unwind after grueling hours at the clinic.
items.ex_zh: 在诊所经历数小时的劳累之后，泡个温水澡能帮他舒缓身心。
items.ex2_en: A cup of warm herbal tea easily unwinds his tightly knotted nerves.
items.ex2_zh: 一杯温热的草药茶轻松舒缓了他紧绷的神经。

items.def_en: to calm down and relax from intensive mental pressure
items.ex_en: She spent the weekend hiking in the mountains to decompress after trial week.
items.ex_zh: 庭审周结束后，她在山中徒步度过周末以释放精神压力。

items.def_en: 1. To relax and reduce mental or physical tension and anxiety.
items.ex_en: Meditation provides a practical technique for corporate managers attempting to destress effectively.
items.ex_zh: 冥想为试图有效减压的企业管理者提供了一种实用的技巧。
items.ex2_en: A weekend at the quiet mountain spa always destresses the exhausted executives.
items.ex2_zh: 在安静的山间温泉度过周末总能缓解疲惫高管们的压力。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate letting go of physical tension, mental strain, or acute anxiety after strenuous effort or emotional pressure. 'Relax' is the neutral umbrella term, while 'destress' explicitly highlights ridding oneself of occupational or psychological stress.
groups.summary_zh: 缓解精神高压或身体紧张，由焦虑紧绷状态回归松弛平静。
groups.desc_en: Centres on deliberately letting go of mental strain, physiological stiffness, or emotional stress in order to return to a calm equilibrium, contrasting with active stimulation.
groups.desc_zh: 指主动释放精神紧绷、躯体僵硬或情绪重压，从高度应激状态逐步回复松弛平和，区别于主动刺激或劳作。
groups.nuance_en: unwind: gradually release tension and relax after demanding work (after work / nerves / mind) · decompress: let go of intense atmospheric or psychological pressure (after shift / divers / crew) · chill out: casually calm down and drop all agitation (friends / evening / weekend) · loosen up: release muscular or social inhibition and stiffness (muscles / speaker / crowd)
groups.nuance_zh: unwind: 在高强度运转后舒展神经消解疲乏 (after work / nerves / mind) · decompress: 卸下超强心理重压或进行减压适应 (after shift / divers / crew) · chill out: 惬意松弛下来、平复烦躁 (friends / evening / weekend) · loosen up: 放松肌肉筋骨或消除社交拘谨 (muscles / speaker / crowd)

groups.name: Relieve & Mitigate · 缓解与减轻 (Relieve, Moderate, Alleviate)
groups.tip: 减轻痛苦痛苦或缓和严重程度

items.def_en: [I/T] To reduce pain, worry, or tension, making something less difficult or harsh
items.ex_en: The doctor administered a mild analgesic to ease the patient's postoperative discomfort.
items.ex_zh: 医生给予了温和的镇痛药，以减轻病人术后的不适感。
items.ex2_en: The sharp pain in his injured ankle eased after several hours of rest.
items.ex2_zh: 休息了几个小时后，他受伤脚踝处的剧痛有所缓解。

items.def_zh: （使）缓和，减轻；节制；主持（讨论、会议等）
items.def_en: 1. To become less extreme, violent, or intense, or to make something so. 2. To act as a moderator or chairperson of a discussion or debate.
items.ex_en: The political faction agreed to moderate its extreme fiscal demands during compromise talks.
items.ex_zh: 该政治派别同意在妥协谈判中缓和其极端的财政诉求。
items.ex2_en: The fierce winter gale moderated considerably toward dawn, bringing much welcome relief.
items.ex2_zh: 凶猛的冬日狂风在拂晓时分大为减弱，带来了令人欣慰的宁静。

items.def_en: to gradually lessen in severity, pain, pressure, or intensity
items.ex_en: The persistent throbbing pain in my shoulder began to ease off gradually.
items.ex_zh: 我肩膀上持续不断的阵痛开始逐渐缓和下来。

items.def_en: to become less strong, severe, or intense (of pain, bad weather, or pressure)
items.ex_en: Forecasters said the torrential rain would not let up until late evening.
items.ex_zh: 气象预报员表示，这场倾盆暴雨直到深夜才会减弱。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to reduce the sharpness, unpleasantness, or intensity of a sensation or feeling
items.ex_en: Having a warm cup of soup helped take the edge off his hunger.
items.ex_zh: 喝一碗热汤有助于稍微缓解他强烈的饥饿感。

items.def_zh: 缓解，减轻（痛苦、压力等）；使宽慰；接替，换班
items.def_en: 1. To make pain, anxiety, or a difficult situation less severe. 2. To replace someone who is on duty.
items.ex_en: Applying ice to the sprained ankle helped relieve the intense throbbing swelling.
items.ex_zh: 在扭伤的脚踝上敷冰有助于缓解剧烈的跳痛与肿胀。

items.def_en: To make something bad or harmful less severe, serious, or damaging
items.ex_en: Engineers implemented floodwalls to mitigate the catastrophic impact of future storm surges.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们修建了防洪堤，以减缓未来风暴潮可能带来的灾难性影响。

items.def_en: To make suffering, deficiency, or a problem less severe
items.ex_en: The international relief charity provided clean water to alleviate severe drought conditions.
items.ex_zh: 该国际救济慈善机构提供了洁净水源，以缓解严重的旱情。

items.def_zh: 平息，缓和（恐惧、饥饿、负罪感等）
items.def_en: To make an unpleasant feeling or unsatisfied appetite less intense
items.ex_en: The company issued an unconditional apology to assuage furious public backlash.
items.ex_zh: 该公司发表了无条件道歉声明，以平息公众强烈的愤怒反弹。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe lessening the severity, intensity, or unpleasantness of pain, suffering, harsh conditions, or extreme states. While 'relieve' focuses on providing direct comfort by removing or blunting an acute distress, 'moderate' and 'mitigate' emphasize tempering or lowering the degree of an extreme condition.
groups.summary_zh: 减轻痛苦、压力或负面状态的剧烈程度，使之缓解趋于温和。
groups.desc_en: Denotes reducing the harshness, severity, or intensity of pain, grief, poverty, or conflict to make it more bearable, distinct from eradicating it completely.
groups.desc_zh: 指对痛苦、贫困、冲突或严苛状态的剧烈程度进行削减缓和，使其变得尚可忍受，区别于彻底根除或消灭。
groups.nuance_en: alleviate: make pain, poverty, or suffering less severe and more tolerable (suffering / pain / poverty) · mitigate: reduce the detrimental impact or risks of an event (disaster / risks / impact) · ease: reduce physical strain, tension, or discomfort gently (pain / burden / tension) · moderate: tone down excess or extreme positions to reasonable levels (tone / stance / demands)
groups.nuance_zh: alleviate: 减轻病痛、贫困或疾苦使其更堪忍受 (suffering / pain / poverty) · mitigate: 采取消减措施以淡化灾难或风险危害 (disaster / risks / impact) · ease: 柔和地缓解身体酸痛、负担或紧张关系 (pain / burden / tension) · moderate: 节制过激言行或降低极端要求 (tone / stance / demands)

groups.name: Relocate & Resettle · 迁居与安置 (Resettle, Relocate, Billet)
groups.tip: 移民重新落户确立合法居所

items.def_en: To assign lodging or accommodations to soldiers or personnel
items.ex_en: The commanding officer arranged to quarter the infantry division in local barracks.
items.ex_zh: 指挥官安排步兵师驻扎在当地的营房内。

items.def_en: to begin living in a new house or assigned residence
items.ex_en: They signed the tenancy agreement and prepared to move in next Saturday morning.
items.ex_zh: 他们签署了租约，并准备在下周六上午迁入新居。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to provide someone with accommodation or quarters to stay in
items.ex_en: My aunt graciously agreed to put up the visiting students for two nights.
items.ex_zh: 我姑妈慷慨地同意留宿这些来访的学生两晚。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to provide someone with the home, funds, or equipment needed to establish residence
items.ex_en: The refugee agency helped set up newly arrived families in affordable suburban apartments.
items.ex_zh: 难民署帮助新抵达的家庭在郊区经济适用公寓中安顿下来。
items.ex2_en: The young newlywed couple set up comfortably in their cozy suburban home.
items.ex2_zh: 新婚年轻夫妇在他们舒适的郊区新家里安顿了下来。

items.def_zh: 迁移，重新安置（员工、家庭、居民）
items.def_en: [I/T] To move someone or oneself to a new place to live or work
items.ex_en: The multinational corporation offered financial packages to relocate skilled staff overseas.
items.ex_zh: 这家跨国公司提供了资金补助，以将技术员工重新安置到海外。
items.ex2_en: Many retired couples relocate to warm coastal towns to escape freezing winter weather.
items.ex2_zh: 许多退休夫妇搬迁到温暖的沿海城镇，以躲避严寒的冬季。

items.def_zh: 宿营，向……派驻借宿（尤指军人）
items.def_en: (+ on/in/with) To lodge soldiers or evacuees in civilian or temporary quarters
items.ex_en: During wartime, authorities were forced to billet displaced troops in municipal schoolhouses.
items.ex_zh: 战时，当局被迫将无处安置的军队借宿驻扎在市立校舍中。

items.def_zh: （使）定居，（在法律上）确定……为正式居住地
items.def_en: (formal, usually passive) To establish someone or oneself in a permanent legal residence.
items.ex_en: For tax purposes, the investor elected to be domiciled in the island jurisdiction.
items.ex_zh: 出于税务考量，这位投资者选择将正式法定居住地确立在该岛屿管辖区。

items.def_en: To go and live in a new country or area, or to help people to do this.
items.ex_en: Humanitarian missions helped resettle hundreds of displaced families across peaceful host communities.
items.ex_zh: 人道主义特派团协助将数百个流离失所的家庭重新安置到和平的接纳社区。
items.ex2_en: Hundreds of displaced villagers resettled peacefully along the fertile riverbanks.
items.ex2_zh: 数百名流离失所的村民在肥沃的河岸边平静地定居下来。

items.def_en: To provide new, usually public or better housing for displaced people
items.ex_en: The council launched an initiative to rehouse residents displaced by urban renewal.
items.ex_zh: 市政厅发起了一项倡议，旨在为因城市更新而失去住房的居民安置新居。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this administrative/demographic frame denote the process of organizing, establishing, or assigning living quarters to people who are migrating, displaced, or serving in military roles. It emphasizes authoritative arrangement and legal residency rather than merely casual dwelling.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及官方或机构对流动、受灾或流离失所人群进行安置与落户。
groups.desc_en: Denotes establishing a new permanent or temporary residence, moving beyond simple transit to emphasize formal administrative housing, displacement, or domestic installation.
groups.desc_zh: 指确立新的长期或临时居所，超越单纯的位移，侧重行政安置、被迫迁徙或安顿起居的组织化过程。
groups.nuance_en: relocate: formal transfer of residence or operations (headquarters / staff / family) · resettle: institutional relocation of displaced populations (refugees / evacuees / migrants) · billet: compulsory or official lodging of military personnel (troops / soldiers / recruits) · quarter: formal housing in assigned lodgings (garrison / troops / officers) · put up: temporary hospitable lodging of guests (visitor / friend / relative)
groups.nuance_zh: relocate: 正式的工作或居住地迁移 (headquarters / staff / family) · resettle: 针对流离失所群体的制度化安置 (refugees / evacuees / migrants) · billet: 官方为军人安排民房宿营 (troops / soldiers / recruits) · quarter: 正式配给驻地或营房 (garrison / troops / officers) · put up: 提供临时的留宿接纳 (visitor / friend / relative)

groups.name: Remain Alive & Endure · 生存与存活 (Live, Survive, Subsist)
groups.tip: 生命延续与艰难求生

items.def_zh: 活着，生存；居住；度过（某种生活）
items.def_en: 1. To be alive or remain alive. 2. To have one's home in a particular place. 3. To spend or pass one's life in a particular way.
items.ex_en: Centenarians who live past a hundred often maintain active social lifestyles.
items.ex_zh: 活过百岁的人瑞往往保持着积极活跃的社交生活方式。

items.def_zh: 幸存，存活；熬过，经受住；比……活得长
items.def_en: 1. To continue to live or exist, especially after a dangerous event or hardship. 2. To live longer than someone else.
items.ex_en: Remarkably, three passengers managed to survive the catastrophic plane crash intact.
items.ex_zh: 令人称奇的是，竟有三名乘客在灾难性的坠机事故中安然幸存。

items.def_en: (+ on/with) to manage to live or cope with difficulty using limited means
items.ex_en: The impoverished student struggled to get by on meager weekly scholarship stipends.
items.ex_zh: 这名贫困学生靠着微薄的每周奖学金津贴艰难地勉强过活。

items.def_zh: 渡过难关；自重病重伤中生还
items.def_en: [I/T] to recover from a serious illness or survive a life-threatening crisis
items.ex_en: The doctors were amazed that the patient pulled through after such severe injuries.
items.ex_zh: 医生们对患者受了如此重伤后仍能挺过来感到惊奇。

items.def_zh: 勉强维持生计，艰难度日
items.def_en: manage to survive or live on very little money or resources
items.ex_en: After losing his main job, he could barely scrape by on freelance gigs.
items.ex_zh: 失去全职工作后，他仅靠打零工勉强维持生计。

items.def_en: manage to survive or continue with what is available, despite it not being ideal
items.ex_en: We lacked real camping gear, but we managed to make do with blankets.
items.ex_zh: 我们缺少正规的露营装备，但凑合着用毛毯应付了过去。

items.def_en: continue to survive or hold out in difficult or dangerous conditions
items.ex_en: Hang on a second, let me grab a pen to write that down.
items.ex_zh: 稍等一下，我拿支笔把它记下来。

items.def_en: to remain alive after the death of someone else or after something ceases
items.ex_en: The elderly woman managed to outlive both her husband and her younger siblings.
items.ex_zh: 这位老妇人的寿命比她的丈夫和弟弟妹妹都要长。

items.def_zh: 靠微薄资源勉强维持生存
items.def_en: (+ on) to manage to stay alive with minimal food or money
items.ex_en: Displaced villagers were forced to subsist on wild roots and contaminated river water.
items.ex_zh: 流离失所的村民被迫靠野草根和受污染的河水勉强维生。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the fundamental biological or economic state of maintaining life, ranging from ordinary existence to enduring extreme perils or scraping by on minimal resources.
groups.summary_zh: 表示维持生命或存活，涵盖日常存在、度过险境及勉强糊口。
groups.desc_en: Covers continuing biological or economic existence against mortality, hardship, or exhaustion, shifting from mere living to endurance under acute constraint.
groups.desc_zh: 指在死亡、困境或资源匮乏下维系生命或生计，从单纯的“活着”聚焦于极端逆境中的坚挺与残存。
groups.nuance_en: survive: outlasting life-threatening peril or trauma (crash / cancer / ordeal) · pull through: recovering from critical illness or near-fatal danger (surgery / coma / crisis) · subsist: maintaining bare physical survival on minimal sustenance (pittance / rations / wage) · get by: coping adequately despite financial or material shortfall (salary / meager means) · scrape by: barely surviving on extreme margins of income (pennies / minimum wage) · outlive: surviving beyond another person or lifespan (spouse / peers / usefulness)
groups.nuance_zh: survive: 历经致命危险或创伤后幸存 (crash / cancer / ordeal) · pull through: 从危重伤病中脱险康复 (surgery / coma / crisis) · subsist: 仅靠最低生存资料勉强糊口 (pittance / rations / wage) · get by: 虽资源拮据仍能应付度日 (salary / meager means) · scrape by: 在赤贫边缘极其艰难地维生 (pennies / minimum wage) · outlive: 比他人长寿或比事物存在更久 (spouse / peers / usefulness)

groups.name: Remember & Recall · 记忆与回忆 (Remember, Retain, Recollect)
groups.tip: 信息存入脑海与重现

items.def_en: to retain in memory or spontaneously bring back into one's mind a fact, person, or event
items.ex_en: I suddenly remembered that I had left my car keys on the counter.
items.ex_zh: 我猛然记起自己把车钥匙落在了柜台上。

items.def_zh: 回忆起，回想起；召回，收回
items.def_en: 1. To bring a fact, event, or situation back into one's mind; to remember. 2. To officially order someone to return, or ask for defective goods to be returned.
items.ex_en: The witness could not clearly recall the exact sequence of events that evening.
items.ex_zh: 目击者无法清晰地回忆起那天晚上的确切事发经过。

items.def_zh: 记住，保留（记忆中的信息）
items.def_en: to keep facts, figures, or information securely in one's mind over time
items.ex_en: Brilliant students often retain complex scientific formulas effortlessly for many years.
items.ex_zh: 优秀的学生往往能在多年间毫不费力地记住复杂的科学公式。

items.def_en: (+ on/at sth) think about or reflect on something that happened in the past
items.ex_en: Looking back on his college years, he realized how naive he had been.
items.ex_zh: 回想起自己的大学岁月，他意识到当时的自己是多么幼稚。

items.def_en: (+ to sth) actively direct one's thoughts to an earlier time or event
items.ex_en: Thinking back to my early days in the industry, I made so many mistakes.
items.ex_zh: 回想起我刚入行时的那些日子，我犯过很多错误。

items.def_en: (+ sth) bring a fact or past experience back into conscious thought
items.ex_en: The distant melody called to mind long-forgotten summers spent beside the quiet sea.
items.ex_zh: 那遥远的旋律使人忆起在宁静海边度过的早已遗忘的夏日。

items.def_en: To learn something so thoroughly that you can remember it exactly.
items.ex_en: The young actor stayed up late to memorize all his lines perfectly.
items.ex_zh: 那位年轻演员熬夜将所有的台词背得滚瓜烂熟。

items.def_en: (+ about) to indulge in enjoyable recollection of past events
items.ex_en: The elderly comrades gathered to reminisce about their shared hardships during wartime.
items.ex_zh: 老战友们聚在一起，深情追忆战火岁月中共同经历的艰难困苦。

items.def_zh: 回想，忆起（通常需努力思索）
items.def_en: to bring something from the past back to mind, often with conscious mental effort
items.ex_en: The aged professor paused to recollect the obscure name of his former pupil.
items.ex_zh: 老教授停顿了一下，努力回想那个昔日门生的生僻名字。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame encompass committing facts to memory, holding information across time, and actively retrieving past experiences or stored knowledge back into conscious awareness.
groups.summary_zh: 指有意识地背诵记忆信息，或在脑海中重新调取并重温过去的经历与知识。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on the cognitive storage, mental persistence, and deliberate retrieval of past information, distinct from spontaneous imagination or present perception.
groups.desc_zh: 指过去信息在大脑中的储存、保持及主观调取，区别于自发的当下想象或感官知觉。
groups.nuance_en: remember: general cognitive retention or timely recall (name / appointment / detail) · retain: keeping information or knowledge securely in memory (facts / vocabulary / data) · recall: deliberate retrieval of specific stored facts (incident / conversation / figure) · memorize: intentional encoding for verbatim mastery (lines / poem / formula) · reminisce: sentimental, enjoyable sharing of past experiences (youth / past / old days)
groups.nuance_zh: remember: 最基础的记起或未遗忘 (name / appointment / detail) · retain: 长久保持并记住知识信息 (facts / vocabulary / data) · recall: 有意识地精准调取过去细节 (incident / conversation / figure) · memorize: 刻意背诵以达到熟记 (lines / poem / formula) · reminisce: 带着温情惬意地追忆往昔 (youth / past / old days)

groups.name: Repair & Revamp · 修缮与改造 (Overhaul, Refit, Revamp)
groups.tip: 修复破损缺陷，令旧物焕发新生

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) make an area, building, or object look cleaner, neater, and more attractive
items.ex_en: They applied fresh paint to spruce up the dingy lobby before guests arrived.
items.ex_zh: 在客人到来之前，他们刷上新漆把昏暗的大厅收拾得焕然一新。

items.def_zh: 翻新，修缮，修整（旧房或旧物）
items.def_en: (+ sth) repair, paint, and modernize an old building, room, or vehicle
items.ex_en: The couple bought an abandoned cottage intending to do it up completely.
items.ex_zh: 这对夫妇买下了一栋废弃的农舍，打算将其彻底翻新一番。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) supply or equip someone or something with all the necessary gear or modern fittings
items.ex_en: They spent thousands of dollars to kit out the basement as a studio.
items.ex_zh: 他们花了好几千美元将地下室改装并配齐了录音室的所有设备。

items.def_zh: 全面翻修，改版，翻新；修补
items.def_en: To reorganize, repair, or redesign something thoroughly so as to improve its appearance or functioning.
items.ex_en: The software company decided to revamp its outdated interface for new users.
items.ex_zh: 这家软件公司决定彻底改版其过时的界面，以吸引新用户。

items.def_en: alter the structure, style, or form of a building, room, or object
items.ex_en: The architect planned to remodel the old kitchen into an airy living space.
items.ex_zh: 建筑师计划改造旧厨房，将其变成宽敞通风的起居空间。

items.def_en: adapt or update equipment or facilities to meet current standards
items.ex_en: The local hospital secured funding to modernize its aging intensive care facilities.
items.ex_zh: 当地医院获得了资金，用以更新其陈旧的重症监护设施。
items.ex2_en: The ancient port city modernized rapidly following major foreign trade agreements.
items.ex2_zh: 在达成重大对外贸易协定后，这座古老的港口城市迅速实现了现代化。

items.def_zh: 整修，改装，翻新（船只、车辆或机器）
items.def_en: To repair, clean, and equip a ship, building, or machine with new parts or fittings.
items.ex_en: The navy sent the damaged patrol vessel to the shipyard to refit.
items.ex_zh: 海军将受损的巡逻艇送往造船厂进行整修并更换设备。

items.def_zh: 检修，修复，翻新（机器、设备等）
items.def_en: To repair, clean, and replace worn parts in a used engine, appliance, or vehicle so that it operates like new.
items.ex_en: Skilled mechanics were hired to recondition the vintage engine for public display.
items.ex_zh: 技术熟练的机械师受雇翻新这台老式发动机以供公开展出。

items.def_en: take apart a machine or system thoroughly to inspect, repair, and restore it
items.ex_en: Technicians will completely overhaul the aircraft engine before granting safety clearance.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员将在核准安全许可前对飞机引擎进行彻底检修。

groups.summary_en: Agents upgrade, overhaul, or modernize existing systems, ships, buildings, or mechanisms to restore functionality or enhance performance.
groups.summary_zh: 对设施、船只或机械进行全面翻新、检修与现代化改装升级。
groups.desc_en: Denotes restoring, upgrading, or transforming existing physical spaces or equipment, contrasting with initial construction or superficial cleaning.
groups.desc_zh: 指对既有空间、设施或设备进行修复、翻新或结构性升级，区别于从零建造或单纯的保洁打扫。
groups.nuance_en: revamp: comprehensive structural overhaul to modernize appeal (system / image / website) · refit: technical repair and re-equipping of vessels or industrial facilities (ship / plant / fleet) · remodel: changing the physical layout or architecture (kitchen / basement / interior) · recondition: restoring machinery to prime functional order (engine / equipment / vehicle) · spruce up: quick aesthetic tidying or cosmetic freshening (room / appearance / garden)
groups.nuance_zh: revamp: 全面翻新改造以展现现代新貌 (system / image / website) · refit: 对船舶或工业设施进行改装整修 (ship / plant / fleet) · remodel: 改变建筑或房间的结构布局 (kitchen / basement / interior) · recondition: 将机械设备检修并恢复至良好性能 (engine / equipment / vehicle) · spruce up: 快速的局部修饰与整饰美化 (room / appearance / garden)

groups.name: Repay & Settle Debt · 偿还与退款补偿 (Repay, Refund, Reimburse)
groups.tip: 退回款项或弥补欠款

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) return money that you borrowed from someone
items.ex_en: He promised to pay back every cent of the money he had borrowed.
items.ex_zh: 他承诺会一分不差地还清之前借的所有钱。

items.def_en: (+ sth) finish paying all the money that you owe on a loan, mortgage, or debt
items.ex_en: After thirty grueling years, they finally managed to pay off their home mortgage.
items.ex_zh: 经过艰苦的三十年，他们终于还清了房屋抵押贷款。

items.def_en: (+ with sb) pay someone the money that you owe them, settling an account
items.ex_en: If you pay for the groceries now, we can settle up when we get home.
items.ex_zh: 要是你现在先付食材的钱，我们到家后再结清。

items.def_en: 1. To give someone their money back, especially because they have returned goods or are dissatisfied with a service.
items.ex_en: The store agreed to refund the total purchase price for the damaged item.
items.ex_zh: 商店同意为这件受损的商品全额退款。

items.def_en: (+ for) to pay someone an appropriate sum of money to make up for loss, damage, or work done
items.ex_en: The negligent contractor must compensate the family for the severe structural damage caused.
items.ex_zh: 疏忽的承包商必须就所造成的严重结构性损坏对该家庭作出赔偿。

items.def_zh: 偿还，付清（借款）；报答，回报
items.def_en: 1. To pay back money that you have borrowed. 2. (+ with/for) To do or give something good in return for a favor, help, or kindness.
items.ex_en: She swore that she would repay his profound kindness with unwavering loyalty.
items.ex_zh: 她发誓要以坚定的忠诚来回报他深厚的恩情。

items.def_zh: 报销，偿还（垫付的款项）；补偿，赔付
items.def_en: 1. (+ for) To pay back money to someone that they have spent on your behalf or lost through official business.
items.ex_en: The firm will reimburse traveling employees for all legitimate meal and hotel expenses.
items.ex_zh: 公司将为出差员工报销所有合理的餐饮和住宿费用。

items.def_en: [I/T] to send money in payment for goods, services, or debt, typically by post or electronic transfer
items.ex_en: Please remit the balance due within thirty days to avoid additional penalties.
items.ex_zh: 请在三十天内汇出到期未结款项，以免产生额外罚金。

items.def_en: (+ against/for) to compensate someone for loss or damage through a formal or legal agreement
items.ex_en: The insurer pledged to indemnify the policyholder against unforeseen property losses.
items.ex_zh: 保险公司承诺赔偿投保人遭受的不可预见财产损失。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this institutional and contractual financial frame denote returning money or equivalent value to a recipient, distinguishing between returning purchase costs (refund), settling borrowed debt (repay), and covering expenses fronted by an individual (reimburse).
groups.summary_zh: 商业与法律契约下返还款项，细分退还购货款、结清债务及报销垫付款。
groups.desc_en: Centers on restoring financial equilibrium by returning borrowed funds, compensating incurred expenses, or satisfying debts, contrasting with one-way giving or buying.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重于通过归还借款、报销开支或清偿债务来恢复财务平衡，区别于单向的赠予、投资或常规购买。
groups.nuance_en: repay: returning borrowed money or fulfilling long-term debt (loan / debt / mortgage) · reimburse: paying back out-of-pocket expenses incurred on business (expenses / traveler / mileage) · refund: returning money paid for unsatisfactory goods or canceled services (customer / ticket / deposit) · compensate: making financial amends for loss, damage, or injury (victim / worker / loss) · settle up: clearing mutual or shared accounts in full (bill / tab / partner)
groups.nuance_zh: repay: 偿还借款或清偿长期借贷 (loan / debt / mortgage) · reimburse: 报销公务垫付的实际费用 (expenses / traveler / mileage) · refund: 退还未消费或不合格商品款项 (customer / ticket / deposit) · compensate: 对损失、伤害进行经济补偿或赔偿 (victim / worker / loss) · settle up: 算清并结清互负账目 (bill / tab / partner)

groups.name: Repel & Expel · 击退与驱逐 (Repulse, Expel, Ward off)
groups.tip: 将敌对力量挡回驱除

items.def_en: to prevent someone or something unpleasant or hostile from affecting or approaching you
items.ex_en: She drank warm lemon tea with honey to ward off an incoming cold.
items.ex_zh: 她喝了蜂蜜温柠檬水，以防感冒侵袭。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) forcefully repel an advancing enemy or attacker
items.ex_en: Defenders fired relentlessly to beat back repeated enemy charges against the fortress gates.
items.ex_zh: 守军不断猛烈开火，打退了敌人对要塞大门的接连冲锋。

items.def_en: to force an advancing enemy force to retreat through defensive violence
items.ex_en: The allied troops managed to drive back the enemy vanguard.
items.ex_zh: 盟军部队成功击退了敌方先头部队。

items.def_en: to defend oneself against an attacker or physical attack by thrusting them back
items.ex_en: He raised his thick wooden cane to fend off the aggressive stray dogs.
items.ex_zh: 他举起粗木手杖，挡开了那几只极具攻击性的流浪狗。

items.def_zh: 击退，奋力抵抗（袭击或感染）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) defend oneself against and successfully repel an attacker or illness
items.ex_en: Her exhausted immune system struggled desperately to fight off the aggressive bacterial infection.
items.ex_zh: 她疲惫不堪的免疫系统在奋力抵抗来势汹汹的细菌感染。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) prevent an enemy, attacker, or competitor from advancing or defeating you
items.ex_en: Our tired squad barely managed to hold off the attacking rival team.
items.ex_zh: 我们疲倦的队伍勉强抵挡住了进攻的竞争对手。

items.def_en: to forcefully and authoritatively expel an unwanted or evil presence from a person or group
items.ex_en: The ancient holy priest invoked sacred rites to cast out the lurking demon.
items.ex_zh: 年迈的圣祭司举行神圣仪式，将潜伏的恶灵彻底逐出。

items.def_zh: 击退，打退；使厌恶，使反感；拒绝
items.def_en: 1. to drive back an attacking enemy by force. 2. to cause strong feelings of disgust or aversion. 3. to reject an offer or approach coldly.
items.ex_en: The reinforced garrison managed to repulse the frontal assault with heavy artillery fire.
items.ex_zh: 增援的守备部队借助重炮火力成功击退了正面的猛烈攻势。

items.def_zh: 驱除（恶魔、邪念），驱邪；消除（痛苦回忆等）
items.def_en: to drive out an evil spirit by prayers or religious rituals; to free oneself from an unpleasant memory or feeling
items.ex_en: The venerable bishop was summoned to exorcise the malevolent spirit from the house.
items.ex_zh: 德高望重的主教受召前来，为宅邸驱除潜藏的恶灵邪崇。

groups.summary_en: An agent forcefully drives an intruding, hostile, or malignant entity (enemy troops, supernatural spirits, attackers) away from a protected space or physical host.
groups.summary_zh: 指运用力量、法术或戒备将敌方、入侵者或恶灵从所据领地或寄宿体内击退排挤出去。
groups.desc_en: Depicts driving an approaching threat, enemy, or unwanted element backward by force or deterrence, contrasting with passive containment or fleeing.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过武力或威慑将逼近的敌人、威胁或不洁之物向后击退或逐出，区别于被动包容或退避逃跑。
groups.nuance_en: repulse: forcefully driving back an armed assault or disgustingly rejecting (attack / advance / invasion) · fend off: deflecting a direct physical attack or critical scrutiny (blow / attacker / criticism) · ward off: taking anticipatory measures to keep harm or disease away (evil / danger / infection) · beat back: vigorously and repeatedly pushing back an advancing force (flames / crowd / enemy) · cast out: formally and utterly expelling from a group or state (demon / heretic / exile)
groups.nuance_zh: repulse: 强力击溃武装进攻或令人厌恶地严拒 (attack / advance / invasion) · fend off: 挡开正面攻击或招架诘难质问 (blow / attacker / criticism) · ward off: 采取预防措施避开厄运、病痛或危险 (evil / danger / infection) · beat back: 奋力且反复地打退推进的攻势 (flames / crowd / enemy) · cast out: 正式且彻底地驱逐、驱除 (demon / heretic / exile)

groups.name: Rescue & Deliver · 救援与解脱 (Rescue, Deliver, Extricate)
groups.tip: 解除束缚重获自由

items.def_zh: 释放，解放；使解脱，使摆脱
items.def_en: To release someone or something from custody, confinement, or restraint; to relieve of a burden or obligation.
items.ex_en: The judge declared that authorities must free the wrongly detained suspect immediately.
items.ex_zh: 法官裁定，当局必须立即释放被错误拘留的嫌疑人。

items.def_zh: 拯救，挽救，救助；节省，节约；积攒，储蓄；保存（数据）
items.def_en: 1. To rescue or protect someone or something from danger, harm, or death. 2. To avoid spending or using up money, time, or energy. 3. (computing) To store computer data to a storage medium.
items.ex_en: Heaven alone could save the doomed city from the wrath of impending doom.
items.ex_zh: 唯有上苍才能拯救这座注定毁灭的城市免遭浩劫之怒。

items.def_zh: 解救；拯救（免受苦难或邪恶）
items.def_en: (+ from) to save someone from evil, suffering, or captivity (often formal or literary)
items.ex_en: The devout worshippers prayed that the Almighty would deliver them from mortal danger.
items.ex_zh: 虔诚的信徒们祈祷全能的主能将他们从致命危险中解救出来。

items.def_en: to save someone or something from danger, harm, captivity, or death
items.ex_en: Coast guard officers arrived just in time to rescue the stranded sailors.
items.ex_zh: 海岸警卫队人员及时赶到，营救了那些被困的水手。

items.def_en: to rescue someone or an organization from a serious financial or operational predicament
items.ex_en: The central government intervened with emergency cash to bail out the failing bank.
items.ex_zh: 中央政府介入并提供紧急救助资金，帮助濒临破产的银行摆脱困境。

items.def_zh: 打捞出，救出（水中或险境中之人或物）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) pull someone or something out of water or another dangerous confined place
items.ex_en: He managed to fish out the terrified puppy from the deep sewage ditch.
items.ex_zh: 他设法从深不见底的排污沟里将吓坏的小狗给捞了出来。

items.def_zh: 挖出，从废墟/积雪中营救出
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) rescue someone trapped under rubble, earth, or snow by excavating
items.ex_en: I dug out an old photo album from the attic.
items.ex_zh: 我从阁楼里翻出了一本旧相册。

items.def_en: (+ sb) assist someone in dealing with a difficult task or emergency situation
items.ex_en: Could you help out with the dishes while I prepare dinner?
items.ex_zh: 我做晚饭的时候你能帮忙洗下碗吗？

items.def_en: to free someone from a difficult, entangling, or trapped physical situation
items.ex_en: Paramedics worked tirelessly for two hours to extricate the driver from the wreckage.
items.ex_zh: 急救人员不知疲倦地工作了两小时，才将司机从汽车残骸中解救出来。

groups.summary_en: An agent pulls someone or something out of imminent peril, harm, capture, or oppressive conditions to bring them to safety and liberty. Register varies from everyday safety interventions to dramatic physical liberation.
groups.summary_zh: 将处于险境、囚禁或痛苦状态中的人或事物解救并恢复安全自由。
groups.desc_en: Involves liberating a subject from mortal peril, physical entrapment, or catastrophic financial collapse, contrasting with minor assistance or preventive care.
groups.desc_zh: 指将目标从致命危险、物理受困或灾难性破产中解救出来，区别于轻度的随手帮忙或日常照料。
groups.nuance_en: rescue: direct, urgent extraction from active physical peril (hostage / survivor / hiker) · deliver: formal or spiritual liberation from captivity, oppression, or evil (captive / soul / people) · bail out: financial rescue from imminent collapse or bankruptcy (bank / industry / government) · extricate: disentangling someone from complex physical or social traps (driver / oneself / entanglement) · dig out: laborious physical removal from debris or snow (avalanche victim / rubble / car)
groups.nuance_zh: rescue: 紧急奔赴现场并实施直接救拔 (hostage / survivor / hiker) · deliver: 庄重或宗教意义上的拯救解脱 (captive / soul / people) · bail out: 实施注资以拯救濒危破产实体 (bank / industry / government) · extricate: 将某人从物理困局或棘手纠葛中解脱 (driver / oneself / entanglement) · dig out: 费力从积雪、废墟中刨出挖出 (avalanche victim / rubble / car)

groups.name: Resist & Withstand · 抵抗与坚守 (Endure or Hold Out Against Adverse Force)
groups.tip: 顶住冲击承受攻击不退缩

items.def_en: [I/T] to use force or willpower to fight back against someone or keep something from happening
items.ex_en: The brave villagers gathered to resist the hostile takeover of their communal farmland.
items.ex_zh: 勇敢的村民聚集在一起，抵制外部势力对自己公有农田的恶意兼并。

items.def_en: maintain a firm, unyielding stance in the face of adversity or confrontation
items.ex_en: Despite aggressive pressure from the press, the manager told his players to hang tough.
items.ex_zh: 尽管媒体步步紧逼，主教练还是告诫队员们要咬牙硬挺到底。

items.def_en: remain firmly anchored or committed without giving way under external force
items.ex_en: Amid the howling tempest, the courageous captain urged his crew to hold fast.
items.ex_zh: 在咆哮的暴风雨中，英勇的船长敦促船员们紧抓不放、坚守阵地。

items.def_en: to continue to resist an enemy or endure difficult conditions without giving in
items.ex_en: The besieged soldiers managed to hold out until fresh reinforcements finally reached them.
items.ex_zh: 被围困的士兵们顽强坚守，直到急援部队最终赶到。

items.def_en: refuse to yield, retreat, or change one's position against heavy pressure or attack
items.ex_en: The foreign minister promised to stand firm against unreasonable unilateral economic sanctions.
items.ex_zh: 外交部长承诺绝不退缩，坚决抵制不合理的一边倒经济制裁。

items.def_zh: 勇敢抵抗，顶住（压力/对手）
items.def_en: to resist someone or something boldly and resolutely without fear
items.ex_en: These materials are designed to stand up to extreme weather conditions.
items.ex_zh: 这些材料旨在经受住极端天气的考验。

items.def_en: to come safely through a storm, difficult period, or severe trial
items.ex_en: The resilient small business managed to weather the severe downturn without firing staff.
items.ex_zh: 这家富有韧性的小企业经受住了严重衰退的考验，没有解雇任何员工。

items.def_zh: 经受，承受，顶住（withstand的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of withstand; resisted or endured successfully.
items.ex_en: The ancient stone bridge withstood the violent torrents caused by the relentless monsoon.
items.ex_zh: 那座古石桥顶住了由连绵季风引发的狂暴山洪。

items.def_en: To resist, endure, or hold out successfully against force, pressure, or hardship without giving way.
items.ex_en: Engineers designed the offshore platform to withstand the destructive force of massive hurricanes.
items.ex_zh: 工程师设计了该离岸平台，使其能够经受住特大飓风的毁灭性冲击。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers enduring pressure, physical wear, or hostile assault without yielding or breaking, progressing from passive resilience to active, immovable resistance.
groups.summary_zh: 承受外部压力、击打或恶劣环境而不屈服，体现韧性到强硬坚守的强度递进。
groups.desc_en: Involves maintaining an unyielding defensive posture against sustained physical pressure, coercion, or natural forces, contrasting with active aggression or submission.
groups.desc_zh: 指在持续的物理冲击、外在胁迫或自然侵蚀下坚守阵线、拒不妥协，区别于主动进攻或屈服溃退。
groups.nuance_en: resist: actively opposing pressure, temptation, or authority (arrest / temptation / invasion) · withstand: tolerating severe stress or impact without collapsing (strain / pressure / test) · weather: enduring and surviving a turbulent trial or storm (crisis / scandal / storm) · stand up to: courageously defying a dominant or bullying opponent (bully / regime / tyrant) · hold out: maintaining a defensive perimeter until relief arrives (troops / defenders / supply)
groups.nuance_zh: resist: 主动抵御诱惑、压迫或抗拒权威 (arrest / temptation / invasion) · withstand: 经受住高压、冲击而未破损损坏 (strain / pressure / test) · weather: 安然度过动荡风波或恶劣危机 (crisis / scandal / storm) · stand up to: 勇敢挺身对抗强势霸凌者 (bully / regime / tyrant) · hold out: 孤军坚守据点等待转机或援军 (troops / defenders / supply)

groups.name: Rest & Idle · 休息与闲卧 (Laze, Repose, Lounge)
groups.tip: 卧床歇息静养恢复体能

items.def_en: (informal) relax completely, doing nothing mentally demanding like watching TV
items.ex_en: On quiet Sunday afternoons, I just want to veg out watching comedy series.
items.ex_zh: 在静谧的周日下午，我只想彻底放空、看看情景喜剧。

items.def_zh: 闲逛，闲散度日，懒散地待着
items.def_en: spend time relaxing lazily and doing very little
items.ex_en: Teenagers love to lounge around the shopping mall during warm summer vacation afternoons.
items.ex_zh: 青少年度假时很喜欢在温暖的夏日下午聚在商场里闲散打发时间。

items.def_en: spend time in an idle, unproductive, and relaxed way
items.ex_en: Instead of seeking employment, he preferred to laff around his parents' messy garage.
items.ex_zh: 他不但不去找工作，反而情愿在他父母杂乱的车库里游手好闲。

items.def_en: relax completely instead of feeling anxious or expending physical energy
items.ex_en: You need to chill out and stop obsessing over minor travel plan details.
items.ex_zh: 你得彻底放松一下，别再死盯着那些无足轻重的旅行细节不放了。

items.def_en: lie, sit, or stand in a relaxed, lazy, or indolent way
items.ex_en: Several tired tourists lounged near the hotel pool under wide striped umbrellas.
items.ex_zh: 几名疲惫的游客懒散地斜靠在旅馆泳池边的宽大条纹阳伞下。

items.def_en: idle away time; spend time doing little or nothing productive
items.ex_en: He did nothing but loaf on the sofa all weekend, ignoring all chores.
items.ex_zh: 整个周末他就只是在沙发上游手好闲，所有家务事一概不管。

items.def_en: sit, stand, or move with a drooping, lazy posture
items.ex_en: The bored student slouched deeply in his wooden chair throughout the lecture.
items.ex_zh: 那个无聊的学生整堂讲座都没精打采地瘫坐在木头椅子里。

items.def_zh: 静卧，休息，长眠；寄托（信任、希望等）于
items.def_en: 1. to rest, sleep, or lie peaceful in a particular place. 2. ('repose in') to place trust, hope, or confidence in someone or something.
items.ex_en: The tired wanderer sought a quiet woodland meadow to repose under the shade.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的旅人寻得一处静谧的林间草地，在树荫下静卧休憩。

items.def_zh: 闲逛，闲散，懒散度日；消磨（时光）
items.def_en: 1. (+ around/about) to spend time relaxing and doing very little. 2. to spend time in a lazy way.
items.ex_en: During the holidays, we would laze on the sunny beach all morning long.
items.ex_zh: 假期里，我们整个上午都会在阳光明媚的海滩上慵懒地闲散度过。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe being physically at rest, either reclining quietly to recover energy or lounging idly without purpose or ambition.
groups.summary_zh: 指身体静止放松、安歇小憩或无所事事地闲躺闲卧。
groups.desc_en: Denotes passive, physically relaxed inactivity, ranging from tranquil recuperation to inert, unproductive sluggishness, contrasting with purposeful work or sleep.
groups.desc_zh: 指身体放松、不事劳作的停歇状态，涵括从从容静养到虚掷光阴的懒散瘫坐，区别于有目的的工作或纯粹入睡。
groups.nuance_en: repose: dignified, peaceful, and restorative rest (body / soul / mind) · lounge: relaxing in a lazy, indolent, sprawling posture (couch / poolside / lobby) · veg out: completely passive, brainless relaxation (front of TV / weekend / afternoon) · loaf: idling away time unproductive and evasively (day / afternoon / work) · chill out: deliberately winding down to dispel stress (friends / music / weekend)
groups.nuance_zh: repose: 优雅安详、恢复精力的静卧休憩 (body / soul / mind) · lounge: 懒洋洋、姿态散漫地倚躺闲坐 (couch / poolside / lobby) · veg out: 大脑完全放空、瘫软不动的无脑休整 (front of TV / weekend / afternoon) · loaf: 游手好闲、逃避正事的虚掷光阴 (day / afternoon / work) · chill out: 舒缓紧绷神经的主动放松 (friends / music / weekend)

groups.name: Retaliate & Avenge · 报复与复仇 (Inflict Harm in Return for a Wrong)
groups.tip: 受到伤害后实施回击报复

items.def_zh: 替……报仇，报复；（为……）洗雪（仇恨）
items.def_en: To inflict punishment or injury in return for a wrong done to oneself or others; to avenge.
items.ex_en: The exiled prince swore a solemn oath to revenge the murder of his father.
items.ex_zh: 流亡的王子庄严起誓，必将为惨遭杀害的父亲洗雪血海深仇。

items.def_en: to retaliate against criticism, an attack, or an opponent
items.ex_en: The prime minister wasted no time and decided to hit back at his critics.
items.ex_zh: 首相毫不拖延，当即决定对批评他的人予以猛烈回击。

items.def_en: to attack someone who has harmed or attacked you
items.ex_en: The company struck back at its competitors by slashing prices across the board.
items.ex_zh: 该企业通过全线大幅降价对竞争对手发起了回击。

items.def_en: (+ sb) punish someone or take revenge on them for bad treatment or injury
items.ex_en: She vowed that she would pay back the cruel betrayers for their deceit.
items.ex_zh: 她发誓一定要严惩那些背信弃义的骗子，报复他们的欺诈行径。

items.def_en: (+ sb) retaliate against someone who has caused you harm or embarrassment
items.ex_en: He swore he would get back at them for ruining his reputation.
items.ex_zh: 他发誓一定要报复他们败坏自己声誉的行为。

items.def_en: (+ with sb) inflict harm or take revenge on someone so that an injury is repaid equally
items.ex_en: He waited patiently for months just to get even with his dishonest business partner.
items.ex_zh: 他耐心地等了好几个月，只为了能报复那个奸诈的合伙人、扯平旧账。

items.def_en: To punish or harm someone in return for an injury or wrong done to oneself or others.
items.ex_en: The prince swore an oath to avenge his fallen father on the battlefield.
items.ex_zh: 王子立下重誓，要在战场上为阵亡的父亲报仇雪恨。

items.def_zh: 反击，报复（以同等行动回敬）
items.def_en: (+ against/by) to make an attack or assault in return for a similar attack
items.ex_en: The military vowed to retaliate against the hostile regime by launching targeted airstrikes.
items.ex_zh: 军方誓言要通过发动定点空袭，对敌对政权实施反击。

items.def_zh: 以同样方式回应（恩怨等）
items.def_en: [I/T] to respond to an action or hostile gesture with a corresponding one
items.ex_en: If provoked again, our nation is fully prepared to reciprocate every aggressive provocation.
items.ex_zh: 若再遭挑衅，我方完全准备好对每一次侵略行径做出同等回应。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on striking back against an aggressor or wrongdoer. Verbs range from broad defensive retaliation to personal, justice-seeking retribution.
groups.summary_zh: 针对侵害采取反击或施加惩戒，涵盖战术还击到道德或个人情感复仇。
groups.desc_en: Centers on inflicting reciprocal harm, penalty, or counter-attack in response to a perceived grievance, contrasting with passive acceptance, forgiveness, or judicial punishment.
groups.desc_zh: 指因遭受侵害而向对方施加对等的伤害、打击或反制，区别于逆来顺受、宽恕原谅或合法的司法审判。
groups.nuance_en: retaliate: launching an overt counter-attack against aggression (strikes / sanctions / raid) · avenge: exacting righteous retribution on behalf of another or a cause (murder / death / defeat) · revenge: vindictive, personal payback fueled by spite (insult / betrayal / slight) · strike back: reacting forcefully and immediately to an offensive (competitor / critic / enemy) · get even: settling personal scores to eliminate a perceived imbalance (rival / score / tormentor)
groups.nuance_zh: retaliate: 针对遭受的攻击实施明确反击或报复 (strikes / sanctions / raid) · avenge: 替受害者伸张正义雪耻惩凶 (murder / death / defeat) · revenge: 掺杂个人私怨的报仇解恨 (insult / betrayal / slight) · strike back: 遭受打击后迅速坚决地还击 (competitor / critic / enemy) · get even: 扯平私人恩怨、找回场子 (rival / score / tormentor)

groups.name: Retreat & Evacuate · 撤退与疏散 (Retreat, Evacuate, Withdraw)
groups.tip: 面临威胁向后退走

items.def_en: To move back or away from a place, danger, or an enemy; to change your mind or back down from a position.
items.ex_en: Facing overwhelming enemy artillery, the commander ordered his troops to retreat into the valley.
items.ex_zh: 面对敌军压倒性的炮火，指挥官命令部队撤回山谷。

items.def_en: to move back toward rear defenses, especially when forced by enemy pressure
items.ex_en: The troops were ordered to fall back to fortified positions.
items.ex_zh: 部队接到命令，撤退到坚固的防御阵地。

items.def_en: [I/T] to withdraw troops, investments, or personnel entirely from a specific region or engagement
items.ex_en: The multinational corporation decided to pull out of the unprofitable market.
items.ex_zh: 该跨国公司决定退出这一无利可图的市场。

items.def_en: move backwards away from someone or something dangerous or aggressive
items.ex_en: I warned the aggressive stray dog to back off before it attacked my sister.
items.ex_zh: 在那只凶狠的流浪狗袭击我妹妹之前，我警告它往后退。

items.def_zh: 撤出，迅速离开（危险区域）
items.def_en: leave a room or area quickly, especially to avoid danger or conflict
items.ex_en: When the brawl broke out at the pub, we decided to clear out immediately.
items.ex_zh: 酒馆里爆发斗殴时，我们决定立刻撤离现场。

items.def_en: (+ from sb/sth) move slowly backwards away from a hazard, person, or threat
items.ex_en: The hikers slowly backed away from the rattling snake coiled beside the trail.
items.ex_zh: 徒步旅行者缓缓向后退却，避开盘踞在小道旁发出响声的毒蛇。

items.def_en: [I/T] to move soldiers or personnel back away from a battlefield or forward position
items.ex_en: The general decided to withdraw all frontline battalions to prevent an imminent encirclement.
items.ex_zh: 将军决定撤走所有前线营队，以防止即将面临的合围。
items.ex2_en: The exhausted enemy battalions withdrew quietly into the dense forest before dawn.
items.ex2_zh: 精疲力竭的敌军营队在黎明前悄然撤退进了茂密的森林。

items.def_en: 1. To move people away from a dangerous place to safety, or to leave a building or area because of danger. 2. To empty the bowels or bladder.
items.ex_en: Authorities urged residents to evacuate the coastal town before the category five hurricane arrived.
items.ex_zh: 当局敦促居民在五级飓风来袭前撤离这座沿海城镇。

items.def_en: to depart suddenly or break camp secretly or hurriedly
items.ex_en: Under cover of darkness, the rebel army decided to decamp to the mountains.
items.ex_zh: 借着夜色的掩护，叛军决定拔营撤往山区。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote coordinated backward or outward egress from a hazardous, contested, or compromised location. 'Retreat' focuses on military or defensive withdrawal away from a pressing foe, while 'evacuate' focuses on emptying an endangered populated area of non-combatants.
groups.summary_zh: 指从危险、战区或受灾区有计划地后撤离开或组织人员疏散。
groups.desc_en: Designates an orderly or forced backward movement away from an enemy, hazard, or untenable position, contrasting with forward assault or disorderly flight.
groups.desc_zh: 指从敌对交火、险境或无法立足的阵地进行有组织或被迫的后撤离开，区别于向前冲锋或溃散奔逃。
groups.nuance_en: retreat: tactical withdrawal of military forces under pressure (army / troops / forces) · evacuate: clearing people out of a hazardous zone to safety (civilians / residents / building) · withdraw: formal, deliberate disengagement of troops or presence (troops / delegation / forces) · pull out: complete strategic extraction of assets or military personnel (garrison / market / investment) · fall back: receding to a secondary defensive perimeter under assault (position / line / ridge)
groups.nuance_zh: retreat: 军队在重压下实施战术性后退 (army / troops / forces) · evacuate: 将人员从危险区域疏散转移至安全地带 (civilians / residents / building) · withdraw: 正式、审慎地抽回驻军或撤出代表 (troops / delegation / forces) · pull out: 全面且彻底地撤离人员、驻军或资本 (garrison / market / investment) · fall back: 遭遇猛烈攻势后退守第二道防线 (position / line / ridge)

groups.name: Retrieval & Resurfacing of Memories · 回忆与复现 (Recall, Recollect, Evoke)
groups.tip: 往事重现与心绪唤醒

items.def_en: (+ sth) cause a memory or past feeling to be recalled vividly
items.ex_en: Hearing that old melody brought back vivid memories of our carefree childhood summers.
items.ex_zh: 听到那首旧旋律，唤起了我们对无忧无虑童年夏日的生动回忆。

items.def_zh: 使忆起，召唤出（记忆或画面）
items.def_en: (+ sth) make one think of something; summon memories or images into the mind
items.ex_en: The sight of the abandoned farmhouse called up bittersweet images of my grandparents.
items.ex_zh: 看到那座废弃的农舍，使我脑海中浮现出祖父母苦乐参半的过往画面。

items.def_en: (+ to sth) remember or mention something that happened in the past
items.ex_en: Her melancholic verse harks back to the forgotten sorrows of ancient battlefields.
items.ex_zh: 她那忧伤的诗句追溯起古代战场上早已被人遗忘的哀伤。

items.def_en: (+ about) to indulge in pleasant, nostalgic memories of past events
items.ex_en: The elderly veterans gathered at the dinner to reminisce about their youth.
items.ex_zh: 老兵们在宴席上聚在一起，怀旧地追忆各自的青春岁月。

items.def_en: (formal) To remember something, especially by making an effort to recall it.
items.ex_en: Despite his advanced age, the scholar could distinctly recollect the day the war began.
items.ex_zh: 尽管年事已高，这位学者仍能清晰地记起战争爆发的那一天。

items.def_en: to create or bring a vivid image, picture, or memory vividly to mind
items.ex_en: The novelist's descriptions conjure up the bustling atmosphere of nineteenth-century London.
items.ex_zh: 小说家的生动描写使十九世纪伦敦的喧嚣氛围跃然眼前。

items.def_zh: 唤起，引起（回忆、感情或意象）
items.def_en: To bring a feeling, memory, or image into the mind.
items.ex_en: The tragic symphony seemed to evoke an overwhelming sense of loss among the audience.
items.ex_zh: 这部悲壮的交响乐似乎在听众心中唤起了一种强烈的失落感。

items.def_zh: 重温，在想象中再次体验
items.def_en: To experience something again, especially in your imagination.
items.ex_en: Every time he closed his eyes, he seemed to relive the terrifying accident.
items.ex_zh: 每当他闭上双眼，仿佛都在脑海中重新经历那场可怕的意外。

items.def_en: to bring back into consciousness or active recall memories long forgotten
items.ex_en: The discovery of the journal served to resurrect painful memories she had buried.
items.ex_zh: 这本日记的发现唤醒了她早已埋藏在心底的痛苦回忆。

groups.summary_en: An agent deliberately retrieves past experiences from memory or is confronted by stimuli that bring vivid emotional impressions back to life. Verbs differentiate cognitive retrieval effort from sensory triggering and intense emotional re-experience.
groups.summary_zh: 有意识检索记忆或受外物触动而重现旧景，重在心理提取与再体验。
groups.desc_en: Highlights the dynamic resurfacing, vivid mental reconstruction, or emotional reactivation of past experiences, contrasting with inert semantic retention.
groups.desc_zh: 强调过往经历在脑海中生动浮现、重新建构或引发强烈情感共鸣的动态过程，区别于冰冷的静态记忆存储。
groups.nuance_en: evoke: summoning vivid sensory impressions, emotions, or associations (memory / atmosphere / era) · relive: experiencing a past event internally as if happening anew (nightmare / trauma / triumph) · conjure up: magically or creatively generating a vivid mental picture (image / vision / past) · recollect: deliberately piecing together fragmented past episodes (details / events / encounter) · bring back: causing past memories or feelings to return vividly (nostalgia / flood of memories / sorrow)
groups.nuance_zh: evoke: 唤起生动的感官印象、氛围或深层情绪 (memory / atmosphere / era) · relive: 心理上身临其境般重温、再历往事 (nightmare / trauma / triumph) · conjure up: 凭空如变戏法般在脑海中勾勒浮现景象 (image / vision / past) · recollect: 费力拼凑回想零散断裂的往事细节 (details / events / encounter) · bring back: 外部事物勾起旧日情景或回忆复苏 (nostalgia / flood of memories / sorrow)

groups.name: Revel & Socialize · 游乐与聚会狂欢 (Play, Party, Revel)
groups.tip: 休闲放松社交娱乐

items.def_zh: 玩耍，嬉戏，玩乐；参加（体育运动或比赛）；演奏（乐器）；扮演（角色）
items.def_en: 1. To engage in activity for fun, relaxation, or enjoyment. 2. To participate in a sport or competitive game. 3. To perform music on an instrument or act a role in a drama.
items.ex_en: The children gathered on the lawn after school to play tag until sunset.
items.ex_zh: 放学后，孩子们聚集在草坪上玩捉人游戏，直到日落。

items.def_zh: 尽情玩乐，参加聚会狂欢
items.def_en: To attend or participate in a party, celebrating and having fun, often by drinking, dancing, and socializing.
items.ex_en: The college students plan to party all night after finishing their final exams.
items.ex_zh: 大学生们计划在期末考试结束后痛痛快快狂欢整夜。

items.def_en: continue drinking, dancing, and enjoying boisterous celebration
items.ex_en: Even after the music stopped at midnight, they decided to party on at Mark's apartment.
items.ex_zh: 尽管午夜时分音乐已经停了，他们还是决定去马克家继续嗨。

items.def_en: go out drinking and celebrating boisterously in bars and clubs
items.ex_en: After landing that massive promotion, Marcus took his colleagues to paint the town red.
items.ex_zh: 马库斯获得重大晋升后，带同事们去酒吧尽情痛饮狂欢。

items.def_en: enjoy oneself immensely through extravagant parties, dining, or festive activities
items.ex_en: Having won the lottery, they traveled across Europe to live it up in luxury.
items.ex_zh: 中了大奖后，他们游历欧洲各地，纵情过着奢华狂欢的生活。

items.def_en: (+ with) to participate in friendly, leisurely social interaction with other people
items.ex_en: She enjoys attending the weekend mixer to socialize with new colleagues from other departments.
items.ex_zh: 她喜欢参加周末交流酒会，与来自其他部门的新同事联络感情。

items.def_en: (+ in) to take immense pleasure in a wild, noisy celebration or festival
items.ex_en: The masked villagers continued to revel in the midnight festival beneath the lantern-lit trees.
items.ex_zh: 戴着面具的村民们在灯影婆娑的树下继续尽情享受深夜的狂欢盛典。

items.def_en: to play and run about happily, playfully, and briskly
items.ex_en: Young lambs began to frolic joyfully across the vibrant, dew-kissed spring meadows.
items.ex_zh: 幼小的羊羔开始在生机盎然、沾满露珠的春日草地上欢快地嬉戏雀跃。

items.def_en: to drink alcohol freely and indulge in boisterous, noisy social merrymaking
items.ex_en: The raucous sailors continued to carouse in the dimly lit waterfront tavern until dawn.
items.ex_zh: 吵闹的水手们在昏暗的滨水酒馆里纵酒作乐，一直狂欢到天明。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scenario describe individuals engaging in lively social entertainment, festivities, games, or boisterous celebratory gatherings. Registers vary from everyday children's games to unrestrained celebratory nightlife.
groups.summary_zh: 描述投身于游戏娱乐、社交派对或节日狂欢等社交娱乐场景。
groups.desc_en: Encompasses collective, lively, and unrestrained indulgence in pleasure, celebration, and sociability, contrasting with formal decorum or quiet contemplation.
groups.desc_zh: 指群体性沉浸于喧闹享乐、社交聚会或放纵狂欢的热烈状态，区别于端庄肃穆的礼仪或独处沉思。
groups.nuance_en: revel: delighting openly and exuberantly in celebration or triumph (night / victory / glory) · party: participating in social festivities and celebratory drinking (friends / night / weekend) · paint the town red: engaging in a wild, flamboyant night of public celebration (night / city / bars) · frolic: engaging in carefree, playful, physical merriment (lambs / children / waves) · live it up: indulging extravagantly and lavishly in pleasure (lifestyle / vacation / money)
groups.nuance_zh: revel: 沉醉于盛大欢庆或因胜利而狂喜狂欢 (night / victory / glory) · party: 参加社交聚会饮酒狂欢 (friends / night / weekend) · paint the town red: 通宵达旦在城中痛饮作乐喧闹 (night / city / bars) · frolic: 欢快无忧、撒欢雀跃地嬉戏 (lambs / children / waves) · live it up: 挥金如土、极尽奢华地享乐人生 (lifestyle / vacation / money)

groups.name: Revile & Blaspheme · 辱骂与亵渎 (Vituperate, Revile, Blaspheme)
groups.tip: 恶言相向并肆意辱骂攻讦他人

items.def_en: [I/T] to utter offensive or profane words expressing hatred or wishing evil upon someone
items.ex_en: The furious driver slammed his steering wheel and began to curse at the traffic.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的司机猛砸方向盘，开始大声咒骂拥堵的路况。

items.def_en: to scold or condemn someone angrily and at length
items.ex_en: The stern headmaster began to berate the delinquent student for his repeated absences.
items.ex_zh: 严厉的校长开始因旷课问题声色俱厉地斥责这名违纪学生。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to criticize someone or something suddenly and very angrily
items.ex_en: During the live press conference, the senator lashed out at dishonest media reporting.
items.ex_zh: 在现场新闻发布会上，这位参议员猛烈抨击了不诚实的媒体报道。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to attack someone fiercely with words; to scold harshly
items.ex_en: The furious manager began to lay into his team for their careless mistakes.
items.ex_zh: 暴怒的经理因下属犯下粗心错误而把团队痛骂了一顿。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to criticize or verbally abuse someone in an extremely aggressive manner
items.ex_en: The frustrated coach tore into the defenders during halftime for their dreadful performance.
items.ex_zh: 在中场休息时，沮丧的教练因防守队员糟糕的表现把他们痛斥了一顿。

items.def_en: [I/T] to utter bitter, highly abusive, and harshly critical language against someone
items.ex_en: The embittered critic continued to vituperate his political rivals with malicious accusations.
items.ex_zh: 这位心怀怨恨的评论家继续用恶毒的指控肆意辱骂他的政治对手。

items.def_en: 1. (formal) To criticize or abuse someone fiercely with angry, hateful language.
items.ex_en: Corrupt officials were widely reviled by citizens who suffered from the oppressive policies.
items.ex_zh: 腐败官员遭到了饱受压迫政策之苦的民众广泛而严厉的谩骂。

items.def_en: to treat a sacred entity, site, or belief with extreme disrespect or irreverence
items.ex_en: Vandals broke into the historic cathedral at midnight to desecrate the sacred altar.
items.ex_zh: 破坏分子半夜闯入历史悠久的大教堂，亵渎了神圣的祭坛。

items.def_zh: 亵渎神明，说亵渎的话；肆意侮辱
items.def_en: 1. To speak irreverently or disrespectfully about God or sacred things.
items.ex_en: The heretic was condemned for daring to blaspheme against the kingdom's revered deities.
items.ex_zh: 该异教徒因胆敢公然亵渎王国所崇奉的神明而遭到了谴责。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve extreme verbal condemnation, scurrilous vituperation, or speaking sacrilegiously against the sacred. They denote the most severe, hateful, and profane tiers of verbal transgression.
groups.summary_zh: 施以极其恶毒的咒骂、痛斥或针对神圣事物的亵渎。
groups.desc_en: Involves releasing ferocious, abusive, and contemptuous verbal fury, or profaning the sacred, contrasting with measured criticism or polite dissent.
groups.desc_zh: 指以暴烈、轻蔑、侮辱性的语言发泄怒火，或对神圣事物进行玷污亵渎，区别于克制的批评或有礼的异议。
groups.nuance_en: revile: subjecting someone to public, vitriolic abuse and contempt (critics / press / traitor) · vituperate: berating with sustained, scholarly, or bitter invective (opponent / policy / corruption) · lay into: launching a sudden, furious verbal attack against someone (subordinate / team / driver) · berate: scolding harshly and lengthily from a position of authority (child / employee / student) · desecrate: deliberately violating and dishonoring a sacred place or object (tomb / shrine / flag)
groups.nuance_zh: revile: 予以公开的痛斥、辱骂与唾弃 (critics / press / traitor) · vituperate: 施加持续且充满恶意的恶言抨击 (opponent / policy / corruption) · lay into: 劈头盖脸地予以痛骂或猛烈斥责 (subordinate / team / driver) · berate: 上级对下级严肃持久地训斥责骂 (child / employee / student) · desecrate: 故意亵渎、玷污神圣之所或信物 (tomb / shrine / flag)

groups.name: Ridicule & Lampoon · 讽刺与讥讽 (Satirize Through Parody and Caricature)
groups.tip: 运用辛辣手段讽刺与丑化

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to mock, ridicule, or tease someone or something in a lighthearted or satirical manner
items.ex_en: The comedians love to poke fun at pompous politicians during their weekly satire show.
items.ex_zh: 喜剧演员们喜欢在每周的讽刺节目中拿自命不凡的政客们开玩笑。

items.def_zh: 滑稽模仿（某人的言行举止）
items.def_en: (+ sb) to mimic or impersonate someone in an exaggerated way to make people laugh
items.ex_en: He can take off the prime minister's peculiar mannerisms with hilarious accuracy.
items.ex_zh: 他能极其滑稽而逼真地模仿那位首相奇特的言行举止。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to mock or parody someone or something by imitating them in an amusing way
items.ex_en: The satirical television sketch brilliantly sends up overhyped corporate wellness trends.
items.ex_zh: 那出讽刺电视小品巧妙地滑稽戏仿了过度炒作的企业养生风潮。

items.def_en: to imitate the style of someone or something in an exaggerated way for comic effect
items.ex_en: The student actors produced a short play to parody popular superhero movie clichés.
items.ex_zh: 学生演员们排演了一部短剧，以此恶搞热门超级英雄电影中的老套桥段。

items.def_zh: 把……画成漫画讽刺；夸张讽刺地描述（或模仿）
items.def_en: To represent, draw, or imitate someone in an exaggerated or distorted way so as to make them appear ridiculous.
items.ex_en: The editorial cartoonist managed to caricature the arrogant mogul with striking exaggeration.
items.ex_zh: 社论漫画家通过醒目的夸张手法，将那位傲慢的大亨讽刺地画成了漫画。

items.def_zh: 讽刺，嘲弄，以讽刺文章（或漫画等）嘲讽
items.def_en: To publicly criticize, mock, or ridicule someone or something using humorous satire.
items.ex_en: The underground journal continued to lampoon the dictatorial regime through biting political satire.
items.ex_zh: 地下期刊继续通过辛辣的政治讽刺来无情嘲弄那个独裁政权。

items.def_en: to use irony, sarcasm, or humor to expose and criticize people's stupidity or vices
items.ex_en: Jonathan Swift used sharp wit to satirize the hypocrisy of contemporary British society.
items.ex_zh: 乔纳森·斯威夫特运用敏锐的机智讽刺了当代英国社会的虚伪面目。

items.def_en: to mock an earnest subject or figure through comically grotesque or incongruous imitation
items.ex_en: The irreverent troupe staged an eccentric operetta to burlesque solemn tragic myths.
items.ex_zh: 这支不羁的剧团上演了一出古怪的轻歌剧，滑稽戏仿庄重的悲剧神话。

items.def_en: to expose someone to severe public ridicule, contempt, or censure
items.ex_en: The disgraced executive was pilloried by the public press for embezzling pension funds.
items.ex_zh: 这名身败名裂的高管因挪用养老金而遭到大众媒体的猛烈抨击。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote mocking or attacking a person, policy, or institution through artistic, literary, or comedic exaggeration and parody.
groups.summary_zh: 通过艺术夸张、漫画或讽刺笔法揭露缺陷并予以公开戏谑嘲讽。
groups.desc_en: Centers on mocking individuals, institutions, or conventions through witty imitation, caricature, or artistic exaggeration, contrasting with serious analytical critique or hostile libel.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过滑稽摹仿、夸张讽喻或戏仿来嘲弄揭露人物、体制或习俗，区别于严肃的理性批评或恶意中伤。
groups.nuance_en: lampoon: publicly ridiculing prominent figures via harsh satirical art (politicians / royalty / elite) · parody: comically imitating an artist’s style or work for humor (novel / genre / speech) · caricature: distorting distinctive features grotesquely for comic effect (politician / face / habits) · satirize: employing irony and humor to expose vice or folly (society / hypocrisy / regime) · send up: affectionately or teasingly mimicking someone or something (celebrity / genre / tradition)
groups.nuance_zh: lampoon: 通过尖锐的讽刺文学或漫画公开嘲弄权贵 (politicians / royalty / elite) · parody: 戏仿特定作品或艺术流派风格以博人一笑 (novel / genre / speech) · caricature: 极度夸张某人特征的讽刺画式摹写 (politician / face / habits) · satirize: 运用讽刺手法针砭时弊、揭露荒谬 (society / hypocrisy / regime) · send up: 轻松开玩笑式地戏拟或模仿揶揄 (celebrity / genre / tradition)

groups.name: Rob & Plunder · 抢劫与掠夺 (Deprive by Force or Stealth)
groups.tip: 以暴力手段劫掠他人财物

items.def_en: to take property unlawfully from a person or place by force or threat
items.ex_en: Two masked men planned to rob the downtown jewelry store before dawn broke.
items.ex_zh: 两名蒙面男子计划在天亮之前抢劫市中心的那家珠宝店。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to steal something from someone, or to cheat them out of money
items.ex_en: Unsuspecting tourists are often ripped off by unlicensed taxi operators.
items.ex_zh: 毫无防备的游客经常被无照出租车司机敲竹杠。

items.def_en: [I/T] to steal goods from a place during a war, riot, or natural disaster
items.ex_en: Desperate opportunists began to loot abandoned appliance shops amid the post-hurricane chaos.
items.ex_zh: 在飓风过后的混乱中，不顾一切的投机者开始趁乱洗劫被遗弃的家电商铺。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to rob a person, bank, or vehicle using a weapon or threat of violence
items.ex_en: A masked gunman attempted to hold up the local grocery store last night.
items.ex_zh: 昨晚，一名蒙面持枪歹徒企图抢劫当地那家杂货店。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to threaten someone with a gun in order to rob them
items.ex_en: The desperate convict tried to stick up a gas station attendant with a pistol.
items.ex_zh: 那个走投无路的囚犯试图用手枪持枪抢劫一名加油站员工。

items.def_en: (slang) To steal valuable goods or large amounts of money in a daring robbery.
items.ex_en: The mastermind recruited expert thieves to heist millions worth of diamonds from Antwerp.
items.ex_zh: 主谋招募了经验丰富的盗贼，企图从安特卫普盗劫价值数百万的钻石。

items.def_en: To steal goods or valuables violently from a place, especially during a war or civil disorder.
items.ex_en: The ruthless invaders swept through the province to plunder its ancient monasteries.
items.ex_zh: 残暴的入侵者横扫整个省份，肆意劫掠当地古老的修道院。

items.def_en: [I/T] to violently rob a place using force, especially during wartime
items.ex_en: Merciless mercenaries entered the fallen city to murder innocents and pillage historic homes.
items.ex_zh: 残忍的雇佣兵攻入陷落的城市，屠杀无辜百姓并暴力洗劫历史民宅。

items.def_zh: 洗劫，翻箱倒柜彻底搜刮
items.def_en: to search thoroughly and violently through a place, causing destruction and theft
items.ex_en: Burglars managed to ransack the entire mansion while the family was on holiday.
items.ex_zh: 趁全家人外出度假之际，窃贼们彻底翻箱倒柜搜刮了整座豪宅。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the unlawful appropriation of property through intimidation, force, or sweeping devastation, escalating from organized thievery to wartime ravaging.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过武力威胁、突袭或战乱席卷夺取他人财物，强调暴力程度与破坏力递增。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the illicit, aggressive dispossession of goods through physical violence, armed threat, or predatory raids, contrasting with covert burglary or subtle fraud.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过直接暴力、武装威逼或战乱洗劫强行剥夺掠取财物，区别于隐蔽入室盗窃或暗中欺诈。
groups.nuance_en: rob: unlawfully stripping a person or place of property via threat (bank / traveler / store) · hold up: robbing at gunpoint or weapon threat (cashier / bank / train) · loot: ransacking and stealing goods during riots, disasters, or war (shops / museum / town) · plunder: systematic, massive pillaging of an area by conquerors (city / wealth / resources) · pillage: violent wartime sacking and physical ravaging (village / countryside / monastery)
groups.nuance_zh: rob: 运用人身威逼剥夺财物 (bank / traveler / store) · hold up: 持枪持械当面劫持抢劫 (cashier / bank / train) · loot: 趁骚乱、天灾或战祸趁火打劫 (shops / museum / town) · plunder: 征服者对战败领地财富的大规模掠夺洗劫 (city / wealth / resources) · pillage: 战乱中对村庄城邑的暴烈洗劫与破坏 (village / countryside / monastery)

groups.name: Rotate on an Axis or Pivot · 轴向旋转与回转 (Rotate, Swivel)
groups.tip: 围绕轴心自转或转动方向

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to rotate so as to face in the opposite direction, or cause something to do so
items.ex_en: She called his name softly, prompting him to turn around and smile warmly.
items.ex_zh: 她轻声呼唤他的名字，促使他转过身来，报以温和的微笑。
items.ex2_en: The curious child turned around the tiny prism to catch the morning sunlight.
items.ex2_zh: 好奇的孩子转动着小三棱镜，以捕捉清晨的阳光。

items.def_en: [I/T] to turn or balance on a central point or pin
items.ex_en: The basketball player quickly pivoted on his left foot to elude the defender.
items.ex_zh: 这名篮球运动员迅速以左脚为轴转动，从而摆脱了防守队员。
items.ex2_en: The crane operator pivoted the heavy steel boom toward the awaiting cargo ship.
items.ex2_zh: 起重机操作员将沉重的钢制吊臂转向等候中的货船。

items.def_en: To turn or spin around on a fixed central point or pivot, or to cause something to do so.
items.ex_en: The receptionist swiveled in her chair to greet the visitors entering the office.
items.ex_zh: 接待员在转椅上转过身，向步入办公室的来访者打招呼。
items.ex2_en: The astronomer smoothly swiveled the brass telescope toward the distant glowing constellation.
items.ex2_zh: 天文学家平稳地将黄铜望远镜转向遥远的发光星座。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to turn round very quickly on an axis or pivot point
items.ex_en: Hearing a loud crash behind her, the dancer spun around in sheer shock.
items.ex_zh: 听到身后传来一声巨响，舞蹈演员震惊地快速转过身来。
items.ex2_en: The playful boy spun his little sister around on the slippery grass.
items.ex2_zh: 顽皮的男孩在湿滑的草地上把他的小妹妹转得团团转。

items.def_en: to pivot or turn around suddenly to face another direction
items.ex_en: The guard wheeled around instantly upon hearing suspicious footsteps near the perimeter fence.
items.ex_zh: 一听到外围栅栏旁有可疑脚步声，警卫立刻猛然转身警惕起来。
items.ex2_en: The mounted soldier wheeled his warhorse around to face the pursuing cavalry.
items.ex2_zh: 骑兵调转战马，面向追击的骑兵部队。

items.def_en: 1. To turn or cause to turn around a central point or axis. 2. To regularly change or take turns doing a job or task.
items.ex_en: The massive radar antenna continues to rotate smoothly atop the coastal surveillance tower.
items.ex_zh: 巨大的雷达天线在沿海监视塔顶上继续平稳地旋转。
items.ex2_en: The mechanic slowly rotated the rusty gear to check for missing metal teeth.
items.ex2_zh: 机械师缓慢转动生锈的齿轮，以检查是否有缺失的金属齿。

items.def_en: [I/T] to turn around a center or orbit around an external central point
items.ex_en: Astronomers explained how terrestrial planets revolve around the central star in stable orbits.
items.ex_zh: 天文学家解释了类地行星是如何在稳定轨道上环绕中心恒星公转的。
items.ex2_en: The clever engineer designed a mechanism that constantly revolves the solar panels.
items.ex2_zh: 聪明的工程师设计了一种能不断旋转太阳能电池板的机构。

items.def_en: [I/T] to turn round and round quickly and lightly
items.ex_en: The cheerful ballerina began to twirl across the stage in her glittering costume.
items.ex_zh: 欢快的芭蕾舞演员身着闪亮的演出服，开始在舞台上轻快地旋转。
items.ex2_en: The smiling girl twirled her colorful silk ribbon during the holiday parade.
items.ex2_zh: 微笑的女孩在节日游行中挥舞转动着她五颜六色的丝带。

items.def_en: [I/T] to turn around rapidly on a central point or axis
items.ex_en: The vintage vinyl record began to spin on the polished turntable platter.
items.ex_zh: 那张老旧的黑胶唱片开始在抛光的唱盘托盘上快速旋转。
items.ex2_en: The playful child loved to spin the wooden top across the smooth kitchen floor.
items.ex2_zh: 贪玩的孩子喜欢在光滑的厨房地板上抽打旋转木陀螺。
