groups.summary_en: Verbs describing movement around a central axis or pivot point, ranging from continuous mechanical rotation to turning one's head, body, or an apparatus horizontally.
groups.summary_zh: 指围绕中心轴或枢轴发生的水平转动、旋转或机械回转。
groups.desc_en: Specifies rotational or circular physical motion around a fixed central point, axis, or pivot, contrasting with linear propulsion or random agitation.
groups.desc_zh: 指围绕固定中心、转轴或支点所做的径向或圆周旋转运动，区别于线性直线推进或无规则晃荡。
groups.nuance_en: rotate: turning continuously around an internal central axis (wheel / earth / blades) · pivot: swinging or turning horizontally on a fixed pinpoint support (heel / foot / hinge) · swivel: smoothly rotating horizontally on a 360-degree mechanism (chair / head / camera) · twirl: spinning rapidly, lightly, and gracefully (dancer / baton / hair) · revolve: orbiting or moving in a circular path around an external center (sun / center / hub)
groups.nuance_zh: rotate: 绕自身内部中心轴做整圈旋转 (wheel / earth / blades) · pivot: 以某固定支点为轴心做折角或回转 (heel / foot / hinge) · swivel: 依托转轴机构平稳水平回转 (chair / head / camera) · twirl: 轻盈、快速而优美地自转打转 (dancer / baton / hair) · revolve: 绕外部另一中心天体或轴心公转运转 (sun / center / hub)

groups.name: Rough Physical Push & Crowd Shoving · 推挤与推搡 (Jostle, Shove, Manhandle)
groups.tip: 在人群中推推搡搡挤开

items.def_en: [I/T] to push past someone or force a way through a crowd using one's elbows
items.ex_en: Commuters had to elbow through the packed subway platform to reach the doors.
items.ex_zh: 通勤者不得不一边用手肘推挤着穿过拥挤的地铁站台，一边走向车门。

items.def_en: [I/T] to push, butt, or push against gently with the head or horns
items.ex_en: The playful young calf began to bunt affectionately against its mother's flank.
items.ex_zh: 那只活泼的小牛犊开始亲昵地用头轻顶母亲的腹侧。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to force one's way aggressively into a space or crowd using physical strength
items.ex_en: Aggressive reporters tried to muscle into the restricted room to question the politician.
items.ex_zh: 激进的记者们试图强行挤入受限制的房间，以质问那位政客。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to physically jostle someone or treat them aggressively and imperiously
items.ex_en: Don't let them push you around; you have rights as a tenant.
items.ex_zh: 别让他们摆布你；作为租客你也是有权利的。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to push or handle someone roughly and aggressively
items.ex_en: The schoolyard bullies began to shove him around until a teacher intervened.
items.ex_zh: 校园恶霸们开始粗暴地推搡他，直到一名老师出面干预。

items.def_en: [I/T] to push someone or something roughly and forcefully with one's hands
items.ex_en: Impatient commuters started to shove against the closed subway doors during rush hour.
items.ex_zh: 早高峰期间，不耐烦的通勤者开始用力推搡紧闭的地铁门。

items.def_en: 1. to push or bump roughly against someone, especially in a crowd. 2. to compete forcefully with other people for something
items.ex_en: Photographers jostled through the dense crowd to snap pictures of the arriving actress.
items.ex_zh: 摄影师们在密集的人群中推搡前行，抢着拍摄抵临的女演员。

items.def_zh: 凭力气硬挤入或强行推搡
items.def_en: [I/T] (+ in/into/past) to force one's way using physical strength or aggressive pressure
items.ex_en: He muscled past the security guards to enter the restricted backstage area.
items.ex_zh: 他硬凭力气挤过保安，强行闯入了后台限制区域。

items.raw_cluster: 粗暴对待与推搡 Manhandle & Shove
items.def_zh: 粗暴地推搡（或拉扯）；用人力搬运（重物）
items.def_en: 1. to push, drag, or handle someone roughly. 2. to move a heavy or awkward object using physical human strength
items.ex_en: Four husky movers had to manhandle the grand piano up the winding stairs.
items.ex_zh: 四名魁梧的搬运工只得靠人力把这台大三角钢琴硬搬上旋转楼梯。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe pushing, bumping, or handling someone roughly or aggressively, typically in a crowd or during physical restraint. They vary in force from accidental crowd bumping to aggressive physical manhandling.
groups.summary_zh: 指在人群中推挤或粗暴拉扯、推搡他人的动作，从轻微拥挤到粗暴控制不等。
groups.desc_en: Highlights coarse, forceful physical shoving and bodily displacement within dense crowds or tight spaces, contrasting with gentle guiding or formal hand-to-hand combat.
groups.desc_zh: 强调在拥挤人群或局促空间内粗野施加身体冲撞、推挤争道，区别于温和引导或正规肉搏搏击。
groups.nuance_en: jostle: bumping and pushing roughly against others in a crowd (commuters / shoppers / crowd) · shove: delivering a sudden, hard, aggressive physical push (policeman / door / bystander) · elbow: using sharp elbow thrusts to force one's way forward (competitor / way / crowd) · muscle into: aggressively forcing oneself into a group, space, or enterprise (market / territory / conversation) · push around: bullying and dominating someone coercively (peers / employees / weak)
groups.nuance_zh: jostle: 人群中杂乱互撞、你推我搡争抢空间 (commuters / shoppers / crowd) · shove: 猝不及防、粗暴猛力地向前狠推 (policeman / door / bystander) · elbow: 用手肘狠命架开他人硬挤开路 (competitor / way / crowd) · muscle into: 仗着蛮力或强势强行插足占领 (market / territory / conversation) · push around: 倚强凌弱、颐指气使地随意摆布欺负 (peers / employees / weak)

groups.name: Rub & Scrape · 摩擦与刮蹭 (Rub, Scrape, Grate)
groups.tip: 表面接触产生摩擦或刮蹭痕迹

items.def_en: (+ sth) to rub a surface vigorously with a cloth, abrasive paper, or scraper to clean or smooth it
items.ex_en: The carpenter carefully rubbed down the oak tabletop with fine-grit sandpaper.
items.ex_zh: 木匠用细砂纸仔细擦拭打磨橡木桌面。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to remove something from a surface by friction, or to become removed by being rubbed
items.ex_en: He tried to rub off the stubborn pencil marks with a dry cloth.
items.ex_zh: 他试图用干布擦掉那些顽固的铅笔痕迹。
items.ex2_en: The cheap paint began to rub off the old wooden table quickly.
items.ex2_zh: 那张旧木桌上的劣质油漆很快就开始脱落了。

items.def_en: 1. To rub a rough or sharp edge against a surface, often making a mark or sound. 2. To rub your skin with your nails to relieve an itch.
items.ex_en: The stray kitten began to scratch at the wooden leg of the chair.
items.ex_zh: 那只流浪小猫开始抓挠椅子的木腿。
items.ex2_en: The sharp thorns scratched her bare forearms while she picked wild blackberries.
items.ex2_zh: 她在采摘野黑莓时，锋利的荆棘划破了她裸露的小臂。

items.def_zh: 摩擦，揉，搓；涂抹；相互摩擦
items.def_en: To move your hand, a cloth, or an object back and forth over a surface while pressing against it.
items.ex_en: She gently rubbed her sore shoulders after spending the entire day typing.
items.ex_zh: 在打了一整天字后，她轻轻揉了揉酸痛的肩膀。

items.def_en: to rub an object with a soft cloth or buffer to make it smooth and shiny
items.ex_en: He used a microfiber cloth to buff the polished shoe to a brilliant shine.
items.ex_zh: 他用超细纤维布将擦过的皮鞋抛光得光可鉴人。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to remove an unwanted substance or layer from a surface by dragging a hard edge across it
items.ex_en: The cook used a spatula to scrape off the burnt food from the pan.
items.ex_zh: 厨师用抹刀刮掉煎锅里烧焦的食物残渣。

items.def_en: [I/T] to rub food against a shredder, or to rub two hard surfaces together with a harsh noise
items.ex_en: The chef quickly grated a block of parmesan cheese over the warm pasta.
items.ex_zh: 主厨迅速在热乎乎的意大利面表面磨碎了一块帕尔玛奶酪。

items.def_en: [I/T] to drag a sharp or hard edge firmly across a surface to clean, level, or damage it
items.ex_en: He used a metal blade to scrape old paint from the window frame.
items.ex_zh: 他用金属刀片刮掉窗框上的旧油漆。

items.def_en: [I/T] to rub hard with a stiff brush or cloth, especially with water and soap
items.ex_en: She spent the afternoon scrubbing the greasy kitchen floor with hot soapy water.
items.ex_zh: 整个下午她都在用热肥皂水用力擦洗油腻的厨房地板。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe drawing one object firmly against another's surface to clean, abrade, smooth, or relieve an itch. 'Rub' specifies continuous surface contact and friction, whereas 'scrape' applies a rigid edge to drag across or peel off a surface layer.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过硬质边缘刮除或平顺按揉在物体表面产生的机械摩擦。
groups.desc_en: Applies frictional force across a surface to clean, smooth, abrade, or reduce, contrasting with static pressure or impact cutting.
groups.desc_zh: 强调沿物体表面施加摩擦剪切力以达到清洁、磨光、磨损或磨碎的效果，区别于单纯的静压或切削。
groups.nuance_en: rub: general back-and-forth friction (hands / eyes / lotion) · scrape: dragging a hard edge to dislodge layers (paint / rust / mud) · buff: polishing with soft friction to produce shine (car / nails / shoes) · grate: aggressive shredding by frictional abrasion (cheese / nutmeg / carrots)
groups.nuance_zh: rub: 往复摩擦的常规动作 (hands / eyes / lotion) · scrape: 用硬质边缘刮除表面附着物 (paint / rust / mud) · buff: 用软质材料轻擦抛光 (car / nails / shoes) · grate: 用粗糙孔状工具擦碎磨细 (cheese / nutmeg / carrots)

groups.name: Rummage & Ransack · 翻找与搜寻 (Rummage, Ransack, Scour)
groups.tip: 翻箱倒柜彻底搜翻掠寻

items.def_en: (+ around/through) To search for something by turning things over in disorder
items.ex_en: He rooted around in his messy backpack looking for the car keys.
items.ex_zh: 他在乱糟糟的背包里胡乱翻找车钥匙。
items.ex2_en: Wild hogs rooted the muddy ground under the oak trees for buried acorns.
items.ex2_zh: 野猪拱开橡树下泥泞的地面，寻找埋藏的橡子。

items.def_en: (+ for/in) To search widely or rummage around for food or provisions
items.ex_en: The survivors had to forage in the ruined pantry for any remaining food.
items.ex_zh: 幸存者们不得不在残破的食品储藏室里翻找残留的吃食。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to search through a pile or container by moving objects aside
items.ex_en: I spent an hour digging through old files to find our marriage certificate.
items.ex_zh: 我花了一个小时在旧档案堆中翻找我们的结婚证书。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to search untidily through a collection of things by moving items around
items.ex_en: She rooted through her handbag but could not find her sunglasses anywhere.
items.ex_zh: 她在手提包里翻了个遍，却到处都找不到墨镜。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to search thoroughly and haphazardly through a container or area
items.ex_en: Burglars rummaged through every bedroom dresser before escaping with the jewelry.
items.ex_zh: 窃贼们在带着珠宝逃走之前，翻遍了每个卧室的梳妆台。

items.def_zh: 翻寻，快速搜找（尤指偷窃）
items.def_en: [I/T] (+ through) To search through something quickly and untidily, often with intent to steal
items.ex_en: The thief rifled through her desk drawers in search of cash and passports.
items.ex_zh: 小偷翻检了她的办公桌抽屉，搜寻现金和护照。

items.def_en: To search a place or area thoroughly and systematically in order to find something
items.ex_en: Search parties continued to scour the dense woods for the missing hiker.
items.ex_zh: 搜救队继续在地毯式搜寻这片密林，以寻找失踪的徒步旅行者。

items.def_zh: 翻找，搜寻，翻箱倒柜地找
items.def_en: (+ through/in/around) To search for something by moving things around carelessly and hurriedly.
items.ex_en: He rummaged through the dusty closet hoping to find his old winter coat.
items.ex_zh: 他在布满灰尘的衣柜里翻找，希望能找出自己的旧冬衣。

items.def_zh: 洗劫，翻箱倒柜搜掠；彻底搜查
items.def_en: To search a place thoroughly and violently, causing damage and mess, especially to steal things.
items.ex_en: Rebels ransacked the abandoned clinic and stole valuable medical supplies.
items.ex_zh: 叛军洗劫了被废弃的诊所，掠走了宝贵的医疗物资。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe searching untidily or aggressively through an enclosed place, container, or belongings by moving things about carelessly or violently. 'Rummage' evokes disordered digging through items, whereas 'ransack' connotes destructive, predatory, or thoroughly disruptive searching.
groups.summary_zh: 杂乱地翻动容器或强行粗暴搜掠场所，以寻找特定物品。
groups.desc_en: Involves disorderly, physically intrusive physical searching through an enclosed space or heap, unlike systematic scanning or visual browsing.
groups.desc_zh: 指在密闭空间或杂乱堆积物中进行翻动、搅扰式的侵入性搜寻，区别于条理分明的视线扫视或检索。
groups.nuance_en: rummage: untidy, haphazard searching through contents (drawers / attic / closet) · ransack: destructive, thorough pillaging or intrusive searching (house / office / luggage) · rifle: rapid, stealthy or predatory searching to pilfer (pockets / files / safe) · scour: sweeping an entire area exhaustively (neighborhood / records / countryside)
groups.nuance_zh: rummage: 翻箱倒柜的杂乱翻找 (drawers / attic / closet) · ransack: 具破坏性或洗劫性的彻底搜刮 (house / office / luggage) · rifle: 快速、鬼祟地翻检翻扒 (pockets / files / safe) · scour: 地毯式、穷尽性的全面搜查 (neighborhood / records / countryside)

groups.name: Schedule & Slate · 安排与排定 (Time Allocation & Formal Scheduling)
groups.tip: 规划日程并列入计划

items.def_en: to plan that an event or activity will happen at a particular time or date
items.ex_en: The manager scheduled the quarterly performance review for next Tuesday morning.
items.ex_zh: 经理将季度绩效考评安排在下周二上午进行。

items.def_zh: 将……排入日程表，列入议程
items.def_en: To enter or schedule something in a calendar or timetable.
items.ex_en: Please calendar the budget review meeting so everyone remembers to attend.
items.ex_zh: 请将预算审查会议排入日程表，以便大家记得参加。

items.def_zh: 为……安排时间（或位置）；放入狭槽（或狭缝）
items.def_en: 1. To assign a time, position, or slot for someone or something in a schedule. 2. To put something into a narrow opening or slot.
items.ex_en: The producer managed to slot the urgent interview into the morning show.
items.ex_zh: 制作人设法将这次紧急采访插排进早间节目中。

items.def_en: to make a provisional booking or tentative appointment with the possibility of changing it
items.ex_en: Let's pencil in lunch for next Friday, subject to your travel plans.
items.ex_zh: 我们先暂定下周五吃午饭，具体视你的出行计划而定。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to schedule or arrange a definite appointment or time slot for someone
items.ex_en: The clinic can book you in for a dental examination next month.
items.ex_zh: 诊所可以帮你预约在下个月进行牙科检查。

items.def_zh: 在日程表上划出（特定时间段）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to reserve a specific period of time on a schedule so that nothing else can be planned
items.ex_en: I always block out two quiet hours each morning for uninterrupted writing.
items.ex_zh: 我每天早晨总会在日程中划出安静的两小时用于专心写作。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to manage to find time in a busy schedule to see someone or do a task
items.ex_en: The doctor promised to fit in the walk-in patient between her appointments.
items.ex_zh: 医生承诺在预约间隙抽空接诊这位未预约的患者。

items.def_en: (+ for / to do) to plan or schedule sth for a future time; designate sb for a post
items.ex_en: The city council has slated the historic bridge for demolition this autumn.
items.ex_zh: 市议会已拟定于今年秋季拆除这座历史悠久的大桥。

items.def_zh: 指定，专门预留（时间或资金）
items.def_en: (+ for) to designate or set aside sth specifically for a definite intended purpose or time
items.ex_en: The university earmarked these surplus funds for future scientific research projects.
items.ex_zh: 大学已将这笔结余资金专门划拨用于未来的科研项目。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote assigning an event, task, or person to a specific time, date, or programmatic position in a calendar or organizational agenda.
groups.summary_zh: 在日程表、节目单或计划中排定时间段或次序。
groups.desc_en: Involves allocating specific temporal boundaries and institutional slots for planned events, unlike spontaneous happening or mere delay.
groups.desc_zh: 指为预定事件规划明确的时间区间与机构档期，区别于自发进行或单纯的推迟。
groups.nuance_en: schedule: authoritative planning of timing (meeting / flight / appointment) · slate: designating or earmarking for a future role or time (release / hearing / trial) · slot: fitting into a constrained temporal opening (interview / patient / performance) · pencil in: provisional, tentative scheduling subject to confirmation (lunch / date / catch-up)
groups.nuance_zh: schedule: 正式排定具体日程与时间表 (meeting / flight / appointment) · slate: 拟定或指派于特定档期/角色 (release / hearing / trial) · slot: 见缝插针地安排进紧凑时段 (interview / patient / performance) · pencil in: 临时、待确认地初步排入日程 (lunch / date / catch-up)

groups.name: Score & Scribe Surfaces · 划刻与压印 (Scribe, Score, Indent)
groups.tip: 用锐器在表面刻出细划痕

items.def_zh: 划刻出；在表面刮出（标记或字迹）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to make shallow marks, words, or designs onto a surface using a sharp instrument
items.ex_en: The prisoner used a sharp stone to scratch in his initials.
items.ex_zh: 囚犯用一块锋利的石头在墙上划刻出自己的名字缩写。

items.def_zh: （用划线器等在表面）划线，刻痕；抄写
items.def_en: 1. (technical) To mark or scratch a guiding line on wood, metal, or stone using a pointed tool. 2. (formal or archaic) To write or transcribe.
items.ex_en: The craftsman used a steel tool to scribe a precise cutting line.
items.ex_zh: 工匠用钢制划线器刻出了一条精确的切割标记线。

items.def_en: (often passive) To mark or dot a surface with tiny spots.
items.ex_en: Clusters of tiny golden freckles specked her cheeks under the summer sun.
items.ex_zh: 在夏日的阳光下，一簇簇微小的金色雀斑点缀在她的面颊上。

items.def_zh: 压出凹痕；使边缘呈锯齿状；（段首）缩进
items.def_en: 1. To make a dent or impression in a surface or edge. 2. To start a line of text further from the margin than other lines.
items.ex_en: Heavy blows from the falling rocks indented the steel surface of the shield.
items.ex_zh: 落石的沉重撞击在钢盾表面压出了道道凹痕。
items.ex2_en: Thin aluminum sheets easily indent under the strong force of heavy hail.
items.ex2_zh: 在强力冰雹的击打下，薄铝板很容易凹陷。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to mark a surface with lines or grooves, especially to guide cutting or indicate removal
items.ex_en: He scored out the incorrect dimensions with a ruler and marker pen.
items.ex_zh: 他用尺子和记号笔划线标出并去掉了不正确的尺寸。

items.def_en: to cut a shallow notch, line, or groove into a surface with a sharp tool
items.ex_en: The baker scored the surface of the dough before putting it into the oven.
items.ex_zh: 面包师在把面团放入烤箱前在其表面划出了切口。

items.def_en: to decorate metal surfaces by indenting lines with a hammer and punch
items.ex_en: The silversmith used delicate punches to chase intricate floral patterns onto the chalice.
items.ex_zh: 银匠使用精致的冲头在圣杯上錾刻出复杂的缠枝花纹。

items.def_en: to cut lines or patterns into metal or glass using acid or a sharp point
items.ex_en: The artist used dilute acid to etch delicate lines onto the copper plate.
items.ex_zh: 艺术家使用稀酸在铜版上蚀刻出细腻的线条。

items.def_en: to cut designs, letters, or lines into hard material using an etching tool
items.ex_en: A local jeweler will engrave your initials onto the silver locket.
items.ex_zh: 当地的珠宝商会在银制小金盒上雕刻你的名字缩写。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe tracing sharp shallow reference marks, grooves, tiny specks, or depressions into flat surfaces without completely severing the substrate, typically for guiding, measuring, or indenting.
groups.summary_zh: 指在材质表面划出标线、压入印记或轻微刻痕的操作。
groups.desc_en: Involves incising, marking, or impressing lines and patterns into a firm substrate, contrasting with superficial pigment application like painting.
groups.desc_zh: 指在硬质基底上切划、刻入或压印出线条与凹痕，区别于颜料涂绘等纯表面附着。
groups.nuance_en: score: cutting a shallow baseline or groove, often for folding or breaking (bread / glass / surface) · scribe: precisely scratching a layout mark with a sharp tool (wood / metal / stone) · etch: cutting fine lines using chemical acid or sharp points (glass / circuit / memory) · indent: pressing a recess into a surface without cutting (margin / metal / paper)
groups.nuance_zh: score: 划出浅槽以便折断、烘焙或标记 (bread / glass / surface) · scribe: 用划线针在工件上精准划痕定位 (wood / metal / stone) · etch: 用酸液蚀刻或利器雕镂精细图案 (glass / circuit / memory) · indent: 物理压出凹痕或缩进边距 (margin / metal / paper)

groups.name: Scout & Forage · 侦察与搜寻 (Scout, Reconnoiter, Forage)
groups.tip: 前哨探路搜集前方情报

items.def_en: (+ for) search an area systematically for valuable mineral deposits or opportunities
items.ex_en: Geologists traveled deep into the arid mountains to prospect for copper deposits.
items.ex_zh: 地质学家深入贫瘠的山区勘探铜矿储量。

items.def_en: 1. To explore an area in order to gather information about enemy positions or terrain. 2. To look searchingly for someone or something having specific qualities.
items.ex_en: Two brave riders went ahead to scout the rugged territory for danger.
items.ex_zh: 两名勇敢的骑兵先行一步，去侦察这片崎岖地带是否存在危险。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Explore an area or examine a situation to gather preliminary information
items.ex_en: The advance team left early to scout out potential camping sites near the river.
items.ex_zh: 先遣队早早出发，去河流附近实地探查潜在的露营地点。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Search thoroughly until a person, animal, or vital supply is found
items.ex_en: Detectives worked around the clock to hunt down the suspect.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们夜以继日地工作，力求将嫌疑人缉拿归案。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Search persistently until hidden items or information are discovered
items.ex_en: The persistent journalist managed to ferret out the buried truth behind the scandal.
items.ex_zh: 那名执着的记者设法查寻出了丑闻背后被掩盖的真相。

items.def_en: [I/T] physically explore or make cautious inquiries to test conditions or defenses
items.ex_en: Investigators cautiously probed the collapsed mine entrance before sending rescue workers inside.
items.ex_zh: 调查人员在派遣救援人员进入之前，谨慎探查了坍塌的矿井入口。

items.def_zh: 搜寻（食物、物资等）；搜寻粮草
items.def_en: (+ for) To search widely across an area for food or wild provisions.
items.ex_en: Deer frequently forage for wild berries in the nearby valley during early autumn.
items.ex_zh: 初秋时节，鹿群经常在附近的山谷中搜寻野果。

items.def_en: search a place thoroughly and systematically in pursuit of something or someone
items.ex_en: The police scoured the entire district looking for any witnesses to the robbery.
items.ex_zh: 警方彻底搜查了整个街区，寻找抢劫案的任何目击者。

items.def_en: (military) To explore an area, usually in secret, to gather information about enemy forces or terrain.
items.ex_en: Special forces crossed the river at night to reconnoiter the enemy defenses.
items.ex_zh: 特种部队在夜间过河，对敌军的防御工事进行侦察。

groups.summary_en: Agents explore unfamiliar or hostile terrain to gather tactical intelligence, locate targets, or search for food and vital supplies.
groups.summary_zh: 在开阔或陌生区域展开探查，以搜集情报、侦测敌情或寻找补给。
groups.desc_en: Involves exploratory spatial movement to locate dispersed resources, intelligence, or targets, contrasting with stationary harvesting or passive observation.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过移动探测来寻找分散的资源、情报或目标，区别于定点采集或消极观察。
groups.nuance_en: scout: reconnoitering territory ahead to assess conditions (location / talent / trail) · forage: roaming widely in search of food or supplies (nuts / provisions / supplies) · prospect: systematically exploring geological or market potential (gold / oil / clients) · ferret out: relentlessly extracting concealed facts or individuals (truth / secrets / culprit)
groups.nuance_zh: scout: 前哨侦察、实地踩点或发掘选拔 (location / talent / trail) · forage: 到处漫游搜寻吃食或补给 (nuts / provisions / supplies) · prospect: 勘探地质矿藏或发掘市场商机 (gold / oil / clients) · ferret out: 像雪貂般刨根问底搜寻潜藏之物 (truth / secrets / culprit)

groups.name: Scrub & Wash by Force · 强力洗涤与冲洗 (Scour, Syringe, Scrub)
groups.tip: 注水冲洗或深度冲涤干净

items.def_zh: 用拖把或海绵冲洗擦净
items.def_en: (+ sth) Clean a surface, especially a ship's deck or floor, using a swab or mop and plenty of water
items.ex_en: The weary crew had to swab down the main deck after the heavy storm.
items.ex_zh: 暴风雨过后，疲惫的船员们只得用拖把冲洗干净主甲板。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Clean a large object or surface thoroughly by spraying or pouring water over it
items.ex_en: He washed down the spicy tacos with a cold glass of lemonade.
items.ex_zh: 他喝了一大口冰柠檬水，咽下了辛辣的墨西哥卷饼。

items.def_zh: 用注射器冲洗（耳道、伤口等）；用注射器抽取（或注入）
items.def_en: To clean, wash, or flush out an ear, wound, or cavity using a syringe.
items.ex_en: The nurse prepared warm sterile saline to syringe the child's blocked ear canal.
items.ex_zh: 护士准备了温热的无菌生理盐水，用注射器冲洗孩子堵塞的耳道。

items.def_zh: 用拖把或棉签擦洗清洁
items.def_en: (+ down) to clean or wipe a floor, deck, or wound using a swab, mop, or pad
items.ex_en: Orderlies swabbed the bloody floor before admitting the next emergency patient.
items.ex_zh: 勤杂工在接纳下一位急诊病人前，迅速擦洗干净了带血的地板。

items.def_en: to wash out a wound, body opening, or tissue with a continuous stream of water or saline
items.ex_en: The surgeon thoroughly irrigated the contaminated wound with sterile saline solution.
items.ex_zh: 外科医生用无菌生理盐水彻底冲洗了受污染的伤口。

items.def_zh: 用软管冲洗（车身、地面等）
items.def_en: to wash something thoroughly by directing a heavy stream of water from a hose
items.ex_en: He used a high-pressure hose to hose down the muddy driveway thoroughly.
items.ex_zh: 他用高压水管把满是泥泞的车道彻底冲洗了一遍。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Clean a large surface thoroughly by rubbing hard with a stiff brush and water
items.ex_en: Workers spent hours scrubbing down the stone walls to remove the graffiti.
items.ex_zh: 工人们花了数小时用力刷洗石墙，以彻底清除上面的涂鸦。

items.def_en: [I/T] to rub a hard surface vigorously with a stiff brush or cloth, usually with water and soap
items.ex_en: She had to scrub the scorched cooking pot with steel wool.
items.ex_zh: 她不得不拿钢丝球用力刷洗烧糊的煮锅。

items.def_zh: 彻底擦洗，刷洗；冲刷，冲蚀；彻底搜查
items.def_en: 1. To clean or brighten the surface of something by rubbing it hard with an abrasive or brush. 2. To search an area thoroughly in order to find someone or something.
items.ex_en: He took a wire brush to scour the rust from the garden gate.
items.ex_zh: 他拿来钢丝刷，彻底擦除花园铁门上的锈迹。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote cleaning a surface or internal cavity through vigorous physical action or targeted liquid application, such as abrasive rubbing ('scour') or pressurized flushing with an instrument ('syringe').
groups.summary_zh: 特指运用器械冲洗或施加强力摩擦刮除污垢的深层清洁方式。
groups.desc_en: Cleans a surface through intensive mechanical friction or pressurized fluid delivery, contrasting with gentle rinsing or passive soaking.
groups.desc_zh: 通过高强度机械摩擦或加压流体喷射进行深度清洁，区别于温和漂洗或静态浸泡。
groups.nuance_en: scrub: vigorous friction with a brush or abrasive (floors / pots / hands) · swab: absorbing or cleansing using a mop or sponge pad (deck / throat / wound) · hose down: clearing debris with a continuous high-volume water jet (driveway / patio / yard) · syringe: irrigating or clearing cavities via targeted fluid pressure (ear / wound / catheter)
groups.nuance_zh: scrub: 用刷子或硬物用力用力擦洗刷洗 (floors / pots / hands) · swab: 用拖把或医用棉签吸拭清洗 (deck / throat / wound) · hose down: 用水管强力冲洗大片区域 (driveway / patio / yard) · syringe: 用注射器精准注液冲洗管腔 (ear / wound / catheter)

groups.name: Seal & Weatherproof · 密封与填塞封闭
groups.tip: 闭合开口并严密塞紧

items.def_en: (+ sth) Fill and make watertight or airtight seams and cracks using caulking compound
items.ex_en: The technician used waterproof sealant to caulk up the open window seam.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员使用防水密封胶把敞开的窗缝完全填死。

items.def_en: to fasten or close an aperture tightly so that air, liquid, or gas cannot enter or escape
items.ex_en: Please seal the envelope firmly before dropping it into the mailbox.
items.ex_zh: 投入邮箱之前，请将信封彻底封紧。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Prevent access to or passage of fluids/air into an area or container by closing openings completely
items.ex_en: Armed guards sealed off the street following the security alert.
items.ex_zh: 安全警报拉响后，武装警卫封锁了整条街道。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Close an opening, container, or seam completely so that nothing can enter or escape
items.ex_en: Workers quickly sealed up the abandoned well to prevent any accidents.
items.ex_zh: 工人们迅速将废弃的井口封死，以防发生任何意外。

items.def_en: to secure or fit a joint with a resilient mechanical seal to prevent fluid leakage
items.ex_en: The engineer carefully gasketed the high-pressure steam valve to eliminate dangerous vapor leaks.
items.ex_zh: 工程师细心地为高压蒸汽阀装上垫圈密封，以消除危险的蒸汽泄漏。

items.def_en: to make a joint, seam, or crack watertight or airtight by filling it with a waterproof mastic
items.ex_en: You need to caulk the bathroom tiles to prevent water from leaking through.
items.ex_zh: 你需要用填缝剂把浴室瓷砖封好，以防止水分渗漏进去。

items.def_en: To close or seal a package, container, or seam tightly again after it has been opened.
items.ex_en: Be sure to reseal the food packet to keep the crackers completely crisp.
items.ex_zh: 务必将食品袋重新封严，以保持饼干的完全酥脆。
items.ex2_en: The damaged plastic envelope resealed firmly when exposed to warm air.
items.ex2_zh: 破损的塑料封套在受热空气作用后牢固地重新密封了。

items.def_zh: 为（门窗）安装密封防风条
items.def_en: To fit strips of rubber, foam, or metal around doors or windows to block drafts, cold air, or rain.
items.ex_en: We should weatherstrip the drafty front door before freezing winter temperatures arrive.
items.ex_zh: 在寒冬降临前，我们应该给透风的前门安装防风密封条。

items.def_zh: 填塞（缝隙）以防漏，堵漏；（给马蹄铁）装防滑尖铁
items.def_en: 1. (variant of caulk) To fill the seams or joints of something with waterproof material to prevent leaking. 2. To provide a horseshoe with sharp cleats or points to prevent slipping.
items.ex_en: Old shipwrights calked the oak seams with pitch to preserve the historic hull.
items.ex_zh: 老造船匠用沥青填塞橡木接缝以防漏，从而保护这艘古老船体的完整。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe applying specific materials, gaskets, or compounds to seams, cracks, or openings to make an enclosure impervious to air, moisture, or drafts. Manner variations depend on the application medium, such as caulking compound, weatherstripping tape, or sealant.
groups.summary_zh: 指使用密封胶、填缝剂或绝缘条封闭缝隙以防渗水漏气。
groups.desc_en: Closes off openings and interfaces with impervious barriers to prevent passage of fluids, air, or contaminants, contrasting with merely covering or latching.
groups.desc_zh: 利用密封材料阻断缝隙与界面，以彻底杜绝流体、气体或异物渗漏，区别于常规遮盖或锁闭。
groups.nuance_en: seal: creating an airtight or watertight hermetic barrier (envelope / container / leak) · caulk: filling building joints and seams with flexible sealant (bathtub / window / seam) · weatherstrip: lining perimeter gaps against outdoor elements (door / window / sill) · gasket: inserting a flat mechanical ring to prevent fluid leakage between joined parts (engine / pipe / flange)
groups.nuance_zh: seal: 封闭接口形成防渗漏隔离 (envelope / container / leak) · caulk: 用填缝胶打胶填堵建筑接缝 (bathtub / window / seam) · weatherstrip: 加装密封胶条以防风雨侵入 (door / window / sill) · gasket: 装配机械密封垫片防漏 (engine / pipe / flange)

groups.name: Secrete & Excrete · 分泌与排泄 (Salivate, Stale, Discharge)
groups.tip: 腺体分泌体液或排泄废物

items.def_en: (+ sth) Emit or produce a liquid, secretion, smell, or gas from inside
items.ex_en: The rotting vegetation gave off a foul chemical odor.
items.ex_zh: 腐烂的植被散发出一股难闻的化学异味。

items.def_en: Flow slowly and steadily out of a gland, wound, or small opening
items.ex_en: A thick, yellowish fluid began to ooze out of the infected wound slowly.
items.ex_zh: 浓稠泛黄的液体开始从受感染的伤口中缓缓渗出。

items.def_en: Flow or leak out slowly through small pores or cracks
items.ex_en: Cold rainwater continued to seep out through tiny cracks in the basement wall.
items.ex_zh: 冰冷的雨水不断从地下室墙壁的细小裂缝中渗透出来。

items.def_zh: （马、牛等）排尿，撒尿；（使）变陈旧，（使）走味
items.def_en: 1. (of horses, cattle, etc.) To urinate. 2. To make or become stale or uninteresting.
items.ex_en: The tired packhorse stood quietly by the dusty path to stale in peace.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的驮马静静立在尘土飞扬的小径旁安然撒尿。
items.ex2_en: Leaving fresh artisan bread uncovered overnight will quickly stale its tender crust.
items.ex2_zh: 将新鲜手工面包敞口放置过夜，会很快使其松脆的外皮变硬变陈。

items.def_en: to allow saliva to run continuously out of the mouth involuntarily
items.ex_en: The teething baby continued to drool down the front of his cotton bib.
items.ex_zh: 正在长牙的小婴儿口水不断淌到他的棉质围兜正面。

items.def_en: (of an organ or cell) to produce and release a functional liquid substance
items.ex_en: Specialized glands in the stomach secrete digestive acids to break down consumed food.
items.ex_zh: 胃部的特化腺体分泌消化酸以分解摄入的食物。

items.def_zh: 分泌唾液，流口水；垂涎，极度渴望
items.def_en: 1. To produce saliva in the mouth. 2. (+ over) To show great eagerness or anticipation for something.
items.ex_en: The hungry predators began to salivate profusely as fresh meat was brought out.
items.ex_zh: 当新鲜肉食被端出来时，饥饿的捕食者们开始大量分泌唾液。

items.def_en: [I/T] to emit or release pus, fluid, or bodily matter from a wound or cavity
items.ex_en: The surgical incision started to discharge clear serous fluid during the patient's recovery.
items.ex_zh: 在病人康复期间，手术切口开始排出清亮的浆液性分泌物。

items.def_en: to separate and discharge waste matter from the bodily system
items.ex_en: The kidneys continuously filter metabolic waste and excrete excess fluids through urine.
items.ex_zh: 肾脏持续过滤代谢废物，并通过尿液排泄多余的体液。

groups.summary_en: Biological organisms release fluid or waste products from internal glands or organs, either functional secretions (e.g. saliva) or waste excretions (e.g. urine in animals).
groups.summary_zh: 机体或腺体产生并排出机能性体液（唾液等）或生理代谢废弃物。
groups.desc_en: Discharges biological or internal fluids outward from tissue or boundaries, contrasting with external application or non-biological pouring.
groups.desc_zh: 由机体组织或内部屏障向外排泄、渗析或释放生理流体，区别于外在浇泼或非生物性流动。
groups.nuance_en: secrete: functional biological production and release of chemicals (hormone / enzyme / saliva) · ooze: slow, viscous bleeding or exuding through pores or cracks (blood / pus / sap) · drool: involuntary leaking of excess saliva from the mouth (saliva / baby / dog) · discharge: expelling built-up pathological fluid or waste (pus / fluid / emission)
groups.nuance_zh: secrete: 有机体生成并分泌生理活性物质 (hormone / enzyme / saliva) · ooze: 浓稠液体自创口或微孔缓慢渗出 (blood / pus / sap) · drool: 唾液不自主地顺嘴角垂流 (saliva / baby / dog) · discharge: 机体排出积聚的病理性液体或废料 (pus / fluid / emission)

groups.name: Seize & Haul · 抓夺与强拉 (Grab, Seize, Snatch, Haul, Tow)
groups.tip: 徒手用力夺取或拉拽

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Take sudden and firm physical possession of someone or something with one's hands
items.ex_en: He managed to grab hold of the railing before slipping on the ice.
items.ex_zh: 他在结冰的地面上滑倒前，设法一把紧紧抓住了栏杆。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Pull a heavy load inside, or take a suspect into custody forcibly
items.ex_en: The police officers arrived promptly to haul in the primary suspect for interrogation.
items.ex_zh: 警官们迅速赶到，将主要嫌疑人强行拘捕回局审讯。

items.def_en: to pull somebody or something along the ground with effort
items.ex_en: The weary soldier had to drag the heavy supply crate across the mud.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的士兵不得不拖着沉重的补给箱穿过泥地。

items.def_en: To pull a vehicle, boat, or other object along behind another using a rope, chain, or towbar.
items.ex_en: A heavy-duty truck arrived to tow the stranded car to the nearest garage.
items.ex_zh: 一辆重型卡车赶来将滞留的小轿车拖往最近的汽修厂。

items.def_en: to take hold of something suddenly, roughly, or secretly
items.ex_en: A masked thief dashed forward to snatch her purse and fled into traffic.
items.ex_zh: 一名蒙面小偷冲上前一把夺过她的手提包，窜入了车流中。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Carry or drag someone or something away by force or with heavy physical effort
items.ex_en: Security guards rushed over to haul off the unruly protestor from the venue.
items.ex_zh: 保安人员冲上前去，把那个胡闹的抗议者强行从场馆里拖走了。

items.def_zh: 抓住，攫取；抓住（机会）；吸引
items.def_en: 1. To take hold of something or someone suddenly and roughly. 2. To quickly take an opportunity. 3. (informal) To get someone's attention.
items.ex_en: She managed to grab the falling vase right before it struck the floor.
items.ex_zh: 就在花瓶即将砸在地上之前，她敏捷地一把抓住了它。

items.def_en: to take hold of something suddenly and forcefully with the hands or take legal possession of it
items.ex_en: Federal agents were authorized to seize all illegal contraband found on the vessel.
items.ex_zh: 联邦执法人员获权没收在船只上查获的所有非法违禁品。

items.def_en: to pull or carry something heavy with a continuous, strenuous effort
items.ex_en: Two burly workers had to haul the massive safe up three narrow staircases.
items.ex_zh: 两名健壮的工人不得不吃力地把笨重的保险箱拖上三段狭窄的楼梯。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe forcibly taking hold of an object or dragging/towing it along with physical effort, spanning fast tactical grabs to heavy-load pulls.
groups.summary_zh: 用力抓取、抢夺或以机械力/体力强行牵引拽拉。
groups.desc_en: Combines a forceful, abrupt grip with subsequent heavy, resistant traction or dragging, contrasting with gentle holding or unresisted carrying.
groups.desc_zh: 将猛烈突发的抓握动作与随后的强力抗阻拖拉结合，区别于轻拿轻放或无负重的平移携带。
groups.nuance_en: seize: sudden, overwhelming capture by force or authority (power / contraband / hostage) · snatch: rapid, predatory taking before interference can occur (purse / opportunity / victory) · haul: straining to pull heavy or bulky loads over distance (cargo / net / timber) · tow: pulling an unpowered vehicle or vessel using a line or hitch (car / boat / barge)
groups.nuance_zh: seize: 凭借权威或压倒性力量强行夺取、扣押 (power / contraband / hostage) · snatch: 趁人不备猛然一把夺走 (purse / opportunity / victory) · haul: 费力搬运或长距离拖拉沉重物体 (cargo / net / timber) · tow: 用缆绳或挂钩牵引机动车辆/船只 (car / boat / barge)

groups.name: Separate & Detach · 分离与解扣 (Uncouple, Disconnect, Detach)
groups.tip: 解开连接使部件各自分离

items.def_en: Separate into pieces or become detached from a joined structure
items.ex_en: The weathered wooden barrel began to come apart under the extreme water pressure.
items.ex_zh: 在极端水压之下，那只风化严重的木桶开始散裂解体。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Disengage or release something from a hook or fastening
items.ex_en: She carefully leaned forward to unhook her wool coat from the rusty nail.
items.ex_zh: 她小心地俯身上前，将羊毛大衣从生锈的钉子上脱钩解下。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ from) to unfasten and separate one part or item from a larger structure
items.ex_en: Technicians must detach the faulty fuel line before initiating routine maintenance on the engine.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员在对发动机进行例行检修前，必须拆卸出现故障的燃油管路。
items.ex2_en: The outer booster rocket detaches smoothly after reaching the upper atmosphere.
items.ex2_zh: 外部助推火箭在到达高层大气后平稳脱离。

items.def_en: [I/T] to break the physical or operational contact or connection between two linked things
items.ex_en: Always remember to disconnect the electrical power before attempting to clean internal parts.
items.ex_zh: 尝试清洁内部部件之前，务必记得切断电源联结。
items.ex2_en: The internet connection frequently disconnects whenever stormy weather brings heavy rainfall.
items.ex2_zh: 每当暴风雨带来暴雨时，互联网连接经常会中断。

items.def_zh: 脱开，解开，拆开（连接的车厢、机械等）
items.def_en: To disconnect or separate two things that are joined together, such as railway carriages.
items.ex_en: Railway workers quickly worked to uncouple the damaged freight car from the train.
items.ex_zh: 铁路工人迅速行动，将受损的货运车厢从列车上解开脱钩。
items.ex2_en: The rusted railway carriages uncoupled suddenly while traveling over the bridge.
items.ex2_zh: 生锈的火车车厢在过桥时突然脱钩解开了。

items.def_en: Become physically separated or detached from a larger joined object or assembly
items.ex_en: A huge chunk of the crumbling iceberg broke away into the dark ocean.
items.ex_zh: 正在崩解的冰山中有一大块脱离母体，坠入了漆黑的海洋。

items.def_en: 1. To divide, disconnect, or stop being joined together. 2. To stand or act as a barrier between people or things. 3. (of a couple) To stop living together.
items.ex_en: A solid brick wall serves to separate the garden from the busy highway.
items.ex_zh: 一道坚固的砖墙将花园与繁忙的公路分隔开来。
items.ex2_en: The long freight train separated into two sections during the steep mountain climb.
items.ex2_zh: 长长的货运列车在爬陡坡时裂成了两截。

items.def_en: (+ from) to unhook or release an animal or vehicle from a hitch
items.ex_en: The farmer walked over to unhitch the horse from the heavy wooden plow.
items.ex_zh: 农夫走上前去，把马匹从沉重的木犁上解开卸下。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ from) to release an interlocking mechanical component from engagement with another
items.ex_en: The operator pressed the primary lever to disengage the clutch from the rotor.
items.ex_zh: 操作员按下主操纵杆，使离合器与转子解除啮合。
items.ex2_en: The safety clutch disengages automatically if internal engine temperatures rise too high.
items.ex2_zh: 如果发动机内部温度升得过高，安全离合器会自动脱开。

groups.summary_en: An agent mechanically disengages or undoes the physical linkage joining two bound objects (such as vehicles, machinery parts, or fastenings), setting them free of each other.
groups.summary_zh: 松解、解除物理联结机械装置，将相互钩合或扣接在一起的物体分离开来。
groups.desc_en: Undoes a mechanical coupling or physical bond to make unified entities distinct, contrasting with breaking materials or non-mechanical dividing.
groups.desc_zh: 解除物体之间的机械连接或物理咬合使之分离复原，区别于材料断裂破坏或抽象的分类。
groups.nuance_en: detach: unfastening a connected subordinate component without damage (coupon / retinas / cord) · disconnect: interrupting functional linkage or utility flow (power / hose / phone) · uncouple: releasing mechanical linkage between paired vehicles or units (railcar / trailer / engine) · unhitch: freeing an animal or vehicle from a harness or tow hitch (horse / trailer / wagon)
groups.nuance_zh: detach: 完好拆下或分离从属部件 (coupon / retinas / cord) · disconnect: 断开电源、管路等功能性连接 (power / hose / phone) · uncouple: 解除成对车辆或机械单元的挂钩 (railcar / trailer / engine) · unhitch: 解除挽具或挂钩以松脱马匹/拖车 (horse / trailer / wagon)

groups.name: Sewing & Stitching Craft · 针缝与补缀工艺 (Stitch, Sew, Hem)
groups.tip: 针线交织与衣物缝合

items.def_en: (+ sth) Close a tear, hole, or incision completely using a needle and thread
items.ex_en: She used black thread to sew up the torn seam of his jacket.
items.ex_zh: 她用黑线把他的夹克上裂开的缝口给缝补好了。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Join the edges of cloth or human flesh together with stitches
items.ex_en: The doctor had to stitch up the deep cut on his bleeding forearm.
items.ex_zh: 医生不得不把他流血的前臂上的那道深伤口缝合起来。

items.def_zh: 粗缝，用粗针脚临时缝合
items.def_en: (+ sth) Attach a piece of fabric temporarily with loose or quick stitches
items.ex_en: She decided to tack on the lace collar before doing the final stitching.
items.ex_zh: 她决定在进行最终缝合之前，先用粗针脚将蕾丝领子临时粗缝固定。

items.def_en: 1. To sew or join pieces of fabric together using a needle and thread. 2. To close a wound with stitches.
items.ex_en: The experienced surgeon prepared to stitch the clean wound with delicate, precise motions.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的外科医生动作细致精准，准备缝合这道干净的伤口。

items.def_en: [I/T] to join or fasten pieces of fabric, leather, or material using needle and thread
items.ex_en: My grandmother taught me how to sew custom cushions from leftover fabric scraps.
items.ex_zh: 祖母曾教我如何用剩余的边角碎布缝制定制靠垫。

items.def_en: [I/T] to repair a hole in knitted cloth by interweaving yarn with a needle
items.ex_en: He sat under the lamp to darn the worn heels of his socks.
items.ex_zh: 他坐在台灯下织补自己那双磨损了后跟的厚袜子。

items.def_en: to turn under and sew the finished edge of a piece of cloth
items.ex_en: She spent the afternoon folding fabric to hem her new pair of trousers.
items.ex_zh: 她花了整整一下午折起布料，给自己的新裤子缝边。

items.def_zh: 缝制，缝补（sew 的过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past participle of sew; to join, fasten, or repair cloth using a needle and thread.
items.ex_en: Each delicate pattern was sewn onto the ceremonial silk banner with gold thread.
items.ex_zh: 每个精巧的图案都是用金线精心缝制在仪式用的丝绸旗帜上的。

items.def_zh: 粗缝，用大针脚假缝定位
items.def_en: to tack or sew pieces of fabric together temporarily with loose, long stitches
items.ex_en: Tailors usually baste the suit jacket parts together before fitting them on clients.
items.ex_zh: 裁剪师通常会在让客户试穿前用大针脚将西装各部件假缝定位。

groups.summary_en: An artisan or tailor manipulates needle and thread to join fabrics, create garments, or close seams in cloth or flesh. Verbs represent the foundational technical acts of sewing, edging, tacking, or stitching seams.
groups.summary_zh: 裁缝或手工艺人运用针线拼接织物、修补边沿或手工缝合破口。
groups.desc_en: Binds, repairs, or finishes pliable textiles using thread passed by a needle, contrasting with gluing, stapling, or structural weaving.
groups.desc_zh: 指使用穿线针贯穿柔性织物进行缝合、修补或收边，区别于粘接、订书钉装订或整布织造。
groups.nuance_en: sew: general broad process of needle-and-thread fabric construction (garment / button / dress) · stitch: creating individual needle loops or rapid surgical/textile bonds (wound / seam / patch) · darn: interlacing yarn across a worn hole to restore fabric (socks / sweater / hole) · hem: folding and stitching fabric edges to prevent fraying (skirt / curtain / pants)
groups.nuance_zh: sew: 针线缝制的泛称 (garment / button / dress) · stitch: 缝制连续针脚或临床外科缝合 (wound / seam / patch) · darn: 用纱线经纬交错织补破洞 (socks / sweater / hole) · hem: 织物折边压边以防脱线 (skirt / curtain / pants)

groups.name: Shake & Tremble · 颤抖与剧颤 (Quiver, Tremble, Shudder)
groups.tip: 从轻微发抖到剧烈摇晃

items.def_en: (+ sth) Shake involuntarily and slightly because of cold, fear, or weakness
items.ex_en: The lost child began to tremble with cold in the sudden mountain downpour.
items.ex_zh: 迷路的孩子在突如其来的山地暴雨中因寒冷而开始发抖。

items.def_en: to shake involuntarily with quick, short movements as a result of fear, cold, or weakness
items.ex_en: His cold hands started to tremble as he reached for the front doorknob.
items.ex_zh: 当他伸手去够前门门把手时，冰凉的双手开始颤抖起来。

items.def_zh: 颤抖，发抖；微颤，轻微晃动
items.def_en: to shake, tremble, or vibrate with a slight, rapid motion, often because of strong emotion, cold, or physical force
items.ex_en: The autumn leaves seemed to quiver softly under the touch of evening breezes.
items.ex_zh: 秋天的树叶在晚风的轻抚下似乎微微颤动。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Agitate or vibrate an object vigorously back and forth
items.ex_en: The new CEO plans to shake up the entire management structure.
items.ex_zh: 新任首席执行官计划对整个管理架构进行大洗牌。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Shake violently or convulse momentarily with horror, disgust, or cold
items.ex_en: Witnesses could not help but shudder at the horrifying sight of the wreckage.
items.ex_zh: 目击者们看着残骸那令人毛骨悚然的惨状，禁不住剧烈打颤。

items.def_zh: 摇动，摇晃；颤抖，发抖；动摇
items.def_en: 1. to move quickly back and forth, up and down, or from side to side, or to cause something to do so. 2. to tremble because of cold, fear, or illness. 3. to make someone or something feel less confident or secure
items.ex_en: A heavy blast from the demolition site caused nearby glass windows to shake.
items.ex_zh: 拆迁现场传来的一声巨响，震得附近的玻璃窗剧烈晃动。
items.ex2_en: She gently shook the glass bottle to dissolve the white powder inside.
items.ex2_zh: 她轻轻摇晃玻璃瓶，以溶解里面的白色粉末。

items.def_en: to shake suddenly and briefly with a strong, deep convulsive movement from disgust or fear
items.ex_en: A cold draft through the hallway made her shudder involuntarily from head to toe.
items.ex_zh: 穿堂而过的冷风让她不由自主地从头到脚剧烈打了个寒颤。

items.def_en: to shake violently, especially of the ground or large structures under immense force
items.ex_en: The ancient foundations seemed to quake as the subterranean explosion tore through rock.
items.ex_zh: 当地下爆炸撕裂岩层时，古老的地基仿佛剧烈摇晃起来。

items.def_en: [I/T] to shake violently and uncontrollably with sudden, irregular spasmodic contractions
items.ex_en: Severe electrical shocks caused the patient's entire muscular frame to convulse violently.
items.ex_zh: 强烈的电击致使患者全身的肌肉骨架发生剧烈痉挛抽搐。
items.ex2_en: Violent volcanic eruptions convulsed the peaceful island throughout the terrible night.
items.ex2_zh: 剧烈的火山喷发在可怕的整夜里震撼抽搐着这座平静的岛屿。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote involuntary or mechanical vibrating movements, ranging from fine, delicate twitching caused by cold or emotion to violent structural jolts. 'Quiver' occupies the low-intensity threshold of barely visible shaking, whereas 'convulse' reaches violent spasmodic agitation.
groups.summary_zh: 按物理或情绪震动幅度由微弱细颤到剧烈痉挛的级差排列。
groups.desc_en: Undergoes rapid, involuntary, reciprocating micro-oscillations driven by cold, emotion, or seismic energy, contrasting with intentional motion or broad swinging.
groups.desc_zh: 因寒冷、强烈情绪或地质受力而发生不自主的快速往复微振，区别于有意摆动或大范围晃荡。
groups.nuance_en: tremble: steady, delicate vibrating from fear, weakness, or age (hands / voice / leaves) · quiver: slight, rapid fluttering vibration (lip / arrow / chin) · shudder: sudden, violent convulsive shivering from disgust or shock (body / spine / engine) · quake: deep, powerful seismic or structural shaking (ground / earth / empire)
groups.nuance_zh: tremble: 细微而持续的战栗抖动 (hands / voice / leaves) · quiver: 轻微急速的颤振或抽动 (lip / arrow / chin) · shudder: 突发剧烈的打冷战或震颤 (body / spine / engine) · quake: 深层、剧烈的地动山摇或动摇根基 (ground / earth / empire)

groups.name: Shave, Pare & Bore · 削切与掘凿 (Spud, Tonsure, Gouge)
groups.tip: 下放钻头向地下开凿深孔

items.def_en: (+ sth) Trim or shave off outer layers or edges of something bit by bit
items.ex_en: The craftsman used a small sharp knife to pare down the wooden dowel.
items.ex_zh: 工匠用一把锋利的小刀将这根木销钉一点点削细削薄。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Cut, scoop, or force out a hollow or piece from a surface using a sharp or curved tool
items.ex_en: The woodcarver used a chisel to gouge out hollow spaces inside the log.
items.ex_zh: 木雕师用圆凿在原木内部剜出凹陷的中空空间。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Cut off a thin layer or unwanted material from a surface using a blade
items.ex_en: The carpenter had to shave off a few millimeters from the swollen door.
items.ex_zh: 木工不得不从受潮膨胀的门板边缘刨削掉几毫米。

items.def_en: (+ of/off) to cut wool or hair from an animal or person, or slice through heavy material with blades
items.ex_en: Every spring the local farmhands shear thick fleece from hundreds of mature sheep.
items.ex_zh: 每年春天，当地农工都会从数百只成年绵羊身上剪下厚厚的羊毛。

items.def_en: (+ out) to make a deep groove, hole, or indentation in something using a sharp chisel or claw-like tool
items.ex_en: Vandals used a rusty screwdriver to gouge deep lines into the car door.
items.ex_zh: 破坏分子用一把生锈的螺丝刀在汽车门上狠狠抠出了几道深痕。

items.def_en: (+ out) to widen, enlarge, or clear a drilled hole or bore using a rotary cutting tool
items.ex_en: The gunsmith took great care to ream out the newly bored rifle barrel.
items.ex_zh: 枪匠小心翼翼地对新钻孔的步枪枪管进行铰孔精加工。

items.def_zh: 开钻（油气井）；用短铲除草，铲除
items.def_en: 1. (petroleum engineering) To start drilling an oil or gas well (often 'spud in'). 2. To dig or cut with a spud or spade.
items.ex_en: The drilling crew prepared their equipment to spud the deep offshore oil well.
items.ex_zh: 钻井队准备好了全部设备，准备正式开钻这口深水海上油井。

items.def_en: (+ away/down) to trim off outer layers, skin, or edges using a small sharp blade
items.ex_en: She sat quietly on the bench to pare the tough rind off apples.
items.ex_zh: 她静静坐在长凳上，用小刀削去苹果表面坚硬的外皮。

items.def_zh: 为……剃发，削发（尤指剃度入修会）
items.def_en: To shave the head or the crown of the head of someone entering the priesthood or a monastic order.
items.ex_en: The solemn bishop prepared to tonsure the young novice entering the cloistered abbey.
items.ex_zh: 庄重的教区主教准备为即将进入隐修院的年轻修士剃发祝圣。

groups.summary_en: Specialized vocational, mechanical, or ritual acts involving chipping, boring, shearing, or stripping surface material from an object or head using dedicated tools.
groups.summary_zh: 使用专用工具进行剥凿、打孔或仪式性剃除毛发/表层材料。
groups.desc_en: Progressively strips, carves, or hollows out layers of solid material using bladed or rotating cutting edges, contrasting with blunt smashing or sheer slicing.
groups.desc_zh: 使用刀刃或旋转切削工具层层剥离、刮削或挖空坚硬材料，区别于钝力砸碎或简单平切。
groups.nuance_en: shave off: slicing thin surface slivers away cleanly (whiskers / wood / fractions) · pare: trimming outer skin or reducing volume gradually (apple / nails / budget) · gouge: forcefully hollowing out a deep scoop or groove (channel / flesh / eye) · ream: enlarging or smoothing a cylindrical hole with a rotary cutter (hole / pipe / cylinder)
groups.nuance_zh: shave off: 贴着表面刨削或修除薄层 (whiskers / wood / fractions) · pare: 削去外皮或逐步消减规模 (apple / nails / budget) · gouge: 用凹凿或蛮力挖出深槽凹坑 (channel / flesh / eye) · ream: 用铰刀扩大并修光圆孔 (hole / pipe / cylinder)

groups.name: Shine & Glimmer · 闪烁与烁耀 (Glint, Luminesce, Scintillate)
groups.tip: 光芒忽明忽暗微弱闪烁

items.def_en: to burn or shine unsteadily or intermittently
items.ex_en: The lone candle flame began to flicker wildly in the sudden cold draft.
items.ex_zh: 那根孤零零的蜡烛火苗在突来的穿堂冷风中开始剧烈摇曳闪烁。

items.def_en: to shine with a flickering light that alternates rapidly between bright and faint
items.ex_en: Millions of distant stars twinkle across the clear, velvet sky throughout the night.
items.ex_zh: 数以百万计的遥远星辰整夜在晴朗如丝绒般的天空中闪闪发光。

items.def_en: to shine with a soft, slightly wavering, luminous light
items.ex_en: The moonlight cast a soft shimmer across the calm surface of the lake.
items.ex_zh: 皎洁的月光在平静的湖面上泛起一片轻柔摇曳的微光。

items.def_zh: 闪闪发光，闪烁（微弱的光）
items.def_en: 1. To shine with small, bright flashes of light; (of eyes) to show an emotion briefly.
items.ex_en: A brief glint of cold steel caught the sentry's eye in darkness.
items.ex_zh: 黑暗中，冷冽钢铁反射的一道短暂微光吸引了哨兵的注意。

items.def_en: 1. To emit light without producing much or any heat.
items.ex_en: Deep-sea jellyfish luminesce under immense marine pressure to deter predators in total dark.
items.ex_zh: 深海海蜇在深水重压下发出冷光，以在漆黑中威慑捕食者。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to produce a brief, tiny flash of reflected light off a polished or faceted surface
items.ex_en: Sharp rays of sunshine glint off the polished brass dome of the cathedral.
items.ex_zh: 炽烈的阳光在大教堂那经过抛光的黄铜圆顶上折射出闪烁的光芒。

items.def_en: to shine continuously with bright, lively, jumping points of reflected light
items.ex_en: Tiny ripples sparkle away under the afternoon sun as river water glides past.
items.ex_zh: 随着河水流淌而过，微小的涟漪在午后阳光下闪耀生辉不停。

items.def_zh: 晶莹璀璨地迸闪火星般光芒
items.def_en: to shine brightly with flashes of light scattered across many points
items.ex_en: The faceted diamond seemed to sparkle brilliantly whenever light touched its sharp edges.
items.ex_zh: 每当光线掠过锋利的棱面时，这枚切面钻石都会迸发出耀眼的光芒。

items.def_zh: 闪烁，闪耀；焕发才华，妙语连珠
items.def_en: 1. To shine brightly with quick flashes of light; to be brilliantly lively, clever, or witty.
items.ex_en: Distant stars scintillate across the pristine desert sky with icy and pure brilliance.
items.ex_zh: 遥远的繁星在原始洁净的荒漠夜空中闪烁跳跃，散发出冰冷纯净的光芒。

groups.summary_en: A light source or reflective facet emits light marked by rapid flashes, intermittent glimmers, or chemical luminescence.
groups.summary_zh: 伴随微动、折射或发光体特质而起伏闪烁的瞬时微光。
groups.desc_en: Emits or reflects dynamic, intermittent, or shifting visible light from surfaces, contrasting with uniform, steady, and high-intensity blazing.
groups.desc_zh: 自表面发射或反射出动态、间歇或流转的光亮，区别于均匀、恒定且高强度的灼热直射。
groups.nuance_en: glint: brief, sharp, pinpoint reflection off a hard surface (metal / eye / blade) · shimmer: soft, undulating, wavering luminescence (heat / water / silk) · sparkle: bright, lively scattering of multi-angled flashes (diamonds / snow / champagne) · twinkle: soft, intermittent rhythmic pulsing or blinking (stars / lights / eyes)
groups.nuance_zh: glint: 硬物表面一闪而过的刺目寒光 (metal / eye / blade) · shimmer: 柔和波动、若隐若现的泛光 (heat / water / silk) · sparkle: 多角度璀璨散射的欢快火花 (diamonds / snow / champagne) · twinkle: 柔和、有节奏的时隐时现闪烁 (stars / lights / eyes)

groups.name: Shore Up & Structurally Reinforce · 支撑与物理加固 (Underpin, Shore up, Buttress)
groups.tip: 搭设脚手架稳固支撑结构

items.def_en: (+ up) to prevent something from falling by placing an object under or against it
items.ex_en: The workers used a thick timber to prop the falling garden fence securely.
items.ex_zh: 工人们用一根粗木料将那堵摇摇欲坠的花园栅栏牢牢支起。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to secure, stiffen, or reinforce a structure using tight stays, struts, or braces
items.ex_en: Engineers had to brace up the sagging ceiling before continuing internal construction work.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们在继续室内施工之前，必须先用支架把下垂的天花板加固撑紧。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to support a structure, object, or wall by placing a physical prop or beam underneath or against it to stop it falling
items.ex_en: They placed several wooden beams to prop up the cracked retaining wall safely.
items.ex_zh: 他们安放了数根木梁，以安全地把出现裂纹的挡土墙支承起来。

items.def_en: to support a building, wall, or structure with props or wooden shores to prevent collapse
items.ex_en: Heavy wooden timbers were quickly installed to shore up the damaged mine shaft.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的木质撑木被迅速架设起来，以支撑加固受损的矿井通道。

items.def_en: to strengthen, support, or make rigid with a firm brace or diagonal beam
items.ex_en: Engineers used heavy wooden beams to brace the unstable mine shaft against collapse.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们用沉重的木梁支撑着不稳定的矿井，以防坍塌。

items.def_zh: 为……搭建脚手架；（教育学）为（学习者）提供支架式指导
items.def_en: 1. To support a building or structure with scaffolding; (education) to provide structured guidance to learners.
items.ex_en: Construction workers will scaffold the historic facade before repairs begin tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 建筑工人们将在明天开始维修前为这座历史建筑的外立面搭建脚手架。

items.def_zh: 支撑，加固（建筑物底层）；巩固，构成……的基础
items.def_en: 1. To support or form the foundation of a wall or building; to strengthen, support, or substantiate an argument or system.
items.ex_en: Specialists injected concrete to underpin the deteriorating foundations of the ancient cathedral.
items.ex_zh: 专家们注入混凝土以加固古老教堂日趋恶化的地基。

items.def_zh: 给（船）装压舱物；用道渣铺垫（铁轨）
items.def_en: 1. To provide a ship with heavy material for stability; to lay crushed stone under railway tracks.
items.ex_en: Crews laid crushed granite to ballast the newly installed section of railway track.
items.ex_zh: 施工人员铺设碎花岗岩作为道渣，以稳固新铺设的铁轨路段。

items.def_en: to support or strengthen a wall or building with an external architectural buttress
items.ex_en: Architects decided to buttress the towering stone wall with massive masonry arches.
items.ex_zh: 建筑师们决定用巨大的石拱来支撑高耸的石墙。

groups.summary_en: Physical engineering and manual stabilization verbs describing the addition of beams, props, heavy weights, or foundations to prevent a structure from sagging or collapsing.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过架设支架、底座、压载物或立柱从物理底层结构上进行加固支撑。
groups.desc_en: Provides rigid external or foundational structural resistance against gravitational collapse or lateral drift, contrasting with internal tensile strengthening.
groups.desc_zh: 提供外部或底层的刚性物理支撑以抗衡重力坍塌或侧向倾倒，区别于材料内部的抗拉硬化。
groups.nuance_en: prop: placing an angled temporary strut underneath to keep upright (ladder / elbow / gate) · shore up: adding timber or metal bracing to support a weakened structure (wall / foundation / ceiling) · buttress: building permanent projecting masonry support against lateral thrust (wall / tower / defenses) · underpin: establishing solid support from below a foundation (masonry / footing / bridge)
groups.nuance_zh: prop: 斜向支顶以防止物体倒下 (ladder / elbow / gate) · shore up: 用撑木支架加固支撑下沉结构 (wall / foundation / ceiling) · buttress: 构筑坚实扶壁以抵抗侧推力 (wall / tower / defenses) · underpin: 从基础底部进行托换固基 (masonry / footing / bridge)

groups.name: Shorten & Condense · 缩减与压缩 (Shorten, Condense, Compress)
groups.tip: 删繁就简，缩减篇幅与体积

items.def_en: (+ sth) Reduce the length, volume, or size of something
items.ex_en: The editor told the reporter to cut down the lengthy article by half.
items.ex_zh: 编辑吩咐记者将那篇冗长文章的篇幅削减一半。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Reduce the dimensions, size, or scope of something in proportion
items.ex_en: The developer had to scale down the residential project because of rising costs.
items.ex_zh: 由于成本上升，开发商不得不按比例缩减该住宅项目的规模。

items.def_en: (+ to) To shorten a word, phrase, or piece of writing by omitting letters, sounds, or parts.
items.ex_en: In academic writing, authors often abbreviate complex chemical terms to simple acronyms.
items.ex_zh: 在学术写作中，作者常将复杂的化学术语缩写为简单的首字母缩略词。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Reduce a liquid or text to its essential, concentrated elements
items.ex_en: The analyst managed to boil down the lengthy report into three key points.
items.ex_zh: 分析师成功地将那份冗长的报告浓缩为三个核心要点。
items.ex2_en: The complex international disagreement essentially boils down to basic territorial boundaries.
items.ex2_zh: 复杂的国际分歧归根结底主要是基本的领土边界问题。

items.def_en: [I/T] To press something into a smaller space or decrease its volume
items.ex_en: Powerful hydraulic machinery can compress industrial waste into dense, manageable cubes.
items.ex_zh: 强大的液压机械能将工业废料压缩成紧密且易于处理的立方体。
items.ex2_en: Spongy insulation foam easily compresses under the pressure of heavy floor tiles.
items.ex2_zh: 海绵状隔热泡沫在重型地砖的压力下极易被压缩。

items.def_zh: 使凝缩，压缩（文字或体积）
items.def_en: [I/T] To make something more compact, dense, or shorter in substance or words
items.ex_en: The author worked tirelessly to condense the sprawling narrative into a concise volume.
items.ex_zh: 作者夜以继日地工作，力求将那部篇幅浩繁的叙事作品压缩为简明的单行本。
items.ex2_en: Warm humid air condenses into tiny water droplets upon meeting cold glass.
items.ex2_zh: 温暖潮湿的空气遇到冷玻璃便凝结成微小的水滴。

items.def_zh: （使）放气，（使）瘪掉；打消（气焰），挫伤（信心）；紧缩（通货）
items.def_en: 1. To let air or gas out of something, or to become smaller by losing air or gas. 2. To make someone feel less confident or proud. 3. To reduce the level of economic activity or money supply.
items.ex_en: He opened the air valve slowly to deflate the large inflatable swimming pool.
items.ex_zh: 他慢慢打开气阀，让巨大的充气游泳池排气瘪掉。
items.ex2_en: The punctured bicycle tire deflated completely before he could reach home.
items.ex2_zh: 被扎破的自行车轮胎在他到家前就已经完全漏气瘪了。

items.def_en: To shorten a piece of writing or speech without losing its central sense
items.ex_en: The publisher commissioned an editor to abridge the classic novel for young readers.
items.ex_zh: 出版商委托一名编辑为年轻读者删节这部经典小说。

items.def_en: To shorten something by cutting off the top, end, or tail portion
items.ex_en: The software will automatically truncate long filenames to prevent system errors.
items.ex_zh: 该软件会自动截断过长的文件名以防止系统出错。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail reducing the physical length, spatial volume, air pressure, or written length of something. 'Abbreviate' focuses specifically on shortening words or written accounts, while 'deflate' specifically reduces volume by removing trapped air or gas.
groups.summary_zh: 通过省略、排气或挤压，使长度、体积或篇幅缩减变小。
groups.desc_en: Reduces the temporal duration, spatial length, or information volume of an item while retaining essential substance, contrasting with destructive mutilation.
groups.desc_zh: 在保留核心实质的前提下缩减事物的时间跨度、物理长度或信息体量，区别于破坏性的残损削割。
groups.nuance_en: abbreviate: shortening words or symbols by truncating letters (term / title / name) · abridge: condensing long text while retaining core narrative or argument (novel / dictionary / rights) · condense: concentrating volume or vapor into a denser, compact form (milk / steam / report) · boil down: reducing complex information to its essential core (argument / issue / essence)
groups.nuance_zh: abbreviate: 截断字母缩写词语符号 (term / title / name) · abridge: 删节缩编文本但保留核心脉络 (novel / dictionary / rights) · condense: 将流体或长篇内容浓缩精炼 (milk / steam / report) · boil down: 复杂事实剥离杂质、归结提炼至本质 (argument / issue / essence)

groups.name: Sift & Sieve · 筛滤与细致排查 (Sift, Sieve, Riddle)
groups.tip: 用细孔筛网过滤粗粒杂质

items.def_en: to pass substances through a coarse wire mesh or systematically check items to eliminate unsuitable ones
items.ex_en: Workers use vibrating metal meshes to screen gravel by particle size efficiently.
items.ex_zh: 工人们使用振动金属网按颗粒大小高效筛分碎石。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Examine a large amount of information, evidence, or matter carefully to find what is relevant
items.ex_en: Detectives spent days to sift through piles of evidence from the crime scene.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们花了好几天时间细致排查来自犯罪现场的大量物证。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Filter out or eliminate unwanted individuals, substances, or elements
items.ex_en: Automated filters help recruiters screen out unqualified applicants before the interview stage.
items.ex_zh: 自动化过滤器帮助招聘人员在面试阶段前筛掉不合格的应聘者。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Reduce a list or group of candidates or items by gradually eliminating the less suitable ones
items.ex_en: The admissions committee will winnow down hundreds of applications to twenty finalists.
items.ex_zh: 招生委员会将对数百份申请进行逐步筛选，最终锁定二十名入围者。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Remove or eliminate unwanted, inferior, or troublesome members or things from a group
items.ex_en: The preliminary trial serves to weed out weak competitors before the national championship.
items.ex_zh: 预赛旨在全国锦标赛前淘汰实力较弱的竞争者。

items.def_zh: 用粗筛筛选（矿石、泥土等）
items.def_en: to pass gravel, soil, or coal through a coarse wire mesh or sieve to separate fragments
items.ex_en: Old quarrymen would riddle coarse earth before carting the stones away.
items.ex_zh: 老采石工人在用车拉走石块之前，会先用粗筛筛分粗土。

items.def_zh: 筛分，过滤；细查，详审；撒落
items.def_en: 1. To pass a powder or loose substance through a sieve to separate fine parts from lumps. 2. (+ through) To examine information or evidence thoroughly to isolate what is useful or true.
items.ex_en: The baker gently began to sift flour over the counter before kneading dough.
items.ex_zh: 面包师在揉面之前，轻轻地开始将面粉过筛撒在操作台上。

items.def_en: To pass a liquid, powder, or grain through a sieve to remove coarse particles.
items.ex_en: She used a fine wire mesh to sieve lumps from the cocoa powder.
items.ex_zh: 她用细铁丝网筛掉可可粉中的结块。

items.def_zh: 扬谷扬去糠秕；去粗取精，筛选出
items.def_en: (+ out/down) to separate chaff from grain by air current, or narrow down a group to find the best elements
items.ex_en: Farmers toss the gathered wheat high into the breeze to winnow the chaff.
items.ex_zh: 农夫们把收获的麦子高高扬入微风中以吹去糠秕。

groups.summary_en: An agent separates finer particles from coarser matter using a mesh instrument, or figuratively examines large quantities of evidence or data to extract what is relevant. Verbs in this frame contrast physical mesh-straining with meticulous intellectual sorting.
groups.summary_zh: 用筛网分离颗粒物杂质，或引申为在海量材料中严密筛查出有用信息。
groups.desc_en: Passes mixed matter through porous mesh or fine criteria to separate desirable components from coarse residue, contrasting with indiscriminate dumping.
groups.desc_zh: 使混合物通过多孔介质或精密判据，将有用组分与粗劣残渣分离，区别于不加甄别的倾倒或粗筛。
groups.nuance_en: sift: passing powdery substances through a mesh, or meticulously analyzing details (flour / evidence / clues) · sieve: mechanical straining of liquids or solids through a perforated vessel (sand / soup / gravel) · screen: testing or filtering candidates against threshold eligibility standards (applicants / baggage / calls) · winnow down: progressively eliminating inferior options until few remain (choices / candidates / field)
groups.nuance_zh: sift: 细网过筛粉末，或极其严谨地抽丝剥茧排查 (flour / evidence / clues) · sieve: 用多孔筛网进行固液分离或粒度分级 (sand / soup / gravel) · screen: 依据门槛条件进行批量初审筛选 (applicants / baggage / calls) · winnow down: 去芜存菁，将庞大备选集逐轮淘汰收窄 (choices / candidates / field)

groups.name: Signal & Indicate · 示意与发信号 (Flag, Signal, Motion)
groups.tip: 用动作或暗号传达意图

items.def_en: (+ sb) Direct someone by making a non-verbal gesture with hands or head
items.ex_en: The usher quietly motioned to the late arrivals toward the empty back seats.
items.ex_zh: 领位员悄悄向迟到的人打手势，示意他们去后排空位就座。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Signal to the driver of a vehicle to stop by waving one's hand or an object
items.ex_en: The stranded motorist tried desperately to flag down passing vehicles on the highway.
items.ex_zh: 被困的驾车者在公路上拼命招手，试图拦停过往车辆。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Motion to someone or a vehicle to proceed by moving one's hand
items.ex_en: The traffic officer checked our permit quickly and then waved us on.
items.ex_zh: 交警迅速检查了我们的许可证，随后摆手示意我们继续前行。

items.raw_cluster: 示意与发信号 Signal & Flag
items.def_zh: 示意，打信号（如挥手拦截车辆）；标出，标示；衰退，变弱
items.def_en: 1. to signal someone (such as a driver) to stop or pay attention, especially by waving a hand or flag. 2. to mark or draw attention to something for special handling. 3. to become tired, weaker, or less enthusiastic.
items.ex_en: The patrol officer stood in the road to flag incoming traffic to stop.
items.ex_zh: 巡警站在路中央打信号示意迎面而来的车辆停下。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ to/toward) to direct or signal someone with a movement of the hand, head, or body
items.ex_en: The director made a slight gesture to motion toward the waiting actors offstage.
items.ex_zh: 导演做了一个微小的手势，示意候在台下的演员上场。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ at) to shine or flicker a light as a visual signal or warning
items.ex_en: The truck driver began to flash his headlights at the speeding car ahead.
items.ex_zh: 卡车司机开始向前方的超速车辆闪烁大灯以示警告。
items.ex2_en: Bright hazard lights flashed continuously along the shoulder of the dark highway.
items.ex2_zh: 明亮的危险报警灯在黑暗公路的路肩上不停闪烁。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make a gesture with the hand, arm, or head to encourage someone to approach
items.ex_en: The shopkeeper smiled warmly and beckoned the curious tourists inside the store.
items.ex_zh: 店主热情地微笑，招手示意好奇的游客进店。

items.def_en: to wave your hand or an object to signal a moving vehicle to halt
items.ex_en: We stood on the roadside trying in vain to wave down an empty taxi.
items.ex_zh: 我们站在路边，徒劳地试图招手拦下一辆空出租车。

items.def_en: 1. to make a movement, sound, or action to give a message or order to someone. 2. to indicate, express, or make known a feeling, intention, or change.
items.ex_en: The referee raised his arm to signal the immediate end of the match.
items.ex_zh: 裁判举起手臂，示意比赛立即结束。

groups.summary_en: A person communicates a message, warning, or operational instruction using gestures, lights, visual markers, or formal indicators rather than full speech. Verbs vary by the channel employed, from waving down traffic to flashing optical codes.
groups.summary_zh: 通过手势、视听标志或信号装置传达警告、意图或指令。
groups.desc_en: Conveys visual gestural or optical cues to arrest attention or impart directional instructions, contrasting with verbal broadcasting or tacit inaction.
groups.desc_zh: 通过身体手势或光学符号传达视觉提示以引起注意或给出动作指引，区别于语言播报或静默不作为。
groups.nuance_en: flag down: waving urgently to force a moving vehicle to stop (taxi / police / driver) · motion: using hand or head gestures to direct someone's movement (towards / forward / inside) · beckon: gesturing attractively with finger or hand to summon someone closer (stranger / crowd / follower) · flash: pulsing lights abruptly to alert or warn (headlights / warning / signal)
groups.nuance_zh: flag down: 挥手动手势拦截逼停行驶车辆 (taxi / police / driver) · motion: 用手势或点头示意他人动作朝向 (towards / forward / inside) · beckon: 招手或屈指呼唤召唤他人走近 (stranger / crowd / follower) · flash: 闪烁灯光以示告警或联络 (headlights / warning / signal)

groups.name: Simulate & Put On · 伪装与假冒 (Pretend, Sham, Feign)
groups.tip: 装模作样掩盖真相与伪装

items.def_en: (+ that/sb) Claim or pretend falsely that something is true or that someone is a certain way
items.ex_en: He tried to make out that he knew all the famous celebrities personally.
items.ex_zh: 他试图假称自己私下认识所有那些著名的名人。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Pretend to have a particular feeling, quality, or manner to impress or deceive
items.ex_en: She had to put on an air of calm confidence during the interrogation.
items.ex_zh: 在审讯过程中，她不得不装出一副从容自信的样子。

items.def_en: to artificially put on a style, mannerism, or attitude to impress or mislead
items.ex_en: The diplomat tended to affect a bored indifference during controversial public debates.
items.ex_zh: 这位外交官在有争议的公开辩论中往往做作地摆出一副漠不关心的样子。

items.def_en: to invent, simulate, or imitate falsely to mislead others
items.ex_en: The child tried to fake a severe cough to avoid attending school today.
items.ex_zh: 这孩子试图装出剧烈咳嗽的样子，以逃避今天去上学。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth as sb/sth) Falsely represent someone or something to be another entity through deception
items.ex_en: The con artist attempted to pass off cheap glass beads as genuine diamonds.
items.ex_zh: 这个骗子企图把廉价的玻璃珠假冒成真钻石。

items.def_en: To act as if something is true when it is not, especially in pretend play or to deceive.
items.ex_en: The boy liked to pretend he was an astronaut exploring distant uncharted planets.
items.ex_zh: 那男孩喜欢假装自己是一名正在探索遥远未知行星的宇航员。

items.def_en: To pretend to have or feel something in order to deceive others.
items.ex_en: Don't sham ignorance when we all know you witnessed the entire incident.
items.ex_zh: 我们都知道你目击了整件事，就别再装糊涂了。

items.def_en: to simulate an illness, emotion, or state with intent to deceive
items.ex_en: The tired soldier decided to feign illness in order to escape rigorous guard duty.
items.ex_zh: 那个疲惫的士兵决定装病，以逃避严酷的站岗任务。

items.def_en: [I/T] to conceal one's true motives, beliefs, or feelings by false appearance
items.ex_en: A skilled politician knows how to dissemble his ambitions behind modest rhetoric.
items.ex_zh: 老练的政客懂得如何用谦逊的说辞来掩饰自己的野心。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the deliberate adoption of an outward false appearance, emotion, or condition in order to deceive onlookers, distinguished by register and the degree of theatricality or deceit involved.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过神态、举止故意装出某种假象以蒙蔽他人。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves adopting a deceptive exterior or false behavioral posture to fabricate an emotion, identity, or state of affairs, contrasting with simple lying by relying on overt enactment and performance rather than verbal misrepresentation alone.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式是通过虚假举止或外在伪装来演出某种情绪、身份或事实，与单纯说谎相比，其核心在于外在行为的表演性与做作性伪造而非单纯言语欺瞒。
groups.nuance_en: pretend: general mental or playful roleplay (innocence / ignorance) · feign: artful simulation of internal conditions or ailments (madness / interest / illness) · sham: dishonest enactment to dupe observers (grief / piety) · affect: conscious artificial adoption of mannerisms or accents (airs / indifference / accent) · fake: direct counterfeit production or performance (injury / smile / orgasm)
groups.nuance_zh: pretend: 通用假装或角色扮演 (innocence / ignorance) · feign: 精心伪装生理病痛或内在情绪 (madness / interest / illness) · sham: 旨在蒙蔽旁人的虚伪做戏 (grief / piety) · affect: 刻意矫揉造作地采纳某种神态或腔调 (airs / indifference / accent) · fake: 冒名顶替或直接伪造外表行为 (injury / smile / orgasm)

groups.name: Slacken to Enfeeble · 放缓、衰竭与削弱 (Slacken, Wither, Enfeeble)
groups.tip: 力量或状态逐渐减弱消退

items.def_en: Become slower, less active, or less intense in effort or tension
items.ex_en: The violent rainstorm began to slacken off as evening approached the valley.
items.ex_zh: 随着夜幕降临山谷，狂暴的暴风雨开始逐渐减弱。

items.def_en: [I/T] to lose strength or power, or cause someone or something to do so
items.ex_en: Prolonged malnutrition will inevitably weaken the patient's immune system over time.
items.ex_zh: 长期的营养不良随着时间的推移必然会削弱患者的免疫系统。
items.ex2_en: The fierce hurricane winds began to weaken significantly over the mountainous terrain.
items.ex2_zh: 凶猛的飓风在山岳地带上空开始明显减弱。

items.def_zh: 放慢，减缓，减弱；（使）变松，松开
items.def_en: 1. (+ off/up) To become or make something slower, less active, or less intense. 2. To become looser, or make something loose.
items.ex_en: The captain ordered his crew to slacken the mooring ropes before departing.
items.ex_zh: 船长在启航前命令船员们松开系泊缆绳。
items.ex2_en: Torrential rain slackened after midnight, offering relief to the flooded valley.
items.ex2_zh: 午夜过后倾盆大雨减弱了，给被水淹没的山谷带来了喘息之机。

items.def_en: Slowly lose strength, health, or vitality until near death or extinction
items.ex_en: Without proper medical care, the injured stray dog began to fade away slowly.
items.ex_zh: 得不到适当的医疗救治，受伤的流浪狗生命活力逐渐衰竭。

items.def_zh: 消除两极分化；（物理、生物）去极化，消除极化
items.def_en: 1. To reduce or eliminate sharp polarization or division between opposing groups. 2. (physics / biology) To remove or reduce electrical or magnetic polarization.
items.ex_en: Civic leaders organized forums aimed to depolarize the bitterly divided community.
items.ex_zh: 民间领袖组织了多场论坛，旨在消除这个严重分裂的社区中的两极分化。
items.ex2_en: Public opinions depolarized considerably as factual information reached both opposing sides.
items.ex2_zh: 随着真实信息传达给对立双方，公众观点明显不再那么两极分化。

items.def_en: Gradually become physically weak and thin through illness or starvation
items.ex_en: Without proper treatment, the patient began to waste away rapidly.
items.ex_zh: 若不接受适当治疗，患者便会迅速衰弱消瘦。

items.def_en: to severely impair the strength or vitality of someone or something
items.ex_en: Severe respiratory infections can debilitate elderly patients for several consecutive months.
items.ex_zh: 严重的呼吸道感染会使老年患者连续数月虚弱不堪。

items.def_en: 1. (formal) To make a person, body, or institution very weak, frail, or powerless.
items.ex_en: Decades of rampant corruption served to enfeeble the once-mighty royal dynasty.
items.ex_zh: 数十年猖獗的腐败彻底削弱了曾经强盛一时的皇家王朝。

items.def_en: [I/T] to waste away or decline in effectiveness due to lack of use or disease
items.ex_en: Muscles quickly begin to atrophy if a limb remains immobilized inside a cast.
items.ex_zh: 如果肢体被石膏固定不动，肌肉很快就会开始萎缩。
items.ex2_en: Prolonged bed rest will rapidly atrophy vital muscle groups in elderly patients.
items.ex2_zh: 长期卧床会使老年患者的重要肌群迅速萎缩。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe a loss of vigor, physical tension, vitality, or structural strength, progressing in intensity from mild slackening of pace/tension to debilitating physical or biological enfeeblement.
groups.summary_zh: 描述力量、紧张感或生理机能从放缓松弛逐步恶化到虚弱枯竭的过程。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves a continuous downward trajectory of vitality, tension, or systemic capacity toward exhaustion, contrasting with episodic weakening by emphasizing organic dissipation, structural loosening, or lingering physical decline.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现生命力、张力或系统机能持续衰退直至枯竭的渐进轨迹，与突发削弱相比，更侧重有机消散、张力松弛或缓慢虚耗的病理/生理退化过程。
groups.nuance_en: slacken: reduction in rate, tension, or vigilance (pace / tension / discipline) · wither: shriveling and loss of moisture, vitality, or relevance (vine / limb / hopes) · enfeeble: deeply sap structural or constitutional strength (monarchy / constitution / resolve) · debilitate: render physically frail or operationally incapacitated by illness or strain (body / economy / patient) · waste away: gradual somatic emaciation through chronic affliction (flesh / tissues)
groups.nuance_zh: slacken: 速度、张力或警惕性放缓松懈 (pace / tension / discipline) · wither: 因失水失活而枯萎衰亡 (vine / limb / hopes) · enfeeble: 极大削弱体制、精神或制度根基 (monarchy / constitution / resolve) · debilitate: 因病痛或负荷导致身体/机能严重受损虚脱 (body / economy / patient) · waste away: 因慢性消耗而日渐消瘦衰亡 (flesh / tissues)

groups.name: Slip Away & Evade · 逃遁与规避 (Elude, Bunk, Abscond)
groups.tip: 巧妙躲避追查与危险

items.def_en: to depart quietly and unnoticed without attracting attention
items.ex_en: Don't let this incredible opportunity slip away.
items.ex_zh: 别让这个绝佳的机会悄悄溜走。

items.def_en: Depart quietly or secretly without attracting attention
items.ex_en: He managed to slip off while everyone was distracted by the fireworks display.
items.ex_zh: 当大家的注意力都被烟花表演吸引时，他悄悄溜走了。

items.def_en: Leave quickly or secretly, especially to avoid an awkward situation, obligation, or duty
items.ex_en: She decided to duck out of the boring meeting during the coffee break.
items.ex_zh: 她决定趁着茶歇时间从那场无聊的会议中溜走。

items.def_en: Move away quietly and stealthily so as not to be seen or heard
items.ex_en: The burglar tried to sneak away through the unlocked kitchen window undetected.
items.ex_zh: 窃贼企图从未上锁的厨房窗户神不知鬼不觉地偷偷溜走。

items.def_en: Leave hurriedly, especially in order to escape capture or detection
items.ex_en: The burglar made off as soon as the burglar alarm went off.
items.ex_zh: 防盗警报一响，窃贼就仓皇逃窜了。

items.def_en: to escape or avoid someone or something by ingenuity or cleverness
items.ex_en: The clever fox managed to evade the hounds by swimming across the stream.
items.ex_zh: 聪明的狐狸通过游过小溪成功躲过了猎犬的追踪。

items.def_zh: 逃跑，溜走；逃学，旷工；搭铺，睡简易床
items.def_en: 1. To run away or escape hastily. 2. ('bunk off') (British informal) To stay away from school or work without permission. 3. ('bunk down') To sleep in a simple bed or bunk.
items.ex_en: The frightened thief chose to bunk through the back alley when sirens sounded.
items.ex_zh: 警报声响起时，受惊的贼选择仓皇从后巷溜走逃跑。

items.def_zh: 逃避，躲避；使避开；把……难倒，不为……所理解
items.def_en: 1. To manage to escape from or avoid being caught by someone through cleverness or quickness. 2. If a fact, name, or solution eludes you, you cannot remember or understand it.
items.ex_en: The elusive criminal continued to elude the police by adopting multiple false identities.
items.ex_zh: 那个行踪诡秘的罪犯通过使用多个虚假身份，继续躲避警方的追捕。

items.def_en: to leave secretly and quietly, typically to escape custody or avoid arrest
items.ex_en: The corrupt treasurer planned to abscond to a foreign country with public funds.
items.ex_zh: 那名腐败的财务主管企图携公款潜逃至国外。

groups.summary_en: A person quickly departs without permission or deftly slips away to avoid capture, duty, or confrontation. Verbs range from colloquial bolting to formal stealthy avoidance or absconding.
groups.summary_zh: 为躲避追捕、责任或抓获而秘密溜走或机警避开。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema denotes departing or dodging through stealth, swiftness, or cunning to avoid capture, duty, or confrontation, contrasting with plain fleeing by highlighting surreptitious maneuvering and successful evasion.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式指凭借潜行、敏捷或诡计脱身，以规避拘捕、责任或对峙，与一般逃跑相比，突出其神不知鬼不觉的机动策略与成功摆脱的规避性。
groups.nuance_en: slip away: quiet unobtrusive departure without notice (party / unnoticed / crowd) · sneak away: stealthy, furtive exit to conceal guilt or escape detection (meeting / darkness) · evade: skillfully dodge pursuit, question, or obligation (capture / taxes / questions) · elude: frustrate capture or grasp by agility or cleverness (pursuers / grasp / detection) · abscond: flee covertly, typically with stolen assets or to escape legal custody (funds / bail)
groups.nuance_zh: slip away: 悄然离场而不引人注目 (party / unnoticed / crowd) · sneak away: 鬼祟溜走以避人耳目 (meeting / darkness) · evade: 巧妙闪避追捕、审问或法定责任 (capture / taxes / questions) · elude: 凭机智敏捷使追捕者或捕捉者扑空 (pursuers / grasp / detection) · abscond: 携款潜逃或违保脱逃 (funds / bail)

groups.name: Smooth & Align · 抹平与理顺 (Slick, Preen, Straighten)
groups.tip: 抚平褶皱理顺表面

items.def_en: to disentangle and straighten tangled hair or fleece using a comb
items.ex_en: The mother gently began to comb out the stubborn knots in her daughter's hair.
items.ex_zh: 母亲温柔地开始梳理顺女儿头发上那些顽固的发结。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to flatten hair back against the head using oil, gel, or water
items.ex_en: He applied scented pomade to slick back his hair before the formal dinner.
items.ex_zh: 在正式晚宴之前，他抹上有香味的发油把头发向后梳平。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to make someone or something look neater, cleaner, and more attractive
items.ex_en: We spent all morning trying to spruce up the old cottage for guests.
items.ex_zh: 我们花了一整个上午收拾打扮这间老屋，准备迎接客人。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to push the loose edges of a garment neatly into a waistband or other piece of clothing
items.ex_en: The schoolboy had to tuck in his wrinkled shirt before entering the classroom.
items.ex_zh: 这个男学生在进教室之前必须把皱巴巴的衬衫下摆掖好整平。

items.def_zh: 理顺，抹平（头发等，常与 back/down 连用）；使光滑
items.def_en: to make hair or a surface smooth, flat, and shiny, especially by applying oil, gel, or water
items.ex_en: The barber used wet styling gel to slick the young man's unruly hair.
