items.ex_zh: 干燥的天气导致旧外墙的抹灰层开裂并成片剥落。

items.def_en: to drop off or be scraped away in flakes or thin scales
items.ex_en: Moisture accumulation made coats of degraded paint scale off the brick masonry.
items.ex_zh: 水分积聚使得砖墙表面老化变质的漆层成片剥落。
items.ex2_en: The sharp scraper will easily scale off the thick layer of rust.
items.ex2_zh: 这把锋利的刮刀可以轻松刮掉那层厚厚的铁锈。

items.def_en: to scrape off the tough outer plates or encrusted surface layer from something
items.ex_en: The apprentice spent the morning helping the chef scale fresh rainbow trout.
items.ex_zh: 学徒整个上午都在帮主厨刮去新鲜虹鳟鱼的鳞片。

items.def_en: To remove the dry outer covering from grains, nuts, or corn.
items.ex_en: Rural millers work through chilly mornings to husk abundant bushels of barley.
items.ex_zh: 乡村磨坊工人在清凉的清晨辛勤劳作，给数蒲式耳的大麦脱去外壳。

items.def_zh: 剥除；剥去（保护层或外壳）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to systematically peel off or remove an outer protective casing or covering
items.ex_en: Technicians must strip away protective insulating tape to inspect underlying electrical wires.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员必须剥除保护性绝缘胶带，以检查里面的电线。

items.def_en: (+ off/away) to pull or peel off an outer covering, sheath, or layer by force
items.ex_en: The apprentice had to strip damaged plastic sheath off exposed copper wires.
items.ex_zh: 学徒不得不剥除裸露铜线上受损的塑料护套层。

items.def_zh: 剥（玉米）苞叶；剥（牡蛎等）外壳；脱去（衣服）
items.def_en: To remove the outer shell or covering from oysters, corn, etc.; to take off clothes quickly.
items.ex_en: Fishermen teach novices how to quickly shuck stubborn oysters without hurting fingers.
items.ex_zh: 渔民教授新手如何在不伤及手指的情况下快速撬剥坚硬的牡蛎壳。

items.def_zh: （使）烧蚀，（使）消融；（医学上）切除，消融
items.def_en: (specialist) To wear away or be worn away by heat, friction, or melting; to surgically remove body tissue.
items.ex_en: Specialized laser beams ablate precise layers of corneal tissue during corrective eye surgery.
items.ex_zh: 在眼部矫正手术中，专用激光束能消融切除极其精准的角膜组织层。
items.ex2_en: The surface ice on the glacier began to ablate rapidly under heat.
items.ex2_zh: 冰川表面的冰层在高温下开始迅速消融。

items.def_zh: 脱落，剥落（层状外皮/角质）
items.def_en: [I/T] to cast off, shed, or peel away in thin layers, scales, or flakes
items.ex_en: Dermatologists recommend gentle cleansers that help exfoliate dead epidermal surface cells naturally.
items.ex_zh: 皮肤科医生推荐使用有助于自然剥落表皮坏死细胞的温和洁面乳。
items.ex2_en: Dry skin patches will naturally exfoliate after several warm, soothing baths.
items.ex2_zh: 泡过几次舒缓的热水澡后，干燥的皮肤碎屑会自然脱落。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on detaching a tough protective casing, shell, or outer surface layer, spanning agricultural manual extraction (corn, shellfish) to technical and medical layer erosion.
groups.summary_zh: 指脱除硬质外苞、甲壳外层，或技术/医学上剥离侵蚀表层。
groups.desc_en: Denotes shedding, peeling, or ablating outer husks, flakes, or surface strata layer by layer, contrasting with internal hollow-out or uniform dissolution.
groups.desc_zh: 指一层层脱除外壳、鳞片或使表层材料脱落，区别于内部掏空或均匀溶解。
groups.nuance_en: husk: strip the dry enclosing leafy sheath from grain or nuts (corn / grains / coconut) · shuck: remove shells or husks vigorously (oysters / clams / corn) · ablate: erode, vaporize, or peel away surface material via heat or friction (rock / tumor / heat shield) · flake off: detach in thin small dry scales or chips (paint / rust / skin) · scale off: shed or peel away hard encrusted layers (fish / rust / boiler scale)
groups.nuance_zh: husk: 剥除谷物、干果干燥包皮 (corn / grains / coconut) · shuck: 剥撬硬贝壳或苞叶 (oysters / clams / corn) · ablate: 经消融、热蚀剥除表层 (rock / tumor / heat shield) · flake off: 呈片状干屑剥落 (paint / rust / skin) · scale off: 刮除硬质鳞片或水垢 (fish / rust / boiler scale)

groups.name: Stroll & Wander Aimlessly · 漫步与闲荡 (Unhurried Directionless Walking)
groups.tip: 无固定目的地闲逛

items.def_en: to spend time moving about in an unhurried, aimless way doing small casual tasks
items.ex_en: Grandpa loves to potter about the vegetable garden on lazy Sunday mornings.
items.ex_zh: 爷爷喜欢在惬意的周日清晨在菜园里闲逛，随手打理些琐事。

items.def_en: to walk in a leisurely, relaxed manner
items.ex_en: Couples often stroll along the breezy riverside promenade during warm summer evenings.
items.ex_zh: 在温暖的夏夜，情侣们常常沿着微风轻拂的河滨步道悠闲漫步。

items.def_en: to walk around a place casually without any specific direction or purpose
items.ex_en: Curious tourists love to wander around historic town squares without any map.
items.ex_zh: 好奇的游客喜欢漫无目的地四处闲逛历史悠久的城镇广场，不带任何地图。

items.def_zh: 闲逛，信步漫步；从容做琐事，消磨时间
items.def_en: 1. (chiefly BrE) To walk or move about slowly and aimlessly. 2. To spend time doing small, pleasant, or trivial tasks in a relaxed way.
items.ex_en: He prefers to potter in his woodworking shed whenever free afternoons arise.
items.ex_zh: 每逢空闲的下午，他更喜欢在木工棚里漫步悠闲地捣鼓杂活。

items.def_en: to walk in a slow, relaxed, and leisurely manner
items.ex_en: Retired neighbors like to stroll through the landscaped park every pleasant evening.
items.ex_zh: 退休的邻居们喜欢在每个宜人的傍晚漫步穿过风景优美的公园。

items.def_zh: 漫步，闲逛，游荡；走神，神游；迷失方向
items.def_en: 1. To walk or move around slowly and without a specific destination or purpose. 2. (of thoughts or attention) To lose focus or drift away.
items.ex_en: Lost hikers continued to wander through misty pine woods hoping for shelter.
items.ex_zh: 迷路的徒步旅行者继续在多雾的松林中漫无目的地游荡，希望能找到避难处。

items.def_en: to walk at a slow, gentle, and unhurried pace
items.ex_en: Families amble down shady village avenues enjoying the cool pleasant evening breeze.
items.ex_zh: 一家老小沿着绿树成荫的乡村林荫道缓缓漫步，享受凉爽惬意的晚风。

items.def_en: to walk along with a confident, proud, or entirely unhurried air
items.ex_en: Confident models saunter along luxury hotel lobbies attracting admiring glances from bystanders.
items.ex_zh: 自信的模特慢悠悠地信步穿过豪华酒店大堂，引来旁观者赞许的目光。

items.def_en: to follow a winding and turning course without clear destination
items.ex_en: Clear shallow mountain streams meander gracefully through quiet emerald valleys and meadows.
items.ex_zh: 清澈浅缓的山间溪流优雅地蜿蜒流经宁静翠绿的山谷与草甸。

groups.summary_en: An individual walks or moves about at an unhurried, leisurely pace without a fixed goal, often engaging in small, casual domestic or observational activities along the way.
groups.summary_zh: 步调从容无目的漫行，或在小范围内优哉游哉走走停停。
groups.desc_en: Denotes leisurely, unhurried pedestrian locomotion lacking an urgent destination, contrasting with goal-oriented trekking or brisk marching.
groups.desc_zh: 指无紧迫目的地、从容舒缓的步行或信步漫游，区别于目标明确的快步疾行或行军。
groups.nuance_en: stroll: walk at a calm, recreational, leisurely pace (along the promenade / in the park) · wander: roam aimlessly or drift off-course without fixed path (around the streets / through the woods) · amble: move along at an easy, relaxed, slow rhythm (down the lane / into the room) · saunter: walk in a confident, unhurried, nonchalant manner (into the lobby / across the street) · potter: spend time aimlessly moving and doing minor trifles (about the garden / in the shed)
groups.nuance_zh: stroll: 闲适惬意地散步 (along the promenade / in the park) · wander: 漫无目的地闲逛游荡 (around the streets / through the woods) · amble: 悠然缓步慢行 (down the lane / into the room) · saunter: 步履轻快从容、神态自若漫步 (into the lobby / across the street) · potter: 慢条斯理地瞎忙碎活 (about the garden / in the shed)

groups.name: Structural Analysis & Dissection · 剖析与解构 (Deconstruct, Dissect, Parse)
groups.tip: 层层解剖细部脉络

items.def_en: to analyze a multifaceted concept, quote, or phenomenon point by point to reveal underlying meanings
items.ex_en: Our literature professor will unpack ambiguous philosophical symbolism within this modernist poem.
items.ex_zh: 我们的文学教授将拆解分析这首现代主义诗歌中含混的哲学象征意义。

items.def_zh: 对（句子或代码）作语法分析，句法剖析；仔细推敲，深入剖析
items.def_en: To analyze a sentence or string of computer code into its grammatical parts; to examine or analyze something closely.
items.ex_en: Computational compilers must parse complex code syntax before translating instructions into executables.
items.ex_zh: 计算编译器必须在将指令翻译成可执行文件前对其复杂代码语法进行句法剖析。

items.def_zh: 细分剖析；解构（结构或论点）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to divide a complex idea, argument, or structure into its component parts to analyze it
items.ex_en: The financial consultant helped us break down complicated monthly corporate expenditure reports.
items.ex_zh: 财务顾问帮助我们细分剖析了纷繁复杂的企业月度支出报告。
items.ex2_en: The complex historical argument broke down into several distinct theoretical components.
items.ex2_zh: 这篇复杂的历史论点分解成了几个明确的理论组成部分。

items.def_zh: 梳理出；剖析出（细节或深层含义）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to carefully extract, separate, or analyze complex details or meaning from a larger body of information
items.ex_en: The researcher attempted to tease out meaningful patterns from the dense statistical data.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员试图从纷繁复杂的统计数据中梳理出有价值的规律。

items.def_en: to examine or inspect closely and thoroughly with keen critical attention
items.ex_en: Regulatory authorities will scrutinize the proposed merger to prevent unlawful market monopolization.
items.ex_zh: 监管机构将严密审视这项拟议的合并，以防止非法的市场垄断。

items.def_zh: 解构，剖析，拆解（文本、理论或概念）
items.def_en: To analyze a text, artwork, or cultural theory carefully to reveal its underlying structure, contradictions, and hidden assumptions.
items.ex_en: Her latest book seeks to deconstruct traditional narratives surrounding early colonial history.
items.ex_zh: 她的最新著作试图解构围绕早期殖民历史的传统叙事。

items.def_zh: 彻底剖析；严厉解构（论点或理论）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to rigorously dismantle and critically analyze the components or weaknesses of an argument or text
items.ex_en: The defense attorney proceeded to take apart the prosecutor's flimsy argument piece by piece.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师接着将控方站不住脚的论点逐一彻底剖析击碎。

items.def_en: to examine and analyze minutely, laying bare each constituent part or systemic flaw
items.ex_en: The essay meticulously anatomizes the social inequities embedded within the modern legal framework.
items.ex_zh: 该论文细致剖析了根植于现代法律体系之内的社会不公。

items.def_zh: 仔细剖析，深入分析；解剖（动植物尸体）
items.def_en: 1. To examine or analyze an argument, text, or failure in minute detail. 2. To cut open a dead body or plant to study its internal structure.
items.ex_en: Scholars continue to dissect the philosophical underpinnings of this controversial twentieth-century manifesto.
items.ex_zh: 学者们仍在深入分析这份饱受争议的二十世纪宣言背后的哲学基础。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify rigorous, critical intellectual scrutiny wherein a complex argument, biological specimen, or linguistic string is decomposed into its fundamental structural components.
groups.summary_zh: 将复杂对象、文本或论点细致拆解为基底要素进行微观分析。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the meticulous, methodical breaking down of an intricate text, argument, or system into constituent elements to inspect its workings, contrasting with superficial evaluation.
groups.desc_zh: 指将复杂文本、论点或系统逐层剖析分解以明晰其内在机理，区别于泛泛浏览或粗略评估。
groups.nuance_en: deconstruct: take apart assumptions to reveal underlying biases or mechanics (text / argument / myth) · dissect: anatomize and examine each structural component minutely (argument / corpse / market trends) · parse: analyze syntactic components or scrutinize ambiguous phrasing (sentence / statement / signals) · unpack: unfold and explain layered, dense concepts clearly (complex theory / assumptions / data) · anatomize: subject to exhaustive, forensic structural critique (society / failure / human nature)
groups.nuance_zh: deconstruct: 解构既定框架以暴露其预设 (text / argument / myth) · dissect: 巨细靡遗地解剖分析结构 (argument / corpse / market trends) · parse: 语法式逐字审视或拆解细察 (sentence / statement / signals) · unpack: 深入浅出拆解阐释复杂内涵 (complex theory / assumptions / data) · anatomize: 严密细致剖析体制或人性 (society / failure / human nature)

groups.name: Study & Learn · 学习与研习 (Educational Engagement & Knowledge Acquisition)
groups.tip: 探求新知并领悟掌握

items.def_zh: 学习，攻读；研读，审视，研究
items.def_en: 1. To spend time learning about a subject by reading, attending classes, etc. 2. To examine or consider something carefully.
items.ex_en: Medical researchers must study the virus extensively before formulating an effective vaccine.
items.ex_zh: 医学研究人员在研制出有效疫苗之前，必须对该病毒进行广泛研究。

items.def_zh: 学习，学到；得知，获悉；记住
items.def_en: 1. To gain knowledge of or skill in something through study, practice, or teaching. 2. To become aware of something by hearing, reading, or being told.
items.ex_en: New employees need time to learn the intricate details of company safety protocols.
items.ex_zh: 新员工需要时间来学习掌握公司安全规程的复杂细节。

items.def_en: to examine, read, or study a text or document with close and sustained attention
items.ex_en: The archivist spent hours poring over fragile manuscripts from the fourteenth century.
items.ex_zh: 档案管理员花了数小时仔细研读十四世纪的脆弱手稿。

items.def_en: (chiefly BrE) to study hard, especially by reading books when preparing for tests
items.ex_en: Tom decided to swot in the library all weekend before his final exams.
items.ex_zh: 汤姆决定整个周末都泡在图书馆里埋头苦读，迎接期末考试。

items.def_en: (+ on sth) to study a subject intensively in order to learn quickly about it
items.ex_en: I need to bone up on employment law before tomorrow morning's client consultation.
items.ex_zh: 在明早的客户咨询之前，我需要突击恶补一下劳动法知识。

items.def_en: (+ on sth) to study a subject quickly and intensely, especially immediately before an examination
items.ex_en: She stayed up all night to mug up on European history facts.
items.ex_zh: 她熬了整整一夜，拼命突击复习欧洲历史知识点。

items.def_en: (+ on sth) to study hard and thoroughly, usually for an upcoming test
items.ex_en: He went to his room early to swot up on organic chemistry equations.
items.ex_zh: 他早早回了房间，为即将到来的考试刻苦研读有机化学方程式。

items.def_zh: 突击死记硬背，临时抱佛脚
items.def_en: to prepare for an examination by studying intensively over a very short period
items.ex_en: Desperate students often try to cram an entire semester of material into one night.
items.ex_zh: 情急之下的学生往往试图在通宵里死记硬背整整一学期的内容。

items.def_en: (+ into) to research or study a subject deeply and systematically
items.ex_en: The investigative journalist resolved to delve into the mayor's undisclosed financial dealings.
items.ex_zh: 这位调查记者决心深入探究市长未予公开的财务交易。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate deliberate intellectual engagement with academic materials or instruction to acquire facts, principles, and competencies across various learning settings.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过阅读、听课、探究或突击备考等方式吸收文化与专业知识。
groups.desc_en: Denotes intense, dedicated intellectual labor to acquire knowledge or master educational content, contrasting with passive absorption or idle reading.
groups.desc_zh: 指为汲取知识或应对考核而投入的专注脑力研读，区别于消极被动吸收或消遣阅读。
groups.nuance_en: pore over: examine written materials with sustained, absorbing concentration (manuscript / documents / maps) · cram: stuff vast amounts of information into memory right before a deadline (for an exam / facts / vocabulary) · swot: study rigorously and doggedly over extended periods (for finals / on history) · bone up: review or quickly learn essentials on a specific subject (on tax law / for interview) · learn: acquire permanent comprehension or practical competence (language / skill / lesson)
groups.nuance_zh: pore over: 聚精会神伏案研读 (manuscript / documents / maps) · cram: 临考前死记硬背突击 (for an exam / facts / vocabulary) · swot: 刻苦钻研备考 (for finals / on history) · bone up: 临阵磨枪补习特定要点 (on tax law / for interview) · learn: 习得长效知识或技能 (language / skill / lesson)

groups.name: Subdue & Overpower · 压制与强行制服 (Restrain, Subdue, Overpower, Vanquish)
groups.tip: 以压倒性力量使其服从顺从

items.def_en: to use moderate physical or verbal force to prevent someone from moving, acting, or escalating
items.ex_en: Security officers acted swiftly to restrain the agitated protester near the podium.
items.ex_zh: 安保人员迅速采取行动，制止了讲台附近情绪激动的抗议者。

items.def_en: (+ down/against) to hold someone firmly against a surface so they cannot move
items.ex_en: The officer managed to pin the suspect against the brick wall until backup arrived.
items.ex_zh: 警官设法将嫌疑人按在砖墙上使其动弹不得，直到增援赶到。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to prevent someone from moving or rising by keeping physical weight or force on them
items.ex_en: Two burly guards rushed forward to hold down the violent intruder on the floor.
items.ex_zh: 两名身材魁梧的保安冲上前去，将强行闯入的暴徒按倒在地制服。

items.def_zh: 按住；压制（使其无法动弹）
items.def_en: (+ sb) to physically press someone down against a surface so they cannot move
items.ex_en: It took three officers to pin down the struggling assailant on the pavement.
items.ex_zh: 三名警官合力才把在人行道上拼命挣扎的袭击者按住制服。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to overcome someone in a physical struggle and force them to the ground
items.ex_en: A bystander bravely leaped forward to wrestle down the fleeing thief in the street.
items.ex_zh: 一名路人勇敢地上前，在街上将正欲逃跑的窃贼摔倒在地制服。

items.def_zh: 制服，征服，压制；抑制，克制（感情）；减弱，降低（光线、声音等）
items.def_en: 1. To bring a person, crowd, or rebellion under control by force; defeat. 2. To suppress or control strong feelings. 3. To make something less intense or bright.
items.ex_en: Riot police deployed tear gas to subdue the increasingly unruly crowd outside parliament.
items.ex_zh: 防暴警察施放催泪瓦斯，以压制议会大楼外愈发骚乱的人群。

items.def_zh: 制服，击败，压倒；（情绪、气味等）使难以忍受，使不知所措
items.def_en: 1. To defeat or subdue someone by using superior physical strength, numbers, or force. 2. (of an emotion, smell, or heat) To have such a strong effect on someone that they cannot resist or think clearly.
items.ex_en: The bank guard managed to overpower the lone robber before any shots were fired.
items.ex_zh: 银行保安在没有开一枪的情况下成功制服了单枪匹马的劫匪。

items.def_en: to stop disorder, rebellion, or violent opposition decisively using forceful intervention
items.ex_en: Government forces were dispatched immediately to quell the violent uprising in the northern province.
items.ex_zh: 政府军立即出动，以平息北部省份爆发的暴力叛乱。

items.def_en: to defeat an opponent, enemy, or opposing force completely in a battle or competition
items.ex_en: The valiant monarch swore to vanquish every enemy threatening the realm's sacred borders.
items.ex_zh: 英勇的君王誓要彻底击溃威胁王国神圣边界的一切敌寇。

groups.summary_en: An agent exerts escalating physical force, authority, or superior prowess to overcome resistance and bring an opponent or rebellious group under control.
groups.summary_zh: 施加不断增强的力量以压制反抗并彻底制服对手。
groups.desc_en: Denotes imposing superior physical strength or authority to immobilize, conquer, and neutralize an actively resisting entity, contrasting with peaceful persuasion.
groups.desc_zh: 指运用压倒性的肉体力量或权威压制并制服激烈抗拒者，区别于言辞说服或非暴力规劝。
groups.nuance_en: subdue: bring under control and quieten through force or will (suspect / rebellion / impulses) · overpower: overcome an adversary by vastly superior physical might (guards / assailant / rivals) · quell: crush and put an end to disorder or fear decisively (riots / fears / rebellion) · restrain: physically hold someone back to prevent motion or harm (inmate / impulses / attacker) · pin down: hold an opponent firmly against a surface to immobilize them (opponent / arms / suspects)
groups.nuance_zh: subdue: 彻底制伏并平息抗逆 (suspect / rebellion / impulses) · overpower: 以压倒性体力胜出制服 (guards / assailant / rivals) · quell: 果断平息骚乱或恐慌 (riots / fears / rebellion) · restrain: 约束限制其肢体行动 (inmate / impulses / attacker) · pin down: 按倒死死压住动弹不得 (opponent / arms / suspects)

groups.name: Subdued & Scornful Laughter · 窃笑与轻蔑嗤笑 (Snicker, Titter, Chortle)
groups.tip: 包含偷笑咯咯笑到嗤之以鼻的笑态

items.def_en: 1. (+ at) To laugh quietly in a nervous, foolish, or restrained manner.
items.ex_en: Several nervous students began to titter during the principal's unusually awkward speech.
items.ex_zh: 在校长异常尴尬的讲话过程中，几名紧张的学生开始吃吃地窃笑。

items.def_en: to laugh quietly or inwardly to oneself for a prolonged period
items.ex_en: Sitting in the corner, grandfather was chuckling away at his favorite satirical comic.
items.ex_zh: 祖父坐在角落里，看着他最喜欢的讽刺漫画暗自低笑个不停。

items.def_zh: 一笑置之；用讥笑或不屑的态度对待
items.def_en: (+ sth) to dismiss or minimize an awkward situation or criticism by laughing dismissively
items.ex_en: He tried to laugh off the criticism, but it clearly bothered him.
items.ex_zh: 他试图对批评一笑了之，但显然心里很介意。

items.def_en: To laugh repeatedly in a light, silly, high-pitched, or nervous way
items.ex_en: The girls could not help but giggle when the puppy chased its own tail.
items.ex_zh: 当小狗追着自己的尾巴打转时，女孩们忍不住咯咯笑出声来。

items.def_en: To laugh quietly or inwardly with suppressed satisfaction
items.ex_en: He read the sarcastic reply and gave a quiet chuckle of sheer amusement.
items.ex_zh: 他读着那条讽刺的回复，发自内心地轻声低笑了一下。

items.def_en: To smile in an affected, smug, or offensively knowing way
items.ex_en: The arrogant champion could only smirk as his opponent fumbled with the equipment.
items.ex_zh: 当对手笨拙地摆弄器材时，傲慢的卫冕冠军脸上露出得意的冷笑。

items.def_en: 1. (+ at) (chiefly North American) To laugh quietly and disrespectfully or slyly, especially at someone's misfortune.
items.ex_en: Rude classmates began to snicker when poor Arthur spilled ink all over his shirt.
items.ex_zh: 当可怜的亚瑟把墨水洒了一身时，无礼的同班同学开始暗中偷笑。

items.def_zh: 咯咯地笑，欢笑，洋洋得意地笑
items.def_en: 1. (+ at/with) To laugh quietly and merrily with amusement or satisfaction.
items.ex_en: The old gentleman chortled with delight upon reading his grandson's witty postcard.
items.ex_zh: 读到孙子写来的风趣明信片时，老绅士开怀地咯咯欢笑起来。

items.def_en: (+ at) To laugh in a half-suppressed, disrespectful or unkind manner
items.ex_en: They sat in the back row to snigger meanly at the speaker's accent.
items.ex_zh: 他们坐在后排，不怀好意地窃笑演讲者的口音。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures vocal expressions of amusement that are restrained, suppressed, self-satisfied, or mocking rather than open and hearty. Verbs vary by acoustic pitch, degree of malice or gloating, and social appropriateness.
groups.summary_zh: 指压抑、窃密或带有自鸣得意、嘲讽意味的笑。
groups.desc_en: Denotes laughing under one's breath or expressing derision, suppressed amusement, or smugness, contrasting with open, hearty, innocent laughter.
groups.desc_zh: 指压低声音的窃笑，或流露出轻蔑、得瑟的抑制性冷笑，区别于坦荡无邪的开怀大笑。
groups.nuance_en: snicker: give a stifled, disrespectful or mean-spirited laugh (at mistakes / in class) · smirk: smile in an irritatingly smug, self-satisfied, or insolent way (at an opponent / triumphantly) · chortle: chuckle gleefully with a snorting or throaty breath (with delight / over the news) · titter: laugh nervously, quietly, or affectingly in short bursts (at an awkward remark / behind hands) · chuckle: laugh quietly to oneself in inward amusement (at a memory / quietly)
groups.nuance_zh: snicker: 掩口吃吃窃笑或坏笑 (at mistakes / in class) · smirk: 浮现得瑟、轻蔑的冷笑或谄笑 (at an opponent / triumphantly) · chortle: 得意咯咯笑甚至发出轻微哼声 (with delight / over the news) · titter: 神经质或尴尬掩饰的轻笑 (at an awkward remark / behind hands) · chuckle: 独自暗自低声发笑 (at a memory / quietly)

groups.name: Subvert & Overthrow Regime · 颠覆与推翻政权 (Subvert, Overthrow, Topple)
groups.tip: 自下而上摧毁政权或系统

items.def_en: to weaken or ruin the foundation or authority of a system gradually or insidiously
items.ex_en: Persistent corruption scandals continue to undermine public trust in the judicial system.
items.ex_zh: 持续不断的腐败丑闻不断削弱公众对司法体系的信任。

items.def_en: to remove someone from a political position of authority or elected office
items.ex_en: Reformist candidates managed to unseat the entrenched incumbent in yesterday's parliamentary election.
items.ex_zh: 在昨天的议会选举中，改革派候选人成功罢黜了根深蒂固的现任官员。

items.def_en: [I/T] to cause a leader or regime to lose power and fall
items.ex_en: Massive civic demonstrations threatened to topple the military regime within a fortnight.
items.ex_zh: 大规模的民众示威游行大有在两周之内推翻该军政府之势。
items.ex2_en: The corrupt regime will certainly topple under sustained public outrage and boycotts.
items.ex2_zh: 这个腐败的政权在公众持续的愤怒和抵制下必定会倒台。

items.def_zh: 排挤出局；强行逐出权力中心
items.def_en: (+ sb) to force someone out of a position of authority or governmental power
items.ex_en: The founder was gradually pushed out of the company by the board.
items.ex_zh: 创始人逐渐被董事会排挤出了公司。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to forcibly remove someone from political office or authority
items.ex_en: The judge threw out the lawsuit due to lack of evidence.
items.ex_zh: 法官因证据不足驳回了该起诉讼。

items.def_zh: 推翻，打倒（政权或统治者）
items.def_en: to remove a leader, government, or institution from power, especially by using force
items.ex_en: Rebel forces united to overthrow the oppressive dictatorship and establish democratic rule.
items.ex_zh: 叛军联合起来推翻了残暴的独裁统治，并建立了民主政权。

items.def_zh: 驱逐，强行推翻剥夺职位
items.def_en: to force someone out of a position of power, often decisively
items.ex_en: A unanimous board vote was sufficient to oust the chief executive immediately.
items.ex_zh: 董事会一致通过的表决足以立即将这位首席执行官罢免下台。

items.def_zh: 颠覆，破坏，推翻（政权、体制或原则）
items.def_en: to undermine, destroy, or overthrow an established government, system, or belief
items.ex_en: Foreign operatives attempted to subvert the newly established democratic institutions through disinformation.
items.ex_zh: 外国特工试图通过虚假信息颠覆新建的民主机构。

items.def_zh: 推翻；使（政府或领导人）垮台
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to cause a government, regime, or ruler to lose power or collapse
items.ex_en: Widespread public outrage over economic mismanagement eventually brought down the coalition government.
items.ex_zh: 民众对经济治理不善的广泛愤怒最终导致联合政府垮台。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the dismantling or forced removal of an established regime, government, or authority. They scale from covert, insidious undermining up to violent and absolute collapse.
groups.summary_zh: 指动摇、瓦解或以武力击垮既定政权与体制，由隐秘侵蚀递进至强制推翻。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the forceful, illicit, or systemic removal and destruction of an established government, authority, or political regime, contrasting with orderly electoral change.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过强力、暗中破坏或体系性颠覆推翻既有政权与建制，区别于宪制下的正常换届选举。
groups.nuance_en: overthrow: forcefully topple a ruling power or sovereign entity (regime / tyrant / government) · topple: cause an established government or autocrat to fall abruptly (dictator / empire / cabinet) · subvert: secretly erode the foundations of institutional authority (democracy / state / values) · oust: expel an incumbent from an official post or territory (leader / incumbent / president) · unseat: strip an elected official of their political office (member of parliament / incumbent / senator)
groups.nuance_zh: overthrow: 武力彻底推翻政权或暴君 (regime / tyrant / government) · topple: 导致政权轰然垮台 (dictator / empire / cabinet) · subvert: 暗中瓦解渗透政治根基 (democracy / state / values) · oust: 驱逐驱离公职人员 (leader / incumbent / president) · unseat: 在选举或竞争中把…拉下马 (member of parliament / incumbent / senator)

groups.name: Summarize & Recap · 概括与重述 (Summarize, Recap, Recapitulate)
groups.tip: 扼要提炼并回顾核心要点

items.def_en: to give a description of the main facts, points, or structure of something without details
items.ex_en: The opening chapter aims to outline the central themes of the forthcoming research.
items.ex_zh: 开篇章节旨在概述后续研究的核心主题。

items.def_en: to state the main points of an argument, situation, or discussion succinctly
items.ex_en: The chairman took five minutes to sum up the key findings of the audit.
items.ex_zh: 主席花了五分钟时间总结了审计的核心结论。

items.def_en: to make a condensed summary or synopsis of a book, play, or argument
items.ex_en: The critic was asked to synopsize the intricate four-act play in brief terms.
items.ex_zh: 评论家受邀用简短的语言为这部结构错综复杂的四幕剧撰写内容提要。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to conclude or summarize the main points of a discussion, presentation, or text
items.ex_en: Let's wrap up this meeting so everyone can catch their flights.
items.ex_zh: 我们结束这次会议吧，这样大家都能赶上航班。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to gather together and present a summary of facts, news, or arguments
items.ex_en: The police rounded up several suspects following the robbery.
items.ex_zh: 抢劫案发生后，警方搜捕了几名嫌疑人。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to quickly repeat, read, or summarize the primary contents of something
items.ex_en: Let us quickly run through the safety procedures before commencing the test flight.
items.ex_zh: 在开始试飞之前，我们先粗略过一遍安全操作规程。

items.def_en: to give a brief statement of the main points of something
items.ex_en: The concluding paragraph will summarize the core arguments presented across the essay.
items.ex_zh: 结尾段落将概括整篇文章中所陈述的核心论点。

items.def_zh: 概括，扼要重述；翻新（轮胎面）
items.def_en: 1. To briefly summarize or repeat the main points of something. 2. To put a new rubber tread on a worn tire.
items.ex_en: Before taking audience questions, the presenter took a moment to recap main points.
items.ex_zh: 在回答听众提问之前，主讲人花了一点时间扼要重述了要点。

items.def_en: To summarize and repeat the main points of a speech, argument, or text.
items.ex_en: Allow me to recapitulate the essential terms agreed upon during our preliminary negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 请允许我简要重述我们在初步谈判中达成的基本条款。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote stating the principal facts, points, or arguments of a preceding discussion or text in an abbreviated form, ranging from casual conversational summaries to formal scholarly synopses.
groups.summary_zh: 指将前述讨论、言论或文本的核心要点进行简明概括与重述。
groups.desc_en: Denotes condensing extended discourse or complex events into essential, concise takeaway points, contrasting with exhaustive elaboration or verbatim quoting.
groups.desc_zh: 指将冗长论述或繁复事件提炼压缩为核心要点进行概述，区别于详尽铺陈或全文复述。
groups.nuance_en: summarize: deliver a condensed statement of key facts or arguments (findings / article / points) · recap: succinctly review preceding events or arguments to reinforce memory (events / meeting / discussion) · synopsize: condense the plot of a narrative or work into an abstract (novel / plot / script) · outline: present the high-level skeleton or main features of a plan (proposals / plan / framework) · wrap up: conclude a session by briefly consolidating conclusions (discussion / presentation / meeting)
groups.nuance_zh: summarize: 概述提炼核心要旨 (findings / article / points) · recap: 简短重述前情以加深印象 (events / meeting / discussion) · synopsize: 为叙事文本或剧作提供梗概 (novel / plot / script) · outline: 列出骨干大纲或结构要点 (proposals / plan / framework) · wrap up: 总结陈词收尾议程 (discussion / presentation / meeting)

groups.name: Supply & Replenish · 供给与补给 (Supply, Replenish, Provision)
groups.tip: 源源不断供应物资服务

items.def_en: supply a ship, army, or expedition with necessary food and equipment
items.ex_en: The quartermaster was ordered to provision the expedition vessels with sufficient grain.
items.ex_zh: 军需官接到命令，为远征船队储备充足的谷物物资。

items.def_en: add liquid or balance to something in order to make it completely full
items.ex_en: The waitress stopped by our table to top up our empty water glasses.
items.ex_zh: 女服务员走到我们桌旁，将我们空了的水杯重新倒满。

items.def_en: to make or become completely full, especially of fuel, liquid, or commodities
items.ex_en: Motorists rushed to fill up their tanks before the announced fuel price hike.
items.ex_zh: 车主们在公布的油价上涨之前争先恐后地把油箱加满。
items.ex2_en: The large decorative bathtub will fill up completely within fifteen minutes.
items.ex2_zh: 这个大型装饰浴缸会在十五分钟内完全注满水。

items.def_en: (+ on sth) to accumulate a substantial supply of provisions or goods
items.ex_en: Residents were urged to stock up on canned food ahead of the blizzard.
items.ex_zh: 居民们被敦促在暴风雪来临之前大量储备罐头食品。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to provide someone or something with all the necessary supplies or equipment
items.ex_en: The charity helped kit out the community youth club with brand-new sports gear.
items.ex_zh: 该慈善机构帮助为社区青年俱乐部配备了崭新的体育装备。

items.def_zh: 不断提供，连续供给（食物、酒等）；不断向……发问；从事（行业）；定期往返于
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To keep offering or supplying someone with large amounts of food, drink, or questions. 2. To work steadily at a trade or profession. 3. To travel regularly along a route.
items.ex_en: Gracious hosts continued to ply their weary guests with fine wine and appetizers.
items.ex_zh: 热情好客的主人不断为疲惫的宾客端上美酒和精致的小吃。

items.def_en: fill something up again after it has been used or depleted
items.ex_en: Park rangers worked tirelessly to replenish the dwindling emergency medical supplies in shelters.
items.ex_zh: 护林员不知疲倦地工作，以补充庇护所中日渐见底的急救医疗用品。

items.def_zh: 给……补充燃料，加油；加燃料
items.def_en: To put fresh fuel into an aircraft, vehicle, or ship; to take on fresh supplies of fuel.
items.ex_en: The long-range cargo aircraft had to land in Iceland to refuel properly.
items.ex_zh: 那架远程货运飞机不得不在冰岛降落以加满燃料。
items.ex2_en: Ground crews quickly refueled the passenger jet before its scheduled transatlantic flight.
items.ex2_zh: 地勤人员在客机按计划进行跨大西洋飞行前迅速为它加满了油。

items.def_zh: 重新进货，补足，重新装满
items.def_en: (+ with) To fill a store, warehouse, or supply again with fresh goods.
items.ex_en: Merchants will quickly restock the grocery store with fresh produce tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 商家将在明天清晨迅速为杂货店补满新鲜农产品。
items.ex2_en: Essential supplies and perishable foods restock quickly when new shipments arrive daily.
items.ex2_zh: 随着每天新货运达，生活必需品和易腐食品迅速重新补满。

groups.summary_en: An agent provides essential commodities, consumables, or fuels to keep a recipient, vessel, or store functional and well-stocked.
groups.summary_zh: 向特定对象、储藏地或工具补充供给物资、燃料与日常必需品。
groups.desc_en: Denotes providing essential material goods or restoring depleted fuel, supplies, and provisions to ensure continued function, contrasting with singular gifted items.
groups.desc_zh: 指为保障维系正常运转而供给必需物资或重新加注消耗殆尽的储备，区别于单次的赠予馈赠。
groups.nuance_en: replenish: restore depleted reserves back to original, full levels (stocks / funds / energy) · provision: supply an expedition, ship, or military unit with food and supplies (vessel / troops / expedition) · top up: fill an existing container or account to its brim or limit (glass / fuel tank / phone credit) · refuel: supply fuel to machinery or replenish physical endurance (aircraft / engine / body) · stock up: buy or accumulate large quantities of goods for future use (supplies / groceries / ammunition)
groups.nuance_zh: replenish: 补充消耗的储备使其复原 (stocks / funds / energy) · provision: 为远征队或军队配给给养物资 (vessel / troops / expedition) · top up: 添至满溢或给账户补足差额 (glass / fuel tank / phone credit) · refuel: 为交通工具加油或恢复体力 (aircraft / engine / body) · stock up: 大量囤积货物备用 (supplies / groceries / ammunition)

groups.name: Support & Render Aid · 援助与扶助 (Aid, Assist, Succor)
groups.tip: 施以援手提供助益

items.def_en: [I/T] to make it easier or possible for someone to do something by offering services or resources
items.ex_en: Volunteers stepped forward to help elderly residents carry heavy groceries during the freeze.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者们走上前去，在严寒天气中帮助老年居民搬运沉重的食品百货。

items.def_en: 1. To help someone to do something or provide aid; to facilitate.
items.ex_en: Specialized paralegals assist senior attorneys in drafting complex international trade agreements.
items.ex_zh: 专业律师助理协助资深律师起草复杂的国际贸易协定。

items.def_en: 1. To provide help, support, or resources to someone; to facilitate.
items.ex_en: International relief organizations stepped forward to aid famine victims across the devastated region.
items.ex_zh: 国际救援组织挺身而出，援助重灾区各地遭受饥荒的灾民。

items.def_en: (formal) to give immediate help or relief to someone who is suffering or in distress
items.ex_en: Devoted field medics arrived promptly to succor the wounded soldiers under heavy fire.
items.ex_zh: 忠诚的战地军医在猛烈炮火下迅速赶到，救助负伤的士兵。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to assist someone, especially by giving practical aid in a difficult situation
items.ex_en: Could you help out with the dishes while I prepare dinner?
items.ex_zh: 我做晚饭的时候你能帮忙洗下碗吗？

items.def_en: (+ sb) to unite together to help or support someone in a time of crisis or distress
items.ex_en: Neighbors gladly rallied round the grieving family after the tragic house fire occurred.
items.ex_zh: 惨烈的民宅火灾发生后，邻居们欣然团结起来援助这个悲痛的家庭。

items.def_en: to join in enthusiastically to offer help or practical assistance
items.ex_en: If we all pitch in, we can finish clearing the yard in an hour.
items.ex_zh: 如果我们大家齐心协力，一个小时就能把院子清理干净。

items.def_en: to take over duties from someone, or to provide humanitarian assistance to people in distress
items.ex_en: Fresh troops arrived at midnight to relieve the exhausted defenders stationed along the perimeter.
items.ex_zh: 生力军在半夜抵达，换班接替驻守在防线边沿上精疲力竭的防守部队。

items.def_zh: 有助于，有益于；对……有帮助
items.def_en: 1. To be of use, help, or advantage to someone (especially in 'avail oneself of': to make use of).
items.ex_en: All his impassioned appeals did not avail him against the court's stern verdict.
items.ex_zh: 他所有慷慨激昂的恳求在法院严厉的判决面前都无济于事。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe giving practical, medical, financial, or direct relief to help someone achieve a goal, overcome distress, or meet an immediate need.
groups.summary_zh: 指为受困者或需要者提供切实的行动协助、物资资助或解困援助。
groups.desc_en: Denotes extending proactive aid, labor, or comfort to support someone experiencing hardship or operational strain, contrasting with mere sympathy or passive solidarity.
groups.desc_zh: 指为身处困顿或压力中的对象主动施予劳力、资源或救援，区别于口头同情或袖手旁观。
groups.nuance_en: succor: provide urgent relief and comfort to those in dire distress (victims / wounded / destitute) · assist: provide formal, secondary aid to a primary operator (surgeon / director / customer) · aid: give substantial, organized help to overcome a crisis (refugees / developing nations / victims) · pitch in: join cooperatively in a shared manual or fiscal effort (with the chores / funds / work) · rally round: gather together swiftly to back an embattled peer (colleague / family / leader)
groups.nuance_zh: succor: 急难关头施加救助与安抚 (victims / wounded / destitute) · assist: 作为副手协助主事者 (surgeon / director / customer) · aid: 组织性、实质性施以援助 (refugees / developing nations / victims) · pitch in: 齐心协力凑钱或搭手出力 (with the chores / funds / work) · rally round: 团结聚拢在落难者身旁鼎力相助 (colleague / family / leader)

groups.name: Surge & Flow Forcefully · 涌流与奔涌 (Well, Course, Gush)
groups.tip: 液体或气流急速涌动

items.def_en: (of a liquid or emotion) To rise to the surface and flow out or prepare to overflow.
items.ex_en: Sorrow seemed to well in her dark eyes upon hearing the tragic news.
items.ex_zh: 听到这个悲惨的消息，悲伤之情似乎在她深邃的双眼中涌现。

items.def_en: to flow rapidly and abundantly out of a container, channel, or wound
items.ex_en: She poured out her troubles to her best friend over coffee.
items.ex_zh: 她一边喝咖啡一边向闺蜜倾诉自己的烦恼。
items.ex2_en: Tearful grievances poured out uncontrollably as she confronted her estranged family members.
items.ex2_zh: 当她面对疏远的家人时，满腹委屈泪如雨下地倾泻而出。

items.def_zh: 涌出；喷涌而起（液体或情绪）
items.def_en: to rise to the surface and start to flow outward copiously
items.ex_en: Tears began to well up in her eyes as the heartfelt tribute ended.
items.ex_zh: 当真挚动人的致敬落幕时，泪水开始从她的眼眶中涌出。

items.def_zh: （液体）奔流，急速流动；（情绪）涌动；用猎犬追猎
items.def_en: 1. (of liquid, blood, or feelings) To move or flow quickly through or over something. 2. To hunt game with dogs using sight rather than scent.
items.ex_en: Adrenaline coursed wildly through his veins as the siren wailed across the compound.
items.ex_zh: 警报声响彻大院时，肾上腺素在他血管中猛烈地奔流。

items.def_zh: 流淌、汩汩涌流（如眼泪、鲜血）
items.def_en: (+ down/from) to flow quickly and continuously in a steady direction
items.ex_en: Tears began to stream down her cheeks as she listened to the heartbreaking news.
items.ex_zh: 听着那令人心碎的消息，眼泪开始顺着她的脸颊流淌下来。
items.ex2_en: Powerful automated nozzles stream clean water directly onto the muddy car chassis.
items.ex2_zh: 强劲的自动喷嘴将清洁的水直接喷流到沾满泥巴的汽车底盘上。

items.def_en: to gush or shoot out forcefully in a sudden stream
items.ex_en: A jet of dark oil began to spurt out from the damaged pipeline.
items.ex_zh: 一股黑色的石油开始从破损的管道中喷涌而出。
items.ex2_en: The damaged pressure valve began to spurt out freezing industrial cooling liquid.
items.ex2_zh: 受损的压力阀开始喷射出冰冷的工业冷却液。

items.def_en: (+ through/forward) to move forward suddenly and powerfully like a great wave
items.ex_en: A mighty flood of meltwater began to surge through the narrow mountain gorge.
items.ex_zh: 一股强劲的融雪洪水开始在狭窄的山峡中汹涌奔腾。

items.def_en: (+ out/from) to pour out suddenly and with great force in large quantities
items.ex_en: Cold spring water started to gush from the deep fissure in the rock.
items.ex_zh: 清冽的泉水开始从岩石的深裂缝中喷涌而出。
items.ex2_en: The broken municipal pipe gushed icy water all over the crowded intersection.
items.ex2_zh: 破裂的市政管道把冰冷的水喷涌到了拥挤的十字路口各处。

items.def_en: [I/T] to shoot out in a sudden, sharp, forceful jet or burst
items.ex_en: Blood began to spurt violently across the floor when the severed artery ruptured.
items.ex_zh: 被割断的动脉破裂时，鲜血猛烈地喷射在地上。
items.ex2_en: The malfunctioning fire hydrant spurted murky water across the empty street corner.
items.ex2_zh: 故障的消火栓将浑浊的脏水喷向了空荡的街角。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this manner-of-motion frame depict liquids, blood, tears, or strong emotions rising up and traveling rapidly and copiously along a channel or from an outlet. Nuances range from rising smoothly ('well') to rushing freely ('course') and erupting under pressure ('gush').
groups.summary_zh: 描摹液体、血液或内心情感自深处涌起并在通道中奔流的动态。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the rapid, copious, and pressurized kinetic movement of liquids or feelings breaking forth, contrasting with slow trickling, calm soaking, or static pooling.
groups.desc_zh: 指液体或汹涌情绪在压力下大量、奔涌迸发而出的动能状态，区别于涓涓细流、浸润或静止积存。
groups.nuance_en: gush: burst out suddenly and copiously in large volumes (blood / oil / tears) · surge: swell and rush forward in a sudden powerful wave (water / crowd / electricity) · well: rise up smoothly to the surface from deep reservoirs (tears / emotions / water) · course: move swiftly and unimpeded along a defined pathway (blood / adrenaline / tears) · stream: flow steadily and continuously in an unbroken ribbon (light / people / sweat)
groups.nuance_zh: gush: 猛烈喷溅、大量涌流 (blood / oil / tears) · surge: 如巨浪般陡然前涌激增 (water / crowd / electricity) · well: 从深处自下而上汩汩漫涌 (tears / emotions / water) · course: 沿脉络道途飞速流淌 (blood / adrenaline / tears) · stream: 连绵不绝地川流不息 (light / people / sweat)

groups.name: Surgical Cutting & Boring · 手术剖切与钻刺 (Vivisect, Trepan, Resect)
groups.tip: 活体解剖进行医学探查

items.def_zh: 切除；切下（病变组织或器官）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to surgically remove a part of the body, tumor, or diseased tissue by cutting
items.ex_en: He decided to cut out caffeine completely to improve his sleep.
items.ex_zh: 为了改善睡眠，他决定彻底戒掉咖啡因。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to excise or remove surrounding flesh or damaged tissue surgically
items.ex_en: The surgeon had to cut away the surrounding gangrenous tissue to prevent infection.
items.ex_zh: 外科医生必须切除周围坏疽的组织以防感染。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to puncture and cut open a boil, abscess, or swelling with a surgical instrument
items.ex_en: The chief surgeon prepared a sterile scalpel to lance open the deep abscess.
items.ex_zh: 主刀医生准备了无菌手术刀，以切开深处的脓肿进行引流。

items.def_en: to prick or cut open a boil, abscess, or blister with a lancet to drain fluid
items.ex_en: The physician used a sterile blade to lance the painful boil on his arm.
items.ex_zh: 医生用无菌刀片切开了他手臂上疼痛的疖子引流。

items.def_en: to surgically cut out an organ, growth, or piece of tissue from the body
items.ex_en: The surgical team managed to excise the malignant tumor without damaging nearby organs.
items.ex_zh: 手术团队成功切除了恶性肿瘤，且未损伤临近器官。

items.def_en: to surgically cut off a limb or digit by medical procedure
items.ex_en: Surgeons were forced to amputate the soldier's crushed lower leg to save his life.
items.ex_zh: 外科医生被迫截去该士兵被压碎的小腿以保全其性命。

items.def_zh: 截除，部分切除（器官或结构）
items.def_en: to cut out or remove part of an organ or anatomical structure surgically
items.ex_en: The surgical team decided to resect a diseased section of the patient's colon.
items.ex_zh: 外科团队决定部分切除患者出现病变的一段结肠。

items.def_zh: 对（头骨）施环锯手术；诱骗，诈骗
items.def_en: 1. (surgery / historical) To cut or bore a circular hole into a person's skull using a cylindrical saw (trepan). 2. (archaic) To entrap, ensnare, or deceive someone.
items.ex_en: The ancient healer resolved to trepan the warrior's skull to relieve the mounting pressure.
items.ex_zh: 古医者决定对这名武士的头骨施环锯术以缓解不断上升的压力。

items.def_en: (science / medicine) To perform surgical operations or experiments on a living animal for scientific inquiry.
items.ex_en: Nineteenth-century physiologists would often vivisect dogs to study cardiovascular mechanics.
items.ex_zh: 十九世纪的生理学家经常对狗进行活体解剖以研究心血管机制。

groups.summary_en: Refers to specialized, highly invasive medical or experimental procedures where a practitioner cuts, bores into, or excises living bodily tissue or skull bone. These terms belong to clinical, surgical, or anatomical registers rather than general wounding.
groups.summary_zh: 指对活体组织或骨骼进行钻孔、解剖或切除的专门外科及实验手术。
groups.desc_en: Denotes specialized, precise medical cutting, drilling, or organ removal on living tissue under clinical parameters, contrasting with indiscriminate butchery or trauma.
groups.desc_zh: 指在临床或生理解剖语境下对活体组织进行的精准切割、钻孔或器官切除，区别于粗暴屠宰或创伤。
groups.nuance_en: excise: remove an entire tissue, lesion, or organ surgically (tumor / lesion / tissue) · resect: surgically cut out a substantial portion of an organ or structure (bowel / liver / lobe) · trepan: bore a hole perforating the skull for intracranial access (skull / cranium) · lance: pierce an abscess or boil to release contained pus (boil / infection / blister) · amputate: surgically sever an extremity or limb from the body (limb / leg / finger)
groups.nuance_zh: excise: 手术完整切除病灶组织 (tumor / lesion / tissue) · resect: 手术大部切除器官结构 (bowel / liver / lobe) · trepan: 环锯颅骨开孔 (skull / cranium) · lance: 刺破穿刺痈脓排液 (boil / infection / blister) · amputate: 外科截断肢体部位 (limb / leg / finger)

groups.name: Surpass & Outdo in Specific Metric · 按特定维度超越 (Outpace, Outstrip, Outnumber)
groups.tip: 在数量、速度或权重上胜过他人

items.def_en: to overtake competitors and gain an advantage in a race, measure, or competition
items.ex_en: The seasoned marathon runner began to pull ahead in the final two miles.
items.ex_zh: 那位经验丰富的马拉松选手在最后两英里开始超前领先。

items.def_zh: 拉大领先优势；甩开对手
items.def_en: to increase the distance or margin by which one is ahead of rivals
items.ex_en: The champion accelerated in the final lap to pull away from his exhausted rivals.
items.ex_zh: 卫冕冠军在最后一圈加速，拉大优势甩开了疲惫的对手。

items.def_zh: 重于，大于（在价值或重要性上超过）
items.def_en: to be greater or more significant than something in weight, value, or importance
items.ex_en: The long-term economic benefits clearly outweigh the initial costs of this project.
items.ex_zh: 该项目的长期经济效益显然大于其前期的初始成本。

items.def_zh: 数量多于，在数量上超过
items.def_en: to be greater in number than someone or something
items.ex_en: The rebel forces easily outnumber the garrison stationed inside the frontier fort.
items.ex_zh: 叛军的人数轻易超过了驻扎在边境堡垒内的守军。

items.def_en: to perform significantly better or more efficiently than someone or something else
items.ex_en: The new electric model continues to outperform its gasoline rivals in acceleration tests.
items.ex_zh: 这款新型电动车型在加速测试中表现持续优于其燃油竞品。

items.def_zh: 超过……的速度，比……跑得更快；发展快于
items.def_en: to move, grow, or develop faster than someone or something else
items.ex_en: Consumer demand has begun to outpace the company's current manufacturing capacity.
items.ex_zh: 消费者的需求已经开始超过公司目前的生产能力。

items.def_zh: 超过，胜过；跑过，甩在后面
items.def_en: to become faster, larger, or better than someone or something else; surpass
items.ex_en: The firm's rapid revenue growth will soon outstrip that of its traditional rivals.
items.ex_zh: 该公司的营收快速增长势头不久将超越其传统竞争对手。

items.def_zh: 使相形见绌，表现远胜于
items.def_en: to be much better, more impressive, or more successful than someone else
items.ex_en: Her dazzling vocal performance managed to outshine all the other contestants tonight.
items.ex_zh: 她今晚那令人惊艳的歌唱表现完全盖过了所有其他选手。

items.def_en: to surpass someone or something so completely that they become unimportant
items.ex_en: Her stunning scientific discovery threatened to eclipse the work of her predecessors entirely.
items.ex_zh: 她那惊人的科学发现大有彻底掩盖前人成果之势。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe exceeding a competitor or standard along a measurable, quantifiable dimension such as speed, growth rate, physical quantity, or performance.
groups.summary_zh: 指在速度、增长率、数量或性能等特定量化维度上超越或胜过对手。
groups.desc_en: Denotes overtaking or exceeding an entity along a specific, measurable dimension, contrasting with generalized dominance or spatial passing by focusing on comparative metrics.
groups.desc_zh: 指在某一具体度量维度上超过或胜过对方，区别于泛化的统治或单纯空间超车，强调对比维度的专一性。
groups.nuance_en: outpace: surpass in speed or rate of growth (rivals / inflation / demand) · outstrip: exceed by a substantial margin in capacity or supply (production / supply / expectations) · outnumber: exceed in head count or numerical quantity (forces / votes / species) · outshine: surpass in brilliance, talent, or prominence (peers / predecessors / competition) · outweigh: exceed in importance, gravity, or influence (benefits / risks / considerations)
groups.nuance_zh: outpace: 在速度或增长率上超越 (rivals / inflation / demand) · outstrip: 在产能、规模或供给上大幅超越 (production / supply / expectations) · outnumber: 在人头或绝对数量上多于 (forces / votes / species) · outshine: 在才华、光彩或引人注目度上胜过 (peers / predecessors / competition) · outweigh: 在重要性、分量或影响力上超过 (benefits / risks / considerations)

groups.name: Surrender & Cave In · 认输与低头屈服 (Yield, Submit, Capitulate)
groups.tip: 从被迫退让到完全俯首听命

items.def_en: to cease fighting or arguing and accept defeat or an opponent's terms
items.ex_en: After hours of relentless negotiation, the stubborn director finally decided to give in.
items.ex_zh: 经过数小时不依不饶的谈判，固执的主任最终决定妥协让步。

items.def_en: (+ to) to give way to arguments, demands, or pressure
items.ex_en: The embattled prime minister refused to yield to the escalating public pressure.
items.ex_zh: 深陷困境的首相拒绝向不断升级的公众压力屈服。

items.def_en: Withdraw a claim, demand, or fighting stance in the face of opposition
items.ex_en: Neither candidate showed any willingness to back down during the heated debate.
items.ex_zh: 在激烈的辩论中，两位候选人都没有表现出任何退让的意愿。

items.def_en: Yield or concede under persuasion, pressure, or stronger force
items.ex_en: The stubborn council members finally began to give way under intense community scrutiny.
items.ex_zh: 在社区舆论的密集审视下，固执的委员会成员终于开始妥协。

items.def_zh: 屈服，顺从，投降；提交，呈递；主张，建议
items.def_en: 1. (+ to) To accept or yield to a superior force, authority, or will of another person. 2. To present a document, proposal, or plan for consideration or judgment. 3. (formal) To suggest or state an opinion formally.
items.ex_en: The defeated commander was forced to submit to the harsh terms imposed by victors.
items.ex_zh: 战败的指挥官被迫屈服于胜利者所强加的苛刻条件。

items.def_zh: 屈服，认输（常作 knuckle under）；开始认真努力（常作 knuckle down）；用指节按压
items.def_en: (also 'knuckle under') To yield, submit, or surrender to pressure or authority.
items.ex_en: He flatly refused to knuckle under to the threats of his political rivals.
items.ex_zh: 他断然拒绝向政敌的威胁认输低头。

items.def_en: (+ to) to suddenly collapse mentally and surrender completely under pressure
items.ex_en: The stressed manager finally caved in to the relentless demands of the strikers.
items.ex_zh: 不堪重负的经理最终彻底顶不住罢工者不依不饶的要求而屈服了。

items.def_en: Submit to authority or pressure, acknowledging defeat
items.ex_en: The rebel faction had no choice but to knuckle under to the central command.
items.ex_zh: 叛乱派系别无选择，只能屈服认输并接受中央指挥。

items.def_en: (+ to) to cease resisting an opponent or demand under negotiated or forced terms
items.ex_en: The besieged garrison had no choice but to capitulate to the enemy forces.
items.ex_zh: 被重重包围的守军别无选择，只得向敌军全面投降。

groups.summary_en: Pressured or overwhelmed agents cease resisting, formally or helplessly giving in to the authority, demands, or superior power of an adversary.
groups.summary_zh: 指在强大压力、权威或武力下停止抵抗而低头顺从。
groups.desc_en: Denotes abandoning resistance and ceding control under external force or relentless pressure, contrasting with voluntary agreement by emphasizing defeat or fatigue.
groups.desc_zh: 指在外部力量或持续压力下放弃抵抗、交出主导权，区别于自愿同意，强调被迫妥协或力竭屈服。
groups.nuance_en: yield: relinquish position or give way under sustained pressure or right-of-way (ground / authority / pressure) · give in: concede reluctantly after prolonged resistance or badgering (demands / pressure / temptation) · cave in: suffer sudden structural collapse of will under severe coercion (management / regime / opposition) · submit: formally or passively place oneself under another's authority (will / judgment / authority) · knuckle under: capitulate completely and subserviently under intimidation (threats / dictatorship / bullying)
groups.nuance_zh: yield: 在持续压力或通行权面前让步退让 (ground / authority / pressure) · give in: 经长时间纠缠或抵抗后勉强让步 (demands / pressure / temptation) · cave in: 在重压下意志突然崩溃瓦解 (management / regime / opposition) · submit: 正式或顺从地屈从于他人意志或管辖 (will / judgment / authority) · knuckle under: 在恐吓或强权下彻底低头屈服 (threats / dictatorship / bullying)

groups.name: Surreptitious Looking · 窥视与窥探 (Peek, Peep, Snoop)
groups.tip: 自缝隙暗中偷偷探看

items.def_en: Look quickly or slyly into an enclosed space or opening
items.ex_en: The curious child paused to peek in through the cracked laboratory door.
items.ex_zh: 好奇的孩子停下脚步，透过开着一道缝的实验室门向里偷看。

items.def_en: (+ at/through/into) To look narrowly or curiously, often through an opening or with strained vision
items.ex_en: The detective leaned forward to peer through the dusty blinds of the suspect's office.
items.ex_zh: 侦探探身上前，透过嫌疑人办公室布满灰尘的百叶窗隐秘地细看。

items.def_en: 1. (+ at/into/through) To look quickly and secretly, often through a narrow opening or when you should not. 2. To stick out slightly so as to be just visible.
items.ex_en: She could not resist the urge to peek at her wrapped birthday present.
items.ex_zh: 她忍不住冲动，偷偷看了一眼包装好的生日礼物。

items.def_zh: 窥看，偷看；隐约显现；（雏鸟等）唧唧叫
items.def_en: 1. (+ at/into/through) To look quickly and secretly at something, especially through a small hole or opening. 2. To appear slightly or briefly. 3. To make a weak high-pitched sound.
items.ex_en: He paused near the door to peep through the keyhole into the study.
items.ex_zh: 他在门边停下脚步，透过钥匙孔向书房里偷看。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Inquire too closely or inquisitively into someone else's private affairs
items.ex_en: Nosy journalists always attempt to pry into the private affairs of local politicians.
items.ex_zh: 爱管闲事的记者总是企图窥探当地政客的私生活。

items.def_en: Look around secretly in an attempt to uncover confidential or private information
items.ex_en: The suspicious tenant caught the landlord trying to snoop around her apartment.
items.ex_zh: 多疑的房客撞见房东正试图在她公寓里四处窥探。

items.def_en: 1. (+ around/into) (informal, disapproving) To look around secretly in a private place or through someone's belongings to find out private information.
items.ex_en: I caught him trying to snoop through the private files on my desk.
items.ex_zh: 我抓到他正企图偷看翻阅我桌上的隐私文件。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To observe secretively and persistently to gather covert information
items.ex_en: The agency hired private detectives to spy on the rival corporation's top scientists.
items.ex_zh: 该机构雇佣私家侦探暗中监视竞争对手公司的顶级科学家。

items.def_en: (+ into) To inquire or look into someone's private affairs with excessive curiosity
items.ex_en: You have no right to pry into the private details of my personal life.
items.ex_zh: 你无权打探我私人生活的隐秘细节。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe looking furtively, briefly, or inquisitively through an opening, around an obstacle, or into private matters without authorization. They range from quick, secretive glances to intrusive prying into others' personal affairs.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过缝隙、遮蔽物暗中窥看，或刺探他人隐秘隐私。
groups.desc_en: Denotes covert, illicit, or secretive visual inspection, contrasting with open observation by actively concealing the act of looking.
groups.desc_zh: 指隐蔽、非法或暗中的视觉窥探，区别于公开观察，强调刻意隐匿自身视线或窥视动作。
groups.nuance_en: peek: take a quick, furtive glance through a narrow opening or barrier (corner / curtain / blinds) · peep: secretly watch through a tiny aperture or crack, often voyeuristically (keyhole / window / hole) · snoop: pry inquisitively into private affairs or search belongings (belongings / drawers / files) · spy: systematically observe an adversary to gather confidential intelligence (rivals / neighbors / enemies) · pry into: offensively probe or interrogate into private business (affairs / personal life / secrets)
groups.nuance_zh: peek: 经狭窄缝隙或屏障快速而隐蔽地瞥视 (corner / curtain / blinds) · peep: 经极小孔洞或缝隙暗中窥探，常带窥私意味 (keyhole / window / hole) · snoop: 偷偷翻找或刺探他人私人物品及隐私 (belongings / drawers / files) · spy: 系统性暗中监视以搜集机密情报 (rivals / neighbors / enemies) · pry into: 侵犯性地探问或探查私人事务 (affairs / personal life / secrets)

groups.name: Swell & Blister · 肿胀与起泡 (Blister, Bulge, Puff up)
groups.tip: 皮肤受烫起泡或局部隆起

items.def_en: [I/T] to become swollen, enlarged, or distended, typically around eyes or joints
items.ex_en: His bruised eye began to puff up terribly after receiving that heavy punch.
items.ex_zh: 挨了那记重拳后，他青肿的眼睛开始厉害地发胀肿起。

items.def_en: Swell or bulge outwards rapidly in a rounded shape
items.ex_en: The infected boil began to balloon out painfully under the skin.
items.ex_zh: 受到感染的疖子在皮下痛苦地鼓起膨出。

items.def_en: Become abnormally swollen or distended in size
items.ex_en: Her swollen wrist started to blow up noticeably after the severe bee sting.
items.ex_zh: 被蜜蜂重重蜇了一下之后，她肿胀的手腕开始明显肿大。
items.ex2_en: Violent internal allergic reactions can blow up facial tissues dangerously fast.
items.ex2_zh: 剧烈的体内过敏反应会以危险的速度使面部组织肿胀起来。

items.def_en: Become larger, rounder, or distended due to fluid accumulation, infection, or injury
items.ex_en: His twisted ankle began to swell up noticeably within minutes of the accident.
items.ex_zh: 事故发生后数分钟内，他扭伤的脚踝便明显肿了起来。

items.def_en: [I/T] to enlarge abnormally in volume or size due to inflammation or fluid retention
items.ex_en: Her sprained ankle began to swell considerably within an hour of the fall.
items.ex_zh: 摔倒后不到一小时，她扭伤的脚踝就明显肿大起来。
items.ex2_en: The harsh allergic reaction will quickly swell his eyes and throat dangerously.
items.ex2_zh: 严重的过敏反应会迅速使他的眼睛和喉咙危险地肿胀起来。

items.def_zh: （使）起水疱，（使）起气泡；严厉抨击
items.def_en: 1. To develop blisters, or cause blisters or bubbles to form on skin, paint, or a surface. 2. To criticize someone severely.
items.ex_en: The intense desert heat caused his exposed shoulders to blister painfully.
items.ex_zh: 沙漠中酷烈的热浪导致他裸露的双肩痛苦地泛起水疱。
items.ex2_en: The freshly applied exterior paint began to blister under the blazing afternoon sun.
items.ex2_zh: 刚刷上的外墙漆在午后炽热的阳光下开始起泡。

items.def_zh: 膨胀，鼓起，凸出；装满，塞满
items.def_en: (+ with/out) To stick out in a round shape, or to swell noticeably because of fullness or pressure.
items.ex_en: The diseased vein in his calf began to bulge visibly beneath the skin.
items.ex_zh: 他小腿上病变的静脉开始在皮肤下明显凸起。

items.def_en: [I/T] to swell or make swollen with fluid or gas, producing an uncomfortable distension
items.ex_en: Eating that rich, salty soup caused his sensitive abdomen to bloat terribly.
items.ex_zh: 喝了那道油腻偏咸的汤后，他敏感的腹部难受地胀满了。
items.ex2_en: His sensitive digestive system will bloat uncomfortably after eating processed carbohydrates.
items.ex2_zh: 吃完加工碳水化合物后，他敏感的消化系统会难受地发胀。

items.def_en: [I/T] (medical/formal) to blister or cause the formation of cutaneous vesicles
items.ex_en: Contact with the corrosive chemical agent began to vesicate the chemist's bare skin.
items.ex_zh: 接触到腐蚀性化学试剂后，化学家裸露的皮肤开始起水疱。
items.ex2_en: Sensitive skin surfaces quickly vesicate when exposed to dangerous concentrated acidic vapors.
items.ex2_zh: 敏感的皮肤表面暴露于危险的浓酸蒸汽时会迅速起泡。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail anatomical or surface swelling, where skin or organic tissue distends, blisters with fluid, or bulges outwards under internal pressure or pathology. Nuances contrast fluid-filled blistering with mechanical protruding.
groups.summary_zh: 肉体表面或皮肉因充水、积气或充血而隆起、鼓出或起水泡。
groups.desc_en: Denotes pathological or physical distension characterized by fluid accumulation, pocket formation, or surface blister eruption, contrasting with structured mechanical expansion.
groups.desc_zh: 指因积液、囊泡形成或表面起泡而产生的病理性或物理性肿胀，区别于结构性机械扩张。
groups.nuance_en: swell: expand naturally or pathologically from internal pressure or inflammation (tissue / ankles / lymph nodes) · blister: form localized fluid-filled epidermal or coating pockets (skin / paint / surface) · bloat: uncomfortably distend with trapped gas or water (abdomen / stomach / body) · bulge: swell outward protrusively at a focused weak point (veins / wall / pocket) · puff up: become softly distended around eyes or face, often from crying or allergies (eyes / cheeks / face)
groups.nuance_zh: swell: 因发炎或内部压力产生生理性或病理性肿大 (tissue / ankles / lymph nodes) · blister: 表皮或涂层起泡形成液体水泡 (skin / paint / surface) · bloat: 因积气或积水导致不适性鼓胀 (abdomen / stomach / body) · bulge: 在局部薄弱处明显向外鼓凸 (veins / wall / pocket) · puff up: 面部或眼周因过敏、哭泣等呈现松软浮肿 (eyes / cheeks / face)

groups.name: Swell & Expand · 膨胀与隆起 (Inflate, Bloat, Swollen)
groups.tip: 充气扩充使整体体积明显变大

items.def_zh: （使）隆起成脊，成垄状；在……上作垄
items.def_en: To form into raised ridges or mark with narrow raised bands; to rise in ridges.
items.ex_en: The compressed layers of hardened sand began to ridge along the desert floor.
items.ex_zh: 被压缩的坚硬沙层开始沿着沙漠地面隆起成脊。
items.ex2_en: The violent subterranean collision will ridge the continental shelf along the coastline.
items.ex2_zh: 剧烈的地下碰撞会使沿海的大陆架隆起起伏的山脊。

items.def_zh: 像气球般鼓起；膨胀隆起
items.def_en: to swell or bulge outwards like a balloon filled with air
items.ex_en: The emergency parachute began to balloon out properly as he plunged through clouds.
items.ex_zh: 当他穿云而降时，应急降落伞像气球般完全鼓起迎风膨胀。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to fill with air or gas so as to expand or swell
items.ex_en: We used an electric pump to blow up the large inflatable mattress quickly.
items.ex_zh: 我们用电动气泵迅速给这个大型充气床垫充气膨胀。
items.ex2_en: The emergency escape slide will blow up automatically upon cabin door deployment.
items.ex2_zh: 应急逃生滑梯在机舱门打开时会自动充气膨胀。

items.def_en: [I/T] To swell or expand with air, fluid, or pride
items.ex_en: The injured boxer watched his bruised eye puff up rapidly after the bout.
items.ex_zh: 比赛结束后，受伤的拳击手看着自己瘀青的眼睛迅速肿大起来。

items.def_en: [I/T] To become larger, rounder, or more bulging than normal
items.ex_en: The soaked wooden planks will quickly swell if left out in the heavy rain.
items.ex_zh: 如果任由暴雨冲淋，浸透的木板很快就会膨胀鼓起。
items.ex2_en: Unbearable seasonal humidity can swell wooden doors and jam their frames tight.
items.ex2_zh: 难耐的季节性潮湿会使木门膨胀，并卡死门框。

items.def_zh: （使）充气，（使）膨胀；抬高（物价等）；使自负
items.def_en: 1. To fill with gas or air, causing to swell or expand, or to expand in this way. 2. To increase the price or size of something artificially.
items.ex_en: The mechanic used compressed air to inflate the rear tire to proper pressure.
items.ex_zh: 修理工使用压缩空气给后轮充气，使之达到合适的胎压。
items.ex2_en: The weather balloon will inflate dramatically as atmospheric pressure decreases at altitude.
items.ex2_zh: 随着高空气压下降，气象气球会显著膨胀起来。

items.def_en: [I/T] To swell outwards under internal pressure
items.ex_en: The heavy contents made the seams of his leather backpack bulge under tension.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的物品使他的皮质双肩包接缝处在受压下凸起鼓开。

items.def_en: To swell or puff up with fluid, gas, or food, or cause to do so.
items.ex_en: Too much salty food can bloat your stomach and make you feel sluggish.
items.ex_zh: 摄入过多高盐食物会让你的腹部膨胀发胀，令人感觉迟钝倦怠。
items.ex2_en: The soaked dead leaves bloat noticeably after prolonged exposure to muddy water.
items.ex2_zh: 浸透的枯叶在泥水中长时间泡着之后明显发胀了。

items.def_zh: 膨胀；扩张（尤指腹部、血管）
items.def_en: [I/T] To enlarge, swell, or stretch out from internal pressure
items.ex_en: Severe abdominal gas began to distend the patient's stomach to an alarming degree.
items.ex_zh: 严重的腹部胀气开始使病人的胃部扩张膨胀到令人担忧的程度。
items.ex2_en: Internal pressure caused the defective hydraulic tube to distend dangerously outward.
items.ex2_zh: 内部压力导致有缺陷的液压管危险地向外膨胀隆起。

groups.summary_en: Surfaces, containers, or biological tissues distend, inflate with gas or fluid, or rise into visible ridges and protrusions.
groups.summary_zh: 腔体或表面因充气、充液或应力而外凸鼓胀、隆起。
groups.desc_en: Denotes outward dimensional expansion and volumetric increase caused by internal pressure, air, or growth, contrasting with simple directional elongation.
groups.desc_zh: 指由内部气压、膨胀力或蓄积引起的体积向外扩张隆起，区别于单纯的单向伸长。
groups.nuance_en: inflate: expand artificially by pumping with air or gas (tire / balloon / raft) · balloon out: expand rapidly, dramatically, and uncontrollably in volume (skirt / debt / sails) · swell: increase substantially in volume or magnitude through accumulation (ranks / river / numbers) · bulge: distend outwardly from overcapacity or stress (eyes / seams / muscles) · bloat: expand excessively and unhealthily (budget / inventory / corpse)
groups.nuance_zh: inflate: 注入气体或空气以使其人工充气膨胀 (tire / balloon / raft) · balloon out: 迅速且剧烈地像气球般向外鼓起或暴增 (skirt / debt / sails) · swell: 通过内部蓄积使体积或规模显著膨胀增多 (ranks / river / numbers) · bulge: 因承载过满或受压而向外隆起凸出 (eyes / seams / muscles) · bloat: 出现病态或过度的臃肿膨胀 (budget / inventory / corpse)

groups.name: Swim & Float · 游泳与浮游 (Self-Propelled Aquatic Motion)
groups.tip: 划水漂游自如前行

items.def_en: Remain suspended and drift gently on or near the surface of water
items.ex_en: Vibrant fallen leaves gently float around on the surface of the quiet garden pond.
items.ex_zh: 色彩鲜艳的落叶在宁静的花园池塘水面上轻轻地漂浮游荡。

items.def_en: to stay resting on the surface of a liquid without sinking
items.ex_en: The hollow wooden barrel managed to float calmly across the slow-moving river.
items.ex_zh: 那个空木桶平稳地浮在水面上，顺着水流平缓的河流漂去。
items.ex2_en: The playful children float colorful paper boats across the calm garden pond.
items.ex2_zh: 爱玩的孩子们把五颜六色的纸船漂浮在平静的花园池塘上。

items.def_en: Swim or move casually through water using short, paddling strokes
items.ex_en: The children love to paddle around playfully in the shallow edges of the pool.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们喜欢在泳池浅水区开心地划水游荡。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Cross a body of water by swimming
items.ex_en: The brave lifeguard prepared to swim across the broad river to rescue them.
items.ex_zh: 英勇的救生员准备横渡宽阔的河流去营救他们。

items.def_zh: 游泳；游动，漂浮；（头脑）眩晕，旋转
items.def_en: 1. To move through water by moving limbs, fins, or tail. 2. To feel dizzy or seem to be spinning.
items.ex_en: Several colorful tropical fish began to swim gracefully through the dense coral reef.
items.ex_zh: 几条色彩斑斓的热带鱼开始在茂密的珊瑚礁中优雅地游动。

items.def_en: to move the feet or hands gently in shallow water
items.ex_en: The barefoot toddlers love to paddle joyfully in the cool ocean shallows.
items.ex_zh: 光着脚的幼童喜欢在清凉的浅海中欢快地涉水戏水。

items.def_en: to swim with quick, shallow strokes like a dog
items.ex_en: The exhausted boy managed to dog-paddle desperately toward the safety of the shallow bank.
items.ex_zh: 筋疲力竭的男孩拼命用狗刨式游泳，划向安全平缓的浅滩。

items.def_en: to keep the head above water while remaining upright by pumping the legs
items.ex_en: The exhausted swimmer had to tread water while waiting for the rescue boat to arrive.
items.ex_zh: 精疲力竭的游泳者不得不踩水，等待救援船的到来。

items.def_en: to swim by extending arms forward and sweeping them back while froglike-kicking
items.ex_en: She learned how to breaststroke efficiently across the deep pool during her morning lesson.
items.ex_zh: 她在早上的课程中学会了如何在深水池中高效地游蛙泳。

groups.summary_en: An animate agent or buoyant body propels itself through or rests suspended on a liquid medium. While 'swim' denotes active, coordinated limb movement through water, verbs like 'tread' and 'dog-paddle' represent specialized physical maneuvers to stay afloat.
groups.summary_zh: 人在水中通过自身肢体协调发力进行游动或保持浮起的姿态动作。
groups.desc_en: Denotes sustaining buoyancy or achieving self-propelled locomotive transit within a body of water, contrasting with passive drifting or sinking.
groups.desc_zh: 指在水体中维持浮力或依靠自身动力游弋前行，区别于被动随波逐流或沉溺下坠。
groups.nuance_en: swim: propel oneself purposefully through water using coordinated limb motions (laps / river / ocean) · float: rest neutrally buoyant on the liquid surface without propulsion (surface / log / raft) · paddle: move through shallow water using short, paddling hand, foot, or oar strokes (canoe / stream / shallows) · tread water: keep the head upright above water using vertical pedaling strokes (pool / deep end / water) · dog-paddle: swim clumsily with basic, repetitive paw-like motions (shallows / shore / pool)
groups.nuance_zh: swim: 协调肢体动作在水中自主且具方向性地游动 (laps / river / ocean) · float: 无需推进力、自然漂浮在液体表面 (surface / log / raft) · paddle: 用手脚或短桨在浅水区划水推进 (canoe / stream / shallows) · tread water: 保持直立姿势原地踩水以使头部露出水面 (pool / deep end / water) · dog-paddle: 采用原始笨拙的狗刨式划水游动 (shallows / shore / pool)

groups.name: Switch & Toggle · 切换与调换 (Toggle, Transpose, Invert)
groups.tip: 在不同状态间快速切换

items.def_en: (+ between/with) to repeatedly shift back and forth from one state, role, or action to another
items.ex_en: The weather seemed to alternate between heavy rain and bright sunshine all afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 整个下午的天气似乎一直在大雨和明媚阳光之间交替切换。
items.ex2_en: The music director will alternate solemn choral hymns with uplifting orchestral pieces.
items.ex2_zh: 音乐总监将把庄严的合唱赞美诗与激昂的管弦乐曲交替安排。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Exchange the mutual positions or orders of two or more items
items.ex_en: Let's swap around these two pictures so the larger frame hangs near the window.
items.ex_zh: 我们把这两幅画对调一下位置，好让大画框挂在窗户边。

items.def_en: Change from one system, mode, or method to another
items.ex_en: The hospital will switch over to a completely digital record system next month.
items.ex_zh: 下个月该医院将全面切换至数字化病历系统。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Invert or reverse the places or relative positions of things
items.ex_en: Can we switch round the chairs so everyone has enough room to sit comfortably?
items.ex_zh: 我们能不能把椅子调换一下位置，让大家都有足够的空间坐得舒服点？

items.def_en: (+ with/for) to give something and receive something else in exchange, swapping relative places
items.ex_en: He offered to swap his aisle seat for a window seat on the flight.
items.ex_zh: 他主动提出在航班上用自己的靠过道座位换一个靠窗座位。

items.def_zh: 切换（在两种状态或选项间转换）；用拴扣扣紧
items.def_en: 1. (computing) To switch between two different options, states, or settings. 2. To fasten with a toggle.
items.ex_en: You can easily toggle between the two user profiles by clicking this small button.
items.ex_zh: 只需点击这个小按钮，你就可以在两个用户配置文件之间轻松切换。

items.def_en: (+ into/for) to substitute one obligation, penalty, or formal arrangement for another
items.ex_en: The governor chose to commute the harsh prison sentence into community service hours.
items.ex_zh: 州长选择将严厉的监禁判决减为社区服务工时。

items.def_en: to turn upside down or reverse the regular order, position, or relationship of items
items.ex_en: The artist decided to invert the normal order of colors to create dramatic contrast.
items.ex_zh: 这位艺术家决定颠倒正常的色彩顺序，以营造强烈的对比感。

items.def_zh: 调换……的顺序（或位置）；（音乐）移调；（数学）移项
items.def_en: 1. To change the relative order or position of two or more things. 2. (music) To play or write music in a different key.
items.ex_en: The printer accidentally transposed two letters, resulting in an awkward spelling error.
items.ex_zh: 印刷工不小心颠倒了两个字母的位置，导致了一个尴尬的拼写错误。

groups.summary_en: An agent switches an operating state between two alternative settings, or exchanges the mutual order, positions, or polarities of two elements.
groups.summary_zh: 在两种状态间来回切换，或置换两者的顺序与位置。
groups.desc_en: Denotes altering state, direction, or role by trading places or alternating between discrete binary options, contrasting with irreversible transformation.
groups.desc_zh: 指在两个或多个离散选项、状态或角色之间进行互换、交替或调换，区别于不可逆的质变改造。
groups.nuance_en: toggle: alternate back and forth between two distinct states with a single trigger (switch / view / mode) · swap: exchange two items or positions mutually between parties (seats / places / shifts) · switch over: change operational systems or allegiance entirely to an alternative (system / power / supplier) · alternate: perform or happen in regular, successive turns (shifts / turns / duties) · invert: flip an orientation, hierarchy, or sequence into its exact opposite (order / colors / hierarchy)
groups.nuance_zh: toggle: 一键在两种互斥状态或模式间来回切换 (switch / view / mode) · swap: 双方互相交换物品、位置或班次 (seats / places / shifts) · switch over: 彻底转移或切换到另一系统或供应商 (system / power / supplier) · alternate: 规律性地轮流交替发生或任职 (shifts / turns / duties) · invert: 将顺序、上下方位或层级完全颠倒颠置 (order / colors / hierarchy)

groups.name: Systematize & Categorize · 整理与归类 (Methodical Structuring and Permutation)
groups.tip: 按逻辑秩序梳理并排列系统化

items.def_en: (+ sth) Divide complex data or items into structured subcategories
items.ex_en: The analyst will break down the quarterly sales figures into distinct regional categories.
items.ex_zh: 分析师将把季度销售数据按不同区域细分拆解。
items.ex2_en: Complex statistical metrics break down into simple baseline measurements for beginners.
items.ex2_zh: 复杂的统计指标可以分解为适合初学者的简单基准测量值。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Organize, separate, or classify items into systematic groups
items.ex_en: She spent the weekend helping her mother sort out old family documents into folders.
items.ex_zh: 她整个周末都在帮母亲把旧的家庭文件分类整理进各个文件夹中。

items.def_en: (+ as/into) to assign items to specific groups in a formal taxonomy
items.ex_en: Biologists classify this newly discovered insect species as a member of the beetle family.
items.ex_zh: 生物学家将这种新发现的昆虫物种归类为甲虫科的一员。

items.def_en: (+ as/into) to place items systematically into designated classes based on shared features
items.ex_en: Librarians categorize the donated books into distinct genres before placing them on shelves.
items.ex_zh: 图书管理员在上架之前，会先将捐赠的书籍系统地归入不同门类。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Assign someone or something to a rigid, predetermined category
items.ex_en: The critics quickly pigeonholed her into the narrow category of romantic comedy actresses.
items.ex_zh: 评论家们很快就把她死板地归为浪漫喜剧女演员一类。

items.def_en: to reduce complex data into a schematic outline, framework, or diagram
items.ex_en: The engineer managed to schematize the complicated electrical network into a clear diagram.
items.ex_zh: 工程师成功将复杂的电力网络图表化整理成清晰的架构图。

items.def_zh: 使系统化，使条理化，有系统地整理
items.def_en: 1. To organize ideas, rules, or information according to a clear, logical system.
items.ex_en: The new manager plans to systematize all filing procedures to boost workplace efficiency.
items.ex_zh: 新经理计划将所有归档流程系统化，以提高工作效率。

items.def_en: 1. (mathematics / formal) To arrange a set of items, letters, or numbers into different orders.
items.ex_en: The algorithm can permute the input sequence into hundreds of distinct mathematical variations.
items.ex_zh: 该算法可以将输入序列排列置换出数百种不同的数学变体。

items.def_en: to arrange rules, laws, or structural principles into a formal, systematic code
items.ex_en: Legal scholars worked diligently for years to codify traditional customary practices into statutory law.
items.ex_zh: 法学学者们多年来勤勉工作，旨在将传统习俗法典化为成文法。

groups.summary_en: A thinker or analyst arranges complex information, items, or concepts into coherent categorical hierarchies, formal systems, or calculated sequence combinations.
groups.summary_zh: 按理性逻辑、分类框架或数学排列梳理复杂要素。
groups.desc_en: Denotes structuring a disordered mass into a logical, accessible scheme based on criteria, hierarchies, or discrete buckets, contrasting with arbitrary grouping.
groups.desc_zh: 指依据明确标准、层级或类别将杂乱事物整编为有序系统，区别于随意的拼凑归并。
groups.nuance_en: classify: arrange systematically into established scientific or taxonomic groups (species / documents / assets) · categorize: assign items to specific descriptive labels or functional buckets (data / records / responses) · systematize: organize haphazard practices or concepts into a coherent, rule-based framework (rules / methods / knowledge) · pigeonhole into: classify rigidly and unfairly into an oversimplified niche (genres / roles / stereotypes) · sort out: disentangle, separate, and arrange mixed items logically (mess / files / priorities)
groups.nuance_zh: classify: 按既定科学、保密或分类学标准进行正式定级分类 (species / documents / assets) · categorize: 将数据或物品归入特定描述性类目 (data / records / responses) · systematize: 将零散做法或经验条理化、体系化为统一规则 (rules / methods / knowledge) · pigeonhole into: 刻板狭隘地强行归类或定性 (genres / roles / stereotypes) · sort out: 理顺、挑拣并整顿杂乱的物品或事务 (mess / files / priorities)

groups.name: Take a Short Light Sleep · 打盹与小憩 (Doze, Snooze, Nap)
groups.tip: 白天闭目养神或短时间浅睡

items.def_en: to sleep lightly or briefly, especially during the daytime
items.ex_en: He usually likes to nap on the comfortable living room couch after Sunday lunch.
items.ex_zh: 周日午饭后，他通常喜欢在舒适的客厅沙发上小睡一会儿。

items.def_en: to have a very short, light sleep of a few minutes
items.ex_en: I managed to catnap in the back of the taxi between busy client appointments.
items.ex_zh: 在忙碌的客户会面间隙，我在出租车后座上匆匆打了个盹。

items.def_en: (informal) To sleep lightly for a short period of time, especially during the day.
items.ex_en: The tired commuter decided to snooze quietly until the train reached the final station.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的通勤者决定安静地小睡片刻，直到列车到达终点站。

items.def_en: (+ off) To sleep lightly or fitfully, especially unintentionally for a short time during the day.
items.ex_en: Grandpa began to doze in his rocking chair while watching the evening television news.
items.ex_zh: 爷爷看着晚间电视新闻，在摇椅上渐渐打起了瞌睡。

items.def_en: Fall into a light, unintentional sleep for a brief period
items.ex_en: Several students began to doze off during the professor's lengthy and monotone lecture.
items.ex_zh: 在教授冗长而单调的讲座中，好几名学生开始打起瞌睡来。

items.def_en: Gradually and gently fall into a light sleep
items.ex_en: She listened to the gentle falling rain and began to drift off peacefully.
items.ex_zh: 听着窗外淅淅沥沥的细雨，她平静地渐渐睡着了。

items.def_en: Slip into light sleep, often suddenly or unintentionally
items.ex_en: I can drop you off at the station on my way to work.
items.ex_zh: 我上班顺路可以把你送到车站下车。

items.def_en: to fall asleep unintentionally, often with the head dropping forward
items.ex_en: He was so exhausted that he started to nod off during the meeting.
items.ex_zh: 他实在太累了，以至于在开会时忍不住耷拉着脑袋打起瞌睡来。

items.def_en: to be half asleep, languid, or in a lethargic, sleepy state
items.ex_en: The warm summer breeze made the tired travelers drowse peacefully under the oak tree.
items.ex_zh: 温暖的夏日微风让疲倦的行人在橡树下慵懒地昏昏欲睡。

groups.summary_en: Describes entering a brief, light, and easily interrupted period of sleep, typically outside of one's regular nightly bed routine. Verbs vary from intentional daytime rest ('nap', 'snooze') to accidental, intermittent drifting into unconsciousness ('doze', 'nod off').
groups.summary_zh: 指在非正式就寝时间短暂、轻微地入睡或打瞌睡。
groups.desc_en: Denotes taking a brief, non-restorative or restorative shallow sleep outside main nocturnal slumber, contrasting with deep continuous nighttime sleep.
groups.desc_zh: 指在夜间主睡眠之外进行的短暂、浅层睡眠或打盹，区别于深度长效的整夜安睡。
groups.nuance_en: nap: intentionally take a brief scheduled rest, usually during the day (afternoon / hour / baby) · doze: sleep lightly and intermittently, easily awakened by minor stimuli (sun / chair / afternoon) · snooze: indulge in brief, lazy sleep or hit an alarm delay (alarm / morning / sofa) · catnap: take an exceptionally short, snatched power sleep (train / desk / minutes) · nod off: unintentionally fall asleep while sitting upright due to drowsiness (meeting / wheel / lecture)
groups.nuance_zh: nap: 有计划的短暂白天小睡或午休 (afternoon / hour / baby) · doze: 处于半睡半醒、极易被微弱声响惊醒的浅睡状态 (sun / chair / afternoon) · snooze: 贪睡赖床或小憩片刻 (alarm / morning / sofa) · catnap: 忙里偷闲打个几分钟的极短瞌睡 (train / desk / minutes) · nod off: 在坐立、开会或听课时因困倦不由自主地打瞌睡点头 (meeting / wheel / lecture)

groups.name: Tap & Strike · 敲击与打击 (Percussive Surface Impact)
groups.tip: 轻微敲打发出清脆声响

items.def_en: (+ sth) Strike a surface lightly and rhythmically with fingers or a small tool
items.ex_en: The bored student began to tap on the wooden desk with his pencil.
items.ex_zh: 百无聊赖的学生开始用铅笔轻轻敲打木质课桌。

items.def_en: (+ on/at) to strike a door or hard surface repeatedly with the knuckles or an object
items.ex_en: Please knock on the manager's office door before entering for your performance review.
items.ex_zh: 在进入经理办公室进行绩效评估之前，请先敲门。

items.def_en: 1. To hit someone or something quickly and lightly, often making a small noise.
items.ex_en: She felt someone tap her shoulder lightly while she waited in the grocery line.
items.ex_zh: 在超市排队时，她感到有人轻轻拍了拍她的肩膀。

items.def_en: (+ on/at) to strike a hard surface sharply and rapidly, producing a crisp knocking sound
items.ex_en: The stern teacher used a wooden ruler to rap sharply on the chalkboard.
items.ex_zh: 严厉的老师用木尺在黑板上急促地敲击了几下。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Strike a surface repeatedly and forcefully, making a loud noise
items.ex_en: He keeps banging on about how things used to be better in the old days.
items.ex_zh: 他老是没完没了地念叨过去的日子有多好。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Strike a door or surface repeatedly with heavy, forceful blows
items.ex_en: Angry protesters began to pound on the heavy gates of the government building.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的抗议者开始用力捶打政府大楼沉重的铁门。

items.def_en: (+ on/against) to hit heavily and repeatedly with heavy blows
items.ex_en: Huge ocean waves continued to pound against the fragile wooden pillars of the pier.
items.ex_zh: 巨大的海浪不断连续猛烈撞击着码头脆弱的木桩。

items.def_zh: 猛击，重击；砰砰作响，发出巨响
items.def_en: 1. To hit something hard, making a loud noise. 2. To make a sudden loud noise.
items.ex_en: The frustrated mechanic began to bang the rusted engine part with a heavy wrench.
items.ex_zh: 沮丧的修理工拿起重扳手，重重地砸向生锈的发动机零件。
