items.ex2_en: The loose wooden shutters bang loudly against the wall during strong winds.
items.ex2_zh: 大风天里，松动的木百叶窗在墙上砰砰作响。

items.def_en: to hit something hard with a blunt instrument or fist, producing a heavy dull sound
items.ex_en: He watched the angry man thump his heavy fist onto the wooden table.
items.ex_zh: 他看着那个愤怒的男人用沉重的拳头重重砸在木桌上。

groups.summary_en: An agent strikes an object or surface with an implement or body part, spanning from light, rhythmic finger contact to loud, reverberating collisions. Verbs are differentiated by the force exerted and the auditory resonance produced.
groups.summary_zh: 从轻点轻叩到发出响亮撞击声的表面敲击动作。
groups.desc_en: Denotes delivering percussive mechanical impacts to a rigid surface to produce sound or force, graduated along an acoustic and kinetic intensity continuum.
groups.desc_zh: 指对坚硬表面施加脉冲式机械敲打以产生声响或冲击力，沿声学与动能强度梯度分布。
groups.nuance_en: tap: strike lightly and briskly with a finger or small tool (shoulder / glass / foot) · knock: strike firmly with knuckles or an implement to signal presence (door / window / wood) · rap: deliver a sharp, quick, resonant stroke (knuckles / gavel / table) · bang: strike with loud, violent, echoing resonance (table / drum / door) · pound: deliver continuous, heavy, smashing blows with immense force (fists / gate / pavement)
groups.nuance_zh: tap: 用手指或小工具轻巧敏捷地轻敲或轻叩 (shoulder / glass / foot) · knock: 用指关节或器具笃笃敲击以示意存在 (door / window / wood) · rap: 急促而清脆地短促敲击 (knuckles / gavel / table) · bang: 猛烈击打发出震耳巨响 (table / drum / door) · pound: 以极大力量连续沉重地擂砸或重击 (fists / gate / pavement)

groups.name: Teach & Instruct · 教授与训导 (Transmit Knowledge, Skills, or Directives)
groups.tip: 传授知识与指导技能规矩

items.def_zh: 执教，训练（专项技能或应试）
items.def_en: [I/T] to train or give specialized preparation to someone for a sport, performance, or exam
items.ex_en: The retired athlete agreed to coach the promising high school basketball team this season.
items.ex_zh: 这位退役运动员同意在本赛季执教这支颇有前途的高中篮球队。

items.def_zh: 教，教导，教授；使懂得，使明白
items.def_en: 1. To give knowledge, skills, or instruction to someone, or show how to do something.
items.ex_en: She hopes to teach basic mathematics and computer programming to young elementary school students.
items.ex_zh: 她希望向小学生讲授基础数学和计算机编程知识。

items.def_zh: 教，教导，教授（teach的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense and past participle of teach; imparted knowledge or skill to someone.
items.ex_en: The veteran carpenter taught his eager young apprentice how to craft durable wooden furniture.
items.ex_zh: 这位资深木匠传授给热切的年轻学徒制作耐用木质家具的技艺。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Transmit knowledge, techniques, or traditions to a student or learner
items.ex_en: Master weavers pass on their traditional textile techniques to dedicated younger village generations.
items.ex_zh: 纺织大师将他们的传统织造技艺传授给村里敬业的年轻一代。

items.def_en: (+ sb) Guide and teach someone systematically through a process or lesson step by step
items.ex_en: Let me walk you through the new software setup process step by step.
items.ex_zh: 让我带你一步一步熟悉这款新软件的安装配置流程。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Impart or instill knowledge or discipline into someone through constant repetition
items.ex_en: The strict drill sergeant tried to drum strict military discipline into the recruits.
items.ex_zh: 严厉的训练军士试图通过反复灌输把严格的军纪教给新兵。

items.def_zh: 指导，讲授（系统技能或规程）
items.def_en: to teach someone a practical skill or academic subject in a structured, formal way
items.ex_en: The flight school instructor will instruct the student pilots in standard emergency landing procedures.
items.ex_zh: 航空学校教官将向飞行学员系统讲授标准紧急迫降程序。

items.def_zh: 个别辅导，当……的私人家教
items.def_en: [I/T] to give private instruction to a single student or small group
items.ex_en: She earns extra income by offering to tutor neighborhood high school students in calculus.
items.ex_zh: 她通过给附近的几名高中生个别辅导微积分来赚取额外收入。

items.def_zh: 灌输（教条、特定思想意识）
items.def_en: to force someone to accept a set of political or religious beliefs uncritically
items.ex_en: The authoritarian regime attempted to indoctrinate young schoolchildren with extreme political propaganda.
items.ex_zh: 该极权政权试图用极端的政治宣传向年轻学童灌输思想。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this educational communication frame denote conveying expertise, formal doctrine, practical techniques, or behavioral guidelines from teacher to learner. They range from natural pedagogical guidance ('teach') to regimented systematic coaching or ideological inculcation.
groups.summary_zh: 通过课堂传授、技术指导或思想灌输，使受众掌握技能与知识。
groups.desc_en: Denotes transferring systematic understanding, physical execution skills, or explicit directives from an authority to a learner, contrasting with passive self-discovery.
groups.desc_zh: 指授业者向学习者系统传授知识、技能或程序规程，区别于被动的自学摸索。
groups.nuance_en: teach: impart general knowledge, concepts, or academic subjects broadly (curriculum / students / class) · instruct: give formal, authoritative directions or structured practical training (trainees / jury / pupils) · coach: provide intensive, individualized performance and strategy training (athletes / team / actors) · tutor: provide private, remedial academic instruction to individuals or small groups (pupils / remedial students / math) · drum into: drill facts or beliefs into someone through relentless, forceful repetition (heads / facts / rules)
groups.nuance_zh: teach: 广泛传授普适知识、学科概念或生活常理 (curriculum / students / class) · instruct: 下达正式操作指示或开展系统规范训练 (trainees / jury / pupils) · coach: 针对技能、比赛或策略进行个性化临场辅导 (athletes / team / actors) · tutor: 进行个别化私人家教或补习辅导 (pupils / remedial students / math) · drum into: 通过反复灌输、死记硬背强行灌输规条 (heads / facts / rules)

groups.name: Tease & Mock · 戏谑与嘲弄 (Tease, Rib, Mock)
groups.tip: 用滑稽言行开玩笑或戏谑调侃

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Tease or playfully ridicule someone in an amused manner
items.ex_en: His friends loved to poke fun at his terrible attempt at baking cookies.
items.ex_zh: 他的朋友们很喜欢拿他糟糕的烤饼干手艺来开玩笑打趣。

items.def_zh: 扮小丑，耍活宝，滑稽逗乐
items.def_en: (+ around/about) To behave in a silly, funny, or playful way to make people laugh.
items.ex_en: The two brothers continued to clown around in the living room until bedtime.
items.ex_zh: 两兄弟一直在客厅里嬉闹耍宝，直到睡觉时间才停下来。

items.def_zh: 逗弄，戏谑，取笑；给……装上肋状物
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To tease or make fun of someone in a good-natured way. 2. To strengthen or provide something with ribs.
items.ex_en: His coworkers like to rib him good-naturedly whenever he arrives wearing matching socks.
items.ex_zh: 每当他穿着搭配得体的新袜子来上班，同事们总爱善意地打趣他。

items.def_en: to tease someone in a light-hearted, good-natured way
items.ex_en: The elderly gentlemen would often chaff each other amiably over their morning game of chess.
items.ex_zh: 两位老先生常常在晨间下棋时互致打趣，谈笑风生。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Subject someone to mockery, laughter, or derisive jokes
items.ex_en: It is completely unkind to make fun of someone just because of their accent.
items.ex_zh: 仅仅因为某人的口音就去嘲笑对方是极其不友善的行为。

items.def_en: (+ sb) Tease, mock, or harshly banter at someone's expense
items.ex_en: The comedians began to rip on each other during the lively podcast recording session.
items.ex_zh: 喜剧演员们在热闹的播客录制期间开始肆意互相吐槽戏谑。

items.def_zh: 讽刺，讥讽，借讽刺作品批评
items.def_en: To criticize or mock someone or something using satire, irony, or humor.
items.ex_en: The political cartoon dared to satirize the arrogant behavior of the corrupt local officials.
items.ex_zh: 这幅政治讽刺漫画大胆地讥讽了当地腐败官员的傲慢行径。

items.def_en: to provoke or challenge someone with cruel, insulting, or mocking remarks
items.ex_en: Rival fans attempted to taunt the visiting goalkeeper with loud jeers and crude chants.
items.ex_zh: 客队门将遭遇了主队球迷大声喝倒彩和粗鲁歌声的肆意挑衅奚落。

items.def_en: (formal) to express contempt for or mock as foolish and completely worthless
items.ex_en: Prominent academics chose to deride his unorthodox scientific theory as absurd and completely unfounded.
items.ex_zh: 知名学者们对他的非正统科学理论嗤之以鼻，斥其荒谬且毫无依据。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve communicating in a playful, ironic, or derisive manner to poke fun at, ridicule, or provoke someone. They vary from affectionate ribbing ('rib', 'tease') to dramatic buffoonery ('clown') and sharper cultural or personal ridicule ('mock', 'satirize').
groups.summary_zh: 指通过言语或戏谑举止开玩笑、揶揄或讽刺挖苦他人。
groups.desc_en: Denotes subjecting a target to ridicule, banter, or biting satire, spanning from affectionate prodding to derisive hostility.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过言辞戏谑、挖苦或讽刺使目标对象受到调侃或羞辱，涵盖从善意逗趣到恶意贬损的谱系。
groups.nuance_en: tease: provoke or laugh at someone playfully or persistently to irritate them (siblings / hair / crush) · mock: mimic or scorn someone contemptuously to make them look ridiculous (accent / efforts / opponent) · taunt: challenge or insult someone maliciously to provoke an angry reaction (crowd / defense / captive) · satirize: expose and criticize human folly or vice using irony and wit (politicians / society / regime) · rib: poke good-natured fun at an acquaintance or friend (colleagues / obsession / accent)
groups.nuance_zh: tease: 善意挑弄或持续逗弄以激起对方反应 (siblings / hair / crush) · mock: 带有轻蔑鄙视意味地模仿或嘲讽 (accent / efforts / opponent) · taunt: 恶意挑衅或出言羞辱以激怒对方 (crowd / defense / captive) · satirize: 运用讽刺手法揭露并批判社会荒谬或政治丑态 (politicians / society / regime) · rib: 在熟人或朋友间进行善意、不带恶意的打趣 (colleagues / obsession / accent)

groups.name: Tease & Rib · 戏谑与调侃捉弄 (Lighthearted Jesting and Banter)
groups.tip: 带玩笑或挑衅性质的言语逗弄

items.def_en: [I/T] to deceive someone playfully as a joke
items.ex_en: Don't take his harsh words seriously; he was only trying to kid with you.
items.ex_zh: 别把他的重话当真，他刚才只是想跟你开个玩笑逗逗你。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to tease or ridicule someone or something in a playful or unkind way
items.ex_en: The older siblings like to make fun of his silly new haircut at dinner.
items.ex_zh: 哥哥姐姐们喜欢在晚饭时拿他滑稽的新发型来开玩笑打趣。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to tease or mock someone or something in a lighthearted or gentle way
items.ex_en: Colleagues frequently poke fun at his peculiar habit of organizing pens by shade.
items.ex_zh: 同事们经常拿他按色调排列钢笔的奇特怪癖来善意取笑。

items.def_zh: 故意调侃；故意惹怒/逗弄
items.def_en: (+ sb) to deliberately tease or play a prank on someone to provoke a reaction
items.ex_en: He told that outrageous story simply to wind up his gullible younger sister.
items.ex_zh: 他编造那个离奇的故事纯粹是为了故意调侃他那容易上当的妹妹。

items.def_en: (informal, chiefly British) To tease, fool, or play a joke on someone.
items.ex_en: Stop pretending that you lost the house keys just to cod me like that.
items.ex_zh: 别再假装把家门钥匙弄丢了，就为了这样戏弄我一番。

items.def_en: to joke with or tease someone in a friendly and good-natured way
items.ex_en: They continued to rib their friend about his clumsy dance moves at the wedding.
items.ex_zh: 他们继续在婚礼上就朋友笨拙的舞步善意调侃他。

items.def_en: 1. (informal) To tease, taunt, or mock someone in a teasing or aggressive way. 2. To scold or criticize someone harshly.
items.ex_en: The older boys in the locker room liked to rag the rookie about his boots.
items.ex_zh: 更衣室里的大男孩们喜欢就新人的球靴捉弄嘲弄他。

items.def_en: [I/T] to laugh at someone and make jokes about them, either playfully or unkindly
items.ex_en: She used to tease her younger brother playfully about his childhood fears of thunder.
items.ex_zh: 她过去常常善意逗弄弟弟，拿他小时候害怕雷声的事情打趣。

items.def_en: to tease someone in a good-humored, bantering way
items.ex_en: The villagers gathered outside the tavern to chaff the nervous young suitor playfully.
items.ex_zh: 村民们聚集在酒馆外，善意地打趣逗弄那个紧张的年轻求婚者。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers playful, informal vocal teasing, banter, or mild torment directed at an individual without severe malice. British and colloquial verbs like 'rag', 'cod', 'rib', and 'chaff' capture affectionate raillery and light mocking.
groups.summary_zh: 指朋友或熟人之间善意的戏弄、取笑或玩笑式调侃。
groups.desc_en: Denotes affectionate, lighthearted teasing and playful banter among familiars, contrasting with malicious or cutting mockery.
groups.desc_zh: 指熟人、朋友之间带有温情、善意且轻松的打趣逗弄，区别于带伤人恶意的讽刺挖苦。
groups.nuance_en: kid: speak jokingly or deceptively in light banter without serious intent (friends / boss / siblings) · tease: playfully provoke someone over quirks or romantic interests (parents / peers / friend) · rib: deliver friendly, teasing digs regarding a known habit or mistake (mate / teammate / colleague) · wind up: deliberately feed false stories to trick and exasperate someone for fun (brother / mate / colleague) · rag: playfully nag or give someone a hard time through teasing (freshmen / rookie / buddy)
groups.nuance_zh: kid: 轻松开玩笑或半真半假地逗乐，无严肃恶意 (friends / boss / siblings) · tease: 拿小毛病或情感八卦善意逗趣打趣 (parents / peers / friend) · rib: 就对方熟知的习惯或小尴尬进行哥们式打趣 (mate / teammate / colleague) · wind up: 故意编造谎话或使坏耍弄对方以看其急躁反应 (brother / mate / colleague) · rag: 半开玩笑地挖苦、数落或调侃 (freshmen / rookie / buddy)

groups.name: Test & Substantiate Validity · 检验与证实 (Test, Verify, Prove)
groups.tip: 用实据验证真实性

items.def_en: to examine something carefully to discover its quality, reliability, or truth
items.ex_en: Engineers must thoroughly test the structural integrity of the bridge before opening it to traffic.
items.ex_zh: 工程师在大桥通车前必须彻底检验其结构完整性。

items.def_zh: 证明，证实；展现；事实证明是，结果是
items.def_en: 1. To show that something is true by providing facts or evidence. 2. to turn out to be in the end.
items.ex_en: The detective presented fingerprint evidence to prove the suspect was present at the scene.
items.ex_zh: 侦探出示了指纹证据，以证明嫌疑人当时确实在犯罪现场。

items.def_zh: 检验，试验；校对（文本）；对……进行防护处理
items.def_en: 1. To test or check something to verify its accuracy or quality; to read and correct printer's proofs. 2. To treat something to make it resistant to damage.
items.ex_en: The dedicated editor stayed late into the night to proof the manuscript for printing.
items.ex_zh: 敬业的编辑工作到深夜，仔细校对准备交付印刷的稿件。

items.def_en: (+ on/with) To conduct scientific tests or try out new ideas to discover or verify something.
items.ex_en: The university researchers plan to experiment with different ceramic compounds under extreme heat conditions.
items.ex_zh: 大学研究人员计划在极高温条件下用不同的陶瓷化合物进行实验。

items.def_zh: 核实，查证（真伪或准确性）
items.def_en: to check and prove that something is true, accurate, or genuine
items.ex_en: The auditors will verify the company's financial records before finalizing the report.
items.ex_zh: 审计人员将在最终确定报告前核实公司的财务记录。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to test something experimentally to see how well it works or whether it is valid
items.ex_en: Scientists built a prototype to test out the aerodynamics in a wind tunnel.
items.ex_zh: 科学家们制造了原型机，以便在风洞中测试其空气动力学性能。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to support or confirm the truth or accuracy of a claim, prediction, or theory
items.ex_en: The final audit results bore out all our initial suspicions about financial mismanagement.
items.ex_zh: 最终的审计结果证实了我们最初对财务管理不善的所有怀疑。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to investigate or examine something to confirm its truth, or to prove to be true and correct
items.ex_en: We need to check out of the hotel by noon, but let's check out the local market first.
items.ex_zh: 我们需要在中午前结账退房，不过先去看看当地的集市吧。

items.def_zh: 用事实证实，确证（指控或观点）
items.def_en: to provide concrete evidence that proves something is true or valid
items.ex_en: The prosecutor failed to substantiate the serious allegations with concrete physical evidence.
items.ex_zh: 检察官未能用具体的实物证据来证实这些严重的指控。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe determining the truth, quality, or operational competence of a hypothesis, claim, or product through rigorous empirical testing or logical demonstration.
groups.summary_zh: 通过实证检验、试验或严密论据来确证真实性或有效性。
groups.desc_en: Denotes empirically challenging an assertion, object, or hypothesis to validate its truth, quality, or operational readiness, contrasting with speculative acceptance.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过实证、操作或实验对断言、对象或假设进行压力考验与核实，区别于主观臆断或被动接受。
groups.nuance_en: test: subject to trials, stresses, or criteria to gauge capability or quality (system / hypothesis / patience) · verify: confirm the factual accuracy or authenticity of a claim by cross-checking (identity / data / facts) · prove: establish beyond doubt through rigorous demonstration or evidence (theory / innocence / guilt) · bear out: corroborate and validate a prediction, hypothesis, or claim through subsequent events (predictions / theory / evidence) · test out: field-test a method or device practically in real conditions (ideas / equipment / prototype)
groups.nuance_zh: test: 施加负荷、考验或试运行以检验性能或质量 (system / hypothesis / patience) · verify: 通过查证、比对核实事实或数据的真实准确性 (identity / data / facts) · prove: 凭借严密逻辑或确凿证据无可辩驳地证明 (theory / innocence / guilt) · bear out: 后续事实或结果印证了早前的预测或假说 (predictions / theory / evidence) · test out: 在实际场景中动手试用或实地检验 (ideas / equipment / prototype)

groups.name: Thread & String · 穿引与串联 (Thread, String, Bead)
groups.tip: 用线绳将细小物件串接成行

items.def_en: (+ sth) to fasten or tighten shoes or garments by drawing laces through eyelets
items.ex_en: He sat on the bench to lace up his running shoes tightly.
items.ex_zh: 他坐在长凳上，把跑鞋的鞋带紧紧系好。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to join several items together sequentially on a string or cord
items.ex_en: The children helped string together painted wooden beads to make colorful necklaces.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们帮忙把涂了颜色的木珠串在一起，制作五彩斑斓的项链。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to pass a thread, cord, or flexible strip through a narrow hole or series of openings
items.ex_en: A recurring theme of alienation threads through all his novels.
items.ex_zh: 一种反复出现的疏离感主题贯穿了他所有的小说。

items.def_en: to pass a thread, ribbon, or wire through the eye of a needle or narrow aperture
items.ex_en: She carefully threaded the fine silk line through the tiny needle eye.
items.ex_zh: 她小心翼翼地将细丝线穿过微小的针眼。

items.def_en: to string beads onto a cord or decorate by threading beads
items.ex_en: The artisan spent hours beading small sparkling crystals onto the delicate ribbon.
items.ex_zh: 手艺人花了数小时将闪亮的小水晶穿成珠状串在精致的丝带上。

items.def_en: to pass a thread or line through an aperture again
items.ex_en: You must rethread the sewing machine before continuing with the torn hem.
items.ex_zh: 在继续缝补破损的下摆之前，你必须给缝纫机重新穿线。

items.def_zh: （string 的过去式和过去分词）用线穿起；悬挂；给（乐器）装弦
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of string: to thread objects onto a string; to hang in a line; to fit strings onto an instrument.
items.ex_en: Workers strung vibrant paper lanterns across the courtyard for the evening festival.
items.ex_zh: 工人们在院子里拉起一排鲜艳的纸灯笼，以迎接晚间的节日。

items.def_zh: 用线串起；用线系，悬挂；给（乐器）上弦
items.def_en: 1. To thread a series of objects onto a cord, thread, or wire. 2. To hang or stretch something across or around an area in a line. 3. To put strings on a musical instrument or sports racket.
items.ex_en: She decided to string polished seashells along a sturdy wire for decoration.
items.ex_zh: 她决定用坚固的金属丝将抛光的贝壳串起来作为装饰。

items.def_en: to draw a cord or lace through eyelets or openings to fasten something
items.ex_en: She carefully laced the leather cord through the brass eyelets of the bodice.
items.ex_zh: 她小心翼翼地将皮绳穿过紧身胸衣的黄铜孔眼系紧。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to passing a fine filament, cord, or flexible medium through an opening or aperture, or sequentially arranging small perforated objects onto a line.
groups.summary_zh: 指将细线穿过孔眼，或把多件打孔物品顺次串在绳线上的动作。
groups.desc_en: Denotes navigating a flexible filament through narrow openings or aligning multiple perforate objects sequentially along a line, contrasting with bundling or weaving.
groups.desc_zh: 指引导柔性线缆穿过细小孔洞，或将带孔物件顺次排布贯穿成串，区别于整体编织或捆扎。
groups.nuance_en: thread: pass a thin filament carefully through an aperture, eyelet, or narrow path (needle / lace / maze) · string: pass a cord through multiple beads or suspend items along a line (pearls / lights / beads) · bead: furnish, decorate, or string with small ornamental perforated balls (necklace / dress / curtain) · lace up: fasten tightly by crisply crisscrossing cords through eyelets (boots / corset / skates) · string together: connect disparate items, words, or thoughts into a coherent sequence (words / sentences / victories)
groups.nuance_zh: thread: 仔细将细线引穿过狭窄孔眼或迷宫缝隙 (needle / lace / maze) · string: 用绳线贯穿珠子或将串状物悬挂串联 (pearls / lights / beads) · bead: 用珠子装饰或顺次穿串串珠 (necklace / dress / curtain) · lace up: 用鞋带等线绳在孔洞间交叉穿引并系紧 (boots / corset / skates) · string together: 将零碎的词句、事件或概念顺畅地串接成串 (words / sentences / victories)

groups.name: Threaten & Intimidate · 威胁与恫吓 (Intimidation / Coercive Menace)
groups.tip: 言语叫嚣到武力威慑恐吓

items.def_en: (+ sb) to bully, intimidate, or tell someone what to do in an aggressive and unfair manner
items.ex_en: Don't let them push you around; you have rights as a tenant.
items.ex_zh: 别让他们摆布你；作为租客你也是有权利的。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to make someone or something go away by frightening or intimidating them
items.ex_en: The loud barking of the guard dog quickly scared off the intruders.
items.ex_zh: 看门犬的大声吠叫迅速吓跑了入侵者。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to defeat or intimidate someone by looking directly and forcefully into their eyes until they look away
items.ex_en: The union leader managed to stare down government negotiators.
items.ex_zh: 工会领袖在谈判桌上顶住压力，以毫不妥协的气势逼退了政府谈判代表。

items.def_en: to act in a threatening or dangerously hostile manner toward sb/sth
items.ex_en: Hostile naval vessels continued to menace commercial shipping routes in international waters.
items.ex_zh: 敌对军舰继续在国际水域对商业航道构成威胁。

items.def_zh: 放空话威吓，叫嚣，咆哮；（风）呼啸，狂吹
items.def_en: 1. To speak aggressively or threateningly, often with little effect or without backing it up. 2. (of wind) To blow violently and noisily.
items.ex_en: The defeated commander could only bluster in futile rage before the tribunal.
items.ex_zh: 战败的指挥官在法庭前只能徒劳地狂怒咆哮。

items.def_zh: 威胁，恐吓；危及；预示（凶兆或坏事）
items.def_en: 1. To state your intention to harm or punish someone. 2. To be likely to cause damage or harm to something.
items.ex_en: Rising sea levels threaten low-lying coastal communities with severe and frequent flooding.
items.ex_zh: 不断上升的海平面威胁着沿海低洼社区，可能带来频繁而严重的洪灾。

items.def_en: to deliberately frighten sb into doing or not doing sth through overt pressure or threats
items.ex_en: Corrupt officials attempted to intimidate key witnesses into retracting their sworn testimony.
items.ex_zh: 腐败官员企图恐吓关键证人，迫使他们撤回宣誓证词。

items.def_en: to frighten or bully sb into submission using angry words or a severe manner
items.ex_en: The aggressive interrogator tried to browbeat the suspect into signing a confession.
items.ex_zh: 气势汹汹的审讯官试图威逼嫌疑人签署供词。

items.def_zh: 暴力威胁，使处于恐惧中
items.def_en: to severely frighten and dominate sb through persistent threats, violence, or brutality
items.ex_en: Armed gangs continued to terrorize the local villagers through constant nighttime raids.
items.ex_zh: 武装团伙通过持续的夜间袭击，使当地村民长期处于恐惧之中。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote communicating an intent to inflict harm, punishment, or negative consequences, scaling from noisy bluster and verbal warnings up to overt terrorization and menacing coercion.
groups.summary_zh: 表达施加伤害或惩罚的企图，从虚张声势递进到公开威逼与恐吓。
groups.desc_en: Denotes projecting menacing power, imminent harm, or aggressive postures to coerce an opponent into fear or compliance, contrasting with persuasive influence.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过展示杀伤力、迫近危险或专横姿态施加恐吓，以胁迫对方屈服退缩，区别于说理劝导。
groups.nuance_en: threaten: declare an explicit intention to inflict harm or jeopardize security (stability / violence / retaliation) · intimidate: instill paralyzing fear or inferiority through overwhelming presence or dominance (witnesses / rivals / voters) · menace: pose an ominous, looming danger through hostile demeanor (streets / civilians / peace) · browbeat: bully and harangue someone aggressively into submission (witness / employees / suspects) · stare down: overcome an adversary's nerve through an unbroken, defiant gaze (opponent / challenger / crowd)
groups.nuance_zh: threaten: 明确放话或以迹象表明将实施惩处、暴力或报复 (stability / violence / retaliation) · intimidate: 凭借体量、声势或威权使对方心生怯懦退缩 (witnesses / rivals / voters) · menace: 呈现不祥或近在眼前的持续危险威慑 (streets / civilians / peace) · browbeat: 盛气凌人地厉声呵斥、威逼就范 (witness / employees / suspects) · stare down: 用坚定挑衅的凝视压倒对方气势 (opponent / challenger / crowd)

groups.name: Thwart & Frustrate Progress · 挫败与阻挠 (Hamper, Thwart, Impede)
groups.tip: 设障阻挠行动或进程推进

items.def_en: to prevent a plan, effort, or desire from progressing or being fulfilled
items.ex_en: Unforeseen bureaucratic obstacles completely frustrated their ambitious plans for economic reform.
items.ex_zh: 无法预料的官僚阻碍彻底打乱了他们雄心勃勃的经济改革计划。

items.def_en: to completely prevent something from happening or someone from achieving a goal
items.ex_en: Sudden budget cuts stymied the research team's efforts to complete the prototype.
items.ex_zh: 突然的预算削减完全妨碍了研究团队完成原型的努力。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to block someone's path, progress, or access to resources
items.ex_en: Heavy snow cut off several remote villages for days.
items.ex_zh: 大雪将几个偏远村庄阻隔了数天之久。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to prevent or hinder someone from doing something or impede an outcome
items.ex_en: A lack of funding stands in the way of expanding the clinic.
items.ex_zh: 资金匮乏阻碍了诊所的扩建工程。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to completely stop or thwart an ongoing activity, attack, or opposing initiative
items.ex_en: The goalkeeper made an acrobatic save to shut down the opposing attack.
items.ex_zh: 守门员做出一次精彩扑救，挫败了对手的进攻。
items.ex2_en: The ancient computer system will shut down completely during routine power outages.
items.ex2_zh: 这台老旧的电脑系统在常规停电期间会完全关闭。

items.def_en: to prevent someone from succeeding in an illicit, hostile, or intended action
items.ex_en: Alert security guards acted swiftly to foil the brazen robbery attempt yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 机警的保安人员昨日迅速采取行动，挫败了这起明目张胆的抢劫企图。

items.def_en: To prevent someone or something from moving, working, or progressing easily.
items.ex_en: Dense fog and icy roads severely hamper rescue efforts after the crash.
items.ex_zh: 浓雾和结冰的道路严重阻碍了事故发生后的救援工作。

items.def_en: To prevent someone from accomplishing a plan, ambition, or effort; to frustrate.
items.ex_en: Vigilant intelligence officers acted promptly to thwart the planned terrorist attack.
items.ex_zh: 机警的情报人员迅速采取行动，挫败了预谋的恐怖袭击。

items.def_en: (formal) To delay, slow down, or prevent the progress or movement of someone or something.
items.ex_en: Severe logistical bottlenecks continue to impede the timely distribution of emergency aid.
items.ex_zh: 严重的物流瓶颈继续阻碍应急物资的及时分发。

groups.summary_en: Verbs indicating the successful interruption, obstruction, or derailment of an agent's plans, objectives, or strategic momentum through direct countermeasures or unfavorable constraints.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过外部干预、阻力或挫败手段使某人的计划或推进无法得逞。
groups.desc_en: Denotes interposing active barriers, strategic countermeasures, or friction that completely derails or drastically slows another's planned progress, contrasting with passive non-involvement.
groups.desc_zh: 指施加阻力、设置路障或采取反制手段彻底挫败阻断或严重延误他人的既定进展，区别于消极不参与。
groups.nuance_en: thwart: successfully frustrate and prevent an opponent's design, plan, or conspiracy (plot / attack / ambitions) · foil: deflect and outwit a hostile scheme at a critical juncture (robbery / plot / attempt) · hamper: impede smooth progress by imposing drag or cumbersome difficulties (efforts / rescue / investigation) · stymie: perplex and block completely, leaving no viable moves or solutions (investigation / negotiations / progress) · frustrate: render efforts futile and ineffective, causing acute blockage (attempts / plans / progress)
groups.nuance_zh: thwart: 成功反制并使对方的阴谋、图谋或攻势彻底落空 (plot / attack / ambitions) · foil: 在关键节点识破或化解危险企图 (robbery / plot / attempt) · hamper: 造成拖累或沉重负担以致妨碍顺畅推进 (efforts / rescue / investigation) · stymie: 使陷入绝境或完全卡壳，无计可施 (investigation / negotiations / progress) · frustrate: 使各项努力化为泡影并陷入徒劳阻滞 (attempts / plans / progress)

groups.name: Till & Plow the Soil · 翻土与耕作
groups.tip: 翻耕土壤准备播种

items.def_en: prepare and cultivate land for crops by plowing or breaking up the soil
items.ex_en: Farmers prepare to till the fertile soil before planting the spring crops.
items.ex_zh: 农民们准备在播种春季作物之前翻耕肥沃的土地。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to break up and turn over soil thoroughly using a plow
items.ex_en: The tractor worked for hours to plow up the hard clay soil.
items.ex_zh: 拖拉机连续作业数小时，彻底翻耕了坚硬的黏土地。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to dig and invert soil in preparation for planting
items.ex_en: You should turn over the garden soil thoroughly before planting the seeds.
items.ex_zh: 播种前，你应该把花园里的土彻底翻一遍。

items.def_en: break up and loosen soil around growing crops with an implement
items.ex_en: The gardener used a hand fork to cultivate the soil around seedlings.
items.ex_zh: 园丁用小手耙为幼苗周围的土壤进行中耕松土。

items.def_zh: 耕（地），用犁翻地；费力穿过，艰难推进
items.def_en: 1. (US) To dig and turn over soil with a plow before planting seeds. 2. (plow through/into) To force a way forward through something with difficulty.
items.ex_en: Local farmers must plow the broad fields before the autumn frost sets in.
items.ex_zh: 当地农民必须在秋霜降临之前把广袤的田地翻耕一遍。

items.def_en: To dig, loosen soil, or weed ground using a hoe.
items.ex_en: She went out early to hoe the dry ground around her vegetables.
items.ex_zh: 她大清早就出门去用锄头松动蔬菜周围的干燥土壤。

items.def_zh: 耕（地），犁田；费力穿过，艰难推进（plow 的英式拼写）
items.def_en: 1. (British English) To dig and turn over soil with a plough before sowing seeds. 2. (plough through/into) To force a way forward through something with difficulty.
items.ex_en: They brought in heavy machinery to plough the expansive fields before winter.
items.ex_zh: 他们在入冬前调来重型农机翻耕广阔的田地。

items.def_en: draw a harrow over tilled land to break clods and pulverize the surface soil
items.ex_en: The farmer hitched the tractor to harrow the field after heavy plowing.
items.ex_zh: 深度耕翻后，农夫挂上拖拉机来耙平田地并碎土。

items.def_en: make long narrow trenches in the earth with or as if with a plow
items.ex_en: The heavy iron blade began to furrow the dark, moisture-laden earth evenly.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的铁刃开始在湿润的黑土地上均匀地犁出垄沟。
items.ex2_en: The dry ground began to furrow naturally under the severe seasonal drought.
items.ex2_zh: 干涸的地面在严重的季节性干旱下开始自然裂开沟痕。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the physical and mechanical act of breaking, turning, loosening, or cutting through soil using agricultural tools (hoes, plows, tillers) to prepare land for seeding.
groups.summary_zh: 使用犁、锄等农具翻动、松动或切碎土壤以备播种的机械性耕作动作。
groups.desc_en: Denotes breaking up, inverting, and aerating topsoil using agricultural implements to prepare a fertile seedbed, contrasting with non-disruptive surface gathering.
groups.desc_zh: 指利用农具翻开、松动、碎化并通气表层土壤以备播种，区别于不翻动土层的地表采收。
groups.nuance_en: plow: cut deeply into and turn over topsoil with a heavy bladed plow (field / furrow / land) · till: prepare land comprehensively for crops by plowing, harrowing, and cultivating (soil / land / acreage) · cultivate: loosen soil around growing crops while eradicating competing weeds (soil / crops / garden) · hoe: scrape and weed topsoil with a small handheld blade (weeds / patch / garden) · harrow: break up clods and smooth plowed ground using a spike-toothed frame (field / clods / soil)
groups.nuance_zh: plow: 用重型犁铧深翻土层并开出犁沟 (field / furrow / land) · till: 综合采用翻土、耙地等方式整治耕地备播 (soil / land / acreage) · cultivate: 浅耕松土以破除土壤板结并清除杂草 (soil / crops / garden) · hoe: 用锄头除草、松表土或修整垄垄 (weeds / patch / garden) · harrow: 用齿耙碎化犁后土块并平整地面 (field / clods / soil)

groups.name: Topple & Keel · 倾覆与倒地 (Keel, Topple, Tumble)
groups.tip: 失去支撑轰然倒塌或跌倒

items.def_en: to lose balance and drop to the ground from an upright position
items.ex_en: The tall stack of heavy books began to wobble and fell over.
items.ex_zh: 那高高一叠厚重的书本开始摇晃，随后倒在地上。

items.def_en: to fall over suddenly or collapse, typically from illness, faintness, or exhaustion
items.ex_en: Overcome by the stifling heat, the young soldier suddenly keeled over backward.
items.ex_zh: 在令人窒息的酷暑下，那名年轻士兵突然向后晕厥倒地。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to overturn or cause something to tilt and fall on its side
items.ex_en: The clumsy puppy bumped the small side table and tipped over the vase.
items.ex_zh: 笨拙的小狗撞到了边桌，把花瓶给弄翻了。
items.ex2_en: The flimsy plastic chair tipped over when the heavy dog jumped up.
items.ex2_zh: 沉重的大狗跳上来时，那把单薄的塑料椅子翻倒了。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to become unsteady and collapse or fall over from a height or upright position
items.ex_en: The decayed wooden fence began to sway and finally toppled over yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 腐烂的木栅栏开始摇晃，昨天终于轰然倒下了。
items.ex2_en: The careless mover managed to topple over the precious antique marble pedestal.
items.ex2_zh: 粗心的搬运工不慎碰倒了那尊珍贵的古董大理石基座。

items.def_en: [I/T] to turn upside down or fall on one side
items.ex_en: Sudden violent wind gusts threatened to overturn the loaded delivery van completely.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的狂风险些将满载的货车彻底吹翻。
items.ex2_en: The overloaded fishing boat overturned completely in the turbulent offshore ocean waves.
items.ex2_zh: 那艘超载的渔船在汹涌的近海波浪中彻底倾覆了。

items.def_zh: （尤指因病痛或疲惫而）突然倒下，昏厥（常与 over 连用）；（船）倾覆
items.def_en: (usually keel over) To fall down suddenly, especially from illness, exhaustion, or shock; (of a boat) to capsize or turn upside down.
items.ex_en: Exhausted after days without water, the lone wanderer seemed about to keel.
items.ex_zh: 缺水数日后精疲力竭，这位孤独的漫游者似乎随时都会猝然倒下。

items.def_zh: （使）失去平衡倒下，倒塌；推翻，颠覆（政权或领导人）
items.def_en: 1. To become unsteady and fall down, or make something do this. 2. To remove a leader or government from power.
items.ex_en: The violent tremors caused several old brick chimneys to topple into rubble.
items.ex_zh: 强烈的震颤导致几座老旧的砖砌烟囱倒塌成碎石。
items.ex2_en: Persistent military pressure and public boycotts can topple corrupt regional autocrats quickly.
items.ex2_zh: 持续的军事压力和公众抵制能迅速推翻腐败的地区独裁者。

items.def_en: [I/T] to overturn or cause a boat to overturn completely in the water
items.ex_en: A massive rogue wave caused the small fishing vessel to capsize instantly.
items.ex_zh: 一道巨大的疯狗浪使这艘小型渔船瞬间在水中倾覆。
items.ex2_en: The small wooden canoe capsized completely in the turbulent river rapids.
items.ex2_zh: 那只小木独木舟在湍急的河流水流中彻底翻船了。

items.def_en: to suddenly fall down or cave in as a result of structural failure or loss of strength
items.ex_en: The dilapidated warehouse roof might collapse under the weight of heavy snow.
items.ex_zh: 年久失修的仓库屋顶可能会在厚重积雪的重压下坍塌。
items.ex2_en: Controlled underground explosions carefully collapse the abandoned industrial cooling tower inward.
items.ex2_zh: 受控的地下爆破小心翼翼地将废弃的工业冷却塔向内炸塌。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this physical dynamics frame depict losing balance or structural integrity and falling over, collapsing sideways, or being overturned, ranging from sudden fainting to catastrophic structural collapse.
groups.summary_zh: 失去重心或结构支撑发生倾斜、倒塌、翻倒或昏厥摔倒。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an object or person losing vertical equilibrium and collapsing laterally or upside-down, contrasting with a straightforward downward drop by emphasizing rotation around a fulcrum or base.
groups.desc_zh: 指物体或人失去垂直平衡后沿支点横向倾斜倒地或翻转，区别于直线下落，强调失衡翻侧的力学过程。
groups.nuance_en: tip over: slight tilt leading to accidental overturn (glass / vase / chair) · topple: unstable tall mass collapsing under weight or top-heaviness (statue / regime / tower) · keel over: abrupt sideways collapse of a person fainting or a ship turning turtle (person / boat) · capsize: nautical complete overturning bottom-up in water (vessel / sailboat / canoe)
groups.nuance_zh: tip over: 轻微倾斜导致的翻倒 (glass / vase / chair) · topple: 高耸不稳定结构因头重脚轻而倾倒 (statue / regime / tower) · keel over: 人因眩晕猝然栽倒或船侧翻 (person / boat) · capsize: 船只在水面底朝天彻底倾覆 (vessel / sailboat / canoe)

groups.name: Touch & Manipulate Manually · 触碰与手操摆弄 (Handle, Finger, Palpate)
groups.tip: 用手或工具进行摆弄掌控

items.def_en: [I/T] to touch something with your fingers in order to examine or experience its texture
items.ex_en: The tailor reached out to feel the fine wool before making cuts.
items.ex_zh: 裁缝伸手触摸细羊毛面料以检验手感，然后才开始裁剪。

items.def_en: [I/T] to put your hand or finger on something or someone
items.ex_en: She raised a gentle finger to touch the delicate petals of the rose.
items.ex_zh: 她轻轻抬起一根手指，触碰了玫瑰娇嫩的花瓣。

items.def_zh: 用手拿，触摸；操作，操纵；处理，应付
items.def_en: 1. To touch, hold, or move something with your hands. 2. To operate, control, or use a tool or machine. 3. To deal with, manage, or take charge of a situation, person, or task.
items.ex_en: Museum visitors are strictly warned not to handle the fragile ancient artifacts.
items.ex_zh: 博物馆访客受到严格警告，切勿用手触摸脆弱的古代文物。

items.def_zh: 用手指触摸，拨弄；（向警方）告发，指认
items.def_en: 1. To touch, handle, or feel something with your fingers. 2. (informal) To identify or accuse someone, especially as a criminal.
items.ex_en: He nervously fingered the coins in his pocket while waiting for results.
items.ex_zh: 在等待结果时，他紧张地用手指拨弄着口袋里的硬币。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to examine or test the surface, shape, or texture of something by touching it
items.ex_en: The blind technician carefully felt up the surface to detect tiny cracks.
items.ex_zh: 盲人技工仔细摸索着表面，以探查是否存在微小的裂纹。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to touch, handle, or fiddle with an object continuously with one's fingers
items.ex_en: The bored student continued to play with his pen during the lecture.
items.ex_zh: 无聊的学生在讲座期间不停地在手指间摆弄着钢笔。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to move or fiddle with an object idly or absentmindedly in one's hands
items.ex_en: He began to toy with the silver ring on his left finger.
items.ex_zh: 他开始漫不经心地摆弄起左手上戴着的银戒指。

items.def_en: (+ with) to touch, manipulate, or play with something restlessly with the hands
items.ex_en: She began to fiddle with her necklace whenever she felt excessively anxious.
items.ex_zh: 每当感到过度焦虑时，她就会开始胡乱摆弄胸前的项链。

items.def_en: to examine a part of the body by pressing lightly with the fingers, usually in a medical context
items.ex_en: The examining physician will gently palpate the patient's abdomen to check for swelling.
items.ex_zh: 主治医生将轻柔地对患者腹部进行触诊，以检查是否有肿胀。

groups.summary_en: An agent uses their hands, palms, or fingertips to touch, hold, examine, or physically manage an object. Verbs distinguish between general carrying/managing ('handle'), running fingertips over something casually or nervously ('finger'), and turning something over in the hands ('manipulate').
groups.summary_zh: 用手或手指触摸、摆弄、拿取或检验物体。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on tactile exploration or physical manipulation using fingers and hands, contrasting with blunt mechanical pushing by highlighting sensory feedback, dexterity, or restless idling.
groups.desc_zh: 强调使用手指或双手进行触觉感知或精细操纵，区别于机械式粗暴推拉，突出触觉反馈、敏捷度或无意识玩弄。
groups.nuance_en: handle: deliberate, responsible managing or lifting with hands (luggage / delicate goods / weapon) · finger: touching, tracing, or testing with fingertips (fabric / beads / trigger) · fiddle: restless, aimless, or amateurish manipulation (keys / knobs / pen) · toy with: casual, non-committal or playful handling (food / idea / pencil)
groups.nuance_zh: handle: 审慎、负责任的双手搬持或操控 (luggage / delicate goods / weapon) · finger: 指尖触摸、摩挲或探查 (fabric / beads / trigger) · fiddle: 坐立不安或不熟练的拨弄摆弄 (keys / knobs / pen) · toy with: 漫不经心地把玩摆弄 (food / idea / pencil)

groups.name: Trace Back & Reverse Course · 折返与循迹原路返回 (Retrace, Backtrack, Double back)
groups.tip: 受阻后撤或循原路折返

items.def_en: to start traveling back to one's point of departure or previous location
items.ex_en: The sun is setting, so let's head back to the campsite.
items.ex_zh: 太阳快下山了，我们回营地吧。

items.def_en: to curve around and return along a circular path to the starting point
items.ex_en: The scenic mountain trail will loop back to the parking lot eventually.
items.ex_zh: 这条风景优美的山间步道最终会绕回原处的停车场。

items.def_en: (+ to) to trace backward along a recorded path or previous line of motion
items.ex_en: The contamination was tracked back to a faulty valve in the plant.
items.ex_zh: 此次污染最终追溯到了工厂内一个有故障的阀门。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to return in the direction one came from, or cause someone to do so
items.ex_en: Severe blizzard conditions forced the mountaineering expedition to turn back immediately.
items.ex_zh: 严重的暴风雪天气迫使登山探险队立即原路折返。
items.ex2_en: Heavy blizzard warnings turned back hundreds of hopeful motorists at the pass.
items.ex2_zh: 严重的暴风雪预警使数百名满怀希望的车主在山口折返。

items.def_en: [I/T] to travel backwards or drive a vehicle backwards
items.ex_en: The truck driver had to reverse carefully down the narrow residential alley.
items.ex_zh: 卡车司机不得不小心翼翼地沿着狭窄的居民巷道倒车。
items.ex2_en: The cautious driver reversed the heavy pickup truck into the narrow garage.
items.ex2_zh: 谨慎的司机把那辆笨重的皮卡车倒进了狭窄的车库。

items.def_zh: 原路折返；改变立场，反悔
items.def_en: 1. To go back along the same path one came; to reverse an earlier opinion, policy, or decision.
items.ex_en: Lost in the dense fog, the hikers decided to backtrack immediately.
items.ex_zh: 在大雾中迷路后，徒步旅行者决定立即按原路折返。

items.def_en: to turn and go back in the direction you have just come from
items.ex_en: Realizing he had dropped his keys, he had to double back.
items.ex_zh: 意识到钥匙掉了之后，他不得不原路折回去找。

items.def_en: 1. To move backward or decline to an earlier, worse state; (astronomy) to appear to move in a reverse direction.
items.ex_en: The society seemed to retrograde into tribal hostility after the central government fell.
items.ex_zh: 中央政权倒台后，该社会似乎退化回了部落敌对的野蛮状态。

items.def_en: 1. To go back over the same path or route one has traveled; to recall or trace the history of something back to its origin.
items.ex_en: Detectives tried to retrace the missing victim's final steps through the city.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们试图追溯失踪受害者在城市中走过的最后足迹。

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote the precise spatial manner of reversing course, following the exact route one previously traveled, or moving in an opposite direction along a trajectory.
groups.summary_zh: 指沿原路折返、重循旧迹或逆向回到起点与前段路径的行动方式。
groups.desc_en: Involves turning around to follow a previously traversed path in reverse order, differing from merely retreating by stressing adherence to the original track or chronological sequence.
groups.desc_zh: 指原路折返或循着来时路径倒退，区别于一般的撤退，强调严格依循原路线或时间线逆向追溯。
groups.nuance_en: backtrack: reversing direction along an exact prior route or logically retracting a step (steps / route / statement) · retrace: deliberately following an original trail step by step to find something (steps / path / origins) · double back: making a sharp 180-degree turn, often to evade or surprise (tracks / trail / corner) · turn back: abandoning forward progress and returning toward the starting point (traveler / clock / army)
groups.nuance_zh: backtrack: 沿原路后退或在论述中回退反悔 (steps / route / statement) · retrace: 为寻物或查探而刻意原路重走或追溯 (steps / path / origins) · double back: 沿原路急转折回，多用于摆脱追踪 (tracks / trail / corner) · turn back: 中途放弃前进而掉头折返 (traveler / clock / army)

groups.name: Trade & Barter · 交易与交换 (Trade, Exchange, Barter)
groups.tip: 双方互通有无做买卖

items.def_zh: 做买卖，经商，从事交易；交换，互换
items.def_en: 1. To buy and sell goods or services. 2. To exchange something for something else.
items.ex_en: Merchant vessels crossed perilous oceans to trade silk and spices with distant empires.
items.ex_zh: 商船跨越险恶的大洋，与遥远的帝国做丝绸和香料的贸易。

items.def_zh: 交换，互换；兑换（货币）；交流
items.def_en: To give something to someone and receive something of equal value or type in return.
items.ex_en: The two collectors agreed to exchange rare postage stamps after brief negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 经过简短的协商，两位收藏家同意互换珍稀邮票。

items.def_en: (+ in) to buy and sell goods or people illicitly or commercially
items.ex_en: International cartels frequently traffic in illegal wildlife parts across porous jungle borders.
items.ex_zh: 跨国犯罪集团经常穿过防守松散的丛林边境非法贩运野生动物制品。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to give an old item as part of the payment when purchasing a new one
items.ex_en: I traded in my old sedan for a hybrid SUV.
items.ex_zh: 我把旧轿车折价置换了一辆混动SUV。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to exchange or give up one thing in return for gaining another
items.ex_en: Commuters often trade off a longer travel time for cheaper housing.
items.ex_zh: 通勤者往往以更长的路途时间换取更便宜的住房成本。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to replace one item with another equivalent item by mutual exchange
items.ex_en: The mechanic had to swap out the damaged spark plugs for new ones.
items.ex_zh: 技工不得不调换下损坏的火花塞，换上新的。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ for/with) to give something to someone in exchange for something else, usually informally
items.ex_en: The schoolchildren decided to swap their lunch snacks during the afternoon recess.
items.ex_zh: 小学生们决定在下午课间休息时互换各自带来的午餐零食。

items.def_zh: 从事金融活动；搞投机，从事欺骗性财务活动
items.def_en: To engage in financial operations, management, or financial wheeling and dealing (often implying trickery).
items.ex_en: Corrupt executives sought to financier complex shell schemes to obscure massive corporate debts.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的高管企图从事欺骗性的金融运作构筑空壳架构，以掩盖巨额公司债务。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ for/with) to exchange goods or services directly for other goods or services without using money
items.ex_en: During the economic crisis, local villagers would barter fresh vegetables for basic medical supplies.
items.ex_zh: 经济危机期间，当地村民常用新鲜蔬菜换取基础医疗用品。

groups.summary_en: Parties mutually transfer goods, services, or currency under agreed commercial or reciprocal terms.
groups.summary_zh: 双方相互让渡商品、货币或服务以实现商业互换或对等交易。
groups.desc_en: Signifies reciprocal transfer of goods, rights, or concessions between two parties, contrasting with unilateral gifting or pure financial purchasing by emphasizing direct substitution or equivalency.
groups.desc_zh: 指双方对等转让货物、权益或让步，区别于单向赠予或纯货币购买，强调以物换物、替代或等价互换。
groups.nuance_en: trade: commercial swapping or giving up one asset for another (commodities / shares / favors) · exchange: mutual, often formalized giving and receiving of equivalent items (gifts / pleasantries / currencies) · swap: informal, direct one-for-one substitution (seats / phone numbers / shifts) · barter: direct exchange of commodities without monetary intermediation (goods / livestock / produce)
groups.nuance_zh: trade: 商业性互换或以物易物 (commodities / shares / favors) · exchange: 相互给予并接收等价物的规范互换 (gifts / pleasantries / currencies) · swap: 非正式的一对一直接替换 (seats / phone numbers / shifts) · barter: 不涉及货币的纯粹实物交易 (goods / livestock / produce)

groups.name: Trade & Transact · 贸易与交易 (Trade, Deal, Merchandise)
groups.tip: 市场买卖与商业往来

items.def_zh: 做生意，经营（尤指特种或违禁商品）
items.def_en: (+ in/with) to buy and sell specific commercial goods, art, securities, or illegal drugs
items.ex_en: The undercover agent discovered that the suspect dealt in stolen art and illegal diamonds.
items.ex_zh: 卧底探员发现该嫌疑人从事被盗艺术品和非法钻石的交易。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ in/with) to buy, sell, or exchange commodities, securities, or services commercially
items.ex_en: The merchant house trades in raw silk and rare spices with several overseas partners.
items.ex_zh: 该商号与数个海外伙伴进行生丝和珍稀香料的商业贸易。

items.def_zh: 做非法买卖，贩卖（毒品、军火或人口等）；做贸易
items.def_en: To buy and sell goods illegally (such as drugs or weapons) or trade in human beings; to trade or do business.
items.ex_en: Federal prosecutors alleged that the syndicate conspired to traffic illicit firearms across international borders.
items.ex_zh: 联邦检察官指控该犯罪集团密谋跨越国境贩运非法枪支。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to buy and sell a particular product or commodity as a business
items.ex_en: For over three decades, his family firm has dealt in high-end vintage watches.
items.ex_zh: 三十多年来，他的家族企业一直经营高档古董手表。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to sell off unwanted goods or assets quickly, often at a reduced price
items.ex_en: The struggling retailer decided to flog off its excess winter stock at bargain prices.
items.ex_zh: 这家陷入困境的零售商决定低价甩卖过剩的冬季库存。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to sell all or part of an inventory, business, or assets cheaply or swiftly
items.ex_en: The company had to sell off its non-core assets to pay off debts.
items.ex_zh: 该公司不得不变卖非核心资产以偿还债务。

items.def_zh: 经商，买卖商品；推销，促销
items.def_en: 1. To buy and sell goods commercially as a merchant. 2. To promote or market goods or services to encourage sales.
items.ex_en: The studio plans to merchandise apparel and collector figurines alongside the film release.
items.ex_zh: 该工作室计划在电影上映的同时推销服装和收藏级手办。

items.def_en: to try to sell small goods by going from house to house or travelling from place to place
items.ex_en: Old hawkers used to peddle handmade brooms from door to door across the neighborhood.
items.ex_zh: 从前，老摊贩们常在附近街坊挨家挨户兜售手工扫帚。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ for/with) to exchange goods or services directly without using money
items.ex_en: In rural markets, farmers regularly barter surplus grain for handmade pottery and woven baskets.
items.ex_zh: 在乡村集市上，农民们经常用多余的粮食换取手工陶器和编织篮。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail commercial exchange, distribution, and commercial handling of goods and commodities across legitimate and illicit retail or international markets.
groups.summary_zh: 在正规商业零售或违禁跨境市场中进行商品买卖、分销及流转交易。
groups.desc_en: Covers commercial operations involving selling, marketing, or peddling merchandise for profit, contrasting with personal gifting or non-commercial sharing by emphasizing retail/wholesale transactional profit.
groups.desc_zh: 指为了营利而从事的商品批发、零售或兜售行为，区别于私人转赠或非商业共享，强调商业交易与流通。
groups.nuance_en: deal: transacting business or trading, often in high-stakes, specialized, or illicit goods (arms / drugs / cards) · merchandise: actively promoting and displaying goods to optimize retail sales (products / brand / inventory) · peddle: selling small items or ideas door-to-door or in public streets, often with derogatory undertone (wares / influence / drugs) · flog off: disposing of unwanted assets cheaply or hastily (assets / surplus stock / vehicle)
groups.nuance_zh: deal: 经营专向商品，常含高风险或违禁品交易 (arms / drugs / cards) · merchandise: 针对零售的商品推销与陈列规划 (products / brand / inventory) · peddle: 沿街兜售小商品，亦可贬指宣扬私货 (wares / influence / drugs) · flog off: 低价、仓促变卖或抛售劣质/多余资产 (assets / surplus stock / vehicle)

groups.name: Trade Embargo & Cultural Taboo · 禁运与禁忌 (Embargo, Taboo, Sanction)
groups.tip: 依据法令或习俗取缔封禁

items.def_en: to put a person, country, or organization on a list of those that are disapproved of or banned from certain dealings
items.ex_en: The financial authority decided to blacklist companies that repeatedly fail safety compliance audits.
items.ex_zh: 金融监管机构决定将屡次未通过安全合规审计的公司列入黑名单。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to deliberately exclude a party from commercial or social activities by joint refusal to deal
items.ex_en: The cartel tried to freeze out the new startup by pressuring all major distributors.
items.ex_zh: 该卡特尔企图通过向所有主要分销商施压，联手排挤那家初创公司。

items.def_zh: 联合抵制（商业往来或活动）
items.def_en: to refuse to buy, use, or participate in something as a collective act of protest
items.ex_en: Consumers organized a campaign to boycott the retailer over its controversial labor policies.
items.ex_zh: 消费者发起了一场联合抵制该零售商的活动，以抗议其备受争议的劳工政策。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to close off an area, port, or route to prevent access, movement, or trade
items.ex_en: Naval forces moved swiftly to block off the coastal strait to stop maritime trade.
items.ex_zh: 海军部队迅速行动，封锁了沿海海峡以阻止海上贸易。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to prevent someone or something from entering or participating in a market or society
items.ex_en: Aggressive domestic tariffs effectively shut out foreign competitors from the lucrative telecom market.
items.ex_zh: 激进的国内关税实际上把外国竞争对手挡在了利润丰厚的电信市场之外。

items.def_zh: 对……施加经济或外交制裁
items.def_en: to impose official penalties or commercial restrictions on a state, entity, or individual
items.ex_en: The international council voted to sanction the rogue regime over illicit nuclear enrichment.
items.ex_zh: 国际理事会投票决定对该违规政权的非法铀浓缩活动施加制裁。

items.def_en: to forbid or ban a topic, word, or practice by social convention or religious custom.
items.ex_en: Ancient religious doctrines strictly taboo the consumption of meat during the sacred fasting period.
items.ex_zh: 古老的宗教教义严禁在神圣的斋戒期间食用肉类。

items.def_zh: 对……实行禁运；禁止出版（或播发）
items.def_en: 1. to impose an official ban on trade or commercial activity with a particular country. 2. to officially ban the publication or broadcast of information before a specified date.
items.ex_en: The neighboring nations voted to embargo crude oil shipments bound for the hostile territory.
items.ex_zh: 邻国投票决定对运往敌对领土的原油货物实行禁运。

items.def_zh: 封锁（港口、边界或贸易通道）
items.def_en: to seal off an area or port by military or physical force to prevent the transit of goods and people
items.ex_en: Battleships were deployed to blockade the strategic harbor and prevent essential supplies from entering.
items.ex_zh: 战舰被部署用来封锁该战略港口，防止必需物资进入。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote instituting macro-level trade restrictions, state boycotts, or deep-seated cultural bans against dealing with an entity or discussing a topic. They scale from cultural or social avoidance to sweeping sovereign or multilateral commercial bans.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及宏观层面的贸易制裁、禁运或文化社会层面的禁忌与排斥。
groups.desc_en: Denotes coercive commercial or social exclusion imposed by authority or collective consensus, contrasting with generic prohibition by targeting systemic access, trade routes, or communal acceptance.
groups.desc_zh: 指由官方权力或群体共识实施的惩罚性商业阻断或社会排斥，区别于一般禁令，强调切断系统性准入、商贸或交往。
groups.nuance_en: embargo: official state prohibition on commercial trade or shipping (oil / grain / arms) · sanction: state-level economic or diplomatic punitive measures (regime / bank / exports) · boycott: concerted grassroots refusal to buy from or interact with an entity (products / elections / games) · blacklist: listing individuals or organizations designated for complete exclusion or discrimination (subcontractors / workers / websites)
groups.nuance_zh: embargo: 国家层面的贸易封锁或禁运 (oil / grain / arms) · sanction: 依国际法或国家法令实施的制裁 (regime / bank / exports) · boycott: 群众性、自发联合抵制消费或合作 (products / elections / games) · blacklist: 列入黑名单以行全面排斥或封锁 (subcontractors / workers / websites)

groups.name: Transmit & Broadcast · 信息传输与播送 (Transmit, Broadcast, Telefax)
groups.tip: 借助通信媒介发送传输信息

items.def_en: [I/T] to send out radio or television signals to a wide public audience
items.ex_en: The national network will broadcast the championship football match live to millions tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 国家电视网明天将向数百万观众现场直播这场足球冠军赛。
items.ex2_en: The emergency public radio signal will broadcast continuously throughout the severe hurricane.
items.ex2_zh: 紧急公共广播信号将在严重的飓风期间持续播出。

items.def_zh: 定向发送（无线电波/光信号）
items.def_en: to direct or send a radio signal, television program, or light in a specific direction
items.ex_en: The transmission tower beams microwave signals across the mountain pass to remote relay stations.
items.ex_zh: 该发射塔将微波信号定向穿过山口，发送至偏远的中继站。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to transmit or broadcast signals, electronic messages, or information
items.ex_en: The maritime rescue beacon automatically sends out distress coordinates to nearby coastal stations.
items.ex_zh: 海上救援信标会自动向附近的海岸电台发出求救坐标。

items.def_zh: 定向发送（无线电信号等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to transmit an electronic signal, radio waves, or broadcast data from a satellite or transmitter downward
items.ex_en: The weather satellite continuously beams down high-resolution radar imagery to the ground observatory.
items.ex_zh: 气象卫星持续向下方的地面天文台定向发送高分辨率雷达图像。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to connect a communication signal, phone call, or broadcast feed to another channel
items.ex_en: The operator promised to patch through the live audio feed to the newsroom.
items.ex_zh: 话务员答应将现场音频信号转接到新闻编辑室。

items.def_en: to send an electronic signal, message, or program over a wire, radio, or data link
items.ex_en: Fiber-optic cables transmit encrypted diplomatic communications across oceanic distances at immense speeds.
items.ex_zh: 光纤电缆以极高的速度跨越大洋传输加密的外交通信。

items.def_en: to receive a signal or message and pass it on to another recipient or transmission point
items.ex_en: Orbiting satellites relay telemetry signals from deep-space probes back to the terrestrial base.
items.ex_zh: 轨道卫星将深空探测器的遥测信号中继回地面基地。

items.def_zh: 转播，转发，重新发送（信号或数据）
items.def_en: To broadcast, relay, or send a signal, transmission, or piece of data onward again.
items.ex_en: The hill station will retransmit digital broadcast signals directly to underserved rural valleys.
items.ex_zh: 山顶站点将数字广播信号重新发送至服务不足的乡村河谷。

items.def_zh: 传真发送，用传真机传送
items.def_en: (dated) To send or transmit a document by facsimile machine.
items.ex_en: The cautious diplomat hastened to telefax the confidential treaty before the telegraph lines failed.
items.ex_zh: 谨慎的外交官在电报线路瘫痪之前匆匆传真发送了机密条约。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scenario cover the technical or technological sending and relaying of signals, documents, audiovisual data, or messages through electronic media or telecommunication channels.
groups.summary_zh: 指利用电子设备、网络或通信频段发送、转播及传真信号或数据。
groups.desc_en: Refers to dispatching electromagnetic waves, telecommunication signals, or audiovisual media across distances to receivers, contrasting with physical transport by involving intangible electronic propagation.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过电磁波、电信信号或音视频媒介向远端接收方无线或有线播发，区别于实物运输，强调无形信号的辐射与中继。
groups.nuance_en: broadcast: disseminating signals or programming over a wide area to public receivers (news / program / signal) · transmit: technical sending of data, electrical signals, or pathogens from sender to receiver (data / impulse / frequencies) · beam: directing focused radio, light, or satellite transmission toward a specific target (satellite images / signals / power) · relay: receiving and re-broadcasting a signal onward along a transmission chain (message / instructions / signal)
groups.nuance_zh: broadcast: 向公众广泛播发音视频节目或无线电 (news / program / signal) · transmit: 技术性地发射或传送数据、信号 (data / impulse / frequencies) · beam: 定向发射无线电波、光束或卫星信号 (satellite images / signals / power) · relay: 沿传输链接收并中继转发信号或讯息 (message / instructions / signal)

groups.name: Trap & Enmesh · 缠困与陷入 (Entangle, Enmesh, Mire)
groups.tip: 陷入泥沼缠绊难以脱身

items.def_zh: 使陷于泥沼；使陷入停滞
items.def_en: [I/T] To prevent someone or something from moving forward or making progress
items.ex_en: Excessive administrative red tape threatened to bog down the ambitious infrastructure renewal project.
items.ex_zh: 过多的行政繁文缛节可能使雄心勃勃的基础设施更新项目陷入停滞。
items.ex2_en: The ambitious environmental reform initiative bogged down amid fierce legislative political bickering.
items.ex2_zh: 这项雄心勃勃的环保改革倡议在激烈的立法政治争吵中停滞不前。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to involve or entangle someone in an unwanted, complex, or compromising situation
items.ex_en: The young diplomat was inadvertently caught up in an intricate web of espionage allegations.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻的外交官不经意间卷入了一场错综复杂的间谍指控风波中。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to cause cords, threads, or people to become hopelessly knotted, trapped, or muddled
items.ex_en: He managed to tangle up the long kite strings during the fierce afternoon wind.
items.ex_zh: 在午后猛烈的强风中，他不慎把长长的风筝线缠成了一团。
items.ex2_en: The thin decorative fishing lines tangle up easily when thrown haphazardly.
items.ex2_zh: 随手乱扔时，细细的装饰钓鱼线很容易缠成一团。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to persuade or trap someone into taking part in an activity or obligation
items.ex_en: She managed to rope in three reluctant colleagues to help organize the charity gala.
items.ex_zh: 她设法拉拢了三位不情愿的同事来帮忙筹备慈善晚会。

items.def_zh: 捕捉；诱捕，罗织陷阱陷害
items.def_en: To catch an animal in a trap, or catch someone by clever trickery
items.ex_en: The poacher set crude wire traps to snare wild game roaming through the forest.
items.ex_zh: 盗猎者布设了简陋的铁丝陷阱，以诱捕在森林中漫游的野兽。

items.def_en: To cause something to become twisted together with or caught in something else
items.ex_en: Drifting nylon fishing nets often entangle innocent marine turtles near the shallow coral reef.
items.ex_zh: 漂流的尼龙渔网常常在浅珊瑚礁附近缠住无辜的海龟。

items.def_zh: 使陷入困境，缠困；使陷于泥潭
items.def_en: 1. (usually passive) To involve or tangle someone in a difficult, messy situation. 2. To cause to sink or become stuck in mud.
items.ex_en: Bitter factional disputes continue to mire the fragile transition council in deep political paralysis.
items.ex_zh: 激烈的派系争端继续使脆弱的过渡委员会陷入严重的政治瘫痪。

items.def_en: 1. To lure or trick someone into a dangerous, compromising, or unlawful situation. 2. To catch an animal in a trap.
items.ex_en: Undercover agents must ensure they do not illegally entrap suspects into committing serious offenses.
items.ex_zh: 卧底探员必须确保自己没有非法诱骗嫌疑人去犯下严重罪行。

items.def_zh: 使落入网中；使陷入（困境）
items.def_en: To catch or involve someone or something in a net or complicated, compromising situation
items.ex_en: Lethal court intrigues threatened to enmesh the young heir in dangerous treasonous conspiracies.
items.ex_zh: 致命的宫廷阴谋随时可能使这位年轻的继承人深陷危险的叛逆阴谋之中。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe snaring or catching someone or something in a physical web, mud, or trap, or metaphorically trapping them in an inescapable, difficult, or compromising situation. 'Mire' highlights becoming physically or conceptually bogged down, whereas 'entrap' implies deliberate cunning.
groups.summary_zh: 使陷入淤泥、罗网或复杂的困境、纠纷中难以脱身。
groups.desc_en: Describes physical or figurative snaring wherein an entity becomes immobilized by cords, webs, sticky ground, or complex schemes, contrasting with simple imprisonment by emphasizing suffocating, complicated entrapment.
groups.desc_zh: 指实体在物理或隐喻上被绳网、泥潭或复杂阴谋缠绊困死，区别于简单关押，强调陷入难以自拔的复杂牵绊。
groups.nuance_en: entangle: twisting together into a snarl or ensnaring in messy complications (wires / fishing nets / affairs) · mire: sinking deeply into wet swampy mud, or being bogged down in slow difficulties (swamp / bureaucracy / debt) · snare: capturing an animal or victim via a hidden loop, trap, or deceitful scheme (rabbit / prey / voter) · entrap: luring a person intentionally into a compromising trap or criminal act (suspect / prey / politician)
groups.nuance_zh: entangle: 缠绕结块，或卷入错综复杂的麻烦 (wires / fishing nets / affairs) · mire: 陷于泥泞沼泽，或深陷官僚债务泥潭 (swamp / bureaucracy / debt) · snare: 设圈套设陷阱诱捕，多含机巧诱捕之意 (rabbit / prey / voter) · entrap: 诱使或设局使人陷入犯罪圈套 (suspect / prey / politician)

groups.name: Travel in Groups or Specialized Transit · 结队旅行与专线通行 (Caravan, Tram)
groups.tip: 成群漫游与结队迁徙

items.def_en: to travel regularly back and forth between two specific places using designated transit
items.ex_en: Commuter rail lines shuttle between the bustling downtown terminal and suburban residential districts.
items.ex_zh: 市郊通勤铁路线穿梭往返于繁华的市中心枢纽与郊区住宅区之间。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to enter a vehicle, bus, or train together quickly and in an unorganized group
items.ex_en: Excited soccer fans tried to pile into the crowded subway car after the match.
items.ex_zh: 比赛结束后，兴奋的足球迷们争先恐后地蜂拥挤入拥挤的地铁车厢。

items.def_en: to travel together in a single shared motor vehicle, usually to and from work or school
items.ex_en: Several suburban teachers decided to carpool together each morning to reduce high gasoline expenses.
items.ex_zh: 几位郊区教师决定每天早晨拼车同行，以减少昂贵的汽油开支。

items.def_en: to make a long, arduous journey, typically on foot or in an organized expedition
items.ex_en: Exhausted explorers had to trek through dense alpine forests before reaching base camp.
items.ex_zh: 精疲力竭的探险者们不得不徒步穿过茂密的高山森林才到达大本营。

items.def_en: [I/T] to travel or transport people regularly back and forth between two places
items.ex_en: Dedicated electric ferries shuttle tourists across the wide river every fifteen minutes throughout summer.
items.ex_zh: 整个夏季，专用电动轮渡每隔十五分钟便在宽阔的河上穿梭往返运送游客。
items.ex2_en: The convenient airport express shuttle buses shuttle passengers continuously between busy terminals.
items.ex2_zh: 便捷的机场穿梭大巴在繁忙的航站楼之间持续摆渡乘客。

items.def_en: to travel regularly between home and work or school using public transport or a car
items.ex_en: Tens of thousands of white-collar professionals commute daily into the capital city by high-speed rail.
items.ex_zh: 数以万计的白领专业人士每天乘高速铁路通勤往返于首都。

items.def_en: [I/T] to travel together in a group of vehicles or ships for mutual security or convenience
items.ex_en: Naval destroyers were assigned to convoy vulnerable merchant vessels through hostile pirate waters.
items.ex_zh: 海军驱逐舰受命为穿过敌对海盗水域的脆弱商船护航。

items.def_zh: （乘野营车或大篷车）旅行，度假；结队前行
items.def_en: 1. To travel or take a holiday in a camper trailer or caravan. 2. To travel together in a group or convoy.
items.ex_en: During summer holidays, adventurous families often caravan across scenic coastal highways in motorhomes.
items.ex_zh: 暑假期间，富有冒险精神的家庭经常开着野营车沿着风景优美的沿海公路结队旅行。

items.def_zh: 乘有轨电车出行；用矿车（或煤车）运载
items.def_en: 1. To travel by tram or streetcar. 2. To transport goods or minerals in a tram or cart.
items.ex_en: Many elderly residents prefer to tram into the historic city center for daily shopping.
items.ex_zh: 许多老年居民更喜欢乘有轨电车前往历史悠久的市中心进行日常购物。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe travelling in an organized convoy, group, or via specialized shared transit, moving together across distances or commuting along defined tracks.
groups.summary_zh: 指结伴成队迁徙旅行，或乘坐有轨电车等特定公共交通通行。
groups.desc_en: Depicts movement characterized by collective formations, recurring predetermined circuits, or shared transit vehicles, contrasting with lone, irregular travel by emphasizing organized formation or shuttle loops.
groups.desc_zh: 描述以队列行进、预定固定路线或共乘工具为特征的群体性位移，区别于单独随意出行，强调编队组织或往返摆渡。
groups.nuance_en: caravan: traveling together in a long convoy across rough or desolate terrain (merchants / nomads / trucks) · convoy: traveling in an organized protective military or commercial motorcade (ships / supplies / vehicles) · commute: traveling back and forth regularly between home and work (workers / daily / distance) · shuttle: running back and forth over a short fixed route repeatedly (bus / passengers / ferries)
groups.nuance_zh: caravan: 商队或车队结队穿越荒漠或险恶长途 (merchants / nomads / trucks) · convoy: 具备护卫性质或编队前行的车船队 (ships / supplies / vehicles) · commute: 定期往返于居住地与工作场所的通勤 (workers / daily / distance) · shuttle: 在两点之间频繁固定往返摆渡 (bus / passengers / ferries)

groups.name: Trigger & Spark Immediate Reaction · 引发与骤然诱发 (Trigger, Spark, Provoke)
groups.tip: 诱发事端或引起连锁反应

items.def_en: (formal) to cause something to happen, especially an emotion or an event
items.ex_en: The prime minister's abrupt resignation will undoubtedly occasion widespread speculation and political unrest.
items.ex_zh: 首相的突然辞职无疑将引起广泛的猜测和政治动荡。

items.def_en: to cause a strong reaction, an event, or a process to happen suddenly or immediately
items.ex_en: Sudden sharp price hikes on basic food staples could trigger mass civil unrest.
items.ex_zh: 基础主粮价格的突然暴涨可能会引发大规模的民众动乱。

items.def_zh: 引发，触发，激起；发出火花
items.def_en: 1. to bring about or trigger a sudden reaction, dispute, or event. 2. to produce tiny sparks of fire or electricity
items.ex_en: The minister's provocative statement was enough to spark heated parliamentary debates on immigration.
items.ex_zh: 该部长挑衅性的声明足以激起议会内部关于移民问题的激烈辩论。

items.def_en: to suddenly ignite or precipitate a widespread violent conflict or dispute
items.ex_en: The sudden announcement of price hikes touched off violent protests across the capital.
items.ex_zh: 突然宣布的涨价消息在首都全城引发了暴力抗议。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to trigger or suddenly cause a series of events, an explosion, or an intense reaction
items.ex_en: A single stray spark could set off a catastrophic explosion inside the chemical refinery.
items.ex_zh: 哪怕一颗飞溅的火星，也能在化工厂内部诱发毁灭性的爆炸。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to suddenly provoke or trigger an acute dispute, riot, or violent event
items.ex_en: Unfair wage cuts threatened to spark off violent labor protests across industrial manufacturing plants.
items.ex_zh: 不合理的降薪威胁着在各大工业制造厂引发暴力劳工抗议。

items.def_zh: 引起；导致（不良反应或危机）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to cause something unpleasant, sudden, or severe to happen or develop
items.ex_en: Severe emotional stress and chronic exhaustion can easily bring on debilitating migraine headaches.
items.ex_zh: 严重的精神压力和长期疲劳很容易引起令人虚弱的偏头痛发作。

items.def_zh: 激起，引发（强烈抗议/冲突）
items.def_en: to stimulate an immediate emotional outbreak, protest, or retaliatory action
items.ex_en: Arbitrary police arrests served only to provoke violent clashes with defiant street demonstrators.
items.ex_zh: 警方的肆意逮捕只会激起与不妥协的街头示威者之间的暴力冲突。

items.def_zh: 引燃，激起（强烈情感/冲突）
items.def_en: to suddenly trigger explosive feelings, controversy, or open violence
items.ex_en: Controversial changes to electoral laws threatened to ignite fierce hostility among rival factions.
items.ex_zh: 对选举法的争议性修改有可能在各敌对派系之间激起强烈的敌意。
items.ex2_en: Deep-seated political resentment can ignite suddenly into widespread violent civil disobedience.
items.ex2_zh: 根深蒂固的政治怨恨可能会突然爆发为大范围的暴力公民抗命。

groups.summary_en: Verbs denoting serving as the direct catalyst or sudden spark that sets off an intense, rapid, or volatile event, crisis, or reaction.
groups.summary_zh: 作为直接导火索，骤然诱发或引爆剧烈反应、危机或情绪。
groups.desc_en: Highlights serving as the decisive catalyst that instantly sets off an explosive reaction, process, or emotional outburst, contrasting with slow gradual evolution by stressing sharp temporal immediacy.
groups.desc_zh: 指作为决定性的催化剂瞬间引爆冲突、连锁反应或情绪爆发，区别于缓慢演进，强调时间上的骤然触发。
groups.nuance_en: trigger: activating a predetermined mechanical response or volatile cascade (crisis / alarm / memory) · spark: generating the initial tiny flash that ignites a major event or debate (protests / fire / controversy) · touch off: setting off an explosive, violent chain of events rapidly (riots / panic / explosion) · provoke: deliberately stimulating or angering someone into a hostile reaction (anger / retaliation / crisis)
groups.nuance_zh: trigger: 扣动扳机般激活连锁反应或剧烈变化 (crisis / alarm / memory) · spark: 点燃火星，指微小诱因促成重大事件 (protests / fire / controversy) · touch off: 骤然引爆火药桶式的骚乱或危机 (riots / panic / explosion) · provoke: 故意激惹或挑衅使之做出敌对反应 (anger / retaliation / crisis)

groups.name: Twist, Gnarl & Contort · 扭结与畸形弯曲 (Contort, Gnarl, Frizz)
groups.tip: 受力改变原有平直形态

items.def_en: (+ sth) to twist, bend, or roll into a tight curved or coiled shape
items.ex_en: Dry autumn leaves curl up and crackle underfoot during the brisk morning walk.
items.ex_zh: 在清凉的晨间散步时，干枯的秋叶蜷缩卷起，在脚下发出咔嚓声。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to twist sharply into tight, irregular bends or loops
items.ex_en: Old garden hoses tend to kink up whenever you try dragging them across lawns.
items.ex_zh: 每当你试图把老旧的花园水管拖过草坪时，它往往就会打结起扭。
items.ex2_en: Thin flexible electrical wires can kink up tightly inside narrow storage boxes.
items.ex2_zh: 细软的电线在狭窄的储物箱内容易紧紧地扭结在一起。

items.def_en: to bend, warp, or collapse out of shape under intense heat, weight, or pressure
items.ex_en: The steel support beams began to buckle under the tremendous weight of collapsing masonry.
items.ex_zh: 在坍塌石墙的巨大重压之下，钢制支撑梁开始变形弯曲。

items.def_en: to become bent, twisted, or out of shape as a result of heat or moisture
items.ex_en: Unfinished wooden floorboards can warp easily if exposed to excessive humidity and heat.
items.ex_zh: 未做防水处理的木质地板如果暴露在过高的湿度和热量中，很容易发生翘曲。
items.ex2_en: Excessive environmental heat will warp these delicate vinyl records within several minutes.
items.ex2_zh: 过高的环境温度会在几分钟内烤弯这些脆弱的黑胶唱片。

items.def_en: to form a sharp, unintended curl, twist, or bend in a wire, rope, or hair
items.ex_en: The stiff charging cord will kink sharply if you bend it against the joint.
items.ex_zh: 如果你对着接头处反折，硬质充电线就会形成尖锐的死结。
items.ex2_en: Sharp awkward turns can easily kink the copper refrigeration tubing during installation.
items.ex2_zh: 安装过程中剧烈别扭的转弯很容易将铜制制冷管道折出死弯。

items.def_en: to bend or curve backward or in the opposite direction
items.ex_en: The artisan carved an elegant longbow whose slender wooden tips recurve gracefully outward.
items.ex_zh: 工匠雕刻了一张优雅的长弓，其修长的木质弓梢优美地向外反弯。
items.ex2_en: The skilled traditional craftsman will recurve the wooden bow tips using steam.
items.ex2_zh: 熟练的传统工匠会用蒸汽把木弓两端向后弯曲。

items.def_en: (of hair) to become tightly curled or rough and unruly, or to make hair form into tiny tight curls
items.ex_en: Her naturally straight hair began to frizz uncontrollably in the oppressive tropical humidity.
items.ex_zh: 在令人压抑的热带湿气中，她原本柔顺的直发开始不受控制地起毛卷曲。
items.ex2_en: The humid ocean breeze will quickly frizz my freshly styled wavy hair.
items.ex2_zh: 潮湿的海风会迅速让我刚做好的波浪卷发变得毛躁蓬乱。

items.def_zh: 使扭曲，使多节；咆哮，龇牙低吼
items.def_en: (usually passive) to twist, knot, or distort something (such as wood, roots, or hands) into a rough, bent shape
items.ex_en: Decades of relentless ocean winds had gnarl the ancient pines into grotesque silhouettes.
items.ex_zh: 数十年来无休止的海风已将那些古松扭曲成奇形怪状的轮廓。

items.def_en: to twist or bend severely out of the natural or normal shape
items.ex_en: Severe muscular spasms caused the patient's limbs to contort into unnatural and painful positions.
items.ex_zh: 严重的肌肉痉挛使患者的肢体扭曲成极其不自然且痛苦的姿势。
items.ex2_en: The dancer's flexible body contorted fluidly during the intense modern performance.
items.ex2_zh: 在激烈的现代舞表演中，舞者柔韧的身体灵巧地扭动折叠。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote physical deformation involving severe twisting, crimping, knotting, or irregular bending backward or outward into an unnatural or tightly coiled state.
groups.summary_zh: 强调反向曲折、紧密起皱或扭曲结节等非平滑的畸态形变。
groups.desc_en: Involves physical distortion of an object's structural shape through bending, heat, pressure, or twisting forces, contrasting with clean fracture by emphasizing deformed, gnarled, or curved lines.
groups.desc_zh: 指物体因受力、受热或挤压而发生形态畸变、扭曲弯折，区别于断裂，强调线条结构的歪斜、纠结或凹陷。
groups.nuance_en: warp: twisting out of a flat plane through dampness or heat (wood / floorboards / mind) · contort: twisting violently out of natural shape or facial expression (face / limbs / body) · gnarl: making rough, knobby, and twisted by age or disease (branches / hands / roots) · kink: forming a sharp, unnatural twist or curl in a straight length (hose / wire / hair)
groups.nuance_zh: warp: 因受潮受热而发生平面翘曲变形 (wood / floorboards / mind) · contort: 肢体或面容因痛苦而极度扭曲失真 (face / limbs / body) · gnarl: 因岁月风蚀或疾病而粗糙多瘤节畸形 (branches / hands / roots) · kink: 线缆、软管等因扭转产生折结或死弯 (hose / wire / hair)

groups.name: Twist, Wind & Interlace Strands · 卷绕与缠绕 (Spool, Twine, Interweave)
groups.tip: 丝线交织盘旋卷绕

items.def_en: (+ sth) to interweave three or more strands of flexible material together into a single cord
items.ex_en: Artisans meticulously braid together colored silk cords to create durable ceremonial ropes for temples.
items.ex_zh: 手工艺人细心地将彩色丝线编织在一起，为寺庙制作耐用的仪式绳索。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to wind a line, wire, or cord around a spool or reel
items.ex_en: The deep-sea angler began to slowly reel in the nylon fishing line yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 昨天，这位深海钓客开始缓慢地把尼龙钓鱼线收卷在线轮上。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to roll or twist a thread, string, or cable tightly around a core or into a ball
items.ex_en: He helped his grandmother wind up the loose knitting yarn into a tidy ball.
items.ex_zh: 他帮祖母把散开的编织毛线紧紧地卷绕成一个规整的线团。

items.def_en: (+ around/round) To wrap a strand, cord, or tape around a center or object
items.ex_en: She carefully wound the decorative ribbon around the package before tying a bow.
items.ex_zh: 她在打结之前，仔细地把装饰丝带缠绕在包裹上。
items.ex2_en: The slender garden ivy wound tightly around the old wooden trellis.
items.ex2_zh: 细长茂盛的常春藤紧紧地缠绕在古老的木格架上。

items.def_zh: 缠绕在线轴上，把……绕上卷轴；（计算机）假脱机操作
items.def_en: 1. To wind thread, wire, or tape onto or off a spool or reel. 2. (computing) To transfer data to a temporary storage area for later processing or printing.
items.ex_en: The machine began to spool the copper wire onto the large wooden drum.
items.ex_zh: 机器开始将铜线缠绕到巨大的木质线轴上。
items.ex2_en: The shiny magnetic tape spools smoothly inside the newly cleaned cassette player.
items.ex2_zh: 锃亮的磁带在新清理过的磁带播放机内顺畅地卷绕着。

items.def_en: To weave three or more strands of flexible material diagonally together
items.ex_en: She sat quietly on the porch to braid three strips of colored leather.
items.ex_zh: 她静静地坐在门廊上，将三根彩色皮条编成辫子。

items.def_en: To wind, coil, or twist around something or around each other; to make something by twisting strands together.
items.ex_en: Fragrant honeysuckle vines twine gently around the ancient stone pillars of the veranda.
items.ex_zh: 芬芳的忍冬藤蔓轻柔地盘绕在走廊古老的石柱上。
items.ex2_en: The elderly weaver twined thick strands of wool into durable winter yarn.
items.ex2_zh: 老纺织工把粗羊毛股搓成了结实的冬用纱线。

items.def_zh: （使）交织，（使）编织在一起（interweave 的过去分词）
items.def_en: (past participle of interweave) To weave, blend, or closely connect two or more things together.
items.ex_en: Golden threads were subtly interwoven with dark wool to create an exquisite tapestry.
items.ex_zh: 金线巧妙地与深色羊毛交织在一起，构成了一幅精美的壁毯。
items.ex2_en: Diverse cultural traditions naturally interweave across decades of harmonious community life.
items.ex2_zh: 多元的文化传统在数十年和谐的社区生活中自然交织融合。

items.def_en: (+ around/with) To twist or twine two or more elements closely together
items.ex_en: Wild ivy branches entwine around the iron gates, concealing the abandoned estate behind.
items.ex_zh: 野生的常春藤枝条缠绕在铁门上，掩映着身后废弃的庄园。
items.ex2_en: The skilled florist will entwine colorful satin ribbons through the holiday wreath.
items.ex2_zh: 熟练的花艺师将把彩色的缎带缠绕穿过节日花环。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses manipulating flexible, thread-like materials by winding them around a core, twisting filaments together, or interlacing strands into a unified structure. Distinctions turn on whether the motion is circular coiling, spiral twining, or reciprocal braiding.
groups.summary_zh: 指将丝线或柔韧物料进行卷盘、绞扭缠绕或相互交错编结。
groups.desc_en: Involves winding, interlacing, or twisting multiple flexible strands around a core or together, contrasting with messy entanglement by denoting structured, orderly, or decorative integration.
groups.desc_zh: 指将柔软线股卷绕于轴心或互相编织穿插，区别于杂乱无章的缠结，强调结构性、工序性或装饰性盘绕。
groups.nuance_en: wind: coiling a length of material spirally around an object or spool (rope / watch / yarn) · spool: winding thread, tape, or wire rapidly onto a cylindrical reel (thread / ribbon / wire) · braid: interweaving three or more strands diagonally to make a unified strip (hair / rope / dough) · twine: winding flexibly around a support or twisting strands together tightly (ivy / threads / fingers)
groups.nuance_zh: wind: 呈螺旋状绕线或上发条 (rope / watch / yarn) · spool: 规整、快速地将线缆收卷到线轴上 (thread / ribbon / wire) · braid: 将三股及以上发股/绳股交织编成辫状 (hair / rope / dough) · twine: 盘旋缠绕在支柱上，或将多股捻合 (ivy / threads / fingers)

groups.name: Typecast & Pigeonhole · 归类归纳与刻板定型 (Lump, Bracket, Stereotype)
groups.tip: 按本质属性整理分门别类

items.def_en: (+ sth + as sth) to categorize or label something broadly as a particular kind of thing
items.ex_en: You should just chalk that disastrous dinner up as another funny travel mishap.
items.ex_zh: 你大可把那顿糟糕透顶的晚餐归为又一次搞笑的旅行插曲。

items.def_zh: 把……归类，归为一组；把……放入括号内；用托架固定
items.def_en: 1. (+ together/with) To group people or things together as being similar or of the same class. 2. To enclose words or numbers in brackets.
items.ex_en: Critics often bracket his experimental fiction with the surrealist movement of the 1920s.
items.ex_zh: 批评家们常将他的实验性小说与20世纪20年代的超现实主义运动归为一类。

items.def_zh: 把……归并到一起，混为一谈；结块，成团
items.def_en: 1. (+ together) To put different things or people together into the same group without distinction. 2. To form into lumps or clumps.
items.ex_en: Don't lump all modern pop songs together as talentless junk without listening closely.
items.ex_zh: 别没仔细听就把所有现代流行歌曲都混为一谈，全当成毫无才华的垃圾。

items.def_en: to place people or things systematically into particular groups based on shared qualities
items.ex_en: Biologists strictly categorize specimens according to their genetic relationships and morphological traits.
items.ex_zh: 生物学家根据遗传亲缘关系和形态特征对样本进行严格分类。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to confine someone within a rigid, narrow conceptual or social category
items.ex_en: My car was boxed in by two huge delivery trucks, and I couldn't pull out.
items.ex_zh: 我的车被两辆大卡车死死卡在中间，根本开不出来。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to categorize or group disparate people or things together without making proper distinctions
items.ex_en: The lazy report lumped disparate customer complaints together into one meaningless general category.
items.ex_zh: 这份敷衍的报告把性质各异的客户投诉归拢到一起，塞进一个毫无意义的笼统类别。

items.def_zh: 对……产生刻板印象，按成见归类；把……模式化
items.def_en: To form a fixed, oversimplified, and often unfair idea about a person, group, or thing.
items.ex_en: Media portrayals often stereotype working-class families as uneducated and emotionally unstable.
items.ex_zh: 媒体的刻画往往对工人阶级家庭带有成见，将他们定型为缺乏教养且情绪不稳定。

items.def_en: to classify someone or something into a rigid, restrictive, or oversimplified category
items.ex_en: The ambitious young author refused to let reviewers pigeonhole her diverse literary work.
items.ex_zh: 这位雄心勃勃的年轻作家拒绝让书评人将她多样化的文学作品生硬归类。

items.def_en: to repeatedly assign an actor or person to a single stereotype or conventional role
items.ex_en: After playing the ruthless villain twice, he feared casting directors would permanently typecast him.
items.ex_zh: 在两次饰演冷酷的反派之后，他担心选角导演会永远将他定型在这一类角色中。
