groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote cognitive sorting or collective categorization, particularly those biased or reductive judgments that group disparate entities under broad, unnuanced labels.
groups.summary_zh: 以宽泛、刻板或笼统方式将相异事物归入同一范畴。
groups.desc_en: Refers to mentally grouping diverse entities into rigid, oversimplified classifications, contrasting with nuanced analysis by emphasizing reductive, dismissive, or unfair categorizations.
groups.desc_zh: 指将多样客体强行纳入刻板、简化的既定类别，区别于细致分析，强调粗暴合并、定型或忽视个体微差。
groups.nuance_en: pigeonhole: classifying someone unfairly into a narrow, rigid, and restrictive category (actor / writer / policy) · lump together: indiscriminately gathering disparate things into a single undifferentiated group (cases / groups / issues) · stereotype: holding a fixed, overgeneralized, and often biased image of a group (minorities / tourists / teenagers) · bracket: grouping items together between common limits or treating them as comparable (incomes / contenders / concepts)
groups.nuance_zh: pigeonhole: 狭隘定型并限制其发展空间 (actor / writer / policy) · lump together: 不加甄别地把不同事物混为一谈 (cases / groups / issues) · stereotype: 抱持刻板印象进行标签化 (minorities / tourists / teenagers) · bracket: 划归同一档次、区间或并提讨论 (incomes / contenders / concepts)

groups.name: Unite & Ally · 联合与结盟 (Unite, Ally, Band together)
groups.tip: 携手合作结成联盟

items.def_en: 1. (+ up/with) To join together with someone or a group to work as a team. 2. (+ with) To combine or match one thing with another.
items.ex_en: Our engineering department will team with international specialists to construct the suspension bridge.
items.ex_zh: 我们的工程部门将与国际专家合作建造这座悬索桥。

items.def_en: To join together, or join people or groups together, to form a single unit or act in agreement.
items.ex_en: Factional leaders agreed to unite against the looming constitutional threat to democratic governance.
items.ex_zh: 各派系领导人同意团结起来，共同应对民主治理面临的迫在眉睫的宪政威胁。
items.ex2_en: Shared economic interests will unite these diverse neighboring provinces against foreign tariffs.
items.ex2_zh: 共同的经济利益将把这些不同的邻省团结起来共同抵御外国关税。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ with) to join or combine formally with another party for mutual benefit
items.ex_en: The independent state chose to ally with neighboring powers for strategic regional defense.
items.ex_zh: 该独立国家选择与邻近大国结盟，以加强区域战略防御。
items.ex2_en: Shared strategic interests ally these competitive regional companies against the dominant monopoly.
items.ex2_zh: 共同的战略利益将这些具有竞争关系的区域公司联合起来抵御行业寡头。

items.def_en: to form a group in order to take collective action or defend mutual interests
items.ex_en: Local shopkeepers decided to band together to resist the corporate mall's aggressive expansion.
items.ex_zh: 当地小店主们决定联合起来，抵制商业综合体的激进扩张。

items.def_en: (+ with sb) to join together with another person or group to work toward a common purpose
items.ex_en: The two rival tech companies decided to team up to develop the open-source platform.
items.ex_zh: 这两家相互竞争的科技公司决定联手合作，共同开发该开源平台。

items.def_en: to unite or combine efforts with someone else to achieve a shared objective
items.ex_en: The two rival tech startups joined forces to dominate the competitive autonomous driving market.
items.ex_zh: 这两家相互竞争的科技初创企业联手合作，以主导竞争激烈的自动驾驶市场。

items.def_en: (+ with sb) to connect, meet, or form an alliance with another party or faction
items.ex_en: The two railway networks are scheduled to link up by the end of next year.
items.ex_zh: 这两条铁路网计划于明年年底实现连通。
items.ex2_en: Engineers linked up the two separate optical fibers across the mountain gorge.
items.ex2_zh: 工程师们将穿过山峡的两条独立光纤连接了起来。

items.def_en: (+ into) to come together to form one larger whole or political coalition
items.ex_en: Several grassroots protest factions gradually coalesced into an influential nationwide political movement.
items.ex_zh: 几个草根抗议派别逐渐联合起来，形成了一场具有全国影响力的政治运动。

items.def_en: [I/T] to join together into a formal federation or political union
items.ex_en: The historically divided autonomous cantons eventually agreed to federate for collective security.
items.ex_zh: 历史上各自为政的自治州最终同意结成联邦，以实现集体安全。
items.ex2_en: Charismatic leaders hoped to federate the disparate provinces into one sovereign state.
items.ex2_zh: 具有魅力的领袖们希望将分散的省份联合为一个主权联邦国家。

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote entities such as people, factions, or nations joining forces to pursue a shared goal or mutual defense. Nuances differ between formal pacts, collaborative teamwork, and spontaneous collective organizing.
groups.summary_zh: 个人、组织或国家为共同目标或防卫而联手合作、缔结联盟。
groups.desc_en: Denotes distinct entities joining together into a cooperative coalition or consolidated whole, contrasting with solitary operation by emphasizing unified purpose and synergistic strength.
groups.desc_zh: 指不同主体联合形成紧密同盟或融为一个整体，区别于单打独斗，强调统一目标与协同力量。
groups.nuance_en: ally: entering into a formal political or strategic partnership (nations / factions / corporations) · band together: forming an informal defensive or reactive league against a common threat (residents / workers / rebels) · coalesce: merging separate elements gradually into a singular cohesive entity (ideas / interests / parties) · unite: joining together harmoniously into an indivisible whole (citizens / workers / opposition)
groups.nuance_zh: ally: 缔结正式政治、军事或战略盟友关系 (nations / factions / corporations) · band together: 为应对共同威胁而自发抱团联合 (residents / workers / rebels) · coalesce: 散碎要素逐渐聚拢、融合成一个统一体 (ideas / interests / parties) · unite: 紧密团结为坚不可摧的整体 (citizens / workers / opposition)

groups.name: Unlawful Deprivation of Goods · 盗窃与洗劫抢掠 (Pilfer to Plunder)
groups.tip: 从小偷小摸到暴力明抢

items.def_zh: 小偷小摸，偷窃（微量物品）
items.def_en: [I/T] to steal things of little value, especially in small quantities repeatedly
items.ex_en: The warehouse clerk systematically pilfered valuable electronic components over several profitable months.
items.ex_zh: 那名仓库文员在获利的数月里，系统性地小偷小摸贵重的电子元器件。

items.def_en: [I/T] to secretly take another person's property without permission or intention of returning it
items.ex_en: The masked burglar managed to steal antique jewelry while the family slept upstairs.
items.ex_zh: 蒙面窃贼在一家人于楼上熟睡时，成功盗取了古董首饰。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to steal something and hurry away with it undetected or unstopped
items.ex_en: Thieves broke into the gallery and made off with three priceless paintings.
items.ex_zh: 盗贼闯入画廊，盗走了三幅无价的名画。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to steal property from someone or cheat them out of possessions
items.ex_en: Unsuspecting tourists are often ripped off by unlicensed taxi operators.
items.ex_zh: 毫无防备的游客经常被无照出租车司机敲竹杠。

items.def_en: [I/T] to enter a building illegally in order to steal property
items.ex_en: Thieves chose to burgle the luxury downtown boutique during the heavy holiday weekend storm.
items.ex_zh: 盗贼选择在假末周末的暴风雨期间破门入室，洗劫了市中心的奢侈品精品店。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to steal all the money or goods from a place or person, leaving it completely bare
items.ex_en: Sneaky thieves cleaned out the corner bakery overnight, taking every cent from the register.
items.ex_zh: 狡猾的小偷在一夜之间搬空了街角面包店，收银机里的一分钱都没留下。

items.def_en: 1. To take money or property from a person or place illegally, especially using violence or threats. 2. (+ of) To unfairly deprive someone of something desirable or rightful.
items.ex_en: Two masked men planned to rob the suburban financial institution during morning rush hour.
items.ex_zh: 两名蒙面男子计划在早高峰期间抢劫那家郊区的金融机构。

items.def_en: 1. (+ through) To search quickly through something in order to steal or find items. 2. To steal something from a place; to plunder or loot.
items.ex_en: Desperate trespassers began to rifle through the desk drawers, searching for hidden bearer bonds.
items.ex_zh: 绝望的非法侵入者开始翻箱倒柜搜寻办公桌抽屉，寻找藏匿的无记名债券。

items.def_en: [I/T] to steal goods from a place or person violently and openly, especially during wartime
items.ex_en: Ruthless mercenaries proceeded to plunder the sacred coastal shrine without mercy or restraint.
items.ex_zh: 冷酷的雇佣兵毫无怜悯与节制地大肆掠夺了沿海的神圣圣殿。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe unlawfully taking property from a person or place without permission. Intensity scales from petty, stealthy thievery to forceful confrontation and violent ransacking or stripping of goods.
groups.summary_zh: 按侵害强度递增：从小偷小摸、入室行窃到当面抢劫及洗劫掠夺。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to unlawfully taking property belonging to another without permission, ranging along an intensity axis from covert petty theft to violent, systemic ransacking.
groups.desc_zh: 指未经许可非法掠夺或窃取他人财物，依强度沿从隐秘微小偷窃至暴力公开洗劫的光谱展开。
groups.nuance_en: pilfer: stealing petty amounts or small items repeatedly and furtively (supplies / snacks / cash) · burgle: breaking into a building illicitly with intent to steal (house / premises / apartment) · rob: taking property directly from a person or place using violence or intimidation (bank / pedestrian / store) · rifle: searching hurriedly and destructively through a container to steal contents (drawers / pockets / safe)
groups.nuance_zh: pilfer: 顺手牵羊、多次微量窃取小物件 (supplies / snacks / cash) · burgle: 破门入室行窃 (house / premises / apartment) · rob: 使用暴力、胁迫手段当面强抢 (bank / pedestrian / store) · rifle: 破坏性翻箱倒柜搜罗盗窃 (drawers / pockets / safe)

groups.name: Unsteady & Tottering Gait · 摇晃与踉跄行进 (Stagger, Lurch, Hobble)
groups.tip: 失衡挣扎或踉跄慢行

items.def_zh: 步履踉跄，摇摇欲坠地走
items.def_en: to walk with shaky, hesitant, and unsteady steps, as though about to collapse
items.ex_en: The frail old gentleman began to totter along the uneven cobblestone garden path.
items.ex_zh: 那位虚弱的老绅士开始在不平整的鹅卵石花园小径上踉跄而行。

items.def_en: to make abrupt, uncontrolled, and swaying forward movements while walking
items.ex_en: The exhausted marathoner continued to lurch along the track toward the distant finish banner.
items.ex_zh: 筋疲力竭的马拉松选手继续在跑道上东倒西歪地行进，朝远处的终点横幅挪动。

items.def_en: to walk or advance with unsteadiness, repeatedly tripping or faltering
items.ex_en: Concussed and shivering, the injured hiker stumbled along the dark forest trail.
items.ex_zh: 脑震荡且浑身发抖的受伤徒步者在黑暗的森林小道上跌跌撞撞地走着。

items.def_en: to move in an unsteady, zigzag path due to drunkenness, injury, or vertigo
items.ex_en: The severely intoxicated patron began to weave around the crowded tables toward the exit.
items.ex_zh: 那名喝得烂醉的顾客开始在拥挤的餐桌间摇晃行进，朝出口走去。

items.def_en: to walk or move unsteadily, almost falling, as if carrying a great weight or disoriented
items.ex_en: Stunned by the unexpected explosion, the soldier staggered back toward the emergency trench.
items.ex_zh: 被突如其来的爆炸震懵后，这名士兵摇晃着踉跄退向应急战壕。

items.def_zh: 挣扎，踉跄乱动；不知所措，陷入困境
items.def_en: to struggle awkwardly to move or stay upright, especially in water or mud; to experience great confusion or difficulty
items.ex_en: The lost mare began to flounder in the deep, icy marsh beside the river.
items.ex_zh: 迷路的母马开始在河畔冰冷深陷的沼泽中艰难挣扎。

items.def_en: to make a sudden, unsteady, or uncontrolled movement forward or sideways; stagger
items.ex_en: A violent sea wave caused the small vessel to lurch violently toward the portside.
items.ex_zh: 一阵汹涌的海浪使小船猛烈地向左舷倾斜摇晃。

items.def_zh: 跛行，蹒跚；束缚（马等的腿）；妨碍，阻碍
items.def_en: 1. to walk with difficulty, taking small or uneven steps because of injury or pain 2. to tie the legs of an animal together; hamper or restrict
items.ex_en: Nursing a severely sprained ankle, he managed to hobble across the busy street.
items.ex_zh: 忍着脚踝的严重扭伤，他艰难地跛行穿过了繁忙的街道。

items.def_en: to rock, sway, or move backwards uncontrollably from shock, dizziness, or a blow
items.ex_en: The disoriented boxer began to reel backwards after taking a punishing direct right hook.
items.ex_zh: 在挨了一记沉重的右手直钩拳后，被打蒙的拳击手眩晕着向后踉跄。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail locomotion impaired by shock, intoxication, disorientation, or physical injury, producing abrupt lateral swaying or unstable flailing.
groups.summary_zh: 指因眩晕、受创、醉酒或虚弱导致的重心失衡、左摇右晃的踉跄步态。
groups.desc_en: Describes ambulatory movement destabilized by weakness, intoxication, uneven terrain, or injury, contrasting with firm locomotion through loss of rhythm, balance, or posture.
groups.desc_zh: 描述因虚弱、醉酒、路面崎岖或伤痛导致的步伐失稳，区别于稳健步伐，强调失去节奏、平衡与重心。
groups.nuance_en: stagger: walking with deep unsteadiness, nearly falling due to exhaustion or intoxication (drunkard / survivor / steps) · lurch: making sudden, uncontrolled, violent rolling tilts forward or sideways (vehicle / ship / drunk) · totter: walking with feeble, trembling, precarious steps as if about to fall (toddler / elderly / regime) · hobble: walking awkwardly with limp, restricted steps due to leg or foot injury (patient / horse / pensioner)
groups.nuance_zh: stagger: 因极度虚弱、醉酒而身形摇晃、几欲摔倒 (drunkard / survivor / steps) · lurch: 猛然向前或向一侧颠簸晃动失控 (vehicle / ship / drunk) · totter: 颤巍巍、弱不禁风地迈步蹒跚 (toddler / elderly / regime) · hobble: 因腿脚伤痛或受限而一瘸一拐地艰难跛行 (patient / horse / pensioner)

groups.name: Uphold & Defend Principle · 支持与维持裁决原则 (Uphold, Maintain, Sustain)
groups.tip: 坚定捍卫决议、法治与正义

items.def_en: to keep an established principle, position, or standard in existence
items.ex_en: Principled magistrates must consistently maintain absolute impartiality throughout prolonged controversial trials.
items.ex_zh: 有原则的法官必须在漫长且有争议的审判中始终保持绝对的公正。

items.def_en: to stand by and protect a law, principle, or ruling against criticism or challenge
items.ex_en: Constitutional scholars gathered to defend the historic statutory right to free public assembly.
items.ex_zh: 宪政学者们齐聚一堂，为公众自由集会的历史性法定权利进行辩护。

items.def_zh: 确认；认可（异议或主张）有效
items.def_en: to officially uphold, accept, or decide that a legal objection or claim is valid
items.ex_en: The presiding appellate judge chose to sustain the formal objection raised by defense counsel.
items.ex_zh: 主审上诉法官决定确认被告辩护律师提出的正式异议有效。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to adhere to, affirm, or continue to defend a decision, promise, or legal principle
items.ex_en: I will stand by my decision regardless of public criticism.
items.ex_zh: 无论外界如何批评，我都会坚持自己的决定。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to publicly defend or advocate for a principle, right, or standard against opposition
items.ex_en: It is essential to stand up for your beliefs even when others disagree.
items.ex_zh: 即使别人不同意，也要勇于捍卫自己的信念。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to support and defend a contested cause, belief, or ruling
items.ex_en: You ought to stick up for your fundamental workplace rights during contract negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 在合同谈判期间，你应该勇敢维护自己基本的工作权益。

items.def_en: to formally state that a legal judgment or conviction will be upheld
items.ex_en: The high judicial panel voted unanimously to affirm the lower court's landmark environmental ruling.
items.ex_zh: 最高司法委员会一致投票决定确认维持下级法院具有里程碑意义的环境判决。

items.def_zh: 维护，捍卫（原则、正义等）；维持，确认（原判、决定等）
items.def_en: 1. To defend or maintain a principle, law, or right against opposition. 2. (law) To officially agree with and confirm a previous decision or court ruling.
items.ex_en: Appointed magistrates take an oath to uphold the fundamental tenets of constitutional democracy.
items.ex_zh: 获任命的法官宣誓捍卫宪政民主的基本原则。

items.def_zh: 维护，捍卫；维持（原判）（uphold的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of uphold; to defend a principle or confirm a legal decision.
items.ex_en: The supreme bench decisively upheld the constitutional validity of the controversial economic legislation.
items.ex_zh: 最高法院果断确认维持了这部备受争议的经济立法的合宪性。

groups.summary_en: An authority, court, or institution formally defends, affirms, or sustains an established law, conviction, principle, or custom against legal challenge or erosion. 'Uphold' typically denotes affirming lower rulings or defending standards, while 'sustain' confirms formal objections or validity.
groups.summary_zh: 司法或权威机构依法维持原判、确立原则或辩护惯例。
groups.desc_en: Refers to actively confirming, defending, or legally validating an established decision, value, or legal standard, contrasting with subversion or repeal by providing authoritative backing.
groups.desc_zh: 指主动支持、维护或在法律上维持既定决议、价值或标准，区别于推翻或废止，强调权威性认可与辩护。
groups.nuance_en: uphold: affirming and sustaining a lower decision or principle as legally correct (ruling / conviction / tradition) · maintain: asserting firmly or preserving a position consistently over time (innocence / standards / order) · sustain: legally ruling an objection valid, or enduringly supporting a burden (objection / damage / effort) · defend: protecting an idea, principle, or verdict against vigorous external attack (rights / thesis / reputation)
groups.nuance_zh: uphold: 上级机构或司法裁定维持原判或捍卫原则 (ruling / conviction / tradition) · maintain: 坚定不移地主张、坚守标准或立场 (innocence / standards / order) · sustain: 法庭上认可异议成立，或长效支撑 (objection / damage / effort) · defend: 面临质疑与反驳时出面辩护捍卫 (rights / thesis / reputation)

groups.name: Upload & Transfer Data · 数据传输与转移 (Digital File and Stream Transmission)
groups.tip: 网络或物理途径传输

items.def_en: (+ sth) to transmit digital files or data across a network or communication channel to another party
items.ex_en: Could you please send over the finalized project blueprints before the afternoon meeting?
items.ex_zh: 你能赶在下午开会前把最终敲定的项目蓝图发送过来吗？

items.def_en: (+ sth) to transmit digital data or files wirelessly from a satellite or remote source to a receiving device
items.ex_en: The orbital satellite will beam down high-resolution meteorological telemetry to the research station.
items.ex_zh: 轨道卫星将把高分辨率的气象遥测数据无线下传给地面科研站。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to transmit software updates or electronic data automatically to client devices across a network
items.ex_en: The founder was gradually pushed out of the company by the board.
items.ex_zh: 创始人逐渐被董事会排挤出了公司。

items.def_en: to transmit continuous audio or video data over the internet for immediate consumption
items.ex_en: Subscribers can easily stream ultra-high-definition documentary footage directly to their smart displays.
items.ex_zh: 订阅用户可以轻松将超高清纪录片片段直接流式传输到智能显示设备上。
items.ex2_en: Popular radio shows stream seamlessly across reliable high-speed wireless home internet connections.
items.ex2_zh: 广受欢迎的广播节目通过可靠的高速无线家庭网络顺畅地在线播放。

items.def_en: (+ to) to send commits, data, or update payloads proactively from a client to a remote repository
items.ex_en: The lead developer prepared to push local code commits to the central server.
items.ex_zh: 首席开发者准备将本地代码提交推送到中央代码仓库中。

items.def_en: (+ to/from) to copy or transmit digital data from one system or storage medium to another
items.ex_en: It takes several minutes to transfer the raw photographic archive to an external drive.
items.ex_zh: 将原始照片档案传输到外接硬盘需要花费几分钟时间。
items.ex2_en: Large compressed media files transfer quickly through these modern fiber optic connections.
items.ex2_zh: 大型压缩媒体文件通过这些现代光纤连接传输得非常迅速。

items.def_en: 1. To copy or transfer data, files, or software from the internet or a central computer onto a local device.
items.ex_en: Students were instructed to download the official syllabus directly from the course portal.
items.ex_zh: 学生们接到指示，直接从课程门户网站下载官方教学大纲。

items.def_en: 1. To transfer data, files, or programs from a local computer or device to a central network or internet.
items.ex_en: Remember to upload your signed insurance disclosure forms before the policy renewal deadline.
items.ex_zh: 请记得在保单续约截止日期前上传已签字的保险告知书。

items.def_en: to move data from a primary processor or memory bank to secondary storage or an auxiliary server
items.ex_en: The central server can efficiently offload intensive rendering queries to auxiliary edge nodes.
items.ex_zh: 中央服务器可以高效地将密集的渲染查询分流卸载到辅助边缘节点。

groups.summary_en: An agent or automated client program moves digital files, packets, or streams between local storage, remote servers, or devices across a network protocol.
groups.summary_zh: 在本地与远端服务器或设备间传输数字文件与流数据。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the movement of electronic files and digital packets across networks between local machines and remote servers, contrasting with non-digital transport through logical packet routing.
groups.desc_zh: 指在局域设备与远程服务器或网络端之间转移电子文件与数字数据包，区别于物理搬运，强调数字化路由传输。
groups.nuance_en: upload: transferring digital files upward from a client device to a central server (video / document / data) · download: retrieving data or files downward from an internet server to local storage (app / update / file) · stream: delivering continuous audio or video data for immediate rendering without prior saving (audio / matches / content) · transfer: moving funds, data files, or ownership logically across system interfaces (funds / files / calls)
groups.nuance_zh: upload: 将数据或文件从本地终端发送至中心服务器 (video / document / data) · download: 从网络服务器检索并保存文件至本地 (app / update / file) · stream: 以数据流形式实时播送并即时渲染，不强制本地预存 (audio / matches / content) · transfer: 在系统接口间迁移、调拨数据或资金 (funds / files / calls)

groups.name: Utilize & Exploit · 善用与撬动利用 (Utilize, Leverage, Harness)
groups.tip: 发挥人或事物的功用

items.def_zh: 开辟，开发利用（潜能、资源）
items.def_en: draw upon a resource, fund, or supply of expertise for a specific purpose
items.ex_en: The philanthropic foundation plans to tap domestic investment reserves for the upcoming hospital project.
items.ex_zh: 该慈善基金会计划开辟国内投资储备，以资助即将开展的医院项目。

items.def_zh: 调配，有效运用（资源、手段）
items.def_en: bring resources, arguments, or capabilities into effective action
items.ex_en: Military strategists chose to deploy advanced reconnaissance aircraft along the contested sovereign border.
items.ex_zh: 军事战略家决定在有争议的主权边境线上调配并部署先进的侦察机。

items.def_en: (formal) To make practical and effective use of something.
items.ex_en: Modern laboratories utilize automated screening technologies to expedite novel therapeutic discovery.
items.ex_zh: 现代实验室利用自动化筛查技术来加速新型药物疗法的发现。

items.def_en: take strategic advantage of an opportunity, asset, or condition
items.ex_en: Savvy investors moved swiftly to capitalize on shifting consumer sentiment toward renewable energy.
items.ex_zh: 精明的投资者迅速行动，充分利用消费者对可再生能源态度的转变来牟利。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make strategic use of an available supply of skills, resources, or knowledge
items.ex_en: She drew on her extensive background in marketing to craft the new campaign.
items.ex_zh: 她借鉴了自己在市场营销方面的深厚背景来策划新的推广活动。

items.def_zh: 开发利用；汲取（潜能、市场）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to access and harness a useful resource, market, or reservoir of knowledge
items.ex_en: Ambitious international brands strive to tap into the booming regional e-commerce retail market.
items.ex_zh: 雄心勃勃的国际品牌正努力开拓并利用该地区蓬勃发展的电子商务零售市场。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to exploit a quality, reputation, or connection to gain maximum practical advantage
items.ex_en: He managed to secure funding by trading on his family's influential name.
items.ex_zh: 他仗着家族的显赫名望设法获取了资金。

items.def_zh: 充分利用，借助……发挥最大效能；（金融）举债经营，以杠杆投资
items.def_en: 1. To use existing resources, influence, or technology to maximum strategic advantage. 2. (finance) To use borrowed money to finance an investment or transaction.
items.ex_en: Corporate leadership sought to leverage their patented software architecture across all consumer products.
items.ex_zh: 企业领导层试图充分利用其专利软件架构，以在其所有消费品中发挥最大效能。

items.def_en: control and direct the power of natural resources, talents, or efforts
items.ex_en: Engineers designed innovative turbines to harness tidal currents flowing through the deep estuary.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们设计了创新的涡轮机，以驾驭并利用流经幽深河口的水流潮汐能。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote putting resources, skills, or assets to effective, strategic, or maximal practical use to accomplish a goal.
groups.summary_zh: 高效运用、战略性撬动或转化资源以达成既定目标。
groups.desc_en: Denotes strategically mobilizing an available resource, capability, or advantage to achieve a concrete end, contrasting with passive possession or mere expenditure.
groups.desc_zh: 指战略性地调动、激活或转化既有资源与优势以达成目标，区别于消极拥有或盲目耗费。
groups.nuance_en: utilize: formal or practical employment for a purpose (technology / resources) · leverage: strategic magnification of existing advantage (assets / influence) · harness: capturing and directing raw energy or potential (wind / talent) · tap into: accessing an unexploited reservoir (markets / reserves) · capitalize on: turning a favorable circumstance into profit (mistakes / trends)
groups.nuance_zh: utilize: 务实或正式地投入使用 (technology / resources) · leverage: 借助杠杆撬动并放大既有优势 (assets / influence) · harness: 驾驭并引导原始力量或潜能 (wind / talent) · tap into: 开发引入未充分利用的深层储备 (markets / reserves) · capitalize on: 趁机将有利条件变现 (mistakes / trends)

groups.name: Vacation & Sojourn · 避暑与度假小住 (Summer, Winter, Holiday)
groups.tip: 休假放松与异地旅居

items.def_en: to spend the summer in a particular place, especially on holiday or vacation
items.ex_en: Wealthy patrons of the arts traditionally summer along the tranquil rocky shores of Maine.
items.ex_zh: 富有的艺术赞助人传统上会在缅因州宁静的岩石海岸避暑度假。

items.def_en: to spend a weekend in a particular place, especially for leisure or holiday
items.ex_en: City dwellers love to weekend in picturesque rustic cabins near the mountain lake.
items.ex_zh: 城市居民热衷于在靠近高山湖泊、风景如画的质朴小木屋里度周末。

items.def_en: (+ in/at) to spend the winter months in a particular resort or warmer climate
items.ex_en: Elderly retirees often winter in sunny Mediterranean coastal towns to escape damp northern cold.
items.ex_zh: 年长的退休人员常在阳光明媚的地中海沿海小镇过冬，以躲避北方潮湿的严寒。

items.def_en: (+ in/at) to spend time away from home enjoying recreation or leisure (mainly British)
items.ex_en: The aristocratic family used to holiday at their grand lakeside lodge in Scotland.
items.ex_zh: 这个贵族家庭过去常在苏格兰宏伟的湖边庄园里度过休闲假日。

items.def_en: (+ in/at) to take a holiday or spend vacation time in a specific destination (mainly American)
items.ex_en: Many overworked executives prefer to vacation in secluded tropical resorts far from emails.
items.ex_zh: 许多工作过度的企业高管更喜欢在远离电子邮件的幽静热带度假村休假。

items.def_en: (+ at/with) to stay for a brief period as a temporary resident or visitor
items.ex_en: The wandering scholar decided to sojourn at the quiet monastery for several reflective months.
items.ex_zh: 这位漫游的学者决定在这座寂静的修道院作短期逗留，在此沉思冥想数月。

items.def_en: to leave home or work to spend time relaxing on holiday or vacation
items.ex_en: We really need to get away to the seaside this weekend to relax.
items.ex_zh: 我们这个周末真得去海边度个假，好好放松一下了。

items.def_zh: 躲起来消夏/小住；隐居度假
items.def_en: to stay temporarily in a secluded or quiet place to rest, retreat, or spend a season
items.ex_en: During the sweltering heat, they hole up in their secluded mountain cabin.
items.ex_zh: 在酷暑难耐的日子里，他们躲在幽静的山间小屋里避暑消夏。

items.def_en: to lodge or reside temporarily as a guest at a place for a night or short sojourn
items.ex_en: It's too late to drive back, so you should just stay over tonight.
items.ex_zh: 开车回去太晚了，你今晚就在这儿过夜吧。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate residing temporarily in a leisurely locale for a season, holiday, or weekend to relax, characteristic of seasonal migration and recreational getaways.
groups.summary_zh: 前往某地度假、过周末或度过特定季节（避暑/避寒）。
groups.desc_en: Denotes temporarily withdrawing from habitual work to reside elsewhere for rest, seasonal dwelling, or refuge, contrasting with permanent relocation.
groups.desc_zh: 指暂时脱离常规工作生活，异地小住、避暑越冬或隐退休假，区别于永久定居迁徙。
groups.nuance_en: vacation: taking formal recreational leave away from home (in Europe / at the coast) · summer: spending the hot season in a cooler or resort locale (in Maine / on the Riviera) · winter: passing the cold season in a warmer climate (in Florida / in the south) · sojourn: temporary formal stay in a place (in Rome / abroad) · hole up: retreating into seclusion or concealment (in a cabin / in a hotel)
groups.nuance_zh: vacation: 离家进行正式的休闲度假 (in Europe / at the coast) · summer: 在避暑胜地度过炎夏 (in Maine / on the Riviera) · winter: 在温暖地区度过寒冬 (in Florida / in the south) · sojourn: 客居他乡或短暂停留 (in Rome / abroad) · hole up: 隐居、避世或藏匿于安全处所 (in a cabin / in a hotel)

groups.name: Vegetative Flourishing & Enrichment · 滋养与绽放 (Blossom, Fertilise, Flourish)
groups.tip: 如花朵般绽放生长繁荣

items.def_en: to produce and unfold fresh leaves, entering a lush green vegetative state
items.ex_en: When gentle rains fall, the ancient elms along the riverbank slowly leaf out.
items.ex_zh: 当微雨洒落，河岸边的古老榆树缓缓展出翠绿的新叶。

items.def_en: to grow, sprout, or develop rapidly out of the ground
items.ex_en: Fresh green shoots began to spring up across the meadow after the shower.
items.ex_zh: 阵雨过后，整片草地上开始蓬勃萌生出嫩绿的幼芽。

items.def_en: [I/T] to begin to grow leaves, buds, or shoots
items.ex_en: The tiny tomato seeds began to sprout tiny green shoots after three days.
items.ex_zh: 三天后，细小的番茄种子开始抽出了嫩绿的细芽。
items.ex2_en: Warm, sunny spring weather helps sprout delicate wildflower seeds across the meadows.
items.ex2_zh: 温暖晴朗的春日天气有助于让草地上的娇嫩野花种子发芽。

items.def_en: to grow taller or lengthen very rapidly in a brief period of botanical vigor
items.ex_en: The bamboo stalks shoot up almost several inches after every warm summer downpour.
items.ex_zh: 每逢夏季暖雨倾盆，那些竹笋几乎都会猛蹿几英寸高。

items.def_en: to produce flowers or achieve a healthy, vibrant appearance
items.ex_en: The delicate cherry trees bloom with glorious pink petals every single April.
items.ex_zh: 每年四月，娇柔的樱花树都会绽放出灿烂的粉色花瓣。

items.def_zh: 开花；繁荣，兴旺，蓬勃发展
items.def_en: 1. To produce flowers. 2. To develop, flourish, or become more successful and attractive.
items.ex_en: The apple orchards blossom into fragrant clouds of white petals every single spring.
items.ex_zh: 每逢春季，苹果园里繁花竞放，化作一片芬芳的白云。

items.def_en: to supply with the nutrients necessary for growth and vitality
items.ex_en: Rich organic matter will nourish the young saplings through the dry summer months.
items.ex_zh: 丰富的有机质将在干燥的夏季月份里滋养这些幼树。

items.def_zh: 使受精，使受粉；施肥，使肥沃
items.def_en: 1. To cause an egg, animal, or plant to develop new life by joining with a male cell. 2. To add fertilizer to soil or plants to aid growth.
items.ex_en: Gardeners must fertilise the soil with rich compost before sowing any delicate seeds.
items.ex_zh: 在播种细嫩的种子之前，园丁必须用富饶的堆肥使土壤肥沃。

items.def_en: to begin to grow or develop rapidly and abundantly
items.ex_en: In late spring, fertile valleys burgeon with wildflowers and lush green vegetation.
items.ex_zh: 暮春时节，肥沃的山谷中野花丛生，草木繁茂。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail botanical growth and enrichment, encompassing both the external act of enriching soil/plants and the plant's own vibrant phase of flowering and flourishing.
groups.summary_zh: 植物开花绽放或施肥充养等滋生演进的具体方式。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the organic emergence, vigorous maturation, and physiological enrichment of vegetative life, contrasting with static growth or synthetic production.
groups.desc_zh: 指植物机体由内而外的生发、盛开以及通过养分实现的滋养繁茂，区别于单纯尺度增大或机械制造。
groups.nuance_en: sprout: early emergence of buds or shoots (seeds / leaves) · bloom: opening into full floral beauty or peak vitality (roses / youth) · blossom: progressive flowering yielding future fruit or maturity (orchards / talent) · nourish: sustaining organic growth with vital nutrients (seedlings / soil) · fertilise: enriching soil or gametes to enable prolific yield (crops / fields)
groups.nuance_zh: sprout: 萌发新芽或展露生机 (seeds / leaves) · bloom: 花朵盛开或生理机能达到全盛 (roses / youth) · blossom: 渐进绽放并孕育成熟结果 (orchards / talent) · nourish: 提供机体生长所需的养分与滋润 (seedlings / soil) · fertilise: 施肥使土壤或配子丰沃多产 (crops / fields)

groups.name: Verbally Abuse & Revile · 辱骂与谩骂 (Abuse, Revile, Vituperate)
groups.tip: 由言语侮辱升级为恶毒痛骂

items.def_en: to say or do something deliberately offensive and disrespectful to someone
items.ex_en: It was completely unacceptable for him to insult the host in front of everyone.
items.ex_zh: 他在众人面前公然侮辱主人，这完全是不可接受的。

items.def_zh: 辱骂，粗话痛骂；用俚语说
items.def_en: (British informal) To attack or insult someone using abusive, vulgar language.
items.ex_en: The furious cab driver began to slang the pedestrian for crossing carelessly.
items.ex_zh: 暴怒的出租车司机用粗话痛骂那个莽撞横穿马路的行人。

items.def_en: to scold or condemn someone angrily and at length
items.ex_en: The angry supervisor began to berate the careless technician for missing crucial safety deadlines.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的主管因粗心的技术人员错过关键安全期限而对其厉声呵斥。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to suddenly attack someone with angry insults or bitter invective
items.ex_en: The frustrated politician began to lash out at reporters with bitter, hostile accusations.
items.ex_zh: 受挫的政客开始用充满敌意的刻薄指责猛烈痛斥记者。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to attack someone verbally with harsh, aggressive, and abusive language
items.ex_en: The coach started to lay into the players after their embarrassing tournament defeat.
items.ex_zh: 在球队遭遇尴尬惨败后，教练开始对着队员们破口痛骂。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to scold, abuse, or criticize someone with fierce verbal ferocity
items.ex_en: The boss began to tear into the junior designer over the botched project.
items.ex_zh: 老板因为砸锅的项目，狠狠痛骂了那位初级设计师一顿。

items.def_en: to criticize someone in a very angry and abusive manner, often publicly
items.ex_en: Crowds gathered outside the courthouse to revile the corrupt magistrate with fierce fury.
items.ex_zh: 人群聚集在法院外，满腔怒火地公开痛骂那个贪腐的法官。

items.def_en: (archaic) To revile, abuse, or speak slanderously and insultingly of someone.
items.ex_en: The drunken rogue would often blackguard his rivals with crude and malicious slanders.
items.ex_zh: 那个醉汉恶棍常常用粗鄙恶毒的诽谤言辞肆意辱骂对手。

items.def_en: to blame or insult someone violently using abusive, malicious language
items.ex_en: The bitter polemicist continued to vituperate his former patrons with unbridled venomous prose.
items.ex_zh: 那位满腹怨怼的论战者继续用毫无顾忌的恶毒言辞肆意诋毁旧主。

groups.summary_en: Speakers direct harsh, derogatory, or scurrilous language toward a person to humiliate or defame them, escalating from informal street insult to bitter, sustained invective.
groups.summary_zh: 使用侮辱、粗鄙或恶毒言语攻击他人，多含贬损与泄愤色彩。
groups.desc_en: Denotes discharging harsh, scornful, or insulting speech directly at someone to demean or injure them, contrasting with mild criticism or reasoned dispute.
groups.desc_zh: 指以羞辱性、敌意或粗暴言辞直接攻击斥责他人，区别于温和批评或说理辩论。
groups.nuance_en: revile: subjecting to public, venomous invective (opponents / traitors) · berate: angrily and scoldingly chiding at length (staff / players) · lay into: launching an aggressive, unrestrained verbal assault (critics / rivals) · insult: deliberately offending dignity or self-worth (intelligence / honor) · lash out at: suddenly venting defensive, bitter verbal fury (reporters / colleagues)
groups.nuance_zh: revile: 极具攻击性地公开痛骂或辱骂 (opponents / traitors) · berate: 怒气冲冲地长时间痛陈斥责 (staff / players) · lay into: 毫无保留地猛烈开火痛批 (critics / rivals) · insult: 蓄意贬损他人尊严与人格 (intelligence / honor) · lash out at: 突然且具防御性地发泄怒火攻击 (reporters / colleagues)

groups.name: Verify & Ascertain Truth · 查证与核实 (Verify, Ascertain, Authenticate)
groups.tip: 搜集真凭实据核验真伪

items.def_en: make sure that something is true, accurate, or justified through evidence
items.ex_en: Auditors must verify the financial records before publishing the comprehensive annual corporate review.
items.ex_zh: 审计员在发布全面的企业年度审查报告前，必须核实财务记录。

items.def_en: (+ sth) To investigate or verify the truth or accuracy of information, or (of facts) to be confirmed as true
items.ex_en: We need to check out of the hotel by noon, but let's check out the local market first.
items.ex_zh: 我们需要在中午前结账退房，不过先去看看当地的集市吧。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) To support or confirm the truth of a claim, prediction, or evidence
items.ex_en: The final audit results bore out all our initial suspicions about financial mismanagement.
items.ex_zh: 最终的审计结果证实了我们最初对财务管理不善的所有怀疑。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) To find the exact origin, fact, or person after thorough and systematic searching
items.ex_en: The police managed to track down the suspect after weeks of investigation.
items.ex_zh: 经过数周的调查，警方终于追查到了嫌疑人的下落。

items.def_en: check or prove the validity or accuracy of a claim or document
items.ex_en: Subsequent laboratory experiments helped validate the controversial claims made by the young scientist.
items.ex_zh: 随后的实验室检测有助于证实这位年轻科学家提出的争议性主张。

items.def_zh: 查明，精确指出；准确确定（位置或时间）
items.def_en: 1. To find, identify, or explain the exact position, cause, or time of something.
items.ex_en: Technicians managed to pinpoint the exact location of the subterranean pipe rupture quickly.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员迅速精确查明了地下管道破裂的具体位置。

items.def_en: 1. (formal) To find out and verify the exact facts or truth about something through investigation.
items.ex_en: Detectives worked tirelessly to ascertain the precise sequence of events during the incident.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们夜以继日地工作，以查明事件发生时的确切经过。

items.def_en: confirm or give support to a statement, theory, or finding with evidence
items.ex_en: Two independent witnesses arrived to corroborate the suspect's original alibi regarding the robbery.
items.ex_zh: 两名独立证人出面证实了嫌疑人关于那起抢劫案的最初不在场证明。

items.def_zh: 证实……为真，证明……是真实的；（计算机）验证（身份）
items.def_en: 1. To prove officially that a document, signature, artwork, or identity is genuine.
items.ex_en: The museum curator had to authenticate the ancient manuscript before bidding at auction.
items.ex_zh: 博物馆馆长在参与拍卖竞价前，必须鉴定证实这份古代手稿的真伪。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe systematic investigative or analytical efforts to establish factual accuracy, provenance, or exact parameters. They differ by whether the goal is identifying a precise point, validating genuine origins, or resolving doubt with definitive proof.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过调查、比对或技术检验来确定事实真相与真实性。
groups.desc_en: Denotes rigorous investigative procedures aimed at confirming the truth, accuracy, or authenticity of a claim, contrasting with mere guessing or assuming.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过比对、调查或证据链检验以确证事实真相与有效性，区别于主观揣测或被动采信。
groups.nuance_en: verify: establishing truth or accuracy via empirical checking (facts / credentials) · ascertain: finding out definitively through inquiry (causes / facts) · corroborate: strengthening a claim with independent supporting evidence (testimony / evidence) · validate: officially or logically confirming legitimacy and correctness (theories / claims) · pinpoint: locating or identifying with extreme precision (locations / errors)
groups.nuance_zh: verify: 通过查证比对确认真实性与准确度 (facts / credentials) · ascertain: 经过深入调查弄清确切原委 (causes / facts) · corroborate: 提供第三方独立证据以佐证 (testimony / evidence) · validate: 在法律或逻辑层面上认可有效性 (theories / claims) · pinpoint: 极为精确地定位或指出 (locations / errors)

groups.name: Violent Homicide · 暴力杀害与行凶 (Knife, Stone, Murder)
groups.tip: 施加致命伤剥夺生命

items.def_en: kill someone by squeezing their neck to stop breathing
items.ex_en: The ruthless assassin attempted to strangle the sleeping guard with a silk cord.
items.ex_zh: 冷酷的刺客试图用一根丝绳勒死沉睡中的警卫。

items.def_en: (+ sb) To murder someone intentionally, especially in an informal or underworld context
items.ex_en: The mafia boss ordered his henchmen to bump off the troublesome rival informant.
items.ex_zh: 黑帮头目命令手下干掉那个惹来麻烦的敌对线人。

items.def_en: (+ sb) To assassinate or deliberately kill a specific targeted person
items.ex_en: The hitman was hired by rival gangsters to take out the key witness.
items.ex_zh: 这名杀手受敌对帮派雇佣，意图除掉那名关键证人。

items.def_zh: 用石头砸死，用石块处决；投石击打
items.def_en: To throw stones at someone, especially to kill or execute them as a punishment.
items.ex_en: The enraged mob threatened to stone the helpless captive outside the fortress walls.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的暴民威胁要在城墙外用石头活活砸死那个无助的俘虏。

items.def_en: To stab or cut someone with a knife.
items.ex_en: A masked mugger tried to knife the defenseless tourist during the dark alleyway robbery.
items.ex_zh: 一名蒙面劫匪在昏暗的小巷抢劫中，企图用刀刺杀毫无防备的游客。

items.def_en: kill a person in a violent, deliberate manner (formal or literary)
items.ex_en: The ruthless warlord resolved to slay every rival prince who threatened his succession.
items.ex_zh: 残暴的军阀决意杀戮每一个威胁到他继位大权的敌对王子。

items.def_en: (+ sb) To kill someone by striking them repeatedly with severe physical violence
items.ex_en: The brutal guards threatened to beat to death anyone caught attempting midnight escape.
items.ex_zh: 残忍的看守威胁要将任何企图在午夜逃跑的人活活打死。

items.def_en: 1. To kill someone deliberately and unlawfully. 2. (informal) To spoil, ruin, or perform something very badly.
items.ex_en: The conspirators met in secret to plan how to murder the wealthy merchant.
items.ex_zh: 阴谋者们秘密会面，策划如何谋害那位富商。

items.def_en: murder a prominent person by surprise attack, usually for political reasons
items.ex_en: Conspirators plotted in secret to assassinate the visiting premier during the state procession.
items.ex_zh: 阴谋分子秘密策划在国事巡游期间刺杀来访的总理。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the deliberate, illegal killing of human beings using targeted weapons, physical violence, or premeditated assault. They escalate in intensity and legal/moral severity from specific instrumental assaults to outright premeditated murder.
groups.summary_zh: 指使用特定武器行凶或蓄意非法夺取他人生命。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the unlawful, violent termination of human life through physical brutality or stealth, contrasting with lawful execution or accidental death.
groups.desc_zh: 指使用暴力手段、凶器或暗杀非法剥夺他人生命，区别于法定执行死刑或意外致死。
groups.nuance_en: murder: premeditated, unlawful killing (victims / rivals) · knife: fatally stabbing or slashing with a blade (guards / rivals) · strangle: killing by compressing the throat to cut off air (victims / spouses) · stone: killing communally or brutally by hurling rocks (captives / apostates) · bump off: underworld slang for eliminating or assassinating (informants / witnesses)
groups.nuance_zh: murder: 蓄意且非法的故意谋杀 (victims / rivals) · knife: 持刀刺死或砍死 (guards / rivals) · strangle: 扼颈勒死以阻断呼吸 (victims / spouses) · stone: 用乱石砸死 (captives / apostates) · bump off: 黑帮俚语指干掉或做掉 (informants / witnesses)

groups.name: Walk with Heavy or Bold Stride · 迈步与行走 (Clump, Swagger, Stride)
groups.tip: 不同姿态步幅的行走方式

items.def_zh: 沉重缓慢地走，蹒跚而行
items.def_en: to walk slowly and with heavy steps, usually because of tiredness or difficult terrain
items.ex_en: Exhausted soldiers began to plod through the muddy trenches under the heavy rain.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的士兵们冒着大雨，步履沉重地跋涉在泥泞的战壕中。

items.def_en: To enter a room or area with deliberate, assertive, and heavy strides
items.ex_en: The stern director would march in and demand an immediate explanation from everyone.
items.ex_zh: 那位严厉的主任大步昂然走进房间，要求所有人立即作出解释。

items.def_en: To walk away with loud, heavy, and angry steps
items.ex_en: After losing the heated argument, the manager began to stomp off in disgust.
items.ex_zh: 在激烈的争论中败下阵来后，经理气急败坏地跺着大步走开了。

items.def_en: To walk forward with long, vigorous, and purposeful steps
items.ex_en: Every morning at dawn, she would stride out across the dew-soaked meadow vigorously.
items.ex_zh: 每天拂晓时分，她都会精神抖擞地迈开大步，穿过沾满露水的草地。

items.def_en: to walk with long, energetic, and purposeful steps
items.ex_en: The diplomat proceeded to stride toward the podium with unwavering authority and grace.
items.ex_zh: 外交官迈着坚定沉稳的大步走向讲台，神态端庄而充满威严。

items.def_en: to walk in a proud, pompous way with head up and chest thrust forward
items.ex_en: The arrogant peacocks strut through the courtyard garden displaying their magnificent bright plumage.
items.ex_zh: 傲慢的孔雀在庭院花园里大摇大摆地漫步，炫耀着华丽明亮的羽毛。

items.def_zh: 脚步沉重而笨拙地走；聚集，成团
items.def_en: 1. To walk with heavy, clumsy, noisy steps. 2. To form or gather into a dense mass or cluster.
items.ex_en: The tired lumberjack would clump heavily down the wooden stairs in his mud-caked boots.
items.ex_zh: 疲倦的伐木工人穿着沾满泥巴的靴子，笨重嘈杂地走下木楼梯。
items.ex2_en: The food processor will clump wet flour into heavy dough quite rapidly.
items.ex2_zh: 食品料理机会相当迅速地将湿面粉聚结成厚重的面团。

items.def_zh: 大摇大摆地走，趾高气扬地走；吹嘘，妄自尊大
items.def_en: To walk or behave in a proud, arrogant, or excessively self-confident way.
items.ex_en: Young officers love to swagger into the crowded tavern, eager to impress everyone.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的军官们喜欢趾高气扬地踱进拥挤的酒馆，渴望引起众人的赞叹。

items.def_en: to walk with forceful, loud, deliberate steps, often out of anger
items.ex_en: Furious about the unfair penalty, the player began to stomp off the pitch.
items.ex_zh: 因不满不公的判罚，那名球员怒气冲冲地跺着重步走下了球场。

groups.summary_en: Agents propel themselves on foot with distinctive physical cadence or attitude, contrasting heavy, noisy footfalls with confident, insolent, or decisive strides.
groups.summary_zh: 通过特定的步态、声响或姿态行走，体现沉重笨拙或傲慢果敢。
groups.desc_en: Denotes walking with deliberate, exaggerated physical impact, expansive strides, or self-assertive posture, contrasting with unobtrusive strolling or running.
groups.desc_zh: 指步态带有沉重撞击感、宽阔步幅或炫耀威势的迈步行进，区别于低调漫步或奔跑。
groups.nuance_en: stride: taking long, purposeful, confident steps (across the room / forward) · swagger: walking with an arrogant, swinging conceit (into town / down the street) · strut: stiff-legged, pompous walking showing off (on stage / around) · clump: walking with heavy, noisy, clumsy footfalls (down the stairs / boots) · plod: slow, laborious, weary walking (through mud / homeward)
groups.nuance_zh: stride: 大步流星、自信果断地迈步 (across the room / forward) · swagger: 摇头晃脑、不可一世地大摇大摆 (into town / down the street) · strut: 昂首阔步、傲慢做作地踱步 (on stage / around) · clump: 迈着沉重、笨拙而嘈杂的响亮脚步 (down the stairs / boots) · plod: 步履沉重缓慢、疲倦地跋涉 (through mud / homeward)

groups.name: Wash & Cleanse Body Parts · 冲洗与盥洗 (Gargle, Lave, Rinse)
groups.tip: 漱口洗脸涤荡身体部位

items.def_en: (+ sth) To wash the mouth or a body cavity thoroughly with clean water without soap
items.ex_en: Be sure to rinse out your mouth thoroughly with lukewarm water after brushing.
items.ex_zh: 刷完牙后，务必用温水彻底把口腔冲漱干净。

items.def_en: (+ sb) To clean a person's body gently using a wet sponge or cloth
items.ex_en: The gentle nurse volunteered to sponge down the feverish patient with cool water.
items.ex_zh: 温柔的护士主动用凉水为发着高烧的病人擦洗身体。

items.def_zh: 用水冲洗（全身或身体部位）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) To thoroughly clean all or part of the body by splashing or spraying water over it
items.ex_en: He washed down the spicy tacos with a cold glass of lemonade.
items.ex_zh: 他喝了一大口冰柠檬水，咽下了辛辣的墨西哥卷饼。

items.def_en: (+ down) to wipe or wash the body gently using a damp sponge or cloth
items.ex_en: The attendant began to sponge down the weary runner's dust-covered face and neck.
items.ex_zh: 工作人员开始用湿海绵擦洗那名疲惫跑者布满灰尘的面庞和颈部。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ out) to wash mouth, hands, or hair lightly with clean water without soap
items.ex_en: You should rinse your soapy hands thoroughly under the faucet after handling grease.
items.ex_zh: 接触油脂后，你应该在水龙头下彻底把满是肥皂沫的手冲洗干净。

items.def_en: To clean the throat and mouth with a liquid held in the back of the mouth while exhaling.
items.ex_en: The physician advised the coughing patient to gargle with warm salted water daily.
items.ex_zh: 医生建议咳嗽的病人每天用温盐水含漱咽喉。

items.def_zh: 清洗，沐浴；（水）轻拍，流淌冲刷
items.def_en: 1. (literary or archaic) To wash or bathe something gently. 2. (of water) To wash or flow against a shore or surface.
items.ex_en: She knelt beside the crystal brook to lave her sunburnt face and hands.
items.ex_zh: 她跪在清澈的溪水旁，轻轻清洗晒伤的面庞和双手。

items.def_zh: 沐浴，用水清洗（伤口或身体部位）
items.def_en: [I/T] to immerse the body in water to wash; or gently wash a body part or wound with liquid
items.ex_en: The medic helped bathe the painful wound with a sterile antiseptic liquid carefully.
items.ex_zh: 医务人员小心地用无菌消毒液清洗擦拭那处疼痛的伤口。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ out) to rinse or swirl liquid vigorously around the mouth or a container
items.ex_en: He had to swill the minty liquid around his mouth before spitting it.
items.ex_zh: 他必须把薄荷漱口水在嘴里使劲含漱一番，然后再吐掉。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe specific bodily washing or rinsing actions, differing by the technique, targeted anatomical area, and liquid flow. 'Gargle' specifies oscillating liquid in the throat, 'rinse' clears with water alone, while 'lave' is a poetic, gentle bathing or splashing action.
groups.summary_zh: 按清洗方式与身体部位细分的盥洗动作：漱口、冲洗及沐洗等。
groups.desc_en: Denotes directing liquid over or applying a moist absorbent tool to specific bodily surfaces to cleanse or soothe, contrasting with full-body immersion.
groups.desc_zh: 指用水流冲洗或用湿润织物擦洗身体特定部位以达清洁舒缓，区别于全身性浸泡盆浴。
groups.nuance_en: rinse: clearing away soap or debris with clean water (hair / mouth) · gargle: swirling liquid in the throat with expelled breath (throat / with saltwater) · sponge: wiping down gently using a moist absorbent sponge (face / patient) · lave: poetic washing or gentle lapping of liquid (wounds / brow) · bathe: washing or immersing a specific injured part (eyes / feet)
groups.nuance_zh: rinse: 用清水冲洗泡沫或残渣 (hair / mouth) · gargle: 含漱液体清洁咽喉 (throat / with saltwater) · sponge: 用湿海绵轻柔擦拭 (face / patient) · lave: 雅致或诗意地濯洗伤口或额头 (wounds / brow) · bathe: 浸洗或清洗局部患处 (eyes / feet)

groups.name: Weeping & Tearful Lamentation · 呜咽与抽泣啼哭 (Pule, Blub, Weep)
groups.tip: 从低声啜泣到放声大哭

items.def_en: to make weak, quiet crying sounds expressive of fear, distress, or hurt
items.ex_en: The terrified puppy began to whimper softly in the corner of the dark kennel.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的小狗在昏暗犬舍的角落里低声呜咽抽泣。

items.def_en: To cry plaintively, weakly, or fretfully, especially like a sick child or young bird.
items.ex_en: The sick infant continued to pule faintly through the cold, restless winter night.
items.ex_zh: 患病的婴儿在寒冷难熬的冬夜里不停地微弱啜泣哀鸣。

items.def_en: (+ sth) To struggle to suppress tears or convulsive sobs with great difficulty
items.ex_en: The grieving widow tried to choke back her desperate sobs during the eulogy.
items.ex_zh: 悲痛的寡妇在悼词宣读期间拼命忍住绝望的抽泣声。

items.def_en: To emit a loud, tearful wail or vocal lamentation from grief or pain
items.ex_en: Hearing the devastating news, the desolate mother could only cry out in agony.
items.ex_zh: 听到这毁灭性的噩耗，绝望的母亲只能痛苦地号啕哀呼。

items.def_zh: 哭泣，流泪（weep 的过去式及过去分词）；渗出
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of weep; to have cried or shed tears.
items.ex_en: The defeated monarch wept bitter tears of remorse beside his fallen city walls.
items.ex_zh: 战败的君主在坍塌的城墙边洒下了悔恨的苦涩泪水。

items.def_zh: 抽抽搭搭地哭，号啕大哭；哭着说出
items.def_en: To cry noisily and childishly.
items.ex_en: The spoiled toddler began to blub loudly after losing his favorite yellow toy.
items.ex_zh: 那个被宠坏的幼儿丢了他最喜欢的黄色玩具后，开始大声号啕大哭。

items.def_en: To lose emotional control and begin weeping uncontrollably
items.ex_en: Under intense cross-examination, the exhausted witness started to break down and weep openly.
items.ex_zh: 在严苛的盘问下，筋疲力尽的证人终于情绪崩溃，失声痛哭起来。
items.ex2_en: The relentless questioning from the prosecutor finally broke down the stubborn witness.
items.ex2_zh: 检察官无休止的质问最终使这名顽固的证人崩溃了。

items.def_en: to cry noisily with gasping, convulsive breaths
items.ex_en: She could only sob quietly into her pillow throughout the lonely, silent night.
items.ex_zh: 在寂静孤独的长夜里，她只能埋在枕头中低声抽泣。

items.def_en: to utter a loud, prolonged, high-pitched cry of deep grief and lamentation
items.ex_en: Distraught relatives began to wail loudly outside the collapsed mine in deep despair.
items.ex_zh: 心碎的亲属在塌陷的矿井外陷入绝望，放声痛哭号啕。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail shedding tears and emitting cries of sorrow, ranging from weak, childish whines to unrestrained, convulsive weeping.
groups.summary_zh: 指伴随落泪的悲泣体验，从细弱哀鸣、委屈抽噎到放声痛哭。
groups.desc_en: Denotes shedding tears accompanied by audible vocalizations of grief, distress, or loss, contrasting with silent stoicism or loud screaming.
groups.desc_zh: 指伴随抽噎、哭泣声泄露内心情感的流泪痛哭，区别于默默隐忍或无泪狂嚎。
groups.nuance_en: sob: weeping with convulsive, gasping breaths (openly / uncontrollably) · whimper: crying with low, plaintive, broken sounds (in fear / softly) · weep: formal or literary shedding of sustained tears (tears / for the dead) · break down: losing emotional control and collapsing into tears (in court / completely) · blub: colloquial crying noisily and childishly (messily / in self-pity)
groups.nuance_zh: sob: 倒抽冷气、抽噎剧烈地痛哭 (openly / uncontrollably) · whimper: 委屈、恐惧地低声呜咽啜泣 (in fear / softly) · weep: 文雅或庄重地垂泪、哀泣 (tears / for the dead) · break down: 心理防线崩溃失声痛哭 (in court / completely) · blub: 口语中指孩子气地嚎啕大哭 (messily / in self-pity)

groups.name: Weight & Compress · 施压与压紧 (Exert Downward Load or Compact Mass)
groups.tip: 施加重量或外力压实

items.def_en: (+ down) to pack down firmly by a succession of light, tapping blows
items.ex_en: The gardener used a wooden mallet to tamp the moist soil around the roots.
items.ex_zh: 园丁用木槌将根系周围湿润的泥土轻轻拍实捣紧。

items.def_en: (+ sth) To press loose earth, snow, or materials together into a dense, solid mass
items.ex_en: Workers used heavy wooden rollers to pack down the loose gravel along the road.
items.ex_zh: 工人们用沉重的木制滚筒将沿路松散的碎石彻底压紧夯实。
items.ex2_en: Fresh snow will quickly pack down under the weight of passing vehicles.
items.ex2_zh: 在新过车辆的重压下，新雪很快就会被压实。

items.def_en: (+ on sth) To exert continuous downward physical force to compress or compact something
items.ex_en: You need to press down firmly on the dough to expel any trapped air.
items.ex_zh: 你需要用力向下按压面团，以排出里面残留的空气。

items.def_en: (+ sth) To keep something firmly in place or compress it by placing heavy weights on top
items.ex_en: She felt weighed down by domestic responsibilities and work pressures.
items.ex_zh: 她感到家庭责任和工作压力压得自己喘不过气来。

items.def_zh: 在……上加重量；压住，压紧；使加权
items.def_en: To attach a weight to or place a heavy object on something to hold it down or make it heavier.
items.ex_en: Use these heavy stone pavers to weight the tarpaulin against the stormy wind.
items.ex_zh: 用这些沉重的铺路石板把防水布压紧，以防被暴风掀翻。

items.def_en: to press or squeeze something together so that it occupies less space
items.ex_en: Hydraulic machinery is utilized to compress loose metal scraps into dense transportable blocks.
items.ex_zh: 水压机械被用来将松散的废金属压缩成致密且便于运输的金属块。
items.ex2_en: These dense foam layers compress easily when packed into a tight shipping carton.
items.ex2_zh: 这些致密的泡沫层装入狭小的运输纸箱时很容易被压缩。

items.def_en: to squeeze or compress tightly around the circumference of an object
items.ex_en: Heavy elastic bands constrict the swollen limb to reduce localized tissue inflammation effectively.
items.ex_zh: 厚重的弹力绷带紧紧勒住肿胀的肢体，以有效减轻局部组织炎症。
items.ex2_en: His pupils constrict naturally when exposed to bright morning sunlight.
items.ex2_zh: 暴露在明亮的晨光下时，他的瞳孔会自然收缩。

items.def_zh: 压紧，压实；撞击，冲击；对……产生影响
items.def_en: 1. To press or pack firmly together into a solid mass. 2. To hit with great force, or have a strong effect on something.
items.ex_en: Heavy steamrollers continuously run back and forth to impact the loose gravel layers.
items.ex_zh: 重型压路机来回碾压，以将松散的碎石层压实结实。

items.def_en: to exert heavy pressure on loose material to form a dense, firm mass
items.ex_en: Workers must compact the gravel foundation thoroughly before pouring the heavy concrete slabs.
items.ex_zh: 工人们在浇筑厚重的混凝土板之前，必须将碎石地基彻底压实。
items.ex2_en: Wet coastal soil will compact firmly after several weeks of heavy traffic.
items.ex2_zh: 经过几周繁忙的交通，潮湿的沿海土壤会紧实固结。

groups.summary_en: An agent applies persistent gravitational load or mechanical force to an object or volume to press, stabilize, or compact it into a denser solid state.
groups.summary_zh: 通过施加物理重负或机械挤压力使之压实或压牢。
groups.desc_en: Denotes exerting downward or inward force to compact particulate matter or burden an object with mass, contrasting with unweighted resting or expanding.
groups.desc_zh: 指施加向下重力或向内压力以压实疏松物质或加重负荷，区别于轻放或松散扩张。
groups.nuance_en: compress: squeezing volume into a denser form (gas / air / files) · weigh down: overburdening physically or psychologically with gravity (branches / mind) · tamp: gently tapping down loose material repeatedly (tobacco / soil / gravel) · pack down: compressing loose substances firmly together (snow / earth) · impact: forcing wedged particles or surfaces tightly together (debris / soil)
groups.nuance_zh: compress: 向内加压缩减体积使之致密 (gas / air / files) · weigh down: 凭借重力沉沉下压或使心理负重 (branches / mind) · tamp: 连续轻敲捣实疏松颗粒 (tobacco / soil / gravel) · pack down: 将松散物质压紧实 (snow / earth) · impact: 强力压挤或嵌紧成坚实硬块 (debris / soil)

groups.name: Whisper & Mutter · 低语与咕哝 (Whisper, Murmur, Mumble)
groups.tip: 刻意压低声音喃喃自语

items.def_en: utter words very quietly or gently, often as an intimate disclosure
items.ex_en: She leaned close in the twilight to breathe her secret into his ear.
items.ex_zh: 她在暮色中俯身靠近，在他耳边轻声吐露出自己的秘密。

items.def_en: [I/T] speak very softly using one's breath rather than throat sounds to maintain secrecy
items.ex_en: The students leaned across the desk to whisper the test answers in secret.
items.ex_zh: 学生们伏在课桌上，暗中窃窃私语交流考试答案。

items.def_zh: 低语，低声说；轻声私语；发连续柔和的声音
items.def_en: 1. To speak or say something very softly and quietly. 2. To make a continuous low, gentle sound.
items.ex_en: The evening breeze seemed to murmur ancient secrets through the dark willow branches.
items.ex_zh: 晚风拂过幽暗的柳枝，仿佛在轻声倾诉着古老的秘密。

items.def_en: Speak so quietly that almost no one can hear, typically to express annoyance
items.ex_en: He turned away to mutter under his breath after the manager denied his request.
items.ex_zh: 经理拒绝他的请求后，他转过身去低声嘟囔着表示不满。

items.def_en: Speak in a continuous low whisper
items.ex_en: Conspirators lingered beside the palace fountain to whisper away in the fading twilight.
items.ex_zh: 密谋者们在宫殿喷泉旁盘桓，在日暮西山中低声私语不止。

items.def_en: mutter or complain persistently in a low, monotonous voice
items.ex_en: Grandpa sat in his armchair to chunter endlessly about the noisy neighborhood children.
items.ex_zh: 爷爷坐在扶手椅里，喋喋不休地抱怨着邻居家吵闹的孩子们。

items.def_zh: 咕哝，含糊其辞地说，喃喃自语
items.def_en: To speak or say something quietly and unclearly so that words are hard to understand.
items.ex_en: Nervous witnesses often mumble during cross-examination, making their crucial testimony difficult to transcribe.
items.ex_zh: 紧张的证人在交叉盘问时往往含糊其辞，使关键证词难以记录。

items.def_en: (+ about/to) To speak quietly in a low, unclear voice, especially when complaining or annoyed.
items.ex_en: The disgruntled employee began to mutter about unfair treatment during the meeting.
items.ex_zh: 心怀不满的员工在会议期间开始低声抱怨遭遇不公待遇。

items.def_en: [I/T] make a low, rough, involuntary sound expressing reluctant agreement or surly discontent
items.ex_en: The exhausted clerk could only grunt brief approval before stamping the arrival documents.
items.ex_zh: 疲倦的办事员只能含糊地低哼一声表示认可，随即在入境文件上盖了章。

groups.summary_en: Speakers utter words in low, indistinct, or breathy tones, ranging from secretive or tender confidences to irritated and indecipherable complaints.
groups.summary_zh: 以低沉、含糊或窃窃私语的方式说话，常带有不满或隐秘色彩。
groups.desc_en: Denotes phonating speech at very low volume without vocal cord vibration or with indistinct articulation, contrasting with clear, audible projection.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过气音或低音弱化发音、含混说话以防被他人听清，区别于清晰亮堂的高声宣明。
groups.nuance_en: whisper: speaking entirely on breath without vocal cord vibration (secrets / softly) · mutter: speaking indistinctly in low, often resentful tones (complaints / threats) · murmur: low, continuous, indistinct and gentle vocalization (prayers / assent) · mumble: dropping consonants and slurring words together (excuses / words) · breathe: uttering very softly as an intimate exhalation (words / promises)
groups.nuance_zh: whisper: 纯以气流无声带振动发出耳语 (secrets / softly) · mutter: 压低声音、往往带抱怨地低声咕哝 (complaints / threats) · murmur: 温柔连续而模糊的低吟私语 (prayers / assent) · mumble: 含糊吞字、咬字不清地嘟囔 (excuses / words) · breathe: 如同呼气般极为亲昵轻声吐露 (words / promises)

groups.name: Wield & Harness · 操控与驾驭 (Wield, Harness, Channel)
groups.tip: 掌控并发挥能量工具

items.def_en: (+ sth) To make active use of one's reserved abilities, power, or inner resources
items.ex_en: The embattled prime minister had to call upon hidden reserves of political strength.
items.ex_zh: 四面楚歌的首相不得不调用深藏的政治手腕与威信。

items.def_en: apply or bring into play a right, authority, or influence
items.ex_en: The regulatory agency refused to exercise its statutory authority over the financial sector.
items.ex_zh: 监管机构拒绝针对金融行业行使其法定监管权力。

items.def_en: (+ sth) To exert and direct one's power, influence, or pressure to achieve a desired outcome
items.ex_en: Diplomats must bring to bear considerable political leverage to secure the hostage release.
items.ex_zh: 外交官们必须施加巨大的政治影响力，以确保人质获释。

items.def_zh: 开发利用，驾驭（资源或潜能）
items.def_en: (+ sth) To harness, manage, and draw upon an available force, supply, or energy
items.ex_en: Engineers sought new methods to tap into vast geothermal reserves deep underground.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们寻找新方法以开发利用深埋于地底的巨大地热储量。

items.def_en: direct energy, resources, or emotion toward a specific purpose
items.ex_en: The coach urged young athletes to channel their intense frustration into productive practice.
items.ex_zh: 教练督促青年运动员们将强烈的挫败感转化为高效的训练动力。

items.def_zh: 控制并利用（自然力、资源等）；给（马等）套上挽具
items.def_en: 1. To control and make effective use of a natural force, energy source, or skill. 2. To put a harness onto a horse or working animal.
items.ex_en: Engineers built advanced turbines along the coastline to harness powerful oceanic tidal currents.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们沿着海岸线建造先进涡轮机，以有效驾驭强劲的海潮能量。

items.def_zh: 行使，运用（权力、影响等）；挥舞，操作（武器或工具）
items.def_en: 1. To possess and exercise great political power, authority, or influence. 2. To hold and use a weapon or tool skillfully.
items.ex_en: Authoritarian monarchs wield ultimate constitutional authority over domestic and foreign state policies.
items.ex_zh: 专制君主在国内及对外国家政策上行使着至高无上的宪法权力。

items.def_en: To use something—such as power, authority, funds, or medication—in the wrong way or for a dishonest purpose.
items.ex_en: Corrupt officials often misuse public funds designated for essential municipal infrastructure development.
items.ex_zh: 腐败官员常常滥用专用于基础市政设施建设的公共资金。

items.def_en: make full use of and derive benefit from a resource or opportunity
items.ex_en: The corporation seeks to exploit emerging artificial intelligence technologies for market dominance.
items.ex_zh: 该企业试图充分开发利用新兴的人工智能技术以主导市场。

groups.summary_en: An agent actively controls, directs, or exploits tools, power, authority, or natural forces, ranging from skillful mastery to deliberate abuse.
groups.summary_zh: 主动掌握、驾驭或运用工具、权力及自然资源，涵盖善用与滥用。
groups.desc_en: Denotes holding, directing, and executing authority, physical implements, or non-physical forces, contrasting with passive containment or uncontrolled release.
groups.desc_zh: 指执掌、调遣并有效运用器械、权威或潜能，区别于被动保有或失控外泄。
groups.nuance_en: wield: holding and effectively using authority or a tool (power / sword / influence) · harness: binding and systematically channeling energy or talent (resources / technology) · channel: directing energies or emotions toward a specific pathway (rage / creativity) · exercise: actively putting a right or power into practice (authority / discretion) · bring to bear: applying pressure or expertise deliberately to a problem (influence / leverage)
groups.nuance_zh: wield: 执掌并挥舞器械或掌控运用权力 (power / sword / influence) · harness: 驾驭并系统化调度能量或资源 (resources / technology) · channel: 引导精力或情感注入特定轨道 (rage / creativity) · exercise: 践行行使法定义务、权利或权柄 (authority / discretion) · bring to bear: 调集并集中施加压力或影响力 (influence / leverage)

groups.name: Work & Labor · 工作与劳作 (Toil, Labor, Drudge, Exert)
groups.tip: 辛勤工作与体力劳作

items.def_zh: 工作，劳作；运转，起作用；操作，经营；加工，塑造
items.def_en: 1. to exert physical or mental effort; do a job 2. to function, operate, or produce the desired effect 3. to shape, mold, or process a material
items.ex_en: Skilled artisans work raw clay patiently until it forms an exquisite porcelain vase.
items.ex_zh: 熟练的工匠耐心地加工粗陶土，直至其成为一只精美的瓷瓶。

items.def_zh: 做零工，打杂；分包（工作）；利用公职营私舞弊
items.def_en: 1. to do casual or odd jobs; work as a jobber 2. (formal) to use a public office or position for private or corrupt gain
items.ex_en: The minister was accused of attempting to job public contracts to corrupt associates.
items.ex_zh: 部长被指控企图利用公职营私舞弊，将公共合同分包给腐败同伙。

items.def_en: to do hard physical work or strive diligently under strain
items.ex_en: Miners continue to labor deep underground under hazardous and extremely hot conditions.
items.ex_zh: 矿工们继续在极度危险且炽热的环境中于地下深处辛苦劳作。

items.def_zh: 做苦工，像奴隶般拼命干活
items.def_en: (+ away/over) to work excessively hard under oppressive or thankless conditions
items.ex_en: Junior associates slave over endless audit documents without any real hope of promotion.
items.ex_zh: 初级助理在毫无晋升希望的情况下，拼命埋头处理没完没了的审计文件。

items.def_zh: 拼命苦干，当牛做马般劳作
items.def_en: (+ at sth) To work extremely hard and continuously for a long period of time
items.ex_en: The tired apprentice had to slave away at boring manual tasks all day.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的学徒不得不整天像奴隶般拼命干那些枯燥的体力活。

items.def_en: (+ at sth) To labor persistently and laboriously at a difficult or monotonous task
items.ex_en: She had to grind away at tedious spreadsheet data throughout the weekend.
items.ex_zh: 她整个周末都不得不埋头苦干，处理那些乏味的电子表格数据。

items.def_zh: 辛勤劳作，不辞劳苦地干
items.def_en: To perform exhausting, arduous physical or mental labor over an extended period
items.ex_en: Generations of forgotten peasants had to toil away upon the barren stony fields.
items.ex_zh: 数代被遗忘的贫苦农人只得在贫瘠多石的田地里终日辛勤劳作。

items.def_en: (+ away/at) to work extremely hard and continuously over long periods
items.ex_en: Generations of impoverished peasants had to toil under the harsh feudal landowner system.
items.ex_zh: 数代赤贫的佃农不得不在严苛的封建地主制度下艰难劳作。

items.def_zh: 干苦工，做繁重单调的工作
items.def_en: to perform dull, hard, or menial labor
items.ex_en: The poor scullery maid had to drudge through endless piles of dirty dishes.
items.ex_zh: 可怜的厨房女仆不得不整天干苦工，清洗堆积如山的肮脏碗碟。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote expending physical or mental effort to produce goods, perform tasks, or earn a livelihood. Registers range from everyday employment ('work', 'job') to strenuous, exhausting manual exertion ('labor', 'toil', 'drudge').
groups.summary_zh: 指从事体力或脑力劳动，涵盖从日常上班到极度艰辛劳役的语体与色彩。
groups.desc_en: Denotes expending sustained physical or mental effort toward production or task completion, contrasting with leisurely recreation or effortless execution.
groups.desc_zh: 指持续付出体力或脑力以完成任务与生产，区别于休闲娱乐或信手拈来。
groups.nuance_en: work: general purposeful mental or physical labor (job / hard) · toil: exhausting, arduous, unrelenting physical drudgery (in the fields / under the sun) · labor: formal or heavy sustained physical exertion (under difficult conditions / on a project) · slave: working excessively long hours under harsh, subjugated conditions (over a hot stove / for a master) · grind away: tedious, repetitive, dogged work over a long duration (at studies / at a desk)
groups.nuance_zh: work: 广义的劳作与履职 (job / hard) · toil: 筋疲力竭、汗流浃背的艰辛苦工 (in the fields / under the sun) · labor: 繁重的体力劳作或系统的工程劳动 (under difficult conditions / on a project) · slave: 像奴隶般受压榨超负荷拼命干活 (over a hot stove / for a master) · grind away: 枯燥单调、日复一日地伏案埋头苦熬 (at studies / at a desk)

groups.name: Wrap Closely & Encase · 密实包裹与贴身覆裹 (Envelop, Bard)
groups.tip: 层层裹紧或完全包覆

items.def_en: (+ sth) To cover an object completely and securely with paper, cloth, or protective material
items.ex_en: Let's wrap up this meeting so everyone can catch their flights.
items.ex_zh: 我们结束这次会议吧，这样大家都能赶上航班。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) To enclose and fasten an object or body part securely with tight bands or cloth
items.ex_en: The paramedic carefully bound up the deep wound to stem the bleeding.
items.ex_zh: 医护人员小心地包扎好深伤口以止血。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) To wrap a baby or limb tightly and closely in cloth or blankets
items.ex_en: The nurse helped swaddle up the shivering newborn infant in warm wool blankets.
items.ex_zh: 护士帮忙用温暖的羊毛毯将瑟瑟发抖的新生儿紧紧裹好。

items.def_en: (+ in/with) To cover, wrap, or surround someone or something completely.
items.ex_en: Dense morning fog began to envelop the quiet coastal harbor in total silence.
items.ex_zh: 清晨浓重的雾气开始将宁静的海港完全笼罩在死寂之中。

items.def_zh: 用寿衣包裹；将…完全笼罩遮蔽
items.def_en: to wrap a body in a winding sheet, or envelop something completely from sight
items.ex_en: The mourning relatives arrived at dawn to shroud the fallen warrior in silk.
items.ex_zh: 哀悼的亲属在拂晓赶来，用丝绸包裹阵亡勇士的遗体。

items.def_zh: （烹饪前在瘦肉上）裹上一层肥肉（或培根）
items.def_en: (cooking) To cover or wrap lean meat with slices of bacon or fat before roasting to keep it moist.
items.ex_en: The chef chose to bard the lean venison roast with strips of fatback.
items.ex_zh: 厨师选择在精瘦的鹿肉烤块表面裹上一层肥猪肉片以保持多汁。

items.def_en: (+ in/with) to wrap, bind, or swaddle someone or something thoroughly in folds of material
items.ex_en: The medics hastened to swathe the injured limbs with thick clean linen bandages.
items.ex_zh: 医护人员赶紧用厚实干净的亚麻绷带把伤肢紧紧包扎裹好。

items.def_zh: （用布料）紧紧裹住（婴儿或伤处）
items.def_en: to wrap someone, especially a baby, tightly in cloths or blankets
items.ex_en: Mothers traditionally swaddle their newborn infants to provide warmth and comforting physical security.
items.ex_zh: 母亲们传统上会用布料紧紧裹住新生儿，以提供温暖与抚慰人心的安全感。

items.def_en: to wrap up, surround, or encompass someone affectionately or closely
items.ex_en: The weeping mother rushed forward to enfold her returning soldier in a embrace.
items.ex_zh: 泣不成声的母亲冲上前去，将归来的军人孩子紧紧抱入怀中。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on completely surrounding or binding an object in a protective or culinary outer layer, such as shrouding a form entirely or strapping fat/bacon onto meat.
groups.summary_zh: 紧密贴合地裹住某物，或在烹饪中以肥肉片紧缚肉块以防干焦。
groups.desc_en: Denotes binding or covering something tightly with flexible material to insulate, secure, or hide it, contrasting with loose draping or exposing.
groups.desc_zh: 指使用柔性覆盖物将物体紧紧包扎、封裹或遮蔽，区别于松散搭挂或暴露在外。
groups.nuance_en: envelop: completely enclosing from all sides in a soft shroud (in mist / in warmth) · swaddle: wrapping an infant tightly with cloths to restrict movement (infants / newborns) · swathe: winding or binding heavily in broad layers of fabric (in bandages / in silk) · shroud: screening, veiling, or covering in a funerary or obscuring wrap (in secrecy / corpses) · bard: tying strips of fat around meat before roasting (meat / poultry)
groups.nuance_zh: envelop: 四面八方完全密闭覆裹或笼罩 (in mist / in warmth) · swaddle: 用布帛紧裹婴儿以限制活动防惊跳 (infants / newborns) · swathe: 用宽幅布帛或绷带重重包扎 (in bandages / in silk) · shroud: 覆以寿衣遮盖尸体或将事物隐匿 (in secrecy / corpses) · bard: 烹饪前在肉块外贴裹肥肉片 (meat / poultry)

groups.name: Yield to Rules & Authority · 遵从与依从 (Obey, Comply)
groups.tip: 遵照指示或规则行事

items.def_en: to accept and act in accordance with a decision, law, or agreement
items.ex_en: All contracting parties agreed to abide by the formal ruling of the tribunal.
items.ex_zh: 所有签约方均同意信守并严格遵从仲裁法庭的正式裁决。

items.def_zh: 严守；坚持遵循（准则、规章）
items.def_en: to strictly observe or act in agreement with a principle, rule, or guideline
items.ex_en: Medical researchers must strictly adhere to international ethical guidelines throughout the clinical trial.
items.ex_zh: 医学研究人员在整个临床试验过程中必须严格遵循国际伦理准则。

items.def_zh: 顺从，赞同并遵从（规矩或建议）
items.def_en: (+ sth) To accept, agree with, and conform one's actions to rules, plans, or decisions
items.ex_en: The committee members chose to fall in with the proposed company policy changes.
items.ex_zh: 委员会成员们选择顺从并接受公司提出的政策调整方案。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) To give way to authoritative demands, legal pressure, or established rules
items.ex_en: The minister refused to yield to public pressure and stood firmly by the policy.
items.ex_zh: 该部长拒绝向公众压力低头，坚定地支持这项政策。

items.def_zh: 顺从，遵从（上级旨意或规定）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) To submit to the authority, rule, or overwhelming judgment of others
items.ex_en: The government eventually bowed to public pressure and cancelled the controversial tax.
items.ex_zh: 政府最终屈服于公众压力，取消了这项有争议的税收。

items.def_zh: 遵从，顺从，服从（规则、法律或要求）
items.def_en: To act in accordance with a wish, command, rule, or requirement.
items.ex_en: All chemical manufacturers must strictly comply with mandatory federal industrial safety regulations.
items.ex_zh: 所有化工制造商都必须严格遵守联邦强制性工业安全生产法规。

items.def_en: To do what you are told to do by a person, rule, or law.
items.ex_en: Every enlisted soldier must strictly obey the direct orders given by senior commanders.
items.ex_zh: 每一名入伍士兵都必须严格服从高级指挥官下达的直接指令。

items.def_en: (+ to/with) to behave according to established rules, social customs, or standards
items.ex_en: Architectural blueprints must conform to strict municipal earthquake safety codes before construction starts.
items.ex_zh: 建筑蓝图在开工前必须严格符合市政抗震安全规范。

items.def_zh: 遵从；服从（权威或他人意见）
items.def_en: (+ to) to yield respectfully to the opinion, wish, or judgment of another person
items.ex_en: Young attorneys typically defer to the senior partner during complex courtroom litigation proceedings.
items.ex_zh: 在复杂的法庭诉讼程序中，年轻律师通常会尊重并遵从资深合伙人的意见。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe conforming one's actions to explicit commands, regulations, legal standards, or authoritative requests, ranging from direct submission to institutional adherence.
groups.summary_zh: 遵守规章制度、指令或权威要求，按标准行事或顺从他人指示。
groups.desc_en: Denotes conforming one's actions to established rules, directives, or external dominance, contrasting with defiance, rebellion, or unilateral autonomy.
groups.desc_zh: 指个人的意志与行径顺应既定规则、法度或外部权威，区别于违抗背叛或独断自主。
groups.nuance_en: obey: direct submission to an order or authority figure (orders / commands) · comply: passive or formal adherence to external criteria or requests (with regulations / with standards) · conform: adjusting behavior to match normative group conventions (to expectations / to standards) · abide by: steadfastly accepting and upholding a ruling or agreement (rules / decisions) · bow to: reluctantly conceding under superior force or pressure (pressure / the inevitable)
groups.nuance_zh: obey: 直接听从、顺从指令或长官权威 (orders / commands) · comply: 循规蹈矩、合乎外部规章要求 (with regulations / with standards) · conform: 遵从群体惯例以求合群一致 (to expectations / to standards) · abide by: 恪守、甘受裁决或约定的约束 (rules / decisions) · bow to: 在强压或大势所趋下被迫低头屈服 (pressure / the inevitable)

groups.name: Abolish & Annul by Authority · 官方废止与撤销 (Repeal, Annul, Nullify)
groups.tip: 正式宣布旧法或契约作废

items.def_zh: 废除，取消（法律、惯例或制度）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Abolish or get rid of a legal rule, custom, or institution
items.ex_en: The legislature finally voted to do away with the archaic trade tariff system.
items.ex_zh: 立法机构最终投票决定废除这项陈旧落后的贸易关税制度。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Declare a law, statute, or regulation invalid by official judicial decision
items.ex_en: The appellate court voted to strike down the unconstitutional municipal surveillance ordinance yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 上诉法院昨日裁决判决废止这项违宪的市政监控法令。

items.def_zh: 宣布……无效，作废，废止；排泄，排出（大小便等）
items.def_en: 1. (law) To officially declare that a contract, document, or election is invalid and has no legal force. 2. (formal/medicine) To discharge or empty urine or feces from the body.
items.ex_en: The judicial panel decided to void the tainted commercial contract due to fraud.
items.ex_zh: 司法审判小组鉴于存在欺诈行为，决定宣布该违规商业合同无效。

items.def_en: (law/politics) (of a government or parliament) To officially cancel or revoke a law so that it is no longer valid.
items.ex_en: Parliament voted overwhelmingly to repeal the obsolete maritime trade tariffs enacted last century.
items.ex_zh: 议会以压倒性多数投票通过废除上世纪颁布的过时海运关税法案。

items.def_en: to formally put an end to an established system, practice, or institution
items.ex_en: The newly elected democratic government resolved to abolish cruel colonial penal codes immediately.
items.ex_zh: 新当选的民主政府决意立即废除残酷的殖民时期刑法体系。

items.def_en: to make a law, agreement, or decision legally void and without binding force
items.ex_en: Procedural irregularities during the trial served to nullify the previous guilty verdict rendered.
items.ex_zh: 审理过程中的程序性违规使得先前作出的有罪判决在法律上宣告无效。

items.def_zh: 宣布（婚姻、契约、法律等）无效，废除，取消
items.def_en: (law) To officially state that a marriage, contract, law, or decision is invalid and has no legal effect.
items.ex_en: The high court had legal authority to annul the fraudulently executed land treaty.
items.ex_zh: 最高法院拥有法定权力，宣布这一通过欺诈手段签署的土地条约作废。

items.def_en: to officially end a legal agreement, treaty, or law through authoritative decree
items.ex_en: The authoritarian regime chose to abrogate the international peace treaty without prior notice.
items.ex_zh: 该专制政权未提前通知便擅自决定废除这一国际和平条约。

groups.summary_en: Formal legal verbs meaning to formally abolish, declare non-binding, or eradicate a statute, treaty, custom, or established institution.
groups.summary_zh: 官方或法律层面正式废除法律、条约或制度，使其失去法律效力。
groups.desc_en: Denotes formally declaring an existing law, treaty, or decree completely dead and without legal force, contrasting with suspending or amending it.
groups.desc_zh: 指由法定权力机构正式撤销、废止法律法令或契约效力，区别于暂缓或修订。
groups.nuance_en: repeal: parliamentary revocation of an established statute (legislation / acts) · abolish: completely ending an institution or archaic practice by law (slavery / taxes) · annul: declaring an agreement retroactively void as if it never existed (marriages / contracts) · strike down: judicial invalidation of an unconstitutional measure (laws / bans) · abrogate: formal or unilateral repudiation of a treaty or constitutional principle (treaties / rights)
groups.nuance_zh: repeal: 立法机关正式通过法案废止法令 (legislation / acts) · abolish: 通过法律制度彻底废除旧制或陋习 (slavery / taxes) · annul: 宣告法律关系自始无效 (marriages / contracts) · strike down: 司法机关裁定违宪而予以驳回无效化 (laws / bans) · abrogate: 官方或单方面正式废止条约或宪法权利 (treaties / rights)

groups.name: Absolve & Acquit · 赦免与雪冤 (Absolve, Exonerate, Acquit)
groups.tip: 司法判决或良心上赦免罪责

items.def_en: (+ of) to prove that someone is innocent of a crime, mistake, or misconduct
items.ex_en: New surveillance footage helped clear the innocent suspect of armed robbery charges completely.
items.ex_zh: 全新的监控录像帮助这名无辜的嫌疑人彻底洗清了持械抢劫的罪名。
items.ex2_en: Her good name cleared completely once the missing financial documents were discovered.
items.ex2_zh: 一旦找到遗失的财务文件，她的清白便彻底恢复了。

items.def_en: (+ sb) Decide not to punish sb for an offense or give them a very light penalty
items.ex_en: The sympathetic judge decided to let off the young first-time offender with community service.
items.ex_zh: 心怀同情的法官决定从宽放过这名初犯青年，仅处以社区服务。

items.def_en: (let sb off the hook) Free sb from blame, guilt, obligation, or punishment
items.ex_en: The unexpected discovery of alibi evidence finally let him off the hook entirely.
items.ex_zh: 不在场证明的意外发现，终于让他彻底摆脱了重大犯罪嫌疑。

items.def_en: to officially allow someone who has been convicted of a crime to go free without legal punishment
items.ex_en: The outgoing governor decided to pardon several nonviolent offenders before leaving public office.
items.ex_zh: 即将卸任的州长决定在离职前特赦数名非暴力罪犯。

items.def_en: (+ of) to officially decide and state in a court of law that someone is not guilty of a crime
items.ex_en: A unanimous jury voted to acquit the accused executive of federal fraud charges.
items.ex_zh: 陪审团一致投票决定宣判被指控的高管在联邦欺诈罪名上无罪。

items.def_en: to prove that someone is not guilty or that someone was right after doubts or accusations
items.ex_en: Subsequent scientific investigations served to vindicate the whistleblower after months of harsh criticism.
items.ex_zh: 数月严厉指责之后，后续的科学调查终于证实了这名举报人的清白与正确。

items.def_zh: 赦免，免除（责任、罪过）；宣告……无罪
items.def_en: (formal) To state officially that someone is free from guilt, blame, or sin, or to release someone from a duty or obligation.
items.ex_en: The ecclesiastical tribunal voted to absolve the penitent monk of his spiritual transgressions.
items.ex_zh: 教会裁判所投票决定赦免这位忏悔修士所犯下的宗教过错。

items.def_zh: 免除（责任）；宣布……无罪，证明……清白
items.def_en: (formal / law) To officially pronounce someone free from guilt, blame, or legal responsibility for a crime or mistake.
items.ex_en: DNA analysis served to exonerate the wrongfully convicted prisoner after two long decades.
items.ex_zh: DNA分析结果证实了这名被误判入狱长达二十年的囚犯的清白。

groups.summary_en: Legal or moral authorities relieve a person from guilt, accusation, or liability. Verbs distinguish between verdict-based legal discharge ('acquit'), comprehensive clearance from culpability ('exonerate'), and moral or spiritual forgiveness ('absolve', 'pardon').
groups.summary_zh: 官方或道德权威免除当事人的过错、指控或罪责，涉及法庭无罪判决与道德赦免。
groups.desc_en: Denotes clearing an accused individual of legal guilt, moral blameworthiness, or suspicion, contrasting with convicting, punishing, or remaining under cloud.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过司法审判或事实昭雪洗清当事人的罪责与道德污点，区别于定罪受罚或含冤受嫌。
groups.nuance_en: acquit: formal judicial verdict of not guilty (defendants / suspects) · exonerate: clearing completely from official blame or accusation based on facts (officers / suspects) · absolve: releasing from moral, religious, or formal culpability (sinners / of guilt) · vindicate: clearing reputation and validating actions through subsequent proof (decisions / names) · pardon: executive forgiveness of criminal punishment despite guilt (convicts / offenses)
groups.nuance_zh: acquit: 法院正式裁决无罪 (defendants / suspects) · exonerate: 根据调查证据彻底洗清渎职或罪责嫌疑 (officers / suspects) · absolve: 宗教或道德上宽恕免罪 (sinners / of guilt) · vindicate: 借由后续事实证实当初之举正确并恢复名誉 (decisions / names) · pardon: 执政长官特赦减免其刑事刑罚 (convicts / offenses)

groups.name: Absorb & Resorb · 吸收与再吸收 (Absorb, Resorb, Reabsorb)
groups.tip: 生物体再吸收摄入物质

items.def_en: To take in a liquid or other substance gradually from the surface or through pores/membranes
