items.def_zh: 派给……任务，向……指派工作；使辛劳，使劳累
items.def_en: 1. To give someone a specific task or responsibility. 2. To put a heavy strain on someone; burden.
items.ex_en: The director tasked the investigative team with reviewing five years of suspicious financial transactions.
items.ex_zh: 署长指派调查小组审查过去五年的可疑财务交易记录。

items.def_zh: 分派，布置（任务）；指派，选派；分配；归因于
items.def_en: 1. To give someone a particular job, task, or responsibility. 2. To allocate or designate something for a specific purpose. 3. (+ to) To ascribe or attribute something to.
items.ex_en: The biology teacher will assign a comprehensive research project to each lab partner group.
items.ex_zh: 生物老师将给每个实验搭档小组分派一项综合性研究课题。

items.def_en: (+ among/between) to divide work, blame, or resources according to a measured plan
items.ex_en: The tribunal had to apportion liability equally between the two shipping companies involved in the collision.
items.ex_zh: 仲裁庭必须在卷入相撞事故的两家航运公司之间按比例分摊民事赔偿责任。

groups.summary_en: An authoritative figure or administrative system designates duties, roles, or portions of resources to particular individuals, groups, or objectives.
groups.summary_zh: 主管机关或管理者将特定职责、任务指令或资源配额分派给对应人员或用途。
groups.desc_en: To distribute duties, shares, or resources according to an authoritative plan, contrasting with casual giving by its deliberate, functional dispensation.
groups.desc_zh: 指依据权威规划将职责、配额或资源分派给特定对象，与随意施予不同，它强调按职能或定额进行的规范化处置。
groups.nuance_en: allocate: officially set aside funds or physical resources for a specific purpose (budget / resource / spectrum) · assign: designate a duty, role, or task to a specific person (task / role / homework) · allot: parcel out shares or portions from a finite supply (time / quota / share) · delegate: entrust authority or task downward to a subordinate (authority / responsibility / power) · task: explicitly charge someone with accomplishing a mission (team / soldier / unit)
groups.nuance_zh: allocate: 官方划拨专款或特定资源 (budget / resource / spectrum) · assign: 指定人员承担具体任务或身份 (task / role / homework) · allot: 从有限总额中按比例定额分配 (time / quota / share) · delegate: 向上放下权力或事务性职责 (authority / responsibility / power) · task: 赋予某人或组织明确行动指令 (team / soldier / unit)

groups.name: Assimilate & Internalize Information · 领悟与内化吸收 (Assimilate, Internalize)
groups.tip: 彻底吸收转化为自身知识

items.def_en: to take in and understand information, facts, or ideas comprehensively
items.ex_en: The new syllabus was designed to help students absorb complex scientific concepts more easily.
items.ex_zh: 新教学大纲旨在帮助学生更轻松地吸收和理解复杂的科学概念。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to absorb facts, ideas, or impressions eagerly and easily into one's mind
items.ex_en: Enthusiastic young apprentices eagerly soak up practical wisdom from experienced mentors in the workshop.
items.ex_zh: 热情的年轻学徒在车间里如饥似渴地汲取经验丰富的导师传授的实践智慧。

items.def_zh: 领悟；消化吸收（知识或信息）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to fully understand, absorb, and mentally assimilate information
items.ex_en: The tragic news was so shocking that she could barely take in what happened.
items.ex_zh: 这则悲惨的消息太令人震惊，以至于她一时难以消化吸收发生了什么。

items.def_en: to reflect upon and thoroughly master complex concepts over time
items.ex_en: It took several weeks of quiet study to digest the philosopher’s dense metaphysical arguments.
items.ex_zh: 他经过数周静心研读，才彻底消化领会了那位哲学家晦涩深奥的形而上学论点。

items.def_zh: 吸收，充分理解，内化（知识、思想）；（使）同化，融入
items.def_en: 1. to fully understand and absorb ideas or information. 2. to integrate or cause to integrate into a wider society or culture.
items.ex_en: Bright doctoral candidates must assimilate voluminous academic literature before formulating an original dissertation hypothesis.
items.ex_zh: 聪颖的博士生在提出独创的论文假设之前，必须充分消化吸收大量的学术文献。
items.ex2_en: Complex philosophical theories rarely assimilate easily into popular cultural consciousness.
items.ex2_zh: 复杂的哲学理论很少能轻易融入大众文化意识之中。

items.def_zh: 使内化，将……吸收为自身观念（或信仰）
items.def_en: to accept and absorb an idea, attitude, or belief so deeply that it becomes part of one's own character or thinking.
items.ex_en: Through years of rigorous training, soldiers internalize a profound sense of duty and discipline.
items.ex_zh: 通过多年的严格训练，士兵们将深切的责任感和纪律性内化为自身本能。

items.def_zh: 被完全理解；逐渐深入人心
items.def_en: to become completely understood and internalised over time, especially painful or profound news
items.ex_en: The reality of what happened took several days to sink in.
items.ex_zh: 过了好几天，大家才真正领会所发生事情的严重性。

items.def_en: to firmly establish habits, attitudes, or beliefs so deeply that they are hard to alter
items.ex_en: Strict early childhood guidance helped ingrain fundamental principles of honesty and empathy in her.
items.ex_zh: 严格的幼年教导帮助她在内心深处深深印刻下诚实与同理心的基本原则。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame scale in cognitive and psychological depth from initial conceptual integration of ideas into one's knowledge base to deeply embedding cultural values and morals into one's unconscious mindset.
groups.summary_zh: 指认知吸收深度的递进，从理解并吸收概念到思想观念的完全内化。
groups.desc_en: To take external knowledge, culture, or experiences deeply into the cognitive architecture, moving beyond superficial hearing to full mental integration.
groups.desc_zh: 指将外界知识、文化或经验深层吸纳入认知体系，与浅层听闻不同，它强调认知结构的重塑与融会贯通。
groups.nuance_en: absorb: take in and retain information gradually and effortlessly (knowledge / fact / atmosphere) · digest: mentally process and break down complex material over time (information / report / news) · assimilate: fully integrate new concepts or cultural norms into an existing framework (culture / data / idea) · internalize: incorporate values, beliefs, or patterns into one's deep subconscious psyche (norm / value / bias) · ingrain: fix firmly and indelibly into the mind or habits (habit / prejudice / value)
groups.nuance_zh: absorb: 逐步且自然地汲取吸收信息 (knowledge / fact / atmosphere) · digest: 经由思索消化理清复杂材料 (information / report / news) · assimilate: 将新知识或文化彻底同化吸纳 (culture / data / idea) · internalize: 将外在规范与价值观内化为内在信念 (norm / value / bias) · ingrain: 使思维习惯或偏见根深蒂固 (habit / prejudice / value)

groups.name: Astonish & Stun · 错愕与惊愕 (Astonish, Stun, Daze)
groups.tip: 突发意外让人目瞪口呆、思维停滞

items.def_en: to shock or surprise someone by moving suddenly or making a sudden noise
items.ex_en: The sudden loud bang of the car backfiring served to startle the timid pedestrian.
items.ex_zh: 汽车回火突然发出的一声巨响，吓得那位胆小的行人浑身一颤。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to shock, surprise, or disconcert someone unexpectedly (usually passive)
items.ex_en: I was taken aback by how bluntly she criticized the proposal.
items.ex_zh: 她对提案批评得如此直白，令我深感震惊。

items.def_zh: 使大为震撼；令…目瞪口呆
items.def_en: (+ sb) to overwhelm someone with immense surprise, shock, or admiration
items.ex_en: The breathtaking visual effects in the new sci-fi blockbuster will completely blow away audiences.
items.ex_zh: 这部新科幻大片中令人叹为观止的视觉特效定会让观众大为震撼。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to astound or strike someone with overwhelming amazement or disbelief
items.ex_en: Our team was knocked out of the tournament in the quarter-finals.
items.ex_zh: 我们队在四分之一决赛中被淘汰出局。

items.def_zh: 使震惊，使目瞪口呆；打晕，使昏迷
items.def_en: 1. To shock or surprise someone so much that they cannot react immediately. 2. To knock someone unconscious or senseless with a blow.
items.ex_en: The sudden announcement of the CEO's abrupt resignation seemed to stun the entire boardroom.
items.ex_zh: 首席执行官突然辞职的意外消息似乎让整个董事会成员目瞪口呆。

items.raw_cluster: 使震惊与惊讶 Surprise & Astonish
items.def_zh: 使十分惊讶，使大吃一惊
items.def_en: 1. To surprise or shock someone very greatly.
items.ex_en: The astonishing discovery of an ancient subterranean palace never ceased to astonish the archaeologists.
items.ex_zh: 这座古老地下宫殿的惊人发现，令考古学家们始终感到无比震惊。

items.def_en: to astonish someone so severely that they are temporarily speechless
items.ex_en: The witness's sudden confession was extraordinary enough to dumbfound the prosecutor and the defense alike.
items.ex_zh: 证人的突然招供异乎寻常，足以让检方和辩方同时惊得瞠目结舌。

items.def_zh: 使目瞪口呆；使大吃一惊
items.def_en: to surprise or shock someone intensely so that they do not know what to say
items.ex_en: Her unexpected promotion over senior colleagues managed to flabbergast everyone working in the department.
items.ex_zh: 她越过资深同事破格获得提拔，着实让该部门的所有人都目瞪口呆。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote striking someone with sudden disbelief, intellectual shock, or cognitive numbness due to something completely unexpected.
groups.summary_zh: 因完全出乎意料而使人震惊、发呆或暂时无法思考。
groups.desc_en: To overwhelm someone with unexpectedness or grandeur so intensely that it causes temporary mental paralysis, differing from mild surprise by the severity of the cognitive shock.
groups.desc_zh: 指因事物出人意料或极其震撼而导致短时间思维停滞，与轻度惊讶不同，它侧重认知冲击带来的错愕与呆滞。
groups.nuance_en: startle: cause a sudden involuntary physical or mental jolt (horse / passerby / sleeper) · stun: render speechless, numb, or mentally immobilized (audience / spectator / critic) · astonish: strike with great wonder through exceptional or improbable occurrences (crowd / scholar / friend) · flabbergast: leave utterly helpless with astonishment or disbelief (public / parent / official) · dumbfound: strike mute with confusion or amazement (critic / detective / observer)
groups.nuance_zh: startle: 使人因突发刺激而猛然受惊一战 (horse / passerby / sleeper) · stun: 产生强烈震慑使人陷入麻木呆滞 (audience / spectator / critic) · astonish: 因罕见或非凡之事令人惊异 (crowd / scholar / friend) · flabbergast: 令人瞠目结舌、难以置信 (public / parent / official) · dumbfound: 惊得目瞪口呆而说不出话 (critic / detective / observer)

groups.name: Astound & Appal · 骇异与惊骇 (Astound, Appal, Horrify)
groups.tip: 惊骇万分令人难以置信

items.def_zh: 使毛骨悚然；令人骇然恐惧
items.def_en: (+ sb) to cause someone to feel uneasy, frightened, or horrified
items.ex_en: The way that abandoned house looks at dusk really creeps me out.
items.ex_zh: 那栋废弃房屋在黄昏时的模样真让我心里发毛。

items.def_en: to cause someone to feel extreme surprise, bewilderment, or disbelief
items.ex_en: The sheer scale of the accounting fraud will stagger regulatory investigators across the country.
items.ex_zh: 这桩财务造假规模之大，足以令全国各地的监管调查人员难以置信。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to become extremely agitated, terrified, or appalled, or cause someone to do so
items.ex_en: Seeing a venomous snake slide across the tent floor caused the camper to freak out.
items.ex_zh: 看到一条毒蛇滑过帐篷地面，吓得那个露营者惊骇失措。
items.ex2_en: That sudden loud thunderclap freaked out every nervous pet in the neighborhood.
items.ex2_zh: 那声突如其来的巨响雷鸣吓坏了附近所有神经质的宠物。

items.def_zh: 使恶心骇然；使极其反感
items.def_en: (+ sb) to disgust or horrify someone deeply with something offensive or repulsive
items.ex_en: The sight of maggots crawling in the rotten meat was enough to gross out everyone.
items.ex_zh: 看到蛆虫在腐肉中蠕动，足以让在场的每一个人都感到恶心反感。

items.def_zh: 使恐惧；使极度震惊愤慨
items.def_en: to shock and dishearten someone by being extremely bad, offensive, or gruesome
items.ex_en: The graphic photographs depicting the battlefield carnage will horrify anyone who views them closely.
items.ex_zh: 描绘战场惨烈屠杀的写实照片会让每一个仔细端详它们的人感到毛骨悚然。

items.def_en: 1. (US appall) To shock, horrify, or disgust someone deeply.
items.ex_en: The deplorable conditions within the overcrowded shelter will appal any civilized human rights advocate.
items.ex_zh: 过度拥挤的庇护所内恶劣至极的环境，令任何文明的人权倡导者都深感惊骇。

items.def_en: 1. To shock or greatly amaze someone, leaving them stunned or bewildered.
items.ex_en: The sheer computational power of the quantum processor never fails to astound experienced computer engineers.
items.ex_zh: 该量子处理器的强悍算力总能让经验丰富的计算机工程师们惊叹震骇。

items.def_en: to frighten or shock someone so intensely that they are unable to move or speak
items.ex_en: The shrill scream echoing through the dark catacombs seemed to petrify the weary explorers.
items.ex_zh: 回荡在阴暗地下墓穴中的尖锐惨叫，仿佛把疲惫的探险家们吓得僵死在原地。
items.ex2_en: Ancient organic matter can petrify gradually into stone under immense geological pressure.
items.ex2_zh: 在巨大的地质压力下，古代有机物可以逐渐石化成石头。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe overwhelming someone with profound shock combined with intense disbelief, dismay, moral outrage, or deep dread.
groups.summary_zh: 极大震惊并伴随强烈的难以置信、道德反感或骇怕。
groups.desc_en: To shock deeply with moral revulsion, horror, or dread, distinguishing itself from intellectual astonishment by the visceral presence of disgust and fear.
groups.desc_zh: 指因极端的道德沦丧或骇人惨象而引发剧烈心理惊骇与反感，与智识上的惊叹不同，它带有强烈的生理厌恶与恐惧色彩。
groups.nuance_en: appal: shock profoundly by overcoming standards of decency, justice, or quality (behavior / atrocity / condition) · horrify: fill with extreme fear, dread, or moral disgust (witness / public / family) · petrify: paralyze with intense, freezing terror (victim / child / audience) · stagger: unnerve or overwhelm deeply with the sheer scale of horror or misfortune (imagination / belief / observer) · freak out: induce an uncontrolled state of acute panic or revulsion (passenger / roommate / fan)
groups.nuance_zh: appal: 践踏道德或常理底线令人触目惊心 (behavior / atrocity / condition) · horrify: 引发极度的毛骨悚然与道义厌恶 (witness / public / family) · petrify: 吓得魂飞魄散、僵在原地 (victim / child / audience) · stagger: 灾难或恶行的规模之大令人难以招架 (imagination / belief / observer) · freak out: 极度惊慌失措或神经崩溃 (passenger / roommate / fan)

groups.name: Attract & Captivate · 吸引与迷住 (Allure, Mesmerize, Captivate)
groups.tip: 散发魅力令人心神荡漾着迷

items.def_en: (+ sb) to attract someone powerful sensory attention and make them involved or captivated
items.ex_en: The charismatic storyteller used vivid imagery to draw in the curious crowd gathered outside.
items.ex_zh: 富有魅力的讲故事者运用生动的意象，将聚集在门外好奇的人群吸引了过来。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to attract crowds, interest, or attention on a large scale
items.ex_en: The annual international jazz festival continues to pull in huge tourist crowds every single summer.
items.ex_zh: 一年一度的国际爵士音乐节每年夏天都能持续吸引大批游客慕名前来。

items.def_zh: 迷住，吸引……的全部注意力
items.def_en: To attract and hold the interest and charm of someone intensely
items.ex_en: Her expressive musical performance never failed to captivate the demanding concert audience from start to finish.
items.ex_zh: 她富有表现力的音乐演奏自始至终都能深深吸引挑剔的音乐厅观众。

items.def_zh: 深深迷住；使无法自拔地卷入
items.def_en: (+ sb) to irresistibly captivate or draw someone into a situation or emotional state
items.ex_en: He didn't want any drama, but he was inevitably sucked in.
items.ex_zh: 他本不想惹是生非，却不可避免地被卷了进去。

items.def_en: (literary) to powerfully attract, tempt, or charm someone
items.ex_en: The whisper of ancient gold and mythical glory continued to allure intrepid wanderers eastward.
items.ex_zh: 古老黄金与神话荣耀的传闻，继续诱惑着无畏的流浪者踏上东方征程。

items.def_en: to hold someone's attention completely; to fascinate or entrance someone as if by hypnosis
items.ex_en: The fluid movements of the classical dancer seemed to mesmerize spectators across the auditorium.
items.ex_zh: 古典舞者行云流水般的动作，宛如施了催眠术般迷住了剧场里的所有观众。

items.def_en: To capture the fascinated attention of someone entirely, as if under a spell
items.ex_en: The dramatic sea cliffs and wild coastal landscapes enthrall every traveler visiting the remote islands.
items.ex_zh: 壮丽的海边峭壁与原始的海岸风光，使每一位造访这座偏远岛屿的旅人深深陶醉。

items.def_zh: 用符咒般的力量迷住，使呆若木鸡
items.def_en: To hold the complete attention of someone as if by magic; entrance
items.ex_en: Her enchanting soprano voice had an uncanny power to spellbind listeners into absolute silence.
items.ex_zh: 她那空灵迷人的女高音似乎拥有一种不可思议的魔力，让听众听得如痴如醉、全场肃静。

groups.summary_en: A person, object, or phenomenon exerts powerful gravitational pull over someone's sensory or emotional attention. Progression scales from subtle seductive attraction ('allure') to captivating engagement ('captivate') up to total, hypnotic immobilization ('mesmerize', 'spellbind').
groups.summary_zh: 通过魅力、美感或神秘感完全抓住对方的注意力和情感，使其深陷其中。
groups.desc_en: To exert an irresistible sensory or psychological pull over an agent's attention, contrasted with gentle appealing by its hypnotic, arresting intensity.
groups.desc_zh: 指对人的感官或心理施加无可抗拒的磁吸力，与温和的引起兴趣不同，它侧重催眠般、勾魂摄魄的专注与俘获。
groups.nuance_en: captivate: hold attention completely through charm, beauty, or wit (audience / reader / crowd) · allure: entice and draw in through seductive, often deceptive promises (investor / traveler / customer) · mesmerize: hold in a spellbound, almost hypnotic trance (spectator / onlooker / listener) · enthrall: hold completely spellbound as if under an enchanting power (viewer / child / reader) · spellbind: hold motionless and silent purely by magnetic performance (crowd / gathering / assembly)
groups.nuance_zh: captivate: 凭借魅力、才学或美感牢牢俘获 (audience / reader / crowd) · allure: 以诱人或带有诱饵的承诺诱引 (investor / traveler / customer) · mesmerize: 如施催眠术般使人痴迷入神 (spectator / onlooker / listener) · enthrall: 令人心驰神往、彻底被吸引 (viewer / child / reader) · spellbind: 以极具张力的表现使人屏息定格 (crowd / gathering / assembly)

groups.name: Attribute & Impute · 归因与归属 (Attribute, Ascribe, Impute)
groups.tip: 将事由归结于特定缘故

items.def_en: (+ sth to sth) allocate or attribute a particular value, origin, or cause to something
items.ex_en: Archaeologists cautiously assign the ancient clay pottery to the late Bronze Age.
items.ex_zh: 考古学家谨慎地将这件古代陶器归属于青铜时代晚期。

items.def_zh: 把……归因于，归咎于；认为……具有（某种品质）
items.def_en: (attribute something to) To say or believe that something is the result of a particular thing; to consider someone to have a particular quality.
items.ex_en: The financial analysts attribute the market rally to unexpectedly strong corporate earnings.
items.ex_zh: 金融分析师们将市场的强劲反弹归因于好于预期的企业财报。

items.def_en: (+ sth to sth) explain the reason for something as being caused by a particular factor
items.ex_en: Let's chalk our team's embarrassing defeat up to poor communication and fatigue.
items.ex_zh: 我们还是把团队这场难堪的败局归咎于沟通不畅和疲劳吧。

items.def_en: (+ sth to sth) to explain something by assigning it to a particular cause or origin
items.ex_en: She decided to put his irritable outburst down to intense work-related stress.
items.ex_zh: 她决定把他的发脾气归因于工作带来的巨大压力。

items.def_en: (+ sth on sb) to assign the blame or responsibility for something bad onto someone
items.ex_en: You cannot simply pin the entire budget shortfall on the junior accountant.
items.ex_zh: 你不能随随便便把整个预算短缺的过错全推到初级会计头上。

items.def_en: (+ sth to sth) to attribute the ultimate origin, cause, or source of something to a past event
items.ex_en: The tradition can be traced back to the medieval period.
items.ex_zh: 这一传统可以追溯到中世纪时期。

items.def_zh: 把……归因于，归咎于；认为……属于
items.def_en: (formal) (ascribe something to) To consider that something is caused by a particular person or thing, or to believe that a work was created by someone.
items.ex_en: Historians firmly ascribe this anonymous revolutionary tract to an obscure provincial printer.
items.ex_zh: 历史学家们断定这篇匿名革命传单出自一位不出名的地方印刷商之手。

items.def_zh: 归咎；把（恶行、不良动机等）归于
items.def_en: (+ sth to sb) assign guilt, responsibility, or an undesirable motive to someone
items.ex_en: The prosecutor sought to impute a malicious motive to the defendant's actions.
items.ex_zh: 检察官试图把不良动机归咎于被告的行为。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate cognitive links where a quality, cause, origin, or authorship is assigned to a specific source or agent. The syntactic pattern typically features a direct object followed by the preposition 'to'.
groups.summary_zh: 将原因、结果、动机、品质或作品归咎或归功于特定主体。
groups.desc_en: To intellectually link an outcome, quality, or artifact to an alleged cause, source, or author, unlike direct accusing by its explanatory, causal attribution.
groups.desc_zh: 指在认知上将某一结果、品质或作品归结于特定的起因、源头或创作者，与直接指控不同，它强调因果归属与源流追溯。
groups.nuance_en: attribute: credit an effect, quote, or quality to an identified source or cause (success / quote / painting) · ascribe: assign a trait, origin, or cause through scholarly or formal estimation (motive / origin / meaning) · impute: assign a undesirable action, guilt, or motive critically to someone (motive / crime / blame) · pin on: fasten blame or guilt unfairly or hastily onto a target (crime / blame / failure) · chalk up to: casually explain away an event by identifying its obvious cause (inexperience / bad luck / fatigue)
groups.nuance_zh: attribute: 将成果、引文或特质归结于某源头 (success / quote / painting) · ascribe: 经正式考证或推断将特性归于某因 (motive / origin / meaning) · impute: 将不良动机、过错或罪名加之于人 (motive / crime / blame) · pin on: 仓促或嫁祸式地将责任栽到某人头上 (crime / blame / failure) · chalk up to: 非正式地将成败简单归因于某由 (inexperience / bad luck / fatigue)

groups.name: Authorize & Confer Rights · 授权与赋权 (Entitle, Privilege, Empower)
groups.tip: 给予法定资格或特殊特权

items.def_zh: 准许，颁发执照赋予资格
items.def_en: to give official or legal permission to someone to own, use, or do something
items.ex_en: The national aviation authority refused to license the airline after multiple violations.
items.ex_zh: 在发生多次违规后，国家民航局拒绝向该航空公司颁发许可证。

items.def_zh: 赋予……权利，使享有资格；给（书、文章等）定名
items.def_en: 1. To give someone the right or claim to have or do something. 2. To give a title to a book, poem, or other work.
items.ex_en: This gold membership card will entitle you to unlimited access to the lounge.
items.ex_zh: 这张黄金会员卡将赋予您无限制使用贵宾休息室的权利。

items.raw_cluster: 优待与赋予特权 Privilege & Favor
items.def_zh: 给予……特权，赋予特殊待遇；特免
items.def_en: To give a special right, advantage, or immunity to someone or something.
items.ex_en: The outdated tax code tends to privilege large corporations over small businesses.
items.ex_zh: 这项过时的税法倾向于给大企业赋予优于小企业的特权待遇。

items.def_en: (+ to do sth) to give official permission or legal approval for an action
items.ex_en: The board met this morning to authorize the director to sign the contract.
items.ex_zh: 董事会今天上午召开会议，正式授权主管签署该合同。

items.def_en: (+ sb with sth) to formally grant or confer legal authority, power, or privileges upon someone
items.ex_en: The charter was amended to invest the chief ombudsman with broad investigatory powers.
items.ex_zh: 章程经过修订，正式赋予了首席监察专员广泛的调查权力。

items.def_en: (+ sth in sb) to confer legal rights, property, or authoritative powers fully upon a person or body
items.ex_en: The constitutional amendment will vest sole regulatory authority in the newly created commission.
items.ex_zh: 宪法修正案将把独家监管权全权赋予新成立的委员会。

items.def_zh: 授权，赋予自主权/法定权力
items.def_en: (+ to do sth) to give someone the official power, authority, or legal freedom to do something
items.ex_en: The statutory warrant empowered inspectors to enter the commercial premises without notice.
items.ex_zh: 法定搜查令授权检查员无需预先通知即可进入商业场所。

items.def_en: to give someone the legal right to vote or official constitutional status
items.ex_en: A landmark constitutional amendment was passed to enfranchise millions of disenfranchised citizens.
items.ex_zh: 一项具有里程碑意义的宪法修正案获得通过，赋予了数百万无权公民投票权。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame deal with granting legal rights, institutional privileges, social exemptions, or authoritative capacities to individuals or groups. Verbs vary primarily by official status and the breadth of prerogative bestowed.
groups.summary_zh: 依照法律、规章或制度赋予当事人权利、特权或法定资格。
groups.desc_en: To formally confer legal, institutional, or sovereign power upon an entity, differing from personal encouragement by its institutional legitimacy and binding force.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过法律、规章或主权机制正式授予权力、资格或特权，与私下的鼓励不同，它强调制度层面的合法性与执行力。
groups.nuance_en: authorize: give official sanction or legal warrant to perform an act (payment / strike / use) · empower: grant legal or practical capacity and autonomy to act (agency / citizen / employee) · entitle: give a bona fide claim or right to receive something (worker / holder / citizen) · vest in: formally place an absolute power or right under the tenure of a body (power / authority / jurisdiction) · enfranchise: grant the constitutional right to vote or full civic rights (population / minority / woman)
groups.nuance_zh: authorize: 批准或核准某项具体行动的执行 (payment / strike / use) · empower: 赋予行使职能的法定权力或自主权 (agency / citizen / employee) · entitle: 使某人具备享有福利或待遇的合法资格 (worker / holder / citizen) · vest in: 将重大权力或管辖权庄严归于某主体 (power / authority / jurisdiction) · enfranchise: 赋予公民选举权或完全政治权利 (population / minority / woman)

groups.name: Avian & Canine Vocalization · 鸟鸣与兽吠 (Twitter, Bay, Yelp)
groups.tip: 飞禽走兽的各种叫声拟音

items.def_zh: （鸟等）发出尖细的叫声；尖声鸣叫
items.def_en: Begin to sing or make a high-pitched chirping sound, especially like a bird
items.ex_en: At dawn, tiny sparrows began to pipe up outside my bedroom window.
items.ex_zh: 黎明时分，小麻雀开始在我卧室窗外发出尖细清脆的鸣叫。

items.def_zh: （鸟）唧唧喳喳地叫；嘁嘁喳喳地讲，叽叽咕咕地说
items.def_en: 1. (of a bird) To make a succession of short, high-pitched sounds. 2. To talk rapidly and nervously in a high-pitched voice about unimportant things.
items.ex_en: Flocks of hungry robins twitter continuously among the bare winter tree branches.
items.ex_zh: 成群饥饿的知更鸟在光秃秃的冬日树枝间唧唧喳喳叫个不停。

items.def_en: (of a small bird or insect) to make a short, sharp, high-pitched repetitive sound
items.ex_en: Crickets continued to chirp rhythmically in the tall grass throughout the night.
items.ex_zh: 整夜里，蟋蟀都在茂密的草丛中富有节奏地唧唧鸣叫。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Emit a sudden sharp barking cry or sound
items.ex_en: The guard dog barked out a ferocious warning as footsteps approached the fence.
items.ex_zh: 当脚步声靠近篱笆时，看门狗厉声吠叫着发出一声凶猛的警告。

items.def_zh: （尤指猎犬、狼）长嗥，引颈低吠；（人群）高声叫嚷
items.def_en: 1. (especially of large dogs or wolves) To bark or howl with deep, prolonged sounds. 2. (of a crowd) To shout loudly and continuously, often demanding something violently.
items.ex_en: Bloodhounds bayed mournfully into the cold night air, tracking the fugitive's scent.
items.ex_zh: 寻血猎犬迎着清冷的夜空发出低沉悠长的哀嚎，追踪着逃犯的气味。

items.def_en: [I/T] (of a dog) to emit a sharp, explosive vocal sound
items.ex_en: The neighbor's restless terrier started to bark fiercely at the delivery van.
items.ex_zh: 邻居家躁动不安的㹴犬开始冲着送货货车狂吠不止。

items.def_zh: 嗷叫；尖叫（因疼痛或兴奋）
items.def_en: (of a canine) to utter a short, sharp, high-pitched cry especially from pain or excitement
items.ex_en: The startled puppy gave a sharp yelp when someone accidentally stepped on its tail.
items.ex_zh: 有人不小心踩到小狗的尾巴时，受惊的小狗发出一声短促的尖叫。

items.def_en: [I/T] (of a dog or wolf) to emit a long, loud, mournful cry
items.ex_en: A lonely wolf began to howl plaintively beneath the pale winter moon.
items.ex_zh: 一只孤独的狼在苍白清冷的冬夜月光下开始哀怨地长嚎。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate specific acoustic sound emissions produced by animals (principally birds and hounds), categorized by pitch, rhythm, and acoustic intent (such as light twittering vs. deep howling hunts).
groups.summary_zh: 动物特有的发声行为，涵盖鸟类的清脆叽喳啼鸣到猎犬的深沉低嗥咆哮。
groups.desc_en: To produce natural species-specific auditory signals characteristic of birds and canines, distinguished from human articulation by instinctive acoustic patterning.
groups.desc_zh: 指鸟类与犬科动物发出本能的特有鸣吠声，与人类的言语发音不同，它强调由本能驱使的声学物理特征。
groups.nuance_en: chirp: utter short, high-pitched, cheerful avian notes (bird / cricket / sparrow) · twitter: emit a light, rapid succession of tremulous avian chirps (finch / swallow / flock) · bark: emit an abrupt, explosive canine vocalization (dog / guard dog / hound) · bay: utter deep, prolonged, resonant howling barking, especially while hunting (hound / wolf / pack) · howl: emit a long, mournful, high-volume canine cry (wolf / coyote / stray)
groups.nuance_zh: chirp: 发出短促清脆的鸟鸣或虫唧 (bird / cricket / sparrow) · twitter: 连续发出轻快颤动的细碎啁啾 (finch / swallow / flock) · bark: 发出短促有力的犬吠 (dog / guard dog / hound) · bay: （猎犬追踪时）发出低沉悠长的长吠 (hound / wolf / pack) · howl: 发出凄厉、持续的高亢号叫 (wolf / coyote / stray)

groups.name: Ballroom & Partner Dance · 舞步与交谊舞 (Waltz, Tango, Foxtrot)
groups.tip: 伴随旋律起舞摇摆

items.def_en: to perform a ballroom dance with alternating slow and quick steps
items.ex_en: The elegant couple managed to foxtrot smoothly across the crowded wooden dance floor.
items.ex_zh: 这对优雅的伴侣在拥挤的木质舞池中流畅自如地跳起了狐步舞。

items.def_en: to dance the rumba, marked by rhythmic hip movements
items.ex_en: They practiced for months to rumba gracefully with fluid and expressive hip movements.
items.ex_zh: 他们苦练数月，只为伴随流畅且富有表现力的胯部动作优雅地跳伦巴舞。

items.def_en: to dance the lively Brazilian samba
items.ex_en: Carnival revellers gathered in the vibrant streets to samba until the early morning.
items.ex_zh: 狂欢节的人群聚集在热闹的街头，跳着欢快的桑巴舞直至清晨。

items.def_en: to perform a fast, acrobatic swing dance to jazz music
items.ex_en: Couples used to jitterbug energetically to live swing bands in the packed hall.
items.ex_zh: 伴着现场摇摆乐队的演奏，情侣们过去常常在挤满人的大厅里精力充沛地跳吉特巴舞。

items.def_zh: 迈步跳舞；步入舞池起舞
items.def_en: Go onto the dance floor and perform structured dance steps with a partner
items.ex_en: The tuxedoed gentlemen bowed to their partners before they stepped out together.
items.ex_zh: 身穿晚礼服的绅士们先向舞伴鞠躬，随后一同迈入舞池起舞。

items.def_zh: 旋转（舞伴）；（伴着舞步）旋转化圈
items.def_en: (+ sb) Rotate smoothly across the floor during a ballroom dance or waltz
items.ex_en: He loved to spin his partner around effortlessly during the crescendo of the waltz.
items.ex_zh: 在华尔兹渐入高潮时，他喜欢毫不费力地带着舞伴轻快旋转。
items.ex2_en: The graceful dancer spun around effortlessly on the polished wooden floor.
items.ex2_zh: 这位优雅的舞者在光滑的木地板上毫不费力地旋转着。

items.def_en: To dance the tango.
items.ex_en: The dancers moved with intense theatrical passion whenever they began to tango.
items.ex_zh: 每当开始跳探戈舞时，舞者们的动作都流露出强烈的戏剧性激情。

items.def_zh: 跳华尔兹舞，与……跳华尔兹舞；轻快地走，昂首阔步；轻而易举地获得（成功）
items.def_en: 1. To dance a waltz, or dance a waltz with someone. 2. (+ in/into/through) (informal) To walk somewhere briskly and confidently, or accomplish something easily.
items.ex_en: You cannot simply waltz into my private office without an appointment, young man.
items.ex_zh: 年轻人，你不能没有预约就这么大摇大摆地走进我的私人办公室。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to performing specific structured social or ballroom partner dances, often characterized by particular rhythmic steps, glide movements, and hold positions.
groups.summary_zh: 指按照特定节拍、舞步或姿态跳交谊舞或特定舞种。
groups.desc_en: To execute coordinated, stylized rhythmic movements with a partner across a floor, contrasting with freeform dancing by its strict structural tempos and holds.
groups.desc_zh: 指伴侣之间遵循固定节拍、身姿与舞步规范进行的双人配合舞蹈，与即兴自由舞不同，它具有严格的形式规程与身体框架。
groups.nuance_en: waltz: glide smoothly in triple time with sweeping rotations (couple / dancer / partner) · tango: dance with dramatic pauses, sharp head turns, and stalking steps (pair / partner / troupe) · foxtrot: progress smoothly around the room with alternating slow and quick strides (dancer / beginner / competitor) · rumba: perform slow, expressive Latin hip motions in a compact space (couple / dancer / soloist) · samba: dance with energetic bouncy hip rhythms and festive propulsion (reveller / performer / dancer)
groups.nuance_zh: waltz: 循三拍子平稳滑行并作大弧度旋转 (couple / dancer / partner) · tango: 步伐干脆沉稳，伴随戏剧性停顿与甩头 (pair / partner / troupe) · foxtrot: 以慢快交替的步幅优雅行进 (dancer / beginner / competitor) · rumba: 在小范围内展现抒情缠绵的胯部律动 (couple / dancer / soloist) · samba: 伴随活泼弹跳感呈现热情奔放的节奏 (reveller / performer / dancer)

groups.name: Bat & Hit Baseball · 棒球击球动作 (Bunt, Homer, Slug)
groups.tip: 全垒打或短打碰撞球体

items.def_zh: （棒球中）短打，轻击；（用头或角）顶撞
items.def_en: 1. (in baseball) to hit a pitched ball lightly with the bat without swinging so that it rolls softly in the infield. 2. to push or butt with the head or horns.
items.ex_en: The crafty batter decided to bunt carefully down the third-base line to advance the runner.
items.ex_zh: 机敏的打者决定沿着三垒线小心短打，以此推进垒上的跑者。

items.def_en: (+ a bunt) to gently bat a pitched ball with deliberate touch so it rolls a short distance
items.ex_en: The government has laid down strict safety guidelines for the industry.
items.ex_zh: 政府为该行业制定了严格的安全指南。

items.def_en: to hit a baseball high into the air within the infield for an easy catch
items.ex_en: These error messages keep popping up on my screen.
items.ex_zh: 这些错误提示一直在我的屏幕上弹出来。

items.def_en: [I/T] to hit a baseball hard and on a straight, low trajectory
items.ex_en: He managed to line a sharp pitch straight past the diving shortstop.
items.ex_zh: 他成功击出一记凌厉的平飞球，恰好越过了飞身扑救的游击手。

items.def_en: to hit a ball with a sharp, sweeping blow
items.ex_en: The powerhouse designated hitter stepped up and swatted the incoming fastball into deep left field.
items.ex_zh: 力量型指定打击手走上前，一记猛挥把飞来的快速球狠抽到了左外野深处。

items.def_en: (in baseball) to hit a home run
items.ex_en: The star rookie managed to homer dramatically in the bottom of the ninth inning.
items.ex_zh: 这位明星新秀在第九局下半场戏剧性地击出了一记本垒打。

items.def_en: [I/T] to strike a ball with great force and power
items.ex_en: The cleanup hitter stepped to the plate and slugged the fastball over the fence.
items.ex_zh: 第四棒打者走上击球区，大力重击将快速球轰出了全垒打墙。

items.def_zh: 击出场外全垒打；强力击飞
items.def_en: (+ sth) to hit a baseball cleanly and powerfully beyond the outfield boundaries
items.ex_en: With bases fully loaded, the slugger knocked the ball clean out of the park.
items.ex_zh: 在满垒的情况下，这位强打者干净利落地把球轰成了场外全垒打。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this specialized sporting manipulation frame describe how a batter makes contact with a pitched baseball, varying by mechanics from an intentional soft deflection (bunting) to powerful driving strikes.
groups.summary_zh: 特指棒球击球中不同的击打手法与力量施加，涵盖短打触击与强力挥棒轰击。
groups.desc_en: To strike a pitched baseball with a bat using specialized biomechanical techniques, contrasted with generic hitting by its rule-governed tactical objectives.
groups.desc_zh: 指在棒球运动中使用球棒依循特定挥击技法击打来球，与泛泛的挥打不同，它包含明确的战术意图与击球弹道要求。
groups.nuance_en: bunt: deliberately tap the ball lightly into the infield without swinging (ball / pitch / runner) · slug: strike the ball with immense rotational power for extra bases (pitch / fastball / homer) · homer: hit the ball over the fence for a four-base run (drive / pitch / ball) · pop up: hit a misjudged pitch high into the infield air for an easy out (ball / pitch / batter) · swat: take an aggressive, flat swing that drives the ball forcefully (pitch / ball / drive)
groups.nuance_zh: bunt: 迎球轻触使球落在内野形成短打 (ball / pitch / runner) · slug: 强力挥棒重击以打出长打 (pitch / fastball / homer) · homer: 击出越过外野全垒打墙的本垒打 (drive / pitch / ball) · pop up: 击球过浅使之垂直冲天形成内野必接飞球 (ball / pitch / batter) · swat: 顺势猛挥击出强劲平飞球 (pitch / ball / drive)

groups.name: Be Full & Overflowing · 充满与丰足 (Abound, Teem, Swarm)
groups.tip: 数量极多或大量充斥

items.def_en: (+ sth) to be full of or intensely crowded with people, animals, or objects
items.ex_en: Ancient coral reefs teem with thousands of vibrantly colored tropical fish and crustaceans.
items.ex_zh: 古老的珊瑚礁中挤满了成千上万色彩斑斓的热带鱼类和甲壳动物。

items.def_en: to be so completely full of something that it cannot contain any more and overflows
items.ex_en: Her heart seemed to brim over with boundless gratitude and relief upon hearing the news.
items.ex_zh: 听到这个消息后，她的内心洋溢着无尽的感激与释怀。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to be extremely filled or overflowing with a feeling, energy, or objects
items.ex_en: The bustling community hall was bursting with festive laughter and infectious holiday cheer.
items.ex_zh: 熙熙攘攘的社区礼堂里充盈着节日的欢笑和富有感染力的喜悦。

items.def_en: (+ with) to be filled or crowded with a moving mass of living things
items.ex_en: During early summer, quiet forest pathways swarm with buzzing insects and nesting birds.
items.ex_zh: 初夏时节，幽静的森林小径上密密麻麻地挤满了嗡嗡作响的昆虫和筑巢的飞鸟。

items.def_en: (+ with) to be so full of something that it exceeds limits or margins
items.ex_en: The generous buffet tables overflow with exquisite seafood and seasonal fruits tonight.
items.ex_zh: 今晚丰盛的自助餐桌上堆满了各式精美的海鲜与应季水果。
items.ex2_en: Heavy monsoon rains quickly overflowed the drainage channels throughout the downtown district.
items.ex2_zh: 暴雨迅速使整个市区的排水沟渠满溢溢出。

items.def_zh: 大量存在，充斥；盛产，富于
items.def_en: To exist in large numbers or amounts; (abound in/with) to be full of something.
items.ex_en: Coastal inlets in this remote northern territory abound with migrating salmon every autumn.
items.ex_zh: 每年秋天，这片偏远北部地区的沿海海湾都盛产着洄游的三文鱼。

items.def_en: (+ with) to be densely covered or packed with something prominent or threatening
items.ex_en: The perimeter of the top-secret military installation bristled with high-definition security cameras.
items.ex_zh: 绝密军事基地周边密集布满了高清监控摄像头。

items.def_zh: 充满，挤满，到处都是；（雨水）倾盆而下
items.def_en: 1. (teem with) To be full of or swarming with people, animals, or things. 2. (of rain) To fall heavily; pour.
items.ex_en: Dense tropical rainforests naturally teem with countless rare plant and insect species.
items.ex_zh: 茂密的热带雨林中天然充满着无数珍稀的动植物物种。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict a place, environment, or domain existing in an exceptionally populated, densely occupied, or overwhelmingly plentiful state. They typically take prepositions such as 'with' or occur intransitively with locative subjects.
groups.summary_zh: 表示某场所或环境中某物大量存在、充盈流动或遍布。
groups.desc_en: To contain or produce life, objects, or fluids in such high density that it visibly strains or surpasses the physical boundaries, differing from static fullness by its dynamic crowdedness.
groups.desc_zh: 指空间或容器内的生命体、事物或液体达到饱和甚至满溢外流的动态充盈状态，与静态充满不同，它强调高密度与活跃感。
groups.nuance_en: teem with: be heavily populated and buzzing with active living beings (fish / life / crowd) · abound: exist in great numbers or widespread plentiful supply (wildlife / resource / opportunity) · brim over: be filled to the absolute uppermost edge so as to spill (glass / tear / joy) · overflow: spill beyond the containment limits due to surplus volume (river / basin / crowd) · bristle: be packed defensively or aggressively upright like stiff hairs (weapon / antenna / hostility)
groups.nuance_zh: teem with: 充满繁衍活跃的活体生命而显得挤拥 (fish / life / crowd) · abound: （某物）大量存在或普遍充斥 (wildlife / resource / opportunity) · brim over: 满至边缘几乎或已经外溢 (glass / tear / joy) · overflow: 因容积超限而彻底漫出容器边界 (river / basin / crowd) · bristle: 密密麻麻如刺般挺立或充斥敌意 (weapon / antenna / hostility)

groups.name: Befall & Happen Unto · 发生与降临 (Befall, Betide, Overtake)
groups.tip: 多指厄运或命运忽然降临

items.def_en: (formal/literary) to afflict or punish sb with hardship, plague, or calamity
items.ex_en: A severe winter plague visited the besieged mountain village with catastrophic consequences.
items.ex_zh: 一场严酷的冬季瘟疫降临在被围困的山村，造成了灾难性的后果。

items.def_en: (+ to) to take place affecting sb/sth as a passive recipient of an event
items.ex_en: We all wondered what unexpected misfortune would happen to the reckless travelers next.
items.ex_zh: 我们都在想，接下来究竟会有什么意外厄运降临在那些鲁莽的旅行者身上。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to unexpectedly affect, strike, or descend upon someone (of feelings, misfortune, or fate)
items.ex_en: A sudden overwhelming sense of melancholy came upon the poet during twilight.
items.ex_zh: 暮色苍茫之际，一种突如其来的强烈忧郁感悄然袭上诗人的心头。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to descend upon or befall someone as a fate, duty, misfortune, or curse
items.ex_en: The solemn responsibility to rebuild the ruined chapel fell on the young abbot.
items.ex_zh: 重建毁损小教堂的庄严责任最终落在了这位年轻院长的头上。

items.def_zh: 突然降临到；灾难性袭向
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to arrive suddenly and overwhelm someone or something, often disastrously
items.ex_en: A severe locust swarm descended upon the fertile farmland, destroying the harvest.
items.ex_zh: 一场严重的蝗灾突然袭向肥沃的农田，摧毁了所有庄稼。

items.def_en: (of an unpleasant feeling, event, or fate) to affect sb suddenly and unexpectedly
items.ex_en: Drowsiness began to overtake the weary truck driver on the dark mountain highway.
items.ex_zh: 在漆黑的山间公路上，强烈的困意猛然袭向了疲惫不堪的卡车司机。

items.def_en: (literary) (especially of something unpleasant or unfortunate) To happen to someone or occur.
items.ex_en: Terrible calamities befell the ancient royal house after the rightful king was betrayed.
items.ex_zh: 正统国王遭到背叛之后，可怕的灾难接二连三降临在这个古老王室的头上。

items.def_en: (literary or archaic) To happen to someone or come to pass.
items.ex_en: Woe betide the foolish traveler who ignores the local guide's explicit warnings.
items.ex_zh: 厄运必将降临在忽视当地向导明确警告的愚蠢旅行者身上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this literary/elevated occurrence frame focus on unexpected, fateful, or adverse events descending upon a specific affected person or group. 'Befall' and archaic 'betide' explicitly construct an event or fate striking a recipient as object or indirect target.
groups.summary_zh: 强调（通常具决定性或灾难性的）命运与意外事件降临到某人身上。
groups.desc_en: To happen unto someone as an external, fateful event, contrasting with intentional agency or neutral occurrence by its sense of unwilled destiny and looming gravity.
groups.desc_zh: 指重大变故或命运事件不可抗拒地降临到特定当事人身上，与普通发生不同，它带有宿命感与被动承受的厚重色彩。
groups.nuance_en: befall: happen to someone as an unfortunate, fateful circumstance (tragedy / disaster / fate) · betide: happen or come to pass by preordained destiny (woe / fate / destiny) · overtake: catch up with and engulf someone unexpectedly (disaster / exhaustion / grief) · descend upon: arrive suddenly, overwhelmingly, and often destructively (curse / darkness / locust) · fall on: land upon someone as a heavy duty, blow, or stroke of luck (blow / suspicion / responsibility)
groups.nuance_zh: befall: （不幸、灾难等）厄运降临在某人身上 (tragedy / disaster / fate) · betide: 宿命般发生或注定降临 (woe / fate / destiny) · overtake: （疲惫、悲伤、灾难）猝然追上并压垮 (disaster / exhaustion / grief) · descend upon: 突如其来且大规模笼罩降临 (curse / darkness / locust) · fall on: （打击、怀疑或职责）落在特定对象身上 (blow / suspicion / responsibility)

groups.name: Beget & Sire Offspring · 繁衍与父系受孕 (Beget, Sire, Foal)
groups.tip: 由父系繁衍后代或血统传承

items.def_en: [I/T] to mate and produce offspring, or keep animals for reproduction
items.ex_en: Migratory seabirds return to these rugged cliffs every spring to mate and breed.
items.ex_zh: 候鸟每年春天都会返回这些陡峭的悬崖进行交配并繁殖后代。
items.ex2_en: Local farmers breed robust cattle specifically to withstand harsh alpine winters.
items.ex2_zh: 当地农民专门培育健壮的牛群，以抵御严酷的高山冬季。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Produce or give birth to young or offspring
items.ex_en: According to ancient myth, the sea goddess brought forth strange aquatic creatures.
items.ex_zh: 根据古老的神话传说，海之女神孕育繁衍出了奇形怪状的水生生物。

items.def_en: Give birth to offspring, used especially of livestock animals
items.ex_en: He dropped out of college to start his own technology firm.
items.ex_zh: 他从大学辍学去创办了自己的科技公司。

items.def_en: [I/T] (of fish, frogs, or mollusks) to release eggs, sperm, or young in large numbers
items.ex_en: Thousands of salmon swim upstream every October to spawn in shallow riverbeds.
items.ex_zh: 每年十月，成千上万条鲑鱼逆流而上，在浅浅的河床上产卵繁殖。

items.def_zh: （尤指雄性家畜）成为……的父亲；做父系配种
items.def_en: (especially of male horses or cattle) to become the male parent of animal offspring
items.ex_en: The legendary racehorse went on to sire dozens of record-breaking championship thoroughbreds.
items.ex_zh: 这匹传奇赛马后来作为父本配种，繁育出了数十匹打破纪录的纯种冠军赛马。

items.def_en: (of a mare or female donkey) To give birth to a foal.
items.ex_en: The prize-winning Arabian mare is expected to foal safely early next month.
items.ex_zh: 人们预计这匹屡获殊荣的阿拉伯母马将于下月初顺利产驹。

items.def_en: [I/T] to produce young or offspring through sexual reproduction
items.ex_en: Most biological species possess an innate biological drive to mate and procreate successfully.
items.ex_zh: 大多数生物物种都拥有交配并成功繁衍后代的本能冲动。

items.def_zh: （作为父亲）生下，繁衍（beget的过去式）；招致，引起
items.def_en: (archaic) Past tense of beget: to father a child, or to cause or produce something.
items.ex_en: The ancient scriptures record that the patriarch begat three noble sons in exile.
items.ex_zh: 古老的典籍记载，这位族长在流亡期间生下了三个出身高贵的儿子。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this biological frame refer specifically to procreation and lineage generation, especially paternal generation in animals or archaic human genealogy, as well as delivering specific animal young.
groups.summary_zh: 专指雄性配种繁衍后代或特定动物产仔的生殖过程。
groups.desc_en: To act as the biological progenitor in generating and bringing forth offspring, distinguished from generic reproduction by specific patriarchal or zoological lineages.
groups.desc_zh: 指作为生物学亲代产生后代，与宽泛的繁衍不同，它多侧重父系受孕血统或特定动物产仔机制。
groups.nuance_en: sire: beget offspring as the male biological parent, especially in livestock (champion / colt / offspring) · beget: generate or father offspring, often carrying an archaic or causal sense (child / son / violence) · foal: give birth specifically to a young horse or related equine (mare / colt / filly) · spawn: release massive quantities of eggs, or give rise to proliferations (salmon / offspring / controversy) · procreate: reproduce sexually as a deliberate biological function (species / couple / human)
groups.nuance_zh: sire: （尤指优良雄性种畜）作为父本配种生育 (champion / colt / offspring) · beget: （传统文体）作为生父养育，或衍生结果 (child / son / violence) · foal: （母马等马科动物）产下马驹 (mare / colt / filly) · spawn: （鱼类等）大量排卵产卵，或催生大量产物 (salmon / offspring / controversy) · procreate: 遵循生物学本能进行两性繁衍 (species / couple / human)

groups.name: Bend & Buckle Materially · 物理翘曲与起褶 (Warp, Kink, Buckle)
groups.tip: 受外力或环境致形状走样

items.def_en: (+ sth) Twist or bend out of a flat alignment into upward curves at the edges
items.ex_en: Old photographs tend to curl up along the brittle edges if exposed to sunlight.
items.ex_zh: 老照片如果暴露在阳光下，脆弱的边缘往往会翘曲卷起来。

items.def_en: to force an object out of a straight line into a curve or angle
items.ex_en: Strong blacksmiths use intense heat and heavy hammers to bend the iron rods.
items.ex_zh: 强壮的铁匠利用高温和沉重的铁锤将铁条弯曲成形。
items.ex2_en: The flexible bamboo poles bend gracefully under the weight of heavy snow.
items.ex2_zh: 柔韧的竹竿在厚厚的积雪重压下优雅地弯曲。

items.def_en: to form into a spiral, curved, or upturned shape at the edges
items.ex_en: Overheated plastic book covers often curl unpredictably when exposed to direct heat.
items.ex_zh: 过热的塑料书皮在直接受热时，边缘往往会不可预料地翘曲卷起。
items.ex2_en: The skilled stylist used a heated iron to curl her thick brown hair.
items.ex2_zh: 熟练的发型师用卷发棒卷起了她浓密的棕色头发。

items.def_en: to compress, pinch, or bend material into small regular folds or ridges
items.ex_en: The pastry chef used a fluted wheel to crimp the dough along the edges.
items.ex_zh: 糕点厨师用滚花轮将面团边缘压出整齐的波状褶纹。

items.def_zh: 因受压而弯折变形；扭曲皱缩
items.def_en: Warp, bend, or collapse under excessive heat, pressure, or weight
items.ex_en: The thin steel rails buckled up under the extreme heat wave this afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 今天下午，细钢轨在极端热浪的侵袭下受热弯曲变形了。
items.ex2_en: Extreme hydraulic pressure will buckle up the reinforced steel container during the test.
items.ex2_zh: 在测试过程中，极高的液压会将加固的钢制容器压曲压瘪。

items.def_zh: （使）弯曲，（使）翘曲；曲解，扭曲（心智等）
items.def_en: 1. To bend or twist out of shape, especially from the effects of heat or damp, or to cause something to do this. 2. To distort someone's mind or judgment.
items.ex_en: Excessive moisture in the basement caused the heavy wooden door to warp completely.
items.ex_zh: 地下室过多的湿气导致沉重的木门彻底翘曲变形。
items.ex2_en: Old wooden floorboards warp visibly whenever hot humid weather persists for weeks.
items.ex2_zh: 每当炎热潮湿的天气持续数周，旧木地板就会明显翘曲。

items.def_en: to bend, collapse, or give way under compressive force or intense heat
items.ex_en: The steel railway tracks began to buckle under the intense afternoon summer heat.
items.ex_zh: 夏日下午酷热难耐，钢轨开始受热变形弯折。
items.ex2_en: Excessive structural stress can buckle the thin metal frame of the building.
items.ex2_zh: 过度的结构应力会使建筑物的薄金属框架发生弯曲变形。

items.def_en: To form, or cause something like a rope, hose, wire, or hair to form, a sharp twist or bend.
items.ex_en: Water stopped flowing after the long garden hose twisted into a sharp kink.
items.ex_zh: 长长的花园水管扭成死结后，水便停止了流动。
items.ex2_en: Careless handling will kink the thin copper wire and disrupt electrical transmission.
items.ex2_zh: 粗心的操作会使细铜线打结扭曲，从而扰乱电力传输。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on linear or planar physical objects (wood, metal, wires, pipes) losing their straight, level alignment through heat, moisture, or compressive stress, developing curls, bends, or twists.
groups.summary_zh: 指木材、金属、管线等因受潮、受热或受压而发生弯折、翘曲或起褶。
groups.desc_en: To yield under mechanical stress, heat, or moisture into an irregular, damaged contour, contrasting with deliberate elastic bending by its structural deformation or failure.
groups.desc_zh: 指物体因受力、受热或受潮等外力作用发生失稳变形或损坏，与弹性的弯曲不同，它强调结构扭曲破损与非预期的形变。
groups.nuance_en: warp: twist or curve out of shape due to uneven moisture, heat, or drying (wood / floorboard / perspective) · buckle: collapse or crumple suddenly under excessive axial pressure (steel / knee / plate) · kink: form an abrupt sharp twist or loop in an otherwise straight line (hose / wire / pipe) · crimp: pinch or press into deliberate small regular ridges or crinkles (wire / hair / pastry) · curl: bend or roll smoothly into a curved, spiral, or circular form (leaf / paper / edge)
groups.nuance_zh: warp: 因受潮或受热不均而翘曲变形 (wood / floorboard / perspective) · buckle: 在轴向重压下不堪重负而压屈折曲 (steel / knee / plate) · kink: （管线）自身扭结或出现死弯 (hose / wire / pipe) · crimp: 压制出密集的微小褶痕或波形 (wire / hair / pastry) · curl: 自然卷曲或蜷曲成弧线状 (leaf / paper / edge)

groups.name: Bend & Flex · 弯曲与屈伸 (Flex, Bow, Stoop, Arch)
groups.tip: 关节屈伸或收缩肌肉活动

items.def_en: curve the upper body downwards or forwards toward the ground
items.ex_en: He bent down to tie his shoelaces.
items.ex_zh: 他弯下腰系鞋带。

items.def_zh: 弯腰，鞠躬；（使）弯曲，弯成弓形
items.def_en: 1. To bend one's head or body forward as a sign of respect, greeting, or submission. 2. To bend or curve under pressure.
items.ex_en: The polite shopkeeper smiled and bowed respectfully to welcome each arriving customer.
items.ex_zh: 彬彬有礼的店主微笑着恭敬鞠躬，欢迎每一位光临的顾客。
items.ex2_en: The reverent monks bow their heads respectfully during the solemn evening prayers.
items.ex2_zh: 虔诚的僧侣们在庄严的晚祷中恭敬地低下了头。

items.def_en: [I/T] to curve the back or a bodily part into a graceful arc shape
items.ex_en: The frightened black cat began to arch its back defensively at the dog.
items.ex_zh: 那只受惊的黑猫拱起后背，警惕地防备着那只狗。
items.ex2_en: Her slender spine arched gracefully backward during the final gymnastics performance routine.
items.ex2_zh: 在最后的体操动作中，她纤细的脊椎优雅地向后弯成弓形。

items.def_zh: 弯曲（关节）；绷紧（肌肉）；（使）屈伸
items.def_en: To bend a joint or limb; to tighten or contract a muscle.
items.ex_en: The dedicated athlete paused to flex his sore muscles after the hard workout.
items.ex_zh: 刻苦的运动员在高强度训练后停下来紧绷放松酸痛的肌肉。
items.ex2_en: The new rubber joints flex smoothly without breaking under repeated mechanical stress.
items.ex2_zh: 这种新型橡胶接头在反复的机械应力下能平稳弯曲而不折断。

items.def_en: to bend the head and shoulders forwards and downwards
items.ex_en: The tall man had to stoop low to walk through the ancient doorway.
items.ex_zh: 那位身材高大的男子不得不弯下腰，穿过狭矮的古门。

items.def_en: (+ sth) raise one's shoulders or round one's back posture defensively or compactly
items.ex_en: Freezing commuters hunch up their cold shoulders against the sharp icy wind.
items.ex_zh: 冻坏的通勤人员顶着刺骨的寒风，紧紧耸起发冷的肩膀。
items.ex2_en: Her shoulders hunched up reflexively against the biting chill of the morning air.
items.ex2_zh: 她的双肩本能地耸了起来，以抵御清晨凛冽的寒风。

items.def_en: to bend knees and body close to the ground, pulling limbs in
items.ex_en: The sneaky detective managed to crouch silently behind the thick garden hedge.
items.ex_zh: 鬼鬼祟祟的侦探设法悄无声息地蹲伏在茂密的花园树篱后。

items.def_en: bend suddenly forward at the waist, typically from intense pain or laughter
items.ex_en: The boxer doubled over in agony after taking a sharp blow to the abdomen.
items.ex_zh: 腹部遭受重击后，拳击手痛苦地弓下了身子。
items.ex2_en: A severe stomach cramp doubled the runner over right near the finish line.
items.ex2_zh: 剧烈的胃痉挛使那名跑步者就在终点线附近疼得弓弯了身子。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate curving, flexing, or lowering body parts, whether to stretch muscles, show reverence, or alter posture.
groups.summary_zh: 指弯曲躯体、屈伸肌肉或俯身行礼等身体姿态变换。
groups.desc_en: To alter the physical posture of the body or a limb by contracting joints, distinguishing itself from collapse by controlled somatic intentionality.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过骨骼关节的主动收折调节身体姿态，与倒塌失控不同，它强调受躯体意识调控的屈伸与倾斜动作。
groups.nuance_en: flex: contract a muscle or bend a joint deliberately to test or display it (muscle / limb / foot) · bow: incline the head or torso forward in reverence, greeting, or defeat (head / knee / body) · stoop: bend the upper body forward and downward, often habitual with age (posture / shoulder / back) · arch: curve the back or a body part into a convex arching shape (spine / brow / back) · crouch: lower the entire body by bending the knees close to the ground (body / position / runner)
groups.nuance_zh: flex: 主动紧绷收缩肌肉或弯折关节 (muscle / limb / foot) · bow: 倾身鞠躬或低头以示尊崇、服从 (head / knee / body) · stoop: 上半身前倾微屈，常指驼背屈身 (posture / shoulder / back) · arch: 将躯干或眉眼反向弓起呈弧状 (spine / brow / back) · crouch: 屈膝下蹲使重心放低贴近地面 (body / position / runner)

groups.name: Beset & Beleaguer · 困扰与逼压 (Beset, Beleaguer, Plaguer)
groups.tip: 四面包围苦苦相逼

items.def_en: to make repeated attacks on an enemy or harass someone continuously
items.ex_en: Guerrilla fighters continued to harry the retreating royal army throughout the narrow pass.
items.ex_zh: 游击队员在狭窄的山口一路持续袭扰撤退的皇家军队。

items.def_en: (+ sb) join together in a group to attack, harass, or oppose someone
items.ex_en: Older schoolyard bullies often gang up on younger children during lunch recess.
items.ex_zh: 高年级的校园恶霸常在午休时联手欺负低年级孩子。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) gradually surround or approach nearer to threaten or distress someone
items.ex_en: Armed police officers began to close in on the fugitive hiding downtown.
items.ex_zh: 武装警察开始逐步逼近包围躲在市中心的逃犯。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) exert relentless, overwhelming pressure or approach aggressively
items.ex_en: The hurricane was bearing down on the coastal towns at terrifying speed.
items.ex_zh: 飓风以可怕的速度向沿海城镇逼近。

items.def_en: to continually cause trouble, suffering, or distress to someone or something
items.ex_en: Persistent financial troubles plague the small family business during the harsh winter.
items.ex_zh: 持续不断的财务问题在严冬里困扰着这家小型家族企业。

items.def_en: to repeatedly pester or urge someone with questions or demands
items.ex_en: The eager reporters badger the mayor daily with relentless questions about corruption.
items.ex_zh: 热切的记者们每天都用关于腐败的连珠炮式提问纠缠市长。

items.def_zh: 围攻，包围；困扰，使苦恼；镶嵌
items.def_en: 1. (usually passive, 'be beset by/with') To trouble, surround, or harass someone or something persistently. 2. (archaic) To surround or attack from all sides.
items.ex_en: The ancient mountain fortress was continually beset by unforgiving winter blizzards.
items.ex_zh: 这座古老的山间要塞持续受到无情冬日暴风雪的围困。

items.def_zh: 围攻，包围；使困扰，使陷入困境
items.def_en: 1. (often passive, 'be beleaguered') To overwhelm or persistently harass someone with difficulties or criticism. 2. (military) To surround an enemy town or position with armed forces.
items.ex_en: The beleaguered prime minister faced harsh, persistent criticism regarding the economic crisis.
items.ex_zh: 深陷困境的首相因经济危机而面临持续严厉的指责。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey being continuously harassed, overwhelmed, or surrounded by persistent difficulties, critics, or hostile forces, whether literally in combat or metaphorically in distress.
groups.summary_zh: 遭受多方持续围攻、逼压或被重重困难与问题缠绕。
groups.desc_en: Denotes surrounding, pursuing, or overwhelming an entity with persistent pressures, attacks, or vexations, unlike passive suffering or solitary misfortune.
groups.desc_zh: 指受到来自多方的持续侵扰、围攻或压力逼迫，不同于单方面的被动受害或孤立不幸。
groups.nuance_en: beset: surround on all sides by persistent troubles (doubts / difficulties / scandal) · beleaguer: lay siege to through external pressure or distress (beleaguered industry / city / government) · plague: afflict continually like an epidemic or nuisance (drought / injuries / corruption) · harry: harass through repeated predatory incursions or demands (defenders / coastline / debtor) · badger: pester persistently with questions or pleas (witness / official / committee)
groups.nuance_zh: beset: 诸事缠身或四面受困 (doubts / difficulties / scandal) · beleaguer: 处于重重包围与外部高压之下 (beleaguered industry / city / government) · plague: 如疫病般反复纠缠折磨 (drought / injuries / corruption) · harry: 骚扰性反复侵扰或袭逼 (defenders / coastline / debtor) · badger: 纠缠不休地追问或央求 (witness / official / committee)

groups.name: Besiege & Blockade · 围困与封锁 (Besiege, Blockade, Cordon)
groups.tip: 截断交通补给切断内外通道

items.def_en: (formal/military) to surround a town or fortified place with military forces so as to besiege it
items.ex_en: The imperial forces advanced swiftly to invest the rebellious frontier garrison completely.
items.ex_zh: 帝国军队迅速推进，将叛乱的边境驻军要塞彻底合围。

items.def_en: to isolate an area by forming a protective barrier of police, soldiers, or tape
items.ex_en: Armed security officers worked quickly to cordon off the crowded crash site.
items.ex_zh: 武装安保人员迅速行动，用警戒线封锁了拥挤的事故现场。

items.def_en: to surround someone or something completely so that free movement is impossible
items.ex_en: Tall concrete walls completely hem in the tiny backyard of the estate.
items.ex_zh: 高大的混凝土墙将庄园狭小的后院彻底围困其中。

items.def_en: (+ sth) block all entrances and exits to prevent movement in or out of an area
items.ex_en: Armed guards sealed off the street following the security alert.
items.ex_zh: 安全警报拉响后，武装警卫封锁了整条街道。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) surround someone or something completely so that escape is impossible
items.ex_en: My car was boxed in by two huge delivery trucks, and I couldn't pull out.
items.ex_zh: 我的车被两辆大卡车死死卡在中间，根本开不出来。

items.def_zh: 切断（补给、退路或外界联系）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) isolate a place or force from supplies, reinforcements, or communication
items.ex_en: Heavy snow cut off several remote villages for days.
items.ex_zh: 大雪将几个偏远村庄阻隔了数天之久。

items.def_en: 1. To surround a port, city, or country with troops or ships to prevent people and goods from entering or leaving.
items.ex_en: Naval warships were deployed urgently to blockade the busy southern trade harbor.
items.ex_zh: 海军战舰被紧急部署，以全面封锁繁忙的南方贸易港口。

items.def_zh: 围攻，包围；围扰，蜂拥而至
items.def_en: 1. (military) To surround a town or fortress with armed forces to cut off supplies and force surrender. 2. To overwhelm or harass someone with persistent requests or questions.
items.ex_en: Royal troops prepared their heavy catapults to besiege the rebel mountain fortress.
items.ex_zh: 皇家军队准备好重型投石机，围攻叛军盘踞的山寨。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this military and operational frame refer to encircling an enemy fortress, city, or coast with armed forces to seal off access, sever supply lines, and compel surrender.
groups.summary_zh: 用军事或警卫力量切断外部通道与补给以封锁围困目标地。
groups.desc_en: Involves physically enclosing, cutting off, or isolating a place or group to enforce surrender or containment, contrasting with open field conflict.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过物理包围、断绝交通或隔离封锁使目标受困，区别于开阔地带的正面作战。
groups.nuance_en: besiege: surround militarily to compel surrender (fortress / city / garrison) · blockade: seal off access ports or borders to halt commerce and supplies (harbor / coastline / island) · cordon off: enclose an area with barriers or police tape to control access (crime scene / blast zone / perimeter) · hem in: restrict movement tightly within confines (infantry / fleet / options) · invest: formally surround with military forces to begin a prolonged siege (stronghold / capital)
groups.nuance_zh: besiege: 军事重围以迫降 (fortress / city / garrison) · blockade: 封锁港口或通道以阻绝补给 (harbor / coastline / island) · cordon off: 拉起警戒线隔离现场 (crime scene / blast zone / perimeter) · hem in: 紧密包围而限制机动空间 (infantry / fleet / options) · invest: 兵临城下合围立营以待攻坚 (stronghold / capital)

groups.name: Block & Seal · 机械卡阻与孔径密闭 (Chock, Plug, Occlude)
groups.tip: 密闭孔道阻隔不通

items.def_en: (+ up) to fill an opening or leak completely with a tightly fitted stopper or material
items.ex_en: He grabbed some sticky sealant to plug the leaking pipe under the sink.
items.ex_zh: 他拿了些粘性密封剂去封堵水槽下面漏水的管道。

items.def_en: (+ sth) fill an aperture or channel tightly so that passage is hindered or stopped
items.ex_en: Decaying autumn leaves choke up the narrow drainage ditch beside the road.
items.ex_zh: 腐烂的秋叶堵塞了路旁狭窄的排水渠。

items.def_en: (+ sth) become or cause to become wedged tightly and unable to move or flow
items.ex_en: A single stalled car jammed up traffic for miles.
items.ex_zh: 一辆抛锚的车导致后方交通堵塞了数英里。
items.ex2_en: The office paper shredder jammed up when someone inserted heavy cardboard by mistake.
items.ex2_zh: 当有人误塞入厚纸板时，办公室碎纸机卡死了。

items.def_en: (+ sth) block a hole, pipe, or aperture tightly to stop fluid or passage
items.ex_en: The plumber tried hard to plug up the small crack using silicone.
items.ex_zh: 水管工努力用硅胶把那个细小的裂口塞住。

items.def_en: to push tightly into a confined space so as to prevent any further movement
items.ex_en: A small rusted coin managed to jam the busy vending machine coin slot.
items.ex_zh: 一枚生锈的小硬币把繁忙的自动售货机投币口卡死了。
items.ex2_en: The old lock will jam instantly if you force the wrong key inside.
items.ex2_zh: 如果你强行把错误的钥匙插进去，这把旧锁会立刻卡住。

items.def_en: to overcrowd, clog, or stop up a narrow channel or passage
items.ex_en: Heavy weekend traffic will severely congest the narrow arteries leading downtown.
items.ex_zh: 周末的繁忙车流将严重堵塞通往市中心的狭窄主干道。
items.ex2_en: Narrow mountain tunnels congest easily whenever heavy holiday traffic begins each evening.
items.ex2_zh: 每当傍晚假期的繁忙交通开始时，狭窄的山区隧道很容易发生拥堵。

items.def_en: 1. (+ up) To block, wedge, or secure something (such as a wheel) with a chock to stop it from moving.
items.ex_en: The driver remembered to chock the heavy trailer wheels on the steep slope.
items.ex_zh: 司机记得在陡坡上用楔子垫稳重型拖车的轮子。

items.def_zh: 使闭塞，堵塞，阻隔；（上下齿）咬合
items.def_en: 1. (formal / medical) To block, close up, or obstruct an opening or passage; (of teeth) to meet or close together properly.
items.ex_en: Thick fatty deposits can occlude vital coronary arteries and trigger serious attacks.
items.ex_zh: 厚厚的脂肪沉积物会堵塞重要的冠状动脉并引发严重发作。
items.ex2_en: Upper and lower teeth should occlude properly to ensure effective food chewing.
items.ex2_zh: 上下牙齿应正确咬合，以确保有效地咀嚼食物。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail physical manipulation to restrict movement or halt fluid/light flow by jamming a wedge under an object or totally plugging and sealing an aperture or vessel.
groups.summary_zh: 指用楔子卡死机构以防滑动，或用物质完全塞住通道、孔道与管腔。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on stopping flow, movement, or passage by wedging a mechanical obstruction or filling an opening tightly, contrasting with mere closing.
groups.desc_zh: 强调通过楔入机械障碍物或塞死孔道来阻断流动或移动，不同于常规的关闭或掩门。
groups.nuance_en: chock: wedge a block against wheels to prevent rolling (wheel / tire / trailer) · plug: stop up a hole tightly with a fitting insert (leak / bore / gap) · jam: wedge or stick so tightly that mechanical motion is arrested (gears / lock / printer) · occlude: close off or obstruct a lumen, duct, or vessel physiologically (artery / duct / pore) · congest: overcrowd a conduit to the point of clogging (traffic / airway / sinuses)
groups.nuance_zh: chock: 用楔块垫阻轮体防溜 (wheel / tire / trailer) · plug: 紧密塞住洞孔或漏点 (leak / bore / gap) · jam: 机械卡壳或挤塞停转 (gears / lock / printer) · occlude: 闭塞脉管、孔隙或通道 (artery / duct / pore) · congest: 过度拥挤致通道堵滞 (traffic / airway / sinuses)

groups.name: Blow & Gust · 吹动与狂刮 (Blow, Gust, Whistle)
groups.tip: 气流呼呼吹送移动

items.def_en: [I/T] To pass or cause to pass gently through the air like a light breeze
items.ex_en: Sweet floral scents waft gently through the open bedroom window each spring evening.
items.ex_zh: 每个春夜，甜美的花香都会穿过敞开的卧室窗户轻轻飘入。
items.ex2_en: A gentle evening breeze wafted the smell of fresh bread across the street.
items.ex2_zh: 温柔的晚风将新鲜面包的香味吹送到了街对过。

items.def_en: (+ sth) knock something down by the force of moving air, or fall over from wind
items.ex_en: Violent storm gusts threaten to blow over the frail wooden garden fence.
items.ex_zh: 猛烈的风暴阵风威胁着要刮倒脆弱的木制花园栅栏。
items.ex2_en: The lightweight patio chairs blew over during the powerful midnight thunderstorm.
items.ex2_zh: 那些轻便的庭院椅子在午夜强烈的雷雨中被吹倒了。

items.def_en: 1. (of wind or air) to move or be in motion. 2. to force air out through the mouth or into an instrument.
items.ex_en: Bitter arctic winds blow fiercely across the open prairie throughout the long winter.
items.ex_zh: 刺骨的北极寒风在整个漫长冬季里猛烈掠过空旷的大草原。

items.def_en: (Of wind) To move rapidly past an obstacle, producing a clear, high-pitched shrill noise
items.ex_en: Frigid winter gales whistle loudly through the narrow cracks in the attic window.
items.ex_zh: 寒冬的大风透过阁楼窗户的狭小缝隙发出尖利的呼啸声。

items.def_en: (+ sth) blow through an area or opening with a sustained, loud, high-pitched wail
items.ex_en: Icy alpine winds howl through the deserted stone ruins atop the mountain peak.
items.ex_zh: 冰冷的高山狂风呼啸穿过山顶废弃的石制遗址。

items.def_en: (+ sth) blow violently and swiftly through a space or landscape
items.ex_en: Sudden freezing gales whip through the empty city alleys late at night.
items.ex_zh: 深夜里，突如其来的刺骨狂风猛烈席卷空旷的城市小巷。

items.def_en: (Of wind) To blow in sudden, forceful, and brief rushes
items.ex_en: Unpredictable sea winds gust powerfully against the tall cliffs along the coast.
items.ex_zh: 变幻莫测的海风化作阵阵强风，猛烈吹打着沿海的悬崖。

items.def_en: (Of wind) To blow violently making a loud, mournful sound
items.ex_en: The furious northern gales howl outside our small wooden cabin all night long.
items.ex_zh: 狂暴的北风整夜在我们的小木屋外面怒号咆哮。

groups.summary_en: Air or wind moves across a space, either as a steady current or in sudden, distinct kinematic patterns. Verbs capture different wind behaviors, from steady generic flow ('blow') to sudden violent surges ('gust') or high-pitched, howling passage ('whistle', 'howl').
groups.summary_zh: 气流或风在空间中的流动运动，体现为由平稳吹拂到突发阵风或呼啸狂风。
groups.desc_en: Describes air or wind moving with distinct dynamics, sound, and force, contrasting with motionless calm or uniform fluid flow.
groups.desc_zh: 指气流运动所表现出的独特动态、声响与风力强度，不同于平静无风或均匀液体流动。
groups.nuance_en: blow: generic air movement (wind / breeze / leaves) · gust: blow in sudden, violent intermittent bursts (gale / wind / squall) · whistle: move rapidly while producing a shrill whistling tone (wind / gale / draft) · howl: roar with deep, mournful auditory ferocity (blizzard / tempest / wind) · whip through: lash or drive through rapidly and violently (currents / squall / dust)
groups.nuance_zh: blow: 基础的风吹流动 (wind / breeze / leaves) · gust: 阵风突起狂吹 (gale / wind / squall) · whistle: 疾风呼啸鸣响 (wind / gale / draft) · howl: 怒风凄厉号叫 (blizzard / tempest / wind) · whip through: 狂风如鞭般迅疾穿抽 (currents / squall / dust)

groups.name: Board Transportation · 登乘交通工具 (Board, Embark, Entrain)
groups.tip: 进入交通工具出发

items.def_zh: 上（船、飞机、火车等），登乘；寄宿，提供膳宿；用木板封盖
items.def_en: 1. To get on or into a ship, aircraft, train, or bus. 2. To live in a place and pay for accommodation and meals, or provide this. 3. (often board up) To cover something with wooden boards.
items.ex_en: Passengers queued up calmly to board the overnight express train to Chicago.
items.ex_zh: 乘客们平静地排队登上开往芝加哥的通宵特快列车。

items.def_zh: 骑上，登上（马车、自行车等）
items.def_en: [I/T] to get up on a horse, bicycle, or elevated transport vehicle ready for travel
items.ex_en: The experienced ranger prepared to mount his trusty horse for the patrol.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的护林员准备骑上他忠诚的马匹去巡逻。

items.def_en: [I/T] (formal) to board an airplane, or cause passengers or troops to board an airplane
items.ex_en: The military squad prepared to emplane quickly before dawn broke over the airfield.
items.ex_zh: 军分队在破晓晨光降临机场之前迅速登机整装待发。
items.ex2_en: Flight attendants emplaned the elderly passengers carefully before boarding the remaining travelers.
items.ex2_zh: 乘务员在安排其余旅客登机前，细心引导老年乘客上了飞机。

items.def_en: (+ sth) step onto or board a bus, train, plane, or ship
items.ex_en: Eager commuters wait patiently in line to get on the crowded morning bus.
items.ex_zh: 心急的通勤族耐心排队，准备登上拥挤的早班公交车。

items.def_en: (+ sth) quickly or casually step onto a bus, train, or other vehicle
items.ex_en: We decided to hop on the downtown tram instead of walking in the rain.
items.ex_zh: 我们决定跳上市中心电车，而不是冒雨步行。

items.def_zh: 爬上，登入（大型交通工具）
items.def_en: (+ sth) board a ship, aircraft, train, or large vehicle by climbing steps
items.ex_en: The excited tourists eagerly climb aboard the luxurious cruise ship at the dock.
items.ex_zh: 兴奋的游客们在码头迫不及待地登上那艘豪华邮轮。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ on/upon) to go aboard a ship, aircraft, or other vehicle to begin a journey; or put passengers aboard
items.ex_en: Diplomats will embark tomorrow on an official diplomatic voyage across the Atlantic.
items.ex_zh: 外交官们将于明日登船启程，开始横跨大西洋的正式访问。
items.ex2_en: The cruise company will embark five hundred excited passengers on the Caribbean voyage.
items.ex2_zh: 邮轮公司将让五百名兴奋的乘客登船开始加勒比之行。

items.def_zh: （使）登乘火车；（物理/流体中）挟带，夹带
items.def_en: 1. (dated) To board a train, or put passengers or troops onto a train. 2. (technical) To carry along or trap bubbles, drops, or particles in a moving fluid.
items.ex_en: The soldiers formed neat lines to entrain under the commander's watchful gaze.
items.ex_zh: 士兵们排成整齐的纵队，在指挥官的注视下登乘火车。
items.ex2_en: The military commander entrained his exhausted troops before night fell over the station.
items.ex2_zh: 军事指挥官在车站夜幕降临前安排疲惫的部队登上了火车。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate the act of getting onto or putting passengers/cargo into a vehicle, ship, aircraft, or train for travel. While 'board' is the universal everyday term, 'embark' often applies to ships/planes or suggests setting out on a voyage, and 'entrain' specifies boarding a train.
groups.summary_zh: 指旅客或货物登上轮船、飞机、火车等交通工具以启程出发。
groups.desc_en: Specifies the physical or formal act of stepping or loading onto a vessel or conveyance, contrasting with merely traveling or sitting inside.
groups.desc_zh: 特指登上、跨上或装运进入交通工具的物理动作与手续，不同于单纯的乘坐或处于其内。
groups.nuance_en: board: enter a large public transport vehicle formally (plane / ship / train) · embark: go on board a ship or aircraft, often initiating a venture (passengers / troops / vessel) · mount: climb onto the back of an animal or cycle (horse / bicycle / platform) · entrain: put onto or board a train, especially military forces (troops / passengers / battalions) · emplane: board an aircraft, typically in formal or military usage (company / contingent / passengers)
groups.nuance_zh: board: 正式登乘大型公共交通工具 (plane / ship / train) · embark: 登船或登机启程 (passengers / troops / vessel) · mount: 骑上、跨上或踏上 (horse / bicycle / platform) · entrain: 登乘或装运上列车 (troops / passengers / battalions) · emplane: 正式或军队列队登机 (company / contingent / passengers)

groups.name: Bond & Fuse Materials · 熔接与层压 (Solder, Laminate, Weld)
groups.tip: 压制黏合成多层复合体

items.def_en: (+ sth) join or blend materials permanently into a single body using heat or chemical bonding
items.ex_en: Extreme hydraulic pressure helped fuse together the ceramic and metal components seamlessly.
items.ex_zh: 极高的水压有助于将陶瓷和金属部件无缝熔合在一起。
items.ex2_en: The heated glass layers fused together securely to create a shatterproof window panel.
items.ex2_zh: 受热的玻璃层牢固地熔接在一起，制成了防碎窗板。

items.def_en: (+ sth) fuse separate pieces of metal or thermoplastic together by applying intense heat
items.ex_en: The mechanic will weld together the fractured steel beams from the truck chassis.
items.ex_zh: 机械工将把卡车底盘断裂的钢梁重新焊接在一起。
items.ex2_en: These heated plastic components will weld together seamlessly under intense industrial pressure.
items.ex2_zh: 这些受热的塑料部件在极高的工业压力下将无缝熔接在一起。

items.def_en: (+ sth) unite two surfaces firmly by means of adhesive, pressure, or chemical treatment
items.ex_en: Special industrial adhesives firmly bond together these composite plastic panels for aircraft.
items.ex_zh: 特种工业粘合剂将这些用于飞机的复合塑料板牢固地胶粘在一起。
items.ex2_en: The two wooden planks bonded together firmly after the epoxy resin hardened.
items.ex2_zh: 环氧树脂固化后，两块木板牢固地粘结在了一起。

items.def_en: to join or become combined by or as if by melting together
items.ex_en: Intense thermal energy caused the plastic polymers to fuse into a single block.
items.ex_zh: 强烈的热能使塑料聚合物熔合成了一整块。
items.ex2_en: The master artisan will fuse separate colored glass pieces into an ornate vase.
items.ex2_zh: 这位工艺大师将把不同的彩色玻璃片熔合成一个华丽的花瓶。

items.def_en: to join pieces of metal or plastic by heating them until they melt together
items.ex_en: Skilled ironworkers must weld structural steel joints carefully to ensure building safety.
items.ex_zh: 熟练的铁匠必须仔细焊接建筑钢结构接头以确保大楼安全。

items.def_en: To join pieces of metal or electrical wires together with melted solder.
items.ex_en: The technician learned how to solder thin copper wires onto the motherboard.
items.ex_zh: 技术员学习了如何将细铜线焊接在母板上。

items.def_en: 1. To cover paper or a flat surface with a protective layer of plastic. 2. To bond thin layers of material together to make a composite.
items.ex_en: Workers will laminate the sensitive company badges using clear, durable plastic film.
items.ex_zh: 工人们将用透明耐用的塑料薄膜为敏感的公司胸牌压膜保护。

items.def_en: to solder with a relatively infusible and hard alloy such as brass
items.ex_en: The jeweler used a tiny torch to braze the brass components securely.
items.ex_zh: 珠宝工匠使用微型喷枪将黄铜部件牢固地硬钎焊在一起。

groups.summary_en: Someone permanently joins materials (metal, plastic, paper) using heat, adhesives, or pressure to create an integrated bond or composite structure. Verbs specify technical fabrication methods, contrasting surface coating, heat fusion, or brazing.
groups.summary_zh: 通过加热、压合或熔焊将不同材质牢固接合为一体的技术工艺框架。
groups.desc_en: Refers to uniting solid materials permanently into one continuous body through heat, melting, or adhesive layers, contrasting with mechanical fastening (bolting/screwing).
groups.desc_zh: 指通过受热熔合、钎料或黏合层压使材料牢固结为一体，不同于用螺栓销钉等机械紧固。
groups.nuance_en: weld: unite metals or plastics by melting and fusing the base materials (plates / joints / beams) · solder: join metal components using a low-melting filler alloy (circuits / wires / pipes) · braze: join metals using a high-melting non-ferrous filler metal without melting the base (alloys / fittings / tubes) · fuse: melt together completely into a homogeneous mass (glass / minerals / atoms) · laminate: bond multiple thin layers together with adhesive and pressure (sheets / veneers / glass)
groups.nuance_zh: weld: 熔化母材的熔焊 (plates / joints / beams) · solder: 熔融低熔点焊料的软钎焊 (circuits / wires / pipes) · braze: 高温硬钎焊 (alloys / fittings / tubes) · fuse: 高温熔合成一体 (glass / minerals / atoms) · laminate: 涂胶加压层压叠合 (sheets / veneers / glass)

groups.name: Breach Rules & Defy Authority · 违抗规章与犯禁 (Contravene, Flout, Transgress)
groups.tip: 公然无视规矩法律并加以触犯

items.def_en: to break or violate an agreement, law, contract, or code of conduct
items.ex_en: Releasing confidential customer data will blatantly breach our strict corporate privacy policies.
items.ex_zh: 泄露客户机密数据将公然违反我们严格的企业隐私政策。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Oppose, disobey, or breach an established rule, law, or principle
items.ex_en: His dishonest business actions go against every moral principle his parents taught him.
items.ex_zh: 他不诚实的商业行为违背了父母教给他的每一条道德准则。

items.def_zh: 公开反抗；勇敢顶撞（权威）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Resist or openly defy a powerful person, authority, or bullying force
items.ex_en: These materials are designed to stand up to extreme weather conditions.
items.ex_zh: 这些材料旨在经受住极端天气的考验。

items.def_en: to openly refuse to obey or show respect for authority, laws, or conventions
items.ex_en: The rebellious teenage driver continued to defy basic traffic laws on the highway.
items.ex_zh: 那个叛逆的年轻司机在高速公路上继续公然违抗基本交通法规。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ on/upon) to act in a way that breaks a law, rule, or another person's rights
items.ex_en: Unauthorized downloading may infringe copyright laws and bring about serious legal consequences.
items.ex_zh: 未经授权的下载可能会侵犯版权法并引致严重的法律后果。

items.def_zh: 违反，触犯（法律、规则等）；与……相抵触
items.def_en: (formal) to do something that is forbidden by a law, rule, or treaty; conflict with
items.ex_en: The proposed trade tariff might contravene existing international commerce treaties between nations.
items.ex_zh: 拟议的贸易关税可能会与国与国之间现有的国际商贸条约相抵触。

items.def_zh: 公然违抗，藐视，蔑视（法律、规则等）
items.def_en: to deliberately disobey a rule, law, or custom openly and without respect
items.ex_en: Arrogant executives continue to flout environmental safety guidelines despite severe government fines.
items.ex_zh: 尽管政府处以重罚，傲慢的高管们依然公然藐视环境安全准则。

items.def_zh: 违背，逾越（道德规范、界限等）；违反
items.def_en: (formal) to go beyond the limit of what is morally, socially, or legally acceptable; violate
items.ex_en: He knew that lying under official oath would fatally transgress the legal boundary.
items.ex_zh: 他深知在宣誓下作伪证将严重触犯法律红线。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote infringing laws, limits, or social mores, ranging from technical non-compliance to brazen defiance and moral overstepping.
groups.summary_zh: 表示对法律、条令或伦理规范的违反，从技术性违规到公然蔑视抗拒。
groups.desc_en: Centers on intentionally violating, bypassing, or showing open contempt toward laws, pacts, or authorities, contrasting with accidental error.
groups.desc_zh: 指对法规、条约或权威的蓄意违犯、逾越或公然藐视，不同于无意的失误或疏漏。
groups.nuance_en: breach: break through a legal bond, contract, or trust (contract / trust / protocol) · contravene: act in direct conflict with an explicit law or principle (regulations / treaty / code) · flout: openly and scornfully disregard a rule or convention (rules / ban / authority) · transgress: cross a moral boundary or legal limit (boundaries / moral law / limits) · infringe: encroach upon or subtly violate established rights or patents (patent / copyright / rights)
groups.nuance_zh: breach: 破毁契约、信义或防线 (contract / trust / protocol) · contravene: 抵触或违反明文规约 (regulations / treaty / code) · flout: 公然藐视并公然违反 (rules / ban / authority) · transgress: 越过道德或法律边界 (boundaries / moral law / limits) · infringe: 侵犯或蚕食权利与专利 (patent / copyright / rights)

groups.name: Brood & Sulk in Resentment · 郁结与生闷气 (Sulk, Mope, Stew)
groups.tip: 嘟嘴生闷气与暗自懊恼

items.def_zh: 无精打采地闲逛；郁闷消沉地走动
items.def_en: Move around aimlessly in an unhappy, listless, or resentful mood
items.ex_en: He did nothing all weekend except mope around the apartment feeling bitter.
items.ex_zh: 他整个周末无所事事，只在公寓里郁闷地闲逛，满心怨忿。

items.def_en: to push one's lips forward in a petulant or sullen show of annoyance
items.ex_en: The disappointed toddler began to pout when her father denied her sweet treats.
items.ex_zh: 当爸爸不给甜食时，失望的小女孩便开始噘嘴赌气。

items.raw_cluster: 愠怒与生闷气 Sulk & Pout
items.def_en: 1. To remain silent, bad-tempered, and distant because you are annoyed or disappointed.
items.ex_en: He chose to sulk in his bedroom rather than join family dinner celebrations.
items.ex_zh: 他选择躲在卧室里生闷气，而不愿参加家庭晚餐庆祝。

items.def_zh: 闷闷不乐，消沉发呆；无所事事地闲逛
items.def_en: 1. (+ around/about) To wander around feeling sad, gloomy, and sorry for yourself.
items.ex_en: Stop sitting there to mope, and let us find another good solution instead.
items.ex_zh: 别坐在那儿垂头丧气发呆了，让我们另寻良策吧。

items.def_zh: （怨恨、烦恼）折磨，侵蚀（某人的内心）
items.def_en: (+ sb) Cause someone continuous inward anxiety, distress, or resentment over time
items.ex_en: The unresolved guilt continued to eat away at him for years.
items.ex_zh: 那份未解的内疚感多年来持续折磨着他的内心。

items.def_en: (+ over/on) to dwell unhappily on a subject that causes resentment or distress
items.ex_en: It is unhealthy to brood over past mistakes that you cannot possibly change.
items.ex_zh: 对那些根本无法改变的陈年往事郁郁寡欢是无益身心的。

items.raw_cluster: 使懊恼与使沮丧 Chagrin & Disappoint
items.def_zh: 使懊恼，使感到屈辱或失望
items.def_en: 1. (usually passive, 'be chagrined') To make someone feel annoyed, disappointed, and humiliated.
items.ex_en: The senior scientist was deeply chagrined to discover severe errors in his findings.
items.ex_zh: 这位资深科学家发现自己的研究成果存在重大错误，深感懊恼屈辱。

items.def_zh: 暗自发愁/气恼；内心煎熬
items.def_en: (+ over/in) to worry, fret, or seethe in quiet, agitated resentment over a prolonged period
items.ex_en: Instead of talking things through, Mark stayed home to stew over the insult.
items.ex_zh: 马克没有把话挑明，而是待在家里为受到的侮辱暗自生闷气。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe exhibiting silent, passive, or visible resentment, dejection, or annoyance instead of speaking openly. They range from withdrawn silence born of bad temper (sulk) and listless wandering in self-pity (mope) to inward emotional boiling (stew, brood).
groups.summary_zh: 因不满、委屈或受挫而保持沉默、阴沉抑郁地独处或暗中生闷气。
groups.desc_en: Denotes silently dwelling upon real or imagined grievances with resentful melancholy, contrasting with explosive rage or open weeping.
groups.desc_zh: 指在心中暗自郁结、生闷气或反复咀嚼怨忿，不同于爆发性狂怒或公开哭诉。
groups.nuance_en: brood: dwell moodily and continuously on an unhappy subject (injustice / defeat / failure) · sulk: maintain a sullen, silent, resentful withdrawal (child / loser / player) · mope: wander or sit listlessly in low spirits and self-pity (around house / in bedroom) · stew: boil inwardly with suppressed anger and anxiety (anger / resentment / rage) · pout: push out the lips to display petulant displeasure (lips / child / face)
groups.nuance_zh: brood: 郁郁寡欢地反复沉思挂怀 (injustice / defeat / failure) · sulk: 赌气不理人地生闷气 (child / loser / player) · mope: 垂头丧气地无精打采游荡 (around house / in bedroom) · stew: 在心头焦躁憋火发酵 (anger / resentment / rage) · pout: 撅嘴闹别扭以示不满 (lips / child / face)

groups.name: Build & Erect · 搭建与构筑框架 (Erect, Rafter, Frame, Assemble)
groups.tip: 平地起高楼的建筑过程

items.def_en: to construct or put together the structural framing of a building or roof
