items.ex_zh: 在简短的最后一句话中，演讲者极其清晰地概括了整场辩论。

items.def_en: to state the main points or an overall evaluation concisely
items.ex_en: The lead analyst took five minutes to sum up the quarterly financial performance.
items.ex_zh: 首席分析师花了五分钟时间概括总结了该季度的财务表现。

items.def_en: (+ sth) be summarized or reduced to its essential, most fundamental point
items.ex_en: The whole protracted political controversy really boils down to simple corporate greed.
items.ex_zh: 这整场旷日持久的政治争议归根结底其实就是赤裸裸的企业贪婪。

items.def_en: (+ sth) give a concluding summary of the main points of a discussion or meeting
items.ex_en: Let's wrap up this meeting so everyone can catch their flights.
items.ex_zh: 我们结束这次会议吧，这样大家都能赶上航班。

items.def_en: To give a brief summary or statement of the main points of something.
items.ex_en: The executive summary will summarize the key findings of the extensive market investigation.
items.ex_zh: 执行摘要将概述这项广泛市场调查的主要核心发现。

items.def_en: to state again briefly the principal points just made
items.ex_en: Before moving forward, let us quickly recap the primary safety procedures discussed earlier.
items.ex_zh: 在继续进行之前，让我们快速回顾一下先前讨论的主要安全规程。

items.def_en: to express the essential features of something in a very brief and pithy form
items.ex_en: Her brilliant concluding phrase managed to encapsulate the central theme of the entire conference.
items.ex_zh: 她那句精彩的总结性话语高度浓缩概括了整场大会的核心主题。

items.def_en: to repeat or summarize the main points in a formal discourse or lecture
items.ex_en: The guest lecturer paused briefly to recapitulate his central thesis before opening for questions.
items.ex_zh: 客座讲师稍作停顿，在开放提问之前先扼要重述了他的核心论点。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey the act of distilling extensive spoken or written discourse into an abridged statement of main points, ranging from general speech to formal academic and legal registers.
groups.summary_zh: 将大量言语或文本提炼出核心要点，涵盖日常与严谨语域。
groups.desc_en: Entails extracting, compressing, and stating the bare essentials or overarching conclusion of an extended discourse, contrasting with expanding or elaborating in full detail.
groups.desc_zh: 指提炼并浓缩长篇大论或复杂局面的核心精髓以作凝练复述，区别于展开细节或长篇大论。
groups.nuance_en: summarize: providing a comprehensive condensed statement of main points (report / argument / findings) · sum up: expressing the essence, total verdict, or concluding gist succinctly (speech / debate / situation) · recapitulate: systematically restating key headings or stages in concise order (points / history / themes) · encapsulate: capturing the spirit or whole substance within a tiny, potent vehicle (era / philosophy / message) · boil down to: reducing complex realities to their singular underlying bedrock (core / issue / question)
groups.nuance_zh: summarize: 标准化提要，概括主要论点 (report / argument / findings) · sum up: 结语式综述要旨或作总结评定 (speech / debate / situation) · recapitulate: 条理分明地重述纲要或发展阶段 (points / history / themes) · encapsulate: 极高度浓缩，将精神凝结于极简形式 (era / philosophy / message) · boil down to: 抽丝剥茧，归根结底还原为最根本的一点 (core / issue / question)

groups.name: Confer & Bestow · 赋予与授予 (Confer, Bestow, Endow, Vest)
groups.tip: 上级依制度赋予权利或资格

items.def_en: (+ with/in) to formally endow a person with authority, rights, or official ceremonial attire
items.ex_en: The historic national charter invested the presiding magistrate with ultimate discretionary judicial authority.
items.ex_zh: 这部具有历史意义的国家宪章正式赋予了主持法官终极的司法裁量权。

items.def_zh: 归属于；赋予（权力、财产权益）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) confer legal authority, property rights, or powers upon a designated entity
items.ex_en: Executive legislative authority shall vest in the newly established interim administrative council today.
items.ex_zh: 行政立法权力自今日起正式归属于新成立的临时管理委员会。

items.def_en: (+ sb) formally induct someone into public office or confer official duties via an oath
items.ex_en: The new president will be sworn in on January 20th.
items.ex_zh: 新总统将于1月20日宣誓就职。

items.def_zh: 授予，赋予（权力、财产等）；归属于
items.def_en: 1. (usually 'be vested in/with') To confer or give legal authority, rights, or property to someone. 2. To become legally owned or held by someone.
items.ex_en: The revised constitution vested broad emergency administrative powers in the democratically elected president.
items.ex_zh: 修改后的宪法赋予了民主选举出的总统广泛的紧急行政权力。

items.def_en: To grant a permanent, tenured academic or professional position to someone.
items.ex_en: The university board voted unanimously to tenure the brilliant young theoretical physics professor.
items.ex_zh: 大学董事会一致投票决定授予那位才华横溢的年轻理论物理学教授终身教职。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to grant a title, award, degree, or benefit formally as a high institutional body
items.ex_en: The prestigious university decided to confer an honorary doctoral degree upon the philanthropic diplomat.
items.ex_zh: 这所知名大学决定授予那位热心慈善的外交家荣誉博士学位。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to present an honour, gift, or right to someone as an act of generosity or esteem
items.ex_en: The elderly monarch chose to bestow a royal knighthood on the distinguished humanitarian.
items.ex_zh: 年迈的君主决定赐予这位杰出的人道主义者皇家爵士爵位。

items.def_zh: 赋予（才能/特权），捐赠设立
items.def_en: (+ with) to provide someone or an institution with a permanent source of income, quality, or asset
items.ex_en: Nature seemed to endow the prodigy with exceptional musical and mathematical abilities from birth.
items.ex_zh: 大自然似乎从这位神童出生起便赋予了他非凡的音乐和数学才能。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the formal, ceremonial, or legal act of imparting rights, power, honors, privileges, or academic permanency onto an individual or entity.
groups.summary_zh: 依据法律、传统或权威机制，正式授予某人权力、荣誉、资产或永久任职资格。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to formally, legally, or graciously imparting an honor, office, legal right, or natural quality upon a recipient, differing from physical hand-to-hand transferring or buying.
groups.desc_zh: 指以庄严、法律或恩典形式向受让方赋予荣誉、职位、法定权力或天赋禀赋，区别于一般的物理转交或买卖。
groups.nuance_en: confer: officially granting a title, degree, or benefit after deliberation (degree / honor / legitimacy) · bestow: graciously or generously gifting an honor or treasure upon someone (gift / blessing / favor) · endow: permanently providing with an innate quality, talent, or perpetual fund (faculty / university / hospital) · vest: legally fixing rights, power, or authority firmly in an office or person (power / authority / shares) · invest: ceremonially installing someone into an office or cloaking with authority (dignity / powers / authority)
groups.nuance_zh: confer: 审议商榷后正式授予头衔、学位或特权 (degree / honor / legitimacy) · bestow: 带有恩赏或庄重意味地赐予馈赠 (gift / blessing / favor) · endow: 赋予天资、才赋或永久性注资设立基金 (faculty / university / hospital) · vest: 在法律上把权力、权利不可剥夺地归属于某人 (power / authority / shares) · invest: 举行庄重仪式封拜授职赋予权能 (dignity / powers / authority)

groups.name: Confine & Imprison · 束缚与监禁 (Confine, Imprison, Incarcerate)
groups.tip: 缩限行动范围直至关押

items.def_en: to keep someone or something inside the limits of a particular activity, subject, or space
items.ex_en: The warden ordered the guards to confine the violent inmate to solitary isolation.
items.ex_zh: 监狱长命令狱警将那名有暴力倾向的囚犯单独监禁于隔离牢房。

items.def_zh: 把……圈禁在狭小空间；束缚
items.def_en: (+ sb) confine or restrict someone within a tightly limited space
items.ex_en: Police officers used metal barricades to pen in the protesters within the plaza.
items.ex_zh: 警官们用金属路障将抗议者圈禁在广场之内。

items.def_en: (+ sb) confine someone in a secluded place away from the outside world
items.ex_en: The tyrant chose to shut away political dissidents in remote mountain fortresses.
items.ex_zh: 暴君选择将政治异见人士幽禁在偏远的山间堡垒中。

items.def_zh: 关入笼中；严密封锁限制
items.def_en: to shut or enclose someone or an animal in a cage or cramped space
items.ex_en: Poachers often cage wild monkeys in cramped enclosures before selling them unlawfully.
items.ex_zh: 偷猎者在非法出售野生猴子之前，往往先把它们关在狭小的笼子里。

items.def_zh: 禁锢，限制（在狭小空间内）
items.def_en: 1. To confine or restrict someone to a small or narrow space.
items.ex_en: Long winter storms cabin him within the dreary walls of the lonely cottage.
items.ex_zh: 漫长的冬日风暴将他禁锢在孤寂小屋沉闷的四壁之内。

items.def_en: (+ sb) confine someone securely in a prison, cell, or locked room
items.ex_en: Guards lock up dangerous offenders in maximum-security cells every evening at nine.
items.ex_zh: 狱警每晚九点都会将危险罪犯关押在高度戒备的牢房里。

items.def_en: 1. To put someone in prison, or to confine them and limit their freedom.
items.ex_en: The authoritarian government sought to imprison journalists who dared question its policies.
items.ex_zh: 该专制政府企图监禁敢于质疑其政策的记者。

items.def_zh: 关押；监禁（法律正式称谓）
items.def_en: (formal) to put someone in prison or keep them in a place they cannot leave
items.ex_en: The military tribunal decided to incarcerate the convicted traitor for thirty years.
items.ex_zh: 军事法庭决定将这名定罪的叛国者监禁三十年。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physically restricting a person's freedom of movement, escalating from confining someone to tight quarters up to formal penal incarceration.
groups.summary_zh: 剥夺行动自由，从限制在狭窄空间到正式入狱监禁。
groups.desc_en: Captures the strict physical restriction of liberty by locking an entity within an enclosed, bounded, or punitive space, contrasting with loose monitoring or open detention.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过围墙、栅栏或牢门将个体的行动自由严格限制在封闭狭小或惩罚性空间内，区别于开敞式羁押或松散监视。
groups.nuance_en: confine: restricting movement within narrow physical or medical boundaries (quarters / space / wheelchair) · imprison: legally locking away in a penal institution for crime (felons / criminals / rebels) · incarcerate: formal or systemic state detention behind bars (inmates / dissidents / offenders) · pen in: restricting animals or crowds into a tight, enclosed paddock (livestock / crowd / protesters) · cage: trapping within metal bars or wire mesh like an animal (animals / tiger / prisoner)
groups.nuance_zh: confine: 限制在狭窄物理或医疗界限之内不得外出 (quarters / space / wheelchair) · imprison: 依据司法判决投入牢狱剥夺人身自由 (felons / criminals / rebels) · incarcerate: 正式、制度化地关押监禁于铁窗之后 (inmates / dissidents / offenders) · pen in: 像圈牲口般将人群或动物围困在封闭围栏中 (livestock / crowd / protesters) · cage: 如禽兽般关入带铁条或铁丝网的笼子中 (animals / tiger / prisoner)

groups.name: Continuous Fluid Motion · 流动与穿流 (Flow, Stream, Run)
groups.tip: 如水流般连续涌动

items.def_en: to move along with a continuous, smooth, quiet, and effortless motion
items.ex_en: Swans glide effortlessly across the tranquil surface of the sunlit mountain lake.
items.ex_zh: 天鹅在阳光洒照的宁静高山湖面上毫不费力地平稳滑行。

items.def_en: flow smoothly or overflow past a boundary or rim
items.ex_en: Heavy autumn rains caused boiling floodwaters to spill over the stone embankment.
items.ex_zh: 连绵秋雨导致汹涌的洪水漫过了石质堤坝。

items.def_en: (+ down/from) to flow in a steady liquid stream
items.ex_en: Warm tears began to run down her pale cheeks during the emotional farewell.
items.ex_zh: 在动情的道别中，温热的泪水顺着她苍白的脸颊流淌下来。
items.ex2_en: The technician ran cooling water through the overheated radiator pipe.
items.ex2_zh: 技术人员将冷却水注入过热的散热器管道中。

items.def_en: enter or arrive continuously in large numbers or volumes like a flowing current
items.ex_en: Thousands of excited fans began to flood in through the stadium's north gates.
items.ex_zh: 成千上万兴奋的球迷开始如潮水般从体育场的北门涌入。

items.def_en: flow or stream continuously and rapidly out of an enclosure in large quantities
items.ex_en: She poured out her troubles to her best friend over coffee.
items.ex_zh: 她一边喝咖啡一边向闺蜜倾诉自己的烦恼。
items.ex2_en: Tearful grievances poured out uncontrollably as she confronted her estranged family members.
items.ex2_zh: 当她面对疏远的家人时，满腹委屈泪如雨下地倾泻而出。

items.def_en: (+ through/down) to move without interruption along a defined trajectory, usually quickly
items.ex_en: Sudden adrenaline coursed through his tense veins as the nocturnal predator approached.
items.ex_zh: 当那只夜间捕食者靠近时，突然涌起的肾上腺素在他的紧绷血管中奔流。

items.def_zh: 流动，涌动；畅流，连贯流动；飘扬，飘拂
items.def_en: To move steadily and continuously in one direction like water or another liquid; to move along smoothly and without interruption.
items.ex_en: Melted glacial waters flow steadily down the rugged valley into the reservoir.
items.ex_zh: 融化的冰川之水持续不断地顺着崎岖的山谷流进水库。

items.def_zh: 流，流动，涌；飘动，飘扬；流出（液体）；在线流式传输（音视频）
items.def_en: 1. To move or flow continuously and in large amounts, like a stream. 2. To wave or float outward freely in the wind. 3. To transmit or receive continuous audio or video data over the internet.
items.ex_en: Morning sunlight began to stream through the large bay window into the hall.
items.ex_zh: 晨曦开始透过宽大的飘窗倾泻进大厅。
items.ex2_en: The projection room streamed live footage across the auditorium screen.
items.ex2_zh: 放映室将实时画面推流到了礼堂的大屏幕上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate the steady, continuous, fluid-like movement of liquids, traffic, or crowds moving smoothly along a course or path.
groups.summary_zh: 指液体、人流或车流沿特定通道或方向持续、平稳地漫流穿行。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the smooth, uninterrupted, and continuous translational motion characteristic of fluids advancing along a channel or gradient, contrasting with sudden bursts or static containment.
groups.desc_zh: 指流体沿着通道、坡度平稳、不间断且具连贯性的运动表征，区别于断续喷射或静止容纳。
groups.nuance_en: flow: baseline smooth, continuous forward movement of liquids (water / blood / current) · stream: moving steadily in a narrow, well-defined directional course (tears / sunlight / commuters) · run: rapid liquid movement or dripping unchecked (tears / tap / river) · course: moving swiftly, powerfully, and purposefully through systemic channels (veins / blood / river) · pour out: discharging in large, heavy, unbroken volume (liquid / crowds / rain)
groups.nuance_zh: flow: 最通用的流体平稳连贯地流淌向前 (water / blood / current) · stream: 如细流般源源不断、呈线性定向流动 (tears / sunlight / commuters) · run: 水流快速淌下、淌落或失控外流 (tears / tap / river) · course: 奔腾奔流，在既定脉络或河道中强力穿流 (veins / blood / river) · pour out: 大量、倾注式地一涌而出 (liquid / crowds / rain)

groups.name: Convey & Carry by Specialized Means · 载运与运送 (Porter, Smuggle, Ferry)
groups.tip: 肩扛手提搬运货物

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) transport or carry someone or something away, especially in a vehicle or with effort
items.ex_en: Police arrived promptly to cart off the unruly patrons from the noisy pub.
items.ex_zh: 警察迅速赶到，把那些闹事的顾客从嘈杂的酒吧里拉走了。

items.def_zh: 摆渡；渡运（人员或货物）穿过
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth across sth) transport people or cargo across a body of water or designated route
items.ex_en: The barge operator offered to ferry across stranded tourists and their bulky vehicles.
items.ex_zh: 驳船运营商主动提出将滞留的游客和他们庞大的车辆摆渡过去。

items.def_en: to convey passengers or goods regularly from one place to another across water or along a route
items.ex_en: Local boatmen ferry daily commuters between the mainland and the isolated fishing village.
items.ex_zh: 当地船夫在大陆和孤立的渔村之间穿梭运送日常通勤者。

items.def_en: to convey goods or burdensome items in a vehicle or by hand over distances
items.ex_en: The farmer had to cart heavy wooden crates across the muddy orchard road.
items.ex_zh: 农夫不得不穿过泥泞的果园小路吃力地运送沉重的木箱。

items.def_en: (+ sth) carry something heavy, clumsy, or cumbersome from place to place
items.ex_en: I hate having to lug around this massive reference book all afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 我讨厌整个下午都得吃力地随身带着这本厚重的大部头参考书。

items.def_en: to pull or transport large quantities of heavy goods by truck, cart, or ship
items.ex_en: Large freight trucks haul industrial machinery through the narrow mountain passes daily.
items.ex_zh: 大型货运卡车每天都在狭窄的山口之间拖运工业机械。

items.def_en: To carry luggage, supplies, or heavy loads, especially as a porter.
items.ex_en: Sherpas were hired to porter heavy climbing gear up the treacherous ridge.
items.ex_zh: 夏尔巴人受雇将沉重的攀登装备挑运上凶险的山脊。

items.def_en: To take, send, or bring goods or people secretly and illegally into or out of a place.
items.ex_en: Criminal syndicates attempted to smuggle rare antiquities past the maritime border patrol.
items.ex_zh: 犯罪集团企图瞒过海上边防巡逻队走私珍稀文物。

groups.summary_en: Agents transfer physical cargo or individuals using specific modes, channels, or physical roles, whether by manual conveyance, clandestine transit, or shuttling.
groups.summary_zh: 借助特定承运身份、交通工具或隐秘通道运送物资及人员。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on transporting cargo or passengers utilizing specific vehicles, arduous manual conveyance, or illicit covert channels, differing from natural locomotion.
groups.desc_zh: 指借助专业交通工具、艰苦的人力搬运或隐蔽非法通道来转运人或货物，区别于自主行走或自然散发。
groups.nuance_en: ferry: conveying people or goods regularly back and forth across a natural barrier (passengers / cars / supplies) · cart: transporting heavy, bulky loads unceremoniously in a wheeled vehicle (produce / luggage / boxes) · haul: pulling or transporting heavy loads over distance with great effort (cargo / timber / freight) · lug: laboriously carrying heavy, awkward items by hand (luggage / suitcases / equipment) · smuggle: conveying contraband secretly and illegally across borders (drugs / weapons / cash)
groups.nuance_zh: ferry: 摆渡，借助轮渡或载具在固定两点间穿梭转运 (passengers / cars / supplies) · cart: 用简陋车皮转运大批沉重杂物 (produce / luggage / boxes) · haul: 用重型卡车长途拖运大宗沉重物资 (cargo / timber / freight) · lug: 吃力笨重地手提肩抗随身搬运 (luggage / suitcases / equipment) · smuggle: 瞒天过海，非法秘密夹带偷运违禁品 (drugs / weapons / cash)

groups.name: Convulse & Shimmy · 抽搐与抖动 (Involuntary or Rhythmic Oscillatory Movement)
groups.tip: 肌肉不由自主地剧烈痉挛抽动

items.def_en: to shake with a slight, rapid, tremulous movement
items.ex_en: Delicate autumn leaves quiver softly in the chill evening breeze across the meadow.
items.ex_zh: 纤弱的秋叶在穿过草甸的傍晚凉风中微微颤动。

items.def_en: [I/T] to give a short, sudden, involuntary jerking movement
items.ex_en: His tired left eyelid began to twitch uncontrollably during the stressful meeting.
items.ex_zh: 在压力巨大的会议中，他疲惫的左眼皮开始不受控地抽动。
items.ex2_en: The playful cat twitched its furry ears at every faint sound.
items.ex2_zh: 这只调皮的猫对每一个微弱的声音都会抖动毛茸茸的耳朵。

items.def_zh: 晃动，异常抖动，振颤；跳希米舞（摇摆臀部和肩膀）
items.def_en: To shake, vibrate, or wobble abnormally from side to side; to dance with smooth, shaking movements of the hips and shoulders.
items.ex_en: The front wheels began to shimmy violently at higher highway travel speeds.
items.ex_zh: 在较高的公路行驶速度下，前轮开始剧烈晃动起来。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) jar physically or cause to vibrate and jolt violently
items.ex_en: The new CEO plans to shake up the entire management structure.
items.ex_zh: 新任首席执行官计划对整个管理架构进行大洗牌。

items.def_en: to shake violently and momentarily, typically as a result of fear, cold, or disgust
items.ex_en: She could not help but shudder with disgust at the horrifying sight.
items.ex_zh: 面对那可怕的景象，她禁不住厌恶地战栗了一下。

items.def_en: become suddenly rigid, paralyzed, or painfully locked by muscle spasm
items.ex_en: His lower back muscles began to seize up after hours of strenuous lifting.
items.ex_zh: 经过数小时的重体力搬运后，他的下背部肌肉开始痉挛僵死。

items.def_en: to experience sudden, involuntary, painful muscle contractions
items.ex_en: The athlete collapsed when his right calf began to spasm from extreme dehydration.
items.ex_zh: 当右小腿因极度脱水开始剧烈抽筋时，这名运动员倒了下去。

items.def_zh: （使）抽搐，（使）痉挛；剧烈震颤，剧烈动荡
items.def_en: To shake violently with sudden, uncontrollable muscle spasms, or cause someone to do so; to undergo or cause violent agitation.
items.ex_en: The venom caused the victim's limbs to convulse uncontrollably within minutes.
items.ex_zh: 蛇毒在数分钟内就让受害者的四肢发生了剧烈抽搐。
items.ex2_en: The experimental serum convulsed the laboratory monkey with terrifying muscle spasms.
items.ex2_zh: 这种实验性血清让实验猴因可怕的肌肉痉挛而剧烈抽搐。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses involuntary, rapid, or uncontrolled bodily vibrations, scaling from subtle, rhythmic wobbles to violent, full-body physiological spasms.
groups.summary_zh: 身体出现的不自主或节律性震颤，涵盖从轻微摇颤到剧烈肌肉抽搐的强度谱系。
groups.desc_en: Denotes involuntary, rapid, or rhythmic oscillatory movements driven by neuro-muscular distress or kinetic instability, differing from deliberate shaking or smooth vibration.
groups.desc_zh: 指由神经肌肉异常或机械动能失衡引起的非自发、剧烈或节律性震颤摇晃，区别于受控的晃动或平稳振动。
groups.nuance_en: twitch: brief, localized involuntary jerk (eyelid / muscle / lip) · shudder: sudden convulsive tremor from horror or cold (body / engine / frame) · spasm: involuntary muscular contraction or sudden disruption (back / artery / diaphragm) · convulse: violent, full-body paroxysmal shaking (patient / crowd / laughter) · shimmy: rapid lateral vibrational wobble (wheels / dancer / chassis)
groups.nuance_zh: twitch: 局部短促抽动 (eyelid / muscle / lip) · shudder: 因恐惧、寒冷或剧震产生的全身战栗 (body / engine / frame) · spasm: 肌肉阵发性痉挛或功能突发骤停 (back / artery / diaphragm) · convulse: 剧烈抽搐或翻腾震荡 (patient / crowd / laughter) · shimmy: 异常横向快速摆动晃荡 (wheels / dancer / chassis)

groups.name: Cool & Freeze · 降温与冷冻 (Cool, Chill, Refrigerate, Deep-freeze)
groups.tip: 降温结霜甚至冰封

items.def_en: to become less warm, or to make something less warm without reaching freezing
items.ex_en: Leave the freshly baked berry pie on the counter to cool gradually.
items.ex_zh: 把刚烤好的浆果派放在料理台上渐渐冷却。
items.ex2_en: You should cool the boiled soup before putting it into storage.
items.ex2_zh: 在将煮好的汤存放起来之前，你应该先让它冷却。

items.def_en: become lower in temperature, or cause something to lose heat
items.ex_en: Give him a few minutes to cool down before discussing the issue.
items.ex_zh: 在讨论这个问题之前，先给他几分钟冷静一下。
items.ex2_en: A cold drink will cool down the exhausted marathon runners after finishing.
items.ex2_zh: 一杯冷饮会让跑完马拉松后筋疲力竭的跑者们冷静降温。

items.def_en: to make something thoroughly cold, usually in a refrigerator, but above freezing point
items.ex_en: The chef decided to chill the white wine before serving the banquet.
items.ex_zh: 主厨决定在上宴席前先把白葡萄酒彻底冰镇一下。
items.ex2_en: The fresh lemonade chilled in the refrigerator before the summer picnic.
items.ex2_zh: 新鲜的柠檬水在夏季野餐前放入冰箱冰镇冷却。

items.def_en: (+ sth) lower the temperature of food, drink, or an object significantly
items.ex_en: Be sure to chill down the broth quickly before storing it safely overnight.
items.ex_zh: 在安全存放过夜之前，务必先把肉汤迅速彻底冷却降温。
items.ex2_en: The thick stew chilled down rapidly in the commercial freezer overnight.
items.ex2_zh: 浓稠的炖汤在商用冰柜中过夜迅速降温了。

items.def_zh: （使）结霜，（使）覆上霜；（在糕点上）涂糖霜
items.def_en: 1. to become covered with frost, or cover something with ice crystals. 2. to cover a cake or baked goods with icing.
items.ex_en: Subzero temperatures overnight caused moisture to frost the windshield of every parked car.
items.ex_zh: 夜间的零下低温使湿气在每辆停放车辆的挡风玻璃上凝结成了霜。
items.ex2_en: The kitchen window frosted over rapidly during the bitter winter night.
items.ex2_zh: 在严寒的冬夜里，厨房窗户迅速结满了一层霜。

items.def_en: to keep food, drinks, or medicine cold in a refrigerator to prevent spoiling
items.ex_en: You must refrigerate these biological samples immediately to ensure they do not spoil.
items.ex_zh: 你必须立即冷藏这些生物样本，以防它们变质。

items.def_en: become completely covered with a layer of hard ice
items.ex_en: The lake usually freezes over by late December.
items.ex_zh: 这个湖通常在十二月下旬完全封冻。
items.ex2_en: Arctic cold snaps often freeze over the broad surface of northern rivers.
items.ex2_zh: 北极寒潮经常将北方河流开阔的水面完全冻结封冻。

items.def_en: to freeze food quickly at very low temperatures for long-term storage
items.ex_en: Commercial trawlers deep-freeze raw tuna right at sea to preserve peak freshness.
items.ex_zh: 商业拖网渔船在海上就直接对生鲜金枪鱼进行极温速冻，以保持最佳新鲜度。

groups.summary_en: This scale captures the lowering of temperature, progressing from gentle cooling to standard refrigeration and culminating in sub-zero freezing. Verbs vary primarily by target temperature and commercial/domestic intent.
groups.summary_zh: 按降温程度从温和凉化、冷藏保鲜递进至极端深度冷冻。
groups.desc_en: Covers thermal energy extraction across varying thresholds of cold, ranging from gentle thermal moderation to solidifying sub-zero preservation, unlike simple passive cooling in ambient air.
groups.desc_zh: 涵盖不同程度的降温与锁鲜过程，从温和降温、保鲜冷藏延伸至深层冰冻固化，区别于常温下的自然凉透。
groups.nuance_en: cool: moderate reduction of heat (soup / engine / temper) · chill: lower to cold but unfrozen temperatures (wine / air / spine) · refrigerate: mechanically preserve food at low temperatures (milk / vaccines / perishables) · deep-freeze: freeze rapidly at extreme sub-zero temperatures (meat / vegetables / assets)
groups.nuance_zh: cool: 温和降温或使之凉爽 (soup / engine / temper) · chill: 显著致凉但不结冰 (wine / air / spine) · refrigerate: 机械冷藏保鲜 (milk / vaccines / perishables) · deep-freeze: 极低温速冻或长期冻结 (meat / vegetables / assets)

groups.name: Correct & Rectify · 纠错与扶正拨乱 (Correct, Rectify, Redress)
groups.tip: 纠正偏差恢复正常状态

items.def_zh: 纠正，纠偏；使扶直，使恢复正常（或平衡）；为……昭雪
items.def_en: 1. To correct a mistake, wrong, or unfair situation; make right. 2. To return or restore something to an upright or proper position.
items.ex_en: The new legislation sought to right centuries of profound injustice against minorities.
items.ex_zh: 这项新法规旨在纠正数世纪以来针对少数群体的深刻不公。
items.ex2_en: The overturned sailboat righted itself after the violent squall subsided.
items.ex2_zh: 狂风平息后，倾覆的帆船自己扶正了过来。

items.def_en: 1. To fix or remove errors, flaws, or mistakes from something. 2. To mark the errors in a student's work or a test.
items.ex_en: The diligent teacher stayed late to correct dozens of handwritten history essays.
items.ex_zh: 勤勉的老师留到很晚，批改了几十篇手写的历史论文。

items.def_zh: 解决；纠正偏差；理清错乱
items.def_en: (+ sth) resolve an error, misunderstanding, or confused and irregular situation
items.ex_en: Our financial advisors will quickly straighten out the billing discrepancies for you.
items.ex_zh: 我们的财务顾问会迅速为你理清这些账单出入。

items.def_zh: 理顺；纠正解决（问题或失误）
items.def_en: (+ sth) rectify a problem, resolve a difficulty, or restore an irregular condition to order
items.ex_en: The manager held an emergency meeting to sort out the logistics nightmare.
items.ex_zh: 经理召开了一次紧急会议，以解决这场后勤乱局。

items.def_zh: 纠正；拨乱反正；改正错误
items.def_en: (+ sth) correct a mistake, injustice, or malfunction so that proper order is restored
items.ex_en: The newly appointed ombudsman worked tirelessly to set right the agency's past errors.
items.ex_zh: 新任命的监察专员不知疲倦地工作，以纠正该机构过去的错误。

items.def_en: to make minor changes or improvements to text, law, or behavior to correct faults
items.ex_en: Lawmakers convened yesterday to amend outdated provisions regarding digital privacy rights.
items.ex_zh: 立法者昨日齐聚一堂，对有关数字隐私权的过时条款进行修正。

items.def_zh: 纠正，矫正（错误或不良状况）
items.def_en: (formal) to put right an undesirable situation, mistake, or imbalance
items.ex_en: Technicians worked around the clock to rectify the software vulnerability before launch.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员夜以继日地工作，以在发布前纠正软件中的漏洞。

items.def_zh: 纠正，平反，补偿（不公或损害）
items.def_en: (formal) to remedy or set right an unfair, undesirable, or unequal situation
items.ex_en: The court ordered the company to redress the financial harm caused to consumers.
items.ex_zh: 法院责令该公司对消费者造成的经济损失进行赔偿与纠偏。

groups.summary_en: An agent identifies an error, injustice, or physical misalignment and restores the situation to its proper, accurate, or upright state. Verbs range from routine marking of errors to formal moral redress or physically setting something upright.
groups.summary_zh: 发现偏差、错误或不公后，将其纠正、拨正或恢复到正确与公平状态。
groups.desc_en: Involves intervening in an erroneous, disordered, or unjust condition to restore alignment with an established standard, law, or moral ideal, unlike merely improving a baseline state.
groups.desc_zh: 指针对错误、偏离或不公状态进行干预以恢复基准、正轨或公道，区别于在正常状态上的常规改进。
groups.nuance_en: correct: remove specific factual errors or deviations (mistake / posture / test) · amend: modify formal wording or legislation to improve it (constitution / bill / contract) · rectify: fundamentally resolve an unfair, deficient, or faulty situation (injustice / error / imbalance) · redress: remedy or compensate for a grievance or wrong (grievance / wrong / balance)
groups.nuance_zh: correct: 纠正具体错误或纠正偏离 (mistake / posture / test) · amend: 修订文本或法律条文 (constitution / bill / contract) · rectify: 彻底矫正失衡、缺陷或不当局面 (injustice / error / imbalance) · redress: 补偿、昭雪或纠正所受冤屈 (grievance / wrong / balance)

groups.name: Corrupt & Degrade · 腐蚀与堕落 (Corrupt, Degrade, Deprave)
groups.tip: 内在品德变质从蚕食到堕落

items.def_en: to contaminate morally or impart an undesirable defect to character
items.ex_en: Greed and unchecked ambition will eventually taint the pure ideals of youth.
items.ex_zh: 贪婪和未受节制的野心最终将玷污年轻时纯洁的理想。

items.def_en: to reduce the moral quality, value, or dignity of someone or something
items.ex_en: Corrupt politicians often debase the integrity of democratic institutions for personal gain.
items.ex_zh: 腐败政客常为了个人私利贬低民主机构的尊严与操守。

items.def_zh: 拉下水，使（道德/地位）堕落
items.def_en: (+ sb) to lower someone's moral standards or social standing to an inferior level
items.ex_en: Rising energy costs could drag down the entire manufacturing sector.
items.ex_zh: 不断上涨的能源成本可能会拖垮整个制造业。

items.def_zh: 引诱入歧途，使误入歧途
items.def_en: (+ sb) to encourage someone to do bad, immoral, or foolish things
items.ex_en: Disreputable peers conspired to lead astray the naive heir into reckless gambling.
items.ex_zh: 声名狼藉的狐朋狗友合谋引诱不谙世事的继承人误入放纵赌博的歧途。

items.def_zh: 使堕落，腐蚀；贿赂；破坏，损坏（数据等）
items.def_en: 1. To cause someone to become morally bad or dishonest, especially by offering bribes. 2. To damage, alter, or spoil something (such as computer data or a text).
items.ex_en: Dishonest officials managed to corrupt the fair bidding process through lavish payoffs.
items.ex_zh: 不诚实的官员通过巨额贿赂败坏了原本公正的招标程序。
items.ex2_en: Ancient legal records corrupt easily under poor environmental conditions over centuries.
items.ex2_zh: 在恶劣的环境条件下，古老的法律文献经过几个世纪很容易腐烂损坏。

items.def_en: to alter something from its original, rightful course or corrupt someone sexually or morally
items.ex_en: Bribed witnesses tried to pervert the course of justice with fabricated testimonies.
items.ex_zh: 被收买的证人企图用捏造的证词破坏司法公正的正常走向。

items.def_en: (formal) To make someone morally bad or evil; to corrupt someone's character.
items.ex_en: Vile temptations served only to deprave his once noble and generous character.
items.ex_zh: 卑劣的诱惑只会败坏他曾经高贵而慷慨的品性。

items.def_en: to corrupt someone morally through sensual indulgence and dissipation
items.ex_en: Wild decadence and luxury threatened to debauch the young noblemen of court.
items.ex_zh: 放荡的堕落与奢靡险些让宫廷里的年轻贵族们沉湎酒色、心志败坏。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses moral and ethical decay, tracing how integrity, innocence, or character is systematically eroded. The scale progresses from taint and debasement to complete moral depravity and perversion.
groups.summary_zh: 道德伦理遭受浸染蚀退，直至走向极度堕落与败坏。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the progressive moral, spiritual, or institutional degradation of integrity through pernicious external influence, contrasting with organic physical decay.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过恶劣的外部侵蚀使道德、操守或体制逐步走向败坏与堕落，区别于纯粹的物理腐烂。
groups.nuance_en: taint: spoil purity or integrity with a touch of corruption (reputation / sample / honor) · corrupt: undermine the integrity or legality of an agent or system (official / system / youth) · pervert: redirect a good or natural thing to a deviant, wrongful end (justice / truth / course) · deprave: warp and degrade moral character severely (mind / soul / morals) · debauch: lead into destructive sensual or hedonistic excess (youth / innocents / palate)
groups.nuance_zh: taint: 玷污名誉或使纯洁性受损 (reputation / sample / honor) · corrupt: 贿赂收买或使系统/道德败坏 (official / system / youth) · pervert: 歪曲颠倒正当事物或原则 (justice / truth / course) · deprave: 使心智或道德极度堕落 (mind / soul / morals) · debauch: 引诱放荡或沉溺声色 (youth / innocents / palate)

groups.name: Crash & Impact · 撞击与拍击 (Splat, Broadside, T-bone)
groups.tip: 猛烈冲击或高速相撞

items.def_zh: 发出啪嗒声地撞在……上，摔得稀烂；使发出吧嗒声撞击
items.def_en: (informal) to hit a surface with a wet, flat sound, or to cause something to land this way.
items.ex_en: The overripe watermelon fell from the tailgate and splatted on the concrete.
items.ex_zh: 熟透的西瓜从车尾挡板掉下来，啪嗒一声摔在水泥地上砸得稀烂。
items.ex2_en: The careless child splatted a scoop of mashed potatoes onto the floor.
items.ex2_zh: 那个粗心的小孩把一勺土豆泥啪的一声拍在了地板上。

items.def_en: (+ sth/sb) collide with or hit another vehicle, object, or pedestrian
items.ex_en: A distracted driver ran into the stone pillar outside the shopping center.
items.ex_zh: 一名分心的司机撞上了购物中心外面的石柱。

items.def_en: to strike a vehicle or object along the side with a glancing blow
items.ex_en: The speeding delivery van sideswiped three parked sedans along the narrow street.
items.ex_zh: 那辆飞驰的快递面包车刮蹭了窄街上停靠的三辆轿车侧面。

items.def_en: (+ sth/sb) crash forcefully and violently into someone or something, often without slowing down
items.ex_en: The runaway semi-truck plowed into the highway guardrail during the storm.
items.ex_zh: 失控的半挂卡车在暴风雨中猛烈撞上了公路护栏。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ into/against) to crash or hit something with great impact and loud noise
items.ex_en: The out-of-control vehicle slammed into the heavy steel barricade with enormous force.
items.ex_zh: 失控的车辆以巨大的冲击力砰地猛撞在重型钢制路障上。
items.ex2_en: The frustrated driver slammed the heavy car door against the concrete post.
items.ex2_zh: 沮丧的司机把沉重的车门猛地撞在了水泥柱上。

items.def_en: to crash into the side of another vehicle at a right angle
items.ex_en: An SUV ran the red light and T-boned our compact rental car.
items.ex_zh: 一辆SUV闯了红灯，拦腰撞上了我们租来的紧凑型轿车。

items.def_en: (chiefly North American) to crash directly into the side of another vehicle.
items.ex_en: The speeding pickup truck broadsided the station wagon at the blind intersection.
items.ex_zh: 超速行驶的皮卡在视线受阻的十字路口猛烈撞击了旅行车的侧面。

items.def_en: (+ sth/sb) collide with an object or vehicle with tremendous, destructive force
items.ex_en: A heavy falling branch smashed into the windshield during the fierce gale.
items.ex_zh: 在狂风呼啸中，一根掉落的粗大树枝猛烈撞碎了挡风玻璃。

groups.summary_en: Objects impact surfaces or other moving vehicles in specific geometric angles or explosive textures. Nuances emphasize specific impact modes such as a liquid/soft entity hitting flat with a splash, or a vehicle smashing perpendicular into the flank of another.
groups.summary_zh: 描述特定的撞击形态（如侧面拦腰猛撞、湿软物啪嗒撞碎）。
groups.desc_en: Specifies high-energy, violent physical collisions characterized by the specific angle, blunt force, or spatial orientation of impact, rather than generic contact.
groups.desc_zh: 特指伴随剧烈冲击力、特定撞击角度或受力形态的猛烈碰撞，而非宽泛的接触或碰擦。
groups.nuance_en: sideswipe: strike along the side with a glancing blow (car / barrier / mirror) · T-bone: collide directly perpendicularly into the side of a vehicle (vehicle / truck / sedan) · broadside: strike or be struck broadside-on with massive force (freighter / yacht / target) · plow into: crash into something with unstoppable forward momentum (crowd / barricade / building) · splat: strike a flat surface with a wet, flattening impact (bug / tomato / mud)
groups.nuance_zh: sideswipe: 侧面刮擦碰撞 (car / barrier / mirror) · T-bone: 垂直直角拦腰撞击 (vehicle / truck / sedan) · broadside: 侧舷迎头撞击或横向猛撞 (freighter / yacht / target) · plow into: 带着不可遏止的动量猛烈撞入 (crowd / barricade / building) · splat: 软/湿物体啪嗒撞碎在平面上 (bug / tomato / mud)

groups.name: Cross & Traverse Natural Obstacles · 跨越与穿行 (Pass, Ford)
groups.tip: 涉水越障从一侧到达另一侧

items.def_zh: 穿过，越过；传递；度过；通过（考试、法律等）
items.def_en: 1. To go across, through, or past someone or something. 2. To hand or transfer something to someone. 3. To spend time. 4. To succeed in a test or be officially approved.
items.ex_en: Tired hikers had to pass the narrow canyon before dusk fell completely.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的徒步者必须在夜幕完全降临前穿过狭窄的峡谷。
items.ex2_en: The busy waiter quickly passed the basket of bread across the table.
items.ex2_zh: 忙碌的服务员迅速把面包篮递过了餐桌。

items.def_en: [I/T] to go from one side of a road, river, or room to the other
items.ex_en: Careful pedestrians cross the busy avenue only when the walk signal illuminates.
items.ex_zh: 谨慎的行人只有在步行信号灯亮起时才会横过繁忙的大街。

items.def_zh: 涉过，涉水穿过（河流等浅水处）
items.def_en: 1. To cross a river or other shallow body of water on foot or in a vehicle.
items.ex_en: Weary cavalrymen prepared to ford the icy river under the midnight moon.
items.ex_zh: 疲倦的骑兵们准备在午夜的月光下涉水渡过冰冷的河流。

items.def_zh: 抄近路穿过（田地、开阔地等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) pass through an area, field, or open space to take a shorter route
items.ex_en: Environmental concerns cut across traditional party lines.
items.ex_zh: 环境问题超越了传统的政党界限。

items.def_en: (+ sth) walk through shallow water, such as a stream or river, to reach the opposite bank
items.ex_en: We took off our heavy boots to wade across the shallow creek.
items.ex_zh: 我们脱下厚重的靴子，涉水趟过了这条浅溪。

items.def_en: (+ sth) set off and journey directly across an expanse of terrain
items.ex_en: The explorers resolved to strike across the vast, arid desert at daybreak.
items.ex_zh: 探险家们决心在拂晓时分直接拔足穿过这片辽阔而干旱的荒漠。

items.def_en: (+ across/through) to walk through water, mud, or thick snow that impedes motion
items.ex_en: Rescuers had to wade through waist-deep murky waters to reach stranded victims.
items.ex_zh: 救援人员不得不趟过齐腰深的浑水去营救滞留的灾民。

items.def_zh: 横穿；横渡（宽阔陆地或水域）
items.def_en: to cross or travel across a wide or difficult area of land or water
items.ex_en: Daring mountaineers plan to traverse the hazardous alpine glacier without mechanized support.
items.ex_zh: 勇敢的登山者计划在没有机械辅助的情况下横穿危险的高山冰川。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers moving across, through, or over physical barriers, bodies of water, or stretches of land. 'Pass' is the general, neutral term for going across or through an area, whereas 'ford' specifically denotes wading across a shallow part of a river or stream on foot or horseback.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过、穿过或趟过河流、陆地或障碍物等自然空间。
groups.desc_en: Emphasizes overcoming and moving across physical natural barriers (especially waterways, terrain, or expanses), distinct from mere locomotion along an unobstructed road.
groups.desc_zh: 强调跨越、穿行自然险阻（尤指水流、复杂地形或荒原），区别于平坦道路上的普通行进。
groups.nuance_en: cross: move from one side of a boundary or terrain to the other (river / border / street) · ford: wade directly through shallow water on foot or in vehicle (river / stream / shallows) · wade: walk through water or mud with physical resistance (stream / surf / shallows) · traverse: travel across a wide, arduous geographical expanse (continent / desert / ridge) · cut across: pass through diagonally to take a shorter route (field / park / bay)
groups.nuance_zh: cross: 越过边界、河流或道路两端 (river / border / street) · ford: 涉浅水渡过 (river / stream / shallows) · wade: 顶着阻力在水或泥泞中跋涉 (stream / surf / shallows) · traverse: 艰难横越辽阔地理疆域 (continent / desert / ridge) · cut across: 抄近道横穿 (field / park / bay)

groups.name: Cultivate & Condition Soil · 农田耕作与土壤改良 (Plow, Till, Harrow)
groups.tip: 翻耕破土以平整农田

items.def_en: to prepare land for growing crops by plowing or harrowing
items.ex_en: The experienced farmer used his oxen to till the fertile soil before spring planting.
items.ex_zh: 这位经验丰富的农夫在春播前用牛翻整了肥沃的土地。

items.def_en: (+ sth) break up and turn over compacted soil or land using a plow
items.ex_en: They had to plow up the dried pasture to prepare for the new crop.
items.ex_zh: 他们不得不把干涸的牧场犁开，为播种新作物做准备。

items.def_en: (+ sth) dig and invert topsoil with a spade or implement to aerate and prepare it
items.ex_en: She went out to turn over the garden soil with a spade before sowing.
items.ex_zh: 播种前，她拿着铁锹去把花园里的泥土翻动疏松了一遍。

items.def_zh: 碎土；使（结块土壤）破碎疏松
items.def_en: (+ sth) crush and aerate dense clods of earth to prepare a suitable seedbed
items.ex_en: You need to break up the hard dirt clods before sowing the delicate seeds.
items.ex_zh: 在播撒娇嫩的种子之前，你需要先把坚硬的土块捣碎。
items.ex2_en: The dense clods of dry soil break up easily under heavy rains.
items.ex2_zh: 干燥致密的泥土块在暴雨下很容易散开。

items.def_en: (agriculture) to break up and cultivate soil using a disc harrow
items.ex_en: At dusk, the weary tractor driver continued to disk the wide stubble fields.
items.ex_zh: 黄昏时分，疲惫的拖拉机手继续用圆盘耙耕耙着广袤的茬地。

items.def_zh: 施石灰于（土壤等），用石灰处理；涂粘鸟胶于
items.def_en: (agriculture) to treat soil or water with lime to reduce acidity
items.ex_en: The elderly steward counseled the tenant to lime the acidic meadow ere winter set.
items.ex_zh: 老管事建议佃户在入冬前给酸性草甸施石灰调理。

items.def_en: to turn over earth with a heavy blade before planting
items.ex_en: Farmers usually plow their fields in late autumn to prepare for the next season.
items.ex_zh: 农民通常在深秋犁地，为下一个耕作季节做准备。

items.def_en: to draw an agricultural implement over plowed land to break clods and smooth the surface
items.ex_en: After plowing the extensive fields, they used heavy iron rakes to harrow the earth.
items.ex_zh: 耕翻大片农田后，他们用沉重的铁耙平整了土地。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to mechanically working, aerating, or chemically treating agricultural soil to prepare it for planting or enhance fertility. They typically take soil, ground, or fields as direct objects.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过机械翻耕、平整或施加改良剂来处理农田土壤以备播种。
groups.desc_en: Describes systematic agricultural interventions using mechanical or chemical implements to disturb, aerate, and condition soil for planting, unlike unmanaged natural growing.
groups.desc_zh: 指运用农具或化学手段破土、翻耕并调理土壤以备播种的农事活动，区别于未经干预的自然生发。
groups.nuance_en: till: cultivate and prepare soil generally for crops (soil / land / ground) · plow: cut deep furrows and invert soil using a share or tractor (field / furrow / earth) · harrow: break up clods and smooth the tilled surface with spikes or discs (field / ground / surface) · lime: treat acidic soil by applying calcium compounds (soil / lawn / plot) · disk: break and aerate topsoil using a disk harrow (field / stubble / soil)
groups.nuance_zh: till: 综合翻耕熟化土地 (soil / land / ground) · plow: 用犁深耕起垄翻土 (field / furrow / earth) · harrow: 耙碎土块并整平地表 (field / ground / surface) · lime: 撒石灰以改良酸性土壤 (soil / lawn / plot) · disk: 用圆盘耙破土平整 (field / stubble / soil)

groups.name: Cure & Preserve with Condiments · 糖腌与盐渍 (Sugar, Salt, Cure)
groups.tip: 施加盐糖香料提升食物风味

items.def_zh: 在……中加糖，撒糖于；使甜蜜，粉饰
items.def_en: 1. to add sugar to something or coat something with sugar 2. to make something unpleasant seem more appealing or acceptable
items.ex_en: She decided to sugar the tart cranberries generously before baking them into a pie.
items.ex_zh: 在将酸蔓越莓烤成馅饼之前，她决定多撒些糖。

items.def_zh: 给……加盐调味；（用盐）腌制；在……上撒盐
items.def_en: 1. to add salt to food to improve its flavor 2. to preserve food by treating it with salt 3. to spread salt on a surface such as a road
items.ex_en: The chef told his apprentice to salt the raw mackerel before placing it outside.
items.ex_zh: 大厨吩咐学徒在把生鲭鱼拿到室外前先撒盐腌制。

items.def_en: to preserve meat, fish, or other food by salting, smoking, or drying
items.ex_en: Local artisans cure thick pork belly with coarse salt and fragrant wood smoke.
items.ex_zh: 当地手艺人用粗盐和芳香的木烟腌制厚厚的五花肉。
items.ex2_en: These salted cod fillets cure slowly in the dry ocean breeze.
items.ex2_zh: 这些腌鳕鱼片在干燥的海风中慢慢风干熟成。

items.def_en: to preserve fruit by cooking or coating it thoroughly in heavy sugar syrup
items.ex_en: Grandmother loves to candy orange peels in boiling syrup every winter for holiday treats.
items.ex_zh: 每年冬天，祖母都喜欢在滚烫的糖浆里煮渍橙皮做节日甜点。

items.def_zh: 用盐腌制（肉类或鱼类）以长期保存
items.def_en: (+ sth) to preserve meat, fish, or vegetables by packing them in salt
items.ex_en: Fishermen used to salt down their fresh cod in large wooden barrels for winter.
items.ex_zh: 渔民们过去常把新鲜鳕鱼码在大木桶里加盐腌存以备过冬。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to steep food items in brine or vinegar for long-term preservation
items.ex_en: Every autumn, we pickle down cucumbers in large ceramic crocks for the long winter.
items.ex_zh: 每年秋天，我们都会把黄瓜腌渍在大陶罐里以备漫长的冬天食用。

items.def_en: to preserve food in vinegar, brine, or a spiced acidic solution
items.ex_en: My grandmother taught me how to pickle small cucumbers using white vinegar and dill.
items.ex_zh: 我祖母教我如何用白醋和莳萝来腌制小黄瓜。

items.def_en: to soak or preserve meat, fish, or vegetables in heavily salted water
items.ex_en: They brine the fresh pork belly overnight in seasoned water to enhance its flavor.
items.ex_zh: 他们把新鲜五花肉在调味盐水中浸泡过夜以提升风味。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe treating ingredients with fundamental chemical preserving agents—chiefly sugar, salt, or smoke—to cure, preserve, dehydrate, or heavily sweeten/salinate them as part of preparation or storage.
groups.summary_zh: 用糖、盐等基质进行腌制、脱水保鲜或加味处理。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on preserving edible matter against microbial decay using osmotic, chemical, or curing agents (salts, sugars, acids), distinct from thermal cooking or plain freezing.
groups.desc_zh: 特指利用高渗透压或化学浸渍介质（盐、糖、酸液）脱水防腐加工食品，区别于熟制烹饪或机械冷冻。
groups.nuance_en: cure: preserve through a systematic salting, smoking, or drying regime (ham / bacon / fish) · salt: pack or rub with dry salt to draw moisture (cod / pork / hides) · brine: soak food in a saturated salt-and-water solution (pickles / turkey / olives) · pickle: preserve and ferment in an acidic vinegar or brine solution (cucumbers / onions / vegetables) · candy: preserve or coat thoroughly by boiling in heavy sugar syrup (ginger / peel / fruit)
groups.nuance_zh: cure: 综合腌熏脱水防腐 (ham / bacon / fish) · salt: 撒盐或用干盐包裹腌制 (cod / pork / hides) · brine: 浸入高浓度浓盐水中盐渍 (pickles / turkey / olives) · pickle: 用醋或卤水泡制酸洗发酵 (cucumbers / onions / vegetables) · candy: 用浓糖浆浸渍蜜制 (ginger / peel / fruit)

groups.name: Decide & Choose · 决定与决断 (Decide, Settle on, Opt)
groups.tip: 权衡利弊做出裁决

items.def_en: to make a choice or judgment about something after consideration
items.ex_en: The committee members will decide the final winner after reviewing all the submitted portfolios.
items.ex_zh: 委员会成员将在审阅所有提交的作品集后决定最终的获胜者。

items.def_zh: 决定，下定决心；支配，决定；查明，测定
items.def_en: 1. to decide firmly or officially. 2. to control or influence something directly. 3. to discover or calculate facts about something.
items.ex_en: The municipal council will formally determine the official budget for the upcoming fiscal year.
items.ex_zh: 市政委员会将正式决定下一财政年度的官方预算。

items.def_en: to make a firm and formal decision to do something
items.ex_en: The board resolved to implement stricter environmental standards across all manufacturing facilities immediately.
items.ex_zh: 董事会决议立即在所有生产基地实施更为严格的环保标准。

items.def_en: to choose or agree upon something after consideration or discussion
items.ex_en: After hours of heated discussion, the partners finally settled on a new marketing strategy.
items.ex_zh: 经过数小时的激烈讨论，合伙人们终于敲定了新的营销策略。

items.def_en: (+ sth/sb) make a final choice among two or more possibilities after consideration
items.ex_en: After visiting ten properties, the young couple finally decided on the downtown apartment.
items.ex_zh: 看了十处房产后，这对年轻夫妇终于选定了市中心的那套公寓。

items.def_en: (+ sth) choose one particular option or course of action instead of other alternatives
items.ex_en: Given the rising tuition costs, many students opt for cheaper community college courses.
items.ex_zh: 鉴于学费上涨，许多学生选择就读更为便宜的社区学院课程。

items.def_en: (+ sth/sb) choose an option or candidate decisively, often after prolonged hesitation
items.ex_en: After weighing both job offers for weeks, she finally plumped for the startup role.
items.ex_zh: 在两份工作之间权衡了数周后，她最终敲定了初创公司的职位。

items.def_en: to make a choice or decision from a range of possibilities
items.ex_en: Eligible employees may opt to receive stock options instead of an annual cash bonus.
items.ex_zh: 符合条件的员工可以选择接受股票期权以代替年度现金奖金。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the cognitive process of reaching a conclusion or selecting an alternative after deliberation. 'Determine' implies firm or authoritative conclusion, whereas 'opt' highlights picking one alternative among many.
groups.summary_zh: 指在权衡各种选项后做出明确决断或选定特定行动方案。
groups.desc_en: Highlights the cognitive or collective closure that terminates deliberation to select a singular course of action, unlike enduring state of wishing or intending.
groups.desc_zh: 强调通过主观权衡或决断终止犹豫，在若干选项中确定唯一步调，区别于持续的意图或空想。
groups.nuance_en: decide: reach a definite resolution after thought or debate (case / issue / future) · determine: establish authoritatively or settle with finality (outcome / course / fate) · resolve: make a firm, formal, or principled determination (dispute / crisis / to act) · opt: choose one preference from available alternatives (out / in / for change) · settle on: arrive at a final compromise after vacillation (date / name / plan)
groups.nuance_zh: decide: 权衡或辩论后做定夺 (case / issue / future) · determine: 查明、判定或最终决定 (outcome / course / fate) · resolve: 下定决心或通过正式决议解决 (dispute / crisis / to act) · opt: 在备选项中做取舍抉择 (out / in / for change) · settle on: 犹疑反复后最终选定 (date / name / plan)

groups.name: Deem & Judge Status · 视作与判定 (Deem, Repute, Regard)
groups.tip: 对事物形成主观定性判断

items.def_en: to form an authoritative opinion or conclusion about the condition or status of something
items.ex_en: Inspectors will judge whether the refurbished building meets the requisite structural safety regulations.
items.ex_zh: 检查人员将判定翻修后的建筑物是否符合必要的结构安全法规。

items.def_en: To consider, judge, or regard in a specified way.
items.ex_en: The administrative tribunal deemed the proposed company merger non-compliant with existing regulatory frameworks.
items.ex_zh: 行政法庭判定拟议的公司合并案不符合现有的监管框架。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth as ...) regard, evaluate, or consider someone or something as possessing a certain character or status
items.ex_en: Many experienced scholars look on his radical thesis as a bold breakthrough in linguistics.
items.ex_zh: 许多资深学者将他激进的论文视作语言学领域的一次大胆突破。

items.def_zh: 视为；认为……具有特定属性
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth as ...) judge, deem, or evaluate someone or something to be in a specified condition
items.ex_en: Historians now view as catastrophic the ill-conceived treaty signed by the embattled monarch.
items.ex_zh: 历史学家如今将那位四面楚歌的君主签署的草率条约视为灾难性的举措。

items.def_zh: 算作；视为（符合资格或状态）
items.def_en: (+ sth/sb) be judged or deemed officially or functionally equivalent to a specified status
items.ex_en: Under local electoral law, an unmarked ballot paper will count as an invalid vote.
items.ex_zh: 根据当地选举法，未作标记的选票将被算作废票。

items.def_en: (chiefly passive) to consider or regard someone or something as being a specified thing
items.ex_en: In our sleepy town, he was widely reckoned the best mechanic around for classic cars.
items.ex_zh: 在我们宁静的小镇上，他被大家公认为当地最好的老爷车修理工。

items.def_zh: 普遍认为，把……称为，普遍认定
items.def_en: (chiefly passive) To be generally considered or said to be something.
items.ex_en: The ancient scholar was reputed to possess profound knowledge of long-forgotten mystical arts.
items.ex_zh: 世人普遍认为这位古代学者精通早已被人遗忘的神秘法术。

items.def_en: (+ to be / as) (formal/legal) to declare or judge officially through formal ruling
items.ex_en: The bankruptcy court officially adjudged the struggling retail firm to be entirely insolvent.
items.ex_zh: 破产法院正式裁定这家陷入困境的零售企业已彻底无力偿债。

groups.summary_en: An evaluator, court, or public opinion holds, judges, or treats an entity as possessing a specified status, quality, or condition. Verbs vary primarily in official judicial weight versus widespread popular repute.
groups.summary_zh: 由评判者或公众舆论基于评估将某事物视作或判定为某种状态。
groups.desc_en: Covers assigning a formal, evaluative, or conventional status to an entity based on mental assessment or authoritative decree, unlike raw perception.
groups.desc_zh: 指基于心智裁量、社会公认或权威裁决赋予某事物特定定性与地位，区别于未经判断的客观感知。
groups.nuance_en: deem: formally judge or hold an opinion based on standard or policy (fit / necessary / ineligible) · reckon: calculate informally or estimate status subjectively (chances / among peers / force) · repute: credit widely by common report or general supposition (author / wise / treasure) · adjudge: declare or decide authoritatively by judicial decree (bankrupt / guilty / winner) · view as: mentally frame or interpret under a particular rubric (threat / success / ally)
groups.nuance_zh: deem: 依据标准认定或断定 (fit / necessary / ineligible) · reckon: 估算、揣度或视作 (chances / among peers / force) · repute: 社会公论普遍认为 (author / wise / treasure) · adjudge: 司法或权威裁决认定 (bankrupt / guilty / winner) · view as: 心理上将……视为或解读为 (threat / success / ally)

groups.name: Defend & Counter · 防御预备与反制对抗 (Counteract, Forearm, Neutralize)
groups.tip: 御敌于外并保护己方

items.def_en: to protect against physical attack, aggression, or danger
items.ex_en: The brave soldiers fought courageously to defend their beloved homeland against hostile foreign invaders.
items.ex_zh: 勇敢的士兵们英勇战斗，保卫他们深爱的祖国免遭外国侵略者的侵袭。

items.def_en: to successfully push away or defend oneself against an incoming blow or assault
items.ex_en: The seasoned politician managed to fend off aggressive questions from reporters during the briefing.
items.ex_zh: 这位经验丰富的政客在简报会期间成功挡开了记者们的咄咄逼人的提问。

items.def_zh: 避开；抵挡防范（攻击或厄运）
items.def_en: (+ sth/sb) protect oneself against or prevent an impending attack, danger, or evil effect
items.ex_en: Villagers used to burn aromatic herbs inside their homes to ward off seasonal sickness.
items.ex_zh: 村民们过去常在屋内点燃芳香草药，以防范季节性疾病。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) successfully resist an advancing enemy, opponent, or attack to prevent them from breaking through
items.ex_en: Our tired squad managed to hold off the fierce enemy counterattack until dawn arrived.
items.ex_zh: 我们疲惫的小队设法抵挡住了敌人凶猛的反扑，直到黎明来临。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) repel an attacker or overcome an aggressive physical threat through vigorous defense
items.ex_en: The elderly shopkeeper used a broom to fight off the aggressive stray dogs outside.
items.ex_zh: 上了年纪的店主用扫帚击退了外面几条具有攻击性的流浪狗。

items.def_en: to render an opposing threat or hostile force completely harmless or ineffective
items.ex_en: Special forces executed a coordinated raid to neutralize the hostile terrorist threat effectively.
items.ex_zh: 特种部队发起了一场协同突袭，有效瓦解了敌对恐怖分子的威胁。

items.def_en: 1. (usually passive) To prepare or equip someone in advance against an expected danger or difficulty.
items.ex_en: Prior intelligence forearmed the diplomatic delegation against unexpected hostility during the summit negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 事先获得的情报使外交代表团预先做好了应对峰会谈判期间突发敌意的准备。

items.def_en: 1. To reduce or prevent the bad effect of something by acting against it.
items.ex_en: Doctors administered a targeted antidote immediately to counteract the lethal effects of snake venom.
items.ex_zh: 医生立即注射了靶向解毒剂，以抵消蛇毒的致命危害。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on proactively taking defensive measures in anticipation of an attack or actively neutralizing the adverse force, effect, or hostility of an opponent.
groups.summary_zh: 指事前采取防范准备，或在遭受对抗、攻击时采取行动抵消其威胁。
groups.desc_en: Encompasses preventative and reactive measures to deflect, withstand, or neutralize an imminent hostile attack or damaging force, unlike initiating aggression.
groups.desc_zh: 涵盖抵御、反制或化解迫在眉睫的攻击、侵袭与破坏的主动与被动措施，区别于先发制人的进攻。
groups.nuance_en: defend: shield or protect from aggression, attack, or censure (border / champion / position) · fend off: keep at bay or push back an oncoming threat actively (critics / blow / takeover) · ward off: take prophylactic action to avert danger, cold, or illness (evil / disease / attack) · neutralize: render a threat harmless or inoperative (threat / weapon / poison) · forearm: equip or mentally prepare beforehand against expected peril (guard / mind / soldier)
groups.nuance_zh: defend: 保卫、守护或据理辩护 (border / champion / position) · fend off: 积极推开或击退逼近的威胁 (critics / blow / takeover) · ward off: 事先防范以避开灾祸或病疾 (evil / disease / attack) · neutralize: 使威胁、武器失效或中和 (threat / weapon / poison) · forearm: 预先武装防备以御风险 (guard / mind / soldier)

groups.name: Deficit to Gradual Depletion · 匮乏与渐进消损 (Lack, Sap, Drain)
groups.tip: 存量不足乃至不断耗损衰竭

items.def_zh: 逐渐抽走；缓慢损耗（资源、压力）
items.def_en: (+ sth) gradually release, siphon off, or drain away a resource, fluid, or pressure over time
items.ex_en: Engineers carefully opened the emergency release valve to bleed off dangerous excess internal pressure.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们小心翼翼地打开应急释放阀，逐渐抽走内部危险的过剩压力。

items.def_zh: 逐渐枯竭；渐渐减弱消散
items.def_en: gradually diminish in strength, substance, or volume until completely gone
items.ex_en: The lively conversation began to peter out as the exhausted guests prepared for sleep.
items.ex_zh: 随着疲惫的客人们准备入睡，热闹的交谈声渐渐微弱下来。

items.def_en: 1. To not have any or not have enough of something.
items.ex_en: The young applicants often lack the necessary practical experience required for this senior position.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的求职者往往缺乏这个高级职位所必需的实际经验。

items.def_en: to gradually deprive someone or something of strength, money, or resources completely
items.ex_en: The protracted legal battle threatens to drain the company's remaining financial resources completely.
items.ex_zh: 旷日持久的法律纠纷可能会彻底耗尽该企业仅剩的财务资源。
items.ex2_en: The muddy floodwaters drained away into the storm canals after the rain.
items.ex2_zh: 大雨过后，浑浊的洪水排入了雨水渠中。

items.def_zh: 逐渐削弱，耗尽（精力、元气、信心等）；挖地道破坏（城墙地基）
items.def_en: 1. To gradually weaken or drain away someone's strength, energy, or confidence. 2. To undermine the foundations of a fortification by digging underneath.
items.ex_en: The grueling commute through heavy rush-hour traffic will sap your energy before work starts.
items.ex_zh: 在早高峰拥堵的车流中艰辛通勤，会在上班前耗尽你的精力。

items.def_en: to reduce the amount, supply, or value of something substantially
items.ex_en: Decades of overfishing have severely depleted the natural stocks of cod in northern waters.
items.ex_zh: 数十年的过度捕捞已严重损耗了北部海域鳕鱼的自然储量。

items.def_en: gradually disappear or diminish completely, especially energy, confidence, or resources
items.ex_en: All the color drained away from her face when she received the tragic news.
items.ex_zh: 听到那个不幸的消息时，她脸上的血色瞬间退得一干二净。
items.ex2_en: The tireless nurse drained away the toxic fluid from the patient's wound.
items.ex2_zh: 不知疲倦的护士排净了病人伤口中的毒液。

items.def_zh: 榨取；大量抽耗（资金或资源）
items.def_en: to extort, drain, or severely exhaust financial or material resources over time
items.ex_en: The prolonged overseas military conflict continued to bleed the nation's treasury of billions.
items.ex_zh: 旷日持久的海外军事冲突持续抽耗着国家数以十亿计的财政资金。

groups.summary_en: A subject experiences an absence or gradual loss of vital resources, strength, or substance. Intensity escalates from passive deficiency or absence of an asset (lack) to steady, insidious undermining (sap), heavy systematic emptying (drain), and total exhaustion of reserves (bleed).
groups.summary_zh: 指资源或能量由本身匮乏，进阶到被持续抽吸、渐进耗损乃至荡尽。
groups.desc_en: Captures the continuous, debilitating extraction or drying up of a finite vital resource or reservoir, contrasting with sudden catastrophic destruction.
groups.desc_zh: 描绘有限的关键资源或生命力被持续抽离、耗蚀直至干涸的过程，区别于突发性的毁灭。
groups.nuance_en: drain: draw off liquid or exhaust energy steadily until empty (reservoir / battery / resources) · sap: gradually undermine vitality, courage, or strength (energy / confidence / strength) · deplete: seriously reduce the remaining quantity of a stock or supply (supplies / reserves / ozone) · bleed: continuously siphon off money, lifeblood, or resources (economy / budget / casualty) · peter out: gradually diminish and trickle to a total halt (enthusiasm / trail / steam)
groups.nuance_zh: drain: 持续抽干水液或耗尽能量 (reservoir / battery / resources) · sap: 潜移默化地暗中削弱元气与意志 (energy / confidence / strength) · deplete: 大幅削减存量或储备 (supplies / reserves / ozone) · bleed: 持续大量流失或榨取资金血脉 (economy / budget / casualty) · peter out: 逐渐变弱、消退直至断绝 (enthusiasm / trail / steam)

groups.name: Deform & Distort Shape or Truth · 扭曲形相与变形 (Distort, Deform, Contort)
groups.tip: 受力变形偏离原本形状

items.def_en: (+ sth) distort the physical form or structure of an object so it loses its natural shape
items.ex_en: The reckless driver managed to bend the metal bumper completely out of shape.
items.ex_zh: 那个鲁莽的司机把金属保险杠撞得完全扭曲变形了。

items.def_en: (+ sth) deliberately alter the intended meaning of words or facts to mislead
items.ex_en: The unscrupulous lawyer tried to twist around the witness's plain words to confuse everyone.
items.ex_zh: 那个不择手段的律师试图曲解证人直白的话语来混淆视听。

items.def_en: 1. To pull or twist something out of its natural, normal, or original shape. 2. To report or represent information in an untrue or misleading way.
items.ex_en: Biased media outlets often distort crucial facts to satisfy their own underlying political agendas.
items.ex_zh: 有偏见的媒体机构往往会歪曲关键事实以迎合自身的政治意图。
items.ex2_en: The image on the old monitor distorts when magnetic devices approach.
items.ex2_zh: 当磁性设备靠近时，旧显示器上的图像就会失真扭曲。

items.def_en: to give an abnormal, uneven, or ugly shape to something
items.ex_en: Severe burns from the laboratory fire managed to misshape the contours of his face.
items.ex_zh: 实验室火灾造成的严重烧伤使他的面部轮廓彻底畸形走样。

items.def_en: To spoil or change the normal or natural shape of something, especially through pressure or stress.
items.ex_en: Intense subterranean tectonic pressure can gradually deform the ancient stratified rock layers over millennia.
items.ex_zh: 强烈的地下地质压力会在数千年间逐渐使古老的沉积岩层发生形变。
items.ex2_en: Soft plastic containers deform easily when exposed to boiling hot water.
items.ex2_zh: 软塑料容器接触沸腾的热水时很容易变形。

items.def_en: to reproduce a message, sound, or report in a confused or distorted way
items.ex_en: A faulty transmission satellite will garble critical data before reaching the receiving ground stations.
items.ex_zh: 出现故障的传输卫星会在关键数据到达地面接收站之前将其弄得混乱不堪。

items.def_en: to twist or wrench out of normal shape, especially violently or grotesquely
items.ex_en: Extreme physical agony caused the wounded soldier to contort his face in silent suffering.
items.ex_zh: 极度的肉体痛苦令受伤的士兵面容扭曲，在无声中煎熬。
items.ex2_en: The gymnast's slender body contorts effortlessly into incredible shapes during performances.
items.ex2_zh: 体操运动员修长的身躯在表演中轻松地弯曲成不可思议的形状。

items.def_zh: 严重损毁变形，割裂扯碎
items.def_en: to destroy the proper form of something by cutting, tearing, or crushing severely
items.ex_en: The violent factory accident threatened to mangle the worker's left arm beyond surgical repair.
items.ex_zh: 那场严重的工厂事故险些将工人的左臂碾得稀烂，以至无法手术修复。

groups.summary_en: Centers on significantly altering the natural shape, appearance, sound, or conceptual truth of something so that its proportional harmony is lost. Applies equally to physical forms, facial expressions, and abstract representations like facts or data.
groups.summary_zh: 指严重改变形貌、面容、声音或事实，使其失真或不成原样。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the alteration of spatial geometry or informational integrity away from truth, nature, or proper form, unlike mere scaling or clean translation.
groups.desc_zh: 指空间形态或信息原本真实性发生变形、曲解与走样，区别于成比例的缩放或忠实转换。
groups.nuance_en: deform: spoil the natural physical shape through stress or heat (metal / bone / structure) · distort: pull out of true shape, sound, or ideological veracity (truth / lens / reality) · contort: twist violently into unnatural, strained angles (face / body / argument) · garble: distort messages, sound, or transmission into confusion (transmission / signal / message) · mangle: mutilate physically or butcher a concept ruinously (limb / machinery / speech)
groups.nuance_zh: deform: 因受力或受热致使物理结构永久变形 (metal / bone / structure) · distort: 歪曲事实、声音失真或扭曲物形 (truth / lens / reality) · contort: 扭结或强行扭曲成怪异姿态 (face / body / argument) · garble: 讹传信息或造成通讯信号错乱 (transmission / signal / message) · mangle: 物理撕碎碾压或拙劣糟蹋文意 (limb / machinery / speech)

groups.name: Defrost & Melt · 解冻与消融 (Thaw, Defrost, Melt)
groups.tip: 受热冰雪消融，坚冰化为流水

items.def_en: to remove ice or frost mechanically or chemically from the surface of something
items.ex_en: Ground crews used heated chemical spray to de-ice the aircraft wings before clearance.
items.ex_zh: 地勤人员在起飞前使用加热的化学喷雾给飞机机翼除冰。

items.def_zh: （使）融化，（使）解冻；（使态度、关系等）缓和
items.def_en: 1. (of ice, snow, or frozen food) To melt or become liquid or soft again. 2. (of relations or attitudes) To become warmer, friendlier, or more relaxed.
items.ex_en: As springtime temperatures steadily rise, the thick mountain snow will finally begin to thaw.
items.ex_zh: 随着春季气温稳步回升，山间厚厚的积雪终于开始消融了。
items.ex2_en: The warm spring sun will thaw the frozen soil across the fields.
items.ex2_zh: 温暖的春阳将解冻田野里冻结的泥土。

items.def_en: dissolve or turn to liquid and disappear through melting, as snow or ice does under warmth
items.ex_en: When morning sunlight struck the garden, the delicate frost quickly began to melt away.
items.ex_zh: 当清晨的阳光洒向花园时，娇嫩的白霜很快开始融化消散。

items.def_en: (+ sth) become unfrozen completely, or cause a frozen object or food item to return to room temperature
items.ex_en: You should leave the frozen poultry on the kitchen counter to thaw out completely.
items.ex_zh: 你应该把冻禽肉放在厨房料理台上，让它彻底解冻。
items.ex2_en: The chef thaw out the thick pork chops before grilling them tonight.
items.ex2_zh: 大厨在今晚烤肉前彻底解冻了厚猪排。

items.def_en: To remove ice or frost from a refrigerator, vehicle windshield, etc., or to thaw frozen food before cooking.
items.ex_en: Remember to defrost the dense chicken breasts before placing them inside the hot oven.
items.ex_zh: 把结实的鸡胸肉放进热烤箱之前，记得先让它解冻。
items.ex2_en: The frozen steaks will defrost completely in cold water within two hours.
items.ex2_zh: 冷冻牛排在冷水中两小时内就会彻底解冻。

items.def_zh: 融化；将（金属、固态物）熔解成液体
items.def_en: (+ sth) heat a solid until it liquefies completely, or liquefy through intense heat
items.ex_en: Looters planned to melt down the stolen antique silver chalices into easily tradable ingots.
items.ex_zh: 劫匪们打算将盗来的古代银圣杯熔解成易于交易的银锭。
items.ex2_en: The massive blocks of ice melt down rapidly under the blazing sun.
items.ex2_zh: 巨大的冰块在烈日下迅速融化。

items.def_en: [I/T] to change or cause to change completely from a solid state to a liquid by heat
items.ex_en: Unattended on the warm stove, the fresh block of butter quickly began to melt.
items.ex_zh: 搁在温热炉灶上无人照看的新鲜黄油很快便开始融化。
items.ex2_en: The baker melted the dark chocolate carefully over a gentle double boiler.
items.ex2_zh: 面包师在温和的双层蒸锅上小心地融化了黑巧克力。

items.def_en: (formal/technical) to dissolve gradually and turn completely into liquid by absorbing moisture or heating
items.ex_en: Under intense tropical moisture, the pure chemical crystals began to deliquesce into clear liquid.
items.ex_zh: 在热带浓重的湿气下，纯净的化学晶体开始潮解成澄澈的液体。

groups.summary_en: A frozen or solid substance transitions to a liquid, softened, or ice-free state through the application or absorption of heat. Verbs escalate from gentle surface de-icing to total phase change into liquid.
groups.summary_zh: 因受热由冻结或固态逐渐变软、除冰直至完全液化。
groups.desc_en: Details thermal phase transitions from frozen, solid, or icy states back to liquid, softened, or ambient operational states, contrasting with simple warming without phase change.
groups.desc_zh: 强调物质从冰冻结晶态向液态消融或温化解除冰霜的相变过程，区别于不发生相变的普通受热。
groups.nuance_en: thaw: transition naturally from frozen to liquid by rising temperature (ground / ice / relation) · defrost: remove ice accumulation from a cold unit or unfreeze frozen food (freezer / windshield / meat) · melt: change from solid to liquid via application of heat (wax / snow / metal) · de-ice: chemically or mechanically eliminate ice from surfaces (wings / road / aircraft) · deliquesce: dissolve into liquid gradually by absorbing ambient moisture (salt / mushroom / leaf)
groups.nuance_zh: thaw: 随气温回升自然融化或关系缓和 (ground / ice / relation) · defrost: 机械除霜或将冻品化冻 (freezer / windshield / meat) · melt: 加热使固体彻底熔解为液体 (wax / snow / metal) · de-ice: 喷剂或机械为关键表面除冰 (wings / road / aircraft) · deliquesce: 吸湿潮解成液态 (salt / mushroom / leaf)

groups.name: Degrade & Debase · 贬值与品质劣化 (Cheapen, Taint, Debase)
groups.tip: 降低品质或使其价值贬损

items.def_en: to make something weaker or less effective by adding extraneous elements
items.ex_en: Introducing vague compromises will only dilute the legal force of this comprehensive reform bill.
items.ex_zh: 引入含糊的妥协条款只会削弱这项全面改革法案的法律效力。
items.ex2_en: Concentrated vinegar dilutes easily with fresh spring water in glass jars.
items.ex2_zh: 浓缩醋在玻璃罐中很容易用新鲜泉水稀释。

items.def_en: to lower the taste, aesthetic, or intellectual standard of something
items.ex_en: Sensational commercial interests threaten to vulgarize the solemn dignity of traditional classical musical compositions.
items.ex_zh: 耸人听闻的商业利益正威胁着将传统古典音乐作品的庄严美感庸俗化。

items.def_en: (+ sth) lower the level, intrinsic value, or moral standing of something
items.ex_en: Sensational tabloid coverage will only bring down the quality of serious public discourse.
items.ex_zh: 小报耸人听闻的报道只会拉低严肃公众讨论的水准。

items.def_zh: 稀释；贬低削弱（质量、效力）
items.def_en: (+ sth) reduce the quality, strength, purity, or effectiveness of something
items.ex_en: The committee chose to water down the regulations to appease powerful industry lobbyists.
items.ex_zh: 委员会选择削弱这些监管条例的力度，以安抚势力强大的行业说客。

items.def_zh: 贬低（人格、价值等），降低……的品格；使贬值，使降价
items.def_en: 1. to lower the moral value, respect, or quality of someone or something 2. to lower the price or cost of something
items.ex_en: Relying on cheap gimmicks will cheapen the brand image in the eyes of consumers.
items.ex_zh: 依赖廉价的噱头会降低该品牌在消费者心中的形象。
items.ex2_en: A nation's currency cheapens when domestic inflation rates spike dramatically.
items.ex2_zh: 当国内通货膨胀率急剧飙升时，该国的货币就会贬值。

items.def_zh: 降低……的品质（或价值、道德）；使（硬币、货币）贬值
items.def_en: to reduce the quality, value, or moral character of someone or something; to lower the value of a currency
items.ex_en: The empire began to debase its silver currency to finance unending foreign wars.
items.ex_zh: 该帝国开始使白银货币贬值，以资助无休止的对外战争。

items.def_en: to corrupt or debase something by adding inferior, foreign, or improper materials
items.ex_en: Unscrupulous merchants were caught attempting to adulterate expensive olive oil with cheaper substitutes.
items.ex_zh: 不法商贩企图在昂贵的橄榄油中掺入廉价替代品，当场被抓获。

items.def_zh: 败坏，腐蚀（质地或纯洁性）
items.def_en: to spoil or taint the integrity, purity, or original state of something completely
items.ex_en: Industrial runoffs can corrupt the pristine quality of the valley's natural freshwater springs.
items.ex_zh: 工业径流会破坏山谷天然淡水泉的原始纯净水质。
items.ex2_en: The unprotected computer files corrupt spontaneously after sudden system power failures.
items.ex2_zh: 未受保护的计算机文件在系统突然断电后会自行损坏。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote lowering the intrinsic quality, moral purity, currency value, or artistic worth of something, scaling from vulgarization to fundamental corruption and debasement.
groups.summary_zh: 使事物的内在品质、纯度、格调或价值逐步劣化与降格。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on the diminution of intrinsic value, chemical purity, dignity, or cultural sophistication by introducing inferior elements, unlike plain physical wear-and-tear.
groups.desc_zh: 特指通过掺杂劣质成分或降低品味而削贬其内在价值、纯度或崇高性，区别于正常的物理磨损。
groups.nuance_en: debase: lower the fundamental standard, quality, or purity of something (currency / character / art) · adulterate: make impure or unsafe by adding foreign or inferior ingredients (food / wine / drug) · cheapen: degrade perceived worth, dignity, or aesthetic prestige (reputation / debate / brand) · dilute: weaken the strength or quality by mixing or diffusing (solution / message / impact) · vulgarize: reduce to coarse, common, or unsophisticated forms (art / taste / culture)
groups.nuance_zh: debase: 降低成色、贬值货币或使人格堕落 (currency / character / art) · adulterate: 掺假使食品药品不纯或劣质 (food / wine / drug) · cheapen: 贬低身价、声望或格调 (reputation / debate / brand) · dilute: 稀释冲淡浓度或削弱效力 (solution / message / impact) · vulgarize: 使通俗化、粗俗化或丧失高雅 (art / taste / culture)

groups.name: Deregulate & Liberalize · 放宽管制与解禁 (Deregulate, Liberalize, Unbridle)
groups.tip: 打破垄断束缚并放宽行政管制

items.def_zh: 解除管制；取消价格或行业限制
items.def_en: to free an economy, price, or product from government controls
items.ex_en: The ministry voted to decontrol natural gas prices to encourage competitive domestic production.
items.ex_zh: 该部表决取消对天然气价格的管制，以鼓励国内竞争性生产。

items.def_en: to release from severe legal, administrative, or literal shackles
items.ex_en: The sweeping decree promised to unshackle the creative spirit of the oppressed populace.
items.ex_zh: 这项影响深远的法令承诺将受压迫民众的创造力彻底解放。

items.def_zh: 开放，解除（市场、贸易等）限制
items.def_en: (+ sth) remove barriers or regulations to make trade, an economy, or an industry accessible to all
items.ex_en: The new treaty will open up the domestic telecommunications market to foreign competitors.
items.ex_zh: 新条约将向外国竞争对手开放国内电信市场。

items.def_en: (+ sth/sb) make restrictions, rules, or enforcement less severe or burdensome
items.ex_en: The city council decided to ease up on zoning restrictions for food trucks.
items.ex_zh: 市议会决定放宽对餐车经营的区域规划限制。

items.def_en: to release someone or something from regulatory or contractual constraints
items.ex_en: The recent reform will untie local enterprises from obsolete bureaucratic constraints.
items.ex_zh: 近期的改革将把地方企业从陈旧的行政束缚中解脱出来。
items.ex2_en: The loose knot untied easily when the wind pulled the rope.
items.ex2_zh: 风拉扯绳索时，那个松垮的结很容易就解开了。

items.def_zh: 放开限制，解除束缚；除去……的马辔
items.def_en: 1. To free something from restraint, inhibition, or control. 2. To remove the bridle from a horse.
items.ex_en: The tyrant sought to unbridle his darkest ambitions across the conquered lands.
items.ex_zh: 暴君企图在被征服的土地上肆意放纵自己最阴暗的野心。

items.def_zh: 解除对……的管制，放宽对……的行政限制
items.def_en: To remove government controls, rules, or regulations from an industry, market, or activity.
items.ex_en: Lawmakers plan to deregulate the energy market to foster competition among utility providers.
items.ex_zh: 立法者计划解除对能源市场的管制，以促进公用事业供应商之间的竞争。

items.raw_cluster: 放宽与自由化 Relax & Liberalize
items.def_en: To make laws, systems, or trade regulations less strict, allowing greater freedom.
items.ex_en: The government intends to liberalize trade policies to attract more foreign capital investments.
items.ex_zh: 政府打算放宽贸易政策，以吸引更多的外国资本投资。
items.ex2_en: The rigid market economy liberalized quickly under new progressive leadership.
items.ex2_zh: 在新的开明领导下，僵化的市场经济迅速实现了自由化。

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote dismantling government, economic, or behavioral restrictions to facilitate open, unhindered activity. They differ by domain: policy-level statutory rollback vs. removal of civil/trade barriers vs. literary release of wild impulses.
groups.summary_zh: 指废除制度束缚、放宽行业政策管制或解开行为限制。
groups.desc_en: Captures the systematic removal of legal restrictions, bureaucratic restraints, or statutory impediments to promote open autonomy, distinct from informal permission.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过法定程序或体制变革系统性拆除监管束缚与准入壁垒，区别于非正式的个体许可。
groups.nuance_en: deregulate: abolish or reduce statutory rules in an economic sector (market / aviation / industry) · liberalize: make laws, social codes, or trade policies less stringent (trade / visa / regime) · decontrol: eliminate official statutory price or supply limits (prices / rents / imports) · unshackle: release from burdensome, paralyzing constraints metaphorically (economy / potential / talent) · unbridle: release completely from all moral or structural restraints (passion / ambition / power)
groups.nuance_zh: deregulate: 取消或放宽行业行政管制 (market / aviation / industry) · liberalize: 放宽法令、贸易限制或思想管控 (trade / visa / regime) · decontrol: 解除官方物价、租金或配额统管 (prices / rents / imports) · unshackle: 解开束缚以释放巨大潜能 (economy / potential / talent) · unbridle: 彻底放开辔头纵容失控 (passion / ambition / power)

groups.name: Design & Devise · 设计与构想 (Formulate Functional or Aesthetic Structures)
groups.tip: 构思构想外观或实现方案

items.def_en: 1. To plan and make drawings or models showing the look and function of something before it is built or made. 2. To intend or plan something for a particular purpose.
items.ex_en: A team of skilled architects gathered to design an eco-friendly municipal library.
items.ex_zh: 一支经验丰富的建筑师团队齐聚一堂，设计一座环保型市立图书馆。

items.def_en: (+ into/from) to shape or design an object skillfully using specific materials or forms
items.ex_en: The artisan managed to fashion delicate ornaments from discarded pieces of drift timber.
items.ex_zh: 手艺人设法用废弃的浮木雕琢出精美的装饰品。

items.def_en: (+ sth) plan or design the details of something carefully
items.ex_en: The committee met to map out a clear strategy for the next five years.
items.ex_zh: 委员会开会为接下来的五年详细制定了清晰的战略规划。

items.def_en: (+ sth) arrange or plan the physical or visual design of something
items.ex_en: The CEO laid out an ambitious five-year growth strategy.
items.ex_zh: 首席执行官详细阐述了一项雄心勃勃的五年增长战略。

items.def_en: (+ sth) outline or draw the rough structure or preliminary design of something
items.ex_en: The lead engineer will sketch out the preliminary design during our morning briefing.
items.ex_zh: 首席工程师将在我们的早间简报会上勾画出初步设计草图。

items.def_en: to plan or invent a complex system, procedure, or plan from existing principles
items.ex_en: The analysts managed to devise an elaborate algorithm for monitoring suspicious financial transactions.
items.ex_zh: 分析师们成功构想出一套复杂的算法，用于监测可疑金融交易。

items.def_en: to draw up a detailed technical plan or architectural scheme for an artifact or project
items.ex_en: Senior planners gathered yesterday to blueprint the infrastructural expansion of the seaport.
items.ex_zh: 高级规划师们昨日齐聚，为海港的基础设施扩建制定蓝图。

items.def_zh: 使风格化，使程式化（按特定艺术样式设计）
items.def_en: To design, represent, or perform something according to a particular conventional or non-realistic artistic style.
items.ex_en: The muralist chose to stylize the natural landscape into bold geometric patterns.
items.ex_zh: 壁画家选择将自然景观程式化为醒目的几何图案。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on conceiving, planning, and patterning objects, systems, or visual forms before fabrication, balancing utilitarian structure with deliberate stylistic choices.
groups.summary_zh: 在制造前对物品、外观或系统进行统筹规划与艺术/功能性设计。
groups.desc_en: Involves mentally originating and systematically planning functional systems, aesthetic artifacts, or strategic blueprints, rather than fabricating physical objects blindly.
groups.desc_zh: 指在心理上构想并系统性规划功能结构、艺术形态或战略蓝图，区别于照猫画虎的盲目制造。
groups.nuance_en: design: conceive and produce functional or aesthetic plans for an object (building / software / fashion) · devise: invent or plan an intricate method or apparatus ingeniously (scheme / strategy / apparatus) · blueprint: draft a detailed, programmatic strategic model (plan / reform / expansion) · map out: plan and arrange the sequence of a project or route carefully (career / route / strategy) · sketch out: outline the main preliminary points or draft quickly (plan / idea / outline)
groups.nuance_zh: design: 构思并绘制功能性或美学图样 (building / software / fashion) · devise: 巧妙发明出方法、方案或装置 (scheme / strategy / apparatus) · blueprint: 拟定详尽蓝图与实施方案 (plan / reform / expansion) · map out: 缜密规划全套进程或路线 (career / route / strategy) · sketch out: 勾勒起草初步框架轮廓 (plan / idea / outline)

groups.name: Desperately Beg & Supplicate · 恳求与哀求 (Beg, Plead, Implore)
groups.tip: 从寻常请求到哀求乞求

items.def_en: (+ sb) make an earnest, serious, or urgent request to someone in authority
items.ex_en: Humanitarian leaders formally appeal to the international council for immediate emergency assistance.
items.ex_zh: 人道主义领袖正式向国际理事会呼吁立即提供紧急援助。

items.def_en: to ask someone earnestly or desperately for food, money, or a favor
items.ex_en: Desperate refugees were forced to beg the border guards for water rations.
items.ex_zh: 绝望的难民被迫向边境守卫乞求分发饮用水配额。

items.def_en: to ask someone earnestly and anxiously to do something
items.ex_en: The disgraced general sent an envoy to entreat the king for clemency.
items.ex_zh: 失宠的将军派出一名使者，恳求国王宽大处理。

items.def_en: (+ sth) plead desperately or vocally for help, mercy, or relief
items.ex_en: The entire healthcare system is crying out for urgent reform.
items.ex_zh: 整个医疗体系迫切需要紧急改革。

items.def_zh: 恳求，乞求；（在法庭上）认罪或抗辩；为……辩护
items.def_en: 1. to ask for something in an earnest and emotional way; to beg 2. to state formally in court whether you are guilty or not guilty of a crime
items.ex_en: The tearful child continued to plead with her parents for a second chance.
items.ex_zh: 那个泪流满面的孩子继续恳求父母再给她一次机会。

items.def_en: to ask someone desperately and earnestly to do something; to beg
items.ex_en: Citizens gathered before the embassy to implore the foreign powers for diplomatic intervention.
items.ex_zh: 民众聚集在大使馆前，哀求外国势力进行外交干预。

items.def_en: to ask urgently and fervently for something, typically expressing deep distress
items.ex_en: I beseech your majesty to spare the innocent villagers from this cruel punishment.
items.ex_zh: 我恳求陛下免除这些无辜村民所受的残酷惩罚。

items.def_en: to ask or beg for something humbly and earnestly, especially from a deity or superior
items.ex_en: The kneeling pilgrims supplicate the divine patron for deliverance from the raging pestilence.
items.ex_zh: 下跪的朝圣者虔诚地哀告神圣的守护者，祈求免受肆虐瘟疫的侵害。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe urgent, emotionally fraught, or desperate entreaties made to an authority or another person, typically marked by humility, vulnerability, or deep distress. They range from earnest legal or emotional pleading to abject, desperate supplication.
groups.summary_zh: 带有强烈情绪、卑微或绝望色彩的恳求与哀求。
groups.desc_en: Expresses desperate, submissive, and emotionally charged verbal solicitations for mercy, aid, or relief under acute vulnerability, distinct from transactional requesting.
groups.desc_zh: 表现处于极度弱势或绝境中带有强烈情绪与低姿态的叩求与哀告，区别于平等的常规索要与商洽。
