groups.nuance_en: intertwine: weave or twist two or more strands closely through each other (branches / destinies) · convolute: coil tortuously until complicated or difficult to trace (argument / plot / intestines) · twine: wrap around a support spirally like a climbing vine (vine / tendril / rope) · coil: wind tightly into concentric rings or spirals (snake / rope / spring) · wind around: wrap in continuous turns around a central axis (finger / post / trunk)
groups.nuance_zh: intertwine: 相互绞缠交织，命运或枝条紧密结合 (branches / destinies) · convolute: 盘旋卷曲以致极度错综复杂 (argument / plot / intestines) · twine: 像藤蔓一样螺旋盘附缠绕 (vine / tendril / rope) · coil: 紧密卷绕成同心圆或螺旋圈 (snake / rope / spring) · wind around: 连续绕圈包裹中央轴体 (finger / post / trunk)

groups.name: Join & Bind Typographically/Physically · 焊接与连字符连接 (Weld, Hyphen, Splice)
groups.tip: 焊接或符号连接一体

items.def_en: (+ sth) to unite or connect two things together physically to form a continuous whole
items.ex_en: He decided to join up right after graduating from high school.
items.ex_zh: 高中一毕业他就决定参军入伍。
items.ex2_en: Workers will join up the two pipeline sections early tomorrow morning.
items.ex2_zh: 工人们将于明早把两段管道连接在一起。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to join the ends of two ropes, wires, or pieces of film together to form a single continuous piece
items.ex_en: The technician had to splice together two torn fiber cables very carefully.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员必须非常小心地将两条断裂的光纤缆线拼接在一起。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to join separate parts together to make a whole
items.ex_en: Detectives worked tirelessly to piece together fragmented evidence from the crime scene.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们不知疲倦地工作，将犯罪现场零散的证据拼合在一起。

items.def_en: [I/T] to join or become joined together firmly by or as if by melting
items.ex_en: Intense thermal pressure caused the metal components to fuse into solid rock.
items.ex_zh: 巨大的热压使这些金属部件熔合成了坚硬的整体。
items.ex2_en: Extreme electrical heat will fuse the two copper wires together permanently.
items.ex2_zh: 极高的电热会将两根铜线永久熔合在一起。

items.def_zh: 焊接，熔接；使结合成一体
items.def_en: 1. To join pieces of metal or plastic by heating them until they fuse. 2. To unite people, organizations, or ideas firmly into a single cohesive whole.
items.ex_en: The skilled technician will weld these steel girders to reinforce the bridge.
items.ex_zh: 熟练的技术工人将焊接这些钢梁以加固桥梁。

items.def_en: to join two pieces of rope, wire, or film by interweaving strands or overlapping ends
items.ex_en: He learned how to splice the frayed nautical ropes aboard the vessel.
items.ex_zh: 他学会了如何在船上绞接拼接磨损起毛的航海绳缆。

items.def_zh: 用连字符连接（单词或音节）
items.def_en: To join words or syllables together using a hyphen (-); hyphenate.
items.ex_en: The editor reminded the novice writer to hyphen compound modifiers before nouns.
items.ex_zh: 编辑提醒这位新手作家要在名词前面的复合修饰语中使用连字符。

items.def_en: to connect two words or syllables with a hyphen
items.ex_en: The style manual requires editors to hyphenate compound adjectives before nouns consistently.
items.ex_zh: 该格式手册要求编辑始终用连字符连接名词前面的复合形容词。

groups.summary_en: An agent fuses, unites, or connects two entities into a continuous whole, either physically via heat/pressure or symbolically/typographically using punctuation or specialized joints. Verbs emphasize the creation of an unbreakable or formal composite link.
groups.summary_zh: 通过焊接等物理方式或连字符等形式将两部分牢固熔接或连结成一个整体。
groups.desc_en: Denotes seamlessly bonding, splicing, or grammatically linking physical or symbolic elements together into a continuous structural unit, contrasting with juxtaposition through permanent fusion or hyphenation.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过熔融、接驳或语法符号将分散的物理线段或词素固结为一个连续结构单元，与简单并列（put together）相比强调永久性融接或形态学链接。
groups.nuance_en: weld: fuse metals or unite components permanently through extreme heat or pressure (steel / plates / coalition) · splice: join ropes, wires, or film strips by overlapping and interweaving ends (film / genes / wire) · hyphenate: link distinct words graphically into a compound unit via a hyphen (words / terms) · fuse: liquefy and coalesce completely into a unified mass (materials / interests) · piece together: reconstruct a coherent whole from fragmented bits (clues / mosaic / evidence)
groups.nuance_zh: weld: 通过高温高压将金属熔接固结，或使联盟紧密合一 (steel / plates / coalition) · splice: 叠接或穿接绳头、基因序列或胶片胶卷 (film / genes / wire) · hyphenate: 用连字符将数个单词粘结为复合词 (words / terms) · fuse: 熔化合为一体，无缝融合 (materials / interests) · piece together: 将零碎拼块或线索严密拼合复原 (clues / mosaic / evidence)

groups.name: Leer & Ogle · 窥看与不怀好意地注视 (Leer, Ogle, Gawk)
groups.tip: 带有欲念或失礼地盯看

items.def_zh: 上下打量；（带有性意味地）注视
items.def_en: (+ sb) to look at someone carefully, especially to evaluate their sexual attractiveness
items.ex_en: We need to check out of the hotel by noon, but let's check out the local market first.
items.ex_zh: 我们需要在中午前结账退房，不过先去看看当地的集市吧。

items.def_en: (informal) to look closely, intently, or brazenly at someone
items.ex_en: The suspicious guard began to eyeball every customer entering the luxury boutique.
items.ex_zh: 心存戒备的保安开始上下打量每一个进入这家奢华精品店的顾客。

items.def_en: (+ at) to stare openly and rudely, often in a stupid, gaping, or unseemly manner
items.ex_en: Tourists often stand and gawk at the extravagant houses along the boulevard.
items.ex_zh: 游客们常常驻足傻看着林荫大道旁那些极其奢华的住宅。

items.def_zh: 呆看；失礼地张大嘴巴注视
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to stare openly and rudely, often with open-mouthed curiosity
items.ex_en: Pedestrians stopped to gawk at the bizarre street performer juggling flaming torches.
items.ex_zh: 行人们停下脚步，失礼地张大嘴巴注视着那个耍弄火把的怪异街头艺人。

items.def_zh: 色迷迷地看，挑逗地凝视
items.def_en: to stare at someone with open and suggestive sexual desire
items.ex_en: The creep continued to ogle passing women from across the hotel terrace.
items.ex_zh: 那个令人厌恶的家伙继续从酒店露台对面色迷迷地凝视着路过的女性。

items.def_zh: 色迷迷地看，斜着眼不怀好意地看
items.def_en: to look or stare at someone in an unpleasant, malicious, or sexually suggestive way
items.ex_en: The shady man continued to leer across the room at the dancers.
items.ex_zh: 那个形迹可疑的男人继续从房间另一侧不怀好意地斜眼看着舞者们。

items.def_zh: 斜眼看；不怀好意或色迷迷地注视
items.def_en: (+ sb) to look at someone in an unpleasant, malicious, or sexually suggestive way
items.ex_en: I noticed the sinister stranger leer at me from across the bar.
items.ex_zh: 我注意到那个不怀好意的陌生人从酒吧另一侧色迷迷地盯着我看。

items.def_en: (+ over/at) to gaze upon someone with malicious satisfaction or triumph
items.ex_en: He could not help but gloat over his rival's humiliating public defeat.
items.ex_zh: 看到竞争对手在公众面前丢脸落败，他忍不住幸灾乐祸地冷眼旁观。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe fixing one's gaze upon a person in a sexually suggestive, predatory, intrusive, or malicious manner. 'Ogle' leans toward overt sexual admiration/undressing with eyes, whereas 'leer' conveys malicious, lascivious, or sinister intent.
groups.summary_zh: 指带着挑逗、好色、侵犯性或邪恶的不良意图注视他人。
groups.desc_en: Denotes casting inappropriate, sexually suggestive, open-mouthed, or malicious glances at someone, contrasting with neutral observing by conveying crude appetite, mockery, or voyeuristic intrusion.
groups.desc_zh: 指带着性欲觊觎、呆滞失礼或恶意的目的凝视窥看他人，与中性观察（look/watch）相比突显出粗鄙的肉欲、嘲弄或侵犯意味。
groups.nuance_en: leer: cast an unpleasant, sly, or sexually suggestive sideways look (stranger / creep) · ogle: stare openly and unabashedly with greedy sexual desire (crowd / body) · gawk: stare with an open mouth in clumsy, stupid amazement (tourists / onlookers) · gloat: gaze with malicious triumph over another's misfortune (rival / enemy) · eyeball: look straight and aggressively at someone to intimidate or size them up (opponent / rival)
groups.nuance_zh: leer: 投以心怀鬼胎、下流挑逗或不怀好意的斜视 (stranger / creep) · ogle: 肆无忌惮、露骨贪婪地色眯眯打量 (crowd / body) · gawk: 呆头呆脑、张口结舌地傻看发愣 (tourists / onlookers) · gloat: 幸灾乐祸地看着对手落难自鸣得意 (rival / enemy) · eyeball: 毫无礼貌地直勾勾挑衅式打量 (opponent / rival)

groups.name: Legal Substitution & Contractual Succession · 法律代位与契约承继 (Subrogate, Novate)
groups.tip: 订立新合同以替代旧债权

items.def_zh: 转让（合同权利、财产或利益）
items.def_en: (+ to) to legally transfer rights, claims, or property to another party
items.ex_en: The inventor agreed to assign all patent rights to the pharmaceutical corporation.
items.ex_zh: 发明人同意将所有专利权转让给这家医药公司。

items.def_zh: 转移，转交（权利、责任或所有权）
items.def_en: (+ sth to sb) to transfer a legal right, title, claim, or obligation to a successor
items.ex_en: The aging patriarch decided to pass on the family estate to his grandson.
items.ex_zh: 年迈的族长决定将家族产业的所有权转交给他孙子。

items.def_zh: 签署转让；通过签字转交（财产或权利）
items.def_en: (+ sth to sb) to officially transfer the legal ownership of rights or property to another party by signing a document
items.ex_en: She reluctantly agreed to sign over the deed of the property to creditors.
items.ex_zh: 她勉强同意签署文件，将该房产的产权正式转让给债权人。

items.def_zh: 移交；交出（控制权或法定责任）
items.def_en: (+ sth to sb) to transfer formal responsibility, rights, or possession of something to another person
items.ex_en: The outgoing general will hand over operational command to his successor tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 即将卸任的将军将于明天上午把作战指挥权正式移交给继任者。

items.def_zh: 正式取代（既有法律、规则或条约）
items.def_en: to take the place of a previously valid law, contract, or provision, rendering it void
items.ex_en: This comprehensive international agreement will supersede all earlier bilateral trade treaties.
items.ex_zh: 这项全面的国际协定将正式取代先前所有的双边贸易条约。

items.def_zh: 移交；转移给（继承人或下级）
items.def_en: [I/T] (+ on/upon/to) to pass duties, liabilities, or powers from one legal body or holder to a successor
items.ex_en: Administrative responsibilities will devolve upon the newly formed regional governing council.
items.ex_zh: 行政管理职责将移交给新成立的地区管理委员会。

items.def_zh: （法律或保险中）代位求偿，替代
items.def_en: (law) To substitute one person or party in place of another with respect to a lawful claim, right, or demand.
items.ex_en: Upon paying the settlement, the insurer shall subrogate to all lawful recovery claims.
items.ex_zh: 支付理赔金后，保险人应当代位享有所有合法的追偿请求权。

items.def_zh: （通过订立新契约）更新，替代（合同或债务）
items.def_en: (law) To replace an existing legal contract or obligation with a new one.
items.ex_en: Both parties agreed to novate the outstanding debt through a revised financial agreement.
items.ex_zh: 双方同意通过订立经修订的新财务协议来更新并替代未偿债务。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this legal frame describe substituting one party, right, or obligation for another by operation of law or mutual contract, transferring liabilities, claims, or duties formally from an original holder to a successor.
groups.summary_zh: 通过法律规定或合同协议，将权利、债务或法律主体正式转移替代给另一方。
groups.desc_en: Involves formally transferring, replacing, or assuming rights, duties, or contractual standing through legal mechanisms, contrasting with informal physical handing-over.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及通过法律或正式程序转移、替代或承接权利、债务与契约地位，区别于非正式的物理移交。
groups.nuance_en: assign: formal transfer of existing rights or property to a third party (rights / patent / contract) · novate: legally replace an original party or obligation with a new one, extinguishing the old contract (agreement / debt / contract) · subrogate: step into the legal shoes of another to pursue their claims (insurer / right / claim) · devolve: pass duties, powers, or estate downward or by succession (power / authority / estate) · sign over: legally surrender ownership via signature (deed / title / assets)
groups.nuance_zh: assign: 依法将现有权利或财产转让给第三方 (rights / patent / contract) · novate: 订立新约以全面替换原当事人或债务，旧契约即刻消灭 (agreement / debt / contract) · subrogate: 保险人等依法代位行使被保险人的追偿求偿权 (insurer / right / claim) · devolve: 职责、权力或遗产依法下放、移交或自然继承 (power / authority / estate) · sign over: 通过签署法律文书正式放弃或过户产权 (deed / title / assets)

groups.name: Lengthen & Protract · 延长与展延 (Lengthen, Extend, Protract)
groups.tip: 拉长空间维度或延长持续时间

items.def_en: (+ sth) to extend the duration or spatial span of something
items.ex_en: Exhausted from the marathon, he stretched out on the grass to catch his breath.
items.ex_zh: 跑完马拉松筋疲力尽的他躺在草地上歇气。
items.ex2_en: The professor had to stretch out the difficult lecture to two hours.
items.ex2_zh: 教授不得不把这堂难懂的讲座延长至两个小时。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make something longer in physical span, reach, or duration
items.ex_en: The board decided to extend the project deadline by an additional three months.
items.ex_zh: 董事会决定将项目的截止日期再延长三个月。
items.ex2_en: The magnificent scenic highway will extend along the rugged coastal cliffs.
items.ex2_zh: 这条壮丽的景观公路将沿着崎岖的海岸悬崖延伸。

items.def_en: [I/T] to pull something to its full length or make a period of time cover more
items.ex_en: The gymnasts stretch their muscles thoroughly before starting the intensive routine.
items.ex_zh: 体操运动员在开始高强度训练之前会彻底拉伸肌肉。
items.ex2_en: This elastic sports fabric will stretch easily during vigorous bodily movements.
items.ex2_zh: 这种弹性运动面料在剧烈肢体运动中很容易拉伸。

items.def_en: To become longer in distance or time, or to make something longer.
items.ex_en: The tailor will lengthen the trousers slightly to match the client's height.
items.ex_zh: 裁缝会把裤子稍微加长一点，以符合顾客的身高。
items.ex2_en: The evening shadows lengthen rapidly across the quiet courtyard at sunset.
items.ex2_zh: 日落时分，傍晚的阴影在安静的院子里迅速拉长。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to prolong something unnecessarily or make it continue longer than desirable
items.ex_en: There is no need to drag out the dispute any longer.
items.ex_zh: 没有必要再故意拖延这场争端了。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make an event, speech, or process last much longer than necessary
items.ex_en: The car hit a patch of black ice and spun out into the ditch.
items.ex_zh: 汽车碾过一块暗冰，失控打转滑进了路沟。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make or become longer in physical shape, often through stretching
items.ex_en: Warm temperatures cause the specialized glass tube to elongate along the track.
items.ex_zh: 温暖的温度促使特制玻璃管沿着轨道拉长延伸。
items.ex2_en: The specialized machine will elongate the warm metal rods into wires.
items.ex2_zh: 这台专用机器会将受热的金属棒拉长成线材。

items.def_en: (formal) To prolong something or make a meeting, process, or event last longer than expected or necessary.
items.ex_en: Endless procedural objections threatened to protract the legal trial indefinitely.
items.ex_zh: 无休止的程序性异议极有可能让这场法律审判无限期地拖延下去。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to stretching physical dimensions or drawing out durations in time, ranging from neutral extension to wearisome prolongation.
groups.summary_zh: 指在空间长度或时间跨度上加以拉长或过度延展。
groups.desc_en: Denotes drawing out length, duration, or scope beyond normal or desired limits, contrasting with mere neutral expansion or enlargement.
groups.desc_zh: 指将空间长度、时间跨度或范围拉伸、延宕至超出常规或预期，区别于中性的单纯扩大或扩张。
groups.nuance_en: lengthen: neutralize or physical/temporal increase in longitudinal dimension (shadows / days / skirt) · extend: stretch outward in space, scope, or granted deadline (deadline / territory / welcome) · protract: prolong tediously or unnecessarily in time (negotiations / conflict / agony) · drag out: deliberately or annoyingly slow down to delay completion (proceedings / meeting / discussion) · elongate: physically pull or stretch out to make slenderly longer (neck / shape / fibers)
groups.nuance_zh: lengthen: 使物理长度或时间跨度单纯变长 (shadows / days / skirt) · extend: 向外延伸空间、拓展适用范围或延展宽限期 (deadline / territory / welcome) · protract: 冗长、不必要地拖延时间或延长痛苦过程 (negotiations / conflict / agony) · drag out: 刻意或令人厌烦地慢吞吞拉长，迟迟不肯收场 (proceedings / meeting / discussion) · elongate: 在物理形态上被拉伸拉细 (neck / shape / fibers)

groups.name: Levy Taxes & Extra Charges · 征税与加收费用 (Tax, Surcharge, Levy)
groups.tip: 按规定额外加收税费附加费

items.def_en: to impose an obligatory financial charge on a citizen, goods, or transactions by an authority
items.ex_en: The regional authority plans to tax luxury imported cars at a higher rate.
items.ex_zh: 该地区当局计划对进口豪华汽车按更高税率征税。

items.def_en: to evaluate property in order to set a tax, or to impose a specific charge on someone
items.ex_en: The county assessor will assess the commercial property based on current values.
items.ex_zh: 县估税官将根据当前市场价值对该商业地产核定税额。

items.def_zh: 强行征收；额外加收（税款或费用）
items.def_en: (+ sth) impose an extra tax, fee, or penalty suddenly or unfairly
items.ex_en: The city council decided to slap on a congestion fee for drivers.
items.ex_zh: 市议会决定突然对驾驶员强行加收一笔拥堵费。

items.def_zh: 附加，额外计入（费用或税额）
items.def_en: (+ sth) add an extra charge or condition onto an existing bill or payment, often as an afterthought
items.ex_en: The airline tried to tack on hidden handling fees to every passenger.
items.ex_zh: 这家航空公司试图对每位乘客额外追加隐秘的手续费。

items.def_en: to impose a tax, fee, or fine formally by legal authority
items.ex_en: The national parliament voted to levy a heavy tax on carbon emissions.
items.ex_zh: 国家议会投票决定对碳排放正式征收重税。

items.def_en: to fix or impose a duty on goods entering or leaving a country
items.ex_en: The government chose to tariff foreign electronics to safeguard domestic manufacturing industries.
items.ex_zh: 政府选择对外国电子产品征收关税，以保护国内制造业。

items.def_zh: 对……收取额外费用，加收附加税
items.def_en: to charge an additional fee or tax on something over and above the regular price
items.ex_en: Delivery services will surcharge peak season packages to offset high operational expenses.
items.ex_zh: 快递服务将对旺季包裹加收额外费用，以弥补高昂的运营开销。

items.def_zh: 缴纳什一税；向……征收什一税
items.def_en: to pay or collect one tenth of one's income or produce as a religious tax or offering
items.ex_en: The devout farmers faithfully tithe ten percent of their grain harvest annually.
items.ex_zh: 虔诚的农夫们每年都恪尽职守地缴纳其粮食收成的十分之一作为什一税。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to official, institutional, or customary acts of imposing obligatory fees, taxes, or additional surcharges on goods, transactions, or people. They vary by administrative mechanism, religious obligation, or supplemental commercial pricing.
groups.summary_zh: 依法或按惯例征收赋税、附加费与摊派款项。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the authoritative, institutional, or arbitrary imposition of compulsory financial levies or incremental surcharges, contrasting with standard consensual pricing.
groups.desc_zh: 指官方、机构或收费方强制性、指令性地征收赋税或加收额外附加费，区别于常规协商定价。
groups.nuance_en: tax: legally demand state contribution on income, goods, or wealth (income / profits / goods) · levy: authoritatively impose and collect a tax, fine, or toll (fine / tariff / assessment) · surcharge: add an extra compulsory fee on top of existing base cost (fare / ticket / bill) · tariff: impose duties specifically on cross-border imports/exports (imports / goods / steel) · slap on: aggressively or arbitrarily impose a sudden penalty or fee (fine / surcharge / sanctions)
groups.nuance_zh: tax: 国家依法对收入、商品或资产普遍课征税款 (income / profits / goods) · levy: 官方依职权正式征收、强行摊派税赋或罚款 (fine / tariff / assessment) · surcharge: 在原有基础费用之外额外加收附加费 (fare / ticket / bill) · tariff: 专门针对进出口关税的课征或调整 (imports / goods / steel) · slap on: 粗暴、突然或惩罚性地强加费用或限制 (fine / surcharge / sanctions)

groups.name: Live in Specific Lifestyle Manner · 以特定方式栖居生活 (Bachelor, Bach, Slum)
groups.tip: 生物在特定环境下栖息

items.def_zh: 临时露营；在简陋环境中暂居
items.def_en: live or sleep in makeshift conditions like in a tent or unfurnished room
items.ex_en: During home renovations, the family had to camp out in the unfurnished basement.
items.ex_zh: 在房屋翻修期间，全家人不得不暂居在未添置家具的地下室里。

items.def_zh: 隐居；窝在（某处生活或藏匿）
items.def_en: stay or reside in a secluded or hidden accommodation for an extended period
items.ex_en: The exhausted novelist chose to hole up in a remote mountain cabin.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的作家选择窝在一座偏远的山中小屋里避世写作。

items.def_en: (+ with) live together without being married, or cohabit casually
items.ex_en: He decided to shack up with his new partner in a rented flat.
items.ex_zh: 他决定和新伴侣在租来的公寓里同居生活。

items.def_zh: 过单身生活；独自料理生活
items.def_en: 1. (dated or informal) To live as an unmarried man, managing one's own housekeeping and cooking.
items.ex_en: After his flatmate relocated, Mark had to bachelor in the city alone.
items.ex_zh: 室友搬走后，马克不得不独自一人在这座城市里料理单身生活。

items.def_zh: （slum it）在简陋条件下度日；逛贫民窟，体验下层生活
items.def_en: (also 'slum it') (informal) To live or spend time in conditions much poorer or less comfortable than you are used to.
items.ex_en: We had to slum it in a drafty cabin during our hiking trip.
items.ex_zh: 徒步旅行期间，我们不得不在一间四处漏风的简陋木屋里将就度日。

items.def_zh: 过单身汉生活，独自操持家务
items.def_en: 1. (informal, chiefly US / NZ) To live alone as a bachelor, doing one's own cooking and housekeeping.
items.ex_en: After college, Mark preferred to bach in a tiny studio near his workplace.
items.ex_zh: 大学毕业后，马克更喜欢在工作地点附近的小单身公寓里独自操持生活。

items.def_en: live in squalid, messy, or uncomfortable conditions
items.ex_en: The stranded students had to pig it inside the filthy, unheated warehouse overnight.
items.ex_zh: 滞留的学生们不得不在肮脏且没有暖气的仓库里邋遢困苦地度过一宿。

items.def_zh: 过简陋生活，勉强将就居住
items.def_en: live temporarily without normal comforts and conveniences
items.ex_en: Without any electricity or running water, the campers gladly chose to rough it.
items.ex_zh: 在没有水电供应的情况下，露营者们欣然选择过简陋的将就生活。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe residing or keeping house in a distinct, socially characterized manner—typically living unencumbered as an unmarried person, roughing it in rustic accommodations, or deliberately enduring substandard conditions below one's customary station.
groups.summary_zh: 指过着单身汉生活、简居独处或屈身栖居于低端环境。
groups.desc_en: Denotes inhabiting a dwelling or conducting daily life under distinctive, makeshift, or suboptimal socio-domestic arrangements, contrasting with settled conventional living.
groups.desc_zh: 指在非正规、将就凑合或特定社会亚状态下栖居生活，区别于按部就班的定居生活。
groups.nuance_en: rough it: endure living without basic domestic comforts or amenities (outdoors / camping / wilderness) · hole up: hide or take secluded refuge for protection or evasion (cabin / hideout / hotel) · shack up: live together in an informal romantic cohabitation without marriage (partner / lover / girlfriend) · slum: visit or inhabit conditions markedly below one's customary social station (neighborhood / tenements / club) · camp out: live temporarily in makeshift quarters or open air (tent / lawn / office)
groups.nuance_zh: rough it: 在缺乏生活设施与基本便利的艰苦条件下将就度日 (outdoors / camping / wilderness) · hole up: 闭门隐居、藏匿避风头或与世隔绝 (cabin / hideout / hotel) · shack up: 未婚同居、搭伙过日子 (partner / lover / girlfriend) · slum: 屈尊体验下层艰苦生活或出入贫民区消遣 (neighborhood / tenements / club) · camp out: 在野外露宿或在临时简陋场所打地铺借宿 (tent / lawn / office)

groups.name: Locate & Determine Identity · 查明与确准定位 (Locate, Pinpoint, Identify)
groups.tip: 探明确切位置与情况

items.def_zh: 用检索表鉴定（动植物物种）；确定，查明
items.def_en: To identify an organism or object using a biological classification key.
items.ex_en: The botanist sought to key the rare alpine moss using classification charts.
items.ex_zh: 植物学家试图借助分类检索表来鉴定这种罕见的高山苔藓。

items.def_en: to detect, locate, or identify someone or something visually or through observation
items.ex_en: From the lookout tower, the ranger managed to spot a faint plume of smoke.
items.ex_zh: 护林员从瞭望塔上敏锐地发现了一缕微弱的烟雾。

items.def_zh: 找出……的位置，查明；使坐落于，安置
items.def_en: 1. To discover the exact place or position of something. 2. To place, establish, or position something in a particular location.
items.ex_en: Search parties used sonar equipment to locate the wreckage on the sea floor.
items.ex_zh: 搜救队利用声呐设备查明了海底残骸的确切位置。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to search for someone or something until they are located
items.ex_en: Talent scouts regularly seek out exceptional young athletes across small rural communities.
items.ex_zh: 球探经常穿梭于各个乡村社区，物色天赋出众的年轻运动员。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to identify or distinguish one person or thing specifically from a larger group
items.ex_en: It is unfair to single out one player when the whole team performed poorly.
items.ex_zh: 在全队表现都很差的情况下，单单挑出一名球员来责备是不公平的。

items.def_en: to find something or someone by carefully following clues, trails, or investigation
items.ex_en: The police managed to track down the suspect after weeks of investigation.
items.ex_zh: 经过数周的调查，警方终于追查到了嫌疑人的下落。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to direct one's attention or locate the exact position or identity of a target
items.ex_en: The detective managed to zero in on the exact hideout within hours.
items.ex_zh: 警探在数小时内便锁定了藏匿点的确切位置。

items.def_zh: 精准确定，查明准确位置或原因
items.def_en: to discover, locate, or explain the exact position, nature, or reason of something
items.ex_en: Engineers worked around the clock to pinpoint the precise source of the leak.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们夜以继日地工作，以查明泄漏源头的准确位置。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the cognitive and investigatory process of finding the exact spatial position, nature, or critical identity of an unknown target. Nuances differentiate general discovery of position from high-precision targeting.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过认知搜寻或分析手段，查明具体目标的位置、属性或关键特征。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the cognitive or sensory process of isolating, tracking down, and fixing the precise coordinates or identity of a target, contrasting with general unguided searching.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过感官甄别、搜寻追踪并精确锁定目标的具体坐标或真实身份，区别于漫无目的的搜寻。
groups.nuance_en: locate: establish the exact physical site or existence of something (source / missing person / files) · pinpoint: determine precise coordinates, cause, or timing with sharp accuracy (location / cause / problem) · track down: pursue elusive clues until finding the quarry (suspect / reference / fugitive) · spot: perceive and recognize visually, especially amid distractions (target / defect / error) · zero in on: progressively converge attention or aim directly onto a target (weakness / target / problem)
groups.nuance_zh: locate: 查明某物的确切物理位置或下落 (source / missing person / files) · pinpoint: 以极高精确度锚定具体坐标、病因或核心症结 (location / cause / problem) · track down: 循线追踪、克服重重困难抓捕或找到 (suspect / reference / fugitive) · spot: 在复杂背景中一眼认出或瞥见 (target / defect / error) · zero in on: 焦点逐步收拢并全神贯注锁定目标 (weakness / target / problem)

groups.name: Locomotion on Belly or All Fours · 匍匐与爬行 (Crawl, Creep, Grovel)
groups.tip: 四肢着地贴地缓慢向前爬

items.def_zh: 蹑手蹑脚爬行；悄无声息地贴地潜行
items.def_en: move along quietly and stealthily close to the ground
items.ex_en: The soldier began to creep along the muddy trench under dense fog cover.
items.ex_zh: 士兵借着浓雾的掩护，沿着泥泞的战壕悄无声息地贴地潜行。

items.def_zh: 缓慢蠕动前行；艰难爬移
items.def_en: move forward extremely slowly and with painstaking caution
items.ex_en: The wounded climber had to inch along the narrow, icy rock ledge.
items.ex_zh: 受伤的攀登者只得在狭窄冰冷的岩石壁架上艰难蠕动前行。

items.def_en: to move along extremely slowly, little by little
items.ex_en: Lying flat on his belly, he continued to inch toward the perimeter wire.
items.ex_zh: 他平趴在地上，继续极缓慢地向铁丝网边缘寸进挪动。
items.ex2_en: The cautious driver had to inch the oversized vehicle through the gate.
items.ex2_zh: 谨慎的司机不得不将这辆超大尺寸的车辆一点点挪过大门。

items.def_zh: 匍匐爬行；蹑手蹑脚地走，轻手轻脚地移动；逐渐蔓延
items.def_en: 1. To move slowly with the body close to the ground; to crawl. 2. To move quietly and carefully to avoid being noticed. 3. To develop, advance, or grow gradually.
items.ex_en: The cat began to creep through the tall grass toward the unsuspecting sparrow.
items.ex_zh: 那只猫压低身体贴近地面，悄悄穿过茂密的草丛走向毫无防备的麻雀。

items.def_zh: 爬行，匍匐前进；缓慢行进；巴结，谄媚
items.def_en: 1. To move forward on hands and knees or with the body dragging close to the ground. 2. To move forward extremely slowly. 3. (informal) To behave subserviently toward someone.
items.ex_en: We had to crawl on our hands and knees through the tight tunnel.
items.ex_zh: 我们不得不手膝着地，在狭窄的管道中匍匐爬行。

items.def_zh: 匍匐爬行，蹑手蹑脚地走（creep的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense and past participle of creep; to have moved slowly and stealthily, close to the ground or without being noticed.
items.ex_en: The scout crept across the open field on all fours without making noise.
items.ex_zh: 侦察兵四肢着地轻手轻脚地爬过开阔的田野，没有发出一丝声响。

items.def_zh: 匍匐；趴倒（亦含卑躬屈膝）
items.def_en: to lie or crawl with the face downwards and body close to the earth
items.ex_en: Defeated prisoners were forced to grovel in the dust before the ruthless conqueror.
items.ex_zh: 战败的俘虏被迫在残暴的征服者面前面朝下趴倒在尘土中。

items.def_zh: 手足并用地攀爬或匍匐移走
items.def_en: to move hurriedly or awkwardly on hands and feet over rough terrain
items.ex_en: Terrified hikers had to scramble on all fours across the crumbling gravel slope.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的徒步者们不得不手足并用地在崩塌的碎石坡上慌忙爬行。

groups.summary_en: An agent moves forward close to the ground on hands and knees, on the belly, or with exceptionally slow, stealthy strides to stay low and undetected.
groups.summary_zh: 指手膝着地、腹部贴地匍匐前进，或极其缓慢贴地移动的身姿。
groups.desc_en: Denotes human or animal locomotion characterized by keeping the body prone, low, or using multiple limbs, contrasting with upright bipedal walking.
groups.desc_zh: 指身体紧贴地面、伏卧或四肢着地的匍匐位移方式，区别于直立行进。
groups.nuance_en: crawl: move slowly on hands and knees or with body dragging along ground (baby / soldier / traffic) · creep: move slowly, quietly, and cautiously to avoid detection (shadow / burglar / fear) · inch: advance by tiny, barely perceptible increments (crowd / car / glacier) · grovel: crawl or prostrate oneself abjectly in submission or fear (feet / dust / dirt) · scramble: move hurriedly and awkwardly using both hands and feet over rough terrain (scree / slope / rocks)
groups.nuance_zh: crawl: 四肢着地爬行或肚皮贴地匍匐前进；亦指极其缓慢的蠕行 (baby / soldier / traffic) · creep: 蹑手蹑脚、鬼鬼祟祟地轻步潜行以防被察觉 (shadow / burglar / fear) · inch: 一寸一寸极缓慢、近乎停滞地向前挪动 (crowd / car / glacier) · grovel: 卑躬屈膝地匍匐在地、奴颜婢膝求饶 (feet / dust / dirt) · scramble: 在陡坡乱石上手脚并用仓促攀爬挣扎 (scree / slope / rocks)

groups.name: Logical Generalization & Deduction · 归纳与推演 (Generalize, Deduce, Induce)
groups.tip: 依循严谨逻辑层层推导

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ that/out) to formulate thoughts systematically using logical arguments
items.ex_en: Philosophers reason that every observable effect must originate from a prior sufficient cause.
items.ex_zh: 哲学家们推导认为，每一种可观察到的结果都必然源于先前充足的起因。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to solve a problem or arrive at an understanding through logical thinking
items.ex_en: Scientists are trying to figure out why the virus mutated so rapidly.
items.ex_zh: 科学家们正试图弄明白这种病毒为何变异得如此之快。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to deduce, calculate, or logically determine something by reasoning
items.ex_en: She managed to work out the mystery using simple facts and basic logic.
items.ex_zh: 她利用基本事实和简单逻辑，顺利推理得出了谜团的答案。

items.def_en: to derive or infer a general law from particular facts or instances
items.ex_en: From decades of observational data, scientists managed to induce a universal physical law.
items.ex_zh: 科学家根据数十年的观测数据，成功归纳出了一条普适的物理定律。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to find a solution or conclusion through careful logical analysis and deduction
items.ex_en: The investigator managed to reason out the sequence of events before midnight arrived.
items.ex_zh: 调查员在午夜来临之前，凭借严谨的逻辑分析推论出了事件的完整经过。

items.def_zh: 概括，归纳；以偏概全，泛泛而论；普及
items.def_en: 1. to form a general principle or conclusion from specific examples or evidence. 2. to make a general statement that is too broad, often oversimplifying
items.ex_en: Researchers should not generalize from a tiny sample of poorly controlled clinical trials.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员不应从控制不佳的微小临床样本中贸然得出普遍规律。

items.def_en: to form an opinion or reach a conclusion about something by reasoning logically from facts or evidence
items.ex_en: Detectives can deduce the suspect's approximate height from these distinct muddy footprints.
items.ex_zh: 刑警能够根据这些清晰的泥泞脚印，合乎逻辑地推断出嫌疑人的大致身高。

items.def_en: [I/T] to deduce or reason using formal syllogistic logic
items.ex_en: The scholar paused to syllogize the moral dilemma from clear classical premises.
items.ex_zh: 学者停顿下来，从明确的古典前提以三段论推导这一道德困境。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on formal cognitive directional reasoning: bottom-up inductive generalization from particulars to universals, or top-down deductive reasoning from premises to specific instances.
groups.summary_zh: 指从个别到一般的归纳概括，或从普遍法则向下推演具体情况的思维方式。
groups.desc_en: Denotes formal or structured mental processing to extrapolate general laws or derive specific truths from premises, contrasting with intuitive guessing or raw remembering.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过归纳普遍规律或依据前提推导结论的形式逻辑认知推理，区别于直觉猜测或机械记忆。
groups.nuance_en: deduce: infer a specific necessary conclusion logically from general premises (conclusion / facts / motive) · induce: formulate a general principle from particular observed instances (law / theory / principle) · generalize: extend observations from specific cases to formulate broad concepts (findings / results / conclusion) · reason: apply coherent logic and critical thinking to resolve a matter (way / solution / truth) · syllogize: infer conclusions through formal deductive categorical syllogisms (argument / premise / inference)
groups.nuance_zh: deduce: 由一般前提推导必然发生的个别事实（演绎推理） (conclusion / facts / motive) · induce: 从大量个别观测事实中总结一般性原理（归纳推理） (law / theory / principle) · generalize: 由点及面进行概括，提炼普遍适用结论 (findings / results / conclusion) · reason: 运用理性思维与严谨逻辑进行分析推论 (way / solution / truth) · syllogize: 运用经典三段论形式进行严格推演 (argument / premise / inference)

groups.name: Lower Body to Ground · 跪屈与蹲伏 (Kneel, Crouch)
groups.tip: 降低重心的不同下蹲姿态

items.def_en: to lower one's body closer to the ground to avoid danger or remain hidden
items.ex_en: When gunfire erupted nearby, the frightened civilians shouted to get down immediately.
items.ex_zh: 附近爆发枪声时，惊恐的平民大喊着立刻俯身贴地隐蔽。

items.def_en: (+ down) to sit on your heels or bend your knees low while remaining on the feet
items.ex_en: The gardener paused to squat down and inspect the tender new tomato sprouts.
items.ex_zh: 园丁停下脚步蹲下身来，仔细检查刚长出来的娇嫩番茄幼芽。

items.raw_cluster: 姿势与身体动作 Posture & Gesture
items.def_en: 1. (+ down) To bend your knees and lower your body close to the ground, often in fear, hiding, or readiness to spring.
items.ex_en: The hunter had to crouch low behind bushes to remain unseen.
items.ex_zh: 猎人不得不压低身体蜷缩在灌木丛后，以免被猎物察觉。

items.def_zh: 跪下，屈膝（kneel的过去式及过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense and past participle of kneel; rested on one or both knees.
items.ex_en: She knelt silently on the stone floor to recite her evening prayers.
items.ex_zh: 她静静地跪在石质地板上，默诵着晚间的祷告词句。

items.def_en: to lower one's body quickly to the floor or ground, often for concealment or protection
items.ex_en: As explosions rocked the perimeter, soldiers were ordered to drop down instantly.
items.ex_zh: 当阵地周围响起剧烈爆炸时，士兵们接到命令立刻扑倒在地掩蔽。

items.def_en: to squat or crouch low to the ground with the knees bent
items.ex_en: We had to hunker down behind the stone wall during the hailstorm.
items.ex_zh: 冰雹肆虐期间，我们不得不蹲伏屈身缩在石墙后面躲避。

items.def_en: (+ up) to curl one's limbs close to the body for warmth, protection, or fear
items.ex_en: Shivering with cold, the stray puppies had to huddle close together.
items.ex_zh: 那些流浪的小狗冻得瑟瑟发抖，只得紧紧蜷缩依偎在一起。
items.ex2_en: The shepherd managed to huddle the frightened sheep into the barn.
items.ex2_zh: 牧羊人设法将受惊的羊群聚拢赶入牲口棚中。

items.def_en: to crouch down or shrink away in fear, pain, or shame
items.ex_en: The frightened spaniel would cower beneath the wooden table whenever thunder cracked.
items.ex_zh: 每当雷声隆隆作响时，受惊的猎犬都会畏缩地蜷伏在木桌底下。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe lowering the human torso toward the ground by bending the knees or hips, often for concealment, defense, reverence, or physical work. 'Kneel' focuses on resting one's weight on the knees, while 'crouch' centers on bringing the chest and belly close to the ground while balancing on bent legs.
groups.summary_zh: 指弯曲膝盖或躯干以降低重心，采取跪坐、蹲踞或缩低身姿的体态。
groups.desc_en: Denotes bending the knees or curling the torso to bring the center of gravity close to the ground, contrasting with remaining upright or fully lying prone.
groups.desc_zh: 指弯曲膝盖或收缩躯干以降低重心贴近地面，区别于直立站立或完全平躺。
groups.nuance_en: kneel: rest one or both knees on the ground in deference, prayer, or rest (pew / ground / prayer) · crouch: bend knees and lower body close to ground, ready to spring or hide (shadows / corner / grass) · squat: sit on one's heels or bend deeply with thighs against calves (heels / haunches / ground) · hunker down: crouch low, bracing stably against storm or trouble (shelter / storm / bunker) · cower: crouch, tremble, and shrink back in terror or servility (fear / corner / blows)
groups.nuance_zh: kneel: 双膝或单膝着地以示虔敬、屈服或进行劳作 (pew / ground / prayer) · crouch: 屈膝弯背低姿态蹲伏，蓄势待发或借掩体隐藏 (shadows / corner / grass) · squat: 完全屈膝蹲下，臀部悬空落于脚后跟上 (heels / haunches / ground) · hunker down: 蹲伏缩身并坚守阵地以抗击外界风浪困难 (shelter / storm / bunker) · cower: 因恐惧、屈辱而畏缩蜷伏、瑟瑟发抖 (fear / corner / blows)

groups.name: Manual Shaping & Curving · 捏塑与团聚 (Ball, Cup, Mold)
groups.tip: 揉揉捏捏将其塑造成团状

items.def_en: to bend hands, fingers, or a pliable surface into a curved, rounded configuration
items.ex_en: The artisan carefully learned to curl the pliable copper strips with pliers.
items.ex_zh: 工匠认真学会了用手钳将柔韧的铜条弯折卷曲成优美的弧形。
items.ex2_en: The delicate flower petals will curl when exposed to dry heat.
items.ex2_zh: 娇嫩的花瓣暴露在干热环境中时会卷曲起来。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to squeeze or crumple something into a spherical, globular mass
items.ex_en: Frustrated by mistakes, the author began to ball up his manuscript pages.
items.ex_zh: 因屡屡出错而感到沮丧，作者动手把写好的手稿纸页团成纸球。
items.ex2_en: The discarded foil wrappers will ball up easily in your hand.
items.ex2_zh: 废弃的锡箔包装纸在手里很容易揉捏成团。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to curve or bend something into a curved or coiled shape
items.ex_en: He used his thumb to curl up the stiff edges of parchment.
items.ex_zh: 他用拇指将那张羊皮纸原本平挺的边缘向上卷曲成弧形。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to shape a flexible material into a cylinder or ball by folding it repeatedly
items.ex_en: Remember to roll up the heavy canvas tightly before placing it away.
items.ex_zh: 把厚重的帆布收起来存放前，切记要将其紧紧卷成圆筒状。
items.ex2_en: The dried autumn leaves roll up into brittle tubes in winter.
items.ex2_zh: 干燥的秋叶在冬天卷成了脆弱的筒状。

items.def_en: To form or be formed into a tight, round shape or ball.
items.ex_en: Anger caused him to ball his hands into tight fists immediately.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒使他不由自主地将双手紧紧攥成坚硬的拳头。
items.ex2_en: The damp synthetic fibers ball tightly when rubbed against rough surfaces.
items.ex2_zh: 潮湿的合成纤维在粗糙表面上摩擦时会紧紧团聚起球。

items.def_zh: （使双手）做成杯状，拱起手捧着；为……拔火罐
items.def_en: 1. To shape your hands into a curved cup-like shape, or hold something gently with your hands curved. 2. To apply a heated suction cup to the skin as a therapeutic treatment.
items.ex_en: She had to cup both hands together to drink from mountain springs.
items.ex_zh: 她不得不将双手合拢做成杯状，去舀山涧中的清泉饮用。

items.def_en: to shape something into a ball or cylinder by turning it between the palms or on a surface
items.ex_en: The baker proceeded to roll the soft yeast dough into smooth spheres.
items.ex_zh: 面包师傅接着将柔软的发酵面团在掌心揉搓滚成光滑的球体。
items.ex2_en: The soft clay rolls smoothly between the potter's warm palms.
items.ex2_zh: 柔软的陶土在陶工温暖的手掌间平滑地滚成圆柱体。

items.def_en: to work a soft, pliable substance by hand into a definite shape
items.ex_en: Potters carefully mold wet clay into exquisite decorative vases with skilled hands.
items.ex_zh: 陶艺师用灵巧的双手小心翼翼地把湿润的黏土塑造成精美的装饰花瓶。

groups.summary_en: An agent shapes a malleable material or their own body part (especially hands) into a curved, hollow, or globular form. Verbs in this frame detail the precise geometry and physical action of the hands.
groups.summary_zh: 用双手或模具将物体捏制成弧状、碗状或球体，或手部自身做出相应姿势。
groups.desc_en: Denotes manually gathering, bending, or kneading pliable materials into rounded, hollowed, or defined geometrical contours, contrasting with cutting or flattening.
groups.desc_zh: 指用手将柔韧材料揉捏、弯折或团聚成球状、杯状等特定立体曲面，区别于切割或摊平压扁。
groups.nuance_en: ball: compact material tightly into a spherical mass (fists / paper / dough) · cup: curve the palm or hands into a concave receptacle (hands / chin / cheek) · mold: manually knead and shape a plastic substance into desired form (clay / figure / dough) · roll: turn material over and over to make a cylinder or ball (mat / pastry / cigarette) · curl: bend or wind a flexible strip into spiral or ringed shapes (hair / ribbon / edge)
groups.nuance_zh: ball: 将纸团、面团或手掌紧密揉攥成球状 (fists / paper / dough) · cup: 双手或单手掌心弯曲拱成凹兜状以托举或护住 (hands / chin / cheek) · mold: 用手捏制、塑形可塑物料以成形 (clay / figure / dough) · roll: 将片状或柔韧物料顺次卷裹成圆柱状或滚动成团 (mat / pastry / cigarette) · curl: 使柔软条状物弯折盘曲成螺旋或环状 (hair / ribbon / edge)

groups.name: Mark & Pattern with Distinctive Signs · 刻印与覆纹 (Character, Checker, Inscribe)
groups.tip: 在表面压印或铭刻印记

items.def_zh: 划线标明；以特定记号标出
items.def_en: (+ sth) draw lines or place distinctive marks to distinguish a boundary or pattern
items.ex_en: Her exceptional leadership skills marked her out for early promotion.
items.ex_zh: 她出众的领导能力注定了她会早早获得晋升。

items.def_en: 1. (archaic) To engrave, inscribe, or stamp symbols or marks on something. 2. (literary) To describe or characterize.
items.ex_en: Deep scars seemed to character the aged veteran's weathered bronze countenance.
items.ex_zh: 深深的伤疤仿佛在那位老兵饱经沧桑的古铜色脸庞上铭刻下印记。

items.def_en: to decorate or mark a surface with a recurring design or sequence
items.ex_en: Skilled weavers pattern the royal silk tapestry with delicate silver floral borders.
items.ex_zh: 娴熟的织工在御用丝绸挂毯上织出精致的银色花卉边缘图案。

items.def_zh: 使呈方格花纹，用方格图案装饰；使交替变化，使多元化
items.def_en: To mark, divide, or pattern a surface with alternating squares or colors.
items.ex_en: Morning sunlight shone through the leaded panes to checker the dining hall floor.
items.ex_zh: 晨光穿透铅条窗格，在餐厅地板上投射出明暗交替的方格图案。

items.def_zh: 冲压刻出；压印出（图案或形状）
items.def_en: (+ sth) produce a shape or mark on a surface using a heavy die or stamp
items.ex_en: Heavy industrial machines stamp out precise brass seals in just seconds.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的工业机械在短短数秒内就能冲压刻出精密的黄铜印章。

items.def_en: to impress a pattern, mark, or design forcefully onto a surface
items.ex_en: The customs official proceeded to stamp the blue insignia into each passport.
items.ex_zh: 海关官员随即在每一本护照上用力盖印下蓝色的徽记图案。

items.def_en: 1. (+ on/with) To write, carve, or engrave words or designs onto a surface. 2. To write a dedication in a book or on a gift.
items.ex_en: Silversmiths prepare to inscribe memorable anniversary dates onto the polished silver locket.
items.ex_zh: 银匠准备在打磨光亮的银盒吊坠上铭刻下值得纪念的周年日期。

items.def_en: to mark permanently with a hot iron, or indelibly fix an impression on something
items.ex_en: Ranchers use glowing iron rods to brand their distinctive insignia onto cattle.
items.ex_zh: 牧场主们用烧红的铁烙条把独特的专属印记打在牛只身上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to marking, patterning, or stamping a surface with distinctive figures, checkered squares, or written symbols, often metaphorically describing how traits or experiences leave an indelible signature on character or appearance.
groups.summary_zh: 指在表面印刻图案、方格或文字记号，亦比喻性格或特质的烙印。
groups.desc_en: Denotes applying distinctive visual designs, incisions, or permanent symbols to mark or alter a surface, contrasting with plain unpatterned coating or coloring.
groups.desc_zh: 指在表面印压、雕凿或覆盖具有辨识度的纹路与特征符号，区别于均一涂覆或中性上色。
groups.nuance_en: inscribe: carve, etch, or write words or marks permanently onto a hard surface (monument / ring / tombstone) · brand: mark indelibly with hot iron to assert ownership or stigmatize (cattle / criminal / memory) · stamp: impress a design, seal, or mark onto a surface with force (passport / document / metal) · checker: mark or diversify with an alternating pattern of squares or colors (history / board / pattern) · pattern: decorate or structure in a repeated regular graphic motif (fabric / wallpaper / surface)
groups.nuance_zh: inscribe: 在石木金属等坚硬表面刻写题铭或字迹 (monument / ring / tombstone) · brand: 用烙铁打上永久印记以宣告所有权，或打上污名烙印 (cattle / criminal / memory) · stamp: 用图章或冲模在表面重重压印出印记或图案 (passport / document / metal) · checker: 使表面交织呈现黑白相间方格纹；比喻使履历斑驳多舛 (history / board / pattern) · pattern: 用规整重复的几何或花卉图案进行装饰布置 (fabric / wallpaper / surface)

groups.name: Marry & Wed · 婚恋与缔结 (Marry, Wed, Tie the Knot)
groups.tip: 结为夫妻或联姻结合

items.def_zh: 结婚；娶，嫁；为……主持婚礼；结合，使结合
items.def_en: 1. To become legally joined to someone as spouses, or take someone as a spouse. 2. To perform a marriage ceremony for two people. 3. To combine two qualities, concepts, or things.
items.ex_en: The young couple decided to marry in a quiet village church yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 这对年轻伴侣昨天决定在一座安静的乡村教堂里喜结连理。

items.def_zh: （与……）结婚，娶，嫁；结合，使紧密结合
items.def_en: 1. (formal or literary) To marry someone. 2. To combine two different ideas, qualities, or things closely.
items.ex_en: The prince was formally destined to wed a foreign princess that spring.
items.ex_zh: 按先前的正式安排，王子注定要在当年春天迎娶一位外国公主。

items.def_en: (idiomatic/informal) to get married
items.ex_en: After five years of dating, they finally decided to tie the knot.
items.ex_zh: 经过五年的恋爱长跑，他们终于决定喜结良缘，正式步入婚姻。

items.def_zh: 成双结对；结为伴侣/夫妻
items.def_en: form a romantic or marital partnership together
items.ex_en: Many childhood sweethearts eventually pair off after finishing their university degrees together.
items.ex_zh: 许多青梅竹马在共同完成大学学业之后，最终结为夫妻伴侣。

items.def_en: (+ sb) find a spouse for someone, especially a son or daughter, and arrange the marriage
items.ex_en: In historic aristocratic families, parents often sought to marry off their daughters for political alliance.
items.ex_zh: 在历史上的贵族家庭中，父母往往试图通过把女儿嫁出去来建立政治联姻。

items.def_en: (formal/literary) to marry a person; to take someone as a spouse
items.ex_en: In ancient epics, brave noble warriors sought to espouse fair royal maidens.
items.ex_zh: 在古老的史诗之中，英勇的高贵战士们往往渴望迎娶美丽的王室少女。

items.def_en: To marry again after a previous marriage has ended in divorce or death.
items.ex_en: Years after losing her husband, Clara felt finally ready to remarry happily.
items.ex_zh: 在丈夫去世多年后，克拉拉终于感到自己做好了准备重新步入婚姻。

items.def_en: (archaic or literary) To marry a woman, or take someone as a wife.
items.ex_en: The prosperous landowner decided it was high time to wive and settle.
items.ex_zh: 这位家境富裕的地主认定，如今正是自己娶妻安家的绝佳时机。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to entering into the legal, religious, or social contract of matrimony, or officiating at such a ceremony. They vary from standard neutral usage (marry) to literary/formal expressions (wed, espouse) and archaic terms (wive).
groups.summary_zh: 缔结法定或世俗婚姻契约，涵盖口语成婚与文雅联姻表达。
groups.desc_en: Denotes formalizing or executing the legal, social, or religious contract of marriage, contrasting with non-committal romantic dating.
groups.desc_zh: 指缔结法律、宗教或世俗婚姻契约，正式确立夫妻关系，区别于非婚恋爱交往。
groups.nuance_en: marry: enter into matrimony (transitive/intransitive, neutral standard) (sweetheart / partner / fortune) · wed: formal or poetic synonym for entering matrimony, often highlighting ritual (bride / partner / couple) · tie the knot: informal, idiomatic expression for getting married (church / registry / weekend) · espouse: take as a spouse (archaic/formal), or embrace a cause wholeheartedly (cause / principles / doctrine) · marry off: find a marriage partner for someone, often to dispense of responsibility (daughter / son / siblings)
groups.nuance_zh: marry: 中性通用的结婚、迎娶或出嫁 (sweetheart / partner / fortune) · wed: 庄重书面或诗意用语，侧重婚礼仪式与盟誓结发 (bride / partner / couple) · tie the knot: 口语俚语“喜结连理、结为连理” (church / registry / weekend) · espouse: 迎娶结合（古雅文书）；引申为全心支持拥护学说主张 (cause / principles / doctrine) · marry off: 替他人张罗完婚以卸下包袱（如把子女嫁出） (daughter / son / siblings)

groups.name: Mass Collapse & Downward Giving Way · 塌陷与崩落 (Slump, Avalanche, Cave in)
groups.tip: 突然下垂沉重倒下

items.def_en: (of ground or buildings) to sink down to a lower level without sudden violent disintegration
items.ex_en: Because of abandoned coal mines, the foundations began to subside quite visibly.
items.ex_zh: 受废弃煤矿的影响，房屋的地基开始出现肉眼可见的明显下陷。

items.def_en: to collapse inward or fall down toward the center because the support beneath has failed
items.ex_en: Heavy snow caused the barn's rotted wooden roof to cave in completely.
items.ex_zh: 厚重的积雪导致谷仓那已腐朽的木质屋顶彻底向内凹陷坍塌。

items.def_en: of earth, snow, or rubble, to collapse and cascade downward along an incline
items.ex_en: Torrential rain caused loose dirt and gravel to slide down steep hillsides.
items.ex_zh: 暴雨导致松散的泥土和碎石沿着陡峭的山坡不断向下滑塌。
items.ex2_en: Heavy machinery will slide down the muddy slope during extreme storms.
items.ex2_zh: 在极端风暴中，重型机械会滑下泥泞的斜坡。

items.def_zh: 沉重地倒下，猛然跌落；（身子）瘫倒，颓然坐下；（价格、经济等）猛跌，骤降
items.def_en: 1. To sit, lean, or fall heavily and suddenly because you are tired, weak, or ill. 2. To decrease suddenly and by a large amount.
items.ex_en: Exhausted after the marathon, she let herself slump onto the soft grass.
items.ex_zh: 跑完马拉松后疲惫不堪，她任由自己的身子颓然倒在柔软的草地上。

items.def_en: of a roof, ceiling, or geological mass, to collapse inward or fall down into an empty space below
items.ex_en: Without sturdy timber supports, the old mine tunnel will likely fall in.
items.ex_zh: 倘若没有坚固的木质支架支撑，旧矿井通道极有可能会向下塌陷。

items.def_en: of a physical structure or ground, to suddenly break, fracture, or collapse under excessive pressure or weight
items.ex_en: Under immense hydraulic pressure, the weakened retaining wall will eventually give way.
items.ex_zh: 在巨大的水压作用下，受损弱化的挡土墙最终必定会崩裂坍塌。

items.def_zh: 崩塌，雪崩般坍落；大量涌至
items.def_en: 1. (of snow, rock, or earth) To slide down a mountainside in a sudden mass. 2. To arrive or occur suddenly in overwhelming numbers.
items.ex_en: Tons of loose snow threatened to avalanche down onto the alpine resort.
items.ex_zh: 成吨松散的积雪随时有雪崩般向下方的高山度假村轰然坍落的危险。

items.def_en: (of an iceberg or glacier mass) to split off, collapse, and drop away violently
items.ex_en: Tourists watched in absolute awe as huge glaciers began to calve noisily.
items.ex_zh: 游客们怀着无比震撼的心情，目睹巨大的冰川开始轰然断裂崩解。

groups.summary_en: A heavy mass, structure, or geological feature suddenly loses support and cascades downward or caves inward under its own weight. The verbs specify the physical dynamics, such as crumbling inward, sliding down a slope, or tumbling en masse.
groups.summary_zh: 重物、地表或建筑结构因失去支撑而在自重下向下坍塌或倾泻。
groups.desc_en: Denotes sudden or progressive downward structural failure where a solid mass falls inward or cascades under gravity, contrasting with uniform gradual sinking.
groups.desc_zh: 指固态结构因失去支撑而在重力作用下发生局部向内塌缩、失稳崩坠，区别于均匀平缓下沉。
groups.nuance_en: cave in: collapse inward or give way completely from above (roof / mine / tunnel) · slump: collapse heavily and suddenly downward under its own weight (soil / bank / shoulders) · avalanche: cascade down precipitously in a huge, overwhelming rush (snow / debris / rocks) · calve: break off a huge mass of ice from a glacier into water (iceberg / glacier / shelf) · subside: sink gradually downward to a lower level without catastrophic shattering (ground / floodwaters / swelling)
groups.nuance_zh: cave in: 顶部受压向内破裂崩塌，出现巨大空洞 (roof / mine / tunnel) · slump: 边坡土石或躯体因重力突发性深层下滑滑塌 (soil / bank / shoulders) · avalanche: 如雪崩般汹涌倾泻坍落 (snow / debris / rocks) · calve: 冰川前端巨大冰体断裂崩解并坠入水中 (iceberg / glacier / shelf) · subside: 地基或积水缓慢地向下沉陷平复，非灾难性爆碎 (ground / floodwaters / swelling)

groups.name: Mate & Copulate by Manner · 交配与交媾 (Mate, Rut, Fuck)
groups.tip: 两性交合与生物本能

items.def_en: come together as a male and female pair for mating
items.ex_en: In springtime, migratory geese pair up along marshy riverbanks to breed.
items.ex_zh: 在春季，候鸟大雁会在沼泽密布的河岸边成对结对，以便繁育后代。
items.ex2_en: The experienced science teacher will pair up students for the lab experiment.
items.ex2_zh: 经验丰富的科学老师将把学生们两人一组配对做实验室实验。

items.def_en: (+ sb) engage in sexual intercourse with sb
items.ex_en: He lied about his relationship status just to sleep with naive women.
items.ex_zh: 他隐瞒了自己的感情状况，只是为了与天真的女性发生性关系。

items.def_en: (of a male animal) to climb onto a female animal to mate
items.ex_en: The stallion reared up and attempted to mount the mare in the corral.
items.ex_zh: 公马扬起前蹄，试图在畜栏里爬跨母马进行交配。

items.def_en: (especially of animals) To engage in sex in order to produce young; to bring together to breed.
items.ex_en: Pandas held in captivity often refuse to mate during their brief fertility window.
items.ex_zh: 圈养的大熊猫在短暂的受孕期内往往拒绝交配。
items.ex2_en: Careful zookeepers try to mate rare species during their fertile cycle.
items.ex2_zh: 细心的动物园管理员尝试在稀有物种受孕周期内让其配种交配。

items.def_zh: （鹿等雄性哺乳动物）发情，交尾
items.def_en: (of male deer or other mammals) To enter a period of sexual excitement and activity; to mate.
items.ex_en: Deep in the misty autumn forest, the red deer stags began to rut.
items.ex_zh: 在薄雾笼罩的秋日密林深处，雄性红鹿开始发情交尾。

items.def_en: (+ with) to engage in sexual intercourse, especially in a biological or formal sense
items.ex_en: Certain insect species copulate with multiple partners to maximize their reproductive genetic diversity.
items.ex_zh: 某些昆虫物种会与多个配偶交配，以最大化繁殖的遗传多样性。

items.def_en: (taboo, slang) 1. To have sexual intercourse with someone. 2. To ruin, botch, or damage something.
items.ex_en: He completely lost his temper after realizing they managed to fuck up everything.
items.ex_zh: 意识到他们把一切彻底搞砸后，他完全发火了。

items.def_en: [I/T] (British slang) to have sexual intercourse with someone
items.ex_en: He bragged down at the pub about how he had managed to shag her.
items.ex_zh: 他在酒吧里吹嘘自己是如何把她搞到手的。

groups.summary_en: Organisms engage in sexual intercourse, spanning biological animal mating, seasonal rutting, and crude or vigorous human copulation.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖动物自然交配、发情期交媾及人类粗俗直接的性交行为。
groups.desc_en: Denotes sexual copulation or mounting behavior characterized by biological reproductive instincts, animal mechanics, or vulgar colloquialism, contrasting with romantic emotional intimacy.
groups.desc_zh: 指基于生物生殖本能、动物交配机制或粗鄙语域的性交动作，区别于温存的情感交融。
groups.nuance_en: mate: pair together for animal reproduction (season / birds / animals) · rut: engage in intense periodic seasonal sexual heat and copulation (deer / stags / mammals) · mount: step onto or climb upon another animal's back to copulate (mare / female / cow) · copulate: formal biological term for the physical act of sexual intercourse (pair / male and female / species) · fuck: taboo, highly explicit and vulgar term for sexual intercourse (partner / prostitute / stranger)
groups.nuance_zh: mate: 动植物或昆虫为繁衍后代进行成对交配 (season / birds / animals) · rut: 偶蹄类哺乳动物在特定发情期狂躁冲动地追逐交尾 (deer / stags / mammals) · mount: 雄性动物爬跨至雌性背上行交配动作 (mare / female / cow) · copulate: 科学或法医语境下描述两性交媾的严谨中性词 (pair / male and female / species) · fuck: 极具禁忌色彩的粗鄙脏话，指代直接性交动作 (partner / prostitute / stranger)

groups.name: Military Armament & Disarmament · 军备配置与裁减 (Arm, Disarm, Demilitarize)
groups.tip: 国家或军队武装配备与解禁

items.def_en: to supply a person, group, or country with weapons for combat
items.ex_en: The government pledged to arm local militias defending against the invading rebel forces.
items.ex_zh: 政府承诺向抵抗叛军入侵的地方民兵提供武器。

items.def_en: equip oneself or one's group with weapons in preparation for conflict
items.ex_en: Street gangs began to tool up with automatic rifles before the anticipated turf war.
items.ex_zh: 在预期的地盘争夺战打响前，街头帮派开始配备自动步枪武装起来。

items.def_en: relax from a state of military readiness or withdraw from active deployment
items.ex_en: The CEO decided to stand down after the company's financial scandal was exposed.
items.ex_zh: 公司财务丑闻曝光后，首席执行官决定引咎辞职。

items.def_en: (+ arms/weapons) surrender one's weaponry and cease fighting
items.ex_en: The government has laid down strict safety guidelines for the industry.
items.ex_zh: 政府为该行业制定了严格的安全指南。

items.def_en: [I/T] to take weapons away from someone, or to reduce a nation's military arms
items.ex_en: International peacekeepers worked tirelessly to disarm the rebel fighters across the border territory.
items.ex_zh: 国际维和人员不知疲倦地开展工作，以解除边境地区叛军分子的武装。
items.ex2_en: Both hostile rival nations agreed to disarm under the peace treaty.
items.ex2_zh: 交战的敌对两国根据和平协议同意解除武装裁军。

items.def_en: to adapt, convert, or exploit something for use as a weapon
items.ex_en: Hostile foreign actors sought to weaponize sensitive personal data during the recent election.
items.ex_zh: 敌对外国势力试图在最近的选举中将敏感个人数据武器化。

items.raw_cluster: 解除武装与裁军 Disarm & Demilitarize
items.def_zh: 解除武装，使非军事化，废除军备
items.def_en: to remove armed forces, weapons, and military installations from an area or country
items.ex_en: Both nations agreed to demilitarize the disputed border zone under strict international supervision.
items.ex_zh: 两国同意在严格的国际监督下拆除争议边境地区的军事设施。

items.def_en: to supply an army or country with new weapons again, or equip oneself with weapons again
items.ex_en: The parliament voted overwhelmingly to rearm the nation's infantry with modern defensive hardware.
items.ex_zh: 议会以压倒性多数投票赞成用现代防御装备重新武装本国步兵。
items.ex2_en: The isolated country began to rearm rapidly after border skirmishes erupted.
items.ex2_zh: 边境冲突爆发后，这个孤立的国家开始迅速重新武装。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers state or institutional operations involving the acquisition, enhancement, reduction, or stripping of weaponry and military installations. The continuum ranges from arming/rearming troops to demilitarizing zones or disarming forces.
groups.summary_zh: 对军队、国家或特定区域进行装备配置、重整或裁撤武器。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the institutional equipping or systematic stripping of military hardware and weaponry, contrasting with personal everyday tool-usage.
groups.desc_zh: 指国家或武装力量成体系地配备致命武器装备或执行强制裁军解除战备，区别于日常工具配赋。
groups.nuance_en: arm: equip with weapons and defensive military readiness (rebels / troops / nation) · disarm: strip of weapons or neutralise an offensive threat (enemy / militia / bomb) · demilitarize: legally prohibit and remove military forces and installations from an area (zone / border / region) · weaponize: convert a pathogen, technology, or rhetoric into an instrument of war (pathogen / data / space) · rearm: build up depleted armed forces or replace weapons systems again (forces / military / state)
groups.nuance_zh: arm: 用进攻防卫性重型武器全副武装军队或组织 (rebels / troops / nation) · disarm: 强制收缴或自愿交出武器以解除战斗力；拆除爆炸物 (enemy / militia / bomb) · demilitarize: 通过条约法律在特定地带拆除军事设施并撤离驻军 (zone / border / region) · weaponize: 将民用技术、生物病原体或话语权改造为具有杀伤力的新型武器 (pathogen / data / space) · rearm: 战后或军备削减后再度重振军备 (forces / military / state)

groups.name: Mobilize & Muster Resources · 动员与召集 (Mobilize, Muster, Rally)
groups.tip: 广泛召集人员或调动战力

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ around/behind) to bring people together to support a common cause, leader, or effort
items.ex_en: Supporters began to rally around the reform candidate following her impassioned televised address.
items.ex_zh: 在改革派候选人发表慷慨激昂的电视演说后，支持者们开始团结在她周围。
items.ex2_en: The charismatic union leader managed to rally thousands of striking workers.
items.ex2_zh: 富有魅力的工会领袖成功号召并集结了数千名罢工工人。

items.def_en: (+ sb) summon someone to serve in the armed forces or muster for a duty
items.ex_en: The defense ministry decided to call up several thousand reservists for immediate active duty.
items.ex_zh: 国防部决定征召数千名预备役军人立即服现役。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) assemble or collect scattered people, animals, or resources together
items.ex_en: The police rounded up several suspects following the robbery.
items.ex_zh: 抢劫案发生后，警方搜捕了几名嫌疑人。

items.def_zh: 极力争取；召集（支持、资源）
items.def_en: (+ sth) gather or muster support, enthusiasm, or business through vigorous effort
items.ex_en: The campaign manager worked late into the night trying to drum up local support.
items.ex_zh: 竞选经理工作到深夜，极力争取当地民众的支持。

items.def_zh: 统筹调集，组织（人力/论据）
items.def_en: to systematically gather, arrange, and deploy resources, people, or evidence for action
items.ex_en: The prosecutor carefully began to marshal all available forensic evidence for the upcoming trial.
items.ex_zh: 检察官开始细致统筹调集所有可用的法医证据，以备即将到来的庭审。

items.def_en: [I/T] to formally summon people to assemble together for an official meeting or council
items.ex_en: The secretary general decided to convene an emergency meeting of the security council.
items.ex_zh: 秘书长决定召集安理会紧急会议。
items.ex2_en: The parliamentary advisory committee will convene tomorrow morning at nine o'clock.
items.ex2_zh: 议会咨询委员会将于明天上午九点正式集合开会。

items.def_zh: 召集，集合（军队等）；鼓起，振作（勇气、支持等）
items.def_en: 1. To gather together troops for inspection or battle, or summon up courage, strength, or support.
items.ex_en: She struggled to muster enough courage to confront her tyrannical boss about the issue.
items.ex_zh: 她竭力鼓起足够的勇气，就这个问题质问她专横的老板。
items.ex2_en: All naval reserve divisions must muster promptly before dawn at headquarters.
items.ex2_zh: 所有海军预备役部队必须在黎明前迅速在总部集合完毕。

items.def_zh: 动员，调动；组织（人员或资源以采取行动）
items.def_en: 1. To organize and prepare troops, citizens, or resources for urgent military or political action.
items.ex_en: The city authorities acted swiftly to mobilize emergency medical teams during the sudden blizzard.
items.ex_zh: 在突如其来的暴风雪中，市政府迅速行动，调动应急医疗队。
items.ex2_en: The reserve army infantry regiments will mobilize rapidly across the region.
items.ex2_zh: 预备役陆军步兵团将在整个地区迅速动员集结起来。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate assembling, organizing, and deploying military forces, collective populations, or personal inner resolve to confront a shared emergency or collective objective.
groups.summary_zh: 指为应对紧要关头而组织、召集并调动军队、群众资源或内在勇气。
groups.desc_en: Denotes systematically summoning, gathering, and preparing scattered forces or dormant resources into active readiness, contrasting with passive collection or hoarding.
groups.desc_zh: 指将散落的人力、资源或内在意志从休眠状态中系统性集结并调整至备战待命状态，区别于静态囤积。
groups.nuance_en: mobilize: activate and organize populations or logistics for swift, coordinated action (troops / army / resources) · muster: summon up courage or assemble personnel for inspection (courage / support / troops) · rally: reunite dispersed forces for a renewed collective effort (troops / supporters / market) · marshal: strategically arrange and organize complex resources into effective order (facts / arguments / forces) · convene: formally call people together for an official assembly (meeting / council / parliament)
groups.nuance_zh: mobilize: 临战或危机时高效动员全社会组织、军队与后勤资源 (troops / army / resources) · muster: 费力鼓起残存勇气或集结部众接受检阅点名 (courage / support / troops) · rally: 召集溃散力量重整旗鼓，或发动支持者呼应声援 (troops / supporters / market) · marshal: 运筹帷幄地将纷繁证据、论点或兵力梳理排布妥当 (facts / arguments / forces) · convene: 依据法定程序召集代表召开正式会议 (meeting / council / parliament)

groups.name: Moisten to Drench · 浸湿至湿透 (Sop, Douse, Soak, Saturate)
groups.tip: 液体浸透直至湿透

items.def_en: (+ sth) absorb liquid from a surface using an absorbent material like bread or a cloth
items.ex_en: He used a dry paper towel to sop up the coffee spilled across the table.
items.ex_zh: 他用干纸巾吸干了洒在桌上的咖啡。

items.def_en: (+ sth) moisten a surface or material thoroughly by sprinkling or spraying liquid on it
items.ex_en: Firefighters sprayed the smoking timber to wet down the area before flames reignited.
items.ex_zh: 消防员向冒烟的木材喷水进行浇灌浸润，以防死灰复燃。

items.def_zh: 浸湿，泡透；（用海绵、面包等）吸尽，蘸尽（液体）
items.def_en: 1. To dip or soak food into liquid. 2. (usually 'sop up') To absorb or soak up liquid with bread, a cloth, or a sponge.
items.ex_en: We used chunks of crusty bread to sop the flavorful sauce from our plates.
items.ex_zh: 我们用大块脆皮面包蘸尽了盘子里美味的酱汁。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make completely wet by keeping immersed or allowing liquid to penetrate thoroughly
items.ex_en: You should soak the dried beans overnight in cold water before cooking them.
items.ex_zh: 煮豆子前，你应该把干豆子浸在冷水里泡透一整夜。
items.ex2_en: Let the dry sponge soak in warm soapy water for minutes.
items.ex2_zh: 让干海绵在温肥皂水中浸泡几分钟。

items.def_en: (+ sth) wet an absorbent object or material completely through its entire thickness
items.ex_en: The freezing winter rain managed to soak through her heavy wool winter coat.
items.ex_zh: 冰冷的冬雨完全湿透了她厚重的羊毛冬大衣。

items.def_en: to wet thoroughly, especially by pouring liquid copiously over the exterior
items.ex_en: A passing truck drove through a puddle and managed to drench my clothes entirely.
items.ex_zh: 一辆驶过的卡车碾过水坑，彻底浇透了我的衣服。

items.def_zh: 泼水于，浇透，浸透；熄灭（火、灯）
items.def_en: 1. To pour a large amount of liquid over someone or something; drench. 2. To extinguish a fire or turn off a light.
items.ex_en: Campers used buckets of lake water to douse the roaring campfire before sleeping.
items.ex_zh: 露营者睡前用几桶湖水浇灭了熊熊燃烧的营火。

items.def_en: to fill or soak an item with liquid until no more can possibly be absorbed
items.ex_en: Relentless torrential rainfall continued to saturate the soil until severe flash floods occurred.
items.ex_zh: 持续的暴雨不断浸透土壤，直至引发了严重的山洪。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote saturating an absorbent object with liquid, arranged by the degree of wetness imparted—from absorbing liquid locally (sopping) to total, heavy saturation or thorough soaking.
groups.summary_zh: 表达吸附水分或倾注液体的湿润程度，从局部吸湿到全面彻底湿透。
groups.desc_en: Denotes introducing liquid onto or into a porous medium across a continuum from mere wetting to ultimate molecular saturation, contrasting with dry surface coating.
groups.desc_zh: 指液体逐渐渗入多孔介质，从初级沾湿递进至分子级终极饱和状态的连续浸透过程，区别于表面干燥涂覆。
groups.nuance_en: soak: immerse or leave in liquid until liquid penetrates completely (beans / clothes / rainwater) · drench: wet thoroughly and copiously from above by pouring liquid (rain / sweat / storm) · saturate: fill a substance with liquid to the point where no more can be absorbed (sponge / market / soil) · douse: suddenly plunge into liquid or drench by throwing a heavy volume of water over (fire / flames / lights) · sop: absorb liquid via capillary action using a porous substance, or remain dripping wet (bread / gravy / sweat)
groups.nuance_zh: soak: 将物体长时间浸泡于液体中使之通体吸饱透湿 (beans / clothes / rainwater) · drench: 遭遇暴雨倾盆或水流劈头浇泼而从头到脚湿透 (rain / sweat / storm) · saturate: 介质吸纳液体达到物理极限，彻底饱和无法再吸 (sponge / market / soil) · douse: 将大量水突然泼向火源以熄灭，或猛烈泼湿 (fire / flames / lights) · sop: 利用面包、棉布等疏松多孔物吸附饱蘸汤汁液体 (bread / gravy / sweat)

groups.name: Move & Relocate · 迁移与搬迁 (Relocate, Migrate, Resettle)
groups.tip: 变更常驻地点位置

items.def_en: [I/T] to change one's home or place of work from one location to another
items.ex_en: The young family finally decided to move from their cramped apartment into a suburb.
items.ex_zh: 这个年轻的家庭最终决定从狭窄的公寓搬迁到郊区居住。
items.ex2_en: The moving company will move all their fragile furniture next Monday.
items.ex2_zh: 搬家公司将在下周一搬运他们所有的易碎家具。

items.def_en: permanently leave one's home or current place of residence
items.ex_en: His landlord gave him thirty days to move out.
items.ex_zh: 房东限他三十天之内搬走。

items.def_en: start living in a new home or place of residence
items.ex_en: The excited tenants were scheduled to move in early next Saturday morning.
items.ex_zh: 兴奋的新租客定于下周六一早搬入新居。

items.def_zh: 收拾家当迁居；移居他处
items.def_en: leave the place where one has settled and relocate to a new home or area
items.ex_en: After years in the dreary city, they decided to pull up stakes and farm.
items.ex_zh: 在这个沉闷的城市生活多年后，他们决定收拾家当迁居去务农。

items.def_en: to move a person, family, or community permanently to an entirely new environment
items.ex_en: The civil war forced authorities to transplant thousands of displaced villagers to safer regions.
items.ex_zh: 内战迫使当局将数千名流离失所的村民迁移安置到更安全的地区。

items.def_en: To move to a new place to live or operate, or to move someone or something to a new place.
items.ex_en: The international corporation decided to relocate its regional headquarters to Singapore next quarter.
items.ex_zh: 这家跨国公司决定下季度将其区域总部迁往新加坡。
items.ex2_en: Many rural residents decided to relocate when the factory closed permanently.
items.ex2_zh: 当工厂永久关闭时，许多农村居民决定搬迁离开。

items.def_en: 1. (of animals or birds) To travel to a different region according to the seasons. 2. To move from one country or region to another to live or work.
items.ex_en: Each autumn, millions of monarch butterflies migrate south across thousands of miles to Mexico.
items.ex_zh: 每年秋天，数以百万计的帝王蝶向南迁徙数千英里前往墨西哥。

items.def_en: [I/T] to establish, or assist people in establishing, a new permanent home in a different region or country
items.ex_en: The international charity helped resettle thousands of political refugees in safe democratic countries.
items.ex_zh: 这家国际慈善机构帮助在安全的民主国家重新安置了数千名政治难民。
items.ex2_en: Displaced refugee families will resettle peacefully in the peaceful northern territory.
items.ex2_zh: 流离失所的难民家庭将在和平的北部领地安顿定居下来。

groups.summary_en: Agents change their permanent or habitual place of residence or base of operations, ranging from personal moving to large-scale ecological or demographic shifts.
groups.summary_zh: 主体从一地变更为另一地居住或运营，涉及个人搬迁与群体迁徙。
groups.desc_en: Denotes terminating residence in one location and establishing domestic or community roots in another, contrasting with transient temporary travel.
groups.desc_zh: 指终止在原籍或旧址的居留，迁徙并重新扎根于新居住地，区别于短期过客式旅行。
groups.nuance_en: relocate: move one's permanent residence or corporate operational base to a new site (headquarters / family / factory) · migrate: move seasonally or systematically from one habitat/country to another en masse (birds / workers / population) · resettle: settle in a new area after displacement, especially under institutional sponsorship (refugees / immigrants / community) · pull up stakes: abruptly or decisively uproot oneself from an established home (family / home / business) · transplant: remove a person, population, or organ and establish them in alien soil (population / culture / community)
groups.nuance_zh: relocate: 个人安家或企业机构将总部迁至新址长期运作 (headquarters / family / factory) · migrate: 鸟类依季节迁徙，或人口成规模向异国他乡移居劳作 (birds / workers / population) · resettle: 难民或动迁居民在政府资助安置下于新居地重建家园 (refugees / immigrants / community) · pull up stakes: 断然拔除旧有根基，彻底搬家远走他乡 (family / home / business) · transplant: 将人群或文化像移栽树木般植入完全陌生的土壤 (population / culture / community)

groups.name: Nag, Harass & Dun · 纠缠索要与苦苦逼逼 (Badger, Dun, Harangue)
groups.tip: 像獾般死缠烂打、反复纠缠骚扰

items.def_en: to annoy someone with frequent, trivial, or persistent requests
items.ex_en: Street vendors continued to pester tourists with cheap trinkets outside the museum entrance.
items.ex_zh: 小贩们在博物馆入口外不断用廉价小饰品烦扰游客。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) contact someone repeatedly to demand payment, an answer, or pending work
items.ex_en: I need to chase up the finance team regarding the overdue invoice.
items.ex_zh: 我得催一下财务团队处理那笔逾期未付的发票。

items.def_en: (+ sb) constantly criticize, harass, or nag someone about their obligations
items.ex_en: His mother would constantly get on at him about finishing his tedious homework.
items.ex_zh: 他的母亲总是为了让他做完枯燥的家庭作业而唠叨责备他。

items.def_en: (+ sb) repeatedly pester, nag, or remind someone to do something
items.ex_en: She had to keep on at her landlord to fix the leaking ceiling.
items.ex_zh: 她不得不反复催逼房东去修补漏水的房顶。

items.def_en: to trouble, torment, or exert persistent pressure on someone with unwanted demands
items.ex_en: Corrupt debt collectors hired thugs to harass vulnerable citizens outside their family homes.
items.ex_zh: 不良讨债人雇佣暴徒在弱势公民的家门外对其进行骚扰。

items.def_zh: 纠缠，死缠烂打；反复追问，逼迫
items.def_en: (+ into/about) To repeatedly harass, urge, or pester someone into doing or telling something.
items.ex_en: Persistent reporters continued to badger the foreign minister about the controversial trade agreement.
items.ex_zh: 执着的记者们就那份备受争议的贸易协定反复逼问外交部长。

items.def_en: to pursue, harass, or urge someone relentlessly for demands or information
items.ex_en: Ruthless paparazzi continued to hound the grieving royal family for private sensational photographs.
items.ex_zh: 无良狗仔队为了博人眼球的私密照片，不断追逼悲痛中的王室成员。

items.def_zh: 催讨（债款），逼索；反复索求
items.def_en: 1. To persistently demand payment of a debt from someone.
items.ex_en: Grisly moneylenders arrived at dawn to dun the impoverished tailor for his arrears.
items.ex_zh: 冷酷的放贷人拂晓而至，向贫困的裁缝逼索欠款。

groups.summary_en: A creditor, claimant, or irritated party relentlessly presses someone with repeated demands, questions, or payment reminders. Verbs advance in emotional friction and coercive pressure from annoying badgering to aggressive, persistent debt collection.
groups.summary_zh: 因要钱、要答案或施压而反复催逼、纠缠不休，直至逼索债务。
groups.desc_en: Denotes persistently hounding or bothering someone with repeated, unyielding demands or complaints, contrasting with polite single-instance asking.
groups.desc_zh: 指以连续不断、令人窒息的催逼或抱怨反复纠缠施压，区别于单次礼貌探询。
groups.nuance_en: dun: make persistent, coercive demands upon someone for the repayment of a debt (debtor / customer / payment) · badger: harass persistently with questions, pestering requests, or nagging (witness / government / official) · hound: relentlessly pursue or harass someone like a hunting dog (press / paparazzi / suspects) · pester: annoy continuously with petty, irritating, or unwanted interruptions (parents / sister / colleagues) · harass: subject someone to systematic, hostile, and intimidating persecution (workers / victim / employees)
groups.nuance_zh: dun: 针对应收欠款展开紧咬不放的连环催讨逼债 (debtor / customer / payment) · badger: 像獾般缠斗，以连珠炮般的提问或软磨硬泡让人抓狂 (witness / government / official) · hound: 如猎犬嗅迹般穷追不舍、寸步不离地尾随骚扰 (press / paparazzi / suspects) · pester: 因鸡毛蒜皮琐事反复惹人厌烦、死缠烂打 (parents / sister / colleagues) · harass: 具有敌意、系统性且往往带有恐吓性质地持续骚扰侵害 (workers / victim / employees)

groups.name: Narrate with Nuance · 详述与克制表述 (Recount, Understate, Detail)
groups.tip: 一五一十详尽叙述事情经过

items.def_en: (+ sth) avoid discussing an unpleasant detail by mentioning it very briefly or superficially
items.ex_en: The spokesperson attempted to gloss over their massive financial deficit during the briefing.
items.ex_zh: 发言人在通报会上试图轻描淡写地掩饰他们巨额的财政赤字。

items.def_en: (+ sth) minimize the significance, severity, or importance of something rhetorically
items.ex_en: The government tried to play down the seriousness of the economic crisis.
items.ex_zh: 政府试图淡化这场经济危机的严重性。

items.def_zh: 轻描淡写地叙述；低调陈述，保守陈述
items.def_en: To state or describe something in a restrained way, making it seem less important, serious, or large than it actually is.
items.ex_en: The medical report seemed to understate the grave severity of his infectious condition.
items.ex_zh: 该医疗报告似乎保守陈述了他感染病情的严重程度。

items.def_zh: 详细阐述；条理清晰地说明
items.def_en: (+ sth) explain, narrate, or describe facts or details clearly and sequentially
items.ex_en: The CEO laid out an ambitious five-year growth strategy.
items.ex_zh: 首席执行官详细阐述了一项雄心勃勃的五年增长战略。

items.def_en: to give a full, precise, and itemized account of facts or events
items.ex_en: The lead detective meticulously began to detail each piece of incriminating physical evidence.
items.ex_zh: 首席刑警开始细致列举每一件确凿的物证。

items.def_zh: 详述，叙述；重新清点，重计（选票等）
items.def_en: 1. To tell someone a detailed story or account of what happened. 2. To count something again, especially votes.
items.ex_en: The elderly veteran paused solemnly before beginning to recount his harrowing wartime experiences.
items.ex_zh: 那位老兵庄重地停顿了一下，随后开始详述他那段痛苦惨烈的战时经历。

items.def_en: to make sth appear less important, severe, or significant than it really is
items.ex_en: Senior company executives desperately tried to downplay the environmental damage caused by the spill.
items.ex_zh: 公司高管极力试图淡化泄漏事故所造成的环境破坏。

items.def_en: to state sth too strongly, exaggerating its importance, severity, or degree
items.ex_en: Alarmist journalists tend to overstate the actual risks associated with novel artificial intelligence.
items.ex_zh: 耸人听闻的记者往往会夸大与新型人工智能相关的实际风险。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this communicative manner frame involve conveying a sequence of facts, incidents, or claims with a deliberate rhetorical posture. 'Recount' gives a faithful, ordered narrative of past events, whereas 'understate' rhetorically downplays importance, severity, or emotional scale.
groups.summary_zh: 以特定的叙事口吻或修辞倾向，对既往事件或数据进行详述或克制表述。
groups.desc_en: Involves calibrating the framing, prominence, or granularity of information when reporting facts, unlike simple 'stating' or 'telling' which neutrally conveys propositional content.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及在陈述或报道事实时刻意调节信息的详略度、比重或修辞分寸，而非中性地交代内容的简单“陈述/告知”。
groups.nuance_en: detail: systematically elaborate every component (plan / allegations / requirements) · recount: narrate a sequence of past experiences chronologically (events / story / ordeal) · downplay: deliberately minimize the importance or severity of something (concerns / risks / significance) · understate: represent something with calculated restraint or modesty (figures / importance / impact) · gloss over: treat an awkward or damaging detail superficially to conceal it (flaws / differences / mistakes)
groups.nuance_zh: detail: 系统详尽地逐项列举阐明 (plan / allegations / requirements) · recount: 依时序生动叙述亲历往事 (events / story / ordeal) · downplay: 刻意淡化或贬低重要性与严重度 (concerns / risks / significance) · understate: 用克制、低调的手法保留陈述 (figures / importance / impact) · gloss over: 轻描淡写以掩盖瑕疵或难堪处 (flaws / differences / mistakes)

groups.name: Nerve Strain & Total Depletion · 耗竭与萎靡 (Frazzle, Enervate, Exhaust)
groups.tip: 身心精疲力竭磨损神经

items.def_en: (+ sb) gradually drain someone's energy, strength, or psychological resistance
items.ex_en: Persistent negotiations finally wore down the opposition's resistance.
items.ex_zh: 旷日持久的谈判最终瓦解了反对派的抵抗意志。
items.ex2_en: The rubber soles will wear down quickly from running on rough asphalt.
items.ex2_zh: 在粗糙的沥青路面上跑步会导致橡胶鞋底迅速磨损变薄。

items.def_en: to deplete someone entirely of vitality, strength, or emotional capacity
items.ex_en: Caring for her terminally ill relative began to drain all her remaining energy.
items.ex_zh: 照顾身患绝症的亲戚开始耗尽她仅存的所有精力。
items.ex2_en: His deep inner emotional reserves began to drain after endless arguments.
items.ex2_zh: 经过无休止的争吵后，他内心深处的情感储备开始耗尽。

items.def_en: become completely exhausted and unable to function due to prolonged stress or overwork
items.ex_en: Young corporate lawyers often burn out after working eighty exhausting hours every week.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的企业律师在每周经历八十小时的繁重工作后常常身心耗垮。

items.def_en: collapse into sleep or lose consciousness due to overwhelming physical exhaustion
items.ex_en: He worked for thirty straight hours before he finally conked out on sofa.
items.ex_zh: 他连续工作了三十个小时，最后终于在沙发上倒头昏睡过去。

items.def_en: to use up all the mental or physical resources of someone completely
items.ex_en: Running an ultramarathon through rugged mountain paths will quickly exhaust your physical stamina.
items.ex_zh: 在崎岖的山路上跑超级马拉松会迅速耗尽你的体力。

items.def_zh: 使精疲力竭，使焦躁不安；（使）磨损，（使）破烂
items.def_en: 1. (informal, often passive) To make someone completely exhausted or stressed, or to become exhausted. 2. To wear away or fray into shreds.
items.ex_en: Juggling three demanding part-time jobs simultaneously began to frazzle the young single mother.
items.ex_zh: 同时兼顾三份要求极高的兼职工作让这位年轻的单身母亲精疲力竭。
items.ex2_en: Her delicate nerves will frazzle quickly under such unrelenting deadline pressure.
items.ex2_zh: 在如此无情的截稿压力下，她脆弱的神经很快就会疲惫崩溃。

items.raw_cluster: 使虚弱与疲惫 Weaken & Exhaust
items.def_zh: 使衰弱，使无力，使精疲力竭
items.def_en: (formal) To make someone feel physically, mentally, or morally weak and drained of energy.
items.ex_en: The sweltering midsummer humidity seemed to enervate the laborers working in the field.
items.ex_zh: 仲夏闷热潮湿的天气似乎让田间劳作的工人们浑身乏力、疲惫不堪。

items.def_zh: 使极度虚弱；使无力倒地
items.def_en: to reduce someone to extreme physical weakness or incapacitation
items.ex_en: A lethal virulent fever threatened to prostrate the entire village within several days.
items.ex_zh: 一场致命的恶性高烧在短短几天内就让全村人极度虚弱、卧床不起。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scale specify severe physical and nervous draining where an entity's energy reserves are completely wiped out, leading to collapse, fraying nerves, or prostration.
groups.summary_zh: 描述精神紧绷、气力被掏空至崩溃瓦解的重度耗竭梯度。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the progressive or catastrophic drain of physical, mental, or nervous reserves to the point of collapse, differing from generic 'tiring' through its irreversible sense of system failure.
groups.desc_zh: 指身心或神经储备被渐进消耗或骤然抽空直至系统性崩溃，与普通“疲劳”的区别在于其不可逆的耗竭感与瘫痪状态。
groups.nuance_en: exhaust: completely deplete finite physical energy or resources (supplies / patience / energy) · frazzle: wear nerves to a ragged, irritable state (nerves / staff / mind) · enervate: insidiously sap vitality, moral courage, or stamina (climate / spirit / strength) · burn out: collapse due to prolonged chronic occupational or emotional stress (employees / doctors / oneself) · prostrate: reduce to total helpless physical or emotional collapse (illness / grief / exhaustion)
groups.nuance_zh: exhaust: 彻底耗尽有限的体能或储备 (supplies / patience / energy) · frazzle: 使神经极度紧绷、焦躁疲惫 (nerves / staff / mind) · enervate: 暗中削弱生机、斗志或耐力 (climate / spirit / strength) · burn out: 因长期职业或心理压力过度而彻底崩解 (employees / doctors / oneself) · prostrate: 使身体或精神极度虚弱而完全瘫倒 (illness / grief / exhaustion)

groups.name: Objectify & Depersonalize · 物化与客体化 (Objectify, Sexualize, Instrumentalize)
groups.tip: 剥夺主体性降格相待

items.def_en: (+ sb) to view someone as inferior, unworthy of respect, or lacking human worth
items.ex_en: She never looks down on anyone just because they come from a humble background.
items.ex_zh: 她绝不会仅仅因为别人出身平凡而看不起对方。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to dismiss someone entirely as insignificant, useless, or merely a disposable liability
items.ex_en: Cruel managers quickly chose to write off the injured factory worker as useless.
