items.ex_zh: 冷酷的管理人员很快决定将受伤的工厂工人当作无用之人一笔勾销。

items.def_zh: 迷恋化，盲目迷信化（把人物化为执念象征）
items.def_en: To regard with excessive, irrational, or purely sexualizing obsession
items.ex_en: The advertising campaign tended to fetishize traditional working-class culture for commercial vanity.
items.ex_zh: 该广告策划倾向于将传统的工人阶级文化盲目迷信化，以满足商业虚荣。

items.def_zh: 使性化，将……视为性对象；使具有性特征
items.def_en: To make someone or something sexual in character, quality, or appearance, or to view or treat someone purely in sexual terms.
items.ex_en: Critics argued the video game served primarily to sexualize female heroines inappropriately.
items.ex_zh: 批评人士认为，这款电子游戏的主要目的在于不当地将女性英雄角色性化。

items.def_zh: 商品化（使人沦为可买卖的货物）
items.def_en: To treat a human being, service, or concept as a raw tradeable commodity
items.ex_en: Dating applications increasingly threaten to commoditize genuine human romance into superficial transactions.
items.ex_zh: 约会应用程序日益威胁着将人类真挚的浪漫情感商品化为肤浅的交易。

items.def_zh: 工具化（将人视作达成目的之手段）
items.def_en: To treat a person or relationship merely as a useful means to an end
items.ex_en: Ruthless politicians often instrumentalize personal friendships merely to advance their ambitious agendas.
items.ex_zh: 冷酷的政客常常将个人友谊工具化，仅仅用作推进其野心议程的手段。

items.def_zh: 将……物化（降格相待）；使客观化，使具体化
items.def_en: 1. To treat a person as a mere object or sexual commodity without regard to their dignity or feelings. 2. To express something abstract in a concrete, objective form.
items.ex_en: Modern fashion advertisements often blatantly objectify young women to boost luxury sales.
items.ex_zh: 现代时尚广告往往公然物化年轻女性，以此来提升奢侈品的销量。

items.def_en: To deprive someone of human qualities, individuality, or basic dignity
items.ex_en: Brutal prison conditions systematically dehumanize inmates by stripping away their individual dignity.
items.ex_zh: 残暴的监狱环境剥夺了犯人的个人尊严，在体制上将他们彻底非人化。

groups.summary_en: This cognitive/manner frame captures treating human beings not as autonomous agents with feelings and dignity, but as inert commodities, tools, or physical instruments. Verbs progress in severity from viewing someone through a reductive physical lens to totally dehumanizing them as disposable items.
groups.summary_zh: 指在认知或态度上剥夺人的主体性与尊严，降格为工具、商品或客体。
groups.desc_en: Entails stripping a human being of interiority, agency, or personhood to treat them purely as an instrument, commodity, or sensory commodity, contrasting with simple 'disrespecting'.
groups.desc_zh: 指剥夺人的主体性、内在灵魂与尊严，将其单纯视为工具、商品或感官消费客体，与一般的“不尊重”有本质的降格差异。
groups.nuance_en: objectify: reduce an autonomous person to a mere passive thing (women / bodies / individuals) · dehumanize: strip human qualities and dignity, treating someone as subhuman or animal (prisoners / minority / population) · commoditize: transform human traits or relations into marketable economic units (culture / labor / relationships) · instrumentalize: exploit someone cynically as a functional tool for an external end (students / victims / allies) · sexualize: view or portray purely through a sexual lens regardless of appropriateness (children / images / professions)
groups.nuance_zh: objectify: 将有主体性的人降格为纯粹客体或玩物 (women / bodies / individuals) · dehumanize: 剥夺人的尊严与人性特征，视同禽兽或非人 (prisoners / minority / population) · commoditize: 将人的特质或关系异化为可买卖的商品 (culture / labor / relationships) · instrumentalize: 将他人功利性地作为达成目的的手段 (students / victims / allies) · sexualize: 不合时宜地将对象强行性化或视作性符号 (children / images / professions)

groups.name: Obliterate & Eradicate · 彻底抹去与完全消灭 (Decimate, Annihilate, Obliterate)
groups.tip: 由表及里，彻底消灭不留痕迹

items.def_en: (+ sth) destroy, obscure, or remove something completely so that no sign of it remains
items.ex_en: Massive black clouds drifted across the horizon to blot out the setting sun.
items.ex_zh: 大片乌云飘过地平线，彻底遮没了落日的余晖。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) find and eradicate someone or something destructive completely
items.ex_en: The internal affairs bureau launched an investigation to root out corruption among officers.
items.ex_zh: 内政部门展开调查，以彻底清除警官内部的腐败现象。

items.def_en: (+ sth) eradicate or extinguish something unwanted or dangerous entirely
items.ex_en: Health officials launched an aggressive vaccination campaign to stamp out the infectious outbreak.
items.ex_zh: 卫生官员发起了一场强有力的疫苗接种运动，以彻底扑灭传染病的爆发。

items.def_en: destroy or get rid of something completely, especially something bad or harmful
items.ex_en: Global health initiatives collaborated effectively to eradicate the deadly smallpox virus entirely.
items.ex_zh: 全球卫生倡议组织有效合作，彻底根除了致命的天花病毒。

items.def_zh: 大批杀害，大量消灭；严重破坏；（历史）每十人杀一人
items.def_en: 1. To destroy or kill a large proportion of a population, army, or system. 2. (historical) To kill one in every ten of a group of soldiers as a punishment.
items.ex_en: The viral epidemic threatens to decimate the region's already vulnerable livestock population this winter.
items.ex_zh: 这场病毒性流行病恐将在今年冬天摧毁该地区本就脆弱的牲畜种群。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) destroy completely, leaving no survivors or traces
items.ex_en: That sudden flash flood managed to wipe out our entire camp in minutes.
items.ex_zh: 那场突如其来的山洪在几分钟内就彻底冲毁了我们的整个营地。

items.def_en: destroy something completely so that nothing remains or can be recognized
items.ex_en: The heavy artillery bombardment threatened to obliterate the ancient fortress from the map.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的炮火轰击几乎要把这座古老要塞从地图上彻底抹去。

items.def_zh: 彻底消灭，毁灭；彻底击溃
items.def_en: 1. To destroy someone or something completely so that nothing remains. 2. To defeat an opponent or enemy decisively and completely.
items.ex_en: The coalition launched a massive counteroffensive to annihilate the entrenched enemy forces.
items.ex_zh: 联军发起大规模反攻，以彻底消灭固守阵地的敌军部队。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote extreme degrees of destruction that wipe out entities, populations, or objects, ranging from heavy destruction (decimate) to total obliteration where literally no trace or living remnant remains.
groups.summary_zh: 按破坏程度由重创大部分递进至全歼、彻底抹杀、不留一丝痕迹。
groups.desc_en: Refers to the total, ruthless extirpation of entities leaving no trace or viability behind, contrasting with basic 'damaging' or 'defeating' by its absolute, permanent finality.
groups.desc_zh: 指彻底、决绝地根除或湮灭某物使其不留丝毫痕迹或生机，与一般的“破坏”或“战胜”相比具有绝对的终结性。
groups.nuance_en: obliterate: completely erase all visible traces or structural existence (memory / town / evidence) · annihilate: reduce completely to nonexistence or inflict absolute destruction (army / enemy / chances) · eradicate: pull up by the roots to permanently end a widespread problem (disease / poverty / corruption) · decimate: destroy a large, catastrophic proportion of a group (population / troops / industry) · stamp out: forcibly and swiftly suppress an emerging threat (rebellion / fire / dissent)
groups.nuance_zh: obliterate: 彻底抹去一切可见痕迹或物质结构 (memory / town / evidence) · annihilate: 将某物化为乌有或对敌军实施全歼 (army / enemy / chances) · eradicate: 连根拔起以彻底杜绝顽疾或祸害 (disease / poverty / corruption) · decimate: 大规模杀伤或重创群体中的极大比例 (population / troops / industry) · stamp out: 以铁腕手段迅速扑灭扑击萌芽威胁 (rebellion / fire / dissent)

groups.name: Omit & Neglect Duties · 疏忽与缺损不顾 (Neglect, Ignore, Shirk)
groups.tip: 从视而不见到疏于照管

items.def_en: to reject, dismiss, or ignore someone's advice, complaint, or approach casually
items.ex_en: He tried to brush off the criticism as petty jealousy.
items.ex_zh: 他试图对这些批评不予理会，将其归咎于小人的嫉妒。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) ignore or disregard someone or something when attention or action is due
items.ex_en: The committee chose to pass over her application despite her impressive professional credentials.
items.ex_zh: 尽管她拥有亮眼的专业资历，委员会还是决定对她的申请不予考虑。

items.def_en: (+ sth) avoid fulfilling a duty, obligation, or piece of work through evasion
items.ex_en: He always invents ridiculous excuses to shirk out of his weekend cleaning duties.
items.ex_zh: 他总是编造荒唐的借口来逃避周末的值日打扫工作。

items.def_en: decrease one's effort or neglect one's required duties through laziness
items.ex_en: The manager warned him that continuing to slack off would cost him his job.
items.ex_zh: 经理警告他，如果继续这般消极怠工，他就会丢掉饭碗。

items.def_en: to intentionally pay no attention to someone or something
items.ex_en: Drivers who deliberately ignore traffic signals will face severe penalties and license suspension.
items.ex_zh: 故意无视交通信号灯的司机将面临严厉处罚和吊销驾照。

items.def_zh: 不理会，低估，不全信；打折，减价
items.def_en: 1. to decide that something is not important or not likely to be true. 2. to reduce the price of something
items.ex_en: We should not entirely discount his assessment despite his lack of formal training.
items.ex_zh: 尽管他缺乏正规训练，我们也不应完全忽视他的评估意见。

items.def_zh: 疏忽，忽视，不顾；疏于照管；未能（做某事）
items.def_en: 1. To fail to give proper care, attention, or maintenance to someone or something. 2. (+ to do) To fail to do something because of carelessness or forgetfulness.
items.ex_en: The landlord was penalized for having neglected essential repairs throughout the winter months.
items.ex_zh: 房东因在整个冬季疏于进行必要的修缮而受到了处罚。

items.def_en: to avoid or evade dealing with a duty, responsibility, or work through laziness or evasion
items.ex_en: A dependable employee does not shirk responsibilities when difficult challenges suddenly emerge.
items.ex_zh: 一名可靠的员工在突遭严峻挑战时绝不会推卸责任。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame mark an escalating intensity of cognitive omission, progressing from passive disattention or deliberate refusal to attend, to culpable failure to care for or fulfill responsibilities.
groups.summary_zh: 体现从主观不予理会、价值折损到严重失职失于照管的递进。
groups.desc_en: Involves the culpable failure to attend to or fulfill an explicit obligation or standard of care, contrasting with neutral 'omitting' by its breach of duty or ethics.
groups.desc_zh: 指对明确的职责、照看标准或既定义务进行应受谴责的怠慢或回避，与中性的“忽略/遗漏”相比带有失职或渎职色彩。
groups.nuance_en: neglect: persistently fail to give proper care, attention, or maintenance (duties / children / health) · shirk: deliberately evade a burdensome duty or hard labor through evasion (responsibilities / duties / work) · pass over: intentionally or inadvertently skip eligible candidates or items in order (promotion / details / candidate) · brush off: dismiss a person or obligation curtly with minimal concern (concerns / advice / complaint) · slack off: reduce effort and diligence out of laziness or fatigue (work / studies / effort)
groups.nuance_zh: neglect: 长期怠慢、疏于照管法定职责或应尽照料 (duties / children / health) · shirk: 故意逃避沉重的责任、苦差或义务 (responsibilities / duties / work) · pass over: 忽略、越过或未予考虑应得之人或细节 (promotion / details / candidate) · brush off: 轻率不理或傲慢打发诉求与责任 (concerns / advice / complaint) · slack off: 偷懒懈怠，主动降低工作或学习投入 (work / studies / effort)

groups.name: Orchestrate & Engineer · 精心策划与全盘部署 (Orchestrate, Engineer, Mastermind)
groups.tip: 统筹全局运筹帷幄规划

items.def_zh: 谋划；精心编造（计划或借口）
items.def_en: (+ sth) devise or orchestrate a complex plan, excuse, or plot, especially deceitfully
items.ex_en: He had to cook up an excuse for being late to the morning briefing.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不编造一个早会迟到的借口。

items.def_en: (+ sth) plan or coordinate the precise details of a project or scheme systematically
items.ex_en: The committee met to map out a clear strategy for the next five years.
items.ex_zh: 委员会开会为接下来的五年详细制定了清晰的战略规划。

items.def_en: (+ sth) organize and engineer the logistical details or conditions for an operation
items.ex_en: The logistics team worked late to set up supply routes for the relief mission.
items.ex_zh: 后勤团队工作到深夜，为救援任务筹划并打通了补给路线。
items.ex2_en: The stage crew will set up early tomorrow before the concert.
items.ex2_zh: 舞台工作人员将在明早音乐会开始前早早集合安排就绪。

items.def_en: to arrange or bring about a complex situation through clever and calculated manipulation
items.ex_en: The veteran diplomat managed to engineer a peaceful resolution between the warring factions.
items.ex_zh: 这位资深外交官巧妙周旋，促成了交战各方达成和平协议。

items.def_zh: 使作好准备（以面对困难或冲击）；支撑，加固；使振作
items.def_en: 1. (brace oneself) To prepare mentally or physically for an impending shock, impact, or difficulty. 2. To support, steady, or reinforce a structure with a brace.
items.ex_en: Residents along the coast must brace themselves for the catastrophic hurricane approaching landfall.
items.ex_zh: 沿海居民必须做好心理准备，以迎接即将在陆地登陆的灾难性飓风。

items.def_en: to plan and direct an elaborate or difficult operation from behind the scenes
items.ex_en: Federal prosecutors identified the senior executive who helped mastermind the intricate corporate fraud.
items.ex_zh: 联邦检察官指认了在幕后策划这起复杂企业欺诈案的高管。

items.def_zh: 精心策划，统筹安排；把……编成管弦乐曲
items.def_en: 1. To organize or coordinate a complex situation, plan, or campaign carefully to achieve a desired effect. 2. To arrange or score a piece of music for an orchestra.
items.ex_en: The campaign strategist worked tirelessly to orchestrate a seamless nationwide media blitz.
items.ex_zh: 竞选策略师不知疲倦地工作，以统筹安排一场天衣无缝的全国媒体攻势。

items.def_en: to plan and coordinate the precise sequence of steps or events in an operation
items.ex_en: The operations team had to choreograph every stage of the royal delegation's visit.
items.ex_zh: 运营团队必须严密调度王室代表团访问行程的每一个环节。

groups.summary_en: A strategist or conspirator coordinates disparate elements, logistical assets, or people into a cohesive, calculated plan or prepares defenses against an expected challenge. Verbs range from coordinating complex maneuvers smoothly to tightly engineering covert schemes.
groups.summary_zh: 精心排布、统揽全局以策划实施复杂行动，或周密准备应对挑战。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the complex, covert, or highly structured arrangement of disparate elements to bring about a desired outcome, differing from general 'planning' in its manipulative or dramaturgical sophistication.
groups.desc_zh: 指为了达成特定图谋，像导演或总装师一样精密、隐蔽或全局性地调度各方元素，不同于普通的简单“计划”。
groups.nuance_en: orchestrate: coordinate diverse agents and timing to produce a synchronized effect (campaign / coup / comeback) · mastermind: act as the intellectual architect behind a complex plot or enterprise (robbery / plot / scheme) · engineer: cleverly contrive conditions, often behind the scenes, to achieve a result (crisis / victory / downfall) · choreograph: stage-manage actions or public spectacles down to the finest detail (protest / debate / ceremony) · cook up: concoct a deceitful story, excuse, or hasty scheme (excuse / story / plan)
groups.nuance_zh: orchestrate: 幕后统筹各方力量以实现高度同步的图谋 (campaign / coup / comeback) · mastermind: 作为主谋或首席大脑策划复杂的行动 (robbery / plot / scheme) · engineer: 巧妙甚至暗中做局以操纵局势演变 (crisis / victory / downfall) · choreograph: 精确编排公开展示或事件的每一个细微环节 (protest / debate / ceremony) · cook up: 凭空捏造、编造谎言、借口或草率计谋 (excuse / story / plan)

groups.name: Peel & Shell Produce · 剥皮与去荚 (Peel, Hull, Pod)
groups.tip: 剥除外皮或去除外壳

items.def_en: (+ sth) to pull or remove a skin, rind, or outer layer away from produce
items.ex_en: He began to peel off the thick orange rind before eating the fruit.
items.ex_zh: 在吃水果前，他开始剥下那层厚厚的橙子皮。
items.ex2_en: The brittle outer bark began to peel off in large strips.
items.ex2_zh: 脆弱的外层树皮开始大片大片地剥落下来。

items.def_en: To remove the outer covering, shell, or stem from seeds, nuts, or fruit.
items.ex_en: She spent the afternoon helping her grandmother hull fresh strawberries for homemade jam.
items.ex_zh: 她整个下午都在帮祖母给新鲜草莓去蒂，用来制作自制果酱。

items.def_zh: 剥（豌豆、蚕豆等的）豆荚；（植物）结荚
items.def_en: 1. To remove peas or beans from their pods. 2. (of plants) To produce seed pods.
items.ex_en: We sat on the porch together to pod sweet peas from the garden.
items.ex_zh: 我们一起坐在门廊上，剥着刚从花园里摘下的甜豌豆荚。

items.def_en: to cut away the thin skin or outer surface of a fruit or vegetable with a knife
items.ex_en: The chef instructed the apprentice to pare the rough skins from the apples.
items.ex_zh: 主厨吩咐学徒用小刀削去苹果粗糙的外皮。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to pull away or remove the outer skin, peel, or husk from produce
items.ex_en: Remember to strip off the dried husk before roasting the sweet corn cobs.
items.ex_zh: 在烤甜玉米棒之前，记得先把干燥的外皮剥除掉。

items.def_en: to strip or slip off the thin outer skin from fruits, vegetables, or nuts
items.ex_en: You need to scald the ripe tomatoes briefly to skin them more easily.
items.ex_zh: 你需要将熟透的西红柿焯烫一下，这样剥皮会更容易。

items.def_zh: 剥去（坚果、豌豆等）的外壳/荚
items.def_en: to remove the protective outer hard covering or pod from nuts, peas, or crustaceans
items.ex_en: They gathered around the kitchen table to shell walnuts for the holiday cake.
items.ex_zh: 他们围坐在厨房餐桌旁剥核桃壳，准备用来做节日蛋糕。

items.def_en: 1. To remove the skin or outer covering from a fruit or vegetable. 2. (of paint, skin, etc.) To come off in small pieces or strips.
items.ex_en: Please peel three large potatoes before you begin preparing the evening stew.
items.ex_zh: 在开始准备今晚的炖菜之前，请先削好三个大土豆的皮。
items.ex2_en: The old cracked exterior paint will peel under harsh damp conditions.
items.ex2_zh: 在严酷潮湿的环境下，开裂的旧外墙油漆会剥落掉皮。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe removing the natural outer skins, husks, or pods from fruits, vegetables, seeds, or legumes in culinary preparation.
groups.summary_zh: 指在烹饪或加工果蔬、豆类时，剥除其天然外皮、种皮或荚壳。
groups.desc_en: Specifies the mechanical removal of an outer natural covering, skin, husk, or casing from produce, unlike generic 'uncovering' which lacks agricultural/culinary specificity.
groups.desc_zh: 特指机械或手工剥除农产品、果实外部的天然表皮、外壳或豆荚，与宽泛的“揭开/去皮”相比极具农事与烹饪特定性。
groups.nuance_en: peel: strip off the soft outer skin or rind with hands or a blade (potatoes / apples / orange) · pare: trim away outer edges or thin slivers of skin with a knife (apple / crust / rind) · shell: remove hard outer casings or brittle shells (nuts / peas / shrimp) · hull: remove the calyx, leafy stem, or fibrous husk (strawberries / corn / grains) · pod: extract edible seeds from their elongated legumes (peas / beans) · skin: strip the tough skin or hide completely from produce or game (tomatoes / peaches / rabbit)
groups.nuance_zh: peel: 用手或工具剥除较软的果皮或表皮 (potatoes / apples / orange) · pare: 用小刀削去果皮薄层或修整边缘 (apple / crust / rind) · shell: 剥除硬壳或坚硬外皮以取仁 (nuts / peas / shrimp) · hull: 去除草莓果蒂、谷物颖壳或苞叶 (strawberries / corn / grains) · pod: 将豆粒从豆荚中剥出 (peas / beans) · skin: 将紧贴的硬皮、外膜或动物外皮完整剥下 (tomatoes / peaches / rabbit)

groups.name: Persist in Place or Condition · 停留与留置 (Stay, Remain, Linger)
groups.tip: 停在原位或守住原有状态

items.def_zh: 停留，逗留；保持，维持（某种状态）；暂住
items.def_en: 1. To continue to be in a particular place, state, or condition. 2. To live somewhere temporarily as a guest or visitor.
items.ex_en: The doctor advised him to stay in bed until the high fever broke.
items.ex_zh: 医生建议他卧床休息，直到高烧完全退去。

items.def_zh: 保持，仍然处于；逗留，留在原处；剩余，遗留
items.def_en: 1. To continue to be in the same state or condition. 2. To stay in the same place without moving away. 3. To still exist after other things have been used or dealt with.
items.ex_en: Investigators found that several vital questions remain unanswered despite months of intensive research.
items.ex_zh: 调查人员发现，尽管进行了数月的高强度调研，几个关键问题仍未得到解答。

items.def_en: to remain continuously in one physical place without moving or leaving
items.ex_en: The officer ordered the confused tourists to stay put until rescue workers arrived.
items.ex_zh: 警官命令那些慌乱的游客留在原地，直到救援人员赶到。

items.def_en: (+ somewhere) to linger or stay in a place without any definite purpose
items.ex_en: A few suspicious youths continued to hang around the empty parking lot tonight.
items.ex_zh: 今晚有几个形迹可疑的年轻人在空旷的停车场周围游荡闲待。

items.def_en: to stay in a place or situation for a period of time rather than leaving
items.ex_en: I can stick around for another hour if you still need some help.
items.ex_zh: 如果你还需要帮忙的话，我可以再多留一个小时。

items.def_zh: 寄居，常住（文雅/古旧用语）
items.def_en: archaic/literary: to dwell, remain, or stay permanently in a location
items.ex_en: The solitary hermit chose to abide in the shadow of the ancient mountains.
items.ex_zh: 孤独的隐士选择在那座古老山峦的阴影下长久寄居。

items.def_en: to stay in a place longer than necessary, typically because of reluctance to leave
items.ex_en: Guests continued to linger in the courtyard long after the concert had finished.
items.ex_zh: 音乐会结束很久之后，客人们依然流连在院子里不愿离去。

items.def_en: archaic: to delay leaving or linger in an area longer than intended
items.ex_en: The weary travelers could not tarry long beside the enchanting forest spring.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的旅人们不能在迷人的林间泉水旁逗留耽搁太久。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this stative frame denote continuing to occupy a spatial position or maintain an unmodified state rather than moving or changing. Stay is the high-frequency default emphasizing voluntary physical non-departure; remain is more formal, emphasizing continuity across time or being left after others depart; linger and tarry add nuances of reluctant, prolonged, or aimless staying.
groups.summary_zh: 指留在某一物理场所未离开，或在外部环境推移下保持原有存续状态。
groups.desc_en: Involves maintaining presence in a specific physical locus or temporal state despite time passing or pressure to move, contrasting with generic 'being' by emphasizing non-departure.
groups.desc_zh: 指在时间流逝或外部催促下仍坚守于特定物理位置或未变状态，相比中性的“在某处”，强调不离去与延续性。
groups.nuance_en: remain: continue in a state or place after others depart or conditions change (calm / seated / unchanged) · stay: deliberately pause departure or dwell temporarily as a guest (home / hotel / awake) · linger: delay departure out of reluctance, affection, or habit (smell / doubt / guest) · tarry: dawdle or postpone onward journey unnecessarily (path / journey / traveller) · abide: endure or inhabit a station steadfastly over long durations (presence / faith / memory)
groups.nuance_zh: remain: 他人离去或环境改变后仍保留在原位或原有状态 (calm / seated / unchanged) · stay: 刻意停留不走或暂住某处 (home / hotel / awake) · linger: 依恋、不舍或因惯性而迟迟不肯散去 (smell / doubt / guest) · tarry: 耽搁、拖延，在旅途或行事中磨蹭停留 (path / journey / traveller) · abide: 坚定不移地长期居留或驻留长存 (presence / faith / memory)

groups.name: Pester & Infuriate · 烦扰与激怒 (Hassle, Vex, Infuriate)
groups.tip: 琐事缠身令人心浮气躁

items.def_en: to cause someone mild annoyance, inconvenience, or disruption
items.ex_en: Please do not bother the head chef while he is plating the appetizers.
items.ex_zh: 主厨在为开胃菜摆盘时，请不要打扰他。

items.def_en: to make someone moderately angry or impatient by repeated minor acts
items.ex_en: His constant interruptions began to annoy everyone present at the morning strategy meeting.
items.ex_zh: 他接二连三的打断开始让晨间战略会议上的每一个人心生厌烦。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to repeatedly bother, criticize, or harass someone unfairly
items.ex_en: Why do the older kids always pick on him during recess?
items.ex_zh: 为什么大孩子们课间总爱找他茬、欺负他？

items.def_en: (informal) To annoy, bother, or harass someone persistently, especially by nagging or making demands.
items.ex_en: Aggressive street vendors continued to hassle tourists walking near the famous temple gates.
items.ex_zh: 咄咄逼人的街头小贩不停地在著名寺庙大门附近纠缠游客。

items.def_en: (formal or literary) To cause someone to feel annoyed, frustrated, or worried, especially about trivial matters.
items.ex_en: These inexplicable delays continued to vex the weary travelers throughout the long journey.
items.ex_zh: 这些莫名其妙的延误在漫长的旅程中不断让疲惫的旅人们感到心烦意乱。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to deliberately annoy or irritate someone until they are upset or angry
items.ex_en: Stop teasing your younger sister just to wind her up before dinner starts.
items.ex_zh: 别再故意逗你妹妹、赶在晚饭前把她惹恼了。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to thoroughly infuriate or intensely annoy someone
items.ex_en: His rude remarks were enough to piss off everyone in the entire office.
items.ex_zh: 他无礼的言论足以彻底惹恼整个办公室里的所有人。

items.def_en: to make someone extremely angry and outraged beyond patience
items.ex_en: The company's refusal to offer refunds will infuriate thousands of disappointed customers.
items.ex_zh: 该公司拒绝退款的做法必将彻底激怒数千名失望的顾客。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve irritating or distressing someone, stepping up from persistent nuisance and badgering to profound vexation and outright fury.
groups.summary_zh: 从持续纠缠、添乱的烦扰到令人深感苦恼乃至暴怒的情感升级。
groups.desc_en: Denotes escalating interpersonal friction from repetitive, unwanted intrusion to driving someone into incandescent rage, contrasting with baseline 'displeasing'.
groups.desc_zh: 指从反复无休止的打扰纠缠，升级为将对方逼至暴怒狂躁的情绪刺激过程，非一般的“使人不快”。
groups.nuance_en: hassle: continually pester or badger someone with petty demands (customers / workers / boss) · vex: trouble, perplex, and wear on someone's patience over time (problem / question / spirit) · infuriate: drive someone into an intense, explosive rage (critics / public / parents) · pick on: repeatedly single out a vulnerable target for unfair teasing or bullying (sister / newcomer / child) · wind up: deliberately bait or needle someone to provoke an outburst (brother / opponent / rival)
groups.nuance_zh: hassle: 找麻烦、用琐事反复纠缠骚扰 (customers / workers / boss) · vex: 使人感到心烦意乱、困扰且无计可施 (problem / question / spirit) · infuriate: 彻底激怒，使人勃然大怒或暴跳如雷 (critics / public / parents) · pick on: 专门找茬、刁难或欺负弱小目标 (sister / newcomer / child) · wind up: 故意挑衅引诱以把人逼到发飙 (brother / opponent / rival)

groups.name: Praise Aggressively & Boast Publicly · 吹捧与大肆宣扬 (Tout, Trumpet, Hype)
groups.tip: 像吹小号般大肆鼓吹宣扬

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to praise, promote, or boast about someone or something enthusiastically to increase their perceived value
items.ex_en: The company talked up the new phone, but users found it quite ordinary.
items.ex_zh: 公司对那款新手机大加吹捧，但用户发现它其实平平无奇。

items.def_zh: 吹捧，大肆宣扬；兜售，招徕（顾客）
items.def_en: 1. to praise or advertise something enthusiastically to persuade people of its merits. 2. to try to sell something in an aggressive or persistent way.
items.ex_en: The advertisement seeks to tout the company's new electric vehicle as revolutionary.
items.ex_zh: 这则广告试图将该公司的新型电动汽车大肆宣传为革命性产品。

items.def_en: to boast about or praise something excessively, often in a self-congratulatory way
items.ex_en: The proud warlord loved to vaunt his glorious battlefield victories before the court.
items.ex_zh: 这位狂妄的军阀喜欢在朝廷面前大肆吹嘘自己辉煌的战场战功。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to promote or publicize something aggressively with extravagant claims
items.ex_en: Marketers worked tirelessly to hype up the upcoming smartphone release on social networks.
items.ex_zh: 营销人员夜以继日地在社交网络上大肆炒作即将发布的智能手机。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to praise someone or something excessively or exaggerate their importance or qualities
items.ex_en: Biographers often puff up minor political achievements to flatter their prominent wealthy subjects.
items.ex_zh: 传记作者往往会夸大一些微不足道的政绩，来奉承他们那些显赫富有的传主。

items.def_en: to advertise, publicize, or promote something aggressively using exaggerated claims
items.ex_en: The studio tried hard to hype the mediocre movie with extravagant promotional trailers.
items.ex_zh: 电影制片厂试图通过浮夸的宣传预告片来大肆炒作这部平庸的电影。

items.def_zh: 大肆鼓吹，宣扬；吹小号；（大象）吼叫
items.def_en: 1. to announce or praise something loudly and proudly. 2. to make a loud sound like that of a trumpet, especially as an elephant does.
items.ex_en: Company executives rarely hesitate to trumpet their soaring profit margins to eager investors.
items.ex_zh: 公司高管向热切的投资者大肆吹嘘其飞涨的利润率时向来毫不含糊。

items.def_zh: 大肆宣传，哗众取宠地吹捧
items.def_en: to praise or publicize extravagantly and noisily, often with shallow exaggeration
items.ex_en: Promoters attempted to ballyhoo the boxing match as the greatest sports spectacle ever.
items.ex_zh: 推广方试图大肆炒作这场拳击赛，将其吹嘘为史无前例的体育盛会。

groups.summary_en: Speakers publicly promote, extol, or boast about the virtues, success, or advantages of someone or something, often with an aggressive, commercial, or boastful tone.
groups.summary_zh: 公开极力宣传、吹嘘或高调夸耀某人某物的价值或成就。
groups.desc_en: Involves public, extroverted glorification or commercial hawking of an entity, often with deliberate exaggeration, contrasting with neutral 'recommending'.
groups.desc_zh: 指为谋取利益或声势而公开、外显、乃至夸大其词地宣扬与吹嘘某事物，有别于中性的“推荐”。
groups.nuance_en: tout: aggressively solicit interest or promote merits for commercial/reputational gain (credentials / product / benefits) · trumpet: loudly and ostentatiously broadcast an achievement or success (victory / arrival / success) · hype: stimulate excessive public excitement through intense, exaggerated promotion (movie / stock / launch) · vaunt: boastfully display or vaingloriously extol an asset (power / achievements / superiority) · ballyhoo: generate loud, sensational, and trivial promotional clamor (event / tour / discovery)
groups.nuance_zh: tout: 竭力推销、招徕或极力吹捧优点 (credentials / product / benefits) · trumpet: 大张旗鼓地高调宣扬成就或政绩 (victory / arrival / success) · hype: 通过天花乱坠的宣传进行炒作以制造轰动 (movie / stock / launch) · vaunt: 夸夸其谈、自矜自夸所拥有的优势或力量 (power / achievements / superiority) · ballyhoo: 大肆喧闹宣扬，制造耸人听闻的营销噱头 (event / tour / discovery)

groups.name: Precipitate in Torrents · 倾泻与暴雨倾盆 (Pour, Sheet, Pelt)
groups.tip: 如暴雨幕布般倾泻流淌

items.def_zh: 倾泻，倾盆而下；倒，灌，注；大量涌入；倾诉
items.def_en: 1. To flow or cause to flow continuously in a stream. 2. To rain heavily and continuously. 3. To come or go in large numbers.
items.ex_en: Dark storm clouds gathered quickly, and heavy rain began to pour over town.
items.ex_zh: 乌云迅速汇聚，倾盆大雨随即铺天盖地落向小镇。
items.ex2_en: She carefully poured hot tea into the ceramic cups on the table.
items.ex2_zh: 她小心地将热茶倒在桌上的陶瓷杯中。

items.def_zh: 如瀑布般层叠倾泻，大量涌流
items.def_en: to pour, fall, or rush down rapidly in large quantities like a waterfall
items.ex_en: Torrents of melted snow began to cascade down the steep mountain slopes swiftly.
items.ex_zh: 融化的雪水如瀑布般顺着陡峭的山坡迅速倾泻而下。

items.def_en: (+ down) of rain: to fall exceedingly heavily and copiously
items.ex_en: The afternoon sky darkened ominously as rain began to teem down mercilessly.
items.ex_zh: 午后的天空阴沉得可怕，暴雨随即无情地瓢泼倾注而下。

items.def_zh: 倾盆大雨；倒水般下大雨
items.def_en: to rain extremely hard and heavily
items.ex_en: We had to cancel the outdoor picnic because it started to bucket down.
items.ex_zh: 我们不得不取消户外野餐，因为天空中突然倒水般下起了大雨。

items.def_en: to rain heavily and rapidly with driving kinetic force
items.ex_en: I stood beneath the awning while rain continued to pelt down outside endlessly.
items.ex_zh: 我站在雨棚下方，外面的暴雨不停地狂砸在地面上。

items.def_en: to rain heavily and relentlessly in massive volumes
items.ex_en: The rain poured down all afternoon, flooding the streets.
items.ex_zh: 大雨下了一整个下午，淹没了街道。

items.def_zh: （如雨水般）大片倾泻，倾盆而下；覆盖，形成薄层
items.def_en: (of rain or water) To fall heavily or flow in large, wide sheets.
items.ex_en: Dense sheets of relentless rainwater began to sheet across the open coastal highway.
items.ex_zh: 密集的连绵雨水如巨幅水幕般大片倾泻在空旷的沿海公路上。

items.def_en: of rain: to fall heavily and strike surfaces with relentless force
items.ex_en: Huge icy raindrops continued to pelt against our fragile windowpanes all night long.
items.ex_zh: 巨大的冰冷雨滴整夜不停地猛烈敲击着我们脆弱的窗玻璃。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this meteorological and fluid-motion frame denote liquid—overwhelmingly heavy rain—discharging in massive volumes or uninterrupted broad waves. The distinction lies in continuous streams (pour, stream) versus vast horizontal walls of water (sheet) or driving kinetic velocity (pelt, cascade).
groups.summary_zh: 描述大量雨水或液体以极大体量、连续面状或高速撞击的方式倾泻而下。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on the violent, unbroken kinetic volume of rainfall descending en masse, unlike gentle meteorological 'raining'.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重降雨在动能与流量上的凶猛、密集与倾泻状态，区别于温和的普通“下雨”。
groups.nuance_en: pour: discharge a heavy, continuous, and steady torrent of rain (rain / water / storm) · sheet: fall in wide, curtain-like, impenetrable walls of water (rain / spray / water) · pelt: strike surfaces violently with driving, bead-like force (rain / hailstones / drops) · teem: descend in dense, overflowing, bustling profusion (rain / skies / downpour) · bucket down: informal colloquial release of immense, deluge-level volumes (rain / clouds / skies)
groups.nuance_zh: pour: 如倾倒般持续大股倾泻 (rain / water / storm) · sheet: 如瀑布水幕般连成整片倾覆而下 (rain / spray / water) · pelt: 雨点如弹丸般凶猛、密集地抽打敲击 (rain / hailstones / drops) · teem: 瓢泼密集、铺天盖地充斥视界 (rain / skies / downpour) · bucket down: (口语) 暴雨如倾盆而下 (rain / clouds / skies)

groups.name: Premiere & Debut · 首演与面世 (Premiere, Debut, Unveil)
groups.tip: 文艺作品首次公开展现

items.def_en: to start selling a new product or service publicly
items.ex_en: The startup plans to launch its flagship software product across European markets next month.
items.ex_zh: 这家初创公司计划于下个月在欧洲市场推出其旗舰软件产品。
items.ex2_en: The innovative smartphone app will launch worldwide early next Monday morning.
items.ex2_zh: 这款创新的智能手机应用程序将于下周一清晨在全球推出。

items.def_en: to bring something into use or make it known for the first time
items.ex_en: The pharmaceutical company aims to introduce a revolutionary allergy medication by late autumn.
items.ex_zh: 这家制药公司计划在深秋前向市场引进一款革命性的抗过敏药物。

items.def_zh: 首演，首次公映；使……首映（或首演）
items.def_en: 1. To have a first public performance or showing, or to present a show or film for the first time.
items.ex_en: The renowned director will premier his latest historical drama at the film festival.
items.ex_zh: 这位知名导演将在本次电影节上首次公映他的最新历史大片。
items.ex2_en: The acclaimed broadway musical will premier in London next Friday evening.
items.ex2_zh: 这部备受好评的百老汇音乐剧将于下周五晚在伦敦首映。

items.def_zh: 首次亮相，初次登台；使……首次推出
items.def_en: 1. To perform or appear in public for the first time, or to introduce a product or show to the public for the first time.
items.ex_en: The automaker chose the annual convention to debut its cutting-edge electric supercar.
items.ex_zh: 该汽车制造商选择在年度盛会上首次推出其前沿的电动超级跑车。
items.ex2_en: The revolutionary electric vehicle will debut during the international motor show tomorrow.
items.ex2_zh: 这款革命性的电动汽车将于明天在国际车展上首次亮相。

items.def_en: to make a new product, service, or system available to the public in stages
items.ex_en: The tech giant intends to roll out the updated operating system in phases.
items.ex_zh: 这家科技巨头打算分阶段向公众正式铺开这款升级后的操作系统。

items.def_zh: 推出（新产品、作品、唱片等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to launch or release a new product, publication, or creative work to the public
items.ex_en: The publisher plans to bring out the author's anticipated memoir next spring.
items.ex_zh: 出版社计划于明年春天推出这位作者备受期待的回忆录。

items.def_zh: （电影、书籍、产品等）上映，出版，发行
items.def_en: to be released, published, or made available to the public for the first time
items.ex_en: The long-awaited sequel will finally come out in theaters across the country tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 这部万众期待的续集终于将在明天于全国各地的影院正式上映。

items.def_zh: 公布，揭幕（新产品或计划）
items.def_en: to show or introduce a new product, work of art, or policy to the public for the first time
items.ex_en: The mayor held a press conference to unveil the city's economic redevelopment plan.
items.ex_zh: 市长召开了新闻发布会，向公众公布了该市的经济重建规划。

groups.summary_en: A creative production, performer, or product is presented or made accessible to the public for the very first time.
groups.summary_zh: 文艺作品、演员或产品首次向公众演出、亮相或发售。
groups.desc_en: Refers to the formal, often ceremonial moment of exposing a finished work, system, or commercial product to the public gaze for the first time, contrasting with mundane 'starting'.
groups.desc_zh: 特指将完成的作品、系统或商用产品首次正式、仪式化地推向公众视野并接受检视，不同于简单的“开始”。
groups.nuance_en: premiere: stage the very first public screening or performance of an artwork (film / opera / symphony) · debut: introduce a person, product, or team into public life or a market for the first time (album / collection / model) · unveil: dramatically reveal a newly completed or secretive design or plan (monument / statue / prototype) · roll out: deploy a new product, policy, or system gradually across regions (network / vaccine / program) · launch: propel a major venture, spacecraft, or commercial line with formal fanfare (campaign / rocket / initiative)
groups.nuance_zh: premiere: 影视或艺术作品的全球或公开发布首映/首演 (film / opera / symphony) · debut: 人物、作品或产品初次登台亮相或试水入市 (album / collection / model) · unveil: 揭幕新造物、掀开保密原型或政策方案 (monument / statue / prototype) · roll out: 逐步在全域铺开推行新产品或新政策 (network / vaccine / program) · launch: 正式发起重大行动、新产品上线或火箭发射 (campaign / rocket / initiative)

groups.name: Present & Display Formally · 展示与呈现 (Present, Display, Exhibit)
groups.tip: 公开呈现与直观展示内容

items.def_en: (+ sth) to spread out or arrange things formally for inspection, assessment, or view
items.ex_en: The CEO laid out an ambitious five-year growth strategy.
items.ex_zh: 首席执行官详细阐述了一项雄心勃勃的五年增长战略。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to exhibit or arrange something in a public place for people to look at
items.ex_en: Curators decided to put on display several rare medieval manuscripts this coming weekend.
items.ex_zh: 策展人们决定在即将到来的周末公开陈列展出几件珍贵的中世纪手稿。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to arrange and display items formally so that they can be seen or inspected
items.ex_en: The antique dealer took great care to set out the porcelain vases formally.
items.ex_zh: 古董商极其细致地把这些瓷瓶正式陈列开来，以供客人鉴赏。

items.def_en: to put something in a prominent place so that people may see it easily
items.ex_en: The gallery owner chose to display the prize-winning painting directly beside the entrance.
items.ex_zh: 画廊主人选择将这幅获奖画作直接展示在正门入口旁醒目的位置。

items.def_zh: 展现，呈现；提出，提交；授予，赠予；引见，介绍
items.def_en: 1. To show, exhibit, or display something to an audience. 2. To introduce, submit, or offer a proposal, idea, or document for consideration. 3. To give something formally or ceremonially to someone.
items.ex_en: The lead architect will present the final stadium design to city officials tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 首席建筑师明天将向市政官员展示最终的体育场设计方案。

items.def_zh: 展现，表现（某种形象或特质）；放映，投射（光影）；凸出，伸出；预测，推算
items.def_en: 1. To present or display oneself, a quality, or an image in a particular way to others. 2. To throw or display light, shadow, or an image onto a surface or screen. 3. To stick out or extend beyond an edge or surface. 4. To estimate or forecast a future trend or amount.
items.ex_en: The chief executive consistently strives to project confidence and authority during press conferences.
items.ex_zh: 首席执行官在新闻发布会上始终努力展现出自信与威严。

items.def_en: to show an item, artwork, or quality publicly in a gallery, court, or formal setting
items.ex_en: The municipal museum will exhibit several rare Renaissance paintings for the first time.
items.ex_zh: 这家市立博物馆将首次公开展出数幅珍贵的文艺复兴时期画作。

items.def_en: to present someone or something in a way that highlights the best qualities
items.ex_en: The upcoming festival will showcase emerging musical talents from across the northern region.
items.ex_zh: 即将举行的音乐节将充分展示来自北部地区的新兴音乐人才。

groups.summary_en: Presenters formally set forth, exhibit, or project an image, proposal, or display before an audience for inspection, assessment, or appreciation.
groups.summary_zh: 指在公众或受众面前正式呈现、陈列或投射展示。
groups.desc_en: Entails deliberately arranging visual, intellectual, or artistic material for an audience's structured inspection, distinguishing itself from inadvertent 'showing'.
groups.desc_zh: 指为了接受公众或特定群体的正式检视与鉴赏，而有条理、有设计感地呈现材料，区别于无意的“显露”。
groups.nuance_en: display: exhibit objects prominently and attractively for public viewing (wares / artwork / emotions) · present: formally hand over, introduce, or articulate a work or argument (findings / report / credentials) · exhibit: officially place artifacts or behaviors on view in a gallery or legal forum (paintings / relics / symptoms) · showcase: deliberately highlight the finest qualities or top talents of something (talents / collection / skills) · lay out: spread items or arguments out in an organized, easily digestible array (plans / spread / wares)
groups.nuance_zh: display: 醒目且具吸引力地陈列商品或外显情绪 (wares / artwork / emotions) · present: 正式呈递、宣讲研究成果、凭证或观点 (findings / report / credentials) · exhibit: 在展厅或法定场合依规公开展出展品或症状 (paintings / relics / symptoms) · showcase: 作为橱窗标杆集中展现最具优势的特长或藏品 (talents / collection / skills) · lay out: 将物品、方案或论点条理清晰地铺开展示 (plans / spread / wares)

groups.name: Provoke & Tease Coquettishly · 挑逗与逗引 (Coquet, Tantalize, Flirt)
groups.tip: 戏谑调情或吊人胃口

items.def_en: to entice or provoke someone sexually or playfully while keeping satisfaction just out of reach
items.ex_en: She liked to tease her admirer by leaning in close and suddenly withdrawing.
items.ex_zh: 她喜欢靠得很近又突然退开，以此挑逗她的追求者。

items.def_en: to behave playfully as if attracted to someone, without serious intent
items.ex_en: He openly flirted with the new waitress while waiting for his dinner order.
items.ex_zh: 他在等晚餐时公然同那位新来的女服务员调情。

items.def_en: (+ with) to act playfully or flirtatiously without serious commitment
items.ex_en: The reckless nobleman chose to dally with the young maiden during the festival.
items.ex_zh: 那位轻浮的贵族在节日期间肆意调戏那位年轻少女。

items.def_zh: 卖弄风情，调情；玩弄，挑逗
items.def_en: (+ with) (dated) To flirt playfully without serious romantic intentions.
items.ex_en: The frivolous countess loved to coquet with young officers at the summer ball.
items.ex_zh: 那位轻佻的伯爵夫人喜欢在夏季舞会上同年轻军官卖弄风情。

items.def_en: (+ sb) mislead someone into believing that one is romantically or sexually interested in them
items.ex_en: It was cruel of him to lead on a woman he never loved.
items.ex_zh: 他引诱一个自己从未爱过的女人并让她心存幻想，真是太残忍了。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) toy with someone's feelings or affection without serious intention
items.ex_en: She felt devastated when she realized he was only playing with her feelings.
items.ex_zh: 当意识到他只是在玩弄自己的感情时，她感到痛心疾首。

items.def_en: To tease or torment someone by showing or promising something desirable that remains just out of reach.
items.ex_en: The enticing aroma of baking bread tantalized the starving travelers outside the bakery.
items.ex_zh: 烤面包诱人的香气让面包店外饥肠辘辘的旅人们干着急。

items.def_en: to excite or stimulate someone in a mildly pleasurable or suggestive way
items.ex_en: The author used provocative descriptions to titillate readers throughout the historical novel.
items.ex_zh: 作者在整部历史小说中运用挑逗性的描写来激起读者的兴致。

groups.summary_en: Someone playfully or seductively entices another by displaying something desirable while holding it out of reach, or flirts to excite desire without intent to commit. Actions range from subtle coquetry to frustrating allure.
groups.summary_zh: 通过展示诱人目标或以轻浮姿态示爱诱惑对方，吊人胃口或撩拨情愫。
groups.desc_en: Involves playful, erotic, or calculated engagement that excites desire or curiosity without granting immediate gratification, contrasting with straightforward 'seducing'.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过轻浮、爱昧或欲擒故纵的互动挑起情欲或好奇，但又暂不满足对方，不同于直奔主题的“诱惑”。
groups.nuance_en: flirt: playfully signal romantic or erotic interest without serious intent (colleague / stranger / danger) · tease: entice by showing or promising something desirable while playfully withholding it (lover / audience / crowd) · tantalize: torment someone by keeping an alluring prize just out of reach (tastebuds / senses / reader) · titillate: arouse mild, often superficial sexual or sensational excitement (curiosity / senses / viewers) · coquet: behave playfully in an insincere, coquettish manner to gain admiration (admirers / crowd / suitors)
groups.nuance_zh: flirt: 带有调情意味地挑逗互动，但不作严肃承诺 (colleague / stranger / danger) · tease: 逗弄、撩拨，通过欲给还休来吊胃口 (lover / audience / crowd) · tantalize: 用近在咫尺却可望不可即的诱惑折磨人 (tastebuds / senses / reader) · titillate: 挑动感官或好奇心以制造微弱的肉欲/猎奇刺激 (curiosity / senses / viewers) · coquet: 卖弄风情、虚与委蛇以博取仰慕 (admirers / crowd / suitors)

groups.name: Public Mockery & Jeering · 戏谑与当众嘲弄 (Wisecrack, Catcall, Pillory)
groups.tip: 发嘘声或起哄喝倒彩戏弄当事人

items.def_en: (informal) To make a witty, sarcastic, or cheeky remark.
items.ex_en: The cheeky comedian continued to wisecrack about the mayor during the live broadcast.
items.ex_zh: 那个厚脸皮的喜剧演员在直播中不断拿市长说俏皮话打趣。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) mock or ridicule someone publicly
items.ex_en: The cruel onlookers began to laugh at the nervous speaker on the platform.
items.ex_zh: 残忍的旁观者们开始在讲台下公开嘲笑那位紧张的发言人。

items.def_en: (+ sb) silence or drown out a speaker by shouting loudly or jeering
items.ex_en: The angry crowd shouted down the politician before he could finish his opening remarks.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的群众大声起哄，让那位政客开场白还没说完就无法继续了。

items.def_en: to provoke or challenge someone with insulting, sarcastic, or cruel remarks
items.ex_en: The hostile crowd continued to taunt the visiting goalkeeper after every conceded goal.
items.ex_zh: 每当丢球后，充满敌意的人群就会继续奚落客队守门员。

items.def_en: to disrupt a public speaker with aggressive, mocking questions and insults
items.ex_en: Angry protestors repeatedly tried to heckle the minister throughout his keynote economic address.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的抗议者在部长的重点经济演讲中屡次试图起哄质问。

items.def_en: (+ at) to laugh at or shout rude, derisive remarks at someone publicly
items.ex_en: Rival fans gathered outside the stadium to jeer at the defeated team.
items.ex_zh: 对手的球迷聚集在体育场外，对落败的球队起哄喝倒彩。

items.def_zh: 吹口哨起哄，发嘘声喝倒彩
items.def_en: To make loud whistles, shouts, or rude sexual comments at someone in public or to a performer.
items.ex_en: Construction workers gathered at the corner to catcall women passing by the site.
items.ex_zh: 建筑工人们聚集在街角，对路过工地的女性吹口哨起哄。

items.def_zh: 当众嘲弄，严厉抨击；处以颈手枷示众
items.def_en: 1. (often passive) To criticize, ridicule, or humiliate someone publicly and harshly. 2. (historical) To punish someone by locking them in a pillory.
items.ex_en: The dishonest politician was pilloried by the national press following the corruption scandal.
items.ex_zh: 腐败丑闻曝光后，那位不诚实的政客遭到了全国媒体的严厉抨击与嘲弄。

groups.summary_en: A speaker publicly mocks, derides, or humiliates a target, ranging from lighthearted quips and hostile heckling to severe public exposure and excoriation.
groups.summary_zh: 以言语当众讽刺、起哄嘲弄或公开谴责羞辱，方式由俏皮转为严苛。
groups.desc_en: Denotes vocal, collective, or public scorn directed at exposing a target to indignity and humiliation, contrasting with private 'criticizing'.
groups.desc_zh: 指在公开场合通过喧嚣、言辞或起哄让目标承受尊严扫地的羞辱，区别于私下的“批评”。
groups.nuance_en: jeer: shout derisive, loud, and mocking insults at a performer or speaker (crowd / mob / spectators) · heckle: disrupt an orator with aggressive, challenging, and persistent interruptions (speaker / politician / comedian) · catcall: shout shrill whistles or sexually suggestive, derisive remarks (pedestrians / actress / player) · pillory: publicly expose a person or policy to savage societal ridicule or vilification (press / critics / media) · taunt: provoke someone deliberately with cruel, jeering reproaches (opponent / victim / enemy)
groups.nuance_zh: jeer: 发出粗鄙刺耳的嘘声与当众嘲弄 (crowd / mob / spectators) · heckle: 用尖锐打断和诘难搅扰演说者 (speaker / politician / comedian) · catcall: 当众吹口哨或发出下流/喝倒彩式的叫声 (pedestrians / actress / player) · pillory: 将某人或言行置于舆论风口浪尖施以严酷游街示众式的声讨 (press / critics / media) · taunt: 用刻毒冷嘲蓄意激怒、挑衅对方 (opponent / victim / enemy)

groups.name: Pull & Drag · 拉引与拖拽 (Apply Tensile Force to Move an Object)
groups.tip: 持续施加拉力拽动重物前移

items.def_en: [I/T] to exert force upon something to move it towards oneself or the point of effort
items.ex_en: The firefighter had to pull the heavy iron lever toward himself to vent.
items.ex_zh: 消防员不得不把沉重的铁拉杆拉向自己以进行排气。

items.def_en: [I/T] to pull something hard or suddenly, often in short, repeated jerks
items.ex_en: The frightened little boy began to tug frantically at his mother's woolen sleeve.
items.ex_zh: 那个受惊的小男孩开始拼命拉扯他母亲的羊毛衣袖。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) pull someone or something along a surface with tensile force
items.ex_en: The exhausted hikers had to drag along their heavy sled through deep snow.
items.ex_zh: 筋疲力尽的徒步者只得硬拉着沉重的雪橇在厚雪中前行。

items.def_zh: 拉，拖，拽；吸引；提取，汲取；画，描绘；（与……）打成平手
items.def_en: 1. To pull or drag someone or something steadily. 2. To attract interest or attention. 3. To extract or obtain something from a source. 4. To produce a picture with a pen or pencil. 5. To finish a game or competition with equal scores.
items.ex_en: Strong draft horses were harnessed together to draw the loaded timber cart uphill.
items.ex_zh: 几匹健壮的挽马被套在一起，奋力将装满木材的大车往山上拉。

items.def_zh: 拖，慢而费力地拉动（在地面磨擦）
items.def_en: [I/T] to pull something heavy along the ground with effort and friction
items.ex_en: The exhausted mechanic had to drag the damaged iron engine across the concrete.
items.ex_zh: 精疲力竭的修理工只得把损坏的铁质引擎拖过水泥地面。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) pull or transport someone or something away with substantial effort
items.ex_en: The police had to haul away the broken vehicles blocking the narrow highway.
items.ex_zh: 警方不得不费力把堵塞狭窄公路的故障车辆拖走。

items.def_zh: 用力拖拉；运载（沉重之物）
items.def_en: [I/T] to pull or transport something very heavy with sustained, arduous exertion
items.ex_en: The dockworkers had to haul bulky cargo crates up the steep wooden ramp.
items.ex_zh: 码头工人不得不吃力地将沉重的货箱运上陡峭的木质斜坡。

items.def_zh: 强拉，拽，硬拖（尤指拽送法庭等）
items.def_en: (formal or archaic) To drag, haul, or force someone to go somewhere, especially into court.
items.ex_en: The king's soldiers arrived to hale the accused conspirator before the royal tribunal.
items.ex_zh: 国王的士兵赶来，将那名被控同谋者强行押解至皇家法庭。

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies exerting tensile force towards oneself or along a surface, escalating from smooth linear guidance to laborious, heavy hauling against resistance.
groups.summary_zh: 沿特定方向对物体施加拉力，从顺畅牵引逐渐升级为克服阻力的沉重拖拽。
groups.desc_en: Involves applying continuous tensile force to displace an object against friction, mass, or resistance, differing from mere 'carrying' or 'moving'.
groups.desc_zh: 指克服摩擦力、质量或阻力，通过施加持续拉力使物体产生位移，有别于纯粹的“搬运/移动”。
groups.nuance_en: pull: apply general tensile force to draw an object toward the source of effort (rope / trigger / plug) · drag: pull a heavy or unwilling object slowly across a resistant surface (feet / luggage / body) · haul: transport an extremely heavy or bulky load over a distance with great effort (cargo / timber / nets) · tug: give a succession of sharp, short, and urgent pulls (sleeve / rope / hair) · draw: smoothly pull an object or vehicle behind in a continuous, guided motion (carriage / sword / curtains)
groups.nuance_zh: pull: 施加牵引力将物体拉向自身的最普适动作 (rope / trigger / plug) · drag: 克服地面摩擦力费力拖拽重物或不情愿的人 (feet / luggage / body) · haul: 耗费大量体能或机械力长距离运送重负或大宗物资 (cargo / timber / nets) · tug: 短促、突然而用力地猛拉或拽扯 (sleeve / rope / hair) · draw: 平稳、流畅且定向地牵引、拔出或拉拢 (carriage / sword / curtains)

groups.name: Punish & Penalize · 惩罚与制裁 (Punish, Penalize, Discipline)
groups.tip: 对违规行为进行纪律制裁

items.def_en: to punish someone officially within an organization or household in order to maintain order and obedience
items.ex_en: The hospital board voted unanimously to discipline the surgeon for violating safety protocols.
items.ex_zh: 医院理事会一致投票决定对违反安全规程的外科医生给予纪律处分。

items.def_en: 1. To make someone suffer a penalty or hardship for a crime, fault, or wrongdoing. 2. To treat roughly or inflict severe damage upon.
items.ex_en: The magistrate will severely punish any offenders convicted of armed robbery this year.
items.ex_zh: 地方法官今年将严厉惩处任何被定罪为持械抢劫的罪犯。

items.def_en: (+ sb) severely punish or criticize someone for wrongdoing
items.ex_en: The principal will come down on any students caught vandalizing school property.
items.ex_zh: 校长会对任何被抓到破坏学校公物的学生予以痛斥和严惩。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) take strict disciplinary measures to stop or penalize illegal or illicit activity
items.ex_en: The authorities decided to clamp down on unauthorized gambling dens across the city.
items.ex_zh: 当局决定在全市范围内对未经许可的地下赌场进行严加管束与取缔。

items.def_zh: 惩罚，处罚；置于不利地位
items.def_en: 1. To punish someone for breaking a rule, regulation, or law. 2. To put someone at an unfair disadvantage.
items.ex_en: The regulatory agency decided to penalize the pharmaceutical firm for deceptive advertising practices.
items.ex_zh: 监管机构决定对进行虚假宣传的制药公司予以处罚。

items.def_en: to inflict punishment on someone, often accompanied by strong verbal reprimand
items.ex_en: The commanding officer publicly chastised the soldier for neglecting his basic sentry duties.
items.ex_zh: 指挥官当众严厉斥责了那名疏忽基本哨兵职责的士兵。

items.def_zh: （通过惩罚或挫折）使收敛，使悔悟；惩戒，惩罚
items.def_en: 1. (often passive) To make someone feel humble, restrained, or sorry, especially through suffering or discipline. 2. (formal) To punish or correct someone in order to improve them.
items.ex_en: Years of severe adversity had served to chasten his once uncontrollable and arrogant pride.
items.ex_zh: 多年严酷的逆境终于使他那曾经不可一世的傲气收敛并有所悔悟。

items.def_en: to punish or severely rebuke someone publicly or formally
items.ex_en: The regulatory committee moved to castigate the corrupt bank for blatant financial malpractice.
items.ex_zh: 监管委员会决议对存在公然金融违规行为的腐败银行予以严惩。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to imposing a negative consequence, penalty, or corrective suffering upon a person or group for an offense, rule-breaking, or wrongdoing, differing in formal versus institutional registers.
groups.summary_zh: 对违法、违规或过错行为施加处分或制裁，体现由轻至重的制度约束。
groups.desc_en: Specifies the formal, moral, or institutional imposition of suffering, loss, or retribution on an offender, contrasting with generic 'harming'.
groups.desc_zh: 特指基于道德、制度或法律权威，对违纪违规者施加受苦、损失或惩戒，区别于无章法的“伤害/攻击”。
groups.nuance_en: punish: impose an unpleasant consequence on someone for an offense as retribution (offenders / crimes / child) · penalize: subject someone to a statutory, sporting, or financial disadvantage (violators / foul / company) · discipline: correct conduct and train obedience through structured sanctions (troops / students / members) · castigate: subject someone to severe, formal verbal censure or condemnation (officials / report / hypocrisy) · chastise: reprimand sharply or inflict corporal correction to correct behavior (subordinates / press / child)
groups.nuance_zh: punish: 为报应过错而施加苦楚或制裁的通用概念 (offenders / crimes / child) · penalize: 依规扣分、处以行政罚款或剥夺比赛权益 (violators / foul / company) · discipline: 为树立铁的纪律或顺从而对人员进行整饬处分 (troops / students / members) · castigate: 在公开或官方场合予以严厉申斥或口诛笔伐 (officials / report / hypocrisy) · chastise: 痛斥或施加体罚以纠正不良言行 (subordinates / press / child)

groups.name: Purify & Chemically Refine · 提纯与净化 (Elute, Decarbonize, Purify)
groups.tip: 洗脱杂质提取纯净成分

items.def_en: (+ sth) remove or be removed as vapor through continuous heating
items.ex_en: The chemist needed to boil off the excess solvent before analyzing the residue.
items.ex_zh: 化学家在分析残留物之前需要加热蒸除多余的溶剂。
items.ex2_en: The remaining water began to boil off quickly under intense direct heat.
items.ex2_zh: 在强烈的直接加热下，剩余的水开始迅速汽化蒸发。

items.def_en: (+ sth) remove unwanted substances or impurities using a filter or separating process
items.ex_en: The software is designed to filter out spam emails automatically.
items.ex_zh: 该软件旨在自动过滤掉垃圾邮件。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make a liquid clear or pure by removing suspended solids or impurities
items.ex_en: The chef added beaten egg whites to clarify the rich chicken broth completely.
items.ex_zh: 厨师加入了打发的蛋清以彻底澄清除杂浓郁的鸡汤。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ out/from) to extract or remove soluble constituents from a solid using a percolating liquid
items.ex_en: Acidic water began to leach dangerous heavy metals from the discarded industrial waste.
items.ex_zh: 酸性水开始从废弃的工业废料中浸取出危险的重金属。
items.ex2_en: Toxic chemicals easily leach into groundwater during heavy periods of rainfall.
items.ex2_zh: 在暴雨期间，有毒化学物质很容易滤入地下水中。

items.def_en: [I/T] to purify a liquid by heating it into vapor and condensing it back to liquid
items.ex_en: The technician used specialized apparatus to distill pure alcohol from the fermented mash.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员使用专用装置从发酵醪液中蒸馏提取出纯酒精。

items.def_zh: 洗脱，淘洗（用溶剂从吸附材料中提取出分离物）
items.def_en: to extract or wash out an adsorbed substance from a chromatography column or absorbent using a solvent
items.ex_en: The researcher used an organic solvent to elute the retained proteins carefully.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员使用有机溶剂小心地将截留的蛋白质洗脱出来。

items.def_zh: 除去…中的碳（或积碳）；使脱碳，使实现低碳化
items.def_en: 1. to remove carbon or carbon deposits from an engine, metal, or substance. 2. to reduce or eliminate carbon dioxide emissions from an economy, process, or industry
items.ex_en: The garage technician will decarbonize the vintage car engine to restore optimal performance.
items.ex_zh: 汽修师傅将清除这台老爷车引擎的积碳以恢复最佳性能。

items.def_en: [I/T] to convert a solid directly to vapor upon heating and condense to pure form
items.ex_en: The alchemist attempted to sublimate raw sulfur into a purer crystal powder.
items.ex_zh: 炼金术士试图通过升华将天然硫磺提纯为更纯净的结晶粉末。
items.ex2_en: Dry ice can sublimate directly into carbon dioxide gas at room temperature.
items.ex2_zh: 干冰在室温下可以直接升华成二氧化碳气体。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on chemical and metallurgical extraction, separation, or stripping processes aimed at removing contaminants, carbon, or specific solutes. Verbs describe specialized chemical isolation techniques.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过特定的化学、冶金或萃取手段剥除杂质或提取目标成分以达到高纯度。
groups.desc_en: Centers on isolating an essential, pure substance by separating it from contaminants or base mixtures via chemical/physical phase transitions, contrasting with basic 'cleaning'.
groups.desc_zh: 指利用相变或物理化学原理从混合物或杂质中剥离并提取纯净成分，不同于机械式的日常“洗净”。
groups.nuance_en: distill: extract and concentrate volatile components through vaporization and condensation (spirits / water / essence) · purify: free a substance from all foreign, polluting, or imperfect elements (air / water / soul) · clarify: remove suspended solid particles or impurities to render a liquid clear (butter / broth / wine) · leach: extract soluble minerals or chemicals out of a solid through a percolating liquid (nutrients / soil / chemicals) · elute: wash out an adsorbed substance from a chromatography column using a solvent (proteins / sample / fractions)
groups.nuance_zh: distill: 利用沸点差异通过蒸发冷凝提取高纯成分或凝练精髓 (spirits / water / essence) · purify: 全面清除异质杂质以使物质或心灵纯洁化 (air / water / soul) · clarify: 滤除悬浮杂质使液体清澈明透 (butter / broth / wine) · leach: 液体渗透固体时将可溶成分溶出浸提 (nutrients / soil / chemicals) · elute: (色谱法) 用洗脱液洗脱吸附柱中的吸附成分 (proteins / sample / fractions)

groups.name: Purify & Decontaminate · 净化、提纯与除杂 (Purify, Detoxify, Refine)
groups.tip: 清除杂质或毒素恢复纯净

items.def_en: (+ sth) clean the interior of something thoroughly, removing all impurities or contamination
items.ex_en: We must thoroughly clean out the rusty tank before pouring in fresh water.
items.ex_zh: 在倒入清水之前，我们必须把生锈的水箱彻底清理干净。

items.def_en: (+ sth) completely remove, cleanse, or eliminate harmful, unwanted, or sinful elements
items.ex_en: The ancient ritual sought to purge away lingering corruption from the sacred grove.
items.ex_zh: 古老的仪式旨在涤荡神圣树林中残留的污秽与恶念。

items.def_en: to remove impurities or unwanted elements from a substance, typically as part of an industrial process
items.ex_en: The industrial plant operates around the clock to refine crude oil into gasoline.
items.ex_zh: 该工业工厂昼夜不停地运转，将原油精炼成汽油。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ of/from) to remove dirty or harmful substances from something
items.ex_en: This multi-stage filtration system can purify contaminated well water from harmful heavy bacteria.
items.ex_zh: 这套多级过滤系统可以净化受污染的井水，清除有害细菌。
items.ex2_en: Over time, the murky river water gradually purified through natural gravel filters.
items.ex2_zh: 随着时间的推移，浑浊的河水通过天然砾石层逐渐净化。

items.def_en: 1. (chemistry / engineering) To remove dissolved, trapped, or adsorbed gas from a liquid, solid, or container.
items.ex_en: Technicians must degas the molten polymer to prevent bubbles during high-pressure molding.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员必须对熔融聚合物进行脱气处理，以防高压成型时产生气泡。

items.def_en: to neutralize or remove chemical, biological, or radioactive contaminants from an area or object
items.ex_en: Hazmat crews arrived swiftly to decontaminate the laboratory after the toxic chemical spill.
items.ex_zh: 有毒化学品泄漏后，防化人员迅速赶到对实验室进行了消毒洗消。

items.def_zh: 解毒，排毒；净化，去除毒素
items.def_en: 1. To remove harmful or toxic substances from the body, or to cleanse a contaminated substance or environment.
items.ex_en: The human liver works continuously to detoxify metabolic waste and harmful ingested chemicals.
items.ex_zh: 人体肝脏持续工作以分解代谢废物并清除摄入的有害化学毒素。
items.ex2_en: Her body slowly detoxified after several weeks of drinking pure mineral water.
items.ex2_zh: 在喝了几周纯净矿泉水后，她的身体慢慢完成了排毒。

items.def_zh: 净化心灵，使精神化，使超凡脱俗；赋予……精神意义
items.def_en: 1. To purify or elevate morally and spiritually; to give a religious or spiritual meaning and character to something.
items.ex_en: The ascetic aimed to spiritualize earthly suffering through solitary prayer and quiet meditation.
items.ex_zh: 这位苦修者旨在通过独自祈祷与静默冥想来净化人世苦难并赋予其精神意义。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the removal of harmful contaminants, toxins, dissolved gases, or spiritual impurities from a body, chemical compound, or mind to restore it to an unpolluted state.
groups.summary_zh: 指清除毒素、杂质、气体或精神污垢，使物质或心灵恢复纯净状态。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the systematic removal of foreign, harmful, or debasing elements to achieve pristine purity, contrasting with mere surface washing or cosmetic cleaning.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过物理、化学或精神手段剔除外来杂质、有害物或沉渣以达本真纯粹，区别于仅去除表面污垢的普通清洗。
groups.nuance_en: purify: rendering intrinsically clean or morally stainless (water / soul / air) · decontaminate: neutralizing hazardous or toxic pollutants (soil / site / equipment) · detoxify: eliminating physiological or psychological toxins (body / liver / culture) · refine: purifying and upgrading through repeated processing (petroleum / sugar / skills)
groups.nuance_zh: purify: 使本质纯正或精神净化 (water / soul / air) · decontaminate: 中和并清除有害或放射性污染 (soil / site / equipment) · detoxify: 清除生理或心理层面的毒素 (body / liver / culture) · refine: 经深度加工提纯或去粗取精 (petroleum / sugar / skills)

groups.name: Pursue & Apprehend · 追捕与擒获 (Hunt, Capture, Apprehend)
groups.tip: 追踪捕猎并俘虏拘捕

items.def_en: to force a person or animal into a place from which they cannot escape
items.ex_en: The police hounds managed to corner the dangerous fugitive in a dead alley.
items.ex_zh: 警犬设法将那名危险的逃犯逼入了死胡同中使之走投无路。

items.def_zh: 捕获，俘获；占领，夺取；准确表达
items.def_en: 1. To catch and imprison a person or animal by force or skill; take control of a place. 2. To accurately represent or record a mood, quality, or atmosphere.
items.ex_en: Elite military rangers executed a midnight raid to capture the notorious insurgent commander.
items.ex_zh: 精锐军事突击队员执行夜袭，俘获了臭名昭著的叛军指挥官。

items.def_en: 1. To pursue and kill wild animals for food or sport. 2. To search determinedly for someone or something.
items.ex_en: Federal agents continued to hunt the elusive fugitive across multiple southern state borders.
items.ex_zh: 联邦特工继续跨越南部多个州界搜寻追踪那名行踪不定的逃犯。

items.def_en: to find someone or something after a thorough or difficult search
items.ex_en: The police managed to track down the suspect after weeks of investigation.
items.ex_zh: 经过数周的调查，警方终于追查到了嫌疑人的下落。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) search relentlessly for and capture a fugitive, criminal, or quarry
items.ex_en: Detectives worked around the clock to hunt down the suspect.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们夜以继日地工作，力求将嫌疑人缉拿归案。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) gather, corner, and capture suspects or animals systematically
items.ex_en: The police rounded up several suspects following the robbery.
items.ex_zh: 抢劫案发生后，警方搜捕了几名嫌疑人。

items.def_en: to catch and arrest someone who has not obeyed the law
items.ex_en: Federal marshals coordinated across state lines to apprehend the fugitive bank robber yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 联邦执法官昨天跨州协同行动，成功拘捕了在逃的银行抢劫犯。

items.def_en: (informal) to catch someone doing something wrong or take someone into custody
items.ex_en: The store detective managed to nab the shoplifter right at the exit door.
items.ex_zh: 便衣保安正好在出口处当场逮住了那个小偷。

groups.summary_en: An agent actively tracks, pursues, and forcibly secures control over a fugitive, prey, or enemy combatant. Verbs span the full operational arc from active tracking to taking into custody.
groups.summary_zh: 追踪并最终通过强制手段剥夺自由或羁押的完整追捕场景。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the dynamic sequence of trailing, outmaneuvering, and physically detaining a fleeing target, distinguishing targeted manhunts from general seeking.
groups.desc_zh: 指从尾随追踪、封堵围堵到最终实施拘捕的完整追击链条，区别于漫无目的的搜寻。
groups.nuance_en: hunt down: relentless pursuit until final discovery (fugitive / killer / prey) · track down: following subtle forensic trails to a hiding place (suspect / records / witness) · corner: forcing into a position leaving no escape (prey / suspect / market) · apprehend: formal legal seizure by authority (felon / suspect / thief) · round up: herding and gathering dispersed targets collectively (gang members / strays / suspects)
groups.nuance_zh: hunt down: 穷追不舍直至最终捕获 (fugitive / killer / prey) · track down: 循线追踪并起底藏身处 (suspect / records / witness) · corner: 将目标逼入无路可逃的绝境 (prey / suspect / market) · apprehend: 依法实施正式抓捕 (felon / suspect / thief) · round up: 将分散的目标围拢收网 (gang members / strays / suspects)

groups.name: Push & Propel · 推动与驱使 (Propel, Drive, Impel)
groups.tip: 施加推力使物体向前移动

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) propel someone or something mechanically or urgently forward
items.ex_en: Powerful tidal currents combine to drive forward the massive wooden transport barge.
items.ex_zh: 强劲的潮水汇聚在一起，驱使巨大的木质货船向前推进。

items.def_en: continue forward with determination or propel something forward energetically
items.ex_en: Despite severe logistical hurdles, the development team resolved to push ahead with construction.
items.ex_zh: 尽管面临严重的后勤障碍，开发团队仍下定决心大力推进施工。

items.def_en: to force a person, animal, or object to move forcefully in a specific direction
items.ex_en: The furious sheepdog barked loudly to drive the scattered flock toward the fold.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的牧羊犬大声吠叫，将分散的羊群驱赶向羊圈。

items.def_zh: 推进，驱动（物体向前移动）
items.def_en: to push, drive, or force someone or something forward or in a particular direction
items.ex_en: Powerful twin rocket thrusters ignite simultaneously to propel the scientific satellite into orbit.
items.ex_zh: 强大的双火箭推进器同时点火，推动科学卫星进入轨道。

items.def_zh: （尤指在未准备好时）仓促推入，迫使承担；用草叉叉起
items.def_en: 1. to thrust someone suddenly into a difficult role, situation, or position. 2. to lift or move something with a pitchfork
items.ex_en: The sudden crisis pitchforked the young inexperienced senator into high cabinet leadership.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的危机迫使这位毫无经验的年轻参议员仓促走上内阁高层领导岗位。

items.def_en: [I/T] to push someone or something roughly or forcefully
items.ex_en: The impatient commuter began to shove others aside to board the crowded train.
items.ex_zh: 心急的通勤者开始粗暴推搡其他人，想要挤上拥挤的列车。

items.def_en: to force, urge, or drive someone to do something; to push or drive an object forward
items.ex_en: Severe economic pressure began to impel desperate families to seek work in cities.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的经济压力开始迫使绝望的家庭前往城市寻找工作。

items.def_en: [I/T] to push suddenly and with substantial force
items.ex_en: The brave knight managed to thrust his silver sword deep into the beast.
items.ex_zh: 勇敢的骑士设法将他的银剑狠狠刺进了巨兽体内。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe exerting mechanical force or urgent internal compulsion that drives an object or agent forward through space or into swift action.
groups.summary_zh: 指施加机械推力或强烈驱策力，使物体或个体向前疾进或被迫采取行动。
groups.desc_en: Denotes applying forceful forward kinetic or motivational energy to overcome inertia, contrasting with passive drifting or mere guidance.
groups.desc_zh: 指施加强劲的机械或心理推动力以克服惯性向前推进，区别于顺势漂流或单纯引导。
groups.nuance_en: propel: driving forward with explosive or mechanical force (missile / craft / economy) · drive: applying sustained, disciplined force toward an objective (car / project / growth) · impel: urging forward through irresistible internal or external compulsion (duty / conscience / crisis) · thrust: suddenly and forcefully jabbing or pushing forward (blade / hand / responsibility) · pitchfork: abruptly thrusting someone into an unprepared role (novice / minister / successor)
groups.nuance_zh: propel: 以机械或爆发力高速推进 (missile / craft / economy) · drive: 持续强力驱动以实现目标 (car / project / growth) · impel: 凭道义、良知或外力驱使前行 (duty / conscience / crisis) · thrust: 猛力且突然地向前推刺或塞给 (blade / hand / responsibility) · pitchfork: 猝不及防地将人推上风口浪尖或职位 (novice / minister / successor)

groups.name: Push & Pull · 推拉与拽引 (Push, Pull, Tug)
groups.tip: 施加向内推或向外拉的机械力

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) exert tensile force to draw someone or something back toward oneself
items.ex_en: The alert mother had to pull back her child from the speeding car.
items.ex_zh: 警觉的母亲不得不一把将孩子拉回，避开飞驰而来的汽车。
items.ex2_en: The invading troops decided to pull back across the rugged northern border.
items.ex2_zh: 入侵的部队决定撤回到崎岖的北部边境之后。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) exert force to move someone or something away or resist backward
items.ex_en: The bouncer had to push back the rowdy fans rushing the club door.
items.ex_zh: 保镖不得不动手把冲撞夜总会大门的闹事粉丝推了回去。

items.def_en: to hold onto someone or something and move them towards yourself or in a particular direction
items.ex_en: She pulled the heavy wooden chair closer to the fireplace to get warm.
items.ex_zh: 她把沉重的木椅拉近壁炉以取暖。

items.def_en: 1. to use physical pressure or force to move someone or something away or into a particular position. 2. to encourage or force someone to do something or work harder
items.ex_en: Despair pushed him toward the edge of an unfathomable and darkening abyss.
items.ex_zh: 绝望将他推向深不可测且愈发昏暗的深渊边缘。

items.def_en: [I/T] to pull something heavy along the ground with substantial effort
items.ex_en: Two workers had to drag the soaked carpet across the muddy yard.
items.ex_zh: 两名工人不得不费力地把浸湿的地毯拖过泥泞的院子。

items.def_en: [I/T] to pull something hard, quickly, or repeatedly with short jerks
items.ex_en: The frightened little boy tugged at his mother's sleeve in the crowd.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的小男孩在人群中拽着母亲的衣袖。

items.def_en: to pull or drag something very heavy using sustained, intense exertion
items.ex_en: Fishermen worked together to haul the enormous net filled with glistening fish.
items.ex_zh: 渔民们合力拖起装满闪闪发光游鱼的沉重渔网。

items.def_en: to pull, strain, or twist something away with a violent sudden movement
items.ex_en: The thief managed to wrench the handbag from her grasp and fled.
items.ex_zh: 窃贼猛地一把从她手中夺走手提包，随即逃之夭夭。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe exerting directional physical force either away from oneself (pushing) or toward oneself (pulling), spanning smooth and jerky motions.
groups.summary_zh: 指施加向外推开或向内拉近的身体物理力，涵盖平缓移动与猛烈拉扯。
groups.desc_en: Denotes directional mechanical manipulation along an axis toward or away from the agent, distinguished from stationary holding or frictionless sliding.
groups.desc_zh: 指沿轴向朝向或背离施力者方向施加机械外力，区别于静止持握或无阻力滑动。
groups.nuance_en: pull: drawing an entity toward oneself (lever / cord / trigger) · push: applying continuous pressure away from oneself (cart / button / door) · drag: pulling heavy or resistant weight along a surface (feet / sack / anchor) · tug: giving short, sharp, intermittent pulls (sleeve / rope / heartstrings) · haul: moving very heavy loads with strenuous effort (cargo / timber / net) · wrench: twisting and pulling away violently (weapon / door / ankle)
groups.nuance_zh: pull: 沿施力者方向拉引 (lever / cord / trigger) · push: 背向施力者推挤 (cart / button / door) · drag: 克服阻力在地面拖拽 (feet / sack / anchor) · tug: 短促而用力地拉扯 (sleeve / rope / heartstrings) · haul: 费力搬运或长距离拖运重物 (cargo / timber / net) · wrench: 猛烈扭拧并强行拔出 (weapon / door / ankle)

groups.name: Push & Shove · 推搡与冲撞 (Jostle, Shove, Thrust)
groups.tip: 发力猛推或向前猛刺

items.def_en: to push someone or something with a finger or pointed object
items.ex_en: He prodded the campfire with a stick to keep the flames burning.
items.ex_zh: 他用棍子捅了捅营火，好让火苗继续燃烧。

items.def_en: [T/I] to push roughly against someone, usually in a crowd
items.ex_en: Commuters jostled each other impatiently as they rushed onto the crowded subway.
items.ex_zh: 上班族在冲上拥挤的地铁时彼此不耐烦地推推搡搡。

items.def_en: (+ sb) physically shove or bully someone into compliance
items.ex_en: Don't let them push you around; you have rights as a tenant.
items.ex_zh: 别让他们摆布你；作为租客你也是有权利的。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) push someone or something out of the way forcefully or rudely
items.ex_en: The aggressive guard shoved the protesters aside to clear a broad path.
items.ex_zh: 凶悍的警卫粗暴地将抗议者推到一旁，以清理出一条宽敞的通道。

items.def_zh: 用肘推搡，用肘挤着前行
items.def_en: To push or strike someone with your elbow, or force your way through a crowd using your elbows.
items.ex_en: She elbowed her way through the noisy crowd to reach the stage.
items.ex_zh: 她用手肘在嘈杂的人群中挤出一条路，走到了舞台前。

items.def_en: to push or strike with the head or horns; to push gently
items.ex_en: The young goat gently bunted against my knees, asking for fresh greens.
items.ex_zh: 小山羊用头轻轻顶着我的膝盖，讨要新鲜青草。

items.def_zh: 猛推，推挤；乱塞，胡乱放置
items.def_en: 1. To push someone or something roughly and forcefully. 2. (informal) To put something somewhere carelessly or hurriedly.
items.ex_en: An angry customer shoved the store manager back against the glass counter.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的顾客猛地一推，将店长推倒在玻璃柜台上。

items.def_en: 1. To push someone or something suddenly and with great force. 2. To make a sudden forward stabbing movement with a weapon or body part.
items.ex_en: He thrust his gleaming rapier into the shadow concealing his deadly foe.
items.ex_zh: 他将闪亮的细剑猛刺入藏着宿敌的阴影之中。

groups.summary_en: Agents exert abrupt physical force with hands, elbows, or the body to displace someone or something forcibly. Nuances range from forceful, rude jostling in a crowd to violent, forward-directed thrusts.
groups.summary_zh: 强调运用肢体施加突发性外力，以粗暴或强行的方式推挤推搡目标。
groups.desc_en: Denotes rude, aggressive physical contact displacing others through crowded space, contrasting with polite passing or coordinated movement.
groups.desc_zh: 指在拥挤空间内粗暴冲撞、推挤他人以强行夺道，区别于礼貌让行或协调移动。
groups.nuance_en: shove: pushing forcefully and rudely (bystander / furniture / box) · jostle: roughly bumping and pushing in a packed crowd (commuters / crowd / passengers) · elbow: using bent arms to force a path through people (way / competitor / rivals) · push around: bullying and bossing someone around overbearingly (subordinate / peer / sibling) · bunt: gently nudging or bunting off-target (ball / calf / rival)
groups.nuance_zh: shove: 蛮横粗暴地推搡 (bystander / furniture / box) · jostle: 在拥挤人群中推推搡搡 (commuters / crowd / passengers) · elbow: 用胳膊肘硬挤出通道或排挤对手 (way / competitor / rivals) · push around: 霸凌、呼来喝去或横加摆布 (subordinate / peer / sibling) · bunt: 顶撞或用头轻触推离 (ball / calf / rival)

groups.name: Push Beyond Physical Limits · 劳累过度与身体透支 (Overwork, Overdrive, Exhaust)
groups.tip: 超负荷驱动身体直到精疲力竭

items.def_zh: 使负担过重；使过度耗损
items.def_en: to make excessive demands on someone's strength, energy, or faculties
items.ex_en: Assuming additional administrative duties will severely overtax the department's limited faculties.
items.ex_zh: 承担额外的行政职责将严重过度耗损该部门有限的精力与能力。

items.def_en: (+ sb) cause someone to become weak, fatigued, or exhausted through overexertion
items.ex_en: Working late every single evening will completely run down your immune system.
items.ex_zh: 每天晚上加班会彻底拖垮你的免疫系统。

items.def_en: to exhaust someone completely through continuous hard work or exertion
items.ex_en: Running after toddlers all afternoon completely wore me out.
items.ex_zh: 整个下午跟在幼儿屁股后面跑让我筋疲力尽。

items.def_zh: 精疲力竭，过度劳累致垮
items.def_en: (+ sb) become or make someone thoroughly exhausted from prolonged overwork and stress
items.ex_en: The relentless pressure of seventy-hour workweeks eventually burned out the engineers.
items.ex_zh: 每周工作七十小时的持续高压最终使工程师们彻底累垮。

items.def_en: to drain someone entirely of physical or mental energy
items.ex_en: The rigorous mountain ascent exhausted the stamina of even experienced hikers.
items.ex_zh: 艰难的登山过程甚至耗尽了经验丰富的徒步者的体力。

items.raw_cluster: 过度劳作与疲竭 Overwork & Exhaust
items.def_en: 1. To work too hard for too long, or force an employee or machine to work excessively.
items.ex_en: Factory owners should not overwork their employees during the peak shipping season.
items.ex_zh: 工厂老板不应在出货旺季让员工过度劳累。

items.raw_cluster: 过度劳作与疲竭 Overwork & Exhaust
items.def_zh: 驱使过度，使劳累过度；使（发动机等）超负荷运转
items.def_en: 1. To drive, work, or push a person, animal, or system excessively hard beyond safe limits.
items.ex_en: The cruel carriage master overrode the weary horses on the steep mountain path.
items.ex_zh: 残忍的车夫在陡峭的山路上过度驱使疲惫的马匹。

items.def_zh: 使极度虚脱；使力竭倒地
items.def_en: to reduce someone to extreme physical weakness or utter collapse through fatigue
items.ex_en: Fever and immense sorrow combined to prostrate the solitary wanderer completely.
items.ex_zh: 发烧与巨大的悲痛交加，令这位孤独的漫游者彻底瘫倒力竭。

groups.summary_en: An agent drives oneself or another past sustainable limits of energy or endurance, leading to acute depletion or breakdown. Verbs range from working excessive hours (overwork) to driving past breaking points (overdrive) and draining reserves entirely (exhaust, overtire, wear out).
groups.summary_zh: 指强迫自己或他人工作过量，造成体力与精力严重耗尽乃至崩溃。
groups.desc_en: Denotes driving living organisms beyond sustainable physiological capacity into total collapse, contrasting with productive exertion.
groups.desc_zh: 指过度驱使生理机能超出承受极限以致身心崩溃，区别于可持续的正常劳作。
groups.nuance_en: exhaust: completely draining all energy or resources (strength / patience / savings) · overtax: imposing burdens that stretch resilience past endurance (heart / patience / resources) · burn out: depleting mental and emotional capacity via chronic stress (staff / doctor / teacher) · wear out: degrading vitality through prolonged relentless friction (body / shoes / patience) · prostrate: reducing physically or mentally to total helplessness (fever / grief / fatigue)
groups.nuance_zh: exhaust: 彻底耗尽全部体力或精力 (strength / patience / savings) · overtax: 施加过度负荷使其难以承受 (heart / patience / resources) · burn out: 因长期高压导致心力交瘁、职业倦怠 (staff / doctor / teacher) · wear out: 经久磨损使其精疲力竭或报废 (body / shoes / patience) · prostrate: 使极度衰弱无力而瘫倒 (fever / grief / fatigue)

groups.name: Quantity Adequacy to Saturation · 充盈至超载 (Suffice, Sate, Overload)
groups.tip: 从刚好满足需求到过度负荷

items.def_en: to provide enough to meet a demand, standard, or requirement
items.ex_en: The current supply of grain will easily satisfy the town's winter needs.
items.ex_zh: 目前的粮食供应将轻易满足全镇的冬季需求。

items.def_en: To be enough or adequate for a purpose or need.
items.ex_en: A brief summary will suffice to inform the board of our progress.
items.ex_zh: 一份简短的总结足以向董事会汇报我们的进展。

items.def_en: (+ sth) become completely full or make a container full to capacity
items.ex_en: Rainwater continued to fill up the metal barrel outside the garden shed.
items.ex_zh: 雨水继续灌满花园棚屋外的金属水桶。
items.ex2_en: The stadium parking lot will fill up rapidly before tonight's championship game.
items.ex2_zh: 今晚的冠军赛之前，体育场的停车场很快就会停满。

items.def_en: to supply someone with so much of something that they are completely full or bored
items.ex_en: The lavish multi-course banquet failed to satiate his peculiar appetite for power.
items.ex_zh: 奢华的多道菜宴席并未能满足他对权力的奇异渴望。

items.def_en: (+ sth) clog or completely fill a passage or space so movement is blocked
items.ex_en: Fallen autumn leaves quickly choked up the narrow drainage ditch along the street.
items.ex_zh: 秋天的落叶迅速堵塞了沿街狭窄的排水沟。

items.def_zh: 使超载，使负荷过多；使负担过重
items.def_en: To put too great a load, amount of work, or electrical current on someone or something.
items.ex_en: Plugging too many heaters into one socket will certainly overload the circuit.
items.ex_zh: 在一个插座上插太多加热器肯定会使电路过载。

items.def_en: to overwhelm someone or something with an enormous quantity of items
items.ex_en: Frustrated consumers inundated the regulatory agency with thousands of formal complaints.
items.ex_zh: 受挫的消费者向监管机构提交了数千份正式投诉，令其应接不暇。

items.def_en: to supply something in excessive quantities that exceed demand
items.ex_en: Cheap foreign imports began to glut the market, causing domestic prices to plunge.
items.ex_zh: 廉价的外国进口商品开始充斥市场，导致国内物价暴跌。

groups.summary_en: This scale captures the transition of quantity or capacity from merely adequate to heavily excessive. 'Suffice' represents the threshold of minimum adequacy, while 'overload' marks the hazardous or excessive extreme where capacity is completely exceeded.
groups.summary_zh: 描述数量从最低限度的‘足够’攀升至超出负荷的‘过载’。
groups.desc_en: Traces the continuum from satisfying an exact capacity to catastrophic overflowing, contrasting with linear, non-bounded accretion.
groups.desc_zh: 描绘从刚好满足容量到彻底溢出充塞的渐进状态，区别于无边界的线性累加。
groups.nuance_en: suffice: meeting minimum demands or requirements adequately (amount / explanation / funds) · satiate: filling an appetite completely to the point of dullness (hunger / curiosity / lust) · fill up: occupying empty volume to its normal capacity (tank / room / quota) · overload: burdening beyond safe structural capacity (circuit / truck / system) · inundate: overwhelming completely like an uncontrollable flood (office / inbox / market) · glut: flooding a market with massive unsellable surplus (market / warehouses / supply)
groups.nuance_zh: suffice: 恰好满足最低需求 (amount / explanation / funds) · satiate: 彻底填满食欲或欲望致生腻烦 (hunger / curiosity / lust) · fill up: 填满空缺至额定容量 (tank / room / quota) · overload: 严重超载超出安全负荷 (circuit / truck / system) · inundate: 如洪水般大量淹没、应接不暇 (office / inbox / market) · glut: 过量供应塞满市场导致滞销 (market / warehouses / supply)

groups.name: Quash & Extinguish Rumor/Rebellion · 扑灭与扼杀 (Quell, Stifle, Scotch)
groups.tip: 彻底扑灭苗头扼杀在摇篮中

items.def_zh: 防患于未然；扼杀在摇篮中
