items.def_en: (nip sth in the bud) to put an end to a problem or bad behavior at an early stage before it grows
items.ex_en: Management acted immediately to nip the brewing workplace dispute in the bud.
items.ex_zh: 管理层立即采取行动，将正在酝酿的职场争端扼杀在摇篮中。

items.def_en: (+ sth) suppress, extinguish, or crush an uprising, rumor, or fire with force
items.ex_en: Security forces moved rapidly to stamp out the rebellion across several provinces.
items.ex_zh: 安全部队迅速出动，彻底扑灭了数个省份的叛乱。

items.def_en: (+ sth) decisively put a stop to an objection, rebellion, or talk
items.ex_en: The chairman briskly shut down all further debate regarding the budget proposal.
items.ex_zh: 董事长干脆利落地制止了关于预算提案的一切进一步辩论。
items.ex2_en: The old electrical power plant shut down permanently after thirty productive years.
items.ex2_zh: 这座老旧的发电厂在运行了三十年后永久关闭了。

items.def_zh: 扼杀，彻底平息（谣言、计划等）
items.def_en: To decisively put an end to a rumor, fear, belief, or plan.
items.ex_en: The prime minister issued a statement to scotch persistent rumors of a reshuffle.
items.ex_zh: 首相发表声明以彻底平息有关内阁重组的持续谣言。

items.def_zh: 扼杀，压制；（使）窒息，（使）喘不上气
items.def_en: 1. To prevent something from happening, continuing, or developing; to suppress feelings or reactions. 2. To be unable to breathe freely, or prevent someone from breathing.
items.ex_en: Strict government regulations threatened to stifle innovation within the emerging tech sector.
items.ex_zh: 严格的政府监管可能扼杀新兴科技领域的创新。

items.def_en: to extinguish or suppress a flame, sentiment, or initiative by depriving it of oxygen or room to develop
items.ex_en: Authoritarian censors attempted to smother every spark of creative dissent in print.
items.ex_zh: 独裁审查机构企图扼杀出版物中一切带有创意的异见火苗。

items.def_en: to stop violent behavior, protest, or deep feelings using force or definitive authority
items.ex_en: Riot police were deployed to quell the violent unrest sweeping the capital.
items.ex_zh: 防暴警察被调派去平息席卷首都的暴力动乱。

items.def_en: to decisively use force to stop a rebellion, protest, or vigorously put an end to rumors
items.ex_en: Government officials moved quickly to quash malicious rumors about a banking collapse.
items.ex_zh: 政府官员迅速采取行动，强力平息有关银行倒闭的恶意谣言。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe forcibly suppressing, decisively crushing, or choking off dissent, rebellion, rumors, or fledgling ideas before they spread or fully develop.
groups.summary_zh: 果断压制或扼杀异见、叛乱、谣言或势头，防其蔓延成势。
groups.desc_en: Denotes forcefully suppressing an emergent rumor, unrest, or threat before it spreads uncontrollably, contrasting with negotiated settlement.
groups.desc_zh: 指在谣言、叛乱或威胁刚露头时采取强硬手段予以扑灭粉碎，区别于妥协或谈判。
groups.nuance_en: quell: pacifying a violent uprising or overwhelming panic (rebellion / riots / fears) · quash: authoritatively nullifying or suppressing something instantly (verdict / rumor / revolt) · nip in the bud: destroying a problem at its earliest inception (plot / trouble / crisis) · stifle: suffocating or holding down an expression or impulse (dissent / yawn / giggles) · scotch: conclusively disabling or putting an end to a false story (rumor / theory / speculation)
groups.nuance_zh: quell: 平息暴动或压制恐慌情绪 (rebellion / riots / fears) · quash: 权威性地撤销、平定或粉碎 (verdict / rumor / revolt) · nip in the bud: 防微杜渐，将隐患扼杀在萌芽状态 (plot / trouble / crisis) · stifle: 窒息并扼制声音或冲动 (dissent / yawn / giggles) · scotch: 彻底辟谣或击碎虚妄传言 (rumor / theory / speculation)

groups.name: Reinvigorate & Jumpstart · 赋能与重新激活 (Energize, Jumpstart, Vitalize)
groups.tip: 激发潜能注入充沛活力

items.def_zh: 赋予生命力；使活力充沛
items.def_en: to endow with life, vigor, or active vitality
items.ex_en: Dynamic civic leaders strove to vitalize the stagnant economy of the valley.
items.ex_zh: 充满活力的公民领袖努力使山谷停滞的经济重新焕发活力。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Make someone or something more lively, energetic, or interesting
items.ex_en: A cup of strong black coffee helped pep up the exhausted student.
items.ex_zh: 一杯浓黑咖啡让精疲力竭的学生振作了起来。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Make something more energetic, cheerful, or stimulating, or become more active
items.ex_en: Upbeat folk music helped liven up the rather quiet family dinner party.
items.ex_zh: 欢快的民间音乐让相当冷清的家庭晚宴活跃了起来。
items.ex2_en: The quiet wedding reception began to liven up after the lively music started.
items.ex2_zh: 欢快的音乐响起后，原本安静的婚宴开始热闹起来。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Become or cause someone or something to become more cheerful, active, or revived
items.ex_en: After a short afternoon nap, the children began to perk up noticeably.
items.ex_zh: 下午小睡之后，孩子们明显恢复了精神。
items.ex2_en: The pleasant morning sunshine will perk up those drooping flower blossoms outside.
items.ex2_zh: 宜人的晨光会使外面低垂的花朵重新焕发精神。

items.def_en: to restore energy, enthusiasm, or operational capability to
items.ex_en: A quiet weekend in the mountains allowed him to recharge his batteries.
items.ex_zh: 在山里度过一个宁静的周末让他重新充满精力。

items.def_zh: 激励，使精力充沛；供给能量，通电
items.def_en: 1. To give someone or something renewed energy, enthusiasm, or vitality. 2. To supply a device or circuit with electricity or power.
items.ex_en: Her passionate opening speech energised the volunteers for the demanding campaign ahead.
items.ex_zh: 她激情洋溢的开场演说激励了志愿者们投身艰巨的选战。

items.def_en: to give new energy or strength to someone or something
items.ex_en: Strategic foreign investments helped reinvigorate the nation's declining steel manufacturing industry.
items.ex_zh: 战略性外国投资帮助重振了该国正在衰退的钢铁制造业。

items.def_zh: 给……以生机，促进；用跨接引线启动（汽车等）
items.def_en: 1. To give an immediate boost to a stalled activity, economy, or process. 2. To start the engine of a vehicle with a flat battery using jumper cables connected to another battery.
items.ex_en: The chancellor announced major tax cuts to jumpstart the stalled national economy.
items.ex_zh: 财政大臣宣布重大减税政策以促进停滞的国民经济。

groups.summary_en: An agent or intervention imparts fresh vigor, dynamism, or sudden starting power into a flagging system, organization, process, or tired person.
groups.summary_zh: 指为停滞或疲态的系统、机构或机体注入新鲜活力与重启能量。
groups.desc_en: Denotes injecting fresh dynamism into a stalled, languid, or depleted entity to restore operation, contrasting with passive natural recovery.
groups.desc_zh: 指给停滞、倦怠或衰竭的客体注入强劲新动力以重启运转，区别于消极被动的自然恢复。
groups.nuance_en: reinvigorate: restoring vigorous energy and freshness (economy / campaign / debate) · jumpstart: giving rapid initial impetus to a stagnant process (negotiations / market / career) · energize: infusing dynamic vitality and enthusiasm into a group (base / crowd / team) · recharge: replenishing drained batteries, stamina, or resolve (batteries / mind / batteries) · vitalize: imbuing an inanimate system with living soul and purpose (democracy / prose / community)
groups.nuance_zh: reinvigorate: 赋予重新勃发的生命力与朝气 (economy / campaign / debate) · jumpstart: 采取强效措施快速启动停滞进程 (negotiations / market / career) · energize: 注入充沛活力并激发干劲 (base / crowd / team) · recharge: 蓄力充电以恢复精力或电量 (batteries / mind / batteries) · vitalize: 赋予无生气系统以生机与灵魂 (democracy / prose / community)

groups.name: Reiterate & Restate · 重申与反复陈述 (Reiterate, Iterate, Restate)
groups.tip: 为强调立场而再三重复声明

items.def_en: (+ sth) Repeat an idea, fact, or argument forcefully so that it cannot be misunderstood
items.ex_en: The public campaign aimed to hammer home the dangers of drunken driving.
items.ex_zh: 这项公益宣传活动旨在向公众反复强调酒后驾车的危险。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Explain something very clearly, explicitly, and in detail so there is no ambiguity
items.ex_en: You don't need to spell out every detail; we get the general idea.
items.ex_zh: 你不需要把每个细节都阐释得那么细，我们明白大意。

items.def_en: (+ sth into sb) Teach or emphasize something to someone through persistent, forceful repetition
items.ex_en: Our strict tutor drummed correct grammatical rules into us through daily exercises.
items.ex_zh: 我们严厉的家庭教师通过日常练习向我们反复灌输正确的语法规则。

items.def_en: (+ that) (formal) To repeat a statement, opinion, or demand several times for emphasis and clarity.
items.ex_en: The foreign minister reiterated that border negotiations would proceed without any delay.
items.ex_zh: 外交部长重申，边界谈判将毫不拖延地进行。

items.def_zh: 再次重申，坚定确认（立场、原则或承诺）
items.def_en: to state again with strong conviction that something is definitely true or valid
items.ex_en: The allied leaders met to reaffirm their mutual commitment to global peace.
items.ex_zh: 同盟国领袖会面，坚定重申他们对维护全球和平的共同承诺。

items.def_zh: 重申，重新表述（用稍有不同的措辞再次讲明）
items.def_en: to state something again or in a different way, especially to make the meaning clearer
items.ex_en: The professor had to restate his complex thesis using much simpler terminology.
items.ex_zh: 教授不得不使用简单得多的术语来重新阐明他复杂的论点。

items.def_en: 1. (formal) To repeat a statement or perform something again. 2. (computing) To repeat a process or series of steps in order to get closer to a desired result.
items.ex_en: The software engineer will iterate the underlying algorithm until performance criteria improve.
items.ex_zh: 软件工程师将不断迭代底层算法，直到性能指标改善。

items.def_zh: 过分冗长地反复强调（令人厌烦地絮叨）
items.def_en: to explain, repeat, or insist on something repeatedly or excessively
items.ex_en: There is no need to belabor the point since everyone already agrees.
items.ex_zh: 既然大家都已赞同，就无须在此过分唠叨强调这一点了。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate repeating an assertion, argument, or directive, usually to eliminate ambiguity, provide emphatic clarity, or guide sequential computation.
groups.summary_zh: 指为强调要点、消除误解而重申或多次陈述同一观点。
groups.desc_en: Denotes expressing an assertion repeatedly to ensure deep cognitive entrenchment and dispel ambiguity, contrasting with stating novel information.
groups.desc_zh: 指反复陈述已知主张以强化记忆并消除歧义，区别于初次阐述新信息。
groups.nuance_en: reiterate: repeating an opinion or demand firmly for clarity (commitment / stance / demand) · reaffirm: validating and confirming a pledge with renewed conviction (alliance / faith / support) · restate: expressing a premise again, often in clearer terms (policy / problem / case) · drum into: drilling a lesson obsessively through tedious repetition (heads / facts / rules) · hammer home: driving a key message into minds by sheer rhetorical force (point / message / truth)
groups.nuance_zh: reiterate: 为明晰立场而坚定重申 (commitment / stance / demand) · reaffirm: 再次确认并强化既有承诺或信念 (alliance / faith / support) · restate: 换个方式重新表述以更清晰 (policy / problem / case) · drum into: 填鸭式灌输以强行记诵 (heads / facts / rules) · hammer home: 强力灌输并将核心论点彻底讲透 (point / message / truth)

groups.name: Relinquish Official Office · 辞官解任与辞职退职 (Resign, Step Down, Demit)
groups.tip: 主动卸任职位或放弃

items.def_en: 1. To leave a job, school, or organization permanently. 2. To stop doing something or give up a habit.
items.ex_en: Disillusioned by corporate corruption, the senior director decided to quit his position.
items.ex_zh: 对企业腐败感到失望后，高级主管决定辞去职务。

items.def_en: 1. To voluntarily leave a job, office, or position. 2. (resign oneself to) To accept something undesirable as inevitable.
items.ex_en: The finance minister felt compelled to resign following allegations of serious misconduct.
items.ex_zh: 在受到严重不当行为的指控后，财政部长被迫引咎辞职。

items.def_en: to withdraw voluntarily from an important position or role to let someone else take over
items.ex_en: The CEO decided to step down after a decade of leading the corporation.
items.ex_zh: 执掌公司十年后，首席执行官决定引咎辞职。

items.def_en: to formally resign from a leadership post, witness stand, or public contest
items.ex_en: The CEO decided to stand down after the company's financial scandal was exposed.
items.ex_zh: 公司财务丑闻曝光后，首席执行官决定引咎辞职。

items.def_en: [I/T] to resign from or give up an office or position, especially in formal or academic contexts
items.ex_en: The distinguished dean will demit his academic office at the term's end.
items.ex_zh: 这位受人尊敬的院长将在学期末正式卸任其学术职务。

items.def_en: to withdraw from a prestigious role, competition, or public position gracefully
items.ex_en: After three decades in politics, the senator decided to bow out gracefully.
items.ex_zh: 在政坛打拼了三十年后，这位参议员决定体面退场。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to relinquish authority, duties, or a position of responsibility to someone else
items.ex_en: The outgoing governor agreed to hand over administrative authority next Monday morning.
items.ex_zh: 即将离任的州长同意在下周一上午移交行政权力。

items.def_en: [I/T] to renounce one's throne, supreme power, or major high-level responsibility formally
items.ex_en: Facing imminent public revolution, the elderly monarch decided to abdicate the throne.
items.ex_zh: 面临迫在眉睫的民众起义，年迈的君主决定宣布退位。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote formally giving up an official post, governance position, employment, or royal office, varying from formal institutional notifications to voluntary departures.
groups.summary_zh: 正式放弃职位、公职、王位或领导权并离开岗位的行为。
groups.desc_en: Denotes relinquishing an authoritative seat or title according to institutional procedure, contrasting with being summarily fired.
groups.desc_zh: 指依循既定制度程序主动脱卸官职或权力交接，区别于被单方面免职解雇。
groups.nuance_en: resign: formally surrendering an official office or job (post / directorship / seat) · step down: voluntarily leaving a high leadership post to make way (CEO / chairmanship / presidency) · abdicate: formally renouncing supreme monarchical sovereignty (throne / crown / responsibility) · demit: formally relinquishing an ecclesiastic or specialized office (office / ministry / charge) · bow out: gracefully withdrawing from public life or competition (race / contest / politics)
groups.nuance_zh: resign: 正式递交辞呈以解除公职 (post / directorship / seat) · step down: 主动让贤退下领导要职 (CEO / chairmanship / presidency) · abdicate: 依法正式退位让出国君大权 (throne / crown / responsibility) · demit: 卸任神职、学术或专有公职 (office / ministry / charge) · bow out: 体面隐退或退出角逐 (race / contest / politics)

groups.name: Repair & Mend · 修补与修整 (Patch, Darn, Cobble)
groups.tip: 弥补残缺修改瑕疵使其复原

items.def_zh: 修补，打补丁；拼凑；暂时解决
items.def_en: 1. To repair a hole, tear, or worn surface by sewing or gluing a patch over it. 2. (computing) To update or fix a program with a software patch.
items.ex_en: Frail memory could scarcely patch the tattered garments of his forgotten youth.
items.ex_zh: 脆弱的记忆已难以修补他那被遗忘的青春残破衣衫。

items.def_en: To put a new sole on a shoe or boot.
items.ex_en: The skilled craftsman promised to sole my favourite leather walking boots properly.
items.ex_zh: 熟练的工匠答应帮我把心爱的皮革徒步靴换好新鞋底。

items.def_zh: 修正，修订，改订；复习（功课）
items.def_en: 1. To re-examine and alter, improve, or correct a text, plan, or opinion. 2. (chiefly British English) To review notes or books in preparation for an exam.
items.ex_en: The committee met frequently to revise outdated safety regulations across the facility.
items.ex_zh: 委员会频繁开会，以修订设施内各项过时的安全规章。

items.def_en: repair something damaged quickly, temporarily, or haphazardly
items.ex_en: He used some duct tape to patch up the leaking plastic pipe.
items.ex_zh: 他用一些绝缘胶带草草修补了那根漏水的塑料管。

items.def_en: (+ sth) quickly produce, assemble, or repair something using whatever parts or materials are available
items.ex_en: They had to cobble together a temporary shelter using scrap metal sheets.
items.ex_zh: 他们不得不使用废金属板拼凑修补出一个临时的遮蔽所。

items.def_en: (+ sth) join the broken or torn parts of an object back together
items.ex_en: She patiently managed to piece together the shattered pieces of the porcelain.
items.ex_zh: 她耐心地把破碎的瓷器碎片拼合完整。

items.def_en: mend a hole in knitted or woven fabric by weaving yarn across it
items.ex_en: Grandmother taught me how to darn small holes in thick woollen socks.
items.ex_zh: 祖母教我如何织补厚羊毛袜上的小破洞。

items.def_en: repair shoes or rough footwear as a shoemaker
items.ex_en: The elderly village shoemaker continues to cobble worn boots in his workshop.
items.ex_zh: 这位年迈的乡村鞋匠继续在他的作坊里修补破旧的靴子。

groups.summary_en: Craftsmen or owners fix damaged, torn, or worn items by affixing material, replacing specific parts, or tailoring structural components.
groups.summary_zh: 为磨损破损的衣物、鞋履或器物贴上补丁、换底或予以缝补修复。
groups.desc_en: Denotes piecing together or patching torn fabric, leather, or improvised structures, contrasting with comprehensive industrial overhaul.
groups.desc_zh: 指对破损织物、皮革或临时结构实施局部缝缀拼接，区别于工业化的整体翻新。
groups.nuance_en: patch: sewing or bonding material over a hole or defect (trousers / tire / software) · darn: weaving yarn over holes in knitted cloth (socks / sweater / hole) · cobble together: quickly putting disparate parts together crudely (coalition / agreement / plan) · piece together: assembling scattered fragments into a coherent whole (clues / mosaic / narrative) · sole: replacing the bottom leather or rubber of footwear (shoes / boots / footwear)
groups.nuance_zh: patch: 打补丁覆盖破损处或修复代码 (trousers / tire / software) · darn: 经纬织补毛织物破洞 (socks / sweater / hole) · cobble together: 仓促拼凑简陋拼合 (coalition / agreement / plan) · piece together: 将零散碎片拼接整合复原 (clues / mosaic / narrative) · sole: 为鞋靴换上新鞋底 (shoes / boots / footwear)

groups.name: Repair & Restore · 修复与复原 (Repair, Restore, Recondition)
groups.tip: 修整破损使旧物重返原貌

items.def_zh: 修理，修补；补救，修复（关系、名誉等）；（formal）前往，去往（repair to）
items.def_en: 1. To mend or fix something broken, damaged, or torn. 2. To remedy or put right an unwelcome situation or damaged relationship. 3. (formal) (+ to) To go to a particular place.
items.ex_en: Diplomats worked tirelessly through the night to repair strained relations between countries.
items.ex_zh: 外交官们通宵达旦地不知疲倦工作，以修复两国之间的紧张关系。

items.def_zh: 修复，整修（建筑物、艺术品等）；恢复，使复原；归还
items.def_en: 1. To repair or renovate a building, work of art, or object to return it to its original condition. 2. To bring back a former condition, feeling, or state of affairs. 3. (formal) To return something lost or stolen to its owner.
items.ex_en: The museum hired expert conservators to restore the damaged sixteenth-century oil painting.
items.ex_zh: 博物馆聘请了专家级文物保护人员来修复那幅受损的十六世纪油画。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Repair, renovate, or redecorate an old building, car, or other damaged item
items.ex_en: They bought an old stone cottage in the countryside to do up.
items.ex_zh: 他们在乡下买了一栋旧石屋打算翻修一番。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Repair or mend something quickly, temporarily, or by fixing damaged spots
items.ex_en: The landlord quickly patched up the leaking roof with some cheap tar.
items.ex_zh: 房东用一些廉价沥青草草修补了漏水的屋顶。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Repair, clean up, or restore something damaged or worn to sound condition
items.ex_en: We spent all weekend fixing up the old wooden shed behind the garden.
items.ex_zh: 我们花了整个周末整修花园后面的旧木棚。

items.def_en: to restore a building, room, or structure to a good state of repair
items.ex_en: The university allocated substantial funds to renovate the historic library building this year.
items.ex_zh: 大学今年拨出巨额资金，用于翻修具有历史意义的图书馆大楼。

items.def_en: to clean, decorate, and repair an old building or piece of equipment to look new
items.ex_en: The company invested millions of dollars to refurbish its downtown corporate headquarters.
items.ex_zh: 公司投资数百万美元整修了位于市中心的公司总部大楼。

items.def_en: to repair and thoroughly overhaul an engine or machine so that it is in good working condition
items.ex_en: The certified technician agreed to recondition the vintage tractor engine for heavy work.
items.ex_zh: 具有资质的技术员同意对老式拖拉机发动机进行大修翻新以供重载使用。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on returning a damaged, worn, or aging physical object, ecosystem, or condition back to sound working order or its pristine original state.
groups.summary_zh: 指使损坏、磨损或老化的物品、建筑或系统恢复到健全状态或初始原貌。
groups.desc_en: Denotes returning an aged, damaged, or decayed building or valuable asset to its pristine historic condition, contrasting with superficial cleaning.
groups.desc_zh: 指将老化、受损或衰败的建筑或贵重资产恢复至历史原有品相，区别于表面抹擦。
groups.nuance_en: restore: bringing an art piece or historical monument to original state (painting / church / sanity) · renovate: modernizing and structurally upgrading older buildings (kitchen / warehouse / house) · refurbish: redecorating, repainting, and cosmetically renewing interiors (hotel / offices / apartment) · recondition: overhauling and certifying used machinery to sound state (engine / equipment / vehicle) · patch up: makeshift or hasty cosmetic repairing (crack / wall / quarrel)
groups.nuance_zh: restore: 将文物或古迹恢复原状 (painting / church / sanity) · renovate: 对旧建筑进行结构升级翻新 (kitchen / warehouse / house) · refurbish: 重新装修粉刷使内部焕然一新 (hotel / offices / apartment) · recondition: 全面检修认证二手机械以恢复工况 (engine / equipment / vehicle) · patch up: 权宜修补或暂时化解争执 (crack / wall / quarrel)

groups.name: Reproduce & Reenact · 翻版与重现 (Reenact, Recreate, Replay)
groups.tip: 照样复刻，再次呈现原貌

items.def_en: (+ sth) listen to or watch a sound or video recording that has just been made
items.ex_en: The detective played back the surveillance video to catch any missed details.
items.ex_zh: 侦探回放了监控录像，以捕捉任何遗漏的细节。

items.def_en: (+ sth) perform the actions and dialogue of an event or story
items.ex_en: The drama students gathered on the lawn to act out famous historical events.
items.ex_zh: 戏剧系的学生们聚集在草坪上，将著名的历史事件表演出来。

items.def_zh: 重放，重演（录像、赛事或回忆）
items.def_en: to play a recording, sporting sequence, or scene again, or to experience an event anew in memory
items.ex_en: The broadcast technicians decided to replay the decisive goal in super slow motion.
items.ex_zh: 转播技术人员决定用超慢动作重放那个决定胜负的进球。

items.def_zh: 复写，复印；使增多，使多样化
items.def_en: 1. (dated) To make multiple copies of a document. 2. To multiply or make manifold.
items.ex_en: A subtle sorrow seemed to manifold the deeper shades of her twilight musings.
items.ex_zh: 一种淡淡的忧伤似乎使她在暮色中的幽思更加深沉多重。

items.def_zh: 重现，再造（昔日场景或体验）
items.def_en: to reproduce or bring back the conditions, atmosphere, or appearance of a previous era or event
items.ex_en: The living museum strives to recreate the authentic atmosphere of an eighteenth-century village.
items.ex_zh: 这座活态博物馆力图重现十八世纪村庄的真实风貌。

items.def_zh: 重演（角色）；重奏，重复（乐段、歌曲等）
items.def_en: (US variant of reprise) To repeat a song, musical passage, or performance, or replay a particular dramatic role.
items.ex_en: The acclaimed actress returned to reprize her iconic role on Broadway this winter.
items.ex_zh: 这位备受赞誉的女演员今年冬天重返百老汇，再次饰演她的标志性角色。

items.def_zh: 重播，重映（节目、电影）；重新进行（比赛、选举等）
items.def_en: To broadcast a television programme or film again; to run a race, election, or test again.
items.ex_en: The sports network decided to rerun the thrilling championship match yesterday evening.
items.ex_zh: 体育网络频道昨晚决定重播那场扣人心弦的冠军争夺赛。

items.def_zh: 重演，再现（历史事件或罪案现场）
items.def_en: to act out a past event, historical battle, or crime scene again in a formal or theatrical manner
items.ex_en: Local historians and volunteers gathered in costume to reenact the decisive civil battle.
items.ex_zh: 当地历史学者和志愿者身着服装齐聚一堂，重新演绎了那场决定性的国内战役。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe reproducing, repeating, or performing again a prior event, artistic performance, broadcast, or document to capture or demonstrate its original form. They contrast mechanical multiple-copy creation with dramatic or chronological recreation and rerun.
groups.summary_zh: 以翻印、重播、重演等方式再次呈现先前的事件、作品或文稿。
groups.desc_en: Denotes recreating, re-performing, or reproducing a past event or dramatic performance faithfully, contrasting with inventing an entirely novel scene.
groups.desc_zh: 指对过去发生过的真实历史事件或艺术演出进行真实复现或演练，区别于原创全新场景。
groups.nuance_en: reenact: performing past historical events in authentic detail (battle / crime / history) · replay: running a recording or mental sequence again (tape / incident / game) · recreate: constructing an accurate likeness of an extinct or past scene (scene / atmosphere / past) · act out: physicalizing an inner emotional narrative or script (fantasies / drama / frustration) · rerun: rebroadcasting an entertainment program or re-executing (series / election / experiment)
groups.nuance_zh: reenact: 现场情景再现或模拟历史事件 (battle / crime / history) · replay: 重播录像或在脑海反复复盘 (tape / incident / game) · recreate: 依样复原重造过去的场景氛围 (scene / atmosphere / past) · act out: 将心理戏或剧本付诸肢体表演 (fantasies / drama / frustration) · rerun: 重播剧集或重新进行推演选举 (series / election / experiment)

groups.name: Respire & Emit Strained Breath · 呼气与喘鸣 (Exhale, Wheeze, Gasp)
groups.tip: 呼气与粗重喘息的声音

items.def_en: (+ sth) Expel air from the lungs; exhale
items.ex_en: Relax your shoulders and breathe out slowly through your mouth.
items.ex_zh: 放松肩膀，通过嘴巴缓缓呼气。

items.def_en: to breathe in short, rapid gasps from physical exertion
items.ex_en: He began to puff loudly after carrying the heavy boxes up three flights.
items.ex_zh: 把沉重的箱子搬上三层楼后，他开始大口呼呼喘气。

items.def_en: to breathe out air, smoke, or vapor from the lungs
items.ex_en: Close your eyes, take a deep breath, and then slowly exhale the air.
items.ex_zh: 闭上眼睛，深深吸一口气，然后慢慢把气呼出。

items.def_en: Breathe hard and audibly with labored, rapid exhalations due to heavy exertion
items.ex_en: The cyclist puffed away with intense effort as she climbed the steep incline.
items.ex_zh: 那位骑车人吃力地爬上陡峭的斜坡，呼哧呼哧直喘粗气。

items.def_en: to breathe quickly and loudly through the mouth, as after strenuous physical exercise
items.ex_en: The tired dog lay on the porch, panting heavily in the summer heat.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的狗趴在门廊上，在盛夏的酷热中大口大口喘着粗气。

items.def_zh: 喘息，发出哮鸣声呼吸；喘息着说
items.def_en: to breathe with difficulty and with a whistling, rattling sound, especially due to a chest illness
items.ex_en: Suffering from severe seasonal asthma, the elderly patient began to wheeze after walking.
items.ex_zh: 由于患有严重的季节性哮喘，这位老病人在走动后开始哮鸣喘息。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Say something with great difficulty while struggling to breathe or panting
items.ex_en: Collapsing onto the bench, the exhausted messenger gasped out the urgent warning.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫不堪的信使瘫倒在长椅上，上气不接下气地说出了紧急警告。

items.def_zh: 倒抽气，因窒息/惊恐而倒吸冷气
items.def_en: (+ for) to inhale suddenly and sharply with an open mouth, usually due to pain, shock, or lack of air
items.ex_en: The injured diver surfaced suddenly, gasping for air after the long, frantic swim.
items.ex_zh: 受伤的潜水员在经过漫长而慌乱的游动后突然浮出水面，大口倒抽着空气。

groups.summary_en: A person expels air or breathes with difficulty, producing audible, labored, or involuntary sounds due to physical exertion, obstruction, or distress.
groups.summary_zh: 排出体内气体，或因气道狭窄、疲劳而发出沉重粗重的喘息声。
groups.desc_en: Denotes releasing respiratory breath with audible aerodynamic struggle, contrasting with silent, unlabored breathing.
groups.desc_zh: 指因呼吸道受阻或体力透支而发出带有杂音的困难呼气，区别于平稳无声的正常呼吸。
groups.nuance_en: exhale: breathing air outward from lungs voluntarily (smoke / breath / sigh) · gasp: suddenly catching breath sharply due to shock or oxygen deficit (air / astonishment / pain) · pant: breathing rapidly and shallowly after intense exertion (dog / athlete / runner) · wheeze: breathing with a continuous whistling, raspy sound (chest / patient / asthmatic) · puff: blowing out quick, short bursts of breath or smoke (pipe / cigarette / breath)
groups.nuance_zh: exhale: 将肺部气体自主呼出 (smoke / breath / sigh) · gasp: 因休克、剧痛或缺氧猛然倒抽一口凉气 (air / astonishment / pain) · pant: 剧烈运动后急促短浅地喘息 (dog / athlete / runner) · wheeze: 气道狭窄呼吸时发出哮喘哨鸣音 (chest / patient / asthmatic) · puff: 一股股短促喷吐气息或烟雾 (pipe / cigarette / breath)

groups.name: Respond & React · 反应与回应 (Respond, React, Rejoin)
groups.tip: 对外界言行给出及时的反应

items.def_zh: 回答，答复；做出反应，响应
items.def_en: 1. To say, write, or do something as an answer, reaction, or reply.
items.ex_en: The press secretary promised to respond promptly to all media inquiries tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 新闻秘书承诺将于明天上午对所有媒体质询迅速作出答复。

items.def_en: [I/T] to respond in opposition or defense to an argument or action
items.ex_en: The defense attorney immediately countered the prosecutor's claims with solid photographic evidence.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师立即出示确凿的照片证据反驳了检察官的主张。

items.def_zh: 做出反应，回应；起化学反应；起不良反应
items.def_en: 1. To act or change in response to an event, situation, or stimulus. 2. (chemistry) To undergo a chemical change.
items.ex_en: His sensitive soul reacted with profound grief to the sight of such injustice.
items.ex_zh: 目睹如此不公的景象，他那敏感的心灵泛起了深切的悲凉。

items.def_en: (+ at sb) Criticize, retaliate, or respond forcefully to an attack or accusation
items.ex_en: The mayor decided to hit back at his political rivals during the interview.
items.ex_zh: 市长决定在采访中对政敌的指责予以强力反击。

items.def_en: (+ at sb) Respond or retaliate aggressively against an opponent or criticism
items.ex_en: The company struck back at its competitors by slashing prices across the board.
items.ex_zh: 该企业通过全线大幅降价对竞争对手发起了回击。

items.def_en: (+ sb) Reply impudently or defend oneself sharply against criticism
items.ex_en: Don't answer back when your teacher is giving you advice.
items.ex_zh: 老师给你提建议时不要顶嘴。

items.def_en: [I/T] to give a quick, witty, or sharp verbal response to a statement
items.ex_en: She promptly rejoined that her previous statements had been entirely accurate and justified.
items.ex_zh: 她随即反驳称，自己先前的陈述完全准确且合情合理。

items.def_en: [I/T] to answer a remark quickly, sharply, or aggressively
items.ex_en: He sharply retorted that nobody had asked for their unsolicited financial advice anyway.
items.ex_zh: 他尖刻地反唇相讥，说反正也没人向他们征求过那些不请自来的财务建议。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this broad behavioral and communicational frame describe acting, moving, or communicating in direct consequence of an external stimulus, utterance, or event.
groups.summary_zh: 受到外界刺激、局势变化或话语影响后作出动作或言语反应。
groups.desc_en: Denotes providing an immediate intellectual, defensive, or communicative return to an external action or stimulus, contrasting with initiating unprompted action.
groups.desc_zh: 指对外部刺激、挑衅或提问做出即刻的智力反击或沟通反馈，区别于自发的主动行为。
groups.nuance_en: respond: replying formally or acting constructively to an impulse (letter / treatment / stimulus) · react: producing an immediate involuntary physical or emotional response (shock / news / insult) · retort: delivering a sharp, witty, or combative answer instantly (critic / accusation / compliment) · rejoin: offering a formal or sarcastic reply to a charge (criticism / claim / debate) · strike back: executing a retaliatory defensive attack (competitor / assailant / regime)
groups.nuance_zh: respond: 作出理性正式的答复或产生治疗反应 (letter / treatment / stimulus) · react: 对外界变故作出即时本能反应 (shock / news / insult) · retort: 机敏、尖锐或反唇相讥地回怼 (critic / accusation / compliment) · rejoin: 针对指责提出正式反驳 (criticism / claim / debate) · strike back: 展开防卫性反击报复 (competitor / assailant / regime)

groups.name: Restore Mechanical Function · 检修与修缮 (Repair, Overhaul, Mend)
groups.tip: 彻底检修或修补磨损部件

items.def_en: to carry out regular maintenance or repairs on an engine, vehicle, or appliance
items.ex_en: You ought to service your vehicle regularly to maintain its long-term safety.
items.ex_zh: 你应该定期保养检修你的车辆，以保持其长期的安全性。

items.def_en: to restore damaged, faulty, or worn machinery or objects to good working condition
items.ex_en: Technicians worked through the night to repair the plant's main hydraulic generator.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员通宵达旦地工作，以检修工厂的主水压发电机。

items.def_en: to repair something quickly or temporarily, often roughly
items.ex_en: He quickly patched up the old bicycle chain with some spare metal links.
items.ex_zh: 他用几节备用金属链环临时拼凑修补了这条旧自行车链条。

items.def_en: (+ sth) repair, recondition, or improve the physical condition of a mechanism, room, or vehicle
items.ex_en: The mechanic promised to fix up the broken lawnmower before the weekend arrived.
items.ex_zh: 机械师答应在周末到来之前把那台坏掉的割草机修整好。

items.def_zh: 调试，检修（发动机或机械）
items.def_en: (+ sth) adjust an engine or machine so that it runs smoothly and efficiently
items.ex_en: The mechanic took two hours to tune up the race car's high-performance engine.
items.ex_zh: 机械师花了两个小时调试那辆赛车的高性能发动机。

items.def_zh: 彻底检修，大修；全面改革，彻底革新；赶上，超过
items.def_en: 1. To examine and repair a machine, engine, or system thoroughly. 2. To reform or restructure a system completely. 3. (chiefly British) To overtake someone in a race or contest.
items.ex_en: The airline decided to completely overhaul the aircraft engines before resuming international service.
items.ex_zh: 该航空公司决定在恢复国际航线之前对飞机发动机进行彻底大修。

items.def_zh: 修理，缝补；愈合，痊愈；改善
items.def_en: 1. To repair something that is broken, torn, or damaged. 2. (of a bone or wound) To heal or become sound again.
items.ex_en: The local cobbler used traditional tools to mend the worker's leather boot.
items.ex_zh: 当地的鞋匠用传统工具修理那位工人的皮靴。
items.ex2_en: His broken leg bone began to mend remarkably well after the surgery.
items.ex2_zh: 手术后，他骨折的腿骨开始愈合得非常好。

items.def_en: to overhaul and repair a machine or component so that it is in like-new working condition
items.ex_en: The engineering plant can recondition heavy industrial valves to meet modern specifications.
items.ex_zh: 这家工程制造厂能够翻新重工业阀门，使其达到现代规格标准。

groups.summary_en: This scenario covers inspecting, servicing, and fixing mechanical systems, tools, garments, or structures that are worn or broken. 'Mend' suits small, domestic, or fabric repairs; 'overhaul' denotes dismantling and extensively reconditioning complex machinery or systems.
groups.summary_zh: 针对损坏或磨损之机械、器具进行小修、补缀或全面大修。
groups.desc_en: Denotes diagnosing, fixing, and maintaining mechanical or technical apparatus to ensure operational integrity, contrasting with aesthetic decoration.
groups.desc_zh: 指对机械或技术系统进行系统排查、修复与维护以保障运转安全，区别于纯视觉装潢。
groups.nuance_en: service: carrying out regular routine maintenance on a vehicle or device (boiler / car / engine) · overhaul: dismantling, thoroughly inspecting, and fully rebuilding machinery (engine / system / bureaucracy) · tune up: making minor adjustments to optimize engine efficiency (engine / carburetor / system) · repair: fixing a specifically damaged or dysfunctional mechanism (brakes / pump / gear) · mend: restoring a tear, fractured part, or minor mechanical break (fence / watch / net)
groups.nuance_zh: service: 按期对车辆或设备进行常规保养 (boiler / car / engine) · overhaul: 彻底拆解排查并全面大修机器 (engine / system / bureaucracy) · tune up: 调校机械微调以达最佳工况 (engine / carburetor / system) · repair: 修理特定损坏失效的机械部件 (brakes / pump / gear) · mend: 修复裂痕、轻微断裂或破损小件 (fence / watch / net)

groups.name: Restrict & Restrain · 节制与抑制 (Restrict, Restrain, Curb)
groups.tip: 压制冲动势头加以有效控制

items.def_en: to put a limit on the amount, size, or range of something
items.ex_en: The municipal council agreed to restrict heavy vehicle traffic within the city center.
items.ex_zh: 市政委员会同意限制重型车辆在市中心通行的数量与范围。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Prevent someone or something from moving forward, developing, or acting freely
items.ex_en: Persistent financial hardship continued to hold back the promising student from higher education.
items.ex_zh: 持续的经济困难继续阻碍着这位有前途的学生去接受高等教育。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Control or limit the size, cost, number, or freedom of something
items.ex_en: The government adopted strict fiscal measures to keep down the rising consumer prices.
items.ex_zh: 政府采取了严格的财政措施来抑制不断上涨的消费品价格。

items.def_en: to control or limit something that has developed too far or too fast
items.ex_en: The central board had to rein in the department's excessive project expenditure.
items.ex_zh: 中央董事会不得不对该部门过度的项目开支加以严格控制。

items.def_en: 1. To control, limit, or restrain something harmful or unwanted, such as inflation or anger.
items.ex_en: The monetary authorities raised interest rates sharply to curb rapidly mounting inflationary pressure.
items.ex_zh: 货币当局大幅提高利率以抑制迅速上升的通胀压力。

items.def_zh: 制止，管束；抑制，克制（情绪或行为）
items.def_en: 1. (+ from) To stop someone from doing something physically, or to control a strong feeling or urge.
items.ex_en: Security officers moved quickly forward to restrain the furious spectator from entering the arena.
items.ex_zh: 安保人员迅速上前制止那位狂怒的观众进入比赛场地。

items.def_en: (+ on sb/sth) Take strict and firm legal or official measures to suppress or restrict an activity
items.ex_en: Federal authorities announced decisive plans to clamp down on unauthorized offshore banking activities.
items.ex_zh: 联邦当局宣布了严厉取缔离岸非法银行业务的果断计划。

items.def_en: to limit or restrict someone's freedom or scope of action
items.ex_en: Severe budgetary limits inevitably constrain the agency's ability to hire skilled technical personnel.
items.ex_zh: 严峻的预算限制不可避免地约束了该机构聘用专业技术人才的能力。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote checking, controlling, or holding back actions, impulses, or growth, progressing from mild checks to firm physical or formal control.
groups.summary_zh: 控管或压制动作、冲动及发展，从约束到强力遏止。
groups.desc_en: Denotes deliberately applying regulatory, punitive, or physical boundaries to suppress explosive expansion, contrasting with laissez-faire permission.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过法规、外力或戒律强行施加约束以压制其肆意扩张，区别于放任自流。
groups.nuance_en: restrain: physically or legally holding someone back from immediate action (suspect / tears / impulses) · restrict: confining within defined boundaries or statutory quotas (movement / imports / access) · curb: checking or holding back an undesirable escalation (inflation / spending / emissions) · rein in: pulling tightly on the reins to control runaway excess (spending / budget / ambition) · clamp down: enforcing strict, authoritarian suppression of unwanted activities (corruption / dissent / protests)
groups.nuance_zh: restrain: 施加外力或法律手段遏制即刻行动 (suspect / tears / impulses) · restrict: 在法定限额或空间范围内划界限流 (movement / imports / access) · curb: 勒住缰绳般抑制恶性势头发展 (inflation / spending / emissions) · rein in: 收紧开支或控制失控野心 (spending / budget / ambition) · clamp down: 采取强硬高压手段严打取缔违规行为 (corruption / dissent / protests)

groups.name: Revere & Venerate · 崇敬与敬仰 (Reverence, Worship, Adoration)
groups.tip: 由赞叹钦佩升华为敬畏膜拜

items.def_en: to admire deeply because of abilities, qualities, or status
items.ex_en: We all deeply respect her remarkable dedication to serving vulnerable community members.
items.ex_zh: 我们都由衷地敬重她为服务弱势社区群体所付出的卓越心血。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to admire and have a great deal of respect for someone
items.ex_en: Young athletes around the world look up to her as an inspirational leader.
items.ex_zh: 全世界的年轻运动员都视她为鼓舞人心的榜样并敬佩她。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to show deep reverence, submission, or worship toward someone or something
items.ex_en: The rebels refused to bow down to the authoritarian regime.
items.ex_zh: 叛军拒绝向独裁政权低头屈服。

items.def_en: (often passive) To fill someone with deep respect, wonder, or admiration mixed with fear.
items.ex_en: The towering majesty of the ancient cathedral never failed to awe weary pilgrims.
items.ex_zh: 古老大教堂高耸庄严的气势无不令疲惫的朝圣者肃然起敬。

items.def_en: to feel deep respect, love, and awe for someone or something
items.ex_en: Generations of scholars continue to revere the great philosopher for his enduring wisdom.
items.ex_zh: 世世代代的学者依然因其永恒的智慧而由衷崇敬这位伟大的哲学家。

items.def_zh: 把……当偶像崇拜，盲目敬仰
items.def_en: to admire and revere someone excessively or unreservedly
items.ex_en: Young aspiring musicians often idolize famous rock stars without seeing their personal flaws.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的抱负音乐人常常把著名摇滚明星奉为偶像盲目崇拜，却忽视了后者的个人缺点。

items.def_en: to deeply respect, honor, and revere someone or something, especially because of age, wisdom, or sacredness
items.ex_en: Many cultures traditionally venerate their ancestors through formal rites and quiet domestic offerings.
items.ex_zh: 许多文化历来通过正式仪式和在家中祭拜来崇敬祖先。

items.def_zh: 崇拜，敬奉（神明或极度崇敬之人）
items.def_en: to show reverence and adoration for a deity or treat someone with supreme devotion
items.ex_en: Devout pilgrims travel great distances across rough terrain to worship at the holy shrine.
items.ex_zh: 虔诚的朝圣者跋山涉水穿越险峻地带，前往圣地神龛敬奉参拜。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures feelings and acts of profound respect, awe, and veneration toward people, deities, or institutions viewed as sacred or morally elevated. Intensity scales from standard deep respect to profound spiritual or religious adoration.
groups.summary_zh: 表达对神圣、长者或崇高事物从敬重、敬畏到顶礼膜拜的情感梯度。
groups.desc_en: Denotes regarding an entity with deep deference, devotion, or awe, escalating from civil deference to religious deification rather than merely liking or approving.
groups.desc_zh: 指怀着敬重、虔诚或敬畏之情对待某主体，语义从世俗的敬重逐步升级为宗教般的神化崇拜，而非单纯的喜欢或赞同。
groups.nuance_en: respect: basic civil esteem or fair consideration (authority / elder / opinion) · revere: profound spiritual or solemn deference (memory / master / traditions) · venerate: ritualized, age-hallowed reverence (saint / relic / antiquity) · idolize: uncritical romanticized adoration (celebrity / hero / parent) · worship: religious adoration or total submission (deity / altar / money)
groups.nuance_zh: respect: 基础而理性的尊重或顾及 (authority / elder / opinion) · revere: 深沉庄严的崇敬 (memory / master / traditions) · venerate: 敬仰具有神圣或历史厚重感的人事物 (saint / relic / antiquity) · idolize: 盲目崇拜或偶像化 (celebrity / hero / parent) · worship: 顶礼膜拜与宗教式狂热 (deity / altar / money)

groups.name: Revise & Redact · 修订与改写 (Rework, Redact, Revise)
groups.tip: 校正文本，重新润色修改

items.def_zh: 润色；微调修改（文本或艺术作品）
items.def_en: (+ sth) make small revisions or improvements to a piece of writing or artwork
items.ex_en: She spent a few minutes touching up her makeup before the live broadcast.
items.ex_zh: 在直播开始前，她花了几分钟补了补妆。

items.def_zh: 重写；在原稿上覆写修改
items.def_en: (+ sth) rewrite text or record over existing material to revise or replace it
items.ex_en: Be careful not to write over the original draft stored in the folder.
items.ex_zh: 小心不要将保存在文件夹中的原稿覆盖重写了。

items.def_en: [I/T] to examine and correct, update, or improve a text, book, or plan
items.ex_en: The committee met yesterday to revise the draft regulations before their final release.
items.ex_zh: 委员会昨天召开会议，在最终发布之前修订规章草案。

items.def_zh: 涂黑遮盖（以隐去敏感文本）；涂抹审查
items.def_en: (+ sth) obscure or redact words in a document by covering them with black ink
items.ex_en: He blacked out for a few seconds after hitting his head on the doorframe.
items.ex_zh: 他的头撞在门框上后昏厥了数秒。

items.def_en: to change the words of a formal document, law, or contract in order to correct or improve it
items.ex_en: Lawmakers convened to formally amend the constitutional provisions regarding executive presidential emergency powers.
items.ex_zh: 立法者开会正式修正涉及总统行政紧急权力的宪法条款。

items.def_zh: 修改，修订；重做，重新加工
items.def_en: To revise, rewrite, or reshape a piece of writing, music, or material to improve it.
items.ex_en: The young composer decided to rework the final movement of his first symphony.
items.ex_zh: 这位青年作曲家决定重写他第一交响曲的末乐章。

items.def_zh: 修订，编辑（尤指删去或遮盖敏感、机密信息）；起草，编写
items.def_en: To edit a text for publication, especially by removing or blacking out sensitive or confidential information.
items.ex_en: The intelligence agency chose to redact several sensitive passages before releasing the memo.
items.ex_zh: 情报机构在公开这份备忘录之前，决定对其中的几处敏感段落做涂黑遮蔽处理。

items.def_en: [I/T] to write something again in a substantially altered form to improve clarity or style
items.ex_en: The editor advised the author to rewrite the entire opening chapter for clarity.
items.ex_zh: 编辑建议作者为了清晰起见，把整个开篇第一章重写一遍。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame characterize modifying written texts, legal documents, or creative materials by editing, censoring, rewriting passages, or adapting structure.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过删改、审查屏蔽或大幅重新构思，对文本、法案或作品进行改动修订。
groups.desc_en: Involves altering, adjusting, or censoring written or creative content to improve, adapt, or conceal it, distinguished from initial writing or passive proofreading.
groups.desc_zh: 指对文本或创作内容进行修改、润色或审查以实现改善、适配或隐匿，区别于初次创作或单纯校对。
groups.nuance_en: revise: systematic modification to improve clarity or accuracy (manuscript / policy / textbook) · amend: formal legal modification by addition or subtraction (constitution / contract / law) · rework: extensive structural restructuring or refining (script / proposal / design) · redact: selective blacking out or excision of sensitive data (document / file / names) · rewrite: complete compositional overhaul (draft / scene / code)
groups.nuance_zh: revise: 系统性修改以提升准确度或质量 (manuscript / policy / textbook) · amend: 法律或规约的正式修正与补充 (constitution / contract / law) · rework: 深度结构性重做与打磨 (script / proposal / design) · redact: 审查性涂黑或删改敏感信息 (document / file / names) · rewrite: 推倒重写或大幅改头换面 (draft / scene / code)

groups.name: Revive & Rejuvenate · 复元与焕活 (Revive, Rejuvenate, Revitalize)
groups.tip: 重新焕发青春，复苏往日活力

items.def_zh: 使精神振作，使恢复精力
items.def_en: to give new strength or energy to someone who is tired or hot
items.ex_en: The cool mountain water seemed to refresh his wearied spirit and travel-worn limbs.
items.ex_zh: 清凉的山泉水仿佛让他疲惫的心神和风尘仆仆的四肢重新焕发了活力。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) become more active, energetic, or cheerful, or cause someone to feel this way
items.ex_en: A cup of hot black coffee always helps me perk up each morning.
items.ex_zh: 一杯热黑咖啡总能帮我每天早晨振作起精神来。
items.ex2_en: The drooping indoor houseplant perked up immediately after receiving fresh water.
items.ex2_zh: 萎靡的室内绿植浇了新鲜的水后立刻挺立了起来。

items.def_en: [I/T] to become, or make someone become, conscious, healthy, or active again
items.ex_en: A sip of cold water helped revive the fainting runner during the marathon.
items.ex_zh: 在马拉松比赛中，喝了一口凉水帮助那位晕厥的跑者苏醒了过来。
items.ex2_en: The ancient cultural tradition slowly revived among the younger generation of villagers.
items.ex2_zh: 这一古老的文化传统在年轻一代村民中慢慢复兴。

items.def_en: quickly recover health, energy, or success after an illness or setback
items.ex_en: The resilient local economy managed to bounce back quickly after the devastating financial crisis.
items.ex_zh: 极具韧性的当地经济在毁灭性的金融危机之后迅速恢复了元气。

items.def_en: (+ sb) restore someone to consciousness or revive someone from faintness
items.ex_en: The paramedics used smelling salts to bring round the unconscious victim at once.
items.ex_zh: 医护人员立刻使用嗅盐使昏迷的受害者苏醒了过来。

items.def_zh: 使恢复元气，使复苏，使重获新生
items.def_en: To give new life, energy, vitality, or success to something that has become weak or inactive.
items.ex_en: The council launched ambitious development projects to revitalize the decaying historic urban waterfront.
items.ex_zh: 市政会启动了雄心勃勃的开发项目，以使日渐衰落的历史滨水区重获新生。

items.def_zh: 使恢复活力，使焕发青春；使重获新生
items.def_en: To make someone look or feel younger and more energetic, or to make an organization or system more effective and lively again.
items.ex_en: The comprehensive restructuring plan was designed to rejuvenate the stagnant manufacturing company.
items.ex_zh: 这项全面的重组计划旨在让这家停滞不前的制造企业重新焕发活力。

items.def_en: to give life, energy, and strength to someone or something
items.ex_en: A brisk morning walk along the scenic coast will invigorate your tired mind.
items.ex_zh: 沿着风景优美的海岸快步晨走，会让你疲惫的头脑充满活力。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote restoring energy, physical vigor, freshness, or youthful capacity to an animate being, organization, or exhausted system.
groups.summary_zh: 指为疲惫或衰败的人、组织注入元气，使其恢复活力或年轻状态。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on restoring energy, vitality, health, or functioning from a state of exhaustion, lapse, or decline, unlike original generation or static maintenance.
groups.desc_zh: 强调使处于耗竭、萎靡或停滞状态的人或事物恢复元气、活力或运转，不同于原发生成或维持现状。
groups.nuance_en: revive: restore from near-death, unconsciousness, or collapse (patient / economy / tradition) · refresh: light recovery of energy or alertness (mind / body / browser) · perk up: regain brisk spirits or uprightness (plants / child / spirits) · rejuvenate: restore youthful vigor or pristine condition (skin / organization / career) · revitalize: inject transformative new dynamic energy (neighborhood / industry / brand)
groups.nuance_zh: revive: 使从濒死、昏迷或崩溃中苏醒复原 (patient / economy / tradition) · refresh: 驱散疲劳、恢复清爽提神 (mind / body / browser) · perk up: 提振精神、迅速恢复生机 (plants / child / spirits) · rejuvenate: 返老还童或全面恢复年轻态 (skin / organization / career) · revitalize: 注入强劲新动力以复兴 (neighborhood / industry / brand)

groups.name: Revoke & Invalidate Status · 吊销与裁定无效 (Revoke, Rescind, Invalidate)
groups.tip: 宣布资格取消或法律无效

items.def_en: (+ sth) to officially strip someone of a right, license, or legal privilege
items.ex_en: The judge decided to take away his driver's license after multiple serious traffic violations.
items.ex_zh: 在发生多次严重交通违规之后，法官决定吊销他的驾照。

items.def_en: (+ sb of sth) to officially take away someone's title, rank, authority, or status
items.ex_en: The military tribunal decided to strip the disgraced general of all his military decorations.
items.ex_zh: 军事法庭决定剥夺这位名誉扫地的将军所拥有的全部军职荣誉。

items.def_en: to officially cancel or withdraw a license, permit, right, or legal privilege
items.ex_en: The transportation authority decided to revoke his commercial driving permit after repeated safety violations.
items.ex_zh: 交通管理局在屡次发生违规安全行为后，决定吊销他的商业驾驶许可证。

items.def_zh: 取消……的资格；使不合格，使不适宜
items.def_en: to officially stop someone from participating in a competition or activity, or from holding a position, because they broke a rule or lack qualifications
items.ex_en: Two positive drug tests were enough to disqualify the athlete from the tournament.
items.ex_zh: 两次药检呈阳性足以取消该运动员参加本次锦标赛的资格。

items.def_en: to withdraw an offer, statement, or formal grant previously issued
items.ex_en: Under intense public pressure, the senator was forced to retract his controversial statement.
items.ex_zh: 在巨大的舆论压力下，参议员不得不收回他那番充满争议的言论。
items.ex2_en: The frightened cat's sharp claws retracted instantly into its soft paws.
items.ex2_zh: 受惊的小猫锋利的爪子立刻缩回了它柔软的肉垫里。

items.def_zh: 使无效，使作废；证明……不成立
items.def_en: to officially make something legally invalid or no longer acceptable; to prove that an argument, idea, or result is incorrect
items.ex_en: Any procedural error during the collection of evidence may invalidate the entire case.
items.ex_zh: 证据收集过程中的任何程序性失误都可能使整个案件归于无效。

items.def_zh: 废除，撤销，取消（法律、合同或决议）
items.def_en: to officially cancel or revoke a law, contract, order, or decision so that it is no longer valid
items.ex_en: The board voted unanimously to rescind the controversial policy implemented last December.
items.ex_zh: 董事会一致投票决定废除去年十二月实施的这项颇具争议的政策。

items.def_zh: 撤销，判为无效（判决/裁定）
items.def_en: to officially reject or declare an earlier legal ruling or conviction void
items.ex_en: The appeals court decided to quash the conviction due to tainted police evidence.
items.ex_zh: 上诉法院因警方证据受到污染而决定撤销原判。

groups.summary_en: Verbs specifying the cancellation, withdrawal, or nullification of granted privileges, legal statuses, licenses, or eligibility by an oversight body.
groups.summary_zh: 权威机构裁定取消资格、吊销执照或撤回已授予的特权。
groups.desc_en: Signifies an authoritative or legal act that cancels, annuls, or withdraws an officially recognized privilege, law, or status, distinct from mere refusal or termination.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过权威或法律程序废止、撤销或取消已获得的特权、法规或合法资格，区别于直接拒绝或自然终止。
groups.nuance_en: revoke: officially cancel an issued permit, privilege, or decree (license / charter / parole) · rescind: formally annul an existing agreement or decree from the start (decision / contract / offer) · invalidate: destroy the legal standing or cogency of something (ballot / visa / argument) · quash: officially suppress or overturn a ruling by higher authority (subpoena / conviction / rumor) · strip of: punitively divest someone of titles or honors (rank / medal / citizenship)
groups.nuance_zh: revoke: 官方收回或吊销已赋予的许可或特权 (license / charter / parole) · rescind: 废除或撤销既定的决定、要约或合约 (decision / contract / offer) · invalidate: 使作废或失去法律效力/逻辑合理性 (ballot / visa / argument) · quash: 司法上撤销裁决或平息抑制 (subpoena / conviction / rumor) · strip of: 惩罚性剥夺头衔、身份或荣誉 (rank / medal / citizenship)

groups.name: Ride & Cycle · 骑乘与轻便通行 (Bike, Cycle, Pedal)
groups.tip: 骑车开车陆地行驶

items.def_en: to ride a bicycle over a distance
items.ex_en: She prefers to cycle along the scenic coastal route to work every morning.
items.ex_zh: 她喜欢每天早上沿着风光优美的海岸线骑自行车上班。

items.def_en: [I/T] to travel on a bicycle or push/steer a wheeled vehicle along a path
items.ex_en: He wheeled his bicycle slowly through the crowded pedestrian plaza toward the station.
items.ex_zh: 他推着自行车穿过拥挤的步行广场，慢慢向车站走去。
items.ex2_en: A flock of startled seagulls wheeled gracefully above the choppy ocean waves.
items.ex2_zh: 一群受惊的海鸥在波涛汹涌的海面上空优美地盘旋。

items.def_zh: 驾车疾行，乘汽车旅行；用车运送；迅速移动
items.def_en: 1. To travel by car, especially at a steady speed. 2. To transport someone in a motor vehicle.
items.ex_en: We motored along the empty coastal highway at a brisk and steady speed.
items.ex_zh: 我们驾驶汽车以平稳欢快的车速行驶在空旷的沿海公路上。

items.def_en: 1. To travel or ride on a bicycle or motorcycle.
items.ex_en: I usually bike over to my brother's house when the weather stays clear.
items.ex_zh: 只要天气晴朗，我通常都会骑车去我哥家。

items.def_zh: 蹬车离去；骑自行车远去
items.def_en: depart or move off by riding a bicycle
items.ex_en: He waved a quick goodbye and pedaled away down the narrow residential street.
items.ex_zh: 他匆匆挥手告别，随后蹬车沿着狭窄的居住区街道远去。

items.def_en: leave a place riding on a bicycle
items.ex_en: She unlocked her helmet, mounted her bike, and cycled off into the evening.
items.ex_zh: 她解开安全帽，跨上单车，骑车消失在暮色之中。

items.def_en: depart riding on a bicycle, horse, or motorcycle
items.ex_en: The courier jumped onto his motorcycle and rode off into the heavy traffic.
items.ex_zh: 快递员跳上摩托车，骑车冲进了拥挤的车流中。

items.def_en: [I/T] to propel a bicycle or vehicle forward by working the foot pedals
items.ex_en: He had to pedal furiously to propel the heavy tandem bike up that hill.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不拼命蹬踏脚踏板，才能把那辆沉重的双人自行车踩上斜坡。

groups.summary_en: A person travels by operating or riding a light wheeled vehicle, primarily a bicycle or small motorized craft. 'Bike' and 'cycle' focus on pedal-powered transport, while informal uses like 'motor' convey traveling purposefully by automobile or power-assisted vehicle.
groups.summary_zh: 依靠骑行自行车或驾驶小型机动车辆进行个人出行与通行。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on self-propelled or low-power vehicle travel (especially two-wheeled), contrasting with operating heavy motor vehicles or traveling on foot.
groups.desc_zh: 聚焦于骑乘人力或轻型载具（尤指双轮车）的通行方式，区别于驾驶重型汽车或徒步行进。
groups.nuance_en: cycle: formal or sustained bicycling travel (commute / tour / path) · bike: everyday conversational two-wheeler transit (work / town / trail) · pedal: mechanical leg action driving the cranks (uphill / furiously / home) · wheel: push or steer a wheeled device alongside oneself (bicycle / luggage / barrow) · ride off: depart mounted upon a bike or horse (sunset / distance)
groups.nuance_zh: cycle: 正式的骑行或长途自行车运转 (commute / tour / path) · bike: 日常口语中的骑自行车出行 (work / town / trail) · pedal: 侧重双腿踩踏脚踏板的动作 (uphill / furiously / home) · wheel: 推行、推着双轮或轮式载具 (bicycle / luggage / barrow) · ride off: 骑着车或牲畜离去 (sunset / distance)

groups.name: Roar & Rant · 咆哮与狂怒斥责 (Roar, Rant, Bellow)
groups.tip: 大声叫嚷或咆哮宣泄情绪

items.def_en: [I/T] say something in a very loud voice, expressing strong emotion or getting attention
items.ex_en: He had to shout over the roar of the machinery to warn his crew.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不盖过机器的轰鸣声大声喊叫，以警告他的工人们。

items.def_zh: 喋喋不休地怒骂；没完没了地咆哮抱怨
items.def_en: continue speaking at great length in a wild, impassioned, or angry manner
items.ex_en: The angry neighbor continued to rant on about the noise long after midnight.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的邻居过了半夜还在喋喋不休地怒骂抱怨噪音问题。

items.def_en: (+ sth) shout or deliver an angry statement with tremendous vocal power
items.ex_en: Upbeat music blasted out of the speakers throughout the celebration.
items.ex_zh: 在整场庆典期间，扬声器里一直高分贝地播放着欢快的音乐。

items.def_zh: 以高声叫喊压制（阻止对方发言）
items.def_en: (+ sb) silence or drown out a speaker by shouting loudly
items.ex_en: The angry crowd shouted down the politician before he could finish his opening remarks.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的群众大声起哄，让那位政客开场白还没说完就无法继续了。

items.def_en: (+ at/about/against) To speak or shout loudly, angrily, and at length about something you dislike or disagree with.
items.ex_en: My supervisor began to rant about the delayed reports during our morning meeting.
items.ex_zh: 我的主管在早会上开始怒气冲冲地大声抱怨报告被延期。

items.def_en: (+ at/about) speak wildly, irrationally, or furiously, as if mad or delirious
items.ex_en: The fever made him rave incoherently about strange shadows inside the hospital room.
items.ex_zh: 高烧让他神志不清，语无伦次地大喊病房里有诡异的黑影。

items.def_en: [I/T] shout something in a very loud, deep, and angry voice
items.ex_en: The drill sergeant began to bellow orders across the parade ground this morning.
items.ex_zh: 今天清晨，操练教官在检阅场上扯着大嗓门低沉地咆哮发令。

items.def_zh: 咆哮，大吼；呼啸，轰鸣；放声大笑
items.def_en: 1. To make a deep, very loud, continuous sound, or to shout something loudly in anger or excitement. 2. To move rapidly while making a loud, continuous noise.
items.ex_en: The coach began to roar instructions at the players from the sideline bench.
items.ex_zh: 教练在场边替补席上大声吼叫着给队员们布置战术。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail vociferous, emotionally charged vocal output delivered with fierce volume or wild, uncontrolled anger, ranging from sustained incoherent diatribes to explosive animalistic shouts.
groups.summary_zh: 因愤怒而狂暴失控地大吼、咆哮或口若悬河地狂躁斥责。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to loud, uncontrolled, or furious vocalization venting rage, defiance, or agitation, unlike structured debate or quiet weeping.
groups.desc_zh: 指以震耳欲聋、失控或狂怒的方式发出呼喊、宣泄暴怒或抨击，区别于理性的辩论或低声哭诉。
groups.nuance_en: roar: deep, deafening, resonant vocal projection (lion / crowd / engine) · bellow: deep, powerful, echoing shout of animalistic rage or command (order / bull / pain) · rant: sustained wild, irrational, and angry declamation (demagogue / lunatic / hours) · rave: incoherent, frenzied, emotionally deregulated speech (fever / mania / reviews) · shout down: overwhelm someone's speech by sheer acoustic volume (speaker / opposition)
groups.nuance_zh: roar: 发出深沉宏大如雷鸣般的怒吼或咆哮 (lion / crowd / engine) · bellow: 粗犷低沉而极具震慑力的吼叫或号令 (order / bull / pain) · rant: 滔滔不绝、非理性且情绪激动的抨击或痛斥 (demagogue / lunatic / hours) · rave: 语无伦次、狂热狂暴的胡言乱语 (fever / mania / reviews) · shout down: 以高分贝呼喊强行压制打断发言 (speaker / opposition)

groups.name: Routine Transit & Long Expeditions · 远行与通勤 (Commute, Voyage, Trek)
groups.tip: 长途跋涉或乘船远航

items.def_en: to travel over an extended distance, usually over a considerable period
items.ex_en: The solitary traveler journeyed across the arid desert under the blazing southern sun.
items.ex_zh: 孤身一人的旅者在南方烈日暴晒下，穿行于贫瘠的荒漠之中。

items.def_en: leave a place to begin a journey or commute
items.ex_en: We packed our rucksacks early and prepared to head off toward the mountains.
items.ex_zh: 我们早早收拾好行囊，准备动身前往群山之中。

items.def_en: depart on a long, arduous walking journey or expedition
items.ex_en: The expedition team packed their heavy gear and trekked off into the jungle.
items.ex_zh: 探险队收拾好沉重的装备，迈开步子长途跋涉走入丛林。

items.def_en: begin a long voyage, expedition, or regular journey
items.ex_en: The sailors set out across the open sea just before the morning light.
items.ex_zh: 水手们在晨光微现之际启程，驶向辽阔的大海。

items.def_en: [I/T] to pass through or across a place on the way to somewhere else
items.ex_en: Foreign cargo ships must obtain permission before they transit these narrow territorial waters.
items.ex_zh: 外国货轮在过境穿过这片狭窄的领海之前必须获得许可。

items.def_en: to make a long, arduous journey, especially on foot over challenging terrain
items.ex_en: They had to trek across rugged alpine terrain to reach the remote village.
items.ex_zh: 他们不得不长途跋涉穿过崎岖的高山地形，才能到达那座偏远的小山村。

items.def_en: To make a long journey, especially by sea or in space.
items.ex_en: Ancient Polynesian navigators voyaged across vast uncharted expanses of the Pacific Ocean.
items.ex_zh: 古老的波利尼西亚航海家们曾远航横跨未知的广阔太平洋海域。

items.def_zh: 通勤，上下班往返；减刑；替代
items.def_en: 1. To travel regularly between one's home and place of work or study. 2. (law) To change a severe judicial punishment to a less severe one.
items.ex_en: Many suburban residents commute by passenger train to the downtown financial district daily.
items.ex_zh: 许多郊区居民每天乘坐客运列车前往市中心的金融区通勤。

groups.summary_en: Travelers undertake journeys marked either by recurring daily transit between home and work or by extended, adventurous, or seafaring expeditions.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖日常往返通勤与距离漫长、充满探险性质的远征航行。
groups.desc_en: Captures purposeful spatial relocation, ranging from repetitive local transit to grueling, long-distance exploratory voyages, contrasting with stationary habitation or idle strolls.
groups.desc_zh: 概括带有明确空间位移的出行，涵盖从高度规律的日常通勤到艰险的长途远征，不同于定居原地或散漫闲逛。
groups.nuance_en: commute: regular recurring travel between home and workplace (daily / train / miles) · transit: passing through or intermediate passage between nodes (freight / zone / station) · trek: arduous, slow overland journey across rough terrain (mountains / jungle / across) · voyage: prolonged, momentous expedition across sea or outer space (ocean / spacecraft / discovery) · journey: prolonged progression across distance, often experiential (countryside / recovery)
groups.nuance_zh: commute: 往返于居住地与工作场所之间的定期通勤 (daily / train / miles) · transit: 在两地或交通枢纽间中转、过境 (freight / zone / station) · trek: 跨越崎岖地形的艰辛长途跋涉 (mountains / jungle / across) · voyage: 跨越大洋或太空的漫长宏大航行 (ocean / spacecraft / discovery) · journey: 长距离的旅程或心路历程 (countryside / recovery)

groups.name: Rub & Scuff · 磨损与擦伤 (Chafe, Scuff, Fray)
groups.tip: 反复磨蹭擦伤表面

items.def_en: (+ sth) become worn, unraveled, or shredded along the edges from rubbing
items.ex_en: Constant rubbing against the desk caused the cuffs of his jacket to fray out.
items.ex_zh: 由于经常在桌面上摩擦，他夹克的袖口都磨散起毛了。
items.ex2_en: Constant friction against sharp rocks can fray out the climber's thick rope.
items.ex2_zh: 与锋利岩石的持续摩擦会磨损登山者的粗绳边缘。

items.def_en: (+ sth) remove or erode the surface of something through continuous friction
items.ex_en: Centuries of footsteps slowly rubbed away the inscriptions carved onto the stone steps.
items.ex_zh: 几个世纪以来的脚步践踏，慢慢磨损掉了雕刻在石阶上的铭文。
items.ex2_en: The faded paint began to rub away after decades of direct exposure.
items.ex2_zh: 经过几十年的直接暴露，褪色的油漆开始磨蚀剥落。

items.def_zh: 磨损，擦伤（表面）；拖着脚走
items.def_en: To mark or scratch the surface of something by rubbing or dragging against it, or to drag your feet while walking.
items.ex_en: Dragging his feet along the gravel path will scuff his brand new shoes.
items.ex_zh: 拖着脚在碎石路上走会擦坏他的崭新皮鞋。
items.ex2_en: Soft leather shoes tend to scuff easily against rough concrete pedestrian sidewalks.
items.ex2_zh: 柔软的皮鞋在粗糙的水泥人行道上很容易被擦伤磨损。

items.def_en: (+ sth) gradually diminish or erode a surface through continuous rubbing
items.ex_en: Persistent dripping water will eventually wear away even the hardest granite boulder.
items.ex_zh: 持续不断的滴水最终也能磨损侵蚀哪怕是最坚硬的花岗岩巨石。
items.ex2_en: The coastal chalk cliffs slowly wear away against the crashing ocean waves.
items.ex2_zh: 沿海的白垩悬崖在翻滚的海浪拍打下缓缓被侵蚀。

items.def_en: [I/T] to become worn or unraveled at the edge through continuous rubbing
items.ex_en: Friction against the rough stones caused the climber's rope to fray rapidly.
items.ex_zh: 与粗糙岩石的摩擦使得登山者的绳索迅速磨损起毛。
items.ex2_en: The rough wooden desk will fray the smooth silk sleeves of his shirt.
items.ex2_zh: 粗糙的木桌会磨烂他衬衫的光滑丝绸衣袖。

items.def_en: to make sore or rub raw by prolonged friction against the skin
items.ex_en: The stiff leather harness began to gall the horse's shoulders during work.
items.ex_zh: 在劳作过程中，僵硬的皮质挽具开始磨破这匹马的肩膀皮肤。

items.def_zh: （使）擦伤，（使）擦痛；（因受限制而）恼怒，焦躁
items.def_en: 1. To rub against skin or another surface and make it sore or worn, or to become sore by rubbing. 2. To feel annoyed or impatient because of a restriction or rule.
items.ex_en: Tight wet fabric will chafe your skin uncomfortably on a long run.
items.ex_zh: 紧绷湿润的布料在长跑中会擦痛你的皮肤，令人很不适。
items.ex2_en: His sensitive inner thighs chafed terribly during the exhausting marathon footrace.
items.ex2_zh: 在令人筋疲力尽的马拉松长跑中，他敏感的大腿内侧擦伤得很厉害。

items.def_en: to scrape or wear away the surface layer of skin, rock, or material through harsh friction
items.ex_en: Windborne sand particles will continually abrade the outer surface of these stone monuments.
items.ex_zh: 随风飞扬的沙粒会不断磨蚀这些石制纪念碑的外表面。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict superficial wear, irritation, or marked blemishes caused by continuous repetitive friction against fabric, leather, or sensitive skin. 'Chafe' typically targets tender skin or tight bonds, while 'scuff' marks smooth, polished rigid surfaces like shoes or flooring.
groups.summary_zh: 强调因反复摩擦而在皮肤表面导致发红或在物件表面造成磨痕。
groups.desc_en: Details mechanical surface degradation or biological irritation caused by repetitive friction or contact, as opposed to sudden impact trauma or chemical dissolution.
groups.desc_zh: 特指因持续或反复的机械摩擦与碰擦导致表面磨损、破裂或皮肤发红刺痛，区别于骤然撞击碎裂或化学溶解。
groups.nuance_en: chafe: irritate or inflame tissue or surfaces through constant rubbing (skin / collar / leash) · scuff: mark, scrape, or mar a surface by glancing friction (shoes / floor / leather) · fray: unravel or wear into loose threads along an edge (rope / nerves / collar) · abrade: wear away or scrape smooth by rough mechanical friction (stone / skin / cornea) · gall: severely rub raw, sore, or deeply excoriate (saddle / skin / pride)
groups.nuance_zh: chafe: 持续摩擦导致发炎红肿或表面擦破 (skin / collar / leash) · scuff: 刮蹭、磨毛或在表面划出磨损划痕 (shoes / floor / leather) · fray: 织物或边缘因磨擦而抽丝磨损 (rope / nerves / collar) · abrade: 粗糙研磨剥蚀或擦伤磨破 (stone / skin / cornea) · gall: 严重摩擦致破皮起泡，引申为刺痛折磨 (saddle / skin / pride)

groups.name: Rupture & Shatter · 破裂炸裂与粉碎 (Crack, Rupture, Shatter)
groups.tip: 粉身碎骨般的剧烈破裂

items.def_en: [I/T] to break or cause to break, crack, or split cleanly or partially
items.ex_en: The excessive stress caused the brittle metal beam to fracture right down its center.
items.ex_zh: 过大的应力导致脆弱的金属横梁从正中央断裂开来。
items.ex2_en: A heavy blunt force could fracture the fragile bone in his forearm.
items.ex2_zh: 沉重的钝力可能会导致他前臂脆弱的骨头断裂。

items.def_en: (+ sth) fracture or split sharply on impact or under heavy force
items.ex_en: The heavy wooden door began to crack open under the relentless battering ram.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的木门在攻城锤的猛烈撞击下开始裂开一道缝隙。
items.ex2_en: The hungry squirrel used its sharp teeth to crack open the walnut.
items.ex2_zh: 饥饿的松鼠用锋利的牙齿咬开了坚硬的核桃。

items.def_en: [I/T] to break open or apart suddenly and violently, especially from internal pressure
items.ex_en: The water main burst suddenly, sending high-pressure water flooding down the main avenue.
items.ex_zh: 主供水管道突然爆裂，高压水流喷涌而出，淹没了主要大街。
items.ex2_en: The playful puppy tried to burst every single colorful balloon at the party.
items.ex2_zh: 爱玩的小狗试图弄破派对上的每一个彩色气球。

items.def_en: (+ sth) split, crack, or fly open violently under pressure
items.ex_en: High internal pressure caused the steel valve to burst open with tremendous force.
items.ex_zh: 过高的内部压力导致钢阀门以极大的威力猛然爆裂开来。
items.ex2_en: The angry wind burst open the frail wooden shutters in the middle night.
items.ex2_zh: 狂风在半夜猛烈地撞开了脆弱的木质百叶窗。

items.def_zh: （使）粉碎，碎裂；破灭，摧毁（希望、信念等）
items.def_en: 1. to break suddenly into very small pieces, or to make something break in this way. 2. to completely destroy or ruin someone's hopes, peace, or beliefs.
items.ex_en: The falling brick caused the front windshield to shatter into thousands of pieces.
items.ex_zh: 落下的砖头导致前挡风玻璃瞬间粉碎成了成千上万块碎片。
items.ex2_en: A single errant baseball shattered the delicate glass window in the living room.
items.ex2_zh: 一颗飞偏的棒球砸碎了客厅精巧的玻璃窗。

items.def_zh: （使）破裂，爆裂；（使关系）破裂，断绝
items.def_en: 1. to burst or tear open, or to cause a pipe, tissue, or blood vessel to do so. 2. to disrupt or end a friendly relationship, connection, or agreement.
items.ex_en: Internal pressure caused the old underground pipe to rupture without any prior warning.
items.ex_zh: 内部压力导致陈旧的地下管道在没有任何预警的情况下爆裂。
items.ex2_en: Extremely high blood pressure can suddenly rupture weak blood vessels inside the brain.
items.ex2_zh: 极高的血压可能会突然使大脑内部脆弱的血管破裂。

items.def_en: [I/T] to break or shatter suddenly into small, thin fragments or pieces
items.ex_en: The fragile crystal chalice hit the hard floor and shivered into delicate shards.
items.ex_zh: 脆弱的水晶高脚杯掉在坚硬的地板上，碎成了细小的碎片。
items.ex2_en: The fierce explosion shivered every tall glass skyscraper window on the block.
items.ex2_zh: 剧烈的爆炸震碎了街区上每座摩天大楼的高处玻璃窗。

items.def_en: (+ sth) shatter or rupture completely into pieces from explosive internal or external force
items.ex_en: The powerful blast managed to blow apart the concrete bunker in seconds.
items.ex_zh: 巨大的爆炸在几秒钟内就将混凝土掩体炸得粉碎。

groups.summary_en: An entity breaks apart under immense physical pressure, impact, or internal strain. Verbs graduate from a clean structural tear or split to catastrophic fragmentation into myriad airborne shards.
groups.summary_zh: 承受外力或内压发生破裂，乃至剧烈粉碎炸裂成碎片。
groups.desc_en: Denotes violent, catastrophic loss of structural integrity driven by internal pressure or concussive impact, escalating from clean fissure to explosive splintering.
groups.desc_zh: 指因内部压力积聚或剧烈外部冲击导致物体结构的灾难性破裂或解体，由微小断裂递进至爆炸性粉碎。
groups.nuance_en: fracture: cleanly snap, crack, or break structural continuity (bone / skull / alliance) · rupture: breach or tear open from severe internal tension or pressure (appendix / pipeline / relations) · burst: violently explode outward from unsustainable internal pressure (bubble / dam / balloon) · shatter: smash instantly into myriad sharp fragments (glass / illusions / silence) · shiver: splinter into tiny slivers from violent shock (wood / mast / mirror)
groups.nuance_zh: fracture: 骨折、断裂或使结构关系产生破裂 (bone / skull / alliance) · rupture: 承受不住内部压力而发生破裂或撕裂 (appendix / pipeline / relations) · burst: 因极度胀满或内压向外炸开迸发 (bubble / dam / balloon) · shatter: 碎裂成无数微小锋利碎屑 (glass / illusions / silence) · shiver: 遭受剧烈冲击而化为碎片木屑 (wood / mast / mirror)

groups.name: Sanction & Confer Authority · 授权、赋权与认证 (Empower, Accredit, Legalize)
groups.tip: 赋予合法权力与行动资格

items.def_en: to formally delegate someone to perform an official task, rank, or artistic production
items.ex_en: The municipal council decided to commission a local sculptor to craft the monument.
items.ex_zh: 市政委员会决定委托一位当地雕塑家来制作这座纪念碑。

items.def_en: to give someone an official permit or legal certificate allowing them to practice or trade
items.ex_en: The state medical board will license qualified graduates after rigorous background examinations.
items.ex_zh: 州医疗委员会将在进行严格的背景审查后，准予合格的毕业生执业。

items.def_en: to give official permission, approval, or formal sanction for an action or person
items.ex_en: The managing director must authorize any expense report exceeding five thousand dollars.
items.ex_zh: 任何超过五千美元的开支报告都必须由总经理亲自批准。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to give formal or official approval to a document, plan, or authority
items.ex_en: The client is scheduled to sign off on the architectural blueprints this afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 客户定于今天下午正式签字批准这份建筑设计蓝图。

items.def_zh: 将（权力、财产）授予；归属于
items.def_en: (+ sth in sb) to confer legal authority, power, or rights upon a person or body
items.ex_en: The revised constitution shall vest supreme executive authority in the newly elected parliament.
items.ex_zh: 修订后的宪法应将最高行政权力授予新当选的议会。

items.def_zh: 授权，准许；使能够，提升……的自主权
items.def_en: to give someone the official authority or freedom to do something; to give someone more control over their life or situation.
items.ex_en: The new legal charter will empower municipal officials to enforce local zoning regulations.
items.ex_zh: 新的法律章程将授权市政官员去切实执行当地的分区法规。

items.def_zh: 官方认可，鉴定合格；委派，派遣（外交代表）；把……归于
items.def_en: 1. (often passive) to officially recognize an institution or person as meeting required standards. 2. to appoint someone as an official representative.
items.ex_en: The international agency refused to accredit the private clinic due to subpar hygiene.
items.ex_zh: 由于卫生条件不达标，该国际机构拒绝给这家私立诊所提供资质认证。

items.def_en: to make an activity or substance permitted by law.
items.ex_en: The parliament passed landmark legislation to legalize recreational cannabis across the nation.
items.ex_zh: 议会通过了一项具有里程碑意义的法案，使全国娱乐用大麻合法化。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this institutional frame denote an official authority, legal body, or institutional mechanism granting formal power, recognized status, statutory validity, or practical autonomy to an agent, institution, or practice. They differ primarily by the institutional sphere (legal statute, institutional accreditation, or personal delegation).
groups.summary_zh: 官方或权威机构授予法定权力、资质认证或赋予行动自主权。
groups.desc_en: Involves legally, administratively, or institutionally conferring valid power, jurisdiction, or recognized legitimacy upon an actor, contrasting with arbitrary seizing of control.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过法律、行政或权威机构正式赋予行动者权力、资质或认可其合法性，区别于非法的强权抢夺。
groups.nuance_en: authorize: formally empower someone to act or grant permission (expenditure / access / search) · empower: bestow practical autonomy, capability, or legal agency (citizens / law / team) · license: issue a legal certification permitting regulated activities (physician / vehicle / trade) · accredit: officially recognize an institution as meeting quality standards (college / embassy / lab) · vest in: legally and constitutionally endow inherent power in an office (authority / power / jurisdiction)
groups.nuance_zh: authorize: 正式核准、委派或授予实施权限 (expenditure / access / search) · empower: 赋权，增强自主能力或法律效力 (citizens / law / team) · license: 签发执照以准许从事特定管制活动 (physician / vehicle / trade) · accredit: 官方认证机构资质或派遣使节 (college / embassy / lab) · vest in: 依宪法或法定程序将权力赋予特定实体 (authority / power / jurisdiction)

groups.name: Saturate & Pervade · 充盈、弥漫与充血 (Suffuse, Pervade, Engorge)
groups.tip: 充满空间或向各处渗透

items.def_en: (+ sth) to flow or spread slowly into and pervade a space or substance
items.ex_en: Toxic chemicals began to seep into the underground aquifer over several decades.
items.ex_zh: 数十年来，有毒化学物质已逐渐渗透进入地下蓄水层中。

items.def_zh: 灌输；使充满（情感或品质）
items.def_en: (+ with) to thoroughly permeate or saturate with a feeling, quality, or value
items.ex_en: Her wise grandmother sought to imbue the young girl with courage and compassion.
items.ex_zh: 她充满智慧的祖母试图给这个年轻女孩灌输勇气与慈悲之心。

items.def_en: to spread through and be perceptible in every part of a space or group
items.ex_en: A distinctive smell of fresh roasted coffee began to pervade the small library.
items.ex_zh: 一股独特的现磨咖啡香气开始弥漫在这间小图书馆的各个角落。

items.def_en: 1. (+ with) (literary) (of color, light, or feeling) To spread gradually all over or through someone or something.
items.ex_en: A soft golden glow seemed to suffuse the quiet valley at twilight.
items.ex_zh: 暮色之中，柔和的金光似乎弥漫遍布了这片寂静的山谷。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to penetrate completely through something, making it thoroughly wet
items.ex_en: Heavy monsoon rains quickly managed to soak through his thin cotton canvas jacket.
items.ex_zh: 猛烈的季风暴雨迅速将他那件薄棉帆布夹克彻底浸湿透了。

items.def_en: [I/T] to cause an organ or vessel to become abnormally full of blood or fluid, or to clog a conduit
items.ex_en: Chronic inflammation will congest nasal blood vessels and obstruct normal airflow through passages.
items.ex_zh: 慢性炎症会使鼻部血管异常充血并阻碍通道内的正常气流。
items.ex2_en: Downtown commuter streets always congest horribly during peak evening rush hour traffic.
items.ex2_zh: 市中心的通勤街道在傍晚的高峰期总是严重堵塞。

items.def_zh: 使充血，使充盈；狼吞虎咽，大吃
items.def_en: 1. (usually passive) To cause an organ, tissue, or blood vessel to swell with blood or other fluid. 2. To eat or consume greedily.
items.ex_en: Severe cardiac failure may engorge the patient's liver vessels with accumulated blood.
items.ex_zh: 严重的心力衰竭可能会使患者的肝脏血管因积血而发生充盈肿胀。

items.def_zh: 使人口过剩，使数量过多
items.def_en: 1. (usually passive) To cause an area to have too many people or animals for the available resources to support.
items.ex_en: Rapid urban migration threatens to overpopulate the capital city within the next decade.
items.ex_zh: 快速的城市移民潮有可能在未来十年内导致首都面临人口过剩的困境。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate a substance, liquid, or quality spreading thoroughly through or swelling within an area or physiological vessel until it is fully permeated or congested.
groups.summary_zh: 指流体、光气或感觉彻底充盈、浸润或使器官血管充血膨胀的过程。
groups.desc_en: Describes fluids, pigments, qualities, or masses spreading throughout an entire volume until completely packed or soaked, unlike superficial topical coating.
groups.desc_zh: 描述液体、气息、情感或群体在整体空间或介质内部彻底浸润、弥漫或充塞，不同于表层轻微覆盖。
groups.nuance_en: suffuse: gradually spread color, warmth, or light across a surface or field (cheeks / glow / warmth) · pervade: diffuse imperceptibly throughout every crevice or facet (smell / influence / paranoia) · imbue: deeply saturate with a lasting quality, spirit, or conviction (character / culture / mind) · engorge: swell to abnormal capacity with fluid or blood (vein / tick / river) · congest: block or clog an area through excessive accumulation (traffic / lungs / sinuses)
groups.nuance_zh: suffuse: 光芒、色泽或温润感在表面漫溢铺展 (cheeks / glow / warmth) · pervade: 气味、氛围或影响无孔不入地渗透弥漫 (smell / influence / paranoia) · imbue: 思想、情操或特质的深层灌输浸润 (character / culture / mind) · engorge: 充血、吸饱液体后过度肿胀充盈 (vein / tick / river) · congest: 因积聚过甚而堵塞壅塞 (traffic / lungs / sinuses)

groups.name: Savor & Relish · 品味与享受 (Savor, Relish, Bask)
groups.tip: 细细品味并全然乐在其中

items.def_zh: 沉浸于，尽情沐浴于（赞美、温暖）
items.def_en: (+ in) to lie comfortably in warmth, or enjoy pleasant approval or admiration
items.ex_en: The proud director paused on the stage to bask in the audience's applause.
items.ex_zh: 傲然的导演在舞台上驻足，尽情沐浴在观众热烈的掌声与赞誉中。

items.def_en: (+ sth) gaze at or savor an experience or scene with deep sensory pleasure
items.ex_en: We stood silently at the summit, drinking in the magnificent view.
items.ex_zh: 我们静静地站在山顶上，尽情饱览那壮丽的景色。

items.def_zh: 尽情享受；沉浸于（阳光、氛围、赞誉等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) absorb, relish, and thoroughly enjoy a pleasant sensory or emotional atmosphere
items.ex_en: We sat by the Mediterranean harbor to soak up the peaceful warm afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 我们坐在地中海港口边，尽情享受着静谧而温暖的午后时光。

items.def_zh: 陶醉于；沉浸在……的快感中
items.def_en: (+ sth) take extreme delight, pride, or relish in an experience or achievement
items.ex_en: The triumphant players gathered together to revel in their unexpected championship win.
items.ex_zh: 获胜的球员们聚在一起，沉浸在他们出人意料夺冠的巨大狂喜中。

items.def_en: (+ in) to take great and self-indulgent pleasure in comfort or pleasure
items.ex_en: She booked an appointment to luxuriate in the warm, fragrant mineral spring baths.
items.ex_zh: 她预约了一次体验，去纵情享受温暖而芳香的矿物温泉沐浴。

items.def_zh: 尽情享受，品味，玩味；渴望
items.def_en: 1. To enjoy an experience, prospect, or food with great pleasure and anticipation.
items.ex_en: The competitive athlete seemed to relish the immense challenge ahead of the finals.
items.ex_zh: 这位好胜的运动员似乎无比享受决赛前即将来临的巨大挑战。

items.def_zh: 品尝，细细品味，尽情享受；体会
items.def_en: 1. (US spelling of savour) To enjoy food, drink, or a pleasant experience slowly so as to appreciate every detail.
items.ex_en: She closed her eyes to savor every bite of the rich chocolate cake.
items.ex_zh: 她闭上眼睛，细细品味每一口浓郁的巧克力蛋糕。

items.def_en: (+ in) to get great satisfaction and uninhibited delight from a situation
items.ex_en: The young prince reveled in the uninhibited adoration showered upon him by the crowd.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的王子陶醉在人群倾注于他的狂热爱戴之中。

groups.summary_en: A person consciously pauses to fully experience, appreciate, and derive deep pleasure or psychological gratification from a sensory experience, victory, or moment. Verbs emphasize deliberate appreciation over casual liking.
groups.summary_zh: 专注于充分感受并咀嚼某种滋味、体验或成功带来的愉悦与心理满足感。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to lingering over a pleasurable sensation, accomplishment, or environment with acute mindfulness and indulgence, rather than consuming or acting hurriedly.
groups.desc_zh: 强调带着极高专注度细细品味、沉浸并尽情享受美好感受、成就或环境，而非匆匆消费或略过。
groups.nuance_en: savor: slow down to taste, appreciate, or deeply experience details (victory / wine / moment) · relish: enthusiastically anticipate or look forward to enjoying something (challenge / opportunity / irony) · revel: indulge in noisy, exuberant, or unrestrained celebration (party / night / victory) · bask: expose oneself comfortably to warm light or widespread adulation (sunlight / glory / approval) · luxuriate: sensuously wallow in lavish comfort or pleasure (hotel / warmth / bath)
groups.nuance_zh: savor: 细细咂摸、悠然品味美食或胜利的滋味 (victory / wine / moment) · relish: 满怀兴味与热忱地期待或享受某事 (challenge / opportunity / irony) · revel: 纵情狂欢、沉溺于欢愉与庆祝中 (party / night / victory) · bask: 沐浴在阳光下或沉浸于荣誉赞誉中 (sunlight / glory / approval) · luxuriate: 沉溺奢华享受或极致舒适的环境 (hotel / warmth / bath)

groups.name: Scatter & Sprinkle · 撒播与铺撒 (Disperse Fine or Loose Particles over a Surface)
groups.tip: 把草料散布铺洒一地

items.def_en: (+ over) to trickle or pour a thin stream of liquid over food lightly
items.ex_en: The chef decided to drizzle balsamic glaze over the fresh mozzarella and ripe tomatoes.
items.ex_zh: 厨师决定将黑醋汁细密地淋在新鲜马苏里拉奶酪和成熟番茄上。
items.ex2_en: Cold rainwater continued to drizzle quietly over the sleepy coastal village all morning.
items.ex2_zh: 整个上午，冰冷的雨水继续静静地下在沉睡的海滨村庄上。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to throw or drop loose things in many different directions over an area
items.ex_en: The gardener began to scatter seeds around the newly tilled flower beds this morning.
items.ex_zh: 今天早上，园丁开始在刚翻耕的花坛各处播撒种子。
