items.ex_zh: 难民们在漫长的北上跋涉中不得不苦苦忍受严寒。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame scale from the basic cognitive capacity to tolerate pain, hardship, or discomfort up to long-term heroic perseverance under severe, agonizing distress without capitulating.
groups.summary_zh: 由基础耐受烦扰递进到在极端痛苦或漫长困境中坚忍硬撑。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on withstanding prolonged hardship, pain, or psychological distress without collapsing, distinct from welcoming acceptance or active counterattack.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重于在漫长苦难、剧痛或心理重压下苦撑硬熬而不垮掉，区别于欣然接纳或主动反击。
groups.nuance_en: bear: supporting heavy emotional weight without breaking down (grief / burden / responsibility) · stand: having the fortitude to tolerate unpleasantness (pain / noise / insult) · endure: sustaining severe, prolonged suffering through sheer resilience (torture / winter / hardship) · tough out: gritty, stubborn refusal to yield in difficult circumstances (crisis / storm / season)
groups.nuance_zh: bear: 默默承受沉重的心灵或身体重负 (grief / burden / responsibility) · stand: 具备忍受不适或挑衅的意志耐力 (pain / noise / insult) · endure: 凭借坚韧毅力在漫长残酷苦难中熬过去 (torture / winter / hardship) · tough out: 咬紧牙关、硬着头皮顶住逆境 (crisis / storm / season)

groups.name: Transilluminate & Reevaluate · 透光照检与复查核验 (Candle, Reexamine, Reinspect)
groups.tip: 逐项核对查验排除瑕疵

items.def_en: to inspect or verify something a second time to ensure accuracy
items.ex_en: The accountant sat down to recheck the column of numbers for possible errors.
items.ex_zh: 会计坐下来重新核对这列数字，以防出错。

items.def_en: to carry out a second or repeated inspection to ensure compliance or quality
items.ex_en: The safety officer will reinspect the manufacturing plant before granting final clearance.
items.ex_zh: 安全官将在发放最终合格许可前对制造工厂进行复验。

items.def_en: to pass strong light through an organ, tissue, or egg to examine internal structures
items.ex_en: The physician prepared to transilluminate the patient's frontal sinuses to detect blockage.
items.ex_zh: 医生准备通过光照透视患者的额窦以探查是否存在堵塞。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Examine something carefully to ensure accuracy, safety, or physical integrity
items.ex_en: Always check over your essay for grammatical slips before submitting.
items.ex_zh: 提交文章前，务必仔细检查一遍是否有语法疏漏。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Inspect or examine something again to verify condition or detect faults
items.ex_en: Please look over these revised contract clauses before we proceed with the signing.
items.ex_zh: 在我们正式签字之前，请再过目审验一下这些修改后的合同条款。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Examine the details of something carefully in a secondary round of review
items.ex_en: The supervisor asked him to go over each invoice to confirm the totals.
items.ex_zh: 主管要求他逐项复核每一张发票以确认总额。

items.def_zh: 透光检查（蛋的受精或新鲜程度）
items.def_en: To examine eggs for freshness or fertility by holding them up to a bright light.
items.ex_en: The farmer paused to candle each hen egg against the glowing oil lamp.
items.ex_zh: 农夫停下手中的活，将每枚鸡蛋对着明亮的油灯透光检查。

items.def_zh: 重新检查，重新审查；重考；复讯（证人）
items.def_en: To examine, inspect, or question someone or something again.
items.ex_en: The committee decided to reexamine the controversial evidence behind closed doors this morning.
items.ex_zh: 委员会决定今天上午闭门重新审查那份有争议的证据。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to specialized forms of diagnostic verification, specifically checking internal integrity via backlighting/transillumination (candling) or conducting repeated, secondary rounds of rigorous inspection.
groups.summary_zh: 通过透光照检（如照蛋）或重复复审等专门方法进行的核验。
groups.desc_en: Denotes subjecting an object or claim to a secondary, rigorous inspection—sometimes utilizing penetrating light—to detect hidden flaws, contrasting with a cursory first glance.
groups.desc_zh: 指对物品或结论进行二次乃至深度的透视或严苛复核以排查隐患，区别于粗略的初次浏览。
groups.nuance_en: candle: holding up to light to inspect internal quality (eggs / gems) · reexamine: scrutinizing again in light of new evidence or doubts (case / assumptions / patient) · reinspect: formally and systematically inspecting a second time for compliance (premises / vehicle / aircraft) · go over: methodically reviewing details for errors (accounts / notes / contract)
groups.nuance_zh: candle: 透光照检内部品质或瑕疵 (eggs / gems) · reexamine: 结合新疑点或证据重新审视审讯 (case / assumptions / patient) · reinspect: 依照规范和准则再次正式核验 (premises / vehicle / aircraft) · go over: 逐条排查疏漏与细节差错 (accounts / notes / contract)

groups.name: Tread Heavily & Crush Underfoot · 踩踏与跺脚 (Stomp, Trample)
groups.tip: 重重踩压与踏步

items.def_en: [I/T] to put one's foot down on; step or walk on something
items.ex_en: The solitary traveler dared not tread upon the sacred moss of the sanctuary.
items.ex_zh: 孤独的旅人不敢践踏圣所内神圣的苔藓。

items.def_en: 1. Past participle of tread; stepped or walked upon heavily or firmly.
items.ex_en: The wild violets lay trodden into the dark earth after the hasty retreat.
items.ex_zh: 仓促撤退之后，野紫罗兰被踩烂在黑土之中。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Bring the foot down heavily and forcefully on someone or something
items.ex_en: He rushed forward to stamp on the burning embers before the grass ignited.
items.ex_zh: 他在草地着火前冲上前去狠踩那些燃烧的余烬。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Crush, flatten, or compress something underfoot by stepping on it heavily
items.ex_en: The autumn pilgrims slowly tread down the fallen leaves along the forest path.
items.ex_zh: 秋日的朝圣者沿着林间小径慢慢踩实落叶。

items.def_en: [I/T] to bring the foot down heavily and forcefully on the ground, often out of anger
items.ex_en: The frustrated child began to stamp loudly on the floor in protest.
items.ex_zh: 受挫的孩子开始使劲跺脚，在地上制造噪音以示抗议。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Flatten, crush, or destroy plants or objects by stepping roughly on them
items.ex_en: Careless spectators managed to trample down the delicate flowerbeds outside the stadium.
items.ex_zh: 粗心的观众踩烂了体育场外娇嫩的花坛。

items.def_en: 1. (+ on/out/around) To walk with heavy, noisy steps, or stamp one's foot down forcefully in anger.
items.ex_en: Angry about the verdict, he began to stomp around the living room.
items.ex_zh: 他对判决结果十分气愤，开始在起居室里怒气冲冲地重重踱步。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ on/over) to step heavily and repeatedly on something so as to crush or damage it
items.ex_en: The cattle broke free and started to trample the young corn shoots.
items.ex_zh: 牲口挣脱了束缚，开始践踏玉米幼苗。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe driving the foot hard into the ground or down upon an object or living thing, either in fury or to crush and ruin. 'Stomp' foregrounds forceful, loud downward footsteps, whereas 'trodden' (tread) conveys stepping heavily upon something, often flattening, degrading, or injuring it.
groups.summary_zh: 指用力跺地或将脚重重踩在物体或地面上，常伴随重击或踩碎。
groups.desc_en: Involves stepping heavily upon a surface or object so as to crush, flatten, or damage it, contrasting with gentle walking or light pacing.
groups.desc_zh: 指用脚沉重地踏击、践踏某表面或物体，致使其受压扁平、破碎或受损，区别于轻柔迈步或寻常走动。
groups.nuance_en: tread: stepping on or pressing down with the foot (grapes / floorboard / path) · stamp: forcefully bringing the foot down to make a thud or crush (foot / floor / embers) · trample: crushing, flattening, or destroying under multiple heavy steps (grass / crops / rights) · stomp: walking or treading with deliberate, loud, angry thuds (stairs / puddle / mud)
groups.nuance_zh: tread: 踏步于其上或踩压碾踏 (grapes / floorboard / path) · stamp: 极具爆发力地向下跺脚或踩灭 (foot / floor / embers) · trample: 乱脚践踏摧残致使其破烂扁平 (grass / crops / rights) · stomp: 带着怒气或重力蹬跺地面发出闷响 (stairs / puddle / mud)

groups.name: Trigger & Excite into Activity · 触发与激发活性 (Activate, Stimulate, Animate)
groups.tip: 触动开关使其开始运转工作

items.def_en: to cause an intensive functional process or reaction to begin
items.ex_en: Inhaling fine pollen grains can trigger an immediate allergic reaction in sensitive patients.
items.ex_zh: 吸入微小花粉粒会引发敏感患者即刻的过敏反应。

items.def_en: to ignite or provide the initial stimulus that sets something into motion
items.ex_en: His provocative remarks managed to spark fierce controversy among the gathered journalists.
items.ex_zh: 他挑衅性的言论引发了在场记者之间的激烈争论。

items.def_en: 1. To cause something to start working, operate, or become active.
items.ex_en: Pressing the red emergency button will instantly activate the building's fire sprinklers.
items.ex_zh: 按下红色紧急按钮会立即激活大楼的自动喷淋灭火系统。
items.ex2_en: The security alarm activates immediately whenever someone steps through the main gate.
items.ex2_zh: 每当有人穿过大门时，安全警报就会立即启动。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to activate, excite, or stimulate someone or a system into vigorous activity
items.ex_en: The coach's speech fired up the team before the final match.
items.ex_zh: 决赛前，教练的演讲彻底点燃了全队的斗志。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to arouse or stimulate dormant feelings, memories, or biological impulses
items.ex_en: The old black-and-white photographs never failed to stir up forgotten childhood memories.
items.ex_zh: 那些老旧的黑白照片总能唤起被遗忘的童年记忆。

items.def_zh: 使有生气，激活；赋予生命；制作成动画
items.def_en: 1. To make someone or something lively, energetic, and full of spirit. 2. To give life to something. 3. To produce drawings or models as a moving film.
items.ex_en: Her witty storytelling never failed to animate the otherwise dull dinner table.
items.ex_zh: 她风趣幽默的故事总能使原本沉闷的餐桌变得充满生气。

items.def_zh: 激发，促进，激励；刺激（机体或器官）
items.def_en: 1. To encourage something to grow, develop, or become more active. 2. To make an organ, organism, or part of the body function or react.
items.ex_en: Lower interest rates are explicitly designed to stimulate sluggish national economic growth.
items.ex_zh: 降低利率明确旨在刺激疲软的国家经济增长。

items.def_en: to awaken or stir someone/something from lethargy into active response
items.ex_en: The blare of the brass bugle served to rouse the sleeping camp.
items.ex_zh: 嘹亮的铜军号声唤醒了沉睡的营地。

groups.summary_en: A stimulus triggers an otherwise dormant function, physiological mechanism, or cognitive process, bringing it into an active, responsive, or lively operational state.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过外界刺激触发生理机制、心智或系统功能，使其进入活跃状态。
groups.desc_en: Involves initiating an energetic chain reaction, neural response, or latent behavior, transforming inactivity into active motion, unlike sustained maintenance.
groups.desc_zh: 指开启能量链条、引发神经反射或潜藏行为，打破静态转化为活跃状态，区别于持续平稳维系。
groups.nuance_en: trigger: immediately releasing a built-up process or explosive reaction (alarm / avalanche / crisis) · spark: igniting sudden interest, debate, or conflict from a tiny origin (controversy / riot / interest) · activate: formally switching a dormant system or mechanism into operation (account / protein / mechanism) · stimulate: increasing internal activity, vitality, or physiological function (growth / appetite / economy)
groups.nuance_zh: trigger: 触动引信或枢纽而瞬间引发连锁反应 (alarm / avalanche / crisis) · spark: 由极小起因瞬间激起火花、争论或动荡 (controversy / riot / interest) · activate: 启动休眠系统使之进入运作状态 (account / protein / mechanism) · stimulate: 注入活力以促进内在机能或活性增强 (growth / appetite / economy)

groups.name: Trim & Crop · 修剪与截除 (Roach, Jag, Crop)
groups.tip: 剪短边缘使之整齐整洁

items.def_en: (+ sth) Remove an unwanted end or protrusion with a quick cut of scissors or shears
items.ex_en: Use the kitchen shears to snip off any dry, withered herb leaves.
items.ex_zh: 用厨房剪刀剪掉所有干枯的香草叶片。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Cut back the edges or growth of foliage, hair, or material to make it neat
items.ex_en: The gardener promised to trim back the overgrown ivy along our stone wall.
items.ex_zh: 园丁答应修剪掉石墙上过度蔓延的常春藤。

items.def_en: [I/T] to cut something with short, quick, light strokes of scissors
items.ex_en: She carefully took up small scissors to snip the stray clothing threads.
items.ex_zh: 她小心翼翼地拿起小剪刀，轻剪掉多余的线头。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Cut or slice off a branch, appendage, or excess material sharply
items.ex_en: The forester had to lop off the low hanging bough with his saw.
items.ex_zh: 林务员不得不使用锯子截断那根低垂的树枝。

items.def_en: to cut hair, plants, or edges short, neat, or to a specific uniform length
items.ex_en: The stylist agreed to crop her heavy hair into a neat summer bob.
items.ex_zh: 发型师答应将她厚重的头发剪短成利落的夏日波波头。

items.def_zh: 剪短（马鬃使其直立）；剪平（头发等）；使拱起
items.def_en: 1. (chiefly North American) To cut a horse's mane very short so that it stands bristling upright. 2. To arch or curve something upward.
items.ex_en: The groom prepared his finest shears to roach the thoroughbred's unruly mane.
items.ex_zh: 马夫备好最上等的剪刀，将那匹纯种马桀骜不驯的鬃毛剪短立起。

items.def_zh: 剪（撕）成锯齿状，使产生缺口；刺，戳
items.def_en: To cut, slash, or tear uneven notches or sharp teeth into an edge.
items.ex_en: Be careful not to jag the raw silk fabric while cutting the pattern.
items.ex_zh: 剪裁纸样时要小心，不要把生丝面料剪成参差不齐的缺口。

items.def_en: to cut wool, hair, or surface material off closely using heavy shears or blades
items.ex_en: Farmers gather every spring to shear heavy wool coats from the flock.
items.ex_zh: 每年春天，农夫们都会聚集在一起剪除羊群身上厚厚的羊毛。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate specific physical cutting actions aimed at trimming, leveling, notching, or shearing hair, mane, foliage, or materials to alter their outline or reduce length.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过修整、锯齿状剪切或剪截边缘，对毛发、植物或材质进行修齐或截短。
groups.desc_en: Involves reducing the length, height, or periphery of something by cutting away excess edges or tips, contrasting with shearing off the root or dividing in half.
groups.desc_zh: 指剪除或切除物体边缘、尖端等赘余部分以控制长宽轮廓，区别于连根斩断或劈成两半。
groups.nuance_en: snip: cleanly cutting with a small, sharp, scissors-like stroke (thread / hair / herbs) · crop: cutting short the top, edges, or margins (photograph / mane / tail) · trim back: pruning or reducing protruding growth to maintain bounds (hedges / budget / branches) · lop off: bluntly and quickly chopping off an entire protruding extremity (branch / limb / ear)
groups.nuance_zh: snip: 用小剪刀敏捷清脆地剪下微小部分 (thread / hair / herbs) · crop: 截短顶部、剪短鬃尾或裁切边缘 (photograph / mane / tail) · trim back: 剪除侧生枝桠或削减超支部分以收拢规整 (hedges / budget / branches) · lop off: 大刀阔斧地直接砍断削除整个突出部位 (branch / limb / ear)

groups.name: Unfasten & Loosen Closures · 解开紧固与松解联结 (Unfasten, Untie, Loose)
groups.tip: 解除系紧状态并释放物体

items.def_zh: 解开，松开；释放，放开；发射（箭、子弹）
items.def_en: 1. To unfasten, untie, or loosen something. 2. To set free or release someone or something from restraint. 3. To shoot or fire a bullet, arrow, or missile.
items.ex_en: With gentle hands, the maid leaned forward to loose the silken cords.
items.ex_zh: 侍女身体前倾，用温柔的双手解开那些丝绳。

items.def_en: [I/T] to unfasten a buckle on a belt, shoe, or harness
items.ex_en: The exhausted traveler sat down on the bench to unbuckle his heavy sandals.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的旅人在长凳上坐下，解开他那沉重凉鞋的搭扣。
items.ex2_en: The loose leather strap unbuckled unexpectedly while he ran down the street.
items.ex2_zh: 当他沿着街道奔跑时，松脱的皮带意外解开了。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make a tight binding, knot, or closure less tight or rigid
items.ex_en: He pulled at the tight collar to loosen up his stiff necktie.
items.ex_zh: 他扯了扯勒紧的领口，以松开僵硬的领带。
items.ex2_en: The tight knot loosened up gradually after being soaked in warm water.
items.ex2_zh: 紧绷的绳结在温水中浸泡后渐渐松开了。

items.def_en: [I/T] to undo a knot, or free something that is held by a knot
items.ex_en: She bent over patiently to untie the double knot in her running shoes.
items.ex_zh: 她耐心地弯下腰，解开跑鞋上系的死结。
items.ex2_en: Her silk shoelaces untied on their own while she walked around town.
items.ex2_zh: 当她在城里散步时，她的丝绸鞋带自己松开了。

items.def_en: [I/T] to undo the buttons of an article of clothing
items.ex_en: He stepped inside the heated room and began to unbutton his wool coat.
items.ex_zh: 他走进温暖的房间，开始解开羊毛大衣的纽扣。
items.ex2_en: The loose collar unbuttoned easily as he leaned forward during the meal.
items.ex2_zh: 用餐时他往前一倾，宽松的领口便轻易解开了。

items.def_zh: 解开，松开；撤销，破坏（undo的过去式）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense of undo: unfastened, untied, opened, or reversed something.
items.ex_en: He undid the wet laces of his hiking boots with trembling, freezing fingers.
items.ex_zh: 他用颤抖而冰冷的手指解开了登山靴上湿透的鞋带。

items.def_zh: 解开……的钩子；从钩上取下
items.def_en: 1. To unfasten hooks on something, or to release or remove something from a hook.
items.ex_en: Please unhook the safety chain before trying to push the heavy gate open.
items.ex_zh: 在试图推开沉重的大门之前，请先把安全链钩解开。

items.def_zh: 解开，松开，打开（系紧或扣住之物）
items.def_en: 1. To undo, open, or loosen something that is fastened, tied, or buttoned.
items.ex_en: Passengers must not unfasten their seat belts while the aircraft is still taxiing.
items.ex_zh: 飞机仍在滑行期间，乘客切勿解开安全带。
items.ex2_en: The metal clasp unfastened suddenly under the intense strain of heavy luggage.
items.ex2_zh: 在沉重行李的巨大拉力下，金属扣突然松脱了。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this physical frame denote undoing, releasing, or separating clasps, hooks, knots, and restraining mechanisms to open a garment, container, or tethered item.
groups.summary_zh: 指解开绳扣、挂钩等固定连接构件，使物体脱离束缚或开启。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on loosening or opening mechanical fasteners or knots to release tension or separation, contrasting with breaking or cutting them.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重于松解或开启紧固机械件、绳结以解除束缚或张力，区别于暴力砸毁或直接切断。
groups.nuance_en: unfasten: formally opening any securing mechanism (seatbelt / clasp / latch) · untie: loosening intertwined knots or cords (laces / knot / ribbon) · unbutton: disengaging buttons from their holes (shirt / jacket / collar) · unbuckle: opening a clasp with a pin or prong (belt / harness / strap)
groups.nuance_zh: unfasten: 解开或松开各类机械紧固锁扣 (seatbelt / clasp / latch) · untie: 解开纠结缠绕的绳结或系带 (laces / knot / ribbon) · unbutton: 解除纽扣与扣眼的咬合 (shirt / jacket / collar) · unbuckle: 弹开带刺针或插槽的带扣 (belt / harness / strap)

groups.name: Unfasten & Undo · 解扣与解开 (Unfasten, Untie, Unzip)
groups.tip: 解脱绳结拉锁使敞开

items.def_en: [I/T] to release the buckle of a belt, strap, or harness
items.ex_en: He sat down on the sofa and hurried to unbuckle his tight leather belt.
items.ex_zh: 他在沙发上坐下，连忙解开紧绷的皮带扣。
items.ex2_en: The old safety belt unbuckled abruptly during the bumpy off-road truck ride.
items.ex2_zh: 在颠簸的卡车越野行驶中，旧安全带突然解开了。

items.def_zh: 脱下；取下（通过解开扣合件）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to unfasten and remove a garment, belt, or watch from the body
items.ex_en: She had to take off her wristwatch before stepping into the examination room.
items.ex_zh: 步入考场之前，她不得不解下戴着的手表。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make a tight knot, strap, or binding less firmly fastened
items.ex_en: Can you loosen up this strap a bit? It is cutting into my shoulder.
items.ex_zh: 你能把这条带子松开一点吗？它勒得我肩膀疼。
items.ex2_en: The stiff climbing rope loosened up gradually after months of regular use.
items.ex2_zh: 经过数月的常规使用，坚硬的攀登绳渐渐变松弛了。

items.def_zh: 拉开（……的）拉链；解压缩（计算机文件）
items.def_en: 1. To open clothing, a bag, etc. by pulling the zipper open, or to become unfastened by a zipper. 2. (computing) To decompress a zipped file.
items.ex_en: He began to unzip the heavy winter parka as the room grew warm.
items.ex_zh: 随着屋子里变暖和，他拉开了厚重冬款派克大衣的拉链。
items.ex2_en: Her worn backpack unzipped completely, spilling schoolbooks all across the corridor floor.
items.ex2_zh: 她那破旧的书包拉链彻底裂开，课本洒满了走廊地面。

items.def_zh: 解开，松开（绳、结、捆绑之物等）
items.def_en: To undo or loosen a knot, cord, or something that is tied or bound.
items.ex_en: The sailor had to untie several complex knots before lowering the rescue boat.
items.ex_zh: 水手必须先解开几个复杂的绳结，然后才能放下救援艇。
items.ex2_en: The delicate ribbon untied smoothly with just a single gentle tug yesterday.
items.ex2_zh: 昨天只需轻轻一拉，精致的丝带便顺滑地解开了。

items.def_en: [I/T] to unfasten the buttons of a garment
items.ex_en: He paused to unbutton his collar and relax after the stressful afternoon meeting.
items.ex_zh: 结束了下午压力巨大的会议后，他停下来解开衣领纽扣放松一下。
items.ex2_en: Her loose silk blouse unbuttoned slightly while she carried the heavy parcels.
items.ex2_zh: 当她搬运沉重的包裹时，宽松的丝绸衬衫扣子稍微解开了。

items.def_en: to disconnect or unfasten something by releasing hooks
items.ex_en: The climber managed to unhook the carabiner from the harness with one hand.
items.ex_zh: 登山者设法单手将安全钩从安全带上解开。

items.def_en: [I/T] to open or release a fastener, clip, lock, or buckle holding something together
items.ex_en: Technicians must unfasten the locking clips before inspecting the delicate engine components.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员在检查精密发动机部件前，必须先解开锁定卡扣。
items.ex2_en: The rusted gate latch unfastened smoothly after being sprayed with lubricating oil.
items.ex2_zh: 喷上润滑油后，生锈的大门插销顺畅地打开了。

groups.summary_en: An agent undoes a fastener, knot, or mechanical closure to open a garment, container, or bound object. Verbs correspond directly to the specific mechanism being undone (knots, zips, buttons, buckles).
groups.summary_zh: 解开拉链、绳结、搭扣等紧固件以释放或打开物体。
groups.desc_en: Centers on releasing physical fasteners on worn items or containers to allow opening or removal, contrasting with permanently detaching or severing.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重于解开服饰或容器上的各色扣锁结构以便开启或脱卸，区别于永久性的拆除或割除。
groups.nuance_en: unzip: opening a toothed slide fastener (jacket / bag / tent) · unhook: releasing an eye-and-catch, hook, or latch mechanism (bra / latch / gate) · untie: releasing knotted ties on garments or bundles (apron / shoelaces / knot) · unbuckle: releasing a strap held by a buckle (belt / sandals / helmet)
groups.nuance_zh: unzip: 顺滑拉开咬合齿状拉链 (jacket / bag / tent) · unhook: 脱开倒钩、锁扣或搭钩 (bra / latch / gate) · untie: 解除衣带、鞋带等打好的活结 (apron / shoelaces / knot) · unbuckle: 解开卡榫或针扣式的安全皮带 (belt / sandals / helmet)

groups.name: Unfurl & Spread Out · 展开与展平 (Unfurl, Splay, Outstretch)
groups.tip: 将折叠卷曲之物展平铺开

items.def_en: [I/T] to spread out or cause to spread out in the shape of an open fan
items.ex_en: The search party began to fan out across the dense woodland at dawn.
items.ex_zh: 黎明时分，搜救队开始呈扇形散开穿过茂密的树林。
items.ex2_en: The commander fanned out his troops along the edge of the riverbank.
items.ex2_zh: 指挥官将他的部队沿河岸边缘呈扇形散开部署。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to unfold or cause sth folded to become flat and wide
items.ex_en: She decided to open out the giant folding map across the wooden table.
items.ex_zh: 她决定把那张巨大的折叠地图在木桌上完全展开。
items.ex2_en: The vast green valley opened out before the hikers as they reached the summit.
items.ex2_zh: 当徒步旅行者到达山顶时，广阔的绿色山谷在他们眼前豁然展开。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to open and spread sth flat that has been rolled up, or to become flat in this way
items.ex_en: The workers will roll out the new synthetic turf across the football pitch.
items.ex_zh: 工人们将把新的人造草皮在足球场上平整地铺开。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to open out or arrange sth over a wider surface
items.ex_en: The search team spread out across the forest to look for the missing hikers.
items.ex_zh: 搜救队在森林中分散开来寻找失踪的徒步旅行者。
items.ex2_en: The gardener spread out fresh wood mulch evenly across the flowerbeds.
items.ex2_zh: 园丁把新鲜的木屑均匀地铺撒在各个花坛上。

items.def_en: [I/T] to open out something that has been rolled into a flat shape
items.ex_en: The curator carefully began to unroll the ancient silk manuscript on the table.
items.ex_zh: 馆长小心翼翼地开始在桌面上展开展平那卷古老的丝绸手稿。
items.ex2_en: The thick carpet unrolled smoothly across the floor of the empty living room.
items.ex2_zh: 厚厚的地毯平整地展铺在空旷起居室的地板上。

items.def_en: to extend or stretch out limbs or flat material to full length
items.ex_en: The eagle did outstretch its majestic wings against the fierce mountain winds.
items.ex_zh: 那只雄鹰迎着凛冽的山风完全展开了它威严的双翼。

items.def_zh: 展开，解开，展平；开放，展现
items.def_en: To open out or unroll something that was folded, curled, or rolled up, such as a flag, sail, or umbrella; to become spread out.
items.ex_en: The soldiers watched the silk banner unfurl slowly in the morning breeze.
items.ex_zh: 士兵们注视着丝质旗帜在晨风中缓缓展开。
items.ex2_en: The experienced sailors quickly unfurled the main sails before the wind picked up.
items.ex2_zh: 经验丰富的水手赶在起风前迅速展开了主帆。

items.def_zh: （使）张开，（使）张开成八字形，展开
items.def_en: (+ out/apart) To spread fingers, legs, or objects wide apart or outward at an angle.
items.ex_en: He collapsed onto the gym mat, letting his weary limbs splay outward.
items.ex_zh: 他倒在健身垫上，任由疲惫的四肢大喇喇地向外张开。
items.ex2_en: The frightened kitten splayed its sharp claws outward to grip the slippery branch.
items.ex2_zh: 受惊的小猫向外张开锋利的爪子，紧紧抓住湿滑的树枝。

groups.summary_en: Agents or objects open, unroll, or flare out from a folded, rolled, or compressed state into a fully extended and flattened posture.
groups.summary_zh: 指将卷起、折叠或聚拢的物体向外伸展并摊开展平。
groups.desc_en: Involves expanding, rolling out, or spreading something from a folded, curled, or compact state into its full flat or extended dimension, contrasting with folding or contracting.
groups.desc_zh: 指将卷起、折叠或闭合的物体向外展开、展平至其完整平面或极限跨度，区别于卷缩或折叠。
groups.nuance_en: unfurl: releasing rolled or gathered cloth or banners so they wave or drape (flag / sail / banner) · splay: spreading digits or limbs wide and outward awkwardly (fingers / legs / feet) · outstretch: extending arms or wings outward to their full span (arms / hands / wings) · roll out: uncoiling or flattening along a surface (carpet / dough / map)
groups.nuance_zh: unfurl: 舒展旗帜、风帆等使之顺风铺展飘扬 (flag / sail / banner) · splay: 将手指或肢体向外叉开、呈八字展张 (fingers / legs / feet) · outstretch: 向外伸张至双臂或双翼最大开度 (arms / hands / wings) · roll out: 沿平面滚开铺平卷轴、地毯或面团 (carpet / dough / map)

groups.name: Unify & Fuse into Whole · 融合与熔合 (Meld, Amalgamate, Fuse)
groups.tip: 多物合为一体交融

items.def_en: [I/T] to combine components so that they function together as an integrated whole
items.ex_en: The architects designed the new system to integrate smoothly with existing municipal infrastructure.
items.ex_zh: 建筑师设计该新系统，使其能与现有的市政基础设施顺畅整合为一体。
items.ex2_en: The manager worked hard to integrate the new employees into the existing team.
items.ex2_zh: 经理努力将新员工融入现有的团队中。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to combine or merge distinct elements into a single harmonious whole
items.ex_en: Their contrasting vocal styles blend together to produce an exceptionally rich musical harmony.
items.ex_zh: 他们截然不同的演唱风格融为一体，产生了极为丰富和谐的音乐效果。
items.ex2_en: The chef blended together fresh herbs and olive oil to make delicious sauce.
items.ex2_zh: 厨师将新鲜香草与橄榄油融合在一起，调制出美味的酱汁。

items.def_en: to join or merge together to form a unified entity
items.ex_en: Disparate factions must come together to form a stable and enduring coalition government.
items.ex_zh: 不同的派别必须联合起来，以组建一个稳定持久的联合政府。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to join closely or firmly together into an organic whole
items.ex_en: Shared hardship helped knit together the isolated villagers into a fiercely resilient community.
items.ex_zh: 共同的苦难使偏远村民紧密结合成了一个极具韧性的整体。
items.ex2_en: The broken bones knit together well after several months in a sturdy cast.
items.ex2_zh: 在结实的石膏固定几个月后，折断的骨头愈合良好。

items.def_en: [I/T] to join together securely or permanently into a single entity, often as if melted
items.ex_en: Intense heat caused the two metal plates to fuse into a single block.
items.ex_zh: 高温使两块金属板熔合成了一个坚固的整体。
items.ex2_en: The technician used a laser to fuse the delicate glass tubes securely together.
items.ex2_zh: 技术人员使用激光将脆弱的玻璃管牢固地熔接在一起。

items.def_en: (+ with/into) To combine or blend smoothly together into a unified whole.
items.ex_en: Ancient traditions seamlessly meld with modern aspirations in this vibrant coastal city.
items.ex_zh: 在这座充满生机的沿海城市中，古老传统与现代抱负完美融为一体。
items.ex2_en: The artistic director melded classical orchestral melodies with modern electronic synthesizer beats.
items.ex2_zh: 艺术总监将古典管弦旋律与现代电子合成器节拍融合在一起。

items.def_en: (+ with) To join or merge two or more organizations, businesses, or things into a single unit.
items.ex_en: The board voted unanimously to amalgamate their regional branch with the parent enterprise.
items.ex_zh: 董事会一致投票同意将其区域分部与母公司合并为一体。
items.ex2_en: The two competing financial institutions amalgamated into a single corporation last December.
items.ex2_zh: 两家竞争的金融机构于去年十二月合并为一家独立公司。

items.def_en: (+ into) to grow or come together from disparate parts into a single mass
items.ex_en: Over decades, small scattered settlements began to coalesce into a sprawling urban center.
items.ex_zh: 数十年来，零星分散的定居点逐渐凝聚成一个不断扩张的城市中心。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe two or more distinct entities, substances, or concepts combining organically or structurally to form a unified, indivisible whole, differentiated primarily by formality and technical register.
groups.summary_zh: 表示不同要素结合为一个不可分割的统一个体，重在融为一体。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the seamless blending or metallurgical-style joining of diverse elements into a single harmonious or monolithic entity, distinct from loose physical aggregation.
groups.desc_zh: 指不同元素之间完全交融或熔接为浑然一体的新形态，区别于机械性的简单堆叠或分散杂凑。
groups.nuance_en: fuse: joining permanently through melting or intense heat/energy (metal / bones / ideas) · meld: blending smoothly and harmoniously together without sharp boundaries (flavors / styles / voices) · amalgamate: combining diverse organizations or elements into a coherent whole (companies / cultures / unions) · coalesce: gradually coming together to form a single larger mass or consensus (opinions / droplets / factions)
groups.nuance_zh: fuse: 借由高温、熔合或极强力量结为不可分割的整体 (metal / bones / ideas) · meld: 浑然天成地顺畅混合无突兀痕迹 (flavors / styles / voices) · amalgamate: 将不同组织或元素正式合并为统一实体 (companies / cultures / unions) · coalesce: 细小粒子、阵营或观点逐渐聚拢凝结成大整体 (opinions / droplets / factions)

groups.name: Utter Loudly & Raise a Racket · 呼喊与喧嚷 (Cry, Din, Clamor)
groups.tip: 因情绪激动扯开嗓子大叫

items.def_en: (+ sth) to speak or shout loudly so as to attract attention
items.ex_en: The lost hiker decided to call out loudly for help across the canyon.
items.ex_zh: 迷路的徒步旅行者决定隔着峡谷大声呼喊求救。

items.def_zh: 叫喊，大声呼叫；哭泣，流泪
items.def_en: 1. to shout or utter a loud call, exclamation, or sound. 2. to shed tears because of pain, sadness, or joy.
items.ex_en: The sentry had to cry a warning when shadowy figures approached the gate.
items.ex_zh: 当黑影靠近大门时，哨兵不得不大声发出警告。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ at/to) to utter words or sounds with maximum vocal volume
items.ex_en: The foreman had to shout over the deafening noise of the factory machinery.
items.ex_zh: 工头不得不盖过工厂机器震耳欲聋的轰鸣声高声大喊。

items.def_en: to make a loud sound or utter words loudly because of pain, fear, or urgency
items.ex_en: The injured player could not help but cry out when touching his knee.
items.ex_zh: 受伤的队员在碰到膝盖时忍不住痛得大叫出声。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to say sth in a sudden and very loud voice
items.ex_en: He couldn't resist shouting out the answer before the teacher called his name.
items.ex_zh: 老师还没点他的名字，他就忍不住大声喊出了答案。

items.def_zh: 大声喧闹，喧嚷；反复叮嘱，絮叨灌输
items.def_en: 1. to make a loud, unpleasant, or confusing noise. 2. to instill or repeat something wearyingly into someone's head.
items.ex_en: Sirens and barking hounds continued to din through the narrow medieval alleys tonight.
items.ex_zh: 今晚，警报声和猎犬的吠叫声在狭窄的中世纪小巷中喧嚣不绝。

items.def_zh: 大声喧哗，大声吵闹要求
items.def_en: (+ for/against) to make a loud and persistent outcry or demand with confusion and noise
items.ex_en: Angry citizens gathered outside city hall to clamor for immediate economic reforms.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的市民聚集在市政厅外，大声吵闹着要求立即进行经济改革。

items.def_en: [I/T] to emit a deep, loud, roaring shout or sound, typically in anger or pain
items.ex_en: The drill sergeant began to bellow orders at the exhausted recruits across the field.
items.ex_zh: 训练教官隔着操场对着筋疲力尽的新兵狂吼下达命令。

groups.summary_en: People emit powerful vocal shouts, vocalizations, or collective ear-splitting noises that overpower ambient sound or demand immediate attention.
groups.summary_zh: 发出响亮叫喊，或持续制造震耳欲聋、嘈杂喧闹的声响。
groups.desc_en: Involves projecting the human voice or a sonic outcry at maximum volume to express raw distress, command, or chaotic uproar, contrasting with quiet speech or whispering.
groups.desc_zh: 指极力提高嗓门放声高呼或制造喧嚣巨响以宣泄情绪或下达指令，区别于平和低语或静默耳语。
groups.nuance_en: cry: calling out sharply due to distress, pain, or urgent need (help / anguish / warning) · shout: projecting speech loudly and forcefully across a distance (orders / insult / name) · bellow: producing a deep, resonant, bull-like roar in fury or pain (rage / command / defiance) · clamor: loud, persistent, confused collective shouting or demanding (crowd / mob / press)
groups.nuance_zh: cry: 因悲痛、绝望或紧急求援而尖声哭喊哭叫 (help / anguish / warning) · shout: 扯开嗓门用力远距离大喊发号施令 (orders / insult / name) · bellow: 如公牛般浑厚、震耳欲聋地咆哮怒吼 (rage / command / defiance) · clamor: 众人七嘴八舌、喧闹不休地吵闹呼吁 (crowd / mob / press)

groups.name: Vary & Approximate · 跨度与趋近 (Range, Approximate, Fluctuate)
groups.tip: 数值在一定区间波动并趋近目标

items.def_en: to increase or move gradually and incrementally toward a higher figure
items.ex_en: Treasury bond yields edge up slightly ahead of the central bank policy announcement.
items.ex_zh: 在央行公布政策之前，国债收益率小幅缓慢攀升。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to stay or fluctuate near a particular amount, level, or approximate value
items.ex_en: Unemployment figures continue to hover around four percent despite ongoing industrial strikes.
items.ex_zh: 尽管罢工不断，失业率数据仍在百分之四上下徘徊浮动。

items.def_zh: 稳定在某个水平；趋于平稳
items.def_en: to stop fluctuating and remain steady at a certain approximate level
items.ex_en: Analysts expect skyrocketing housing prices to level off before the coming autumn months.
items.ex_zh: 分析师预计暴涨的房价将在秋季到来之前趋于平稳。

items.def_en: to come near to a specific quantity, figure, or condition in degree or number
items.ex_en: Total vehicle sales approach nearly ten million units by the fourth quarter.
items.ex_zh: 截至第四季度，汽车总销量已接近近千万辆的关口。

items.def_zh: （在一定范围内）变动，变化；漫游；排列
items.def_en: 1. (+ from/between) To vary between certain limits or along a numerical scale. 2. To wander or travel freely over an area.
items.ex_en: Nighttime temperatures in the high desert range between freezing cold and mild warmth.
items.ex_zh: 这片高地沙漠的夜间温度在冰点与微温之间变动。

items.def_en: To be almost equal to or very close to something in amount, quality, or nature.
items.ex_en: The experimental measurements approximate theoretical predictions made by leading quantum physicists.
items.ex_zh: 这些实验测量数据极其接近顶尖量子物理学家所做的理论预测。

items.def_en: to rise and fall irregularly in number, level, or price within limits
items.ex_en: Gasoline prices fluctuate unpredictably during periods of severe global political instability.
items.ex_zh: 在全球政局严重不稳定的时期，汽油价格往往会出现不可预测的上下波动。

items.def_en: (+ between) to fluctuate continually between two fixed points, extremes, or values
items.ex_en: Voter preferences continually oscillate between fiscal conservatism and expansive social spending.
items.ex_zh: 选民的倾向在财政保守主义与扩张性社会支出之间不断摆动。

groups.summary_en: This scalar frame governs expressions of numerical extent, variation across bounds, or estimation toward a target value. 'Range' details distribution between specified limits, while 'approximate' denotes approaching a value or standard closely without exact convergence.
groups.summary_zh: 表示数值在界限内跨越分布，或在量级与标准上逐步趋近估值。
groups.desc_en: Denotes shifting irregularly within a boundary or drawing closer toward a specific numerical or qualitative benchmark, contrasting with staying strictly constant.
groups.desc_zh: 指在一定区间内波动游移或逐渐向某一标尺、数值靠拢，区别于绝对的恒定不变。
groups.nuance_en: range: extending across varying limits from a minimum to a maximum (temperature / prices / age) · fluctuate: moving irregularly up and down without stable pattern (rates / currencies / mood) · approximate: coming very close to an exact figure, quality, or standard (perfection / speed / truth) · oscillate: swinging steadily back and forth between two distinct states (pendulum / feelings / policies)
groups.nuance_zh: range: 在极值区间内横跨浮动 (temperature / prices / age) · fluctuate: 不规则地上蹿下跳、剧烈起伏 (rates / currencies / mood) · approximate: 极度贴近某精确数值、标准或特质 (perfection / speed / truth) · oscillate: 在截然相反的两极间有规律地摆动犹豫 (pendulum / feelings / policies)

groups.name: Violent Surge & Forceful Charge · 冲撞与猛冲 (Rush, Storm, Charge)
groups.tip: 快步猛冲疾驰而去

items.def_en: [I/T] to rush aggressively forward in an attack or headlong movement
items.ex_en: Mounted knights prepared to charge directly into the enemy line at dawn.
items.ex_zh: 骑兵们准备在黎明时分直接向敌方阵线猛冲突击。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to rush in a clumsy, rude, or forcefully forceful manner
items.ex_en: He did not knock before deciding to barge into the private conference room.
items.ex_zh: 在决定猛冲乱撞闯进私人会议室之前，他根本没有敲门。

items.def_en: to rush or charge inside an area in a furiously agitated, aggressive manner
items.ex_en: The furious manager proceeded to storm in and demand an immediate explanation.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的经理气势汹汹地冲了进来，要求立即给出合理解释。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to rush or charge aggressively and violently toward or into sth
items.ex_en: The runaway truck seemed ready to tear into the delicate glass storefront.
items.ex_zh: 失控的卡车似乎马上就要猛烈撞进脆弱的玻璃店面。

items.def_zh: 气冲冲地疾走，猛冲；突袭，攻占
items.def_en: 1. To move or rush somewhere in an angry, aggressive manner. 2. To attack and capture a place by sudden, direct force.
items.ex_en: Protesters threatened to storm the fortified gates if their demands were ignored.
items.ex_zh: 抗议者威胁称，如果他们的诉求被无视，他们将强行攻占防御坚固的大门。

items.def_zh: 猛冲，疾驰，奔跑；匆忙行事；催促，仓促处理
items.def_en: 1. To move, run, or go somewhere with great speed. 2. To do something hurriedly or force someone to act too quickly.
items.ex_en: Paramedics had to rush across the crowded platform toward the collapsed passenger.
items.ex_zh: 医护人员不得不飞速冲过拥挤的站台，奔向晕倒的乘客。
items.ex2_en: The nurses rushed the critical patient directly into the emergency operating room.
items.ex2_zh: 护士们火速将病危患者直接送入急诊手术室。

items.def_zh: 呼啸猛冲；高速不可阻挡地前冲
items.def_en: (+ down/through) to move at high speed without stopping for obstacles
items.ex_en: We watched the speeding freight train barrel through the deserted rural station.
items.ex_zh: 我们注视着那列超速货运火车呼啸着猛冲穿过荒无人烟的乡村车站。

items.def_en: [I/T] to surge in a wild, panicked headlong rush, especially as a crowd or herd
items.ex_en: A sudden crack of lightning caused the wild herd to stampede blindly.
items.ex_zh: 一道突然的炸雷吓得狂躁的兽群盲目地溃冲惊奔起来。
items.ex2_en: Gunfire stampeded the wild horses across the open plains in pure terror.
items.ex2_zh: 枪声吓得野马群在开阔的原野上惊恐奔逃。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe moving with forceful, aggressive momentum driven by urgency or rage, ranging from hurried rushing to explosive, tempestuous charges.
groups.summary_zh: 描述带有冲劲、怒气或紧迫性由快走升级为狂暴冲击的运动。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on explosive, fast-moving physical rushes forward marked by sheer mass or aggressive momentum, contrasting with cautious stalking or orderly advancing.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重于倚仗速度、体量或凶猛势头进行具有冲击性的向前奔袭，区别于审慎的潜行或有序的列队推进。
groups.nuance_en: charge: rushing forward aggressively to attack or confront (enemy / target / barrier) · storm: violently and furiously invading an enclosed place (building / barricade / palace) · barrel: hurtling uncontrollably and heavily at reckless speed (train / truck / downhill) · stampede: panicked, wild, crushing rush of a large mass (crowd / cattle / herd)
groups.nuance_zh: charge: 直奔攻击目标发起具毁灭性的猛烈冲锋 (enemy / target / barrier) · storm: 狂暴迅猛地强攻冲杀进密闭空间 (building / barricade / palace) · barrel: 如沉重木桶般横冲直撞、势不可挡地狂飙 (train / truck / downhill) · stampede: 极度恐慌失控的大群狂奔踩踏 (crowd / cattle / herd)

groups.name: Wake & Awaken from Sleep · 醒来与唤醒 (Wake & Awaken)
groups.tip: 从睡梦中醒来或催促醒来

items.def_zh: 醒来，唤醒（最常用标准词）
items.def_en: to stop sleeping or make someone stop sleeping; become conscious after sleep
items.ex_en: Please tread softly so you do not wake the exhausted baby upstairs.
items.ex_zh: 请轻点走，免得吵醒楼上疲倦熟睡的婴儿。
items.ex2_en: She woke early every morning to watch the sunrise over the ocean.
items.ex2_zh: 她每天清晨早早醒来，观看海上日出。

items.def_zh: 醒来，叫醒（口语核心动词短语）
items.def_en: to cease sleeping or cause someone to cease sleeping, especially in everyday speech
items.ex_en: The alarm didn't go off, so I didn't wake up until eight.
items.ex_zh: 闹钟没响，所以我直到八点才醒。
items.ex2_en: The gentle morning sunshine woke up the campers sleeping inside their tents.
items.ex2_zh: 清晨柔和的阳光唤醒了在帐篷里熟睡的露营者。

items.def_en: (+ sb) To arouse someone from deep sleep, lethargy, or inactivity
items.ex_en: The sharp cold water helped stir up the drowsy watchman on duty.
items.ex_zh: 冰凉刺骨的冷水让值班时昏昏欲睡的守卫猛然清醒过来。

items.def_en: To awaken or regain consciousness after fainting, anesthesia, or sleep
items.ex_en: It took several anxious minutes for the fainting athlete to come round.
items.ex_zh: 昏厥过去的运动员过了令人焦急的几分钟才渐渐恢复知觉。

items.def_zh: （使）醒来，唤醒；唤起（记忆、情感等）；觉察，意识到
items.def_en: 1. (formal or literary) to wake up from sleep, or to make someone wake up 2. to stir up or arouse an emotion, interest, or memory
items.ex_en: The distant morning bells gently awaken the sleepy villagers from their slumber.
items.ex_zh: 远方清晨的钟声轻柔地将沉睡的村民从睡梦中唤醒。
items.ex2_en: He awakened to the cheerful sound of birds singing outside his bedroom window.
items.ex2_zh: 他在卧室窗外小鸟欢快的鸣叫声中醒来。

items.def_en: to wake someone up from deep sleep, unconsciousness, or lethargy
items.ex_en: No amount of loud banging could rouse him from that deep exhaustion.
items.ex_zh: 任凭怎么大声敲门，也无法将他从极度疲惫的沉睡中叫醒。

items.def_zh: （使）再度醒来；（使）再次唤醒，重新激起
items.def_en: to wake up again, or to make someone wake up again; to revive a feeling or memory
items.ex_en: Gentle morning sun rays through the blinds reawaken him from brief dreams.
items.ex_zh: 穿过百叶窗的柔和晨光再次将他从短暂的睡梦中唤醒。
items.ex2_en: Her deep artistic passion reawakened during her long summer holiday in Venice.
items.ex2_zh: 在威尼斯的漫长暑假期间，她深厚的艺术热情重新苏醒了。

items.def_en: (formal or literary) to stop sleeping, or to wake someone from sleep
items.ex_en: A soft knock upon the chamber door did waken the sleeping princess.
items.ex_zh: 卧房门上一声轻柔的叩击，唤醒了沉睡中的公主。
items.ex2_en: The tired traveler wakened suddenly at the strange noise outside the cabin.
items.ex2_zh: 疲惫的旅行者被小木屋外的奇怪声响突然惊醒。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe stirring from sleep or rousing someone from an unconscious state, used both literally for slumber and figuratively for alertness or spiritual revival. Nuances range from ordinary physical waking to elevated, literary, or poetic awakening.
groups.summary_zh: 从睡眠中苏醒或唤醒他人，涵盖日常睡眠苏醒至书面/诗意化的顿悟觉醒。
groups.desc_en: Marks the physiological transition from unconscious sleep to conscious sensory alertness, distinct from falling asleep or merely remaining idle.
groups.desc_zh: 指机体由无意识的沉睡状态过渡进入感知警觉的清醒状态，区别于入眠或仅是放空发呆。
groups.nuance_en: wake: basic cessation of sleep, becoming conscious (morning / nightmare / dawn) · awaken: formal, literary, or figurative opening of eyes/awareness (consciousness / senses / populace) · rouse: forcefully shaking or rousing someone out of deep sleep or apathy (sleeper / troops / spirit) · come round: slowly regaining consciousness after fainting, coma, or anesthesia (patient / boxer / survivor)
groups.nuance_zh: wake: 基础的结束睡眠、睁眼醒转 (morning / nightmare / dawn) · awaken: 书面或比喻性的被动唤醒意识、感官或觉悟 (consciousness / senses / populace) · rouse: 用力推摇、惊醒沉睡者或提振懈怠情绪 (sleeper / troops / spirit) · come round: 晕厥、麻醉或重击后逐渐苏醒恢复知觉 (patient / boxer / survivor)

groups.name: Whip & Scourge · 鞭笞与严酷体罚 (Flog, Scourge, Welt)
groups.tip: 挥舞皮鞭惩戒抽打

items.def_en: (+ at sb) To strike out violently at someone with or as if with a whip
items.ex_en: The cornered outlaw began to lash out wildly at guards with his riding whip.
items.ex_zh: 走投无路的亡命徒开始用马鞭向守卫们疯狂地甩鞭抽打。

items.def_en: to strike repeatedly with a flexible lash or strap as a punishment
items.ex_en: Cruel overseers would regularly whip runaway slaves as a warning to others.
items.ex_zh: 残暴的监工常常用皮鞭抽打逃跑的奴隶，以此杀鸡儆猴。

items.def_en: to strike someone forcefully with a whip, cord, or sudden blow
items.ex_en: The driver used a flexible leather strap to lash the stubborn donkey.
items.ex_zh: 车夫用一根柔软的皮带狠狠抽打了那头倔强的驴子。

items.def_en: (+ sb) To physically assault someone with repeated, severe punitive blows
items.ex_en: Brawlers began to lay into the defenseless stranger outside the crowded tavern.
items.ex_zh: 闹事者们在拥挤的酒馆外开始对着毫无防备的陌生人痛打狠揍。

items.def_en: to beat someone as judicial or formal punishment using a bundle of birch twigs
items.ex_en: Historically, naval courts would sometimes birch young offenders for minor disciplinary breaches.
items.ex_zh: 历史上，海军法庭有时会对违反轻微纪律的年轻罪犯施以桦条抽打体罚。

items.def_zh: 鞭笞，严刑拷打；（英，非正式）兜售，变卖
items.def_en: 1. to beat someone severely with a whip or stick as a punishment. 2. (informal, chiefly BrE) to sell something quickly or cheaply.
items.ex_en: The harsh colonial judge sentenced the convicted pirate to be publicly flogged.
items.ex_zh: 严酷的殖民地法官判处这名被定罪的海盗接受公开鞭笞体罚。

items.def_zh: 鞭笞，鞭打；使受苦难，折磨，蹂躏
items.def_en: 1. to whip someone severely as a punishment. 2. to cause great pain, suffering, or devastation to a place or people.
items.ex_en: Brutal prison guards would scourge helpless captives until they yielded vital secrets.
items.ex_zh: 残暴的狱卒会严刑鞭笞无助的俘虏，直到他们吐露关键机密。

items.def_zh: 鞭打，痛打（在皮肤上打出红肿条痕）；给……加贴边
items.def_en: 1. to beat heavily, leaving raised red marks on the skin. 2. to sew a reinforcing strip (welt) onto a shoe or garment.
items.ex_en: The abusive master would welt the poor apprentice whenever minor mistakes occurred.
items.ex_zh: 每当出现微小的差错，那个虐待狂师傅就会狠命痛打可怜的学徒致其皮开肉绽。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify administering severe physical blows to an individual's body using a whip, lash, or rod, causing welt marks, deep lacerations, or intense punitive suffering.
groups.summary_zh: 指用皮鞭、棍杖等严酷抽打肉体并留下伤痕的肉刑或暴行。
groups.desc_en: Involves striking the body repeatedly with a flexible, sharp implement (whip, rod) as severe corporal punishment or torture, distinct from blunt punching or kicking.
groups.desc_zh: 指利用软鞭、条杖等柔韧或带刺器械反复抽打肉体进行严酷惩戒或折磨，区别于钝性的拳打脚踢。
groups.nuance_en: whip: striking sharply with a lash, strap, or flexible cord (horse / prisoner / back) · flog: beating repeatedly and severely as judicial punishment (convict / sailor / back) · scourge: severely punishing or torturing with a multi-thonged whip; figuratively afflicting (flesh / nation / plague) · welt: striking so hard as to raise swollen, raised red ridges on the skin (skin / flesh / thighs)
groups.nuance_zh: whip: 用皮鞭或细软带状物清脆凶狠地抽打 (horse / prisoner / back) · flog: 作为正式体罚反复且残酷地杖刑或鞭刑 (convict / sailor / back) · scourge: 用带刺皮鞭抽得皮开肉绽，引申为使生灵涂炭 (flesh / nation / plague) · welt: 狠辣抽打使皮肤隆起道道红肿伤痕 (skin / flesh / thighs)

groups.name: Whittle & Chisel · 削制与凿刻 (Whittle, Chisel, Sculpt)
groups.tip: 运刀切削，雕琢材料成型

items.def_en: (+ at sth / + sth) to cut small pieces off wood or other solid material using a knife; gradually reduce by trimming
items.ex_en: The old woodcarver sat quietly to whittle away excess timber from the figurine.
items.ex_zh: 老木雕师静静地坐着，一点点削掉小雕像上多余的木料。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to carve or shape an object down to size by shaving away outer layers
items.ex_en: He whittled down the thick pine branch until it fit neatly into the socket.
items.ex_zh: 他削细了粗松木枝，直到它能严丝合缝地插进插孔里。

items.def_zh: 削（木头），雕削；削减，逐渐减少
items.def_en: 1. (+ down/away) To carve wood gradually by cutting off thin shavings; to reduce a number, list, or cost steadily.
items.ex_en: The craftsman whittled soft cedar wood by the porch as the evening grew cooler.
items.ex_zh: 傍晚天气转凉时，手艺人在门廊边削着软雪松木。

items.def_en: to cut away the outer surface or edges of something with a sharp knife
items.ex_en: Use a sharp paring knife to pare the bruised rind from each pear.
items.ex_zh: 用锋利的小刀削去每个梨子碰伤的表皮。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to cut, carve, or hollow out wood or stone with a chisel to form a shape
items.ex_en: The sculptor carefully chiseled out the delicate facial features from the marble block.
items.ex_zh: 雕刻家小心翼翼地从大理石块中凿出精致的面部轮廓。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to carve, scoop, or dig out the interior of a solid material to make it empty
items.ex_en: Ancient tribes hollowed out massive tree trunks to construct sturdy river canoes.
items.ex_zh: 古代部落将粗大的树干挖空，制成结实的内河独木舟。
items.ex2_en: The limestone cliffs hollowed out over centuries from constant relentless ocean waves.
items.ex2_zh: 几个世纪以来，在持续无情的海浪冲刷下，石灰岩悬崖逐渐凹陷空洞化。

items.def_en: 1. To cut or carve wood or stone using a chisel. 2. (informal) To cheat or swindle someone out of money.
items.ex_en: The mason chiseled the sandstone block into a smooth, rectangular step.
items.ex_zh: 石匠用凿子将砂岩块雕成平整的长方形台阶。

items.def_en: to make a deep hole or groove in a surface using a sharp or curved tool
items.ex_en: The stray dog gouged deep scratches into the wooden front door with its claws.
items.ex_zh: 那只流浪狗用爪子在前木门上抓出了深深的划痕。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote shaping, trimming, or carving solid materials (especially wood or stone) by using sharp hand tools in specific manual cutting motions.
groups.summary_zh: 使用手持刀凿工具对木、石等硬质材料进行削切塑造。
groups.desc_en: Involves subtractive reduction or shaping of a solid material via small cutting or chiseling actions, unlike generic cutting which severs or divides in single strokes.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及通过细微切削或凿刻对固体材料进行渐进式减法成型或缩减，不同于一刀切断的普通切割。
groups.nuance_en: whittle: shave wood gradually with a knife (wood / stick / figurine) · chisel: cut or shape hard material with a beveled tool (stone / marble / statue) · gouge: scoop out deep, rough grooves forcefully (groove / channel / eye) · pare: trim away thin outer layers or excess (rind / fingernails / costs)
groups.nuance_zh: whittle: 用刀轻柔渐进削木成型 (wood / stick / figurine) · chisel: 用凿子重力刻削硬质材料 (stone / marble / statue) · gouge: 强力挖出深槽或凹坑 (groove / channel / eye) · pare: 削去薄层外皮或逐步削减多余部分 (rind / fingernails / costs)

groups.name: Winter & Casual Travel Modes · 雪橇与便车出行 (Sleigh, Snowmobile, Hitchhike)
groups.tip: 搭车或驾驶载具出行

items.def_en: To travel aimlessly and casually from place to place without fixed plans
items.ex_en: We bummed around several small ski towns after finishing our seasonal lodge jobs.
items.ex_zh: 结束度假屋的季节性工作后，我们在几个滑雪小镇间随性晃荡。

items.def_en: To travel along a route by getting free rides in passing vehicles
items.ex_en: He hitched along the snowy highway, hoping a passing truck would stop soon.
items.ex_zh: 他沿着积雪的公路一路搭便车前行，希望过路的卡车能快点停下。

items.def_en: to travel across ice or snow on a runner-mounted sled
items.ex_en: The children sledded across the frozen pond until twilight covered the valley.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们乘着雪橇在结冰的池塘上滑行，直到薄暮笼罩山谷。

items.def_en: to drive or travel with a dog sled across snow
items.ex_en: The expedition team mushed through the fierce blizzard toward the remote cabin.
items.ex_zh: 探险队赶着狗拉雪橇穿过狂暴的风雪，朝偏远的木屋前行。

items.def_en: to travel or transport someone or something in a sleigh over snow.
items.ex_en: They sleighed across the snowy meadow, bundled together under heavy wool blankets.
items.ex_zh: 他们裹在厚羊毛毯下，乘着雪橇穿过覆雪的草甸。

items.def_zh: 骑雪地摩托，乘雪上机动车旅行
items.def_en: to travel or ride on a snowmobile.
items.ex_en: Rangers snowmobiled along the frozen ridgeline to inspect isolated telephone poles.
items.ex_zh: 护林员骑着雪地摩托沿着冰封的山脊巡视孤立的电线杆。

items.def_en: to travel by asking passing drivers for free rides in their vehicles.
items.ex_en: He decided to hitchhike through the mountains instead of paying for the train.
items.ex_zh: 他决定一路搭便车穿过山区，而不是花钱坐火车。

items.def_en: to coast down a snow-covered slope on a long, flat wooden toboggan
items.ex_en: We tobogganed down the steep hillside, shouting with excitement the entire way.
items.ex_zh: 我们乘着长平底雪橇从陡峭的山坡冲下，一路上兴奋地大叫。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe traversing snowy winter terrain via specialized sliding or tracked vehicles, or securing opportunistic passage by soliciting lifts along public roadways.
groups.summary_zh: 指利用冬季特种载具在雪地前行，或在公路招手搭顺风车出行。
groups.desc_en: Encompasses specialized snow-bound locomotion or opportunistic vehicle hitching, distinguished from standard driving or walking by seasonal equipment or reliance on passing transit.
groups.desc_zh: 涵盖依托冰雪特制工具或借乘过路载具的非典型出行方式，不同于常规的驱车或步行。
groups.nuance_en: sled: coast over snow or ice on runners (hill / slope / snow) · snowmobile: travel on an engine-powered tracked snow vehicle (backcountry / trail / tundra) · mush: command and drive a dog-sled team (dogs / team / tundra) · hitchhike: solicit free rides from passing motor vehicles (highway / route / lift)
groups.nuance_zh: sled: 乘雪橇在雪坡上滑行 (hill / slope / snow) · snowmobile: 驾驶机动雪地车行进 (backcountry / trail / tundra) · mush: 驱赶并驾驭狗拉雪橇 (dogs / team / tundra) · hitchhike: 在路边拦车搭便车 (highway / route / lift)

groups.name: Withhold & Hold Back · 扣留与拒给 (Withhold, Retain, Keep Back)
groups.tip: 拒不给出或留在自己手中

items.def_en: to keep possession of something rather than returning or surrendering it
items.ex_en: The embassy will retain your original passport until the security review concludes.
items.ex_zh: 在大使馆的安全审查结束之前，他们将保留您的护照原件。

items.def_en: (+ obj) to refuse to give or reveal something, keeping it in reserve or secret
items.ex_en: The witness kept back crucial details about the incident during initial questioning.
items.ex_zh: 证人在最初的询问中隐瞒了有关该事件的关键细节。

items.def_en: (+ obj) to withhold information, payment, or goods instead of delivering them
items.ex_en: The firm held back the final settlement payment until inspection was complete.
items.ex_zh: 该公司扣下了最终结算款项，直到质检彻底完成。

items.def_en: (+ sb) To refuse to give expected information, money, or goods to someone who is entitled to it
items.ex_en: I know you have more information—don't hold out on me.
items.ex_zh: 我知道你还掌握更多信息——别对我隐瞒。

items.def_zh: 搁置压下，扣押（文件等）不发
items.def_en: (+ sth) To deliberately delay dealing with, releasing, or surrendering documents, funds, or news
items.ex_en: The committee sat on the audit findings for weeks before informing shareholders.
items.ex_zh: 委员会将审计结果压了数周，迟迟不向股东通报。

items.def_zh: 扣留，保留，拒绝给予；隐瞒；克制
items.def_en: (+ from) To refuse to give, grant, or disclose something that is due, requested, or expected.
items.ex_en: The insurer cannot legally withhold approved compensation from eligible policyholders.
items.ex_zh: 保险公司依法不得扣留给予符合条件投保人的已批复赔偿金。

items.def_zh: 扣留，保留，拒绝给予（withhold的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of withhold; to have deliberately held back, refused to grant, or retained.
items.ex_en: The supervisor withheld vital operational data from the board during the audit.
items.ex_zh: 主管在审计期间向董事会隐瞒了重要的运营数据。

items.def_en: to seize and hold property or goods by official or legal authority
items.ex_en: Authorities impounded the unregistered cargo ship following the customs inspection.
items.ex_zh: 海关检查后，当局扣押了那艘未注册的货船。

groups.summary_en: Refers to intentionally declining to give, surrender, or transfer money, documents, or information that is due, expected, or claimed by someone else. The emphasis is on active non-disclosure or refusal to release rather than mere passive ownership.
groups.summary_zh: 指蓄意扣留、拒绝移交或压下应给付的金钱、证物或信息。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the deliberate refusal or restraint in releasing possessions, money, or information, contrasting with mere non-giving by emphasizing an existing claim, duty, or entitlement.
groups.desc_zh: 指故意压扣、隐瞒或拒不交出财物或信息，区别于单纯不给，强调违背交付义务或应有权利。
groups.nuance_en: withhold: systematically refuse to grant or release due items (consent / tax / information) · retain: keep possession of what one already holds (lawyer / control / custody) · hold out on: informally conceal secrets or share from an associate (partner / friend / truth) · impound: legally seize and hold property by authority (vehicle / document / contraband)
groups.nuance_zh: withhold: 依法或制度性拒不发放、扣留 (consent / tax / information) · retain: 继续保有并控制已有之物 (lawyer / control / custody) · hold out on: 口语中对同伴隐瞒私藏 (partner / friend / truth) · impound: 执法或主管机关依法查扣充公 (vehicle / document / contraband)

groups.name: Wrap in Flexible Bands · 缠裹与襁褓包扎 (Swaddle, Swathe, Bandage)
groups.tip: 用织物层层包扎裹紧

items.def_zh: 用襁褓包裹（婴儿）；裹紧，束缚
items.def_en: 1. (+ in) To wrap a newborn baby tightly in cloth or a blanket. 2. To wrap or bind something securely.
items.ex_en: The nurse swaddled the newborn infant gently in a warm flannel blanket.
items.ex_zh: 护士用温暖的法兰绒毛毯将新生儿轻柔地包裹起来。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to tie or wrap bandages securely around an injury or body part
items.ex_en: The paramedic carefully bound up the deep wound to stem the bleeding.
items.ex_zh: 医护人员小心地包扎好深伤口以止血。

items.def_en: (+ sb) to wrap someone warmly and snugly in layers of clothing or blankets
items.ex_en: Make sure you bundle up the kids before they go outside into the snow.
items.ex_zh: 在孩子们跑出去玩雪之前，一定要把他们裹得严严实实的。
items.ex2_en: The tourists bundled up against the freezing arctic wind before leaving the lodge.
items.ex2_zh: 游客们离开木屋前裹紧衣服，以抵御北极刺骨的寒风。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to cover or swaddle someone or something thoroughly in warm or protective cloth
items.ex_en: Let's wrap up this meeting so everyone can catch their flights.
items.ex_zh: 我们结束这次会议吧，这样大家都能赶上航班。

items.def_en: to wrap or wind a band, rope, or cloth tightly around someone or something
items.ex_en: The medic used clean linen strips to bind the traveler's sprained ankle.
items.ex_zh: 军医用干净的亚麻布条紧紧缠裹住旅行者扭伤的脚踝。

items.def_en: to bind or wrap an injured part of the body with a strip of protective cloth
items.ex_en: She quickly bandaged her arm after scraping it against the wire fence.
items.ex_zh: 手臂在铁丝网栅栏上擦伤后，她迅速用绷带将其包扎起来。

items.def_en: (+ in/with) to wrap someone or something up warmly, thickly, or protectively
items.ex_en: She muffled her face with a heavy scarf to fend off the biting frost.
items.ex_zh: 她用厚厚的围巾严严实实地裹住脸，以抵御刺骨的严寒。

items.def_en: 1. (+ in) To wrap or bind someone or something completely in cloth, bandages, or other material. 2. To envelop or surround completely.
items.ex_en: Thick autumn mists swathed the silent valley in an ethereal white veil.
items.ex_zh: 浓重的秋雾将寂静的山谷笼罩在一层缥缈的白纱之中。

groups.summary_en: An agent winds long, supple strips of fabric, bandages, or soft coverings around a body or object in continuous overlapping layers. Manner distinctions contrast immobilizing infants in snug cloths (swaddle) against enveloping broadly in long wraps or winding shrouds (swathe) and winding medical dressings (bandage).
groups.summary_zh: 指用布帛、绷带等柔性材料对肢体或物体进行层层包裹缠扎。
groups.desc_en: Refers to enveloping or encasing a body or limb in multiple layers of flexible fabric or bindings, differing from simple covering by the snug, binding, and restrictive manner.
groups.desc_zh: 指用多层柔软织物或带状物紧密包覆躯体或肢体，区别于普通覆盖，强调紧裹、缠缚与约束性。
groups.nuance_en: swaddle: wrap an infant tightly in cloths to limit movement (infant / newborn / baby) · bandage: bind an injured part with sterile strips for healing (wound / ankle / limb) · swathe: wrap or envelop fully in broad wraps or mist (body / head / mist) · muffle: deaden sound or protect against cold by thick wrapping (throat / voice / ears)
groups.nuance_zh: swaddle: 用布紧紧包裹婴儿以束缚肢体 (infant / newborn / baby) · bandage: 用绷带包扎伤口以促愈合 (wound / ankle / limb) · swathe: 用大片布料或雾气层层裹覆 (body / head / mist) · muffle: 用厚物紧裹以保暖或消音 (throat / voice / ears)

groups.name: Write & Craft Literary Works · 写作与文艺创作 (Compose, Pen, Author)
groups.tip: 构思创作文艺谱写作品

items.def_zh: 撰写，著述（书籍、报告或方案）
items.def_en: to write or be the original creator of a book, report, or official document
items.ex_en: The professor authored a comprehensive report detailing sustainable urban development.
items.ex_zh: 这位教授撰写了一份详尽阐述城市可持续发展的综合报告。

items.def_zh: 起草，拟定（文稿、诗文初稿）
items.def_en: to prepare a preliminary version of a piece of writing or speech
items.ex_en: She sat down to draft an outline for her upcoming conference presentation.
items.ex_zh: 她坐下来为即将召开的会议发言拟定提纲初稿。

items.def_zh: 执笔写下；创作（文章、信件、诗词）
items.def_en: to write or compose a literary piece, letter, or article by hand or with care
items.ex_en: The reclusive poet penned verses of sorrow beneath the pale moonlight.
items.ex_zh: 这位隐世的诗人在清冷的月光下执笔写下哀伤的诗篇。

items.def_zh: 创作，谱写（乐曲、诗歌、信件等）；组成，构成；使平静
items.def_en: 1. to write or produce a piece of music, poetry, or text. 2. to make up or form something. 3. to calm oneself or one's feelings.
items.ex_en: The maestro composed an evocative string quartet during his retreat in Salzburg.
items.ex_zh: 这位音乐大师在萨尔茨堡休养期间创作了一首极富感染力的弦乐四重奏。

items.def_zh: 写诗，作诗，用诗表达；使精通（常用于 be versed in）
items.def_en: 1. to write poetry or express something in metrical verse. 2. (usually passive: 'be versed in') to be skilled or knowledgeable in a subject.
items.ex_en: The bard versed the tragic tale of lost lovers in rhyming stanzas.
items.ex_zh: 吟游诗人用押韵的诗节作诗倾诉失落恋人的悲情故事。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to compose a full, structured piece of writing based on notes or ideas
items.ex_en: The analyst will write up a formal assessment once all lab results arrive.
items.ex_zh: 一旦所有化验结果出炉，分析员就会撰写出一份正式评估报告。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to write or compose a letter, poem, or literary piece quickly and with little effort
items.ex_en: He dashed off a quick thank-you note before sprinting to catch his train.
items.ex_zh: 他在飞奔赶火车之前，匆匆写就了一封简短的感谢信。

items.def_zh: 创作出，产出（大量文章或作品）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to produce a quantity of written, musical, or artistic work steadily
items.ex_en: The prolific author turned out two bestselling detective novels in one year.
items.ex_zh: 这位多产的作家在一年之内接连创作出两部畅销侦探小说。

groups.summary_en: Refers to producing written literary, poetic, or musical works with conscious artistry and deliberate craft. Verbs range from general formal composition ('compose', 'author') to poetic or stylistic crafting ('verse', 'pen').
groups.summary_zh: 强调带有技巧与文学修养地撰写诗文、乐曲或著作。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on the intellectual creation and formal production of texts, contrasting with mundane transcription or typing by its emphasis on authorship, style, and structure.
groups.desc_zh: 聚焦于文本的智力构思与文体创作，区别于机械抄写或敲字，强调原创构思、文风与谋篇布局。
groups.nuance_en: author: create an original text or policy as primary originator (book / report / legislation) · pen: physically or personally write a polished piece (letter / missive / memoir) · compose: painstakingly arrange words or verse with artistic care (poem / speech / essay) · draft: write a preliminary or structural version (contract / bill / outline)
groups.nuance_zh: author: 作为主要创作者撰写出书或制定政策 (book / report / legislation) · pen: 亲笔挥毫写就信件或文稿 (letter / missive / memoir) · compose: 讲究修辞与章法地构思谱写 (poem / speech / essay) · draft: 拟定起草初稿或框架 (contract / bill / outline)

groups.name: Acoustic Resonance & Lingering Echo · 声响回荡与共鸣 (Resonate, Resound, Reiterate)
groups.tip: 回响振荡在耳畔久久不绝

items.def_en: [I/T] to send back or repeat sound by reflection of sound waves
items.ex_en: The church bells echoed across the silent valley at dawn.
items.ex_zh: 破晓时分，教堂的钟声在寂静的山谷中回荡。
items.ex2_en: The tall canyon walls echoed her loud cries across the rocky expanse.
items.ex2_zh: 高耸的峡谷石壁在岩石遍布的原野上回荡着她的大声呼喊。

items.def_en: to produce a loud, clear sound that carries across a distance
items.ex_en: A single gunshot rang out suddenly through the quiet mountain pass.
items.ex_zh: 寂静的山口中突然响亮传开了一声清脆的枪响。

items.def_en: to resound or reverberate back from a distant surface or across a space
items.ex_en: His desperate shouts echoed back from the sheer granite cliff across the canyon.
items.ex_zh: 他绝望的呼喊声从峡谷对岸陡峭的花岗岩悬崖上回荡过来。

items.def_en: of a sound, to remain audible across a distance or continue to reverberate
items.ex_en: Unused vacation days cannot be carried over into the next calendar year.
items.ex_zh: 未休的年假不能顺延至下一日历年。

items.def_zh: 共振，产生共鸣；引起反响
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To produce or be filled with a deep, full, vibrating sound. 2. (+ with) To evoke an emotional response or shared feeling.
items.ex_en: Her poignant words resonated deeply within the hearts of everyone present.
items.ex_zh: 她感人肺腑的话语在在场每个人的内心深处引起了强烈共鸣。

items.def_en: 1. (+ with/through) To fill a place with sound or echo loudly. 2. To be widely celebrated, praised, or proclaimed.
items.ex_en: Triumphant cheers resounded throughout the ancient stone halls of the castle.
items.ex_zh: 胜利的欢呼声在城堡古老的石制大殿中回响不绝。

items.def_en: (of a loud noise) to be repeated several times as an echo throughout a space
items.ex_en: Thunder reverberated through the cavernous hall, shaking dust from the chandeliers.
items.ex_zh: 雷声在空旷如洞穴的大厅里反复回荡，震落了吊灯上的灰尘。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe deep, vibrating sounds echoing through a space, filling an area with persistent reverberation, or evoking a deeply felt parallel in memory or meaning.
groups.summary_zh: 深沉的声音在空间中回荡、充满振鸣，或在精神层面引发共鸣。
groups.desc_en: Depicts sound vibrating across physical or cognitive spaces with prolonged acoustic presence, contrasting with transient noises by sustained repetition and resonance.
groups.desc_zh: 描述声音在物理或心理空间中震荡延续，区别于瞬时发声，强调回响的持久、回荡与共振。
groups.nuance_en: reverberate: echo repeatedly in an enclosed physical or emotional space (hall / valley / shockwave) · resound: fill a space with loud, triumphant sonic vibration (applause / voice / brass) · resonate: evoke sympathetic acoustic vibration or deep emotional alignment (chord / theme / message) · echo: bounce sound waves directly off a surface (canyon / voice / footsteps)
groups.nuance_zh: reverberate: 在封闭空间或情绪中反复震荡回荡 (hall / valley / shockwave) · resound: 响亮回旋、充斥空间 (applause / voice / brass) · resonate: 产生声学校准共振或唤起深刻情感共鸣 (chord / theme / message) · echo: 声波遇障碍物形成物理回声 (canyon / voice / footsteps)

groups.name: Acoustic Tones: Buzz, Hum & Whistle · 嗡鸣与清鸣 (Hum, Buzz, Flute)
groups.tip: 蜜蜂振翅般的持续嗡叫

items.def_zh: 发出低沉单调的嗡嗡声
items.def_en: to make a continuous low monotonous sound, like an engine or bee
items.ex_en: The heavy ventilation system droned relentlessly through the long night.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的通风系统在漫漫长夜里持续发出单调低沉的嗡嗡声。

items.def_en: to continuously make a low vibrating humming sound
items.ex_en: Old electrical transformers buzzed away behind the garage all afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 车库后面老旧的电力变压器整个下午都在不停地低嗡作响。

items.def_zh: 发嗡嗡声；忙碌，活跃；哼唱（曲调）
items.def_en: 1. To make a low, continuous vibrating sound. 2. To be full of busy activity. 3. To sing a tune with your lips closed.
items.ex_en: Fluorescent ceiling fixtures hummed faintly in the empty office corridor.
items.ex_zh: 空荡荡的办公室走廊里，天花板上的荧光灯发出微弱的嗡嗡声。

items.def_zh: 发笛音，以清脆悦耳的声音说或唱；吹长笛；在……上刻凹槽
items.def_en: 1. To speak, sing, or make a sound in a high, clear, musical voice. 2. To play on a flute. 3. To carve decorative vertical grooves into a surface.
items.ex_en: Songbirds fluted clear, sweet melodies from the dew-drenched boughs.
items.ex_zh: 鸣禽在挂满露珠的枝头吐出清脆悦耳、宛如笛音的婉转曲调。

items.def_en: to make a continuous low, rapid whirring sound like revolving machinery
items.ex_en: The small cooling fan whirred softly beside his laptop as he worked.
items.ex_zh: 他工作时，笔记本电脑旁的小散热风扇发出一阵轻柔的呼呼转鸣。

items.def_zh: 持续发出低沉的嗡嗡声
items.def_en: to make a continuous, low, monotonous humming or buzzing sound
items.ex_en: The air conditioner droned on without pause despite the cooling evening air.
items.ex_zh: 尽管入夜后空气转凉，空调仍低沉单调地嗡嗡响个不停。

items.def_en: to make a continuous rapid vibrating sound like a flying bee
items.ex_en: Dozens of honeybees buzzed around the blooming lavender bushes under the sun.
items.ex_zh: 数十只蜜蜂在阳光下盛开的薰衣草丛周围嗡嗡振鸣。

groups.summary_en: An object, creature, or sound source generates a sustained, resonant acoustic tone—ranging from low continuous vibrations to sweet, flute-like or high vibrational notes.
groups.summary_zh: 物体或发声源产生持续、共鸣的声响，涵盖低频振动嗡鸣至清亮如笛的音调。
groups.desc_en: Captures low, continuous, and monotonous or vibrational acoustic frequencies, differing from sharp staccato noises by their sustained harmonic or mechanical continuity.
groups.desc_zh: 刻画低沉、连续、单调或振动性的音频声响，区别于清脆断续的杂音，强调机械或谐波的持续性。
groups.nuance_en: buzz: produce a sharp, vibrating rapid sound like wings or current (bee / wire / intercom) · hum: emit a smooth, low continuous vibrational note (motor / engine / lips) · drone: utter or make a heavy, dull, ceaseless monotonous hum (aircraft / bagpipe / speaker) · whir: emit a soft, rapid rotary rushing sound (fan / blades / camera)
groups.nuance_zh: buzz: 发出类似昆虫振翅或电流的嘈杂嗡鸣 (bee / wire / intercom) · hum: 闭口或机器发出平稳低沉的哼鸣 (motor / engine / lips) · drone: 产生单调沉闷、令人昏昏欲睡的长鸣 (aircraft / bagpipe / speaker) · whir: 齿轮或叶片快速旋转发出的柔和飕飕声 (fan / blades / camera)

groups.name: Adjoin & Abut · 毗连与切近相接 (Adjoin, Abut)
groups.tip: 地界或空间紧紧相靠相连

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to share a boundary with an adjacent territory or property
items.ex_en: The peaceful farmland borders upon a dense nature reserve to the north.
items.ex_zh: 这片宁静的农田北面与一片茂密的自然保护区接界。

items.def_en: to be located immediately next to or adjacent to another entity
items.ex_en: Our small vineyard neighbors an expansive family-owned orchard down the slope.
items.ex_zh: 我们的小葡萄园沿坡而下，与一座规模庞大的家族果园紧邻。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to lie along or share a physical boundary with something
items.ex_en: The scenic coastal highway borders on the steep cliff edges for miles.
items.ex_zh: 这条风景优美的沿海公路有数英里路段紧挨着陡峭的悬崖边缘。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to touch along a border or be next to something directly
items.ex_en: The newly paved rear courtyard abuts onto the historic town square.
items.ex_zh: 新近铺砌的后庭院与具有历史意义的城镇广场直接相连。

items.def_en: to be placed or situated at the side or flank of something
items.ex_en: Majestic marble statues flank the monumental stone entrance of the museum.
items.ex_zh: 宏伟的大理石雕像矗立在博物馆厚重的石质大门两侧。

items.def_en: 1. (formal) To be next to or share a boundary or wall with a room, building, or piece of land.
items.ex_en: The royal bedchamber adjoins a private study overlooking the palace gardens.
items.ex_zh: 皇家卧室与一间俯瞰宫殿花园的私人书房相连。

items.def_en: 1. (+ on/against) (formal) To touch or share a boundary or edge with another property, structure, or area.
items.ex_en: His private estate abuts on the northern perimeter of the national forest.
items.ex_zh: 他的私人庄园紧靠着国家森林北面的边界。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate spatial relations where physical bodies, lands, or buildings share a boundary, border, or touch directly alongside one another.
groups.summary_zh: 土地、建筑物等彼此接壤、毗邻或紧密接触相切。
groups.desc_en: Denotes physical contiguity along shared boundaries or immediate margins, contrasting with mere proximity by demanding direct contact without intervening space.
groups.desc_zh: 指空间边界上的直接接触与切合，区别于临近但有间隙，强调无缝相接、紧邻接壤。
groups.nuance_en: abut: touch directly along a physical boundary or edge without gap (property / wall / pier) · adjoin: be joined or united at the margin as contiguous rooms or plots (room / property / estate) · border: form or run along an outer perimeter (lake / nation / forest) · flank: be positioned on either lateral side of something (entrance / general / runway)
groups.nuance_zh: abut: 建筑或地界在端点处严密顶接、抵触 (property / wall / pier) · adjoin: 房间或地块紧密毗连相通 (room / property / estate) · border: 沿边缘环绕或形成国界边界 (lake / nation / forest) · flank: 位于两侧加以护卫或夹峙 (entrance / general / runway)

groups.name: Advise & Counsel · 劝诫与深谋指引 (Counsel, Rede, Admonish)
groups.tip: 由日常提议上升为专业指导

items.def_en: (+ sth/doing sth) to give serious, authoritative advice to avoid a specific action or hazard
items.ex_en: Health authorities strongly caution against drinking untreated river water during floods.
items.ex_zh: 卫生部门严正告诫民众防范洪水期间饮用未经处理的河水。

items.def_zh: 建议，劝告；提供心理咨询（或专业指导）
items.def_en: To give advice or guidance to someone, especially on personal or professional matters.
items.ex_en: The mentor counseled her to explore multiple job offers before deciding.
items.ex_zh: 导师建议她在做决定之前多加考察几个录用机会。

items.def_en: to warn or counsel someone firmly about their duty, conduct, or future action
items.ex_en: The judge admonished the disruptive spectator to maintain decorum inside the courtroom.
items.ex_zh: 法官严肃告诫扰乱秩序的旁听者务必在法庭内保持庄重。

items.def_en: (archaic) To give advice or counsel to someone; to explain or interpret.
items.ex_en: The elderly druid reded the young warrior against seeking reckless vengeance.
items.ex_zh: 老德鲁伊劝告年轻的勇士切莫因鲁莽而寻求复仇。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to strongly counsel someone not to do something or to be careful of danger
items.ex_en: Local guides warned against hiking the treacherous ridge trail without ropes.
items.ex_zh: 当地向导严正警告切勿在没有绳索保护的情况下徒步攀爬危险的山脊道。

items.def_en: (+ to/with) to instruct or urge someone with formal responsibility or authority
items.ex_en: The commander charged his lieutenants with protecting the remaining supplies.
items.ex_zh: 指挥官郑重嘱咐副官们，命其全力护卫剩余的补给物资。

items.def_en: to strongly urge or encourage someone to do something through moral appeal
items.ex_en: The activist exhorted the assembled crowd to defend civil liberties peacefully.
items.ex_zh: 活动家规劝在场聚集的群众以和平方式捍卫公民自由。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve serious, weighty, or authoritative advice given in formal, moral, or archaic contexts, guiding conduct or warning against error.
groups.summary_zh: 指庄重、具道德约束力或权威深思的劝戒与指导。
groups.desc_en: Conveys authoritative or solemn guidance aimed at steering decisions or rectifying conduct, distinguished from casual tips by high gravitas and moral or legal weight.
groups.desc_zh: 指具有权威性、审慎性或规诫色彩的深思指引，区别于轻描淡写的随口建议，具有较强威信与防范色彩。
groups.nuance_en: counsel: provide formal, deliberate guidance based on wisdom or law (client / leader / patient) · admonish: reprove mildly yet earnestly as a cautionary warning (student / offender / follower) · exhort: urge passionately and forcefully toward moral action (crowd / troops / believers) · charge: formally command and entrust with solemn duty (jury / committee / envoy)
groups.nuance_zh: counsel: 基于专业法理或深思熟虑进行顾问式指引 (client / leader / patient) · admonish: 诚恳温和地告诫、责备以防再犯 (student / offender / follower) · exhort: 满怀激情地劝勉、激励行善 (crowd / troops / believers) · charge: 郑重训令并托付严肃职责 (jury / committee / envoy)

groups.name: Advise & Recommend · 建议与推荐 (Recommend, Advise, Suggest)
groups.tip: 出于好意提出主意或对策

items.def_en: to put forward an idea, plan, or piece of advice for consideration
items.ex_en: She suggested a different route to avoid the evening rush hour traffic.
items.ex_zh: 她提议换一条路线，以避开傍晚的高峰期车流。

items.def_en: 1. To advise or suggest a particular course of action. 2. To praise someone or something as being suitable for a particular job or purpose.
items.ex_en: I highly recommend reading the manual thoroughly before assembling the machine.
items.ex_zh: 我强烈建议在组装这台机器之前先仔细阅读说明书。

items.def_en: [I/T] to formally put forward a course of action for discussion and adoption
items.ex_en: The committee decided to propose a comprehensive overhaul of the current procurement regulations.
items.ex_zh: 委员会决定对现行采购法规提出彻底改革方案。

items.def_zh: 建议，劝告；给……出主意；通知
items.def_en: 1. To give advice or a recommendation to someone about what they should do. 2. (formal) To give someone official information or notice.
items.ex_en: Legal counsel will advise the board regarding potential compliance risks before the merger.
items.ex_zh: 法律顾问将在并购前就潜在的合规风险向董事会提供建议。

items.def_en: to recommend or advise something strongly with persistent emphasis
items.ex_en: Health officials urge the public to complete their vaccinations before the winter season.
items.ex_zh: 卫生官员力劝公众在冬季来临前完成疫苗接种。

items.def_en: (+ sth/sb) to suggest an idea, proposal, or candidate for consideration
items.ex_en: The delegation will put forward an alternative candidate during tomorrow's executive council session.
items.ex_zh: 代表团将在明天的执行委员会会议上提出另一位候选人。

items.def_en: (+ sth/doing sth) to recommend that someone should not pursue a specific course of action
items.ex_en: Financial analysts strongly advise against investing capital in such volatile emerging offshore funds.
items.ex_zh: 金融分析师极力建议不要把资金投入到这种剧烈波动的离岸新兴基金中。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate offering opinions, proposals, or endorsements about the best course of action to another person.
groups.summary_zh: 指为他人提出合理化建议、方案或推荐适当人选。
groups.desc_en: Involves putting forward non-binding ideas or courses of action for another’s consideration, distinct from commands by leaving agency entirely with the recipient.
groups.desc_zh: 指向他人提出供其权衡考虑的行动方案，区别于强制指令，完全保留受众的主动选择权。
groups.nuance_en: suggest: propose tentatively or casually for open consideration (idea / course / alternative) · recommend: advocate a choice based on judged merit or experience (book / candidate / treatment) · propose: present a formal, structured plan for adoption (plan / merger / toast) · urge: recommend with persistent, pressing enthusiasm (caution / compliance / action)
groups.nuance_zh: suggest: 委婉或启发性地提出点子供考虑 (idea / course / alternative) · recommend: 基于亲身体验或评估背书郑重推荐 (book / candidate / treatment) · propose: 正式提出系统性方案或提案供采纳 (plan / merger / toast) · urge: 极力敦促、迫切规劝采取行动 (caution / compliance / action)

groups.name: Aid & Empower · 优待与赋能 (Advantage, Enable, Empower)
groups.tip: 给予资源帮助创造有利条件

items.def_zh: 有利于，使处于有利地位；使获益
items.def_en: to put someone in a better, more favorable, or more successful position
items.ex_en: The newly ratified trade agreement will significantly advantage domestic semiconductor manufacturers over competitors.
items.ex_zh: 新批准的贸易协定将使国内半导体制造商相比竞争对手处于极其有利的地位。

items.def_en: to make an action or process possible or easier by removing obstacles
items.ex_en: The newly installed express lane will facilitate customs clearance for cross-border freight traffic.
items.ex_zh: 新设的快速通道将为跨境货运交通的通关提供便利。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to strengthen or empower someone or an organization to improve their capacity
items.ex_en: Targeted federal grants helped build up the regional research institute into an industry powerhouse.
items.ex_zh: 针对性的联邦拨款帮助该地区研究所壮大成为行业龙头。
items.ex2_en: Heavy dark storm clouds built up along the distant western horizon yesterday.
items.ex2_zh: 昨天，沉重漆黑的风暴云在遥远的西方地平线上积聚起来。

items.def_zh: 为……创造有利条件；使具备条件
items.def_en: (+ sb) to provide someone with the resources, position, or advantage needed to succeed
items.ex_en: Her extensive early apprenticeships set her up for a remarkably successful culinary career.
items.ex_zh: 早年广泛的学徒经历为她日后辉煌的烹饪生涯创造了有利条件。
items.ex2_en: The stage sets up quickly due to its modular and lightweight modern design.
items.ex2_zh: 由于其模块化和轻巧的现代设计，该舞台搭建得非常迅速。

items.raw_cluster: 使能够与促成 Enable & Empower
items.def_zh: 使能够，使有能力；使成为可能；激活，启用
items.def_en: 1. to give someone the ability, authority, or means to do something. 2. to make something possible. 3. to activate or turn on a system or feature
items.ex_en: The generous scholarship will enable promising low-income students to attend top-tier universities.
items.ex_zh: 这笔丰厚的奖学金将使有前途的低收入家庭学生能够入读顶尖大学。

items.def_zh: 给予特权；使居有利地位
items.def_en: to grant special rights, systemic advantages, or immunity to someone or something
items.ex_en: The controversial fiscal decree appeared to privilege established corporations over innovative independent startups.
items.ex_zh: 这项充满争议的财政法令似乎给予了老牌企业高于创新独立初创公司的特权。

items.def_zh: 赋权；赋予自主权或能力
items.def_en: to give someone the official authority, confidence, or legal power to do something
items.ex_en: The constitutional amendment will empower regional governors to enact local emergency measures.
items.ex_zh: 该宪法修正案将赋予地方长官颁布地方紧急措施的法定权力。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to providing individuals or groups with favorable conditions, authority, or practical capacity to succeed. While 'enable' provides necessary means or capability, 'empower' grants institutional autonomy, and 'advantage' places someone in a privileged competitive position.
groups.summary_zh: 指为他人提供有利条件、资格或实际权能以助其成功。
groups.desc_en: Signifies providing structural, legal, or institutional means that render action possible or grant strategic superiority, unlike passive helping which merely eases tasks.
groups.desc_zh: 指赋予制度、法律或能力层面的实质支撑以使其能够作为，区别于被动帮衬，强调赋权与机制赋能。
groups.nuance_en: empower: bestow legal authority, power, or inner confidence to act (employees / women / community) · enable: provide the technical, financial, or practical means to make possible (user / system / growth) · privilege: grant exclusive, structural advantages over others (class / elite / insider) · facilitate: smooth away obstacles to make processes easier (negotiation / trade / dialogue)
groups.nuance_zh: empower: 赋予法定权力、资质或自主信心 (employees / women / community) · enable: 提供技术、资金或客观条件使其成为可能 (user / system / growth) · privilege: 给予特殊特权或结构性优待 (class / elite / insider) · facilitate: 疏通堵点使进程更顺畅 (negotiation / trade / dialogue)

groups.name: Align & Parallel Position · 精准平行对齐与贴置 (Collimate, Appose, Align)
groups.tip: 精确定位并对齐轴线

items.def_en: (+ sth) to adjust items or parts so that they are in a straight line or precise parallel alignment
items.ex_en: Carefully line up the printed calibration marks along the edges before cutting.
items.ex_zh: 切割前，请务必沿着边缘将打印出的校准标记仔细对齐。
items.ex2_en: The excited fans lined up outside the stadium hours before the concert.
items.ex2_zh: 兴奋的歌迷们在演唱会开始前数小时便在体育场外排起了长队。

items.def_en: to place things side by side in close physical proximity
items.ex_en: The curator chose to juxtapose classical marble busts alongside modern abstract sculptures.
items.ex_zh: 馆长选择将古典大理石胸像与现代抽象雕塑并列摆放。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make edges, corners, or surfaces precisely straight, parallel, or at right angles
items.ex_en: Take the framing square and square up the corners before nailing them down.
items.ex_zh: 在钉钉子之前，用木工角尺把拐角精确对准校正。
items.ex2_en: The old wooden frame squared up easily once the builder adjusted the braces.
items.ex2_zh: 建筑工调整支撑杆后，旧木框架很容易就方正对齐了。

items.def_zh: 排列整齐，使成一行/一条直线
