items.ex_en: Special forces launched early morning air strikes to blitz the fortified insurgent compound.
items.ex_zh: 特种部队发起清晨空袭，对叛军固守的大院展开闪电般的猛烈轰炸。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe subjecting a target to an overwhelming, continuous assault—originally of artillery or ordnance, and metaphorically of questions, criticisms, or demands.
groups.summary_zh: 对目标施加持续、密集、高烈度的炮火打击或大量言论冲击。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an overwhelming, sustained, high-intensity onslaught of physical projectiles, blows, or figurative demands, contrasting with single discrete strikes by its relentless cumulative saturation.
groups.desc_zh: 指炮火、打击或抽象质询排山倒海般持续密集地倾泻而下；与单次离散打击不同，强调连续不断的累积饱和度与毁灭性压迫感。
groups.nuance_en: bombard: sustained heavy physical or figurative assault (questions / fort / coastline) · shell: explosive artillery bombardment of a fixed target (city / positions / defenses) · barrage: continuous concentrated wall of missiles or queries (criticism / artillery / complaints) · pummel: rapid successive battering strikes (opponent / shore / body) · blitz: sudden, overwhelming, multi-front offensive (advertising / enemy / defense)
groups.nuance_zh: bombard: 密集猛烈轰炸或质询连珠炮式轰击 (questions / fort / coastline) · shell: 专门使用火炮持续炮轰固定目标 (city / positions / defenses) · barrage: 密集弹幕或连珠炮般的情感/言语围攻 (criticism / artillery / complaints) · pummel: 连续不断地以重拳或重物乱打狂砸 (opponent / shore / body) · blitz: 迅猛发起的全面闪电战或攻势 (advertising / enemy / defense)

groups.name: Continuous Rapid Fire & Bombardment · 扫射与猛烈轰击 (Strafe, Fusillade, Pepper)
groups.tip: 远程弹药齐射与扫射

items.def_en: to hit repeatedly with a shower of bullets, shrapnel, or missiles
items.ex_en: Heavy shrapnel fragments continued to pepper the forward bunker during the artillery assault.
items.ex_zh: 在炮火突击期间，大量弹片如雨点般密集击打在前沿掩体上。

items.def_en: to sweep the whole length of a target or area with gunfire
items.ex_en: A lone sniper positioned on the hill began to rake the road with fire.
items.ex_zh: 潜伏在山头的一名狙击手开始自一端至另一端扫射整条道路。

items.def_zh: 齐射，群射，并发；（球类运动）截击，凌空抽射
items.def_en: 1. To discharge or shoot a barrage of bullets, arrows, or words simultaneously or in rapid succession. 2. (sports) To hit or kick a moving ball before it touches the ground.
items.ex_en: Frontline soldiers prepared to volley continuous rifle fire at the approaching enemy ranks.
items.ex_zh: 前线士兵准备向逼近的敌军方阵连续齐射步枪子弹。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) suddenly unleash a continuous burst of heavy gunfire at a target
items.ex_en: The ambush squad suddenly chose to open up on the advancing enemy column.
items.ex_zh: 埋伏的小队突然朝步步逼近的敌军纵队猛烈开火扫射。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth with sth) discharge a rapid, sweeping barrage of gunfire or pellets across an area or target
items.ex_en: The rear sentry turned quickly to spray the dark tree line with automatic fire.
items.ex_zh: 后方哨兵迅速转身，用自动火力向漆黑的林木线扫射出一片弹幕。

items.def_zh: 连续齐射；以连发炮火轰击
items.def_en: to attack or bombard with a rapid, continuous discharge of firearms
items.ex_en: Hostile shore batteries continued to fusillade the retreating transport ships with relentless fury.
items.ex_zh: 敌方岸防炮台以狂暴的连续齐射轰击正在撤退的运输船队。

items.def_zh: （低空飞行飞机）用机枪扫射，猛烈轰击
items.def_en: To attack ground targets repeatedly with machine-gun fire or bombs from low-flying aircraft.
items.ex_en: Two low-flying fighter jets returned to strafe the enemy convoy with heavy machine guns.
items.ex_zh: 两架低空飞行的战斗机返航，用重机枪猛烈扫射敌军车队。

groups.summary_en: Combatants discharge a dense, continuous barrage of gunfire or artillery at an area or target, emphasizing volume and sweeping coverage rather than singular aim.
groups.summary_zh: 指密集连续地扫射、齐射或以重火力压制特定区域。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on rapid, directional, scattershot kinetic fire directed across a wide arc or moving surface, differing from static artillery pounding through high velocity and sweeping coverage.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重于低空扫射或密集散射弹幕掠过受袭面；与大口径静态炮击不同，强调高射速、弹道扩散与扫掠覆盖的动态特质。
groups.nuance_en: strafe: low-altitude sweeping automatic gunfire (infantry / columns / airfields) · pepper: hit repeatedly with small scattered impacts (buckshot / shrapnel / surface) · rake: sweep gunfire continuously across the entire length of a target (deck / trenches / convoy) · volley: discharge a coordinated burst simultaneously (bullets / arrows / stones) · fusillade: rapid, chaotic outbursts of sustained projectile fire (shots / gunfire / missiles)
groups.nuance_zh: strafe: 战机低空掠过进行连续扫射 (infantry / columns / airfields) · pepper: 散弹般细密点状敲击或密集击中 (buckshot / shrapnel / surface) · rake: 沿纵深线或甲板进行地毯式横向扫射 (deck / trenches / convoy) · volley: 齐射或多枚投射物瞬间并出 (bullets / arrows / stones) · fusillade: 连珠炮般快速而喧嚣的连续密集射击 (shots / gunfire / missiles)

groups.name: Convene & Rally · 召集与集结 (Assemble, Convene, Rally)
groups.tip: 召集众人集合或开会

items.def_zh: 召集，集结；（使）重整旗鼓；（使）恢复
items.def_en: 1. To bring people together, or come together, in order to support a common cause or effort. 2. To recover strength, health, or value after an illness, decline, or difficulty.
items.ex_en: Party activists worked tirelessly to rally public support behind the newly proposed healthcare reform.
items.ex_zh: 政党活动家不知疲倦地集结公众力量，以支持新提出的医疗改革。
items.ex2_en: Dispersed soldiers rallied quickly behind their brave commander during the chaotic counterattack.
items.ex2_zh: 在混乱的反击中，溃散的士兵迅速集结在他们勇敢的指挥官身后。

items.def_zh: 召集；召聚（人们开会或商议）
items.def_en: (+ sb) summon people to assemble in one place for a collective purpose or meeting
items.ex_en: The director decided to call together all project managers for an urgent briefing.
items.ex_zh: 主任决定把所有项目经理召集在一起召开一次紧急通报会。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) gather together scattered people or things into a single group
items.ex_en: The police rounded up several suspects following the robbery.
items.ex_zh: 抢劫案发生后，警方搜捕了几名嫌疑人。

items.def_en: [I/T] to bring people together or come together in one place as a coordinated body
items.ex_en: Delegates will assemble inside the grand hall to draft the new international charter.
items.ex_zh: 代表们将在大厅内集合，共同起草新的国际宪章。
items.ex2_en: Workers will assemble the complicated solar panels on the roof this afternoon.
items.ex2_zh: 工人们今天下午将在屋顶组装复杂的太阳能电池板。

items.def_en: to officially and authoritatively order sb to attend or gather for a formal meeting
items.ex_en: The magistrate has decided to summon the elusive witness to testify under oath.
items.ex_zh: 地方法官已决定传唤那位避而不见的证人出庭宣誓作证。

items.def_en: To come together, or to bring people together, for a formal meeting or gathering.
items.ex_en: The chairman chose to convene the emergency security council meeting early this morning.
items.ex_zh: 主席决定于今天清晨正式召集紧急安全理事会会议。
items.ex2_en: The legislative committee will convene tomorrow morning to review the annual budget.
items.ex2_zh: 立法委员会将于明早召开会议审查年度预算。

items.def_en: [I/T] to organize and encourage people to act together to achieve a specific political or civic goal
items.ex_en: Local grassroots leaders helped mobilize thousands of citizens to clean up the polluted riverbank.
items.ex_zh: 当地基层领袖动员了数千名市民共同清理受污染的河岸。
items.ex2_en: Troops mobilized rapidly across the northern border following the sudden security alert.
items.ex2_zh: 在突发安全警报发生后，部队迅速在北部边境集结动员起来。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this governance and collective action frame describe authorities or leaders calling individuals together for a common purpose. 'Convene' denotes an official institutional summoning of delegates or boards, whereas 'rally' emphasizes mobilizing people into concerted political, military, or emotional support.
groups.summary_zh: 指权威机构或领袖为特定事务、议程或共同行动将众人召集到一起。
groups.desc_en: Involves summoning and concentrating dispersed agents into a functional collective body, contrasting with spontaneous gathering by requiring authoritative initiative or an urgent shared purpose.
groups.desc_zh: 通过权威号召或紧迫目标将离散的人员集结成统一步调的团体；与自发聚集不同，强调施动者的组织意志与凝聚过程。
groups.nuance_en: convene: formally call together a deliberative body (committee / parliament / session) · summon: authoritatively mandate attendance (witnesses / council / reserves) · assemble: collect components or people into one ordered location (delegates / crowd / parts) · rally: reinvigorate and unite around a shared cause (supporters / troops / markets) · mobilize: organize resources or troops for active readiness (forces / voters / capital)
groups.nuance_zh: convene: 正式召开立法或审议性质的会议 (committee / parliament / session) · summon: 依职权或法律传唤、强制召集 (witnesses / council / reserves) · assemble: 将人或部件聚集、组装整齐 (delegates / crowd / parts) · rally: 唤起士气并围绕同一口号重新集结 (supporters / troops / markets) · mobilize: 全面动员资源或武装以进入临战状态 (forces / voters / capital)

groups.name: Cooperate & Jointly Work · 合作与协作 (Cooperate, Collaborate, Team up)
groups.tip: 各方齐心协力完成目标

items.def_en: (+ with) To enter into an organized working alliance with another party
items.ex_en: Our tech startup decided to partner with established universities on artificial intelligence research.
items.ex_zh: 我们的科技初创公司决定与知名大学结成合作关系，共同研究人工智能。

items.def_en: (+ with) To join together with another person or group to achieve a common goal
items.ex_en: The two rival tech companies decided to team up to develop the open-source platform.
items.ex_zh: 这两家相互竞争的科技公司决定联手合作，共同开发该开源平台。

items.def_en: To work harmoniously with others, especially in a time of crisis or difficulty
items.ex_en: If we all pull together, we can overcome this terrible financial setback.
items.ex_zh: 只要我们大家齐心协力，就一定能够度过这次可怕的财务危机。

items.def_en: combine efforts, manpower, or resources with someone else to achieve a common goal
items.ex_en: The two competing tech firms decided to join forces to combat rampant digital piracy.
items.ex_zh: 两家互为竞争对手的科技公司决定联手协作，共同打击猖獗的数字盗版。

items.def_en: join in cooperatively with others to help accomplish a task
items.ex_en: If we all pitch in, we can finish clearing the yard in an hour.
items.ex_zh: 如果我们大家齐心协力，一个小时就能把院子清理干净。

items.def_en: To work together with someone else to achieve a common goal; to comply or assist.
items.ex_en: Both local departments agreed to cooperate fully during the cross-border emergency rescue operation.
items.ex_zh: 两个地方部门均同意在跨境紧急救援行动中全力配合。

items.def_en: 1. (+ with/on) To work jointly with others on a shared project or goal. 2. (+ with) To cooperate traitorously with an enemy.
items.ex_en: Distinguished scholars from both universities will collaborate on the groundbreaking climate research initiative.
items.ex_zh: 来自两所大学的杰出学者将合作开展这一具有开创性的气候研究项目。

groups.summary_en: Parties work together toward a shared objective, pooling labor, resources, or intellectual effort. While 'cooperate' often highlights compliance or willingness to help, 'collaborate' stresses deep joint production, and phrasal forms like 'team up' indicate casual or strategic partnership.
groups.summary_zh: 强调双方或多方共同作业、分工协作以达成目标的互动行为。
groups.desc_en: Expresses voluntary pooling of effort, resources, or talent toward a shared objective, contrasting with unilateral action or mere co-presence through mutually dependent synergy.
groups.desc_zh: 表达多方出于共同目标自愿投入资源与劳力进行协同作业；与单干或单纯共处不同，强调实质性的互相配合与协同增效。
groups.nuance_en: collaborate: work closely in intellectual or creative partnership (researchers / artists / scientists) · cooperate: willingly assist or comply with common rules (authorities / suspects / partners) · partner: formally join entities for strategic advantage (firms / universities / investors) · team up: informally band together for a specific task (friends / rivals / developers) · pitch in: contribute casually to an immediate collective chore (money / labor / ideas)
groups.nuance_zh: collaborate: 在智力、科研或艺术上深度共创 (researchers / artists / scientists) · cooperate: 顺畅配合、遵从协作意向或配合调查 (authorities / suspects / partners) · partner: 缔结正式战略伙伴或合伙关系 (firms / universities / investors) · team up: 为某一具体任务暂时搭档组队 (friends / rivals / developers) · pitch in: 众人随手凑份子、搭把手出工出力 (money / labor / ideas)

groups.name: Coordinate Collective Enterprise · 筹划与工会化 (Organize, Plan, Unionize)
groups.tip: 组建工会联合众人

items.def_zh: 组织，筹办；组建（工会）；整理，使有条理
items.def_en: 1. To plan, arrange, or coordinate an event, activity, or system. 2. To form or encourage workers to join a trade union or group. 3. To put things into an orderly structure.
items.ex_en: The student council will organize a charity fundraiser to support the local animal shelter.
items.ex_zh: 学生会将筹办一场慈善筹款活动，以支持当地的动物收容所。

items.def_en: To bring the diverse elements of a complex activity or organization into harmonious efficiency
items.ex_en: The director will coordinate operational efforts across all international branches to maximize efficiency.
items.ex_zh: 主管将协调所有国际分支机构的业务工作，以实现最高效能。
items.ex2_en: The movements of the synchronized swimmers coordinate flawlessly throughout their aquatic performance.
items.ex2_zh: 花样游泳队员的动作在整场水上表演中协调得完美无瑕。

items.def_zh: 建立；创设（组织、机构或体系）
items.def_en: (+ sth) establish or organize an institution, committee, collective, or operational body
items.ex_en: The municipal government decided to set up an independent committee to investigate environmental complaints.
items.ex_zh: 市政府决定成立一个独立委员会来调查环境投诉。
items.ex2_en: The new exhibition tent sets up effortlessly in just under fifteen minutes.
items.ex2_zh: 新的展览帐篷在不到十五分钟内就能毫不费力地搭建完毕。

items.def_zh: 招揽入会；登记加入组织
items.def_en: enlist workers or members into an organized association, union, or collective body
items.ex_en: Union organizers worked tirelessly outside the factory gates to sign up hundreds of factory workers.
items.ex_zh: 工会组织者在工厂大门外不懈努力，招揽了数百名工厂工人入会。
items.ex2_en: Eager volunteers signed up immediately when the community charity launched its drive.
items.ex2_zh: 当社区慈善机构发起活动时，热心的志愿者们立即报了名。

items.def_en: To arrange or manipulate the elements of a situation to achieve a desired maximum effect
items.ex_en: The campaign manager managed to orchestrate a sophisticated public relations blitz before the election.
items.ex_zh: 竞选经理设法在选举前精心策划了一场精密的公关宣传攻势。

items.def_zh: 使制度化；建立正式机构
items.def_en: To establish into a structured, permanent social or legal organization
items.ex_en: The reform aims to institutionalize transparent oversight mechanisms within the public healthcare sector.
items.ex_zh: 该项改革旨在公共医疗部门内部建立起制度化的透明监督机制。

items.def_en: To organize workers into a trade union, or to become a member of a trade union.
items.ex_en: Warehouse employees voted overwhelmingly to unionize despite strong initial opposition from corporate management.
items.ex_zh: 尽管最初遭到公司管理层的强烈反对，仓库员工仍以压倒性多数投票决定组织工会。
items.ex2_en: Labor leaders fought hard to unionize local hospitality workers across the region.
items.ex2_zh: 工会领导人努力组织该地区各地的当地酒店业员工成立工会。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on initiating, systematizing, and structuring social, civic, or labor institutions into functional collectives. Verbs differ between overall strategic program arrangement and legally organizing workers into collective bargaining units.
groups.summary_zh: 指筹办社会活动、协调事务系统或组织工人建立工会联合体。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the institutionalized structuring and systemic mobilization of collective groups into an enduring operational apparatus, distinguished from informal cooperation by bureaucratic formalization.
groups.desc_zh: 将松散集体转变为制度化、具备长期行动力的组织架构；与临时合作不同，强调系统性设计、层级协调与制度建构。
groups.nuance_en: organize: systematically arrange resources or groups into an operational structure (campaign / workers / conference) · orchestrate: masterfully and strategically coordinate complex moving parts (takeover / coup / comeback) · coordinate: align distinct autonomous entities to avoid friction (logistics / efforts / rescue) · unionize: organize workers into a legally recognized collective bargaining unit (workforce / plant / teachers) · institutionalize: entrench a practice or group into a formal, permanent system (reforms / customs / procedures)
groups.nuance_zh: organize: 系统性编排资源或将人员建制化 (campaign / workers / conference) · orchestrate: 幕后精心策划与精妙调度复杂局势 (takeover / coup / comeback) · coordinate: 协调不同独立主体以步调一致消除冲突 (logistics / efforts / rescue) · unionize: 组织劳工建立具有合法谈判地位的工会 (workforce / plant / teachers) · institutionalize: 使行动或机制制度化、法制化 (reforms / customs / procedures)

groups.name: Cough & Sneeze · 咳嗽与喷嚏 (Cough, Sneeze, Hack)
groups.tip: 气道受刺激引发的排异反应

items.def_en: [I/T] to clear phlegm noisily from the throat
items.ex_en: The old smoker paused on the cold porch to noisily hawk up thick phlegm.
items.ex_zh: 那个老烟民停在冰冷的门廊上，大声清嗓咳出一口浓痰。

items.def_zh: 咳，咳嗽；咳出；（发动机等）发出爆震声
items.def_en: 1. to force air suddenly out of the lungs with a sharp, noisy sound. 2. (of an engine or machine) to make a sudden harsh, sputtering sound.
items.ex_en: The dusty air inside the abandoned warehouse caused the urban explorers to cough violently.
items.ex_zh: 废弃仓库内布满灰尘的空气导致城市探险者们剧烈咳嗽。

items.def_en: (+ sth) expel phlegm, mucus, or an object from the throat or lungs by coughing
items.ex_en: He drank some warm tea to help cough up the stubborn mucus in his chest.
items.ex_zh: 他喝了些温茶，以帮助咳出积在胸口的顽固黏痰。

items.def_en: to cough repeatedly in a harsh, dry, painful way
items.ex_en: The sick child began to hack painfully in the middle of the freezing night.
items.ex_zh: 生病的孩子在寒冷的深夜里开始痛苦地连声干咳。

items.def_en: 1. To suddenly expel air noisily through your nose and mouth because of dust, allergies, or a cold.
items.ex_en: The strong fragrance of blooming lilies made her sneeze several times in rapid succession.
items.ex_zh: 盛开百合花的浓郁香气使她接二连三地打了好几个喷嚏。

items.def_zh: 大声干咳着咳出（粘液等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) cough up phlegm or secretions harshly and noisily
items.ex_en: He had to hack up the thick mucus that had accumulated during his cold.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不大声干咳着，咳出感冒期间积聚在喉咙里的浓痰。

items.def_en: to cough with a loud, convulsive gasping sound characteristic of pertussis
items.ex_en: The toddler began to whoop loudly after an exhausting fit of severe coughing.
items.ex_zh: 在一阵令人精疲力竭的剧烈咳嗽后，蹒跚学步的孩子开始抽吸着大声作咳。

groups.summary_en: An agent involuntarily or deliberately expels air abruptly from the respiratory tract (throat, lungs, or nasal passages) to clear irritants. Verbs differentiate by acoustic harshness, respiratory origin, and physical strain.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过喉咙或鼻腔猛烈呼出气流以清除异物，涵盖轻咳、打喷嚏及剧烈干咳等生理反射动作。
groups.desc_en: Covers involuntary, forceful respiratory expulsions aimed at clearing airway irritants, differentiated from regular breathing by sudden spasmodic diaphragmatic force.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过膈肌痉挛性爆发向外强行排出呼吸道异物的生理反应；与平缓呼吸不同，强调突发性、防御性与剧烈气流冲击。
groups.nuance_en: cough: sharply expel air from lungs to clear the throat (blood / phlegm / dust) · sneeze: violently and involuntarily expel air through nose and mouth (allergens / pepper / sunlight) · hack: cough repeatedly with a harsh, dry, rasping sound (smoker / dryly / all night) · hawk: clear throat aggressively by drawing up phlegm (mucus / phlegm / spit) · whoop: cough with a loud convulsive gasping intake of breath (child / breath / gasp)
groups.nuance_zh: cough: 清嗓或因肺部刺激而剧烈咳气 (blood / phlegm / dust) · sneeze: 由鼻腔刺激诱发的不可控剧烈喷嚏 (allergens / pepper / sunlight) · hack: 连续而干涩嘶哑的剧烈咳嗽 (smoker / dryly / all night) · hawk: 用力咯痰、使劲清嗓子 (mucus / phlegm / spit) · whoop: 伴随哮鸣抽吸声的痉挛性剧咳 (child / breath / gasp)

groups.name: Cross & Traverse · 穿越与横跨 (Traverse, Crisscross, Jaywalk)
groups.tip: 从一端横跨穿行到另一端

items.def_en: [I/T] to go from one side of a road, river, or area to the other
items.ex_en: Please look both ways carefully before you cross the busy four-lane avenue downtown.
items.ex_zh: 穿过市中心繁忙的四车道马路之前，请务必仔细看清两侧车辆。

items.def_en: to extend across or cross an expanse or obstacle
items.ex_en: Several ancient stone bridges span the wide river running through the historic capital.
items.ex_zh: 数座古老的石桥横跨穿过这座历史古都的宽阔河流。

items.def_zh: 跨越到另一边；横过（马路等）
items.def_en: cross a road, border, or boundary from one side to the other
items.ex_en: The country musician successfully crossed over into mainstream pop.
items.ex_zh: 这位乡村音乐歌手成功跨界打入了主流流行乐坛。

items.def_en: (+ sth) travel across or traverse an expanse, town, or area on the way to somewhere else
items.ex_en: Migratory birds pass through this coastal marshland every autumn on their southward journey.
items.ex_zh: 候鸟每年秋天在南迁途中都会途经这片沿海湿地。

items.def_en: (formal) to travel across or over a large expanse or rough terrain
items.ex_en: The seasoned mountaineers prepared to traverse the treacherous glacial plateau before nightfall fell.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的登山者准备在夜幕降临前横越危险重重的冰川高原。

items.def_zh: 往来穿梭于；交叉往来；构成交叉图案
items.def_en: To travel back and forth repeatedly across an area; to form a pattern of intersecting lines across something.
items.ex_en: Dozens of paved walking paths crisscross the expansive lawn surrounding the university library.
items.ex_zh: 数十条铺砌的人行便道在大学图书馆周围宽阔的草坪上交错纵横。

items.def_zh: 乱穿马路；违章横穿街道
items.def_en: (chiefly North American) To cross a street carelessly or illegally without using an official crossing or following traffic signals.
items.ex_en: Impulsive pedestrians often jaywalk across this congested intersection despite the strict municipal fines.
items.ex_zh: 尽管市政罚款十分严厉，仍有许多鲁莽的行人经常横穿这个拥堵的路口。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe moving across an expanse, surface, or thoroughfare from one side to another, ranging from general spatial traversal to illicit street crossing.
groups.summary_zh: 指从一侧移动至另一侧横越路面、空间或水陆界线的动作。
groups.desc_en: Involves passing across, bridging, or charting movement over an expansive topographical or conceptual boundary, contrasting with unidirectional travel by emphasizing trans-spatial traversal.
groups.desc_zh: 从一边行进到另一边，切过或跨越广阔的地理界线及障碍；与普通单向前进不同，强调对空间广度与屏障的横向穿透。
groups.nuance_en: traverse: journey across a broad, challenging expanse (glacier / terrain / desert) · span: bridge or extend continuously across a gap (river / decades / distance) · crisscross: travel back and forth across an area forming a network (region / paths / sky) · jaywalk: cross an urban street illegally or carelessly (intersections / traffic / roadway) · cross: move simply from one side of a boundary to the other (border / street / threshold)
groups.nuance_zh: traverse: 艰难横越、横贯广阔险峻的地带 (glacier / terrain / desert) · span: 横跨空间鸿沟或跨越时间跨度 (river / decades / distance) · crisscross: 纵横交错地穿行于整个区域 (region / paths / sky) · jaywalk: 违章或随意横穿马路 (intersections / traffic / roadway) · cross: 从一侧简单跨越至另一侧边界 (border / street / threshold)

groups.name: Culinary & Chemical Softening · 浸透、发泡与软化 (Macerate, Souse, Steep)
groups.tip: 液体充分浸湿乃至泡软

items.def_en: (+ sth) remain immersed in liquid to soften or infuse, or penetrate deeply into a substance
items.ex_en: Allow the dried wild mushrooms to soak in warm salted water until tender.
items.ex_zh: 将干野生菌浸入温盐水中，直至其完全软化。
items.ex2_en: The gardener soaked in the rich organic fertilizer to nourish the dry soil.
items.ex2_zh: 园丁充分渗入富含有机肥料来滋养干燥的土壤。

items.def_zh: 浸泡；沏泡（以析出汁液/香味）
items.def_en: [I/T] to soak in liquid in order to extract flavors, colors, or active principles
items.ex_en: You should steep the fresh mint leaves in boiling water for several minutes.
items.ex_zh: 你应该将新鲜薄荷叶在沸水中沏泡几分钟。
items.ex2_en: The aromatic herbal tea steeped quietly in the ceramic pot for minutes.
items.ex2_zh: 芳香的草本茶在陶瓷壶里静静浸泡了数分钟。

items.def_en: [I/T] to immerse meat, fish, or other food in a seasoned liquid before cooking
items.ex_en: The chef decided to marinate the raw chicken breasts in seasoned olive oil overnight.
items.ex_zh: 大厨决定将生鸡胸肉浸入调味橄榄油中腌制过夜。
items.ex2_en: The flank steak marinated quietly in red wine before going on the grill.
items.ex2_zh: 牛腩排在上烤架前静静地在红酒中腌制浸透。

items.def_zh: 使浸润在（液体中）；浸泡提取
items.def_en: (+ sth) soak solid ingredients in liquid for a prolonged period to extract flavor or soften tissue
items.ex_en: The apothecary would steep medicinal roots in pure spirit beneath the pale moonlight.
items.ex_zh: 药剂师在苍白月色下将草药根须浸润于纯酿烈酒之中。

items.def_en: to preserve or marinate food by steeping it in brine or vinegar
items.ex_en: Grandmother loves to pickle sliced crisp cucumbers in spiced vinegar for the winter.
items.ex_zh: 祖母喜欢将切片的清脆黄瓜浸入香料醋中腌制以备过冬。

items.def_zh: 浸泡，浸透；腌制（浸入盐水或醋中）；使烂醉
items.def_en: To plunge into liquid, soak, or drench thoroughly; to steep food in vinegar or brine.
items.ex_en: The cook prepared to souse the fresh river trout in spiced aromatic vinegar.
items.ex_zh: 厨师准备将新鲜的河鳟浸渍在充满香料的芬芳醋汁中。

items.def_en: To soften or break down a substance, especially food, by soaking it in a liquid.
items.ex_en: The pastry chef gently macerated the sweet ripe berries in fragrant orange liqueur.
items.ex_zh: 甜点师将香甜成熟的浆果轻柔地浸泡在芬芳的香橙利口酒中使其软化。
items.ex2_en: The chopped peaches macerated gently in sweet sugar syrup overnight in the fridge.
items.ex2_zh: 切碎的桃子在冰箱里用甜糖浆静静浸渍了一整夜。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote steeping solids in liquid over an extended period to soften them, break down tissue, or infuse them with flavor or preservatives (especially in culinary or chemical processing).
groups.summary_zh: 强调通过长时间浸泡使固体组织软化、出汁、腌透或溶解萃取。
groups.desc_en: Encompasses the protracted immersion of solids in liquids to absorb flavor, induce chemical extraction, or cause cellular breakdown, contrasting with rapid washing by sustained passive permeation.
groups.desc_zh: 通过长时间液体浸泡使固体吸收风味、析出成分或软化降解组织；与表面冲洗不同，强调液体深层渗透与时间累积的物化改变。
groups.nuance_en: macerate: soften and break down tissues by soaking in liquid (fruit / sugar / alcohol) · steep: soak dry ingredients in liquid to extract flavor or essence (tea / herbs / grains) · marinate: soak meat or food in an acid-seasoning blend prior to cooking (beef / chicken / vegetables) · pickle: preserve and flavor food in brine or acidic vinegar (cucumbers / onions / vegetables) · souse: plunge into, drench, or pickle heavily in brine (fish / meat / herring)
groups.nuance_zh: macerate: 浸液或糖渍软化，使果肉/组织溶出汁液或软烂 (fruit / sugar / alcohol) · steep: 浸泡干原料以淬取其茶香、药效或精华 (tea / herbs / grains) · marinate: 烹饪前置于酸性调味液中腌制以入味并软化 (beef / chicken / vegetables) · pickle: 用盐水或醋酸长时间腌渍以防腐保鲜 (cucumbers / onions / vegetables) · souse: 彻底浸入卤汁或强行暴浸腌制 (fish / meat / herring)

groups.name: Cut Joint & Groove · 开槽与榫接 (Mortise, Rabbet, Dado)
groups.tip: 用利刃截断或开槽加工

items.def_en: to cut a long, narrow channel into a surface
items.ex_en: The carpenter used an electric router to groove the edge of each plank.
items.ex_zh: 木匠用电木铣在每块木板的边缘开出凹槽。

items.def_en: to cut a step-shaped recess along the edge of a piece of wood
items.ex_en: The artisan paused to rebate the sturdy oak frame for the stained glass.
items.ex_zh: 工匠停下手中动作，为嵌放彩色玻璃在坚固的橡木框架上削出槽口。

items.def_en: to cut a rectangular groove across the face of a board to fit another piece
items.ex_en: The cabinetmaker expertly cut a dado across the panel to receive the shelf.
items.ex_zh: 家具工娴熟地在板材横向开出平底槽，以便嵌入隔板。

items.def_en: to cut away a right-angled edge or corner to make a symmetrical sloping edge
items.ex_en: The mason meticulously chamfered the sharp perimeter of the polished white marble slab.
items.ex_zh: 石匠细致地将抛光白大理石板锋利的边缘削出对称的斜角。

items.def_en: To cut across or divide something transversely.
items.ex_en: The surgeon deftly made a clean incision to transect the damaged fibrous tissue.
items.ex_zh: 外科医生手法娴熟地下刀，横切开那处受损的纤维组织。

items.def_zh: 在（木材等上）凿榫眼，开榫槽；用榫接合
items.def_en: To cut a hole or slot into a piece of wood or stone to receive a tenon.
items.ex_en: He wielded the heavy mallet to mortice the thick timber beam with precision.
items.ex_zh: 他挥动沉重的木槌，精准地在粗大木梁上凿出榫眼。

items.def_zh: 在……边缘开槽口；用槽口嵌接
items.def_en: To cut a step-shaped groove along the edge of a board so that another piece fits into it.
items.ex_en: The woodworker chose to rabbet the cabinet door to ensure a dustproof seal.
items.ex_zh: 木工选择在橱柜门边缘开槽口嵌接，以确保防尘密封。

groups.summary_en: Specialized woodworking and craftsmanship verbs denoting the precise cutting, channeling, or grooving of material to form structural joints or cross-sections. Unlike rough chopping, these actions require calculated, measured toolwork.
groups.summary_zh: 指木工或工艺中精确开槽、打榫或横切构件的动作。
groups.desc_en: Denotes subtractive material profiling in carpentry and masonry to create recessed interlocking joints or profiles, contrasting with standard sawing by intentional interlocking geometry.
groups.desc_zh: 在木工或石工中精密切削出凹槽、榫眼以形成咬合构造；与普通锯割不同，强调为嵌合而加工的特定几何型腔。
groups.nuance_en: mortise: cut a rectangular cavity designed to receive a tenon (joint / beam / timber) · dado: cut a flat-bottomed rectangular groove across the grain (shelf / cabinet / panel) · rabbet: cut a step-like recess along the edge of a workpiece (frame / door / edge) · chamfer: cut away a sharp right-angled edge to produce a symmetrical bevel (edge / corner / molding) · groove: cut a long narrow indentation running along the grain (board / panel / seam)
groups.nuance_zh: mortise: 在木料上凿出用于容纳榫头的榫眼 (joint / beam / timber) · dado: 横向跨越木纹开出的平底嵌槽 (shelf / cabinet / panel) · rabbet: 沿工件外边缘切出供嵌合的阶梯式企口 (frame / door / edge) · chamfer: 将直角边缘削切成对称斜角以去毛刺或美化 (edge / corner / molding) · groove: 沿木纹方向刨开出狭长的纵向凹槽 (board / panel / seam)

groups.name: Dare & Endanger · 涉险与冒险 (Attempt, Risk, Venture)
groups.tip: 甘冒风险放手一搏

items.def_en: to make an effort to do something, especially something difficult
items.ex_en: The young athlete will attempt to break the national pole vault record tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻运动员明天将尝试打破全国撑竿跳高纪录。

items.def_zh: 冒……的危险，冒险做；使……面临风险
items.def_en: to put something in a situation where it could be lost or damaged; to do something knowing that bad consequences may occur
items.ex_en: Experienced investors never risk their principal assets on such volatile and unproven schemes.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的投资者绝不会在如此不稳定且未经证实的项目上拿本金去冒险。

items.def_en: [I/T] to proceed or take an initiative despite substantial hazard or uncertainty
items.ex_en: Few solitary wanderers would dare venture across the frozen abyss in profound darkness.
items.ex_zh: 在深沉的黑暗中，极少有孤独的流浪者敢冒险穿过冰封的深渊。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ on/with) to risk money or something vital on a result in the hope of gain
items.ex_en: Desperate speculators often gamble their life savings on high-risk stock market options contracts.
items.ex_zh: 孤注一掷的投机客常常把毕生积蓄押在高风险的股市期权合约上博一把。

items.def_zh: 冒险踏入；涉足（危险未知的领域）
items.def_en: (+ sth) proceed boldly or cautiously into a dangerous, unfamiliar, or hostile place or field
items.ex_en: The technology giant chose to venture into the highly competitive renewable energy sector.
items.ex_zh: 这家科技巨头选择涉足竞争极为激烈的新能源领域。

items.def_zh: 冒险亮出（脖子去犯险等）
items.def_en: (+ one's neck) deliberately take a substantial risk that exposes oneself to danger or criticism
items.ex_en: Why should I stick out my neck to defend someone who cheated us?
items.ex_zh: 我凭什么要冒着引火烧身的风险去为欺骗过我们的人出头？

items.def_en: to put something valuable at risk of being lost or destroyed; to dare to offer
items.ex_en: The cautious diplomat dared not hazard an official opinion on the boundary dispute.
items.ex_zh: 这位谨慎的外交官不敢就边界争端冒昧发表官方意见。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on choosing to undertake an action or journey in the face of potential danger, uncertainty, or failure. 'Attempt' merely denotes trying, while 'risk' foregrounds exposing an asset or life to loss, and 'venture' emphasizes stepping cautiously or boldly into perilous territory.
groups.summary_zh: 面临不测或危险时主动尝试、涉足或押上风险。
groups.desc_en: Signifies stepping beyond safety thresholds to expose oneself or assets to uncertainty, differing from routine decision-making through conscious gamble on negative fallout.
groups.desc_zh: 主动越过安全边界，将自身或财产置于不可控的风险中；与常规决策不同，强调知晓负面后果却执意一搏的冒险性质。
groups.nuance_en: venture: dare to go into an unknown or dangerous space (outdoors / forest / market) · risk: expose valuable assets to potential loss or ruin (life / capital / reputation) · hazard: casually or boldly proffer something uncertain (guess / opinion / fortune) · gamble: wager significant stakes on a highly volatile outcome (future / fortunes / election) · attempt: make an effort to achieve an uncertain, difficult goal (escape / climb / summit)
groups.nuance_zh: venture: 涉险进入未知的地理或商业新境地 (outdoors / forest / market) · risk: 押上关键利益承受重大损失风险 (life / capital / reputation) · hazard: 大胆试探性提出猜想或以物作押 (guess / opinion / opinion) · gamble: 孤注一掷下注于概率悬殊之局 (future / fortunes / election) · attempt: 面对险阻仍尝试努力达成目标 (escape / climb / summit)

groups.name: Decontaminate & Clear Obstructions · 净化与疏通 (Purge, Decontaminate, Unclog)
groups.tip: 疏通管路并清除污染源

items.def_zh: 清理；清除（堵塞物或污物）
items.def_en: (+ sth) remove unwanted debris, contaminants, or blockages from a conduit or space
items.ex_en: The plumber had to clear out thick clumps of grease from the pipe.
items.ex_zh: 水管工不得不从管道中清除掉大块厚厚的油脂杂物。

items.def_zh: 用水冲洗排出（脏物、残留物）
items.def_en: (+ sth) purge toxins, impurities, or sediment from a pipe or system by forcing liquid through it
items.ex_en: Engineers used high pressure to flush out accumulated sediment from the industrial cooling pipes.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们利用高压冲洗排出了工业冷却管道中积聚的沉淀物。

items.def_zh: 清除；清洗（管道/容器杂质）
items.def_en: to rid a container, system, or area of undesirable substances or impurities
items.ex_en: Technicians must thoroughly purge the chemical reactor of toxic gases before performing maintenance.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员在进行检修前，必须彻底排净化学反应釜内的有毒气体。

items.def_en: to clear an obstruction from a pipe, passage, or route
items.ex_en: Maintenance crews worked through the night to unblock the drainage culvert after flooding.
items.ex_zh: 洪水过后，维修人员通宵作业以疏通被堵塞的排水涵洞。

items.def_en: to cleanse something with a chemical agent to destroy harmful bacteria or viruses
items.ex_en: Hospital staff regularly disinfect every surgical instrument with a potent sterile chemical solution.
items.ex_zh: 医院工作人员定期用强效无菌化学溶液对每件手术器械进行消毒。

items.def_en: to remove a blockage from a pipe, drain, or passage so that flow resumes freely
items.ex_en: He poured strong caustic soda down the sink drain to unclog the pipe.
items.ex_zh: 他往水槽排水口倒入强效烧碱，以疏通管道堵塞。
items.ex2_en: The clogged kitchen drain unclogged completely once hot boiling water poured through.
items.ex2_zh: 沸水冲刷过后，堵塞的厨房下水道彻底疏通了。

items.def_zh: 净化，清除……的污染（毒气、辐射等）
items.def_en: to remove dangerous chemicals, radiation, or germs from a person, area, or equipment
items.ex_en: Hazmat crews swiftly moved in to decontaminate the soil following the toxic chemical spill.
items.ex_zh: 危险品处理小组在有毒化学品泄漏后迅速赶到现场净化被污染的土壤。

groups.summary_en: This technical sanitation/maintenance frame focuses on removing pollutants, toxins, or physical blockages from systems, spaces, or conduits to restore them to an uncompromised, flowing state.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过专业手段清除管道堵塞或消除系统、环境中的有毒污染物。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the systematic eradication of impurities, pathogenic contaminants, or kinetic blockages to restore free flow and pristine function, contrasting with surface dusting by deep structural cleansing.
groups.desc_zh: 系统性清除系统内的杂质、病原体或物理阻塞以恢复畅通与净化；与表层除尘不同，强调彻底的深层排出与功能重置。
groups.nuance_en: unclog: clear an obstruction to restore fluid or air passage (drain / pipes / pores) · purge: violently and completely expel unwanted matter or elements (system / ranks / toxins) · decontaminate: remove chemical, radiological, or toxic poisons (soil / site / equipment) · disinfect: cleanse of pathogenic microorganisms using chemical agents (wound / surfaces / hands) · flush out: force liquid through to drive out trapped waste or hidden targets (lines / toxins / suspects)
groups.nuance_zh: unclog: 疏通管道或孔隙中卡住的堵塞物 (drain / pipes / pores) · purge: 剧烈且彻底地清洗体内毒素或清洗异己分子 (system / ranks / toxins) · decontaminate: 消除辐射、生化毒剂等高危污染 (soil / site / equipment) · disinfect: 使用药剂杀死物体表面的致病微生物 (wound / surfaces / hands) · flush out: 注入强劲流体以彻底冲刷出积垢或驱出藏匿物 (lines / toxins / suspects)

groups.name: Demand & Appropriate by Power · 强取与征用 (Exact, Requisition, Commandeer)
groups.tip: 凭权力强行征调物资

items.def_en: (+ sth) take something without permission or authority
items.ex_en: The cheeky neighbor would often help oneself to garden tools without even asking.
items.ex_zh: 那个厚脸皮的邻居经常连声招呼都不打就擅自拿走园艺工具。

items.def_en: (+ sth) take legal or forcible possession of property or goods
items.ex_en: Customs officials acted immediately to seize on the illicit cargo found aboard the ship.
items.ex_zh: 海关官员立即采取行动，依法扣押并没收了船上发现的违禁货物。

items.def_zh: 依法没收；征用（私有财产）
items.def_en: take away private property officially for public use, usually by a state or authority
items.ex_en: The municipal authority exercised legal powers to expropriate private land for airport expansion.
items.ex_zh: 市政当局行使法定权力，依法征用私人土地用于扩建机场。

items.def_zh: 勒索，强求；强索，迫使付出（代价）
items.def_en: To demand and obtain something forcefully or strictly; to inflict punishment or make someone pay a heavy price.
items.ex_en: The conqueror sought to exact heavy tributes from the subjugated border provinces annually.
items.ex_zh: 征服者企图每年从被征服的边境行省强索沉重的贡税。

items.def_en: (especially military or official) To officially demand and take possession of property, supplies, or vehicles for public or military use.
items.ex_en: Military commanders had the legal authority to requisition private vehicles during wartime emergencies.
items.ex_zh: 在战时紧急状态下，军事指挥官有权依法征用民用车辆。

items.def_en: officially take possession or control of something, especially for military or emergency use
items.ex_en: Federal agents arrived quickly to commandeer the civilian vessel for the rescue mission.
items.ex_zh: 联邦执法人员迅速赶到，强行征用了那艘民用船只用于救援任务。

items.def_en: (+ sth from sb) obtain money, information, or agreement from someone by using force, threats, or abuse of power
items.ex_en: Corrupt officials attempted to extort large sums of money from local business owners.
items.ex_zh: 腐败官员企图从当地私营业主手中敲诈勒索大笔金钱。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe an authority, government, or powerful entity forcibly taking, demanding, or commandeering property, payments, or compliance by right of power rather than consensual transaction. They typically govern direct objects representing resources, supplies, penalties, or concessions.
groups.summary_zh: 凭权威或强权强行征集物资、索取代价或强制夺取资产。
groups.desc_en: Represents the non-consensual extraction, confiscation, or levy of property and resources backed by legal coercion or sheer power, contrasting with mutual purchase by authoritative imposition.
groups.desc_zh: 凭借法定公权力、暴力或强势地位非自愿地没收、征用或强索他人资产；与有偿买卖不同，强调不对等的强制霸占与勒索。
groups.nuance_en: commandeer: seize private property arbitrarily for urgent military or official use (vehicle / building / vessel) · requisition: officially and legally demand property for emergency public service (supplies / livestock / quarters) · expropriate: legally take away private property for purported public good (land / assets / property) · exact: demand and enforce payment of non-negotiable tribute or taxes (penalty / concessions / tribute) · extort: wrest money or concessions through intimidation or coercion (ransom / cash / bribes)
groups.nuance_zh: commandeer: 战时或紧急状态下强行征调民用交通工具/建筑物 (vehicle / building / vessel) · requisition: 依据公法程序正式征用紧缺物资或房舍 (supplies / livestock / quarters) · expropriate: 国家或当局依法强行征收/没收私有土地与资产 (land / assets / property) · exact: 依仗权势强征暴敛严苛的赋税或代价 (penalty / concessions / tribute) · extort: 借由敲诈、勒索或威胁强行榨取金钱 (ransom / cash / bribes)

groups.name: Demote & Relegate · 贬黜与降级 (Subordinate, Demote, Relegate)
groups.tip: 降低官衔地位或降为从属

items.def_en: leave an important official job or position to take a lower rank or resign
items.ex_en: The CEO decided to step down after a decade of leading the corporation.
items.ex_zh: 执掌公司十年后，首席执行官决定引咎辞职。

items.def_en: (+ to/from) to move someone to a lower rank, position, or tier of seniority within an organisation
items.ex_en: The board decided to demote the negligent manager to a junior supervisory position.
items.ex_zh: 董事会决定将失职的经理降级为初级主管职位。

items.def_en: to strip an officer or official of their rank or honors as an official punishment
items.ex_en: The military tribunal decided to degrade the traitorous captain before dismissing him entirely.
items.ex_zh: 军事法庭决定在彻底开除这名叛变上尉之前，先剥夺其军衔。

items.def_zh: 使处于次要地位，使从属于
items.def_en: To treat someone or something as less important than someone or something else; to place in a subordinate position.
items.ex_en: Autocratic rulers habitually subordinate judicial independence to their personal political survival and power.
items.ex_zh: 专制统治者习惯于将司法独立置于其个人政治生存与权力的从属地位。

items.def_en: (+ sb) force someone to leave a place, group, or position of influence
items.ex_en: The high council resolved to cast out the heretic into the desolate wilderness.
items.ex_zh: 最高议会决议将异端分子驱逐出教团，放逐到荒凉的原野中。

items.def_zh: 使降级，贬黜；把……降到次要地位；（使运动队）降级
items.def_en: To move someone or something to a lower rank or less important position; (in sports) to downgrade a team to a lower division.
items.ex_en: The executive committee voted to relegate the controversial proposal to a minor agenda.
items.ex_zh: 执行委员会表决通过，把这项有争议的提案贬置为次要议题。

items.def_en: (+ to/from) to send someone away from a royal court, capital, or sphere of power as a severe political expulsion
items.ex_en: The paranoid monarch chose to banish the dissenting duke to a remote island.
items.ex_zh: 多疑的君主决定将持不同政见的公爵贬黜出京，流放到偏远海岛。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe organizational or hierarchical downward movement, where an individual or role is stripped of authority, rank, or prestige, moving from subtle subjugation to humiliating formal exile.
groups.summary_zh: 在组织架构或层级体系中逐级压制、剥夺权柄、降职贬黜或流放边缘。
groups.desc_en: Involves the downward status shift or physical banishment of an individual within a hierarchical structure, contrasting with horizontal lateral transfer by explicit status degradation.
groups.desc_zh: 在组织层级中强行削降个人职位、荣誉或将其驱逐至边缘地位；与平级调动不同，强调权能剥夺与地位贬降。
groups.nuance_en: demote: formally reduce an employee or soldier to a lower rank (officer / manager / employee) · relegate: banish someone or something to an inferior, obscure position (team / duties / obscurity) · degrade: lower in status, dignity, or physical quality (soil / rank / humanity) · subordinate: place in a secondary, compliant, or dependent role (interests / status / role) · banish: forcibly expel from an entire community or sphere (exiles / rebels / thoughts)
groups.nuance_zh: demote: 依行政规章将员工或军官正式降级、降职 (officer / manager / employee) · relegate: 降级入次级联赛，或将人/事贬入次要、被忽视的境地 (team / duties / obscurity) · degrade: 剥夺军衔头衔，或贬低人格尊严、降解质地 (soil / rank / humanity) · subordinate: 将某主体置于附庸或次席的从属地位 (interests / status / role) · banish: 驱逐出境，或强制性放逐排除出某一圈子 (exiles / rebels / thoughts)

groups.name: Descent & Plummet · 跌落与直坠 (Fall, Drop, Plummet)
groups.tip: 因重力向下坠落

items.def_en: fall or allow oneself to fall to a lower level or to the ground
items.ex_en: The exhausted paratrooper began to drop down gently onto the soft grassy hillside.
items.ex_zh: 筋疲力竭的伞兵缓缓降落，轻柔地落在了松软的长满青草的山坡上。

items.def_zh: 落下，掉落，跌倒；减少，下降；倒塌，沦陷
items.def_en: 1. to drop down from a higher level towards the ground 2. to decrease in number, amount, or intensity
items.ex_en: Heavy golden leaves fall quietly from the tall beech trees each crisp autumn.
items.ex_zh: 每当清爽的秋日来临，金黄厚重的树叶便从高大的山毛榉上静静飘落。

items.def_en: to descend slowly and steadily downwards through air, water, or ground
items.ex_en: The damaged submarine began to sink slowly into the dark ocean depths.
items.ex_zh: 受损的潜艇开始缓缓沉入漆黑的海洋深处。
items.ex2_en: The torpedo attack sank the hostile battleship within minutes of the blast.
items.ex2_zh: 鱼雷袭击在爆炸发生几分钟内就击沉了敌方战舰。

items.def_en: to fall or let something fall downward; to decrease or make something decrease in level or amount
items.ex_en: Temperatures will drop noticeably across the region by tomorrow evening.
items.ex_zh: 到明晚，整个地区的气温都会明显下降。
items.ex2_en: The careless tourist dropped his expensive camera straight into the deep river.
items.ex2_zh: 粗心的游客把昂贵的相机直接掉进了深河里。

items.def_en: to fall or dive quickly and with great force from a high level
items.ex_en: The daring diver plunged headfirst into the icy waters below.
items.ex_zh: 那位大胆的跳水员一头扎进了下方冰冷的水中。
items.ex2_en: The sudden financial scandal plunged the established company into serious crisis overnight.
items.ex2_zh: 突如其来的财务丑闻一夜之间将这家老牌公司推入了严重危机。

items.def_en: fall or drop steeply and rapidly from a great height
items.ex_en: Mighty torrents plunge down the sheer granite cliffs toward the valley.
items.ex_zh: 湍急的洪流顺着陡峭的花岗岩悬崖笔直坠入山谷。

items.def_en: to fall very rapidly and perpendicularly from a great height
items.ex_en: Share prices plummeted instantly after the company announced its quarterly losses.
items.ex_zh: 在公司宣布季度亏损后，股价应声暴跌。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote downward vertical motion through space, ranging from gentle gradual lowering to sheer, catastrophic freefall.
groups.summary_zh: 表示在重力或下行动力作用下由高处落向低处，按垂直坠落剧烈度递增。
groups.desc_en: Describes abrupt, unresisted, downward kinetic collapse through gravitational or fiscal free-fall, differing from gradual decline through steep trajectory and high velocity.
groups.desc_zh: 指物体或数值失去支撑后沿重力方向极速失控下坠；与平缓下滑不同，强调近乎垂直的陡峭坠落轨迹与暴跌速度。
groups.nuance_en: plummet: fall straight down at breathtaking, catastrophic speed (temperatures / shares / profits) · plunge: dive or pitch steeply and violently downward (prices / cliff / depths) · sink: descend slowly through a fluid medium or gradually settle (ship / sun / heart) · drop: fall simply from a higher position through release of support (temperatures / jaw / prices) · fall: move downward under gravitational pull without control (leaves / rain / regime)
groups.nuance_zh: plummet: 如铅锤般直线向下暴跌、急剧坠落 (temperatures / shares / profits) · plunge: 呈极陡峭角度剧烈俯冲、猛跌入深渊 (prices / cliff / depths) · sink: 在流体中缓缓下沉，或沉重心绪下坠 (ship / sun / heart) · drop: 脱离依托瞬间自然下落，或指标跳水 (temperatures / jaw / prices) · fall: 重力作用下的最基础下坠或政权溃败 (leaves / rain / regime)

groups.name: Devalue & Downgrade · 价值与评级降低 (Devalue, Depreciate, Downgrade)
groups.tip: 等级地位下滑或资产价值缩水

items.def_en: to reduce the recorded book value of an asset because it is now worth less than formerly calculated
items.ex_en: The bank had to write down several billion dollars in bad loans.
items.ex_zh: 该银行不得不将数十亿美元的不良贷款进行账面减记。

items.def_zh: 减价；给…评低分或降低评级
items.def_en: (+ sth) reduce the official price, value, or assessment score of something
items.ex_en: The department store marked down all winter coats by 40%.
items.ex_zh: 百货公司将所有冬季外套降价了40%。

items.def_en: (+ sth) reduce the nominal value, scope, or financial scale of an asset or plan
items.ex_en: The developer chose to scale down the building project due to high costs.
items.ex_zh: 由于成本高昂，开发商选择缩减建筑项目的规模。

items.def_en: (+ to) to reduce the formal rating, creditworthiness, or status of an organization or asset
items.ex_en: The agency decided to downgrade the sovereign debt rating to junk status.
items.ex_zh: 该机构决定将主权债务评级下调至垃圾级。

items.def_en: to officially reduce the value of a country's currency relative to other currencies
items.ex_en: The central bank decided to devalue the currency to boost export competitiveness.
items.ex_zh: 央行决定让本国货币贬值，以提高出口竞争力。
items.ex2_en: The national currency devalued sharply following the announcement of sudden trade sanctions.
items.ex2_zh: 在宣布突发贸易制裁后，本国货币大幅贬值。

items.def_zh: 表现不佳，业绩未达预期；（投资、股票等）运作差于大盘
items.def_en: to perform less well than expected, or worse than other people, companies, or financial assets
items.ex_en: The mutual fund continues to underperform the broader market this fiscal year.
items.ex_zh: 该共同基金本财年的表现继续落后于大盘。

items.def_zh: （资产、货币等）（使）贬值，跌价；轻视，贬低
items.def_en: 1. to decrease in value over time, or to reduce the official value of a currency 2. to treat or represent something as having little value; to belittle
items.ex_en: Brand-new vehicles usually depreciate rapidly during their first three years of use.
items.ex_zh: 崭新的车辆在使用后的前三年通常贬值非常迅速。
items.ex2_en: Inflationary economic policies depreciated the value of our domestic currency last year.
items.ex2_zh: 通货膨胀的经济政策在去年拉低了我们本国货币的价值。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame belong to economics and evaluation contexts, describing the lowering of an asset's market price, currency exchange rate, credit rating, or operational efficiency.
groups.summary_zh: 在经济与评估语境下，资产、货币、信用评级或性能在数值与等级上的下调或缩水。
groups.desc_en: Reflects the formal administrative reduction of economic book value, exchange rates, or qualitative tiers, distinguished from spontaneous market fluctuations by institutional reassessment.
groups.desc_zh: 通过制度性重估、会计结算或官方决议向下削减标的账面价值或评级；与自发市场波动不同，强调权威维度的调降定性。
groups.nuance_en: downgrade: lower the formal rating, priority, or status assessment (bonds / outlook / credit) · devalue: reduce the official peg of a currency, or lessen intrinsic worth (currency / yuan / accomplishments) · depreciate: steadily lose market value over time, or disparage (assets / dollar / machinery) · write down: reduce the recognized book value of an asset on a balance sheet (assets / debt / goodwill) · mark down: reduce retail price tags to encourage inventory clearance (goods / inventory / prices)
groups.nuance_zh: downgrade: 下调信用评级、风险展望或安全资质 (bonds / outlook / credit) · devalue: 官方宣布本国货币贬值，或贬低成果价值 (currency / yuan / accomplishments) · depreciate: 资产因磨损或市场自然折旧，亦可指贬低轻视 (assets / dollar / machinery) · write down: 在会计账目上计提减值准备、调低账面净值 (assets / debt / goodwill) · mark down: 零售商为清仓而调低商品标价打折 (goods / inventory / prices)

groups.name: Dip to Submerge · 浸蘸至浸没 (Dip, Submerge, Immerse)
groups.tip: 从浅沾轻蘸到彻底浸入液体中

items.def_en: (+ sth) briefly place something into a liquid and lift it out
items.ex_en: She decided to dip in the litmus paper to test the acidity.
items.ex_zh: 她决定把石蕊试纸浸入一下以检测酸度。

items.def_en: 1. To put something briefly into a liquid and take it out again, or to briefly go underwater. 2. To lower or drop briefly, or to decrease slightly in level or amount.
items.ex_en: He watched the swallows dip their wings into the calm lake water.
items.ex_zh: 他看着燕子将翅膀轻轻沾入平静的湖水中。
items.ex2_en: The path dips sharply into the dark valley before climbing the opposite ridge.
items.ex2_zh: 这条小路在攀上对面的山脊前，突然向下倾斜延伸进黑暗的山谷中。

items.def_en: to dip an object briefly into a liquid before quickly taking it out again
items.ex_en: I always dunk my chocolate biscuits into hot tea before eating them.
items.ex_zh: 我吃巧克力饼干前总喜欢把它们泡进热茶里蘸一下。

items.def_en: [I/T] to thrust or push someone or something quickly and forcefully down into liquid
items.ex_en: The blacksmith plunged the red-hot horseshoe into a barrel of cold water.
items.ex_zh: 铁匠将烧红的马蹄铁猛地插进冷水桶里。
items.ex2_en: The stock market plunged dramatically after the unexpected announcement from the central bank.
items.ex2_zh: 央行发布意外公告后，股市大幅暴跌。

items.def_zh: 使浸没，使浸入；使沉浸于，使全神贯注于
items.def_en: 1. To put someone or something completely under the surface of a liquid. 2. To involve someone deeply in an activity, interest, or feeling.
items.ex_en: The technician will immerse the fragile optical sensor completely in cleaning fluid.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员会将脆弱的光学传感器完全浸没在清洗液中。

items.def_zh: 猛然浸入；彻底没入（水中）
items.def_en: (+ sth) push or immerse an object deeply and forcefully beneath the surface of a liquid
items.ex_en: He grabbed the rusty blade and plunged it in the boiling oil.
items.ex_zh: 他抓起生锈的刀刃，猛然将其完全浸入滚烫的热油中。
items.ex2_en: Without any hesitation, the brave lifeguard plunged in to save the drowning child.
items.ex2_zh: 毫不犹豫地，勇敢的救生员纵身跃入水中去救那个溺水的孩子。

items.def_en: [I/T] to cause something to be completely underneath the surface of a liquid
items.ex_en: Rising floodwaters threaten to submerge the entire coastal village by midnight.
items.ex_zh: 不断上涨的洪水可能在午夜前淹没整个沿海村庄。
items.ex2_en: The yellow submarine began to submerge slowly beneath the choppy surface of the ocean.
items.ex2_zh: 黄色潜艇开始在波涛汹涌的海面下缓缓下潜。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express placing an object into a liquid, graded by the physical extent of covering—from brief, partial immersion (dipping) to completely submerging the entire entity beneath the surface.
groups.summary_zh: 体现物体进入液体的深度与程度，从短暂局部沾浸到完全深潜浸没。
groups.desc_en: Captures the graduated immersion of an object into a fluid, ranging from a brief surface kiss to total enveloping beneath the liquid boundary, contrasting with splashing by continuous containment.
groups.desc_zh: 指物体不同程度地没入流体界面的动作谱系（从轻触点蘸至完全浸没）；与泼洒不同，强调液体对实体的包容与浸润。
groups.nuance_en: dip: lower briefly and shallowly into a liquid before raising (brush / toe / ladle) · dunk: briefly immerse completely, often food into a beverage (biscuit / bread / donut) · plunge: thrust forcefully and deeply beneath a liquid surface (hands / dagger / head) · immerse: place entirely under liquid to soak or cover completely (body / specimen / hands) · submerge: completely cover beneath the surface of a deep fluid (submarine / island / vessel)
groups.nuance_zh: dip: 轻缓且浅显地探入液体随即提起蘸取 (brush / toe / ladle) · dunk: 将食物迅速泡入茶饮或液体中旋即取出 (biscuit / bread / donut) · plunge: 猛力且深沉地将物体扎入、猛插进液体深处 (hands / dagger / head) · immerse: 将物体完全浸泡在液体中以使其被全面包覆 (body / specimen / hands) · submerge: 整体没入水下深处使其完全隐没 (submarine / island / vessel)

groups.name: Direct & Steer · 驾驶与掌舵领航 (Steer, Navigate, Pilot)
groups.tip: 掌控方向指引路线

items.def_en: to direct the movement, course, or direction of someone or something
items.ex_en: The lighthouse keepers guide approaching vessels away from the perilous rocks.
items.ex_zh: 灯塔看守人指引靠近的船只避开危险的礁石。

items.def_en: to operate the controls of an aircraft or direct a ship through a hazardous passage
items.ex_en: An experienced local captain arrived to pilot the freighter through the treacherous strait.
items.ex_zh: 一位经验丰富的当地船长赶来引航这艘货轮穿过凶险的海峡。

items.def_en: (+ sth) pilot or direct the course of a vehicle or vessel through a tricky passage
items.ex_en: The helmsman managed to steer through the narrow canal without any incident.
items.ex_zh: 舵手成功操纵船只驶过了狭窄的运河，未发生任何意外。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) navigate and direct the physical passage of someone or a vehicle through an area
items.ex_en: Local scouts volunteered to guide through the dense jungle the lost convoy.
items.ex_zh: 当地向导自愿引导走失的车队穿行茂密的丛林。

items.def_zh: 驾驶，掌舵，操纵方向；引导，带领
items.def_en: 1. To control the direction in which a vehicle, boat, or aircraft moves. 2. To guide someone or something in a particular direction or towards a goal.
items.ex_en: The driver fought to steer the skidding car away from the ditch.
items.ex_zh: 司机拼命打方向盘，操纵打滑的汽车避开水沟。
items.ex2_en: The yacht steers easily even through turbulent coastal waters and heavy winds.
items.ex2_zh: 这艘游艇即使在汹涌的沿海水域和强风中也操控自如。

items.def_zh: 导航，确定路线；驾驶，航行；应对，妥善处理
items.def_en: 1. To plan and direct the route of a ship, aircraft, or vehicle; to find your way through an area. 2. To deal successfully with a difficult or complex situation.
items.ex_en: Modern aircraft rely on satellite systems to navigate across vast oceanic routes.
items.ex_zh: 现代飞机依靠卫星系统在广阔的大洋航线上导航。

items.def_en: to steer or steer a boat, ship, or organization as its helmsman
items.ex_en: The veteran captain returned to helm the sailboat during the sudden storm.
items.ex_zh: 老船长在突如其来的暴风雨中回到岗位掌舵帆船。

groups.summary_en: An operator guides the course, direction, or passage of a vehicle, vessel, or journey through terrain, water, or airspace. 'Steer' emphasizes physical mechanical deflection of direction, 'navigate' focuses on plotting and tracking a passage, and 'pilot' emphasizes expert hands-on guidance through difficult routes.
groups.summary_zh: 操控交通工具的方向或规划路线以安全通行。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the active, tactical mastery of directing a vessel or vehicle through path resistance and environmental hazards, contrasting with passive drifting through intentional control of trajectory.
groups.desc_zh: 在复杂动态水域或空域中主动掌控航向以规避障碍；与被动漂流不同，强调对行进轨迹的持续修正与战术舵控能力。
groups.nuance_en: steer: physically control the mechanical direction of a moving vehicle (car / ship / conversation) · navigate: plot and follow a course through complex, hazardous routes (waters / terrain / bureaucracy) · pilot: take expert physical helm of a specialized craft through tricky conditions (plane / vessel / legislation) · helm: serve as presiding leader directing an enterprise or ship (project / vessel / committee) · guide: escort and show the optimal route to prevent getting lost (visitors / tourists / novice)
groups.nuance_zh: steer: 操纵方向盘或舵柄控制物理机动方向 (car / ship / conversation) · navigate: 识图辨向、规划复杂路径穿行于险境或体制 (waters / terrain / bureaucracy) · pilot: 作为专业领航员/飞行员驾引特种运载器，或引航政策 (plane / vessel / legislation) · helm: 居于掌舵之席统筹领导大局 (project / vessel / committee) · guide: 在旁引路指明正确路线以免迷失 (visitors / tourists / novice)

groups.name: Direct Physical Exchange · 换物与易货 (Swap, Barter, Trade off)
groups.tip: 物物互通不经货币

items.def_en: (+ sth) substitute or exchange one physical item directly for another
items.ex_en: We should swap out the worn tires before embarking on our trip.
items.ex_zh: 在启程出行前，我们应该把磨损的轮胎换掉。

items.def_zh: 以旧折价换新；折价换置
items.def_en: (+ sth) give a used item in part-exchange toward the acquisition of another
items.ex_en: I traded in my old sedan for a hybrid SUV.
items.ex_zh: 我把旧轿车折价置换了一辆混动SUV。

items.def_en: to exchange one thing for another as a compromise or direct bargain
items.ex_en: Commuters often trade off a longer travel time for cheaper housing.
items.ex_zh: 通勤者往往以更长的路途时间换取更便宜的住房成本。

items.def_zh: 交换，调换，以物易物；替换
items.def_en: to give something to someone in exchange for something else, or exchange places.
items.ex_en: The boys decided to swap comic books during their lunch break.
items.ex_zh: 男孩子们决定在午休时间交换漫画书。

items.def_en: (+ with/over) to haggle or barter in a petty manner over terms or items
items.ex_en: He spent all afternoon dickering over the price of an old bicycle.
items.ex_zh: 他整个下午都在为一辆旧自行车的价格讨价还价。

items.def_zh: 以物易物，交易（古旧或方言）
items.def_en: [I/T] (+ with) to barter or exchange goods without money
items.ex_en: Frontier settlers used to truck with local trappers for warm winter furs.
items.ex_zh: 边境开拓者过去常常与当地捕兽者以物易物换取温暖的冬令毛皮。

items.def_zh: 以物易物，物物交换；拿……进行交换
items.def_en: to exchange goods or services directly for other goods or services without using money.
items.ex_en: Villagers often barter fresh homegrown produce for handcrafted tools at the market.
items.ex_zh: 村民们经常在集市上用自家种的新鲜农产品物物交换手制工具。

groups.summary_en: Denotes the bilateral exchange of commodities or possessions without currency. 'Swap' highlights a quick, informal, one-for-one substitution, whereas 'barter' stresses the transactional negotiation of goods or services based on mutual valuation.
groups.summary_zh: 以货物、劳务直接互换资产，侧重无货币流通的以物易物。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on the direct reciprocal substitution of goods, positions, or favors between parties without cash mediation, differing from general commercial buying by bilateral in-kind reciprocity.
groups.desc_zh: 两方在无货币媒介干预下直接互换物品、岗位或利益；与一般买卖不同，强调实物对等置换与即时双向代偿。
groups.nuance_en: barter: exchange goods or services directly without money (goods / wheat / labor) · swap: quickly trade one distinct item or position for another (seats / stories / shirts) · trade in: surrender an old used item as partial payment for a new one (car / phone / equipment) · trade off: compromise by yielding one advantage to secure another (speed / privacy / flexibility) · dicker: engage in petty, protracted haggling over trade terms (price / horses / terms)
groups.nuance_zh: barter: 无货币参与的纯实物或劳务以物易物 (goods / wheat / labor) · swap: 迅速且对等对调物品、座位或班次 (seats / stories / shirts) · trade in: 将旧物件折价以抵扣部分款项换购新品 (car / phone / equipment) · trade off: 权衡取舍，通过牺牲某项优势来换取另一项 (speed / privacy / flexibility) · dicker: 就琐碎交易条件或价格磨牙反复讨价还价 (price / horses / terms)

groups.name: Discharge by Administrative/Military Action · 军政革职与解雇 (Cashier, Invalid, Drum Out)
groups.tip: 令其退役免职或开除公职

items.def_en: (+ of) to officially take away someone's rank, titles, or authority as a penalty
items.ex_en: The court decided to strip the disgraced general of his military honors.
items.ex_zh: 法庭决定剥夺这位身败名裂的将军的一切军界荣誉。

items.def_zh: 因伤残（病）令……退役；因病遣送退役
items.def_en: To discharge or remove someone (especially a member of the armed forces) from active service because of injury or illness.
items.ex_en: The army medical board voted to invalid the wounded sergeant from service.
items.ex_zh: 陆军医疗委员会投票决定让负伤的军士因伤退役。

items.def_en: (+ of) to dismiss someone from a military force or organization in official disgrace
items.ex_en: The corrupt officer was thoroughly disgraced and drummed out of the regiment.
items.ex_zh: 那名腐败的军官名誉扫地，被彻底撵出了团部。

items.def_en: (+ sb) dismiss or expel someone forcibly from a post, military unit, or institution
items.ex_en: He was kicked out of the university for repeatedly cheating on exams.
items.ex_zh: 他因多次考试作弊被大学开除。

items.def_zh: 开除；驱除出机关或军伍
items.def_en: (+ sb) dismiss someone dishonorably or force them to leave an organization
items.ex_en: The judge threw out the lawsuit due to lack of evidence.
items.ex_zh: 法官因证据不足驳回了该起诉讼。

items.def_zh: （军队中）革职，开除军籍；丢弃，罢免
items.def_en: To dismiss an officer from the armed forces in disgrace; to dismiss someone from an official position or discard something.
items.ex_en: The tribunal resolved to cashier the rebellious officer for gross military misconduct.
items.ex_zh: 军事法庭决议因严重的渎职行为革除那名叛乱军官的军籍。

items.def_en: to officially remove a priest or cleric from religious office because of wrongdoing
items.ex_en: The archbishop moved swiftly to defrock the offending priest after the scandal.
items.ex_zh: 丑闻曝光后，大主教迅速采取行动剥夺了那名违纪神父的神职。

groups.summary_en: An institution, armed force, or governing body terminates an individual's commission or service under specific administrative, medical, or disciplinary terms. Verbs highlight dishonorable expulsion, court-martial strip, or medical release.
groups.summary_zh: 因违纪、判决或伤残等特定行政/军事程序革职、除名或退伍。
groups.desc_en: Denotes stripping an individual of rank, office, or membership through formal, institutional, or disciplinary eviction, differing from general termination ('fire/dismiss') by its punitive, status-revoking, and often public nature.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过正式、纪律或体制性程序剥夺某人的军衔、圣职或组织成员资格，与普通解雇（fire/dismiss）相比，更具惩戒性、地位剥夺感及公开羞辱性。
groups.nuance_en: cashier: formally and dishonorably dismiss from military service (officer / captain / commander) · defrock: strip of ecclesiastical authority and clerical status (priest / minister / bishop) · drum out: expel in disgrace accompanied by public ostracism (regiment / party / corps) · invalid: discharge or medically retire due to disability or wounds (soldier / veteran / patient) · strip: divest of rank, titles, or honors punitively (rank / title / medal)
groups.nuance_zh: cashier: 军职羞辱性革职 (officer / captain / commander) · defrock: 褫夺教权/削夺圣职 (priest / minister / bishop) · drum out: 鸣鼓逐出/公然开除 (regiment / party / corps) · invalid: 因伤病退伍/免役 (soldier / veteran / patient) · strip: 剥夺军阶或荣誉头衔 (rank / title / medal)

groups.name: Discolor & Tint · 变色与着色 (Tinge, Stain, Tan)
groups.tip: 色泽发生褪变或被人工染上颜色

items.def_en: (+ with sth) to turn yellow over time due to age, exposure, or smoke
items.ex_en: The antique manuscript pages yellow with age beneath the dim library lamp.
items.ex_zh: 在图书馆昏暗的灯光下，古老手稿的书页因岁月久远而泛黄。

items.def_en: To become purple in color, or to make something purple.
items.ex_en: Ripening clusters of sweet grapes slowly purple along the hillside vineyard rows.
items.ex_zh: 山坡葡萄园里一串串熟透的甜葡萄逐渐变成了深紫色。
items.ex2_en: The cold mountain wind purples his pale lips during the long winter trek.
items.ex2_zh: 在漫长的冬季跋涉中，冰冷的山风把他苍白的嘴唇冻成了紫色。

items.def_en: 1. To become brown, or to make someone's skin brown, from exposure to the sun. 2. To convert animal hide into leather.
items.ex_en: His pale skin would tan quickly under the scorching Mediterranean summer sun.
items.ex_zh: 在地中海灼热的夏日阳光下，他苍白的皮肤很快就晒黑了。
items.ex2_en: Workers tan high-grade cowhide in large wooden vats behind the leather factory.
items.ex2_zh: 工人们在皮革厂后面的大木桶里鞣制优质牛皮。

items.def_en: to impart a slight trace of color, shade, or hue to sth
items.ex_en: The setting sun began to tinge the distant clouds with vibrant rose.
items.ex_zh: 落日开始将远处的云彩染上一抹绚丽的玫瑰色。

items.def_zh: （使）表面烤成褐色；（阳光或热度使）晒黑或枯黄
items.def_en: (+ sth) to make or become brown, especially from exposure to heat, sunlight, or drying
items.ex_en: I'm really browned off with having to wait around for hours.
items.ex_zh: 我不得不干等好几个小时，真是烦透了。
items.ex2_en: The intense summer heat will quickly brown off the tender grass on the lawn.
items.ex2_zh: 酷热的夏日很快就会把草坪上嫩绿的草晒成干褐色。

items.def_en: [I/T] to change or cause sth to change color in an abnormal, spoiled, or faded way
items.ex_en: Harsh industrial chemicals will discolor the marble flooring if not cleaned promptly.
items.ex_zh: 若不及时清理，刺激性工业化学品会使大理石地板变色。
items.ex2_en: The delicate silk fabric will discolor if exposed directly to harsh sunlight.
items.ex2_zh: 这种精致的丝绸织物如果直接暴露在强烈的阳光下就会变色。

items.def_en: [I/T] to become red or make sth red (through sun, blood rush, or dye)
items.ex_en: Her delicate cheeks redden beneath the cold biting winter wind outside.
items.ex_zh: 在室外刺骨的寒冬冷风中，她娇嫩的双颊泛起了红晕。
items.ex2_en: The setting sun reddens the western sky with a brilliant fiery glow tonight.
items.ex2_zh: 今晚落日将西边的天空染上了一片灿烂如火的红霞。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here signify altering an object's surface color, either through natural physiological/solar processes ('tan'), chemical/biological pigment changes ('purple'), or accidental discoloration. Distinctions turn on whether the hue shift is intentional, weather-driven, or an applied stain.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体表面因光照、化学反应或外物渗透而改变自身固有色泽。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an alteration in surface hue or tone caused by age, chemical exposure, light, or physiological reaction, contrasting with intentional painting or coating by implying an involuntary or gradual shift.
groups.desc_zh: 指因老化、化学作用、光照或生理反应导致物体表面色调发生改变，与主动的人工着色（paint/dye）相对，强调非自愿或渐进的成色/变色过程。
groups.nuance_en: tinge: impart a faint, subtle trace of color (sky / cheeks / leaves) · discolor: spoil, tarnish, or alter original color undesirably (teeth / fabric / surface) · tan: darken through exposure to sunlight (skin / hide / leather) · redden: turn red from emotion, irritation, or heat (face / cheeks / sky) · yellow with: turn yellowish due to aging, decay, or disease (paper / age / jaundice)
groups.nuance_zh: tinge: 微染/带有一丝色泽 (sky / cheeks / leaves) · discolor: 变色/褪色/染污原色 (teeth / fabric / surface) · tan: 晒黑/鞣制 (skin / hide / leather) · redden: 发红/脸红 (face / cheeks / sky) · yellow with: 因岁月或病理泛黄 (paper / age / jaundice)

groups.name: Disentangle & Separate Strands · 理顺与解结 (Untangle, Unravel, Disentangle)
groups.tip: 理顺解开打结缠线

items.def_en: (+ sth) to untangle or arrange tangled things into an orderly state
items.ex_en: She patiently spent hours trying to sort out the tangled knitting yarn.
items.ex_zh: 她耐心地花了数小时试图理顺那团缠结在一起的毛线。

items.def_en: to undo stitches or woven threads carefully one by one
items.ex_en: The tailor used a sharp needle to unpick the crooked seam.
items.ex_zh: 裁缝用一根尖细的针小心地挑开那道缝歪了的线迹。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to separate tangled strands, fibers, or hairs carefully and patiently
items.ex_en: She used a wide comb to tease out the stubborn hair knots.
items.ex_zh: 她用一把宽齿梳耐心地把顽固纠结的发结梳理开。

items.def_zh: 解开，理顺（缠结之物）；澄清，理清（混乱局势）
items.def_en: To separate knotted or twisted threads, wires, or hair; to sort out and clarify a complicated situation or problem.
items.ex_en: It took twenty minutes to untangle the knotted cords behind my desk.
items.ex_zh: 理顺我书桌后面打结的电线花掉了二十分钟。

items.def_zh: 拆散，解开（织物等）；使纠缠，使混乱；（纤维或编织物）散开
items.def_en: 1. To separate something into loose threads; to untangle or become unraveled. 2. To tangle, complicate, or become confused.
items.ex_en: The old woman began to ravel the worn wool of the sweater.
items.ex_zh: 老妇人开始把这件破旧毛衣上的羊毛线小心地拆解散开。
items.ex2_en: The loose hem began to ravel after being washed repeatedly in hot water.
items.ex2_zh: 在用热水反复清洗后，松动的衣边开始散开了。

items.def_en: (+ from) to separate things that have become knotted, twisted, or confused together
items.ex_en: He managed to disentangle the delicate fishing line from the sharp coral.
items.ex_zh: 他设法把细脆的鱼线从尖锐的珊瑚上解脱开来。

items.def_en: to free something from tangled, snarled knots or messy snarls
items.ex_en: The old sailor tried to unsnarl the heavy ropes before setting sail.
items.ex_zh: 老水手在扬帆启航之前，努力解开那些缠绕成死结的粗绳。

groups.summary_en: An agent separates snarled, knotted, or intertwined threads, cables, or figurative complications into orderly individual strands. Verbs differ in whether the manner is patient manual clearing, loosening, or pulling apart.
groups.summary_zh: 耐心地将缠绕打结的绳线、线团或混乱乱局逐步解开理顺。
groups.desc_en: Denotes separating snarled, intertwined fibers or resolving complex knotted situations, differing from linear 'dividing' by focusing on the restoration of clarity and order from chaotic entanglement.
groups.desc_zh: 指解开纠缠交错的纤维股线或理清错综复杂的局面，与单纯的“分割”（divide）不同，核心在于从混沌交结中梳理恢复秩序与清晰。
groups.nuance_en: disentangle: free from complicated, snarled physical or figurative ties (threads / knots / complications) · untangle: unknot tangled strands or clarify a messy problem (hair / yarn / mystery) · tease out: patiently extract subtle strands, facts, or threads with gentle effort (fibers / strands / meaning) · unpick: undo woven seams or systematically dismantle an argument (stitches / seam / argument) · unsnarl: clear severe physical or logistical snarls (traffic / lines / wire)
groups.nuance_zh: disentangle: 理顺纠缠/解脱牵扯 (threads / knots / complications) · untangle: 解开绳结/梳理乱象 (hair / yarn / mystery) · tease out: 细致抽绎/挑顺缕线 (fibers / strands / meaning) · unpick: 拆解缝线/逐一挑剔 (stitches / seam / argument) · unsnarl: 排除死结或堵塞 (traffic / lines / wire)

groups.name: Dry-Heat Cooking · 烘焙与干烤 (Bake, Roast, Toast)
groups.tip: 用炉火或烤箱将生食材制熟

items.def_zh: （经烘烤等干热使其）变脆；烘脆
items.def_en: (+ sth) to make or become pleasantly crisp through dry baking or roasting
items.ex_en: Return the soggy fries to the hot oven to crisp them up.
items.ex_zh: 把发软的薯条放回热烤箱中，让它们重新烘脆。
items.ex2_en: The bacon will crisp up nicely if you fry it over medium heat.
items.ex2_zh: 如果你用中火煎培根，它就会变得香脆可口。

items.def_en: [T/I] to make bread or other food brown and crisp by exposing it to direct dry radiant heat
items.ex_en: She likes to toast the bagel slices until they turn golden brown.
items.ex_zh: 她喜欢将切片百吉饼烘烤至表面呈现金黄色。
items.ex2_en: The sourdough bread toasts quickly in this high-powered modern stainless steel toaster.
items.ex2_zh: 酸酵母面包在这台大功率的现代不锈钢烤面包机里很快就能烤焦黄。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to finish cooking or thoroughly bake prepared raw dough or pastries
items.ex_en: The chef will bake off the proofed croissants early tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 厨师明早会一早将发酵好的牛角包送进烤箱烤熟。

items.def_zh: 烘焙，烤制（面包、糕点等）；（使）受暴晒，烤热
items.def_en: 1. To cook food, especially bread, cakes, or pies, by dry heat in an oven. 2. To become or make something extremely warm or dry through intense heat.
items.ex_en: My grandmother loves to bake fresh apple pies on cool autumn afternoons.
items.ex_zh: 我祖母喜欢在凉爽的秋日下午烘焙新鲜的苹果派。
items.ex2_en: The clay pots bake slowly inside the large wood-fired ceramic kiln.
items.ex2_zh: 陶罐在大型柴烧陶瓷窑内慢慢烘烤硬化。

items.def_zh: （在烤箱或明火上）烤，炙烤，烘焙（肉、豆等）；戏谑批评，公开嘲弄
items.def_en: 1. To cook meat, vegetables, or nuts using dry heat in an oven or over an open fire. 2. (informal) To criticize severely, or playfully tease and mock someone.
items.ex_en: The comedians gathered together onstage to mercilessly roast their beloved host.
items.ex_zh: 喜剧演员们聚集在舞台上，毫不留情地公开调侃嘲弄他们敬爱的主持人。
items.ex2_en: Whole potatoes roast best when placed directly upon hot charcoal in the fire pit.
items.ex2_zh: 整颗土豆直接放在火坑里滚烫的木炭上烤效果最好。

items.def_en: to roast grain, corn, or peas slightly by dry heat without adding fat
items.ex_en: Nomads routinely parch dry corn over open stones before grinding it.
items.ex_zh: 游牧民通常在研磨前将干玉米放在露天石头上炒干。

items.def_en: [T/I] to blacken or scorch the exterior surface of food with intense dry heat
items.ex_en: Be careful not to char the bell peppers too heavily over flames.
items.ex_zh: 小心别在明火上把甜椒的表面烤得过分焦黑。
items.ex2_en: The dry wooden fence will char quickly if the bonfire gets too close.
items.ex2_zh: 如果篝火靠得太近，干燥的木栅栏很快就会被烤焦变黑。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate cooking food through enclosed dry heat (such as an oven or dry radiant heat), differentiated by food type and whether open air or browning is involved.
groups.summary_zh: 指利用烤箱内或干热辐射加热食物的烹饪方式，依食材结构与烘炙手法区分。
groups.desc_en: Denotes preparing food or material using dry radiated, circulated, or enclosed heat without boiling liquids, differing from wet-heat cooking (boiling/steaming) through surface chemical transformation (Maillard reaction, moisture depletion).
groups.desc_zh: 指利用辐射热、热风或密闭干热加工食材或物质，与湿法烹调（boil/steam）相对，强调脱水、美拉德反应及表面焦化脆化。
groups.nuance_en: bake: cook food through indirect dry oven heat without open flame (bread / cake / cookies) · roast: cook meat or vegetables uncovered at high dry heat (chicken / meat / coffee beans) · toast: brown surfaces rapidly via direct radiant heat (bread / nuts / marshmallows) · char: blacken and scorch the exterior with intense dry flame (wood / peppers / vegetables) · parch: deplete completely of moisture through scorching heat (corn / throat / earth)
groups.nuance_zh: bake: 烘焙/窑烤 (bread / cake / cookies) · roast: 烘烤/炙烤 (chicken / meat / coffee beans) · toast: 烤焦黄/烘脆表面 (bread / nuts / marshmallows) · char: 烧焦/炭化表层 (wood / peppers / vegetables) · parch: 烤干/烘焙脱水 (corn / throat / earth)

groups.name: Emit Light & Shed Glow · 照亮与发光 (Lighten, Brighten, Illuminate)
groups.tip: 驱散黑暗，使视野豁然开朗

items.def_zh: （使）变亮，照亮；（使）变轻，缓解，减轻
items.def_en: 1. To become brighter, or to make something brighter or lighter in color. 2. To become or make less heavy, serious, or anxious.
items.ex_en: The morning sky began to lighten gradually as the storm finally passed.
items.ex_zh: 随着暴风雨终于过去，清晨的天空开始逐渐亮了起来。
items.ex2_en: She added a drop of white paint to lighten the deep blue mixture.
items.ex2_zh: 她加入一滴白漆，使那深蓝色的颜料变淡一些。

items.def_zh: （使）变亮，照亮；（使）快活起来，（使）充满希望
items.def_en: 1. To become brighter, or to make something brighter. 2. To become or make happier, more cheerful, or hopeful.
items.ex_en: A few well-placed lamps will brighten the dark hallway considerably.
items.ex_zh: 几盏摆放得当的台灯会使昏暗的走廊显著亮堂起来。
items.ex2_en: Her expressive face brightened when she saw her childhood best friend enter the room.
items.ex2_zh: 看到儿时最好的朋友走进房间，她生动的脸庞顿时容光焕发。

items.def_en: (of the sun or a light source) to shine brightly and intensely downward
items.ex_en: Scorching rays beam down from the midday sun upon the open field.
items.ex_zh: 灼热的光芒从正午的太阳直射照耀在开阔的原野上。

items.def_en: [T/I] to make an area or object suddenly bright with light
items.ex_en: Flashes of distant lightning continued to light up the midnight horizon.
items.ex_zh: 远处的阵阵闪电不断将午夜的地平线照得通明。
items.ex2_en: The vast night sky lit up with dazzling fireworks during the grand finale.
items.ex2_zh: 在盛大的尾声中，广袤的夜空被耀眼的烟花照亮了。

items.def_en: to emit a bright, clear, and steady beam of light
items.ex_en: Her sheer determination shone out among all the applicants.
items.ex_zh: 她坚定的决心在所有申请人中格外引人注目。

items.def_en: to light up a place or subject with focused or artistic artificial light
items.ex_en: Strategic floodlights illuminate the historical cathedral facade with stunning brilliance every evening.
items.ex_zh: 精心布置的泛光灯每晚都以惊艳的光彩照射着古老教堂的正面。

items.def_en: to illuminate something intensely with beams of bright radiant light
items.ex_en: Dazzling searchlights irradiate the grand monument against the pitch-black sky.
items.ex_zh: 耀眼的探照灯用强烈的光束照射着漆黑夜空下的宏伟纪念碑。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey rendering an area visibly clearer or casting light upon it, contrasting gradual lightening of color/darkness with active illumination and radiance.
groups.summary_zh: 通过投射光线消除黑暗、照亮空间或使表面变得通明光亮的形态动作。
groups.desc_en: Denotes radiating, projecting, or reflecting luminous energy outward to dispel darkness, differing from intrinsic static brightness by focusing on the dynamic act of shedding light across space.
groups.desc_zh: 指主动向外辐射、投射或散射光能以驱散黑暗，与静态的“明亮”（be bright）不同，强调光能穿透空间、施加光明的动态行为。
groups.nuance_en: illuminate: flood with bright, clarifying light physically or intellectually (room / manuscript / path) · beam down: project a concentrated shaft of light from above (sun / spotlight / searchlight) · brighten: increase the intensity or vividness of illumination (sky / room / prospect) · irradiate: cast penetrating energetic rays upon an object (specimen / tumor / face) · lighten: diminish surrounding darkness or shade (sky / horizon / dusk)
groups.nuance_zh: illuminate: 照亮/全面阐明 (room / manuscript / path) · beam down: 居高投下光柱 (sun / spotlight / searchlight) · brighten: 增亮/放晴 (sky / room / prospect) · irradiate: 照射/辐射穿透 (specimen / tumor / face) · lighten: 变亮/发白微明 (sky / horizon / dusk)

groups.name: Enclose in Rigid Coverings · 套装与鞘封 (Sheathe, Incase, Envelop)
groups.tip: 外壳套入密实包裹

items.def_en: to enclose or contain a mechanism or component within a protective frame or housing
items.ex_en: The aluminum casing is designed to house the sensitive electronic equipment.
items.ex_zh: 这个铝制外壳旨在容纳并保护敏感的电子设备。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to put items into a rigid box or crate for protection or storage
items.ex_en: Before moving out, we spent three days boxing up all our books and clothes.
items.ex_zh: 搬家前，我们花了三天时间把所有的书和衣服打包入箱。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to pack goods into large rigid wooden crates for safe transport
items.ex_en: Workers will crate up the delicate porcelain vases for secure overseas shipment.
items.ex_zh: 工人们将把精美的瓷瓶装入坚固的板条箱封好，以确保海外运输安全。

items.def_en: to cover or enclose an object with an outer protective jacket or casing
items.ex_en: Engineers plan to jacket the underground pipeline with a thick waterproof layer.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们计划给这条地下管道套上一层厚实的防水保护套。

items.def_en: to enclose or cover something completely in a case, close-fitting mold, or hard layer
items.ex_en: The museum chose to encase the priceless gold artifact in bulletproof glass.
items.ex_zh: 博物馆选择将这件无价的金器用防弹玻璃严密包封起来。

items.def_zh: 把……装入箱（或套、壳）内，包住
items.def_en: 1. (variant spelling of encase) To enclose or cover completely within a protective case or covering.
items.ex_en: The artisan chose to incase the delicate golden reliquary in carved ebony.
items.ex_zh: 工匠决定用雕花乌木将精致的金质圣物匣完全包裹起来。

items.def_zh: 插入鞘中；覆盖，包裹（以起保护作用）
items.def_en: 1. To put a sword, knife, or other weapon into its sheath. 2. (+ in/with) To cover or encase something in a protective outer layer.
items.ex_en: The weary knight paused to sheathe his bloody sword before resting.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的骑士停下脚步，在休息前将沾满血迹的利剑收入鞘中。

groups.summary_en: An agent fits an object snugly inside a dedicated protective cover, rigid housing, or tight sheath. The manner of action varies from inserting a blade or wire into a form-fitting sheath (sheathe) to packing firmly within a rigid frame or protective crate (incase/encase) or embedding tightly in a protective jacket.
groups.summary_zh: 指将物体严密装入定制硬质护套、外壳或紧密保护层中。
groups.desc_en: Denotes surrounding an object within a sturdy, protective, or form-fitting rigid receptacle, differing from loose wrapping (wrapping/draping) by emphasizing protective containment, structural housing, and barrier creation.
groups.desc_zh: 指用坚固、贴合或定型的硬质外壳或护套将物体紧密包封，与宽松包裹（wrap/drape）相对，强调保护性容纳、结构嵌装与屏障隔绝。
groups.nuance_en: encase: completely surround and enclose in a tight, firm protective shell (body / relics / concrete) · sheathe: insert into a protective sheath or cover with a defensive outer layer (sword / dagger / cable) · house: structurally accommodate and protect sensitive mechanisms (engine / equipment / turbine) · crate up: pack securely inside heavy wooden slatted containers for transport (machinery / goods / art) · jacket: envelop in an insulating or protective outer sleeve (pipe / cylinder / book)
groups.nuance_zh: encase: 坚固外壳紧密包封 (body / relics / concrete) · sheathe: 入鞘/加护层封套 (sword / dagger / cable) · house: 机械容纳/机箱安置 (engine / equipment / turbine) · crate up: 装入板条箱 (machinery / goods / art) · jacket: 加装外护套/保温套 (pipe / cylinder / book)

groups.name: Encompass & Subsume · 包含与涵括 (Include, Comprise, Embrace)
groups.tip: 全面包罗并广泛囊括

items.def_en: to contain someone or something as part of a whole or group
items.ex_en: The conference fee does not include overnight accommodation or evening meals.
items.ex_zh: 会议费用不包含过夜住宿或晚餐。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to include or encompass a range of things or concepts within a scope
items.ex_en: The proposed environmental legislation will take in several previously unregulated industrial sectors.
items.ex_zh: 拟议中的环境立法将涵盖先前数个不受监管的工业部门。

items.def_zh: 包含，涵盖；欣然接受；拥抱
items.def_en: 1. To include or contain something as a part. 2. To accept an idea, belief, or change eagerly. 3. To hold someone closely in your arms.
items.ex_en: The new curriculum aims to embrace modern scientific methods and classical humanities.
