items.ex_zh: 新课程旨在囊括现代科学方法与古典人文学科。

items.def_en: 1. To consist of or be made up of. 2. To form or make up something.
items.ex_en: The investigative committee will comprise five senior jurists and two forensic specialists.
items.ex_zh: 调查委员会将由五位资深法官和两位法医专家组成。

items.def_en: to include a wide range of ideas, subjects, or items comprehensively
items.ex_en: Her comprehensive study seeks to encompass the entirety of medieval trade networks.
items.ex_zh: 她的综合研究力求全面涵盖中世纪贸易网络的整个脉络。

items.def_en: (+ sth into sth) to integrate or subsume an entity, unit, or concept into a larger whole
items.ex_en: The independent research unit was soon folded into the university's main department.
items.ex_zh: 这个独立研究机构很快被并入了该大学的核心院系。

items.def_zh: 归入；把……纳入更高级别范畴
items.def_en: to incorporate a lesser rule, element, or idea into a broader, comprehensive category
items.ex_en: Scholars often subsume these minor artistic movements under the broad umbrella of modernism.
items.ex_zh: 学者们往往将这些次要的艺术流派归入现代主义这一大类之中。

groups.summary_en: A collective whole, concept, or domain includes constituent elements or broad categories within its scope. Intensity measures the comprehensiveness and scope of inclusion, progressing from basic constituent containment (comprise) to wide-ranging thematic incorporation (embrace, encompass) and all-inclusive totalization (subsume).
groups.summary_zh: 指整体、体系或范畴在广度与深度上容纳、包含各组成部分。
groups.desc_en: Denotes holding, incorporating, or assimilating components within a broader boundary or conceptual framework, contrasting with partial presence by asserting holistic, categorical, or structural inclusion.
groups.desc_zh: 指在更宏观的边界或概念体系中容纳、吸纳或整合各组分，与局部的存在相对，强调结构性、范畴性的全覆盖与整体包摄。
groups.nuance_en: encompass: sweep a comprehensive range within broad borders or scopes (territory / aspects / issues) · subsume: absorb or incorporate a specific item under a wider rule or class (category / case / identity) · comprise: constitute or consist of enumerated constituent elements (provinces / chapters / elements) · embrace: warmly or holistically welcome a range of ideas or elements (variety / diversity / philosophy) · fold into: seamlessly blend a component into an ongoing structure (process / dough / budget)
groups.nuance_zh: encompass: 囊括/周全涵盖 (territory / aspects / issues) · subsume: 归入/吸纳包容 (category / case / identity) · comprise: 构成/由…组成 (provinces / chapters / elements) · embrace: 欣然包罗/信奉融入 (variety / diversity / philosophy) · fold into: 顺势并入/折入 (process / dough / budget)

groups.name: Enhance & Infuse Taste · 增香与赋味 (Flavor, Infuse, Spice)
groups.tip: 加入调料以丰富风味与口感

items.def_en: to add salt, herbs, or spices to food to enhance its natural taste
items.ex_en: Be sure to season the fresh vegetable stew with cracked black pepper.
items.ex_zh: 一定要用研磨黑胡椒碎给这道新鲜蔬菜炖汤调味。

items.def_en: to give a particular taste or flavor to food or drink
items.ex_en: The pastry chef used pure vanilla extract to flavor the delicate almond custard.
items.ex_zh: 糕点师用纯香草精为精致的杏仁卡仕达酱增添风味。

items.def_en: to steep herbs or flavorings in a liquid so that the flavor is absorbed
items.ex_en: The chef decided to infuse warm cream with fragrant crushed cardamom pods.
items.ex_zh: 主厨决定在温热的稀奶油中浸入压碎的香豆蔻以萃取香味。

items.def_en: to flavor something by adding finely grated citrus peel
items.ex_en: She proceeded to zest two fresh lemons directly over the sponge cake batter.
items.ex_zh: 她接着把两个新鲜柠檬的皮屑直接擦入海绵蛋糕糊中提味。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to make food or drink tastier or more pungent by adding zest or spices
items.ex_en: A dash of cayenne pepper will instantly pep up this bland lentil soup.
items.ex_zh: 少许卡宴辣椒粉能立刻让这道清淡的扁豆汤风味倍增。

items.def_zh: 加香料使（食物）更辛香可口
items.def_en: (+ sth) to add spices or seasonings to food or drink to make it more flavorful
items.ex_en: She added chili flakes and roasted cumin to spice up the chicken marinade.
items.ex_zh: 她加入了辣椒碎和烤孜然，让鸡肉腌料更加辛香入味。

items.def_en: to flavor something with aromatic, piquant spices
items.ex_en: Traditional holiday bakers always spice the sweet dough with cinnamon and fragrant cloves.
items.ex_zh: 传统的节日烘焙师总会用肉桂和芳香的丁香来为甜面团调味。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify modifying the sensory profile of food or drink by imparting, infusing, or steeping aromatic and sapid qualities into it. Nuances depend on the specific aromatic medium (herbs, spices, spirits) and the culinary method of flavor transfer.
groups.summary_zh: 通过添加香料或浸泡调配食物饮品的风味与香气。
groups.desc_en: Denotes introducing aromatics, condiments, or pungent elements to intensify or elevate culinary profile, differing from mere mixing by focusing on augmenting palatability and sensory vibrancy.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过添加香料、调味品或芳香元素来提升料理的风味层次，与单纯的掺和（mix）相对，强调赋味、提鲜与风味维度的升华。
groups.nuance_en: season: balance and enhance natural savor with salt, pepper, or herbs (meat / soup / stew) · infuse: steep ingredients in warm liquid to impart delicate aromatic essence (tea / oil / syrup) · spice up: add zesty, pungent kick or metaphorical liveliness (curry / dish / conversation) · zest: flavor with grated citrus rind for sharp aromatic lift (cake / frosting / cocktail) · pep up: enliven flat taste or flagging energy dynamically (sauce / party / team)
groups.nuance_zh: season: 调味/用盐香料入味 (meat / soup / stew) · infuse: 浸渍浸润/萃取赋香 (tea / oil / syrup) · spice up: 加辛香料/添趣增色 (curry / dish / conversation) · zest: 削柑橘皮增香 (cake / frosting / cocktail) · pep up: 提振风味/注入活力 (sauce / party / team)

groups.name: Evaluate & Appraise · 专业核估与鉴定 (Technical Valuation and Compositional Testing)
groups.tip: 专业考量与定性定价

items.def_en: to inspect and assess the structural condition and value of real estate or land
items.ex_en: A certified inspector arrived to survey the historic mansion before the auction commenced.
items.ex_zh: 一名持证检验师在拍卖开始前赶来勘测评估这座历史宅邸。

items.def_en: (+ sth) To calculate, evaluate, or assign an estimated monetary value or cost to goods, jobs, or assets
items.ex_en: The shop priced up all luxury goods ahead of the holiday season.
items.ex_zh: 节假日前夕，该店铺全面上调了所有奢侈品的价格。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) To inspect or investigate someone or something carefully to verify truth, authenticity, or standard
items.ex_en: We need to check out of the hotel by noon, but let's check out the local market first.
items.ex_zh: 我们需要在中午前结账退房，不过先去看看当地的集市吧。

items.def_zh: 化验，分析（矿石或金属成分）；评定，鉴定；尝试
items.def_en: 1. To test or analyze a substance, especially metal or ore, to determine its purity or composition. 2. (formal) To assess, evaluate, or analyze someone or something.
items.ex_en: The metallurgist will assay the extracted ore samples to calculate their silver content.
items.ex_zh: 冶金学家将化验提取出的矿石样本，以测定其含银纯度。

items.def_en: to formally test and prove that an artwork, manuscript, or antique is genuine
items.ex_en: Art historians used infrared imaging to authenticate the unsigned sixteenth-century portrait.
items.ex_zh: 艺术史学家利用红外成像技术鉴定了这幅无署名的十六世纪肖像画的真伪。

items.def_zh: 评定，鉴定，估价；评价，考查
items.def_en: To assess the value, quality, nature, or performance of someone or something, especially officially.
items.ex_en: The bank sent an independent expert to appraise the commercial property accurately.
items.ex_zh: 银行派出一名独立专家对该商业房产进行准确评估。

items.def_en: to determine the concentration or purity of a dissolved substance using volumetric analysis
items.ex_en: The analytical chemist proceeded to titrate the acidic solution using a standard base.
items.ex_zh: 这位分析化学家接着用标准碱溶液对该酸性溶液进行滴定分析。

groups.summary_en: This scenario frame specifies professional or expert evaluation of tangible property, ores, or legal/financial assets to determine monetary worth, authenticity, or chemical composition.
groups.summary_zh: 由专业人士对贵金属、不动产或文物进行的化验分析、成色测试与估价。
groups.desc_en: Denotes subjecting an object or substance to rigorous, technical, or standardized valuation and analytical testing, differing from subjective opinion (guess/estimate) by requiring institutional standards and forensic methodology.
groups.desc_zh: 指依照严谨的技术、行规或分析方法对物品或物质进行量化核估与成分检验，与主观揣测（guess）相对，强调技术公信力与专业程序。
groups.nuance_en: appraise: formulate an authoritative expert monetary valuation (property / jewelry / estate) · assay: test chemical purity or metallic content analytically (ore / gold / blood sample) · titrate: determine exact solution concentration through volumetric measurement (acid / solution / sample) · authenticate: verify the genuine provenance and non-counterfeit status (painting / signature / document) · survey: conduct meticulous structural or physical inspections (land / site / building)
groups.nuance_zh: appraise: 权威估值/资产鉴定 (property / jewelry / estate) · assay: 化验/金相测定 (ore / gold / blood sample) · titrate: 滴定分析 (acid / solution / sample) · authenticate: 鉴真/考证出处 (painting / signature / document) · survey: 测绘/结构性勘查 (land / site / building)

groups.name: Exist & Subsist · 存在与生存 (State of Being / Foundational Existence)
groups.tip: 客观存在或处在某种状态

items.def_en: to have actual being or reality in the world
items.ex_en: Several distinct varieties of rare orchid only exist in deep cloud forests.
items.ex_zh: 几种稀有兰花仅存在于幽深的云雾林中。

items.def_en: (+ in) to exist permanently as an essential constituent or characteristic attribute
items.ex_en: Philosophers argue that moral rights naturally inhere in every sentient human being.
items.ex_zh: 哲学家认为，道德权利天然地固存于每一个有知觉的人身上。

items.def_en: To continue surviving or persisting over time, or to subsist using a specific means of support
items.ex_en: Many retired residents in the remote coastal village live on modest government pensions.
items.ex_zh: 偏远沿海村庄的许多退休居民靠微薄的政府养老金维持生活。

items.def_en: To manage to subsist or live with just enough resources or money
items.ex_en: During his college years, he managed to get by on five dollars daily.
items.ex_zh: 大学期间，他设法靠着每天五美元勉强度日。

items.def_en: to be the fundamental basis, cause, or deep structural root beneath sth
items.ex_en: Deep cultural misunderstandings underlie the ongoing dispute between the two rival factions.
items.ex_zh: 深刻的文化误解是两大对立派别之间持续纷争的根源。

items.def_zh: 共存，同时存在；和平共处
items.def_en: To exist together at the same time or in the same place, especially peacefully despite differences.
items.ex_en: Different ethnic communities continue to coexist peacefully within this ancient border city.
items.ex_zh: 不同的族群继续在这座古老的边境城市中和平共存。

items.def_en: (+ on) to manage to stay alive or continue to exist, often with minimal resources
items.ex_en: The displaced refugees were forced to subsist on wild roots and contaminated water.
items.ex_zh: 流离失所的难民被迫靠野草根和不洁的水勉强维持生计。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the continuous state of being, living, persisting, or serving as an ontological or structural basis for something else.
groups.summary_zh: 描述事物的客观存在、勉强维生或充当底层根基的状态与维系。
groups.desc_en: Denotes enduring in reality, maintaining life on bare essentials, or serving as a ground-level substrate, differing from active flourishing ('thrive/act') by highlighting the baseline condition of being or survival.
groups.desc_zh: 指在客观现实中存续、依靠底线资源维持生命，或作为内在基底而存在，与积极的发展繁荣（thrive）相对，强调本底存在与最低生存状态。
groups.nuance_en: subsist: maintain bare physical survival on minimal food or resources (rations / wage / charity) · inhere: belong intrinsically as a permanent, inseparable quality (qualities / rights / paradox) · underlie: serve as the foundational, implicit basis for phenomena (theory / assumptions / cause) · coexist: persist simultaneously alongside another entity without conflict (religions / species / nations) · get by: manage to survive financially despite limited means (income / salary / little)
groups.nuance_zh: subsist: 勉强度日/糊口存活 (rations / wage / charity) · inhere: 固有/内在于 (qualities / rights / paradox) · underlie: 构成根基/作为深层基础 (theory / assumptions / cause) · coexist: 共存/并行不悖 (religions / species / nations) · get by: 勉力维持/混得过去 (income / salary / little)

groups.name: Experience & Endure Process · 经受与经历 (Undergo, Experience)
groups.tip: 亲身体验或承受变化

items.def_en: to encounter or undergo a particular event, feeling, or change
items.ex_en: Patients may experience mild fatigue and dizziness during the initial treatment phase.
items.ex_zh: 患者在治疗初期可能会经历轻度疲劳和头晕。

items.def_en: to experience a difficult, unpleasant, or complex period or process
items.ex_en: The small company had to go through a painful financial restructuring last winter.
items.ex_zh: 这家小公司在去年冬天不得不经历了一场痛苦的财务重组。

items.def_zh: 经历（艰难困苦）并活过来
items.def_en: (+ sth) To experience an ordeal, catastrophe, or historical hardship and survive it
items.ex_en: He lived through two world wars and several major crises.
items.ex_zh: 他经历了两次世界大战和几场重大危机。

items.def_en: (+ sth) To undergo or experience a particular transitional phase, state, or transformative process
items.ex_en: Adolescents inevitably pass through a prolonged period of identity confusion and emotional turbulence.
items.ex_zh: 青少年不可避免地要经受一段长期的身份迷茫和情绪动荡阶段。

items.def_en: to experience and bear pain, hardship, or prolonged stress without giving in
items.ex_en: The trapped climbers had to endure subzero temperatures for nearly three days.
items.ex_zh: 被困的登山者不得不忍受近三天的零下严寒。

items.def_zh: 经历，经受，承受（变化、痛苦等）
items.def_en: 1. To experience or endure a difficult process, surgery, or significant change.
items.ex_en: The historical archive will undergo a complete digital restoration over the coming months.
items.ex_zh: 该历史档案馆在接下来的几个月内将接受全面的数字化修复。

items.def_zh: 经历，经受（undergo 的过去式）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense of undergo; to experience or endure a difficult process, surgery, or change.
items.ex_en: The structural framework underwent severe testing during the record-breaking winter blizzard.
items.ex_zh: 该建筑框架在那场创纪录的冬季暴风雪中经受了严峻考验。

groups.summary_en: These transitive verbs denote passing through an extended process, transformation, hardship, or medical procedure. 'Undergo' specifically implies submitting to or enduring a structured, often involuntary or taxing ordeal, whereas other members cover passing through transformative experiences.
groups.summary_zh: 指身心经受变化、手术、考验等往往不可避免的历程。
groups.desc_en: Denotes passing through an arduous, transformative, or sequential trial, differing from neutral 'experiencing' by emphasizing passive reception, stamina, and psychological or physical wear.
groups.desc_zh: 指贯穿经受一段艰难、具变革性或序列性的考验过程，与中性的“体验”（experience）相对，强调被动承受、耐力消耗及历练的厚重感。
groups.nuance_en: undergo: submit to an invasive, structural, or systemic procedure (surgery / transformation / trial) · endure: withstand prolonged pain, hardship, or severe adversity without breaking (torture / hardship / cold) · live through: survive a harrowing historical or catastrophic ordeal alive (war / trauma / winter) · go through: advance step-by-step through a grueling sequence or document check (divorce / crisis / audit) · pass through: transition through a temporary stage or physical gate (phase / customs / territory)
groups.nuance_zh: undergo: 经受/接受变革或手术 (surgery / transformation / trial) · endure: 隐忍/久经折磨而不屈 (torture / hardship / cold) · live through: 经历大难并幸存 (war / trauma / winter) · go through: 历经波折/步步走过 (divorce / crisis / audit) · pass through: 穿过/经由过渡阶段 (phase / customs / territory)

groups.name: Exult & Glory · 欢欣与扬扬得意 (Joy, Glory, Exult)
groups.tip: 因喜事而心花怒放并载歌载舞

items.def_en: 1. (literary) To feel or express great happiness or joy. 2. To give joy to; to make glad.
items.ex_en: The gathered townsfolk did joy exceedingly upon hearing news of the victory.
items.ex_zh: 聚集的镇民在听到胜利的消息后欢欣不已。

items.def_zh: 自豪，洋洋得意，为……自鸣得意（glory in）
items.def_en: (also 'glory in') To take great pride, pleasure, or satisfaction in something.
items.ex_en: The tyrant seemed to glory in the utter misery of his subjects.
items.ex_zh: 暴君似乎沉溺于对臣民极度痛苦的得意满足之中。

items.def_en: to express or feel joyful exuberance and triumphant celebration
items.ex_en: The faithful congregations gathered outside the ancient cathedral to sing and jubilate.
items.ex_zh: 虔诚的会众聚集在古老的大教堂外歌唱欢呼。

items.def_en: (+ sth) To take intense pride, triumph, or joyful elation in an achievement or victory
items.ex_en: The proud champion could not help but glory in his historic Olympic triumph.
items.ex_zh: 这位骄傲的冠军情不自禁地沉浸在自己历史性的奥运胜利之中。

items.def_zh: 幸灾乐祸；扬扬得意地夸耀
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) To gloat or express triumphant joy loudly over someone's defeat or one's own success
items.ex_en: It is bad sportsmanship to crow over your defeated opponent after winning.
items.ex_zh: 获胜后对战败的对手幸灾乐祸是非常缺乏体育精神的。

items.def_zh: 感到胜利的喜悦；欢庆胜利
items.def_en: (+ over) to rejoice or exult insolently or passionately over a success or conquered rival
items.ex_en: The general was careful not to triumph insolently over the captured enemy officers.
items.ex_zh: 将军行事谨慎，并未对被俘的敌方军官表现出傲慢的胜利姿态。

items.def_en: (+ in/at) to show and feel great joy, happiness, or jubilation, especially because of a triumph
items.ex_en: The loyal partisans began to exult in the sudden downfall of the regime.
items.ex_zh: 忠诚的游击队员们开始为政权的突然倒台而欢腾雀跃。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote experiencing or manifesting triumphant spiritual or emotional elation, typically taking intense personal satisfaction in a great victory, blessing, or accomplishment.
groups.summary_zh: 指因胜利、成就或幸事而感到由衷的极大欢欣或洋洋自得。
groups.desc_en: Denotes reveling openly, vocalizing triumph, or feeling intense vindication over an accomplishment or rival's defeat, differing from internal quiet joy by its demonstrative and often vainglorious nature.
groups.desc_zh: 指对自身成就或对手溃败表现出公开的欢腾、胜利狂喜或扬扬自得，与内敛的喜悦（happiness）相对，强调溢于言表的宣泄性与好胜炫耀性。
groups.nuance_en: exult: express fervent, uninhibited joy at a great success (victory / defeat of rival / triumph) · crow over: boast noisily and vindictively over a vanquished opponent (rival / opponent / victory) · glory in: take deep, unapologetic pride and relish in a situation (success / freedom / notoriety) · jubilate: celebrate ecstatically and publicly with songs or cheers (crowd / fans / team) · triumph: prevail decisively and savor supreme conquest (adversity / enemies / evil)
groups.nuance_zh: exult: 欢欣雀跃/大喜过望 (victory / defeat of rival / triumph) · crow over: 幸灾乐祸/洋洋自得 (rival / opponent / victory) · glory in: 陶醉于/引以为傲 (success / freedom / notoriety) · jubilate: 欢腾庆贺 (crowd / fans / team) · triumph: 得胜/战胜称雄 (adversity / enemies / evil)

groups.name: Facial & Vocal Mirth · 各种笑声 (Chuckle, Giggle, Snicker)
groups.tip: 从轻声咯咯笑到开怀大笑

items.def_en: Laugh lightly and repeatedly in a silly, nervous, or childish way
items.ex_en: The nervous schoolgirls continued to giggle quietly at the back of the classroom.
items.ex_zh: 紧张的女学生们在教室后排不停地小声傻笑。

items.def_en: Laugh quietly or inwardly, often conveying private amusement or mild satisfaction
items.ex_en: The old grandfather could only chuckle softly at the playful kitten's wild antics.
items.ex_zh: 看着调皮小猫的欢闹举动，老祖父只能在暗自低声发笑。

items.def_en: To make sounds and movements of the face expressing amusement, pleasure, or mockery; to say or utter while laughing.
items.ex_en: The entire studio audience began to laugh at the comedian's clever remarks.
items.ex_zh: 整个演播室的观众都被那名喜剧演员机智的妙语逗笑了。

items.def_en: Give a smothered, half-suppressed laugh, often showing disrespect, contempt, or malice
items.ex_en: Several rude students began to snicker whenever the nervous substitute teacher stammered.
items.ex_zh: 每当紧张的代课老师结巴时，几个无礼的学生就窃笑起来。

items.def_en: Laugh in a harsh, shrill, broken manner reminiscent of a hen
items.ex_en: The wicked crone began to cackle loudly as darkness fell over the swamp.
items.ex_zh: 夜幕降临沼泽之际，邪恶的老妇开始尖声刺耳地怪笑。

items.def_en: Suddenly and uncontrollably start laughing out loud
items.ex_en: The exhausted jurors suddenly burst out laughing when the bailiff dropped his ledger.
items.ex_zh: 当法警失手掉落账本时，疲倦的陪审员们突然哄堂大笑。

items.def_en: Laugh loudly, boisterously, and heartily, often in an uninhibited manner
items.ex_en: Uncle Arthur would always guffaw loudly whenever someone told a dirty bar joke.
items.ex_zh: 每逢有人讲下流的酒吧笑话，亚瑟叔叔总是放声狂笑。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the varied acoustic and expressive ways humans voice mirth, amusement, or mockery, ranging from quiet suppressed snickers to helpless hysterical laughter.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖表达欢愉、打趣、窃笑或嘲讽的各种笑声与面部发笑方式。
groups.desc_en: Denotes producing distinct acoustic patterns of laughter modulated by volume, vocalization, and social restraint, differing from silent facial smiling through auditory realization and physical outburst.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过发音器官发出受音量、音色及社交约束调控的发声笑，与无声的微笑表情相对，强调听觉声效与身体生理上的爆发力。
groups.nuance_en: chuckle: laugh softly and inwardly with low-frequency amusement (satisfaction / quietly / oneself) · giggle: emit rapid, high-pitched, childish, or nervous titters (nervously / girls / delight) · guffaw: roar with boisterous, unrestrained, full-throated belly laughter (delight / laughter / loud) · snicker: laugh stifledly, disrespectfully, or slyly under one's breath (cruelly / whispers / corner) · cackle: laugh with a harsh, sharp, screeching shrillness (witch / glee / hen)
groups.nuance_zh: chuckle: 轻声暗笑/低声失笑 (satisfaction / quietly / oneself) · giggle: 咯咯傻笑/紧张吃吃笑 (nervously / girls / delight) · guffaw: 哄堂大笑/狂笑 (delight / laughter / loud) · snicker: 窃笑/不怀好意的暗笑 (cruelly / whispers / corner) · cackle: 刺耳尖笑/桀桀怪笑 (witch / glee / hen)

groups.name: Facial Expressions of Smiling · 微笑与假笑神态 (Smile, Smirk, Simper)
groups.tip: 轻笑假笑与咧嘴大笑的神态

items.def_zh: 傻笑，做作地笑，假笑；做作地笑着说
items.def_en: To smile in a silly, self-conscious, or overly sweet and unnatural way.
items.ex_en: The nervous courtier continued to simper foolishly while bowing before the majestic queen.
items.ex_zh: 紧张的侍从在向威严的女王鞠躬时，脸上挂着做作的假笑。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) To direct a benevolent, warm, or favorable facial expression of smiling toward someone
items.ex_en: Fortune seemed to smile on the young composer during his first European tour.
items.ex_zh: 命运似乎在年轻作曲家的首次欧洲巡演期间对他格外眷顾。

items.def_en: To form one's features into an expression of pleasure, amusement, or kindness, with the corners of the mouth turned up.
items.ex_en: She paused to smile warmly at the frightened little girl sitting alone.
items.ex_zh: 她停下脚步，向独自坐着受惊的小女孩露出温暖的微笑。

items.def_en: To smile in a smug, self-satisfied, or unkind way.
items.ex_en: He could only smirk when his arrogant rival missed the critical penalty kick.
items.ex_zh: 当傲慢的对手罚失关键点球时，他忍不住露出得意的冷笑。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) To make an affected, smug, or insolently amused facial expression at someone
items.ex_en: The unruly boy continued to smirk at the headmaster throughout the stern reprimand.
items.ex_zh: 在严厉的训诫过程中，那个顽劣的男孩一直对校长冷笑不逊。

items.def_en: (+ at) to curl the lip in a mocking, scornful, or contemptuous facial expression
items.ex_en: The elitist art critic could only sneer at modern popular installations.
items.ex_zh: 那位自命不凡的艺术评论家对现代流行装置作品嗤之以鼻。

items.def_en: (+ at/with) to smile radiantly and broadly, expressing deep happiness or pride
items.ex_en: The proud mother could not stop beaming at her daughter during graduation.
items.ex_zh: 毕业典礼上，骄傲的母亲始终满面春风地看着自己的女儿。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe facial configurations of smiling without prominent loud vocalization, distinguishing genuine warmth from smug, condescending, or affected expressions.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重于无声或微声的面部笑态，细分真诚笑意与得逞、造作之态。
groups.desc_en: Denotes morphing facial muscles into smiling configurations that project affective states ranging from radiance to patronizing malice, differing from vocal mirth through its purely visual and postural modality.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过面部肌肉形变展示从灿烂欢愉到居高临下恶意的微笑神态，与发声笑相对，属于纯视觉与姿态性的神情投射。
groups.nuance_en: beam: radiate an expansive, glowing smile of boundless pride or joy (pride / delight / pleasure) · smirk: wear an irritatingly smug, self-satisfied, or insolent half-smile (smugly / face / satisfaction) · sneer: curl the upper lip in cynical contempt or derision (contempt / face / opponent) · simper: put on an affected, coy, silly, or ingratiating smile (foolishly / coyly / vanity) · smile on: look upon with benevolent favor or cosmic fortune (fortune / gods / project)
groups.nuance_zh: beam: 眉开眼笑/春风满面 (pride / delight / pleasure) · smirk: 得意奸笑/自鸣得意地笑 (smugly / face / satisfaction) · sneer: 撇嘴冷笑/鄙夷讥笑 (contempt / face / opponent) · simper: 矫揉造作地傻笑/谄笑 (foolishly / coyly / vanity) · smile on: 眷顾/垂青 (fortune / gods / project)

groups.name: Fail & Collapse · 受挫与瓦解 (Misfire, Stumble, Founder, Collapse)
groups.tip: 计划或状态受挫瓦解

items.def_en: to lose strength or momentum, or begin to fail in an enterprise
items.ex_en: Economic growth began to falter sharply amid unexpected global trade tensions.
items.ex_zh: 在意料之外的全球贸易紧张局势下，经济增长开始大幅衰退动摇。

items.def_en: fail or cease to function effectively, especially negotiations or relationships
items.ex_en: Crucial diplomatic talks threatened to break down over the contested maritime border.
items.ex_zh: 至关重要的外交谈判因争议海域边界问题面临破裂危险。
items.ex2_en: The intense diplomatic crisis will break down trust between the two neighboring nations.
items.ex2_zh: 这场严重的外交危机将瓦解这两个邻国之间的信任。

items.def_en: fail to happen or be completed successfully, especially of a plan, deal, or negotiation
items.ex_en: The sale of the property fell through when the buyer's loan was rejected.
items.ex_zh: 由于买方的贷款申请被拒，房产交易最终泡汤了。

items.def_zh: （计划、言行等）失败，未达到预期效果；（枪炮）哑火；（引擎）失火，不点火
items.def_en: 1. (of a plan, joke, or scheme) To fail to achieve the desired result or have the opposite effect. 2. (of a gun or engine) To fail to fire or ignite properly.
items.ex_en: Their ambitious marketing strategy will likely misfire without adequate initial market research.
items.ex_zh: 若缺乏充分的前期市场调研，他们雄心勃勃的营销策略很可能会失败。

items.def_en: break down completely or disintegrate into failure
items.ex_en: The delicate political coalition began to fall apart after the unexpected resignation.
items.ex_zh: 在出人意料的辞职事件发生后，脆弱的政治联盟开始彻底瓦解。

items.def_zh: （计划、事业等）失败，破产，崩溃；（船）沉没；（马等）绊倒
items.def_en: 1. (of a plan, project, or business) To fail completely or break down. 2. (of a ship) To fill with water and sink. 3. (of a horse) To stumble and fall.
items.ex_en: The massive municipal project threatened to founder completely due to mounting budget deficits.
items.ex_zh: 由于不断增加的预算赤字，这项庞大的市政工程面临彻底崩溃的危险。

items.def_en: to fail completely and suddenly, as an organization, system, or plan
items.ex_en: The entire national banking network threatened to collapse under immense speculative pressure.
items.ex_zh: 在巨大的投机压力之下，整个国家银行体系面临彻底崩溃的风险。
items.ex2_en: The heavy snowfall collapsed the flimsy canopy covering the outdoor farmers market stalls.
items.ex2_zh: 大雪压垮了遮盖室外农贸市场摊位的简易顶棚。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the progressive breakdown of an enterprise, plan, or negotiation, from an initial hitch or failure to gain traction to complete structural ruin.
groups.summary_zh: 指计划、事业或谈判由局部失灵逐步演变为全面停滞乃至土崩瓦解。
groups.desc_en: Denotes sudden or progressive degradation leading to the catastrophic breakdown of systems, enterprises, or structural coherence, differing from minor error by the totality of functional ruin.
groups.desc_zh: 指系统、计划或结构经历渐进或突发性恶化并最终走向功能瓦解，与局部轻微差错相对，强调功能彻底瘫痪与不可逆的倾覆毁灭。
groups.nuance_en: collapse: cave in structurally or suffer total financial/physical breakdown (system / economy / building) · founder: run aground, fill with water, or plunge into helpless failure (negotiations / ship / company) · falter: lose momentum, waver, or stammer unsteadily at a critical juncture (courage / resolve / voice) · misfire: fail to ignite properly or produce the intended outcome (engine / strategy / joke) · fall through: collapse completely before fruition or conclusion (deal / plan / agreement)
groups.nuance_zh: collapse: 轰然倒塌/系统性崩溃 (system / economy / building) · founder: 触礁沉没/彻底沉沦破产 (negotiations / ship / company) · falter: 动摇衰竭/结结巴巴 (courage / resolve / voice) · misfire: 哑火/未达预期 (engine / strategy / joke) · fall through: 彻底泡汤/未果告吹 (deal / plan / agreement)

groups.name: Feed & Nourish · 哺乳与哺育 (Breastfeed, Suckle, Nurse)
groups.tip: 母亲或母兽哺乳滋养幼崽

items.def_en: [I/T] to feed a baby with milk from the breast, or to drink milk from a mother's breast
items.ex_en: The exhausted mother sat quietly in the rocking chair to nurse her infant.
items.ex_zh: 疲倦的母亲静静地坐在摇椅上给婴儿喂奶。

items.def_en: to feed a baby using a feeding bottle rather than the breast
items.ex_en: Due to medical complications, the parents decided to bottle-feed their newborn daughter.
items.ex_zh: 由于医疗并发症，这对父母决定用奶瓶喂养刚出生的女儿。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to gradually cause a baby or young animal to stop drinking mother's milk and take other nourishment
items.ex_en: The farmer must carefully wean off the young calves from milk replacer.
items.ex_zh: 农夫必须小心地使小牛逐渐断掉人工代乳品。

items.def_en: to fasten onto the mother's nipple properly in order to feed
items.ex_en: The newborn infant took several tries before learning to latch on properly.
items.ex_zh: 这个新生儿尝试了几次才学会正确含住乳头吸吮。

items.def_en: 1. When a mother breastfeeds a baby, she feeds it milk directly from her breast.
items.ex_en: The young mother decided to breastfeed her newborn daughter exclusively for six months.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻的母亲决定对刚出生的女儿进行纯母乳喂养六个月。

items.def_en: (+ off/from) to cause a baby or young animal to stop feeding on its mother's milk
items.ex_en: The farmer carefully weaned the young calves off their mother's milk this spring.
items.ex_zh: 农夫今年春天小心地让幼犊断掉了母乳。

items.def_zh: 哺乳，给……喂奶；吃奶，吮吸母乳
items.def_en: 1. When a mother animal or woman suckles her young, she feeds them milk from her breast or udder; when young animals or babies suckle, they drink milk from the breast or udder.
items.ex_en: In the sheltered den, the mother wolf gently suckled her four hungry cubs.
items.ex_zh: 在隐蔽的洞穴里，母狼温柔地为四只饥饿的幼崽哺乳。

groups.summary_en: A mother or caregiver gives milk or food to an infant, or the infant draws milk from the mother's breast. Verbs capture both the maternal provision and the dependent offspring's ingestion.
groups.summary_zh: 母亲或看护者喂哺婴儿乳汁，或幼崽吸吮母乳，覆盖哺乳、喂奶与抚育全过程。
groups.desc_en: Denotes providing mammalian nourishment directly from the breast or bottle during infancy and orchestrating dietary transitions, contrasting with mature feeding by specifying the biological or neonatal modality.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过乳房或奶瓶为婴儿期幼体提供乳汁滋养并引导断乳过渡，与成体摄食喂养相对，特指哺乳类特有的生理哺乳机制与幼雏阶段哺育。
groups.nuance_en: breastfeed: supply maternal milk directly from human mammary glands (baby / infant / child) · suckle: draw or give milk at breast or udder (young / infant / mother) · nurse: tend to and breastfeed an infant lovingly (baby / child / wound) · bottle-feed: administer milk, formula, or liquid food via a baby bottle (baby / puppy / orphan) · wean: gradually detach an offspring from breastmilk to solid food (child / calf / addiction)
groups.nuance_zh: breastfeed: 母乳喂养 (baby / infant / child) · suckle: 哺乳/吮乳 (young / infant / mother) · nurse: 怀抱喂乳/照料护理 (baby / child / wound) · bottle-feed: 瓶饲/人工奶瓶喂养 (baby / puppy / orphan) · wean: 断乳/使戒除断瘾 (child / calf / addiction)

groups.name: Fitted Coverings & Structural Sheltering · 盖覆与遮蔽 (Cowl, Thatch, Canopy)
groups.tip: 加盖或设棚以挡风遮雨

items.def_en: to cover or fit something with a protective hood or casing
items.ex_en: Technicians hood the sensitive optical lens whenever bad weather approaches the field station.
items.ex_zh: 每当恶劣天气逼近野外台站时，技术人员就会给灵敏的光学镜头套上防护罩。

items.def_zh: 用木板封闭；用木板遮挡
items.def_en: (+ sth) to cover windows, doors, or openings with wooden boards for protection or shelter
items.ex_en: Shopkeepers boarded up their storefronts before the hurricane arrived.
items.ex_zh: 店主们在飓风来临前用木板封住了店铺临街的门窗。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to fasten or secure a protective waterproof sheet over equipment or structures
items.ex_en: Workers quickly tarpaulined down the heavy machinery before the torrential storm struck the yard.
items.ex_zh: 在暴风雨袭击堆场之前，工人们迅速用防水布把重型机械盖严绑好。

items.def_zh: 为……加装顶篷；覆以天篷般遮盖
items.def_en: to cover or shelter something with or as if with a canopy
items.ex_en: Vast intertwining boughs canopy the ancient forest path in perpetual, verdant shadow.
items.ex_zh: 交错蔓生的粗大枝桠如穹顶般笼罩着古老的林间小径，投下无尽的葱茏暗影。

items.def_en: to cover or envelop so as to conceal or protect from exposure
items.ex_en: Heavy evening mists slowly shroud the tranquil valley in mysterious, pale silence.
items.ex_zh: 浓重暮霭渐渐将静谧的山谷笼罩在神秘而苍茫的寂静之中。

items.def_en: To cover the roof of a building with dried straw, reeds, or palm leaves.
items.ex_en: Local craftsmen gathered dry river reeds to thatch the historic cottage's weathered roof.
items.ex_zh: 当地工匠收集干燥的河苇，为这座饱经风霜的古朴农舍铺盖茅草屋顶。

items.def_zh: 用罩遮盖，为……装上烟囱罩（或发动机罩）
items.def_en: To cover an engine, chimney, or head with a protective hood or cowl.
items.ex_en: Engineers carefully cowled the roaring turbine to deflect the harsh sea winds.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们小心地为轰鸣的涡轮机装上导流保护罩，以抵御强烈的海风。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this construction and craft scenario describe installing specific structural coverings, hoods, or traditional roofing onto surfaces or equipment to protect them from weather or hazards.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过加装特定防护罩、顶棚或茅草屋顶等实施遮蔽与防护。
groups.desc_en: Denotes placing tailored structural canopies, hoods, or thatch to shelter openings and surfaces against external elements, differing from generic enveloping by its architectural fit and weather-shielding utility.
groups.desc_zh: 指使用定制的结构天篷、风帽、茅草或护罩覆盖孔洞与建筑物表面以御风雨，与一般包裹相对，强调建筑性适配与防候防护实用功能。
groups.nuance_en: canopy: suspend an overhanging protective or decorative cloth ceiling (bed / forest / terrace) · cowl: cap with a hooded garment or cowl-shaped metallic chimney chimney-vent (chimney / monk / engine) · thatch: construct or repair a traditional roof using dry plant stalks (roof / cottage / hut) · shroud: obscure completely beneath a heavy, impenetrable veil or burial cloth (corpse / mystery / fog) · board up: seal windows and doorways securely with stout timber planks (windows / shop / doors)
groups.nuance_zh: canopy: 架设天篷/遮蔽穹顶 (bed / forest / terrace) · cowl: 罩以风帽/套上烟斗罩 (chimney / monk / engine) · thatch: 用茅草铺盖屋顶 (roof / cottage / hut) · shroud: 裹尸布裹掩/深重隐蔽 (corpse / mystery / fog) · board up: 用木板封钉 (windows / shop / doors)

groups.name: Fork & Bifurcate · 分叉与分流 (Fork, Bifurcate, Diverge)
groups.tip: 物理或路径上的分离分叉

items.def_en: (+ from) to leave the main path, line, or highway to form a subsidiary route
items.ex_en: Take the scenic road that branches off from the highway near the lake.
items.ex_zh: 走湖泊附近从干道分岔出去的那条风景优美的小路。

items.def_en: to spread out from a single point into several directions like a fan
items.ex_en: Search parties fan out across the moorland to locate the missing hikers.
items.ex_zh: 搜救队在荒原上呈扇形散开，寻找失踪的徒步旅行者。
items.ex2_en: The general ordered his commanders to fan out the infantry across the open plains.
items.ex2_zh: 将军命令他的指挥官们将步兵散开在开阔的平原上。

items.def_en: to separate or diverge from the main body, path, or route
items.ex_en: A small faction split off from the main party to form a new coalition.
items.ex_zh: 一个小派系从主要政党中脱离出来，成立了一个新的联盟。

items.def_zh: 分叉，分流；走岔路；用叉子叉起（或翻起）
items.def_en: 1. To divide into two separate parts or branches, as a road or river. 2. To lift, dig, or move something using a fork.
items.ex_en: The winding river forks into two distinct channels just outside the village.
items.ex_zh: 蜿蜒的河流在村外分叉成两条独立的水道。

items.def_en: (+ from) to separate and go in different directions from the same starting point
items.ex_en: The two railway lines diverge from each other just beyond the southern terminal.
items.ex_zh: 这两条铁路线刚过南端终点站就向不同方向岔开。

items.def_en: (formal) To divide or split into two separate branches or forks.
items.ex_en: At this junction, the ancient trading path bifurcates into two separate mountain trails.
items.ex_zh: 在这个交叉路口，这条古老的商道分岔成两条不同的山路。
items.ex2_en: The sudden rocky outcrop bifurcates the powerful river into two rapid streams.
items.ex2_zh: 突然出现的露头岩石将湍急的河流分流为两条激流。

items.def_en: [I/T] to divide or be divided into three separate branches or prongs
items.ex_en: The tranquil stream trifurcates into three glittering ribbons across the rocky meadow.
items.ex_zh: 静谧的溪流穿过岩石草甸，一分为三化作三条波光粼粼的溪带。
items.ex2_en: The company decided to trifurcate the regional department into three specialized independent units.
items.ex2_zh: 公司决定将该区域部门拆分为三个专业的独立部门。

groups.summary_en: Entities such as roads, rivers, branches, or paths split from a single origin into two or more distinct branching directions without external manual intervention.
groups.summary_zh: 道路、河流、解剖脉管等事物从主线顺势分生出两条或多条岔流与分枝。
groups.desc_en: Denotes splitting a singular linear trajectory, channel, or flow into two or more distinct spatial or developmental routes, differing from random dispersal by maintaining branching geometric divergence.
groups.desc_zh: 指将单一的线性路径、水道或干线分裂为两条或多条互异的空间路线或发展支线，与随机散布相对，强调具有分支几何特征的流向分离。
groups.nuance_en: fork: divide directly into two tines or paths at a clear junction (road / river / lightning) · bifurcate: split mathematically or anatomically into two definite branches (vessel / trachea / path) · diverge: move steadily further apart from a single shared origin (paths / opinions / rays) · branch off: split away from the main trunk to establish a secondary feeder route (path / track / stream) · fan out: spread widely outward like an unfolded handheld fan (search party / troops / crowd)
groups.nuance_zh: fork: 分岔成两支/叉开 (road / river / lightning) · bifurcate: 科学/解剖意义上的二歧分支 (vessel / trachea / path) · diverge: 分歧/渐行渐远 (paths / opinions / rays) · branch off: 偏离主干分流而出 (path / track / stream) · fan out: 呈扇形散开/展开 (search party / troops / crowd)

groups.name: Greet & Salute · 问候与致意 (Greet, Welcome, Salute)
groups.tip: 社交礼节与举杯祝愿

items.def_en: to greet someone who has arrived with pleasure and hospitality
items.ex_en: The friendly hosts welcome each arriving guest with warm smiles and refreshments.
items.ex_zh: 热情的房东微笑着迎接每一位到访的客人，并端上茶点。

items.def_zh: 挥手示意（某人）过来问候
items.def_en: (+ sb) greet someone by gesturing with one's hand to invite them to come closer
items.ex_en: Seeing his old friend across the busy terminal, David waved him over cheerfully.
items.ex_zh: 在拥挤的航站楼看到老朋友，戴维高兴地挥手示意他过来。

items.def_en: (+ sb) welcome and guide someone into a place or gathering
items.ex_en: The senior diplomat graciously ushered in the visiting dignitaries to the reception hall.
items.ex_zh: 资深外交官庄重地将到访贵宾迎入接待大厅。

items.def_en: 1. To welcome someone with friendly words or gestures upon meeting them. 2. (of sounds or sights) To be immediately noticed by someone upon entering a place.
items.ex_en: The receptionist greets every visitor warmly as they enter the corporate headquarters.
items.ex_zh: 接待员在访客步入公司总部大楼时热情地向每个人打招呼。

items.def_zh: 高声呼唤致意，欢呼迎候
items.def_en: to call out to attract someone's attention or greet enthusiastically from a distance
items.ex_en: The townspeople assembled at dawn to hail the returning victorious fleet.
items.ex_zh: 镇民们黎明时分聚集在一起，高声欢呼迎接胜利归来的舰队。

items.def_zh: 为……举杯敬酒；烤，烘（面包等）
items.def_en: 1. To raise a glass and drink in honor of someone's health, happiness, or success. 2. To brown bread or other food by exposing it to heat.
items.ex_en: The dinner guests stood to toast the bride and groom with vintage champagne.
items.ex_zh: 宴会宾客纷纷起立，用陈年香槟向新郎新娘举杯祝酒。
items.ex2_en: These thin slices of sourdough bread toast perfectly in our new oven.
items.ex2_zh: 这些薄薄的酸面包片在我们新烤箱里烤得恰到好处。

items.def_en: to show formal respect by a standardized gesture or public ceremony
items.ex_en: The soldiers stood at attention to salute the general during the official parade.
items.ex_zh: 在正式阅兵仪式上，士兵们立正向将军敬礼致敬。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe acknowledging or welcoming someone upon arrival or encounter, ranging from basic polite greetings to celebratory drinking and formal military or ceremonial salutes.
groups.summary_zh: 指在会面或特定仪式场合向他人致意、问候、欢迎或举杯庆祝。
groups.desc_en: Denotes social acknowledgement of an arrival, presence, or achievement, contrasting with neutral perception by encoding ritualized welcome, reverence, or celebration.
groups.desc_zh: 表示对到达、在场或成就的社会性礼仪认可；与中性的感知发现不同，本框架强调仪式化的迎迓、致敬或庆贺。
groups.nuance_en: greet: conventional receipt or reaction (guest / arrival / news) · welcome: hospitable, cordial acceptance (visitor / proposal / change) · hail: enthusiastic public acclaim or summons (hero / achievement / taxi) · salute: formal mark of respect or military honor (flag / officer / courage) · toast: drink to honor or celebrate (couple / victory / health)
groups.nuance_zh: greet: 常规问候或应对反应 (guest / arrival / news) · welcome: 热情好客地接纳与欢迎 (visitor / proposal / change) · hail: 公开高度赞誉或呼唤 (hero / achievement / taxi) · salute: 正式致敬或军礼 (flag / officer / courage) · toast: 举杯祝酒志庆 (couple / victory / health)

groups.name: Harvest & Extract Yield · 采收与收获 (Harvest, Reap, Gather)
groups.tip: 在自然或田间采敛资源

items.def_en: (+ sth) collect and store a harvest or yield
items.ex_en: The farmers worked tirelessly until twilight to gather in the golden wheat harvest.
items.ex_zh: 农夫们不辞劳苦地劳作至黄昏，将金黄的小麦收割归仓。

items.def_zh: 采珍珠，捕珠；凝结成珠状
items.def_en: 1. To fish for or gather pearls from oysters in the ocean. 2. To form into or adorn with pearl-like drops.
items.ex_en: Generations of brave divers pearl in the treacherous deep waters off the southern coast.
items.ex_zh: 数代勇敢的潜水员在南部沿海凶险的深海中采捕珍珠。

items.def_zh: 拾落穗；捡拾剩余农作物
items.def_en: [I/T] to gather leftover grain or produce after the main crop has been harvested
items.ex_en: Poor villagers were permitted to glean the scattered barley ears after the harvest.
items.ex_zh: 收割结束后，贫穷的村民获准在田间拾取散落的大麦穗。

items.def_en: (+ sth) harvest crops and gather them into storage
items.ex_en: They must bring in the entire potato crop before the early autumn frost.
items.ex_zh: 他们必须在初秋降霜之前将所有的马铃薯收割入库。

items.def_zh: 收割，收获；采集，采集资源
items.def_en: To gather a crop, natural resource, or organs for medical use.
items.ex_en: Local vineyard workers harvest the ripe grapes early in the cool morning.
items.ex_zh: 当地葡萄园工人乘着清晨的凉意采摘成熟的葡萄。

items.def_en: [I/T] to cut down and gather a crop (especially grain) at maturity
items.ex_en: With rhythmic scythe strokes, the peasants reap the heavy ears of golden grain.
items.ex_zh: 农人们富有节奏地挥舞着镰刀，收割着沉甸甸的金黄谷穗。

items.def_zh: 打捞，拖网捞取（水底牡蛎或贝类等）
items.def_en: [I/T] to bring up shellfish, mud, or specimens from the seabed using a dredge
items.ex_en: Local fishermen dredge for oysters along the shallow seabed throughout the winter months.
items.ex_zh: 整个冬季，当地渔民都在浅海床拖网捞取牡蛎。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the productive extraction and gathering of mature natural resources, crops, or marine commodities from their native environments for human consumption and trade.
groups.summary_zh: 指对成熟农作物、天然物产或水产的大规模采收与收割。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on gathering mature crops or valuable natural yields from an environment, contrasting with generic taking by highlighting seasonal culmination and systematic extraction.
groups.desc_zh: 强调从自然环境中采收成熟作物或资源产出；与一般性的索取不同，本框架侧重周期性的成果汇总与系统性搜集。
groups.nuance_en: harvest: systematic gathering of mature crops or natural resources (wheat / timber / organs) · reap: cut grain at maturity, often figurative of consequences (crop / rewards / whirlwind) · glean: painstakingly collect leftover remnants or dispersed data (grain / information / insights) · dredge: drag mechanical scoops from underwater beds (oysters / canal / sediment)
groups.nuance_zh: harvest: 系统性采收作物或获取资源 (wheat / timber / organs) · reap: 割取庄稼，常引申为承受后果 (crop / rewards / whirlwind) · glean: 拾落穗，微观搜集零散信息 (grain / information / insights) · dredge: 水底疏浚或捞取 (oysters / canal / sediment)

groups.name: Hinder & Impede · 妨碍与阻碍 (Hinder, Impede, Inhibit, Disadvantage)
groups.tip: 阻扰行动使进程停滞受阻

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) prevent someone or something from making progress or advancing
items.ex_en: Lack of adequate funding will hold back the development of these promising technologies.
items.ex_zh: 缺乏充足的资金将阻碍这些前景广阔的技术的发展。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) obstruct or prevent the progress or success of someone or something
items.ex_en: Bureaucratic hurdles continue to stand in the way of much needed economic reforms.
items.ex_zh: 官僚体制的阻碍继续横亘在亟需推进的经济改革之路上。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) cause someone or something to become stuck or slow down significantly in progress
items.ex_en: Constant disagreements among committee members bogged down the negotiations for three months.
items.ex_zh: 委员会成员之间不断的争执使谈判停滞拖延了整整三个月。
items.ex2_en: The heavy armored vehicle bogged down in the wet clay along the riverbank.
items.ex2_zh: 重型装甲车陷在河岸湿泞的黏土里动弹不得。

items.def_zh: 使处于不利地位，妨碍，损害
items.def_en: (often passive) To put someone in an unfavorable position that reduces their chances of success.
items.ex_en: Inadequate public transport links severely disadvantage job seekers living in rural areas.
items.ex_zh: 公共交通连接不便使生活在农村地区的求职者处于严重劣势。

items.def_zh: 阻碍，抑制，阻止；使拘束，使难为情
items.def_en: 1. To prevent something from growing or developing freely, or to slow down a process. 2. To make someone feel too self-conscious or nervous to act naturally.
items.ex_en: Excessive governmental regulations inhibit the healthy growth of innovative small enterprises.
items.ex_zh: 过度严苛的政府监管抑制了创新型小型企业的健康发展。

items.def_en: to make it difficult for someone to do something or for something to develop
items.ex_en: Severe blizzards threatened to hinder the ongoing rescue operations in the northern pass.
items.ex_zh: 肆虐的暴风雪恐将阻碍北部山口正在展开的救援行动。

items.def_en: to delay or obstruct the progress or movement of something
items.ex_en: Fallen trees and rockslides completely impede the rescue convoy along the mountain highway.
items.ex_zh: 倒塌的树木和山体滑坡完全阻碍了救援车队在山间干道上的行进。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to interfering with an entity's progress, competitive parity, or freedom of operation, making development or success more difficult.
groups.summary_zh: 指给某方设置障碍、削弱其竞争地位或制约其正常运作与进程。
groups.desc_en: Specifies active or systemic obstruction that retards movement, development, or execution, differing from total prevention by focusing on friction, drag, and delay.
groups.desc_zh: 指主动或机制性的阻滞，延缓行进、发展或执行；与彻底阻止不同，本框架强调摩擦、拖累与滞后效应。
groups.nuance_en: hinder: make progress difficult through friction or obstacles (progress / recovery / rescue) · impede: significantly obstruct physical or operational movement (traffic / flow / investigation) · inhibit: check, suppress, or restrain organic or psychological processes (growth / enzymes / impulses) · bog down: entrap in immobilizing complexity or mud (negotiations / troops / system)
groups.nuance_zh: hinder: 产生阻力使进程受阻 (progress / recovery / rescue) · impede: 明显阻碍物理或运作通畅 (traffic / flow / investigation) · inhibit: 抑制生化或心理机能 (growth / enzymes / impulses) · bog down: 陷入泥淖或繁复琐事中难以脱身 (negotiations / troops / system)

groups.name: Hold Sovereign Office · 登位与君临 (Reign, Throne)
groups.tip: 手握大权掌管天下

items.def_en: to exercise ultimate political power and administrative control over a realm
items.ex_en: The sovereign monarch rules the prosperous island nation with a steady and fair hand.
items.ex_zh: 这位君主以稳健公正的手腕统治着这个繁荣的岛国。

items.def_en: to conduct the policy, actions, and affairs of a state
items.ex_en: The democratically elected prime minister and her cabinet govern the nation during crises.
items.ex_zh: 在危机期间，民选首相及其内阁负责治理这个国家。

items.def_zh: 称霸，称王，称帝；居支配地位，主导
items.def_en: 1. To rule a country as a monarch. 2. To be the predominant feature, quality, or condition of a situation.
items.ex_en: Queen Elizabeth I reigned over England during an era of tremendous cultural flourishing.
items.ex_zh: 伊丽莎白一世统治英格兰时期正值文化极度繁荣的时代。

items.def_zh: 使登王位，拥立为君；登位，执政
items.def_en: 1. To place someone on a royal throne; to invest with sovereign power. 2. To sit on or occupy a throne as a ruler.
items.ex_en: Ancient chroniclers record how the loyal lords throned the young prince at dawn.
items.ex_zh: 古代编年史家记录了忠诚的贵族们如何在拂晓时分拥立年轻王子登基。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) rule as monarch over a country, realm, or people
items.ex_en: The wise emperor reigned over the expansive empire for nearly four decades of peace.
items.ex_zh: 这位英明的皇帝统治这个辽阔的帝国近四十年，天下太平。

items.def_en: (+ sth) exercise supreme authority, governance, or sovereign control over an era or realm
items.ex_en: The experienced statesman presided over the nation during its most turbulent post-war years.
items.ex_zh: 这位经验丰富的政治家在战后最动荡的岁月里统领着这个国家。

items.def_en: to formally install a monarch or high dignitary upon a ceremonial throne
items.ex_en: The high clergy will formally enthrone the new archbishop in the historic cathedral.
items.ex_zh: 高级神职人员将在历史悠久的大教堂正式为新任大主教举行加冕即位仪式。

groups.summary_en: This scenario covers the constitutional and ceremonial exercise of royal or sovereign power. 'Throne' refers to the investiture or seating of a monarch, while 'reign' emphasizes holding the sovereign title or tenure over a kingdom.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及君主即位、在位与行使国家元首名分之统治场景。
groups.desc_en: Refers to exercising supreme political sovereignty or presiding over an institutional domain, distinguished from pragmatic administration by ceremonial legitimacy and supreme authority.
groups.desc_zh: 指行使最高统治权或统领制度性领域；与事务性的行政管理不同，本框架凸显仪式合法性与至高权威。
groups.nuance_en: reign: hold royal office as titular or sovereign monarch (monarch / king / queen) · rule: exercise absolute or governing control (empire / nation / dynasty) · govern: direct public policy and legal administration (country / province / people) · enthrone: invest formally with sovereign authority (king / bishop / monarch) · preside over: occupy the seat of authority at a court or assembly (meeting / commission / court)
groups.nuance_zh: reign: 君临、在位执掌王权 (monarch / king / queen) · rule: 实行决定性或绝对统治 (empire / nation / dynasty) · govern: 依法治理与行政管辖 (country / province / people) · enthrone: 举行登基或就任圣职大典 (king / bishop / monarch) · preside over: 主持会议或掌管机构 (meeting / commission / court)

groups.name: Hunt by Method/Quarry · 凭特定方式/猎物狩猎 (Falcon, Rabbit, Ferret)
groups.tip: 如猎犬般疾速奔跑追逐

items.def_en: 1. To hunt rabbits. 2. (rabbit on) (British informal) To talk incessantly and tiresomely about trivial matters.
items.ex_en: The countryside boys often rabbit along the dry grassy banks on sunny weekends.
items.ex_zh: 乡下的男孩子们常在晴朗的周末沿着干燥的草坡猎兔。

items.def_en: to hunt with ferrets, especially rabbits driven from burrows
items.ex_en: Hunters still ferret along the dry hedgerows during the crisp autumn mornings.
items.ex_zh: 猎人们在清爽的秋晨依然会带上雪貂沿着干燥的灌木树篱打猎。

items.def_en: to hunt, catch, or shoot wild birds
items.ex_en: Hunters would often fowl in the foggy marshlands before dawn broke across the water.
items.ex_zh: 猎人们常在破晓前的迷雾沼泽中猎捕野禽。

items.def_zh: 用雪貂驱出；搜寻出猎物
items.def_en: (+ sth) drive quarry out of a burrow or hiding place, especially using ferrets
items.ex_en: The trained working dog managed to ferret out the hidden rabbit from the brambles.
items.ex_zh: 经过训练的猎犬成功将藏匿在荆棘丛中的野兔驱赶了出来。

items.def_en: to hunt game with a trained hawk or falcon
items.ex_en: Medieval nobles would regularly hawk across the vast heathlands during the autumn season.
items.ex_zh: 中世纪贵族每到秋季常常骑马穿越辽阔的荒原放鹰打猎。

items.def_en: To hunt wild animals or birds using a trained falcon.
items.ex_en: Noble huntsmen falcon across the barren steppe in pursuit of elusive desert hares.
items.ex_zh: 贵族猎人们在荒凉的草原上放鹰捕猎，追踪机敏难寻的野兔。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) search for and catch or kill quarry through persistent tracking
items.ex_en: Detectives worked around the clock to hunt down the suspect.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们夜以继日地工作，力求将嫌疑人缉拿归案。

groups.summary_en: A hunter pursues game using specialized animal aides (hawks, ferrets, dogs) or specifically targets a characteristic quarry. Verbs are denominal and capture traditional, highly specific hunting disciplines.
groups.summary_zh: 借助特种动物（鹰隼、猎貂）或针对特定猎物进行的专门化狩猎动作。
groups.desc_en: Specifies pursuing game using specialized hunting animals, techniques, or focused target species, contrasting with generic hunting through technical methodology.
groups.desc_zh: 指利用特定猎兽/猎禽或针对特定猎物的专门捕猎方式；与泛化的狩猎不同，本框架强调专业手法与针对性。
groups.nuance_en: falcon: hunt quarry using trained raptors (game / quarry / heron) · ferret out: search tenaciously and uncover through burrowing or probing (truth / secrets / impostor) · rabbit: hunt rabbits specifically, often with dogs or traps (warren / countryside / pests) · fowl: pursue wild birds or waterfowl (marsh / wetlands / game)
groups.nuance_zh: falcon: 放鹰行猎 (game / quarry / heron) · ferret out: 如雪貂搜穴般搜寻破获 (truth / secrets / impostor) · rabbit: 猎捕野兔 (warren / countryside / pests) · fowl: 猎捕野禽水鸟 (marsh / wetlands / game)

groups.name: Identify by Marking Pigment · 涂染标记与色标 (Raddle, Ruddle, Brand)
groups.tip: 抹上红赭颜料涂染上色

items.def_en: (+ sth) mark lines or boundaries on a surface using chalk
items.ex_en: The coach carefully chalked out the temporary boundary lines on the blacktop court.
items.ex_zh: 教练在沥青球场上仔细地用粉笔画出临时界线。

items.def_en: (+ sth) indicate boundaries or distinct parts using lines or pigment markers
items.ex_en: Surveyors used fluorescent paint to mark off the safety boundaries around the excavation site.
items.ex_zh: 测量人员用荧光漆划出基坑周围的安全警戒边界。

items.def_en: to rub, mark, or distinguish a surface or livestock by drawing with chalk
items.ex_en: The shepherd chalked the selected sheep on their backs to indicate quarantine status.
items.ex_zh: 牧羊人在选定隔离的绵羊背上用白垩画下印记。

items.def_zh: 用红赭石在（羊等）身上打标
items.def_en: to mark sheep with ruddle or red chalk for ownership identification
items.ex_en: Before moving the herd across the common, the shepherd keeled each yearling ewe.
items.ex_zh: 在将羊群赶过公地之前，牧羊人用红赭石给每只一岁母羊做了标记。

items.def_zh: 用红赭石（红颜料）做标记；涂浓妆，涂胭脂；编织（树枝等）
items.def_en: 1. To mark sheep or other animals with red ochre dye. 2. To color or paint with heavy rouge or red powder.
items.ex_en: The old shepherd carefully raddled the breeding rams with brilliant crimson dye.
items.ex_zh: 老牧羊人仔细地用鲜艳的深红色染料为种公羊做标记。

items.def_zh: 用红土（红赭石）涂抹，用红土做标记
items.def_en: To mark sheep or color a surface with ruddle (red ochre).
items.ex_en: He ruddled the entire flock before driving them down to the market pens.
items.ex_zh: 在将羊群赶往集市围栏之前，他用红土在整群羊身上做了标记。

items.def_en: to mark permanently with a hot iron or indelible dye as a proof of ownership
items.ex_en: Ranchers brand their cattle with a distinctive emblem to deter livestock thieves.
items.ex_zh: 牧场主用独特的标志给牲畜烙上印记，以防牲口失窃。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe rubbing or applying pigments, chalk, or marking dyes (especially red ocher on livestock or materials) to distinguish, identify, or claim ownership.
groups.summary_zh: 特指用赭石颜料、染剂在牲畜或原料表面涂划色块以作辨识标记。
groups.desc_en: Denotes applying colored earth, chalk, or heated irons to livestock or surfaces for sorting and ownership, contrasting with decorative painting by its utilitarian identification purpose.
groups.desc_zh: 指使用色土、白垩或烙铁在牲畜或表面施加标识；与装饰性涂绘不同，本框架强调实用性的归属甄别与分类标记。
groups.nuance_en: brand: permanently mark with a hot iron to signify ownership (cattle / livestock / memory) · raddle: mark sheep with colored pigment to track breeding or sorting (sheep / fleece / ram) · chalk: mark temporarily using soft limestone or chalk (line / cue / board) · mark off: delimit boundaries or separate by distinct visual lines (boundary / limits / territory)
groups.nuance_zh: brand: 烙印以确认产权或烙下印记 (cattle / livestock / memory) · raddle: 用彩色油彩涂染羊毛以做育种/分类标记 (sheep / fleece / ram) · chalk: 用白垩划线作临时标记 (line / cue / board) · mark off: 画线划定界线或分区 (boundary / limits / territory)

groups.name: Imaginative Reverie & Whimsical Daydreaming · 遐想神游与脱实幻梦 (Fantasize, Fantasy)
groups.tip: 放飞思绪勾勒画面

items.def_en: gradually lose focus on surroundings and become absorbed in daydreaming
items.ex_en: Whenever the lecture grew tedious, Clara would drift off into elaborate daydreams.
items.ex_zh: 每当讲座变得枯燥乏味时，克拉拉就会神游物外，陷入遐想。

items.def_en: to indulge in a pleasant, wandering series of speculative thoughts while awake
items.ex_en: He sat by the window and daydreamed about traveling across distant continents.
items.ex_zh: 他坐在窗边，开小差幻想着周游遥远的大陆。

items.def_en: become completely detached from one's surroundings while lost in internal thoughts
items.ex_en: Exhausted from overwork, Mark zoned out completely during the lengthy afternoon meeting.
items.ex_zh: 因过度劳累而疲惫不堪的马克在冗长的下午会议中彻底走神发呆了。

items.def_en: To indulge in fantasies or daydreams; to imagine pleasant or improbable things.
items.ex_en: Lonely individuals often fantasy about glamorous adventures in remote and exotic places.
items.ex_zh: 孤独的人常常会幻想去遥远而异域情调的地方展开奇妙冒险。

items.def_zh: 做浪漫不切实际的空想
items.def_en: (+ about) to entertain exaggerated, romantic, or visionary thoughts about something
items.ex_en: Do not romance about effortless fame when real success demands relentless daily toil.
items.ex_zh: 当真正的成功需要日复一日的不懈辛劳时，不要去空想什么轻而易举的成名。

items.def_zh: 幻想，做白日梦；把……想象为
items.def_en: To imagine pleasant, exciting, or impossible events that one wishes would happen.
items.ex_en: Children often fantasize about flying through the clouds like majestic magical eagles.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们常常幻想自己能像威严的神鹰一样在云层中翱翔。

items.def_en: [I/T] to experience sensations of apparent visions that are completely detached from real stimuli
items.ex_en: Suffering from severe dehydration, the lost mountaineer began to hallucinate running streams.
items.ex_zh: 由于严重脱水，迷路的登山者开始产生看到潺潺溪流的幻觉。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this cognitive manner frame capture indulging in wishful, unrestrained, or detached mental daydreams and unrealistic visions, distinct from practical planning or purposeful visualization.
groups.summary_zh: 沉湎于脱离现实的虚构幻象、脱靶白日梦或非现实的情节脑补。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to unmooring attention from empirical reality into internal imaginary daydreams, contrasting with focused problem-solving through its non-directed, escapist nature.
groups.desc_zh: 指注意力脱离现实经验、沉入内在奇想或白日梦；与专注的定向思考不同，本框架强调无导向性与逃避现实色彩。
groups.nuance_en: daydream: lapse into pleasant, waking reverie (future / romance / escape) · fantasize: construct elaborate, wish-fulfilling mental scenarios (wealth / revenge / success) · zone out: lose conscious mental focus and become blankly unresponsive (lecture / screen / traffic) · romance: indulge in idealized, unrealistically poeticized visions (past / idea / notion) · hallucinate: experience vivid perceptual sensations without external stimuli (voices / visions / fever)
groups.nuance_zh: daydream: 白日做梦，陷入愉悦遐想 (future / romance / escape) · fantasize: 构想不切实际的愿望满足幻境 (wealth / revenge / success) · zone out: 走神，大脑短暂停摆发呆 (lecture / screen / traffic) · romance: 浪漫化美化现实 (past / idea / notion) · hallucinate: 产生真切的感知幻觉 (voices / visions / fever)

groups.name: Impudently Defy · 顶撞与无礼不逊 (Cheek, Sauce, Backchat)
groups.tip: 态度放肆或言语冒犯

items.def_en: (+ to) to reply impolitely or defiantly to an elder or superior
items.ex_en: The strict schoolteacher warned the cheeky student never to talk back again.
items.ex_zh: 严厉的老师警告那个厚脸皮的学生绝不许再顶嘴。

items.def_zh: 对……言语冒犯，对……放肆无礼；给……加调味汁
items.def_en: (informal) to speak or behave impudently or rudely toward someone
items.ex_en: The insolent boy dared to sauce the headmaster in front of the entire assembly.
items.ex_zh: 那个傲慢无礼的男孩竟然敢在全体集会上面对校长出言不逊。

items.def_en: (+ to sb) reply rudely or insolently to a person in authority
items.ex_en: Don't answer back when your teacher is giving you advice.
items.ex_zh: 老师给你提建议时不要顶嘴。

items.def_en: (informal) to speak to someone rudely or impudently
items.ex_en: Do not dare cheek your headmistress again, or you will face immediate suspension.
items.ex_zh: 别再斗胆顶撞女校长了，否则你将面临立即停学。

items.def_zh: 向（上级或长辈）回嘴，顶撞
items.def_en: to answer an authority figure back insolently or argumentatively
items.ex_en: The sergeant warned the recruits never to backchat when receiving direct tactical commands.
items.ex_zh: 军士警告新兵，在接受直接战术指令时绝不许回嘴顶撞。

items.def_en: to speak to someone in a disrespectful or cheeky manner
items.ex_en: The boy was grounded after he began to sass his grandmother at dinner.
items.ex_zh: 那男孩在晚饭时开始对祖母无礼顶嘴，随后被关了禁闭。

items.def_en: (+ at sb) respond quickly, sharply, and aggressively to someone
items.ex_en: Exhausted and irritable, the store clerk snapped back at the demanding customer.
items.ex_zh: 身心俱疲且暴躁的店员厉声反驳了那位苛刻的顾客。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate speaking impudently, insolently, or disrespectfully to an authority figure or elder. These verbs carry strong colloquial/British expressive flavor, profiling the subordinate's defiance via cheeky, ill-mannered retorts.
groups.summary_zh: 对长辈或上级出言不逊、顶嘴无礼或傲慢顶撞。
groups.desc_en: Describes retorting insolently to authority or elders, distinguished from ordinary contradiction by its breach of hierarchical etiquette and pert impertinence.
groups.desc_zh: 指对长辈或权威无礼顶撞回嘴；与普通的言语反驳不同，本框架强调对尊卑礼序的冒犯与轻佻无礼。
groups.nuance_en: talk back: answer authority insolently or argumentatively (parents / teacher / boss) · sass: address with cheeky, disrespectful smartness (elders / mother / supervisor) · cheek: behave or speak with brazen effrontery toward superiors (policeman / teacher / authority) · snap back: retort sharply, defensively, and petulantly (critic / questioner / spouse)
groups.nuance_zh: talk back: 顶嘴，违逆还口 (parents / teacher / boss) · sass: 耍嘴皮子，无礼冒犯 (elders / mother / supervisor) · cheek: 大胆放肆地无礼顶撞 (policeman / teacher / authority) · snap back: 厉声反冲，急躁回怼 (critic / questioner / spouse)

groups.name: Infringe Rules & Contractual Terms · 违抗与侵犯 (Breach, Infringe, Violate)
groups.tip: 撕毁协议条约与突破底线

items.def_zh: 违犯，撕毁（协议、规则）；突破，攻破
items.def_en: 1. To violate or break a law, agreement, rule, or contract. 2. To make a gap or opening in a wall, barrier, or defense.
items.ex_en: Failing to deliver the confidential reports on time will severely breach our contractual agreement.
items.ex_zh: 未能按时交付保密报告将严重违背我们的合同协议。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) get into conflict with or violate a rule, law, or authority
items.ex_en: The financial firm fell foul of maritime trading sanctions imposed by the council.
items.ex_zh: 该金融公司触犯了理事会实施的海上贸易制裁法规。

items.def_en: (+ sth) come into conflict with or break a regulation or statute
items.ex_en: Unregistered overseas operators quickly ran afoul of the newly enacted environmental statutes.
items.ex_zh: 未登记的海外经营者很快触犯了新颁布的环境保护法规。

items.def_zh: （体育运动中）犯规，对……犯规；弄脏，污染；缠住
items.def_en: 1. (sports) To commit an unfair or illegal act against an opposing player. 2. To make dirty or polluted.
items.ex_en: The defender was penalized when he deliberately fouled the striker near the goal.
items.ex_zh: 防守队员在球门附近蓄意对前锋犯规而受到了判罚。
items.ex2_en: The boat propeller will foul if seaweed gets tightly tangled around the shaft.
items.ex2_zh: 如果海草紧紧缠绕在轴上，船的螺旋桨就会被卡住。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ on/upon) to break a law, rule, or agreement, or encroach upon someone's rights
items.ex_en: Publishing the uncredited artwork would directly infringe upon the original designer's intellectual property.
items.ex_zh: 发布未经署名的艺术作品将直接侵犯原设计师的知识产权。

items.def_en: to do something that violates an official law, treaty, or formal directive
items.ex_en: The proposed trade subsidy directly contravenes several international treaties signed last decade.
items.ex_zh: 提议的贸易补贴直接违反了过去十年签署的若干国际条约。

items.def_zh: 公然蔑视，公然无视（规章）
items.def_en: to openly disregard an established rule, law, or custom with contempt
items.ex_en: Reckless drivers openly flout the strict speed restrictions set within school zones.
items.ex_zh: 鲁莽的司机公然藐视校区内设立的严格限速规定。

groups.summary_en: Actors disregard, break, or commit a technical or legal infraction against an established rule, contract, sports regulation, or boundary.
groups.summary_zh: 违背或触犯既定规则、协议、法定义务或体育竞赛规程。
groups.desc_en: Involves encroaching upon, trespassing against, or directly violating formal codes, rights, or covenants, contrasting with generic wrongdoing through its direct conflict with codification.
groups.desc_zh: 指侵犯、践踏或直接违反成文法规、权利或协议契约；与泛泛的做错事不同，本框架特指对明确界定规范的逾越。
groups.nuance_en: breach: break a solemn legal covenant, defense, or trust (contract / trust / protocol) · infringe: encroach gradually or illegally upon legal rights or patents (copyright / patent / liberty) · contravene: act in direct conflict with an explicit law, rule, or statute (regulation / directive / law) · flout: openly and contemptuously disregard a rule or convention (rules / law / authority)
groups.nuance_zh: breach: 撕毁协议、破坏防御或背信 (contract / trust / protocol) · infringe: 侵犯法定权利、专利或版权 (copyright / patent / liberty) · contravene: 抵触或违反具体法条章程 (regulation / directive / law) · flout: 公然藐视并公然违反法度 (rules / law / authority)

groups.name: Interlace & Plait · 编织与交错缠结 (Braid, Wattle, Plait)
groups.tip: 经纬编结扎成篱笆

items.def_en: (+ sth) interlace distinct strands of fiber or hair into a single cohesive braid
items.ex_en: The artisan carefully braided together three colored silk cords into a sturdy strap.
items.ex_zh: 工匠仔细地将三根彩色丝绳编织交错在一起，做成一根结实的带子。

items.def_en: (+ sth) weave strands of hair, straw, or fibers together into a braid
items.ex_en: She sat quietly before the vanity mirror to plait up her thick hair.
items.ex_zh: 她静静地坐在梳妆台前，把浓密的头发编成辫子。

items.def_zh: 编成辫，编织（头发或绳索）
items.def_en: to interlace three or more strands of hair, straw, or fabric diagonally to form a single cord
items.ex_en: Local villagers harvest the dry reeds to plait traditional baskets for market.
items.ex_zh: 当地村民收割干芦苇，编织传统篮子拿到集市出售。

items.def_zh: 编成辫，编结；（用饰带等）镶边
items.def_en: 1. To weave three or more strands of hair, thread, or straw together into a plait. 2. To trim or edge a garment with decorative cord or tape.
items.ex_en: She began to braid the strands of sweetgrass into an ornate decorative basket.
items.ex_zh: 她开始把缕缕香草编成一个华丽的装饰篮。

items.def_en: [I/T] to cross or weave parts or strands intimately over and under one another
items.ex_en: Ancient roots interlace beneath the mossy forest floor to form a dense barrier.
items.ex_zh: 古老的树根在长满苔藓的森林地表下交错缠绕，形成坚密的屏障。
items.ex2_en: The skilled weaver interlaced strips of colored bamboo to form an exquisite basket.
items.ex2_zh: 熟练的编织工交错编织彩色竹条，做成了一个精美的篮子。

items.def_zh: 用枝条编造（篱笆、墙壁等）；用板条编结
items.def_en: 1. To build fences, walls, or hurdles by weaving flexible twigs and branches together.
items.ex_en: The woodsman wattled a sturdy shelter using pliable willow shoots and river reeds.
items.ex_zh: 樵夫用柔韧的柳条和河芦编造了一个坚固的庇护所。

items.def_en: [I/T] to weave or blend two or more threads, elements, or strands closely together
items.ex_en: The novelist interwove personal tragedy with grand historical events across the narrative.
items.ex_zh: 这位小说家在叙事中将个人悲剧与宏大的历史事件紧密交织。
items.ex2_en: Myth and history interweave beautifully throughout the ancient epic poems of the region.
items.ex2_zh: 神话与历史在这一地区的古代史诗中优美地交融在一起。

groups.summary_en: An agent interlaces strands of hair, flexible twigs, ribbons, or fibers in a diagonal or interlaced pattern to create decorative bands, ropes, fences, or woven structures. Verbs emphasize distinct manual braiding, plaiting, and twig-hurdle techniques.
groups.summary_zh: 将头发、枝条或纤维股条多股交叉交错编结成绳带、篱笆或结构件。
groups.desc_en: Denotes intertwining multiple pliable strands or flexible materials over and under one another, differing from simple twisting or tying through its structured geometric lattice.
groups.desc_zh: 指将多根柔韧的股线或材料按几何规律相互交织经纬；与简单的缠绕或打结不同，本框架强调结构性的编结网络。
groups.nuance_en: braid: interlace three or more flexible strands into a tight diagonal strip (hair / rope / cord) · plait: weave flat folded sections into a uniform band (straw / hair / ribbon) · interlace: cross or blend distinct strands alternately over and under (branches / fingers / motifs) · wattle: weave twigs and slender branches into fencing or wall lattices (hurdles / fence / twigs)
groups.nuance_zh: braid: 编织三股或多股辫状物 (hair / rope / cord) · plait: 压平交叠编织成带状 (straw / hair / ribbon) · interlace: 纵横穿插交错 (branches / fingers / motifs) · wattle: 用树条枝条编织栅栏或墙骨 (hurdles / fence / twigs)

groups.name: Laud & Exalt · 赞美与崇高颂扬 (Laud, Extol, Exalt)
groups.tip: 从口头称赞到公开正式表彰

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth as sth) to present someone or something as an admirable example to be praised
items.ex_en: The teacher held up her diligent study habits as an example for everyone.
items.ex_zh: 老师把她勤勉的学习习惯作为榜样推崇给所有人。

items.def_en: to praise someone or something very highly in speech or writing, often at a formal occasion
items.ex_en: Colleagues gathered at the memorial service to eulogize the late ambassador's diplomatic integrity.
items.ex_zh: 同事们聚集在追悼会上，盛赞已故大使的外交气节。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to praise someone or something enthusiastically in words or poetry
items.ex_en: Ancient bards sang of the fearless warriors who defended the northern border.
items.ex_zh: 古老的吟游诗人歌颂了保卫北部边境的无畏战士。

items.def_en: (formal) To praise someone or something lavishly or publicly.
items.ex_en: Critics widely lauded the conductor's masterful interpretation of the complex symphonic score.
items.ex_zh: 评论家们广泛盛赞指挥家对这部复杂交响乐谱的精湛诠释。

items.def_zh: 赞扬，高度赞美；提拔，提升（地位等）；使兴高采烈
items.def_en: (formal) 1. To praise someone or something highly. 2. To raise someone to a higher rank, position, or status.
items.ex_en: Poets often exalt the quiet majesty of pristine mountains in their reflective verses.
items.ex_zh: 诗人们常在沉思的诗句中高度赞美原始山峦的沉静庄严。

items.def_en: to praise someone or something enthusiastically and at length, especially in speech or writing
items.ex_en: The keynote speaker extolled the countless virtues of public service before the crowd.
items.ex_zh: 主旨发言人在众人面前极力盛赞公共服务的诸多美德。

items.def_zh: 尊崇，赞美（神或伟大品性）
items.def_en: to praise, glorify, or extol someone or God in a ceremonial or reverent manner
items.ex_en: The choir raised their voices during the cathedral service to magnify the Lord.
items.ex_zh: 唱诗班在大教堂礼拜仪式中高声歌唱，尊崇赞美主。

groups.summary_en: High-register verbs denoting elevated, literary, or ceremonial praise, escalating from lofty commendation of virtues ('laud', 'extol') to quasi-sacred glorification ('magnify', 'exalt').
groups.summary_zh: 高阶书面与典礼性颂扬，从高度歌颂功绩美德递增至近乎神化的崇高赞美与推崇。
groups.desc_en: Involves raising someone or something to supreme heights through high-flown, enthusiastic verbal praise, contrasting with modest compliments through its public or spiritual grandeur.
groups.desc_zh: 指以高度赞赏的言辞将某人或某事物推崇至崇高地位；与日常称赞不同，本框架强调公开性与庄严宏大的颂扬色彩。
groups.nuance_en: extol: praise enthusiastically and lavishly in public speech or writing (virtues / merits / benefits) · laud: formally praise and commend high achievement (efforts / performance / achievements) · exalt: elevate to supreme honor, nobility, or divine status (leader / God / status) · eulogize: deliver high, formal praise, especially posthumously (deceased / career / life)
groups.nuance_zh: extol: 极力赞美，热情讴歌 (virtues / merits / benefits) · laud: 正式称赞，嘉奖成就 (efforts / performance / achievements) · exalt: 崇拔至高位，神化赞颂 (leader / God / status) · eulogize: 致悼词式地高度颂扬 (deceased / career / life)

groups.name: Legal Seizure & Forfeiture · 没收与依法征收 (Confiscate, Foreclose, Impound)
groups.tip: 依法律或权力强行没收

items.def_en: Take official possession of property, contraband, or assets by judicial or police authority
items.ex_en: Federal agents moved swiftly to seize the hidden shipping containers of smuggled goods.
items.ex_zh: 联邦执法人员迅速采取行动，查扣了藏有走私货物的集装箱。

items.def_en: 1. (+ from) To officially take private property away from someone as a punishment or for security reasons.
items.ex_en: Customs officers confiscated the illegal wildlife shipments from the overseas passenger's luggage.
items.ex_zh: 海关官员从该名海外旅客的行李中没收了非法野生动物制品。

items.def_zh: （因违规或受罚而）失去，丧失，被没收
items.def_en: To lose property, money, a right, or a privilege as a penalty for breaking a rule or failing to meet an obligation.
items.ex_en: The fraudulent contractor had to forfeit his operating license following the state investigation.
items.ex_zh: 在州政府调查后，该欺诈承包商不得不被吊销执业执照。

items.def_en: Seize and take legal custody of vehicles, animals, or goods because of a violation of the law
items.ex_en: Traffic police decided to impound the uninsured vehicle after the highway collision.
items.ex_zh: 公路碰撞事故发生后，交警决定扣押这辆未投保的车辆。

items.def_zh: 取消（抵押品）赎回权，没收（抵押财产）；排除，阻止
items.def_en: 1. (+ on) (law / finance) To take legal possession of an owner's property when they fail to keep up their mortgage payments. 2. (formal) To rule out or prevent something from happening.
items.ex_en: The regional bank threatened to foreclose on the mortgaged estate after prolonged nonpayment.
items.ex_zh: 在长期拖欠还款后，该地区银行威胁要取消抵押庄园的赎回权。

items.def_en: Take back ownership of property (e.g. car, house) when the buyer defaults on loan installments
items.ex_en: Bailiffs arrived at dawn to repossess the luxury car following missed financing installments.
items.ex_zh: 因未按期支付车贷，执达员于破晓时分前来收回了这辆豪车。

items.def_zh: 征用，没收（国家征收私产）
items.def_en: (Of a state or authority) Take away privately owned property, typically for public use
items.ex_en: The municipality decided to expropriate several riverside plots to expand the public park.
items.ex_zh: 市政当局决定征用几块滨河地块以扩建公共公园。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote legal or regulatory actions wherein property, rights, or collateral are seized, repossessed, or lost as a penalty for breach of contract, lawbreaking, or loan default.
groups.summary_zh: 指因违约、违法或逾期未还款，依司法或行政权力没收、扣押或剥夺财产权。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to taking possession of property through legal authority, statutory penalty, or sovereign power, distinguished from theft by its institutional judicial backing.
groups.desc_zh: 指凭借司法裁决、法定罚则或主权强制占有财产；与非法掠夺不同，本框架具有明确的体制法理依据。
groups.nuance_en: confiscate: seize private property officially as a penalty or security measure (contraband / weapons / passport) · impound: take legal custody of vehicles or physical goods until cleared (vehicle / cargo / documents) · forfeit: lose ownership of an asset voluntarily or as a punitive consequence (deposit / rights / bail) · expropriate: compulsorily acquire private property for public eminent domain (land / property / assets) · foreclose: legally deprive a mortgagor of redemption right upon default (mortgage / property / home)
groups.nuance_zh: confiscate: 依法没收或充公违禁品 (contraband / weapons / passport) · impound: 扣押、暂扣待查 (vehicle / cargo / documents) · forfeit: 违约丧失或被罚没权益 (deposit / rights / bail) · expropriate: 政府征收或征用私产 (land / property / assets) · foreclose: 银行因违约取消赎回权并查封 (mortgage / property / home)

groups.name: Lose & Misplace · 遗失与错放 (Lose, Misplace, Mislay)
groups.tip: 因疏忽乱放而一时找不到

items.def_en: (+ sth) to accidentally leave an object somewhere when departing
items.ex_en: He realized with horror that he had left behind his passport at security.
items.ex_zh: 他惊恐地发现自己把护照忘在了安检处。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to fail to stay aware of the location or condition of something and thus lose it
items.ex_en: During the chaotic office relocation, the movers lost track of several archival crates.
items.ex_zh: 在混乱的办公室搬迁过程中，搬运工不知几个档案箱的下落。

items.def_zh: 随手乱放而一时找不到（常为暂时性的）
items.def_en: to put an item in an unremembered or incorrect place so that it cannot immediately be found
items.ex_en: The secretary misplaced the signed legal files somewhere inside the vast archive room.
items.ex_zh: 秘书把签署的法律文件随手放在庞大的档案室某处，一时找不到了。

items.def_zh: 放错地方，错放遗失（mislay 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of mislay: to lose something temporarily because you forgot where you put it.
items.ex_en: He frantically searched the study because he had mislaid his reading glasses again.
items.ex_zh: 他在书房里疯狂搜寻，因为他又把老花镜放错地方找不到了。

items.def_en: To lose something temporarily because you forgot where you put it.
items.ex_en: I frequently mislay my office access key whenever I switch jackets in autumn.
items.ex_zh: 秋天只要换外套，我就经常把办公室门禁钥匙随手乱放而找不到。

items.def_en: to accidentally leave behind or lose something while travelling or moving
items.ex_en: Somewhere between the platform and the carriage, she dropped her favorite silver bracelet.
items.ex_zh: 在站台和车厢之间的某处，她不慎遗落了心爱的银手镯。
items.ex2_en: Temperatures drop significantly in the mountain valleys after the autumn sun goes down.
items.ex2_zh: 秋日太阳落山后，山谷中的气温会显著下降。

items.def_zh: 丢失，遗失（通常指不可复得或去向不明）
items.def_en: to be deprived of or cease to have something, especially by accident or carelessness
items.ex_en: Careless tourists often lose their wallets while navigating the crowded subway stations.
items.ex_zh: 粗心的游客在拥挤的地铁站穿行时常常丢失钱包。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote unintentionally forfeiting possession of an item or forgetting where it was put. Nuances range from temporary, recoverable disorientation of an object to irreversible loss.
groups.summary_zh: 指无意中丢失物品或因放错位置而暂时找不到。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on losing intentional physical possession or conscious awareness of an object's spatial location, contrasting with intentional disposal through the absence of deliberate intent.
groups.desc_zh: 指失去对物体空间位置的知觉与控制；与主动遗弃不同，本框架强调非自愿、非故意的失管与遗忘。
groups.nuance_en: lose: suffer the accidental deprivation of possession or trace (keys / wallet / sight) · misplace: place an item temporarily in an unremembered spot (glasses / phone / files) · mislay: put something down carelessly so it cannot be located immediately (notes / pen / ticket) · leave behind: forgetfully or intentionally abandon an item at a previous location (luggage / umbrella / phone)
groups.nuance_zh: lose: 遗失、丧失所有或下落 (keys / wallet / sight) · misplace: 放错地方而一时想不起 (glasses / phone / files) · mislay: 随手乱放导致难觅 (notes / pen / ticket) · leave behind: 遗忘落于某处 (luggage / umbrella / phone)

groups.name: Make Amends & Expiate · 赎罪与清偿过错 (Atone, Expiate, Compensate)
groups.tip: 付出代价来抵偿罪过或损失

items.def_en: (+ sth) to do something good to compensate for an injury, error, or moral failing
items.ex_en: He worked overtime all weekend to make up for the lost hours.
items.ex_zh: 他整个周末都在加班，以弥补损失的工时。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to experience punishment, suffering, or remorse for past wrongdoing
items.ex_en: The corrupt official will eventually pay for his greed behind prison bars.
items.ex_zh: 贪官终将因自己的贪婪在铁窗之后付出代价。

items.def_en: to remedy or set right an unfair situation or grievance by compensation
items.ex_en: The tribunal took decisive steps to redress the longstanding wage inequalities among staff.
items.ex_zh: 特别法庭采取果断措施，匡正员工之间长期存在的工资不公。

items.def_en: (+ for) to make amends or reparation for an offense, crime, or sin
items.ex_en: The disgraced executive attempted to atone for his corporate crimes through philanthropy.
items.ex_zh: 声名狼藉的高管试图通过慈善事业来弥补自己的职务罪行。

items.def_en: (archaic) To pay the penalty for something; to atone for a wrong.
items.ex_en: The traitor knew in his heart he must aby his heinous treachery dearly.
items.ex_zh: 叛徒心知肚明，自己必将为那令人发指的背叛付出惨痛代价。

items.def_en: (+ for) To try too hard to make up for a fault, disadvantage, or mistake, often causing a new problem.
items.ex_en: He tended to overcompensate for his lack of administrative experience by micromanaging everyone.
items.ex_zh: 他往往通过事无巨细的微观管理，来过度弥补自己管理经验的不足。

items.def_en: to extinguish the guilt of sin or wrongdoing by suffering or penance
items.ex_en: The remorseful monk spent months in fasting solitude to expiate his grave sins.
items.ex_zh: 悔恨的僧人在绝食独处中度过了数月，以赎清自己的重罪。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe taking corrective action, enduring penance, or offering reparation to balance out a moral offense, sin, or past injury, ranging from ritualistic expiation to psychological over-adjustment.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过受罚、赔偿或补救行动以弥补过失、罪愆或失衡。
groups.desc_en: Denotes wiping away guilt, moral stain, or civil liability through restitution, suffering, or sacrificial compensation, differing from mere apology by demanding a commensurate countervailing cost.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过实质赔付、受罚或牺牲以涤除罪衍、道德污点或损害责任；与口头道歉不同，本框架要求付出等价的代偿代价。
groups.nuance_en: atone: provide expiatory satisfaction for sins or moral wrongs (sins / past / crime) · expiate: extinguish guilt or religious defilement by enduring punitive ritual (guilt / crime / transgressions) · redress: remedy, compensate, or right an unfair grievance (grievance / balance / wrongs) · make up for: compensate for an omission, shortcoming, or wasted resource (lost time / mistake / deficiency)
groups.nuance_zh: atone: 补过、赎还道德罪衍 (sins / past / crime) · expiate: 涤罪、洗刷罪责或污名 (guilt / crime / transgressions) · redress: 纠正并赔偿不公冤情 (grievance / balance / wrongs) · make up for: 弥补过失或缺陷 (lost time / mistake / deficiency)

groups.name: Maritime Docking & Mooring · 靠岸与系泊 (Dock, Berth, Moor)
groups.tip: 轮船停靠指定泊位

items.def_en: of a boat: to be moored or secured to a quay, pontoon, or buoy with lines
items.ex_en: Most of his capital is tied up in long-term real estate investments.
items.ex_zh: 他的大部分资金都被长期房地产投资套住了。
