items.def_en: of a boat or ship, to arrive and come alongside a dock or harbor
items.ex_en: We watched the colossal cruise liner pull in slowly beside the harbor terminal.
items.ex_zh: 我们注视着那艘庞大的邮轮缓缓进港，停靠在码头客运站旁。

items.def_en: of a watercraft, to steer alongside a wharf, dock, or shore and halt
items.ex_en: The wooden fishing vessel pulled up alongside the stone wharf before sunset.
items.ex_zh: 木制渔船在日落前靠岸停泊在石码头旁。

items.def_zh: 进港停泊，（使船只）靠码头
items.def_en: to bring a ship into a dock or to come into a harbor basin/quay
items.ex_en: The ferry captain maneuvered smoothly to dock the vessel into the ferry slip.
items.ex_zh: 渡轮船长操纵平稳，使船只驶入渡轮泊位进港靠泊。
items.ex2_en: The cruise liner will dock at the international port early tomorrow morning.
items.ex2_zh: 这艘邮轮将于明天清晨停靠在国际码头。

items.def_zh: 系泊，用缆绳或锚将（船）固定
items.def_en: to secure a ship or boat in place with ropes, chains, or an anchor
items.ex_en: Sailors worked swiftly to moor the yacht to the heavy iron quay bollards.
items.ex_zh: 水手们迅速动作，用缆绳将游艇系泊在笨重的码头铁系缆桩上。
items.ex2_en: The fishing boat moors securely in the quiet harbor during the winter season.
items.ex2_zh: 冬季期间，渔船安全地系泊在宁静的港湾里。

items.def_en: (of a ship) To tie up or dock at an assigned place; to guide a ship into a berth.
items.ex_en: The cargo ship berthed at the deepwater container terminal early this morning.
items.ex_zh: 货船于今天清晨停靠在深水集装箱码头指定泊位。
items.ex2_en: The experienced pilot berthed the massive cargo vessel without scratching the wooden pier.
items.ex2_zh: 经验丰富的引水员引导巨大的货船靠岸，没有刮碰到木质码头。

items.def_zh: 停靠码头；使（船）靠码头；在码头上装卸（货物）
items.def_en: (nautical) To moor a ship at a wharf, or unload cargo onto a wharf.
items.ex_en: Stevedores hurried along the quay to wharf the merchant ship laden with grain.
items.ex_zh: 码头工人们沿着码头奔忙，使满载粮食的商船靠上码头卸货。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this specialized nautical scenario govern bringing a vessel alongside a coastal structure and securing it in position. They delineate the specific destination fixture: dock (entering a slip or basin), berth (occupying an allocated quayside spot), wharf (bringing specifically alongside a cargo wharf), and moor/tie up (securing via cables to bitts or buoys).
groups.summary_zh: 航海专业场景：将船只驶入指定水域，靠泊码头并系缆固定。
groups.desc_en: Relates to securing a vessel to a pier, seabed, or wharf for loading or rest, distinguished from open-water navigation by static anchorage and infrastructure attachment.
groups.desc_zh: 指将船舶靠泊于码头、系缆于泊位或浮筒；与航行状态不同，本框架强调利用港口设施实现的稳固停靠与约束。
groups.nuance_en: dock: maneuver a vessel into a slip or contact with a pier (ship / boat / spacecraft) · moor: secure a boat to a fixed buoy, post, or anchor with cables (vessel / yacht / boat) · berth: bring a vessel to an assigned designated resting space (liner / tanker / ship) · tie up: fasten a craft firmly using docklines (boat / skiff / dinghy)
groups.nuance_zh: dock: 靠岸、进坞入港 (ship / boat / spacecraft) · moor: 系缆泊锚、固定停泊 (vessel / yacht / boat) · berth: 停靠指定泊位 (liner / tanker / ship) · tie up: 缆绳系绑系船柱 (boat / skiff / dinghy)

groups.name: Mark & Panel · 标记、烙印与嵌板修饰 (Brand, Panel, Emblazon)
groups.tip: 在物体表面留下印记或装饰

items.def_en: (+ sth) to draw or place visible marks on a surface to define an area or indicate identity
items.ex_en: Her exceptional leadership skills marked her out for early promotion.
items.ex_zh: 她出众的领导能力注定了她会早早获得晋升。

items.def_zh: 用嵌板装饰；给……安装饰板
items.def_en: To cover, line, or decorate a wall, door, or surface with flat panels.
items.ex_en: The carpenter used dark walnut boards to panel the library's formal study walls.
items.ex_zh: 木匠用深色胡桃木板为图书馆正式书房的墙壁安装了饰板。

items.def_en: to impress a pattern, brand, or sign into or onto a surface with an instrument
items.ex_en: Inspectors stamp each inspected leather component with a unique official quality seal.
items.ex_zh: 质检员在每个受检皮革部件上盖印专属的官方质量印记。

items.def_en: to cut or carve designs, names, or identifying marks into a hard material
items.ex_en: The skilled jeweler can engrave delicate initials onto the silver locket.
items.ex_zh: 手艺娴熟的珠宝商能将精致的姓名首字母刻在银制小盒上。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to imprint or engrave a mark permanently onto a surface using heat or branding
items.ex_en: The rancher used hot iron tools to burn in the distinctive ranch crest.
items.ex_zh: 牧场主使用烧热的铁制工具将独特的牧场徽记烙印在上面。

items.def_zh: 打烙印于；铭刻；加污名于，谴责
items.def_en: 1. To mark permanently with a branding iron to indicate ownership or identity. 2. To impress permanently on the mind or memory. 3. To label someone as bad or shameful.
items.ex_en: They brand each cattle beast on the hip before releasing it into pastures.
items.ex_zh: 他们把牛群赶往牧场前，会在每头牲畜的臀部打上烙印。

items.def_en: to conspicuously inscribe, mark, or decorate a surface with a design, crest, or letters
items.ex_en: Knights proudly emblazoned their family coats of arms upon their polished tournament shields.
items.ex_zh: 骑士们自豪地将家族纹章醒目地铭刻在光亮的锦标赛盾牌上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict physical surface modifications intended to identify ownership, decorate, or mark an object permanently using structural plates, burns, or prominent visual devices.
groups.summary_zh: 通过镶嵌护板、烧烙印记或压覆显著标识来标记、识别或装饰表面。
groups.desc_en: Involves stamping, searing, carving, or paneling structural and visual identifiers onto objects, contrasting with generic decoration through indelible attribution and craftsmanship.
groups.desc_zh: 指在表面印刻、烙印、嵌饰标志或护板；与单纯的粉饰不同，本框架强调赋予永久性身份标识或结构性修饰。
groups.nuance_en: brand: impress an indelible mark or commercial identity (cattle / product / soul) · emblazon: display conspicuous heraldic designs or luminous markings (shield / banner / logo) · engrave: cut permanent letters or patterns into a hard surface (stone / ring / plate) · stamp: impress a distinct mark, date, or seal with a tool (passport / document / metal) · panel: furnish walls or ceilings with fitted timber or stone sections (room / walls / ceiling)
groups.nuance_zh: brand: 烙印产权或打上品牌印记 (cattle / product / soul) · emblazon: 显赫地纹饰、图章装饰 (shield / banner / logo) · engrave: 雕刻、镌刻图文 (stone / ring / plate) · stamp: 盖章、冲印标记 (passport / document / metal) · panel: 镶嵌护墙板或壁板 (room / walls / ceiling)

groups.name: Mason & Pave · 石砌与筑路拼修 (Cobble, Pinnacle, Pave, Mason)
groups.tip: 打地基立梁柱，搭建构造物

items.def_en: to pave a surface with flat stone slabs (flagstones)
items.ex_en: Paviors worked all week to flag the garden terrace with blue limestone.
items.ex_zh: 铺石工忙活了整整一周，用蓝色石灰岩石板铺砌了花园露台。

items.def_en: to build, construct, or fortify with stonework or brickwork
items.ex_en: Medieval builders expertly masoned the fortress walls to withstand violent prolonged sieges.
items.ex_zh: 中世纪工匠以精湛技艺用石头砌筑要塞城墙，以抵御旷日持久的猛烈围攻。

items.def_zh: 以砖石/沥青全面铺砌覆盖
items.def_en: (+ sth) to completely cover an area of ground with paving stones, concrete, or asphalt
items.ex_en: The council sparked protests when it chose to pave over the historic cobblestones.
items.ex_zh: 市政当局选择用沥青铺砌覆盖具有历史意义的鹅卵石路，引发了抗议。

items.def_zh: 拼凑搭建；粗制滥造地铺砌拼合
items.def_en: (+ sth) to piece together or construct roughly from varied available stones or materials
items.ex_en: Volunteers cobbled together a rudimentary retaining wall using loose creek rocks and mud.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者用散落的溪石和泥土粗制拼凑成一堵简陋的挡土墙。

items.def_en: to cover a surface such as a road or floor with flat stones, bricks, or asphalt
items.ex_en: The construction crew labored all night to pave the highway with fresh tarmac.
items.ex_zh: 施工队通宵奋战，用崭新的柏油铺砌这条高速公路。

items.def_zh: 给……加顶塔；置于尖塔之上
items.def_en: (architecture / literary) To crown or furnish a building with pinnacles; to place on a high point.
items.ex_en: Gothic architects chose to pinnacle the towering cathedral with delicate stone spires.
items.ex_zh: 哥特式建筑师选择用精致的石质尖顶给高耸的大教堂加顶。

items.def_zh: 铺鹅卵石于；草率拼凑，粗制（常与 together 连用）；修补（鞋等）
items.def_en: 1. To pave a road or surface with cobblestones. 2. (cobble together/up) To assemble or produce something quickly and roughly. 3. To mend or repair shoes.
items.ex_en: Masons labored for months to cobble the sloping avenues of the old quarter.
items.ex_zh: 石匠们辛苦劳作数月，为老城区的斜坡街道铺设了鹅卵石。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate specialized architectural crafts involving masonry, crowning with stone summits, or rough assembling with stone and mortar.
groups.summary_zh: 指砌石、铺筑路面或为建筑顶部装饰尖塔等石构工艺。
groups.desc_en: Covers surfacing a thoroughfare or erecting structural stone walls with masonry and blocks, differing from smooth asphalt spreading through assembled mineral units.
groups.desc_zh: 指使用石块、砖料构筑墙体或铺设路面；与整体浇灌不同，本框架强调利用块状天然/人工矿质单元进行砌筑与拼嵌。
groups.nuance_en: pave: coat a road surface with stone, asphalt, or bricks (street / road / way) · cobble: surface a street specifically with rounded river stones or cobbles (street / alley / courtyard) · cobble together: quickly assemble components roughly or hastily (plan / agreement / solution) · flag: surface walkways with flat rectangular flagstones (path / terrace / patio) · mason: build, face, or fit walls using shaped stone and mortar (wall / chimney / stonework)
groups.nuance_zh: pave: 铺砌硬化路面 (street / road / way) · cobble: 用鹅卵石或方石块铺路 (street / alley / courtyard) · cobble together: 拼凑凑合出粗糙方案 (plan / agreement / solution) · flag: 铺设大块石板 (path / terrace / patio) · mason: 用石料与砂浆砌筑石墙 (wall / chimney / stonework)

groups.name: Misunderstand & Misjudge · 误判与误认 (Cognitive Attribution Errors)
groups.tip: 认知出现偏差导致看错

items.def_en: 1. to wrongly identify someone or something as someone or something else 2. to misunderstand a situation, statement, or idea
items.ex_en: Do not mistake her professional politeness for agreement with your controversial proposal.
items.ex_zh: 不要把她职业性的礼貌误解为赞同你那颇具争议的提议。

items.def_en: (+ with/and) to mistake one person or thing for another due to lack of distinct perception
items.ex_en: People often confuse the quiet twins with each other because of their identical hairstyles.
items.ex_zh: 人们经常因为那对双胞胎相同的发型而把他们彼此搞混。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth as sb/sth) mistakenly identify someone or something as someone or something else
items.ex_en: In the dim hallway light, I completely took him for my older brother.
items.ex_zh: 在走廊昏暗的光线下，我完全把他误认成了我的哥哥。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth with sb/sth) mistake one person or thing for another through confusion
items.ex_en: I always mix up those two identical keys whenever I try to unlock the shed.
items.ex_zh: 每当我想打开棚屋时，总是会搞混那两把一模一样的钥匙。

items.def_en: to interpret a sign, social signal, or text inaccurately
items.ex_en: The junior diplomat badly misread the hostile room and made an awkward joke.
items.ex_zh: 那位初级外交官严重误判了现场敌对的氛围，开了一个尴尬的玩笑。

items.def_en: to form an incorrect opinion about someone or make an inaccurate estimate of a situation, distance, or size
items.ex_en: The driver misjudged the distance between the two trucks and scraped his bumper.
items.ex_zh: 司机误判了两辆卡车之间的距离，擦伤了自己的保险杠。

items.def_en: to deduce an incorrect meaning or intention from someone's words or actions
items.ex_en: The opposition party intentionally misconstrued the minister's cautious statement to spark public outrage.
items.ex_zh: 反对党故意曲解部长的谨慎声明，以激起公众的愤怒。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame represent cognitive errors where a thinker incorrectly identifies an entity as something else or miscalculates someone's character, intentions, or capacities.
groups.summary_zh: 对事物身份产生误认，或对人的性格、意图及局势作出错误的判断。
groups.desc_en: Identifies erroneous cognitive attribution where an agent misidentifies an entity's identity or misinterprets textual or behavioral intent, contrasting with factual ignorance.
groups.desc_zh: 指认知归因或解读错误，将事物认错或对言行意图做出偏差判断；与单纯的无知不同，本框架侧重处理过程中的主观扭曲。
groups.nuance_en: mistake: wrongly take one person, thing, or quality for another (stranger / identity / intention) · confuse: mentally jumble two or more distinct entities or ideas together (names / issues / concepts) · misread: interpret the meaning of a situation, signal, or text erroneously (mood / signs / situation) · misconstrue: interpret words or actions in a perversely incorrect or malicious sense (remarks / motives / silence) · misjudge: evaluate a person's character, distance, or outcome inaccurately (distance / character / situation)
groups.nuance_zh: mistake: 错认、把……误当成 (stranger / identity / intention) · confuse: 混淆两相不同的概念或实体 (names / issues / concepts) · misread: 误读情势、信号或言下之意 (mood / signs / situation) · misconstrue: 曲解、曲意解读言行动机 (remarks / motives / silence) · misjudge: 误判性质、距离或人格 (distance / character / situation)

groups.name: Notch & Groove · 开槽与刻痕 (Notch, Groove, Indent)
groups.tip: 切出凹口留下刻痕

items.def_en: to cut a long, narrow aperture or groove into a surface
items.ex_en: He quickly slotted the thin wooden panel to fit the metal partition neatly.
items.ex_zh: 他利落地在薄木板上开出狭槽，以便严丝合缝地嵌合金属隔板。

items.def_zh: 在……上刻凹痕（或缺口）；赢取，斩获
items.def_en: 1. To cut a V-shaped mark or groove into a surface. 2. ('notch up') (informal) To achieve or score a win, point, or record.
items.ex_en: He notched the wooden post with a knife to mark the daily progress.
items.ex_zh: 他用小刀在木桩上刻出V形缺口，以此记录每天的进度。

items.def_zh: 在……上开槽（或刻凹槽）；狂欢享受，随音乐尽兴
items.def_en: 1. To cut a long narrow channel or track into a surface. 2. (informal) To dance or enjoy rhythmic music deeply.
items.ex_en: The technician carefully grooved the steel beam so the cables could sit flush.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员仔细地在钢梁上开凿凹槽，以便电缆能够平齐嵌入。

items.def_en: to make a notch, cut, or recess in the surface or edge of something
items.ex_en: The heavy steel clamp left a noticeable mark that indented the plastic surface.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的钢夹留下了一道明显的痕迹，把塑料表面压出了凹陷。
items.ex2_en: The soft aluminum sheet indents easily when struck with a hard blunt tool.
items.ex2_zh: 软铝片用坚硬的钝器敲击时很容易凹陷进去。

items.def_en: (+ sth) cut or scoop out the inside or surface of an object to create a cavity or channel
items.ex_en: The artisan used a sharp chisel to hollow out the trunk for planting.
items.ex_zh: 工匠用锋利的凿子将树干内部挖空，以便用来种植植物。
items.ex2_en: Over centuries, the persistent river hollowed out inside the solid limestone cave.
items.ex2_zh: 几个世纪以来，持续流淌的河流冲空了坚固的石灰岩洞穴内部。

items.def_en: to make narrow grooves or deep tracks in a surface
items.ex_en: Centuries of heavy carriage wheels had furrowed the ancient limestone road with deep ruts.
items.ex_zh: 几个世纪以来的沉重马车车轮在那条古老的石灰石道路上碾出了道道深槽。
items.ex2_en: The farmer's weathered brow furrows whenever he worries about the coming harvest.
items.ex2_zh: 每当担心即将到来的收成时，这位老农饱经风霜的眉头就会紧蹙。

items.def_en: (+ sth) cut or scrape a deep recess, groove, or indentation into a surface
items.ex_en: The mechanic used a chisel to gouge out a deep channel in the metal.
items.ex_zh: 机械师用凿子在金属表面凿出了一道深深的凹槽。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote cutting narrow recesses, v-shaped cuts, or functional hollow tracks into surfaces of materials to fit components or mark indicators.
groups.summary_zh: 在材料表面加工切出凹槽、缺口或轨迹。
groups.desc_en: Carving, cutting, or pressing deliberate indentations, channels, or recesses into a physical surface, distinguished from plain cutting by creating functional interlocking or recessed geometry.
groups.desc_zh: 在物体表面刻出、切出或压出具有特定几何形状的凹槽或凹痕，与单纯的切割相比，强调形成具有咬合或导向功能的凹陷构造。
groups.nuance_en: notch: cut a V-shaped indentation or tally mark (timber / belt / stick) · groove: form a long continuous track or channel (wood / metal / surface) · indent: press or set inward from the boundary (margin / surface / edge) · gouge out: scoop out material roughly and deeply (flesh / wood / metal) · furrow: plow or wrinkle into parallel trenches (brow / soil / forehead)
groups.nuance_zh: notch: 切出V形凹痕或记号刻度 (timber / belt / stick) · groove: 开出狭长的导向沟槽或轨道 (wood / metal / surface) · indent: 使表面或边缘向内凹陷或缩进 (margin / surface / edge) · gouge out: 粗暴凿出深槽或挖去大块 (flesh / wood / metal) · furrow: 犁出或深陷出平行沟纹 (brow / soil / forehead)

groups.name: Order & Codify Practices · 规范与制度化 (Regularize, Ritualize, Codify)
groups.tip: 建立规则使之标准化

items.def_en: (+ sth) finalize, formalize, and make a protocol, contract, or procedure rigidly fixed
items.ex_en: Authorities took immediate steps to lock down the perimeter following the security breach.
items.ex_zh: 在发生安全漏洞后，当局立即采取措施封锁了周边区域。

items.def_en: (+ sth) make informal arrangements or tentative practices definite, structured, and agreed upon
items.ex_en: We need to firm up the tentative travel dates before purchasing the plane tickets.
items.ex_zh: 在购买机票之前，我们需要把暂定的出行日期明确敲定下来。
items.ex2_en: The wet concrete mixture will firm up within three hours under sunny skies.
items.ex2_zh: 在晴朗的天空下，湿混凝土搅拌物将在三小时内凝固变硬。

items.def_en: to make a practice, tradition, or convention an established and accepted part of an organization or culture
items.ex_en: The administration sought to institutionalize the transparent review procedures across all regional branches.
items.ex_zh: 管理层试图将透明的审查流程在所有区域分支机构中制度化。

items.def_zh: 编纂（法典）；将…成文化/制度化
items.def_en: to arrange rules, laws, or practices systematically into an official written code
items.ex_en: The committee worked for months to codify traditional safety customs into formal workplace regulations.
items.ex_zh: 委员会花费数月将传统的安全惯例编纂成正式的工作场所规章。

items.def_en: to give an informal arrangement, agreement, or practice official or legal status
items.ex_en: Both companies agreed to formalize their partnership by signing a legally binding contract.
items.ex_zh: 两家公司同意通过签署具有法律约束力的合同，将彼此的合作关系正式确立。

items.def_zh: 使规范化，使合规；使合法化；整顿
items.def_en: To make an irregular situation, status, or system legal, official, or compliant with established rules.
items.ex_en: The government introduced a new program to regularize the status of undocumented workers.
items.ex_zh: 政府出台了一项新计划，以使无证劳工的身份合法合规化。

items.def_zh: 使程式化，使仪式化，使成惯例
items.def_en: To make an activity, pattern of behavior, or procedure into a formal, regular ritual or routine.
items.ex_en: The department chose to ritualize morning briefings to ensure consistent operational discipline.
items.ex_zh: 该部门决定将早间通报会程式化，以确保日常操作纪律的连贯性。

groups.summary_en: An authority or collective culture brings an ad-hoc, informal, or chaotic practice into an orderly, rule-governed, or ceremonial system. Verbs vary by whether the standardization is legal, procedural, or sociocultural.
groups.summary_zh: 将随意无序的惯例纳入既定规则、法制或仪式体系中。
groups.desc_en: Transforming informal, fluid, or ad hoc practices into settled, systematically documented, and repeatable institutional structures, differing from simple organization by its binding systemic permanence.
groups.desc_zh: 将非正式、流动的习惯或操作转化为明文化、制度化且可重复的稳定规则，与简单的整理安排相比，强调确立具有约束力和延续性的体系。
groups.nuance_en: codify: arrange laws or practices into a systematic written code (laws / principles / rules) · formalize: give official or legal status to an informal arrangement (agreement / relationship / partnership) · institutionalize: embed a practice deeply into an organization or culture (habits / values / procedures) · regularize: bring irregular practices into conformity with established standards (status / procedures / system) · ritualize: turn a routine into a prescribed, solemn ceremony (practices / greetings / behaviors)
groups.nuance_zh: codify: 将法则或惯例编纂成系统法典 (laws / principles / rules) · formalize: 赋予非正式安排官方或法定效力 (agreement / relationship / partnership) · institutionalize: 将做法内化并确立为组织或社会制度 (habits / values / procedures) · regularize: 使不规则状态合规化或正规化 (status / procedures / system) · ritualize: 将日常操作程序化或仪式化 (practices / greetings / behaviors)

groups.name: Order Authoritatively & Impose Terms · 命令与权威发号 (Summon, Dictate, Decreed)
groups.tip: 发号施令具强制权威

items.def_en: (+ sb) officially or authoritatively summon someone to appear before a superior or panel
items.ex_en: The executive committee suddenly called in the project director to explain the budget deficit.
items.ex_zh: 执行委员会突然传唤项目总监，要求其解释预算亏空问题。

items.def_zh: 传唤，召唤；召集（会议）；鼓起，振作
items.def_en: 1. to officially order someone to come or be present, especially in court. 2. to gather or call forth courage, strength, or energy (often with 'up').
items.ex_en: The supreme court decided to summon the elusive witness to give formal testimony.
items.ex_zh: 最高法院决定传唤那名避而不见的证人出庭作正式证供。

items.def_en: (+ to/from) to instruct or urge someone authoritatively with the weight of official responsibility
items.ex_en: The federal court enjoined the corporation to cease dumping toxic chemicals into the river.
items.ex_zh: 联邦法院严令责令该企业立即停止向河中倾倒有毒化学物质。

items.def_zh: 制定；命令规定（原则、规章）
items.def_en: (+ the law/rules) authoritatively prescribe rules, orders, or terms that others must obey
items.ex_en: The government has laid down strict safety guidelines for the industry.
items.ex_zh: 政府为该行业制定了严格的安全指南。

items.def_en: [I/T] to order or establish something with the force of sovereign or legal law
items.ex_en: The monarch decreed that all trade tariffs would be immediately abolished across the realm.
items.ex_zh: 君主下令颁布法令，在全境范围内立即废除所有贸易关税。

items.def_zh: 命令，支配，决定；口授，听写
items.def_en: 1. to state or order authoritatively; to determine or control. 2. to say words aloud for someone else to write down.
items.ex_en: Strict safety protocols dictate the exact sequence of steps for handling the radioactive material.
items.ex_zh: 严格的安全规程决定了处置放射性物质的具体操作步骤。

items.def_en: to command, decide, or establish something definitively by divine or absolute authority
items.ex_en: Ancient scriptures ordain that sacred relics must remain within the temple walls forever.
items.ex_zh: 古老的典籍明令规定，神圣的遗物必须永远留在神庙之内。

groups.summary_en: An authority delivers an unchallengeable directive, commanding another person to appear or arbitrarily prescribing the exact rules and terms they must follow.
groups.summary_zh: 凭借绝对权威发号施令、强制传唤或独断硬性规定行为。
groups.desc_en: Exercising legitimate or sovereign authority to compel attendance, issue binding decrees, or unilaterally impose non-negotiable terms, contrasting with basic requesting by its enforceable hierarchy.
groups.desc_zh: 凭借法定或至高权威强制传召、发布具有约束力的法令或单方面规定条款，与普通的指令或请求相比，强调等级森严的强制力与不可违抗性。
groups.nuance_en: summon: authoritatively call someone to appear at a specific place (witness / ambassador / parliament) · dictate: unilaterally impose conditions without room for negotiation (terms / peace / policy) · lay down: firmly state mandatory rules or principles (rules / law / conditions) · decree: issue an official sovereign edict or judgment (amnesty / ban / reform) · ordain: establish by divine or supreme destined authority (fate / destiny / priesthood)
groups.nuance_zh: summon: 凭借权威正式传唤或召集某人到场 (witness / ambassador / parliament) · dictate: 单方面强行指定不容谈判的条款 (terms / peace / policy) · lay down: 坚决明确地立下强制性规章 (rules / law / conditions) · decree: 颁布具有主权效力的官方政令或裁决 (amnesty / ban / reform) · ordain: 奉天命、神意或终极权威注定/确立 (fate / destiny / priesthood)

groups.name: Orderly Layering & Piling · 整齐堆放与成垛码放 (Stack, Rick, Tier)
groups.tip: 将物品一层层向上堆放聚集

items.def_en: (+ sth) to put things into an orderly heap or pile, or to accumulate into one
items.ex_en: The workers began to pile up the smooth timber planks beside the workshop.
items.ex_zh: 工人们开始将平整的木料板材在车间旁整齐地堆叠起来。
items.ex2_en: Dry autumn leaves pile up against the stone wall during windy November afternoons.
items.ex2_zh: 在十一月刮风的午后，干燥的秋叶在石墙边堆积起来。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to arrange things neatly in an orderly, vertical pile, or to accumulate in this way
items.ex_en: Please stack up these reference manuals neatly before the morning inspection begins.
items.ex_zh: 请在早检开始之前，把这些参考手册整齐地码放起来。
items.ex2_en: Unanswered customer complaints stack up quickly if the support staff fails to respond.
items.ex2_zh: 如果客服人员不回复，未解决的客户投诉就会迅速堆积起来。

items.def_en: to lay or gather items one on top of another into a neat or orderly rise
items.ex_en: She carefully piled the freshly ironed linen sheets into a tall, tidy column.
items.ex_zh: 她小心翼翼地将刚熨烫好的亚麻床单叠成整齐的一大摞。
items.ex2_en: Dense snowdrifts began to pile along the highway during the fierce winter blizzard.
items.ex2_zh: 在猛烈的冬季暴风雪中，厚厚的雪堆开始在公路边积聚起来。

items.def_zh: 把（干草、谷物等）堆成垛；扭伤（颈、背等）
items.def_en: 1. To pile hay, straw, or corn into large stacks (ricks). 2. To twist or sprain a muscle or joint.
items.ex_en: The weary farmhands worked until dusk to rick the fragrant autumn clover.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的农工们一直干到黄昏，把散发着清香的秋季三叶草堆成大垛。

items.def_zh: （使）整齐地堆起，叠放；堆满；暗中对……做手脚
items.def_en: 1. To arrange things in an orderly pile, or be arranged in a pile. 2. To fill or cover something with stacks of objects.
items.ex_en: He helped stack the heavy wooden crates orderly against the warehouse wall.
items.ex_zh: 他帮忙把沉重的木箱整整齐齐地码放在仓库墙边。
items.ex2_en: The plastic storage boxes stack neatly inside the corner of the small closet.
items.ex2_zh: 这些塑料收纳盒整整齐齐地叠放在小壁橱的角落里。

items.def_en: to stack cut firewood into neat, measured cords
items.ex_en: Before the winter snow arrived, the logger corded the seasoned split oak.
items.ex_zh: 在冬雪来临之前，伐木工将风干的劈开橡木整齐码放成标准木堆。

items.def_en: to arrange things in orderly, graded vertical ranks or successive levels
items.ex_en: The florist tiered the colorful potted plants vertically to create a cascading garden display.
items.ex_zh: 花艺师将五彩斑斓的盆栽植物分层阶错落码放，打造出瀑布般的花园景观。

groups.summary_en: An agent arranges items systematically in neat, vertical, or interlocking layers to create a stable, organized pile or store. It contrasts with disordered heaping by emphasizing geometrical alignment or structural order.
groups.summary_zh: 将物品有规则、有层次地整齐码放成垛，强调排列的稳定性与条理性。
groups.desc_en: Arranging objects upward in disciplined, stable horizontal layers or uniform tiers, contrasting with messy heaping by its deliberate geometry, structural balance, and inventory control.
groups.desc_zh: 将物品依循几何平衡、横向分层或阶梯状向上整齐码放，与杂乱的堆积相比，强调结构的稳固性、秩序感与空间利用率。
groups.nuance_en: stack: arrange orderly in vertical piles (boxes / chairs / plates) · tier: arrange in stepped or receding vertical ranks (seating / wedding cake / ranks) · cord: stack cut firewood into precise standard volumetric units (wood / timber / logs) · rick: pile agricultural produce into structured, thatched outdoor stacks (hay / grain / straw) · pile up: accumulate objects upward with or without meticulous precision (work / debts / rubble)
groups.nuance_zh: stack: 垂直平稳地整齐层叠码放 (boxes / chairs / plates) · tier: 依梯形、阶梯状分层排列 (seating / wedding cake / ranks) · cord: 将木材按标准码（体积单位）规整码放 (wood / timber / logs) · rick: 将农作物堆成防风雨的规则大草垛 (hay / grain / straw) · pile up: 向上大量聚积或堆放（秩序感较弱） (work / debts / rubble)

groups.name: Overlie & Impose Downward Pressure · 覆压、叠压与压覆于上
groups.tip: 平躺覆于上方形成沉积遮盖

items.def_zh: 躺在……上面，覆在……上面；压死（尤指压在婴儿身上使其窒息）
items.def_en: 1. (geology / formal) To lie directly on top of something else. 2. To lie on top of a young child or animal and suffocate it accidentally.
items.ex_en: Thick strata of hardened sedimentary sandstone overlie the much older metamorphic bedrock.
items.ex_zh: 厚层坚硬的沉积砂岩直接覆盖在更为古老的变质基岩之上。

items.def_en: (+ on sb/sth) to exert heavy, pressing weight downward onto an object or surface
items.ex_en: The immense concrete slab bore down on the foundation pillars with immense weight.
items.ex_zh: 巨大的混凝土厚板以沉重的重力向下压在基柱之上。

items.def_en: (+ on sb/sth) to exert continuous downward gravitational or physical force upon an underlying surface or body
items.ex_en: The heavy stone rollers press down on the gravel to form a solid driveway.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的石碾向下紧紧碾压着碎石，以压实出一条坚固的车道。

items.def_zh: （以天然层或顶部结构）覆盖顶部
items.def_en: to form an upper layer or permanent top surface over an underlying geological deposit or structure
items.ex_en: Impermeable shale formations cap the vast underground reservoir, preventing the oil from escaping.
items.ex_zh: 不透水的页岩地层覆压在庞大的地下储层顶部，阻止了石油外溢。

items.def_zh: 沉重地覆压使之受沉重负荷
items.def_en: to exert heavy downward physical force on something below it
items.ex_en: She felt weighed down by domestic responsibilities and work pressures.
items.ex_zh: 她感到家庭责任和工作压力压得自己喘不过气来。

items.def_zh: 以厚重层严密覆压导致窒息或压迫
items.def_en: to cover a surface or organism heavily so as to extinguish airflow or crush it
items.ex_en: A suffocating layer of heavy volcanic ash smothered the crops in the valley.
items.ex_zh: 一层窒息般的厚重火山灰严密覆压在山谷里的农作物上。

items.def_en: to compress and suppress growth by lying heavily across or tightly around something
items.ex_en: The thick invasive vine quickly strangled the young saplings under its suffocating weight.
items.ex_zh: 茂密的外来藤蔓以沉重窒息的分量缠覆下压，迅速扼杀了幼树的生长。

groups.summary_en: Expresses a stative or gravitational condition where a heavier geological layer, object, or weight lies directly on top of and presses down upon a lower stratum or body.
groups.summary_zh: 呈层状紧压或重压于下方物体或地层之上，构成沉重覆压态势。
groups.desc_en: Exerting heavy downward physical, spatial, or oppressive weight onto a lower surface, differing from light covering by the suffocating, crushing, or confining vertical load imposed.
groups.desc_zh: 自上而下对下方物体施加重力压迫、空间覆顶或窒息性负荷，与单纯的表面覆盖相比，强调纵向的重压、束缚或压迫感。
groups.nuance_en: overlie: lie directly on top of something, often geologically or spatially (strata / sediment / bedrock) · bear down: exert severe physical or psychological pressure from above (weight / sun / pressure) · weigh down: burden heavily to the point of sagging or exhaustion (branches / conscience / luggage) · cap: tightly seal or cover the upper limit (well / volcano / costs) · smother: overwhelm and extinguish air, space, or life beneath a blanket (flames / baby / dissent)
groups.nuance_zh: overlie: 直接叠压或覆盖在上方（尤指地层或物理层） (strata / sediment / bedrock) · bear down: 自上方施加沉重物理或心理重压 (weight / sun / pressure) · weigh down: 沉重拖累致使下垂或疲惫不堪 (branches / conscience / luggage) · cap: 在顶部封盖密封或设定上限 (well / volcano / costs) · smother: 严密盖住以窒息空气、活力或声音 (flames / baby / dissent)

groups.name: Overreach & Transgress · 逾矩与越权 (Overstep, Overreach, Transgress)
groups.tip: 超越职权界限或打破规则

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to gradually intrude upon or take over another person's rights, territory, or time
items.ex_en: The suburban development continues to encroach on the protected natural wetlands nearby.
items.ex_zh: 郊区的房地产开发正在持续蚕食附近受保护的自然湿地。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to gradually intrude upon or overstep rights, boundaries, or proper limits
items.ex_en: The new municipal regulation directly encroached on the long-standing rights of local landowners.
items.ex_zh: 新的市政条例直接侵犯了当地土地所有者长期享有的合法权益。

items.def_en: to behave inappropriately or transgress accepted rules, boundaries, or authority
items.ex_en: Employees knew that anyone who stepped out of line would face immediate dismissal.
items.ex_zh: 员工们清楚，任何胆敢逾矩违规的人都将面临立即解雇。

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ on/upon) to limit, encroach upon, or violate someone's legal rights or rules
items.ex_en: The aggressive surveillance measures clearly infringe upon the citizens' fundamental right to privacy.
items.ex_zh: 这项咄咄逼人的监控措施显然侵犯了公民的基本隐私权。

items.def_zh: 逾越，超出……的限度（如职权、规则等）
items.def_en: To go beyond acceptable or normal limits of behavior, rules, or authority (e.g., overstep the mark).
items.ex_en: The overzealous officer clearly overstepped his legal authority during the unwarranted search.
items.ex_zh: 那名表现过火的警官在无搜查令的搜查中明显逾越了他的法定职权。

items.raw_cluster: 越权与过度扩展 Overreach & Exceed
items.def_zh: 越权，做力所不及的事而失败；过度伸张
items.def_en: (often overreach oneself) To fail by trying to achieve more than one is capable of or by exceeding one's legitimate authority.
items.ex_en: The company tragically overreached itself by taking on too much foreign debt simultaneously.
items.ex_zh: 该公司由于同时承担过多的外债而力不从心，最终陷入困境。

items.def_en: [I/T] to go beyond the limit of what is morally, legally, or socially acceptable
items.ex_en: The corrupt official routinely transgressed the law to enrich his own private businesses.
items.ex_zh: 那名腐败官员经常践踏法律，以肥水流入自家的私营企业。

groups.summary_en: Actors exceed proper limits of authority, jurisdiction, competence, or ethical boundaries, escalating from trespassing accepted social/legal bounds ('overstep', 'transgress') to disastrously overextending one's ambition or capabilities ('overreach').
groups.summary_zh: 行动者超越权力、职责或道德界限，由违背规矩界限递增至因野心过大招致挫败。
groups.desc_en: Crossing permissible, legal, or moral boundaries by gradually invading another's territory or presumptuously exceeding one's legitimate remit, differing from open attack by its overstepping nature.
groups.desc_zh: 僭越法定、道德或权力界限，逐步侵蚀他人领地或越权行事，与公开侵犯相比，强调超越分寸、越轨与权力越界的本质。
groups.nuance_en: encroach: stealthily or gradually intrude upon rights or territory (territory / rights / privacy) · overstep: exceed recognized bounds of propriety, power, or authority (mark / authority / line) · overreach: defeat oneself by attempting to seize more than one's power allows (ambition / grasp / power) · transgress: break or violate an explicit moral or legal boundary (law / bounds / commandment) · infringe: passively or actively breach a patent, rule, or civil right (copyright / patent / liberty)
groups.nuance_zh: encroach: 步步为营地蚕食领地或侵蚀权利 (territory / rights / privacy) · overstep: 超越合宜礼度、职权或限度 (mark / authority / line) · overreach: 贪功冒进而野心超出实际能力 (ambition / grasp / power) · transgress: 逾越明确的道德规范、戒律或法规 (law / bounds / commandment) · infringe: 违背或侵犯既定的版权、专利或权益 (copyright / patent / liberty)

groups.name: Overrule & Strike Down · 否决与推翻 (Nix, Overrule, Veto)
groups.tip: 权威上诉驳回或一票否决动议

items.def_zh: 否决；坚决拒绝（建议或提案）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to decisively reject, veto, or defeat a proposal, plan, or argument
items.ex_en: The board quickly shot down the radical proposal due to severe budget constraints.
items.ex_zh: 由于严重的预算吃紧，董事会迅速否决了那个激进的提案。

items.def_en: (informal) to reject, veto, or cancel a plan, proposal, or idea
items.ex_en: The department head completely nixed our clever vacation plan without offering any explanation.
items.ex_zh: 部门主管没有作任何解释，就彻底驳回了我们精心安排的休假计划。

items.def_zh: 判决无效；推翻（法律或决定）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to officially rule that a law, regulation, or decision is invalid or illegal
items.ex_en: The constitutional court officially struck down the restrictive voting legislation as deeply discriminatory.
items.ex_zh: 宪法法院正式裁定推翻了这项具有歧视性的限制性投票法案。

items.def_en: To exercise an official constitutional or procedural power to refuse consent to a proposal
items.ex_en: The president decided to veto the sweeping bill despite overwhelming support from lawmakers.
items.ex_zh: 尽管得到了议员们的压倒性支持，总统仍决定否决这项涵盖广泛的法案。

items.def_en: To use superior authority to reject or cancel someone's decision, order, or objection
items.ex_en: The chief physician can easily override the junior resident's treatment decisions anytime.
items.ex_zh: 主任医师随时都可以依职权推翻初级住院医生的治疗方案。

items.def_zh: 驳回，否决（决定或反对意见）；改变（下级裁决）
items.def_en: to use one's authority to reject, overturn, or disallow a decision, objection, or argument
items.ex_en: The experienced presiding judge decided to overrule the defense attorney's frequent objections.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的主审法官决定驳回辩护律师频繁提出的反对意见。

items.def_en: To officially reject or declare a legal decision, subpoena, or indictment invalid
items.ex_en: The appellate panel unanimously voted to quash the wrongful conviction after reviewing evidence.
items.ex_zh: 在上诉审理证据之后，审判小组一致投票撤销了原先的错误定罪。

groups.summary_en: An authority figure or governing body invalidates, denies, or uses formal power to nullify a proposal, ruling, or planned course of action. Verbs range from colloquial outright refusals ('nix') to formal institutional nullification ('overrule', 'veto', 'override').
groups.summary_zh: 凭借权力或上级权威对决议、判决或提案予以否决、推翻或驳回。
groups.desc_en: Exercising superior institutional power, legal authority, or executive jurisdiction to annul, invalidate, or definitively kill an existing decision or proposal, contrasting with mere disagreement by its formal cancellation.
groups.desc_zh: 动用更高的机构权力、法定权威或行政管辖权，正式撤销、废止或否决已做出的决定或提案，与单纯反对相比，强调具有制度终局效力的推翻。
groups.nuance_en: veto: formally exercise constitutional power to reject a bill or measure (bill / legislation / proposal) · overrule: use superior judicial or official authority to overturn a prior finding (objection / decision / precedent) · quash: officially and completely annul an illegitimate verdict, indictment, or rebellion (conviction / indictment / rebellion) · strike down: declare a law unconstitutional or void through judicial review (statute / law / ban) · nix: informally but decisively reject or kill an idea (plan / deal / project)
groups.nuance_zh: veto: 行使宪法或法定否决权驳回决议 (bill / legislation / proposal) · overrule: 上级司法或行政官员推翻下级异议或裁决 (objection / decision / precedent) · quash: 依法宣告撤销判决或彻底镇压叛乱 (conviction / indictment / rebellion) · strike down: 司法审查宣告法规违宪并废止 (statute / law / ban) · nix: 口语中果断干脆地毙掉或否决提案 (plan / deal / project)

groups.name: Overtake & Surpass · 超越与赶超 (Overtake, Outrun, Outstrip)
groups.tip: 在速度或位置上超车越过

items.def_zh: 拉开距离甩开；将…远远甩在后面
items.def_en: to run or travel much faster than competitors, leaving them far behind
items.ex_en: The sleek sports car quickly outdistanced all rival vehicles on the open highway.
items.ex_zh: 那辆流线型跑车在开阔的高速公路上迅速拉开距离，将所有竞争车辆远远甩在身后。

items.def_en: (+ of sb/sth) to move in front of a competitor in a race, journey, or competition
items.ex_en: The marathon runner made a sudden surge to pull ahead of the defending champion.
items.ex_zh: 这位马拉松选手突然发力加速，赶超了卫冕冠军。

items.def_zh: 甩开；逐渐拉开领先差距
items.def_en: (+ from sb/sth) to increase the distance between oneself and a pursuer or competitor
items.ex_en: The sprinter began to pull away from his exhausted competitors in the final stretch.
items.ex_zh: 短跑选手在最后冲刺阶段逐渐拉开差距，甩开了疲惫的对手们。

items.def_zh: 超车，赶上，超过；突然降临于
items.def_en: 1. To catch up with and pass someone or something moving in the same direction. 2. To become greater than someone or something in number, amount, or importance. 3. To happen to someone suddenly or unexpectedly.
items.ex_en: He waited for a clear stretch of road to overtake the sluggish tractor.
items.ex_zh: 他等到前方路段畅通后，才加速超越了那台开得慢吞吞的拖拉机。

items.def_zh: 跑得比……快，赶过；超过（能力、范围等）
items.def_en: 1. To run faster or further than someone or something else. 2. To develop, increase, or spread more quickly than something can keep up with.
items.ex_en: Rising infrastructure maintenance costs rapidly outran the original financial projections of the planners.
items.ex_zh: 不断上升的基础设施维护成本迅速超出了规划者最初的财政预测。

items.def_en: to go, develop, or grow more quickly than another person, rate, or competitor
items.ex_en: Rapid technological innovations constantly outpace the development of appropriate governmental regulations.
items.ex_zh: 飞速的技术创新不断超出相关政府监管规章制定的发展速度。

items.def_zh: 超越；胜过（速度或发展速度上远超）
items.def_en: to move faster than and leave someone or something behind, or to exceed substantially in growth
items.ex_en: Domestic solar production rates significantly outstripped earlier market expectations this fiscal year.
items.ex_zh: 本财年国内太阳能生产增速大幅超越了早先的市场预期。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe moving faster than another entity to catch up with and pass them, or exceeding another entity in rate, quantity, or competitive achievement. They range from physical road or track maneuvers to broader quantitative or figurative eclipse.
groups.summary_zh: 在物理移动或指标发展上追平并超过原本领先的对象。
groups.desc_en: Moving faster than a competitor to catch up, draw level, and pass them from behind, distinct from ordinary fast motion by its direct competitive repositioning and widening lead.
groups.desc_zh: 以更快的速度追赶同方向的竞争对手并从后方超越，与单纯的高速运动相比，强调相对位次的逆转以及随之拉开的领先差距。
groups.nuance_en: overtake: catch up with and draw ahead of a moving competitor (car / rival / economy) · outstrip: surpass substantially in growth, capacity, or scale (supply / demand / expectations) · outpace: exceed in rate of speed, expansion, or development (inflation / peers / growth) · outrun: run faster or longer to physically escape or outdistance (pursuers / police / danger) · pull ahead: gradually take the lead in a closely contested race (polls / competitor / race)
groups.nuance_zh: overtake: 从后方赶上并反超同行的实体 (car / rival / economy) · outstrip: 在规模、供应或体量上大幅度超出 (supply / demand / expectations) · outpace: 在发展速率或通胀节奏上将对手甩在身后 (inflation / peers / growth) · outrun: 依靠奔跑速度物理甩开追逐者 (pursuers / police / danger) · pull ahead: 在胶着竞争中逐渐取得领先优势 (polls / competitor / race)

groups.name: Pan & Sweep Visually · 扫视与镜头扫掠 (Sweep, Pan, Scan)
groups.tip: 视线平移或大范围席卷掠过

items.def_en: (+ for sb/sth) to look visually in various directions or sweep across an area
items.ex_en: The frightened lost boy cast around for a familiar face among the crowd.
items.ex_zh: 那个吓坏了的迷路男孩在人群中四处张望，寻找熟悉的面孔。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to turn one's eyes or head to sweep visually across an area
items.ex_en: She took a moment to look around the spacious gallery admiring the paintings.
items.ex_zh: 她停下脚步环视这座宽敞的画廊，欣赏着陈列的画作。

items.def_zh: 平移摄影机拍摄；扫视；淘金
items.def_en: To move a camera slowly from side to side or up and down to follow a subject or film a wide view; to scan an area slowly.
items.ex_en: The documentary camera began to pan slowly across the vast desert horizon.
items.ex_zh: 纪录片摄影机开始缓慢平移，扫过辽阔无垠的沙漠地平线。
items.ex2_en: The cinematographer panned the camera smoothly across the dramatic mountain scenery at sunrise.
items.ex2_zh: 电影摄影师在日出时平稳地摇动镜头掠过壮丽的山峦风光。

items.def_en: to look over all parts of something systematically or searchingly
items.ex_en: The vigilant lifeguard continued to scan the choppy ocean waves for distressed swimmers.
items.ex_zh: 警惕的救生员不断审视扫视汹涌的海浪，寻找遇险的游泳者。

items.def_zh: 扫视，掠过；席卷；打扫，扫除
items.def_en: 1. To move quickly and smoothly over or through an area, or to let your eyes scan across something. 2. To clean a surface using a broom or brush.
items.ex_en: Her keen eyes swept across the crowded auditorium looking for an empty seat.
items.ex_zh: 她敏锐的目光扫视着拥挤的礼堂，寻找空闲的座位。

items.def_en: to pass across or scan over an entire area or surface thoroughly
items.ex_en: The bright coastal lighthouse beam slowly traversed the dark, turbulent waters every evening.
items.ex_zh: 每逢夜晚，海岸灯塔明亮的光束便缓慢横越扫过幽暗汹涌的海面。

items.def_en: (+ across/over) to sweep one's eyes, light, or gaze piercingly from side to side
items.ex_en: The guard raked his flashlight across the courtyard, searching for any sudden movement.
items.ex_zh: 守卫用手电筒横扫过院子，搜寻任何突如其来的动静。

groups.summary_en: Describes eyes, a searchlight, or a camera moving smoothly across a broad horizontal or continuous arc to take in a panoramic view or survey an area systematically.
groups.summary_zh: 指目光、镜头或光束横向连续掠过以巡视或摄入全景。
groups.desc_en: Moving one's gaze or an optical device horizontally across a wide field of view in a continuous, deliberate sweep to survey or locate targets, contrasting with stationary staring by its lateral directional trajectory.
groups.desc_zh: 将视线或光学镜头沿水平方向连续扫掠过广阔视野以进行巡视或索敌，与定点凝视相比，强调横向轴线上的平滑移动与视野覆盖。
groups.nuance_en: pan: rotate a camera or gaze horizontally across a panorama (camera / horizon / audience) · scan: pass the eyes quickly over a scene or text looking for specific points (crowd / horizon / document) · sweep: move a beam, glance, or weapon across an arc systematically (beam / eyes / searchlight) · rake: cast an intense, scrutinizing, or piercing sweep across an area (eyes / gunfire / glance) · traverse: systematically pivot optical equipment or artillery across a lateral angle (mountains / horizon / lens)
groups.nuance_zh: pan: 摇动镜头或水平转动目光巡览全景 (camera / horizon / audience) · scan: 快速浏览或搜寻特定特征与目标 (crowd / horizon / document) · sweep: 光束、视线如扫帚般弧形掠过大片区域 (beam / eyes / searchlight) · rake: 带有审视意味或密集火力般横扫全场 (eyes / gunfire / glance) · traverse: 机械或光学装置做横向扫掠转动 (mountains / horizon / lens)

groups.name: Parturition & Bearing Young · 分娩与产仔 (Birth, Lamb, Calve)
groups.tip: 怀胎受孕到产下幼崽新生命

items.def_en: to assist in the birth of offspring or bring forth a baby
items.ex_en: The experienced midwife helped deliver twins safely in the rural clinic yesterday morning.
items.ex_zh: 昨天上午，这位经验丰富的助产士在乡间诊所顺利接生了一对双胞胎。

items.def_en: To give birth to a baby or young animal; to produce or bring something into existence.
items.ex_en: The old hospital birthed countless children before it was replaced by a modern center.
items.ex_zh: 那座老医院在被现代医疗中心取代之前，迎接了无数婴儿的降生。

items.def_en: [I/T] (of a female dog, wolf, etc.) to give birth to puppies
items.ex_en: Deep inside the frozen cave, the mother wolf whelped five small, shivering cubs.
items.ex_zh: 在冰冻的洞穴深处，母狼产下了五只瑟瑟发抖的小幼崽。

items.def_en: (of livestock or animals) to give birth to offspring
items.ex_en: He dropped out of college to start his own technology firm.
items.ex_zh: 他从大学辍学去创办了自己的科技公司。

items.raw_cluster: 生产与繁殖 Give Birth & Breed
items.def_en: (of a female sheep) To give birth to lambs.
items.ex_en: The shepherd stayed awake all night as his prize ewes began to lamb.
items.ex_zh: 当那些优良母羊开始下羔时，牧羊人整夜未眠。

items.def_en: [I/T] (of a sow) to give birth to a litter of pigs
items.ex_en: Before midnight fell across the misty barn, the stout sow farrowed ten piglets.
items.ex_zh: 在薄雾笼罩的谷仓迎来午夜之前，那头壮硕的母猪产下了十头小猪。

items.def_en: [I/T] to give birth to a calf
items.ex_en: The veterinarian confirmed that several dairy cows would calve during the coming week.
items.ex_zh: 兽医证实有几头奶牛将在下周产犊。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this physiological frame describe the act of giving birth, whether used transitively for humans/general animals or intransitively for species-specific delivery events.
groups.summary_zh: 特指母体经历阵痛生产下胎儿或特定母畜分娩产仔。
groups.desc_en: Expelling or bringing forth viable offspring from the maternal body, distinguished across specific animal taxa or human medical assistance rather than general biological reproduction.
groups.desc_zh: 胎儿由母体产出排出体外，区别于宽泛的繁衍生育，按特定动物物种（牛、羊、犬等）或人类分娩医疗协助呈现高度专属性。
groups.nuance_en: deliver: provide obstetrical assistance to bring forth young (baby / twins / child) · calve: give birth specifically to cattle, whales, or elephants (cow / whale / elephant) · lamb: bring forth young specifically in sheep (ewe / sheep) · whelp: give birth to puppies or carnivorous young (bitch / dog / wolf) · farrow: give birth to a litter of piglets (sow / pig)
groups.nuance_zh: deliver: 为产妇接生或协助分娩 (baby / twins / child) · calve: 特指母牛、鲸或象分娩产犊 (cow / whale / elephant) · lamb: 特指母羊产羔 (ewe / sheep) · whelp: 特指母犬或母狼等食肉兽产崽 (bitch / dog / wolf) · farrow: 特指母猪产下一窝猪崽 (sow / pig)

groups.name: Perceive & Discern · 感知与辨识 (Notice and Distinguish Stimuli)
groups.tip: 感官接收外界信号的觉察

items.def_zh: 察觉，发觉（细微或隐藏之物）
items.def_en: to discover or notice something, especially something not obvious or easy to see
items.ex_en: The sensitive laboratory monitor can detect microscopic leaks in the sealed fuel pipes.
items.ex_zh: 这台灵敏的实验室监测仪能察觉密封燃料管道中的微小泄漏。

items.def_en: [I/T] to see, hear, or recognize someone or something with effort or clarity
items.ex_en: Through the heavy snowfall, we could barely distinguish the outline of the cabin.
items.ex_zh: 穿过漫天大雪，我们勉强能看清那座小木屋的轮廓。

items.def_en: 1. To become aware of, notice, or identify something through the physical senses or the mind. 2. To regard or interpret someone or something in a specific manner.
items.ex_en: Scholars perceive subtle cultural tensions emerging within the newly formed governing coalition.
items.ex_zh: 学者们察觉到新组建的执政联盟内部正在显现微妙的文化紧张关系。

items.def_en: to see, hear, or understand something with difficulty
items.ex_en: I could barely make out what the announcer said over the noisy crowd.
items.ex_zh: 在嘈杂的人群中，我几乎听不清播音员说了些什么。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to recognize or distinguish someone or something from a surrounding group or background
items.ex_en: The victim was able to pick out the attacker from a lineup of suspects.
items.ex_zh: 受害者能够从一排嫌疑人中指认出袭击者。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to notice, discern, or become aware of something subtle that others may miss
items.ex_en: The observant detective immediately picked up on the suspect's slight tremor of hesitation.
items.ex_zh: 观察敏锐的刑警立刻注意到了嫌疑人极其微小的犹豫颤抖。

items.def_en: (formal) To see, hear, or recognize something with difficulty or through careful perception.
items.ex_en: Looking into the dark valley, the scout could discern no signs of movement.
items.ex_zh: 望向漆黑的山谷，侦察兵觉察不出任何活动的迹象。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe taking in sensory information and mentally recognizing, differentiating, or interpreting it. 'Perceive' encompasses sensory and cognitive awareness, while 'discern' and 'detect' emphasize detecting subtle, faint, or distinct details.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过感官或认知识别、分辨出细微刺激或真相。
groups.desc_en: Registering subtle sensory stimuli and mentally isolating them from surrounding noise or ambiguity, contrasting with casual seeing/hearing by its cognitive filtering and acute identification.
groups.desc_zh: 捕捉微弱的感官刺激并将其从背景杂音或模糊状态中提炼识辨出来，与普通看听相比，强调认知过滤、细微辨识与解构能力。
groups.nuance_en: discern: detect with difficulty through careful sensory or mental examination (difference / truth / shapes) · detect: uncover something faint, hidden, or borderline imperceptible (scent / trace / presence) · make out: decipher ambiguous shapes or sounds with visual or auditory effort (figure / words / silhouette) · distinguish: mentally separate one entity or quality from another (feature / difference / sounds) · pick up on: swiftly notice subtle clues or unspoken undercurrents (vibe / hint / cue)
groups.nuance_zh: discern: 经过审视在隐晦中洞察或分辨出真容 (difference / truth / shapes) · detect: 察觉出极其微弱、隐秘或临界的痕迹 (scent / trace / presence) · make out: 极力辨认出模糊的轮廓、文字或声音 (figure / words / silhouette) · distinguish: 明确区别并区分两种相近的事物 (feature / difference / sounds) · pick up on: 敏锐捕捉到微妙线索、情绪或暗示 (vibe / hint / cue)

groups.name: Postal Dispatch & Franking · 邮寄与邮资核验 (Mail, Post, Dispatch)
groups.tip: 涉及信件盖戳与邮资凭证

items.def_zh: 投寄，邮寄（英式核心动词）
items.def_en: to send a letter, parcel, or document via the public postal system
items.ex_en: Please remember to post this parcel before the local collection truck arrives today.
items.ex_zh: 今天当地收件车到达之前，请务必记得把这个包裹寄出。

items.def_zh: 转寄，转发（信件包裹至新地址）
items.def_en: to resend or redirect a letter or parcel to an updated or further address
items.ex_en: The postal department will forward all official letters to your updated permanent address.
items.ex_zh: 邮政部门会将所有官方信件转寄至你更新后的永久地址。

items.def_zh: 邮寄，投递；发送（电子邮件）
items.def_en: To send a letter, parcel, or message using the postal system or email.
items.ex_en: She went down to the central branch to mail the signed legal documents.
items.ex_zh: 她前往中心邮局寄出了已签署的法律文件。

items.def_zh: 在（信件等上）盖邮戳免费寄送，盖免付邮资章
items.def_en: To stamp an official mark on a letter or parcel indicating that postage has been paid or that it is sent free.
items.ex_en: Parliamentary officers frank official notices to ensure they travel without normal postage fees.
items.ex_zh: 议会官员在官方通告上加盖免资邮戳，以确保其无需普通邮费即可寄出。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to dispatch or mail a letter or package through the postal system
items.ex_en: I need to send off this urgent application packet before five o'clock today.
items.ex_zh: 我必须在今天五点之前把这份紧急申请材料寄出去。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to send letters, packages, or materials to many people by mail
items.ex_en: The company mailed out thousands of brochures to prospective clients.
items.ex_zh: 公司向潜在客户邮寄了数千份宣传手册。

items.def_zh: 发送，寄发（包裹、公文等至目的地）
items.def_en: to send off a letter, package, or consignment to a destination with promptness or formality
items.ex_en: The embassy will dispatch diplomatic couriers with the confidential treaty drafts tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 使馆将于明早派送机要外交信差押运机密条约草案。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scenario relate to the formal transmission of physical letters and parcels through an organized postal or courier network, including stamping or marking official authorization on the envelope.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过邮政或投递系统寄送实体信件包裹及邮资处理。
groups.desc_en: Entrusting physical letters or packages to a postal or courier network, complete with official routing and postage validation, contrasting with personal hand delivery by its institutional transit.
groups.desc_zh: 将实体信函或包裹交由邮政及快递网络转运，并完成邮资核验或官印批转，与私人当面递交相比，强调依托制度化邮政系统流通。
groups.nuance_en: frank: officially stamp mail to indicate pre-paid or exempt postage (envelope / mail / letter) · dispatch: send off goods, messengers, or mail promptly on an official errand (courier / package / troops) · forward: redirect mail received at one address to another (mail / letter / email) · post: deposit mail into the public postal system (letter / parcel / card) · mail: send letters or parcels via the postal service (package / invitations / check)
groups.nuance_zh: frank: 邮资核准打码或盖免资公印于邮件上 (envelope / mail / letter) · dispatch: 快速向某地正式派遣、发运或投送 (courier / package / troops) · forward: 将收到的信件转发/转递至新地址 (mail / letter / email) · post: 投递入公共邮政信箱或邮局（英式常用） (letter / parcel / card) · mail: 经由邮政服务网络投送函件 (package / invitations / check)

groups.name: Praise & Hail · 称赞与盛赞 (Compliment, Commend, Hail)
groups.tip: 从赞许夸奖到高度盛赞

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to commend, compliment, or express verbal approval of someone or something
items.ex_en: Senior colleagues speak well of her tireless dedication to resolving difficult client disputes.
items.ex_zh: 资深同事们高度称赞她在解决棘手客户纠纷中所付出的不知疲倦的努力。

items.def_en: To praise or express admiration, approval, or respect for someone.
items.ex_en: The visiting professor complimented our research team on the clarity of our findings.
items.ex_zh: 客座教授赞扬了我们研究团队在研究成果表达上的清晰明确。

items.def_en: to express strong approval of an action, decision, or person
items.ex_en: Environmental groups warmly applauded the government's decision to ban single-use plastic containers.
items.ex_zh: 环保组织对政府禁止一次性塑料容器的决定表示高度赞许。

items.def_en: to formally praise someone or something, especially publicly or officially
items.ex_en: The director commended the young officer for showing exemplary courage during the crisis.
items.ex_zh: 局长表彰了这名年轻军官在危机期间展现出的模范勇气。

items.def_en: (+ of sb/sth) to enthusiastically express high approval, admiration, or acclaim for someone or something
items.ex_en: Generations of poets sang praises of the ancient valley's quiet, enduring majesty.
items.ex_zh: 一代代诗人热情赞颂这座古老山谷静谧而持久的壮美。

items.def_zh: 赞扬，称颂；欢呼；招呼（出租车或人）；下冰雹
items.def_en: 1. To praise or describe someone or something enthusiastically as being very good. 2. To wave or call out to catch the attention of a person or taxi. 3. (impersonal) To produce hailstones during a storm.
items.ex_en: Critics everywhere hail the young pianist as a generational talent in classical music.
items.ex_zh: 各方评论家一致盛赞这位年轻钢琴家为古典乐坛百年难得一见的天才。

items.def_en: to praise or welcome someone or something publicly and enthusiastically
items.ex_en: International audiences acclaim the daring documentary for its uncompromising honesty and visual brilliance.
items.ex_zh: 国际观众公开喝彩这部大胆的纪录片，赞扬其直言不讳与非凡的视觉表现。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe expressing verbal approval or acclaim toward someone's qualities, deeds, or creations, escalating from polite social praise ('compliment') to official recognition ('commend') and enthusiastic public acclaim ('hail', 'acclaim').
groups.summary_zh: 表达口头认可或赞赏，由日常客套夸奖递增至官方表彰与全社会热烈欢呼盛赞。
groups.desc_en: Expressing positive evaluation, honor, or public acclaim for someone's merits or achievements, scaling from polite personal compliments to ecstatic communal adulation.
groups.desc_zh: 对某人的品德、造诣或成就予以赞许、表彰或公开推崇，梯度上涵盖了从私下礼貌性赞扬到全社会狂热赞颂的整幅光谱。
groups.nuance_en: compliment: offer a polite, friendly expression of personal praise (host / performance / attire) · commend: formally approve or recommend someone's meritorious conduct (officer / bravery / service) · applaud: show vigorous, widespread moral or auditory praise (effort / decision / courage) · hail: acclaim someone enthusiastically as a triumph or savior (hero / breakthrough / victor) · acclaim: enthusiastically welcome and praise with public honor (novel / film / achievement)
groups.nuance_zh: compliment: 私下客气、友善地称赞某点特质 (host / performance / attire) · commend: 官方或权威机构正式嘉奖其功勋 (officer / bravery / service) · applaud: 对值得赞赏的作为报以热烈鼓掌赞许 (effort / decision / courage) · hail: 极其热烈地拥戴或欢呼其为英雄/里程碑 (hero / breakthrough / victor) · acclaim: 赢得社会各界与公众的由衷推崇与赞誉 (novel / film / achievement)

groups.name: Presage & Foreshadow · 预示与预兆 (Portend, Forebode, Herald)
groups.tip: 预先显现征兆昭示未来

items.def_en: To signal the approach, arrival, or onset of a major event or new era
items.ex_en: The treaty signed this morning will herald a new era of regional cooperation.
items.ex_zh: 今晨签署的条约将宣告一个区域合作新纪元的到来。

items.def_en: (literary/archaic) to be an omen of; to foretell or portend something
items.ex_en: The blood-red moon seemed to omen the tragic downfall of the proud dynasty.
items.ex_zh: 那一轮血红的月亮似乎预示着骄傲王朝的悲惨覆灭。

items.def_en: To give a subtle suggestion or indication of something that will occur later
items.ex_en: The sudden chill in the opening chapter foreshadows the terrible tragedy that follows.
items.ex_zh: 开篇章节中陡然升起的寒意铺垫了接踵而至的可怕悲剧。

items.def_en: (+ well/ill) To be an omen of a particular future outcome
items.ex_en: Such sharp drops in consumer spending do not bode well for economic recovery.
items.ex_zh: 消费者支出的急剧下降并非经济复苏的好兆头。

items.def_en: To act as an advance warning or harbinger of something evil or disastrous
items.ex_en: Those towering dark clouds foreboded a destructive tempest that would wreck the coast.
items.ex_zh: 那些高耸的乌云预兆着一场将摧毁海岸的毁灭性风暴。

items.def_en: To be a sign or warning that something typically bad will happen in the future
items.ex_en: The ominous tremors in the mountain presage a violent eruption in near future.
items.ex_zh: 山体发出的不祥震颤预示着不久后即将发生剧烈喷发。

items.def_zh: 预示，预告（尤指不祥之事）
items.def_en: To serve as a sign or warning that something momentous or calamitous is likely to happen
items.ex_en: Unusual flock movements among the ravens were believed to portend a great famine.
items.ex_zh: 渡鸦不同寻常的集群行动被认为预兆着一场大饥荒的来临。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe events, signs, or conditions serving as warning indicators or portents of future occurrences, ranging from solemn warnings to ceremonial announcements.
groups.summary_zh: 描述作为征兆预示未来事件，侧重不祥预感或重大转折。
groups.desc_en: Signaling or prefiguring a momentous future event through present omens, patterns, or precursors, differing from factual scientific forecasting by its reliance on fateful signs.
groups.desc_zh: 通过现存的征兆、模式或前兆预示即将到来的重大事态，区别于科学测算预测，强调宿命感、预兆隐喻或警示性征兆。
groups.nuance_en: presage: serve as an ominous or intuitive sign of what is to come (doom / change / crisis) · foreshadow: provide subtle narrative or factual clues hinting at future drama (plot / tragedy / event) · portend: indicate imminent trouble, tragedy, or epochal change (disaster / collapse / doom) · herald: loudly announce or mark the arrival of a major new dawn (era / arrival / dawn) · bode: offer a positive or negative omen of future outcome (well / ill / trouble)
groups.nuance_zh: presage: 作为重大危机或剧变的预兆闪现 (doom / change / crisis) · foreshadow: 文学或现实中提供暗示未来悲剧的伏笔 (plot / tragedy / event) · portend: 预示不祥灾难或动荡即将降临 (disaster / collapse / doom) · herald: 昭示并宣布一个新时代或重大突破的开启 (era / arrival / dawn) · bode: 预兆未来的吉凶（常与well/ill搭配） (well / ill / trouble)

groups.name: Regret & Repent · 懊悔与悔改 (Sorrow and Contrition Over Past Acts)
groups.tip: 对往事深感悔恨并悔改过错

items.def_en: to feel sad, repentant, or disappointed over something done or omitted
items.ex_en: He soon came to regret his rash decision to abandon his college education.
items.ex_zh: 他很快便对自己放弃大学学业的草率决定感到后悔。

items.def_en: (+ over/for sth) Be annoyed with oneself for doing something foolish or missing an opportunity
items.ex_en: She was kicking herself for forgetting her passport on such an important morning.
items.ex_zh: 在如此重要的早晨竟然忘了带护照，她感到懊恼不已。

items.def_en: [I/T] to express passionate sorrow or regret for something
items.ex_en: Villagers gathered to lament the senseless destruction of their centuries-old communal forest.
items.ex_zh: 村民们聚集在一起，痛惜他们数百年历史的公有森林遭受无端破坏。

items.def_en: (formal or literary) To feel deep regret, sorrow, or remorse for something done or allowed to happen.
items.ex_en: The fallen general lived to rue the arrogant choice that doomed his army.
items.ex_zh: 倒台的将军余生都在悔恨那个断送了全军命运的傲慢抉择。

items.def_en: to express deep grief or disapproval about something
items.ex_en: The elder citizens bemoaned the rapid loss of their town's unique cultural heritage.
items.ex_zh: 年长市民们深切悲叹他们小镇独特的文化遗产正在迅速流失。

items.def_en: (+ over/about sth) Blame or criticize oneself excessively with lingering regret or guilt
items.ex_en: Stop beating yourself up over a minor mistake that anyone could have made.
items.ex_zh: 别再为任何人都可能犯的微小失误而过度自责了。

items.def_en: (+ of) To feel sincere sorrow, regret, or remorse for past sins or wrongdoings and resolve to change.
items.ex_en: The broken criminal resolved to repent of his cruel deeds through lifelong service.
items.ex_zh: 心碎的罪犯决意通过一生的奉献来忏悔自己的残忍罪行。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the painful recognition and distress experienced concerning past actions, errors, or sins. They scale from personal dissatisfaction ('regret'), to bitter sorrow ('rue'), up to morally transformative remorse ('repent').
groups.summary_zh: 表达因自身错误或罪过所生的悲叹、痛悔与悔改。
groups.desc_en: Experiencing sharp internal anguish, contrition, or moral self-reproach over a past deed or missed chance, differing from generic sadness by its backward-looking culpability.
groups.desc_zh: 因自身既往行为、决策失误或错失良机而陷入内疚、自责与痛心，与一般性悲伤相比，强调对过往过失的主观归责与道德煎熬。
groups.nuance_en: regret: feel disappointed wishing one had acted differently (decision / actions / words) · rue: bitterly and sorrowfully regret a disastrous blunder (day / choice / mistake) · lament: mournfully express deep sorrow or grievance over a loss (fate / loss / state) · repent: undergo profound moral remorse and reform one's ways (sins / deeds / past) · bemoan: express vocal dissatisfaction and sorrow over an unfortunate reality (loss / fate / decline)
groups.nuance_zh: regret: 遗憾于当初未作更好选择或感到抱歉 (decision / actions / words) · rue: 饱含痛楚地懊悔铸成大错（常作rue the day） (day / choice / mistake) · lament: 对无可挽回的损失或不幸深切哀叹 (fate / loss / state) · repent: 彻底痛改前非，在道德或宗教层面悔罪 (sins / deeds / past) · bemoan: 对不幸现状或衰退怨叹不已 (loss / fate / decline)

groups.name: Renounce Under Oath · 誓弃与发誓放弃 (Forswear, Abjure, Recant)
groups.tip: 公开发誓放弃权利或信仰

items.def_zh: 正式放弃；公开放弃（声明、权利）
items.def_en: to state publicly that you no longer have a particular belief, claim, or connection
items.ex_en: The candidate felt compelled to renounce all ties with the controversial lobbying group.
items.ex_zh: 该候选人觉得不得不公开发表声明，放弃与该争议说客团体的一切关联。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Formally admit that what one said was wrong or untrue and retract it
items.ex_en: The minister was forced to take back his inflammatory accusations against the press.
items.ex_zh: 部长被迫收回了他针对新闻界的煽动性指控。

items.def_zh: 收回（先前的言论或主张）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Retreat from, retract, or formally qualify a previous statement, claim, or promise
items.ex_en: The spokesperson attempted to walk back the senator's controversial comments about trade tariffs.
items.ex_zh: 发言人试图收回并修正参议员此前关于贸易关税的争议言论。

items.def_en: to say formally that you are not responsible for or no longer support an association or act
items.ex_en: The company leaders moved swiftly to disavow the rogue employee's unauthorized political campaign.
items.ex_zh: 公司领导层迅速采取行动，公开否认与该违规员工的未经授权政治活动有任何关联。

items.def_zh: 撤回；公开放弃（原先信仰或供词）
items.def_en: [I/T] to state publicly that your past opinions, statements, or heresy were wrong
items.ex_en: Under intense threat from inquisitors, the philosopher refused to recant his scientific theories.
items.ex_zh: 在宗教裁判所的严酷威胁下，这位哲学家依然拒绝撤回他的科学理论。

items.raw_cluster: 放弃与声明放弃 Renounce & Relinquish
items.def_zh: 公开发誓放弃，发誓戒除（信仰、观点、习惯等）
items.def_en: To solemnly and publicly renounce or give up a belief, claim, or course of action.
items.ex_en: The reformed knight swore to abjure worldly violence and embrace a monastic life.
items.ex_zh: 改过自新的骑士起誓公开发誓戒绝凡尘杀戮，皈依隐修生活。

items.raw_cluster: 放弃与声明放弃 Renounce & Relinquish
items.def_zh: 发誓放弃，发誓戒绝；作伪证，发伪誓
items.def_en: 1. To make a serious decision or promise to give up something (such as a bad habit, belief, or activity). 2. (forswear oneself) To commit perjury or swear falsely.
items.ex_en: In sorrowful prayer, the wanderer pledged to forswear alcohol and deceit forever.
items.ex_zh: 在悲切的祈祷中，流浪者发誓从此戒绝杯中之物与欺诈恶行。

groups.summary_en: A person formally, publically, and solemnly disavows, retracts, or promises under oath to give up a belief, allegiance, or illicit claim. Verbs range from general solemn renunciation to courtroom/doctrinal retraction.
groups.summary_zh: 庄严宣誓放弃、收回原有的信仰、效忠誓约或主张。
groups.desc_en: Formally, publicly, or under solemn oath disavowing previously held beliefs, allegiances, or vows, contrasting with casual retraction by its juridical or theological finality.
groups.desc_zh: 公开、正式或立誓放弃、撤回此前持有的信仰、誓言、主张或忠诚，与随意的改口相比，强调具有法律或宗教层面的彻底决裂。
groups.nuance_en: abjure: solemnly renounce under oath a belief, cause, or citizenship (citizenship / heresy / claim) · recant: publicly withdraw a previously stated doctrine, confession, or opinion (testimony / statement / heresy) · renounce: formally give up a legal title, claim, or way of life (citizenship / title / violence) · forswear: swear solemnly to abandon or abstain from something (luxury / allegiance / habits) · disavow: deny any personal association with or responsibility for an act (statement / connection / actions)
groups.nuance_zh: abjure: 在法庭或誓言下郑重弃绝异端信仰或国籍 (citizenship / heresy / claim) · recant: 公开收回或推翻此前的证词、异端观点 (testimony / statement / heresy) · renounce: 正式声明放弃名衔、法定继承权或暴力手段 (citizenship / title / violence) · forswear: 起誓断绝某种不良嗜好、誓弃旧忠诚 (luxury / allegiance / habits) · disavow: 矢口否认与某人、言论或行动有任何瓜葛 (statement / connection / actions)

groups.name: Repatriate & Ecclesiastically Exclude · 遣返归国与绝罚出教 (Repatriate, Extradite, Excommunicate)
groups.tip: 驱逐出教门或引渡遣返出境

items.def_en: to formally remove a religious minister or priest from professional standing due to misconduct
items.ex_en: The ecclesiastical court moved decisively to defrock the priest after his moral crimes.
items.ex_zh: 在神父道德犯罪之后，教会法庭果断采取行动革除了他的神职。

items.def_en: to officially deprive a priest or clergyman of ecclesiastical status and authority
items.ex_en: The disciplinary council resolved to unfrock the rebellious bishop following multiple public heresies.
items.ex_zh: 在多次公然发表异端言论后，纪律委员会决定剥夺该叛逆主教的神职。

items.def_en: (+ sb) Forcefully expel or banish someone from a community, group, or religious body
items.ex_en: The fanatical council voted to cast out the dissenter from their sacred brotherhood.
items.ex_zh: 狂热的议事会投票决定将这名持异见者逐出他们神圣的兄弟会。

items.def_en: (+ sb) Force someone to return to their country or territory of origin
items.ex_en: Immigration border authorities decided to send back the migrants who lacked valid documentation.
items.ex_zh: 边境移民当局决定遣返那些缺乏有效证件的移民。

items.def_en: to hand over a person accused or convicted of a crime to the jurisdiction of the foreign state where the crime was committed
items.ex_en: The foreign ministry agreed to extradite the fugitive fraudster to face international trial.
items.ex_zh: 外交部同意引渡这名在逃诈骗犯以接受国际法庭的审判。

items.def_en: 1. To send someone (such as a refugee or prisoner of war) back to their own country.
items.ex_en: The Red Cross worked tirelessly to repatriate hundreds of displaced refugees after war.
items.ex_zh: 战后，红十字会不知疲倦地工作，以遣返数百名流离失所的难民。

items.def_en: 1. To officially exclude someone from participation in the sacraments and services of a church.
items.ex_en: The papal decree threatened to excommunicate any nobleman who defied the crown's authority.
items.ex_zh: 教皇法令威胁要开除任何公然违抗王权权威的贵族的教籍。

groups.summary_en: Institutions process individuals out of their current legal or spiritual jurisdiction, either sending them back to their sovereign state of origin or casting them entirely out of the religious community. 'Repatriate' centers on return to one's native state, whereas 'excommunicate' cuts off communion and membership.
groups.summary_zh: 公权力将人遣送回母国，或宗教机构剥夺教籍彻底革除出教。
groups.desc_en: Severing legal, civil, or spiritual membership by expelling an individual back to their country of origin or casting them out of a religious communion, distinct from general banishment by its strict jurisdiction.
groups.desc_zh: 通过移送归国或驱逐出宗教公社，强制剥夺某人在特定社群内的合法席位或精神圣职，与一般的放逐相比，依凭严密的管辖权程序。
groups.nuance_en: repatriate: return an individual or cultural artifact to their home country (refugees / prisoners / artifacts) · extradite: legally hand over an accused criminal to the jurisdiction of another state (fugitive / suspect / criminal) · excommunicate: officially cut someone off from the sacraments of a religious communion (heretic / sinner / member) · defrock: strip an ordained priest or minister of clerical status (priest / minister / bishop) · cast out: forcefully expel someone from a community or family (pariah / stranger / rebel)
groups.nuance_zh: repatriate: 将难民、战俘或文物遣返引渡回祖国 (refugees / prisoners / artifacts) · extradite: 依法将逃犯或嫌疑人引渡移交管辖国 (fugitive / suspect / criminal) · excommunicate: 宗教绝罚，正式开除教籍并剥夺圣事特权 (heretic / sinner / member) · defrock: 剥夺违纪神职人员的教士资格（削职） (priest / minister / bishop) · cast out: 将异类或叛徒强行逐出宗族或群体 (pariah / stranger / rebel)

groups.name: Reset to Baseline & Normalize · 恢复基准与重置常规 (Reset, Normalize, Reboot)
groups.tip: 重归常态或标准状态

items.def_en: to regain or return to an internal state of chemical, physical, or systematic equilibrium
items.ex_en: The disturbed chemical solution takes several hours to re-equilibrate at room temperature.
items.ex_zh: 受到扰动的化学溶液在室温下需要数小时才能重获平衡。
items.ex2_en: The researcher must re-equilibrate the sample before proceeding with the sensitive optical measurements.
items.ex2_zh: 研究人员在进行精密的激光光学测量之前，必须让样品重新达到平衡。

items.def_en: Return to a calm, stable, or normal state after a period of disturbance or excitement
items.ex_en: Once the chaotic crowd leaves, the town should settle down to normal life.
items.ex_zh: 一旦混乱的人群散去，小镇的生活就应该恢复常态。
items.ex2_en: The nursery teacher finally settled the excited children down for their afternoon nap.
items.ex2_zh: 幼儿园老师终于让兴奋的孩子们安静下来睡午觉。

items.def_en: Stop fluctuating, rising, or falling and stabilize at a steady normal baseline
items.ex_en: Economists predict that spiraling inflation rates will finally level off by next quarter.
items.ex_zh: 经济学家预测，不断攀升的通胀率终于将在下个季度趋于平稳。

items.def_en: to set an instrument, system, or setting back to zero or an initial default state
items.ex_en: Press this tiny black button firmly to reset the digital gauge to zero.
items.ex_zh: 用力按住这个黑色小按钮，即可将数字测量仪重置为零。

items.def_en: to become or make something firmly established and unlikely to fluctuate wildly
items.ex_en: The patient's vital signs began to stabilize after emergency doctors administered the antidote.
items.ex_zh: 在急诊医生注射了解毒剂后，患者的生命体征开始平稳下来。
items.ex2_en: The central bank took bold measures to stabilize the fluctuating national currency value.
items.ex2_zh: 中央银行采取果断措施来稳定波动剧烈的国家货币汇率。

items.def_zh: 重新启动（计算机）；重新开创，使复兴
items.def_en: 1. (computing) To shut down and restart a computer system or device. 2. To revive and relaunch a film series, brand, or project.
items.ex_en: A sudden bolt of inspiration seemed to reboot his weary, exhausted creative spirit.
items.ex_zh: 一道突如其来的灵感之光，似乎彻底唤醒了他疲惫衰竭的创作灵魂。
items.ex2_en: The outdated server will reboot automatically every night at three in the morning.
items.ex2_zh: 这台老旧的服务器每晚凌晨三点都会自动重启。

items.raw_cluster: 恢复与正常化 Restore & Normalize
items.def_zh: （使）恢复正常，（使）正常化；（使）标准化
items.def_en: To return to a normal, usual, or standard condition, or to make something do this.
items.ex_en: Diplomats hope to normalize bilateral relations after decades of bitter political estrangement.
items.ex_zh: 外交官们希望在经历了数十年的痛苦政治疏远后，使双边关系恢复正常。
items.ex2_en: Blood pressure usually normalizes after the patient rests quietly for several uninterrupted minutes.
items.ex2_zh: 病人在安静休息几分钟后，血压通常会恢复正常。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe returning a disturbed system, technical device, physiological state, or social relation to its baseline default, stable operating equilibrium, or accepted normal bounds.
groups.summary_zh: 指系统、机器、生理或关系自失常回归标准基准与常态运转。
groups.desc_en: Restoring an agitated, fluctuating, or interrupted system back to its steady operational baseline or equilibrium, contrasting with original creation by its restorative reset mechanism.
groups.desc_zh: 将处于剧烈波动、混乱或中断状态的系统恢复至基准运转状态或动态平衡，与原始创立不同，强调修正偏差、重开基线的恢复机制。
groups.nuance_en: reset: restore an instrument, device, or counter to zero or baseline (counter / password / clock) · normalize: bring erratic conditions back to an ordinary, accepted standard (relations / blood pressure / ties) · stabilize: halt dangerous volatility and secure steady balance (patient / economy / prices) · level off: flatten after a sharp rise or fall to a steady trajectory (growth / altitude / prices) · reboot: shut down completely and restart an entire system afresh (economy / career / computer)
groups.nuance_zh: reset: 将仪器、状态或参数归零或重置至基线 (counter / password / clock) · normalize: 使反常失调的局势回归公认常态 (relations / blood pressure / ties) · stabilize: 止住剧烈动荡，使经济或生命体征平稳 (patient / economy / prices) · level off: 在急剧升降后转入平稳走势 (growth / altitude / prices) · reboot: 彻底关停并重新启动一整套体系 (economy / career / computer)

groups.name: Restoring to Fullness · 补满与补充 (Refill, Replenish, Top up)
groups.tip: 往空缺处注满，使其不再匮乏

items.def_en: to add a small amount of liquid or fuel to an already partially full container to make it completely full
items.ex_en: The attentive waiter arrived promptly to top up her nearly drained wine glass.
items.ex_zh: 贴心的侍应生随即上前，把她快见底的酒杯重新倒满。

items.def_zh: 再注满，重新装满；续杯；再配（药）
items.def_en: To fill a container again after it has been emptied, or to replenish a medical prescription.
items.ex_en: Could you please refill my reusable water bottle before we start the hike?
items.ex_zh: 在我们开始徒步之前，能帮我把可重复使用的水瓶重新装满吗？
items.ex2_en: The groundwater reservoir refills rapidly whenever heavy seasonal monsoon rains soak the earth.
items.ex2_zh: 每当季节性季风暴雨浸透大地，地下水库就会迅速重新蓄满水。

items.def_en: (+ with) to fill up a store, pantry, or inventory with fresh supplies after depletion
items.ex_en: Workers labored overnight to restock the empty supermarket shelves with fresh winter produce.
items.ex_zh: 工人们连夜劳作，用新鲜的冬季农产品重新补足空荡的超市货架。
items.ex2_en: The pond naturally restocks with small native fish after every major seasonal flood.
items.ex2_zh: 每次季节性大洪水过后，池塘里自然又重新蓄满了当地的小鱼。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Make a depleted container completely full, or become completely full
items.ex_en: Remember to fill up the car with diesel before setting out tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 明天早晨出发前，记得给车子加满柴油。
items.ex2_en: The small underground theater filled up rapidly before the famous comedian took stage.
items.ex2_zh: 在著名喜剧演员登台之前，小小的地下剧场迅速坐满了人。

items.def_en: (+ on sth) Buy or collect a large supply of resources, goods, or provisions to replenish stores
items.ex_en: We should stock up on bottled water and canned food before the blizzard hits.
items.ex_zh: 暴风雪来临之前，我们应该多囤些瓶装水和罐头食品。

items.def_en: to restore electric charge or revitalize depleted physical strength and inner resources
items.ex_en: A quiet weekend in the mountains allowed the exhausted doctor to recharge completely.
items.ex_zh: 在山里度过一个宁静的周末，让精疲力竭的医生彻底恢复了精力。

items.def_zh: 补充，重新装满，补足（资源、能量等）
items.def_en: To restore a supply of something to its former level, or to fill something up again.
items.ex_en: The forest rangers worked tirelessly to replenish the depleted water reserves after the drought.
items.ex_zh: 旱灾过后，森林巡护员不知疲倦地工作，以补足消耗殆尽的蓄水储备。

groups.summary_en: An agent fills a depleted container, resource, or reserve back to its original or necessary level. The verbs contrast along lines of physical containers (cups, tanks) versus abstract or collective assets (stocks, energy, depleted reserves).
groups.summary_zh: 将已经消耗或耗空的容器、库存及体能重新补足至充盈状态。
groups.desc_en: Denotes returning an empty or depleted container, store, or reserve to its original full capacity, differing from general 'filling' by presupposing a prior loss or consumption.
groups.desc_zh: 指将已排空或耗竭的容器、储备恢复至原本饱满充盈的状态，与一般的'填充/装满'相比，预设了先前存在消耗或减损。
groups.nuance_en: refill: physically fill a container again (cup / prescription / bottle) · replenish: restock depleted supplies or vital resources to maintain equilibrium (supplies / energy / stocks) · top up: add a small amount to reach maximum capacity or balance (glass / mobile credit / fund) · restock: replenish retail goods or inventory (shelves / inventory / warehouse) · stock up: accumulate large reserves in anticipation of need (supplies / groceries / fuel)
groups.nuance_zh: refill: 再次注满实体容器 (cup / prescription / bottle) · replenish: 补充耗尽的物资或维持机能的资源以恢复平衡 (supplies / energy / stocks) · top up: 添满差额以达上限或补足余额 (glass / mobile credit / fund) · restock: 重新为货架或仓库补齐库存 (shelves / inventory / warehouse) · stock up: 提前大量采购储备以备后用 (supplies / groceries / fuel)

groups.name: Retard & Prolong · 延缓与拖长 (Retard, Prolong, Drag out)
groups.tip: 人为放缓节奏或延长历程时间

items.def_en: to prolong or extend the duration of an activity or discussion
items.ex_en: The defense attorney tried to draw out the cross-examination until the court adjourned.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师试图拖长交叉质询的时间，直到法庭休庭。

items.def_en: to make an event, speech, or process continue for longer than is necessary or pleasant
items.ex_en: There is no need to drag out the dispute any longer.
items.ex_zh: 没有必要再故意拖延这场争端了。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Delay the progress or movement of someone or something
items.ex_en: An unexpected track malfunction held up hundreds of morning commuters for over two hours.
items.ex_zh: 一场突发的轨道故障让数百名早晨通勤的乘客耽搁了两个多小时。

items.def_en: to intentionally make something last as long as possible by working slowly
items.ex_en: The car hit a patch of black ice and spun out into the ditch.
items.ex_zh: 汽车碾过一块暗冰，失控打转滑进了路沟。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Cause an event, activity, or series of actions to last longer than necessary
items.ex_en: The committee managed to string out the budget debate for another three grueling weeks.
items.ex_zh: 委员会设法将预算辩论又拖延了折磨人的整整三周。

items.def_en: To make an activity, state, or process last longer in time.
items.ex_en: Unnecessary procedural disputes will only prolong the suffering of the displaced families.
items.ex_zh: 无休止的程序性争议只会延长这些流离失所家庭的痛苦。

items.def_en: (formal) To slow down the development, progress, or growth of something; to delay.
items.ex_en: Severe lack of natural sunlight can severely retard the growth of these delicate seedlings.
items.ex_zh: 严重缺乏自然光照会极大地阻碍这些娇嫩幼苗的生长。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote slowing down progress or causing a process, duration, or state of affairs to continue far longer than desirable.
groups.summary_zh: 强调阻碍进程、减缓发生速度或不必要地拖长时限。
groups.desc_en: Denotes artificially or undesirably extending the temporal duration of an event, differing from neutral 'delaying' by emphasizing tedious elongation or deceleration of momentum.
groups.desc_zh: 指人为或反常地拉长事件的持续时间，与中性的'推迟/延误'相比，强调拖沓冗长或阻滞原有进度。
groups.nuance_en: prolong: lengthen existence or continuation beyond the normal span (life / agony / negotiations) · drag out: protract tediously or unnecessarily (meeting / legal battle / process) · draw out: extend duration through sustained elicitation or hesitation (discussion / agony / interview) · spin out: deliberately stretch time to make something last (story / funds / speech) · retard: slow down the natural rate of progress or development (growth / recovery / development)
groups.nuance_zh: prolong: 超出正常期限延长存在或持续状态 (life / agony / negotiations) · drag out: 拖泥带水地不必要拖长 (meeting / legal battle / process) · draw out: 通过持续引导或迟疑而拉长过程 (discussion / agony / interview) · spin out: 刻意拖延时间以维持存续 (story / funds / speech) · retard: 阻碍或减缓自然生长与发展进程 (growth / recovery / development)

groups.name: Retell & Narrate · 复述与转述 (Narrate, Relate, Retell)
groups.tip: 条理清晰重述往事，绘声绘色讲述故事

items.def_en: (+ sth) Read written notes or a recorded statement aloud to check accuracy or narrate events
items.ex_en: The operator asked me to read back the security code to make sure it was correct.
items.ex_zh: 接线员让我复诵一遍安全验证码，以确认无误。

items.def_en: [I/T] to tell a story or describe a series of events in speech or writing
items.ex_en: The veteran journalist agreed to narrate the harrowing events of the wartime evacuation.
items.ex_zh: 这位资深记者同意详细叙述那场战时撤离的惨痛经历。

items.def_zh: 复述，重述；重新讲述（故事等）
items.def_en: To tell a story or account again, often in a different way or form.
items.ex_en: Grandmother loved to retell ancient village folklore to the children around the warm fireplace.
items.ex_zh: 祖母喜欢在温暖的壁炉旁向孩子们重新讲述古老的乡村民间传说。

items.def_zh: 滔滔不绝地背诵，一气呵成地讲出
items.def_en: (+ sth) Recite or narrate a story, sequence of facts, or list rapidly and effortlessly from memory
