items.ex_en: The bright pupil could reel off every European capital city without a single pause.
items.ex_zh: 那个聪明的学生能一口气报出欧洲所有国家的首都，中间毫无停顿。

items.def_en: (formal) to give a spoken or written report of an event, experience, or fact
items.ex_en: The rescued sailor calmly began to relate the harrowing sequence of events at sea.
items.ex_zh: 获救的水手平静地开始讲述海上发生的惊心动魄的一幕幕经历。

items.def_en: to repeat a statement, opinion, or message in order to emphasize it
items.ex_en: The spokesperson took care to reiterate that foreign policy priorities had not shifted.
items.ex_zh: 发言人特意重申，对外政策的优先考量并未发生任何转变。

items.def_zh: 复述，重述（retell的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of retell; narrated or told again.
items.ex_en: Generation after generation, the legendary founding myth was retold with enduring reverence.
items.ex_zh: 代代相传间，这则传奇的建国神话始终怀着恒久的敬意被反复传诵。

groups.summary_en: This storytelling frame centers on relating or repeating a narrative tale, personal story, or event sequence to an audience. 'Retell' explicitly emphasizes re-presenting an existing story from a new perspective or in another form, whereas 'narrate' and 'relate' describe continuous oral or written storytelling.
groups.summary_zh: 以口头或书面形式，将已有故事或经历按情节脉络重新讲述或转述。
groups.desc_en: Denotes recounting, repeating, or communicating an already existing sequence of events or speech, differing from original 'speaking' by serving as an interpretive or faithful transfer of prior knowledge.
groups.desc_zh: 指对已有事件序列或言论进行复现、重述或口头传递，与原发性的'讲述/说话'相比，强调作为既有信息的转述或再加工。
groups.nuance_en: retell: tell a story or account again, often with varied wording or style (tale / myth / history) · narrate: systematically recount a sequence of events, often in formal or voiceover commentary (documentary / story / events) · relate: report personal experiences or facts to an audience (incident / anecdote / details) · reel off: recite rapidly and effortlessly from memory (names / facts / statistics) · reiterate: restate a point emphatically for clarity or insistence (plea / warning / support)
groups.nuance_zh: retell: 用不同措辞或形式重新讲故事 (tale / myth / history) · narrate: 系统性、旁白式地叙述连贯事件 (documentary / story / events) · relate: 向听众转述亲历事实或见闻 (incident / anecdote / details) · reel off: 不假思索地快速背诵列举 (names / facts / statistics) · reiterate: 为强调或重申而再次重复要点 (plea / warning / support)

groups.name: Reverential Kneeling & Prostrating · 屈膝下跪与跪拜 (Kneel, Prostrate, Kowtow)
groups.tip: 女子屈膝行屈膝礼致意

items.def_en: to fall or rest on the knees
items.ex_en: Pilgrims would kneel on the cold stone floor to whisper their quiet prayers.
items.ex_zh: 朝圣者们跪在冰冷的石板地上，低声诉说着他们的祈祷。

items.def_en: (+ to) To bend the knees slightly with one foot behind the other as a formal gesture of respect, traditionally done by women and girls.
items.ex_en: The young ballerina paused to curtsy gracefully to the visiting members of royalty.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的芭蕾舞演员停下脚步，优雅地向来访的王室成员行屈膝礼。

items.def_zh: 单膝下跪（行敬礼）；跪拜，屈从
items.def_en: 1. (+ before/to) To bend one knee to the ground briefly in worship or respect, especially in a church. 2. To show servile obedience or excessive deference to someone or something.
items.ex_en: Devout worshippers routinely genuflect before the ornate golden altar upon entering the sanctuary.
items.ex_zh: 虔诚的信徒步入圣所时，照例在华丽的金祭坛前单膝下跪敬拜。

items.def_en: (+ before/to sb) Kneel or bend one's body deeply toward the ground to show reverent submission or worship
items.ex_en: The vanquished warriors were forced to bow down before the ruthless foreign emperor.
items.ex_zh: 战败的勇士们被迫在残暴的异邦皇帝面前屈膝伏拜。

items.def_en: (+ before sb/sth) Drop to the ground or prostrate oneself before someone in reverence or supplication
items.ex_en: Terrified villagers would fall down before the colossal idol to implore for mercy.
items.ex_zh: 惊恐的村民俯伏在巨大的神像前，乞求宽恕与垂怜。

items.def_en: (+ to) to kneel and touch the forehead to the ground in homage
items.ex_en: The imperial subjects were summoned to kowtow before the celestial throne in silence.
items.ex_zh: 帝国臣民奉召在皇座前肃穆磕头跪拜。

items.def_en: to cast oneself face down on the ground in total submission or worship
items.ex_en: The penitent hermit chose to prostrate on the bare earth throughout the night.
items.ex_zh: 忏悔的隐士选择彻夜五体投地伏在光秃的泥地上。

groups.summary_en: Agents drop down onto one or both knees or cast their full body to the floor as an act of formal reverence, submission, penitence, or supplication.
groups.summary_zh: 指因敬意、服从或祈愿而弯膝下跪或全身伏地。
groups.desc_en: Denotes lowering one's bodily posture toward the ground to signal submission, veneration, or penitence, differing from casual 'bending' by its ritualized, hierarchical, or devotional intent.
groups.desc_zh: 指将身体重心放低乃至贴近地面以示屈从、崇敬或忏悔，与随意的'弯腰/下蹲'相比，具有高度仪式化与等级崇奉意味。
groups.nuance_en: kneel: rest on one or both knees in prayer, reverence, or surrender (prayer / submission / altar) · prostrate: cast oneself flat on the ground in extreme humility or adoration (ground / altar / dust) · kowtow: touch the forehead to the ground in servile submission or obsequiousness (emperor / authority / pressure) · genuflect: briefly bend one knee to the ground as a formal religious or deferential salute (altar / presence / monarch) · curtsy: perform a feminine greeting of deference by bending the knees and dipping the body (queen / audience / dancer)
groups.nuance_zh: kneel: 单膝或双膝着地以示祈祷、敬畏或臣服 (prayer / submission / altar) · prostrate: 俯伏平趴于地以示极致谦卑或崇拜 (ground / altar / dust) · kowtow: 跪下叩头，引申为奴颜婢膝地顺从 (emperor / authority / pressure) · genuflect: 屈单膝并迅速起身的宗教敬礼或致敬 (altar / presence / monarch) · curtsy: 女士屈膝微倾的下蹲行礼 (queen / audience / dancer)

groups.name: Ride as Passenger or Mount · 骑乘与乘车搭行 (Ride)
groups.tip: 骑车或乘坐载具

items.def_zh: 骑（马、自行车等）；乘，坐（车辆等）；取决于
items.def_en: 1. to sit on and control the movements of a horse, bicycle, or motorcycle. 2. to travel in or on a vehicle. 3. (ride on) to depend or hang on something.
items.ex_en: Most students prefer to ride their bicycles across campus during the sunny autumn months.
items.ex_zh: 在阳光明媚的秋季月份里，大多数学生更喜欢骑自行车穿行校园。

items.def_en: to share a car journey with others when travelling to work or school
items.ex_en: Several suburban colleagues decided to carpool together to reduce parking fees and emissions.
items.ex_zh: 几位住在郊区的同事决定拼车通勤，以减少停车费和碳排放。

items.def_en: (+ sth) board or mount a vehicle, bicycle, or transit system as a rider
items.ex_en: Just hop on the downtown shuttle outside the terminal to reach the hotel.
items.ex_zh: 直接在航站楼外跳上市中心穿梭巴士，就能到达酒店。

items.def_zh: 坐上，登上（公交车、火车等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) board a train, bus, ship, or bicycle to ride as a passenger
items.ex_en: Commuters queued patiently to get on the electric bus during the rainy evening.
items.ex_zh: 在阴雨连绵的傍晚，通勤者们耐心地排队登上电动公交车。

items.def_en: travel as a passenger in a vehicle alongside another person
items.ex_en: The rookie detective was permitted to ride along with the senior patrol officer.
items.ex_zh: 这名新手刑警获准随资深巡警乘车同行出警。

items.def_en: to travel regularly between home and work via vehicle, train, or bus
items.ex_en: Thousands of white-collar professionals commute by high-speed rail between the two major cities.
items.ex_zh: 数以千计的白领专业人士每天乘高铁往返于这两座大城市之间通勤。

items.def_en: [I/T] to board or cause people to board a railway train for transit
items.ex_en: The somber troops were ordered to entrain at midnight under dense fog cover.
items.ex_zh: 神情凝重的部队奉命在午夜浓雾的掩护下登上列车开拔。
items.ex2_en: The officers entrained the tired soldiers into passenger carriages before the midnight departure.
items.ex2_zh: 军官们在午夜发车前让疲惫的士兵们登上了客运车厢。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this core frame represent the foundational activity of travelling as a passenger in a vehicle, or being carried along while mounted on an animal, bicycle, or transit system.
groups.summary_zh: 指骑马、骑车或作为乘客乘坐公共交通及车辆的基本出行场景。
groups.desc_en: Denotes traveling by being borne along upon an animal or inside a mechanized conveyance, differing from active 'walking' or 'driving' by highlighting passive transport or shared transit.
groups.desc_zh: 指骑跨在动物背上或置身于交通工具内由其承载移动，与自主的'行走'或'操纵驾驶'相比，侧重客体搭乘或顺路通行的属性。
groups.nuance_en: ride: be carried on an animal, bicycle, or transit vehicle (horse / bus / train) · commute: travel regular distances back and forth between home and work (subway / miles / daily) · carpool: share vehicular travel with others to reduce costs or congestion (commute / coworkers / school) · hop on: board a moving or departing vehicle quickly and informally (bus / train / bike) · entrain: formally board a railway train (troops / passengers / detachment)
groups.nuance_zh: ride: 骑乘牲畜、自行车或乘坐交通工具 (horse / bus / train) · commute: 定期往返于居住地与工作地之间通勤 (subway / miles / daily) · carpool: 与他人拼车合乘 (commute / coworkers / school) · hop on: 随意或迅速地跳上车 (bus / train / bike) · entrain: 正式列队或统一登上火车 (troops / passengers / detachment)

groups.name: Rope & Technical Descent · 绳索速降与控速垂落 (Abseil, Rappel, Belay)
groups.tip: 自上而下位移下落

items.def_zh: 沿绳垂降；下降到下方高度
items.def_en: descend deliberately to a lower level along a rope or vertical drop
items.ex_en: The lead rescuer prepared to drop down into the narrow crevasse using anchors.
items.ex_zh: 救援队长准备利用固定锚点顺绳垂降至狭窄的冰裂缝深处。

items.def_zh: 下降，走下，垂落；降临，侵袭；世代相传；屈尊
items.def_en: 1. to move or go down from a higher position to a lower one. 2. (descend on/upon) to arrive suddenly or attack in large numbers. 3. to pass down by inheritance or descent. 4. to lower oneself to an inferior or unethical standard.
items.ex_en: The climbers commenced to descend the hazardous north face before twilight arrived.
items.ex_zh: 登山者赶在暮色降临之前，开始从险峻的北坡向下攀降。

items.def_zh: 系牢；为…打保护（用保护绳控降）
items.def_en: to secure a climber or lower them steadily with a running rope through a friction device
items.ex_en: The experienced mountaineer leaned backward to belay his exhausted partner down the overhang.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的登山家向后倾斜身子，打保护控降疲惫的同伴越过悬壁。

items.def_zh: 用保护绳固定；从绳索保护点下降脱离
items.def_en: secure or control descent using a belay system on a rope
items.ex_en: Once reaching the safety anchor, she took great care to belay off securely.
items.ex_zh: 一抵达安全固定点，她便格外小心地解除保护绳系统脱离。

items.def_en: to make a descent down a cliff or drop using a rope
items.ex_en: The team decided to rope down the limestone cliff rather than hike around.
items.ex_zh: 队员们决定顺绳滑下石灰岩悬崖，而不是绕远路徒步走过去。

items.def_zh: 用绳索沿陡壁下滑；速降
items.def_en: [I/T] to descend a steep rock face or structure using a doubled rope and friction device
items.ex_en: Special tactical officers had to rappel swiftly from the hovering helicopter onto the rooftop.
items.ex_zh: 特警队员不得不迅速从盘旋的直升机上索降至屋顶。

items.def_en: (chiefly BrE) to descend a steep cliff or vertical drop using a rope coiled around the body or attached to a harness.
items.ex_en: Outdoor instructors taught the nervous students how to abseil down the quarry wall.
items.ex_zh: 户外教练向紧张的学生们传授如何沿采石场陡壁绳降。

groups.summary_en: A climber, caver, or tactical operator moves downward a vertical surface or drop using specialized equipment like ropes, harnesses, and friction devices. The verbs describe distinct techniques of controlled, vertical descent.
groups.summary_zh: 使用绳索与制动装备自陡崖或高空受控垂直下降。
groups.desc_en: Denotes utilizing ropes and specialized friction gear to negotiate a controlled vertical descent down a steep incline or cliff, differing from unconstrained 'falling' through mechanical brake control.
groups.desc_zh: 指运用绳索与制动装备沿陡坡或绝壁进行受控的人工竖向降落，与无约束的'下坠'相比，强调机械摩擦控制下的平稳垂降。
groups.nuance_en: rappel: descend a vertical face using friction along a doubled rope (cliff / rock face / helicopter) · abseil: technical mountaineering term for descending via fixed rope control (crevasse / tower / cliff) · belay: secure a climber or descender by controlling rope tension through a braking mechanism (partner / climber / rope) · rope down: descend a steep surface using a rope for hand support or technical friction (slope / ravine / ledge)
groups.nuance_zh: rappel: 利用双绳摩擦控制沿垂直立面垂降 (cliff / rock face / helicopter) · abseil: 登山技术术语，指借由固定绳索控速下降 (crevasse / tower / cliff) · belay: 通过控制绳索张力为攀爬或下降者提供保护制动 (partner / climber / rope) · rope down: 抓绳借力或结绳沿陡峭地形降落 (slope / ravine / ledge)

groups.name: Sacralize & Dedicate · 祝圣与奉献 (Consecrate, Anoint, Hallow)
groups.tip: 举行宗教仪式祝圣为神圣

items.def_en: to invoke divine favor upon or pronounce holy
items.ex_en: The bishop raised his ceremonial cross to bless the solemn assembly of faithful.
items.ex_zh: 主教高举礼仪十字架，为聚集的庄严信众赐福祝圣。

items.def_zh: 将…奉献给神明或神圣事业
items.def_en: (+ to) to solemnly set apart something for sacred or divine honor
items.ex_en: The elders agreed to dedicate the newly erected chapel to the patron saint.
items.ex_zh: 长者们一致同意将新建成的小礼拜堂奉献给守护圣人。

items.def_zh: 授予圣职；立为神职人员
items.def_en: to officially invest someone with ministerial or priestly authority by sacred rite
items.ex_en: The archbishop gathered the clergy to formally ordain three promising theological graduates.
items.ex_zh: 大主教召集教士，正式为三名优秀的神学院毕业生授予圣职。

items.def_zh: 用油涂抹，施涂油礼（以示祝圣）；指定，选定（为接班人等）
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To put oil or water on someone's head or body as part of a religious ceremony to make them holy. 2. To choose someone formally to do a particular important job or to become the successor.
items.ex_en: The high priest prepared fragrant myrrh to anoint the forehead of the monarch.
items.ex_zh: 大祭司备好芳香的没药，准备为君主的额头施涂油礼。

items.def_en: 1. (formal or literary) To make something holy, or to honor and respect something as sacred.
items.ex_en: Generations of quiet contemplation came to hallow the solitary mountain sanctuary forever.
items.ex_zh: 历经数代人静默的默想与沉思，这座孤寂的山间圣地永被尊为神圣。

items.def_zh: 祝圣，奉献给神；献身于，致力（于）
items.def_en: 1. (+ to) To officially state in a religious ceremony that a person, church, or object is holy and dedicated to God. 2. (+ to) (formal) To dedicate your life, time, or energy to a particular purpose.
items.ex_en: The council gathered solemnly to consecrate the newly built cathedral to divine service.
items.ex_zh: 教务会庄严集会，将新建成的大教堂祝圣并奉献于神的侍奉。

items.def_en: to set apart as sacred, cleanse from sin, or impart religious sanction
items.ex_en: Ancient rituals were faithfully performed to sanctify the sacred grove against evil spirits.
items.ex_zh: 古老的仪式被忠实履行，以圣化这片神圣树林并驱除邪灵。

groups.summary_en: Religious or solemn authorities set apart a person, object, or place as sacred through traditional sacramental rites, ritual oil, or dedication to divine service.
groups.summary_zh: 通过宗教仪式、涂油礼或神圣宣告将人、物或场所奉献为圣。
groups.desc_en: Denotes ritually transferring an entity from the profane realm into the sacred or formally setting it apart for higher divine purpose, differing from secular 'assigning' by its religious solemnity.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过宗教仪式将人或物从世俗界划入神圣范畴，或将其彻底奉献给崇高神圣用途，与世俗的'分配/委任'相比具有神圣崇奉性。
groups.nuance_en: consecrate: officially dedicate a person or object to religious service through solemn rite (bishop / ground / church) · sanctify: purify spiritually or render legally or morally sacred (marriage / life / tradition) · anoint: apply consecrated oil ritually to consecrate or bestow divine authority (king / prophet / head) · hallow: honor, respect, or revere as holy through association with the sacred (memory / ground / name) · ordain: formally invest with ministerial or priestly authority (priest / minister / deacon)
groups.nuance_zh: consecrate: 经由庄严仪式正式祝圣为神职或圣所 (bishop / ground / church) · sanctify: 使在精神上神圣化或赋予道义合法性 (marriage / life / tradition) · anoint: 涂抹圣油以封立君王或赋予神圣权威 (king / prophet / head) · hallow: 因崇高历史或神圣关联而奉为圣洁 (memory / ground / name) · ordain: 举行授圣职礼正式册立教职 (priest / minister / deacon)

groups.name: Satisfy & Gratify Appetite · 饱享与止渴 (Extinguishing Physical Desires)
groups.tip: 满足渴求带来心理慰藉

items.def_zh: 一口喝干；大口饮尽以解渴
items.def_en: (+ sth) consume liquid rapidly to slake intense thirst
items.ex_en: After finishing the marathon, he rushed forward to drink down a whole pitcher.
items.ex_zh: 跑完马拉松后，他猛冲上前，一口气喝干了整整一大壶水。

items.def_en: (+ sb/on sth) sate hunger fully by eating a large quantity of food
items.ex_en: The hikers stopped at the roadside diner to fill up on warm pancakes.
items.ex_zh: 徒步旅行者停在路边小餐馆，吃热煎饼把自己填得饱饱的。
items.ex2_en: The hearty oatmeal porridge will fill up the hungry children until midday lunch.
items.ex2_zh: 丰盛的燕麦粥会让饥饿的孩子们一直饱腹到中午吃午饭。

items.def_en: to satisfy one's thirst by drinking liquid; to extinguish longing
items.ex_en: A sip of chilled spring water helped quench his burning thirst under the sun.
items.ex_zh: 一口冰凉的山泉水帮他解除了烈日下的灼热干渴。

items.def_en: to satisfy an appetite or desire fully, sometimes to the point of dulling interest
items.ex_en: A luxurious seven-course banquet served to satiate the voracious appetites of visiting dignitaries.
items.ex_zh: 一场奢华的七道菜盛宴充分满足了来访贵宾们旺盛的食欲。

items.raw_cluster: 满足与使满意 Satisfy & Content
items.def_zh: 充分满足（欲望或胃口）；使厌腻
items.def_en: To satisfy a desire, appetite, or need fully, often to the point of boredom or disgust.
items.ex_en: No amount of decadent delicacies could ever truly sate his bottomless culinary greed.
items.ex_zh: 再多奢靡精巧的佳肴，也永远无法彻底填满他那无底的口腹贪欲。

items.def_zh: （因过多过甜而）使人生腻；使餍足反胃
items.def_en: to disgust or sicken someone with an excess of sweetness, richness, or gratification
items.ex_en: Rich cream sauces with excessive sugar will cloy the palate after a few mouthfuls.
items.ex_zh: 过甜且浓稠的奶油酱汁只要吃上几口，就会让人满嘴发腻。
items.ex2_en: Excessive compliments and artificial sweetness cloy quickly during an otherwise serious discussion.
items.ex2_zh: 在原本严肃的讨论中，过度的奉承和虚伪的甜言蜜语很快就会令人作呕。

items.def_zh: 解（渴）；满足（欲望、好奇心等）；（用生石灰加水）熟化
items.def_en: 1. (literary) To satisfy a thirst, desire, or curiosity. 2. (chemistry) To combine quicklime with water to produce slaked lime.
items.ex_en: The weary wanderer found a hidden freshwater spring to slake his desperate thirst.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的漫游者找到了一处隐秘的清泉，以解他难耐的焦渴。

groups.summary_en: An agent fully quenches or overfills a visceral appetite, thirst, or desire. 'Slake' canonically attaches to thirst, whereas 'sate' and 'satiate' emphasize filling appetite to full or excessive capacity.
groups.summary_zh: 彻底消除并填满干渴、饥饿或生理欲望，强调需求完全得到平息。
groups.desc_en: Denotes fully quenching or extinguishing a physiological or psychological craving to the point of complete fulfillment or surfeit, differing from partial 'feeding' by the total cessation of desire.
groups.desc_zh: 指彻底平息或满足生理及心理上的饥渴欲望至完全餍足甚至过剩的境地，与普通的'进食/供给'相比，强调欲望被彻底熄灭或达到阈值。
groups.nuance_en: quench: completely extinguish physical thirst or burning desire (thirst / desire / fire) · slake: relieve an intense physical thirst or curiosity through supply (thirst / curiosity / lust) · satiate: satisfy an appetite or desire to the fullest, often risking overindulgence (hunger / appetite / curiosity) · sate: fully indulge a craving to capacity (lust / greed / appetite) · cloy: disgust or sicken by supplying an excess of sweetness, richness, or pleasure (sweetness / sentiments / appetite)
groups.nuance_zh: quench: 彻底消除干渴或炽热渴望 (thirst / desire / fire) · slake: 经由适时给予来平息强烈的渴求或好奇 (thirst / curiosity / lust) · satiate: 充分满足胃口或欲望至完全饱足 (hunger / appetite / curiosity) · sate: 使某种嗜好或贪欲达到饱和极点 (lust / greed / appetite) · cloy: 因过甜、过腻或过分取悦而使人生厌发腻 (sweetness / sentiments / appetite)

groups.name: Sound & Blast Horn · 鸣响与鸣笛按角 (Toot, Honk, Blare)
groups.tip: 喇叭发出刺耳鸣响，发出急促警报声

items.def_en: [I/T] to make a short, relatively high-pitched sound with a vehicle horn
items.ex_en: The impatient cab driver started to beep at the stalled delivery truck ahead.
items.ex_zh: 心急的出租车司机开始冲着前面抛锚的送货卡车按喇叭。
items.ex2_en: The angry truck driver beeped his horn furiously at the jaywalking pedestrian below.
items.ex2_zh: 愤怒的卡车司机冲着下方乱穿马路的行人拼命按喇叭。

items.def_zh: （使）鸣笛，吹奏（喇叭等发出短促声响）
items.def_en: 1. To sound a car horn, whistle, or wind instrument, or to make a short, sharp sound.
items.ex_en: He gave a cheerful toot on his horn as he drove past our driveway.
items.ex_zh: 他开车驶过我们车道时，欢快地按了一声短促的喇叭。
items.ex2_en: The little steam train tooted loudly as it entered the narrow mountain tunnel.
items.ex2_zh: 小蒸汽火车在驶入狭窄的山体隧道时大声鸣笛。

items.def_en: Make a loud, clear acoustic signal using a whistle, horn, or bugle
items.ex_en: The referee raised his metallic whistle to sound off across the crowded sports arena.
items.ex_zh: 裁判举起金属哨子，在拥挤的体育场馆里鸣响示意。

items.def_zh: 按（汽车喇叭），按喇叭示意；（大雁等）鸣叫
items.def_en: 1. To sound a car horn, or to make a car horn sound. 2. (of a goose) To make a loud, harsh cry.
items.ex_en: Drivers trapped in the tunnel began to honk their horns in collective frustration.
items.ex_zh: 被困在隧道里的司机们开始沮丧地齐按喇叭。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Produce a very loud, penetrating sound or signal from a horn, siren, or speaker
items.ex_en: Upbeat music blasted out of the speakers throughout the celebration.
items.ex_zh: 在整场庆典期间，扬声器里一直高分贝地播放着欢快的音乐。

items.def_en: [I/T] to sound a horn, siren, or whistle loudly and forcefully
items.ex_en: The oncoming freight locomotive had to blast its horn to warn the stray cattle.
items.ex_zh: 迎面驶来的货运机车不得不震耳欲聋地长鸣汽笛，警告乱晃的牲畜。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make a loud, harsh, penetrating sound with a horn, siren, or trumpet
items.ex_en: Warning sirens began to blare across the sleepy harbor as storm clouds gathered.
items.ex_zh: 暴风云聚集之际，刺耳的警报长鸣声响彻沉睡的港湾。
items.ex2_en: The teenager blared loud rock music through the thin apartment walls all evening.
items.ex2_zh: 那个少年整晚隔着公寓薄薄的墙壁大声播放嘈杂的摇滚乐。

groups.summary_en: A person produces an acoustic warning or signal by sounding a horn, whistle, or siren, ranging from brief courtesy taps ('toot', 'beep') to jarring, resonant acoustic assaults ('blare', 'blast').
groups.summary_zh: 通过喇叭或警笛发出短促或长鸣的鸣笛警示声响。
groups.desc_en: Denotes producing a loud, sharp, or piercing acoustic signal through an automotive or mechanical horn, differing from natural 'sounding' by its jarring alert or warning function.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过车载或机械喇叭发出高亢、刺耳或响亮的声响，与自然的'发声/鸣响'相比，具有突发的警戒、催促或宣泄特质。
groups.nuance_en: honk: emit a loud, harsh call or blast of a vehicle horn (horn / geese / driver) · blare: sound loudly, harshly, and continuously (siren / horn / music) · blast: sound a horn or siren suddenly and with explosive loudness (horn / whistle / trumpet) · toot: sound a horn in short, cheerful, or gentle bursts (horn / whistle / flute) · beep: produce a short, high-pitched mechanical signal (horn / pager / microwave)
groups.nuance_zh: honk: 粗重按响车载喇叭或大雁引吭 (horn / geese / driver) · blare: 刺耳、高分贝且持续性地鸣叫 (siren / horn / music) · blast: 突然炸裂般大声鸣响汽笛或号角 (horn / whistle / trumpet) · toot: 短促轻柔或欢快地鸣笛 (horn / whistle / flute) · beep: 发出短促清脆的机械提示音 (horn / pager / microwave)

groups.name: Specialized Bodily or Technical Descent · 异常垂坠与悬绳下行 (Prolapse, Rappel, Abseil)
groups.tip: 垂直方向上的升起或下降

items.def_en: Descend, sag, or lower to a lower physiological or physical level
items.ex_en: Overstretched muscle tissues gradually drop down after years of sustained mechanical pressure.
items.ex_zh: 在经历了多年的持续机械压力后，过度拉伸的肌肉组织逐渐下垂。

items.def_en: (medical) to drop or sink abnormal downwards; to undergo ptosis
items.ex_en: In advanced muscular atrophy, the weakened upper eyelid may ptosis over the pupil.
items.ex_zh: 在晚期肌萎缩中，衰弱的上眼睑可能会病理性下垂并遮盖瞳孔。

items.def_en: to sink to a lower level or fall downward smoothly and steadily
items.ex_en: Structural engineers observed the foundation subside nearly two centimeters into the soft mud.
items.ex_zh: 结构工程师观察到地基在软泥中平缓地下沉了将近两厘米。

items.def_en: Descend a steep cliff face or vertical surface using ropes (rappel)
items.ex_en: The geological survey crew had to rope down into the steep volcanic crater.
items.ex_zh: 地质考察小组不得不顺绳滑降进入陡峭的火山口内。

items.def_en: 1. (medicine) (of an internal organ or disc) To slip, fall, or sink forward or downward out of its normal anatomical position.
items.ex_en: Severe pelvic muscle laxity may cause the uterus to prolapse outside the body.
items.ex_zh: 严重的盆底肌松弛可能会导致子宫向外发生脱垂。

items.def_en: 1. (+ down) (mountaineering, especially US; British: abseil) To descend a steep rock face or vertical surface by sliding down a rope.
items.ex_en: The mountain guide showed us how to rappel down the wet granite slab safely.
items.ex_zh: 高山向导向我们展示了如何安全地沿湿滑的花岗岩岩壁双绳滑降。

items.def_en: (+ down) to descend a rock face or other near-vertical surface using a doubled rope
items.ex_en: The coastal rescue squad had to abseil down the vertical chalk cliff face.
items.ex_zh: 海岸救援队不得不沿着垂直的白垩纪悬崖双绳下降。

groups.summary_en: An entity descends or drops downward via a specific mechanical technique or pathological physiological displacement. Verbs contrast controlled mountaineering descents down cliffs using friction ropes (rappel, abseil) with involuntary medical downward displacement and sinking of internal organs (prolapse).
groups.summary_zh: 指依靠特定绳索技术垂直下行，或体内器官异常下垂滑出原位。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the abnormal anatomical sagging of an organ or the specialized mechanical downward transit along ropes, differing from plain 'dropping' by clinical or technical structural context.
groups.desc_zh: 指人体器官发生病理性下移下垂，或利用特种绳索进行的专业竖向移动，与常规'掉落'相比，局限于临床解剖或绳索专业技术语境。
groups.nuance_en: prolapse: slip forward or sink abnormally downward from its normal anatomical position (uterus / disc / valve) · ptosis: suffer drooping of an organ, classically the upper eyelid (eyelid / breast / viscera) · subside: sink to a lower or normal level; abate (swelling / land / floodwaters) · abseil: lower oneself down a vertical drop using friction control on ropes (cliff / rock / tower) · rappel: execute a controlled technical descent on fixed doubled rope (cliff / face / shaft)
groups.nuance_zh: prolapse: 解剖器官脱垂或向下滑脱 (uterus / disc / valve) · ptosis: 局部的下垂沉降，尤指上睑下垂 (eyelid / breast / viscera) · subside: 沉降归位或肿胀消退 (swelling / land / floodwaters) · abseil: 登山绳索专业控速下降 (cliff / rock / tower) · rappel: 沿固定双绳技术性垂降 (cliff / face / shaft)

groups.name: Steep Vertical Descent · 坠落与直坠 (Chute, Plummet, Plunge)
groups.tip: 从高处笔直坠落或急剧下跌

items.def_en: to fall rapidly or move downward vertically
items.ex_en: Loose boulders suddenly began to drop down into the narrow mountain canyon below.
items.ex_zh: 松动的巨石突然开始骤然跌落，砸向下方的狭窄峡谷。

items.def_zh: 跳伞；从滑道滑下；（水等）顺斜槽流下
items.def_en: 1. To descend by parachute. 2. To slide down a chute, or convey something along a chute.
items.ex_en: The water began to chute swiftly through the narrow floodgate into the reservoir.
items.ex_zh: 水流开始顺着狭窄的泄洪闸门飞速倾泻滑入水库。
items.ex2_en: Factory workers chute recycled plastic pellets down into the subterranean sorting containers below.
items.ex2_zh: 工厂工人们把回收的塑料颗粒通过溜槽送入下方的地下分拣容器中。

items.def_en: to drop downward steeply or plummet precipitously below a point
items.ex_en: Behind the crumbling stone edge, the sheer cliff face seemed to fall away.
items.ex_zh: 在风化的碎石边缘背后，陡峭的绝壁仿佛直落向下、深不可测。

items.def_en: to fall or drop steeply and suddenly from a high position
items.ex_en: The climber slipped on the icy ledge and plunged into the ravine below.
items.ex_zh: 登山者在结冰的岩架上滑倒，跌入了下方的峡谷中。
items.ex2_en: The knight plunged his sharp sword deep into the terrifying monster's scaly chest.
items.ex2_zh: 骑士将锋利的宝剑深深地刺入了恐怖怪兽布满鳞片的胸膛。

items.def_en: to drop or plummet headfirst toward the ground at a steep angle
items.ex_en: The damaged drone lost power and nosedived straight into the rocky hillside.
items.ex_zh: 损坏的无人机失去动力，径直朝多石的山坡栽了下去。

items.def_en: to fall through the air solely under the force of gravity without resistance or restraint
items.ex_en: Skydiving instructors free-fall for nearly a minute before deploying their parachutes.
items.ex_zh: 跳伞教练在打开降落伞之前会自由落体下坠将近一分钟。

items.def_zh: 垂直落下，坠落；暴跌，骤降
items.def_en: To fall straight down very quickly from a high level, or to decrease rapidly and by a large amount.
items.ex_en: A loose boulder dislodged from the cliff and plummeted toward the highway.
items.ex_zh: 一块松动的巨石从悬崖脱落，直直坠向公路。

groups.summary_en: An entity falls downwards through air or a steep channel with rapid acceleration and acute steepness. Verbs in this frame scale in intensity from controlled sliding descents to unstoppable, catastrophic vertical plunges.
groups.summary_zh: 物体沿极陡坡道或空中垂直下坠，强调下落的势头猛烈与速度极快。
groups.desc_en: Denotes extremely rapid, precipitous, and sheer vertical dropping under gravity or systemic shock, differing from standard 'falling' by its violent steepness and lack of resistance.
groups.desc_zh: 指在重力或系统性骤变作用下发生极速、陡峭、近乎垂直的跌落，与一般的'下降/跌倒'相比，强调下坠之势极猛且毫无缓冲。
groups.nuance_en: plummet: drop steeply and rapidly from a great height (temperatures / profits / aircraft) · plunge: dive, cast oneself, or drop steeply downward with sudden force (prices / vehicle / cliff) · nosedive: plunge headfirst or suffer a sudden disastrous collapse (stocks / economy / plane) · free-fall: drop precipitously without guidance or braking resistance (shares / economy / parachute) · chute: slide or drop down through a steep enclosed passage or channel (cargo / water / debris)
groups.nuance_zh: plummet: 从高空垂直骤降或数值断崖式下跌 (temperatures / profits / aircraft) · plunge: 猛烈向下扎入、坠落或暴跌 (prices / vehicle / cliff) · nosedive: 俯冲下坠，引申为灾难性暴跌 (stocks / economy / plane) · free-fall: 毫无阻力或调控地自由落体式失控下跌 (shares / economy / parachute) · chute: 沿陡峭溜槽或滑道迅速滑下 (cargo / water / debris)

groups.name: Strain & Constrict Facial/Body Parts · 伸长与紧缩局部 (Crane, Purse, Pucker)
groups.tip: 骨骼肌肉的伸展与拉长

items.def_en: (+ sth) to pull facial features tight or contract specific body parts
items.ex_en: The legal team drew up a comprehensive contract for the acquisition.
items.ex_zh: 法律团队为此次收购拟定了一份详尽的合同。

items.def_en: tilt or turn a body part (like the head or ear) attentively or inquisitively
items.ex_en: The puppy cocked its head curiously when it heard the strange whistling sound.
items.ex_zh: 小狗听到奇怪的口哨声，好奇地歪起了脑袋。

items.def_zh: 伸长（脖子），探着身子看；（用起重机）起吊，搬运
items.def_en: 1. To stretch your neck forward or upward in order to see something better. 2. To lift or move heavy loads using a crane.
items.ex_en: Commuters craned their necks to see why the morning train was delayed.
items.ex_zh: 通勤乘客伸长脖子，想看清楚早班列车究竟因何延误。

items.def_en: To press your lips together into a tight, rounded shape, especially to express disapproval, doubt, or deep concentration.
items.ex_en: Lady Catherine pursed her lips in silent disdain upon hearing the insolent reply.
items.ex_zh: 听到这无礼的回答，凯瑟琳夫人敛起双唇，默表轻蔑。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to twist or contract one's facial muscles tightly
items.ex_en: He screwed up his face after taking a sip of the sour milk.
items.ex_zh: 喝了一口酸败的牛奶后，他整张脸都皱成了一团。

items.def_en: tighten the muscles of the forehead or brow into deep lines
items.ex_en: The scholar furrowed his brow while deciphering the faded inscription on the parchment.
items.ex_zh: 学者在破译羊皮纸上褪色的碑文时，深深皱紧了眉头。
items.ex2_en: His forehead furrows deeply whenever he attempts to solve complex mathematical equations alone.
items.ex2_zh: 每当他尝试独自解复杂的数学方程时，他的前额都会皱起深深的纹路。

items.def_en: contract into wrinkles or folds, especially lips in anticipation of a kiss
items.ex_en: The child puckered her lips eagerly to blow out the birthday candles.
items.ex_zh: 小女孩迫不及待地噘起嘴巴，准备吹灭生日蜡烛。
items.ex2_en: The fabric puckers along the seam if you do not use proper tension.
items.ex2_zh: 如果张力掌握不当，布料就会沿着缝线处起皱。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail deliberate muscular movements stretching outward (like the neck) or pinching/constricting together (like the lips).
groups.summary_zh: 伸长、探出身体局部（如脖子）或紧缩挤压特定器官（如嘴唇）。
groups.desc_en: Denotes deliberately contracting, narrowing, or contorting specific facial features or localized body segments, differing from generalized 'moving' by expressing focused strain, scrutiny, or disdain.
groups.desc_zh: 指有意识地紧缩、扭曲或拉长脸部局部器官与肢体部位，与普通的'活动'相比，表现出审视、紧绷、嫌恶或吃力的神态。
groups.nuance_en: crane: stretch out one's neck to see better (neck / head / gaze) · purse: tighten and draw the lips together into a round shape expressing disapproval (lips / mouth / brow) · pucker: gather into small folds or wrinkles, especially the lips before a kiss or from sourness (lips / brow / face) · furrow: draw brows together into deep lines expressing anxiety or concentration (brow / forehead / browline) · screw up: contort the facial features tightly due to pain, effort, or bright light (face / eyes / courage)
groups.nuance_zh: crane: 伸长脖子以求看清 (neck / head / gaze) · purse: 紧抿双唇呈小圆圈以示不满或审视 (lips / mouth / brow) · pucker: 噘起嘴唇或因酸涩、亲吻而缩拢起皱 (lips / brow / face) · furrow: 紧皱眉头呈现深纹以示专注或忧虑 (brow / forehead / browline) · screw up: 因刺目、痛苦或用力而紧缩扭曲五官 (face / eyes / courage)

groups.name: Surpass & Bypass by Leaping · 越级与越过 (Leapfrog, Overshoot)
groups.tip: 冲过终点或飞跃超越

items.def_en: (+ sth) to pass across or bypass an intermediate point by leaping
items.ex_en: The talented student jumped over two grades due to exceptional mathematical abilities.
items.ex_zh: 这名天才学生因出众的数学才能直接跳过了两个年级。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to move beyond an intended point or rival rapidly and abruptly
items.ex_en: The lead cyclist shot past his rival just inches before the finish line.
items.ex_zh: 领骑车手在距离终点线仅数英寸处飞速超赶过了对手。

items.def_en: [I/T] to leap over an obstacle, or suddenly achieve a much higher level or position
items.ex_en: Her debut novel vaulted her into international literary fame almost overnight.
items.ex_zh: 她的处女作几乎在一夜之间便让她跃升至国际文坛名流之列。

items.def_en: to go beyond a physical limit or established boundary
items.ex_en: The survey revealed that the developer overstepped legal property boundaries during construction.
items.ex_zh: 测量显示，开发商在施工过程中越过了合法的土地产权界限。

items.def_zh: 越过，跨越，跳过（阶段或对手）；玩跳背游戏
items.def_en: 1. To advance past competitors or intermediate stages to a higher rank or position rapidly. 2. To jump over someone's bent back in the game of leapfrog.
items.ex_en: Rapid technological advances allowed the startup to leapfrog established industry competitors.
items.ex_zh: 突飞猛进的技术进步让这家初创公司迅速越过了业界的老牌竞争对手。

items.def_zh: 冲过，越过（目标或跑道）；超过（预算或限额）
items.def_en: 1. To go past a particular point, target, or runway unintentionally. 2. To exceed a planned limit, budget, or figure.
items.ex_en: The speeding passenger jet overshot the wet runway in heavy fog.
items.ex_zh: 超速飞行的客机在浓雾中冲出了潮湿的跑道。

items.def_zh: 超越；拉开距离甩在身后
items.def_en: to move much faster than and leave someone or something behind
items.ex_en: The long-distance runner outstripped the trailing pack during the final lap.
items.ex_zh: 长跑运动员在最后一圈发力，把后方的大部队远远甩在了身后。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe moving beyond a target, stage, or competitor by jumping over intermediary steps or traveling past an intended mark. 'Leapfrog' focuses on bypassing intermediate levels to jump ahead, whereas 'overshoot' emphasizes accidentally or deliberately carrying past a boundary or stopping point.
groups.summary_zh: 指越过中间层级抢先超越，或因冲力过猛而越过既定目标界限。
groups.desc_en: Denotes advancing by jumping cleanly past intermediate stages, ranks, or limits, differing from gradual 'advancing' by discontinuous displacement and bypassing bounds.
groups.desc_zh: 指越过中间层级、常规秩序或既定终点向前跳跃推进，与渐进式的'前进/超越'相比，强调脱离轨道的跳跃性与跨越性。
groups.nuance_en: leapfrog: bypass intermediate stages or competitors in a sudden advance (competitors / stages / rivals) · overshoot: fly or travel past a targeted stopping point or estimate (runway / target / budget) · vault: leap vigorously over an obstacle or propel suddenly into a higher tier (fence / prominence / barrier) · outstrip: exceed, surpass, or run faster than a pursuer or standard (supply / rivals / expectations) · overstep: pass beyond acceptable legal, moral, or procedural bounds (boundaries / authority / mark)
groups.nuance_zh: leapfrog: 跨越中间位阶直接反超对手或跨阶段晋级 (competitors / stages / rivals) · overshoot: 越过预定停止点或指标过头 (runway / target / budget) · vault: 强劲跨越障碍或一跃升至高位 (fence / prominence / barrier) · outstrip: 在速度、规模或产能上彻底赶超甩开 (supply / rivals / expectations) · overstep: 逾越权力、道德或规则的合理界限 (boundaries / authority / mark)

groups.name: Surpass & Outdo · 胜过与抢风头 (Outdo, Eclipse, Upstage)
groups.tip: 技高一筹或抢走他人风头

items.def_zh: 使黯然失色，抢去……的风头
items.def_en: to cause someone or their achievement to seem less important or successful because of one's own prominence
items.ex_en: Her younger sister's academic triumphs always overshadowed her own modest successes.
items.ex_zh: 妹妹在学业上的辉煌成就总是让她自己的些许进步显得黯然失色。

items.def_en: to be much more skilled, impressive, or attractive than someone else
items.ex_en: The rookie outfielder completely outshone the veteran players throughout the entire tournament.
items.ex_zh: 这名新秀外野手在整场锦标赛中的表现彻底盖过了所有老将。

items.def_zh: 抢……的风头，抢戏；在舞台后方抢戏
items.def_en: To steal attention or the spotlight away from someone else, especially a fellow performer or colleague.
items.ex_en: The supporting actor completely upstaged the lead star with his hilarious performance.
items.ex_zh: 这位配角凭借滑稽幽默的表演完全抢了主角的风头。

items.def_en: (+ sb) Vastly outdo or outperform someone with effortless superiority
items.ex_en: The veteran lawyer ran circles around the novice prosecutor during cross-examination.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的老律师在交叉盘问中轻松将初出茅庐的检察官驳得体无完肤。

items.def_en: to win the greatest popularity, admiration, or attention in a performance or gathering
items.ex_en: The choir of local schoolchildren stole the show at the gala dinner.
items.ex_zh: 由当地小学生组成的合唱团在晚宴上大放异彩，抢尽了风头。

items.def_zh: 使相形见绌，遮蔽……的光芒
items.def_en: to make someone or something seem much less important, famous, or impressive by comparison
items.ex_en: The inventor's latest breakthrough eclipsed all his previous technological achievements.
items.ex_zh: 这位发明家的最新突破让他先前所有的技术成果都相形见绌。

items.def_en: To do something better, more successfully, or to a greater degree than someone else.
items.ex_en: The rival chefs constantly tried to outdo each other with elaborate culinary presentations.
items.ex_zh: 这两位竞争对手主厨不断试图在精致烹饪摆盘上超越彼此。

groups.summary_en: Competitors or performers surpass rivals in performance or divert social attention away from them, ranging from straightforward superior execution ('outdo', 'outperform') to eclipsing them into insignificance ('eclipse') or stealing the limelight ('upstage').
groups.summary_zh: 在技能、表现或声势上超越竞争者，乃至夺取全场焦点使对方显得黯然失色。
groups.desc_en: Denotes surpassing another in skill, brilliance, or theatrical prominence so as to diminish their visibility, differing from technical 'winning' by stealing attention and eclipsing luster.
groups.desc_zh: 指在才华、表现或风头上压倒他人，使其相形见绌或沦为陪衬，与一般的'获胜'相比，强调掩盖光芒与夺取公众焦点。
groups.nuance_en: outshine: be much more brilliant, impressive, or successful than another (peers / rivals / predecessors) · upstage: divert attention from someone else onto oneself (costar / colleague / event) · eclipse: obscure or surpass another completely through overwhelming greatness (reputation / rivals / achievements) · outdo: exceed someone else in action, performance, or competitiveness (competition / oneself / rival) · overshadow: dominate an occasion or make another seem insignificant by comparison (event / achievement / sibling)
groups.nuance_zh: outshine: 光芒或表现远盖过同侪 (peers / rivals / predecessors) · upstage: 在公共场合抢风头、抢戏而削弱主角关注度 (costar / colleague / event) · eclipse: 以压倒性成就使他人声名彻底黯然失色 (reputation / rivals / achievements) · outdo: 在具体作为或竞争上胜过对手一筹 (competition / oneself / rival) · overshadow: 因自身过于庞大显赫而使对方笼罩在阴影下 (event / achievement / sibling)

groups.name: Systematic Ordering & Hierarchical Valuation · 权衡排序与定先决 (Prioritize, Rank)
groups.tip: 权衡轻重排列优先级

items.def_zh: 整理，按优先级或类别分类
items.def_en: (+ sth) to arrange things in a systematic order or separate items according to priority, type, or importance
items.ex_en: The archivist sorted out the historic manuscripts by date and geographical origin.
items.ex_zh: 档案管理员按日期和地理出处对历史手稿进行了系统整理分类。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to examine a large collection of items or information systematically to isolate what is worthwhile or essential
items.ex_en: Investigators sifted through gigabytes of financial records to isolate suspicious bank transactions.
items.ex_zh: 调查人员细查了数吉字节的财务记录，以分离出可疑的银行交易。

items.def_zh: 挑选出，挑出给予特别重视
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to choose someone or something from a group for special attention, priority, or evaluation
items.ex_en: It is unfair to single out one player when the whole team performed poorly.
items.ex_zh: 在全队表现都很差的情况下，单单挑出一名球员来责备是不公平的。

items.def_zh: 优先处理，按重要性排列次序；优先考虑
items.def_en: To arrange or deal with items in order of importance, or to treat something as more important than other things.
items.ex_en: The emergency response coordinator prioritized rescue operations based on immediate danger levels.
items.ex_zh: 应急响应协调员根据险情的紧迫程度来优先安排救援行动。

items.def_en: to organize or classify items into strict gradations of rank or importance
items.ex_en: The military council hierarchizes strategic threats according to national security severity.
items.ex_zh: 军事委员会依据国家安全受威胁的严重程度对各类战略威胁分级划等。

items.def_zh: 置于优先地位；给予先期权
items.def_en: to accord superior rank or priority in processing or consideration over others
items.ex_en: The board precedenced infrastructure restoration projects over all pending budget requests.
items.ex_zh: 董事会将基础设施修复项目置于所有待决预算请求之前的优先处理地位。

items.def_zh: （按轻重缓急）伤情分流；紧急分类定序
items.def_en: to assign degrees of urgency to wounds, crises, or tasks to determine the order of treatment
items.ex_en: Paramedics quickly triaged incoming casualties in the aftermath of the explosion.
items.ex_zh: 爆炸发生后，急救人员迅速对送来的伤员进行了伤情分类定序。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this cognitive frame denote systematically weighing alternatives according to urgency, merit, or importance, arranging elements into a hierarchical sequence or designating what demands precedence.
groups.summary_zh: 根据重要性、紧迫性或价值，对各项任务或对象进行系统化权衡与排列先后。
groups.desc_en: Denotes methodically evaluating and organizing candidates, tasks, or values into a definitive order of precedence, differing from simple 'sorting' by rigorous hierarchical valuation.
groups.desc_zh: 指依据重要性、紧迫性或价值位阶，对任务、事物进行方法论式的定级与择优排序，与随意的'整理'相比，强调严谨的权重裁决。
groups.nuance_en: prioritize: determine the order of dealing with tasks according to urgency or value (tasks / investments / needs) · triage: rapidly categorize patients or problems by degree of urgency under resource constraints (patients / casualties / issues) · single out: choose one individual or thing specifically for special treatment or criticism (individual / blame / praise) · hierarchize: arrange components into an explicit graded structure of power or authority (ranks / values / structure) · sort out: organize scattered elements into intelligible order or resolve confusion (mess / logistics / problems)
groups.nuance_zh: prioritize: 按紧迫度或核心价值确立轻重缓急优先次序 (tasks / investments / needs) · triage: 在资源受限下按紧急程度进行检伤分类或筛查 (patients / casualties / issues) · single out: 挑出特定个体施加特殊对待或单挑问责 (individual / blame / praise) · hierarchize: 建立等级分明的位阶序列架构 (ranks / values / structure) · sort out: 厘清混乱、分门别类并解决问题 (mess / logistics / problems)

groups.name: Take a Risk & Venture · 冒险一试与投机 (Venture, Hazard, Chance)
groups.tip: 下注博弈或冒险尝试

items.def_zh: 尝试，试图；试验，检验；审理，审判
items.def_en: 1. To make an effort or attempt to do something. 2. To test something to see how good, effective, or suitable it is. 3. (law) To examine and judge a person or case in a court of law.
items.ex_en: Engineers tried the new propulsion system under extreme low-temperature laboratory conditions.
items.ex_zh: 工程师在极低温度的实验室条件下试验了这套新型推进系统。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Take an uncertain risk on someone or something in hopes of gaining an advantage
items.ex_en: Venture capitalists gambled heavily on the untested artificial intelligence biotech startup.
items.ex_zh: 风险投资人在这家未经市场检验的人工智能生物初创公司上下了重注。

items.def_zh: 赌博，下注；钻空子，操纵（规则等）；玩电子游戏
items.def_en: 1. To gamble or bet for money. 2. To manipulate or exploit the rules of a system unfairly for personal advantage ('game the system'). 3. To play video games.
items.ex_en: High-frequency traders constantly game the electronic exchange algorithms for quick profits.
items.ex_zh: 高频交易员不断钻电子交易所算法的空子以牟取暴利。

items.def_en: to risk an action despite the uncertain outcome; take the chance of
items.ex_en: The hikers chanced a steep descent down the unmapped mountain trail.
items.ex_zh: 徒步者碰运气冒险沿着一条未标入地图的险峻山路往下走。

items.def_en: [I/T] to dare to go somewhere or undertake an action involving risk
items.ex_en: Few solitary travelers dared venture beyond the borders of the enchanted forest.
items.ex_zh: 鲜有独行旅人敢于冒险踏入那片魔法森林的边界之外。

items.def_en: (+ sth + on sth) Risk something valuable, such as money or reputation, on the outcome of an uncertain event
items.ex_en: The chief executive staked her professional reputation on the corporate turnaround strategy.
items.ex_zh: 这位首席执行官把自己的职业声誉全都押在了公司的转型战略上。

items.def_en: to risk losing something or hazard an attempt/guess despite peril
items.ex_en: The astronomer hazarded a bold hypothesis concerning the distant exoplanet's atmosphere.
items.ex_zh: 天文学家冒着失误的风险，就遥远系外行星的大气成分斗胆提出了一个假说。

groups.summary_en: Agents undertake uncertain, daring, or speculative actions, knowingly risking loss, failure, or danger for a potential gain.
groups.summary_zh: 指明知存在失败或受损风险仍大胆尝试或押注一搏。
groups.desc_en: Denotes deliberately exposing oneself, resources, or reputation to potential danger or loss in pursuit of an uncertain gain, differing from neutral 'trying' by the conscious gamble with peril.
groups.desc_zh: 指为博取不确定的利益而蓄意将人身、财产或声誉暴露于危险与损失之中，与普通的'尝试'相比，预设了清醒的风险博弈与代价权衡。
groups.nuance_en: venture: dare to embark on a hazardous course of action or express a tentative view (opinion / capital / wilderness) · hazard: risk losing something valuable or offer an estimation tentatively (guess / fortune / life) · gamble on: stake money or future welfare on a highly speculative outcome (success / outcome / stocks) · chance: take the risk of something happening without control (luck / risk / life) · stake on: risk something vital entirely on the success of an event (reputation / career / fortune)
groups.nuance_zh: venture: 冒险涉足险境、投下本金或谨慎试探表态 (opinion / capital / wilderness) · hazard: 冒着失去的危险提出猜想或押上身家 (guess / fortune / life) · gamble on: 就高投机性结果进行赌博押注 (success / outcome / stocks) · chance: 碰运气或听凭不确定风险发生 (luck / risk / life) · stake on: 将声誉或前程完全押在某一成败节点上 (reputation / career / fortune)

groups.name: Take for Granted as True · 假定与前提预设 (Assume, Suppose, Presume)
groups.tip: 基于前设推断未知

items.def_zh: 假定，假设；料想，推测；应当，理应（be supposed to）
items.def_en: 1. To assume or believe something to be true without certain proof. 2. (be supposed to) To be expected or required to do something.
items.ex_en: Detectives supposed that the burglar entered the mansion through an unlocked window.
items.ex_zh: 侦探推测窃贼是通过一扇未锁好的窗户潜入大厦的。

items.def_zh: 假定，假设；承担（责任、角色等）；呈现，显露（特征、面貌）
items.def_en: 1. To accept something as true without having proof. 2. To take on a responsibility, role, or control. 3. To take on a particular quality or appearance.
items.ex_en: Analysts assumed that oil production levels would remain steady throughout next year.
items.ex_zh: 分析师预先假定明年的石油生产水平将保持平稳。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Accept something as true or certain without questioning or testing it
items.ex_en: The manager took for granted that his employees supported the reorganization plan.
items.ex_zh: 经理自以为员工们想当然地都会支持这项重组计划。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Base actions or beliefs on a particular unverified assumption or premise
items.ex_en: The defense counsel proceeded on the assumption that the eyewitness lacked credibility.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师以目击证人缺乏可信度为预设前提展开了辩护。

items.def_zh: 推断，假定（基于合理概率或惯例默认）
items.def_en: to take something to be the case on the basis of probability or reasonable expectation
items.ex_en: Under maritime salvage statutes, rescuers legally presume the abandoned vessel is lost.
items.ex_zh: 根据海难救助法规，救援人员在法律上推定该被弃船只已沉没。

items.def_zh: 假定，设想（作为严谨论证或理论的前提）
items.def_en: to put forward or accept a statement as the factual basis for an argument or theory
items.ex_en: Theoretical physicists posit the existence of extra dimensions to explain cosmic expansion.
items.ex_zh: 理论物理学家假定存在额外维度，以作为解释宇宙膨胀的理论前提。

items.def_zh: 公设，假定（在学术或系统推演中确立前提）
items.def_en: to suggest or assume the truth or existence of something as a necessary postulate
items.ex_en: Euclidean geometry postulates that two straight parallel lines will never intersect.
items.ex_zh: 欧几里得几何学设定两条平行直线永远不可能相交作为公设前提。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this epistemic frame denote treating a proposition as true without immediate conclusive proof. They diverge cleanly in baseline justification: suppose introduces tentative or counterfactual hypothesizing, assume takes an unverified premise as a starting point without evidence, and presume accepts a condition based on reasonable probability or conventional default.
groups.summary_zh: 指在缺乏确凿凭证时将某事视为成立，按推测或默认概率推进认知。
groups.desc_en: Denotes accepting a proposition as true without immediate empirical proof to serve as a premise for reasoning, differing from verified 'knowing' by its provisional reliance on probability or convention.
groups.desc_zh: 指在未经当场实证核验的情况下，将某一命题假定为真实以作为推演前提，与确定'知晓'相比，依赖于盖然性推断或默认惯例。
groups.nuance_en: assume: accept something as true without verification as the basis of an argument (responsibility / identity / truth) · presume: take for granted based on strong probability or reasonable warrant (innocence / guilt / dead) · suppose: consider something as a hypothetical possibility or hesitant belief (scenario / truth / reason) · postulate: put forward an unprovable claim as an essential prerequisite for reasoning (principle / theory / existence) · posit: state or assume a fact firmly as the foundation of an academic argument (hypothesis / correlation / theory)
groups.nuance_zh: assume: 未经实证直接假定或想当然认为 (responsibility / identity / truth) · presume: 依常理或法律事实推定 (innocence / guilt / dead) · suppose: 设想某种假设情况或作初步猜度 (scenario / truth / reason) · postulate: 提出不可自明的基本公理作为理论推演前提 (principle / theory / existence) · posit: 正式确立或提出核心事实作为立论基础 (hypothesis / correlation / theory)

groups.name: Targeted & Concealed Shooting · 隐蔽精准射杀 (Shoot Down, Pick Off)
groups.tip: 开火命中并使目标坠落

items.def_en: to take a casual or opportunistic shot at game or an enemy
items.ex_en: The hunter potted a wild rabbit sitting in the tall brush.
items.ex_zh: 猎手轻巧地一枪打中了那只蹲在高草丛里的野兔。

items.def_en: to shoot targets carefully and individually from a distance
items.ex_en: The hidden sniper picked off enemy sentries stationed along the wall.
items.ex_zh: 潜藏的狙击手从远处将驻扎在围墙边的敌方哨兵逐个点名射杀。

items.def_zh: 击落（鸟兽等使其倒地）；告发，向警方告密
items.def_en: 1. (hunting) To shoot down a bird or bring down an animal to the ground. 2. (British informal, 'grass on') To inform on someone to the police.
items.ex_en: The marksman grassed three grouse before the morning mist had cleared.
items.ex_zh: 晨雾尚未散去，神枪手便已开枪击落了三只松鸡使其坠地。

items.def_zh: 狙击，隐蔽射击；放冷箭，暗中抨击
items.def_en: 1. (+ at) To shoot at someone from a hidden position, usually from a distance. 2. (+ at) To make covert, malicious criticisms or personal attacks.
items.ex_en: Rooftop gunmen sniped at moving military vehicles through the narrow alleyway.
items.ex_zh: 屋顶上的枪手穿过狭窄的小巷，向行进中的军用车辆进行隐蔽狙击。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Knock down or kill a target with gunfire, especially from a distance
items.ex_en: Border patrol agents shot down an unauthorized surveillance drone near the perimeter.
items.ex_zh: 边境巡逻人员在防线附近用枪械击落了一架未经授权的侦察无人机。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Kill, wound, or neutralize a specific enemy target using precise fire
items.ex_en: The sharpshooter took out the enemy machine gunner with one precise shot.
items.ex_zh: 神射手一记精准射击，瞬间消灭了敌方的机枪手。

items.def_en: to fell or kill an opponent instantly with a single gunshot
items.ex_en: The security guard dropped the armed intruder with a single defensive bullet.
items.ex_zh: 安保人员打出一发自卫子弹，瞬间一枪击倒了武装入侵者。
items.ex2_en: The heavy glass vase dropped onto the tiled kitchen floor and shattered instantly.
items.ex2_zh: 沉重的玻璃花瓶掉在厨房铺了瓷砖的地板上，瞬间摔得粉碎。

groups.summary_en: Shooters fire accurately from a concealed position, vantage point, or blind side to knock down or kill specific targets one by one.
groups.summary_zh: 指自隐蔽处或远距离对特定目标进行精准射杀或击落。
groups.desc_en: Denotes firing accurately from a concealed, stationary, or advantageous position to eliminate discrete individual targets, differing from pitched 'skirmishing' by asymmetric stealth and precision.
groups.desc_zh: 指在隐蔽、静止或占优的阵位上实施精准单发射击以剔除离散目标，与正面'交火'相比，强调非对称的匿踪伏击与精确诛杀。
groups.nuance_en: snipe: shoot precisely from a hidden vantage point at long range (target / troops / enemy) · pick off: systematically shoot individuals one by one out of a group (stragglers / targets / guards) · take out: neutralize or destroy a target cleanly with deadly force (sniper / target / vehicle) · pot: shoot small game casually, or hit a target easily from close range (bird / game / sentry) · shoot down: bring down an airborne target or flying vehicle with gunfire or missiles (plane / drone / target)
groups.nuance_zh: snipe: 在隐蔽高处对远距离目标实施精准狙击 (target / troops / enemy) · pick off: 从敌群中逐个瞄准收拾掉落单或孤立目标 (stragglers / targets / guards) · take out: 以精准火力干脆利落地清除目标 (sniper / target / vehicle) · pot: 信手近距离射杀小猎物或哨兵 (bird / game / sentry) · shoot down: 击落空中飞行器或飞禽目标 (plane / drone / target)

groups.name: Technological Displacement & Obsolescence · 技术淘汰与迭代覆写 (Outmode, Overwrite)
groups.tip: 以新换旧并淘汰过时事物

items.def_en: to cause a product, tool, or practice to become outmoded and no longer useful
items.ex_en: Digital music streaming services rapidly obsoleted magnetic tapes and compact audio discs.
items.ex_zh: 数字流媒体音乐服务迅速淘汰了磁带和光盘，使之完全成为陈旧过时的产物。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Gradually withdraw an older technology, product, or system from use
items.ex_en: The transit authority plans to phase out diesel buses over five years.
items.ex_zh: 公交管理局计划在五年内逐步淘汰所有柴油公交车。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) Force an older technology, product, or competitor out of the market by newer alternatives
items.ex_en: Aggressive low-cost imported models squeezed out the domestic car manufacturer entirely.
items.ex_zh: 来势汹汹的低成本进口车型将这家本土汽车制造商彻底排挤出了市场。

items.def_en: to supersede and take the place of an older system, technology, or standard
items.ex_en: Renewable energy networks will eventually supplant fossil fuel infrastructure across the continent.
items.ex_zh: 可再生能源网络终将全面替代并取代整个大陆上的化石燃料基础设施。

items.def_zh: （软件）弃用，宣布不再推荐使用
items.def_en: to declare a software feature or protocol out of date and slated for removal
items.ex_en: Software developers deprecated the obsolete security protocol in the latest software release.
items.ex_zh: 软件开发人员在最新的软件版本中宣布弃用该陈旧的安全协议。

items.def_zh: （计算机中）覆盖，重写（数据）；写得过长（或过于雕琢）
items.def_en: 1. (computing) To replace existing data with new data in the same storage location. 2. To write in a style that is excessively elaborate or ornate.
items.ex_en: Installing the latest firmware will overwrite previous operating system configurations entirely.
items.ex_zh: 安装最新的固件将完全覆盖重写先前的操作系统配置数据。

items.def_en: To cause something to become obsolete, old-fashioned, or no longer useful.
items.ex_en: Rapid advances in microprocessing outmoded the factory's automated production equipment.
items.ex_zh: 微处理技术的突飞猛进使该工厂原有的自动化生产设备彻底过时被汰。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote rendering older systems, designs, or data irrelevant or non-functional by directly superseding them or writing over them with newer technological alternatives.
groups.summary_zh: 通过技术升级、迭代或数据覆盖，使旧有的方案、数据或系统被淘汰废弃。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the structural rendering of an existing tool, system, or idea useless or superseded through modern technological advancement or deliberate replacement, unlike natural decay or active destruction.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过技术进步或有意替代使既有工具、系统或观念在结构上过时、失效或被彻底覆写，区别于自然的腐朽耗损或主动的物理破坏。
groups.nuance_en: obsolete: actively make dated or useless (technology / skill) · phase out: gradually withdraw from circulation (subsidy / product / fleet) · supplant: supersede and usurp a dominant position (rival / legacy system) · deprecate: declare obsolete while maintaining temporary backward compatibility (API / feature / syntax) · overwrite: physically replace existing data with new input (file / memory / code) · outmode: cause to fall behind current styles or standards (fashion / machinery)
groups.nuance_zh: obsolete: 主动使其过时或报废 (technology / skill) · phase out: 有计划地分期淘汰或撤出 (subsidy / product / fleet) · supplant: 取代并挤占其主导地位 (rival / legacy system) · deprecate: 软件中声明废弃但暂保兼容 (API / feature / syntax) · overwrite: 物理覆盖写入新数据 (file / memory / code) · outmode: 因时代发展使其显得陈旧落伍 (fashion / machinery)

groups.name: Toss Around & Traffic In · 随口散播与兜售 (Bandy, Monger, Peddle)
groups.tip: 四处散播言论或传闻，任意散布言辞

items.def_zh: 到处散播；口头频繁提及
items.def_en: (+ sth) Discuss, spread, or use names, ideas, or terms casually and frequently without care
items.ex_en: Sensational tabloid journalists bandied about wild conspiracy rumors without verifying facts.
items.ex_zh: 耸人听闻的小报记者在未经核实事实的情况下到处随意散播荒唐的阴谋论。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Sell or peddle goods, ideas, or rumors opportunistically or quickly
items.ex_en: The bankrupt firm tried to flog off its expired merchandise online.
items.ex_zh: 这家破产公司试图在网上将其积压的过期商品廉价兜售出去。

items.def_en: mention or discuss names, words, or ideas casually without serious thought
items.ex_en: Board members tossed around various restructuring ideas during the informal luncheon meeting.
items.ex_zh: 董事会成员在非正式午餐会上随意提及并漫谈了各种重组思路。

items.def_zh: 散播，四处传布（言论、流言等）；（争执中）来回顶撞，互相对骂；往返抛接（球等）
items.def_en: (also 'bandy about') To spread or discuss ideas, rumors, or names carelessly and widely.
items.ex_en: Delegates refuse to bandy diplomatic accusations during official peace negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 代表们拒绝在正式和平谈判期间互相来回散布指责。

items.def_zh: 大肆宣扬，沿街叫卖般鼓吹
items.def_en: publicly offer, push, or advocate an idea or claim persistently
items.ex_en: The activist group hawked its controversial healthcare reform proposal at every rally.
items.ex_zh: 该维权团体在每次集会上都大肆宣扬并竭力推销其备受争议的医改方案。

items.def_en: promote, spread, or sell an idea, story, or rumor widely and uncritically
items.ex_en: Disreputable websites regularly peddle baseless conspiracy theories to attract gullible readers.
items.ex_zh: 不良网站经常到处兜售毫无依据的阴谋论，以吸引容易受骗的读者。

items.def_zh: 散播，兜售，贩卖（恐惧、谣言等）
items.def_en: (usually in compounds or disapproving contexts) To spread or deal in something undesirable, such as fear, gossip, or warmongering.
items.ex_en: Corrupt demagogues mongered racial prejudice and unfounded terror among the vulnerable citizens.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的煽动者在脆弱的民众之间散播种族偏见与毫无根据的恐惧。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey circulating remarks, rumors, or loaded terms carelessly, casually, or opportunistically as commodities.
groups.summary_zh: 轻率口传、随口翻炒或恶意兜售言论、谣言及是非。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on the light, reckless, or opportunistic dissemination and commercial exploitation of words, ideas, or goods, contrasting with formal debate or legitimate retail trade.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重于轻率口舌散播或机会主义式兜售言论、恐慌与廉价货品，区别于正规的辩论商讨或合法的零售贸易。
groups.nuance_en: bandy about: casually pass around or gossip carelessly (name / rumor / phrase) · peddle: promote dubious ideas or illicit wares persistently (influence / theory / drug) · hawk: aggressively pitch or advertise for quick gain (wares / book / ideology) · monger: deliberately spread harmful sentiments for gain (fear / scandal / war)
groups.nuance_zh: bandy about: 随口散播或当作谈资四处流传 (name / rumor / phrase) · peddle: 兜售推销可疑观点或非法物品 (influence / theory / drug) · hawk: 沿街叫卖或大肆兜售以牟利 (wares / book / ideology) · monger: 恶意散播煽动负面情绪 (fear / scandal / war)

groups.name: Transgress Moral & Legal Boundaries · 违背与犯罪 (Transgress, Violate, Sin)
groups.tip: 触犯戒律道德或法律

items.def_en: (+ against/on) to make an unfair intrusion on rights or commit a moral offense
items.ex_en: The intrusive state surveillance began to trespass on the basic rights of private citizens.
items.ex_zh: 侵入性的国家监控开始侵犯普通公民的基本权利。

items.def_zh: 越界；逾越（伦理道德界限）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Cross an established ethical, moral, or legal boundary
items.ex_en: The country musician successfully crossed over into mainstream pop.
items.ex_zh: 这位乡村音乐歌手成功跨界打入了主流流行乐坛。

items.def_en: [I/T] to go beyond acceptable moral, ethical, or legal boundaries
items.ex_en: Officials who willfully transgress established ethical protocols face immediate termination of their contract.
items.ex_zh: 故意逾越既定道德规范的官员将面临被立即解除合同的处分。

items.def_en: (+ sth) Lapse morally and forfeit a state of righteousness or grace
items.ex_en: Through his brazen betrayal, the proud knight did fall from grace and lost all honor.
items.ex_zh: 因其厚颜无耻的背叛，这位骄傲的骑士从恩典中堕落，丧失了所有荣誉。

items.def_zh: 犯戒，犯罪，违背道德原则
items.def_en: To commit a sin; violate a religious law or moral principle.
items.ex_en: She felt she would sin against her conscience if she hid the truth.
items.ex_zh: 她觉得如果隐瞒真相，就会违背自己的良知。

items.def_zh: 违反，违犯（法律、协议）；侵犯；亵渎
items.def_en: 1. To break or act against a law, rule, or agreement. 2. To infringe upon someone's rights or privacy; disrespect or desecrate something sacred.
items.ex_en: The military operation was found to violate international treaties regarding the protection of civilians.
items.ex_zh: 该军事行动被裁定违反了关于保护平民的国际条约。

items.def_en: to offend grossly against moral decency, human rights, or fundamental standards
items.ex_en: The brutal treatment of peaceful demonstrators continued to outrage basic standards of human decency.
items.ex_zh: 对和平示威者的残暴对待持续践踏着人类良知的基本底线。

groups.summary_en: Moral or legal agents cross boundary limits of ethics, natural laws, or divine commandments, escalating from personal moral failing to severe systemic crime or desecration.
groups.summary_zh: 越过道德、良知或法律戒律红线，程度由个体过失至恶劣罪行。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the crossing of moral, legal, spiritual, or divine boundaries, emphasizing the breach of an established code rather than mere physical entry or property damage.
groups.desc_zh: 指越过道德、法律、教规或神圣边界，强调对既定规范体系的逾越背叛，区别于单纯的物理侵入或财产毁损。
groups.nuance_en: transgress: cross an abstract moral, social, or legal boundary (boundary / norm / law) · violate: forcefully infringe upon a solemn right, oath, or bodily autonomy (sanctity / rights / treaty) · trespass: encroach illicitly on territory, property, or private domains (property / boundary / hospitality) · sin: commit an offense against religious dogma or divine law (soul / God / conscience) · outrage: violently assault deeply held moral sensibilities (decency / humanity / conscience)
groups.nuance_zh: transgress: 逾越抽象的道德、法规或界限 (boundary / norm / law) · violate: 粗暴侵犯神圣权利、条约或身体自主 (sanctity / rights / treaty) · trespass: 非法侵入他人地产或私密领域 (property / boundary / hospitality) · sin: 违背宗教戒律或良心道义 (soul / God / conscience) · outrage: 极大冒犯公序良俗或良知底线 (decency / humanity / conscience)

groups.name: Underscore & Reinforce · 划线与佐证强调 (Underscore, Underline, Accent)
groups.tip: 划重点以引起特别注意

items.def_en: emphasize or give distinctive prominence to a particular feature or statement
items.ex_en: The dramatic lighting helped accent the intricate textures carved into the stone wall.
items.ex_zh: 极具戏剧感的光影突显了石墙上雕刻的复杂纹理。

items.def_en: (+ sth) make something clearer, more noticeable, or more obvious
items.ex_en: The crisis pointed up the urgent need for structural reform.
items.ex_zh: 这场危机凸显了进行结构性改革的紧迫性。

items.def_zh: 使显现，衬托出（特性或要点）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to make a particular quality, feature, or point more noticeable or prominent
items.ex_en: A pinch of sea salt will bring out the natural sweetness of these roasted carrots.
items.ex_zh: 少许海盐能衬托出这些烤胡萝卜的天然清甜。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to support or confirm the truth or validity of an assertion, theory, or expectation
items.ex_en: The final audit results bore out all our initial suspicions about financial mismanagement.
items.ex_zh: 最终的审计结果证实了我们最初对财务管理不善的所有怀疑。

items.def_zh: 清晰凸显，格外引人注目
items.def_en: to be clearly prominent or conspicuous, reinforcing visibility or distinct importance
items.ex_en: Her innovative approach made her application stand out from hundreds of others.
items.ex_zh: 她创新的方法使她的申请在数百人中脱颖而出。

items.def_en: 1. To emphasize or highlight the importance of something. 2. To draw a line underneath text.
items.ex_en: The sudden power outage served to underline our dangerous dependence on the electrical grid.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的停电凸显了我们对电网的危险依赖。

items.def_en: 1. To emphasize or show the importance of something clearly. 2. To draw a line under a word or phrase.
items.ex_en: Recent economic fluctuations underscore the critical necessity of maintaining robust emergency financial reserves.
items.ex_zh: 近期的经济波动突显了维持充足紧急财政储备的极端重要性。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate reinforcing or drawing distinct attention to a truth, reality, or conclusion, often by serving as physical, visual, or contextual markers that validate or emphasize an underlying point.
groups.summary_zh: 通过划线突显或借由现实事实验证并加深强调某一论点。
groups.desc_en: Involves highlighting, drawing explicit attention to, or providing confirming proof for an idea or fact to strengthen its credibility, unlike creating or discovering the argument.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过划线突显、强化注意力或提供事实印证来加固论点或事实的可信度，区别于原发性地创立或发掘论据。
groups.nuance_en: underscore: draw sharp emphatic attention to critical importance (importance / point / need) · underline: visually or rhetorically emphasize a core reality (reality / urgency / fact) · accent: foreground a specific textural or rhythmic aspect (feature / word / contrast) · bear out: confirm or corroborate through subsequent evidence (theory / hypothesis / prediction) · point up: expose or highlight a flaw or distinctive truth clearly (contrast / weakness / inconsistency)
groups.nuance_zh: underscore: 极力凸显某事物的核心重要性 (importance / point / need) · underline: 在修辞或表意上着重强调 (reality / urgency / fact) · accent: 突出特定细节、特征或节奏感 (feature / word / contrast) · bear out: 用后续事实印证或证实论断 (theory / hypothesis / prediction) · point up: 鲜明暴露出缺陷、矛盾或真实面貌 (contrast / weakness / inconsistency)

groups.name: Undertake & Shoulder Responsibility · 承担与认领 (Undertake, Assume, Shoulder)
groups.tip: 挑起责任并着手去做

items.def_en: to take on a role, duty, or responsibility formally
items.ex_en: She will officially assume her duties as head of the department next Monday morning.
items.ex_zh: 她将于下周一上午正式就任系主任一职。

items.def_en: to accept and deal with a heavy burden, responsibility, or blame
items.ex_en: The young minister had to shoulder the heavy burden of reforming the failing healthcare system.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻的部长不得不挑起改革摇摇欲坠的医疗体系的重担。

items.def_en: (take sth on) to agree to do a difficult piece of work, job, or responsibility
items.ex_en: Despite his packed schedule, David agreed to take on the demanding community project.
items.ex_zh: 尽管日程排得满满当当，戴维还是答应承担起这项要求严苛的社区项目。

items.def_zh: 接任，着手处理（职责、工作等）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to accept or begin a job, official duty, or substantial responsibility
items.ex_en: After years abroad, she returned home to take up her position as managing director.
items.ex_zh: 在海外多年后，她回到国内接任总经理一职。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to confront and assume responsibility for a difficult task or critical role
items.ex_en: When the captain was injured, Marcus had to step up to the leadership role.
items.ex_zh: 队长受伤后，马库斯不得不主动站出来承担领导职责。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to agree or commit officially to take on an undertaking, role, or obligation
items.ex_en: Many eager volunteers decided to sign up for the challenging weekend cleanup operation.
items.ex_zh: 许多热心的志愿者决定报名参加这项颇具挑战的周末清理行动。

items.def_en: 1. To accept a job, task, or responsibility and begin to do it. 2. (undertake to do something) To promise or agree to do something.
items.ex_en: The engineering firm will undertake a thorough investigation into the structural integrity of the bridge.
items.ex_zh: 该工程公司将对该桥梁的结构完整性进行全面深入的调查。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe voluntarily or officially committing to perform a significant task, enterprise, role, or legal/ethical responsibility.
groups.summary_zh: 正式或自愿承担重大责任、义务、项目或执行某项任务。
groups.desc_en: Denotes taking upon oneself the burden, formal mandate, or ethical obligation of a task, office, or liability, contrasting with passive acceptance or involuntary imposition.
groups.desc_zh: 指主动或依约领受任务、职责、职务或负累，强调主体对责任的主动认领与扛起，区别于消极顺从或被动摊派。
groups.nuance_en: undertake: formally commit to executing a complex, risky enterprise (project / task / study) · shoulder: resolutely bear a heavy emotional, financial, or ethical burden (responsibility / burden / blame) · assume: officially take over an office, role, or liability (role / responsibility / debt) · take on: accept an added challenge, opponent, or workload (work / opponent / challenge) · step up to: bravely rise to meet a demanding situation (plate / challenge / duty)
groups.nuance_zh: undertake: 正式着手承担大型复杂项目或任务 (project / task / study) · shoulder: 毅然挑起沉重的情感、经济或道义重担 (responsibility / burden / blame) · assume: 正式就任职务或接管债务与责任 (role / responsibility / debt) · take on: 迎接挑战、接手额外工作或招架对手 (work / opponent / challenge) · step up to: 勇于挺身而出应对考验 (plate / challenge / duty)

groups.name: Uniformity & Standards Alignment · 统一标准与同质化 (Standardize, Homogenize, Systematize)
groups.tip: 推行统一标准以消除差异

items.def_zh: 解决，消除（分歧或不一致）
items.def_en: (+ sth) to remove differences, irregularities, or problems in order to achieve uniformity or agreement
items.ex_en: Both legal teams met yesterday to iron out remaining disagreements before signing the contract.
items.ex_zh: 双方律师团队昨天会面，以在签署合同前消除剩余的分歧。

items.def_en: (+ with sth) to align or bring sth into standard agreement with other things
items.ex_en: Our internal policies must line up with the new international environmental regulations.
items.ex_zh: 我们的内部政策必须与最新的国际环境法规保持一致。
items.ex2_en: The teacher asked the young students to line up their colorful desks neatly.
items.ex2_zh: 老师要求年轻的学生们把色彩斑斓的书桌整齐地排成一行。

items.def_en: to make things of the same type conform to an established standard or norm
items.ex_en: The ministry introduced new guidelines to standardize inspection procedures across all regional hospitals.
items.ex_zh: 该部委出台了新指导方针，以使所有地区医院的检查流程合乎统一标准。

items.def_zh: 使常规化；统一（标准或尺度）
items.def_en: to bring data, rules, or practices into conformity with a shared baseline or normal standard
items.ex_en: Analysts must normalize the raw survey data to make meaningful comparisons across different demographics.
items.ex_zh: 分析师必须对原始调查数据进行归一化处理，以便在不同人群之间进行有意义的比较。
items.ex2_en: Traffic flow normalizes quickly once police clear the minor morning fender bender away.
items.ex2_zh: 一旦警方清理完早晨轻微的追尾事故，交通流量就会迅速恢复正常。

items.raw_cluster: 统一与同质化 Standardize & Homogenize
items.def_zh: 使同质化，使均匀；使（牛奶等）均质化
items.def_en: To make different elements, cultures, or parts uniform and similar; to treat a liquid (such as milk) so that its fat is evenly distributed.
items.ex_en: Rapid commercial development threatens to homogenize the distinct architectural traditions of ancient coastal towns.
items.ex_zh: 快速的商业开发恐将使古老沿海城镇独特的建筑传统走向同质化。

items.def_en: to arrange or organize procedures or components according to a comprehensive system
items.ex_en: The archivist worked diligently to systematize the vast collection of historical municipal records.
items.ex_zh: 档案管理员勤勉工作，以使浩繁的市政历史档案系统化。

items.raw_cluster: 规范与制度化 Standardize & Institutionalize
items.def_en: To make or become professional in standards, training, organization, or status.
items.ex_en: The association launched rigorous training programs to professionalize the burgeoning digital marketing industry.
items.ex_zh: 该协会推出了严格的培训项目，以推进新兴数字营销行业的专业化。
items.ex2_en: The sports industry professionalized rapidly over the course of the late twentieth century.
items.ex2_zh: 体育产业在二十世纪后期迅速走向了职业化和专业化。

groups.summary_en: An agent modifies diverse elements, products, or working practices so that they conform to a uniform standard, quality benchmark, or identical characteristics. Verbs range from organizational leveling to technical standardization.
groups.summary_zh: 对不同要素进行标准化改造，消除差异并达成质量或形态统一。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on imposing common standards, smooth coherence, or uniform properties onto diverse elements, distinct from simply organizing or tidying up.
groups.desc_zh: 指对原本多元或杂乱的事物强加统一标准、平滑规范或同质属性，区别于单纯的理顺秩序或局部规整。
groups.nuance_en: standardize: bring into explicit conformity with a benchmark or specification (procedure / curriculum / test) · homogenize: eliminate all internal distinctions to produce uniform sameness (culture / mixture / society) · systematize: organize scattered elements into a coherent, rule-based framework (knowledge / records / approach) · normalize: make an atypical practice regular or universally accepted (relations / behavior / anomaly) · iron out: resolve residual frictions, discrepancies, or snags (wrinkle / difference / difficulty)
groups.nuance_zh: standardize: 使流程或规格统一对齐基准规范 (procedure / curriculum / test) · homogenize: 抹杀内部差异以形成高度同质化 (culture / mixture / society) · systematize: 将零散要素编排成具内在逻辑的体系 (knowledge / records / approach) · normalize: 使反常状态或摩擦重归正常合规 (relations / behavior / anomaly) · iron out: 抚平细小分歧、摩擦或残存障碍 (wrinkle / difference / difficulty)

groups.name: Unsteady & Abrupt Movement · 摇晃与震颤 (Wobble, Jolt)
groups.tip: 失去平衡左右来回晃荡

items.def_en: 1. To move or cause to move unsteadily from side to side. 2. To become weak, uncertain, or indecisive.
items.ex_en: The cyclist began to wobble alarmingly before regaining his footing on the slippery slope.
items.ex_zh: 在湿滑的斜坡上重新站稳之前，骑车人开始险象环生地左右摇晃。
items.ex2_en: The strong gust of coastal wind wobbled the tall outdoor umbrellas on the patio.
items.ex2_zh: 沿海刮来的一阵强风吹得露台上的高大户外遮阳伞摇晃不定。

items.def_en: to move or stand in an unsteady way, swaying as if about to fall
items.ex_en: The stacked wooden chairs began to teeter dangerously as the mischievous child bumped them.
items.ex_zh: 那个调皮的孩子撞了一下后，叠放在一起的木椅开始摇晃，险些倒塌。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to cause sth to tremble or move abruptly with sharp mechanical vibration
items.ex_en: The new CEO plans to shake up the entire management structure.
items.ex_zh: 新任首席执行官计划对整个管理架构进行大洗牌。

items.def_en: to shake violently and uncontrollably, as from an impact or intense cold/fear
items.ex_en: The old locomotive seemed to shudder violently as the engineer slammed on the emergency brakes.
items.ex_zh: 当司机猛踩紧急制动时，老旧的火车头剧烈震颤起来。

items.def_en: 1. To move or cause to move with a sudden, rough, and sharp jerk. 2. To shock or surprise someone into taking action or paying attention.
items.ex_en: The sudden blowout caused the crowded tour bus to jolt violently to the right.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的爆胎使拥挤的观光大巴猛烈地向右颠簸了一下。
items.ex2_en: The unexpected explosion jolted the unsuspecting villagers out of their deep midnight sleep.
items.ex2_zh: 突如其来的爆炸声将毫无防备的村民们从深夜的沉睡中震醒。

items.def_en: to make a sudden, unsteady, and abrupt movement ahead
items.ex_en: When the driver released the clutch too quickly, the car started to lurch forward.
items.ex_zh: 当司机松离合太快时，汽车猛然向前一蹿。

items.def_en: [I/T] to shake or jolt violently due to a sudden physical impact
items.ex_en: The heavy impact against the rock did jar every bone in the driver's body.
items.ex_zh: 与岩石的沉重撞击让司机浑身的骨头都受到了剧烈的震荡。

groups.summary_en: Verbs describing unsteady, oscillating, or abrupt movements, varying from precarious rhythmic unsteadiness to sudden, sharp mechanical shocks.
groups.summary_zh: 指缺乏平衡的摆动、摇晃，或受到突然剧烈撞击引起的震颤颠簸。
groups.desc_en: Characterizes erratic, balance-threatening, or jarring motion marked by sudden shifts in trajectory or equilibrium, unlike rhythmic oscillation or steady acceleration.
groups.desc_zh: 表现为失去平衡、颠簸突兀或震荡冲击的不稳定运动，强调重心失稳或猝然受阻，区别于规律的周期摆动或平稳加速。
groups.nuance_en: wobble: rock unsteadily from side to side around an unstable axis (wheel / table / confidence) · teeter: balance precariously on the verge of falling (brink / edge / rock) · jolt: disturb violently with an abrupt sharp impact (passenger / memory / economy) · shudder: convulse with a rapid, deep mechanical or emotional vibration (engine / body / frame) · lurch: pitch forward or sideward suddenly and uncontrollably (train / crowd / economy)
groups.nuance_zh: wobble: 绕失稳轴心晃悠不稳或摇摆动摇 (wheel / table / confidence) · teeter: 在跌落或崩溃边缘如履薄冰地摇晃 (brink / edge / rock) · jolt: 突遭猛烈颠簸或精神上的骤然震动 (passenger / memory / economy) · shudder: 机械剧烈发颤或身体受寒惊而战栗 (engine / body / frame) · lurch: 猛然失去控制向前或侧方倾斜冲出 (train / crowd / economy)

groups.name: Vaporize & Evaporate · 气化与消散消失 (Vaporize, Evaporate)
groups.tip: 由实体转化为气体消逝

items.def_en: to cause a substance to pass off as vapor, or to evaporate rapidly
items.ex_en: Intense thermal radiation caused the delicate chemical compounds to volatilize into the humid night.
items.ex_zh: 强烈的热辐射使那些脆弱的化合物迅速挥发，散入潮湿的夜色中。
items.ex2_en: The intense laboratory heat will volatilize the organic solvent within a few minutes.
items.ex2_zh: 实验室的强热将在几分钟内使这种有机溶剂迅速挥发。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to dissipate or disappear, or cause mist or liquid to clear, through heat
items.ex_en: The morning sun quickly grew warm enough to burn off the thick mountain mist.
items.ex_zh: 晨阳迅速转暖，驱散了山间浓重的薄雾。
items.ex2_en: The dense morning fog will burn off once the afternoon sun emerges brightly.
items.ex2_zh: 一旦午后的太阳明媚升起，浓厚的晨雾就会自然散尽消退。

items.def_en: to slowly dissipate and disappear completely from view or existence
items.ex_en: As twilight deepened, the last faint traces of vapor began to fade away completely.
items.ex_zh: 随着暮色渐浓，最后一缕微弱的水汽也彻底消散无踪。

items.def_zh: （使）蒸发，（使）气化；（希望、热情等）消散，消失
items.def_en: 1. To change from a liquid into vapor or gas, or to cause this to happen. 2. To disappear or dissolve gradually.
items.ex_en: Under the blistering desert sun, the shallow puddle would evaporate within a few hours.
items.ex_zh: 在酷热的沙漠烈日下，那个浅水坑不出几个小时就会蒸发殆尽。
items.ex2_en: The intense heating lamp evaporates moisture from the damp wheat grains very quickly.
items.ex2_zh: 强烈的加热灯能非常迅速地蒸发潮湿麦粒中的水分。

items.def_zh: 驱散，消散（使烟云、能量散开）
items.def_en: to disappear gradually or cause cloud, vapor, or tension to scatter into nothing
items.ex_en: A steady coastal wind soon helped dissipate the noxious fumes rising from the factory.
items.ex_zh: 持续的沿海海风很快协助吹散了从工厂升起的有害烟雾。
items.ex2_en: The tense atmosphere dissipated gradually after both political sides reached an amicable agreement.
items.ex2_zh: 在政治双方达成和解协议之后，紧张的气氛逐渐烟消云散了。

items.def_en: 1. To turn, or cause to turn, from a solid or liquid into vapor or gas. 2. To destroy something completely, as by extreme heat or an explosion.
items.ex_en: The intense heat from the explosion threatened to vaporize the entire metal storage tank.
items.ex_zh: 爆炸产生的极端高温足以将整个金属储罐彻底汽化。
items.ex2_en: Liquid nitrogen vaporizes rapidly upon coming into direct contact with the warm air.
items.ex2_zh: 液氮在与温暖的空气直接接触时会迅速汽化成气体。

items.def_en: to convert a solid substance directly into gas without passing through liquid phase
items.ex_en: Under extreme conditions, dry ice will sublimate directly into dense clouds of cold gas.
items.ex_zh: 在特定条件下，干冰会直接升华为浓重的冷气云雾。
items.ex2_en: The laboratory technician used extreme heat and pressure to sublimate the solid iodine.
items.ex2_zh: 实验室技术人员利用极端的温度和压力使固体碘直接升华。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical state changes from liquid or solid into gas/vapor, as well as the figurative disappearance, dissipation, or total annihilation of abstract entities.
groups.summary_zh: 由液/固态转化为气体，或具象/抽象化消散湮灭。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to matter or intangible reserves changing into a gaseous state or dispersing completely into nothingness, distinct from mere structural shrinkage or physical departure.
groups.desc_zh: 指物质相变为气体消散，或抽象资产、希望化为乌有彻底散失，区别于单纯的体积萎缩或空间位移。
groups.nuance_en: evaporate: convert liquid to vapor, or vanish tracelessly into thin air (water / surplus / hope) · vaporize: violently or instantly blast into gas or dust (target / liquid / wealth) · dissipate: cause clouds, heat, or energy to scatter thin and dissolve (fog / energy / tension) · sublimate: pass directly from solid to vapor without melting, or refine base impulses (substance / desire / rage) · fade away: progressively lose intensity, distinctness, or presence (voice / memory / light)
groups.nuance_zh: evaporate: 液体蒸发，或资金、希望凭空化为乌有 (water / surplus / hope) · vaporize: 瞬间被彻底气化、轰碎或消灭 (target / liquid / wealth) · dissipate: 烟雾、热量或聚集的能量逐渐驱散淡化 (fog / energy / tension) · sublimate: 物理上直接升华，或心理上将本能转化为崇高行为 (substance / desire / rage) · fade away: 逐渐隐没、光色渐暗或声势式微 (voice / memory / light)

groups.name: Vibrate & Agitate · 震频与撼动 (Vibrate, Jar, Rattle)
groups.tip: 高频振动摇晃不止

items.def_en: to move loosely inside a container or room, repeatedly striking the sides with short sharp sounds
items.ex_en: A few loose plastic screws continued to rattle around inside the empty metal toolbox.
items.ex_zh: 几颗松动的塑料螺丝在空荡荡的金属工具箱里咔嗒乱晃撞响。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make a series of short, sharp knocking sounds while shaking loosely
