groups.nuance_zh: bleach: 借助强氧化化学品或烈日暴晒漂白 (fabric / hair / coral) · whiten: 使整体色泽泛白、增白或转白 (teeth / smile / sheets) · fade: 随光照或时间流逝而逐渐褪色斑驳 (sun / jeans / memory) · decolorize: 在化工或实验中脱色、脱除色素 (solution / oil / substance) · blanch: 因恐惧惊厥致面无血色，或烹饪中焯水去皮 (face / fear / almonds) · lighten: 笼统地降低明度或减轻颜色深重感 (skin / shade / hair)

groups.name: Bless & Consecrate · 宗教祈福与圣仪 (Consecrate, Sanctify, Anoint)
groups.tip: 举行宗教仪式与祝福

items.def_zh: 为（产妇等）举行感恩礼拜，为……举行教会祝福仪式
items.def_en: To perform a special church service of thanksgiving and blessing for (especially a woman after childbirth).
items.ex_en: The village rector prepared to church the young mother following the safe birth of her heir.
items.ex_zh: 继承人平安出生后，村里的教区牧师准备为这位年轻母亲举行产后教会祝福礼。

items.def_en: To ask God or a divine power to protect, help, or favor someone or something
items.ex_en: The bishop raised his ceremonial staff to bless the faithful parishioners before the procession.
items.ex_zh: 主教在巡游队伍出发前举起仪式权杖，为虔诚的教区信众祈福。

items.def_en: To perform a Christian ceremony welcoming someone into the church, typically using water
items.ex_en: The parish priest prepared to baptize the infant before the gathered congregation on Sunday.
items.ex_zh: 教区牧师准备在周日聚集的会众面前为这名婴儿施洗。

items.def_en: To smear or rub oil on someone as part of a religious ceremony to set them apart
items.ex_en: The ancient high priest approached the altar to anoint the chosen monarch with sacred oils.
items.ex_zh: 年迈的大祭司走近祭坛，用圣油为选定的君王行涂油祝圣礼。

items.def_en: To officially state in a religious ceremony that an object, place, or person is holy
items.ex_en: The bishop arrived early yesterday morning to consecrate the newly built stone chapel on the hill.
items.ex_zh: 主教昨天清晨抵达，为山丘上新建的石砌小教堂举行了祝圣仪式。

items.def_en: To make something holy or free from sin through religious observance
items.ex_en: Generations of silent devotion had served to sanctify the ancient mountain shrine in popular memory.
items.ex_zh: 数代人默默的虔信崇拜，让这座古老山林圣地在民意中化为神圣之地。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate religious or ceremonial actions whereby individuals, places, or objects are blessed, cleansed, or made sacred according to spiritual traditions.
groups.summary_zh: 通过宗教仪式祈福、净化或使其神圣化。
groups.desc_en: Signifies endowing a person, object, or space with sacred status or divine favor through prescribed ritual, contrasting with secular congratulation or mundane approval.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过宗教科仪或神圣宣告使人、物或场所获得神圣地位与神恩庇佑，区别于世俗的庆贺或凡俗的认可。
groups.nuance_en: bless: invoke divine favor, protection, or express sacred goodwill (child / marriage / food) · consecrate: formally dedicate exclusively to divine or holy purpose (altar / ground / bishop) · sanctify: purify spiritually or impart religious legitimacy (marriage / vow / soul) · anoint: apply holy oil ritually to dedicate a ruler or priest (king / priest / sick) · baptize: immerse or sprinkle with water to initiate into the faith (infant / convert / candidate) · church: perform a traditional ceremony of blessing, esp. for a woman after childbirth (mother / woman / parishioner)
groups.nuance_zh: bless: 祈求神灵降福庇佑，或宗教性赐福 (child / marriage / food) · consecrate: 正式举行祝圣仪式以将物或人完全奉献归神 (altar / ground / bishop) · sanctify: 使之精神圣化、纯洁化，赋予神圣约束力 (marriage / vow / soul) · anoint: 涂抹圣油以施膏立君王、教士或涂油礼 (king / priest / sick) · baptize: 施以水洗礼以纳为信徒 (infant / convert / candidate) · church: 举行产妇产后感恩祈祷礼等教会仪式 (mother / woman / parishioner)

groups.name: Blow & Gust · 吹拂与刮风 (Blow, Gust, Whistle)
groups.tip: 从微风轻拂到狂风大作

items.def_en: To pass by or subside without causing lasting damage; or to knock something over by wind force
items.ex_en: We stayed indoors and waited patiently for the sudden mountain storm to blow over.
items.ex_zh: 我们待在室内，耐心地等待着这场突如其来的山地风暴平息过去。
items.ex2_en: The strong wind blew over several tall aluminum ladders left outside.
items.ex2_zh: 强风把留在室外的几把高高的铝合金梯子吹倒了。

items.def_en: To move along creating a current of air, or to be moved or carried along by the wind
items.ex_en: Watch your paper napkins because the wind might blow them across the garden table.
items.ex_zh: 照看好你的餐巾纸，因为风可能会把它们吹得滚过整个花园桌子。

items.def_zh: 吹，刮，被风吹走（blow 的过去分词）
items.def_en: (past participle of blow) To move creating an air current, or be moved or shaped by the wind.
items.ex_en: Dry autumn leaves were blown across the vacant courtyard by the sudden evening gust.
items.ex_zh: 傍晚突如其来的阵风把干枯的秋叶吹得散落在空荡的庭院各处。

items.def_en: To move violently or blow sharply with sudden, lash-like force
items.ex_en: Fierce coastal gales began to whip the tall palm trees against the dark horizon.
items.ex_zh: 猛烈的沿海狂风开始呼啸抽打着暗淡地平线下的高大棕榈树。

items.def_en: To blow with a loud, wailing, prolonged noise, typical of fierce storms
items.ex_en: I could hear the freezing winter wind howl through the narrow cracks around the windowframe.
items.ex_zh: 我能听见刺骨的寒冬烈风从窗框狭窄的缝隙中呼啸怒号。

items.def_en: To blow in sudden, forceful, and brief rushes of wind
items.ex_en: A cold autumn wind began to gust intermittently through the barren branches of the orchard.
items.ex_zh: 一阵凄冷的秋风开始断断续续地在果园光秃秃的枝桠间刮起。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers natural atmospheric movements where currents of air sweep across spaces at varying intensities. It spans gentle drifting breezes to violent, howling gusts that drive loose objects before them.
groups.summary_zh: 指空气流动形成的风力吹拂或呼啸强风，涵盖微风到狂风掠过。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the dynamic kinetic movement of air currents along a spectrum of velocity, sound, and turbulence, contrasting with static pressure or atmospheric stillness.
groups.desc_zh: 指气流在速度、声响和湍流剧烈程度上形成的动态流动与吹拂，区别于静态气压或风平浪静。
groups.nuance_en: blow: general movement of an air current (wind / gale / breeze) · gust: burst suddenly and intermittently with forceful violence (wind / storm / gale) · howl: blow fiercely accompanied by loud, mournful acoustic resonance (gale / blizzard / wind) · whip: move rapidly, violently lashing surrounding objects (wind / flag / branches) · blow over: pass by and dissipate without causing permanent disruption (storm / scandal / crisis)
groups.nuance_zh: blow: 气流流动吹拂的通用基准词 (wind / gale / breeze) · gust: 阵阵发作、突发性的猛烈疾风 (wind / storm / gale) · howl: 伴有悲戚或尖厉呼啸声的狂风大作 (gale / blizzard / wind) · whip: 风势强劲抽打撕扯周围物体 (wind / flag / branches) · blow over: 风暴过境平息，或指风波危机自然烟消云散 (storm / scandal / crisis)

groups.name: Blunder & Slip Up · 犯低级错误与失态出丑 (Blunder, Slip up, Goof)
groups.tip: 认知偏差酿成严重差错

items.def_en: (British English, informal) To make a silly, embarrassing, or careless mistake.
items.ex_en: The junior clerk did boob by sending confidential legal documents to the wrong corporate email.
items.ex_zh: 那位初级职员确实犯了蠢，竟把机密法律文件发到了错误的机构邮箱里。

items.def_en: (informal) To make a silly, careless, or clumsy blunder
items.ex_en: I really did goof when I forgot to confirm our non-refundable hotel reservation last week.
items.ex_zh: 上周我居然忘了确认不可退款的酒店预订，真是犯了个糊涂大错。

items.def_en: To make a careless mistake or lapse in attention
items.ex_en: Someone in the accounting department must have slipped up.
items.ex_zh: 财务部肯定有人粗心犯了错。

items.def_en: To make a mistake, or cause someone to make an error or slip
items.ex_en: The aggressive interrogator tried to trip up the suspect with conflicting questions about his timeline.
items.ex_zh: 咄咄逼人的审讯员试图用前后矛盾的时间线问题让嫌疑人说漏犯错。

items.def_en: (informal) To make a mess of something or make a serious error
items.ex_en: You will completely screw up the entire production schedule if you miss this critical deadline.
items.ex_zh: 如果你错过了这个关键的截止时间，就会把整个生产排期全给彻底搞砸。

items.def_en: To make a serious, clumsy, or thoughtless mistake
items.ex_en: The inexperienced diplomat managed to blunder by casually revealing details of the classified peace talks.
items.ex_zh: 那位缺乏经验的外交官不慎随口泄露了机密和谈的细节，犯下了严重过失。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey committing careless, clumsy, or noticeably embarrassing mistakes in action or speech, typically causing public mortification.
groups.summary_zh: 指因粗心或笨拙犯下低级、尴尬或愚蠢的差错，多带有出丑意味。
groups.desc_en: Signifies committing an embarrassing, stupid, or negligent error stemming from carelessness or poor judgment, contrasting with willful malice or systemic failure.
groups.desc_zh: 指因疏忽大意或判断力拙劣而酿成尴尬、低级的错误失态，区别于存心作恶或结构性体制失败。
groups.nuance_en: blunder: make a gross, embarrassing mistake through stupidity or tactlessness (diplomacy / minister / decision) · slip up: make a careless, minor oversight amidst routine execution (schedule / team / details) · screw up: informal, thoroughly botch or ruin a situation through incompetence (job / life / exam) · trip up: stumble on a difficult point or cause someone to reveal an error (question / witness / test) · goof: informal, commit a silly, lighthearted or clumsy mistake (line / scene / actor) · boob: British informal, make an awkward, conspicuous faux pas (reporter / speech / blunder)
groups.nuance_zh: blunder: 因愚蠢盲目或缺乏手腕而犯下重大的失策或丑事 (diplomacy / minister / decision) · slip up: 在日常事务执行中出现疏忽纰漏 (schedule / team / details) · screw up: 口语中因拙劣无能把事情全盘搞砸 (job / life / exam) · trip up: 栽在细节圈套上，或设计使人露出破绽 (question / witness / test) · goof: 犯了滑稽、无足轻重的低级小错 (line / scene / actor) · boob: 英式口语中因笨拙而贻笑大方的失误 (reporter / speech / blunder)

groups.name: Blush & Flush · 面红与泛红 (Blush, Flush, Crimson)
groups.tip: 面颊受刺激泛红发热

items.def_en: to become pink or red in the face because you are embarrassed
items.ex_en: He felt his cheeks color rapidly under the direct, assessing gaze of his demanding supervisor.
items.ex_zh: 在苛刻主管那直勾勾且充满打量的注视下，他感到双颊猛地发红。
items.ex2_en: Fresh ripe berries colored her fingers a vivid shade of crimson red.
items.ex2_zh: 新鲜成熟的浆果把她的手指染成了一抹鲜艳的深红。

items.def_en: to become red or crimson in the face, typically from strong emotion
items.ex_en: His pale visage began to crimson with sudden fury upon hearing the traitor's insolent remarks.
items.ex_zh: 一听到那个叛徒傲慢无礼的话，他苍白的面容因骤起的狂怒而涨得通红。

items.def_en: to suddenly become visibly red or heated in the face due to anger or embarrassment
items.ex_en: Her cheeks began to flare up with angry heat when the colleague disputed her hard evidence.
items.ex_zh: 当同事质疑她的确凿证据时，她的脸颊顿时因愤怒而火辣辣地涨红。

items.def_en: to turn red in the face as a result of sudden embarrassment or emotion
items.ex_en: The shy debutante could not help but color up whenever the handsome captain addressed her directly.
items.ex_zh: 每当英俊的上尉直接与她说话时，腼腆的初入社交界名媛总会忍不住脸红。

items.def_zh: （脸）发红，使脸红；冲洗（抽水马桶、管道等）；奔流；惊飞
items.def_en: 1. (of a face) To become red because of embarrassment, anger, or heat. 2. To clean a toilet or pipe by sending a sudden rush of water through it. 3. To force a person or animal out of a hiding place.
items.ex_en: She felt heat flush through her face and neck after receiving the sudden public rebuke.
items.ex_zh: 在突然受到当众严斥后，她感到一股热流使整张脸和脖子猛然通红。
items.ex2_en: Plumbers flush clogged sewer pipes using specialized high-pressure water jets every spring.
items.ex2_zh: 每年春天，水管工都会用专门的高压水枪冲洗堵塞的下水管道。

items.def_zh: 脸红，发红；感到惭愧，羞愧
items.def_en: 1. To become red in the face because you are embarrassed, shy, or ashamed.
items.ex_en: He began to blush deeply when the teacher read his awkward love poem aloud to everyone.
items.ex_zh: 当老师把那首尴尬的情诗当众大声念出来时，他不由得涨红了脸。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe facial or bodily skin becoming visibly red and hot, caused by internal emotional states (embarrassment, shame) or physical triggers (heat, exertion, fever).
groups.summary_zh: 因羞愧等情绪或发热、运动等生理原因使面部泛红发热。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an involuntary rush of blood to the skin manifesting as red discoloration, distinguishing psychological embarrassment from physiological exertion or temperature changes.
groups.desc_zh: 指血液不自主地涌向皮肤表层导致面颊或体表泛红，区别出心理羞怯反应与体能消耗或温热引发的潮红。
groups.nuance_en: blush: redden modestly in the face from shame, embarrassment, or modesty (cheeks / bride / girl) · flush: redden intensely over the whole face/neck from heat, exertion, or fierce emotion (face / skin / anger) · crimson: darken to a vivid, deep red color through overwhelming affect (cheeks / face / fury) · color: subtler, gradual visible reddening under scrutiny (cheeks / face / ears) · color up: noticeably flush upon reacting to an awkward remark (speaker / youth / face) · flare up: suddenly redden with sudden passion, illness, or anger (temper / rash / skin)
groups.nuance_zh: blush: 因羞赧、难为情或谦逊而两颊微红 (cheeks / bride / girl) · flush: 因燥热、剧烈运动或激动怒气而满脸通红发烫 (face / skin / anger) · crimson: 因极度羞愧或暴怒而面孔变为深红赭色 (cheeks / face / fury) · color: 笼统且较为含蓄地脸部泛起红晕 (cheeks / face / ears) · color up: 受到调侃或窘境刺激后刷地脸红 (speaker / youth / face) · flare up: 骤然面红耳赤，或指炎症/脾气猛烈爆发 (temper / rash / skin)

groups.name: Border & Abut · 相邻与接壤 (Butt, Abut, Flank)
groups.tip: 端部碰接或彼此贴边

items.def_en: (+ on) To form or share an edge or perimeter line with another territory or object
items.ex_en: The peaceful northern provinces of the country border directly on the expansive mountain wilderness.
items.ex_zh: 该国祥和的北部省份与连绵广阔的山地荒野直接接壤。

items.def_en: 1. (+ against/on/up to) To lie adjacent to or touch at an end or edge. 2. To hit or push with the head or horns.
items.ex_en: The weathered wooden barn seemed to butt against the steep stone cliff behind the farm.
items.ex_zh: 那座饱经风霜的木质谷仓紧挨着农场后方陡峭的石壁。

items.def_en: To border physically or approach very closely to a particular condition, state, or limit
items.ex_en: The reckless financial speculation began to verge on blatant fraud as debts mounted without control.
items.ex_zh: 随着债务失控攀升，这种不计后果的金融投机开始濒临明目张胆的诈骗。

items.def_en: To be situated at the side or along both sides of someone or something
items.ex_en: Ancient marble statues of forgotten kings flank the monumental entrance leading into the royal palace.
items.ex_zh: 被遗忘王者的古老白色大理石雕像分别立在通往王宫的宏伟入口两侧。

items.def_en: To be very close to, contiguous with, or joined directly to another room, building, or piece of land
items.ex_en: The luxurious master bedroom and private study adjoin each other through a wide arched doorway.
items.ex_zh: 豪华主卧与私人书房通过一扇宽阔的拱形门道紧密相连。

items.def_en: (+ on/against) To touch or be immediately adjacent along a common boundary or surface
items.ex_en: The eastern boundary of the newly purchased estate will abut on the public nature reserve.
items.ex_zh: 新购庄园的东侧边界将直接毗连公共自然保护区。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this spatial frame denote physical contact, adjacency, or bordering along an edge, perimeter, or boundary line. Nuances separate direct end-to-end touching from running along a side or enclosing borders.
groups.summary_zh: 描述两处土地、建筑物或物体在边界处紧邻相接、贴靠或侧邻。
groups.desc_en: Signifies spatial contiguity or conceptual proximity where edges meet, touch, or flank one another, contrasting with complete separation or distant alignment.
groups.desc_zh: 指空间实体或抽象概念在边界上紧密相接、依傍或临界，区别于完全隔绝或远距离遥望。
groups.nuance_en: border: share an outer boundary or lie along an edge (country / park / river) · abut: terminate directly against or touch physically at a property line (property / building / wall) · adjoin: lie directly next to and in physical contact with a room or land (room / garden / territory) · flank: be situated at the side or lateral edge of something (entrance / general / road) · butt: project or press end-to-end against a surface (beam / joint / wall) · verge on: approach so closely as to almost become an extreme state (madness / absurdity / collapse)
groups.nuance_zh: border: 与某物共享边界或沿边界延伸 (country / park / river) · abut: 建筑或地皮端头直接顶接碰撞、紧密相连 (property / building / wall) · adjoin: 与毗邻的房间或土地紧密挨在一起 (room / garden / territory) · flank: 位于某物两侧予以夹护或在侧翼展开 (entrance / general / road) · butt: 端部对接、紧抵在另一平面上 (beam / joint / wall) · verge on: 在抽象程度上濒临、极度逼近某种极端边缘 (madness / absurdity / collapse)

groups.name: Borrow & Rent · 借入与租用 (Borrow, Rent, Hire, Lease)
groups.tip: 自外部借调使用权

items.def_en: To pay for the temporary use of something, such as a car or suit, usually for a short period
items.ex_en: We decided to hire an estate car for our two-week family tour across the Scottish Highlands.
items.ex_zh: 我们决定在苏格兰高地的两周家庭自驾游期间短期租用一辆旅行车。

items.def_zh: 租用，承租（按期支付租金）
items.def_en: To pay money for the temporary use of property, land, or equipment owned by someone else
items.ex_en: The young medical student decided to rent a modest apartment situated near the teaching hospital.
items.ex_zh: 那位年轻的医学生决定在教学医院附近租下一间不大但适宜的公寓。

items.def_en: To take or receive something from someone with the intention of returning it after a period of time.
items.ex_en: May I borrow your digital camera for the weekend to photograph my sister's outdoor wedding?
items.ex_zh: 我能在周末借用你的数码相机去拍摄我姐姐的户外婚礼吗？

items.def_en: To ask for or obtain something, such as food, money, or a ride, from someone without paying or intending to return it
items.ex_en: The penniless drifter managed to cadge a warm lunch and cigarette from the kind barkeeper.
items.ex_zh: 那个身无分文的流浪汉从善良的酒保那里讨来了一顿热腾腾的午饭和一根烟。

items.def_en: To hold or use property, vehicles, or equipment under the formal terms of a contract or lease
items.ex_en: The shipping firm signed a formal agreement to lease five commercial cargo vessels for five years.
items.ex_zh: 这家航运公司签署了一份正式协议，按约长期租用五艘商用货船，为期五年。

items.def_en: To hire an aircraft, ship, or vehicle for private, designated use
items.ex_en: The wealthy executive chose to charter a luxury jet to attend the urgent international summit.
items.ex_zh: 这位富有的企业高管选择包租一架豪华喷气式飞机前往参加紧急国际峰会。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe obtaining temporary custody or use of property, money, or services with the obligation of returning it, contrasting gratuitous borrowing with fee-based renting or commercial leasing.
groups.summary_zh: 表示以归还为前提借入或付费租用财物与服务。
groups.desc_en: Involves obtaining temporary possession and use of an asset or property without acquiring permanent ownership, contrasting with outright purchasing or gratuitous gift-giving.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及在不取得永久所有权的前提下获得资产或财物的临时占有与使用权，区别于直接买断或无偿赠与。
groups.nuance_en: borrow: take temporary possession with implicit return, often non-monetary (book / money / umbrella) · rent: pay recurrent fees for temporary occupancy or equipment use (apartment / car / equipment) · hire: pay for temporary short-term use of goods, or engage personnel (car / hall / worker) · lease: obtain through a formal, long-term binding legal contract (premises / land / aircraft) · charter: hire an entire transport vehicle or vessel for exclusive journey use (yacht / flight / bus) · cadge: wheedle or beg small items or money without intention to repay (cigarette / drink / money)
groups.nuance_zh: borrow: 临时借用并约定归还，多为日常非商业借入 (book / money / umbrella) · rent: 支付固定租金以定期租用房屋、车辆等 (apartment / car / equipment) · hire: 英式多指短期付费租用工具车辆，或雇佣劳务 (car / hall / worker) · lease: 依据正式法律合同开展的中长期融资或商业租赁 (premises / land / aircraft) · charter: 专门包租整架飞机、船只等专供专属行程 (yacht / flight / bus) · cadge: 讨拿、揩油或蹭取小恩小惠且无意奉还 (cigarette / drink / money)

groups.name: Bounce & Ricochet · 碰撞反弹与偏斜 (Deflect, Carom, Glint Off)
groups.tip: 碰撞硬物受阻弹回

items.def_en: To strike a surface and immediately bound away in another direction.
items.ex_en: The dropped tennis ball managed to bounce off the concrete pavement and land in the bushes.
items.ex_zh: 掉落的网球从水泥路面上弹跳开来，最后落入了灌木丛中。

items.def_en: To hit a surface obliquely and bounce aside without delivering a direct blow.
items.ex_en: The stray ricocheting bullet happened to glance off the steel lamp post without penetrating it.
items.ex_zh: 那颗偏转的流弹恰巧擦过钢质路灯柱弹开了，并未穿透它。

items.def_en: (+ off/into) To strike a surface and ricochet vigorously off it, typically in billiards or vehicles.
items.ex_en: The speeding cue ball seemed to carom off two cushions before gently pocketing the nine-ball.
items.ex_zh: 那颗飞速击出的母球撞击两次库边发生偏折反弹，随后轻轻将九号球撞入袋中。

items.def_en: To spring or bounce back through the air after impacting a solid barrier.
items.ex_en: The missed basketball managed to rebound forcefully from the metal rim into the opponent's arms.
items.ex_zh: 投失的篮球猛烈地从金属篮筐上回弹出来，正好落入对手怀中。

items.def_en: To hit an obstacle and change trajectory or cause something moving to do so.
items.ex_en: The vigilant armored vehicle used active protective plating to deflect the incoming anti-tank rocket.
items.ex_zh: 这辆高度戒备的装甲车使用主动防护装甲使射来的反坦克火箭弹偏转了方向。
items.ex2_en: The speeding bullet deflected off the thick metal signpost into the ditch.
items.ex2_zh: 飞驰的子弹击中厚金属路标后偏斜着飞入了水沟。

items.def_zh: （弹丸、石块等受阻）弹回，跳飞，反弹
items.def_en: (of a bullet, stone, or ball) To hit a hard surface at an angle and bounce away.
items.ex_en: The stray pellet managed to ricochet against the granite cliff and strike the abandoned signpost.
items.ex_zh: 那颗流弹击中花岗岩悬崖后反弹开来，砸中了废弃的路标。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical objects striking a hard surface and deflecting away at an angle, often with preserved kinetic energy or erratic trajectory.
groups.summary_zh: 物体撞击硬物表面后沿倾斜轨迹弹开、偏转或反冲的物理运动。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an object striking a rigid barrier and springing away with altered trajectory, contrasting with shattering on impact or straight penetrating absorption.
groups.desc_zh: 指物体撞击坚硬界面后受反弹力改变原有轨迹折返或弹开，区别于撞碎损毁或直接穿透吸收。
groups.nuance_en: rebound: bounce back directly off an obstacle, or recover after a shock (ball / economy / wall) · ricochet: strike a flat surface at an angle and skip away unpredictably (bullet / projectile / rock) · glance off: strike obliquely and slide away with minimal transferred momentum (armor / shield / surface) · carom: strike and immediately rebound into another object (billiard / ball / vehicle) · deflect: cause or suffer an intentional or accidental alteration of course (beam / bullet / attack) · bounce off: bounce away simply, or bounce ideas off someone informally (trampoline / idea / colleague)
groups.nuance_zh: rebound: 撞击障碍物后直线回弹，或指危机后的经济反弹 (ball / economy / wall) · ricochet: 子弹或碎片斜击坚硬表面后发生乱序跳弹 (bullet / projectile / rock) · glance off: 倾斜擦过表面并带着微弱作用力滑开 (armor / shield / surface) · carom: 撞击一物后连续弹撞至另一物 (billiard / ball / vehicle) · deflect: 因遮挡或偏转导致弹道路线发生偏移 (beam / bullet / attack) · bounce off: 碰撞后自然弹起，或口语中与人试探碰撞想法 (trampoline / idea / colleague)

groups.name: Brawl & Scuffle · 扭打与聚众斗殴 (Scuffle, Tussle, Scraps)
groups.tip: 街头混战或毫无规则的肉搏

items.def_en: To fight briefly and confusedly in a disorderly physical clash
items.ex_en: Rival protesters began to scuffle in the town square until the riot police intervened swiftly.
items.ex_zh: 对立的抗议者在城市广场上开始混战扭打，直到防暴警察迅速介入。

items.def_en: To struggle or fight vigorously with someone, often over possession of something
items.ex_en: The determined defensive players fought to tussle with the forward for possession of the ball.
items.ex_zh: 防守球员们拼尽全力与前锋扭扯争斗，争夺球的控制权。

items.def_en: To engage in a rough, informal fistfight or physical quarrel
items.ex_en: The two rowdy teenagers began to scrap in the alley behind the diner.
items.ex_zh: 那两个吵闹的少年开始在小餐馆后面的小巷里掐架。

items.def_en: To fight or quarrel noisily and violently, especially in a public place.
items.ex_en: Dozens of unruly soccer fans started to brawl noisily outside the stadium gates.
items.ex_zh: 数十名不守规矩的球迷在体育场大门外吵闹地斗殴起来。

items.def_en: To seize and hold an opponent in a close, wrestling-style physical fight
items.ex_en: The two bouncers rushed forward to grapple with the aggressive intruder together.
items.ex_zh: 两名保镖冲上前去，合力与那名具有攻击性的入侵者近身缠斗。

items.def_en: To fight or come into violent confrontation with an opposing group
items.ex_en: Riot police and angry protesters clash near the entrance of the parliament building.
items.ex_zh: 防暴警察与愤怒的抗议者在议会大厦入口附近发生激烈冲突。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict chaotic, rowdy, and often physical skirmishes between individuals or groups, typically involving close quarters and disorganized fighting. While 'brawl' highlights loud public violence, 'scuffle' and 'tussle' imply brief, messy grappling with lower lethality.
groups.summary_zh: 指吵闹、混乱且近距离的徒手打斗或扭扯混战。
groups.desc_en: Involves chaotic, disorganized physical altercations or close-quarters wrestling, contrasting with structured military warfare or formally regulated combat sports.
groups.desc_zh: 指混乱无序的肢体推搡、扭打互殴或近身肉搏，区别于正规军团交战或有裁判规则的搏击竞技。
groups.nuance_en: brawl: noisy, disorderly public fight involving multiple people (bar / drunk / mob) · scuffle: brief, confused, low-intensity tussle at close quarters (protester / police / guard) · tussle: energetic, prolonged physical struggle or determined dispute over control (possession / opponent / ball) · scrap: informal, scrappy little fistfight or spontaneous tiff (schoolyard / boy / dog) · grapple: seize firmly and wrestle bodily at close quarters (wrestler / opponent / attacker) · clash: violent armed meeting between opposing factions, or incompatible collision (police / protest / faction)
groups.nuance_zh: brawl: 酒肆或街头多人参与的喧闹群殴与混战 (bar / drunk / mob) · scuffle: 短暂、混乱但烈度较低的肢体推搡与小冲突 (protester / police / guard) · tussle: 缠斗撕扯，或为争夺控制权展开的激烈较量 (possession / opponent / ball) · scrap: 街坊或孩童间粗糙但自发的小打小闹打架 (schoolyard / boy / dog) · grapple: 紧紧抱住对手躯体进行近身肉搏扭打 (wrestler / opponent / attacker) · clash: 阵营间短兵相接的武力冲突或尖锐对立 (police / protest / faction)

groups.name: Breed & Reproduce · 繁衍与繁殖 (Breed, Propagate, Procreate, Multiply)
groups.tip: 生物世代相传与延续血脉

items.def_zh: 繁殖，繁衍；饲养；招致，酿成
items.def_en: 1. (of animals) To reproduce or mate and produce offspring. 2. To keep and rear animals or plants to produce new ones. 3. To cause or bring about a bad feeling, situation, or condition.
items.ex_en: These migratory birds breed in the sheltered wetlands during the warm summer months.
items.ex_zh: 这些候鸟在温暖的夏季月份于避风湿地中繁衍生息。
items.ex2_en: Passionate farmers breed prize cattle for agricultural exhibitions throughout the rural district.
items.ex2_zh: 热心的农场主为全乡各地的农业博览会繁育优质肉牛。

items.def_en: To produce offspring or new individuals of the same kind naturally
items.ex_en: Microorganisms reproduce rapidly when kept in a warm and nutrient-rich laboratory environment.
items.ex_zh: 微生物在温暖且营养丰富的实验室环境中会迅速繁殖。
items.ex2_en: Digital cameras reproduce fine artwork with extraordinary color accuracy and stunning detail.
items.ex2_zh: 数码相机能以非凡的色彩精准度和令人惊叹的细节复刻精美艺术品。

items.def_en: To release or deposit eggs in water, or to produce offspring in large quantities
items.ex_en: Every autumn, adult salmon swim upstream to spawn in the clear, shallow gravel beds.
items.ex_zh: 每年秋天，成年鲑鱼都会逆流而上，在清澈浅浅的砾石滩产卵。

items.def_en: To increase greatly in number through ongoing reproduction
items.ex_en: Invasive weeds multiply rapidly and choke native vegetation without regular land management.
items.ex_zh: 若缺乏定期的土地管理，入侵杂草会成倍繁殖并扼杀原生植被。
items.ex2_en: Careful investments multiply your retirement savings substantially over several decades of compounding.
items.ex2_zh: 审慎的投资通过数十年的复利能使你的退休储蓄大幅翻倍。

items.def_en: To breed or multiply specimens of a plant or animal from parent stock
items.ex_en: Botanists carefully propagate rare orchid species using specialized stem cuttings in the greenhouse.
items.ex_zh: 植物学家在温室中利用专门的茎插法繁育稀有兰花品种。
items.ex2_en: Sound waves propagate efficiently through dense water over remarkably vast ocean distances.
items.ex2_zh: 声波在稠密的水中能极其有效地跨越极其辽阔的海洋距离传播。

items.def_en: (formal) to produce children or offspring through sexual reproduction
items.ex_en: Most mature animals seek suitable mates primarily to procreate and ensure species survival.
items.ex_zh: 大多数成熟动物寻找合适的配偶主要是为了繁育后代并确保物种存续。

groups.summary_en: Verbs covering biological reproduction and multiplication across animals, plants, and organisms, whether natural or artificially cultivated.
groups.summary_zh: 指生物通过交配、繁育或传代使族群数量倍增的过程。
groups.desc_en: Signifies the biological or horticultural generation and proliferation of successive generations of organisms, contrasting with individual biological growth or mechanical manufacturing.
groups.desc_zh: 指生物体或园艺组织繁衍子代与扩展种群规模的过程，区别于单一生物体的个体成长或工业复制。
groups.nuance_en: breed: produce offspring through sexual union or deliberate selective cultivation (dog / cattle / germ) · reproduce: biologically generate copies of the parent organism (cell / species / organism) · propagate: multiply plants via seeds, cuttings, or spread ideas widely (plant / seed / doctrine) · multiply: increase rapidly and extensively in population or number (cell / rabbit / organism) · procreate: reproduce offspring naturally within an existential biological context (generation / human / couple) · spawn: produce fish eggs en masse, or propagate prolifically (salmon / fungus / offspring)
groups.nuance_zh: breed: 通过交配或人工选育改良繁衍牲畜物种 (dog / cattle / germ) · reproduce: 生物学上生成下一代或单细胞克隆复制 (cell / species / organism) · propagate: 通过扦插、播种繁育植物，或广泛传播思想 (plant / seed / doctrine) · multiply: 生物种群或数量呈乘数式激增 (cell / rabbit / organism) · procreate: 带有繁衍后代生存责任的人类生殖行为 (generation / human / couple) · spawn: 水生生物大量产卵排卵，或密集衍生后代 (salmon / fungus / offspring)

groups.name: Bringing Down & Felling · 砍倒与推翻 (Fell, Cut Down, Topple)
groups.tip: 施加外力砍倒击倒立物

items.def_en: To cut through the base of a tree, post, or plant so that it falls down
items.ex_en: The municipal crew decided to cut down the diseased pine tree this morning.
items.ex_zh: 市政工作人员决定在今天上午砍倒那棵生病的松树。

items.def_en: To make something tall and upright lose balance and collapse
items.ex_en: Violent wind gusts threatened to topple the old brick chimney during the storm.
items.ex_zh: 暴风雨期间，强烈的阵风险些将那座古老的砖烟囱吹倒。
items.ex2_en: The leaning pine tree toppled onto the deserted mountain road during midnight.
items.ex2_zh: 半夜里，那棵倾斜的松树轰然倒在荒凉的山路上。

items.def_en: To fell a tree or obstacle using repeated, forceful ax blows
items.ex_en: The resolute lumberjacks strove to hew down the ancient oak with massive axes.
items.ex_zh: 坚定的伐木工们挥舞沉重的斧头，奋力劈倒了那棵古老的橡树。

items.def_en: To knock flat to the ground, whether a standing structure or an opponent
items.ex_en: The demolition team used high explosives to level the condemned warehouse within seconds.
items.ex_zh: 拆除小组使用烈性炸药在几秒钟内将那座危房仓库夷为平地。

items.def_en: To knock someone down onto the floor or ground with a punch or strike
items.ex_en: A ferocious right hook managed to floor the reigning heavyweight boxing champion instantly.
items.ex_zh: 一记凶狠的右勾拳瞬间将卫冕的重量级拳击冠军打翻在地。

items.def_en: to cut down a tree; to knock someone down with a heavy blow
items.ex_en: Fierce autumn gales managed to fell several venerable trees along the forest path.
items.ex_zh: 凛冽的秋季大风刮倒了林间小道旁的数棵参天古树。

groups.summary_en: This frame relates to bringing upright structures, trees, or persons crashing to the ground through chopping, striking, or forceful impact.
groups.summary_zh: 通过挥砍、重击或施加蛮力将直立人或树木摧折击倒于地。
groups.desc_en: Denotes applying physical or political force to abruptly collapse, cut, or overthrow an upright structure, person, or regime, contrasting with gradual decay or voluntary stepping down.
groups.desc_zh: 指施加外力或政治力量将直立物、躯体或统治政权猛烈砍断、推翻或击倒，区别于自然枯朽颓败或主动退位让贤。
groups.nuance_en: fell: cut down a standing tree, or strike a person flat to the ground (timber / tree / opponent) · topple: unbalance and cause a heavy structure or government to fall (regime / statue / monument) · cut down: sever at the base, or ruthlessly curtail numbers (tree / forest / soldier) · level: demolish completely flat with the terrain (city / building / forest) · floor: knock completely flat with a single concussive blow (boxer / rival / opponent) · hew down: chop down heavily with an axe or blade (tree / branch / enemy)
groups.nuance_zh: fell: 砍倒挺拔巨木，或重击使对手轰然倒地 (timber / tree / opponent) · topple: 破坏平衡使重型建筑、雕像或政府轰然倾覆 (regime / statue / monument) · cut down: 从底部锯断砍倒，或残酷扫射戕害 (tree / forest / soldier) · level: 将建筑或整座城镇彻底夷为平地 (city / building / forest) · floor: 一拳或沉重一击将人彻底干翻在地 (boxer / rival / opponent) · hew down: 用斧刃势大力沉地连续砍劈放倒 (tree / branch / enemy)

groups.name: Broadcast & Beam · 广播与无线传输 (Broadcast, Transmit, Beam)
groups.tip: 通过电波卫星向大众播放信息

items.def_zh: 广播，播送（电视或广播节目）
items.def_en: Send out sound or television programs via radio waves or digital transmission for public reception
items.ex_en: The national television network will broadcast the presidential debate live across the country.
items.ex_zh: 国家电视网将在全国范围内现场直播这场总统辩论。
items.ex2_en: The live concert broadcasted smoothly to millions of online listeners worldwide yesterday.
items.ex2_zh: 昨天的现场音乐会顺利向全球数百万在线听众进行了广播播出。

items.def_zh: 通过卫星播送，经人造卫星传输
items.def_en: To broadcast, transmit, or relay a television or radio signal via a satellite.
items.ex_en: The international news network will satellite the live concert to millions of overseas viewers.
items.ex_zh: 该国际新闻网络将通过卫星向数百万海外观众转播这场现场音乐会。

items.def_zh: 定向发送（无线电信号、电视节目）
items.def_en: Send radio or television signals or light in a particular direction using electronic equipment
items.ex_en: Transmitters on the mountaintop beam television signals directly toward remote rural communities.
items.ex_zh: 山顶上的发射机将电视信号定向发送到偏远的农村社区。

items.def_en: Broadcast a program simultaneously across two or more different stations, networks, or media
items.ex_en: The media network will simulcast the final championship match on radio and television.
items.ex_zh: 该媒体网络将在广播和电视上同步联播最后的冠军争夺战。

items.def_en: Send out an electrical, radio, or television signal through the air or a communication channel
items.ex_en: High-powered antennae transmit vital telemetry data back to the central research station continuously.
items.ex_zh: 大功率天线持续将至关重要的遥测数据传送回中央研究站。

items.def_en: Receive television, radio, or electronic signals and broadcast them onward
items.ex_en: Communications towers relay live video footage from the mountain valley to headquarters.
items.ex_zh: 通信塔将现场视频画面从山谷中继转播至总部。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the electronic dissemination or relay of audiovisual signals, data, or programming across airwaves, satellites, or digital networks to widespread or remote receivers.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过无线电波、卫星或网络向外发射或转播音视频信号。
groups.desc_en: Involves wide electronic dispersion or targeted electromagnetic transmission of audio, video, or data across space, contrasting with point-to-point wired communication.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过无线电磁波将视音频或数字信号向广阔空间公开发散或定向传输，区别于点对点的传统有线电报电话传输。
groups.nuance_en: broadcast: transmit audio or video program to the public at large (program / message / speech) · beam: direct a concentrated signal or broadcast precisely across space (satellite / signal / image) · transmit: send electromagnetic signals or data electronically between stations (data / frequency / signal) · relay: receive a signal and pass it onward down a transmission chain (signal / message / broadcast) · simulcast: broadcast the exact same program simultaneously across different channels (concert / match / network) · satellite: beam transmission via orbital communications relay (feed / signal / broadcast)
groups.nuance_zh: broadcast: 面向大众公共无线电网公开发送节目信号 (program / message / speech) · beam: 将高度聚焦的电磁波定向发射至远方或太空 (satellite / signal / image) · transmit: 在发射与接收端之间进行电子数据信号传送 (data / frequency / signal) · relay: 接收信号并经中继站将其顺畅转播传递 (signal / message / broadcast) · simulcast: 在多个频道或媒体平台上同频同步联播 (concert / match / network) · satellite: 借助人造通信卫星轨道中继向外传输 (feed / signal / broadcast)

groups.name: Browse & Leaf · 翻阅与浏览 (Thumb, Skim, Peruse)
groups.tip: 随手翻书快速查看内容

items.def_en: Look through a book, store, or web pages casually without a specific goal
items.ex_en: I love to browse the colorful book stalls in the old city market.
items.ex_zh: 我喜欢在老城集市上随意翻看那些色彩斑斓的书摊。

items.def_en: Turn over the pages of a book or magazine in rapid succession without reading every word
items.ex_en: I flipped through the magazine while waiting for my coffee.
items.ex_zh: 在等咖啡的时候，我随手翻了翻杂志。

items.def_en: Turn pages of a publication quickly with one's thumb while browsing
items.ex_en: Passengers often thumb through glossy travel magazines while waiting at the airport gate.
items.ex_zh: 乘客在机场登机口候机时经常随手翻阅精美的旅游杂志。

items.def_en: Look quickly over text to locate specific information or grasp an overview
items.ex_en: The busy executive paused to scan the quarterly financial report for critical anomalies.
items.ex_zh: 那位忙碌的主管停下来快速扫视季度财务报告以寻找关键异常。

items.def_en: (also 'leaf through') To turn the pages of a book, magazine, or document quickly without reading carefully.
items.ex_en: She sat quietly on the bench to leaf through an old photo album.
items.ex_zh: 她静静地坐在长椅上，翻阅着一本泛黄的老相册。

items.def_en: Read quickly through a piece of writing in order to pick out key points
items.ex_en: Students usually skim the introductory chapter to understand the core arguments quickly.
items.ex_zh: 学生们通常会略读绪论章节，以便迅速理解核心论点。

items.def_en: to turn the pages of a book, magazine, or document quickly, reading only fragments
items.ex_en: She sat quietly in the waiting room to leaf through the colorful fashion magazines.
items.ex_zh: 她静静地坐在候诊室里，匆匆翻阅着色彩斑斓的时尚杂志。

groups.summary_en: Captures the act of casually turning pages or glancing across written materials and collections without engaging in methodical reading.
groups.summary_zh: 指随手翻转书页、扫视文本或漫不经心挑选阅览的动作。
groups.desc_en: Denotes non-exhaustive, selective ocular inspection or tactile turning of reading material or items, contrasting with systematic linear reading or thorough textual analysis.
groups.desc_zh: 指对阅读材料或展品进行非详尽、选择性的翻动浏览或视线扫视，区别于系统线性的精读或深入文本分析。
groups.nuance_en: browse: casual, wandering examination without fixed intent (racks / websites / titles) · flip through: rapid, rhythmic turning of pages (magazine / catalog) · thumb through: turning pages with deliberate thumb friction (novel / directory) · scan: rapid ocular sweeping to locate specific data (headlines / crowd / horizon) · skim: surface reading that extracts main points while skipping details (report / chapter)
groups.nuance_zh: browse: 漫无目的或随性的翻看挑选 (racks / websites / titles) · flip through: 快速而有节奏地翻动书页 (magazine / catalog) · thumb through: 用拇指一页页翻阅查阅 (novel / directory) · scan: 目光快速掠过以寻觅特定信息 (headlines / crowd / horizon) · skim: 略过细节仅抓取主旨的略读 (report / chapter)

groups.name: Budget & Allocate · 预算与规划 (Earmark, Allocate, Apportion)
groups.tip: 资金使用的事前规划

items.def_zh: 编制预算，把……编入预算；规划（开支、时间）
items.def_en: to plan the spending of money or use of time carefully; to allocate a specific sum for a purpose
items.ex_en: The finance committee must budget sufficient money for necessary school repairs this year.
items.ex_zh: 财务委员会今年必须为必要的学校修缮规划出足够的预算资金。

items.def_en: To officially authorize the expenditure of public or corporate money for a specific cause
items.ex_en: Parliament will formally appropriate twenty million dollars for regional hospital infrastructure improvements.
items.ex_zh: 议会将正式拨款两千万美元用于区域医院的基础设施改善。

items.def_en: To reserve a particular portion of money, time, or goods for future use
items.ex_en: Sensible households usually set aside a small emergency fund for unexpected medical expenses.
items.ex_zh: 明智的家庭通常会留出一笔小额应急资金，以防意外医疗开支。

items.def_en: To distribute resources or duties according to a systematic plan or quota
items.ex_en: The central committee will allocate equal funding to every department next fiscal year.
items.ex_zh: 中央委员会将在下个财政年度向每个部门分配均等的资金。

items.def_en: To set aside funds or resources for a specific, designated purpose
items.ex_en: City officials decided to earmark surplus revenue specifically for inner-city park revitalization.
items.ex_zh: 市政府官员决定将盈余收入专门划拨用于市区公园的活化改造。

items.def_en: To divide and share out costs, tasks, or resources proportionately among different entities
items.ex_en: The tribunal will apportion clean-up costs equally among the three guilty corporations.
items.ex_zh: 仲裁庭将在三家有过错的公司之间均摊清理费用。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame deal with calculating, designating, and distributing financial resources or time systematically for predetermined purposes.
groups.summary_zh: 指为特定用途审慎计划、分配和预留资金或时间资源。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the authoritative designation, division, and reserving of limited fiscal or material resources for designated purposes, contrasting with general saving, unallocated spending, or indiscriminate pooling.
groups.desc_zh: 指依权威程序将有限的财政或物资配额划分、指定并留作特定用途，区别于一般储蓄、无规划开支或无差别资金池混用。
groups.nuance_en: budget: plan and limit future financial spending (funds / expenses / time) · allocate: apportion a share from a central supply to recipients (resources / quota / spectrum) · earmark: designate funds definitively for a specific, exclusive program (revenues / surplus / grant) · appropriate: formally authorize state funds for public use via legislation (subsidies / millions / aid) · apportion: proportionally divide liabilities or assets among parties (costs / seats / damages)
groups.nuance_zh: budget: 规划并限制未来收支预算 (funds / expenses / time) · allocate: 从总体中按指标分配额度 (resources / quota / spectrum) · earmark: 明确指定专款专用 (revenues / surplus / grant) · appropriate: 经由立法或官方正式划拨公款 (subsidies / millions / aid) · apportion: 按比例分摊责任或资产 (costs / seats / damages)

groups.name: Build & Construct Framework · 搭建构架与构筑 (Erect, Assemble, Fabricate)
groups.tip: 搭建框架搭起骨干结构

items.def_en: To construct or understand a whole structure by joining individual parts together sequentially
items.ex_en: The detectives worked tirelessly to piece together fragmented evidence into a cohesive timeline.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们不知疲倦地工作，将零碎的证据拼接成一个连贯的时间线。

items.def_en: To fit together the separate component parts of a machine, furniture, or skeleton structure
items.ex_en: Factory technicians carefully assemble the intricate steel framework inside the expansive manufacturing warehouse.
items.ex_zh: 工厂技术人员在宽敞的制造车间内仔细组装复杂的钢框架。
items.ex2_en: The curious crowd assembled quickly outside town hall to hear official announcements.
items.ex2_zh: 好奇的人群迅速聚集在市政厅外，聆听官方通告。

items.def_zh: 构筑，搭建骨架；制定，拟定；给……装框；陷害
items.def_en: 1. To construct the framework or skeleton of a building or structure. 2. To formulate or express something in words. 3. To put a border or frame around an object. 4. (informal) To falsely incriminate an innocent person.
items.ex_en: Skilled carpenters worked together to frame the timber walls of the new cottage.
items.ex_zh: 技术熟练的木匠们协同工作，搭建新木屋的木制墙体骨架。

items.def_en: To build, assemble, or raise a vertical structure or framework into position
items.ex_en: Construction workers will erect a monumental scaffolding structure beside the historic cathedral tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 建筑工人明天将在历史悠久的大教堂旁竖立起一座巨大的脚手架结构。

items.def_en: To manufacture or shape structural elements from standardized components or raw materials
items.ex_en: The industrial plant can fabricate high-grade steel beams for large bridge construction projects.
items.ex_zh: 该工业厂房能够为大型桥梁建设项目加工制造高强度的钢梁构件。

items.def_en: To furnish a building or conceptual framework with temporary raised staging or supportive platforms
items.ex_en: Restoration experts will scaffold the entire eastern facade before repairing the delicate stonework.
items.ex_zh: 修复专家将在修补脆弱的石构件之前，为整个东立面架设脚手架。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this construction frame focus on forming the structural skeleton, load-bearing architecture, or foundational outline of physical edifices and conceptual models.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过骨架安装、组件配合来构建建筑物或体系的承重与支撑结构。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the structural assembly, fitting, and physical raising of interconnected load-bearing components into an organized skeleton, contrasting with continuous molding, sculpting, or unstructured mass accumulation.
groups.desc_zh: 指将互锁或衔接的承重构件组装、拼接并立起成骨架结构，区别于连续模压、雕刻或无结构的物料堆砌。
groups.nuance_en: assemble: fit pre-made modular components together (furniture / machinery / team) · frame: construct the foundational skeleton that defines outline (house / chassis / narrative) · erect: hoist and set up tall, vertical structural edifices (crane / monument / scaffolding) · fabricate: manufacture or construct components off-site before installation (steelwork / components) · scaffold: build temporary external support platforms (facade / structure / learning)
groups.nuance_zh: assemble: 拼装预制构件为完整整体 (furniture / machinery / team) · frame: 搭建界定轮廓与承重的骨架结构 (house / chassis / narrative) · erect: 垂直吊立或竖起高大建筑 (crane / monument / scaffolding) · fabricate: 在厂房或车间加工预制部件 (steelwork / components) · scaffold: 搭建临时作业脚手架或梯架 (facade / structure / learning)

groups.name: Bulge & Sag Outward · 突出与凸垂鼓出 (Pooch, Bulge, Bag)
groups.tip: 腹部或口袋向外鼓起

items.def_en: to extend prominently outward from the main body or surface
items.ex_en: Several rusty iron nails stick out dangerously from the weathered wooden fence post.
items.ex_zh: 几枚生锈的铁钉危险地从风化的木栅栏柱上伸了出来。

items.def_en: (of clothes or fabric) to hang loosely or bulge outwards in an unsightly way
items.ex_en: Cheap wool trousers often bag at the knees after only a few wearings.
items.ex_zh: 劣质羊毛裤往往穿过几次之后膝盖处就会松垂鼓起。

items.def_en: (+ out) to bulge, protrude, or puff outward, or cause something to do so
items.ex_en: He overstuffed his heavy coat pockets, causing them to pooch out ridiculously.
items.ex_zh: 他把厚大衣的口袋塞得太满，导致口袋滑稽地鼓了出来。
items.ex2_en: The overloaded knapsack pooched out awkwardly against the weary hiker's lower back.
items.ex2_zh: 装载过重的背包笨拙地凸起，抵在疲惫的徒步者后腰上。

items.def_en: (+ out) to swell or cause to swell out like a belly when filled with wind or air
items.ex_en: Sudden coastal gusts caused the ship's massive canvas sails to belly out proudly.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的沿海阵风使轮船巨大的帆布船帆如腹部般高高鼓起。
items.ex2_en: Strong autumn winds bellied the billowing white curtains into the living room.
items.ex2_zh: 强劲的秋风把翻滚的白色窗帘吹得鼓鼓地飘进客厅。

items.def_en: to swell or protrude noticeably outward from an otherwise flat surface
items.ex_en: His swollen wallet caused his back pocket to bulge visibly through his trousers.
items.ex_zh: 鼓胀的钱包使他的裤子后口袋明显地凸了出来。

items.def_en: to jut out or thrust forward from the surrounding boundary or area
items.ex_en: Sharp limestone rocks protrude from the shallow waters along this treacherous reef coastline.
items.ex_zh: 锋利的石灰岩暗礁沿着这条险恶的海岸线从浅水中突出。

groups.summary_en: Covers physical shapes, clothing, or flesh jutting outwards awkwardly, protruding from a contour, or drooping slackly into an unsightly hump or pouch.
groups.summary_zh: 指衣物、肉肚或轮廓向外难看地隆起、鼓出或松弛下垂外凸。
groups.desc_en: Denotes outward deformation, convex swelling, or sag under internal pressure, gravity, or laxity, contrasting with uniform expansion, geometric extrusion, or concave collapse.
groups.desc_zh: 指物体因内部压力、重力负荷或松弛而向外凸出、鼓胀或垂坠变形，区别于均匀膨胀、刚性几何外延或凹陷内缩。
groups.nuance_en: bulge: swell outward tightly under internal strain or fullness (pockets / muscles / eyes) · protrude: project forward or outward past a standard surface line (jaw / branch / nail) · pooch: gather into an unsightly soft outward pouch (belly / fabric) · bag: sag loosely into voluminous, hanging folds (trousers / eyes / fabric) · belly: swell convexly outward like a sail or filled chamber (sails / curtain)
groups.nuance_zh: bulge: 因内部充盈或受压而紧绷鼓出 (pockets / muscles / eyes) · protrude: 越过标准平面向外探出或伸出 (jaw / branch / nail) · pooch: 松软地凸起成小腹状或囊袋 (belly / fabric) · bag: 呈松垮下垂的囊状垂落 (trousers / eyes / fabric) · belly: 像风帆般受力凸起鼓出 (sails / curtain)

groups.name: Bungle & Botch · 笨拙搞砸与办糟 (Botch, Bungle, Mess up)
groups.tip: 粗心大意导致行动彻底搞砸

items.def_en: To handle a matter poorly or throw a plan into disarray through carelessness
items.ex_en: One minor clerical error could completely mess up our carefully organized travel schedule.
items.ex_zh: 一个小小的文书错误就可能彻底搞乱我们精心安排的旅行日程。

items.def_en: To miss or handle clumsily a shot, line, or golden opportunity
items.ex_en: The nervous goalkeeper managed to muff the easy save during the final minutes.
items.ex_zh: 紧张的守门员在最后几分钟里笨拙地错失了这次轻松的扑救。

items.def_en: 1. (informal) To bungle, mess up, or make a clumsy error in doing or performing something.
items.ex_en: The nervous actor started to flub his opening lines before the live audience.
items.ex_zh: 这位紧张的演员在现场观众面前开始讲错自己的开场台词。

items.def_en: To mismanage, ruin, or bungle an undertaking completely
items.ex_en: Do not rush this critical experiment, or you will screw up the results.
items.ex_zh: 不要匆忙进行这个关键实验，否则你会把实验结果全搞砸的。

items.def_en: To ruin or spoil something by clumsy, careless, or shoddy workmanship
items.ex_en: Inexperienced mechanics can easily botch the delicate engine repair without the proper manual.
items.ex_zh: 缺乏经验的机修工若无恰当手册，很容易粗制滥造搞砸精密发动机的维修。

items.def_en: To carry out a task clumsily, incompetently, and with disastrously poor results
items.ex_en: Incompetent junior officers bungle the routine administrative procedure through sheer lack of attention.
items.ex_zh: 无能的初级军官纯粹因粗心大意而把常规行政程序办得一塌糊涂。

groups.summary_en: Characterizes handling a task, job, or performance with utter clumsiness, incompetence, or incompetence that results in poor execution.
groups.summary_zh: 强调执行动作或处理事务笨拙拙劣，彻底弄糟任务。
groups.desc_en: Denotes clumsy, incompetent, or careless execution that spoils a task or ruins an opportunity, contrasting with calculated sabotage, system failure, or blameless misfortune.
groups.desc_zh: 指因笨拙、无能或粗心大意而把任务或良机搞砸弄糟，区别于蓄意破坏、系统性崩溃或不可抗力的纯粹不幸。
groups.nuance_en: bungle: ruin through gross clumsiness, mismanagement, or tactical incompetence (investigation / raid / negotiations) · botch: patch, repair, or execute crudely and defectively (repair / surgery / job) · flub: make an embarrassing, clumsy slip in performance or delivery (line / shot / cue) · muff: miss or mishandle an easy athletic catch or obvious opportunity (catch / chance / punt) · screw up: informal, pervasive disruption or ruining of a situation (plan / relationship / life)
groups.nuance_zh: bungle: 因笨拙失误或处置不力而全盘搞砸 (investigation / raid / negotiations) · botch: 手艺粗糙或拙劣修补把活做烂 (repair / surgery / job) · flub: 在表演、台词或发挥中丢丑失手 (line / shot / cue) · muff: 错失极易把握的接球或绝佳良机 (catch / chance / punt) · screw up: 口语中把事情或局面搞得一团糟 (plan / relationship / life)

groups.name: Burden & Encumber · 加负与拖累 (Weigh Down, Encumber, Saddle)
groups.tip: 施加重担或造成牵绊

items.def_zh: 给……加重担，使承受负担；烦扰，拖累
items.def_en: To weigh someone or something down with a heavy load, responsibility, or emotional worry.
items.ex_en: Severe financial liabilities heavily burden the newly appointed managing director with unbearable anxiety.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的财务债务给新任命的总经理带来了不堪忍受的沉重负担与焦虑。

items.def_zh: 压垮；使心事重重；沉重压迫
items.def_en: To make someone heavy, slow, or depressed by a physical load or severe worries
items.ex_en: She felt weighed down by domestic responsibilities and work pressures.
items.ex_zh: 她感到家庭责任和工作压力压得自己喘不过气来。

items.def_en: (+ with) To place an unwelcome responsibility, debt, or task on someone
items.ex_en: The retired father did not wish to saddle his children with heavy debts.
items.ex_zh: 这位退休的父亲不希望让自己的孩子们承担沉重的债务。

items.def_en: To put too much weight or work on someone or something
items.ex_en: Managers must not overload vulnerable novice employees with unrealistic project deadlines every week.
items.ex_zh: 经理们绝不能每周都给脆弱的新手员工安排不切实际的项目截止日期使其负担过重。

items.def_en: To place an excessive load or financial charge on a person or system
items.ex_en: Excessive administrative fees threaten to surcharge the struggling municipal transport authority beyond capacity.
items.ex_zh: 高昂的管理费用恐将给苦苦挣扎的市政交通管理部门带来超出承受能力的过重负担。

items.def_en: To restrict someone's movement or actions by placing heavy loads or legal claims on them
items.ex_en: Unresolved legal disputes will severely encumber the sale of the historic commercial estate.
items.ex_zh: 未决的法律纷争将极大地拖累这座具有历史意义的商业地产的出售。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to imposing onerous duties, physical mass, debts, or emotional strain that severely hamper freedom of movement or function.
groups.summary_zh: 指施加沉重的物质、责任、债务或精神重负，使之不堪负重或行动受阻。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the imposition of oppressive physical, fiscal, or moral weight that impedes free movement, progress, or vitality, contrasting with simple assignment of duty or voluntary bearing.
groups.desc_zh: 指施加压迫性的物理、财务或精神重负而阻碍自由活动、进展或生命力，区别于合理的工作指派或主动承载。
groups.nuance_en: burden: impose heavy, oppressive obligations or emotional weight (taxpayers / conscience / family) · weigh down: drag downward physically or spiritually so motion stalls (branches / spirits / luggage) · saddle: unfairly or unavoidably encumber with an onerous lingering liability (debt / legacy / responsibility) · encumber: impede physical movement or legal title with hindrances (estate / runner / operations) · overload: place excessive functional strain exceeding design capacity (grid / circuits / system)
groups.nuance_zh: burden: 施加压迫性的责任或精神重压 (taxpayers / conscience / family) · weigh down: 在物理或精神上沉重拖拽使其难以行动 (branches / spirits / luggage) · saddle: 使其硬性背负难甩掉的债务或包袱 (debt / legacy / responsibility) · encumber: 在空间、行动或产权上设置羁绊阻碍 (estate / runner / operations) · overload: 超出系统或机能的额定承载负荷 (grid / circuits / system)

groups.name: Bury & Cremate · 殡葬与安葬 (Bury, Inter, Cremate)
groups.tip: 遗体火化或入土安葬仪式

items.def_en: To place a dead body into the ground or a tomb, typically accompanied by funeral rites
items.ex_en: Mourners gathered in the peaceful countryside cemetery to bury the beloved village doctor.
items.ex_zh: 哀悼者聚集在宁静的乡村墓地，安葬这位受人爱戴的乡村医生。

items.def_en: To bury a dead body with appropriate ceremony and solemn respect
items.ex_en: The decorated war hero was finally laid to rest with full military honors.
items.ex_zh: 这位屡建功勋的战斗英雄最终在隆重的军礼中入土为安。

items.def_en: To deposit a dead body into an earth grave or crypt during a formal burial service
items.ex_en: Priests gathered yesterday to inter the archbishop inside the cathedral's consecrated underground crypt.
items.ex_zh: 神职人员昨天齐聚一堂，将大主教安葬在大教堂神圣的地下墓穴中。

items.def_en: 1. To burn the body of a dead person to ashes, usually as part of a funeral service.
items.ex_en: According to her final wishes, the family chose to cremate her mortal remains.
items.ex_zh: 根据她的遗愿，家人选择将其遗体火化。

items.def_en: To dig up a corpse from the ground or tomb, typically for investigation or reburial
items.ex_en: State forensic experts will exhume the remains tomorrow to conduct further toxicological tests.
items.ex_zh: 国家法医专家将于明天掘出遗骸，以进行进一步的毒理学检测。

items.def_en: To place a deceased body inside a tomb, vault, or monument
items.ex_en: Ancient masons carved elaborate limestone sepulchers to entomb the deceased pharaoh in glory.
items.ex_zh: 古代石匠雕凿了精致的石灰岩墓室，以荣耀地将去世的法老葬入墓穴。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses formal and ritual actions taken to lay a deceased body to rest, whether by interment in the earth or tomb, or reduction to ashes by heat.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过火化、土葬等仪式对遗体进行最终安葬与处理。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the ritual, sacred, or legal disposition of human remains through sub-surface internment or thermal reduction, contrasting with biological decomposition, medical disposal, or morbid concealment.
groups.desc_zh: 指依法定、宗教或仪式程序，通过入土掩埋或高温火化处理人类遗体，区别于自然生物分解、医疗废弃处置或犯罪匿尸。
groups.nuance_en: bury: deposit beneath the earth's surface in ground or grave (corpse / ashes / treasure) · inter: formal ritual burial of a body or urn in a grave (remains / body / urn) · cremate: incinerate human remains to granular ashes (body / corpse / pet) · exhume: legally unearth a buried body for forensic or relocation reasons (remains / corpse / grave) · entomb: enclose irrevocably within a stone crypt, vault, or collapsed cavern (monarch / miners / sarcophagus)
groups.nuance_zh: bury: 掩埋入土或通用下葬 (corpse / ashes / treasure) · inter: 庄重仪式性地入土或入墓穴安葬 (remains / body / urn) · cremate: 将遗体高温火化为骨灰 (body / corpse / pet) · exhume: 经合法程序起掘发掘已葬遗体 (remains / corpse / grave) · entomb: 封入永久性石棺、墓室或塌方地穴 (monarch / miners / sarcophagus)

groups.name: Bury & Entomb · 安葬与埋葬 (Inter, Inhume, Lay to Rest)
groups.tip: 装殓入棺长眠于墓穴之中

items.def_en: To place a dead body in the earth or a tomb, usually with funeral ceremonies
items.ex_en: Sorrowful relatives gathered at the hilltop cemetery to bury their grandfather beside his wife.
items.ex_zh: 悲伤的亲属齐聚山顶墓地，将祖父安葬在他妻子的身旁。

items.def_en: To bury someone with ceremony and respect
items.ex_en: The elderly statesman was laid to rest yesterday in a private family ceremony.
items.ex_zh: 这位年迈的政治家昨天在一场私人家庭仪式中被安葬入土。

items.def_en: To deposit a dead body in the earth; bury
items.ex_en: Mourners assembled at dusk to inhume the fallen chieftain within the sacred earth.
items.ex_zh: 哀悼者于黄昏时分聚集，将阵亡的首领土葬于神圣的土地之中。

items.def_en: To bury a dead body formally in a grave or tomb
items.ex_en: The fallen soldiers were solemnly interred in the national cemetery yesterday afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 阵亡士兵于昨天下午被庄严安葬在国家公墓中。

items.def_zh: 将……装殓入棺；把……装入小盒中
items.def_en: To place a dead body inside a coffin; to put or enclose something in a small chest or casket.
items.ex_en: The sorrowful attendants casketed the fallen monarch within the ornate family vault.
items.ex_zh: 悲痛的侍从们将驾崩的君王装殓入华丽的家族墓室之中。

items.def_en: To place a dead body in a tomb, crypt, or monument
items.ex_en: Ancient Egyptian pharaohs were entombed inside massive stone pyramids with immense treasures.
items.ex_zh: 古埃及法老被深埋于巨大的石质金字塔内，身旁伴随无数珍宝。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to the formal or solemn act of placing a deceased person's body into a grave, vault, or coffin as part of funerary rites.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及将遗体安置入棺、墓穴或地下的安葬行为。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the solemn enshrinement or subterranean sealing of dead bodies inside sepulchers, vaults, or formal graves, contrasting with makeshift outdoor burial, disposal, or cremation.
groups.desc_zh: 指将遗体庄严安放并封存入墓穴、石棺或地底陵墓的殡葬过程，区别于简易就地掩埋、抛尸或火化。
groups.nuance_en: lay to rest: gentle, euphemistic liturgical committal of a person to the grave (leader / comrade / fears) · inter: solemn, official liturgical placement in earth or vault (victim / hero / ash) · inhume: technical or archaic term for burial specifically in soil (body / mortal remains) · entomb: seal immovably within a crypt, mausoleum, or solid stone (king / pharaoh / martyrs) · casket: place a deceased body into a ceremonial coffin (body / remains)
groups.nuance_zh: lay to rest: 委婉温和的安魂与入土为安 (leader / comrade / fears) · inter: 严肃正式的入穴或下葬仪式 (victim / hero / ash) · inhume: 专指将遗体土葬的术语或古称 (body / mortal remains) · entomb: 封置入宏伟陵墓、石棺或墓穴 (king / pharaoh / martyrs) · casket: 将遗体装殓入柩或收殓 (body / remains)

groups.name: Cache & Stash · 隐藏与储藏 (Stash, Hoard, Squirrel Away)
groups.tip: 藏匿储存于隐秘处

items.def_en: To hide or store a reserve of money or goods gradually in a safe place for future use
items.ex_en: She had squirreled away a tidy sum of cash inside an old shoebox.
items.ex_zh: 她在一个旧鞋盒里偷偷存下了一笔可观的现金。

items.def_en: To store something neatly in a discreet, private, or out-of-the-way spot
items.ex_en: He tucked away the precious heirloom inside a secret compartment behind the bookshelf.
items.ex_zh: 他把珍贵的传家宝藏在书架后面的暗格里。

items.def_en: To save or stow away money or assets secretly for future security
items.ex_en: Grandpa salted away a portion of his monthly pension for emergency medical needs.
items.ex_zh: 爷爷每月把一部分养老金存起来备用，以防突发的医疗开销。

items.def_zh: 隐藏，储藏；（计算机）存入高速缓冲存储器
items.def_en: to hide or store supplies, weapons, or digital data in a secret or fast-access place
items.ex_en: The weary travelers cached their remaining emergency supplies deep within the mountain cavern.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的旅人们把剩余的应急物资储藏在深山洞穴之中。

items.def_en: (+ away) To store or hide an item or money safely, secretly, or quickly
items.ex_en: He quickly stashed away the stolen diamond necklace under his mattress before police entered.
items.ex_zh: 在警察进门前，他迅速把偷来的钻石项链藏在了床垫底下。

items.def_en: To collect and store large quantities of food, money, or goods beyond present needs
items.ex_en: Panicked residents began to hoard bottled water and canned goods before the storm.
items.ex_zh: 恐慌的居民在暴风雨来临前开始囤积瓶装水和罐头食品。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail concealing valuables, ammunition, provisions, or data in secure, covert spots for future retrieval.
groups.summary_zh: 为防被盗或以备未来使用，将贵重物品或物资秘密隐匿、封存。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the secretive, prudent, or clandestine concealment of valuables, provisions, or contraband in secure hiding spots for future emergency retrieval, contrasting with public warehousing or immediate consumption.
groups.desc_zh: 指为防备紧急事态或躲避搜查，将贵重财物、物资或违禁品隐秘储存在安全密闭之处，区别于公开仓储或随用随取。
groups.nuance_en: stash: hastily conceal in a secret, handy hiding place (cash / drugs / loot) · cache: store supplies or weapons in a secure, hidden logistical depot (weapons / provisions / munitions) · squirrel away: hoard small amounts incrementally for lean times (savings / snacks / earnings) · salt away: prudently accumulate financial assets securely over time (fortune / capital / bonuses) · hoard: greedily or compulsively amass goods beyond need without parting (food / gold / supplies)
groups.nuance_zh: stash: 匆忙藏匿在秘密近手之处 (cash / drugs / loot) · cache: 将物资武器建立隐秘补给点存放 (weapons / provisions / munitions) · squirrel away: 细水长流地积攒物资防备荒歉 (savings / snacks / earnings) · salt away: 谨慎稳妥地长线存下私房钱或资本 (fortune / capital / bonuses) · hoard: 贪婪或病态地过度囤积屯聚 (food / gold / supplies)

groups.name: Cackle & Guffaw · 刺耳尖笑与狂笑 (Guffaw, Shriek, Howl)
groups.tip: 发出各种神态与声调的笑声

items.def_zh: 突然哈哈大笑，捧腹大笑
items.def_en: To burst suddenly and uncontrollably into loud, hearty laughter
items.ex_en: Her impression of the boss made everyone in the room crack up.
items.ex_zh: 她模仿老板的样子让屋里的所有人都笑得前仰后合。
items.ex2_en: The reckless driver managed to crack up his father's expensive luxury car.
items.ex2_zh: 那个鲁莽的司机把他父亲昂贵的豪华轿车给撞毁了。

items.def_en: (+ with laughter) To laugh with deep, full-throated, resounding volume
items.ex_en: The entire auditorium roared with laughter at the comedian's brilliant punchline.
items.ex_zh: 全场观众被喜剧演员绝妙的妙语逗得放声大笑。

items.def_en: (+ with laughter) To make a loud, sustained vocal sound expressing intense, helpless amusement
items.ex_en: The boys howled with laughter as their friend slipped playfully into the mud.
items.ex_zh: 看到朋友嬉闹着滑进泥坑，男孩子们止不住地狂笑起来。

items.def_en: To laugh loudly and boisterously, often in an uninhibited or crude fashion
items.ex_en: The drunk sailors guffawed loudly at the barkeep's rather crude and bawdy joke.
items.ex_zh: 喝醉的水手们听了酒保粗鄙低俗的笑话后放肆地狂笑起来。

items.def_en: To emit a high-pitched, piercing sound of extreme amusement or delight
items.ex_en: The teenagers shrieked with delighted laughter when the surprise party was revealed.
items.ex_zh: 当惊喜派对揭晓时，少年们发出了兴奋愉悦的尖声大笑。

items.def_zh: 发出刺耳的笑声，咯咯地大笑；（母鸡）咯咯叫
items.def_en: To laugh loudly in a shrill, unpleasant way, or (of a bird) to make a harsh, noisy cry.
items.ex_en: The wicked old witch cackled maliciously as her dark potion began to brew.
items.ex_zh: 邪恶的老巫婆在黑药水开始沸腾时发出了阴险刺耳的咯咯笑声。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe vocal laughter that is unusually loud, harsh, shrill, or uninhibited, contrasting sharply with discreet giggles or quiet chuckles.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重发出响亮刺耳、放肆尖锐或不可抑制的大笑声。
groups.desc_en: Denotes harsh, uncontrolled, high-decibel, or unseemly vocal expressions of laughter or derision, contrasting with pleasant chuckling, warm smiling, or polite amusement.
groups.desc_zh: 指刺耳、失控、高分贝或失态放肆的爆发性笑声或嘲谑，区别于悦耳的低笑、含蓄微笑或礼貌性捧腹。
groups.nuance_en: cackle: emit shrill, sharp, hen-like laughter associated with malice or mischief (witch / villain / hen) · guffaw: burst into loud, coarse, boisterous belly laughter (crowd / audience / men) · howl: emit prolonged, uncontrollable shrieks of hilarity (audience / wolves / wind) · shriek: utter high-pitched piercing laughs or screams under sudden mirth or terror (laughter / delight / wind) · crack up: suddenly succumb to helpless, convulsive laughter (class / audience / friend)
groups.nuance_zh: cackle: 发出如母鸡般尖锐刺耳、略带恶意的咯咯笑 (witch / villain / hen) · guffaw: 爆发粗犷、响亮而放肆的捧腹大笑 (crowd / audience / men) · howl: 因极度好笑而发出持续的狂笑嚎叫 (audience / wolves / wind) · shriek: 刺耳尖声尖笑或狂叫 (laughter / delight / wind) · crack up: 突然忍不住当场笑破肚皮或失态 (class / audience / friend)

groups.name: Call & Telephone · 致电与拨通 (Ring, Call Up, Dial)
groups.tip: 口头大声呼叫或拨打电话

items.def_en: To make telephone contact with someone
items.ex_en: Please call your mother tonight to let her know that you arrived safely.
items.ex_zh: 今晚请给你妈妈打个电话，告诉她你已经平安到达。

items.def_en: To make a telephone call to someone.
items.ex_en: I will phone the hotel reception directly to confirm our room reservations later.
items.ex_zh: 我稍后会直接给酒店前台打电话以确认我们的客房预订。

items.def_zh: 打电话（主要用于英式英语）
items.def_en: (especially British) To telephone someone
items.ex_en: I will ring you back tomorrow morning as soon as the shop opens.
items.ex_zh: 明天早上一开店，我就会立刻给你回电话。

items.def_en: To dial someone's phone number and speak with them
items.ex_en: She called up her former college roommate to share the exciting job offer.
items.ex_zh: 她打电话给以前的大学室友，分享获得了理想职位的喜讯。

items.def_en: To make a telephone call to someone
items.ex_en: The cashier rang up the items and gave me the receipt.
items.ex_zh: 收银员为商品扫码结账并把收据递给了我。

items.def_en: To select digits on a telephone to initiate a connection
items.ex_en: He nervously dialed the emergency operator when smoke began filling the hallway.
items.ex_zh: 浓烟弥漫走廊时，他紧张地拨通了紧急求助电话。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe initiating voice telecommunication or placing a contact request over fixed or mobile telephone infrastructure.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过固定电话、移动设备或网络语音系统发起通话联络。
groups.desc_en: Denotes establishing telephonic audio or data connection over telecommunication networks, contrasting with face-to-face vocal summoning, radio broadcasting, or text messaging.
groups.desc_zh: 指经由电讯网络接通音频或数据通讯，区别于当面呼唤、无线广播喊话或文本通信。
groups.nuance_en: call: general initiation of telephone communication (office / doctor / emergency) · phone: establish contact explicitly using telephone infrastructure (home / police / headquarters) · ring: sound the acoustic alert on a recipient's telephone (friend / doorbell / changes) · dial: enter the numeric digits to route a connection (number / code / 911) · call up: summon someone deliberately by telephone (reservist / source / contact)
groups.nuance_zh: call: 打电话发起通信的通用称呼 (office / doctor / emergency) · phone: 使用电话设备建立通话 (home / police / headquarters) · ring: 拨打让对方电话铃声响起 (friend / doorbell / changes) · dial: 拨按电话号码数字寻呼 (number / code / 911) · call up: 特意致电联系或通电话 (reservist / source / contact)

groups.name: Calm & Quiet · 平息与缓和 (Soothe, Hush, Muffle)
groups.tip: 安抚躁动让环境与心绪宁静

items.def_en: (informal) Become calmer and less agitated or angry after a period of excitement or rage
items.ex_en: The angry customer took a deep breath and simmered down after being offered compensation.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的顾客在获得赔偿后深吸了一口气，逐渐平息了怒火。
items.ex2_en: The patient nurse simmered down the distressed toddler with a soothing bedtime story.
items.ex2_zh: 耐心的护士用一个轻柔的睡前故事让焦虑哭闹的幼儿平静了下来。

items.def_en: to make someone or something calm or less noisy, or to become calm or quiet.
items.ex_en: The experienced teacher struggled to quiet the excited children after the morning recess.
items.ex_zh: 早休结束后，这位经验丰富的老师费了好大劲才让兴奋的孩子们安静下来。
items.ex2_en: The rowdy crowd quieted instantly when the headmaster stepped onto the stage.
items.ex2_zh: 当校长走上舞台时，吵闹的人群立刻安静了下来。

items.def_en: Gently calm someone down, relieve their anxiety, or ease physical discomfort
items.ex_en: The gentle classical music helped to soothe the exhausted patient's growing anxiety.
items.ex_zh: 轻柔的古典音乐有助于抚慰这位疲惫病人日益增长的焦虑感。

items.def_en: Make someone or something become quiet, or suddenly stop speaking or making noise
items.ex_en: A sudden winter chill hushed the noisy whispers of the gathering crowd outside.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的冬日寒意让室外聚集人群的嘈杂低语瞬间静了下来。
items.ex2_en: The excited audience hushed completely as the famous pianist took his seat.
items.ex2_zh: 当那位著名钢琴家就座时，激动的观众彻底安静了下来。

items.def_zh: 压低，使（声音）变沉闷隔绝
items.def_en: Deaden or wrap something to make a sound less loud, distinct, or audible
items.ex_en: She pressed a soft woolen scarf against her mouth to muffle her sobs.
items.ex_zh: 她把一条柔软的羊毛围巾捂在嘴上，以压低自己的抽泣声。

items.def_zh: 制伏，压抑平息（骚动或情绪）
items.def_en: Bring a person, feeling, or noise under control by superior force or restrained authority
items.ex_en: The riot police quickly moved into position to subdue the violent street protests.
items.ex_zh: 防暴警察迅速就位，以制伏并平息街头的暴力抗议活动。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote diminishing acoustic noise, turbulent motion, or emotional agitation into a tranquil, quiet state. They describe actions ranging from hushing audible commotion to soothing ruffled feelings or stifling sounds.
groups.summary_zh: 使声音低落沉寂，或使烦躁骚动的情绪与场面平息下来。
groups.desc_en: Denotes reducing acoustic disturbance, emotional fury, or kinetic turmoil to restore tranquility, stillness, or control, contrasting with complete extermination, active provocation, or natural decay.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过抚平、压制或吸收减弱声浪、情绪狂躁或骚乱动态以恢复宁静平和，区别于暴力毁灭、挑衅激化或自然静默。
groups.nuance_en: soothe: comfort, alleviate distress, or pacify pain gently (nerves / infant / conscience) · quiet: reduce noise, vocalization, or turbulent agitation to stillness (crowd / fears / room) · hush: induce immediate, reverent or conspiratorial silence (room / baby / critics) · muffle: deaden or dull acoustic sound by wrapping or barriers (sound / footsteps / drums) · subdue: bring wild energy, riotous behavior, or passions firmly under control (rebellion / attacker / impulse)
groups.nuance_zh: soothe: 柔和地抚慰神经、平息疼痛或焦虑 (nerves / infant / conscience) · quiet: 使噪杂人群或纷乱思绪静下来 (crowd / fears / room) · hush: 使立时肃静、噤声或嘘止 (room / baby / critics) · muffle: 用包裹物隔绝阻隔声音使其低沉 (sound / footsteps / drums) · subdue: 以克制力或权威强行压制驯服骚乱或冲动 (rebellion / attacker / impulse)

groups.name: Camp & Bivouac · 扎营与露宿 (Pitch, Bivouac, Rough it)
groups.tip: 户外搭建帐篷过夜栖息

items.def_en: To set up a tent and live outdoors temporarily.
items.ex_en: We decided to camp near the clear mountain stream for two pleasant nights.
items.ex_zh: 我们决定在清澈的山间溪流旁扎营度过两个愉快的夜晚。

items.def_en: To set up tents and establish a campsite
items.ex_en: The weary exploration team decided to pitch camp before total darkness fell across the valley.
items.ex_zh: 疲倦的探险队决定在黑夜彻底笼罩山谷之前安营扎寨。

items.def_en: To live for a short time in conditions that are not comfortable or lack modern amenities
items.ex_en: During their budget road trip through the desert, the college students had to rough it.
items.ex_zh: 在穿越沙漠的穷游途中，大学生们不得不忍受艰苦简陋的生活。

items.def_en: To sleep outside in a tent or sleeping bag rather than inside a permanent building
items.ex_en: Hundreds of excited fans decided to camp out overnight on the pavement outside the arena.
items.ex_zh: 数百名热情的歌迷决定在场馆外的人行道上露营过夜。

items.def_en: To settle in a camp, especially of soldiers or travelers establishing tents
items.ex_en: The imperial legions encamped along the mist-shrouded riverbank awaiting the morning signal.
items.ex_zh: 帝国军团在薄雾笼罩的河岸边扎营宿营，等待清晨的信号。

items.def_zh: 露宿，野营（通常指简陋无帐篷）
items.def_en: To stay in a temporary camp without tents or substantial shelter, especially outdoors overnight
items.ex_en: The stranded alpine climbers had to bivouac on a narrow ledge without any sleeping bags.
items.ex_zh: 受困的高山攀登者不得不没有任何睡袋地在狭窄的岩架上露宿过夜。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe setting up temporary shelter outdoors, sleeping in tents or under the open sky, ranging from comfortable recreational camping to improvised survival stays.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及在户外搭建帐篷、露营或无遮蔽露宿的动作。
groups.desc_en: Denotes establishing temporary outdoor shelters or encampments in natural terrain for military, recreational, or survival purposes, contrasting with permanent residence, hotel lodging, or continuous trekking.
groups.desc_zh: 指因军事、休闲或野外生存需要，在户外自然地带搭建临时居所或露宿，区别于永久定居、旅店投宿或昼夜不歇的行军跋涉。
groups.nuance_en: camp: inhabit temporary outdoor shelters like tents for recreation or utility (scouts / hikers / refugees) · pitch camp: erect tents and establish an orderly site infrastructure (expedition / platoon) · bivouac: camp temporarily without tents or substantial shelter under emergency or tactical conditions (troops / climbers / platoon) · rough it: live outdoors without standard modern amenities or comforts (travelers / family / weekend) · encamp: systematically settle armed troops or large nomadic groups in formation (army / tribe / forces)
groups.nuance_zh: camp: 通用的野外扎营或露营生活 (scouts / hikers / refugees) · pitch camp: 动手撑起帐篷、建立营盘 (expedition / platoon) · bivouac: 在无帐篷简易条件下露天露宿 (troops / climbers / platoon) · rough it: 舍弃现代舒适过原生态艰苦户外日子 (travelers / family / weekend) · encamp: 军队或部族大规模安营扎寨设驻 (army / tribe / forces)

groups.name: Campaign & Crusade · 倡导与奋战 (Campaign, Crusade, Champion, Agitate)
groups.tip: 为特定社会理想投身长期斗争

items.def_en: (+ for/against) To take part in a planned series of activities to achieve a social, political, or commercial goal
items.ex_en: Local environmental activists campaigned vigorously for stricter emission standards across all major factories.
items.ex_zh: 当地环保活动人士积极开展运动，争取对所有大型工厂实施更严格的排放标准。

items.def_en: To try to persuade politicians or officials to support or defeat a specific law or policy
items.ex_en: Corporate representatives frequently lobby congressional members to weaken existing environmental safety regulations.
items.ex_zh: 企业代表频繁游说国会议员，试图削弱现行的环境安全法规。

items.def_zh: 游说竞选，进行巡回演说
items.def_en: (+ for) To travel around an area making political campaign speeches before an election
items.ex_en: The charismatic young senator has been stumping for his party's chosen candidate all week.
items.ex_zh: 那位极富魅力的年轻参议员整个星期都在为党内指定的候选人巡回演说竞选。

items.def_en: To fight for, speak publicly in support of, or defend a cause, right, or principle
items.ex_en: She dedicated her entire career to champion the fundamental legal rights of marginalized workers.
items.ex_zh: 她倾注了整个职业生涯，竭力捍卫边缘工人群体的基本法定权益。

items.def_zh: 投身运动，奋力争取，长期奋战；参加十字军东征
items.def_en: To fight or campaign vigorously for a cause or against something regarded as an evil.
items.ex_en: The dedicated doctor continued to crusade against the unchecked spread of infectious diseases.
items.ex_zh: 这位敬业的医生继续投身于抗击传染病肆虐蔓延的长期斗争之中。

items.def_en: (+ for/against) To argue strongly and publicly in order to build support for political or social change
items.ex_en: Dissident intellectuals began to agitate publicly for democratic political reforms across the country.
items.ex_zh: 持不同政见的知识分子开始公开呼吁并在全国范围内力争民主政治改革。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers engaging in energetic, organized public action to promote a cause, reform, or policy, spanning from formal political campaigning to fierce activist crusading.
groups.summary_zh: 强调为特定理念或社会变革积极奔走、游说与奋战。
groups.desc_en: Denotes leading or participating in an aggressive, sustained, and organized public struggle for an ideological cause, reform, or policy, contrasting with passive intellectual support or solitary, quiet lobbying.
groups.desc_zh: 指为某一社会变革、意识形态或政策诉求发起或投身于旷日持久、有组织的公开奋战，区别于单纯纸上谈兵的赞成或私下寡言游说。
groups.nuance_en: campaign: execute structured operations to achieve public, legal, or social goals (rights / reform / election) · crusade: wage an impassioned, moralistic war against a perceived evil (corruption / poverty / injustice) · champion: aggressively defend, promote, and spearhead someone else's cause (underdog / bill / liberty) · agitate: stir up public discontent, unrest, or vocal debate to force change (reform / strike / masses) · stump: travel across districts delivering persuasive campaign speeches (candidate / trail / district)
groups.nuance_zh: campaign: 有组织地开展运动推动某项诉求 (rights / reform / election) · crusade: 怀揣崇高道德使命感为除弊而发起十字军式奋战 (corruption / poverty / injustice) · champion: 作为旗手挺身捍卫、倡导某群体或法案 (underdog / bill / liberty) · agitate: 鼓动煽动舆论与底层大众情绪以促成变动 (reform / strike / masses) · stump: 巡回演讲为竞选奔走拉票 (candidate / trail / district)

groups.name: Campaign & Lobby · 竞选与游说 (Lobby, Canvass, Stump)
groups.tip: 政治竞选争取选票

items.def_zh: 参加竞选；发起运动，游说宣传
items.def_en: To conduct, organize, or take part in a series of planned activities to achieve a political, social, or commercial goal.
items.ex_en: The energetic team campaigned tirelessly across five states to promote the public healthcare initiative.
items.ex_zh: 充满活力的团队在五个州不知疲倦地展开宣传运动，以推广公共医疗倡议。

items.def_en: (+ for/against) To try to persuade politicians, officials, or leaders to support or defeat a proposed law
items.ex_en: Trade union representatives intend to lobby against the proposed cuts to public pension benefits.
items.ex_zh: 工会代表打算进行游说，反对拟议中对公共养老金福利的削减。

items.def_en: (+ for/against) To engage in a vigorous, impassioned concerted effort for social or political change
items.ex_en: He spent two decades crusading against systemic corruption within the municipal government department.
items.ex_zh: 他花了二十年时间，针对市政部门内部的体制性腐败展开长期奋战。

items.def_en: (+ for) To travel around giving political speeches to garner votes during an election campaign
items.ex_en: The incumbent governor spent October stumping across rural counties to secure vital farming votes.
items.ex_zh: 现任州长整个十月都在农村各县巡回演说竞选，以争取关键的农民选票。

items.def_en: (+ for/against) To campaign publically and energetically to stir up public support or protest
items.ex_en: Militant union leaders agitate for nationwide industrial walkouts over low baseline wages.
items.ex_zh: 激进的工会领袖因基础工资过低而煽动并在全国范围内鼓动行业罢工。

items.def_en: To travel through an area visiting residents to solicit votes, donations, or opinions
items.ex_en: Dedicated party volunteers canvassed the entire suburban neighborhood to gather voter support before Tuesday.
items.ex_zh: 敬业的政党志愿者在周二之前走访了整个郊区社区，以拉取选民支持。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate organized efforts to influence public opinion, secure votes, or persuade government officials to adopt specific policies or elect particular candidates.
groups.summary_zh: 指为实现政治诉求、竞选公职或推动特定议案而展开的有组织游说与宣传。
groups.desc_en: Denotes deliberate strategic actions aimed at influencing lawmakers, securing electoral votes, or shaping governmental policy, contrasting with ordinary non-political marketing or direct popular rebellion.
groups.desc_zh: 指旨在影响立法者决策、赢取选票或左右公共政策的政治策略行为，区别于一般商业营销或直接武装叛乱。
groups.nuance_en: lobby: solicit, persuade, or pressure legislators and officials directly on policy (lawmakers / Congress / senators) · canvass: systematically poll or solicit votes and opinions door-to-door (voters / neighborhood / district) · stump: travel systematically on a campaign tour giving political rallies (candidate / state / circuit) · campaign: run an official multi-faceted political contest for office (seat / presidency / reelection) · agitate: arouse ideological discontent or collective public mobilization (masses / workers / public)
groups.nuance_zh: lobby: 就特定法案直接游说立法者或官员 (lawmakers / Congress / senators) · canvass: 逐门逐户走访拉票或详查选民意向 (voters / neighborhood / district) · stump: 候选人深入各区进行巡回政治演说 (candidate / state / circuit) · campaign: 开展全面竞选选战角逐公职 (seat / presidency / reelection) · agitate: 政治鼓动以激发社会抗议行动 (masses / workers / public)

groups.name: Capsize & Invert · 翻覆与倒置 (Overturn, Upend, Keel over)
groups.tip: 底朝天翻转倾覆倒置

items.def_en: Lose balance and fall over on its side, or cause an object to topple
items.ex_en: The gusty wind caused the tall garden vase to tip over onto the terrace.
items.ex_zh: 阵风导致露台上的高花瓶失去平衡翻倒在地。
items.ex2_en: The playful puppy tipped over the tall ceramic vase in the hallway.
items.ex2_zh: 调皮的小狗把走廊里高高的陶瓷花瓶碰倒了。

items.def_en: Roll or rotate completely upside down onto its opposite surface
items.ex_en: The heavy freight truck skidded on the icy road and turned over completely.
items.ex_zh: 那辆重型货车在结冰的道路上打滑，彻底翻了过去。

items.def_en: Turn over completely so that the top becomes the bottom, or cause to do so
items.ex_en: A rogue ocean wave violently overturned the small wooden rowboat near the rocky shore.
items.ex_zh: 一道凶猛的巨浪在礁石海岸附近将那艘小木划艇猛烈打翻。
items.ex2_en: The speeding racecar overturned violently after hitting the slick concrete protective barrier.
items.ex2_zh: 高速飞驰的赛车撞上湿滑的水泥防护栏后猛烈翻车。

items.def_en: Set or turn something upside down or on its end
items.ex_en: The angry customer carelessly upended the dining table during a loud restaurant argument.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的顾客在餐馆大声争吵中粗暴地掀翻了餐桌。

items.def_en: Turn over on its side or completely upside down in water, or collapse suddenly
items.ex_en: The overloaded fishing boat began to keel over dangerously in the violent gale.
items.ex_zh: 那艘超载的渔船在狂暴的大风中开始危险地倾覆。

items.def_en: (of a boat) To turn upside down in the water, or to cause a boat to do this.
items.ex_en: A sudden violent gust caused the small racing sailboat to capsize instantly in mid-lake.
items.ex_zh: 一阵突如其来的狂风导致那艘小型竞速帆船在湖中央瞬间倾覆。
items.ex2_en: The overloaded ferry capsized suddenly in stormy river currents during the night.
items.ex2_zh: 超载的渡船夜间在汹涌的风暴河水中突然倾覆翻沉。

groups.summary_en: Covers severe upsets where vehicles, vessels, or tall objects lose stability, tip over, and end up upside down or on their side.
groups.summary_zh: 指船只、车辆或直立物因失去平衡而倾覆、翻底或底朝天颠倒。
