groups.desc_en: Denotes the kinetic inversion, overturning, or dynamic loss of equilibrium resulting in the top and bottom reversing positions, contrasting with gentle tilting, horizontal sliding, or structural disintegrating.
groups.desc_zh: 指物体因失衡、动能冲击或倾覆导致上下位置彻底倒置或底朝天，区别于小幅度倾斜、水平位移或结构粉碎。
groups.nuance_en: capsize: overturn completely in water, bottom-up (boat / canoe / vessel) · overturn: turn upside down or onto its side by force; invalidate legally (car / decision / verdict) · upend: flip entirely upside down or throw into complete disorder (canoe / expectations / life) · keel over: suddenly tip over sideways or collapse faint (ship / pedestrian / tree) · tip over: lose balance and spill from an upright position (vase / chair / lamp)
groups.nuance_zh: capsize: 专指舟船在水面上倾覆、底朝天 (boat / canoe / vessel) · overturn: 强力翻倒底朝天；法理上推翻判决 (car / decision / verdict) · upend: 彻底倒置竖立翻转；彻底颠覆既有秩序 (canoe / expectations / life) · keel over: 侧向倾倒翻转；人因昏厥猝然栽倒 (ship / pedestrian / tree) · tip over: 失去重心失衡歪倒或碰倒 (vase / chair / lamp)

groups.name: Cater & Pander · 迎合与供给 (Pander, Accommodate, Humor)
groups.tip: 顺应特定群体偏好与需求

items.def_zh: 迁就；迎合（某人的脾气或任性）
items.def_en: To agree with someone or comply with their wishes simply to keep them quiet or happy
items.ex_en: The weary parents decided to humor the cranky toddler with a bedtime story.
items.ex_zh: 疲倦的父母决定讲个睡前故事来迁就那个任性闹别扭的幼儿。

items.def_en: To consider someone's special needs or desires and adapt one's behavior or plans to suit them
items.ex_en: The hotel chef happily adjusted the menu to accommodate the foreign guests' dietary restrictions.
items.ex_zh: 酒店大厨欣然调整了菜单，以顾及并顺应外国客人的饮食限制。

items.def_en: To direct one's efforts toward pleasing or winning the approval of a particular group
items.ex_en: The calculating politician chose to play to popular prejudices rather than present factual solutions.
items.ex_zh: 那位精于算计的政客选择迎合大众的偏见，而非提出切实的解决方案。

items.def_zh: 迎合，投合；承办宴席，提供饮食服务
items.def_en: 1. (+ to) To try to satisfy the specific needs, tastes, or desires of a person or group. 2. (+ for) To provide food and drink service for a social event or party.
items.ex_en: This luxury seaside resort was designed specifically to cater to very wealthy foreign travelers.
items.ex_zh: 这家豪华海滨度假村专门为迎合非常富有的外国旅客的需求而设计。

items.def_en: (+ to) To submit obsequiously or yield tamely to someone's demands or wishes
items.ex_en: The proud diplomat refused to truckle to the unreasonable territorial demands of the invader.
items.ex_zh: 这位有骨气的外交官拒绝卑躬屈膝地屈从于侵略者无理的领土要求。

items.def_zh: 迎合；谄媚（尤指低级趣味）
items.def_en: (+ to) To do or say what someone wants in order to please them, usually in a way that is disgraceful or unreasonable
items.ex_en: The sensationalist tabloids blatantly pander to the public's worst vulgar appetites for cheap gossip.
items.ex_zh: 那些耸人听闻的八卦小报公然迎合大众对廉价流言最粗俗的恶趣味。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on shaping one's actions, services, or goods to please a specific audience or satisfy niche demands. It ranges from helpful accommodation to ethically dubious, spineless indulgence.
groups.summary_zh: 指为迎合特定群体需求或低级趣味而迁就调整服务与言行。
groups.desc_en: Denotes adjusting services, products, or demeanor to gratify the tastes, vices, or baser expectations of an audience, contrasting with objective educating, strict discipline, or principled refusal.
groups.desc_zh: 指顺应、将就甚至谄媚迎合受众的偏好、需求或低级趣味，区别于客观引导、严苛规训或原则性拒绝。
groups.nuance_en: cater: provide specialized services or tailor offerings to fit existing tastes (tastes / clients / tourists) · pander: debase standards to gratify base desires, vices, or vulgar tastes (fears / basest instincts / prejudices) · play to: calibrate performances or rhetoric directly to elicit crowd applause (gallery / audience / strengths) · accommodate: flex boundaries or adjust arrangements to assist someone's needs (guests / requests / handicap) · humor: indulge someone's quirks, unreasonable moods, or delusions pacifically (boss / whims / child)
groups.nuance_zh: cater: 针对特定群体需求提供专门供应或投其所好 (tastes / clients / tourists) · pander: 迎合低俗趣味、恶习或民粹偏见 (fears / basest instincts / prejudices) · play to: 投机性讨好特定受众以博取喝彩 (gallery / audience / strengths) · accommodate: 迁就调节以容纳他人特殊要求 (guests / requests / handicap) · humor: 顺着对方脾气或古怪念头加以应付迁就 (boss / whims / child)

groups.name: Censor & Suppress · 审查与删剪 (Redact, Bowdlerize, Expurgate)
groups.tip: 行使权力查禁敏感内容

items.def_en: To cover text or images with dark ink to prevent them from being read
items.ex_en: He blacked out for a few seconds after hitting his head on the doorframe.
items.ex_zh: 他的头撞在门框上后昏厥了数秒。

items.def_en: To edit, alter, or censor text by deleting parts of it
items.ex_en: The strict imperial censor blue-penciled several satirical paragraphs from the dissident's provocative manuscript.
items.ex_zh: 严苛的帝国审查官大笔删削了这位异见人士挑衅性手稿中的数个讽刺段落。

items.def_en: To remove, obscure, or black out sensitive text or information before publication
items.ex_en: The government agency redacted several classified names from the public investigative report.
items.ex_zh: 政府机构从公开的调查报告中删节并涂黑了几个机密姓名。

items.def_zh: 审查并删剪（书刊、电影、信件等）；查禁
items.def_en: To examine books, films, or other materials officially and remove parts considered offensive, politically sensitive, or dangerous.
items.ex_en: Authoritarian regimes systematically censor foreign news broadcasts to prevent unfavorable public discourse.
items.ex_zh: 威权政权系统性地审查并删剪外国新闻广播，以防止不利的公众言论。

items.def_zh: 删减（以使之适宜大众）；净化删节
items.def_en: To censor a text by removing or altering passages considered vulgar or improper
items.ex_en: Victorian editors deliberately bowdlerized the ancient classic to make it suitable for schoolchildren.
items.ex_zh: 维多利亚时代的编辑故意对古代名著进行净化删节，使其适合学童阅读。

items.def_zh: 删去（令人不快或不合体统的内容）
items.def_en: To remove matter thought objectionable or unsuitable from a book, play, or account
items.ex_en: The publisher had to expurgate all obscene language before the novel could enter classrooms.
items.ex_zh: 出版社必须删去所有淫秽字眼，这部小说才能获准进入课堂。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the intervention by authorities to suppress, excise, or black out objectionable, sensitive, or politically undesirable portions of texts or media.
groups.summary_zh: 官方或管理者对出版物与资讯进行审查、删节或涂盖。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the institutional, editorial, or moral scrubbing, excising, or obscuring of objectionable or classified content before publication, contrasting with open criticism, passive leaking, or total physical book-burning.
groups.desc_zh: 指出版或传播前，基于体制、法律或道德审查，对敏感违规内容进行删剪、涂黑或净化处理，区别于公开书评批判、泄密或直接焚毁书籍。
groups.nuance_en: censor: officially examine and suppress morally or politically unacceptable matter (mail / press / film) · redact: obscure or erase sensitive or classified passages from a released legal document (file / report / names) · expurgate: purge obscene, vulgar, or offensive passages from a literary work (novel / text / edition) · bowdlerize: prudishly sanitise a literary classic by removing sexual or offensive content, weakening it (play / classic / edition) · black out: physically obscure text with heavy opaque ink, or block transmission (lines / news / broadcast)
groups.nuance_zh: censor: 官方行使审查权屏蔽政治或道德违规内容 (mail / press / film) · redact: 法律或机密文本公开前涂黑遮蔽涉密段落 (file / report / names) · expurgate: 剔除文本中被认为淫秽、不雅的字句 (novel / text / edition) · bowdlerize: 过度道貌岸然地删改文学作品致其失色 (play / classic / edition) · black out: 用墨迹彻底涂黑字句或实施新闻屏蔽 (lines / news / broadcast)

groups.name: Center & Align Medially · 居中对齐与定位 (Centre, Middle, Centralize)
groups.tip: 移至中间或特定位置

items.def_zh: 把……置于中间；（球类运动）传中，把（球）踢到中路
items.def_en: 1. To place or position something in the center or middle. 2. (sports) To kick or pass a ball into the middle of the field or pitch.
items.ex_en: The agile winger middled the ball perfectly into the penalty box for an easy goal.
items.ex_zh: 身手敏捷的边锋把球完美地传中到禁区内，轻松破门得分。

items.def_zh: 置于中心，居中；将……集中于，以……为中心
items.def_en: 1. To move to or place something at the center. 2. (+ on/around) To focus or concentrate primarily on a particular subject or point.
items.ex_en: The visual designer carefully centred the company logo on the glossy presentation cover.
items.ex_zh: 视觉设计师小心地将公司标志居中放置在光滑的演示文稿封面上。
items.ex2_en: The entire novel centres around the mysterious disappearance of a prominent scientist.
items.ex2_zh: 整部小说的核心围绕着一位著名科学家的神秘失踪展开。

items.def_en: to distribute or balance items uniformly about a central point
items.ex_en: The ancient artist attempted to equidistribute the intricate marble statues about the sacred circular altar.
items.ex_zh: 古代艺术家试图使那些繁复的大理石雕像围绕神圣的圆形祭坛均匀居中分布。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to arrange things in a straight line or adjust them to match a central or uniform axis
items.ex_en: Please line up the margins carefully with the central axis of the document.
items.ex_zh: 请仔细将页边距与文档的中心轴线对齐排列。
items.ex2_en: Eager movie fans lined up patiently around the corner before ticket sales.
items.ex2_zh: 热切的影迷在售票前耐心地在拐角处排成长队。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to position or align an object squarely and evenly relative to a center or border
items.ex_en: Just square up that picture frame neatly so it sits straight in the center.
items.ex_zh: 把那个相框摆正对齐，让它规整地处在正中心就好。
items.ex2_en: The new modular shelves square up neatly against the flat brick wall.
items.ex2_zh: 新型组合架整整齐齐地正对着平整的砖墙靠直对齐。

items.def_en: to bring into or place at the center of an area or system
items.ex_en: The architects decided to centralize the grand staircase within the newly designed atrium.
items.ex_zh: 建筑师们决定将大楼梯置于新设计的中庭正中心。

groups.summary_en: Actors position, align, or balance an object or feature exactly along a central axis or midpoint relative to its surrounding frame or bounds.
groups.summary_zh: 指将物体或构件置于正中轴线或对准中心位置。
groups.desc_en: Aligning, balancing, or concentrating items relative to a midpoint or common axis, unlike general spatial arranging which lacks a focal point.
groups.desc_zh: 围绕中心点或中轴进行对齐、居中或权力集聚，区别于不强调轴心对称的常规空间排布。
groups.nuance_en: centre: place directly at the midpoint or focal point (text / ball / attention) · centralize: concentrate dispersed authority or operations into a single core (power / control / operations) · line up: arrange precisely along a straight linear axis (troops / ducks / vehicles) · square up: align symmetrically and perpendicular to edges (corners / shoulders / accounts) · middle: position centrally or cross into the center area (ball / heading)
groups.nuance_zh: centre: 置于正中或使成为视觉焦点 (text / ball / attention) · centralize: 将分散的权力或职能向核心集聚 (power / control / operations) · line up: 沿直线基准整齐对齐 (troops / ducks / vehicles) · square up: 正对平直对齐或使边角周正 (corners / shoulders / accounts) · middle: 置于中位或击入中心区域 (ball / heading)

groups.name: Certify & Legally Validate · 律法确认与公证 (Legitimize, Notarize, Validate)
groups.tip: 官方公证认可并正式授权生效

items.def_en: (+ sth) give official or legal approval to a document, decision, or plan
items.ex_en: My manager finally agreed to sign off on the new project proposal today.
items.ex_zh: 我的经理今天终于同意在新的项目方案上签字批准了。

items.def_en: to make something officially acceptable, legally binding, or confirmed as correct
items.ex_en: The immigration officer must stamp your passport to validate the long-term visa.
items.ex_zh: 移民局官员必须在你的护照上盖章以确认长期签证生效。

items.def_zh: 证明真实；给…作证（签署确认）
items.def_en: to state or sign officially that a legal document or record is genuine and valid
items.ex_en: Two independent witnesses were summoned to attest the signature on the last will.
items.ex_zh: 两名独立的证人被传唤来为遗嘱上的签名作证并确认有效。

items.def_en: to prove or certify that an official document, seal, or artifact is genuine
items.ex_en: The museum experts employed modern spectral analysis to authenticate the ancient royal scroll.
items.ex_zh: 博物馆专家利用现代光谱分析技术来鉴证这幅古代皇家手卷的真实性。

items.def_zh: 使合法化；使合理化，使合乎道义
items.def_en: To make something legal, justifiable, or socially and morally acceptable.
items.ex_en: The landmark court ruling helped legitimize the rights of independent contract workers.
items.ex_zh: 这项具有里程碑意义的法院裁决有助于确立独立合同工权益的合法地位。

items.def_zh: 公证，由公证人确认（文件等）
items.def_en: To have a legal document officially certified, attested, or stamped by a notary public.
items.ex_en: You must have the local authority notarize the contract before buying the property.
items.ex_zh: 在购买该房产之前，你必须让当地公证处公证这份合同。

groups.summary_en: A legally empowered official or authorized procedure confers legal validity, authentic status, or statutory approval on a document, act, or claim. Verbs range from general validation to specific notarial witnessing.
groups.summary_zh: 依照法律或法定程序对文书、行为等给予法律效力确认或公证认可。
groups.desc_en: Formally establishing or attesting to the legal truth, authority, or compliance of an artifact or claim, contrasting with informal endorsing or belief.
groups.desc_zh: 依循法定或官方程序对文件、事实的真伪有效性进行核验与背书，区别于非正式的认可或主观相信。
groups.nuance_en: notarize: authenticate a document legally through a licensed notary (deed / contract / signature) · authenticate: verify genuine historical or material origin (artifact / painting / signature) · validate: officially confirm compliance, accuracy, or binding legality (passport / hypothesis / claim) · attest: formally affirm or serve as sworn witness to a fact (accuracy / signature / innocence) · legitimize: confer lawful or socially accepted status upon an action or status (claim / regime / child)
groups.nuance_zh: notarize: 由公证人依法公证具结 (deed / contract / signature) · authenticate: 鉴定真伪以确证系真品 (artifact / painting / signature) · validate: 依法定或程序性要求核验使其生效 (passport / hypothesis / claim) · attest: 正式作证证明某事属实 (accuracy / signature / innocence) · legitimize: 赋予法律地位或使其合规合理化 (claim / regime / child)

groups.name: Champion & Root For · 热忱声援与摇旗呐喊 (Champion, Back, Cheer on)
groups.tip: 化身拉拉队员极力喝彩声援

items.def_en: Give essential moral, political, or practical support to a candidate, initiative, or stance
items.ex_en: Several prominent business leaders decided to back the mayor's green energy initiative.
items.ex_zh: 几位著名的商界领袖决定全力支持市长的绿色能源倡议。

items.def_en: Urge a participant forward with shoutings of praise and encouragement
items.ex_en: Crowds of enthusiastic spectators gathered along the track to cheer on the runners.
items.ex_zh: 大批热情的观众聚集在跑道旁，为长跑选手们呐喊助威。

items.def_en: Express enthusiastic hope and active moral backing for the success of a person or team
items.ex_en: Our entire family will gather tonight to root for our local football team.
items.ex_zh: 我们全家人今晚会聚在一起，为本地足球队加油助威。

items.def_en: Enthusiastically promote, speak in favor of, and advance the standing of someone or something
items.ex_en: The prominent celebrity endorsement helped boost the author's reputation nationwide.
items.ex_zh: 知名名人的代言极大地在全国范围内推崇并提升了这位作者的声誉。

items.def_zh: 担任拉拉队员；极力声援，竭力支持
items.def_en: 1. To perform cheers to support a sports team, or to enthusiastically promote and champion a person or cause.
items.ex_en: Senior executives continued to cheerlead the controversial merger despite widespread employee skepticism.
items.ex_zh: 尽管员工普遍心存怀疑，高管们依然在极力吹捧和推崇这桩备受争议的并购案。

items.def_zh: 捍卫，竭力倡导，为…而斗争
items.def_en: Vigorously advocate, defend, or fight for a person, cause, or policy in public
items.ex_en: The senator vowed to champion environmental protection laws during her upcoming legislative term.
items.ex_zh: 参议员发誓要在即将到来的立法任期内竭力捍卫环境保护法案。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses vocal, enthusiastic, and partisan support for a person, cause, or faction, spanning spontaneous emotional cheering to relentless public promotion and advocacy.
groups.summary_zh: 指以高度热情、声势浩大地为某人或某事业声援、摇旗鼓劲。
groups.desc_en: Publicly and vigorously advocating, cheering, or fighting for an entity's victory, distinct from passive agreement or silent approval.
groups.desc_zh: 公开且满怀热情地为某人或事业站台呐喊、积极争取胜局，区别于被动的认同或默许。
groups.nuance_en: back: provide decisive material, financial, or political support (candidate / plan / proposal) · root for: emotionally wish and cheer for someone's victory (team / underdog / protagonist) · cheer on: vocally shout encouragement during an ongoing contest (runner / athlete / team) · champion: aggressively defend and advance a cause or policy as its chief advocate (cause / rights / reform) · cheerlead: enthusiastically and unreservedly promote a venture or figure (company / initiative / policy)
groups.nuance_zh: back: 提供实质性的资金、政治或道义后盾 (candidate / plan / proposal) · root for: 情感上暗自祈祷或盼望某方获胜 (team / underdog / protagonist) · cheer on: 现场呐喊助威以提振士气 (runner / athlete / team) · champion: 作为头号倡导者力推某项事业或权益 (cause / rights / reform) · cheerlead: 极力鼓动宣传并为其摇旗呐喊 (company / initiative / policy)

groups.name: Chat & Converse · 闲聊与交谈 (Chat, Gossip, Chew the fat)
groups.tip: 闲聊漫谈或深入交换意见

items.def_en: To spend time chatting amiably about unimportant things
items.ex_en: We sat on the porch for hours just to shoot the breeze together.
items.ex_zh: 我们就坐在门廊上吹水闲聊了好几个小时。

items.def_en: To engage in casual, trivial conversation about everyday topics
items.ex_en: They enjoyed a cup of coffee and paused to chitchat about routine neighborhood matters.
items.ex_zh: 他们喝着咖啡，停下来闲聊起街坊邻里琐事。

items.def_zh: 侃大山，长时间闲聊唠嗑
items.def_en: To chat socially and informally at considerable length
items.ex_en: Old classmates met at the pub to chew the fat about their college days.
items.ex_zh: 老同学们在酒吧碰面，海阔天空地唠起大学时代的往事。

items.def_en: To talk in a friendly, informal, and relaxed manner.
items.ex_en: We sat together in the sunny park and began to chat about our plans.
items.ex_zh: 我们坐在阳光明媚的公园里，轻松闲聊起彼此的计划。

items.def_en: To talk casually about other people's private lives and affairs
items.ex_en: Colleagues gathered in the break room to gossip about their manager's secret engagement.
items.ex_zh: 同事们聚在茶水间，对他家经理秘密订婚的事说长道短。

items.def_en: To talk at length in a foolish, inconsequential, or simple-minded way
items.ex_en: The frivolous courtier continued to prattle about silly trifles before the solemn assembly.
items.ex_zh: 那个轻浮的侍臣在庄严的集会上面对众人絮絮叨叨着愚蠢的琐事。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe informal, relaxed verbal exchanges where speakers interact socially rather than engaging in rigid, goal-oriented debate. They range from light social talk to colloquial idioms meaning to shoot the breeze at length.
groups.summary_zh: 指随性、轻松的日常闲聊或唠嗑，不带正式谈判色彩。
groups.desc_en: Engaging in informal, reciprocal spoken exchange without a strict transactional agenda, contrasting with structured debate or formal negotiation.
groups.desc_zh: 无拘无束、非事务性地进行日常口头对谈或琐碎交流，区别于严谨的辩论或正式谈判。
groups.nuance_en: chat: talk in an easy, friendly, and informal manner (friend / neighbor / colleague) · chitchat: exchange inconsequential social pleasantries and small talk (weather / trivia / neighbor) · gossip: converse idly about the intimate, unverified personal lives of others (coworker / scandal / celebrity) · prattle: chatter on childishly, inconsequentially, and at tedious length (nonsense / child / enthusiast) · chew the fat: engage in prolonged, unhurried, leisurely reminiscing or banter (buddies / veteran / family)
groups.nuance_zh: chat: 轻松友好地聊天谈心 (friend / neighbor / colleague) · chitchat: 寒暄客套或聊微不足道的话题 (weather / trivia / neighbor) · gossip: 闲言碎语打探传播他人私生活 (coworker / scandal / celebrity) · prattle: 没完没了地絮叨琐碎幼稚之言 (nonsense / child / enthusiast) · chew the fat: 慢条斯理地熟人叙旧唠嗑 (buddies / veteran / family)

groups.name: Chemical Breakdown & Hydrolysis · 分解与水解 (Hydrolyze, Decompose, Digest)
groups.tip: 通过水解等反应分解物质

items.def_en: To separate or decompose into simpler chemical compounds or constituent parts
items.ex_en: Beneficial soil microbes quickly break down the complex organic compost into vital nutrients.
items.ex_zh: 有益的土壤微生物迅速将复杂的有机堆肥分解为重要的养分。
items.ex2_en: Synthetic plastics break down very slowly under ordinary natural environmental conditions outdoors.
items.ex2_zh: 在室外普通的自然环境条件下，合成塑料降解分解得极慢。

items.def_en: To break down food, tissue, or organic material chemically or enzymatically into absorbable substances
items.ex_en: Specialized stomach enzymes slowly digest complex dietary proteins into absorbable amino acids.
items.ex_zh: 特化的胃部酶类能将复杂的膳食蛋白质缓慢消化水解为易吸收的氨基酸。

items.def_en: To break down chemically into simpler, often lower-energy compounds through exposure to enzymes, heat, or light
items.ex_en: Prolonged exposure to ultraviolet radiation will steadily degrade the synthetic polymer chains.
items.ex_zh: 长期暴露在紫外线下会使该合成聚合物分子链持续发生化学降解。

items.def_en: To break down into simpler chemical constituents or decay through natural biological or chemical processes
items.ex_en: Under intense heat, the chemical compound will decompose into various toxic gaseous oxides.
items.ex_zh: 在高温作用下，该化合物会分解为多种有毒的气态氧化物。
items.ex2_en: High temperatures decompose dangerous organic pollutants into harmless water and carbon dioxide.
items.ex2_zh: 高温将危险的有机污染物分解为无害的水和二氧化碳。

items.def_en: To split a molecule reversibly into simpler constituents, ions, or atoms
items.ex_en: In dilute aqueous solutions, the ionic molecules readily dissociate into separate charged ions.
items.ex_zh: 在稀水溶液中，离子分子极易解离成各自带电的独立离子。
items.ex2_en: Intense electrical pulses dissociate stubborn chemical bonds within toxic waste compound mixtures.
items.ex2_zh: 强烈的电脉冲解离了有毒废弃物化合物混合物中顽固的化学键。

items.def_en: 1. (chemistry) To break down a chemical compound by reacting it with water, or to undergo such a reaction.
items.ex_en: Strong acids catalyze the reaction that will hydrolyze the polysaccharide into simple sugars.
items.ex_zh: 强酸催化了该反应，从而将多糖水解为单糖。
items.ex2_en: These peptide polymers hydrolyze spontaneously in mildly acidic aqueous solutions over time.
items.ex2_zh: 随着时间推移，这些肽聚合物在弱酸性水溶液中会自发水解。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the breakdown of chemical substances or complex organic matter into simpler components through chemical, biological, or thermal processes. While 'hydrolyze' specifically denotes cleavage by reaction with water, others emphasize natural decay, enzymatic digestion, or thermal cracking.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及化合物或有机质通过水、热、酶等作用降解为简单成分的化学与生物分解。
groups.desc_en: Breaking down complex molecular structures into simpler chemical constituents via biochemical or chemical pathways, contrasting with mere physical smashing.
groups.desc_zh: 通过化学键断裂或生物化学作用将大分子裂解为简单组分，区别于机械性的物理捣碎。
groups.nuance_en: break down: split a compound into constituent elements or metabolites (waste / nutrient / pollutant) · hydrolyze: cleave chemical bonds specifically through reaction with water (protein / ester / starch) · decompose: rot or disintegrate organically into elementary matter (corpse / matter / biomass) · digest: break down food chemically in an alimentary tract (meal / nutrient / fat) · degrade: progressively lose molecular weight or functional structure through environmental exposure (plastic / polymer / toxin)
groups.nuance_zh: break down: 通用性分解为低分子或代谢物 (waste / nutrient / pollutant) · hydrolyze: 借由水分子反应水解断键 (protein / ester / starch) · decompose: 有机质腐败或自然蜕变为原生元素 (corpse / matter / biomass) · digest: 在消化系统内生化降解食物 (meal / nutrient / fat) · degrade: 聚合物在环境介质中逐步老化降解 (plastic / polymer / toxin)

groups.name: Chemical Modification & Refining · 化工提纯与衍生改性 (Refine, Reprocess, Derivatize)
groups.tip: 化学工艺或深层再加工

items.def_en: to divide a mixture into distinct fractions or components by distillation or crystallization
items.ex_en: The chemical engineer planned to fractionate the complex petroleum blend through careful distillation.
items.ex_zh: 化学工程师计划通过精细蒸馏对复杂的石油混合物进行分馏。

items.def_zh: 衍生化；使转变成衍生物
items.def_en: to chemically transform a compound into a derivative of similar chemical structure
items.ex_en: Researchers sought to derivatize the steroid molecule to facilitate accurate chromatographic detection.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员试图将该类固醇分子衍生化，以便于进行精确的色谱检测。

items.def_zh: 精炼；提纯（油品、糖或化学物）
items.def_en: to remove impurities or unwanted elements from a crude substance by chemical or thermal means
items.ex_en: The industrial plant operates large distillation units to refine crude oil into gasoline.
items.ex_zh: 该工业工厂运行着大型蒸馏装置，将原油精炼成汽油。

items.def_en: to extract a pure chemical component by removing foreign or contaminating substances
items.ex_en: Technicians use precise filtration to purify the raw chemical solution before crystallization.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员在结晶前采用精细过滤法提纯粗化学溶液。
items.ex2_en: The contaminated stream purifies naturally as it flows through the dense wetland.
items.ex2_zh: 受污染的溪流在流经茂密的湿地时自然得到了净化。

items.def_zh: （用柠檬酸）处理，使成柠檬酸盐（或酯）
items.def_en: (chemistry) To treat or combine a substance with citric acid or a citrate.
items.ex_en: The lab technician planned to citrate the fresh donor blood to prevent coagulation.
items.ex_zh: 实验员计划用柠檬酸盐处理新鲜的供者血液以防止凝固。

items.def_zh: 再处理，回收加工（废料、核燃料等）
items.def_en: To process used materials or waste, especially nuclear fuel, so that they can be used again.
items.ex_en: The specialized facility operates advanced reactors to reprocess spent nuclear fuel safely.
items.ex_zh: 该专业设施运行先进的反应堆，以安全地回收再处理乏核燃料。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on advanced laboratory or chemical engineering operations where a chemical substance, biological extract, or nuclear material is chemically altered, purified, or recycled into another derivative or state.
groups.summary_zh: 指在化验或化工过程中对物质进行化学反应改性、精炼或循环再处理。
groups.desc_en: Processing, isolating, or chemically modifying raw materials to yield pure fractions or altered chemical derivatives, unlike crude mechanical sorting.
groups.desc_zh: 对粗料进行化工提纯、分馏或分子改性以获高纯度馏分或新衍生物，区别于粗糙的机械分选。
groups.nuance_en: refine: remove impurities from crude substances to achieve high purity (oil / sugar / metal) · purify: rid a sample completely of foreign or contaminating matter (water / air / protein) · fractionate: separate a complex mixture into distinct components by boiling point or phase (crude oil / blood / plasma) · derivatize: alter a molecule chemically to produce an analyzable or functional derivative (compound / analyte / sugar) · reprocess: chemically or mechanically treat spent material for reuse (nuclear fuel / waste / plastic)
groups.nuance_zh: refine: 精炼原材以除去杂质提高品位 (oil / sugar / metal) · purify: 彻底清除污染物或异质以净纯 (water / air / protein) · fractionate: 按沸点或物理特性分馏出各级组分 (crude oil / blood / plasma) · derivatize: 对基团进行化学改性制成衍生物 (compound / analyte / sugar) · reprocess: 对乏料或废弃物进行化学后处理回用 (nuclear fuel / waste / plastic)

groups.name: Chirp & Tweet · 啼鸣与啁啾 (Tweet, Chirp, Warble)
groups.tip: 鸟类或昆虫清脆短促的发声

items.def_en: To make a weak, high-pitched chirping sound characteristic of young chicks
items.ex_en: The tiny baby chicks began to peep loudly inside their warm incubator.
items.ex_zh: 那群刚孵出的小鸡开始在温暖的孵化器里清脆地哔哔鸣叫。

items.def_zh: （鸟）鸣叫，啼叫；在社交平台发推文
items.def_en: 1. (of a bird) To make a short, high-pitched chirp or sound. 2. To post a message or update on the social media platform X (formerly Twitter).
items.ex_en: A solitary robin perched on the fence to tweet in the early dawn.
items.ex_zh: 一只独自落在篱笆上的知更鸟在清晨的曙光中轻声鸣叫。

items.def_en: To make a series of lively, high-pitched chirping sounds
items.ex_en: Flocks of morning sparrows began to chirrup merrily among the leafy apple branches.
items.ex_zh: 一群晨雀开始在枝叶繁茂的苹果树枝间欢快地啁啾鸣叫。

items.def_en: To make a short, sharp, high-pitched sound typical of small birds or crickets
items.ex_en: Tiny green crickets began to chirp rhythmically beneath the porch floorboards tonight.
items.ex_zh: 今晚，小小的绿色蟋蟀开始在门廊地板下富有节奏地唧唧叫着。

items.def_en: To utter a rapid, vibrating succession of high-pitched musical notes
items.ex_en: The delicate nightingale perched high above to trill a haunting melodic phrase.
items.ex_zh: 精巧的夜莺栖息在高处，啭鸣出一曲萦绕人心的颤音旋律。

items.def_en: To sing with melodious, rolling, or trembling notes
items.ex_en: Brightly colored songbirds began to warble their pleasant morning melodies among the blossoms.
items.ex_zh: 色彩明丽的鸣禽开始在花丛间婉转啼唱起悦耳的晨曲。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the high-pitched, short, or melodious vocalizations of small birds and insects. It contrasts sharp single notes with extended, musical trills and chirruping calls.
groups.summary_zh: 描述小鸟或昆虫发出的短促、清脆或婉转悦耳的啼鸣声。
groups.desc_en: Emitting high-pitched, short, or melodious vocalizations characteristic of birds or small creatures, unlike deep mammalian roars or bellowing.
groups.desc_zh: 鸟类或小生物发出短促、尖细或婉转的啼鸣与音律，区别于哺乳动物低沉的嘶吼或长啸。
groups.nuance_en: chirp: emit a short, sharp, cheerful high-pitched note (sparrow / cricket / chick) · tweet: produce a small, delicate chirp typical of a young or small songbird (bird / fledgling / canary) · warble: sing with a sweet, constantly shifting melodic quaver (songbird / thrush / river) · trill: produce a rapid, vibrant alternation between adjacent high musical notes (canary / nightingale / soprano) · peep: make a feeble, tiny, high-pitched squeak (chick / bird / mouse)
groups.nuance_zh: chirp: 发出短促清脆欢快的啼叫或唧唧声 (sparrow / cricket / chick) · tweet: 小鸟发出的细弱短鸣 (bird / fledgling / canary) · warble: 鸟鸣或流水般婉转多变地啼啭 (songbird / thrush / river) · trill: 高频颤音式啼鸣或歌唱 (canary / nightingale / soprano) · peep: 幼雏或幼崽发出极其微弱的吱吱声 (chick / bird / mouse)

groups.name: Choke & Suffocate · 噎呛与窒息 (Gasp, Suffocate, Asphyxiate)
groups.tip: 呼吸道受阻乃至濒临窒息

items.def_en: To choke, reach to vomit, or prevent someone from speaking by plugging their mouth
items.ex_en: The pungent smell of rotten garbage caused the young cleaner to gag uncontrollably.
items.ex_zh: 腐烂垃圾刺鼻的恶臭让那个年轻的清洁工忍不住一阵作呕。

items.def_en: (+ for) To breathe in suddenly and loudly with your mouth open, especially because of shock or lack of air
items.ex_en: Exhausted after the steep sprint, the weary hiker began to gasp for breath.
items.ex_zh: 在经历陡峭冲刺后精疲力竭，疲惫的徒步者开始倒吸粗气。

items.def_zh: （使）窒息，噎住，呛住；阻塞，堵塞；抑制，掐住
items.def_en: 1. To be unable to breathe, or prevent someone from breathing, because the windpipe is blocked or constricted. 2. To fill or block a passage or space completely. 3. To suppress, stifle, or restrain an emotion or speech.
items.ex_en: Thick black smoke from the kitchen threatened to choke the trapped family members.
items.ex_zh: 厨房里冒出的滚滚浓黑烟雾几乎要呛得被困的家人们窒息。
items.ex2_en: He choked violently on a piece of tough meat during family dinner.
items.ex2_zh: 在家庭聚餐时，他被一块硬肉狠狠噎住窒息了。

items.def_en: To die, suffer, or cause someone to die from being unable to breathe
items.ex_en: Without immediate ventilation, toxic carbon monoxide fumes could suffocate everyone in the room.
items.ex_zh: 如果不立即通风，有毒的一氧化碳废气可能会使房间内的所有人窒息而死。
items.ex2_en: The poor animal suffocated silently inside the airtight container before morning arrived.
items.ex2_zh: 清晨来临前，那只可怜的动物在密封容器中窒息而死。

items.def_en: To kill someone by squeezing their throat tightly so they cannot breathe
items.ex_en: The villain used a sturdy wire in an attempt to strangle the guard.
items.ex_zh: 那个恶徒企图用一根坚固的铁丝将警卫生生勒死。

items.def_en: To kill or render unconscious by depriving of oxygen
items.ex_en: Dense smoke generated during the subterranean explosion threatened to asphyxiate trapped underground miners.
items.ex_zh: 井下爆炸产生的浓烈烟雾极有可能使被困的地下矿工缺氧窒息。
items.ex2_en: The trapped diver asphyxiated slowly when his emergency oxygen supply ran empty.
items.ex2_zh: 当应急供氧耗尽时，被困的潜水员慢慢窒息而亡。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on physiological respiratory distress, where air intake is cut off by internal airway obstruction, external strangulation, or an oxygen-deprived environment.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖因异物卡阻、外力压迫或缺氧造成的呼吸困难乃至窒息反应。
groups.desc_en: Obstructing, cutting off, or struggling against the mechanical intake of air necessary for respiration, contrasting with simple non-fatal coughing.
groups.desc_zh: 因异物卡阻、外力勒缢或缺氧导致呼吸受阻乃至濒临窒息，区别于普通的轻咳。
groups.nuance_en: choke: suffer severe airway obstruction from a foreign body or constriction (bone / food / smoke) · suffocate: die or suffer from acute oxygen deprivation without direct throat blockage (gas / smoke / pillow) · asphyxiate: cause unconsciousness or death via lethal gas saturation or lack of oxygen (fumes / carbon monoxide / smog) · strangle: kill or compress fatally by tight external constriction of the neck (victim / rival / breathe) · gag: retch involuntarily when the throat is irritated or mechanically obstructed (reflex / spoon / cloth)
groups.nuance_zh: choke: 气道被外来异物或烟尘堵死而噎呛窒息 (bone / food / smoke) · suffocate: 因密闭隔绝空气或被掩掩而闷死 (gas / smoke / pillow) · asphyxiate: 因毒气或严重缺氧导致机体窒息死亡 (fumes / carbon monoxide / smog) · strangle: 用手或绳索紧扼颈部施加外力致死 (victim / rival / breathe) · gag: 因异物触碰咽喉而产生干呕反射 (reflex / spoon / cloth)

groups.name: Claim & Profess · 声称与断言 (Claim, Profess, Assert)
groups.tip: 声称其真或斩钉截铁地断言

items.def_en: To state that something is true, often without providing definite proof
items.ex_en: Many dubious online advertisements claim that this simple supplement cures joint pain completely.
items.ex_zh: 许多可疑的网络广告声称这种简单的保健品能彻底治愈关节疼痛。

items.def_en: (+ to) To lay claim to a particular quality, right, or title
items.ex_en: The ambitious prince dared not pretend to the imperial throne without military support.
items.ex_zh: 没有军队的支持，野心勃勃的王子不敢贸然觊觎自诩拥有皇位。

items.def_en: To assert that someone has done something illegal or wrong, typically without proof
items.ex_en: Prosecutors allege that the corporate executive systematically siphoned public funds for personal gain.
items.ex_zh: 检察官指控该企业高管为谋取私利而系统性地侵吞公款。

items.def_en: To falsely present someone or something as being another person or thing
items.ex_en: The street vendor attempted to pass off cheap synthetic gems as natural diamonds.
items.ex_zh: 那个街头摊贩企图将廉价的人造宝石冒充为天然钻石售卖。

items.def_zh: 声称，自称（常含虚假或缺乏依据之意）；标榜
items.def_en: (+ to be/do) (formal) To claim or profess to be or do something, especially falsely or without proof.
items.ex_en: These newly discovered manuscripts purport to represent the authentic writings of the monarch.
items.ex_zh: 这些新发现的手稿声称是那位君主的亲笔真迹。

items.def_en: To claim or declare a feeling, belief, or identity, sometimes insincerely
items.ex_en: The deceitful courtier chose to profess eternal loyalty while plotting behind closed doors.
items.ex_zh: 狡诈的侍臣在暗地密谋的同时，却公开表白对君王永恒的忠诚。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to stating that something is true or asserting an identity or status, often carrying skepticism about whether the claim is genuine or backed by proof.
groups.summary_zh: 表示自称、断言或声称拥有某种身份或事实，常含真伪存疑意味。
groups.desc_en: Asserting ownership, truth, or identity without full independent substantiation, contrasting with stating established, unchallenged facts.
groups.desc_zh: 在缺乏绝对实证前提下单方面主张属实、自封身份或提出权利要求，区别于陈述公认事实。
groups.nuance_en: claim: assert ownership or factual validity without definitive corroboration (innocence / prize / damages) · allege: assert that someone committed an offense without having yet proven it (misconduct / fraud / guilt) · profess: openly declare a belief, feeling, or expertise that may not be sincere (faith / love / ignorance) · purport: claim to be or mean something on the face of it, often suspiciously (document / letter / intent) · pretend: feign a condition, status, or knowledge untruthfully (illness / friendship / interest)
groups.nuance_zh: claim: 单方声称属实或索领权利 (innocence / prize / damages) · allege: 未经司法定罪前指控其违法犯罪 (misconduct / fraud / guilt) · profess: 公开表白信仰、情感或自称具某特质 (faith / love / ignorance) · purport: 声称或标榜是某物，暗含真伪存疑 (document / letter / intent) · pretend: 虚构假装自身具备某种状态或身份 (illness / friendship / interest)

groups.name: Clash & Conflict · 抵触与不和 (Clash, Jar, Conflict)
groups.tip: 观点针锋相对爆发激烈碰撞

items.def_en: (+ with) To clash or be contrary to other principles, beliefs, or claims
items.ex_en: These strict new internal policies directly conflict with the fundamental rights of employees.
items.ex_zh: 这些严格的内部新政策与雇员的基本权利产生了直接抵触。

items.def_en: (+ with) To quarrel with someone and stop being on friendly terms
items.ex_en: The two long-time business partners managed to fall out over a trivial sum.
items.ex_zh: 这两位多年的商业合伙人竟然因为一笔微不足道的款项而彻底闹翻了。

items.def_en: (+ with) To be in strong, sharp disagreement or incompatibility with something
items.ex_en: The council members' radical views clash sharply with the long-standing traditional community values.
items.ex_zh: 委员会成员的激进观点与该社区长久以来的传统价值观发生了激烈冲突。

items.def_en: (+ with/against) To be incongruous, unpleasantly discordant, or out of harmony
items.ex_en: His cynical jokes often jar with the somber atmosphere of memorial services.
items.ex_zh: 他那些冷嘲热讽的笑话常常与追悼会庄严肃穆的氛围格格不入。

items.def_en: (+ with) To come into direct, irreconcilable opposition regarding aims or views
items.ex_en: The expansionist ambitions of the empire inevitably collide with the sovereignty of neighboring states.
items.ex_zh: 该帝国的扩张野心不可避免地与邻国的主权发生了剧烈抵触。

items.def_zh: 不和，意见不一致；不谐调
items.def_en: (formal) To disagree, clash, or be out of harmony with someone or something.
items.ex_en: The harsh dissonance of the modern movement seemed to discord with classical harmony.
items.ex_zh: 现代乐章刺耳的不谐和音似乎与古典主义的和声美感完全抵触。

groups.summary_en: Describes ideas, principles, temperaments, or sounds colliding antagonistically or failing to harmonize. Key distinctions track whether the discord is an active abrasive dispute, jarring aesthetic dissonance, or irreconcilable inconsistency.
groups.summary_zh: 指观点、风格、性格或声音因不契合而产生冲突与龃龉。
groups.desc_en: Exhibiting severe friction, incompatibility, or sharp discordance between opposing elements or opinions, contrasting with harmonious coexistence.
groups.desc_zh: 观念、利益、色彩或日程之间出现不可调和的尖锐抵触与冲突，区别于协调共存。
groups.nuance_en: clash: meet in sharp, noisy ideological, temporal, or aesthetic conflict (personalities / schedules / colors) · conflict: stand in direct mutual opposition or irreconcilable inconsistency (interest / schedule / narrative) · jar: strike unpleasantly upon one's senses, nerves, or sensibilities (notes / contrast / tone) · collide: crash directly together in aggressive opposing collision (interests / viewpoints / cultures) · fall out: quarrel bitterly with an associate, causing a severed relationship (friends / partners / allies)
groups.nuance_zh: clash: 观点、时间或色彩间剧烈撞车或格格不入 (personalities / schedules / colors) · conflict: 利益或叙述逻辑上不可兼得的冲突矛盾 (interest / schedule / narrative) · jar: 突兀不谐，刺耳刺目引发感官不适 (notes / contrast / tone) · collide: 两种截然相反的文化或诉求正面猛烈交锋 (interests / viewpoints / cultures) · fall out: 密友或盟友间发生反目争吵致关系决裂 (friends / partners / allies)

groups.name: Claw & Lacerate · 抓挠与撕扯 (Claw, Tear, Gouge)
groups.tip: 利爪抓挠撕扯物体

items.def_en: To scratch or tear violently and repeatedly at a person or obstacle using fingernails or talons
items.ex_en: The terrified captive began to claw at the heavy wooden door in panic.
items.ex_zh: 惊恐万状的俘虏在慌乱中拼命抓挠那扇沉重的木门。

items.def_en: To attack something physically or verbally with relentless, destructive energy
items.ex_en: The hungry bear began to tear into the metal container with ferocious speed.
items.ex_zh: 饥饿的黑熊以惊人的凶猛势头疯狂撕扯撕咬着金属容器。

items.def_en: To pull something apart forcibly into pieces or cause deep ragged wounds with claws or force
items.ex_en: The aggressive feral dog can tear tough fabric into small shreds within seconds.
items.ex_zh: 那只凶猛的野狗能在几秒钟内把厚实的布料撕个稀烂。

items.def_zh: 用爪抓，撕扯；（用爪或手指）挖，抓取；费力夺回
items.def_en: 1. (+ at) To scratch, tear, or dig at something with sharp claws or fingernails. 2. ('claw back') To gradually recover money, power, or an advantage.
items.ex_en: Panicked by the smoke, the trapped passengers began to claw at the door.
items.ex_zh: 受浓烟惊吓的被困乘客开始疯狂用双手撕抓车门。

items.def_en: To inflict deep, jagged cuts or tears on flesh using sharp claws, teeth, or jagged edges
items.ex_en: Sharp jagged rocks beneath the surf will deeply lacerate any unwary swimmer's skin.
items.ex_zh: 海浪下尖锐嶙峋的礁石会重重割裂任何大意游泳者的皮肉。

items.def_en: To dig or force something out roughly, leaving a deep hollow groove or severe laceration
items.ex_en: The rampaging beast managed to gouge a deep jagged groove into the tree.
items.ex_zh: 暴怒的野兽硬是在坚硬的树干上生生剜出了一道深深的凹痕。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe aggressive, frantic, or sharp-edged gouging, tearing, and scraping with pointed claws, talons, or fingernails.
groups.summary_zh: 用利爪或指甲撕扯、猛抓以造成破坏或奋力挣扎。
groups.desc_en: Tearing, scratching, or scooping out tissue or material using sharp claws, nails, or pointed instruments, contrasting with clean blunt striking.
groups.desc_zh: 利用利爪、指甲或尖锐锋刃进行撕扯、抠挖或抓裂，区别于钝器打击或平直裁切。
groups.nuance_en: claw: dig sharp nails or talons into a surface to tear or climb (skin / way / dirt) · tear: rip material or flesh apart violently using sheer pulling tension (flesh / fabric / paper) · lacerate: cut or tear skin raggedly through severe physical trauma (flesh / wound / tissue) · gouge: scoop or dig out a deep trench or hole with a curved sharp force (eye / groove / hole) · claw at: scrape desperately or frantically at something (throat / door / clothing)
groups.nuance_zh: claw: 用指甲或利爪死命抓挠抠挖 (skin / way / dirt) · tear: 施加强力撕裂扯破肌理或布帛 (flesh / fabric / paper) · lacerate: 造成参差不齐的皮肉撕裂伤口 (flesh / wound / tissue) · gouge: 抠挖剜出凹槽、眼球或孔洞 (eye / groove / hole) · claw at: 绝望抓挠某处以求解脱 (throat / door / clothing)

groups.name: Clog & Silt Up · 阻塞与淤塞 (Silt Up, Clog, Choke)
groups.tip: 泥沙淤积致通道堵塞

items.def_en: To clog, foul, or prevent the smooth operation of a mechanism or channel with a sticky substance
items.ex_en: Pouring sticky syrup down the drain will completely gum up the delicate gears.
items.ex_zh: 将粘稠的糖浆倒进排水管会彻底粘死堵塞精密齿轮的运作。

items.def_zh: （河口、港湾等）淤积；被淤泥堵塞
items.def_en: To become gradually filled and obstructed with fine silt and sediment, or cause a waterway to do so
items.ex_en: Without regular dredging, the shallow harbor will gradually silt up during winter months.
items.ex_zh: 如果不定期清淤，这个浅水港湾在冬季几个月里便会逐渐被淤泥填塞。
items.ex2_en: Seasonal flooding silted up the agricultural irrigation canal with thick sticky mud.
items.ex2_zh: 季节性洪水带来的粘稠厚泥淤塞了农田灌溉水渠。

items.def_en: To block or become blocked with an accumulation of solid material or dirt so that movement is restricted
items.ex_en: Fallen autumn leaves can quickly clog the narrow municipal drainage channels after storms.
items.ex_zh: 暴雨过后，掉落的秋叶会迅速堵塞狭窄的市政排水通道。
items.ex2_en: Narrow bathroom pipes clog easily whenever grease washes down the sink drain.
items.ex2_zh: 每当油脂冲下水槽排水口时，狭窄的浴室水管都很容易堵塞。

items.def_en: To overcrowd or obstruct a conduit, passage, or route with an excessive volume of matter
items.ex_en: Unregulated cargo transports will inevitably congest the narrow mountain pass during rush hours.
items.ex_zh: 在高峰时段，无序通行的货运车流势必会堵塞狭窄的山口通道。
items.ex2_en: Commuter traffic congests heavily near the central tunnel entrance every weekday evening.
items.ex2_zh: 每个工作日傍晚，中央隧道入口附近的通勤交通都会严重拥堵。

items.def_en: (also 'silt up') To become blocked or filled with silt, or to cause a waterway or harbor to do so.
items.ex_en: Heavy seasonal runoff threatened to silt the narrow harbor mouth within months.
items.ex_zh: 严重的季节性径流可能在几个月内让狭窄的港口河口淤塞。
items.ex2_en: The lazy river silts rapidly during dry summer months without flowing water.
items.ex2_zh: 在没有流动活水的干燥夏月，这条流速缓慢的河流迅速淤积。

items.def_en: To fill a passage, pipe, or channel so full of matter that free circulation is completely stopped
items.ex_en: Decaying autumn leaves fell rapidly and choked the outdoor drainage pipe completely.
items.ex_zh: 腐烂的秋叶迅速落下，将室外排水管彻底堵塞。
items.ex2_en: The narrow exhaust chimney choked quickly with thick black soot during winter.
items.ex2_zh: 冬天里，狭窄的排烟烟囱迅速被厚厚的黑烟灰堵塞住了。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame capture the gradual or heavy accumulation of sediment, debris, or particulate matter that obstructs flow in pipes, drainage basins, harbors, and waterways.
groups.summary_zh: 泥沙、杂物等颗粒物质聚积沉淀，导致管道或河道水流通路受阻。
groups.desc_en: Obstructing, plugging, or filling a conduit or passage with accumulated sediment, sticky matter, or excessive volume, contrasting with unobstructed free flow.
groups.desc_zh: 由于淤泥、胶状物或过量堆积导致管道、通道堵塞或流通受阻，区别于通畅流淌。
groups.nuance_en: clog: impede or stop flow through a passage by accumulation of matter (drain / artery / pipe) · silt up: become choked specifically by fine deposited mineral sand or mud (harbor / river / reservoir) · congest: overcrowd or overfill a network beyond fluid capacity (traffic / nasal / lungs) · gum up: foul and immobilize mechanical works with a sticky viscous residue (gears / system / mechanism) · choke: throttle or close off an opening by dense, overwhelming packing (filters / weeds / canal)
groups.nuance_zh: clog: 杂物积聚堵塞管路通道 (drain / artery / pipe) · silt up: 泥沙沉积导致河道港湾淤浅填塞 (harbor / river / reservoir) · congest: 负荷超载导致的流速滞塞或充血 (traffic / nasal / lungs) · gum up: 黏液附着卡死机械运转或阻碍流程 (gears / system / mechanism) · choke: 杂物水草极度拥挤填塞而闭绝水流 (filters / weeds / canal)

groups.name: Coerce & Blackmail · 勒索与要挟 (Blackmail, Bleed, Squeeze)
groups.tip: 捏住把柄进行言语要挟逼索钱财

items.def_en: To extort large amounts of money from someone continuously
items.ex_en: The ruthless loan sharks continued to bleed the desperate merchant for months.
items.ex_zh: 残忍的高利贷者接连数月不断榨取那个走投无路的商人的钱财。

items.def_en: To obtain money from someone by deceit, intimidation, or extortion
items.ex_en: Corrupt inspectors used to shake down local tavern owners for protection money.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的巡查员过去常常向当地酒馆老板敲竹杠索要保护费。

items.def_en: To put pressure on someone to force them into giving up money or favors
items.ex_en: The powerful syndicate attempted to squeeze the shopkeeper for higher weekly payouts.
items.ex_zh: 势力庞大的辛迪加企图施压逼迫店主提高每周交纳的金额。

items.def_en: To demand money or favors from someone by threatening to reveal damaging secrets about them.
items.ex_en: The rogue accountant threatened to blackmail his former employer with stolen files.
items.ex_zh: 那个无良会计威胁要用盗窃的文件敲诈他的前雇主。

items.def_en: To compel someone to act through force, threats, or intimidation
items.ex_en: The military tribunal attempted to coerce the captured officer into signing confessions.
items.ex_zh: 军事法庭企图强迫被俘军官在供词上签字。

items.def_en: To obtain something by using threats, force, or abuse of authority
items.ex_en: Corrupt officials used fabricated charges to extort millions from successful private entrepreneurs.
items.ex_zh: 腐败官员利用捏造的罪名从成功的私营企业家手中勒索数百万资金。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate extorting money, property, or favors by exploiting sensitive leverage, exposing damaging secrets, or applying menacing emotional pressure.
groups.summary_zh: 通过揭发丑事、威胁隐秘利益或施加威吓手段强索金钱或特权。
groups.desc_en: Extracting money, assets, or compliance through menacing threats, exposure, or illicit systemic pressure, contrasting with voluntary legitimate commerce.
groups.desc_zh: 利用隐私把柄、暴力威逼或权力施压榨取金钱与屈服，区别于正当自愿交易。
groups.nuance_en: blackmail: demand money or favors under the threat of exposing damaging secrets (victim / politician / lover) · extort: illicitly wring money or confessions through official coercion or intimidation (cash / confession / ransom) · shake down: systematically extort money from people, often through intimidation or corrupt leverage (shopkeeper / target / business) · bleed: relentlessly and progressively drain someone of their financial assets (victim / company / resources) · squeeze: exert harsh financial or regulatory pressure to compel a concession (debtor / supplier / hostage)
groups.nuance_zh: blackmail: 以揭发隐私把柄相要挟进行勒索 (victim / politician / lover) · extort: 仰仗权势或暴力威逼敲诈钱财口供 (cash / confession / ransom) · shake down: 黑道或恶警以保护费等由敲竹杠搜刮 (shopkeeper / target / business) · bleed: 彻底吸干剥削尽其资产 (victim / company / resources) · squeeze: 步步紧逼榨取财物或迫其妥协 (debtor / supplier / hostage)

groups.name: Coerce & Press-gang · 强迫与诱骗胁迫 (Coerce, Railroad, Dragoon)
groups.tip: 用欺骗或暴力胁迫他人顺从

items.def_zh: 仓促强迫，逼迫…匆忙行动
items.def_en: To force someone into doing something hastily or without giving them time to consider or protest
items.ex_en: They tried to railroad me into signing the lease before reading it.
items.ex_zh: 他们试图在我不及阅读的情况下仓促强迫我签署租约。

items.def_zh: 诱骗，胁迫（某人做某事）；拐骗（去当水手）
items.def_en: (informal) to force or trick someone into doing something they do not want to do, or into going somewhere
items.ex_en: My clever roommate managed to shanghai me into helping him move furniture.
items.ex_zh: 我聪明的室友设法生拉硬拽骗我帮他搬家具。

items.def_en: To force or compel someone into taking on a job or task against their will
items.ex_en: The committee managed to press-gang several reluctant junior staff into organizing the gala.
items.ex_zh: 委员会强行抓差，让几名不情愿的初级员工去组织这场晚会。

items.def_en: To use physical force, intimidation, or aggressive pressure to make someone do something
items.ex_en: Corrupt city regulators tried to strong-arm the reluctant builder into accepting substandard materials.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的城市监管官员企图采取强硬手段逼迫不情愿的建筑商接受劣质材料。

items.def_en: To persuade someone forcefully to do something that they are unwilling to do, especially by using threats
items.ex_en: Authoritarian regimes frequently coerce dissidents into publicly confessing manufactured crimes against state security.
items.ex_zh: 专制政权经常胁迫异见人士公开承认捏造的危害国家安全罪行。

items.def_en: To force or bully someone into doing something they do not wish to do
items.ex_en: The domineering matriarch sought to dragoon her dutiful son into an unwanted marriage.
items.ex_zh: 专横的家族女长辈企图强迫她顺从的儿子接受一段违心的婚姻。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe compelling someone into an unwanted task or position, often through trickery, overwhelming social pressure, or outright intimidation. While standard compulsion can be legal, these verbs highlight unfair tactics, manipulation, or browbeating.
groups.summary_zh: 强调通过施压、诱骗或恃强凌弱迫使他人就范。
groups.desc_en: Forcing, tricking, or bulldozing someone into doing something entirely against their will through systemic coercion or deceit, contrasting with gentle persuasion.
groups.desc_zh: 借助暴力、欺瞒或强势压迫强推某人顺从就范，区别于温和劝诱。
groups.nuance_en: railroad: rush or force someone into an unfavorable action without fair hearing (suspect / legislation / decision) · strong-arm: compel compliance using blatant physical force or aggressive intimidation (rival / witness / union) · press-gang: conscript or compel someone abruptly into service against their wishes (crew / workers / volunteers) · shanghai: kidnap, trick, or drug someone into involuntary service or a compromising spot (sailors / captive / rival) · dragoon: severely coerce or badger someone into executing an onerous task (allies / citizens / voters)
groups.nuance_zh: railroad: 仓促构陷或强行通关压制抗辩 (suspect / legislation / decision) · strong-arm: 动用暴力蛮横胁迫使其就范 (rival / witness / union) · press-gang: 强行拉壮丁抓充劳役 (crew / workers / volunteers) · shanghai: 诱拐、下药或用诡计绑架服劳役 (sailors / captive / rival) · dragoon: 动用军警或蛮力高压逼服 (allies / citizens / voters)

groups.name: Cognitive Awakening & Comprehension · 顿悟与领会 (Realize, Grasp, Fathom)
groups.tip: 顿悟明白其中道理

items.def_en: To begin to realize or understand what is happening or meant
items.ex_en: It took him several awkward minutes to cotton on to their inside joke.
items.ex_zh: 他花了尴尬的几分钟才明白他们内部玩笑的含义。

items.def_en: To become slowly or suddenly clear to someone's mind
items.ex_en: It slowly began to dawn on her that he was not coming back.
items.ex_zh: 她慢慢意识到他再也不会回来了。

items.def_en:
1. to understand or become aware of a fact or situation
2. to achieve something that you were hoping for
items.ex_en: She suddenly began to realise the immense danger awaiting them in the valley.
items.ex_zh: 她猛然认识到山谷中等待着他们的巨大危险。

items.def_en: To fully understand the meaning, importance, or nature of something complicated
items.ex_en: Few novice investors truly grasp the subtle systemic risks of derivative markets.
items.ex_zh: 很少有新手投资者能真正透彻理解衍生品市场微妙的系统性风险。

items.def_en: To mentally grasp the nature, significance, or underlying logic of something
items.ex_en: The young scholar could scarcely comprehend the profound philosophical implications of the manuscript.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻学者几乎无法理解该手稿深刻的哲学内涵。

items.def_zh: 洞悉；探明（复杂/费解之事）
items.def_en: To successfully understand something deep, puzzling, or mysterious after much reflection
items.ex_en: Seasoned astronomers still struggle to fathom the underlying nature of dark matter.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的天文学家仍难以彻底探明暗物质的潜在本质。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey the mental arrival at conscious understanding, ranging from sudden realization to deep, analytical comprehension of complex facts.
groups.summary_zh: 描述思维意识的唤醒，从豁然顿悟到深层彻底理解复杂实情。
groups.desc_en: Transitioning from ignorance to sudden, deep, or progressive mental comprehension of a truth, contrasting with possessing static knowledge.
groups.desc_zh: 从愚昧懵懂突然或渐进地顿悟领会事理真相，区别于静态的知识储存。
groups.nuance_en: realise: become fully conscious of a reality or consequence (mistake / danger / truth) · dawn on: strike someone's mind gradually or suddenly as a self-evident revelation (realization / truth / irony) · cotton on: colloquially catch on to an ongoing fact or hidden trick (scam / hint / plan) · grasp: mentally comprehend the core principle, meaning, or complexity of an idea (concept / reality / gravity) · fathom: penetrate to the profound bottom of a deep mystery or cryptic motive (mystery / mind / motive)
groups.nuance_zh: realise: 猛然觉察到客观事实或后果 (mistake / danger / truth) · dawn on: 真相或荒谬感在心中渐渐被悟出 (realization / truth / irony) · cotton on: 口语化地觉察识破隐情或圈套 (scam / hint / plan) · grasp: 领悟抓住抽象概念或复杂事实的精髓 (concept / reality / gravity) · fathom: 彻底测度弄懂深奥莫测之谜或动机 (mystery / mind / motive)

groups.name: Cognitive Blurring & Confusion · 概念混淆与合并 (Confuse, Blur, Muddle)
groups.tip: 将不同概念融为一体或混为一谈

items.def_en: Mistake one person, thing, or idea for another in the mind
items.ex_en: Foreign tourists often confuse the city's historical district with the modern financial hub.
items.ex_zh: 外国游客经常把该市的历史街区同现代金融中心相混淆。

items.def_en: Make boundaries, differences, or distinctions unclear and difficult to perceive
items.ex_en: Partisan media coverage tends to blur the crucial distinction between fact and opinion.
items.ex_zh: 带有党派倾向的媒体报道往往会模糊事实与观点之间的关键界限。
items.ex2_en: Distant city streetlights blur softly through the rain-streaked windowpane at midnight.
items.ex2_zh: 半夜里，透过布满雨痕的窗玻璃，远处城市的街灯变得柔和模糊。

items.def_en: Consider or portray one thing as identical or equivalent to another
items.ex_en: Critical theorists refuse to equate mere economic growth with genuine social welfare.
items.ex_zh: 批判理论家拒绝将单纯的经济增长等同于真正的社会福祉。

items.def_en: Mix different thoughts, facts, or things together in a disorganized or confused way
items.ex_en: The confused witness began to jumble together events from two entirely separate evenings.
items.ex_zh: 困惑的证人开始把两个完全不同夜晚发生的事情胡乱混在一起。

items.def_en: Confuse or mix up two or more things, concepts, or identities in one's mind
items.ex_en: In his tired state, he managed to muddle up the twin sisters' names.
items.ex_zh: 在他疲惫的状态下，他把那对双胞胎姐妹的名字彻底搞混了。

items.def_zh: 将（两个或多个不同事物）混淆，合并（为一体）
items.def_en: (formal) To combine two or more separate things, especially ideas, concepts, or texts, into one whole, often creating confusion.
items.ex_en: The editorial tended to conflate distinct political ideologies into one broad pejorative term.
items.ex_zh: 该社论倾向于将不同的政治意识形态合并为一个宽泛的贬义词。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the mental act of failing to distinguish between distinct entities, concepts, or categories, mistakenly treating or fusing them as one.
groups.summary_zh: 指在认知上未能分清不同实体或概念，将其混同、模糊或误作一体。
groups.desc_en: Mentally or conceptually fusing, entangling, or failing to distinguish between distinct ideas or entities, contrasting with analytical categorization.
groups.desc_zh: 在认知上混淆、合并或分不清两项本有明确差异的概念或事物，区别于条分缕析。
groups.nuance_en: conflate: mistakenly combine two distinct concepts or narratives into a single unified whole (concepts / issues / accounts) · confuse: mistake one person, thing, or concept for another (identities / symptoms / terms) · blur: diminish the sharp distinctions separating categories or limits (boundaries / lines / distinction) · equate: treat two fundamentally unequal or different things as identical (criticism / terms / success) · muddle up: hopelessly tangle, mix up, or confuse elements in memory or thought (dates / facts / names)
groups.nuance_zh: conflate: 将两个本不相同的事物或议题混为一谈 (concepts / issues / accounts) · confuse: 错将甲认作乙或弄混认知 (identities / symptoms / terms) · blur: 淡化模糊了原本明确的界限区分 (boundaries / lines / distinction) · equate: 简单粗暴地将截然不同之物等同起来 (criticism / terms / success) · muddle up: 思维或记忆混乱导致颠倒纠缠 (dates / facts / names)

groups.name: Color & Dye Materials · 染色与涂饰 (Dye, Stain, Marble)
groups.tip: 涂刷或浸染赋予外观新色彩

items.def_en: [I/T] to treat wood, glass, or biological specimens with a penetrating pigment liquid
items.ex_en: The skilled carpenter chose to stain the oak tabletop a rich walnut brown.
items.ex_zh: 手艺精湛的木匠选择将橡木桌面着色为浓郁的胡桃棕色。

items.def_en: To change the color of something such as cloth or hair, especially by soaking it in a coloring liquid.
items.ex_en: She decided to dye the faded cotton curtains a deep navy blue.
items.ex_zh: 她决定把褪色的棉质窗帘染成深海军蓝。

items.def_zh: 使呈现大理石花纹，给……上大理石斑纹
items.def_en: To stain, paint, or pattern paper, wood, or other material so that it looks like veined marble.
items.ex_en: The craftsperson used floating pigment baths to marble thick sheets of parchment paper.
items.ex_zh: 手工艺人利用浮色颜料槽给厚羊皮纸印上大理石斑纹。

items.def_en: [I/T] to remove color from a fabric, hair, or pulp using chemicals or sunlight
items.ex_en: Direct intense sunlight will gradually bleach the delicate pigment from the curtains.
items.ex_zh: 强烈的直射阳光会逐渐漂白窗帘上细腻的色素。
items.ex2_en: Delicate silk shirts bleach quickly if hung outside under scorching summer sun.
items.ex2_zh: 精致的真丝衬衫如果晾晒在夏日烈日下，很快就会褪色泛白。

items.def_en: (technical) to color a substance by adding pigment or natural coloration
items.ex_en: Specialized gland cells pigment the butterfly's wings with intricate, iridescent patterns.
items.ex_zh: 专门的腺体细胞给蝴蝶的翅膀着色，形成错综复杂的绚丽斑纹。

items.def_en: to apply a slight or delicate coloration to hair, paper, or glass
items.ex_en: The skilled glazier prepared to tint the automotive glass with a charcoal film.
items.ex_zh: 熟练的玻璃工准备用炭灰色薄膜微染这块汽车玻璃。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote altering the color or surface appearance of a material (fabric, wood, paper, or hair) by impregnating it with pigments, coloring agents, or specialized decorative patterning. 'Dye' penetrates textiles or fibers fully, 'stain' alters surface tones, and 'marble' creates a swirling decorative vein pattern.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过浸润染料、上色或施加纹理改变材料表面颜色的工艺行为。
groups.desc_en: Altering the color, tone, or surface pattern of an industrial or raw material via chemical baths, pigments, or stains, contrasting with applying surface coat paint.
groups.desc_zh: 通过化学浸泡、染色剂或特定工艺渗入改变原料底色或纹理，区别于表面喷覆油漆。
groups.nuance_en: dye: impregnate fabric or hair throughout with a soluble color solution (fabric / yarn / hair) · stain: color a porous substrate while preserving and highlighting its underlying grain (wood / slide / floor) · bleach: chemically strip color or whiten thoroughly through oxidation (hair / fabric / pulp) · pigment: incorporate insoluble color particles directly into a medium (paint / skin / plastic) · tint: impart a light, delicate cast of color to a surface or glass (glass / hair / photo)
groups.nuance_zh: dye: 用染液对纺织品或头发进行透染 (fabric / yarn / hair) · stain: 着色并保留凸显木材或标本肌理 (wood / slide / floor) · bleach: 通过氧化漂白剥去原色 (hair / fabric / pulp) · pigment: 添加颜料颗粒使其整体着色 (paint / skin / plastic) · tint: 为玻璃、毛发等赋予浅淡色调 (glass / hair / photo)

groups.name: Color & Imbue Tone · 染色与赋色 (Hue, Complexion, Tint)
groups.tip: 施加色调赋予特殊外观

items.def_en: To tint or color something with a particular shade or hue.
items.ex_en: Dying embers continued to hue the dark room with a gentle copper glow.
items.ex_zh: 垂死余烬继续赋予黑暗房间一层柔和的微红铜色调。

items.def_zh: 浅染，微染（给予微弱色调）
items.def_en: to apply a small amount of color to something, giving it a slight hue
items.ex_en: The morning sun rose slowly to tint the snowy peak a delicate pink.
items.ex_zh: 晨曦缓缓升起，给积雪的山峰浅浅染上一抹娇嫩的粉红。

items.def_zh: 着微色，使带有一点颜色
items.def_en: to impart a slight or faint trace of a color to an object or surface
items.ex_en: A brief touch of frost began to tinge the maple leaves with scarlet.
items.ex_zh: 一阵微霜使枫叶开始隐隐透出一抹猩红。

items.def_zh: 赋予……色彩；赋予……某种特征或外观
items.def_en: To give a particular color, tint, appearance, or character to something.
items.ex_en: Warm evening shadows seemed to complexion the ancient stone arches with a melancholic mood.
items.ex_zh: 温暖的暮色阴影似乎赋予了古老石拱门一种忧郁的色彩特征。

items.def_zh: 染（用染料给布料、头发等彻底着色）
items.def_en: to change the color of something permanently using a chemical dye or liquid
items.ex_en: The local artisan used natural indigo solutions to dye large rolls of coarse linen.
items.ex_zh: 当地工匠使用天然蓼蓝浸液给成卷的粗亚麻布彻底染色。

items.def_en: to saturate or pervade an object deeply with a dye, stain, or color
items.ex_en: Master glassmakers would imbue the molten crystal with rare cobalt oxides for vibrant blueness.
items.ex_zh: 玻璃吹制大师会将稀有的氧化钴熔入晶体，使其完全浸染上明艳的蔚蓝。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote altering the visual appearance of an entity by imparting a specific color, shade, or natural pigmentation. They vary in depth of color change from subtle surface washes to deep, structural coloration.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过赋予颜色、色泽或天然色素来改变物体表面的视觉色调。
groups.desc_en: Subtly infusing, tinting, or coloring a physical appearance or abstract sentiment with a distinctive emotional or chromatic cast, contrasting with stark monochrome.
groups.desc_zh: 为神色、外貌或精神意绪赋予某种微妙的色晕或情感底色，区别于单调素色。
groups.nuance_en: tint: add a faint, transparent trace of color or shading (cheeks / sky / windows) · tinge: impart a tiny hint or trace of an extraneous color or emotion (hair / cheeks / sadness) · imbue: deeply saturate or permeate a subject with an enduring emotional quality or value (mind / work / spirit) · hue: cast or color something in a distinctive spectral tone (sky / leaves / landscape) · complexion: give a specific cast, appearance, or coloring to an aspect or face (situation / matter / narrative)
groups.nuance_zh: tint: 施加轻微淡薄的色彩或明暗渲染 (cheeks / sky / windows) · tinge: 渗入极其微量的色痕或情感余韵 (hair / cheeks / sadness) · imbue: 思想或作品中深沉灌注某种精神意绪 (mind / work / spirit) · hue: 赋予鲜明的光谱色泽或调性 (sky / leaves / landscape) · complexion: 改变脸容气色或赋予事情特定定性 (situation / matter / narrative)

groups.name: Come into Sight or Existence · 显形与浮现 (Materialize, Reappear)
groups.tip: 从暗中或遮蔽处出现浮现

items.def_en: (+ from) to come out into view or become manifest after being hidden
items.ex_en: A sleek black submarine began to emerge from the dense morning coastal fog.
items.ex_zh: 一艘线条流畅的黑色潜艇开始从清晨浓郁的沿海大雾中浮现。

items.def_en: to become visible or arrive at a place, especially when awaited or missing
items.ex_en: Despite my frequent reminders, he failed to show up for our afternoon rehearsal.
items.ex_zh: 尽管我屡次提醒，他还是没有在我们下午的彩排中露面。

items.def_en: to be found or suddenly appear after being lost, hidden, or absent
items.ex_en: The missing family heirloom did not turn up until the estate was cleared.
items.ex_zh: 直到清理遗产时，那件遗失的传家宝才突然被找到。
items.ex2_en: A thorough search of the dusty attic turned up several forgotten family letters.
items.ex2_zh: 对落满灰尘的阁楼进行彻底搜查后，找到了几封被遗忘的家书。

items.def_en: [I/T] to appear clearly or demonstrate one's presence in a tangible form
items.ex_en: Latent financial strains began to manifest visibly in their quarterly corporate reports.
items.ex_zh: 潜在的财务压力开始在他们的季度公司财报中显露无遗。

items.def_en: To appear or become visible again after being absent or hidden for a time.
items.ex_en: The elusive mountain leopard did not reappear until several snowy weeks had passed.
items.ex_zh: 直到过去数周大雪纷飞的日子，那只行踪难觅的雪豹才再次出现。

items.def_zh: 突然显现，现形；实现，成为现实
items.def_en: 1. To appear suddenly and unexpectedly, especially as if from nowhere. 2. To become a reality; to actually happen.
items.ex_en: The promised budget surplus failed to materialize despite significant federal spending cuts.
items.ex_zh: 尽管联邦政府大幅削减了开支，承诺的预算盈余却并未实现。

groups.summary_en: Verbs expressing the transition from unseen or absent to perceivable reality, often suddenly, tangibly, or after a period of disappearance.
groups.summary_zh: 强调事物从不可见或缺席状态转变为清晰显形、具象化或重新出现。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an entity shifting from obscurity, nonexistence, or physical absence into perceptible presence, contrasting with deliberate arrival or simple creation by emphasizing the spontaneous or perceptual threshold crossed.
groups.desc_zh: 指事物或人从隐蔽、不存在或缺失状态跨入可感知的现实视野，区别于预定抵达或平铺直叙的‘创造’，强调呈现与浮现的过程性或突发性。
groups.nuance_en: emerge: gradual transition out of concealment, obscurity, or fluid state (leader / pattern / detail) · materialize: sudden, almost magical physical manifestation out of nothingness (threat / evidence / objection) · show up: informal physical arrival, often belated or casual (guest / contestant) · turn up: unexpected reappearance after loss or search (lost keys / evidence / body) · manifest: tangible outward display of an internal or latent quality (symptom / anxiety / divinity)
groups.nuance_zh: emerge: 从隐藏、模糊或孕育状态中逐渐浮现或脱颖而出 (leader / pattern / detail) · materialize: 如同凭空变出般突然具象化或落实 (threat / evidence / objection) · show up: 口语中非正式露面，常带迟到或随意感 (guest / contestant) · turn up: 失踪或搜寻后出人意料地重新出现 (lost keys / evidence / body) · manifest: 隐性特征、情绪或疾病显形化与外在表露 (symptom / anxiety / divinity)

groups.name: Compare & Liken · 比拟与类比 (Liken, Compare, Equate)
groups.tip: 找寻相似处作形象比照

items.def_en: (+ to/with) To examine or represent two entities as similar or of equivalent standing
items.ex_en: Scholars often compare this ancient political crisis to modern parliamentary standoffs.
items.ex_zh: 学者们经常把这场古代政治危机比作现代议会僵局。

items.def_en: To show or highlight a close resemblance or structural similarity to another thing
items.ex_en: The protagonist's sudden downward trajectory seems to parallel historical falls from grace.
items.ex_zh: 主角突然的滑坡历程似乎比照了历史上那些从云端跌落的悲剧。

items.def_en: To make an explicit analogy or comparison between two things to clarify meaning
items.ex_en: The theoretical physicist sought to analogize quantum entanglement using paired everyday coins.
items.ex_zh: 这位理论物理学家试图用一对普通硬币来类比量子纠缠现象。

items.def_en: To demonstrate or establish a mutual relationship, correspondence, or systematic parallel
items.ex_en: Researchers managed to correlate erratic oceanic temperature shifts with recent violent storms.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员设法将异常的海洋温度变化与近期的猛烈风暴关联起来。
items.ex2_en: Violent coastal storms and sudden ocean temperature anomalies correlate strongly across historical records.
items.ex2_zh: 在历史记录中，狂暴的沿海风暴与突发的海水温度异常密切相关。

items.def_en: (+ with/to) To consider or declare two different things to be identical, equal, or mutually equivalent
items.ex_en: Critics argued it was utterly absurd to equate minor protests with armed insurrection.
items.ex_zh: 批评人士认为，将微不足道的抗议活动等同于武装暴乱极其荒唐。

items.def_en: 1. (+ to) (formal) To compare one person or thing to another by highlighting similarities.
items.ex_en: The classical poet liked to liken human life to a swift mountain stream.
items.ex_zh: 这位古典诗人喜欢将人生比作湍急的山间溪流。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on cognitively or rhetorically establishing points of resemblance, similarity, or identity between two distinct entities or phenomena.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过类比或联想，指出人或事物之间的相似或等同之处。
groups.desc_en: Denotes evaluating or asserting correspondence between two entities, contrasting with plain contrast or measurement by emphasizing the conceptual alignment, parity, or illustrative parallel drawn.
groups.desc_zh: 指在两个概念或实体间建立对照或对应关系，区别于单纯的对比差异或客观测量，强调指出二者的相似性、对等性或以此喻彼。
groups.nuance_en: compare: neutral baseline evaluation of similarities and differences (notes / performance / prices) · liken: metaphorical assertion of qualitative resemblance (life to a journey / mind to a computer) · equate: assertive claim that two distinct things are interchangeable or morally identical (wealth with success / silence with guilt) · parallel: structural or historical correspondence running side by side (development / trend / career) · analogize: explanatory mapping of relationships from one domain to another (brain to hardware / market to ecosystem)
groups.nuance_zh: compare: 最基础的中性并列比对异同 (notes / performance / prices) · liken: 将一物比拟或借喻为另一物 (life to a journey / mind to a computer) · equate: 强行将二者等同视之或断定为同一性质 (wealth with success / silence with guilt) · parallel: 在结构、走势或历史上高度平行契合 (development / trend / career) · analogize: 为阐明深层机制而进行系统的逻辑类比 (brain to hardware / market to ecosystem)

groups.name: Complete & Finalize · 完成与收尾 (Wrap up, Wind up, Conclude)
groups.tip: 使事情正式落地收尾

items.def_en: To bring something to an end formally or reach an agreement officially
items.ex_en: The special envoys met yesterday to conclude a binding bilateral trade treaty.
items.ex_zh: 特使们昨日会晤，以正式缔结一项具有约束力的双边贸易条约。

items.def_en: To complete or finish an event, task, or meeting successfully
items.ex_en: Let's wrap up this meeting so everyone can catch their flights.
items.ex_zh: 我们结束这次会议吧，这样大家都能赶上航班。

items.def_en: To bring a business, speech, or process gradually to an end
items.ex_en: The exhausted chairperson signaled his intention to wind up the tedious annual meeting.
items.ex_zh: 筋疲力尽的主席示意他打算结束这场冗长乏味的年度会议。

items.def_zh: 为…画上圆满句号；使圆满收尾
items.def_en: To finish or complete something in a particularly satisfying or successful way
items.ex_en: A breathtaking acoustic encore served to cap off an already magnificent evening concert.
items.ex_zh: 一段扣人心弦的原声加演为那场本已精彩绝伦的晚间音乐会画上了圆满句号。

items.def_zh: 了结；处理完（悬而未决的事）
items.def_en: To settle the final details of something (often as 'tie up loose ends')
items.ex_en: Most of his capital is tied up in long-term real estate investments.
items.ex_zh: 他的大部分资金都被长期房地产投资套住了。

items.def_zh: 把……最后定下来，最终落实；完成
items.def_en: To make final arrangements for something or agree on the last details of a plan or agreement.
items.ex_en: Diplomats worked tirelessly overnight to finalise the delicate terms of the ceasefire.
items.ex_zh: 外交官们彻夜不知疲倦地工作，以最终落实停火协议的微妙条款。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers actions aimed at concluding an undertaking, settling the last outstanding details, or bringing a project to a definitive close.
groups.summary_zh: 强调完成最后环节、敲定细节或彻底结束事务。
groups.desc_en: Denotes bringing an extended activity, discussion, or project to its terminal phase, contrasting with abrupt cessation or passive ending by emphasizing orderly resolution and tidying up loose ends.
groups.desc_zh: 指将持续的活动、谈判或工程带入终局并收束遗留事项，区别于突兀中断或自然停止，强调有序的终结与收束动作。
groups.nuance_en: conclude: formal logical or procedural termination (treaty / speech / investigation) · wrap up: briskly finishing the final stages of a project or meeting (deal / session / filming) · wind up: gradual settling of affairs toward closure, often winding down operations (business / estate / debate) · cap off: providing a crowning or decisive finishing touch (career / season / victory) · tie up: resolving minor pending issues and loose ends (loose ends / transaction / contract)
groups.nuance_zh: conclude: 正式、具仪式感或逻辑推演后的审慎终结 (treaty / speech / investigation) · wrap up: 迅速利落地完成末尾事务并收尾 (deal / session / filming) · wind up: 逐步清算、收束日常事务以走向最终停业或结案 (business / estate / debate) · cap off: 以高光成就或精彩动作画上圆满句号 (career / season / victory) · tie up: 收束未决细节并解决遗留残存问题 (loose ends / transaction / contract)

groups.name: Complicate & Entangle · 复杂化与纠缠 (Confound, Muddle, Cloud)
groups.tip: 问题节外生枝演变得更加棘手

items.def_en: To introduce irrelevant or confusing details to make a clear issue hard to understand
items.ex_en: The defense attorney introduced irrelevant rumors merely to muddy the waters further.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师引入无关的谣言，纯粹是为了进一步混淆视听。

items.raw_cluster: 恶化与复杂化 Worsen & Complicate
items.def_zh: 使复杂化，使恶化，使棘手
items.def_en: To make something more difficult, complex, or problematic to deal with.
items.ex_en: Unexpected transport delays will certainly complicate the logistical deployment across distant bases.
items.ex_zh: 意料之外的运输延误肯定会使跨越遥远基地的后勤部署复杂化。

items.def_en: To bring into a disordered, confusing, or ambiguous state
items.ex_en: Too many contradictory directives from management only served to muddle the project goals.
items.ex_zh: 管理层过多自相矛盾的指令只会把项目目标搞得混乱不堪。

items.def_en: To cause something to become complicated, jammed, or tangled in disorder
items.ex_en: A minor computer glitch threatened to snarl up the entire metropolitan rail network.
items.ex_zh: 一个小小的电脑故障极有可能使整个大都市的铁路网络陷入瘫痪。

items.def_en: To mix up distinct elements or worsen complexity by defying clear analysis
items.ex_en: These confounding statistical anomalies confound existing models and defy easy theoretical explanation.
items.ex_zh: 这些令人费解的统计异常使现有模型混杂混乱，难以用理论轻松解释。

items.def_en: To involve someone or something in a complicated, compromising, or intractable situation
items.ex_en: He feared that accepting the donation might entangle his firm in political controversy.
items.ex_zh: 他担心接受这笔捐款可能会让自己的公司卷入复杂的政治纷争。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on introducing tangled layers, confusion, or conflicting elements into an issue, making understanding, resolution, or execution significantly harder.
groups.summary_zh: 使局面错综复杂、难以理清，增加解决问题的难度。
groups.desc_en: Denotes escalating confusion or disorder by introducing thorny elements, contrasting with simple difficulty by emphasizing knotty, tangled interrelatedness or obscured clarity.
groups.desc_zh: 指引入节外生枝的因素致使局面混乱、交错难解，区别于单纯的‘困难’，强调事物盘根错节、难以理清或能见度被遮蔽。
groups.nuance_en: complicate: make more intricate, difficult, or problematic (situation / recovery / negotiations) · muddle: create disorganized confusion and lack of clear boundary (distinction / message / thinking) · muddy the waters: deliberately obscure issues to confuse judgment (debate / narrative / facts) · snarl up: cause gridlock, tangle, or physical/logistical jams (traffic / supply chain / bureaucracy) · entangle: inextricably ensnare in complicated, compromising relationships (finances / legal dispute / web of lies)
groups.nuance_zh: complicate: 增加变数使得结构更繁复或事态恶化 (situation / recovery / negotiations) · muddle: 搞混边界或次序导致条理不清 (distinction / message / thinking) · muddy the waters: 故意搅浑水以掩盖真相或扰乱视听 (debate / narrative / facts) · snarl up: 使交通、流程或官僚系统陷入死结与瘫痪 (traffic / supply chain / bureaucracy) · entangle: 卷入难以脱身的纷争、利害关系或骗局 (finances / legal dispute / web of lies)

groups.name: Compromise & Concede · 妥协与让步 (Compromise, Concede, Bargain)
groups.tip: 协商中让步达成一致

items.def_en: To end a dispute or legal contest by reaching a mutual contractual agreement
items.ex_en: The warring corporate partners chose to settle their contentious trademark dispute out of court.
items.ex_zh: 交战的合伙企业选择在法庭外就激烈的商标纠纷达成和解。

items.def_zh: 妥协，让步；危及，损害（名誉、安全等）
items.def_en: 1. To reach an agreement in which each side gives up part of what it originally wanted. 2. To damage, weaken, or expose something to danger or suspicion.
items.ex_en: Both negotiating delegations agreed to compromise on tariffs to avoid a disastrous trade war.
items.ex_zh: 两个谈判代表团一致同意在关税问题上互相妥协，以避免灾难性的贸易战。

items.def_en: To practice mutual accommodation by willing compromises between two sides
items.ex_en: Successful collective bargaining naturally requires genuine give and take from both sides.
items.ex_zh: 成功的集体谈判自然需要双方展示出真诚的互谅互让与妥协。

items.def_en: To compromise with someone by making concessions equal to those they offer
items.ex_en: The stubborn buyer finally agreed to meet halfway regarding the vehicle's selling price.
items.ex_zh: 那位固执的买家终于同意就汽车的售价各退半步达成妥协。

items.def_en: To negotiate the terms of an agreement, trading reciprocal concessions to find common ground
items.ex_en: Union representatives sat with management to bargain over workplace safety and hourly wages.
items.ex_zh: 工会代表与管理层坐在一起，就工作场所安全和小时工资进行谈判磋商。

items.def_en: To reluctantly admit defeat or surrender a right, point, or territory in an argument
items.ex_en: The diplomat finally agreed to concede the contested border territory during peace negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 在和平谈判中，这位外交官终于同意割让这片有争议的边境领土。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers mutual dispute resolution where conflicting parties give up contested ground or rights in order to reach consensus. It highlights tactical trade-offs, formal acknowledgments, and pragmatic agreements rather than mere emotional relenting.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过各退一步、放弃部分主张或诉求，以达成具有约束力的协议。
groups.desc_en: Denotes resolving an impasse through reciprocal or unilateral relinquishment of demands, contrasting with unconditional surrender by highlighting transactional accommodation.
groups.desc_zh: 指双方或单方放弃部分立场以打破僵局，区别于无条件的认输投降，强调相互调和、谈判退让的博弈过程。
groups.nuance_en: compromise: mutual sacrifice of claims to forge acceptable common ground (values / principles / settlement) · concede: yield a disputed point or recognize an opponent's advantage (defeat / territory / right) · meet halfway: bilateral egalitarian mutual step forward (colleagues / demands / offer) · settle: reach an operative formal agreement ending a dispute (lawsuit / claim / debt) · bargain: haggle and trade terms to maximize positional advantage (price / terms / contract)
groups.nuance_zh: compromise: 各退一步以达成折中，或指违背初衷牺牲原则 (values / principles / settlement) · concede: 在论辩或博弈中被迫承认失利或让出利益 (defeat / territory / right) · meet halfway: 双方均等各迈一步进行平等妥协 (colleagues / demands / offer) · settle: 正式了结争端或债务达成和解 (lawsuit / claim / debt) · bargain: 为争取利益而反复讨价还价与交换条件 (price / terms / contract)

groups.name: Concentrate & Condense · 浓缩与冷凝 (Condense, Boil Down, Reduce)
groups.tip: 排去稀释成分聚集成高浓度

items.def_en: To simmer a sauce or liquid until it becomes thicker and more flavorful through evaporation
items.ex_en: Simmer the red wine gently to reduce it into a rich, glossy glaze.
items.ex_zh: 慢火煨炖红酒，使其收汁变稠成浓郁油亮的酱汁。
items.ex2_en: The spiced berry sauce will reduce slowly into a thick and flavorful syrup.
items.ex2_zh: 加了香料的浆果汁会慢慢浓缩成浓稠美味的糖浆。

items.def_en: To reduce a liquid by prolonged boiling, or to summarize a complex issue into its fundamental point
items.ex_en: The ongoing political debate boils down to an argument over fundamental tax fairness.
items.ex_zh: 这场持续的政治辩论归结起来就是一场关于基本税收公平的争论。
items.ex2_en: The speaker tried to boil down the complex economic report to basic points.
items.ex2_zh: 发言者试图将这份复杂的经济报告浓缩归纳为几个基本要点。

items.def_zh: 浓缩，提纯；集中，全神贯注
items.def_en: 1. to reduce a liquid or solution to a denser, stronger form by removing water 2. to focus your attention, energy, or resources on one thing
items.ex_en: The factory uses advanced heat processes to concentrate fresh orange juice before shipping.
items.ex_zh: 工厂在运输前采用先进的加热工艺对新鲜橙汁进行浓缩。
items.ex2_en: Dissolved mineral salts gradually concentrate as excess water evaporates from the shallow desert lake.
items.ex2_zh: 随着浅沙漠湖泊中多余水分的蒸发，溶解的矿物盐逐渐浓缩。

items.def_zh: 使冷凝；浓缩；压缩（文章等）
items.def_en: To make a liquid or gas denser by cooling or removing water, or to shorten a text to its essentials
items.ex_en: The editor asked him to condense his lengthy research manuscript into five pages.
items.ex_zh: 编辑让他把冗长的研究手稿压缩成五页。
items.ex2_en: Rising atmospheric moisture will condense rapidly into dense fog over the cold mountain valley.
items.ex2_zh: 不断上升的大气湿气在寒冷的山谷上空迅速凝结成浓雾。

items.def_en: To thicken or congeal a liquid through evaporation or dehydration, especially in formal or medical contexts
items.ex_en: The apothecary gently heated the herbal extract to inspissate the medicinal resin.
items.ex_zh: 药剂师轻轻加热草药提取物，以使药用树脂增稠浓缩。
items.ex2_en: The sweet plant sap will inspissate naturally under the dry summer sun.
items.ex2_zh: 甜美的植物汁液在干燥的夏日阳光下会自然浓缩变稠。

items.def_en: To purify or concentrate a liquid by heating it to vapor and cooling it, or to extract essential meaning
items.ex_en: The author managed to distill years of philosophical contemplation into one short essay.
items.ex_zh: 作者成功地将多年的哲学思考提炼成了一篇短文。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to removing liquid, water, or bulk from a substance to make it thicker, denser, or more potent. They often extend figuratively to distilling ideas, texts, or problems into their core elements.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过蒸发、滤除水分使液体浓缩增稠，亦引申为提炼概括核心信息。
groups.desc_en: Denotes extracting essence or shrinking bulk by removing non-essential volume or diluent, contrasting with simple shrinking by focusing on heightened density, potency, or clarity.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过剔除多余水分、溶剂或冗长细节来提炼核心并缩小体积，区别于普通的‘缩水’，强调质地变稠、纯度或浓度显著提升。
