groups.nuance_en: concentrate: increase density or chemical potency by removing solvent (juice / ore / power) · condense: compress vapor to liquid or abbreviate text into dense form (steam / report / argument) · boil down: reduce liquid by boiling, or reduce an issue to its barest core (sauce / debate / issue) · distill: extract the purest spiritual or conceptual essence via vaporous refinement (wisdom / essence / spirit) · reduce: simmer culinary liquid to intensify flavor and reduce volume (sauce / broth / stock)
groups.nuance_zh: concentrate: 脱去稀释剂提高理化浓度，或集聚资源 (juice / ore / power) · condense: 冷凝液化，或将冗长文本浓缩为精炼要义 (steam / report / argument) · boil down: 熬干减量，或引申为将问题化约为最底层本质 (sauce / debate / issue) · distill: 蒸馏提取，或提炼思想与经验的最精纯精髓 (wisdom / essence / spirit) · reduce: 烹饪中慢熬收汁使风味浓郁 (sauce / broth / stock)

groups.name: Concern & Care · 关心与介意 (Care, Mind, Bother)
groups.tip: 放不下、在心上挂念与介怀

items.def_zh: 在乎，介意，关心；照顾，关照（care for）；愿意，想要
items.def_en: 1. To be interested in or concerned about something. 2. (care for) To look after or provide for someone. 3. (care for / to do) To want or like to do something.
items.ex_en: He genuinely cares for his elderly neighbors whenever severe winter storms strike.
items.ex_zh: 每当严冬暴风雪来袭，他都会真切地关照上了年纪的邻居。

items.def_zh: 介意，在乎；注意，当心；照看，看护
items.def_en: 1. To be annoyed, worried, or bothered by something. 2. To be careful about; heed. 3. To take care of or watch over someone or something.
items.ex_en: Would you mind keeping your voice down while the baby is sleeping?
items.ex_zh: 宝宝睡觉的时候，你介意放低声音吗？

items.def_en: [I/T] to make an effort or to be annoyed/worried by something
items.ex_en: She decided not to bother responding to those pointless online comments yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 她昨天决定不再费心去回复那些毫无意义的网络评论。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to feel concern, interest, or emotional investment regarding someone or something
items.ex_en: True leaders genuinely care about the long-term well-being of their communities.
items.ex_zh: 真正的领导者由衷地在乎其社区的长远福祉。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to pay excessive or nervous attention to someone or something
items.ex_en: Grandmother tends to fuss over every minor sniffle whenever the grandchildren visit.
items.ex_zh: 孙辈们每次来访，祖母往往连他们哪怕一点微小的抽鼻涕都会瞎操心。

items.def_en: (+ about/over) to be continuously worried, anxious, or unhappy about something
items.ex_en: There is no reason to fret over small mistakes in your first draft.
items.ex_zh: 没有理由为你初稿中的微小错误而发愁不安。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on an experiencer attaching subjective importance or negative feeling to a state of affairs. While 'care' reflects general emotional investment or concern, 'mind' is largely used in negative and interrogative contexts to denote objecting to or being troubled by something.
groups.summary_zh: 主观上对某事感到介意、挂怀或产生情感投入。
groups.desc_en: Denotes investing affective energy, unease, or attention toward an object, contrasting with intellectual interest by emphasizing subjective stakes, anxiety, or emotional burden.
groups.desc_zh: 指将情感、注意力或焦虑感倾注于某事，区别于单纯的理智好奇，强调内心的牵挂、介怀或情绪负累。
groups.nuance_en: care: possess genuine emotional investment, affection, or regard (about safety / for elderly) · mind: feel personal objection, discomfort, or annoyance (the noise / waiting / intrusion) · bother: expend personal effort or suffer irritating mental friction (with details / about opinion) · fuss over: bestow excessive, nervous, or trivializing attention (appearance / guest / details) · fret: suffer chronic, unproductive inward worry (over mistakes / about money / constantly)
groups.nuance_zh: care: 怀有真挚的关怀、牵挂或同理心 (about safety / for elderly) · mind: 感到反感、介意或心理抵触 (the noise / waiting / intrusion) · bother: 费心耗神去做某事，或受到令人烦躁的打扰 (with details / about opinion) · fuss over: 对琐碎细节表现得过分紧张、嘘寒问暖或瞎操心 (appearance / guest / details) · fret: 在内心反复为未来或细故焦虑发愁 (over mistakes / about money / constantly)

groups.name: Concoct & Hatch · 谋划与编造 (Cook up, Hatch, Devise)
groups.tip: 凭空捏造，虚构罗织剧情

items.def_en: To invent a method, system, or plan cleverly and thoughtfully
items.ex_en: Engineers worked overtime to devise an innovative filtration system for the plant.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们加班加点，为该工厂构想出一套创新的过滤系统。

items.def_en: To invent or fabricate an excuse, story, or deceptive plan
items.ex_en: He had to cook up an excuse for being late to the morning briefing.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不编造一个早会迟到的借口。

items.def_en: To invent an idea, scheme, or fantasy that is unusual, fanciful, or impractical
items.ex_en: Only marketing executives could dream up such an impractical promotional campaign.
items.ex_zh: 只有市场主管才能凭空想出这种不切实际的推广活动。

items.def_en: To create or secretly devise a plot, conspiracy, or plan, usually harmful or clandestine
items.ex_en: Rebels gathered in the shadows to hatch a perilous treason against the crown.
items.ex_zh: 叛乱分子聚集在阴影中，密谋对王室发动一场危险的叛逆。

items.def_zh: 捏造，编造（借口、计划）；调制，配制
items.def_en: 1. To invent an excuse, story, or plan, especially to deceive someone. 2. To make a food or drink by mixing different ingredients together.
items.ex_en: He quickly concocted a plausible alibi to explain his absence from the meeting.
items.ex_zh: 他迅速编造了一个看似合理的托辞来解释自己的缺席。

items.def_en: To invent false information or forge evidence in order to deceive people
items.ex_en: The corrupt accountant deliberately fabricated financial statements to deceive the auditors.
items.ex_zh: 那个贪腐的会计故意伪造财务报表以蒙骗审计人员。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe scheming, formulating intricate plans, or fabricating deceitful stories and excuses. They highlight clandestine craftiness or elaborate mental calculation.
groups.summary_zh: 指秘密策划方案或巧妙编造借口、阴谋，带有工于心计的意味。
groups.desc_en: Denotes mentally formulating an intricate scheme, invention, or falsehood, contrasting with candid planning by emphasizing artfulness, clandestine design, or sheer fabrication.
groups.desc_zh: 指在头脑中构思复杂方案、谎言或圈套，区别于公开坦荡的‘规划’，强调匠心独运、暗中策划或无中生有的虚构成分。
groups.nuance_en: devise: intellectually design a clever, practical mechanism or plan (strategy / solution / method) · concoct: invent an elaborate excuse, drink, or fictitious story (excuse / beverage / plot) · hatch: secretly nurture and finalize a covert plot or conspiracy (plot / scheme / conspiracy) · fabricate: construct outright falsehoods or forged evidence from scratch (evidence / charges / story) · cook up: hastily or mischievously assemble a dubious excuse or scheme (scheme / explanation / plan)
groups.nuance_zh: devise: 运用智力巧妙设计切实可行的策略或机械 (strategy / solution / method) · concoct: 混合调制饮品，或编造煞有介事的借口与谎言 (excuse / beverage / plot) · hatch: 在暗中孵育策划阴谋或颠覆性方案 (plot / scheme / conspiracy) · fabricate: 凭空捏造、伪造伪证以陷害或掩盖 (evidence / charges / story) · cook up: 口语中仓促或别有用心地捯饬出借口或小算盘 (scheme / explanation / plan)

groups.name: Condemn & Rail · 谴责与痛斥 (Fulminate, Denounce, Inveigh)
groups.tip: 从严厉谴责升级为激烈痛骂

items.def_en: (+ at/against) To suddenly attack someone verbally with harsh, aggressive criticism or abuse.
items.ex_en: Under intense questioning, the stressed politician suddenly lashed out at reporters.
items.ex_zh: 在严厉的质问下，这位压力巨大的政客突然厉声斥责起记者来。

items.def_en: (+ against/at) To complain angrily and bitterly about someone or something.
items.ex_en: The bitter old man continued to rail against the injustice of fate.
items.ex_zh: 那个满腹怨怼的老人继续痛斥命运的不公。

items.def_en: To criticize someone or something strongly and publicly, often stating that they are evil, dishonest, or illegal.
items.ex_en: Human rights organizations publicly denounced the violent military crackdown on peaceful protesters.
items.ex_zh: 人权组织公开谴责针对和平示威者的暴力军事镇压。

items.def_en: (+ against) To speak or write with deep hostility and bitter criticism against something.
items.ex_en: The fiery columnist continued to inveigh against the corruption of local officials.
items.ex_zh: 这位言辞激烈的专栏作家继续撰文猛烈痛斥地方官员的腐败。

items.def_en: To punish, rebuke, or criticize someone extremely severely, often in public.
items.ex_en: The board gathered to castigate the rogue executive for his reckless mismanagement.
items.ex_zh: 董事会集会严厉责难那位胡作非为的高管极其鲁莽的管理不善。

items.def_en: (+ against/at) To express intense, explosive anger and criticism publicly and forcefully.
items.ex_en: The preacher stood at the pulpit to fulminate against rising societal decadence.
items.ex_zh: 传教士站在讲坛上，怒斥日益严重的社会堕落现象。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses fierce verbal assault, indignant protest, and blistering public rebuke. While 'rail' stresses prolonged, exasperated complaining, 'denounce' delivers formal moral condemnation, and 'fulminate' captures explosive oratorical rage.
groups.summary_zh: 指满怀义愤或激烈怒火地公开发难、猛烈抨击与痛骂。
groups.desc_en: Denotes expressing virulent public or verbal condemnation, contrasting with measured criticism by emphasizing blistering outrage, moral censure, or polemical ferocity.
groups.desc_zh: 指用激烈言辞予以公开声讨或痛责，区别于克制的‘批评’，强调怒不可遏的道德审判、攻击性与火药味。
groups.nuance_en: denounce: publicly proclaim someone or something as wicked, guilty, or illegitimate (corruption / tyrant / treaty) · rail: passionately protest and complain with prolonged indignation (against injustice / at fate / against taxes) · fulminate: erupt into thunderous, explosive verbal condemnation (against heresy / about regulations) · castigate: severely criticize or reprimand with punitive harshness (critic / behavior / official) · inveigh: launch a formal, bitter literary or oratorical assault (against corruption / against decadence)
groups.nuance_zh: denounce: 正式、公开发表声明痛斥其不义或撕毁条约 (corruption / tyrant / treaty) · rail: 满腔悲愤地持续抗议、痛骂不公或命运 (against injustice / at fate / against taxes) · fulminate: 如雷霆般暴怒声讨，情绪极其激烈 (against heresy / about regulations) · castigate: 施加惩戒式的严厉训诫与鞭笞 (critic / behavior / official) · inveigh: 发起极为激烈且文采斐然的书面或演说痛斥 (against corruption / against decadence)

groups.name: Condescend & Patronize · 居高临下与优越屈尊 (Condescend, Patronize, Stoop)
groups.tip: 居高临下施恩或自显优越

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) consider oneself superior to someone or view them with patronizing disdain
items.ex_en: She never looks down on anyone just because they come from a humble background.
items.ex_zh: 她绝不会仅仅因为别人出身平凡而看不起对方。

items.def_zh: 以居高临下的口吻对……说话
items.def_en: (+ to) to speak condescendingly to someone as if they were simple or inferior
items.ex_en: Stop talking down to the interns as if they cannot understand simple concepts.
items.ex_zh: 别再用那种居高临下的口吻跟实习生说话，好像他们理解不了简单概念似的。

items.def_en: (+ to) to lower one's moral or social standards by doing something beneath oneself
items.ex_en: A respectable professional should never stoop to spreading malicious workplace rumors.
items.ex_zh: 一个体面的专业人士绝不该降格到去散布恶毒的职场谣言。

items.def_zh: 屈尊，俯就；表现出优越感，居高临下
items.def_en: 1. (+ to do) To agree to do something while behaving as if you are superior and doing others a favor. 2. (+ to) To treat someone with an air of condescension or superiority.
items.ex_en: The arrogant professor rarely condescended to answer questions from undergraduate students.
items.ex_zh: 那位傲慢的教授极少屈尊回答本科生提出的问题。

items.def_zh: 居高临下地对待，自显优越；光顾，惠顾；资助，赞助
items.def_en: 1. (disapproving) To speak or behave toward someone in a way that suggests you think you are more intelligent or important than them. 2. (formal) To be a regular customer of a business, shop, or restaurant. 3. To act as a patron toward; support or sponsor.
items.ex_en: She hated how senior colleagues patronized her whenever she proposed creative ideas.
items.ex_zh: 她讨厌每当自己提出创意想法时资深同事那种自显优越的做派。

items.def_en: (+ to do sth) to do something that one considers beneath one's dignity
items.ex_en: The aloof nobleman did not deign to acknowledge the peasants' polite greetings.
items.ex_zh: 冷漠的贵族甚至不屑屈尊理会农夫们礼貌的问候。

groups.summary_en: Superiors behave towards others with an air of gracious superiority, treating them as inferiors while feigning benevolence, polite concession, or guidance.
groups.summary_zh: 指以居高临下的优越姿态对待他人或故作宽宏屈尊。
groups.desc_en: Denotes interacting with others from an assumed stance of superior status, intelligence, or virtue, contrasting with simple arrogance by emphasizing the visible performance of humoring or stooping to an inferior.
groups.desc_zh: 指自居上位去对待地位、智识不如自己的人，区别于普通的自大，强调那种屈尊俯就、自命不凡或把对方当小孩哄的做作姿态。
groups.nuance_en: condescend: consciously waive rank to show graciousness, often carrying an offensive aura of superiority (to explain / to crowd) · patronize: treat someone with an ostensibly kind demeanor that insults their maturity or competence (customer / junior / staff) · stoop: lower one's moral dignity to commit a base act (to bribery / to petty lies) · deign: reluctantly condescend to perform an act deemed beneath one's dignity (to reply / to speak) · talk down: use simplified, patronizing speech implying the listener is unintelligent (to students / to public)
groups.nuance_zh: condescend: 刻意放下身段屈尊以示开恩，却透出高人一等的傲慢 (to explain / to crowd) · patronize: 表面温和关照实则将对方视作低能儿般居高临下 (customer / junior / staff) · stoop: 自贬身价，堕落到去做卑劣下作之事 (to bribery / to petty lies) · deign: 傲慢矜持地恩赐回应，认为该事本有损尊严 (to reply / to speak) · talk down: 用哄小孩或俯就的口吻讲话，暗示对方缺乏理解力 (to students / to public)

groups.name: Confine & Enclose · 限制与监禁 (Incarcerate, Hem In, Impound)
groups.tip: 限定活动范围与人身自由

items.def_en: To surround someone or something tightly so they have little room to move or act
items.ex_en: Surrounding skyscrapers completely hem in the historic chapel, blocking out natural sunlight.
items.ex_zh: 周围的摩天大楼将这座历史悠久的小教堂紧紧包围，挡住了自然阳光。

items.def_en: To keep someone or an animal confined in an uncomfortably small or enclosed space
items.ex_en: Heavy blizzards cooped the entire family up inside the cabin for days.
items.ex_zh: 大暴雪将全家人困在木屋里好几天，动弹不得。

items.def_en: To enclose or confine someone closely within walls against their will
items.ex_en: Cruel captors chose to immure the deposed king within stone dungeon walls.
items.ex_zh: 残酷的捕获者选择将废黜的国王幽禁在坚硬的石牢高墙之内。

items.def_zh: 限制，使局限于；监禁，关押
items.def_en: (+ to) to keep someone or something restricted within a certain place, limit, or subject; to keep someone in an enclosed space
items.ex_en: Please confine your remarks strictly to the topic currently under discussion.
items.ex_zh: 请将您的发言严格限制在当前讨论的话题范围内。

items.def_en: To officially keep someone in custody and prevent them from leaving
items.ex_en: Customs officers decided to detain the traveler for carrying undeclared valuable goods.
items.ex_zh: 海关官员决定扣留该旅客，因其携带有未申报的贵重物品。

items.def_en: To put or hold someone inside a prison or correctional facility
items.ex_en: The court decided to incarcerate the convicted embezzler for ten long years.
items.ex_zh: 法院决定将这名被定罪的公款侵吞犯监禁长达十年。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame define restricting a person, group, or topic strictly within physical perimeters or predefined conceptual scopes.
groups.summary_zh: 将人、物或议题严格限制、锁闭在固定的空间或范围之内。
groups.desc_en: Denotes restricting an agent within physical or spatial barriers, contrasting with abstract regulation by emphasizing bodily sequestration, incarceration, or severe spatial constriction.
groups.desc_zh: 指将人或动物限制在坚固、狭小或受控的物理空间内，区别于抽象的规章约束，强调对人身自由的剥夺、拘禁或空间逼仄感。
groups.nuance_en: confine: restrict within defined physical bounds or beds due to illness (prisoner / patient / livestock) · incarcerate: formally imprison in a penal institution (offender / felon / criminal) · detain: hold someone in custody temporarily under legal authority (suspect / traveler / activist) · immure: enclose completely within walls or impenetrable isolation (hermit / prisoner / body) · coop up: cramp inside an uncomfortably tight, suffocating enclosure (children / chickens / team)
groups.nuance_zh: confine: 将活动范围限制在狭小区域，或因病卧床 (prisoner / patient / livestock) · incarcerate: 正式关押入狱或送入精神病院监禁 (offender / felon / criminal) · detain: 依据行政或法律职权予以暂时羁押或扣留 (suspect / traveler / activist) · immure: 幽闭于深墙或彻底与外界隔绝的死地 (hermit / prisoner / body) · coop up: 将人或动物憋屈地拘押在逼仄窒息的空间内 (children / chickens / team)

groups.name: Confirm & Corroborate · 证实与确证 (Substantiate, Verify, Authenticate)
groups.tip: 提供证据互相印证与证实

items.def_en: To check and confirm whether an assertion, figure, or identity is accurate and genuine
items.ex_en: Investigators carefully reviewed bank records to verify the authenticity of the transactions.
items.ex_zh: 调查人员仔细审查了银行记录，以核实交易的真实性。

items.def_en: To provide evidence or factual results supporting a theory, prediction, or claimant
items.ex_en: The final audit results bore out all our initial suspicions about financial mismanagement.
items.ex_zh: 最终的审计结果证实了我们最初对财务管理不善的所有怀疑。

items.def_en: To confirm that something is factually sound, logically legitimate, or legally valid
items.ex_en: Subsequent clinical trials helped validate the initial hypothesis regarding the new drug.
items.ex_zh: 随后的临床试验证实了关于这种新药的初步假设是正当有效的。

items.def_en: (formal) To provide evidence or information that supports and confirms a statement, theory, or finding.
items.ex_en: Independent satellite imagery emerged to corroborate the eyewitness accounts of the incident.
items.ex_zh: 独立的卫星图像涌现出来，佐证了目击者对该事件的陈述。

items.def_en: To prove formally that an item, document, or statement is genuine rather than fake
items.ex_en: Museum specialists used infrared scanning to authenticate the newly discovered Renaissance painting.
items.ex_zh: 博物馆专家使用红外扫描来鉴别这幅新发现的文艺复兴时期画作的真伪。

items.def_en: To provide substantial evidence, documentation, or facts to prove the truth of a claim
items.ex_en: The plaintiff failed to substantiate her serious allegations with any credible evidence.
items.ex_zh: 原告未能用任何可信的证据来证实她的严重指控。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe supplying independent proof, testimonial support, or empirical documentation to establish the factual truth of an assertion.
groups.summary_zh: 指提出有力凭据、事实或独立证据以印证并核实论断的真实性。
groups.desc_en: Denotes establishing the truth, validity, or accuracy of a claim using external evidence or official testing, contrasting with initial assertion by emphasizing secondary, independent validation.
groups.desc_zh: 指借助外在客观证据或官方程序对某断言进行二次检验确证，区别于单方面的宣称，强调独立性与证据链的闭合。
groups.nuance_en: verify: check facts or identity against standard criteria or reality (identity / hypothesis / accuracy) · corroborate: provide supporting, independent evidence that strengthens an account (testimony / story / findings) · substantiate: furnish solid, material proof for an otherwise floating allegation (claim / accusation / charge) · validate: officially certify as legally, technically, or logically sound (ticket / theory / feelings) · authenticate: establish original genuineness and non-forgery (painting / artifact / signature)
groups.nuance_zh: verify: 对照标准、事实或凭证核实真伪与精确度 (identity / hypothesis / accuracy) · corroborate: 提供独立旁证来增强先前陈述的可信度 (testimony / story / findings) · substantiate: 提供实质性硬核证据以坐实指控或主张 (claim / accusation / charge) · validate: 赋予合规效力，或从逻辑与情感上承认合理性 (ticket / theory / feelings) · authenticate: 鉴别文物、签名或作品确系真品而非伪造 (painting / artifact / signature)

groups.name: Conserve & Economize · 节约与保护 (Conserve, Husband, Economize)
groups.tip: 妥善保留防止物品变质耗损

items.def_zh: 妥善节用；精打细算管理
items.def_en: Manage, cultivate, or use resources prudently and economically
items.ex_en: During harsh winters, prudent farmers husband their scarce grain reserves with care.
items.ex_zh: 在严酷的冬季，谨慎的农夫们会精心节用匮乏的粮食储备。

items.def_zh: 精打细算撑起；使（钱财等）耐用
items.def_en: Make a quantity of food, money, or resources last longer by using it sparingly
items.ex_en: By cooking simple meals at home, they managed to stretch their meager budget.
items.ex_zh: 通过在家做简餐，他们设法靠微薄的预算精打细算撑了下去。
items.ex2_en: Our remaining emergency water supplies simply cannot stretch across another hot summer week.
items.ex2_zh: 我们剩余的应急饮用水根本无法支撑又一个炎热的一周。

items.def_en: Spend less money or use fewer supplies and resources than usual
items.ex_en: The family resolved to economize on electricity by unplugging unused household appliances.
items.ex_zh: 该家庭决定通过拔掉不用电器的插头来节约用电、紧缩开支。

items.def_zh: 保护，保存；节约，节省；使（能量等）守恒
items.def_en: 1. to protect something from harm, loss, or waste; to use something carefully to prevent depletion. 2. (physics) to keep a quantity constant during a physical process.
items.ex_en: Citizens were strongly urged to conserve drinking water during the prolonged summer drought.
items.ex_zh: 在漫长的夏季干旱期间，市民们被强烈呼吁节约饮用水。

items.def_en: Limit the consumption or distribution of scarce goods, fuel, or food
items.ex_en: The besieged garrison had to ration remaining food supplies to survive longer.
items.ex_zh: 被围困的守军不得不定量配给剩余的粮食供应，以支撑更久。

items.def_en: Reduce the quantity, duration, or extent of something to conserve supplies
items.ex_en: The municipal government decided to curtail nonessential public expenditures during the crisis.
items.ex_zh: 危机期间，市政府决定削减非必要的公共开支。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on managing limited resources, energy, or natural assets prudently to prevent waste, depletion, or extinction.
groups.summary_zh: 指审慎节约、精打细算地使用有限资源，以防消耗竭尽或破坏。
groups.desc_en: Denotes prudent management and sparing use of finite resources, contrasting with stingy hoarding or mere saving by emphasizing stewardship, sustainability, and planned consumption.
groups.desc_zh: 指对有限资源进行审慎规划与节流管理，区别于守财奴式的吝啬或普通的‘储蓄’，强调善用资源、延长其维系周期的管家精神。
groups.nuance_en: conserve: protect and deliberately save resources from waste or destruction (water / energy / wildlife) · husband: manage dwindling provisions with farsighted, calculated frugality (resources / strength / wealth) · economize: reduce operating expenses and avoid extravagance (on heating / budget / spending) · ration: allocate scarce necessities in strictly metered portions (fuel / food / supplies) · stretch: make an inadequate resource last further through inventive austerity (budget / supplies / dollar)
groups.nuance_zh: conserve: 秉持环保或可持续理念保护与节约自然资源 (water / energy / wildlife) · husband: 审慎周全、极具远见地妥善省用稀缺资源 (resources / strength / wealth) · economize: 削减不必要开支以度过财政紧缩 (on heating / budget / spending) · ration: 在资源匮乏时期实行定量配给配售 (fuel / food / supplies) · stretch: 靠精打细算让捉襟见肘的物资多撑一段时日 (budget / supplies / dollar)

groups.name: Constrain & Inhibit · 限制与约束 (Shackle, Hamstring, Tether)
groups.tip: 通过规则约束限制行动自由

items.def_en: To restrict someone's freedom of action or movement through obligations or conditions
items.ex_en: He didn't want to buy a house because he hated being tied down to one location.
items.ex_zh: 他不想买房，因为讨厌被束缚在同一个地方。

items.def_en: To hamper, impede, or limit the proper development or freedom of something
items.ex_en: Outdated societal dogmas continue to trammel the creative impulses of young minds.
items.ex_zh: 陈旧的社会教条继续束缚着年轻一代的创造性冲动。

items.def_en: 1. (formal) To restrict or limit someone's freedom, choice, or actions. 2. (often passive, 'be constrained to') To compel or force someone to act in a certain way.
items.ex_en: Budgetary limitations heavily constrain our ability to hire experienced senior software engineers.
items.ex_zh: 预算限制极大地约束了我们聘请经验丰富的资深软件工程师的能力。

items.def_en: To severely prevent freedom of action or development, as if with chains
items.ex_en: Excessive bureaucratic regulations should not shackle the natural growth of small businesses.
items.ex_zh: 过度的官僚规章制度不应束缚小型企业的自然发展。

items.def_zh: 使受挫；切断…的活动能力
items.def_en: To severely handicap, impair, or limit the efficiency or effectiveness of someone or something
items.ex_en: Sudden legal disputes threaten to hamstring the company's major expansion into foreign markets.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的法律纠纷恐将削弱公司向海外市场大幅扩张的能力。

items.def_en: To restrict or confine someone's freedom or advancement
items.ex_en: Generations of tyrannical edicts served only to fetter the nation's cultural renaissance.
items.ex_zh: 数代暴虐的法令只会羁绊这个国家的文化复兴。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on restricting someone's capacity for independent movement, choice, or operation, frequently through institutional, physical, or resource limitations.
groups.summary_zh: 强调通过制度、环境或物理力量束缚主体的行动自由或发展能力。
groups.desc_en: Denotes crippling an agent's freedom of action, mobility, or development, contrasting with spatial confinement by emphasizing external hindrances, functional paralysis, or structural hobbling.
groups.desc_zh: 指束缚或剥夺行动主体的自主活动能力与发展潜能，区别于物理空间的‘禁锢’，强调机制性绑架、功能残损或被羁绊带来的施展受阻。
groups.nuance_en: constrain: force into limits through external necessity, rules, or conditions (growth / choice / spending) · hamstring: severely impair the effectiveness or operating capacity of a system (economy / investigation / military) · shackle: bind down with heavy, oppressive structural or ideological restrictions (economy / innovation / liberty) · fetter: chain ankles or hinder free movement through archaic encumbrance (industry / imagination / trade) · trammel: entangle in a fine mesh of bureaucratic or legal impediments (progress / liberty / market)
groups.nuance_zh: constrain: 受到外部条件、规则或力量的迫使与制约 (growth / choice / spending) · hamstring: 割断脚筋般从要害处重创体制运作能力 (economy / investigation / military) · shackle: 如戴沉重枷锁般压制自由与创新 (economy / innovation / liberty) · fetter: 戴上脚镣，引申为陈旧体制对行动的羁绊 (industry / imagination / trade) · trammel: 如落入罗网般被官僚琐事或法规层层缠扰 (progress / liberty / market)

groups.name: Consume & Deplete · 消耗与耗尽 (Consume, Deplete, Exhaust)
groups.tip: 从持续消耗到彻底耗竭

items.def_en: To use up or spend time, effort, or capital in completing a specific purpose
items.ex_en: Scientists must expend enormous intellectual effort to decode complex genetic sequences accurately.
items.ex_zh: 科学家们必须耗费巨大的心智努力，才能精确破译复杂的基因序列。

items.def_en: To finish completely the entire supply of an ingredient, fuel, or material
items.ex_en: We used up all the flour baking cookies this morning.
items.ex_zh: 今天早上烤饼干把我们所有的面粉都用光了。

items.def_zh: 消耗，耗费；吃，喝；（情感）吞噬，困扰
items.def_en: 1. to use up resources, fuel, or time 2. (formal) to eat or drink something 3. (of a strong feeling) to take up all the attention and energy of someone
items.ex_en: Modern data servers consume massive amounts of electrical power to operate continuously.
items.ex_zh: 现代数据服务器为了保持持续运转，需要消耗海量的电能。

items.def_en: To cause a pool of funds, vitality, or energy to flow away steadily until exhausted
items.ex_en: The prolonged legal battle threatened to drain all their hard-earned retirement savings.
items.ex_zh: 旷日持久的官司恐将耗干他们辛勤攒下的全部退休积蓄。
items.ex2_en: Vital public funds drain rapidly whenever regional crises occur without adequate administrative oversight.
items.ex2_zh: 每当发生区域性危机且缺乏充分的行政监管时，关键公共资金就会迅速耗尽。

items.def_en: To severely reduce the supply, proportion, or natural stocks of something valuable
items.ex_en: Severe overgrazing continues to deplete valuable natural nutrients from the fragile soil.
items.ex_zh: 严重的过度放牧继续使脆弱土壤中宝贵的天然养分急剧枯竭。

items.def_en: To completely use up a resource, reserve, or energy supply until nothing is left
items.ex_en: Intense desert heat will quickly exhaust an unprepared hiker's entire water supply.
items.ex_zh: 沙漠中酷烈的热浪很快就会耗尽毫无准备的徒步者所有的饮水储备。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the graded reduction and ultimate running out of finite materials, fuel, funds, physical energy, or natural resources through ongoing use or expenditure.
groups.summary_zh: 指资源、燃料、精力或积蓄因持续使用而逐渐削减直至枯竭耗尽。
groups.desc_en: Denotes utilizing energy, raw material, or vital force to the point of severe depletion or annihilation, contrasting with gentle usage by emphasizing irreversible absorption or terminal exhaustion.
groups.desc_zh: 指消耗资源、体能或元气直至枯竭殆尽，区别于正常的‘使用’，强调不可逆的吞噬吸收与逼近极限的耗空。
groups.nuance_en: consume: ingest, destroy by fire, or absorb vast supplies of energy/goods (fuel / calories / time) · deplete: steadily hollow out a stock until dangerously low (reserves / ozone / inventory) · exhaust: drain completely of strength, patience, or options (patience / resources / possibilities) · drain: draw off vitality, funds, or liquid continuously and relentlessly (treasury / energy / swamp) · use up: finish off the remainder of a finite supply completely (batteries / patience / materials)
groups.nuance_zh: consume: 吞食、焚毁或巨量吸收占用能源与注意力 (fuel / calories / time) · deplete: 使库存或自然储量持续被掏空至警戒线 (reserves / ozone / inventory) · exhaust: 彻底耗尽最后一丝体力、资源或可能性 (patience / resources / possibilities) · drain: 如放水般无休止地汲干元气、资金或精力 (treasury / energy / swamp) · use up: 将手头的有限余量消耗得干干净净 (batteries / patience / materials)

groups.name: Consummate & Crown · 圆满完成与圆房 (Consummate, Crown, Finalize)
groups.tip: 既指事业大功告成，又特指婚姻圆房

items.def_en: To complete or reward something successfully with a final triumphant touch or achievement
items.ex_en: A prestigious international award came to crown her glorious thirty-year scientific career.
items.ex_zh: 一项声名显赫的国际大奖为她三十年光辉的科研生涯加冕圆满。

items.def_en: To make an agreement, bargain, or relationship definitive, official, and complete
items.ex_en: A firm handshake between the two leaders helped seal the bilateral trade pact.
items.ex_zh: 两位领导人坚定的握手帮助最终敲定了这项双边贸易协定。

items.def_zh: 实现；达到预定完满状态
items.def_en: To achieve a promise, hope, or complete developmental destiny
items.ex_en: Graduating with top academic honors fulfilled her lifelong ambition of becoming an astronomer.
items.ex_zh: 以最高学术荣誉毕业实现了她成为一名天文学家的毕生抱负。

items.def_en: To succeed in obtaining, achieving, or decisively settling an agreement or deal
items.ex_en: Her masterly closing argument served to clinch the high-profile courtroom victory.
items.ex_zh: 她精湛的结案陈词最终锁定了这场备受瞩目的法庭胜利。

items.def_zh: 最终确定；完成最后手续
items.def_en: To finish the last details of a plan, legal contract, or business arrangement
items.ex_en: Legal counsels will meet tomorrow morning to finalize the multi-million-dollar acquisition contract.
items.ex_zh: 法律顾问将于明早会面，以最终确定这项数百万美元的收购合同。

items.def_zh: （同房）圆房，使（婚姻）完满；完成，圆满达成（交易等）
items.def_en: 1. To make a marriage or relationship legally complete by having sexual intercourse. 2. (formal) To bring a deal, arrangement, or plan to a successful conclusion.
items.ex_en: The ambitious tech startup finally consummated the landmark merger with its rival.
items.ex_zh: 这家雄心勃勃的科技初创企业终于圆满达成了与竞争对手的历史性合并。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses bringing an ongoing project, treaty, relationship, or marriage to ultimate, culminating perfection and legal or emotional fulfillment. In marital settings it explicitly denotes initial sexual union; in broader usage it marks the definitive crowning achievement.
groups.summary_zh: 指使事业、协议达到圆满极点，或经由圆房使婚姻生效。
groups.desc_en: Denotes bringing an enterprise, covenant, or union to its definitive, crowning peak of legal or experiential reality, contrasting with routine finishing by highlighting the ultimate sealing ritual or triumphant realization.
groups.desc_zh: 指将契约、联姻或重大事业推向具有终极法律效力或登峰造极的顶点，区别于一般工序的‘完成’，强调终极盖棺定论的仪式性与完满感。
groups.nuance_en: consummate: make complete or officially legally real, particularly a marriage via intercourse, or a major deal (marriage / deal / ambition) · crown: bestow supreme honor or serve as the culminating glory (career / triumph / queen) · clinch: decisively secure and lock down a disputed deal or victory (deal / title / victory) · seal: formally, permanently certify and guarantee an agreement (pact / fate / agreement) · finalize: settle the conclusive details of an operative plan (contract / arrangements / terms)
groups.nuance_zh: consummate: 走向最高圆满境界；特指通过同房圆房完成婚约，或达成世纪交易 (marriage / deal / ambition) · crown: 为其加冕，或作为辉煌生涯的登峰造极之作 (career / triumph / queen) · clinch: 凭借决定性一击锁定交易、冠军或胜利 (deal / title / victory) · seal: 盖印确立契约，或铁板钉钉地决定命运 (pact / fate / agreement) · finalize: 敲定所有末节细节使其正式生效 (contract / arrangements / terms)

groups.name: Contaminate & Taint · 污染与玷污 (Taint, Besmirch, Befoul)
groups.tip: 混入杂质，破坏纯洁与原本品质

items.def_en: 1. To spoil or affect something with a bad, corrupt, or poisonous quality; to damage someone's reputation.
items.ex_en: Widespread bribery scandals threaten to taint the prestigious university's global standing.
items.ex_zh: 蔓延的受贿丑闻恐将玷污这所名牌大学的全球声誉。

items.def_en: To make someone's good reputation, achievement, or character lose its brilliance or respect
items.ex_en: Repeated ethical violations serve only to tarnish his remarkable legacy as governor.
items.ex_zh: 屡屡发生的道德违规行为只会败坏他作为州长的卓越声望。
items.ex2_en: A politician's hard-earned reputation can tarnish quickly following unexpected public ethical scandals.
items.ex2_zh: 政客辛苦建立的声誉在发生意想不到的公共伦理丑闻后会迅速受损。

items.def_en: To damage the purity, beauty, or unimpeachable integrity of something precious
items.ex_en: Corrupt politicians should never sully the sacred honor of this democratic institution.
items.ex_zh: 腐败政客绝不应玷污这个民主机构的神圣荣誉。

items.def_en: To cause harm to the good reputation, honor, or spotless image of someone or something
items.ex_en: Malicious rumors sought to besmirch the magistrate's spotless honor throughout the commonwealth.
items.ex_zh: 恶毒的谣言企图玷污地方法官在全联邦的清白声誉。

items.def_en: To make foul, filthy, or morally repulsive through direct physical dirt or gross misconduct
items.ex_en: Noxious chemicals began to befoul the pristine mountain spring with dark oily sludge.
items.ex_zh: 有毒化学品开始以黑色油污弄脏了原本纯净的山泉。

items.def_en: To spoil something sacred, holy, or pure with foulness, corruption, or utter disrespect
items.ex_en: The ruthless invaders dared to defile the ancient sanctuary with their muddy boots.
items.ex_zh: 残暴的入侵者竟敢穿着沾满泥巴的靴子亵渎这处古老的圣所。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on inflicting a lasting, damaging defect, infection, or moral stain on someone's reputation, food supplies, character, or innocence, turning what was once pure or credible into something corrupted.
groups.summary_zh: 指对名誉、品质或洁净事物造成不可逆的毒害、玷污与腐蚀。
groups.desc_en: Denotes corrupting the purity, physical cleanliness, or moral honor of something pristine, contrasting with ordinary damage by emphasizing chemical, biological, or spiritual defilement.
groups.desc_zh: 指玷污、损害原本纯洁之物的物理清洁或道德名节，区别于单纯的‘损坏’，强调生物、化学层面的毒害或精神名誉层面的污名化。
groups.nuance_en: taint: spoil trace purity with poison, corruption, or moral fault (reputation / blood / evidence) · tarnish: dull the luster of metal, or degrade public prestige through scandal (image / reputation / medal) · sully: soil virgin cleanliness or stain clean moral standing (name / honour / hands) · besmirch: sling mud at someone's honor or pedigree maliciously (reputation / character / legacy) · defile: desecrate something sacred, clean, or pure with profanity or filth (sanctuary / temple / virginity)
groups.nuance_zh: taint: 注入毒素腐化，或使纯洁记录带上抹不掉的污点 (reputation / blood / evidence) · tarnish: 使贵金属失去光泽，或因丑闻使名望蒙羞受损 (image / reputation / medal) · sully: 弄脏原本不染纤尘的名声、贞洁或双手 (name / honour / hands) · besmirch: 恶意泼脏水玷污他人品格或历史功绩 (reputation / character / legacy) · defile: 亵渎圣殿、糟蹋纯洁肉体或神圣戒律 (sanctuary / temple / virginity)

groups.name: Contract & Bind · 契约与法律约束 (Contract, Article, Indenture, Bind)
groups.tip: 通过条文契约约束

items.def_zh: 以契约约束（学徒或实习生）
items.def_en: (formal) To bind someone by a contract, especially as an apprentice or trainee.
items.ex_en: The firm agreed to article the promising graduate to a senior barrister.
items.ex_zh: 该事务所同意以学徒契约将这位前途光明的毕业生签给一位资深出庭律师。

items.def_zh: 订立合同，缔结契约；（使）收缩，缩短；感染（疾病）
items.def_en: 1. To make a formal or legal agreement with someone. 2. To become smaller or narrower, or make something do this. 3. To catch or develop a serious disease.
items.ex_en: The municipal authority will contract with private firms to build the bridge.
items.ex_zh: 市政当局将与私营企业签订合同来修建这座桥梁。
items.ex2_en: Cooling temperatures quickly contract the heated metal rails along the busy commuter line.
items.ex2_zh: 降低的气温迅速使繁忙通勤线路上的受热金属轨道发生收缩。

items.def_en: (+ to/by) to legally or morally oblige someone to adhere to a duty, agreement, or term
items.ex_en: The terms of this non-disclosure agreement strictly bind all participating parties.
items.ex_zh: 本保密协议的条款对所有参与方均具有严格的法律约束力。

items.def_zh: 令（某人）具结保证，依法约束
items.def_en: (+ sb) to place someone under legal or judicial obligation to perform an action or keep the peace
items.ex_en: The magistrate bound him over to keep the peace for twelve months.
items.ex_zh: 治安法官责令他遵守治安一年以保释。

items.def_zh: 签约雇用；签约承担义务
items.def_en: (+ sb) to bind someone or oneself by contract to a specific period of service or duty
items.ex_en: The agency managed to sign up the skilled programmer for three years.
items.ex_zh: 该中介机构成功签约录用了这名技术熟练的程序员，合同期三年。
items.ex2_en: Thousands of eager college students sign up for advanced technical courses every semester.
items.ex2_zh: 每学期都有数千名热切的大学生报名参加高级技术课程。

items.def_zh: 签学徒契约，以契约束缚
items.def_en: (+ to) to bind someone by a formal legal agreement to work for another for a fixed period
items.ex_en: The poor boy was indentured to an abusive blacksmith for seven years.
items.ex_zh: 那个可怜的男孩被迫立约给一个虐待人的铁匠当了七年学徒。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this legal frame depict entering into, drafting, or imposing legally binding covenant obligations (often governing service, partnership, or trade) between parties.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过订立具有法律效力的合同或学徒契约，使双方受到义务约束。
groups.desc_en: Denotes legally obligating or subordinating an individual via formal articles, indentures, or service covenants, contrasting with voluntary agreement by highlighting unyielding legal liability and servile commitment.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过严苛的契据、学徒合同或法律担保将某人与特定劳务或法定义务死死绑定，区别于普通自愿协作，强调法律约束与人身依附性。
groups.nuance_en: contract: enter into a legally enforceable agreement to perform work or supply goods (debt / marriage / services) · bind: hold someone under unshakeable legal, moral, or contractual obligation (contract / promise / agreement) · indenture: bind an apprentice or laborer by formal sealed deed to a master (apprentice / servant / laborer) · article: formally bind a trainee or clerk under articles of apprenticeship (clerk / apprentice / pupil) · bind over: legally order a defendant under recognizance to keep peace or appear in court (defendant / over to keep the peace / suspect)
groups.nuance_zh: contract: 签订具备强制执行力的正式法律合同或缔结盟约 (debt / marriage / services) · bind: 在法律、契约或道德上施加无法脱身的约束 (contract / promise / agreement) · indenture: 依据古代苛刻契约将契约工或学徒终身/长期抵押给师傅 (apprentice / servant / laborer) · article: 依学徒契约将文书、学徒送入事务所接受绑定培养 (clerk / apprentice / pupil) · bind over: 法院裁定责令缴纳保释金保证守法或应诉 (defendant / over to keep the peace / suspect)

groups.name: Contradict & Gainsay · 反驳与自相矛盾 (Deny, Gainsay, Invalidate)
groups.tip: 针锋相对地质疑与反驳论点

items.def_en: To state that an allegation, rumor, or statement is simply not true.
items.ex_en: The minister attempted to deny all allegations of financial impropriety yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 部长昨天试图否认所有关于财务不当行为的指控。

items.def_en: To question the validity or truth of a claim, fact, or conclusion.
items.ex_en: Independent researchers dispute the dubious statistical conclusions presented by the ministry.
items.ex_zh: 独立研究人员对部委提出的可疑统计结论提出了异议。

items.def_en: To disagree strongly with a particular point and choose to argue against it.
items.ex_en: The chief economist must take issue with the unrealistic revenue forecast.
items.ex_zh: 首席经济学家必须对这一不切实际的税收预测提出强烈异议。

items.def_zh: 反驳，驳斥；与……相抵触，与……矛盾
items.def_en: 1. To say that a statement or person is wrong by stating the opposite. 2. If two facts, reports, or claims contradict each other, they are so different that both cannot be true.
items.ex_en: These new forensic findings directly contradict the suspect's original alibi.
items.ex_zh: 这些新的法医鉴定结果与嫌疑人最初的不在场证明直接相抵触。

items.def_en: To give an impression of something that does not match reality, or contradict it.
items.ex_en: His gentle and courteous demeanor seemed to belie his inner ruthlessness.
items.ex_zh: 他温柔有礼的举止似乎掩盖并与其内心的冷酷无情相矛盾。

items.def_en: To deny, dispute, or speak against a statement (usually in negative constructions).
items.ex_en: No honest citizen could gainsay the extraordinary valor displayed by the guards.
items.ex_zh: 任何诚实的公民都无法否认警卫们所表现出的非凡英勇。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on stating the polar opposite of a proposition, pointing out internal inconsistency, or flatly denying the truth of what was just asserted.
groups.summary_zh: 直言否定前述断言、指出两相冲突或断然否认某事实的存在。
groups.desc_en: Denoting an explicit stance of logical incompatibility or factual refutation against an assertion, contrasting with mere disagreement by actively asserting the falsity, opposite, or invalidity of a proposition.
groups.desc_zh: 表示对某一论断提出逻辑上的不相容性或事实反驳，与普通意见不合不同，它强调主动断定某命题为假、相反或无效。
groups.nuance_en: deny: declare an allegation untrue or refuse existence (allegations / charges / reality) · dispute: question the validity or fairness of a claim (results / findings / ownership) · contradict: state the direct opposite or be logically incompatible with (testimony / evidence / statements) · belie: give a false impression that conflicts with reality (expectations / appearance / fears) · gainsay: formally or obstinately deny a plain truth (facts / verdict / authority)
groups.nuance_zh: deny: 否认指控属实或断然拒绝存在 (allegations / charges / reality) · dispute: 质疑某项主张的有效性或公正性 (results / findings / ownership) · contradict: 陈述相反事实或在逻辑上前后矛盾 (testimony / evidence / statements) · belie: 表象与实际情况相悖掩盖真相 (expectations / appearance / fears) · gainsay: 形式化或固执地否认既定事实 (facts / verdict / authority)

groups.name: Convene & Select Jurors · 遴选与召集 (Em風nel/Empanel, Swear In, Subpoena)
groups.tip: 依法选定并登记陪审团成员

items.def_zh: （法庭上）对（陪审员人选）提出异议
items.def_en: (law) To formally object to the inclusion of a prospective juror during selection
items.ex_en: The defense attorney moved to challenge two prospective jurors for clear bias.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师以存在明显偏见为由，提议对两名候选陪审员提出异议。

items.def_zh: 编入陪审团名单；选定陪审团
items.def_en: To select and list candidates to serve on a jury for a specific trial
items.ex_en: The circuit court clerk will empanel a fresh jury tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 巡回法院书记官将于明早为本案遴选并确定一组新的陪审团。

items.def_zh: 使宣誓就职（或入列陪审）
items.def_en: To administer an official oath to someone before they assume duties as a juror or public official
items.ex_en: The new president will be sworn in on January 20th.
items.ex_zh: 新总统将于1月20日宣誓就职。

items.def_en: To officially order a citizen to appear in court for jury service or legal examination
items.ex_en: The local sheriff was ordered to summon fifty citizens for jury service.
items.ex_zh: 当地治安官接到命令，传唤五十名公民到庭履行陪审义务。

items.def_zh: 召集（专门小组或陪审团）
items.def_en: To call people together formally for an official inquest, panel, or legal session
items.ex_en: The county coroner decided to convene a special panel to examine evidence.
items.ex_zh: 县法医决定召集一个专门委员会来审查相关证据。
items.ex2_en: The newly elected national parliament will convene tomorrow morning to debate urgent bills.
items.ex2_zh: 新当选的国民议会将于明早召开会议，辩论紧急法案。

items.def_zh: 选定（陪审团成员），将……列入陪审员名单
items.def_en: (law) To select and swear in a group of citizens to serve as a jury in a trial.
items.ex_en: Officials took two days to impanel twelve unbiased citizens for the trial.
items.ex_zh: 官员们花了整整两天时间才为审判选定并宣誓了十二名公正的陪审员。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses the formal legal procedures for conscripting, screening, selecting, and swearing in citizens to constitute a jury, panel, or investigative body.
groups.summary_zh: 法庭依法筛选、召集并宣誓组建陪审团或专门小组。
groups.desc_en: Actions within the formal judicial procedure of assembling, vetting, and officially inaugurating a jury, differing from general judicial summoning by its focus on assembling a representative civic tribunal.
groups.desc_zh: 指在正式司法程序中召集、审查并宣誓确立陪审团的法定流程，与普通司法传唤相比，专指组建具有公信力的公民审判团。
groups.nuance_en: summon: formally order citizens to appear for duty (jurors / witnesses / panel) · convene: call together an official body or assembly (jury / grand jury / court) · empanel: select and list individuals to serve on a specific jury (jury / panel / members) · challenge: formally object to a prospective juror's inclusion (juror / bias / array) · swear in: administer the official oath before hearing evidence (jury / panel / witnesses)
groups.nuance_zh: summon: 发出法定传票要求到庭应征 (jurors / witnesses / panel) · convene: 召集法定团体或开庭 (jury / grand jury / court) · empanel: 筛选并正式录入陪审员名单 (jury / panel / members) · challenge: 正式对潜在陪审员资格提出回避异议 (juror / bias / array) · swear in: 主持就职宣誓使其获得法定权力 (jury / panel / witnesses)

groups.name: Cope & Manage · 应对与周旋 (Grapple, Tackle, Contend)
groups.tip: 调动认知资源化解难题

items.def_zh: 勉强对付过去，勉强维生
items.def_en: Have just enough money, resources, or ability to survive or manage difficult conditions
items.ex_en: He worked two part-time night jobs just to get by each month.
items.ex_zh: 他打了两份夜班兼职，仅仅是为了每个月勉强糊口。

items.def_en: (+ with) To deal successfully with a difficult situation or problem.
items.ex_en: The hospital staff could barely cope with the sudden influx of patients.
items.ex_zh: 医院的工作人员几乎无法应付突然涌入的大批病患。

items.def_zh: 搏斗应付，应付吃紧的难题
items.def_en: (+ with) Have to deal with a persistent problem, hardship, or disadvantage
items.ex_en: Small business owners must constantly contend with soaring inflation and regulatory burdens.
items.ex_zh: 小企业主必须不断应对不断攀升的通货膨胀和监管负担。

items.def_en: Come through a dangerous crisis or severe difficulty safely without being broken by it
items.ex_en: The fragile shipping enterprise managed to weather the fierce global economic storm.
items.ex_zh: 这家脆弱的航运企业设法平安度过了猛烈的全球经济风暴。

items.def_zh: 果断着手处理，对付解决
items.def_en: Make a determined, energetic effort to deal with and solve a difficult issue or task
items.ex_en: The city council plans to tackle urban congestion with new transit lines.
items.ex_zh: 市议会计划通过新建公交线路来果断解决城市拥堵问题。

items.def_zh: 扭结抗争，竭力设法应对
items.def_en: (+ with) Try very hard to understand, deal with, or find solutions for a difficult problem
items.ex_en: Senior administrators must grapple with massive budget deficits over the coming year.
items.ex_zh: 高级管理层在未来一年里必须竭力应对巨额的预算赤字。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the cognitive, emotional, and practical efforts expended to confront, handle, and overcome adversity, stress, or demanding tasks, varying from just barely surviving hardships to taking proactive problem-solving action.
groups.summary_zh: 表达直面困难、重负或挑战时，努力周旋、应对并设法处置。
groups.desc_en: Engaging with adversity, stress, or demanding tasks to maintain equilibrium or achieve resolution, moving beyond passive enduring into active psychological or practical management.
groups.desc_zh: 与困境、压力或艰巨任务周旋以维持平衡或求得解决，超越了消极忍耐，强调主动的心理调适或实际处置。
groups.nuance_en: get by: manage to survive or function with minimal resources (salary / minimal sleep / meager savings) · cope: handle stress and emotional demands without collapsing (stress / loss / demands) · contend: struggle with external difficulties or hostile forces (challenges / problems / elements) · weather: endure a crisis successfully until it passes (storm / crisis / recession) · tackle: confront and deal aggressively with a difficult problem (crisis / deficit / crime) · grapple: struggle intimately and intensely with a complex dilemma (issues / conscience / complexities)
groups.nuance_zh: get by: 依靠最低资源勉强度日或维持运转 (salary / minimal sleep / meager savings) · cope: 承受并妥善应付压力或悲伤 (stress / loss / demands) · contend: 与外界困境或不利力量周旋抗衡 (challenges / problems / elements) · weather: 挺过危机直至雨过天晴 (storm / crisis / recession) · tackle: 迎头痛击并着手攻克棘手难题 (crisis / deficit / crime) · grapple: 深入缠斗、苦苦思索复杂症结 (issues / conscience / complexities)

groups.name: Corrode & Erode · 侵蚀与腐蚀 (Corrode, Erode, Wear Away)
groups.tip: 化学或风雨缓慢蚕食

items.def_en: Cause something to become gradually thinner, smoother, or weaker through friction or continuous contact
items.ex_en: Continuous water friction will eventually wear away even the hardest granite rocks.
items.ex_zh: 水流的持续摩擦最终甚至会将最坚硬的花岗岩磨损殆尽。
items.ex2_en: Soft limestone steps wear away steadily under the heavy footsteps of thousands of daily tourists.
items.ex2_zh: 每天成千上万游客沉重的脚步使松软的石灰岩台阶逐渐磨损。

items.def_en: Damage or destroy a substance gradually by chemical action, rust, or steady destruction
items.ex_en: Acidic industrial fumes gradually eat into the historic marble facade of the cathedral.
items.ex_zh: 酸性工业废气逐渐侵蚀着大教堂古老的大理石外立面。

items.def_en: Create small hollow marks or small depressions on a metal or stone surface through corrosive action
items.ex_en: Salty ocean spray will inevitably pit the smooth metallic finish of boats.
items.ex_zh: 咸涩的海洋飞沫不可避免地会使船只光滑的金属表面蚀出麻点。

items.def_en: Become oxidized and coated with iron oxide when exposed to moisture and air
items.ex_en: Discarded iron tools will rust quickly when exposed to humid rainy weather.
items.ex_zh: 被遗弃的铁制工具暴露在潮湿多雨的天气中会迅速生锈。
items.ex2_en: Constant coastal humidity and salty breezes will rust these exposed steel support cables.
items.ex2_zh: 沿海持续的湿气和含盐海风会腐蚀这些裸露的钢质支撑缆索。

items.def_en: Gradually wear away soil, rock, or other materials through wind, water, or friction
items.ex_en: Violent ocean storms rapidly erode the fragile cliffs along the eastern coastline.
items.ex_zh: 狂暴的海风暴迅速侵蚀着东部海岸线脆弱的悬崖。
items.ex2_en: The sandy riverbanks erode rapidly every spring under powerful surges of melting snow.
items.ex2_zh: 每年春天，在融雪形成的强劲洪流冲击下，沙质河岸迅速受到侵蚀。

items.def_en: 1. to slowly destroy or damage a material by chemical action, rust, or acid; to be destroyed in this way. 2. to gradually weaken or undermine something.
items.ex_en: Harsh chemical runoff will rapidly corrode the underground steel support pipes.
items.ex_zh: 强烈的化学废水将迅速腐蚀地下的钢制支撑管道。
items.ex2_en: Exposed iron pipes corrode quickly when acidic rainwater leaks into the old basement.
items.ex2_zh: 当酸性雨水渗入老地下室时，裸露的铁管会迅速发生腐蚀。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the gradual physical or chemical wearing down, decay, and disintegration of surfaces or structural materials over time.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过风化、摩擦或化学作用使物质表面与结构发生渐进式的剥落销蚀。
groups.desc_en: The gradual destruction, wearing down, or eating away of solid material by physical friction or chemical action, contrasting with sudden fracturing or breaking by its cumulative, slow progression.
groups.desc_zh: 固体物质通过物理摩擦或化学作用而缓慢剥蚀、损耗，与突发性的断裂不同，强调累积性的渐进损耗过程。
groups.nuance_en: wear away: diminish surfaces through friction or time (steps / tread / resistance) · eat into: progressively penetrate and consume a substance or resource (metal / margins / savings) · pit: form tiny depressions or indentations across a surface (metal / stone / face) · erode: wear down landscapes or abstract values through fluid action or attrition (soil / coastline / confidence) · corrode: chemically destroy metals or slowly undermine integrity (pipes / metal / fabric)
groups.nuance_zh: wear away: 因机械摩擦或经年累月而磨损 (steps / tread / resistance) · eat into: 逐步侵入并蚕食固体或资源 (metal / margins / savings) · pit: 使表面形成密密麻麻的小凹坑 (metal / stone / face) · erode: 通过水流冲刷或渐进消耗而侵蚀 (soil / coastline / confidence) · corrode: 经化学反应腐蚀金属或破坏抽象结构 (pipes / metal / fabric)

groups.name: Corrode & Tarnish · 氧化腐蚀与生锈 (Rust, Oxidize, Corrode)
groups.tip: 化学侵蚀或氧化生锈

items.def_en: to cause hollow marks or tiny corrosive cavities to form on a surface
items.ex_en: Concentrated acidic secretions will pit the polished bronze finish over several months.
items.ex_zh: 高浓度的酸性分泌物会在数月内使抛光的青铜表面凹陷斑驳。

items.def_en: (+ at) to gradually destroy or consume a surface or substance by chemical or mechanical action
items.ex_en: Persistent alkaline water leaks eat away at the subterranean foundation walls.
items.ex_zh: 持续的碱性水渗漏不断侵蚀啃噬着地下地基墙体。

items.def_en: 1. to become coated with rust through exposure to moisture and air, or cause metal to do this 2. to lose quality, skill, or vitality through lack of use or practice
items.ex_en: Unused mechanical joints will rust easily if stored in this damp basement.
items.ex_zh: 闲置的机械关节如果存放在这个潮湿的地下室里很容易生锈。
items.ex2_en: Damp salty air will quickly rust the heavy hinges of the garden gate.
items.ex2_zh: 潮湿带有盐分的空气会迅速使花园大门的厚重铰链生锈。

items.def_en: to lose or cause to lose lustre, especially through exposure to air or moisture
items.ex_en: Sulfur pollutants in urban air will tarnish silver ornaments within weeks.
items.ex_zh: 城市空气中的硫化物污染物会在几周内使银饰失去光泽。
items.ex2_en: Polished brass fixtures tarnish quickly when constantly exposed to humid tropical ocean air.
items.ex2_zh: 抛光的黄铜配件在经常接触潮湿的热带海洋空气时会迅速失去光泽。

items.def_en: to undergo a chemical reaction combining with oxygen, producing a crust, film, or rust
items.ex_en: Exposed copper rooftops oxidize slowly into an ethereal pale green patina over decades.
items.ex_zh: 裸露的铜制屋顶在数十年间缓缓氧化，形成一层空灵的浅绿色铜锈。
items.ex2_en: High concentrations of ozone can oxidize delicate electronic circuit boards inside unprotected industrial machines.
items.ex2_zh: 高浓度的臭氧会氧化无防护工业机器内部精密的电子电路板。

items.def_en: to slowly damage or destroy a metal or material through chemical or electrochemical action
items.ex_en: Salt deposits from deicing chemicals corrode metal vehicular undercarriages very quickly.
items.ex_zh: 除冰化学品残留的盐分会极其迅速地腐蚀车辆底盘的金属。
items.ex2_en: Underground bronze water pipes corrode steadily when buried in highly acidic swamp soils.
items.ex2_zh: 地下青铜水管埋在强酸性沼泽土壤中时会逐渐发生腐蚀。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses metals and material surfaces undergoing electrochemical breakdown, oxidization, tarnishing, or gradual destruction due to moisture, air, or acids.
groups.summary_zh: 指金属或材质表面因受空气、水分或化学试剂侵蚀而氧化、生锈或变暗。
groups.desc_en: Chemical oxidation and surface deterioration specifically targeting metals or reflective surfaces, differing from generic wear by its distinct chemical transmutation (discoloration, scaling, rust).
groups.desc_zh: 金属或光滑表面特有的化学氧化与劣化过程，与普通磨损不同，伴有明显的化学形态改变（变色、起皮、生锈）。
groups.nuance_en: oxidize: combine chemically with oxygen to change state (copper / surface / chemicals) · tarnish: lose luster or discolor through surface chemical reaction (silver / brass / reputation) · rust: form reddish-brown iron oxide through exposure to moisture (metal / iron / chains) · pit: create localized corrosive cavities in metal (aluminum / chrome / surface) · corrode: disintegrate comprehensively via chemical or electrochemical attack (acid / chassis / battery)
groups.nuance_zh: oxidize: 发生氧化反应改变表面性质 (copper / surface / chemicals) · tarnish: 发生表面氧化变暗失去光泽或沾污 (silver / brass / reputation) · rust: 铁质因接触水汽而产生红褐色锈迹 (metal / iron / chains) · pit: 在金属表面产生局域性点状腐蚀斑 (aluminum / chrome / surface) · corrode: 遭化学或电化学作用全面蚀损 (acid / chassis / battery)

groups.name: Cosign & Guarantee · 连带签署与担保 (Underwrite, Guarantee, Back)
groups.tip: 共同签名确认法律效力

items.def_en: To provide financial, moral, or institutional support to reinforce an undertaking
items.ex_en: Several prominent international venture capitalists chose to back the ambitious research project.
items.ex_zh: 几位著名的国际风险投资家选择出资支持这个雄心勃勃的研究项目。

items.def_en: To legally promise to pay another party's debt or honor their obligations if they default
items.ex_en: The wealthy benefactor offered to guarantee the entire bank loan for them.
items.ex_zh: 这位富有的捐助者提出为他们全额担保这笔银行贷款。

items.def_en: To pledge ongoing loyalty or guarantee the quality and promises made by an entity
items.ex_en: Our manufacturing company will always stand behind the products we sell globally.
items.ex_zh: 我们制造公司将始终为我们在全球销售的产品提供质量担保与后盾支持。

items.def_en: To accept financial responsibility for commercial risk or guarantee purchase of unsold shares
items.ex_en: Noble financiers agreed to underwrite the precarious enterprise against sudden financial ruin.
items.ex_zh: 贵族金融家们同意承保这家岌岌可危的企业，以抵御突如其来的经济破产。

items.def_en: (+ against) To promise legal protection or compensation against future damage, loss, or lawsuit
items.ex_en: The corporation promised to indemnify directors against personal liability from civil lawsuits.
items.ex_zh: 该公司承诺赔偿并保障董事免于因民事诉讼承担个人赔偿责任。

items.def_zh: 连带签署，共同担保（协议或贷款）
items.def_en: To sign a loan agreement or official document jointly with another party, accepting equal legal obligation.
items.ex_en: His wealthy uncle agreed to cosign the substantial mortgage agreement yesterday afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 他富有的叔叔昨天下午同意在这份数额巨大的按揭贷款协议上共同连带签字。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe entering into legal or financial compacts jointly or as a guarantor, formally assuming liability to repay a debt or execute a contract if another party defaults.
groups.summary_zh: 指在金融与法律合同中承担连带签署、背书担保或兜底清偿责任。
groups.desc_en: Assuming secondary or joint legal and financial responsibility for another party's obligation, contrasting with direct borrowing by acting as an external guarantor or safety net.
groups.desc_zh: 为另一方的债务或履约义务承担附带或连带的法律与财务责任，与直接借贷不同，扮演的是外部担保人或兜底角色。
groups.nuance_en: back: provide financial, political, or moral support (venture / candidate / proposal) · stand behind: vouch for the quality or integrity of a person or product (product / promise / claim) · guarantee: pledge formal assurance of performance, payment, or quality (loan / safety / results) · cosign: sign a document alongside the primary party to accept joint liability (loan / lease / mortgage) · underwrite: assume financial risk for an enterprise or security issue (risk / policy / IPO) · indemnify: secure against future legal liability or compensate for loss (loss / damages / officer)
groups.nuance_zh: back: 提供财务、声誉或政治后盾支撑 (venture / candidate / proposal) · stand behind: 以信誉力保产品品质或承诺兑现 (product / promise / claim) · guarantee: 对履约、付款或结果提供法律或事实保证 (loan / safety / results) · cosign: 共同签字承担连带偿还或法律责任 (loan / lease / mortgage) · underwrite: 承保金融风险或包销证券发行 (risk / policy / IPO) · indemnify: 赔偿损失或免除未来的法律追责 (loss / damages / officer)

groups.name: Counter & Push Back · 应对抗辩与回击 (Push Back, Riposte, Fight Back)
groups.tip: 针对对方观点针锋相对地回击

items.def_en: To reply to someone with an opposing argument, or to take action in order to oppose or defend against something.
items.ex_en: The spokesperson attempted to counter the critical allegations with newly released data.
items.ex_zh: 发言人试图用最新公布的数据来反驳那些批评性质的指控。

items.def_en: (+ against) To oppose, resist, or argue back against a plan or viewpoint.
items.ex_en: Local union leaders plan to push back against proposed wage cuts aggressively.
items.ex_zh: 当地工会领导人计划对拟议的降薪方案展开强烈的抵制与抗辩。

items.def_en: To make a quick and witty or damaging reply countering an attack or claim.
items.ex_en: The minister managed to riposte with a devastating remark during the debate.
items.ex_zh: 部长在辩论中设法用一句极具杀伤力的犀利言辞进行了迅即回击。

items.def_en: (+ against) To defend yourself energetically against criticism, demands, or an adversary.
items.ex_en: The embattled politician decided to fight back against the relentless media onslaught.
items.ex_zh: 这位四面楚歌的政客决定奋起反击媒体连篇累牍的猛烈攻势。

items.def_en: (+ at) To retaliate against critics or opponents through spoken or written attacks.
items.ex_en: The director chose to hit back at spiteful reviews in yesterday's broadcast.
items.ex_zh: 导演在昨天的广播节目中选择对那些恶意的负面影评进行回击。

items.def_en: To ward off a question or challenge by answering evasively or cleverly turning it aside.
items.ex_en: The diplomat managed to parry intrusive personal inquiries with an elusive smile.
items.ex_zh: 这位外交官报以一抹令人捉摸不透的微笑，巧妙地挡开了侵犯隐私的质问。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on tactical argumentation where a speaker parries an opponent's critique or move by delivering an immediate, offsetting counter-argument or defense.
groups.summary_zh: 在辩论或策略对抗中进行抗辩、化解攻势并组织反向制衡。
groups.desc_en: Delivering an immediate defensive or offensive response to an incoming attack, argument, or pressure, differing from initial aggression by being reactive and repelling.
groups.desc_zh: 针对正在遭受的攻击、论点或压力实施即时防守或反冲，与主动进攻不同，具有反制性与防御反击特征。
groups.nuance_en: parry: deflect or ward off an incoming blow or awkward question (thrust / question / attack) · counter: offer an opposing action, argument, or blow to neutralize an attack (argument / move / claim) · push back: resist or oppose a prevailing demand or policy (regulations / demands / mandates) · riposte: deliver a quick, witty, or sharp retaliatory retort (criticism / jab / remark) · fight back: resist physical or systemic encroachment forcefully (tears / invaders / infection)
groups.nuance_zh: parry: 巧妙化解或偏转迎面而来的打击或尖锐提问 (thrust / question / attack) · counter: 提出对立论据或招式予以针对性回击 (argument / move / claim) · push back: 对推行的政策、指令提出阻击反弹 (regulations / demands / mandates) · riposte: 机敏、尖锐地进行言语回敬反讥 (criticism / jab / remark) · fight back: 进行强力反抗以抵御侵犯或压制 (tears / invaders / infection)

groups.name: Creative Synthesis & Combination · 合成与结合 (Amalgamate, Fuse, Blend)
groups.tip: 化学或逻辑上的要素拼合

items.def_en: Make or assemble something by combining distinct parts, ingredients, or chemicals
items.ex_en: The apothecary will compound medicinal herbs to form an effective soothing ointment.
items.ex_zh: 药剂师将配制多种草药，以制成一种有效的舒缓药膏。

items.def_en: Assemble a coherent story, theory, or object by gathering separate fragments together
items.ex_en: Detectives worked tirelessly to piece together fragmented witness accounts into the truth.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们不知疲倦地工作，将零散的目击者叙述拼凑还原为真相。

items.def_en: Mix different substances or qualities together smoothly and harmoniously
items.ex_en: The talented composer likes to blend traditional folk melodies with modern synthesizers.
items.ex_zh: 这位才华横溢的作曲家喜欢将传统民间旋律与现代合成器声音交融在一起。
items.ex2_en: The warm spices and coconut cream blend perfectly into a rich, fragrant stew.
items.ex2_zh: 温热的香料与椰浆完美地融合在一起，化作浓郁芳香的炖菜。

items.def_en: Join or blend diverse things together inextricably, often by melting or intense union
items.ex_en: Extreme heat will fuse the distinct metallic layers into a single shield.
items.ex_zh: 极高的温度会将不同金属层牢固地熔合成为一体护盾。
items.ex2_en: The fractured pelvic bones will fuse completely after several months of strict bedrest.
items.ex2_zh: 骨折的骨盆骨在经过数月的严格卧床休息后将会完全愈合连接。

items.def_zh: （通过化学或生物过程）合成；综合，融合（思想、观点等）
items.def_en: 1. To produce a substance by chemical or biological combination. 2. To combine different ideas, facts, or styles to form a single integrated whole.
items.ex_en: The author managed to synthesize disparate philosophical concepts into one coherent thesis.
items.ex_zh: 作者成功地将不同的哲学概念综合为一个逻辑连贯的论题。

items.def_en: Combine multiple elements, organizations, or materials into a unified single whole
items.ex_en: The board decided to amalgamate three regional subsidiaries into one centralized enterprise.
items.ex_zh: 董事会决定将三家地区子公司联合合并为一家集约化企业。
items.ex2_en: The two competing financial institutions will amalgamate early next year to reduce costs.
items.ex2_zh: 这两家相互竞争的金融机构将于明年初合并，以降低运营成本。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on systematically bringing disparate substances, elements, or concepts together through a process of synthesis to yield a distinct new composite entity.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重将异质元素、成分或理论系统结合或化合，产出全新统一体。
groups.desc_en: Uniting disparate elements, ideas, or materials into an integrated and novel whole, contrasting with simple aggregation by producing emergent synergy or a unified entity.
groups.desc_zh: 将离散的元素、理念或材料熔铸成一个崭新的有机整体，与简单的物理堆叠不同，强调融合成一体产生协同效应。
groups.nuance_en: blend: merge components smoothly so individual identities soften (flavors / styles / colors) · fuse: melt or bond parts irrevocably into a seamless whole (ideas / genres / metals) · synthesize: integrate diverse data or concepts into a coherent theoretical framework (findings / data / ideas) · amalgamate: combine organizations, cultures, or assets into a single body (companies / cultures / traditions) · piece together: reconstruct a coherent whole out of scattered fragments (puzzle / story / evidence)
groups.nuance_zh: blend: 将不同要素柔和调和以淡化界限 (flavors / styles / colors) · fuse: 熔铸黏合使各部分浑然一体无法拆分 (ideas / genres / metals) · synthesize: 将不同数据或理论综合归纳为新体系 (findings / data / ideas) · amalgamate: 将实体、文化或机构合并为一个大联合体 (companies / cultures / traditions) · piece together: 搜集零散拼图或线索拼凑出全貌 (puzzle / story / evidence)

groups.name: Criticize & Condemn · 谴责与声讨 (Condemn, Denounce, Castigate)
groups.tip: 从批评升级为严厉谴责

items.def_zh: 谴责，痛斥；判刑，判处；宣告（建筑物）为危房
items.def_en: 1. To express very strong disapproval of someone or something, usually in public. 2. To sentence someone to a severe punishment. 3. To officially declare a building unfit for use.
items.ex_en: World leaders gathered to condemn the unprovoked missile strikes on innocent towns.
items.ex_zh: 多国领导人齐聚一堂，对针对无辜城镇的无端导弹袭击表示强烈谴责。

items.def_en: (+ as) To declare publicly that someone or something is wicked, evil, or utterly wrong
items.ex_en: The bishop rose to denounce the corrupt governor as an unprincipled tyrant.
items.ex_zh: 主教站起身来，公开痛斥这位腐败的州长是个毫无原则的暴君。

items.def_en: To strongly and openly express condemnation of something considered unfair, harmful, or shameful
items.ex_en: Civil rights activists loudly decry the unfair restrictions placed on peaceful assembly.
items.ex_zh: 民权活动家们公开强烈谴责对和平集会施加的不公正限制。

items.def_en: To express severe, formal official disapproval of someone's misconduct or failing
items.ex_en: The ethics committee voted overwhelmingly to censure the senator for gross misconduct.
items.ex_zh: 道德委员会以压倒性多数投票决定对该参议员的严重不当行为予以正式申诫。

items.def_en: To criticize a person, performance, or policy harshly, vigorously, and mercilessly
items.ex_en: Furious editorial writers proceeded to lambaste the mayor's disastrous fiscal incompetence.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的社论撰稿人随即对市长极其灾难性的财政无能展开了严厉痛斥。

items.def_en: (+ for) To reprimand and criticize someone extremely severely, often in a blistering public fashion
items.ex_en: The commander did castigate the soldiers for their inexcusable failure of discipline.
items.ex_zh: 指挥官因士兵们不可饶恕的违纪行为对他们进行了极其严厉的痛责。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame articulate deep moral indignation, official censure, or severe castigation of wrongful, criminal, or heinous actions.
groups.summary_zh: 指因道德或法规严重逾矩而予以严厉抨击与公开定罪。
groups.desc_en: Formally or forcefully expressing harsh moral, ethical, or authoritative disapproval, moving beyond mild fault-finding into authoritative rejection or aggressive excoriation.
groups.desc_zh: 在道德、伦理或权威层面对某人某事进行严厉而正式的斥责，超越了普通挑刺，上升到公开否定或痛加谴责。
groups.nuance_en: decry: publicly and strongly depreciate or express sorrowful disapproval (violence / injustice / decline) · condemn: pronounce complete judicial or moral damnation upon (attacks / violence / regime) · denounce: publicly proclaim something as evil, traitorous, or unlawful (corruption / treaties / hypocrisy) · censure: deliver a formal, authoritative reprimand (conduct / minister / member) · castigate: punish severely with harsh verbal rebuke (hypocrisy / officials / neglect) · lambaste: attack violently and mercilessly in speech or writing (critics / policy / performance)
groups.nuance_zh: decry: 公开痛陈弊害并表示强烈惋惜或谴责 (violence / injustice / decline) · condemn: 在道德或司法上予以彻底定罪与唾弃 (attacks / violence / regime) · denounce: 公开揭发并斥责某事为罪恶、非法或背叛 (corruption / treaties / hypocrisy) · censure: 权威机构作出正式的官方谴责与处分 (conduct / minister / member) · castigate: 进行严厉无情的口诛笔伐或惩戒 (hypocrisy / officials / neglect) · lambaste: 在言辞或文章中给予痛斥体无完肤的猛烈抨击 (critics / policy / performance)

groups.name: Crouch & Squat · 蹲伏与蜷缩 (Squat, Cower, Cuddle)
groups.tip: 缩成一团蹲伏避寒避险

items.def_en: To draw one's arms and legs tightly close to the torso in a protective posture
items.ex_en: Frightened by thunder, the small puppy began to curl up under blankets.
items.ex_zh: 小狗被雷声吓坏了，开始蜷缩在毯子下面。

items.def_en: To bend one's knees fully so the buttocks rest near or on the heels
items.ex_en: Tired gardeners often squat near garden beds to prune delicate young saplings.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的花匠们经常蹲坐在花坛旁修剪娇嫩的幼苗。

items.def_en: To settle into a low crouching shelter or brace oneself to endure a difficult period
items.ex_en: Residents were urged to hunker down until the severe blizzard blew over.
items.ex_zh: 居民们被敦促躲进室内潜心坚守，直到猛烈的暴风雪平息过去。

items.def_en: To lower the body stance by bending knees and spine, often to hide or prepare to leap
items.ex_en: The cautious hunters crouch quietly behind bushes awaiting the approaching wild boar.
items.ex_zh: 谨慎的猎人们静静地蹲伏在灌木丛后，等待着逼近的野猪。

items.def_zh: 蹲下，蹲伏；隐蔽防御，按兵不动
items.def_en: (also 'hunker down') To squat down low on one's heels.
items.ex_en: We had to hunker down in the basement until the ferocious storm passed.
items.ex_zh: 我们不得不蜷缩在地下室里，直到狂暴的风暴过去。

items.def_en: To cringe or crouch down in fear, terror, or subservience
items.ex_en: The frightened puppy began to cower behind the sofa when thunder shook the house.
items.ex_zh: 当雷声震动房屋时，受惊的小狗开始蜷缩在沙发后面发抖。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers lowering the body close to the ground by bending knees and spine, whether to take cover, conceal oneself, rest on heels, or brace against harsh conditions. It contrasts utilitarian low stances with defensive or protective curling.
groups.summary_zh: 指屈膝弯腰、紧贴地面以隐蔽、避险或休整的低姿态动作。
groups.desc_en: Lowering the body close to the ground by bending limbs, done for concealment, defensive retreat, or compact rest, differing from casual sitting by its readiness, tension, or fear.
groups.desc_zh: 弯曲四肢使身体尽量贴近地面，旨在隐蔽、防御退避或蜷聚，与随意就坐相比，带有紧绷防备、求生或畏怯意味。
groups.nuance_en: squat: balance on the feet with knees fully bent (floor / heels / ground) · crouch: lower the body close to earth, poised for action or concealment (shadows / bushes / ready) · hunker down: crouch low to shelter securely against hardship or siege (shelter / storm / trench) · curl up: draw knees and torso into a compact, protective ball (sofa / ball / bed) · cower: shrink away or crouch low in abject fear or subservience (corner / terror / fear)
groups.nuance_zh: squat: 双膝弯曲贴近脚跟蹲在地上 (floor / heels / ground) · crouch: 压低身躯伏下以求隐蔽或蓄势待发 (shadows / bushes / ready) · hunker down: 伏低身子躲避恶劣风暴或长期坚守 (shelter / storm / trench) · curl up: 蜷缩成一团以获得舒适或保护 (sofa / ball / bed) · cower: 因极端恐惧或屈服而瑟缩发抖 (corner / terror / fear)

groups.name: Crush & Mash to Pieces · 压碎与捣烂 (Crush, Mash, Squash)
groups.tip: 施加重压直至彻底成浆

items.def_en: To crush food or another soft substance until it becomes a uniform paste or pulp
items.ex_en: Use a heavy fork to mash the boiled sweet potatoes into a smooth paste.
items.ex_zh: 用一把结实的叉子把煮熟的红薯捣成细腻的泥状。

items.def_en: To crush thoroughly into a pulpy, blended consistency
items.ex_en: Just mash up those ripe bananas and toss them into the pancake batter.
items.ex_zh: 把那些熟透的香蕉捣烂，直接扔进煎饼面糊里就行。

items.def_en: To press or squeeze something with a force that deforms, breaks, or destroys its structure
items.ex_en: Falling rocks completely crushed the front bumper of the abandoned vehicle.
items.ex_zh: 滚落的石块彻底压毁了那辆被遗弃车辆的前保险杠。

items.def_en: To crush or squeeze something flat, soft, or out of shape through sudden or heavy pressure
items.ex_en: Be careful with that grocery bag so you do not squash the fresh tomatoes.
items.ex_zh: 小心拿那个杂货袋，别把新鲜番茄挤烂了。
items.ex2_en: Overripe soft peaches will squash easily under the heavy weight of heavier canned groceries.
items.ex2_zh: 过熟的软桃子在较重的罐头杂物重压下很容易被压烂。

items.def_en: To crush or grind something, such as fruit, wood, or paper, into a soft, wet, shapeless mass.
items.ex_en: The machine uses immense hydraulic pressure to pulp scrap timber for cardboard production.
items.ex_zh: 该机器利用巨大的液压将废木材捣烂成浆，用于生产纸板。

items.def_en: To crush, grind, or beat something into fine powder, dust, or tiny fragments
items.ex_en: He used a heavy mallet to pulverize the dry spices into fine dust.
items.ex_zh: 他用一把重木槌将干香料彻底捣碎成细粉。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe exerting forceful mechanical pressure on an object until its physical integrity collapses into a soft, flattened, or formless mass. They range from utilitarian kitchen preparation to violent destructive flattening.
groups.summary_zh: 通过施压使物体破裂、扁平化或化为烂泥浆状。
groups.desc_en: Applying overwhelming physical compression or impact to disintegrate a solid structure into a soft, flattened, or powdered mass, contrasting with neat cutting by its violent deformation.
groups.desc_zh: 施加压倒性的机械挤压或撞击，将坚硬或成形的物体破坏为泥状、扁平状或粉末状，与规则切割相比强调粉碎性形变。
groups.nuance_en: mash: crush food or soft matter into a uniform paste (potatoes / bananas / ingredients) · squash: compress something soft or hollow into a flattened, deformed state (grapes / bug / box) · crush: break or deform completely by heavyweight compression (bones / rebellion / ice) · pulp: beat or grind material until it becomes a wet, fibrous mass (wood / fruit / opponent) · pulverize: reduce completely to fine dust or powder (concrete / rock / defense)
groups.nuance_zh: mash: 将食物或软质材料压捣成糊状 (potatoes / bananas / ingredients) · squash: 将柔软或空心物体压扁形变 (grapes / bug / box) · crush: 施以重压彻底压碎、粉碎或镇压 (bones / rebellion / ice) · pulp: 捣打碾压直至变成湿软浆状 (wood / fruit / opponent) · pulverize: 将坚硬物体彻底粉碎成细粉微粒 (concrete / rock / defense)

groups.name: Cunning Superiority & Evasion · 智胜与耍花招胜过 (Outsmart, Outfox)
groups.tip: 凭借心智机巧压制并胜过对手

items.def_zh: 巧妙避开，规避（规则或对手）
items.def_en: (+ sth/sb) to overcome or bypass a rule, obstacle, or person by clever or sly means
items.ex_en: Clever accountants found a tricky loophole to get around the strict tax regulations.
items.ex_zh: 精明的会计师找到了一个狡猾的漏洞，巧妙避开了严格的税收规定。

items.def_zh: 巧妙穿过，趁人不备越过
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to pass or evade an opponent or obstacle quietly and cunningly without detection
items.ex_en: The nimble winger managed to slip by the opposing defender without being noticed.
items.ex_zh: 那名敏捷的边锋成功趁对手防守队员不备，悄然越过了防线。

items.def_en: to get the better of someone by being cleverer or more astute
items.ex_en: The veteran chess master managed to outwit his aggressive opponent in twenty moves.
items.ex_zh: 这位经验丰富的国际象棋大师在二十步内智胜了他那咄咄逼人的对手。

items.def_en: to overcome an opponent by using more skillful or tactically superior maneuvers
items.ex_en: The seasoned diplomat managed to outmaneuver rival envoys during the tense treaty negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 这位经验丰富的外交官在紧张的条约谈判中在策略上制胜了敌对使节。

items.def_zh: 智胜，比……精明，以计谋击败
items.def_en: To defeat or gain an advantage over someone by being more clever or cunning than they are.
items.ex_en: The clever detective managed to outsmart the elusive thief at every single turn.
items.ex_zh: 这位聪明的侦探在每个关头都以计谋战胜了那个狡猾难捕的盗贼。

items.def_zh: 以计谋挫败，以机智胜过
items.def_en: To defeat or outsmart someone by using clever, cunning, or deceitful tactics.
items.ex_en: She managed to outfox her sneaky business competitors by keeping the merger confidential.
items.ex_zh: 她通过对并购事宜严格保密，以机智挫败了诡计多端的商业对手。

groups.summary_en: Verbs where an agent defeats, bypasses, or gains an advantage over a rival through superior wit, cunning, sly calculation, or shrewdness.
groups.summary_zh: 凭借过人智谋、狡黠手段或计策在博弈中胜过、挫败对手。
groups.desc_en: Gaining an advantage over or bypassing an opponent through superior mental agility, deception, or tactical resourcefulness, differing from physical triumph by relying purely on cunning.
groups.desc_zh: 凭借过人的智力敏捷度、计谋或战术机动压制对手或绕过壁垒，与力量取胜不同，完全依托机巧与谋略。
groups.nuance_en: outwit: defeat an adversary by superior ingenuity or calculation (enemies / rivals / detective) · outsmart: gain the upper hand by using cleverer, shrewder tactics (competitors / system / traps) · outfox: deceive or outmaneuver an opponent using cunning stealth (pursuers / defense / regulator) · outmaneuver: surpass through superior movement, positioning, or strategic plotting (opponents / fleet / politicians) · get around: circumvent a rule, restriction, or obstacle cleverly (law / ban / obstacles)
groups.nuance_zh: outwit: 凭智计、算计棋高一着而战胜对手 (enemies / rivals / detective) · outsmart: 用更聪敏过人的手段占得上风 (competitors / system / traps) · outfox: 如狐狸般狡黠机警地使对手落入圈套 (pursuers / defense / regulator) · outmaneuver: 凭借卓越的运筹调度或战术走位击败对手 (opponents / fleet / politicians) · get around: 巧妙地规避法规、限制或绕开障碍 (law / ban / obstacles)

groups.name: Customize & Tailor · 定制与个性化 (Tailor, Bespeak, Individualize)
groups.tip: 依特定需求进行专享改造

items.def_en: To make something specifically ordered and fitted to an individual customer
items.ex_en: The local carpenter will custom-make an oak dining table for our odd-sized room.
items.ex_zh: 当地的木匠将为我们尺寸特殊的房间专门定做一张橡木餐桌。

items.def_en: To adapt or make something especially suitable for a specific person, group, or purpose
items.ex_en: The tutor can tailor the lesson plans to suit each student's specific learning pace.
items.ex_zh: 家教可以调整教案，以适应每位学生具体的学习节奏。

items.def_en: To build or change something according to a customer's individual needs and preferences
items.ex_en: The software vendor allows clients to customize their dashboards according to their workflow.
items.ex_zh: 该软件供应商允许客户根据自己的工作流程自定义控制面板。

items.raw_cluster: 定制与个性化 Customize & Personalize
items.def_zh: 使个性化，专为个人定制；在……上标明专有记号
items.def_en: To design, adapt, or mark something to suit a specific individual's tastes, needs, or identity.
items.ex_en: The craftsman can personalize your leather journal by embossing your initials on it.
items.ex_zh: 工匠可以在皮质日记本上压印您的姓名首字母，使其专属于您。

items.def_en: To give something individual character or adapt it to a single person's needs
items.ex_en: The medical program seeks to individualize patient therapies according to unique genetic markers.
items.ex_zh: 该医疗项目旨在根据独特的基因标记使患者的治疗方案个别化。

items.def_en: To order or arrange for something in advance according to custom specifications
items.ex_en: The wealthy patron chose to bespeak a magnificent marble sculpture for the gallery.
items.ex_zh: 这位富有的资助人决定为画廊预订一座华丽的定制大理石雕塑。

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote modifying, designing, or adapting goods, services, or experiences to match individual specifications, personal tastes, or unique requirements.
groups.summary_zh: 依据个体特定偏好或要求专门定制与改造。
groups.desc_en: Adapting or manufacturing an object, system, or service to match the precise, unique specifications or identity of an individual client, contrasting with standardized mass production.
groups.desc_zh: 使物品、系统或服务契合特定客户的精准需求或个性特征进行调适与制造，与标准化量产相对立。
groups.nuance_en: tailor: adapt or modify content, fit, or services to match exact needs (speech / treatment / suit) · customize: alter features of a standard product to individual preference (settings / vehicle / interface) · personalize: add personal markers or emotional touches to an item (gifts / message / experience) · individualize: design distinct treatment specifically tailored to single cases (instruction / care / approach) · custom-make: manufacture entirely from scratch to custom dimensions (furniture / shoes / cabinetry)
groups.nuance_zh: tailor: 如量体裁衣般调整内容或服务以完全贴合需求 (speech / treatment / suit) · customize: 在标准产物上改装定制功能与外观 (settings / vehicle / interface) · personalize: 加入专属名字或个人印记彰显个性 (gifts / message / experience) · individualize: 因材施教地为个体制定专属策略 (instruction / care / approach) · custom-make: 完全按客户尺寸与规格从零订做制造 (furniture / shoes / cabinetry)

groups.name: Dampen & Moisten · 浸湿与微湿 (Humidify, Mist, Sponge)
groups.tip: 增加液体与水分浸润

items.def_en: To spray fine droplets of liquid onto something, or become covered with vapor
items.ex_en: Remember to mist the delicate fern fronds with water every single morning.
items.ex_zh: 记得每天早晨向娇嫩的蕨类叶片上喷洒水雾。
items.ex2_en: The bathroom mirror began to mist heavily as hot water filled the tub.
items.ex2_zh: 当热水注满浴缸时，浴室的镜子开始蒙上一层厚厚的白雾。

items.def_en: To spray a fine mist of liquid onto something briefly
items.ex_en: Just spritz a little lemon juice over the grilled salmon before serving it.
items.ex_zh: 在上菜前，只需往烤三文鱼上轻轻喷洒一点柠檬汁即可。

items.def_en: To wipe or moisten a surface gently using a damp sponge
items.ex_en: Gently sponge the stained fabric with warm water to loosen the spilled sauce.
items.ex_zh: 用温水轻轻擦拭沾有污渍的织物，以软化洒出来的酱汁。

items.def_en: To make dry air or a room more moist by releasing fine vapor
items.ex_en: The central ventilation system works continuously to humidify dry air during cold winters.
items.ex_zh: 中央通风系统持续运转，在寒冬为干燥的空气加湿。

items.def_zh: 弄湿，微湿；减弱，抑制（热情或声响）
items.def_en: 1. to make something slightly wet 2. to make feelings, especially excitement or enthusiasm, less strong
items.ex_en: A light drizzle dampened the dry soil before the gardeners began planting seeds.
items.ex_zh: 在园丁们开始播种之前，一场细雨微湿了干涸的土壤。

items.def_zh: 减弱，消减（与dampen同义的引申义）
items.def_en: To make a sound, feeling, or sensation much weaker or less intense
items.ex_en: Heavy velvet curtains helped to deaden the loud street noise outside the bedroom.
items.ex_zh: 厚重的丝绒窗帘有助于减弱卧室外嘈杂的街头噪音。

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies reducing dry brittleness by lightly coating with liquid or vapor, and readily extends metaphorically to suppressing, dulling, or abating vigor and enthusiasm.
groups.summary_zh: 指轻微打湿或加湿以减除干燥，亦常引申为抑制情绪、热情或减弱强度。
groups.desc_en: Applying a modest, controlled quantity of moisture to a surface or air without full saturation, differing from soaking or drenching by maintaining a light, superficial dampness.
groups.desc_zh: 在物体表面或空气中施加适度、受控的轻微湿气，与浸泡或湿透不同，强调微湿且不至于过饱和。
