groups.nuance_en: dampen: make slightly wet or reduce intensity/vibration (cloth / spirits / vibration) · humidify: increase moisture content within ambient air (air / room / atmosphere) · mist: spray a very fine vapor or cloud of tiny water droplets over (plants / face / garden) · spritz: apply a quick, light spray of liquid droplets (hair / fragrance / oil) · sponge: clean or moisten gently using an absorbent sponge (table / wound / forehead)
groups.nuance_zh: dampen: 使物体表面微湿，或使声波、热情受挫减弱 (cloth / spirits / vibration) · humidify: 提高空间或空气中的湿度 (air / room / atmosphere) · mist: 喷洒极细微的雾状水汽润泽表面 (plants / face / garden) · spritz: 快速而轻巧地喷出细小水花或香气 (hair / fragrance / oil) · sponge: 用海绵轻轻蘸湿、擦拭或润物 (table / wound / forehead)

groups.name: Dare & Defy · 敢于与叫板 (Dare, Defy, Challenge)
groups.tip: 鼓起勇气对抗危险或权威

items.def_en: Invite someone to engage in a contest, test of strength, or proof of capability
items.ex_en: The reigning champion decided to challenge his fiercest rival to an immediate rematch.
items.ex_zh: 卫冕冠军决定向他最强劲的对手发起挑战，立即进行重赛。

items.def_en: 1. To be brave enough to do something difficult or dangerous. 2. To challenge someone to do something risky or frightening.
items.ex_en: None of the timid boys would dare cross the rickety wooden suspension bridge.
items.ex_zh: 那些胆小的男孩中没有一个敢跨过摇摇晃晃的木吊桥。

items.def_en: Dare to do or say something that involves substantial risk or danger
items.ex_en: No solitary wanderer would venture into that desolate mountain pass after darkness fell.
items.ex_zh: 夜幕降临后，没有任何独行者敢涉足那条荒凉的山口通道。

items.def_en: Endure or confront unpleasant, hazardous, or stormy conditions courageously
items.ex_en: The rescue team had to brave severe blizzard conditions to reach trapped climbers.
items.ex_zh: 救援队不得不冒着严酷的暴风雪去搜救被困的登山者。

items.def_zh: 迎战，勇斗（强敌/艰巨任务）
items.def_en: Fight, compete against, or tackle a formidable opponent or daunting task
items.ex_en: Our small startup is ready to take on giant industry leaders this year.
items.ex_zh: 我们的小创业公司准备在今年迎战庞大的行业巨头。

items.def_en: Openly resist, refuse to obey, or challenge authority or expectations boldly
items.ex_en: The brave villagers chose to openly defy the oppressive edicts issued by soldiers.
items.ex_zh: 勇敢的村民们选择公然违抗士兵们下达的压迫性法令。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses having the personal audacity to confront peril or authority, as well as actively challenging someone else to demonstrate courage.
groups.summary_zh: 表达敢于涉险反抗，或向他人下战书发起挑战。
groups.desc_en: Manifesting courage by confronting danger, authority, or daunting odds, contrasting with reckless folly through its deliberate assertion of fearlessness or insolence.
groups.desc_zh: 在危险、权威或压倒性力量面前挺身叫板，与鲁莽愚蠢不同，强调主动宣示无畏、抗命或下战书。
groups.nuance_en: dare: summon courage to attempt something risky, or provoke another to do so (leap / dream / confront) · venture: take the commercial or physical risk of stepping into uncertainty (abroad / opinion / capital) · brave: endure harsh conditions or hostility with unflinching fortitude (elements / storm / dangers) · challenge: invite someone to a contest or contest an established fact (authority / assumptions / rival) · defy: openly refuse to submit to or obey authority or expectations (orders / gravity / odds)
groups.nuance_zh: dare: 鼓起勇气涉险，或出言挑衅激人行事 (leap / dream / confront) · venture: 冒着未知的风险涉足险境或提出观点 (abroad / opinion / capital) · brave: 迎着恶劣风雨或危险面不改色勇毅前行 (elements / storm / dangers) · challenge: 提出挑战邀请一较高下，或对权威与前提出质疑 (authority / assumptions / rival) · defy: 公然蔑视抗命，或打破自然规律/常理极限 (orders / gravity / odds)

groups.name: Debar & Disqualify · 禁止与剥夺资格 (Debar, Disqualify, Invalidate)
groups.tip: 依法阻绝或剥夺资格

items.def_en: To formally exclude someone from an activity, right, or premises
items.ex_en: The sports committee decided to bar unruly fans from attending any upcoming matches.
items.ex_zh: 体育委员会决定禁止不守规矩的球迷入场观看接下来的任何比赛。

items.def_en: To officially forbid an action or thing by laws, rules, or orders
items.ex_en: Strict park regulations strictly prohibit setting up open campfires near dry pine woods.
items.ex_zh: 严格的公园法规严禁在干燥的松树林附近生起露天营火。

items.def_en: To make someone not qualified or legally entitled to have or do something
items.ex_en: Missing the mandatory residency requirement will render the candidate ineligible for public office.
items.ex_zh: 未达到法定居住年限将使该候选人丧失竞选公职的资格。

items.def_en: To decide that someone or something is completely impossible, unsuitable, or ineligible
items.ex_en: The doctor decided to rule out surgery until less invasive treatments had failed.
items.ex_zh: 医生决定在侵入性较小的疗法失效之前，先排除手术方案。

items.def_en: To officially stop someone from participating, winning, or practicing a profession due to breaking a rule
items.ex_en: Officials were forced to disqualify the sprinter after two consecutive false starts occurred.
items.ex_zh: 在连续出现两次抢跑之后，裁判们被迫取消了该短跑选手的参赛资格。

items.def_en: 1. (+ from) (formal) To officially ban or prevent someone from doing something, entering a place, or holding a privilege.
items.ex_en: A prior criminal conviction may debar an applicant from entering the legal profession.
items.ex_zh: 先前的刑事定罪可能会剥夺申请人从事法律职业的资格。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on formally or legally denying someone a privilege, office, right, or qualification through an authoritative decree or failure of prerequisites.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过权威、法律或规则正式剥夺某人的资格、权利或准入许可。
groups.desc_en: Officially excluding someone from a privilege, office, right, or competition by enforcing formal legal, ethical, or statutory barriers, contrasting with physical restraint by its institutional validity.
groups.desc_zh: 依据法律、伦理或规则，通过制度性限制正式剥夺某人的特权、公职、权利或参赛资格，区别于物理拦截，强调法定效力。
groups.nuance_en: bar: officially block or prevent entry, access, or participation (entry / journalists / lawyers) · prohibit: forbid an action formally by law or edict (smoking / sales / exports) · disqualify: render ineligible or unfit due to rules violation or lack of prerequisites (competitor / candidate / evidence) · debar: formally and specifically prohibit someone from an office, privilege, or profession (lawyers / practice / public office) · rule out: eliminate from consideration as an option or diagnosis (possibility / suspect / surgery)
groups.nuance_zh: bar: 正式阻断其入场、参与或行使特定职权的通道 (entry / journalists / lawyers) · prohibit: 经由法规法令明文下令禁止 (smoking / sales / exports) · disqualify: 因违规或条件不符而取消参赛/入选资格 (competitor / candidate / evidence) · debar: 依法或依行规正式剥夺从事特定职业或特权资格 (lawyers / practice / public office) · rule out: 在考察或诊断中彻底将某种可能性排除 (possibility / suspect / surgery)

groups.name: Debase & Prostitute · 出卖人格与自贬才智 (Prostitute, Sell Out, Debase)
groups.tip: 为图利益自贬身价出卖原则

items.def_zh: 贬低，使蒙羞（尤指 demean oneself）
items.def_en: to cause a severe loss in dignity or self-respect through unworthy behavior
items.ex_en: The proud senator refused to demean himself by trading favors for political support.
items.ex_zh: 这位骄傲的参议员拒绝通过利益交换换取政治支持来贬低自己的人格。

items.def_zh: 出卖背叛（原则/同伴），同流合污
items.def_en: to abandon one's moral values, cause, or associates for financial gain or personal comfort
items.ex_en: Tickets sold out within minutes; fans later accused the band of selling out to commercial sponsors.
items.ex_zh: 门票几分钟内便售罄；乐迷们随后指责该乐队向商业赞助商出卖了艺术灵魂。

items.def_en: to turn from sound moral principles to dishonesty, depravity, or bribery
items.ex_en: Unchecked greed can corrupt even the most idealistic public officials over extended periods.
items.ex_zh: 长此以往，不受约束的贪婪甚至会使最富理想主义的公职人员腐化堕落。
items.ex2_en: Ancient religious doctrines corrupt easily when ambitious politicians twist moral texts for personal gain.
items.ex2_zh: 当野心勃勃的政客为了私利歪曲道德文本时，古老的宗教信条极易变质。

items.def_zh: 卖淫；出卖（原则、才能等）以牟利
items.def_en: (also 'prostitute oneself') To engage in sexual activity for payment
items.ex_en: He felt that writing dishonest promotional reviews was akin to prostituting his artistic craft.
items.ex_zh: 他觉得撰写虚假推广软文无异于出卖自己的艺术才能以牟利。

items.def_zh: 侮辱，损害……的自尊与品格
items.def_en: to treat or use someone in a way that humiliates them and reduces their worth
items.ex_en: Prison guards should never degrade inmates by subjecting them to unnecessary strip searches.
items.ex_zh: 狱警绝不应该通过进行不必要的搜身来侮辱犯人并损害其自尊。

items.def_en: to lower the moral character, dignity, or genuine quality of someone or oneself
items.ex_en: Sensational tabloid gossip only serves to debase serious political discussion in our society.
items.ex_zh: 耸人听闻的小报八卦只会降低我们社会严肃政治讨论的格调与品质。

groups.summary_en: Conveys trading away one's creative talents, core beliefs, dignity, or moral integrity for mercenary reward, expediency, or fame.
groups.summary_zh: 指为金钱或功利而出卖原则、自轻自贱或玷污才智尊严。
groups.desc_en: Willfully lowering moral character, artistic integrity, or human dignity in exchange for pecuniary gain or expedient advantage, contrasting with mere moral decline by its venal, commodifying intent.
groups.desc_zh: 为了金钱利益或眼前便利，主动出卖、自贬道德操守、艺术良知或人格尊严，区别于普通道德沦丧，强调唯利是图的变质与商品化妥协。
groups.nuance_en: debase: lower the fundamental moral value, quality, or standard of something (currency / debate / standards) · degrade: treat with humiliating disrespect or cause comprehensive deterioration (humanity / environment / women) · demean: act in a way that damages one's own or another's status and self-respect (profession / office / self) · sell out: betray fundamental values, allies, or artistic integrity for money or safety (ideals / friends / movement) · prostitute: commodify one's talent, body, or principles unworthily for base gain (talents / art / principles)
groups.nuance_zh: debase: 贬低事物的内在价值、纯度或辩论水准 (currency / debate / standards) · degrade: 侮辱践踏尊严，或使品质结构全面恶化堕落 (humanity / environment / women) · demean: 做出有失身份、自贬身价或折辱他人的举止 (profession / office / self) · sell out: 为蝇头微利或安危背叛理念、盟友与艺术良知 (ideals / friends / movement) · prostitute: 辱没出卖自己的才华、肉体或原则以谋取卑劣利益 (talents / art / principles)

groups.name: Decide & Resolve · 决定与抉择 (Determine, Settle, Conclude)
groups.tip: 从做出抉择到坚定决意

items.def_en: (+ for / to) Make a choice from a range of available possibilities
items.ex_en: After evaluating multiple proposals, the directors will opt for a sustainable development strategy.
items.ex_zh: 在评估多项方案后，董事们将抉择采取可持续发展战略。

items.def_en: Come to a definitive decision after hesitation or contemplation
items.ex_en: She could not make up her mind about which prestigious university to attend.
items.ex_zh: 她迟迟拿不定主意该去哪所名牌大学就读。

items.def_zh: 决定，抉择；裁决，判决；解决
items.def_en: 1. To make a choice or judgment about something after considering the possibilities. 2. To settle, resolve, or officially judge a dispute or outcome.
items.ex_en: The panel will meet tomorrow afternoon to decide the outcome of the dispute.
items.ex_zh: 专家组将于明天下午开会，对这场纠纷的裁决结果作出决定。

items.def_en: Bring an uncertain dispute, choice, or matter to an agreed-upon conclusion
items.ex_en: Both parties agreed to settle their contract disagreements without entering a courtroom trial.
items.ex_zh: 双方同意在不进入法庭审判的情况下敲定并解决合同分歧。

items.def_en: Firmly establish, calculate, or make up one's mind about an outcome or rule
items.ex_en: Laboratory tests will determine the exact concentration of toxic chemicals in the water.
items.ex_zh: 实验室检测将准确查明并确定水中所含毒性化学物质的浓度。

items.def_en: Make a firm, solemn, and steadfast decision to do something
items.ex_en: The council members resolve to enact stricter environmental protections before the year ends.
items.ex_zh: 委员会成员们下定决心，要在年底前颁布更加严格的环保法令。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe cognitive acts of coming to a conclusive judgment, selecting an option from competing alternatives, or firmly binding oneself to an intended course of action.
groups.summary_zh: 权衡抉择，对不同选项或悬而未决的事项形成确定意志或结论。
groups.desc_en: Bringing uncertainty or deliberation to a definitive close by selecting an option or committing firmly to a course of action, contrasting with vacillation through its finality and resolve.
groups.desc_zh: 通过做出最终选择或坚决承诺，结束犹豫不决或权衡考量，与摇摆不定相对，强调决断的终局性与坚定信念。
groups.nuance_en: opt: choose a specific alternative out of available possibilities (treatment / early retirement / strategy) · decide: reach a judgment or select a course after consideration (fate / case / direction) · make up one's mind: resolve personal hesitation and conclude on an intent (future / career / purchase) · settle: resolve a dispute, debt, or open issue conclusively (dispute / score / argument) · determine: establish authoritatively or firmly cause a fixed outcome (outcome / cause / truth) · resolve: form a firm, unshakeable determination to execute a purpose (dispute / conflict / do so)
groups.nuance_zh: opt: 在多种现成备选方案中倾向性地做出取舍 (treatment / early retirement / strategy) · decide: 经由权衡考量就某一方向形成定论 (fate / case / direction) · make up one's mind: 打破内心犹豫迟疑，下定做某事的决心 (future / career / purchase) · settle: 使悬而未决的争议、债务或纠葛彻底平息解决 (dispute / score / argument) · determine: 查明确定事实真相，或起决定性主导作用 (outcome / cause / truth) · resolve: 下定不可动摇的坚强意志贯彻某目标，或决意化解冲突 (dispute / conflict / do so)

groups.name: Decipher & Read · 辨读与释意 (Decipher, Make out, Construe, Fathom)
groups.tip: 破解隐秘玄机与密码

items.def_zh: 读出；领会（深层意义/意图）
items.def_en: To understand the meaning of non-verbal cues, intentions, or difficult characters
items.ex_en: A perceptive detective can easily read subtle micro-expressions across a suspect's nervous face.
items.ex_zh: 敏锐的侦探能轻而易举地从嫌疑人紧张的面庞上读出微妙的微表情。

items.def_en: To deduce or understand something from words, clues, or observed evidence
items.ex_en: From the somber tone of her voice, I gather that the negotiations failed.
items.ex_zh: 从她低沉严肃的语气中，我推想出谈判已经破裂。
items.ex2_en: Dark rain clouds gather rapidly above the mountain peaks before the fierce afternoon storm.
items.ex2_zh: 在下午猛烈的暴风雨来临之前，乌云迅速在山峰上方聚集起来。

items.def_en: To manage to see, read, or hear something with difficulty because it is faint or unclear
items.ex_en: Through the heavy morning fog, we could barely make out the distant lighthouse.
items.ex_zh: 透过清晨浓重的大雾，我们几乎看不清远处的灯塔。

items.def_en: To recognize and understand the true nature or hidden inner motives behind words or facades
items.ex_en: Experience allowed the savvy investor to see into the hidden risks behind numbers.
items.ex_zh: 丰富的经验使这位精明的投资者能够洞悉数字背后隐藏的真实风险。

items.def_zh: 破译（密码）；辨认出（难辨字迹等）；理解，解读
items.def_en: To succeed in reading, decoding, or understanding text that is difficult to read or information that is mysterious or obscure.
items.ex_en: Cryptographers worked through the night to decipher the intercepted wartime enemy radio transmissions.
items.ex_zh: 密码学家们通宵工作，以破译拦截到的战时敌方无线电通讯。

items.def_en: (+ as) To understand the meaning of a word, remark, or action in a particular way
items.ex_en: You must not construe his prolonged silence as complete agreement with our terms.
items.ex_zh: 你绝不能将他长久的沉默解读为对我们条款的完全赞同。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on the perceptual and cognitive struggle to read barely legible handwriting, faded inscriptions, or cryptic expressions and understand their underlying meaning.
groups.summary_zh: 辨认模糊难辨的字迹，或领悟晦涩难懂的言辞与表情。
groups.desc_en: Involves extracting semantic meaning or hidden intent from faint, obscure, or encoded signals, going beyond passive reading to active, interpretive penetration.
groups.desc_zh: 指从模糊、晦涩或编码的信息中提取语义或言外之意，超越被动阅读，强调主动的解读与穿透式释意。
groups.nuance_en: read: perceives underlying sentiment or clues through surface signs (intentions / mood / signs) · gather: infers tentative meaning from situational context (impression / meaning / sense) · make out: discerns visually or auditorily with sensory effort (silhouette / handwriting / words) · decipher: unlocks meaning from genuinely obscure or corrupted script/signals (code / inscription / notes) · construe: assigns an analytical or legal interpretation to ambiguous actions or texts (remark / silence / statute)
groups.nuance_zh: read: 透过表面迹象洞悉潜在意图或情绪 (intentions / mood / signs) · gather: 结合情境推测出初步结论或语意 (impression / meaning / sense) · make out: 费力辨清模糊的视听信息 (silhouette / handwriting / words) · decipher: 破译难辨、残缺或深奥的符号文本 (code / inscription / notes) · construe: 对模糊言行或条文进行定性分析与阐释 (remark / silence / statute)

groups.name: Decipher & Unravel · 剖析与抽丝剥茧 (Unravel, Untangle, Tease out, Sift)
groups.tip: 抽丝剥茧理清疑团

items.def_en: (+ through) To examine a huge amount of clues, evidence, or details carefully to find what is relevant
items.ex_en: Investigators had to sift through thousands of financial transactions to find genuine fraud.
items.ex_zh: 调查人员不得不仔细筛查数千笔金融交易，以找出真正的诈骗行为。

items.def_en: To understand a story, crime, or mystery by assembling fragmented evidence bit by bit
items.ex_en: Historians worked painstakingly to piece together the lost civilization from scattered clay fragments.
items.ex_zh: 历史学家们艰苦努力，从散落的陶片中逐步拼凑还原出消逝的文明。

items.def_zh: 费力梳理出；耐心抽取出
items.def_en: To manage to reveal or extract hidden facts, subtle meanings, or strands of truth through patient effort
items.ex_en: Careful cross-examination helped the lawyer tease out the truth from misleading testimony.
items.ex_zh: 细致的交叉询问帮助律师耐心地从误导性证词中抽取出事实真相。

items.def_zh: 解开，澄清（谜团、疑难等）；拆开（织物等）；崩溃，瓦解
items.def_en: 1. To solve, explain, or clarify a mystery or complicated puzzle. 2. To undo or separate knotted or woven threads. 3. To fall apart, break down, or fail (of a system, plan, or relationship).
items.ex_en: Detectives spent tedious months trying to unravel the tangled circumstances of his disappearance.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们花费了数月乏味的时间，试图解开他失踪案中错综复杂的谜团。
items.ex2_en: The intricate diplomatic agreement began to unravel quickly amid rising international border disputes.
items.ex2_zh: 在日益加剧的国际边界争端中，这项错综复杂的外交协议开始迅速瓦解。

items.def_zh: 解开；理清（混乱思绪或复杂关系）
items.def_en: To separate things that are twisted together; clarify and make sense of a complicated situation
items.ex_en: The counselor helped the estranged couple untangle their complex web of bitter resentments.
items.ex_zh: 咨询师帮助这对分居的夫妇理清了他们之间错综复杂的积怨。

items.def_en: (+ from) To separate one complicated idea, narrative, or problem from another to make it clearer
items.ex_en: The researcher struggled to disentangle historical fact from myth in ancient folklore narratives.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员费力地在古代民间传说叙事中将历史事实与神话辨明澄清。

groups.summary_en: This frame highlights the step-by-step, tactile or analytical disentanglement of complex, interconnected threads of information, convoluted plots, or knotted dilemmas until the whole structure is revealed.
groups.summary_zh: 抽丝剥茧般理清错综复杂的线索、纠葛或深奥谜题。
groups.desc_en: Metaphorizes resolving intellectual confusion as disentangling a knotted mass or sifting mixed particles into ordered threads, contrasting with abrupt global decoding.
groups.desc_zh: 将消除认知混乱隐喻为解开纠结乱麻或筛分杂质，强调循序渐进地梳理出秩序，而非瞬间的整体破译。
groups.nuance_en: sift: filters through voluminous data to isolate relevant items (evidence / records / data) · piece together: reconstructs an entire narrative from scattered fragments (clues / story / timeline) · tease out: carefully extracts subtle, tightly bound details with patience (nuance / strand / truth) · unravel: resolves complex mysteries or intricate systems as threads come loose (plot / mystery / knot) · disentangle: frees a core element from confusing entanglements (fact from fiction / mess / complexity)
groups.nuance_zh: sift: 细致筛查海量信息以提炼有用元素 (evidence / records / data) · piece together: 将零散碎片拼接重构成完整真相 (clues / story / timeline) · tease out: 极具耐心地理出紧密交织的隐秘细节 (nuance / strand / truth) · unravel: 如拆线般顺藤摸瓜解开错综谜团 (plot / mystery / knot) · disentangle: 将交织混杂的要素彻底解套理顺 (fact from fiction / mess / complexity)

groups.name: Declutter & Streamline · 清理杂物与规整空间 (Clear out, Tidy, Weed out)
groups.tip: 清除杂乱使环境井井有条

items.def_en: To remove mess or unnecessary things from a room or surface to make it tidier
items.ex_en: She spent the quiet weekend afternoon working to declutter her messy home office.
items.ex_zh: 她利用宁静的周末下午清理凌乱的家庭办公室中的杂物。

items.def_en: To empty a place thoroughly by discarding or putting away unnecessary contents
items.ex_en: We should clear out that dusty storage room before the new tenants arrive.
items.ex_zh: 在新房客到来之前，我们应该把那个落满灰尘的储藏室彻底清理干净。

items.def_en: To make a place neat by putting things in their proper places
items.ex_en: Please tidy up the living room before our dinner guests arrive this evening.
items.ex_zh: 在今晚宴请的客人到达之前，请先把客厅收拾整洁。
items.ex2_en: The cluttered workshop will tidy up quickly once we organize those scattered power tools.
items.ex2_zh: 一旦我们把那些散落的电动工具整理好，凌乱的车间很快就会收拾整洁。

items.def_en: To systematically remove unwanted or useless items or elements from a collection
items.ex_en: The human resources department aims to weed out unqualified applicants during preliminary screenings.
items.ex_zh: 人力资源部门旨在初审阶段淘汰掉不合格的申请人。

items.def_en: To look through a group of things carefully in order to organize them or remove unwanted items
items.ex_en: She spent hours sorting through boxes of old family photographs.
items.ex_zh: 她花了数小时翻检那几箱老家庭照片。

items.def_zh: 清理，使整洁，清除……的杂物
items.def_en: To remove unnecessary objects or clutter from a space to make it tidy.
items.ex_en: I spent the entire weekend trying to unclutter my small home office.
items.ex_zh: 我花了一整个周末来清理我那间狭小的家庭办公室。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe removing unnecessary, scattered, or messy items from a room, container, or workspace to restore order. While 'declutter' focuses on discarding excess possessions, 'clear out' implies thorough removal, and 'weed out' emphasizes sorting to eliminate the unwanted.
groups.summary_zh: 指清除多余或杂乱物品以恢复整洁、开阔与秩序。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on purging surplus physical or operational clutter to restore functional order, contrasting with mere routine surface cleaning.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重于清除冗余的物理或流程杂物以恢复功能性秩序，而非普通的表面日常清洁。
groups.nuance_en: declutter: eliminates accumulated non-essential objects to free up space (room / desk / inbox) · clear out: empties a defined enclosure thoroughly of contents (closet / garage / attic) · tidy up: arranges items neatly into their assigned places (mess / desk / apartment) · weed out: selectively expels inferior, unwanted components from a collective (candidates / files / defects) · sort through: methodically inspects an unsorted pile to decide retention (papers / clothes / belongings)
groups.nuance_zh: declutter: 清除积压闲置杂物以还原本质空间 (room / desk / inbox) · clear out: 彻底倒空某一封闭区域的所有杂物 (closet / garage / attic) · tidy up: 收拾规整零乱物件使之井然有序 (mess / desk / apartment) · weed out: 甄别并剔除群体中的劣质淘汰项 (candidates / files / defects) · sort through: 逐一翻检杂乱堆积物以决定去留 (papers / clothes / belongings)

groups.name: Decode & Decrypt · 解密与转换 (Decode, Decrypt, Demystify, Translate)
groups.tip: 将晦涩代码翻译明了

items.def_en: (+ into) To express specialized, technical, or symbolic communication in words that ordinary people understand
items.ex_en: She managed to translate dense medical jargon into clear advice for patients.
items.ex_zh: 她成功将晦涩的医学术语转译为面向病患的清晰建议。
items.ex2_en: These theoretical economic ideas translate poorly into practical daily policies for struggling families.
items.ex2_zh: 这些理论上的经济观点很难转化为针对困难家庭的切实日常政策。

items.def_zh: 诠释；解读（含蓄或编码意义）
items.def_en: To explain or decide on the intended meaning of ambiguous signals, charts, or signs
items.ex_en: Scholars continue to interpret the ambiguous symbols carved upon the ancient stele.
items.ex_zh: 学者们仍在对刻在古石碑上的模糊符号进行深入解读。

items.def_zh: 破译，译码；理解（晦涩含义）
items.def_en: 1. To translate a coded message, secret signal, or electronic data into intelligible language. 2. To understand the hidden or complicated meaning of something.
items.ex_en: Engineers worked around the clock to decode the strange radio transmission.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们夜以继日地工作，试图破译那串奇怪的无线电信号。

items.def_en: To analyze strings of coded data, syntax, or complex speech into distinct structural components
items.ex_en: The computational algorithm was designed to parse complex syntactic structures in speech.
items.ex_zh: 该计算算法旨在剖析口语中复杂的句法结构。

items.def_en: To convert cryptographically encoded or encrypted data back into its original plain, unencrypted form
items.ex_en: Specialists used advanced software to decrypt the seized hard drive's hidden files.
items.ex_zh: 专家们使用先进软件解密了被扣押硬盘中的隐藏文件。

items.def_en: To make a complicated or esoteric subject easier to understand by removing mystery and jargon
items.ex_en: The professor wrote a concise guide to demystify quantum computing for undergraduates.
items.ex_zh: 这位教授撰写了一本简明指南，旨在为本科生揭开量子计算的神秘面纱。

groups.summary_en: This frame belongs to the formal/technical domain of converting encrypted ciphertexts, technical jargon, or encoded binary transmissions back into human-readable, intelligible communication.
groups.summary_zh: 将加密电文、生硬术语或机器信号还原为可读懂的信息。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to translating symbolic, encrypted, or opaque data into comprehensible, plain representation, contrasting with purely aesthetic interpretation.
groups.desc_zh: 强调将高度符号化、加密或晦涩的数据转换为通俗透明的可读信息，区别于纯粹的审美性解读。
groups.nuance_en: translate: renders meaning across linguistic systems or practical outcomes (text / theory into practice / ideas) · decode: converts ciphered or implicit signals into explicit understanding (cipher / message / body language) · parse: breaks down a complex stream into grammatical or computational parts (sentence / code / data) · decrypt: unlocks mathematically protected cryptographic data (file / hard drive / communication) · demystify: strips away esoteric aura to make something plainly understandable (process / jargon / market)
groups.nuance_zh: translate: 转换语言符号或将理论转化为实际运用 (text / theory into practice / ideas) · decode: 将暗语或隐式信号解码为显性明言 (cipher / message / body language) · parse: 严密拆解句法或数据流的分支结构 (sentence / code / data) · decrypt: 针对数学加密文本执行技术破译 (file / hard drive / communication) · demystify: 破除神秘面纱使深奥流程通俗化 (process / jargon / market)

groups.name: Decompress & Relieve · 缓解与释放 (Unwind, De-stress, Let up)
groups.tip: 释放压力使身心舒缓

items.def_en: To relax completely and stop worrying, often after a stressful situation
items.ex_en: Just chill out on the sofa and stop worrying about work tonight.
items.ex_zh: 今晚就在沙发上好好放松一下吧，别再为工作发愁了。

items.def_en: To reduce feelings of tension and mental or emotional pressure
items.ex_en: A brisk walk in the park helps me de-stress after chaotic meetings.
items.ex_zh: 混乱的会议结束后，在公园快走有助于我缓解压力。

items.def_en: To get rid of accumulated nervous energy, anger, or stress through vigorous activity
items.ex_en: He went to the gym to blow off steam after the argument.
items.ex_zh: 争吵之后，他去健身房发泄内心的火气。

items.def_en: To release strong feelings, pressure, or frustration openly and forcefully
items.ex_en: She called her sister just to vent her frustration about the job.
items.ex_zh: 她打电话给妹妹，只是为了宣泄对工作的不满。

items.def_en: To relax and let go of stress after a period of work or nervous tension
items.ex_en: Listening to soft jazz helps him unwind after a long business flight.
items.ex_zh: 在漫长的商务飞行后，听听轻柔的爵士乐能帮他放松身心。
items.ex2_en: The gentle therapist used soothing guided meditation to unwind the patient's tightly coiled anxiety.
items.ex2_zh: 温和的治疗师使用舒缓的冥想引导来消除患者紧绷的焦虑情绪。

items.def_en: 1. To reduce air or water pressure gradually; (informal) to relax and relieve stress after hard work.
items.ex_en: I need a quiet weekend in the mountains to completely decompress.
items.ex_zh: 我需要去山里度过一个宁静的周末来彻底放松减压。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on discharging pent-up physical pressure or emotional stress, transitioning from intense strain or work into a state of relaxed recovery.
groups.summary_zh: 指卸除积聚的物理压力或神经紧绷，从高压忙碌转入松弛休整。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on releasing accumulated psychological or physiological tension after prolonged exertion, contrasting with mere static resting.
groups.desc_zh: 强调在长期承压或劳顿之后主动释放身心蓄积的张力，区别于纯粹的静止休息。
groups.nuance_en: chill out: settles into an informal state of calm detachment (nerves / attitude / mind) · de-stress: takes proactive measures to dissipate physiological stress (body / mind / lifestyle) · vent: releases bottled-up negative emotions verbally or explosively (frustration / anger / spleen) · unwind: gradually loosens coiled tension like wound-up clockwork (tension / day / mind) · decompress: equalizes internal mental pressure safely after high-stress immersion (after work / pressure / team)
groups.nuance_zh: chill out: 迅速进入闲散松弛、不较劲的安逸状态 (nerves / attitude / mind) · de-stress: 采取主动措施排解体内蓄积的压力 (body / mind / lifestyle) · vent: 将积压的愤懑情绪宣泄宣吐出来 (frustration / anger / spleen) · unwind: 像松开发条般渐进舒缓紧绷神经 (tension / day / mind) · decompress: 从极高压沉浸环境平稳回归泄压 (after work / pressure / team)

groups.name: Dedicate & Devote · 奉献与倾注 (Devote, Dedicate, Commit)
groups.tip: 全身心投入崇高事业或信仰

items.def_zh: 致力于，投入（资源或自身）
items.def_en: (+ oneself/resources to) to pledge or devote completely to a particular purpose or course of action
items.ex_en: The council decided to commit substantial financial resources to environmental protection.
items.ex_zh: 委员会决定投入大量财政资源用于环境保护。

items.def_zh: 把（时间、精力等）全部倾注于
items.def_en: (+ sth to sth) to dedicate or surrender oneself, time, or resources completely to a specific pursuit
items.ex_en: In her retirement, she gave over every spare hour to classical poetry.
items.ex_zh: 退休之后，她将所有的空闲时间都奉献给了古典诗歌。

items.def_en: (+ sth to sb/sth) to dedicate or sacrifice one's time, resources, or efforts wholly for a particular person or cause
items.ex_en: He decided to give up his remaining free weekends to the charity.
items.ex_zh: 他决定把剩下的周末空闲时间都奉献给这家慈善机构。

items.def_zh: 把……奉献给，致力于（尤指 dedicate oneself/time to）；将（作品等）题献给；为（建筑物等）举行落成典礼
items.def_en: 1. (dedicate yourself/something to) To give a lot of your time, effort, or life to a particular purpose or cause. 2. To address or offer a book, music, or artwork to someone as a tribute.
items.ex_en: The scientist chose to dedicate his life to discovering a clean energy source.
items.ex_zh: 这位科学家选择将毕生精力奉献给清洁能源的研发。

items.def_en: To give your time, effort, or love completely to a person, activity, or cause.
items.ex_en: She resolved to devote all her remaining energy to defending civil liberties.
items.ex_zh: 她决心将自己所有的剩余精力都倾注于捍卫公民自由。

items.def_en: (+ to) to officially dedicate someone or something to a revered, solemn, or religious purpose
items.ex_en: The young monk decided to consecrate his remaining years to divine contemplation.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻的僧侣决定将余生奉献给对神圣的沉思。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe giving a significant portion of one's time, efforts, resources, or one's entire life exclusively to a cause, person, or serious pursuit.
groups.summary_zh: 指将自身时间、精力或心血全心全意倾注于某项事业、信仰或他人。
groups.desc_en: Involves the solemn allocation of personal energy, time, or identity to a single sovereign purpose, contrasting with general assignment or temporary spending.
groups.desc_zh: 指将精力、时间或自身身份神圣且排他地倾注于特定目标，区别于一般的分配或短暂花销。
groups.nuance_en: commit: binds oneself irreversibly by pledge or resources (resources / life / capital) · give up: sacrifices or surrenders a possession or pursuit voluntarily (time / career / rights) · dedicate: formally devotes effort or honors an entity with single-minded focus (life / monument / career) · devote: pours deep emotional affection and time into a cherished end (attention / energy / life) · consecrate: sanctifies religiously or elevates to an inviolable status (life / ground / memory)
groups.nuance_zh: commit: 签署承诺或彻底押注自身资源与信誉 (resources / life / capital) · give up: 怀着牺牲精神割舍自身权益或时间 (time / career / rights) · dedicate: 专心致志并正式奉献终生或项目 (life / monument / career) · devote: 倾注深沉情感与无私关切于所爱事物 (attention / energy / life) · consecrate: 赋予宗教般的神圣性或奉为不朽 (life / ground / memory)

groups.name: Define & Interpret · 定义与阐释 (Construe, Frame, Conceptualize)
groups.tip: 重新界定概念并诠释内涵

items.def_en: To express something chosen carefully to emphasize a particular perspective or context
items.ex_en: The campaign manager chose to frame the debate around economic security.
items.ex_zh: 竞选经理选择从经济安全的角度来构建这场辩论。

items.def_en: To express an idea or feeling fluently and clearly in words
items.ex_en: The ambassador managed to articulate the government's concerns with remarkable precision.
items.ex_zh: 大使以非凡的准确性清晰阐明了政府的关切。

items.def_zh: 重新界定，重新定义；改变……的性质或范围
items.def_en: To define again or differently; to change the nature, meaning, or boundaries of a concept, role, or standard.
items.ex_en: Recent technological breakthroughs will fundamentally redefine the boundaries of modern healthcare.
items.ex_zh: 近期的技术突破将从根本上重新界定现代医疗的范畴。

items.def_en: To understand the meaning of a word, action, or remark in a particular way
items.ex_en: The court refused to construe silence as an admission of legal guilt.
items.ex_zh: 法院拒绝将沉默解释为对法律罪责的承认。

items.def_en: To describe, explain, or mark the exact limits of something in detail
items.ex_en: The white paper seeks to delineate the exact boundaries of regulatory authority.
items.ex_zh: 该白皮书旨在详细勾勒出监管权力的确切界限。

items.def_en: To form an idea or principle in your mind to understand a phenomenon
items.ex_en: Philosophers struggled to conceptualize the sudden shift in collective moral consciousness.
items.ex_zh: 哲学家们难以对集体道德意识的骤变进行概念化阐述。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses intellectual and communicative verbs used to delineate boundaries, establish the essence of concepts, or frame how phenomena are understood.
groups.summary_zh: 阐发事物本质、界定概念范围或从特定角度解读。
groups.desc_en: Involves structuring, bounding, and conceptualizing an abstract subject to establish how it should be perceived, contrasting with simply labeling it.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重于为抽象事物界定边界、建构语境并引导认知方式，区别于简单的命名打标签。
groups.nuance_en: frame: establishes the conceptual context or narrative bias of an issue (debate / narrative / question) · articulate: gives coherent, lucid verbal expression to nuanced thoughts (vision / argument / philosophy) · redefine: alters existing boundaries or benchmarks fundamentally (concept / relationship / success) · construe: interprets ambiguous actions or statements within a distinct viewpoint (motives / remarks / meaning) · conceptualize: models and forms an abstract paradigm from disparate ideas (framework / idea / strategy)
groups.nuance_zh: frame: 确立议题的话语框架或预设立场 (debate / narrative / question) · articulate: 清晰系统地用语言表述精密思想 (vision / argument / philosophy) · redefine: 重新划定既有边界并刷新定义标准 (concept / relationship / success) · construe: 在特定视角下主观引申与推论定性 (motives / remarks / meaning) · conceptualize: 将零散认知上升为抽象概念或模型 (framework / idea / strategy)

groups.name: Defy & Rebel · 违抗与叛逆 (Defy, Flout, Rebel)
groups.tip: 从消极不服从到公开挑衅违抗

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To violate a law, agreement, or established rule.
items.ex_en: The proposed local ordinance may infringe upon the constitutional rights of citizens.
items.ex_zh: 这项拟议的地方条例可能会侵犯公民的宪法权利。

items.def_en: To confront and resist an intimidating person or oppressive command bravely.
items.ex_en: These materials are designed to stand up to extreme weather conditions.
items.ex_zh: 这些材料旨在经受住极端天气的考验。

items.def_zh: 违抗，不服从；违反（法规、命令）
items.def_en: To refuse to do what you are told, or to break a rule, law, or command.
items.ex_en: The rebellious soldier chose to disobey the commander's direct tactical order.
items.ex_zh: 那名叛逆的士兵选择违抗指挥官的直接战术命令。

items.def_en: To openly refuse to obey a law, order, or authority figure with boldness.
items.ex_en: The protestors gathered outside the municipal building to openly defy the curfew.
items.ex_zh: 抗议者聚集在市政大楼外，公然违抗宵禁令。

items.def_en: To intentionally break a rule, convention, or statute with blatant disrespect.
items.ex_en: Several foreign vessels continue to flout international maritime safety regulations.
items.ex_zh: 数艘外国船只继续公然藐视国际海上安全法规。

items.def_en: (+ against) To fight against an existing government, ruler, or system of authority.
items.ex_en: Underground factions began to rebel against the oppressive measures of the junta.
items.ex_zh: 地下派系开始反抗军政府的压迫性措施。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers deliberate non-compliance, escalating from passive or direct disregard of orders to outright rebellion against institutional authority.
groups.summary_zh: 对规章、禁令或上级命令的不服从、公然蔑视乃至武装反叛。
groups.desc_en: Expresses active, overt resistance or intentional disobedience against authority, rules, or fate, contrasting with quiet evasion or passive non-compliance.
groups.desc_zh: 指对权威、法则或宿命采取公开对抗、公然违抗的挑衅行为，区别于消极回避或暗中怠工。
groups.nuance_en: disobey: fails or refuses to follow explicit lawful orders (orders / parents / commands) · stand up to: confronts an intimidating adversary with courage (bully / tyrant / pressure) · defy: confronts authority or natural odds boldly and mockingly (odds / authority / ban) · flout: openly and contemptuously disregards conventions or laws (rules / law / convention) · rebel: rises up in active, collective, or systemic mutiny against an established order (regime / authority / tradition)
groups.nuance_zh: disobey: 不听从明确命令，拒绝顺从 (orders / parents / commands) · stand up to: 毫不畏惧地挺身对抗强势强权 (bully / tyrant / pressure) · defy: 傲然藐视权威、禁令或公然对抗常理 (odds / authority / ban) · flout: 公然践踏并肆无忌惮地嘲弄规则法规 (rules / law / convention) · rebel: 发动成体系的叛变或决绝背叛既有秩序 (regime / authority / tradition)

groups.name: Degrade & Weaken · 损耗与效能削弱 (Impair, Debilitate, Compromise)
groups.tip: 机能受损结构遭破坏

items.def_en: to make or become less in intensity, quality, or functional capacity
items.ex_en: Chronic fatigue began to diminish her overall cognitive performance over time.
items.ex_zh: 随着时间的推移，长期疲劳开始降低她的整体认知能力。
items.ex2_en: His chronic joint pain began to diminish significantly after completing several physical therapy sessions.
items.ex2_zh: 在完成了几次物理治疗疗程后，他的慢性关节疼痛开始显著减轻。

items.def_zh: 削弱，损害（安全性或机能）
items.def_en: to cause the impairment or weakening of structural, bodily, or operational integrity
items.ex_en: Moisture in the basement could eventually compromise the structural stability of foundations.
items.ex_zh: 地下室的潮气最终可能会损害地基的结构稳定性。

items.def_en: to weaken or damage something (such as health, vision, or an ability), causing it to function less effectively
items.ex_en: Prolonged exposure to loud machinery will permanently impair your hearing capacity.
items.ex_zh: 长期暴露在嘈杂的机械声中会永久损害你的听力能力。

items.def_en: to severely weaken the strength, vigour, or operational ability of someone or something
items.ex_en: A severe bout of pneumonia threatened to debilitate the elderly statesman.
items.ex_zh: 一场严重的肺炎险些击垮这位年迈政治家的身体。

items.def_en: to spoil, reduce, or destroy the quality, efficiency, or legal force of something
items.ex_en: Fraudulent signatures would completely vitiate the legal validity of the agreement.
items.ex_zh: 伪造的签名将彻底破坏该协议的法律效力。

items.def_en: to damage or weaken severely so that normal functioning is largely prevented
items.ex_en: A sudden transit strike threatened to cripple the entire city's commerce.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的交通罢工可能使整座城市的商业陷入瘫痪。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on damaging, weakening, or diminishing the normal functionality, strength, or structural integrity of faculties, materials, or operational systems.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重使身体机能、机械强度或运作系统受损、衰退或功能大打折扣。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the progressive or acute undermining of structural integrity, efficiency, or health, contrasting with complete destruction or simple surface wear.
groups.desc_zh: 指体系结构、机能或效能受到渐进或急性削弱而丧失健全性，区别于彻底毁灭或普通磨损。
groups.nuance_en: diminish: reduces size, scope, or perceived importance quantitatively (impact / influence / resources) · compromise: exposes integrity, security, or standards to hazardous vulnerability (safety / immune system / integrity) · impair: damages functional faculty, quality, or sensory execution (vision / judgement / ability) · debilitate: drains vital physical strength or organizational stamina severely (disease / economy / workforce) · cripple: renders totally unable to operate normally through devastating damage (infrastructure / industry / economy)
groups.nuance_zh: diminish: 在数量、规模或声望上予以削减减损 (impact / influence / resources) · compromise: 使核心防线、安全性或纯洁性产生致命缺口 (safety / immune system / integrity) · impair: 损伤人体机能、判断力或感知运转效能 (vision / judgement / ability) · debilitate: 深度消耗身体活力或组织长期元气 (disease / economy / workforce) · cripple: 造成瘫痪性重创使其彻底丧失运行能力 (infrastructure / industry / economy)

groups.name: Delegate & Appoint · 授权与分派职务 (Depute, Delegate, Commission)
groups.tip: 授权指定代理人代表行事

items.def_en: To formally choose someone to carry out a specific task or produce a specific piece of work
items.ex_en: The local council voted to commission a famous sculptor for the monument.
items.ex_zh: 地方议会表决委托一位著名雕塑家来制作这座纪念碑。

items.def_en: To officially choose someone for a special position or assignment
items.ex_en: The board decided to designate a senior officer as the crisis coordinator.
items.ex_zh: 董事会决定指定一名高级主管担任危机协调员。

items.def_en: To give official permission or legal authority to someone to do something
items.ex_en: Only the general director can authorize expenditure exceeding ten thousand dollars.
items.ex_zh: 只有总经理才有权核准超过一万美元的支出。

items.def_en: To entrust a task, duty, or power to another person, especially a subordinate
items.ex_en: Effective managers know how to delegate operational responsibilities to their staff.
items.ex_zh: 高效的管理者懂得如何将运营职责委派给下属员工。

items.def_en: To give someone the official authority, legal power, or confidence to take action
items.ex_en: The charter was revised to empower regional inspectors with regulatory oversight.
items.ex_zh: 该章程经过修订，旨在授予区域督察员监管权。

items.def_zh: 委派，授权（某人）代理；把（权限等）委托给
items.def_en: 1. (+ to/to do) (formal) To appoint someone to act as a representative or perform a duty on one's behalf; to delegate a power or duty.
items.ex_en: The ambassador had to depute an aide to attend the conference.
items.ex_zh: 大使不得不委派一名助手代替他出席会议。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate transferring authority, duties, or representative roles from a superior or organization to an authorized agent. Nuances vary according to legal formality, specific task assignment, and institutional power.
groups.summary_zh: 指官方或上级将权力、职责或代理任务正式委派或分派给他人。
groups.desc_en: Involves transferring official power, discrete tasks, or operational agency from a higher authority to a representative, contrasting with unilateral abdication.
groups.desc_zh: 指上级权威将具体的权力、任务或代理权制度化地下放给代理人，区别于单方面的放弃职权。
groups.nuance_en: commission: formally contracts or authorizes an entity to execute a specialized project (artist / study / officer) · designate: officially selects or names someone for a specified post or function (successor / area / representative) · delegate: entrusts operational duties or subordinate authority downward (authority / task / responsibility) · empower: invests someone with legal agency or self-determining autonomy (citizens / team / employee) · depute: assigns a subordinate explicitly to act as one's official proxy (subordinate / deputy / envoy)
groups.nuance_zh: commission: 正式立项委托特定人执行专属任务 (artist / study / officer) · designate: 官方指派选定特定角色、接班人或用途 (successor / area / representative) · delegate: 自上而下合理下放具体权力与行政职责 (authority / task / responsibility) · empower: 赋予法律授权或提升个体的自主决断权 (citizens / team / employee) · depute: 派定代理人全权代表自己履职 (subordinate / deputy / envoy)

groups.name: Demand & Insist · 索求与强令 (Demand, Exact, Claim)
groups.tip: 坚决要求或主张应得权利

items.def_en: To demand or require publicly that action be taken
items.ex_en: Outraged citizens took to the streets to call for immediate policy reform.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的市民走上街头，公开呼吁立即进行政策改革。

items.def_en: To demand forcefully and refuse to accept any refusal or alternative
items.ex_en: The demanding client continued to insist on unrealistic deadlines for delivery.
items.ex_zh: 苛刻的客户继续执意要求不切实际的交付期限。

items.def_en: To assert or demand as a right that something belongs to you
items.ex_en: He stepped forward to claim full ownership of the recovered family estate.
items.ex_zh: 他走上前去，主张对收回的家族产业拥有全部所有权。

items.def_en: 1. To ask for something firmly, forcefully, and authoritatively. 2. To require or need something.
items.ex_en: The angry workers gathered to demand safer conditions and higher basic wages.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的工人们聚集在一起，强烈要求更安全的环境和更高的底薪。

items.def_en: To demand and obtain something firmly or by using authority, threats, or force
items.ex_en: Corrupt officials used heavy regulatory fines to exact payments from merchants.
items.ex_zh: 腐败官员利用高额监管罚款强行向商户索取钱财。

items.def_en: To wrest or obtain money or favors by intimidation, violence, or abuse of authority
items.ex_en: The gang attempted to extort large sums from vulnerable shop owners.
items.ex_zh: 该犯罪团伙试图向处于弱势的店主敲诈巨款。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express assertive, peremptory, or coercive calls for compliance, payment, explanation, or rights. They differ in degree of institutional authority, pressure, and whether force or absolute entitlement is claimed.
groups.summary_zh: 表达强硬、不容置疑地要求提供、交出或顺从。
groups.desc_en: Encompasses forceful, insistent claims made with authority or leverage that tolerate no refusal, contrasting with mild requests or polite petitions.
groups.desc_zh: 指凭借权威、权利或强硬手段提出不容拒绝的索求，区别于温和的请求或礼貌的请愿。
groups.nuance_en: call for: publicly declares a condition or action necessary in a situation (action / resignation / inquiry) · insist on: holds unyielding resolve regarding a requirement or standard (terms / punctuality / answers) · demand: forcefully requires compliance under implicit or explicit sanction (ransom / apology / explanation) · exact: forcibly or painfully wrings compliance, toll, or restitution (price / revenge / concession) · extort: illegally wrings money or submission through coercion and intimidation (money / confession / bribes)
groups.nuance_zh: call for: 公开呼吁或形势要求必须采取某行动 (action / resignation / inquiry) · insist on: 咬定特定标准或要求绝不妥协 (terms / punctuality / answers) · demand: 依仗强势强硬索要并要求立即服从 (ransom / apology / explanation) · exact: 强行榨取代价、偿付或予以严酷索求 (price / revenge / concession) · extort: 借暴力威逼或恐吓手段强行勒索 (money / confession / bribes)

groups.name: Democratize & Liberalize · 民主化与均等开放 (Liberalize, Emancipate, Decontrol)
groups.tip: 革新制度使之趋向民主现代

items.def_en: To remove social, economic, or legal barriers and make something broadly available
items.ex_en: The government decided to open up the state telecom sector to competitors.
items.ex_zh: 政府决定向竞争对手开放国家电信领域。

items.def_en: To give someone the authority, confidence, or legal freedom to control their own destiny
items.ex_en: The microfinance initiative aims to empower rural women through business training.
items.ex_zh: 该小额信贷计划旨在通过商业培训增强农村妇女的自主权。

items.def_en: To distribute government or administrative power away from a central authority to local levels
items.ex_en: The administration plans to decentralize healthcare management to distinct regional authorities.
items.ex_zh: 政府计划将医疗管理权下放给各个地方机构。
items.ex2_en: The vast national education system will decentralize gradually over the next five fiscal years.
items.ex2_zh: 庞大的国家教育体系将在未来五个财政年度内逐步实现权力下放。

items.def_en: To make laws, economic systems, or political regimes less strict and more open
items.ex_en: The cabinet passed reforms to liberalize the nation's stringent financial sector.
items.ex_zh: 内阁通过了改革方案，以放宽对该国严格金融领域的管制。
items.ex2_en: The nation's restrictive trade laws will liberalize substantially under the new international treaty.
items.ex2_zh: 根据新的国际条约，该国限制性的贸易法规将大幅放宽。

items.def_zh: 使民主化；使普及，使大众化
items.def_en: 1. To make a country or institution democratic. 2. To make something accessible to all people.
items.ex_en: Affordable internet access helped democratize advanced education across the developing world.
items.ex_zh: 平价的互联网接入有助于在发展中国家普及高等教育。
items.ex2_en: Modern educational institutions democratize rapidly whenever affordable digital tools become widely accessible everywhere.
items.ex2_zh: 每当平价的数字工具随处普及之时，现代教育机构就会迅速走向大众化。

items.def_en: To free someone from legal, political, or social enslavement and restrictions
items.ex_en: The historic decree served to emancipate millions from centuries of servitude.
items.ex_zh: 这项历史性法令将数百万人从长达数百年的奴役中解放出来。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses political and social restructuring to dismantle hierarchical monopolies, expand civic participation, and make power or access universal.
groups.summary_zh: 指推行民主改革、打破专制特权或使权利与资源普及至大众。
groups.desc_en: Denotes breaking down monopolistic hierarchies to make access, power, or goods widely accessible and equitable, contrasting with top-down benevolent charity.
groups.desc_zh: 指打破垄断与特权壁垒，使资源、权利或商品实现广泛且均等的普惠，区别于自上而下的恩赐。
groups.nuance_en: open up: expands access to formerly restricted realms or opportunities (markets / opportunities / borders) · empower: equips marginalized subjects with autonomy and real capacity (marginalized / youth / citizens) · decentralize: redistributes administrative control away from a single focal core (power / authority / operations) · liberalize: removes restrictive state or institutional regulations (economy / laws / trade) · democratize: renders high-end goods, tools, or governance accessible to ordinary people (technology / education / access)
groups.nuance_zh: open up: 开放此前受限的领域或准入门槛 (markets / opportunities / borders) · empower: 赋予边缘群体实质自主权与行动能力 (marginalized / youth / citizens) · decentralize: 分散行政与决断中枢，推行去中心化 (power / authority / operations) · liberalize: 放宽制度管制与消除行政羁绊 (economy / laws / trade) · democratize: 推进平民化普及，让高阶资源惠及大众 (technology / education / access)

groups.name: Demote & Depose · 降职与罢免 (Downgrade, Relegate, Oust)
groups.tip: 官职降等直至彻底废黜下台

items.def_zh: 使降级；调低…的级别或重要性
items.def_en: To reduce someone or something to a lower rank, status, or level of importance
items.ex_en: The agency chose to downgrade the nation's sovereign credit rating yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 该机构昨天决定调低该国的主权信用评级。

items.def_zh: 使降职；将…降到次要或较低位置
items.def_en: (+ to) To assign someone or something to a lower, less important, or less pleasant rank or position
items.ex_en: The manager decided to relegate the underperforming player to the reserves.
items.ex_zh: 经理决定将表现不佳的队员降入预备队。

items.def_en: 1. (+ to) To move someone down to a lower position, rank, or grade, especially as a penalty.
items.ex_en: The committee voted to demote the sergeant after the procedural breach.
items.ex_zh: 在发生违规行为后，委员会表决将该中士降职。

items.def_en: To officially take away someone's rank, titles, honors, or privileges, often as a punishment
items.ex_en: The court decided to strip the disgraced general of his military honors.
items.ex_zh: 法院决定剥夺这位名誉扫地的将军的军中荣誉。

items.def_en: (+ from) To force someone out of a position of leadership, office, or power
items.ex_en: Rebel shareholders formed an alliance to oust the founder from the board.
items.ex_zh: 反叛股东结成同盟，企图将创始人逐出董事会。

items.def_zh: 废黜；罢免（君主或政权首脑）
items.def_en: To suddenly and officially remove a monarch or ruler from power, typically by political or military force
items.ex_en: A sudden military uprising managed to depose the autocratic head of state.
items.ex_zh: 一场突发的军事起义推翻了专制国家元首的政权。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to stripping someone of rank, office, or authority, ranging from formal administrative downgrades to forceful removals from power.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及削减职级、调低身份或强行解除权力与职位的行为。
groups.desc_en: Encompasses the punitive or systematic downward removal of an individual from rank, status, or sovereign office, contrasting with voluntary retirement.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过惩罚性或体制性手段将当事人从职权、地位或宝座上拉下，区别于主动隐退。
groups.nuance_en: downgrade: reduces the systemic rating, priority, or technical status (credit rating / threat / status) · relegate: shifts someone to an inferior division, obscure role, or lower concern (division / role / background) · demote: lowers formal corporate or military rank punitively (officer / employee / rank) · strip of: formally and disgracefully confiscates honors, rank, or titles (titles / rank / assets) · oust: forces out an incumbent from an institutional position (leader / rival / government) · depose: forcefully and officially removes a sovereign ruler from supreme power (king / dictator / president)
groups.nuance_zh: downgrade: 调低技术级别、信用评级或预警等级 (credit rating / threat / status) · relegate: 降至次要联赛、边缘席位或受冷落境地 (division / role / background) · demote: 因过失或纪律惩戒给予行政/军衔降职 (officer / employee / rank) · strip of: 惩罚性地正式剥夺荣誉、军衔或头衔 (titles / rank / assets) · oust: 通过博弈或施压将当权者驱逐下台 (leader / rival / government) · depose: 彻底废黜元首、君主或最高统治者 (king / dictator / president)

groups.name: Dent & Indent · 凹陷与磕碰 (Dent, Dingle, Dimple)
groups.tip: 受冲撞在表面留下凹印

items.def_en: To make a small surface dent or nick in something, especially a motor vehicle
items.ex_en: A stray shopping cart managed to ding the driver's side door.
items.ex_zh: 一辆失控的购物车把驾驶室侧的车门磕出了一个小凹痕。
items.ex2_en: Soft painted car panels ding easily when reckless drivers swing doors open in parking lots.
items.ex2_zh: 在停车场里，当粗心的司机猛推开车门时，柔软的车漆面板很容易被磕瘪。

items.def_en: To make a small depression, notch, or groove in a surface or edge by pressing or striking
items.ex_en: Heavy blows began to indent the protective metallic plating over time.
items.ex_zh: 随着时间的推移，沉重的打击开始在金属防护板上留下凹痕。
items.ex2_en: The soft wooden table edge will indent permanently under the heavy iron clamp.
items.ex2_zh: 柔软的木质桌缘在沉重的铁夹压迫下会留下永久的凹痕。

items.def_en: To make an indentation or cavity inside or upon the surface of something
items.ex_en: Artisans used iron chisels to hollow out the granite stone surface.
items.ex_zh: 工匠们用铁凿在花岗岩石材表面凿出凹窝。
items.ex2_en: Ancient limestone cliffs hollow out slowly after centuries of pounding ocean waves.
items.ex2_zh: 在经历了几个世纪汹涌海浪的拍击后，古老的石灰岩悬崖逐渐凹陷变空。

items.def_zh: 使凹陷，使磕出凹痕；打击，削弱（信心、名誉等）
items.def_en: 1. To make a hollow mark or depression in a hard surface by striking it, or become marked in this way. 2. To damage, diminish, or weaken someone's confidence, pride, or finances.
items.ex_en: Falling hailstones managed to dent the thin hood of the vehicle.
items.ex_zh: 落下的冰雹把车辆单薄的引擎盖砸出了凹坑。
items.ex2_en: Thin aluminum panels will dent easily if dropped from high storage shelves onto concrete floors.
items.ex2_zh: 如果从高高的储物架上掉落到混凝土地面上，薄铝板很容易被砸凹。

items.def_en: To bend, warp, or collapse under the influence of heat, pressure, or impact
items.ex_en: The intense heat caused the steel track to buckle within hours.
items.ex_zh: 剧烈的高温导致钢轨在数小时内严重受压变形。
items.ex2_en: Sudden seismic shocks can buckle thick highway overpass supports during severe earthquakes.
items.ex2_zh: 在强烈地震中，突发的地震冲击波会使厚重的高架桥支撑柱发生弯曲压垮。

items.def_en: To make a deep, rough groove, hole, or depression in a surface by forceful scraping or cutting
items.ex_en: The moving dolly accidentally gouged a deep trench into the hardwood floor.
items.ex_zh: 搬运推车不小心在硬木地板上刮出了一道深痕。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate damaging or altering a firm surface by impacting or pressing it so as to leave a hollow, crease, or indentation without completely perforating it. Typical objects include sheet metal, body panels, woodwork, or hard soil.
groups.summary_zh: 通过撞击、挤压使硬质表面受损产生凹痕或坑洼，未穿透。
groups.desc_en: Describes mechanical deformation where a smooth surface yields inward from an impact without tearing entirely, contrasting with piercing or shattering.
groups.desc_zh: 描绘物体表面受到外力撞击后向内凹陷形变但未完全破碎的物理状态，区别于穿透或粉碎。
groups.nuance_en: ding: causes minor, shallow, noticeable impact blemishes (car door / reputation / fender) · indent: presses inward to create a precise shallow recession or notch (surface / margin / text) · dent: strikes a substantial depression into rigid metal or a subject's confidence (car / armor / pride) · buckle: collapses or crumples irregularly under crushing axial load (knees / bridge / pavement) · gouge: tears out a deep, ragged groove through violent abrasive force (wood / metal / eye)
groups.nuance_zh: ding: 造成轻微碰擦的细小凹痕或微损 (car door / reputation / fender) · indent: 均匀压入形成规则浅坑或缩进 (surface / margin / text) · dent: 撞击硬物形成较深凹坑或重挫自尊心 (car / armor / pride) · buckle: 在轴向重压下发生失稳弯折或扭曲 (knees / bridge / pavement) · gouge: 施加钝器或刮削力剜出深槽或裂痕 (wood / metal / eye)

groups.name: Deny & Repudiate · 否认与驳斥 (Deny, Disown, Repudiate)
groups.tip: 从口头否认到彻底拒不承认

items.def_zh: 收回（先前的言论或主张）
items.def_en: (+ sth) retreat from or retract an earlier statement, claim, or promise
items.ex_en: The minister attempted to walk back his controversial remarks about the tax policy.
items.ex_zh: 这位部长试图收回他关于税收政策的争议性言论。

items.def_zh: 否认，否定；拒绝给予，剥夺
items.def_en: 1. to state that something is not true; to refuse to admit. 2. to refuse to give or allow something to someone.
items.ex_en: The spokesperson firmly denied all allegations of bribery reported by the press.
items.ex_zh: 发言人坚决否认了媒体报道的所有受贿指控。

items.def_zh: 断绝关系，拒不承认（责任或所属）
items.def_en: To declare that one no longer has any connection with, ownership of, or responsibility for something
items.ex_en: The company moved quickly to disown the unauthorized statements made by the employee.
items.ex_zh: 该公司迅速采取行动，拒不承认该员工发表的未经授权言论。

items.def_zh: 拒不承认，声明与……断绝关系
items.def_en: To deny any responsibility for, knowledge of, or association with an act or claim
items.ex_en: The administration hastened to disavow any prior knowledge of the covert operation.
items.ex_zh: 政府急忙声明对该秘密行动事先毫不知情。

items.def_zh: 否认，驳斥；拒绝承认；声明断绝关系；拒不履行（债务等）
items.def_en: (formal) to refuse to accept, acknowledge, or obey something; to deny the truth or validity of something
items.ex_en: The newly elected government decided to repudiate the foreign debts incurred previously.
items.ex_zh: 新当选的政府决定拒绝承认之前欠下的外债。

items.def_en: To forcefully deny a statement or demonstrate that an accusation is untrue
items.ex_en: The defense attorney presented solid forensic evidence to refute the prosecution's charges.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师出示了确凿的法医证据，以驳斥控方的指控。

groups.summary_en: A speaker rejects an assertion, accusation, or responsibility. Intensity progresses from straightforward negation of factual truth ('deny') to complete, aggressive rejection of allegiance, obligation, or validity ('repudiate', 'disavow').
groups.summary_zh: 全盘否认指控、事实，或断然拒绝承认某种关系、责任与正当性。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on explicitly rejecting assertions of truth, disowning allegations, or severing moral association, contrasting with indifferent silence.
groups.desc_zh: 强调以公开言行断然否认指控真实性、割席撇清干系或彻底驳斥，区别于消极沉默。
groups.nuance_en: walk back: retreats incrementally from a previous indiscreet statement (claim / comments / rhetoric) · deny: asserts that an allegation, request, or fact is untrue or withheld (allegations / access / reality) · disown: renounces all familial, legal, or moral connection to someone/something (child / past / heritage) · disavow: explicitly denies responsibility, approval, or prior knowledge of an act (statement / knowledge / link) · repudiate: rejects doctrine, debts, or validity with categorical moral finality (doctrine / debt / agreement) · refute: proves an accusation or thesis systematically wrong with decisive evidence (allegation / theory / argument)
groups.nuance_zh: walk back: 悄悄收回或逐步降温此前的不当言辞 (claim / comments / rhetoric) · deny: 矢口否认指控为真，或拒绝批准请求 (allegations / access / reality) · disown: 决绝登报或宣示断绝亲缘或法理关联 (child / past / heritage) · disavow: 公开澄清与某行为毫无瓜葛或声明不予背书 (statement / knowledge / link) · repudiate: 从根本上全盘拒斥、废弃条约或拒绝认账 (doctrine / debt / agreement) · refute: 摆出铁证从逻辑上严密驳倒谬论 (allegation / theory / argument)

groups.name: Deploy & Station · 调配与部署 (Station, Position, Marshal)
groups.tip: 军事或组织层面的力量配置

items.def_en: To send someone to a particular place to work, especially as a soldier, guard, or official.
items.ex_en: The military decided to post extra guards along the sensitive northern frontier.
items.ex_zh: 军方决定在敏感的北部边境增派哨兵驻守。

items.def_en: To put someone or something carefully into a specific strategic or functional location.
items.ex_en: Officers carefully positioned their surveillance vehicles around all exits of the warehouse.
items.ex_zh: 警官们谨慎地将监控车辆布置在仓库的所有出口周围。

items.def_en: To assign military personnel, police, or guards to a particular place or post for a period of duty.
items.ex_en: The peacekeeping force was stationed in the buffer zone for twelve months.
items.ex_zh: 维和部队被派驻在缓冲区执行了为期十二个月的任务。

items.def_en: 1. To position troops or military equipment systematically over an area for battle. 2. To organize and use resources, skills, or arguments effectively.
items.ex_en: The commander ordered the army to deploy missile batteries across the ridge.
items.ex_zh: 指挥官下令军队沿山脊部署导弹连。

items.def_en: To advance into a designated area to take control, intervene, or establish an active presence.
items.ex_en: Riot police began to move in as the crowd breached the barricades.
items.ex_zh: 随着人群冲破路障，防暴警察开始向前推进包围。

items.def_en: To gather together people, facts, or resources and organize them systematically for a common purpose.
items.ex_en: The campaign manager worked tirelessly to marshal local resources for the election.
items.ex_zh: 竞选经理不知疲倦地统筹召集地方资源以迎接选举。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the systematic positioning, distribution, and utilization of personnel, military forces, or organizational assets. 'Deploy' implies readiness for active combat or strategic execution, whereas 'station' and 'post' focus on assigned locations, and 'marshal' emphasizes assembling scattered resources.
groups.summary_zh: 指将人员、兵力或物资系统性地分派、布设至特定战术位置。
groups.desc_en: Involves moving tactical units or assets deliberately into optimized spatial readiness for operational execution, contrasting with random distribution.
groups.desc_zh: 指按照战略意图将战术人员或设备调配至最佳战备阵位，区别于随机停放或散落分布。
groups.nuance_en: post: assigns an individual sentinel or officer to a specific physical post (guard / sentry / lookouts) · position: arranges units deliberately for optimal tactical advantage (troops / artillery / assets) · station: places personnel permanently or for extended duty at a designated base (forces / garrison / guards) · deploy: spreads out operational resources functionally to an active combat or field sector (troops / software / capital) · marshal: organizes and aligns dispersed forces or arguments systematically before action (forces / evidence / support)
groups.nuance_zh: post: 指派哨兵或警卫坚守具体点位 (guard / sentry / lookouts) · position: 为谋求战术优势而精密摆布阵型 (troops / artillery / assets) · station: 驻防或长期布设于某军事基地或据点 (forces / garrison / guards) · deploy: 将部队、软件或资源投放到前线阵地展开实战 (troops / software / capital) · marshal: 汇聚并统整各方散兵或论据准备发动攻势 (forces / evidence / support)

groups.name: Descend Rapidly & Swoop · 俯冲与猛扑 (Swoop, Dive, Pounce)
groups.tip: 自高处猛然俯冲扑击

items.def_en: To plunge downward steep and fast through the air
items.ex_en: The fighter jet suddenly dove out of the clouds to evade radar.
items.ex_zh: 那架战斗机突然穿出云层向下俯冲以躲避雷达。

items.def_zh: 俯冲急下；机头向下猛冲
items.def_en: To drop nose-first vertically through the air toward the ground
items.ex_en: The damaged drone began to nose-dive directly toward the empty cornfield.
items.ex_zh: 那架受损的无人机开始头朝下直冲向空旷的玉米地。

items.def_en: 1. (of a bird, plane, etc.) To fly or move rapidly downward through the air. 2. To make a sudden attack or raid.
items.ex_en: A hungry hawk suddenly swooped down from the treetops to catch a field mouse.
items.ex_zh: 一只饥饿的老鹰突然从树梢向下俯冲，抓起了一只田鼠。

items.def_en: (of a hawk or falcon) To dive headlong toward prey during flight
items.ex_en: The peregrine falcon stooped at incredible speed to intercept the flying pigeon.
items.ex_zh: 那只游隼以惊人的速度猛烈俯冲，在空中拦截飞翔的鸽子。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To leap or dive suddenly upon prey or an adversary to seize them
items.ex_en: The leopard crouched quietly in the brush before pouncing on the unsuspecting antelope.
items.ex_zh: 猎豹静静潜伏在灌木丛中，随后猛扑向毫无防备的羚羊。

items.def_en: To fall or drop straight down at very high speed
items.ex_en: A loose boulder dislodged from the cliff edge and plummeted into the ravine.
items.ex_zh: 一块松动的巨石从悬崖边缘脱落，笔直坠入峡谷。

groups.summary_en: This motion frame captures sudden, aggressive, or breathtaking airborne descents toward a target, typically by birds of prey, fighter aircraft, or predatory animals.
groups.summary_zh: 描述猛禽、战机或猎手自上而下凌空极速冲降并突袭扑击。
groups.desc_en: Depicts high-speed, controlled aerodynamic plunges downward through space, typically culminating in an attack or abrupt impact, contrasting with passive drifting.
groups.desc_zh: 描绘从高空发起极速且具有攻击性的精准俯冲运动，强调下坠动量，区别于被动飘落。
groups.nuance_en: dive: pitches steeply downward through air or water with sharp momentum (airplane / bird / submarine) · nose-dive: descends steeply headfirst, especially in catastrophic market or trajectory failure (profits / plane / popularity) · swoop: sweeps downward smoothly in a curved predatory arc (bird / eagle / police) · pounce: springs forward and downward abruptly onto an unsuspecting prey or blunder (prey / opportunity / mistake) · plummet: drops vertically down at dizzying, uncontrollable gravitational speed (temperatures / shares / elevator)
groups.nuance_zh: dive: 沿陡峭角度直插空中或水中 (airplane / bird / submarine) · nose-dive: 倒栽葱式俯冲，尤指数据或行情的暴跌 (profits / plane / popularity) · swoop: 划出凌厉弧线自上而下顺畅俯冲扑击 (bird / eagle / police) · pounce: 猛扑向猎物，或迅即抓住漏洞发难 (prey / opportunity / mistake) · plummet: 如铅坠般毫无缓冲地做垂直绝壁暴跌 (temperatures / shares / elevator)

groups.name: Deserve & Merit · 应得与配得 (Merit, Warrant, Earn)
groups.tip: 凭功过理应承受对待

items.def_en: To be considered worthy of a particular kind of treatment or status
items.ex_en: His outstanding contributions certainly rate a permanent mention in the company’s history.
items.ex_zh: 他的杰出贡献当然够格在公司历史上永久占有一席之地。

items.def_zh: 博得，赢得，招致（赞誉、惩罚等）
items.def_en: To get something that you deserve because of your work, qualities, or behavior
items.ex_en: Her dedicated work on the community project earned the widespread respect of residents.
items.ex_zh: 她在社区项目上的奉献工作赢得了居民们的广泛尊重。

items.raw_cluster: 应得与配得上 Deserve & Merit
items.def_en: To earn something or be worthy of it because of your actions, qualities, or situation.
items.ex_en: Everyone who contributed to this breakthrough deserves full recognition for their efforts.
items.ex_zh: 每一位为这项突破做出贡献的人，其努力都值得充分认可。

items.def_zh: 使有必要；值得（采取某种行动）
items.def_en: To make a particular action, reaction, or measure necessary, justified, or appropriate
items.ex_en: The emerging security threat does not warrant such an extreme military intervention.
items.ex_zh: 这一新出现的安全威胁并不值得采取如此极端的军事干预。

items.def_en: To deserve what bad happens to you because of your previous foolish or hostile behavior
items.ex_en: After constantly mocking his rivals, he really had that humiliating defeat coming.
items.ex_zh: 在不断嘲弄对手之后，他遭遇这场奇耻大辱纯属咎由自取。

items.def_en: To be worthy of or deserve praise, attention, or punishment because of qualities or actions
items.ex_en: This preliminary proposal is promising and certainly merits further consideration by directors.
items.ex_zh: 这份初步方案很有前景，当然值得董事们作进一步考虑。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe being entitled to, worthy of, or justly receiving a particular outcome, reaction, or reward based on actions or intrinsic qualities. While 'merit' and 'warrant' lean toward formal justification, 'earn' emphasizes effort and direct causation.
groups.summary_zh: 表示基于行为、资历或本质而应得、配得或理应受到某种对待与评价。
groups.desc_en: Relates moral, legal, or qualitative entitlement between an entity's intrinsic deeds and the outcome due to them, contrasting with arbitrarily receiving windfall.
groups.desc_zh: 指主体的内在行为或品质与所获际遇之间的必然因果相称性，强调‘实至名归’，区别于偶然侥幸获得。
groups.nuance_en: rate: qualifies objectively as worthy of a specified level of regard (mention / priority / notice) · earn: gains legitimate right to a reward through hard sweat or demonstrated merit (respect / living / trust) · deserve: holds an undeniable moral or retributive entitlement to an outcome, good or bad (praise / punishment / break) · warrant: calls for or justifies an action as appropriate, necessary, or proportionate (investigation / attention / arrest) · merit: displays an intrinsic, admirable excellence that inherently justifies reward (award / consideration / reward)
groups.nuance_zh: rate: 客观上够资格排入某档次或获得关注 (mention / priority / notice) · earn: 凭汗水或过硬本领实打实挣得报酬与认可 (respect / living / trust) · deserve: 依照行为业报理应受此对待（褒贬皆可） (praise / punishment / break) · warrant: 事态本身的严重性使后续措施显得完全正当必要 (investigation / attention / arrest) · merit: 凭内在卓越价值理应享受奖赏或考量 (award / consideration / reward)

groups.name: Design & Devise · 规划设计与策划 (Conceive, Formulate, Mastermind)
groups.tip: 工程化设计与方案构想

items.def_en: 1. To design, build, or modify something using scientific or engineering methods. 2. To skillfully arrange or bring about a result, often secretly.
items.ex_en: The senior diplomats managed to engineer a fragile truce between the warring parties.
items.ex_zh: 资深外交官们设法在交战双方之间促成了一场脆弱的休战。

items.def_en: To invent an excuse, story, or ingenious scheme, often dishonestly
items.ex_en: He had to cook up an excuse for being late to the morning briefing.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不编造一个早会迟到的借口。

items.def_en: To plan or arrange an operational sequence or itinerary in complete detail
items.ex_en: The committee met to map out a clear strategy for the next five years.
items.ex_zh: 委员会开会为接下来的五年详细制定了清晰的战略规划。

items.def_zh: 构想出；设计出（方案/装置）
items.def_en: To invent or plan a complex mechanism, system, or strategy with skill
items.ex_en: Engineers worked overtime to devise a clever filtration system for the plant.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们加班加点，为工厂设计出了一套巧妙的过滤系统。

items.def_en: To systematically develop a policy, concept, or elaborate strategy
items.ex_en: The task force will meet tomorrow to formulate a comprehensive cybersecurity strategy.
items.ex_zh: 特别工作组将于明天开会，制定一项全面的网络安全战略。

items.def_en: To plan and direct the execution of an intricate project or scheme
items.ex_en: Federal agents arrested the operative who had masterminded the massive cyber heist.
items.ex_zh: 联邦特工逮捕了幕后操纵那起大规模网络窃案的操盘手。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote strategically originating, structuring, and engineering complex systems, blueprints, plans, or outcomes through ingenuity.
groups.summary_zh: 指运用专业技术或谋略构想、策划并建构复杂系统或方案。
groups.desc_en: Cognitively crafting complex, goal-oriented structural blueprints or calculated strategies, distinct from mere spontaneous inventing by emphasizing systematic architecture and intentional execution.
groups.desc_zh: 认知层面对复杂目标导向蓝图或精算策略的系统构建，与随性发明不同，强调严密的架构策划与执行心机。
groups.nuance_en: engineer: strategically manipulate or structurally orchestrate (coup / deal / turnaround) · cook up: concoct questionable or fabricated schemes (excuse / story / scheme) · map out: chart a comprehensive step-by-step course (route / career / strategy) · devise: inventively formulate a clever mechanism or plan (method / plot / system) · formulate: systematically articulate formal principles or policy (policy / theory / plan) · mastermind: direct and orchestrate a complex operation from behind the scenes (heist / plot / campaign)
groups.nuance_zh: engineer: 巧妙策动或精心构建 (coup / deal / turnaround) · cook up: 编造或密谋不正当计策 (excuse / story / scheme) · map out: 详尽规划步骤路径 (route / career / strategy) · devise: 巧妙构想出机制或办法 (method / plot / system) · formulate: 系统性阐述或拟定 (policy / theory / plan) · mastermind: 幕后操纵策划大案 (heist / plot / campaign)

groups.name: Design & Devise · 赋予风格与定调 (Style, Brand, Tailor)
groups.tip: 设定基调设计整体布局

items.def_en: To design, shape, or decorate something according to an aesthetic fashion or motif
items.ex_en: The architects styled the grand hotel lobby after classical Mediterranean villas.
items.ex_zh: 建筑师们参照古典地中海别墅的风格对宏伟的酒店大堂进行了造型设计。

items.def_zh: 以……为主题，按特定主题设计
items.def_en: To design or decorate something according to a particular theme, motif, or style.
items.ex_en: The developers themed the entire amusement park around ancient mythical creatures.
items.ex_zh: 开发商以古代神话生物为主题设计了整座游乐园。

items.def_zh: 使导向；按某种格调定位
items.def_en: (+ towards/to) To design or align an experience or space around a core characteristic
items.ex_en: The gallery carefully oriented its interior lighting toward highlighting modern sculptures.
items.ex_zh: 美术馆精心调节了室内照明，以突出展示现代雕塑作品。

items.def_en: (+ to/for) To adapt or design something specifically to suit distinct tastes or themes
items.ex_en: The boutique firm tailors wealth management strategies specifically for foreign investors.
items.ex_zh: 这家精品机构专门为外国投资者量身定制财富管理方案。

items.def_en: To decorate, fit out, or garnish something elaborately in a specific thematic style
items.ex_en: He spent thousands of dollars to trick out his vintage truck with neon.
items.ex_zh: 他花了好几千美元用霓虹灯将自己的老式皮卡特装得花里胡哨。

items.def_zh: 树立品牌形象；赋予品牌风格
items.def_en: To design an entity or product with distinctive marks, motifs, and identity
items.ex_en: The agency helped brand the new beverage line as an eco-friendly alternative.
items.ex_zh: 该机构帮助将新饮料系列塑造成环保替代品的品牌形象。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to shaping, styling, or adorning an environment, product, or presentation to conform to an aesthetic motif, identity, or demographic.
groups.summary_zh: 指依据特定的美学主题、风格或既定形象来设计装点事物。
groups.desc_en: Deliberately imparting a distinct aesthetic identity, custom fit, or thematic tone to an entity, contrasting with functional manufacturing by focusing on perceptual and stylistic alignment.
groups.desc_zh: 刻意赋予实体特定的美学标识、定制规格或基调定位，与基础加工不同，强调风格塑造与受众契合度。
groups.nuance_en: style: fashion or shape aesthetically (hair / collection / interior) · theme: unify around a central motif (event / park / party) · orient: align toward a specific target demographic or purpose (business / strategy / product) · tailor: adapt precisely to fit specific needs (course / treatment / resume) · trick out: lavishly or ostentatiously customize (car / rig / gear) · brand: imprint with a recognized commercial or ideological identity (product / image / politician)
groups.nuance_zh: style: 造型设计或做美学修饰 (hair / collection / interior) · theme: 围绕特定主题统一部调 (event / park / party) · orient: 定位朝向特定受众或目标 (business / strategy / product) · tailor: 针对特定需求量身定制 (course / treatment / resume) · trick out: 炫酷改装或盛装打扮 (car / rig / gear) · brand: 树立商业或公众品牌形象 (product / image / politician)

groups.name: Designate Title & Style Nominally · 赐名与加封头衔 (Title, Style, Dub)
groups.tip: 赋予名称、称号或特定头衔

items.def_zh: 给……加标题，定题目；授予头衔
items.def_en: to give a title to a book, movie, work of art, or person
items.ex_en: She decided to title her upcoming documentary after an old folk ballad.
items.ex_zh: 她决定用一首古老民谣的名字来为她即将上映的纪录片定名。

items.def_zh: 称呼，命名；设计，使具有某种风格
items.def_en: 1. to designate, name, or address someone or something by a particular title or term. 2. to design or fashion something in a particular way.
items.ex_en: The ambitious tribal leader styled himself the sovereign ruler of the territory.
items.ex_zh: 这位野心勃勃的部落领袖自称为该领地的最高统治者。

items.def_en: to give a specific title to a book, article, law, or piece of art
items.ex_en: The author chose to entitle his extensive political memoir 'The Final Accord'.
items.ex_zh: 作者选择将他那部篇幅宏大的政治回忆录定名为《最终协定》。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) give an entity or child the same name or honorific as someone or something else
items.ex_en: She was named after her grandmother, who had passed away the year before.
items.ex_zh: 她是用她祖母的名字命名的，祖母在前一年去世了。

items.def_en: (+ as/obj.) to bestow a name, honorary title, or nickname informally or ceremonially upon someone
items.ex_en: Local sports journalists quickly dubbed the fast young striker 'The Flash'.
items.ex_zh: 当地体育记者迅速给这位速度飞快的前锋小将起了个“闪电”的绰号。

items.def_en: to give a baby or vessel a name at a ceremony, or to name someone metaphorically
items.ex_en: The naval admiral officially christened the newly commissioned destroyer yesterday morning.
items.ex_zh: 海军上将昨天上午正式为这艘新服役的驱逐舰命名洗礼。

groups.summary_en: People or official bodies assign a distinctive formal honorific, book name, or descriptive epithet to an entity or dignitary.
groups.summary_zh: 为作品命名，或正式授予、以特定官方头衔/称号称呼某人。
groups.desc_en: Formally or colloquially bestowing an honorary, functional, or descriptive designation onto an entity, differing from ordinary referential naming through ceremonial authority or playful characterization.
groups.desc_zh: 正式或通俗地授予实体荣誉性、职务性或描述性称谓，与普通命名不同，强调仪式权威或形象定性。
groups.nuance_en: title: confer an official book, rank, or formal name upon (book / essay / heir) · style: formally designator or address oneself/another by a specific title (himself / monarch / state) · entitle: grant a legal or designated heading/right (novel / chapter / poem) · name after: honor an antecedent by bestowing their moniker (relative / hero / mentor) · dub: colloquially or honorarily assign a moniker (city / hero / villain) · christen: ceremonially name or inaugurate (baby / ship / bridge)
groups.nuance_zh: title: 赋予正式名称或头衔 (book / essay / heir) · style: 自称或尊称为某特定头衔 (himself / monarch / state) · entitle: 正式定名文稿或赋权 (novel / chapter / poem) · name after: 为纪念某人而命名 (relative / hero / mentor) · dub: 戏谑或公众册封绰号 (city / hero / villain) · christen: 行洗礼命名或启用仪式 (baby / ship / bridge)

groups.name: Detach & Sever · 分离与脱钩 (Uncouple, Disconnect, Sever)
groups.tip: 从整体上拆卸并剥离

items.def_zh: 拆下，分离，分开；使脱离，摆脱
items.def_en: 1. To separate or remove something from something larger that it is attached to. 2. (detach oneself) To distance oneself emotionally or mentally.
items.ex_en: Please detach the completed coupon from the booklet before mailing it back.
items.ex_zh: 在将填好的优惠券寄回之前，请先从手册上撕下。
items.ex2_en: The adhesive label will detach cleanly if you warm it with a hair dryer.
items.ex2_zh: 如果你用吹风机稍微加热，不干胶标签就会干净利落地脱落下来。

items.def_en: To unfasten, unplug, or break the connection between two joined objects or systems
items.ex_en: Make sure to disconnect the appliance from the power socket before cleaning.
items.ex_zh: 在清洁之前，务必先将电器的电源插头从插座上断开。
items.ex2_en: The old home wireless router tends to disconnect suddenly during heavy electrical rainstorms.
items.ex2_zh: 在雷雨大作的天气里，老旧的家用无线路由器往往会突然断开连接。

items.def_en: To completely cut through an object or violently end a relationship/connection
items.ex_en: The country abruptly decided to sever all diplomatic ties with its neighbor.
items.ex_zh: 该国突然决定彻底断绝与其邻国的一切外交关系。

items.def_en: To free something from a mechanism that holds or interlocks it, or to pull back from contact
items.ex_en: The driver must depress the clutch pedal to disengage the engine gears.
items.ex_zh: 驾驶员必须踩下离合器踏板以使发动机齿轮脱开啮合。
items.ex2_en: The rusty metal latch will disengage smoothly once you spray a little lubricant on it.
items.ex2_zh: 一旦你在生锈的金属插销上喷少许润滑剂，它就会顺畅地脱开。

items.def_en: To disconnect two things that are linked or hitched together, such as rail carriages
items.ex_en: Railroad workers had to uncouple the damaged freight car from the train.
items.ex_zh: 铁路工人不得不把受损的货运车厢从列车上解钩分离。
items.ex2_en: The rear rail cars uncouple smoothly whenever technicians operate the automatic release lever.
items.ex2_zh: 每当技术人员操作自动释放杆时，后部的列车车厢就会顺利解钩。

items.def_en: To release or open something that is fixed closed by a clasp, buckle, or clip
items.ex_en: Flight attendants reminded all passengers not to unfasten their seatbelts yet.
items.ex_zh: 乘务员提醒所有乘客暂时不要解开安全带。
items.ex2_en: Her loose vintage bracelet tended to unfasten spontaneously during energetic evening dance routines.
items.ex2_zh: 在欢快激烈的晚间舞蹈动作中，她那松散的复古手镯往往会自行松开。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail the deliberate physical unfastening, disengaging, or slicing apart of an object from another to which it was joined. They range from clicking something loose to permanently severing bonds.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重将原本相连、系牢的事物解开脱离，或将其决绝切断。
groups.desc_en: Breaking physical or structural continuity between linked components, distinct from total annihilation by leaving the constituent parts intact after separation.
groups.desc_zh: 断开相连组件之间的物理或结构连续性，与彻底毁坏不同，断开后各部分本身仍保持相对完整。
groups.nuance_en: detach: separate a connected part while preserving both units (retina / coupon / trailer) · disconnect: terminate physical, functional, or electrical linkage (power / hose / phone) · sever: violently or decisively cut through a continuum (cord / ties / head) · disengage: smoothly release interlocking operational components (clutch / gears / troops) · uncouple: release an explicit structural link between paired units (railcars / carriages / wagons) · unfasten: undo a mechanical latch, clasp, or binding (belt / latch / button)
groups.nuance_zh: detach: 拆卸或脱离附着物 (retina / coupon / trailer) · disconnect: 切断物理、功能或电气回路 (power / hose / phone) · sever: 决绝割断或彻底切断 (cord / ties / head) · disengage: 解除啮合或平稳撤离 (clutch / gears / troops) · uncouple: 脱开挂钩或成对连接 (railcars / carriages / wagons) · unfasten: 解开卡扣、纽扣或紧固件 (belt / latch / button)

groups.name: Deteriorate & Degrade · 恶化与衰败 (Decline, Decouple, Atrophy)
groups.tip: 品质降级每况愈下

items.def_en: To disintegrate, decompose chemically, or fail structurally
