items.ex_en: Natural soil microbes gradually break down fallen leaves into rich nutrient matter.
items.ex_zh: 天然土壤微生物会逐渐将落叶分解为丰富的营养物质。
items.ex2_en: Biodegradable paper packaging will break down naturally within a few months in compost piles.
items.ex2_zh: 可降解纸包装在堆肥堆中几个月内就会自然分解完毕。

items.def_en: To rot or decompose through natural organic or societal processes
items.ex_en: Untreated timber left in damp basements will eventually decay from excessive moisture.
items.ex_zh: 留在潮湿地下室里未经处理的木材最终会因过度潮湿而腐烂。
items.ex2_en: Acidic industrial emissions continuously decay ancient architectural limestone sculptures throughout the historic district.
items.ex2_zh: 酸性工业排放物不断侵蚀着整个历史街区中那些古老的石灰岩建筑雕塑。

items.def_en: To undergo chemical breakdown and decay, especially organic material
items.ex_en: Unpicked apples fell from the branches and began to rot quietly underneath.
items.ex_zh: 未被采摘的苹果从树枝跌落，在树下悄悄地腐烂起来。
items.ex2_en: Humid summer conditions rot harvested berries quickly if farmers do not refrigerate them promptly.
items.ex2_zh: 如果果农不及时冷藏，潮湿的夏季气候会很快使采收的浆果腐烂。

items.def_zh: （使）降解，（使）变质退化；贬低，羞辱；使降职
items.def_en: 1. To deteriorate in quality, or break down chemically in the environment. 2. To treat someone with disrespect, causing them to lose dignity or self-respect.
items.ex_en: Discarded plastic packaging can take hundreds of years to degrade completely outdoors.
items.ex_zh: 废弃的塑料包装在户外可能需要数百年时间才能完全降解。

items.def_en: To become progressively worse in quality, condition, or health
items.ex_en: The patient's clinical condition began to deteriorate rapidly during the night.
items.ex_zh: 该病人的临床状况在夜间开始迅速恶化。

items.def_en: To decline to an inferior, immoral, or less evolved state
items.ex_en: What began as a peaceful debate soon degenerated into an angry brawl.
items.ex_zh: 最初的一场和平辩论很快蜕变成了一场愤怒的混战。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail progressive structural, functional, or biological decay and the loss of inherent quality or integrity over time. They describe physical erosion, biological decomposition, or systemic rot.
groups.summary_zh: 事物质量、机能或结构随时间逐步衰退、破损或分解。
groups.desc_en: Progressively declining in physical integrity, organizational order, or moral quality, contrasting with sudden destruction by emphasizing gradual internal breakdown and entropy.
groups.desc_zh: 物理完整度、组织秩序或道德品质的渐进式退化，与突发毁灭不同，强调内在缓慢的耗损、衰败与熵增。
groups.nuance_en: break down: lose functional integrity or split chemically (engine / communication / barrier) · decay: undergo biological decomposition or institutional rotting (teeth / wood / empire) · rot: spoil through microbial putrefaction or neglected stagnation (fruit / timber / flesh) · degrade: experience systemic descent in grade, quality, or environment (soil / polymer / status) · deteriorate: suffer steady worsenings in condition or health (health / weather / relations) · degenerate: sink to an inferior, corrupted, or debased state (discourse / cell / condition)
groups.nuance_zh: break down: 功能瘫痪或结构分解 (engine / communication / barrier) · decay: 缓慢生物分解或机制衰朽 (teeth / wood / empire) · rot: 腐烂腐败或闲置荒废 (fruit / timber / flesh) · degrade: 质量降级或生态降解 (soil / polymer / status) · deteriorate: 状况、健康等持续恶化 (health / weather / relations) · degenerate: 退化沦落至更低劣状态 (discourse / cell / condition)

groups.name: Detox & Purify · 排毒与净化 (Cleanse, Purge, Flush out)
groups.tip: 清除体内毒素恢复生理洁净

items.def_en: To cleanse the body or an organ by drinking copious fluids to carry away toxins and impurities
items.ex_en: Doctors advised him to drink plenty of warm water to flush out impurities.
items.ex_zh: 医生建议他多喝温水以冲洗排出体内的杂质。

items.def_zh: 通过出汗排出（毒素/感冒）
items.def_en: To get rid of a toxin, cold, or illness by sweating profusely through exercise, heat, or sauna
items.ex_en: He spent an hour in the cedar sauna trying to sweat out his fever.
items.ex_zh: 他在雪松木桑拿房里呆了一个小时，试图通过大量出汗把热度发出来。

items.def_en: To purify or free bodily fluids or organic matter from impurities or impurities
items.ex_en: The traditional remedy was believed to depurate the blood of noxious humors.
items.ex_zh: 人们相信这种传统疗法能净化血液，清除其中的有害毒素。

items.def_en: To rid the body, skin, or an organ of dirt, toxins, or waste products, often through washing or special dietary regimens
items.ex_en: She adopted a raw-juice regimen to cleanse her digestive system completely.
items.ex_zh: 她采用了一种纯生果汁疗法来彻底排毒净化消化系统。

items.def_zh: 通便；催吐清肠；清除（毒素）
items.def_en: To clear the digestive system thoroughly using laxatives or emetics, or to rid the body entirely of unwanted substances
items.ex_en: Patients take specialized medication to purge their bowels thoroughly before the colonoscopy.
items.ex_zh: 患者在接受结肠镜检查前需服用专用药物以彻底清肠通便。

items.def_zh: 排毒，接受戒毒（或戒酒）治疗
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To undergo medical treatment or follow a diet to rid the body of alcohol, drugs, or toxic substances.
items.ex_en: The rock star entered a private clinic to detox from prescription pills.
items.ex_zh: 这位摇滚明星住进了一家私立诊所，以戒除处方药依赖。

groups.summary_en: Refers to ridding the physical body, organs, or an environment of toxic substances, impurities, or metabolic waste. While 'detox' often centers on abstaining from harmful substances or metabolic cleansing, verbs like 'purge' and 'flush out' emphasize aggressive evacuation or dilution.
groups.summary_zh: 指清除体内毒素、杂质或废物的生理净化过程。
groups.desc_en: Eliminating toxic, impure, or superfluous elements from a biological or metaphorical vessel, contrasting with surface washing by targeting deep-seated, systemic contamination.
groups.desc_zh: 从机体或隐喻容器中系统性清除有毒、不纯或冗余成分，与表层冲洗不同，强调消除深层体内污染。
groups.nuance_en: flush out: force impurities or hidden entities out with flow (toxins / system / impurities) · sweat out: expel through perspiration or endure anxiously to completion (fever / alcohol / toxin) · depurate: rigorously purify or clear of impurities medicinally (blood / wound / water) · cleanse: thoroughly purify physically, spiritually, or cosmetically (wound / soul / skin) · purge: violently or drastically eliminate unwanted elements (ranks / bowels / sins) · detox: systematically abstain from or metabolize systemic toxins (body / liver / patient)
groups.nuance_zh: flush out: 借水流冲出排尽毒素 (toxins / system / impurities) · sweat out: 出汗排毒或焦灼熬过 (fever / alcohol / toxin) · depurate: 医药化提纯排杂 (blood / wound / water) · cleanse: 深度物理清洁或净化心灵 (wound / soul / skin) · purge: 强力排空清洗或政治清洗 (ranks / bowels / sins) · detox: 系统戒毒或解毒排毒 (body / liver / patient)

groups.name: Devalue & Depreciate · 贬值与缩水 (Depreciate, Cheapen, Discount)
groups.tip: 等级地位下滑或资产价值缩水

items.def_en: To reduce the original price of goods, or to regard a statement as worth little credence.
items.ex_en: Retailers routinely discount old winter stock to clear shelf space for spring.
items.ex_zh: 零售商通常会对冬季旧库存打折处理，为春装腾出货架空间。

items.def_en: To diminish gradually in price, value, magnitude, or support.
items.ex_en: Consumer demand for the luxury car began to fall away after taxes rose.
items.ex_zh: 加税之后，消费者对这款豪车的需求开始逐渐萎缩。

items.def_en: To officially reduce the recognized book value of an asset on a financial balance sheet.
items.ex_en: The commercial bank was forced to write down billions in bad property loans.
items.ex_zh: 该商业银行被迫将数十亿不良房地产贷款进行资产减记。

items.def_zh: 使贬值，贬值；降低……的价值（或重要性）
items.def_en: 1. To reduce the official value of a currency in relation to other currencies, or to lose value in this way. 2. To diminish the worth, quality, or importance of something.
items.ex_en: The central bank decided to devalue the currency to stimulate export growth.
items.ex_zh: 央行决定让本国货币贬值，以刺激出口增长。
items.ex2_en: The national currency devalued sharply following the announcement of sudden trade sanctions.
items.ex2_zh: 在宣布突发贸易制裁后，本国货币大幅贬值。

items.def_en: To decrease in financial value over time, or to reduce the recorded accounting value of an asset.
items.ex_en: New commercial vehicles typically depreciate rapidly during their first two operating years.
items.ex_zh: 新商用车在投入运营的前两年通常贬值极快。
items.ex2_en: Economic recessions depreciated commercial properties across metropolitan business centers within just twelve short months.
items.ex2_zh: 在短短十二个月内，经济衰退就使大都市商业中心的商业地产大幅贬值。

items.def_en: To reduce the price, monetary worth, or moral/artistic dignity of something.
items.ex_en: Tacky billboard advertisements completely cheapened the historic ambiance of the boulevard.
items.ex_zh: 俗气的广告牌彻底贬损了这条林荫大道原有的历史格调。
items.ex2_en: Massive overproduction of cheap goods caused fine craftsmanship to cheapen rapidly across the retail market.
items.ex2_zh: 廉价商品的大规模过剩生产导致零售市场上的精细工艺品价值迅速缩水贬值。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the reduction in financial worth, purchasing power, market exchange value, or perceived significance. While 'devalue' specifically describes government-mandated currency reductions or intentional belittling, 'depreciate' covers spontaneous market wear or economic loss over time.
groups.summary_zh: 指货币、资产在市场或官方层面出现价值下跌或无形折旧。
groups.desc_en: Diminishing financial value, intrinsic merit, or external respect, contrasting with natural decay by focusing on quantified or perceptual devaluation in an exchange system.
groups.desc_zh: 降低资产金融价值、内在成色或外界尊重度，与自然衰朽不同，强调交换体系中的定量贬值或贬损评价。
groups.nuance_en: discount: deduct monetary value or minimize credibility (price / threat / theory) · fall away: steadily decline in volume, value, or support (support / demand / value) · write down: reduce the recognized book value of an asset (debt / asset / stock) · devalue: officially or perceptually reduce worth/currency parity (currency / degree / contribution) · depreciate: decline over time in monetary worth or disparage merits (capital / asset / currency) · cheapen: degrade intrinsic dignity, status, or aesthetic quality (reputation / debate / product)
groups.nuance_zh: discount: 折价或看轻忽视 (price / threat / theory) · fall away: 价值、支持度逐步萎缩 (support / demand / value) · write down: 会计核算账面减值 (debt / asset / stock) · devalue: 官方宣布货币贬值或贬低贡献 (currency / degree / contribution) · depreciate: 随时间折旧或贬损价值 (capital / asset / currency) · cheapen: 降低格调品味或廉价化 (reputation / debate / product)

groups.name: Devote & Dedicate · 奉献与投入 (Dedicate, Consecrate, Pedge)
groups.tip: 将时间与精力全身心投入

items.def_en: (+ to) To give all of one's time, energy, or efforts completely to a specific noble purpose
items.ex_en: The scientist chose to dedicate her entire life to developing affordable cancer treatments.
items.ex_zh: 这位科学家选择将自己的一生完全奉献给开发平价癌症疗法。

items.def_en: (+ to) To commit resources, time, or self-effort exclusively to a designated person or pursuit
items.ex_en: The foundation chose to devote substantial resources to eradicating rare tropical diseases.
items.ex_zh: 该基金会决定倾注大量资源用于消灭罕见的热带疾病。

items.def_en: To formally bind oneself or commit resources to support a cause or endeavor
items.ex_en: The delegation pledged millions of dollars to support international famine relief efforts.
items.ex_zh: 代表团誓言捐助数百万美元，以支持国际饥荒救济工作。

items.def_en: (+ to) To surrender or dedicate one's entire time, thought, or activities to a focus
items.ex_en: He had given over his twilight years to solitary communion with the sea.
items.ex_zh: 他将自己的垂暮之年完全寄托于与大海的孤独相伴中。

items.def_en: (+ to) To solemnly set apart or dedicate someone or something to a sacred or lofty end
items.ex_en: The young scholar resolved to consecrate her life to the pursuit of truth.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻学者决心将毕生精力奉献给对真理的追求。

items.def_zh: 再次投身于，重新献身于；为（修缮后的建筑等）重新举行落成典礼
items.def_en: (+ to) To devote yourself or something again to a cause or goal, or to dedicate a restored building or monument with a new ceremony.
items.ex_en: The leaders gathered to rededicate themselves to upholding the historic peace accord.
items.ex_zh: 领袖们齐聚一堂，誓言再次全心维护这份历史性的和平协定。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on pledging time, energy, resources, or oneself wholeheartedly to a noble pursuit, cause, deity, or enterprise. It conveys profound loyalty, moral commitment, and sustained investment over an extended duration.
groups.summary_zh: 强调将全部心血、时间或信仰庄严且全身心地倾注于某项事业或崇高目标。
groups.desc_en: Formally allocating time, energy, sacred allegiance, or tangible resources exclusively to an ideal or pursuit, distinct from casual spending by entailing earnest commitment.
groups.desc_zh: 庄重地将时间、精力、神圣誓约或资源专门倾注于某理想或事业，与普通花费不同，蕴含全心承诺。
groups.nuance_en: dedicate: formally designate exclusive time, work, or honor (life / book / monument) · devote: passionately commit deep loyalty, attention, or energy (energy / resources / love) · pledge: solemnly bind oneself to a commitment or contribution (allegiance / aid / support) · give over: abandon or surrender entirely to a state or pursuit (time / self / property) · consecrate: ritually sanctify or irreversibly dedicate to a higher cause (church / life / ground) · rededicate: renew and recommit solemn dedication (effort / life / self)
groups.nuance_zh: dedicate: 正式题献或全身心投身 (life / book / monument) · devote: 倾注深厚情感、精力或资源 (energy / resources / love) · pledge: 庄严宣誓誓约或承诺提供 (allegiance / aid / support) · give over: 全盘交托或完全放任沉溺 (time / self / property) · consecrate: 祝圣或将生命奉献给崇高事业 (church / life / ground) · rededicate: 重新立誓奉献或再投入 (effort / life / self)

groups.name: Diagnose & Pinpoint Faults · 研判诊断与定性 (Pinpoint, Troubleshoot, Identify, Detect)
groups.tip: 根据体征症状作专业辨识

items.def_en: to recognize and correctly name the exact nature or cause of an anomaly or condition
items.ex_en: Advanced spectroscopy allowed technicians to identify the exact contaminant in the water.
items.ex_zh: 先进的光谱分析使技术人员能够测定出水中的确切污染物。

items.def_zh: 分离出；准确定位（故障点）
items.def_en: to separate a single component, pathogen, or variable from others in order to examine it
items.ex_en: Engineers managed to isolate the faulty circuit before the entire system suffered damage.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们赶在整个系统受损之前，准确定位并隔离了故障电路。

items.def_en: to direct all analytical attention or focus toward a single specific problem or source
items.ex_en: After hours of testing, the mechanics finally zeroed in on the oil leak.
items.ex_zh: 经过数小时的测试，机械师们终于锁定了漏油的根因所在。

items.def_en: To identify the nature or cause of an illness, problem, or fault through examination and analysis.
items.ex_en: Specialists used ultrasound imaging to diagnose the patient's acute abdominal pain accurately.
items.ex_zh: 专家们利用超声波成像技术准确诊断了患者的急性腹痛。

items.def_en: to discover, describe, or locate the exact cause, spot, or problem with absolute precision
items.ex_en: Acoustic sensors helped the crew pinpoint the exact fracture in the hull.
items.ex_zh: 声学传感器帮助船员精确查明了船体裂纹的确切位置。

items.def_en: to analyze, trace, and rectify mechanical, software, or operational problems
items.ex_en: Our support technicians worked all night to troubleshoot the unexpected server outage.
items.ex_zh: 我们的技术支持人员通宵工作，以排查突发服务器宕机的故障。

groups.summary_en: Involves investigating symptoms, telemetry, or system failures to isolate the root pathological or mechanical cause. It operates strictly within diagnostic and investigative scenarios.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过全面排查与测定，精确定位疾病病原或系统故障根源。
groups.desc_en: Applying systematic expertise to isolate, categorize, and identify the root cause of an anomaly, differing from passive noticing by executing structured detective logic.
groups.desc_zh: 运用系统性专业知识对异常现象进行排查、定性并锁定根因，与被动察觉不同，重在结构化侦测推断。
groups.nuance_en: identify: formally recognize and label a specific problem or object (cause / flaw / symptom) · isolate: quarantine and distinguish a variable from confounding factors (virus / defect / variable) · zero in on: converge intensely toward the precise source (problem / target / signal) · diagnose: scientifically analyze symptoms to name an underlying pathology (illness / fault / crisis) · pinpoint: locate the absolute precise coordinate, origin, or cause (location / error / cause) · troubleshoot: systematically test and eliminate operational anomalies (glitch / system / bug)
groups.nuance_zh: identify: 识别并确认问题所在 (cause / flaw / symptom) · isolate: 剥离隔绝出单一诱因 (virus / defect / variable) · zero in on: 步步紧逼锁定焦点根源 (problem / target / signal) · diagnose: 剖析病理或病根 (illness / fault / crisis) · pinpoint: 极其精准地指出症结或坐标 (location / error / cause) · troubleshoot: 排查检修排除运行故障 (glitch / system / bug)

groups.name: Differ & Diverge · 相异与分歧 (Differ, Vary, Diverge)
groups.tip: 性质或特征上有所差异

items.def_en: To be different from each other in size, amount, degree, or character across a range
items.ex_en: Specimen sizes vary considerably depending on the geographical region and available food.
items.ex_zh: 样本的大小因地理区域和食物供应情况而呈现显著差异。
items.ex2_en: Clever school teachers intentionally vary daily classroom activities to maintain pupil interest throughout long terms.
items.ex2_zh: 聪明的学校老师有意变换每日的课堂活动，以便在整个漫长学期中保持学生的兴趣。

items.def_en: 1. (+ from) To be unlike or dissimilar in nature, quality, or character. 2. (+ with/over) To disagree in opinion.
items.ex_en: The proposed tax reforms differ substantially from the recommendations made last year.
items.ex_zh: 拟议中的税制改革与去年提出的各项建议有着实质性不同。

items.def_en: (+ with) To fail to match or correspond when comparing two statements, facts, or data points
items.ex_en: The witness's written statement disagrees with the physical evidence gathered at noon.
items.ex_zh: 证人的书面陈述与中午收集到的物证完全不符。

items.def_en: (+ with) To differ fundamentally in color, style, or opinion so as to create discord
items.ex_en: Her radical proposals clashed sharply with the traditional values of the board.
items.ex_zh: 她的激进提议与董事会的传统价值观产生了尖锐冲突。

items.def_en: (+ from) To differ noticeably or depart from what is usual, normal, or expected
items.ex_en: Pilots must never deviate from the established safety protocol during an emergency.
items.ex_zh: 在紧急情况下，飞行员绝不可偏离既定的安全规程。

items.def_en: (+ from) To become increasingly different in character, opinion, or course from an established path
items.ex_en: Over time, the modern dialect diverged significantly from its ancient linguistic roots.
items.ex_zh: 随着时间的推移，现代方言逐渐显著背离了其古老的语言渊源。

groups.summary_en: This frame describes attributes, values, or entities displaying dissimilarities or deviating from a standard or each other. Nuances range from inherent taxonomic variety to active divergence or ideological disagreement.
groups.summary_zh: 描述性质、数值或特征彼此不同，或在发展与观点上产生分歧差异。
groups.desc_en: Exhibiting structural variance, incompatibility, or branching movement away from a baseline or peer, distinct from active fighting by highlighting categorical non-alignment.
groups.desc_zh: 与基准或同类展现出结构差异、互斥性或分流偏移，与正面冲突不同，着重于本质或演进方向的不契合。
groups.nuance_en: vary: manifest shifting diversity or range within parameters (price / degrees / patterns) · differ: fundamentally distinct in quality, view, or characteristic (opinions / traits / species) · disagree: fail to align logically, harmoniously, or dietarily (sources / estimates / accounts) · clash: collide sharply in violent incompatibility (colors / cultures / personalities) · deviate: swing away from an established norm, path, or standard (norm / course / standard) · diverge: branch off in increasingly separate directions (paths / opinions / views)
groups.nuance_zh: vary: 在一定范围内展现变异多样性 (price / degrees / patterns) · differ: 性质、观点或特征截然不同 (opinions / traits / species) · disagree: 事实或证据不吻合一致 (sources / estimates / accounts) · clash: 鲜明对立或刺耳相撞 (colors / cultures / personalities) · deviate: 偏离既定轨道、准则或常理 (norm / course / standard) · diverge: 分道扬镳或分歧愈来愈深 (paths / opinions / views)

groups.name: Digest & Assimilate · 消化与吸收代谢 (Metabolize, Digest, Assimilate)
groups.tip: 食物在肠胃中分解与代谢

items.def_en: to take in nutrients or fluids into the bloodstream through bodily membranes
items.ex_en: Villi lining the small intestine absorb essential nutrients directly into the bloodstream.
items.ex_zh: 小肠内壁的绒毛将必需的养分直接吸收到血液之中。

items.def_en: to reduce complex nutrients into simpler chemical components during metabolism
items.ex_en: Specialized stomach enzymes break down dietary proteins into easily absorbed amino acids.
items.ex_zh: 胃里的特异性酶将膳食蛋白质分解为极易吸收的氨基酸。
items.ex2_en: Complex dietary carbohydrates break down gradually into simple glucose molecules inside human digestive intestines.
items.ex2_zh: 在人体消化道肠道内，复杂的膳食碳水化合物会逐步分解成简单的葡萄糖分子。

items.def_en: to break down food biologically in the stomach and intestines so nutrients can be absorbed
items.ex_en: The patient struggled to digest solid foods properly following the complicated surgery.
items.ex_zh: 经历复杂手术后，该患者很难正常消化固体食物。

items.def_en: to produce biochemical compounds through metabolic activity in an organism
items.ex_en: Human skin cells synthesize vitamin D when directly exposed to natural sunlight.
items.ex_zh: 当直接暴露于自然阳光下时，人体皮肤细胞便会合成维生素D。

items.def_en: to absorb and integrate digested food substances into body tissues
items.ex_en: Her weakened digestive tract could barely assimilate the nutrients from liquid meals.
items.ex_zh: 她虚弱的消化道几乎无法吸收流质食物中的养分。
items.ex2_en: Foreign cultural traditions assimilate slowly into native social customs across several successive immigrant generations.
items.ex2_zh: 在数个连续的移民世代中，外来文化传统会慢慢融入本土社会习俗。

items.def_zh: 代谢，新陈代谢（消化或转化物质）
items.def_en: (biology) To break down or change food, chemicals, or substances in the body by metabolism to produce energy or tissue.
items.ex_en: A runner's weary muscles metabolize glycogen into energy beneath the fading sun.
items.ex_zh: 奔跑者疲惫的肌体在落日余晖下将糖原代谢转化为生生不息的能量。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe internal biochemical or physiological processes that break down ingested sustenance, absorb nutrients, and convert them into energy or tissue.
groups.summary_zh: 指体内将摄入的营养物进行生物分解、消化和吸收转化的生理过程。
groups.desc_en: Biochemically processing, dismantling, and integrating incoming nutrients or complex information into the host organism's internal structure, contrasting with simple intake by entailing profound systemic incorporation.
groups.desc_zh: 在生化或认知层面拆解、吸收外来养分或复杂信息，并使其同化为自身构造，与单纯吞咽摄入相比强调深度融合。
groups.nuance_en: absorb: soak up liquid, energy, or take in ideas (moisture / shock / information) · break down: decompose complex compounds into elementary units (waste / carbohydrates / fat) · digest: break down food in the gut or mentally process complex facts (meal / information / grief) · synthesize: chemically produce or intellectually combine parts into a whole (protein / hormone / data) · assimilate: fully absorb and integrate culturally or biochemically (nutrients / immigrants / knowledge) · metabolize: enzymatically process and convert chemical substances into energy (fat / sugar / drug)
groups.nuance_zh: absorb: 浸润吸收水分、能量或概念 (moisture / shock / information) · break down: 分解复杂化合物 (waste / carbohydrates / fat) · digest: 肠胃消化食物或心智消化消化信息 (meal / information / grief) · synthesize: 化学合成或融会贯通成体系 (protein / hormone / data) · assimilate: 充分吸收同化为自身一部分 (nutrients / immigrants / knowledge) · metabolize: 代谢转化药物或营养物质 (fat / sugar / drug)

groups.name: Dike & Embank · 筑堤与防护 (Embank, Levee, Dam)
groups.tip: 构筑堤坝阻挡洪涝灾害

items.def_en: (often + up) To build a barrier across a watercourse to stop, restrict, or direct its flow
items.ex_en: Local authorities decided to dam the rapid river to avert annual floods.
items.ex_zh: 地方当局决定在湍急的河流上筑坝阻水，以防止连年洪涝。

items.def_en: To enclose, confine, or defend with a raised bank of earth or stone
items.ex_en: Generations of villagers laboured tirelessly to embank the restless currents with limestone.
items.ex_zh: 一代代村民孜孜不倦地用石灰石沿岸筑堤防护，抵御奔涌的激流。

items.def_en: To construct protective ridges or embankments along the banks of a river
items.ex_en: Pioneers had leveed the lower marshlands against the relentless tides of winter.
items.ex_zh: 拓荒者们在低洼湿地边缘筑起防洪长堤，以御冬季不息的狂潮。

items.def_en: To protect a shoreline against erosion by building a retaining wall or barrier
items.ex_en: Engineers sought to bulkhead the eroding bluffs against the pounding ocean surge.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们试图修筑防波挡墙，保护不断被惊涛侵蚀的悬崖。

items.def_en: To enclose or isolate an area by erecting protective vertical structures around it
items.ex_en: Part of the courtyard was walled off to create a private garden.
items.ex_zh: 院子的一部分被砌墙隔开，改造成了一个私人花园。

items.def_en: To protect low-lying land from flooding by constructing an embankment or dike, or to provide with drainage dikes.
items.ex_en: Early settlers diked the tidal flats to foster fertile fields from sea.
items.ex_zh: 早期的定居者修筑堤坝围垦潮间滩涂，向大海夺取肥沃良田。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve constructing earthworks, barriers, or walls to constrain, redirect, or hold back water and prevent coastal or riverine flooding.
groups.summary_zh: 指修建土堤、挡水墙或水坝以阻遏洪水并加固水岸。
groups.desc_en: Erecting engineered earthworks or barrier walls to regulate, contain, or hold back water and external threats, contrasting with natural banks through human defensive intervention.
groups.desc_zh: 构筑人工土方工程或挡壁以阻截、约束水流或外在险患，与天然堤岸不同，强调人工防御性拦截。
groups.nuance_en: dam: block the flow of a watercourse or suppress emotions (river / stream / tears) · embank: enclose or reinforce a bank with structured mounds (river / highway / track) · levee: protect lowlands specifically by raising high flood banks (riverbank / fields / perimeter) · bulkhead: reinforce a shore or partition against water invasion (shoreline / bank / vessel) · wall off: completely isolate or barricade using an impenetrable barrier (area / room / border) · dike: construct massive sea-walls or ditch defenses to prevent flooding (marsh / farmland / lowlands)
groups.nuance_zh: dam: 筑坝截断水流或抑制情感 (river / stream / tears) · embank: 筑筑路堤或加固河岸 (river / highway / track) · levee: 修筑防汛高堤保卫低洼地区 (riverbank / fields / perimeter) · bulkhead: 建造挡水岸壁或防水舱壁 (shoreline / bank / vessel) · wall off: 筑墙完全封堵或隔绝 (area / room / border) · dike: 筑围堤阻挡海潮或排涝防涝 (marsh / farmland / lowlands)

groups.name: Directing Aim & Intent · 瞄准与针对 (Target, Aim, Direct)
groups.tip: 明确指向特定对象

items.def_en: To hold a weapon, camera, light, or gaze steadily focused on a target
items.ex_en: The photojournalist trained her telephoto lens on the protesters marching downtown.
items.ex_zh: 摄影记者将长焦镜头对准了在市中心游行的抗议人群。

items.def_en: to direct an action, criticism, advertising campaign, or weapon at a particular person, group, or goal
items.ex_en: The advertising firm specifically targeted young professionals with their new financial product.
items.ex_zh: 广告公司凭借其新金融产品，专门以年轻职场人士为目标客户。

items.def_en: To point a weapon, comment, or action at someone, or to direct an endeavor toward an end
items.ex_en: The marksman aimed his rifle steadily at the small wooden bullseye.
items.ex_zh: 神射手将步枪沉稳地瞄准了远处小小的木质靶心。

items.def_en: To direct all attention, fire, or efforts precisely toward one specific point
items.ex_en: Our marketing team needs to zero in on these potential consumer trends.
items.ex_zh: 我们的营销团队需要集中全副精力精确锁定这些潜在的消费趋势。

items.def_en: To direct accusations, criticism, or weapons directly and pointedly at someone
items.ex_en: Fierce criticism was leveled at the ministry following the massive data breach.
items.ex_zh: 发生大规模数据泄露事件后，舆论矛头直指该部委。

items.def_zh: 挑选出（以作批评或特别对待）
items.def_en: To choose one person or group from among others for distinctive, often critical, treatment
items.ex_en: It is unfair to single out one player when the whole team performed poorly.
items.ex_zh: 在全队表现都很差的情况下，单单挑出一名球员来责备是不公平的。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on aiming projectiles, actions, remarks, or tailored strategies directly toward a specific recipient, objective, or audience.
groups.summary_zh: 将武器、批评、注意力或策略明确指向特定对象或预定目标。
groups.desc_en: Orienting physical weaponry, sightlines, or rhetorical criticism intently toward an isolated objective, contrasting with diffuse broadcast by enforcing directional convergence.
groups.desc_zh: 将物理武器、视线或指责批判极其集中地定向对准特定对象，与发散式宣泄不同，强调方向的高度收束。
groups.nuance_en: train: align sightlines, cameras, or weapons steadily on a mark (gun / sights / spotlight) · target: select as the deliberate recipient of an attack or campaign (audience / enemy / sector) · aim: calibrate trajectory toward an intended goal or mark (weapon / criticism / product) · zero in on: adjust focus with acute accuracy onto an objective (target / flaw / threat) · level at: aim a serious weapon, charge, or condemnation directly at (criticism / accusation / gun) · single out: separate an individual from a cohort for special treatment (individual / scapegoat / performer)
groups.nuance_zh: train: 将武器或聚光灯稳稳瞄准 (gun / sights / spotlight) · target: 锁定作为打击或营销受众 (audience / enemy / sector) · aim: 校准意向目标或调整弹道 (weapon / criticism / product) · zero in on: 焦点迅速迫近对准关键 (target / flaw / threat) · level at: 针对性地当头抛出指控或平举枪械 (criticism / accusation / gun) · single out: 从群体中单独挑出 (individual / scapegoat / performer)

groups.name: Disarm & Demilitarize · 缴械与去军事化 (Decommission, Demobilize, Neutralize)
groups.tip: 收缴武器消除武装军事力量

items.def_en: Render harmless or ineffective by stripping away aggressive power or lethal capability
items.ex_en: The newly passed legislative amendment effectively defanged the aggressive corporate takeover.
items.ex_zh: 新通过的法律修正案实际上彻底消除了激进企业收购的威胁。

items.def_zh: 解除戒备；撤出战斗岗位
items.def_en: Relax from a state of military readiness or withdraw from an active alert
items.ex_en: The CEO decided to stand down after the company's financial scandal was exposed.
items.ex_zh: 公司财务丑闻曝光后，首席执行官决定引咎辞职。

items.raw_cluster: 缴械与解除武装 Disarm & Demilitarize
items.def_zh: 解除……的武装；放下武器，裁军；消除（敌意或戒心）
items.def_en: 1. To take weapons away from someone, or to give up weapons and reduce military forces. 2. To make someone feel less angry, suspicious, or critical.
items.ex_en: Trained police negotiators managed to peacefully disarm the agitated bank robber.
items.ex_zh: 受过专业训练的警务谈判专家成功和平解除了焦躁劫匪的武装。
items.ex2_en: Both warring neighboring nations agreed to disarm completely under the supervised multilateral peace treaty.
items.ex2_zh: 这两个交战的邻国都同意在受到监督的多边和平条约下完全解除武装。

items.def_en: Officially take weapons, ships, or nuclear plants out of active service
items.ex_en: The navy finalized plans to decommission the aging nuclear submarine next spring.
items.ex_zh: 海军最终敲定了于明年春天让这艘老旧核潜艇正式退役的计划。

items.def_en: Remove all military forces, armaments, and operations from an area or border
items.ex_en: Both nations agreed to demilitarize the disputed border valley without delay.
items.ex_zh: 两国均同意毫不拖延地使这处争议边界山谷实现非军事化。

items.def_en: Disband troops or release members of armed forces from military service
items.ex_en: The government began to demobilize the veteran soldiers after signing the armistice.
items.ex_zh: 签署停战协议后，政府开始对军中老兵进行复员遣散。
items.ex2_en: The exhausted infantry regiment will demobilize officially next month following the formal ceasefire declaration.
items.ex2_zh: 在正式宣布停火之后，这支疲惫的步兵团将于下个月正式复员解甲。

groups.summary_en: Encompasses actions where weapons, armaments, or military capacity are removed, surrendered, stripped down, or rendered completely inoperative.
groups.summary_zh: 指收缴武装、裁撤军队、销毁装备或消除军事防御设施的行动。
groups.desc_en: Systematically stripping military capabilities, neutralizing weapons, or disbanding armed formations under regulated control, distinct from wartime defeat through planned demobilization.
groups.desc_zh: 在管制体系下系统性剥夺军事能力、销毁武器或遣散武装建制，与战场溃败不同，强调规制化的解除与复员。
groups.nuance_en: defang: neutralize the lethal threat or aggression of an opponent (law / military / enemy) · stand down: order military forces to cease high-alert status (troops / forces / alert) · disarm: strip of weapons or disarm emotional hostility (rebel / militia / opponent) · decommission: officially retire equipment or warships from active service (warship / reactor / plant) · demilitarize: remove military forces and installations from an area (zone / border / region) · demobilize: discharge troops from active wartime readiness to civil life (soldiers / army / troops)
groups.nuance_zh: defang: 拔去毒牙削弱危险攻击力 (law / military / enemy) · stand down: 下令部队解除戒备 (troops / forces / alert) · disarm: 收缴武器或化解敌意 (rebel / militia / opponent) · decommission: 退役报废舰艇或核设施 (warship / reactor / plant) · demilitarize: 撤出驻军使区域非军事化 (zone / border / region) · demobilize: 复员遣散部队转入和平状态 (soldiers / army / troops)

groups.name: Discard & Shed · 丢弃与摆脱 (Shed, Slough, Jettison)
groups.tip: 脱落甩掉或丢弃不需要之物

items.def_zh: 摆脱，去除；脱落，脱落（皮、叶等）；流（泪、血）
items.def_en: To get rid of or discard something unwanted; to lose leaves, skin, or hair naturally; to cause tears or blood to flow.
items.ex_en: Deciduous trees shed their colorful leaves as autumn temperatures drop sharply.
items.ex_zh: 随着秋季气温急剧下降，落叶树木纷纷褪落斑斓的树叶。

items.def_en: To cast off an outer layer of dead skin, or to rid oneself of a burdensome habit or feeling
items.ex_en: The corporation must slough off unprofitable subsidiaries to regain its financial health.
items.ex_zh: 该公司必须果断剥离不盈利的下属子公司，以恢复财务健康。
items.ex2_en: Dead skin scales slough off naturally during the reptile's periodic shedding cycle every spring.
items.ex2_zh: 每年春天，在爬行动物的周期性蜕皮过程中，死皮鳞片都会自然脱落。

items.def_en: To free oneself from constraints, burdens, or unwanted garments
items.ex_en: The crew cast off at dawn and sailed into the open ocean.
items.ex_zh: 船员们在黎明时分解缆启航，驶向浩瀚的大洋。

items.def_en: To informally abandon or get rid of someone or something abruptly
items.ex_en: He decided to ditch his broken bicycle and walk the remaining distance.
items.ex_zh: 他决定扔掉坏了的自行车，徒步走完剩下的一段路程。

items.def_en: To throw away or get rid of something that is no longer useful or needed
items.ex_en: Please discard all expired medicines in the designated hazardous waste container.
items.ex_zh: 请将所有过期药品丢弃到指定的危险废弃物收集箱中。

items.def_en: To drop cargo from an aircraft or ship to lighten load, or to abandon an idea, plan, or person
items.ex_en: Faced with falling revenues, the company decided to jettison the risky project.
items.ex_zh: 面对不断下滑的营业收入，公司决定彻底放弃这个高风险项目。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe getting rid of, dropping, or discarding unwanted burdens, physical coverings, or excess baggage, either naturally or decisively.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动脱去、丢弃无用物或自然蜕落附着物。
groups.desc_en: Intentionally casting off superfluous, outworn, or burdensome matter to attain operational lightness or renewal, contrasting with accidental loss through deliberate riddance.
groups.desc_zh: 主动脱卸冗余、陈旧或负担性的物事以求轻装上阵或新生蜕变，与意外遗失不同，强调决断的割舍与摆脱。
groups.nuance_en: shed: naturally drop off outer covering, tears, or unwanted mass (skin / tears / pounds) · slough off: cast off dead tissue, old habits, or lethargy (skin / habits / layers) · cast off: throw away obsolete ties or maritime moorings (anchors / chains / inhibitions) · ditch: crudely or unceremoniously discard someone or something (car / partner / plan) · discard: systematically reject unnecessary items from use (cards / rubbish / clothes) · jettison: forcibly throw cargo overboard to lighten critical load (ballast / cargo / plan)
groups.nuance_zh: shed: 自然褪去外皮、落泪或减去多余重量 (skin / tears / pounds) · slough off: 蜕除死皮坏疽或甩掉积习 (skin / habits / layers) · cast off: 解缆抛开羁绊束缚 (anchors / chains / inhibitions) · ditch: 随意丢弃或甩掉同伴 (car / partner / plan) · discard: 整理挑出弃用废料或废牌 (cards / rubbish / clothes) · jettison: 危机时刻抛弃负荷或搁置计划 (ballast / cargo / plan)

groups.name: Disconnect & Sever · 断开与切断连接 (Disconnect, Uncouple, Sever)
groups.tip: 拔除插头或解除物理连接分离

items.def_en: To remove or separate a part from a larger structure or surface
items.ex_en: Carefully detach the protective cover before attempting to inspect internal wirings.
items.ex_zh: 在尝试检查内部线路之前，请小心拆下外层保护罩。
items.ex2_en: The magnetic solar panels detach easily from the vehicle roof when strong winds blow.
items.ex2_zh: 当强风吹拂时，磁性太阳能电池板很容易从车顶上脱落。

items.def_en: To break the connection between two things or stop a machine's power supply
items.ex_en: Always disconnect the power cord before opening the computer chassis for cleaning.
items.ex_zh: 在打开电脑机箱进行清洁前，请务必先断开电源插头。
items.ex2_en: The noisy Bluetooth headphones disconnect abruptly whenever the user walks beyond fifteen meters away.
items.ex2_zh: 每当使用者走出十五米开外，嘈杂的蓝牙耳机就会突然断开连接。

items.def_en: To divide or cut off cleanly and completely through force
items.ex_en: The sharp falling timber severed the primary electrical cable in an instant.
items.ex_zh: 骤然倒落的尖锐木料瞬间切断了主要输电电缆。

items.def_zh: 拔掉……的插头，断开；拔去塞子，疏通
items.def_en: 1. To disconnect a piece of electrical equipment by taking its plug out of a socket. 2. To remove an obstruction or stopper from.
items.ex_en: Remember to unplug the iron as soon as you finish pressing clothes.
items.ex_zh: 熨烫完衣服后，请务必随手拔掉电熨斗的电源插头。

items.def_en: To free something from being trapped, fitted, or interlocked with another mechanism
items.ex_en: The pilot had to disengage the autopilot system during violent midair turbulence.
items.ex_zh: 在遭遇剧烈空中颠簸时，飞行员不得不脱开自动驾驶系统。
items.ex2_en: The transmission gears disengage smoothly whenever the driver presses down firmly on the clutch.
items.ex2_zh: 每当司机稳稳地踩下离合器时，变速箱齿轮就会平顺地脱离咬合。

items.def_en: To separate two things that are physically joined or linked together, such as railway cars
items.ex_en: Railway workers quickly uncoupled the damaged freight car from the train.
items.ex_zh: 铁路工人们迅速将受损的货运车厢从列车上解钩分离。
items.ex2_en: The two connected railway carriages uncouple automatically when entering the busy maintenance siding track.
items.ex2_zh: 当进入繁忙的检修侧线时，两节相连的铁轨车厢会自动解开联结。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers interrupting physical, electrical, or logistical links between two entities. Verbs range from reversible disengagement like 'disconnect' and 'uncouple' to permanent and forceful separation like 'sever'.
groups.summary_zh: 指断开、拔除或切断物体之间的物理或电气连接。
groups.desc_en: Terminating an active mechanical, functional, or electrical circuit between interrelated entities, contrasting with structural destruction by disrupting communication or current while keeping parts viable.
groups.desc_zh: 切断相互依存实体间的机械、功能或电路连通，与结构毁坏不同，重在通讯、流通或接驳的断开而各部分仍具功能。
groups.nuance_en: detach: physically unfasten a subpart from a main frame (cable / trailer / cord) · disconnect: disrupt circuit, link, or utility conduit (power / caller / pipeline) · sever: violently cut completely through an anatomical or social link (artery / link / cable) · unplug: break electrical contact by pulling a male plug (appliance / cord / charger) · disengage: ease moving gears or mechanisms out of contact (gears / clutch / mechanism) · uncouple: release an explicit pin or latch holding coupled vehicles (cars / train / engine)
groups.nuance_zh: detach: 从主结构上解脱附着部件 (cable / trailer / cord) · disconnect: 切断线路供应或通讯联络 (power / caller / pipeline) · sever: 彻底割断物理线缆或人际联系 (artery / link / cable) · unplug: 拔掉电源插头以断电 (appliance / cord / charger) · disengage: 解除齿轮啮合或传动机构 (gears / clutch / mechanism) · uncouple: 拔除挂钩脱开机车车厢 (cars / train / engine)

groups.name: Discount & Liquidate · 降价抛售与清仓 (Remainder, Clear out, Mark down)
groups.tip: 降价清仓转让余货

items.def_en: To reduce the stated retail price of an article of merchandise
items.ex_en: The department store marked down all winter coats by 40%.
items.ex_zh: 百货公司将所有冬季外套降价了40%。

items.def_zh: 降价清仓出售（滞销图书）
items.def_en: (of a publisher) To sell remaining copies of an unsold or discontinued book at a heavily reduced price.
items.ex_en: The publisher decided to remainder hundreds of unsold hardcovers to discount retailers.
items.ex_zh: 出版商决定将数百本滞销的精装书低价清仓转让给折扣书商。

items.def_en: To sell remaining merchandise quickly and cheaply to empty shelves or storage
items.ex_en: The shop slashed prices by fifty percent to clear out summer apparel.
items.ex_zh: 该店铺将商品价格砍掉一半，以便清仓甩卖夏季服装。

items.def_zh: 批发出售（存货）；转让尾货
items.def_en: To sell or buy goods wholesale in odd, surplus, or clearance lots
items.ex_en: The wholesaler will job these overstocked winter coats to secondary markets abroad.
items.ex_zh: 该批发商将把这批积压的冬季大衣成批转卖给海外二级市场。

items.def_en: To deposit large quantities of unwanted or subsidized goods into a market at very low prices
items.ex_en: Foreign manufacturers were accused of dumping cheap steel into the domestic market.
items.ex_zh: 外国生产商被指控向国内市场低价倾销廉价钢铁制品。

items.def_en: To convert assets or excess inventory into cash rapidly, often under distress
items.ex_en: The bankrupt retailer was forced to liquidate its inventory to satisfy creditors.
items.ex_zh: 这家破产的零售商被迫清仓变现其库存商品以偿还债权人。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers methods of divesting stock, inventory, or discontinued product lines at drastically reduced price points to recover working capital and make shelf space for fresh inventory.
groups.summary_zh: 对积压滞销品或断档货品进行大幅打折、清仓出清。
groups.desc_en: Aggressively slashing prices or offloading inventory to swiftly liquidate assets and free up capital, distinct from routine retail pricing through its urgent volume-clearing posture.
groups.desc_zh: 以大幅降价或倾销手段快速出清库存以回笼资金，与常规调价不同，强调迅速腾出库位或变现的清仓态势。
groups.nuance_en: mark down: write down retail prices for promotion or sale (goods / merchandise / items) · remainder: sell off unsold surplus editions of books at steep discounts (books / editions / stock) · clear out: empty entire storage shelves of old stock rapidly (stock / inventory / shelves) · job: wholesale surplus goods in bulk to secondary middlemen (merchandise / lots / inventory) · dump: flood foreign or open markets at predatory, loss-making rates (goods / steel / shares) · liquidate: sell off company assets into cash under distress (assets / stock / inventory)
groups.nuance_zh: mark down: 零售贴签削价促销 (goods / merchandise / items) · remainder: 大幅降价抛售滞销积压图书 (books / editions / stock) · clear out: 快速甩卖清空整批旧货 (stock / inventory / shelves) · job: 将尾货整批低价分销给二道贩 (merchandise / lots / inventory) · dump: 倾销低价抛售货物或股票 (goods / steel / shares) · liquidate: 破产变卖或清库存变现 (assets / stock / inventory)

groups.name: Disentangle & Free from Peril · 解套与摆脱险境 (Disentangle, Dislodge, Wriggle Out)
groups.tip: 从困境或束缚中解救脱离

items.def_zh: 逐渐松开；慢慢挣脱出来
items.def_en: To free oneself or an object gradually through repeated small movements
items.ex_en: Over time, the vibrating bolt began to work loose from the frame.
items.ex_zh: 随着时间推移，不断振动的螺栓开始逐渐从框架上自行松动。
items.ex2_en: Repeated mechanical vibrations work the tight joint loose after several months of intensive factory operation.
items.ex2_zh: 在工厂高强度运转几个月后，反复的机械振动使紧固的接头逐渐松脱。

items.def_zh: 扭动脱身；（引申）金蝉脱壳
items.def_en: (+ of) To physically twist and squirm out of a tight space or hold, or figuratively evade a tough obligation
items.ex_en: The trapped hiker managed to wriggle out of the narrow rock crevice.
items.ex_zh: 受困的徒步旅行者奋力扭动身躯，终于挣脱了狭窄的岩石缝隙。

items.def_zh: 撬脱；费力从受困处扳开
items.def_en: To force something out of a tight, jammed, or bound position using leverage
items.ex_en: Rescuers used a heavy crowbar to pry loose the jammed vehicle door.
items.ex_zh: 救援人员使用粗重撬棍费力撬开了卡死的汽车车门。

items.def_zh: 逐出；使脱离卡住的位置
items.def_en: To forcibly remove or dislocate someone or something from a jammed, stuck, or firmly fixed position
items.ex_en: A single strong blow was sufficient to dislodge the heavy jammed stone.
items.ex_zh: 猛烈的一击便足以使卡在那里的沉重石块彻底脱离原位。

items.def_en: (+ from) (formal) To free or disentangle someone or something from a dangerous, difficult, or trapped position.
items.ex_en: Paramedics worked tirelessly to extricate the injured driver from the crushed cab.
items.ex_zh: 医护人员不知疲倦地开展施救，将受伤司机从变形的驾驶室中解救出来。

items.def_en: (+ from) To free someone or something from being tangled or caught in an intricate or constricting mess
items.ex_en: Divers attempted to disentangle the endangered sea turtle from the discarded nylon net.
items.ex_zh: 潜水员试图帮助受危及的海龟从废弃尼龙渔网的缠绕中解脱出来。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on physical or figurative extraction from an entangled, constricted, or dangerously confining situation. The core nuance involves overcoming friction, snags, or hazardous physical entrapment with deliberate effort.
groups.summary_zh: 强调通过克服阻力、拆解缠绕或巧妙用力，从物理困境或纠葛中脱险。
groups.desc_en: Painstakingly extracting oneself or an object from intricate entanglements, traps, or perilous pinches, contrasting with effortless escape through delicate maneuvering and spatial release.
groups.desc_zh: 费尽周折地将自身或物体从错综复杂的物理纠缠或险恶困境中解脱出来，与轻松逃离不同，强调精细动作与斡旋解套。
groups.nuance_en: work loose: patiently wiggle something stuck until freedom of movement (bolt / tooth / knot) · wriggle out: squirm physically or shirk a binding commitment dishonorably (contract / grasp / obligation) · pry loose: apply forceful levering to dislodge something jammed (plank / grip / stone) · dislodge: knock or force free from an entrenched fixed position (rock / debris / clot) · extricate: expertly disentangle from a hazardous or trapped situation (victim / oneself / vehicle) · disentangle: unravel intricately knotted cords, thoughts, or alliances (hair / cord / mystery)
groups.nuance_zh: work loose: 耐心左右晃动使其松脱 (bolt / tooth / knot) · wriggle out: 身体蠕动脱困或狡黠推脱义务 (contract / grasp / obligation) · pry loose: 借助杠杆撬松紧卡物 (plank / grip / stone) · dislodge: 震击使之离开固定锚位 (rock / debris / clot) · extricate: 救拔脱离废墟或险境泥潭 (victim / oneself / vehicle) · disentangle: 理清解开盘根错节的乱麻 (hair / cord / mystery)

groups.name: Disperse & Scatter · 散开与消散 (Disperse, Scatter, Dissipate)
groups.tip: 由聚集状态向四周散布

items.def_en: To leave a place, or for smoke/clouds to fade away
items.ex_en: Once the morning fog cleared off, the harbor view became strikingly sharp.
items.ex_zh: 晨雾散去之后，海港的景色顿时变得格外清晰明朗。

items.def_en: To separate suddenly and move off quickly in different directions
items.ex_en: The noisy flock of pigeons scattered instantly upon hearing the loud gunshot.
items.ex_zh: 听到巨大的枪声后，嘈杂的鸽群瞬间四散飞离。
items.ex2_en: Sudden desert wind gusts will scatter dried leaves all over the clean front porch.
items.ex2_zh: 突如其来的沙漠阵风会把干枯的落叶吹得散落在干净的前廊各处。

items.def_en: To move apart and go away in different directions, or to cause people or things to do this.
items.ex_en: Riot police deployed tear gas to disperse the aggressive crowd from squares.
items.ex_zh: 防暴警察施放催泪瓦斯，以驱散广场上聚拢的过激人群。
items.ex2_en: The thick early morning fog began to disperse gradually as the bright sun rose.
items.ex2_zh: 随着明媚的太阳升起，清晨厚重的浓雾开始逐渐消散开来。

items.def_en: To disappear completely or dissolve, like moisture into the air
items.ex_en: Her initial burst of enthusiasm seemed to evaporate completely after hearing difficulties.
items.ex_zh: 听闻重重困难之后，她起初的那股饱满热情似乎全然烟消云散了。
items.ex2_en: Intense solar rays evaporate surface moisture rapidly from the dry desert soil each morning.
items.ex2_zh: 每天早晨，强烈的太阳辐射都会迅速蒸发掉干燥沙漠土壤中的表层水分。

items.def_zh: （使烟雾、感觉等）逐渐消散，驱散
items.def_en: To gradually break up, fade away, or cause to disappear
items.ex_en: Warm afternoon breezes helped dissipate the thick sulfurous fumes over the town.
items.ex_zh: 午后温暖的微风帮助驱散了笼罩在城镇上空的浓烈含硫烟雾。
items.ex2_en: The dense morning clouds dissipate quickly once direct sunlight warms the chilly mountain air.
items.ex2_zh: 一旦直射阳光温暖了寒冷的山间空气，厚厚的晨云便迅速消散。

items.def_en: To cease to exist as an organized group or cause a group to separate
items.ex_en: The rebel militia agreed to surrender weapons and disband under the peace treaty.
items.ex_zh: 叛军民兵组织同意根据和平协议缴械并解散。
items.ex2_en: The voluntary charity committee voted to disband formally after completing all designated community projects.
items.ex2_zh: 志愿慈善委员会在完成所有指定的社区项目后，投票决定正式解散。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers entities or crowds moving away from a central point in various directions until spread out or completely dissolved. It applies to physical crowds, clouds, smoke, and abstract tension.
groups.summary_zh: 表示群体或实体自中心向四面八方散去，或烟雾、情绪等逐渐消散隐去。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the centrifugal breakup of a unified mass or gathering into disparate parts until it fades, differing from simple separation by implying total loss of collective cohesion or physical presence.
groups.desc_zh: 指聚集的群体或实体向四周散开直至凝聚力或存在感完全消失，与单纯的“分离”相比，强调集体凝聚力的瓦解或彻底消散。
groups.nuance_en: scatter: irregular centrifugal dispersion of discrete items (seeds / crowd / ashes) · disperse: orderly or systematic breaking up of an assembled mass (protesters / cloud / gathering) · dissipate: gradual thinning out to the point of vanishing (smoke / energy / tension) · disband: formal dissolution of an organized collective (army / committee / band)
groups.nuance_zh: scatter: 离散个体不规则地向四处抛散 (seeds / crowd / ashes) · disperse: 聚集群体有组织或受力后的解体散开 (protesters / cloud / gathering) · dissipate: 逐渐稀释淡化直至彻底消失 (smoke / energy / tension) · disband: 正式解散有纪律的既定组织 (army / committee / band)

groups.name: Dispose & Discard · 废弃与处置 (Discard, Scrap, Dump)
groups.tip: 扔掉废品或处理闲置

items.def_en: To place something unwanted into the trash or part with it permanently
items.ex_en: You shouldn't throw away such a wonderful job opportunity.
items.ex_zh: 你不应该白白浪费这么好的工作机会。

items.def_en: To discard or break up old equipment for metal, or abandon a plan as useless
items.ex_en: The city council decided to scrap the controversial transit project after severe budget cuts.
items.ex_zh: 在预算大幅削减后，市议会决定废止这项备受争议的交通项目。

items.def_zh: 处置，处理，扔掉（dispose of）；布置，安排；使倾向于
items.def_en: 1. (dispose of) To get rid of someone or something that you no longer want or need. 2. (formal) To arrange things in a particular position; to make someone inclined to a particular state or attitude.
items.ex_en: Hospitals must carefully dispose of hazardous biological waste according to strict federal regulations.
items.ex_zh: 医院必须依据严格的联邦法规妥善处置危险生物废弃物。

items.def_en: To get rid of something that is no longer useful or wanted
items.ex_en: Please discard your outdated access badges before entering the newly secured research facility.
items.ex_zh: 进入新安保研究设施前，请丢弃已过期的出入证件。

items.def_en: To deposit or discard waste carelessly, or abruptly get rid of an unwelcome burden
items.ex_en: Irresponsible contractors routinely dump toxic construction debris along the quiet country road.
items.ex_zh: 不负责任的承包商经常沿着僻静的乡间小路乱倒有毒建筑垃圾。

items.def_en: To throw cargo or fuel off a ship or aircraft, or abandon ideas and burdens to lighten a load
items.ex_en: Facing severe turbulence, the pilot decided to jettison excess fuel over the ocean.
items.ex_zh: 面对剧烈颠簸，飞行员决定将多余的燃油排放到海洋中。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote intentionally getting rid of unwanted materials, possessions, or burdens. They range from systematic disposal to unceremonious shedding of clutter.
groups.summary_zh: 强调主动抛弃、清理或系统性处理掉多余无用的人事物。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on intentional divestment and elimination of unwanted, obsolete, or burdensome items, contrasting with accidental loss by emphasizing deliberate relinquishment.
groups.desc_zh: 强调主动放弃、清除无用、过时或多余的负担物，与意外“遗失”相对，突出主观上的决断性处置。
groups.nuance_en: discard: reject what is redundant or useless after evaluation (waste / cards / outdated ideas) · scrap: permanently abandon an entire project or obsolete asset (plans / project / old machinery) · dump: unceremoniously or irresponsibly offload in bulk (toxic waste / inventory / partner) · jettison: strategically drop a burden to preserve viability (cargo / policy / dead weight)
groups.nuance_zh: discard: 经评估后筛除冗余或无用之物 (waste / cards / outdated ideas) · scrap: 彻底废止整套计划或报废资产 (plans / project / old machinery) · dump: 粗暴、不负责任地成堆倾倒或甩掉 (toxic waste / inventory / partner) · jettison: 为保全大局而果断抛弃沉重包袱 (cargo / policy / dead weight)

groups.name: Distinguish & Differentiate · 辨析与细分 (Distinguish, Differentiate, Tell apart, Discern)
groups.tip: 辨明细微差异并区别对待

items.def_en: to perceive the visible or behavioral difference between two very similar entities
items.ex_en: The twins look so similar that even their teachers can hardly tell them apart.
items.ex_zh: 这对双胞胎长得太像了，连他们的老师都很难分清。

items.def_en: to recognize, show, or mark the difference between two or more people or things
items.ex_en: Novice observers often struggle to distinguish native tree species from invasive foreign varieties.
items.ex_zh: 新手观察员往往很难将本土树种与外来入侵品种区分开来。

items.def_en: to perceive or constitute the specific attributes that make someone or something unique
items.ex_en: Advanced customer service helps differentiate the boutique firm from its larger corporate rivals.
items.ex_zh: 高品质的客户服务有助于使这家精品公司与庞大的企业对手区分开来。

items.def_en: 1. To recognize or see clear differences between things. 2. To treat someone unfairly because of their race, sex, or background.
items.ex_en: The refined wine judge could easily discriminate subtle undertones of oak and vanilla.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的品酒师能轻易辨别出橡木与香草的微妙底味。

items.def_en: to detect or comprehend with the senses or intellect something that is obscured or faint
items.ex_en: Through the heavy morning fog, the captain could barely discern the lighthouse beacon.
items.ex_zh: 穿过清晨的浓雾，船长勉强能够辨清灯塔的光芒。

items.def_en: to fix, establish, or mark the precise boundaries or limits separating two areas or domains
items.ex_en: Surveyors placed concrete pillars to clearly demarcate the border between the two properties.
items.ex_zh: 测量员竖起水泥柱，以明确划定两处地产之间的界限。

groups.summary_en: Denotes detecting subtle variances, borders, or identities between two or more sensory stimuli, ideas, or categories. It highlights analytical discernment and perceptual acuity.
groups.summary_zh: 强调运用感知力或分析力在事物间辨析细微差别与边界。
groups.desc_en: Involves cognitive or perceptual sorting across boundaries to recognize distinct identities, contrasting with general identification by emphasizing fine comparative appraisal.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过认知或感官跨越界限辨明不同实体的独特身份，与粗略的“识别”不同，强调细致的对比性鉴别。
groups.nuance_en: distinguish: recognize defining characteristics between entities (differences / twins / nuances) · differentiate: identify or constitute specific points of contrast (products / features / cells) · discern: detect faint, subtle, or obscured differences with effort (pattern / truth / outline) · demarcate: establish explicit physical or conceptual boundaries (borders / responsibilities / zones)
groups.nuance_zh: distinguish: 辨识实体间的标志性特征 (differences / twins / nuances) · differentiate: 确立或指出具体的差异点 (products / features / cells) · discern: 敏锐察觉幽微、模糊或隐藏的差别 (pattern / truth / outline) · demarcate: 画定清晰的物理或概念界线 (borders / responsibilities / zones)

groups.name: Distort & Misrepresent · 歪曲与曲解 (Distort, Misrepresent, Twist)
groups.tip: 歪曲篡改事实恶意曲解真相

items.def_en: To explain, understand, or represent something incorrectly, whether intentionally or not
items.ex_en: Critics often misinterpret the director's subtle satirical tone as simple cynicism and despair.
items.ex_zh: 评论家经常误解这位导演微妙的讽刺基调，将其视作单纯的愤世嫉俗与绝望。

items.def_en: To repeat someone's words incorrectly, thereby obscuring or changing the original meaning
items.ex_en: Careless journalists frequently misquote the senator's brief remarks regarding recent economic policy reforms.
items.ex_zh: 粗心的记者频繁错误引用参议员关于近期经济政策改革的简短发言。

items.def_en: To deliberately interpret someone's words or an event in a misleading or malicious way
items.ex_en: Political rivals routinely twist his honest statements to undermine his credibility with voters.
items.ex_zh: 政治对手惯常曲解他坦诚的发言，以削弱他在选民心中的公信力。

items.def_en: To change facts, ideas, or circumstances so that they become misleading or untrue
items.ex_en: The sensational tabloid deliberately distorted the interview transcripts to fabricate a major scandal.
items.ex_zh: 这家耸人听闻的小报蓄意歪曲采访记录，以捏造重大丑闻。
items.ex2_en: Historical records distort easily when politically biased authors intentionally omit uncomfortable documented factual details.
items.ex2_zh: 当带有政治偏见的作者故意省略令人不快的记录事实细节时，历史记录很容易失真。

items.def_zh: 歪曲，不如实叙述，不实报道
items.def_en: 1. To give a false or misleading account of facts, views, or someone's character.
items.ex_en: The promotional brochure deliberately misrepresents the hotel's amenities to attract unsuspecting foreign tourists.
items.ex_zh: 宣传册蓄意不实报道酒店的设施，以招揽毫无防备的外国游客。

items.def_en: To reproduce a message, text, or set of facts in a confused, altered, or inaccurate form
items.ex_en: Faulty radio equipment garbled the urgent military transmission during the sudden coastal storm.
items.ex_zh: 故障的无线电设备在突如其来的沿海风暴中弄乱了紧急军用通讯。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to giving an inaccurate, selective, or deliberately biased account of facts, statements, or events. They range from rhetorical bending of someone's words to systemic, fraudulent mischaracterization.
groups.summary_zh: 指对事实、言论或真相进行歪曲、捏造或误导性陈述。
groups.desc_en: Involves altering the true meaning, shape, or sound of information to deceive or obscure, contrasting with honest error by implying subjective manipulation or transmission damage.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过改变信息的原意、形态或原貌进行曲解或遮蔽，与无意的“弄错”不同，强调主观操弄或传播中的失真。
groups.nuance_en: twist: manipulate words or facts tendentiously to serve an agenda (words / meaning / truth) · distort: deform proportional accuracy or reality (facts / reality / image) · misrepresent: present a deliberately false or misleading account (intentions / financial position / credentials) · garble: unintentionally scramble or muddle a message during transmission (message / transmission / text)
groups.nuance_zh: twist: 蓄意歪曲原话或真相以服务特定立场 (words / meaning / truth) · distort: 扭曲客观事实或形态的真实比例 (facts / reality / image) · misrepresent: 故意提供虚假、具误导性的陈述 (intentions / financial position / credentials) · garble: 在传输或表达中使信息支离破碎、混淆不清 (message / transmission / text)

groups.name: Distort & Pervert · 败坏与曲解 (Pervert, Corrupt, Subvert)
groups.tip: 恶劣扭曲真相或本义

items.def_zh: 贬低；降低……的价值或品格
items.def_en: To reduce the quality, value, or moral standard of something
items.ex_en: Excessive sensationalism in the nightly news will ultimately debase public political discourse completely.
items.ex_zh: 晚间新闻中过度的耸人听闻最终将彻底降低公众政治话语的品格。

items.def_en: To cause someone or something to change from good, pure, or honest to dishonest, immoral, or bad
items.ex_en: Greed and unchecked ambition can easily corrupt otherwise decent public officials over time.
items.ex_zh: 随着时间的推移，贪婪和无节制的野心会轻易腐化原本正直的公职人员。
items.ex2_en: Vulnerable young minds corrupt easily when immersed constantly in violent and hateful internet propaganda.
items.ex2_zh: 当经常沉浸在充满暴力和仇恨的网络宣传中时，脆弱的年轻心灵很容易变质堕落。

items.def_en: 1. To distort the true meaning or proper course of something (such as justice); to corrupt or degrade morally.
items.ex_en: Corrupt officials attempted to pervert justice by bribing witnesses and destroying vital evidence.
items.ex_zh: 腐败官员企图通过收买证人和销毁关键证据来歪曲正义。

items.def_zh: 使劣化；使变质；杂乱更改
items.def_en: To alter something so drastically that its true quality, integrity, or purity is debased
items.ex_en: Purists argued that modern commercial revisions would merely bastardize the ancient musical tradition.
items.ex_zh: 正统派认为，现代商业化改编只会使这一古老音乐传统彻底变质。

items.def_zh: 颠覆；暗中破坏（体制、正义等）
items.def_en: To undermine the power, authority, or moral foundation of an established system, institution, or truth
items.ex_en: Undercover agents uncovered a covert network plotting to subvert the constitutional government secretly.
items.ex_zh: 卧底特工发现了一个密谋秘密颠覆立宪政府的地下网络。

items.def_en: To destroy, impair, or corrupt the legal force, purity, or effectiveness of something
items.ex_en: Any procedural violation during evidence gathering could vitiate the entire criminal prosecution proceedings.
items.ex_zh: 取证过程中的任何程序违法都可能使整个刑事起诉程序失效。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers corrupting, debasing, or violently diverting an abstract system, institution, or moral principle away from its rightful, natural, or intended course. It carries an intense moral or systemic condemnation.
groups.summary_zh: 指破坏、腐蚀或严重颠覆正义、制度及道德原则的本义。
groups.desc_en: Signifies corrupting an established standard, purpose, or moral principle until its original integrity is degraded, differing from intellectual bias by targeting moral or structural ruin.
groups.desc_zh: 指对既定标准、宗旨或道德准则进行败坏与颠覆，使其丧失原有的纯洁性或合法性，不同于认识偏差，强调道德或本质层面的堕落毁损。
groups.nuance_en: pervert: divert a sound principle or truth to an unnatural, debased end (justice / course of law / truth) · corrupt: morally taint or decay systemic integrity (morals / officials / system) · subvert: secretly undermine power or an established order from below (authority / democracy / regime) · vitiate: spoil or legally invalidate structural efficacy (contract / reasoning / effectiveness)
groups.nuance_zh: pervert: 歪曲良法善意用于不正当的卑劣目的 (justice / course of law / truth) · corrupt: 从道德或系统内部侵蚀其完整性 (morals / officials / system) · subvert: 由下至上暗中颠覆权威或现有体制 (authority / democracy / regime) · vitiate: 损害本质效力或使法律/逻辑推导归于无效 (contract / reasoning / effectiveness)

groups.name: Distort & Skew · 扭曲与歪曲 (Skew, Distort, Bias)
groups.tip: 偏离原本常态，失真变形走样

items.def_en: To influence someone's opinion or perception in a subjective or prejudiced way
items.ex_en: Traumatic childhood experiences can unconsciously color your adult perceptions of personal trust completely.
items.ex_zh: 童年的创伤经历会在潜意识中彻底影响你成年后对人际信任的看法。
items.ex2_en: Unconscious personal biases will color subtle everyday social judgments without people ever actively realizing it.
items.ex2_zh: 无意识的个人偏见会在人们毫无察觉的情况下，不知不觉地影响日常微小的社会判断。

items.def_en: To influence results, a person, or an opinion unfairly in a particular direction
items.ex_en: Biased survey questions will inevitably bias the survey results toward the sponsor's agenda.
items.ex_zh: 带有偏见的调查问题不可避免地会使调查结果偏向赞助方的意图。

items.def_en: To alter a person's thinking, judgment, or morality so that it becomes perverse or unnatural
items.ex_en: Prolonged exposure to extremist rhetoric can warp an impressionable young person's moral compass.
items.ex_zh: 长期接触极端主义言论会扭曲容易受影响的年轻人的道德准则。
items.ex2_en: Heavy wooden floorboards warp visibly over time when damp moisture continually rises from below.
items.ex2_zh: 当下方的潮湿水汽不断上升时，厚重的木质地板随着时间推移会明显发生翘曲变形。

items.def_en: To change the facts, ideas, or representation of something so that they are misleading or false
items.ex_en: Dishonest accounting practices intentionally distort the true financial standing of the troubled company.
items.ex_zh: 不诚实的做账手段蓄意歪曲了这家陷入困境的公司的真实财务状况。
items.ex2_en: Historical facts distort predictably whenever partisan biographers rewrite complex national events for political convenience.
items.ex2_zh: 每当党派传记作者出于政治便利重新改写复杂的国家事件时，历史事实往往会遭到扭曲。

items.def_zh: 曲解，使有偏向；偏斜，歪斜
items.def_en: 1. To cause results, opinions, or data to be inaccurate, biased, or distorted. 2. To turn or place at an angle; to slant.
items.ex_en: Faulty calibration of laboratory sensors will heavily skew experimental temperature measurements and conclusions.
items.ex_zh: 实验室传感器的校准错误会使实验温度测量及结论严重失真。
items.ex2_en: Statistical research estimates skew significantly if investigators only interview people from one wealthy suburban neighborhood.
items.ex2_zh: 如果调查人员只采访来自一个富裕郊区社区的人群，统计研究的估算结果就会严重失真。

items.def_zh: 有倾向性地陈述，偏向报道
items.def_en: To present information, an article, or a story in a biased way with a deliberate angle
items.ex_en: The conservative editorial board consistently slants political coverage to favor incumbent party candidates.
items.ex_zh: 该保守派编辑部一贯带有倾向性地报道政治新闻，以偏袒现任执政党候选人。
items.ex2_en: Sensational news headlines slant visibly towards sensationalism whenever competing media companies fight for advertising revenue.
items.ex2_zh: 每当竞争对手的媒体公司争夺广告收入时，耸人听闻的新闻标题就会明显带有博人眼球的倾向性。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to introducing systematic error, asymmetry, or partiality into facts, data, perspectives, or representations so that the truth is misrepresented.
groups.summary_zh: 指因偏差或主观意图导致数据、事实或真相被歪曲篡改。
groups.desc_en: Involves bending, tilting, or tilting a perspective or dataset out of true alignment, contrasting with outright fabrication by focusing on asymmetrical bias or deviation.
groups.desc_zh: 指使视角、数据或认知偏离客观中准线发生倾斜或失真，与纯粹的“捏造”不同，强调非对称的偏倚与失衡。
groups.nuance_en: skew: pull a statistical or thematic balance disproportionately to one side (results / data / distribution) · bias: predispose unfairly toward or against a specific party (judgment / jury / coverage) · warp: deform internal integrity or moral judgment over time (mind / judgment / wood) · slant: craft a narrative from a deliberate, partisan angle (story / reporting / perspective)
groups.nuance_zh: skew: 使统计数据或整体分布向某一方失衡偏移 (results / data / distribution) · bias: 带有预设偏见地影响判断公正 (judgment / jury / coverage) · warp: 扭曲内在心智、理智或材质原貌 (mind / judgment / wood) · slant: 带有明显倾向性地对事实进行切片报道 (story / reporting / perspective)

groups.name: Ditch & Abandon · 决绝抛弃与甩掉 (Chuck, Bin, Drop)
groups.tip: 狠心丢弃不再理会

items.def_zh: 终止接触；甩掉（伴侣/朋友）
items.def_en: To stop associating with someone or cease carrying out an ongoing scheme
items.ex_en: After repeatedly uncovering deceitful behavior, she chose to drop the unreliable business partner.
items.ex_zh: 在屡次发现欺诈行为后，她选择与那个不可靠的商业合伙人断绝往来。
items.ex2_en: Sudden temperature drops cause frozen tree branches to break and drop onto the driveway.
items.ex2_zh: 骤降的气温导致结冰的树枝折断，纷纷掉落在车道上面。

items.def_zh: 摆脱，去除（累赘、员工、债务）
items.def_en: To rid oneself of unwanted weight, jobs, assets, or obligations efficiently
items.ex_en: To regain profitability, the struggling airline must quickly shed unprofitable regional routes immediately.
items.ex_zh: 为了恢复盈利，这家陷入困境的航空公司必须立即迅速砍掉亏损的支线航线。

items.def_en: To throw something away into a waste receptacle or terminate a project entirely
items.ex_en: After reviewing the abysmal first draft, the editor told him to bin it.
items.ex_zh: 看完极其糟糕的初稿后，编辑叫他直接把它扔进垃圾桶。

items.def_en: To casually throw something away or abandon a partner, job, or plan
items.ex_en: He impulsively decided to chuck his miserable office job and travel across Europe.
items.ex_zh: 他一时冲动，决定抛弃那份痛苦的办公室工作去环游欧洲。

items.def_zh: 丢弃，抛弃，甩掉；使（飞机）水上迫降；在……开沟
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To get rid of or abandon someone or something you no longer want. 2. To make an emergency landing of an aircraft on water.
items.ex_en: Executives chose to ditch the outdated software platform in favor of cloud-based solutions.
items.ex_zh: 高管们决定抛弃过时的软件平台，转而采用基于云的解决方案。

items.def_en: To intentionally reject, dismiss, or abandon someone or something without hesitation
items.ex_en: The ruthless ruler cast aside old loyal allies the moment power was secured.
items.ex_zh: 掌权的那一刻，这位冷酷的统治者便将旧日忠诚的盟友彻底弃之不顾。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers high-intensity, casual, or ruthless ways of severing ties or dumping unwanted objects, commitments, and people. It highlights haste, callousness, or sudden disregard.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重果断、仓促或无情地抛弃、扔掉或甩脱人事物。
groups.desc_en: Emphasizes the abrupt, unsentimental severing of ties and physical disposal of an encumbrance, contrasting with polite resignation by its callous, decisive finality.
groups.desc_zh: 强调以粗暴、决绝且不带感情色彩的方式断绝关系或甩掉累赘，与客气的“放弃”相对，极具断腕式的决绝与冷酷感。
groups.nuance_en: ditch: abruptly abandon a person, plan, or vehicle to escape liability (boyfriend / plans / car) · chuck: casually or contemptuously toss away (rubbish / career / keys) · bin: decisively trash as worthless (proposal / draft / junk) · cast aside: discard coldly once utility has expired (allies / doubts / loyalties)
groups.nuance_zh: ditch: 为摆脱包袱而突然甩掉或抛下 (boyfriend / plans / car) · chuck: 漫不经心或轻蔑地随手扔掉 (rubbish / career / keys) · bin: 判定毫无价值而直接扔进垃圾桶 (proposal / draft / junk) · cast aside: 待利用价值耗尽后冷酷遗弃 (allies / doubts / loyalties)

groups.name: Diversify & Branch Out · 多样化与业务拓展 (Branch out, Vary, Expand)
groups.tip: 打破单一形态向多元方向分生

items.def_en: (+ into) To increase the range, scope, or operations of a business or portfolio
items.ex_en: The successful tech startup aims to expand into foreign emerging markets next fiscal year.
items.ex_zh: 这家成功的科技初创公司计划在下一财年将业务拓展至国外新兴市场。
items.ex2_en: The ambitious company will expand operations throughout the entire southern region next year.
items.ex2_zh: 这家雄心勃勃的公司明年将在整个南部地区扩大业务。

items.def_en: To introduce changes and differences into something to prevent monotony
items.ex_en: Skillful teachers consciously vary instructional methods to maintain strong classroom interest and dynamic engagement.
items.ex_zh: 娴熟的教师会自觉使教学方法多样化，以保持浓厚的课堂兴趣和积极的互动。
items.ex2_en: Ticket prices often vary significantly according to consumer demand and seasonal trends.
items.ex2_zh: 票价通常会根据消费者需求和季节趋势发生显著变化。

items.def_en: (+ into) To start doing a new type of activity or business distinct from one's main work
items.ex_en: After mastering residential architecture, the design studio began to branch out into commercial interiors.
items.ex_zh: 在精通住宅建筑后，该设计工作室开始涉足商业室内设计领域。

items.def_en: To distribute risks, investments, or resources across several diverse areas
items.ex_en: The search team spread out across the forest to look for the missing hikers.
items.ex_zh: 搜救队在森林中分散开来寻找失踪的徒步旅行者。
items.ex2_en: The gardener spread out fresh wood mulch evenly across the flowerbeds.
items.ex2_zh: 园丁把新鲜的木屑均匀地铺撒在各个花坛上。

items.raw_cluster: 分化与多样化 Diversify & Vary
items.def_zh: （使）多样化，（使）多元化发展；（企业）扩大业务范围，从事多种经营
items.def_en: 1. To become more varied, or to make something more varied. 2. (+ into) (of a business or investor) To expand into new products, services, or markets.
items.ex_en: Wise institutional investors actively diversify their investment portfolios to minimize catastrophic market risks.
items.ex_zh: 明智的机构投资者积极使投资组合多元化，以最大限度降低灾难性市场风险。
items.ex2_en: The local farm diversified into organic fruit production to generate steady income.
items.ex2_zh: 这家当地农场转向有机水果种植，以获取稳定的收入。

items.def_en: To increase the variety, scope, or range of interests, activities, or choices
items.ex_en: Traveling across varied cultures will profoundly broaden a student's intellectual perspectives on humanity.
items.ex_zh: 在多元文化间旅行将深刻拓宽学生对人类社会的认知视野。
items.ex2_en: The narrow river begins to broaden noticeably as it approaches the coastline.
items.ex2_zh: 这条狭窄的河流在接近海岸线时开始明显变宽。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses expanding range, form, or operations into new and distinct types, varieties, or market sectors to spread risk or enrich breadth.
groups.summary_zh: 指拓展范围、品种或业务领域，实现多态化以分散风险或增强生机。
groups.desc_en: Describes the outward proliferation from a central core into varied new arenas, contrasting with mere quantitative enlargement by emphasizing qualitative heterogeneity.
groups.desc_zh: 指以核心本体为基点向全新领域延展出异质性分支，与单纯的数量“扩大”不同，强调品类或维度的多样化。
groups.nuance_en: diversify: spread into varied fields to reduce risk or enrich assortment (portfolio / economy / product line) · branch out: venture into an unfamiliar but related domain (into catering / overseas / new genres) · expand: increase scale, territory, or volume outward (business / network / vocabulary) · broaden: widen scope, horizons, or base to be more inclusive (horizons / appeal / knowledge)
groups.nuance_zh: diversify: 布局多元领域以分散风险或丰富品类 (portfolio / economy / product line) · branch out: 从母体向陌生但相关的新赛道试探性伸展 (into catering / overseas / new genres) · expand: 扩大体量、版图或规模 (business / network / vocabulary) · broaden: 拓宽视野、受众基数或知识广度 (horizons / appeal / knowledge)

groups.name: Divert & Shunt · 转移与分流 (Reroute, Deflect, Sidetrack)
groups.tip: 改变路线或分流改道

items.def_zh: 使转轨，使分流；推托，搁置
items.def_en: 1. To move a train or carriage onto a side track or from one track to another. 2. To push someone or something aside to a less important place or task.
items.ex_en: Supervisors decided to shunt the controversial report onto a secondary subcommittee for delay.
items.ex_zh: 主管们决定将这份备受争议的报告推给一个二级小组委员会以搁置处理。

items.def_en: To direct or guide money, resources, or energy along a particular course
items.ex_en: The municipal charity will channel international emergency donations directly into rural flood relief.
items.ex_zh: 该市政慈善机构将把国际紧急捐款直接引导至农村洪灾救援工作中。

items.def_en: To cause something or someone to change direction or turn away from a course
items.ex_en: Police officers had to divert oncoming traffic around the hazardous multi-vehicle highway collision.
items.ex_zh: 警察不得不引导迎面而来的车流绕开高速公路上危险的连环相撞事故。

items.def_zh: 使偏斜；转移（批评、注意力）
items.def_en: To cause something to change direction after hitting it, or turn aside criticism or questions
items.ex_en: The polished spokesperson managed to deflect difficult investigative questions about executive corporate fraud.
items.ex_zh: 这位干练的发言人成功转移了关于高管公司欺诈的棘手调查性提问。
items.ex2_en: The speeding bullet deflected off the thick metal shield into the air.
items.ex2_zh: 飞驰的子弹从厚重的金属盾牌上弹开，飞入了空中。

items.def_en: To send traffic, funds, or goods along an alternative route
items.ex_en: Severe flash flooding prompted airport authorities to reroute all incoming international passenger flights.
items.ex_zh: 严重的突发山洪促使机场当局改变所有入境国际客运航班的航线。

items.def_en: To distract someone from the main subject or purpose with irrelevant issues
items.ex_en: Unresolved personal disputes threatened to sidetrack the committee from its essential budgetary objectives.
items.ex_zh: 悬而未决的私人纠纷可能会让委员会从其核心的预算目标上分心偏航。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures turning aside, redirecting, or pushing something or someone away from the primary trajectory or main priority into a secondary, alternate path.
groups.summary_zh: 指偏离主道或既定目标，将人、物或注意力转移、分流至旁支。
groups.desc_en: Involves deflecting an active flow, train of thought, or physical entity from its standard pathway, contrasting with outright stopping by redirecting toward an alternate conduit.
groups.desc_zh: 指将流动中的实体、注意力或流程从正轨导向备用或分支路径，与彻底“制止”不同，强调路径的重定向或移转。
groups.nuance_en: divert: turn away traffic, attention, or resources to an alternative channel (traffic / attention / funds) · deflect: bounce aside an incoming strike, criticism, or force (blow / criticism / question) · reroute: change the designated itinerary or transmission path (flight / pipeline / calls) · shunt: push an issue or cargo to an obscure sideline out of the main way (problem / passengers / train)
groups.nuance_zh: divert: 将流量、注意力或资金调转至替代通道 (traffic / attention / funds) · deflect: 使迎面而来的打击、质询或力量偏斜化解 (blow / criticism / question) · reroute: 重新规划指定交通或通信路线 (flight / pipeline / calls) · shunt: 将难题或车厢推向边缘旁轨以腾出主道 (problem / passengers / train)

groups.name: Divide & Alienate · 分裂与瓦解 (Alienate, Estrange, Fragment)
groups.tip: 破坏原有团结使之分裂

items.def_en: To break or cause to break into small, distinct, and disconnected parts
items.ex_en: Internal ideological disagreements caused the coalition to fragment into numerous hostile regional factions.
items.ex_zh: 内部意识形态分歧导致该联盟分裂成无数敌对的区域派系。
items.ex2_en: The ancient stone statue fragmented into small pieces after falling off the pedestal.
items.ex2_zh: 那座古老的石雕从底座上掉落后碎成了小块。

items.def_en: To cause someone to become unfriendly, hostile, or indifferent
items.ex_en: His dismissive public remarks threatened to alienate loyal voters right before the election.
items.ex_zh: 就在大选前夕，他轻蔑的公开言论可能疏远忠诚的选民。

items.def_en: To divide or split into smaller, weaker, conflicting groups
items.ex_en: Fierce competition caused the once united protest movement to splinter into radical sects.
items.ex_zh: 激烈的竞争导致曾经团结的抗议运动分裂为激进的派系。
items.ex2_en: Factional disputes splintered the once mighty political party into three rival factions.
items.ex2_zh: 派系争端将曾经强大的政党分裂成了三个敌对派别。

items.def_en: To cause something to split into two completely opposing camps or opinions
items.ex_en: The controversial new tax policy will polarize national voters along sharp economic lines.
items.ex_zh: 这项备受争议的新税收政策将使全国选民按明显的经济界限走向两极分化。
items.ex2_en: Public opinion began to polarize rapidly after the unexpected election results emerged.
items.ex2_zh: 出人意料的选举结果公布后，公众舆论开始迅速两极分化。

items.def_en: To cause someone to stop being friendly, close, or affectionate with another
items.ex_en: Bitter arguments over inheritance served to estrange the young heir from his family.
items.ex_zh: 关于遗产的激烈争吵使这位年轻的继承人与家人彻底疏远。

items.def_en: 1. (formal) To cause people, groups, or factions to separate, divide, or cease to be united.
items.ex_en: Religious and tribal rivalries threatened to disunite the fragile post-war coalition government completely.
items.ex_zh: 宗教与部落间的敌对冲突可能会彻底瓦解战后脆弱的联合政府。
items.ex2_en: The long-standing regional alliances disunited gradually under severe external diplomatic pressure.
items.ex2_zh: 在巨大的外部外交压力下，长期存在的地区联盟逐渐瓦解。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on breaking harmony, cohesion, or political solidarity, driving factions or individuals apart into discord.
groups.summary_zh: 指打破群体凝聚力或和谐，使之产生分歧、疏离乃至分裂瓦解。
groups.desc_en: Depicts the ideological or social fracture that drives allied elements into mutual hostility and isolation, contrasting with clean functional splitting by emphasizing relational bitterness.
groups.desc_zh: 指在意识形态或情感上制造裂痕，使同盟群体陷入相互敌对与疏离，不同于中性的功能分割，强调关系的决裂与对立。
groups.nuance_en: polarize: split a community into two irreconcilable extremes (opinion / society / electorate) · alienate: make once-sympathetic parties cold or hostile (allies / voters / friends) · estrange: rupture an intimate bond over time resulting in total emotional separation (family / spouse / child) · splinter: fracture a cohesive movement into tiny warring factions (party / faction / group)
groups.nuance_zh: polarize: 促使观点或群体两极对立、绝不妥协 (opinion / society / electorate) · alienate: 招致疏远或使原本支持者转为冷淡与敌意 (allies / voters / friends) · estrange: 因隔阂使亲密关系长期断裂乃至形同陌路 (family / spouse / child) · splinter: 使凝聚的组织脆断裂变为微小碎片派系 (party / faction / group)

groups.name: Divide & Segment · 分割与划分 (Partition, Subdivide, Compartmentalize)
groups.tip: 将整体切分成不同的独立部分

items.def_en: To separate a particular area or portion from the rest of a space
items.ex_en: Police sectioned off the street with tape while detectives examined the crime scene.
items.ex_zh: 当刑警勘查犯罪现场时，警方用警戒线将整条街道隔离开来。

items.def_en: To divide something into smaller constituent parts or categories
items.ex_en: The developers plan to subdivide the large rural estate into dozens of residential parcels.
items.ex_zh: 开发商计划将这片庞大的乡村地产细分成数十个住宅地块。
items.ex2_en: The main cellular structure will subdivide into several distinct operational compartments naturally.
items.ex2_zh: 主要的细胞结构会自然细分为几个不同的功能隔室。

items.def_en: To divide land or resources into separate smaller plots or shares
items.ex_en: The committee met to parcel out the remaining grant money among local applicants.
items.ex_zh: 委员会开会把剩余的拨款资金划分分配给当地的申请人。

items.def_en: To divide, partition, or split something into separate parts, sections, or segments.
items.ex_en: Marketing analysts segment consumer audiences into distinct demographics to refine targeted sales strategies.
items.ex_zh: 市场分析师将消费者群体细分为不同的人群特征，以完善定向销售策略。
items.ex2_en: The vast domestic consumer market segments naturally according to age and income.
items.ex2_zh: 庞大的国内消费市场会自然根据年龄和收入进行细分。

items.def_en: To divide a room, area, or country into separate parts with walls or borders
items.ex_en: Builders used temporary wooden dividers to partition the expansive warehouse into functional offices.
items.ex_zh: 建筑工人们用临时木制隔板将宽敞的仓库隔成多间实用的办公室。

items.def_en: To divide into separate, distinct, and non-overlapping sections or mental categories
items.ex_en: Seasoned emergency workers must learn to compartmentalize personal emotions during traumatic rescue operations.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的急救人员在创伤性的救援行动中必须学会将个人情感隔开。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe breaking down a continuous whole, market, or space into distinct, structured sections or categories. They emphasize deliberate organizational, structural, or analytical separation.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重将整体、空间或市场系统性地划分、拆解为若干独立部分。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the systematic division of a whole into bounded, manageable sections, contrasting with destruction by maintaining structural and organizational logic.
groups.desc_zh: 指按照系统逻辑将整体切分为具有清晰界限的管理单元，与破坏性解体不同，强调井然有序的结构性划分。
groups.nuance_en: segment: slice a market or continuum into demographically distinct units (market / audience / population) · partition: divide a physical territory or room with structural barriers (country / room / hard drive) · subdivide: break an already divided piece into smaller components (land / categories / lots) · compartmentalize: isolate mental concepts or tasks to prevent cross-contamination (emotions / life / mind)
groups.nuance_zh: segment: 将市场或连续体细分为特征明显的独立区段 (market / audience / population) · partition: 设立硬性物理或地缘隔断加以分割 (country / room / hard drive) · subdivide: 在已有细分基础上进行次级重组细切 (land / categories / lots) · compartmentalize: 将心理情绪或职责隔绝在独立抽屉内互不干扰 (emotions / life / mind)

groups.name: Dominate & Boss Around · 专横与辖制 (Boss around, Bully, Tyrannize)
groups.tip: 专横跋扈地支配与控制他人

items.def_en: To continuously tell someone what to do in an officious, domineering manner
items.ex_en: Nobody likes an arrogant colleague who tries to boss around everyone in the office.
items.ex_zh: 没人喜欢那种试图在办公室里对每个人都颐指气使的傲慢同事。

items.def_en: To behave in an arrogant, superior way toward others
items.ex_en: After receiving his promotion, Marcus began to lord it over his former teammates.
items.ex_zh: 升职之后，马库斯开始在以前的队友面前摆架子、作威作福。

items.def_en: To intimidate or bully someone into doing something using arrogant words or looks
