items.ex_en: The aggressive prosecutor attempted to browbeat the nervous witness into modifying her testimony.
items.ex_zh: 咄咄逼人的检察官试图威逼这名紧张的证人修改证词。

items.def_en: To act without any care or respect for the feelings, rights, or wishes of others
items.ex_en: The authoritarian mayor tends to ride roughshod over neighborhood community objections to developments.
items.ex_zh: 这位独断专行的市长往往蛮横无视附近社区对开发项目的反对意见。

items.def_en: (+ over) To rule, control, or treat subordinates with cruel and autocratic power
items.ex_en: The cruel warlord continued to tyrannize over impoverished villagers throughout the remote valley.
items.ex_zh: 残暴的军阀继续在整个偏远山谷中对贫困的村民施行暴虐统治。

items.def_zh: 专横跋扈，称王称霸；盛气凌人地控制
items.def_en: (+ over) To behave in an arrogant, bossy way, attempting to control others arbitrarily.
items.ex_en: The overbearing patriarch continued to domineer over his adult children and their households.
items.ex_zh: 这位专横的家族长辈继续对他的成年子女及其家庭横加干涉、专横统治。

groups.summary_en: This frame involves imposing one's will on others through overbearing attitudes, bullying, or autocratic control. Synonyms distinguish between casual browbeating, systematic tyranny, and petty micromanagement.
groups.summary_zh: 指态度专断、高高在上地管束、辖制或指使他人。
groups.desc_en: Portrays arrogant, overbearing micro-management through intimidation and unilateral will, contrasting with legitimate leadership by its despotic, humiliating manner.
groups.desc_zh: 指凭个人专断意志，通过威吓、践踏他人意愿实行作威作福的专横掌控，与正当“领导”不同，具有屈辱和专制特征。
groups.nuance_en: boss around: issue petty, nagging orders condescendingly (colleagues / siblings / staff) · browbeat: intimidate someone into compliance with gruff overbearing speech (witness / subordinates / opponent) · tyrannize: rule over others through cruelty and oppressive power (household / population / team) · ride roughshod over: arrogantly ignore others' rights, opinions, or objections (feelings / regulations / opposition)
groups.nuance_zh: boss around: 居高临下、琐碎傲慢地差遣他人 (colleagues / siblings / staff) · browbeat: 以声色俱厉的盛气凌人姿态威逼妥协 (witness / subordinates / opponent) · tyrannize: 施以严酷而窒息的暴虐式统治 (household / population / team) · ride roughshod over: 专横跋扈、肆意践踏他人的权益或规章 (feelings / regulations / opposition)

groups.name: Dominate & Control · 颐指气使与作威作福 (Boss, Dictate, Browbeat)
groups.tip: 以专断态度对他人呼来喝去

items.def_en: To continuously tell someone what to do in a domineering, arrogant, and irritating manner
items.ex_en: I absolutely refuse to let my overbearing elder brother boss me around anymore.
items.ex_zh: 我绝不再容忍我那专横的哥哥对我颐指气使、随意摆布。

items.def_en: To treat someone unfairly or contemptuously by giving them orders and exploiting their compliance
items.ex_en: Don't let them push you around; you have rights as a tenant.
items.ex_zh: 别让他们摆布你；作为租客你也是有权利的。

items.def_en: To act in a haughty, superior, and condescending way toward someone over whom one claims power
items.ex_en: He loved to lord it over younger apprentices whenever the master left the workshop.
items.ex_zh: 每当师傅离开作坊，他就喜欢在年轻学徒面前称王称霸、摆谱作态。

items.def_zh: 对……指手画脚，专横地发号施令
items.def_en: 1. (+ around/about) To tell people what to do in an overbearing, domineering, or annoying way.
items.ex_en: Stop trying to boss everyone around and just focus on your own assignment.
items.ex_zh: 别老想着对每个人发号施令，专心做你自己的任务吧。

items.def_en: To lay down rules, terms, or orders with authoritative imperiousness, admitting no dissent
items.ex_en: The conquering empire sought to dictate harsh peace terms to the defeated nation.
items.ex_zh: 这个征服帝国企图向战败国强加苛刻的和平条款。

items.def_en: To intimidate or bully someone through harsh, overbearing words or looks into doing what one wants
items.ex_en: The aggressive prosecutor attempted to browbeat the nervous witness into changing her testimony.
items.ex_zh: 盛气凌人的检控官试图用严词吓唬那个紧张的证人，迫使其改变证词。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures overbearing, petty, or tyrannical interpersonal control where one party relentlessly directs or bullies others. While 'boss around' focuses on obnoxious meddling and nagging commands, related verbs escalate into autocratic decreeing or coercive intimidation.
groups.summary_zh: 指专横跋扈、发号施令或以高压姿态强行摆布他人。
groups.desc_en: Scales the behavioral spectrum from self-important meddling to absolute dictation of terms over others, contrasting with egalitarian coordination by imposing hierarchical dominance.
groups.desc_zh: 刻画从爱指手画脚的自我膨胀到单向发号施令的霸道压制光谱，与平等协调相对，强调等级化的强权施压。
groups.nuance_en: boss: treat someone as a subordinate by issuing curt directives (junior staff / crew / teammates) · dictate: unilaterally impose non-negotiable terms (terms / policy / pace) · push around: bully and physically or psychologically shove weaker parties (weaker kids / tenants / rivals) · lord it over: flaunt superiority over others to make them feel small (peers / rivals / household)
groups.nuance_zh: boss: 摆领导架子对人呼来喝去 (junior staff / crew / teammates) · dictate: 单方面下达不容置疑的硬性规定 (terms / policy / pace) · push around: 仗势欺凌、随意拿捏弱者 (weaker kids / tenants / rivals) · lord it over: 趾高气扬地摆谱显摆以衬托自身优越 (peers / rivals / household)

groups.name: Dot & Pepper · 点缀与密集分布 (Disperse Marks or Entities as Accents Across an Expansive Backdrop)
groups.tip: 将细小物斑点状撒落或散布

items.def_zh: 使带有微小斑点，点缀斑点于
items.def_en: to mark a surface with tiny, minute spots or specks of color
items.ex_en: A few gray hairs began to fleck his dark temples as he aged.
items.ex_zh: 随着年龄增长，几缕白发开始点缀在他黝黑的鬓角。

items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To scatter or be spread across an area like small points. 2. To mark with a small dot.
items.ex_en: Picturesque white cottages dot the green hillside overlooking the quiet bay.
items.ex_zh: 风景如画的白色小屋散布在俯瞰宁静海湾的绿色山坡上。

items.def_en: to mark or cover something with a pattern of very small spots or marks
items.ex_en: Small dark freckles speckle her pale cheeks after spending afternoons in the sun.
items.ex_zh: 在阳光下度过几个午后，她苍白的脸颊上布满了细小的深色雀斑。

items.def_zh: 布满，散布；大量击打；给……加胡椒粉
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To scatter or distribute things thickly across an area. 2. To hit repeatedly with small objects. 3. To season food with pepper.
items.ex_en: Shrapnel fragments peppered the concrete wall during the unexpected explosion outside the base.
items.ex_zh: 基地外发生意外爆炸时，弹片密集地击打在混凝土墙面上。

items.def_zh: 镶嵌，密布于（如宝石或明显突起）
items.def_en: to cover or decorate a surface with many small, distinct, and prominent objects
items.ex_en: Gleaming golden rivets stud the heavy leather armor of the royal guard.
items.ex_zh: 皇家卫士厚重的皮甲上密布着闪闪发光的金色铆钉。

items.def_zh: 使满缀闪亮物，缀满（繁星、亮片）
items.def_en: (literary) to cover or adorn with sparkling, glittering spangles or lights
items.ex_en: Countless radiant stars bespangle the silent midnight sky above the desert.
items.ex_zh: 数不尽的璀璨繁星缀满了荒漠上方静谧的午夜天空。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this visual-distribution frame capture how entities appear as dispersed distinct marks across an expansive surface or scenery. 'Dot' emphasizes tiny, isolated spots across a landscape, while 'pepper' indicates high-density distribution like burst pellets hitting a target surface.
groups.summary_zh: 以离散点状或高密斑驳状分布并点缀于广阔背景之上。
groups.desc_en: Visualizes scattering small, contrasting entities or marks across a vast expanse, differing from thorough covering by leaving the primary backdrop clearly visible.
groups.desc_zh: 指在广阔底衬上稀疏或密集地点缀对比鲜明的微小痕迹或实体，与完全“覆盖”不同，底色始终清晰可见。
groups.nuance_en: dot: scatter visible entities sparsely across an expansive surface (landscape / sea / map) · pepper: bombard or scatter items forcefully and densely across a surface (audience with questions / report with facts / wall with shrapnel) · stud: embed prominent, decorative, or hard elements firmly across an area (sky with stars / leather with metal / coast with villas) · fleck: lightly mark a surface with tiny specks or color variations (hair with gray / foam with blood / canvas with gold)
groups.nuance_zh: dot: 在辽阔基底上呈孤立星散分布 (landscape / sea / map) · pepper: 密集、连珠炮似地散布或轰击 (audience with questions / report with facts / wall with shrapnel) · stud: 牢固镶嵌闪耀、突出或坚硬之物 (sky with stars / leather with metal / coast with villas) · fleck: 微量微小的色斑或斑屑浮贴点缀 (hair with gray / foam with blood / canvas with gold)

groups.name: Double & Pair · 倍增与成双 (Geminate, Double, Pair)
groups.tip: 成对形成或数量直接翻倍

items.def_en: To join two elements or entities together into a functioning pair
items.ex_en: Engineers couple the high-speed locomotive to the passenger carriages using reinforced steel links.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们用加固钢接头将高速机车与客车车厢连接成一体。
items.ex2_en: The specialized mechanical connectors couple automatically when the train carriages touch firmly.
items.ex2_zh: 当列车车厢紧密贴合时，专用机械连接器会自动联结。

items.def_en: To multiply or increase by two; to make twice as great or many
items.ex_en: The ambitious company plans to double its production output over the next two years.
items.ex_zh: 这家雄心勃勃的公司计划在未来两年内将其产量翻一番。
items.ex2_en: Our operational energy costs doubled unexpectedly during the severe winter storm season.
items.ex2_zh: 在严酷的冬季风暴期间，我们的运营能源成本出人意料地翻了一番。

items.def_en: (often + off/up) To join or arrange two things or individuals together as a set
items.ex_en: The teacher instructed the students to pair up for the science laboratory experiment.
items.ex_zh: 老师指示学生们结成搭档来进行科学实验室的实验。
items.ex2_en: The dance instructor paired skilled students with complete beginners for balance.
items.ex2_zh: 舞蹈教练将熟练的学生与初学者配对，以实现均衡。

items.def_en: To combine, link closely, or pair two complementary things together
items.ex_en: Ancient myths frequently twin profound sorrow with extraordinary spiritual renewal in their heroes.
items.ex_zh: 古老的神话往往将英雄深重的苦难与其非凡的心灵新生紧密交织在一起。

items.def_en: To make an exact copy of something or repeat an action identically
items.ex_en: Researchers struggled to duplicate the surprising laboratory results during subsequent controlled trials.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员在随后的对照试验中很难复制出那些惊人的实验室结果。

items.def_en: To arrange, produce, or occur in pairs; to double a speech sound or letter.
items.ex_en: Certain Semitic languages geminate medial consonants to signify intensive or causative verbal actions.
items.ex_zh: 某些闪米特语言通过使词中辅音成重叠双音来表示强化或使动意义。
items.ex2_en: The specific consonant sounds geminate automatically within this regional grammatical dialect.
items.ex2_zh: 在这一地区语法方言中，特定的辅音会自动双写发音。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on multiplying by two, arranging components into pairs, or creating identical dual counterparts across numerical, physical, and linguistic contexts.
groups.summary_zh: 表示数量翻倍、两两配对或形成双重对称的相叠变化。
groups.desc_en: Involves binding entities into a unified dual unit or replicating an original by a factor of two, contrasting with linear addition by enforcing mutual pairing or exact doubling.
groups.desc_zh: 指将实体结合为对称的双生单位，或在数量上使基数精准翻倍，不同于普通的单向累加，强调二元绑定或倍增。
groups.nuance_en: pair: match two complementary or compatible items together (wine with cheese / socks / dancers) · couple: link two elements together conceptually or physically to produce an effect (theory with practice / cars / talent with luck) · double: multiply an amount or size by two (profits / speed / size) · twin: establish a symmetrical reciprocal partnership between two entities (towns / concepts / engines)
groups.nuance_zh: pair: 将两件互补或匹配的物品/人物配对 (wine with cheese / socks / dancers) · couple: 物理或逻辑上将二者相连以产生合力 (theory with practice / cars / talent with luck) · double: 使数量、尺寸或强度翻倍 (profits / speed / size) · twin: 使两造结为对称对等、休戚与共的结对关系 (towns / concepts / engines)

groups.name: Downgrade & Demote · 降级与下调 (Demote, Depreciate, De-escalate)
groups.tip: 等级地位下滑或资产价值缩水

items.def_en: To reduce the price, grade, score, or assigned valuation of something.
items.ex_en: The department store marked down all winter coats by 40%.
items.ex_zh: 百货公司将所有冬季外套降价了40%。

items.def_en: To reduce the size, rate, tier, or extent of an operation or plan.
items.ex_en: The tech firm decided to scale down its global expansion amid economic uncertainty.
items.ex_zh: 在经济不确定的背景下，这家科技公司决定缩减其全球扩张规模。

items.def_en: To reduce or cause to become less intense, severe, dangerous, or militarized.
items.ex_en: Diplomats worked tirelessly throughout the night to de-escalate rising border tensions between rivals.
items.ex_zh: 外交官们彻夜不懈地努力，以缓和敌对双方不断加剧的边境紧张局势。
items.ex2_en: Violent territorial border clashes de-escalated quickly after mutual ceasefire agreements took effect.
items.ex2_zh: 在停火协议生效后，激烈的领土边境冲突迅速降级。

items.def_zh: 使降级，贬低；降低……的重要性
items.def_en: To reduce someone or something to a lower rank, rating, status, or level of importance.
items.ex_en: The credit agency chose to downgrade the troubled country's sovereign debt rating yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 该信用评级机构昨天决定下调这个陷入困境的涉事国家的主权债务评级。

items.def_en: (+ to) To place someone or something into a lower, less powerful, or less important category.
items.ex_en: The committee chose to relegate the controversial issue to an obscure subpanel.
items.ex_zh: 委员会决定将这一争议性议题降级移交至一个不起眼的分委会处理。

items.def_en: To move someone to a lower rank, position, or tier of responsibility, often as a punishment.
items.ex_en: The commander decided to demote the negligent officer to the rank of sergeant.
items.ex_zh: 指挥官决定将这名失职的军官降职为中士。

groups.summary_en: This frame addresses reducing someone or something from an established rank, classification, security alert, or official credit rating to a lower one. 'Downgrade' often targets formal ratings and estimates, whereas 'demote' specifically lowers occupational hierarchy.
groups.summary_zh: 指官方或系统性地将职位、资信评级或危险等级向下调动。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on intentional downward revision in status, rank, or threat level across an established hierarchy, contrasting with accidental decline by being an authoritative decree.
groups.desc_zh: 指权威机构或主体依层级秩序主动向下调降等级、评级或烈度，与被动的衰落不同，强调自上而下的制度性贬抑。
groups.nuance_en: downgrade: lower the formal assessment, status, or credit rating of an asset (bonds / outlook / system) · demote: strip an employee or soldier of rank and move them down (officer / employee / player) · relegate: banish someone or something to an inferior, obscure position (to the bench / to lower division / to footnote) · de-escalate: systematically lower the temperature and intensity of a conflict (tensions / conflict / rhetoric)
groups.nuance_zh: downgrade: 官方下调资产或系统的信用与资质评级 (bonds / outlook / system) · demote: 纪律性剥夺头衔职位并降级降职 (officer / employee / player) · relegate: 放逐、降入次级联赛或打入冷宫 (to the bench / to lower division / to footnote) · de-escalate: 策略性降低对抗与冲突的白热化程度 (tensions / conflict / rhetoric)

groups.name: Drain & Empty · 排空与清空 (Drain, Evacuate, Clear out)
groups.tip: 放干积水或倒空内部所盛物

items.def_en: To make a space empty by removing all unwanted or stored objects from inside it
items.ex_en: We spent all Saturday morning helping him clear out his cluttered attic.
items.ex_zh: 我们整个周六上午都在帮他清理杂乱无章的阁楼以腾出空间。

items.def_zh: 排空，倒空；变空；流入（大海或河流）
items.def_en: 1. To remove everything from a container or space. 2. To become empty. 3. (of a river) To flow into a larger body of water.
items.ex_en: She rushed home after work to empty the dirty recycling bins into containers.
items.ex_zh: 她下班后匆忙赶回家，将脏兮兮的分类垃圾桶倒进大垃圾箱里。
items.ex2_en: The bustling sports stadium emptied within minutes after the final whistle blew.
items.ex2_zh: 终场哨声响起后，熙熙攘攘的体育场在几分钟内就空了。

items.def_en: To remove liquid completely from a container or space, or to become completely dry of liquid
items.ex_en: Workers must drain the swimming pool completely before applying a fresh coat of paint.
items.ex_zh: 工人们在涂刷新漆之前，必须彻底排空泳池里的水。
items.ex2_en: Soapy bath water drained away quickly down the narrow porcelain tub pipe.
items.ex2_zh: 带有肥皂沫的洗澡水顺着狭窄的瓷浴缸管道迅速排空了。

items.def_en: To empty or discharge the contents of the bladder or bowels
items.ex_en: The nurse instructed the post-surgery patient to void his bladder before discharge.
items.ex_zh: 护士嘱咐这名术后病人在出院前先排空膀胱。

items.def_en: To empty the contents of a container, organ, or vessel, especially by removing gas, air, or bodily waste
items.ex_en: Technicians use a vacuum pump to evacuate all air from the sealed glass chamber.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员使用真空泵将密封玻璃室内的所有空气彻底抽空。

items.def_en: To completely strip or remove the internal contents, structure, or fittings of a building or room
items.ex_en: The builders plan to gut the entire Victorian mansion before beginning extensive renovations.
items.ex_zh: 建筑工人们计划在开始大规模翻新前，将整座维多利亚式老宅的内部彻底掏空。

groups.summary_en: Covers removing the entire contents from a container, vessel, room, or space. 'Empty' is generic, while 'drain' focuses on liquid runoff, 'evacuate' implies complete systematic removal or bodily excretion, and 'clear out' stresses physical decluttering.
groups.summary_zh: 指将容器、空间或系统内的液体、物品完全排出或腾空。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the thorough extraction or voiding of internal contents until a receptacle is completely hollow, contrasting with superficial cleaning by its total internal voiding.
groups.desc_zh: 指将容器或空间内的内容物彻底抽干或排空至中空状态，与表层清洁不同，强调内部赋存物的彻底剥离与腾空。
groups.nuance_en: drain: draw off liquid or exhaust energy gradually until depleted (swamp / battery / resources) · evacuate: urgently remove inhabitants from a dangerous zone, or empty internal pressure (civilians / building / bowels) · clear out: vacate a room or space by removing clutter and junk (closet / attic / desk) · gut: violently hollow out the entire interior of a structure or argument (building / policy / fish)
groups.nuance_zh: drain: 循序渐进抽干液体或耗尽能量储备 (swamp / battery / resources) · evacuate: 因危急情势对人员实施疏散撤离，或排空内部压力 (civilians / building / bowels) · clear out: 将房间或隔层内的杂物腾空搬净 (closet / attic / desk) · gut: 摧毁或完全掏空建筑物、政策的核心内部构造 (building / policy / fish)

groups.name: Drape & Arrange · 垂挂与搭覆 (Swathe, Sling, Enfold)
groups.tip: 系于高处或自然垂落

items.def_en: To extend or open out cloth or a covering smoothly across a surface
items.ex_en: She carefully spread the embroidered tablecloth over the long dining table before dinner.
items.ex_zh: 开饭前，她小心翼翼地把绣花台布平铺在长长的餐桌上。

items.def_en: To attach or place a garment or cloth so that it falls freely without touching the floor
items.ex_en: Please hang your wet trench coat in the closet near the front entrance.
items.ex_zh: 请把你的湿风衣挂在靠近正门玄关处的衣橱里。

items.def_zh: 披，搭；悬挂（布帘等），覆以褶帘
items.def_en: To hang or place cloth, clothing, or a body part loosely and gracefully over or around something.
items.ex_en: She chose to drape a soft velvet shawl loosely over her bare shoulders.
items.ex_zh: 她选择将一条柔软的丝绒披肩随意而优雅地搭在裸露的双肩上。

items.def_en: To suspend or hang something loosely over a shoulder or support in a casual way
items.ex_en: He casually slung his heavy leather backpack over one shoulder and walked out.
items.ex_zh: 他随意地把沉重的皮质背包往单肩上一挎，便迈步走了出去。

items.def_en: To cover or envelop someone or something completely so as to hide from view
items.ex_en: Thick coastal fog began to shroud the towering cliffs in total eerie silence.
items.ex_zh: 浓郁的海岸大雾开始在诡谲的寂静中将高耸的悬崖完全遮蔽掩盖。

items.def_en: To wrap, envelop, or drape someone or something in layers of cloth or bandages
items.ex_en: Nurses gently swathed the injured soldier's chest in sterile white linen bandages.
items.ex_zh: 护士们用无菌白色亚麻绷带轻柔地将伤兵的胸口紧紧包裹起来。

groups.summary_en: This frame involves placing fabric, clothing, or limbs loosely, elegantly, or casually over a surface, furniture, or another body part, focusing on the graceful folds or relaxed posture created.
groups.summary_zh: 轻柔、自然或优雅地将织物或肢体搭披在某物上。
groups.desc_en: Depicts placing flexible, hanging material loosely over a form so it falls under gravity in relaxed folds, contrasting with taut wrapping by its fluid, loose posture.
groups.desc_zh: 指将柔软材质松散搭覆于形态之上，任其因重力自然下垂并形成褶皱，与紧绷的“包裹”不同，强调松弛垂悬的姿态。
groups.nuance_en: drape: arrange cloth loosely over a frame or body in elegant folds (garment / fabric / flag) · sling: loosely hang or cast a flexible item across a support (bag over shoulder / arm in a sling / hammock) · swathe: wrap completely in extensive folds of binding material (mummy / body in bandages / hills in mist) · shroud: obscure or cover darkly and impenetrably from view (corpse / mystery / mountain in fog)
groups.nuance_zh: drape: 使织物在物体或身躯上优雅自然地下垂悬覆 (garment / fabric / flag) · sling: 随性将带状物或肢体斜跨、斜吊在支撑点上 (bag over shoulder / arm in a sling / hammock) · swathe: 用层层叠叠的布匹或介质将整体重重裹缚 (mummy / body in bandages / hills in mist) · shroud: 如同裹尸布般严密、阴森地遮蔽掩盖 (corpse / mystery / mountain in fog)

groups.name: Drift & Wander · 漂流与流徙 (Meander, Stray, Waft)
groups.tip: 在水面或空气中漂动

items.def_en: To float or live aimlessly without putting forward clear deliberate direction
items.ex_en: After leaving his job, he seemed content to drift along without ambitious goals.
items.ex_zh: 离职之后，他似乎很满足于这种毫无雄心壮志、随波逐流的生活。

items.def_en: To walk or move around casually with no fixed destination or route
items.ex_en: Tourists love to wander through the labyrinthine cobblestone alleys of the historic district.
items.ex_zh: 游客们喜欢在历史街区迷宫般的鹅卵石小巷中悠闲漫步。

items.def_zh: 漂流，漂移；漂泊，无目的地游荡
items.def_en: 1. To be carried along slowly and gently by currents of water or air. 2. (+ into/toward) To move, change, or live aimlessly from one situation or place to another.
items.ex_en: Discarded wooden fishing boats drift slowly across the calm surface of the misty lake.
items.ex_zh: 废弃的木制渔船在薄雾笼罩的平静湖面上缓缓漂流。

items.def_en: To move away unintentionally from a group, path, or expected bounds
items.ex_en: A young lamb managed to stray away from the flock during the storm.
items.ex_zh: 暴风雨期间，一只小羊不慎脱离了羊群偏离走失。

items.def_en: To follow a winding, turning course without an urgent or direct heading
items.ex_en: The shallow mountain stream meanders lazily through the lush green summer meadows.
items.ex_zh: 浅浅的山涧小溪懒洋洋地蜿蜒流过夏季郁郁葱葱的草甸。

items.def_en: To move or be carried lightly and smoothly through the air or over water
items.ex_en: Delicate floral scents waft through the open French windows on gentle evening breezes.
items.ex_zh: 伴着轻柔的晚风，阵阵怡人的花香悄然飘进敞开的落地窗。
items.ex2_en: Gentle morning breezes wafted the pleasant aroma of freshly brewed coffee outside.
items.ex2_zh: 清晨温柔的微风将现煮咖啡的怡人香气吹送到了室外。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures unhurried, directionless movement driven by external currents, winds, or a lack of definite purpose. Agents or objects float along passively or wander off course.
groups.summary_zh: 指随风浪漂荡或漫无目的、随遇而安地缓步移动。
groups.desc_en: Denotes aimless, passive, or winding motion guided by external currents or lack of intent, contrasting with directed purposeful locomotion.
groups.desc_zh: 表示缺乏明确目标、随外力流动或心无定所的被动游移，区别于有明确方向和意图的定向行进。
groups.nuance_en: drift: passive floating carriage by currents (snow / current / crowd) · wander: aimless roaming over land without fixed route (streets / mind / gaze) · stray: wandering away from a designated path or moral bounds (sheep / path / topic) · meander: circuitous, winding progression (river / conversation / path) · waft: gentle airborne flotation on breezes (scent / smoke / music)
groups.nuance_zh: drift: 随波逐流或随风漂泊 (snow / current / crowd) · wander: 漫无目的地闲逛流连 (streets / mind / gaze) · stray: 偏离正道或走失 (sheep / path / topic) · meander: 迂回曲折地蜿蜒而行 (river / conversation / path) · waft: 乘微风轻盈飘送 (scent / smoke / music)

groups.name: Drink Copiously · 豪饮与嗜酒 (Quaff, Imbibe, Guzzle)
groups.tip: 贪杯嗜饮或大口痛快饮酒

items.def_en: To drink alcoholic beverages habitually or frequently, typically in small amounts over time.
items.ex_en: The elderly country squire loved to tipple dry sherry quietly by the fireside.
items.ex_zh: 这位年迈的乡村乡绅酷爱在壁炉旁静静小酌几口干雪莉酒。

items.def_en: (archaic) To drink alcoholic beverages frequently or excessively.
items.ex_en: Roguish tavern regulars would bib ale until the small hours of the morning.
items.ex_zh: 酒馆里那些放荡不羁的常客总会放肆痛饮麦酒，直到凌晨时分。

items.def_en: To drink alcohol or other liquids, especially in a formal, literary, or humorous context.
items.ex_en: Dignified guests gathered on the terrace to imbibe fine vintage champagne after speeches.
items.ex_zh: 致辞结束后，尊贵的宾客们聚集在露台上细细品饮上等的陈年香槟。

items.def_en: To quickly drink an alcoholic beverage down in one continuous gulp.
items.ex_en: He leaned against the wooden counter and knocked back his whiskey in one gulp.
items.ex_zh: 他倚靠在木质吧台上，一仰脖把威士忌咕咚喝了个精光。

items.def_en: To drink an alcoholic or flavorful beverage heartily, enthusiastically, and in large gulps.
items.ex_en: Thirsty travelers stopped at the village inn to quaff large flagons of cider.
items.ex_zh: 口渴的旅客们在乡村客栈停下脚步，痛快畅饮大壶的苹果酒。

items.def_en: To drink or eat quickly, eagerly, and in large quantities in a greedy or noisy manner.
items.ex_en: The hungry teenagers guzzled cold soda right from the bottle after soccer practice.
items.ex_zh: 足球训练结束后，饥渴的少年们抓起冰镇汽水直接对着瓶口大口狂灌。

groups.summary_en: This frame describes consuming alcohol or liquids in copious amounts, with gusto, or with chronic abandon. While 'quaff' highlights energetic, hearty draughts and 'guzzle' stresses greedy, unrefined ingestion, 'imbibe' offers a formal or euphemistic alternative.
groups.summary_zh: 指大口吞咽、大量纵饮或长年贪杯酗酒的行为模式。
groups.desc_en: Denotes consuming alcoholic beverages copiously, greedily, or habitually, contrasting with ordinary, moderate drinking or sipping.
groups.desc_zh: 表示大量、贪婪或习惯性地豪饮烈酒，区别于普通的一般饮水或小口慢啜。
groups.nuance_en: tipple: habitual, steady indulgence in small alcoholic drinks (whisky / wine) · imbibe: formal absorption of alcohol or metaphorical uptake of ideas (liquor / culture / wisdom) · knock back: rapid, casual gulping down of an alcoholic drink (pint / shot / beer) · quaff: hearty, enthusiastic drinking in deep draughts (ale / cider / wine) · guzzle: voracious, undisciplined, and greedy swallowing (beer / soda / fuel)
groups.nuance_zh: tipple: 经常性嗜酒、微醺独酌 (whisky / wine) · imbibe: 典雅书面语，饮酒或引申为吸纳思想 (liquor / culture / wisdom) · knock back: 豪爽迅速地一饮而尽 (pint / shot / beer) · quaff: 痛快大口畅饮 (ale / cider / wine) · guzzle: 贪婪无节制地暴饮狂灌 (beer / soda / fuel)

groups.name: Drip & Drizzle · 滴沥与微淌 (Trickle, Drip, Seep)
groups.tip: 液体点滴掉落或下细雨

items.def_zh: 下毛毛雨；淋撒，淋浇（液体）
items.def_en: 1. When it drizzles, fine, light rain falls steadily. 2. (+ over/with) To pour a thin stream of liquid gently over food.
items.ex_en: The chef began to drizzle rich extra virgin olive oil over the warm salad.
items.ex_zh: 主厨开始把浓郁的特级初榨橄榄油缓缓淋浇在温热的沙拉上。
items.ex2_en: Cold autumn rain continued to drizzle softly over the quiet mountain village.
items.ex2_zh: 寒冷的秋雨继续静静地下在宁静的山村上空。

items.def_en: To fall in small liquid drops, or let liquid fall in this manner
items.ex_en: Melting icicles drip cold water steadily from the tiled eaves of the roof.
items.ex_zh: 融化的冰凌正从屋顶的瓦檐上不断地滴落冰冷的水珠。
items.ex2_en: The clumsy laboratory assistant dripped dangerous acidic chemicals onto the wooden bench.
items.ex2_zh: 笨手笨脚的实验室助手把危险的酸性化学品滴在了木台上。

items.def_en: To flow or make liquid flow slowly in a very thin, gentle stream
items.ex_en: Tears began to trickle down her pale cheeks as the sad song played.
items.ex_zh: 随着悲伤的歌声响起，泪水开始从她苍白的脸颊上无声细淌。
items.ex2_en: The gardener trickled fresh rainwater slowly over the delicate indoor bonsai tree.
items.ex2_zh: 园丁将新鲜雨水缓缓浇淋在娇嫩的室内盆栽上。

items.def_en: To flow or leak slowly through small openings or porous material
items.ex_en: Toxic chemicals began to seep slowly through the cracked containment walls underground.
items.ex_zh: 有毒化学物质开始透过地下出现裂缝的防护墙缓慢渗出。

items.def_zh: 稀疏溅落；洒上零星雨点
items.def_en: To scatter or fall in tiny, distinct droplets across a surface
items.ex_en: Sudden raindrops began to spatter noisily against the dusty living room windowpanes.
items.ex_zh: 骤起的零星雨点开始噼里啪啦地稀疏溅落在积满灰尘的客厅窗玻璃上。
items.ex2_en: The careless chef spattered hot cooking oil across the clean kitchen walls.
items.ex2_zh: 粗心的厨师把滚烫的食用油溅到了干净的厨房墙壁上。

items.def_en: To pass or cause liquid to pass slowly through fine pores or a filter
items.ex_en: Hot water must slowly percolate through finely ground coffee beans to extract rich flavor.
items.ex_zh: 热水必须缓慢地渗透滤过细磨咖啡豆，方能萃取出浓郁的风味。
items.ex2_en: The barista percolates boiling water through dark coffee grounds every single morning.
items.ex2_zh: 咖啡师每天早晨都会将沸水过滤注入深色咖啡粉中。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey liquids moving or falling in tiny, fine quantities or thin streams rather than gushing torrents. They often depict delicate precipitation or slow culinary drizzling.
groups.summary_zh: 指液体以极细水流、微雨或水滴形式缓慢滴落或淌流。
groups.desc_en: Denotes fluid movement occurring in small drops, slender streams, or slow permeation, contrasting with forceful gushing or steady pouring.
groups.desc_zh: 表示液体以点滴、细流或缓慢渗透的形式释出，区别于汹涌喷射或倾盆泼洒。
groups.nuance_en: drip: falling in distinct, intermittent droplets (faucet / sweat / candle) · trickle: flowing in a thin, sluggish, fragile stream (stream / tear / blood) · seep: slow oozing through tiny pores or hidden gaps (oil / moisture / poison) · percolate: gradual filtration through a porous medium or slow spread through a group (coffee / water / ideas) · spatter: scattering in small, forceful droplets upon impact (mud / rain / grease)
groups.nuance_zh: drip: 间断成颗下滴 (faucet / sweat / candle) · trickle: 细细缓缓地涓涓流淌 (stream / tear / blood) · seep: 经由微孔缝隙缓慢渗漏 (oil / moisture / poison) · percolate: 过滤渗透，引申为观念缓慢扩散 (coffee / water / ideas) · spatter: 飞溅散落成零星污渍 (mud / rain / grease)

groups.name: Drop with a Sound · 扑通落下与钝响掉落 (Plop, Plunk, Thud, Flump)
groups.tip: 脱离支撑垂直掉落

items.def_zh: 软塌塌地倒下，噗通躺下
items.def_en: fall, lie, or sit down heavily and awkwardly due to exhaustion or limpness
items.ex_en: Exhausted after the marathon, she could only flop onto the living room sofa.
items.ex_zh: 跑完马拉松精疲力竭的她，只能软塌塌地噗通瘫倒在客厅沙发上。

items.def_zh: 扑通落下；扑通扔下，沉重地放下
items.def_en: to fall or drop heavily into water or onto a soft surface with a short, hollow sound, or to drop something in this way
items.ex_en: Heavy pebbles plop into the deep garden pond, sending ripples across the surface.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的石子扑通一声落入幽深的花园水池，在水面上荡开圈圈涟漪。
items.ex2_en: She plopped the large sugar cubes carelessly into her hot herbal tea.
items.ex2_zh: 她漫不经心地把大块方糖扑通扔进了热花草茶里。

items.def_en: drop or deposit heavy objects abruptly and carelessly onto a surface
items.ex_en: Tired commuters dump down their heavy grocery bags onto the hard kitchen floor.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的通勤者们把沉重的食品杂物袋重重地扑通扔在坚硬的厨房地板上。

items.def_en: fall or drop heavily with a dull, soft thud onto a bed, sofa, or floor
items.ex_en: Weary from traveling, he flumped heavily onto the soft hotel mattress with relief.
items.ex_zh: 旅途劳顿的他如释重负，噗通一声沉沉跌倒在柔软的酒店床垫上。
items.ex2_en: Exhausted from heavy work, he flumped his heavy leather backpack onto the floor.
items.ex2_zh: 繁重工作后疲惫不堪的他，把沉重的皮背包沉重地摔在地上。

items.def_en: fall or strike heavily against something with a low, dull acoustic impact
items.ex_en: The thick encyclopedia fell off the table and thudded loudly against the floor.
items.ex_zh: 那本厚重的百科全书从桌上掉落，砰然沉重地砸在地板上。

items.def_en: drop abruptly or heavily onto a surface with a hollow sound, or set down carelessly
items.ex_en: He plunked his heavy tool crate onto the workbench with an impatient sigh.
items.ex_zh: 他叹了口不耐烦的气，沉重地把笨重的工具箱砰的一声扔在工作台上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe falling or deliberately dropping into liquid, soft bedding, or onto a surface with a distinct sound—such as a watery splash or a dull, heavy thud. They emphasize the auditory feedback and the ungraceful, relaxed physical impact.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体或身体掉落入水或软垫上，并伴随特有扑通声或沉闷钝响的动作。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an object or body falling or collapsing with a characteristic auditory impact, contrasting with silent, controlled lowering.
groups.desc_zh: 表示物体或身体脱力下坠并发出特定撞击钝响，区别于无声受控的缓慢放置。
groups.nuance_en: plop: dropping into water or a soft surface with a hollow, gentle sound (stone / coin / mud) · plunk: dropping or setting down abruptly with a sharp, resonant sound (guitar / money / bag) · thud: striking a solid surface heavily with a dull, low-pitched sound (body / crate / bass) · flop: collapsing or falling loosely, heavily, and clumsily (exhaustion / body / fish) · flump: dropping or falling heavily with a dull, soft thump (armchair / body / cushions)
groups.nuance_zh: plop: 噗通落水或掉入泥中之轻响 (stone / coin / mud) · plunk: 突兀沉重且发出清脆回响地丢下 (guitar / money / bag) · thud: 沉重钝击发出的闷响 (body / crate / bass) · flop: 笨拙无力地瘫倒跌落 (exhaustion / body / fish) · flump: 软绵绵且发闷地颓然坐下或倒下 (armchair / body / cushions)

groups.name: Drug & Sedate · 麻醉与给药致昏 (Sedate, Anesthetize, Tranquilize)
groups.tip: 使用药物致人昏睡麻木

items.def_zh: 给……下药；使服麻醉药，麻醉
items.def_en: To give a drug to a person or animal, especially in order to make them sleepy or unconscious.
items.ex_en: The nervous kidnapper tried to drug the restless hostage using a spiked drink.
items.ex_zh: 神情紧张的绑匪试图用掺了药的饮料给躁动不安的人质下药使其昏睡。

items.def_zh: 对…下药；使服兴奋剂或麻醉药
items.def_en: To give someone or an animal drugs to affect their performance or render them unconscious
items.ex_en: Unscrupulous trainers were caught trying to dope the racehorse before the championship final.
items.ex_zh: 不择手段的驯马师在锦标赛决赛前试图对赛马下药，结果被当场抓获。

items.def_en: To administer a drug to a patient or animal to reduce agitation and promote calm or sleep
items.ex_en: Physicians decided to sedate the agitated intensive care patient to allow proper rest.
items.ex_zh: 医生们决定给这位狂躁不安的重症监护患者注射镇静剂，以便其充分休息。

items.def_en: To calm or subdue a person or dangerous animal using a pharmacological tranquilizer
items.ex_en: Wildlife rangers used a dart to tranquilize the escaped bear safely in town.
items.ex_zh: 野生动物巡护员使用麻醉镖在镇上安全地将那只逃跑的熊打晕镇定。

items.def_en: To cause someone to become unconscious or deeply asleep through medicine or drugs
items.ex_en: Our team was knocked out of the tournament in the quarter-finals.
items.ex_zh: 我们队在四分之一决赛中被淘汰出局。

items.def_en: To give a chemical substance to induce insensibility to pain before surgery
items.ex_en: The experienced surgeon prepared to anesthetize the patient before initiating the complex procedure.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的外科医生在开始这项复杂的手术前，做好了给病人实施麻醉的准备。

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies the administration of pharmaceuticals or chemical agents to deliberately calm, dull consciousness, induce sleep, or eliminate sensation. Clinical terms like 'anesthetize' contrast with clinical-yet-coercive terms like 'tranquilize' or 'knock out'.
groups.summary_zh: 指使用药物使其镇静、麻痹知觉或陷入昏睡。
groups.desc_en: Denotes chemically or pharmacologically subduing, calming, or rendering unconscious, contrasting with psychological calming or physical restraint.
groups.desc_zh: 表示通过化学或药物手段使人或动物镇静、昏睡或丧失知觉，区别于心理安抚或机械物理束缚。
groups.nuance_en: drug: administering substances to induce stupor or insensibility, often nefariously (drink / victim / racehorse) · sedate: calming or inducing sleepiness through clinical medicine (patient / animal / nerves) · tranquilize: relieving acute agitation or immobilizing wildlife via central nervous system depressants (tiger / patient / elephant) · anesthetize: inducing total or localized insensibility to surgical pain (patient / limb / consciousness) · knock out: rendering completely unconscious via heavy chemical dose or physical blow (boxer / painkiller / patient)
groups.nuance_zh: drug: 下药致昏或下药控制 (drink / victim / racehorse) · sedate: 临床施用镇静剂以缓解焦虑 (patient / animal / nerves) · tranquilize: 麻醉镇定以平息躁狂或制服野兽 (tiger / patient / elephant) · anesthetize: 施用麻醉剂使丧失痛觉或知觉 (patient / limb / consciousness) · knock out: 强力致昏或打晕 (boxer / painkiller / patient)

groups.name: Early Type & Symbolic Foreshadowing · 原型映射与征兆预示 (Prefigure, Foreshadow, Presage)
groups.tip: 言语或征兆提前预示未来

items.def_en: To foreshadow faintly or sketch the partial outline of a future reality
items.ex_en: His prophetic early essays adumbrate the major themes of his later philosophical masterwork.
items.ex_zh: 他那些极具预见性的早期散文，隐约勾勒出了他晚年哲学巨著的主题雏形。

items.def_en: To act as an early warning or symbolic sign of a future event in a narrative or history
items.ex_en: Ominous storm clouds gathering above the fortress foreshadow the tragic demise of the king.
items.ex_zh: 堡垒上方聚集的不祥风暴云层，在叙事中隐隐预示了国王的悲剧性陨落。

items.def_en: (+ well/ill) To be an omen of a specific outcome in the future
items.ex_en: The abrupt resignation of the foreign minister does not bode well for peace.
items.ex_zh: 外交部长的突然辞职绝非和平的好兆头。

items.def_en: To serve as a portent, omen, or forewarning of a future event (often unwelcome)
items.ex_en: Dark financial indicators presage another prolonged period of severe global economic recession.
items.ex_zh: 暗淡的金融指标预示着全球经济即将迎来又一段漫长而严重的衰退期。

items.def_en: To be a sign or warning that something momentous, calamitous, or unpleasant is likely to happen
items.ex_en: Those ominous dark clouds and eerie silences portend an approaching violent storm across the valley.
items.ex_zh: 那些不祥的乌云与诡异的死寂，预示着山谷间一场狂暴的风暴即将来临。

items.def_en: (formal) to be an early sign, model, or indication of something that will happen or exist later
items.ex_en: His early revolutionary writings prefigure the radical political reforms of the following turbulent decade.
items.ex_zh: 他早期的革命著作预示了随后动荡十年的激进政治改革。

groups.summary_en: This literary and symbolic frame focuses on early events, textual elements, or structural antecedents that represent, mirror, or ominous anticipate a subsequent climax, historical occurrence, or thematic realization.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重文艺隐喻、历史原型对后续发展、高潮或恶兆在象征或结构层面的映射与先兆预显。
groups.desc_en: Denotes serving as a prior symbolic counterpart or omen of a future reality, contrasting with explicit, evidence-based scientific prediction.
groups.desc_zh: 表示作为原初形态、象征符号或凶吉征兆预兆未来，区别于基于数据的严密科学推算。
groups.nuance_en: prefigure: serving as an early prototype, model, or conceptual preview (modernism / movement / future) · foreshadow: subtle dramatic hinting at future narrative developments (disaster / twist / doom) · presage: serving as an intuitive sign or portent of an outcome (crisis / storm / decline) · portend: gravely warning of momentous or disastrous future events (calamity / war / collapse) · adumbrate: faintly sketching or shadowing forth embryonic features (theory / reforms / outline)
groups.nuance_zh: prefigure: 在形态或构想上作为先驱雏形 (modernism / movement / future) · foreshadow: 文学或叙事中对后文伏笔隐喻 (disaster / twist / doom) · presage: 显露事物发展的预兆迹象 (crisis / storm / decline) · portend: 庄严预示灾难性重大后果 (calamity / war / collapse) · adumbrate: 隐约勾勒雏形或预示轮廓 (theory / reforms / outline)

groups.name: Eat Greedily & Devour · 狼吞虎咽与暴食 (Gobble, Devour, Scarf down)
groups.tip: 如狼似虎般快速吞食大嚼

items.def_en: To gulp or swallow food hurriedly without chewing properly
items.ex_en: Running desperately late for work, he bolted his breakfast and rushed out the door.
items.ex_zh: 因为上班快要迟到了，他囫囵吞下早餐便冲出了家门。

items.def_zh: 囫囵吞下；狼吞虎咽吃完
items.def_en: To eat something up very rapidly, voraciously, and eagerly
items.ex_en: Starving after football practice, the teenagers scarfed down two large pepperoni pizzas within minutes.
items.ex_zh: 橄榄球训练后饿极了的少年们几分钟内就狼吞虎咽地吃光了两大盒意式辣香肠披萨。

items.def_en: 1. (often wolf down) To eat food quickly, greedily, and eagerly.
items.ex_en: He was so famished that he wolfed down his entire burger in three bites.
items.ex_zh: 他饿坏了，三口两口就把整只汉堡狼吞虎咽地吃了下去。

items.def_en: To eat up hungrily, voraciously, and greedily
items.ex_en: The famished hikers devoured the warm meal the moment they arrived at the mountain lodge.
items.ex_zh: 饥肠辘辘的徒步者们一到达山间小屋，就狼吞虎咽地吃光了热气腾腾的饭菜。

items.def_en: (often gobble up/down) To swallow food quickly and noisily in large chunks
items.ex_en: The boy quickly gobbled up his dessert before his older brother could ask for some.
items.ex_zh: 那个男孩赶在哥哥开口索要之前，三两口大口吞食光了自己的甜点。

items.def_en: (+ on) To stuff oneself with huge quantities of food greedily until full
items.ex_en: During the holiday feast, the guests gorged on roasted turkey and sweet desserts all night.
items.ex_zh: 在节日宴席上，宾客们整晚都在大吃烤火鸡与甜点，直到肚儿滚圆。

groups.summary_en: Highlights ingesting nourishment with extreme speed, animalistic hunger, rapacious greed, or a total disregard for social dining manners.
groups.summary_zh: 强调极度饥饿或贪食之下，以飞快、贪婪的动作将食物吞食一空。
groups.desc_en: Denotes consuming food rapidly, rapaciously, or in excessive quantities, contrasting with polite, measured, or delicate eating.
groups.desc_zh: 表示急切、凶猛或超量进食的失态暴食行为，区别于彬彬有礼的细嚼慢咽。
groups.nuance_en: devour: eating with ravenous, destructive hunger, or consuming greedily (meal / prey / book) · gobble: swallowing rapidly in large, noisy mouthfuls (turkey / lunch / food) · wolf: tearing through and gulping food down with animalistic speed (dinner / pizza / burger) · gorge: stuffing oneself to surfeited excess (chocolates / food / pastries) · scarf down: informal rapid gulping down of a meal (sandwich / breakfast / fries)
groups.nuance_zh: devour: 狼吞虎咽地吞食，引申为如饥似渴地吸纳 (meal / prey / book) · gobble: 仓促大口咯咯吞食 (turkey / lunch / food) · wolf: 如狼撕咬般迅疾吞下 (dinner / pizza / burger) · gorge: 毫无节制地暴饮暴食吃到撑胀 (chocolates / food / pastries) · scarf down: 口语中急急忙忙风卷残云般扒光 (sandwich / breakfast / fries)

groups.name: Echo & Sympathetic Resonance · 附和、呼应与顺从 (Resonate, Chime with, Second)
groups.tip: 机械重复或随声附和

items.def_zh: 附和插话；插嘴表示赞同
items.def_en: (+ with) To join in a conversation or discussion, typically to express agreement or echo a view
items.ex_en: Several colleagues chimed in with supportive comments during the manager's proposal for remote work.
items.ex_zh: 经理提出远程办公的提议时，几位同事纷纷插话表示赞同。

items.def_en: (+ with) To pretend to agree with someone or their assertions to keep peace or gain time
items.ex_en: She decided to play along with his ridiculous story just to avoid an awkward argument.
items.ex_zh: 为了避免一场尴尬的争吵，她决定顺着他那荒诞的说法随声附和。

items.def_zh: 附议；赞同并支持（提案或观点）
items.def_en: To express formal agreement with a proposal, motion, or expressed sentiment made by another
items.ex_en: The senior board member gladly rose to second the motion to approve the new budget.
items.ex_zh: 资深董事高兴地起身附议，支持批准这项新预算方案。

items.def_zh: 附和，盲目重复；发出回声，产生回响
items.def_en: 1. To repeat or agree with someone else's opinions, words, or feelings. 2. To send back or reflect sound as an echo.
items.ex_en: Several junior delegates merely echoed the chairman's opinions without expressing any views of their own.
items.ex_zh: 几名初级代表只是附和主席的意见，没有表达任何自己的看法。
items.ex2_en: Loud thunder echoed through the dark mountain valleys during the sudden downpour.
items.ex2_zh: 突降暴雨期间，巨响的雷声在幽暗的山谷中回荡。

items.def_en: (+ with) To evoke an immediate feeling of shared sympathy, deep agreement, or thematic consistency
items.ex_en: The politician's poignant speech about working-class struggles resonated deeply with the anxious local voters.
items.ex_zh: 这位政治家关于工人阶层艰辛的动情演讲，深深引起了焦虑的当地选民的共鸣。

items.def_en: To repeatedly reverberate, mirror, or proclaim an already stated opinion or widespread sentiment
items.ex_en: The vast cathedral walls seemed to re-echo the somber lamentations of the grieving congregation.
items.ex_zh: 巨大的大教堂高墙似乎反复回响并呼应着哀恸会众的凄凉哀歌。
items.ex2_en: Joyful laughter re-echoed across the quiet village square throughout the festive evening.
items.ex2_zh: 欢快的笑声在整个节日夜晚不断回荡在宁静的村庄广场上。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on mirroring, amplifying, or harmonizing with another person's expressed view, sentiment, or ideology. Unlike mindless parroting, verbs here emphasize alignment, social consensus, sympathetic accord, or formal endorsement.
groups.summary_zh: 强调与他人的思想、言论或情绪产生呼应、表示赞同或顺从共鸣。
groups.desc_en: Denotes repeating, agreeing with, or vibrating in harmony with another's words, feelings, or actions, contrasting with independent origination or dissent.
groups.desc_zh: 表示在言语、情感或立场上附和、响应或共鸣，区别于自主发声或相左对立。
groups.nuance_en: echo: repeating another's words or sentiment verbatim or closely (sentiments / words / view) · resonate: evoking deep sympathetic vibration or emotional relevance (themes / message / audience) · chime in: interrupting pleasantly to add supportive agreement (conversation / discussion / chorus) · second: formally supporting a motion or endorsing another's opinion (motion / proposal / nomination) · play along: cooperating outwardly or pretending agreement for expediency (game / plan / pretense)
groups.nuance_zh: echo: 鹦鹉学舌或应声附和 (sentiments / words / view) · resonate: 引起深层情感共振或共鸣 (themes / message / audience) · chime in: 适时插话表达支持 (conversation / discussion / chorus) · second: 附议提案或赞同说法 (motion / proposal / nomination) · play along: 顺水推舟、逢场作戏地配合 (game / plan / pretense)

groups.name: Edit & Revise · 编辑与校订 (Revise, Proofread, Redact)
groups.tip: 修润文本删除修正错误

items.def_en: 1. To prepare text, film, or other material by correcting, modifying, or condensing it for publication or broadcasting.
items.ex_en: The veteran journalist helped edit the final draft of the investigative report before publication.
items.ex_zh: 这位资深记者在调查报告发表前协助编辑了最终定稿。

items.def_en: To re-examine and alter written work to improve its content, style, or factual accuracy
items.ex_en: The student spent the weekend revising her literature essay to improve clarity and coherence.
items.ex_zh: 这名学生花了一整个周末修改她的文学论文，以提高清晰度与连贯性。

items.def_en: To remove unwanted sentences, footage, or sections during the editorial process
items.ex_en: He decided to cut out caffeine completely to improve his sleep.
items.ex_zh: 为了改善睡眠，他决定彻底戒掉咖啡因。

items.def_en: To make formal, minor changes to a document, statement, or law to correct flaws
items.ex_en: Parliament voted overwhelmingly to amend the outdated constitutional clause regarding national emergency powers.
items.ex_zh: 议会以压倒性多数投票通过，对涉及国家紧急权力的一项陈旧宪法条款予以修正。

items.def_en: To edit text by blacking out or removing sensitive information prior to release
items.ex_en: Government officials redacted the confidential military intelligence before releasing the files to the public.
items.ex_zh: 政府官员在向公众公开发布这些档案之前，删节隐去了其中的机密军事情报。

items.def_en: To read over printer proofs or written text carefully to detect and correct typographical errors
items.ex_en: Please proofread the contract carefully to ensure there are no lingering typographical or spelling errors.
items.ex_zh: 请仔细校对合同，确保没有任何残留的排版或拼写错误。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on textual or media curation: refining, pruning, adjusting, and correcting raw drafted material to ensure accuracy, coherence, and publication quality.
groups.summary_zh: 指对原稿或音视频进行修改、校勘与删改裁剪，以达到发表与播出标准。
groups.desc_en: Denotes altering, refining, or redacting written text to improve quality, accuracy, or compliance, contrasting with initial generative drafting.
groups.desc_zh: 表示对文本进行修改、精简、校对或隐匿以完善质量或符合标准，区别于初始草拟创作。
groups.nuance_en: edit: selecting, pruning, and preparing text for publication (manuscript / video / article) · revise: re-examining and substantially amending content or policy (essay / estimates / draft) · proofread: painstakingly catching typographical, mechanical, and grammatical errors (galleys / copy / manuscript) · redact: blacking out sensitive information or compiling a selective text (documents / report / names) · amend: legally or formally modifying a text to correct defects (constitution / law / text)
groups.nuance_zh: edit: 编选、剪辑并润色定稿 (manuscript / video / article) · revise: 大幅重温并修订内容或政策 (essay / estimates / draft) · proofread: 逐字逐句校对字词印误 (galleys / copy / manuscript) · redact: 涂黑抹去机密信息或编校文献 (documents / report / names) · amend: 依照程序正式修正条文 (constitution / law / text)

groups.name: Eject & Oust · 弹出与逐出 (Eject, Expel, Oust)
groups.tip: 强力向外弹射或驱赶

items.def_en: To force someone to leave a room, building, or competition due to misbehavior
items.ex_en: The judge threw out the lawsuit due to lack of evidence.
items.ex_zh: 法官因证据不足驳回了该起诉讼。

items.def_en: To deliberately drive someone away from a community, group, or society
items.ex_en: For questioning sacred traditions, the defiant philosopher was cast out from his native city.
items.ex_zh: 由于质疑神圣传统，这位叛逆的哲学家被逐出了他的故土城邦。

items.def_en: To officially force someone to leave a school, organization, or country
items.ex_en: The university disciplinary committee decided to expel the student for committing severe academic dishonesty.
items.ex_zh: 大学纪律委员会决定开除这名存在严重学术不端行为的学生。

items.def_en: 1. (+ from) To force someone to leave a place or organization. 2. To push something out suddenly and with force; to escape from an aircraft by ejector seat.
items.ex_en: Security guards quickly intervened to eject the disorderly spectator from the crowded concert hall.
items.ex_zh: 保安人员迅速介入，将那名扰乱秩序的观众逐出了拥挤的音乐厅。

items.def_en: To legally force someone to leave the house, land, or building they are renting
items.ex_en: The landlord obtained an official court order to evict the delinquent tenants for nonpayment.
items.ex_zh: 房东获得了法院的正式判决，依法驱逐拖欠房租的租客。

items.def_en: To force someone out of a position of power or out of a place
items.ex_en: The rebel faction managed to oust the authoritarian military dictator in a bloodless coup.
items.ex_zh: 叛军派系在一场不流血的政变中成功罢黜了这位独裁的军事独裁者。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the forcible removal of an object mechanically from a machine, or the compulsory expulsion of an individual from a venue, position, or organization. Force, suddenness, or legal eviction are prominent.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过机械力弹出物体，或通过权威/暴力将人强行逐出场所或职务。
groups.desc_en: Denotes forcing an individual or entity out of an enclosure, position, or tenure by authority or power, contrasting with voluntary exit.
groups.desc_zh: 表示凭借权力或暴力将主体从处所、席位或任期中强制驱逐，区别于自主退场或解聘。
groups.nuance_en: eject: forcefully or mechanically propelling outward (pilot / disc / unruly patron) · expel: officially banishing or driving out permanently (student / diplomat / invader) · oust: removing someone from a position of political or institutional power (dictator / rival / leadership) · evict: legally expelling a tenant from a property (tenant / squatter / family) · cast out: morally, socially, or religiously exiling from a community (devils / heretic / pariah)
groups.nuance_zh: eject: 机械弹射或强行逐出场馆 (pilot / disc / unruly patron) · expel: 官方正式开除或驱逐出境 (student / diplomat / invader) · oust: 政治斗争中罢免驱逐或赶下台 (dictator / rival / leadership) · evict: 依法驱逐租客腾退房产 (tenant / squatter / family) · cast out: 宗教或社群层面的唾弃放逐 (devils / heretic / pariah)

groups.name: Elect & Return to Office · 推选与选任 (Elect, Return, Reinstall)
groups.tip: 通过投票表决再次当选职务

items.def_en: (politics, esp. British) To elect a candidate as a representative to parliament or public office
items.ex_en: The industrial northern constituency chose to return the incumbent member of parliament once again.
items.ex_zh: 该北部工业选区再次选出这位现任国会议员代表他们。

items.def_en: To officially install an elected candidate into a legislative or representative body
items.ex_en: The newly elected senator was officially seated after taking the customary constitutional oath yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 新当选的参议员在昨天宣读惯常的宪法誓词后，正式就任席位。

items.def_en: To choose someone to hold a public office or leadership role through a formal vote
items.ex_en: Citizens queued patiently for hours to elect their local representatives during yesterday's municipal elections.
items.ex_zh: 在昨天的市政选举中，市民们耐心地排队数小时来推选他们的当地代表。

items.def_en: To choose a candidate or party to take office through winning an election
items.ex_en: Citizens voted in a reform-minded mayor during the recent election.
items.ex_zh: 市民在最近的选举中选出了一位具有改革思想的新市长。

items.def_en: To officially designate someone to continue serving in a position for another term
items.ex_en: The prime minister decided to reappoint the experienced diplomat for another crucial diplomatic term.
items.ex_zh: 首相决定重新任命这位经验丰富的外交官，继续担任另一个关键任期的职务。

items.def_en: To vote someone back into the same public office for another term.
items.ex_en: The grateful community voted overwhelmingly to reelect their dedicated mayor for a third term.
items.ex_zh: 心怀感激的社区居民以压倒性多数投票再次选出他们尽职的市长连任第三届。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe choosing public officials, leaders, or representatives by collective electoral mandate, as well as confirming or returning incumbents to office.
groups.summary_zh: 通过选举产生公职人员，或将其再次选入领导职位。
groups.desc_en: Denotes assigning official institutional authority through democratic vote, contrasting with autocratic appointment or hereditary succession.
groups.desc_zh: 表示通过选民投票授予公职或使其重返议席，区别于专制任命或世袭继承。
groups.nuance_en: elect: choosing a representative by collective voting process (president / board / candidate) · return: electing a member to parliament or legislature in British/Commonwealth usage (MP / government / majority) · seat: officially installing an elected official into their legislative chamber (delegate / senator / committee) · reelect: voting an incumbent back into continuous or repeated office (mayor / incumbent / official) · vote in: ushering a person or party into governance via popular vote (party / reforms / candidate)
groups.nuance_zh: elect: 经集体投票选举产生 (president / board / candidate) · return: 英联邦体系中选出议员进入议会 (MP / government / majority) · seat: 正式核准并赋予立法席位 (delegate / senator / committee) · reelect: 投票选举现任者连任 (mayor / incumbent / official) · vote in: 选民用选票将政客或政党选上台 (party / reforms / candidate)

groups.name: Elevate & Ennoble · 抬高身价与赋尊 (Dignify, Ennoble, Exalt)
groups.tip: 抬高社会地位并赋予尊严

items.def_en: To describe or represent something as admirable or splendid, sometimes undeservedly
items.ex_en: Certain historical films tend to glorify brutal warfare instead of portraying its tragic reality.
items.ex_zh: 某些历史影片往往美化残酷的战争，而不是展现其悲惨的现实。

items.def_zh: 抬高……的身价，赋予……尊严；使显得庄严（或重要）
items.def_en: To make someone or something appear worthy, impressive, noble, or more important than they actually are.
items.ex_en: The diplomat refused to dignify the scandalous accusations with an official formal public response.
items.ex_zh: 这位外交官拒绝通过发表正式公开回应来抬高那些丑闻指控的身价。

items.def_en: To raise someone to a higher rank or status, or to praise them extravagantly
items.ex_en: Poets throughout the ages have sought to exalt the virtue of courage during conflict.
items.ex_zh: 历代诗人们都试图在诗篇中高度赞扬冲突之中的勇敢美德。

items.def_zh: 使神圣化；赋予神圣光环
items.def_en: To declare or set apart as sacred, thereby lending profound religious or historical dignity
items.ex_en: The archbishop arrived to consecrate the newly built stone cathedral in a solemn ceremony.
items.ex_zh: 大主教亲临现场，在一场庄严的仪式上使这座新建的石砌大教堂神圣化。

items.def_en: To lend noble, honorable, or elevated moral quality to a person, act, or character
items.ex_en: Acts of selfless devotion invariably ennoble the spirit and inspire the surrounding community greatly.
items.ex_zh: 无私奉献的举动总能使心灵变得高尚，并极大地激励身边的整个群体。

items.def_en: To increase the power, status, or perceived wealth of someone, often excessively
items.ex_en: The ambitious prince sought continuously to aggrandize his dynastic prestige through extravagant public monuments.
items.ex_zh: 野心勃勃的王子不断试图通过铺张建立公共纪念碑来抬高其王室威望。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate the act of conferring honor, solemnity, nobility, or unearned gravitas onto an individual, title, or act. It ranges from sincere moral elevation to conferring a spurious, pretentious legitimacy upon trivial things.
groups.summary_zh: 指赋予某人或某事尊贵地位、光彩或冠冕堂皇的名目。
groups.desc_en: Denotes investing someone or something with higher moral, spiritual, or social stature, contrasting with practical promotion or physical raising.
groups.desc_zh: 表示赋予对象更高的道德品格、崇高声望或精神尊严，区别于单纯职务升迁或物理抬高。
groups.nuance_en: ennoble: imbuing with moral grandeur, aristocratic virtue, or high rank (soul / mind / character) · exalt: raising to sublime status, supreme glory, or praising extravagantly (virtue / hero / leader) · dignify: conferring solemn worth or respectable gravity upon something (proceedings / title / ceremony) · glorify: bestowing radiant religious praise or romanticized honor upon (God / past / violence) · aggrandize: magnifying someone's power, wealth, or status often unnaturally or selfishly (reputation / empire / self)
groups.nuance_zh: ennoble: 净化升华品格或封赐贵族爵位 (soul / mind / character) · exalt: 提拔至崇高巅峰或赞颂入微 (virtue / hero / leader) · dignify: 赋予庄重尊严或受人尊敬的气度 (proceedings / title / ceremony) · glorify: 归荣耀于神或浪漫美化 (God / past / violence) · aggrandize: 夸大或自私地扩张声势财富 (reputation / empire / self)

groups.name: Elude & Escape · 摆脱与脱逃 (Elude, Slip, Break Away)
groups.tip: 设法躲避追捕逃离险境

items.def_en: To get free from captivity, confinement, or a dangerous situation
items.ex_en: The prisoners managed to escape through a concealed underground tunnel during the heavy storm.
items.ex_zh: 囚犯们在大风暴期间通过一条隐蔽的地道成功逃脱。

items.def_en: To leave a place quietly or inconspicuously without being noticed by captors or attendees
items.ex_en: Don't let this incredible opportunity slip away.
items.ex_zh: 别让这个绝佳的机会悄悄溜走。

items.def_en: (+ from) To free oneself abruptly by force from someone's grasp, control, or confinement
items.ex_en: The captive suddenly lunged forward and managed to break away from the guard's grasp.
items.ex_zh: 俘虏突然向前猛扑，成功挣脱了卫兵的控制。

items.def_en: To escape from or evade a pursuer, tracker, or unwanted companion
items.ex_en: The elusive thief managed to give the slip to the detectives in the market.
items.ex_zh: 那个狡猾的小偷在熙熙攘攘的集市中设法甩掉了便衣侦探。

items.def_zh: 逃脱，躲避（追捕）；规避，逃避（责任、问题等）
items.def_en: 1. To escape or avoid someone pursuing you. 2. To avoid dealing with, answering, or fulfilling a duty, tax, or question.
items.ex_en: The corrupt businessman spent years using complex offshore schemes to evade hefty tax penalties.
items.ex_zh: 这个腐败的商人多年来利用复杂的离岸方案来逃避高额的税务罚款。

items.def_en: To escape or avoid detection or capture by someone through speed, guile, or clever tactics
items.ex_en: The nimble pickpocket managed to elude the police by disappearing into the subway crowd.
items.ex_zh: 敏捷的扒手潜入地铁人流中，巧妙逃脱了警方的抓捕。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on successfully breaking free or getting away from pursuit, confinement, capture, or dangerous traps. It emphasizes dynamic movement, cunning stealth, or outmaneuvering an opponent.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过机敏身手或脱困行动，摆脱追捕、监禁或围困。
groups.desc_en: Denotes escaping or frustrating capture, comprehension, or containment through agility or cunning, contrasting with overt confrontational resistance.
groups.desc_zh: 表示通过身手灵巧或策略诡谲逃脱追捕、躲开纠缠或避开理解，区别于正面硬碰硬的反抗。
groups.nuance_en: elude: cleverly slipping away from pursuers, grasp, or understanding (captors / police / comprehension) · evade: strategically dodging an obligation, blow, or question (taxes / duty / question) · escape: successfully getting free from physical confinement or mortal danger (prison / trap / fire) · slip away: departing quietly and unnoticed without confrontation (party / crowd / quietly) · break away: detaching violently from physical restraint or ideological control (captor / pack / party)
groups.nuance_zh: elude: 巧妙避开抓捕追兵，或使人无法理解领会 (captors / police / comprehension) · evade: 处心积虑逃避义务或闪避提问 (taxes / duty / question) · escape: 摆脱束缚脱离险境 (prison / trap / fire) · slip away: 悄然溜走、不为人知地脱身 (party / crowd / quietly) · break away: 挣脱物理控制或脱离组织派系 (captor / pack / party)

groups.name: Emancipate & Sever Shackles · 解除束缚与禁锢 (Unshackle, Emancipate, Manumit)
groups.tip: 松绑绳索还其行动自如

items.def_en: To loosen or unfasten the cords, knots, or ropes binding someone or something
items.ex_en: The hostage breathed a sigh of relief as the rescuer gently untied her hands.
items.ex_zh: 当救援人员轻轻解开绑在她手上的绳子时，人质松了一口气。
items.ex2_en: The loose knot untied on its own while he was walking briskly.
items.ex2_zh: 当他轻快步行时，那个松掉的绳结自己解开了。

items.def_zh: 解开，松绑；释放，使解脱（unbind的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of unbind; to untie, release, or free from fastenings, bonds, or restrictions.
items.ex_en: With solemn mercy, the victorious king unbound the defeated captive and granted him freedom.
items.ex_zh: 怀着庄严的仁慈，胜利的国王为被俘者解开束缚，并赐予了他自由。

items.def_zh: 使脱离奴役；使觉醒解脱
items.def_en: (literary) To liberate someone from a state of enslavement, subjugation, or mental servitude
items.ex_en: The brilliant educator sought tirelessly to disenthrall the impoverished youth from persistent generational ignorance.
items.ex_zh: 这位杰出的教育家孜孜不倦地寻求让贫民青年脱离世代相传的蒙昧奴役。

items.def_zh: 除去……的枷锁；使摆脱束缚
items.def_en: To remove chains or fetters from someone, or to deliver someone from oppressive social or institutional constraints
items.ex_en: The bold new economic policies aimed to unshackle domestic entrepreneurs from crippling trade regulations.
items.ex_zh: 大胆的新经济政策旨在让国内企业家摆脱繁复严苛的贸易法规束缚。

items.def_zh: 解放（奴隶）；给予政治或法律平等权利
items.def_en: To liberate someone from social, legal, or political servitude and grant them full personal rights
items.ex_en: The historic decree finally served to emancipate millions of people from brutal state-sponsored servitude.
items.ex_zh: 这项历史性法令最终使数百万人摆脱了国家体制下的残酷奴役，获得了自由。

items.def_en: (formal/historical) To release an enslaved person from slavery by legal decree
items.ex_en: Under Roman law, the master chose to manumit his loyal servant upon his deathbed.
items.ex_zh: 依据罗马法律，这位主人在临终前决定解除其忠仆的奴籍。

groups.summary_en: This sociopolitical and moral frame focuses on breaking, untying, or lifting figurative and systemic fetters, bondage, or social oppression. The terms highlight the transition from servitude, institutional subjugation, or heavy restrictions to autonomy.
groups.summary_zh: 特指斩断锁链、废除奴役或打破体制性束缚以赋予自由。
groups.desc_en: Denotes setting free from literal bonds, slavery, or systemic oppression, contrasting with granting temporary leave or minor permissions.
groups.desc_zh: 表示解除肉体锁链、奴役地位或体制性重压，区别于寻常的准假或小范围宽容。
groups.nuance_en: emancipate: legally or socially freeing from institutional, political, or parental subjugation (slaves / women / mind) · unshackle: physically or metaphorically unbinding from chains and rigid constraints (prisoner / economy / trade) · manumit: formally releasing a slave from legal bondage through a master's act (slaves / captive / bondman) · disenthrall: liberating from psychological thrall, spell, or deep ideological illusion (masses / mind / imagination) · untie: loosening physical knots, ropes, or literal fastenings (knot / hands / parcel)
groups.nuance_zh: emancipate: 政治或法律上解放被压迫群体 (slaves / women / mind) · unshackle: 解开镣铐枷锁，彻底松绑 (prisoner / economy / trade) · manumit: 主人正式解除奴隶身契 (slaves / captive / bondman) · disenthrall: 从迷醉、思想奴役或幻梦中唤醒解放 (masses / mind / imagination) · untie: 物理上解开绳索纽带 (knot / hands / parcel)

groups.name: Embarrass & Disconcert · 难堪与窘迫 (Mortify, Disconcert, Fluster)
groups.tip: 因失误或失态而感到窘迫不安

items.def_en: to cause someone to feel nervous, self-conscious, or ashamed.
items.ex_en: His loud, clumsy remarks began to embarrass his sister in front of her friends.
items.ex_zh: 他在她朋友面前大声而笨拙的言论开始让他的妹妹感到难堪。

items.def_zh: 使深感屈辱；使极度难堪
items.def_en: to cause someone to feel extremely humiliated, shameful, or acutely embarrassed
items.ex_en: The executive was deeply mortified when his disastrous calculation errors were exposed before the board.
items.ex_zh: 当自己灾难性的计算失误在董事会面前被揭穿时，这名主管感到极度难堪。

items.def_zh: 使张皇失措；使心神不宁
items.def_en: to disturb the composure or self-possession of someone by unexpected behavior or news
items.ex_en: The sudden hostile questioning from the audience clearly disconcerted the normally confident guest speaker.
items.ex_zh: 观众席突然提出的敌意质问显然让那位平时颇为自信的演讲嘉宾张皇失措。

items.def_en: to make someone agitated, nervous, and confused by rushing them or catching them off guard
items.ex_en: The aggressive interviewer deliberately tried to fluster the candidate with sudden, personal philosophical inquiries.
items.ex_zh: 盛气凌人的面试官故意抛出突然的个人哲学问题，试图使候选人慌乱手脚。

items.def_en: to make someone feel uneasy, awkward, or confused in a social or confrontational situation
items.ex_en: The sudden, pointed query about his financial conflicts served to discomfit the proud politician.
items.ex_zh: 关于其财务冲突的突如其来的尖锐质问，让这位高傲的政客一时不知所措。

items.def_en: to make someone feel self-conscious, shamefaced, or uneasy through an awareness of failure or faux pas
items.ex_en: Nothing could completely abash the arrogant young nobleman despite his repeated diplomatic blunders abroad.
items.ex_zh: 尽管在海外一再犯下外交失误，却没有什么能让这位傲慢的年轻贵族感到一丝羞愧。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe inducing social unease, loss of poise, self-consciousness, or acute shame in another person.
groups.summary_zh: 指使人感到难堪、窘迫、自惭形秽或手足无措。
groups.desc_en: Denotes throwing someone into self-conscious distress, shame, or mental confusion, contrasting with inflicting physical harm or mild irritation.
groups.desc_zh: 表示因失态、暴露或难堪局面引发极度羞赧、失措或内心混乱，区别于肉体痛苦或微小烦恼。
groups.nuance_en: embarrass: causing social awkwardness, fluster, or self-consciousness (mistake / family / silence) · mortify: wounding deeply with intense humiliation and agonizing shame (pride / failure / blunder) · disconcert: upsetting composure or unsettling expectations suddenly (revelation / stare / news) · fluster: throwing into agitated, nervous, and hurried confusion (interviewee / staff / speaker) · abash: making someone feel completely subdued, sheepish, and humiliated (criticism / glance / presence)
groups.nuance_zh: embarrass: 令人社交尴尬或面红耳赤 (mistake / family / silence) · mortify: 极度羞辱以致无地自容 (pride / failure / blunder) · disconcert: 破坏镇定使人惊惶失措 (revelation / stare / news) · fluster: 使人手忙脚乱、心烦意乱 (interviewee / staff / speaker) · abash: 令人羞惭无措、自惭形秽 (criticism / glance / presence)

groups.name: Embezzle & Misappropriate · 盗用与侵吞 (Embezzle, Misappropriate, Siphon off)
groups.tip: 监守自盗非法侵吞公款

items.def_en: To dishonestly or illegally remove money from an account, fund, or organization over time
items.ex_en: The corrupt treasurer secretly siphoned off millions from the charity fund into private accounts.
items.ex_zh: 这名贪污的财务主管暗中从慈善基金中抽走数百万资金，转入个人账户。

items.def_zh: 暗中抽取（部分收益、佣金）
items.def_en: To steal small amounts of money or profits secretly from an employer or business transaction over a period of time
items.ex_en: The crooked casino cashier managed to skim money off daily cash takings for months.
items.ex_zh: 这个心术不正的赌场收银员数月来一直从每日营业收入中暗中抽取小额公款。

items.def_en: To misuse or embezzle funds held in trust or official custody
items.ex_en: The entrusted public servant chose to defalcate trust funds to settle his gambling debts.
items.ex_zh: 这位受托的公职人员竟选择挪用信托基金来偿还个人赌债。

items.def_zh: 挪用，侵吞（公款或受托财产）
items.def_en: To dishonestly take money or property that you have been trusted to manage, and use it for your own purposes
items.ex_en: The corrupt official was prosecuted after attempting to misappropriate municipal disaster relief funds unlawfully.
items.ex_zh: 这名腐败官员因企图非法挪用市政救灾款项而遭到起诉。

items.def_en: To embezzle or steal public funds or property entrusted to one's official care
items.ex_en: An independent audit discovered that the state governor had peculated hundreds of public resources.
items.ex_zh: 一项独立审计发现，该州州长侵吞挪用了价值数百笔的公共资源。

items.def_en: To steal money or property that has been placed in your trust or care, especially from an employer or organization.
items.ex_en: The rogue accountant was convicted of schemes designed to embezzle substantial corporate payroll funds.
items.ex_zh: 这名不法会计因策划盗用公司巨额工资资金而被定罪。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to dishonestly taking or diverting money or property that has been entrusted to one's care, especially in an organizational, corporate, or fiduciary context. Nuances range from legal indictments of fraudulent conversion to stealthily siphoning off accounts over time.
groups.summary_zh: 指侵吞、盗用受托管理的公款或财产，多用于职务犯罪与财务欺诈语境。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the fraudulent diversion of entrusted funds or assets for personal gain, contrasting with overt robbery or burglary.
groups.desc_zh: 表示背弃信任、利用职权便利暗中将所托管的资金财产据为己有，区别于明抢明盗的暴力劫掠。
groups.nuance_en: embezzle: systematically stealing entrusted corporate or public funds through falsified trust (funds / money / fortune) · misappropriate: wrongfully allocating or dishonestly diverting funds to unauthorized uses (grant / assets / money) · siphon off: gradually and surreptitiously diverting financial assets elsewhere (profits / funds / resources) · peculate: formal or legal term for public embezzlement by an official (state funds / revenue / treasury) · skim: illicitly taking small off-the-top slices of gross revenue before accounting (cash / profits / revenue)
groups.nuance_zh: embezzle: 监守自盗、贪污侵吞公款 (funds / money / fortune) · misappropriate: 挪用资金用于未授权之用途 (grant / assets / money) · siphon off: 抽逃隐匿资金或暗渡陈仓 (profits / funds / resources) · peculate: 法律严词，特指官吏盗用国帑 (state funds / revenue / treasury) · skim: 瞒报总账截留一笔油水 (cash / profits / revenue)

groups.name: Embody & Materialize · 具象与成形 (Incarnate, Personify, Manifest)
groups.tip: 使抽象概念具象化落地

items.raw_cluster: 具象与赋予形体 Embody & Materialize
items.def_zh: 使具象化，体现，赋予形体
items.def_en: To give a physical form, concrete presence, or distinct shape to an abstract idea or concept.
items.ex_en: The sculptor worked tirelessly to body forth human sorrow through cold, unyielding white marble.
items.ex_zh: 雕塑家孜孜不倦地工作，通过冰冷坚硬的汉白玉将人类的悲伤具象化。

items.def_en: Show an abstract quality, feeling, or symptom plainly by one's outward actions or appearance
items.ex_en: His deep inner anxiety began to manifest through nervous hand tremors and rapid breathing.
items.ex_zh: 他内心深处的焦虑开始通过手部的紧张颤抖和急促的呼吸显现出来。

items.def_en: Express, represent, or provide a tangible form to an abstract idea, principle, or quality
items.ex_en: The new constitutional charter aims to embody the core democratic principles of human dignity.
items.ex_zh: 新宪法宪章旨在体现人类尊严这一核心民主原则。

items.def_zh: 物化，成为现实，赫然出现
items.def_en: Become real or actual, or appear suddenly as if taking on physical form
items.ex_en: Despite initial optimistic investor promises, the anticipated financial support failed to materialize this quarter.
items.ex_zh: 尽管最初投资人承诺乐观，但预期的资金支持本季度未能成为现实。

items.def_en: Embody or represent a quality or concept in human or physical form
items.ex_en: To many loyal citizens, the charismatic general seemed to incarnate the spirit of victory.
items.ex_zh: 在许多忠诚的公民看来，这位富有魅力的将军似乎成了胜利精神的化身。

items.def_en: Be the perfect example of a quality, or depict a thing or abstraction as a living person
items.ex_en: Her persistent compassion and daily dedication personify the very essence of true selfless charity.
items.ex_zh: 她持久的同情心与日常奉献，典型体现了真正无私慈善的本质。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote imparting physical reality, tangible substance, or representative human-like presence to abstract concepts, ideals, virtues, or thoughts.
groups.summary_zh: 赋予抽象观念、精神或构想以具体形态或实在载体。
groups.desc_en: Denotes giving concrete, tangible, or human form to an abstract concept or spirit, contrasting with purely intellectual definition.
groups.desc_zh: 表示将抽象精神、品质或理念转化为有形肉身或具体载体，区别于纯文字概念定义。
groups.nuance_en: embody: concretely exemplifying an abstract idea, spirit, or value in a tangible whole (spirit / ideal / values) · personify: representing a quality or abstract concept as a human archetype or figure (greed / elegance / evil) · incarnate: investing divine, spiritual, or incorporeal essence with literal flesh (spirit / devil / virtue) · materialize: suddenly taking physical shape, appearing, or becoming reality (ghost / dreams / opportunities) · manifest: openly revealing an inner trait or hidden force through discernible signs (symptoms / discontent / power)
groups.nuance_zh: embody: 集中体现某种抽象价值或理念 (spirit / ideal / values) · personify: 拟人化，作为某品质的人格化身 (greed / elegance / evil) · incarnate: 具象化为肉身，转世降临 (spirit / devil / virtue) · materialize: 具象成实体，或梦想成为现实 (ghost / dreams / opportunities) · manifest: 通过外在迹象显露潜质或情感 (symptoms / discontent / power)

groups.name: Embroider & Embellish · 刺绣与添油加醋 (Embroider, Adorn, Color)
groups.tip: 刺绣点缀或辞藻艺术润色

items.def_en: To influence, distort, or add exaggerated flavor or bias to an account or description
items.ex_en: Personal grudges clearly colored his subjective recollection of the dispute during the public hearing.
items.ex_zh: 个人的恩怨显然给他在公开听证会上对那场纷争的主观回忆染上了偏见色彩。
items.ex2_en: Her pale cheeks colored softly with embarrassment during the awkward awkward introduction.
items.ex2_zh: 在那场尴尬的介绍中，她苍白的面颊因难堪而微微泛红。

items.def_en: To present something in an unusually attractive or deceitfully favorable way
items.ex_en: You don't need to dress up; casual clothes are fine for the party.
items.ex_zh: 你不需要盛装打扮，去参加聚会穿便装就行。
items.ex2_en: She decided to dress up the plain dining table with colorful flowers.
items.ex2_zh: 她决定用色彩斑斓的鲜花将朴素的餐桌装饰一番。

items.def_en: To add more details, substance, or vivid information to a basic plan or outline
items.ex_en: Let us flesh out the rough storyboard before pitching it to the creative director.
items.ex_zh: 在向创意总监提案之前，我们先把简略的分镜脚本充实一下。

items.def_en: To decorate a surface physically or embellish speech and writing with flowery details
items.ex_en: The speaker chose to ornament his formal address with archaic rhetoric and classical allusions.
items.ex_zh: 演讲者选择用晦涩的修辞和古典典故来润色他的正式演说。

items.def_zh: 在……上刺绣；对……添油加醋，对（故事等）润色渲染
items.def_en: 1. To decorate cloth with sewn patterns using thread. 2. To add fictional or exaggerated details to a story to make it more interesting.
items.ex_en: He tended to embroider the mundane details of his travels to amuse his dinner guests.
items.ex_zh: 他往往会对他旅行中平淡的细节添油加醋，以逗乐宴席上的宾客。

items.def_en: To make something more attractive by adding decorative details, or to make a story more interesting by adding fictitious details
items.ex_en: Skilled artisans embellish the palace corridors with intricate floral carvings and polished gilt molding.
items.ex_zh: 能工巧匠们用繁复的花卉雕刻和打磨的镀金线条来装点宫殿走廊。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to enhancing a surface with decorative needlework or figurative details, often shading into embellishing, exaggerating, or romanticizing a narrative to make it more compelling. Collocations include tales, stories, fabrics, and facts.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过刺绣装饰织物，或在叙述中添油加醋以增强吸引力。
groups.desc_en: Denotes adding decorative, exaggerated, or fictitious details to beautify or enliven, contrasting with faithful, unvarnished reporting.
groups.desc_zh: 表示通过添砖加瓦、极尽修饰或夸大其词来美化增色，区别于实事求是的如实陈述。
groups.nuance_en: embroider: stitching fictitious narrative details or exaggeration onto a true account (story / facts / truth) · embellish: beautifying or adorning narratives or physical items to make them more captivating (tale / account / garments) · ornament: decorating purely for superficial aesthetic charm (facade / prose / music) · dress up: styling or modifying something ordinary to make it seem grander or deceptive (truth / facts / statistics) · flesh out: adding legitimate substance, depth, and detail to an initial bare outline (skeleton / plan / characters)
groups.nuance_zh: embroider: 添油加醋、渲染夸大事实细节 (story / facts / truth) · embellish: 润饰加工让叙述或器物更吸睛 (tale / account / garments) · ornament: 增添修饰、浮华装点 (facade / prose / music) · dress up: 乔装打扮或粉饰太平 (truth / facts / statistics) · flesh out: 补充血肉细节以丰满骨架雏形 (skeleton / plan / characters)

groups.name: Emit & Radiate · 散发与辐射 (Emit, Radiate, Exude)
groups.tip: 向四周喷发或辐射光热

items.def_en: Release or produce heat, fumes, light, or an aroma into the surrounding air
items.ex_en: The rotting vegetation gave off a foul chemical odor.
items.ex_zh: 腐烂的植被散发出一股难闻的化学异味。

items.def_zh: 定向照射，发射（光芒或电波）
items.def_en: Transmit light, heat, radio signals, or television programs in a focused direction
items.ex_en: The coastal station will beam high-frequency signals directly toward incoming oceanic vessels tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 沿海基站将于明早直接向驶入的大洋船只定向发射高频信号。

items.def_zh: 散发，发出（光、热、声音、气味等）；放射
items.def_en: To send out or produce light, heat, sound, gas, or a smell.
items.ex_en: Faulty industrial furnaces often emit perilous volumes of carbon monoxide into the surrounding workshop.
items.ex_zh: 出现故障的工业熔炉往往会向周围车间排放危险剂量的有害一氧化碳。

items.def_en: Send out rays or waves of light, heat, or energy from a central core
items.ex_en: Massive cooling coils radiate immense heat into the reinforced chamber during sustained turbine operations.
items.ex_zh: 在涡轮机持续运转期间，巨大的冷却盘管会向加固舱室内辐射出大量热量。

items.def_en: (+ from) Originate and spread out gently from a specific source, such as sounds or heat
items.ex_en: Gentle acoustic tones emanate from the antique grandfather clock located in the central hallway.
items.ex_zh: 柔和的鸣响声自位于中央走廊的老式落地钟中袅袅散发出来。

items.def_en: Release gas, liquid, or an electrical charge forcefully into the immediate environment
items.ex_en: Damaged capacitors quickly discharge lethal electrical currents into nearby maintenance panels upon accidental contact.
items.ex_zh: 受损的电容器一旦发生意外接触，就会迅速向附近的维修面板释放致命电流。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical or perceptual sources broadcasting light, heat, ionizing radiation, or sonic waves outward in all directions.
groups.summary_zh: 强调光源、热源或能量向四周发射或播散。
groups.desc_en: Outward transmission of energy, particles, or intangible aura from a central source, contrasting with generic 'release' by emphasizing radial or diffusive propagation into surrounding space.
groups.desc_zh: 能量、粒子或无形气场从中心源向外发散或辐射，区别于一般的“释放”，侧重径向扩散与弥漫。
groups.nuance_en: emit: standard objective release of energy or particles (gas / light / signal) · radiate: spread intensely outward in straight lines or waves (heat / confidence / warmth) · emanate: originate intangibly and diffuse gently outward (scent / authority / charm) · discharge: forceful or chemical expulsion of accumulated contents (waste / electricity / fluid) · beam: direct bright, focused rays or joyful expression (smile / radio wave / sunlight) · give off: informal continuous passive release (heat / odor / fumes)
groups.nuance_zh: emit: 客观标准的能量或粒子释放 (gas / light / signal) · radiate: 沿射线强烈发散或四溢 (heat / confidence / warmth) · emanate: 无形质感温和发源并弥漫 (scent / authority / charm) · discharge: 积存物用力或化学性排出 (waste / electricity / fluid) · beam: 聚焦照射或绽放灿烂神情 (smile / radio wave / sunlight) · give off: 口语化自然持续散发 (heat / odor / fumes)

groups.name: Emit Pungent Odor · 散发恶臭与强烈气味 (Reek, Stink, Whiff)
groups.tip: 散发明显或极其刺鼻恶臭

items.def_zh: 散发气味；有（不好的）气味
items.def_en: To give off an odor, frequently an unpleasant one
items.ex_en: The damp basement rooms always smell faintly of stagnant rainwater and decaying wallpaper paste.
items.ex_zh: 潮湿的地下室房间总是隐隐散发着积存雨水和腐败壁纸胶的难闻气味。

items.def_en: To smell very bad or give off a foul odor
items.ex_en: His sweaty gym kit began to pong horribly after sitting unwashed inside the locker.
items.ex_zh: 他那套被汗浸湿的运动服没洗就放在储物柜里，开始散发出阵阵恶臭。

items.def_zh: 散发出难闻的气味；带有一股异味
items.def_en: To give off a distinct, usually unpleasant puff of smell
items.ex_en: These leftover seafood containers whiff terribly whenever the refrigerator door is opened even slightly.
items.ex_zh: 只要冰箱门稍稍打开一条缝，这些吃剩的海鲜盒就会散发出一股难闻的异味。

items.def_en: To give off an intensely strong and unpleasant smell
items.ex_en: Those rotting trash bins outside the crowded kitchen hum intensely beneath the scorching midday sun.
items.ex_zh: 拥挤厨房外那些腐烂的垃圾桶在正午的烈日暴晒下简直臭气熏天。

items.def_en: To emit a strong, extremely unpleasant odor
items.ex_en: Uncollected garbage bags stink up the entire apartment stairwell during the muggy summer afternoons.
items.ex_zh: 在闷热的夏日午后，无人清理的垃圾袋让整个公寓楼梯间臭气熏天。

items.def_zh: 发臭，散发刺鼻气味；明显带有……气息
items.def_en: (+ of) To smell very strongly and unpleasantly of something.
items.ex_en: His woollen winter overcoat continued to reek of cheap cigar smoke for several days.
items.ex_zh: 他那件羊毛冬季大衣一连好几天都刺鼻地散发着劣质雪茄烟的臭味。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe giving off an intense, distinct, and usually offensive smell. They range from neutral mild whiffs to overwhelming, nauseating stenches that cling to surroundings.
groups.summary_zh: 描述散发出刺鼻、浓烈或令人不快的恶臭气味，程度由隐约飘散到极度难闻。
groups.desc_en: Sensory perception of highly offensive or overpowering olfactory emissions, moving beyond neutral 'smelling' toward aggressive environmental contamination and physical revulsion.
groups.desc_zh: 散发强烈刺鼻或令人作呕的气味，脱离中性的“闻到”，强调对嗅觉环境的侵入与恶心感。
groups.nuance_en: smell: neutral sensory base capable of negative coloring (odor / decay / fish) · whiff: emit a faint, sudden puff of bad scent (drain / trash / gas) · pong: informal sustained release of unpleasant odor (feet / cheese / gym bag) · hum: emit a stench so thick it seems palpably active (rubbish / latrine / socks) · stink: emit a sharp, pervasive foul stench (sweat / garbage / breath) · reek: saturate the air unmistakably and overpoweringly (alcohol / tobacco / decay)
groups.nuance_zh: smell: 中性气味感知基准词 (odor / decay / fish) · whiff: 逸出轻微、突然的一股恶臭 (drain / trash / gas) · pong: 英式口语化持续散发难闻异味 (feet / cheese / gym bag) · hum: 恶臭熏天至如嗡嗡作响般厚重 (rubbish / latrine / socks) · stink: 散发明显、普遍的刺鼻恶臭 (sweat / garbage / breath) · reek: 充斥弥漫着浓烈扑鼻的气味 (alcohol / tobacco / decay)

groups.name: Empathy & Consolation · 同情与慰藉 (Console, Sympathize, Solace)
groups.tip: 对他人不幸遭遇表达哀思与同情
