items.def_en: Ease the sorrow or grief of someone, imparting a sense of relief and hope
items.ex_en: She sat beside her grieving friend to comfort her with gentle words and quiet patience.
items.ex_zh: 她坐在悲痛的朋友身旁，用温和的话语和耐心的陪伴宽慰她。

items.def_en: Express formal sympathy and sorrow to someone who has suffered a bereavement
items.ex_en: Distinguished foreign ambassadors arrived promptly to condole with the royal family upon the tragedy.
items.ex_zh: 尊贵的外交使节们闻讯迅速抵达，就这场悲剧向王室成员正式吊唁。

items.def_en: Comfort someone who is experiencing grief, disappointment, or distress
items.ex_en: The social worker attempted to console the distraught family after their devastating structural loss.
items.ex_zh: 在那场毁灭性的财产损失发生后，社工试图安抚陷入极度痛苦的一家人。

items.def_en: Give comfort or consolation in times of sadness, grief, or distress
items.ex_en: Her deep spiritual convictions solace the aging scholar throughout this profound period of desolation.
items.ex_zh: 她虔诚的内心信仰在这段深切的孤寂岁月中抚慰着这位年迈的学者。

items.def_en: Feel or express compassion, pity, or shared sadness for someone's misfortune
items.ex_en: Colleagues openly sympathize with his unfortunate situation following the sudden closure of the factory.
items.ex_zh: 工厂突然倒闭之后，同事们对他不幸的遭遇深表同情与体谅。

items.def_en: (+ with/over) To express sympathy or sadness for the misfortune, grief, or disappointment of someone.
items.ex_en: Neighbors gathered quietly on the front porch to commiserate with him over his loss.
items.ex_zh: 邻居们静静地聚集在前廊，就他的惨重损失向他表达深切慰问与同情。

groups.summary_en: This frame relates to communicating heartfelt empathy, sharing in another's sorrow, or actively providing emotional comfort and solace to someone who is grieving or distressed.
groups.summary_zh: 向身处逆境或悲痛者传达同理心、深切关怀或施以情感安抚。
groups.desc_en: Interpersonal alleviation of emotional pain through shared sorrow and active soothing, contrasting with passive 'pity' by offering relational shelter and emotional solidarity.
groups.desc_zh: 通过分担忧伤与主动安抚来减轻他人的情感痛苦，区别于被动的“怜悯”，侧重提供情感庇护与同理共振。
groups.nuance_en: comfort: soothe immediate distress and provide physical/emotional ease (child / patient / mourner) · console: soften profound grief or disappointment over irreplaceable loss (widow / loser / family) · solace: provide deep internal refuge and quiet peace (soul / lonely heart / exile) · condole with: formally express formal sympathy over death (bereaved / family / survivor) · commiserate: mutually exchange expressions of sorrow or misfortune (colleague / friend / team) · sympathize: intellectually comprehend and feel compassionate toward another's plight (victim / plight / cause)
groups.nuance_zh: comfort: 抚慰当下痛苦并带来安抚与舒缓 (child / patient / mourner) · console: 抚平因不可挽回之损失带来的深切悲痛 (widow / loser / family) · solace: 给予深层的心灵慰藉与内在庇护 (soul / lonely heart / exile) · condole with: 吊唁并就死讯正式表达哀悼 (bereaved / family / survivor) · commiserate: 同病相怜地互诉或表达惋惜 (colleague / friend / team) · sympathize: 理智理解并同情他人处境 (victim / plight / cause)

groups.name: Emulsify & Homogenize · 乳化与混融 (Emulsify, Homogenize, Blend, Incorporate)
groups.tip: 乳化混合均匀调配

items.def_en: beat distinct liquid ingredients rapidly with a whisk to form a smooth single liquid
items.ex_en: Whisk together the olive oil, vinegar, and minced garlic until the dressing appears glossy.
items.ex_zh: 将橄榄油、香醋和蒜末搅打混合均匀，直到调味汁呈现光泽。

items.def_en: blend or combine one ingredient thoroughly into an existing mixture until fully absorbed
items.ex_en: Gradually incorporate the chilled heavy cream into the warm melted chocolate using steady strokes.
items.ex_zh: 用平稳的手法逐渐将冰镇鲜奶油拌入温热的融化巧克力中，使其融为一体。

items.def_en: hold micro-droplets or fine particles evenly distributed throughout a liquid medium
items.ex_en: Special stabilizing surfactants suspend minuscule oil droplets uniformly throughout the dense aqueous cleaning solution.
items.ex_zh: 专用的稳定表面活性剂使微小的油滴均匀地悬浮分散在浓稠的水性清洁液中。

items.def_en: mix different substances thoroughly together so that they lose their distinct identities
items.ex_en: Carefully blend the dry spices before rubbing them over the surface of the meat.
items.ex_zh: 将干燥的香料充分混合均匀，然后均匀涂抹在肉的表面。
items.ex2_en: The warm pastel colors blend harmoniously across the canvas of the painting.
items.ex2_zh: 柔和的粉彩颜色在画作的画布上和谐地融为一体。

items.def_en: treat a mixture or liquid so that its disparate components become evenly dispersed and consistent
items.ex_en: Industrial dairy processors homogenize whole milk to prevent cream from separating toward the surface.
items.ex_zh: 工业乳品加工厂对全脂牛奶进行均质化处理，以防止乳脂析出并浮向表面。

items.def_en: (chemistry / cooking) to mix two liquids that normally do not blend (such as oil and water) into a smooth, stable emulsion, or to become mixed in this way
items.ex_en: Natural egg yolks emulsify golden oil and fragrant lemon juice into luxurious velvety mayonnaise.
items.ex_zh: 天然蛋黄使金黄的油脂和芬芳的柠檬汁乳化交融，化为丝滑奢华的蛋黄酱。
items.ex2_en: Oil and cold water will not emulsify without adding an active binding agent.
items.ex2_zh: 若不添加活性结合剂，油和冷水就不会乳化。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this culinary and chemical frame describe bringing together immiscible liquids or heterogeneous substances into an evenly distributed, stable mixture or emulsion. The process requires mechanical shearing, whisking, or stabilizing agents.
groups.summary_zh: 指借助机械搅拌或乳化剂，使互不相溶的液体或异质材料充分融合为均质胶态。
groups.desc_en: Forced combination of naturally immiscible or heterogeneous substances into a stable, uniform fluid matrix, differing from generic 'mixing' by requiring mechanical shear and microstructure dispersion.
groups.desc_zh: 通过机械剪切迫使不相溶或非均质物质稳定结合为微观均匀体系，区别于简单的“混合”，强调界面改性与微结构分散。
groups.nuance_en: blend: thoroughly combine varied ingredients into a smooth macroscopic whole (flavors / batter / spices) · whisk together: rapidly aerate and mix light liquid components with a whip (eggs / dressing / cream) · incorporate: fold a minor component smoothly into a larger mass (butter / flour / dry ingredients) · suspend: hold undissolved microscopic particles dispersed throughout a medium (pigment / particles / droplet) · homogenize: break down particles mechanically to make a mixture permanently uniform (milk / emulsion / mixture) · emulsify: force two naturally immiscible liquids into a stable dispersion (oil and vinegar / egg yolk / dressing)
groups.nuance_zh: blend: 将不同成分彻底混融成均质整体 (flavors / batter / spices) · whisk together: 快速搅打使轻质液体混匀并充气 (eggs / dressing / cream) · incorporate: 将次要成分平顺拌入主体基质 (butter / flour / dry ingredients) · suspend: 使不溶微粒均匀悬浮于介质中 (pigment / particles / droplet) · homogenize: 机械破碎微粒以实现长期均质化 (milk / emulsion / mixture) · emulsify: 促使水油等互不相溶的液体形成乳浊液 (oil and vinegar / egg yolk / dressing)

groups.name: Encamp & Station Soldiers · 驻扎营地与划区驻扎 (Encamp, Bivouac, Station)
groups.tip: 为军队调遣安排民居宿营

items.def_en: Position military personnel, naval units, or equipment at a designated outpost
items.ex_en: Allied commanders will station infantry divisions along strategic border outposts before dawn breaks tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 盟军指挥官将于明日黎明前在战略边境哨所部署并驻扎步兵师。

items.def_en: Station troops in a fortified position, fortress, or town to defend it
items.ex_en: The emperor ordered veteran regiments to garrison the frontier citadel against impending barbarian raids.
items.ex_zh: 皇帝下令派遣精锐兵团驻守边境要塞，以抵御即将来袭的蛮族劫掠。

items.def_en: Provide soldiers with accommodation in dedicated military barracks
items.ex_en: Authorities had to barrack reinforcement troops inside converted historic warehouses near the industrial waterfront.
items.ex_zh: 军方不得不将增援部队安置在工业滨水区附近改建的具有历史意义的仓库兵营中。

items.def_zh: 为（军队）安排宿营，使驻扎；把……划分为区
items.def_en: 1. To assign troops to temporary quarters or billets. 2. To divide a territory into administrative districts.
items.ex_en: Generals agreed to canton weary regiments across peaceful agricultural villages during the harsh winter months.
items.ex_zh: 将领们同意在严酷的冬季里将疲惫的军团分派驻扎在宁静的农业村落中。

items.def_en: Settle in or establish a camp, especially of soldiers or nomadic travelers
items.ex_en: Nomadic warriors encamp near the freshwater spring while dusk falls across the barren plateau.
items.ex_zh: 荒芜高原上夜幕降临之际，游牧勇士们在淡水泉边设营扎寨。

items.def_en: Stay in a temporary open-air camp without tents or under minimal improvised shelter
items.ex_en: Exhausted mountaineers decided to bivouac beneath an icy rock ledge until the blizzard subsided.
items.ex_zh: 精疲力竭的登山者们决定在冰冷的岩壁下露宿扎营，直到暴风雪减弱平息。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to stationing armed forces in tactical field camps, dedicated winter garrisons, or designated geographical zones. Distinctions involve field bivouacking, tactical dispersal, and formal base deployment.
groups.summary_zh: 指部队在野外、营地或划分好的防区内扎营、驻防与驻宿扎下根基。
groups.desc_en: Establishing a stationary military presence or temporary bivouac within a defined geographic territory, contrasting with dynamic 'marching' or simple 'camping' through strategic deployment and defensive posturing.
groups.desc_zh: 在特定地理区域建立军队据点或临时宿营，区别于动态的“行军”或纯民用的“露营”，强调战略部署与防御阵地。
groups.nuance_en: station: assign troops or personnel to a specific post or strategic base (troops / guards / fleet) · garrison: secure a fortified town or fortress with permanent defensive troops (fort / outpost / town) · barrack: house military personnel in permanent lodging buildings (soldiers / recruits / regiments) · canton: quarter troops among local inhabitants or district quarters (army / cavalry / division) · encamp: pitch an organized temporary military camp (army / legion / brigade) · bivouac: set up temporary, austere open-air resting quarters without tents (troops / patrol / soldiers)
groups.nuance_zh: station: 派驻或部署军队至战略哨位/基地 (troops / guards / fleet) · garrison: 派兵进驻要塞或城镇执行守备 (fort / outpost / town) · barrack: 将官兵集中安置在营房营舍内 (soldiers / recruits / regiments) · canton: 划区或借住民房让部队休整宿营 (army / cavalry / division) · encamp: 扎设正规野战帐篷军营 (army / legion / brigade) · bivouac: 在野外无帐篷露宿或简陋暂住 (troops / patrol / soldiers)

groups.name: Enchant & Cast Spells · 施法与蛊惑 (Witch, Bewitch, Enchant, Hex)
groups.tip: 借助魅力或巫术操纵心智

items.def_en: to cast a spell over someone; to enchant or bewitch someone through magic or charm
items.ex_en: Ancient folklore claims she could witch unsuspecting travelers with a single, intoxicating emerald gaze.
items.ex_zh: 古老的民间传说称，她仅凭一眼令人陶醉的翠绿凝视便能蛊惑毫无防备的行客。

items.def_en: put under a magical spell, or delight profoundly with an almost supernatural allure
items.ex_en: Her melodic voice seemed to enchant the restless forest creatures gathered around the pool.
items.ex_zh: 她悦耳的嗓音仿佛施了神奇的魔法，迷住了水池周围躁动不安的林间生灵。

items.def_en: bring bad luck or an unfortunate outcome to someone or something by supernatural misfortune
items.ex_en: Please don't mention our winning streak, or you will jinx the entire upcoming championship.
items.ex_zh: 千万别提我们连胜的事，否则你会给接下来的整个冠军决赛招来霉运。

items.def_en: charm, enchant, or influence someone deceitfully, often masking true intentions
items.ex_en: Clever courtiers often beguile gullible young monarchs with flattering falsehoods to secure illicit fortunes.
items.ex_zh: 精巧狡黠的朝臣往往用谄媚的虚言迷诱易受骗的年轻君主，以谋取不义之财。

items.def_en: cast an evil spell or curse upon someone, bringing bad luck or harm
items.ex_en: Spiteful occult practitioners attempt to hex their unsuspecting political rivals with ancient ritualistic curses.
items.ex_zh: 居心不良的术士试图用古老的仪式诅咒，对毫无防备的政敌施咒下蛊。

items.def_zh: 施魔法蛊惑，迷得神魂颠倒
items.def_en: cast a spell on someone, or gain control over them through irresistible magical attraction
items.ex_en: The sorceress sought to bewitch the royal guards through enchanted melodies from afar.
items.ex_zh: 女术士试图自远处通过施有魔法的动人旋律，蛊惑那些皇家卫兵。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on casting magical spells or curses on individuals, or exercising supernatural or seductive sway to bend another's will. The verbs range from folk-magic hexing to irresistible, otherworldly enchanting of romantic partners.
groups.summary_zh: 指运用巫术、符咒或超自然魅力对人施加影响、控制其心智或降下厄运。
groups.desc_en: Subjugating another's will, senses, or fate through magical arts, supernatural charms, or hypnotic delusion, differing from ordinary 'persuasion' by implying occult manipulation or irrational fascination.
groups.desc_zh: 利用法术、超自然咒语或致幻魅力操控他人的心智与命运，区别于普通的“说服”，强调神秘学干预与非理性的摄魂蛊惑。
groups.nuance_en: enchant: cast a delightful or magical spell that captivates completely (audience / lover / senses) · bewitch: paralyze judgment through mesmerizing fascination or sorcery (crowd / travelers / victim) · beguile: charm deceitfully or lead astray with alluring illusions (investors / voters / unsuspecting prey) · hex: inflict malevolent supernatural misfortune or a curse upon (rival / enemy / household) · jinx: bring bad luck accidentally through superstition or careless words (team / deal / mission) · witch: practice dark magic upon or bewitch archaicly (souls / livestock / wanderers)
groups.nuance_zh: enchant: 施以迷人法术或令人心醉神迷 (audience / lover / senses) · bewitch: 以妖术或摄人魅力使其神魂颠倒 (crowd / travelers / victim) · beguile: 以诱人假象巧计诱骗或倾倒 (investors / voters / unsuspecting prey) · hex: 施以恶意巫术下咒降灾 (rival / enemy / household) · jinx: 因迷信或言语乌鸦嘴带来霉运 (team / deal / mission) · witch: 施巫术迷惑或对…施黑魔法 (souls / livestock / wanderers)

groups.name: Enclose & Encircle · 环绕与包围 (Encircle, Hem In, Encompass)
groups.tip: 四面包夹团团围住

items.def_en: To form a ring or circle around someone or something
items.ex_en: Ancient stone dolmens still ring the silent hillside where druidic gatherings once took place.
items.ex_zh: 古老的石棚墓依旧环绕着那座寂静的山坡，德鲁伊的集会曾在此举行。

items.def_en: 1. To be all around someone or something; to encircle on all sides.
items.ex_en: Thick pine forests surround the remote alpine village, protecting it from fierce arctic winds.
items.ex_zh: 茂密的松林环绕着这座偏远的阿尔卑斯小村庄，抵御着凛冽的极地寒风。

items.def_en: To completely surround or enclose physically
items.ex_en: Massive granite cliffs encompass the secluded coastal bay, sheltering docked vessels from oceanic squalls.
items.ex_zh: 巍峨的花岗岩峭壁合抱包围着隐秘的海湾，庇护着停泊船只免受大洋飑风袭击。

items.def_en: To form a complete circle around someone or something
items.ex_en: Dozens of vigilant security guards encircle the diplomatic convoy during the contentious summit protest.
items.ex_zh: 在充满争议的峰会抗议期间，数十名警惕的安保人员紧紧包围着外交车队。

items.def_en: To encircle, surround, or bind around securely
items.ex_en: Jagged volcanic peaks gird the fertile coastal plain against relentless northern continental storms.
items.ex_zh: 参差的火山山脉环绕着肥沃的沿海平原，抵御着来自北方大陆的无情风暴。

items.def_en: To surround someone or something tightly, restricting their freedom of movement
items.ex_en: Aggressive paparazzi hem in the movie star, leaving her no room to reach her limousine.
items.ex_zh: 来势汹汹的狗仔队紧紧围堵住这位影星，让她根本无法脱身走向豪华轿车。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers positioning or moving around an entity so as to enclose, hem in, or form a continuous boundary on all sides.
groups.summary_zh: 指在周围形成闭合边界，将目标全方位包围、围堵或环抱。
groups.desc_en: Forming an unbroken curved or perimeter boundary around an entity, contrasting with mere 'bordering' by asserting continuous spatial closure and restrictive containment.
groups.desc_zh: 沿周边形成封闭的环形边界予以环绕，区别于单侧的“毗邻”，强调周向的空间闭合与合围约束。
groups.nuance_en: surround: encompass on all sides in a basic spatial configuration (house / perimeter / town) · encircle: form a complete geometric circle or tight loop around (city / island / waist) · ring: form a dense circular barrier or defensive formation (stadium / camp / summit) · encompass: comprehensively envelop, contain, or include within boundaries (territory / diverse ideas / whole region) · hem in: tightly restrict movement by trapping on all sides (convoy / army / trapped wild game) · gird: bind or secure tightly around as with a belt or defensive line (city / loins / cliffs)
groups.nuance_zh: surround: 空间上全方位包围或环绕 (house / perimeter / town) · encircle: 形成正圆或紧密闭环加以围拢 (city / island / waist) · ring: 环形列阵围堵以作防卫或围观 (stadium / camp / summit) · encompass: 宏观包含、环抱或统摄于疆域内 (territory / diverse ideas / whole region) · hem in: 紧密合围使之动弹不得 (convoy / army / trapped wild game) · gird: 如腰带般紧束环绕或环设防线 (city / loins / cliffs)

groups.name: Enclose & Fence · 围圈与阻隔 (Fence, Cordon, Enclose)
groups.tip: 设立栅栏圈出一片封闭区域

items.def_en: To separate an area from the space around it by placing ropes around it
items.ex_en: Staff will rope off the central museum courtyard while delicate antique artifacts are unpacked.
items.ex_zh: 在开箱取出易碎古董文物期间，工作人员会用绳索将博物馆中央庭院圈起隔开。

items.def_zh: （用栅栏或篱笆）围住，圈起；击剑；搪塞，回避
items.def_en: 1. To enclose or surround an area of land with a fence. 2. To practice or compete in the sport of fencing. 3. To avoid answering a question directly; equivocate.
items.ex_en: Ranchers must fence their vast pasture lands to keep domestic cattle from wandering onto highways.
items.ex_zh: 牧场主必须用栅栏将大片牧场围住，以防家畜漫步游荡到公路上。

items.def_en: To close off an area to the public using ropes, tapes, or police lines to prevent access
items.ex_en: Armed tactical units will cordon off the surrounding downtown blocks during the forensic investigation.
items.ex_zh: 在法医取证调查期间，全副武装的特警分队将封锁周围的闹市区街区。

items.def_en: To surround an area with bushes or trees, or figuratively to strictly confine someone's freedom
items.ex_en: Dense thorn thickets hedge in the private orchard, deterring local deer from nibbling apples.
items.ex_zh: 茂密的荆棘丛将私人果园严严实实地圈在其中，阻止当地野鹿啃食苹果。

items.def_en: To enclose an area or structure using railings or railings-based barriers
items.ex_en: Park rangers chose to rail in the dangerous cliffside viewing deck with steel posts.
items.ex_zh: 公园巡逻员选择用坚固的钢制立柱将危险的悬崖观景台用栏杆围起来。

items.def_en: To surround something on all sides with a wall, fence, or physical boundary
items.ex_en: Tall wrought-iron barriers completely enclose the historic estate, restricting unauthorized civilian vehicular access.
items.ex_zh: 高耸的锻铁栅栏将这处历史庄园四面圈起，严格限制未获准的民用车辆进入。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe erecting physical barriers, railings, walls, or cordons to circumscribe a perimeter, restrict access, or protect an inner area. Contrasts center on the type of enclosure used (hedges, ropes, palisades) and whether the barrier is defensive, agricultural, or security-focused.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过架设栅栏、围墙或警戒线将区域围起以实施阻隔。
groups.desc_en: Erecting a permeable or light physical perimeter to demarcate territory, prevent trespass, or isolate a zone, contrasting with solid 'walling' through relative ease of installation and visual transparency.
groups.desc_zh: 架设透光或轻质的物理周界以划定领地、阻隔侵入或隔离区域，区别于实心“筑墙”，侧重安装便捷性与视线透光度。
groups.nuance_en: enclose: seal or partition an area within physical boundaries (garden / pasture / courtyard) · fence: surround with wooden, wire, or metal barrier posts (pasture / property / field) · cordon off: seal off an area temporarily with tapes or guards for security (crime scene / blast zone / street) · rope off: designate a temporary perimeter using suspended ropes (VIP area / queue / museum exhibit) · hedge in: box in tightly with shrubs or restrict metaphorically (meadow / choices / freedoms) · rail in: enclose with rigid horizontal bars or balustrades (pen / paddock / balcony)
groups.nuance_zh: enclose: 用实体周界将场地围拢闭合 (garden / pasture / courtyard) · fence: 用栅栏、铁丝网围绕划界 (pasture / property / field) · cordon off: 用警戒线或哨兵封锁隔离危险/涉案现场 (crime scene / blast zone / street) · rope off: 用绳索临时围起限制进入 (VIP area / queue / museum exhibit) · hedge in: 用树篱围住或比喻性限制自由 (meadow / choices / freedoms) · rail in: 用金属或木质栏杆围封 (pen / paddock / balcony)

groups.name: Enclose & Shield · 包围与遮蔽 (Enclose, Envelop, Shroud)
groups.tip: 四周环绕封闭并包裹

items.def_en: (+ in/with) To cover something by folding paper, cloth, or other flexible material around it
items.ex_en: Carefully wrap the delicate porcelain vase in thick bubble film before sealing the parcel.
items.ex_zh: 在封好包裹之前，请小心地用厚气泡膜将易碎的瓷瓶包好。

items.def_zh: 包围，围住；随信（或包裹）附上
items.def_en: 1. To surround or shut in an area on all sides with a wall, fence, or other barrier. 2. To place something inside an envelope or package along with a letter.
items.ex_en: Imposing stone ramparts enclose the ancient settlement, deterring prospective marauders through the ages.
items.ex_zh: 巍峨的石砌城墙将这座古老的定居点四面包围，千百年来一直阻吓着觊觎的劫掠者。

items.def_en: (+ in) To conceal, hide, or cover something as if with a cloak
items.ex_en: Subversive political conspirators often cloak their secret agendas in high-minded appeals for public welfare.
items.ex_zh: 颠覆性的政治密谋者往往将秘密议程隐匿在崇高的公众福祉诉求之下。

items.def_en: To wrap up, cover, or surround someone or something completely on all sides
items.ex_en: Impenetrable seasonal fog banks envelop the coastal promontory, blinding incoming navigators within moments.
items.ex_zh: 浓重得不可穿透的季节性海雾将海角完全笼罩，片刻间让驶近的航海者丧失视线。

items.def_en: (+ in) To cover, obscure, or veil something from clear sight, as with mist, cloth, or darkness
items.ex_en: Swirling white mists shroud the ruined castle battlements as darkness descends upon the valley.
items.ex_zh: 夜幕降临谷地之际，翻卷的白色迷雾完全遮蔽了城堡破败的垛口。

items.def_en: To cover or enclose something completely in a tight, protective case or hard shell
items.ex_en: Specialists encase fragile satellite sensors in hardened titanium alloy canisters for extra launch durability.
items.ex_zh: 专家们将易损的卫星传感器装入坚固的钛合金外壳中，以提升发射耐受度。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on encasing, wrapping, or shutting something in on all sides with protective coverings, wrappings, fog, or screens, sheltering or shielding it from the elements or view.
groups.summary_zh: 全方位包裹、笼罩或遮蔽某物，以起到掩护、保护或密封作用。
groups.desc_en: Completely blanketing an object within a protective, obscuring, or confining outer layer, contrasting with external 'guarding' by operating as an intimate, form-fitting shell.
groups.desc_zh: 用保护性、遮蔽性或贴身的外层完全包裹物体，区别于外部“守卫”，侧重紧密贴合的封套与隐匿屏障。
groups.nuance_en: wrap: fold flexible material entirely around an object (package / scarf / wound) · enclose: shut inside a container, envelope, or protective bounds (letter / document / courtyard) · envelop: wrap completely and softly so as to engulf or suffuse (darkness / flames / mist) · cloak: conceal deliberately beneath an obscuring mantle or cover (identity / intentions / movement) · shroud: veil darkly, eerily, or in deathly obscurity (corpse / mystery / mountain peak) · encase: enclose firmly in a rigid, hard outer protective layer (fossil / jewel / specimen)
groups.nuance_zh: wrap: 用柔软材料整体包裹缠绕 (package / scarf / wound) · enclose: 封入容器、信封或封闭空间内 (letter / document / courtyard) · envelop: 柔和地整体笼罩或吞没 (darkness / flames / mist) · cloak: 借斗篷或假象刻意隐蔽遮掩 (identity / intentions / movement) · shroud: 如裹尸布般阴沉覆盖或使晦暗成谜 (corpse / mystery / mountain peak) · encase: 嵌入坚硬刚性的外壳中保护封存 (fossil / jewel / specimen)

groups.name: Enclose & Wall · 包围与围筑 (Wall, Fence, Cordon)
groups.tip: 砌筑墙壁圈定四周防守封闭

items.def_en: To enclose or confine an area or animals completely with a fence
items.ex_en: Farmers will fence in the sheep paddock before grazing season begins early next spring.
items.ex_zh: 在明春早些时候放牧季节开始之前，农夫们将用栅栏把羊圈彻底圈围起来。

items.def_en: To separate or enclose a section of space using metal or wooden railings
items.ex_en: Engineers decided to rail off the fragile glass platform while maintenance crews inspected structural bolts.
items.ex_zh: 检修团队检查结构螺栓期间，工程师们决定用栏杆将易碎的玻璃平台隔离开来。

items.def_en: To obstruct completely a street, passage, or route to prevent traffic or movement
items.ex_en: Traffic police block off the main intersection whenever official state motorcades cross the capital.
items.ex_zh: 每当外国元首车队穿过首都时，交警都会彻底封锁主要的十字路口通行。

items.def_en: To seal an area or accident site with barricades, tapes, or guards to bar entry
items.ex_en: Emergency teams cordon off the chemical spillage site to shield civilian bystanders from toxic emissions.
items.ex_zh: 应急救援小组拉起警戒线封锁化学品泄漏现场，以防平民围观者遭受有毒气体侵害。

items.def_zh: 用墙围住，筑墙围护；（筑墙）封堵
items.def_en: To surround, enclose, or defend an area with a wall; ('wall off/up') to seal or separate an opening or area with a wall.
items.ex_en: Renovation crews wall up the historic brick archway to reinforce the crumbling foundational structure.
items.ex_zh: 翻新施工队筑墙封堵了这座历史悠久的砖砌拱门，以此加固摇摇欲坠的建筑地基。

items.def_en: To block an entrance, road, or room with improvised defensive barriers
items.ex_en: Defiant demonstrators barricade the university library doors with heavy oak desks and metal cabinets.
items.ex_zh: 顽抗的示威者用沉重的橡木书桌和金属文件柜设路障死死封堵了大学图书馆大门。

groups.summary_en: This frame denotes erecting, deploying, or utilizing structural barriers such as walls, fences, or barricades to partition space, seal perimeters, or block off external access.
groups.summary_zh: 通过构筑实体墙体、栅栏或防线将空间封闭、隔绝或圈禁。
groups.desc_en: Creating an impenetrable, rigid vertical obstruction to divide, seal off, or repel passage, contrasting with light 'fencing' by emphasizing structural mass, defensive fortification, and complete obstruction.
groups.desc_zh: 构筑厚重坚固的竖向实体障碍以阻绝、封锁或防御通行，区别于轻质“围栏”，强调结构体量、工事化与彻底截断。
groups.nuance_en: wall: seal or separate solidly with masonry or stone barriers (garden / entrance / courtyard) · barricade: hastily erect crude, bulky obstructions against an enemy (street / doorway / entrance) · block off: physically obstruct an access route to prevent transit (intersection / traffic / hallway) · cordon off: systematically secure and restrict access via formal lines (disaster area / crime scene / building) · fence in: contain within tall, continuous boundary fences (livestock / perimeter / yard) · rail off: separate a dangerous or restricted section with rigid barriers (edge / track / gallery)
groups.nuance_zh: wall: 砌墙围堵或砖石固封 (garden / entrance / courtyard) · barricade: 仓促构筑街垒工事抵御冲击 (street / doorway / entrance) · block off: 阻断通道以防通行 (intersection / traffic / hallway) · cordon off: 设警戒线管制出入 (disaster area / crime scene / building) · fence in: 用栅栏将人畜围困于内 (livestock / perimeter / yard) · rail off: 用栏杆隔开危险或限制区域 (edge / track / gallery)

groups.name: Encode & Decipher · 编码与破译 (Encrypt, Decode, Scramble)
groups.tip: 把信息转为特定代码格式传递

items.def_en: To convert digital data from one specific encoding format directly into another
items.ex_en: Advanced automated algorithms quickly transcode archived broadcast files into optimized digital formats for preservation.
items.ex_zh: 先进的自动化算法迅速将归档的广播媒体转码为适于保存的优化数字格式。

items.def_en: To alter electronic signals or broadcasts so they can only be received with a special decoder
items.ex_en: Broadcasters scramble their premier pay-per-view transmission signals to deter unauthorized household interception.
items.ex_zh: 广播公司对付费频道的传输信号进行扰频处理，以防止未授权家庭随意拦截接收。

items.def_zh: 编码，将……译成密码；（遗传）编码决定
items.def_en: 1. To convert information, a message, or data into a coded or digital format for security or transmission. 2. (genetics) To specify the genetic code for a protein or trait.
items.ex_en: The software must encode user credentials before transmitting them across the public network.
items.ex_zh: 该软件在通过公共网络传输用户凭据之前必须对其进行编码。

items.def_en: To convert plain data into cipher text to prevent unauthorized access
items.ex_en: Financial institutions routinely encrypt sensitive transactions to protect customer data from unauthorized interception.
items.ex_zh: 金融机构通常会对敏感交易进行加密，以保护客户数据免遭未授权截获。

items.def_en: To translate a coded message, signal, or data back into plain, understandable form
items.ex_en: Engineers worked around the clock to decode the telemetry signal sent from space.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们夜以继日地工作，以破译从太空发回的遥测信号。

items.def_en: To succeed in reading or understanding obscure, illegible, or coded text
items.ex_en: Scholars spent decades attempting to decipher the eroded inscriptions on the ancient monument.
items.ex_zh: 学者们花费了数十年时间试图辨认那座古老纪念碑上风化的铭文。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses technical and communicative operations that transform information into an obfuscated or secret format, or reverse that transformation to render the meaning accessible.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖将信息转化为加密、伪装形式或反向解析破译的通信密码场景。
groups.desc_en: Transforming intelligible information into an unreadable algorithmic format for security, or reversing that transformation, contrasting with mere 'translating' through intentional cryptographic obscurity.
groups.desc_zh: 将可读信息通过算法转换为不可读格式以确保安全，或反向还原，区别于单纯的“翻译”，强调密码学隐秘性与技术还原。
groups.nuance_en: encode: convert information into a standardized digital or symbolic system (data / message / DNA) · encrypt: convert plain text into cryptographic cipher to block unauthorized access (hard drive / communication / password) · scramble: distort an electronic signal or text deliberately into disorder (radio transmission / satellite broadcast / voice) · transcode: convert directly from one digital encoding format to another (video file / audio stream / codec) · decode: extract original meaning from an encoded technical format (signal / transmission / DNA sequence) · decipher: reconstruct meaning from obscure, ancient, or heavily disguised text (hieroglyphs / code / illegible handwriting)
groups.nuance_zh: encode: 将信息转化为标准系统代码 (data / message / DNA) · encrypt: 运用密码学加密防止未经授权读取 (hard drive / communication / password) · scramble: 扰乱电讯信号或字符次序使其失真 (radio transmission / satellite broadcast / voice) · transcode: 在不同数字编码格式之间转码 (video file / audio stream / codec) · decode: 从技术编码中逆向解码还原 (signal / transmission / DNA sequence) · decipher: 破解晦涩、古老或伪装的难懂文段 (hieroglyphs / code / illegible handwriting)

groups.name: Endanger & Put at Risk · 危及与危害 (Endanger, Compromise, Put in jeopardy)
groups.tip: 使事物陷入险境与危机

items.def_en: To be likely to cause damage, harm, or ruin to an existing condition or plan
items.ex_en: Rising sea levels threaten low-lying coastal communities with severe and frequent flooding.
items.ex_zh: 海平面上升威胁着沿海低洼社区，恐将带来严重而频繁的洪灾。

items.def_en: To expose security, integrity, or chances of success to discredit or severe risk
items.ex_en: A single data breach can easily compromise the security of thousands of clients.
items.ex_zh: 一次单独的数据泄露就很容易危及数千名客户的账户安全。

items.def_en: To expose vital assets or outcomes to unpredictable peril or total loss
items.ex_en: The sudden cancellation of government subsidies put thousands of local manufacturing jobs in jeopardy.
items.ex_zh: 政府补贴的突然取消使数千个当地制造业工作岗位陷入险境。

items.def_en: To put someone or something in a situation where they might be harmed, destroyed, or injured
items.ex_en: Reckless industrial waste dumping continues to endanger fragile aquatic ecosystems throughout the region.
items.ex_zh: 肆意倾倒工业废物的行为继续危及整个地区脆弱的水生生态系统。

items.def_en: To put someone or something in serious danger of being harmed, damaged, or lost.
items.ex_en: Leaking confidential negotiation documents would severely jeopardize the entire merger deal.
items.ex_zh: 泄露机密谈判文件将严重损害整起并购交易。

items.def_en: To place someone or something in grave, imminent danger of ruin or failure
items.ex_en: The severe budget deficit could imperil the future of several vital municipal welfare programs.
items.ex_zh: 严重的财政赤字可能会危及数项至关重要的市政福利项目的存续。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe actions or policies that expose plans, status, security, or lives to immediate vulnerability or potential failure. Frequent collocates include future, safety, career, peace, and security.
groups.summary_zh: 指使前途、安全、健康或系统陷入危险、脆弱或失败境地。
groups.desc_en: Exposing a state, entity, or interest to systemic vulnerability, ruin, or imminent harm, differing from direct 'attacking' by bringing about a heightened state of existential hazard.
groups.desc_zh: 使特定主体或利益暴露于脆弱、毁损或迫在眉睫的风险之中，区别于直接的“打击”，强调置入危险境地与系统性威胁。
groups.nuance_en: endanger: place in direct path of biological extinction or physical harm (species / lives / safety) · jeopardize: put a future outcome, success, or stability at serious hazard (career / deal / prospects) · imperil: formally expose to acute, grave existential danger (survival / economy / ecosystem) · compromise: weaken integrity, security, or moral standing through vulnerability (national security / immune system / integrity) · threaten: portend upcoming harm or menace actively (peace / stability / forest) · put in jeopardy: subject formally to judicial, systemic, or severe risk (status / project / freedom)
groups.nuance_zh: endanger: 使生命或物种面临直接生存危险 (species / lives / safety) · jeopardize: 使前途、成果或局势处于毁损危局 (career / deal / prospects) · imperil: 文雅指出使面临存亡绝续之剧烈危机 (survival / economy / ecosystem) · compromise: 破坏防御系统、安全性或原则导致隐患 (national security / immune system / integrity) · threaten: 构成潜在或即将来临的危险预兆 (peace / stability / forest) · put in jeopardy: 使陷入司法或体制性严重险境 (status / project / freedom)

groups.name: Endure & Outlast · 存续与久经 (Outlive, Weather, Withstand, Persist)
groups.tip: 挺过苦难且比他人存活更久

items.def_en: To survive a severe storm, trouble, or difficult condition without serious harm
items.ex_en: The small company managed to ride out the recession without laying off any staff.
items.ex_zh: 这家小公司成功渡过了经济衰退期，且没有裁掉任何员工。

items.def_en: To continue firmly or obstinately to exist beyond the normal or expected duration
items.ex_en: Pockets of high unemployment persist despite the recent rebound in the national economy.
items.ex_zh: 尽管近期国民经济有所回升，但局部高失业率依然持续存在。

items.def_en: To live or remain in existence longer than another person, idea, or institution
items.ex_en: The pioneering philosopher lived long enough to outlive all of his fiercest critics.
items.ex_zh: 这位开创先河的哲学家活得很长，比他所有最激烈的批评者都更为长寿。

items.def_en: To withstand and come safely through a dangerous crisis, storm, or hardship
items.ex_en: The small family firm managed to weather the fierce financial downturn without layoffs.
items.ex_zh: 这家小型家族企业设法平安度过了严峻的经济衰退，没有裁减员工。

items.def_en: To remain undamaged and unaffected by severe stress, force, or wear
items.ex_en: Reinforced concrete structures are specially engineered to withstand catastrophic seismic shocks during earthquakes.
items.ex_zh: 钢筋混凝土结构经过特殊工程设计，以经受住地震期间灾难性的地震震动。

items.def_zh: 比……存活更久，比……维持更长
items.def_en: To continue to exist, survive, or remain effective longer than someone or something else.
items.ex_en: High-quality leather boots will easily outlast cheap footwear made from synthetic materials.
items.ex_zh: 优质的皮靴使用寿命很容易超过合成材料制成的廉价鞋类。

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote surpassing temporal limits or external destructive stresses, continuing to exist, function, or prevail long after rivals, hardships, or natural lifespans have expired.
groups.summary_zh: 强调跨越时间考验或抵御外部风雨侵蚀，比对手或苦难留存更久。
groups.desc_en: Maintaining existence, integrity, or functional survival across severe adversity, temporal decay, or hostile forces, contrasting with passive 'staying' through victorious resistance and longevity.
groups.desc_zh: 历经严酷逆境、时间侵蚀或敌对力量仍维持存续与功能完好，区别于被动的“停留”，侧重顽强抗阻与长久超越。
groups.nuance_en: persist: stubbornly continue to exist despite attempts to eradicate or time (symptoms / doubts / customs) · withstand: successfully resist strong destructive physical or mental pressures (impact / scrutiny / siege) · weather: survive safely through a violent storm or turbulent crisis (storm / scandal / recession) · ride out: navigate through a rough tempestuous period until calm returns (storm / bear market / turmoil) · outlast: survive longer in endurance or durability than a competitor (rivals / battery / peers) · outlive: survive past the death of another person or the usefulness of a thing (spouse / usefulness / children)
groups.nuance_zh: persist: 顽强存留、久经驱除而不散 (symptoms / doubts / customs) · withstand: 抵御猛烈物理冲击、严密审查或围攻 (impact / scrutiny / siege) · weather: 顶住暴风雨或严峻危机安然度过 (storm / scandal / recession) · ride out: 顺应颠簸熬过动荡期以待转机 (storm / bear market / turmoil) · outlast: 在耐受力或寿命上比对手更持久 (rivals / battery / peers) · outlive: 比…活得更长或存续超越其失效期 (spouse / usefulness / children)

groups.name: Engender & Cause · 孕育与产生 (Beget, Spawn, Breed, Foster)
groups.tip: 催生出某种感受或状态

items.def_en: To produce, trigger, or cultivate negative conditions such as conflict, discontent, or crime
items.ex_en: Pervasive social inequality tends to breed deep resentment among marginalized urban communities.
items.ex_zh: 普遍存在的社会不平等往往会在被边缘化的城市群体中滋生深深的怨恨。
items.ex2_en: Dangerous disease mosquitoes breed rapidly in stagnant puddles after heavy tropical rainfalls.
items.ex2_zh: 热带暴雨过后，传播疾病的危险蚊子在死水坑中迅速繁殖。

items.def_en: To encourage the development or growth of ideas, feelings, or relationships
items.ex_en: The university aims to foster meaningful intellectual dialogue among students from diverse backgrounds.
items.ex_zh: 该大学旨在促进来自不同背景的学生之间开展有意义的学术对话。

items.def_en: To cause something abstract or collective to develop or happen
items.ex_en: The controversial new property tax policy gave rise to widespread public protests.
items.ex_zh: 这项备受争议的新房产税政策引发了广泛的公众抗议。

items.def_en: To generate or produce something in prolific quantities, often suddenly or disruptively
items.ex_en: The massive success of the original smartphone spawned countless imitations across the globe.
items.ex_zh: 最初那款智能手机的巨大成功催生了全球各地无数的模仿产品。

items.def_zh: 引起，产生，催生（某种感情、情况或关系）
items.def_en: (formal) To cause a particular feeling, situation, or condition to develop.
items.ex_en: The mayor's ambiguous statements engendered widespread suspicion regarding the actual redevelopment budget.
items.ex_zh: 市长模棱两可的声明引发了公众对实际再开发预算的普遍怀疑。

items.def_en: (formal) To give rise to or bring about a particular effect or condition
items.ex_en: Ancient wisdom warns that greed inevitably begets sorrow and spiritual ruin.
items.ex_zh: 古老的智慧告诫人们，贪婪必将招致悲痛与精神毁灭。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers causative acts whereby specific states, conditions, controversies, or deep emotions are brought into existence. Collocations often involve abstract outcomes like fear, hostility, prosperity, or change.
groups.summary_zh: 指催生、诱发或孕育出特定情感、社会状况或连锁后果。
groups.desc_en: Acting as the conceptual seedbed, fertile origin, or generative condition for new states, emotions, or problems, differing from transactional 'causing' by implying biological or iterative proliferation.
groups.desc_zh: 作为新事态、情绪或隐患的孵化温床与发生源，区别于机械的“导致”，强调生物繁衍般的孕育、滋生与层出。
groups.nuance_en: engender: give rise naturally to feelings, controversies, or states of mind (mistrust / hope / controversy) · beget: generate as father to child, or trigger inevitable sequential results (violence / greed / offspring) · spawn: produce prolifically, rapidly, and often unwelcomely (imitators / sequels / subcultures) · breed: systematically cultivate or foster negative social conditions (contempt / discontent / crime) · foster: tenderly nurture the growth and development of something positive (innovation / talent / cooperation) · give rise to: neutrally serve as the factual origin or trigger for an event (complaints / speculation / complications)
groups.nuance_zh: engender: 孕育或诱发特定心态、争议或情感 (mistrust / hope / controversy) · beget: 如父子相继般催生或引发因果循环 (violence / greed / offspring) · spawn: 如产卵般大量滋生繁殖次级衍生品 (imitators / sequels / subcultures) · breed: 滋生或繁衍恶习、不满等负面态势 (contempt / discontent / crime) · foster: 悉心培育、助长积极良性的发展 (innovation / talent / cooperation) · give rise to: 客观引发事端、猜测或并发症 (complaints / speculation / complications)

groups.name: Enlist & Mobilize · 招募与动员 (Enlist, Mobilize, Conscript)
groups.tip: 应征入伍或争取支持参与

items.def_en: To select and order someone into mandatory military service
items.ex_en: The military council voted to draft thousands of young men into regular infantry units.
items.ex_zh: 军事委员会投票决定征募数千名青年男子进入正规步兵部队。

items.def_en: To bring people together to unite their efforts in support of a cause or military struggle
items.ex_en: The charismatic activist managed to rally thousands of supporters behind the new climate initiative.
items.ex_zh: 这位颇具号召力的活动家设法集结了数千名支持者来拥护这项新的气候倡议。
items.ex2_en: Disheartened troops rallied quickly when their determined commander arrived at the front lines.
items.ex2_zh: 当坚定的指挥官抵达前线时，灰心的部队迅速重整旗鼓。

items.def_en: To commit oneself or register another to join an organization or the armed forces
items.ex_en: My grandfather decided to sign up for the navy immediately after leaving high school.
items.ex_zh: 我祖父高中一毕业就决定报名加入海军。
items.ex2_en: She decided to sign up her young son for private tennis lessons.
items.ex2_zh: 她决定给年幼的儿子报名参加私人网球课程。

items.def_zh: 应征入伍；招募；争取，谋求（支持或帮助）
items.def_en: 1. To join or recruit someone into the armed forces. 2. To ask for and obtain the help, support, or cooperation of someone.
items.ex_en: The charity sought to enlist the direct help of prominent business leaders worldwide.
items.ex_zh: 该慈善机构力求争取世界各地知名商界领袖的直接支持。

items.def_en: To organize people or resources to be ready for active military service or coordinated civic action
items.ex_en: The government swiftly mobilized national emergency resources to aid victims of the earthquake.
items.ex_zh: 政府迅速调动国家应急资源，以援助地震灾民。
items.ex2_en: The elite naval reserves mobilized swiftly in response to rising territorial tensions.
items.ex2_zh: 精锐海军预备役部队迅速动员起来，应对日益紧张的领土局势。

items.def_zh: 强制征召；强行征召入伍
items.def_en: To legally compel someone to join the armed services by law
items.ex_en: During the protracted war, the regime chose to conscript young men indiscriminately.
items.ex_zh: 在旷日持久的战争期间，该政权选择不加区别地强制征召年轻男子入伍。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers signing up or securing personnel for military service or collaborative public action, spanning voluntary self-enlistment, rallying supporters, and state-mandated conscription.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖为军队服役或大型行动招募人手，兼含主动投军、动员盟友与强制征兵。
groups.desc_en: Summoning and organizing individuals into collective, legally binding military service or coordinated civic action, contrasting with casual 'hiring' through martial imperative and collective destiny.
groups.desc_zh: 召集并组织个体进入具有法律约束力的兵役或协同公民行动，区别于日常的“雇佣”，强调军事强制力与群体动员机制。
groups.nuance_en: enlist: secure voluntary commitment or join a military branch/cause (help / army / volunteers) · conscript: enroll individuals compulsorily into military service by law (recruits / civilians / youth) · draft: select and mandate individuals into military duty via official call-up (citizens / soldiers / athletes) · mobilize: assemble and ready armed forces or civilian resources for active crisis (troops / population / resources) · rally: bring scattered supporters or demoralized forces together for unified action (troops / support / party faithful) · sign up: voluntarily register oneself for a role, service, or enlistment (infantry / course / volunteer duty)
groups.nuance_zh: enlist: 自愿入伍或征得外部协助与支持 (help / army / volunteers) · conscript: 依法强制征募兵员服役 (recruits / civilians / youth) · draft: 经官方征兵机制选拔指派入伍 (citizens / soldiers / athletes) · mobilize: 动员军队或战略资源进入临战/战备状态 (troops / population / resources) · rally: 召集涣散力量重整旗鼓协同呼应 (troops / support / party faithful) · sign up: 个人自主报名签署协议参与 (infantry / course / volunteer duty)

groups.name: Enmesh & Trap · 缠结与困陷 (Entangle, Snare, Embroil)
groups.tip: 被网罗陷阱死死缠住难脱

items.def_en: Involve someone or something inextricably in a messy situation or physical knots
items.ex_en: His shady business deals tangled him up in messy lawsuits that lasted years.
items.ex_zh: 他那些不正当的商业交易让他卷入了长达数年的混乱官司之中。
items.ex2_en: The long headphone cords tangled up tightly inside his messy coat pocket.
items.ex2_zh: 长长的耳机线在他杂乱的外套口袋里紧紧缠在了一起。

items.def_zh: 使陷入泥潭；使深陷困境
items.def_en: Cause to become stuck in mud, or involve someone or something in a difficult, slow-moving situation
items.ex_en: Endless bureaucracy threatened to mire the vital regional transit project in perpetual delays.
items.ex_zh: 无休止的官僚程序恐将使这项重大的区域交通项目深陷无尽的拖延之中。

items.def_en: (often passive) To catch or entangle someone or something in a net, or involve them deeply in an unpleasant or complicated situation.
items.ex_en: He soon found himself enmeshed in a corrupt web of corporate deceit and blackmail.
items.ex_zh: 他很快发现自己深陷于错综复杂的企业欺诈与勒索网络之中。

items.def_en: Involve someone deeply in an argument, conflict, or difficult situation
items.ex_en: The ambassador feared the incident would embroil both nations in an unnecessary conflict.
items.ex_zh: 大使担心这起事件会使两国卷入一场不必要的冲突。

items.def_en: Catch someone or something in a snare or trap, or trick them into a difficult situation
items.ex_en: The unscrupulous moneylender used predatory contracts to ensnare desperate borrowers in endless debt.
items.ex_zh: 那名不择手段的放贷人利用掠夺性合同诱骗走投无路的借款人陷入无尽的债务陷阱。

items.def_en: Trick or deceive someone into committing a wrongful act or falling into a compromising position
items.ex_en: Undercover operatives attempted to entrap the corrupt official into accepting an illicit payoff.
items.ex_zh: 卧底探员企图设套诱骗这名腐败官员收受非法贿赂。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe catching, ensnaring, or deeply involving someone in an inescapable physical tangle or a distressing web of circumstances.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过物理网罗或复杂困境将人事物深深绊住、陷害或无法脱身。
groups.desc_en: Capturing an entity within intricate physical snares, sticky morasses, or convoluted social complications, contrasting with simple 'catching' by emphasizing progressive entanglement and inability to break free.
groups.desc_zh: 将实体卷入盘根错节的罗网、泥淖或错综复杂的社会纷争，区别于单纯的“抓住”，强调越陷越深且无法自拔的纠缠性。
groups.nuance_en: enmesh: trap deeply within an intricate, inescapable web or organizational net (scandal / bureaucracy / controversy) · embroil: draw an unwilling party into conflict or messy disputes (country / diplomat / family) · ensnare: capture artfully using a physical snare, clever trap, or seduction (prey / victim / heart) · entrap: trick someone deceitfully into committing a crime or making a fatal error (suspect / criminal / politician) · mire: sink and immobilize heavily in thick mud or stagnant paralysis (tank / economy / negotiations) · tangle up: physically twist fibers or mentally complicate a situation into a knot (hair / cords / affairs)
groups.nuance_zh: enmesh: 卷入纷繁复杂的权力网、丑闻或体系纠葛中 (scandal / bureaucracy / controversy) · embroil: 将无辜者拖入争端纷扰与漩涡 (country / diplomat / family) · ensnare: 用网罗、圈套或心计巧妙诱捕 (prey / victim / heart) · entrap: 设下诱捕圈套引人犯罪或失足 (suspect / criminal / politician) · mire: 深陷泥潭或致使体制/谈判陷入停滞 (tank / economy / negotiations) · tangle up: 物理绞缠打结或把事务搞成乱麻 (hair / cords / affairs)

groups.name: Enslave & Oppress · 奴役与压迫 (Enslave, Subjugate, Oppress)
groups.tip: 残酷压迫并彻底剥夺人身自由

items.def_en: To bring a person, group, or rebellious force under subjection using decisive force
items.ex_en: Riot police deployed tear gas to subdue the violent demonstrators outside city hall.
items.ex_zh: 防暴警察施放催泪瓦斯，以制服市政厅外的暴力示威者。

items.def_en: To govern or treat people in an unjust, cruel, and profoundly restrictive manner
items.ex_en: The totalitarian regime used secret police to systematically oppress ethnic minority groups.
items.ex_zh: 该极权政权利用秘密警察系统性地压迫少数族裔群体。

items.def_en: To rule over or mistreat someone with merciless, absolute, and despotic severity
items.ex_en: The ruthless warlord continued to tyrannize over defenseless villagers throughout the province.
items.ex_zh: 残暴的军阀继续在全省境内残酷虐待毫无防卫能力的村民。

items.def_en: (+ on/underfoot) To violate, crush, or disregard people's freedoms and basic rights roughly
items.ex_en: Citizens marched peacefully when the new emergency law began to trample on civil liberties.
items.ex_zh: 当新的紧急状态法开始践踏公民自由时，市民们举行了和平游行。

items.def_zh: 奴役，使成为奴隶；束缚，使受控制
items.def_en: To make someone a slave, or to completely dominate and control someone's mind, life, or actions.
items.ex_en: Conquering armies would historically enslave captured civilian populations after taking hostile cities.
items.ex_zh: 历史上，征服军在攻占敌对城市后往往会奴役俘获的平民人口。

items.def_en: To defeat and place an entire people or nation under rigid, absolute control
items.ex_en: The Roman legions fought brutal campaigns to subjugate the rebellious tribes of Gaul.
items.ex_zh: 罗马军团进行了残酷的征战，以彻底征服高卢的反叛部落。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate the systemic, coercive deprivation of freedom, autonomy, and human dignity. They describe subjecting a population or person to tyrannical dominance, extreme cruelty, servitude, or crushed spirit.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过强力、专制或残酷手段剥夺人身自由，实施全面统治与压制。
groups.desc_en: Extinguishing an entity's political or personal autonomy through institutionalized tyranny, physical coercion, and forced subjugation, contrasting with legitimate 'governing' by absolute dehumanization and cruelty.
groups.desc_zh: 通过制度性强权、暴力压迫剥夺群体或个体的自主权与自由，区别于合法的“统治”，强调非人道压制与彻底征服。
groups.nuance_en: enslave: legally or physically turn human beings into owned chattel or total dependents (population / prisoners / mind) · subjugate: bring completely under imperial control or military conquest (nations / rebellion / tribes) · oppress: burden cruelly and systematically with unjust authority (minorities / citizens / poor) · tyrannize: rule over despotically and arbitrarily with terrifying cruelty (subjects / household / population) · subdue: bring a rebellious or ferocious force under control by superior might (insurgents / blaze / emotions) · trample: step heavily upon and crush rights, feelings, or dignity arrogantly (rights / feelings / freedoms)
groups.nuance_zh: enslave: 在法律或肉体上沦为奴隶，彻底剥夺人身自由 (population / prisoners / mind) · subjugate: 通过征服在武力或主权上予以臣服归顺 (nations / rebellion / tribes) · oppress: 动用国家强权残暴而系统性地打压 (minorities / citizens / poor) · tyrannize: 专横残暴地施行暴政施虐 (subjects / household / population) · subdue: 以绝对力量制服暴乱、敌对势力或抑制情感 (insurgents / blaze / emotions) · trample: 肆意践踏权利、尊严或自由 (rights / feelings / freedoms)

groups.name: Enter & Ingress · 进入与迈入 (Enter, Ingress, Step into)
groups.tip: 由外部穿入内部

items.def_zh: 进入，迈入；参加，加入；输入，录入
items.def_en: 1. To come or go into a place. 2. To become a member or participant in an organization, competition, or activity. 3. To record or key in data.
items.ex_en: Visitors must present official photographic identification before they can enter the research facility.
items.ex_zh: 访客在进入研究设施之前必须出示官方照片身份证件。

items.def_en: to pass over a threshold or boundary into an interior
items.ex_en: She felt a sudden chill the moment she crossed the threshold of the manor.
items.ex_zh: 跨过庄园门槛的那一刻，她感到一阵突如其来的寒意。

items.def_en: to move by taking steps into an enclosed room or distinct area
items.ex_en: Reporters watched quietly as the defense attorney stepped into the crowded courtroom.
items.ex_zh: 当辩护律师步入拥挤的法庭时，记者们静静地注视着。

items.def_en: to enter a building or room toward the speaker
items.ex_en: The weather turned bitterly cold, so she invited the shivering guests to come in.
items.ex_zh: 天气变得刺骨寒冷，于是她邀请瑟瑟发抖的客人们进屋。

items.def_en: to enter or gain entry into an enclosed space or property
items.ex_en: Unauthorized personnel are strictly forbidden to ingress beyond this secure checkpoint perimeter.
items.ex_zh: 严禁未经授权的人员进入该安全检查站警戒线以内。

items.def_en: to enter a structure or room by walking
items.ex_en: I walked into the silent conference room and found nobody waiting there.
items.ex_zh: 我走进寂静的会议室，发现那里空无一人。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote crossing a boundary, doorway, or threshold to move from outside to inside an enclosed space, territory, or condition.
groups.summary_zh: 指跨越边界或门槛，从外部穿行步入空间或境地内部。
groups.desc_en: Transgressing an outer threshold to pass into an enclosed physical, institutional, or experiential interior, contrasting with 'approaching' by completing spatial or existential crossing.
groups.desc_zh: 跨越外部边界或门槛进入物理、体制或体验性的内部空间，区别于“靠近”，强调完成界线的实质性切入。
groups.nuance_en: enter: cross an exterior boundary to get inside a structure or space (room / market / profession) · cross: transit laterally over a boundary line, threshold, or linear barrier (border / river / threshold) · step into: deliberately place one's foot across an entrance or assume a new role (hall / leadership / office) · walk into: enter casually on foot, or walk unsuspectingly into a trap (office / trap / ambush) · come in: move inside from an outside perspective or respond to an invitation (house / room / harbor) · ingress: execute technical, formal, or astronomical entry through an entry portal (building / airspace / secure facility)
groups.nuance_zh: enter: 跨过边界进入建筑、领地或行业 (room / market / profession) · cross: 穿过边境线、河流或门槛等线性界线 (border / river / threshold) · step into: 迈步跨入空间或履新上任 (hall / leadership / office) · walk into: 步行迈入或毫无防备落入圈套 (office / trap / ambush) · come in: 顺应呼唤从外部走进室内 (house / room / harbor) · ingress: 形式化或技术性地准入特定空域及通道 (building / airspace / secure facility)

groups.name: Enter & Log Data · 输入与录入 (Key in, Type in, Feed, Record)
groups.tip: 通过键盘设备向系统录入指令

items.def_en: to supply continuous information, raw data, or materials directly into a computer or device
items.ex_en: Automated external sensors continuously feed live weather data directly into the central forecasting system.
items.ex_zh: 自动化外部传感器持续将实时气象数据直接输送到中央预报系统中。

items.def_en: to record, store, or preserve data digitally from an analog or direct input source
items.ex_en: High-precision digital scanners capture the subtle physical textures of ancient historical artifacts.
items.ex_zh: 高精度数字扫描仪能抓取录入古代历史文物的细腻物理纹理。

items.def_en: to make an official, systematic record of events, numbers, or activities into a registry
items.ex_en: Security guards must immediately log the details of every delivery vehicle entering the compound.
items.ex_zh: 保安人员必须立即将进入院区的每辆送货车辆的详细信息登记入系统。

items.def_en: To put data, information, or instructions into a computer or system.
items.ex_en: The research assistant needs to input these survey responses into the statistical software.
items.ex_zh: 研究助理需要将这些调查问卷的回复输入到统计软件中。

items.def_en: to type text or numerical data into a computer or digital device using a keypad or keyboard
items.ex_en: Please key in your four-digit PIN to complete the transaction.
items.ex_zh: 请输入您的四位数密码以完成交易。

items.def_en: to enter words or code into an application by striking keys on a keyboard
items.ex_en: You need to type in your four-digit PIN to complete the transaction.
items.ex_zh: 您需要输入四位个人密码才能完成此项交易。

groups.summary_en: Pertains to feeding raw data, text, or instructions into a computing terminal, ledger, or system. The frame highlights the tactile act of keystroking or systematic digitization.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过键盘或接口将文本、数值及数据准确存入系统或文档。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the mechanical or systematic intake of external information into an electronic system or official ledger, differing from general 'writing' by its strict focus on digital processing, structured indexing, and continuous data ingestion.
groups.desc_zh: 指将外部信息机械或系统化地录入电子系统或官方台账，与一般“书写/记录”的区别在于强调数字化处理、结构化归档与数据摄取流程。
groups.nuance_en: feed: continuously supplying dynamic streams into a processing model (data / stream / pipeline) · capture: automatically trapping sensory or raw intake at point of origin (leads / images / audio) · log: officially recording events into a chronologic audit trail (incident / hours / transaction) · input: broad electronic submission into computing variables (parameters / credentials / values) · key in: manual entry specifically via physical keypad (PIN / code / details) · type in: manual entry via standard alphanumeric keyboard (password / URL / prompt)
groups.nuance_zh: feed: 动态持续地向处理模型供给流式数据 (data / stream / pipeline) · capture: 在数据源头处自动截获捕获 (leads / images / audio) · log: 按时间顺序记入正式台账或审计日志 (incident / hours / transaction) · input: 广义地向系统输入变量参数 (parameters / credentials / values) · key in: 特指通过物理键盘/小键盘敲入代码 (PIN / code / details) · type in: 通过标准键盘打字输入文本 (password / URL / prompt)

groups.name: Entertain & Amuse · 娱乐与逗乐 (Divert, Regale, Cheer Up)
groups.tip: 提供消遣，博得愉快欢笑

items.def_en: To provide someone with amusement or enjoyment, especially through performances or hospitality
items.ex_en: The circus troupe traveled between towns to entertain families with daring acrobatic displays.
items.ex_zh: 马戏团在城镇间巡回演出，以大胆的杂技表演给千家万户带来欢乐。

items.def_en: To make someone feel happier, brighter, and more cheerful after sadness or gloom
items.ex_en: His thoughtful surprise gift helped cheer up his sister after her difficult exam.
items.ex_zh: 他贴心准备的惊喜礼物让经历艰苦考试后的妹妹重新高兴起来。
items.ex2_en: The gloomy patient cheered up noticeably upon receiving visits from close childhood friends.
items.ex2_zh: 在得到童年好友的探望后，情绪低落的病人明显振作了起来。

items.def_zh: 逗乐，使发笑；给……提供娱乐，消遣
items.def_en: 1. To make someone laugh or smile. 2. To keep someone pleasantly entertained so that they do not get bored.
items.ex_en: The clown's clumsy antics never failed to amuse the delighted children in the audience.
items.ex_zh: 小丑笨拙滑稽的动作总能把台下兴高采烈的孩子们逗乐。

items.def_en: To distract someone pleasantly from serious matters, fatigue, or boredom
items.ex_en: She read light humorous essays to divert her troubled mind from painful medical worries.
items.ex_zh: 她阅读轻松幽默的随笔，以排解心中因医疗问题引起的痛苦烦忧。

items.def_en: To appeal to someone's sense of humor and make them smile or laugh
items.ex_en: The absurdity of the situation really tickled him, making him burst into laughter.
items.ex_zh: 这种荒诞的境况着实逗乐了他，让他忍不住放声大笑。

items.def_en: (+ with) To entertain or amuse someone delightfully, typically with stories, jokes, or generous food
items.ex_en: The retired captain loved to regale his dinner guests with thrilling seafaring adventures.
items.ex_zh: 这位退役船长喜欢在席间向晚宴宾客讲述惊险的航海历险趣事以取悦他们。

groups.summary_en: These verbs describe capturing someone's attention in a pleasant, cheerful, or humorous way. They range from diverting boredom and providing structured spectacle to producing sudden smiles and laughter.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过幽默言行或娱乐节目引人发笑、驱散无聊并带来身心愉悦。
groups.desc_en: Covers providing pleasant cognitive distraction or evoking laughter to lift mood, differing from generic 'pleasing' by deliberately engaging attention through performance, humor, or storytelling.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过表演、幽默或叙事提供愉悦的心智消遣或逗人发笑以提振情绪，与普通“使高兴”的区别在于强调刻意通过娱乐手段吸引并转移注意力。
groups.nuance_en: entertain: broadly sustaining interest through hosted hospitality or performance (guests / audience / crowds) · amuse: evoking mild laughter, wry smiles, or playful diversion (child / crowd / oneself) · divert: drawing conscious attention away from worry or tedium (mind / thoughts / attention) · regale: captivating listeners with lavish hospitality or delightful anecdotes (audience / listeners / guests with stories) · tickle: sparking sudden humorous delight or flattering a sensory fancy (fancy / ribs / palate) · cheer up: actively dispelling gloom to restore good spirits (friend / patient / team)
groups.nuance_zh: entertain: 广义地通过招待或表演维持受众兴致 (guests / audience / crowds) · amuse: 逗乐并引来会心一笑或消遣解闷 (child / crowd / oneself) · divert: 转移注意力以摆脱忧虑或沉闷 (mind / thoughts / attention) · regale: 用绘声绘色的奇闻轶事或盛宴款待吸引听众 (audience / listeners / guests with stories) · tickle: 触动幽默感或迎合某种偏好喜好 (fancy / ribs / palate) · cheer up: 驱散抑郁阴霾使情绪好转 (friend / patient / team)

groups.name: Entice & Coax · 诱惑与以利相诱 (Entice, Lure, Cajole)
groups.tip: 利用利益或欲望诱导他人

items.def_en: (+ into/away) To persuade or attract someone to go somewhere or do something by offering a pleasant reward or bait
items.ex_en: Scammers often lure unsuspecting victims into fraudulent investment schemes with promises of easy wealth.
items.ex_zh: 骗子往往以轻松暴富的许诺为诱饵，诱骗毫无戒心的受害者陷入欺诈投资骗局。

items.def_en: (+ into/away) To attract or persuade someone to do something by offering something pleasant or advantageous.
items.ex_en: The prestigious firm offered lucrative annual bonuses to entice top software developers away.
items.ex_zh: 这家知名企业开出丰厚年终奖金的条件，以诱使顶尖软件开发者跳槽。

items.def_en: (+ into) To gently and persistently persuade someone to do something through kind words or patience
items.ex_en: The nurse managed to coax the frightened child into taking his bitter medicine quietly.
items.ex_zh: 护士耐心地哄劝那个受惊的孩子安静地把苦药喝了下去。

items.def_en: (+ into) To persuade someone to do something by using sustained flattery or gentle deception
items.ex_en: She skillfully managed to cajole her reluctant brother into driving her to the airport.
items.ex_zh: 她巧舌如簧，成功哄骗不情愿的哥哥开车送她去机场。

items.def_en: (+ into/out of) To persuade or obtain something from someone by using flattering words or ingratiating charm
items.ex_en: The manipulative lobbyist managed to wheedle confidential budget details out of the junior minister.
items.ex_zh: 这个善于钻营的游说客设法从初级部长那里阿谀套出了机密预算细节。

items.def_en: (+ into) To persuade someone to do something through clever, deceitful, or deceptive coaxing
items.ex_en: The slick salesman managed to inveigle the elderly couple into purchasing overpriced insurance coverage.
items.ex_zh: 那个油腔滑调的推销员设法诱骗这对老夫妇购买了价格过高的保险。

groups.summary_en: This frame refers to persuading or attracting someone to go somewhere or perform an act by holding out appealing rewards, inducements, or sweet persuasion. It differs from neutral convincing by relying squarely on attractive bait.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过抛出利益、许诺诱人前景或甜言蜜语引诱劝服他人行动。
groups.desc_en: Involves nudging an unwilling or hesitant agent toward an action through sweet talk, psychological manipulation, or attractive baits, unlike straightforward 'asking' or forceful 'compelling'.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过甜言蜜语、心理操纵或利益诱饵，诱导原本犹豫不决或抗拒的对象采取行动，区别于直截了当的“要求”或暴力“强迫”。
groups.nuance_en: entice: attracting by offering an alluring reward, prospect, or sensory treat (customers / investors / prey) · lure: drawing into a trap, danger, or compromising position via deceptive bait (victims / ships / suspects) · coax: gently and patiently persuading someone hesitant or stubborn (child / agreement / engine) · cajole: persistent teasing flattery and sweet-talk to wear down resistance (colleague / boss / consent) · wheedle: whining or fawning ingratiation to extract a specific favor (concession / money / permission) · inveigle: cunningly enmeshing someone into an unwanted trap or obligation (unsuspecting buyer / victim / consent)
groups.nuance_zh: entice: 以诱人的回报、前景或利益进行吸引招揽 (customers / investors / prey) · lure: 用虚假诱饵将目标引诱至圈套或危险绝境 (victims / ships / suspects) · coax: 耐心温和地哄劝犹豫不决或固执的人 (child / agreement / engine) · cajole: 用持续的甜言蜜语和讨好消磨对方抵抗 (colleague / boss / consent) · wheedle: 低声下气地央求或谄媚套取好处 (concession / money / permission) · inveigle: 运用狡黠心计诱使人陷入圈套或义务 (unsuspecting buyer / victim / consent)

groups.name: Err & Deviate · 判断失误与偏差走偏 (Err, Stray, Lapse)
groups.tip: 认知偏颇酿成差错

items.def_zh: 犯错误，出差错；偏离正道
items.def_en: (formal) To make a mistake or be incorrect in judgment or action.
items.ex_en: Legal scholars argue that the supreme appellate court erred fundamentally in its constitutional interpretation.
items.ex_zh: 法学学者认为最高上诉法院在其宪法解释中犯下了根本性错误。

items.def_en: To make an accidental mistake in conduct, calculation, or judgment
items.ex_en: The rookie financial analyst stumbled by miscalculating the quarterly tax liabilities in the report.
items.ex_zh: 这位初出茅庐的金融分析师在报告中算错了季度税务负债，犯下了失误。

items.def_en: (+ from) To diverge from an accepted standard, truth, or correct path
items.ex_en: The witness began to stray from the factual timeline during aggressive cross-examination.
items.ex_zh: 在咄咄逼人的交叉盘问下，证人开始偏离事实发生的时间线。

items.def_en: (+ into) To slip gradually into an inferior, erroneous, or immoral state
items.ex_en: Without regular oversight, even dedicated workers may lapse into careless and unproductive habits.
items.ex_zh: 若缺乏定期监督，即便是敬业的员工也可能逐渐陷入粗心和效率低下的恶习。

items.def_en: (+ from) To depart from established rules, expected facts, or orthodox beliefs
items.ex_en: The researchers must not deviate from established ethical protocols during the clinical trials.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员在临床试验期间绝不能偏离既定的伦理规范。

items.def_en: To assess a situation, figure, or probability incorrectly
items.ex_en: Officials severely miscalculated the public expenditure required for the infrastructure project.
items.ex_zh: 官员们严重低估了该基建项目所需的公共开支。

groups.summary_en: This frame refers to falling into intellectual, moral, or procedural inaccuracy, emphasizing departure from truth, righteousness, or standard correctness.
groups.summary_zh: 指在判断、道德或行为准则上发生偏差、失误或偏离正道。
groups.desc_en: Emphasizes falling away from an established standard of accuracy, rectitude, or continuity through misjudgment or inadvertence, contrasting with deliberate malice or simple ignorance.
groups.desc_zh: 强调因判断失误或一时疏忽而偏离既定的准确度、道德准则或正轨，与蓄意作恶或单纯无知截然不同。
groups.nuance_en: err: making an intellectual misjudgment or flawed assessment (side of caution / judgment / calculation) · stumble: inadvertently faltering, hesitating, or making a clumsy mistake (words / step / response) · stray: physically or morally wandering away from a designated path or flock (path / topic / principles) · lapse: temporarily failing in attention or sliding into an inferior state (judgment / memory / concentration) · deviate: systematically diverging from an established norm, route, or standard (norm / course / protocol) · miscalculate: committing a fatal error in strategic prediction or arithmetic assessment (risk / cost / reaction)
groups.nuance_zh: err: 出现理性判断或裁决上的失误差错 (side of caution / judgment / calculation) · stumble: 因不留神而结巴口误或办事失足 (words / step / response) · stray: 在空间或道德路径上发生迷失偏离 (path / topic / principles) · lapse: 专注度出现短暂脱节或滑向不良状态 (judgment / memory / concentration) · deviate: 系统性地偏离既定轨道、常规或标准 (norm / course / protocol) · miscalculate: 在战略预判或数值测算上发生致命误判 (risk / cost / reaction)

groups.name: Establish & Locate · 设立与进驻 (Base, Station, Anchor)
groups.tip: 建立机构并落定选址

items.def_zh: 将基地设于；定居扎根于
items.def_en: (+ in/at) To locate the operational centre, headquarters, or personnel of an organization in a place
items.ex_en: The technology firm decided to base its regional branch in central Singapore.
items.ex_zh: 这家科技公司决定将其区域分部设在新加坡市中心。

items.def_en: To assign an organization's personnel or military unit to a designated post
items.ex_en: The ministry will station peacekeepers along the contested border to deter aggression.
items.ex_zh: 该部将在有争议的边界沿线部署维和人员以遏制侵略。

items.def_en: To provide living accommodations and institutional operational lodgings in a venue
items.ex_en: The command chose to quarter the infantry division in local barracks.
items.ex_zh: 司令部决定将步兵师驻扎在当地的兵营中。

items.def_en: To establish the headquarters or main center of operations of an organization or business in a particular place.
items.ex_en: The conglomerate chose to headquarter its European operations in central Frankfurt.
items.ex_zh: 该企业集团选择将欧洲业务总部设在法兰克福市中心。

items.def_en: To establish an office, business, or operational presence in a location
items.ex_en: Several innovative software firms set up shop in the emerging tech district.
items.ex_zh: 几家创新型软件公司在新兴的科技园区开业立足。

items.def_en: To firmly fix an enterprise or institution within a regional community or hub
items.ex_en: The new research university will anchor economic development throughout the entire valley.
items.ex_zh: 这所新建的研究型大学将成为带动整个流域经济发展的核心依托。
items.ex2_en: The heavy naval vessel anchors securely in the calm sheltered deep harbor.
items.ex2_zh: 沉重的海军舰船在风平浪静的避风深水港中稳稳抛锚。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate placing or stationing the headquarters, central operations, or core physical footprint of an enterprise in a particular location.
groups.summary_zh: 指将企事业单位、指挥部或业务中枢设立并安顿于某特定地点。
groups.desc_en: Specifies placing institutional presence, personnel, or commercial operations in a definitive geographic locus, contrasting with temporary visiting or abstract existence.
groups.desc_zh: 指将机构实体、军警人员或商业运营固定在特定的地理坐标作为立足点，区别于暂时的途经拜访或抽象的存在。
groups.nuance_en: base: grounding primary operational support or identity in a central territory (operations / troops / headquarters) · station: deploying personnel or military units to a specific post for vigilance (guards / troops / fleet) · quarter: billeting or housing personnel in designated living quarters (soldiers / troops / garrison) · headquarter: designating the executive command node of an organization (business / command / agency) · set up shop: initiating commercial or professional activity in a new market (business / practice / branch) · anchor: securely rooting a network or development project in a stable hub (development / coalition / mall)
groups.nuance_zh: base: 将主要业务支持或身份依托立足于核心地域 (operations / troops / headquarters) · station: 将人员或部队派驻到指定哨位执行常态戒备 (guards / troops / fleet) · quarter: 为驻军或特定人员安排驻扎住所 (soldiers / troops / garrison) · headquarter: 将执行指挥中枢设立在某地 (business / command / agency) · set up shop: 在新据点破土开展商业或执业活动 (business / practice / branch) · anchor: 将开发项目或网络稳固地扎根锚定于核心枢纽 (development / coalition / mall)

groups.name: Evade & Shirk Duty · 逃避与推卸 (Dodge, Duck, Weasel Out)
groups.tip: 懒惰推卸责任或逃避义务

items.def_en: (+ of) To withdraw from a commitment, contract, or promised task before completion
items.ex_en: The investors tried to back out of the agreement at the eleventh hour.
items.ex_zh: 投资者在最后关头试图反悔并退出协议。
items.ex2_en: The frightened driver backed the large delivery truck out of the narrow alleyway.
items.ex2_zh: 受惊的司机将大型送货卡车从狭窄的小巷中倒了出来。

items.def_en: To shift responsibility or blame for an obligation onto somebody else
items.ex_en: Instead of admitting their gross mistake, the senior managers chose to pass the buck.
items.ex_zh: 高级管理层没有承认他们的严重错误，而是选择推卸责任。

items.def_en: To cleverly or dishonorably avoid an awkward duty, meeting, or difficult interview
items.ex_en: The senator tried to duck pressing questions about the ongoing campaign audit.
items.ex_zh: 参议员试图回避有关正在进行的竞选审计的紧迫问题。

items.def_en: To deliberately avoid dealing with a responsibility, obligation, question, or payment
items.ex_en: He went to great lengths to dodge his lawful corporate tax obligations.
items.ex_zh: 他竭尽全力逃避自己法定的企业纳税义务。

items.def_en: To deliberately avoid doing work, a duty, or a responsibility that you should do.
items.ex_en: A responsible officer should never shirk difficult duties during an administrative crisis.
items.ex_zh: 一位负责任的官员绝不应在行政危机期间推卸艰巨的职责。

items.def_zh: 耍滑头逃避（承诺或义务）
items.def_en: (+ of) To avoid doing something promised or required by acting dishonestly or making devious excuses
items.ex_en: He fabricated an elaborate excuse to weasel out of his weekend shift.
items.ex_zh: 他编造了一个复杂的借口来耍滑头逃避周末的值班。

groups.summary_en: This frame involves deliberately avoiding duties, accountability, work, or difficult questions through excuses, subterfuge, or deceit. Unlike physical flight, this involves moral evasion of societal or professional obligations.
groups.summary_zh: 通过借口、推诿或欺骗手段逃避责任、工作或义务。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on deceitful, cowardly, or opportunistic maneuvers used to escape accountability, onerous labor, or explicit commitments, contrasting with honest refusal.
groups.desc_zh: 强调通过欺瞒、怯懦或投机取巧的手段逃避责任、繁重劳务或明确承诺，区别于光明正大的拒绝放弃。
groups.nuance_en: dodge: nimbly evading a direct blow, difficult question, or legal liability (question / taxes / bullet) · duck: swiftly dropping out of view to avoid awkward encounters or duties (issue / responsibility / meeting) · shirk: dishonorably avoiding strenuous duty, sacrifice, or hard work (duty / responsibility / work) · pass the buck: shifting blame or administrative headache onto another colleague (blame / problem / responsibility) · weasel out: wriggling out of a promise or trap through slippery excuses (commitment / deal / agreement) · back out: formally or abruptly retreating from a prior agreement at the eleventh hour (deal / contract / agreement)
groups.nuance_zh: dodge: 敏捷侧身闪避直面而来的质问、赋税或责任 (question / taxes / bullet) · duck: 迅速缩头潜藏以躲开棘手事项或照面 (issue / responsibility / meeting) · shirk: 缺乏操守地偷懒逃避繁重职责或艰苦劳务 (duty / responsibility / work) · pass the buck: 将烫手山芋或过失推卸转嫁给他人 (blame / problem / responsibility) · weasel out: 用油嘴滑舌的借口钻空子钻出承诺 (commitment / deal / agreement) · back out: 在最后一刻毁约临阵退缩 (deal / contract / agreement)

groups.name: Exacerbate & Aggravate · 恶化与加剧 (Intensify, Worsen, Inflame)
groups.tip: 火上浇油，事态朝更坏方向演变

items.def_en: To become or make something of lower quality, poorer condition, or greater severity
items.ex_en: Severe storms will worsen travel conditions across the northern highways this weekend.
items.ex_zh: 严重的暴风雨将使本周末北部高速公路的出行条件进一步恶化。
items.ex2_en: Her chronic health condition worsened rapidly despite taking the prescribed medical treatments.
items.ex2_zh: 尽管接受了处方药物治疗，她的慢性健康状况仍迅速恶化。

items.def_en: To make a problem or difficult situation worse by adding further complications to it
items.ex_en: Prolonged logistical strikes compounded the severe supply chain shortages across the region.
items.ex_zh: 长期的物流罢工加剧了整个地区严重的供应链短缺问题。

items.def_en: To increase rapidly in size, severity, intensity, or hostility
items.ex_en: Border skirmishes threaten to escalate the regional conflict into all-out armed war.
items.ex_zh: 边境摩擦有可能使该地区冲突升级为全面武装战争。
items.ex2_en: Border disputes escalated into a serious international crisis within just few weeks.
items.ex2_zh: 边境争端在短短几周内升级为严重的国际危机。

items.def_en: To make an injury, problem, or offense worse or more serious
items.ex_en: Strenuous physical labor will only aggravate the serious injury in your shoulder.
items.ex_zh: 繁重的体力劳动只会加重你肩膀的严重损伤。

items.def_en: To make a problem, bad situation, or negative feeling worse or more severe.
items.ex_en: The rising interest rates will exacerbate financial distress among lower-income households.
items.ex_zh: 不断上升的利率将加剧低收入家庭的财务困境。

items.def_en: To provoke or intensify violent, angry, or painful feelings and situations
items.ex_en: His inflammatory speech served only to inflame bitter hatred between rival factions.
items.ex_zh: 他那煽动性的演说只会激化对立阵营之间的刻骨仇恨。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers actions or circumstances that deepen the severity, pain, bitterness, or volatility of an already negative situation. These verbs emphasize an escalation from bad to much worse.
groups.summary_zh: 使已有的不良状态、矛盾或伤痛变得更加严峻或激烈。
groups.desc_en: Describes the sharp deterioration of an already negative condition or volatile conflict, differing from neutral 'increase' by adding irritation, complexity, or dangerous intensity.
groups.desc_zh: 指本已消极的事态或一触即发的冲突发生急剧恶化，区别于中性的“增加”，包含加剧刺痛、复杂化或推向危险烈度的特质。
groups.nuance_en: worsen: simple gradual or precipitous decline in quality or condition (situation / health / relations) · compound: multiplying difficulties by adding fresh layers of trouble (problem / debt / crisis) · escalate: accelerating the scope, scale, or violence of an armed or social confrontation (conflict / violence / crisis) · aggravate: making an existing injury, legal fault, or annoyance sharper and more painful (injury / symptom / situation) · exacerbate: provoking a volatile problem into a much more acute crisis (tension / inequality / shortage) · inflame: stoking intense passions, hatreds, or physical inflammation (passions / debate / grievance)
groups.nuance_zh: worsen: 状态、品质或局势发生简单的逐渐或急剧变坏 (situation / health / relations) · compound: 叠加上新的麻烦使困境成倍复加 (problem / debt / crisis) · escalate: 武装或社会冲突的规模、烈度与范围急剧升级 (conflict / violence / crisis) · aggravate: 使现有的创伤、病情或冒犯更趋刺痛剧烈 (injury / symptom / situation) · exacerbate: 刺激易挥发的不良问题恶化成更尖锐的危机 (tension / inequality / shortage) · inflame: 煽风点火激化群体怒火、偏见或仇恨 (passions / debate / grievance)

groups.name: Exacting Extraction & Overburden · 苛征与过度剥削 (Overburden, Fleece, Bleed dry)
groups.tip: 施加过重税负或过度压榨

items.def_en: To exploit a situation, system, or person dishonestly to extract the maximum possible money or advantage
items.ex_en: Corrupt executives managed to milk the failing subsidiary for millions in bonuses.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的高管设法从这家濒临倒闭的子公司榨取了数百万的奖金。

items.def_en: (informal) To strip someone of money or property through excessive fees, overcharging, or fraud
items.ex_en: Disreputable repair shops often fleece vulnerable tourists for basic vehicle maintenance.
items.ex_zh: 不良修理厂经常在基础车辆保养上敲诈人生地不熟的游客。

items.def_zh: 哄抬价格以勒索；漫天要价
items.def_en: To overcharge customers unfairly, especially during an emergency or shortage
items.ex_en: Opportunistic vendors attempted to gouge desperate residents during the severe hurricane.
items.ex_zh: 投机商贩在严重飓风期间试图向绝望的居民漫天要价。

items.def_en: To weigh down an individual, system, or economy with excessive responsibilities, debts, or demands
items.ex_en: Excessive administrative paperwork will overburden frontline healthcare workers in rural clinics.
items.ex_zh: 过多的行政繁文缛节会让乡村诊所的一线医护人员负担过重。

items.def_zh: 向……征税过重；使负担过度，使劳累过度
items.def_en: 1. To demand too much tax from someone or something. 2. To put too great a demand on someone's physical strength, ability, or resources.
items.ex_en: The aggressive fiscal measure threatened to overtax struggling small manufacturing businesses.
items.ex_zh: 这项激进的财政举措恐将使苦苦挣扎的小型制造企业负担过重。

items.def_en: To deplete all the financial resources of a person, firm, or country through sustained extortion or expenses
items.ex_en: Endless corporate lawsuits threaten to bleed the struggling technology startup completely dry.
items.ex_zh: 无休止的企业诉讼恐将把这家苦苦挣扎的初创科技公司彻底榨干。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this economic and possessive frame describe subjecting people, organizations, or resources to excessive levies, extortionate financial demands, or ruinous extraction. The core sense ranges from burdensome official taxes to predatory swindling.
groups.summary_zh: 强调对财务或体能资源施以过重负荷、苛捐杂税或残酷抽吸剥削。
groups.desc_en: Involves applying merciless fiscal or physical pressure to extract maximum value until the victim is hollowed out, differing from ordinary taxation or fair pricing.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过残酷的财政或体力压榨获取极限利益，直至受害者被掏空殆尽，区别于正常的课税或合理定价。
groups.nuance_en: milk: systematically extracting resources or advantages over a prolonged duration (system / cash cow / investor) · fleece: stripping an unsuspecting or vulnerable client of funds via deceit or rip-offs (tourists / victims / customers) · gouge: charging exorbitant, unconscionable prices during artificial or real emergencies (consumers / prices / customers) · overburden: crushing an entity under unsustainable weight or logistical demands (taxpayer / infrastructure / system) · overtax: exhausting internal strength, capacity, or resources beyond their breaking point (resources / patience / system) · bleed dry: completely draining money, vitality, or lifeblood until utter collapse (economy / victim / coffers)
groups.nuance_zh: milk: 长期而系统化地从目标身上挤压榨取剩余价值 (system / cash cow / investor) · fleece: 通过欺瞒或暴利手段将单纯受害者的钱财剥光 (tourists / victims / customers) · gouge: 在稀缺或紧急关头敲竹杠索要畸形高价 (consumers / prices / customers) · overburden: 用不堪重负的负担压垮体系或纳税人 (taxpayer / infrastructure / system) · overtax: 使资源、耐受力或机能超负荷运转至极限 (resources / patience / system) · bleed dry: 彻底放干吸尽受害者的资金或命脉血汗 (economy / victim / coffers)

groups.name: Exceed Permitted or Welcome Presence · 逾期逗留与怠慢客套 (Overstay, Outstay, Trespass)
groups.tip: 逗留时间超出许可或预期期限

items.def_zh: 逗留过久令主人嫌弃，过分叨扰
items.def_en: fixed idiom: to stay somewhere as a guest longer than one's hosts desire
items.ex_en: The noisy tourists did not realize they had begun to outstay their welcome.
items.ex_zh: 喧闹的游客没有意识到他们的久留已经开始令主人心生厌烦。

items.def_zh: 逾期滞留，超过签证合法期限停留
items.def_en: collocation: to remain illegally in a country past the authorized expiration date
items.ex_en: Foreign students who overstay their visa risk immediate deportation and heavy fines.
items.ex_zh: 逾期滞留签证的留学生面临被立即驱逐出境并处以重罚的风险。

items.def_en: remain in a place or social setting longer than is necessary, welcome, or customary
items.ex_en: Hang on a second, let me grab a pen to write that down.
items.ex_zh: 稍等一下，我拿支笔把它记下来。

items.def_en: stay somewhere past the time when one is expected or welcomed to leave
items.ex_en: A few unwanted guests continued to linger on after the official reception.
items.ex_zh: 几位不受欢迎的宾客在正式招待会结束后仍旧赖着不走。

items.def_zh: 停留超过（规定时间或期限）；逗留过久
items.def_en: To stay somewhere longer than an allowed or expected time (e.g. overstay one's visa/welcome).
items.ex_en: Travelers must ensure they do not overstay their permitted time in the country.
items.ex_zh: 旅客必须确保自己在该国停留的时间不超过规定期限。

items.def_zh: 逗留超过（时间限制或主人的容忍度）；比……逗留更久
items.def_en: To stay longer than permitted or welcome (especially in 'outstay one's welcome'); to stay longer than someone else.
items.ex_en: The stubborn delegate continued to outstay every other diplomat at the conference.
items.ex_zh: 那位固执的代表在会议上比其他所有外交官都停留得更久。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this relational frame describe remaining in a location, host's residence, or legal jurisdiction beyond the time permitted by explicit visa allowances or implicit social welcome. Overstay focuses on legal/temporal threshold breaches (e.g., visas), outstay typically governs social hospitality (outstaying one's welcome), while tarry over/overhang involve improper prolongation.
groups.summary_zh: 指停留时间超出签证许可期限，或客人逗留过久耗尽主人好客热情的行为。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on lingering in a physical or social space beyond the boundaries of explicit legality or unwritten social patience, differing from neutral 'staying' by its breach of courtesy or law.
groups.desc_zh: 强调在物理或社交空间内滞留的时间突破了法律明文界限或无形的社交礼数容忍度，区别于中性的“停留”。
