groups.nuance_en: overstay: exceeding an official chronological limit, especially legal residency rights (visa / permit / time limit) · outstay: staying socially longer than one's host finds pleasant or permissible (welcome / visit) · outstay one's welcome: crystallizing the idiomatic exhaustion of a host's social hospitality (welcome) · hang on: stubbornly clinging to a lingering existence, position, or life (office / life / power) · linger on: persisting softly in a space or memory long past its natural dusk (memory / smell / twilight)
groups.nuance_zh: overstay: 超出法定的时限，特指逾期非法居留 (visa / permit / time limit) · outstay: 逗留时间长于主人接纳的社交耐心极限 (welcome / visit) · outstay one's welcome: 习语化表达因呆得太久而招人生厌 (welcome) · hang on: 顽固恋栈职位、硬撑存续或苟延残喘 (office / life / power) · linger on: 在空间或记忆中依依不舍地延存盘桓 (memory / smell / twilight)

groups.name: Exclude & Banish · 排斥与驱逐放逐 (Exclude, Ostracize, Banish)
groups.tip: 从排除在外升级为逐出国境

items.def_en: To prevent someone or something from entering a place or participating in discussions
items.ex_en: The committee decided to shut out independent observers from the critical deliberations.
items.ex_zh: 委员会决定将独立观察员排除在关键审议之外。

items.def_en: To officially prevent someone from going somewhere, taking part, or securing a right
items.ex_en: Strict safety regulations bar unauthorized visitors from entering the heavy manufacturing zone.
items.ex_zh: 严格的安全规程禁止未经授权的人员进入重工业制造区。

items.def_zh: 排斥，排除在外；不包括，不予考虑
items.def_en: 1. To deliberately prevent someone or something from entering a place or taking part in an activity. 2. To leave out or decide not to consider something.
items.ex_en: The selection committee chose to exclude unqualified candidates from the final interview.
items.ex_zh: 选拔委员会决定将不合格的候选人排除在终面之外。

items.def_en: To intentionally refuse to speak to, associate with, or accept someone into a community or group
items.ex_en: The village elders chose to ostracize anyone who violated traditional communal customs.
items.ex_zh: 村里的长辈决定排挤并孤立任何违反传统公社习俗的人。

items.def_en: To force someone to live away from their native country, often for political reasons
items.ex_en: The authoritarian regime chose to exile prominent political dissidents to remote islands.
items.ex_zh: 该独裁政权决定将著名的政治异见人士流放到偏远岛屿。

items.def_en: To officially send someone away from a country or place of residence as a punishment
items.ex_en: The royal decree would banish convicted conspirators from the imperial capital permanently.
items.ex_zh: 皇家法令将永久把定罪的谋反者驱逐出帝国首都。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this intensity spectrum describe deliberate rejection, social cutoff, or physical banishment from a collective, community, or privilege, spanning quiet omission to permanent exile.
groups.summary_zh: 指将人蓄意排斥在外，直至施以社会孤立、放逐出境的强硬手段。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the deliberate physical, legal, or social expulsion of an individual from an ingroup or sovereign homeland, differing from ordinary departure by its punitive enforcement.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过司法、暴力或集体共识，将某人从社群或母国物理或社会性地排斥驱逐，区别于自愿离去，带有惩戒性质。
groups.nuance_en: exclude: shutting out from participation, privilege, or membership by boundary rules (competitors / evidence / applicants) · shut out: forcefully or unfeelingly locking someone out of a game, circle, or opportunity (rival / opponent / noise) · bar: imposing an impassable legal or physical barrier against entry (entry / access / candidate) · ostracize: socially freezing out an individual through collective silent rejection (individual / dissenter / member) · exile: legally sending away a citizen to reside permanently outside their native borders (dissident / leader / writer) · banish: commanding absolute, irrevocable expulsion from a sovereign territory or mental state (traitor / thought / criminal)
groups.nuance_zh: exclude: 依据准则边界排斥于参与权、特权或资格之外 (competitors / evidence / applicants) · shut out: 强硬无情地将对手拒于局外或机会之门外 (rival / opponent / noise) · bar: 设置不可逾越的法令或物理门槛予以阻拦 (entry / access / candidate) · ostracize: 群体一致形成冷暴力对异见者实行社交孤立 (individual / dissenter / member) · exile: 依政令将本国公民放逐驱逐至国境之外 (dissident / leader / writer) · banish: 勒令永久放逐出主权领地，或强行摒除杂念 (traitor / thought / criminal)

groups.name: Excrete & Defecate · 排便与排泄 (Defecate, Excrete, Shit)
groups.tip: 生理代谢物排放过程

items.def_zh: 拉屎，排便；拉屎弄脏；戏弄，胡扯
items.def_en: 1. (taboo slang) To pass feces from the bowels; defecate. 2. (slang) To tease, mock, or attempt to deceive someone.
items.ex_en: The stray dog decided to shit on the pristine front lawn.
items.ex_zh: 那只流浪狗决定在平整干净的前草坪上拉屎。

items.def_en: to defecate (slang, mildly vulgar)
items.ex_en: He had to crap behind the bushes during the long mountain hike.
items.ex_zh: 在漫长的山地徒步途中，他不得不去灌木丛后拉屎。

items.def_zh: 拉屎，便便（儿童语或非正式口语）
items.def_en: to defecate; used informally, especially by or to children
items.ex_en: The young toddler announced loudly that he needed to poop immediately.
items.ex_zh: 那个小幼儿大声宣告自己需要马上便便。

items.def_en: [I/T] to separate and discharge waste matter from the body or system
items.ex_en: Certain marine organisms excrete excess salt through specialized cellular glands.
items.ex_zh: 某些海洋生物通过专门的细胞腺体排泄多余的盐分。

items.def_zh: 拉屎，排便（shit 的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: (taboo slang) Past tense and past participle of shit: to defecate.
items.ex_en: The terrified captive shat himself during the violent artillery bombardment yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 那名吓坏的俘虏在昨天猛烈的炮击中吓得拉了裤子。

items.def_zh: 排便，大便（正式或医学语体）
items.def_en: to pass solid waste from the body through the bowels (formal/clinical)
items.ex_en: Patients unable to defecate naturally may require specialized medical intervention promptly.
items.ex_zh: 无法自然排便的患者可能需要立即接受专业的医疗干预。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to expelling solid waste from the bowels, ranging across clinical/formal biological terms, neutral everyday phrasing, and vulgar slang.
groups.summary_zh: 指将体内固体废物排出体外的生理行为，涵盖医学术语、口语及粗俗俚语。
groups.desc_en: Encompasses the biological expulsion of solid digestive waste, stratified strictly by sociolinguistic registers ranging from sterile medical clinicality to crude street profanity.
groups.desc_zh: 涵盖人体或动物排出固体消化道废弃物的生理行为，在社会语言学上因语域跨度极大（从严肃医学到市井粗口）而形成鲜明层级。
groups.nuance_en: excrete: technical biological discharge of waste matter from an organism (waste / sweat / toxins) · defecate: formal clinical or scientific terminology for evacuating the bowels (patient / animal) · poop: mild, sanitized colloquialism primarily used with or by young children (toddler / diaper) · shit: raw, emphatic, and vulgar taboo profanity for defecation (pants / brick) · crap: blunt, colloquial, mildly coarse slang (pants) · shat: archaic or deliberate mock-dramatic past form used for colloquial shock or humor (bed / pants)
groups.nuance_zh: excrete: 生物体排出代谢废弃物的专业生理学术语 (waste / sweat / toxins) · defecate: 临床医学与科学描述排便的正式语域词 (patient / animal) · poop: 带有儿语色彩、温和经过修饰的口语表达 (toddler / diaper) · shit: 粗俗、具冒犯性但极为强烈的市井禁忌粗话 (pants / brick) · crap: 介于粗鄙与市井之间的通俗俚语 (pants) · shat: 带有古旧风或刻意戏剧化调侃效果的 shit 过去式 (bed / pants)

groups.name: Execute & Capital Punishment · 依法处决与处死 (Execute, Decapitate, Hang)
groups.tip: 斩首等不同方式的死刑处决

items.def_en: to kill someone by tying a rope around their neck and dropping them
items.ex_en: The state decided to hang the convicted murderer at dawn yesterday morning.
items.ex_zh: 该州决定于昨天清晨对那名被定罪的凶手执行绞刑。

items.def_en: to kill someone as a lawful punishment for a serious crime
items.ex_en: The state intended to execute the convicted war criminal at sunrise.
items.ex_zh: 该州打算在日出时分处决这名被定罪的战争罪犯。

items.def_en: (+ sb) To execute someone by hanging, whether judicially or extrajudicially
items.ex_en: An angry mob threatened to string up the suspected horse thief.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的暴徒威胁要将那名涉嫌偷马的盗贼吊死。

items.def_zh: 斩首，砍头；使（组织等）群龙无首
items.def_en: 1. To cut off the head of a person or animal, especially as an execution. 2. (figurative) To weaken or destroy an organization by removing its leaders.
items.ex_en: The radical revolution aimed to decapitate the entire ruling royal aristocracy completely.
items.ex_zh: 激进革命旨在彻底斩断并瓦解整个统治王室贵族阶层。

items.def_en: to execute someone using a guillotine
items.ex_en: The revolutionary tribunal ordered guards to guillotine the traitor in the square.
items.ex_zh: 革命法庭命令警卫在广场上用断头台处决该叛徒。

items.def_zh: 以电刑处死；使触电致死（或重伤）
items.def_en: To kill or severely injure someone by passing a strong electric current through their body, especially as an execution method or by accident.
items.ex_en: The prison used a high-voltage chair to electrocute the condemned serial killer.
items.ex_zh: 监狱使用高压电椅对这名被判死刑的连环杀手执行了电刑。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify carrying out a legal sentence of death on a person, distinguished primarily by the mechanical or physical method used (e.g., severance, electric current, suspension).
groups.summary_zh: 指依照法律判决处死罪犯，核心区分在于具体的行刑手段与方式。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the deliberate, juridical termination of a human life pursuant to a lawful capital sentence, distinguishing institutional execution from extrajudicial murder or lynching.
groups.desc_zh: 指依据死刑判决以特定刑讯技术合法剥夺受刑人生命的司法行为，区别于法外的私刑或单纯的谋杀。
groups.nuance_en: execute: lawful administrative carrying out of an official death sentence (prisoner / convict / traitor) · hang: suspending by the neck using a noose until dead from asphyxiation or broken cervical vertebrae (criminal / captive / pirate) · string up: informal, violent extrajudicial lynching or crude hanging by an angry mob (vigilante / suspect) · decapitate: severing the head cleanly or brutally from the body via blade or trauma (captive / victim / corpse) · guillotine: mechanized decapitation specifically using the heavy falling blade apparatus (king / aristocrat / traitor) · electrocute: putting to death by conducting lethal high-voltage electrical current through the body (death-row inmate / murderer)
groups.nuance_zh: execute: 依照官方定谳依法行刑处死 (prisoner / convict / traitor) · hang: 用套索悬颈致窒息或颈椎折断绞死 (criminal / captive / pirate) · string up: 暴民非正规私刑处决或简陋就地吊死 (vigilante / suspect) · decapitate: 用刀具或外力斩首切断躯干与头部的连结 (captive / victim / corpse) · guillotine: 专指使用断头台重型落刃机械行刑斩首 (king / aristocrat / traitor) · electrocute: 通以致命高压电流执行电椅处死 (death-row inmate / murderer)

groups.name: Execute & Capital Punishment · 处决与行刑 (Execute, Behead, Decapitate)
groups.tip: 执行死刑并将罪犯送上断头台

items.def_en: To kill someone by tying a rope around their neck and dropping them
items.ex_en: The prison warden ordered guards to hang the traitor at midnight.
items.ex_zh: 监狱长命令警卫在午夜对叛国者施以绞刑。

items.def_en: To kill someone legally as a punishment for a serious crime
items.ex_en: The military tribunal decided to execute the deserter under martial law.
items.ex_zh: 军事法庭决定依据戒严法处决这名逃兵。

items.def_en: To execute someone officially as a capital penalty
items.ex_en: The court decided to put to death the mastermind behind the attack.
items.ex_zh: 法院决定对这次袭击背后的主谋处以死刑。

items.def_en: To cut off someone's head as a method of execution
items.ex_en: The executioner was ordered to behead the convicted rebel in the courtyard.
items.ex_zh: 刽子手奉命在庭院内将定罪的叛乱分子斩首。

items.def_en: To cut off the head of a person or animal, especially officially or surgically
items.ex_en: The executioner prepared his sharp axe to decapitate the condemned nobleman.
items.ex_zh: 刽子手准备好锋利的斧头，准备将这名获罪的贵族斩首。

items.def_zh: 用断头台处决（斩首）；（用切纸机等）裁切；（议会中）限制辩论并强行表决
items.def_en: 1. To execute someone using a guillotine. 2. (British politics) To end debate on a parliamentary bill by a fixed time so a vote can be taken. 3. To cut paper or materials with a guillotine machine.
items.ex_en: The revolutionary council voted to guillotine the treasonous general before midday.
items.ex_zh: 革命委员会投票决定在正午前用断头台处决那名叛逆的将军。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the lawful or official killing of a condemned person as capital punishment, ranging from general execution to specific lethal methods.
groups.summary_zh: 指依据官方判决对受刑人执行死刑，包含各类具体的行刑方式。
groups.desc_en: Centers on the formal operational mechanisms and violent anatomical techniques of legally ending a condemned convict's life, emphasizing procedural administration over general killing.
groups.desc_zh: 聚焦于通过法定的刑罚手段或特定的人体破坏机制终结死囚生命的执刑场景，强调程序执行性而非一般杀戮。
groups.nuance_en: execute: general institutional performance of the death penalty under law (death-row inmate / spy) · put to death: solemn, ceremonial, or legal dispatch of an offender's life (convict / captive / prisoner) · behead: manual severance of the head, often historically associated with swords or axes (monarch / captive / saint) · decapitate: clinical, anatomical term for head detachment through judicial or traumatic means (victim / torso / head) · guillotine: programmatic, egalitarian state execution using the mechanical falling blade (nobles / political prisoners) · hang: execution by judicial drop or suspended strangulation (murderer / felon)
groups.nuance_zh: execute: 制度化落实极刑判决的统括性表达 (death-row inmate / spy) · put to death: 庄严、法令色彩浓郁的“处死”委婉表达 (convict / captive / prisoner) · behead: 人工手持刀斧执行斩首的传统意象 (monarch / captive / saint) · decapitate: 偏临床、法医学视角的身首分离斩首 (victim / torso / head) · guillotine: 专指法国大革命式的断头台机械斩首 (nobles / political prisoners) · hang: 经绞架坠落或窒息手段执行绞刑 (murderer / felon)

groups.name: Exemplify & Elucidate · 举例与阐释 (Exemplify, Illustrate, Demonstrate)
groups.tip: 用事实、证据或示范进行论证

items.def_en: (formal) To cite or mention something as an example.
items.ex_en: The historian chose to instance the treaty as evidence of diplomatic failure.
items.ex_zh: 这位历史学家引证该条约为外交失败的例证。

items.def_zh: 示范，演示；证明，证实；游行示威
items.def_en: 1. To show, explain, or prove something clearly by giving proof or practical examples. 2. To take part in a public protest.
items.ex_en: The laboratory experiments demonstrate conclusively that the compound inhibits viral replication.
items.ex_zh: 实验室实验确凿地证明了该化合物能够抑制病毒复制。

items.def_zh: （用例子、数据等）阐明，说明；给……加插图
items.def_en: 1. To explain or clarify something by using examples, diagrams, or pictures. 2. To provide pictures, drawings, or photographs for a book or article.
items.ex_en: The professor used recent economic data to illustrate the volatile market trends.
items.ex_zh: 教授运用近期的经济数据来说明动荡的市场趋势。

items.def_en: to make something clearer or easier to understand by giving more details or an explanation
items.ex_en: The spokesperson issued a formal statement to clarify the controversial policy change.
items.ex_zh: 发言人发表了一份正式声明，以阐明这项饱受争议的政策变动。

items.def_en: to be a typical example of something, or to show something by giving an example
items.ex_en: Her selfless dedication to public service continues to exemplify true civic leadership.
items.ex_zh: 她对公共服务的无私奉献始终是真正的公民领导力的典范。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make something very clear by explaining it in formal or technical detail
items.ex_en: The distinguished scholar agreed to elucidate the obscure philosophical doctrine for students.
items.ex_zh: 这位著名学者同意为学生深入阐明那门晦涩的哲学学说。

groups.summary_en: A speaker or writer provides concrete instances, analogies, or evidence to clarify, substantiate, or make an abstract concept readily understandable.
groups.summary_zh: 通过列举实例、演示或图解来清晰阐明抽象概念或论点。
groups.desc_en: Refers to making abstract assertions transparent, credible, and vivid by anchoring them to concrete cases, instances, or didactic demonstrations, contrasting with pure theoretical definition.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过援引具体个案、例证或直观展示，将抽象论点具象化、明晰化并确证其合理性，区别于单纯的理论下定义。
groups.nuance_en: exemplify: serving as the definitive, textbook embodiment of an abstract quality or model (principles / ideals / success) · illustrate: clarifying an obscure point using relatable stories, diagrams, or practical examples (concept / lecture / point) · demonstrate: logically proving or openly exhibiting a truth or operation beyond doubt (efficacy / competence / technique) · clarify: removing fog, ambiguity, or confusion to make an idea lucid (intent / position / statement) · elucidate: providing comprehensive intellectual illumination of deep or cryptic texts and problems (theory / text / mystery) · instance: citing a precise single event or datum as empirical corroboration (case / example / incident)
groups.nuance_zh: exemplify: 作为最典型、教科书式的化身体现抽象原则 (principles / ideals / success) · illustrate: 借助故事、图表或实例使晦涩观点通俗易懂 (concept / lecture / point) · demonstrate: 通过严密逻辑推演或现场操作确凿无疑地证明展示 (efficacy / competence / technique) · clarify: 澄清疑虑模糊之处使立场意思明了 (intent / position / statement) · elucidate: 对深刻、繁复或深奥的理论文本做彻底阐释 (theory / text / mystery) · instance: 举出确凿的单一个案或事件作为实证支撑 (case / example / incident)

groups.name: Exercise & Exert · 行使与施加 (Exercise, Exert, Wield, Apply)
groups.tip: 实际动用权力或施加威压

items.def_en: put a rule, principle, or forceful measure into practical operation
items.ex_en: The central bank decided to apply stringent regulatory measures across all branches.
items.ex_zh: 央行决定在所有分支机构中实施严格的监管措施。
items.ex2_en: These strict safety regulations apply equally to all employees throughout the facility.
items.ex2_zh: 这些严格的安全规定同样适用于该设施内的所有员工。

items.def_en: 1. to use or apply a right, power, or authority. 2. to do physical activities to stay healthy or train
items.ex_en: Citizens must exercise their constitutional voting rights during the upcoming parliamentary election.
items.ex_zh: 公民在即将举行的议会选举中必须行使宪法赋予的投票权。

items.def_en: cite or appeal to an authoritative clause, right, or legal power to authorize an action
items.ex_en: The government chose to invoke emergency powers to curb the widespread civil unrest.
items.ex_zh: 政府决定援引紧急权力以遏制普遍蔓延的民间动乱。

items.def_en: hold and effectively use power, authority, or influence over others
items.ex_en: The prime minister continued to wield considerable political influence over the legislature.
items.ex_zh: 首相继续对立法机构行使着相当大的政治影响力。

items.def_en: bring power, force, or influential leverage effectively to bear upon something
items.ex_en: The prime minister sought to exert considerable pressure on the rebellious backbenchers.
items.ex_zh: 首相试图对造反的后座议员施加相当大的压力。

items.def_en: direct influence, resources, or acute pressure decisively upon a target or situation
items.ex_en: The alliance resolved to bring diplomatic pressure to bear on the hostile regime.
items.ex_zh: 该联盟决意对该敌对政权施加外交压力。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on putting rights, authority, discretion, or physical and political power into active operation. The verbs emphasize either the legitimate execution of constitutional/legal powers or the forceful leverage of pressure and influence.
groups.summary_zh: 指合法行使权利、权限，或主动施加力量、权威与政治影响力。
groups.desc_en: Depicts bringing intangible authority, physical energy, or legal leverage to bear upon an object to enforce intent or achieve an effect, differing from passive possession of power.
groups.desc_zh: 描绘将无形的权威、体力或法律杠杆积极落实并施加于客体，以贯彻意志或促成某种结果，区别于权力的消极拥有。
groups.nuance_en: exercise: purposefully putting an active right, faculty, or restraint into practice (power / discretion / caution) · exert: heavily applying physical strength or systemic leverage to overcome resistance (influence / pressure / effort) · wield: visibly brandishing and commanding potent tools, weapons, or political dominance (power / influence / sword) · apply: practically focusing an abstract rule, force, or pressure to a target spot (pressure / brakes / rule) · invoke: calling upon a sacred name, statute, or legal right to authorize an action (clause / right / treaty) · bring to bear: marshaling diverse external forces and focusing them directly onto a problem (resources / pressure / weight)
groups.nuance_zh: exercise: 自觉行使权利、自由裁量权或节制机能 (power / discretion / caution) · exert: 施展体力或发挥巨大无形杠杆以压倒阻力 (influence / pressure / effort) · wield: 赫然执掌、挥舞并有效调度权力或武器 (power / influence / sword) · apply: 将抽象规则、外力或刹车压力务实精准地贴合施加 (pressure / brakes / rule) · invoke: 援引法条、特权或权威名义赋予行动合法性 (clause / right / treaty) · bring to bear: 汇聚多方外部力量并精准对准某焦点施压 (resources / pressure / weight)

groups.name: Exercise & Train · 体能训练与负重锻炼 (Work out, Pump, Bench-press)
groups.tip: 肢体主动发力锻炼体能

items.def_en: to engage in vigorous physical exercise routines to improve fitness
items.ex_en: She likes to work out at the community gym three mornings every week.
items.ex_zh: 她喜欢每周有三个早晨去社区健身房锻炼。

items.def_en: to lift a barbell or weights upwards while lying on a bench
items.ex_en: After months of rigorous training, he could finally bench-press over two hundred pounds.
items.ex_zh: 经过数月的刻苦训练，他终于能够卧推超过两百磅。

items.def_en: to lift heavy weights as an intensive bodybuilding activity
items.ex_en: He spends nearly every weekend pumping iron with his buddies at the gym.
items.ex_zh: 他几乎每个周末都在健身房和哥们儿一起举重撸铁。

items.def_en: to do gentle stretching or light exercises following an intensive workout
items.ex_en: Be sure to warm down with light stretches after that intense track session.
items.ex_zh: 在那场高强度的田径训练后，一定要做轻度拉伸来进行放松整理。

items.def_zh: 做引体向上；用下巴触碰
items.def_en: (also 'chin oneself') To pull oneself up on a horizontal bar until the chin is level with or above the bar.
items.ex_en: He challenged himself to chin ten consecutive times before leaving the fitness park.
items.ex_zh: 他挑战自己在离开健身公园前连续做十个引体向上。

items.def_en: to perform knee-bending strength exercises, often with a barbell across the shoulders
items.ex_en: Athletes should always maintain a neutral spine whenever they squat heavy barbell weights.
items.ex_zh: 运动员进行大重量杠铃深蹲时应始终保持脊柱中立。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame relate to performing specific physical exercises, calisthenics, or strength routines to build fitness and muscular endurance.
groups.summary_zh: 指进行具体的器械力量训练、自体重健身或专项体能锻炼。
groups.desc_en: Relates to targeted physical conditioning through progressive resistance and biomechanical movements to build muscle or enhance stamina, differing from recreational play.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过渐进式抗阻训练和特定生物力学动作锻炼肌肉或增强心肺体能，区别于随意娱乐性的体育嬉戏。
groups.nuance_en: work out: general dedicated physical conditioning session in or out of the gym (gym / daily / routines) · pump iron: colloquial heavy weightlifting aimed at muscle hypertrophy (gym / weights) · bench-press: specifically lifting a loaded barbell from the chest while supine on a bench (weight / bar / reps) · squat: performing knee-and-hip flexion under a loaded barbell to train legs and core (weight / bar / deep) · chin: performing bodyweight pull-ups by pulling the chin over an overhead bar (bar / repetitions) · warm down: engaging in gentle, decelerating stretches post-workout to clear lactic acid (muscles / body / heart rate)
groups.nuance_zh: work out: 广义的健身房或日常体能锻炼单元 (gym / daily / routines) · pump iron: 通俗指旨在增肌的高强度撸铁举重 (gym / weights) · bench-press: 特指仰卧在卧推凳上推举杠铃的胸肌训练动作 (weight / bar / reps) · squat: 负重或徒手下蹲以强化下肢力量与核心的深蹲动作 (weight / bar / deep) · chin: 抓住单杠将下巴拉过杠顶的引体向上 (bar / repetitions) · warm down: 剧烈运动后拉伸慢行以平复心率的整理放松 (muscles / body / heart rate)

groups.name: Exhort & Admonish · 告诫与极力劝勉 (Urge, Admonish, Exhort)
groups.tip: 由诚意规劝上升为严肃告诫

items.def_en: [I/T] (+ of/against/to) to advise someone of danger or undesirable consequences before acting
items.ex_en: The coast guard warned tourists against swimming near the dangerous rocky cliffs.
items.ex_zh: 海岸警卫队警告游客不要在危险的悬崖岩石附近游泳。

items.def_en: (+ to/on) to encourage someone strongly and earnestly to take a particular action
items.ex_en: Environmental activists urge the government to invest more heavily in renewable solar energy.
items.ex_zh: 环保人士敦促政府加大对可再生太阳能的投资。

items.def_en: To advise or urge someone seriously to do or not do something, or to scold someone firmly but gently.
items.ex_en: The magistrate chose to admonish the young offender rather than impose severe fines.
items.ex_zh: 法官选择训诫这名年轻违法者，而没有施加重罚。

items.def_en: (+ for) to express disapproval or administer a mild, principled rebuke to someone
items.ex_en: The headmaster gently reproved the students for their thoughtless pranks during the ceremony.
items.ex_zh: 校长温和地训责了学生们在典礼上轻率的恶作剧行为。

items.def_en: To strongly encourage, advise, or urge someone to do something.
items.ex_en: The pastor took to the pulpit to exhort the congregation to love one another.
items.ex_zh: 牧师登上讲坛，谆谆规劝会众要彼此相爱。

items.def_en: (+ to/from) to direct, command, or urge someone with authoritative moral or legal weight
items.ex_en: The court issued a strict decree that enjoined both parties from contacting each other.
items.ex_zh: 法院下达了严格法令，责令双方不得互相接触。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate speech acts where an agent strongly prompts the addressee to adopt a moral course of action or reproves misbehavior. They scale in urgency and moral authority from gentle cautioning (admonish) to impassioned, urgent appeals (exhort, beseech).
groups.summary_zh: 基于权威或道德紧迫感提出劝诫、告诫与极力敦促。
groups.desc_en: Involves applying moral, spiritual, or authoritative suasion to steer another person toward virtuous conduct or away from peril, differing from detached advice or hostile rebuking.
groups.desc_zh: 指依托道德、精神感染力或威严，促使他人遵从义举或规避陷阱险境，区别于淡漠的建议或怀有敌意的斥责。
groups.nuance_en: warn: notifying someone in advance of an impending hazard, penalty, or disaster (public / danger / consequences) · urge: earnestly pressing someone with acute psychological urgency to take action (reform / caution / crowd) · admonish: gently yet firmly correcting a lapse or warning against misconduct (pupil / offender / gently) · reprove: expressing calm, authoritative disapproval directly to someone's face (fault / behavior / child) · exhort: passionately, oratorically urging people toward noble action and heroic resolve (followers / crowds / troops) · enjoin: legally or authoritative decreeing that someone must perform or cease an act (silence / duty / party)
groups.nuance_zh: warn: 就即将到来的危害、惩戒或险情提前发出预警 (public / danger / consequences) · urge: 带有心理紧迫感地急切敦促对方付诸行动 (reform / caution / crowd) · admonish: 温和而严正地提醒失误或告诫不可再犯 (pupil / offender / gently) · reprove: 当面以威严冷静的态度对不良言行表示微责 (fault / behavior / child) · exhort: 以富有感染力的演说规劝、勉励听众奋发勇为 (followers / crowds / troops) · enjoin: 凭借权威法令或训令严肃责成/禁止履行某项行为 (silence / duty / party)

groups.name: Exonerate & Plead Excuse · 开脱与提供不在场证明 (Exonerate, Excuse, Absolve, Plead)
groups.tip: 提出不在场证据或理由，为自身开脱罪责

items.def_en: to offer an apology, explanation, or mitigating ground to release someone from an obligation or fault
items.ex_en: Nothing you say now can excuse such blatant neglect of your professional duties.
items.ex_zh: 你现在说什么也无法为你公然怠忽职守开脱。

items.def_en: to allow someone who has done wrong to go without severe reprimand or punishment
items.ex_en: The traffic officer let him off with a simple warning instead of a ticket.
items.ex_zh: 交警放过了他，只给了口头警告而没有开罚单。

items.def_en: to declare oneself innocent or guilty in a court of law, or put forward an excuse in one's defense
items.ex_en: The defendant decided to plead guilty to the lesser charges during the hearing.
items.ex_zh: 被告在听证会上决定就较轻的罪名认罪申辩。

items.def_en: to declare someone formally free from guilt, moral obligation, or punishment
items.ex_en: The internal report formally absolved the chief financial officer of any deliberate wrongdoing.
items.ex_zh: 内部报告正式免除了首席财务官的任何蓄意过错责任。

items.def_zh: 为……提供不在场证明，为……辩解开脱
items.def_en: To provide an excuse or an alibi for someone to clear them of blame.
items.ex_en: His loyal friend attempted to alibi him by lying about where they had been.
items.ex_zh: 他忠实的朋友谎称他们当时的去向，试图为他辩解开脱。

items.def_en: to officially absolve someone from blame, guilt, or criminal responsibility for a wrongdoing
items.ex_en: Conclusive forensic evidence served to completely exonerate the suspect from the alleged crime.
items.ex_zh: 决定性的法医物证彻底洗清了该嫌疑人涉嫌的罪名。

groups.summary_en: Covers legal or forensic speech acts where an accused party produces proof, excuses, or defenses to shift blame, refute culpability, and clear their name of wrongdoing.
groups.summary_zh: 指在受指控时提供不在场证明或托词，以此免除刑责与罪咎。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the legal, moral, or rhetorical lifting of blame and liability from an accused party, whether through formal exoneration or establishing factual absence, contrasting with admitting guilt.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过司法审判、道德辩解或出示不在场证明，免除受指控方的罪责或法律责任，区别于认罪伏法。
groups.nuance_en: exonerate: completely clearing someone of blame or criminal guilt after thorough scrutiny (defendant / suspect / report) · absolve: granting formal spiritual or legal remission of sin, guilt, or liability (sins / guilt / debtor) · alibi: establishing factual, verifiable proof that an accused was elsewhere during a crime (suspect / whereabouts / defendant) · excuse: explaining away or forgiving a minor fault, breach of decorum, or absence (absence / behavior / ignorance) · let off: showing leniency by declining to inflict a deserved legal or moral penalty (warning / hook / offender) · plead: making an emotional or formal courtroom petition to justify oneself (innocence / guilty / case)
groups.nuance_zh: exonerate: 经严密调查彻底洗脱犯罪嫌疑、恢复名誉昭雪 (defendant / suspect / report) · absolve: 给予宗教上罪愆的赦免或法律债务/过错的正式免除 (sins / guilt / debtor) · alibi: 提供确凿的行踪证据证明案发时不在场 (suspect / whereabouts / defendant) · excuse: 辩解或体谅轻微的礼貌失序、过失或旷课缺席 (absence / behavior / ignorance) · let off: 网开一面予以从轻免罚或免于起诉 (warning / hook / offender) · plead: 在法庭或对立面面前正式抗辩陈词以自白 (innocence / guilty / case)

groups.name: Expand & Dilate · 扩张与局部膨胀 (Expand, Dilate, Distend)
groups.tip: 向外延伸，体量或范围不断扩大

items.def_en: [I/T] to become or make larger in size, area, volume, or scope
items.ex_en: The retail chain plans to expand its presence across several emerging Asian markets.
items.ex_zh: 这家零售连锁店计划将业务版图扩大到几个新兴亚洲市场。
items.ex2_en: The universe continues to expand at an astonishing rate through deep space.
items.ex2_zh: 宇宙继续在外太空以惊人的速度不断膨胀。

items.def_en: [I/T] to expand or puff out beyond normal dimensions, typically due to pressure or inflammation
items.ex_en: Her sprained ankle began to swell visibly within an hour of the fall.
items.ex_zh: 摔倒后不到一小时，她扭伤的脚踝就开始明显肿胀起来。
items.ex2_en: The gentle rain swelled the narrow mountain brook into a rushing river.
items.ex2_zh: 连绵小雨使狭窄的山间溪流涨成了一条奔腾的河流。

items.def_en: [I/T] to fill something with air or gas so that it swells up
items.ex_en: Please help me inflate these colorful rubber balloons before the birthday party begins.
items.ex_zh: 生日派对开始前，请帮我把这些彩色橡胶气球吹胀鼓起。
items.ex2_en: The safety life raft inflated automatically upon touching the cold ocean surface.
items.ex2_zh: 救生筏一接触到冰冷的海面就自动充气膨胀了。

items.def_zh: （使）扩大，（使）膨胀，（使）张大；详述，详加论述 (dilate on/upon)
items.def_en: 1. To become wider, larger, or more open, or make something do so; 2. (dilate on/upon) to speak or write at length about something.
items.ex_en: The doctor administered special eye drops to dilate the patient's pupils for examination.
items.ex_zh: 医生给患者滴了专用眼药水以散大瞳孔进行检查。
items.ex2_en: His pupils dilated dramatically in the pitch darkness of the underground cave.
items.ex2_zh: 在地下洞穴的一片漆黑中，他的瞳孔急剧放大。

items.def_en: To expand operations or influence on a worldwide scale, or cause something to do so.
items.ex_en: Technological advancements rapidly helped the regional enterprise globalize its diverse product supply chains.
items.ex_zh: 技术进步迅速帮助这家区域企业将其多元化的产品供应链推向全球化。
items.ex2_en: Modern financial markets globalized rapidly during the late twentieth century through technology.
items.ex2_zh: 在20世纪末，现代金融市场借助技术迅速走向全球化。

items.def_zh: （使）膨胀，（使）肿胀，（因内压而）鼓起
items.def_en: To swell or expand outward due to internal pressure, or cause something to do so.
items.ex_en: Trapped gas caused the patient's abdomen to distend painfully throughout the night.
items.ex_zh: 滞留的气体导致该患者的腹部整夜痛苦地异常鼓胀。
items.ex2_en: His painful stomach distended visibly due to severe chronic digestive gas problems.
items.ex2_zh: 由于严重的慢性消化胀气问题，他疼痛的腹部明显膨胀。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify the outward growth, swelling, or stretching of a body part, volume, or systemic scale, contrasting internal physiological distension with systemic expansion.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体、器官或体系由内而外地膨胀、张开或扩展。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an outward, internal-pressure-driven volumetric expansion or circumferential widening, distinct from directional lengthening or abstract scope enlargement.
groups.desc_zh: 指受内部压力或生理机制驱动的向外体积膨胀或周向扩张，区别于单向的长度延伸或抽象的范围扩大。
groups.nuance_en: expand: generic volumetric or dimensional growth (business / universe / chest) · swell: organic puffing or accumulation from pressure/fluid (ankle / river / pride) · inflate: outward distension by pumping gas or artificial puffery (balloon / tire / prices) · dilate: circumferential widening of an aperture or vessel (pupils / blood vessels / nostrils) · distend: abnormal or uncomfortable bulging from internal pressure (abdomen / stomach / veins)
groups.nuance_zh: expand: 普遍的体积或维度向外扩大 (business / universe / chest) · swell: 因液体、充血或情绪积聚而鼓胀 (ankle / river / pride) · inflate: 充气膨胀或人为虚抬 (balloon / tire / prices) · dilate: 孔径或管腔的周向扩开 (pupils / blood vessels / nostrils) · distend: 因内部压力导致的病理或不适性鼓胀 (abdomen / stomach / veins)

groups.name: Expand & Extend · 膨胀与延伸 (Expand, Extend, Stretch)
groups.tip: 体积或范围向外扩张

items.def_en: [I/T] to draw out or extend in length or surface area by tension
items.ex_en: Athletes should always stretch their hamstrings thoroughly before starting any intense sprint.
items.ex_zh: 运动员在开始激烈冲刺前，应始终充分拉伸大腿后肌群。
items.ex2_en: The thick elastic fabric stretches easily without losing its original firm shape.
items.ex2_zh: 这种厚实的弹性面料很容易拉伸，且不会失去原有的紧实形状。

items.def_en: [I/T] to increase in breadth or lateral extent
items.ex_en: Traveling abroad can help students broaden their cultural understanding and historical perspectives.
items.ex_zh: 出国旅行可以帮助学生拓宽文化理解和历史视野。
items.ex2_en: Her expressive smile broadened into joyous laughter upon seeing her long-lost friend.
items.ex2_zh: 见到久违的朋友后，她那生动的笑容展成欢畅的大笑。

items.def_zh: 延伸，伸展；延长，扩大；给予，提供
items.def_en: 1. To stretch out or reach in distance, space, or time; to make larger, longer, or broader. 2. To offer or give something formally (such as greetings, an invitation, or help).
items.ex_en: The university agreed to extend the submission deadline for all final graduation theses.
items.ex_zh: 大学同意延长所有最终毕业论文的提交截止日期。
items.ex2_en: The magnificent mountain range extends majestically across several northern continental international borders.
items.ex2_zh: 壮丽的山脉雄伟地绵延跨越了北部大陆的数个国际边界。

items.def_en: 1. To become or make larger in size, volume, scope, or extent. 2. (+ on/upon) To give more details about something.
items.ex_en: The speaker paused briefly to expand on the third point of his proposal.
items.ex_zh: 发言人稍作停顿，对提案中的第三点进行了详细阐述。
items.ex2_en: The ambitious company plans to expand its regional manufacturing capacity next spring.
items.ex2_zh: 这家雄心勃勃的公司计划在明年春天扩大其区域制造产能。

items.def_en: [I/T] to lengthen out or become physically longer relative to original proportions
items.ex_en: Intense mechanical traction served to slowly elongate the fractured limb back into alignment.
items.ex_zh: 强烈的机械牵引使骨折的肢体慢慢拉长并重新复位。
items.ex2_en: Cast shadows elongate dramatically across the dusty desert sand at late sunset.
items.ex2_zh: 在暮色斜阳下，投下的阴影在满布尘土的沙漠沙地上急剧拉长。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make or become wider, larger, or more open, especially an aperture or pupil
items.ex_en: Certain neurological conditions cause pupils to dilate abnormally when exposed to bright lights.
items.ex_zh: 某些神经系统疾病会导致瞳孔在强光照射下出现异常扩大。
items.ex2_en: Specialized drops dilate the patient's pupils before the detailed eye examination begins.
items.ex2_zh: 在详细的眼科检查开始前，专用滴眼液会放大患者的瞳孔。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this manner frame describe spatial enlargement or elongation. They differentiate between volumetric dilation in all directions (expanding) versus linear unrolling, stretching, or lengthening along an axis (extending).
groups.summary_zh: 物体或范围在空间维度上的径向膨胀扩大或单向拉长延伸。
groups.desc_en: Involves drawing outward across space, time, or limits to reach a greater span, contrasting with uniform 3D volumetric ballooning.
groups.desc_zh: 指在空间、时间或边界上向外拉长或伸展以达到更大跨度，区别于均匀的三维立体膨胀。
groups.nuance_en: extend: prolonging or thrusting outward across space or time (deadline / reach / invitation) · stretch: drawing out elastic limits or straining coverage (muscle / budget / truth) · broaden: widening horizontal scope or inclusivity (horizons / appeal / knowledge) · elongate: increasing physical or visual length (shadow / neck / vowel) · expand: spreading outward across overall scale or volume (empire / operation / chest)
groups.nuance_zh: extend: 沿时间或空间界限向外延伸推展 (deadline / reach / invitation) · stretch: 拉伸弹性限度或极力延展覆盖面 (muscle / budget / truth) · broaden: 拓宽横向跨度或包容度 (horizons / appeal / knowledge) · elongate: 单纯拉长物理长度或视效 (shadow / neck / vowel) · expand: 在整体规模或体积上向外扩展 (empire / operation / chest)

groups.name: Expect & Anticipate · 期待与预料 (Anticipate, Await, Foresee)
groups.tip: 预想未来可能发生的情况

items.def_zh: 预料，预期；期待，指望；要求
items.def_en: 1. To think or believe that something will happen. 2. To wait for or anticipate someone or something. 3. To demand that someone do something.
items.ex_en: Analysts expect consumer prices to rise steadily over the next few financial quarters.
items.ex_zh: 分析人士预计消费价格在未来几个财政季度内将稳步上涨。

items.def_en: To foresee an event and take proactive action or mentally prepare for its occurrence
items.ex_en: Experienced commanders anticipate enemy movements well before any tactical engagement officially begins.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的指挥官早在任何战术交锋正式打响前就预判了敌军动向。

items.def_en: To feel pleasure and positive excitement about an event that is going to happen
items.ex_en: We are all looking forward to our annual summer vacation.
items.ex_zh: 我们大家都十分期盼一年一度的暑假。

items.def_en: To wait for something with expectation, readiness, or longing
items.ex_en: Thousands of anxious citizens gathered in the plaza to await the final election results.
items.ex_zh: 成千上万焦虑的市民聚集在广场上，等待最终的选举结果。

items.def_en: To form a mental picture of something as a desirable or probable future eventuality
items.ex_en: Urban planners envisage a carbon-neutral metropolis featuring autonomous public electric transport systems.
items.ex_zh: 城市规划者展望了一座配备自动化公共电动交通系统的碳中和都市。

items.def_en: To know or realize that something will happen before it occurs
items.ex_en: Few industry experts could foresee the devastating economic collapse triggered by the pandemic.
items.ex_zh: 几乎没有行业专家能够预见疫情所引发的毁灭性经济崩溃。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses mental projection regarding future events, ranging from neutral logical expectation to eager, proactive emotional readiness. Verbs differentiate between passive certainty and active preparation.
groups.summary_zh: 指对未来事件的心理预期、预先准备或殷切盼望。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on mentally projecting toward future occurrences with varying degrees of certainty, preparation, or emotion, contrasting with passive retrospective realization.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重于以不同程度的确定性、准备或情绪对未来事件进行心理投射，区别于被动的回顾与事后认知。
groups.nuance_en: expect: standard cognitive presumption that something will occur (delivery / baby / change) · anticipate: taking proactive mental or physical measures in advance (needs / objection / demand) · await: patient, often formal expectation of a pending outcome (trial / verdict / arrival) · foresee: predicting or discerning future events before they happen (consequences / crisis / future) · envisage: mentally imagining a desirable or possible future scenario (possibilities / future / reform)
groups.nuance_zh: expect: 常规认知上预料某事必然发生 (delivery / baby / change) · anticipate: 预料并提前在行动或心理上做好准备 (needs / objection / demand) · await: 较为正式地静候未决的结果 (trial / verdict / arrival) · foresee: 预见并洞察将要发生的后果 (consequences / crisis / future) · envisage: 在脑海中设想某种未来图景或可能性 (possibilities / future / reform)

groups.name: Expel & Deport · 驱逐与流放 (Exile, Banish, Deport)
groups.tip: 放逐异乡剥夺本国居住权

items.def_en: 1. To force someone to leave their country or home, often for political reasons.
items.ex_en: The military dictatorship chose to exile the prominent dissident author to a remote island.
items.ex_zh: 该军政府决定将这位著名的异见作家流放到一座偏远岛屿上。

items.def_en: to officially force someone to leave a country, school, or organization
items.ex_en: The disciplinary committee voted unanimously to expel the dishonest student from the academy.
items.ex_zh: 纪律委员会一致投票决定将这名舞弊学生从学院开除。

items.def_zh: 剥夺法律保护权并放逐
items.def_en: to deprive someone of the protection of the law, historically placing them outside society
items.ex_en: In medieval times, monarchs would frequently outlaw rebellious barons to seize their lands.
items.ex_zh: 在中世纪，君主常常会剥夺造反贵族的法律保护权并将其放逐以没收其领地。

items.def_en: to legally expel a foreign national from a country back to their country of origin
items.ex_en: Immigration authorities took immediate steps to deport the undocumented felon back to his homeland.
items.ex_zh: 移民当局立即采取措施，依法将这名无证重罪犯驱逐回原籍国。

items.def_en: to send someone away from a country or place as an official punishment, forbidding return
items.ex_en: The angry king resolved to banish the corrupt advisor from the realm forever.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的国王决意将这位腐败的顾问永远放逐出国境。

items.def_zh: 逐出本国，放逐；移居国外
items.def_en: 1. To force someone to leave their native country. 2. To live in or move to a foreign country.
items.ex_en: During the violent revolution, the ruling junta moved swiftly to expatriate all political rivals.
items.ex_zh: 在暴烈的革命期间，统治军政府迅速采取行动将所有政敌逐出本国。

groups.summary_en: An authority or state formally and forcibly removes an individual from their home country or community, legally barring them from return. While 'exile' and 'banish' historically emphasize punitive separation from homeland, 'deport' and 'expel' denote modern legal or sovereign ejection.
groups.summary_zh: 统治当局将某人强制逐出国土或社区并禁止其返回的惩处或主权行为。
groups.desc_en: Signifies the authoritative or coercive casting out of individuals from a country, group, or jurisdiction, contrasting with voluntary departure or informal ejection.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过权威或强制手段将个人逐出国境、社群或管辖范围，区别于自愿离去或非正式驱赶。
groups.nuance_en: expel: forceful ejection from an institution or space (student / diplomat / invader) · deport: legally removing an alien to their home country (illegal immigrant / criminal / foreigner) · banish: authoritative castigation requiring permanent removal from a realm (traitor / rival / thoughts) · exile: sending someone away from their homeland, often politically motivated (dissident / king / writer) · outlaw: stripping of legal status and protections (rebel / fugitive / clan)
groups.nuance_zh: expel: 强制开除或逐出特定机构与空间 (student / diplomat / invader) · deport: 依据法令将外籍人员驱逐出境 (illegal immigrant / criminal / foreigner) · banish: 权威性地永远逐出某领域或国境 (traitor / rival / thoughts) · exile: 因政治原因流放或流亡异乡 (dissident / king / writer) · outlaw: 剥夺法律身份及保护予以放逐 (rebel / fugitive / clan)

groups.name: Explore & Investigate · 探索与探究 (Investigate, Probe, Delve into)
groups.tip: 深入未知领域探索实情

items.def_en: To carry out a systematic or formal inquiry to discover and examine the facts of an issue
items.ex_en: Detectives were dispatched to investigate the strange circumstances surrounding the executive's sudden disappearance.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们被派去调查这位高管突然失踪背后的离奇情况。

items.def_en: To travel through an unfamiliar area to learn about it, or to examine something systematically and thoroughly.
items.ex_en: Scientists designed advanced deep-sea submersibles to explore the darkest trenches of the Pacific.
items.ex_zh: 科学家设计了先进的深海潜水器来勘探太平洋最幽暗的海沟。

items.def_en: To explore an area in advance in order to gather information about terrain, opponents, or resources
items.ex_en: The forward infantry patrol was ordered to scout the dense forest for hidden ambushes.
items.ex_zh: 前沿步兵巡逻队奉命搜寻侦察茂密森林中隐蔽的伏兵。

items.def_en: To investigate something thoroughly and meticulously by digging deeply into research or records
items.ex_en: Historians continue to delve into ancient archives to uncover the true causes of the war.
items.ex_zh: 历史学家继续钻研古代档案，以揭示这场战争的真正起因。

items.def_en: To examine or inquire into something deeply, closely, and often intrusively
items.ex_en: Journalists persistently probe the murky financial transactions between corporate lobbyists and influential lawmakers.
items.ex_zh: 记者们不断深入探查企业说客与有影响力的议员之间暧昧的财务交易。

items.def_en: To make a preliminary survey of an unfamiliar area to gain strategic or practical information
items.ex_en: The advance military squadron was dispatched to reconnoiter the rugged mountain pass at dawn.
items.ex_zh: 先头军事分队在破晓时分被派去先行勘察崎岖的山口要道。

groups.summary_en: Refers to traveling through unknown territories or systematically scrutinizing an intellectual topic, problem, or mystery. 'Explore' balances geographical and conceptual journeying, while 'probe' and 'delve into' emphasize deep, intrusive inquiry.
groups.summary_zh: 指对未知区域进行实地勘查或对问题深入探寻求知。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an active, systematic search through an unknown or obscured domain to uncover facts, contrasting with casual looking or passive reception of information.
groups.desc_zh: 指对未知或被掩盖领域进行主动、系统的探查以发现事实，区别于走马观花的打量或被动接收信息。
groups.nuance_en: investigate: formal, systematic inquiry to uncover evidence or truth (crime / accident / fraud) · explore: venturing into an unfamiliar physical or intellectual territory (cave / options / idea) · probe: piercing beneath the surface to test vulnerabilities or hidden truths (depths / motives / scandal) · delve into: conducting exhaustive, research-heavy excavation (archives / history / past) · reconnoiter: military or tactical advance scouting (terrain / enemy positions / area)
groups.nuance_zh: investigate: 为查明案情或真相进行的正式系统调查 (crime / accident / fraud) · explore: 踏入未知的物理或概念领域进行探索 (cave / options / idea) · probe: 刺破表层深入探测隐秘或弱点 (depths / motives / scandal) · delve into: 彻底钻研、深挖文献或内情 (archives / history / past) · reconnoiter: 战术或军事性质的事先侦察 (terrain / enemy positions / area)

groups.name: Express & Articulate Views · 表达与阐明观点 (Express, Voice, Opine)
groups.tip: 将内心情感或想法用言语说出

items.def_zh: 公开发表；宣泄（看法、不满）
items.def_en: to make opinions, complaints, or views known publicly to open discussion
items.ex_en: The town hall provided a platform for frustrated residents to air their legitimate grievances.
items.ex_zh: 市政厅大会为沮丧的居民提供了一个公开发表合法诉求的平台。
items.ex2_en: The popular documentary series airs nationwide every Sunday evening at eight o'clock.
items.ex2_zh: 这部受欢迎的纪录片系列于每周日晚八点在全国播出。

items.def_en: (+ that) (formal or humorous) To state or express one's opinion about something.
items.ex_en: The senior economic analyst opined that inflation would likely peak before next winter.
items.ex_zh: 资深经济分析师发表意见认为，通胀很可能在明年入冬前见顶。

items.def_zh: 表达，吐露（意见、感受等）；发浊音
items.def_en: 1. To express feelings, opinions, or doubts aloud. 2. (linguistics) To pronounce a sound with vibration of the vocal cords.
items.ex_en: Several board members chose to voice strong objections to the proposed corporate merger.
items.ex_zh: 几位董事会成员选择公开发表意见，对拟议的企业合并表示强烈反对。

items.def_en: To show or communicate a feeling, opinion, or fact through words, looks, or actions.
items.ex_en: She struggled to express her deep gratitude to the doctors who saved her father.
items.ex_zh: 她竭力向救了她父亲的医生们表达由衷的谢意。

items.def_en: to express an idea, thought, or feeling with great clarity and coherence
items.ex_en: The defense attorney managed to articulate the complicated constitutional issues with remarkable clarity.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师以非凡的清晰度准确阐明了复杂的宪法问题。

items.def_zh: 宣泄；吐露（怒气或强烈情绪）
items.def_en: to give forceful, unreserved public expression to a powerful emotion or grievance
items.ex_en: He stormed outside to vent his pent-up frustration after that disastrous client meeting.
items.ex_zh: 在那场灾难性的客户会议后，他冲到外面宣泄内心压抑的挫败感。

groups.summary_en: Verbs of communicative delivery specifying how an agent puts thoughts, feelings, or formal stances into words, ranging from raw emotional venting to philosophical speculation.
groups.summary_zh: 指将内在看法、情感或观点通过言语清楚表述出来的方式。
groups.desc_en: Specifies putting thoughts, feelings, or opinions into communicative form (often public), contrasting with private contemplation or mere factual reporting.
groups.desc_zh: 强调将思想、情绪或观点转化为交际表达（常具公开性），区别于内心的沉思或单纯的事实通报。
groups.nuance_en: express: generic outward conveyance of feeling or idea (concern / gratitude / view) · articulate: putting complex thoughts into clear, structured speech (vision / policy / argument) · voice: publicly giving utterance to a sentiment or concern (doubts / objection / grievances) · opine: stating an explicit personal belief or commentary (on politics / matter) · vent: releasing pent-up, volatile emotions forcefully (anger / frustration / spleen)
groups.nuance_zh: express: 普遍向外传达情绪、态度或观点 (concern / gratitude / view) · articulate: 清晰且有条理地阐明复杂思想 (vision / policy / argument) · voice: 公开发声以表达顾虑或异议 (doubts / objection / grievances) · opine: 表达个人见解或予以评述 (on politics / matter) · vent: 宣泄压抑已久的愤懑情绪 (anger / frustration / spleen)

groups.name: Express Approval & Commendation · 赞扬与嘉奖 (Praise, Commend, Extol)
groups.tip: 正式表扬嘉奖其功劳与表现

items.def_en: 1. to express admiration or approval of someone or something. 2. to worship or express honor and gratitude to God.
items.ex_en: Critics were quick to praise the young pianist for her flawless debut performance.
items.ex_zh: 评论家们迅速赞扬了这位年轻钢琴家无可挑剔的首演表现。

items.def_en: to praise enthusiastically and publicly as an outstanding success
items.ex_en: Art critics worldwide acclaim the director's latest film as a genuine cinematic masterpiece.
items.ex_zh: 全世界的艺术评论家一致公开赞誉该导演的新作为真正的电影杰作。

items.def_en: [I/T] to express strong approval of an idea, policy, or action
items.ex_en: Civic leaders widely applaud the council's bold initiative to construct affordable green housing.
items.ex_zh: 市民领袖广泛赞许市政委员会建造经济型绿色住房的大胆倡议。

items.def_zh: 赞扬，表彰；推荐；把……托付给
items.def_en: 1. (formal) to praise someone or something formally or publicly. 2. to recommend someone or something to others. 3. (formal) to entrust someone or something to someone's care.
items.ex_en: The city mayor wished to commend the courageous firefighter for his heroic rescue effort.
items.ex_zh: 市长希望公开表彰这位勇敢的消防员英勇的营救行动。

items.def_en: (formal) to praise a person or their achievements highly, often publicly
items.ex_en: Scholars laud the newly discovered manuscript as a breakthrough in medieval literary history.
items.ex_zh: 学者们盛赞这份新发现的手稿是中世纪文学史上的重大突破。

items.def_en: (+ the virtues of) to praise enthusiastically and lavishly
items.ex_en: The advertisement continues to extol the magical health virtues of their herbal extract.
items.ex_zh: 该广告继续极力吹捧他们草本提取物神奇的健康功效。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate verbal expressions of warm approval, admiration, or official tribute directed at someone's merits or achievements. Registers span from everyday positive evaluation to formal or elevated laudation.
groups.summary_zh: 对某人的品格、功绩或表现表达由衷赞赏、表扬或官方嘉奖。
groups.desc_en: Denotes expressing explicit, high-level social or moral validation of a person or achievement, contrasting with neutral acknowledgment or mild concession.
groups.desc_zh: 指对人或其成就给予明确、高度的社会或道德认可，区别于中立的确认或勉强的首肯。
groups.nuance_en: praise: generic, warm commendation of merit (courage / effort / student) · applaud: signaling strong, often public enthusiastic approval (decision / move / courage) · commend: formal, official acknowledgment of worthy service (soldier / initiative / diligence) · laud: publicly glorifying or singing the praises of (achievement / hero / virtue) · extol: highly elevated, enthusiastic praise of qualities (virtues / benefits / merits)
groups.nuance_zh: praise: 最通用的对优良品格或努力的热情赞许 (courage / effort / student) · applaud: 公开、热烈地鼓掌赞许某项举措 (decision / move / courage) · commend: 官方或正式表彰值得嘉奖的操行 (soldier / initiative / diligence) · laud: 高调盛赞某项重大成就或英雄品质 (achievement / hero / virtue) · extol: 极尽推崇并盛赞其优点或价值 (virtues / benefits / merits)

groups.name: Expropriate & Commandeer · 征用与占为己有 (Expropriate, Commandeer, Confiscate)
groups.tip: 私占或依公权强制征收

items.def_en: To eagerly or opportunistically take control of something, such as an advantage or pretext
items.ex_en: Political rivals immediately seized on the incumbent's careless remark to mount fierce counterattacks.
items.ex_zh: 政治对手立即抓住现任官员的不慎言论，发起了猛烈的反击。

items.def_zh: 私占，侵吞；征用；拨出（专款）
items.def_en: 1. To take something for one's own use, typically without permission. 2. To allocate or set aside money or assets for a special purpose.
items.ex_en: The former treasurer was convicted after he attempted to appropriate company funds for personal luxury.
items.ex_zh: 前财务主管因企图侵吞公司资金用于个人奢侈消费而被定罪。

items.def_en: To seize property or contraband using official authority, usually as a penalty
items.ex_en: Customs officials acted swiftly to confiscate the illegal shipment of contraband ivory tusks.
items.ex_zh: 海关官员迅速采取行动，依法没收了这批走私的非法象牙制品。

items.def_en: To take possession of private property or vehicles by force for military or emergency purposes
items.ex_en: Soldiers had to commandeer private civilian trucks to transport emergency medical supplies to frontline bases.
items.ex_zh: 士兵们不得不征用民间卡车将应急医疗物资运送到前线基地。

items.def_en: To legally take away private property or real estate for public use, often by state power
items.ex_en: The municipal government decided to expropriate private farmland to build the new highway.
items.ex_zh: 市政府决定征收私人农田以修建新公路。

items.def_zh: 冒领；擅自霸占（权力/特权）
items.def_en: (+ to oneself) To claim or seize power, rights, or privileges without proper justification
items.ex_en: The ambitious general attempted to arrogate to himself supreme authority over the state.
items.ex_zh: 野心勃勃的将军企图擅自霸占国家的最高权力。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the unilateral, authoritative, or illicit seizure of property, funds, or assets for official or private use. Collocates often include funds, private land, vehicles, or emergency powers.
groups.summary_zh: 指官方强制征收或私人擅自侵占财产、资金及物资。
groups.desc_en: Involves taking possession of property or power authoritatively, arbitrarily, or by force without owner consent, contrasting with voluntary transfer or routine trade.
groups.desc_zh: 指凭借公权、强权或霸道单方面占有财产或权力，区别于自愿让渡或常规买卖交易。
groups.nuance_en: confiscate: seizing private property by legal or disciplinary authority (contraband / weapon / phone) · expropriate: state taking of private land/assets for public or political ends (land / property / assets) · commandeer: taking arbitrary control of civilian property for urgent official use (vehicle / ship / building) · appropriate: taking exclusive possession, often unlawfully or without permission (funds / culture / ideas) · arrogate: presumptuously claiming a power or privilege without right (power / authority / right)
groups.nuance_zh: confiscate: 依法或依校规惩罚性罚没、查扣 (contraband / weapon / phone) · expropriate: 国家或政权为公用/政治目的征收私产 (land / property / assets) · commandeer: 紧急状态下强行征用民用设备 (vehicle / ship / building) · appropriate: 挪用公款或擅自将他人所有据为己有 (funds / culture / ideas) · arrogate: 僭越、擅自揽取不应享有的权力 (power / authority / right)

groups.name: Extort & Blackmail · 勒索与敲诈 (Extort, Blackmail, Bleed)
groups.tip: 用威胁手段强行索取财物

items.def_zh: 压榨；逼迫（交出钱财或信息）
items.def_en: To exert severe economic or psychological pressure on someone to extract funds or concessions
items.ex_en: Corrupt officials continued to squeeze local businesses for extra fees and political favors.
items.ex_zh: 腐败官员继续向当地企业施压，榨取额外费用和政治利益。

items.def_en: To extort money from someone through deceit, intimidation, or aggressive pressure
items.ex_en: Local thugs tried to shakedown small shopkeepers for weekly protection money along the street.
items.ex_zh: 街头混混试图向沿街小店主敲诈每周的保护费。

items.def_en: To extort or drain money continuously from someone until their resources are exhausted
items.ex_en: The ruthless moneylender intended to bleed the struggling family dry with exorbitant interest rates.
items.ex_zh: 冷酷的高利贷者企图用极高的利息将这个困境中的家庭榨干。

items.def_en: To force someone to give money or do something by threatening to reveal damaging secrets or harm them
items.ex_en: He threatened to blackmail the executive with leaked emails unless he received a fortune.
items.ex_zh: 他威胁要曝光泄露的邮件来要挟这位高管，除非拿到巨款。

items.def_en: (+ from) To obtain money, information, or agreement from someone by using threats, force, or intimidation.
items.ex_en: The corrupt officer conspired to extort huge sums of money from wealthy suspects.
items.ex_zh: 那名腐败官员图谋向富有的嫌疑人敲诈巨额钱财。

items.def_en: (+ from) To obtain something forcefully or through extreme effort despite stubborn resistance
items.ex_en: The determined union leaders managed to wrest major concessions from the stubborn management.
items.ex_zh: 坚定的工会领袖设法从固执的管理层那里艰难争得了重大让步。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote extracting money, concessions, or compliance through coercion, threats, or abuse of power. While legal terms emphasize illicit force, informal extensions capture relentless financial draining.
groups.summary_zh: 以威胁、胁迫或不当压力逼迫对方交出钱财或妥协，含法律指控与盘剥意味。
groups.desc_en: Represents the illicit or coercive extraction of money, favors, or concessions through threats or relentless pressure, contrasting with fair negotiation or lawful collection.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过威胁、要挟或无情施压进行非法敲诈或榨取，区别于公平交易或合法征收。
groups.nuance_en: extort: unlawfully compelling payment through threats of violence or ruin (money / confession / ransom) · blackmail: coercing concessions under threat of exposing damaging secrets (politician / victim / employer) · bleed: draining resources steadily to the point of exhaustion (company / funds / dry) · squeeze: exerting intense financial or economic duress to extract value (suppliers / profit / borrowers) · wrest: pulling away control or concessions with violent effort (concessions / control / power)
groups.nuance_zh: extort: 运用暴力或毁灭性威胁强行勒索 (money / confession / ransom) · blackmail: 抓住把柄以揭丑要挟进行敲诈 (politician / victim / employer) · bleed: 持续敲骨吸髓直至榨干资产 (company / funds / dry) · squeeze: 施加严密经济高压以挤榨利益 (suppliers / profit / borrowers) · wrest: 费尽气力强行夺取或逼出让步 (concessions / control / power)

groups.name: Extract & Draw · 抽取与挤取 (Draw Fluid or Essence from a Source)
groups.tip: 利用负压或挤压榨出液体

items.def_zh: 开阀抽取（树汁、桶装酒）；开发
items.def_en: to pierce a container or source to draw liquid or resource from it
items.ex_en: Workers tap maple trees in early spring to collect sweet sap for syrup.
items.ex_zh: 工人们在早春钻开枫树以收集用于制作糖浆的甘甜树汁。

items.def_zh: （用虹吸管）抽出，转移（资金/液体）
items.def_en: (+ off/out) to convey liquid through a tube; to divert funds or resources covertly
items.ex_en: The dishonest accountant used offshore shell companies to siphon off millions from the firm.
items.ex_zh: 不诚实的会计利用离岸空壳公司秘密转移了公司数百万资金。

items.def_zh: 吸，吮吸；抽取，吸取；〈非正〉糟糕，令人厌恶
items.def_en: 1. To pull liquid, air, or an object into the mouth or an enclosed space using suction. 2. (informal) To be very bad, unpleasant, or disappointing.
items.ex_en: The child used a colourful straw to suck fresh lemonade from the tall glass.
items.ex_zh: 孩子用一根彩色吸管从高脚玻璃杯里吸出新鲜的柠檬水。

items.def_zh: 挤奶，挤（奶）；榨取，勒索（钱财、利益等）
items.def_en: 1. To draw milk from a cow, goat, or other female animal. 2. (informal) To exploit or extract money, advantage, or information from someone in an unfair or ruthless way.
items.ex_en: The greedy promoters tried to milk the aging rock band for every last dollar.
items.ex_zh: 贪婪的推广商企图榨干这支老牌摇滚乐队的最后一分钱。

items.def_en: [I/T] to cause liquid to run out completely; to deplete resources or energy
items.ex_en: Prolonged medical expenses threatened to drain the family's modest life savings completely away.
items.ex_zh: 长期的医疗开支恐将彻底耗尽这个家庭微薄的毕生积蓄。
items.ex2_en: The flooded lake water drained away through natural underground limestone sinkholes gradually.
items.ex2_zh: 漫灌的湖水通过天然地下石灰岩落水洞逐渐排走了。

items.def_en: to press firmly together to force out liquid or extract something with effort
items.ex_en: She leaned over the bowl to squeeze fresh juice from ripe lemon halves.
items.ex_zh: 她俯身在碗上方，从切开的熟柠檬中挤出新鲜汁液。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe extracting liquid, nutrients, or intangible value from a container or living organism, varying by physical mechanism (suction, squeezing) or exploitative intent.
groups.summary_zh: 通过吮吸、挤压或抽引从源体获取液体或利益，侧重手法特征与榨取意味。
groups.desc_en: Depicts pulling liquid, value, or essence out of a reservoir or entity through suction, tapping, or pressure, contrasting with mere pouring or surface scraping.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过吸附、开槽引流或挤压从储源中抽取液体、价值或精髓，区别于表层倾倒或刮除。
groups.nuance_en: tap: piercing a reservoir to draw out an ongoing supply (resource / vein / potential) · siphon: diverting liquid or illicitly channeling funds across boundaries (funds / fuel / cash) · milk: systematically draining a source for maximum yield or exploitation (system / cow / client) · drain: completely emptying fluid or vitality out of a container (battery / swamp / energy) · squeeze: applying mechanical pressure to extract drops or yield (juice / lemon / profits)
groups.nuance_zh: tap: 开口引流或开发利用储备资源 (resource / vein / potential) · siphon: 虹吸液体，或暗中转移挪用资金 (funds / fuel / cash) · milk: 充分压榨或利用以获取最大产出 (system / cow / client) · drain: 彻底排空液体或耗尽活力 (battery / swamp / energy) · squeeze: 施加物理挤压力榨出汁液或收益 (juice / lemon / profits)

groups.name: Extract & Pry Loose · 撬开与撬出 (Prise, Pry, Winkle)
groups.tip: 费力从狭缝或壳中挑出

items.def_en: to force or ease something out of a tight space by using a wedge
items.ex_en: He used a flat chisel to wedge out the jammed stone from the track.
items.ex_zh: 他用一把平凿将卡在轨道上的石头挤撬了出来。

items.def_en: to move or lift something heavy using a firm lever or tool
items.ex_en: The mechanics used a long iron bar to lever the massive engine block upward.
items.ex_zh: 机械师们用一根长铁棍将沉重的发动机缸体撬了起来。

items.def_en: to use force or a tool with leverage to move, raise, or open something stuck
items.ex_en: The burglar tried to pry the rusted cellar door open with a heavy screwdriver.
items.ex_zh: 窃贼试图用一把重型螺丝刀撬开生锈的地窖门。

items.def_zh: （用针等从壳中）挑出；挑出，搜出，挖出（尤与 out 连用）
items.def_en: (chiefly British informal) ('winkle out') To extract or force someone or something out of a tight space, hiding place, or position with difficulty.
items.ex_en: Detectives spent hours trying to winkle the crucial truth out of the suspect.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们花了数小时试图从嫌疑人口中费力挖出关键真相。

items.def_zh: 撬，撬开，撬动；费力套出（信息）
items.def_en: (chiefly British) To use force or a tool to lever or pry something open or away; to extract with difficulty.
items.ex_en: He managed to prise open the wooden crate using a rusted metal crowbar.
items.ex_zh: 他用一根生锈的金属撬棍设法撬开了那个木箱。

items.def_en: to force open a locked window, door, or drawer using a small crowbar or tool
items.ex_en: The thief managed to jimmy the back window and slip into the dark house.
items.ex_zh: 小偷设法用撬棍撬开了后窗，潜入了漆黑的屋内。

groups.summary_en: An agent applies leveraged force or painstaking probing to separate, dislodge, or extract an object from a tight, stuck, or confined space. Verbs vary by the tool, leverage, and physical effort required.
groups.summary_zh: 施加杠杆或细致撬动以从紧密夹缝或狭小空间中起出、撬开某物。
groups.desc_en: Involves applying mechanical leverage or wedging tools into a narrow gap to force something open or free, contrasting with sliding, unlocking, or cutting.
groups.desc_zh: 指使用杠杆工具插入狭缝强行将其撬开或撬松，区别于平滑滑动、开锁或切割。
groups.nuance_en: pry: applying leverage to force open or separate tight objects (lid / crate / door) · prise: British equivalent of pry, emphasizing forceful wedging (open the box / shell) · lever: using an actual lever mechanism to hoist or dislodge (rock / beam / body) · winkle: painstakingly digging something out of an enclosed crevice (information / meat / spy) · jimmy: illicitly forcing open a lock or window using a makeshift tool (window / lock / door)
groups.nuance_zh: pry: 用杠杆原理强行撬开紧闭之物 (lid / crate / door) · prise: 英式用法，强调工具楔入撬开 (open the box / shell) · lever: 利用杠杆力臂移动重物或撬松 (rock / beam / body) · winkle: 极费周折地从夹缝中剔出或挖出 (information / meat / spy) · jimmy: 用扁平工具撬锁或撬窗入室 (window / lock / door)

groups.name: Extract & Pull Out · 拔出与提炼 (Extract, Draw out, Pry)
groups.tip: 费力把嵌入之物抽出提取

items.def_en: To pull something gently or smoothly from inside a holder or container; to elicit hidden information
items.ex_en: The magician gently began to draw out a long silk ribbon from his pocket.
items.ex_zh: 魔术师轻轻地开始从口袋里抽出一根长长的丝带。

items.def_en: To remove something by pulling it firmly from where it is fixed or embedded
items.ex_en: The multinational corporation decided to pull out of the unprofitable market.
items.ex_zh: 该跨国公司决定退出这一无利可图的市场。

items.def_zh: 拔出，抽出；提取，提炼；索取，榨取
items.def_en: To remove, pull out, or draw out something with effort, skill, or force; to obtain a substance or information from something.
items.ex_en: The dentist had to extract two damaged wisdom teeth during the complex surgical procedure.
items.ex_zh: 牙医在复杂的手术过程中不得不拔掉两颗受损的智齿。

items.def_en: To use leverage to force something open or dislodge it from a tight space
items.ex_en: The rescue workers used a specialized crowbar to pry the warped door free.
items.ex_zh: 救援人员使用特制撬棍撬开了变形的车门。

items.def_en: To forcibly pull or extract something away from a tight grasp or difficult obstacle
items.ex_en: The brave soldier managed to wrest the loaded pistol from his violent captor.
items.ex_zh: 勇敢的士兵设法从凶暴的看守手中强行夺下了上膛的手枪。

items.def_zh: 解救；使摆脱（险境或纠缠）
items.def_en: To free or release someone or something from a tangled, trapped, or dangerous position with difficulty
items.ex_en: Firefighters worked frantically to extricate the trapped driver from the badly crushed vehicle.
items.ex_zh: 消防员们拼命工作，将受困的司机从严重变形的车中解救出来。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote removing or obtaining an embedded object or substance through deliberate force, mechanical effort, or specialized technique. They often contrast raw physical pulling with chemical or informational extraction.
groups.summary_zh: 强调借助外力、技巧或工序将嵌生物件、深层成分或隐秘信息拔出或提炼出来。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on pulling an embedded, resistant element out of a matrix or tight confinement, contrasting with casual picking up or effortless retrieval.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重于从基质或深陷束缚中将紧固、附着的对象用力拔出或提炼出来，区别于轻松捡起或顺手取回。
groups.nuance_en: extract: removing an embedded object or isolating a chemical constituent (tooth / mineral / DNA) · pull out: physical withdrawal of an inserted element or force (nail / troops / plug) · draw out: coaxing or stretching an entity out from concealment (secret / sword / shy person) · extricate: disentangling someone trapped in an intricate hazard (victim / wreckage / oneself) · wrest: wrenching away an object from a stubborn grip (weapon / victory / control)
groups.nuance_zh: extract: 拔除深嵌之物或化学提炼有效成分 (tooth / mineral / DNA) · pull out: 物理拔出插接物或撤出驻军 (nail / troops / plug) · draw out: 引出隐藏之物、拔剑或诱导启齿 (secret / sword / shy person) · extricate: 从危险或错综复杂的困境中解救解脱 (victim / wreckage / oneself) · wrest: 从牢固抓握中猛力夺取、硬抢 (weapon / victory / control)

groups.name: Fabricate & Forge · 编造与伪造 (Concoct, Forge, Trump up)
groups.tip: 无中生有捏造谎言或假货

items.def_en: To invent an untrue story, excuse, or explanation rather than tell facts
items.ex_en: He had to make up an elaborate excuse for being late to work today.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不编造一个精心构思的借口来解释今天上班迟到。

items.def_en: To contrive or fabricate a dishonest explanation, excuse, or plot
items.ex_en: He had to cook up an excuse for being late to the morning briefing.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不编造一个早会迟到的借口。

items.def_en: To invent an elaborate story, excuse, or plan, often to deceive people
items.ex_en: The dishonest salesman had to concoct an ingenious alibi to deceive the skeptical police.
items.ex_zh: 不诚实的推销员不得不编造一个巧妙的不在场证明来蒙骗怀疑的警察。

items.def_en: To deliberately invent false charges or complaints against someone
items.ex_en: He was arrested on trumped-up charges orchestrated by his political rivals.
items.ex_zh: 他因政敌蓄意捏造的莫须有罪名而被捕。

items.def_en: To make an illegal, fraudulent copy of a document, signature, or currency
items.ex_en: The corrupt clerk attempted to forge his supervisor's signature on the official transfer document.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的办事员企图在官方调拔文件上伪造主管的签名。

items.def_en: 1. To invent false information, evidence, or an excuse in order to deceive people. 2. (manufacturing) To construct or manufacture something from prepared components.
items.ex_en: Corrupt detectives conspired to fabricate false evidence against the prominent political activist.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的便衣警探密谋捏造针对那位著名政治活动家的伪证。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail deliberately inventing falsehoods, doctoring evidence, or counterfeiting documents and stories with the intention of misleading, deceiving, or framing others.
groups.summary_zh: 指蓄意捏造谎言、虚构借口或伪造物证以达到蒙骗、嫁祸目的的行为。
groups.desc_en: Involves inventing false narratives, evidence, or documents with fraudulent intent, contrasting with factual compilation or honest creative writing.
groups.desc_zh: 指怀着欺诈意图凭空捏造虚假叙事、伪造证据或公文，区别于事实记录或正当文学创作。
groups.nuance_en: fabricate: weaving a complex, fully invented falsehood or physical counterfeit (evidence / lie / excuse) · forge: producing fraudulent duplicates of legal signatures, currency, or art (signature / document / passport) · concoct: stirring together plausible details into an inventive yarn (story / excuse / scheme) · trump up: maliciously inventing bogus charges against an innocent party (charges / allegations / case) · make up: casual or spontaneous invention of an untrue account (excuse / story / explanation)
groups.nuance_zh: fabricate: 精心捏造整套谎言或伪造物证 (evidence / lie / excuse) · forge: 仿造签名、票据或艺术品以假乱真 (signature / document / passport) · concoct: 拼凑细节调制出可信的借口或方案 (story / excuse / scheme) · trump up: 恶意罗织假罪名以诬告陷害 (charges / allegations / case) · make up: 口头随口编造或谎称 (excuse / story / explanation)

groups.name: Fabricate & Mass-Produce · 工业生产与制造 (Fabricate, Assemble, Turn Out)
groups.tip: 工业加工制造各类成品

items.def_en: 1. To make or produce goods on a large scale using machinery. 2. To invent, fabricate, or make up a false story, excuse, or evidence.
items.ex_en: The multinational plant can manufacture thousands of precise electronic components every single day.
items.ex_zh: 这家跨国工厂每天都能批量制造数以千计的精密电子元件。

items.def_en: To produce standardized goods in large quantities, usually using machines on assembly lines
items.ex_en: The automated factory was designed to mass-produce reliable consumer electronics at minimal cost.
items.ex_zh: 这座自动化工厂旨在以最低成本批量生产可靠的消费电子产品。

items.def_en: To produce something mechanically or industrially, especially in large amounts
items.ex_en: The high-tech assembly lines can turn out hundreds of finished vehicles every hour.
items.ex_zh: 高科技装配线每小时能产出数百辆完工的汽车。

items.def_en: To produce large quantities of something rapidly and automatically, often with poor quality
items.ex_en: The content mill continues to churn out cheap marketing articles for clickbait websites.
items.ex_zh: 这家内容作坊源源不断地为诱饵点击网站粗制滥造廉价的营销文章。

items.def_en: To make something by joining separate component parts together systematically
items.ex_en: Engineers worked carefully to assemble the delicate satellite components inside the cleanroom.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们在无尘室里小心翼翼地组装精密的卫星零部件。
items.ex2_en: Eager peaceful protesters assembled outside city hall to demand immediate political reform.
items.ex2_zh: 热切的和平抗议者聚集在市政厅外，要求立即进行政治改革。

items.def_en: To make or construct a product or structure by assembling prepared components
items.ex_en: Workers at the shipyard fabricate large steel panels for the new commercial vessel.
items.ex_zh: 造船厂的工人们为新型商用船只装配制造大型钢结构板材。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses the systematic industrial processing, assembly, or mechanical fabrication of tangible goods or products on a significant scale.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过工业机械、装配线或加工系统规模化制造实体产品。
groups.desc_en: Centers on the structured, industrial-scale production or assembly of standardized goods, contrasting with artisanal bespoke crafting or organic growth.
groups.desc_zh: 聚焦于工业化流水线上标准化货品的规模式制造或组装，区别于手工作坊定制或天然生长。
groups.nuance_en: manufacture: industrial-scale processing of raw materials into finished products (goods / cars / chips) · mass-produce: churning out identical standardized units in huge quantities (clothing / vehicles / electronics) · assemble: fitting together pre-made components into a whole (engine / furniture / team) · fabricate: manufacturing industrial structures from metal plates/beams (steel / structure / components) · churn out: uninspired, rapid production of large volumes (novels / graduates / widgets)
groups.nuance_zh: manufacture: 成规模的工业原料深加工与成品制造 (goods / cars / chips) · mass-produce: 依托流水线批量复制大宗标品 (clothing / vehicles / electronics) · assemble: 将预制零部件拼装成整体 (engine / furniture / team) · fabricate: 工业构件的剪裁、冲压与下料制作 (steel / structure / components) · churn out: 机械粗糙、流水账式快速大批量产出 (novels / graduates / widgets)

groups.name: Fade & Diminish · 消退与变淡 (Fade, Wane, Dwindle)
groups.tip: 光彩逐渐暗淡最终完全消失

items.def_en: 1. to lose brightness, color, or loudness gradually, or to cause something to do so 2. to slowly disappear or decline
items.ex_en: The brilliant sunset colours began to fade slowly into the dark night sky.
items.ex_zh: 绚烂的落日余晖开始在夜幕中慢慢褪去。
items.ex2_en: Intense tropical sunlight will quickly fade the vibrant colors of those curtains.
items.ex2_zh: 强烈的热带阳光会很快使那些窗帘鲜艳的颜色褪色。

items.def_en: To lose intensity of brightness or clarity, or cause visibility to decrease
items.ex_en: Thick stormy clouds began to dim the afternoon sunlight across the entire valley.
items.ex_zh: 厚重的暴风雨云开始使整个山谷的午后阳光变得暗淡。
items.ex2_en: The bright theatre lights dimmed softly as the evening performance finally began.
items.ex2_zh: 随着晚间演出终于开始，剧院明亮的灯光缓缓变暗。

items.def_en: To diminish in size, number, or strength gradually until little remains
items.ex_en: Their emergency food supplies continued to dwindle rapidly as severe winter storms lingered.
items.ex_zh: 随着严酷的冬季风暴持续不退，他们的应急口粮迅速减少。

items.def_en: To recede like the tide, gradually decaying in momentum, emotion, or life force
items.ex_en: As twilight fell, his remaining strength seemed to ebb away into the silence.
items.ex_zh: 暮色降临时，他残留的体力似乎在寂静中逐渐消逝。

items.def_en: To decrease in vigor, power, brightness, or scale over an extended period
items.ex_en: Public enthusiasm for the lengthy war began to wane after heavy battlefield losses.
items.ex_zh: 在战场遭遇惨重损失后，公众对持久战争的热情开始减退。

items.def_en: To gradually come to an end by steadily growing weaker, smaller, or slower
items.ex_en: The heavy rain showers started to peter out as the cold front passed.
items.ex_zh: 随着冷锋过境，倾盆大雨开始逐渐减弱停歇。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail progressive diminution in perceptual strength, intensity, or distinctness—such as the gradual fading of colors, memory, sound, daylight, or passion over time.
groups.summary_zh: 强调光度、色彩、声音或情感强度随着时间推移逐步减弱暗淡。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the gradual, continuous weakening of sensory intensity, vitality, or quantity toward eventual insignificance, contrasting with abrupt cessation or violent destruction.
groups.desc_zh: 指感官强度、生命力或数量缓慢而连续地减退直至微不足道，区别于突然中断或剧烈毁灭。
groups.nuance_en: fade: loss of sensory brightness, color, or sound intensity (light / memory / hopes) · wane: cyclical or gradual decline of power, size, or influence (moon / popularity / enthusiasm) · dwindle: shrinking in quantity, reserves, or head-count toward near zero (resources / numbers / savings) · ebb: rhythmic receding of a tide, energy, or confidence (tide / life / support) · peter out: gradually diminishing until sputtering out completely (stream / trail / conversation)
groups.nuance_zh: fade: 色彩、光亮或声音等感官强度逐渐暗淡褪色 (light / memory / hopes) · wane: 影响力、月相或势头的周期性渐次亏缺 (moon / popularity / enthusiasm) · dwindle: 数量、储量或人数逐渐缩减至见底 (resources / numbers / savings) · ebb: 如潮水般有节律地退潮或元气退减 (tide / life / support) · peter out: 后劲不足逐渐衰减直至彻底停歇 (stream / trail / conversation)

groups.name: Fade & Perish · 消逝与消亡 (Disappear, Dissolve, Evaporate)
groups.tip: 从看不见到彻底灭绝消亡

items.def_en: To slowly become weaker, dimmer, or less distinct until completely gone
items.ex_en: The distant church bells began to fade away into the cool evening breeze.
items.ex_zh: 远处的教堂钟声在凉爽的晚风中逐渐消散。

items.def_en: To cease to be visible or to pass out of sight entirely
items.ex_en: The mysterious stranger seemed to disappear into thin air without leaving any tracks.
items.ex_zh: 那个神秘的陌生人似乎凭空消失了，没有留下任何痕迹。

items.def_en: To break down, melt, or disintegrate into nothingness
items.ex_en: The morning mist began to dissolve beneath the warmth of the rising sun.
items.ex_zh: 晨雾在初升太阳的暖意下开始融化消散。
items.ex2_en: The persistent chemist dissolved the white powder into the clear acidic solution.
items.ex2_zh: 这位执着的化学家把白色粉末溶解在了透明的酸性溶液中。

items.def_zh: 突然消失，不见；绝迹，消亡
items.def_en: to disappear suddenly or completely; to cease to exist
items.ex_en: The ancient woodland creatures seemed to vanish without a trace from the forest.
items.ex_zh: 古老的林地生物似乎从森林中彻底消失得无影无踪。

items.def_en: To vanish abruptly without leaving a trace, often said of emotions, hopes, or assets
items.ex_en: All their optimistic hopes began to evaporate as disastrous election results rolled in.
items.ex_zh: 随着灾难性的选举结果陆续揭晓，他们所有乐观的希望都化为了乌有。
items.ex2_en: The midday sun quickly evaporated the remaining raindrops on the stone pathway.
items.ex2_zh: 正午的太阳迅速蒸发了石子路面上残留的雨滴。

items.def_en: To die, be destroyed, or cease to exist permanently through ruin or violence
items.ex_en: Thousands of innocent civilians would perish unless emergency relief supplies arrived in time.
items.ex_zh: 除非应急救援物资及时送达，否则数以千计的无辜平民将会丧生。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe entities passing out of sight, existence, or memory, ranging from gradual natural fading to sudden, irreversible disappearance.
groups.summary_zh: 描述人、物或现象从视线或存在中逐渐消退直至彻底灭绝。
groups.desc_en: Highlights the irreversible transition from existing to total nonexistence or dissolution, contrasting with mere temporary absence or reversible hiding.
groups.desc_zh: 强调事物从有形存在不可逆地走向彻底虚无或分解，区别于暂时的离开或隐匿。
groups.nuance_en: vanish: sudden, baffling disappearance leaving no trace (magician / trace / species) · disappear: generic cessation of visibility or presence (fog / symptoms / money) · evaporate: turning to vapor, or metaphorically vanishing instantly into thin air (water / trust / profits) · dissolve: disintegrating structurally into a surrounding medium (tablet / parliament / tears) · perish: suffering absolute destruction, death, or extinction (crops / travelers / empire)
groups.nuance_zh: vanish: 突然神秘地彻底隐匿无踪 (magician / trace / species) · disappear: 最通用的不再可见或不复存在 (fog / symptoms / money) · evaporate: 蒸发汽化，或比喻信心/财富化为乌有 (water / trust / profits) · dissolve: 结构解体消融于介质，或组织解散 (tablet / parliament / tears) · perish: 因灾难、残酷环境等走向灭亡死亡 (crops / travelers / empire)

groups.name: Fail & Flunk · 考核落第与挂科不合格 (Fail, Pluck, Wash out)
groups.tip: 考试不及格或事业遭挫败

items.def_en: To not pass an exam, test, or course, or grade someone as having not met the standard
items.ex_en: He was terrified that he would fail the crucial board certification examination tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 他非常害怕自己明天的执业资格关键考试会不及格。

items.def_en: (informal, especially North American) To perform disastrously badly on a test or exam
items.ex_en: I totally forgot to study, so I knew I would bomb that test.
items.ex_zh: 我完全忘了复习，所以我知道那场考试我肯定会考砸。

items.def_en: (informal) To fail a rigorous training program or course and be disqualified
items.ex_en: The outdoor music festival was completely washed out by the downpour.
items.ex_zh: 室外音乐节因倾盆大雨而被迫彻底取消。
items.ex2_en: Frequent machine washing will cause bright summer fabric dyes to wash out completely.
items.ex2_zh: 频繁的机洗会导致鲜艳的夏季面料染料彻底褪色。

items.def_en: To barely succeed in passing a test or course, hovering just above failure
items.ex_en: She only studied the night before, barely managing to scrape through the exam.
items.ex_zh: 她只在考前那一晚复习，才勉强在考试中压线及格。

items.def_en: (+ of) To leave an educational institution or course before graduating, often following failure
items.ex_en: He dropped out of college to start his own technology firm.
items.ex_zh: 他从大学辍学去创办了自己的科技公司。

items.def_zh: 考试不及格；给……打不及格；败北，失败
items.def_en: (informal, especially North American) To fail an exam, course, or test, or to give someone a failing grade.
items.ex_en: The professor warned that skipping laboratory sessions would cause several lazy students to flunk.
items.ex_zh: 教授警告说旷掉实验课会导致几个懒惰的学生挂科。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on failing an academic examination, course, or assessment, or giving an examinee an unacceptable failing grade.
groups.summary_zh: 指在考试、学业或资格考核中不及格、被淘汰或给某人打不及格。
groups.desc_en: Specifies falling below an established standard of competence in an academic or training evaluation, contrasting with moral transgressions or physical collapses.
groups.desc_zh: 特指在学业、测试或资格考核中未达到既定合格线，区别于道德失范或物理崩溃。
