groups.nuance_en: fail: standard non-attainment of required evaluation benchmarks (exam / test / course) · flunk: colloquial failing, either of a candidate or by an examiner (algebra / student / test) · wash out: failing rigorous military or athletic screening and being expelled (cadet / recruit / pilot) · drop out: voluntarily quitting a program before completion (school / college / race) · bomb: colloquially failing catastrophically or bombing a test (audition / exam / interview)
groups.nuance_zh: fail: 考核或标准测试未达及格线的通称 (exam / test / course) · flunk: 口语中的挂科不及格，或指教师当掉学生 (algebra / student / test) · wash out: 在残酷选拔淘汰中因不合格被刷掉 (cadet / recruit / pilot) · drop out: 在学业中途退学、辍学 (school / college / race) · bomb: 口语中指发挥极差导致考试或面试惨败 (audition / exam / interview)

groups.name: Fail & Malfunction · 故障与罢工 (Conk Out, Break Down, Glitch)
groups.tip: 机器或系统运转失灵失败

items.def_en: Stop working properly due to a mechanical, electrical, or structural fault
items.ex_en: Our old family station wagon chose to break down in the remote mountain pass.
items.ex_zh: 我们那辆老旧的旅行车偏偏在偏僻的山口抛锚了。
items.ex2_en: The talented teacher broke down the complex mathematical concept into simple steps.
items.ex2_zh: 这位才华横溢的老师把复杂的数学概念分解成了简单的步骤。

items.def_en: Suddenly stop functioning or fail completely, especially of an engine or electrical appliance
items.ex_en: The ancient air conditioner decided to conk out during the hottest summer afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 那台老旧的空调偏在最炎热的夏日午后彻底歇菜了。

items.def_en: Suffer a brief, minor, or temporary malfunction or irregularity in operation
items.ex_en: The livestream broadcast began to glitch just as the president announced his resignation.
items.ex_zh: 就在总统宣布辞职时，网络直播开始出现卡顿故障。

items.def_en: Completely cease to operate or support load under continuous strain
items.ex_en: After carrying heavy concrete blocks all morning, his tired knees finally gave out.
items.ex_zh: 搬了一上午沉重的水泥块后，他疲惫的膝盖终于彻底撑不住了。

items.def_en: Become locked, jammed, or unable to move due to friction, heat, or internal failure
items.ex_en: Without enough lubricating oil, the overheated tractor engine will quickly seize up completely.
items.ex_zh: 如果没有足够的润滑油，过热的拖拉机发动机会迅速彻底卡死。

items.def_en: (of a machine, system, or organ) To fail to function or work properly.
items.ex_en: Critical safety systems may malfunction if the electrical grid experiences a sudden surge.
items.ex_zh: 如果电网遭遇突发浪涌，关键的安全系统可能会运转失灵。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey the sudden or progressive operational breakdown, stalling, or failure of mechanical engines, electrical hardware, or automated systems.
groups.summary_zh: 指机器、系统或设备发生故障、停转或瘫痪。
groups.desc_en: Identifies the cessation of normal operational function in mechanical, electrical, or biological systems, contrasting with intentional shutdowns or deliberate destruction.
groups.desc_zh: 指机械、电子或机体系统因机械故障而丧失正常运转功能，区别于主动关机或人为故意破坏。
groups.nuance_en: break down: complete mechanical failure halting regular operation (car / engine / negotiations) · malfunction: operating improperly or incorrectly due to a system glitch (equipment / sensor / valve) · conk out: informal sudden dying of an engine or tired person (motor / battery / heart) · glitch: brief, localized electrical or software anomaly (system / screen / software) · seize up: mechanical jamming due to excessive friction or lack of oil (engine / joint / brakes)
groups.nuance_zh: break down: 机械彻底抛锚瘫痪无法运转 (car / engine / negotiations) · malfunction: 机器或传感器发生功能失调、运作不正常 (equipment / sensor / valve) · conk out: 口语中机器或人体突然断电熄火罢工 (motor / battery / heart) · glitch: 软件或电气系统的短暂小毛病、失灵 (system / screen / software) · seize up: 因缺油或过热导致机械死死卡死咬住 (engine / joint / brakes)

groups.name: Faint & Regain Consciousness · 昏厥与苏醒 (Pass Out, Black Out, Come Round)
groups.tip: 短暂失去知觉后恢复

items.def_en: To recover consciousness or normal physical faculties after fainting or an accident
items.ex_en: The doctor waited patiently beside the hospital bed until the patient finally came round.
items.ex_zh: 医生耐心地守在病床边，直到病人终于苏醒过来。

items.def_en: To regain consciousness after fainting or anesthesia
items.ex_en: After remaining unconscious for nearly twenty minutes, the injured cyclist finally came to.
items.ex_zh: 昏迷了近二十分钟后，受伤的骑行者终于恢复了知觉。

items.def_en: To fall down suddenly, especially in a faint or as a result of illness
items.ex_en: The exhausted marathon runner looked utterly pale before suddenly threatening to keel over.
items.ex_zh: 筋疲力竭的马拉松选手脸色惨白，险些突然栽倒在地。

items.def_en: To suddenly lose consciousness for a brief period, typically from exhaustion, heat, or intoxication
items.ex_en: The oppressive heat in the crowded hall caused several young spectators to pass out.
items.ex_zh: 拥挤大厅里的闷热天气导致数名年轻观众当场昏倒。

items.def_zh: 眼前发黑而晕厥；暂时性丧失记忆
items.def_en: To experience a sudden, temporary loss of vision, consciousness, or memory
items.ex_en: He blacked out for a few seconds after hitting his head on the doorframe.
items.ex_zh: 他的头撞在门框上后昏厥了数秒。

items.def_en: To suddenly lose consciousness for a short time, usually falling to the ground.
items.ex_en: She felt extremely dizzy from the stuffy room and feared she might faint.
items.ex_zh: 闷热的房间让她感到极度头晕，生怕自己会昏倒。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe abruptly losing consciousness due to shock, illness, or trauma, as well as regaining normal awareness afterwards. They range from colloquial phrasal verbs for blacking out to clinical or gentle terms for coming round.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖因生理休克或虚弱突发性失去知觉，以及随后苏醒过来恢复意识的过程。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the involuntary loss or subsequent recovery of sensorimotor consciousness, contrasting with deliberate resting or ordinary sleep by its abrupt, physiological disruption.
groups.desc_zh: 指知觉与运动意识的非自愿丧失或随后的恢复，与有意休息或正常入睡的区别在于其突发性及病理/生理机能中断。
groups.nuance_en: faint: lose consciousness briefly from circulatory drop (heat / hunger / shock) · pass out: succumb suddenly to physical exhaustion or intoxication (heat / drink / pain) · black out: undergo temporary loss of vision or memory without necessarily collapsing (memory / vision / pilot) · keel over: collapse abruptly and rigidly, often falling forward (heat / exhaustion / heart attack) · come round / come to: gradually regain consciousness and orientation after a swoon (patient / victim / fighter)
groups.nuance_zh: faint: 因血压或血液循环骤降而短暂昏厥 (heat / hunger / shock) · pass out: 因力竭、极度痛苦或醉酒而失去知觉昏倒 (heat / drink / pain) · black out: 眼前发黑或暂时性记忆缺失 (memory / vision / pilot) · keel over: 身体僵硬地猝然倒地或栽倒 (heat / exhaustion / heart attack) · come round / come to: 昏厥后逐渐苏醒并恢复意识 (patient / victim / fighter)

groups.name: Falsify & Doctor · 篡改与伪造 (Doctor, Cook, Fudge, Rig)
groups.tip: 暗中动手脚改变原貌

items.def_zh: 篡改，伪造；在（食物或饮料中）掺杂质，下毒；行医
items.def_en: 1. To alter or tamper with something, especially dishonestly in order to deceive. 2. To add something harmful or potent to food or drink.
items.ex_en: The corrupt researcher attempted to doctor the laboratory test results before publishing them.
items.ex_zh: 那个不端的研究员企图在发表前篡改实验室检测结果。

items.def_en: To artificially manipulate or falsify financial accounts, figures, or records
items.ex_en: The crooked executive hired shady accountants to cook the books before the federal audit.
items.ex_zh: 这个不法高管在联邦审计前雇用了可疑的会计师来做假账。

items.def_en: To manipulate or alter a contest, election, price, or system dishonestly to ensure a specific outcome
items.ex_en: Corrupt officials made a secret pact to rig the upcoming local municipal election.
items.ex_zh: 腐败官员达成秘密协议，企图暗中操纵即将举行的地方市政选举。

items.def_zh: 搪塞掩饰，胡乱拼凑（数字）
items.def_en: To adjust or manipulate facts, figures, or explanations dishonesly or vaguely to avoid difficulties
items.ex_en: He tried to fudge the quarterly figures so nobody noticed the financial shortfall.
items.ex_zh: 他试图在季度数据上敷衍做手脚，免得有人注意到资金亏空。

items.def_en: To deliberately change records, accounts, or evidence in order to deceive others
items.ex_en: The disgraced accountant deliberately chose to falsify several audit records to conceal corporate fraud.
items.ex_zh: 这名身败名裂的会计故意篡改多份审计记录以隐瞒公司欺诈行为。

items.def_en: To corrupt, debase, or make a food, drink, or drug impure by adding inferior or unauthorized substances
items.ex_en: Unscrupulous suppliers were caught attempting to adulterate raw milk with harmful chemical additives.
items.ex_zh: 不法供应商因企图在生鲜乳中掺入有害化学添加物而被当场查获。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on intentionally altering, falsifying, or manipulating documents, data, records, or substances to mislead, conceal fraud, or secure illegitimate gain. The acts involve deliberate deception and corruption of integrity.
groups.summary_zh: 特指出于欺骗、掩盖真相或舞弊目的，对账目、数据或原件进行暗中改动。
groups.desc_en: Refers to surreptitiously tampering with genuine data, documents, or systems to misrepresent reality, contrasting with raw creation ex nihilo by altering pre-existing legitimate records.
groups.desc_zh: 指暗中篡改或操纵已有的真实数据、文件或系统以歪曲事实，与凭空捏造不同，其基础是对既有记录的加工与扭曲。
groups.nuance_en: doctor: alter or disguise evidence or substances deceitfully (drinks / photograph / records) · cook: fraudulently manipulate financial figures to present a false impression (books / accounts / figures) · rig: prearrange or manipulate a system or contest illicitly (election / market / match) · fudge: blur, evade, or cosmetically adjust figures to avoid awkward truths (figures / issue / numbers) · falsify: formally alter or misstate documentation illegally (records / accounts / evidence) · adulterate: debase the purity of a substance by adding inferior ingredients (food / wine / milk)
groups.nuance_zh: doctor: 为掩盖真相而篡改或掺假 (drinks / photograph / records) · cook: 欺诈性地做假账、虚构财务数据 (books / accounts / figures) · rig: 幕后操纵或内定选举与竞赛 (election / market / match) · fudge: 含糊粉饰、微调数据以蒙混过关 (figures / issue / numbers) · falsify: 正式且非法地伪造或纂改文件 (records / accounts / evidence) · adulterate: 在食品或物质中掺杂劣质物使变质 (food / wine / milk)

groups.name: Falsify & Forge · 虚构与伪造 (Falsify, Forge, Fabricate, Cook up)
groups.tip: 无中生有编造谎言与篡改数据

items.def_en: alter or tamper with a document, drink, or result dishonestly to alter its impression or effect
items.ex_en: Someone managed to doctor the surveillance tape before detectives could inspect it properly.
items.ex_zh: 在刑警仔细检查之前，有人设法篡改了那段监控录像。

items.def_en: concoct or invent a false story, alibi, or excuse deceitfully
items.ex_en: He had to cook up an excuse for being late to the morning briefing.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不编造一个早会迟到的借口。

items.def_en: produce a fraudulent copy of a document, signature, or banknote with intent to defraud
items.ex_en: He used tracing paper to forge his employer's signature on the company check.
items.ex_zh: 他用描摹纸在公司支票上伪造了雇主的签名。

items.def_en: invent false stories, evidence, or data deliberately in order to deceive
items.ex_en: The rogue researcher chose to fabricate clinical test data to secure government grant money.
items.ex_zh: 这名学术败类选择编造临床试验数据以骗取政府拨款。

items.def_en: manipulate or adjust facts, figures, or issues dishonestly to avoid difficulties or provide false impressions
items.ex_en: The politician tried to fudge the real costs during the televised press conference.
items.ex_zh: 这位政客在电视新闻发布会上试图含糊其辞地掩盖实际成本。

items.def_en: to alter, forge, or misrepresent records, documents, or data dishonestly in order to deceive people
items.ex_en: The corrupt official had conspired to falsify property deeds for personal financial gain.
items.ex_zh: 那个腐败官员同谋篡改了房产权证书以牟取个人利益。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers deliberate acts of altering, fabricating, or faking documents, official records, scientific results, or accounts to mislead others. These actions involve dishonest misrepresentation, intentional distortion, or counterfeit production.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过捏造、篡改文件或伪造事实来欺瞒他人的不诚实行为。
groups.desc_en: Covers the deceptive creation of fraudulent objects, documents, or narratives from whole cloth, contrasting with mere modification by generating an counterfeit artifact de novo.
groups.desc_zh: 指凭空捏造、仿造具有欺骗性的物品、文件或叙事，与单纯修改的区别在于从无到有地生成假冒品。
groups.nuance_en: forge: make an illicit, deceptive copy of an official artifact or signature (signature / passport / banknote) · fabricate: invent an elaborate lie or spurious evidence from scratch (evidence / story / pretext) · cook up: concoct an improvised excuse or scheme collaboratively or hastily (alibi / story / scheme) · falsify: render untrue by intentional misrepresentation or spurious generation (results / reports / documents)
groups.nuance_zh: forge: 伪造、仿造官方文件或签名以乱真 (signature / passport / banknote) · fabricate: 凭空编造证据、借口或谎言 (evidence / story / pretext) · cook up: 仓促或私下合谋编造说辞或借口 (alibi / story / scheme) · falsify: 蓄意篡改或制作不实报告 (results / reports / documents)

groups.name: Falter & Weaken · 动摇与衰退 (Falter, Waver, Flag)
groups.tip: 由坚定不移到动摇变衰弱

items.def_en: To move unsteadily from side to side, or show uncertainty of purpose
items.ex_en: The bicycle began to wobble violently as she lost her balance downhill.
items.ex_zh: 随着她在下坡时失去平衡，自行车开始剧烈摇晃起来。
items.ex2_en: The mischievous puppy wobbled the shaky wooden table, spilling the cold milk.
items.ex2_zh: 那只淘气的小狗晃动了摇晃的木桌，洒出了冰牛奶。

items.def_en: To become unsteady, uncertain, or lose confidence and strength
items.ex_en: The prime minister did not waver in her determination to pass the treaty.
items.ex_zh: 首相在通过该条约的坚定决心上未曾出现丝毫动摇。

items.def_zh: 逐渐消失；逐渐衰退减弱
items.def_en: To gradually diminish until completely disappearing or becoming ineffective
items.ex_en: Public protests began to peter out after the government promised major tax reforms.
items.ex_zh: 在政府承诺重大税改之后，公众抗议开始逐渐平息消失。

items.def_en: To become tired, weaker, or less enthusiastic and effective
items.ex_en: Our physical energy started to flag after hiking under the relentless summer sun.
items.ex_zh: 在炎炎夏日下徒步跋涉后，我们的体力开始渐渐不支。

items.def_zh: 动摇，衰退，衰弱；结结巴巴地说；蹒跚，踉跄
items.def_en: 1. To lose strength, momentum, or confidence and begin to weaken or fail. 2. To speak hesitantly or walk unsteadily.
items.ex_en: His resolve did not falter even when faced with overwhelming political adversity.
items.ex_zh: 即便面对排山倒海般的政治困境，他的决心也未曾动摇。

items.def_en: To decrease gradually in vigor, power, intensity, or extent
items.ex_en: The emperor's imperial influence began to wane as local warlords seized regional control.
items.ex_zh: 随着地方军阀割据一方，皇帝的帝国统治力开始日渐衰退。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe losing physical strength, conviction, operational momentum, or steady progress, showing imminent signs of breakdown.
groups.summary_zh: 指力量、信心、势头或身体状态动摇不稳，开始显出疲态或衰退迹象。
groups.desc_en: Marks a progressive loss of physical strength, resolve, or operational momentum, contrasting with sudden cessation by exhibiting hesitation, unsteadiness, or gradual decay.
groups.desc_zh: 指体力、意志或发展势头的逐步动摇与衰退，与骤然停滞的区别在于其表现出的犹豫、蹒跚或渐进式衰竭。
groups.nuance_en: falter: lose strength, confidence, or steady movement, showing sudden hesitation (voice / steps / resolve) · waver: oscillate unsteadily between choices or levels of commitment (commitment / resolve / faith) · flag: decline noticeably in energy, enthusiasm, or vigor (energy / interest / enthusiasm) · wane: gradually decrease in power, intensity, or influence over time (influence / popularity / moon) · peter out: gradually diminish to the point of extinction or nothingness (enthusiasm / protest / trail)
groups.nuance_zh: falter: 因信心或力量动摇而步履蹒跚、支吾不前 (voice / steps / resolve) · waver: 在决意或信念上左右动摇、犹豫不决 (commitment / resolve / faith) · flag: 势头、精力或兴趣显著低落衰减 (energy / interest / enthusiasm) · wane: 影响力、声望或光亮随时间渐次式微 (influence / popularity / moon) · peter out: 逐渐减弱至彻底消失或告终 (enthusiasm / protest / trail)

groups.name: Fan & Ventilate · 鼓风与扇动 (Fan, Stoke, Ventilate)
groups.tip: 搧动器具鼓起风力吹拂

items.def_en: To spread open or spread out across a wide area from a central point
items.ex_en: Searchers were instructed to fan out across the dense woods to locate the child.
items.ex_zh: 搜救人员奉命在密林中成扇形散开，以寻找那个失踪的孩子。
items.ex2_en: The skilled dealer fanned out the deck of playing cards across the table.
items.ex2_zh: 娴熟的发牌员在桌面上将整副扑克牌整齐地展开铺开。

items.def_zh: 扇（风），煽动（风力）；成扇形散开；（棒球中）三振（击球手）
items.def_en: 1. To blow air onto someone or something by waving a fan or other flat object. 2. (+ out) To spread out in the shape of an open fan. 3. (baseball) To strike out a batter.
items.ex_en: She used a cardboard folder to fan her flushed face in the heat.
items.ex_zh: 她用一个纸板文件夹在酷热中给自己发烫的脸庞扇风。

items.def_en: To introduce air or gas into a material or liquid to oxygenate it
items.ex_en: Earthworms crawl through silent loam, aerating the dark soil for budding spring flora.
items.ex_zh: 蚯蚓穿梭于静谧的沃土间，为迎春萌发的草木疏松透气。

items.def_en: To cause fresh air to enter and circulate freely throughout a space
items.ex_en: Hospital staff opened several large casement windows to thoroughly ventilate the sterile ward.
items.ex_zh: 医护人员打开了数扇大型平开窗，以便彻底给无菌病房通风换气。

items.def_en: To encourage a fire to burn more fiercely by adding fuel or agitating air
items.ex_en: He knelt beside the hearth to stoke the glowing embers with dry pine.
items.ex_zh: 他跪在壁炉旁，往通红的余烬里添加干燥的松木以助长火势。

items.def_en: To blow air onto a hearth or flame using a bellows device
items.ex_en: The master blacksmith bellows the coals until a blinding white heat bursts forth.
items.ex_zh: 铁匠大师拉动风箱鼓吹炭火，直至迸发出耀眼的白炽光芒。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve actively directing a draft or stream of air toward something to cool it, aerate it, or stoke a combustion. They emphasize deliberate mechanical or manual movement to agitate air.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动扇动或吹气以鼓风、降温、通风或煽旺火苗。
groups.desc_en: Specifies generating or directing airflow to stimulate combustion, enhance respiration, or purge stagnant air, contrasting with passive airing by actively forcing air currents.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过机械或物理手段产生定向气流以助燃、促进呼吸或排除浊气，与自然通风的区别在于施加了主动的风力驱动。
groups.nuance_en: fan: wave air toward something to cool it or incite a flame (flames / embers / face) · stoke: stir up and feed fuel and air to a fire to intensify it (fire / furnace / fears) · ventilate: provide an enclosed space with fresh circulating air (room / building / lungs) · bellows: blast air forcefully using a bellows mechanism (furnace / forge / fire)
groups.nuance_zh: fan: 扇动气流以致凉爽，或煽动火势/情绪 (flames / embers / face) · stoke: 添煤拨旺炉火，引申为激化情绪 (fire / furnace / fears) · ventilate: 使封闭空间通风换气，或引申为公开宣泄 (room / building / lungs) · bellows: 用风箱强力鼓风促燃 (furnace / forge / fire)

groups.name: Fasten with Adhesive · 粘贴与粘附 (Glue, Paste, Stick, Affix)
groups.tip: 涂胶粘合使两物贴紧

items.def_en: To press and secure an adhesive edge or flap flatly against a backing surface
items.ex_en: Please lick the envelope flap and stick down the edges firmly before mailing.
items.ex_zh: 寄出前请舔湿信封舌口，并将边缘按平贴紧。

items.def_en: To attach or become attached to a surface by adhesive force or natural tackiness
items.ex_en: You can stick the reminder note onto the refrigerator door with some tape.
items.ex_zh: 你可以用些胶带把便签纸贴在冰箱门上。
items.ex2_en: Wet snow began to stick firmly to the cold glass car windshield.
items.ex2_zh: 湿雪开始牢牢地粘在冰冷的汽车挡风玻璃上。

items.def_en: To seal, join, or fasten something using sticky gum or cohesive syrup
items.ex_en: He used a brush to gum the vintage label securely onto the bottle.
items.ex_zh: 他用刷子涂上树胶，将这张复古标签牢牢粘在瓶子上。

items.def_en: To stick or fasten paper, pictures, or objects to a surface using adhesive paste or gum
items.ex_en: The poet loved to paste dried autumn leaves onto yellowed parchment paper albums.
items.ex_zh: 诗人喜欢用浆糊把干燥的秋叶粘贴在泛黄的羊皮纸册页上。

items.def_en: To fasten, join, or attach something securely to an exterior surface, usually by adhesive means
items.ex_en: The applicant must affix a recent photograph to the designated box on page two.
items.ex_zh: 申请人必须将近期免冠照片贴在第二页指定的方框内。

items.def_en: 1. To join or fasten things together using glue. 2. (often passive, 'be glued to') To fix your attention or eyes completely on something.
items.ex_en: Use waterproof resin to glue the wooden pieces back together along the joint.
items.ex_zh: 请用防水树脂沿接缝处将这些木构件重新粘合起来。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate joining, affixing, or holding lightweight objects together using paste, gum, or adhesive film. The physical action is direct, practical, and everyday, with common metaphorical extensions related to immobility.
groups.summary_zh: 通过胶水、浆糊或粘附力将物体粘接或贴在另一物体表面上。
groups.desc_en: Denotes joining, securing, or mounting surfaces together via an adhesive chemical bond, contrasting with mechanical fastening (nails, bolts) through cohesive contact adhesion.
groups.desc_zh: 指利用黏稠物质或胶性界面将表面贴合或固定，与钉固等机械紧固的区别在于依靠黏附力的化学/物理贴合。
groups.nuance_en: glue: attach firmly and permanently with a strong adhesive compound (wood / broken vase / pieces) · paste: fasten paper or lightweight items using a wet, starch-based adhesive (poster / wallpaper / label) · stick: cause to adhere spontaneously or manually, often with pressure-sensitive tack (tape / stamp / label) · affix: attach formally or securely to a designated surface (stamp / signature / label) · gum: coat or fasten with viscous, gummy substance (envelope / label / teeth)
groups.nuance_zh: glue: 使用强力胶剂进行永久或牢固粘合 (wood / broken vase / pieces) · paste: 使用浆糊或水性胶粘帖纸张等轻物 (poster / wallpaper / label) · stick: 压贴或随手贴附不干胶等粘性物 (tape / stamp / label) · affix: 正式、规整地将签条或印章贴附固定 (stamp / signature / label) · gum: 用粘质物或树胶封贴 (envelope / label / teeth)

groups.name: Favor & Coddle · 溺爱与过度娇宠 (Coddle, Pamper, Mollicoddle)
groups.tip: 关怀过度如同筑起温室

items.def_zh: 把……当婴儿对待，过分娇惯
items.def_en: Treat someone like a small child by doing everything for them or shielding them excessively
items.ex_en: Stop trying to baby him; he is twenty-five and can make his own appointments.
items.ex_zh: 别再把他当婴儿娇惯了；他都二十五岁了，能自己预约事务。

items.def_en: Harm a child's character by consistently giving them everything they ask for without discipline
items.ex_en: Grandparents often spoil their only grandchild by buying every single toy he demands.
items.ex_zh: 祖父母往往百依百顺，给独孙买下他要的所有玩具，从而惯坏了他。
items.ex2_en: Fresh raw meat will spoil quickly if left out in hot weather.
items.ex2_zh: 新鲜生肉如果放置在炎热天气下会很快变质变坏。

items.def_zh: 纵容娇宠，悉心犒劳服侍
items.def_en: Give someone special comfort, luxury, and attention, catering to all their desires
items.ex_en: The luxury spa retreat exists to pamper guests with massages and fragrant baths.
items.ex_zh: 这处豪华水疗度假村旨在通过按摩和香薰浴悉心犒劳宾客。

items.def_zh: 娇生惯养，细心呵护免受挫折
items.def_en: Treat someone with extreme indulgence, care, or protection, often to a harmful degree
items.ex_en: His overbearing parents coddle him constantly instead of letting him confront real life.
items.ex_zh: 他那过分保护的父母总对他细心呵护，而不让他面对现实生活的风雨。

items.def_en: To protect someone, especially a child, too much so that they do not learn to be independent.
items.ex_en: If parents overprotect their adolescent children, they may never develop essential coping mechanisms.
items.ex_zh: 如果父母对青春期子女过度保护，孩子可能永远无法培养基本的应对机制。

items.def_zh: 百般呵护，过分溺爱娇纵
items.def_en: Overprotect and pamper someone so excessively that they fail to develop fortitude or independence
items.ex_en: You will ruin that young boy if you mollycoddle him whenever he cries.
items.ex_zh: 如果他一哭你就百般溺爱娇纵，你迟早会彻底毁了那个小男孩。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict interpersonal overprotectiveness and excessive pampering, shielding an individual (usually a child or dependent) from life's ordinary harshness, thereby stifling their resilience and self-reliance.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重人际间过度看护、娇生惯养或溺爱包办，剥夺自立锻炼机会。
groups.desc_en: Involves shielding someone excessively from hardship or indulging their every whim, contrasting with benign care by producing debilitating dependency or fragility.
groups.desc_zh: 指过度溺爱、娇惯或阻隔外界一切风雨，与健康关怀的区别在于这种照料会削弱当事人的独立与抗挫能力。
groups.nuance_en: coddle: treat with extreme gentleness and overprotective caution (children / athletes / eggs) · pamper: gratify lavishly with luxury, ease, and comfort (guests / pets / wife) · spoil: ruin the character of a person by excessive indulgence (child / grandchildren / dog) · mollycoddle: baby and overprotect someone in an effeminate, suffocating manner (recruits / boys / players) · baby: patronize and treat someone as if they were a helpless infant (adult / brother / patient)
groups.nuance_zh: coddle: 悉心呵护、过度保护使其免受挫折 (children / athletes / eggs) · pamper: 提供极致物质奢靡与舒泰享受 (guests / pets / wife) · spoil: 纵容无度致使其性格任性娇纵 (child / grandchildren / dog) · mollycoddle: 溺爱娇养、过度保护致使其脆弱懦弱 (recruits / boys / players) · baby: 将已具备自理能力的人当作婴儿般对待 (adult / brother / patient)

groups.name: Feint & Deceive · 佯攻与诱敌 (Feint, Fake out, Juke)
groups.tip: 做假动作诱骗敌人产生误判

items.def_en: To avoid someone or something by a sudden, quick physical evasion or sidestep
items.ex_en: The nimble pedestrian managed to dodge the speeding delivery scooter on the pavement.
items.ex_zh: 敏捷的行人成功侧身闪避了人行道上疾驰的外卖电瓶车。

items.def_en: To mislead or outwit an opponent by feigning a move in one direction before taking another
items.ex_en: The clever point guard managed to fake out his defender with a head gesture.
items.ex_zh: 聪明的控球后卫通过一个摆头动作成功用假动作晃过了防守球员。

items.def_en: To intentionally provoke or lure an adversary into making an ill-advised, exploitable move
items.ex_en: The defense attorney tried to bait the emotional witness into an angry outburst.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师试图设圈套激怒情绪激动的证人，引诱其当庭失态爆发。

items.def_zh: （在球类运动中）做假动作欺骗对手
items.def_en: (sports) to make a deceptive movement in football, rugby, etc., pretending to pass or kick the ball, in order to trick an opponent
items.ex_en: The agile midfielder managed to dummy the goalkeeper and slide the ball in.
items.ex_zh: 敏捷的中场球员虚晃一枪骗过守门员，将球轻松推入球网。

items.def_zh: 虚晃避开；做假动作晃过
items.def_en: To make a quick deceptive move or sudden shift of direction to evade a defender
items.ex_en: The running back managed to juke two tacklers with a breathtaking sideline cut.
items.ex_zh: 跑卫在边线处一记惊艳的急停变向，虚晃晃过了两名扑截防守队员。

items.def_en: To make a deceptive or distracting movement intended to mislead an opponent in sports or combat
items.ex_en: The fencer stepped forward to feint high before striking low at the torso.
items.ex_zh: 击剑手向前迈步做出上刺佯攻，随即迅速刺向对手的躯干下方。

groups.summary_en: Covers deceptive tactical ploys, sham moves, or mock strikes designed to mislead an opponent in sports or combat about one's true intention or trajectory.
groups.summary_zh: 指在对抗或体育竞技中通过虚晃、假动作误导对手并诱使其失位。
groups.desc_en: Denotes executing a deceptive motion or mock attack to divert an opponent's anticipation before striking elsewhere, contrasting with a direct kinetic assault.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过虚招、假动作诱使对手预判失误从而露出破绽，与正面攻击的区别在于其动作的核心是诱骗与声东击西。
groups.nuance_en: feint: make a deceptive movement or diversionary strike to draw a parry (with the left / blow / maneuver) · fake out: mislead an opponent completely about one's true direction or intent (defender / goalie / opponent) · juke: make a quick, agile deceptive sidestep to evade a tackle (linebacker / defender / pursuer) · dummy: deliberately allow a ball to pass through or feign a kick in sports (ball / pass / defender) · bait: deliberately lure an opponent into a trap by feigning vulnerability (enemy / hook / opponent)
groups.nuance_zh: feint: 虚晃一招以诱敌防守或分散注意 (with the left / blow / maneuver) · fake out: 用彻底的假动作晃过防守者 (defender / goalie / opponent) · juke: （球场上）快速变向晃脱拦截 (linebacker / defender / pursuer) · dummy: 佯装触球实则漏球晃骗防守 (ball / pass / defender) · bait: 故意示弱以引诱对手落入圈套 (enemy / hook / opponent)

groups.name: Fend & Deflect · 抵挡与招架 (Fend, Ward off, Parry)
groups.tip: 架起盾牌抵挡进攻推开攻击

items.def_en: To turn aside from a straight course, or divert someone's criticism or focus.
items.ex_en: The spokesperson attempted to deflect reporters' sharp questions about the recent corporate scandal.
items.ex_zh: 发言人试图转移记者们针对近期公司丑闻所提出的尖锐质问。
items.ex2_en: The speeding tennis ball deflected sharply off the net onto the ground.
items.ex2_zh: 飞驰的网球擦网后急剧偏转落到了地面上。

items.def_en: To temporarily avert or delay an imminent bad outcome or disaster.
items.ex_en: Emergency international loans helped stave off the impending collapse of the national currency.
items.ex_zh: 紧急国际贷款帮助暂时化解了本国货币即将面临的崩盘危机。

items.def_en: To avert, repel, or protect oneself against danger, disease, or an unwanted approach.
items.ex_en: She took herbal supplements daily to ward off severe winter colds and influenza.
items.ex_zh: 她每天服用草本补充剂，以抵御严重的冬季感冒与流感侵袭。

items.def_en: To ward off a weapon or blow, or adroitly evade a difficult question or critique.
items.ex_en: With an iron rapier, the duel protagonist did parry the villain's lethal thrust.
items.ex_zh: 决战的主角手持铁剑，优雅地架开了恶徒直取要害的致命一刺。

items.def_en: (also 'fend off') To defend against or push away an attack, blow, or unwanted question.
items.ex_en: Security guards rushed forward to fend off aggressive protesters outside the embassy gate.
items.ex_zh: 安保人员迅速上前，挡开了使馆大门外咄咄逼人的抗议者。

items.def_en: To drive back an attacker, army, or offensive force by fighting.
items.ex_en: The garrison fought bravely all night to repel the fierce foreign invasion force.
items.ex_zh: 守军整夜浴血奋战，成功击退了凶猛的外邦入侵部队。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) to ward off, neutralize, or push back an antagonistic threat or attack
items.ex_en: The experienced diplomat skillfully fended off aggressive questions from the persistent reporters.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的外交官巧妙地化解了咄咄逼人的记者们提出的挑衅性问题。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the dynamic physical or verbal maneuver of blocking, redirecting, or pushing away an incoming attack, aggressive demand, or uncomfortable scrutiny.
groups.summary_zh: 采取防守姿态或机敏反应来抵挡、化解攻击或质问。
groups.desc_en: Specifies turning aside, repelling, or holding off incoming physical attacks, intrusive questions, or imminent crises, contrasting with absorptive blocking by deflecting trajectory.
groups.desc_zh: 指将袭来的物理攻击、质问或危机格挡开、化解或逼退，与生硬承受的区别在于通过偏折轨迹或筑起屏障御敌于外。
groups.nuance_en: parry: expertly ward off or deflect a thrust or weapon, or skillfully evade a probing query (blow / thrust / question) · deflect: cause an incoming projectile, blow, or criticism to swerve away (ball / bullet / criticism) · ward off: take defensive measures to prevent an attack, illness, or misfortune from landing (evil / infection / blows) · stave off: temporarily delay or keep at bay an impending catastrophe (famine / collapse / bankruptcy) · fend: push away, repel, or resist intruders or assaults (off attackers / off suitors / for oneself)
groups.nuance_zh: parry: 灵巧格挡刀剑刺击，或机智化解质询 (blow / thrust / question) · deflect: 使来袭的物弹或批评偏离原方向 (ball / bullet / criticism) · ward off: 采取防御措施挡开侵害、疾病或不幸 (evil / infection / blows) · stave off: 暂时延缓或击退迫在眉睫的危机 (famine / collapse / bankruptcy) · fend: 奋力推开、抵挡来犯之敌或纠缠者 (off attackers / off suitors / for oneself)

groups.name: Fester & Ulcerate · 溃烂与化脓 (Suppuration & Tissue Breakdown)
groups.tip: 伤口细菌感染并溃烂化脓

items.def_en: suddenly develop eruptions, rashes, or sores on the skin
items.ex_en: Stress caused his sensitive skin to break out in an itchy allergic rash.
items.ex_zh: 压力导致他敏感的皮肤上突然爆发出一片发痒的过敏性皮疹。

items.def_zh: （伤口）化脓，溃烂；（怨恨、问题等）加剧，恶化
items.def_en: 1. (of a wound or sore) To become infected and produce pus. 2. (of bad feelings or problems) To become worse or more intense over time.
items.ex_en: Untreated deep wounds will fester quickly in this humid tropical jungle climate.
items.ex_zh: 在热带丛林潮湿的气候下，未经处理的深层伤口会很快化脓溃烂。

items.def_en: (of skin or tissue) To develop an ulcer, or cause an ulcer to develop.
items.ex_en: Without proper circulation, the fragile tissues around his ankle began to ulcerate painfully.
items.ex_zh: 由于缺乏顺畅的血液循环，他脚踝周围的脆弱组织开始痛苦地溃烂生疮。
items.ex2_en: Untreated viral infections can ulcerate delicate mucous membranes throughout the digestive tract.
items.ex2_zh: 未经治疗的病毒感染会使整个消化道娇嫩的黏膜发生溃疡。

items.def_en: to undergo the formation and discharge of pus
items.ex_en: The jagged wound continued to suppurate despite repeated washing with surgical antiseptics.
items.ex_zh: 尽管反复用医用消毒剂清洗，那道参差不齐的伤口依然不断流脓。

items.def_en: (+ at sth) progressively destroy or erode tissue, a surface, or emotional well-being
items.ex_en: Untreated corrosive acids will slowly eat away at the vulnerable underlying dermal tissue.
items.ex_zh: 未经处理的腐蚀性酸液会缓慢侵蚀溃烂底下脆弱的真皮组织。

items.def_en: [I/T] to become affected with or cause localized death and decay of soft tissue
items.ex_en: Severe frostbite caused the lost explorer's blackened toes to gangrene beneath thick bandages.
items.ex_zh: 严重的冻伤导致迷路探险家厚厚绷带下发黑的脚趾生出了坏疽。
items.ex2_en: Without adequate blood supply, untreated necrotic tissue will gangrene and require amputation.
items.ex2_zh: 若没有充足的血液供应，未经治疗的坏死组织会发生坏疽并需要截肢。

groups.summary_en: Tissue or wounds undergo progressive bacterial infection, leading to pus generation, open sores, or gangrene. Figuratively, negative feelings decay and generate toxicity over time.
groups.summary_zh: 创口或组织发生感染化脓、腐烂破坏，程度逐步加深至坏疽溃败。
groups.desc_en: Covers the progressive decay, necrosis, and purulent corruption of biological tissue or unresolved emotional grievances, contrasting with clean healing by continuous septic deterioration.
groups.desc_zh: 指生物组织化脓、腐败坏死，或消极情绪郁结恶化，与洁净愈合相对，强调脓性或潜伏性的持续恶化。
groups.nuance_en: fester: rot and generate pus internally, or allow resentment to worsen through neglect (wound / resentment / grievances) · suppurate: medically produce or discharge purulent matter (abscess / lesion / wound) · ulcerate: develop into an open, eroding lesion or sore (stomach / tissue / skin) · gangrene: undergo localized tissue death due to loss of blood supply (limb / toes / foot) · eat away: chemically or progressively erode substance from the margins (flesh / bone / shore)
groups.nuance_zh: fester: 伤口化脓溃烂，或怨恨仇隙在暗中滋长加剧 (wound / resentment / grievances) · suppurate: （病理上）形成并排出脓液 (abscess / lesion / wound) · ulcerate: 组织受蚀形成开放性溃疡 (stomach / tissue / skin) · gangrene: 因缺血而发生组织坏疽坏死 (limb / toes / foot) · eat away: 逐步侵蚀、蚕食肉体或物质结构 (flesh / bone / shore)

groups.name: Fill & Occupy · 充满与填充 (Fill, Pack, Stuff)
groups.tip: 装满空间不再空虚

items.def_en: To push something quickly and forcefully into a small space or container
items.ex_en: I watched him stuff dirty laundry into his battered canvas gym bag haphazardly.
items.ex_zh: 我看着他胡乱地把脏衣服塞进那个破旧的帆布健身包里。

items.def_en: To put a large quantity of things or people tightly into a space
items.ex_en: Commuters pack the morning subway trains so tightly that passengers can barely breathe.
items.ex_zh: 早高峰的通勤客把地铁列车挤得水泄不通，乘客几乎无法呼吸。

items.def_zh: 充满，填满；担任，充任；满足
items.def_en: 1. To make or become full; to occupy a space completely. 2. To take up a job or position and do it.
items.ex_en: Please fill the glass pitcher with cold lemonade before our guests arrive outside.
items.ex_zh: 请在客人们在门外抵达之前，用冰柠檬水倒满玻璃壶。
items.ex2_en: The concert hall filled completely with eager fans well before showtime started.
items.ex2_zh: 音乐厅在演出开始前很久就完全挤满了热切的歌迷。

items.def_en: To fill or take up a particular space, area, or period of time
items.ex_en: The newly installed library archives occupy almost the entire basement level today.
items.ex_zh: 新建的图书馆档案库如今几乎占用了整个地下室楼层的空间。

items.def_en: To become completely full, or make something completely full
items.ex_en: Motorists queued patiently along the roadside to fill up their empty gasoline tanks.
items.ex_zh: 车主们在路边耐心地排起长队，准备将空空如也的油箱彻底加满。
items.ex2_en: The small parking lot fills up quickly on busy holiday shopping weekends.
items.ex2_zh: 在繁忙的假日购物周末，那个小型停车场很快就停满了。

items.def_en: To force a person, thing, or group into a space that is already nearly full
items.ex_en: We had to cram seven large travel bags into the tiny car trunk.
items.ex_zh: 我们不得不把七个大旅行包硬塞进那辆小轿车狭窄的后备箱里。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to causing a container, space, or vacancy to become full by inserting contents or taking up the available room. They range from neutral containment to forceful crowding and physical saturation.
groups.summary_zh: 表示装满、填塞或占据可用空间的动作，涵盖中性填补到用力塞满。
groups.desc_en: Involves occupying interior volume until little or no free capacity remains, contrasting with partial placement by attaining volumetric saturation or tight spatial compression.
groups.desc_zh: 指占据容器或空间的内部容积直至无剩余容量，与局部放置的区别在于达到容积饱和或紧密的物理充塞。
groups.nuance_en: fill: make full by adding contents until capacity is reached (glass / room / vacancy) · pack: arrange items compactly into a container for storage or transport (suitcase / boxes / crowd) · stuff: force a large quantity of material tightly or carelessly into a confined space (cushion / turkey / pockets) · cram: force an excessive number of people or objects into an inadequate space (books / passengers / clothes) · occupy: reside within or take up an allotted amount of physical space or time (seat / room / territory)
groups.nuance_zh: fill: 注满、填满容器直至达到容量极限 (glass / room / vacancy) · pack: 有序紧凑地打包或装入容具 (suitcase / boxes / crowd) · stuff: 塞满、塞紧，多指随意或紧压塞填 (cushion / turkey / pockets) · cram: 将过多的人或物强行塞进狭小空间 (books / passengers / clothes) · occupy: 占领、占用特定的物理空间或时间 (seat / room / territory)

groups.name: Finalize Deal & Settle · 敲定与落实协议 (Clinch, Finalize, Settle)
groups.tip: 锁定胜利或最终敲定合同协议

items.def_en: To successfully conclude a business negotiation or sale
items.ex_en: The corporate sales team worked late into the night to close the deal.
items.ex_zh: 企业销售团队忙到深夜，终于顺利谈成了这笔交易。

items.def_en: To resolve a dispute or come to an official agreement on a matter
items.ex_en: Both companies agreed to settle the prolonged patent dispute out of open court.
items.ex_zh: 两家公司一致同意在庭外了结这场旷日持久的专利纠纷。

items.def_en: To formally confirm, conclude, or make definitive an agreement
items.ex_en: A firm handshake between the two executives helped seal the historic trade alliance.
items.ex_zh: 两位高管之间坚定的握手，正式敲定了这项历史性的贸易联盟协议。

items.def_zh: 顺利完成；圆满结束（交易）
items.def_en: To complete or conclude a deal, contract, or meeting successfully
items.ex_en: Let's wrap up this meeting so everyone can catch their flights.
items.ex_zh: 我们结束这次会议吧，这样大家都能赶上航班。

items.def_zh: 敲定，最后达成（协议）；赢得（比赛）；（拳击中）扭住对手
items.def_en: 1. To succeed in settling, winning, or concluding an agreement or deal finally. 2. (boxing) To hold the opponent closely with one or both arms.
items.ex_en: His dazzling rhetoric did clinch the sovereign treaty before sunset came.
items.ex_zh: 他令人赞叹的雄辩口才，终在夕阳西下前一举敲定了这份主权条约。

items.def_en: To agree on or complete the last details of an arrangement or plan
items.ex_en: The committee will convene on Monday to finalize details of the new budget.
items.ex_zh: 委员会将于周一召开会议，敲定新财政预算案的最终细节。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe successfully concluding negotiations, securing a contract, or firmly cementing a business or diplomatic deal beyond dispute.
groups.summary_zh: 指经过谈判最终成功达成协议、敲定合同或确立交易方案，使之板上钉钉。
groups.desc_en: Marks bringing business negotiations, contractual terms, or disputes to an authoritative, binding conclusion, contrasting with preliminary exploration by definitive finalization.
groups.desc_zh: 指将商务谈判、合同条款或争端推向终局并确立具有约束力的结论，与初步探讨的区别在于其确凿的敲定性。
groups.nuance_en: clinch: definitively win, secure, or settle a deal or victory after prolonged contest (deal / victory / title) · finalize: put the ultimate touches on and officially approve plans or agreements (details / agreement / contract) · settle: reach an amicable or binding resolution to an outstanding dispute or account (dispute / claim / bill) · seal: conclude and formally bind a pact or agreement irreversibly (deal / fate / treaty) · wrap up: successfully bring ongoing negotiations or proceedings to a neat conclusion (meeting / deal / investigation)
groups.nuance_zh: clinch: 经角逐后锁定胜局、成功拿下交易 (deal / victory / title) · finalize: 敲定细节、最终落实协定 (details / agreement / contract) · settle: 和解争端或结清账目款项 (dispute / claim / bill) · seal: 正式签署、板上钉钉地盖棺定论 (deal / fate / treaty) · wrap up: 圆满结束谈判或顺利收尾 (meeting / deal / investigation)

groups.name: Financial Ruin & Depletion · 破产与倾家荡产 (Bankrupt, Ruin, Impoverish)
groups.tip: 财力耗尽直至彻底崩溃

items.def_en: To gradually exhaust the money, supplies, or financial capacity of someone
items.ex_en: Prolonged medical expenses will drain the retired couple's remaining personal savings quickly.
items.ex_zh: 长期持续的医疗开销将很快耗尽这对退休夫妇仅存的个人积蓄。
items.ex2_en: Liquid fuel drained steadily from the cracked tank onto the cold ground.
items.ex2_zh: 液体燃料从破裂的油箱中源源不断地排落到冰冷的地面上。

items.def_zh: 掏空（某人财物）；使倾家荡产
items.def_en: To take, win, or consume all the money that someone possesses
items.ex_en: A single night at the casino managed to clean out his entire bank account.
items.ex_zh: 在赌场里度过的一个晚上，就把他整个银行账户的钱掏得精光。

items.def_en: To destroy someone financially or cause their business to fold
items.ex_en: These massive legal penalties could easily break the struggling local manufacturing enterprise.
items.ex_zh: 这些巨额的法律罚金足以轻易让这家苦苦挣扎的本地制造企业彻底破产。
items.ex2_en: The brittle glass mirror broke into dozens of sharp fragments upon impact.
items.ex2_zh: 那面脆弱的玻璃镜子在撞击下碎成了几十块锋利的碎片。

items.def_en: To make a person, region, or enterprise extremely poor
items.ex_en: Unfair trade sanctions threaten to impoverish millions of vulnerable agrarian citizens nationwide.
items.ex_zh: 不公平的贸易制裁极有可能使全国数以百万计脆弱的农业民众陷入极端贫困。

items.def_en: To cause someone or an institution to lose all their money, property, or status
items.ex_en: The catastrophic lawsuit threatens to ruin the family business within a few months.
items.ex_zh: 这场灾难性的诉讼可能在数月内让这家家族企业倾家荡产。

items.raw_cluster: 破产与使破产 Ruin & Bankrupt
items.def_en: to make a person, business, or country go bankrupt or lose all their money
items.ex_en: Massive unhedged debts eventually bankrupted the municipal government during the severe credit crisis.
items.ex_zh: 在严重的信贷危机中，巨额未对冲的债务最终使该市政府破产。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail stripping an individual, business, or state of financial solvency, reducing them to insolvency or economic collapse.
groups.summary_zh: 指剥夺个人、机构或国家的财力资信，使其陷入破产绝境。
groups.desc_en: Specifies stripping an individual or entity of financial assets to the point of insolvency or utter penury, contrasting with minor financial loss by catastrophic depletion.
groups.desc_zh: 指彻底剥夺个人或实体的资产，使其陷入资不抵债或一贫如洗的境地，与一般亏损的区别在于毁灭性的资源枯竭。
groups.nuance_en: bankrupt: legally or functionally reduce to insolvency through total loss of capital (company / debtor / economy) · ruin: utterly destroy financial solvency, status, or prospects (family / investor / business) · impoverish: reduce to extreme, systemic poverty over time (population / peasant / nation) · clean out: exhaust or steal all available monetary funds completely (savings / bank account / casino) · drain: continuously siphon away monetary reserves until depleted (coffers / resources / finances)
groups.nuance_zh: bankrupt: 使在法律或事实上破产倒闭 (company / debtor / economy) · ruin: 倾家荡产、毁灭经济立足根基 (family / investor / business) · impoverish: 使逐步沦落至赤贫或极度贫困 (population / peasant / nation) · clean out: 彻底掏空积蓄或赢光某人钱财 (savings / bank account / casino) · drain: 持续耗尽、抽干财政资金或资源 (coffers / resources / finances)

groups.name: Fit & Dovetail · 契合与吻合 (Dovetail, Interlock, Jibe)
groups.tip: 如榫卯般严丝合缝紧密咬合

items.def_en: (+ with) To be harmonious or suitable with a surrounding group, system, or plan
items.ex_en: The proposed schedule will not fit in with the current operational requirements.
items.ex_zh: 提议的时间表无法与当前的运营需求相协调。

items.def_en: (+ with) To correspond exactly in nature, opinion, occurrence, or position
items.ex_en: The minister's private assessment did not coincide with the official cabinet statement.
items.ex_zh: 该部长的个人评估与内阁的官方声明并不一致。

items.def_en: (+ with) To be in full accord, compatibility, or agreement with another set of facts
items.ex_en: His bizarre alibi simply does not jibe with the forensic evidence found.
items.ex_zh: 他的离奇不在场证明根本与现场发现的法医证据不符。

items.def_en: (+ with) To harmonize, coordinate smoothly, or fit together cleanly like gear teeth
items.ex_en: Our marketing initiative must mesh with the ongoing product development timeline.
items.ex_zh: 我们的营销方案必须与正在推进的产品研发进度紧密配合。

items.def_en: To fit or join together closely so that each part interconnects securely with another
items.ex_en: The steel support beams interlock tightly to resist high seismic pressure.
items.ex_zh: 这些钢支撑梁紧密咬合，以抵御强烈的地震压力。
items.ex2_en: Skilled carpenters interlock the wooden puzzle joints carefully without using any nails.
items.ex2_zh: 熟练的木工不用任何钉子，小心地将木质榫卯接头咬合在一起。

items.def_zh: （使）吻合，（使）严密契合；用鸠尾榫接合
items.def_en: (+ with/into) If two things dovetail, or if you dovetail them, they fit together neatly and harmoniously; to join pieces of wood with dovetail joints.
items.ex_en: Her innovative strategy dovetailed nicely into the department's long-term restructuring goals.
items.ex_zh: 她的创新策略与该部门长期的重组目标严密契合。
items.ex2_en: The architect dovetails traditional building techniques with modern green design philosophies seamlessly.
items.ex2_zh: 建筑师将传统建筑技术与现代绿色设计理念天衣无缝地结合在一起。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate the seamless, precise, and harmonious integration of parts, ideas, schedules, or facts. The emphasis is on structural compatibility, logical alignment, or mutual reinforcement without friction or contradiction.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重在结构、逻辑或时间上天衣无缝地精密吻合、协调一致。
groups.desc_en: Denotes matching parts, ideas, or schedules so accurately that they unite seamlessly into a coherent whole, contrasting with discordant collision by harmonious structural alignment.
groups.desc_zh: 指零件、观点或日程之间精准吻合、紧密咬合，浑然一体，与冲突互斥相对，强调结构上的无缝对接。
groups.nuance_en: dovetail: fit together smoothly and complementarily, like mortise and tenon (plans / interests / schedules) · interlock: connect mechanically with parts clasping and securing one another (gears / fingers / puzzle pieces) · mesh: engage harmoniously like teeth of gears, working synchronously (ideas / gears / personalities) · jibe: harmonize and agree consistently with stated facts or evidence (accounts / figures / story) · coincide: occur at the exact same space, time, or alignment (dates / views / interests)
groups.nuance_zh: dovetail: 如榫卯般严丝合缝、有机互补 (plans / interests / schedules) · interlock: 机械式咬合、互扣为一体 (gears / fingers / puzzle pieces) · mesh: 像齿轮般啮合并紧密配合 (ideas / gears / personalities) · jibe: 与既有说法、证据或事实相符合/一致 (accounts / figures / story) · coincide: 时间空间上的重合或意见一致 (dates / views / interests)

groups.name: Fit Mechanical Parts & Hardware · 装设蹄铁与机械传动齿
groups.tip: 为马钉蹄或给机器装齿轮

items.def_en: to fit a horse or beast of burden with horseshoes
items.ex_en: The blacksmith will shoe the restless stallion before the long mountain trek.
items.ex_zh: 铁匠将在长途跋涉山路前为这匹躁动的公马钉好马蹄铁。

items.def_en: to furnish an edge or gear with projecting teeth or notches
items.ex_en: The artisan carefully toothed the iron wheel to drive the clockwork mechanism.
items.ex_zh: 工匠仔细地为铁轮开齿，以驱动发条机械装置。

items.def_zh: 给（管道或轮盘）装配凸缘或法兰盘
items.def_en: to provide an object or wheel with a rim or projecting collar
items.ex_en: The engineer decided to flange the heavy pipe to ensure a leakproof joint.
items.ex_zh: 工程师决定给这根粗管道配上法兰盘，以确保接头严密不漏。

items.def_en: To fit or nail a horseshoe onto the hoof of a horse.
items.ex_en: The experienced farrier skillfully horseshoed the mare in less than thirty minutes.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的蹄铁匠在不到三十分钟内熟练地为母马钉上了马掌。

items.def_zh: 给……装轮齿；（掷骰子时）作弊
items.def_en: 1. To fit a wheel or gear with teeth (cogs). 2. (archaic) To cheat, especially at dice.
items.ex_en: The millwright labored throughout the morning to cog the wooden water wheel properly.
items.ex_zh: 磨坊修造工忙碌了整个上午，以便给木制水轮装好齿轮。

items.def_zh: 给…安装防滑垫或系缆角柱
items.def_en: to secure or reinforce something with cleats or projecting brackets
items.ex_en: The shipwright cleated the upper deck beam to secure the heavy rigging.
items.ex_zh: 造船匠在上层甲板梁上加装系缆夹板，以固定重型索具。

groups.summary_en: Pertains to specialized mechanical assembly or protective shoeing, specifically mounting shoes on hooves or providing gears/teeth to industrial machinery.
groups.summary_zh: 为机械传动装置安装齿齿构件，或为牲畜钉装马蹄铁。
groups.desc_en: Specifies attaching or machining specialized hardware components (shoes, teeth, flanges, cleats) onto surfaces or mechanisms to enable traction, drive transmission, or structural stability.
groups.desc_zh: 指在构件或蹄部装设专用五金附件（如蹄铁、齿牙、法兰、凸榫），以实现防滑抓地、机械传动或定位支撑功能。
groups.nuance_en: shoe: fit a protective metal plate onto the hoof of an animal (horse / hoof / mule) · cog: furnish a wheel or timber with projecting teeth or notches to engage a drive (wheel / gear / joint) · toothe: cut or form serrated, interlocking projections along an edge (saw / gear / edge) · flange: equip an object with a projecting rim or collar for strength or attachment (pipe / wheel / rail) · cleat: secure with or attach gripping studs or mooring cleats onto a surface (sole / deck / beam)
groups.nuance_zh: shoe: 为马匹等役畜钉装保护性蹄铁 (horse / hoof / mule) · cog: 为轮体或木件装设嵌齿以供传动啮合 (wheel / gear / joint) · toothe: 在边缘加工出用于啮合或切割的锯齿 (saw / gear / edge) · flange: 装配凸缘或法兰盘以供紧固连接 (pipe / wheel / rail) · cleat: 安装防滑防冲的抓地鞋钉或系缆防滑夹 (sole / deck / beam)

groups.name: Flatter & Ingratiate · 讨好与逢迎 (Curry Favor, Ingratiate, Brown-nose)
groups.tip: 说好话巴结讨好以获取利益

items.def_en: To make deliberate, focused efforts to win someone's favor, support, or friendship
items.ex_en: The ambitious diplomat sought constantly to court the prince with lavish literary praise.
items.ex_zh: 雄心勃勃的外交官不断用奢华的文学颂词刻意迎合这位王子。

items.def_en: (+ to) To insinuate oneself into someone's friendship or favor for self-serving reasons
items.ex_en: He tried to cozy up to the director just before the promotions.
items.ex_zh: 就在晋升前夕，他试图巴结主管以谋取私利。

items.def_en: To lavish excessive praise and kindness on someone prior to asking for a favor
items.ex_en: She decided to butter up her supervisor before asking for extra vacation.
items.ex_zh: 在提出休假要求之前，她决定先好好奉承一下主管。

items.def_en: To flatter or behave obsequiously toward superiors to secure advancement or approval
items.ex_en: Nobody respected him because he would blatantly brown-nose the executives for promotions.
items.ex_zh: 没人尊重他，因为他总是为了升职明目张胆地拍高管的马屁。

items.def_zh: 讨好，巴结（常用于 curry favour）；梳刷（马匹）；用咖喱烹调
items.def_en: 1. (in curry favour) To try to win someone's approval or praise through flattery. 2. To brush and clean the coat of a horse.
items.ex_en: The ambitious junior official sought to curry favour with the royal court.
items.ex_zh: 那位野心勃勃的年轻官员试图讨好朝廷以获取恩宠。

items.def_en: (+ oneself with) To deliberately bring oneself into another's favor through charm or flattery
items.ex_en: He took every opportunity to ingratiate himself with the influential managing partner.
items.ex_zh: 他抓住一切机会去巴结讨好那位有权有势的管理合伙人。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe calculated efforts to gain another person's goodwill, acceptance, or approval through intentional charm, compliance, or targeted flattery. They center on the strategic cultivation of liking rather than mere spontaneous praise.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重出于策略目的蓄意笼络、迎合他人，以博得好感与赏识。
groups.desc_en: Describes calculated efforts to win favor, patronage, or advantage from a superior through sweet talk or submissive attentiveness, contrasting with sincere friendship by strategic sycophancy.
groups.desc_zh: 指为了谋取私利或庇护，精明算计地通过甜言蜜语或殷勤侍奉来讨好上位者，与真诚结交相对，带有明显的功利性与阿谀性。
groups.nuance_en: curry: consciously seek to gain another's favor through persistent calculated obsequiousness (favor / grace) · ingratiate: systematically establish oneself in the good graces of someone (oneself with the boss / host) · butter up: lavish someone with praise and compliments to soften them up before a request (boss / parents / teacher) · court: solicit the approval, alliance, or favor of an influential entity (donors / voters / favor) · brown-nose: vulgarly fawn over authority figures for self-advancement (supervisor / teacher / executive)
groups.nuance_zh: curry: 处心积虑地竭力讨好以博取欢心 (favor / grace) · ingratiate: 逢迎巴结以使自己获得上位者好感 (oneself with the boss / host) · butter up: 巧言令色拍马屁以铺垫后续要求 (boss / parents / teacher) · court: 刻意招揽、献殷勤以争取选票或资助 (donors / voters / favor) · brown-nose: 毫无自尊地对领导溜须拍马 (supervisor / teacher / executive)

groups.name: Flatter & Ingratiate · 谄媚与卑躬屈膝 (Fawn, Grovel, Truckle)
groups.tip: 奴颜婢膝谄媚奉承，摇尾乞怜讨好权贵

items.def_en: (+ to) To deliberately flatter or please someone in authority to gain favor
items.ex_en: Stop trying to suck up to the boss; it won't help.
items.ex_zh: 别再试图拍老板马屁了；这根本没有用。

items.def_en: (+ to) To act sycophantically toward someone important to gain personal advantage
items.ex_en: He refused to toady to the corrupt oligarch to secure his career.
items.ex_zh: 他拒绝向那位腐败的寡头献媚以换取自己的仕途。

items.def_en: (+ to) To submit obsequiously or act subserviently to someone's wishes
items.ex_en: The proud scholar vowed never to truckle to the tyrannical censor's demands.
items.ex_zh: 傲骨嶙峋的学者发誓绝不屈从于专横审查官的要求。

items.def_zh: 谄媚，阿谀奉承；（狗等）摇尾乞怜
items.def_en: (+ on/over) To praise and be overly attentive to someone in a servile, flattering way to gain favor.
items.ex_en: Greedy courtiers continued to fawn over the wealthy monarch for royal favors.
items.ex_zh: 贪婪的朝臣们继续向富有的君主阿谀奉承，以求得皇室恩赐。

items.def_en: (+ to) To act in an excessively subservient or deferential manner toward authority
items.ex_en: The minister refused to kowtow to foreign powers during the tense negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 在紧张的谈判中，该部长拒绝向外国势力唯命是从。

items.def_en: To behave in an excessively humble, demeaning way to gain forgiveness or favor
items.ex_en: He was forced to grovel before the tribunal to avoid severe punishment.
items.ex_zh: 他被迫在法庭前卑躬屈膝，以避免严厉的惩罚。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses acts of obsequious, servile deference where an actor demeans themselves through excessive praise or servility to win favor from a superior. Verbs differ in posture, ranging from adoring sycophancy to complete self-abasement.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过过分夸赞或卑屈姿态讨好掌权者，带有鲜明的谄媚低贱色彩。
groups.desc_en: Covers abject, servile self-degradation before power or authority to appease or court favor, contrasting with normal deference by the complete surrender of personal dignity.
groups.desc_zh: 指在权贵面前极尽卑躬屈膝、自贬自贱之能事以求苟安或获宠，与正当礼貌尊重的区别在于其彻底丧失了人格尊严。
groups.nuance_en: fawn: display exaggerated affection or subservience like a groveling dog (over royalty / over the rich / upon superiors) · grovel: degrade oneself by begging servilely or lying prostrate in fear or apology (at feet / for forgiveness / before masters) · kowtow: bow down excessively or act in a slavishly compliant manner (to demands / to authority / to dictators) · truckle: yield servilely and submissively to the will of an overbearing authority (to power / to superiors) · toady: behave like a fawning sycophant for petty advantages (to officials / to the rich)
groups.nuance_zh: fawn: 摇尾乞怜般对权贵阿谀奉承 (over royalty / over the rich / upon superiors) · grovel: 卑躬屈膝地匍匐哀求或认罪 (at feet / for forgiveness / before masters) · kowtow: 奴颜婢膝地向权威屈服磕头 (to demands / to authority / to dictators) · truckle: 毫无骨气地屈从于强权 (to power / to superiors) · toady: 充当马屁精拍马逢迎 (to officials / to the rich)

groups.name: Flatter & Tout · 吹捧与兜售 (Plug, Hype, Tout)
groups.tip: 充当托儿做托儿吹嘘，极力吆喝推销

items.def_en: To promote or mention a product, book, or service publicly to increase popularity
items.ex_en: The talk show host took a moment to plug his latest autobiography.
items.ex_zh: 脱口秀主持人借机为自己的最新自传做了下宣传。

items.def_en: To describe something in a very positive or glowing light to make people admire it
items.ex_en: The company talked up the new phone, but users found it quite ordinary.
items.ex_zh: 公司对那款新手机大加吹捧，但用户发现它其实平平无奇。

items.def_en: To publicize or stimulate interest in something through extravagant, exaggerated claims
items.ex_en: Marketers worked tirelessly to hype the upcoming smartphone before its global launch.
items.ex_zh: 营销人员在即将全球发售前不知疲倦地炒作这款智能手机。

items.def_en: To lavishly praise a book, performance, or commodity beyond what is deserved
items.ex_en: The literary magazine continued to puff the editor's poorly written debut novel.
items.ex_zh: 那本文学杂志继续吹捧主编那部写得极差的处女作小说。

items.def_en: To praise or publicize something insistently to persuade others of its exceptional value
items.ex_en: Brokers continue to tout the questionable stock as a guaranteed golden opportunity.
items.ex_zh: 经纪人们继续大力吹捧这只可疑的股票，称其为绝佳良机。

items.def_zh: 充当托儿，为……做托儿吹嘘（公开推销以蒙骗他人）
items.def_en: (+ for) (especially North American informal) To act as a decoy or publicly praise and promote something in which one has a hidden dishonest interest.
items.ex_en: Investigators caught the influencer attempting to shill for an unregulated crypto token.
items.ex_zh: 调查人员抓到该网红试图为一种不受监管的加密代币充当托儿。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers communicative acts aimed at aggressively promoting, puffing up, or shilling for a product, idea, or individual. The intent ranges from commercially calculated touting to extravagant and often disingenuous public boosting.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重为谋求利益而对人、商品或观点进行大肆宣传、推销与吹嘘。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on aggressively publicizing, overstating, or commercially pushing a person, product, or cause, contrasting with objective information dissemination by its promotional partiality.
groups.desc_zh: 指带有商业偏向或功利目的大肆宣传、吹嘘或推销人、商品与主张，与客观陈述的区别在于其夸大其词的叫卖与炒作倾向。
groups.nuance_en: tout: boastfully praise and solicit business or customers for a product or person (benefits / credentials / wares) · hype: promote extravagantly and sensationally to generate artificial excitement (product / movie / stock) · plug: give a favorable public mention to a product within another media context (book / single / sponsor) · puff: inflate the merits of something through uncritical, exaggerated praise (review / resume / performance) · shill: act as an accomplice or deceptive booster pretending to be an enthusiastic customer (crypto / scam / product) · talk up: speak enthusiastically about something to raise its perceived value (prospects / economy / candidate)
groups.nuance_zh: tout: 竭力叫卖、吹嘘推荐以招徕客户 (benefits / credentials / wares) · hype: 铺天盖地大肆炒作以制造轰动 (product / movie / stock) · plug: 在节目或公开场合顺带植入宣传 (book / single / sponsor) · puff: 毫无原则地捧杀、夸大吹捧 (review / resume / performance) · shill: 充当托儿或隐蔽助推者替人叫好 (crypto / scam / product) · talk up: 在言语间极力赞扬以抬高其声势 (prospects / economy / candidate)

groups.name: Flesh Out & Swell · 饱满与填充鼓起 (Plump, Puff Up, Fill Out)
groups.tip: 体积或外表变大凸起

items.def_en: to become larger, rounder, or inflated with air, liquid, or padding
items.ex_en: His bruised ankle began to puff up rapidly after the basketball game.
items.ex_zh: 打完篮球赛后，他扭伤的脚踝迅速肿胀了起来。

items.def_en: to become rounder and heavier in form, losing gauntness or thinness
items.ex_en: After months of healthy eating, his hollow cheeks began to fill out.
items.ex_zh: 经过几个月的健康饮食，他凹陷的脸颊开始变得丰满起来。

items.def_en: to shake or pat soft materials like pillows or feathers so they become full and airy
items.ex_en: She paused to fluff up the down pillows before the guests arrived.
items.ex_zh: 在客人们到达之前，她停下来抖松了羽绒枕头。

items.def_en: to become larger or rounder than normal due to internal pressure, expansion, or accumulation
items.ex_en: Her sprained wrist began to swell dramatically within minutes of the fall.
items.ex_zh: 跌倒后几分钟内，她扭伤的手腕便开始剧烈肿胀。
items.ex2_en: Heavy seasonal downpours will quickly swell local rivers and threaten low-lying residential farms.
items.ex2_zh: 季节性的大暴雨将迅速使当地河流涨水，并威胁低洼的居民农场。

items.def_en: to swell or cause to swell abnormally with fluid or gas
items.ex_en: Excess salt caused his fingers to bloat uncomfortably during the flight.
items.ex_zh: 过量的盐分导致他在飞行途中手指难受地发胀。
items.ex2_en: Eating rich, salty processed snacks will uncomfortably bloat your stomach within hours.
items.ex2_zh: 食用油腻且高盐的加工零食会在几小时内让你的胃难受地发胀。

items.def_zh: （使）鼓起，（使）丰满；重重放下；扑通倒下
items.def_en: 1. (+ up) to make something fuller, rounder, or softer by shaking or patting it, or to become fuller and rounded 2. to drop or put something down heavily or carelessly 3. (+ down) to sit or fall down suddenly and heavily
items.ex_en: She stepped into the guest bedroom to plump the pillows before arrival.
items.ex_zh: 在客人到达前，她走进客房将枕头拍打得蓬松饱满。

groups.summary_en: Pertains to soft objects, body parts, or fabrics becoming comfortably rounded, volumized, full, or puffed up through shaking, hydration, weight gain, or stuffing.
groups.summary_zh: 指靠抖松、充气、长肉或补水使物体或身体部位变得丰满、膨松或软乎。
groups.desc_en: Denotes expanding in volume, soft thickness, or roundness to appear healthy or distended, distinct from plain linear growing or scaling.
groups.desc_zh: 指在体积、厚度或圆润度上向外充盈或膨胀以显饱满或鼓胀，区别于单纯的尺寸变大或线性增长。
groups.nuance_en: plump: shake or fatten into pleasing roundness (cushions / cheeks) · puff up: inflate with air or swell with pride/allergy (eyes / chest) · fluff up: shake soft items to restore loft (pillows / feathers) · fill out: gain healthy weight or detail (figure / sketch) · swell: expand from fluid, pressure, or emotion (ankle / ranks) · bloat: unpleasantly distend with excess gas or fluid (stomach / budget)
groups.nuance_zh: plump: 拍松或使丰满圆润 (cushions / cheeks) · puff up: 充气膨起或因过敏/自豪鼓起 (eyes / chest) · fluff up: 抖松羽绒织物以恢复蓬松 (pillows / feathers) · fill out: 身体长丰满或内容变充实 (figure / sketch) · swell: 因积液、受压或情绪而肿胀增大 (ankle / ranks) · bloat: 不自然地气胀或水肿浮肿 (stomach / budget)

groups.name: Flip & Toss · 翻动与抛掷 (Toss, Flick, Whisk)
groups.tip: 轻巧向上翻面或顺手抛掷

items.def_en: Turn something so that the side that was underneath is now facing upwards
items.ex_en: Flip the steak over after two minutes to ensure it cooks evenly.
items.ex_zh: 两分钟后将牛排翻个面，以确保受热均匀。
items.ex2_en: The speeding race car lost traction and flipped over into the muddy ditch.
items.ex2_zh: 超速的赛车失去牵引力，翻倒进了泥泞的沟渠中。

items.def_en: Turn round and round rapidly, or cause a flat object to rotate and flip
items.ex_en: He can spin a silver coin across the smooth mahogany tabletop effortlessly.
items.ex_zh: 他能毫不费力地在光滑的红木桌面上转动一枚银币。
items.ex2_en: The wooden top began to spin smoothly across the freshly waxed hardwood floor.
items.ex2_zh: 木质陀螺开始在刚打过蜡的硬木地板上平稳地旋转起来。

items.def_zh: 轻抛，翻动；迅速翻转；轻击
items.def_en: 1. To turn over quickly, or to throw something with a quick, light movement so that it turns over in the air. 2. To flick or strike something lightly with a quick motion.
items.ex_en: The chef managed to flip the thin pancake cleanly in the air.
items.ex_zh: 厨师成功地在空中利落地将那张薄煎饼翻了个面。
items.ex2_en: The coin flipped rapidly through the air before landing on the dusty floor.
items.ex2_zh: 硬币在空中快速翻转，随后掉落在了满是灰尘的地板上。

items.def_en: Throw lightly or casually, or gently turn food ingredients over to mix them
items.ex_en: He decided to toss the fresh greens with olive oil and vinegar.
items.ex_zh: 他决定用橄榄油和醋轻轻翻拌这些新鲜的蔬菜。

items.def_en: Move or propel something with a sudden, quick, light snap of the wrist or fingers
items.ex_en: With a deft motion, she flicked the dead bug off the windowsill.
items.ex_zh: 她手腕轻轻一弹，把死虫子从窗台上弹飞了。

items.def_en: Throw or fling something with a deliberate, targeted forward motion
items.ex_en: The boy managed to pitch the heavy stone straight into the river.
items.ex_zh: 男孩设法将那块沉重的石头径直抛进了河里。

groups.summary_en: Expresses quick, light manipulative actions that cause an object to turn over, invert, or sail briefly into the air with a flicking wrist movement.
groups.summary_zh: 指用敏捷轻快的手部或手腕动作使物体在空中翻转或翻面。
groups.desc_en: Denotes imparting quick, rotational, or casual ballistic motion through the air, contrasting with deliberate placing or forceful straight throwing.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过翻转、轻弹或随手抛掷赋予物体旋转或空中的轻快运动，区别于规整放置或蓄力直线投掷。
groups.nuance_en: flip: snap over with a quick rotational flick (coin / pancake) · toss: throw lightly, casually, or upward (salad / ball / coin) · flick: snap away with a light, sharp finger/wrist motion (switch / ash) · spin: rotate rapidly around an axis (wheel / top) · pitch: throw with aimed force or rock back and forth (baseball / ship)
groups.nuance_zh: flip: 快速翻转或弹起 (coin / pancake) · toss: 随手轻抛或向上掷出 (salad / ball / coin) · flick: 弹动手指或手腕轻甩 (switch / ash) · spin: 使绕轴高速旋转 (wheel / top) · pitch: 用力定向投掷或颠簸颠动 (baseball / ship)

groups.name: Float & Buoy · 漂浮与浮载 (Buoy, Bob, Suspend)
groups.tip: 浮在水面或空中随波逐流

items.def_en: To maintain buoyancy and remain on top of water without sinking
items.ex_en: Tired swimmers struggled desperately to stay afloat until the rescue boat arrived.
items.ex_zh: 筋疲力尽的游泳者竭力保持漂浮，直到救援船赶到。

items.def_en: To move up and down quickly and lightly while resting on the surface of water
items.ex_en: Several brightly colored buoys bob gently on the surface of the harbor.
items.ex_zh: 几个色彩鲜艳的浮标在港口水面上轻轻地上下晃荡。
items.ex2_en: The curious child liked to bob the rubber toy up and down underwater.
items.ex2_zh: 那个好奇的孩子喜欢将橡胶玩具在水下上下颠动玩耍。

items.def_zh: 漂浮，浮动；提出（建议或计划）；（使公司股票）上市
items.def_en: 1. To stay or move on the surface of a liquid without sinking, or drift gently through the air. 2. To suggest an idea, plan, or question for consideration. 3. To issue shares of a company on the stock market.
items.ex_en: Dry autumn leaves float gracefully down the quiet surface of the stream.
items.ex_zh: 干枯的秋叶在静谧的溪流表面优雅地漂浮而下。
items.ex2_en: The children float small wooden toy boats across the calm garden pond every afternoon.
items.ex2_zh: 孩子们每天下午都会把小木头玩具船漂在平静的花园池塘上。

items.def_en: To hold a substance or particle floating evenly throughout a fluid or gas
items.ex_en: Tiny chemical catalysts remain suspended throughout the liquid solution during the reaction.
items.ex_zh: 微小的化学催化剂在反应过程中均匀地悬浮在液体溶液中。

items.def_en: To stay suspended in one place in the air, neither rising nor falling
items.ex_en: Dense morning fog seemed to hover motionless over the damp forest floor.
items.ex_zh: 浓重的晨雾似乎一动不动地悬停在潮湿的林地上空。

items.def_en: (often + up) To keep someone or something afloat on a liquid surface
items.ex_en: The life jacket helped buoy the exhausted swimmer until help finally came.
items.ex_zh: 救生衣托住了精疲力竭的游泳者，直到救援最终到来。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe being physically supported by the buoyancy of water or air without sinking. They contrast buoyant stillness, rhythmic surface bobbing, and suspension.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体因浮力作用停留在水面或空中不沉，或轻快晃荡。
groups.desc_en: Denotes remaining suspended without sinking on or within a fluid or air medium, contrasting with resting on a solid base or plunging.
groups.desc_zh: 指在液体表面、水体中或空气中浮托不沉，区别于实底支撑或下沉坠落。
groups.nuance_en: float: stay sustained on liquid or drift in air (leaves / clouds) · bob: bounce gently up and down on water (cork / boat) · buoy: keep aloft or uplift emotionally/financially (spirits / economy) · suspend: hang motionlessly within a medium (particles / droplet) · hover: remain poised in one airborne spot (helicopter / hawk)
groups.nuance_zh: float: 漂浮于液面或在空气中漂移 (leaves / clouds) · bob: 随波上下轻晃轻浮 (cork / boat) · buoy: 浮托起来或在精神/经济上支撑振奋 (spirits / economy) · suspend: 悬浮停滞于介质之中 (particles / droplet) · hover: 在空中定点盘旋悬停 (helicopter / hawk)

groups.name: Forage & Harvest Wild Food · 野外采集与收获 (Forage, Gather, Glean)
groups.tip: 采收坚果农作物归仓

items.def_en: To search for and pick wild plants, berries, or mushrooms to use as food
items.ex_en: Villagers head into the damp autumn forest to gather wild edible mushrooms.
items.ex_zh: 村民们走进潮湿的秋季森林，采摘野生可食用蘑菇。
items.ex2_en: A curious crowd began to gather slowly outside the locked embassy gates yesterday morning.
items.ex2_zh: 昨天上午，一群好奇的人群开始缓缓聚集在紧闭的大使馆大门外。

items.def_en: To gather or look for edible nuts.
items.ex_en: Local children love to nut in the hazel groves during late autumn.
items.ex_zh: 当地的孩子们喜欢在深秋时节去榛树林里采摘坚果。

items.def_en: To go searching for and gathering wild berries
items.ex_en: We used to berry along the edge of the woods every August.
items.ex_zh: 过去每逢八月，我们总去树林边缘采摘野生浆果。

items.def_zh: 搜寻（食物等）；漫山遍野地觅食
items.def_en: (+ for) To search widely across an area for wild food or provisions
items.ex_en: Hungry deer forage for fresh shoots under the heavy blanket of snow.
items.ex_zh: 饥饿的鹿在厚厚的积雪下四处觅食新鲜的嫩芽。

items.def_en: To collect leftover grain or produce from a field after the main harvest has been gathered
items.ex_en: Poor peasant women would glean the fields after the reapers had departed.
items.ex_zh: 在收割者离开后，贫困的农妇们会在田间捡拾落穗。

items.def_zh: 寻觅残羹剩饭；翻找可用之物
items.def_en: To search through discarded materials or wild areas for usable food or items
items.ex_en: Crows scavenge for edible scraps among the roadside refuse bins every morning.
items.ex_zh: 乌鸦每天早晨在路边的垃圾箱中搜寻残羹剩饭。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to searching for and collecting wild, uncultivated, or residual food and natural resources from the land. While commercial harvesting focuses on cultivated crops, these terms emphasize roaming, scrounging, or gathering scattered natural bounty.
groups.summary_zh: 指在野外或田间寻觅、采摘与收集天然食物或残存作物的动作。
groups.desc_en: Denotes searching natural habitats to harvest edible wild flora and fauna, differing from structured agricultural farming.
groups.desc_zh: 指在野外自然生境中搜寻采撷野生动植物食用资源，区别于正规农事耕作。
groups.nuance_en: forage: roam widely seeking wild edible provisions (mushrooms / berries / herbs) · gather: pluck and collect dispersed natural goods (firewood / nuts) · glean: painstakingly collect leftover crops or scattered facts (grain / information) · scavenge: search through discarded organic matter for scraps (carcass / food)
groups.nuance_zh: forage: 四处搜寻野生食材与药草 (mushrooms / berries / herbs) · gather: 采摘拾取分散的自然产物 (firewood / nuts) · glean: 拾捡遗落的庄稼残穗或散碎信息 (grain / information) · scavenge: 在残羹弃物或尸体中翻找觅食 (carcass / food)

groups.name: Forage & Scavenge · 觅食与搜寻 (Forage, Rummage, Comb)
groups.tip: 在野外搜寻食物或腐肉残渣

items.def_en: (+ in/for) To dig into or search through a container or pile of objects by turning things over
items.ex_en: I watched him root around in his messy backpack for his keys.
items.ex_zh: 我看着他在凌乱的双肩包里到处翻找钥匙。

items.def_en: (+ for) To search widely across an area for food or provisions
items.ex_en: Wild hogs forage for acorns and roots along the damp forest floor.
items.ex_zh: 野猪沿着潮湿的林地地面四处搜寻橡子和草根。

items.def_en: To find or discover something hidden or lost through persistent searching and digging
items.ex_en: The determined reporter managed to ferret out the truth behind the scandal.
items.ex_zh: 这位意志坚定的记者成功查明了这起丑闻背后的真相。

items.def_en: (+ for) To search an area or set of items extremely thoroughly in order to find something
items.ex_en: Search parties comb the dense valley for any sign of missing hikers.
items.ex_zh: 搜救队彻底梳理茂密的山谷，寻找失踪徒步者的任何踪迹。

items.def_zh: （在垃圾中）搜寻（有用物或食物）；以（腐肉等）为食；打扫
items.def_en: 1. To search through discarded waste, garbage, or carcasses for food or usable items. 2. (of an animal) To feed on carrion or decaying organic matter. 3. To clean or clear away.
items.ex_en: Hungry stray dogs scavenge through the dumpster behind the restaurant for scraps.
items.ex_zh: 饥饿的流浪狗在餐馆后面的垃圾桶里翻找残羹剩饭。

items.def_en: (+ through) To search for something by moving things around in an untidy and hurried way
items.ex_en: She began to rummage through the crowded closet looking for winter boots.
items.ex_zh: 她开始在拥挤的衣柜里胡乱翻寻冬天的靴子。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on hunting, rummaging, or sifting through an environment or discarded materials to find food, resources, or salvageable items. It ranges from natural animal feeding behaviors to human sorting through refuse.
groups.summary_zh: 在环境或废弃物中到处搜检、探寻食物或有用物资。
groups.desc_en: Denotes thoroughly rummaging, poking, or filtering through messy spaces to uncover obscure items, contrasting with passive scanning or systematic audits.
groups.desc_zh: 指在杂乱杂物或隐秘处翻弄搜寻以找出隐藏之物，区别于静态扫视或规范审计。
groups.nuance_en: scavenge: forage among detritus or refuse for reusable scrap (food / metal) · rummage: search untidily by turning things over (drawers / attic) · comb: systematically sweep through every inch of an area (beach / records) · ferret out: relentlessly uncover something deeply hidden (truth / secret) · root around: poke through clutter inquisitively (closet / bag)
groups.nuance_zh: scavenge: 在废墟垃圾中翻找可利用之物 (food / metal) · rummage: 乱翻抽屉或杂物堆寻找 (drawers / attic) · comb: 地毯式细致搜查梳理 (beach / records) · ferret out: 坚持不懈地搜寻查明隐秘 (truth / secret) · root around: 翻箱倒柜胡乱扒拉搜找 (closet / bag)

groups.name: Forage & Wild Gathering · 野外采摘与捕捞 (Forage, Shrimp, Blackberry)
groups.tip: 野外搜寻鱼类或果实

items.def_en: to gather wild berries
items.ex_en: Every summer the family would berry in the nearby mountain hills.
items.ex_zh: 每年夏天，这家人都会去附近的山丘上采摘野生浆果。

items.def_en: to gather wild mushrooms in the countryside
items.ex_en: They often mushroom in the moist pine woods after heavy autumn rains.
items.ex_zh: 秋季大雨过后，他们经常去潮湿的松树林里采蘑菇。

items.def_en: To fish for or catch shrimp.
items.ex_en: Coastal fishermen head out early at low tide to shrimp the shallows.
items.ex_zh: 沿海渔民在退潮时清早出海，在浅滩处捕捞小虾。

items.def_en: To go out picking or gathering wild blackberries.
items.ex_en: The children went to blackberry along the old stone canal this afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们今天下午顺着古老的石头运河去采摘野黑莓了。

items.def_en: to dig for or gather clams in tidal sands or mudflats
items.ex_en: Local villagers often clam along the muddy coastal shores at low tide.
items.ex_zh: 退潮时，当地村民经常沿着泥泞的海岸边挖蛤蜊。

items.def_zh: 搜寻野味；采集野食（菌菇、野草等）
items.def_en: (+ for) to search widely in the wild for wild food supplies or provisions
items.ex_en: Every autumn, the villagers forage for wild mushrooms in the damp birch woods.
items.ex_zh: 每年秋天，村民们都会在潮湿的桦树林里搜寻野生菌菇。

groups.summary_en: This scenario denotes going into nature specifically to seek, gather, or catch particular wild edibles, berries, or small aquatic fauna through recreational or artisanal forays.
groups.summary_zh: 指前往野外采摘特定野果或徒手捕捞小型水产的野趣劳动。
groups.desc_en: Denotes zeroing in on specific wild food species in their native terrain using target-specific harvesting activities, contrasting with generic foraging.
groups.desc_zh: 指在特定野外水陆环境中针对某种物种展开专门采摘或捕捞，区别于宽泛的粗放觅食。
groups.nuance_en: mushroom: hunt and pick wild fungi in woods (chanterelles / woods) · berry: search for and pick edible small fruits (brambles / hills) · clam: dig in tidal mudflats for bivalves (tide / beach) · shrimp: net small crustaceans in coastal shallows (waters / bay) · forage: search broadly for varied edible wild plants (forest / shoreline)
groups.nuance_zh: mushroom: 进山林采摘野生蕈类 (chanterelles / woods) · berry: 在灌木荒野采集野浆果 (brambles / hills) · clam: 在退潮滩涂挖蛤蜊 (tide / beach) · shrimp: 在浅海或滩涂捞小虾 (waters / bay) · forage: 漫游采集多种野生动植物 (forest / shoreline)

groups.name: Force & Coerce · 强迫与胁迫 (Coerce, Compel, Intimidate, Press-gang)
groups.tip: 运用威胁逼迫对方服从命令

items.def_en: Frighten someone purposefully into doing or avoiding a particular course of action
items.ex_en: The thugs attempted to intimidate the key witness into withdrawing her testimony.
items.ex_zh: 暴徒们企图恐吓关键证人，迫使她撤回证词。

items.def_en: Force someone to do something through overriding authority or inescapable circumstance
items.ex_en: Severe economic hardship compelled the council to suspend the construction project indefinitely.
items.ex_zh: 严峻的经济困境迫使市政厅无限期暂停该建设计划。

items.def_en: Force someone to act by threatening to reveal damaging or compromising secrets
items.ex_en: The hacker threatened to blackmail the executive with leaked private correspondence.
items.ex_zh: 黑客威胁要利用泄露的私人信件来勒索这位高管。

items.def_en: Use physical force, bullying, or aggressive pressure to compel compliance
items.ex_en: The landlord tried to strong-arm the tenants into accepting an illegal rent hike.
items.ex_zh: 房东试图动用强硬手段逼迫租客接受非法的租金上涨。

items.def_en: to force someone to do something by using threats or other unpleasant methods
items.ex_en: The defendant claimed corrupt officers coerced him into signing the false confession.
items.ex_zh: 被告声称腐败的警官胁迫他签署了这份虚假的供词。

items.def_en: Bully or intimidate someone with harsh words and arrogant manners into submission
items.ex_en: The aggressive prosecutor attempted to browbeat the nervous defendant into an admission.
items.ex_zh: 咄咄逼人的检察官企图以盛气凌人的态度威逼紧张的被告认罪。

groups.summary_en: These verbs describe overriding another party's will through intimidation, severe duress, threats, or institutional force to compel action.
groups.summary_zh: 指借助暴力、威胁、恐吓或严厉压力迫使对方屈从行事。
groups.desc_en: Denotes compelling involuntary compliance through threats, physical dominance, or overbearing pressure, contrasting with persuasive reasoning.
groups.desc_zh: 指凭借武力、威吓或不对等权势强行迫使他人就范，区别于说服或正当命令。
groups.nuance_en: coerce: force compliance via threats, leverage, or intimidation (confession / witness) · compel: force someone to act through overwhelming moral/legal necessity or strength (obedience / respect) · intimidate: frighten someone into submission (rival / jury) · browbeat: bully loudly and overbearingly into doing something (staff / witness) · strong-arm: apply heavy physical or political force bluntly (opponents / legislators)
groups.nuance_zh: coerce: 施加威胁或筹码强行逼迫 (confession / witness) · compel: 凭借法理、道义或压倒性力量迫使 (obedience / respect) · intimidate: 恫吓威慑令人生畏退缩 (rival / jury) · browbeat: 盛气凌人、吹胡子瞪眼地呵斥威逼 (staff / witness) · strong-arm: 动用蛮力或政治手腕强硬施压 (opponents / legislators)

groups.name: Formal Assent & Approval · 同意与赞许 (Accede, Acquiesce, Sanction)
groups.tip: 从被动准许到主动赞同认可

items.def_en: (+ in/to) Accept something reluctantly but without protest; give passive assent
items.ex_en: Reluctant to prolong the dispute, the committee finally acquiesced in the chairman's proposal.
items.ex_zh: 委员会不愿让争端持续下去，最终默许了主席的提议。

items.def_en: Give official or final approval to a document, plan, or decision
items.ex_en: The executive director refused to sign off on the proposed budget adjustments.
items.ex_zh: 执行主管拒绝签字批准拟议的预算调整方案。

items.def_en: (+ to) To give permission or agree to do something, especially after consideration.
items.ex_en: The board formally consented to the proposed merger after reviewing the financial audit.
items.ex_zh: 在审查财务审计报告后，董事会正式同意了拟议的合并方案。

items.def_en: Declare public or official approval and support for an idea, policy, or candidate
items.ex_en: The medical association chose to formally endorse the government's new healthcare initiative.
items.ex_zh: 该医学协会选择正式公开支持政府推出的新医疗计划。

items.def_en: (+ to) Agree to a demand, request, or proposal, especially after initial reluctance
items.ex_en: Management ultimately acceded to the workers' demand for safer factory operating conditions.
items.ex_zh: 管理层最终同意了工人们关于改善工厂安全作业条件的诉求。

items.def_en: Give official permission, authorization, or formal approval for an action
items.ex_en: The ethics committee refused to sanction any human trials without further data.
items.ex_zh: 伦理委员会拒绝在没有进一步数据的情况下批准任何人体试验。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote granting permission, officially ratifying a proposal, or yielding agreement along an intensity gradient from passive concurrence to formal authoritative authorization.
groups.summary_zh: 从勉强默认到官方权威授权，表示给予许可、赞同或批准。
groups.desc_en: Denotes granting authoritative approval or grudging consent within an established hierarchy, distinct from enthusiastic voluntary partnering.
groups.desc_zh: 指在层级制或正式程序中给予定夺批准或退让性顺从，区别于热烈的主动结盟协作。
groups.nuance_en: sanction: officially authorize or penalize by legal mandate (plan / action) · sign off on: give formal final approval to pass a stage (budget / design) · endorse: publicly express support or stamp approval (candidate / policy) · accede: yield to a formal demand or take high office (request / treaty) · acquiesce: reluctantly accept without protest (demands / decision)
groups.nuance_zh: sanction: 官方正式批准认可 (plan / action) · sign off on: 签字画押完成终审验收 (budget / design) · endorse: 公开背书支持 (candidate / policy) · accede: 勉强答应请求或正式签署入约 (request / treaty) · acquiesce: 默不作声地顺从妥协 (demands / decision)

groups.name: Fortify & Reinforce · 防护与加固 (Sandbag, Shore Up, Buttress)
groups.tip: 堆垒掩体加固以抵御外力

items.def_en: To support a wall, building, or declining structure by placing wooden or metal props against or under it
items.ex_en: Workers hastily erected timber beams to shore up the crumbling stone wall.
items.ex_zh: 工人们匆忙架起木梁，以支撑那面摇摇欲坠的石墙。

items.def_en: To make a structure, material, or barrier stronger by adding extra materials or supports
items.ex_en: Engineers plan to reinforce the cracked concrete foundation using heavy steel bars.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们计划使用粗钢筋来加固开裂的混凝土基座。

items.def_en: To strengthen, prop, or secure a structure with rigid stays, beams, or supports against heavy strain
items.ex_en: Carpenters braced the sloping barn rafters with thick diagonal struts against heavy snow.
items.ex_zh: 木工们用厚实的斜撑加固了倾斜的谷仓椽木，以抵御积雪负荷。

items.def_en: To reinforce or support a wall or building with a projecting structure of masonry or wood
items.ex_en: Ancient masons constructed massive pillars to buttress the towering cathedral walls.
items.ex_zh: 古代石匠建造了粗壮的柱子来为高耸的教堂墙体提供扶壁支撑。
