items.def_zh: 用沙袋堆砌（防洪或加固）；用沙袋打击；故意隐瞒实力以欺骗
items.def_en: 1. To protect or fortify an area against flood water or attack with sandbags. 2. To hit someone with a sandbag. 3. (informal) To deliberately conceal one's true ability or strength to gain an advantage.
items.ex_en: Volunteers worked through the night to sandbag the riverbank before the crest arrived.
items.ex_zh: 志愿人员彻夜堆砌沙袋加固河堤，以抵御洪峰的到来。

items.def_en: To support or strengthen a wall or building from below with masonry, concrete, or extra foundations
items.ex_en: Specialist contractors had to underpin the historic facade with deep concrete piles.
items.ex_zh: 专业承包商不得不打下深层混凝土桩，从底部加固这座历史建筑的外墙基础。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physically reinforcing, barricading, or propping up structures and perimeters against collapse, natural disasters, or assault. They range from hasty emergency barricading to heavy structural engineering.
groups.summary_zh: 通过沙袋、支柱等物理手段应急加固或防护防线，抵御坍塌与外力冲击。
groups.desc_en: Denotes providing external, structural, or defensive props to prevent collapse or breach, contrasting with building a structure from scratch.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过外部加装支柱、垫基或防护物抵御崩溃侵蚀，区别于从零建造。
groups.nuance_en: shore up: support physically or bolster flagging stability (wall / economy / confidence) · buttress: reinforce with external masonry or supportive evidence (building / argument) · underpin: lay foundational support beneath an existing structure or theory (theory / growth) · brace: prepare and secure firmly against an incoming shock (impact / structure) · sandbag: pile earthbags to halt floodwaters or unfairly barricade (riverbank / defense)
groups.nuance_zh: shore up: 支柱撑住颓势以防坍塌 (wall / economy / confidence) · buttress: 筑扶壁加固或以论据强力支撑 (building / argument) · underpin: 打牢底部地基或从底层支撑论点 (theory / growth) · brace: 装支撑加固以抵御冲击 (impact / structure) · sandbag: 堆砌沙袋防汛或设障阻挡 (riverbank / defense)

groups.name: Freeze & Solidify · 冰冻与冻结 (Freeze, Deep-freeze, Ices up)
groups.tip: 遇冷由液态转为冰晶冻块

items.def_zh: （使）结冰，（使）凝结；冷冻；（使）僵住；冻结（资产等）
items.def_en: 1. to turn into ice or become hard because of cold, or preserve food at very low temperatures. 2. to suddenly stop moving. 3. to officially stop or restrict movement or access to funds.
items.ex_en: The bitter arctic wind caused the small backyard pond to freeze completely solid.
items.ex_zh: 刺骨的北极寒风使得后院的小池塘彻底冻成了坚冰。
items.ex2_en: You can safely freeze fresh seasonal berries to enjoy delicious smoothies throughout the winter.
items.ex2_zh: 你可以把新鲜的时令浆果冷冻起来，以便整个冬天享用美味的奶昔。

items.def_en: to become covered with a layer of ice
items.ex_en: Pilots must monitor the aircraft closely when wings begin to ice up.
items.ex_zh: 当机翼开始结冰时，飞行员必须密切监控飞机状态。
items.ex2_en: Freezing rain and sudden blizzards can rapidly ice up the car windshield within minutes.
items.ex2_zh: 冻雨和突如其来的暴风雪可以在几分钟内让汽车挡风玻璃结满冰霜。

items.def_en: to preserve food by freezing it extremely rapidly at very low temperatures
items.ex_en: The factory uses liquid nitrogen chambers to deep-freeze freshly harvested vegetables.
items.ex_zh: 该工厂使用液氮冷冻室对刚采摘的蔬菜进行深冷速冻。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to become completely covered with an uninterrupted sheet of ice
items.ex_en: The lake usually freezes over by late December.
items.ex_zh: 这个湖通常在十二月下旬完全封冻。
items.ex2_en: Arctic cold snaps often freeze over the broad surface of northern rivers.
items.ex2_zh: 北极寒潮经常将北方河流开阔的水面完全冻结封冻。

items.def_zh: 冻结，因受冻而堵塞/卡死
items.def_en: (+ sth) to become completely obstructed, hardened, or inoperable due to sub-zero temperatures and ice formation
items.ex_en: Whenever she stepped onto the stage, her mind completely froze up.
items.ex_zh: 每当她走上舞台，她的大脑就一片空白、彻底卡壳。

items.def_en: to become coated or covered with a layer of ice as water freezes on the surface
items.ex_en: The mountain lake began to ice over during the first severe frost.
items.ex_zh: 在第一场严重的严霜中，高山湖泊的表面开始结起一层薄冰。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the phase transition of liquids or moisture-laden materials turning into solid ice under sub-zero temperatures. 'Froze' is the irregular past tense of freeze, while additions expand the core lexical set of thermal ice-formation.
groups.summary_zh: 特指液体或含水物体因低温而降至冰点并转变成固态冰的过程。
groups.desc_en: Denotes liquid hardening into ice or mechanisms becoming immovably locked due to severe cold, distinct from generic chemical solidifying.
groups.desc_zh: 指因低温导致液体冻结成冰或机械管线结冰受阻，区别于一般的化学硬化凝固。
groups.nuance_en: freeze: turn liquid to solid through low temperature (water / ground) · freeze over: become completely covered with an ice sheet (lake / river) · ice up: accumulate a perilous crust of ice (wings / windshield) · deep-freeze: preserve at ultra-low sub-zero temperatures (food / embryos) · freeze up: lock up mechanically due to ice or freeze emotionally (pipes / actor)
groups.nuance_zh: freeze: 低温下结冰或冻硬 (water / ground) · freeze over: 水面彻底封冻封盖冰层 (lake / river) · ice up: 表面结覆一层硬冰 (wings / windshield) · deep-freeze: 超低温深冷速冻保存 (food / embryos) · freeze up: 管道因结冰冻裂卡死或临场僵住 (pipes / actor)

groups.name: Frolic & Gambol · 嬉戏与雀跃 (Gambol, Romp, Prance, Rollick)
groups.tip: 欢天喜地地蹦跳撒欢玩耍

items.def_en: To run or jump about playfully, happily, and lightly, like a young animal
items.ex_en: Newborn lambs gambol joyfully across the sunlit meadows during early spring mornings.
items.ex_zh: 初春的清晨，初生的羔羊在洒满阳光的草地上欢快雀跃。

items.def_en: To move around with high, bouncy, exuberant steps, showing off joy or pride
items.ex_en: The spirited stallion began to prance around the open paddock with high steps.
items.ex_zh: 那匹生机勃勃的公马迈着高挑轻快的步伐，在围场里昂首跃步。

items.def_en: To engage in boisterous, noisy, and rough physical play
items.ex_en: The children were told repeatedly to stop horsing around near the fragile antiques.
items.ex_zh: 大人们一再告诫孩子们别在那些易碎古董附近胡闹嬉耍。

items.def_en: To act, move, or frolic in a jovial, spirited, and carefree manner
items.ex_en: Carefree youngsters rollicked through the summer streets, laughing and splashing water on passersby.
items.ex_zh: 无忧无虑的年轻人放纵嬉闹在夏日街头，笑着向路人泼水。

items.def_en: (+ around/in) To play, jump, and run around in a lively, cheerful, carefree way.
items.ex_en: Dolphins regularly frolic in the crystal-clear waters near the coral reef.
items.ex_zh: 海豚经常在珊瑚礁附近清澈透明的海水中欢快嬉戏。

items.def_en: (+ about/around) To play or run in a boisterous, energetic, and loud manner
items.ex_en: Two golden retrievers romped enthusiastically through the muddy autumn leaves in the park.
items.ex_zh: 两只金毛寻回犬在公园里泥泞的秋叶堆中兴奋地打闹嬉戏。

groups.summary_en: This frame depicts lively, lighthearted physical play characterized by leaping, skipping, and exuberant physical abandon. It typically evokes young animals or carefree children moving joyously outdoors.
groups.summary_zh: 描绘人或动物欢快轻盈地蹦跳、嬉闹、打滚等充满活力的嬉戏动作。
groups.desc_en: Denotes lively, carefree, and athletic physical playfulness, contrasting with solemn athletic competition or aggressive fighting.
groups.desc_zh: 指轻松快活、充满活力的身体嬉戏蹦跳，区别于严肃的体育竞技或打斗冲突。
groups.nuance_en: frolic: play about happily, lightly, and innocently (lambs / children) · gambol: run and jump about playfully like young animals (lambs / colts) · romp: play boisterously and energetically (puppy / kids) · prance: spring along with proud, exaggerated steps (horse / performer) · horse around: engage in rough, noisy horseplay (boys / teenagers)
groups.nuance_zh: frolic: 轻松无忧地欢快嬉闹 (lambs / children) · gambol: 如幼兽般雀跃蹦跳奔跑 (lambs / colts) · romp: 喧闹欢腾地打闹嬉戏 (puppy / kids) · prance: 趾高气昂地昂首阔步腾跃 (horse / performer) · horse around: 喧闹粗野地胡闹胡折腾 (boys / teenagers)

groups.name: Frolic & Indulge · 放纵与享乐 (Frolic, Revel, Carouse)
groups.tip: 放任自流或无拘无束玩乐

items.def_en: Enjoy oneself without restraint in a lively, playful way, often in an idyllic setting
items.ex_en: Wealthy patrons disported by the shimmering lake, indulging in leisurely afternoon games.
items.ex_zh: 富有的贵客们在波光粼粼的湖畔尽情游乐，沉醉于悠闲的午后游戏中。

items.def_en: Play and run about happily, lightly, and energetically
items.ex_en: Children frolic joyously under the dancing water spray of the garden sprinkler.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们在花园喷头洒出的跃动水花下欢蹦跳跃。

items.def_en: Abandon usual inhibitions and behave in an unrestrained, wild manner
items.ex_en: After final exams were over, the students headed downtown to cut loose.
items.ex_zh: 期末考试结束后，学生们涌向市中心尽情放纵撒欢。

items.def_en: (+ in) Take immense delight in something, often celebrating in a lively and noisy way
items.ex_en: The championship winners reveled in their unexpected victory long into the night.
items.ex_zh: 冠军得主们整夜沉醉并纵情庆祝他们出人意料的胜利。

items.def_en: (archaic or literary) To behave in a reckless, unrestrained, or playful way.
items.ex_en: Gentle spring breezes wanton among the sweet blossoms of the cherry orchard.
items.ex_zh: 柔和的春风在樱桃园芬芳的花丛中随意嬉戏拂动。

items.def_en: Drink plentiful amounts of alcohol and enjoy oneself in a noisy, lively way
items.ex_en: The boisterous sailors caroused till dawn inside the crowded harbor tavern.
items.ex_zh: 喧闹的水手们在拥挤的港口酒馆里畅饮狂欢直至黎明。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here denote unrestrained celebration, boisterous merrymaking, or giving free rein to sensory indulgences and physical delight without social inhibition.
groups.summary_zh: 指纵情嬉戏、寻欢作乐或毫无拘束地沉溺快活。
groups.desc_en: Denotes casting off inhibitions to indulge in unrestrained sensual or merrymaking pleasure, contrasting with quiet relaxation.
groups.desc_zh: 指抛开世俗禁忌沉溺于无拘无束的纵乐狂欢，区别于清静的日常休整。
groups.nuance_en: revel: take exuberant, noisy delight in pleasure (night / victory) · carouse: drink heavily and party boisterously (all night / taverns) · cut loose: discard restraint and act completely freely (party / weekend) · wanton: indulge without moral restraint or frivolously squander (passions / wealth) · disport: enjoy oneself merrily and visibly outdoors (bathers / court)
groups.nuance_zh: revel: 狂欢尽兴、沉醉于享乐 (night / victory) · carouse: 豪饮狂欢作乐 (all night / taverns) · cut loose: 摆脱束缚彻底放飞自我 (party / weekend) · wanton: 肆无忌惮地放纵纵欲或挥霍 (passions / wealth) · disport: 在户外自得其乐地嬉游展露 (bathers / court)

groups.name: Fuel & Stoke · 刺激与助长火势 (Fuel, Stoke, Fan)
groups.tip: 点燃苗头火上浇油促其剧增

items.def_en: To blow air onto a flame, or make a disagreement, jealousy, or unrest more heated
items.ex_en: Sensational headlines only serve to fan public distrust of the judicial system.
items.ex_zh: 耸人听闻的头条新闻只会煽动公众对司法制度的不信任。

items.def_en: To supply material to keep a fire burning or nourish suspicion, fear, or resentment
items.ex_en: Unsubstantiated internet rumors continue to feed the widespread public anxiety across the city.
items.ex_zh: 未经证实的网络谣言不断助长全城蔓延的公众焦虑情绪。

items.def_zh: 加剧，激起，助长；给……提供燃料
items.def_en: 1. To make an argument, feeling, or situation worse, more intense, or more active. 2. To supply something with fuel.
items.ex_en: Rising food prices are likely to fuel public anger ahead of elections.
items.ex_zh: 食品价格的上涨很可能在选举前进一步激化公众的怒火。

items.def_en: To deliberately excite, provoke, or incite intense emotions or frenzy in a crowd
items.ex_en: The demagogue managed to whip up violent crowd hysteria within minutes.
items.ex_zh: 那个煽动者在几分钟内就成功激起了人群极端的狂热情绪。

items.def_en: To add fuel to a fire, or incite and encourage strong emotional fires and rumors
items.ex_en: Provocative speeches often stoke bitter sectarian divisions within the divided border town.
items.ex_zh: 挑衅性的演说往往会煽起这座边境小镇内部激烈的派系纷争。

items.def_en: To cause feelings of anger, passion, or excitement to become far more violent
items.ex_en: The politician's disparaging remarks served only to inflame preexisting racial tensions.
items.ex_zh: 该政客贬损性的言论只会煽起本已存在的暴烈种族紧张情绪。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on stoking, supplying combustible energy to, or exacerbating a preexisting fire, negative emotion, controversy, or volatile crisis to make it escalate intensely.
groups.summary_zh: 指为火焰、冲突或不良情绪注入动能，使事态进一步恶化或激化。
groups.desc_en: Denotes supplying material, oxygen, or psychological incitement that intensifies an active fire or destructive passion, contrasting with igniting from scratch.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过补充燃料、氧气或挑衅言论使已燃的火势或激烈情绪持续升温加剧，区别于点火初起。
groups.nuance_en: fuel: supply with combustible material or sustain ongoing passion (fire / speculation / anger) · stoke: poke and feed a furnace or vigorously incite feelings (flames / fears / resentment) · fan: blow air to stimulate embers or agitate conflict (embers / tensions / unrest) · inflame: provoke intense, fiery passion, anger, or tissue swelling (passions / crowd / wound) · whip up: deliberately excite a volatile frenzy (enthusiasm / hysteria)
groups.nuance_zh: fuel: 添加燃料以维持或助长火势/猜疑 (fire / speculation / anger) · stoke: 添煤拨火或蓄意激起恐惧怨恨 (flames / fears / resentment) · fan: 扇风助火或煽动矛盾冲突 (embers / tensions / unrest) · inflame: 点燃激情激怒人群或引起发炎 (passions / crowd / wound) · whip up: 刻意煽动激起狂热或恐慌情绪 (enthusiasm / hysteria)

groups.name: Function & Operate · 运行与起效 (Function, Run, Tick)
groups.tip: 机制正常运转发挥作用

items.def_en: to operate properly and perform its intended task without failure
items.ex_en: After installing the replacement motherboard, the desktop computer finally worked as expected.
items.ex_zh: 更换主板后，这台台式电脑终于恢复正常运转了。

items.def_en: to operate continuously, as an engine, machine, or software program
items.ex_en: Engineers kept the backup generator running throughout the prolonged coastal blackout.
items.ex_zh: 在漫长的沿海断电期间，工程师们让备用发电机保持连续运转。
items.ex2_en: The silent desktop computer runs smoothly even while rendering complex three-dimensional architectural models.
items.ex2_zh: 即便在渲染复杂的三维建筑模型时，这台静音台式电脑依然运行顺畅。

items.def_en: (+ as) to perform a specific function, duty, or purpose adequately
items.ex_en: This folded cardboard box can serve as a temporary bed for the kitten.
items.ex_zh: 这个折叠纸箱可以充当小猫的临时小窝。

items.def_en: To work or operate in a proper, expected, or natural way.
items.ex_en: Without a consistent blood supply, the vital human organs cease to function.
items.ex_zh: 如果没有持续的血液供应，人体的重要器官就会停止运转。

items.def_en: to begin to take effect or start functioning automatically
items.ex_en: The automatic sprinkler system should kick in if indoor temperatures exceed thirty degrees.
items.ex_zh: 如果室内温度超过三十度，自动喷淋系统就会开始启动运转。

items.def_en: to function smoothly and steadily, like a clock or biological mechanism
items.ex_en: With proper maintenance, the antique grandfather clock still ticks with flawless precision.
items.ex_zh: 保养得当下，这座老式落地钟依然运作良好且分秒不差。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express that an apparatus, system, or physiological mechanism is working normally, performing its role, or generating its intended operational effect.
groups.summary_zh: 指机器、系统或人体机能正常运转并产生预期的功效。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an internal mechanism, organ, or system operating as designed to produce its intended utility, contrasting with broken idleness or inert rest.
groups.desc_zh: 指机械、器官或系统正常运转并发挥既定效用，区别于停滞故障或静止休眠。
groups.nuance_en: function: operate properly in its assigned role (organ / brake) · run: be in continuous operational motion (engine / program) · work: produce effective mechanical or utilitarian results (machine / strategy) · tick: keep continuous regular operation like a clock (clock / mind) · kick in: start taking operational effect after an initial delay (drug / backup generator)
groups.nuance_zh: function: 正常发挥特定功能职责 (organ / brake) · run: 持续平稳运转 (engine / program) · work: 机器有效做功或策略起效奏效 (machine / strategy) · tick: 如钟表般规律运转维持活力 (clock / mind) · kick in: 延迟后开始生效起作用 (drug / backup generator)

groups.name: Fund & Finance · 资助与出资 (Fund, Finance, Back)
groups.tip: 投入本金期待回报

items.def_en: To support someone or a project with money, power, or authority
items.ex_en: Several prominent venture capitalists agreed to back the clean energy startup.
items.ex_zh: 几位著名的风险投资家同意为这家清洁能源初创公司提供资金支持。

items.def_en: To provide money for a project, activity, or event
items.ex_en: The philanthropic trust agreed to fund the construction of a regional clinic.
items.ex_zh: 该慈善信托基金同意出资赞助建设一家地区诊所。

items.def_en: To provide the money needed to pay for something substantial or commercial
items.ex_en: Local commercial banks formed a syndicate to finance the massive railway expansion.
items.ex_zh: 当地商业银行组建了银团，为这一庞大的铁路扩建工程筹措资金。

items.def_zh: 投资，投入（资金以求利）；投入（时间、精力等）；授予（权力等）
items.def_en: 1. To put money into bank accounts, shares, businesses, or property in order to obtain a profit. 2. (+ in) To spend time, effort, or energy on something to achieve an advantage. 3. (formal) To give power, rights, or authority to someone.
items.ex_en: The pension fund managers opted to invest heavily in renewable infrastructure projects.
items.ex_zh: 养老金管理人员选择向可再生基础设施项目大举投入资金以求回报。

items.def_zh: 出资赞助，提供赌注/本钱
items.def_en: To provide someone with money or capital for an enterprise, business, or venture
items.ex_en: His wealthy uncle agreed to stake him in his ambitious culinary venture.
items.ex_zh: 他富有的叔父同意出资资助他雄心勃勃的餐饮创业项目。

items.def_en: (informal) To support a person, project, or organization by paying all or most of their expenses
items.ex_en: An anonymous foreign billionaire offered to bankroll the controversial independent film.
items.ex_zh: 一位匿名的外国亿万富翁主动提出为这部备受争议的独立电影提供全部资金支持。

groups.summary_en: Covers providing monetary capital or resources to support projects, ventures, or institutions in return for future returns, ownership, or public benefit.
groups.summary_zh: 指为项目、企业或活动投入资金以支持其运作或获取回报。
groups.desc_en: Denotes providing monetary capital or underwriting to enable ventures, projects, or people to operate, distinct from merely spending or donating pocket cash.
groups.desc_zh: 指投入资金或提供财务兜底以支持企业、项目或事业落地运转，区别于日常零星消费或小额捐赠。
groups.nuance_en: fund: furnish regular capital or cash reserves for a dedicated purpose (research / project) · finance: provide large-scale commercial credit or structured loans (expansion / deal) · bankroll: wholly support an endeavor financially as an affluent patron (campaign / film) · back: give financial or credibility endorsement to a person/venture (startup / candidate) · stake: risk specific money on someone's enterprise or gamble (entrepreneur / gambler)
groups.nuance_zh: fund: 设立专款拨款资助 (research / project) · finance: 通过融资或大额贷款支持 (expansion / deal) · bankroll: 金主全额包办出资 (campaign / film) · back: 给予资金后盾或声誉支持 (startup / candidate) · stake: 下注出资扶持人选以图分润 (entrepreneur / gambler)

groups.name: Fundraise & Solicit · 募捐与筹款 (Fundraise, Solicit, Rally)
groups.tip: 为特定目的公开筹集资金

items.def_en: To quickly stimulate and collect financial backing, donations, or enthusiasm
items.ex_en: The campaign staff managed to whip up ten thousand dollars by midnight.
items.ex_zh: 竞选团队设法在午夜前迅速筹集到了一万美元的捐款。

items.def_en: To fund a project or venture by raising small amounts of money from a large number of people online
items.ex_en: The independent indie studio plans to crowdfund its upcoming fantasy video game.
items.ex_zh: 这家独立工作室计划在网上众筹其即将推出的奇幻电子游戏。

items.def_zh: 大力招揽；筹集（资金或赞助）
items.def_en: To try persistently to obtain funds, business, or backing through promotional efforts
items.ex_en: The young entrepreneur visited local businesses trying to drum up financial support.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻的创业者四处拜访当地企业，竭力招揽赞助和筹集资金。

items.def_en: To circulate a collection container to gather voluntary monetary contributions from a group
items.ex_en: Church ushers quietly passed round a velvet basket to collect Sunday offerings.
items.ex_zh: 教堂执事们悄悄在人群中传递天鹅绒篮子，以募集周日奉献款。

items.def_en: (+ for) To collect or raise money for a charity, organization, or political campaign.
items.ex_en: Volunteers mobilized across town to fundraise for the damaged animal shelter.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者们在全镇动员起来，为受损的动物收容所筹集善款。

items.def_en: (formal) To ask for money, donations, help, or votes from people or organizations
items.ex_en: The charitable foundation dispatched representatives to solicit corporate donations for youth programs.
items.ex_zh: 该慈善基金会派出代表，为青年发展项目向企业征集捐助资金。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame relate to appealing for and gathering monetary contributions, philanthropic aid, or investment funds from donors, institutions, or the general public.
groups.summary_zh: 面向公众或机构发起号召，以募集善款、赞助或启动资金。
groups.desc_en: Denotes actively petitioning networks, crowds, or patrons to gather funds for a public cause or campaign, contrasting with commercial selling or investing.
groups.desc_zh: 指面向公众、群体或金主广泛游说募化资金，区别于商品买卖或股权投资。
groups.nuance_en: fundraise: systematically hold events or campaigns to collect charitable gifts (charity / school) · solicit: directly and explicitly ask for money, votes, or favors (donations / advice) · crowdfund: collect tiny amounts from large online crowds (project / startup) · drum up: energetically agitate to generate support or interest (business / support) · pass round: circulate a collection plate or hat among attendees (hat / collection plate)
groups.nuance_zh: fundraise: 举办有组织的慈善募捐活动 (charity / school) · solicit: 登门或公开恳请赞助施舍 (donations / advice) · crowdfund: 通过网络平台面向大众众筹 (project / startup) · drum up: 大张旗鼓四处招徕拉拢款项或支持 (business / support) · pass round: 在人群中传递募捐箱/帽子收拢零钱 (hat / collection plate)

groups.name: Furnish & Surface-Trim · 蒙面装潢与金银丝点缀
groups.tip: 软装陈设装潢居所

items.def_zh: 重做（家具的）包布与软垫
items.def_en: to replace the padding, springs, and fabric cover of an upholstered seat
items.ex_en: The craftsman took two weeks to completely re-upholster the antique Victorian armchair.
items.ex_zh: 工匠花了整整两周时间彻底重做了这把维多利亚时代老扶手椅的软垫与包布。

items.def_en: to adorn fabric or garments with small shiny metallic or plastic discs
items.ex_en: The designer spent days meticulously sequining the dramatic satin evening gown.
items.ex_zh: 设计师花费数天时间，精心在这袭奢华缎面晚礼服上缀饰亮片。

items.def_en: to cover a surface thinly with gold leaf or gold-coloured pigment
items.ex_en: Master artisans used delicate gold leaf to gild the elaborate palace ceiling.
items.ex_zh: 工艺大师们用纤薄的金箔为这座精美繁复的宫殿天顶贴金点缀。

items.def_zh: 为（沙发、椅子等）装上垫子和面料，装璜
items.def_en: To cover a chair or sofa with padding, springs, and fabric or leather.
items.ex_en: The workshop will upholster the dining chairs in water-resistant navy velvet.
items.ex_zh: 工坊将使用防水的海军蓝天鹅绒面料为这些餐椅装上软垫包布。

items.def_zh: 用金属箔（或金属丝）装饰；使显得俗丽，虚饰
items.def_en: To decorate something with tinsel; to give something a cheap, glittering, or showy appearance.
items.ex_en: Merchants tinsel the dull department store windows to attract impressionable holiday shoppers.
items.ex_zh: 商人们用俗丽的金属箔装饰灰暗的百货橱窗，以吸引容易动心的假日顾客。

items.def_zh: 结彩装饰；以花彩垂挂装饰
items.def_en: (+ with) to drape or adorn a place with hanging strings of flowers, ribbons, or lights
items.ex_en: The garden pavilion was lavishly festooned with fragrant jasmine and paper lanterns.
items.ex_zh: 花园凉亭上奢华地结彩挂满了芬芳的茉莉花串和纸灯笼。

groups.summary_en: Applies surface decorative crafts, specifically upholstering seating furniture with padding and textile, or draping and trimming surfaces with glittery metallic strips.
groups.summary_zh: 为家具包衬软垫布料，或用金属金银丝等细料精心装缀表面。
groups.desc_en: Denotes affixing ornamental fabric, precious metallic foil, or decorative spangles onto plain physical surfaces, distinct from structural construction.
groups.desc_zh: 指在家具或器物表面包覆布料、贴金或挂缀饰品以增添美感，区别于骨架结构的修造。
groups.nuance_en: upholster: cover structural furniture with padding, springs, and decorative fabric (sofas / chairs) · gild: overlay with a thin layer of gold or impart superficial glamor (woodwork / lily) · sequin: adorn with small shiny reflective plastic discs (dress / costume) · festoon: drape lavishly with hanging garlands, chains, or ribbons (hall / tree) · tinsel: decorate with sparkling metallic strips or give cheap glitter to (tree / float)
groups.nuance_zh: upholster: 为家具装设软垫及包蒙布艺 (sofas / chairs) · gild: 贴金箔或外表涂金粉装点 (woodwork / lily) · sequin: 缀以亮片闪片装饰 (dress / costume) · festoon: 用彩带、花环悬垂结彩装点 (hall / tree) · tinsel: 用金银丝金箔条点缀闪烁 (tree / float)

groups.name: Garment Alteration & Seaming · 裁缝修边与改衣 (Hem, Take in, Alter)
groups.tip: 穿针引线缝边锁扣修补

items.def_en: To make changes to clothing so that it fits better
items.ex_en: The seamstress agreed to alter the evening gown before the diplomatic banquet tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 女裁缝同意在明天的外交晚宴前修改这件晚礼服的尺寸。
items.ex2_en: The heavy wool coat alters easily with a few minor seam adjustments today.
items.ex2_zh: 这件厚重的羊毛大衣只需稍作缝线调整即可轻松修改合身。

items.def_en: To make a garment narrower or tighter by resewing the seams
items.ex_en: She had to take in the waist of her favorite trousers after losing weight.
items.ex_zh: 体重减轻后，她不得不把最喜欢的那条裤子的腰围改窄。

items.def_en: To make a garment looser or wider by releasing seam allowances
items.ex_en: The tailor will let out the suit jacket slightly to ensure a comfortable fit.
items.ex_zh: 裁缝会把西装外套稍微放宽一些，以确保穿起来舒适。

items.def_en: To fit or modify a garment precisely to an individual's specific body measurements
items.ex_en: He paid an experienced craftsman to tailor the vintage wool coat to his frame.
items.ex_zh: 他请了一位经验丰富的师傅，根据自己的身材缝改这件复古羊毛大衣。

items.def_en: To make a garment or piece of fabric shorter by cutting or hemming
items.ex_en: She asked the dry cleaner to shorten the curtains so they cleared the floor.
items.ex_zh: 她让干洗店把窗帘改短，以免拖到地面上。
items.ex2_en: These crisp autumn days shorten noticeably as winter approaches the northern mountain regions.
items.ex2_zh: 随着冬季临近北部山区，这些清爽的秋日白昼明显变短了。

items.def_en: 1. To fold over and sew down the edge of a piece of cloth or a garment. 2. (hem in) To surround or restrict someone or something closely.
items.ex_en: My grandmother taught me how to hem the skirt neatly using a blind stitch.
items.ex_zh: 祖母教我如何用暗针法把裙边折缝得整整齐齐。

groups.summary_en: This scenario frame covers specific tailoring actions performed on fabric and garments to adjust fit, shorten lengths, or finish raw borders.
groups.summary_zh: 聚焦缝纫中卷边、改小、缩短等服装边沿剪裁与改样操作。
groups.desc_en: Denotes precisely recutting, taking in, or sewing edges of an existing garment to customize its fit or length, distinct from weaving fabric or initial mass manufacture.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过缝纫对现成成衣进行放宽、收紧、截短或卷边以重整版型，区别于织布或整件成衣的量产原造。
groups.nuance_en: alter: modify the proportions or cut of an existing garment (suit / dress) · take in: narrow the seams to make a loose garment tighter (waist / seams) · let out: undo seams to make a tight garment looser (trousers / seam) · hem: fold over and sew down the raw edge of fabric (curtains / skirt) · shorten: reduce the vertical length of trousers or sleeves (sleeves / pants) · tailor: adjust expertly to conform closely to a specific body's shape (jacket / coat)
groups.nuance_zh: alter: 依照身型对成衣裁剪改版 (suit / dress) · take in: 收紧侧缝以减小围度 (waist / seams) · let out: 拆放缝份以放宽衣物 (trousers / seam) · hem: 折边缝死布料毛边以防脱线 (curtains / skirt) · shorten: 改短袖口或裤长 (sleeves / pants) · tailor: 针对特定体型精裁量身修整 (jacket / coat)

groups.name: Gather & Assemble · 聚集与搜集 (Assemble, Muster, Amass)
groups.tip: 将分散物品归拢一处

items.def_en: To bring things or people together from different places over a period of time
items.ex_en: The botanist spent years traveling the continent to collect rare alpine plant specimens.
items.ex_zh: 这位植物学家花了数年游历这片大陆，以收集稀有的高山植物标本。
items.ex2_en: Stray raindrops collect quietly along the edges of the broad green lotus leaves.
items.ex2_zh: 零星的雨滴静静地聚集在宽大碧绿的荷叶边缘。

items.def_zh: 聚集，集合；收集，采集；逐渐获得；推断
items.def_en: 1. To come together, or bring people or things together in one place. 2. To collect several things, often from different places. 3. To conclude or understand from evidence or information.
items.ex_en: The children quickly gathered colorful autumn leaves fallen beneath the ancient oak tree.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们迅速在古老的橡树下收集起飘落的五彩秋叶。
items.ex2_en: Dark storm clouds gather menacingly above the valley before the heavy afternoon downpour.
items.ex2_zh: 午后大雨倾盆而下之前，乌云在山谷上方阴沉地聚集起来。

items.def_en: To find and bring together scattered people, animals, or items into one location
items.ex_en: The police rounded up several suspects following the robbery.
items.ex_zh: 抢劫案发生后，警方搜捕了几名嫌疑人。

items.def_en: To come together in a single place, or bring people or parts together into a cohesive group
items.ex_en: The committee convened to assemble delegates from every participating regional district this morning.
items.ex_zh: 委员会今晨召开会议，召集了来自每个参与行政区的代表。
items.ex2_en: The weary travelers assemble quietly in the hotel lobby before the morning departure.
items.ex2_zh: 疲惫的旅客们在清晨出发前静静地在酒店大堂集合。

items.def_en: To assemble troops or summon up internal strength, courage, or support for a specific effort
items.ex_en: She struggled to muster enough courage to confront her supervisor about the unfair policy.
items.ex_zh: 她竭力鼓起足够的勇气，去就那项不公平的政策质问她的主管。
items.ex2_en: All naval reserve divisions must muster promptly before dawn at headquarters.
items.ex2_zh: 所有海军预备役部队必须在黎明前迅速在总部集合完毕。

items.def_en: To gradually accumulate a large amount of money, information, or wealth
items.ex_en: The secretive investor managed to amass a colossal fortune through prudent real estate acquisitions.
items.ex_zh: 这位低调的投资者通过审慎的房地产收购，积聚了一笔巨额财富。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers bringing people, objects, or resources together into one group or repository, whether casually assembling or methodically amassing valuable assets.
groups.summary_zh: 指将人、物或资源召集、聚集或逐步搜集至一处。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the intentional bringing together of scattered people, objects, or resources into a single location or collective whole, contrasting with passive accumulation by emphasizing agentive aggregation.
groups.desc_zh: 指主动将分散的人员、物体或资源汇聚归拢为整体，区别于被动的自然堆积，强调有意识的聚合行动。
groups.nuance_en: collect: systematic retrieval or gathering of items (data / specimens / coins) · assemble: structured fitting or convening into an organized body (team / machine / crowd) · muster: summoning up dispersed strength or personnel with effort (courage / troops / support) · amass: accumulating large, substantial quantities over time (wealth / fortunes / evidence)
groups.nuance_zh: collect: 有系统地收集或整理 (data / specimens / coins) · assemble: 结构化装配或召集成立整齐队伍 (team / machine / crowd) · muster: 费力调动或鼓起分散的力量与人员 (courage / troops / support) · amass: 长期大量聚积或积攒财富资料 (wealth / fortunes / evidence)

groups.name: Gather & Condense · 凝聚与结聚 (Condense, Coalesce, Aggregate)
groups.tip: 微粒聚集成核与凝结

items.def_en: To collect into a single mass, sum, or cluster
items.ex_en: Microscopic particles suspended in the chemical solution gradually aggregate into visible clusters.
items.ex_zh: 悬浮在化学溶液中的微观粒子逐渐聚集成肉眼可见的团块。
items.ex2_en: The online platform aggregates daily financial news stories from hundreds of independent publishers.
items.ex2_zh: 该在线平台汇总了来自数百家独立出版机构的每日财经新闻。

items.def_en: To change or cause something to change from a gas or vapor into a liquid droplets on a surface
items.ex_en: Warm breath caused moisture to condense rapidly on the freezing window panes.
items.ex_zh: 温热的呼吸使水汽在冰冷的窗玻璃上迅速凝结成水滴。
items.ex2_en: Cold metal pipes condense rising steam into tiny droplets of fresh distilled water.
items.ex2_zh: 冰冷的金属管道将升腾的水蒸气冷凝成微小的纯净蒸馏水滴。

items.def_en: To come together to form one larger mass, system, or community
items.ex_en: Several distinct resistance movements coalesced into a unified political front against the regime.
items.ex_zh: 数个各不相同的抵抗运动融合成了一个反对该政权的统一政治阵线。

items.def_en: To form into crystals or take a definite, structured physical or conceptual shape
items.ex_en: Her vague theoretical thoughts began to crystallize into a concrete thesis proposal.
items.ex_zh: 她那些模糊的理论思考开始凝结成一份具体的论文开题报告。
items.ex2_en: Cooling sugar syrup will crystallize dense sugars into delightful brittle rock candy overnight.
items.ex2_zh: 冷却糖浆会在一夜之间将高浓度糖分结晶成美味酥脆的冰糖。

items.def_en: (specialist) To form a central nucleus, or cause material to gather, condense, or crystallize around a core.
items.ex_en: Tiny dust motes in the cold cloud nucleate moisture into delicate ice crystals.
items.ex_zh: 冷云中细微的尘埃微粒促使水汽凝结，聚成精致的冰晶。
items.ex2_en: Ice crystals nucleate rapidly when subzero atmospheric temperatures drop below critical threshold levels.
items.ex2_zh: 当零下气温骤降至临界阈值以下时，冰晶会迅速成核形成。

items.def_zh: 凝结；凝固（成冻状或固体）
items.def_en: To become thick or solid, especially upon cooling, as blood or molten fat
items.ex_en: The fatty gravy began to congeal on the plate as it cooled down.
items.ex_zh: 盘中油脂丰厚的肉汁随着温度下降开始凝结成厚厚的固体。
items.ex2_en: Freezing winter temperatures congeal the melted grease into a waxy white solid mass.
items.ex2_zh: 严冬的冰冻低温把融化的油脂凝固成了蜡状的白色固态物质。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the process by which dispersed particles, vapors, or disparate elements draw together around a core or unite into a solid, cohesive mass. They often collocate with physical states like moisture, crystals, droplets, or abstract ideas converging into a whole.
groups.summary_zh: 描述分散颗粒、水汽或要素汇聚凝聚成核或团块的过程。
groups.desc_en: Involves separate elements, vapors, or concepts drawing together into a denser, unified, or structured mass, contrasting with mechanical gathering by implying physical phase change or conceptual integration.
groups.desc_zh: 指分散的元素、蒸汽或抽象概念相互吸引聚合成更紧密、统一的实体，区别于机械组装，强调相态转变或概念熔合。
groups.nuance_en: aggregate: combining disparate units into a statistical or composite sum (data / scores / resources) · condense: compressing substance or text into a denser, shorter form (steam / report / ideas) · coalesce: merging distinct factions or streams into a single unified whole (factions / opinions / droplets) · crystallize: resolving vague thoughts or substances into clear, definitive structure (plans / policy / liquid)
groups.nuance_zh: aggregate: 将离散单元统计或复合成总量 (data / scores / resources) · condense: 将物质浓缩凝结或把文本压缩精简 (steam / report / ideas) · coalesce: 不同派系或水流自然融合为统一整体 (factions / opinions / droplets) · crystallize: 使模糊想法或液体结晶定型为清晰结构 (plans / policy / liquid)

groups.name: Gather & Swarm · 聚集与簇拥 (Crowd, Swarm, Flock)
groups.tip: 群体如蜂群般汇聚

items.def_en: To wander around a specific area in a confused or disorderly mass
items.ex_en: Bored passengers continued to mill around the crowded terminal during the unexpected flight delay.
items.ex_zh: 在航班意外延误期间，无聊的乘客们继续在拥挤的航站楼里盲目盘桓。

items.def_en: To gather together in large numbers or press closely together in a confined space
items.ex_en: Excited fans crowded into the narrow corridor hoping to catch a fleeting glimpse.
items.ex_zh: 兴奋的粉丝们挤满了狭窄的走廊，希望能瞥见偶像一眼。
items.ex2_en: Tourists crowd the tiny local souvenir shop whenever the tour buses arrive together.
items.ex2_zh: 每当旅游大巴一同抵达时，游客们就会挤满这家小巧的地方纪念品店。

items.def_en: To gather or move together in large numbers, especially toward an attraction or event
items.ex_en: Thousands of enthusiastic tourists flock to the coastal town every midsummer weekend.
items.ex_zh: 每到仲夏周末，成千上万热情的游客便成群结队地涌向这座沿海小镇。

items.def_en: To crowd around someone aggressively or excitedly in large numbers
items.ex_en: Aggressive paparazzi mobbed the young actress as she attempted to enter her hotel.
items.ex_zh: 当年轻女演员试图走进酒店时，激进的狗仔队蜂拥而上将她围堵。

items.def_en: To move or gather in a large, busy, and densely packed group like insects
items.ex_en: Eager shoppers swarmed into the department store the moment the doors finally opened.
items.ex_zh: 大门终于打开的那一刻，急切的购物者如蜂群般涌入了百货大楼。

items.def_en: To gather or move in a large, densely packed crowd; to fill a place completely.
items.ex_en: Vast pilgrimages of weary travelers throng the ancient flagstone streets toward the sanctuary.
items.ex_zh: 浩浩荡荡疲惫的朝圣队伍挤满了古老的石板街，涌向圣所。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe large numbers of people or animals moving together or congregating densely in a space, often overwhelming the surrounding area.
groups.summary_zh: 强调人群或动物密集聚集、涌入或蜂拥包围某处。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on large multitudes of animate beings moving, converging, or pressing together en masse, contrasting with orderly assembly by emphasizing chaotic density, kinetic motion, and overwhelming numbers.
groups.desc_zh: 指大量生命体群体性地涌动、聚集或紧密挤压，区别于有序集会，强调高密度、骚动感与规模压迫感。
groups.nuance_en: crowd: pressing closely into a confined space (hall / entrance / platform) · flock: moving together in large numbers driven by shared impulse or attraction (tourists / fans / birds) · swarm: massing and moving in agitated, cloud-like multitudes (insects / reporters / protestors) · mob: aggressively surrounding or crowding around a focal person or spot (celebrity / referee / store) · throng: filling and packing a space densely while milling about (streets / markets / pilgrims)
groups.nuance_zh: crowd: 拥挤挤入狭窄有限空间 (hall / entrance / platform) · flock: 随大流受吸引而成群涌向 (tourists / fans / birds) · swarm: 像蜂群般骚动密集地穿梭包围 (insects / reporters / protestors) · mob: 喧闹或攻击性地团团围住某人某地 (celebrity / referee / store) · throng: 熙熙攘攘地挤满穿梭于场所 (streets / markets / pilgrims)

groups.name: Gaze & Peer · 凝视与端详 (Peer, Squint, Scrutinize)
groups.tip: 眯眼端详乃至久久凝望

items.def_en: To glance quickly or furtively, often through a narrow opening
items.ex_en: The curious toddler tried to peek through the tiny keyhole into the parlor.
items.ex_zh: 那个好奇的幼儿试图通过门上的小钥匙孔偷看客厅里的情形。

items.def_zh: 端详，凝视；费力地看，细看
items.def_en: To look closely, carefully, or with difficulty at something, especially when trying to see clearly.
items.ex_en: The sailor had to peer intently through the dense coastal fog for landmarks.
items.ex_zh: 水手不得不费力地凝视浓重的沿海大雾，搜寻陆标。

items.def_en: To look steadily and intently at something, especially in wonder, love, or deep thought
items.ex_en: They stood together on the cliff to gaze at the tranquil setting sun.
items.ex_zh: 他们一起伫立在悬崖边，凝望着那轮平静落下的夕阳。

items.def_en: To look at something with eyes partly closed, typically in bright light or when trying to see clearly
items.ex_en: He had to squint at the tiny print on the medicine bottle without his glasses.
items.ex_zh: 没戴眼镜，他不得不眯起眼睛看药瓶上的小字。

items.def_en: To look at and study a text, map, or object with great care and concentration
items.ex_en: The dedicated cartographer spent hours to pore over the ancient topographical charts.
items.ex_zh: 那位专注的制图师花了数小时凝神研读那些古老的地形图纸。

items.def_en: To examine or inspect someone or something very closely and thoroughly
items.ex_en: Federal investigators arrived early to scrutinize the company’s extensive financial records.
items.ex_zh: 联邦调查人员一早就到了，以仔细详审该公司详尽的财务记录。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on looking intently, narrowly, or with physical effort to discern detail despite poor vision or obstruction. Unlike open admiration, these verbs emphasize focus, visual strain, and close inspection.
groups.summary_zh: 强调因视线受阻、距离远或审视细节而费力细看、凝望。
groups.desc_en: Describes visual perception modulated by intensity, duration, and optical effort, moving from casual peeping to sustained contemplation and deep critical inspection, contrasting with simple seeing.
groups.desc_zh: 指在注意力、视线穿透度与认知强度上有级差的注视活动，区别于普通的被动“看”，强调视线投入与审视深度。
groups.nuance_en: peer: looking intently or with difficulty through an obstruction or gloom (darkness / mist / window) · gaze: looking steadily with wonder, longing, or deep thought (stars / horizon / lover) · squint: partly closing eyes to sharpen focus or block harsh light (bright sun / fine print / glare) · scrutinize: examining every detail with meticulous, critical rigor (document / contract / face) · pore over: reading or studying minutely for an extended duration (manuscript / maps / data)
groups.nuance_zh: peer: 费力透过障碍或昏暗处仔细张望 (darkness / mist / window) · gaze: 带着惊奇、凝思或深情久久凝视 (stars / horizon / lover) · squint: 眯缝着眼睛以看清细部或遮挡强光 (bright sun / fine print / glare) · scrutinize: 带着批判与挑剔心态逐项严密审视 (document / contract / face) · pore over: 长时间埋头精读钻研材料 (manuscript / maps / data)

groups.name: Gel & Coagulate · 凝结与定型 (Gel, Congeal, Coagulate)
groups.tip: 由液态凝结成固体或胶状

items.def_zh: 形成协调整体；达成一致
items.def_en: To start to work well as an organized, harmonious group or clear plan
items.ex_en: After months of chaotic rehearsals, the complex theatrical production finally began to come together.
items.ex_zh: 经过数月混乱的排练，这部复杂的舞台剧制作终于开始显现出协调的整体面貌。

items.def_en: To change from a liquid or soft state into a firm, solid form
items.ex_en: You must wait at least twenty minutes for the gelatin dessert to set properly.
items.ex_zh: 你必须等待至少二十分钟，明胶甜点才能完全凝固成型。

items.def_zh: 凝结，胶化；（想法、计划等）成形；（团队）融洽合作
items.def_en: 1. (of a liquid) To thicken and become a jelly-like substance. 2. (of ideas, plans, or people) To take definite shape or work together smoothly and effectively.
items.ex_en: The newly hired research team took several weeks before their dynamic began to gel.
items.ex_zh: 新聘请的研发团队磨合了数周，彼此之间的配合才开始融洽成型。

items.def_zh: 胶化；（想法或关系）成型定局
items.def_en: To take definite form or begin to work well and cohesively together
items.ex_en: Their vague business strategy finally started to jell into an actionable marketing plan.
items.ex_zh: 他们原本模糊的商业策略终于开始成型定局，化作切实可行的营销方案。
items.ex2_en: The innovative team leader helped jell differing employee opinions into one cohesive strategy.
items.ex2_zh: 充满创新思维的团队负责人帮助将员工们不同的意见整合成了统一的战略。

items.def_en: To become thick, soft, or solid, especially when cooling from a liquid state
items.ex_en: Left undisturbed overnight in the refrigerator, the rich beef broth began to congeal completely.
items.ex_zh: 在冰箱里静置过夜后，浓郁的牛肉清汤已彻底凝固成冻。
items.ex2_en: The icy night air will congeal spilled oil into thick sticky black sludge.
items.ex2_zh: 冰冷的夜间空气会把溢出的油凝固成黏稠厚重的黑色淤渣。

items.def_en: To change from a liquid to a thick, semi-solid state, especially of blood or milk
items.ex_en: The specialized medicine works rapidly to help the patient's blood coagulate normally.
items.ex_zh: 这种特效药见效迅速，有助于该患者的血液恢复正常的凝结功能。
items.ex2_en: Adding natural rennet helps coagulate fresh milk during the artisan cheese-making process.
items.ex2_zh: 在手工奶酪制作过程中，加入天然凝乳酶有助于使新鲜牛奶凝固。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote liquid, semi-fluid mixtures or abstract concepts (plans, teams, thoughts) thickening into a unified, cohesive, gelatinous mass or structured whole. Physical contexts contrast with figurative usage where unformed ideas crystallize and click together.
groups.summary_zh: 指流体凝成胶状，或抽象的想法、团队形成协同与默契。
groups.desc_en: Governs the phase-transition schema where liquid, disordered, or provisional states thicken into a stable, semi-solid, or functioning reality, contrasting with mere freezing by implying organic coherence.
groups.desc_zh: 指液体、松散物或未成形构想凝聚变稠、固化并定型的过程，区别于单纯冷冻，强调内在有机结合与方案落实。
groups.nuance_en: set: firming up into final solid form after pouring or resting (concrete / jelly / glue) · gel: taking cohesive shape or functioning smoothly together (team / project / mixture) · congeal: cooling or drying into an unpleasantly viscous or solid state (grease / blood / soup) · coagulate: chemically clumping liquid into thick curd-like clots (milk / blood / proteins)
groups.nuance_zh: set: 经静置固化形成终态硬度 (concrete / jelly / glue) · gel: 方案成形运转或团队配合顺畅磨合成型 (team / project / mixture) · congeal: 因冷却或凝结变成黏稠凝固体 (grease / blood / soup) · coagulate: 经生化反应析出凝块 (milk / blood / proteins)

groups.name: Gentrify & Regenerate · 旧区改造与升级 (Regenerate, Revamp, Redevelop)
groups.tip: 老城区中产阶级化更新改造

items.def_en: To raise something to a higher standard, newer specification, or better quality
items.ex_en: The public library secured municipal funding to upgrade its outdated computer laboratory facilities.
items.ex_zh: 公共图书馆获得了市政资金，用于升级其陈旧的计算机实验室设施。

items.def_en: To make a place or oneself look cleaner, tidier, and more fashionable
items.ex_en: The local pub decided to smarten up before the busy summer tourist season.
items.ex_zh: 这家当地酒馆决定在繁忙的夏季旅游旺季到来之前重新修饰收拾一番。
items.ex2_en: The hardworking couple decided to smarten up their old cottage before listing it.
items.ex2_zh: 这对勤劳的夫妇决定在挂牌出售前把自己旧农舍整饬修缮一番。

items.def_en: To overhaul, modernize, or restructure something completely to make it more appealing
items.ex_en: The struggling streaming service plans to revamp its interface to retain restless subscribers.
items.ex_zh: 这家举步维艰的流媒体服务商计划彻底改造其界面，以留住躁动不安的订户。

items.def_en: To bring new life, economic vitality, and improvements to a declining urban area
items.ex_en: Civic leaders sought grand investments to regenerate the decaying post-industrial riverfront district.
items.ex_zh: 市政领袖们寻求巨额投资，以振兴这座日渐衰败的后工业滨水区域。
items.ex2_en: The neglected riverfront district regenerates steadily as new cultural businesses open their doors.
items.ex2_zh: 随着新的文化企业陆续开业，这处昔日荒废的滨河区正稳步焕发新生。

items.def_en: To build new housing or commercial developments on land where old buildings stood
items.ex_en: Private developers bought the abandoned warehouse district to redevelop it into luxury condominiums.
items.ex_zh: 私人开发商买下了这片废弃的仓库区，准备将其重新开发为高档公寓。
items.ex2_en: The historic harbor district redevelops rapidly into a thriving modern tourist destination today.
items.ex2_zh: 如今，这处历史悠久的港口街区正迅速改建为一个繁荣的现代旅游胜地。

items.def_zh: 使（旧城区等）中产阶级化，改造升级
items.def_en: 1. To renovate and improve a poor urban area so that it conforms to middle-class taste, often displacing poorer residents.
items.ex_en: Trendy cafes and luxury lofts rapidly gentrify the previously neglected working-class neighborhood.
items.ex_zh: 时髦的咖啡馆和高档阁楼公寓迅速使这个昔日无人问津的工人阶级街区中产阶级化。
items.ex2_en: The historic docklands gentrify rapidly as affluent young tech workers relocate here steadily.
items.ex2_zh: 随着富裕的年轻科技从业者不断迁入，历史悠久的码头区正迅速贵族化。

groups.summary_en: This frame relates to municipal and social urban renewal, where neglected neighborhoods, properties, or infrastructure are modernized, remodeled, or upgraded, frequently altering their socioeconomic character.
groups.summary_zh: 指对衰败街区或物业进行翻新改造、重建升级及士绅化。
groups.desc_en: Profiles the structural, cosmetic, or socioeconomic upgrading of dilapidated urban zones, contrasting with new construction by requiring pre-existing decay as the baseline for transformation.
groups.desc_zh: 指针对衰败城市空间在建筑、功能或社会阶层结构上的升级与翻新，区别于白地起建，强调以破败现状为改造基底。
groups.nuance_en: revamp: restructuring and refreshing the surface look or operations (brand / facility / image) · regenerate: bringing economic and social vitality back to a depressed area (waterfront / inner city / economy) · redevelop: demolishing and fundamentally rebuilding a physical site (brownfield / site / housing) · gentrify: elevating an urban area socioeconomically, often displacing lower-income residents (neighborhood / quarter / district)
groups.nuance_zh: revamp: 对外观或运营模式进行大幅翻新修补 (brand / facility / image) · regenerate: 使萧条衰败地带重获社会经济活力 (waterfront / inner city / economy) · redevelop: 拆旧改建以重新规划利用地块 (brownfield / site / housing) · gentrify: 伴随中产阶层迁入引发社区高档化并挤出原住民 (neighborhood / quarter / district)

groups.name: Gesture & Signal · 体态与示意 (Beckon, Wave, Shrug)
groups.tip: 点头或肢体动作示意

items.def_en: To move your raised hand back and forth as a greeting, farewell, or directional signal
items.ex_en: She stood on the platform to wave goodbye as the train slowly departed.
items.ex_zh: 火车缓缓开动时，她站在月台上挥手告别。

items.def_zh: 打手势示意（某人做某事）
items.def_en: To direct someone to move or perform an action by making a silent gesture
items.ex_en: The waiter silently motioned the VIP guests toward their reserved private dining booth.
items.ex_zh: 服务员默默打手势示意贵宾们走向为他们预留的私人用餐包厢。

items.def_en: To move your hands, arms, or head to express an intention or accentuate meaning
items.ex_en: He loved to gesture expansively whenever he told dramatic stories about his youth.
items.ex_zh: 每当讲述年轻时的戏剧性往事，他总是喜欢做些幅度夸张的手势。

items.def_zh: 点头示意，点头答应；打盹，打瞌睡
items.def_en: 1. To move your head down and up, especially to show agreement, greeting, or acknowledgement. 2. To let your head fall forward when sleepy; to fall asleep briefly.
items.ex_en: The exhausted student began to nod during the professor's monotonous three-hour lecture.
items.ex_zh: 在这位教授单调乏味的三个小时讲座中，精疲力竭的学生开始打瞌睡。

items.def_zh: 耸肩（表示不解或漠不关心）
items.def_en: To raise and drop your shoulders to show indifference, doubt, or lack of knowledge
items.ex_en: She could only shrug when asked how the expensive porcelain vase was broken.
items.ex_zh: 当被问及那个昂贵的瓷花瓶是如何碎掉时，她只能耸耸肩表示不知。

items.def_en: To signal someone with your hand or head urging them to approach or follow
items.ex_en: The museum guide paused to beckon the straying tourists toward the main exhibit.
items.ex_zh: 博物馆导游停下脚步，招手示意那些掉队的游客走向主展厅。

groups.summary_en: Relates to physical body language, especially head, hand, or shoulder movements deployed deliberately to communicate consent, direction, dismissal, or attitude without speech.
groups.summary_zh: 通过点头、挥手、耸肩等肢体动作传递示意、认可或情感反应。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on bodily, non-verbal transmission of intent or direction, contrasting with verbal speech by relying on culturally coded physical signs to instruct or acknowledge.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过身体部位的非语言动作来传递意图或指令，区别于言语表述，依赖具象肢体符号以完成示意。
groups.nuance_en: wave: moving hand back and forth to greet or attract notice (hand / farewell / crowd) · gesture: using hands or limbs expressively to emphasize an idea (hands / impatience / agreement) · shrug: lifting shoulders to convey indifference, ignorance, or resignation (shoulders / doubt / indifference) · beckon: curling a finger or waving an arm to summon someone closer (finger / waiter / crowd)
groups.nuance_zh: wave: 挥手致意或以此吸引注意 (hand / farewell / crowd) · gesture: 用手势或肢体动作辅助表达意图 (hands / impatience / agreement) · shrug: 耸肩以示不知、无所谓或无奈 (shoulders / doubt / indifference) · beckon: 招手或屈指呼唤对方靠拢接近 (finger / waiter / crowd)

groups.name: Glide & Breeze · 悠然快步与滑行 (Coast, Sweep, Sail)
groups.tip: 轻盈顺畅毫无阻力地前行

items.def_zh: 顺势滑行；毫不费劲地前进
items.def_en: To move effortlessly, propelled only by inertia or gravity rather than exertion
items.ex_en: He stopped pedaling and let the bicycle coast down the gentle sloping driveway.
items.ex_zh: 他停下蹬踏动作，任由自行车顺着平缓的坡道一路滑行下去。

items.def_zh: 昂然飘然而过；从容前行
items.def_en: To move quickly, smoothly, and confidently in a particular direction
items.ex_en: The confident diplomat seemed to sail through every intense round of trade negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 那位自信的外交官似乎毫不费力地从容通过了每一轮激烈的贸易谈判。

items.def_zh: 轻快自信地走；轻易通过
items.def_en: 1. To walk or move in a casual, confident, and effortless manner. 2. (breeze through) To pass or succeed in something easily.
items.ex_en: She managed to breeze through the difficult final examination without breaking a sweat.
items.ex_zh: 她毫不费吹灰之力，轻轻松松就通过了那场极具挑战性的期末考试。

items.def_en: To move smoothly and quietly without noticeable effort or resistance
items.ex_en: The elegant swan seemed to glide across the mirror-like surface of the lake.
items.ex_zh: 优雅的天鹅仿佛轻巧地滑过如镜面般平静的湖面。

items.def_zh: 大摇大摆漫步；轻快昂首踱入
items.def_en: To walk somewhere casually, cheerfully, or presumptuously without obstacle
items.ex_en: You cannot simply waltz into a secure facility without showing proper identification badges.
items.ex_zh: 你不能连有效的身份证件都不出示，就这么大摇大摆地踱进安保严密的设施。

items.def_en: To move smoothly and with dignity or impressive momentum into a space
items.ex_en: The distinguished monarch swept into the grand ballroom surrounded by royal guards.
items.ex_zh: 那位尊贵的君主在皇家卫队的簇拥下，仪态万千地阔步走入富丽堂皇的舞厅。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict movement executed with apparent ease, lightness, confidence, and unhurried fluidity, often without detectable friction or strenuous effort.
groups.summary_zh: 指步伐轻快、毫不费力且自信舒展地滑行、漫步或顺遂前行。
groups.desc_en: Captures frictionless, graceful, and seemingly effortless locomotion through space or challenges, contrasting with laboured marching by foregrounding momentum and ease.
groups.desc_zh: 指在空间移动或通过关卡时展现出如行云流水、毫不费力的顺滑态势，区别于费力的跋涉，强调动量与轻盈感。
groups.nuance_en: coast: moving effortlessly on existing momentum without applying power (downhill / bicycle / career) · sail: proceeding smoothly and unimpeded through obstacles (exam / interview / customs) · breeze: moving in or through briskly, cheerfully, and nonchalantly (room / audition / test) · glide: moving with smooth, continuous, quiet motion across a surface (swan / skater / dancer) · sweep: moving grandly, swiftly, and majestically through an area (hall / stage / corridor)
groups.nuance_zh: coast: 借已有惯性滑行或坐享其成不再发力 (downhill / bicycle / career) · sail: 毫无悬念且顺风顺水地轻松过关 (exam / interview / customs) · breeze: 步履轻盈、神色自若地快速通过 (room / audition / test) · glide: 贴着表面无声平滑且连贯地滑动 (swan / skater / dancer) · sweep: 昂首阔步、仪态庄重而迅疾地掠过 (hall / stage / corridor)

groups.name: Glimmer & Shimmer · 微光闪烁与晃动 (Shimmer, Twinkle, Flicker)
groups.tip: 光源稳定或微弱地放光

items.def_zh: 明灭不定，忽隐忽现地闪烁
items.def_en: To burn or shine unsteadily with rapid variations in brightness, like a candle flame.
items.ex_en: A single beeswax candle continued to flicker against the drafty chamber's stone walls.
items.ex_zh: 一根单薄的蜂蜡蜡烛在透风的石室墙壁前继续明灭不定地闪烁着。

items.def_en: To shine with a gentle, smooth, but distinct light, especially through darkness.
items.ex_en: The polished silver cutlery began to gleam under the soft dining room chandelier.
items.ex_zh: 在餐厅吊灯柔和的光芒映照下，抛光银质餐具闪耀出柔润的光芒。

items.def_en: To shine with rapid, dancing flashes of bright light, like distant stars.
items.ex_en: Countless distant galaxies twinkle softly in the velvety blackness of the night sky.
items.ex_zh: 无数遥远的星系在如天鹅绒般漆黑的夜空中轻柔地闪闪发光。

items.def_zh: 闪烁微光，泛起粼粼波光
items.def_en: To shine with a soft, tremulous, or wavering light, like heat haze or water.
items.ex_en: Ethereal heat waves caused the distant asphalt horizon to shimmer like pooled water.
items.ex_zh: 缥缈的热浪使得远处的沥青地平线宛如积水般泛起阵阵微光波影。

items.raw_cluster: 发光与照射 Shine & Emit Light
items.def_en: To shine with a faint, wavering, or unsteady light.
items.ex_en: A faint lantern seemed to glimmer through the dense foliage of the dark forest.
items.ex_zh: 一盏微弱的提灯似乎透过黑暗森林中茂密的枝叶闪烁着微光。

items.def_en: To produce a tiny, momentary flash of reflected light off a polished surface.
items.ex_en: I saw a sharp glint of light reflect off the sniper's polished lens.
items.ex_zh: 我看到狙击手擦得发亮的镜片上反射出一道短暂而细微的亮光。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this perceptual frame signify faint, wavering, soft, or intermittently trembling illumination rather than a blinding continuous glare.
groups.summary_zh: 微弱、摇曳或断续闪烁的柔和光亮，常见于星辰、微火或水面反光。
groups.desc_en: Profiles unsteady, faint, or intermittent light emissions, contrasting with constant glare or blazing illumination by underscoring shifting intensity and delicate luminosity.
groups.desc_zh: 描述微弱、摇曳或断续不定的光亮表现，区别于持久强光或炽热照明，侧重微光忽明忽暗的细腻质感。
groups.nuance_en: flicker: wavering unsteadily and threatening to go out (flame / candle / screen) · twinkle: shining with rapidly pulsating, cheerful points of light (star / eye / city lights) · shimmer: gleaming with a soft, tremulous, undulating light (lake / heat / satin) · glimmer: emitting a faint, unsteady, distant light (candle / hope / dawn) · glint: flashing momentarily with a brief, hard, sharp reflection (steel / coin / eye)
groups.nuance_zh: flicker: 忽明忽暗地晃动、濒临熄灭 (flame / candle / screen) · twinkle: 明亮闪烁、轻快跳跃的星点状反光 (star / eye / city lights) · shimmer: 随水波或热气晃动的柔和微光 (lake / heat / satin) · glimmer: 隐约若现的微弱散光 (candle / hope / dawn) · glint: 金属或坚硬表面反射出的瞬时锐利闪光 (steel / coin / eye)

groups.name: Glorify & Exalt · 崇奉与极度赞美 (Glorify, Exalt, Extol, Lionize)
groups.tip: 从口头表扬到高度推崇赞颂

items.def_en: To speak of someone or something with boundless enthusiasm and approval
items.ex_en: The proud food critics continue to sing the praises of her innovative bakery.
items.ex_zh: 傲慢的美食评论家们依然对她那家别出心裁的面包店大加赞赏。

items.def_en: 1. To praise and worship God or someone highly. 2. To make something seem much better, more exciting, or more noble than it really is.
items.ex_en: Sensationalist media outlets often glorify dangerous outlaws instead of honoring ordinary working people.
items.ex_zh: 耸人听闻的媒体机构往往大肆美化危险的亡命之徒，而不是赞颂平凡的劳动者。

items.def_en: To treat someone as a celebrated hero or notable public figure with intense adulation
items.ex_en: The cultural elite rushed to lionize the eccentric novelist after his surprise debut.
items.ex_zh: 在这位古怪小说家令人惊艳的首作问世后，文化精英们争相将他奉为偶像。

items.def_zh: 赞扬；赞美（多用于书面或正式表彰）
items.def_en: To express strong formal praise and approval of an achievement or quality
items.ex_en: The university president formally gathered faculty members to laud the scientist’s groundbreaking discovery.
items.ex_zh: 大学校长正式召集教职员工，对该科学家开创性的科学发现予以公开表彰。

items.def_en: To praise someone or something very enthusiastically in speech or writing
items.ex_en: Health advocates continuously extol the long-term cardiovascular benefits of a Mediterranean diet.
items.ex_zh: 健康倡导者不断高度赞扬地中海饮食对心血管健康的长期益处。

items.def_en: To praise or honor someone highly, or raise them to a much higher status or rank
items.ex_en: The solemn coronation ceremony served to exalt the young prince above all nobility.
items.ex_zh: 庄严的加冕典礼旨在使这位年轻王子的崇高地位凌驾于所有贵族之上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey enthusiastic, reverent, or hyperbolic praise that elevates someone or something to heroic, divine, or celebrated status, sometimes crossing into romanticized myth-making.
groups.summary_zh: 将人、事或神性推崇到极高地位、极力颂扬甚至理想化的赞颂行为。
groups.desc_en: Governs the social and rhetorical act of elevating someone or something to transcendent, heroic, or supreme status, contrasting with mild commendation by expressing extreme hyperbole or worship.
groups.desc_zh: 指在言论或仪式上将客体提升至崇高、英雄式甚至神圣地位的极度推崇，区别于普通表扬，带有强烈的夸张或膜拜色彩。
groups.nuance_en: glorify: transforming something mundane or violent into something noble and splendid (violence / past / martyr) · lionize: treating someone as a fêted celebrity or cultural hero (author / celebrity / general) · laud: praising formally and publicly for an accomplishment (efforts / virtues / achievement) · extol: proclaiming the exceptional merits of something enthusiastically (virtues / benefits / wisdom) · exalt: elevating in rank, spiritual dignity, or cosmic glory (god / ruler / status)
groups.nuance_zh: glorify: 将平凡甚至暴力之物美化赞颂为光辉崇高 (violence / past / martyr) · lionize: 把某人当作文化英雄或名流众星捧月般奉迎 (author / celebrity / general) · laud: 在正式公开场合高度赞扬其成就 (efforts / virtues / achievement) · extol: 热情洋溢地极力吹捧某物的优异长处 (virtues / benefits / wisdom) · exalt: 提拔晋升其地位或在精神信仰上无限拔高 (god / ruler / status)

groups.name: Gossip & Circulate Hearsay · 传闻与谣传 (Rumor, Whisper, Murmur)
groups.tip: 未经证实的风声四处流传

items.def_en: (+ sth) distribute or circulate gossip, news, or unverified stories among many people
items.ex_en: Mischievous employees began to pass around wild rumors about the CEO's sudden resignation.
items.ex_zh: 爱惹事的员工们开始在私下四处散播有关首席执行官突然辞职的荒诞谣言。

items.def_en: (chiefly passive, 'be rumored') To circulate unverified news, gossip, or reports about someone or something.
items.ex_en: The veteran midfielder is widely rumored to be joining a rival club next season.
items.ex_zh: 坊间盛传这位经验丰富的中场球员将在下赛季加盟一家竞争对手俱乐部。

items.def_zh: 私下流传，窃窃私语般传闻
items.def_en: (often passive: be whispered) pass unverified rumors privately or quietly
items.ex_en: It was whispered in the corridors that massive budget cuts were imminent this fall.
items.ex_zh: 走廊里悄悄流传着今年秋天即将大幅削减预算的消息。

items.def_en: (+ about) talk casually or maliciously about other people's private lives
items.ex_en: The neighbors often gossip about his eccentric habits whenever he leaves the house.
items.ex_zh: 每当他走出家门，邻居们就常常对他古怪的习惯说三道四。

items.def_en: (+ sth) freely dispense or spread gossip or disparaging rumors to others
items.ex_en: She could not resist dishing out juicy secrets about her coworker's messy divorce.
items.ex_zh: 她忍不住大肆向人搬弄关于同事混乱离婚的劲爆八卦。

items.def_en: (+ about/abroad) spread a report or rumor widely among people
items.ex_en: News of the general's unexpected retreat was quickly bruited abroad by common heralds.
items.ex_zh: 将军意外撤军的消息很快就被传令官们传得沸沸扬扬。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame emphasize spreading unverified gossip, speculative tales, or backchannel allegations without official substantiation.
groups.summary_zh: 私下耳语、传闻议论未经核实的流言蜚语或道听途说。
groups.desc_en: Frames the informal, non-verified transmission of unconfirmed talk, secrets, or rumors through social networks, contrasting with official reporting by highlighting its clandestine, speculative nature.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过非正式社交网络扩散未经验证的传言、秘闻或闲话，区别于官方权威通报，强调隐秘流传与揣测性质。
groups.nuance_en: rumor: circulating unverified accounts widely among the public (merger / scandal / demise) · whisper: spreading secretive, often scandalous gossip discretely (corridors / treason / romance) · gossip: chatting casually about the private affairs of others (neighbors / colleagues / lives) · bruit: reporting or disseminating news clamorously and abroad (news / fame / name)
groups.nuance_zh: rumor: 在大众间流传未经证实的消息 (merger / scandal / demise) · whisper: 窃窃私语般暗中散布私密或丑闻 (corridors / treason / romance) · gossip: 闲聊八卦他人的私生活 (neighbors / colleagues / lives) · bruit: 沸沸扬扬地向外大肆张扬散布 (news / fame / name)

groups.name: Gradual Wearing Away · 磨损与水土风蚀 (Erode, Weather, Abrade)
groups.tip: 风化水冲或摩擦损耗

items.def_en: to wear away or make raw by repeated rubbing or surface contact
items.ex_en: The stiff leather boots began to chafe his heels after two miles of hiking.
items.ex_zh: 徒步两英里后，僵硬的皮靴开始磨破他的脚后跟。
items.ex2_en: His sensitive skin chafes easily whenever he wears rough, synthetic running clothes outdoors.
items.ex2_zh: 每当他在户外穿着粗糙的合成纤维运动服时，他敏感的皮肤很容易磨破。

items.def_en: to carry away or undermine earth or material by the surging action of water
items.ex_en: The outdoor music festival was completely washed out by the downpour.
items.ex_zh: 室外音乐节因倾盆大雨而被迫彻底取消。
items.ex2_en: Frequent machine washing will cause bright summer fabric dyes to wash out completely.
items.ex2_zh: 频繁的机洗会导致鲜艳的夏季面料染料彻底褪色。

items.def_en: to reduce in height, thickness, or substance through persistent rubbing or friction
items.ex_en: Persistent negotiations finally wore down the opposition's resistance.
items.ex_zh: 旷日持久的谈判最终瓦解了反对派的抵抗意志。
items.ex2_en: The rubber soles will wear down quickly from running on rough asphalt.
items.ex2_zh: 在粗糙的沥青路面上跑步会导致橡胶鞋底迅速磨损变薄。

items.def_en: to undergo or cause to undergo changes in appearance or structure due to natural atmospheric exposure
items.ex_en: Decades of harsh mountain winds had weathered the wooden cabin into pale gray.
items.ex_zh: 数十年的高山严风吹拂，使这座小木屋风化褪成了浅灰色。

items.def_en: 1. to gradually wear away or be worn away by wind, water, or other natural forces 2. to slowly reduce, weaken, or destroy something over time
items.ex_en: Continuous waves slowly erode the soft limestone cliffs along the southern coastline.
items.ex_zh: 持续的波浪逐渐侵蚀着南部海岸线上脆弱的石灰岩悬崖。
items.ex2_en: Soft sandstone cliffs erode rapidly under the relentless pounding of heavy ocean waves.
items.ex2_zh: 在汹涌海浪的持续拍击下，柔软的砂岩悬崖侵蚀得十分迅速。

items.def_en: to scrape or wear away the surface of something through friction or harsh contact
items.ex_en: Strong desert gales carrying coarse sand will severely abrade the car's exterior paint.
items.ex_zh: 夹带着粗沙的猛烈沙漠狂风会严重磨损汽车的外漆。

groups.summary_en: Denotes the slow, progressive mechanical or natural removal of surface matter (such as soil, rock, or fabric) via constant friction, weather exposure, or flow.
groups.summary_zh: 指受风雨冲刷、水流或摩擦长期作用，表面被缓慢剥蚀、磨平或刮损。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the gradual, continuous mechanical or environmental attrition that rubs, washes, or scrapes away surfaces over time, contrasting with sudden catastrophic demolition.
groups.desc_zh: 指机械摩擦或自然营力在漫长时间里对物体表面的渐进损耗与剥蚀，区别于突发性破坏，强调时间的持续累积效应。
groups.nuance_en: chafe: rubbing against skin or fabric causing irritation or wear (collar / ropes / skin) · wear down: steadily diminishing thickness, resistance, or endurance over time (teeth / resistance / tires) · weather: enduring long exposure to elements that alters surface or texture (rocks / wood / storm) · erode: eating away soil, rock, or intangible assets by wind or water (coastline / confidence / soil) · abrade: scraping away surface layers through rough friction (skin / metal / fabric)
groups.nuance_zh: chafe: 摩擦导致皮肤生疼磨破或绳索擦损 (collar / ropes / skin) · wear down: 持续损耗使厚度变薄或消磨阻力意志 (teeth / resistance / tires) · weather: 经受风吹日晒产生质地风化改观 (rocks / wood / storm) · erode: 遭水流风力渐进冲刷剥蚀或削弱信心 (coastline / confidence / soil) · abrade: 粗糙硬物刮擦磨损表皮 (skin / metal / fabric)

groups.name: Graduate & Degree · 毕业与授位 (Graduate, Matriculate, Qualify)
groups.tip: 完成学业并获颁正规学术学位

items.def_zh: 毕业；授予…学位，准予…毕业；分等级，标刻度
items.def_en: 1. To successfully complete an academic degree, course of study, or high school education. 2. To grant a degree or diploma to someone; to mark divisions or scale intervals on a measuring device.
items.ex_en: After years of rigorous study, Maria will finally graduate with honors this Friday.
items.ex_zh: 经过多年的刻苦学习，玛丽亚终于将在本周五以优异成绩毕业。
items.ex2_en: The prestigious medical school will graduate fifty talented young physicians next month.
items.ex2_zh: 这所著名的医学院下个月将准予五十名才华横溢的年轻医师毕业。

items.def_en: To successfully pass necessary examinations or complete required courses to practice a profession
items.ex_en: She took three tough examinations to qualify as an architect in the state.
items.ex_zh: 她参加了三次严苛的考试，才在该州取得了建筑师执业资格。
items.ex2_en: Passing these comprehensive technical evaluations will qualify you for senior engineering positions nationwide.
items.ex2_zh: 通过这些全面的技术考核将使你有资格担任全国范围的高级工程师职位。

items.def_zh: 军校结业；结业受训完成
items.def_en: (UK) To complete a military or police training course and graduate into service
items.ex_en: His proud family watched him pass out from the naval academy last weekend.
items.ex_zh: 上周末，他自豪的家人们看着他从海军学院顺利结业受训。

items.def_zh: 获得学位；参加毕业典礼
items.def_en: (formal, US) To receive an academic degree at a formal graduation ceremony
items.ex_en: Several brilliant scholars will commence with highest academic honors at tomorrow's formal convocation.
items.ex_zh: 数位杰出的学者将在明天的正式毕业典礼上获得最高学术荣誉学位。
items.ex2_en: The university president will commence three hundred graduating doctoral candidates this pleasant afternoon.
items.ex2_zh: 大学校长将于今天这个宜人的下午为三百名毕业博士生授予学位。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To officially grant or present a university degree, title, or academic honor
items.ex_en: The university chancellor will confer an honorary doctorate upon the distinguished visiting novelist.
items.ex_zh: 大学校长将向这位杰出的客座小说家授予荣誉博士学位。

items.def_zh: 被大学录取入学；注册入学
items.def_en: To formally enroll or be admitted into a college, university, or academic study program
items.ex_en: Only the top applicants are permitted to matriculate into this prestigious university.
items.ex_zh: 只有顶尖的申请者才获准注册进入这所享誉盛名的大学深造。
items.ex2_en: The prestigious fine arts academy will matriculate only forty outstanding international students this autumn.
items.ex2_zh: 这所著名的美术学院今年秋天仅将录取四十名杰出的国际学生入学。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers milestones and formal institutional completions within the educational lifecycle, from finishing study requirements and receiving a credential to conferring degrees upon students.
groups.summary_zh: 指完成学业要求、取得学历证书或学术机构授予学位资格。
groups.desc_en: Structures the institutional transitions of education and professional qualification, spanning admission, milestone exams, and the ritual bestowal of credentials, contrasting with general skill acquisition.
groups.desc_zh: 体现学业与职业准入的制度化演变历程，涵盖从注册入学、考核合格到典礼授位的全过程，区别于普通的技能习得。
groups.nuance_en: matriculate: officially enrolling as a candidate in a college or university (university / college / students) · qualify: satisfying formal examination standards to practice a profession (doctor / lawyer / race) · graduate: successfully finishing an academic course and receiving a diploma (university / high school / cohort) · confer: ceremonially granting a degree, title, or honor upon an individual (degree / title / award)
groups.nuance_zh: matriculate: 正式登记注册成为大学学籍生 (university / college / students) · qualify: 考核达标获得专业执业资格 (doctor / lawyer / race) · graduate: 顺利修满学业毕业受证 (university / high school / cohort) · confer: 在仪式上正式授予学位或头衔 (degree / title / award)

groups.name: Grapple & Wrestle · 缠斗与抱摔 (Wrestle, Scuffle, Tussle)
groups.tip: 近身肉搏徒手扭抓与角力

items.def_en: To fight briefly and chaotically in a disordered, confused crowd or pair
items.ex_en: Rival fans began to scuffle in the narrow alley outside the packed stadium.
items.ex_zh: 敌对的球迷在拥挤的体育场外的狭窄巷子里扭打混战起来。

items.def_en: (+ with) To struggle or fight roughly, especially over the possession of something
items.ex_en: The two eager defenders tussled with each other for control of the ball.
items.ex_zh: 两名积极的后卫为了争抢球权而激烈地相互厮打缠斗。

items.def_en: To engage in direct, stubborn confrontation or conflict with an opponent
items.ex_en: The two politicians often lock horns over environmental regulations during committee debates.
items.ex_zh: 这两位政客在委员会辩论期间经常就环保法规激烈交锋。

items.def_en: To fight someone by holding, locking, and trying to throw or force them to the ground
items.ex_en: The fierce competitors wrestled on the mat until one pinned the other down.
items.ex_zh: 两位凶猛的选手在垫子上摔跤扭打，直到一人将另一人按倒在地。

items.def_en: (+ with) To become involved in a physical or argumentative conflict with someone
items.ex_en: He warned the newcomer never to tangle with the experienced union leader.
items.ex_zh: 他警告新来的人千万不要与那位经验丰富的工会领袖起冲突。

items.def_zh: 扭打，搏斗；努力对付，竭力解决
items.def_en: 1. To wrestle or struggle closely with someone. 2. ('grapple with') To try hard to deal with or overcome a difficult problem or challenge.
items.ex_en: Local authorities must grapple with the severe housing shortage before winter arrives.
items.ex_zh: 在严冬来临之前，地方当局必须竭力解决严重的住房短缺问题。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on close-quarters physical combat and hand-to-hand engagement, characterized by seizing, holding, locking limbs, and struggling vigorously to overpower an opponent.
groups.summary_zh: 指近身肉搏、相互揪扯锁抱或费力搏斗以制服对手的对抗方式。
groups.desc_en: Involves close-quarters, bodily entanglement marked by physical grabbing, balancing, and countering, metaphorically extending to intense mental struggles, contrasting with strikes or ranged combat.
groups.desc_zh: 指近身缠绕、扭打或相互拉扯的躯体对抗模式，并引申为与棘手难题的搏斗，区别于器械格斗或打击技，强调胶着缠结。
groups.nuance_en: scuffle: engaging in a brief, disorganized, non-lethal brawl (guards / protesters / patrons) · tussle: struggling vigorously in a scrappy contest for control of something (ball / dominance / prize) · lock horns: engaging in a stubborn, direct deadlock or ideological clash (politicians / regulators / rivals) · wrestle: battling physically or mentally to pin down an opponent or dilemma (opponent / conscience / problem) · grapple: gripping tightly and struggling physically or confronting deep existential challenges (assailant / crisis / reality)
groups.nuance_zh: scuffle: 短暂混乱、无明确套路的推搡抓扯 (guards / protesters / patrons) · tussle: 为争夺控制权而激烈扭扯较量 (ball / dominance / prize) · lock horns: 如公牛抵角般各不相让的僵持争斗 (politicians / regulators / rivals) · wrestle: 抱摔角力或在脑海中与难题痛苦斗争 (opponent / conscience / problem) · grapple: 贴身肉搏紧揪不放或直面棘手现实 (assailant / crisis / reality)

groups.name: Grasp & Internalize · 领悟与心领神会 (Fathom, Internalize, Grok)
groups.tip: 心领神会掌握精髓

items.def_en: (+ to) To suddenly comprehend or realize the truth of a situation
items.ex_en: It took him several minutes to cotton on to their deceptive business scheme.
items.ex_zh: 他花了足足几分钟才恍然大悟，识破了他们的商业骗局。

items.def_en: (slang or dated) To understand or grasp something clearly.
items.ex_en: Keep your voice down around here if you savvy what is good for you.
items.ex_zh: 如果你懂什么是对你好的，在这里就老实压低声音。

items.def_en: To succeed in comprehending a bizarre, counterintuitive, or complex concept
items.ex_en: I simply cannot wrap my head around this bizarre theoretical physics concept.
items.ex_zh: 我实在是无法理解并消化这个极其怪诞的理论物理学概念。

items.def_en: To penetrate to the underlying meaning or reason of something obscure or deep
items.ex_en: Historians have struggled to fathom the enigmatic motives behind the monarch's sudden abdication.
items.ex_zh: 历史学家们一直难以彻底看透这位君主突然退位背后的莫测动机。

items.def_en: To incorporate values, ideas, or knowledge so deeply that they become intuitive parts of oneself
items.ex_en: Children quickly internalize the ethical standards and cultural behaviors modeled by their parents.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们很快就会将父母树立的道德规范和文化行为内化于心。

items.def_zh: 心领神会，彻底通透理解
items.def_en: To understand intuitively, deeply, and completely through emotional or intellectual empathy
items.ex_en: Once you truly grok this programming paradigm, writing clean code becomes effortless.
items.ex_zh: 一旦你真正通透领会了这种编程范式，写出简洁的代码就会变得轻而易举。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the deep, informal, or profound cognitive leap whereby complex external concepts are fully comprehended and absorbed into one's intuitive understanding.
groups.summary_zh: 指对深奥事理彻底领会、透彻理解并转化为内心认知。
groups.desc_en: Traces the cognitive arc from registering elusive concepts to deep, intuitive internalization where the mind fully assimilates external truth, contrasting with superficial memorization.
groups.desc_zh: 描述思维从捕捉模糊端倪到彻底消化吸收的认知深化过程，使外部知识化为直觉，区别于表层的死记硬背。
groups.nuance_en: cotton on: tardily or suddenly realizing what is actually happening (truth / scheme / joke) · wrap one's head around: overcoming mental disorientation to comprehend a bizarre idea (concept / scale / theory) · fathom: penetrating deep emotional or intellectual complexities to understand them (motives / mysteries / depth) · internalize: incorporating values or knowledge into one's fundamental psychological core (values / beliefs / norms) · grok: understanding something profoundly, empathetically, and completely (culture / codebase / essence)
groups.nuance_zh: cotton on: 恍然大悟或后知后觉领会真相 (truth / scheme / joke) · wrap one's head around: 克服认知障碍费力想通离奇复杂之事 (concept / scale / theory) · fathom: 测透深奥难解的奥秘或动机 (motives / mysteries / depth) · internalize: 将外在准则规范内化为精神底层信仰 (values / beliefs / norms) · grok: 凭直觉共情达到全然心领神会的化境 (culture / codebase / essence)

groups.name: Graze & Nibble · 漫食与零食 (Graze, Nibble, Peck)
groups.tip: 食草动物漫游啃食牧草

items.def_en: (+ on) to eat small amounts of food casually between regular meals
items.ex_en: Students love to snack on roasted nuts and dried fruit while studying late.
items.ex_zh: 学生们深夜学习时喜欢抓些烤坚果和果干当零食吃。

items.def_zh: 扒拉着吃；毫无胃口地吃
items.def_en: to eat only tiny morsels of food without enthusiasm or appetite
items.ex_en: Feeling quite unwell, the child could only peck at her bowl of soup.
items.ex_zh: 由于身体很不舒服，那个孩子只能毫无胃口地扒拉着碗里的汤。

items.def_en: to eat tiny portions of a meal slowly, showing little interest
items.ex_en: Depressed by the bad news, he merely picked at his cold dinner.
items.ex_zh: 受坏消息影响而情绪低落的他，只是无精打采地挑着面前冰凉的晚餐。

items.def_en: to feed on leaves and twigs, or sample small bites of food at leisure
items.ex_en: A graceful deer stepped out of the woods to browse on fresh willow shoots.
items.ex_zh: 一只优雅的鹿走出森林，悠闲地漫食着鲜嫩的柳树嫩芽。

items.def_en: 1. When cattle, sheep, or other animals graze, they eat grass growing in a field, or to put livestock out to feed. 2. To scrape and break the surface of the skin slightly by rubbing against something rough.
items.ex_en: Dozens of dairy cattle graze lazily on the lush green alpine slopes.
items.ex_zh: 几十头奶牛在苍翠茂盛的高山斜坡上悠闲地吃着草。

items.def_en: to eat food by taking very small, gentle bites repeatedly
items.ex_en: The nervous boy began to nibble on a cookie during the awkward silence.
items.ex_zh: 在尴尬的沉默中，那个紧张的男孩开始小口啃食起一块饼干。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to eating casual, leisurely, or diminutive morsels throughout the day rather than sitting down for a complete, structured meal.
groups.summary_zh: 指零碎食用、漫不经心地小口进食或以吃零食代餐。
groups.desc_en: Captures unstructured, casual, or low-intensity eating characterized by taking tiny bites, picking food without appetite, or eating sporadically throughout the day, contrasting with consuming structured full meals.
groups.desc_zh: 指非正餐式的零星进食习惯，表现为小口咬嚼、挑挑拣拣或全天散漫吃零食，区别于正襟危坐的三餐摄入。
groups.nuance_en: snack: eating small amounts of light food between regular meals (chips / fruit / mid-morning) · pick at: eating listlessly and unenthusiastically in tiny, reluctant fragments (food / salad / dinner) · peck at: taking small, bird-like, hurried bites without genuine appetite (lunch / bread / meal) · nibble: taking tiny, cautious, delicate bites of something (cookie / cheese / lip) · graze: eating small snacks continuously throughout the day rather than sitting down to meals (buffet / all day / snacks)
groups.nuance_zh: snack: 两餐之间吃点零食小吃垫饥 (chips / fruit / mid-morning) · pick at: 毫无食欲地挑拣拨弄饭菜 (food / salad / dinner) · peck at: 如鸟啄食般无精打采地小口轻咬 (lunch / bread / meal) · nibble: 细嚼小口慢慢啃吃 (cookie / cheese / lip) · graze: 像牛羊吃草般在一天里零星持续吃点心 (buffet / all day / snacks)

groups.name: Ground & Earth · 接地与深埋 (Ground, Embed, Anchor)
groups.tip: 引入地线或埋覆于泥土中

items.def_en: To connect an electrical device or wire to the physical earth to prevent electric shock or damage
items.ex_en: The certified electrician made sure to ground the metal fuse box properly.
items.ex_zh: 持证电工确保将金属保险丝盒正确接入地线以防触电。

items.def_zh: 把（电线）接地；用土把（植物）覆上
items.def_en: To connect an electrical circuit or device to the ground for safety; to cover the stems or roots of a plant with earth.
items.ex_en: The technician will earth the entire wiring system before testing the heavy equipment.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员在测试重型设备前，会将整个布线系统安全接地。

items.def_en: To establish something firmly in earth, soil, or deep foundations
items.ex_en: The gardener rooted the young apple trees deeply in rich, fertile loam.
items.ex_zh: 园丁将幼小的苹果树苗深深地扎根种植在肥沃的壤土中。
items.ex2_en: Healthy willow cuttings root quickly when placed in fresh water near a sunny window.
items.ex2_zh: 健康的柳树插条放在向阳窗户附近的清水中很快就会生根。

items.def_en: To drive, dig, or bury a post, foundation, or shaft deeply into the earth or sea floor
items.ex_en: Engineers will sink massive concrete pylons deep into the soft riverbed tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们明天将把巨大的混凝土桩柱深深打入柔软的河床中。
items.ex2_en: Heavy iron anchors sink quickly beneath the stormy ocean surface to the seafloor.
items.ex2_zh: 沉重的铁锚迅速沉入波涛汹涌的海面之下，直达海底。

items.def_en: To fasten something firmly to the ground or a rigid base so that it cannot move
items.ex_en: They used heavy steel bolts to anchor the metal frame to the floor.
items.ex_zh: 他们使用重型钢制螺栓把金属框架牢牢固定在地板上。
items.ex2_en: The deep roots of coastal mangroves anchor firmly in the soft underwater silt.
items.ex2_zh: 沿海红树林深扎的根系牢牢地固定在水下松软的淤泥之中。

items.def_en: To fix something firmly and deeply in a surrounding mass of soil, rock, or concrete
items.ex_en: Workers embed heavy steel reinforcement bars into the damp concrete for extra strength.
items.ex_zh: 工人们把重型钢筋深嵌进湿混凝土中，以提供额外强度。

groups.summary_en: Concerns completing an electrical circuit to the physical earth for surge safety, or securing something firmly into the soil or structural foundation. 'Earth' (chiefly BrE) and 'ground' (chiefly AmE) are electrical synonyms, while 'embed' stresses deep physical insertion.
groups.summary_zh: 指电气接通大地以保安全，或将构件牢固埋入地下。
groups.desc_en: Profiles fixing an object, system, or circuit securely into an immovable base, earth, or deep substrate to provide fundamental stability, safety, or permanence, contrasting with surface placement.
groups.desc_zh: 指将物体、电气系统或理论根基牢固固定于大地或底层基质之中，以获取绝对的稳固、安全或长久性，区别于浮于表面的放置。
groups.nuance_en: ground: connecting an electrical circuit to earth or basing arguments on reality (wire / aircraft / argument) · root: establishing firm, deep-seated organic origins in a substrate (trees / tradition / culture) · sink: driving deep into ground or water substrate (shaft / foundations / piling) · anchor: securing firmly against drift or movement using heavy tackle or principles (ship / tent / expectations) · embed: inserting deeply and tightly into a surrounding solid mass (chip / bullet / journalist)
groups.nuance_zh: ground: 电气接地保安全或使论点植根现实 (wire / aircraft / argument) · root: 深深扎根于文化土壤或物理底层 (trees / tradition / culture) · sink: 将立柱或地基深沉打入地下或水底 (shaft / foundations / piling) · anchor: 抛锚固定以防漂移，或作为锚点维稳 (ship / tent / expectations) · embed: 紧紧嵌入围裹物或牢固植入内部 (chip / bullet / journalist)

groups.name: Habituate & Familiarize · 习惯与使适应 (Condition, Acclimate, Inure)
groups.tip: 调整认知以融入新境

items.def_en: To progressively become accustomed to a situation, noise, or condition until it feels normal
items.ex_en: The factory workers slowly grew used to the deafening roar of the machinery.
items.ex_zh: 工厂工人们慢慢逐渐习惯了机器发出的震耳欲聋的轰鸣声。

items.def_en: To train or train someone's mind or body to react in a particular habitual way
items.ex_en: Intense survival training will condition the elite soldiers to endure freezing weather.
items.ex_zh: 高强度的生存训练将锻炼使这些精锐士兵适应严寒天气。

items.def_en: ('accustom oneself/someone to') To make oneself or someone familiar with a new situation, habit, or environment.
items.ex_en: The explorer struggled to accustom himself to the intense arctic cold and darkness.
items.ex_zh: 探险家努力让自己适应北极刺骨的严寒与漫长的黑暗。

items.def_en: To make someone or oneself familiar with a condition or behavior through repeated exposure
