items.ex_en: Constant exposure will habituate lab animals to frequent human handling and medical checks.
items.ex_zh: 长期的接触会使实验动物习惯频繁的人工操作与医疗检查。

items.def_en: To get used to a new climate, altitude, culture, or operational environment
items.ex_en: Hikers usually rest for several days to acclimate to the extreme mountain altitude.
items.ex_zh: 徒步旅行者通常会休整几天，以适应极高的高山海拔。

items.def_en: (+ to) To make someone toughened to or less affected by hardship, pain, or unpleasantness through prolonged experience
items.ex_en: Years of solitary living in the wilderness had inured the trapper to hardship.
items.ex_zh: 多年在荒野中的独居生活，使这个捕猎者习惯了各种艰苦磨难。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the psychological or physiological process of becoming used to conditions, stresses, or routines over time. Some verbs highlight voluntary acclimation, while others emphasize hardening against hardship.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过反复接触或训练，逐渐适应乃至对艰辛习以为常。
groups.desc_en: Maps the progressive adaptation of human or animal psychology/physiology to challenging conditions or behavioral patterns, contrasting with instant adjustment by underscoring time and repeated exposure.
groups.desc_zh: 体现身心机制经受长期、反复的外部刺激或恶劣环境后，逐步形成生理或心理耐受与习性，区别于瞬间顺应，强调时间的钝化历程。
groups.nuance_en: condition: training reflex or psychological response through repetitive reinforcement (reflex / mind / athlete) · accustom: familiarizing oneself or someone to a new baseline norm over time (oneself / taste / habits) · habituate: making a stimulus feel normal through regular psychological tolerance (smell / drug / routine) · acclimate: adjusting physiologically or behaviorally to an unfamiliar climate or altitude (altitude / climate / environment) · inure: toughening someone to pain, hardship, or misery through prolonged exposure (hardship / violence / cold)
groups.nuance_zh: condition: 经反复训练形成条件反射或身心定势 (reflex / mind / athlete) · accustom: 循序渐进使之习惯新的常态或生活标准 (oneself / taste / habits) · habituate: 习惯化以脱敏常规刺激 (smell / drug / routine) · acclimate: 生理机制逐步适应新气候或高海拔环境 (altitude / climate / environment) · inure: 经受长期艰难困苦而变得麻木、坚韧或不以为意 (hardship / violence / cold)

groups.name: Hairstyling & Personal Grooming · 梳妆修发与弄姿 (Coif, Pompadour, Groom)
groups.tip: 打理毛发仪容修饰外表

items.def_en: To arrange, cut, or shape hair into an attractive design
items.ex_en: A creative hairdresser helped style her hair into an elegant retro chignon.
items.ex_zh: 一位富有创意的发型师帮她将头发打造成优雅的复古发髻。

items.def_en: To apply scented wax or ointment to hair to sleek, hold, or shine it
items.ex_en: The barber used a sweet-scented pomade to sleek back his customer's thick hair.
items.ex_zh: 理发师抹上香气宜人的发油，将顾客浓密的头发整齐地向后梳平。

items.def_en: To backcomb hair toward the roots to give it greater volume
items.ex_en: The stylist began to tease her bangs to add dramatic height and volume.
items.ex_zh: 发型师开始倒梳她的刘海，以增加夸张的高度和蓬松感。

items.def_en: To brush, clean, and make someone's hair or general appearance neat
items.ex_en: He took twenty minutes to wash, shave, and groom himself before the interview.
items.ex_zh: 面试前，他花了二十分钟洗脸、刮胡子并精心整理个人容貌。

items.def_zh: 打理（头发），做发型；给……戴头巾
items.def_en: To style, arrange, or dress someone's hair.
items.ex_en: Renowned stylists gathered backstage to coif the models for the glamorous runway show.
items.ex_zh: 著名发型师齐聚后台，为即将登上华丽走秀的模特们打理发型。

items.def_en: To spend time arranging one's hair, makeup, or clothes with painstaking care
items.ex_en: She stood before the bathroom mirror to primp for nearly an entire hour.
items.ex_zh: 她在浴室镜子前足足细致打扮梳洗了将近一个小时。

groups.summary_en: Verbs describing meticulous personal care directed toward styling, trimming, and arranging hair or appearance to achieve a polished, elegant look.
groups.summary_zh: 集中于做发型、梳理发丝以及修整仪表的精细打理行为。
groups.desc_en: Actions aimed at deliberately arranging, sculpting, or fine-tuning one's hair and physical appearance, contrasting with basic bodily hygiene (washing/cleaning) by focusing on aesthetic presentation and meticulous vanity.
groups.desc_zh: 着眼于对发型与外表进行刻意修整、造型或精细梳理的行为，不同于基础的身体清洁（洗护），强调审美塑造与顾影自怜的讲究。
groups.nuance_en: groom: maintain clean, neat overall appearance (dog / nails / coat) · style: shape aesthetically according to a design (hair / outfit / look) · tease: backcomb strands to artificially create volume (hair / locks / roots) · coif: elaborate, professional hair arranging (curls / tresses) · primp: fussily adjust minor grooming details before a mirror (feathers / appearance / self)
groups.nuance_zh: groom: 打理维护整洁利落的整体外表 (dog / nails / coat) · style: 按特定设计进行发型或美学造型 (hair / outfit / look) · tease: 倒梳打毛发根以营造蓬松感 (hair / locks / roots) · coif: 讲究且精心整饬的做发型 (curls / tresses) · primp: 临镜反复捯饬、挑剔细节 (feathers / appearance / self)

groups.name: Hang & Dangle · 悬挂与垂荡 (Swing, Suspend, Droop)
groups.tip: 悬空吊着随风摇曳晃动

items.def_en: To extend downward freely from an elevated point
items.ex_en: Lush green ivy tendrils hang down gracefully from the crumbling balcony railings.
items.ex_zh: 郁郁葱葱的常春藤卷须从破损的阳台栏杆上优美地垂落下来。

items.def_en: To hang something up from a high support so that it is free on all sides
items.ex_en: The stage crew will suspend a large crystal chandelier high above the orchestra.
items.ex_zh: 舞台工作人员将把一盏巨大的水晶吊灯高高悬挂在管弦乐队上方。

items.def_en: To move slowly or rhythmically backwards and forwards or from side to side
items.ex_en: The tall pine trees sway gently back and forth under the summer breeze.
items.ex_zh: 高大的松树在夏日的微风中轻轻地来回摇曳。
items.ex2_en: Loud thunder and strong winds sway the fragile wooden footbridge across the ravine.
items.ex2_zh: 雷鸣和强风吹得横跨峡谷的脆弱木吊桥摇晃不定。

items.def_zh: 悬垂，摇晃地悬挂；使悬垂；用…引诱
items.def_en: 1. To hang or swing loosely, or hold something so that it does. 2. To offer something attractive to tempt someone.
items.ex_en: Bright silver keys dangle casually from a red leather strap on his backpack.
items.ex_zh: 亮银色的钥匙随意地悬挂垂吊在他背包的红色皮带上。
items.ex2_en: The playful cat owner dangled a piece of red yarn above the kitten.
items.ex2_zh: 爱玩的主人在小猫头顶上晃悠着一根红色的毛线。

items.def_en: To bend or hang downwards limp from lack of strength, moisture, or support
items.ex_en: Freshly cut flowers begin to droop quickly without adequate water in the vase.
items.ex_zh: 新采摘的花朵如果花瓶里水分不足，很快就会蔫瘪下垂。

items.def_en: To move back and forth or sideways while suspended or pivoted from a fixed point
items.ex_en: The children swing gleefully on the old playground tire attached to the oak.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们欢快地在系在橡树上的旧轮胎秋千上荡来荡去。
items.ex2_en: The batter swung the heavy wooden bat forcefully at the incoming curveball yesterday.
items.ex2_zh: 击球手昨天用尽全力将厚重的木质球棒挥向飞来的曲球。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures objects or appendages hanging unsupported from above and swinging loosely or swaying with motion. Figuratively, it extends to holding out enticing prospects to entice someone.
groups.summary_zh: 自上方悬空垂下，并可自由晃荡或摇摆。
groups.desc_en: Entities attached or fixed from above remaining aloft without ground support and subject to gravity or motion, contrasting with rigid standing or anchored bearing by foregrounding down-hanging suspension and loose oscillation.
groups.desc_zh: 附着或固定于上方且脱离地面支撑、受重力或外力摆动的状态，不同于稳固直立或底部承重，强调向下悬挂垂挂与无依附的摇晃。
groups.nuance_en: suspend: attach from above to prevent falling or keep immobile aloft (cable / sentence / particles) · dangle: hang loosely and swing playfully or precariously (legs / bait / carrot) · swing: move rhythmically back and forth on an axis (pendulum / hips / door) · droop: sag downwards under weight, fatigue, or wilt (eyelids / branches / shoulders) · sway: oscillate gently side to side from external force (branches / crowd / bridge)
groups.nuance_zh: suspend: 自上方固定悬吊以防坠落或令其悬浮 (cable / sentence / particles) · dangle: 悬垂并随意或危险地荡晃 (legs / bait / carrot) · swing: 绕支点或轴线作有规律的往复摆动 (pendulum / hips / door) · droop: 因重力、疲软或萎蔫而向下耷拉 (eyelids / branches / shoulders) · sway: 受外力作用左右徐缓摇摆 (branches / crowd / bridge)

groups.name: Harass & Molest · 骚扰与侵害 (Harass, Pester, Assault)
groups.tip: 侵扰挑衅甚至造成人身侵害

items.def_en: to repeatedly urge, ask, or bother someone until they give in
items.ex_en: Desperate reporters badger the retired politician until he finally comments on the scandal.
items.ex_zh: 绝望的记者们不断纠缠那位退休政客，直到他最终对丑闻发表评论。

items.def_en: to annoy someone repeatedly with frequent requests, questions, or interruptions
items.ex_en: Restless children often pester their exhausted mother with silly questions during long drives.
items.ex_zh: 在漫长的车程中，好动的孩子们经常用愚蠢的问题烦扰疲惫的母亲。

items.def_en: to torment or intimidate someone with persistent annoyance, threats, or unwelcome attention
items.ex_en: The corrupt landlord would harass vulnerable tenants with constant eviction threats and inspections.
items.ex_zh: 这个黑心房东不断用驱逐威胁和上门检查来骚扰弱势租户。

items.def_en: to pursue, harass, or urge someone relentlessly without giving them peace
items.ex_en: Aggressive creditors continue to hound the bankrupt businessman day and night for repayment.
items.ex_zh: 激进的债权人日夜紧逼纠缠着这位破产的商人，逼他偿还欠款。

items.def_en: 1. To touch or abuse someone, especially a child, sexually. 2. (formal or dated) To annoy, assault, or interfere with someone in a harmful way.
items.ex_en: The notorious criminal was arrested for attempting to molest an innocent park visitor.
items.ex_zh: 这名臭名昭著的罪犯因企图猥亵一名无辜的公园游客而被捕。

items.def_en: to attack someone violently in a physical or sexual manner
items.ex_en: A masked intruder tried to assault the lone night guard outside the warehouse.
items.ex_zh: 一名蒙面入侵者试图在仓库外暴力殴打袭击那名值夜班的守卫。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe subjecting someone to persistent annoyance, intrusive hostility, intimidation, or physical violation. Nuances range from unrelenting verbal irritation to criminal sexual assault.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖从持续言语纠缠、恶意恐吓到严重肢体侵犯与性骚扰的递进侵害。
groups.desc_en: Persistent, unwanted intrusion or violation of a person's boundaries ranging from irritating demands to criminal bodily violation, contrasting with simple persuasion or single disputes by its aggressive repetition or physical invasiveness.
groups.desc_zh: 对个人心理或身体边界施加的持续性不当侵扰或侵害，从令人恼怒的纠缠升级至刑事人身侵犯，不同于普通劝说或单次冲突，强调重复侵扰或肉体侵凌。
groups.nuance_en: pester: annoy repeatedly with petty requests (parents / staff / officials) · badger: relentlessly press and wear down by interrogation or nagging (witness / minister / boss) · harass: systematically subject to persistent torment or hostile pressure (tenants / workers / dissidents) · hound: pursue tenaciously without giving respite (suspect / debtor / celebrity) · molest: criminally touch or sexually abuse an unwilling victim (child / passenger / victim)
groups.nuance_zh: pester: 用琐碎要求反复纠缠打扰 (parents / staff / officials) · badger: 穷追不舍地质问或唠叨施压 (witness / minister / boss) · harass: 系统性、蓄意进行骚扰施压 (tenants / workers / dissidents) · hound: 如猎犬般咬住不放地围堵紧逼 (suspect / debtor / celebrity) · molest: 猥亵或性侵犯违背意愿者 (child / passenger / victim)

groups.name: Harden & Solidify · 固化与坚硬 (Harden, Solidify, Petrify)
groups.tip: 质地变硬强化坚固度

items.def_zh: （使）变硬，（使）硬化；（使态度或人）变坚决，变冷酷
items.def_en: 1. To become firm, solid, or stiff, or to make something solid. 2. To become or make someone more tough, determined, or unsympathetic.
items.ex_en: Wet cement will slowly harden into durable concrete over the next twenty-four hours.
items.ex_zh: 湿水泥将在接下来的二十四小时内慢慢硬化成坚固的混凝土。
items.ex2_en: Cold mountain air and freezing winter winds quickly harden soft mud into stone.
items.ex2_zh: 清冷的的山间空气和刺骨的冬风迅速将软泥冻得坚硬如石。

items.def_zh: 变硬；使生硬；增强坚定性
items.def_en: To become firm, rigid, or less flexible, or to strengthen resolve
items.ex_en: The cold wind caused the wet fabric of his trousers to stiffen rapidly.
items.ex_zh: 寒风让他裤子上湿漉漉的布料迅速变硬。
items.ex2_en: Recent unexpected military threats stiffen the resolve of national leaders to resist aggression.
items.ex2_zh: 最近突如其来的军事威胁坚定了国家领导人抵抗侵略的决心。

items.def_en: To separate into curds and whey, or to coagulate into solid clumps
items.ex_en: Adding lemon juice to warm milk will cause it to curdle immediately.
items.ex_zh: 将柠檬汁加入热牛奶中会使牛奶立刻凝结成絮状。
items.ex2_en: Excessive heat during cooking will quickly curdle fresh dairy cream in delicate sauces.
items.ex2_zh: 烹调时温度过高会使精致酱汁中的新鲜鲜奶油迅速结块凝固。

items.def_en: To become hard or firm, or to make an agreement or relationship more definite and robust
items.ex_en: The two companies signed an agreement to solidify their ongoing commercial partnership.
items.ex_zh: 两家公司签署了一项协议，以巩固他们现有的商业伙伴关系。
items.ex2_en: Molten volcanic lava solidifies rapidly upon coming into contact with cold ocean seawater.
items.ex2_zh: 熔融的火山岩浆在接触到冰冷的海水后迅速凝固。

items.def_en: To become hard and stony through deposits of calcium, or to become inflexible and resistant to change
items.ex_en: Years of bureaucratic inertia caused the once dynamic institution to calcify completely.
items.ex_zh: 多年的官僚惰性使这个曾经充满活力的机构彻底僵化。
items.ex2_en: Prolonged chemical exposure can gradually calcify soft arterial tissues over several decades.
items.ex2_zh: 长期的化学物质接触可能会在数十年间逐渐使柔软的动脉组织钙化。

items.def_en: To change organic matter slowly into stone, or figuratively to make attitudes rigid and unchangeable
items.ex_en: Millennia of mineral-rich water worked slowly to petrify the fallen ancient tree.
items.ex_zh: 数千年来富含矿物质的水流缓慢作用，使倒下的古树完全石化。
items.ex2_en: Fallen prehistoric trees petrify slowly when buried under thick volcanic ash over millennia.
items.ex2_zh: 倒下的史前古树在厚厚的火山灰掩埋下历经数千年慢慢石化。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on scalar transitions from soft, pliable, or fluid states to rigid, tough, and impenetrable conditions. It applies equally to physical materials curing into stone/metal and human attitudes becoming unyielding, callous, or unbending.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体由软变硬、凝固，或人的态度意志变得坚决冷酷。
groups.desc_en: The physical or metaphorical transition of a pliable, liquid, or adaptable substance into an unyielding, rigid, or permanent state, contrasting with simple freezing by implying structural densification, chemical settling, or total loss of flexibility.
groups.desc_zh: 柔韧、流体或具适应性的事物向僵硬、固化或不可逆状态的转变，不同于简单的冻结，强调内部结构致密化、化学凝聚或弹性的彻底丧失。
groups.nuance_en: solidify: transition from fluid to coherent solid or consolidate an abstract plan (mass / position / support) · harden: increase structural firmness or emotional callousness (arteries / resolve / attitude) · curdle: congeal into lumps via chemical reaction or spoil (milk / blood / cream) · calcify: turn into brittle calcium or become inflexibly rigid (tissue / dogma / bureaucracy) · petrify: turn to stone organically or paralyze completely with fear (wood / fossils / bystanders)
groups.nuance_zh: solidify: 从流体凝为坚固整体或使抽象计划落实 (mass / position / support) · harden: 物理硬化或心理变得冷酷坚决 (arteries / resolve / attitude) · curdle: 凝乳结块或使（血液/情绪）冻结凝固 (milk / blood / cream) · calcify: 钙化或使体制/思想彻底僵化 (tissue / dogma / bureaucracy) · petrify: 石化变为矿物或吓得呆若木鸡 (wood / fossils / bystanders)

groups.name: Hasten & Accelerate · 加速与疾行 (Hasten, Speed Up, Quicken)
groups.tip: 速度逐渐加快或促进行程

items.def_en: To move or act with speed, or cause someone to do so quickly
items.ex_en: You need to hurry or you will miss the morning train to London.
items.ex_zh: 你必须快点，否则你就会错过早班开往伦敦的火车。
items.ex2_en: Anxious parents hurried their frightened young children into the underground bomb shelter quickly.
items.ex2_zh: 焦急的父母迅速催促着受惊的小孩跑进地下防空洞。

items.def_en: To move faster or make something happen at a faster rate
items.ex_en: The factory introduced automation to speed up the sluggish vehicle assembly process.
items.ex_zh: 该工厂引入自动化技术以加快缓慢的汽车组装流程。

items.def_en: To move swiftly or do something too rapidly without deliberation
items.ex_en: Do not rush into a major financial commitment without consulting your accountant.
items.ex_zh: 在咨询会计师之前，切勿匆忙做出重大的财务承诺。
items.ex2_en: The busy emergency clinic had to rush essential medical supplies to remote flood-stricken villages.
items.ex2_zh: 繁忙的急救诊所不得不将急需的医疗用品火速运往偏远的受灾村庄。

items.def_en: 1. To make something happen sooner or more quickly. 2. To move or act swiftly.
items.ex_en: The dark gathering clouds seemed to hasten the arrival of a gloomy dusk.
items.ex_zh: 聚拢的乌云似乎加速了阴沉黄昏的降临。
items.ex2_en: The anxious students hasten toward the examination hall before the morning bell rings.
items.ex2_zh: 焦虑的学生们在早读铃声响起之前急忙奔向考场。

items.def_en: To become quicker or make pace, pulse, or actions move faster
items.ex_en: Her footsteps began to quicken as the lonely road grew progressively darker.
items.ex_zh: 随着寂静的道路越发昏暗，她的脚步开始加快。

items.def_en: To start to move faster, or cause a process to occur more rapidly
items.ex_en: The driver pressed the pedal hard to accelerate past the slow truck.
items.ex_zh: 司机猛踩油门加速，超过了那辆缓慢行驶的卡车。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe accelerating the pace of physical travel or causing events and transitions to occur far earlier than scheduled.
groups.summary_zh: 指加快自身的移动行进速度，或人为使某事件提前、快速推进发生。
groups.desc_en: Active reduction of transit time or speeding up of event tempo driven by urgency or mechanical power, contrasting with mere continuous motion by emphasizing a marked increase in velocity to beat a deadline.
groups.desc_zh: 因紧迫感或动力驱使而主动缩短耗时或提高节奏，不同于一般的持续移动，强调为了赶时间而显著提升运转或行进速率。
groups.nuance_en: hasten: prompt rapid action or prematurely bring about an event (departure / demise / ruin) · quicken: make lively, responsive, or perceptibly faster in tempo (pulse / pace / steps) · speed up: mechanically or practically increase operating rate (process / production / recovery) · accelerate: continuously increase rate of change or velocity according to dynamic laws (growth / inflation / vehicle) · rush: act or move with frantic, often disorderly haste (decision / patient / stage)
groups.nuance_zh: hasten: 因急迫而促进行动或催化某事提前发生 (departure / demise / ruin) · quicken: 使节律、步频或生命体征明显加快活跃 (pulse / pace / steps) · speed up: 机械或实际操作层面提速 (process / production / recovery) · accelerate: 物理加速或使发展态势持续激增 (growth / inflation / vehicle) · rush: 仓促鲁莽、忙乱甚至忙中有错地猛冲 (decision / patient / stage)

groups.name: Haul & Drag · 拖拉与牵引 (Haul, Tow, Lug)
groups.tip: 用力牵拉拖拽物体向前移动

items.def_en: To drag or allow something to drag loosely along the ground behind someone or something
items.ex_en: The child allowed his long woolen scarf to trail loosely in the mud.
items.ex_zh: 那个孩子任由他的长毛线围巾拖在泥地里。

items.def_en: To take something or someone away awkwardly or forcefully, as if on a cart
items.ex_en: The angry landlord began to cart off the tenant's remaining broken furniture.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的房东开始费力运走房客留下来的破旧家具。

items.def_en: To pull something heavy or reluctant along the ground with effort and friction
items.ex_en: Two heavy laborers struggled to drag the fallen log across the field.
items.ex_zh: 两名健壮的工人费力地将那根倒下的原木拖过田野。

items.def_en: To pull a vehicle, boat, or equipment along behind another vehicle using a rope, chain, or towbar
items.ex_en: The emergency truck had to tow the damaged sedan to a nearby garage.
items.ex_zh: 抢险拖车不得不把受损的轿车拖到附近的修车厂。

items.def_en: To carry or drag something heavy and awkward with clumsy, tiresome effort
items.ex_en: She had to lug three overflowing suitcases up five flights of steep stairs.
items.ex_zh: 她不得不费力地把三个装得过满的行李箱提上五层陡峭的楼梯。

items.def_en: 1. To pull or drag something heavy with continuous effort. 2. To transport goods or materials by truck, cart, or ship.
items.ex_en: The local freight company will haul industrial machinery across the desert highway.
items.ex_zh: 当地的货运公司将通过沙漠公路运送这批工业机械。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe pulling heavy, cumbersome objects across a surface or transporting large loads with sustained physical effort or mechanical power. Nuances differentiate surface friction, mechanical towing, and awkward burdens.
groups.summary_zh: 指克服地面摩擦或巨大阻力，费力拖曳重物或机械牵引大批物资。
groups.desc_en: Expending heavy physical force to pull resistant, heavy, or non-self-propelled burdens across a surface or distance, contrasting with lightweight carrying by emphasizing friction, ponderous weight, and mechanical strain.
groups.desc_zh: 施加重力将沉重、无动力或具阻力之物沿表面或特定路线拉扯转移，不同于轻巧的搬运，强调摩擦力、笨重负荷与机械性费力。
groups.nuance_en: drag: pull forcefully along the ground against substantial friction (body / feet / luggage) · tow: pull a trailing vehicle or vessel using a line or hitch (car / barge / glider) · haul: transport heavy cargo over long distance or hoist with effort (freight / timber / catch) · lug: carry or drag an unwieldy, awkward load with labor (baggage / equipment / boxes) · trail: drag loosely behind on a surface without lifting (dress / lead / smoke)
groups.nuance_zh: drag: 克服地面摩擦力费力拖拽 (body / feet / luggage) · tow: 用缆绳或拖钩牵引车辆/船只 (car / barge / glider) · haul: 远距离重载运输或费力拉拽大批量物品 (freight / timber / catch) · lug: 笨手笨脚、吃力地提拉或拖运沉重累赘物 (baggage / equipment / boxes) · trail: 在身后松散曳地或拖带出痕迹 (dress / lead / smoke)

groups.name: Heavy Drinking & Imbibing · 痛饮与酗酒 (Booze, Binge, Guzzle)
groups.tip: 从慢饮微醺到暴饮滥醉

items.def_en: To drink intoxicating liquor habitually or in small, repeated quantities
items.ex_en: The retired magistrate would tipple fine sherry alone in his candlelit study.
items.ex_zh: 退职的治安官常常在点着蜡烛的书房里独自小酌优质雪利酒。

items.def_en: To drink an alcoholic drink down quickly in large gulps
items.ex_en: He managed to knock back two pints of stout before the match started.
items.ex_zh: 他在比赛开始前一口气灌下了两品脱世涛啤酒。

items.def_en: To drink an alcoholic beverage heartily and with great enjoyment
items.ex_en: The thirsty hikers stopped at the inn to quaff large mugs of ale.
items.ex_zh: 口渴的徒步旅行者停在客栈里，痛饮大扎大扎的麦芽酒。

items.def_en: (informal) To drink alcohol, especially in large quantities.
items.ex_en: The off-duty soldiers went into town to booze until the early morning.
items.ex_zh: 休假的士兵们进城去通宵豪饮，直到清晨。

items.def_en: (+ on) To indulge in an unrestrained, excessive period of alcohol consumption
items.ex_en: He tends to binge on cheap beer whenever work stress becomes overwhelming.
items.ex_zh: 每当工作压力过大时，他总会狂饮廉价啤酒消愁。

items.def_en: To drink liquor greedily, noisily, or in very large amounts
items.ex_en: The rowdy college students guzzle cold beer during every home football game.
items.ex_zh: 那些吵闹的大学生在每场主场橄榄球赛期间都大口狂灌冰啤酒。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe heavy, intemperate, or enthusiastic consumption of alcohol, often in social revelry or compulsive bouts.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重大肆饮酒、海量灌酒或沉溺杯中之物的豪饮与酗酒行为。
groups.desc_en: Consuming intoxicating liquor excessively, rapaciously, or habitually, contrasting with civilized, moderate sipping by emphasizing large volumes, intoxicating intent, and loss of restraint.
groups.desc_zh: 大肆、贪婪或习惯性地过量饮用酒精饮料，不同于温和文明的小酌品鉴，强调牛饮之量、求醉之意与毫无节制。
groups.nuance_en: tipple: drink liquor habitually in small, frequent amounts (whisky / gin / daily) · knock back: swallow a drink quickly and heartily in one gulp (pint / shots / drink) · quaff: drink a large beverage heartily with gusto (ale / wine / brew) · booze: engage in heavy, prolonged, unstructured drinking (night / weekends / friends) · guzzle: drink or consume greedily and copiously (beer / fuel / soda)
groups.nuance_zh: tipple: 习惯性频繁喝上几口小酒 (whisky / gin / daily) · knock back: 仰头一饮而尽、豪饮干下 (pint / shots / drink) · quaff: 痛快开怀地大口畅饮佳酿 (ale / wine / brew) · booze: 长时间、无节制地聚众酗酒胡饮 (night / weekends / friends) · guzzle: 贪婪暴饮、狂喝海塞 (beer / fuel / soda)

groups.name: Hesitate & Vacillate · 犹豫与摇摆 (Waver, Dither, Hesitate)
groups.tip: 举棋不定并在多方选择间摇摆

items.def_en: To pause before saying or doing something through reluctance, uncertainty, or doubt
items.ex_en: Do not hesitate to ask questions if you require any further assistance.
items.ex_zh: 如果您需要进一步的帮助，请毫不犹豫地提问。

items.def_en: To shift back and forth irregularly in stance, opinion, or sentiment
items.ex_en: Public sentiment continued to fluctuate between profound sympathy and rising public outrage.
items.ex_zh: 公众舆论在深切同情与日益高涨的公愤之间剧烈摇摆。

items.def_en: To spend time being chronically indecisive and failing to commit to an action
items.ex_en: Stop trying to shilly-shally and make up your mind about the job.
items.ex_zh: 别再优柔寡断了，快对这份工作拿定主意吧。

items.def_en: (+ between) To show indecisiveness, flicker in determination, or hesitate between two options
items.ex_en: She began to waver between accepting the overseas scholarship and staying home.
items.ex_zh: 她开始在接受海外奖学金和留在家乡之间犹豫不决。

items.def_en: (+ over/about) To be anxiously indecisive and unable to settle on a course of action
items.ex_en: He will dither over which menu item to order for twenty minutes.
items.ex_zh: 他能为菜单上点哪道菜犹豫不决磨蹭二十分钟。

items.def_en: 1. (+ between) (formal) To waver or alternate between different opinions, actions, or choices without making up one's mind.
items.ex_en: The indecisive politician would vacillate between opposing policy options before the vote.
items.ex_zh: 在表决之前，这位优柔寡断的政客在对立的政策选项之间摇摆不定。

groups.summary_en: Details the cognitive and behavioral instability of someone constantly shifting between choices, lacking firm resolve, or delaying decisions.
groups.summary_zh: 描写心理游移不决、反复摇摆不定或迟疑拖延的态度。
groups.desc_en: Mental suspension between conflicting choices or paths characterized by indecision, delay, and lack of resolute commitment, contrasting with definitive choice or steady deliberation by stressing oscillating unsteadiness.
groups.desc_zh: 在相互冲突的选择之间悬而不决的心智停滞状态，不同于笃定的决断或有条理的权衡，强调摇摆不定、拖延与意志脆弱。
groups.nuance_en: hesitate: pause briefly due to uncertainty, fear, or reluctance (reply / decision / moment) · waver: lose firmness and fluctuate between two distinct stances (resolve / loyalty / support) · vacillate: repeatedly alternate back and forth between contradictory courses (opinions / policies / minds) · dither: waste time in nervous, agitated indecisiveness over trivial choices (details / clothes / choice) · shilly-shally: stall procrastinatingly with timidity or evasiveness (matters / reform / actions)
groups.nuance_zh: hesitate: 因疑虑、畏怯或迟疑而出现短暂停顿 (reply / decision / moment) · waver: 意志、立场在两极间摇撼不定 (resolve / loyalty / support) · vacillate: 在截然相反的政见或决定间反覆无常 (opinions / policies / minds) · dither: 焦虑不安、六神无主地在琐事上瞎纠结 (details / clothes / choice) · shilly-shally: 怯懦畏缩地优柔寡断、久拖不决 (matters / reform / actions)

groups.name: Hijack & Commandeer · 劫持与强征 (Commandeer, Usurp, Expropriate)
groups.tip: 强行扣押载具或征调物资

items.def_en: To gain control of a company, vehicle, agenda, or responsibility
items.ex_en: The aggressive software giant plans to take over its smaller domestic rival.
items.ex_zh: 这家行事激进的软件巨头计划接管其规模较小的国内竞争对手。

items.def_en: To divert, absorb, or assimilate an idea or role for one's own purpose
items.ex_en: The executive tried to co-opt grassroots initiatives to enhance corporate brand image.
items.ex_zh: 这位主管试图将民间草根的倡议据为己用，以提升企业品牌形象。

items.def_zh: 劫持（飞机等交通工具）；强行控制，篡夺
items.def_en: 1. To seize control of an aircraft, ship, or vehicle illegally by force. 2. To take control of something, such as a meeting or discussion, and use it for one's own purpose.
items.ex_en: Masked extremists plotted to hijack the commercial flight during its final approach.
items.ex_zh: 蒙面极端分子密谋在客机最后进近降落阶段实施劫持。

items.def_en: To take someone's power, position, or authority without having the legal right
items.ex_en: The rebellious general plotted to usurp royal authority during the ongoing famine.
items.ex_zh: 叛乱的将军密谋在持续的饥荒中篡夺王室的权威。

items.def_en: To officially or high-handedly take possession of private property for temporary use
items.ex_en: Soldiers arrived at dawn to commandeer several civilian trucks for troop transport.
items.ex_zh: 士兵们拂晓时赶来强征了几辆民用卡车用于运送部队。

items.def_en: (+ to oneself) To claim or take something, such as a right, without justification
items.ex_en: The arrogant junior officer attempted to arrogate to himself decisive executive powers.
items.ex_zh: 那个傲慢的初级军官企图擅自为自己霸占决定性的执行权力。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame emphasize taking illicit or high-handed control over vehicles, organizations, public discussions, or processes for one's own agenda.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过强硬手腕或非法途径擅自夺取载具、平台议题或权力的支配控制。
groups.desc_en: Illegitimately redirecting, pre-empting, or seizing control of an institution, resource, or process for an unauthorized agenda, contrasting with legal acquisition by emphasizing opportunistic breach of authority or diversion.
groups.desc_zh: 非正当地劫持、篡夺或挪用机构、资源或议程以服务于私利，不同于合法征收或常规接管，强调越权侵犯与霸道偏离原定轨道。
groups.nuance_en: hijack: divert an existing agenda or debate aggressively for one's own ends (meeting / debate / narrative) · commandeer: arbitrarily requisition private property or tools for urgent official or personal use (vehicle / building / resources) · usurp: illegally snatch sovereign power or authority belonging to another (throne / power / role) · co-opt: absorb or assimilate a rival idea/group into one's own system to neutralize opposition (movement / rhetoric / critics) · arrogate: presumptuously claim rights or powers without legal justification (privilege / authority / rights)
groups.nuance_zh: hijack: 强行劫持、扭曲会议或公共议题的走向 (meeting / debate / narrative) · commandeer: 强行征用私人财产/物资以应急或自用 (vehicle / building / resources) · usurp: 篡夺不属于自己的王位或法定大权 (throne / power / role) · co-opt: 收编或拉拢异己理念/人员以消解阻力 (movement / rhetoric / critics) · arrogate: 擅断妄取、僭越地声称拥有权利 (privilege / authority / rights)

groups.name: Hijack & Seize Control · 劫持与强夺 (Skyjack, Seize, Pirate)
groups.tip: 武力强占交通工具并扣留人质

items.def_en: To gain control of an enemy vehicle, position, or person by force
items.ex_en: Elite commando units managed to capture the strategic radar base without casualties.
items.ex_zh: 精锐突击部队成功夺取了那处战略雷达基地，且无一伤亡。

items.def_en: To seize a ship or cargo at sea by violence; to appropriate without authorization
items.ex_en: Heavily armed raiders planned to pirate valuable oil tankers in international waters.
items.ex_zh: 全副武装的袭击者密谋在公海海域武装劫掠高价值油轮。

items.def_en: To take possession of someone or something quickly, forcibly, or by legal power
items.ex_en: Federal agents moved quickly to seize the illegal assets stored in Zurich.
items.ex_zh: 联邦特工迅速采取行动，查封了存放于苏黎世的非法资产。

items.def_zh: 劫持（飞机、车辆等）；强行夺取
items.def_en: (variant spelling of hijack) To illegally seize control of an aircraft, vehicle, or cargo by force.
items.ex_en: Armed insurgents attempted to highjack the regional passenger train near the border.
items.ex_zh: 武装叛乱分子企图在边境附近强行劫持那列地区客运火车。

items.def_en: To hijack an aircraft while in flight using force or intimidation
items.ex_en: Two desperate convicts managed to skyjack the chartered plane mid-flight yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 两名亡命之徒昨天在飞行途中劫持了那架包机。

items.def_en: To seize a vehicle from its driver by using violence or coercion
items.ex_en: Masked gunmen attempted to carjack the luxury limousine at the red light.
items.ex_zh: 蒙面持枪歹徒试图在红灯处强行劫持那辆豪华轿车。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express forcibly and illegally seizing transit vehicles, transit goods, or operational control by threat of armed violence.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过武力威胁，非法抢夺交通载具、货物或控制权的强盗与劫持行为。
groups.desc_en: Violently seizing physical control of a vehicle, vessel, or craft while in transit to dictate its destination or hold it hostage, contrasting with stationary vehicle theft by emphasizing underway confrontation and commandeering.
groups.desc_zh: 在交通工具运行途中以暴力或威逼手段强夺其控制权以改变目的地或作为人质要挟，不同于停放时的静态盗窃，强调行进间的突袭与挟持。
groups.nuance_en: hijack: forcibly take illicit control of a vehicle, convoy, or shipment en route (plane / lorry / shipment) · skyjack: specifically seize control of an airplane in flight (airliner / flight / aircraft) · carjack: assault the driver of a motor vehicle to steal it by force (car / vehicle / SUV) · pirate: attack, board, and rob vessels or intercept goods at sea (vessel / ship / broadcast) · seize: capture suddenly and legally or by overwhelming force (weapons / ship / cargo)
groups.nuance_zh: hijack: 在运输途中暴力截获、控制车辆或货运 (plane / lorry / shipment) · skyjack: 特指在飞行途中劫持民航班机 (airliner / flight / aircraft) · carjack: 街头截停车辆并暴力威逼车主夺取汽车 (car / vehicle / SUV) · pirate: 海上登船劫掠或非法截收/盗播 (vessel / ship / broadcast) · seize: 凭借压倒性武力或法令强行查扣扣押 (weapons / ship / cargo)

groups.name: Hit & Kick · 击打与踢触 (Punt, Boot, Loft)
groups.tip: 用力踢打碰撞物体

items.def_zh: 凌空踢（球）；撑（平底船）；赌博，碰运气
items.def_en: 1. (sports) To kick a ball after dropping it from one's hands before it hits the ground. 2. To propel a flat-bottomed boat with a pole. 3. (informal) To gamble or bet on something.
items.ex_en: The experienced kicker managed to punt the football deep into opponent territory.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的踢球员凌空一脚，将橄榄球深深踢入对手半场。

items.def_en: To strike or kick a ball upward so that it travels high into the air
items.ex_en: The midfielder stepped forward to loft the ball neatly over the defense.
items.ex_zh: 中场球员上前起脚，将球巧妙地高高挑过对方防线。

items.def_en: To strike a ball abruptly using the end of the toes
items.ex_en: The striker managed to toe-poke the loose ball past the sprawling goalkeeper.
items.ex_zh: 前锋趁乱用脚尖一捅，将球送过扑倒在地的门将。

items.def_en: To kick or strike a ball before it bounces on the ground
items.ex_en: The forward timed his leap perfectly to volley the cross into goal.
items.ex_zh: 前锋起跳时机分秒不差，凌空抽射将传中球踢入球门。

items.def_en: To kick an athletic ball forcefully and far downfield
items.ex_en: The frustrated defender tried to boot the clearing ball out of bounds.
items.ex_zh: 心烦意乱的后卫一记大脚解围，试图把球踢出边线。

items.def_en: (informal) To kick a football long and hard without precision
items.ex_en: Under intense defensive pressure, the fullback chose to hoof the ball away.
items.ex_zh: 在严密防守的压力下，这名边卫选择大脚把球乱踢解围。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate striking an airborne or descending athletic ball with foot, boot, or paddle to propel it high, deep, or evasively downfield, balancing kinetic force with trajectory control.
groups.summary_zh: 用脚掌、足尖或器具凌空起脚踢击或推挑球体。
groups.desc_en: Propelling a ball or projectile using the foot or lower leg via distinctive striking techniques and biomechanics, contrasting with general hand striking by its specific athletic trajectories and foot interfaces.
groups.desc_zh: 运用足部或小腿通过特定技术机制踢击球体或抛射物，不同于用手的常规打击，强调基于运动专项的脚法触球方式与抛物线轨迹。
groups.nuance_en: punt: drop a ball from the hands and kick it before it touches the ground (football / ball / kick) · volley: strike a ball while it is still in mid-air before it bounces (shot / cross / ball) · boot: strike a ball or object powerfully, roughly, or indiscriminately with the boot (ball / clearance / door) · loft: kick or strike a ball softly into a high arcing trajectory (cross / pass / ball) · hoof: kick a football hard, high, and without tactical subtlety downfield (ball / clearance / shot)
groups.nuance_zh: punt: 弃手凌空踢球，即球未触地前凌空抽踢 (football / ball / kick) · volley: 凌空抽射，在球落地前直接凌空补击 (shot / cross / ball) · boot: 大脚猛踢或粗暴地踢开 (ball / clearance / door) · loft: 将球挑击成高弧线过顶吊射/传球 (cross / pass / ball) · hoof: 毫无章法地将球大脚高高开向后场 (ball / clearance / shot)

groups.name: Hit & Tap · 轻触与推杆 (Putt, Tap in, Nudge)
groups.tip: 控制力度进行击打或触碰

items.def_en: To knock a ball easily into the hole or net from very close range
items.ex_en: The striker only needed to tap in the rebound from close range.
items.ex_zh: 这名前锋只需在近距离轻轻推射，将反弹球送入球门。

items.def_en: To hit a ball lightly and softly just over an obstacle or into a nearby target zone
items.ex_en: The clever player managed to dink the tennis ball over the net.
items.ex_zh: 这位机敏的选手巧妙地将网球轻轻推挑过了球网。

items.def_en: To push a ball or object very gently so it rolls slowly forward
items.ex_en: He used his foot to nudge the stationary ball toward his teammate.
items.ex_zh: 他用脚轻轻一拨，将静止的皮球推向了身旁的队友。

items.def_en: (in golf) To hit a golf ball gently across the green with a putter toward or into the hole.
items.ex_en: The champion golfer prepared carefully to putt the ball from twelve feet.
items.ex_zh: 冠军高尔夫球手严阵以待，准备在十二英尺外推球入洞。

items.def_en: To hit a sports ball with a smooth, deliberate, and controlled swing or motion
items.ex_en: She used smooth wrist control to stroke the ball cleanly toward target.
items.ex_zh: 她利用柔顺的手腕控制，平稳推球直奔目标而去。

items.def_en: To propel an object forward with a quick, light movement of the wrist or club
items.ex_en: The forward used his stick to flick the hockey puck into goal.
items.ex_zh: 这名前锋用球棍灵巧一拨，把冰球弹射进了球网。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses controlled, short-distance, precision strokes intended to steer or roll a sports ball or token gently into a pocket, cup, or specific target mark, prioritizing finesse over brute power.
groups.summary_zh: 使用推杆或柔和力道对球施加短程精准轻推或轻拨。
groups.desc_en: Applying subtle, low-impact, precision touch to an object or ball to steer, guide, or roll it gently into a target, contrasting with forceful striking by emphasizing soft finesse and micro-distance management.
groups.desc_zh: 对物体或球体施加微妙、低冲击力的精准微触以推引其入位，不同于发力猛击，强调轻盈手感、微小距离调控与巧劲。
groups.nuance_en: putt: strike a golf ball smoothly to roll it along the turf into a hole (ball / shot / green) · tap in: finish an easy scoring chance with an effortless short-range nudge (rebound / winner / shot) · nudge: push gently and softly to shift position or prompt notice (ball / shoulder / needle) · dink: delicately chip or flick a soft, short-arcing shot over an obstacle (pass / ball / shot) · flick: move or strike with a quick, snapping, light wrist motion (wrist / ball / switch)
groups.nuance_zh: putt: （高尔夫）推杆推球滚向洞杯 (ball / shot / green) · tap in: 近距离轻松顺势补射进球 (rebound / winner / shot) · nudge: 轻推、微蹭使其轻缓移位 (ball / shoulder / needle) · dink: 巧打轻挑，打出柔和近网挑球或挑传 (pass / ball / shot) · flick: 抖动手腕作短促、轻灵的轻弹抽打 (wrist / ball / switch)

groups.name: Hitch & Tether · 系扣与拴接 (Hitch, Tether, Lash, Mooring)
groups.tip: 用绳索等束缚或系住

items.def_en: To join or link two vehicles, mechanisms, or parts together using a hitch or coupling device
items.ex_en: The rail engineer helped couple the freight cars securely to the locomotive.
items.ex_zh: 铁路工程师协助将货运车厢牢固地挂接到火车头上。
items.ex2_en: The heavy rail cars couple automatically when they touch each other on track.
items.ex2_zh: 沉重的火车车厢在铁轨上相互接触时便会自动连接挂钩。

items.def_zh: 拴住，套住，拴紧；猛拉，提起；搭便车
items.def_en: 1. (+ to/up) To fasten or tie something to another object with a rope, knot, or hook. 2. To pull up clothing with a quick movement. 3. To hitchhike.
items.ex_en: The farmer paused to hitch the heavy plough onto his sturdy tractor.
items.ex_zh: 农夫停下动作，将沉重的犁具挂套在他结实的拖拉机上。

items.def_en: To secure or immobilize an object tightly to a surface or structure using ropes or cords
items.ex_en: He didn't want to buy a house because he hated being tied down to one location.
items.ex_zh: 他不想买房，因为讨厌被束缚在同一个地方。

items.def_en: To fasten a boat, ship, or aircraft to the shore, dock, or sea floor with ropes or anchors
items.ex_en: The harbor crew helped to moor the cruising yacht alongside the pier.
items.ex_zh: 港口工作人员协助将巡航游艇用缆绳系泊在码头边。
items.ex2_en: The small fishing boat moors safely at the protected harbor pier every evening.
items.ex2_zh: 这艘小型渔船每天傍晚都会安全停泊在受庇护的港口码头边。

items.def_en: To tie an animal or object with a rope or chain to limit its range of movement
items.ex_en: The farmer decided to tether the restless goat securely to an oak.
items.ex_zh: 农夫决定把那只躁动不安的山羊拴在一棵橡树上。

items.def_en: To bind or fasten securely to something else with multiple wraps of rope or cord
items.ex_en: The crew worked quickly to lash the heavy cargo to the deck.
items.ex_zh: 船员们迅速将沉重的货物用绳索牢牢捆绑在甲板上。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on securing an animal, vehicle, or cargo to a post, hook, or transport frame using a quick knot, rope, or coupling. These actions highlight temporary, functional linkage or fastening rather than permanent fusion.
groups.summary_zh: 用钩子、绳索或扣眼将人畜或车辆挂接或拴紧。
groups.desc_en: Restraining, coupling, or fastening mobile objects, vessels, or animals to an anchor or together with ropes, straps, or hitches, contrasting with permanent joining (welding) by preserving reversible tethered limitation.
groups.desc_zh: 用绳索、挽具或拖钩将活动物体、舟船或牲畜拴缚在固定锚点或彼此联结，不同于焊接等永久结合，强调具可逆性的牵引或绳网限位。
groups.nuance_en: tether: fasten an animal or device with a rope/chain to restrict movement range (goat / horse / cable) · moor: secure a ship, boat, or balloon to an anchor or buoy (vessel / yacht / boat) · lash: bind multiple items tightly together with cord or rope wrapping (spars / cargo / equipment) · hitch: fasten something to a vehicle or hook with a catch or knot (trailer / horse / ride) · couple: connect two mechanical parts or railcars together for joint operation (coaches / wagons / units)
groups.nuance_zh: tether: 用拴绳/链条将动物或设备系住以限制活动半径 (goat / horse / cable) · moor: 将船艇系泊于浮筒、锚位或码头 (vessel / yacht / boat) · lash: 用绳索层层交叉扎牢、捆绑稳固 (spars / cargo / equipment) · hitch: 挂钩接载拖车或用活结套扣拴住 (trailer / horse / ride) · couple: 机械式地联挂车厢或机件接合 (coaches / wagons / units)

groups.name: Hold & Cradle · 抱持与呵护 (Cradle, Nuzzle, Cuddle)
groups.tip: 用双臂或怀抱温柔护持

items.def_zh: 抱持，呵护；温柔抱在怀中
items.def_en: 1. To hold someone or something gently and lovingly in your arms, hands, or lap, protecting them.
items.ex_en: The exhausted mother continued to cradle her sleeping newborn throughout the storm.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的母亲在整场暴风雨中一直轻柔地把熟睡的初生儿抱在怀中。

items.def_en: To settle or move into a warm, comfortable position, often close to someone.
items.ex_en: The chilly child loved to snuggle under the thick wool blanket beside grandma.
items.ex_zh: 怕冷的孩子喜欢在奶奶身边紧贴着蜷卧在厚羊毛毯下。

items.def_en: To touch or rub gently with the nose or face, showing affection.
items.ex_en: The gentle mare leaned down to nuzzle her newborn foal with affection.
items.ex_zh: 温顺的母马俯下身，充满爱意地用鼻子轻蹭刚出生的小马驹。

items.def_en: To hold someone or something close in an affectionate, loving way.
items.ex_en: The little girl wanted to cuddle her fluffy teddy bear in bed.
items.ex_zh: 小女孩想在床上搂抱她那只毛茸茸的泰迪熊。

items.def_en: To hold someone or something tightly in your hands or arms.
items.ex_en: The weeping widow continued to clasp her husband's worn silver ring tightly.
items.ex_zh: 痛哭的遗孀继续在手心里紧紧握着她丈夫那枚磨损的银戒。

items.def_en: (formal or literary) To surround or hold someone tenderly in your arms.
items.ex_en: The old woman reached out to enfold her returning grandson in warmth.
items.ex_zh: 老妇人伸出双手，满怀温暖地将归家的孙儿紧紧拥入怀中。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe holding or pressing someone or something tenderly and protectively in one's arms, lap, or hands. They contrast warm intimacy with physical shelter and maternal-like tenderness.
groups.summary_zh: 体现温柔呵护、抱持或亲密依偎的肢体动作。
groups.desc_en: Holding, drawing close, or nestling a person or delicate object with tender, protective affection, contrasting with utilitarian gripping or crushing restraint by emphasizing emotional tenderness and protective warmth.
groups.desc_zh: 满怀温存与保护欲地将人或娇弱之物抱入怀中或相依偎，不同于实用的手抓或暴力的禁锢，强调情感上的依恋、呵护与亲密体温。
groups.nuance_en: cradle: hold gently, protectively, and securely in curved arms or hands (baby / head / infant) · snuggle: settle or press closely into a warm, comfortable position (under covers / against shoulder / bed) · nuzzle: rub or push gently with the nose or face in affection (cheek / neck / dog) · cuddle: hold affectionately in a warm, loving embrace (child / pillow / baby) · enfold: surround or wrap completely in arms or fabric (arms / mist / cloak)
groups.nuance_zh: cradle: 宛如摇篮般轻柔、小心翼翼地护抱在怀中 (baby / head / infant) · snuggle: 舒适温暖地依偎、蜷缩贴靠 (under covers / against shoulder / bed) · nuzzle: 用鼻子或面颊爱抚地轻蹭 (cheek / neck / dog) · cuddle: 宠溺爱抚地拥抱依偎 (child / pillow / baby) · enfold: 展开双臂或织物将对方完全环抱包裹 (arms / mist / cloak)

groups.name: Honor & Revere · 尊崇与敬重 (Honor, Revere, Venerate)
groups.tip: 表彰嘉奖赋予荣耀

items.def_en: (+ sb) have a great deal of respect, admiration, and reverence for someone
items.ex_en: Young athletes around the world look up to her as an inspirational leader.
items.ex_zh: 全世界的年轻运动员都视她为鼓舞人心的榜样并敬佩她。

items.def_en: to treat someone as a celebrated hero or celebrity and give them vast public attention
items.ex_en: The press began to lionize the young pilot after his heroic survival.
items.ex_zh: 年轻飞行员英勇生还后，媒体开始大肆将他奉为英雄人物。

items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) show excessive or profound reverence, submission, or respect toward someone or an ideal
items.ex_en: The rebels refused to bow down to the authoritarian regime.
items.ex_zh: 叛军拒绝向独裁政权低头屈服。

items.def_zh: 尊敬，崇敬；给予表彰，授予荣誉；兑现，信守（诺言或支票）
items.def_en: 1. To show great respect and admiration for someone. 2. To reward or praise someone publicly. 3. To fulfill, keep, or accept (a promise, agreement, or check).
items.ex_en: The university decided to honor the veteran diplomat for her lifetime of public service.
items.ex_zh: 大学决定向这位奉献了一生从事公共服务的资深外交官致敬并授予荣誉。

items.def_en: to feel deep respect, awe, or admiration for someone or something regarded as sacred or noble
items.ex_en: Generations of local villagers revere the ancient oak tree as a sacred guardian spirit.
items.ex_zh: 世世代代的当地村民都将这棵古橡树奉为神圣的守护神并心怀敬畏。

items.def_en: to hold someone or something in profound, quasi-religious awe and esteem, often on historical or spiritual grounds
items.ex_en: Devout pilgrims continue to venerate the sacred relics preserved within the ancient mountain monastery.
items.ex_zh: 虔诚的朝圣者继续对保存在这座古老高山修道院内的圣物顶礼膜拜。

groups.summary_en: Actors show profound social or moral respect toward individuals, ideals, or traditions, ranging from formal dignification and badges of merit ('honor') to deep religious or ethical reverence ('revere', 'venerate').
groups.summary_zh: 展现深沉社会敬意与道德推崇，由正式授予殊荣递增至发自内心的敬畏与神圣崇奉。
groups.desc_en: Elevating an individual, institution, or ideal with profound moral respect, deference, or quasi-sacred awe, contrasting with ordinary liking or praise by emphasizing social or spiritual hierarchy and solemn devotion.
groups.desc_zh: 对某人、机构或理想抱以高度道德崇敬、尊奉或近乎神圣的敬畏，不同于一般的喜爱或口头夸奖，强调精神阶序上的膜拜与肃穆推崇。
groups.nuance_en: revere: regard with deep, awe-inspiring, and solemn respect (memory / leader / tradition) · venerate: treat with profound, sacred deference due to historic age or holiness (saints / elders / relics) · honor: bestow formal public recognition or uphold high ethical standards (veterans / commitment / memory) · lionize: treat an individual as a fashionable celebrity with excessive adulation (author / hero / guest) · look up to: admire and respect someone as an aspirational role model (mentor / parents / elder)
groups.nuance_zh: revere: 心怀敬畏、肃然起敬地推崇尊奉 (memory / leader / tradition) · venerate: 因高龄、神圣性或历史厚重而虔诚顶礼膜拜 (saints / elders / relics) · honor: 授予公开荣誉、隆重铭记或恪守道义 (veterans / commitment / memory) · lionize: 将某人奉为名人巨擘般狂热捧捧 (author / hero / guest) · look up to: 将某人视为楷模抱以由衷仰慕钦佩 (mentor / parents / elder)

groups.name: Host & Moderate · 主持与主办 (Host, Chair, Emcee)
groups.tip: 作为东道主组织并款待来宾

items.def_en: to organize and provide the space or facilities for an event; to act as host to guests or on a television or radio show.
items.ex_en: The capital city will host the upcoming international climate conference next spring.
items.ex_zh: 首都将于明年春天主办即将召开的国际气候会议。

items.def_zh: 主持（会议、委员会等）；担任……的主席
items.def_en: to act as the chairperson of a meeting, committee, or organization.
items.ex_en: She was appointed to chair the newly formed ethics committee on artificial intelligence.
items.ex_zh: 她被任命主持新成立的人工智能伦理委员会。

items.def_en: [I/T] to preside over a debate, panel, or discussion to ensure fairness and order
items.ex_en: A seasoned political journalist was selected to moderate the tense final presidential debate.
items.ex_zh: 一名经验丰富的政治记者入选主持紧张的最终总统辩论。
items.ex2_en: The experienced diplomat can moderate skillfully when ideological tensions flare during peace negotiations.
items.ex2_zh: 当和平谈判中出现意识形态紧张时，这位资深外交官能熟练地主持协调。

items.def_en: (+ sth) serve as the primary host, presenter, or public face of a broadcast show or event
items.ex_en: Authorities suspected the consulting firm was merely fronting for an offshore syndicate.
items.ex_zh: 当局怀疑这家咨询公司仅仅是某离岸犯罪集团的台前幌子。

items.def_zh: 主持（新闻节目、全场播报）
items.def_en: to act as the primary presenter of a television broadcast or live news show
items.ex_en: He will anchor the evening news broadcast for the network starting next Monday.
items.ex_zh: 他将从下周一开始担任该电视网络晚间新闻节目的当家主播。
items.ex2_en: The seasoned journalist anchors smoothly whenever sudden breaking national crises disrupt scheduled programming.
items.ex2_zh: 每当突发国家危机打断原定节目时，这位经验丰富的记者总能沉稳地主持。

items.def_zh: 担任司仪；主持（节目、典礼）
items.def_en: [I/T] to act as master of ceremonies at an entertainment event or formal ceremony
items.ex_en: A popular local comedian agreed to emcee the annual charity gala tonight.
items.ex_zh: 一位颇受欢迎的当地喜剧演员同意今晚担任年度慈善晚会的司仪。

groups.summary_en: A designated person or organization serves as the master of ceremonies, provider of venue, or meeting leader for a public event, broadcast show, conference, or dinner party. Verbs distinguish running a panel ('chair'), welcoming guests ('host'), or introducing performers ('emcee').
groups.summary_zh: 主办大型活动、主持会议议程或引导宴会节目流程。
groups.desc_en: Orchestrating, directing, or presiding over a public broadcast, ceremony, or deliberative assembly to ensure order and presentation, contrasting with mere passive participation by holding conversational and procedural governance.
groups.desc_zh: 对公共广播、仪式或会议进行统筹主持、程序把控与节奏引领，不同于被动参会，强调掌控会场秩序、话语引导与对外呈现的主导权。
groups.nuance_en: host: welcome guests and steer a public broadcast, dinner, or social event (show / party / dinner) · chair: preside formally over a deliberative meeting, committee, or board (committee / meeting / session) · moderate: neutrally arbitrate debates and enforce speaking rules (debate / panel / discussion) · anchor: serve as the central, authoritative on-air presenter of a broadcast (newscast / coverage / broadcast) · emcee: serve as master of ceremonies providing lively entertainment links (banquet / gala / evening)
groups.nuance_zh: host: 作为东道主或节目主持人串场迎宾 (show / party / dinner) · chair: 依照议事规程正式主持委员会或董事会议 (committee / meeting / session) · moderate: 居中调解、把控论辩节奏与规则 (debate / panel / discussion) · anchor: 作为核心新闻主播统领把控整档大台播报 (newscast / coverage / broadcast) · emcee: 担当晚会或庆典司仪，活跃衔接气氛 (banquet / gala / evening)

groups.name: Hound & Harass Relentlessly · 穷追与死缠烂打 (Hound, Badger, Harry, Harass)
groups.tip: 如猎犬般紧追不舍百般纠缠

items.def_zh: 紧盯不放；近身监视施压
items.def_en: To monitor, chase, or pressure someone uncomfortably close while they are trying to act
items.ex_en: I can hardly finish my design work with the manager constantly breathing down my neck.
items.ex_zh: 经理总是在旁边紧盯施压，我几乎无法完成我的设计工作。

items.def_en: To repeatedly pester or bother someone with persistent questions or annoying requests
items.ex_en: Reporters continued to badger the spokesperson with hostile questions during the press briefing.
items.ex_zh: 在新闻简报会上，记者们不断用充满火药味的问题纠缠发言人。

items.def_en: To urge, push, or tease someone persistently to get them to do something quickly
items.ex_en: She constantly chivvied the slow children along so they would not miss the school bus.
items.ex_zh: 她不断催促磨蹭的孩子们快走，以免他们赶不上校车。

items.def_en: To torment someone continually through demands, attacks, or constant interruptions
items.ex_en: Relentless bureaucratic audits continued to harry the exhausted relief agency throughout the harsh winter.
items.ex_zh: 无休止的行政审计在整个严冬持续侵扰着心力交瘁的救援机构。

items.def_en: To trouble, distress, or intimidate someone by ongoing intrusive behavior or repeated pressure
items.ex_en: The landlord faced legal charges after attempting to systematically harass the elderly tenants.
items.ex_zh: 房东在企图系统性骚扰逼迫年长租户后，面临法律指控。

items.def_en: To pursue, harass, or disturb someone relentlessly without giving them peace.
items.ex_en: Paparazzi hound the young celebrity relentlessly wherever she attempts to spend her private time.
items.ex_zh: 无论这位年轻名人试图在哪里度过私人时光，狗仔队总是穷追不舍。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate predatory, persistent tracking and pestering, where the agent pursues a victim without respite through constant demands, questions, or stalking.
groups.summary_zh: 像猎犬般死死咬住不放，持续不断地追踪、纠缠或施压骚扰。
groups.desc_en: Pursuing, tracking, or pressing an adversary or quarry relentlessly without allowing respite or escape, contrasting with polite follow-up by its exhausting persistence and hunter-like siege mentality.
groups.desc_zh: 如恶犬追捕猎物般咬住不放地紧逼、围追或催逼，不给对方任何喘息或脱身之机，不同于礼貌随访，强调精疲力竭式的围猎压迫感。
groups.nuance_en: hound: track, pursue, and pester relentlessly without giving quarter (celebrities / suspects / debtors) · harry: subject to constant, exhausting hit-and-run attacks or demands (flanks / defense / minister) · badger: persistently harangue with nagging queries to extract something (witness / committee / government) · breathe down someone's neck: hover invasively close to monitor and intimidate someone working (staff / team / workers) · chivy: continually urge or nag someone to hurry or do something (children / pupils / crowd)
groups.nuance_zh: hound: 如影随形、穷追猛打地围堵逼迫 (celebrities / suspects / debtors) · harry: 频繁骚扰侵袭使其疲于奔命 (flanks / defense / minister) · badger: 没完没了地唠叨盘问以求得逞 (witness / committee / government) · breathe down someone's neck: 亦步亦趋、近距离极具压迫感地监视盯梢 (staff / team / workers) · chivy: 喋喋不休地催促驱赶某人做事 (children / pupils / crowd)

groups.name: Hover & Drift · 悬停与盘旋 (Poise, Flit, Hang About)
groups.tip: 空中停滞与平稳盘旋

items.def_en: To be carried slowly along by a current of air or water without propulsion
items.ex_en: The little wooden boat continued to drift helplessly along the foggy river current.
items.ex_zh: 那艘小木船继续在雾气弥漫的河水水流中无助地漂移。

items.def_en: To loiter or stay in a place with no apparent purpose, often lingering near others
items.ex_en: A group of teenagers used to hang around the convenience store parking lot every evening.
items.ex_zh: 一群十几岁的年轻人过去每天傍晚都在便利店停车场周围闲逛逗留。

items.def_en: To stay in a place longer than necessary because of hesitation or reluctance to leave
items.ex_en: A few nostalgic guests continued to linger near the doorway long after midnight.
items.ex_zh: 过了午夜许久，仍有几位心怀留恋的客人逗留在门道附近不肯离去。

items.def_zh: （在空中）盘旋，悬停；徘徊，逗留；踌躇
items.def_en: 1. To stay in one place in the air, flying or floating. 2. To stay close to someone or something, often in an uncertain or waiting manner.
items.ex_en: A lone rescue helicopter hovered quietly above the dense forest canopy searching for survivors.
items.ex_zh: 一架搜救直升机在茂密的森林树冠上方静静盘旋，搜寻幸存者。

items.def_zh: 悬停保持平衡；蓄势待发
items.def_en: To balance or remain held steady in one suspended position
items.ex_en: The hawk remained poised motionless on the branch before swooping down upon its unsuspecting prey.
items.ex_zh: 鹰在树枝上纹丝不动地蓄势平衡，随后向毫无防备的猎物俯冲而下。

items.def_en: To move or fly around someone or something in an aerial circle
items.ex_en: Three seagulls circle slowly above the fishing harbor waiting for discarded fish scraps.
items.ex_zh: 三只海鸥在渔港上空缓缓盘旋飞行，等待着被丢弃的碎鱼肉。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe remaining stationary or gently oscillating in the air without touching down, or lingering closely nearby with quiet or hesitant attention.
groups.summary_zh: 在空中悬止盘旋，或在某处附近徘徊不去。
groups.desc_en: Remaining suspended, circling, or loitering in proximate airspace or immediate physical presence without departing, contrasting with purposeful direct transit by its motionless suspension, hesitant circling, or aimless lingering.
groups.desc_zh: 悬浮在空中或流连于附近空间不肯离去，不同于目的明确的直线过境，强调近距离悬停、迟疑盘旋或漫无目的的徘徊滞留。
groups.nuance_en: hover: remain suspended stationary in the air or loiter anxiously close by (helicopter / hawk / nurse) · circle: move continuously in a circular flight path around a focal point (aircraft / vultures / birds) · poise: balance motionlessly in mid-air or preparation ready to strike (brink / diver / bird) · drift: float along smoothly and aimlessly carried by currents (clouds / snow / current) · linger: delay leaving a place out of reluctance or longing (memory / crowd / scent)
groups.nuance_zh: hover: 振翅或借动力在空中定点悬停，或焦急在旁守候 (helicopter / hawk / nurse) · circle: 绕着特定中心目标在上空作环形盘旋 (aircraft / vultures / birds) · poise: 在空中或边缘保持稳定悬浮、引弓待发 (brink / diver / bird) · drift: 顺水或随气流漫无目的地平缓漂泊 (clouds / snow / current) · linger: 依依不舍、拖延流连而不去 (memory / crowd / scent)

groups.name: Humanize & Civilize · 人性化与教化 (Civilize, Edify, Enlighten)
groups.tip: 提升文明素养与人性关怀

items.def_en: To give someone greater knowledge, spiritual understanding, and rational insight
items.ex_en: The visiting scholar hoped to enlighten the young students on complex philosophical traditions.
items.ex_zh: 这位访问学者希望能在复杂的哲学传统上启迪这些年轻学生。

items.def_en: To make something harsh, rigid, or institutional more gentle, warm, and approachable
items.ex_en: Potted plants and warm wooden furnishings helped soften the hospital's sterile corporate atmosphere.
items.ex_zh: 盆栽植物与温润的木质家具弱化了医院原本单调冰冷的机构氛围。
items.ex2_en: Her stern facial expression softened visibly when she saw her playful golden retriever.
items.ex2_zh: 当看到她那只活泼的金毛猎犬时，她严厉的面部表情明显柔和了下来。

items.def_en: To educate and refine a society or person away from harsh, uncultured, or brutal manners
items.ex_en: Early reformers believed rigorous public education would civilize generations and eradicate urban violence.
items.ex_zh: 早期的改革家坚信严谨的公共教育能够教化世代并根除城市暴力。

items.def_en: To train people or animals to behave in a way that is acceptable in human society
items.ex_en: Puppy classes help socialize young dogs with other animals and diverse human environments.
items.ex_zh: 幼犬培训班有助于让小狗适应社会，融洽接触其他动物和多样的生活环境。

items.def_zh: 使具人性，使更人道，改善（环境或制度以符合人的需求）
items.def_en: 1. To make something more pleasant, humane, or suitable for people.
items.ex_en: New interior designs aimed to humanize the grim maximum-security prison environment for inmates.
items.ex_zh: 新的室内设计旨在改善重刑犯监狱原本阴沉的环境，使其更具人性化。

items.def_en: To instruct and improve someone morally, spiritually, or intellectually
items.ex_en: The moral philosopher delivered inspiring lectures intended to edify the minds of his listeners.
items.ex_zh: 这位道德哲学家发表了启发性的演讲，意在陶冶听众的心智与情操。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify imparting compassionate, civilized, or culturally elevated qualities to institutions, environments, or raw human nature.
groups.summary_zh: 指使事物更具人性关怀，或使人及环境摆脱粗蛮、迈向开明教化。
groups.desc_en: To elevate someone cognitively, morally, or socially from a raw, animalistic, or crude state into refined human culture, contrasting with simple teaching or training.
groups.desc_zh: 使个体或群体从野蛮、原始或粗粝状态升华至文明与道德心智成熟，有别于普通传授技能或教授知识。
groups.nuance_en: humanize: imbue with compassion or gentle human attributes (system / workplace / design) · civilize: elevate collective social manners and institutions beyond savagery (tribes / society / wild frontier) · socialize: train someone into normative cultural rules (children / citizens / newcomers) · enlighten: dispel ignorance via rational or spiritual truth (public / mind / masses) · edify: uplift and improve morally or intellectually (listener / congregation / soul) · soften: temper harshness or rigidity with milder sensibilities (nature / tone / heart)
groups.nuance_zh: humanize: 赋予人道关怀或去冷酷化 (system / workplace / design) · civilize: 摆脱野蛮以提升社会文明秩序 (tribes / society / wild frontier) · socialize: 灌输规范以适应社会交往 (children / citizens / newcomers) · enlighten: 破除蒙昧以启发理性真知 (public / mind / masses) · edify: 通过高尚言行从道德与精神上陶冶 (listener / congregation / soul) · soften: 软化粗暴生硬的心智或脾气 (nature / tone / heart)

groups.name: Humiliate & Abase · 贬低与屈辱 (Degrade, Mortify, Belittle)
groups.tip: 极力贬抑自尊使人蒙羞

items.def_en: To criticize, insult, or disparage someone in front of others to make them feel insignificant.
items.ex_en: The arrogant manager frequently tried to put down junior colleagues in front of clients.
items.ex_zh: 傲慢的经理经常当着客户的面奚落贬损初级同事。

items.def_en: To make someone or their achievements seem unimportant, small, or worthless.
items.ex_en: Critics often belittle her groundbreaking research simply because she lacks an elite academic pedigree.
items.ex_zh: 批评人士常常仅仅因为她缺乏名校学历，就贬低她开创性的研究成果。

items.def_en: To make someone feel completely ashamed, stupid, or ridiculous, especially publicly.
items.ex_en: The head coach did not intend to humiliate the rookie player before his teammates.
items.ex_zh: 主教练并非故意要在队友面前羞辱这位新秀球员。

items.def_en: To treat someone with such disrespect that they lose their dignity and pride.
items.ex_en: Cruel prison guards attempted to degrade inmates by denying them basic clothing and privacy.
items.ex_zh: 残忍的狱警试图通过剥夺基本衣物和隐私来践踏囚犯的人格尊严。

items.def_en: To cause someone to feel extremely ashamed, embarrassed, or wounded in pride.
items.ex_en: She felt deeply mortified when her private diary entries were accidentally projected onto the auditorium screen.
items.ex_zh: 当自己的私密日记内容被意外投影在大礼堂屏幕上时，她感到极度尴尬受辱。

items.def_en: (also 'abase oneself') To lower yourself or someone in dignity or status; to humble deeply.
items.ex_en: The disgraced courtier refused to abase himself further before the ruthless new monarch.
items.ex_zh: 失宠的朝臣拒绝在残暴的新君面前进一步自贬尊严、卑躬屈膝。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers causing intense loss of pride, status, self-respect, or moral standing. 'Abase' and 'degrade' focus on knocking down rank and dignity, 'belittle' targets intellectual stature, and 'mortify' evokes acute psychological shame.
groups.summary_zh: 指打击尊严与地位，使其蒙羞受辱、自惭形秽或威严扫地。
groups.desc_en: To inflict severe damage on another person's pride, dignity, or status, ranging from mild verbal disparagement to crushing institutional abasement, contrasting with neutral criticism.
groups.desc_zh: 剥夺他人的自尊、体面或地位并使其承受屈辱感，强度由轻度贬损递增至摧毁性的极度自贬，区别于中立客观的批评。
groups.nuance_en: belittle: verbally dismiss the worth or scale of something (achievements / efforts / concerns) · put down: deflate self-esteem via casual slurs or disparaging remarks (peers / subordinates / rival) · humiliate: crush pride publicly, exposing to acute shame (opponent / victim / witness) · degrade: systematically lower status, worth, or moral standing (humanity / conditions / office) · mortify: wound pride so deeply that extreme shame paralyzes (debtor / parent / host) · abase: reduce oneself or another to cowering servility or absolute lowly status (oneself / pride / captive)
groups.nuance_zh: belittle: 言语贬低并淡化其价值 (achievements / efforts / concerns) · put down: 用尖刻贬损言辞挫伤自尊 (peers / subordinates / rival) · humiliate: 公开羞辱使其颜面扫地 (opponent / victim / witness) · degrade: 剥夺尊严并从体制或道德上降格 (humanity / conditions / office) · mortify: 带来无地自容的奇耻大辱 (debtor / parent / host) · abase: 迫使其自卑屈膝或极度自贬身段 (oneself / pride / captive)

groups.name: Humiliate & Demean · 贬抑与羞辱 (Abase, Degrade, Mortify)
groups.tip: 贬低身份使人难堪蒙羞

items.def_en: Criticize or mock someone, especially in front of other people, to make them feel small
items.ex_en: You should never put down your spouse during heated debates at social gatherings.
items.ex_zh: 在社交聚会的激烈争论中，你绝不该出言贬损奚落你的配偶。

items.def_zh: 使谦逊，贬抑；挫败，使蒙羞
items.def_en: To make someone feel less proud, important, or arrogant; to defeat soundly.
items.ex_en: The humiliating electoral defeat helped humble the previously arrogant incumbent senator.
items.ex_zh: 这场令人难堪的选举惨败，挫败了那位原本傲慢的现任参议员的锐气。

items.def_en: Cause someone a severe loss of dignity or respect
items.ex_en: The corrupt official would demean the dignity of his office by taking illicit cash bribes.
items.ex_zh: 贪官通过收取非法现金贿赂，贬低了自己职务的威严与尊严。

items.def_en: Make someone feel ashamed, foolish, or publicly disgraced
items.ex_en: The harsh cross-examination seemed carefully designed to humiliate the witness on the stand.
items.ex_zh: 严苛的盘问似乎是经过精心设计的，意在让证人在证人席上丢尽颜面。

items.def_en: Cause someone profound embarrassment, shame, or chagrin
items.ex_en: The candidate was mortified when an explicit private recording was leaked to the press.
items.ex_zh: 当露骨的私人录音被泄露给媒体时，候选人感到万分难堪与屈辱。

items.def_en: Behave in a way that belittles or degrades someone, especially oneself
items.ex_en: The captured rebel general chose execution rather than abase himself by pleading for imperial mercy.
items.ex_zh: 被俘的叛军将领宁愿受死，也不愿通过乞求皇恩宽恕来自贬人格。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe lowering someone's status, dignity, or pride, ranging from moderate deflation of arrogance to profound, soul-crushing public degradation.
groups.summary_zh: 描述挫伤他人傲气或肆意践踏其尊严的贬抑与屈辱行为。
groups.desc_en: To lower someone's personal prestige, moral standing, or pride, progressing from gentle deflation of self-importance to abject degradation, contrasting with formal legal demotion.
groups.desc_zh: 贬低或践踏他人的体面、道德尊严与社会声望，从温和挫折傲气推进至极度屈从下贱，有别于体制内的正常降职。
groups.nuance_en: humble: bring down pride or pretension to an appropriate level (champion / arrogance / ego) · demean: degrade personal standing or lower conduct below basic decency (profession / oneself / dignity) · put down: condescendingly belittle or stifle self-worth (critics / colleagues / dissent) · humiliate: inflict open, painful loss of social respect (defendant / loser / candidate) · mortify: cause acutely painful embarrassment and internal agony (parents / pride / executive) · abase: cast down to extreme servility or utter unworthiness (oneself / penitent / monarch)
groups.nuance_zh: humble: 挫其骄傲并使其认清局限 (champion / arrogance / ego) · demean: 做出有失体面或自贬身价之事 (profession / oneself / dignity) · put down: 居高临下打压其气焰与价值 (critics / colleagues / dissent) · humiliate: 公然剥夺尊严令其难堪出丑 (defendant / loser / candidate) · mortify: 造成极度窘迫的锥心之辱 (parents / pride / executive) · abase: 卑躬屈膝或彻底贬抑身份至泥淖 (oneself / penitent / monarch)

groups.name: Humor & Indulge · 迁就与顺从 (Humor, Indulge, Mollycoddle)
groups.tip: 顺着对方性子予以迁就

items.def_en: To comply with someone's wishes or mood in order to keep them happy or pacified.
items.ex_en: We decided to humor our grandfather and listen patiently to his familiar childhood stories.
items.ex_zh: 我们决定迁就祖父，耐心地听他讲述那些耳熟能详的童年故事。

items.def_en: to allow someone to have or do whatever they want, often unwisely
items.ex_en: Parents should not constantly indulge their child's every destructive whim and tantrum.
items.ex_zh: 父母不应该一味纵容孩子每一次破坏性的任性念头和发脾气。

items.def_en: to treat someone with excessive comfort, care, and attention
items.ex_en: The luxury resort staff will pamper guests with hot baths and personalized massage therapies.
items.ex_zh: 豪华度假村的员工会用热水浴和个性化按摩疗法悉心照料客人们。

items.def_en: to make someone feel less angry or hostile by conceding to their demands
items.ex_en: Management offered minor wage concessions in an urgent attempt to placate the striking workers.
items.ex_zh: 管理层在工资上作出了微小的让步，急切地试图平息罢工工人的怒火。

items.def_en: to treat someone with too much care, kindness, or protection
items.ex_en: Overprotective parents often coddle their teenagers, leaving them utterly unprepared for real independent living.
items.ex_zh: 过度保护的父母往往对青少年百般娇护，致使他们对真正的独立生活毫无准备。

items.def_en: to give someone far too much attention and protection, treating them like a baby
items.ex_en: His grandmother continues to mollycoddle him even though he is now a grown man.
items.ex_zh: 尽管他现在已经是个成年人了，他的祖母却依然把他当婴儿般溺爱纵容。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to accommodating someone's whims, unreasonable mood, or eccentricities gently to avoid upsetting them or keep the peace.
groups.summary_zh: 指为了顾全大局、避免争吵而迁就、包容或纵容对方的任性与情绪。
groups.desc_en: To yield to another's whims, unreasonable demands, or fragile feelings to appease them or avoid conflict, contrasting with genuine, objective agreement.
groups.desc_zh: 出于安抚、迁就或避免冲突而顺应对方的任性脾气或非分要求，区别于建立在客观认可上的真诚同意。
groups.nuance_en: humor: temporarily play along with odd caprices or false notions (delusions / boss / child) · placate: appease anger or discontent through concessions (protesters / creditors / partner) · indulge: yield permissively to wishes or appetites without restraint (fancies / cravings / whims) · coddle: shield excessively from hardship or reality with soft handling (athletes / staff / ego) · pamper: gratify with luxurious comfort and gentle physical care (guests / pets / patient) · mollycoddle: overprotect and over-indulge to the point of inducing helplessness (son / recruits / team)
groups.nuance_zh: humor: 姑且顺应对方荒唐念头以息事宁人 (delusions / boss / child) · placate: 怀柔安抚愤怒以平息不满 (protesters / creditors / partner) · indulge: 纵容并满足其任性欲望 (fancies / cravings / whims) · coddle: 过于迁就小心护短以免受挫 (athletes / staff / ego) · pamper: 给予奢华舒适的悉心照料 (guests / pets / patient) · mollycoddle: 溺爱护短至令人丧失自立能力 (son / recruits / team)

groups.name: Hustle & Rush · 奔忙与催促 (Hustle, Scurry, Bustle)
groups.tip: 脚步匆忙紧张快速移动

items.def_en: To proceed or prompt another to act rapidly because of pressing time constraints
items.ex_en: We must hurry through airport security if we want to catch our connecting flight.
items.ex_zh: 如果我们想赶上中转航班，就必须匆忙通过机场安检。
items.ex2_en: Concerned flight attendants hurried anxious passengers through the boarding gate before immediate takeoff.
items.ex2_zh: 焦急的乘务员在飞机立即起飞前催促不安的旅客们穿过登机口。

items.def_en: To move, act, or cause someone to progress with headlong, reckless speed
items.ex_en: Paramedics had to rush the injured driver directly to the regional trauma center.
items.ex_zh: 医护人员不得不将受伤的司机仓促紧急送往区域创伤中心。
items.ex2_en: Frantic shoppers rush through the department store doors when major holiday sales open.
items.ex2_zh: 当盛大的节日促销开始时，疯狂的购物者们争先恐后地冲进百货大门。

items.def_zh: 催促，急速推搡前行；奔波，拼搏；推搡；兜售
items.def_en: 1. To hurry someone along, or to move quickly and energetically. 2. To push or shove someone roughly. 3. (informal, especially North American) To work aggressively to make money, or to sell something energetically.
items.ex_en: Security guards quickly hustled the noisy protesters out of the packed auditorium building.
items.ex_zh: 保安人员迅速推搡着将吵闹的抗议者催赶出了拥挤的礼堂大楼。

items.def_en: To move about in an energetic, noisy, and conspicuously busy fashion
items.ex_en: Waiters bustle around the crowded kitchen preparing dozens of elaborate dinner plates at once.
items.ex_zh: 服务员们在拥挤的厨房里忙碌穿梭，同时准备数十份精致的晚餐餐盘。

items.def_en: To move or act with urgent speed, or to accelerate the pace of an occurrence
items.ex_en: The sudden darkening of the evening sky hastened the weary travelers along their journey.
items.ex_zh: 傍晚天空的骤然昏暗，催促着疲惫的行人们加快了赶路的脚步。
items.ex2_en: The weary travelers hasten home across the snowy plains before darkness descends completely.
items.ex2_zh: 疲惫的旅人们赶在黑夜彻底降临前急匆匆穿过雪原赶回家中。

items.def_en: To move quickly with light, short, hurried steps from agitation or urgency
items.ex_en: Frightened mice scurry across the dusty barn floor whenever someone opens the wooden door.
items.ex_zh: 每当有人推开木门，受惊的小老鼠就会迈着碎步仓皇穿过满是灰尘的谷仓地面。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures rapid, energetic, and pressured movement or action, often driven by urgent necessity, crowded environments, or purposeful drive. When used transitively, it highlights actively shoving or hurrying someone else forward.
groups.summary_zh: 指在紧迫氛围或压力之下匆忙、活跃地移动，或强行催促他人行进。
groups.desc_en: To move or compel movement under acute time pressure with distinctive tempos, body postures, or agitation, contrasting with mere unhurried walking or continuous travel.
groups.desc_zh: 在时间紧迫下以特定节奏、姿态或焦急状态快速移动或催促行动，区别于从容的漫步或普通的机械位移。
groups.nuance_en: hurry: accelerate pace due to impending deadline (pedestrians / travelers / travelers) · rush: charge impulsively or move with precipitous urgency (patients / commuters / decisions) · hasten: expedite action deliberately through purposeful urgency (departure / steps / conclusion) · hustle: push through briskly with competitive grit or shove along forcefully (workers / crowd / suspects) · bustle: move around energetically with noisy, fussy self-importance (hostess / staff / shopper) · scurry: scamper with short, rapid, agitated footsteps like a small creature (mice / crabs / assistants)
groups.nuance_zh: hurry: 因赶时间而加快步伐或动作 (pedestrians / travelers / travelers) · rush: 仓促猛冲或急不可耐地行动 (patients / commuters / decisions) · hasten: 刻意加速进程以争取时间 (departure / steps / conclusion) · hustle: 拼抢奔波或推搡催促行进 (workers / crowd / suspects) · bustle: 忙乱奔走且阵仗喧闹 (hostess / staff / shopper) · scurry: 慌张小步疾走犹如受惊小动物 (mice / crabs / assistants)

groups.name: Idealize & Glorify · 美化与理想化 (Glorify, Glamorize, Aggrandize)
groups.tip: 戴着浪漫滤镜对事物过度美化

items.def_en: Disguise or gloss over unpleasant facts in order to give a falsely attractive appearance
items.ex_en: The government report attempted to varnish the bleak economic data with misleading optimistic rhetoric.
items.ex_zh: 政府报告试图用具有误导性的乐观措辞来粉饰惨淡的经济数据。

items.def_zh: 使有魅力；美化（负面事物）
items.def_en: Make something seem charming, exciting, or sophisticated, obscuring unpleasant truths
items.ex_en: Hollywood action movies often glamorize dangerous street crime and reckless underground gun violence.
items.ex_zh: 好莱坞动作电影往往会美化危险的街头犯罪和鲁莽的地下枪支暴力。

items.def_en: Regard or represent someone or something as perfect or better than in reality
items.ex_en: Biographers tend to idealize national historical figures rather than acknowledge their complex human flaws.
items.ex_zh: 传记作家往往倾向于把国家历史人物理想化，而不是正视他们复杂的人性缺陷。

items.def_zh: 粉饰；使（坏事）显得可接受
items.def_en: Make an unattractive, unpleasant, or painful reality seem more acceptable or mild
items.ex_en: The company executives refused to sugarcoat the bad news about impending employee layoffs.
items.ex_zh: 公司高管拒绝粉饰即将裁员的严峻坏消息。

items.raw_cluster: 美化与理想化 Idealize & Glorify
items.def_zh: 使浪漫化，把……想象得过于美好；沉溺于幻想
items.def_en: To talk about or view something in an idealized, unrealistic way that makes it seem better or more appealing than it really is.
items.ex_en: Novels often romanticise severe rural poverty into an idyllic portrait of rustic simplicity.
items.ex_zh: 小说常常把严酷的乡村贫困浪漫化，描摹成一幅田园牧歌式的质朴图景。

items.def_en: Praise or represent something as admirable, heroic, or grand, often undeservedly
items.ex_en: Propaganda posters attempted to glorify brutal frontline combat as an honorable heroic adventure.
items.ex_zh: 宣传海报试图把残酷的前线战斗颂扬美化为一场光荣而英勇的冒险。

groups.summary_en: Covers cognitive and rhetorical acts of depicting something in an excessively noble, beautiful, or romantic light while ignoring ugly realities.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过滤镜或夸张表述美化现实，使其显得远比实情更浪漫或崇高。
groups.desc_en: To mentally reconstruct or cosmetically present an imperfect, flawed reality as noble, flawless, or alluring, contrasting with factual, unvarnished reporting.
groups.desc_zh: 通过滤镜重塑或美化原本充满瑕疵的现实，使其呈现出崇高、纯洁或极具吸引力的假象，区别于客观写实。
groups.nuance_en: idealize: conceptualize something as existing in flawless perfection (past / beauty / relationships) · romanticise: view squalor or hardship through poetic, wistful nostalgia (poverty / struggle / exile) · glamorize: make dangerous or sordid things seem fashionable and seductive (violence / drugs / crime) · sugarcoat: disguise harsh, bitter truths with palatable pleasantries (bad news / pills / feedback) · varnish: apply a superficial, deceptive sheen to conceal defects (history / flaws / image) · glorify: exalt, praise, or elevate to heroic or divine splendor (war / dictator / martyrs)
groups.nuance_zh: idealize: 在观念中赋予无可挑剔的完满假想 (past / beauty / relationships) · romanticise: 给苦难与阴暗蒙上一层诗意与温情 (poverty / struggle / exile) · glamorize: 把危险或恶习渲染得时髦诱人 (violence / drugs / crime) · sugarcoat: 粉饰包裹逆耳刺目的负面真相 (bad news / pills / feedback) · varnish: 涂脂抹粉掩盖缺陷瑕疵 (history / flaws / image) · glorify: 极力颂扬并将之上升到崇高或神圣高度 (war / dictator / martyrs)

groups.name: Idle & Loaf · 游手好闲与怠惰 (Loaf, Laze, Slack)
groups.tip: 游手好闲打发时间消磨生命

items.def_en: (+ around/about) To lie, sit, or stand in a relaxed, lazy posture without working
items.ex_en: During summer vacation, the teenagers would lounge around the public pool all afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 暑假期间，青少年们整个下午都会慵懒地斜靠在公共泳池边闲逛。

items.def_en: (+ away) To spend time doing nothing of substance or importance
items.ex_en: He chose to idle away the rainy weekend afternoon browsing obscure vintage books.
items.ex_zh: 他选择在雨天的周末下午虚度光阴，漫不经心地翻阅着晦涩的古旧书籍。

items.def_zh: 游手好闲，虚度光阴，闲荡
items.def_en: (+ around/about) To spend time idly without doing anything useful.
items.ex_en: Unemployed youths frequently loaf around the street corner talking loudly about trivial neighborhood gossip.
items.ex_zh: 失业青年经常在街角游手好闲地闲荡，大声议论着琐碎的邻里八卦。

items.def_en: (+ around/away) To spend time in a relaxed, lazy, and unproductive manner
items.ex_en: We decided to laze around the sunlit garden instead of cleaning the messy garage.
items.ex_zh: 我们决定在阳光明媚的花园里偷懒打发时间，而不是去打扫凌乱的车库。

items.def_en: To spend time idly wandering or living without regular work
items.ex_en: After college graduation, he spent six months bumming around coastal towns without steady work.
items.ex_zh: 大学毕业后，他在沿海城镇到处晃荡了六个月，没有从事固定的工作。

items.def_en: To reduce one's effort, work lazily, or avoid duties
items.ex_en: Employees began to slack off once they realized the supervisor had left the building.
items.ex_zh: 一旦意识到主管已经离开大楼，员工们便开始懈怠偷懒摸鱼起来。

groups.summary_en: Covers spending time lazily, avoiding productive effort, and wandering or lingering aimlessly without serious intent.
groups.summary_zh: 描述游手好闲、消磨时光、逃避工作或无所事事的状态。
groups.desc_en: To disengage intentionally or habitually from useful, productive labor in favor of leisurely unproductivity, contrasting with legitimate, restorative resting.
groups.desc_zh: 习惯性或故意脱离建设性劳动，沉溺于漫无目的的消磨光阴与怠惰中，区别于合情合理的劳逸恢复。
groups.nuance_en: idle: spend time purposelessly without active employment or output (workers / engines / dreamers) · lounge: recline or sit around with bodily languor and indolent ease (guests / tourists / patrons) · laze: surrender completely to luxurious passivity and restorative inertia (afternoon / weekends / vacationers) · loaf: waste work hours lingering passively and evading duty (laborers / teenagers / crew) · bum around: wander or drift aimlessly without steady work or home (vagabonds / backpackers / youths) · slack off: progressively reduce effort and shirk expected responsibilities (students / employees / soldiers)
groups.nuance_zh: idle: 空转虚度、不从事任何实质工作 (workers / engines / dreamers) · lounge: 懒散斜倚或悠闲呆坐 (guests / tourists / patrons) · laze: 享受无所事事的慵懒时光 (afternoon / weekends / vacationers) · loaf: 游手好闲、磨洋工混日子 (laborers / teenagers / crew) · bum around: 漫无目的随处浪荡游荡 (vagabonds / backpackers / youths) · slack off: 偷懒懈怠、消极降低工作产出 (students / employees / soldiers)

groups.name: Immunize & Inoculate · 保护与免疫 (Immunize, Vaccinate, Inoculate)
groups.tip: 建立免疫屏障，免受侵害感染

items.def_en: Protect someone or something from danger, infectious exposure, criticism, or unpleasant realities
items.ex_en: The thick castle walls helped shield the frightened villagers from incoming enemy arrow volleys.
items.ex_zh: 厚重的城堡城墙帮助庇护受惊的村民免遭敌方密集箭雨的伤害。

items.def_en: Protect someone or something from adverse outside impacts, shocks, or financial hardship
items.ex_en: Diversified investments help insulate the sovereign wealth fund from sudden global market shocks.
items.ex_zh: 多元化投资有助于使主权财富基金免受全球市场突发震荡的不利影响。

items.def_en: (informal) Inject a vaccine into someone with a hypodermic needle
items.ex_en: The clinic nurse will jab dozens of local residents against the seasonal winter flu.
items.ex_zh: 诊所护士将为数十名当地居民接种预防季节性冬季流感的疫苗针。

items.def_en: Administer an antigenic substance to stimulate an individual's immune system against a pathogen
items.ex_en: The clinic will vaccinate hundreds of local children against the measles outbreak tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 诊所明天将为数百名当地儿童接种麻疹疫苗。

items.def_zh: 预防接种；给……灌输保护意识
items.def_en: Treat someone with a vaccine to produce immunity, or introduce a mild stimulus to protect against future shock
items.ex_en: Early childhood exposure to diverse viewpoints helps inoculate students against harmful propaganda.
items.ex_zh: 童年早期接触多元观点有助于增强学生抵御有害宣传的能力。

items.def_en: to protect a person or animal against a disease, especially by administering a vaccine
items.ex_en: Public health officials worked tirelessly to immunize the entire island population against cholera.
items.ex_zh: 公共卫生官员不知疲倦地工作，以使全岛居民对霍乱产生免疫力。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses medical and biological interventions designed to stimulate disease resistance or metaphorically shield against external vulnerabilities.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过接种疫苗或生物学干涉，建立机体抗病保护机制或强化免责屏障。
groups.desc_en: To bestow biological resistance or protective buffering against pathogens or external harms via medical or systemic shielding, contrasting with direct therapeutic curing.
groups.desc_zh: 通过生物学接种或体系化构筑防御屏障来预防外界病原体或损害，区别于发病后的直接临床治疗。
