groups.nuance_en: vaccinate: administer a specific biologic antigen to produce antibodies (infants / populations / cattle) · inoculate: introduce an antigenic agent or idea to foster defensive immunity (children / culture / minds) · immunize: confer active biological or legal exemption/protection from harm (citizens / herds / witnesses) · jab: administer a hypodermic injection briskly and informally (patients / arms / travelers) · shield: place a tangible or institutional barrier between target and danger (economy / witness / vulnerable) · insulate: buffer internally against external shocks, contagion, or volatility (investors / systems / students)
groups.nuance_zh: vaccinate: 注射特定疫苗制剂以建立特异抗体 (infants / populations / cattle) · inoculate: 植入抗原进行接种，或思想上接种预防针 (children / culture / minds) · immunize: 使机体产生完备免疫，或给予免责豁免 (citizens / herds / witnesses) · jab: 口语中直接扎针注射疫苗 (patients / arms / travelers) · shield: 构筑坚实屏障遮蔽并隔绝外部侵害 (economy / witness / vulnerable) · insulate: 依靠绝缘缓冲层抵御外部冲击与波动 (investors / systems / students)

groups.name: Imprison & Incarcerate · 关押与拘禁 (Jail, Confine, Lock Up)
groups.tip: 投入牢狱剥夺人身自由

items.def_en: Put someone in prison or jail as a lawful punishment
items.ex_en: The judge decided to jail the repeat offender for twelve months without probation.
items.ex_zh: 法官决定将这名屡教不改的罪犯关押十二个月，且不得缓刑。

items.def_en: Put someone in a prison or psychiatric hospital and keep them locked inside
items.ex_en: The dangerous suspect was locked up in a maximum-security facility pending further trial.
items.ex_zh: 该危险嫌疑人被关押在戒备最为森严的拘留所，等待进一步审判。

items.def_zh: 禁闭；将……限制在狭小空间中
items.def_en: Keep someone closed in a restricted space or prevent them from leaving
items.ex_en: The prison guards confined the unruly inmate to a small solitary cell overnight.
items.ex_zh: 狱警将那名不守规矩的囚犯关进禁闭室里禁闭了一整夜。

items.def_en: Keep someone in official custody, usually for questioning or before trial
items.ex_en: Customs officers decided to detain the suspicious traveler for further questioning and inspection.
items.ex_zh: 海关官员决定扣留这名可疑旅客以作进一步盘问与检查。

items.def_zh: 把……关押入狱；（在罐中）焖炖
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To put someone in prison. 2. To stew meat (especially hare) slowly in a closed container or pot.
items.ex_en: The police caught him stealing cars and jugged him for six long months.
items.ex_zh: 警察抓住了偷车的他，把他投进大牢关了整整六个月。

items.def_en: Put or confine someone in prison, typically for an extended legal sentence
items.ex_en: The state intends to incarcerate violent criminals for decades to ensure public safety.
items.ex_zh: 该州计划对暴力犯罪分子处以数十年监禁，以确保公众安全。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe depriving someone of their physical freedom by legal authority or force, placing them behind bars or inside a secure facility. They range from neutral administrative terms to colloquial idioms emphasizing confinement.
groups.summary_zh: 通过法律制裁或强制手段剥夺人身自由，实施拘禁或关押。
groups.desc_en: To legally, punitively, or physically deprive an agent of liberty by confining them behind bars or inside enclosed boundaries, contrasting with open, monitored surveillance.
groups.desc_zh: 通过司法、刑罚或物理手段将主体剥夺人身自由并闭锁于封闭空间内，区别于开放式监视或行动限制。
groups.nuance_en: confine: restrict movement within rigid physical or operational limits (patients / prisoners / livestock) · detain: hold someone in custody lawfully for interrogation or temporary delay (suspects / migrants / travelers) · lock up: secure firmly behind locked doors or iron bars (convicts / valuables / cells) · jail: place in an incarceration facility, typically following arrest (offenders / activists / felons) · incarcerate: sentence and lock away within the formal prison apparatus (inmates / criminals / dissidents) · jug: slap into the lockup or county jail informally and unceremoniously (drunks / brawlers / petty thieves)
groups.nuance_zh: confine: 圈禁于狭小范围或限制活动界限 (patients / prisoners / livestock) · detain: 依据执法程序临时扣留或羁押 (suspects / migrants / travelers) · lock up: 锁闭在门扉铁窗之内彻底失去行动自由 (convicts / valuables / cells) · jail: 投进拘留所或监狱关押 (offenders / activists / felons) · incarcerate: 经正式量刑关入完备监狱体系 (inmates / criminals / dissidents) · jug: 口语俚语中投进拘留号子 (drunks / brawlers / petty thieves)

groups.name: Incline & Predispose · 诱导倾向与偏向 (Incline, Bias, Dispose)
groups.tip: 预先使人产生某种倾向

items.def_en: (+ to/towards) To feel a tendency or influence someone towards a particular belief, mood, or choice
items.ex_en: His recent distressing experiences incline him towards a more pessimistic view of humanity.
items.ex_zh: 他近来的痛苦经历使他对人性的看法倾向于更加悲观。
items.ex2_en: Experienced critics incline toward praising ambitious cinematic projects with novel narrative structures.
items.ex2_zh: 经验丰富的影评人倾向于赞扬那些采用新颖叙事结构的雄心勃勃的电影作品。

items.def_zh: 使倾向于，使对…抱有某种态度
items.def_en: (+ to/towards) To make someone naturally inclined to think, feel, or act in a particular way
items.ex_en: Her generous upbringing disposed her to treat all struggling strangers with profound compassion.
items.ex_zh: 她受到的良好教养促使她对所有陷入困境的陌生人怀有深切的同情。

items.def_en: (+ to) To make someone or something inherently more likely to develop a particular condition, attitude, or behavior.
items.ex_en: Chronic psychological stress and poor diet predispose individuals to serious cardiovascular disorders.
items.ex_zh: 长期的心理压力和不良饮食会使个体更容易罹患严重的心血管疾病。

items.def_en: (+ against/towards) To unfairly influence someone's opinion or decision in favor of or against someone or something
items.ex_en: The inflammatory newspaper article was clearly written to bias the jury against him.
items.ex_zh: 这篇煽动性的报纸文章显然意在诱导陪审团对他产生偏见。

items.def_en: To influence or change someone's opinions, feelings, or decisions
items.ex_en: A single compelling speech managed to sway the entire committee's final vote.
items.ex_zh: 一场极具说服力的演说成功动摇了整个委员会的最终投票。
items.ex2_en: Frail saplings sway wildly under the fury of coastal tropical storms every autumn.
items.ex2_zh: 每年秋天，纤细的幼树都会在沿海热带风暴的狂虐下剧烈摇摆。

items.def_zh: 事先灌输，使做好准备倾向
items.def_en: (+ for/to) To prepare someone beforehand to act or think in a certain predetermined manner
items.ex_en: The clever trial lawyer primed the witness to answer every question very cautiously.
items.ex_zh: 那位精明的老练律师事先叮嘱证人，使其准备好谨慎回答每个问题。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe instilling, fostering, or possessing a latent tendency, leaning, or vulnerability toward a specific attitude, action, or state. They range from neutral inclination to deliberate prejudicial biasing.
groups.summary_zh: 表示使人产生某种心理倾向、态度偏向或具备易受某种影响的体质。
groups.desc_en: To exert subtle directional leverage on a mind, posture, or system, shifting baseline neutrality toward a favored outcome, contrasting with overt force or command.
groups.desc_zh: 对主体的心智、立场或系统施加隐蔽倾斜力，打破原有中立使之产生特定倾向，区别于强行命令或直接干涉。
groups.nuance_en: incline: bend natural preference or mental leaning toward a choice (minds / jurors / listeners) · dispose: arrange temperament or conditions favorably toward an attitude (hearts / circumstances / audience) · predispose: implant prior genetic, systemic, or experiential susceptibility (genes / conditions / patients) · bias: skew judgment unfairly against objective equity (data / judges / sampling) · sway: shift wavering opinions or decisions through persuasive or emotional weight (voters / crowds / jury) · prime: prepare beforehand with cues to evoke a selective cognitive leaning (subjects / memory / witnesses)
groups.nuance_zh: incline: 心理微偏向某种选择或判断 (minds / jurors / listeners) · dispose: 从性格或氛围上调动出愿意接纳的心境 (hearts / circumstances / audience) · predispose: 先天或背景上预先植入易感性或前置倾向 (genes / conditions / patients) · bias: 形成系统性偏见，扭曲公正客观 (data / judges / sampling) · sway: 靠说服力或情绪势头左右摇摆不定的意志 (voters / crowds / jury) · prime: 事先灌输线索以诱发潜意识预设偏好 (subjects / memory / witnesses)

groups.name: Incline & Stoop · 俯身与屈体 (Stoop, Bend, Crouch)
groups.tip: 身体向前下方躬身弯曲

items.def_en: To tilt one's torso over a barrier, surface, or space
items.ex_en: She had to lean over the wooden railing to spot her missing keys.
items.ex_zh: 她不得不探身越过木栏杆，以寻找丢失的钥匙。

items.def_en: To curve the upper body forward, downward, or sideways from an upright position
items.ex_en: He had to bend forward to tie his shoelace before resuming the run.
items.ex_zh: 在继续跑步之前，他不得不弯下身子系好鞋带。
items.ex2_en: The athletic gymnast can easily bend her flexible spine backward without feeling strain.
items.ex2_zh: 这位运动健将能轻松将柔韧的脊柱向后弯曲而丝毫不觉费力。

items.def_en: 1. To bend the head and body forward and downward. 2. (stoop to) To lower one's moral standards to do something bad or dishonest.
items.ex_en: The tall man had to stoop low to enter the ancient stone doorway.
items.ex_zh: 身材高大的男子不得不躬下身子才能穿过古老的石门。

items.def_en: To round or arch one's back and draw one's shoulders forward
items.ex_en: He tended to hunch his shoulders whenever he sat working before his computer.
items.ex_zh: 每当坐在电脑前工作时，他总会习惯性地耸肩弓背。
items.ex2_en: The tall man hunches instinctively whenever passing beneath low ancient stone doorways.
items.ex2_zh: 每当穿过古老矮小的石门框时，这位高个男子都会本能地弓下身子。

items.def_en: To lower the head or body abruptly to avoid being hit or seen
items.ex_en: He had to duck quickly beneath the doorframe to avoid hitting his head.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不迅速低下头穿过门框，以免撞到脑袋。

items.def_en: To lower the body by bending the knees deeply and bowing forward
items.ex_en: The frightened kitten began to crouch low under the dusty sofa in silence.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的小猫默默地蜷缩在布满灰尘的沙发底下。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this manner frame depict bodily posturing where the spine, neck, or knees bend forward and down, often to pick something up or avoid striking an obstacle.
groups.summary_zh: 指脊背、头颈或躯干向前下方弯曲、弓背低头等肢体姿态。
groups.desc_en: To bend, lower, or fold the human body downward from an erect stance to accommodate spatial obstacles, evade danger, or express humility, contrasting with horizontal lying.
groups.desc_zh: 从直立姿态向下弯折或低垂躯干，以应对空间限制、躲避威胁或表达谦卑，区别于全身平躺。
groups.nuance_en: feature: give prominent billing or notable focus to a distinctive component (actors / songs / amenities) · contain: hold within physical or conceptual boundaries (liquids / files / ingredients) · comprise: constitute or be made up of definitive parts in total (chapters / members / elements) · encompass: circle around and include broadly within an extensive scope (disciplines / scope / areas) · showcase: exhibit intentionally to display merits and finest qualities (talents / collections / products) · embody: represent and incarnate an abstract quality in concrete form (virtues / ideals / spirit)
groups.nuance_zh: feature: 以某亮点或名流作为主要号召力 (actors / songs / amenities) · contain: 物理或逻辑容纳于边界之内 (liquids / files / ingredients) · comprise: 由若干特定组成部分在整体上构成 (chapters / members / elements) · encompass: 宏大而全面地囊括其外延 (disciplines / scope / areas) · showcase: 设立展示台以高光彰显精粹 (talents / collections / products) · embody: 抽象理念通过具体实体完美具象化 (virtues / ideals / spirit)

groups.name: Include & Contain · 包含与涵盖 (Feature, Contain, Comprise)
groups.tip: 以某项特征为主要包含

items.def_zh: 以……为主要特色，包含；起重要作用；由……主演
items.def_en: 1. To include someone or something as a prominent characteristic, part, or performer. 2. To have an important role or place in something.
items.ex_en: The upcoming festival will feature several award-winning international musicians on the main stage.
items.ex_zh: 即将到来的音乐节主舞台将迎来多位屡获殊荣的国际音乐家领衔演出。

items.def_en: To consist of, encompass, or be made up of particular constituent elements or items
items.ex_en: The university committee will comprise seven distinguished senior scholars and two student representatives.
items.ex_zh: 大学委员会将由七位资深知名学者和两名学生代表组成。

items.def_en: To include a wide spectrum of ideas, elements, or regions within a scope
items.ex_en: The ambitious environmental study will encompass twenty distinct marine ecosystems across the continent.
items.ex_zh: 这项雄心勃勃的环保研究将涵盖整个大陆的二十个不同海洋生态系统。

items.def_en: To draw targeted public attention to a specific element, event, or participant as a main feature
items.ex_en: The evening news broadcast decided to spotlight the heroic efforts of local firefighters.
items.ex_zh: 晚间新闻广播决定重点报道当地消防员的英勇事迹。

items.def_en: To express, include, or give tangible form to a quality, concept, or feature within a larger body
items.ex_en: His recent public actions embody the noble ideals of selfless public service well.
items.ex_zh: 他最近的公开行动很好地体现了无私奉献社会的崇高理想。

items.def_en: To display or exhibit prominently the best features, talents, or qualities of something
items.ex_en: The exhibition was deliberately designed to showcase the finest traditional craftsmanship of Italy.
items.ex_zh: 该展览经过精心设计，旨在展示意大利最精湛的传统工艺。

groups.summary_en: This frame denotes having components, members, or prominent highlights as internal elements of a wider work, entity, product, or roster.
groups.summary_zh: 客体作为组成部分、特色亮点被囊括或展现于整体之中。
groups.desc_en: To encompass, host, or present elements as parts of an overarching whole, contrasting with excluding or standing alongside outside.
groups.desc_zh: 作为上位整体去容纳、呈现或包容下属要素，区别于外部罗列或完全排除在外。
groups.nuance_en: feature: give prominent billing or notable focus to a distinctive component (actors / songs / amenities) · contain: hold within physical or conceptual boundaries (liquids / files / ingredients) · comprise: constitute or be made up of definitive parts in total (chapters / members / elements) · encompass: circle around and include broadly within an extensive scope (disciplines / scope / areas) · showcase: exhibit intentionally to display merits and finest qualities (talents / collections / products) · embody: represent and incarnate an abstract quality in concrete form (virtues / ideals / spirit)
groups.nuance_zh: feature: 以某亮点或名流作为主要号召力 (actors / songs / amenities) · contain: 物理或逻辑容纳于边界之内 (liquids / files / ingredients) · comprise: 由若干特定组成部分在整体上构成 (chapters / members / elements) · encompass: 宏大而全面地囊括其外延 (disciplines / scope / areas) · showcase: 设立展示台以高光彰显精粹 (talents / collections / products) · embody: 抽象理念通过具体实体完美具象化 (virtues / ideals / spirit)

groups.name: Incremental Stepped Adjustment · 阶梯式递进增减 (Ratchet, Crank, Step up)
groups.tip: 校正量度、比例并依规调控

items.def_zh: 大幅提升；开大（音量、强度）
items.def_en: To increase the level, volume, speed, or intensity of something mechanically or forcefully.
items.ex_en: He decided to crank up the heater as the night grew increasingly chilly.
items.ex_zh: 随着夜色渐冷，他决定把暖气开大。

items.def_en: To increase something incrementally by distinct steps, especially efforts, security, or pace.
items.ex_en: The hospital had to step up security measures following the recent incident.
items.ex_zh: 在最近的事件发生后，医院不得不加强安保措施。

items.def_zh: 快速增多；扩大生产/活动
items.def_en: To build up or expand a rate, pace, production, or intensity progressively over time.
items.ex_en: The manufacturing plant plans to ramp up vehicle production before the holiday season.
items.ex_zh: 该制造工厂计划在假期来临前逐步大幅提高汽车产量。
items.ex2_en: Defense production will ramp up significantly to replenish depleted military stockpiles nationwide soon.
items.ex2_zh: 国防生产将大幅提升，以尽快补充全国消耗的军备储备。

items.def_en: To deliberately increase the intensity, rhetorical force, or degree of something.
items.ex_en: The candidate chose to dial up the rhetoric during the final heated debate.
items.ex_zh: 候选人选择在最后一场激烈的辩论中加大言辞攻势。

items.def_en: To raise or achieve an increase in degree, level, or score by a specific step.
items.ex_en: The team managed to notch up their overall intensity during the second half.
items.ex_zh: 球队在下半场成功将整体对抗强度提升了一个档次。

items.def_zh: 逐步调高（或调低），阶段性调整
items.def_en: (also 'ratchet up') To increase or decrease something repeatedly by small amounts in stages that cannot be easily undone.
items.ex_en: The central bank may ratchet up interest rates slowly over the coming months.
items.ex_zh: 央行可能会在未来几个月内分阶段逐步提高利率。
items.ex2_en: Political tensions ratchet up steadily as international diplomatic negotiations fail across the region.
items.ex2_zh: 随着该地区国际外交谈判破裂，政治紧张局势逐步加剧升级。

items.def_en: (+ sth) to increase sth steadily and repeatedly by increments
items.ex_en: The coach decided to ratchet up training intensity right before the championship finals.
items.ex_zh: 教练决定在锦标赛决赛前逐步提升训练强度。
items.ex2_en: Diplomatic tensions ratcheted up rapidly after the border incident between both neighboring countries.
items.ex2_zh: 两国边境事件发生后，外交紧张局势迅速逐步升级。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on shifting a quantity, intensity, or pressure upward or downward in discrete, irreversible, or incremental steps, frequently associated with gears, policy levers, or escalations.
groups.summary_zh: 指像齿轮卡扣一样分阶段、一档一档地逐步提升或收紧。
groups.desc_en: To systematically advance intensity, volume, or pressure by discrete, controllable mechanical increments, contrasting with smooth, uncalibrated natural surges.
groups.desc_zh: 像拨动机械旋钮或齿轮卡榫般，按梯级有意识且可控地逐级推高强度或规模，区别于平滑自然的自发生长。
groups.nuance_en: step up: elevate efforts or pace through structured, deliberate stages (security / production / pressure) · ramp up: scale upward along a steady, planned operational slope (capacity / testing / manufacturing) · crank up: force output or volume higher aggressively as if turning a handle (volume / engine / heat) · dial up: adjust intensity or tone higher via precise calibration (rhetoric / tension / aggression) · notch up: register one distinct quantifiable tick or win upward (victories / score / rates) · ratchet: force progressively higher through locking steps that prevent backsliding (pressure / sanctions / tensions)
groups.nuance_zh: step up: 阶段性强化力度或节奏 (security / production / pressure) · ramp up: 沿既定坡度平稳规模化爬坡扩产 (capacity / testing / manufacturing) · crank up: 粗暴有力地把音量或运转开足马力 (volume / engine / heat) · dial up: 精准校准并有意调高对立基调或强度 (rhetoric / tension / aggression) · notch up: 记分板上斩获又一格递增成绩 (victories / score / rates) · ratchet: 像棘轮般单向咬死、只升不降地步步加压 (pressure / sanctions / tensions)

groups.name: Incur & Invite · 招致与招惹 (Incur, Invite, Bring upon)
groups.tip: 行为导致招来不良后果

items.def_en: To behave in a way that is risky and likely to attract danger, disaster, or rejection
items.ex_en: Hiking across the frozen lake in mild weather is simply courting outright disaster.
items.ex_zh: 在温和天气下徒步穿越结冰的湖面简直是在自招祸患。

items.def_en: To act in a way that makes bad treatment, trouble, or criticism likely to happen to oneself
items.ex_en: Leaving your front door wide unlocked will simply invite trouble from local burglars.
items.ex_zh: 大门敞开不锁只会给当地窃贼招揽麻烦。

items.def_en: To draw hostility, suspicion, or unwanted attention toward oneself
items.ex_en: His bizarre behavior at the quiet library was bound to attract unwanted suspicion.
items.ex_zh: 他在安静的图书馆里的怪异举止必然会引来不必要的怀疑。

items.def_en: To cause something unpleasant or disastrous to happen to oneself or one's group through foolishness or error
items.ex_en: His reckless financial gambles have brought immense ruin upon his entire innocent family.
items.ex_zh: 他不计后果的金融投机给全家无辜之人招致了巨大的灾难。

items.def_en: To allow debts, bills, or deficits to accumulate quickly through one's own spending
items.ex_en: She managed to run up enormous credit card bills during her lavish vacation.
items.ex_zh: 她在奢华度假期间挥霍无度，积欠了数额巨大的信用卡账单。

items.def_zh: 招致，惹来（不良后果）；蒙受，承担（费用、债务）
items.def_en: To bring upon oneself something unpleasant or unwanted as a result of one's own actions; to become liable to pay costs or debts.
items.ex_en: Late tax submissions will incur severe financial penalties under the revised municipal code.
items.ex_zh: 根据修订后的市政法规，逾期提交税表将招致严厉的经济罚款。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe unintentionally or heedlessly bringing unpleasant consequences (debts, wrath, penalties, hostility) upon oneself through one's own conduct.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重因自身的行为、态度或过失，使自己蒙受债务、非议、惩罚等不利后果。
groups.desc_en: To expose oneself to or draw down unavoidable negative consequences through one's own voluntary actions or negligence, contrasting with passive suffering of bad luck.
groups.desc_zh: 因自身的主动行为、狂妄或疏忽，诱发并招揽来不利的负面后果，区别于无辜遭遇横祸。
groups.nuance_en: incur: bring upon oneself mandatory legal, financial, or punitive liabilities (debts / wrath / penalties) · invite: provoke or create tempting vulnerability for trouble through carelessness (criticism / danger / attacks) · court: flirt recklessly with extreme hazards through audacious bravado (disaster / controversy / ruin) · attract: draw unwanted attention or forces toward oneself like a magnet (scrutiny / suspicion / crowds) · bring upon: trigger painful consequences directly affecting oneself or kin (disgrace / ruin / sorrow) · run up: accumulate an escalating load of liabilities swiftly and heedlessly (bills / debt / deficits)
groups.nuance_zh: incur: 招致必须承受的法律、财务或惩戒性代价 (debts / wrath / penalties) · invite: 疏忽大意露出破绽，变相招惹非议或攻击 (criticism / danger / attacks) · court: 铤而走险、近乎玩火般自讨苦吃 (disaster / controversy / ruin) · attract: 像磁铁般吸引来外部审视与敌意 (scrutiny / suspicion / crowds) · bring upon: 作茧自缚，使灾祸降临到自身或家人头上 (disgrace / ruin / sorrow) · run up: 不加节制地迅速积聚滚大负债 (bills / debt / deficits)

groups.name: Indulge & Pamper · 纵容与娇生惯养 (Pamper, Spoil, Mollycoddle)
groups.tip: 过度娇惯姑息甚至沉溺放任

items.def_en: To agree with or please someone simply to keep them calm or satisfied
items.ex_en: She decided to humor her grandfather by listening patiently to his repetitive tales.
items.ex_zh: 她决定顺着祖父的心思，耐心地听他讲述那些重复的故事。

items.def_zh: 悉心娇惯；悉心照料关爱
items.def_en: To treat someone with excessive comfort, care, luxury, and special attention
items.ex_en: The luxury spa is designed to pamper weary guests with exquisite therapeutic treatments.
items.ex_zh: 这家豪华水疗中心旨在用精致的理疗护理悉心款待疲惫的宾客。

items.def_zh: 迎合；曲从（低级趣味或无理要求）
items.def_en: To please or gratify someone's unreasonable or debased wishes and demands
items.ex_en: Sensationalist media outlets always pander to the public's basest fears and raw anxieties.
items.ex_zh: 耸人听闻的媒体总是一味迎合公众最深层的恐惧和赤裸的焦虑。

items.def_en: To damage someone's character, especially a child's, by constantly giving them whatever they wish
items.ex_en: Overprotective parents often spoil their only child with excessive gifts and unconditional praise.
items.ex_zh: 过分溺爱的父母往往用无节制的礼物和盲目的称赞把独生子宠坏。
items.ex2_en: Fresh organic milk will spoil quickly if left out in warm summer temperatures.
items.ex2_zh: 新鲜的有机牛奶如果放在温暖的夏日气温下，很快就会变质腐坏。

items.def_zh: 纵容，放任；沉溺于，纵情于
items.def_en: 1. (+ in) To allow yourself or someone else to enjoy a pleasure, desire, or luxury freely.
items.ex_en: On weekends, she likes to indulge in rich dark chocolate and vintage wines.
items.ex_zh: 周末时，她喜欢纵情享用浓郁的黑巧克力和陈年佳酿。

items.def_en: To protect and pamper someone too much in an overprotective, smothering manner
items.ex_en: Stop trying to mollycoddle the boy every time he scrapes his small knee.
items.ex_zh: 别每次那男孩擦破点膝盖你就去过分娇惯他。

groups.summary_en: This frame relates to treating someone or oneself with excessive leniency, constant gratification, or luxurious care, often to the point of ruining character or exceeding reasonable boundaries.
groups.summary_zh: 过分放任、迁就欲望或悉心照料娇宠，常带有宠坏任性的色彩。
groups.desc_en: To cater excessively to the comforts, tastes, or whims of someone, eroding their resilience through over-protection or softness, contrasting with healthy caring nurture.
groups.desc_zh: 过度迎合对方的舒适享受、任性偏好或脆弱心理，因过度宠溺削弱其坚韧品格，区别于健康的关怀养育。
groups.nuance_en: pamper: shower someone with lavish physical luxury, comfort, and gentle grooming (guests / body / pets) · spoil: ruin character or behavior by endlessly giving in to demands (children / pets / grandchildren) · indulge: allow free rein to passions, appetites, or excessive desires (whims / tastes / fantasies) · pander to: debase standards to cater unscrupulously to baser instincts or demands (fears / audience / tastes) · humor: play along tolerantly with irrational whims to maintain peace (eccentricities / father / patient) · mollycoddle: baby and shield someone so obsessively they cannot endure hardship (athletes / youth / subordinates)
groups.nuance_zh: pamper: 用无微不至的奢华与舒适体贴入微地呵护 (guests / body / pets) · spoil: 有求必应，彻底娇纵败坏其性格与教养 (children / pets / grandchildren) · indulge: 放任其沉溺于欲望、嗜好或任性妄想 (whims / tastes / fantasies) · pander to: 迎合低级趣味或恐惧以博取利益 (fears / audience / tastes) · humor: 迁就配合其古怪秉性以维系表面和气 (eccentricities / father / patient) · mollycoddle: 过分庇护娇惯使其沦为温室花朵 (athletes / youth / subordinates)

groups.name: Infest & Plague · 侵扰与肆虐 (Infest, Beset, Pester)
groups.tip: 害虫或祸害成灾蔓延滋生

items.def_en: Fill and occupy an area uncontrollably with destructive insects, rodents, or weeds
items.ex_en: The abandoned garden shed was completely overrun with destructive weeds and stubborn vines.
items.ex_zh: 废弃的花园棚屋里到处充斥着破坏性的杂草和顽固的藤蔓。

items.def_en: Continually cause worry, suffering, or hardship to a community or individual
items.ex_en: Chronic knee injuries continued to plague the professional athlete throughout his entire career.
items.ex_zh: 长期的膝盖伤病在职业运动员的整个职业生涯中一直困扰着他。

items.def_zh: （害虫、老鼠等）大批出没于，成灾于，骚扰
items.def_en: (especially of insects, pests, or parasites) to inhabit or overrun a place in large, harmful numbers
items.ex_en: Termites began to infest the damp wooden foundations of the old country house.
items.ex_zh: 白蚁开始大批侵扰并危害这栋老旧乡间农舍潮湿的木制地基。

items.def_en: Cause extensive, catastrophic damage and devastation to a place or group
items.ex_en: Fierce tropical typhoons ravage coastal fishing villages throughout the turbulent autumn monsoon season.
items.ex_zh: 猛烈的热带台风在动荡的秋季季风期间肆虐沿海渔村。

items.def_en: Affect or trouble someone or something persistently from all sides
items.ex_en: The fledgling democratic government was beset by endless economic turmoil and widespread corruption.
items.ex_zh: 这个新生的民主政府饱受无休止的经济动荡和广泛腐败的重重困扰。

items.def_en: Annoy someone repeatedly with irritating requests or constant unwelcome presence
items.ex_en: The relentless salesman continued to pester the busy customer with annoying phone calls.
items.ex_zh: 那个纠缠不休的推销员不断用烦人的电话骚扰忙碌的顾客。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on pests, diseases, troubles, or vermin persistently invading a place or distressing a population in large, damaging numbers.
groups.summary_zh: 指害虫、疫病或祸患大肆繁殖侵扰，造成长期的危害与折磨。
groups.desc_en: To overrun, afflict, or swarm an entity persistently and destructively in overwhelming numbers or relentless waves, contrasting with isolated single attacks.
groups.desc_zh: 以压倒性数量或连绵不断的波次，大举滋生、侵袭并肆虐某一宿主或区域，区别于单次的偶发侵扰。
groups.nuance_en: infest: inhabit a place in swarming, unwelcome, parasitic hosts (rats / bugs / parasites) · overrun with: completely submerge and take over space through sheer overwhelming numbers (weeds / tourists / troops) · plague: torment chronically with lingering troubles, diseases, or disasters (drought / injuries / scandals) · beset: surround and harass on all sides with relentless difficulties (problems / doubts / enemies) · pester: annoy repeatedly with petty, persistent, buzzing demands (reporters / children / creditors) · ravage: wreak violent, wide-scale havoc and leave in ruined desolation (cities / disease / war)
groups.nuance_zh: infest: 害虫病菌群集寄生滋扰 (rats / bugs / parasites) · overrun with: 数量过载蔓延并彻底淹没占据 (weeds / tourists / troops) · plague: 像瘟疫般长期困扰折磨 (drought / injuries / scandals) · beset: 困难重重自四面八方围困夹击 (problems / doubts / enemies) · pester: 像苍蝇般反复纠缠骚扰 (reporters / children / creditors) · ravage: 狂暴摧毁并留下满目疮痍 (cities / disease / war)

groups.name: Influence & Sway · 左右与施加影响 (Influence, Sway, Color)
groups.tip: 通过威望或说服力操纵局势

items.def_en: To influence someone's opinion or judgment so that they do not view things impartially
items.ex_en: Past bitter experiences should not color your rational assessment of this new candidate.
items.ex_zh: 过去的痛苦经历不应该让你的理性评估带上对这名新候选人的偏见。
items.ex2_en: Her cheeks color faintly with embarrassment whenever public compliments are paid to her.
items.ex2_zh: 每当在公开场合受到赞扬时，她的面颊都会因害羞而微微泛红。

items.def_en: To direct or guide the direction of someone's thoughts, negotiations, or general behavior
items.ex_en: The seasoned diplomat tried to steer the fragile peace negotiations toward a compromise.
items.ex_zh: 这位经验丰富的外交官试图引导脆弱的和平谈判走向妥协。
items.ex2_en: The sturdy fishing vessel steers effortlessly through narrow channels toward open deep waters.
items.ex2_zh: 坚固的渔船轻松驶过狭窄的水道，朝着辽阔的深海航行。

items.def_en: To influence someone in a way that makes them likely to think, feel, or behave in a certain manner
items.ex_en: Early childhood trauma can predispose vulnerable adolescents toward acute depressive and anxious episodes.
items.ex_zh: 童年早期的创伤会使脆弱的青少年更容易产生重度抑郁和焦虑倾向。

items.def_en: to affect or change the way someone thinks, behaves, or develops, or the way something happens
items.ex_en: Peer pressure can easily influence a teenager's choices regarding lifestyle and social habits.
items.ex_zh: 同伴压力极易左右青少年的生活方式选择及社交习惯。

items.def_en: To cause someone to have an unfair preference for or dislike of a particular point of view
items.ex_en: Personal loyalties may bias the committee's objective evaluation of the grant applications.
items.ex_zh: 个人私交可能会使评审委员会对补助金申请的客观评估产生偏袒。

items.def_en: To persuade someone to believe or do something, or to heavily bias their thinking or decision
items.ex_en: Nothing you say will sway my steadfast decision to resign from this position.
items.ex_zh: 你说什么都无法动摇我辞去这个职位的坚定决定。
items.ex2_en: Public opinions sway unpredictably following sudden breaking revelations in the sensational political trial.
items.ex2_zh: 轰动性政治审判中突如其来的爆料导致公众舆论难以预测地发生动摇。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here denote acting upon people's minds, decisions, or institutional outcomes through persuasion, charisma, or power. While some convey neutral steering, others indicate subtle bias, gradual manipulation, or significant behavioral modification.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过权力、说服或无形力量左右他人思想或决断。
groups.desc_en: To act upon the opinions, decisions, or directions of others through soft or indirect gravitational pull, contrasting with compelling by coercive force.
groups.desc_zh: 通过无形的引力、情感或倾向潜移默化地左右他人的决断或事物轨迹，区别于强权胁迫与行政硬指令。
groups.nuance_en: influence: exert an invisible, enduring effect on thoughts or outcomes (decisions / culture / youth) · sway: tip the momentum of an undecided, oscillating mind (voters / jury / opinions) · steer: guide trajectory subtly toward a preferred destination (conversation / policy / debate) · color: alter perception or objectivity through unconscious bias or emotion (judgment / views / memories) · bias: implant systemic unfairness or partiality in an assessment (sample / results / court) · predispose: configure someone from the outset to react in a specific direction (patients / conditions / mindset)
groups.nuance_zh: influence: 产生深远而持久的潜移默化作用 (decisions / culture / youth) · sway: 在天平摇摆不定时施加关键倾斜力量 (voters / jury / opinions) · steer: 巧妙把控方向与节奏以导向特定轨道 (conversation / policy / debate) · color: 戴着有色眼镜，情绪化污染客观认知 (judgment / views / memories) · bias: 扭曲公正使结论产生预设立场偏向 (sample / results / court) · predispose: 先行设定倾向，使其预先更易接纳某类事物 (patients / conditions / mindset)

groups.name: Inform & Betray · 告密与出卖 (Snitch, Inform, Squeal)
groups.tip: 告密倒戈背弃同伴

items.def_en: (+ on) To secretly inform on someone to an authority figure or parent
items.ex_en: The young boy decided to snitch on his classmate for cheating on tests.
items.ex_zh: 那个小男孩决定向老师打小报告，检举同桌考试作弊。

items.def_en: (also 'rat on') (informal) To betray friends, colleagues, or associates, or inform against them to authorities.
items.ex_en: The terrified thug decided to rat on his criminal gang to avoid prison.
items.ex_zh: 那个惊恐万分的暴徒决定背叛并告发自己的犯罪团伙以逃避牢狱之灾。

items.def_en: (+ on/against) To officially report an associate's unlawful activities to the authorities
items.ex_en: The repentant accountant decided to inform on his corrupt employers to federal investigators.
items.ex_zh: 那位悔悟的会计师决定向联邦调查人员告发其雇主的腐败行为。

items.def_en: (+ on) (chiefly British) To report an associate's wrongdoing to the police
items.ex_en: He was terrified that his former cellmate would grass on him to police.
items.ex_zh: 他非常害怕以前的狱友会向警方告发他。

items.def_en: (+ on) To betray associates by giving incriminating information to the police
items.ex_en: Under intense interrogation, the burglar finally agreed to squeal on his accomplices.
items.ex_zh: 在严苛的审讯下，那名窃贼最终同意供出他的同伙。

items.def_en: To betray a group, friend, or principle for personal financial or social gain
items.ex_en: Tickets sold out within minutes; fans later accused the band of selling out to commercial sponsors.
items.ex_zh: 门票几分钟内便售罄；乐迷们随后指责该乐队向商业赞助商出卖了艺术灵魂。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict disloyalty manifested by turning informant or snitching on colleagues, comrades, or criminal associates to authorities.
groups.summary_zh: 强调背叛同伙或团体，向当局或外人告密出卖。
groups.desc_en: To breach solidarity or confidentiality by leaking secrets or turning in associates to authorities or adversaries, contrasting with transparent, authorized reporting.
groups.desc_zh: 背弃内部忠诚或信任契约，向当局或敌对势力暗中泄露同伙机密或供出同伴，区别于正当合规的公开通报。
groups.nuance_en: inform: furnish covert intelligence on illegal activities to authorities (police / handler / agents) · snitch: act as a petty tattletale, betraying peers on minor transgressions (classmates / prison / rivals) · rat: turn treacherous against fellow co-conspirators in self-preservation (partners / mob / gang) · squeal: confess loudly and implicate colleagues under investigative duress (interrogators / cops / associates) · grass: act as an underworld or working-class supergrass blowing the whistle (suspects / detectives / gang) · sell out: sacrifice ideological principles or comrades for personal financial or power gain (friends / cause / country)
groups.nuance_zh: inform: 向执法机关系统性提供情报或当线人 (police / handler / agents) · snitch: 打小报告告发琐碎过失 (classmates / prison / rivals) · rat: 为自保而毫无信义地出卖同伙 (partners / mob / gang) · squeal: 在审讯压力下熬不住全盘招供扯出同党 (interrogators / cops / associates) · grass: 英式俚语中告发同党给警方当暗桩 (suspects / detectives / gang) · sell out: 为金钱或权势出卖原则、道义或盟友 (friends / cause / country)

groups.name: Inform & Snitch · 告密与出卖 (Snitch, Squeal, Grass)
groups.tip: 向官方告发他人隐私暗中打小报告

items.def_en: (+ on) (informal British) To act as an informer or give incriminating information to the police
items.ex_en: The underworld enforcer warned everyone never to grass on members of their crew.
items.ex_zh: 黑帮头目警告所有人绝不能向警方出卖团队成员。

items.def_en: To betray someone by informing an authority figure about their wrongdoing
items.ex_en: He promised never to rat out his fellow workers to the strict supervisor.
items.ex_zh: 他保证绝不会向严厉的主管告发自己的工友。

items.def_en: (+ on) To expose illegal or unethical wrongdoing within an organization to authorities or the public
items.ex_en: The brave engineer decided to blow the whistle on the company's illegal pollution.
items.ex_zh: 那位勇敢的工程师决定挺身揭发公司非法排污的罪行。

items.def_zh: 告密，告发，打小报告；顺手牵羊，偷窃
items.def_en: 1. (+ on) (informal) To secretly inform someone in authority about someone else's wrongdoings. 2. (informal) To steal something small or of little value.
items.ex_en: Nobody liked him because he would constantly snitch on his siblings to mom.
items.ex_zh: 没人喜欢他，因为他总是不停地向妈妈打兄弟姐妹的小报告。

items.def_en: (+ on) To betray comrades or co-conspirators by revealing incriminating information to the police
items.ex_en: The arrested thief decided to squeal on his accomplices to avoid a prison sentence.
items.ex_zh: 被捕的小偷决定供出同伙，以逃避牢狱之灾。

items.def_en: (+ on) To report petty mischief or trivial secrets, especially between children
items.ex_en: Timmy ran to tattle on his little brother for hiding the television remote control.
items.ex_zh: 蒂米跑去向大人打小报告，告发弟弟藏起了电视遥控器。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers betraying illicit secrets or associates to authority figures, typically in a clandestine, treacherous, or self-serving manner. Verbs range from colloquial schoolyard tattling to criminal gang betrayals.
groups.summary_zh: 指暗中向当局或长辈告发同伙过失，出卖秘密信息。
groups.desc_en: To reveal incriminating or secret information about an associate to an authority, breaking an implicit bond of loyalty unlike neutral reporting.
groups.desc_zh: 背弃同盟或同伴的信任，向当局或外人泄露罪责或秘密情报，区别于中性的陈述或合法通报。
groups.nuance_en: blow the whistle: expose illicit wrongdoing publicly in the public interest (corruption / fraud) · rat out: betray an accomplice to authorities under pressure (partner / accomplice) · snitch: petty or clandestine informership to save oneself (classmate / cellmate) · squeal: break down and confess under interrogation (gang / accomplice) · tattle: childish or trivial reporting of rule-breaking (sibling / classmate) · grass: British underworld betrayal to the police (suspect / criminal)
groups.nuance_zh: blow the whistle: 出于公共利益公开揭发内部不法黑幕 (corruption / fraud) · rat out: 因自保或受压出卖同伙 (partner / accomplice) · snitch: 琐碎告密或私下向权威打小报告 (classmate / cellmate) · squeal: 在审问重压下招供变节 (gang / accomplice) · tattle: 儿童式告状或打小报告 (sibling / classmate) · grass: 英式俚语中向警方出卖道上同伙 (suspect / criminal)

groups.name: Infuse & Aerate · 浸润与充气 (Aerate, Oxygenate, Infuse)
groups.tip: 注入气泡或让液体充分浸透

items.def_en: To convert a substance into gas or charge a liquid with gaseous molecules
items.ex_en: Ancient volcanic furnaces gasify dense minerals into shimmering plumes of vapor.
items.ex_zh: 古老的火山熔炉将致密的矿物气化为闪烁的蒸气羽流。
items.ex2_en: Solid coal samples gasify rapidly under intense pressure and extreme thermal reaction conditions.
items.ex2_zh: 在强压和极端热反应条件下，固体煤样本迅速发生气化反应。

items.def_en: To steep or introduce a substance into liquid so as to transmit its properties or flavor
items.ex_en: The herbalist will infuse dried chamomile into boiling water to extract its medicinal essence.
items.ex_zh: 草药医生将把干燥的甘菊浸入沸水中，以萃取其药用精华。

items.def_zh: 充入二氧化碳，使碳酸盐化
items.def_en: to dissolve carbon dioxide gas into a liquid to make it fizzy
items.ex_en: The factory uses high pressure to carbonate filtered water for sparkling beverages.
items.ex_zh: 工厂利用高压向过滤水中注入二氧化碳，以生产气泡饮料。

items.def_en: To produce a hissing sound and small bubbles as dissolved gas escapes from liquid
items.ex_en: The freshly opened soda began to fizz vigorously in the tall glass.
items.ex_zh: 刚开封的苏打水在高玻璃杯中开始剧烈地嘶嘶泛起气泡。

items.def_en: To supply, treat, or enrich a fluid or blood with oxygen gas
items.ex_en: The mechanical pump works continuously to oxygenate the water in the fish hatchery.
items.ex_zh: 机械泵持续运转，为孵化场的水体充氧。

items.def_en: To introduce air or gas into a liquid or soil to circulate oxygen or create lightness
items.ex_en: Gardeners often aerate compacted lawn soil in spring to encourage deeper root growth.
items.ex_zh: 园丁们常在春季给板结的草坪土壤打孔透气，以促进根系深扎。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on forcing or diffusing a gas, flavor, or chemical agent into a liquid or substrate to alter its texture, effervescence, or composition.
groups.summary_zh: 指将气体、液体或活性成分充入或浸润到介质中，改变其性质或起泡。
groups.desc_en: To introduce a gas, liquid, or flavor into a medium to alter its physical or chemical state, distinct from merely mixing solid ingredients.
groups.desc_zh: 将气体、液体或活性成分充入或浸润至介质中以改变其物理或化学状态，区别于普通的固体混合。
groups.nuance_en: aerate: expose to or circulate air/oxygen throughout (soil / lawn / wine) · oxygenate: supply or enrich chemically with oxygen (blood / water / tissue) · carbonate: dissolve carbon dioxide under pressure (beverage / water) · gasify: convert solid or liquid fuel into gas (coal / biomass) · infuse: steep plant matter to extract flavor or medicinal properties (tea / herbs / oil) · fizz: produce bubbles and hissing sound through effervescence (soda / champagne)
groups.nuance_zh: aerate: 充气或使空气流通以透气松散 (soil / lawn / wine) · oxygenate: 化学性补充或富集氧气 (blood / water / tissue) · carbonate: 加压溶入二氧化碳制成碳酸饮品 (beverage / water) · gasify: 将固/液态燃料高温气化 (coal / biomass) · infuse: 浸泡萃取草本成分或风味 (tea / herbs / oil) · fizz: 冒泡并发出咝咝起泡声 (soda / champagne)

groups.name: Infuse & Permeate · 浸透与赋予 (Imbue, Infuse, Permeate)
groups.tip: 灌输精神或浸润特质

items.def_zh: 布满；充盈（常指光、色或情绪）
items.def_en: To gradually spread across or through something, especially with light, color, or a soft emotion
items.ex_en: A delicate rose blush began to suffuse her cheeks as he spoke softly.
items.ex_zh: 当他轻声细语时，一抹娇柔的红晕开始泛上她的双颊。

items.def_en: To fill someone or something deeply with a particular quality, value, or feeling
items.ex_en: The charismatic director managed to infuse genuine passion into every rehearsal.
items.ex_zh: 这位富有魅力的导演成功地将真挚的热情注入每一次排练中。

items.def_en: To spread through every part of an object, place, or system until completely saturated
items.ex_en: A pungent odor of damp decay seemed to permeate every corridor of the cellar.
items.ex_zh: 一股潮湿腐败的刺鼻气味似乎弥漫在地窖的每一条走廊里。

items.def_en: (formal) to fill someone or something deeply with a quality, feeling, or idea
items.ex_en: Her poetic verses imbue mundane domestic moments with enduring spiritual grace.
items.ex_zh: 她的诗句赋予平凡的琐碎日常以恒久的心灵雅趣。

items.def_en: To exist throughout every aspect or corner of something, such as an odor, belief, or mood
items.ex_en: A sense of mounting dread began to pervade the isolated mountain village.
items.ex_zh: 一种愈发强烈的恐惧感开始笼罩着这座孤立的山村。

items.def_en: To fill something so completely that no more of a substance, moisture, or quality can be absorbed
items.ex_en: Heavy autumn rains continue to saturate the low-lying farmlands across the river valley.
items.ex_zh: 连绵的秋雨继续浸透着河谷各处的低洼农田。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe saturating, deeply penetrating, or endowing a person, object, or medium with a pervasive quality, emotion, atmosphere, or idea. While physical liquids can permeate, these terms frequently operate in abstract and literary contexts.
groups.summary_zh: 表示将某种品质、情感、观念或气味深度浸透、灌注并充盈其中。
groups.desc_en: To spread an intangible quality, feeling, or fluid deeply throughout every part of a recipient until saturated, contrasting with surface-level application.
groups.desc_zh: 无形品质、情绪或液体全面深层渗透并浸润至每个角落，区别于表层的涂抹或浅显的影响。
groups.nuance_en: imbue: deeply permeate with a spiritual, emotional, or moral quality (spirit / mind / confidence) · infuse: impart and instill a vibrant quality or feeling (life / energy / passion) · permeate: spread steadily through pores or boundaries (smell / influence / culture) · pervade: be ubiquitously present throughout a whole space or era (atmosphere / mood / silence) · suffuse: spread gradually over a surface with light or color (glow / warmth / blushes) · saturate: soak or fill to maximum absorbing capacity (market / soil / sponge)
groups.nuance_zh: imbue: 深刻灌注精神、情操或信念 (spirit / mind / confidence) · infuse: 注入生机、情感或特质 (life / energy / passion) · permeate: 弥漫穿透物理孔隙或抽象边界 (smell / influence / culture) · pervade: 无所不在地充斥整个空间或时代 (atmosphere / mood / silence) · suffuse: 光芒、色泽或情绪缓缓洋溢散开 (glow / warmth / blushes) · saturate: 彻底浸透或饱和至极限 (market / soil / sponge)

groups.name: Ingratiate & Flatter · 讨好逢迎与阿谀奉承 (Ingratiate, Flatter, Fawn)
groups.tip: 逢迎巴结他人以博取青睐与好感

items.def_en: To praise someone excessively or insincerely, usually in order to gain their favor or please them
items.ex_en: He tried to flatter the severe critic by praising her past articles profusely.
items.ex_zh: 他极力吹捧那位严苛评论家过去的著作，试图奉承讨好她。

items.def_en: (+ with) To deliberately seek to advance oneself by attentive praise or servile compliance
items.ex_en: The ambitious junior executive sought to curry favor with the managing director.
items.ex_zh: 那位野心勃勃的初级主管试图巴结讨好常务董事。

items.def_en: (+ to) (informal) To try to make someone in authority like you by flattering them or doing them favors
items.ex_en: Nobody respected Kevin because he would constantly suck up to the department head.
items.ex_zh: 没人看得起凯文，因为他总是对部门主管阿谀奉承。

items.def_en: ('ingratiate oneself with') To make deliberate efforts to gain someone's favor, praise, or approval, often insincerely.
items.ex_en: The new diplomat attempted to ingratiate himself with the local tribal leaders.
items.ex_zh: 新任外交官极力迎合当地的部落首领以博取好感。

items.def_en: (+ on/over) To display exaggerated affection, subservience, or flattery in order to curry favor
items.ex_en: Shallow sycophants would fawn over the wealthy heiress whenever she entered the ballroom.
items.ex_zh: 每当那位富家女继承人走进舞厅，浅薄的谄媚者们便对她百般奉承。

items.def_en: (+ to) To act in an abjectly humble, subservient, or desperate manner to win forgiveness or favor
items.ex_en: The disgraced manager refused to grovel to the board members for his old job.
items.ex_zh: 那位名誉扫地的主管拒绝向董事会成员低声下气地乞求保留原职。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this interpersonal frame describe actively seeking the favor, goodwill, or patronage of a superior or target through obsequious behavior, calculated compliment, or subservient attentiveness.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过奉承迎合、曲意逢迎或巴结攀附来博取上位者欢心与好感。
groups.desc_en: To deliberately seek personal favor or advantage through excessive praise, subservience, or calculated self-abasement, beyond sincere politeness.
groups.desc_zh: 为牟取私利而刻意通过谄媚、奴颜婢膝或低三下四来博取他人欢心，超出真诚的礼貌与赞赏。
groups.nuance_en: ingratiate: deliberately establish favor with someone through calculated charm (oneself with the boss / team) · flatter: praise insincerely or excessively to puff up vanity (ego / vanity) · fawn: display excessive, slavish affection or exaggerated submission (over a celebrity / dog-like devotion) · grovel: abase oneself completely in a humiliating, crawling manner (before masters / apology) · curry favor: solicit goodwill by deliberate flattery or gift-giving (with officials / voters) · suck up: crudely and servilely sycophant someone of higher rank (to management / superiors)
groups.nuance_zh: ingratiate: 处心积虑逢迎以博取好感与青睐 (oneself with the boss / team) · flatter: 虚伪奉承以迎合对方虚荣心 (ego / vanity) · fawn: 摇尾乞怜般极尽巴结之态 (over a celebrity / dog-like devotion) · grovel: 奴颜婢膝、卑躬屈膝地乞求原谅 (before masters / apology) · curry favor: 刻意讨好拍马屁以求私利 (with officials / voters) · suck up: 粗俗直白的溜须拍马 (to management / superiors)

groups.name: Initiate & Launch · 发起与倡导 (Kick off, Spearhead, Pioneer)
groups.tip: 主动启动新项目或社会倡议

items.def_en: To start an event, discussion, or series of activities
items.ex_en: Let us kick off the annual festival with a lively musical performance.
items.ex_zh: 让我们用一场欢快的音乐表演来揭开年度节日的序幕。
items.ex2_en: The crucial international soccer tournament will kick off amidst great excitement this afternoon.
items.ex2_zh: 至关重要的国际足球锦标赛将在万众瞩目中于今天下午正式开赛。

items.def_en: To start an organized activity, campaign, or commercial enterprise
items.ex_en: The technology firm will launch its newest smartphone model worldwide next Tuesday morning.
items.ex_zh: 该科技公司将于下周二上午在全球范围内推出其最新款智能手机。
items.ex2_en: The experimental research satellite launches successfully into low earth orbit early tomorrow morning.
items.ex2_zh: 实验性科研卫星将于明晨早期成功发射升入近地轨道。

items.def_zh: 发起，倡导，开始；接纳（新成员入会）；使初步了解
items.def_en: 1. To cause a process or action to begin; to launch. 2. To introduce someone to an organization or activity, often with a formal ceremony.
items.ex_en: The regulatory committee resolved to initiate formal proceedings against the fraudulent company.
items.ex_zh: 监管委员会决定对涉嫌欺诈的公司正式发起立案程序。

items.def_en: To be one of the first people to develop or implement a new idea, method, or field
items.ex_en: Distinguished scientists continue to pioneer radical breakthroughs in the field of gene therapy.
items.ex_zh: 杰出的科学家们在基因治疗领域持续开创革命性突破。

items.def_en: To bring about or initiate an action, reform, or event through deliberate urging
items.ex_en: Undercover agitators attempted to instigate widespread labor strikes across the industrial district.
items.ex_zh: 卧底煽动者企图在整个工业区策划发起广泛的工人罢工。

items.def_en: To serve as the active leader of a campaign, initiative, or movement
items.ex_en: She was chosen to spearhead the nationwide public health campaign against smoking.
items.ex_zh: 她被选定去牵头倡导全国范围内的控烟公共卫生运动。

groups.summary_en: Refers to intentionally starting, launching, or championing a formal process, movement, or campaign. Contrasts high-profile executive leadership with early trailblazing efforts.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动发起、带头推动或倡导某项进程、项目或行动。
groups.desc_en: To set an enterprise, campaign, or idea into decisive forward motion, contrasting with passively managing or maintaining an ongoing process.
groups.desc_zh: 率先挑头、启动或推动一项事业或运动大步向前，区别于按部就班的日常管理或维持现状。
groups.nuance_en: initiate: take the first official step to set a process going (talks / proceedings / reform) · launch: release or send forth decisively into operation or the market (campaign / product / rocket) · spearhead: lead an organized attack, campaign, or initiative from the front (drive / movement / initiative) · pioneer: open up new intellectual or practical territory as a forerunner (research / techniques / field) · kick off: start an event with informal energy and momentum (meeting / season / festival) · instigate: intentionally provoke or trigger an action, often rebellious or subversive (riot / probe / violence)
groups.nuance_zh: initiate: 迈出首步正式开启程序 (talks / proceedings / reform) · launch: 隆重发布、投放市场或发起战役 (campaign / product / rocket) · spearhead: 一马当先带头推进冲锋 (drive / movement / initiative) · pioneer: 开辟先河、首创全新领域 (research / techniques / field) · kick off: 充满活力地鸣锣开赛或揭幕 (meeting / season / festival) · instigate: 挑起、唆使或策动动乱与事端 (riot / probe / violence)

groups.name: Injure & Maim · 创伤与严重致残 (Wound, Mutilate, Maim)
groups.tip: 轻微受伤到重伤致残的升级

items.def_en: To cause physical harm or impairment to someone's body
items.ex_en: The reckless fall threatened to injure his shoulder right before the crucial match.
items.ex_zh: 在关键比赛前夕，那次鲁莽的摔倒险些弄伤他的肩膀。

items.def_zh: （用武器等）使受伤，伤害；伤害（感情）
items.def_en: 1. To injure someone physically, especially with a weapon. 2. To hurt someone's feelings, reputation, or pride.
items.ex_en: Stray shrapnel managed to wound two brave soldiers guarding the remote checkpoint.
items.ex_zh: 四散的弹片击伤了守卫偏远检查站的两名勇敢士兵。

items.def_en: To make a long, deep cut in someone's flesh
items.ex_en: The shattered window panes could gash your bare arms if you push through.
items.ex_zh: 如果你强行挤过去，破碎的窗玻璃可能会划伤你的手臂。

items.def_en: To tear or deeply cut flesh or skin roughly
items.ex_en: Jagged coral reefs can easily lacerate the soft flesh of unwary divers.
items.ex_zh: 参差不齐的珊瑚礁极易割裂粗心潜水员娇嫩的皮肉。

items.def_zh: 毁损肉体；严重割裂残害
items.def_en: To severely damage, disfigure, or cut off parts of a living body
items.ex_en: Cruel poachers often mutilate captured tigers to harvest their teeth and claws illegally.
items.ex_zh: 残忍的盗猎者常残害捕获的老虎，非法割取其牙齿和利爪。

items.def_en: To injure someone severely so that a part of their body is permanently damaged or lost
items.ex_en: Unexploded landmines threaten to maim innocent civilians working in the border fields.
items.ex_zh: 未爆炸的地雷威胁着在边境田地里劳作的无辜平民，动辄致残。

groups.summary_en: Denotes inflicting severe physical damage upon the body, typically involving cutting weapons, ballistics, or extreme trauma. Focuses on violent disruption of bodily integrity ranging from flesh wounds to permanent physical destruction.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过武器或暴力外力对肉体造成严重切割伤、残害或不可逆损伤。
groups.desc_en: To inflict severe physical damage resulting in broken tissue, disfigurement, or loss of bodily integrity, distinguished from minor bruises or sickness.
groups.desc_zh: 造成严重肉体破损、毁容或丧失肢体器官完整性，区别于轻微挫伤或内科疾病。
groups.nuance_en: wound: breach living tissue, typically with an external weapon (soldier / flesh / pride) · injure: cause physical, functional, or institutional harm (spine / knee / reputation) · lacerate: tear or rend flesh or skin roughly and jaggedly (skin / tissue / heart) · gash: make a long, deep cut into flesh (forehead / leg / wound) · mutilate: violently alter and ruin external form or anatomy (corpse / limbs / body) · maim: inflict permanent loss or total disablement of a limb or sensory organ (victim / survivor / worker)
groups.nuance_zh: wound: 器械造成的战伤或穿透性创口 (soldier / flesh / pride) · injure: 造成机能损伤、扭伤或骨折 (spine / knee / reputation) · lacerate: 撕裂成参差不齐的伤口 (skin / tissue / heart) · gash: 划出又长又深的深深刀口或创痕 (forehead / leg / wound) · mutilate: 凶残毁损尸体或肢体外貌 (corpse / limbs / body) · maim: 致使肢体终身残疾或丧失机能 (victim / survivor / worker)

groups.name: Injure & Maim · 残害与伤折 (Maim, Kneecap, Mutilate)
groups.tip: 残害肢体致严重致残

items.def_zh: 使伤残；使丧失活动能力
items.def_en: To cause an illness or injury that renders someone unable to function physically as before
items.ex_en: A severe spinal fracture could permanently disable an athlete in their physical prime.
items.ex_zh: 严重的脊柱骨折可能会使处于巅峰期的运动员终身丧失行动能力。

items.def_en: To injure a person or animal in a leg or foot so that walking becomes difficult or impossible
items.ex_en: A concealed iron trap did cruelly lame the magnificent stag upon the ridge.
items.ex_zh: 隐秘的铁夹残忍地致使山脊上那头雄壮的牡鹿变瘸。

items.def_en: To injure someone physically so that they cannot walk properly or use their limbs freely
items.ex_en: Falling debris threatened to cripple the construction worker during the sudden collapse.
items.ex_zh: 在突如其来的坍塌中，坠落的瓦砾险些使那名建筑工人残废。

items.def_zh: 枪击（或打碎）…的膝盖骨（作为惩罚或警告）
items.def_en: 1. To shoot or deliberately injure someone in the knee as a punishment or warning.
items.ex_en: The ruthless gang ordered enforcers to kneecap any debtor who missed payment deadlines.
items.ex_zh: 残暴的团伙命令打手打碎任何逾期未还款者的膝盖骨。

items.def_zh: 切断；毁伤；严重残毁（肢体等）
items.def_en: To severely damage the body, especially by severing or tearing off an essential limb or part
items.ex_en: Industrial machines without safety guards can violently mutilate the hands of workers.
items.ex_zh: 缺乏安全防护的工业机械会暴力切断并重度毁残工人的双手。

items.def_en: To injure someone so severely that a part of their body is permanently damaged or unusable
items.ex_en: The sudden industrial boiler explosion did maim three operators on the factory floor.
items.ex_zh: 突然发生的工业锅炉爆炸导致车间里的三名操作工重伤致残。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote causing severe, permanent, or debilitating physical damage to someone's body, typically through deliberate violence or brutal punitive strikes. They carry extremely high somatic impact.
groups.summary_zh: 指蓄意对身体造成严重骨折、肢体毁伤或永久性致残伤害。
groups.desc_en: To intentionally destroy bodily function or mobility through focused physical brutality, distinguishing structural disabling from temporary injury.
groups.desc_zh: 以残暴手段蓄意摧毁人体的行动能力或关节机能，区别于一般的创伤，强调造成持久的行动障碍。
groups.nuance_en: maim: permanently deprive of the use of a limb or organ (casualty / worker / veteran) · cripple: severely impair the ability to walk or function normally (system / opponent / limb) · disable: render completely unable to function or move (vehicle / adversary / device) · kneecap: shoot or smash the knee joint deliberately as punishment (victim / informant / rival) · lame: cause temporary or permanent limping through leg injury (horse / foot / stride) · mutilate: hack, excise, or deface key body structures (body / monument / ear)
groups.nuance_zh: maim: 使肢体终生致残断损 (casualty / worker / veteran) · cripple: 严重剥夺行走能力或彻底瘫痪机能 (system / opponent / limb) · disable: 使完全失去行动力或机械停用 (vehicle / adversary / device) · kneecap: 帮派私刑式打碎或枪击膝盖骨 (victim / informant / rival) · lame: 伤及下肢使其跛行 (horse / foot / stride) · mutilate: 割裂残害身体器官与外貌 (body / monument / ear)

groups.name: Inoculate & Immunize · 接种与免疫 (Vaccinate, Immunize, Jab)
groups.tip: 植入抗原刺激机体产生抗体

items.def_en: To provide acquired immune resistance against pathogens or transmissible disease
items.ex_en: Adequate immunization will protect infants from contracting severe measles during seasonal outbreaks.
items.ex_zh: 充分的免疫接种将保护婴儿在季节性疫情爆发期间免受严重麻疹侵害。

items.def_en: To give an additional dose of a vaccine to replenish and increase antibody levels
items.ex_en: Clinics advise elderly patients to boost their immune defenses with another shot.
items.ex_zh: 诊所建议老年患者注射加强针以增强自身的免疫防御。

items.def_en: (informal) To give someone an injection or vaccination with a sharp hypodermic needle
items.ex_en: Nurses will jab hundreds of schoolchildren against seasonal influenza at the clinic tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 护士们明天将在诊所为数百名学童注射流感疫苗。

items.def_en: To administer a vaccine to a person or animal to produce immunity against a specific disease
items.ex_en: Local authorities aim to vaccinate domestic pets against rabies in every rural district.
items.ex_zh: 地方当局旨在为各个乡村地区的家养宠物接种狂犬病疫苗。

items.def_zh: 给……接种疫苗；灌输，灌输思想；（生物）接种（微生物）
items.def_en: To protect a person or animal against a disease by injecting a mild form of it; to introduce microorganisms into a culture medium; to instill an idea into someone's mind.
items.ex_en: Medical researchers plan to inoculate volunteers with a harmless, weakened viral strain.
items.ex_zh: 医学研究人员计划为志愿者接种无害的减毒病毒株。

items.def_en: To make a person immune to an infectious disease, usually through vaccination
items.ex_en: Global health campaigns strive to immunize every vulnerable child against deadly polio.
items.ex_zh: 全球卫生运动力求为每一名易感儿童接种疫苗以抵御致命的小儿麻痹症。

groups.summary_en: Encompasses the biomedical act of administering an antigenic agent to elicit an immune response against infectious disease. 'Inoculate' emphasizes introducing the biological agent, 'vaccinate' specifically uses a vaccine, and 'immunize' focuses on inducing resultant resistance.
groups.summary_zh: 指注射抗原或疫苗以使机体获得抵御感染的免疫力。
groups.desc_en: To stimulate physiological immunity against an infectious pathogen via introducing an antigenic substance, beyond holistic health improvement.
groups.desc_zh: 通过导入抗原物质刺激生理系统产生特异性抗体以防御感染，区别于日常笼统的强身健体。
groups.nuance_en: vaccinate: administer a preparation containing antigenic material (child / patient / herd) · inoculate: introduce an antigen, pathogen, or culture to cultivate resistance or growth (population / tissue / serum) · immunize: confer active biological resistance against a specific disease (infant / flock / population) · boost: deliver a subsequent dose to enhance waning immunity (immunity / antibody / dose) · jab: colloqially give a hypodermic injection (arm / citizen / toddler) · protect: shield against infection or vulnerability broadly (against measles / patient / family)
groups.nuance_zh: vaccinate: 接种疫苗制剂以建立防线 (child / patient / herd) · inoculate: 植入抗原/病原体以诱发免疫或引种培养 (population / tissue / serum) · immunize: 使机体最终获得特异性免疫力 (infant / flock / population) · boost: 注射加强针以唤醒回升抗体 (immunity / antibody / dose) · jab: 口语中打疫苗针 (arm / citizen / toddler) · protect: 提供防范感染的整体防护屏障 (against measles / patient / family)

groups.name: Inquire & Investigate · 询问与打探 (Ask, Query, Probe)
groups.tip: 向人求证情况或正式打听信息

items.def_en: (+ about/for) To put a question to someone in order to elicit information or an answer
items.ex_en: Curious tourists stopped to ask about the historical architecture of the old cathedral.
items.ex_zh: 好奇的游客驻足打听这座古老大教堂的历史建筑风格。

items.def_en: To question someone discreetly or cautiously in order to find out their views or intentions
items.ex_en: The manager quietly sounded out a few team members before unveiling the restructuring plan.
items.ex_zh: 经理在公布重组方案之前，私下试探了几名团队成员的口风。

items.def_en: (+ into) To search into closely, examine thoroughly, or question persistently to uncover hidden facts
items.ex_en: Investigative journalists will probe into allegations of financial corruption at the charity.
items.ex_zh: 调查记者将深入调查这家慈善机构涉嫌财务腐败的指控。

items.def_en: To ask questions about something, especially to check its accuracy or express doubt
items.ex_en: Senior auditors began to query the unusual billing discrepancies in the quarterly ledger.
items.ex_zh: 高级审计员开始对季度分类账目中不同寻常的账单差异提出质疑。

items.def_en: (+ into) To inquire inappropriately or intrusively into other people's private affairs
items.ex_en: Nosy neighbors always try to pry into our private financial affairs during gatherings.
items.ex_zh: 爱管闲事的邻居总是在聚会时企图打听我们的私人财务状况。

items.def_en: (+ about/into) (chiefly British) To ask for information or investigate something.
items.ex_en: The detective arrived promptly to enquire about the missing documents from the safe.
items.ex_zh: 侦探迅速赶到现场，调查保险柜中文件失踪的情况。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve seeking information by putting questions to someone or conducting an investigation into an issue. They range from routine neutral questioning to intrusive prying or formal official investigation.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及向他人提问、探求信息或对问题展开调查的动词，涵盖日常询问至深入打探。
groups.desc_en: To actively seek out information, opinions, or hidden facts from a subject, contrasting with casually waiting to be told.
groups.desc_zh: 主动向对象探寻信息、意图或隐秘真相，区别于被动听闻或日常闲聊。
groups.nuance_en: ask: formulate a direct question seeking an answer (question / direction / permission) · enquire: seek formal or polite information about facts (about prices / details / health) · query: express doubt or formally request clarification on data (database / decision / figures) · probe: deeply examine or search into hidden matters (motives / background / secrets) · sound out: discreetly test someone’s views before taking action (intentions / views / allies) · pry: inquisitively intrude into private matters without right (into affairs / secrets / life)
groups.nuance_zh: ask: 提出直接问题以求解答 (question / direction / permission) · enquire: 礼貌正式地打听情况或事实 (about prices / details / health) · query: 对数据或决定提出质询或查询 (database / decision / figures) · probe: 深入探查刺探深层动机或秘密 (motives / background / secrets) · sound out: 试探摸底对方态度与底线 (intentions / views / allies) · pry: 窥探、刺探他人不愿公开的私事 (into affairs / secrets / life)

groups.name: Insolent Repartee & Backchat · 顶撞顶嘴与反唇相讥 (Sass, Back-talk, Retort)
groups.tip: 态度无礼地顶嘴与回敬

items.def_en: To answer someone rapidly with an incisive, witty, or indignant response
items.ex_en: "I never asked for your opinion," she was quick to retort angrily.
items.ex_zh: “我从没征求过你的意见，”她迅速愤怒地反驳道。

items.def_en: (+ to) To reply defiantly or insolently to someone in authority
items.ex_en: The rebellious teenager dared to talk back to the headmaster during morning assembly.
items.ex_zh: 那个叛逆的少年竟敢在早会上顶撞校长。

items.def_en: To speak to someone with brazen disrespect and cheeky effrontery
items.ex_en: The impudent boy had the nerve to cheek the headmaster after class.
items.ex_zh: 那个放肆的男孩下课后竟然敢无礼顶撞校长。

items.def_en: To reply impudently or argumentatively to a superior or authority figure
items.ex_en: Do not dare to back-talk your mother when she assigns your daily chores.
items.ex_zh: 母亲给你布置日常家务时，休敢出言顶嘴。

items.raw_cluster: 顶撞与反驳 Retort & Talk Back
items.def_en: (informal, chiefly North American) to talk back rudely or cheekily to someone, especially an authority figure
items.ex_en: The spoilt child would constantly sass the babysitter whenever asked to finish homework.
items.ex_zh: 每当被要求完成作业时，那个被宠坏的孩子总是对保姆无礼顶撞。

items.def_en: (+ to/at) To speak impertinently, disrespectfully, or belligerently to someone
items.ex_en: The drunken patron began to mouth off at the bouncer outside the pub.
items.ex_zh: 喝醉的顾客在酒吧门外开始对保安出言不逊、肆意叫嚣。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers responding to figures of authority or conversation partners with cheeky, impudent, or sharp verbal defiance. The focus is on conversational disrespect, sharpness, or quick insolent retorts.
groups.summary_zh: 指对长辈、上级或他人不逊地顶撞、回嘴或带刺地反唇相讥。
groups.desc_en: To answer an authority or peer with provocative, disrespectful, or cheeky defiance, contrasting with humble submission or polite disagreement.
groups.desc_zh: 对权威或对话者进行挑衅性、缺乏尊重的回嘴或反唇相讥，区别于顺从服从或客气的异议。
groups.nuance_en: talk back: brazenly answer a superior or parent when scolded (to parents / teacher) · retort: reply sharply and wittily to a charge or argument (charge / criticism / challenge) · sass: impudently and cheekily disrespect authority (teacher / parent / judge) · back-talk: stubbornly argue back against parental or adult authority (elder / mother) · cheek: speak impolitely and boldly without deference (boss / elder / official) · mouth off: aggressively and tactlessly express opinions or complaints aloud (to cops / in public / behind back)
groups.nuance_zh: talk back: 面对长辈或上司训斥时顶嘴回呛 (to parents / teacher) · retort: 针对指责机敏而犀利地反唇相讥 (charge / criticism / challenge) · sass: 俏皮、傲慢而无礼地顶撞 (teacher / parent / judge) · back-talk: 执拗地跟父母长辈还口顶撞 (elder / mother) · cheek: 放肆无礼、不知天高地厚地顶撞 (boss / elder / official) · mouth off: 大声嚷嚷、毫无顾忌地放肆牢骚或挑衅 (to cops / in public / behind back)

groups.name: Integration & Assimilation · 合并与融合 (Integrate, Merge, Absorb)
groups.tip: 吸纳归并融入成为一体

items.def_zh: 合并，融入；包含，吸收；将……组建为法人公司
items.def_en: 1. To include or blend something into a larger whole or system. 2. To form into a legally recognized company or corporation.
items.ex_en: The modern curriculum will incorporate practical programming skills into basic mathematics instruction.
items.ex_zh: 现代课程体系将把实用编程技能融入基础数学教学中。

items.def_en: Combine two or more things effectively so that they become a single unified system
items.ex_en: Engineers worked overtime to integrate the advanced navigation software into the vehicle cockpit.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们加班加点，以将先进的导航软件整合到车辆驾驶舱中。
items.ex2_en: The immigrant communities integrate smoothly into local civic life over two successive generations.
items.ex2_zh: 移民社群在连续两代人的时间里顺利融入了当地的市民生活。

items.def_en: Take in and make something part of a larger group, organization, or body
items.ex_en: The corporate conglomerate plans to absorb smaller regional competitors over the next decade.
items.ex_zh: 该大型企业集团计划在未来十年内兼并规模较小的区域竞争对手。

items.def_en: Blend or incorporate a component gently and thoroughly into a larger structure
items.ex_en: The director managed to fold into the narrative several subtle references to mythology.
items.ex_zh: 导演巧妙地将数处含蓄的神话典故融入了叙事结构中。

items.def_en: Combine or cause two or more things, companies, or streams to coalesce into a single unit
items.ex_en: Two banking titans announced plans to merge into a massive global financial institution.
items.ex_zh: 两家银行业巨头宣布了合并为一家庞大跨国金融机构的计划。
items.ex2_en: The corporate executive hopes to merge two regional sales divisions into one department.
items.ex2_zh: 企业高管希望将两个区域销售部门合并为一个部门。

items.def_en: Absorb and integrate ideas, customs, or people into a prevailing system or culture
items.ex_en: The university helps international scholars assimilate complex cultural customs into their daily lives.
items.ex_zh: 该大学帮助国际学者将复杂的文化习俗融入到日常生活中。
items.ex2_en: Foreign cultural traditions assimilate slowly into native society across several successive historical eras.
items.ex2_zh: 外来文化传统历经数个相继的历史时代才逐渐被本土社会同化吸收。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here denote absorbing, blending, or assimilating separate elements into a cohesive unified whole or larger operational structure.
groups.summary_zh: 将独立的要素、组织或成分纳为一体，使之并入更大整体。
groups.desc_en: To combine distinct elements or groups into a unified, coherent whole, contrasted with mere mechanical juxtaposition or coexistence.
groups.desc_zh: 将不同的要素或群体融汇融合为一个和谐统一的有机整体，区别于简单的物理拼凑或机械共存。
groups.nuance_en: integrate: coordinate different parts into a functioning unified system (system / schools / data) · merge: blend two distinct entities into one singular identity (companies / tracks / colors) · assimilate: absorb a minority group or idea fully into a dominant culture (immigrants / customs / ideas) · absorb: take in and fully encompass resources or groups into a larger body (costs / territory / shock) · incorporate: legally or structurally include something into an existing framework (features / feedback / company) · fold into: seamlessly blend one component into a larger mix (mixture / department / narrative)
groups.nuance_zh: integrate: 将分立部分整合进运转系统 (system / schools / data) · merge: 强强联合或两造合并为单一实体 (companies / tracks / colors) · assimilate: 被主流文化全面同化同构 (immigrants / customs / ideas) · absorb: 彻底包容吸纳并吞没资源或群体 (costs / territory / shock) · incorporate: 结构性或法理上纳入已有框架 (features / feedback / company) · fold into: 顺畅无痕地调入或并入大局 (mixture / department / narrative)

groups.name: Intercept & Cut Off · 拦截与阻截 (Intercept, Head off, Cut off)
groups.tip: 中途截断阻止前行

items.def_en: To get in front of someone or a group moving toward a destination in order to stop them or change their direction
items.ex_en: Security guards ran ahead to head off the angry demonstrators before the gates.
items.ex_zh: 保安人员飞奔上前，在大门前迎头拦住愤怒的示威人群。

items.def_en: To block the route or path of someone moving, preventing them from proceeding or escaping
items.ex_en: Heavy snow cut off several remote villages for days.
items.ex_zh: 大雪将几个偏远村庄阻隔了数天之久。

items.def_en: To encounter and halt someone when they are exposed or mid-transit
items.ex_en: The customs patrol managed to catch out the smuggler as he crossed border.
items.ex_zh: 海关巡逻队在走私贩穿越边境的中途将其当场截停抓获。

items.def_en: (formal/military) To intercept and prevent enemy movement, contraband, or supply lines from reaching an objective
items.ex_en: Naval forces were dispatched to interdict hostile supply ships entering international territorial waters.
items.ex_zh: 海军部队被派去阻截并封锁进入国际专属海域的敌方补给船。

items.def_zh: 拦截，截住，阻截；截听，截获
items.def_en: To stop, catch, or seize someone or something moving from one place to another before they reach their destination
items.ex_en: Fighter jets scrambled swiftly to intercept an unidentified aircraft approaching the sovereign airspace.
items.ex_zh: 战斗机紧急升空，迅速拦截逼近主权领空的来历不明飞机。

items.def_en: To lie in wait for and stop or ambush someone unexpectedly along their path
items.ex_en: Highwaymen stepped from the shadows to waylay the royal carriage on the lonely forest road.
items.ex_zh: 绿林强盗从阴影中走出，在偏僻的林间小路上拦截了皇家马车。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on stopping, catching, or redirecting someone or something that is moving toward a destination before they arrive, usually by crossing their path or preempting their course.
groups.summary_zh: 指在人、物或信号抵达目的地途中，跨前横切路径实施堵截、阻断或缴获。
groups.desc_en: To actively block, seize, or halt someone or something along its trajectory before it reaches its destination, contrasting with trailing or following.
groups.desc_zh: 在其行进或流通轨道途中主动予以拦截、阻断或围堵，区别于在后尾随或事后追查。
groups.nuance_en: intercept: catch or seize en route before arrival (missile / communication / pass) · head off: alter route to get ahead of and turn back (crisis / stampede / intruder) · cut off: isolate by severing escape lines or supply (supplies / escape / communication) · interdict: prohibit and halt movement by force or legal order (contraband / shipments / route) · waylay: wait in ambush and detain someone unexpectedly (traveler / courier / minister) · catch out: trap or discover someone unexpectedly off guard (in lie / error / fraud)
groups.nuance_zh: intercept: 半途迎面拦截截获 (missile / communication / pass) · head off: 抢先赶到前头予以抄截阻拦 (crisis / stampede / intruder) · cut off: 切断通路或后勤将对方孤立 (supplies / escape / communication) · interdict: 依据军力或法令封锁截断运输线 (contraband / shipments / route) · waylay: 埋伏于半路实施阻拦劫持 (traveler / courier / minister) · catch out: 出其不意抓到现行或把柄 (in lie / error / fraud)

groups.name: Interfere & Meddle · 干涉与瞎掺和 (Interfere, Pry, Butt in)
groups.tip: 没有资格却多管闲事插手

items.def_en: (+ around / on) Look around secretly in order to discover private information about others
items.ex_en: I caught my nosy roommate trying to snoop on my private text messages last night.
items.ex_zh: 昨晚我当场抓到爱管闲事的室友正想偷看我的私人短信。

items.def_en: (informal) Interrupt rudely or intrude uninvited into a conversation or private business
items.ex_en: Please stop trying to butt in on our private discussion without an invitation.
items.ex_zh: 请不要再不请自来地冒失插手我们的私下讨论了。

items.def_zh: 干涉，介入他人事务并造成妨碍
items.def_en: (+ with / in) Deliberately get involved in a situation where one is not wanted or needed, causing trouble
items.ex_en: She warned her distant relatives never to interfere in her difficult personal affairs again.
items.ex_zh: 她警告远房亲戚们绝不要再干涉她棘手的个人私事。

items.def_zh: 管闲事，干涉，干预；瞎弄，擅自乱动
items.def_en: (disapproving) to interfere in something that is not your concern, or touch things without permission.
items.ex_en: He told his mother not to meddle in his private life or career choices.
items.ex_zh: 他告诉母亲不要再对自己的私生活或职业选择指手画脚。

items.def_en: (+ into) Inquire too inquisitively or nosily into other people's private lives
items.ex_en: Journalists should not pry into the tragic family affairs of the grieving movie star.
items.ex_zh: 记者不应当过度打探这位悲痛中的影星家里的不幸私事。

items.def_zh: 胡乱摆弄，非法篡改破坏
items.def_en: (+ with) Interfere with something secretly or improperly in order to alter, damage, or falsify it
items.ex_en: The corrupt official tried to tamper with the sensitive digital records before the investigation.
items.ex_zh: 那名腐败官员在调查展开前试图非法篡改这些敏感的电子记录。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe unwelcome, intrusive, and disruptive involvement in other people's affairs or private business. They carry a strong disapproving tone, often highlighting nosiness, presumption, or unauthorized tampering.
groups.summary_zh: 强调令人反感地插手、过问他人私事或擅自摆弄摆布。
groups.desc_en: To intrusively insert oneself or one's influence into matters that are not one's rightful concern, contrasting with invited help.
groups.desc_zh: 擅自插手、窥探或横加干预本与自己无关的私事，区别于受邀提供的正当协助。
groups.nuance_en: interfere: hinder or meddle with processes by unwanted involvement (in election / with trial / affairs) · meddle: busy oneself officiously in others' concerns without right (in affairs / lives / business) · butt in: rudely interrupt an ongoing conversation or encounter (conversation / discussion / meeting) · pry: aggressively inquire into personal and private matters (into private life / secrets) · snoop: look or prowl around secretively to discover hidden things (around room / on phone / emails) · tamper: make unauthorized, harmful alterations to an object or record (with evidence / lock / meter)
groups.nuance_zh: interfere: 不当介入或妨碍正常进程 (in election / with trial / affairs) · meddle: 瞎操心、多管闲事插足他人事务 (in affairs / lives / business) · butt in: 毫无教养地横插一杠、插嘴打断 (conversation / discussion / meeting) · pry: 刨根问底窥探他人隐私 (into private life / secrets) · snoop: 偷偷摸摸暗中窥视翻查 (around room / on phone / emails) · tamper: 私自篡改破坏证据或机械结构 (with evidence / lock / meter)

groups.name: Interrogate & Grill · 质问与盘问 (Cross-examine, Third-degree, Pump)
groups.tip: 严词诘难与高压拷问

items.def_en: To question someone discreetly or cautiously in order to discover their opinions or intentions.
items.ex_en: The manager quietly sounded out a few team members before unveiling the restructuring plan.
items.ex_zh: 经理在公布重组方案之前，私下试探了几名团队成员的口风。

items.def_en: To ask someone a series of rapid, inquisitive questions to obtain information or test knowledge.
items.ex_en: The anxious teacher began to quiz the nervous students about their missing homework assignments.
items.ex_zh: 焦虑的老师开始盘问那些神色紧张的学生，追查他们缺失的作业。

items.def_en: (+ for) To elicit confidential or private information from someone by persistent questioning.
items.ex_en: The sly reporter tried to pump the young secretary for confidential merger details over lunch.
items.ex_zh: 狡黠的记者在午餐时试图从年轻秘书嘴里套出并购的机密细节。

items.def_en: 1. (informal) To question someone intensely and relentlessly for a long period. 2. To cook food directly under or over intense heat on a metal frame.
items.ex_en: Detectives continued to grill the exhausted suspect about his whereabouts on the fatal night.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们就那个致命之夜的行踪，继续严厉盘问疲惫不堪的嫌疑人。

items.def_en: To question a witness or opponent vigorously in detail to test the truth of their statements.
items.ex_en: The defense attorney prepared to cross-examine the key witness regarding her contradictory earlier testimony.
items.ex_zh: 辩方律师准备就关键证人前后矛盾的早期证词对其进行交叉盘问。

items.def_en: To ask someone thorough, searching questions in a formal, stern, or official setting.
items.ex_en: Federal agents will formally interrogate the foreign diplomat in a secure facility tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 联邦特工将于明早在安全设施内正式讯问这名外国外交官。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here denote aggressive, exhaustive, and relentless questioning aimed at breaking resistance and forcing out hidden truths. 'Grill' conveys colloquial heat and persistence, 'interrogate' formal custodial examination, and 'cross-examine' forensic scrutiny.
groups.summary_zh: 指带有压迫性、审判性地连续盘根问底以撬开真情。
groups.desc_en: To subject someone to rigorous, relentless, and probing questioning to extract admissions or facts, beyond an egalitarian conversation.
groups.desc_zh: 以压迫性、连珠炮式的高压问话迫使对方交代实情或吐露底细，区别于平等的交谈或一般采访。
groups.nuance_en: interrogate: formally and systematically question an official suspect (prisoner / suspect / defector) · grill: relentlessly question someone in an intense, uncomfortable fashion (politician / witness / child) · cross-examine: rigorously test credibility in a courtroom setting (witness / defendant / claim) · pump: extract information cunningly through persistence or drink (friend / informant / for details) · quiz: test knowledge or opinions with short, direct questions (student / applicant / official) · sound out: tactfully seek to elicit opinions or feelings without pressure (views / intentions / stance)
groups.nuance_zh: interrogate: 正式、系统化地讯问嫌疑人 (prisoner / suspect / defector) · grill: 狂轰滥炸式拷问追问 (politician / witness / child) · cross-examine: 法庭上由对方向证人进行盘诘交叉询问 (witness / defendant / claim) · pump: 旁敲侧击或套取内部消息 (friend / informant / for details) · quiz: 简短抽查提问或测验 (student / applicant / official) · sound out: 委婉温和地试探意向 (views / intentions / stance)

groups.name: Intimidate & Browbeat · 威吓与胁迫 (Browbeat, Bully, Cow)
groups.tip: 以强横言行恐吓胁迫他人

items.def_en: To use direct pressure, threats, or intimidation on someone to compel behavior
items.ex_en: She had to lean heavily on her family during those tough months.
items.ex_zh: 在那段艰难的岁月里，她不得不极度依赖家人的支持。

items.def_en: (+ into) To use superior strength, size, or authority to persecute or force someone to comply
items.ex_en: The corrupt landlord tried to bully the poor tenants into paying higher rent early.
items.ex_zh: 恶劣的房东企图仗势欺人，强逼贫困租客提前交付更高额的租金。

items.def_en: (+ into) To frighten or overawe someone into subdued submission through menaces
items.ex_en: The tyrant sought to cow the restless villagers into submission through displays of force.
items.ex_zh: 暴君企图通过展示武力来威慑躁动的村民，迫使他们屈服顺从。

items.def_en: To intentionally make someone fearful or timid, especially to make them act in a certain way
items.ex_en: The burly guards tried to intimidate the peaceful protesters outside the high courthouse gates.
items.ex_zh: 高大的警卫企图恐吓法院高门之外进行和平抗议的人群。

items.def_en: (+ into/through) To force someone or an initiative into submission by sheer aggressive momentum
items.ex_en: The administration managed to bulldoze the controversial legislation through the divided legislative assembly.
items.ex_zh: 政府设法以强硬姿态在产生分歧的立法机构中强行推行了这项有争议的法案。

items.def_en: (+ into) To intimidate or bully someone into doing something using harsh words or stern looks.
items.ex_en: The ruthless prosecutor attempted to browbeat the reluctant witness into signing the fabricated confession.
items.ex_zh: 冷酷的检察官企图通过声色俱厉的威逼，迫使不情愿的证人签下伪造的供词。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses communicative and behavioral acts aimed at frightening, overpowering, or coercing another person into compliance through harsh language, imposing posture, or continuous overbearing threats.
groups.summary_zh: 通过严词厉色、强梁霸道或恐吓威胁迫使他人屈服顺从。
groups.desc_en: To coerce someone into submission or compliance using overbearing posture, threats, or institutional superiority, distinct from rational persuasion.
groups.desc_zh: 倚仗强势体魄、威胁或特权地位强行压服对手使其屈从，区别于讲事实摆道理的理性说服。
groups.nuance_en: intimidate: inspire fear to deter or compel action (witness / voter / competitor) · browbeat: cow and dominate through loud, harsh, arrogant verbal abuse (witness / staff / subordinate) · cow: thoroughly subdue someone’s courage into cowering obedience (into submission / populace / critics) · bully: habitually persecute or harass someone weaker (child / junior / peer) · bulldoze: push aside objections brutally without nuance (legislation / opposition / proposals) · lean on: exert coercive pressure or threats behind the scenes (debtor / official / witness)
groups.nuance_zh: intimidate: 制造恐惧气氛以遏制或强迫对方 (witness / voter / competitor) · browbeat: 盛气凌人、横眉立目地喝斥弹压 (witness / staff / subordinate) · cow: 吓破其胆量使其俯首贴耳 (into submission / populace / critics) · bully: 倚强凌弱、霸凌欺侮弱者 (child / junior / peer) · bulldoze: 粗暴无视一切阻力蛮干到底 (legislation / opposition / proposals) · lean on: 在幕后施加高压恐吓或威逼 (debtor / official / witness)

groups.name: Intimidate & Hector · 恐吓与威逼 (Bully, Browbeat, Cow)
groups.tip: 盛气凌人地威吓并强迫他人

items.def_zh: 迫使…仓促屈服；强行推动
items.def_en: To force someone into doing something hastily without calm consideration
items.ex_en: The aggressive salesman tried to railroad him into signing the unfair purchase contract immediately.
items.ex_zh: 咄咄逼人的推销员试图迫使他仓促签下这份不公平的购买合同。

items.def_en: To use superior strength or influence to intimidate someone, typically to force them to do what one wants
items.ex_en: The older boys frequently bully younger students for their lunch money in the playground.
items.ex_zh: 高年级男生经常在操场上以强欺弱，勒索低年级学生的午餐钱。
