items.def_en: To cause someone to submit or feel subdued through fear or intimidation
items.ex_en: Cruel tyrants could not cow the proud rebellion with terrifying threats of swift punishment.
items.ex_zh: 残暴的统治者无法用迅速惩处的恐怖威胁吓倒这群高傲的起义者。

items.def_zh: 盛气凌人地威吓，威逼，欺凌
items.def_en: To talk to or treat someone in a loud, aggressive, bullying way to force them to do something.
items.ex_en: The arrogant foreman continued to hector the weary factory workers with harsh shouted commands.
items.ex_zh: 傲慢的工头继续用大声呼喝的严厉命令，盛气凌人地训斥疲惫的工厂工人们。

items.def_en: To use coercive or aggressive physical or political tactics to force compliance
items.ex_en: Corrupt party bosses used ruthless threats to strong-arm rebellious delegates into line.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的党派大佬们使用冷酷的威胁手段，强硬逼迫反叛的代表妥协服从。

items.def_en: To intimidate or coerce someone into doing something using aggressive words or stern looks
items.ex_en: The stern director attempted to browbeat the junior manager during the tense board meeting.
items.ex_zh: 严厉的董事在紧张的董事会上试图以严词吓唬那位初级经理。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe using loud, aggressive, or domineering behavior to frighten, pressure, or coerce someone into compliance. Nuances range from persistent verbal harassment and browbeating to sheer psychological intimidation.
groups.summary_zh: 通过言语恐吓、盛气凌人的态度施压或迫使他人顺从。
groups.desc_en: To dominate, lecture, or compel another person through aggressive badgering and physical or verbal force, contrasting with respectful negotiation.
groups.desc_zh: 通过颐指气使、喋喋不休的斥责或强制手段胁迫他人顺从，区别于平等的协商谈判。
groups.nuance_en: hector: badger and address someone in a loud, patronizing, bullying manner (opponent / crowd / assistant) · strong-arm: compel compliance through raw physical force or overt threats (competitor / union / debtor) · railroad into: rush or force someone into an unfair agreement without choice (deal / verdict / decision) · browbeat: verbally crush someone into compliance by harsh domination (witness / committee / clerk) · bully: harass and oppress vulnerable individuals systematically (weaker kids / colleagues) · cow: intimidate into passive, spiritless surrender (critics / opposition / victim)
groups.nuance_zh: hector: 颐指气使、咄咄逼人地训斥纠缠 (opponent / crowd / assistant) · strong-arm: 动用蛮力或武力明火执仗地威逼 (competitor / union / debtor) · railroad into: 强行绑架、草率定案不容辩白 (deal / verdict / decision) · browbeat: 以咆哮压服的威压压制异见 (witness / committee / clerk) · bully: 恃强凌弱并施加长期的欺压 (weaker kids / colleagues) · cow: 吓得对方唯唯诺诺丧失反抗意愿 (critics / opposition / victim)

groups.name: Intravenous Delivery & Injection · 药物输注与静脉给药 (Inject, Transfuse, Infuse)
groups.tip: 针剂输入血管，医学输液与注入

items.def_en: to supply liquid nourishment or medicine slowly through an intravenous drip
items.ex_en: The intensive care nurses drip-feed the comatose patient with vital nutrients every single day.
items.ex_zh: 重症监护室的护士们每天都通过静脉滴注为昏迷的病人补充生命所需的营养。

items.def_en: (+ sth) inject an illegal narcotic directly into a vein
items.ex_en: The desperate addict ducked into the dark alley to shoot up cheap illegal heroin.
items.ex_zh: 绝望的成瘾者溜进黑暗的小巷，向静脉注射廉价的非法海洛因。

items.def_en: to force a fluid or medication into tissue or a vein using a syringe and needle
items.ex_en: The attending nurse will carefully inject the strong sedative directly into the patient's arm.
items.ex_zh: 值班护士将小心地把强效镇静剂直接注射进病人的手臂中。

items.def_en: to introduce a fluid or drug into a vein at a slow, controlled rate over time
items.ex_en: Doctors decided to infuse the chemotherapy drug slowly into the patient's bloodstream over hours.
items.ex_zh: 医生决定在数小时内将化疗药物缓慢且受控地输注进病人的血液中。

items.def_zh: 静脉注射（毒品）；快速注入，直接输送
items.def_en: 1. (slang) To inject an illegal drug directly into a major vein. 2. (informal) To take in or supply something directly and intensely.
items.ex_en: The tragic street musician used to mainline raw narcotics in squalid abandoned buildings nearby.
items.ex_zh: 那个悲剧的街头乐手过去常在附近肮脏的废弃建筑里直接向静脉注射纯毒品。

items.def_en: 1. (medicine) To transfer blood or blood products directly into a patient's vein. 2. To instill, permeate, or infuse an idea or quality into something.
items.ex_en: Surgeons had to transfuse four whole pints of blood into the bleeding accident victim.
items.ex_zh: 外科医生必须向大出血的事故受害者体内输注整整四品脱的血液。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote administering liquids, blood products, or therapeutic/narcotic agents directly into the bloodstream or tissue via needles, catheters, or vascular lines.
groups.summary_zh: 通过针具、导管向血管或组织中输入液体、血液或药剂。
groups.desc_en: To introduce liquid medications, blood, or fluids directly into the venous system or bloodstream, distinguished from oral or topical administration.
groups.desc_zh: 将药物液体、血液或营养成分直接打入或输注进静脉血液循环系统，区别于口服或外敷给药。
groups.nuance_en: inject: force fluid into a body, vein, or tissue with a needle (drug / vaccine / insulin) · transfuse: transfer whole blood or blood products into the bloodstream (blood / plasma / fluid) · infuse: administer large volumes of solution slowly via an intravenous line (saline / medication / chemo) · drip-feed: supply nutrients, funds, or liquids continuously drop by drop (nutrients / liquidity / capital) · mainline: inject a narcotic substance directly into a vein (heroin / drug) · shoot up: colloquially self-administer illegal injectable drugs (heroin / dose)
groups.nuance_zh: inject: 用针管将液体注射入血管或皮下 (drug / vaccine / insulin) · transfuse: 将血液或血制品输注入体内 (blood / plasma / fluid) · infuse: 经静脉通路大剂量长程点滴输液 (saline / medication / chemo) · drip-feed: 慢速滴注或细水长流式输入 (nutrients / liquidity / capital) · mainline: 直接静脉注射强力毒品 (heroin / drug) · shoot up: 俚语中自行注射违禁毒品 (heroin / dose)

groups.name: Intuitive & Mystical Divination · 直觉感应与占卜推测 (Divine, Douse, Scry)
groups.tip: 凭直觉或迹象预判未来

items.def_en: To detect, perceive, or recognize something obscure through sharp insight
items.ex_en: Through the dense winter fog, the watchful lookout could barely discern the distant lighthouse.
items.ex_zh: 穿过冬日的浓雾，警惕的瞭望员几乎难以辨识出远方的灯塔。

items.def_en: To penetrate and understand a profound mystery or another's obscure intentions
items.ex_en: Scholars still struggle to fathom the profound motives driving the mysterious philosopher's sudden departure.
items.ex_zh: 学者们仍难以彻底参透那位神秘哲学家突然离去的深层动机。

items.def_zh: 用探杆探测（水源或矿脉）
items.def_en: (also dowse) To search for underground water or minerals using a divining rod
items.ex_en: The superstitious farmer used a forked hazel stick to douse for water underground.
items.ex_zh: 迷信的农民用一根分叉的榛木枝在地下探测寻找水源。

items.def_en: To understand or foresee something instinctively without the intervention of conscious reasoning
items.ex_en: An experienced commander can often intuit the hidden movements of the enemy before dawn.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的指挥官往往能在黎明前凭直觉推知敌军的隐秘动向。

items.def_zh: 占卜，卜算；凭直觉推测，料想
items.def_en: to discover or guess something by using intuition, perception, or alleged supernatural powers
items.ex_en: Ancient priests claimed they could divine the will of the gods from bird flights.
items.ex_zh: 古代祭司声称他们能够通过鸟类的飞行轨迹占卜出神灵的旨意。

items.def_en: To foretell the future or reveal secrets by gazing into a crystal, mirror, or pool of water
items.ex_en: The mysterious sorceress leaned close over the dark water to scry the kingdom's fate.
items.ex_zh: 神秘的女巫俯身凑近幽暗的水池，凝视占卜王国的未来命运。

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies discerning hidden truths, future developments, or underground materials through deep intuition, non-rational perception, or supernatural and occult methods, distinguishing it from empirical, statistical forecasting.
groups.summary_zh: 强调依赖直觉洞察、通灵玄学、占卜或神秘感应来探测隐秘真相或窥测未来。
groups.desc_en: To ascertain obscure, hidden, or future truths via mystical insight, supernatural means, or deep intuitive leaps, beyond logical deduction.
groups.desc_zh: 凭借神秘占卜、超感知觉或极敏锐的直觉领悟隐藏或未来的真相，区别于基于严密逻辑的因果推论。
groups.nuance_en: divine: discover hidden truth or foresee future by intuition or omens (future / intentions / truth) · intuit: understand instinctively without conscious reasoning (danger / feelings / pattern) · scry: practice crystal gazing to reveal prophetic visions (visions / future / image) · douse: search for underground water or minerals using a dowser's rod (for water / well / vein) · fathom: penetrate and comprehend a deep, obscure mystery (depths / mystery / motive) · discern: recognize and detect with fine cognitive or perceptual insight (difference / outline / truth)
groups.nuance_zh: divine: 占卜吉凶或凭第六感神机妙算 (future / intentions / truth) · intuit: 凭借超验直觉瞬间感知参透 (danger / feelings / pattern) · scry: 借助水晶球或镜面观像占卜 (visions / future / image) · douse: 使用寻龙尺或探测棒探寻地底水源 (for water / well / vein) · fathom: 测透深不可测的动机或奥秘 (depths / mystery / motive) · discern: 敏锐地洞察识别幽微真相 (difference / outline / truth)

groups.name: Invade & Overrun · 侵占与席卷 (Overrun, Swarm, Inundate)
groups.tip: 大举入侵并快速席卷占领

items.def_en: Spread across an area quickly and powerfully, affecting everything in its path
items.ex_en: A ferocious arctic cold wave will sweep over the unprotected northern plains tonight.
items.ex_zh: 一股强烈的北极寒潮今晚将席卷毫无遮蔽的北部大平原。

items.def_en: Move or gather somewhere in large, dense, often disorienting numbers
items.ex_en: Thousands of excited football fans will swarm into the stadium before the final match.
items.ex_zh: 成千上万激动的足球迷将在决赛前成群涌入体育场。

items.def_en: Enter a country or area in large numbers by force to occupy it, or enter a place aggressively in crowds
items.ex_en: Foreign armored divisions prepared to invade the neighboring sovereign nation along the northern frontier.
items.ex_zh: 外国装甲师已做好准备，沿着北部边境武装入侵邻近的主权国家。

items.def_zh: （军队）大举攻占，席卷；（害虫、杂草等）肆虐，泛滥；超过（限度、时间）
items.def_en: 1. to invade, spread over, or occupy a place rapidly and in large numbers. 2. to exceed an allotted limit, budget, or scheduled time.
items.ex_en: Aggressive invasive weeds quickly began to overrun the neglected community gardens this rainy summer.
items.ex_zh: 在这个多雨的夏天，凶猛的入侵性杂草很快便开始肆虐荒废的社区花园。

items.def_en: Sweep over and completely cover or surround something so as to submerge or hide it
items.ex_en: Towering ocean waves threaten to engulf the vulnerable coastal village during the violent storm.
items.ex_zh: 狂暴的暴风雨中，滔天海浪威胁着要彻底吞没这座脆弱的沿海村庄。

items.def_zh: 泛滥于；大批涌向并淹没
items.def_en: Overwhelm or flood a place with huge numbers of people, things, or requests
items.ex_en: Angry citizens will inundate the city council offices with formal complaints about broken roads.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的市民们将用关于道路破损的正式投诉淹没市议会办公室。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers forces, crowds, or phenomena spreading aggressively, rapidly, and in overwhelming numbers to engulf and control a space.
groups.summary_zh: 指大批人马、军队或事物以压倒之势迅速席卷、占据某地。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an overwhelming, hostile ingress or inundation of an area or entity, advancing beyond mere entry into sudden occupation and submergence.
groups.desc_zh: 指敌对或压倒性力量如潮水般涌入、吞没并占领某处，区别于普通进入，强调数量与势头的不可阻挡与淹没性。
groups.nuance_en: invade: organized hostile entry across borders (territory / privacy) · overrun: overwhelming swarm rapidly taking control (defenses / town) · engulf: total oceanic swallowing or surrounding (flames / darkness) · inundate: flooding overwhelm by sheer volume (market / complaints) · swarm: mass crowded movement converging en masse (tourists / locusts)
groups.nuance_zh: invade: 具敌意的有组织入侵或侵犯 (territory / privacy) · overrun: 兵力或群体压倒性席卷攻陷 (defenses / town) · engulf: 如烈火或洪水般彻底吞没 (flames / darkness) · inundate: 数量过大如洪水般淹没受阻 (market / complaints) · swarm: 蜂拥成群密集扑来 (tourists / locusts)

groups.name: Invert & Overturn · 逆转与颠倒 (Invert, Overturn, Upend)
groups.tip: 前后翻转或方向对换完全倒置

items.def_zh: 颠倒，彻底反转；倒退，倒车
items.def_en: 1. To change something completely to its opposite, or invert its order or position. 2. To drive or move backwards.
items.ex_en: The supreme court unexpectedly decided to reverse the lower court's controversial legal ruling yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 最高法院昨天出人意料地决定彻底推翻下级法院那项颇具争议的法律裁决。
items.ex2_en: The driver must reverse carefully when backing the long commercial truck into traffic.
items.ex2_zh: 驾驶员在把长轴商业卡车倒出开进车流时必须小心倒车。

items.def_en: To turn over quickly into an opposite orientation, or suddenly reverse a stance
items.ex_en: The skilled short-order cook watched carefully before using his spatula to flip the pancake.
items.ex_zh: 熟练的快餐厨师仔细观察着，然后用铲子把煎饼迅速翻了个面。
items.ex2_en: The gold coin flipped through the air before landing on the wooden floor.
items.ex2_zh: 金币在空中翻转，然后落在了木地板上。

items.def_en: To put something upside down or in the opposite order, position, or arrangement
items.ex_en: Graphic designers deliberately invert the bright color scheme to create striking negative images instantly.
items.ex_zh: 平面设计师特意颠倒鲜艳的配色方案，以瞬间创造出引人注目的负片效果。

items.def_en: To completely transform a nature, state, or structure into a contrasting or alternative form
items.ex_en: Medieval alchemists believed secret philosophical knowledge could transmute base lead into purest gold.
items.ex_zh: 中世纪炼金术士相信，秘密的哲学知识能够将寻常铅块彻底转化为纯金。
items.ex2_en: Over centuries of deep meditation, mortal flesh might transmute into pure spiritual energy.
items.ex2_zh: 经过数个世纪的深度冥想，凡人之躯可能会蜕变为纯粹的精神能量。

items.def_en: To turn upside down, or officially invalidate and reverse a legal decision or policy
items.ex_en: A sudden violent ocean gale threatened to overturn the small wooden fishing vessel completely.
items.ex_zh: 海上突然刮起的猛烈强风眼看就要将那艘小型木制渔船彻底掀翻。
items.ex2_en: The overloaded canoe overturned suddenly when hit by a massive crashing wave.
items.ex2_zh: 超载的独木舟在被巨浪撞击时突然倾覆了。

items.def_en: To set or turn something completely upside down, disrupting established balance or order
items.ex_en: The revolutionary financial technology threatens to completely upend established banking practices worldwide this year.
items.ex_zh: 这项革命性的金融科技势必会在今年彻底颠覆全球既有的银行业务惯例。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate rotating, flipping, or transforming an order, position, relationship, or ruling entirely into its opposite. The change may be physical (turning upside down) or systemic (overruling a decision).
groups.summary_zh: 使物理位置、既定顺序或裁定彻底转向对立面。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on turning a structure, order, or state upside down or in the opposite direction, differing from generic alteration by reversing polarities or hierarchies.
groups.desc_zh: 指将事物彻底倒置、正反翻转或颠覆现有秩序，不同于普通的改变，强调方向或层级格局的彻底颠倒。
groups.nuance_en: reverse: drive backwards or switch to the opposite direction (trend / decision / polarity) · invert: turn upside down or inside out in structure (order / relationship / image) · overturn: physically tip over or legally invalidate (boat / ruling / verdict) · upend: abruptly disrupt and knock upside down (plans / assumptions / market) · transmute: alter into a higher or entirely different form (base metal / grief / energy)
groups.nuance_zh: reverse: 朝相反方向逆转或取消 (trend / decision / polarity) · invert: 上下或内外次序倒置 (order / relationship / image) · overturn: 翻覆或法律上推翻裁决 (boat / ruling / verdict) · upend: 掀翻并彻底打乱固有格局 (plans / assumptions / market) · transmute: 质变为全新或更高阶形态 (base metal / grief / energy)

groups.name: Invert & Reverse · 颠倒与反转 (Overturn, Upend, Flip)
groups.tip: 上下颠倒或次序彻底反转

items.def_en: To turn over quickly into an upside-down or opposite side position
items.ex_en: She decided to flip the thick mattress over to ensure more even wear throughout.
items.ex_zh: 她决定把厚床垫翻个面，以确保各处磨损更加均匀。
items.ex2_en: The lightweight plastic kayak flipped over instantly in the turbulent river rapids.
items.ex2_zh: 轻便的塑料皮划艇在汹涌的河流急流中瞬间翻了过去。

items.def_zh: 使内外彻底颠倒；搞得翻天覆地
items.def_en: To reverse an object so its interior surface faces outward, or disorganize utterly
items.ex_en: Careless burglars managed to turn the peaceful home inside out searching for hidden jewelry.
items.ex_zh: 粗暴的窃贼为了搜寻隐藏的珠宝，把这个平静的家翻了个底朝天。

items.def_en: To turn upside down or invalidate an established legal decision or balance of power
items.ex_en: The constitutional judges voted unanimously to overturn the unconstitutional surveillance statute this morning.
items.ex_zh: 宪法法院的法官们今晨一致投票推翻了那项违宪的监控法令。
items.ex2_en: The speeding sports car overturned three times before stopping in the roadside ditch.
items.ex2_zh: 那辆超速行驶的跑车翻滚了三次，最后停在路边的沟里。

items.def_en: To turn something upside down, inside out, or reverse its normal order, position, or condition.
items.ex_en: The special telescope mirrors invert the incoming image before focusing it into the eyepiece.
items.ex_zh: 特制的望远镜反射镜在将入射图像聚焦至目镜前，会使其上下倒置。

items.def_en: To switch two or more things into each other's respective position or order
items.ex_en: Drunk printers accidentally transpose adjacent characters, producing confusing typos across the published page.
items.ex_zh: 喝醉的印刷工人不小心调换了相邻字符的位置，导致印出的页面满是混乱的错字。

items.def_en: To set or turn something completely upside down, or thoroughly overturn established order
items.ex_en: The sudden military coup served to upend centuries of established aristocratic political tradition.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的军事政变彻底颠覆了数个世纪以来根深蒂固的贵族政治传统。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses spatial, structural, or logical transformations where items, positions, decisions, or sequences are flipped into an opposite or upside-down configuration.
groups.summary_zh: 指在空间位置、先后次序或既定方向上彻底翻转颠倒。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to spatial or structural flipping, inversion, or spatial repositioning, contrasting with abstract change by stressing geometric or top-to-bottom reversal.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重于空间几何或结构上的翻转、上下颠倒或位置对调，区别于抽象变动，强调物理或空间朝向的相反变换。
groups.nuance_en: flip: briskly toss or rotate 180 degrees (coin / switch / pancake) · invert: reposition upside down or switch sequence (pyramid / order / values) · transpose: swap mutual positions or keys (letters / matrix / musical key) · upend: stand on end or upset top-to-bottom (table / canoe / lives) · turn inside out: reveal the interior by full inversion (pocket / umbrella)
groups.nuance_zh: flip: 轻捷翻转或快速拨动 (coin / switch / pancake) · invert: 颠倒上下或前后次序 (pyramid / order / values) · transpose: 两者对调位置或换调 (letters / matrix / musical key) · upend: 竖起翻倒或使之底朝天 (table / canoe / lives) · turn inside out: 翻转露出内部 (pocket / umbrella)

groups.name: Investigate & Probe · 深入探究与盘诘 (Probe, Delve, Pry, Sift)
groups.tip: 抽丝剥茧探寻隐秘深处

items.def_en: To question someone discreetly or indirectly to find out their views, intentions, or plans.
items.ex_en: The manager quietly sounded out a few team members before unveiling the restructuring plan.
items.ex_zh: 经理在公布重组方案之前，私下试探了几名团队成员的口风。

items.def_zh: 探究，调查；用探针探查，探寻
items.def_en: 1. (+ into) To examine or investigate a complex, hidden, or suspicious situation thoroughly. 2. To physically examine an area, wound, or object by poking with a tool or hand.
items.ex_en: Federal regulators began to probe deeply into the suspicious transactions of the regional bank.
items.ex_zh: 联邦监管机构开始深入探查该地区银行的一系列可疑交易。

items.def_en: (+ into) To search thoroughly and deeply for hidden information, reasons, or obscure details.
items.ex_en: Dedicated historians delve into fragile ancient manuscripts to uncover lost details about the war.
items.ex_zh: 敬业的历史学家们深入钻研脆弱的古老手稿，以挖掘关于战争的失传细节。

items.def_en: (+ into) To enquire too inquisitively or inappropriately into other people's private affairs.
items.ex_en: Nosy neighbors always pry into everyone else's private domestic matters without any shame whatsoever.
items.ex_zh: 那些爱管闲事的邻居总是毫无廉耻地到处打探别人的家庭隐私。

items.def_en: (+ through) To examine evidence or large amounts of material very carefully to separate what is useful from what is not.
items.ex_en: Forensic investigators must carefully sift through tons of debris to identify vital physical evidence.
items.ex_zh: 法医调查人员必须仔细筛查数吨残骸碎屑，以辨认出关键的物证。

items.def_en: To discover hidden information or track down elusive facts by persistent searching.
items.ex_en: Persistent investigative reporters managed to ferret out the hidden truth behind the contract scandal.
items.ex_zh: 锲而不舍的调查记者们终于搜寻出了合同丑闻背后隐藏的真相。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe penetrating beneath the surface to uncover concealed, sensitive, or intricate facts. They emphasize intrusive questioning, deep digging, or painstaking sorting through murky details.
groups.summary_zh: 强调破除掩盖、深入盘查或层层剖析以揭示隐藏实情。
groups.desc_en: Specifies active, incisive, and often intrusive digging for concealed facts, contrasting with casual inquiry through persistent penetration and extraction.
groups.desc_zh: 强调对隐藏信息的深入刺探、细致搜寻与刨根问底，区别于普通询问，带有穿透性、侵入性或细致甄别的色彩。
groups.nuance_en: probe: test or pierce into deep sensitive matters (motives / wound / defenses) · delve: dig deeply and systematically into research (archives / past / mysteries) · pry: offensively inquire into private affairs (personal life / secrets) · sift: painstakingly sort through bulk to find truth (evidence / data / sand) · ferret out: relentlessly hunt down hidden information (truth / runaway / fraud)
groups.nuance_zh: probe: 深入探寻敏感核心或试探 (motives / wound / defenses) · delve: 深入挖掘研究资料或过往 (archives / past / mysteries) · pry: 刺探或窥探他人隐私 (personal life / secrets) · sift: 细致筛查海量数据或线索 (evidence / data / sand) · ferret out: 像猎貂搜洞般搜寻揪出隐秘 (truth / runaway / fraud)

groups.name: Involve & Implicate · 牵连与卷入 (Entangle, Incriminate, Involve)
groups.tip: 卷入事件或暗示牵涉其中

items.def_en: (+ in) To draw someone into an affair, plot, or compromising situation
items.ex_en: She refused to involve her innocent family in the dangerous ongoing political conspiracy.
items.ex_zh: 她拒绝让自己无辜的家人卷入这场正在进行的危险政治阴谋。

items.def_en: 1. (+ in) To show, suggest, or prove that someone was involved in a crime, scandal, or wrong action. 2. To imply or convey indirectly.
items.ex_en: Newly discovered emails seem to implicate several senior cabinet ministers in the bribery scandal.
items.ex_zh: 最新发现的电子邮件似乎暗示数位资深内阁部长与这桩受贿丑闻有牵连。

items.def_en: (+ in/with) To ensnare or involve someone heavily in complex, compromising difficulties
items.ex_en: Greedy investors foolishly entangle themselves in complex, fraudulent offshore tax shelter schemes overseas.
items.ex_zh: 贪婪的投资者愚蠢地让自己深陷于海外复杂而具有欺诈性的避税骗局中。

items.def_en: To provide evidence indicating that someone is guilty of a crime or illicit act
items.ex_en: The incriminating fingerprints will incriminate the notorious gangster in the violent midnight armed robbery.
items.ex_zh: 现场留下的指纹证据将证明这名臭名昭著的黑帮分子参与了午夜持械抢劫。

items.def_en: (+ in) To involve someone in a messy, difficult, or compromising situation that is hard to escape
items.ex_en: Endless bureaucratic red tape threatens to mire the crucial relief project in disastrous delay.
items.ex_zh: 没完没了的官僚繁文缛节眼看要让这项关键的救援工程深陷延误的泥潭。

items.def_en: (+ in) To drag someone deeply into a bitter quarrel, conflict, or legal dispute
items.ex_en: The company was careful not to embroil itself in the bitter ongoing patent dispute.
items.ex_zh: 该公司小心谨慎，避免让自己卷入这场持续不断的激烈专利纠纷之中。

groups.summary_en: Covers showing, claiming, or drawing someone into complicity in wrongdoing, legal transgression, or an unwholesome affair.
groups.summary_zh: 指将人牵扯进犯罪、丑闻或不良事态中，证明其有牵连。
groups.desc_en: Denotes drawing an entity into a compromising, culpable, or complicated situation, differing from simple inclusion by the snare of blame or entanglement.
groups.desc_zh: 指将人或实体卷入复杂困境、罪行或纷争中，不同于普通包含，强调责任牵连、难以脱身或负罪污名。
groups.nuance_en: involve: engage or encompass as an active part (citizens / risk / project) · implicate: connect incriminatingly to a crime or scandal (suspect / official / scandal) · incriminate: directly provide proof of guilt (evidence / confession / accomplice) · embroil: drag into intense, chaotic conflict (country / ally / dispute) · mire: trap deeply in boggy difficulty or moral muck (economy / bureaucracy / controversy)
groups.nuance_zh: involve: 牵涉或使参与 (citizens / risk / project) · implicate: 牵连涉嫌某桩丑闻或罪行 (suspect / official / scandal) · incriminate: 坐实罪证或指证犯罪 (evidence / confession / accomplice) · embroil: 卷入混乱纷争中难以自拔 (country / ally / dispute) · mire: 深陷泥潭或陷入官僚困境 (economy / bureaucracy / controversy)

groups.name: Jam, Freeze & Block · 卡住与受阻 (Jam, Freeze, Wedge)
groups.tip: 受阻黏附无法动弹

items.def_en: To become tightly wedged or blocked so that motion or mechanical function is completely stopped
items.ex_en: Worn gear teeth caused the heavy factory machinery to jam abruptly during full operation.
items.ex_zh: 磨损的齿轮齿导致重型工厂机械在全负荷运转时突然死死卡住。
items.ex2_en: A thick sheet of folded paper jammed the office printer completely this morning.
items.ex2_zh: 今天早上，一张厚厚的折叠纸把办公室打印机完全卡住了。

items.def_zh: （使）卡住，（使）动弹不得；（stick的过去式及过去分词）
items.def_en: Past and past participle of stick; to become trapped, jammed, or unable to move or progress further.
items.ex_en: The delivery truck got completely stuck in the thick mud during the storm.
items.ex_zh: 送货卡车在暴风雨中完全陷在厚厚的泥潭里动弹不得。
items.ex2_en: The stubborn child stuck a piece of chewing gum under the wooden desk.
items.ex2_zh: 那个任性的孩子把一块口香糖粘在了木桌底下。

items.def_en: To stick or fail to slide smoothly due to friction, misalignment, or warping
items.ex_en: The wooden drawer began to bind whenever the weather became excessively humid.
items.ex_zh: 每当天气变得过于潮湿，那个木抽屉就会卡滞拉不动。

items.def_en: (+ into/between) To force something tightly into a narrow space so that it cannot easily move
items.ex_en: He wedged a folded cardboard piece tightly into the gap beneath the door.
items.ex_zh: 他把折叠好的厚纸板紧紧楔入门底的缝隙中。

items.def_en: (+ with) To obstruct a conduit or mechanism by filling it with thick, sticky, or compacted matter
items.ex_en: Decaying fallen leaves quickly clogged the drainage pipe with thick, slimy debris.
items.ex_zh: 腐烂的落叶迅速用黏稠的碎屑堵塞了排水管。
items.ex2_en: The kitchen sink drain clogs frequently whenever grease pours down the steel pipe.
items.ex2_zh: 每当油脂倒进钢管时，厨房水槽的下水道就会频繁堵塞。

items.def_zh: （机器、轴承）抱死；完全冻结卡死
items.def_en: To become totally immobile or unresponsive due to extreme cold, friction, or technical malfunction
items.ex_en: Whenever she stepped onto the stage, her mind completely froze up.
items.ex_zh: 每当她走上舞台，她的大脑就一片空白、彻底卡壳。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote mechanical parts, vehicles, or physical objects becoming firmly caught, wedged, or immobile due to obstruction or friction. Frequent collocates include gears, paper, drawer, traffic, and mud.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重因机械故障、挤压或外力阻碍而动弹不得、卡死。
groups.desc_en: Describes mechanical or fluid obstruction that halts motion, contrasting with deliberate stopping by indicating friction, congestion, or physical immobility.
groups.desc_zh: 描述机械部件、通道或流体因挤压、堵塞或粘附而丧失活动能力，不同于主动制动，强调受阻卡死与物理停滞。
groups.nuance_en: jam: wedge tightly to prevent working (mechanism / printer / gun) · clog: block a conduit with accumulated substance (drain / artery / filter) · wedge: pack tightly into a narrow space (door / crack / foot) · bind: adhere or seize up from friction (gears / brakes / steering) · freeze up: lock completely due to cold or panic (engine / computer / speaker)
groups.nuance_zh: jam: 机械卡死或异物卡阻 (mechanism / printer / gun) · clog: 杂物积聚堵塞通道 (drain / artery / filter) · wedge: 楔入塞紧导致无法动弹 (door / crack / foot) · bind: 因摩擦或形变卡滞受束 (gears / brakes / steering) · freeze up: 因受冻或惊慌彻底僵死死机 (engine / computer / speaker)

groups.name: Jeer & Heckle · 起哄与喝倒彩 (Heckle, Jeer, Boo)
groups.tip: 看台上起哄吵闹或喝倒彩干扰

items.def_en: To make a deep, mocking 'boo' sound to show strong disapproval of a speaker or performance
items.ex_en: Angry spectators began to boo when the referee made the controversial penalty call.
items.ex_zh: 当裁判做出争议性点球判罚时，愤怒的观众开始大发嘘声。

items.def_zh: 喝倒彩，起哄；大声喝彩，加油
items.def_en: 1. (British) To shout and jeer disapprovingly at a speaker or sports team. 2. (+ for) (Australian / New Zealand) To cheer and shout encouragement for a sports team.
items.ex_en: The partisan crowd continued to barrack the visiting team throughout the contentious match.
items.ex_zh: 在这场充满争议的比赛中，偏颇的主场观众不断向客队喝倒彩。

items.def_en: To interrupt a public speaker or performer with persistent, hostile, or derisive remarks
items.ex_en: Disorderly protestors continued to heckle the minister throughout his entire public address.
items.ex_zh: 骚乱的抗议者在部长的整场公开演讲中不断起哄捣乱。

items.def_en: (+ at) To laugh or shout rude, mocking, and insulting remarks at someone publicly
items.ex_en: The hostile crowd continued to jeer at the defeated candidate outside city hall.
items.ex_zh: 敌对的人群在市政厅外持续嘲笑起哄那位落选的候选人。

items.def_zh: 吹口哨起哄，发尖叫嘘声
items.def_en: To make whistle sounds, shrill shouts, or mocking cries to express disapproval or harass someone
items.ex_en: Several rowdy patrons began to catcall when the musician made a visible mistake.
items.ex_zh: 当乐手出现明显失误时，几名吵闹的顾客开始吹口哨起哄。

items.def_en: To prevent someone from being heard by shouting loudly and drowning out their voice
items.ex_en: The angry crowd shouted down the politician before he could finish his opening remarks.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的群众大声起哄，让那位政客开场白还没说完就无法继续了。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe shouting derisive, taunting, or hostile remarks to disrupt and discomfit a public speaker, performer, or sports rival.
groups.summary_zh: 在公众场合大声喧哗、起哄、喝倒彩以扰乱演讲者或比赛方。
groups.desc_en: Denotes vocal public derision directed at a speaker or performer to humiliate or disrupt them, contrasting with quiet disapproval through loud collective mockery.
groups.desc_zh: 指对演讲者、表演者发出喧闹的讥讽、叫倒好以干扰或羞辱对方，区别于私下非议，强调公开、声浪式的敌意打断。
groups.nuance_en: heckle: aggressively interrupt with questions or taunts (speaker / politician / comedian) · jeer: shout mocking, derisive insults (crowd / spectators / rival) · boo: emit a collective low vocal sound of rejection (performer / referee / villain) · catcall: whistle or shout sexually suggestive or mocking cries (actress / passerby) · shout down: silence a speaker by yelling louder (orator / protester / debate)
groups.nuance_zh: heckle: 故意插话质问起哄打乱发言 (speaker / politician / comedian) · jeer: 哄笑嘲弄并发出讥讽 (crowd / spectators / rival) · boo: 发出低沉嘘声以示反感喝倒彩 (performer / referee / villain) · catcall: 发出尖叫声、口哨以调戏或嘲笑 (actress / passerby) · shout down: 用更大的叫喊声压制使之噤声 (orator / protester / debate)

groups.name: Join & Bind · 结合与连接 (Conjoin, Unite, Link)
groups.tip: 将独立部分拼合接合为一体

items.def_en: To join together with others to achieve something, or to bring different parts together into a whole
items.ex_en: The allied nations resolved to unite against common economic and geopolitical challenges.
items.ex_zh: 同盟国决定联合起来应对共同的经济与地缘政治挑战。
items.ex2_en: The visionary president sought to unite the divided country through shared economic prosperity.
items.ex2_zh: 这位有远见的总统试图通过共同的经济繁荣来团结这个分裂的国家。

items.def_en: To make or form a connection between two or more people, things, or places
items.ex_en: A newly constructed bridge will link the isolated rural communities to the capital.
items.ex_zh: 一座新建的大桥将把那些偏远的乡村社区与首都连接起来。

items.def_en: To fasten, connect, or unite two or more things or groups into one
items.ex_en: The two independent labor unions agreed to join together into a single organization.
items.ex_zh: 两个独立的工会同意联合合并成一个统一的组织。
items.ex2_en: The carpenter used wooden pegs to join together the two thick oak beams.
items.ex2_zh: 木匠用木栓将两根厚实的橡木横梁连接在一起。

items.def_en: To join together physically by melting, or to combine distinct qualities or elements seamlessly
items.ex_en: Extreme heat will fuse the two distinct metal pieces into an unbreakable bond.
items.ex_zh: 极高的温度会将两块不同的金属熔合成牢不可破的整体。
items.ex2_en: The heated copper wires quickly fused together under the continuous electrical current.
items.ex2_zh: 在持续的电流作用下，受热的铜线迅速熔合在一起。

items.def_en: 1. (formal) To join, unite, or combine two things together.
items.ex_en: Circumstances worked to conjoin these disparate factors into one comprehensive diplomatic strategy.
items.ex_zh: 种种机缘将这些互不相干的因素结合成了一项综合外交策略。
items.ex2_en: Two distinct rivers conjoin naturally to form a powerful waterway toward the ocean.
items.ex2_zh: 两条不同的河流自然汇合，形成一条通往海洋的强大水道。

items.def_en: To connect or be connected with each other closely or in an intricate network
items.ex_en: Sophisticated optical fiber networks interlink the major trading hubs across the continent.
items.ex_zh: 先进的光纤网络将整个大陆上的主要贸易枢纽紧密相连。
items.ex2_en: Complex neural pathways interlink seamlessly to coordinate subtle sensory perceptions throughout the brain.
items.ex2_zh: 复杂的神经通路无缝互联，在大脑中协调微妙的感官知觉。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the physical or conceptual act of bringing two or more separate entities together to form a single combined whole. They range from physical assembly to abstract merging of ideas, forces, or entities.
groups.summary_zh: 表示将两个或多个独立实体在物理或概念上联结成一体的动作。
groups.desc_en: Involves connecting or consolidating separate parts into an integrated union or network, differing from simple touching by establishing enduring cohesion.
groups.desc_zh: 指将分离的元素结合、粘连或熔为一体，区别于简单的触碰接触，强调形成稳固的物理或系统性联结。
groups.nuance_en: unite: bring together politically or spiritually into one (factions / people / forces) · link: connect structurally or causally like chain links (islands / ideas / databases) · conjoin: grammatically or formally join together (sentences / limbs / twins) · fuse: melt or merge irrevocably into a single entity (metals / cultures / genes) · interlink: connect reciprocally into an interlocking network (systems / components / roads)
groups.nuance_zh: unite: 政治、精神或力量上的联合为一 (factions / people / forces) · link: 结构或逻辑链条上的相连 (islands / ideas / databases) · conjoin: 语法或形式上的结合并接 (sentences / limbs / twins) · fuse: 熔合或彻底交融为一体 (metals / cultures / genes) · interlink: 相互交错串联成网络 (systems / components / roads)

groups.name: Join & Rejoin · 汇合与加入 (Join, Rejoin, Re-enter)
groups.tip: 脱离组织后重新加入归队

items.def_en: To become a member of an organization, group, or activity, or to accompany others
items.ex_en: She decided to join the environmental advocacy group after graduating from college.
items.ex_zh: 大学毕业后，她决定加入那个环保倡导组织。
items.ex2_en: The two mountain trails join smoothly near the scenic summit overlooking the lake.
items.ex2_zh: 两条山间小径在俯瞰湖泊的风景秀丽的山顶附近平缓地汇合。

items.def_en: To enter a group, workforce, political arena, or territory again after leaving it
items.ex_en: After five years abroad, she plans to re-enter the domestic political sphere.
items.ex_zh: 在海外旅居五年后，她打算重新进入国内政坛。

items.def_zh: 团结在……周围；向……汇聚支援
items.def_en: To come together in a group to support or defend a person, organization, or cause
items.ex_en: Loyal supporters rushed to rally around their beleaguered leader during the scandal.
items.ex_zh: 在丑闻期间，忠诚的支持者们迅速团结在他们陷入困境的领袖周围。

items.def_en: (+ with) To connect or associate closely with an organization or party again
items.ex_en: The dissident faction decided to reaffiliate with the national party after lengthy negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 经过漫长的谈判，持不同政见的派系决定重新隶属于国家政党。
items.ex2_en: Party leadership moved to reaffiliate the independent regional branches after the annual convention.
items.ex2_zh: 年会结束后，党派领导层着手重新吸纳各独立的地方分支。

items.def_en: (+ with) To bring or come together again after a period of separation
items.ex_en: The emotional refugee was finally able to reunite with her displaced family members.
items.ex_zh: 这位激动的难民终于得以与流离失所的家人重聚。
items.ex2_en: The successful peace treaty will reunite divided families across the heavily fortified border.
items.ex2_zh: 和平条约的成功签署将使重兵把守边界两端的分离家庭得以团聚。

items.def_zh: 重新加入，回到（某人处）；反驳，答辩
items.def_en: 1. To return to or become a member of a group, organization, or companion again after leaving. 2. (formal) To reply quickly and sharply to a remark.
items.ex_en: The seasoned diplomat chose to rejoin the foreign ministry after his brief retirement.
items.ex_zh: 这位经验丰富的外交官在短暂退休后选择重返外交部。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate entering, becoming a member of, or returning to a social, political, or military collective or ongoing company after a period of absence or separation.
groups.summary_zh: 指重新回到群体中，或再度加入组织、阵营及同伴行列。
groups.desc_en: Centers on restoring broken ties, returning to a group, or converging after separation, contrasting with initial joining by stressing restoration or reentry.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重于离开后的重新聚合、恢复归属或再次加入，区别于首次加入，强调关系重构或重返旧集体。
groups.nuance_en: rejoin: return to a group or answer back sharply (party / team / conversation) · reunite: bring together separated people after long estrangement (family / lovers / diaspora) · re-enter: formally go back into a space, market, or orbit (workforce / market / atmosphere) · rally around: assemble in support of a beleaguered cause or leader (leader / cause / flag) · reaffiliate: re-establish official institutional membership (union / party / federation)
groups.nuance_zh: rejoin: 重新回到集体或反唇相讥 (party / team / conversation) · reunite: 骨肉离散后的团圆重聚 (family / lovers / diaspora) · re-enter: 正式重新进入空间、市场或轨道 (workforce / market / atmosphere) · rally around: 聚拢支持处于困境的领袖或事业 (leader / cause / flag) · reaffiliate: 重新建立正式附属隶属关系 (union / party / federation)

groups.name: Keynote & Deliver · 宣讲与主旨发言 (Deliver, Unveil, Headcharge)
groups.tip: 面向公众发表演说或作报告

items.def_en: To present or communicate a speech or talk to an assembled group of listeners
items.ex_en: The distinguished scholar agreed to give an inspiring speech to the graduates.
items.ex_zh: 这位著名学者同意为毕业生们作一场鼓舞人心的演讲。

items.def_en: To present or pronounce a speech, lecture, or prepared statement formally in public
items.ex_en: The prime minister will deliver an important address to Parliament tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 首相将于明早向议会发表一份重要讲话。

items.def_en: To appear as the chief speaker, star presenter, or main attraction at an event
items.ex_en: A prominent tech executive was invited to headline the annual international developer conference.
items.ex_zh: 一位知名科技高管受邀担任年度国际开发者大会的主讲嘉宾。

items.def_zh: 正式公布；宣布推出（规划等）
items.def_en: To present a new plan, policy, or project officially to an audience for the first time
items.ex_en: The administration plans to roll out its revised healthcare policy next Monday.
items.ex_zh: 政府计划在下周一正式公布其修订后的医疗保障政策。

items.def_zh: 为……拉开序幕；作开幕致辞
items.def_en: To open or inaugurate a major meeting or conference with an introductory address
items.ex_en: The director will kick off the three-day industry summit with welcoming remarks.
items.ex_zh: 主管将发表欢迎致辞，为为期三天的行业峰会拉开序幕。
items.ex2_en: The annual technology conference kicks off tomorrow with an anticipated keynote address.
items.ex2_zh: 一年一度的科技大会将于明天以备受期待的主旨演讲拉开帷幕。

items.def_en: 1. (chiefly US) To deliver the main, theme-setting speech at a conference or convention.
items.ex_en: The celebrated economist was invited to keynote the global monetary policy convention.
items.ex_zh: 这位著名经济学家受邀在全球货币政策大会上作主旨发言。

groups.summary_en: This frame highlights presenting flagship talks, headline speeches, or formal addresses setting the principal theme for an assembly, summit, or high-level organizational conference.
groups.summary_zh: 指在峰会或大会上作主旨报告、正式发表定调演讲。
groups.desc_en: Governs formal, high-profile public delivery or product launches designed to set agendas, contrasting with everyday talk through performative gravity.
groups.desc_zh: 指在正式重要场合进行的主旨宣讲、新品发布或重大活动启动，区别于日常谈话，具有高调的定调性与仪式感。
groups.nuance_en: keynote: deliver the defining address setting the central theme (conference / summit / convention) · deliver: formally articulate and present a prepared speech (address / lecture / remarks) · headline: star as the main featured act or topic (festival / news / bill) · roll out: officially launch and distribute a new product or policy (vaccine / update / campaign) · kick off: formally commence an event or operation (season / campaign / proceedings)
groups.nuance_zh: keynote: 发表确立基调的主旨演讲 (conference / summit / convention) · deliver: 郑重发表或宣读预备好的讲辞 (address / lecture / remarks) · headline: 作为压轴或主打人物登台 (festival / news / bill) · roll out: 正式分步骤推向市场或全面铺开 (vaccine / update / campaign) · kick off: 鸣哨开场或正式启动 (season / campaign / proceedings)

groups.name: Land & Touch Down · 降落与着陆 (Alight, Touch Down, Perch)
groups.tip: 自空中接触地面

items.def_zh: 着陆，降落；（使）上岸；赢得，获得
items.def_en: 1. To bring an aircraft or ship down to earth or onto water, or to arrive on the ground after flying. 2. To come to shore or put passengers ashore from a boat. 3. (informal) To successfully get or achieve a prize, job, or deal.
items.ex_en: The skilled pilot managed to land the small aircraft safely on the highway.
items.ex_zh: 技术熟练的飞行员成功将小型飞机安全降落在公路上。
items.ex2_en: The international flight landed smoothly on the runway despite heavy crosswinds yesterday.
items.ex2_zh: 尽管昨天遭遇了强劲的侧风，这架国际航班还是平稳降落在跑道上。

items.def_en: To make contact with the ground at the end of a flight or descent
items.ex_en: Flight four hundred safely touched down on the icy runway amid heavy snowfall.
items.ex_zh: 四百号航班在鹅毛大雪中安全降落在结冰的跑道上。

items.def_zh: 操纵降落；使（飞机等）着陆
items.def_en: To pilot and safely bring an aircraft down onto the ground or water
items.ex_en: The captain deftly set down the disabled helicopter onto the open sports field.
items.ex_zh: 机长熟练地操纵发生故障的直升机降落在开阔的运动场上。

items.def_en: To land by parachuting into an ocean or body of water, said of spacecraft
items.ex_en: The crewed space capsule is expected to splash down safely in the Pacific.
items.ex_zh: 预计载人太空舱将在太平洋海面安全溅落。

items.def_zh: 栖息；停落在高处或狭窄边缘
items.def_en: (+ on) To alight and balance upon an elevated branch, bar, or narrow perch
items.ex_en: A graceful hawk quietly perched on the narrow branch overlooking the vast meadow.
items.ex_zh: 一只优雅的雄鹰静静栖息在俯瞰广袤草地的细枝上。
items.ex2_en: The falconer gently perched the rare golden eagle onto his heavy leather glove.
items.ex2_zh: 猎鹰人轻轻地把珍稀的金雕安置在他厚重的皮手套上。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To land softly and settle gently onto a surface after flying
items.ex_en: The delicate butterfly fluttered silently and alighted upon the fragrant rose petal.
items.ex_zh: 娇嫩的蝴蝶无声地翩跹，轻柔地飞落在芬芳的玫瑰花瓣上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the final stage of descent where an airborne vessel, bird, or person makes controlled contact with and settles onto a surface.
groups.summary_zh: 描述飞行器、鸟类或人自空中下降并平稳接触地面的过程。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on the final transition of an airborne object, craft, or creature making contact with a resting surface, contrasting with general descent by emphasizing terminal arrival.
groups.desc_zh: 描述飞行器、生物或下坠物体结束飞行状态触及地表，区别于普通下降，强调着地触碰的收尾瞬间与着陆方式。
groups.nuance_en: land: make final contact with solid ground (plane / bird / jumper) · touch down: momentarily or smoothly make contact with the runway (airliner / spacecraft / tornado) · alight: settle lightly and delicately from flight (butterfly / bird / passenger) · perch: balance precariously or neatly on an elevated spot (bird / spectator / cat) · splash down: land directly in water on return from space (capsule / spacecraft)
groups.nuance_zh: land: 降落着陆于地面 (plane / bird / jumper) · touch down: 航机平稳接地或着陆瞬间 (airliner / spacecraft / tornado) · alight: 轻盈飘落或从车船走下 (butterfly / bird / passenger) · perch: 栖息于高处或边缘歇脚 (bird / spectator / cat) · splash down: 太空舱完成轨道飞行溅落水面 (capsule / spacecraft)

groups.name: Lard & Pepper · 穿插点缀与夹杂 (Lard, Pepper, Interlard)
groups.tip: 添彩点缀充实美化

items.def_en: To give zest, piquancy, or variety to writing or discourse by interspersing sharp or witty points
items.ex_en: She salted her analytical lecture with humorous anecdotes to engage the students.
items.ex_zh: 她在剖析性讲座中夹杂着幽默轶事，以吸引学生们的兴趣。

items.def_en: To sprinkle or scatter abundantly through a speech, text, or surface
items.ex_en: The author peppers his intricate historical narrative with authentic period letters and diary entries.
items.ex_zh: 作者在错综复杂的一部历史叙事中大量穿插了真实的时期信件和日记条目。

items.def_en: To intersperse or embellish writing or speech copiously with foreign phrases or allusions
items.ex_en: The eccentric professor loved to interlard his everyday speech with obscure Latin phrases.
items.ex_zh: 这位古怪的教授喜欢在日常讲话中穿插晦涩的拉丁语短语。

items.def_en: To scatter or set thickly across a surface or work with notable features or examples
items.ex_en: Ancient ruins stud the rugged Mediterranean coastline, attracting millions of curious travelers.
items.ex_zh: 古老的遗迹星罗棋布地点缀在崎岖的地中海海岸线上，吸引了数百万游客。

items.def_en: To distribute light touches of specific words, humor, or ideas throughout a piece of work
items.ex_en: The director chose to sprinkle subtle ironic humor throughout the dark drama.
items.ex_zh: 导演选择在这部严肃的暗黑剧中少量穿插些许微妙的反讽幽默。

items.def_zh: 在（话语或文章中）大量穿插，缀满；在（瘦肉）中夹入肥肉膘
items.def_en: 1. To embellish or fill speech or writing abundantly with particular words, quotations, or references. 2. (cooking) To insert strips of fat into lean meat before cooking.
items.ex_en: The pedantic scholar loved to lard his philosophical treatises with obscure Latin quotes.
items.ex_zh: 那位迂腐的学者喜欢在他晦涩的哲学论著中大量堆砌拉丁语名言。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on interspersing speech, prose, or texts heavily with specific elements like jargon, quotations, anecdotes, or foreign phrases, often to an excessive or pretentious degree.
groups.summary_zh: 指在文本或谈话中大量穿插、夹杂引用语、术语或噱头。
groups.desc_en: Depicts enriching or marring a text, speech, or surface by scattering foreign or spicy elements throughout, contrasting with uniform mixing through discrete dispersion.
groups.desc_zh: 指在文章、言语或表面中点缀、夹杂异质元素以增色或使之累赘，区别于均匀融合，强调零散嵌插的分布感。
groups.nuance_en: pepper: hit or sprinkle abundantly with small frequent items (questions / shrapnel / slang) · lard: heavily garnish speech or text, often excessively (prose / speech / budget) · stud: dot thickly with prominent decorative objects (crown / sky / landscape) · interlard: alternate or intersperse speech with foreign tags (discourse / latin / jokes) · sprinkle: lightly scatter drops or small particles throughout (water / sugar / anecdotes)
groups.nuance_zh: pepper: 密集抛洒点缀或如连珠炮般发难 (questions / shrapnel / slang) · lard: 大量穿插华丽辞藻使之显得臃肿 (prose / speech / budget) · stud: 密集镶嵌或点缀醒目之物 (crown / sky / landscape) · interlard: 在话语中穿插外语短语或笑话 (discourse / latin / jokes) · sprinkle: 轻微零星点缀或稀疏抛洒 (water / sugar / anecdotes)

groups.name: Leach & Percolate · 浸出与渗滤 (Percolate, Filter, Bleed Out)
groups.tip: 液体缓缓透滤，析出溶解物质

items.def_en: To pass a liquid or light through a porous medium or screen to separate or diffuse it
items.ex_en: Morning sunlight began to filter gently through the thick fabric of the curtains.
items.ex_zh: 清晨的阳光开始缓缓透入厚厚的窗帘布料。
items.ex2_en: The fine mesh screen will filter coarse particles out of the contaminated water.
items.ex2_zh: 细密的水滤网将把受污染水中的粗颗粒过滤出来。

items.def_en: to wash chemicals or minerals out of soil, stone, or waste by water percolating through, or to be washed away in this way
items.ex_en: Persistent acid rain continues to leach essential minerals from the fragile forest soil.
items.ex_zh: 持续的酸雨不断将脆弱森林土壤中的必需矿物质冲刷滤出。
items.ex2_en: Harmful chemical toxins will leach gradually from the old landfill into groundwater supplies.
items.ex2_zh: 有害的化学毒素会逐渐从旧垃圾填埋场滤出到地下水源中。

items.def_en: To flow or pass slowly through small pores, cracks, or interstices
items.ex_en: Contaminated industrial runoff began to seep into the underground freshwater supply.
items.ex_zh: 受污染的工业径流开始慢慢渗入地下淡水水源中。

items.def_en: To slowly lose or allow chemical substances or dyes to seep out into surrounding material
items.ex_en: The cheap dark dye began to bleed out into the wash water immediately.
items.ex_zh: 那件衣服廉价的深色染料立刻开始渗出到洗涤用水中。

items.def_en: To filter or ooze gradually through a porous substance, or to pass liquid through grounds
items.ex_en: Cold rainwater will slowly percolate through dense layers of limestone over centuries.
items.ex_zh: 寒冷的雨水将在数百年间缓缓渗滤穿过致密的石灰岩层。
items.ex2_en: The barista percolated rich Colombian coffee beans to serve waiting morning customers.
items.ex2_zh: 咖啡师冲煮着浓郁的哥伦比亚咖啡豆，端给等待的早间顾客。

items.def_en: To separate a soluble substance from an insoluble solid by washing or percolation
items.ex_en: Chemists use distilled water to lixiviate the desired alkaline salts from mineral ash.
items.ex_zh: 化学家们使用蒸馏水从矿物灰烬中浸提所需的碱性盐。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here denote a fluid slowly moving through a porous medium, either washing soluble minerals and chemicals out or gradually dripping through a granular substrate.
groups.summary_zh: 指液体在多孔物质中缓慢渗透，溶解或带走化学成分及可溶物。
groups.desc_en: Relates to the chemical or physical extraction and downward seepage of soluble substances through a porous medium, contrasting with broad flow by porous passage.
groups.desc_zh: 指液体在多孔介质中向下渗流并溶出化学成分的过程，区别于普通流动，强调多孔穿透、溶质溶解或缓慢滤失。
groups.nuance_en: leach: wash out soluble nutrients or toxins by liquid (chemicals / soil / minerals) · percolate: trickle slowly through porous ground or spread socially (coffee / rainwater / ideas) · seep: ooze or leak slowly through small pores (blood / moisture / poison) · filter: pass through a medium to separate solids (water / light / impurities) · bleed out: slowly escape or drain away vital liquid (dye / profits / coolant)
groups.nuance_zh: leach: 液体溶解并带走土壤或矿物成分 (chemicals / soil / minerals) · percolate: 液体缓慢滤渗通过或思想慢扩散 (coffee / rainwater / ideas) · seep: 液体透过微孔缓慢渗漏 (blood / moisture / poison) · filter: 经介质滤除杂质或透出 (water / light / impurities) · bleed out: 缓慢流失颜色或关键资源 (dye / profits / coolant)

groups.name: Lecture & Harangue · 说教与高声长篇训话 (Harangue, Preach, Berate)
groups.tip: 滔滔不绝的说教与严肃训诫

items.def_en: (+ about/on) To criticize or admonish someone sternly, often in an annoying, condescending, or didactic way
items.ex_en: My father started to lecture me on personal responsibility and fiscal prudence again.
items.ex_zh: 我父亲又开始针对个人责任和财务谨慎对我进行说教。

items.def_en: (+ to/at) To give unwelcome moral advice in a tedious or self-righteous manner
items.ex_en: She disliked colleagues who constantly preached to others about healthy lifestyle choices.
items.ex_zh: 她讨厌那些整天就健康生活方式的选择向他人大道理说教的同事。

items.def_zh: 立规矩，发号施令，严厉训话
items.def_en: To tell people what to do or not to do in a forceful, authoritarian, and uncompromising manner
items.ex_en: The new headmistress quickly laid down the law regarding strict campus punctuality.
items.ex_zh: 新任女校长迅速对校园守时问题立下了雷厉风行的规矩。

items.def_en: (+ about/on) To express opinions in an authoritative, pompous, and dogmatic way
items.ex_en: He loved to pontificate about international macroeconomic trends at every dinner party.
items.ex_zh: 他喜欢在每次晚宴上就国际宏观经济走势自以为是地发表高论。

items.def_en: To scold or criticize someone angrily, vehemently, and at length
items.ex_en: The enraged manager began to berate the careless staff member in public.
items.ex_zh: 被惹怒的经理开始当众严厉痛斥那位粗心的员工。

items.def_zh: 向……滔滔不绝地演讲，大声训斥
items.def_en: To speak to someone or an audience loudly, forcefully, and at length, often in an aggressive or lecturing manner.
items.ex_en: The angry activist continued to harangue the crowd outside the corporate headquarters.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的活动家在企业总部外继续向人群滔滔不绝地大声训话。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses speaking to someone at great length in an aggressive, pompous, or moralizing manner. Verbs differ in whether the tone is self-righteously preachy, aggressively hostile, or scolding and patronizing.
groups.summary_zh: 指以居高临下、冗长或咄咄逼人的态度对他人进行说教、训诫或高声斥责。
groups.desc_en: Involves delivering prolonged, self-righteous, or aggressive verbal reprimands, differing from supportive instruction through an overbearing and punitive tone.
groups.desc_zh: 指发表冗长、自命不凡或盛气凌人的言辞训斥与道德说教，区别于建设性指导，带有强烈的居高临下和斥责意味。
groups.nuance_en: harangue: aggressively and loudly address a captive audience (crowd / troops / opponent) · berate: angrily and scathingly scold someone at length (employees / child / subordinate) · pontificate: express dogmatic opinions pompously as if infallible (pundits / politician / academic) · preach: deliver moralistic, sanctimonious advice unprompted (temperance / morality / virtues) · lay down the law: authoritarianly set strict rules with no argument (boss / parent / manager)
groups.nuance_zh: harangue: 情绪激昂、长篇大论地大声训话 (crowd / troops / opponent) · berate: 疾言厉色地严加斥责 (employees / child / subordinate) · pontificate: 自命权威地高谈阔论 (pundits / politician / academic) · preach: 居高临下地作道德说教 (temperance / morality / virtues) · lay down the law: 专横下达死规矩不容置辩 (boss / parent / manager)

groups.name: Lecture & Instruct · 授课与训诫 (Teach, Preach, Admonish)
groups.tip: 面向公众或学生正式陈述讲授

items.def_en: 1. To deliver an educational speech or talk to an audience or class. 2. To criticize or warn someone sternly about their behavior.
items.ex_en: The visiting professor will lecture on Renaissance art history in the auditorium.
items.ex_zh: 客座教授将在礼堂就文艺复兴时期的艺术史开办学术讲座。

items.def_en: To deliver a religious sermon, or to give unwanted moral advice in a patronizing way
items.ex_en: The bishop arrived early to preach an inspiring sermon on universal compassion.
items.ex_zh: 主教早早赶来，就博爱这一主题布道，发表了一场鼓舞人心的讲道。

items.def_en: To systematically teach a subject, skill, or principle to learners
items.ex_en: The senior engineer will instruct the new apprentices in safe operating procedures.
items.ex_zh: 资深工程师将向新学徒系统传授安全操作规程。

items.def_en: To criticize, scold, or lecture someone angrily and at length
items.ex_en: The commander chose to berate the derelict guards for jeopardizing base security.
items.ex_zh: 指挥官选择严厉痛斥那些玩忽职守、危及基地安全的警卫。

items.def_en: To speak to someone gently or mildly in disapproval of their behavior
items.ex_en: The mother gently chided her young son for not finishing his dinner.
items.ex_zh: 母亲因年幼的儿子没有吃完晚饭而轻声规劝了他几句。

items.def_zh: 妄加道德评价；作大道理说教
items.def_en: To lecture or pass moral judgment on others' behavior in an irritatingly righteous way
items.ex_en: Commentators ought not moralize about complex geopolitical tragedies from comfortable distances.
items.ex_zh: 评论员们不应该站在舒适的远处对复杂的地缘政治悲剧妄加道德评判。

groups.summary_en: This frame spans two related senses: delivering informative academic instruction to an audience, and reproving someone pedantically or moralistically like an instructor scolding a pupil.
groups.summary_zh: 兼指学术性的讲课授业与居高临下的说教训斥。
groups.desc_en: Covers pedagogical delivery and mild normative correction intended to impart knowledge or behavior, contrasting with aggressive haranguing by emphasizing educational guidance.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过课堂传授、规范劝诫以传道受业或纠正行为，区别于纯粹泄愤训斥，强调教育性、训诫性与导向性。
groups.nuance_en: instruct: authoritatively direct or systematically educate (students / jury / workers) · lecture: systematically present academic material or mildly scold (students / audience / teenager) · chide: gently rebuke or scold for a minor fault (child / colleague / friend) · moralize: comment on affairs with tedious ethical judgments (author / critic / elder) · preach: advocate a doctrine or ethical conduct earnestly (gospel / moderation / patience)
groups.nuance_zh: instruct: 权威性指导或系统化下达指令 (students / jury / workers) · lecture: 讲授专业知识或略带训诫地讲课 (students / audience / teenager) · chide: 善意责备或温和数落轻微过错 (child / colleague / friend) · moralize: 动辄发表枯燥道德感慨 (author / critic / elder) · preach: 宣扬教义或劝喻修德 (gospel / moderation / patience)

groups.name: Legal Liberation & Enfranchisement · 解除束缚与赋予民权 (Enfranchise, Manumit, Emancipate)
groups.tip: 打破枷锁赋予自由与公权

items.def_en: (+ sb) release someone from captivity, confinement, slavery, or legal subjugation
items.ex_en: The appellate court ruled that the wrongfully imprisoned suspect must be set free.
items.ex_zh: 上诉法院裁定必须释放那名被错误关押的嫌疑人。

items.def_en: (+ sb) release someone from prison or legal custody
items.ex_en: The authorities decided to let the reformed inmate out on early parole.
items.ex_zh: 当局决定批准这名表现良好的囚犯提前假释出狱。

items.def_zh: 解放，使重获自由（社会学或政治语境）
items.def_en: to set someone free from oppression, foreign control, or confinement
items.ex_en: Revolutionary forces fought bravely to liberate the oppressed population from imperial rule.
items.ex_zh: 革命力量英勇作战，旨在将受压迫的人民从帝国统治下解放出来。

items.def_zh: 解放（奴隶或受束缚群体），使其获得政治或法律自由
items.def_en: to set someone free from legal, social, or political restrictions and slavery
items.ex_en: The constitutional amendment was passed to emancipate millions from forced generational servitude.
items.ex_zh: 该宪法修正案获得通过，旨在将数百万人从世袭强迫奴役中解放出来。

items.def_zh: 给予选举权；解放，释放（奴隶等）
items.def_en: 1. To give someone the legal right to vote in elections. 2. (historical) To set a slave free from bondage.
items.ex_en: A milestone reform act sought to enfranchise working-class citizens in parliamentary elections.
items.ex_zh: 一项具有里程碑意义的改革法案致力于在议会选举中赋予工人阶级公民投票权。

items.def_en: (historical / law) To formally set a slave free from bondage.
items.ex_en: The wealthy landowner chose to formally manumit several loyal domestic slaves upon his death.
items.ex_zh: 那位富有的土地所有者选择在去世时正式释放身边的几名忠仆。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this legal and sociopolitical frame denote formally granting legal freedom, civil rights, or suffrage to subjugated persons or disenfranchised groups, transforming their constitutional and civic status.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过法律或制度赋予奴隶、受压迫者自由权或公民投票权。
groups.desc_en: Refers to formal, legally sanctioned release from bondage, tutelage, or disenfranchisement, differing from mere physical release by conveying civic status and rights.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过法律或体制手段解除人身奴役、监护或政治压迫，并赋予合法公民权利，区别于简单释放，强调法权与身份解放。
groups.nuance_en: emancipate: release from legal, social, or parental constraints (slaves / women / minor) · enfranchise: legally grant the right to vote or citizenship (citizens / women / residents) · manumit: formally release a slave from servitude by owner's act (slaves / bondsman) · liberate: free from enemy occupation, prison, or tyranny (hostages / city / captives) · set free: physically release from containment or chains (prisoner / bird / captive)
groups.nuance_zh: emancipate: 从社会束缚、奴役或监护中法律解放 (slaves / women / minor) · enfranchise: 赋予选举权或公权 (citizens / women / residents) · manumit: 奴隶主依法释放奴隶 (slaves / bondsman) · liberate: 从占领、暴政或囚禁中解救解放 (hostages / city / captives) · set free: 打开枷锁直接给予自由 (prisoner / bird / captive)

groups.name: Lend & Entrust Temporarily · 借出与出借 (Lend, Lease, Farm out)
groups.tip: 暂时提供财物与他人

items.def_en: To send work or responsibilities out to be done by external contractors or workers
items.ex_en: The startup decided to farm out its routine bookkeeping tasks to external specialists.
items.ex_zh: 该初创公司决定将其日常簿记工作外包给外部专业机构。

items.def_en: To make services, tools, or vehicles available to someone else for a fee
items.ex_en: The company hires out heavy machinery for construction projects.
items.ex_zh: 该公司为建筑工程提供重型机械租赁服务。

items.def_en: To permit another party to use one's property in return for periodic payment
items.ex_en: They decided to rent out their spare room on weekends for extra income.
items.ex_zh: 他们决定在周末把空置的房间租出去以赚取额外收入。

items.def_en: 1. To give something to someone for a short time, expecting it to be returned; to provide money that must be repaid. 2. To impart or contribute a particular quality to something.
items.ex_en: The local library agreed to lend several rare historic manuscripts for the exhibition.
items.ex_zh: 当地图书馆同意为本次展览出借几份珍贵的历史手稿。

items.def_en: To lease part or all of a rented property or asset to a third party
items.ex_en: The tenant may not sublet the premises without prior written consent from the landlord.
items.ex_zh: 未经房东事先书面许可，承租人不得转租该房屋。

items.def_en: To grant temporary possession and use of property or equipment in exchange for rent
items.ex_en: The municipality decided to lease the commercial harbor to a private maritime logistics firm.
items.ex_zh: 市政府决定将该商业港口出租给一家私营海运物流公司。

groups.summary_en: Interpersonal and institutional acts of parting with money, equipment, or belongings for a designated time with the clear understanding that the item itself or equivalent value will return.
groups.summary_zh: 人际借出物品或有期租让，预设物归原主或等价偿还。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to granting temporary use of assets, property, or labor to another party under contractual terms, contrasting with giving away by expecting eventual return or payment.
groups.desc_zh: 指按契约将财物、资产或业务临时借出、出租或外包予他人使用，区别于彻底转让，强调临时性及届期归还或收费。
groups.nuance_en: lend: temporarily give money or object expecting return (money / book / assistance) · lease: grant property or equipment use via formal long-term contract (car / land / office) · sublet: re-rent already leased property to a third party (apartment / office space) · rent out: allow use of personal property for regular fee (room / equipment / car) · farm out: subcontract tasks or work to outside parties (labor / work / services)
groups.nuance_zh: lend: 借出金钱或财物期其归还 (money / book / assistance) · lease: 长期签约出租固定资产 (car / land / office) · sublet: 将承租之物转租给第三方 (apartment / office space) · rent out: 收取常规租金出租房产或物品 (room / equipment / car) · farm out: 将工序或劳务转包给外部 (labor / work / services)

groups.name: Light & Daytime Rest · 小睡与打盹 (Nap, Doze, Snooze)
groups.tip: 生理性入睡与短暂小憩

items.def_en: To gradually and peacefully slip into sleep
items.ex_en: Listening to the gentle rain, he slowly began to drift off to sleep.
items.ex_zh: 听着轻柔的雨声，他渐渐迷迷糊糊地睡着了。

items.def_en: To fall into a light sleep unintentionally while sitting upright
items.ex_en: Grandpa began to nod off in his armchair right after the hearty dinner.
items.ex_zh: 吃完丰盛的晚餐后，爷爷立刻坐在扶手椅上打起了瞌睡。

items.def_en: to sleep lightly or for a short period of time, especially during the day
items.ex_en: She likes to nap on the living room sofa for twenty minutes every afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 她喜欢每天下午在客厅的沙发上小睡二十分钟。

items.def_en: To have a short, comfortable sleep, often voluntarily or by postponing waking up
items.ex_en: He decided to hit the alarm button and snooze for an extra ten minutes.
items.ex_zh: 他决定按下闹钟按钮，再舒舒服服地打个十分钟的盹。

items.def_en: To sleep lightly, intermittently, and fitfully, especially without intending to
items.ex_en: I watched the tired commuter doze fitfully against the train's vibrating glass window.
items.ex_zh: 我看着那个疲惫的通勤者倚着列车震颤的玻璃窗断断续续地打瞌睡。

items.def_en: To sleep peacefully or serenely, often used in literary contexts
items.ex_en: The ancient forest seemed to slumber peacefully under the cold, silent winter moonlight.
items.ex_zh: 古老的森林在清冷寂静的冬日月光下安然沉睡。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame represent brief, non-exhaustive periods of slumber, often taken during daylight hours or drifting in and out of consciousness.
groups.summary_zh: 特指白昼或片刻间的轻度小憩、浅睡或断断续续的入眠。
groups.desc_en: Covers brief, light, or unintended episodes of daytime resting, contrasting with sustained nocturnal slumber through shortness of duration and shallowness.
groups.desc_zh: 指白昼发生的短暂、浅层或不由自主的睡眠与打盹，区别于夜间深睡，强调短时间性与易惊醒性。
groups.nuance_en: nap: deliberately take a short daytime sleep (child / traveler / commuter) · doze: sleep lightly and intermittently, often involuntarily (passenger / elderly / patient) · snooze: snatch brief extra sleep or delay rising (morning / alarm / sofa) · nod off: unintentionally drop off to sleep while sitting upright (meeting / class / wheel) · slumber: rest in peaceful, deep sleep (baby / town / soul)
groups.nuance_zh: nap: 有意安排的白天小憩 (child / traveler / commuter) · doze: 浅度迷糊、断续打盹 (passenger / elderly / patient) · snooze: 赖床补觉或打几分钟盹 (morning / alarm / sofa) · nod off: 坐立听讲时不自主垂头睡着 (meeting / class / wheel) · slumber: 沉浸于安宁沉静的熟睡状态 (baby / town / soul)

groups.name: List & Itemize · 列举与逐项详述 (Catalog, Detail, Itemize)
groups.tip: 逐条列出清单进行详细说明

items.def_en: To explain something in detail, clearly and step by step
items.ex_en: You don't need to spell out every detail; we get the general idea.
items.ex_zh: 你不需要把每个细节都阐释得那么细，我们明白大意。

items.def_zh: 逐条列出，分项列举；详细罗列
items.def_en: 1. To list each individual item, detail, or expense separately and specifically.
items.ex_en: Please itemize all travel expenses on the reimbursement form before submitting it to finance.
items.ex_zh: 在提交给财务部门之前，请在报销单上逐项列出所有差旅费用。

items.def_zh: 一口气列出；滔滔不绝地说出
items.def_en: To say or recite a rapid, effortless list of items from memory
items.ex_en: The bright boy can reel off all fifty state capitals without a single pause.
items.ex_zh: 这个聪明的男孩能一口气念出所有五十个州的首府，中途不打一点磕绊。

items.def_en: To list or describe fully, thoroughly, and point by point
items.ex_en: The official report will detail every step taken during the comprehensive safety audit.
items.ex_zh: 该官方报告将逐一详述在全面安全审查期间所采取的每个步骤。

items.def_en: To make a systematic, comprehensive list of items or events
items.ex_en: Librarians spent months working to catalog the rare manuscripts recently donated to the university.
items.ex_zh: 图书馆管理员花了数月时间对最近捐赠给该大学的珍贵手稿进行编目。

items.def_en: To name things separately, one by one, especially in formal argument
items.ex_en: The attorney proceeded to enumerate the numerous procedural errors committed by the defense team.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师接着逐一列举了对方团队所犯下的诸多程序性错误。

groups.summary_en: Refers to communicating information by breaking it down into discrete components or reciting them one by one. Verbs vary from systematic accounting and official documentation to exhaustive verbal recounting.
groups.summary_zh: 指将信息拆解为独立条目、逐一列举或详述的言语行为。
groups.desc_en: Specifying information unit by unit in an organized or exhaustive sequence, contrasting with general summarizing or random mentioning.
groups.desc_zh: 以条理化或穷尽式的方式逐项列明信息，与概括总结或随意提及相对。
groups.nuance_en: itemize: list individually with formal or financial precision (deductions / expenses / inventory) · catalog: systematically record items or instances for an archive (errors / collection / abuses) · enumerate: formally count off points or examples one by one (reasons / grievances / flaws) · spell out: explain explicitly in exhaustive detail so nothing is misunderstood (terms / implications / requirements) · reel off: recite rapidly and effortlessly from memory (names / statistics / facts) · detail: describe fully point by point (plan / findings / history)
groups.nuance_zh: itemize: 逐条详细列明，强调财务或账单般的精确性 (deductions / expenses / inventory) · catalog: 编目式系统记录 (errors / collection / abuses) · enumerate: 郑重逐一列举点数 (reasons / grievances / flaws) · spell out: 详尽说明以防误解 (terms / implications / requirements) · reel off: 熟练地快速报出一串 (names / statistics / facts) · detail: 逐点细致描述展开 (plan / findings / history)

groups.name: Maneuver & Navigate · 操纵调动与精巧转运 (Maneuver, Steer, Pilot)
groups.tip: 巧妙把控方向与机动调度

items.def_zh: 引导，领航（使沿正确路径行进）
items.def_en: Direct the motion or position of an object or vehicle along a planned course
items.ex_en: The tugboat moved slowly to guide the massive container ship along the narrow canal.
items.ex_zh: 拖船缓慢行驶，引导巨大的集装箱船沿着狭窄的运河航行。

items.def_en: Move or guide something forward very slowly, carefully, and in tiny stages
items.ex_en: The nervous driver tried to inch the delivery van through the narrow alleyway.
items.ex_zh: 紧张的司机试图让送货车极其缓慢谨慎地挪过狭窄的胡同。
items.ex2_en: The sluggish traffic inched forward along the congested downtown highway during rush hour.
items.ex2_zh: 高峰时段，缓慢的车流在拥挤的市区公路上一点一点向前挪动。

items.def_zh: 驾驶，引航（飞机或船只穿越险境）
items.def_en: Carefully direct and steer an aircraft, ship, or vehicle through a difficult passage
items.ex_en: An experienced captain boarded to pilot the ferry safely across the treacherous rocky strait.
items.ex_zh: 一位经验丰富的船长登船引航，使渡轮安全穿过了险象环生的多礁海峡。

items.def_en: Control the direction in which a vehicle, vessel, or aircraft moves
items.ex_en: The helmsman fought high waves to steer the wooden boat safely toward the harbor.
items.ex_zh: 舵手顶着巨浪掌舵操纵，使木船安全驶向港口。
items.ex2_en: The sleek modern yacht steers effortlessly even through choppy open coastal waters.
items.ex2_zh: 这艘时尚的现代游艇即使在波涛汹涌的开阔沿海水域也操控自如。

items.def_en: Plan and direct the course of a vehicle or find one's way safely through a difficult area
items.ex_en: She used an ancient compass to navigate the dense forest during the midnight rescue.
items.ex_zh: 在午夜救援中，她使用古老的指南针引航穿行于茂密的森林中。

items.def_zh: 巧妙移动，操纵；调遣，调动；用计策划
items.def_en: 1. To move or turn skillfully or carefully, especially into or out of a tight space. 2. To guide, direct, or manipulate someone or something cleverly or deviously.
items.ex_en: He had to maneuver his loaded vehicle carefully into the tiny underground parking slot.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不小心翼翼地巧妙操纵满载的车辆，停进狭小的地下车位。
items.ex2_en: The clumsy cargo ship maneuvers poorly inside the tight and shallow inner harbor.
items.ex2_zh: 那艘笨重的货船在狭窄浅水且拥挤的内港里极难操纵。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the conscious, skillful physical or tactical guiding of a vehicle, person, or object through tight spaces, complex trajectories, or challenging conditions.
groups.summary_zh: 指在狭窄或复杂环境中娴熟细致地操控方向、避开障碍调遣移动。
groups.desc_en: Skillfully guiding a physical or metaphorical entity through tight spaces, obstacles, or complex systems, contrasting with passive drifting or straightforward moving.
groups.desc_zh: 巧妙地引导实体或事务穿过狭窄空间、障碍或复杂系统，与被动漂流或简单直行相对。
groups.nuance_en: maneuver: execute tactical, dexterous shifts to achieve a position (vehicle / troops / budget) · navigate: find and negotiate a path through a labyrinthine environment (waters / bureaucracy / terrain) · steer: control the heading or guide direction directly (car / conversation / policy) · pilot: guide as an expert through hazardous or exploratory passages (ship / legislation / test program) · inch: advance by tiny, painstakingly cautious increments (forward / traffic / way) · guide: assist along a path by leading or showing (tourists / decision / missile)
groups.nuance_zh: maneuver: 巧妙调动或施展策略换位 (vehicle / troops / budget) · navigate: 穿过迷宫般复杂的环境或水域 (waters / bureaucracy / terrain) · steer: 掌舵掌控方向 (car / conversation / policy) · pilot: 作为领航员/试验者引导穿过险关 (ship / legislation / test program) · inch: 极其谨慎艰难地挪动 (forward / traffic / way) · guide: 引领带路以助行进 (tourists / decision / missile)

groups.name: Map & Chart · 规划蓝图与绘制路径 (Map, Chart, Plot)
groups.tip: 图解推演未来路径

items.def_en: To arrange or sketch the main parts or overall timeline of a plan without full details
items.ex_en: Let's block out a rough production schedule before we finalize the budget.
items.ex_zh: 在敲定预算之前，我们先初步草拟一份大致的制作进度表吧。

items.def_zh: 规划，安排（常与out连用）；绘制……的地图；映射
items.def_en: (also 'map out') To plan or arrange something in detail.
items.ex_en: The planning committee will map out the urban renewal strategy over the coming decade.
items.ex_zh: 规划委员会将详细规划未来十年的城市更新策略。

items.def_en: To plan in careful detail how something will happen or be done over a period of time
items.ex_en: The committee met to map out a clear strategy for the next five years.
items.ex_zh: 委员会开会为接下来的五年详细制定了清晰的战略规划。

items.def_zh: 绘制；在坐标上标示；策划
items.def_en: To mark a path on a diagram or chart, or to calculate and devise a precise path forward
items.ex_en: The navigator used a brass divider to plot the ship's new course accurately.
items.ex_zh: 领航员用一把黄铜圆规在海图上精确标绘出轮船的新航线。

items.def_en: To plot a course on a map or to plan out a detailed future course of action
items.ex_en: The executive committee gathered to chart the long-term strategic direction of the multinational company.
items.ex_zh: 执行委员会齐聚一堂，为这家跨国公司的长期战略方向制定详细规划。

items.def_en: To describe, trace, or outline precisely the exact boundaries or steps of something
items.ex_en: The treaty must delineate the exact territorial boundaries between the two neighboring sovereign nations.
items.ex_zh: 该条约必须清晰界定这两个相邻主权国家之间的确切领土边界。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame entail charting, surveying, and graphically or conceptually laying out a sequence of future actions, spatial courses, or complex distributions in rigorous, systematic detail.
groups.summary_zh: 指绘制图表、测定路线或系统勾画出详尽行动计划。
groups.desc_en: Projecting spatial coordinates or temporal sequences to structure a future course of action, contrasting with spontaneous execution.
groups.desc_zh: 投射空间坐标或时间序列以规划未来行动路径，与即兴执行相对。
groups.nuance_en: chart: track or plot systematic trajectories and developmental trends (course / progress / future) · map out: organize a comprehensive step-by-step strategy (strategy / career / journey) · plot: calculate coordinates or secretly conspire steps (coordinates / graph / coup) · delineate: mark out clear boundaries or structural lines (boundaries / framework / roles) · block out: draft broad, preliminary shapes or schedules without fine detail (time / scene / shapes)
groups.nuance_zh: chart: 绘制系统航线或追踪发展趋势 (course / progress / future) · map out: 制定详尽的步骤规划 (strategy / career / journey) · plot: 标绘坐标或密谋步骤 (coordinates / graph / coup) · delineate: 勾勒分明轮廓或界限 (boundaries / framework / roles) · block out: 粗略划分大致模块或时间档 (time / scene / shapes)

groups.name: Marinate & Soak · 浸泡与腌制 (Macerate, Pickle, Cure)
groups.tip: 用调味汁浸泡入味

items.def_en: To preserve meat, fish, or other food by salting, smoking, or seasoning it
items.ex_en: Artisans in the coastal village still cure freshly caught salmon with sea salt.
items.ex_zh: 沿海村庄的手艺人仍用海盐腌制新鲜捕获的三文鱼。
items.ex2_en: The salted pork belly will cure slowly in the dry basement over winter.
items.ex2_zh: 腌好的猪五花肉将在干燥的地下室里慢慢风干腌制过冬。

items.def_en: To steep meat, fish, or vegetables in a seasoned, often acidic sauce before cooking
items.ex_en: You should marinade the chicken breast in garlic sauce for at least an hour.
items.ex_zh: 你应该将鸡胸肉在蒜香腌汁中腌泡至少一个小时。

items.def_en: To preserve and flavor food by immersing it in vinegar, brine, or a sour solution
items.ex_en: My grandmother taught me how to pickle crisp cucumbers using vinegar and aromatic spices.
items.ex_zh: 我祖母教我如何用醋和香料腌渍爽脆的黄瓜。

items.def_zh: （将肉、鱼等）腌泡，浸泡于腌汁中
items.def_en: to soak meat, fish, or other food in a seasoned liquid before cooking, or to be soaked in this way
items.ex_en: Chefs prefer to marinate the tough beef cuts overnight to ensure maximum tenderness.
items.ex_zh: 厨师们喜欢将较韧的牛肉块在腌汁中浸泡过夜，以确保口感最为嫩滑。
items.ex2_en: The sliced chicken breasts marinate peacefully in spicy garlic sauce inside the refrigerator.
items.ex2_zh: 切好的鸡胸肉在冰箱里的蒜辣酱汁中静静浸泡腌制。

items.def_en: To plunge or steep food in vinegar, brine, or pickling marinade
items.ex_en: The tavern keeper prepared to souse the fresh river trout in spiced vinegar.
items.ex_zh: 酒馆老板准备将新鲜的河鳟鱼浸渍在调味的香醋汁中。

items.def_zh: 浸软；（将水果用糖或酒）腌透
items.def_en: To soften fruit or food by steeping it in alcohol, sugar, or flavored liquid
items.ex_en: The pastry chef chose to macerate ripe summer strawberries in aged dark rum.
items.ex_zh: 西点师选用陈年黑朗姆酒来浸透软化成熟的夏日草莓。
items.ex2_en: The sweet summer cherries macerate gently in spiced brandy on the kitchen counter.
items.ex2_zh: 甜美的夏日樱桃在厨房台面上的香料白兰地中缓缓浸渍软化。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this culinary frame describe steeping food in a seasoned, acidic, or alcoholic liquid over an extended period to tenderize it, impart flavor, or preserve it.
groups.summary_zh: 指将食材长时间浸润在调味汁或酸性液体中以入味、软化或保鲜。
groups.desc_en: Treating food or organic matter in a liquid, chemical, or salt medium over time to alter flavor, texture, or preservation, contrasting with immediate thermal cooking.
groups.desc_zh: 将食材或有机物置于液体、调料或盐剂中浸泡以改变质地、风味或防腐，与即时热烹饪相对。
groups.nuance_en: marinate: steep food in an acid-and-oil mixture to tenderize and flavor (meat / chicken / tofu) · macerate: soften or break down fruit by soaking in liquid or sugar (berries / fruit / herbs) · pickle: preserve and sour in brine or vinegar (cucumbers / onions / vegetables) · cure: preserve protein via salting, smoking, or drying (meat / ham / fish) · souse: plunge into liquid or douse heavily in brine (fish / pork / vegetables)
groups.nuance_zh: marinate: 用腌汁浸泡使入味变嫩 (meat / chicken / tofu) · macerate: 浸液或糖渍以软化渗汁 (berries / fruit / herbs) · pickle: 醋腌或盐水泡渍以保鲜酸香 (cucumbers / onions / vegetables) · cure: 盐腌熏制以长期防腐 (meat / ham / fish) · souse: 浸没于醋卤或大汁中腌泡 (fish / pork / vegetables)

groups.name: Market & Promote · 营销与推销 (Promote, Tout, Hawk, Plug)
groups.tip: 推销商品促进买卖

items.def_en: to promote, advertise, and offer goods or services for sale to consumers
items.ex_en: The pharmaceutical company plans to market its newly approved diabetes treatment worldwide this spring.
items.ex_zh: 这家制药公司计划今年春季在全球范围内上市推销其新获批的糖尿病药物。

items.def_en: promote or sell goods aggressively through persistent persuasion
items.ex_en: The desperate merchant continued to push his cheap tapestries upon the unwilling crowd.
items.ex_zh: 走投无路的商人继续向不情愿的人群竭力兜售他那廉价的挂毯。

items.def_en: publicize a product, cause, or venture to increase sales or public awareness
items.ex_en: The agency launched a nationwide digital campaign to promote ethical renewable energy consumption.
items.ex_zh: 该机构发起了一项全国性的数字营销活动，以推广合乎道德的可再生能源消费。

items.def_en: mention or recommend a product, book, or show publicly, especially in media appearances
items.ex_en: The famous actor appeared on the talk show to plug his latest historical thriller.
items.ex_zh: 这位著名演员亮相脱口秀节目，顺带宣传他最新的历史惊悚片。

items.def_en: carry goods about for sale, offering them by shouting in streets or markets
items.ex_en: Noisy peddlers gathered at dawn to hawk fresh fish along the crowded harbor streets.
items.ex_zh: 喧闹的小贩黎明时分聚集在拥挤的海港街头，沿街叫卖新鲜的鱼获。

items.def_en: attempt to sell or praise something energetically, often making exaggerated claims
items.ex_en: The aggressive salesman continues to tout the controversial weight loss supplement as a miracle.
items.ex_zh: 这位激进的销售员继续极力吹捧该争议减肥补充剂为奇迹产品。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses commercial and promotional actions intended to bring goods, services, or public figures to market and persuade audiences to buy or support them. Verbs range from broad corporate positioning to aggressive, street-level hawking or casual celebrity plugging.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖将产品或服务推向市场、吸引买家并促成交易的商业宣传活动。
groups.desc_en: Actively publicizing, driving demand for, or pushing commercial goods or ideas into the public eye, contrasting with mere objective offering or neutral selling.
groups.desc_zh: 积极宣传、刺激需求或向公众大力推销商品或观点，与客观陈列或中立销售相对。
groups.nuance_en: promote: raise awareness and foster goodwill or adoption through official campaigns (album / health / brand) · market: position and distribute according to consumer demand (product / software / service) · tout: aggressively boast of merits or praise as exceptional (benefits / credentials / cure) · hawk: aggressively peddle goods in public, often noisily (wares / souvenirs / ideology) · plug: give an opportunistic, casual promotional mention (book / single / website) · push: forcefully urge adoption or sale (agenda / drugs / merchandise)
groups.nuance_zh: promote: 官方或系统化地提升认知度与曝光 (album / health / brand) · market: 按市场需求定位与营销铺设 (product / software / service) · tout: 吹嘘力捧其卓越价值 (benefits / credentials / cure) · hawk: 街头或高调叫卖兜售 (wares / souvenirs / ideology) · plug: 顺便插播提及以做宣传 (book / single / website) · push: 强行推销或硬推 (agenda / drugs / merchandise)

groups.name: Match & Accord · 吻合与一致 (Tally, Match, Correspond)
groups.tip: 数据或事实完全对应

items.def_en: (+ with) To agree or make something agree logically with an established fact or belief
items.ex_en: His recent lavish lifestyle does not square with his modest declared monthly income.
items.ex_zh: 他近来奢华的生活方式与他申报的微薄月收入完全不相符。
items.ex2_en: The careful accountant tried to square the company ledger with official bank records.
items.ex2_zh: 细心的会计试图使公司账本与官方银行记录保持一致。

items.def_en: (+ with/to) To match or be identical with something in detail, character, or quantity
items.ex_en: The serial numbers on the chassis correspond exactly with the official factory documentation.
items.ex_zh: 底盘上的序列号与官方出厂文件完全相符。

items.def_en: To be verified as true, accurate, or consistent upon investigation
items.ex_en: We need to check out of the hotel by noon, but let's check out the local market first.
items.ex_zh: 我们需要在中午前结账退房，不过先去看看当地的集市吧。

items.def_en: (+ with) To match up correctly or bring into exact agreement or compatibility
items.ex_en: Corporate practices must align with environmental regulations established by the federal regulatory agency.
items.ex_zh: 企业的经营实践必须与联邦监管机构制定的环境法规保持一致。
items.ex2_en: The mechanic had to align the car wheels to stop the vehicle shaking.
items.ex2_zh: 机械师必须校正汽车车轮以消除车辆的抖动。

items.def_en: (+ with) To happen at the same time, or to be in total agreement or accord in nature
items.ex_en: Her artistic perspective seemed to coincide completely with the director's unique cinematic vision.
items.ex_zh: 她的艺术视角似乎与导演独特的电影构想完全一致。

items.def_zh: 吻合，符合，相符；清点，计数，核算
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) If figures, accounts, or stories tally, they match or agree with each other. 2. (+ up) To count, calculate, or record a total score or quantity.
items.ex_en: The witness's contradictory story does not tally with the physical evidence gathered yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 证人自相矛盾的陈述与昨天收集到的物证并不吻合。
items.ex2_en: The dedicated auditor worked late to tally every receipt against monthly expense reports.
items.ex2_zh: 敬业的审计员工作到很晚，核对每张收据与月度开支报告。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on accounts, figures, or testimonies agreeing with or confirming one another without discrepancy. Verbs convey a harmonious parallel between independent pieces of evidence or statements.
groups.summary_zh: 指数据、陈述或事实在核对中完全一致、无出入。
