groups.desc_en: Guiding, managing, or manipulating machinery, organizations, or vehicles through ongoing skilled control, contrasting with passive observation.
groups.desc_zh: 通过持续娴熟的操纵使机器、组织或载具保持有效运转，区别于被动观望。
groups.nuance_en: operate: executing functional controls of complex machinery or business (machinery / business / system) · run: maintaining the daily administration or motion of an organization or motor (company / engine / program) · handle: manually manipulating or emotionally managing with dexterity (vehicle / crisis / weapons) · pilot: steering an aircraft, ship, or experimental project through a course (plane / project / ship) · navigate: charting and guiding a course through physical or metaphorical hazards (waters / bureaucracy / route) · work: actively exerting physical force to manipulate a tool or mechanism (controls / levers / soil)
groups.nuance_zh: operate: 操作掌控复杂机械或商业运营 (machinery / business / system) · run: 维持机构、引擎的持续运转管辖 (company / engine / program) · handle: 亲手操弄或灵巧驾驭应付 (vehicle / crisis / weapons) · pilot: 驾驶飞机船只或试行领航项目 (plane / project / ship) · navigate: 辨明方向穿行水域或复杂局面 (waters / bureaucracy / route) · work: 动手拨动扳动或耕作操控 (controls / levers / soil)

groups.name: Optical & Metaphorical Reflection · 映照与映射 (Reflect, Mirror)
groups.tip: 镜面水面反射光线影像

items.def_zh: 映照，照出；反射（光、热或声音）；反映，显示；深思，反省
items.def_en: 1. To show the image of someone or something on a shiny surface. 2. To throw back light, heat, or sound from a surface. 3. To show, express, or be a sign of something. 4. To think deeply about something.
items.ex_en: The polished granite facade reflects the midday sunlight onto the courtyard below.
items.ex_zh: 抛光花岗岩外墙将正午的阳光反射到下方的庭院中。

items.def_en: To show the reflection of someone or something; to reflect or resemble closely.
items.ex_en: The calm waters of the lake mirror the surrounding snow-capped mountain peaks.
items.ex_zh: 平静的湖面倒映着四周白雪皑皑的山峰。

items.def_en: to repeat or closely resemble something else in appearance, quality, or sentiment
items.ex_en: His recent policy proposals closely echo the core themes of the earlier manifesto.
items.ex_zh: 他最近的政策提案与早期宣言的核心主题高度呼应。
items.ex2_en: Loud thunderclaps echoed menacingly through the dark mountain valleys during the storm.
items.ex2_zh: 暴风雨中，巨大的雷鸣在黑暗的山谷间阴森地回荡着。

items.def_en: to reflect or throw back light, heat, or an image from a surface
items.ex_en: The polished silver shield cast back the harsh glare of the setting sun.
items.ex_zh: 抛光的银盾映回了落日刺眼的余晖。

items.def_en: (+ sth) reflect light, sound, or an image back from a surface
items.ex_en: Specially treated glass panels bounce back harmful ultraviolet rays from the interior gallery.
items.ex_zh: 经特殊处理的玻璃面板将有害紫外线从室内展厅反射回去。

items.def_en: (+ sth) reflect light, heat, or an image from an optical surface
items.ex_en: The expansive glass facade threw back the brilliant morning light across the harbor.
items.ex_zh: 宽阔的玻璃幕墙将明亮的晨光反射到整个海港上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs denoting an optical surface throwing back an image or light, or metaphorically matching, reproducing, or echoing characteristics and realities faithfully.
groups.summary_zh: 指光线或镜面映射出物象，或比喻性地忠实折射、映现真实面貌。
groups.desc_en: Sending back an image, wave, or structural attribute that corresponds to an original source, contrasting with absorbing or distorting it.
groups.desc_zh: 原样或对应性地反向投射影像、声波或深层特质，区别于直接吸收或变形。
groups.nuance_en: reflect: throwing back light, heat, or expressing an underlying quality (light / values / reality) · mirror: copying an exact image, state, or pattern faithfully (reality / trend / feelings) · echo: repeating auditory waves or closely reverberating opinions (words / sentiments / cries) · bounce back: elastically repelling an object or recovering from adversity (signal / ball / from injury) · cast back: projecting light, shadow, or memories backward in space or time (light / thoughts / mind) · throw back: forcefully redirecting an incoming wave, light, or gaze (reflection / light / head)
groups.nuance_zh: reflect: 投射光热或反映内涵本质 (light / values / reality) · mirror: 极其精确地仿效映照 (reality / trend / feelings) · echo: 物理回声或与言论遥相呼应 (words / sentiments / cries) · bounce back: 弹性弹回或迅速复原 (signal / ball / from injury) · cast back: 向后回投光影或追溯回忆 (light / thoughts / mind) · throw back: 强力反弹打回光波或仰首回掷 (reflection / light / head)

groups.name: Optimize & Maximize · 优化与效能最大化 (Maximize, Rationalize, Streamline)
groups.tip: 优化升级调整至最佳

items.def_en: To inspect, adjust, and optimize an engine, machine, or operational procedure
items.ex_en: The senior mechanic will tune up the aircraft engines before tomorrow's test flight.
items.ex_zh: 高级机修工将在明天的试飞前对飞机发动机进行检修调优。

items.def_en: To exploit an existing resource, asset, or advantage to maximum benefit
items.ex_en: The enterprise aims to leverage its international distribution network to maximize annual revenue.
items.ex_zh: 该企业旨在充分利用其国际分销网络以实现年收入最大化。

items.def_en: To increase something to the highest possible degree, value, or amount
items.ex_en: We must carefully allocate our limited marketing budget to maximize overall quarterly sales.
items.ex_zh: 我们必须谨慎分配有限的营销预算，以使季度总销售额最大化。

items.def_zh: 优化，使达到最佳状态；充分利用
items.def_en: 1. To make something as good, effective, or efficient as possible.
items.ex_en: Engineers continuously modify the algorithm to optimize data processing speeds across the network.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们不断修改该算法，以优化整个网络的数据处理速度。

items.def_en: To adapt a system to run with maximum efficiency and minimum waste
items.ex_en: The management implemented new software to streamline the entire supply chain workflow.
items.ex_zh: 管理层启用了新软件以简化整个供应链的工作流程。

items.def_en: To make an organization, system, or process more effective by reorganizing it logically
items.ex_en: The board plans to rationalize the manufacturing division by consolidating redundant overseas facilities.
items.ex_zh: 董事会计划通过整合多余的海外设施来精简重组制造部门。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe tuning processes, operations, or systems to achieve maximal operational efficiency, minimal waste, and optimal strategic outcome.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过系统化调整使效能、资源利用或产出达到最优或极致。
groups.desc_en: Revising, pruning, or driving systems to their absolute peak effectiveness and minimum waste, contrasting with clumsy expansion or stagnation.
groups.desc_zh: 通过精简、重构使系统达到最高效能和最低损耗，区别于粗放扩张或停滞不前。
groups.nuance_en: optimize: tuning all operating variables to achieve maximum systemic efficiency (performance / workflow / code) · maximize: pushing quantity, profits, or output to the absolute upper limit (profits / potential / utility) · streamline: removing redundant steps to make a process smoother and faster (operations / process / workforce) · rationalize: restructuring an organization to eliminate waste and make it economically logical (operations / production / structure) · leverage: utilizing an existing asset as strategic fulcrum for disproportionate gain (assets / connections / advantages) · tune up: performing minor precision calibrations to maintain peak operation (engine / system / performance)
groups.nuance_zh: optimize: 调优各变量实现综合最佳表现 (performance / workflow / code) · maximize: 将产量或收益推向绝对峰值 (profits / potential / utility) · streamline: 剔除冗余环节以实现流线型提效 (operations / process / workforce) · rationalize: 破除浪费、合理化重组业务 (operations / production / structure) · leverage: 撬动既有杠杆以博取放大效益 (assets / connections / advantages) · tune up: 细节微调校准保持极佳运转 (engine / system / performance)

groups.name: Oral & Forced Ejection · 吐出与喷射 (Spew, Eject, Spurt)
groups.tip: 由口中吐出或向外强力喷溅

items.def_en: Expel mucus, blood, or foreign matter from the respiratory tract by coughing
items.ex_en: The sick patient continued to cough up thick mucus throughout the cold night.
items.ex_zh: 那名患病的病人在寒冷的夜里一直咳出浓痰。

items.def_zh: 吐出（唾沫、食物等）；喷出，喷射；下毛毛雨
items.def_en: 1. To force saliva, food, or liquid out of your mouth; to eject liquid or sparks forcefully. 2. (impersonal) To rain very lightly.
items.ex_en: The bonfire began to crackle and spit bright sparks onto the dry grass.
items.ex_zh: 篝火开始噼啪作响，并将明亮的火星喷射到干草上。

items.def_en: Force or throw something out violently, suddenly, or automatically
items.ex_en: The automated safety mechanism will instantly eject any jammed components from the chamber.
items.ex_zh: 自动安全机构将立即把任何卡住的部件从舱室中弹射出来。

items.def_en: Eject the contents of the stomach involuntarily through the mouth
items.ex_en: The patient began to vomit involuntarily after ingesting the contaminated water sample.
items.ex_zh: 病人在摄入受污染的水样后开始不由自主地呕吐。

items.def_en: Expel large quantities of liquid, gas, or vomit rapidly and violently
items.ex_en: The broken pipe started to spew filthy brown sludge across the basement floor.
items.ex_zh: 破裂的水管开始向地下室地板上大批喷涌污浊的泥浆。
items.ex2_en: Thick sulfuric clouds spewed violently from the crater of the active volcano yesterday.
items.ex2_zh: 昨天，浓厚的硫磺云从活火山的火山口中剧烈喷发出来。

items.def_en: Gush out in a sudden, forceful stream or burst through a narrow opening
items.ex_en: A jet of hot oil suddenly spurted from the fractured metal valve.
items.ex_zh: 一股热油突然从破裂的金属阀门中喷涌而出。
items.ex2_en: The careless mechanic spurted dark motor oil onto the clean concrete garage floor.
items.ex2_zh: 粗心的机械工把黑色的机油喷溅到了干净的车库水泥地面上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the rapid, forceful discharge of liquids, substances, or particles from the mouth, orifice, or containment vessel under pressure.
groups.summary_zh: 指从口中或孔口强力排挤、吐出、喷射或喷溅液体与杂物。
groups.desc_en: Expelling substances or words from the mouth or an orifice with violent, involuntary, or explosive velocity, contrasting with gentle release or swallowing.
groups.desc_zh: 自口腔或孔道以猛烈、强迫或喷涌之势向外排斥，区别于徐缓吐气或吞咽。
groups.nuance_en: spew: pouring forth voluminous fluids, fumes, or venomous words uncontrollably (toxic waste / ash / insults) · spit: forcefully ejecting small amounts of saliva or contemptuous words from the mouth (blood / venom / curses) · vomit: ejecting stomach contents involuntarily through the mouth (food / blood / bile) · eject: mechanically or forcefully discharging contents outward (pilot / cartridge / disc) · spurt: gushing out suddenly in a high-pressure jet (blood / flames / water) · cough up: forcefully expelling from the lungs, or slangily yielding up money (phlegm / blood / cash)
groups.nuance_zh: spew: 大量、失控地喷涌污物或恶语 (toxic waste / ash / insults) · spit: 吐出唾液或啐出轻蔑言词 (blood / venom / curses) · vomit: 胃内容物不由自主剧烈呕吐 (food / blood / bile) · eject: 机械或外力强行弹射排出 (pilot / cartridge / disc) · spurt: 呈间歇性高压射流喷出 (blood / flames / water) · cough up: 咳出痰血，或俚语勉强掏出钱财 (phlegm / blood / cash)

groups.name: Orate & Declaim · 演说与激昂高论 (Declaim, Pontificate, Harangue)
groups.tip: 正式登台发表演说或阐述

items.def_en: (+ on/about) To talk lengthily and opinionatedly about a topic to listeners
items.ex_en: He was holding forth on politics to anyone who would listen.
items.ex_zh: 他逢人便大发议论，大谈特谈政治。

items.def_zh: 滔滔不绝地说；喷出空话
items.def_en: To speak a lot in an unthinking, tedious, or pretentious manner
items.ex_en: He continued to spout meaningless corporate buzzwords throughout the entire team meeting.
items.ex_zh: 他在整个团队会议期间不停地滔滔不绝讲着毫无意义的企业套话。
items.ex2_en: Cool mountain water spouted continuously from the bronze fountain in the plaza.
items.ex2_zh: 清凉的山泉水从广场上的青铜喷泉中源源不断地喷涌出来。

items.def_zh: 发表演说，致辞；高谈阔论
items.def_en: 1. (formal or humorous) To make a formal, often pompous or lengthy public speech.
items.ex_en: The visiting scholar began to orate pompously before the small student gathering yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 那位访问学者昨天在小规模的学生集会上开始高谈阔论。

items.def_en: To speak rhetorically, eloquently, or pompously with dramatic passion
items.ex_en: The veteran actor stepped forward to declaim the dramatic monologue with theatrical passion.
items.ex_zh: 这位资深演员走上前去，满怀戏剧激情地慷慨陈词朗诵独白。

items.def_zh: 武断地说；自以为是地发表高见
items.def_en: To express opinions or deliver speeches in a pompous, dogmatic, or condescending way
items.ex_en: The retired politician loved to pontificate about economic reform on various news programs.
items.ex_zh: 这位退休政客喜欢在各个新闻节目中就经济改革自以为是地发表高见。

items.def_zh: 滔滔不绝地训话；大声质问
items.def_en: To speak to someone loudly, aggressively, and at great length, often criticizing them
items.ex_en: The supervisor began to loudly harangue the assembly workers over minor production delays.
items.ex_zh: 主管因轻微的生产延误开始大声训斥装配线工人。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here portray rhetorical delivery characterized by elevated tone, bombastic theatricality, high formality, or self-important pontification before an audience.
groups.summary_zh: 指带有夸张、激昂、做作或自以为是腔调的高谈阔论。
groups.desc_en: Delivering public speech with theatrical rhetorical flair, dogmatic pretension, or aggressive verbosity, contrasting with collaborative conversational dialogue.
groups.desc_zh: 以戏剧化辞令、自以为是的说教或咄咄逼人的态势发表演说，区别于平和交流。
groups.nuance_en: orate: speaking grandiloquently and pompously as if before an assembly (on podium / to the crowd) · declaim: reciting aloud with impassioned, dramatic, stage-like gestures (poetry / against injustice / speech) · pontificate: expressing dogmatic opinions with smug, self-important authority (on morals / from armchair / about politics) · harangue: aggressively and loudly lecturing to criticize or browbeat an audience (crowd / troops / workers) · hold forth: talking endlessly and self-indulgently to a captive listener group (on philosophy / at dinner / at the bar) · spout: expelling rehearsed, superficial dogmas glibly (theories / slogans / platitudes)
groups.nuance_zh: orate: 煞有介事地发表高调演说 (on podium / to the crowd) · declaim: 慷慨激昂、富有戏剧腔调地朗诵痛陈 (poetry / against injustice / speech) · pontificate: 居高临下武断说教 (on morals / from armchair / about politics) · harangue: 咄咄逼人长篇训斥轰炸 (crowd / troops / workers) · hold forth: 滔滔不绝大发议论霸占话语场 (on philosophy / at dinner / at the bar) · spout: 夸夸其谈背诵口号空话 (theories / slogans / platitudes)

groups.name: Order & Mandate · 命令与指示 (Require, Direct, Instruct)
groups.tip: 上级发布具有约束力的指令

items.def_en: To make something necessary according to an official rule, regulation, or law
items.ex_en: Federal regulations strictly require all commercial vessels to carry sufficient emergency lifeboats.
items.ex_zh: 联邦法规严格要求所有商船必须配备足够的应急救生艇。

items.def_en: To give an official order or instruction to a person or organization to take a specific action
items.ex_en: The commanding officer will direct the engineering unit to construct the perimeter barrier.
items.ex_zh: 指挥官将指示工程部队建造周边隔离防线。

items.def_zh: 强制命令，规定；授权，委托统治
items.def_en: 1. To officially order, demand, or require something by law or policy. 2. To give official authority or a legal mandate to someone to act.
items.ex_en: New legislation will mandate annual carbon emission audits for all industrial manufacturing plants.
items.ex_zh: 新立法将强制规定所有工业制造厂每年必须进行碳排放审计。

items.def_en: To state officially that a particular rule, procedure, or action must be followed
items.ex_en: The statutory building codes prescribe rigorous fire safety standards for high-rise commercial structures.
items.ex_zh: 法定建筑规范对高层商业建筑规定了严格的消防安全标准。

items.def_en: To formally tell someone what they must do, often in an administrative or operational context
items.ex_en: The regional administrator will instruct the local branches to implement the updated protocols.
items.ex_zh: 区域主管将指示地方分支机构执行更新后的操作规程。

items.def_en: To officially instruct or urge someone with authority to perform a duty or refrain from an action
items.ex_en: The judicial tribunal will formally enjoin the corporation from divesting its core assets.
items.ex_zh: 司法审判庭将正式责令该企业不得剥离其核心资产。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the exercise of institutional authority to dictate actions, set policies, or compel compliance. While 'mandate' emphasizes binding official requirements, related verbs range from direct supervisory instruction to legal compulsion.
groups.summary_zh: 通过制度或行政权力下达指令、规定行为或强制执行要求。
groups.desc_en: Imposing an authoritative obligation or procedural specification on an agent, contrasting with mere 'requesting' or 'advising' through coercive institutional backing.
groups.desc_zh: 凭借制度或层级权威施加具有约束力的义务或流程指令，区别于毫无强制力的普通“请求”或“建议”。
groups.nuance_en: require: fundamental necessity or compulsory condition (evidence / compliance / license) · direct: authoritative administrative guidance (staff / operations / inquiry) · mandate: legal or democratic compulsion (vaccination / reporting / reforms) · prescribe: authoritative rule-setting or medical specification (treatment / rules / procedure) · instruct: procedural or operational ordering (lawyers / jury / team) · enjoin: solemn legal prohibition or judicial command (conduct / parties / strikes)
groups.nuance_zh: require: 制度或法定之硬性必需 (evidence / compliance / license) · direct: 组织行政层面的权威指引与部署 (staff / operations / inquiry) · mandate: 法律、民意或制度强制赋予并要求执行 (vaccination / reporting / reforms) · prescribe: 规范性、明文或处方性规约 (treatment / rules / procedure) · instruct: 具体步骤性、业务性的正式指示 (lawyers / jury / team) · enjoin: 庄严司法禁令或具有法纪效力的勒令 (conduct / parties / strikes)

groups.name: Originate & Stem · 源自与发端 (Originate, Arise, Spring)
groups.tip: 溯源事物的根基发端

items.def_en: (+ from) To originate, grow, or burst forth rapidly from a root or cause
items.ex_en: Her deep commitment to environmental advocacy sprang from childhood experiences in pristine forests.
items.ex_zh: 她对环保倡导的深厚投入源自童年在原始森林中的经历。

items.def_en: 1. (+ from) To originate, develop, or have root in something. 2. To stop or restrict the flow, spread, or increase of something.
items.ex_en: Many ongoing diplomatic disputes stem from unresolved historical conflicts between both nations.
items.ex_zh: 许多持续的外交争端皆源于两国之间悬而未决的历史冲突。

items.def_en: (+ from) To trace one's root, origin, or lineage back to a foundational source
items.ex_en: Several modern legal principles directly derive from foundational doctrines of Roman jurisprudence.
items.ex_zh: 数条现代法律原则直接衍生自罗马法学的基本学说。

items.def_en: (+ from/out of) To come into existence or develop as a result of something
items.ex_en: Complicated logistical challenges invariably arise from sudden alterations in trade policy guidelines.
items.ex_zh: 繁杂的后勤挑战总是由贸易政策方针的突然变动而引发。

items.def_en: (+ in/from) To have a specified beginning, creator, or geographical origin
items.ex_en: The ancient culinary tradition originated in the mountainous regions of northern Italy.
items.ex_zh: 这一古老的烹饪传统起源于意大利北部的山区。

items.def_en: (+ from) To issue, spread out, or originate from a central source or authority
items.ex_en: Authoritative regulatory decisions emanate directly from the central executive committee of the council.
items.ex_zh: 权威性的监管决定直接出自委员会的中央执行机构。

groups.summary_en: Covers having an ultimate point of beginning, cause, or derivation from a particular condition, root, or source.
groups.summary_zh: 强调事物以某一事件、原因或环境为发端、根源或衍生源头。
groups.desc_en: Tracing a phenomenon back to its source, root, or generative cause, contrasting with instantaneous 'creation' or external 'introduction'.
groups.desc_zh: 将事物的发展演化溯源至其根本起因或物理发源地，强调内生性溯源而非外力凭空“创造”或“引入”。
groups.nuance_en: originate: definitive initial beginning point (tradition / idea / flight) · stem: rooted emergence from an underlying cause (problems / crisis / conflict) · derive: semantic, historical, or chemical deduction/extraction (word / pleasure / compound) · arise: situational surfacing out of conditions (questions / disputes / needs) · spring: spontaneous sudden emergence from a hidden reservoir (leaks / hope / doubts) · emanate: pervasive outward radiation from an intangible source (light / warmth / authority)
groups.nuance_zh: originate: 确凿的源起时空或发端始点 (tradition / idea / flight) · stem: 因果深层根植或由…滋生而来 (problems / crisis / conflict) · derive: 历史、词源或化学上的派生、抽取 (word / pleasure / compound) · arise: 顺应局势客观浮现或冒出 (questions / disputes / needs) · spring: 泉涌般突然或自发冒现 (leaks / hope / doubts) · emanate: 无形气场、光芒或威信由内向外散发 (light / warmth / authority)

groups.name: Outlive & Survive · 比…长寿与存活 (Outlive, Survive, Outlast)
groups.tip: 度过劫难且寿命超过他人

items.def_en: To continue to live despite extreme hardship, aging, or after the loss of loved ones
items.ex_en: Despite the severe winter famine, the resilient community managed to live on.
items.ex_zh: 尽管遭遇了严酷的冬季饥荒，这个坚韧的社区依然设法活了下去。

items.def_en: To live, endure, or remain functional longer than someone or something else
items.ex_en: This durable solid oak table will certainly outlast cheaper modern particleboard furniture.
items.ex_zh: 这张耐用的实木橡木桌肯定比便宜的现代刨花板家具更经久耐用。

items.def_en: To last longer than another entity or to endure beyond a designated lifetime
items.ex_en: Her timeless literary creations will easily outwear the ephemeral fashions of this century.
items.ex_zh: 她永恒的文学创作将轻易超越本世纪短暂的流行风尚而长久流传。

items.def_zh: 渡过难关；（大病或重伤后）活过来
items.def_en: To survive a severe, life-threatening illness, injury, or critical ordeal
items.ex_en: The doctors were amazed that the patient pulled through after such severe injuries.
items.ex_zh: 医生们对患者受了如此重伤后仍能挺过来感到惊奇。

items.def_en: To continue to live or exist, especially after a dangerous event or after someone else has died
items.ex_en: Only two passengers managed to survive the catastrophic plane crash last night.
items.ex_zh: 昨晚灾难性的空难中仅有两名乘客得以幸存。

items.def_zh: 比…长寿；比…活得长，比…延续得久；度过（难关）而健在
items.def_en: 1. To live longer than another person; to remain alive or in existence after something has ceased.
items.ex_en: The elderly patriarch managed to outlive his younger siblings by over two decades.
items.ex_zh: 这位年迈的家族长辈比他的弟弟妹妹们多活了二十多年。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe living longer than another individual or continuing to endure and persist beyond a critical disaster, traumatic event, or historical era.
groups.summary_zh: 指在寿命上长于他人，或在危险、创伤及灾难中存活幸免。
groups.desc_en: Continuing to exist beyond a critical temporal threshold, disaster, or comparison partner, contrasting with simple continuous 'living' or 'remaining'.
groups.desc_zh: 跨越致命危机、损耗极度考验或在存续时间上超过参照对象，区别于平淡无奇的单纯“活着”或“停留”。
groups.nuance_en: survive: enduring mortal peril or extreme shock (crash / winter / cancer) · outlive: exceeding another entity in biological lifespan or utility (spouse / peers / usefulness) · outlast: surpassing another in endurance or structural durability (competitors / rivals / battery) · live on: lasting continuation in memory or legacy (memory / legacy / name) · pull through: recovering successfully from critical danger or illness (surgery / illness / crisis) · outwear: remaining functional longer than something else, often through wear resistance (welcome / fabric / rivals)
groups.nuance_zh: survive: 挺过致命危险、浩劫或极端逆境 (crash / winter / cancer) · outlive: 在生理寿命或效用上比…活得长 (spouse / peers / usefulness) · outlast: 耐受性、竞争周期或续航上战胜并长于对方 (competitors / rivals / battery) · live on: 精神、声名或遗产长存不朽 (memory / legacy / name) · pull through: 绝境逢生、从危重伤病中脱险挺过来 (surgery / illness / crisis) · outwear: 比…更耐磨损，或因过度耗磨而逐渐被消耗 (welcome / fabric / rivals)

groups.name: Overcharge & Fleece · 多收与敲诈 (Rip off, Fleece, Gouge)
groups.tip: 提供服务后索要相应费用

items.def_en: To cheat someone by charging them far too much money for something
items.ex_en: Unsuspecting tourists are often ripped off by unlicensed taxi operators.
items.ex_zh: 毫无防备的游客经常被无照出租车司机敲竹杠。

items.def_en: To give someone back less money than they are owed as change, or to treat them unfairly
items.ex_en: The careless cashier managed to shortchange him by five dollars at the register.
items.ex_zh: 粗心的收银员在收银台前少找了他五美元零钱。

items.def_en: To charge someone an unexpectedly large or unfair amount of money
items.ex_en: The mechanic really stung us for simple brake repairs on the old sedan.
items.ex_zh: 修车工在修理这辆旧轿车的简单刹车问题上狠敲了我们一笔。

items.def_en: To take a lot of money from someone by charging them too much or cheating them
items.ex_en: Unscrupulous souvenir merchants routinely fleece gullible tourists near the crowded historic landmark.
items.ex_zh: 不道德的纪念品商贩经常在拥挤的历史地标附近敲诈轻信的游客。

items.def_en: To force someone to pay an unethically high or inflated price, especially in a crisis
items.ex_en: Greedy local retailers started to gouge panicked customers on bottled water during floods.
items.ex_zh: 贪婪的当地零售商在洪水期间开始对瓶装水哄抬价格、讹诈恐慌的顾客。

items.def_en: 1. To ask someone to pay too much money for goods or services.
items.ex_en: The downtown boutique tended to overcharge foreign travelers for conventional leather goods.
items.ex_zh: 市中心的那家精品店往往对普通皮具向外国游客索价过高。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe demanding an unfairly high price or swindling someone financially. They range from billing errors to predatory price gouging and outright extortion.
groups.summary_zh: 指漫天要价、索取过高费用或在交易中敲诈勒索顾客。
groups.desc_en: Exacting an unfair, extortionate, or fraudulent financial price from a vulnerable transaction partner, contrasting with fair 'selling' or legitimate 'taxing'.
groups.desc_zh: 利用信息差、垄断或交易弱势巧取豪夺、开出不公高价，区别于正当合法的“定价”或“征税”。
groups.nuance_en: overcharge: billing more than the rightful or standard amount (customer / account / fee) · rip off: blatant informal exploitation or extortion (tourists / buyers / public) · gouge: predatory emergency or monopoly price hikes (consumers / victims / prices) · fleece: systematic swindling or stripping of wealth (investors / marks / rubes) · sting: deceptive extraction via trickery or sharp dealing (victims / tourists / bettors) · shortchange: depriving someone of full due or proper change (shopper / customer / workers)
groups.nuance_zh: overcharge: 超过公允/标定价格索取账目 (customer / account / fee) · rip off: 赤裸露骨的宰客、宰人或敲竹杠 (tourists / buyers / public) · gouge: 灾难或垄断时期趁火打劫、漫天要价 (consumers / victims / prices) · fleece: 蓄谋将受骗者的财产像羊毛般剥光 (investors / marks / rubes) · sting: 设套诱骗或通过诡计讹取钱财 (victims / tourists / bettors) · shortchange: 找零缺斤短两，或在精神待遇上亏待薄待 (shopper / customer / workers)

groups.name: Overdraw & Overspend · 透支与超支 (Overspend, Run Up, Exceed)
groups.tip: 支出超出限额或账户余额

items.def_en: To spend part of a fund or savings reserve that was not initially meant to be used
items.ex_en: We reluctantly had to dip into our emergency reserves to repair the furnace.
items.ex_zh: 我们不得不勉强动用应急储备金来维修暖气炉。

items.def_en: To spend more money than an opponent, competitor, or prior allocation
items.ex_en: The wealthy candidate managed to comfortably outspend her primary opponent during television campaigns.
items.ex_zh: 富有的候选人在电视竞选期间的支出轻松超过了她的初选对手。

items.def_en: To spend more money than is budgeted, available, or prudent
items.ex_en: Families often overspend on expensive luxury gifts during the extended holiday shopping season.
items.ex_zh: 在漫长的假日购物季中，许多家庭往往会在昂贵的奢侈礼品上超支。

items.def_zh: 透支（银行账户）；夸大，夸张
items.def_en: 1. (banking) To take more money out of a bank account than it contains. 2. To exaggerate or overstate something.
items.ex_en: The client inadvertently incurred heavy penalties when attempting to overdraw his commercial account.
items.ex_zh: 客户在试图透支其商业账户时，不经意间招致了高额罚款。

items.def_zh: 刷爆（信用卡）；达到信用上限
items.def_en: To reach the utmost spending limit on a credit card or line of credit
items.ex_en: He managed to completely max out two credit cards during the lavish vacation.
items.ex_zh: 他在那次奢华的度假期间彻底刷爆了两张信用卡。

items.def_en: To allow debts, bills, or deficits to accumulate quickly to a high total
items.ex_en: The reckless young entrepreneur quickly ran up massive debts across several corporate accounts.
items.ex_zh: 鲁莽的年轻创业者很快在多个公司账户上积欠了巨额债务。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate exhausting monetary reserves, spending beyond allocated budgets, or drawing more funds or resources than one actually possesses.
groups.summary_zh: 花费超过预算额度，或向账户和资源进行透支借贷。
groups.desc_en: Exceeding available financial balances, credit ceilings, or budgeted allocations, contrasting with measured 'spending' or 'disbursing'.
groups.desc_zh: 越过账户余额、信用额度或既定预算上限进行无节制消耗，区别于正常的“支出”或“拨付”。
groups.nuance_en: overspend: exceeding a targeted budget limit (budget / funds / earnings) · overdraw: pushing a bank balance into negative territory (account / balance / credit) · max out: reaching the absolute ceiling of a resource or line of credit (card / limit / 401k) · run up: accumulating large liabilities through repeated indulgence (debts / bill / tab) · dip into: tapping into reserve savings prematurely (savings / capital / reserves) · outspend: spending more than a rival party in competition (rivals / opponents / campaign)
groups.nuance_zh: overspend: 账面超支、超出既定财务预算 (budget / funds / earnings) · overdraw: 银行账户透支至负数 (account / balance / credit) · max out: 刷爆信用卡或用尽可用额度天花板 (card / limit / 401k) · run up: 累积欠下一大笔债务或账单 (debts / bill / tab) · dip into: 动用原本预备不动用的储蓄老本 (savings / capital / reserves) · outspend: 在竞选或商业比拼中比对手花更多的钱 (rivals / opponents / campaign)

groups.name: Overhang & Loom · 突出与悬压 (Protrude, Project, Impend)
groups.tip: 自高处悬空挂着或覆于上方

items.def_en: To extend outward or upward beyond an edge or line
items.ex_en: The upper balcony of the modernist building projects over the crowded pedestrian walkway.
items.ex_zh: 这座现代主义建筑的上层阳台突出伸展在拥挤的人行道上方。

items.def_zh: 悬垂于…之上，突出在…上方；逼近，笼罩
items.def_en: To stick out or hang over something below; (figurative) to loom or threaten ominously.
items.ex_en: Thick branches of the ancient willow overhang the narrow stone pathway beside the pond.
items.ex_zh: 古柳的茂密枝条悬垂在池塘旁狭窄的石阶小路之上。

items.def_en: To be suspended above something; (figurative) to threaten or cause anxiety continually
items.ex_en: A persistent cloud of uncertainty continues to hang over the entire merger negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 持续的疑云始终笼罩在整个合并谈判之上。

items.def_en: To stick out or extend outward beyond the main surface or edge
items.ex_en: Several jagged limestone cliffs jut out dramatically into the rough coastal waters.
items.ex_zh: 几座参差不齐的石灰岩悬崖赫然突出，伸向汹涌的近海。

items.def_en: To thrust or bulge forward and stick out from the surrounding surface
items.ex_en: Heavy metal support bolts visibly protrude from the crumbling exterior concrete foundation.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的金属支撑螺栓明显地从开裂的外层混凝土基座中隆起突出。

items.def_en: To appear as a large, shadowy, often menacing shape hanging or rising above
items.ex_en: Dark thunderous clouds began to loom threateningly over the isolated mountain village.
items.ex_zh: 乌黑的雷云开始以隐约威胁之势笼罩在孤立的山村上空。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict structures or geological features jutting forward or hanging out above an area below. Figuratively, they describe threats or solemn fates hovering menacingly overhead.
groups.summary_zh: 物体向外突出悬于上方，或危险与阴影沉重笼罩。
groups.desc_en: Physically projecting outwards over an edge or hanging menaces in spatial/psychological proximity, contrasting with passive 'standing' or 'hanging'.
groups.desc_zh: 在物理空间突出悬立于上方，或在心理上投下压迫性的隐忧阴影，区别于平静的单纯“悬挂”或“立着”。
groups.nuance_en: protrude: jutting noticeably out from a flat surface (jaw / nails / rocks) · project: extending outward in architecture or three dimensions (balcony / ledge / beams) · jut out: sharp, angular spatial protrusion (cliff / rock / chin) · overhang: suspending physically over the ground below (balcony / cliff / branch) · hang over: hovering overhead physically or casting a psychological cloud (cloud / shadow / threat) · loom: appearing impendingly large or threatening in the near future (crisis / storm / deadline)
groups.nuance_zh: protrude: 显著从基底表面外突或隆起 (jaw / nails / rocks) · project: 建筑结构或实体几何性向外挑出伸展 (balcony / ledge / beams) · jut out: 尖锐、突兀地探出边缘 (cliff / rock / chin) · overhang: 悬空遮蔽在下方地面或空间上方 (balcony / cliff / branch) · hang over: 物理上悬于头顶，或心理阴影挥之不去 (cloud / shadow / threat) · loom: 庞然迫近、隐约浮现且带来危机压迫感 (crisis / storm / deadline)

groups.name: Overreact & Lose Composure · 反应失度与过激 (Freak Out, Overblow, Go Ballistic)
groups.tip: 对外界刺激做出应答

items.headword: make a mountain out of a molehill
items.lemma: make a mountain out of a molehill
items.def_en: To treat a slight difficulty or minor incident as a serious disaster.
items.ex_en: You should not make a mountain out of a molehill over minor scheduling conflicts.
items.ex_zh: 你不应该为了微不足道的日程冲突而大惊小怪、小题大做。

items.def_zh: 灾难化想象，往最坏处惊慌反应
items.def_en: To present or view an unfavorable event as being completely disastrous.
items.ex_en: Anxious managers tend to catastrophize whenever preliminary sales figures dip slightly below projections.
items.ex_zh: 每年初步销售额略低于预期时，焦虑的经理们往往会陷入灾难化的极度恐慌中。

items.def_en: To suddenly lose one's temper and shout angrily at someone.
items.ex_en: The tired manager suddenly blew up when the assistant misplaced the confidential dossier.
items.ex_zh: 当助理把机密卷宗放错地方时，疲惫的经理突然大发雷霆。
items.ex2_en: Demolition experts blew up the condemned concrete bridge early this morning.
items.ex2_zh: 爆破专家今天清晨炸毁了那座已被宣布报废的混凝土桥梁。

items.def_en: To become crazily excited, furious, or shocked beyond self-control.
items.ex_en: My dad will flip out if he finds out I dented his new car.
items.ex_zh: 要是我爸发现我把他新车给撞凹了，他肯定会抓狂的。

items.def_zh: 吓坏，情绪失控大发雷霆
items.def_en: To become extremely agitated, frightened, or irrationally angry over a situation.
items.ex_en: Don't completely freak out just because your flight was delayed by twenty minutes.
items.ex_zh: 别仅仅因为航班延误了二十分钟就彻底失控抓狂。
items.ex2_en: The loud thunderstorm freaked out the trembling little puppy hiding under the sofa.
items.ex2_zh: 巨大的雷雨声把躲在沙发底下发抖的小狗吓坏了。

items.def_en: To react more strongly, angrily, or emotionally than a situation justifies.
items.ex_en: Financial investors should never overreact to temporary fluctuations within volatile stock markets.
items.ex_zh: 金融投资者绝不应对动荡股市中的暂时波动过度反应。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures responding to events or news with disproportionate emotion, panic, or anger far beyond what the circumstances warrant.
groups.summary_zh: 情绪或言行反应过激，表现出远超实际事态的慌乱、愤怒或夸张态度。
groups.desc_en: Responding to a stimulus with emotional disproportion or catastrophic agitation, contrasting with objective 'reacting' or proportional 'countering'.
groups.desc_zh: 对轻微刺激报以失控、剧烈且极不对称的情绪反应，区别于沉着客观的“响应”或合理“对抗”。
groups.nuance_en: overreact: general disproportionate emotional/behavioral response (critics / market / parents) · catastrophize: cognitively assuming worst-case disastrous outcomes (patient / mind / thoughts) · freak out: sudden colloquial panic, shock, or loss of composure (crowd / parents / kids) · blow up: sudden eruptive burst of fury (boss / temperament / dad) · flip out: wildly irrational, manic, or violent emotional outbreak (fans / driver / public) · make a mountain out of a molehill: colloquial exaggeration of petty grievances into major crises (issues / complaints / problems)
groups.nuance_zh: overreact: 整体表现出反应过激、小题大做 (critics / market / parents) · catastrophize: 灾难化思维、主观将微小事件预想为末日 (patient / mind / thoughts) · freak out: 突然吓破胆、慌神或心态大崩 (crowd / parents / kids) · blow up: 情绪瞬间如炸弹般雷霆爆发 (boss / temperament / dad) · flip out: 极度愤怒、发狂或举止乖戾失控 (fans / driver / public) · make a mountain out of a molehill: 小题大做、将鸡毛蒜皮夸大为滔天大浪 (issues / complaints / problems)

groups.name: Overspread & Blanket · 蔓延覆盖与笼罩 (Blanket, Overspread, Suffuse)
groups.tip: 物质在表面大面积铺开与遮盖

items.def_en: To spread slowly, quietly, and imperceptibly across a landscape or person's face
items.ex_en: A subtle look of realization slowly crept over her previously troubled face.
items.ex_zh: 一丝恍然大悟的隐约神情慢慢浮现在她先前忧虑的脸上。

items.def_zh: 厚厚铺满；像地毯般覆盖
items.def_en: To cover a ground or floor densely with an even layer of vegetation, snow, or petals
items.ex_en: Drifting cherry blossoms gently carpet the wide garden pathway after the morning breeze.
items.ex_zh: 晨风拂过后，飘落的樱花厚厚铺满了宽敞的花园小径。

items.def_zh: 布满；充盈（指光线、色彩或液体）
items.def_en: To spread gradually through or over a surface, especially with light, color, or fluid
items.ex_en: A radiant golden glow slowly began to suffuse the eastern horizon at dawn.
items.ex_zh: 破晓时分，一抹灿烂的金光缓缓充盈了东方的天际。

items.def_en: (literary) To spread over and cover a surface or area completely.
items.ex_en: A delicate twilight gloom began to overspread the silent valley as night descended.
items.ex_zh: 随着夜幕降临，一抹微弱的暮色开始笼罩静谧的山谷。

items.def_zh: 厚厚覆盖；如毯子般铺满
items.def_en: To cover completely with a thick, uniform layer of snow, fog, leaves, or silence
items.ex_en: A fresh layer of heavy snow blanketed the quiet town overnight.
items.ex_zh: 一夜之间，一层厚厚的新雪覆满了这座宁静的小镇。

items.def_en: To sweep over and swallow up completely, as by water, flames, or catastrophe
items.ex_en: Raging floodwaters threatened to engulf the historic villages along the riverbank.
items.ex_zh: 汹涌的洪水眼看就要吞没沿河的历史古村落。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the progressive, widespread extension of a layer (such as clouds, snow, color, or feelings) across a wide expanse, resulting in complete, even coverage.
groups.summary_zh: 指云彩、积雪或色彩在广阔表面上徐徐漫延并全面覆盖。
groups.desc_en: Gradually expanding across an entire expanse to form a dense enveloping mantle, contrasting with localized 'touching' or sparse 'scattering'.
groups.desc_zh: 以绵延、不可阻挡之势在二维或三维空间全面铺开笼罩，区别于点状零星的“散落”或局部“触及”。
groups.nuance_en: blanket: laying a thick, continuous concealing layer (snow / smog / smoke) · overspread: literary slow diffusion across a surface (blush / clouds / gloom) · suffuse: liquid or radiant permeation from within (light / glow / warmth) · carpet: forming a decorative, dense ground covering (leaves / flowers / moss) · engulf: swallowing whole within destructive surrounding mass (flames / darkness / waves) · creep over: insidious, gradual spreading across a boundary (vines / shadows / dread)
groups.nuance_zh: blanket: 像厚毛毯般严密遮盖压覆 (snow / smog / smoke) · overspread: 文学性描摹面容或天幕的缓慢弥漫 (blush / clouds / gloom) · suffuse: 光芒、色泽或情绪自内而外充盈渗透 (light / glow / warmth) · carpet: 像地毯般细密铺满地面 (leaves / flowers / moss) · engulf: 毁灭性力量四面包抄吞没 (flames / darkness / waves) · creep over: 阴影或藤蔓悄无声息地匍匐蔓延 (vines / shadows / dread)

groups.name: Overwork & Burn Out · 耗损与劳累过度 (Overwork, Overstrain, Burn out, Run down)
groups.tip: 用力过度导致筋疲力尽

items.def_en: to cause someone's health, vitality, or immune resistance to deteriorate from fatigue
items.ex_en: Working twelve hours every day will quickly run down your immune system.
items.ex_zh: 每天工作十二个小时很快就会拖垮你的免疫系统。

items.def_en: to exhaust someone thoroughly through sustained physical exertion
items.ex_en: Running after toddlers all afternoon completely wore me out.
items.ex_zh: 整个下午跟在幼儿屁股后面跑让我筋疲力尽。

items.def_en: to become completely exhausted and ineffective as a result of long-term work stress
items.ex_en: Many junior doctors burn out within their first year of hospital residency.
items.ex_zh: 许多初级医生在医院规培的第一年内就耗尽了精力。

items.def_en: to subject a muscle, body part, or mental faculty to more tension or effort than is safe
items.ex_en: Improper lifting techniques can seriously overstrain the muscles of the lower back.
items.ex_zh: 不恰当的提重物姿势会严重劳损下背部肌肉。

items.def_en: to make excessive demands on someone's physical strength, cognitive capacity, or endurance
items.ex_en: Managing two major departments simultaneously began to overtax his mental faculties.
items.ex_zh: 同时管理两个主要部门开始使他的心智不堪重负。

items.def_zh: 使用力过度，过度消耗（常用于反身代词）
items.def_en: (overexert oneself) To push oneself too hard physically or mentally, causing strain or exhaustion.
items.ex_en: The cardiologist warned the recovering patient not to overexert himself while exercising.
items.ex_zh: 心脏科医生警告正在康复的病人锻炼时切勿用力过度。

groups.summary_en: Centers on pushing the human body or nervous system past physiological boundaries, inducing acute physical injury, fatigue, or nervous breakdown through excess strain.
groups.summary_zh: 指过度透支身心机能以至引发疲竭、肌肉劳损或生理崩溃。
groups.desc_en: Subjecting an organism or mechanism to stress exceeding sustainable regenerative limits, contrasting with productive 'exercising' or routine 'working'.
groups.desc_zh: 使生物体或机械长期超负荷运转直至透支损耗，区别于良性的“锻炼”或规律的“劳作”。
groups.nuance_en: overwork: driving an individual beyond safe working limits (staff / body / soil) · burn out: complete psychological/physical exhaustion from prolonged stress (workers / doctors / career) · wear out: degrading functionality through repetitive friction or use (shoes / patience / body) · overtax: draining capacity, resources, or cognitive stamina beyond bearing (system / strength / patience) · overexert: sudden dangerous physical strain beyond personal limits (muscles / heart / yourself) · run down: gradual cumulative enervation resulting in systemic exhaustion (batteries / health / morale)
groups.nuance_zh: overwork: 强逼工作超时超量导致身心疲惫 (staff / body / soil) · burn out: 长期高压摧残导致心理能量耗竭罢工 (workers / doctors / career) · wear out: 摩擦损耗直至失去效用或筋疲力尽 (shoes / patience / body) · overtax: 超出耐受极限的重负压榨 (system / strength / patience) · overexert: 单次用力过猛伤及心肺筋肉 (muscles / heart / yourself) · run down: 长期亏空导致体质或运转状态江河日下 (batteries / health / morale)

groups.name: Pamper & Spoil · 娇惯与纵容 (Indulge, Mollycoddle, Cosset)
groups.tip: 悉心溺爱或过度纵容娇惯

items.def_en: To allow someone to have or do whatever they want, especially without restraint
items.ex_en: Grandparents often indulge young children with sweet treats after every family dinner.
items.ex_zh: 每顿家宴之后，祖父母常常纵容年幼的孩子吃甜食。

items.def_en: To harm someone's character, especially a child's, by excessive leniency or endless gifts
items.ex_en: Giving them expensive presents every weekend will inevitably spoil the young kids.
items.ex_zh: 每个周末都给孩子们昂贵的礼物，不可避免地会惯坏他们。
items.ex2_en: Fresh organic milk will spoil quickly if left out in warm summer weather.
items.ex2_zh: 新鲜的有机牛奶如果在炎热的夏天气候中放置，很快就会变质。

items.def_en: To care for and protect someone in an overindulgent and sheltering way
items.ex_en: Wealthy patrons tended to cosset the young prodigy within sheltered private salons.
items.ex_zh: 富有的资助人往往在避世的私人沙龙里娇惯这位年轻的神童。

items.def_en: To indulge with every attention, comfort, and kindness, often excessively
items.ex_en: Luxury resorts pamper their guests with complimentary massages and gourmet room service.
items.ex_zh: 奢华度假村用免费按摩和精美客房送餐悉心照料客人们。

items.def_zh: 娇惯，溺爱，过度呵护；用文火煮（蛋）
items.def_en: 1. To treat someone with excessive care and protect them too much. 2. (cooking) To cook eggs gently in water just below boiling.
items.ex_en: Protective parents often coddle their teenagers instead of teaching them independence.
items.ex_zh: 过度保护的父母常常溺爱十几岁的孩子，而不是教他们独立。

items.def_en: To treat someone with excessive indulgence and overprotectiveness, making them soft
items.ex_en: If you mollycoddle the boy constantly, he will never learn resilience.
items.ex_zh: 如果你一直过分呵护这个男孩，他将永远学不会坚强。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on treating someone with exaggerated attentiveness, gentle shielding, or excessive leniency. The actions often carry a negative connotation of weakening self-reliance or ruining character through overprotection.
groups.summary_zh: 强调过度呵护、溺爱或百依百顺，常隐含削弱独立性或惯坏脾气之意。
groups.desc_en: Gratifying desires with excessive comfort or leniency to the detriment of self-reliance, contrasting with wholesome 'nurturing' or essential 'caring'.
groups.desc_zh: 以无原则的溺爱、奢靡享受或过度保护消解其自立能力，区别于健康的“养育”或适度的“关怀”。
groups.nuance_en: pamper: treating with luxurious physical care and indulgent comfort (guests / pets / skin) · spoil: ruining character through unchecked material indulgence (children / grandkids / appetites) · indulge: gratifying impulsive whims or desires freely (fancies / cravings / passion) · coddle: sheltering with excessive, fragile, or protective care (athletes / eggs / students) · mollycoddle: effeminately overprotecting someone from everyday hardships (boys / patients / recruits) · cosset: enveloping in sheltered, suffocatingly affectionate seclusion (pets / favorites / calves)
groups.nuance_zh: pamper: 提供极致舒适、奢华享受与细致服侍 (guests / pets / skin) · spoil: 毫无节制的物质纵容并宠坏品格 (children / grandkids / appetites) · indulge: 迁就、纵容随性的念头或口腹之欲 (fancies / cravings / passion) · coddle: 视若易碎珍品般小心翼翼呵护 (athletes / eggs / students) · mollycoddle: 过分娇生惯养、护短免受现实风雨 (boys / patients / recruits) · cosset: 像待弱雏般置于温暖隔绝中千娇百宠 (pets / favorites / calves)

groups.name: Pander & Cater · 迎合与阿谀 (Pander, Cater, Truckle)
groups.tip: 无底线逢迎迁就低俗需求

items.def_en: to provide what someone wants or needs, often catering to lower or vulgar tastes
items.ex_en: Tabloid magazines deliberately cater to the public appetite for celebrity gossip.
items.ex_zh: 小报杂志刻意迎合公众对名人八卦的低俗趣味。

items.def_en: to direct one's efforts at pleasing a particular group or exploiting their biases
items.ex_en: The charismatic politician tried to play to the conservative voters' deepest fears.
items.ex_zh: 这位有魅力的政客试图迎合保守派选民内心最深层的恐惧。

items.def_zh: 迎合，曲从，讨好（低俗或不合理的要求）
items.def_en: (also 'pander to') (disapproving) To satisfy someone's unreasonable wishes, prejudices, or immoral desires in order to gain an advantage.
items.ex_en: Corrupt candidates routinely pander to populist sentiments just to secure crucial votes.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的候选人经常迎合民粹情绪，只为了争取关键选票。

items.def_en: (+ to) to flatter or defer to someone in authority for personal advantage
items.ex_en: Ambitious courtiers would shamelessly toady to the newly appointed prime minister.
items.ex_zh: 野心勃勃的侍臣们厚颜无耻地向新上任的首相谄媚讨好。

items.def_en: (+ to) to submit obsequiously or yield servilely to someone else's demands
items.ex_en: The proud diplomat refused to truckle to the foreign dictator's unjust demands.
items.ex_zh: 这位高傲的外交官拒绝向外国独裁者不公正的要求曲意逢迎。

items.def_en: (+ to) to show excessive deference or subservience in order to gain favor
items.ex_en: Principled scholars must never kowtow to corporate donors seeking editorial control.
items.ex_zh: 有原则的学者绝不能向谋求编辑控制权的企业赞助商低三下四。

items.def_zh: 迎合；纵容（不良嗜好或无理要求）
items.def_en: (+ sb/sth) indulge or gratify weak, unreasonable, or selfish desires and demands
items.ex_en: Sensational tabloid newspapers constantly pander to the public's thirst for cheap scandals.
items.ex_zh: 耸人听闻的小报不断迎合公众对低俗丑闻的猎奇嗜好。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe yielding to, gratifying, or exploiting the base desires, prejudices, or demands of others, often compromising personal integrity or higher standards in the process.
groups.summary_zh: 指为讨好他人或谋取利益而曲意迎合其低级趣味或无理要求。
groups.desc_en: Accommodating base tastes, prejudices, or superior powers through servile concession, contrasting with principled 'serving' or legitimate 'satisfying'.
groups.desc_zh: 违背原则屈从于受众的低级趣味、偏见或强权者的意志，区别于有底线的“服务”或合情“满足”。
groups.nuance_en: cater to: tailored adaptation to specific market needs or demographic preferences (tourists / tastes / niche) · pander: debasing standards to gratify vulgar instincts or biases (voters / prejudices / basest instincts) · play to: tailoring performance purposefully to elicit specific audience applause (gallery / base / crowds) · toady: fawning and obsequious flattery to curry personal favor (boss / superiors / royalty) · kowtow: servile deference and humiliating submission to authority (regime / masters / donors) · truckle: shameful ideological yielding to outside pressure or power (demands / tyranny / masters)
groups.nuance_zh: cater to: 针对特定受众偏好提供精准定制服务 (tourists / tastes / niche) · pander: 放弃底线迎合公众低级趣味或盲从偏见 (voters / prejudices / basest instincts) · play to: 投其所好做戏以博取特定群体欢呼 (gallery / base / crowds) · toady: 趋炎附势、低三下四拍马逢迎 (boss / superiors / royalty) · kowtow: 奴颜婢膝地向权贵磕头屈从 (regime / masters / donors) · truckle: 毫无骨气地屈从于强权施压 (demands / tyranny / masters)

groups.name: Parade & Strut · 游行与大摇大摆 (Strut, Swagger, Prance)
groups.tip: 高调走动引人注目

items.def_en: To walk with measured, rhythmic steps, often as part of an organized procession or protest
items.ex_en: Thousands of demonstrators prepared to march peacefully through the central business district.
items.ex_zh: 数以千计的示威者准备和平走过中央商务区进行游行。
items.ex2_en: The demanding drill sergeant marched the exhausted young recruits across the muddy field.
items.ex2_zh: 严厉的训练军士带着筋疲力尽的新兵们走过了泥泞的操场。

items.def_zh: 游行，招摇过市；炫耀，大肆展示
items.def_en: 1. To walk or march in a procession or stride around ostentatiously to be seen. 2. To display or flaunt something proudly in order to impress others.
items.ex_en: The proud collectors love to parade their rare vintage sports cars downtown.
items.ex_zh: 这些骄傲的收藏家喜欢在市中心大肆展示他们珍稀的古董跑车。

items.def_zh: 腾跃；大摇大摆欢快地走
items.def_en: To walk with exaggerated, bouncy, or flamboyant movements to show off
items.ex_en: Excited show dogs prance proudly around the judging arena during competitions.
items.ex_zh: 兴奋的纯种赛犬在比赛期间骄傲欢快地绕着评判台腾跃。

items.def_zh: 轻盈招摇地走；摆动身体走
items.def_en: To walk with exaggerated hip movements or flamboyant grace to attract notice
items.ex_en: Models sashay down the elevated runway wearing the designer's latest spring collection.
items.ex_zh: 模特们身着设计师最新的春季系列轻盈招摇地走过加高天桥。

items.def_zh: 大摇大摆走；高傲地踱步
items.def_en: To walk with a proud, stiff, and self-important gait intended to attract attention
items.ex_en: Confident peacocks strut around the palace gardens showing off their magnificent plumage.
items.ex_zh: 自信的孔雀在宫殿花园里高傲踱步，炫耀它们华丽的羽毛。

items.def_zh: 昂首阔步；神气活现地走
items.def_en: To walk in a confident, boastful, or arrogantly aggressive manner
items.ex_en: Triumphant athletes swagger through the crowded locker room after winning the championship.
items.ex_zh: 夺冠后，胜利的运动员们神气活现地穿过拥挤的更衣室。

groups.summary_en: Covers ostentatious, proud, or ritualized walking intended to impress, show off status, or display oneself to onlookers.
groups.summary_zh: 指为引人注目或展现傲慢、自信而大摇大摆、昂首阔步地走动。
groups.desc_en: Walking with ostentatious bodily swagger or public exhibition to project self-importance, contrasting with functional 'walking' or plain 'stepping'.
groups.desc_zh: 借助夸张仪态、浮夸步伐进行自我显摆或威权巡礼，区别于以位移为唯一目的的“行走”或“行进”。
groups.nuance_en: parade: purposeful public exhibition or collective formal procession (wealth / captives / streets) · strut: stiff-legged arrogant walking with head held high (rooster / stage / corridors) · swagger: insolent, swaying walk radiating overweening confidence (drifter / cowboy / bullies) · march: disciplined, rhythmic collective advance (troops / protesters / cadence) · prance: springy, high-stepping theatrical bouncing motion (horses / dancers / kids) · sashay: smooth, hip-swinging confident gliding movement (models / runway / room)
groups.nuance_zh: parade: 盛大游行或带有炫耀意味的公开招摇 (wealth / captives / streets) · strut: 昂首阔步、盛气凌人如公鸡般挺胸行走 (rooster / stage / corridors) · swagger: 狂妄自大、两膀摇晃的大摇大摆 (drifter / cowboy / bullies) · march: 纪律严明、步调一致的列队行进 (troops / protesters / cadence) · prance: 如骏马般轻快跃动、神气活现地欢蹦 (horses / dancers / kids) · sashay: 摆动腰肢、步态婀娜自信的滑步徐行 (models / runway / room)

groups.name: Paraphrase & Reword · 转述与重述 (Rephrase, Restate, Recast)
groups.tip: 换用不同词句重新阐述

items.def_en: To express what someone else has said or written using different words, especially to simplify it
items.ex_en: Students are instructed to paraphrase academic sources carefully to avoid unintentional plagiarism.
items.ex_zh: 学生们被指示要仔细转述学术文献，以避免无意中造成抄袭。

items.def_en: To say or write something again in different words to make it clearer
items.ex_en: Could you please rephrase that complicated explanation so everyone understands easily?
items.ex_zh: 你能把那个复杂的解释改述一下，好让大家都能轻松听懂吗？

items.def_en: To express something again using different words to make it clearer or more appropriate.
items.ex_en: The editor advised the author to reword the offensive sentence immediately.
items.ex_zh: 编辑建议作者立即换个更合适的措辞改写那句冒犯性的话。

items.def_en: To present or explain a concept or problem in a different way or from a new perspective
items.ex_en: Clever negotiators know how to reframe difficult disagreements into mutual opportunities.
items.ex_zh: 聪明的谈判者懂得如何将棘手的分歧重新建构成双方的机遇。

items.def_en: To formulate or present an argument, sentence, or structure in a completely new form
items.ex_en: The scholar chose to recast her initial hypothesis in light of evidence.
items.ex_zh: 鉴于新的证据，这位学者选择彻底重组她最初的假说。

items.def_en: To state an opinion, fact, or argument again, often in a clearer or more emphatic way
items.ex_en: The defense attorney took a moment to restate his client's innocence.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师花了一点时间再次强调他当事人的清白无辜。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate expressing an existing statement, idea, or text in different words to improve clarity, adjust tone, or ensure mutual understanding.
groups.summary_zh: 指用不同措辞对原意进行重新表达，以求更清晰、得体或明确。
groups.desc_en: Expressing an established meaning through altered vocabulary, syntax, or cognitive perspectives, contrasting with verbatim 'quoting' or conceptual 'inventing'.
groups.desc_zh: 在保留原有语义内核的前提下重构词汇、语序或认知框架，区别于一字不差的“引用”或全新“创作”。
groups.nuance_en: paraphrase: condensing or elucidating an original text in different wording (text / arguments / quotes) · rephrase: altering the precise verbal phrasing for clarity or diplomacy (question / apology / request) · reword: superficial substitution of specific words (clause / sentence / contract) · restate: reaffirming a core thesis or conviction, often identically or emphatically (principles / case / commitment) · recast: structurally overhauling form, role, or composition (article / system / role) · reframe: shifting the conceptual context or interpretive perspective (debate / narrative / issue)
groups.nuance_zh: paraphrase: 转述意译原意以使其通俗易懂 (text / arguments / quotes) · rephrase: 为求委婉或明晰换一种说法 (question / apology / request) · reword: 替换字词、微调句式表面措辞 (clause / sentence / contract) · restate: 重申、反复申明原有主旨与立场 (principles / case / commitment) · recast: 彻底改写结构、重塑形式或角色 (article / system / role) · reframe: 转换认知框架与解读语境 (debate / narrative / issue)

groups.name: Pat & Stroke · 轻拍与抚摩 (Pet, Caress, Fondle)
groups.tip: 用手掌轻柔接触、拍打或抚摸

items.def_en: To touch or hit gently and repeatedly with the flat part of the hand.
items.ex_en: She leaned down to pat her exhausted dog gently on the head.
items.ex_zh: 她弯下身子，轻轻拍了拍疲惫的爱犬的头。

items.def_en: To touch or stroke an animal or child in a friendly, gentle manner
items.ex_en: Children waited patiently in line to pet the friendly rescue pony.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们耐心地排着队，想去摸一摸那匹友善的获救矮马。

items.def_en: To move the hand or fingers gently and repeatedly over a surface, skin, or fur
items.ex_en: He sat quietly on the sofa to stroke his purring tabby cat.
items.ex_zh: 他静静地坐在沙发上，抚摩着发出呼噜声的虎斑猫。

items.def_en: To press fingers or a palm against something and move it back and forth
items.ex_en: The athlete began to rub his sore calves vigorously after the sprint.
items.ex_zh: 短跑结束后，运动员开始用力搓揉自己酸痛的小腿。

items.def_en: To touch or stroke someone or something gently and lovingly
items.ex_en: Gentle evening breezes caress the quiet shoreline beneath the pale moonlight.
items.ex_zh: 温柔的晚风在苍白的月光下轻抚着宁静的海岸线。

items.def_en: To touch or stroke someone or something lovingly, gently, or sexually
items.ex_en: The collector would fondle the smooth jade sculpture while deep in thought.
items.ex_zh: 那位收藏家沉思时总会爱抚把玩那件光滑的玉雕。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here denote affectionate, comforting, or calming tactile gestures made with the open palm or fingers gliding across someone or an animal.
groups.summary_zh: 指用手掌或手指轻抚、爱抚或温和触碰以示温情与安慰。
groups.desc_en: Applying tactile hand motions to convey affection, comfort, or sensory pleasure, contrasting with aggressive 'hitting' or accidental 'bumping'.
groups.desc_zh: 通过手掌的温和触碰动作传递安抚、温存或感官愉悦，区别于敌意的“打击”或无意识的“碰撞”。
groups.nuance_en: pat: light, affectionate tapping with an open palm (back / head / dog) · stroke: smooth, rhythmic linear sliding of the hand (hair / cat / cheek) · pet: fondling or smoothing domestic animals or loved ones affectionately (dog / pony / cat) · caress: tender, slow loving touch full of deep emotional intimacy (skin / face / child) · rub: continuous sliding surface friction to warm, clean, or soothe (eyes / back / hands) · fondle: tactile stroking or handling, sometimes carrying sexual overtones (hair / jewelry / lover)
groups.nuance_zh: pat: 用平展掌心轻拍给予赞许或安慰 (back / head / dog) · stroke: 沿单方向顺滑平稳地抚摸 (hair / cat / cheek) · pet: 充满爱抚地抚弄、轻抚宠物或孩子 (dog / pony / cat) · caress: 深情款款、轻柔爱恋的抚弄 (skin / face / child) · rub: 掌心往复摩擦以缓解酸痛或取暖 (eyes / back / hands) · fondle: 留恋地抚弄把玩，常带性欲或爱抚意味 (hair / jewelry / lover)

groups.name: Pawn & Collateralize · 典当与抵押借贷 (Pawn, Mortgage, Pledge)
groups.tip: 以财物作担保质押借款

items.def_zh: 抵押（房产或土地）以获取贷款
items.def_en: to offer property or real estate as security to a lender for a loan
items.ex_en: They had to mortgage their suburban home to finance the new business venture.
items.ex_zh: 他们不得不把郊区的房子抵押出去，为新的创业项目筹集资金。

items.def_en: to leave something valuable with a creditor as a formal guarantee that a debt will be paid
items.ex_en: The merchant agreed to pledge his valuable family heirlooms as collateral.
items.ex_zh: 商人同意将自己珍贵的传家宝典当抵押，作为履约担保。

items.def_zh: 签字放弃/质押（权利或财产）
items.def_en: (+ sth) give up ownership or claim to property or assets by signing a legal document
items.ex_en: He inadvertently signed away the copyright to his debut novel.
items.ex_zh: 他不慎签字放弃了自己处女作小说的版权。

items.def_zh: 提供（资产）作为抵押/担保
items.def_en: (+ sth) provide property, valuables, or funds as collateral or security for a loan
items.ex_en: The entrepreneur had to put up his private estate for the loan.
items.ex_zh: 这位企业家不得不拿出自己的私人庄园作为那笔贷款的抵押。

items.def_en: To leave an object of value with a pawnbroker in exchange for borrowed money.
items.ex_en: Desperate for rent money, he decided to pawn his gold pocket watch.
items.ex_zh: 急着筹房租的他决定把自己的金怀表典当换钱。

items.def_en: (informal) to pawn an item at a pawnshop to borrow quick money
items.ex_en: He went downtown to hock his old acoustic guitar for quick cash.
items.ex_zh: 他跑到市中心当掉了自己的旧原声吉他，换了点应急快钱。

groups.summary_en: This commercial domain involves a debtor transferring an asset, property deed, or personal possession to a lender as security for a loan, facing forfeiture if unpaid. 'Pawn' and 'hock' typically involve small physical valuables deposited at a shop, whereas 'mortgage' involves real estate.
groups.summary_zh: 以财物或不动产作为债务担保交付债权人以换取借款。
groups.desc_en: Surrendering proprietary assets or rights as security to acquire liquidity or loans, contrasting with outright 'selling' or debt-free 'gifting'.
groups.desc_zh: 放弃资产的实际控制权或设置抵押物权以换取短期流动资金，区别于彻底“售出”或无偿“赠予”。
groups.nuance_en: pawn: depositing personal items physically with a broker for cash (watch / jewelry / guitar) · mortgage: encumbering real property as security for a bank loan (house / property / future) · pledge: solemn formal commitment of assets, votes, or honor as security (collateral / support / loyalty) · hock: informal, often desperate pawning of personal items (heirlooms / ring / silver) · put up: posting assets or funds as bail, collateral, or ante (collateral / money / bond) · sign away: legally and irrevocably relinquishing assets or rights (rights / title / estate)
groups.nuance_zh: pawn: 将私人物件送进典当行换取小额应急现金 (watch / jewelry / guitar) · mortgage: 以不动产作抵向银行申请按揭贷款 (house / property / future) · pledge: 正式立誓质押资产，或庄严认捐承诺 (collateral / support / loyalty) · hock: 口语中因穷困潦倒而变当随身细软 (heirlooms / ring / silver) · put up: 提供资产或现金作为抵押物、保释金 (collateral / money / bond) · sign away: 签字画押、白白放弃权利或资产所有权 (rights / title / estate)

groups.name: Persist & Persevere · 坚持与隐忍 (Persevere, Persist, Endure)
groups.tip: 意志坚定百折不挠

items.def_en: To persevere and survive during a challenging, exhausting, or critical crisis
items.ex_en: Hang on a second, let me grab a pen to write that down.
items.ex_zh: 稍等一下，我拿支笔把它记下来。

items.def_zh: 奋力推进；坚定继续走下去
items.def_en: To continue moving forward or working in a determined, focused way despite obstacles
items.ex_en: Despite the worsening storm, the mountaineers decided to press on toward camp.
items.ex_zh: 尽管暴风雪越来越大，登山队员们还是决定奋力向营地推进。

items.def_en: (+ in/with) To continue firmly in an opinion or course of action in spite of difficulty, opposition, or failure
items.ex_en: Stubborn researchers persist in testing controversial hypotheses despite continuous experimental failures.
items.ex_zh: 尽管实验接连失败，固执的研究人员依然执意继续测试有争议的假说。

items.def_zh: 硬挺下去；迎难而上坚持
items.def_en: To continue doing something with fortitude even when conditions are painful, boring, or difficult
items.ex_en: Even with a severe headache, she chose to soldier on until five.
items.ex_zh: 即便头痛欲裂，她还是选择硬挺着坚持工作到五点。

items.def_en: To undergo and suffer hardship, suffering, or misfortune patiently without yielding
items.ex_en: Refugees had to endure unimaginable hardships while crossing the harsh mountain pass.
items.ex_zh: 难民们在穿越艰险的山口时不得不忍受难以想象的苦难。

items.def_zh: 坚持不懈，百折不挠，不屈不挠
items.def_en: (+ with/in) To continue trying to achieve something difficult despite obstacles, delays, or failure.
items.ex_en: Promising inventors persevere with their innovative designs despite facing skepticism from investors.
items.ex_zh: 尽管面对投资者的质疑，有前途的发明家们依然坚持不懈地推进其创新设计。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers maintaining an effort, course of action, or belief over a prolonged duration despite hardships, discouragement, pain, or outright opposition. Persist highlights unrelenting continuance (sometimes obstinate), while persevere accentuates moral grit and tenacity against odds.
groups.summary_zh: 指在困境、阻力或痛苦面前坚持不懈、隐忍挺住。
groups.desc_en: Maintaining operational purpose and effort against stubborn friction, suffering, or resistance, contrasting with voluntary 'yielding' or effortless 'coasting'.
groups.desc_zh: 在持续遭遇挫折、痛苦或强大阻力时咬牙坚守预定目标，区别于随波逐流的“顺从”或轻松的“维持”。
groups.nuance_en: persist: obstinate refusal to cease despite warnings or logical futility (efforts / doubts / symptoms) · persevere: moral fortitude to pursue long-term aims through arduous difficulty (studies / trials / career) · endure: tolerating profound pain, distress, or weathering trials over time (hardship / suffering / winter) · hang on: desperate physical or emotional clinging in extreme precarity (grip / job / sanity) · press on: purposeful momentum pushing forward despite worsening obstacles (journey / work / inquiry) · soldier on: stoic, uncomplaining continuation of duty despite fatigue or illness (illness / rain / work)
groups.nuance_zh: persist: 不顾阻力或常理执拗地坚持、持续存在 (efforts / doubts / symptoms) · persevere: 历经磨难后为了崇高长远目标百折不挠 (studies / trials / career) · endure: 隐忍承受付诸肉体或精神的长久苦痛 (hardship / suffering / winter) · hang on: 悬崖边拼死咬牙苦撑 (grip / job / sanity) · press on: 义无反顾顶着恶劣条件继续向前推进 (journey / work / inquiry) · soldier on: 像老兵般吃苦耐劳、默默扛起职责继续干 (illness / rain / work)

groups.name: Peruse & Pore Over · 审阅与精读 (Pore over, Scrutinize, Wade through)
groups.tip: 逐字逐句仔细审视阅读

items.def_en: To turn the pages of a book, document, or magazine quickly without reading completely
items.ex_en: Passengers often leaf through glossy magazines while waiting at the airport gate.
items.ex_zh: 旅客们在机场登机口候机时经常随手翻阅铜版纸杂志。

items.def_en: To spend a lot of time and effort reading something lengthy, boring, or difficult
items.ex_en: The legal intern had to wade through hundreds of boring contract pages.
items.ex_zh: 这位法务实习生不得不艰难通读数百页枯燥的合同文件。

items.def_en: To read or examine something carefully, thoroughly, and in detail.
items.ex_en: Prospective buyers should carefully peruse the fine print before signing any agreement.
items.ex_zh: 潜在买家在签署任何协议之前都应仔细研读那些补充细则。

items.def_en: To search through documents or text thoroughly in order to find specific information
items.ex_en: Investigators comb through financial records to identify any suspicious transactions or anomalies.
items.ex_zh: 调查人员全面梳理财务记录，以寻找任何可疑交易或异常情况。

items.def_en: To read or study something very carefully and attentively for a long period
items.ex_en: Scholars pore over ancient historical manuscripts to uncover lost details about civilization.
items.ex_zh: 学者们研读古代历史手稿，以发掘失落的文明细节。

items.def_en: To examine someone or something with tremendous care and thoroughness
items.ex_en: Senior auditors will scrutinize every tax document before submitting the official report.
items.ex_zh: 高级审计师在提交正式报告前将细审每一份税务文件。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures manner-of-reading verbs involving deep cognitive engagement, concentrated visual focus, and exhaustive textual examination.
groups.summary_zh: 高度专注、极为细致地阅读、审阅或研读文本。
groups.desc_en: Inspecting written or physical material with concentrated analytical rigor, contrasting with cursory 'skimming' or effortless 'glancing'.
groups.desc_zh: 对文本或物证施加高度专注的深度剖析与细致排查，区别于浮光掠影的“略读”或漫不经心的“扫视”。
groups.nuance_en: scrutinize: critical, skeptical examination seeking flaws or verify integrity (records / accounts / contract) · pore over: sustained, microscopic reading requiring deep mental absorption (maps / manuscripts / code) · peruse: formal reading through with deliberate care (documents / terms / menu) · comb through: exhaustive systematic spatial/textual sorting for hidden items (archives / wreckage / files) · wade through: laborious struggle through thick, tedious, or voluminous material (reports / bureaucracy / legalese) · leaf through: casual, low-effort flipping of unbound pages (catalogue / magazine / album)
groups.nuance_zh: scrutinize: 带着挑剔怀疑的目光深究核验细节破绽 (records / accounts / contract) · pore over: 埋头躬身、极度专注地钻研细读 (maps / manuscripts / code) · peruse: 正式且从容审慎地阅览通读全篇 (documents / terms / menu) · comb through: 地毯式、梳头般逐行彻底排查 (archives / wreckage / files) · wade through: 面对冗长晦涩的文件如涉泥泞般吃力翻阅 (reports / bureaucracy / legalese) · leaf through: 漫不经心地随手翻阅书页 (catalogue / magazine / album)

groups.name: Phase & Stage · 分期推进与阶段实施 (Phase, Stage, Stagger)
groups.tip: 按项目节点分阶段逐步推行

items.def_en: To arrange, organize, and carry out a complex activity or project in distinct progressive steps
items.ex_en: Engineers plan to stage the complex bridge renovation across three separate seasons.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们计划将复杂的桥梁翻新工程分三个季度分阶段开展。

items.def_en: To carry out, introduce, or discontinue something in gradual, planned stages.
items.ex_en: The administration plans to phase the new curriculum changes over four years.
items.ex_zh: 管理层计划在四年时间内分阶段逐步推行新的课程改革。

items.def_en: To introduce a new system, regulation, or process gradually in planned stages
items.ex_en: The hospital will phase in the upgraded digital medical record system gradually.
items.ex_zh: 医院将分阶段逐步引入升级后的数字化病历系统。

items.def_en: To withdraw, stop, or discontinue something gradually over an extended period
items.ex_en: The government intends to phase out diesel vehicles over the next decade.
items.ex_zh: 政府打算在未来十年内分阶段逐步淘汰柴油汽车。

items.def_en: To launch or make a new product, system, or policy officially available to successive groups
items.ex_en: The tech giant plans to roll out the updated operating system nationwide.
items.ex_zh: 这家科技巨头计划在全国范围内分批推出更新后的操作系统。

items.def_en: To arrange events, working hours, or procedures so they occur at alternating or intervals
items.ex_en: The factory decided to stagger employee shifts to avoid severe hallway congestion.
items.ex_zh: 工厂决定错开员工的班次，以避免走廊出现严重拥堵。

groups.summary_en: This frame refers to executing, deploying, or withdrawing a project, service, or policy in deliberate, sequential intervals rather than all at once, managing disruption and resource pacing.
groups.summary_zh: 指按时间表或顺序分步骤、分批次推进或撤出项目。
groups.desc_en: Decomposing a complex execution into sequenced, temporal, or operational increments, contrasting with single-step 'implementing' or abrupt 'launching'.
groups.desc_zh: 将复杂的整体工程拆解为在时间或空间上有序衔接的阶段性递进，区别于一蹴而就的“实施”或突击性“上线”。
groups.nuance_en: phase: orchestrating progress systematically divided into designated chronological periods (project / operations / changes) · stage: organizing and mounting an event or scheduled progression (protest / recovery / coup) · phase in: gradually introducing new protocols while old ones expire (regulations / taxes / system) · phase out: progressively retiring an obsolete system or substance (subsidies / chemicals / fleet) · roll out: progressive commercial deployment to public markets (network / vaccine / product) · stagger: arranging overlapping starting times or alternating intervals to avoid bottlenecking (hours / shifts / payments)
groups.nuance_zh: phase: 在宏观规划上按工期分阶段统筹实施 (project / operations / changes) · stage: 精心组织筹划并分幕上演事件或复苏计划 (protest / recovery / coup) · phase in: 步步为营地分期推行新规或新系统 (regulations / taxes / system) · phase out: 有步骤地将旧物、落后产能或津贴逐步淘汰停用 (subsidies / chemicals / fleet) · roll out: 新产品、服务或疫苗向市场分批铺开推广 (network / vaccine / product) · stagger: 错开班次或间隔以避免拥堵 (hours / shifts / payments)

groups.name: Pilfer & Petty Theft · 偷窃与小偷小摸 (Pilfer, Filch, Pinch)
groups.tip: 顺手牵羊秘密盗取商铺物品

items.def_en: To steal items inconspicuously from a person, pocket, or store
items.ex_en: Pickpockets attempted to lift a leather wallet from the tourist's back pocket.
items.ex_zh: 扒手企图从这位游客的后裤袋里顺走一个皮夹。
items.ex2_en: The dense morning fog lifted completely as warm sunlight bathed the mountain valley.
items.ex2_zh: 当温暖的阳光洒满山谷时，清晨浓重的雾气完全消散了。

items.def_en: To take something without permission, especially something small or unimportant
items.ex_en: Did somebody pinch my favorite fountain pen from the messy office desk?
items.ex_zh: 有人从凌乱的办公桌上顺手牵羊拿走了我最喜欢的钢笔吗？

items.def_zh: 在商店顺手牵羊，入店行窃
items.def_en: To steal goods from a shop or store while pretending to be a customer.
items.ex_en: Security guards caught two teenagers attempting to shoplift designer cosmetics this afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 保安今天下午抓住了两名企图入店行窃名牌化妆品的青少年。

items.def_en: To repeatedly steal small amounts of money or things of little value
items.ex_en: Dishonest warehouse workers would regularly pilfer valuable electronics from the storage depot.
items.ex_zh: 不诚实的仓库工人经常从仓储中心偷窃贵重的电子产品。

items.def_en: To steal something of modest value sneakily and casually
items.ex_en: Naughty children tried to filch fresh cookies from the cooling kitchen counter.
items.ex_zh: 淘气的孩子们试图从厨房的晾凉台上顺手偷走新鲜出炉的饼干。

items.def_en: To take something dishone﻿stly, often involving a breach of trust or secrecy
items.ex_en: The rogue secretary managed to purloin several classified diplomatic letters from the locked vault.
items.ex_zh: 那个败类秘书设法从上锁的金库中盗取了几封机密外交信件。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers surreptitiously stealing small, inexpensive items or money over time, typically through sneakiness, light fingers, or opportunistic petty theft.
groups.summary_zh: 指悄悄顺走小额财物或零碎物品的偷窃与小摸小偷行为。
groups.desc_en: Denotes taking someone else's property stealthily, opportunistically, or in small quantities, differing from outright robbery or grand theft by its minor scale, lack of overt force, and colloquial or literary register.
groups.desc_zh: 指以隐蔽、顺手牵羊或零星蚕食的方式盗取财物，与抢劫或大宗盗窃相比，侧重金额微小、无暴力性且多具口语或文雅色彩。
groups.nuance_en: pilfer: repeated small-scale theft, often by an insider (supplies / petty cash / inventory) · filch: quick, sneaky snatching of low-value items (trinket / document / coin) · pinch: informal opportunistic taking or casual swiping (wallet / phone / seat) · shoplift: stealing merchandise openly displayed inside a retail store (cosmetics / clothes / groceries) · purloin: formal or euphemistic illicit appropriation, often involving breached trust (manuscript / funds / trade secrets)
groups.nuance_zh: pilfer: 内部小额多次盗用或蚕食 (supplies / petty cash / inventory) · filch: 顺手摸走微小零碎物品 (trinket / document / coin) · pinch: 口语中顺手牵羊或占便宜 (wallet / phone / seat) · shoplift: 从零售商店货架偷带商品 (cosmetics / clothes / groceries) · purloin: 文雅或委婉指侵吞机密、信任之物 (manuscript / funds / trade secrets)

groups.name: Plan & Conspire · 谋划与预谋 (Plot, Scheme, Hatch)
groups.tip: 事先构思盘算甚至暗中蓄意图谋

items.def_en: To invent or concoct an excuse, story, or deceptive scheme in order to mislead people.
items.ex_en: He had to cook up an excuse for being late to the morning briefing.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不编造一个早会迟到的借口。

items.def_en: To make clever, devious, and often dishonest plans to gain an advantage or deceive others.
items.ex_en: Disgruntled executives began to scheme against the new chief director during private dinner meetings.
items.ex_zh: 心怀不满的高管们开始在私人晚餐会议上密谋对付新任总经理。

items.def_en: To create or devise a secret plan, conspiracy, or plot, typically one with bad intentions.
items.ex_en: In the dim cellar, the rebels met nightly to hatch a treacherous plot.
items.ex_zh: 在阴暗的地窖里，叛乱者每晚聚会以策划一场险恶的阴谋。

items.def_en: To make a secret, elaborate plan with others to do something illegal, harmful, or subversive.
items.ex_en: Disloyal officers met secretly to plot the overthrow of the newly formed government.
items.ex_zh: 不忠的军官们秘密会面，策划推翻新成立的政府。

items.def_en: (+ with/against) To secretly plan with other people to carry out an unlawful, harmful, or treasonous act.
items.ex_en: Corrupt officials chose to conspire with smugglers against the regional border security force.
items.ex_zh: 腐败官员选择与走私者勾结，共同密谋对抗地区边防部队。

items.def_en: To think about, plan, or intend an action—especially a crime—before committing it.
items.ex_en: Prosecutors argued that the accused killer did deliberately premeditate the murder for months.
items.ex_zh: 检方辩称，被告凶手确实对这起谋杀蓄谋了数月之久。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on deliberate cognitive preparation for future action, especially illicit, harmful, or secretive deeds. Unlike generic planning, 'premeditate' foregrounds legally actionable forethought, while 'plot' and 'conspire' stress deceitful coordination.
groups.summary_zh: 指为实现特定（多含恶意或非法）目的而事先策划与密谋。
groups.desc_en: Involves conceiving, designing, and orchestrating future actions in secrecy, typically with sinister, manipulative, or subversive intent, contrasting with neutral foresight or transparent organization.
groups.desc_zh: 指暗中构想并策划未来的行动，通常带有险恶、操纵或颠覆性企图，区别于中性的前瞻规划或公开部署。
groups.nuance_en: plot: deliberate, methodical engineering of a complex betrayal or crime (overthrow / assassination / revenge) · scheme: self-serving, cunning manipulation often involving deceits (scam / takeover / promotion) · hatch: imaginative, secretive brewing of an intrigue or plan (conspiracy / scheme / plot) · cook up: improvising or concocting a dubious excuse or story (excuse / alibi / narrative) · conspire: joining forces with others secretly to commit an illegal or hostile act (treason / fraud / coup)
groups.nuance_zh: plot: 周密策划复杂背叛或犯罪 (overthrow / assassination / revenge) · scheme: 工于心计地谋取私利 (scam / takeover / promotion) · hatch: 暗中酝酿构想出阴谋或诡计 (conspiracy / scheme / plot) · cook up: 临时编造拼凑假借口或谎言 (excuse / alibi / narrative) · conspire: 结党营私或串通密谋 (treason / fraud / coup)

groups.name: Plant & Embed · 植入与安插 (Embed, Insert, Lodge)
groups.tip: 深栽入土或安插紧扣内部

items.def_en: Fit smoothly and easily into a narrow opening or planned position
items.ex_en: She managed to slot in the delicate memory card without bending any pins.
items.ex_zh: 她设法将精致的存储卡精准插入，没有弯折任何引脚。
items.ex2_en: The replacement electronic component slotted in perfectly without requiring any modification.
items.ex2_zh: 该替换电子元件完美嵌合就位，无需进行任何修改。

items.def_en: Place, fit, or thrust something carefully into another thing
items.ex_en: The technician must carefully insert the diagnostic probe into the designated testing chamber.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员必须小心翼翼地将诊断探头插入指定的测试室内。

items.def_zh: 种植，播种；牢固安置，植入；安插，暗中放置
items.def_en: 1. To put seeds, bulbs, or plants into the soil to grow. 2. To place or fix something firmly in a particular position.
items.ex_en: Detectives managed to secretly plant a miniature tracking device under the suspect's dashboard.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们成功地在嫌疑人的仪表盘下方暗中安放了一个微型追踪器。

items.def_en: Become firmly fixed or embed something firmly in a particular place
items.ex_en: A tiny stray pebble managed to lodge firmly inside the bicycle gear mechanism.
items.ex_zh: 一颗细小的碎石卡进了自行车的齿轮传动机构中。
items.ex2_en: The nervous hunter lodged a sharp bullet securely inside the rifle chamber.
items.ex2_zh: 紧张的猎人将一颗锋利的子弹稳妥地装入了步枪枪膛内。

items.def_en: Fix an object firmly and deeply in a surrounding mass
items.ex_en: Workers embed heavy steel reinforcement bars deep within the wet foundation concrete mixture.
items.ex_zh: 工人们将粗重的钢筋牢牢嵌入未干的基础混凝土搅拌物中。

items.def_en: Insert tissue, a device, or an idea deeply into a body or mind
items.ex_en: Surgeons will implant a miniature wireless pacemaker directly into the patient's heart wall.
items.ex_zh: 外科医生将把一个微型无线起搏器直接植入患者的心壁。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe deliberately fixing, inserting, or anchoring an object firmly into a surrounding medium or strategic position, often secretly or permanently. While 'plant' suggests intentional placement or concealment, 'embed' and 'root' emphasize deep physical or conceptual entrenchment.
groups.summary_zh: 强调将物体牢固置入、深嵌或隐蔽安插于介质中。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on forcing, inserting, or anchoring an object, organism, or operative deeply and firmly into an enclosing matrix, contrasting with loose placement or surface attachment.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重将物体、生物或人员深沉且牢固地嵌入封闭基质或组织中，与松散放置或表面附着形成对比。
groups.nuance_en: plant: place deliberately for covert purposes or growth (bug / mole / evidence) · embed: press or fuse deeply and integrally into a surrounding mass (sensor / clause / reporter) · insert: introduce smoothly into a receptive opening (key / needle / plug) · lodge: become stuck, settled, or temporarily rooted inside a crevice (bullet / complaint / bone) · implant: surgically fix tissue or insert an idea deeply into the mind (pacemaker / chip / doubts)
groups.nuance_zh: plant: 密谋安插内鬼、窃听器或栽赃证据 (bug / mole / evidence) · embed: 深度嵌入基质使其浑然一体 (sensor / clause / reporter) · insert: 顺畅平稳地插入开孔或槽位 (key / needle / plug) · lodge: 卡入狭缝、留宿或正式提出 (bullet / complaint / bone) · implant: 外科植入体内或将思想深植脑中 (pacemaker / chip / doubts)

groups.name: Planting & Sowing · 播种与定植 (Plant, Sow, Bed out)
groups.tip: 用点播器打穴并播种苗株

items.def_en: Place a seed, bulb, or young plant in the ground so that it can grow
items.ex_en: We will plant five young apple trees along the southern fence tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 我们明早将沿着南侧篱笆栽种五棵苹果树幼苗。

items.def_en: Plant a seedling or cutting into an individual container or pot
items.ex_en: Gardeners should pot up these rooted tomato cuttings before their delicate roots entangle.
items.ex_zh: 园丁们应该在这些生根的番茄插条细根缠绕之前将它们移栽进盆。

items.def_zh: 把（温室苗）移栽到花坛中
items.def_en: Transfer young garden plants from pots or frames into outdoor garden beds
items.ex_en: The gardeners began bedding out the summer annuals as soon as the frost risk passed.
items.ex_zh: 霜冻危险一过，园丁们便开始把夏季一年生花苗移栽到花坛中。

items.def_en: Dig up a growing plant and plant it again in another place
items.ex_en: The landscaper plans to transplant the mature shrub into a sunnier garden corner.
items.ex_zh: 园林设计师打算将这株成熟的灌木移栽到花园阳光更充沛的角落。

items.def_en: Plant seeds in or on the ground by scattering or dropping them into furrows
items.ex_en: Farmers sow wheat seeds along shallow furrows right after the initial autumn rains.
items.ex_zh: 初秋降雨过后，农民们立即顺着浅沟播种小麦种子。

items.def_zh: 用点播器打穴种植（种子或幼苗）
items.def_en: To make holes in the soil with a pointed tool (a dibble) for planting seeds, seedlings, or bulbs.
items.ex_en: The gardener knelt on the damp earth to dibble tender leek seedlings.
items.ex_zh: 园丁跪在湿润的泥土上，用打穴器为娇嫩的韭葱幼苗打孔定植。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses the physical actions of introducing seeds, bulbs, or young plants into the soil or potting medium to grow. Nuances range from broad surface broadcasting to delicate root-setting and protective planting.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及将种子、幼苗或球茎置入土壤或培育基中的种植操作。
groups.desc_en: Involves establishing seeds, seedlings, or mature flora into soil or media for biological cultivation, contrasting with non-agricultural placement or mechanical burial.
groups.desc_zh: 指将种子、幼苗或植株定植于土壤或培养基中进行农艺栽培，区别于非农业放置或机械掩埋。
groups.nuance_en: sow: scatter or drill seeds directly into the ground (seeds / wheat / discord) · plant: place a seed, bulb, or young plant into the ground to grow (tree / rose / bulb) · transplant: dig up and re-establish in a new location (seedlings / organs / shoots) · pot up: transfer a growing plant into a individual container (cuttings / geraniums / seedlings) · bed out: transfer tender greenhouse plants into outdoor flowerbeds (annuals / borders / begonias)
groups.nuance_zh: sow: 撒播或条播种子，比喻播撒种因 (seeds / wheat / discord) · plant: 将植物、球茎等栽植入土 (tree / rose / bulb) · transplant: 移栽幼苗或移植器官 (seedlings / organs / shoots) · pot up: 将植株移植入单株花盆 (cuttings / geraniums / seedlings) · bed out: 将温室幼苗定植于户外花坛 (annuals / borders / begonias)

groups.name: Play Truant & Slack · 逃课与旷工 (Bunk, Slack, Malinger)
groups.tip: 偷懒溜号逃避工作职责

items.def_en: To work with less energy, diligence, or seriousness than required, especially when unsupervised
items.ex_en: Warehouse workers tend to slack off whenever the senior supervisor steps away briefly.
items.ex_zh: 只要高级主管稍一离开，仓库工人往往就会消极怠工。

items.def_zh: 旷工，偷懒溜号，逃避职责；削薄（皮革等）
items.def_en: 1. (+ off) (British informal) To avoid work, school, or duty by staying away or leaving early. 2. (leatherwork) To pare, shave, or slice off the surface of leather.
items.ex_en: He decided to skive off work early to catch the afternoon football match.
items.ex_zh: 他决定提前翘班溜号，去赶看下午的足球比赛。
