items.def_en: (British informal) To stay away from school or work without permission
items.ex_en: Several rebellious teenagers decided to bunk off school and wander around the mall.
items.ex_zh: 几名叛逆的少年决定翘课，在购物中心里四处游荡。

items.def_en: To stay away from school or work without explanation or authorization
items.ex_en: The restless boys decided to play hooky and spend their afternoon fishing instead.
items.ex_zh: 那些不安分的男孩决定逃学，把下午的时间花在钓鱼上。

items.def_en: (informal) To deliberately skip or fail to attend an assigned class, shift, or appointment
items.ex_en: He made a rash decision to ditch his mandatory morning physics review session.
items.ex_zh: 他轻率地决定翘掉早上的必修物理复习课。

items.def_en: To pretend to be sick or incapacitated in order to avoid duties or work
items.ex_en: The lazy soldier attempted to malinger in order to avoid rigorous trench drills.
items.ex_zh: 那个懒惰的士兵企图装病，以逃避严酷的战壕演练。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to illicitly absenting oneself from work or school, wasting working hours, or feigning illness to shirk toil. They are predominantly informal or colloquial register.
groups.summary_zh: 旷工、旷课、摸鱼或装病以躲避日常工作与课业。
groups.desc_en: Denotes illicitly dodging assigned duties, work, or school through evasion, feigned illness, or chronic idling, distinct from legitimate leave or regular rest.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过逃避、装病或慢性摸鱼非法躲避既定工作、学习或职责，与合法请假或常规休整不同。
groups.nuance_en: slack off: reduce effort or idle lazily on the job (employees / students / crew) · malinger: feign illness specifically to evade duty or military service (soldier / worker / patient) · play hooky: informally or playfully skip school or work for fun (students / classes / afternoon) · bunk off: British slang for evading obligatory school or a shift (school / work / meeting) · ditch: abandon or skip a scheduled commitment casually (class / lecture / date)
groups.nuance_zh: slack off: 消极怠工或偷懒摸鱼 (employees / students / crew) · malinger: 故意装病以逃避兵役或工作 (soldier / worker / patient) · play hooky: 旷课或翘班去玩耍 (students / classes / afternoon) · bunk off: 英式俚语中旷课或早退 (school / work / meeting) · ditch: 随意弃置、甩掉或翘掉活动 (class / lecture / date)

groups.name: Plow & Till · 耕作与翻整 (Plow, Till, Cultivate)
groups.tip: 用农具翻整碎土准备播种

items.def_en: Prepare and cultivate land for crops by plowing, harrowing, or hoeing
items.ex_en: Local farmers till the fertile riverbed acreage before planting early spring grain crops.
items.ex_zh: 当地农民在播种早春粮食作物前翻整肥沃的河床农田。

items.def_en: Dig deep into soil so that the lower layer is brought to the surface
items.ex_en: Gardeners must turn over the compacted soil completely to expose rich underlying nutrients.
items.ex_zh: 园艺工作者必须彻底深翻板结的土壤，以显露底层丰富的养分。

items.def_en: Break up the soil around growing crops or prepare land for planting
items.ex_en: Mechanized tractors cultivate the extensive agricultural estate to eliminate invasive early spring weeds.
items.ex_zh: 机械化拖拉机对这片大庄园的土地进行中耕除草，以清除初春的入侵杂草。

items.def_en: Turn up earth with a plow before sowing seeds
items.ex_en: Farmers will plow the hard ground before heavy winter frost hardens the surface.
items.ex_zh: 在强烈的冬霜使地表硬化之前，农民们将耕翻坚硬的土地。

items.def_zh: 用耙耕整（土地）；折磨，使极度痛苦
items.def_en: 1. To pull a harrow over ploughed land to break up clods of soil and level the surface. 2. To cause deep distress or mental anguish to someone.
items.ex_en: The tractor was deployed to harrow the bumpy field into a smooth seedbed.
items.ex_zh: 拖拉机被调去耙整坑洼不平的田地，将其平整为适宜的苗床。

items.def_en: Make long narrow trenches in the ground with a plow
items.ex_en: Iron blades furrow the dark earth, leaving straight trenches beneath the morning sky.
items.ex_zh: 铁刃在晨空下犁开黑黝黝的泥土，留下一道道笔直的浅沟。
items.ex2_en: Her pale forehead furrowed with deep concern upon hearing the bad news.
items.ex2_zh: 听到这个坏消息后，她苍白的额头因深深的担忧而皱了起来。

groups.summary_en: Refers to agricultural ground-preparation tasks where soil is cut, turned, broken, and aerated to ready a seedbed for sowing.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过机械或农具深翻、耙碎、疏松土壤以备播种的农耕操作。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on the mechanical disruption, aeration, and preparation of agricultural soil, contrasting with manual weeding or simple surface cleaning.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重对农业土壤进行翻耕、松土、整地等机械作业，与单纯人工除草或地表清理形成对比。
groups.nuance_en: plow: cut, lift, and turn over soil using a heavy blade (field / furrow / snow) · till: prepare and cultivate land comprehensively for crops (soil / acreage / plot) · cultivate: loosen soil around growing crops or break clods to promote growth (patch / land / crops) · turn over: spade or invert soil layers manually or lightly (earth / compost / garden bed) · harrow: break up clods and smooth ploughed ground using a spiked frame (field / seedbed / surface)
groups.nuance_zh: plow: 用犁深耕翻土或开辟通道 (field / furrow / snow) · till: 综合性耕作与翻整土壤以待播种 (soil / acreage / plot) · cultivate: 中耕松土以破土块并助生长 (patch / land / crops) · turn over: 手工或浅层翻土、倒堆 (earth / compost / garden bed) · harrow: 用耙碎土平整苗床 (field / seedbed / surface)

groups.name: Plummet & Nose-dive · 骤降与坠落 (Plummet, Tumble, Nose-dive)
groups.tip: 从高处急速垂直坠落

items.def_en: To fall sharply from a high point or decrease significantly in magnitude
items.ex_en: I can drop you off at the station on my way to work.
items.ex_zh: 我上班顺路可以把你送到车站下车。

items.def_en: To fall suddenly, clumsily, or roll head over heels down a slope
items.ex_en: Heavy boulders began to tumble rapidly down the steep, rain-soaked mountain slopes yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 昨天，沉重的巨石开始沿着陡峭且雨水浸湿的山坡飞速滚落。

items.def_zh: 猛跌，骤降；纵身跃入，急坠
items.def_en: 1. To jump, dive, or fall suddenly and forcefully downward. 2. To drop steeply or rapidly in amount, value, or temperature.
items.ex_en: Global market indices began to plunge rapidly amid persistent fears of economic stagnation.
items.ex_zh: 在对经济停滞的持续担忧中，全球市场指数开始急剧暴跌。
items.ex2_en: The brave swimmer plunged his hands into icy water to retrieve the phone.
items.ex2_zh: 勇敢的游泳者把双手浸入冰冷的水中去捞手机。

items.def_en: To drop rapidly without control or resistance under the pull of gravity
items.ex_en: The national currency began to free-fall instantly after the sudden sovereign debt default.
items.ex_zh: 突发主权债务违约之后，该国货币瞬间陷入了断崖式下跌。

items.def_en: To drop suddenly and steeply downward, or deteriorate abruptly in value
items.ex_en: Company profits began to nose-dive abruptly after consumer watchdog groups uncovered the flaw.
items.ex_zh: 在消费者监督团体曝光该缺陷后，公司利润便急剧跳水。

items.def_en: To fall or drop straight down at very high speed
items.ex_en: Unfavorable quarterly earnings caused regional bank shares to plummet to unprecedented historical lows.
items.ex_zh: 不理想的季度财报导致区域性银行股价暴跌至史无前例的历史低点。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on sudden, steep, and uncontrolled downward motion in physical space or rapid declines in metrics and rates. The frame emphasizes drastic loss of height, stability, or momentum.
groups.summary_zh: 强调速度极快、近乎垂直或完全失控的猛烈下坠与暴跌。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an extremely steep, rapid, and uncontrolled downward trajectory in metrics, altitude, or fortune, contrasting with steady deceleration or modest declines.
groups.desc_zh: 指数值、高度或境况发生极陡峭、迅猛且往往失控的坠落，与渐进减速或温和下行形成对比。
groups.nuance_en: plummet: vertical, sheer, and drastic drop at high velocity (profits / temperatures / shares) · plunge: sudden dive forward and down into depth or crisis (prices / currency / economy) · nose-dive: catastrophic rapid descent headfirst towards disaster (aircraft / approval ratings / sales) · tumble: rapid, clumsy fall involving rolling or instability (stocks / exports / rankings) · free-fall: uncontrolled, uninterrupted downward plunge without resistance (currency / economy / market)
groups.nuance_zh: plummet: 直线垂直暴跌且速度极快 (profits / temperatures / shares) · plunge: 猛扎入深处或深陷危机 (prices / currency / economy) · nose-dive: 俯冲式栽跟头坠毁 (aircraft / approval ratings / sales) · tumble: 跌跌撞撞的翻滚急跌 (stocks / exports / rankings) · free-fall: 毫无阻力的失控自由落体式暴跌 (currency / economy / market)

groups.name: Politicize & Weaponize · 政治化与工具化 (Inject Partisan Bias into Neutral Spheres)
groups.tip: 操纵公共议题并将其政治工具化

items.def_zh: 意识形态化，赋予意识形态色彩
items.def_en: to interpret, govern, or distort something according to a rigid political ideology
items.ex_en: State officials attempted to ideologize elementary history curricula according to rigid party doctrines.
items.ex_zh: 政府官员企图根据僵化的党派教条，将小学历史课程意识形态化。

items.def_zh: 使党派化，使呈现党争偏见
items.def_en: to cause an issue or organization to take on narrow party bias
items.ex_en: Political analysts warned that the controversial debate would partisanize the nonpartisan election commission.
items.ex_zh: 政治分析人士警告称，这场争议性辩论将使中立的选举委员会党派化。

items.def_zh: 大肆渲染（以达到政治目的）
items.def_en: (+ sth) emphasize or exaggerate an issue deliberately for political or tactical advantage
items.ex_en: Clever spin doctors play up minor border disputes to stoke nationalist voter sentiment.
items.ex_zh: 精明的政治推手大肆渲染微小的边境争端，以煽动民族主义选民情绪。

items.def_zh: 借机利用（某事谋取政治私利）
items.def_en: (+ sth) exploit an event, controversy, or situation to gain unfair partisan or personal advantage
items.ex_en: Shameless politicians chose to cash in on the tragedy during critical primary debates.
items.ex_zh: 不择手段的政客们选择在关键的初选辩论中借这场悲剧大捞政治资本。

items.raw_cluster: 政治化与操纵 Politicize & Manipulate
items.def_zh: 使政治化，赋予……政治色彩；使关心政治
items.def_en: 1. To give a political tone or character to something, or make an issue politically controversial.
items.ex_en: Critics argued that lawmakers sought to politicize routine public health advisory guidelines unnecessarily.
items.ex_zh: 批评人士指出，立法者试图将常规的公共卫生指导方针政治化，实属多余。

items.def_zh: 武器化，将……转为攻击政敌的手段
items.def_en: to exploit a neutral fact, law, or scandal as an offensive tool to attack political opponents
items.ex_en: Opposition leaders weaponize confidential ethics probes against the beleaguered cabinet minister relentlessly.
items.ex_zh: 反对党领袖毫不留情地将保密道德审查武器化，用于攻击陷入困境的内阁部长。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe framing an otherwise neutral, scientific, cultural, or administrative topic into a partisan controversy to gain factional advantage. 'Politicize' makes an issue political, whereas related terms emphasize turning societal issues into ideological battlegrounds or weapons.
groups.summary_zh: 将原本中立的事物染上政党党派色彩，或转为政治斗争工具。
groups.desc_en: Involves reframing neutral institutions, factual events, or public goods into divisive political instruments or hostile levers, contrasting with legitimate governance or unbiased analysis.
groups.desc_zh: 指将中立机构、客观事件或公共事务重新定义为制造对立的政治工具或攻击利器，与正当治理或客观分析不同。
groups.nuance_en: politicize: infuse partisan bias or political controversy into non-political spheres (science / judiciary / pandemic) · weaponize: adapt a resource, norm, or grievance to attack an opponent (law / rhetoric / data) · ideologize: subject a neutral concept strictly to a rigid doctrinal system (education / curriculum / history) · partisanize: split an issue rigidly along party lines (debate / appointment / discourse) · cash in on: opportunistically exploit a development for narrow advantage (crisis / trend / outrage)
groups.nuance_zh: politicize: 将中立领域浸染党派色彩或政治化 (science / judiciary / pandemic) · weaponize: 将规则、言论或资源武器化以攻讦对手 (law / rhetoric / data) · ideologize: 用意识形态教条改造中立事物 (education / curriculum / history) · partisanize: 使议题党派化、阵营撕裂化 (debate / appointment / discourse) · cash in on: 借机图利或投机吃政治红利 (crisis / trend / outrage)

groups.name: Pollute & Adulterate · 污染与掺杂 (Adulterate, Contaminate, Pollute)
groups.tip: 掺入不良成分败坏纯度

items.def_en: To dilute a liquid food or drink with water, often to stretch quantities dishonestly
items.ex_en: The dishonest bartender would regularly water down expensive whiskey bottles to maximize profit.
items.ex_zh: 那个不诚实的酒保经常在昂贵的威士忌酒瓶里掺水稀释以榨取暴利。

items.def_zh: 稀释；冲淡（使质量或浓度下降）
items.def_en: To make a liquid weaker or less concentrated by mixing it with water or another liquid
items.ex_en: Laboratory technicians must dilute the concentrated acid with purified water before routine use.
items.ex_zh: 实验技术人员在常规使用前必须用纯净水稀释浓酸。
items.ex2_en: The strong fruit syrup dilutes rapidly when mixed with cold sparkling water.
items.ex2_zh: 浓郁的水果糖浆与冰镇气泡水混合时会迅速稀释。

items.def_zh: 掺假；掺杂（违禁品或液体）
items.def_en: (informal) To mix an illicit drug or spirit with an inferior substance to increase volume
items.ex_en: Shady street dealers often cut pure illicit substances with cheap, chalky chemical adulterants.
items.ex_zh: 黑市毒贩常在纯正违禁品中掺入廉价的粉状化学杂质以扩充体积。

items.def_en: To make a substance or environment impure or poisonous by introducing dirt, chemicals, or bacteria
items.ex_en: Untreated factory sewage will quickly contaminate the vital freshwater reservoir downstream without treatment.
items.ex_zh: 未经处理的工厂污水若不经净化，将迅速污染下游重要淡水水库。

items.def_en: To introduce harmful, toxic, or filthy substances into water, air, or soil
items.ex_en: Reckless industrial operations pollute fresh alpine water systems with dangerous chemical discharge materials.
items.ex_zh: 不顾后果的工业作业排放危险化学废料，污染了清澈的高山水系。

items.def_zh: 在（饮食或物质中）掺假，使变质
items.def_en: 1. To make food, drink, or a substance less pure or of poorer quality by adding cheaper or inferior ingredients.
items.ex_en: Greedy merchants often adulterate extra virgin olive oil with cheaper, low-grade vegetable substitutes.
items.ex_zh: 贪婪的商人经常在特级初榨橄榄油中掺入廉价低质的植物替代油。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame deal with degrading the purity, authenticity, or wholesome standard of consumable substances, raw materials, or physical supplies by introducing cheaper, foreign, or harmful components.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过掺入劣质、外来或不纯物质来劣化产品或原料的纯度。
groups.desc_en: Involves spoiling the purity, health, or integrity of a substance by introducing toxic agents, foreign substances, or excessive diluents, contrasting with legitimate blending or refining.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过混入有毒物质、外来杂质或过量稀释剂，破坏原本的纯度、健康性或完整性，与合理的混合或提纯不同。
groups.nuance_en: pollute: discharge environmental waste to contaminate natural media (rivers / atmosphere / ocean) · contaminate: render impure or hazardous by contact or infiltration (water supply / sample / wound) · adulterate: secretly debase food, drink, or drugs by adding inferior ingredients (milk / wine / spices) · dilute: reduce strength or purity by adding water or solvent (solution / acid / shares) · cut: illicitly stretch drugs or fuels using cheap fillers (cocaine / heroin / fuel)
groups.nuance_zh: pollute: 工业或环境废弃物造成的广域公害污染 (rivers / atmosphere / ocean) · contaminate: 接触、渗入有毒有害物质导致不洁 (water supply / sample / wound) · adulterate: 为图私利在食品药品中掺杂使假 (milk / wine / spices) · dilute: 加溶剂稀释浓度，引申削弱效力 (solution / acid / shares) · cut: 毒品或燃油中掺加劣质填充剂 (cocaine / heroin / fuel)

groups.name: Popularize & Mainstream · 普及与推广 (Popularize, Broaden, Disseminate)
groups.tip: 推广先进理念与事物，使之在公众中普及

items.def_zh: 使成为主流，推广入主流
items.def_en: bring an idea, style, or method into widespread ordinary usage or acceptance
items.ex_en: Aggressive promotional initiatives helped mainstream electric personal vehicles among ordinary suburban commuters.
items.ex_zh: 强劲的推广举措使电动私人汽车在普通郊区通勤族中迅速成为主流。

items.def_en: (formal) make technical or esoteric knowledge easy for ordinary people to understand
items.ex_en: The prominent physicist wrote accessible paperbacks to vulgarize quantum mechanics for lay readers.
items.ex_zh: 这位著名物理学家撰写通俗读物，向普通读者普及量子力学知识。

items.def_en: become popular or widely accepted and adopted by the public
items.ex_en: The new fashion trend quickly caught on among teenagers.
items.ex_zh: 这种新的时尚潮流迅速在青少年中流行开来。

items.def_zh: 使普及；使被大众理解接纳
items.def_en: (+ sth) communicate an idea or concept effectively so that it is widely understood and accepted
items.ex_en: He used simple analogies to put across complex scientific concepts.
items.ex_zh: 他运用简单的打比方，将复杂的科学概念表达得清晰易懂。

items.def_zh: 普及，推广；使通俗化，大众化
items.def_en: 1. To make something widely known, popular, or accepted by the general public. 2. To present a complex subject in an easily understandable and appealing form.
items.ex_en: Dedicated television broadcasts popularize cutting-edge planetary research among curious high school students effectively.
items.ex_zh: 专门的电视节目行之有效地向充满好奇心的高中生普及前沿行星研究。

items.def_zh: 使大众化，让大众普及享有
items.def_en: make something accessible to everyone, not just an elite minority
items.ex_en: Affordable microfinance programs seek to democratize entrepreneurial capital for impoverished rural communities.
items.ex_zh: 普惠微型金融项目旨在让贫困农村社区广泛享有创业资本。
items.ex2_en: Higher education democratized rapidly once accredited online courses became widely available to everyone.
items.ex2_zh: 一旦认证的在线课程普及开来，高等教育便迅速实现了大众化普及。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe introducing an idea, product, or cultural practice to the general public to gain wide acceptance, comprehension, or adoption.
groups.summary_zh: 向广大公众推广普及知识、产品或风尚使其大众化。
groups.desc_en: Denotes spreading elite, complex, or esoteric knowledge, practices, or goods to make them accessible and embraced by the broad public, contrasting with gatekeeping or specialized preservation.
groups.desc_zh: 指将精英、复杂或小众的知识、风尚或商品普及推广给广大民众，与行业壁垒或专业化保密相对。
groups.nuance_en: popularize: make a complex concept or style widely known and favored (theory / concept / sport) · mainstream: bring subcultural or niche practices into the dominant cultural norm (ideas / genre / trend) · democratize: make access to power, art, or technology affordable and universal (access / education / technology) · catch on: gain widespread spontaneous popularity and adoption (trend / fashion / slang) · vulgarize: degrade quality or dignity by reducing it to crude common taste (art / language / philosophy)
groups.nuance_zh: popularize: 将专业或小众理论通俗化推广 (theory / concept / sport) · mainstream: 将边缘或亚文化推入主流轨道 (ideas / genre / trend) · democratize: 打破垄断，使大众享有获取门槛 (access / education / technology) · catch on: 自发形成风潮流行开来 (trend / fashion / slang) · vulgarize: 庸俗化，因过度顺从低俗口味而贬值 (art / language / philosophy)

groups.name: Possess & Own · 拥有与享有 (Possess, Own, Hold)
groups.tip: 享有所有权或实际占有

items.def_en: To have something as one's lawful property
items.ex_en: The wealthy landowning family continues to own prime real estate across the capital.
items.ex_zh: 这个富有的地主家族继续在首都各地拥有优质黄金地产。

items.def_en: To keep, retain, or have in one's possession or control, such as property, titles, or shares
items.ex_en: The multinational sovereign fund continues to hold controlling corporate shares in telecommunications giants.
items.ex_zh: 该跨国主权基金继续持有几家电信巨头公司的控股权。

items.def_en: To have at one's disposal or naturally deserve and receive something valuable (respect, resources)
items.ex_en: The charismatic diplomat can command immense respect from senior world leaders across continents.
items.ex_zh: 这位富有魅力的外交官能够赢得来自各大洲资深世界领袖的极高尊重。

items.def_en: To continue to hold, have, or keep possession of something rather than lose or surrender it
items.ex_en: The original founders retain ultimate editorial authority over all published daily news content.
items.ex_zh: 最初的创始人对所有每日出版的新闻内容保留着最终的编辑决定权。

items.def_zh: 拥有，占有；具有（品质、能力）；支配，控制（心智）
items.def_en: 1. To have or own something; to have a particular quality or ability. 2. To completely control someone's mind, feelings, or actions
items.ex_en: Certain elite scholars possess extraordinary analytical capabilities beyond the reach of average practitioners.
items.ex_zh: 某些顶尖学者具备普通从业者难以企及的非凡分析能力。

items.def_en: To have or contain a desirable feature, asset, or quality that is a source of pride
items.ex_en: The historic metropolitan luxury hotel can boast magnificent waterfront views and neoclassical architecture.
items.ex_zh: 这家历史悠久的大都市豪华酒店坐拥绝美的临水景观和新古典主义建筑。

groups.summary_en: Denotes holding proprietary entitlement, custody, inherent attributes, or lawful dominance over goods, assets, characteristics, or rights, contrasting legal title with de facto holding.
groups.summary_zh: 指对财物拥有法定所有权或实际持有，亦可指生来具备某种特质与能力。
groups.desc_en: Covers legal entitlement, actual custody, inherent attributes, or prestigious advantages one holds, contrasting with temporary borrowing, hunting for, or mere desiring.
groups.desc_zh: 涵盖法律所有权、实际支配、内在禀赋或拥有某种引以为傲的优势，区别于临时借用、追逐或单纯渴望。
groups.nuance_en: own: hold full, undisputed legal property title to something (property / house / business) · possess: have custody of an object or naturally embody an internal quality (weapons / drugs / charisma) · hold: physically grasp, legally occupy, or maintain a title/view (passport / shares / view) · boast: proudly possess a distinctive, attractive feature (amenities / views / pedigree) · command: control extensive respect, resources, or authority effortlessly (respect / fees / price)
groups.nuance_zh: own: 拥有明确且完全的法律物权 (property / house / business) · possess: 实际占有某物或内具某种天赋秉性 (weapons / drugs / charisma) · hold: 执掌职位、持有资产或抱有观点 (passport / shares / view) · boast: 坐拥引以为荣的特色亮点 (amenities / views / pedigree) · command: 拥有并调动大批资源或博得崇高威望 (respect / fees / price)

groups.name: Pour & Decant · 倾倒与分装 (Pour, Decant, Dispense, Dish out)
groups.tip: 倾斜容器倒出或滗出清液

items.def_en: To serve portions of food onto plates or into bowls from a communal pot
items.ex_en: Camp volunteers began to dish out steaming lentil stew to hungry mountain hikers.
items.ex_zh: 营地志愿者们开始向饥肠辘辘的登山者分发热气腾腾的扁豆炖菜。

items.def_en: To cause a liquid or loose particulate to flow out of a container in a continuous stream
items.ex_en: She proceeded to pour fragrant black tea into delicate porcelain cups for guests.
items.ex_zh: 她接着把香气扑鼻的红茶倒入精美的瓷杯中招待客人。
items.ex2_en: Rich red wine poured steadily into the crystal goblet during the feast.
items.ex2_zh: 宴会期间，醇厚的红酒平稳地注入了水晶高脚杯中。

items.def_en: (+ out/into) To serve or transfer soup or liquid food using a deep, long-handled spoon
items.ex_en: The head chef began to ladle rich beef broth into preheated ceramic bowls.
items.ex_zh: 主厨开始用汤勺将浓郁的牛肉清汤舀入预热过的陶瓷碗中。

items.def_en: To pour liquid gently from one container into another, often without disturbing the sediment at the bottom.
items.ex_en: The sommelier will carefully decant the aged red vintage wine before table service.
items.ex_zh: 侍酒师会在上桌前小心翼翼地将陈年红葡萄酒滗出换瓶。

items.def_en: (+ into) To pour liquid or small particles through a funnel or a narrow aperture
items.ex_en: The mechanic had to funnel clean transmission fluid into the narrow engine opening.
items.ex_zh: 机械师不得不通过漏斗把干净的变速箱油灌入狭窄的发动机孔中。

items.def_en: To provide, distribute, or measure out liquids, medicine, or rations systematically
items.ex_en: Automated medical storage units dispense precise prescription medication doses to emergency room nurses.
items.ex_zh: 自动化药品储存单元向急诊室护士精准分发处方药剂。

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies transferring liquids or loose solids from one vessel into another or into individual servings, ranging from gentle careful pouring to routine serving.
groups.summary_zh: 细致或按份从一个容器向另一容器倾倒、分装液体或物品。
groups.desc_en: Involves discharging, transferring, or apportioning liquids or loose granular solids from one container to another, differing from uncontrolled splashing, leaking, or steady soaking.
groups.desc_zh: 指将液体或松散颗粒从容器中倾倒、转移或定量分装分发，不同于无序飞溅、渗漏或持续浸润。
groups.nuance_en: pour: stream liquid continuously downward from a vessel (tea / wine / concrete) · decant: gently pour liquid from one vessel to another, leaving dregs behind (wine / sauce / chemical) · ladle: transfer liquid using a deep, long-handled spoon (soup / punch / stew) · funnel: channel fluid or resources through a narrow opening or conduit (liquid / funds / traffic) · dispense: systematically distribute goods, medicine, or rations (medicine / cash / advice)
groups.nuance_zh: pour: 连续不断地倾倒倾泻液体 (tea / wine / concrete) · decant: 缓缓滗出上清液体以除沉淀，醒酒 (wine / sauce / chemical) · ladle: 用长柄勺盛取、舀出 (soup / punch / stew) · funnel: 通过狭窄通道引流汇聚资源或液体 (liquid / funds / traffic) · dispense: 制度化、有步骤地分配或调剂 (medicine / cash / advice)

groups.name: Practice & Hone Skills · 操练与磨砺 (Rehearse, Drill, Hone)
groups.tip: 反复操练以熟能生巧

items.def_en: (+ on) Refresh one's existing knowledge or dormant skill through quick review
items.ex_en: She decided to brush up on her conversational French before the Paris trip.
items.ex_zh: 在巴黎之行前，她决定温习一下自己的法语日常口语。

items.def_en: Improve, refine, or add final touches of elegance and proficiency to a skill
items.ex_en: The pianist spent hours each morning trying to polish his challenging solo performance.
items.ex_zh: 这位钢琴家每天清晨都花数小时来打磨他那难度极高的独奏表演。

items.def_zh: 练习，操练；实践，实行；从事（医、法等职业）
items.def_en: 1. (British English) To do something repeatedly in order to become skilled at it. 2. To do something regularly as a habit, tradition, or principle. 3. To work as a doctor, lawyer, etc.
items.ex_en: Aspiring young musicians must practise complex technical scales diligently every single morning.
items.ex_zh: 有抱负的年轻音乐家每天早晨都必须勤勉地练习复杂的技巧音阶。

items.def_en: Practice a play, music, or speech thoroughly in preparation for public performance
items.ex_en: The theater cast will rehearse the opening scene several times before Friday.
items.ex_zh: 剧组演员将在周五之前把开场戏排练数次。

items.def_zh: 反复操练，死记硬背训练
items.def_en: Train someone or practice intensely through repetitive, disciplined exercises
items.ex_en: The coach will drill the players on defensive formations every single morning.
items.ex_zh: 教练每天早晨都会对队员们进行防守阵型的强化操练。

items.def_en: Refine, sharpen, or perfect a skill or talent over a sustained period
items.ex_en: The young violinist spent countless hours striving to hone her interpretive technique.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻的小提琴家花费了无数时间来磨砺自己的演奏诠释技巧。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the deliberate, repetitive execution of an activity to refine technique, build fluency, or prepare for performance. Distinctions center on structured discipline, artistic rehearsal, and technical refinement.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过刻意、重复性的动作或训练来提升技能熟练度、排练或打磨技巧。
groups.desc_en: Involves methodical, repetitive exertion to elevate technical precision, mental readiness, or physical execution, contrasting with innate talent or unguided trial-and-error.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过有组织、重复性的操练来精进技术、提升熟练度或心理状态，区别于纯天赋展现或无向盲试。
groups.nuance_en: practise: repeatedly execute an activity to build competence (piano / grammar / medicine) · hone: refine and sharpen an existing skill or tool to near perfection (skills / craft / instincts) · drill: train intensively through rigid, repetitive discipline (troops / vocabulary / procedures) · rehearse: run through a performance or speech prior to public delivery (play / speech / steps) · polish: touch up minor imperfections to make a work sparkle (essay / technique / delivery)
groups.nuance_zh: practise: 规律重复以形成基本技能 (piano / grammar / medicine) · hone: 切磋琢磨，使既有技能趋向炉火纯青 (skills / craft / instincts) · drill: 机械化高强度严苛操练 (troops / vocabulary / procedures) · rehearse: 演出或公开发言前的带场彩排 (play / speech / steps) · polish: 润色润饰，消除微小瑕疵 (essay / technique / delivery)

groups.name: Praise & Commend · 赞美与褒奖 (Praise, Commend, Applaud)
groups.tip: 由口头称赞到竭力推崇歌颂

items.def_en: To express strong admiration, approval, or gratitude for someone or their qualities
items.ex_en: The principal took time to praise the students for their outstanding initiative.
items.ex_zh: 校长特意抽出时间表扬了学生们出色的主动精神。

items.def_en: To express strong approval of an idea, policy, or action
items.ex_en: Environmental groups enthusiastically applaud the city's new ban on single-use plastics.
items.ex_zh: 环保团体对该市新出台的一次性塑料禁令表示热烈赞许。

items.def_en: To praise someone or something enthusiastically and publicly, often as a major achievement
items.ex_en: International critics widely acclaim her debut novel as a contemporary literary triumph.
items.ex_zh: 国际评论界普遍称誉她的处女作小说为当代文学的杰作。

items.def_en: To officially praise someone, especially in public, for an achievement or notable conduct
items.ex_en: The mayor will officially commend the firefighter for her heroic actions tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 市长将于明日正式表彰该消防员的英勇事迹。

items.def_en: To praise someone or something enthusiastically and at length
items.ex_en: Satisfied clients constantly sing the praises of our dedicated customer service department.
items.ex_zh: 满意的客户对我们敬业的客户服务部门赞不绝口。

items.def_en: 1. (+ as) (formal) To praise someone or something very enthusiastically.
items.ex_en: Scholars gathered to extol the deceased statesman as an apostle of liberty.
items.ex_zh: 学者们齐聚一堂，极力颂扬这位已故政治家为自由的使徒。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express high vocal or written approval, highlighting merit, quality, or commendable actions. They range from standard expressions of admiration to formal organizational commendation.
groups.summary_zh: 对出色行为或优秀特质表达由衷赞许、极力赞赏或官方表彰。
groups.desc_en: Denotes expressing explicit positive evaluation, admiration, or formal recognition of merits, contrasting with mild acceptance or silent appreciation.
groups.desc_zh: 指对长处、功绩公开表达积极评价、钦佩或正式赞赏，与默许或私下激赏形成对比。
groups.nuance_en: praise: speak highly of virtues, actions, or achievements (efforts / courage / performance) · commend: formally approve, recommend, or credit someone's conduct (officer / bravery / initiative) · applaud: express enthusiastic approval through handclapping or public acclaim (decision / reform / performance) · acclaim: enthusiastically and publicly herald as outstanding (masterpiece / author / breakthrough) · extol: lavish unreserved, highly elevated praise upon (virtues / benefits / merits)
groups.nuance_zh: praise: 普遍称赞嘉许其表现或美德 (efforts / courage / performance) · commend: 官方、正式表彰嘉奖或推荐 (officer / bravery / initiative) · applaud: 鼓掌喝彩或极力称道某举措 (decision / reform / performance) · acclaim: 广受业界或大众推崇称赞 (masterpiece / author / breakthrough) · extol: 极尽词句高度赞扬推崇 (virtues / benefits / merits)

groups.name: Prattle & Chitchat · 喋喋不休与闲聊 (Jaw, Prattle, Gab)
groups.tip: 轻松聊天或随性八卦

items.def_en: To converse casually about superficial social topics and day-to-day trivialities
items.ex_en: Neighbors often stop by the front porch to chitchat about daily happenings.
items.ex_zh: 邻居们常在前门廊前驻足，闲聊些日常琐事。

items.def_en: (informal) To talk or chat at length; to lecture or scold someone tediously.
items.ex_en: Old friends like to sit on the dock and jaw until dusk.
items.ex_zh: 老朋友们喜欢坐在码头上闲扯，一直聊到黄昏。

items.def_en: (informal) To talk continuously and enthusiastically, typically about matters of little importance
items.ex_en: The teenagers stayed on the phone for hours just to gab incessantly.
items.ex_zh: 十几岁的孩子们打了几个小时电话，只是没完没了地瞎扯。

items.def_en: (informal, + on) To talk relentlessly, repetitively, and annoyingly about trivialities
items.ex_en: I cannot listen to him yak on about his lawnmower any longer.
items.ex_zh: 我再也听不下去他没完没了地唠叨他的割草机了。

items.def_en: (informal, + on/about) To talk aimlessly and casually for a long stretch of time
items.ex_en: They love to natter about local gossip over a pot of tea.
items.ex_zh: 他们喜欢边喝一壶茶边闲聊本地的八卦琐事。

items.def_en: (+ on/about) To talk at length in a foolish, childish, or inconsequential way
items.ex_en: The careless courtiers prattle endlessly about trivial matters during the solemn council.
items.ex_zh: 在庄严的议事期间，轻浮的朝臣们仍就琐事絮叨不休。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this expressive frame depict informal, rapid, idle, or incessantly tedious chatter about trivial subjects, often lingering past listener interest.
groups.summary_zh: 指冗长、琐碎、喋喋不休或信口开河的非正式闲聊、碎嘴与神聊。
groups.desc_en: Involves indulging in light, informal, and often rambling or trivial spoken conversation, contrasting with structured debate or formal lecture.
groups.desc_zh: 指沉溺于轻松、非正式、常显散漫或微不足道的口头攀谈，区别于结构严谨的辩论或正式演说。
groups.nuance_en: chitchat: exchange friendly, harmless small talk about trivialities (weather / neighbors / politics) · prattle: chatter on meaninglessly and at length in a childish way (children / stream / nonsense) · natter: chat idly and comfortably for hours (friends / tea / hours) · gab: talk endlessly and glibly, often about gossip (phone / gossips / friends) · jaw: speak colloquially, repeatedly, or excessively at length (hours / night / bar)
groups.nuance_zh: chitchat: 交换无关紧要的客套闲聊或碎语 (weather / neighbors / politics) · prattle: 像小儿般没完没了说琐碎空话 (children / stream / nonsense) · natter: 亲切舒适地长时间漫谈家常 (friends / tea / hours) · gab: 滔滔不绝地八卦闲扯 (phone / gossips / friends) · jaw: 口语中长篇大论地磨嘴皮子 (hours / night / bar)

groups.name: Precipitate & Shower Down · 降落与倾泻 (Hail, Sleet, Pour)
groups.tip: 自天空高处顺势坠下

items.def_zh: 下雨；大量落下，大量倾泻
items.def_en: 1. (impersonal, 'it rains') To fall in drops from the clouds. 2. To fall, drop, or throw something down in large quantities.
items.ex_en: Dark storm clouds gather and heavy drops begin to rain across the valley.
items.ex_zh: 乌云密布，大颗的雨滴开始倾泻在整个山谷中。

items.def_en: To rain very heavily and rapidly without stopping
items.ex_en: Torrents of water continue to pour relentlessly from the saturated midnight sky.
items.ex_zh: 倾盆大雨持续不断地从漆黑的午夜天空中倾泻而下。
items.ex2_en: The careless bartender accidentally poured sticky soda all over the wooden counter.
items.ex2_zh: 粗心的调酒师不小心把黏稠的汽水泼得满木头吧台都是。

items.def_en: To fall hard and relentlessly against a surface in rapid succession
items.ex_en: Fierce hail began to pelt down violently against our fragile kitchen window.
items.ex_zh: 猛烈的冰雹开始狠狠地砸向我们脆弱的厨房窗户。

items.def_zh: 如下雨般纷纷落下；倾洒
items.def_en: To fall or descend in large amounts over a wide area
items.ex_en: Fragrant cherry blossoms shower down upon the quiet path in gentle gusts.
items.ex_zh: 微风拂过，芬芳的樱花如雨般纷纷散落在寂静的小径上。

items.def_en: (impersonal, 'it hails') To fall from clouds in pellets of frozen rain
items.ex_en: Severe storms struck the province, causing it to hail heavily for hours.
items.ex_zh: 暴风雨袭击了该省，导致一连数小时降下大冰雹。

items.def_en: To rain lightly in very small, fine droplets
items.ex_en: Gray clouds gather overhead as cold rain begins to drizzle over pedestrians.
items.ex_zh: 头顶阴云密布，冰冷的细雨开始洒落在行人身上。
items.ex2_en: The chef drizzled fragrant virgin olive oil over the fresh garden salad.
items.ex2_zh: 大厨将芬芳的初榨橄榄油淋在新鲜的田园沙拉上。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers meteorological precipitation falling from the sky as well as objects, blows, or words cascading down in intense, concentrated volumes.
groups.summary_zh: 指气象降水自空中落下，或比喻事物、打击如雨水般密集倾泻。
groups.desc_en: Covers atmospheric moisture falling or striking downward in various states and intensities, contrasting with surface pooling or ambient humidity.
groups.desc_zh: 涵盖大气水分以不同物理形态和强度降落地表的过程，与地面积水或环境湿度不同。
groups.nuance_en: rain: fall in droplets of condensed water vapor (parade / plains / afternoon) · pour: fall heavily, continuously, and copiously (rain / buckets / sky) · drizzle: fall in very fine, misty, light droplets (mist / morning / rain) · hail: precipitate small balls or lumps of hard ice (stones / storm / ice) · pelt down: rain or hail striking hard and aggressively against surfaces (rain / storm / drops)
groups.nuance_zh: rain: 凝结成水滴降落的常规下雨 (parade / plains / afternoon) · pour: 瓢泼大雨倾盆而下 (rain / buckets / sky) · drizzle: 如雾般轻微细软的毛毛细雨 (mist / morning / rain) · hail: 降下坚硬的冰雹块 (stones / storm / ice) · pelt down: 雨雹猛烈抽打敲击地面或屋顶 (rain / storm / drops)

groups.name: Predict & Foretell · 预言与推断 (Forecast, Foresee, Project)
groups.tip: 对未来局势的发展作出预先判断

items.def_en: To estimate a future rate, amount, or state by calculating from existing trends
items.ex_en: Financial analysts project significant revenue growth over the upcoming three fiscal quarters.
items.ex_zh: 财务分析师推断未来三个财政季度的收入将大幅增长。

items.def_en: to say that an event or action will happen in the future, often as a result of knowledge, data, or experience
items.ex_en: Meteorologists predict that temperatures will plunge considerably throughout the entire region.
items.ex_zh: 气象学家预测，整个地区的气温将大幅下降。

items.def_en: To estimate or calculate a future trend, event, or weather condition based on current data
items.ex_en: Economists forecast a modest revival in consumer spending over the coming autumn.
items.ex_zh: 经济学家预测今年秋季消费者支出将出现适度复苏。

items.def_en: To make a formal prediction about future developments based on current indicators
items.ex_en: Leading epidemiologists prognosticate a sharp decline in infection rates by next spring.
items.ex_zh: 权威流行病学家根据指标预测，到明年春天感染率将大幅下降。

items.def_en: To be aware of or realize beforehand that something is going to happen
items.ex_en: Nobody could foresee the profound social upheaval sparked by the sudden decree.
items.ex_zh: 没有人能预见到这项突如其来的法令所引发的深刻社会动荡。

items.def_zh: 预言（多带宗教或灵性色彩）
items.def_en: To declare or state that something will happen, especially through supposed divine inspiration
items.ex_en: Ancient oracles prophesy that a righteous leader shall arise from deep despair.
items.ex_zh: 古老的先知预言，一位正义的领袖必将从绝望深渊中崛起。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote making informed, intuitive, or formal declarations about what will happen in the future, contrasting scientific extrapolation with intuitive foresight.
groups.summary_zh: 基于分析、趋势或前瞻判断对未来事件进行推断与宣告。
groups.desc_en: Involves stating or calculating that a specific event will occur in the future based on signs, data, or divine revelation, contrasting with pure speculation or post-hoc analysis.
groups.desc_zh: 指依据迹象、数据模型或神性启示断言未来事件，与纯粹瞎猜或事后归纳相对。
groups.nuance_en: predict: state what will happen based on deduction, pattern, or intuition (outcome / trend / winner) · forecast: systematically calculate future weather or macroeconomic metrics using models (weather / sales / growth) · project: extrapolate future figures forward based on current rates (revenue / earnings / trends) · foresee: be aware of or anticipate a development before it manifests (problems / consequences / future) · prophesy: declare future events via alleged divine revelation or visionary insight (doom / coming / calamity)
groups.nuance_zh: predict: 根据蛛丝马迹或规律推测断言 (outcome / trend / winner) · forecast: 依据统计或科学气象模型系统预报 (weather / sales / growth) · project: 按当前速率趋势进行未来数据推演 (revenue / earnings / trends) · foresee: 预见预知尚未暴露的问题或后果 (problems / consequences / future) · prophesy: 借助宗教或通灵启示宣示预言 (doom / coming / calamity)

groups.name: Preserve & Bottle · 储藏与防腐保鲜 (Preserve, Pickle, Tin)
groups.tip: 将物品妥善存放以备后用

items.def_zh: 把（食品等）装罐保存；解雇
items.def_en: 1. To preserve food or drink by sealing it in a can or tin. 2. (informal) To dismiss someone from a job.
items.ex_en: Every autumn, our family works together to can freshly harvested sweet peaches.
items.ex_zh: 每年秋天，我们全家都会一起动手把刚采摘的新鲜甜桃装罐保存。

items.def_en: To treat food or perishable material to keep it from decaying
items.ex_en: Traditional farmers use salt and aromatic spices to preserve winter meat supplies.
items.ex_zh: 传统农户使用食盐和香料来防腐保存过冬的肉食储备。

items.def_en: To preserve meat, fish, or skins by smoking, salting, or drying them
items.ex_en: Artisans cure pork bellies in fragrant hickory smoke for several slow weeks.
items.ex_zh: 手艺人将五花肉放在芬芳的山核桃木烟雾中熏腌数周。
items.ex2_en: The salted codfish cures naturally under the dry northern wind and sun.
items.ex2_zh: 腌鳕鱼在干燥的北风与阳光下自然风干腌制。

items.def_en: To store and seal preserved food securely inside glass jars
items.ex_en: We plan to jar fresh strawberry jam before the summer fruit spoils.
items.ex_zh: 我们打算在夏日水果变质前，把新鲜草莓酱装罐密封起来。

items.def_en: To pack and seal food in airtight metal tins or cans for preservation
items.ex_en: Workers at the coastal cannery tin fresh sardines immediately after docking.
items.ex_zh: 沿海罐头厂的工人们在渔船靠岸后立即将新鲜沙丁鱼装听密封。

items.def_en: To preserve vegetables, fish, or meat in vinegar, brine, or pickling solutions
items.ex_en: Grandmother taught me how to pickle crisp cucumbers using dill and vinegar.
items.ex_zh: 祖母教会了我如何用莳萝和醋腌制爽脆的黄瓜。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on treating, cooking, or sealing perishable foodstuffs and biological materials using cans, jars, brine, or chemical methods to prevent spoilage.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过灌装、腌制或密闭工艺加工食品以长期保鲜防腐。
groups.desc_en: Denotes treating, sealing, or packaging perishable food products to halt microbial decay and extend shelf life indefinitely, contrasting with immediate cooking or natural refrigeration.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过特定工艺处理、密封包装易腐食物以阻止微生物变质并长期储存，与即烹即食或常规冷藏相对。
groups.nuance_en: preserve: maintain foodstuffs in sound condition via boiling, drying, or sugar (fruit / berries / food) · can: seal food hermetically in airtight metal or glass vessels (tomatoes / peaches / tuna) · pickle: steep vegetables or fish in brine or vinegar to ferment or sour (cucumbers / onions / herring) · cure: treat meat or fish using salt, smoke, or nitrates (bacon / ham / fish) · jar: seal preserves inside sterile glass jars for domestic keeping (jam / chutney / honey)
groups.nuance_zh: preserve: 用糖煮、脱水等方式防腐保藏 (fruit / berries / food) · can: 工业或深度密封于铁罐或耐热罐头中 (tomatoes / peaches / tuna) · pickle: 浸泡在盐水或醋汁中腌制发酵 (cucumbers / onions / herring) · cure: 采用熏制、腌渍硝制肉类或鱼类 (bacon / ham / fish) · jar: 装入消过毒的玻璃密封罐保存 (jam / chutney / honey)

groups.name: Preserve & Maintain · 保存与保持 (Preserve, Maintain, Safeguard)
groups.tip: 悉心防范损坏维持长久留存

items.def_zh: 维护；保养（保持良好状态）
items.def_en: Keep a building, machine, or state of affairs in good working condition by regular care
items.ex_en: Technicians visit the facility regularly to maintain crucial backup power generation units.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员定期造访该设施，以保养关键的备用发电设备。

items.def_zh: 保护，维护；保存，保留；腌制（食物）
items.def_en: 1. to keep something in its original state or in good condition; to prevent something from being damaged or destroyed. 2. to treat food to prevent it from decaying.
items.ex_en: Conservationists strive to preserve fragile coastal ecosystems from destructive commercial development.
items.ex_zh: 环保人士努力保护脆弱的海岸生态系统，使其免遭破坏性商业开发的破坏。

items.def_en: Keep someone or something going over an extended period; preserve viability
items.ex_en: The foundation provides vital resources to sustain fragile agricultural initiatives over time.
items.ex_zh: 该基金会提供至关重要的资源，以长期维持脆弱的农业发展项目。

items.def_en: Maintain something at its current high level or keep property in sound condition
items.ex_en: Our manufacturing team worked overtime to keep up exceptional product quality standards.
items.ex_zh: 我们的制造团队加班加点，以保持卓越的产品质量标准。

items.def_en: Protect something valuable or vulnerable from harm, threat, or exploitation
items.ex_en: New encryption protocols aim to safeguard user privacy against illicit digital intrusions.
items.ex_zh: 新的加密协议旨在捍卫用户隐私免受非法数字化入侵。

items.def_en: Store equipment, ships, or planes in good condition so that they can be reused later
items.ex_en: The navy decided to mothball older destroyers during times of fiscal constraint.
items.ex_zh: 海军决定在财政紧张时期将较老的驱逐舰封存备用。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on keeping artifacts, buildings, food, or pristine states in their original, undamaged condition and preventing decay.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过保养、维稳或防腐手段，将物品或原初状态完好保留下来。
groups.desc_en: To proactively apply care, protection, or resources to an entity to prevent decay, depletion, or alteration over time, unlike passive retention or neglect.
groups.desc_zh: 主动投入养护、防护或资源以防止事物随时间发生衰败、耗竭或变异，区别于被动留存或任其自生自灭。
groups.nuance_en: maintain: routine upkeep to ensure operational readiness (standards / roads / equipment) · preserve: protective intervention to keep intact in original state (heritage / food / order) · sustain: continuous provision of energy or support to prevent collapse (life / growth / momentum) · safeguard: proactive defense against prospective external harm (interests / rights / future) · mothball: deliberate deferral by placing in protective storage (fleet / plant / project)
groups.nuance_zh: maintain: 常规维保以维持运转就绪 (standards / roads / equipment) · preserve: 保护性干预以保持原貌未损 (heritage / food / order) · sustain: 持续供给能量或支撑以防崩溃 (life / growth / momentum) · safeguard: 前瞻性防御外部潜在侵害 (interests / rights / future) · mothball: 封存闲置以备未来重启 (fleet / plant / project)

groups.name: Pressurize & Compress · 增压与压缩 (Compress, Pressurize, Compact)
groups.tip: 施加压力减小体积

items.def_en: (+ on sth) apply downward force to compress something into a smaller space
items.ex_en: Carefully press down on the soil around the sapling to secure it.
items.ex_zh: 在幼苗周围小心地向下压紧土壤以将其固定。

items.def_en: [I/T] to make a gas or vapor denser, especially by cooling or compressing it into liquid
items.ex_en: Cooling chambers rapidly condense water vapor into reusable liquid for industrial processes.
items.ex_zh: 冷却室将水蒸气迅速冷凝成可重复利用的液体以供工业使用。
items.ex2_en: Moist water vapor condenses into tiny liquid droplets on the cold windowpane.
items.ex2_zh: 潮湿的水蒸气在冰冷的窗玻璃上凝结成细小的液滴。

items.def_en: (+ sth) compress loose material into a compact, firm mass by pressing
items.ex_en: Hikers pack down fresh snow along the trail to ensure safer passage.
items.ex_zh: 徒步旅行者压实步道上的新雪，以确保通行更加安全。
items.ex2_en: The thick powdery snow packs down firmly under the heavy winter boots.
items.ex2_zh: 厚厚的粉雪在沉重的冬靴踩踏下被牢牢压实。

items.def_en: to press something firmly together to make it solid and compact
items.ex_en: Heavy road rollers compact loose gravel before workers apply the asphalt layer.
items.ex_zh: 在工人们铺设沥青层之前，重型压路机会将松散的碎石压实。
items.ex2_en: The loose garden soil compacts easily after receiving several consecutive heavy rains.
items.ex2_zh: 疏松的花园土壤在经历几场连续的大雨后很容易被压实。

items.def_en: to press or squeeze something so that it fits into a smaller space or becomes denser
items.ex_en: Powerful industrial machines compress scrap metal into dense, easily transportable rectangular cubes.
items.ex_zh: 强劲的工业机械将废金属压缩成致密、易于运输的长方体。
items.ex2_en: Spongy foam cushions compress effortlessly when someone sits down upon the armchair.
items.ex2_zh: 当有人坐在扶手椅上时，海绵泡沫坐垫会毫不费力地被压缩。

items.def_zh: 使增压，维持（机舱、管道等内部）气压；对……施加压力，强迫
items.def_en: 1. To maintain or increase the internal air or fluid pressure in a sealed compartment or container. 2. To force or persuade someone to do something; put pressure on.
items.ex_en: Engineers carefully pressurize the aircraft cabin before it ascends into high altitude.
items.ex_zh: 工程师在飞机升入高空之前仔细为客舱增压。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote applying physical force inward on a gas, liquid, or bulk material to reduce its volume, increase internal pressure, or consolidate it into a denser mass.
groups.summary_zh: 指对气体、液体或物料施压以减小体积、提升压强或压实密闭。
groups.desc_en: To apply external mechanical or internal pneumatic force to condense matter into a denser mass or higher energy state, contrasting with simple crushing or flat flattening.
groups.desc_zh: 施加机械外力或气压使物质密度变大、体积缩小或进入高压能态，区别于单纯的压碎或压扁。
groups.nuance_en: press down: directed downward manual or mechanical pressure (lever / pedal / lid) · compress: reduce overall volume by squeezing along axes (gas / files / spine) · compact: firmly consolidate loose particles into a solid, stable mass (soil / trash / powder) · pressurize: raise internal fluid or pneumatic tension within an enclosed space (cabin / tank / hull) · condense: transform into a denser physical or informational state (steam / moisture / summary)
groups.nuance_zh: press down: 定向向下施加机械或手动压力 (lever / pedal / lid) · compress: 多轴向挤压以缩减整体体积 (gas / files / spine) · compact: 压实散粒使之紧密稳固 (soil / trash / powder) · pressurize: 提升封闭系统内的气压或流体压强 (cabin / tank / hull) · condense: 冷凝或精简为更高密度形态 (steam / moisture / summary)

groups.name: Program & Code · 编程与代码构建 (Script, Configure, Compile)
groups.tip: 编写计算机程序与逻辑

items.def_zh: 为……编写程序；预先设定；安排
items.def_en: 1. To write a computer program, or set a device to operate in a particular way automatically. 2. To schedule or plan an event or series of events.
items.ex_en: Engineers program the central controller to adjust cooling rates based on temperature.
items.ex_zh: 工程师对中央控制器进行编程，使其根据温度自动调整冷却速率。

items.def_en: To write a short computer program or series of commands to automate routine tasks
items.ex_en: System administrators often script mundane tasks to streamline regular server backup processes.
items.ex_zh: 系统管理员经常编写脚本来执行常规任务，以简化定期的服务器备份流程。

items.def_en: To write computer code for software applications or systems
items.ex_en: Developers code innovative features every afternoon using clean and maintainable modern architectures.
items.ex_zh: 开发人员每天下午运用简洁且易维护的现代架构编写创新功能。

items.def_en: To fix data or program parameters directly into the source code rather than obtaining them dynamically
items.ex_en: Tired programmers foolishly hardcode sensitive credentials into public repositories during late shifts.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的程序员在夜班期间愚蠢地将敏感凭据硬编码进公共代码库中。

items.def_en: To convert high-level programming instructions into machine code for execution
items.ex_en: Software tools compile high-level source files into executable binary instructions very quickly.
items.ex_zh: 软件工具能极快地将高级源文件编译为可执行的二进制指令。

items.def_en: To set up a computer system, application, or network for a particular purpose
items.ex_en: Technicians must configure network switches according to stringent organizational security protocols today.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员今天必须按照严格的组织安全协议来配置网络交换机。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail writing, preparing, and structuring machine-readable instructions or setting up digital architectures to automate and control electronic devices.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过编写、配置计算机指令与脚本，使设备按预设逻辑自动化运行。
groups.desc_en: To author, translate, or architect systematic algorithmic logic into machine-executable instructions, differing from general text editing or document authoring.
groups.desc_zh: 将算法逻辑与系统规则构筑并转换为机器可执行的指令集，区别于通用的文本编辑或文档写作。
groups.nuance_en: program: architect overall software logic and routines (computer / robot / chip) · code: translate logic into specific syntax (routine / algorithm / app) · script: write interpreted code to automate tasks (automation / tool / pipeline) · hardcode: embed fixed data directly into the source (values / credentials / path) · compile: transform human-readable source into binary machine code (program / kernel / binary)
groups.nuance_zh: program: 规划与构建系统性软件逻辑 (computer / robot / chip) · code: 编写具体语法的实现代码 (routine / algorithm / app) · script: 编写解释型脚本以实现流程自动化 (automation / tool / pipeline) · hardcode: 将固定数据硬编码嵌入源码 (values / credentials / path) · compile: 将源码编译转换为机器原生二进制 (program / kernel / binary)

groups.name: Progress & Fare · 进展与境况 (Fare, Cope, Muddle through)
groups.tip: 事情推进或生活境况发展

items.def_en: to manage, cope, or make progress in life or work
items.ex_en: Despite facing language barriers, international students get on remarkably well at university.
items.ex_zh: 尽管面临语言障碍，国际学生在大学里适应得相当不错。

items.def_en: to manage to live or survive with limited resources
items.ex_en: Unemployed workers barely get by on modest savings during lengthy economic recessions.
items.ex_zh: 在长期的经济衰退期间，失业工人靠微薄的积蓄勉强糊口。

items.def_zh: 胡乱应付过去；勉强挺过
items.def_en: to manage to succeed or reach the end despite lack of clear organization
items.ex_en: Without proper training, novice clerks merely muddle through complex financial audits daily.
items.ex_zh: 由于缺乏恰当的培训，新手办事员每天只是勉强应付复杂的财务审计。

items.def_en: (+ well/badly) To succeed, progress, or get along in a particular situation.
items.ex_en: Small coastal businesses fare badly whenever prolonged winter storms deter tourist traffic.
items.ex_zh: 每当持续的冬季风暴阻碍游客前往时，沿海小企业的境况就很糟糕。

items.def_en: (+ with) to deal successfully with a difficult and stressful situation
items.ex_en: Paramedics learn disciplined methods to cope with acute stress during emergency operations.
items.ex_zh: 急救人员学习严格的方法，以应对紧急行动期间的剧烈压力。

items.def_en: to fare exceptionally well, becoming successful or flourishing
items.ex_en: Innovative technological ventures prosper under favorable regulatory frameworks and steady investments.
items.ex_zh: 在有利的监管框架和稳定的投资下，创新科技企业蓬勃发展。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate experiencing a certain degree of success, struggle, or well-being when navigating a particular ordeal, journey, or life condition.
groups.summary_zh: 指在特定境遇或过程中进展、维持生计或艰难应对。
groups.desc_en: To manage one's circumstances and achieve a specific outcome or quality of survival across time, contrasting with stationary existing or passive endurance.
groups.desc_zh: 在特定外部境况下应对生存并展现出特定的进展状态，区别于静态的存在或麻木的忍耐。
groups.nuance_en: fare: experience a specified outcome or fortune through an ordeal (badly / well / candidate) · cope: successfully manage difficult burdens or stressors (stress / workload / loss) · muddle through: survive or succeed clumsily without clear planning (crisis / semester / negotiations) · get by: subsist with only the bare minimum of resources (pittance / salary / basics) · prosper: thrive vigorously with sustained expansion and success (business / community / ecosystem)
groups.nuance_zh: fare: 在经历特定阶段后表现出某种境况结果 (badly / well / candidate) · cope: 承受并妥善应对繁重负荷或压力 (stress / workload / loss) · muddle through: 毫无规划地胡乱应付糊弄过关 (crisis / semester / negotiations) · get by: 仅凭最低限度资源勉强糊口度日 (pittance / salary / basics) · prosper: 蓬勃发展并获得持续成功与繁荣 (business / community / ecosystem)

groups.name: Prompt & Spurn · 催促与促使行动 (Spur, Urge, Goad)
groups.tip: 言语推力由微弱提示转向力催

items.def_en: To push, remind, or nudge someone who is hesitant into moving or acting
items.ex_en: The manager had to prod hesitant staff members to finish their audits.
items.ex_zh: 经理不得不督促犹豫不决的员工尽快完成他们的审计工作。

items.def_en: To persistently urge or encourage someone to do something foolish or risky
items.ex_en: Mischievous classmates egg on younger boys to perform reckless stunts after school.
items.ex_zh: 调皮的同学在放学后怂恿低年级男生表演鲁莽的危险动作。

items.def_en: To advise or strongly encourage someone to take a specified course of action
items.ex_en: Physicians strongly urge sedentary patients to incorporate daily walking into their routines.
items.ex_zh: 医生极力劝告久坐的患者将每日散步纳入他们的日常生活习惯。

items.def_zh: 促使，推动；激励；（给演员等）提示，提词
items.def_en: 1. To encourage or cause someone to do something. 2. To help an actor or speaker remember the next words.
items.ex_en: Mounting financial difficulties prompt corporate executives to reconsider current expansion timelines carefully.
items.ex_zh: 日益严重的财务困难促使企业高管仔细重新考虑当前的扩张时间表。

items.def_en: To encourage someone or provoke an immediate surge of action or enthusiasm
items.ex_en: Healthy competition can spur talented young athletes toward achieving their fullest potential.
items.ex_zh: 良性竞争能够激励有才华的年轻运动员充分发挥自身潜能。

items.def_en: To intentionally provoke or annoy someone into doing something, often rashly
items.ex_en: Aggressive hecklers deliberately goad nervous debaters into losing their temper on stage.
items.ex_zh: 挑衅的起哄者故意在台上招惹刺激紧张的辩手，使其情绪失控。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on motivating, pressing, or prodding someone into taking immediate action or speaking, ranging from subtle reminders to intense psychological pressure.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过言语提醒、激将或施压，催促其迅速采取行动。
groups.desc_en: To apply external psychological or physical stimulus to induce or accelerate an agent's reluctant or dormant action, contrasting with gentle recommending or forced coercion.
groups.desc_zh: 施加外部心理刺激或推力以催生或加速行为人犹豫不决的行动，区别于温和劝告或强制逼迫。
groups.nuance_en: prompt: elicit an immediate response through a cue or reminder (investigation / reply / decision) · urge: earnestly and repeatedly advise urgent action (caution / reform / patience) · spur: incite sharp acceleration or sudden effort (growth / recovery / innovation) · goad: provoke action through deliberate irritation or teasing (rival / opponent / anger) · egg on: incite someone to reckless or foolish actions (bystanders / peer / fight)
groups.nuance_zh: prompt: 借由提示或契机促成即刻反应 (investigation / reply / decision) · urge: 恳切反复催促采取紧迫行动 (caution / reform / patience) · spur: 犹如策马加鞭般激起加速或突进 (growth / recovery / innovation) · goad: 蓄意激惹以刺激对方采取冲动反抗 (rival / opponent / anger) · egg on: 煽动唆使他人做出鲁莽愚蠢之举 (bystanders / peer / fight)

groups.name: Proselytize & Convert · 传教劝导与极力规劝 (Proselytize, Convert, Exhort)
groups.tip: 竭力劝导乃至热心传教以改变观点

items.def_en: To succeed in persuading someone to support, agree with, or join you
items.ex_en: His witty presentation helped win over even the most skeptical investors.
items.ex_zh: 他机智风趣的演说赢得了哪怕是最持怀疑态度的投资者的支持。

items.def_en: (+ to) To strongly encourage, urge, or warn someone to do something with earnest moral conviction
items.ex_en: The preacher stood before the congregation to exhort sinners to genuine repentance.
items.ex_zh: 传教士站在会众面前，力劝罪人们真诚忏悔。

items.def_en: (+ to) To persuade someone to change their religion, political loyalty, or core system of beliefs
items.ex_en: Zealous missionaries attempted to convert native villagers to their newly introduced faith.
items.ex_zh: 热切的传教士试图劝说当地村民皈依他们新传入的信仰。
items.ex2_en: The old industrial warehouse converted smoothly into trendy residential lofts last year.
items.ex2_zh: 那座旧工业仓库去年顺利改造成了时尚的住宅阁楼公寓。

items.def_en: (+ for/against) To make a concerted, determined, and public effort to achieve or promote a cause
items.ex_en: The attorney general vowed to crusade against institutional corruption throughout the judicial system.
items.ex_zh: 司法部长誓言要对整个司法系统内的体制性腐败展开坚决斗争。

items.def_zh: 劝诱改宗，力劝……改变信仰；极力宣扬
items.def_en: To attempt to convert someone to one's own religion, political beliefs, or opinions.
items.ex_en: Religious visitors are strictly forbidden to proselytize within the sovereign monastery grounds.
items.ex_zh: 严格禁止宗教访客在拥有主权的修道院领地内传教。

items.def_en: To preach a religious gospel zealously, or to passionately advocate a particular cause or practice
items.ex_en: The keynote speaker continued to evangelize the profound benefits of renewable energy technologies.
items.ex_zh: 主讲人继续极力宣扬可再生能源技术带来的深远益处。

groups.summary_en: This frame involves intensely striving to persuade others to accept, adopt, or convert to a specific ideological, religious, or philosophical doctrine. Verbs reflect varying degrees of evangelizing fervor and urgency.
groups.summary_zh: 指带着强烈的宗教或意识形态信念，竭力劝导并促使他人皈依或皈心。
groups.desc_en: To actively and persistently campaign to persuade others to adopt one's religious faith, ideology, or cause, contrasting with impartial exposition or neutral teaching.
groups.desc_zh: 积极且执着地奔走劝诱他人皈依自身信仰、意识形态或理念，区别于客观阐述或中立教学。
groups.nuance_en: convert: successfully transform another's faith or allegiance (infidels / skeptics / customers) · proselytize: fervently attempt to recruit converts to a belief (followers / faith / creed) · evangelize: enthusiastically proclaim doctrine to spread a movement (gospel / tech / methodology) · exhort: urgently appeal to someone's conscience or duty (crowd / troops / believers) · crusade: wage a prolonged, passionate moral campaign (reform / justice / cause)
groups.nuance_zh: convert: 成功转变他人的信仰归属或立场 (infidels / skeptics / customers) · proselytize: 执着狂热地四处招募信仰皈依者 (followers / faith / creed) · evangelize: 热情布道以广泛普及某种信念或技术范式 (gospel / tech / methodology) · exhort: 恳切呼吁以激发道德良知或责任担当 (crowd / troops / believers) · crusade: 掀起长期而激昂的道德维权运动 (reform / justice / cause)

groups.name: Prospect & Probe · 勘探与搜寻 (Prospect, Probe, Survey)
groups.tip: 勘察地界寻找潜在资源

items.def_en: To inspect, measure, and record the physical features of a tract of land or geological site
items.ex_en: Government engineers must survey the coastal terrain before approving the planned highway expansion.
items.ex_zh: 政府工程师在批准拟建的公路扩建计划前，必须对沿海地形进行测绘勘查。

items.def_en: To travel through an unfamiliar area to discover geographical features or mineral deposits
items.ex_en: Geologists intend to explore the remote mountain basin for untapped copper deposits.
items.ex_zh: 地质学家打算勘探偏远的山间盆地，寻找未开发的铜矿床。

items.def_zh: 勘探，勘察（矿藏等）；探寻，寻找
items.def_en: (+ for) To search an area for valuable natural resources such as gold, minerals, or oil.
items.ex_en: Early settlers endured brutal winter conditions to prospect for gold in the canyon.
items.ex_zh: 早期的定居者忍受着严酷的冬日环境在峡谷中淘金勘探。

items.def_en: (+ for / out) To search an area to gather strategic information, locate resources, or identify talent
items.ex_en: The military drone flew ahead to scout for suitable landing sites across the ridge.
items.ex_zh: 军用无人机飞在前方，以侦察整条山脊上合适的着陆点。

items.def_en: (informal, chiefly Aus/NZ) To search abandoned diggings, riverbeds, or clutter for gold, gems, or scraps
items.ex_en: The kids loved to fossick along the creek bed for colorful quartz crystals.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们喜欢沿着小溪河床到处乱翻，寻找彩色的石英晶体。

items.def_en: To examine, explore, or search deeply into an area, substance, or issue
items.ex_en: Investigators began to probe the suspicious financial transactions recorded by the defunct bank.
items.ex_zh: 调查人员开始深查这家倒闭银行记录的可疑金融交易。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to conducting exploratory, systematic investigations of physical terrain or specialized domains to uncover hidden minerals, resources, or commercial opportunities.
groups.summary_zh: 为发掘矿产、商机或地下资源而展开的定向实地勘探与考察。
groups.desc_en: To systematically search an unmapped territory or hidden medium for valuable natural resources or hidden data, contrasting with casual browsing or general observation.
groups.desc_zh: 系统性探寻未勘探地域或隐秘介质以搜寻矿藏资源或隐藏信息，区别于漫不经心的翻阅或泛泛的观察。
groups.nuance_en: prospect: search physical terrain specifically for valuable minerals or commercial viability (gold / oil / leads) · probe: deeply investigate a hidden, sensitive, or defensive space (defenses / wound / motives) · survey: comprehensively scan and measure a broad perimeter (site / land / opinion) · explore: venture systematically into unknown territory to understand it (caves / wilderness / options) · scout: reconnoiter ahead to gather tactical advance intelligence (location / talent / route)
groups.nuance_zh: prospect: 探察地形以搜寻潜在矿藏或商业契机 (gold / oil / leads) · probe: 深入刺探敏感隐秘处或试探防御 (defenses / wound / motives) · survey: 全面测绘、勘查或审视广阔范围 (site / land / opinion) · explore: 系统涉足未知领域以拓宽认知 (caves / wilderness / options) · scout: 前出侦察踩点以搜集战术前哨情报 (location / talent / route)

groups.name: Protest & Picket · 抗议与设立警戒线示威 (Protest, Picket, Demonstrate)
groups.tip: 罢工者举牌纠察表达诉求

items.def_en: To walk together through public streets in an organized group to show support or protest
items.ex_en: Thousands of citizens chose to march through the downtown avenues demanding immediate climate action.
items.ex_zh: 成千上万的市民选择走上市中心大道游行，要求立即采取气候行动。
items.ex2_en: The fierce general marched his disciplined troops across the rugged desert terrain.
items.ex2_zh: 凶悍的将军率领他纪律严明的部队穿过了崎岖的沙漠地带。

items.def_en: To express strong public disagreement or disapproval of an idea or policy
items.ex_en: Local residents gathered at city hall to protest against the proposed landfill expansion.
items.ex_zh: 当地居民聚集在市政厅，抗议拟建的垃圾填埋场扩建项目。

items.def_en: To take part in a public march or gathering to make feelings about something known
items.ex_en: Union members intend to demonstrate peacefully outside parliament during the budget debate tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 工会成员打算在明天的预算辩论期间，在议会外举行和平示威。

items.def_en: To assemble publicly in a massive gathering to voice support or opposition
items.ex_en: Supporters began to rally in the central square to defend democratic electoral reforms.
items.ex_zh: 支持者开始聚集在中央广场举行集会，以捍卫民主选举改革。
items.ex2_en: The charismatic party leader rallied enthusiastic voters across several key swing states.
items.ex2_zh: 这位极具魅力的党派领袖在几个关键摇摆州召集并鼓动了热情的选民。

items.def_en: To stop working or leave a meeting suddenly as an act of industrial or political protest
items.ex_en: Factory employees decided to walk out abruptly over deteriorating workplace safety conditions yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 因工作场所安全状况持续恶化，工厂员工昨天决定突然罢工离场。

items.def_zh: 在……设置纠察；在……外抗议（示威）；担任纠察
items.def_en: 1. To stand or march outside a factory, office, or building as a picket during a strike or protest to persuade others not to enter.
items.ex_en: Striking dockworkers gathered early this morning to picket the entrance to the terminal.
items.ex_zh: 罢工的码头工人今天一大早就聚集起来，在码头入口处设置纠察抗议。

groups.summary_en: Encompasses organizing public acts of opposition, labor pickets, and collective demonstrations to challenge policies, employers, or institutions.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过走上街头游行、设立纠察线或公开抗议以表达诉求。
groups.desc_en: To publicly assemble and display collective dissent against policies or authority to disrupt norms and enforce reform, contrasting with violent rebellion or quiet negotiation.
groups.desc_zh: 公开集结并展示集体抗议以表达对体制或政策的反对，旨在扰动常规以迫成变革，区别于武装叛乱或闭门谈判。
groups.nuance_en: protest: formally declare strong collective disapproval of a grievance (decision / bill / injustice) · demonstrate: manifest political power via coordinated public assembly (solidarity / streets / masses) · picket: station picketers outside a workplace to deter strikebreakers (gate / factory / site) · march: advance through public thoroughfares in unified procession (capital / freedom / peace) · walk out: abruptly abandon a workplace or assembly as collective defiance (workers / union / delegates)
groups.nuance_zh: protest: 公开申明抗议以宣泄对某项不公的强烈异议 (decision / bill / injustice) · demonstrate: 举行公开集会以展现群体诉求与政治力量 (solidarity / streets / masses) · picket: 在营业场所前设立示威警戒线以阻拦复工 (gate / factory / site) · march: 结队在公共街道行进以形成声势 (capital / freedom / peace) · walk out: 愤然集体离场罢工以示抗议抵制 (workers / union / delegates)

groups.name: Publicize & Promote · 宣传与报道 (Feature, Splash, Hype)
groups.tip: 大肆宣扬与登报公布

items.def_en: To give special prominence or emphasis to someone or something in a newspaper, show, or film
items.ex_en: The documentary will feature several renowned marine biologists discussing coral reef preservation efforts.
items.ex_zh: 这部纪录片将重点聚焦数位著名海洋生物学家讨论珊瑚礁保护工作的专访。

items.def_en: To mention or promote a product, book, or film publicly during a broadcast
items.ex_en: The author appeared on the morning talk show to plug his newest thriller.
items.ex_zh: 这位作家做客早间脱口秀节目，顺便为自己的最新惊悚小说做宣传。

items.def_zh: 作为标题大肆报道，使成为头条新闻；给……加标题；担任（演出等的）主角
items.def_en: 1. To publicize, report, or feature prominently as a headline news item. 2. To provide with a headline. 3. To perform as the star or main act in an entertainment event.
items.ex_en: Major national tabloids rushed to headline the sudden resignation of the prime minister.
items.ex_zh: 各大全国性小报纷纷将首相的突然辞职作为头条新闻大肆报道。

items.def_en: To advertise or praise something extravagantly to make people excited about it
items.ex_en: Tech bloggers continue to hype the upcoming smartphone release despite disappointing leaked specifications.
items.ex_zh: 尽管泄露的规格令人失望，科技博主们仍在大肆炒作即将发布的智能手机。

items.def_en: To display a news story, picture, or headline prominently across a page or screen
items.ex_en: Newspapers across the country decided to splash the dramatic rescue photograph across page one.
items.ex_zh: 全国各地的报纸都决定将这张充满戏剧性的救援照片醒目刊登在头版。
items.ex2_en: Bold headlines splashed across every morning newspaper following the sudden political scandal.
items.ex2_zh: 突发政治丑闻之后，醒目的头条新闻赫然刊登在各大晨报上。

items.def_en: To announce or talk about something proudly and publicly so everyone notices
items.ex_en: Executives love to trumpet the company's record quarterly profits at every shareholder meeting.
items.ex_zh: 高管们喜欢在每次股东大会上大肆吹嘘公司创纪录的季度利润。

groups.summary_en: This communicative frame captures media practices of spotlighting, heavily reporting, and generating widespread public visibility or excitement for an item or personality.
groups.summary_zh: 媒体予以重点报道、大力宣传或大肆造势。
groups.desc_en: To deliberately project an item, persona, or event into public prominence via media dissemination, contrasting with quiet publication or confidential distribution.
groups.desc_zh: 借助媒介力量将特定事物、人物或活动推向公众瞩目的前台，区别于低调发布或保密分发。
groups.nuance_en: feature: give prominent showcase to a specific element (interview / artist / song) · splash: display sensationally across prominent media space (scandal / headline / photo) · trumpet: loudly proclaim an accomplishment with boastful pride (success / achievements / arrival) · hype: artificially inflate public excitement through aggressive buzz (movie / product / release) · plug: opportunistically promote an item within an unrelated forum (book / show / brand)
groups.nuance_zh: feature: 作为主打要素予以特写或突出展示 (interview / artist / song) · splash: 在版面或主屏上进行煽情性醒目大篇幅报道 (scandal / headline / photo) · trumpet: 敲锣打鼓般大肆宣扬吹嘘自身功绩 (success / achievements / arrival) · hype: 借由密集营销炒作人为制造狂热预期 (movie / product / release) · plug: 在公开场合顺带插播植入广告以宣传产品 (book / show / brand)

groups.name: Punish & Penalize · 惩治与教训 (Chasten, Discipline, Reprimand)
groups.tip: 通过体罚或严厉惩诫教训

items.def_en: To punish an individual in order to instill obedience, order, or self-control
items.ex_en: The regulatory board has the authority to discipline licensed physicians for professional misconduct.
items.ex_zh: 监管委员会完全有权因执业不端行为惩处持证医师。

items.def_zh: 处以罚则；使处不利境地
items.def_en: To impose a formal penalty or disadvantage on someone for breaking a rule
items.ex_en: The referee chose to penalize the aggressive defender for a reckless late tackle.
items.ex_zh: 裁判决定对该侵略性极强的后卫处以罚则，因其进行了鲁莽的迟到铲球。

items.def_en: To inflict discipline or hardship upon someone in order to restrain or subdue them
items.ex_en: Severe financial hardship seemed to chasten his once arrogant and reckless personal demeanor.
items.ex_zh: 严重的经济困难似乎磨炼了他，使他曾经傲慢鲁莽的作风大为收敛。

items.def_en: (dialect or old-fashioned) To punish someone or teach them a harsh lesson; to teach.
items.ex_en: I'll larn you to sneak into my locked orchard and steal my apples!
items.ex_zh: 看我怎么狠狠收拾你，教训你竟敢溜进我锁着的果园偷苹果！

items.def_en: To reprimand or punish an offender with considerable severity
items.ex_en: The manager threatened to come down on anyone who leaked the confidential project.
items.ex_zh: 经理威胁称，谁要是泄露绝密项目机密，就严惩不贷。

items.def_en: To punish or severely rebuke someone for inappropriate conduct
items.ex_en: The headmaster proceeded to chastise the students publicly for their disruptive classroom behavior.
items.ex_zh: 校长随即因学生扰乱课堂纪律的行为而当众严厉训诫了他们。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe inflicting penalties, chastisement, or harsh correction on someone to correct behavior or deter future misconduct.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过施加痛苦、惩罚或严厉训诫以纠正不良行为的行为。
groups.desc_en: To systematically inflict pain, restriction, or loss upon a wrongdoer to enforce order and deter recidivism, contrasting with vengeful retaliation or spontaneous abuse.
groups.desc_zh: 依规对违纪越轨者施加痛苦、制裁或损失以彰显纪律并防止再犯，区别于泄愤报复或无端虐待。
groups.nuance_en: discipline: train or correct conduct through formal institutional sanctions (soldiers / students / staff) · penalize: impose a designated fine or operational handicap for a rule breach (offenders / foul / latecomers) · chastise: reprimand severely or corporal-punish to instill shame (critics / subordinates / children) · chasten: humble and subdue someone through humbling hardship or rebukes (defeat / experience / remarks) · come down on: descend aggressively with heavy retribution upon a subordinate (violators / fraud / culprits)
groups.nuance_zh: discipline: 依循纪律规章惩治并纠正行为举止 (soldiers / students / staff) · penalize: 因违反规则而扣分、罚款或施加不利处罚 (offenders / foul / latecomers) · chastise: 严厉谴责或体罚教训以令其知耻 (critics / subordinates / children) · chasten: 经受挫折折磨而使其敛去锋芒、变得谦逊规矩 (defeat / experience / remarks) · come down on: 对违规下属施以雷霆般的严厉惩办 (violators / fraud / culprits)

groups.name: Puzzle & Bewilder · 困惑与不解 (Puzzle, Baffle, Perplex)
groups.tip: 面对复杂情况百思不解

items.def_en: To think about something until you finally understand it or resolve the confusion surrounding it
items.ex_en: Scientists are trying to figure out why the virus mutated so rapidly.
items.ex_zh: 科学家们正试图弄明白这种病毒为何变异得如此之快。

items.def_zh: 使迷惑，使困惑；苦思，苦苦琢磨
items.def_en: 1. To baffle, bewilder, or cause someone to feel confused. 2. (+ over/about) To think hard and long about something in order to understand it.
items.ex_en: These strange astronomical readings continue to puzzle researchers stationed at the polar observatory.
items.ex_zh: 这些奇异的天文读数继续让驻扎在极地天文台的研究人员困惑不解。

items.def_en: To confuse and slightly worry someone because something is difficult to understand or solve
items.ex_en: The intricate tax law changes seem to perplex even the most seasoned accountants.
items.ex_zh: 复杂微妙的税法变动似乎连经验最老到的会计师也感到纠结困惑。

items.def_en: To cause someone to be completely unable to understand, explain, or solve a problem
items.ex_en: The magician's final disappearance managed to baffle the entire audience in the auditorium.
items.ex_zh: 魔术师最后的凭空消失成功难倒了礼堂内的全体观众。

items.def_zh: 使不知所措；使眼花缭乱
items.def_en: To confuse someone severely, especially by presenting too many conflicting choices, details, or changes
items.ex_en: A sudden maze of conflicting transit signs served only to bewilder the lost tourists.
items.ex_zh: 突然出现的一大堆相互矛盾的交通路标只会让迷路的游客更加不知所措。

items.def_en: To make someone feel completely unable to explain an event or secret phenomenon
items.ex_en: The sudden disappearance of ancient civilizations in the valley continues to mystify historians.
items.ex_zh: 该山谷中古代文明的骤然消失至今仍令历史学家们大惑不解。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses mental states and causes where an unexpected, contradictory, or complex situation renders someone unable to understand, solve, or explain something. Baffle implies total failure of understanding, while perplex highlights accompanying worry or indecision.
groups.summary_zh: 指因事情复杂、矛盾或怪异而令人费解、困惑或冥思苦想。
groups.desc_en: To confound an observer's intellectual grasp due to inherent obscurity, contradiction, or complete lack of explanatory clues, contrasting with mere misunderstanding.
groups.desc_zh: 因事物本身的隐晦、矛盾或完全缺乏线索，导致认知主体陷入智识迷局，区别于单纯的误解。
groups.nuance_en: puzzle: tease the intellect with an unresolved, intriguing ambiguity (clues / mystery / behavior) · perplex: induce anxious mental disorientation through conflicting factors (questions / paradox / observers) · baffle: completely thwart any intellectual attempt to solve or comprehend (police / experts / scientists) · bewilder: overwhelm the senses and mind with chaotic complexity (stranger / crowd / rules) · mystify: leave entirely unable to account for an enigmatic phenomenon (audiences / critics / disappearance)
groups.nuance_zh: puzzle: 包含费解矛盾而引人反复琢磨困惑 (clues / mystery / behavior) · perplex: 因复杂混乱的线索使人陷入焦虑不安的茫然 (questions / paradox / observers) · baffle: 完全难倒当事人，使解题或查案毫无头绪 (police / experts / scientists) · bewilder: 因头绪纷繁或突变而使人大脑宕机、辨不清方向 (stranger / crowd / rules) · mystify: 宛如神秘莫测的谜团令人不可思议 (audiences / critics / disappearance)

groups.name: Question & Challenge · 质问与质疑 (Query, Dispute, Call into question)
groups.tip: 带着怀疑质问并提出挑战

items.def_en: To ask about something, especially in order to check if it is correct or true.
items.ex_en: Auditors decided to query several ambiguous travel expenses billed to the university department.
items.ex_zh: 审计员决定就记在大学该部门名下的几笔性质模糊的差旅费提出正式质疑。

items.def_en: To cause doubt or uncertainty to exist about whether something is true, useful, or reliable.
items.ex_en: The recent data breach may call into question the overall reliability of our security.
items.ex_zh: 最近的数据泄露事件可能会使我们整个安全系统的可靠性受到严重怀疑。

items.def_zh: 质疑，对……表示怀疑；讯问，审问
items.def_en: 1. To express doubts about the accuracy, honesty, or advisability of something. 2. To ask someone a series of questions formally or systematically.
items.ex_en: Several board members openly question the viability of launching the costly foreign initiative.
items.ex_zh: 几位董事会成员公开质疑启动这一昂贵的海外项目是否切实可行。

items.def_en: To question the truth, legality, or authority of someone or something, demanding proof or change.
items.ex_en: Opposition leaders intend to challenge the constitutional legality of the newly passed emergency decree.
items.ex_zh: 反对党领袖打算就新通过的紧急法令的合宪性向政府提出严正质疑。

items.def_en: To disagree with something, especially an official finding or claim, and argue that it is wrong.
items.ex_en: The pharmaceutical company filed documents to dispute the regulatory board's adverse safety findings.
items.ex_zh: 该制药公司递交了文件，正式驳斥监管委员会不利的安全调查结果。

items.def_zh: 指责，攻击质疑（动机或名誉）
items.def_en: To attack something such as someone's character, motives, or honesty as false or untrustworthy.
items.ex_en: The defense attorney tried to impugn the honesty and credibility of the star witness.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师试图攻击指责关键证人的诚实度与信誉不可靠。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on casting doubt on the validity, veracity, or authority of a claim, policy, or person. 'Question' and 'query' involve raising intellectual skepticism, while 'challenge' and 'dispute' directly contest legitimacy and demand defense.
groups.summary_zh: 对某事物的真实性、合理性或权威性提出怀疑与异议。
groups.desc_en: To refuse to accept a premise or claim at face value by demanding proof or formally disputing its validity, contrasting with passive acceptance or total denial.
groups.desc_zh: 拒绝盲信既有主张，通过要求提供证据或正式提出异议来质疑其有效性，区别于顺从接受或武断否定。
groups.nuance_en: query: raise a polite or technical inquiry seeking clarification (invoice / status / database) · question: express skepticism over the honesty, wisdom, or legitimacy of a matter (motives / wisdom / judgment) · challenge: directly confront an assertion demanding formal justification (authority / decision / assumption) · dispute: officially argue against and contest the truth of a claim (claim / election / figures) · impugn: assault the fundamental integrity or honor of a person's character (integrity / honesty / character)
groups.nuance_zh: query: 提出事务性或技术性疑问以求澄清 (invoice / status / database) · question: 对某事的合理性、动机或智慧表达怀疑 (motives / wisdom / judgment) · challenge: 当面叫板并要求对方自证其正当性 (authority / decision / assumption) · dispute: 就事实或裁决进行正式辩驳与争端对抗 (claim / election / figures) · impugn: 直斥其非，攻击贬损其名誉、操守或人品 (integrity / honesty / character)

groups.name: Question & Interrogate · 讯问与审问 (Interrogate, Grill, Cross-examine)
groups.tip: 正式面谈或法理上的盘问

items.def_zh: 面试，面谈；采访；讯问，审问
items.def_en: 1. To ask someone formal questions to evaluate their suitability for a job or course. 2. To question someone to gather information for a news story or broadcast. 3. (of police) To formally question a suspect or witness.
items.ex_en: Senior hiring managers will interview three qualified candidates for the vacant executive position.
items.ex_zh: 高级招聘主管今天将面试三位申请该空缺高管职位的合格人选。

items.def_en: (+ for) To ask someone persistent questions in order to extract confidential information
items.ex_en: The inquisitive reporter tried to pump the young intern for details about the merger.
items.ex_zh: 那名好奇的记者试图从年轻实习生那里套取关于合并案的内幕细节。

items.def_en: To question a witness closely in court to test or discredit previous testimony
items.ex_en: The prosecuting attorney stepped forward to cross-examine the alibi witness before the jury.
items.ex_zh: 检察官走上前去，在陪审团面前严密反诘盘问不在场证明证人。

items.def_en: To question someone discreetly to discover their opinions or future plans
items.ex_en: The manager quietly sounded out a few team members before unveiling the restructuring plan.
items.ex_zh: 经理在公布重组方案之前，私下试探了几名团队成员的口风。

items.def_en: To subject someone to intense, unrelenting questioning
items.ex_en: Detectives spent hours attempting to grill the tight-lipped suspect about the midnight robbery.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们花了数小时对这名守口如瓶的嫌疑人进行严酷盘问，逼问午夜抢劫案。

items.def_en: To question a suspect or captive formally and persistently, often aggressively
items.ex_en: Special military intelligence agents arrived to interrogate the captured operative under strict protocol.
items.ex_zh: 特种军事情报人员赶到现场，按照严格的规程讯问被俘特工。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on systematically asking questions to obtain intelligence, assess qualifications, or elicit confessions under varying degrees of pressure.
groups.summary_zh: 指系统性、正式或施压性地盘问、审讯以获取信息或查证事实。
groups.desc_en: To subject a person to focused, methodical probing in an authoritative or investigative setting to extract hidden information, contrasting with informal conversation.
groups.desc_zh: 在权威或调查语境下对当事人展开密集且有条理的追问以挖出隐情，区别于日常漫谈。
groups.nuance_en: interrogate: systematically examine a captive or suspect with coercive institutional authority (suspect / prisoner / spy) · grill: subject someone to relentless, aggressive questioning under heat (witness / politician / candidate) · cross-examine: rigorously test a witness's testimony under formal adversarial rules (witness / complainant / expert) · pump: covertly and persistently coax gossip or secrets out of an informant (source / insider / informant) · sound out: discreetly probe someone's prospective reaction or inclinations (colleagues / opinion / intentions)
groups.nuance_zh: interrogate: 依仗公权力对嫌疑人或战俘进行系统性审问讯问 (suspect / prisoner / spy) · grill: 轮番轰炸般严厉盘问使对方招架不住 (witness / politician / candidate) · cross-examine: 在法庭上对证人证言进行对抗性交叉盘问 (witness / complainant / expert) · pump: 旁敲侧击以套取秘密情报或内幕 (source / insider / informant) · sound out: 私下探听摸底以摸清对方真实意图或倾向 (colleagues / opinion / intentions)

groups.name: Queue & Line · 排队与成列 (Line up, Queue up, File)
groups.tip: 按顺序依次排列成行

items.def_en: To walk or march deliberately in a single line, one behind another
items.ex_en: The silent students were instructed to file quietly into the assembly hall this morning.
items.ex_zh: 今天早上，安静的学生们接到指示排成单行有序步入礼堂。
