items.def_en: To form or stand in a single-file or orderly row while waiting for something
items.ex_en: Hungry patrons began to line up outside the renowned bakery before dawn broke.
items.ex_zh: 饥肠辘辘的顾客在天破晓前就已开始在这家著名面包店门外排好队伍。
items.ex2_en: The teacher had to line up the excited children before entering the museum.
items.ex2_zh: 进入博物馆前，老师不得不让兴奋的孩子们排好队。

items.def_en: To join a line of people waiting to enter a venue, receive a service, or purchase goods
items.ex_en: Anxious commuters had to queue up on the icy platform awaiting the delayed train.
items.ex_zh: 焦虑的通勤者不得不结冰的站台上排队等候那趟晚点的列车。

items.def_en: To form a long, extended line or succession with notable gaps between individuals
items.ex_en: The exhausted marathon runners began to string out across the final hilly miles.
items.ex_zh: 筋疲力尽的马拉松跑者在最后几英里的多山路段上稀疏拉开成长串。

items.def_en: To take one's place in an orderly military or structured rank and line
items.ex_en: The drill sergeant loudly ordered the recruits to fall in before the morning inspection.
items.ex_zh: 操练军士大声命令新兵在晨检开始前迅速集合站队。

items.def_zh: 排队，成列等候；使排列成行
items.def_en: 1. (+ up) (chiefly British) To line up or wait in a queue to do or get something. 2. To arrange into a queue or sequence.
items.ex_en: British shoppers patiently queue outside the popular department store during the annual winter sale.
items.ex_zh: 在一年一度的冬季大促期间，英国顾客在热门百货公司外耐心地排队等候。

groups.summary_en: Covers the social coordination of people or vehicles arranging themselves in a sequence while waiting or moving. 'Queue' and 'line up' denote waiting sequentially, while 'file' stresses advancing in an orderly single row.
groups.summary_zh: 指人或车辆有序排列成行，等待服务或顺次前行。
groups.desc_en: To arrange oneself or objects into a deliberate sequential linear order across space or time, contrasting with disordered clustering or scattering.
groups.desc_zh: 使个体或物体在空间或时间上按既定先后次序排列成线，区别于无序聚拢或散落。
groups.nuance_en: queue: wait in a sequential order according to arrival time (passengers / fans / shoppers) · line up: form into a straight, disciplined row or array (students / soldiers / vehicles) · file: march past in a narrow, disciplined single or double column (in / out / past) · fall in: assume precise formation under military or paramilitary command (platoon / troops / squad) · string out: scatter or extend thinly over a lengthy distance (runners / peloton / convey)
groups.nuance_zh: queue: 依先来后到次序等候排队 (passengers / fans / shoppers) · line up: 顺次整齐地站成一排或列队整装 (students / soldiers / vehicles) · file: 鱼贯成单列秩序井然地鱼贯出入 (in / out / past) · fall in: 听从口令迅速立正集合归队入列 (platoon / troops / squad) · string out: 稀稀拉拉被拉扯成一条过长的断续长带 (runners / peloton / convey)

groups.name: Quibble & Cavil · 狡辩与吹毛求疵 (Quibble, Cavil, Split hairs)
groups.tip: 在细枝末节上诡辩胡搅

items.def_zh: 过分琐碎辨析；钻牛角尖
items.def_en: To dwell obsessively on minute, practically meaningless differences in argument
items.ex_en: We do not have enough valuable meeting time to split hairs over minor punctuation.
items.ex_zh: 我们没有充裕的宝贵会议时间去为几个微不足道的标点符号钻牛角尖。

items.def_en: (+ about/over) To argue or complain about small, trivial, or unimportant matters
items.ex_en: It is counterproductive to quibble over tiny travel expenses when the project succeeded.
items.ex_zh: 在项目已经成功的情况下，为微不足道的差旅费争论不休只会适得其反。

items.def_en: (+ at/about) To make petty, carping, or unnecessary objections
items.ex_en: Strict legal purists will constantly cavil at minor procedural defects in the treaty draft.
items.ex_zh: 严苛的法律教条主义者总是会抓着条约草案中细微的程序瑕疵不放、妄加指摘。

items.def_en: To focus hypercritically on tiny, inconsequential flaws or mistakes
items.ex_en: Reviewers always love to nitpick about slight formatting inconsistencies in submitted manuscripts.
items.ex_zh: 审稿人总是特别喜欢挑剔投稿手稿中那些微小的格式不一致。

items.def_zh: 说模棱两可的话；推诿含糊
items.def_en: To use ambiguous language intentionally in order to conceal the truth or avoid committing
items.ex_en: The pressured politician chose to equivocate rather than give a candid yes or no.
items.ex_zh: 承受重压的政客选择含糊其辞、大打太极，而不是坦诚地给出肯定或否定的答复。

items.def_en: 1. (dated) To quibble, bicker, or argue over petty, insignificant, or dishonest legal points.
items.ex_en: The corrupt magistrate continued to pettifog over obscure statutory clauses to delay the trial.
items.ex_zh: 贪腐的执政官继续就晦涩的法规条款百般狡辩扯皮，以故意拖延审判。

groups.summary_en: Captures raising petty, trivial objections or dodging true issues through pedantic distinctions, evasive arguments, or legalistic pretexts.
groups.summary_zh: 指在微末细节上挑刺、狡辩纠缠或避重就轻地争执辩解。
groups.desc_en: To obsessively contest trivial details or engage in deceptive linguistic distinctions to evade an issue or disrupt agreement, contrasting with substantive debate.
groups.desc_zh: 死抠细枝末节或玩弄概念文字游戏以回避实质问题或阻挠达成共识，区别于严肃的实质辩论。
groups.nuance_en: quibble: evade a central point by arguing over trifling nuances (details / definitions / words) · cavil: raise petty, irritating, and unwarranted objections (costs / formatting / grammar) · nitpick: obsessively criticize minute, inconsequential flaws (flaws / errors / presentation) · split hairs: draw absurdly fine or irrelevant semantic distinctions (semantics / definitions / logic) · equivocate: use deliberately ambiguous language to conceal the truth (answers / responses / truth)
groups.nuance_zh: quibble: 为无关紧要的字眼细微差异狡辩纠缠 (details / definitions / words) · cavil: 吹毛求疵，挑剔鸡毛蒜皮的不合理之处 (costs / formatting / grammar) · nitpick: 鸡蛋里挑骨头，挑刺细小无足轻重的瑕疵 (flaws / errors / presentation) · split hairs: 作毫无实际意义的过度精细划分 (semantics / definitions / logic) · equivocate: 含糊其辞以模棱两可的话闪烁其词 (answers / responses / truth)

groups.name: Radiate & Beam · 射线放射与照射 (Beam, Radiate, Cast)
groups.tip: 放射出射线与光芒

items.def_en: To direct downward beams of light over a person or ground.
items.ex_en: Gentle moonbeams shine down on the tranquil waters of the darkened forest lake.
items.ex_zh: 柔和的月光向下倾泻照耀在幽暗森林湖泊宁静的水面上。

items.def_en: To pour or shine steadily and brightly through an opening or window.
items.ex_en: Golden rays of morning sunlight stream through the wide glass panels of the greenhouse.
items.ex_zh: 清晨金色的阳光透过温室宽大的玻璃板倾泻照射进来。
items.ex2_en: The stage projector streamed bright colorful lights across the crowded dance floor.
items.ex2_zh: 舞台投影仪将明亮绚丽的光束投射在拥挤的舞池上。

items.def_en: To send light, shadows, or glances across an area or surface.
items.ex_en: The ancient stone towers cast long and ominous shadows over the silent cobblestone streets.
items.ex_zh: 古老的石塔向寂静的鹅卵石街道投下漫长而凶险的阴影。

items.def_zh: 放射（光线），辐射出光线；照射
items.def_en: To send out or be sent out in the form of rays of light; to emit or shine rays.
items.ex_en: The morning sun began to ray dazzling light over the misty mountain summit.
items.ex_zh: 朝阳开始向雾气缭绕的山顶放射出耀眼夺目的光芒。
items.ex2_en: Warm beams of sunlight rayed brightly through the dense branches of the ancient forest.
items.ex2_zh: 温暖的阳光透过古老森林茂密的枝头放射出耀眼的光芒。

items.def_en: To emit a steady shaft of brilliant light in a specific direction.
items.ex_en: The search helicopter began to beam an intense searchlight over the dark choppy waters.
items.ex_zh: 搜救直升机开始向黑暗汹涌的水域定向发射出一道强烈的探照灯光束。

items.def_zh: 辐射，向四周发散出（光或热）
items.def_en: To send out rays or waves of light, heat, or energy in all directions.
items.ex_en: Hot ceramic heating elements radiate immense warmth uniformly across the drafty studio room.
items.ex_zh: 滚烫的陶瓷发热元件向这间透风的工作室四周均匀辐射出巨大的热量。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on light or energy traveling outward in distinct, directional shafts, straight beams, or spreading rays from an illuminated center.
groups.summary_zh: 光线呈束状、放射状向外直线发散照射或在表面投射光影。
groups.desc_en: To project straight streams of optical or electromagnetic energy outward from an active luminous source, contrasting with broad unfocused glowing.
groups.desc_zh: 从发光源向外笔直投射出集中的光学或电磁射线束，区别于漫反射或整体微弱发光。
groups.nuance_en: beam: direct a concentrated, intense ray of light or signal toward a point (searchlight / signal / radio) · radiate: emit waves or rays outward omnidirectionally from a core (heat / light / energy) · stream: flow continuously and copiously through an aperture (sunlight / tears / traffic) · cast: throw light or shadow across a surface or direction (shadow / glow / pall) · shine down on: illuminate a target from a celestial or elevated vantage (sun / moon / spotlight)
groups.nuance_zh: beam: 定向投射聚焦且高亮度的光束或无线电信号 (searchlight / signal / radio) · radiate: 从核心源向四周全方位发射光波或热辐射 (heat / light / energy) · stream: 光束顺着缝隙或窗口持续倾泻涌入 (sunlight / tears / traffic) · cast: 将光芒或阴影投射、抛洒于受光面上 (shadow / glow / pall) · shine down on: 从高空对下方目标进行朗朗普照 (sun / moon / spotlight)

groups.name: Radiate & Emanate · 辐射与发散 (Emanate, Beam, Exude, Diffuse)
groups.tip: 由中心向四面八方放射散布

items.def_en: to send forth or throw light, shadow, or a glance in a particular direction
items.ex_en: The flickering tavern fireplace cast a warm, comforting amber glow across the wooden room.
items.ex_zh: 酒馆里跳动的壁炉火焰向木屋投射出一片温暖惬意的琥珀色光芒。

items.def_en: to spread out widely over a large area or through a substance
items.ex_en: The scented oils slowly diffuse rich floral aromas through the entire spa sanctuary.
items.ex_zh: 芳香精油在整个水疗静修室中缓缓弥散出浓郁的花卉香气。
items.ex2_en: Sweet floral fragrances slowly diffuse through the warm, quiet evening air.
items.ex2_zh: 甜美的花香在温暖宁静的晚风中缓缓弥漫散开。

items.def_en: to issue, proceed, or flow out from a source into the surrounding space
items.ex_en: A distinctive sense of calm seemed to emanate directly from the elderly meditation master.
items.ex_zh: 一种独特的平静安详感似乎直接从这位年长的禅修大师身上流露出来。

items.def_zh: 照射；绽放流露（笑容或光芒）
items.def_en: to transmit light, radio signals, or a broad, radiant emotional expression
items.ex_en: The triumphant championship winner could not help but beam a proud, joyful smile.
items.ex_zh: 凯旋归来的总冠军得主忍不住绽放流露出自豪而喜悦的灿烂笑容。

items.def_zh: 放射，散发；流露；辐射状发出
items.def_en: 1. To emit or send out heat, light, or other energy in rays or waves. 2. To show a particular quality or emotion strongly. 3. To spread out in all directions from a central point.
items.ex_en: The newly installed solar panels radiate considerable thermal energy during peak afternoon hours.
items.ex_zh: 新安装的太阳能电池板在午后高峰时段会散发出大量的热能。

items.def_zh: 散发；充分显露（特质或情绪）
items.def_en: to clearly and abundantly display an aura, quality, or feeling, or slowly discharge liquid
items.ex_en: Throughout the intensive cross-examination, the seasoned diplomat continued to exude effortless composure.
items.ex_zh: 在严厉的交叉盘问中，这位经验丰富的外交官始终流露出从容不迫的沉着。

groups.summary_en: Describes the propagation outward of energy, light, heat, or intangible personal qualities from a central source. These verbs emphasize waves or streams spreading into the surrounding environment.
groups.summary_zh: 指能量、光热或气质情感从中心源头向外散发与弥漫。
groups.desc_en: To send forth an intangible atmospheric quality, aura, or subtle physical vapor outward into the surrounding environment, contrasting with deliberate injection.
groups.desc_zh: 从本体向周遭环境自发弥散、发散出某种无形气场、特质或幽微气体，区别于刻意的主动注入。
groups.nuance_en: emanate: originate and flow perceptibly from a recognizable source (fragrance / warmth / confidence) · exude: oozingly display an abundant, palpable aura or emotion (confidence / charm / malice) · diffuse: disperse widely and softly to permeate a medium (aroma / light / influence) · radiate: powerfully transmit a visible or felt aura from one's presence (joy / health / power) · beam: project an unmistakable aura of luminous happiness (smile / satisfaction / pride)
groups.nuance_zh: emanate: 某种特质或气味从源头处袅袅升起并被感知 (fragrance / warmth / confidence) · exude: 浑身上下自然流露、充盈散发出某种强烈神态 (confidence / charm / malice) · diffuse: 广泛柔和地向四周扩散渗透 (aroma / light / influence) · radiate: 自身如发热体般向外强烈辐射感染力 (joy / health / power) · beam: 容光焕发地洋溢出掩饰不住的喜悦自豪 (smile / satisfaction / pride)

groups.name: Rake & Sweep · 耙拢与刮取 (Scrape up, Scavenge, Comb)
groups.tip: 将分散之物归拢聚集

items.def_en: To gather together loose leaves, soil, or debris using a rake
items.ex_en: Every autumn, the groundskeeper has to rake up dry leaves across the courtyard.
items.ex_zh: 每年秋天，场地管理员都必须把院子各处的落叶用耙子聚拢起来。

items.def_en: To earn or gather very large amounts of money easily or quickly
items.ex_en: The summer blockbuster is expected to rake in millions during its opening weekend.
items.ex_zh: 这部暑期大片预计在首映周末就能大笔狂揽数百万美元。

items.def_en: To manage to gather just enough money, resources, or people with considerable difficulty
items.ex_en: We barely managed to scrape together enough money to pay the apartment deposit.
items.ex_zh: 我们好不容易才东拼西凑凑够了付公寓押金的钱。

items.def_en: To search a place thoroughly and systematically to find or gather something
items.ex_en: Rescue teams continue to comb the dense forest for any sign of survivors.
items.ex_zh: 救援队继续彻底搜查茂密的森林，寻找幸存者的任何蛛丝马迹。

items.def_zh: （用耙子）耙平，拢聚；扫视，快速浏览；大量赚取（与in连用）
items.def_en: 1. (+ up/together) To pull, gather, or smooth materials with a rake. 2. To sweep or search rapidly across an area. 3. (rake in) To earn or gather a large amount of money easily.
items.ex_en: The gardener used a wooden tool to rake the gravel along the path.
items.ex_zh: 园丁用一把木制工具将小径旁的碎石耙平整。

items.def_en: To search through discarded waste or wild areas to collect useful items or food
items.ex_en: Stray dogs often scavenge for discarded food scraps around the open-air market stalls.
items.ex_zh: 流浪狗经常在露天市场的货摊周围搜寻遗弃的残羹剩饭。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame emphasize sweeping, scraping, or raking surfaces to extract, clear, or gather scattered items, often involving physical implements or sweeping searching motions.
groups.summary_zh: 指用工具或类似扫拂、刮梳的动作拢集散物或刮搜财物。
groups.desc_en: To draw a tool across a wide area or scrounge persistently across terrain to gather scattered valuables, remnants, or debris, contrasting with singular picking.
groups.desc_zh: 用工具在广阔表面上刮扫拖拽，或通过多方搜罗将分散各处的残羹、钱财或线索敛聚起来，区别于单点拾取。
groups.nuance_en: rake: scrape leaves or soil uniformly using a tined tool (leaves / lawn / gravel) · rake in: amass large sums of money or profit effortlessly (millions / cash / winnings) · scrape together: struggle to assemble barely sufficient resources from sparse origins (funds / pennies / team) · comb: search every inch of a terrain with dense, fine-grained thoroughness (area / archives / hair) · scavenge: rummage through discarded waste for salvageable scraps (food / scrap / bins)
groups.nuance_zh: rake: 用齿耙梳理或聚拢地表的落叶杂草 (leaves / lawn / gravel) · rake in: 像耙拢财宝般大把大把敛取巨额财富 (millions / cash / winnings) · scrape together: 东拼西凑、好不容易才艰难筹措齐备 (funds / pennies / team) · comb: 如密齿梳理般地毯式彻底搜寻梳理 (area / archives / hair) · scavenge: 在废品堆或残羹冷炙中寻觅可回收残余物资 (food / scrap / bins)

groups.name: Realize & Materialize · 实现与具象化 (Materialize, Fulfill, Bring to fruition)
groups.tip: 将设想转化为现实结果

items.def_en: To cause something to happen or be achieved
items.ex_en: The widespread adoption of AI is likely to bring about major changes in the job market.
items.ex_zh: 人工智能的广泛应用可能会给就业市场带来重大变革。

items.def_en: To bring about, accomplish, or put into effect
items.ex_en: The executive committee enacted stringent measures to effectuate immediate organizational and structural changes.
items.ex_zh: 执行委员会颁布了严厉的措施，以促成即时的组织和结构变革。

items.def_zh: 使取得成果；使完全实现
items.def_en: To cause a plan, project, or process to achieve successful and full realization
items.ex_en: Years of collaborative research finally brought the ambitious renewable energy initiative to fruition.
items.ex_zh: 多年的合作研究终于使这项雄心勃勃的可再生能源倡议取得了成果。

items.def_en: To make a dream, promise, hope, or prophecy become reality
items.ex_en: The scholar worked tirelessly to fulfill his lifelong ambition of publishing the definitive text.
items.ex_zh: 这位学者孜孜不倦地工作，以实现他出版权威著作的毕生抱负。

items.def_en: To become real or actual, especially after being planned, hoped for, or imagined
items.ex_en: Despite extensive preparations, the expected investments failed to materialize before the fiscal deadline.
items.ex_zh: 尽管做了大量准备，预期的投资在财年截止前仍未能落实到位。

items.def_zh: 使……成为现实，实现；使现实化
items.def_en: To make something real or bring it into concrete existence; to fulfill potential or plans.
items.ex_en: Mentorship programs help young artists actualize their creative potential within competitive professional environments.
items.ex_zh: 导师项目帮助年轻艺术家在竞争激烈的专业环境中充分实现其创作潜能。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here signify translating concepts, ambitions, or potentials from an abstract, latent state into concrete, tangible reality.
groups.summary_zh: 将潜能、规划或设想转化为真实存在与现实成果。
groups.desc_en: Denotes translating an abstract concept, intention, or latent potential into concrete, physical reality, contrasting with mere wishing or planning by emphasizing tangible execution.
groups.desc_zh: 指将抽象的概念、意图或潜在可能转化为切实的具象现实，强调实际落地而非空想或规划。
groups.nuance_en: materialize: emerge into perceptible physical reality (hopes / threats / opportunity) · fulfill: satisfy a pledge, duty, or condition (promise / obligation / destiny) · bring to fruition: mature a project through sustained effort (plans / vision / scheme) · actualize: develop inherent potential into reality (potential / ambitions / self) · effectuate: formally or legally execute an outcome (change / policy / transaction)
groups.nuance_zh: materialize: 具象化显现或成真 (hopes / threats / opportunity) · fulfill: 履行承诺或契合天命预期 (promise / obligation / destiny) · bring to fruition: 历经持续耕耘促成结果落地 (plans / vision / scheme) · actualize: 将内在潜能充分变现 (potential / ambitions / self) · effectuate: 通过法律或行政手段落实产生效力 (change / policy / transaction)

groups.name: Rearrange & Shift Schedule · 调整日程与延期 (Postpone, Defer, Move)
groups.tip: 重新调整日程并统筹安排

items.def_en: Delay or postpone an arranged meeting or duty until a later time
items.ex_en: We had to put off our weekly team review until next Monday afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 我们不得不把每周的团队复盘推迟到下周一下午。

items.def_en: Postpone or delay a deadline, start time, or planned event
items.ex_en: Management decided to push back the project launch date by another three weeks.
items.ex_zh: 管理层决定将项目上线日期顺延三周。

items.def_en: Move an appointment, event, or deadline to an earlier date or time
items.ex_en: The chairperson requested to bring forward the annual symposium to early September.
items.ex_zh: 主席提议将年度研讨会提前至九月上旬举行。

items.def_en: Arrange for an event or action to take place at a later time than originally scheduled
items.ex_en: Bad weather forced the organizers to postpone the outdoor championship until next month.
items.ex_zh: 恶劣的天气迫使组织者将室外锦标赛推迟到下个月。

items.def_en: Put off an action, decision, or payment to a future date deliberately
items.ex_en: The administrative board elected to defer its final determination pending further environmental assessments.
items.ex_zh: 管理委员会决定推迟作出最终决议，等待进一步的环境评估。

items.def_zh: 重新安排（日程、时间）；重新调整（还债计划等）
items.def_en: 1. To change the date, time, or schedule of an event or appointment. 2. To agree on a new plan for repaying a debt.
items.ex_en: Please contact the clinic promptly if you need to reschedule your dental appointment.
items.ex_zh: 如果您需要重新安排看牙预约，请及时联系诊所。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on altering the prearranged calendar time or sequencing of an event, appointment, or obligation. Nuances contrast delaying, advancing forward, and comprehensively reorganizing a timetable.
groups.summary_zh: 指更改既定活动、预约或义务的时间与进度安排，涵盖推迟、提前与重编日程。
groups.desc_en: Denotes altering a committed temporal arrangement by shifting an event forward or backward in time, contrasting with outright cancellation or static scheduling.
groups.desc_zh: 指对既定时间线进行前移或后延的动态重调，不同于彻底取消或初始排期。
groups.nuance_en: postpone: formally delay until a later definite or indefinite time (meeting / trial / departure) · defer: yield or delay action in deference to judgment or a future trigger (decision / payment / taxes) · put off: informally procrastinate or push back an unpleasant task (confrontation / visit / chores) · bring forward: shift to an earlier date or time (deadline / hearing / election) · reschedule: assign a new time slot to an appointment (flight / interview / appointment)
groups.nuance_zh: postpone: 正式推迟至未来某时 (meeting / trial / departure) · defer: 遵从审慎考量或顺延触发而延期 (decision / payment / taxes) · put off: 非正式拖延或避开难办之事 (confrontation / visit / chores) · bring forward: 提前安排日程 (deadline / hearing / election) · reschedule: 重新改定具体时间段 (flight / interview / appointment)

groups.name: Reassert, Reiterate & Emphasize · 重申与强化强调 (Reiterate, Reaffirm, Belabor)
groups.tip: 再度提起以加深印象或强调

items.def_en: To state an idea, objective, or position a second time, usually using distinct terms for clarity
items.ex_en: The ambassador took care to restate the administration's official policy in unambiguous terms.
items.ex_zh: 大使特意用明确的措辞重新陈述了本届政府的官方政策。

items.def_en: 1. To say, state, or perform something again, especially for clarity or emphasis.
items.ex_en: The instructor asked the student to repeat the sentence clearly for the class.
items.ex_zh: 讲师让那名学生把句子清晰地重复一遍给全班听。

items.def_zh: 重申，反复讲（以引起重视）
items.def_en: To say something again or several times in order to make the meaning unmistakable
items.ex_en: The director wished to reiterate that company confidentiality rules apply to all employees.
items.ex_zh: 总监希望重申，公司的保密规定适用于全体员工。

items.def_zh: 反复敲黑板强调；透彻灌输
items.def_en: To state a fact or point with forceful repetition so that listeners fully grasp or accept it
items.ex_en: The presenter used vivid charts to hammer home the risks of delayed action.
items.ex_zh: 演讲者用生动的图表反复强调拖延行动所带来的巨大风险。

items.def_zh: 重申；再次确认（信念、承诺）
items.def_en: To formally state again that something is true, or declare renewed support for an allegiance or policy
items.ex_en: Both nations signed the treaty to reaffirm their enduring commitment to regional peace.
items.ex_zh: 两国签署了该条约，以重申其对区域和平的坚定承诺。

items.def_zh: 过分强调；喋喋不休地谈论
items.def_en: To explain, discuss, or worry about an argument more than is necessary or polite
items.ex_en: There is no need to belabor an obvious point that everyone already understands.
items.ex_zh: 没有必要喋喋不休地强调一个大家都已经明白的显而易见的事实。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this communicative frame describe affirming, asserting, or declaring a statement, stance, or point multiple times to ensure clarity, absolute certainty, or persistent emphasis. Nuances range from resolute diplomatic reaffirmation to tedious over-arguing.
groups.summary_zh: 旨在通过再次陈述或多次强调，使立场、观点或警告更加明确坚决。
groups.desc_en: Denotes stating a proposition again with renewed or escalating force to ensure comprehension or compliance, contrasting with initial assertion or neutral restatement.
groups.desc_zh: 指以加重或强化的口吻反复申明既有立场以确保贯彻或领悟，不同于初次宣称或中立复述。
groups.nuance_en: reiterate: restate firmly for clarity and emphasis (demand / commitment / stance) · reaffirm: reassert confidence, validity, or formal allegiance (faith / pledge / support) · hammer home: enforce an idea forcefully through blunt repetition (point / message / lesson) · belabor: dwell on or repeat tiresomely beyond necessity (point / obvious / argument) · restate: state again in the same or clearer terms (case / position / terms)
groups.nuance_zh: reiterate: 为明晰立论而郑重重申 (demand / commitment / stance) · reaffirm: 重新确证其有效性或信念誓约 (faith / pledge / support) · hammer home: 强力反复灌输直至彻底领会 (point / message / lesson) · belabor: 喋喋不休过度强调已知事实 (point / obvious / argument) · restate: 用更清晰语词重新表述原意 (case / position / terms)

groups.name: Rebut & Refute · 正式辩驳与论驳 (Refute, Repudiate, Confute)
groups.tip: 提供反证强力驳斥，严密推翻对方论点

items.def_zh: 将（论点）批驳得体无完肤
items.def_en: To systematically criticize and expose every fatal flaw in an argument.
items.ex_en: The civil war threatens to tear the entire country apart.
items.ex_zh: 内战有让整个国家分崩离析的危险。

items.def_zh: 破坏……的可信度，使不可信
items.def_en: To destroy confidence in or demonstrate the untruth of an assertion or witness.
items.ex_en: The newly discovered laboratory logs completely discredit the fraudulent findings of the study.
items.ex_zh: 新发现的实验室记录彻底打破了该研究所宣称结果的可信度。

items.def_en: To prove that an argument, statement, or accusation is entirely false using evidence.
items.ex_en: The defense attorney presented solid surveillance footage to refute the prosecutor's central claim.
items.ex_zh: 辩方律师出示了确凿的监控录像，以驳斥检察官的核心主张。

items.def_en: To reject the authority or truth of a claim, accusation, or doctrine with solemn finality.
items.ex_en: The spokesperson issued a formal statement to repudiate the baseless allegations of corruption.
items.ex_zh: 发言人发表正式声明，断然否认了毫无事实根据的腐败指控。

items.def_zh: 反驳，辩驳，驳斥（用证据或论据证明其错误）
items.def_en: To prove that a statement, accusation, or argument is false, using evidence or counterarguments.
items.ex_en: The economist published empirical data to rebut the misleading claims made by critics.
items.ex_zh: 该经济学家公布了实证数据，以反驳批评人士提出的误导性言论。

items.def_en: To conclusively prove a person or their argument to be in error.
items.ex_en: No serious scholar could confute the rigorous mathematical proof established by the mathematician.
items.ex_zh: 没有一位严肃的学者能够驳倒这位数学家所确立的严谨数学证明。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this formal rhetorical frame refer to presenting structured arguments, facts, or testimony to legally or intellectually overthrow an opponent's claims.
groups.summary_zh: 在正式辩论或司法中，举证反驳控诉、推翻对方论据的严谨论辩。
groups.desc_en: Denotes formally confronting, disproving, or nullifying an opposing argument, charge, or theory through evidence and logic, contrasting with vague denial or passive disbelief.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过论据与严密逻辑正式击溃、反驳对立方的指控或论点，不同于消极否认或单纯质疑。
groups.nuance_en: rebut: counter an argument or allegation in formal debate or law (allegation / charge / presumption) · refute: conclusively prove an assertion or thesis to be false (claim / hypothesis / accusation) · repudiate: formally reject the validity or authority of an assertion (doctrine / treaty / statement) · confute: overwhelm an opponent's thesis by exposing fatal contradictions (fallacy / opponent / doctrine) · tear apart: aggressively dismantle a weak argument or testimony (testimony / theory / defense)
groups.nuance_zh: rebut: 在法庭或辩论中针对性提出反驳 (allegation / charge / presumption) · refute: 以确凿证据证伪对方论断 (claim / hypothesis / accusation) · repudiate: 正式拒斥或拒不认同某观点 (doctrine / treaty / statement) · confute: 抓住逻辑自相矛盾处驳倒对方 (fallacy / opponent / doctrine) · tear apart: 猛烈撕碎摧毁破绽百出的论述 (testimony / theory / defense)

groups.name: Recharge & Replenish · 恢复精力与重蓄能量 (Replenish, Rest, Regain)
groups.tip: 注入充沛能量，重拾饱满活力

items.def_en: To gradually rest and relax after a period of intense exertion
items.ex_en: After finishing the demanding project, we took a quiet weekend to wind down.
items.ex_zh: 在完成繁重的项目后，我们度过了一个安静的周末来好好歇息放松。
items.ex2_en: The government plans to wind down the emergency financial subsidy program by December.
items.ex2_zh: 政府计划在十二月前逐步停止这项紧急财政补贴计划。

items.def_zh: （使）恢复体力，重振旗鼓；给（电池）充电
items.def_en: 1. To regain physical energy, strength, or enthusiasm by resting. 2. To restore electrical energy to a rechargeable battery or device.
items.ex_en: A peaceful walk along the beach helped the overworked designer recharge his mind.
items.ex_zh: 海滩边的漫步帮助这位过度劳累的设计师重新恢复了精力。

items.def_en: To restore a depleted supply, energy level, or bodily reserve to fullness
items.ex_en: The medical team administered intravenous fluids to replenish the patient's depleted hydration levels.
items.ex_zh: 医疗团队通过静脉注射补充液体，以恢复患者耗竭的水分储备。

items.def_en: To pause, rest, and reorganize one's efforts or mental focus before continuing
items.ex_en: The sales team needed to pause, regroup, and devise a better pitching strategy.
items.ex_zh: 销售团队需要暂停下来、重整旗鼓，并制定出一套更有效的推介策略。

items.def_en: To relax and stop feeling nervous or tired after hard work
items.ex_en: I like to listen to soothing classical music to unwind after long shifts.
items.ex_zh: 在长时间轮班后，我喜欢听舒缓的古典音乐来放松身心。
items.ex2_en: A cup of warm chamomile tea will help unwind your tense mind after work.
items.ex2_zh: 下班后喝一杯温热的洋甘菊茶有助于放松你紧绷的心神。

items.def_en: To regain energy, strength, or good health after exhaustion or illness
items.ex_en: The surgeon advised the patient to rest at home and recuperate for several weeks.
items.ex_zh: 外科医生建议患者在家休息并调养数周以恢复健康。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to restoring depleted physical stamina, mental energy, or internal reserves through rest, nourishment, or quiet intervals.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过休息、补给或休整来恢复消耗的体能、精力或储备活力。
groups.desc_en: Denotes disengaging from stress to restore depleted physical, mental, or material reserves, contrasting with routine idle passivity or pure medical healing.
groups.desc_zh: 指脱离消耗状态以休整并恢复枯竭的身心能量或储备，不同于无目的闲散或纯病理治疗。
groups.nuance_en: recharge: replenish inner stamina, energy, or enthusiasm (batteries / mind / batteries metaphor) · unwind: release accumulated tension and stress gradually (after work / nerves / tension) · replenish: restore physical supplies, fluids, or stocks to a full state (stocks / reserves / fluids) · recuperate: regain strength, health, or financial footing after loss (from illness / losses / strength) · regroup: reorganize and collect oneself after a setback (forces / thoughts / energy)
groups.nuance_zh: recharge: 恢复精神动力与内在高阶精力 (batteries / mind / batteries metaphor) · unwind: 逐步松弛释放蓄积的压力 (after work / nerves / tension) · replenish: 补给消耗殆尽的物质库存或水分 (stocks / reserves / fluids) · recuperate: 在病痛损耗后修养恢复体元 (from illness / losses / strength) · regroup: 受挫后重整旗鼓平复心绪 (forces / thoughts / energy)

groups.name: Reconcile & Integrate Differences · 调和与折中 (Reconcile, Integrate, Align)
groups.tip: 消除分歧冲突使各部分和谐一致

items.def_en: (+ into/with) To merge separate parts or disparate components into an effective, coherent whole
items.ex_en: The company intends to integrate innovative software solutions into its existing operational workflow.
items.ex_zh: 该公司打算将创新的软件解决方案整合到其现有的运营流程中。
items.ex2_en: The two corporate departments integrated smoothly over the course of the following year.
items.ex2_zh: 在接下来的一年里，这两个公司部门顺利地整合在了一起。

items.def_en: To resolve minor disputes, inconsistencies, or friction through mutual adjustments
items.ex_en: Both project managers met this afternoon to iron out the remaining contractual details.
items.ex_zh: 两位项目经理今天下午碰头，解决了剩余的合同细节分歧。

items.def_zh: 对齐；使成一线；使结盟/一致
items.def_en: (+ with) To arrange into correct relative position, or bring policies and objectives into line
items.ex_en: The marketing team worked diligently to align their outreach campaign with brand values.
items.ex_zh: 营销团队勤勉工作，使其推广活动与品牌核心价值保持一致。
items.ex2_en: The new organizational strategies aligned neatly with our original corporate vision.
items.ex2_zh: 新的组织战略与我们最初的企业愿景紧密吻合。

items.def_en: (+ with) To find an acceptable way to balance two contrasting ideas, systems, or hostile parties
items.ex_en: It proved remarkably difficult to reconcile the conflicting accounts given by different witnesses.
items.ex_zh: 事实证明，要调和不同证人提供的相互矛盾的陈述极其困难。

items.def_zh: 使协调，使一致；协调，相符；唱和声，用和声伴奏
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To combine, blend, or make different things fit together in an agreeable, pleasing, or consistent way. 2. (music) To sing or play musical notes that combine pleasingly.
items.ex_en: The regional council seeks to harmonize commercial building codes across all member states.
items.ex_zh: 地区委员会力求使所有成员国之间的商业建筑规范协调一致。
items.ex2_en: The traditional stone walls harmonize beautifully with the modern glass facade of the museum.
items.ex2_zh: 传统的石墙与博物馆现代化的玻璃外墙相得益彰。

items.def_en: (+ with/into) To fit together seamlessly and logically like interlocking joints
items.ex_en: The new environmental policies dovetail perfectly with the company's broader sustainability goals.
items.ex_zh: 新的环保政策与公司更广泛的可持续发展目标严丝合缝地紧密衔接。
items.ex2_en: The project managers carefully dovetailed both schedules to avoid any costly operational delays.
items.ex2_zh: 项目经理仔细衔接了两份时间表，以避免任何高昂的运营延误。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on active diplomatic, organizational, or conceptual adjustment to eliminate conflicts and bring diverging elements into structural balance. Key collocates include standards, laws, policies, and conflicting accounts.
groups.summary_zh: 强调主动消除差异或分歧，使制度、观点或利益达成一致。
groups.desc_en: Denotes resolving contradictions and aligning disparate components into a unified, workable whole, contrasting with mere compromise or unilateral suppression.
groups.desc_zh: 指化解冲突分歧并将各要素整合成契合协同的整体，不同于单纯妥协让步或强行压制。
groups.nuance_en: reconcile: make compatible two seemingly inconsistent facts or estranged parties (differences / accounts / views) · harmonize: blend diverse elements into pleasing, frictionless concord (standards / interests / voices) · align: adjust strategic parts to point toward a shared objective (interests / strategy / priorities) · dovetail: interlock complementary schedules or ideas smoothly (schedules / plans / pieces) · iron out: eliminate minor remaining difficulties or wrinkles (wrinkles / details / differences)
groups.nuance_zh: reconcile: 调和两立矛盾或平息双方嫌隙 (differences / accounts / views) · harmonize: 使异质要素达致无摩擦的和鸣统一 (standards / interests / voices) · align: 校准多方使之与总目标方向一致 (interests / strategy / priorities) · dovetail: 榫卯般无缝嵌套契合计划安排 (schedules / plans / pieces) · iron out: 熨平扫清残留的微小细节障碍 (wrinkles / details / differences)

groups.name: Record & Inventory · 清点与盘查 (Itemize, Audit, Stocktake)
groups.tip: 逐项盘点登记成册归档

items.def_en: (+ of) To count and record supplies, or carefully assess an overall situation
items.ex_en: The board decided to pause expansion plans and take stock of financial performance.
items.ex_zh: 董事会决定暂停扩张计划，审慎评估公司的整体财务状况。

items.def_en: To inspect and verify official financial records or operational inventories
items.ex_en: External consultants were hired to audit the company's financial ledgers before the merger.
items.ex_zh: 在合并前，外部顾问受聘对公司的财务账目进行全面审计。

items.def_en: To make a complete, detailed list or count of all the goods, property, or equipment in a place.
items.ex_en: The museum staff spent several months carefully inventorying every artifact in the collection.
items.ex_zh: 博物馆工作人员花费数月时间仔细清点并编目了馆藏的每一件文物。

items.def_en: To list, describe, and classify items in an organized index or inventory
items.ex_en: Librarians worked tirelessly to catalogue the rare historical manuscripts in the special collection.
items.ex_zh: 图书管理员孜孜不倦地工作，为特藏室中的珍贵历史手稿编目分类。

items.def_en: To calculate a cumulative total or verify counts item by item
items.ex_en: The election officials worked late into the evening to tally the remaining ballots.
items.ex_zh: 选举官员工作到深夜，以清点并核对剩余的选票数量。
items.ex2_en: Her detailed personal recollection does not quite tally with the official police records.
items.ex2_zh: 她详细的个人回忆与警方的官方记录并不完全相符。

items.def_en: To list all individual items or components in a systematic, detailed fashion
items.ex_en: The detailed invoice failed to itemize the individual costs for labor and materials.
items.ex_zh: 那份详细的发票未能将人工和材料的具体费用逐条列出。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the systematic counting, itemizing, and verification of assets, goods, or resources in an establishment.
groups.summary_zh: 指系统化地逐项清点、核实与列出库存、资产及物资。
groups.desc_en: Denotes systematically inspecting, counting, and categorizing existing assets or conditions to establish exact verification, contrasting with casual counting or continuous narrative recording.
groups.desc_zh: 指对存量资产或现状进行系统性清点、核查与分类确权，不同于随性计数或流水账式记录。
groups.nuance_en: inventory: list and evaluate all tangible stock or assets methodically (assets / stock / supplies) · itemize: specify every component individually with exact values (deductions / expenses / bill) · audit: formally scrutinize records and assets for legal accuracy (books / accounts / compliance) · take stock: pause to comprehensively assess a situation or resource state (situation / assets / lives) · tally: continuously count and record numbers to keep score or total (votes / losses / scores)
groups.nuance_zh: inventory: 系统盘点造册全部实物资产 (assets / stock / supplies) · itemize: 逐一分项列明清单明细及价值 (deductions / expenses / bill) · audit: 依规审计核查账目与资产真实性 (books / accounts / compliance) · take stock: 停下步调全面检视态势与家底 (situation / assets / lives) · tally: 连续点算并累计积分或票数 (votes / losses / scores)

groups.name: Record & Log · 记载与日志记录 (Document, Chronicle, Minutes)
groups.tip: 把事实或数据登入日志存档

items.def_en: To record the details of an event or process in writing, photos, or other evidence
items.ex_en: The investigative journalist traveled abroad to document human rights violations in the region.
items.ex_zh: 调查记者前往海外，以纪实文献的形式记录该地区的人权侵害事件。

items.def_en: 1. To make an official record of events, facts, or measurements in a logbook or database. 2. To cut down trees for wood.
items.ex_en: The flight crew must log all instrument readings at regular intervals during flight.
items.ex_zh: 机组人员在飞行过程中必须定期将所有仪表读数记录在飞行日志中。

items.def_en: To make an official written record of proceedings and decisions taken at a meeting
items.ex_en: The corporate secretary carefully minuted every formal resolution passed during the annual meeting.
items.ex_zh: 公司秘书仔细地将年会上通过的每一项正式决议记入会议纪要。

items.def_en: To write down a piece of information quickly on paper
items.ex_en: Let me grab a pen so I can jot down your phone number.
items.ex_zh: 我去拿支笔，好把你的电话号码草草记下来。

items.def_en: To write down useful details so as not to forget them
items.ex_en: Please note down the key points covered in today's seminar.
items.ex_zh: 请把今天研讨会讲到的要点记下来。

items.def_en: To record a detailed, continuous series of historic or notable events
items.ex_en: The historian dedicated three volumes to chronicle the profound rise of industrial civilization.
items.ex_zh: 这位历史学家倾注了三卷著作，详细编年记载了工业文明的深刻兴起。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe entering sequential events, technical observations, or administrative transactions into chronological logs or permanent written records.
groups.summary_zh: 指按时间顺序将事件、数据或交涉事实载入正式日志与档案。
groups.desc_en: Denotes capturing information in a permanent written, audio, or visual record to preserve history or provide official evidence, contrasting with fleeting mental recall.
groups.desc_zh: 指将信息以书面、音视频等载体固化存底以备考据或法律佐证，不同于短暂的心智记忆。
groups.nuance_en: document: furnish written or evidentiary proof of events or facts (case / history / human rights abuses) · log: record occurrences systematically in chronological sequence (hours / flights / calls) · chronicle: narrate historical events in rich chronological detail (rise / era / struggle) · minute: record proceedings formally in an official meeting register (meeting / resolution / proceedings) · note down: quickly capture a fleeting fact or instruction for immediate use (address / thoughts / details)
groups.nuance_zh: document: 出具文件或留存详实证据证明实况 (case / history / human rights abuses) · log: 按时序流水严格登记航次工时 (hours / flights / calls) · chronicle: 编年史式详细撰述时代变迁 (rise / era / struggle) · minute: 正式采写会议决议与纪要 (meeting / resolution / proceedings) · note down: 随手速记转瞬即逝的要点或信息 (address / thoughts / details)

groups.name: Record & Register · 登记与建档 (Enrol, Enter, Matriculate)
groups.tip: 按章程登记造册留下凭证

items.def_en: To write or input vital data or a participant's name into a register or database
items.ex_en: The clerk will enter your personal details directly into the municipal registry database.
items.ex_zh: 办事员会将您的个人信息直接录入市政登记数据库中。

items.def_zh: 登记，注册；挂号；记录，显示
items.def_en: 1. To record someone's or something's name on an official list. 2. To send mail by paying an extra fee for tracking and security. 3. To show or indicate an amount or feeling.
items.ex_en: All foreign correspondents must register their official credentials with the ministry upon arrival.
items.ex_zh: 所有外国记者抵境后均须在部门正式登记其官方证件。

items.def_en: (+ in/on) To formally enter someone into the official roll or membership of an institution
items.ex_en: Prospective applicants must enrol in the introductory coursework prior to the fall semester.
items.ex_zh: 意向申请人必须在秋季学期开始前正式登记修读入门课程。

items.def_en: To register one's name formally for an activity, organization, or commitment
items.ex_en: Hundreds of enthusiastic residents decided to sign up for the community cleanup initiative.
items.ex_zh: 数百名热心的居民决定报名参加社区环境清洁活动。
items.ex2_en: The fitness coach managed to sign up twenty new members this weekend.
items.ex2_zh: 健身教练这个周末成功给二十位新会员办理了报名。

items.def_en: To register one's arrival formally at a hotel, airport desk, or appointment
items.ex_en: Passengers are advised to check in at least two hours prior to departure.
items.ex_zh: 建议乘客至少在起飞前两小时办理登机手续。

items.def_zh: 录取入学；注册为大学生
items.def_en: To register formally as a student entering a university or degree course
items.ex_en: Over one thousand undergraduate scholars will matriculate at the university this coming autumn.
items.ex_zh: 今年秋季，将有一千多名本科生正式注册入学该大学。
items.ex2_en: The prestigious academy will matriculate five hundred international students during the upcoming semester.
items.ex2_zh: 这所著名学府将在即将到来的学期录取五百名国际留学生。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to officially recording names, identities, or vital data into an institutional ledger, roll, or database.
groups.summary_zh: 指将人名、文件或官方资格正式录入名册、档案或系统。
groups.desc_en: Denotes officially inscribing an individual or entity into an institutional roll or database to grant recognized status, contrasting with anonymous entry or private record-keeping.
groups.desc_zh: 指将人或实体正式录入机构名册或系统以赋予法定身份与资格，不同于匿名准入或私下备忘。
groups.nuance_en: register: record officially in an authorized directory for legal validity (voters / vehicle / trademark) · enrol: officially admit into a course, school, or formal membership (students / recruits / courses) · enter: insert data formally into a record book or contest (contest / race / database) · matriculate: formally register as an academic student at a university (university / college / freshman) · check in: announce arrival and register presence at a facility (hotel / airport / desk)
groups.nuance_zh: register: 在官方主管部门登记以确立合法资质 (voters / vehicle / trademark) · enrol: 正式吸纳录入成为学员或机构成员 (students / recruits / courses) · enter: 将姓名数据填入名册或报名参赛 (contest / race / database) · matriculate: 大学学籍正式注资登记 (university / college / freshman) · check in: 抵店抵港办理到场报到手续 (hotel / airport / desk)

groups.name: Recover & Regain · 恢复与复原 (Recuperate, Rally, Bounce Back)
groups.tip: 重回先前的良好状态

items.def_zh: 康复，恢复（健康或常态）；重新获得，找回；挽回（损失）
items.def_en: 1. To return to a normal state of health, strength, or functioning. 2. To regain possession or control of something lost or stolen.
items.ex_en: It took the patient several weeks of therapy to fully recover from surgery.
items.ex_zh: 这位病人在接受数周治疗后才完全从手术中康复过来。

items.def_en: To revive or recover strength, confidence, or value after a decline
items.ex_en: Global equity markets began to rally following the central bank's surprise rate cut.
items.ex_zh: 在央行意外宣布降息之后，全球股票市场开始止跌回升。
items.ex2_en: The charismatic coach gave a passionate speech to rally the disheartened players.
items.ex2_zh: 这位富有魅力的教练发表了慷慨激昂的演讲，以重振灰心丧气的队员们。

items.def_en: To quickly recover from adversity, illness, or a setback
items.ex_en: Resilient businesses often bounce back quickly even after severe regional economic downturns.
items.ex_zh: 即使经历严重的区域经济衰退，具有韧性的企业通常也能迅速恢复元气。

items.def_en: To recover or bounce back after an economic slump, defeat, or illness
items.ex_en: Economists predict manufacturing output will rebound sharply during the upcoming fourth fiscal quarter.
items.ex_zh: 经济学家预测制造业产出将在即将到来的第四财季强劲反弹。

items.def_en: To obtain possession or use of an ability, condition, or position again after losing it
items.ex_en: The injured athlete worked diligently for months to regain full mobility in his knee.
items.ex_zh: 这名受伤的运动员刻苦训练了数月，以重新恢复膝关节的全部活动能力。

items.def_en: To recover from illness, exertion, or financial losses over time
items.ex_en: The exhausted diplomat retreated to a secluded country estate to quietly recuperate.
items.ex_zh: 心力交瘁的外交官退隐到一座幽静的乡村庄园，以静心休养恢复体力。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on returning to a baseline state of physical health, psychological balance, financial stability, or control after illness, shock, or loss. Verbs emphasize the restorative process or the resilience shown during an upturn.
groups.summary_zh: 从伤病、打击或劣势中重新恢复健康、力量或常态。
groups.desc_en: Denotes bouncing back from depletion, disease, financial loss, or adversity to regain a prior healthy or functional equilibrium, contrasting with original growth or unhampered thriving.
groups.desc_zh: 指自虚损、疾病、亏损或困境中逆转重振以重回元气平衡，不同于从零成长或顺境繁荣。
groups.nuance_en: recover: return to a normal state of health, strength, or control (from illness / losses / poise) · regain: reacquire a specific attribute, power, or territory previously lost (consciousness / control / lead) · rebound: bounce back briskly after hitting a sharp low point (economy / market / price) · rally: revive sharply through collective or internal energy after weakness (stocks / troops / patient) · bounce back: exhibit resilient psychological or systemic recovery (from defeat / adversity / injury)
groups.nuance_zh: recover: 普遍恢复原有的健康、力量或状态 (from illness / losses / poise) · regain: 重新夺回丧失的意识、掌控权或领地 (consciousness / control / lead) · rebound: 触底后强劲反弹回升 (economy / market / price) · rally: 跌势中集聚力量掀起止跌回升 (stocks / troops / patient) · bounce back: 展现韧性迅速从挫折伤痛中自愈 (from defeat / adversity / injury)

groups.name: Recruit & Headhunt · 人才招揽与聘录 (Recruit, Headhunt, Scout)
groups.tip: 征召吸纳新成员入队

items.def_en: To give someone a job in exchange for wages or salary
items.ex_en: The expanding technology firm plans to hire fifty skilled software engineers this year.
items.ex_zh: 这家不断扩张的科技公司计划今年录用五十名熟练的软件工程师。

items.def_zh: 招募，吸收（新成员）；征募（新兵）
items.def_en: To enlist or enroll someone as a new member, employee, or soldier in an organization or the armed forces.
items.ex_en: The military academy launched an aggressive campaign to recruit top graduates across the country.
items.ex_zh: 军事学院发起了一场声势浩大的宣传活动，在全国范围内招募优秀毕业生。

items.def_en: To search for talented individuals, especially in sports, entertainment, or specialized business roles
items.ex_en: Talent agents regularly scout premier college tournaments to discover promising young basketball players.
items.ex_zh: 星探们定期到顶级大学联赛中物色有前途的年轻篮球选手。

items.def_en: To actively seek out and approach an experienced person to persuade them to leave their current job for another
items.ex_en: A rival agency tried to headhunt our senior designer with an enormous signing bonus.
items.ex_zh: 一家竞争对手试图用巨额签约奖金挖走我们的资深设计师。

items.def_en: To integrate and train a newly hired employee or member into an organization
items.ex_en: The human resources division will formally onboard thirty engineering specialists next Monday morning.
items.ex_zh: 人力资源部将于下周一上午正式为三十位工程专家办理入职培训。

items.def_en: To persuade someone to leave an opponent's or competitor's organization to join one's own
items.ex_en: Tech giants frequently poach talented software architects from start-ups by offering doubled salaries.
items.ex_zh: 科技巨头经常通过开出双倍薪水从初创公司挖走才华横溢的软件架构师。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on identifying, attracting, and onboarding fresh talent or members into companies, athletic programs, and professional organizations. Nuances range from standard hiring pipelines to aggressive talent-scouting.
groups.summary_zh: 聚焦为企事业单位或团队物色、招募与吸收新成员，涵盖招聘与猎头挖角。
groups.desc_en: Denotes identifying, attracting, and officially hiring human talent into an organization, contrasting with passive applicant intake or impersonal resource procurement.
groups.desc_zh: 指主动物色、吸纳并录用人才进入组织架构，不同于被动受理求职或非人力物资采购。
groups.nuance_en: hire: engage the services of someone for payment (employees / staff / consultants) · recruit: enlist personnel into an organization or movement en masse (volunteers / members / talent) · scout: proactively seek out raw talent or competitors' prospects (players / models / talent) · headhunt: aggressively target and lure senior executives from elsewhere (CEO / executives / specialists) · poach: illicitly or aggressively hire away talent from a rival firm (talent / staff / workers)
groups.nuance_zh: hire: 劳资对价聘用具体人员 (employees / staff / consultants) · recruit: 体系化征集招募梯队成员或志愿者 (volunteers / members / talent) · scout: 主动潜入一线物色发掘潜力苗子 (players / models / talent) · headhunt: 猎头定点物色锁定高级管理人员 (CEO / executives / specialists) · poach: 不讲武德地从竞对处挖角核心骨干 (talent / staff / workers)

groups.name: Recuse & Withdraw · 回避与退出 (Recuse, Abstain, Stand Aside)
groups.tip: 因利益冲突主动申请回避

items.def_en: To temporarily or permanently leave an official role or step out of an inquiry to avoid conflict of interest
items.ex_en: The committee chairperson decided to step aside during the inquiry into his financial disclosures.
items.ex_zh: 在对其财务披露进行调查期间，委员会主席决定主动回避。

items.def_zh: 退职；退出席位；停止任职
items.def_en: To leave a position of authority, committee, or tribunal, especially temporarily
items.ex_en: The CEO decided to stand down after the company's financial scandal was exposed.
items.ex_zh: 公司财务丑闻曝光后，首席执行官决定引咎辞职。

items.def_en: (+ from) To remove oneself from an official proceeding, contest, negotiation, or position
items.ex_en: The senior diplomat chose to withdraw from negotiations after fundamental disagreements arose.
items.ex_zh: 在产生根本分歧后，这位资深外交官选择退出谈判。
items.ex2_en: The controversial candidate decided to withdraw his nomination before the final primary vote.
items.ex2_zh: 这位饱受争议的候选人决定在最后的初选投票前撤回提名。

items.def_en: To declare someone officially ineligible to participate, judge, or vote in a proceeding due to bias or rule violations
items.ex_en: The appellate judge had to disqualify the juror due to obvious personal bias.
items.ex_zh: 上诉法官因明显的个人偏见而不得不裁定取消该陪审员的资格。

items.def_en: (+ from) To formally choose not to vote or participate in a collective decision-making process
items.ex_en: Two council members decided to abstain from voting on the controversial development project.
items.ex_zh: 两名市议员决定在有争议的开发项目表决中弃权。

items.def_zh: （因利益冲突）主动申请回避，要求（法官等）回避
items.def_en: (recuse oneself) (law) To withdraw from a legal case or position of judgment due to a potential conflict of interest.
items.ex_en: The judge chose to recuse herself because she held shares in the defendant company.
items.ex_zh: 法官选择主动回避，因为她持有被告公司的股份。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate an official, judge, or board member deliberately stepping away from an official duty, vote, or case due to a conflict of interest, bias, or procedural mandate. Nuances range from formal legal self-disqualification to diplomatic or voluntary abstention.
groups.summary_zh: 指因利益冲突或程序规范而主动退出、回避裁决或表决。
groups.desc_en: Denotes stepping aside from a role, decision, or vote to avoid bias, conflict of interest, or compromise, contrasting with involuntary removal or cowardly abandonment.
groups.desc_zh: 指为规避利益冲突、不公嫌疑或秉持公心而主动回避并退出裁决，不同于免职驱逐或怯懦脱逃。
groups.nuance_en: recuse: withdraw oneself formally as a judge or official due to conflict of interest (judge / oneself / official) · step aside: relinquish a position graciously to allow another to take over (leader / minister / rival) · abstain: deliberately refrain from voting or exercising a privilege (from voting / motion / resolution) · stand down: withdraw from an active post, witness stand, or candidacy (candidate / chairman / witness) · withdraw: pull out of a race, commitment, or formal engagement (candidacy / troops / bid)
groups.nuance_zh: recuse: 法官或公职人员因利益回避正式申请离席 (judge / oneself / official) · step aside: 顾全大局礼貌让贤让位 (leader / minister / rival) · abstain: 表决时有意弃权不置可否 (from voting / motion / resolution) · stand down: 从要职、证人席或竞选中退位卸职 (candidate / chairman / witness) · withdraw: 撤回竞标、参选资格或派出的队伍 (candidacy / troops / bid)

groups.name: Recycle & Repurpose · 回收与利用 (Recycle, Salvage, Reclaim)
groups.tip: 物品回收并重新利用

items.def_en: To adapt an object or material for use in a different way or for a new purpose
items.ex_en: The municipality plans to repurpose the abandoned textile factory into affordable creative workspaces.
items.ex_zh: 市政当局计划改造这座废弃纺织厂，将其作为经济实惠的创意办公空间。

items.def_zh: 升级改造；增值改造利用
items.def_en: To reuse discarded objects or materials in such a way as to create a product of higher quality or value than the original
items.ex_en: Local artisans upcycle discarded ocean plastics into durable, high-end designer furniture for collectors.
items.ex_zh: 当地手艺人将废弃的海洋塑料升级改造成供藏家使用的高档耐用设计家具。

items.def_zh: 回收利用，再循环；重新使用（旧概念、材料等）
items.def_en: 1. To treat or process used materials such as paper, glass, or plastic so that they can be used again. 2. To use something again in a different form or context.
items.ex_en: Communities across the province recycle millions of tons of domestic paper each year.
items.ex_zh: 全省各社区每年回收利用数百万吨生活用纸。

items.def_zh: 回收利用；开垦；重新获得
items.def_en: To treat waste products and materials so that they can be used again, or to restore land to cultivation
items.ex_en: The agricultural project successfully reclaimed thousands of hectares of arid land for farming.
items.ex_zh: 该农业项目成功将数千公顷干旱土地开垦复耕。

items.def_zh: 抢救；挽救；从废品中回收
items.def_en: To save goods, damaged machinery, or materials from being destroyed, lost, or wasted
items.ex_en: Workers managed to salvage critical computer equipment from the burning office building overnight.
items.ex_zh: 工人们彻夜努力，从着火的办公楼里抢救出了关键的电脑设备。

items.def_en: To use something again rather than throwing it away
items.ex_en: Eco-friendly cafes actively encourage customers to reuse their ceramic cups for morning coffee.
items.ex_zh: 环保咖啡馆积极鼓励顾客重复使用陶瓷杯来喝早咖啡。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers processes that collect discarded goods, scrap, or waste materials and convert them into reusable products or extract valuable components. Terms vary depending on whether the action involves mechanical reprocessing, creative adaptation, or rescue from destruction.
groups.summary_zh: 指对废弃物、材料或残存部件进行回收、再生与再利用。
groups.desc_en: Denotes reclaiming discarded, spent, or surplus materials and processing them for continued or higher utility, contrasting with raw creation or pure disposal.
groups.desc_zh: 指将废弃或闲置物料回收转化以延续或升级其使用价值，不同于采掘全新原料或直接弃置。
groups.nuance_en: recycle: process used materials through industrial cycles to produce new items (paper / plastic / waste) · repurpose: adapt an object or space for an entirely different function (containers / buildings / content) · upcycle: reuse discarded objects into a product of higher artistic or practical value (materials / furniture / clothes) · salvage: rescue usable value or parts from wreckage or ruins (wreckage / pride / components) · reclaim: recover usable materials from industrial waste or barren land (land / rubber / wastewater)
groups.nuance_zh: recycle: 通过工业降解再造使废料循环利用 (paper / plastic / waste) · repurpose: 改变既有物品或空间功能挪作他用 (containers / buildings / content) · upcycle: 巧思再造使废弃物升值为高档新产品 (materials / furniture / clothes) · salvage: 从残骸毁弃物中抢救抢修有用部件 (wreckage / pride / components) · reclaim: 从工业废弃物或荒地中回收再生资源 (land / rubber / wastewater)

groups.name: Redesign & Overhaul · 重新设计与系统改造 (Redesign, Revamp, Re-engineer)
groups.tip: 重新构想与蓝图规划

items.def_en: To restructure or redesign an organization, technical system, or operation fundamentally
items.ex_en: Consultants helped the logistics company re-engineer its supply chain network to reduce delays.
items.ex_zh: 顾问帮助这家物流公司重构了供应链网络以减少延误。

items.def_en: To rearrange the elements or settings of hardware, software, or an architectural design
items.ex_en: Technicians must reconfigure the central network servers before deploying the massive software update.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员在部署大规模软件更新之前，必须重新配置中心网络服务器。

items.def_en: To thoroughly examine and dismantle a machine or system in order to repair or radically alter it
items.ex_en: The airline decided to completely overhaul the aging fleet to improve passenger safety.
items.ex_zh: 该航空公司决定对老化机队进行彻底检修，以提高乘客安全。

items.def_en: To design a product, building, or system again in an altered or improved way.
items.ex_en: Automakers will redesign the vehicle's interior to provide significantly more legroom for passengers.
items.ex_zh: 汽车制造商将重新设计车辆内部，为乘客提供明显更多的腿部空间。

items.def_en: To change, repair, or improve the appearance or structure of something to make it modern and appealing
items.ex_en: The marketing department hopes to revamp their digital campaign before the summer launch.
items.ex_zh: 市场营销部希望在夏季新品发布前彻底翻新其数字宣传方案。

items.def_en: To change the structural layout, shape, or design of a building, room, or organizational model
items.ex_en: The architects were hired to remodel the historic library into a multimedia center.
items.ex_zh: 建筑师受聘将这座历史悠久的图书馆改造成多媒体中心。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses reimagining, restructuring, and rebuilding existing structures, systems, mechanisms, or products to correct flaws, optimize performance, or adapt to modern requirements.
groups.summary_zh: 指对现有产品、架构或机制进行革新改造与重新设计。
groups.desc_en: Denotes comprehensively dismantling, restructuring, and modernizing an existing system, process, or artifact, contrasting with surface cosmetics or incremental tinkering.
groups.desc_zh: 指对既有系统、流程或构架进行彻底拆解与结构性重构现代化，不同于浅层修补或小幅微调。
groups.nuance_en: overhaul: thoroughly inspect, dismantle, and rebuild a system or engine (engine / tax system / machinery) · re-engineer: fundamentally redesign business processes for drastic performance gains (processes / business / software) · redesign: formulate a new structural or visual design for an existing product (website / curriculum / packaging) · revamp: renovate and restyle an enterprise or facade to boost appeal (brand / strategy / image) · reconfigure: alter the spatial or functional settings of parts without remaking them (network / settings / hardware)
groups.nuance_zh: overhaul: 全面解体检修并重组运转机制 (engine / tax system / machinery) · re-engineer: 根本性重构业务或工程运行范式 (processes / business / software) · redesign: 重新审视构架并重绘结构或外观 (website / curriculum / packaging) · revamp: 翻修刷新外在形象与策略风貌 (brand / strategy / image) · reconfigure: 重新配置既有部件的拓扑或参数参数 (network / settings / hardware)

groups.name: Redound & Contribute · 促成与回报 (Redound, Conduce, Turn Out)
groups.tip: 行为或成就最终反作用于自身名誉

items.def_en: Help to cause, bring about, or increase the likelihood of a certain outcome
items.ex_en: Frequent industrial emissions contribute to worsening air pollution in the metropolitan valley.
items.ex_zh: 频繁的工业排放导致了大都市峡谷地区日益严重的空气污染。

items.def_zh: 有助益于；导致（良好后果）
items.def_en: Help to produce or promote a particular result or condition, especially a desirable one
items.ex_en: A stable macroeconomic environment will always conduce to sustained international trade and investment.
items.ex_zh: 稳定的宏观经济环境总是有助于持续的国际贸易和投资。

items.def_zh: 影响（某人的）评价与声誉
items.def_en: Bring credit or discredit to someone by being associated with their behavior or conduct
items.ex_en: Any inappropriate conduct by officers will reflect unfavorably on the entire police department.
items.ex_zh: 警官的任何不当行为都会对整个警察部门的声誉产生不利影响。

items.def_en: Be received by someone regularly or naturally over time as a direct benefit or advantage
items.ex_en: Substantial financial gains will accrue to patent holders once production begins next quarter.
items.ex_zh: 下季度一旦投入生产，巨额经济收益将自然归于专利持有者。

items.def_zh: 转变为（对某人有利/不利）
items.def_en: Result in a specific advantage, profit, or loss for a person
items.ex_en: The unexpected currency devaluation did not turn to the advantage of domestic exporters.
items.ex_zh: 意料之外的货币贬值并没有转化为对国内出口商有利的局面。

items.def_zh: 对……产生重大影响；增加，使增加（尤指声誉、利益，redound to）
items.def_en: (redound to) (formal) to contribute greatly to someone's credit, honor, advantage, or disadvantage
items.ex_en: Her tireless humanitarian efforts will certainly redound to the lasting honor of our university.
items.ex_zh: 她不知疲倦的人道主义努力必将极大地为我们大学增添持久的光彩。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on actions or circumstances naturally turning out to, culminating in, or yielding distinct credit, advantage, or disadvantage to someone.
groups.summary_zh: 指行为、努力或客观事态最终促成并归结为某种荣誉、声望或利害结果。
groups.desc_en: Denotes actions or qualities flowing back to affect, benefit, or compromise the originating agent or principal, contrasting with neutral causality or outward donation.
groups.desc_zh: 指某项行为或资质反哺、回报或折射到行为主体自身的声誉与利益上，不同于单向奉献或客观因果。
groups.nuance_en: redound: react back favorably or unfavorably upon one's reputation (to one's credit / benefit / honor) · conduce to: lead directly as an instrumental factor toward a favorable state (harmony / peace / success) · contribute to: play a partial role among other factors in causing a result (success / inflation / decline) · accrue to: accumulate naturally or legally over time as a benefit or interest (benefits / interest / advantages) · reflect on: cast credit, discredit, or a certain impression upon someone (character / honor / professionalism)
groups.nuance_zh: redound: 最终归结反哺于自身的声誉或利益 (to one's credit / benefit / honor) · conduce to: 极其有益于促成某种特定良性结果 (harmony / peace / success) · contribute to: 作为促成因素之一助推结果产生 (success / inflation / decline) · accrue to: 随时间推移合法孳生并归属于某方 (benefits / interest / advantages) · reflect on: 投射印证并影响外界对人品的评价 (character / honor / professionalism)

groups.name: Reestablish & Reinstate · 重建与恢复 (Restore, Reconstitute, Reinstitute)
groups.tip: 重新建立体制或恢复秩序

items.def_en: To bring back a previous condition, practice, or relationship of order and peace
items.ex_en: Diplomats worked tirelessly to restore peaceful relations between the two neighboring sovereign nations.
items.ex_zh: 外交官们不知疲倦地工作，以恢复这两个邻近主权国家之间的和平关系。

items.def_en: To introduce, establish, or initiate a policy, rule, or system again
items.ex_en: The city council voted unanimously to reinstitute free public transport on weekends.
items.ex_zh: 市议会一致投票决定周末重新恢复推行免费公共交通。

items.def_en: To reconstruct or form again, especially diplomatic ties, trust, or a destroyed system
items.ex_en: Both nations pledged to rebuild mutual trust through continuous bilateral security talks.
items.ex_zh: 两国均承诺通过持续的双边安全谈判来重建互信。

items.def_en: To restore someone or something to their former position, rank, or condition
items.ex_en: The court ordered the university board to reinstate the wrongfully dismissed professor immediately.
items.ex_zh: 法院责令大学董事会立即恢复被不当解雇教授的职位。

items.def_zh: 重建，重新设立；恢复（秩序、关系等）
items.def_en: To set up, restore, or bring back an institution, system, relationship, or state of affairs that previously existed.
items.ex_en: The two nations agreed to reestablish formal diplomatic ties after decades of silence.
items.ex_zh: 两国在数十年的沉默后同意重新恢复正式外交关系。

items.def_en: To build up or organize a body, committee, or nation again in a new or restored form
items.ex_en: The prime minister moved swiftly to reconstitute the crisis cabinet after widespread resignations.
items.ex_zh: 在出现大范围辞职后，首相迅速采取行动改组了危机内阁。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this formal and institutional frame describe restoring treaties, public order, diplomatic ties, official posts, or legal frameworks that had been severed or abolished. They focus on legitimate authority and structural continuity.
groups.summary_zh: 在官方或制度层面恢复原有的秩序、关系或职务。
groups.desc_en: Denotes restoring a disrupted, abolished, or lost institution, status, or order back to its rightful operational existence, contrasting with de novo establishment or continuous maintenance.
groups.desc_zh: 指将中断、废黜或丧失的建制、名誉或秩序恢复至原有的存续与执行力，不同于平地起初建或日常维系。
groups.nuance_en: reinstate: return someone or an abolished rule to their former rank, office, or validity (official / policy / order) · restore: bring back to a pristine, original, or healthy condition (monarchy / peace / eyesight) · reestablish: set up once again an institutional link, rule, or equilibrium (diplomatic ties / authority / order) · reinstitute: formally bring back an abolished law, practice, or ceremony (draft / curfew / sanctions) · reconstitute: reorganize a dissolved entity with new or original components (committee / board / government)
groups.nuance_zh: reinstate: 恢复当事人的原职头衔或废止政策的原效力 (official / policy / order) · restore: 全面修复回溯至原初健康或安定面貌 (monarchy / peace / eyesight) · reestablish: 重新缔结并恢复中断的关系或权威 (diplomatic ties / authority / order) · reinstitute: 重新颁行曾被废止的制度或法律 (draft / curfew / sanctions) · reconstitute: 将已解散实体重新改组重塑构架 (committee / board / government)

groups.name: Refine & Polish · 提炼与润色 (Polish, Hone, Fine-tune)
groups.tip: 去粗取精达到完美状态

items.def_en: To make improvements to a piece of work or skill until it is smooth and elegant
items.ex_en: She spent several quiet evenings helping him polish the final draft of his essay.
items.ex_zh: 她花了几个安静的晚上帮他打磨润色论文的最终稿。

items.def_en: 1. To make a substance pure by removing unwanted materials from it. 2. To improve a method, system, idea, etc. by making small changes.
items.ex_en: Scientists continue to refine the manufacturing techniques used for producing synthetic biodegradable materials.
items.ex_zh: 科学家们继续完善用于生产可生物降解合成材料的制造工艺。

items.def_en: To make a process or organization simpler and more efficient by removing unnecessary steps
items.ex_en: The hospital introduced digital registration to streamline patient intake and cut waiting times.
items.ex_zh: 医院推出了数字化挂号，以精简接诊流程并缩减候诊时间。

items.def_en: To sharpen, develop, and perfect a skill, technique, or blade over time
items.ex_en: Apprentices spent years of rigorous daily practice to hone their exquisite woodcarving skills.
items.ex_zh: 学徒们经过数年日复一日的严格练习，以磨砺他们精湛的木雕技艺。

items.def_en: To make very small adjustments to a system or plan to achieve optimal performance
items.ex_en: Engineers spent two days on the track trying to fine-tune the racecar's suspension system.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们在赛道上花了整整两天时间，试图微调赛车的悬挂系统。

items.def_en: To polish metal to a high sheen, or to polish and improve an image or reputation
items.ex_en: The senator accepted the philanthropic role to burnish his public image before reelection.
items.ex_zh: 参议员接受了这一慈善职务，以便在连任竞选前擦亮公众形象。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on elevating an already acceptable skill, object, or argument by removing subtle flaws, sharpening precision, and adding sophistication.
groups.summary_zh: 指对已有成果进行润色、打磨、去除瑕疵以达到更高纯度或水准。
groups.desc_en: Denotes purging flaws, sharpening precision, and elevating the quality of an already competent product or skill, contrasting with foundational creation or coarse repair.
groups.desc_zh: 指在已有合格基础上去粗取精、打磨精细度与格调，不同于底层初创或粗糙打补丁。
groups.nuance_en: refine: remove impurities, ambiguities, or roughness to reach purity and precision (process / theory / crude oil) · polish: eliminate minor flaws and impart shine, grace, or professionalism (manuscript / speech / performance) · hone: sharpen an acute skill, instrument, or competitive edge (skills / instincts / craft) · fine-tune: make tiny, highly calibrated adjustments for peak performance (engine / model / algorithm) · streamline: remove redundancies to make an operation sleek and efficient (operations / process / design)
groups.nuance_zh: refine: 提炼粹选去除杂质与瑕疵以趋精密 (process / theory / crude oil) · polish: 润色文稿并扫尽微瑕以增添光彩格调 (manuscript / speech / performance) · hone: 研磨砥砺技艺、直觉或竞争锐气 (skills / instincts / craft) · fine-tune: 针对系统参数做微米级精准调校 (engine / model / algorithm) · streamline: 精简冗余以理顺流程提升效能 (operations / process / design)

groups.name: Refloat & Salvage · 起浮与脱浅 (Salvage, Unstick, Surface)
groups.tip: 受浮力作用在水面或空中漂起

items.def_en: To rise up to the surface of water after being completely submerged
items.ex_en: The submarine was forced to surface after experiencing severe mechanical failure during patrol.
items.ex_zh: 潜艇在巡逻期间遭遇严重机械故障，被迫浮出水面。

items.def_en: To release a stranded ship or trapped object so it can move and float again
items.ex_en: Rescue tugs operated through high tide to free the stranded container ship quickly.
items.ex_zh: 救援拖船在涨潮时持续作业，迅速解救了搁浅的集装箱船。

items.def_en: To rescue or recover a damaged or sunken ship and its cargo from water
items.ex_en: Specialized divers were dispatched to salvage valuable antique porcelain from the sunken galleon.
items.ex_zh: 专业潜水员被派去从沉没的大帆船中打捞珍贵的古董瓷器。

items.def_en: To knock or force a vessel or object out of a position where it is stuck fast
items.ex_en: Tugboats pushed relentlessly from both sides to dislodge the tanker from the sandbank.
items.ex_zh: 拖船在两侧不懈推挤，试图使油轮脱离沙洲。

items.def_zh: （使）再浮起，（使搁浅船只）起浮脱困
items.def_en: To float again, or release a stranded, sunken, or grounded vessel back into deep water so it floats.
items.ex_en: Salvage crews pumped tons of sand away to refloat the enormous bulk carrier.
items.ex_zh: 打捞队抽走数吨泥沙，终于使这艘巨大的散货船重新浮起。
items.ex2_en: The stranded cargo ship finally refloated when the powerful spring tide arrived.
items.ex2_zh: 当强劲的春潮来临时，搁浅的货轮终于重新漂浮了起来。

items.def_en: To bring a sunken vessel or underwater wreckage back up to the surface
items.ex_en: Maritime engineers used massive crane barges to raise the historic warship from the seabed.
items.ex_zh: 海洋工程师利用巨型起重船将这艘历史战舰从海底打捞出水。

groups.summary_en: This nautical and mechanical frame concerns restoring buoyancy to grounded or sunken craft, raising heavy objects out of waterbeds, or returning submerged objects to a floating state.
groups.summary_zh: 指使搁浅、沉没的船舶重新浮起脱困，或从水底打捞复位。
groups.desc_en: Denotes releasing a grounded, sunken, or immobilized maritime vessel or heavy asset back into buoyancy and free navigation, contrasting with ordinary lifting or dry-land towing.
groups.desc_zh: 指使搁浅、沉没或卡阻的船舶及大型水上设施重新脱困并起浮复原航行，不同于常规陆上拖吊或普通提拔。
groups.nuance_en: refloat: restore a stranded, beached, or sunken vessel back into floating status (ship / tanker / hull) · salvage: rescue a distressed vessel, cargo, or valuable gear from maritime loss (vessel / cargo / wreck) · dislodge: knock loose an asset jammed tight in mud, rocks, or sand (boat / boulder / debris) · free: untangle or release an immobilized vessel from an obstruction (vessel / crew / stuck ship) · raise: hoist a sunken wreck to the water surface using pontoons or cranes (sunken ship / submarine / wreck)
groups.nuance_zh: refloat: 使搁浅或失衡坐底的船舶重回漂浮状态 (ship / tanker / hull) · salvage: 从海难残骸中打捞施救货轮与物资 (vessel / cargo / wreck) · dislodge: 施加外力冲脱卡死的岩石泥滩 (boat / boulder / debris) · free: 解开束缚使受阻船体脱困解围 (vessel / crew / stuck ship) · raise: 利用浮筒吊臂将水下沉船整体打捞出水 (sunken ship / submarine / wreck)

groups.name: Refresh & Revitalize · 提神与更新 (Invigorate, Rejuvenate, Freshen Up)
groups.tip: 重获清新与精神活力

items.def_en: To wash, tidy oneself up, or take a short break in order to feel clean and alert
items.ex_en: I need to go freshen up in the restroom before the dinner party begins.
items.ex_zh: 晚宴开始前我得去洗手间梳洗提神一下。
items.ex2_en: A brisk morning shower will quickly freshen up your mind before work.
items.ex2_zh: 上班前冲个清爽的晨澡会让你迅速提神醒脑。

items.def_en: To make someone or something more lively, interesting, or spirited
items.ex_en: A dash of fresh lemon juice will pep up this rather bland seafood soup.
items.ex_zh: 少许新鲜柠檬汁能让这道寡淡的海鲜汤变得风味十足。

items.def_en: To imbue something with new life, vigor, or dynamic energy
items.ex_en: The municipal council approved ambitious investments to revitalize the decaying historic waterfront district.
items.ex_zh: 市议会批准了雄心勃勃的投资方案，以使衰败的历史滨水区焕发新生。

items.def_en: To make someone or something look or feel younger, fresher, or more lively
items.ex_en: A fortnight of tranquil mountain hiking served to rejuvenate her tired body and mind.
items.ex_zh: 两周宁静的山间徒步让她疲惫的身心彻底恢复了活力。

items.def_zh: 使精神饱满，使恢复活力；使显得新鲜；（风）增强
items.def_en: 1. To make someone feel clean and refreshed, or make something fresh again. 2. (of the wind) To blow harder and cooler.
items.ex_en: Splashing cold spring water onto your face will instantly freshen you during hot journeys.
items.ex_zh: 在炎热的旅途中，往脸上拍些冰凉的泉水能让你立刻感到精神一振。
items.ex2_en: The cool ocean breeze began to freshen noticeably as sunset approached the bay.
items.ex2_zh: 随着夕阳逼近海湾，凉爽的海风开始明显变强变清新。

items.def_en: To give strength, vitality, or energy to someone
items.ex_en: The crisp morning mountain breeze never failed to invigorate the weary travelers completely.
items.ex_zh: 清晨凛冽清新的山风总能让疲惫的旅人们顿时感到精神充沛。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe renewing sensory vigor, cleanliness, mental clarity, or aesthetic vibrancy. They convey shaking off lethargy, staleness, or fatigue to feel bright and energetic again.
groups.summary_zh: 消除疲惫与陈旧感，使精力、头脑或面貌焕然一新。
groups.desc_en: Denotes imparting fresh energy, youthfulness, or vitality to a tired, dormant, or aged entity, going beyond simple rest by implying an active restoration of vigor or novelty.
groups.desc_zh: 指为疲惫、衰老或停滞的主体注入新鲜活力或恢复青春，超越了单纯的休息，强调主动重获生机或焕新感。
groups.nuance_en: freshen up: quick superficial grooming or cooling renewal (appearance / drink / memory) · pep up: inject rapid lively energy or flavor into something dull (party / team / economy) · revitalize: deeply restore vitality, economic health, or systemic strength (downtown / economy / neighborhood) · rejuvenate: restore youthful vigor, appearance, or freshness (skin / career / brand) · invigorate: stimulate directly with robust energy or alertness (walk / shower / competition)
groups.nuance_zh: freshen up: 快速表面梳理或适度清爽焕新 (appearance / drink / memory) · pep up: 为沉闷事物注入即时活力或提味 (party / team / economy) · revitalize: 深度复苏经济、体制或组织元气 (downtown / economy / neighborhood) · rejuvenate: 恢复青春神采、活力或年轻化 (skin / career / brand) · invigorate: 给予强劲的精神或身体刺激提振 (walk / shower / competition)

groups.name: Refute & Disprove · 证据证伪与驳倒 (Debunk, Invalidate, Explode)
groups.tip: 立论反驳证其不成立

items.def_zh: 彻底打破，彻底粉碎（迷信、谣言）
items.def_en: To decisively shatter and expose a myth or false belief as groundless.
items.ex_en: The clinical trial gathered enough empirical data to explode the popular dietary myth completely.
items.ex_zh: 这项临床试验收集了足够的经验数据，彻底粉碎了这一流行的饮食迷信。

items.def_zh: 击溃，彻底否决（论点、提议）
items.def_en: To defeat or destroy an argument, proposal, or theory by showing its flaws.
items.ex_en: Senior executives quickly moved to shoot down his impractical restructuring proposal during the meeting.
items.ex_zh: 在会议期间，高管们迅速行动，彻底否决了他那不切实际的重组提议。

items.def_en: To prove that an argument, conclusion, or theory is erroneous and cannot stand.
items.ex_en: The recent discovery of contradictory archival records will invalidate previous historical theories completely.
items.ex_zh: 最新发现的矛盾档案记录将完全证明先前的历史理论不成立。

items.def_en: To show that an idea, myth, or belief is false, pretentious, or exaggerated.
items.ex_en: The documentary consulted top astrophysicists to debunk persistent conspiracy theories about lunar landings.
items.ex_zh: 该纪录片咨询了顶尖天体物理学家，以揭穿关于登月的顽固阴谋论。

items.def_en: To prove by evidence or argument that an idea, claim, or theory is false.
items.ex_en: Subsequent laboratory experiments managed to disprove the controversial chemical theory beyond any doubt.
items.ex_zh: 随后的实验室实验成功且无可置疑地证伪了这一有争议的化学理论。

items.def_en: To demonstrate that a scientific hypothesis or factual claim is untrue by test.
items.ex_en: Scientists conducted rigorous blind trials in an attempt to falsify the controversial medical hypothesis.
items.ex_zh: 科学家们进行了严谨的双盲试验，试图证伪这个饱受争议的医学假说。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this epistemic frame denote decisively demonstrating the falsity or inaccuracy of an assertion, hypothesis, myth, or thesis through rigorous evidence and logic.
groups.summary_zh: 运用确凿证据或逻辑推演彻底推翻某假设、学说或虚假传言。
groups.desc_en: Denotes decisively demonstrating the falsity, invalidity, or groundlessness of an assertion or belief, contrasting with mere disagreement by relying on definitive evidence, logical collapse, or authoritative rejection.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过确凿证据、逻辑推演或权威裁决决定性地证实某观点为虚假、无效或毫无根据，不同于泛泛的反驳。
groups.nuance_en: debunk: expose the falseness or fraudulence of an exaggerated myth or claim (myth / theory / claim) · disprove: establish falsehood conclusively using empirical facts or logic (hypothesis / allegation / theorem) · invalidate: legally or logically deprive of validity or cogency (contract / results / findings) · explode: shatter or demolish an entrenched popular misconception violently (myth / notion / fallacy) · falsify: prove scientifically inconsistent or deliberately alter for deceit (data / records / prediction) · shoot down: summarily reject or decisively defeat an idea or proposal (proposal / argument / theory)
groups.nuance_zh: debunk: 揭穿神话、伪科学或虚假夸大的真相 (myth / theory / claim) · disprove: 用确凿事实或严密逻辑彻底证伪 (hypothesis / allegation / theorem) · invalidate: 使合同、论据或实验结果丧失效力 (contract / results / findings) · explode: 彻底粉碎流传已久的谬论或假说 (myth / notion / fallacy) · falsify: 科学意义上的证伪，或故意篡改作伪 (data / records / prediction) · shoot down: 迅速否定、彻底击败提案或观点 (proposal / argument / theory)

groups.name: Regard & Deem · 视作与看待 (Consider, Deem, View, Gauge)
groups.tip: 以某种眼光评定事物

items.def_en: (+ as) To think about, interpret, or evaluate someone or something from a particular perspective
items.ex_en: Most international analysts view the proposed treaty as a major diplomatic milestone for peace.
items.ex_zh: 大多数国际分析家将这项拟议的条约视作迈向和平的重大外交里程碑。

items.def_en: To have a particular opinion about someone or something; hold the view that someone or something is a certain way
items.ex_en: Many leading critics consider her final novel to be her finest literary masterpiece.
items.ex_zh: 许多知名评论家认为她的最后一部小说是她最杰出的文学巨作。

items.def_en: (+ as) To consider someone or something to be a particular thing, or to be considered valid under a rule
items.ex_en: Under current tournament regulations, this late submission will not count as a valid entry.
items.ex_zh: 根据目前的比赛规则，这份迟交的作品将不被算作有效参赛资格。

items.def_en: 1. To think of, consider, or evaluate someone or something in a particular way. 2. (formal) To look closely or steadily at someone or something.
items.ex_en: Historians generally regard his sweeping legal reforms as the cornerstone of modern constitutional law.
items.ex_zh: 历史学家普遍将他大刀阔斧的法律改革视为现代宪法的基石。

items.def_en: To judge or evaluate something in a particular way, especially formally or officially
items.ex_en: The regulatory board will deem any unlicensed financial transaction strictly illegal and punishable.
items.ex_zh: 监管委员会将认定任何未经许可的金融交易为完全非法并予以处罚。

items.def_en: (+ as) To regard or think about someone or something with a specific attitude or disposition
items.ex_en: Local villagers traditionally look on the ancient oak tree as a sacred guardian spirit.
items.ex_zh: 当地村民传统上将那棵古老的橡树视为神圣的守护神。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here denote evaluating, framing, or holding an opinion about a person, action, or situation. Nuances range from formal institutional determinations ('deem') to subjective cognitive framing ('view as', 'count as').
groups.summary_zh: 在心智中对人或事物进行主观评判、定性或视作某种角色。
groups.desc_en: Denotes holding an evaluative, interpretive stance toward an entity or assigning it a specific conceptual status, differing from passive perception by involving deliberate mental assessment.
groups.desc_zh: 指对某事物持有评价性、解释性的态度或赋予特定认知地位，不同于单纯的感知，强调带有主观判断的定性。
groups.nuance_en: deem: authoritative or formal judgmental assessment (appropriate / necessary / unfit) · regard: adopt a sustained, respectful, or evaluative attitude toward (candidate / colleague / danger) · view: interpret or frame through a particular cognitive angle (proposal / challenge / failure) · consider: weigh thoughtfully or reflectively categorize (option / factor / equal) · look on: maintain a detached, observant, or defined perspective as a spectator (affair / situation / intruder)
groups.nuance_zh: deem: 正式、权威或法律层面上的判定与视作 (appropriate / necessary / unfit) · regard: 带有主观态度、尊重或评价性地看待 (candidate / colleague / danger) · view: 从特定认知框架或立场审视理解 (proposal / challenge / failure) · consider: 经权衡考量后在心理上归类为 (option / factor / equal) · look on: 以旁观或特定心理视角看待 (affair / situation / intruder)

groups.name: Regulate & Control · 控制与规范 (Control, Govern, Oversee)
groups.tip: 依规章制度对系统加以约束

items.def_en: To enforce regulations, compliance, and order within a particular sector, trade, or group
items.ex_en: The federal agency was established to police trade practices across major financial markets.
items.ex_zh: 该联邦机构的设立旨在监管主要金融市场的交易行为是否合规。

items.def_zh: 控制，规范，管理；调节，校准
items.def_en: 1. To control or direct by a rule, principle, or law. 2. To adjust a mechanism or system to a desired speed, temperature, or level.
items.ex_en: The internal thermostat regulates the engine's operating temperature within optimal parameters.
items.ex_zh: 内部恒温器将发动机的工作温度调节在最佳参数范围内。

items.def_en: To supervise people or processes to ensure that tasks are executed legally and correctly
items.ex_en: An independent committee was appointed to oversee the execution of clinical trials.
items.ex_zh: 一个独立委员会受命监督临床试验的执行情况。

items.def_en: To bring something under tighter control, restraining unwanted freedom or excessive growth
items.ex_en: The treasury moved quickly to rein in excessive public spending this quarter.
items.ex_zh: 财政部迅速采取行动，严格控制本季度的过量公共支出。
