items.def_en: To have the power to direct, restrain, or dictate the behavior, functioning, or course of something
items.ex_en: Operators must control the flow of coolant during peak operating hours.
items.ex_zh: 操作员必须在用电高峰期控制冷却液的流量。

items.def_en: To officially control and direct the public policy, actions, or affairs of an entity or state
items.ex_en: Strict constitutional principles govern the enactment of new federal taxation policies.
items.ex_zh: 严谨的宪法原则支配着联邦新税收政策的制定。

groups.summary_en: Deals with exercising authority or operational parameters over systems, markets, institutions, or behaviors. 'Regulate' stresses formal rules and calibrated standards, 'govern' focuses on sovereign jurisdiction, and 'rein in' emphasizes curbing excess.
groups.summary_zh: 指依据规则、法律或机制来监督、引导与约束秩序。
groups.desc_en: Denotes exercising authoritative constraint, surveillance, and directive force over agents or systems to maintain orderly boundaries, contrasting with passive monitoring.
groups.desc_zh: 指凭借权威对系统、机构或行为施加约束、监督和指导力量以维持秩序，有别于消极观望。
groups.nuance_en: regulate: control according to precise rules or systematic parameters (industry / market / temperature) · govern: exercise overarching constitutional or natural rule determining behavior (country / conduct / principles) · police: enforce compliance and maintain order through constant active surveillance (borders / compliance / industry) · rein in: exert sharp, corrective restraint to stop runaway excess (spending / inflation / temper) · oversee: supervise operations from above to ensure proper execution (project / operations / team) · control: exercise direct mastery and manipulative dominance over operations (crowd / process / destiny)
groups.nuance_zh: regulate: 依据条例文本或参数进行规范与调节 (industry / market / temperature) · govern: 统摄全局或依据固有法则支配行为 (country / conduct / principles) · police: 巡查监督并强制执行规范秩序 (borders / compliance / industry) · rein in: 勒马收缰般强力遏制失控或过度行为 (spending / inflation / temper) · oversee: 居高临下地把关监督以保顺利执行 (project / operations / team) · control: 施加直接主导权与全方位控制 (crowd / process / destiny)

groups.name: Regulate & Standardize · 规范与标准化 (Normalize, Homogenize, Codify)
groups.tip: 立规立矩统一步调

items.def_en: To control an activity or process by using official rules, laws, or guidelines
items.ex_en: New directives strictly regulate the disposal of hazardous electronic waste nationwide.
items.ex_zh: 新政令在全国范围内严格规范危险电子废弃物的处理。

items.def_zh: 使标准化，使符合统一标准
items.def_en: To make things conform to a single standard or consistent quality, rule, or model.
items.ex_en: The alliance seeks to standardize manufacturing criteria across all partner nations.
items.ex_zh: 该联盟致力于统一所有成员国之间的制造业标准。

items.def_en: To make a system, organization, or process simpler, more efficient, and consistent by eliminating redundant steps
items.ex_en: Management hopes to streamline the onboarding process to reduce bureaucratic delays.
items.ex_zh: 管理层希望精简入职流程，以减少官僚作风造成的延误。

items.def_en: To bring something to a standard, expected, or typical state, pattern, or baseline
items.ex_en: The medication helped normalize her blood sugar levels after several months.
items.ex_zh: 几个月后，该药物帮助她的血糖水平恢复正常。
items.ex2_en: Heart rates generally normalize after a few minutes of quiet, restful breathing.
items.ex2_zh: 在进行几分钟平静休息的呼吸后，心率通常会恢复正常。

items.def_en: To bring systems, rules, or standards into agreement so that they work well together without conflict
items.ex_en: Member states must harmonize technical safety standards to facilitate cross-border trade.
items.ex_zh: 各成员国必须协调统一技术安全标准，以促进跨境贸易。
items.ex2_en: The singers' resonant voices harmonized perfectly in the historic stone cathedral.
items.ex2_zh: 歌手们洪亮的声音在古老的石质大教堂里完美地谐调共鸣。

items.def_zh: 编纂；把…编成法典或规则
items.def_en: To arrange laws, principles, or rules into a systematic and formal written code
items.ex_en: Legal scholars gathered in Geneva to codify maritime navigation customary laws.
items.ex_zh: 法学学者齐聚日内瓦，将海上航行习惯法编纂成典。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers bringing practices, components, or systems into alignment with a shared model, benchmark, or regulatory framework. It spans technical harmonization, legal codification, and systematic control.
groups.summary_zh: 消除差异与混乱，使制度、产品或流程符合统一标准或规范。
groups.desc_en: Denotes systematically aligning disparate parts, procedures, or rules into a uniform, compliant, or mutually compatible operational framework, contrasting with ad-hoc coordination.
groups.desc_zh: 指系统性地将零散、不一的流程、构件或规则统一、兼容并编纂成规，不同于临时的随性协调。
groups.nuance_en: standardize: make uniform according to an agreed benchmark or specification (procedures / tests / components) · codify: arrange unwritten customs, laws, or principles into an explicit formal code (rules / laws / practice) · normalize: bring back to an accepted normal standard or stabilize diplomatic ties (relations / trade / metrics) · harmonize: reconcile divergent laws or standards to operate compatibly (standards / policies / regulations) · streamline: eliminate redundancies to optimize operational efficiency (process / operations / system)
groups.nuance_zh: standardize: 依据基准统一步调、规格或流程 (procedures / tests / components) · codify: 将零散做法或不成文习惯整理编纂为法典规范 (rules / laws / practice) · normalize: 使异常状态重回常轨或使两国外交关系正常化 (relations / trade / metrics) · harmonize: 调和异见或使不同体系法规协调一致 (standards / policies / regulations) · streamline: 精简冗余环节以提高效率 (process / operations / system)

groups.name: Rehearse & Practice · 演练与排练 (Practice, Drill, Run Through)
groups.tip: 舞台演出前的反复练习

items.def_en: To perform an activity or skill repeatedly in order to acquire or maintain proficiency
items.ex_en: The young violinist practiced her scales daily to prepare for competitions.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻的小提琴手每天练习音阶，为比赛做准备。

items.def_en: To plan, produce, and organize a dramatic performance or simulated scenario
items.ex_en: The emergency responders staged a mock rescue drill near the riverbank.
items.ex_zh: 应急救援人员在河岸附近组织了一场模拟救援演习。

items.def_en: To train or rehearse rigorously through repetitive exercises and discipline
items.ex_en: The coach drilled the defensive line relentlessly before the championship game.
items.ex_zh: 主教练在锦标赛前对防线进行了严格的反复操练。

items.def_en: To practice a performance, speech, or sequence quickly from start to finish
items.ex_en: Let's run through the opening scene one more time before lunch.
items.ex_zh: 咱们午饭前把开场戏再快速过一遍吧。

items.def_en: To conduct a complete trial or rehearsal of a process before the real event
items.ex_en: The engineering team scheduled a dry-run before the actual system launch.
items.ex_zh: 工程团队在系统正式上线前安排了一次模拟演练。

items.def_zh: 排练，排演；反复练习；详述，列举
items.def_en: 1. To practice a play, concert, speech, or piece of music before performing it in public. 2. To repeat or give a long account of something in detail.
items.ex_en: The orchestra gathered every evening to rehearse the demanding symphony program.
items.ex_zh: 管弦乐团每天傍晚聚集在一起排练这套难度极高的交响曲目。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve practicing performances, maneuvers, or spoken parts prior to an official event. They range from formal stage rehearsals to rigorous military and safety drills.
groups.summary_zh: 指在正式演出、发布或实战前预先排演、反复练习。
groups.desc_en: Denotes structured, repeated simulation or trial execution of a performance, plan, or procedure ahead of actual deployment, contrasting with spontaneous execution.
groups.desc_zh: 指在正式实施前对演出、行动或流程进行结构化的反复试演或操练，不同于未经准备的临场发挥。
groups.nuance_en: rehearse: practice a performance, speech, or sequence comprehensively before presentation (speech / lines / presentation) · drill: train rigorously through disciplined, repetitive conditioning (troops / team / students) · dry-run: execute a complete procedural simulation to catch system flaws without live stakes (launch / test / procedure) · run through: perform a rapid, end-to-end review or check of material (checklist / script / plan) · stage: organize and put on a public performance, demonstration, or artificial scenario (protest / production / comeback)
groups.nuance_zh: rehearse: 全面排练演讲、剧目或既定答辩环节 (speech / lines / presentation) · drill: 通过严苛重复的纪律性手段操练强化 (troops / team / students) · dry-run: 临战前不计实效的实操空转演练以查漏补缺 (launch / test / procedure) · run through: 快速过一遍脚本、清单或动作流程 (checklist / script / plan) · stage: 策划并公开展演或搬上舞台 (protest / production / comeback)

groups.name: Reinforce & Armor · 加固与强化 (Reinforce, Fortify, Stud)
groups.tip: 钉掌加厚增强结构韧性

items.def_zh: 镶嵌；用饰钉/防滑钉加固
items.def_en: To fit, reinforce, or cover a surface with metal studs or raised projections
items.ex_en: Workers studded the heavy leather boots with steel to ensure traction.
items.ex_zh: 工人们在厚皮靴上嵌上钢钉以确保抓地力。

items.def_zh: 装防滑齿；装防滑条加固
items.def_en: To strengthen or provide footwear or beams with cleats for grip and rigidity
items.ex_en: The master carpenter cleated the weathered oak beams against violent tremors.
items.ex_zh: 老木匠用压条加固风化的橡木横梁，以抵御剧烈的震动。

items.def_en: To strengthen, improve, or give greater substance to something physical or organizational
items.ex_en: The company hired extra security to beef up protection around the warehouse.
items.ex_zh: 公司雇佣了额外的安保人员来加强仓库周边的防护。

items.def_en: To make a structure, material, or object stronger by adding more support or material
items.ex_en: Engineers used carbon fibers to reinforce the damaged bridge pillars securely.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们使用碳纤维牢固地加固了受损的桥墩。

items.def_en: To reinforce or fasten the soles of shoes or boots with hobnails.
items.ex_en: The mountain guide hobnailed his thick boots before ascending the icy crag.
items.ex_zh: 向导在攀登冰封的峭壁之前，在厚靴底钉上了平头钉。

items.def_en: To make a structure or object stronger and better able to resist damage or wear
items.ex_en: Citizens worked tirelessly to fortify the earthen levee against impending floods.
items.ex_zh: 市民们不知疲倦地工作，加固土堤以抵御即将来临的洪水。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote physically strengthening, lining, or armor-plating materials and garments with studs, plates, or extra layers to withstand heavy wear.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过钉铁掌、衬垫或加厚材料，对物件（尤其鞋履与结构）进行机械加固。
groups.desc_en: Denotes physically or structurally strengthening an object against impact, wear, or collapse by adding external barriers, internal supports, or dense attachments, contrasting with natural growth.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过增设外部防线、内部支撑或硬质构件来结构性增强抗冲击、耐磨或防垮塌能力，不同于自然强壮。
groups.nuance_en: reinforce: strengthen structurally from within or behind using added material or personnel (concrete / troops / security) · fortify: defensively strengthen against military attack or enrich nutritional value (border / city / foods) · beef up: colloquially augment the capacity, volume, or severity of something (security / staff / penalties) · stud: dot or embed a surface densely with protective or decorative metal projections (jacket / snow tires / shield) · cleat: fit with cleats to provide traction or secure rope fixtures (shoes / sails / gangway)
groups.nuance_zh: reinforce: 从内部或背面添加材料或兵力进行结构性加固 (concrete / troops / security) · fortify: 构筑军事防御工事防范外侵，或添加营养成分强化 (border / city / foods) · beef up: 口语中扩充人手、提升安全等级或加大力度 (security / staff / penalties) · stud: 嵌上防滑金属钉或铆钉加固表面 (jacket / snow tires / shield) · cleat: 装上防滑夹板、防滑钉或防滑装置 (shoes / sails / gangway)

groups.name: Reinstate & Restore · 恢复原状与复官复职 (Restore, Reinstate, Re-establish)
groups.tip: 官复原职或恢复此前权利

items.def_en: To bring back an original condition, status, power, or constitutional right
items.ex_en: The high court voted to restore voting rights to former felons.
items.ex_zh: 最高法院投票决定恢复刑满释放人员的投票权。

items.def_en: To set up or validate a system, institution, or official relation again
items.ex_en: Both nations agreed to re-establish formal diplomatic ties after decades of tension.
items.ex_zh: 两国在数十年紧张局势后同意重新确立正式外交关系。

items.def_en: (+ with) To endow someone again with power, legal authority, or rank
items.ex_en: The parliament voted to reinvest the prime minister with emergency executive authority.
items.ex_zh: 议会投票决定重新授予首相紧急行政权力。

items.def_en: To introduce or use a former rule, law, practice, or standard again
items.ex_en: The ministry decided to bring back the traditional apprenticeship examination program.
items.ex_zh: 该部门决定重新采用传统的学徒考核制度。

items.def_zh: 使复职，使恢复原位；恢复（法律、制度等）
items.def_en: 1. To restore someone to their previous job, rank, or position. 2. To restore a law, rule, or custom that had been abolished.
items.ex_en: The tribunal ordered the corporation to reinstate the wrongfully dismissed engineer immediately.
items.ex_zh: 法庭责令该企业立即恢复被错误解雇工程师的职位。

items.def_en: To return someone to their former good reputation, privileges, or standing
items.ex_en: The committee worked diligently to rehabilitate the reputation of the exiled artist.
items.ex_zh: 委员会努力工作，以恢复这位流亡艺术家的名誉。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on returning a dismissed person to an official position or re-establishing a suspended policy, rank, privilege, or status to its former validity.
groups.summary_zh: 指使被免职者恢复原职原薪，或使失效、废除的规章制度重新生效。
groups.desc_en: Denotes putting back a deposed person, repealed law, or compromised state into its lawful, original, or functional standing, contrasting with starting anew.
groups.desc_zh: 指使被废黜者、被废除法规或受损状态恢复至原有的合法身份、功效或常态，不同于从头建立。
groups.nuance_en: reinstate: restore a person to a former dismissed office, status, or valid state (employee / ban / license) · restore: return an object, institution, or healthy condition to its original pristine state (order / monarchy / painting) · rehabilitate: restore someone to normal life, standing, or reputation after injury or imprisonment (reputation / patient / offender) · re-establish: set up once again an institutional link, rule, or equilibrium after disruption (ties / control / credibility) · bring back: colloquially revive a retired custom, product, or memory (trend / memories / death penalty)
groups.nuance_zh: reinstate: 恢复遭免职者的职位、停用禁令或吊销的执照 (employee / ban / license) · restore: 将古迹、秩序或健康状态完全修复还原至原状 (order / monarchy / painting) · rehabilitate: 使受损名誉平反、或使伤患罪犯重新康复融入社会 (reputation / patient / offender) · re-establish: 在中断之后重新确立外交、统治或信用 (ties / control / credibility) · bring back: 重新引回旧风尚、惯例或勾起回忆 (trend / memories / death penalty)

groups.name: Rekindle & Reawaken · 重燃与唤醒 (Revive, Resurrect, Reignite)
groups.tip: 死灰复燃重燃生机

items.def_en: To cause something sudden, such as feelings, memories, or a dispute, to start
items.ex_en: A provocative remark sparked off a fierce debate among the committee members.
items.ex_zh: 一句挑衅性的话在委员会成员之间引发了激烈的辩论。

items.def_en: To restore to life, consciousness, or vigor, or make active again
items.ex_en: The paramedic managed to revive the unconscious diver using chest compressions.
items.ex_zh: 护理人员通过胸外按压使昏迷的潜水员恢复了意识。
items.ex2_en: The wilting indoor ferns revived quickly after getting fresh water and sunlight.
items.ex2_zh: 那些枯萎的室内蕨类植物在获得新鲜水和阳光后迅速恢复了生机。

items.def_zh: 重新激起，重燃（情感、希望或冲突）；重新点燃
items.def_en: To revive or bring back a feeling, relationship, interest, or fire that had died down.
items.ex_en: The unexpected reunion rekindled sweet memories of their long-forgotten youth.
items.ex_zh: 这次意外的重逢重新激起了他们对淡忘已久的青春的美好回忆。
items.ex2_en: Old childhood passions rekindled when she discovered her grandmother's vintage oil paints.
items.ex2_zh: 当她发现祖母的复古油画颜料时，童年的旧日热情重新燃起。

items.def_en: To awaken or trigger memories, desires, or capabilities that had faded
items.ex_en: The haunting melody reawakened long-dormant sorrow within the old traveler's heart.
items.ex_zh: 那令人难忘的旋律再次唤醒了老行者心中沉睡已久的悲伤。
items.ex2_en: His deep scientific curiosity reawakened after reading the fascinating newly published research.
items.ex2_zh: 读完这篇引人入胜的新发表研究后，他对科学的浓厚好奇心被重新唤醒。

items.def_en: To catch fire or cause strong feelings, debates, or conflicts to flare up anew
items.ex_en: The controversial legislation threatened to reignite intense ethnic strife across the provinces.
items.ex_zh: 这项有争议的法案可能重新引发各省之间强烈的民族冲突。
items.ex2_en: Violent territorial disputes reignited along the disputed mountain border late last night.
items.ex2_zh: 昨晚深夜，争议山区边界沿线再次爆发激烈的领土争端。

items.def_en: To bring back into use, notice, or activity a practice, belief, or concept that had long ceased
items.ex_en: The scholar sought to resurrect forgotten philosophical frameworks from classical antiquity.
items.ex_zh: 这位学者试图重新启用古典时代被遗忘的哲学体系。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses bringing dormant emotions, relationships, controversies, or intellectual interests back into active flame. Verbs carry strong metaphorical imagery of igniting embers or waking something from deep slumber.
groups.summary_zh: 重新点燃休眠的情感、兴趣、争议或昔日关系。
groups.desc_en: Denotes reviving an extinguished, dormant, or fading emotional, intellectual, or figurative flame, escalating from quiet arousal to full-blown resurgence, contrasting with initial creation.
groups.desc_zh: 指唤醒沉睡或重燃濒于熄灭的情感、冲突或信念，呈现从暗流激发到全面复兴的强度推进，不同于初次萌生。
groups.nuance_en: rekindle: blow on dying embers to renew former warmth or affection (romance / passion / interest) · reignite: cause an abrupt, fiery resurgence of heated dispute or ambition (controversy / debate / hopes) · reawaken: arouse dormant feelings, memories, or instincts from a sleep-like state (memories / fears / curiosity) · resurrect: dramatically bring back from the dead an abandoned concept or custom (career / proposal / debate) · spark off: trigger a rapid chain reaction of explosive events or feelings (riots / controversy / trend)
groups.nuance_zh: rekindle: 拨亮微炭般重温旧情或重拾昔日兴趣 (romance / passion / interest) · reignite: 激烈引发已平息的争论、冲突或雄心 (controversy / debate / hopes) · reawaken: 唤醒沉睡已久的潜伏记忆、恐惧或本能 (memories / fears / curiosity) · resurrect: 起死回生般使彻底废弃的案子或职业重见天日 (career / proposal / debate) · spark off: 闪电引爆一系列连锁抗议或冲突事件 (riots / controversy / trend)

groups.name: Release & Emit Volatiles · 释放与脱气 (Outgas, Degas, Exude)
groups.tip: 物质从表面解吸并释放

items.def_zh: 释放出气体（尤指真空或受热时）
items.def_en: To release or give off a gas or vapor, especially from a solid or liquid under reduced pressure or heat
items.ex_en: The polymer seal outgassed hazardous volatile organic compounds in the vacuum chamber.
items.ex_zh: 聚合物密封件在真空室中释放出危险的挥发性有机化合物。
items.ex2_en: New interior materials outgas significantly when exposed to the hot desert climate.
items.ex2_zh: 新型内饰材料在暴露于炎热的沙漠气候中时会大量散发出气体。

items.def_zh: 慢慢放掉，排泄（系统内的多余气体或压力）
items.def_en: To slowly and deliberately release excess gas, fluid, or pressure from a closed system
items.ex_en: Technicians opened the valve to bleed off dangerous excess pressure safely.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员打开阀门，安全地排泄掉危险的过剩压力。

items.def_en: To remove dissolved or entrapped gas from a liquid, vacuum system, or solid material
items.ex_en: The metallurgist degassed the molten alloy to eliminate hidden structural flaws.
items.ex_zh: 冶金师对熔融合金进行了脱气处理，以消除潜在的结构缺陷。

items.def_en: To extract an adsorbed substance from a solid adsorbent by washing with a solvent
items.ex_en: The chemist eluted the absorbed protein molecules with an acidic buffer solution.
items.ex_zh: 化学家用酸性缓冲液洗脱了吸附的蛋白质分子。

items.def_en: (of a gas) To escape or pass through a tiny hole into an area of lower pressure
items.ex_en: Compressed helium effused steadily through the microscopic fracture in the vessel wall.
items.ex_zh: 压缩氦气透过容器壁上的微小裂缝稳定地泻流而出。
items.ex2_en: The technician opened the valve to effuse the trapped gas safely into air.
items.ex2_zh: 技术人员打开阀门，将截留的气体安全地释放到空气中。

items.def_en: (chemistry / physics) To release or remove an adsorbed substance from a surface, or to be released from a surface.
items.ex_en: Higher temperatures caused the trapped moisture to desorb from the porous clay.
items.ex_zh: 高温促使滞留的水分从多孔黏土中脱附出来。
items.ex2_en: Chemists applied intense thermal energy to desorb hazardous compounds from the filter.
items.ex2_zh: 化学家施加高温热能，以将有害化合物从过滤器中解吸出来。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scientific and physical frame describe the release, expulsion, or removal of trapped, dissolved, or surface-bound gases, vapors, and chemical substances. Collocations typically center on materials, pressure changes, thermal reactions, and chemical extraction.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及材料科学或化学中排出、释放被吸附或溶解的气体与微小物质的过程。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the deliberate, physical, or chemical emission and purging of trapped gases, vapors, or volatile components from solid materials or closed systems, contrasting with general liquid pouring.
groups.desc_zh: 指固相材料或封闭系统内部所截留气体、挥发物或吸附质的物理脱附、逸出与泄放，不同于一般的液体倾泻。
groups.nuance_en: outgas: release trapped gases from solid materials under vacuum or heat (polymers / coating / spacecraft) · degas: intentionally remove dissolved gases from a liquid or melt (solvent / metal / wine) · bleed off: gradually discharge excess trapped gas or hydraulic pressure safely (pressure / charge / steam) · desorb: release an adsorbed substance from a surface through thermodynamic changes (gas / ions / moisture) · effuse: escape of gas through a microscopic hole into a vacuum (gas / molecules / helium)
groups.nuance_zh: outgas: 固体材料在真空或加热条件下自然向外释放内部吸附气体 (polymers / coating / spacecraft) · degas: 主动脱除液体、溶剂或熔体中的溶解气体 (solvent / metal / wine) · bleed off: 逐渐安全放掉管道或容器中过剩的气压或流体 (pressure / charge / steam) · desorb: 热力学上从吸附剂表面使解吸释放 (gas / ions / moisture) · effuse: 气体分子通过微孔向外向真空扩散泻出 (gas / molecules / helium)

groups.name: Relief & Printmaking Techniques · 雕版与压印印制 (Emboss, Stencil, Lithograph)
groups.tip: 借助模板与压力拓印图案

items.def_en: to print patterns or text onto paper or textiles using hand-carved wooden blocks
items.ex_en: The artisan block-printed intricate floral motifs along the length of fine silk.
items.ex_zh: 手工艺人在上乘丝绸上雕版印制出复杂的精美花卉图案。

items.def_en: to force ink through a prepared screen of fine mesh onto a substrate
items.ex_en: The studio screenprints each limited poster using specially blended metallic inks.
items.ex_zh: 该工作室使用特制的金属油墨丝网印刷每一张限量版海报。

items.def_zh: 用模板（孔版）印制，用镂花模板绘制
items.def_en: to paint, draw, or print letters or designs on a surface using a stencil.
items.ex_en: Volunteers stenciled parking zone numbers along the curbs of the street.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者们用镂花模板沿着街边的路缘印上停车区编号。

items.def_en: to engrave or print designs through incisions sunken below the surface
items.ex_en: The engraver intaglioed delicate floral flourishes deep within the polished copper plate.
items.ex_zh: 雕刻师在磨光的铜版深处凹雕出精致的花卉纹饰。

items.def_zh: 在……上压印浮雕（或凸纹），压花
items.def_en: to decorate a surface with a raised design, pattern, or lettering stamped into it.
items.ex_en: The binder embossed the antique leather journal with shimmering golden lettering.
items.ex_zh: 装订师在古董皮革日记本上压印出闪闪发光的金色字样。

items.def_en: to print pictures or text using the process of lithography.
items.ex_en: Nineteenth-century naturalists lithographed vivid anatomical illustrations for medical encyclopedias.
items.ex_zh: 十九世纪的博物学家用石印术为医学百科全书印刷生动的解剖图解。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe specialized printing and surface-decorating crafts—such as raising reliefs, masking cutouts, or transferring chemical impressions onto paper, metal, or fabric.
groups.summary_zh: 指浮雕、网版漏印、石版平印等特定版画与印制工艺加工。
groups.desc_en: Denotes transferring graphics or ink onto a surface through specialized relief, incised, chemical, or perforated mechanical matrices, contrasting with freehand drawing or flat digital printing.
groups.desc_zh: 指借助凸版、凹版、化学平版或孔版镂空等特定制版印制技术将图文转印至承载物，不同于徒手绘制或数码直喷。
groups.nuance_en: emboss: press a raised relief design onto paper, leather, or metal without necessarily using ink (seal / logo / paper) · stencil: apply pigment through cut-out apertures of an impervious sheet (letters / pattern / design) · screenprint: squeeze ink through mesh fabric masked with a photo-stencil (posters / shirts / textiles) · lithograph: print from a flat chemical stone or zinc plate using oil-water repellence (illustrations / poster / print) · block-print: stamp repeating designs onto fabric or paper using carved relief blocks (fabric / paper / pattern)
groups.nuance_zh: emboss: 压印形成高出纸面或皮面的浮雕立体花纹 (seal / logo / paper) · stencil: 借由镂空模板刷涂漏印出字母或图案 (letters / pattern / design) · screenprint: 丝网孔版刮印油墨印制 (posters / shirts / textiles) · lithograph: 利用油水互斥原理从平滑石版或金属板转印 (illustrations / poster / print) · block-print: 用雕刻好的木凸版盖印图案于织物或纸张上 (fabric / paper / pattern)

groups.name: Relinquish Grip & Free Restraints · 撒手与松开扣件 (Let go, Unleash, Unclasp)
groups.tip: 解除外力束缚使其脱困自由

items.def_zh: 释放，放开；解除，免除；发布，发行
items.def_en: 1. To set free someone or something from confinement, control, or restraint. 2. To stop holding something and let it go. 3. To make information, a movie, or a product publicly available.
items.ex_en: The wildlife sanctuary released two rehabilitated sea turtles into open waters.
items.ex_zh: 野生动物保护区将两只康复的海龟释放到开阔水域中。

items.def_en: To cease holding something deliberately so that it falls or is left behind
items.ex_en: He dropped the heavy parcel onto the floor with a loud thud.
items.ex_zh: 他手一松，把沉重的包裹掉在地上，发出一声巨响。
items.ex2_en: Temperatures dropped dramatically overnight across the entire northern mountainous region.
items.ex2_zh: 整个北部山区一夜之间气温急剧下降。

items.def_en: (+ of) To stop holding, grasping, or gripping something or someone
items.ex_en: The frightened hiker refused to let go of the sturdy safety rope.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的徒步旅行者抓紧坚固的安全绳，不肯放手。

items.def_zh: 松开（紧握的双臂、手）；解开（扣环）
items.def_en: To open or release a clasp, or to loosen a tight grip with hands or arms
items.ex_en: The mother gently unclasped her arms from around her sleeping child.
items.ex_zh: 母亲轻轻松开环抱着熟睡孩子的双臂。
items.ex2_en: The rusty metal latch unclasped smoothly once the locksmith sprayed some oil.
items.ex2_zh: 锁匠喷了些油后，生锈的金属弹簧搭扣顺利地解开了。

items.def_en: To untie, unfasten, or set completely free from physical bonds
items.ex_en: The herdsman unloosed the tethered hounds to roam the open hillside.
items.ex_zh: 牧人解开拴着的猎犬，任由它们在开阔的山坡上漫游。

items.def_zh: 脱开，解脱（啮合或扣合的部件）
items.def_en: To release or detach a mechanical component from another connected part
items.ex_en: The operator stepped on the pedal to disengage the main mechanical gear.
items.ex_zh: 操作员踩下踏板，使主机械齿轮脱开啮合。
items.ex2_en: The automated locking mechanism disengaged smoothly once the power supply was cut.
items.ex2_zh: 电源一旦切断，自动锁定机构便顺利脱开。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this manual and physical control frame denote the deliberate cessation of grasping, holding, clutching, or mechanical fastening. They describe letting go of objects, slackening mechanical latches, or terminating direct physical grip.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动松开手部抓握、解除机械卡扣或停止物理束缚的动作。
groups.desc_en: Denotes physically releasing one's manual grip, unfastening a mechanical latch, or detaching restrained elements to allow free movement, contrasting with continuing to grasp or bind.
groups.desc_zh: 指松开手部抓握、解开机械卡扣或解除束缚物使对象脱离受控状态，不同于持续紧抓或捆扎。
groups.nuance_en: let go: voluntarily release physical hold or yield emotional control (handle / rope / fear) · release: free from physical containment, capture, or tension (hostage / brake / grip) · unclasp: unfasten a latch, buckle, or parting tightly locked hands (hands / necklace / buckle) · disengage: mechanically uncouple interlocking gears, or tactically pull out of contact (clutch / gears / troops) · unloose: completely untie, loosen restraints, or unleash unrestrained energy (bonds / ropes / fury)
groups.nuance_zh: let go: 主动松开手部抓握或放下心理执念 (handle / rope / fear) · release: 释放被束缚者、松开机械制动器或解除受控张力 (hostage / brake / grip) · unclasp: 解开搭扣、饰针或松开紧扣的十指 (hands / necklace / buckle) · disengage: 离合器脱离啮合、拔出卡榫或撤退脱离接触 (clutch / gears / troops) · unloose: 解开绳结约束或彻底任由情绪怒火迸发 (bonds / ropes / fury)

groups.name: Remember & Recall · 回忆与想起 (Recall, Recollect, Reminisce)
groups.tip: 留存或重新唤醒记忆

items.def_en: (+ to) To direct one's thoughts back to past events or periods
items.ex_en: Thinking back to my early days in the industry, I made so many mistakes.
items.ex_zh: 回想起我刚入行时的那些日子，我犯过很多错误。

items.def_zh: 记得，记起；记住，牢记；代向……致意
items.def_en: 1. To have a memory of a past person, event, or fact in your mind. 2. To not forget to do something. 3. (formal) To convey greetings from one person to another.
items.ex_en: She remembered locking the front door before leaving for work this morning.
items.ex_zh: 她记得今天早上去上班前锁好了前门。

items.def_en: To bring a specific past fact, image, or circumstance back into the conscious mind
items.ex_en: The witness tried to recall the precise sequence of events that evening.
items.ex_zh: 目击者试图回想起那天晚上一连串事件的精确顺序。

items.def_en: (+ about) To talk, think, or write about past experiences with fondness
items.ex_en: The retired sailors sat together and reminisced about life on the oceans.
items.ex_zh: 退役水手们坐在一起，缅怀过往的海上生活。

items.def_en: To summon a memory back to mind, often with conscious mental effort
items.ex_en: The elderly professor could hardly recollect where he placed his lecture notes.
items.ex_zh: 老教授几乎想不起自己把讲义放在哪里了。

items.def_en: To bring vivid memories or impressions sharply into the conscious mind
items.ex_en: The nostalgic melody conjured up vivid memories of childhood summer holidays.
items.ex_zh: 那充满怀旧感的旋律在脑海中勾起了儿时暑假的生动记忆。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the cognitive act of bringing previously acquired knowledge, perceptions, or personal memories back into conscious thought.
groups.summary_zh: 指将过去的经历、事实或感知自记忆中提取至意识中的心理过程。
groups.desc_en: Denotes intentionally or spontaneously retrieving, narrating, or reconstructing past memories and experiences within consciousness, contrasting with prospective thinking or forgetting.
groups.desc_zh: 指在大脑意识中有意识或自发地检索、重构或叙述过往的记忆与经历，不同于展望未来或遗忘。
groups.nuance_en: remember: retain in or retrieve knowledge from memory effortlessly (name / date / incident) · recall: consciously extract specific historical facts, details, or names to mind (details / events / address) · recollect: deliberately piece together half-forgotten or fragmented memories through mental effort (past / incident / thoughts) · reminisce: indulge in fond, talkative, or nostalgic storytelling about the past (youth / school days / past) · conjure up: vividly evoke an imaginative or spectral image from memory (image / memories / vision)
groups.nuance_zh: remember: 头脑自发保有或忆起特定信息或诺言 (name / date / incident) · recall: 有意识地从记忆库中提取具体历史事件、细节或名单 (details / events / address) · recollect: 努力在脑海中拼接拼凑已模糊的零碎记忆 (past / incident / thoughts) · reminisce: 充满温情、怀旧且乐于倾诉地畅谈往事 (youth / school days / past) · conjure up: 历历在目地勾勒、唤起如在眼前的记忆意象 (image / memories / vision)

groups.name: Remodel, Revamp & Restructure · 重塑与再造 (Remodel, Revamp, Overhaul)
groups.tip: 重新铸型与结构改造

items.def_zh: 调整结构；重组（企业体制、债务等）
items.def_en: To alter the basic organizational, operational, or financial framework of an institution or plan
items.ex_en: The bank agreed to restructure the corporation's crippling multi-million-dollar debt.
items.ex_zh: 银行同意对该企业数百万美元的严重债务进行重组。

items.def_zh: 全面检修；彻底革新（体系、机制）
items.def_en: To thoroughly examine and make necessary structural repairs, adjustments, or systemic reforms
items.ex_en: The ministry launched a major initiative to overhaul the obsolete healthcare system.
items.ex_zh: 该部门发起了一项重大举措，旨在全面革新陈旧的医疗保健体系。

items.def_en: To modernize, improve, or reconstruct the outward form or features of something to make it more appealing
items.ex_en: The studio plans to revamp the website to attract a younger audience.
items.ex_zh: 工作室计划翻新网站，以吸引更年轻的受众群体。

items.def_zh: 改造；重新塑造（房屋结构、组织模式）
items.def_en: To change the physical structure, layout, or design of an existing building, room, or conceptual system
items.ex_en: The architects were hired to remodel the historic library's interior layout completely.
items.ex_zh: 建筑师受聘彻底改造这座历史悠久的图书馆的内部布局。

items.def_en: To alter the overall character, trajectory, or physical shape of something substantially
items.ex_en: Emerging artificial intelligence technologies will reshape the future landscape of higher education.
items.ex_zh: 新兴的人工智能技术将重塑高等教育的未来格局。

items.def_zh: 重塑，改造；改写；重铸；重新选派（角色）
items.def_en: 1. To change, adapt, or reorganize something into a new form. 2. To melt metal again and pour it into a mold. 3. To assign a new actor or group of actors to a play, film, or role.
items.ex_en: The author recast the original tragedy into a lighthearted satirical stage comedy.
items.ex_zh: 作者将原本的悲剧改写成了一部轻松幽默的讽刺舞台喜剧。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe giving a significantly new structure, appearance, or operating format to a system, policy, argument, or physical entity. They stress transforming pre-existing material or conceptual foundations into a refined or modern iteration.
groups.summary_zh: 强调对原有构架、方案或实物进行脱胎换骨式的修改、重构与翻新。
groups.desc_en: Denotes taking an existing physical, organizational, or conceptual entity and profoundly altering its form, structural blueprint, or functional arrangement to modernize or optimize it.
groups.desc_zh: 指对现有的物理、组织或观念实体进行深层的形态重塑、架构重组或功能重构以求革新，区别于小修小补。
groups.nuance_en: restructure: reorganize the internal architecture, debt, or hierarchy of an organization (debt / company / department) · overhaul: thoroughly examine, disassemble, and repair/rebuild a machine or system (system / engine / policy) · revamp: renovate cosmetically or structurally to give a modern, appealing edge (website / image / portfolio) · remodel: alter the architectural layout or design structure of a building or room (kitchen / home / system) · recast: alter the formulation, role-assignment, or framing of an idea or drama (role / question / argument)
groups.nuance_zh: restructure: 重组企业债务、内部层级或架构 (debt / company / department) · overhaul: 彻底拆卸检修机器、系统或彻查政策缺陷进行大修 (system / engine / policy) · revamp: 翻新改造以呈现现代化且具吸引力的新风貌 (website / image / portfolio) · remodel: 改动建筑物格局、室内空间结构或设计 (kitchen / home / system) · recast: 重新设定叙述框架、角色人选或换角度阐述问题 (role / question / argument)

groups.name: Remorse & Contrition · 后悔与忏悔 (Repent, Rue, Atone)
groups.tip: 从内心惋惜遗憾升级为痛改前非

items.def_en: Feel intensely annoyed and frustrated with oneself for making an obvious mistake
items.ex_en: I kicked myself for forgetting to save the final draft before rebooting.
items.ex_zh: 我真懊恼自己在重启之前竟然忘了保存最终草稿。

items.def_en: To feel sadness, remorse, or disappointment over something that has happened or been done, especially a mistake.
items.ex_en: I deeply regret selling my childhood home during such a difficult financial period.
items.ex_zh: 我非常后悔在那样艰难的经济时期卖掉了自己童年时的家。

items.def_en: Express passionate sorrow, deep regret, or mourning over an unfortunate event
items.ex_en: Historians continue to lament the tragic destruction of ancient libraries and cultural artifacts.
items.ex_zh: 历史学家们继续为古代图书馆和文化文物的悲剧性毁灭而痛惜。

items.def_en: Bitterly regret a past action, decision, or missed opportunity
items.ex_en: He would bitterly rue the fateful decision to ignore his mentor's solemn warning.
items.ex_zh: 他将对自己无视导师郑重警告的这一宿命决定追悔莫及。

items.def_en: Feel deep sorrow and contrition for one's sins or wrongdoing, resolving to reform
items.ex_en: The convicted felon truly repented of his cruel deeds before receiving the sentence.
items.ex_zh: 这名被定罪的重犯在听取判决前真心为自己的残酷行径悔过。

items.def_en: (+ for) Make amends or reparation for a serious fault, wrong, or sin
items.ex_en: The disgraced executive attempted to atone for his severe negligence through charitable donations.
items.ex_zh: 这位名誉扫地的高管试图通过慈善捐款来弥补自己的严重过失。

groups.summary_en: This spectrum tracks the inner pangs of guilt, remorse, and deep self-reproach, escalating from wistful regret over a mistake to moral contrition and penitent self-abasement.
groups.summary_zh: 刻画从对过失的惋惜遗憾，上升至触及灵魂的愧疚、痛悔与忏悔。
groups.desc_en: Denotes emotional distress, self-reproach, and moral reckoning over a past transgression, error, or missed opportunity, scaling from private rueful annoyance to deep spiritual penitence.
groups.desc_zh: 指因过去的过失、罪愆或错失良机而在内心产生的痛苦自责与道德清算，从懊悔恼怒升华至深刻的宗教忏悔与赎罪。
groups.nuance_en: kick oneself: informally reproach oneself with acute annoyance over a foolish slip or missed chance (slip-up / mistake / blunder) · regret: experience sorrow, dissatisfaction, or polite cognitive grief over an act or outcome (decision / words / departure) · rue: bitterly and fruitlessly lament the inevitable bitter harvest of an unwise choice (day / choice / action) · repent: undergo sincere moral or spiritual transformation and remorse for a sin (sins / past / lifestyle) · atone: take concrete restorative action or undergo suffering to expiate guilt (sin / crime / neglect)
groups.nuance_zh: kick oneself: 口语中因一时愚蠢或痛失良机而气恼得捶胸顿足 (slip-up / mistake / blunder) · regret: 为既成事实或遗憾结果感到痛心、惋惜或抱歉 (decision / words / departure) · rue: 抱恨饮泣地痛悔某项不智举动带来的惨痛苦果 (day / choice / action) · repent: 彻底痛改前非、真诚忏悔道德或宗教过失 (sins / past / lifestyle) · atone: 付出实际代价或补救行动以赎罪弥补 (sin / crime / neglect)

groups.name: Renounce & Abdicate · 放弃与退位 (Abdicate, Relinquish, Renounce)
groups.tip: 主动声明放弃权利或王位退位

items.def_en: Resign or withdraw formally from an important official post or leadership role
items.ex_en: The CEO decided to step down after a decade of leading the corporation.
items.ex_zh: 执掌公司十年后，首席执行官决定引咎辞职。

items.def_en: Withdraw from a contest, position, or command to let someone else take over
items.ex_en: The CEO decided to stand down after the company's financial scandal was exposed.
items.ex_zh: 公司财务丑闻曝光后，首席执行官决定引咎辞职。

items.def_zh: 声明放弃（头衔、权利或信仰）
items.def_en: Formally state that one gives up any claim to a position, right, or belief
items.ex_en: The young prince chose to renounce his hereditary claim to the royal throne.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻的王子选择宣布放弃自己对王位的世袭继承权。

items.def_zh: 被迫放弃，交出（权力或控制）
items.def_en: Voluntarily cease to keep, claim, or maintain control over power or authority
items.ex_en: Under intense political pressure, the dictator reluctantly relinquished absolute control over the armed forces.
items.ex_zh: 在巨大的政治压力下，这位独裁者被迫交出了对军队的绝对控制权。

items.def_en: Give up control, territory, or sovereign rights formally to another party
items.ex_en: Following the peace treaty, the defeated nation agreed to cede contested border territories.
items.ex_zh: 和约签订后，战败国同意割让具有争议的边境领土。

items.def_zh: 正式退位，放弃王位；放弃（职责、权力）
items.def_en: 1. To formally give up the throne or royal authority. 2. To fail to carry out or abandon an important duty or responsibility.
items.ex_en: The monarch chose to abdicate the imperial throne due to deteriorating personal health.
items.ex_zh: 由于个人健康状况恶化，这位君主选择正式放弃帝位退位。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe formally surrendering a high office, sovereign power, or vital duty, either through constitutional procedure or an explicit disavowal of authority.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及正式放弃王位、职权或重要法定职责。
groups.desc_en: Denotes formally, legally, or voluntarily surrendering a sovereign throne, executive power, or claimed title under public or political circumstances, contrasting with being violently ousted.
groups.desc_zh: 指在公权力或政治语境下，正式、合法或自愿放弃王位、国家权力或既有法定权利，不同于被武力政变剥夺。
groups.nuance_en: abdicate: formally renounce the monarchical throne, royal duty, or fundamental responsibility (throne / crown / responsibility) · step down: resign or vacate a prominent leadership post voluntarily (leader / post / position) · renounce: publicly surrender a legal right, royal claim, or citizenship (claim / title / citizenship) · relinquish: reluctantly give up physical control, custody, or authority to another (control / command / power) · cede: formally yield territory, legal rights, or jurisdiction to another state through treaty (territory / power / sovereignty)
groups.nuance_zh: abdicate: 君王正式宣布退位，或推卸不可推卸的重大职责 (throne / crown / responsibility) · step down: 自愿从领导高位卸任、退位让贤 (leader / post / position) · renounce: 公开且正式声明放弃王位继承权、法定权利或国籍 (claim / title / citizenship) · relinquish: 不情愿但不得不移交权力、控制权或监护权 (control / command / power) · cede: 依据条约正式割让领土、让与司法管辖权或主权 (territory / power / sovereignty)

groups.name: Renounce & Disavow · 宣布放弃与弃绝 (Disavow, Repudiate, Abdicate)
groups.tip: 主动宣布放弃权利或职责

items.def_zh: 宣布放弃（权利、头衔等）；声明脱离关系，断绝
items.def_en: 1. To formally and publicly give up a claim, right, title, or position. 2. To state formally that one no longer believes in, follows, or supports something.
items.ex_en: The diplomat formally renounced all ties with the extremist regime during the conference.
items.ex_zh: 那位外交官在会议期间正式宣布与极端主义政权断绝一切关系。

items.def_en: To willingly surrender ownership, control, or a legal claim to another party
items.ex_en: The founder agreed to relinquish all legal ownership of the patent to investors.
items.ex_zh: 创始人同意自愿将该专利的所有合法所有权转让给投资者。

items.def_en: To formally resign from high sovereign office, monarchy, or critical duty
items.ex_en: The weary sovereign chose to abdicate high office amid mounting civil unrest nationwide.
items.ex_zh: 在全国日益高涨的民间动荡中，心力交瘁的君主选择辞去最高统治职位。

items.def_en: To state publicly that you have no knowledge of or responsibility for something
items.ex_en: The spokesperson hastened to disavow the controversial remarks made by the junior senator.
items.ex_zh: 发言人赶紧公开否认并拒绝对那位初级参议员的争议言论负责。

items.def_zh: 驳斥；断绝关系；拒绝承认
items.def_en: To refuse decisively to accept, believe, or have any association with something
items.ex_en: The scientist was quick to repudiate the fraudulent data published under her name.
items.ex_zh: 这位科学家迅速驳斥并拒不承认以她名义发表的造假数据。

items.def_en: To state solemnly and publicly, often under oath, that you renounce a belief or cause
items.ex_en: The dissident was compelled to abjure her political beliefs under severe judicial duress.
items.ex_zh: 在严厉的司法胁迫下，这位异见人士被迫立誓放弃自己的政治信仰。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate deliberate, public, and formal acts of giving up claims, doctrines, allegiances, or official sovereign roles.
groups.summary_zh: 指正式、公开地声明放弃权利、王位、信仰或否认干系。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an explicit, uncompromising public statement cutting ties with, disowning, or repudiating a previously held belief, sworn pledge, ally, or scandalous claim, contrasting with ambiguous hedging.
groups.desc_zh: 指公开发表决绝声明，坚决切断关联、弃绝誓言信仰、宣布不认同盟或否认丑闻干系，不同于模棱两可的回避。
groups.nuance_en: disavow: deny knowledge of, connection with, or responsibility for an embarrassing act or entity (knowledge / statement / connection) · repudiate: forcefully reject the truth, validity, or authority of a charge, contract, or person (allegations / debt / treaty) · renounce: solemnly declare a permanent, principled abandonment of a doctrine or allegiance (violence / faith / allegiance) · abjure: formally, often under oath, recant a solemn religious faith, heresy, or claim (faith / realm / allegiance)
groups.nuance_zh: disavow: 彻底否认某争议言论与自己有牵连，拒不承认责任 (knowledge / statement / connection) · repudiate: 坚决驳斥指控之真实性，或拒不认账、撕毁合同条约 (allegations / debt / treaty) · renounce: 出于道德信仰立场公开放弃某种教条、暴力手段或效忠誓言 (violence / faith / allegiance) · abjure: 在宣誓等极庄严场合下公开放弃背离异端、信仰或旧籍 (faith / realm / allegiance)

groups.name: Renovate & Modernize · 修缮与翻新 (Refurbish, Revamp, Renovate)
groups.tip: 重新整修焕然一新

items.def_en: To make someone or something look neater, cleaner, or more attractive with minor improvements
items.ex_en: We bought fresh flowers and colorful cushions to spruce up the guest bedroom.
items.ex_zh: 我们买了鲜花和彩色靠垫，把客房稍微打扮装饰了一下。

items.def_en: To restore a building, room, or structure to good condition by repairing and remodeling
items.ex_en: The local council allocated substantial funds to renovate the historic municipal library completely.
items.ex_zh: 地方议会拨出大笔资金，用于全面整修翻新这座历史悠久的市政图书馆。

items.def_en: To change and improve the appearance, structure, or function of something thoroughly
items.ex_en: The tech firm decided to revamp its mobile application to attract younger users.
items.ex_zh: 这家科技公司决定全面改造其移动应用程序，以吸引更年轻的用户。

items.def_en: To change the internal structure, layout, or decorative style of a room or building
items.ex_en: They hired a licensed architect to remodel the cramped kitchen into an open layout.
items.ex_zh: 他们聘请了一位持证建筑师，将狭窄的厨房改造成开放式格局。

items.def_en: To clean, repair, or redecorate a building, room, or piece of equipment to restore it to good condition.
items.ex_en: The heritage trust invested millions to refurbish the aging theater to its former glory.
items.ex_zh: 遗产信托基金投入数百万资金翻修这座老化的剧院，重现其往日辉煌。

items.def_en: To return a derelict building or neglected area to a usable, functional state
items.ex_en: Urban planners launched an ambitious project to rehabilitate the abandoned industrial docklands.
items.ex_zh: 城市规划者启动了一项宏大的项目，旨在对废弃的工业码头区进行整治复原。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses updating, upgrading, and aesthetically restoring properties, facilities, or machines to modern standards and pristine working condition.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重建筑、设备或空间的升级翻新、装潢改造与重焕新生。
groups.desc_en: Denotes restoring a dilapidated building, outdated space, or tired interior to a fresh, fully functional, and modernized state, contrasting with tearing down and rebuilding from scratch.
groups.desc_zh: 指将破败、老化或过时的房屋建筑、内饰设备整修并赋予现代风貌与实用机能，不同于彻底拆除重建。
groups.nuance_en: renovate: structurally restore and modernize an old house or infrastructure (building / home / stadium) · refurbish: redecorate, refurnish, and polish equipment or premises to like-new condition (hotel / equipment / offices) · spruce up: make neat, tidy, and aesthetically brighter with quick superficial touch-ups (room / garden / image) · remodel: alter the architectural structure, spatial plan, or layout of rooms (kitchen / bathroom / apartment) · rehabilitate: restore a derelict historic property to structural soundness and habitable utility (building / warehouse / dockland)
groups.nuance_zh: renovate: 对老旧房屋或市政建筑进行系统性的结构翻新与现代化改造 (building / home / stadium) · refurbish: 重新粉刷陈设、修整设备以使物业焕然一新 (hotel / equipment / offices) · spruce up: 通过快速简单的打扫装点使空间整洁亮堂 (room / garden / image) · remodel: 改动房屋室内格局、动线与空间设计 (kitchen / bathroom / apartment) · rehabilitate: 将废弃已久的历史建筑或工业遗迹改造修复至可使用状态 (building / warehouse / dockland)

groups.name: Repair & Restore · 修理与修复 (Repair, Mend, Patch up)
groups.tip: 修补损坏使其恢复功能

items.def_en: To perform routine maintenance or minor repairs on a vehicle, appliance, or machine
items.ex_en: You should regularly service your vehicle to prevent costly engine breakdowns on trips.
items.ex_zh: 你应该定期保养车辆，以防止旅途中出现代价高昂的发动机故障。

items.def_zh: 修理，修复；使固定；确定，安排
items.def_en: 1. To repair or mend something that is broken, damaged, or not working properly. 2. To fasten, attach, or place firmly. 3. To arrange, decide on, or set a time or date.
items.ex_en: The technician arrived quickly to fix the leaking pipe underneath the kitchen sink.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员迅速赶到，修理了厨房水槽下方漏水的管道。

items.def_en: To restore something damaged, faulty, or worn to good condition or working order
items.ex_en: Specialized engineers were deployed to repair the structural damage on the suspension bridge.
items.ex_zh: 专业工程师被派去修复悬索桥上的结构性损坏。

items.def_en: To repair something roughly, temporarily, or by covering holes or damaged areas
items.ex_en: He managed to patch up the leaking tent fabric with some heavy-duty waterproof tape.
items.ex_zh: 他用一些强力防水胶带勉强将漏雨的帐篷布修补了一下。

items.def_en: To thoroughly examine and make extensive repairs or adjustments to a machine or system
items.ex_en: The maintenance crew had to overhaul the aircraft engine before clearing it for flight.
items.ex_zh: 维修人员必须对飞机发动机进行彻底大修，然后才能批准飞行。

items.def_en: To repair a tear, break, or injury, especially in cloth, simple items, or bones
items.ex_en: My grandmother taught me how to mend worn socks using a wooden darning egg.
items.ex_zh: 我祖母教我如何用木制织补蛋来缝补穿破的袜子。
items.ex2_en: The fractured arm bone should mend naturally within six to eight weeks.
items.ex2_zh: 骨折的手臂骨骼应该在六到八周内自然愈合。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to returning damaged, broken, or malfunctioning objects or systems back to working order, ranging from quick everyday remedies to systematic mechanical overhauls.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖将受损或故障之物恢复正常运转的各类修理与修复行为。
groups.desc_en: Denotes restoring a damaged, malfunctioning, or worn object or relationship to working order or structural integrity, contrasting with mere creation ('build') or complete replacement ('replace').
groups.desc_zh: 指将受损、故障或破损的物品或关系恢复至可用状态或结构完整性，区别于从无到有的创造（build）或全盘替代（replace）。
groups.nuance_en: fix: general, informal restoration of functionality (leak / car / bug) · repair: formal restoration of physical structure or impaired faculties (bridge / tissue / relationship) · mend: repairing small tears, garments, or fractured health/relations (clothes / bones / fences) · patch up: makeshift, temporary repair or superficial reconciliation (quarrel / tire / wound) · overhaul: thorough dismantling, inspection, and rebuilding (engine / system / economy) · service: routine preventative maintenance of machinery (boiler / car / equipment)
groups.nuance_zh: fix: 最通用的口语修复，重在恢复功能 (leak / car / bug) · repair: 正式修缮，侧重物理结构或受损机能的实质性修复 (bridge / tissue / relationship) · mend: 缝补织物，或修合裂痕与创伤 (clothes / bones / fences) · patch up: 权宜打补丁或敷衍化解矛盾 (quarrel / tire / wound) · overhaul: 全面拆解大修或彻底重整 (engine / system / economy) · service: 机器设备的定期维护保养 (boiler / car / equipment)

groups.name: Repay & Reciprocate · 回报与酬谢 (Requite, Reciprocate, Reward)
groups.tip: 对善意或付出予以报答

items.def_en: To give someone something good because they have worked hard or achieved something significant
items.ex_en: The company decided to reward outstanding employees with generous annual cash bonuses.
items.ex_zh: 公司决定用丰厚的年度现金奖金来奖励优秀的员工。

items.def_en: To give something to someone as an award or compensation for effort, loss, or injury
items.ex_en: The insurance firm promised to recompense the homeowners for flood-related property damages.
items.ex_zh: 保险公司承诺对屋主因洪水遭受的财产损失进行赔偿。

items.def_en: To pay back money that you have borrowed, or to do something pleasant for someone who has helped you
items.ex_en: I will gladly help you move tomorrow to repay your kind assistance last week.
items.ex_zh: 我很乐意明天帮你搬家，以报答你上周对我的善意相助。

items.def_en: To share the same feelings as someone else, or to behave towards someone in the same way they have behaved towards you
items.ex_en: She felt awkward because she could not reciprocate his passionate expressions of romantic love.
items.ex_zh: 她感到很尴尬，因为她无法对他的炽热示爱给予同样的情感回应。

items.def_en: To pay someone for work that they have done or services provided
items.ex_en: The university agreed to remunerate the guest lecturers according to standard institutional rates.
items.ex_zh: 大学同意按照标准的机构费率向客座讲师支付报酬。

items.def_en: (formal or literary) To give something in return for a favor, kindness, or love, or to retaliate for a wrong.
items.ex_en: The brave knight swore to requite the grievous insult against his noble house.
items.ex_zh: 这位勇敢的骑士誓要对针对其尊贵家族的沉重侮辱进行报复。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to giving something back in return for a favor, benefit, service, or even an injury. While requite carries an elevated, literary tone often linked to love or revenge, synonyms range from formal contractual reimbursement to mutual social reciprocation.
groups.summary_zh: 表示对善意、恩惠或行为予以回报、酬谢或报答。
groups.desc_en: Denotes returning an equivalent value, favor, injury, or payment to balance a moral or transactional ledger, contrasting with unilateral granting ('give') or mere financial disbursement ('pay').
groups.desc_zh: 指返还对等的报酬、恩惠、伤害或款项以平衡道义或交易账目，区别于单向赋予（give）或纯粹的支出（pay）。
groups.nuance_en: reward: giving an incentive or prize for merit or service (effort / loyalty / behavior) · repay: returning borrowed funds or reciprocating kindness/injury (loan / kindness / debt) · reciprocate: mutual matching of feelings, gestures, or actions (feelings / hospitality / gesture) · remunerate: formal monetary compensation for labor or services rendered (employees / services / work) · recompense: making amends or providing financial/moral compensation for loss (victims / losses / damage) · requite: formal or poetic return of love, favor, or retaliatory harm (love / kindness / injury)
groups.nuance_zh: reward: 因功绩或良好表现给予奖赏/报偿 (effort / loyalty / behavior) · repay: 偿还欠款或报答恩惠/报复仇恨 (loan / kindness / debt) · reciprocate: 对等回应彼此的情感、礼遇或举动 (feelings / hospitality / gesture) · remunerate: 对付出劳动或服务给予正式薪资报酬 (employees / services / work) · recompense: 对损失或苦劳进行补偿或赔偿 (victims / losses / damage) · requite: 书面/诗意表达，对爱意、恩惠或伤害做出对等回报或报复 (love / kindness / injury)

groups.name: Repel & Expel · 击退与驱逐 (Repel, Rebough, Ward off)
groups.tip: 打退进攻并彻底逐出界外

items.def_en: To defend oneself against an assault, blow, or unwanted demand
items.ex_en: The exhausted politician struggled to fend off aggressive questions from hostile investigative reporters.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫不堪的政客极力抵挡来自敌意调查记者的咄咄逼人的质问。

items.def_en: To prevent someone or something harmful from approaching or affecting you
items.ex_en: Drinking herbal tea and resting may help ward off persistent winter respiratory infections.
items.ex_zh: 喝草药茶并多休息有助于防止持久的冬季呼吸道感染侵袭。

items.def_zh: 击退，驱逐；抵御，抗拒；使厌恶，使反感；（物理）排斥
items.def_en: 1. To drive back or force away an attacker or enemy. 2. To resist or ward off something. 3. To cause strong feelings of disgust or horror. 4. (physics) To push away another body by magnetic or electrostatic force.
items.ex_en: Fortified garrison troops managed to repel the surprise assault mounted by enemy invaders.
items.ex_zh: 设防的要塞守军成功击退了敌方侵略者发动的突袭。

items.def_en: To reject an offer, approach, or advance in an abrupt and ungracious manner
items.ex_en: The company board decided to rebuff the rival corporation's hostile takeover bid immediately.
items.ex_zh: 公司董事会决定立即断然回绝竞争对手公司的敌意收购要约。

items.def_en: To force an advancing hostile force or intruder to retreat
items.ex_en: The allied troops managed to drive back the enemy vanguard.
items.ex_zh: 盟军部队成功击退了敌方先头部队。

items.def_en: To drive back an attacking army or forceful intrusion through effective resistance
items.ex_en: The coastal defense batteries successfully repulsed the approaching hostile fleet from the harbor.
items.ex_zh: 海岸防御炮台成功打退了逼近港口的敌方舰队进攻。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame evoke active physical or tactical resistance to push oncoming hostile forces, pests, or unwanted advances away from a defended boundary, keeping adversaries at bay.
groups.summary_zh: 武力反抗或设防，将进攻者、侵入者或敌意冲锋强力驱退。
groups.desc_en: Denotes actively parrying, driving back, or holding off an approaching enemy, threat, or unwanted advance, contrasting with passively enduring ('withstand') or surrendering ('yield').
groups.desc_zh: 指主动抵御、击退或挡开逼近的敌人、威胁或不受欢迎的示好，区别于被动承受（withstand）或妥协屈服（yield）。
groups.nuance_en: repel: forcefully driving back an attack or inducing strong physical/visceral aversion (invaders / insects / advances) · repulse: driving back an offensive assault with decisive force (assault / attack / enemy) · fend off: deflecting multiple ongoing attacks, questions, or competitors through agility (blows / questions / rivals) · ward off: proactively averting or keeping away an impending evil or disease (danger / infection / evil) · rebuff: blunt, snubbing refusal of an offer, overture, or advance (advances / offer / proposal) · drive back: forcing advancing military forces or crowds to retreat (troops / crowd / offensive)
groups.nuance_zh: repel: 强力击退来犯，或在物理/感官上产生排斥厌恶 (invaders / insects / advances) · repulse: 以决定性力量粉碎敌方攻势 (assault / attack / enemy) · fend off: 灵活招架并化解连番攻击、提问或竞争者 (blows / questions / rivals) · ward off: 防范、挡开逼近的厄运、疾病或危险 (danger / infection / evil) · rebuff: 斩钉截铁地粗暴拒绝提议、示好或要求 (advances / offer / proposal) · drive back: 迫使敌军或人群步步后撤 (troops / crowd / offensive)

groups.name: Report & Relate · 汇报与陈述 (Report, Relate, Recount)
groups.tip: 向上级或公众汇报陈述情况

items.def_en: 1. To give a spoken or written account of an event, fact, or situation. 2. (+ to/for) To present oneself at a place as required.
items.ex_en: All employees must report any suspicious workplace activity to building security personnel immediately.
items.ex_zh: 所有员工必须立即向大楼安保人员汇报工作场所内的任何可疑活动。

items.def_en: To tell a story, incident, or detailed sequence of events to someone
items.ex_en: The weary survivor sat down to relate the terrifying events of that fateful night.
items.ex_zh: 疲倦的幸存者坐下来，向大家叙述那个宿命之夜的恐怖经过。

items.def_en: To give someone essential information, facts, or instructions in a concise summary
items.ex_en: The commanding officer gathered the tactical squad to brief them on the rescue mission.
items.ex_zh: 指挥官召集了战术小队，向他们简要通报救援任务的核心情况。

items.def_en: (+ to/on) To return and present findings or progress to a superior or commissioning group
items.ex_en: The research team will report back on their laboratory findings to the executive committee.
items.ex_zh: 研究小组将向执行委员会反馈汇报其实验室的研究结果。

items.def_en: To narrate the facts or details of an experience or past event in chronological order
items.ex_en: The elderly veteran began to recount his harrowing experiences during the prolonged arctic campaign.
items.ex_zh: 这位老兵开始详细叙述他在漫长的北极战役中所经历的惨痛往事。

items.def_zh: 听取汇报；盘问任务执行情况
items.def_en: To question someone thoroughly about a completed mission or task to obtain vital information
items.ex_en: Intelligence officers met to debrief the returned operative in an undisclosed secure facility.
items.ex_zh: 情报官员在一个秘密的安全设施中会面，听取归来特工的详细任务汇报。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers delivering an official, detailed, or structured account of events, facts, findings, or narratives to an authority figure, audience, or supervisor.
groups.summary_zh: 指按要求向上级、公众或受众叙述、通报事实与经过。
groups.desc_en: Denotes conveying observed facts, official accounts, or narrative information to an audience or authority, contrasting with casual talking ('speak') or artistic fabrication ('invent').
groups.desc_zh: 指向上级、受众或对方系统汇报观察所得、官方事实或叙述经历，区别于随意交谈（speak）或虚构编造（invent）。
groups.nuance_en: report: formally presenting official facts or findings to superiors/public (findings / progress / crime) · relate: recounting a personal story, event, or sequence of experiences in detail (anecdote / story / experience) · brief: giving concise, preparatory instructions or intelligence beforehand (president / team / troops) · debrief: systematically questioning someone returning from a mission to extract intelligence (astronauts / soldiers / agent) · recount: narrating past events step-by-step from memory (adventures / history / events) · report back: returning to give an update after executing an assigned inquiry (findings / results / team)
groups.nuance_zh: report: 向公众或上级正式汇报调查结果或事实 (findings / progress / crime) · relate: 详细叙述亲身经历、故事或关联事件 (anecdote / story / experience) · brief: 任务前下达简要指示或通报核心情报 (president / team / troops) · debrief: 任务结束后系统询问当事人以调取第一手情报 (astronauts / soldiers / agent) · recount: 凭记忆逐一详叙往昔经历 (adventures / history / events) · report back: 领受任务并调查完毕后回来复命复述 (findings / results / team)

groups.name: Resemble & Mirror · 相似与类同 (Resemble, Echo, Take after)
groups.tip: 样貌相似或彼此相称

items.def_en: To look like or be similar to another person or thing in appearance, character, or qualities.
items.ex_en: The architecture of the new museum closely resembles classical Greek temple design.
items.ex_zh: 这座新博物馆的建筑风格与古希腊神庙的设计极为相似。

items.def_en: To look or behave like an older member of your family
items.ex_en: In terms of patience, she definitely takes after her father.
items.ex_zh: 说到耐心，她显然很像她父亲。

items.def_en: To be extremely similar to something else in development, structure, or outcome
items.ex_en: The country's economic trajectory parallels the development trends observed in neighboring emerging markets.
items.ex_zh: 该国的经济轨迹与在周边新兴市场中观察到的发展趋势极为吻合。

items.def_en: To be reminiscent of or duplicate the style, ideas, or qualities of another
items.ex_en: Her innovative contemporary designs consciously echo the modernist aesthetics of the mid-twentieth century.
items.ex_zh: 她的前卫当代设计自觉呼应了二十世纪中叶的现代主义美学风格。
items.ex2_en: Loud footsteps echoed through the empty marble corridors of the ancient museum.
items.ex2_zh: 响亮的脚步声在古老博物馆空旷的大理石走廊里回荡。

items.def_zh: 模拟，模仿……的外貌或特征
items.def_en: To reproduce the appearance, behavior, or conditions of something
items.ex_en: The virtual reality headset can realistically simulate zero-gravity environments for trainee astronauts.
items.ex_zh: 该虚拟现实头显能够为受训航天员逼真地模拟失重环境条件。

items.def_zh: 反映，极为相似，如实映射
items.def_en: To be very similar to or reflect the exact qualities, patterns, or trends of something else
items.ex_en: Consumer spending patterns often mirror the broader macroeconomic trends of the national economy.
items.ex_zh: 消费者的消费模式往往如实反映出国家经济更为宏观的走向。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers entities sharing observable features, characteristics, or behaviors with another. Gradations range from a casual superficial likeness to strong genealogical inheritance or evocative thematic reflection.
groups.summary_zh: 表示人或事物在外貌、性格或特质上的相似、相像或呼应。
groups.desc_en: Denotes exhibiting correspondence, parallel characteristics, or shared appearance with an existing entity or model, contrasting with being completely identical ('equal') or radically divergent ('differ').
groups.desc_zh: 指在外观、特征或走势上与已有实体呈现相似、平行对应或映射，区别于完全同一（equal）或截然不同（differ）。
groups.nuance_en: resemble: sharing physical or qualitative similarity (parent / sculpture / model) · take after: inheriting physical traits or temperament from an older family member (father / mother / ancestor) · mirror: reflecting features, patterns, or trends with high fidelity (reality / trends / society) · echo: repeating or reverberating previous themes, statements, or sentiments (sentiments / words / views) · parallel: matching the trajectory, progress, or structure of another entity (development / career / trajectory) · simulate: artificially imitating the appearance, behavior, or conditions of something (flight / conditions / environment)
groups.nuance_zh: resemble: 外观或特质上的客观相似 (parent / sculpture / model) · take after: 在容貌、性格或举止上肖似家族长辈 (father / mother / ancestor) · mirror: 如镜面般高度如实映射趋势或现实 (reality / trends / society) · echo: 呼应、回响先前的言论、观点或情绪 (sentiments / words / views) · parallel: 在发展轨迹、结构或进程上与之一致平行 (development / career / trajectory) · simulate: 模拟仿真某种物理状态、环境或行为 (flight / conditions / environment)

groups.name: Reserve & Secure · 预订与锁定 (Secure, Hold, Slate)
groups.tip: 提前锁定服务或资源

items.def_en: to reserve accommodations, a place, a ticket, or services in advance; to officially record someone's name for an offense
items.ex_en: We should book our train tickets well in advance to avoid peak holiday fares.
items.ex_zh: 我们应该提前订好火车票，以避开节假日的票价高峰。

items.def_en: To keep an item, ticket, or room temporarily reserved and unavailable to others
items.ex_en: The reservation agent agreed to hold two seats until six o'clock this evening.
items.ex_zh: 预订代理同意将这两个座位暂留保留到今天傍晚六点。

items.def_zh: 设法获得，锁定（席位或名额）
items.def_en: To successfully obtain or lock down a confirmed ticket, place, or booking after effort
items.ex_en: She was finally able to secure a front-row seat for the prestigious gala.
items.ex_zh: 几经努力，她终于成功搞到了一张这场盛大晚会的前排座位席位。

items.def_en: To arrange or schedule a tentative appointment or booking subject to later confirmation
items.ex_en: Let's pencil in a preliminary planning meeting for next Tuesday afternoon pending final confirmation.
items.ex_zh: 我们先初步将策划会议排在下周二下午，尚待最终确认。

items.def_en: To designate a chunk of dates, rooms, or calendar time exclusively for a group or purpose
items.ex_en: The conference organizers had to block out thirty hotel rooms for the visiting delegation.
items.ex_zh: 会议组织者必须为来访代表团预留出三十间酒店客房。

items.def_en: To schedule or plan that something will take place at a specific future date
items.ex_en: The committee decided to slate the annual shareholder vote for early next month.
items.ex_zh: 委员会决定将年度股东投票的时间预定安排在下月初举行。

groups.summary_en: This commercial transaction frame focuses on arranging, registering, and locking in places, services, accommodations, or schedules in advance.
groups.summary_zh: 提前预约、登记或排定席位、房间及日程安排。
groups.desc_en: Denotes preemptively claiming, locking in, or setting aside time, resources, or places for future utilization, contrasting with immediate consumption ('use') or permanent acquisition ('buy').
groups.desc_zh: 指为将来的使用而预先认领、锁定或划拨时间、资源或名额，区别于当下即刻消费（use）或永久买断（buy）。
groups.nuance_en: book: arranging and confirming accommodations, travel, or tickets in advance (flight / room / table) · secure: successfully obtaining or locking down a scarce or competitive resource (funding / deal / victory) · hold: temporarily keeping a resource or item reserved pending final confirmation (room / seat / line) · pencil in: tentatively scheduling an appointment subject to later change (meeting / date / lunch) · block out: setting aside a solid chunk of time or space exclusively (afternoon / calendar / time) · slate: officially planning or programming an event or nominee for a specific slot (launch / meeting / project)
groups.nuance_zh: book: 预订旅宿、座位、票务等标准服务 (flight / room / table) · secure: 历经竞争或努力稳妥锁定稀缺资源/协议 (funding / deal / victory) · hold: 暂时保留名额、房间或货物待最后确认 (room / seat / line) · pencil in: 铅笔草拟式暂定日程，保留调整余地 (meeting / date / lunch) · block out: 在日历或空间上专门圈出/冻结整块时段 (afternoon / calendar / time) · slate: 列入日程预定安排，或预备提名 (launch / meeting / project)

groups.name: Resolve & Settle · 解决与平息 (Settle, Reconcile, Iron out, Smooth over)
groups.tip: 排除疑难化解矛盾

items.def_en: To reach a final agreement or decision on an argument, disagreement, or claim
items.ex_en: Both corporate parties agreed to settle their prolonged patent infringement dispute out of court.
items.ex_zh: 双方企业同意在庭外了结平息他们旷日持久的专利侵权纠纷。

items.def_zh: 解决，化解（争端或难题）；下定决心；决议
items.def_en: 1. To solve or find a satisfactory end to a problem, conflict, or dispute. 2. To make a firm decision to do something. 3. (formal) To make a formal decision or vote on a motion.
items.ex_en: Diplomats worked tirelessly throughout the night to resolve the escalating diplomatic border crisis peacefully.
items.ex_zh: 外交官们通宵达旦地不懈工作，以和平化解不断升级的外交边境危机。

items.def_zh: 消除；解决（细节分歧/麻烦）
items.def_en: To remove problems, disagreements, or minor difficulties by mutual negotiation
items.ex_en: The contract lawyers met again this morning to iron out minor legal wording differences.
items.ex_zh: 合同律师们今早再次会面，以通过协商消除法律措辞上的细微分歧。

items.def_en: To make problems, differences, or unpleasant incidents appear less serious to restore peace
items.ex_en: The manager intervened immediately to smooth over heated interpersonal tensions among the project team.
items.ex_zh: 经理立即出面干预，以平息化解项目团队成员之间激化的矛盾不快。

items.def_en: To deal with a problem, claim, or piece of business completely and satisfactorily
items.ex_en: The probate judge acted swiftly to dispose of all outstanding estate claims today.
items.ex_zh: 遗嘱检验法官今天迅速采取行动，妥善了结了所有未决的遗产索赔问题。

items.def_en: To find an acceptable compromise between two opposing ideas, parties, or conflict situations
items.ex_en: The mediator strove to reconcile the conflicting demands of labor unions and corporate executives.
items.ex_zh: 调解人努力调和工会诉求与企业高管利益之间相互冲突的分歧矛盾。

groups.summary_en: This frame emphasizes ending contention, dispute, conflict, or procedural friction to reach an agreeable consensus or equilibrium. It contrasts finding technical answers with managing human differences and negotiations.
groups.summary_zh: 平息争端或消除分歧，促成妥协、协议与和谐了结。
groups.desc_en: Denotes bringing disputes, inconsistencies, or chaotic tensions to a definitive conclusion or harmonious alignment, contrasting with inflaming ('escalate') or evading ('sidestep').
groups.desc_zh: 指将争议、分歧或混乱局势引向最终定论、和谐解决或平息，区别于激化矛盾（escalate）或刻意回避（sidestep）。
groups.nuance_en: resolve: finding a definitive solution to a complex issue or internal conflict (crisis / dispute / conflict) · settle: reaching an agreement, paying off an account, or establishing finality (lawsuit / claim / argument) · reconcile: restoring harmony between conflicting beliefs, accounts, or estranged parties (differences / accounts / views) · iron out: smoothing over small lingering wrinkles or logistical discrepancies (details / difficulties / differences) · smooth over: superficial placation to minimize friction or gloss over embarrassment (tensions / ruffled feathers / rift) · dispose of: decisively concluding, settling, or getting rid of a matter (case / business / objection)
groups.nuance_zh: resolve: 彻底决断并消除核心纷争或复杂疑难 (crisis / dispute / conflict) · settle: 通过妥协协议、结清账目使争端彻底尘埃落定 (lawsuit / claim / argument) · reconcile: 使冲突账目、矛盾观点或决裂双方重归一致或和解 (differences / accounts / views) · iron out: 熨平、理清细节上的残留瑕疵或小磕碰 (details / difficulties / differences) · smooth over: 息事宁人式地掩盖矛盾或缓和表面尴尬 (tensions / ruffled feathers / rift) · dispose of: 彻底了结、处理并扫清事务或法律案件 (case / business / objection)

groups.name: Restrain & Constrain · 勒缰与约束 (Rein in, Curb, Check)
groups.tip: 勒住缰绳施加外部规约控制

items.def_en: To prevent someone or something from moving forward, expressing emotion, or progressing
items.ex_en: Security guards struggled to hold back the surging crowd of eager concert fans.
items.ex_zh: 安保人员竭力阻挡蜂拥而入、情绪激动的演唱会歌迷人群。

items.def_en: To stop or slow down the growth, progress, or expansion of something unwelcome
items.ex_en: The central bank raised benchmark interest rates to check rapid domestic price inflation.
items.ex_zh: 央行提高了基准利率，以遏制国内物价快速上涨的势头。

items.def_en: To control or limit something undesirable, such as spending, inflation, or temper
items.ex_en: The city council implemented strict measures to curb excessive late-night commercial noise pollution.
items.ex_zh: 市议会采取了严格措施，以控制深夜过度的商业噪音污染。

items.def_zh: 勒马，勒住缰绳；控制，约束
items.def_en: 1. To stop or slow down a horse by pulling on its reins. 2. ('rein in') To control, limit, or restrain someone or something strictly.
items.ex_en: The rider pulled firmly on the leather straps to rein her galloping horse.
items.ex_zh: 骑手紧紧拉住皮缰绳，勒住了她飞奔的骏马。

items.def_en: To limit severely the freedom of action or development of someone or something
items.ex_en: Severe budgetary deficits continue to constrain the agency's ability to implement critical public programs.
items.ex_zh: 严重的财政赤字继续限制着该机构实施关键公共项目的能力。

items.def_en: To restrain or bring under control as if using a bridle; to curb hostile impulses
items.ex_en: He struggled to bridle his surging rage before addressing the insolent young messenger.
items.ex_zh: 在向那个傲慢的年轻信使开口之前，他竭力克制住心中翻涌的怒火。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on applying control, bounds, or friction to prevent runaway growth, impulses, or expenditures. Many verbs derive from equestrian metaphors denoting deliberate suppression of kinetic momentum.
groups.summary_zh: 通过拉紧缰绳般的控制手段，压制冲动、支出或过热态势，防止失控。
groups.desc_en: Denotes exerting physical, moral, or mechanical force to rein in, suppress, or decelerate unruly urges or runaway movements, contrasting with liberating ('unleash') or passively witnessing ('allow').
groups.desc_zh: 指施加外力、道德约束或机制手段，对失控冲动或奔逸之势进行勒缰、压制或减速，区别于纵容释放（unleash）或听之任之（allow）。
groups.nuance_en: curb: actively checking or pulling back an excessive impulse or runaway trend (inflation / appetite / spending) · rein: checking runaway speed or control as if pulling a horse's reins (spending / ambition / enthusiasm) · check: abruptly halting, arresting, or testing the progress of a threat (spread / growth / advance) · hold back: physically or emotionally restraining from acting or advancing (tears / anger / crowd) · constrain: forcing someone into a restricted course through external limitations or pressure (behavior / choices / growth) · bridle: exerting tight control over pride, temper, or speech (tongue / anger / ambition)
groups.nuance_zh: curb: 强力遏制、勒住过度的欲望、开支或势头 (inflation / appetite / spending) · rein: 如同勒住脱缰野马般收紧失控的权力或野心 (spending / ambition / enthusiasm) · check: 突然截住、叫停或核验危险走势 (spread / growth / advance) · hold back: 隐忍克制内在情感，或阻拦前冲 (tears / anger / crowd) · constrain: 受外部客观条件、法则所迫而受限 (behavior / choices / growth) · bridle: 严格控制傲气、脾气或谨言慎行 (tongue / anger / ambition)

groups.name: Restrict & Demarcate · 限制与限定 (Limit, Cap, Circumscribe)
groups.tip: 设立界限防止越界违规

items.def_en: To control or keep something to a specified maximum size, number, or degree
items.ex_en: The university decided to limit class sizes to thirty students to enhance engagement.
items.ex_zh: 大学决定将班级人数限制在三十人以内，以提高课堂参与度。

items.def_en: To set an upper limit on spending, prices, numbers, or payments
items.ex_en: Lawmakers voted overwhelmingly to cap annual tuition increases at three percent nationwide.
items.ex_zh: 议员们以压倒性多数投票赞成将全国年学费上涨幅度限制在百分之三以内。

items.def_en: to limit the size, amount, or range of something, or control actions
items.ex_en: The municipal ordinance strictly restricts the distribution of promotional flyers in commercial zones.
items.ex_zh: 市政法令严格限制在商业区散发宣传传单。

items.def_en: To bring something under tighter control, cutting back excessive behavior or spending
items.ex_en: The finance minister must rein in government spending before national inflation spirals further.
items.ex_zh: 财政部长必须在国家通胀进一步失控之前严格控制政府支出。

items.def_en: To control, check, or limit something undesirable from spreading or escalating
items.ex_en: Strict regulatory measures were introduced to curb the proliferation of fraudulent financial schemes.
items.ex_zh: 出台严格的监管措施旨在遏制金融诈骗计划的蔓延。

items.def_zh: 划定界限；约束（权力或自由）
items.def_en: To draw a boundary around and strictly control or limit powers, rights, or possibilities
items.ex_en: The newly amended constitution explicitly circumscribes the emergency powers granted to the executive.
items.ex_zh: 新修订的宪法明确限制了赋予行政部门的紧急权力。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to setting definitive bounds, caps, or operational scopes to prevent growth, access, or activity beyond a regulated baseline.
groups.summary_zh: 设定界限、额度或操作范围，以防止活动或数量超出规定标准。
groups.desc_en: Denotes drawing normative, statutory, or physical boundaries around scope, magnitude, or freedom, contrasting with complete prohibition ('ban') or unbounded expansion ('expand').
groups.desc_zh: 指在规模、数量、权限或自由度周围划定规范、法规或物理边界，区别于全盘封杀（ban）或无限扩张（expand）。
groups.nuance_en: limit: setting a practical, quantitative, or natural threshold (exposure / spending / speed) · restrict: placing formal, legal, or physical confines around actions or access (access / trade / movement) · cap: placing a strict, non-negotiable upper numerical ceiling (prices / bonuses / emissions) · circumscribe: drawing definitive perimeter lines that tightly constrain authority or scope (power / role / freedom) · rein in: tightening boundaries to stop unbounded fiscal or policy drift (costs / deficit / program) · curb: keeping growth or behaviors within acceptable parameters (excesses / expansion / practices)
groups.nuance_zh: limit: 设定客观容量、时间或数量上的最大阈值 (exposure / spending / speed) · restrict: 通过法规、权限或物理封锁限制流通或自由 (access / trade / movement) · cap: 设死封顶上限，严禁突破 (prices / bonuses / emissions) · circumscribe: 划定清晰周线，严格限定权力或活动范围 (power / role / freedom) · rein in: 紧缩边界以阻止财政或政策过度泛滥 (costs / deficit / program) · curb: 将过火的扩张或行为钳制在可控界限内 (excesses / expansion / practices)

groups.name: Restructure & Realign · 机构重组与全面整顿 (Reorganize, Restructure, Revamp)
groups.tip: 对机构或人员做系统重组

items.def_zh: 精简……的机构，使流程精练高效
items.def_en: to make an organization or process more efficient by stripping away redundant administrative layers
items.ex_en: Management sought to streamline internal approval processes to accelerate the launch of products.
items.ex_zh: 管理层试图精简内部审批流程，以加快新产品的推出。

items.def_en: to overhaul or reconstruct the internal parts, layout, or organization of something to improve it
items.ex_en: The company hired a renowned design firm to revamp its outdated mobile application.
items.ex_zh: 公司聘请了一家著名的设计公司来全面改造其陈旧的手机应用程序。

items.def_en: 1. To change the structure, arrangement, or management of an organization or system to make it work more effectively.
items.ex_en: The director proposed to reorganize the sales department into three distinct regional divisions.
items.ex_zh: 总监提议将销售部门重组成三个不同的区域分支。
items.ex2_en: The local charity reorganized efficiently to serve low-income families in the area.
items.ex2_zh: 该地方慈善机构进行了高效重组，以更好地服务该地区的低收入家庭。

items.def_en: (+ sth) rid an organization of inefficient, corrupt, or unwanted personnel in a restructuring
items.ex_en: The incoming chief executive decided to clean out the entire incompetent executive committee.
items.ex_zh: 新上任的首席执行官决定彻底清除整个不称职的执行委员会。

items.def_zh: 大刀阔斧重组，彻底整顿
items.def_en: (+ sth) radically reorganize or restructure an organization or department to improve effectiveness
items.ex_en: The new CEO plans to shake up the entire management structure.
items.ex_zh: 新任首席执行官计划对整个管理架构进行大洗牌。

items.def_zh: 重组，调整（组织/债务）结构
items.def_en: [I/T] to make fundamental changes to the operational, legal, or financial structure of an entity
items.ex_en: The board resolved to restructure their massive corporate debt to avoid impending bankruptcy.
items.ex_zh: 董事会决定重组庞大的公司债务，以避免迫在眉睫的破产风险。

groups.summary_en: An executive or administrative authority alters the structural hierarchy, workflows, or operational setup of a business, government, or system to resolve inefficiencies. Verbs range from internal reordering to root-and-branch corporate restructuring.
groups.summary_zh: 对机构、体制或企业业务框架进行重新规划、精简整顿与体系重构。
groups.desc_en: Denotes radically altering the internal architecture, workflow, or personnel of an organization to restore efficiency, contrasting with routine maintenance ('manage') or total liquidation ('dissolve').
groups.desc_zh: 指大刀阔斧地重塑机构内部架构、业务流程或人员配置以扭转颓势或提效，区别于日常管理（manage）或解散清算（dissolve）。
groups.nuance_en: restructure: altering fundamental financial, operational, or legal frameworks (debt / operations / company) · reorganize: reshuffling existing departments, hierarchies, or systems for order (department / staff / file) · revamp: substantially redesigning or upgrading appearances, systems, or features (image / website / policies) · streamline: stripping redundancies and friction to maximize operational efficiency (processes / workforce / bureaucracy) · shake up: causing disruptive, radical personnel or cultural shifts to jolt an organization (cabinet / industry / management) · clean out: aggressively purging deadwood, corruption, or unwanted elements (bureaucracy / executive suite / ranks)
groups.nuance_zh: restructure: 对债务、资本或业务底层架构进行战略性重组 (debt / operations / company) · reorganize: 重新理顺部门职能、人员分工或层级关系 (department / staff / file) · revamp: 对旧有系统、形象或产品进行翻新改版与升级 (image / website / policies) · streamline: 砍掉冗余环节与臃肿编制以实现精简化 (processes / workforce / bureaucracy) · shake up: 采取震荡性的人事或制度巨震以打破僵局 (cabinet / industry / management) · clean out: 铁腕大清洗，清除机构冗员或腐败分子 (bureaucracy / executive suite / ranks)

groups.name: Restructure Rhythm & Morphology · 重组质地与节律 (Granulate, Syncopate)
groups.tip: 调整节奏规律或物质形态

items.def_zh: 打碎；打乱（连贯结构或节奏）
items.def_en: (+ sth) Divide or separate something continuous into smaller fragments, grains, or disconnected units
items.ex_en: The instructor used interactive exercises to break up the monotonous rhythm of lectures.
items.ex_zh: 教师利用互动练习来打破讲座单调乏味的节奏。
items.ex2_en: The massive arctic iceberg broke up into countless smaller blocks of ice.
items.ex2_zh: 巨大的北极冰山碎裂成了无数块较小的冰块。

items.def_en: to vary the tone, pitch, or frequency of a wave or rhythmic pattern
items.ex_en: The experienced orator learned to modulate his vocal pitch to captivate dynamic audiences.
items.ex_zh: 这位经验丰富的演说家学会了调节语调高低，以吸引多变的听众。
items.ex2_en: His deep vocal tone modulated naturally throughout the long Shakespearean theatrical performance.
items.ex2_zh: 在整场莎士比亚戏剧演出中，他深沉的声音自然地抑扬顿挫。

items.def_en: to reduce a solid substance into fine particles or powder
items.ex_en: Just use a heavy rolling pin to pulverize those stale biscuits into crumbs.
items.ex_zh: 只要用一根厚重的擀面杖把那些不新鲜的饼干压碎成粉末就行。

items.def_zh: （使）成颗粒状，（使）粉碎成细粒；（伤口）长出肉芽
items.def_en: 1. to form something into small grains or granules, or break down into small particles 2. to form new healthy tissue in a healing wound
items.ex_en: The molten alloy began to granulate into lustrous metallic beads upon sudden cooling.
items.ex_zh: 熔融的合金在骤冷后开始碎化为具有光泽的金属细粒。
items.ex2_en: The industrial machine granulates synthetic rubber polymers into uniform tiny pellets.
items.ex2_zh: 这台工业机器将合成橡胶聚合物粉碎成均匀的小颗粒。

items.def_zh: （音乐）改变……的节奏（使出现切分音）；（语言学）略去（词中的）字母或发音
items.def_en: 1. to change the normal rhythm of music by placing accents on normally unaccented beats 2. to shorten a word by omitting a sound or letter from the middle
items.ex_en: The jazz percussionist loved to syncopate the traditional waltz tempo during live performances.
items.ex_zh: 这位爵士鼓手喜欢在现场演奏中改变传统圆舞曲的节奏，加入切分音。

items.def_en: to break up a liquid or system into minute droplets or isolated components
items.ex_en: The powerful pressurized nozzle helped atomize the fragrant liquid into a delicate mist.
items.ex_zh: 高压喷嘴将芳香液体雾化成细致入微的水雾。
