items.ex2_en: The pressurized fuel atomized instantly upon entering the engine's hot combustion chamber.
items.ex2_zh: 加压燃料一进入发动机的高温燃烧室就瞬间雾化了。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote altering the structural regularity, texture, or rhythmic distribution of a medium—breaking smooth continuities into grains, syncopated stresses, or fragmented units.
groups.summary_zh: 打破平滑连续性，重组物质颗粒质感或节奏重音。
groups.desc_en: Denotes fragmenting continuous matter or disrupting regular temporal cadence into distinct micro-units or irregular pulses, contrasting with continuous blending ('fuse') or keeping uniform tempo ('synchronize').
groups.desc_zh: 指将连续的物理质地粉碎为微小颗粒，或打破均匀节律使其呈现错位脉冲，区别于融为一体（fuse）或匀速平推（synchronize）。
groups.nuance_en: break up: dividing a solid mass, rhythm, or assembly into smaller pieces (concrete / rhythm / monopoly) · modulate: adjusting the pitch, tone, frequency, or tempo in nuanced steps (voice / frequency / rhythm) · pulverize: crushing solid matter into microscopic dust or annihilating structure (rock / coal / opposition) · granulate: converting material into distinct, uniform grains or textured particles (sugar / metal / texture) · atomize: dispersing liquids into ultra-fine spray or fracturing society into isolated individuals (liquid / fuel / society) · syncopate: shifting musical or rhythmic accents off the regular beat to create unexpected tension (beat / rhythm / melody)
groups.nuance_zh: break up: 将整块实体、匀质节奏或垄断集团碎解分立 (concrete / rhythm / monopoly) · modulate: 灵巧调控音质、频率或节律的抑扬起伏 (voice / frequency / rhythm) · pulverize: 彻底碾压粉碎为齑粉，或彻底摧毁 (rock / coal / opposition) · granulate: 使物质形成均匀沙粒、颗粒或颗粒感 (sugar / metal / texture) · atomize: 将液体雾化为微滴，或使社会组织极端原子化 (liquid / fuel / society) · syncopate: 运用切分音打破正拍，使节律产生错位跃动 (beat / rhythm / melody)

groups.name: Resuscitate & Reanimate · 起死回生与强效复苏 (Resuscitate, Reanimate, Revive)
groups.tip: 从濒死状态中重获生机

items.def_en: To help someone regain consciousness after fainting or anesthesia
items.ex_en: The nurse applied smelling salts to bring the patient around after the surgery.
items.ex_zh: 手术结束后，护士使用嗅盐让病人恢复了知觉。

items.def_en: To revitalize or bring renewed energy and freshness to something dying or moribund
items.ex_en: The enthusiastic young director managed to breathe life into the dreary theatrical production.
items.ex_zh: 这位热情洋溢的年轻导演成功地为那部沉闷的戏剧注入了生机。

items.def_en: To bring back consciousness, health, or functioning to someone weak or fainting
items.ex_en: Splashing cold water on his pale face helped revive the exhausted marathon runner.
items.ex_zh: 往苍白的脸上泼冷水使这位筋疲力尽的马拉松选手苏醒过来。
items.ex2_en: The dehydrated potted plants revived quickly after receiving a generous soaking yesterday.
items.ex2_zh: 缺水的盆栽植物在昨天饱吸水分后迅速恢复了活力。

items.def_en: To bring someone who is unconscious or nearly dead back to life or consciousness
items.ex_en: Paramedics deployed an automated defibrillator to resuscitate the victim of the cardiac arrest.
items.ex_zh: 医护人员使用自动除颤仪使那名心脏骤停的受害者苏醒过来。
items.ex2_en: The exhausted drowning victim resuscitated spontaneously before emergency paramedics even arrived.
items.ex2_zh: 筋疲力尽的溺水者在急救人员赶到之前就已经自主苏醒了。

items.def_en: To restore life, breath, or animated movement to something dead or lifeless
items.ex_en: The gentle morning sunshine seemed to reanimate the frosted leaves across the garden.
items.ex_zh: 清晨温和的阳光仿佛给花园里结霜的树叶重新赋予了生机。

items.def_zh: 使复活，使苏醒；给……以新的生机，使重获活力
items.def_en: (formal) To bring back to life, consciousness, or vigor; revitalize.
items.ex_en: A substantial grant was awarded to revivify the dilapidated historical district downtown.
items.ex_zh: 一笔可观的拨款被用于使市中心破旧的历史街区重获生机。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on restoring life, heartbeat, or consciousness to someone clinically dead or unconscious, or breathing new kinetic vitality into something near death.
groups.summary_zh: 指促使濒死、昏迷者恢复心跳呼吸与知觉，或使奄奄一息之物重获生机。
groups.desc_en: Denotes restoring vitality, consciousness, or active operation to an entity on the verge of physical death or utter collapse, contrasting with initial generation ('create') or gentle healing ('soothe').
groups.desc_zh: 指将处于濒死、休克或彻底崩溃边缘的生命或体系抢救回生机勃勃的状态，区别于初生创造（create）或温和调理（soothe）。
groups.nuance_en: revive: returning consciousness, health, or popularity to a languishing entity (patient / economy / career) · resuscitate: applying clinical or emergency intervention to restore breathing, heartbeat, or financial viability (patient / victim / economy) · reanimate: infusing apparent life, motion, or spark into a lifeless corpse or stagnant project (corpse / genre / movement) · breathe life into: invigorating an inert, stale, or mundane undertaking with fresh inspiration (project / play / economy) · bring around: restoring someone from fainting or intoxication back to consciousness (casualty / patient / victim) · revivify: giving renewed moral, creative, or cultural energy to something aging (tradition / spirit / institution)
groups.nuance_zh: revive: 使昏厥者苏醒，或使疲软经济/沉寂事业重获生机 (patient / economy / career) · resuscitate: 通过心肺复苏或紧急抢救挽救生命，或对垂死机构输血纾困 (patient / victim / economy) · reanimate: 赋予僵尸或死气沉沉的旧事物以生命与动力 (corpse / genre / movement) · breathe life into: 为枯燥滞重的项目注入活力与新灵感 (project / play / economy) · bring around: 唤醒昏倒、醉酒或神志不清的人 (casualty / patient / victim) · revivify: 赋予老旧体制或文化以崭新的精神与活力 (tradition / spirit / institution)

groups.name: Retort & Snap Back · 尖锐反驳与回呛 (Snap, Come Back, Cl打击ap Back)
groups.tip: 机智敏捷反唇相讥，迅速回怼对方质难

items.def_en: (+ with) To reply promptly and cleverly to a criticism or query.
items.ex_en: She managed to come back with a scathing retort to his arrogant question.
items.ex_zh: 面对他傲慢的提问，她毫不示弱地予以尖锐反驳。

items.def_en: (+ at) To respond swiftly and sharply to insults or public criticism.
items.ex_en: The pop star did not hesitate to clap back at her harsh critics.
items.ex_zh: 这位流行歌星毫不犹豫地对那些严苛的批评者予以强势回击。

items.def_en: To answer someone back instantly with irritation or anger.
items.ex_en: Overwhelmed by relentless exhaustion, the tired clerk could only snap back at customers.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫不堪的店员在极度劳累之下，只能厉声反呛顾客。

items.def_zh: （机智或愤怒地）反驳，反唇相讥，回嘴
items.def_en: To reply quickly and sharply to an accusation or criticism in an angry or witty manner.
items.ex_en: He had the audacity to retort that the costly blunder was not his.
items.ex_zh: 他竟然厚颜无耻地反驳说那次代价高昂的失误不是他的责任。

items.def_en: To retaliate against hostile speech with an equally scathing spoken attack.
items.ex_en: The company struck back at its competitors by slashing prices across the board.
items.ex_zh: 该企业通过全线大幅降价对竞争对手发起了回击。

items.def_en: (+ at) To say something sharp, irritable, and hurtfully abrupt in response.
items.ex_en: Under intense deadline pressure, the stressed editor began to snap at harmless interns.
items.ex_zh: 在迫近的截止日期压力下，焦虑的编辑开始对无辜的实习生厉声斥责。

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies the stylistic and emotional manner of replying—specifically making a fast, biting, sharp, or sarcastic counter-remark when provoked.
groups.summary_zh: 在被冒犯或挑衅时，以尖锐、机敏或恼怒的口吻迅速回嘴反唇相讥。
groups.desc_en: Denotes delivering an instantaneous, sharp, or witty counter-verbal strike in response to criticism or insult, contrasting with measured debate ('argue') or silent acceptance ('yield').
groups.desc_zh: 指在遭遇批评、讥讽或挑衅时，立刻回以尖锐、机敏或反唇相讥的语言反击，区别于从长计议的论辩（argue）或忍气吞声（yield）。
groups.nuance_en: retort: delivering a swift, razor-sharp, or witty verbal rejoinder (sharply / angrily / with a quip) · snap back: reacting with an irritated, instantaneous sharp rebuke (at a critic / angrily / in frustration) · snap: speaking in a sudden, sharp, snarling tone under strain (at reporters / in anger / answer) · clap back: delivering a public, defiant, and stinging counter-attack against critics, especially on social media (at trolls / online / to critics) · come back: offering a clever verbal riposte or regaining momentum in an argument (with an answer / sharply / retort) · strike back: launching a retaliatory counter-offensive in words or actions (at critics / against rivals / forcefully)
groups.nuance_zh: retort: 敏捷、机智且针锋相对地反驳回敬 (sharply / angrily / with a quip) · snap back: 带着恼怒或烦躁立刻回冲过去 (at a critic / angrily / in frustration) · snap: 厉声呵斥或没好气地没头没脑呛声 (at reporters / in anger / answer) · clap back: 公开、高调且辛辣地反抽批评者/网络黑子 (at trolls / online / to critics) · come back: 巧妙反戈一击或语言回击 (with an answer / sharply / retort) · strike back: 展开有力的反攻或反击报复 (at critics / against rivals / forcefully)

groups.name: Return & Revert · 返回与回溯 (Return, Revert, Backtrack)
groups.tip: 沿原路折返归来

items.def_zh: 返回，归来；归还，送回；回报
items.def_en: 1. To go or come back to a place, condition, or activity. 2. To give, put, or send something back to where it came from.
items.ex_en: The weary diplomat resolved to return to his homeland after prolonged international negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 在漫长的国际谈判结束后，这位疲惫的外交官决心返回祖国。

items.def_en: to return to a previous topic, plan, or physical point after wandering
items.ex_en: Let us conclude this brief tangent and circle back to our original agenda.
items.ex_zh: 让我们结束这段跑题，折回到我们最初的议程上。

items.def_en: to turn back sharply and retrace one's physical steps or route
items.ex_en: Realizing they took the wrong trail, the hikers had to double back immediately.
items.ex_zh: 意识到走错了小径后，徒步者们不得不立刻原路折回。

items.def_en: (+ to) to go back to a previous state, condition, or habit
items.ex_en: Under extreme psychological stress, the patient began to revert to destructive childhood habits.
items.ex_zh: 在极度的心理压力下，该患者开始重犯童年时期的破坏性恶习。

items.def_en: to retrace one's steps along a path, or retreat from a previous opinion
items.ex_en: Faced with fierce public backlash, the politician chose to backtrack on his proposal.
items.ex_zh: 面对公众的激烈反对，这位政客选择在自己的提案上退让改变立场。

items.def_en: to return to a former, less developed, or worse state
items.ex_en: Without continuous educational intervention, reading literacy in disadvantaged regions will inevitably regress further.
items.ex_zh: 若缺乏持续的教育干预，贫困地区的阅读读写能力必将进一步倒退。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame highlight physical or metaphorical motion going backward to a previous location, earlier point in time, prior stage, or original state.
groups.summary_zh: 指身体重回原处，或事物、思路退回至先前的初始状态。
groups.desc_en: Denotes shifting movement, state, or focus backward to an earlier position, prior stage, or point of origin, contrasting with steady progress ('advance') or staying put ('remain').
groups.desc_zh: 指在空间移动、状态演变或论题上回溯到早先位置、原有起点或旧阶段，区别于持续推进（advance）或驻留原地（remain）。
groups.nuance_en: return: broadly moving back to a starting location, state, or topic (home / to work / to reality) · revert: falling back to an earlier, often less desirable condition, habit, or legal ownership (to old habits / to type / to owner) · backtrack: retracing steps physically or retracting a previously held opinion/path (steps / path / statement) · regress: deteriorating back into a less developed, primitive, or worse condition (to childhood / into chaos / state) · double back: turning sharply around on one's own tracks to elude pursuit or re-examine (on one's tracks / path / along the trail) · circle back: revisiting an issue, conversation, or person at a later stage (to the topic / later / to an idea)
groups.nuance_zh: return: 最普适的返回起点、旧职或回到现实 (home / to work / to reality) · revert: 复发旧习、退回前态，或财产所有权归还 (to old habits / to type / to owner) · backtrack: 原路折回，或被迫推翻/收回先前的言论 (steps / path / statement) · regress: 倒退回更幼稚、退化或恶化的阶段 (to childhood / into chaos / state) · double back: 沿原路突然折返以甩开追击或复查 (on one's tracks / path / along the trail) · circle back: 稍后再兜回来重新讨论或跟进某议题 (to the topic / later / to an idea)

groups.name: Reveal & Disclose · 透露与揭示 (Disclose, Divulge, Unveil)
groups.tip: 使隐秘之事浮出水面为人所知

items.def_en: To betray or accidentally reveal a secret, intention, or true identity
items.ex_en: His nervous trembling voice threatened to give away their hidden presence behind curtains.
items.ex_zh: 他颤抖而紧张的声音差点暴露出他们躲在窗帘后面的踪迹。

items.def_en: To reveal a secret or piece of confidential information inadvertently
items.ex_en: During casual conversation, the careless assistant let slip details of the impending merger.
items.ex_zh: 在闲聊中，那个粗心的助理无意中泄露了即将进行的合并细节。

items.def_en: 1. To make known something secret or previously unknown. 2. To show something that was hidden or not visible.
items.ex_en: The official report will reveal extensive evidence of corporate fraud to the public.
items.ex_zh: 这份官方报告将向公众揭露涉及企业欺诈的大量证据。

items.def_zh: 透露，公开（机密或未知信息）
items.def_en: To make secret or new information known publicly or officially
items.ex_en: The university spokesperson refused to disclose the confidential terms of the financial settlement.
items.ex_zh: 大学发言人拒绝公开这一财务和解协议的机密条款。

items.def_en: To remove a covering from something, or to show or introduce a new plan, product, or finding for the first time
items.ex_en: The tech giant plans to unveil its revolutionary smartphone at the annual convention.
items.ex_zh: 这家科技巨头计划在年度大会上首次公布其革命性智能手机。

items.def_en: To give away private, secret, or sensitive information, often when one should not
items.ex_en: Government officials are legally bound never to divulge classified intelligence to foreign agents.
items.ex_zh: 政府官员受法律约束，绝不得向外国间谍泄露机密情报。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to making hidden facts, secret plans, or concealed objects known or visible to others. They range from neutral factual disclosures to formal, public, or dramatic unveilings.
groups.summary_zh: 指将隐秘事实、机密信息或遮蔽之物公之于众或使其可见。
groups.desc_en: Denotes making previously hidden, secret, or unknown information or reality perceptible and public, contrasting with concealing ('hide') or concocting ('fabricate').
groups.desc_zh: 指将先前被遮蔽、保密或未知的事实与真容公之于众或使其显现，区别于蓄意隐匿（hide）或虚构编造（fabricate）。
groups.nuance_en: reveal: uncovering hidden truths, identities, or spiritual/dramatic insights (truth / secret / identity) · disclose: formally or contractually making known private facts or financial data (information / assets / conflict of interest) · divulge: indiscreetly blabbing confidential, sensitive, or personal secrets (secrets / plans / details) · unveil: formally showing a new product, monument, or policy for the first time (statue / plan / car) · let slip: unintentionally or carelessly uttering a secret (secret / word / fact) · give away: betraying secrets or inadvertently displaying genuine emotions (position / game / emotion)
groups.nuance_zh: reveal: 揭开被遮掩的真相、身份或具有戏剧性的内情 (truth / secret / identity) · disclose: 官方或合规性地公开敏感事实、资产或利益往来 (information / assets / conflict of interest) · divulge: 泄露机密、私密情报或不宜声张之秘 (secrets / plans / details) · unveil: 为新雕塑、新产品或新蓝图举行揭幕首秀 (statue / plan / car) · let slip: 无意中说漏嘴或失言走漏风声 (secret / word / fact) · give away: 出卖底牌、暴露位置，或不经意间流露真情 (position / game / emotion)

groups.name: Revel & Roister · 狂欢与作乐 (Revel, Carouse, Make merry)
groups.tip: 喧闹放纵喧哗寻欢作乐

items.def_en: To play, romp, and behave merrily in an energetic, lighthearted way
items.ex_en: Playful young lambs began to frolic joyfully across the sunlit, clover-filled spring meadows.
items.ex_zh: 顽皮的小羊羔们开始在阳光普照、开满三叶草的春季草甸上欢快嬉戏。

items.def_en: (+ in) To celebrate noisily, heartily, and take supreme delight in festivities
items.ex_en: Triumphant villagers gathered around the roaring bonfire to revel in their unexpected victory.
items.ex_zh: 胜利的村民们聚集在熊熊燃烧的篝火旁，尽情庆祝他们意想不到的胜利。

items.def_en: To go out and celebrate exuberantly and flamboyantly in public venues
items.ex_en: After passing the bar exam, the graduates decided to paint the town red.
items.ex_zh: 通过律师资格考试后，毕业生们决定出门通宵狂欢作乐。

items.def_en: To indulge without restraint in merrymaking, revelry, or drinking
items.ex_en: Every Friday evening, the carefree sailors would spree through the lively harbor taverns.
items.ex_zh: 每逢周五晚上，无忧无虑的水手们便会在热闹的港口酒馆里肆意狂欢买醉。

items.def_en: To engage in boisterous, rowdy drinking bouts and uninhibited partying
items.ex_en: Raucous mercenary soldiers continued to carouse and drink heavily in the dim tavern.
items.ex_zh: 喧闹的雇佣军士兵在昏暗的酒馆里继续痛饮狂欢，纵酒作乐。

items.def_en: 1. (literary) To celebrate, drink, and make merry in a noisy, boisterous, or riotous manner.
items.ex_en: Boisterous celebrants gathered to roister through the cobblestone streets until early morning hours.
items.ex_zh: 喧闹的狂欢者聚集在鹅卵石街道上闹饮作乐，一直持续到凌晨。

groups.summary_en: Expresses boisterous, noisy, and uninhibited celebration, often involving excessive drinking, carousing, and high-spirited carnal revelry.
groups.summary_zh: 指纵情痛饮、大肆喧闹欢庆并享受放浪形骸的社交狂欢。
groups.desc_en: Denotes engaging in loud, unrestrained, or celebratory partying and merrymaking, contrasting with solemn mourning ('mourn') or quiet contemplation ('meditate').
groups.desc_zh: 指纵情于高声喧哗、放浪不羁的狂欢作乐或庆祝活动，区别于肃穆哀悼（mourn）或静息沉思（meditate）。
groups.nuance_en: revel: taking intense, prolonged delight in celebrations or good fortune (in victory / in freedom / all night) · carouse: engaging in boisterous, drunken partying and drinking binges (with friends / through the night / at taverns) · roister: noisily, rowdily partying in public spaces (through the streets / with comrades / after victory) · frolic: playing around playfully, lightheartedly, and innocently (in the waves / on the lawn / lambs) · spree: engaging in an extravagant, unchecked burst of indulgence (shopping / spending / crime) · paint the town red: going out for an exuberant, wild night of drinking and urban entertainment (on Friday night / with friends / after exams)
groups.nuance_zh: revel: 沉醉并极尽享受狂欢、胜利或自由带来的快感 (in victory / in freedom / all night) · carouse: 聚众豪饮、酩酊大醉的放荡酒宴 (with friends / through the night / at taverns) · roister: 在公共场合喧哗嬉闹、横冲直撞的狂闹 (through the streets / with comrades / after victory) · frolic: 纯真天真地撒欢、嬉戏打闹 (in the waves / on the lawn / lambs) · spree: 爆发式的狂欢或无节制的放纵挥霍 (shopping / spending / crime) · paint the town red: 结伙痛饮狂欢，尽情享受夜生活 (on Friday night / with friends / after exams)

groups.name: Revive & Rally · 复苏与苏醒好转 (Rally, Recover, Come round)
groups.tip: 从垂死昏厥中重获生机

items.def_en: To recover strength, health, or spirits after a period of illness or weakness
items.ex_en: After weeks of intense medical treatment, the elderly patient began to rally noticeably.
items.ex_zh: 经过数周的紧张治疗，这位老年患者的病情开始明显好转。
items.ex2_en: The defensive coach rallied his exhausted players during the tense final timeout.
items.ex2_zh: 防守教练在紧张的最后一次暂停期间鼓舞了他精疲力竭的队员们。

items.def_en: To regain consciousness after fainting, sleeping, or being knocked out
items.ex_en: The boxer took nearly two full minutes to come to after that knockout.
items.ex_zh: 在那次击倒之后，拳击手花了将近整整两分钟才苏醒过来。

items.def_en: To become conscious again after an accident, operation, or swoon
items.ex_en: It took several minutes for the dazed driver to come round after collision.
items.ex_zh: 撞车之后，恍惚的司机过了好几分钟才缓过来并恢复知觉。

items.def_en: To become or make someone more cheerful, lively, or energetic
items.ex_en: A cup of strong black coffee helped the drowsy programmer perk up immediately.
items.ex_zh: 一杯浓烈的黑咖啡帮助昏昏欲睡的程序员立即振作起精神。
items.ex2_en: The sleepy children perked up immediately when their favorite cartoon theme started.
items.ex2_zh: 当最喜欢的动画片主题曲响起时，困倦的孩子们立刻精神了起来。

items.def_en: To recover quickly from a serious illness, defeat, or setback
items.ex_en: Resilient entrepreneurs always manage to bounce back quickly from unexpected economic downturns.
items.ex_zh: 有韧性的企业家总能迅速从意想不到的经济低迷中触底反弹。

items.def_zh: （使）复苏，（使）苏醒；（使）复兴，重新恢复；重新上演（剧目等）
items.def_en: 1. To become conscious, healthy, or active again, or cause someone to do so. 2. To bring back to life, use, or prominence; revitalize. 3. To produce a play or musical again after a period of absence.
items.ex_en: Fresh spring rains will surely revive the parched crops across the dry valley.
items.ex_zh: 清新的春雨必将使整个干旱山谷中枯萎的庄稼重新恢复生机。
items.ex2_en: Her spirits revived noticeably after hearing the joyful news about her family.
items.ex2_zh: 听到家人的好消息后，她的心情明显好转了起来。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe a person or organism recovering physical vitality, rallying from exhaustion or illness, or returning to an active, conscious state.
groups.summary_zh: 指人或生物从昏迷、衰弱或病痛中恢复意识、精力与生机活力。
groups.desc_en: Denotes regaining physical vigor, market strength, or emotional spirits after a period of fainting, slump, or exhaustion, contrasting with permanent sinking ('collapse') or worsening ('deteriorate').
groups.desc_zh: 指在经历休克、低谷或衰竭后，体力、行情或士气呈现复原、止跌回升，区别于一蹶不振（collapse）或继续恶化（deteriorate）。
groups.nuance_en: rally: drawing together scattered energy to stage a sharp collective or market recovery (stocks / team / support) · recover: reclaiming health, losses, or equilibrium over time (from illness / losses / consciousness) · bounce back: displaying resilience by swiftly rebounding after defeat or injury (from defeat / from recession / quickly) · perk up: brightening up noticeably in energy, interest, or mood (spirits / flowers / market) · come to: regaining consciousness after fainting, anesthesia, or a blow (on the floor / after surgery / slowly) · come round: gradually returning to consciousness or warming up to an opposing idea (after fainting / to an idea / slowly)
groups.nuance_zh: rally: 重整旗鼓，指股市低迷后强力反弹或队伍重振士气 (stocks / team / support) · recover: 循序渐进地康复、挽回损失或恢复常态 (from illness / losses / consciousness) · bounce back: 展现极佳的弹性，受挫后迅速触底反弹 (from defeat / from recession / quickly) · perk up: 精神、兴致或状态明显振作提神 (spirits / flowers / market) · come to: 昏厥、麻醉或受重击后苏醒恢复知觉 (on the floor / after surgery / slowly) · come round: 渐渐恢复意识，或转而认同原先反对的意见 (after fainting / to an idea / slowly)

groups.name: Revoke & Cancel · 撤销与取消 (Call Off, Void, Rescind)
groups.tip: 宣布法令失效或取消前置决议

items.def_en: To decide that an planned event, gathering, strike, or operation will not happen
items.ex_en: Organizers decided to call off the outdoor festival due to torrential overnight rainfall.
items.ex_zh: 由于夜间暴雨倾盆，组织者决定取消户外音乐节。

items.def_en: To decide that an organized event, agreement, or order will not happen or will no longer be valid; to offset or neutralize.
items.ex_en: The airline had to cancel all scheduled departures because of dense coastal fog.
items.ex_zh: 由于沿海浓雾弥漫，航空公司不得不取消所有预定的航班起飞。

items.def_en: To abandon an intended initiative, proposal, or scheduled project entirely
items.ex_en: The city council decided to scrap the controversial transit project after budget shortfalls.
items.ex_zh: 在出现预算短缺后，市议会决定彻底放弃这个饱受争议的交通项目。

items.def_en: To render a contract, document, or transaction legally ineffective or worthless
items.ex_en: Failure to provide authentic signatures will instantly void the entire international purchase agreement.
items.ex_zh: 未能提供真实签名将立即导致整份国际采购协议无效作废。

items.def_en: To formally cancel the validity of a license, authorization, rights, or a will
items.ex_en: The transportation authority decided to revoke his commercial driving license following repeated violations.
items.ex_zh: 由于屡次违章，交通管理局决定吊销他的商业驾驶执照。

items.def_en: To officially withdraw, retract, or reverse an order, law, permit, or decision
items.ex_en: The governing board voted to rescind the outdated policy regarding mandatory remote attendance.
items.ex_zh: 管理委员会投票决定废止关于强制远程出勤的过时政策。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers decisions by individuals, organizers, or authorities to nullify scheduled arrangements, transactions, or standing privileges before or during execution.
groups.summary_zh: 强调经由决定使预订、活动、协议或特权作废或不再生效。
groups.desc_en: Denotes formally nullifying, repealing, or abandoning an existing rule, permission, agreement, or planned event, contrasting with ratification ('enact') or confirmation ('reaffirm').
groups.desc_zh: 指通过权威手段正式宣告先前的法令、许可、契约或既定安排作废与撤销，区别于批准生效（enact）或重申坚持（reaffirm）。
groups.nuance_en: cancel: declaring that a planned event, subscription, or order will not occur (flight / subscription / meeting) · call off: decisively terminating an imminent event, strike, or pursuit (strike / wedding / search) · revoke: officially stripping away a previously granted privilege, license, or right (license / citizenship / parole) · rescind: formally repealing an edict, contract, law, or agreement by an authority (offer / decision / law) · scrap: completely ditching an obsolete plan, policy, or project as worthless (plans / project / system) · void: rendering a legal instrument or contract completely invalid and without force (contract / warranty / ballot)
groups.nuance_zh: cancel: 宣布取消既定活动、预约或订单 (flight / subscription / meeting) · call off: 叫停迫在眉睫的行动、罢工或搜捕 (strike / wedding / search) · revoke: 官方吊销、收回此前赋予的执照、特权或国籍 (license / citizenship / parole) · rescind: 法律或官方机构正式废止决议、撤销要约 (offer / decision / law) · scrap: 因行不通而将计划、项目彻底作废报废 (plans / project / system) · void: 判决或使合同、票据、保修完全失效 (contract / warranty / ballot)

groups.name: Reward & Compensate · 奖赏与报偿 (Reward, Compensate, Recompense)
groups.tip: 按付出给予回馈肯定

items.def_zh: 奖赏，报答，酬谢；使得到应有回报
items.def_en: To give something to someone because they have done good work, behaved well, or achieved success.
items.ex_en: The company established an annual bonus scheme to reward exceptional innovation among engineers.
items.ex_zh: 公司设立了年度奖金机制，以酬谢工程师们展现出的杰出创新。

items.def_en: To give someone an equivalent return or reward for a service rendered or damage suffered
items.ex_en: The firm agreed to recompense the loyal consultant generously for his invaluable guidance.
items.ex_zh: 公司同意为这位忠诚顾问极有价值的指导提供优厚的报酬。

items.def_en: To yield beneficial results or lucrative returns for prior effort or endurance
items.ex_en: Her relentless dedication and late night study sessions finally began to pay off.
items.ex_zh: 她坚持不懈的投入和深夜苦读终于开始为她带来丰厚回报。

items.def_en: (+ for) To pay money or provide a balancing benefit to balance effort, loss, or injury
items.ex_en: The airline offered travel vouchers to compensate passengers for the extensive flight delay.
items.ex_zh: 航空公司提供了旅行代金券，以补偿乘客因长时间航班延误所蒙受的损失。

items.def_en: (+ against/for) To compensate someone for incurred loss, damage, or legal liability
items.ex_en: The contract guarantees that the corporation will indemnify the contractor against third-party lawsuits.
items.ex_zh: 合同保证，公司将承担承包商因第三方诉讼而产生的一切损失与赔偿责任。

items.def_en: To pay someone for the labor, professional services, or work they have carried out
items.ex_en: The university will adequately remunerate the visiting scholar for her specialized lectures.
items.ex_zh: 大学将为这位客座学者的专业讲座支付充足的酬金。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on conferring money, goods, honors, or advantages upon someone in recognition of their positive effort, achievement, service, or sustained suffering. It spans institutional prizes, fair remuneration, and restorative restitution.
groups.summary_zh: 因良好的行为、功绩或损失付出，而给予他人相应的物质或荣誉报偿。
groups.desc_en: Giving value back to an agent in recognition of service, merit, or to offset an incurred loss or injury, contrasting with plain paying or gifting by carrying an intrinsic moral, contractual, or corrective entitlement.
groups.desc_zh: 因对方的付出、功劳或所受损失而给予对等价值的回报或补偿，与普通支付或赠予相比，带有道德认可、契约对价或权益填补属性。
groups.nuance_en: reward: confer benefit for merit or effort (effort / loyalty / success) · compensate: neutralize loss, injury, or hardship with equivalent value (victim / worker / damages) · recompense: formal restitution or reciprocal reward (service / loss / kindness) · remunerate: formally pay for work or services rendered (director / employee / services) · indemnify: legally protect or reimburse against financial loss or liability (policyholder / company / costs)
groups.nuance_zh: reward: 因功劳或忠诚予以奖赏 (effort / loyalty / success) · compensate: 弥补损失、工伤或不利条件 (victim / worker / damages) · recompense: 正式回报劳苦或补偿损失 (service / loss / kindness) · remunerate: 依约给付劳务报酬 (director / employee / services) · indemnify: 依法赔偿或免除经济责任 (policyholder / company / costs)

groups.name: Riffle & Flick · 翻动与轻拂 (Flick, Shuffle, Rustle)
groups.tip: 快速翻动书页或沙沙作响

items.def_en: Move papers or leaves so that they make dry, soft whispering crackling sounds
items.ex_en: Stop rustling those candy wrappers while the movie is still playing.
items.ex_zh: 电影还在放呢，别再把糖纸弄得沙沙响了。
items.ex2_en: Golden birch leaves rustled softly in the gentle cool morning breeze outdoors.
items.ex2_zh: 金黄的白桦树叶在户外清晨柔和凉爽的微风中沙沙作响。

items.def_en: Turn over pages, photographs, or cards rapidly with quick, sharp strokes
items.ex_en: She sat by the window, idly flicking through an old fashion magazine.
items.ex_zh: 她坐在窗边，心不在焉地飞快翻阅一本旧时尚杂志。

items.def_en: Examine, touch, or verify a sequence of items or pages in rapid succession
items.ex_en: Let me quickly run through these invoices to check for any billing errors.
items.ex_zh: 让我快速过一遍这些发票，看看有没有计费错误。

items.def_en: Spread out cards, pages, or fingers into the curved shape of an open semicircular fan
items.ex_en: The magician fanned the deck of cards smoothly across the green velvet.
items.ex_zh: 魔术师将整副纸牌在绿色丝绒桌面上顺畅地呈扇形展开。

items.def_en: Mix playing cards or loose sheets of paper together thoroughly by sliding them past each other
items.ex_en: Please shuffle the cards carefully before dealing the next poker hand.
items.ex_zh: 发下一把扑克牌前，请把牌仔细洗好。

items.def_zh: 快速翻阅，翻动；洗（牌）；使起微波
items.def_en: 1. To turn over or flick through pages or cards quickly. 2. To shuffle playing cards by flicking the corners together. 3. To cause light waves or ripples on water.
items.ex_en: A sudden autumn gust riffled the yellowed pages of his open journal.
items.ex_zh: 一阵突如其来的秋风快速翻动着他摊开的泛黄日记本。

groups.summary_en: Highlights the tactile, rhythmic mechanical manipulation of paper edges or cards, making a fluttering sound as pages or cards snap past.
groups.summary_zh: 指快速拨弄书页或纸牌边缘、发出沙沙声的轻快翻动动作。
groups.desc_en: Lightly brushing, rapidly turning, or leafing through stacked or layered flat surfaces, distinguished from thorough reading or rough handling by its brisk, tactile, and superficial manipulation.
groups.desc_zh: 轻巧、快速地拂动或翻阅叠放的扁平物体，与精读或粗暴翻弄相比，强调动作敏捷、触觉轻柔且仅作泛览。
groups.nuance_en: flick through: quickly flip pages with casual glances (magazine / channels / photos) · riffle: rapidly thumb through layered edges producing a fluttering sound (pages / deck of cards / documents) · run through: swiftly review or rehearse a sequence (script / list / notes) · rustle: generate crisp dry friction noises while handling (leaves / paper / silk) · shuffle: mechanically randomize the order of flat items (cards / papers / feet)
groups.nuance_zh: flick through: 漫不经心地随手翻阅 (magazine / channels / photos) · riffle: 快速弹拨边缘发出沙沙声 (pages / deck of cards / documents) · run through: 快速通读或过一遍 (script / list / notes) · rustle: 翻动干燥薄层发出窸窣声 (leaves / paper / silk) · shuffle: 打乱重排叠放物件 (cards / papers / feet)

groups.name: Roar & Snarl · 吼叫与咆哮 (Snarl, Growl, Bellow)
groups.tip: 愤怒时龇牙低吼，发出震慑性怒号

items.def_zh: 厉声厉气地说，恶狠狠地反唇相讥
items.def_en: To speak impatiently or irritably with sharp, sudden, cutting words
items.ex_en: "Stop asking stupid questions," the stressed manager snapped at her assistant.
items.ex_zh: “别再问蠢问题了，”压力巨大的经理厉声对助手斥道。

items.def_en: To shout orders or insults abruptly and sharply in an intimidating manner
items.ex_en: The drill sergeant barked sharp orders across the noisy parade ground.
items.ex_zh: 军士长在喧闹的检阅场上厉声发出一道道命令。

items.def_en: To make a low, guttural, threatening sound, or utter words in an angry, rumbling tone
items.ex_en: "Get off my property right now," the furious farmer growled menacingly.
items.ex_zh: “立刻从我的地盘滚出去，”愤怒的农夫低沉咆哮着。

items.def_en: To utter a full, deep, loud, and prolonged cry from anger, excitement, or predatory instinct
items.ex_en: The lion roared loudly, asserting dominance over the vast African savannah.
items.ex_zh: 狮子发出一声震天怒吼，向广袤的非洲大草原宣示霸权。

items.def_en: To shout in a deep, booming, resonant voice, typically out of rage or pain
items.ex_en: He bellowed in sudden agony when the heavy iron crate crushed his foot.
items.ex_zh: 当沉重的铁箱砸碎他的脚时，他因剧痛而发出凄厉的吼叫。

items.def_zh: （动物）龇牙低吼，咆哮；怒吼着说；缠结，使混乱
items.def_en: 1. (+ at) To make a deep, rough, threatening sound while showing the teeth, or say something in this manner. 2. (+ up) To become twisted into an entangled mass, or complicate traffic.
items.ex_en: The guard dog snarled viciously at the stranger approaching the locked gate.
items.ex_zh: 看门犬对着靠近锁闭大门的陌生人龇牙低吼。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate vocalizations made with hostility, guttural rasping, and bared teeth or raw volume. They denote intimidating, animalistic, or furious outbursts directed at an adversary.
groups.summary_zh: 指露出尖牙或充满敌意的低吼、怒号及凶猛咆哮。
groups.desc_en: Uttering deep, guttural, or explosive vocalizations driven by hostility, territorial threat, or rage, contrasting with ordinary shouting by its primal, beast-like resonance and intimidating menace.
groups.desc_zh: 由敌意、领地防御或狂怒引发的低沉、喉音或爆发性吼叫，与普通叫喊相比，带有原始的野兽感与威慑力。
groups.nuance_en: growl: low, rumbling guttural threat (dog / stomach / commander) · snarl: harsh threatening sound with bared teeth (wolf / rival / traffic) · roar: immense, resonant full-throated boom (lion / crowd / engine) · bellow: loud, deep, hollow shout of fury or pain (bull / sergeant / giant) · bark: sharp, abrupt, explosive verbal snapping (dog / officer / command)
groups.nuance_zh: growl: 低沉滚动的喉音威吓 (dog / stomach / commander) · snarl: 龇牙咧嘴的凶狠低吼 (wolf / rival / traffic) · roar: 宏大震天的气势咆哮 (lion / crowd / engine) · bellow: 狂怒或痛苦的粗粝长吼 (bull / sergeant / giant) · bark: 短促严厉的厉声喝斥 (dog / officer / command)

groups.name: Roll & Bowl · 滚动与滚转 (Roll, Trundle, Tumble)
groups.tip: 球状物体翻滚前行

items.def_zh: 平稳快速行驶；轻快滚过
items.def_en: To move along smoothly, rapidly, and effortlessly on wheels
items.ex_en: Their polished carriage bowled along the sunlit country lane without a tremor.
items.ex_zh: 他们擦拭锃亮的马车在洒满阳光的乡间小道上平稳轻快地疾驰。

items.def_en: To move along a surface by revolving over and over on an axis
items.ex_en: The red wooden ball rolled across the uneven grass into the pond.
items.ex_zh: 那个红色木球滚过坑洼不平的草坪，掉进了池塘里。
items.ex2_en: The clumsy worker accidentally rolled the heavy metal drum down the ramp.
items.ex2_zh: 笨拙的工人不小心将沉重的铁桶滚下了斜坡。

items.def_en: To roll or move along slowly, noisily, or heavily on wheels
items.ex_en: Old carts trundled noisily over the rough cobblestones into the crowded market.
items.ex_zh: 旧马车沉重喧闹地轧过粗糙的鹅卵石路，驶向拥挤的市集。
items.ex2_en: The tired porter trundled the heavy luggage cart across the busy airport.
items.ex2_zh: 疲惫的搬运工推着沉重的行李手推车穿过繁忙的机场。

items.def_zh: 滚球，使球滚动；掷球（板球或保龄球中）；快而稳地行驶
items.def_en: 1. To roll a ball smoothly along the ground in a game. 2. (cricket) To pitch or deliver the ball toward the batsman. 3. (+ along) To travel quickly and smoothly.
items.ex_en: The skilled athlete bowled the heavy sphere directly toward the target pins.
items.ex_zh: 这位娴熟的选手将重球笔直地朝球瓶滚掷过去。

items.def_en: To revolve or turn rapidly on an axis or pivot while moving
items.ex_en: The glossy coin continued to spin smoothly on the polished wooden table.
items.ex_zh: 那枚光亮的硬币在光洁的木桌上继续顺畅地自转。
items.ex2_en: The playful toddler spun the colorful plastic top across the smooth floor.
items.ex2_zh: 贪玩的小孩在光滑的地板上把色彩缤纷的塑料陀螺转得飞快。

items.def_en: To fall, turn over repeatedly, or roll end over end in an uncontrolled way
items.ex_en: Loose pebbles tumbled down the steep embankment after the sudden summer rain.
items.ex_zh: 夏季暴雨过后，松散的碎石稀里哗啦地滚落陡峭的护坡。

groups.summary_en: Covers moving by rotating repeatedly across a surface or propelling a rounded object onward along the ground.
groups.summary_zh: 描述物体自身翻滚旋转前进，或顺地滚送球体等圆物。
groups.desc_en: Moving across a surface via continuous rotation around an axis, differing from sliding or dragging by revolving motion, and from soaring by constant or bounding ground contact.
groups.desc_zh: 沿表面作轴向连续旋转前进，与滑动或拖拽不同在于周身翻转，与腾空飞越不同在于依托地表滚动。
groups.nuance_en: roll: revolve continuously over a surface (ball / wheel / tear) · tumble: fall and roll end over end without control (acrobat / rocks / toddler) · trundle: roll along slowly, heavily, and clumsily (cart / luggage / bus) · bowl: roll smoothly and rapidly, often intentionally directed (ball / bowler / carriage) · spin: rotate rapidly around an internal axis (top / wheel / propeller)
groups.nuance_zh: roll: 沿平面平稳滚转 (ball / wheel / tear) · tumble: 失控翻滚跌落 (acrobat / rocks / toddler) · trundle: 沉重迟缓地颠簸滚动 (cart / luggage / bus) · bowl: 快速顺畅地向前滚进 (ball / bowler / carriage) · spin: 绕自身轴心快速自转 (top / wheel / propeller)

groups.name: Rot & Decompose · 腐烂与分解 (Compost, Decompose, Break Down)
groups.tip: 堆肥发酵降解，化腐朽为养分

items.def_en: to separate organic compounds into simpler substances or decay biologically
items.ex_en: Soil microbes break down fallen autumn leaves into rich, fertile organic mulch.
items.ex_zh: 土壤微生物将飘落的秋叶分解为肥沃的有机覆土。
items.ex2_en: Discarded organic waste will break down rapidly in warm, well-aerated compost bins.
items.ex2_zh: 废弃的有机垃圾在温暖且通风良好的堆肥桶中会迅速分解。

items.def_en: 1. to convert organic waste, such as leaves and food scraps, into compost 2. to treat soil or plants by spreading compost over them
items.ex_en: We compost kitchen scraps and yard trimmings to enrich our vegetable patch.
items.ex_zh: 我们将厨房残羹和庭院剪枝制成堆肥，以滋养我们的菜园。

items.def_en: to be broken down harmlessly into natural products by microorganisms
items.ex_en: These eco-friendly packaging materials biodegrade naturally within twelve weeks of disposal.
items.ex_zh: 这些环保包装材料在丢弃后十二周内就会自然生物降解。
items.ex2_en: Soil microorganisms quickly biodegrade harmless organic residues in modern municipal composting facilities.
items.ex2_zh: 土壤微生物在现代市政堆肥设施中迅速生物降解无害的有机残留物。

items.def_en: to rot or decompose through the natural action of bacteria and fungi
items.ex_en: Fallen tree trunks slowly decay on the damp, shaded forest floor.
items.ex_zh: 倒地的树干在潮湿阴暗的林地上缓慢地腐烂衰朽。
items.ex2_en: Excessive moisture and poor ventilation will quickly decay untreated wooden fence posts.
items.ex2_zh: 过度潮湿和通风不良会迅速使未处理的木栅栏柱发生腐烂。

items.def_en: to undergo or cause to undergo chemical breakdown through natural biological activity into simpler elements
items.ex_en: Bacteria decompose animal carcasses into simpler chemical compounds within several weeks.
items.ex_zh: 细菌在数周内将动物尸体分解为更简单的化合物。
items.ex2_en: Fallen organic leaves decompose naturally during wet winter months in the forest.
items.ex2_zh: 掉落的有机树叶在森林潮湿的冬日里会自然分解。

items.def_en: to rot and decay with the emission of a foul, offensive odor
items.ex_en: Leftover fish began to putrefy in the unventilated heat of the cabin.
items.ex_zh: 吃剩的鱼肉在闷热不通风的船舱里开始腐败发臭。
items.ex2_en: Warm humid conditions rapidly putrefy raw meat left sitting out on counters.
items.ex2_zh: 温热潮湿的条件会迅速使放在柜台上的生肉腐烂发臭。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the biochemical breakdown of organic matter through natural or managed biological processes into soil-enriching humus or simpler chemical substances.
groups.summary_zh: 指有机物在自然或人为调控下被微生物分解转化为肥料或基础养分。
groups.desc_en: Undergoing biological or chemical disintegration into elemental components, focusing on the systemic degradation mechanism rather than mere aesthetic repugnance.
groups.desc_zh: 通过生物或化学作用分解为基础组分，侧重物质裂解的转化机制，而非单纯的感官腐败。
groups.nuance_en: decompose: break down biochemically into basic organic matter (corpse / leaves / tissue) · break down: separate into simpler constituent parts (plastic / chemical / food) · biodegrade: be broken down naturally by microorganisms without harm (packaging / waste / polymers) · compost: actively decompose organic matter to produce fertilizer (scraps / manure / yard waste) · decay: structurally decline and weaken over time (teeth / wood / civilization)
groups.nuance_zh: decompose: 生化分解为有机组分 (corpse / leaves / tissue) · break down: 降解裂变为细小结构 (plastic / chemical / food) · biodegrade: 经微生物天然无害降解 (packaging / waste / polymers) · compost: 经堆肥发酵制成肥料 (scraps / manure / yard waste) · decay: 经年累月逐渐衰退断蚀 (teeth / wood / civilization)

groups.name: Rot & Decompose · 腐烂与分解 (Rot, Decay, Putrefy)
groups.tip: 有机物从变质逐步化作泥土

items.def_en: To become unfit for eating through age or warm conditions
items.ex_en: Unpasteurized milk will spoil quickly if not kept in the refrigerator.
items.ex_zh: 未经巴氏消毒的牛奶如果不放在冰箱里很快就会变质变馊。
items.ex2_en: Excessive summer humidity can easily spoil fresh baked goods within several days.
items.ex2_zh: 夏季过高的湿度很容易在几天内使新鲜烘焙的食品变质。

items.def_en: To gradually degrade, break down, or spoil through organic and chemical processes
items.ex_en: Without regular brushing, residual sugars will inevitably decay your tooth enamel.
items.ex_zh: 若不定期刷牙，残留的糖分不可避免地会腐蚀你的牙釉质。
items.ex2_en: Untreated pine boards decay rapidly when exposed to constant damp autumn rainfall.
items.ex2_zh: 未经处理的松木板在长期暴露于秋季潮湿的雨水中时会迅速腐朽。

items.def_en: To undergo natural decomposition through the action of bacteria and fungi
items.ex_en: Overripe apples fell to the damp ground and began to rot.
items.ex_zh: 熟透的苹果掉落在潮湿的地上，开始腐烂。
items.ex2_en: Persistent dampness and warm fungal infections rotted the wooden foundation of the barn.
items.ex2_zh: 持续的潮湿和真菌侵染导致谷仓的木质地基发生腐烂。

items.def_en: to rot and break down naturally into simpler chemical elements or substances; to separate something into its component parts
items.ex_en: Fungi decompose dead plant fibers into vital nutrients for the surrounding soil.
items.ex_zh: 真菌将死亡的植物纤维分解为周围土壤所需的关键养分。
items.ex2_en: Discarded fruit rinds will decompose rapidly in the humid backyard compost bin.
items.ex2_zh: 丢弃的果皮在潮湿的后院堆肥箱中会迅速分解。

items.def_en: To become infected and filled with pus, or rot and decay offensive to the senses
items.ex_en: The untreated puncture wound began to fester and swell alarmingly overnight.
items.ex_zh: 未经处理的刺伤伤口一夜之间就开始化脓溃烂并严重肿胀。

items.def_en: To rot and decay producing a foul and repulsive stench
items.ex_en: The bloated carcass began to putrefy beneath the blazing midday sun.
items.ex_zh: 那具肿胀的尸体在正午灼热的烈日下开始腐败发臭。
items.ex2_en: Intense tropical heat will rapidly putrefy exposed organic matter within a day.
items.ex2_zh: 强烈的热带高温会在一天内使暴露在外的有机物迅速腐烂发臭。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses biological and organic deterioration where dead matter breaks down into simpler chemical constituents through bacterial action and natural decay.
groups.summary_zh: 强调有机体因微生物作用而自然败坏、腐烂、解体或质变。
groups.desc_en: Progressing through stages of organic corruption and putrid foulness, advancing from mild loss of freshness to offensive, infectious liquefaction.
groups.desc_zh: 有机物从失去新鲜感向腐臭、化脓乃至液化逐步加剧的感官腐败过程。
groups.nuance_en: spoil: lose freshness or become unfit to consume (milk / fruit / food) · decay: steadily rot and crumble away (timber / tooth / body) · rot: disintegrate foully through dampness or bacteria (meat / apple / carcass) · putrefy: rot with repulsive odor and gas formation (corpse / flesh / wound) · fester: generate pus or painfully corrupt from within (wound / resentment / slum)
groups.nuance_zh: spoil: 变质发酸以致不能食用 (milk / fruit / food) · decay: 逐渐蛀烂并丧失结构完整 (timber / tooth / body) · rot: 湿腐溃烂并散发异味 (meat / apple / carcass) · putrefy: 尸体或腐肉极度恶臭化解 (corpse / flesh / wound) · fester: 溃烂化脓或怨气暗中积聚 (wound / resentment / slum)

groups.name: Rote Mimicry & Unthinking Repetition · 机械复述与盲从传话 (Regurgitate, Ape, Chime in)
groups.tip: 像鹦鹉学舌般机械照搬复读

items.def_zh: 装模作样地说；口头上空洞念诵
items.def_en: To utter or say words, platitudes, or solemn promises insincerely or without real conviction
items.ex_en: Corrupt politicians easily mouth platitudes about justice while ignoring public suffering.
items.ex_zh: 腐败政客对正义空喊漂亮话，却对民众的苦难视若无睹。

items.def_zh: 反复齐呼；机械式反复念诵
items.def_en: To shout or speak slogans, verses, or phrases repetitively in unison or in a monotone manner
items.ex_en: Thousands of passionate demonstrators chanted the antiwar slogan in total unison.
items.ex_zh: 数以千计慷慨激昂的示威者异口同声地反复齐呼反战口号。

items.def_zh: 机械地重复，盲目附和，学舌
items.def_en: 1. (disapproving) To repeat someone else's words or ideas mechanically without really understanding them.
items.ex_en: He merely parrots party slogans without understanding their broader economic implications.
items.ex_zh: 他只是鹦鹉学舌般机械重复政党口号，根本不懂其更深远的经济含义。

items.def_zh: 老生常谈地搬出；重复俗套的说辞
items.def_en: (disapproving) To produce clichéd arguments, stock excuses, or familiar quotes routinely and predictably
items.ex_en: The spokesperson trotted out tired excuses to justify the sudden price hike.
items.ex_zh: 发言人老生常谈地搬出俗套的说辞，来为突如其来的涨价开脱。

items.def_zh: 拙劣模仿；生硬效仿（他人言行）
items.def_en: To imitate someone's speech mannerisms or gestures clumsily or without comprehension
items.ex_en: Novice debaters often ape their mentor's aggressive hand gestures and tone.
items.ex_zh: 初出茅庐的辩手往往会拙劣模仿他们导师激进的手势和语调。

items.def_zh: 照本宣科地复述；生搬硬套
items.def_en: (disapproving) To reproduce facts, phrases, or arguments mechanically without digesting or understanding them
items.ex_en: Unprepared students simply regurgitate textbook facts instead of offering original analysis.
items.ex_zh: 没有做好准备的学生只会照本宣科地复述课本事实，毫无原创分析。

groups.summary_en: This communication frame describes repeating or mimicking utterances, slogans, or dogma in a mindless, uncritical, or automated fashion. It highlights a lack of original understanding, critical evaluation, or genuine communicative intent.
groups.summary_zh: 强调不假思索、缺乏主见或机械式地照搬与重复他人的言论。
groups.desc_en: Mindlessly echoing, mimicking, or reproducing another party's words or behaviors without critical comprehension, contrasting with thoughtful quoting or genuine endorsement.
groups.desc_zh: 未经批判性理解而机械复述、模仿或转述他人言行，与深思熟虑的引用或真诚认同形成对比。
groups.nuance_en: parrot: mechanically repeat words without understanding (talking points / slogan / phrase) · ape: clumsily or slavishly imitate manners or style (style / masters / mannerisms) · regurgitate: blindly spew back memorized facts or dogmas (facts / ideology / textbook) · trot out: mechanically produce overused arguments or excuses (excuse / clichés / platitudes) · mouth: articulate words without genuine belief or voice (platitudes / words / prayer)
groups.nuance_zh: parrot: 鹦鹉学舌般机械复述 (talking points / slogan / phrase) · ape: 拙劣或奴性地模仿风格举止 (style / masters / mannerisms) · regurgitate: 生吞活剥地倒背事实观点 (facts / ideology / textbook) · trot out: 机械端出用滥的借口或陈词 (excuse / clichés / platitudes) · mouth: 虚应故事地嘴唇微动或空喊 (platitudes / words / prayer)

groups.name: Rumble & Boom · 轰鸣与隆隆声 (Resound, Roar, Peal)
groups.tip: 低沉而震耳欲聋的声音

items.def_en: To make a continuous low, heavy, resonant sound like thunder or heavy vehicles
items.ex_en: Heavy freight trucks rumble across the suspension bridge throughout the night.
items.ex_zh: 重型货车整夜在悬索桥上隆隆驶过。

items.def_en: To echo repeatedly and loudly, often causing slight physical vibration
items.ex_en: His deep, thunderous voice reverberated throughout the vast marble cathedral.
items.ex_zh: 他那低沉如雷的声音在大理石大教堂的整个空间内久久回荡。

items.raw_cluster: 发出轰鸣与作响 Rumble & Boom
items.def_zh: 发出低沉隆隆声，轰鸣；繁荣，激增
items.def_en: 1. To make a deep, loud, resonant sound. 2. To experience rapid economic growth or success.
items.ex_en: Distant naval cannons boomed ominously through the dense coastal fog.
items.ex_zh: 远方的舰炮在浓重的海雾中沉闷而凶险地轰鸣。

items.def_en: To make a very loud, deep noise, or move with that kind of tremendous sound
items.ex_en: The midnight express train thundered past the quiet suburban station.
items.ex_zh: 午夜特快列车雷鸣般呼啸着掠过寂静的郊区车站。

items.def_en: To make a deep, prolonged, very loud sound, like an engine or a stormy sea
items.ex_en: Massive ocean waves roared against the jagged granite cliffs during the storm.
items.ex_zh: 暴风雨中，巨大的海浪呼啸着猛烈撞击犬牙交错的花岗岩悬崖。

items.def_en: To sound out in a loud, echoing burst or ring with prolonged resonance
items.ex_en: Joyous cathedral bells pealed across the valley to celebrate the royal wedding.
items.ex_zh: 欢庆的教堂钟声在山谷间悠扬大作，庆祝王室婚礼。
items.ex2_en: The happy bellringers pealed the giant bronze bells across the whole valley.
items.ex2_zh: 欢快的司钟人们敲响了巨大的青铜钟，钟声在整个山谷中回荡。

groups.summary_en: This frame comprises emitting continuous, deep, explosive, or resonant acoustic vibrations such as thunder, artillery, heavy machinery, or amplified sound.
groups.summary_zh: 指发出沉闷低回、震耳欲聋或持续回响的轰隆声。
groups.desc_en: Emitting or propagating deep, continuous, or rolling resonant acoustic energy that physically shakes its surroundings, differing from sharp high-pitched clatter.
groups.desc_zh: 发出或传导深沉、连续或滚动的共鸣声能并引起物理震颤，区别于尖锐清脆的撞击声。
groups.nuance_en: rumble: deep, continuous, low rolling sound (thunder / stomach / train) · boom: sudden, massive, resonant explosive sound (cannon / bass / voice) · thunder: crash loudly with imposing, concussive force (applause / surf / waterfall) · reverberate: echo repeatedly through a space (sound / shockwaves / laughter) · peal: ring out in rich, loud, sustained bursts (bells / thunder / laughter)
groups.nuance_zh: rumble: 沉闷连续的滚动隆隆声 (thunder / stomach / train) · boom: 巨大低沉的轰响或震波 (cannon / bass / voice) · thunder: 如雷霆般剧烈轰鸣震荡 (applause / surf / waterfall) · reverberate: 声波在封闭空间内回响震荡 (sound / shockwaves / laughter) · peal: 钟声或雷鸣宏亮阵阵激荡 (bells / thunder / laughter)

groups.name: Run Organized Extortion · 有组织敲诈与非法勾当 (Racketeer, Swindle, Hustle)
groups.tip: 黑帮以暴力敲诈勒索钱财

items.def_en: To make an unfair, exorbitant profit through predatory or illicit circumstances
items.ex_en: Corrupt merchants were caught profiteering by hoarding vital medicines during the crisis.
items.ex_zh: 腐败奸商在危机期间囤积救命药品牟取暴利，当场被抓。

items.def_en: To intimidate and extort money from someone through underworld muscle
items.ex_en: Mobsters regularly shook down local restaurant owners for hefty protection money.
items.ex_zh: 黑帮分子定期向当地餐馆老板勒索数额不菲的保护费。

items.def_en: To use physical force, intimidation, or aggressive threats to compel compliance
items.ex_en: Armed thugs tried to strong-arm the elderly shopkeeper into selling his land.
items.ex_zh: 持械暴徒企图用暴力胁迫那位年迈的店主交出土地。

items.def_en: To strip someone of money or property through fraudulent, predatory schemes
items.ex_en: Dishonest tour guides consistently fleece gullible visitors with overpriced souvenirs.
items.ex_zh: 不良导游总是用天价纪念品对轻信的游客大敲竹杠。

items.def_en: To wrest money or property through illicit and systematic intimidation
items.ex_en: The ruthless cartel used death threats to extort funds from the politician.
items.ex_zh: 冷血的犯罪集团以死亡威胁向该政客勒索巨额资金。

items.def_zh: 进行非法敛财，参与敲诈勒索
items.def_en: To make money through dishonest, fraudulent, or illegal business schemes such as extortion.
items.ex_en: Organized crime syndicates racketeer within the city's private waste disposal industry.
items.ex_zh: 有组织犯罪团伙在该市的民营垃圾清运业中进行非法敛财。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on engaging in structured, institutionalized, or organized crime schemes—such as protection rackets, predatory scams, or underworld financial coercion.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过有组织团伙、欺诈性生意网络或保护费机制长期实施非法敲诈牟利。
groups.desc_en: Coercively extracting illicit wealth or compliance through intimidation, institutional abuse, or systematic extortion, contrasting with simple theft by relying on leverage and menace.
groups.desc_zh: 利用恐吓、体制特权或有组织网络强索不义之财，与普通盗窃相比，依靠人身威胁与权力杠杆。
groups.nuance_en: extort: extract money or concessions through threats or coercion (bribe / confession / ransom) · shake down: coerce someone into paying via aggressive threats (shopkeeper / business / tourist) · strong-arm: force compliance using physical intimidation (witness / merchant / opponent) · racketeer: operate an organized illegal fraudulent scheme (gang / mobster / syndicate) · fleece: strip someone thoroughly of their money via swindling (investors / tourists / public)
groups.nuance_zh: extort: 依仗恐吓或胁迫勒索 (bribe / confession / ransom) · shake down: 暴力敲诈勒索商户或目标 (shopkeeper / business / tourist) · strong-arm: 倚仗蛮力或武力施压屈服 (witness / merchant / opponent) · racketeer: 操盘有组织敲诈勒索黑产 (gang / mobster / syndicate) · fleece: 巧取豪夺榨干受骗者钱财 (investors / tourists / public)

groups.name: Sacrifice & Forego · 牺牲与放弃 (Surrender, Relinquish, Forego)
groups.tip: 为大局舍弃个人利益

items.def_en: To cheerfully or deliberately abstain from having or enjoying something desirable
items.ex_en: She deliberately chose to forego dessert to maintain her rigorous training regimen.
items.ex_zh: 她特意选择放弃吃甜点，以维持她严苛的训练作息。

items.def_en: To abandon ownership, pursuit, or possession of something valuable
items.ex_en: He had to give up his ancestral farm after bankruptcy.
items.ex_zh: 破产后，他不得不舍弃了祖辈留下的农场。

items.def_en: To lose or give up a privilege, asset, or right as a consequence of error, duty, or rule
items.ex_en: Violating company confidentiality rules will forfeit your claim to the yearly bonus.
items.ex_zh: 违反公司保密规章将使你丧失申领年度奖金的资格。

items.def_en: To willingly surrender custody, a claim, right, or treasured possession to another
items.ex_en: The retiring monarch agreed to relinquish control of the kingdom to his heir.
items.ex_zh: 退位的君主同意将王国的统治权让渡给他的继承人。

items.def_en: 1. To give up something valued for the sake of other considerations or for someone else. 2. To offer something as a sacrifice to a deity.
items.ex_en: Devoted parents willingly sacrifice personal ambitions for their children's welfare.
items.ex_zh: 全心全意的父母甘愿为了儿女的福祉牺牲自己的个人抱负。

items.def_en: (+ to) To give up a right, advantage, or resource under external pressure or duty
items.ex_en: The conquered garrison had to surrender all ammunition to the advancing army.
items.ex_zh: 被征服的守军不得不将全部弹药交予推进中的敌军。

groups.summary_en: Encompasses voluntarily relinquishing valuable possessions, rights, advantages, or ethical standings for a higher purpose, duty, or obligation.
groups.summary_zh: 指为实现崇高目标或迫于义务，自愿让出或割舍重大利益。
groups.desc_en: Yielding a valuable possession, right, or desire, progressing from voluntary abstention to painful, total, and enforced forfeiture.
groups.desc_zh: 放弃自身珍视的权益、愿望或所有物，程度从主动克制弃权递进至痛苦、彻底乃至被迫的丧失。
groups.nuance_en: forego: voluntarily decide to abstain from an advantage (pleasure / opportunity / salary) · relinquish: let go or yield control, right, or claim (power / custody / control) · surrender: give up under pressure or admit defeat (weapon / independence / territory) · sacrifice: give up something vital for a higher purpose (career / life / happiness) · forfeit: lose something as a penalty for wrongdoing or default (deposit / right / title)
groups.nuance_zh: forego: 主动克制放弃既得利益或享受 (pleasure / opportunity / salary) · relinquish: 勉强或正式交出控制权或主张 (power / custody / control) · surrender: 在外力逼迫下认输投降交出 (weapon / independence / territory) · sacrifice: 为更高目标而献祭宝贵事物 (career / life / happiness) · forfeit: 因违约或违纪而被剥夺没收 (deposit / right / title)

groups.name: Sanctify & Elevate to Sainthood · 封圣与祝圣 (Canonize, Sanctify, Beatify)
groups.tip: 宗教层面的祝圣与尊奉

items.def_en: To officially declare someone to be a saint (canonize); to regard or treat someone as holy or a saint.
items.ex_en: The grateful villagers saint the martyred doctor who cured their epidemic.
items.ex_zh: 心怀感激的村民们将那位治愈了他们疫病的殉道医生尊为圣人。

items.def_en: To officially declare a person, bread/wine, or building sacred to God
items.ex_en: The elderly bishop consecrated the newly rebuilt cathedral before thousands of worshippers.
items.ex_zh: 年迈的主教在数千名信徒面前为新重建的大教堂祝圣。

items.def_zh: 奉为神明般供奉，铭记并崇敬
items.def_en: To place a relic or revered figure in a shrine or regard with sacred veneration
items.ex_en: The democratic constitution enshrines basic human rights for all citizens.
items.ex_zh: 民主宪法将所有公民的基本人权庄严地铭记并奉为崇高原则。

items.def_zh: 使神圣化，祝圣；使正当化，认可
items.def_en: 1. To make something holy or officially bless it through a religious ceremony. 2. To give official or religious sanction to something, making it morally acceptable.
items.ex_en: The archbishop conducted holy rites to sanctify the newly constructed burial grounds.
items.ex_zh: 大主教举行神圣仪式，为新建的墓地进行祝圣以使其圣化。

items.def_zh: 册封为圣人，追封为圣徒
items.def_en: To officially declare a dead person to be an authorized saint in the church
items.ex_en: The Holy See decided to canonize the nineteenth-century nun for her verified miracles.
items.ex_zh: 圣座决定追封那位十九世纪的修女为圣徒，因其展现了经核实的奇迹。

items.def_zh: 宣福，行宣福礼（封圣前奏）
items.def_en: (of the Pope) To officially announce that a deceased person is blessed, preliminary to canonization
items.ex_en: The Pope will officially beatify the martyred priest during Sunday mass.
items.ex_zh: 教皇将在周日弥撒期间正式为那位殉难的牧师行宣福礼。

groups.summary_en: This ecclesiastical and ritual frame concerns solemn religious authority declaring a deceased person a saint, elevating an object or status to sacred veneration, or rendering a person or place holy through sacrament and decree.
groups.summary_zh: 指宗教机构或权威通过庄严仪式将人册封为圣徒，或将事物祝圣使之神圣化。
groups.desc_en: Formally elevating a person, relic, or idea into the realm of the sacred, untouchable, or venerable, contrasting with ordinary respect by imparting institutional or metaphysical holiness.
groups.desc_zh: 将人物、圣物或观念正式确立为神圣、不可侵犯或至高典范，与普通尊重相比，赋予了体制化或形而上的圣洁地位。
groups.nuance_en: sanctify: make holy, purify, or give religious sanction to (marriage / ground / sacrifice) · consecrate: formally dedicate to religious or divine service (bishop / altar / temple) · enshrine: protect and revere as holy or inviolable (rights / memory / relic) · beatify: papal declaration that a deceased person is blessed (pope / martyr / monk) · canonize: officially declare a deceased person to be a saint (saint / church / hero)
groups.nuance_zh: sanctify: 赋予定律神圣性或加以祝圣 (marriage / ground / sacrifice) · consecrate: 正式奉献于神职或宗教用途 (bishop / altar / temple) · enshrine: 铭刻奉入神龛使其不可侵犯 (rights / memory / relic) · beatify: 罗马教廷册封其为真福者 (pope / martyr / monk) · canonize: 官方正式册封为圣人或奉为宗师 (saint / church / hero)

groups.name: Satisfy & Gratify · 满足与取悦 (Satisfy, Please, Content)
groups.tip: 满足欲望与期许使其称心

items.def_en: To make someone feel happy, satisfied, or approving
items.ex_en: The pianist selected a charming waltz to please the expectant evening audience.
items.ex_zh: 钢琴家挑选了一首悦耳的华尔兹，以讨好今晚满怀期待的观众。

items.def_en: To make someone feel happy and satisfied with what they have, often keeping expectations modest
items.ex_en: The modest harvest will content the frugal farmers through the coming winter.
items.ex_zh: 这不算丰盛的收成已足以让朴素的农夫们在来冬心满意足。

items.def_en: To fulfill someone's needs, demands, or expectations, making them feel pleased or contented
items.ex_en: The gourmet buffet easily satisfied the voracious appetites of all visiting athletes.
items.ex_zh: 这顿美馔自助餐轻松满足了所有来访运动员的旺盛食欲。

items.def_en: To allow someone or oneself to enjoy the pleasure of something, often to excess
items.ex_en: She decided to indulge her cravings by ordering a rich chocolate dessert.
items.ex_zh: 她决定顺从自己的口腹之欲，点了一份浓郁的巧克力甜点。

items.def_zh: 使满意，使高兴；满足（欲望、期许等）
items.def_en: To please or satisfy someone, or to indulge a craving, desire, or appetite.
items.ex_en: The committee's generous approval did much to gratify the young scholar's burning ambitions.
items.ex_zh: 委员会慷慨的批准极大地满足了这位年轻学者的勃勃雄心。

items.def_en: To bring pleasure, relief, or deep satisfaction to someone's heart or mind
items.ex_en: The unexpected arrival of peace news served to gladden every anxious heart in town.
items.ex_zh: 停战消息的意外传来让城里每一颗焦虑的心都欣喜万分。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe giving someone pleasure by fulfilling their desires, needs, or expectations. While 'gratify' often implies indulging an appetite, pride, or deep craving, synonyms range from basic fulfillment to soothing delight.
groups.summary_zh: 描述满足他人欲望、需求或虚荣心，带来愉悦与宽慰。
groups.desc_en: Meeting the desires, expectations, or emotional needs of an agent, contrasting with mere tolerance by evoking positive psychological fulfillment.
groups.desc_zh: 迎合并实现主体的欲望、期望或情感需求，与单纯容忍不同，能引发积极的心理满足感。
groups.nuance_en: satisfy: meet requirements, desires, or hunger adequately (need / hunger / condition) · please: evoke joy or approval in someone (audience / patron / parents) · content: make someone accept their lot without craving more (oneself / customer / mind) · gratify: provide immediate pleasure or appease a vanity/craving (desire / ego / senses) · indulge: yield permissively to an urge or whim (whim / fantasy / appetite)
groups.nuance_zh: satisfy: 充分达标以满足需求或欲望 (need / hunger / condition) · please: 讨得欢心并博得认可 (audience / patron / parents) · content: 使感到知足且别无他求 (oneself / customer / mind) · gratify: 使虚荣或冲动获得快感满足 (desire / ego / senses) · indulge: 纵容迁就某种癖好或奢望 (whim / fantasy / appetite)

groups.name: Saturate & Permeate · 浸透与渗透 (Saturate, Permeate, Pervade)
groups.tip: 深层浸润直至彻底饱和

items.def_en: To thoroughly immerse or imbue an object or person with a quality or medium
items.ex_en: The elderly scholar lived in a tranquil retreat steeped in ancient classical traditions.
items.ex_zh: 这位年迈的学者住在一处深浸于古老古典传统的宁静幽居之中。

items.def_en: To spread completely throughout every part of an object, space, or group
items.ex_en: The distinct aroma of roasted spices began to permeate the entire kitchen area.
items.ex_zh: 烤香料独特的香气开始弥漫在整个厨房区域。

items.def_zh: 使浸透，使充满；使受孕，使怀孕
items.def_en: 1. to soak or fill something completely with a liquid, gas, or substance 2. to make a female pregnant
items.ex_en: Technicians impregnate the dense timber with chemical preservatives to resist rot effectively.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员用化学防腐剂浸透致密的木料，以有效防止腐烂。

items.def_en: To spread through and be noticeable throughout every portion of something
items.ex_en: A subtle sense of mutual distrust seemed to pervade the tense negotiation room.
items.ex_zh: 一种微妙的互不信任感似乎弥漫在紧张的谈判室里。

items.def_en: To spread gradually through, across, or over something with liquid, light, or color
items.ex_en: Golden rays of morning sunlight suffuse the quiet valley with extraordinary warmth.
items.ex_zh: 清晨金色的阳光洒满寂静的山谷，充溢着非凡的温暖。

items.def_en: To make something hold as much liquid, moisture, or solute as can possibly be absorbed
items.ex_en: Heavy monsoon rains quickly saturate the low-lying fields beyond their normal capacity.
items.ex_zh: 暴虐的季风降雨迅速使低洼的田野湿透饱和。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe a substance, liquid, or gas entering, diffusing through, and filling every pore, fiber, or corner of an object until total absorption or saturation is reached.
groups.summary_zh: 指液体、气体或特性深度渗入多孔介质的每一细孔，达到彻底充塞饱和。
groups.desc_en: A substance, fluid, or quality progressively diffusing throughout another medium, graduating from deep soaking to absolute, unabsorbable capacity.
groups.desc_zh: 某种物质、液体或特质在介质中不断扩散渗透，程度从深度浸润直至达到无法再吸收的极限饱和。
groups.nuance_en: steep in: soak thoroughly in liquid or immerse in knowledge (tea / history / tradition) · permeate: spread gradually through every pore or part (smell / influence / water) · pervade: diffuse comprehensively throughout an entire space or atmosphere (gloom / scent / ideology) · suffuse: spread gradually over or through with light, color, or emotion (light / color / warmth) · saturate: soak so completely that no more can be absorbed (market / soil / sponge)
groups.nuance_zh: steep in: 长期浸润或深陷于某种氛围学识 (tea / history / tradition) · permeate: 穿过微孔全面渗透渗入 (smell / influence / water) · pervade: 弥漫充斥整个空间或系统 (gloom / scent / ideology) · suffuse: 光色或情绪轻柔漫溢开来 (light / color / warmth) · saturate: 彻底湿透或达到饱和极限 (market / soil / sponge)

groups.name: Scan & Inspect · 扫视与审视 (Scan, Scrutinize, Skim)
groups.tip: 快速扫读细致检查各处

items.def_en: To look at or examine something quickly and briefly, often to form a preliminary impression
items.ex_en: Would you mind casting an eye over my rough draft before tomorrow morning?
items.ex_zh: 你介意在明天早上之前帮我粗略过目一下初稿吗？

items.def_en: (+ through/over) To read or look through something quickly in order to identify the main points without reading every word
items.ex_en: She skimmed through the lengthy briefing paper to extract the primary financial figures.
items.ex_zh: 她快速浏览了这份冗长的简报，以提取主要的财务数据。

items.def_zh: 细看，审视；粗略翻阅，扫视；扫描（图像或数据）
items.def_en: 1. To look at something carefully and thoroughly in search of something. 2. To read or look over something quickly. 3. To pass an optical or electronic beam over something to capture data or an image.
items.ex_en: The security guard carefully scanned the bustling terminal crowd for suspicious luggage.
items.ex_zh: 保安仔细审视着熙熙攘攘的航站楼人群，搜寻可疑行李。

items.def_en: (+ over/across) To move one's eyes or gaze quickly and smoothly across an area in search of something
items.ex_en: Her anxious eyes swept over the crowded platform searching for her lost sister.
items.ex_zh: 她焦急的目光扫过拥挤的站台，寻找失散的妹妹。

items.def_en: To look at and read or study a book, map, or document with prolonged, focused attention
items.ex_en: The diligent historian pored over ancient church records to verify the historical date.
items.ex_zh: 勤勉的历史学家凝神研读古老的教会档案，以核实那个历史日期。

items.def_en: To examine someone or something very carefully and thoroughly, looking for details, errors, or hidden clues
items.ex_en: Auditors arrived early to scrutinize every single expense report from the past quarter.
items.ex_zh: 审计员早早赶来，仔细审查上个季度的每一份报销单。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe directing one's gaze systematically over an area, text, or surface, ranging from rapid visual sweeps to rigorous, detail-oriented examination.
groups.summary_zh: 指有条理地注视或查阅，涵盖快速浏览与细致审视。
groups.desc_en: Directing visual or analytical attention across an area or document, varying in manner from lightning-fast skimming to exhaustive, microscopic scrutiny.
groups.desc_zh: 对文本或视野展开视觉或逻辑检视，方式从极速泛读扫视到穷尽细节的显微镜式审视。
groups.nuance_en: skim: read or glance over rapidly for main points only (headline / surface / document) · scan: sweep the gaze quickly searching for specific cues (crowd / horizon / barcode) · cast an eye over: give a quick, casual preliminary inspection (draft / manuscript / room) · scrutinize: examine minutely with critical, searching detail (record / face / contract) · pore over: study or read with intense, sustained concentration (map / text / ledger)
groups.nuance_zh: skim: 略读浮光掠影以提取大意 (headline / surface / document) · scan: 扫视全貌以搜寻特定信息 (crowd / horizon / barcode) · cast an eye over: 大致过目或草草审阅 (draft / manuscript / room) · scrutinize: 严密挑剔地细查细节 (record / face / contract) · pore over: 凝神长久地伏案研读 (map / text / ledger)

groups.name: Scar & Disfigure · 留下伤痕与损容 (Scar, Deface, Blemish)
groups.tip: 从局部伤痕到完全毁灭破损

items.def_en: To spoil the appearance or flaw the perfect surface or reputation of something
items.ex_en: A single careless administrative error threatened to blemish the firm's unblemished reputation.
items.ex_zh: 一个粗心的行政错误险些玷污了该事务所无可指摘的声誉。

items.def_zh: 使留下伤痕；使心灵受创伤；结疤
items.def_en: 1. To leave a permanent physical mark on the skin or land. 2. To leave a lasting feeling of grief or emotional trauma in someone. 3. To form a scar.
items.ex_en: Severe childhood hardships can scar an individual's emotional outlook for many decades.
items.ex_zh: 童年的严重苦难可能会在往后数十年里给一个人的情感留下创伤。

items.def_en: To ruin or diminish the perfection, completeness, or attractiveness of something
items.ex_en: A sudden violent thunderstorm threatened to mar the exquisite perfection of the garden wedding.
items.ex_zh: 一场突如其来的狂暴雷雨险些破坏了这场花园婚礼的绝妙完美。

items.def_en: To deliberately spoil the appearance of something, especially by writing on or cutting it
items.ex_en: Vandals used industrial spray paint to deface the historic marble fountain overnight.
items.ex_zh: 蓄意破坏者在一夜之间用工业喷漆污损了这座历史悠久的大理石喷泉。

items.def_en: To spoil the attractive appearance of someone or something severely and often permanently
items.ex_en: The horrific chemical explosion threatened to disfigure the young factory worker permanently.
items.ex_zh: 那场可怕的化学爆炸险些使这位年轻的工厂工人永久毁容。

items.def_en: To inflict severe and lasting emotional shock or deep psychological pain upon someone
items.ex_en: Witnessing the brutal highway collision severely traumatized the innocent young bystanders.
items.ex_zh: 目睹那场惨烈的公路相撞事件使无辜的年轻旁观者身心大受创伤。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe leaving lasting, visible, or psychological marks that mar the appearance, integrity, or emotional well-being of someone or something. They range from superficial blemishes to deep, permanent disfigurement.
groups.summary_zh: 描述在身体、景物或心灵上留下永久性伤痕、玷污或毁容。
groups.desc_en: Inflicting physical or aesthetic damage on a surface or appearance, progressing from superficial imperfections to permanent structural disfigurement and trauma.
groups.desc_zh: 对物体表面或肉体外观造成形态或美感损害，程度从表层瑕疵递进至永久性损容毁形与精神创伤。
groups.nuance_en: blemish: spoil the flawless perfection of a surface (reputation / skin / record) · mar: impair the beauty, perfection, or quality of (surface / celebration / landscape) · deface: spoil the surface appearance deliberately through vandalism (monument / poster / wall) · disfigure: permanently spoil the shape or outward appearance of (face / body / landscape) · scar: leave enduring physical marks or deep emotional trauma (tissue / psyche / community)
groups.nuance_zh: blemish: 留下轻微瑕疵玷污原本无暇之物 (reputation / skin / record) · mar: 破坏完整美感或煞风景 (surface / celebration / landscape) · deface: 故意涂画破坏公共外观 (monument / poster / wall) · disfigure: 永久性损毁相貌或形体结构 (face / body / landscape) · scar: 留下终生疤痕或深刻心灵创痛 (tissue / psyche / community)

groups.name: Scatter & Clutter · 散落与杂乱丢弃 (Litter, Clutter, Strew)
groups.tip: 随处抛掷散落成杂乱

items.def_en: To leave things in untidy places where they ought not to be
items.ex_en: Please stop leaving your muddy football boots about in the entrance hall.
items.ex_zh: 请不要再把你沾满泥巴的足球鞋乱扔在门厅里了。

items.def_en: To throw or drop things in different directions so they cover an area
items.ex_en: Gusty autumn winds scatter dry golden leaves across the deserted village square.
items.ex_zh: 阵阵秋风把干燥的金黄色落叶撒落在空荡荡的村庄广场上。
items.ex2_en: The frightened flock of birds scattered quickly across the wide autumn sky.
items.ex2_zh: 受惊的鸟群在辽阔的秋日天空中迅速向四处飞散开来。

items.def_zh: 乱扔；到处散落，乱七八糟地堆满；（动物）产仔
items.def_en: 1. To leave rubbish or scattered items lying untidily around a place. 2. (of an animal) To give birth to a litter of young.
items.ex_en: Careless tourists continue to litter the pristine mountain trails with plastic bottles.
items.ex_zh: 粗心的游客继续把塑料瓶乱扔在原始的山道上。

items.def_en: To make an area dirty, untidy, or disordered
items.ex_en: The rambunctious puppies completely messed up the neatly arranged living room rugs.
items.ex_zh: 那几只精力过剩的小狗把摆放整齐的客厅地毯搞得一团糟。

items.def_en: To fill or cover a place with an untidy collection of things
items.ex_en: Stacks of unopened cardboard boxes clutter the narrow hallway near the entrance.
items.ex_zh: 一堆堆未拆封的纸箱把入口附近的狭窄走廊塞得乱七八糟。

items.def_en: To scatter things untidily over a surface or place
items.ex_en: The bridesmaids strew delicate rose petals along the stone pathway before sunset.
items.ex_zh: 伴娘们在日落前沿着石径撒落娇艳的玫瑰花瓣。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on depositing items haphazardly or untidily across a surface or space, often creating disorder, untidiness, or obstruction.
groups.summary_zh: 表示将杂物、垃圾等凌乱散放或随意丢弃在某处，造成杂乱无章的景象。
groups.desc_en: Distributing objects untidily across a space without order, contrasting with organized placement by creating visual disorder and obstruction.
groups.desc_zh: 毫无规则地将物品凌乱分散在空间各处，与规整收纳相对，强调视觉杂乱与空间阻塞。
groups.nuance_en: scatter: throw or toss loosely in various directions (seeds / papers / ashes) · strew: spread untidily over a broad surface (flowers / wreckage / debris) · litter: discard messily, making an area dirty or unsightly (street / beach / floor) · clutter: crowd and choke a space with disorderly items (desk / room / hallway) · mess up: disarrange or throw into disordered confusion (hair / room / schedule)
groups.nuance_zh: scatter: 朝各个方向撒落或抛散 (seeds / papers / ashes) · strew: 密密麻麻散落铺满地面 (flowers / wreckage / debris) · litter: 乱扔垃圾杂物破坏整洁 (street / beach / floor) · clutter: 杂物堆积塞满并阻塞空间 (desk / room / hallway) · mess up: 弄乱整洁秩序致其脏乱 (hair / room / schedule)

groups.name: Scatter & Disperse · 分散与驱散 (Disperse, Dissipate, Disband)
groups.tip: 由聚到散四散奔逃

items.def_en: To run away quickly with light, hurried steps in different directions
items.ex_en: The frightened mice scurried off under the wooden floorboards upon hearing footsteps.
items.ex_zh: 受到惊吓的老鼠一听到脚步声就仓皇溜散到了木地板下面。

items.def_en: 1. To move or cause people or animals to suddenly move in different directions; disperse. 2. To throw or drop things in different directions over a wide area.
items.ex_en: The sudden loud thunderclap caused the feeding pigeons to scatter in panic.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的一声炸雷让正在觅食的鸽子惊慌地四散飞开。
items.ex2_en: The playful dog scattered dried autumn leaves all over the clean lawn.
items.ex2_zh: 淘气的狗狗把干燥的秋叶撒得满干净的草坪都是。

items.def_en: To spread out widely or drive a group of people or things away in various directions
items.ex_en: Riot police deployed tear gas to disperse the rowdy crowd before dusk.
items.ex_zh: 防暴警察在黄昏前施放催泪瓦斯驱散了吵闹的人群。
items.ex2_en: The thick early morning fog began to disperse gradually as the bright sun rose.
items.ex2_zh: 随着明媚的太阳升起，清晨厚重的浓雾开始逐渐消散开来。

items.def_en: To gradually disappear or cause smoke, mist, or feelings to vanish into thin air
items.ex_en: Gentle morning breezes slowly dissipate the thick fog blanketing the coastal harbor.
items.ex_zh: 柔和的晨风慢慢驱散了笼罩在海港上的浓雾。
items.ex2_en: Dense morning fog dissipated rapidly once the bright sun rose over hills.
items.ex2_zh: 当明媚的太阳升上山头，浓重的晨雾便迅速消散了。

items.def_en: To stop functioning as a formal group, committee, or military unit and separate
items.ex_en: The independent oversight panel will officially disband after submitting its final report.
items.ex_zh: 独立监督小组在提交最终报告后将正式解散。
items.ex2_en: The military commanders decided to disband the specialized tactical unit after the conflict.
items.ex2_zh: 军事指挥官决定在冲突结束后解散该专业战术小队。

items.def_en: To scatter things messily untidily over a surface or area
items.ex_en: Fallen autumn leaves were strewn along the quiet path beside the riverbank.
items.ex_zh: 凋落的秋叶散落在河岸旁的幽静小径上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate crowds, objects, or clouds breaking up and moving outward in all directions, dissolving cohesion. They highlight random distribution or the complete breakup of a unified mass.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重聚集的人群、微粒或物体向四面八方散去，使其不再凝聚。
groups.desc_en: A unified collective or concentration breaking apart and moving away in varied directions, contrasting with orderly departure by dissolving into constituent parts.
groups.desc_zh: 原本聚集的群体或浓度核心解体并朝四处分离散去，与整队离开不同，强调凝聚力的瓦解与消融。
groups.nuance_en: scatter: break and flee hastily in different directions (crowd / herd / pigeons) · disperse: break up and cause to vanish or spread out (protesters / cloud / seeds) · dissipate: gradually thin out and disappear entirely (smoke / fog / tension) · disband: officially break up an organized group or unit (army / committee / band) · scurry off: run away rapidly with small hurried steps (mice / servants / children)
groups.nuance_zh: scatter: 受惊吓四散溃退逃窜 (crowd / herd / pigeons) · disperse: 驱散或自发散开至稀疏 (protesters / cloud / seeds) · dissipate: 烟雾或情绪逐渐消散殆尽 (smoke / fog / tension) · disband: 正式解散编制或组织 (army / committee / band) · scurry off: 碎步匆匆仓皇溜走 (mice / servants / children)

groups.name: Screen & Filter · 筛查与甄别 (Filter, Vet, Sift)
groups.tip: 通过检查过滤不良信息

items.def_zh: 甄别，筛查；审查；遮蔽，掩护
items.def_en: 1. To test, examine, or check people or things to find disease, faults, or suitability. 2. To protect, shelter, or hide behind a screen.
items.ex_en: The airport clinics rigorously screen arriving passengers for signs of infectious fever.
items.ex_zh: 机场诊所对入境旅客进行严格筛查，以排查传染性发热迹象。

items.def_en: (often + out) To pass items through a selective process to keep desirable elements and reject others
items.ex_en: The new software system can filter out spam messages with remarkable accuracy.
items.ex_zh: 这款新软件系统能以极高的准确度过滤掉垃圾邮件。
items.ex2_en: Warm afternoon sunlight filtered gently through the green leaves of the weeping willow.
items.ex2_zh: 午后温暖的阳光透过垂柳青翠的叶片柔和地洒了进来。

items.def_en: To assign degrees of urgency to wounds, illnesses, or tasks to decide order of treatment
items.ex_en: Nurses swiftly triage incoming disaster casualties based on the severity of injuries.
items.ex_zh: 护士们根据伤情的严重程度迅速对送抵的灾难伤员进行分诊。

items.def_en: To eliminate inferior, unsuited, or unwanted members from a group
items.ex_en: The rigorous entrance exam helped weed out unsuitable applicants from the program.
items.ex_zh: 严格的入学考试有助于从该项目中淘汰不合格的申请者。

items.def_en: To examine someone or something to confirm truth, identity, or soundness
items.ex_en: We need to check out of the hotel by noon, but let's check out the local market first.
items.ex_zh: 我们需要在中午前结账退房，不过先去看看当地的集市吧。

items.def_en: To investigate someone's background, past record, or suitability thoroughly before approval
items.ex_en: The security team will vet all potential candidates before granting security clearance.
items.ex_zh: 安全团队将在发放安全许可之前对所有潜在候选人进行严格审查。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote systematically evaluating candidates, items, or signals through standardized tests or criteria to identify flaws, verify qualifications, or isolate acceptable targets.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过既定标准或测试对人员或事物进行系统性筛查、背景审查或甄别淘汰。
groups.desc_en: Evaluating and separating entities against criteria to admit the qualified and eliminate the unfit, differing from mere sorting by its defensive and gatekeeping purpose.
groups.desc_zh: 依据标准对目标群体进行甄别检验以准入合格者并剔除不适者，与一般分类相比，强调把关与防御职能。
groups.nuance_en: screen: systematically test or check for latent suitability or defects (passengers / candidates / blood) · filter: separate and block unwanted elements via a barrier (content / contaminants / resumes) · vet: investigate an individual's background thoroughly for integrity (candidate / appointee / source) · weed out: aggressively remove inferior, redundant, or undesirable items (incompetents / defects / weaklings) · triage: prioritize patients or tasks based on urgency and resource constraints (patients / casualties / tickets)
groups.nuance_zh: screen: 照章系统初筛排查潜在缺陷 (passengers / candidates / blood) · filter: 设卡阻截剔除不合规因子 (content / contaminants / resumes) · vet: 严密政审查验背景与可靠度 (candidate / appointee / source) · weed out: 坚决淘汰清除劣质或冗余成分 (incompetents / defects / weaklings) · triage: 依紧迫程度检伤分类与排定优先级 (patients / casualties / tickets)

groups.name: Scroll & Browse · 滚屏与翻动 (Scroll, Swipe, Flick)
groups.tip: 屏幕或页面上下翻动

items.def_en: To turn the pages of a book, document, or publication quickly
items.ex_en: He casually leafed through the glossy magazine while waiting for his appointment.
items.ex_zh: 他在等待赴约时随手翻阅着那本铜版纸杂志。

items.def_zh: 滚屏，滚翻（屏幕内容）；（使）卷起
items.def_en: 1. (+ up/down/through) (computing) To move text, images, or webpage content across a screen. 2. To curl or cause to curl into the shape of a scroll.
items.ex_en: The ancient poet watched the dry parchment scroll gently beneath his fingers.
items.ex_zh: 那位古代诗人注视着干燥的羊皮纸卷在指间徐徐卷曲。

items.def_en: To inspect text, goods, or online content casually without a fixed goal
items.ex_en: Shoppers often browse the vintage clothing racks without intending to buy anything.
items.ex_zh: 顾客们经常随心浏览复古服装货架，却并无购买之意。

items.def_en: (+ through) To turn pages quickly or perform short, fast scrolling gestures
items.ex_en: She flicked through the fashion catalog quickly during her short train commute.
items.ex_zh: 她在短暂的乘火车通勤途中快速翻阅了那本时尚画册。

items.def_en: (+ left/right/up) To move a finger across a touchscreen to change content or view pages
items.ex_en: You can easily swipe left to view the next slide in sequence.
items.ex_zh: 你可以轻松向左划动屏幕来按顺序查看下一张幻灯片。

items.def_en: (+ through) To read or view text rapidly in order to grasp the main points
items.ex_en: The executive skimmed through the quarterly balance sheet to spot major anomalies.
items.ex_zh: 这位主管快速扫视了季度资产负债表，以发现重大异常。

groups.summary_en: Covers digital interaction gestures and rapid mechanical scanning through digital pages, texts, feeds, or physical leaves.
groups.summary_zh: 指在屏幕或书页上滑动、翻动浏览以查看连续图文内容。
groups.desc_en: Involves navigating superficially through physical pages or digital interfaces with quick, low-cognitive physical inputs, differing from deep 'reading' or 'studying' through continuous kinetic skimming.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及通过快速、轻微的肢体或手势交互在实体书页或数字界面上浮光掠影地浏览，与专注的'精读/研读'形成对照。
groups.nuance_en: scroll: continuous vertical or horizontal digital traversal (feed / webpage) · swipe: directional finger stroke across a touchscreen (card / photo) · flick: rapid, light finger movement inducing inertia (screen / switch) · browse: leisurely perusal without rigid targets (catalog / aisles) · leaf through: physical turning of leaves or pages (book / magazine) · skim: rapid visual scanning for gist (report / headline)
groups.nuance_zh: scroll: 屏幕画面的连续垂直或水平滚动 (feed / webpage) · swipe: 触屏上的定向滑动手势 (card / photo) · flick: 引发惯性滚动的快速轻弹 (screen / switch) · browse: 无固定目标的随意泛览 (catalog / aisles) · leaf through: 翻动纸质书页 (book / magazine) · skim: 掠取要点的快速略读 (report / headline)

groups.name: Seam & Join · 接缝与缉缝 (Hem, Stitch, Overlock)
groups.tip: 针线压缝合拢衣物接缝
