items.def_en: To kill someone or an animal in a violent, bloody, or archaic/heroic manner
items.ex_en: The ruthless assassin slayed anyone who dared stand in his gang's way.
items.ex_zh: 冷酷的刺客残杀了所有敢阻挡他团伙去路的人。

items.def_en: To commit the crime of deliberately and unlawfully killing another human being
items.ex_en: He brutally murdered his wealthy business partner just to claim the inheritance.
items.ex_zh: 他残忍地谋杀了富有的合伙人，只为霸占那笔遗产。

items.def_en: To kill animals for meat, or kill large numbers of people cruelly and indiscriminately
items.ex_en: The rampaging mercenaries slaughtered innocent villagers and looted every single dwelling.
items.ex_zh: 横行霸道的雇佣兵屠杀了无辜村民，并洗劫了每一栋房屋。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe intentionally taking the life of a human being or animal. Semantic distinctions hinge on legal execution, brutal butchery, predatory hunting, or unlawful malice.
groups.summary_zh: 指有意剥夺人或动物生命的各种行为，包含处刑、谋害与屠杀。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the termination of life with specific connotations of violence, judicial power, mass brutality, or criminality, contrasting with generic neutral dying ('kill') through heavy social or narrative framing.
groups.desc_zh: 指以暴力、司法处决、大规模屠戮或犯罪手段夺取生命，与中性的“杀死 (kill)”相比，带有强烈的叙事色彩、制度权能或残暴性。
groups.nuance_en: slay: archaic or literary term for striking dead in battle, or mythic beasts (dragon / beast / foe) · slaughter: to kill animals for meat, or massacre people en masse brutally (cattle / civilians / innocents) · murder: to kill unlawfully with premeditated malice (victim / rival / witness) · execute: to put to death pursuant to a legal sentence (prisoner / traitor / convict) · bump off: informal/slang term for murdering or assassinating (rival / boss / witness)
groups.nuance_zh: slay: 书面或史诗语体中斩杀、弑杀 (dragon / beast / foe) · slaughter: 宰杀牲畜或大规模残忍屠杀 (cattle / civilians / innocents) · murder: 蓄意非法谋杀 (victim / rival / witness) · execute: 依法或依命令执行死刑 (prisoner / traitor / convict) · bump off: 俚语干掉、做掉 (rival / boss / witness)

groups.name: Slide & Slip · 滑行与滑倒 (Slide, Skid, Glide)
groups.tip: 表面失控滑移或打滑倒下

items.def_en: To move continuously, smoothly, and effortlessly through air or over ice
items.ex_en: The majestic bald eagle glided smoothly on thermal updrafts above the canyon.
items.ex_zh: 那只威严的白头海雕乘着热气流在峡谷上空流畅滑翔。

items.def_zh: 打滑，滑倒；悄悄溜走；滑落，下滑
items.def_en: 1. To slide accidentally and lose one's footing or balance. 2. To move quietly and stealthily without attracting attention. 3. To slide smoothly or cause something to glide smoothly into position.
items.ex_en: He slipped on the icy pavement and bruised his shoulder quite badly.
items.ex_zh: 他在结冰的人行道上滑倒，肩膀摔得青一块紫一块。

items.def_en: To move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact
items.ex_en: The heavy wooden drawer slides smoothly along its newly oiled metal runners.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的木抽屉在刚涂过油的金属导轨上平稳地滑动。
items.ex2_en: He slid the confidential report across the mahogany desk toward his business partner.
items.ex2_zh: 他把那份机密报告沿着红木办公桌推向他的商业合伙人。

items.def_en: (+ over/up) To catch one's foot and stumble, often leading to a slip or fall
items.ex_en: She tripped over a protruding tree root and fell onto the trail.
items.ex_zh: 她被一根凸出的树根绊了一下，摔倒在小道上。
items.ex2_en: The mischievous little boy stuck out his foot to trip his older brother.
items.ex2_zh: 调皮的小男孩伸出脚绊倒了他的哥哥。

items.def_en: To slide sideways or uncontrollably over a surface due to loss of traction
items.ex_en: The speeding delivery van skidded wildly on wet leaves before stopping safely.
items.ex_zh: 超速行驶的货车在湿树叶上猛烈打滑，随后安全停下。

items.def_en: To move by sliding sinuously or unstable over a slick, uneven surface
items.ex_en: The venomous viper slithered silently across the loose gravel toward the bushes.
items.ex_zh: 那条毒蛇悄无声息地滑过松散的碎石，钻向灌木丛。

groups.summary_en: Covers smooth continuous movement across a slick surface, or unintended loss of traction causing a sudden loss of balance.
groups.summary_zh: 指在光滑表面上无阻力移动，或因失去抓地力而失去平衡滑倒。
groups.desc_en: Denotes smooth, continuous, or uncontrolled movement along a low-friction surface, contrasting with rolling or stepping by stressing continuous flat contact and potential loss of traction.
groups.desc_zh: 指物体或人在低摩擦表面上的平滑、无障碍行进或失控打滑，与滚动或迈步相比，强调与接触面的贴地平移及对抓地力的失去。
groups.nuance_en: slide: standard controlled or continuous gliding over a smooth surface (door / home / scale) · slip: an accidental loss of footing or smooth discrete movement (ice / floor / mind) · skid: to slide sideways or forward uncontrollably due to loss of tire/foot traction (car / tires / wheels) · glide: to move smoothly, effortlessly, and gracefully without friction (ice / dancer / swan) · slither: to move with a winding, serpentine, or stealthy sliding motion (snake / creature / mud)
groups.nuance_zh: slide: 沿平面平稳滑行或滑动机构运作 (door / home / scale) · slip: 脚下打滑失足，或无意滑落 (ice / floor / mind) · skid: 车轮或脚步因抓地力丧失而打滑侧滑 (car / tires / wheels) · glide: 优雅无阻、毫不费力地滑翔或滑行 (ice / dancer / swan) · slither: 蛇行般蜿蜒贴地滑行 (snake / creature / mud)

groups.name: Smell & Scent · 嗅探与闻气 (Sniff, Scent, Snuff)
groups.tip: 用鼻子感知空气中气味

items.def_en: To detect by sense of smell, or to sense something imminent intuitively
items.ex_en: The experienced hounds quickly scented the wounded stag hiding among the ferns.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的猎犬很快嗅到了藏在蕨类植物丛中的受伤雄鹿。

items.def_en: To draw air audibly up through the nose to detect a scent or clear mucus
items.ex_en: She sniffed cautiously at the opened milk carton to verify its freshness.
items.ex_zh: 她小心翼翼地闻了闻打开的牛奶盒，确认它是否新鲜。

items.def_zh: 闻到一缕气味；略微闻到
items.def_en: To catch a brief, faint smell of something, or to emit a puff of odor
items.ex_en: I whiffed stale cigar smoke the moment I opened the front door.
items.ex_zh: 我一打开前门就闻到了一缕难闻的雪茄烟味。

items.def_en: To discover or detect something by smelling, or figuratively by shrewd searching
items.ex_en: Trained dogs efficiently sniffed out the concealed contraband at border customs.
items.ex_zh: 训练有素的搜救犬在边境海关高效地嗅出了藏匿的违禁品。

items.def_zh: 闻到，嗅出；散发气味，闻起来有……气味；闻，嗅
items.def_en: 1. To perceive the scent or odor of something using your nose. 2. To have or emit a particular odor, or to smell bad. 3. To sniff at something to discover its odor.
items.ex_en: The kitchen smelled delightfully of cinnamon, vanilla, and freshly baked sourdough.
items.ex_zh: 厨房里散发着肉桂、香草和新鲜出炉酸种面包的诱人香气。

items.def_zh: 抽气嗅闻；用鼻子使劲吸
items.def_en: To inhale audibly through the nose to detect an odor
items.ex_en: The curious terrier snuffed at the damp soil near the rabbit hole.
items.ex_zh: 那只好奇的梗犬在兔子洞附近的湿土上使劲嗅闻。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the sensory perception of odors through the nose or the emission of a characteristic aroma. Verbs range from involuntary olfaction to active, deliberate sniffing and detecting traces.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖通过嗅觉器官感知气味或自身散发气味的动作与状态。
groups.desc_en: Denotes perceiving, inhaling, or actively tracking olfactory stimuli, contrasting with passive perception by encompassing deliberate olfactory exploration and animalistic sensing.
groups.desc_zh: 指感知、吸入或主动追踪气味信息，与被动的“嗅到”相比，包含刻意的吸气嗅探动作及动物性的气味追踪本能。
groups.nuance_en: smell: basic perception of an odor, active or passive (roses / smoke / rat) · sniff: to draw air audibly through the nose to identify a scent (air / flower / food) · scent: to detect, trail, or imbue with an odor, typical of animals (danger / blood / prey) · sniff out: to locate something hidden through relentless searching (truth / corruption / scandal) · whiff: to catch a brief, sudden, or faint draft of odor (odor / breeze / cordite)
groups.nuance_zh: smell: 最基本的闻到气味或发出气味 (roses / smoke / rat) · sniff: 抽鼻子吸气以细嗅 (air / flower / food) · scent: 动物嗅探追踪气味，或察觉端倪 (danger / blood / prey) · sniff out: 顺藤摸瓜搜出隐秘物或真相 (truth / corruption / scandal) · whiff: 略微吸到或闻到一缕微弱气味 (odor / breeze / cordite)

groups.name: Snag & Catch · 勾绊与卡住 (Snag, Catch, Tangled)
groups.tip: 被突起物挂住或受阻卡壳

items.def_en: To wedge tightly in an opening or mechanism so that motion is completely prevented
items.ex_en: A crumpled piece of cardboard jammed the roller mechanism inside the printer.
items.ex_zh: 一张褶皱的硬纸板卡死了打印机内部的滚轴机构。
items.ex2_en: The rusted iron mechanism suddenly jammed when workers attempted to lift the sluice.
items.ex2_zh: 当工人们试图提起水闸时，生锈的铁制机械装置突然卡住了。

items.def_en: (+ on) To become hooked, trapped, or entangled unexpectedly on a protruding object
items.ex_en: His wool jacket caught on a rusty wire protruding from the fence.
items.ex_zh: 他的羊毛外套被篱笆上伸出的生锈铁丝挂住了。

items.def_en: To fasten, fasten on, or catch onto something with or as if with a hook
items.ex_en: He hooked his fishing tackle securely onto the boat's stainless steel railing.
items.ex_zh: 他把钓具牢牢地钩在船身的不锈钢栏杆上。

items.def_en: To become tangled or caught with lines, ropes, or mechanisms, impeding free movement
items.ex_en: The trailing nylon mooring line fouled the ship's massive bronze propeller.
items.ex_zh: 拖曳在后的尼龙系泊缆绳缠住了轮船巨大的青铜螺旋桨。
items.ex2_en: The loose fishing lines fouled during the violent storm and could not move.
items.ex2_zh: 松散的鱼线在剧烈的暴风雨中缠成一团，无法移动。

items.def_zh: 勾绊，卡住；勾破；抓住，获取
items.def_en: 1. To catch, snag, or tear on a sharp or rough object. 2. (informal) To obtain, catch, or secure something quickly.
items.ex_en: I managed to snag the very last discounted ticket for tonight's concert.
items.ex_zh: 我设法顺手抢到了今晚音乐会的最后一张打折票。
items.ex2_en: Her delicate silk scarf snagged on the rusty nail protruding from the wall.
items.ex2_zh: 她精致的丝巾挂在了墙上凸出的生锈铁钉上。

items.def_en: To cause something to become twisted, caught, and snared in wires, cords, or vegetation
items.ex_en: The discarded plastic netting entangled several sea turtles near the shallow reef.
items.ex_zh: 废弃的塑料渔网在浅礁附近缠住了好几只海龟。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers mechanical or physical entanglements where an object or garment gets caught on a projection, resulting in an abrupt halt, tear, or obstruction.
groups.summary_zh: 突起物挂住、勾扯或卡阻衣物及物体，导致受阻或撕破。
groups.desc_en: Denotes unexpected mechanical or physical obstruction where a moving part or flexible material is caught, trapped, or tangled, contrasting with voluntary stopping by emphasizing disruptive friction or entrapment.
groups.desc_zh: 指运动中的物体或柔性线缆被突起、外物意外勾住、绞入或机械卡死，与主动停顿相比，强调破坏性的机械阻碍或受困阻滞。
groups.nuance_en: snag: to catch or tear unexpectedly on a sharp projection (sleeve / branch / hair) · catch: broad capturing of an edge or component causing cessation (foot / latch / throat) · jam: to become wedged tightly so movement is immobilized (gun / printer / door) · foul: to become entangled, choked, or encrusted, especially ropes/props (anchor / propeller / lines) · entangle: to intertwine intricately so liberation is difficult (roots / wire / affairs)
groups.nuance_zh: snag: 被尖锐物勾住扯破或遇到突发小阻碍 (sleeve / branch / hair) · catch: 绊住、勾住、被机构咬合 (foot / latch / throat) · jam: 挤紧卡死导致彻底无法运转 (gun / printer / door) · foul: 缠结阻滞水下螺旋桨或锚缆 (anchor / propeller / lines) · entangle: 彻底绞缠成死结、深陷纠纷 (roots / wire / affairs)

groups.name: Snake & Meander · 蜿蜒蛇行与盘曲延伸 (Snake, Wind, Meander, Serpentine)
groups.tip: 如蛇一般曲折蜿蜒向前

items.def_en: follow a curving, twisting line, course, or pathway through an area
items.ex_en: The scenic country road winds gently through emerald pastures and dense forests.
items.ex_zh: 这条风景优美的乡间小路蜿蜒穿过碧绿的牧场和茂密的森林。
items.ex2_en: The careful mountaineer wound the long climbing rope around his strong right arm.
items.ex2_zh: 谨慎的登山者把长长的登山绳缠绕在结实的右臂上。

items.def_en: pass carefully and sinuously through a narrow, crowded, or intricate space
items.ex_en: The nervous courier threaded cautiously through the jam-packed, bustling night market.
items.ex_zh: 神情紧张的信使小心翼翼地曲折穿行在拥挤熙攘的夜市中。

items.def_en: follow a bent or winding route that repeatedly alters orientation
items.ex_en: The ancient cobblestone trail twists sharply along the rugged mountain crest.
items.ex_zh: 这条古老的鹅卵石小径沿着崎岖的山脊急剧曲折盘旋。

items.def_en: to move, twist, or wind in a sinuous manner like a snake
items.ex_en: A long queue of patient fans snaked around the massive stadium block.
items.ex_zh: 耐心等候的粉丝排成的长队宛如长蛇般绕着巨大的体育场街区蔓延。

items.def_en: follow a winding, slow, or circuitous course without fixed urgency
items.ex_en: The shallow river meanders leisurely past historic villages and sunny vineyards.
items.ex_zh: 浅浅的河流悠然自得地蜿蜒流过古朴的村落和阳光明媚的葡萄园。

items.def_en: move in or form concentric curved, spiral, or loop-like turns
items.ex_en: Thick plumes of dark smoke coiled lazily upward from the decaying chimney.
items.ex_zh: 浓密的黑烟从破败的烟囱中慢悠悠地盘旋上升。
items.ex2_en: The quiet sailor coiled the thick wet hemp rope neatly on the deck.
items.ex2_zh: 沉默的水手把又粗又湿的麻绳整齐地盘在甲板上。

groups.summary_en: This frame characterizes smooth, fluid, continuous curved motion across space, reminiscent of a snake's locomotion or a meandering river. The curves are sinuous and sweeping rather than sharp or angular.
groups.summary_zh: 指如流水或游蛇般平缓、连续弯曲蜿蜒推进或延伸的轨迹与姿态。
groups.desc_en: Denotes tracing a sinuous, twisting, or meandering path through space, contrasting with linear progression by highlighting continuous curves, leisurely bends, or natural terrain avoidance.
groups.desc_zh: 指道路、河流或线条在空间中呈现多弯、回环或曲折盘旋的前行路径，与直线行进相比，强调依地势曲折摆动或从容慢游。
groups.nuance_en: snake: to wind through an area in long, narrow, S-like curves (river / path / queue) · meander: to wander leisurely and circuitously without an urgent direction (stream / conversation / path) · wind: to advance through repeated sweeping bends or spirals (road / staircase / trail) · twist: to distort sharply with sudden, abrupt turns (path / lane / river) · thread: to navigate carefully through narrow, complex, or crowded passages (way / crowd / labyrinth)
groups.nuance_zh: snake: 如蛇行般蜿蜒伸展 (river / path / queue) · meander: 漫无目的地曲折流淌或闲逛 (stream / conversation / path) · wind: 盘旋曲折前进 (road / staircase / trail) · twist: 急转突弯、盘结延伸 (path / lane / river) · thread: 穿针引线般穿梭于复杂狭窄处 (way / crowd / labyrinth)

groups.name: Snatch & Swipe · 扒窃与偷摸 (Cop, Swipe, Nick)
groups.tip: 不正当秘密占有财物

items.def_en: To take something that belongs to someone else dishonestly or without asking permission
items.ex_en: Someone brazenly walked off with my expensive umbrella during the office lunch.
items.ex_zh: 有人在公司午休时明目张胆地顺走了我昂贵的雨伞。

items.def_en: To steal something, especially from a shop or an unsuspecting person's pocket or bag
items.ex_en: A professional pickpocket lifted his leather wallet on the crowded morning commuter train.
items.ex_zh: 一名职业扒手在拥挤的早班通勤列车上偷走了他的皮夹。
items.ex2_en: The dense morning fog began to lift slowly over the calm mountain valley.
items.ex2_zh: 清晨浓重的雾气开始在平静的山谷上空缓缓消散。

items.def_en: To steal an object, often quickly or impulsively
items.ex_en: The cheeky rascal nicked a pair of designer sunglasses from the counter.
items.ex_zh: 那个厚脸皮的无赖从柜台上顺走了一副名牌太阳镜。

items.def_en: To steal something of little value, usually quickly and without being noticed
items.ex_en: He pinched a handful of fresh cherries from the vendor's unattended cart.
items.ex_zh: 他趁小贩无人看管时从手推车里偷抓了一把新鲜樱桃。

items.def_en: To steal something casually or opportunistically, especially an item of modest value
items.ex_en: A brazen customer swiped the brand-new tester bottle from the cosmetic display.
items.ex_zh: 一名厚颜无耻的顾客从化妆品陈列架上顺走了崭新的试用装。

items.def_en: (slang) 1. To steal or take something unlawfully. 2. To catch or arrest someone.
items.ex_en: The petty thief tried to cop some shiny watches from the storefront.
items.ex_zh: 那个小偷企图从临街橱窗里顺手牵羊拿走几块闪亮的手表。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers informal and colloquial acts of snatching, lifting, or sneaking away small items without authorization. It emphasizes casual, illicit, or opportunist appropriation rather than grand larceny.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重口语与俚语中的顺手牵羊、偷摸或顺走小物件。
groups.desc_en: Denotes informal, covert, or swift petty theft of unattended items, contrasting with heavy armed robbery ('rob') by emphasizing opportunistic stealth, sleight of hand, or colloquial triviality.
groups.desc_zh: 指乘人不备、顺手牵羊式的小偷小摸或顺走财物，与暴力的抢劫相比，强调机会主义、手法隐秘及日常口语色彩。
groups.nuance_en: swipe: informal lifting or stealing with a quick casual motion (wallet / card / sandwich) · pinch: British informal for pilfering minor items (pennies / ideas / shoes) · nick: British colloquial for petty stealing or taking (car / wallet / tools) · lift: professional or casual shoplifting and petty extraction (wallet / goods / jewels) · walk off with: to brazenly or casually abscond with something not belonging to one (prize / cash / equipment)
groups.nuance_zh: swipe: 顺手摸走、顺手牵羊 (wallet / card / sandwich) · pinch: 英式俚语偷鸡摸狗、掐走小东西 (pennies / ideas / shoes) · nick: 英式口语顺走、扒窃 (car / wallet / tools) · lift: 扒手行窃、商店顺手牵羊 (wallet / goods / jewels) · walk off with: 大摇大摆据为己有地顺走 (prize / cash / equipment)

groups.name: Sniff & Probe · 嗅探与搜搜 (Nose, Sniff, Pry)
groups.tip: 顺着气味蛛丝马迹打探

items.def_zh: 四处探头翻找，随意翻寻
items.def_en: To search through items or explore an area casually or meddlesomely
items.ex_en: The curious tenant poked around the dusty attic looking for forgotten relics.
items.ex_zh: 好奇的房客在积满灰尘的阁楼里四处翻寻，寻找被遗忘的旧物。

items.def_zh: 嗅，闻；打听，探听；（车辆、船只等）小心前移
items.def_en: 1. To smell or sniff something; to pry or investigate in a meddlesome way. 2. (of a vehicle or vessel) To move forward slowly and carefully.
items.ex_en: The nosey neighbor kept trying to nose into our private family finances.
items.ex_zh: 那个爱管闲事的邻居总是试图打探我们家的私人财务状况。

items.def_en: To inhale audibly through the nose to identify or scrutinize an odor
items.ex_en: The suspicious sommelier sniffed the wine cork carefully to detect any flaws.
items.ex_zh: 多疑的侍酒师仔细嗅了嗅葡萄酒瓶塞，以察觉是否有任何瑕疵。

items.def_en: To look around furtively trying to find out personal or confidential information
items.ex_en: The meddlesome roommate constantly snooped through my private emails while I showered.
items.ex_zh: 那个爱管闲事的室友趁我洗澡时经常偷窥我的私人电子邮件。

items.def_en: To inquire insolently or intrusively into other people's private matters
items.ex_en: I hate when pushy acquaintances pry into my personal dating life.
items.ex_zh: 我讨厌那些冒昧的熟人打探我的私人恋爱生活。

items.def_en: To search out tenacity and uncover hidden facts, secrets, or evasive individuals
items.ex_en: The determined investigative reporter ferretted out the company's hidden offshore accounts.
items.ex_zh: 那名执着的调查记者挖出了该公司隐秘的离岸账户。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate sniffing physically or prying inquisitively into hidden spaces or personal secrets. They describe investigative scrutiny driven by keen olfactory instinct or intrusive curiosity.
groups.summary_zh: 用鼻闻探，或指带着好奇、窥探欲到处打听搜寻。
groups.desc_en: Denotes intrusive, inquisitive snooping or searching into confidential or private matters, contrasting with formal investigating by stressing clandestine, nosy, or unwanted prying.
groups.desc_zh: 指怀着强烈好奇心对他人私密事务进行的暗中打探、窥探或翻找，与正规调查相比，强调不合法的越界性、窥探癖或讨人嫌的刺探。
groups.nuance_en: pry: to inquire impertinently or force open private concerns (secrets / affairs / life) · snoop: to look around surreptitiously to find private information (drawers / emails / phone) · nose: to pry inquisitively or edge one's way into others' business (into / around / affairs) · poke around: to casually inspect or rummage through unfamiliar places (attic / files / shop) · ferret out: to search tenaciously until hidden information or people are uncovered (truth / facts / secrets)
groups.nuance_zh: pry: 打探隐私、撬探机密 (secrets / affairs / life) · snoop: 偷偷摸摸潜入窥探 (drawers / emails / phone) · nose: 好管闲事地东闻西嗅探听 (into / around / affairs) · poke around: 到处翻寻、漫不经心地闲翻 (attic / files / shop) · ferret out: 像雪貂搜洞般不依不饶查出底细 (truth / facts / secrets)

groups.name: Snigger & Smirk · 讥笑与暗笑 (Snicker, Smirk, Chortle)
groups.tip: 掩嘴暗笑或心怀不善地窃窃嗤笑

items.def_en: To laugh quietly to oneself in a restrained, amused way
items.ex_en: The elderly gentleman chuckled quietly to himself while reading the humorous memoir.
items.ex_zh: 那位老绅士读着幽默的回忆录，独自轻声低笑起来。

items.def_en: (+ at) To laugh quietly or half-suppress a laugh, especially in a disrespectful or unkind manner
items.ex_en: The disrespectful boys snickered at the substitute teacher's awkward, stammering introduction.
items.ex_zh: 那帮不礼貌的男生对代课老师笨拙结巴的自我介绍暗自嗤笑。

items.def_zh: 窃笑，暗笑（尤指不敬或幸灾乐祸地）
items.def_en: (chiefly British) To laugh quietly in an unkind, disrespectful, or covert way.
items.ex_en: Rude classmates sniggered nastily when he mispronounced the foreign foreign author's name.
items.ex_zh: 当他读错那位外国作家的名字时，粗鲁的同班同学恶劣地窃笑起来。

items.def_en: To laugh nervously, quietly, or covertly, often at something embarrassing or scandalous
items.ex_en: Several nervous girls tittered anxiously when the solemn lights suddenly flickered out.
items.ex_zh: 当严肃大厅的灯光突然闪烁熄灭时，几名紧张的女孩不安地吃吃窃笑。

items.def_en: To smile in an unpleasant, smug, or conceited way showing self-satisfaction
items.ex_en: The arrogant rival smirked triumphantly after winning the final round of chess.
items.ex_zh: 傲慢的对手在赢下最后一轮国际象棋比赛后得意地冷笑。

items.def_en: (+ at) To smile or speak in a mocking, scornful manner that reveals contempt
items.ex_en: The haughty critic sneered at the amateur painting exhibited in the gallery.
items.ex_zh: 那位傲慢的评论家对画廊展出的业余画作嗤之以鼻。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures quiet, covert, or stifled laughter typically tinged with malice, disrespect, superiority, or amusement at someone else's misfortune or embarrassment.
groups.summary_zh: 指暗中、压抑或带有轻蔑嘲弄意味的窃笑与冷笑。
groups.desc_en: Denotes suppressed, mocking, or self-satisfied laughter, contrasting with hearty, open merriment by highlighting derision, concealment, superiority, or malice.
groups.desc_zh: 指压抑、窃笑或自得的嘲讽性笑声，与开怀大笑相比，带有明显的掩饰性、优越感、戏谑或轻蔑意味。
groups.nuance_en: smirk: an insolent, smug, or self-satisfied conceited smile (face / expression / satisfaction) · sneer: a facial grimace showing utter contempt, scorn, or cynicism (critics / rival / comment) · snicker: a half-suppressed, disrespectful, sly giggle (at / corner / audience) · snigger: British equivalent of snicker, often with unpleasant malice (behind back / whisper / schoolboy) · chortle: a satisfied, chuckling snort combining a chuckle and a snort (glee / delight / triumph)
groups.nuance_zh: smirk: 沾沾自喜、得瑟轻佻的假笑或傻笑 (face / expression / satisfaction) · sneer: 充满鄙视、轻蔑的冷笑嘲笑 (critics / rival / comment) · snicker: 捂嘴偷笑、暗中窃笑 (at / corner / audience) · snigger: 英式暗含恶意的窃笑 (behind back / whisper / schoolboy) · chortle: 幸灾乐祸或欢快得意的咯咯咯发笑 (glee / delight / triumph)

groups.name: Soak & Dunk · 浸湿与浸泡 (Dip, Immerse, Souse)
groups.tip: 没入水中彻底浸湿

items.def_en: To put something briefly into a liquid and take it out again immediately
items.ex_en: He dipped his crusty bread briefly into the hot bowl of soup.
items.ex_zh: 他把硬皮面包在热汤碗里稍稍蘸了一下。
items.ex2_en: The narrow dirt path dips sharply into a shallow valley filled with wildflowers.
items.ex2_zh: 狭窄的泥土小路急剧向下倾斜，通向开满野花的浅谷中。

items.def_zh: 泡一下，浸入（液体中）；（篮球中）扣篮
items.def_en: 1. to dip something, especially bread or a biscuit, briefly into a liquid before eating it 2. (basketball) to slam the ball directly down through the hoop
items.ex_en: The sleepy traveler dunked chocolate biscuits into his hot mug of coffee.
items.ex_zh: 昏昏欲睡的旅客把巧克力饼干泡进冒着热气的大杯咖啡里。

items.def_en: To plunge an object completely into a liquid bath
items.ex_en: The technician fully immersed the metal component into the chemical bath.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员将该金属部件完全浸入化学药液池中。

items.def_en: To plunge suddenly into liquid, or to douse heavily with water
items.ex_en: The furious cook soused the smoking pan under a blast of water.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的厨师把冒烟的平底锅猛然浸入冲刷的凉水下浇灭。

items.def_en: To push or thrust something vigorously and suddenly into a liquid
items.ex_en: The blacksmith plunged the red-hot iron horseshoe deep into the cold water.
items.ex_zh: 铁匠将烧得通红的铁马蹄铁猛然扎入冰冷的水中。
items.ex2_en: Global stock markets plunged dramatically after the unexpected announcement of high trade tariffs.
items.ex2_zh: 在出人意料的高额关税声明公布后，全球股市大幅暴跌。

items.def_en: To push or drop something entirely below the surface of water
items.ex_en: The scuba diver slowly submerged beneath the crystal clear turquoise Caribbean waves.
items.ex_zh: 水肺潜水员缓缓沉入加勒比海清澈透亮的碧绿波涛之下。
items.ex2_en: Careful scientists submerged the waterproof monitoring equipment deep into the icy Arctic lake.
items.ex2_zh: 细心的科学家将防水监测设备深深浸入冰冷的北极湖泊中。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers brief, deliberate, or physical actions of plunging an object momentarily into liquid—such as dipping food, submerging laundry, or plunging a person playfully.
groups.summary_zh: 指迅速、刻意地将物体短暂浸入或沉入液体中，如蘸食或短时间浸洗。
groups.desc_en: Entails putting an entity into a liquid to thoroughly permeate, cover, or wet it, differing from casual washing or sprinkling through physical submersion and liquid saturation.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及将物体完全或部分置入液体中使其湿透、浸透或包裹，与普通的清洗或喷淋相比侧重物理浸没与液体饱和度。
groups.nuance_en: dip: brief partial immersion (pen / chip / toe) · dunk: quick plunge often with intent to soak or coat (biscuit / doughnut / basketball) · immerse: deep, complete envelopment in liquid or medium (hands / sample / body) · souse: heavy drenching or steeping in brine/liquid (herring / clothes) · plunge: forceful, rapid thrust downward into liquid (dagger / head / thermometer) · submerge: total coverage beneath the liquid surface (island / submarine / wreckage)
groups.nuance_zh: dip: 短暂或浅浅地浸沾 (pen / chip / toe) · dunk: 快速按入水中或浸泡 (biscuit / doughnut / basketball) · immerse: 全面浸没或深度沉浸 (hands / sample / body) · souse: 强行浸透或腌渍 (herring / clothes) · plunge: 猛烈迅速地插进或扎入液体 (dagger / head / thermometer) · submerge: 完全淹没于水体表面之下 (island / submarine / wreckage)

groups.name: Soften & Make Pliant · 软化与赋柔 (Mollify, Tenderize, Condition)
groups.tip: 使质地变柔顺便于弯折塑形

items.def_en: To make muscles or joints flexible and ready for action through gentle exercise
items.ex_en: The veteran dancer carefully limbered up before stepping onto the brightly lit stage.
items.ex_zh: 这位经验丰富的舞者在踏上灯光明亮的舞台前认真活动开了筋骨。
items.ex2_en: Light calisthenics will limber up stiff muscles before you begin the intense workout.
items.ex2_zh: 在开始剧烈运动之前，轻度体操可以让僵硬的肌肉变得灵活。

items.def_zh: 保养；调理（皮革或毛发）以保柔润
items.def_en: To treat leather, hair, or skin with a liquid or cream to make it soft and healthy
items.ex_en: Specialists condition high-grade saddles regularly to keep the fine leather supple.
items.ex_zh: 专业人员定期养护高档马鞍，以使优质皮革保持柔韧。

items.def_en: To make or become softer, less hard, or less stiff
items.ex_en: The baker waited for the cold butter to soften at room temperature.
items.ex_zh: 烘焙师静候冷黄油在室温下逐渐软化变软。
items.ex2_en: Warm steam helps soften hardened leather boots before polishing them with rich wax.
items.ex2_zh: 在用润泽鞋油擦拭硬化皮靴之前，热蒸汽有助于将其软化。

items.def_en: To make something soft, pliant, and flexible.
items.ex_en: The artisan used fragrant almond oils to supple the stiff calfskin bindings.
items.ex_zh: 工匠用芳香的杏仁油来润柔僵硬的小牛皮装订封面。
items.ex2_en: The stiff leather baseball glove suppled gradually after several weeks of continuous use.
items.ex2_zh: 僵硬的真皮棒球手套在连续使用数周后逐渐变得柔软灵活。

items.def_en: To make meat tender and easy to chew by beating it or applying a substance
items.ex_en: The seasoned chef tenderized the tough flank steak using a heavy mallet.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的大厨用一把重槌敲松了坚韧的牛腹肉。

items.def_en: To press, squeeze, and work dough or clay with the hands to make it smooth and pliable
items.ex_en: She patiently kneaded the smooth bread dough on the floured wooden table.
items.ex_zh: 她在撒了面粉的木桌上耐心地揉捏光滑的面团。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on rendering physical materials or bodies softer, more pliable, and less rigid, often through treatment, mechanical kneading, or conditioning.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过揉捏、加工或涂敷使质地变软、富有韧性及顺应性。
groups.desc_en: Denotes reducing rigidity, tension, or toughness to make something pliable, workable, or supple, contrasting with merely melting or weakening an object's structural integrity.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过机械、物理或化学手段削减硬度、韧性与张力以恢复或赋予柔韧性，不同于单纯的融化或削弱结构完整性。
groups.nuance_en: soften: broad loss of hardness or harshness (leather / tone / blow) · supple: render bendable and elastic via treatment (skin / joints / leather) · tenderize: break down tough fibers for edible or ductile ease (meat / cutlet) · knead: manipulate physically to achieve smooth elasticity (dough / clay / muscles) · condition: moisturize and nourish to maintain pliancy (hair / leather / soil) · limber up: warm up and stretch to loosen physical tightness (muscles / athlete / joints)
groups.nuance_zh: soften: 软化硬度、缓和语调或冲击 (leather / tone / blow) · supple: 赋柔处理使柔韧有弹性 (skin / joints / leather) · tenderize: 嫩化纤维以便于食用 (meat / cutlet) · knead: 揉捏以赋予均匀弹性 (dough / clay / muscles) · condition: 滋润调理以保持柔润 (hair / leather / soil) · limber up: 活动伸展以消除身体僵直 (muscles / athlete / joints)

groups.name: Solve & Crack · 攻关与破题 (Work out, Figure out, Crack, Unravel)
groups.tip: 从解答问题到彻底化解

items.def_en: To think about something until you finally understand it or find the right answer
items.ex_en: Scientists are trying to figure out why the virus mutated so rapidly.
items.ex_zh: 科学家们正试图弄明白这种病毒为何变异得如此之快。

items.def_en: To discover the answer to a complicated problem by thinking very hard about it over time
items.ex_en: The cryptographer worked relentlessly to puzzle out the cryptic encoded distress signal.
items.ex_zh: 密码学家不懈努力，终于破译了那条隐晦的加密求救信号。

items.def_zh: 计算出；推导出解决办法
items.def_en: To find the answer to a mathematical problem, calculation, or logical puzzle by reasoning
items.ex_en: The gifted student worked out the complicated algebraic equation in under three minutes.
items.ex_zh: 那个有天赋的学生在不到三分钟内就解出了复杂的代数方程。

items.def_zh: 解决（问题）；解答，破解（谜题、案件等）
items.def_en: To find an acceptable answer to, explanation for, or way of dealing with a problem, mystery, or puzzle.
items.ex_en: The brilliant team of forensic detectives finally solved the baffling murder case.
items.ex_zh: 出色的法医侦探团队终于破解了那桩令人费解的谋杀案。

items.def_en: To understand a complicated reason or deep mystery after thorough examination
items.ex_en: Scholars still struggle to fathom the mysterious author's true philosophical intentions.
items.ex_zh: 学者们仍难以彻底参透那位神秘作家真正的哲学意图。

items.def_en: To succeed in finding the solution to a difficult problem, code, or mystery, often after tough effort
items.ex_en: After hours of frustrating trial and error, the programmer finally cracked the stubborn cipher.
items.ex_zh: 经过数小时令人沮丧的反复摸索，程序员终于破解了那个棘手的密码。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on the intellectual exertion and breakthrough involved in conquering a puzzle, mathematical challenge, or mystery. The continuum spans methodical computation ('work out') to sudden cognitive triumph ('crack').
groups.summary_zh: 通过脑力探索、逻辑推导或顿悟攻克难题、谜局或算法。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on the cognitive exertion required to dismantle an intellectual barrier or solve a mystery, contrasting with passive learning or administrative handling.
groups.desc_zh: 强调突破智力阻碍、化解深层谜题所需的攻关与思维推演，区别于被动的知识获取或常规的事务处理。
groups.nuance_en: solve: find the formal, correct answer (problem / riddle / equation) · figure out: use practical reasoning to comprehend or calculate (costs / motive / route) · work out: compute or develop systematically step-by-step (details / solution / budget) · crack: abruptly break through a tough secret or resistance (code / case / safe) · puzzle out: solve slowly through persistent trial and error (meaning / clues / anagram) · fathom: penetrate and comprehend deep, obscure depths (mystery / mind / motive)
groups.nuance_zh: solve: 得出既定正确解 (problem / riddle / equation) · figure out: 经由实用推理琢磨弄懂 (costs / motive / route) · work out: 循序渐进地算出或推演方案 (details / solution / budget) · crack: 攻坚破译硬核密码或悬案 (code / case / safe) · puzzle out: 苦思冥想并逐个排查破解 (meaning / clues / anagram) · fathom: 参透隐晦深奥的内情或动机 (mystery / mind / motive)

groups.name: Solve & Troubleshoot · 调试与排障 (Debug, Diagnose, Trace, Fix)
groups.tip: 排查系统故障并逐一解决疑难

items.def_en: To eliminate bugs, glitches, or technical flaws through testing and adjustments
items.ex_en: The development team worked overnight to iron out several minor glitches before the launch.
items.ex_zh: 开发团队连夜奋战，在发布前消除了几处细小的技术瑕疵。

items.def_en: (+ to) To follow the history, steps, or source of a glitch back to its point of origin
items.ex_en: Engineers managed to trace the sudden system crash to a corrupted memory cache.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们设法将系统的突然崩溃追溯到受损的内存缓存。

items.def_en: To determine the exact nature or cause of a mechanical problem, software defect, or operational issue
items.ex_en: A certified technician was summoned to diagnose the persistent hydraulic failure in the factory.
items.ex_zh: 一名持证技术员被召来查明工厂持续液压故障的确切原因。

items.def_en: To discover, explain, or locate the exact place or cause of an error or problem
items.ex_en: Diagnostic software helped the technician pinpoint the precise origin of the electrical fault.
items.ex_zh: 诊断软件帮助技术人员精准定位了电气故障的确切源头。

items.def_en: To look for and remove errors, faults, or bugs from a computer software program or hardware system
items.ex_en: The software engineers spent all weekend debugging the core algorithm before final deployment.
items.ex_zh: 软件工程师们整个周末都在调试核心算法，以备最终部署。

items.def_zh: 排查并解决故障，排除疑难
items.def_en: To locate and solve technical faults or problems in machinery, computer systems, or organizations.
items.ex_en: Our support technicians are trained to troubleshoot complex hardware malfunctions over the phone.
items.ex_zh: 我们的技术支持人员受过专门训练，可通过电话排查并解决复杂的硬件故障。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the methodical diagnostic process of isolating defects, bugs, or operational failures in machines, software, or workflow systems, then systematically correcting them.
groups.summary_zh: 对机械、程序或系统进行故障定位、查因与调试修复。
groups.desc_en: Involves methodical forensic inspection, technical diagnosis, and remediation of defects in systems, differing from basic problem-solving by emphasizing systemic malfunction isolation.
groups.desc_zh: 指针对复杂系统进行系统性排查、诊断并消除故障与瑕疵，区别于一般破题，强调定位失灵根源与技术调优。
groups.nuance_en: troubleshoot: systematic search to isolate and resolve operational faults (network / hardware / issue) · debug: find and remove specific technical glitches (code / program / system) · diagnose: identify the underlying cause of dysfunction (fault / failure / disease) · pinpoint: locate the exact source of error with precision (leak / trouble / cause) · trace: follow the causal path backward to locate the defect (signal / fault / leakage) · iron out: smooth away small remaining difficulties or friction (kinks / wrinkles / differences)
groups.nuance_zh: troubleshoot: 系统性巡检与排除故障 (network / hardware / issue) · debug: 查错并消除代码或系统毛病 (code / program / system) · diagnose: 诊断失常的核心根因 (fault / failure / disease) · pinpoint: 极其精准地标定故障点 (leak / trouble / cause) · trace: 溯源追踪故障或信号链 (signal / fault / leakage) · iron out: 消除细枝末节的摩擦与阻碍 (kinks / wrinkles / differences)

groups.name: Sound Brass & Horn Calls · 吹奏与号角鸣响 (Trumpet, Toot, Blare)
groups.tip: 通过吹奏号角等发出警报

items.def_en: To cause a horn, trumpet, or alarm to produce a signal or call
items.ex_en: The sentry sounded the brass horn the moment enemy riders appeared on the horizon.
items.ex_zh: 敌军骑兵一出现在地平线上，哨兵就立刻吹响了铜号。
items.ex2_en: A loud emergency siren sounded across the sleepy town during the early morning.
items.ex2_zh: 清晨时分，响亮的紧急警报声在沉睡的小镇上空回荡。

items.def_en: To play a tune on a pipe or flute, or produce a high-pitched whistling note
items.ex_en: The shepherd piped a cheerful tune on his wooden flute as dusk fell.
items.ex_zh: 黄昏降临时，牧羊人用木笛吹奏出一曲欢快的调子。

items.def_zh: 高声吹奏；发出大象般的吼声
items.def_en: To play loudly on a trumpet or brass instrument, or make a loud, ringing sound like that of an elephant
items.ex_en: The lead bull elephant suddenly trumpeted with startling force, scattering the frightened tourists.
items.ex_zh: 领头的公象突然发出一声震耳欲聋的号叫，吓散了游客。

items.def_en: To make a short, sharp whistling or honking sound, especially on a horn, whistle, or pipe
items.ex_en: The impatient driver began to toot his horn as soon as the light changed.
items.ex_zh: 交通灯刚一变，那位心急的司机便嘟嘟地按起了喇叭。
items.ex2_en: A miniature steam locomotive tooted cheerily as it rounded the botanical garden bend.
items.ex2_zh: 微型蒸汽机车绕过植物园弯道时发出欢快短促的鸣笛声。

items.def_en: To make a loud, harsh, piercing sound, typical of brass horns, sirens, or trumpets
items.ex_en: Sirens began to blare continuously across the harbor during the sudden air-raid drill.
items.ex_zh: 在突如其来的防空演习中，警报声响彻整个海港，刺耳刺痛。
items.ex2_en: The excited radio host blared loud upbeat dance music through the studio loudspeakers.
items.ex2_zh: 兴奋的电台主持人通过演播室扬声器高声播放欢快动感的舞曲。

items.def_zh: 吹军号，吹号；（麋鹿等）发出高亢号声
items.def_en: 1. To play a bugle or sound a signal with a bugle. 2. (of an elk or other animal) To make a loud, ringing trumpeting call.
items.ex_en: Deep in the misty valley, a solitary bull elk bugled across the frosty air.
items.ex_zh: 在薄雾笼罩的山谷深处，一头落单的公麋鹿在清冷的空气中高亢鸣叫。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to playing wind or brass instruments to produce clear, loud musical signals or animal calls that carry over long distances. They range from formal fanfare blasts to short, sharp piping notes.
groups.summary_zh: 指吹响号角或铜管乐器发出嘹亮信号，或模拟动物高亢鸣叫。
groups.desc_en: Covers producing loud, piercing, or resonant musical signals on brass or wind instruments, contrasting with quiet melodic singing or background hums through ceremonial volume and alerting force.
groups.desc_zh: 指利用铜管或吹奏乐器发出响亮、刺耳或庄严的号令声响，与轻柔的歌唱或低嗡相比具有极高穿透力与警示礼仪感。
groups.nuance_en: sound: emit or order an authoritative acoustic signal (alarm / retreat / horn) · trumpet: blast loudly like a trumpet or proclaim noisily (victory / arrival / elephant) · blare: emit a harsh, deafening, unmodulated blast (siren / stereo / trumpets) · toot: sound a short, sharp, light horn blast (horn / whistle / flute) · bugle: signal militaristic calls via bugle (reveille / charge / call) · pipe: emit high-pitched shrill whistle or ceremonial tune (passengers / tunes / whistle)
groups.nuance_zh: sound: 吹响或鸣响号令信号 (alarm / retreat / horn) · trumpet: 如小号般高亢吹奏或大肆宣扬 (victory / arrival / elephant) · blare: 刺耳、震耳欲聋地鸣响 (siren / stereo / trumpets) · toot: 短促轻快地按响鸣笛 (horn / whistle / flute) · bugle: 吹军号传达军事口令 (reveille / charge / call) · pipe: 尖锐发声或吹笛迎送 (passengers / tunes / whistle)

groups.name: Spatial Retreat & Receding · 空间后撤与退缩 (Withdraw, Retreat, Ebb)
groups.tip: 自前方向后撤离或渐远

items.def_en: Withdraw from enemy forces or dangerous ground to a place of safety
items.ex_en: The outmatched infantry had no choice but to retreat to the fortified compound.
items.ex_zh: 寡不敌众的步兵别无选择，只得撤退到设防的营地。

items.def_en: Move backward, especially as a strategic military maneuver to safer defensive lines
items.ex_en: The troops were ordered to fall back to fortified positions.
items.ex_zh: 部队接到命令，撤退到坚固的防御阵地。

items.def_en: Move backwards slowly away from someone or something dangerous or frightening
items.ex_en: The hiker began to back away slowly when she saw the mother bear.
items.ex_zh: 看到母熊后，徒步旅行者开始缓缓向后倒退避开。

items.def_en: Move back or away from a place, military situation, or confrontation
items.ex_en: The military command formally decided to withdraw all ground forces from the contested valley.
items.ex_zh: 军方指挥部正式决定从那片争议山谷中撤出所有地面部队。
items.ex2_en: The exhausted infantry troops withdrew to defensible hilltop positions before the cold night.
items.ex2_zh: 疲惫的步兵部队在寒夜降临前撤回至易守难攻的山顶阵地。

items.def_zh: 后退，退去；逐渐减弱，变得渺茫；（头发等）后移
items.def_en: To move back or away from a previous position; to become smaller, weaker, or less distinct.
items.ex_en: As the boat moved forward, the familiar coastline began to recede into thick fog.
items.ex_zh: 随着船只前行，熟悉的海岸线开始渐渐退入浓雾之中。

items.def_en: (of water or qualities) Flow back out away from land; gradually decline or diminish
items.ex_en: As twilight deepened over the silent harbor, the tide slowly began to ebb.
items.ex_zh: 当暮色笼罩寂静的港口，潮水开始缓缓退去。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures physical backward motion in space, describing bodies, tides, or front lines pulling away, diminishing in prominence, or stepping back.
groups.summary_zh: 指物理空间上的向后移动、潮水消退、阵线撤出或景物渐行渐远。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the physical retreat, backward movement, or gradual draining away of an entity from an advanced position, contrasting with forward advance or stationary hiding.
groups.desc_zh: 指实体从原有推进位置向后撤退、退却或逐渐消退流走，与向前挺进或原地隐蔽形成空间反差。
groups.nuance_en: retreat: pull back under pressure, danger, or order (army / troops / glaciers) · withdraw: orderly, voluntary, or strategic removal of forces/presence (forces / troops / presence) · fall back: tactical retreat to a secondary defensive position (line / position / perimeter) · back away: move backward hesitantly due to fear or caution (stranger / edge / dog) · recede: gradually diminish or move farther away into the distance (floodwaters / shoreline / hairline) · ebb: flow outward or back away like tidal water (tide / life / support)
groups.nuance_zh: retreat: 在压力、危险或受挫下被迫后退 (army / troops / glaciers) · withdraw: 有条不紊地战略撤出或抽离 (forces / troops / presence) · fall back: 战术性后退至后方防线 (line / position / perimeter) · back away: 出于戒备或恐惧谨慎后退 (stranger / edge / dog) · recede: 渐行渐远、视线或水平面后退 (floodwaters / shoreline / hairline) · ebb: 潮水般退去或衰落 (tide / life / support)

groups.name: Specify & Itemize · 详细说明与指明 (Enumerate, Itemize, Detail)
groups.tip: 逐一具体列出各项细则要求

items.def_en: To explain the details of something in a very clear, deliberate, and unambiguous way
items.ex_en: You don't need to spell out every detail; we get the general idea.
items.ex_zh: 你不需要把每个细节都阐释得那么细，我们明白大意。

items.def_en: To describe, list, or explain something fully and point by point
items.ex_en: The official report details every safety infraction observed during the annual factory audit.
items.ex_zh: 该官方报告逐条详细列举了年度工厂审计中发现的每一项安全违规。

items.def_en: To set down or list individual items or particulars one by one
items.ex_en: The billing department will itemize all consulting charges on your monthly corporate invoice.
items.ex_zh: 财务部门会在您的每月企业账单上分项列出所有咨询费用。

items.raw_cluster: 详细说明与指明 Detail & Specify
items.def_zh: 明确说明，具体指定，详细列明
items.def_en: To state clearly, explicitly, and in detail as a condition, requirement, or fact.
items.ex_en: The architectural contract should clearly specify the required fire-retardant qualities of the materials.
items.ex_zh: 建筑合同应当明确规定材料所需的阻燃特性。

items.def_en: To state clearly and firmly that something must be done or accepted as part of an agreement
items.ex_en: The revised terms expressly stipulate that all outstanding debts must be settled immediately.
items.ex_zh: 修改后的条款明确规定，所有未清偿债务必须立即结清。

items.def_en: To name things separately one after another, especially in a formal or exhaustive manner
items.ex_en: The prosecutor proceeded to enumerate each violation of the statute before the jury.
items.ex_zh: 检察官开始向陪审团一一列举违反该法令的各项具体行为。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on identifying or describing components, requirements, or terms with rigorous clarity and precision. Verbs contrast in whether they highlight listing distinct elements one by one, breaking down particulars, or fixing unambiguous conditions.
groups.summary_zh: 强调以清晰、具体的方式列出、详述或明确规定各项细节与要求。
groups.desc_en: Entails formulating conditions, items, or requirements in exhaustive, explicit detail, contrasting with vague generalization or open-ended summaries.
groups.desc_zh: 指逐项列举或穷尽式明确规定细节、条件与清单，区别于笼统的概括或模糊的宏观定性。
groups.nuance_en: specify: state explicitly and unambiguously (details / requirements / reasons) · itemize: break down into an organized list of individual components (costs / expenses / deductions) · enumerate: mention a series of things one by one (grievances / sins / points) · detail: describe fully with comprehensive specifics (plan / account / specifications) · stipulate: lay down an essential condition as an absolute demand (terms / condition / requirement) · spell out: explain in the simplest, most painstaking detail (instructions / implications / rules)
groups.nuance_zh: specify: 明确指定并给出具体参数 (details / requirements / reasons) · itemize: 逐项列清费用或清单明细 (costs / expenses / deductions) · enumerate: 一一列举数点理由或事实 (grievances / sins / points) · detail: 详尽描述每一处细节 (plan / account / specifications) · stipulate: 在契约中明确立项约定 (terms / condition / requirement) · spell out: 不厌其烦地解释得一清二楚 (instructions / implications / rules)

groups.name: Splash & Spray · 飞溅与喷洒 (Splash, Spray, Spatter)
groups.tip: 液体受力喷射或四处飞溅

items.def_en: To scatter tiny drops of liquid or light particles gently over a surface
items.ex_en: The baker used a fine sieve to sprinkle powdered sugar over the pastries.
items.ex_zh: 面包师用细筛将糖粉细细洒在糕点上。

items.def_en: To scatter liquid in fine, dispersed droplets onto or across a surface
items.ex_en: The gardener used a brass nozzle to spray cool water across the rosebushes.
items.ex_zh: 园丁用黄铜喷头向玫瑰花丛喷洒凉水。
items.ex2_en: Foamy ocean water sprayed across the wooden deck as giant waves struck forcefully.
items.ex2_zh: 巨浪猛烈拍击时，泡沫飞溅的海水洒满了整个木制甲板。

items.def_zh: 飞溅，溅起；泼洒，溅湿；在水中扑腾
items.def_en: 1. (of a liquid) To scatter and fall in drops; to cause liquid to scatter onto someone or something. 2. To move noisily through water making it fly about.
items.ex_en: The children laughed and splashed cold creek water at each other under the sun.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们在阳光下欢笑着，互相泼洒冰凉的溪水。
items.ex2_en: Clear mountain water splashed over the smooth stones beneath the roaring forest waterfall.
items.ex2_zh: 清澈的山泉水飞溅在轰鸣的森林瀑布下光滑的石头上。

items.def_en: To scatter or fall in discrete drops or small, messy spots across a surface
items.ex_en: Hot cooking oil began to spatter across the pristine countertop during the frying.
items.ex_zh: 煎炸过程中，滚烫的热油滴滴答答溅落到了干净的台面上。
items.ex2_en: The messy toddler spattered bright red tomato sauce all over the clean kitchen.
items.ex2_zh: 邋遢的幼儿把鲜红的番茄酱溅得整洁的厨房到处都是。

items.def_en: To splash or move about liquid clumsily inside or over the rim of a container
items.ex_en: Water began to slosh over the brim of the bucket as he ran.
items.ex_zh: 当他奔跑时，水开始从水桶边缘晃荡溅出。
items.ex2_en: The tired worker sloshed muddy water onto the concrete floor while cleaning up.
items.ex2_zh: 疲倦的工人在打扫卫生时把泥水泼洒在混凝土地面上。

items.def_en: To splash or scatter a thick liquid noisily and unevenly upon impact
items.ex_en: The dropped paint can burst open and splattered bright yellow pigment everywhere.
items.ex_zh: 掉落的油漆罐摔裂开来，明黄色的颜料顿时四处乱溅。
items.ex2_en: Slippery wet mud splattered onto the pristine white walls during the heavy rainfall.
items.ex2_zh: 暴雨期间，湿滑的烂泥飞溅到了洁白的墙壁上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe liquids scattering, diffusing into droplets, or breaking against solid surfaces upon impact or through deliberate dispersal. They contrast fine airborne misting with heavy, messy sloshes.
groups.summary_zh: 指水滴或液体撞击散开、四处飞溅或均匀洒出。
groups.desc_en: Describes dispersing liquid droplets across a surface through impact, scattering, or forced expulsion, differing from continuous pouring by producing scattered droplets or messy dispersion.
groups.desc_zh: 指液体受冲击、喷射或甩动而向外抛洒、四溅并形成散落水滴，不同于平稳倾倒，强调分散与飞溅态势。
groups.nuance_en: spray: force liquid out in a fine mist or pressurized jet (perfume / pesticide / bullets) · splash: scatter liquid noisily by impact or movement (water / mud / face) · spatter: scatter drops over a surface irregularly (blood / grease / rain) · splatter: violently splash thicker, messy drops across an area (paint / mud / sauce) · sprinkle: scatter small drops or particles gently and evenly (water / sugar / lawn) · slosh: splash liquid clumsily within or out of a container (water / fuel / drink)
groups.nuance_zh: spray: 压力加压喷射出细雾或水流 (perfume / pesticide / bullets) · splash: 撞击液体引发大片水花飞溅 (water / mud / face) · spatter: 斑驳地点状溅落 (blood / grease / rain) · splatter: 浓稠液体大面积狼藉飞溅 (paint / mud / sauce) · sprinkle: 稀疏、轻柔且均匀地点洒 (water / sugar / lawn) · slosh: 在容器内晃荡溢出 (water / fuel / drink)

groups.name: Spoil & Pamper · 溺爱与纵容 (Spoil, Pamper, Indulge)
groups.tip: 无底线纵容悉心娇惯伺候

items.def_en: To comply with someone's wishes or temper in order to keep them contented
items.ex_en: We decided to humor the elderly uncle by listening patiently to his stories.
items.ex_zh: 我们决定迁就那位老叔叔，耐心地听他讲那些陈年旧事。

items.def_en: To satisfy someone's specific, often selfish or low tastes, needs, or whims
items.ex_en: The commercial station tends to cater to the lowest tastes of television viewers.
items.ex_zh: 这家商业电视台往往迎合电视观众最俗劣的品味。

items.def_en: To yield freely to someone's wishes, appetites, or whims without discipline
items.ex_en: The doting grandfather continued to indulge every single whim of his favorite grandchild.
items.ex_zh: 那位宠溺的祖父继续放任自己最喜爱的孙子提出的每一个任性念头。

items.def_en: To gratify or indulge immoral, unreasonable, or distasteful demands
items.ex_en: The tabloid was widely criticized for pandering to the public's basest morbid curiosity.
items.ex_zh: 该小报因迎合公众最底层的猎奇恶趣味而受到广泛批评。

items.def_en: To harm someone's character by granting them everything they want
items.ex_en: Giving a toddler unlimited candy will only spoil their appetite and behavior.
items.ex_zh: 给幼童无限量的糖果只会宠坏他们的脾气并影响食欲。
items.ex2_en: Fresh milk will spoil rapidly if left on the warm kitchen counter overnight.
items.ex2_zh: 如果新鲜牛奶在温暖的厨房台面上放一整夜，很快就会变质。

items.def_zh: 娇生惯养，精心照料；溺爱，纵容
items.def_en: To treat someone with extreme comfort, care, and luxury, often spoiling them.
items.ex_en: The luxury spa is designed to pamper stressed guests with soothing treatments.
items.ex_zh: 这家豪华水疗馆旨在用舒缓的理疗精心照料倍感压力的客人。

groups.summary_en: Covers indulging someone's whims, showering them with luxuries, or giving in to demands to their moral or behavioral detriment.
groups.summary_zh: 通过物质奢侈或无底线百依百顺来娇惯放纵他人，致其任性妄为。
groups.desc_en: Expresses excessive indulgence, gratification of desires, and sheltering from discipline, contrasting with strict, boundary-enforcing parenting or tough love.
groups.desc_zh: 指过度放任、迎合欲望与无原则顺从，区别于设限严厉的规训教育，强调娇惯与惯纵。
groups.nuance_en: spoil: ruin character or behavior through excessive indulgence (child / grandchild / pet) · pamper: treat with extreme comfort, luxury, and solicitous care (guest / wife / body) · indulge: yield permissively to a desire, whim, or appetite (whim / passion / child) · pander to: cater base, vulgar, or unprincipled desires for personal gain (tastes / mob / prejudices) · cater to: supply exactly what a particular group requires or craves (needs / tastes / tourists) · humor: placate someone by going along with their erratic wishes (mood / eccentricities / delusions)
groups.nuance_zh: spoil: 溺爱放任以致宠坏性格 (child / grandchild / pet) · pamper: 悉心呵护养尊处优 (guest / wife / body) · indulge: 纵容欲望或任性迁就 (whim / passion / child) · pander to: 迎合低俗、不光彩的诉求以谋利 (tastes / mob / prejudices) · cater to: 投其所好满足特定需求 (needs / tastes / tourists) · humor: 迁就附和某人的任性情绪 (mood / eccentricities / delusions)

groups.name: Sponsor & Fund · 赞助与资助 (Sponsor, Underwrite, Bankroll)
groups.tip: 为特定活动提供资金支持

items.def_en: To provide money for an event, project, or organization from public or institutional reserves
items.ex_en: The national scientific council agreed to fund the university's renewable energy research.
items.ex_zh: 国家科学委员会同意为该大学的可再生能源研究项目提供资金。

items.def_en: To support a person, organization, or activity by providing money or other resources, often in exchange for commercial publicity
items.ex_en: A local sportswear manufacturer offered to sponsor the municipal youth marathon this year.
items.ex_zh: 一家当地运动服制造商主动提出赞助今年的市青年马拉松赛。

items.def_en: To pay part of the cost of something to keep selling prices down or keep an activity viable
items.ex_en: The municipal government decided to subsidize public transit tickets to encourage green commuting.
items.ex_zh: 市政府决定对公共交通车票给予补贴，以鼓励绿色出行。

items.def_zh: 承保；包办筹资，承诺兜底
items.def_en: To accept financial responsibility for an endeavor, guaranteeing to cover any losses or shortfalls
items.ex_en: Wealthy patrons of the arts promised to underwrite the costly new opera production.
items.ex_zh: 富有的艺术赞助人们承诺为这部耗资巨大的新歌剧制作兜底。

items.def_en: To support a person, project, or business venture financially, often supplying all the necessary funds
items.ex_en: A reclusive tech billionaire agreed to bankroll the entire deep-sea exploration mission.
items.ex_zh: 一位隐世的科技巨头同意为整个深海勘探任务提供全额资金支持。

items.def_zh: 共同赞助；共同发起，联名提出
items.def_en: 1. To fund, organize, or support an event, project, or legislative bill jointly with another sponsor.
items.ex_en: The senior senator agreed to cosponsor the bipartisan environmental protection bill next week.
items.ex_zh: 资深参议员同意在下周共同发起这项两党环保法案。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe providing financial backing, material resources, or formal organizational endorsement for an event, project, person, or bill. They vary from formal commercial patronage to colloquial, high-risk financial backing.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及为项目、活动或法案提供资金支持与官方赞助，涵盖正式出资与全额包揽。
groups.desc_en: Relates to providing financial backing, formal endorsement, or liability guarantees for an undertaking, contrasting with non-fiscal moral support or direct personal execution.
groups.desc_zh: 指为项目、活动或实体提供资金后盾、担保或冠名支持，区别于单纯的精神声援或自行承办。
groups.nuance_en: fund: provide capital or regular financing directly (project / research / program) · sponsor: finance an event or person in return for commercial publicity (athlete / event / exhibition) · subsidize: support financially with public or partial grants to keep costs low (industry / housing / farming) · underwrite: assume financial risk or guarantee funding for an enterprise (loan / bond / policy) · bankroll: heavily and often quietly finance an expensive venture (campaign / film / rebellion) · cosponsor: share the financial backing or formal legislative introduction with others (bill / conference / study)
groups.nuance_zh: fund: 直接拨款注资 (project / research / program) · sponsor: 赞助商业活动以换取冠名宣传 (athlete / event / exhibition) · subsidize: 给予财政或差额补贴 (industry / housing / farming) · underwrite: 承销、担保并承担潜在亏损风险 (loan / bond / policy) · bankroll: 提供大额腰包支撑整个局势 (campaign / film / rebellion) · cosponsor: 共同出资赞助或联署提案 (bill / conference / study)

groups.name: Sport & Play · 专项球类与休闲竞技 (Golf, Bowl, Skate)
groups.tip: 从事体育运动或休闲玩耍

items.def_en: to fight someone in the sport of boxing using gloved fists
items.ex_en: The Olympic champion prepared diligently to box the formidable challenger next Saturday evening.
items.ex_zh: 这位奥运冠军认真备战，准备在下周六晚与那位强劲的挑战者打拳击赛。

items.def_en: to play the game of bowling or lawn bowls
items.ex_en: Every Friday evening, the retired factory workers meet at the club to bowl.
items.ex_zh: 每个周五晚上，退了休的工厂工人们都会在俱乐部聚会打保龄球。

items.def_en: To play the game of golf.
items.ex_en: My grandfather prefers to golf eighteen holes early every Sunday morning without fail.
items.ex_zh: 我祖父更喜欢在每周日清晨雷打不动地打完十八洞高尔夫。

items.def_en: to travel in a boat powered by wind as a recreational activity or sport
items.ex_en: The adventurous couple bought a sturdy sloop and decided to sail across the Atlantic.
items.ex_zh: 这对敢于冒险的夫妇买了一艘结实的单桅帆船，决定驾船横渡大西洋。

items.def_en: to glide on ice skates or roller skates as a sport or pastime
items.ex_en: Dozens of eager children skate across the frozen pond throughout the chilly winter.
items.ex_zh: 整个寒冬里，许多兴高采烈的孩子们都在结冰的池塘上滑冰。

items.def_en: to ride ocean waves standing or lying on a special board
items.ex_en: Professional athletes travel to the southern coast each winter to surf towering waves.
items.ex_zh: 专业运动员每年冬天都会前往南部海岸，在滔天巨浪上冲浪。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe participating in specific organized sports, recreational games, or athletic outdoor pastimes.
groups.summary_zh: 指参与特定规则的专项球类运动或休闲体育竞技项目。
groups.desc_en: Designates actively participating in a specific recreational sport or athletic discipline governed by rules and specialized gear, contrasting with generic exercising or unregulated play.
groups.desc_zh: 指从事特定规则约束、需专属器材与场地的专项球类、水上或竞技运动，区别于泛泛的锻炼或无规则嬉闹。
groups.nuance_en: golf: play the sport of golf on a course (course / club / links) · bowl: roll a ball to knock down pins in a bowling alley (lanes / strike / league) · skate: glide on ice, wheels, or boards (ice / rink / street) · surf: ride ocean waves on a board (wave / break / swell) · sail: navigate a wind-driven vessel for recreation or sport (yacht / boat / seas) · box: engage in the combat sport of boxing with gloved punches (opponent / ring / title)
groups.nuance_zh: golf: 打高尔夫球 (course / club / links) · bowl: 打保龄球 (lanes / strike / league) · skate: 滑冰或溜冰滑板 (ice / rink / street) · surf: 冲浪竞技 (wave / break / swell) · sail: 驾帆船航行竞技 (yacht / boat / seas) · box: 佩戴拳套进行拳击 (opponent / ring / title)

groups.name: Spread & Broadcast Rumors · 散播与传扬 (Bruit, Circulate, Bandy)
groups.tip: 消息或流言在人群中传开

items.def_zh: 随口传播（谣言、名字等）；议论纷纷
items.def_en: To mention or discuss a word, rumor, or name casually and repeatedly
items.ex_en: Her name was bandied about as a likely candidate for the open directorship.
items.ex_zh: 她的名字被人们随口议论着，看作是空缺总监职位的可能人选。

items.def_en: To pass or cause to pass from person to person or place to place
items.ex_en: Unverified rumors began to circulate among the nervous employees regarding impending layoffs.
items.ex_zh: 关于即将裁员的未经证实的谣言开始在惶恐的员工之间流传。
items.ex2_en: The secretary will circulate the finalized quarterly report to all executive board members.
items.ex2_zh: 秘书将把定稿的季度报告传阅给所有执行董事会成员。

items.def_en: To spread information, knowledge, or ideas widely so as to inform many people
items.ex_en: The research institute aims to disseminate vital public health guidelines to remote communities.
items.ex_zh: 该研究所旨在向偏远社区广泛传播重要的公共卫生指导方针。

items.def_en: (also 'bruit about') To spread a report, rumor, or piece of news widely.
items.ex_en: News of the royal scandal was quickly bruited abroad by sensationalist broadsheets.
items.ex_zh: 关于王室丑闻的消息很快被那些耸人听闻的报纸到处传布开了。

items.def_en: To spread a rumor, story, or statement that is often false
items.ex_en: Spiteful colleagues began to put about malicious lies regarding her sudden promotion.
items.ex_zh: 怀恨在心的同事们开始四处散布关于她突然晋升的恶毒谎言。

items.def_zh: 大肆宣扬；到处讲（隐私或消息）
items.def_en: To tell a piece of news or private detail openly to many people
items.ex_en: You really shouldn't broadcast your sister's personal financial problems to everyone at work.
items.ex_zh: 你真不该在单位到处宣扬你妹妹个人的财务困难。
items.ex2_en: The championship football match will broadcast live across multiple national television channels tonight.
items.ex2_zh: 今晚多条国家电视频道将现场直播这场冠军足球赛。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the deliberate or gossip-driven diffusion of news, rumors, or opinions across a community. They emphasize repetitive hearing, casual talk, or active gossiping.
groups.summary_zh: 描述四处散布、传播谣言、新闻或流言飞语，常带随意性或人际闲谈色彩。
groups.desc_en: Describes propagating unverified reports, secrets, or gossip across a social network, differing from truthful official publication by relying on word-of-mouth leakage and rumor mills.
groups.desc_zh: 指在社交网络或人群中散布未经核实的闲话、流言或隐秘传闻，不同于权威发布，依赖道听途说与耳语发酵。
groups.nuance_en: circulate: pass freely from person to person through a group (rumor / petition / story) · disseminate: spread information or doctrine widely to cultivate awareness (findings / propaganda / data) · broadcast: make widely and publicly known via open channels (news / secrets / views) · bandy about: toss names or rumors around casually or loosely in conversation (names / figures / rumor) · bruit: spread news or gossip noisily and rapidly abroad (rumor / name / report) · put about: deliberately initiate and spread an untruthful rumor (story / lie / rumor)
groups.nuance_zh: circulate: 流言在人际圈中流通传阅 (rumor / petition / story) · disseminate: 扩散传播学说、思想或科研结果 (findings / propaganda / data) · broadcast: 大肆公开宣扬张扬 (news / secrets / views) · bandy about: 口头肆意议论传颂名字或传言 (names / figures / rumor) · bruit: 沸沸扬扬地风传 (rumor / name / report) · put about: 蓄意放风捏造并散播谣言 (story / lie / rumor)

groups.name: Sprint & Bolt · 飞奔与突窜 (Bolt, Dash, Dart)
groups.tip: 极速狂奔夺路而逃

items.def_en: To run or travel somewhere in a great hurry
items.ex_en: Late for his crucial morning interview, Mark dashed madly toward the departing train.
items.ex_zh: 由于要赶不上早晨的关键面试，马克疯了似地冲向即将开动的列车。

items.def_en: To run quickly with quick, short, hurried steps
items.ex_en: Frightened by the loud thunderclap, the small mouse scurried under the kitchen cabinet.
items.ex_zh: 被那声惊雷吓了一跳，那只小老鼠急促小跑着溜到了橱柜底下。

items.def_en: To move somewhere with reckless speed and haste
items.ex_en: The reckless teenager tore down the narrow alleyway on his noisy motorbike.
items.ex_zh: 那个鲁莽的少年骑着嘈杂的摩托车在狭窄的小巷里飞驰狂奔。

items.def_en: To run at full top speed over a short distance
items.ex_en: The energetic athlete sprinted the final fifty meters to secure first place.
items.ex_zh: 这位活力充沛的运动员全速冲刺最后的五十米，锁定了第一名。

items.def_en: To move suddenly and rapidly in a specific direction
items.ex_en: A startled deer suddenly darted across the highway directly in front of us.
items.ex_zh: 一只受惊的鹿突然猛冲过公路，正好穿过我们车前。

items.def_zh: 飞奔，夺路而逃；拴住，锁上
items.def_en: 1. To suddenly run away very fast, especially out of fear or excitement. 2. To fasten a door or window with a bolt.
items.ex_en: The terrified stray dog bolted into the nearby alley when lightning struck nearby.
items.ex_zh: 雷电在附近劈响时，那只吓坏了的流浪狗夺路而逃窜进了附近巷子。

groups.summary_en: These verbs describe sudden, high-velocity running or flight, often triggered by surprise, panic, or sheer urgency.
groups.summary_zh: 强调因受惊、突发状况或急迫而突然爆发出极高速度飞奔逃窜。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to an abrupt, explosive release of maximum locomotive speed over a short distance, differing from steady jogging or standard walking through sheer suddenness and velocity.
groups.desc_zh: 指短距离内突发性、爆发式的极限狂奔或弹射逃窜，与平缓慢跑或步行相比强调突发性与极高初速。
groups.nuance_en: sprint: run at full top speed over a short distance (finish / line / 100m) · bolt: dart away suddenly and uncontrollably like an alarmed animal (horse / door / suspect) · dart: make a sudden, brief, nimble leap or dash (tongue / eyes / corner) · dash: rush quickly and suddenly on an urgent mission (station / shop / rain) · tear: rush wildly and headlong with reckless speed (down / road / street) · scurry: move hurriedly with short, rapid steps like a small creature (away / feet / mouse)
groups.nuance_zh: sprint: 短距离极限全速冲刺 (finish / line / 100m) · bolt: 受惊狂奔脱缰突窜 (horse / door / suspect) · dart: 灵动迅捷地窜动或投射 (tongue / eyes / corner) · dash: 紧急猛冲奔赴某地 (station / shop / rain) · tear: 鲁莽狂暴地疯跑飞驰 (down / road / street) · scurry: 小碎步急促仓皇地碎步逃窜 (away / feet / mouse)

groups.name: Spruce Up & Smarten · 修饰翻新与打扮装点 (Titivate, Freshen, Smarten up)
groups.tip: 打扮修饰使外表光鲜齐整

items.def_en: To make someone or something look cleaner, tidier, or more stylish
items.ex_en: You ought to smarten up before going into the executive meeting room today.
items.ex_zh: 在今天进高管会议室之前，你真该好好整理装扮一番。
items.ex2_en: A fresh coat of glossy paint will smarten up the outdated dining room.
items.ex2_zh: 刷上一层新的光泽油漆会让这间过时的餐厅变得光鲜整洁。

items.def_en: To wash oneself or apply quick cosmetic changes to a room to renew its neatness
items.ex_en: I need to visit the restroom to freshen up before the gala begins.
items.ex_zh: 在晚会开始前，我得去洗手间梳洗一下提提神。
items.ex2_en: A brief summer shower freshened up the sweltering city air by late afternoon.
items.ex2_zh: 午后一场短暂的夏雨让闷热的城市空气变得清新宜人。

items.def_en: To make minor decorative changes or grooming touches to improve appearance
items.ex_en: She stood before the vanity mirror to titivate her hair before dinner.
items.ex_zh: 她在梳妆镜前站定，在晚饭前精心整理修饰着自己的头发。

items.def_en: To dress up or decorate something in an elaborate or showy way
items.ex_en: They gussied up the dusty village hall with bright banners for the celebration.
items.ex_zh: 他们用鲜艳的横幅把积灰的村礼堂刻意装扮一新，以备庆祝。

items.def_en: To improve the appearance of something by making small alterations or corrections
items.ex_en: She spent a few minutes touching up her makeup before the live broadcast.
items.ex_zh: 在直播开始前，她花了几分钟补了补妆。

items.def_zh: 收拾，整理；打扮，使光鲜整洁
items.def_en: To make oneself, a room, or an object cleaner, neater, or more attractive.
items.ex_en: We spent all morning sprucing up the guest room before the relatives arrived.
items.ex_zh: 在亲戚们到来之前，我们花了一上午把客房收拾得整洁光鲜。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on giving a place, object, or person a quick cosmetic improvement to make them look neater, fresher, or more appealing. Unlike heavy renovation, verbs like 'spruce up' and 'freshen up' highlight lightweight grooming, minor repairs, or aesthetic touches.
groups.summary_zh: 指进行快速修饰、收拾或翻新，使人或环境焕然一新。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on tidying, grooming, or redecorating an appearance or setting to make it clean, fashionable, and neat, contrasting with major structural renovation or deep industrial cleaning.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过梳理、补妆、小幅修整或点缀装饰使仪容或居所变得整洁亮丽，区别于大拆大建的硬装修或粗暴保洁。
groups.nuance_en: spruce: smarten or neatening an appearance rapidly (up / house / himself) · smarten up: improve the elegance, neatness, or professionalism of something (wardrobe / image / room) · freshen up: wash, groom, or apply cosmetics to regain freshness (makeup / face / drink) · touch up: add minor corrective brushstrokes or repairs (paint / photo / roots) · titivate: make minor decorative grooming adjustments to dress or hair (hair / outfit / decor) · gussy up: dress up or decorate showily or flashily (oneself / place / car)
groups.nuance_zh: spruce: 快速收拾打理使显利落 (up / house / himself) · smarten up: 提升装扮或外观的整洁体面度 (wardrobe / image / room) · freshen up: 梳洗补妆以恢复清爽状态 (makeup / face / drink) · touch up: 补色微调修润瑕疵 (paint / photo / roots) · titivate: 细微描画梳理做装点 (hair / outfit / decor) · gussy up: 过度打扮或装扮得花枝招展 (oneself / place / car)

groups.name: Spy & Snoop · 刺探与窥视 (Snoop, Pry, Peep)
groups.tip: 鬼祟探头窥探他人隐私

items.def_en: To search around a place trying to uncover hidden information or secrets
items.ex_en: The nosy neighbor was caught trying to nose around our private garage yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 那个爱管闲事的邻居昨天试图在我们私人车库四处打探，被当场抓个正着。

items.def_en: (+ into/through) To look quickly and secretly at something, especially through a narrow opening
items.ex_en: The curious boy leaned forward to peep through a narrow hole in the fence.
items.ex_zh: 好奇的男孩探过身去，透过篱笆上的窄孔偷偷张望。

items.def_en: (+ on) To listen secretly to someone else's private conversation
items.ex_en: She deliberately lingered near the open door to eavesdrop on their private conversation.
items.ex_zh: 她故意在敞开的门旁徘徊，偷听他们的私密谈话。

items.def_zh: 刺探，窥察；暗中监视；窥见
items.def_en: 1. (+ on/into) To secretly collect information about someone or an enemy. 2. To catch sight of or suddenly see something.
items.ex_en: The rival agency hired an operative to spy on the ambassador's daily movements.
items.ex_zh: 敌对情报机构雇佣了一名特工暗中监视大使的日常行踪。

items.def_en: (+ around/into) To look around secretly in order to find out private information about someone
items.ex_en: Why are you snooping around my desk while I am away at lunch?
items.ex_zh: 我出去吃午饭的时候，你为什么在我的办公桌旁鬼鬼祟祟地打探？

items.def_en: (+ into) To try to find out personal details about other people's private lives in an intrusive way
items.ex_en: I politely told my nosy neighbor not to pry into my family matters.
items.ex_zh: 我礼貌地告诉爱管闲事的邻居不要打探我的家事。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe observing others covertly, intrusively, or surreptitiously to uncover private secrets or gather intelligence. They contrast between political or military espionage and nosy, interpersonal meddling.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重暗中监视他人、刺探隐私或搜集秘密情报的窥视行为。
groups.desc_en: Denotes stealthily prying, watching, or overhearing to gather private or confidential secrets, contrasting with transparent interrogation or legitimate open oversight.
groups.desc_zh: 指采取潜行、暗中窥视、偷听等隐蔽手段打探隐私或机密情报，区别于透明正当的公开审问与法定监管。
groups.nuance_en: steady: support to prevent shaking, falling, or wobbling (nerves / hands / ladder) · stabilize: prevent deterioration and hold firm under strain (patient / currency / situation) · level off: cease rising or falling and maintain a flat trajectory (inflation / growth / output) · even out: balance fluctuations to create uniformity (disparities / flow / temperatures) · settle down: become calm, orderly, or rooted after turbulence (dust / life / crowd) · equilibrate: bring into systemic physical or chemical balance (pressures / forces / system)
groups.nuance_zh: steady: 平衡并消除晃动使其平稳 (nerves / hands / ladder) · stabilize: 阻止急剧恶化使其回归稳定 (patient / currency / situation) · level off: 停止急剧上升或下降走向平稳 (inflation / growth / output) · even out: 抹平波动使趋于均衡 (disparities / flow / temperatures) · settle down: 归于平静安定 (dust / life / crowd) · equilibrate: 达成内部物理或系统动态平衡 (pressures / forces / system)

groups.name: Stabilize & Steady · 稳固与平衡 (Stabilize, Steady, Balance)
groups.tip: 保持稳定不再动摇变化

items.def_en: To stop something from shaking, moving, or fluctuating wildly, or to become calm and balanced
items.ex_en: He took several deep breaths to steady his racing heart before stepping onstage.
items.ex_zh: 登台前，他做了几次深呼吸，以平复狂跳的心绪。
items.ex2_en: Her shaky voice steadied noticeably once she began explaining the familiar scientific theory.
items.ex2_zh: 一旦开始解释熟悉的科学理论，她颤抖的声音明显平稳下来。

items.def_en: To become calm, stable, and regular after a period of excitement, change, or turbulence
items.ex_en: Life in the coastal village began to settle down after the devastating storm.
items.ex_zh: 毁灭性的风暴过后，沿海村庄的生活开始恢复平静。
items.ex2_en: A soft bedtime lullaby helped settle down the restless child in her crib.
items.ex2_zh: 轻柔的睡前摇篮曲让婴儿床里躁动不安的孩子安静了下来。

items.def_en: To become balanced, steady, and uniform, or to eliminate uneven fluctuations
items.ex_en: Monthly household expenses should even out once we finish renovating the old kitchen.
items.ex_zh: 一旦翻修完老厨房，每月的家庭开销应该就会趋于平稳均衡。
items.ex2_en: Careful statistical adjustments even out the temporary distortions across our yearly market predictions.
items.ex2_zh: 精细的统计调整消除了我们年度市场预测中的暂时性偏差。

items.def_en: To stop rising or falling and remain at a constant, stable rate or level
items.ex_en: Economists predict that soaring consumer inflation will level off during the third quarter.
items.ex_zh: 经济学家预测，飞涨的消费者通胀将在第三季度趋平稳定。

items.def_en: To bring into or reach an equilibrium where opposing forces or factors balance
items.ex_en: Ancient philosophers believed nature would always equilibrate opposing cosmic forces over time.
items.ex_zh: 古代哲学家相信，随着时间的推移，自然总会使相互对立的宇宙力量达到平衡。
items.ex2_en: The internal chemical concentrations will equilibrate naturally after twenty-four hours in the laboratory.
items.ex2_zh: 在实验室放置二十四小时后，内部化学浓度会自然达到平衡。

items.def_en: To become steady, stable, or unchanging, or to make something do this.
items.ex_en: The central bank intervened immediately to stabilize the falling value of the currency.
items.ex_zh: 中央银行立即进行干预，以稳定不断下跌的货币汇率。
items.ex2_en: Patient blood pressure stabilized rapidly following the administration of the prescribed emergency medicine.
items.ex2_zh: 在给予指定的急救药物后，患者的血压迅速稳定下来。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers processes where fluctuating, volatile, or precarious systems, objects, or conditions settle down, reach equilibrium, or are made resilient against disruption. Unlike purely physical solidifying, the emphasis here is on calm constancy and dynamic balance.
groups.summary_zh: 指系统、局势或物体摆脱波动与不稳，趋于平衡与稳定。

groups.name: Stand in & Deputize · 替补与代职 (Stand in, Pinch-hit, Fill in)
groups.tip: 委派替补上场接替原有位置

items.def_en: (informal) (+ for) To act as a substitute, especially in sports or teaching.
items.ex_en: Can you sub for our injured midfielder during the second half tonight?
items.ex_zh: 今晚下半场你能替补我们受伤的中场球员上场吗？

items.def_en: (+ for) To take someone's place temporarily, especially at work or in a theatrical role
items.ex_en: The assistant director agreed to stand in for the host during the rehearsal.
items.ex_zh: 助理导演同意在彩排期间临时替主持人走位代班。

items.def_en: (+ for) To act as a substitute in an emergency or unexpected absence, originally in baseball
items.ex_en: She kindly agreed to pinch-hit for me when I fell ill before the presentation.
items.ex_zh: 我在演讲前生病了，她非常爽快地同意临时顶替我救场。

items.def_en: (+ for) To act as a deputy or authorized representative on behalf of a superior or colleague
items.ex_en: The ambassador authorized his senior counselor to deputize for him during the negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 大使授权他的高级参赞在谈判期间代表他全权行事。

items.def_en: To enter a situation and take over someone else's role, especially to help solve a problem
items.ex_en: The government had to step in to prevent the bank from collapsing.
items.ex_zh: 政府不得不出手干预，以防止该银行倒闭。

items.def_en: To learn another actor's role in order to be able to substitute for them if necessary
items.ex_en: A talented young actor was chosen to understudy the complex lead role on Broadway.
items.ex_zh: 一位年轻有才华的演员被选中，在百老汇为这个复杂的主角充当候补演员。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on temporarily stepping in to perform another person's duties, such as in sports, theater, or employment. Verbs emphasize acting as a proxy or emergency understudy.
groups.summary_zh: 指在体育、工作或表演中临时顶替他人职责，充当替补或代理。
groups.desc_en: Involves temporarily fulfilling another person's role or station due to their absence or emergency, contrasting with permanent tenure or unauthorized usurpation.
groups.desc_zh: 指在原负责人缺席或出现突发状况时，临时代理、顶岗或替补履行职务，区别于正式调任接管或越权篡位。
groups.nuance_en: stand in: take someone's place temporarily as an arranged proxy (actor / host / colleague) · deputize: act as an authorized official substitute with granted authority (sheriff / boss / minister) · fill in: step in to cover a shift or perform an absent person's duties (colleague / forms / details) · pinch-hit: step into a crunch situation at short notice to replace someone (speaker / team / role) · step in: intervene to manage an affair when another falters or leaves (breach / gap / fight) · understudy: learn another actor's role thoroughly to substitute if needed (lead / star / role)
groups.nuance_zh: stand in: 预定充当替身或代理出场 (actor / host / colleague) · deputize: 获正式赋权代行职务 (sheriff / boss / minister) · fill in: 临时顶班补缺 (colleague / forms / details) · pinch-hit: 紧要关头受命临时救场代打 (speaker / team / role) · step in: 在空缺或危急时介入接手 (breach / gap / fight) · understudy: 作为候补演员跟班备岗 (lead / star / role)

groups.name: Station & Deploy · 驻扎与设防 (Garrison, Station, Billet)
groups.tip: 派遣军队进驻要塞要地防守

items.def_en: To assign soldiers, police, or military assets to stay at a specific base or strategic area
items.ex_en: The government decided to station additional military units along the contested northern border.
items.ex_zh: 政府决定在有争议的北部边境沿线派驻更多军事单位。

items.def_en: To provide living accommodations and sleeping quarters for military personnel
items.ex_en: The fortress commander was ordered to quarter three hundred fresh cavalry recruits immediately.
items.ex_zh: 要塞指挥官接到命令，立即为三百名新征召的骑兵安排食宿。

items.def_en: To position military personnel, ships, or equipment systematically ready for tactical action
items.ex_en: The general moved swiftly to deploy specialized armored units near the front line.
items.ex_zh: 将军迅速行动，在前线附近部署了专门的装甲部队。

items.def_zh: 派兵驻守，守卫（要塞或城镇）
items.def_en: To put soldiers in a town, fort, or base to defend it.
items.ex_en: High command decided to garrison the mountain fortress with experienced elite infantry regiments.
items.ex_zh: 最高指挥部决定派遣经验丰富的精锐步兵团驻守这座山间要塞。

items.def_zh: 为（士兵）安排民房借住；留宿
items.def_en: To provide civilian lodgings or temporary quarters for soldiers in a town or base
items.ex_en: During the winter march, the army commander had to billet troops in local homes.
items.ex_zh: 在冬季行军期间，军队指挥官不得不安排士兵借宿在当地民宅中。

items.def_en: To set up camp and settle soldiers in temporary outdoor tents or shelters
items.ex_en: The weary Roman legion chose to encamp beside the wide river at dusk.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的罗马军团在黄昏时分选择在宽阔的河畔安营扎寨。

groups.summary_en: This military frame involves assigning, lodging, or posting troops and defense units in a particular fortress, town, or strategic post for defense, occupation, or operational readiness.
groups.summary_zh: 指将军队派驻、安置于城塞、据点或城镇进行防守、屯驻或常态布控。
groups.desc_en: Refers to strategically positioning military units or personnel in specific geographic quarters or fortifications, contrasting with being on an active offensive march or demobilizing.
groups.desc_zh: 指将军事力量或常备人员成建制部署、驻扎在特定驻地、营垒或战略要塞，区别于行军突击或复员解散。
groups.nuance_en: station: assign military personnel or assets to a specific post (troops / guards / fleet) · deploy: spread out forces or equipment into readiness for operational use (missiles / police / resources) · garrison: secure a town or fort by permanently quartering troops there (town / fort / border) · quarter: provide temporary housing and lodgings for military troops (soldiers / troops / regiments) · billet: lodge soldiers in private houses by official requisition (troops / regiment / men) · encamp: pitch tents and establish a temporary field camp (army / refugees / troops)
groups.nuance_zh: station: 派驻常驻某哨所或基地 (troops / guards / fleet) · deploy: 战备展开并调派兵力资源 (missiles / police / resources) · garrison: 留兵戍守要塞城镇 (town / fort / border) · quarter: 为部队安排营房配给驻所 (soldiers / troops / regiments) · billet: 官方征用民宅供军人驻扎 (troops / regiment / men) · encamp: 扎营立寨驻宿 (army / refugees / troops)

groups.name: Steal & Rob · 偷盗与抢劫 (Rob, Burgle, Swipe)
groups.tip: 暗中顺手牵羊小偷小摸

items.def_en: To steal something casually, quietly, or opportunistically
items.ex_en: A sly boy managed to swipe a chocolate bar from the grocery counter.
items.ex_zh: 一个机灵的小男孩设法从杂货店柜台上顺走了一块巧克力。

items.def_en: To steal something and escape with it successfully
items.ex_en: Thieves broke into the gallery and made off with three priceless paintings.
items.ex_zh: 盗贼闯入画廊，盗走了三幅无价的名画。

items.def_en: To steal something directly, or to cheat someone out of money unfairly
items.ex_en: Unsuspecting tourists are often ripped off by unlicensed taxi operators.
items.ex_zh: 毫无防备的游客经常被无照出租车司机敲竹杠。

items.def_en: 1. To take something that belongs to someone else without permission. 2. To move quietly and secretly so as not to be seen or heard.
items.ex_en: The thief managed to steal a diamond necklace from the display case unseen.
items.ex_zh: 窃贼在无人察觉的情况下设法从陈列柜中偷走了一条钻石项链。

items.def_en: To enter a building illegally, usually without violence, in order to steal things
items.ex_en: Intruders broke a basement window to burgle the empty suburban residence yesterday evening.
items.ex_zh: 昨晚，入侵者砸碎地下室的一扇窗户潜入那栋空置的郊区住宅行窃。

items.def_en: To take money or property illegally from a person or place, often using or threatening violence
items.ex_en: Armed men planned to rob the central bank vault during broad daylight yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 昨天，多名持枪男子企图在光天化日之下抢劫中央银行的金库。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses unlawfully taking property from an individual, vehicle, or premises, ranging from stealthy theft to forceful, violent dispossession.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖非法窃取或暴力掠夺他人财物的行为，涉及偷盗与打劫。
groups.desc_en: Unlawfully taking another's property, differentiated from simple taking by illicit intent, stealth, unlawful entry, or overt physical force.
groups.desc_zh: 非法占有他人财物的行为总称；与单纯的“拿取”相比，具有非法目的，且根据隐蔽行窃、非法侵入或武力威胁呈现不同手段特征。
groups.nuance_en: steal: general illicit taking without consent (money / jewels / data) · rob: taking directly from a person or place with force or intimidation (bank / traveler / store) · burgle: illegal breaking and entering into a property to steal (home / warehouse / shop) · swipe: casual or brazen opportunistic snatching (wallet / card / phone) · make off with: fleeing successfully with stolen goods (loot / prize / jewels) · rip off: brazen swindling or blatant stealing (tourists / customers / song)
groups.nuance_zh: steal: 最广泛的偷盗统称 (money / jewels / data) · rob: 施加暴力或威胁的直接抢劫 (bank / traveler / store) · burgle: 入室盗窃 (home / warehouse / shop) · swipe: 顺手牵羊、轻浮地顺走 (wallet / card / phone) · make off with: 携赃潜逃 (loot / prize / jewels) · rip off: 宰客、抄袭或明抢 (tourists / customers / song)

groups.name: Steal & Thieve · 偷窃与盗取 (Thieve, Steal, Pilfer)
groups.tip: 暗中非法窃取他人所有

items.def_en: To take another person's property unlawfully and secretly without permission
items.ex_en: Desperate refugees were caught trying to steal fresh bread from the bakery truck.
items.ex_zh: 绝望的难民试图从面包车上偷窃新鲜面包时被当场抓获。

items.def_en: To steal goods from a retail store while pretending to be an ordinary customer
items.ex_en: Store security caught the suspicious teen trying to shoplift expensive cosmetics this morning.
items.ex_zh: 今天上午，商店安保人员抓获了一名企图顺手盗窃昂贵化妆品的可疑青少年。

items.def_en: (dated / literary) To steal things; to take another person's property secretly and dishonestly.
items.ex_en: Impoverished scoundrels were known to thieve in the dark alleys of the ancient city.
items.ex_zh: 人们皆知，穷困潦倒的无赖常常在古城的幽暗小巷里暗中行窃。

items.def_zh: 小偷小摸，偷窃（微量物品）
