items.def_en: To steal things of relatively little value repeatedly or in small quantities
items.ex_en: The dishonest clerk would routinely pilfer pens and small supplies from the office storage.
items.ex_zh: 那个不老实的文员经常从小偷小摸地从办公室储藏室顺走钢笔和小用品。

items.def_en: To steal something secretly, often when given access to it or while violating trust
items.ex_en: The traitor used forged credentials to purloin top-secret military files from the archive.
items.ex_zh: 叛徒利用伪造的证件从档案馆中暗中盗取了绝密军事档案。

items.def_en: To steal casually or surreptitiously, typically items of minor worth
items.ex_en: Someone managed to filch a few loose coins from my open jacket pocket.
items.ex_zh: 有人趁我不备从我敞开的夹克口袋里摸走了几枚零钱。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this core semantic frame describe taking property unlawfully and covertly without the owner's knowledge or consent. Nuances span from petty theft in workplaces to systemic shoplifting and dishonest appropriation.
groups.summary_zh: 统指不为人知地非法窃取他人财物的行为，涵盖小偷小摸与一般盗窃。
groups.desc_en: Depriving an owner of property through covert stealth or breach of trust, contrasting with violent robbery by emphasizing non-confrontational secrecy.
groups.desc_zh: 通过隐秘潜行或辜负信任侵占财物，与使用暴力的“抢劫”相对，强调无对抗性、不为人知的行窃手段。
groups.nuance_en: steal: generic non-violent misappropriation (car / idea / wallet) · thieve: habitual or professional practice of stealthy stealing (belongings / cattle) · pilfer: repeatedly taking small amounts of low-value items (office supplies / petty cash) · filch: sneakily snatching minor items, often opportunistically (trinket / key / biscuit) · purloin: formal or euphemistic stealing through privileged access (documents / letters / funds) · shoplift: stealing goods from retail premises during business hours (clothes / cosmetics / goods)
groups.nuance_zh: steal: 盗窃与私自挪用的统称 (car / idea / wallet) · thieve: 惯常或职业化的偷窃行径 (belongings / cattle) · pilfer: 屡次小额盗用、顺手牵羊 (office supplies / petty cash) · filch: 鬼祟顺走微不足道之物 (trinket / key / biscuit) · purloin: 利用职权或便利窃取公文或机密 (documents / letters / funds) · shoplift: 商店行窃 (clothes / cosmetics / goods)

groups.name: Stipulate & Prescribe · 明文规定与硬性约定 (Prescribe, Mandate, Dictate)
groups.tip: 在法律合同中载明具体条款

items.def_en: To state formally and firmly what rule or principle must be observed
items.ex_en: The government has laid down strict safety guidelines for the industry.
items.ex_zh: 政府为该行业制定了严格的安全指南。

items.def_en: To officially order, require, or make obligatory by law or public policy
items.ex_en: New federal laws mandate that all commercial buildings install advanced fire suppression systems.
items.ex_zh: 新的联邦法律强制要求所有商业建筑安装先进的灭火系统。

items.def_en: To lay down authoritatively a rule or course of action to be followed
items.ex_en: The university handbook prescribes strict ethical conduct for all incoming academic researchers.
items.ex_zh: 该大学的学生手册为所有新入职的学术研究人员明文规定了严格的道德准则。

items.def_en: To control, influence, or lay down binding conditions with supreme authority
items.ex_en: The harsh terms of the treaty dictate the complete disarmament of conquered territories.
items.ex_zh: 该条约的严苛条款强行规定了被征服领土必须彻底解除武装。

items.def_en: To issue an official and inviolable order or proclamation having the force of law
items.ex_en: The king issued an official proclamation to decree a general amnesty for rebels.
items.ex_zh: 国王颁布了一道官方公告，下令对叛乱分子实行大赦。

items.def_en: (formal) To state clearly and firmly that something must be done, especially as a condition of an agreement or law.
items.ex_en: The procurement contract stipulates that goods must be delivered within thirty calendar days.
items.ex_zh: 该采购合同明确规定，货物必须在三十个日历日内交付。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this legal and administrative frame describe establishing authoritative, legally binding terms, prerequisites, or rules that parties must adhere to. While 'stipulate' sets contractual conditions, 'prescribe' lays down exact procedures, and 'mandate' enforces by legislative order.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过法规、契约或指令明文规定并强制执行特定要求。
groups.desc_en: Formally declaring binding rules or obligations by authority, distinct from mere suggesting or requesting by carrying unchallengeable normative force.
groups.desc_zh: 由权威机构或法律条文强制确立不可违背的约束性规则；与“建议/劝告”相对，具有无可置疑的法定拘束力。
groups.nuance_en: stipulate: explicitly insist upon as an essential contractual condition (terms / requirement / condition) · prescribe: authoritative laying down of an exact rule or remedy (guidelines / punishment / dosage) · mandate: authoritative command or statutory requirement (training / quotas / wearing masks) · dictate: unilateral, uncompromising imposition of rules (terms / policy / pace) · decree: formal, sovereign judicial or royal pronouncement (order / end of hostilities) · lay down: clearly codifying authoritative rules (ground rules / principles / procedure)
groups.nuance_zh: stipulate: 在契约中明确规定为必要条件 (terms / requirement / condition) · prescribe: 权威性地明确指定规则或处方 (guidelines / punishment / dosage) · mandate: 依照法令或职权硬性要求 (training / quotas / wearing masks) · dictate: 独断且不容置疑地强加 (terms / policy / pace) · decree: 颁发政令或裁决 (order / end of hostilities) · lay down: 正式制定并明文颁布 (ground rules / principles / procedure)

groups.name: Stipulate & Prescribe · 规定与约定 (Stipulate, Dictate, Lay down)
groups.tip: 条文法规中明确指令与条款

items.def_en: To state officially what must be done, especially rules, principles, or conditions
items.ex_en: The government has laid down strict safety guidelines for the industry.
items.ex_zh: 政府为该行业制定了严格的安全指南。

items.def_en: To explain or present facts, ideas, or conditions clearly and in detail, especially in writing
items.ex_en: The official policy document sets out the precise eligibility requirements for loan applicants.
items.ex_zh: 该官方政策文件详细列明了贷款申请人的具体资格要求。

items.def_zh: 清楚说明；明文规定细节
items.def_en: To explain something in a very clear way with all details so that there is no misunderstanding
items.ex_en: You don't need to spell out every detail; we get the general idea.
items.ex_zh: 你不需要把每个细节都阐释得那么细，我们明白大意。

items.def_zh: 规定，指定；（医生）开（药，处方）
items.def_en: 1. To state officially what should be done; set down as a rule or guide. 2. (medical) To tell someone to take a particular medicine or treatment.
items.ex_en: The city building codes prescribe the exact thickness required for concrete foundations.
items.ex_zh: 城市建筑规范对混凝土基础所需的具体厚度作出了明文规定。

items.def_en: To tell someone what to do or decide what must happen with absolute authority
items.ex_en: A ruthless CEO should not dictate every small operational decision to department heads.
items.ex_zh: 专断的首席执行官不应该对部门主管强行规定每一个微小的运营决策。

items.def_en: To state clearly and firmly that something must be done, or how it must be done, as part of an official agreement or law
items.ex_en: The international convention stipulates that all participating nations must reduce carbon emissions significantly.
items.ex_zh: 该国际公约明确约定，所有参与国都必须大幅减少碳排放。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe officially setting out rules, terms, or conditions that others are required to follow. While 'prescribe' often carries normative or regulatory authority, related terms range from contractual agreements to unilateral requirements.
groups.summary_zh: 以权威或契约形式明确规定条款、行为准则或必要条件。
groups.desc_en: Setting forth operational conditions, guidelines, or procedures clearly in an official context, differing from coercive dictation by emphasizing orderly, explicit codification.
groups.desc_zh: 在官方或协议情境中将执行细则与规程条分缕析地明示；与纯粹强权施压相比，重在规则的清晰建构与细化落纸。
groups.nuance_en: set out: arranging ideas or rules systematically in text (proposals / conditions / criteria) · spell out: explaining details in unmistakable, exhaustive terms (consequences / instructions / steps) · stipulate: stating terms expressly as part of an agreement (contract / conditions / provisions) · lay down: establishing firm operational ground rules (standards / parameters / limits) · prescribe: formally designating correct courses of action (procedures / measures / actions) · dictate: overwhelmingly driving and determining conditions (logic / circumstance / necessity)
groups.nuance_zh: set out: 条理分明地列举或阐明 (proposals / conditions / criteria) · spell out: 逐条详尽且毫无歧义地说明 (consequences / instructions / steps) · stipulate: 在协议中逐条订明 (contract / conditions / provisions) · lay down: 立规矩、划定底线 (standards / parameters / limits) · prescribe: 明文指定应循规程 (procedures / measures / actions) · dictate: 由客观情势所迫使或决定 (logic / circumstance / necessity)

groups.name: Stonewall & Evasively Delay · 阻挠与拖延对谈 (Stonewall, Temporize, Evade)
groups.tip: 用言语推诿或筑起沟通障碍

items.def_en: To avoid giving a direct answer or firm commitment by choosing ambiguous or evasive language
items.ex_en: The spokesperson began to hedge when reporters pressed him about the budget shortfall.
items.ex_zh: 当记者追问预算短缺问题时，发言人开始闪烁其词。

items.def_en: To satisfy an inquirer or complainant temporarily with an excuse or evasion to avoid answering genuinely
items.ex_en: The customer service agent tried to fob off my complaint with a generic excuse.
items.ex_zh: 客服代表试图用一个敷衍的借口来搪塞我的投诉。

items.def_en: To avoid answering a direct question or dealing with an issue by intentional distraction or cleverness
items.ex_en: The politician tried repeatedly to evade the challenging question about rising local taxes.
items.ex_zh: 该政客一再试图回避有关当地税收上涨的尖锐问题。

items.def_en: To speak or act evasively in an inquiry so as to conceal the truth without uttering direct falsehoods
items.ex_en: The witness continued to prevaricate under oath instead of offering a clear answer.
items.ex_zh: 该证人在宣誓后仍旧支吾其词，拒不给出明确的答复。

items.def_en: To deliberately avoid making a decision or committing oneself in conversation in order to gain time
items.ex_en: The cabinet minister chose to temporize until the political controversy finally blew over.
items.ex_zh: 内阁部长选择敷衍拖延，直到这场政治争议最终平息。

items.def_zh: 推诿拖延，阻挠拖延，拒绝配合
items.def_en: 1. To obstruct or delay a discussion, investigation, or political process by refusing to answer questions or give information.
items.ex_en: Defense lawyers tried to stonewall the federal grand jury during the corruption inquiry.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师试图在贪腐调查期间对联邦大陪审团进行推诿阻挠。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail non-cooperative interpersonal or communicative tactics—such as evasiveness, refusal to answer questions, or strategic stalling—to stymie investigations and negotiations.
groups.summary_zh: 在问讯、谈判中通过沉默、搪塞或顾左右而言他来拖延阻挠对方。
groups.desc_en: Deliberately obstructing discourse or delaying resolution through evasive non-cooperation, unlike honest postponement which seeks later engagement.
groups.desc_zh: 在沟通过程中通过含糊推诿、拒绝配合来故意阻挠或拖延；不同于正当的“延期”，其核心在于故意不合作与闪避真相。
groups.nuance_en: stonewall: outright refusing to cooperate or give information (investigation / inquiry / committee) · temporize: acting evasively to buy time and delay a confrontation (tactics / response / negotiations) · prevaricate: speaking equivocally to conceal the truth (answers / witness / politicians) · hedge: qualifying statements to avoid commitment or risk (bets / answers / predictions) · evade: directly deflecting or dodging an issue (question / responsibility / scrutiny) · fob off: dishonestly brushing someone off with flimsy excuses (critics / complaints / customer)
groups.nuance_zh: stonewall: 砌石墙般彻底不配合、全面阻挠 (investigation / inquiry / committee) · temporize: 采取拖延战术争取时间 (tactics / response / negotiations) · prevaricate: 闪烁其词、支吾以隐瞒真相 (answers / witness / politicians) · hedge: 言辞模棱两可、规避明确表态 (bets / answers / predictions) · evade: 直截了当地逃避或回避问题 (question / responsibility / scrutiny) · fob off: 用敷衍塞责的借口打发 (critics / complaints / customer)

groups.name: Stoop & Hunch · 弯腰与蜷缩 (Hunch, Stoop, Crouch, Slouch)
groups.tip: 弓背缩肩，身体向前弯曲姿态

items.def_en: Bend the head and top of the body forward and downward
items.ex_en: The tall athlete had to stoop low to enter the tiny doorway safely.
items.ex_zh: 身材高大的运动员不得不弯下腰来，才安全穿过低矮的门洞。

items.def_zh: 弯腰弓背，耸起（双肩）；蜷缩
items.def_en: to bend your back and shoulders forward into a curved position, or cause them to bend forward
items.ex_en: The cold wind caused the weary traveler to hunch his shoulders in discomfort.
items.ex_zh: 刺骨的寒风让疲惫的旅人难受地耸起双肩、蜷起脊背。
items.ex2_en: The elderly man hunched forward over his steaming bowl of hot vegetable soup.
items.ex2_zh: 那位老人弓着身子趴在冒着热气的热蔬菜汤碗前。

items.def_zh: 没精打采地下垂坐立，懒散含胸
items.def_en: Stand, sit, or walk with slumped, rounded shoulders and relaxed posture
items.ex_en: Tired teenagers often slouch against the wall while waiting for the morning bus.
items.ex_zh: 疲倦的青少年在等早班车时常常没精打采地含胸靠在墙上。

items.def_en: Lower the body by bending knees close to the chest, often to hide or rest
items.ex_en: The soldier chose to crouch behind the stone wall until reinforcements safely arrived.
items.ex_zh: 士兵选择蹲伏在石墙后，直到增援部队安全抵达。

items.def_en: Curl one's limbs close to the body, typically against cold or emotional distress
items.ex_en: The trembling child would huddle under the heavy blanket during the severe blizzard.
items.ex_zh: 在猛烈的暴风雪中，瑟瑟发抖的孩子蜷缩在厚重的毛毯下面。
items.ex2_en: The nervous shepherd huddled the frightened sheep together inside the safe wooden barn.
items.ex2_zh: 紧张的牧羊人把受惊的羊群紧紧聚拢在安全的木制谷仓内。

items.def_en: Shrink back and crouch down in fear or submission
items.ex_en: The terrified stray dog began to cower whenever anyone raised a harsh voice.
items.ex_zh: 每当有人大声斥责，这只受惊的流浪狗就会因恐惧而瑟缩退避。

groups.summary_en: These verbs describe postural adjustments where the spine curves forward or the torso compacts toward the ground, whether from fatigue, dejection, or concealment.
groups.summary_zh: 指脊柱弯曲、含胸驼背或蹲伏蜷缩的身体姿态。
groups.desc_en: Lowering or curling the body posture, differing from upright standing or lying flat by deliberate deformation of the torso for protection, stealth, or fatigue.
groups.desc_zh: 通过弯屈躯干来降低或蜷曲身体姿态；区别于挺直站立或平躺，多出于防卫、隐蔽或疲态。
groups.nuance_en: stoop: bending the head and shoulders habitually or downward to pick up (shoulders / posture / down) · hunch: arching the back forward into a round posture (back / shoulders / over desk) · slouch: droopingly collapsing the posture lazily or dejectedly (in an armchair / posture / along) · crouch: lowering the body close to the ground on bent legs (behind bushes / down / posture) · huddle: curling up tightly for warmth or safety, often together (around fire / in corners / group) · cower: crouching down submissively or fearfully (in fear / before master / corner)
groups.nuance_zh: stoop: 习惯性佝偻或屈身俯拾 (shoulders / posture / down) · hunch: 耸肩弓背 (back / shoulders / over desk) · slouch: 没精打采地瘫坐或懒散耷拉着走 (in an armchair / posture / along) · crouch: 屈膝蹲下以隐匿或蓄力 (behind bushes / down / posture) · huddle: 因寒冷或恐惧蜷缩或挤成一团 (around fire / in corners / group) · cower: 畏缩、瑟瑟发抖地蜷伏 (in fear / before master / corner)

groups.name: Strain & Overexert · 劳损与拉伤 (Overexert, Sprain, Tear)
groups.tip: 过度用力引发肌肉韧带拉伤

items.def_en: To injure a muscle or tendon by overstretching it during physical motion
items.ex_en: The sprinter had to pull a hamstring muscle during the final championship race.
items.ex_zh: 那名短跑运动员在最后的冠军赛中不慎拉伤了大腿后群肌腱。

items.def_zh: 拉伤，扭伤，使过度劳损；极力运用，尽力；拉紧；过滤
items.def_en: 1. To injure a muscle, ligament, or body part by stretching or overexerting it. 2. To make a great physical or mental effort; to push something to its limit. 3. To separate liquid from solid food using a sieve.
items.ex_en: Lifting heavy crates without proper form will quickly strain your lower back muscles.
items.ex_zh: 姿势不正确地搬运重木箱会很快使你的下背部肌肉劳损拉伤。

items.def_en: To injure a joint by suddenly and violently stretching or tearing its ligaments
items.ex_en: She managed to sprain her left ankle after slipping on the icy sidewalk.
items.ex_zh: 她在结冰的人行道上滑倒后，不幸扭伤了左脚踝关节。

items.def_en: (oneself) To make excessive demands on one's physical strength or stamina
items.ex_en: Physicians warned the recovering patient never to overexert himself during rehabilitation exercises.
items.ex_zh: 医生告诫正在康复的患者在康复锻炼期间切勿过度消耗体力。

items.def_en: To rupture fibers of a muscle, tendon, or ligament through sudden heavy load
items.ex_en: The quarterback had the misfortune to tear a knee ligament during yesterday's match.
items.ex_zh: 四分卫在昨天的比赛中不幸拉伤撕裂了一条膝关节韧带。

items.def_en: To make demands on bodily strength, energy, or health that are far too great
items.ex_en: Long hours of continuous manual labor will seriously overtax an elderly worker's body.
items.ex_zh: 长时间连续从事重体力劳动会严重耗竭年迈工人的身体机能。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve pushing muscles, tendons, ligaments, or the bodily constitution beyond its safe threshold, provoking tears or physical injury.
groups.summary_zh: 指身体肌肉、韧带或精力过度用力、拉伸超过负荷，造成局部拉伤扭伤或损伤。
groups.desc_en: Subjecting bodily tissues or resources to excessive mechanical force causing fatigue or trauma, contrasting with ordinary exertion by exceeding physiological thresholds.
groups.desc_zh: 使身体组织或资源承受超出负荷的机械力从而致伤或劳损；与普通“用力”相比，其施力超出了生理极限。
groups.nuance_en: overexert: pushing bodily energy past healthy endurance (heart / body / oneself) · overtax: exhausting non-physical or physical capacity beyond limits (strength / mind / system) · strain: injuring muscle or tendon through stretching or overuse (back / muscle / eyes) · sprain: violently twisting joint ligaments without fracture (ankle / wrist / knee) · tear: completely or partially ripping soft tissue fibers (ligament / cartilage / tendon) · pull: acutely overstretching muscle fibers (hamstring / groin / calf)
groups.nuance_zh: overexert: 用力过猛、体力超支 (heart / body / oneself) · overtax: 劳力伤神过度耗损承载力 (strength / mind / system) · strain: 肌肉或肌腱过度使用导致劳损 (back / muscle / eyes) · sprain: 关节韧带扭伤 (ankle / wrist / knee) · tear: 软组织纤维撕裂 (ligament / cartilage / tendon) · pull: 肌肉纤维骤然拉伤 (hamstring / groin / calf)

groups.name: Strangle & Choke · 扼杀与勒毙 (Scrag, Strangle, Throtte)
groups.tip: 卡扼住喉咙颈部致使窒息死亡

items.def_en: To impede or prevent breathing by blocking the airway or squeezing the throat from outside
items.ex_en: Dense black smoke filled the corridor and threatened to choke the trapped residents.
items.ex_zh: 浓黑的烟雾弥漫了走廊，几乎要让被困的居民窒息。
items.ex2_en: The startled dinner guest began to choke violently on a tiny fish bone.
items.ex2_zh: 受惊的宴席宾客被一根小鱼刺卡住，剧烈地窒息咳嗽起来。

items.def_en: To attack or kill someone by compressing their throat forcefully with one's hands
items.ex_en: The masked assailant tried to throttle the defenseless guard from behind the counter.
items.ex_zh: 蒙面袭击者试图从柜台后掐住那名毫无防备的警卫的脖子致其死亡。

items.def_zh: 勒死，扼毙；粗暴地抓住颈部殴打
items.def_en: 1. To kill someone by choking, strangling, or hanging them. 2. To seize roughly by the neck or assault violently.
items.ex_en: The angry gang threatened to scrag the informant in the dark back alley.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的黑帮分子威胁要在幽暗的后巷里掐死那个线人。

items.def_en: To kill someone by squeezing their neck tightly with hands, a rope, or a cord so they cannot breathe
items.ex_en: The assassin used a piece of heavy cord to strangle the corrupt official.
items.ex_zh: 刺客用一根粗绳勒死了那个贪腐的官员。

items.def_en: To execute or kill someone using a wire, cord, or metal collar tightened around the neck
items.ex_en: The shadow assassin moved silently to garrote the sentry with thin piano wire.
items.ex_zh: 潜行刺客悄无声息地行动，用纤细的钢琴弦将哨兵绞杀。

items.def_en: To cause someone to die or lose consciousness by cutting off their intake of air or oxygen
items.ex_en: Fumes from the faulty heater could asphyxiate sleeping residents within a few hours.
items.ex_zh: 故障加热器散发的废气可能会在几小时内致使熟睡的住户窒息身亡。
items.ex2_en: The trapped miners nearly asphyxiated before rescue teams penetrated the blocked underground shaft.
items.ex2_zh: 在救援队打通堵塞的地下矿井之前，被困矿工几乎窒息而死。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail violent constriction of the throat, windpipe, or neck causing asphyxiation, ranging from bare-handed choking to garroting.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过掐扼咽喉、收紧环圈致人窒息或死亡的暴力动作。
groups.desc_en: Depriving an organism of oxygen by mechanical compression or constriction of the neck or airway, distinct from drowning by the solid or manual agency of asphyxiation.
groups.desc_zh: 通过对颈部或呼吸道的机械性压迫与挤压致使其窒息身亡；区别于水中的“溺水”，其致害方式为物理外力勒扼。
groups.nuance_en: strangle: killing or injuring by squeezing the neck, manually or with a cord (victim / competitor / trade) · throttle: forcefully compressing the windpipe with hand or grasp (neck / throat / industry) · choke: obstructing internal airflow or gagging on an object (food / fumes / airway) · asphyxiate: causing loss of consciousness or death through oxygen deprivation (fumes / smoke / gas) · garrote: executing or murdering using an iron collar or wire cord around the neck (prisoner / victim / cord) · scrag: colloquial rough throttling, wringing the neck, or manhandling (neck / opponent / villain)
groups.nuance_zh: strangle: 用绳物或双手掐死、引申为扼杀 (victim / competitor / trade) · throttle: 用力扼住咽喉致窒息、压制 (neck / throat / industry) · choke: 气管受堵而呛住窒息 (food / fumes / airway) · asphyxiate: 缺氧致窒息（常涉烟气或窒息剂） (fumes / smoke / gas) · garrote: 用铁圈或细金属丝绞杀 (prisoner / victim / cord) · scrag: 粗鲁地揪打、勒脖子 (neck / opponent / villain)

groups.name: Strategic Retreat & Reversal · 后退与退让 (Retract, Backtrack, Renege)
groups.tip: 改变立场或向后撤退移动

items.def_en: Admit that one is wrong and withdraw a claim or demand in a dispute
items.ex_en: The minister was forced to climb down after intense public backlash.
items.ex_zh: 在强烈的公众反对声中，部长被迫让步。

items.def_en: Cease to oppose a challenge or withdraw a claim when faced with resistance
items.ex_en: Faced with furious public protests, the council refused to back down on the tax increase.
items.ex_zh: 面对民众激烈的抗议，市议会仍拒绝在增税问题上退让。

items.def_en: Formally withdraw a statement, accusation, or promise as untrue or unjustified
items.ex_en: The newspaper was legally compelled to retract the false accusation against the foreign minister.
items.ex_zh: 该报社依法被迫撤回了针对外交部长的虚假指控。
items.ex2_en: The mechanical landing gear slowly retracted into the aircraft fuselage after routine takeoff.
items.ex2_zh: 常规起飞后，机械起落架缓慢收缩进飞机的机身之中。

items.def_en: Reverse one's opinion, policy, or position, or return along the same path
items.ex_en: Under intense political pressure, the senator was forced to backtrack on his controversial proposal.
items.ex_zh: 在巨大的政治压力下，这位参议员被迫改变了他在那项争议提案上的立场。

items.def_en: (+ on) Fail to fulfill, dishonor, or go back on a promise, contract, or undertaking
items.ex_en: The developer cannot renege on the contractual agreement without incurring severe legal penalties.
items.ex_zh: 开发商若违背合同协议，将面临严厉的法律惩处。

items.def_zh: 变卦，改变（立场或决定）；后退；倒蹬自行车脚踏板
items.def_en: 1. (+ on) To retreat from or modify a previous statement, opinion, or promise. 2. To move backward or pedal backward on a bicycle.
items.ex_en: The politician started to backpedal on his pledges as soon as journalists raised questions.
items.ex_zh: 记者一提出质疑，这位政客就开始对自己的承诺闪烁其词、暗中变卦。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe figurative movement backward, specifically retreating from a previously held stance, commitment, promise, or argumentative position.
groups.summary_zh: 指在立场、言论、承诺或态度上的后退、食言、撤回或退缩让步。
groups.desc_en: Retracting a previously declared position, pledge, or demand under pressure, distinct from normal progression by representing concession and reversal.
groups.desc_zh: 在外部压力下放弃原先的立场、承诺或要求；与正常决策调整不同，强调被迫让步、自食其言或退缩。
groups.nuance_en: backtrack: completely reversing an earlier policy or stance (decision / policy / statement) · backpedal: hastily retreating from a controversial assertion (pledge / claim / commitment) · back down: yielding and giving up a contested demand under pressure (threat / confrontation / demands) · climb down: publicly humiliatingly conceding an untenable position (demands / ultimatum / stance) · retract: formally withdrawing an official assertion or statement (allegation / statement / claim) · renege: dishonorably failing to fulfill an agreed promise or deal (deal / promise / agreement)
groups.nuance_zh: backtrack: 原路撤回或颠覆既定立场 (decision / policy / statement) · backpedal: 仓促退让、言辞软化以自圆其说 (pledge / claim / commitment) · back down: 在对峙中屈服认怂 (threat / confrontation / demands) · climb down: 认输下台阶、狼狈收回成命 (demands / ultimatum / stance) · retract: 官方声明撤回或辟谣 (allegation / statement / claim) · renege: 背信弃义、不履行协议 (deal / promise / agreement)

groups.name: Stretch & Extend · 延伸与延展 (Sprawl, Elongate, Reach)
groups.tip: 向外伸展开来延展

items.def_en: To spread out over a wider area from a central focal point like an opened fan
items.ex_en: Search volunteers fan out across the dense forest to locate the missing hiker.
items.ex_zh: 搜救志愿者们向整片茂密的森林散开，以寻找失踪的徒步旅行者。
items.ex2_en: The card dealer expertly fanned out the new deck across the green felt.
items.ex2_zh: 发牌员熟练地将新扑克牌在绿色绒布桌面上扇形展开。

items.def_en: (+ to/for) To extend continuously so as to touch, cover, or attain a distant boundary
items.ex_en: The ancient stone wall reaches to the rugged edge of the northern cliffs.
items.ex_zh: 那座古老的石墙一直延伸到北部悬崖崎岖的边缘。

items.def_en: To continue or stretch over a certain area, distance, or period without interruption
items.ex_en: The pristine pine forest extends for several miles along the winding riverbank.
items.ex_zh: 这片原始松林沿着蜿蜒的河岸连绵延伸了数英里。
items.ex2_en: The city council voted to extend the subway line into distant suburban neighborhoods.
items.ex2_zh: 市议会投票决定将地铁线路延伸至偏远的郊区居民区。

items.def_zh: 延伸，伸展，延绵；伸长（肢体）；拉长，撑大
items.def_en: 1. To spread over a large area, distance, or period of time. 2. To make your body or limbs straight and reach out; to pull or spread something wider or longer.
items.ex_en: Endless golden dunes stretch toward the horizon under the scorching desert sun.
items.ex_zh: 在灼热的沙漠艳阳下，无尽的金色沙丘一直延绵至地平线。
items.ex2_en: The physical therapist instructed the patient to stretch his tight hamstring muscles daily.
items.ex2_zh: 理疗师指导这位患者每天拉伸紧绷的腿后侧肌群。

items.def_en: To spread out over a large geographical area in an untidy, irregular, or expansive manner
items.ex_en: Suburban housing developments sprawl across what used to be peaceful countryside farmlands.
items.ex_zh: 郊区住宅区在曾经宁静祥和的乡间农田上肆意蔓延。

items.def_en: To become longer or make something longer in relation to its width
items.ex_en: Extreme tectonic tension gradually elongates the crystalline mineral structures within the bedrock.
items.ex_zh: 极端的构造应力逐渐拉长了基岩内部的结晶矿物构造。
items.ex2_en: The heated copper wire elongates slightly when electric currents pass continuously through it.
items.ex2_zh: 当电流持续通过受热的铜导线时，导线会轻微伸长。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here signify spatial or physical continuation, broadening, or spreading out across geographical terrain or expanding beyond ordinary boundaries.
groups.summary_zh: 描述空间体量、地形或肢体朝外部或纵深持续展开与延伸。
groups.desc_en: Continuously spanning or unrolling across physical space or dimensions, differing from static presence by denoting active elongation or spatial uncoiling.
groups.desc_zh: 在空间或维度上沿一定方向连续伸展或铺开；区别于静态的存在，强调形体的延伸、展开与延展过程。
groups.nuance_en: extend: projecting continuous physical reach or temporal duration (deadline / border / limb) · stretch: drawing out length or continuity across an expanse (canvas / territory / imagination) · reach: achieving contact across an intervening gap (skyline / ceiling / summit) · sprawl: spreading out haphazardly and untidily over a broad area (suburbs / city / legs) · elongate: lengthening a physical form into a slenderer state (shadow / neck / shape) · fan out: spreading outwards from a central point over a wide front (search party / troops / crowd)
groups.nuance_zh: extend: 沿直线或时间轴向外延长 (deadline / border / limb) · stretch: 持续延展或紧绷拉长 (canvas / territory / imagination) · reach: 延伸触及某一远距离终端 (skyline / ceiling / summit) · sprawl: 杂乱无章地向四周蔓延摊开 (suburbs / city / legs) · elongate: 在几何上被拉长拉细 (shadow / neck / shape) · fan out: 呈扇形向外散开扩散 (search party / troops / crowd)

groups.name: Strike & Dislodge Ball · 击球与驱位 (Croquet, Cannon, Dislodge)
groups.tip: 用球槌或器械敲击球体

items.def_zh: 撞碰反弹；使球连续相碰
items.def_en: To strike and bounce off another ball or surface, especially in billiards
items.ex_en: The ivory billiard ball caromed off the mahogany rail into the corner pocket.
items.ex_zh: 象牙台球从红木台边撞碰反弹，滚入了底袋。

items.def_en: To send a ball or object far away by striking it with substantial force
items.ex_en: With a powerful swing, the batsman drove away the ball deep into the outfield.
items.ex_zh: 击球手用力一挥，将球狠狠击飞至外场深处。

items.def_en: To strike a ball so that it rebounds successively off another ball or cushion
items.ex_en: The cue ball cannoned sharply against the red before clipping the cushion.
items.ex_zh: 母球猛烈撞击红球产生反弹，随后蹭到了库边。

items.def_en: To knock a ball, piece, or obstacle out of its current resting place by physical strike
items.ex_en: A precise strike managed to dislodge the competitor's ball from the scoring circle.
items.ex_zh: 一次精准的击打成功把竞争对手的球撞出了得分圈。

items.def_en: To leave an opponent unable to hit their designated target ball directly without curving or using a cushion
items.ex_en: He cleverly snookered his opponent by resting the cue ball behind the black.
items.ex_zh: 他巧妙地将母球停在黑球后方，给对手制造了一杆障碍球。

items.def_zh: （槌球戏中）贴击（击打己球以撞飞紧贴着的对方球）
items.def_en: (in croquet) To drive an opponent's ball away by striking one's own ball when placed in contact with it.
items.ex_en: She placed her mallet firmly to croquet her opponent's ball off the lawn.
items.ex_zh: 她稳稳挥动球槌进行贴击，把对手的球猛然撞飞出草坪。

groups.summary_en: This specialized sports and gaming frame focuses on hitting one's own playing ball, puck, or piece directly against an opponent's ball to deflect, relocate, or propel it out of scoring position, characteristic of lawn and cue games.
groups.summary_zh: 在球类或桌游中用球击撞对手的球使其偏离或位移。
groups.desc_en: Directing an object to strike and deflect another in cue/lawn sports, contrasting with simple hitting by requiring tactical displacement or angled trajectories.
groups.desc_zh: 在球类运动中击打目标以引起偏转或使他球移位；与单纯“击打”不同，重在控球轨迹、借力偏转或战术驱赶。
groups.nuance_en: cannon: striking two target balls in succession with one cue ball (cue ball / shot / object balls) · carom: rebounding obliquely after striking another ball or cushion (ball / cushion / rail) · croquet: driving an opponent's ball away by striking one's own adjacent ball (opponent's ball / stake / hoop) · snooker: placing the cue ball where the opponent cannot directly hit a legal target (opponent / cue ball / game) · dislodge: knocking a settled ball completely out of its original position (ball / object / position) · drive away: hitting a ball with force to send an opponent's ball far from scoring range (target / opponent / ball)
groups.nuance_zh: cannon: 台球中一杆连击两球 (cue ball / shot / object balls) · carom: 碰撞反弹、借折射变线 (ball / cushion / rail) · croquet: 门球中借敲击己球撞飞对方球 (opponent's ball / stake / hoop) · snooker: 制造斯诺克障碍球 (opponent / cue ball / game) · dislodge: 将定着之球猛力击离其位 (ball / object / position) · drive away: 强行将对手的球撞出得分范围 (target / opponent / ball)

groups.name: Strike Heavily with Dull Sound · 重击与闷响 (Thump, Whack, Pound)
groups.tip: 沉重击打发出沉闷撞击声

items.def_en: To strike someone or something vigorously with a forceful blow
items.ex_en: He grabbed a heavy stick and whacked the loose fence post back into place.
items.ex_zh: 他操起一根粗木棍，用力猛击松动的栅栏柱使其复位。

items.def_zh: 重重撞击；砰然沉闷作响
items.def_en: To hit something with a dull, heavy, non-resonant sound
items.ex_en: The thick leather volume thudded onto the oak table, raising a small cloud of dust.
items.ex_zh: 厚重的皮面大部头书沉闷地砸在橡木桌上，激起一小片尘土。

items.def_en: To strike heavily and repeatedly with great force
items.ex_en: Frustrated residents pound on the locked clinic doors, demanding emergency medical assistance.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒焦急的居民们使劲连续重敲紧闭的诊所大门，要求紧急医疗救助。

items.def_en: To strike hard and violently, often causing damage or denting
items.ex_en: Vandals used a crowbar to bash the steel padlock until it finally broke.
items.ex_zh: 破坏分子用铁撬棍猛砸钢质挂锁，直至将其彻底砸碎。

items.def_zh: 重击，重打；砰然撞击；（心脏）怦怦直跳
items.def_en: 1. To hit someone or something heavily with a fist or blunt object, making a dull sound. 2. To beat strongly and quickly.
items.ex_en: The exasperated coach thumped his clipboard against the wooden bench in sheer frustration.
items.ex_zh: 气恼万分的教练愤然将战术板重重摔砸在木凳上。

items.def_en: To hit someone or something extremely hard with a heavy blow
items.ex_en: The defending heavyweight champion clobbered his rival with a ferocious right hook.
items.ex_zh: 卫冕重量级拳王挥出一记凶猛的右勾拳，痛击了他的对手。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate striking someone or something with heavy, blunt, forceful physical impact that produces a low, dull sound rather than a sharp crack.
groups.summary_zh: 表示用拳头或钝器大力击打，发出沉闷重响，强调打击力度与低沉声响。
groups.desc_en: Delivering a heavy impact that produces a low-frequency, blunt reverberation, differing from a sharp crack by dense, concussive acoustic weight.
groups.desc_zh: 重物撞击发出沉闷低沉的声音；区别于清脆的“啪”声，其触觉与听觉特征体现为厚重钝感与冲击力。
groups.nuance_en: thump: heavy impact with a hollow, dull resonance (fist on table / door / chest) · thud: soft, heavy dull sound of a falling weight (body / sack of flour / book) · whack: sharp, decisive impact delivered with a broad or flat implement (ball / back / stick) · pound: repetitive, punishing concussive bludgeoning (pavement / drums / fists) · bash: rough, forceful striking that dents or breaks (head / door / car) · clobber: colloquial overwhelming physical battering or crushing defeat (opponent / intruder / rival)
groups.nuance_zh: thump: 钝重敲击发出闷响 (fist on table / door / chest) · thud: 沉重物体坠地发出噗通钝响 (body / sack of flour / book) · whack: 用扁平物或棍棒脆重地狠抽 (ball / back / stick) · pound: 连续剧烈捶打撞击 (pavement / drums / fists) · bash: 粗暴猛砸导致变形损坏 (head / door / car) · clobber: 痛殴、把对手揍趴下 (opponent / intruder / rival)

groups.name: Strive & Endeavor · 努力与奋斗 (Strive, Struggle, Toil)
groups.tip: 从普通尝试升级为拼搏奋斗

items.def_en: To try very hard to achieve something despite formidable obstacles
items.ex_en: Impoverished local farmers struggle to harvest crops amid an unprecedented seasonal drought.
items.ex_zh: 贫困的当地农民在空前严峻的旱灾中艰难拼搏抢收庄稼。

items.def_en: To work hard and exert immense sustained energy to achieve a goal
items.ex_en: Dedicated humanitarian scientists labor to synthesize an affordable vaccine for tropical diseases.
items.ex_zh: 敬业的人道主义科学家们倾尽心力，竭力合成一种廉价的热带病疫苗。

items.def_en: To apply oneself with heavy mental or physical exertion
items.ex_en: Applicants must exert themselves mentally to complete the rigorous technical assessment on time.
items.ex_zh: 申请人必须全力以赴集中精力，方能按时完成严苛的技术考核。

items.def_en: To make every possible effort and hold back nothing to achieve success
items.ex_en: The underdog team decided to go all out during the final championship minutes.
items.ex_zh: 处于劣势的队伍决定在锦标赛的最后几分钟内孤注一掷、全力以赴。

items.def_en: (+ for/to do) To try very hard to do or achieve something over time
items.ex_en: International environmental organizations strive to protect endangered coastal wetlands from commercial exploitation.
items.ex_zh: 国际环保组织竭力争取保护濒危的沿海湿地免受商业开采之害。

items.def_en: (+ to do) (formal) To try very hard to do or achieve something.
items.ex_en: The research team will endeavor to preserve rare archival manuscripts using digital methods.
items.ex_zh: 该研究团队将竭力尝试采用数字化手段保护罕见的档案手稿。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey directing sustained willpower, intense energy, and earnest determination toward accomplishing a lofty, challenging goal.
groups.summary_zh: 指为了达成艰巨目标或崇高使命，付出坚韧不拔的意志与全心全力的努力。
groups.desc_en: Deploying sustained vigorous human effort toward a challenging objective, differing from light work by the continuous overcoming of internal or external friction.
groups.desc_zh: 为克服困难、达成目标而持续全力以赴；不同于普通的“工作/活动”，强调克服阻力与持久的心力付出。
groups.nuance_en: strive: making noble, persistent efforts toward a high ideal (excellence / perfection / justice) · struggle: laboring under intense difficulty, opposition, or hardship (adversity / disease / survival) · endeavor: earnest, methodical enterprise or dedicated attempt (solution / peace / project) · exert oneself: actively marshaling one's energy or physical faculties (mind / energy / muscles) · labor: enduring arduous, exhausting physical or mental toil (day and night / field / cause) · go all out: committing every available resource and energy without reserve (effort / campaign / match)
groups.nuance_zh: strive: 为崇高追求矢志不渝地奋斗 (excellence / perfection / justice) · struggle: 在逆境与挣扎中艰难求索 (adversity / disease / survival) · endeavor: 严肃、严谨地尽力尝试 (solution / peace / project) · exert oneself: 倾注体能或心力、身体力行 (mind / energy / muscles) · labor: 埋头苦干、承受繁重劳作 (day and night / field / cause) · go all out: 孤注一掷、倾尽全力 (effort / campaign / match)

groups.name: Submerge & Drown · 浸没与淹没 (Submerge, Inundate, Engulf)
groups.tip: 没入水面之下直至被彻底溺毙

items.def_en: To plunge or dip somebody or something deeply into a liquid until covered
items.ex_en: The technician immerses the metal components completely in an anti-corrosive chemical solution.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员将金属部件完全浸入防腐化学溶液中。

items.def_zh: （使）溺死，（使）淹死；淹没，浸没；压过，盖过（声音）
items.def_en: 1. to die by being submerged in water and unable to breathe, or to kill somebody in this way 2. to cover completely with water or liquid 3. (of a sound) to be loud enough to prevent another sound from being heard
items.ex_en: Torrential monsoon rains drown the lower valleys and ruin the seasonal rice harvest.
items.ex_zh: 倾盆的季风暴雨淹没了下游山谷，毁掉了应季的水稻收成。
items.ex2_en: Tragically, three reckless swimmers drowned in the violent rip current near the beach.
items.ex2_zh: 令人悲痛的是，三名鲁莽的游泳者在海滩附近的凶猛离岸流中溺亡。

items.def_zh: 淹没（船只等）；使进水下沉
items.def_en: To overwhelm or sink a boat or structure by filling it completely with water
items.ex_en: A massive rogue wave swamped the small fishing vessel before dawn broke.
items.ex_zh: 天亮前，一道巨大的异常巨浪彻底淹没了那艘小型渔船。

items.def_en: To place or sink something entirely under the surface of water or another liquid
items.ex_en: Rising tides submerge the coastal causeway twice each day, stranding careless motorists.
items.ex_zh: 不断上涨的潮水每天两次淹没沿海堤道，困住粗心大意的驾车者。
items.ex2_en: The sleek submarine submerged quietly beneath the choppy North Atlantic surface during twilight.
items.ex2_zh: 黄昏时分，线条流畅的潜艇静悄悄地下潜至波涛汹涌的北大西洋水下。

items.def_en: To sweep over and swallow something up completely, as deep water or floodwaters do
items.ex_en: Ferocious floodwaters threatened to engulf the historic riverside settlement within a few hours.
items.ex_zh: 凶猛的洪水势要在数小时内将这座历史悠久的河畔村落彻底吞没。

items.def_en: To flood or overwhelm an area completely with a surging volume of water
items.ex_en: The swollen mountain river burst its banks, inundating thousands of adjacent farming acres.
items.ex_zh: 暴涨的山洪冲垮了河堤，使周边数千英亩农田沦为一片汪洋。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers completely plunging or submerging someone or something underwater, leading to biological suffocation, total engulfment, or overwhelming destruction.
groups.summary_zh: 指将人或物完全没入水中导致窒息死亡，或水势彻底吞没掩盖目标。
groups.desc_en: Overwhelming completely beneath a mass of liquid or overpowering bulk, contrasting with surface wetting by absolute immersion and suffocation of presence.
groups.desc_zh: 完全被液体或铺天盖地的物质彻底吞没；与表层润湿相对，强调彻底没顶、失去容身之地的窒息感。
groups.nuance_en: submerge: placing or sinking entirely beneath the surface of a fluid (submarine / island / town) · immerse: plunging deep into liquid, or deeply engaging attention (hands / culture / thoughts) · drown: suffocating fatally in liquid or audibly smothering out (swimmer / noise / sorrows) · inundate: overwhelming completely with an overflowing flood or deluge (coastal areas / market / complaints) · swamp: flooding a vessel or utterly overburdening capacity (boat / hospital / orders) · engulf: devouring and swallowing up entirely on all sides (flames / waves / darkness)
groups.nuance_zh: submerge: 完全没入水底或被淹没 (submarine / island / town) · immerse: 浸入液体中、或全身心沉浸其中 (hands / culture / thoughts) · drown: 溺亡或将声音完全淹没盖过 (swimmer / noise / sorrows) · inundate: 洪水漫灌、或事物铺天盖地涌来 (coastal areas / market / complaints) · swamp: 进水沉没、或负荷过度被压垮 (boat / hospital / orders) · engulf: 烈火、巨浪或黑暗完全吞噬 (flames / waves / darkness)

groups.name: Substitute & Replace · 替代与替换 (Replace, Swap, Exchange)
groups.tip: 用新角色或事物取代原有位置

items.def_en: To take the place of something, or put a new thing or person in place of an old one
items.ex_en: The municipal authority plans to replace aging diesel buses with modern electric vehicles.
items.ex_zh: 市政当局计划用现代电动汽车替换老旧的柴油公交车。

items.def_en: To give something to someone and receive something of equal value or type in return
items.ex_en: Scholars from both universities exchange valuable academic findings during the international symposium.
items.ex_zh: 两所大学的学者在国际研讨会期间互换了宝贵的研究成果。

items.def_en: To change from one thing to another, or substitute one item or method for another
items.ex_en: Due to component shortages, the manufacturer switched to an alternate material supplier.
items.ex_zh: 由于零部件短缺，制造商调换了一家备用的材料供应商。
items.ex2_en: The traffic light suddenly switched from red to bright green without advance warning.
items.ex2_zh: 交通信号灯在没有任何预先警示的情况下突然从红灯变成了明亮的绿灯。

items.def_en: 1. (+ for) To use someone or something instead of another. 2. (+ for) To perform a role or task in place of someone else.
items.ex_en: The coach substituted a fast young striker for the exhausted veteran forward.
items.ex_zh: 教练用一名年轻敏捷的前锋替换下了体力耗尽的锋线老将。

items.def_en: (+ for) To do someone's job or duties temporarily while they are away or unable to work
items.ex_en: Can you fill in for Margaret at the front reception desk this afternoon?
items.ex_zh: 今天下午你能替玛格丽特在总接待台临时顶班吗？

items.def_en: To give something and receive something else in exchange, or exchange one position for another
items.ex_en: The two office colleagues agreed to swap their weekend shifts without dispute.
items.ex_zh: 两位办公室同事毫无争议地同意调换各自的周末轮班。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers putting someone or something in place of another, whether by permanent replacement or functional equivalence. Verbs distinguish between symmetrical swapping and unilateral succession.
groups.summary_zh: 表示用一人或一物取代另一人或物，涵盖对调、更替或功能替代。
groups.desc_en: Placing one entity in the position or role previously occupied by another, distinct from adding new items by requiring exchange or displacement of the original.
groups.desc_zh: 以一物置换另一物原有的位置或角色；不同于单纯“添加”，其核心在于前者的离场与后者的填补。
groups.nuance_en: replace: providing a permanent successor or functional surrogate (engine / staff / broken glass) · substitute: putting an inferior, alternate, or temporary stand-in into service (player / butter / ingredient) · exchange: reciprocal mutual swapping of items between parties (goods / ideas / glances) · swap: informally bartering or trading one equivalent for another (seats / shirts / roles) · switch: suddenly altering direction, mode, or current alignment (channels / allegiance / sides) · fill in: temporarily covering another's vacant duties (shifts / colleague / teacher)
groups.nuance_zh: replace: 正式或永久地更替、换新 (engine / staff / broken glass) · substitute: 使用替代品或代班人员 (player / butter / ingredient) · exchange: 双方等价交换或调换 (goods / ideas / glances) · swap: 私下互换对调 (seats / shirts / roles) · switch: 迅速切换、转换方向或立场 (channels / allegiance / sides) · fill in: 临时顶班或填补空缺 (shifts / colleague / teacher)

groups.name: Sudden Forceful Pulling · 猛拉与拽扯 (Yank, Jerk, Wrench)
groups.tip: 施力拖拽或猛然一扯

items.def_en: (+ at/on) To pull something hard or with repeated small, sharp movements
items.ex_en: The frightened little boy tugged desperately at his mother's woolen winter coat.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的小男孩拼命使劲拽着他母亲的羊毛冬大衣。

items.def_en: To move or pull something with a sudden, sharp, quick movement
items.ex_en: She jerked her hand back when the hot kettle touched her bare fingers.
items.ex_zh: 当滚烫的水壶碰到裸露的手指时，她猝然猛缩回了手。
items.ex2_en: The old commuter train jerked forward violently as the engineer engaged the accelerator.
items.ex2_zh: 当机械师踩下油门时，老旧的通勤火车猛地向前震颤启动。

items.def_en: To seize or pull something quickly, roughly, and suddenly
items.ex_en: A masked thief snatched the diamond necklace straight from the display pedestal.
items.ex_zh: 一名蒙面窃贼一把抓起陈列底座上的钻石项链夺路而逃。

items.def_en: To pull, strain, or twist something violently away from its position
items.ex_en: He managed to wrench the rusted crowbar loose from the jammed doorway.
items.ex_zh: 他使劲猛扭，终于将卡在门框上的生锈撬棍扳了下来。

items.def_en: (+ at/on) To pull someone or something with a sudden, forceful, sharp movement.
items.ex_en: Don't yank so hard on the cord or you will damage the connection.
items.ex_zh: 别使劲猛拽那根电线，否则会弄坏接头的。

items.def_en: To tear or yank something away forcefully and roughly
items.ex_en: A sudden gust ripped away the decorative cloth banner from the grandstand.
items.ex_zh: 一阵突如其来的狂风猛力扯下了主席台上的装饰布幅标语。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe abruptly and forcefully pulling or hauling an object or body part with sharp, sudden physical effort. Nuances hinge on whether the action involves a violent twist, a twitchy spasmodic motion, or aggressive dragging.
groups.summary_zh: 强调以突然、剧烈、短促的爆发力猛拉或扯动某物。
groups.desc_en: Applying sudden, sharp tensile force to abruptly displace an object, differing from smooth pulling by the explosive velocity and discontinuous impulse.
groups.desc_zh: 以猝然、强劲的拉力使物体瞬时位移；与平缓的“拖拉”不同，具有爆发性、非连续与剧烈的冲力特征。
groups.nuance_en: yank: pulling abruptly with an unrefined, sharp heave (cord / chain / rug) · jerk: quick, sharp, spasmodic twitching pull (rope / wheel / head) · wrench: twisting and pulling with violent, damaging torque (shoulder / tool / door handle) · tug: pulling repeatedly or straining against resistance in short bursts (sleeve / boat / rope) · snatch: rapidly seizing and pulling away in one swift grab (purse / chance / child) · rip away: tearing something violently free from its moorings (curtains / mask / poster)
groups.nuance_zh: yank: 猛烈、粗暴地一把拽下 (cord / chain / rug) · jerk: 猝然抽动、猛烈一抽 (rope / wheel / head) · wrench: 带旋转扭力地生拉硬拽 (shoulder / tool / door handle) · tug: 用力扯动、断续对抗性地拉 (sleeve / boat / rope) · snatch: 疾速抢夺并拽走 (purse / chance / child) · rip away: 粗暴硬扯、撕扯下来 (curtains / mask / poster)

groups.name: Suit & Befit · 相称与适宜 (Befit, Suit, Become)
groups.tip: 身份地位或场合恰好相称

items.def_zh: 适称，使显得得体（尤指衣饰或举止）
items.def_en: To enhance someone's appearance or look suitable and proper on them
items.ex_en: That dignified emerald dress becomes her far better than any casual modern outfit.
items.ex_zh: 那件端庄的翠绿色礼服衬得她格外优雅，远胜于任何现代休闲装。

items.def_en: To be convenient, acceptable, or aesthetically flattering to someone
items.ex_en: This flexible hybrid schedule will suit working parents with demanding family commitments.
items.ex_zh: 这种弹性的混合工作安排非常适合家庭负担较重的双职工父母。

items.def_zh: 理应，理当（是某人的义务或责任）
items.def_en: To be incumbent upon or right and proper for someone to do something
items.ex_en: It behoves every civic leader to act with absolute transparency and moral fortitude.
items.ex_zh: 每一位市政领袖理应以绝对的透明度与崇高的道德风范行事。

items.def_en: To be suitable, fitting, or appropriate for someone or something
items.ex_en: Such rude insolence does not beseem an honored officer of the royal guard.
items.ex_zh: 如此傲慢无礼的行径殊不适称一名尊贵的皇家卫队军官。

items.def_en: To match, harmonize, or be in natural agreement with a particular plan, system, or environment
items.ex_en: The proposed architectural design fits in with the historical heritage of the district.
items.ex_zh: 所提议的建筑设计方案同该区域的历史文化遗产十分协调。

items.def_en: (formal) To be suitable, proper, or appropriate for someone's status, character, or situation.
items.ex_en: The quiet solemnity of the cathedral befitted the memory of fallen soldiers.
items.ex_zh: 大教堂肃穆静谧的气氛十分契合对阵亡将士的庄严追思。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses relations where an action, dress, or attribute matches the dignity, propriety, role, or practical requirements of a subject. Nuances range from formal decorum and aesthetic flattering to functional compatibility.
groups.summary_zh: 表示在身份、礼仪、美观或功能上相配、得体、适宜。
groups.desc_en: Conforming with propriety, dignity, or contextual harmony, differing from utility fit by emphasizing ethical, aesthetic, or status-derived appropriateness.
groups.desc_zh: 在道德、品位、礼仪或身份地位上与情境保持适宜与和谐；不同于功能上的“契合”，重在社会契合度与得体。
groups.nuance_en: befit: conforming with the elevated dignity, rank, or gravity of a subject (station / office / king) · suit: matching practical requirements, comfort, or flattering appearance (style / schedule / needs) · become: enhancing someone's appearance or harmonizing with personal dignity (demeanor / smile / dress) · beseem: archaic/formal moral fitness or decency (conduct / Christian / nobility) · behove: invoking duty or moral obligation incumbent upon someone (it behoves us / leader / nation) · fit in with: blending harmoniously into existing arrangements or surroundings (plans / culture / decor)
groups.nuance_zh: befit: 与崇高身份、地位或庄严情境相称 (station / office / king) · suit: 适合实际需求或衬托得体 (style / schedule / needs) · become: 容颜与仪表相得益彰 (demeanor / smile / dress) · beseem: 行止合乎道德规范与体统 (conduct / Christian / nobility) · behove: 基于义务有责任应当去做 (it behoves us / leader / nation) · fit in with: 与既有计划或大局相协调 (plans / culture / decor)

groups.name: Surface & Emerge · 浮现与冒出 (Emerge, Crop Up, Crop Out)
groups.tip: 从水底或隐处升出

items.def_en: To rise quickly or buoyantly to the surface of a liquid
items.ex_en: The cork bobbed up to the surface as soon as it was released.
items.ex_zh: 软木塞一松手就立刻浮上了水面。

items.def_en: To appear suddenly and unexpectedly from beneath, behind, or within something
items.ex_en: These error messages keep popping up on my screen.
items.ex_zh: 这些错误提示一直在我的屏幕上弹出来。

items.def_zh: 浮出水面；露头，浮现；醒来
items.def_en: 1. to rise to the surface of water or the ground 2. to suddenly become visible, known, or available after being hidden
items.ex_en: The naval submarine surfaced quietly near the arctic research vessel at twilight.
items.ex_zh: 薄暮时分，海军潜艇在北极科考船附近悄然浮出水面。

items.def_en: To appear or occur suddenly and unexpectedly, especially of problems or mentions
items.ex_en: Several unexpected technical glitches cropped up during the final stage of product testing.
items.ex_zh: 在产品测试的最终阶段，突然出现了一些意料之外的技术故障。

items.def_en: To come out of an enclosed, submerged, or concealed place into open view
items.ex_en: A graceful white heron emerged from the tall reeds into the morning sunshine.
items.ex_zh: 一只优雅的白鹭从高高的芦苇丛中显露身形，步入晨光之中。

items.def_en: To force a way through a physical surface or barrier into visibility
items.ex_en: Tender green sprouts broke through the frozen soil as the spring thaw arrived.
items.ex_zh: 春回大地冰雪消融，嫩绿的新芽冲破了坚硬的冻土。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses entities moving upwards from below a liquid or subterranean barrier into visibility, or issues, facts, and emotions unexpectedly reappearing or breaking into awareness.
groups.summary_zh: 指从水下或地底升至表面，或引申为隐匿之物突然显现或浮出水面。
groups.desc_en: Transitioning from concealment or lower levels into open visibility, differing from static presence by tracking an unfolding threshold crossing.
groups.desc_zh: 从水下、掩盖中或微末状态破水而出、进入显露视野；区别于静止的显露，重在突破界限的动态过程。
groups.nuance_en: surface: rising to the top of liquid or reappearing after concealment (submarine / whale / scandals) · emerge: gradually coming out from shadows, obscurity, or difficulty into view (leader / details / species) · pop up: appearing abruptly, unpredictably, or lightheartedly (advertisement / notifications / names) · crop up: appearing unexpectedly and often unhelpfully in discourse or work (problems / errors / questions) · bob up: floating buoyantly to the surface with intermittent vertical motion (cork / head / floats) · break through: decisively piercing a physical or figurative barrier into the open (clouds / lines / dawn)
groups.nuance_zh: surface: 浮出水面或隐伏多时后公开 (submarine / whale / scandals) · emerge: 从隐匿或幽暗中显现、崭露头角 (leader / details / species) · pop up: 突然蹦出或弹现 (advertisement / notifications / names) · crop up: 突如其来地冒出（问题、差错） (problems / errors / questions) · bob up: 浮浮沉沉地晃动出水 (cork / head / floats) · break through: 突破云层或屏障脱颖而出 (clouds / lines / dawn)

groups.name: Surface Discoloration & Patching · 斑驳与杂色 (Mottle, Fleck, Dapple)
groups.tip: 表面形成杂色与斑驳印记

items.def_en: To cover a surface with many small dots, marks, or color variations
items.ex_en: Dark brown freckles speckle her fair cheeks after days in the bright sun.
items.ex_zh: 烈日下暴晒数日后，深褐色的雀斑点缀了她白皙的面颊。

items.def_en: To mark or dot something with small spots, specks, or particles
items.ex_en: White foam flecks the dark churning ocean waves during the violent storm.
items.ex_zh: 暴风雨中，白色泡沫星点散布在汹涌翻腾的墨色海浪上。

items.def_en: (usually passive) to mark a surface with irregular spots or patches of different colors
items.ex_en: The forest floor was mottled with delicate patterns of shifting autumn sunlight.
items.ex_zh: 变幻不定的秋日阳光在林间地面上映照出斑驳陆离的斑纹。

items.def_en: To mark or shade a surface with rounded spots or patches of light and shadow
items.ex_en: Filtering canopy leaves dapple the cobblestone path with soft patches of gentle light.
items.ex_zh: 树冠间漏下的光线在鹅卵石小径上洒下了斑驳柔和的明暗光影。

items.def_en: To spot, stain, or obscure a surface with dark liquid marks
items.ex_en: Black printer ink blotted the crisp linen paper, ruining the legal contract.
items.ex_zh: 黑色打印油墨涂污了平整的亚麻纸，毁掉了这份法律合同。

items.def_en: To diversify the color or visual pattern of something with different tints and streaks
items.ex_en: Skillful gardeners variegate the flower beds with alternating bands of scarlet and violet.
items.ex_zh: 技术娴熟的花匠用绯红与紫罗兰相间的条带，使花坛呈现出斑斓杂色。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers processes that mark surfaces with uneven patches, blots, or speckles of distinct colors or shades.
groups.summary_zh: 指在表面形成不规则色斑、点渍或明暗相杂的视觉肌理。
groups.desc_en: Marking a surface with irregular, dispersed spots or patches of contrasting color or light, distinct from uniform coating or intentional drawing.
groups.desc_zh: 在表面形成不规则、分散的杂色斑点或光影块，区别于均匀涂抹或刻意描画。
groups.nuance_en: speckle: scatter with tiny distinct spots (eggshell / granite / trout) · fleck: mark with small streaks or particles (paint / foam / gold) · mottle: cover with irregular blotches or marbling (skin / leaves / stone) · dapple: shade with shifting spots of light and shadow (sunlight / horse / shade) · variegate: diversify with varied colors or patterns (foliage / yarn / leaves)
groups.nuance_zh: speckle: 散布细小明显的斑点 (eggshell / granite / trout) · fleck: 带有细微微粒或斑痕 (paint / foam / gold) · mottle: 形成不规则大块斑驳杂色 (skin / leaves / stone) · dapple: 形成晃动的光影斑驳 (sunlight / horse / shade) · variegate: 呈现多色相间条纹或斑纹 (foliage / yarn / leaves)

groups.name: Surpass & Outperform · 胜过与超越 (Surpass, Outdo, Eclipse)
groups.tip: 在绩效表现上彻底超越对手

items.def_en: To be more successful, creative, or effective than someone else
items.ex_en: Determined to win, the ambitious young chef tried to outdo his former mentor.
items.ex_zh: 这位雄心勃勃的年轻厨师决心取胜，竭力超越他昔日的恩师。

items.def_en: To exceed someone or something in quality, quantity, degree, or achievement
items.ex_en: This season's corporate profits surpass all financial expectations projected by economic analysts.
items.ex_zh: 本季度的企业利润超越了经济分析师所预测的所有财务预期。

items.def_en: To achieve better results, productivity, or financial performance than someone or something else.
items.ex_en: Our tech startup managed to outperform established competitors throughout the fourth fiscal quarter.
items.ex_zh: 我们这家初创科技公司在整个第四财季的表现均优于老牌竞争对手。

items.def_en: To become larger, faster, or greater in amount or degree than a rival or benchmark
items.ex_en: Global demand for clean energy is expected to outstrip domestic supply within two decades.
items.ex_zh: 全球对清洁能源的需求预计将在二十年内超过国内供应量。

items.def_en: To be much more impressive or successful than someone else in a shared setting
items.ex_en: The young soprano managed to outshine all other performers during the gala concert.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻的女高音歌唱家在庆典音乐会上力压群芳，表现格外亮眼。

items.def_en: To become much more important, popular, or successful than another, making them insignificant
items.ex_en: Her groundbreaking scientific discovery threatened to eclipse the achievements of her former mentors.
items.ex_zh: 她这项开创性的科学发现令她昔日导师们的成就相形见绌。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate exceeding another entity in skill, performance, quality, speed, or market achievement.
groups.summary_zh: 指在能力、成果、业绩或表现上全面超越他人。
groups.desc_en: Exceeding another entity in performance, quality, or extent, distinct from merely preceding or winning a fixed contest.
groups.desc_zh: 在表现、质量或规模上超越另一实体，区别于单纯的时间在先或在固定规则比赛中获胜。
groups.nuance_en: surpass: broadly exceed expectations or standards (expectations / limits / rivals) · outdo: exceed someone in competitive effort or achievement (competitors / rivals / predecessors) · outperform: deliver superior functional or financial results (market / peers / engine) · outstrip: outrun or exceed quantitatively (demand / supply / growth) · eclipse: completely overshadow and diminish the importance of another (fame / legacy / achievements)
groups.nuance_zh: surpass: 广泛超越预期或标准 (expectations / limits / rivals) · outdo: 在竞争中比…更胜一筹 (competitors / rivals / predecessors) · outperform: 在效能或业绩上表现更优 (market / peers / engine) · outstrip: 在速度或数量增长上甩开 (demand / supply / growth) · eclipse: 掩盖光芒使之相形见绌 (fame / legacy / achievements)

groups.name: Surrender & Yield · 屈从与屈服 (Give In, Yield, Capitulate, Cede)
groups.tip: 在重压或诱惑下放弃抵抗

items.def_en: (+ to) to give way to pressure, superiority, or strong influence
items.ex_en: The stubborn diplomat refused to yield to foreign threats during the tense negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 在紧张的谈判期间，这位固执的外交官拒绝向外国威胁屈服。

items.def_en: (+ to) to stop resisting an argument, demand, or temptation after a struggle
items.ex_en: After hours of constant begging, my mother finally gave in to my plea.
items.ex_zh: 在连续央求了几个小时后，母亲终于向我的恳求妥协了。

items.def_en: (+ to) to submit reluctantly to the authority or harsh demands of someone else
items.ex_en: The union workers refused to knuckle under to the harsh demands of management.
items.ex_zh: 工会工人们拒绝向管理层提出的苛刻要求低头认输。

items.def_en: (+ to) to collapse mentally or politically and give in completely to immense pressure
items.ex_en: The prime minister finally caved in to intense political pressure from the opposition.
items.ex_zh: 首相最终在来自反对党的巨大政治压力面前彻底妥协。

items.def_en: (+ to) 1. to stop resisting a temptation, pressure, or disease and give in. 2. to die from an illness or injury.
items.ex_en: The fragile monarch eventually succumbed to a lethal viral infection after several weeks.
items.ex_zh: 几周后，这位虚弱的君主最终因致命的病毒感染而不幸离世。

items.def_en: (+ to) to surrender or cease resisting an opponent or demanding pressure completely
items.ex_en: The surrounded garrison was forced to capitulate to the advancing forces at dawn.
items.ex_zh: 被重重围困的守军被迫在黎明时分向挺进的敌军投降。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote ceasing resistance against an overpowering force, temptation, sickness, or ultimatum and accepting defeat.
groups.summary_zh: 指不再抗拒外界压力、诱惑或疾病，妥协或彻底认输。
groups.desc_en: Relinquishing resistance or control to an opposing force or authority, distinct from mutual compromise or tactical retreat.
groups.desc_zh: 向敌对力量或外部权威放弃抵抗与控制权，区别于平等的相互妥协或战术性撤退。
groups.nuance_en: yield: give way under physical pressure or authority (ground / temptation / pressure) · give in: cease resistance after prolonged insistence (demands / pressure / tears) · cave in: abruptly collapse under extreme pressure (demands / opposition / threats) · succumb: be overcome by disease, temptation, or fatal force (illness / temptation / injuries) · capitulate: formally cease resistance on specified terms (army / government / demands)
groups.nuance_zh: yield: 在外力或权威施压下顺从让步 (ground / temptation / pressure) · give in: 在持久僵持后放弃坚持 (demands / pressure / tears) · cave in: 在重压下全线崩溃妥协 (demands / opposition / threats) · succumb: 最终被疾病、诱惑或致命力量压垮 (illness / temptation / injuries) · capitulate: 签订协议或按条件正式投降 (army / government / demands)

groups.name: Surround & Besiege · 包围与围困 (Mob, Besiege, Swarm)
groups.tip: 群体围拢或围困受压

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To move from disparate directions toward the same target to surround it
items.ex_en: Hundreds of impassioned demonstrators began to converge on the historic government plaza today.
items.ex_zh: 数百名慷慨激昂的示威者今天开始从四面八方聚集包围历史悠久的政府广场。

items.def_en: To drive someone into a tight spot where escape is impossible, preventing them from slipping away
items.ex_en: Two alert police officers managed to corner the fleeing suspect in an alleyway.
items.ex_zh: 两名警惕的警员成功将逃跑的嫌疑人逼入了一条死胡同中。

items.def_zh: 蜂拥团团围住，大举包围
items.def_en: To crowd around someone or something in a large, noisy, and disorderly group.
items.ex_en: Eager movie fans rushed forward to mob the famous actor outside the theater.
items.ex_zh: 热切的影迷们蜂拥而上，在剧院外将这位著名演员团团围住。

items.def_en: (+ around/over) To move around or congregate closely over someone or somewhere in large, bustling numbers
items.ex_en: Dozens of curious journalists swarmed around the defense attorney after the dramatic verdict.
items.ex_zh: 宣判结果出人意料之后，数十名好奇的记者成群包围了辩护律师。

items.def_en: To pursue relentlessly, harass, or crowd around someone without giving them rest
items.ex_en: Aggressive paparazzi continued to hound the pop star throughout her entire European vacation.
items.ex_zh: 在整个欧洲度假期间，咄咄逼人的狗仔队一直在对这位流行歌星进行纠缠骚扰。

items.def_zh: 围困；成群包围（要求回应）
items.def_en: To crowd around someone aggressively with requests or surround a place with forces
items.ex_en: Angry constituents continue to besiege the representative's office with demands for immediate resignation.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的选民继续围堵在众议员办公室外，强烈要求其立即辞职。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate swarming or pressing tightly around a person or place in a disorderly, frantic, or hostile mass, restricting movement or creating extreme overwhelming pressure.
groups.summary_zh: 群体喧闹无序或敌意聚集，蜂拥紧围目标以制造压迫感。
groups.desc_en: Enclosing or harassing an entity tightly from multiple directions to trap or coerce it, distinct from peaceful gathering or distant monitoring.
groups.desc_zh: 从多个方向紧密合围或骚扰目标以使其受困或受压迫，区别于和平聚集或远距离监控。
groups.nuance_en: converge: move inward from various directions toward one focal point (crowds / forces / opinions) · corner: drive into an inescapable situation or physical angle (suspect / prey / market) · mob: crowd around disorderly and aggressively (celebrity / referee / player) · swarm: mass and move around rapidly in large numbers (bees / tourists / protesters) · besiege: surround with military force or overwhelm with demands (city / fortress / questions)
groups.nuance_zh: converge: 从四面八方向一点汇聚 (crowds / forces / opinions) · corner: 逼入无法逃脱的角落或绝境 (suspect / prey / market) · mob: 杂乱且具侵略性地围堵 (celebrity / referee / player) · swarm: 像蜂群般成群涌动包围 (bees / tourists / protesters) · besiege: 军事围困或以要求/问题围攻 (city / fortress / questions)

groups.name: Surround & Flank · 包围与侧翼围绕 (Flank, Border, Hem in)
groups.tip: 从四周或两侧分布环抱

items.def_en: To form an edge or boundary along the periphery of something
items.ex_en: Rows of tall cypress trees gracefully border the winding driveway of the estate.
items.ex_zh: 一排排高大的柏树优雅地沿庄园蜿蜒的车道边缘延伸。

items.def_en: To accompany someone or something laterally or closely to offer protection, honor, or guidance
items.ex_en: Two armed naval vessels will escort the civilian freighter through the contested waters.
items.ex_zh: 两艘全副武装的军舰将护送这艘民用货轮穿过争议水域。

items.def_en: To lie along, travel along, or form the outer edge or border of an area
items.ex_en: The rugged hiking trail skirts the outer rim of the massive volcanic crater.
items.ex_zh: 这条崎岖的徒步小径沿着巨大的火山口外缘延伸。

items.def_en: (often passive, 'be fringed with') To form a narrow border or surrounding margin along the edge of something
items.ex_en: The tranquil mountain valley was fringed with majestic pine trees covered in snow.
items.ex_zh: 宁静的山谷边缘环绕着一棵棵白雪覆盖的雄伟松树。

items.def_zh: 位于……的两侧（或侧翼），侧翼包围
items.def_en: (often passive, 'be flanked by') To be situated at the side or sides of someone or something.
items.ex_en: The visiting prime minister was flanked by armed security guards during the speech.
items.ex_zh: 来访的首相在演讲期间两侧站立着全副武装的保镖。

items.def_en: To surround someone or something tightly from multiple sides, restricting lateral movement
items.ex_en: Thick rows of riot police moved swiftly to hem in the unruly protesters.
items.ex_zh: 密集的防暴警察队伍迅速推进，将骚乱的抗议者紧紧包围。

groups.summary_en: This frame relates to spatial positioning along the lateral sides, margins, or boundaries of a person, parade, or landscape, often forming an escort or physical perimeter.
groups.summary_zh: 位于主体两侧或周边边界，形成翼侧护卫、衬托或围护。
groups.desc_en: Positioning along the perimeter, edges, or sides of an entity to frame, accompany, or confine it, distinct from aggressive total encirclement.
groups.desc_zh: 沿实体边缘、侧翼或边界排列以衬托、护卫或限制其范围，区别于侵略性的全封闭式围困。
groups.nuance_en: flank: occupy a position at the left or right side of (general / building / entrance) · border: form or run along an edge of a territory or area (country / river / property) · fringe: form a decorative or natural margin around (meadow / coast / hair) · skirt: move along or lie along the edge to avoid the center (city / issue / boundary) · hem in: confine closely within narrow physical or metaphorical limits (troops / choices / growth)
groups.nuance_zh: flank: 位于目标的两侧或侧翼 (general / building / entrance) · border: 形成或沿边界展开 (country / river / property) · fringe: 沿外沿形成边缘或须边 (meadow / coast / hair) · skirt: 绕过边缘或回避核心 (city / issue / boundary) · hem in: 紧紧圈限或阻碍自由动弹 (troops / choices / growth)

groups.name: Survey & Probe · 探测与勘测 (Sound, Gauge, Fathom)
groups.tip: 测量深浅探寻未明深处

items.def_en: To measure the depth of water using a weighted line or sonar, or figuratively investigate someone's intentions
items.ex_en: The seasoned diplomat sought to sound the foreign minister regarding a possible treaty.
items.ex_zh: 这位经验丰富的外交官试图探询该国外交部长对可能签署条约的态度。
items.ex2_en: A soft chime sounded throughout the quiet corridors to indicate visiting hours ended.
items.ex2_zh: 柔和的钟声在安静的走廊中响起，提示探视时间已经结束。

items.def_en: To examine and record the physical features, contours, or boundaries of an area of land
items.ex_en: Civil engineers were hired to survey the rugged terrain before constructing the highway.
items.ex_zh: 在修建公路之前，土木工程师们受雇对这片崎岖的地形进行勘测。

items.def_en: To elicit opinions or probe someone's intentions discreetly and indirectly
items.ex_en: The manager quietly sounded out a few team members before unveiling the restructuring plan.
items.ex_zh: 经理在公布重组方案之前，私下试探了几名团队成员的口风。

items.def_en: To measure an exact dimension or depth, or to make an informed judgment about a situation
items.ex_en: The company conducted several consumer interviews to gauge public reaction to the product.
items.ex_zh: 公司进行了数次消费者访谈，以评估公众对该产品的反应。

items.def_zh: 探测，测量（水深等）；钻研，探究（奥秘等）；给……装管道设施
items.def_en: 1. To measure the depth of water, especially with a plumb line. 2. To probe or explore something thoroughly ('plumb the depths'). 3. To install plumbing pipes in a building.
items.ex_en: The philosopher devoted his life to plumb the profound mysteries of human consciousness.
items.ex_zh: 这位哲学家毕生致力于深入探究人类意识的深邃奥秘。

items.def_en: To measure the depth of water, or to probe deeply enough to understand an elusive truth
items.ex_en: Sailors lowered heavy weighted lines into the dark ocean to fathom its depth.
items.ex_zh: 水手们将沉重的铅垂线沉入漆黑的大海，以测量其深度。

groups.summary_en: Covers technical, dimensional, or figurative assessment of depth, extent, or underlying conditions. 'Plumb' entails measuring depth or penetrating hidden depths, 'sound' involves measuring water depth or checking attitudes, and 'gauge' evaluates dimension and intent.
groups.summary_zh: 指测量深度、勘查状况或试探性评估真实程度。
groups.desc_en: Investigating depth, intent, or quantitative extent by systematic measurement or indirect inquiry, distinct from surface observation.
groups.desc_zh: 通过系统测量或间接探听来探测深度、意图或数值大小，区别于表层的肉眼观察。
groups.nuance_en: sound: measure physical depth by line or echo (depths / water / ocean floor) · sound out: discreetly elicit someone's opinions or intentions (allies / voters / intentions) · gauge: systematically measure or evaluate a quantifiable metric (mood / distance / speed) · plumb: measure vertical depth or examine deeply (depths / mysteries / soul) · fathom: fully penetrate the meaning or depth of something perplexing (mystery / motive / reason)
groups.nuance_zh: sound: 用铅锤或声波测水深 (depths / water / ocean floor) · sound out: 试探性地探听他人态度或意图 (allies / voters / intentions) · gauge: 系统评估或测定参数 (mood / distance / speed) · plumb: 垂直测深或彻底探究 (depths / mysteries / soul) · fathom: 彻底看穿或洞悉令人困惑的事物 (mystery / motive / reason)

groups.name: Suture & Stitch · 伤口缝合与闭合 (Stitch, Close up, Resuture)
groups.tip: 穿针引线缝合创口或织物

items.def_en: To complete a surgical operation by bringing the incisions back together and sewing them
items.ex_en: The surgeon worked quickly and carefully to close up the abdominal incision properly.
items.ex_zh: 外科医生迅速且细致地操作，将腹部切口妥善闭合。
items.ex2_en: The deep surgical cut closed up cleanly after seven days of proper care.
items.ex2_zh: 经过七天的精心护理，深层的手术切口干干净净地愈合闭合了。

items.def_en: To tie off a blood vessel, duct, or surgical tissue tightly with a thread or wire
items.ex_en: The surgeon used sterile silk to ligate the severed artery during the procedure.
items.ex_zh: 手术过程中，外科医生使用无菌丝线将断裂的动脉结扎。

items.def_en: To stitch a wound or surgical opening together again after stitches have failed
items.ex_en: The medical team had to resuture the patient's wound after the initial stitches tore.
items.ex_zh: 在最初的缝线崩开后，医疗团队不得不为患者重新缝合伤口。

items.def_en: To join the edges of a cut or wound together using a needle and surgical thread
items.ex_en: The attending physician had to stitch the deep laceration on the boy's forehead.
items.ex_zh: 主治医生不得不缝合小男孩前额上那道很深的撕裂伤。

items.def_en: To close surgical incisions or severed tissue using specialized medical staples
items.ex_en: The surgical team used medical equipment to staple the lengthy incision shut cleanly.
items.ex_zh: 手术团队使用医疗器械将狭长的切口利落地用缝合钉封合。

items.def_en: 1. (surgery) To stitch up a deep wound or surgical cut using medical thread.
items.ex_en: The doctor carefully prepared the needle to suture the wide gash across his forearm.
items.ex_zh: 医生仔细备好缝合针，以缝合他前臂上那道很宽的伤口。

groups.summary_en: This clinical and trauma frame focuses on medically approximating wound margins or tissue layers using surgical needles, thread, or staples to promote sterile healing.
groups.summary_zh: 医学场景中利用针线、缝线或缝合钉对创口边缘进行严密缝合与闭合。
groups.desc_en: Reapproximating and securing separated living tissue to promote healing, distinct from general sewing or non-biological joining.
groups.desc_zh: 缝合、对合并固定分离的活体组织以促进创口愈合，区别于普通的缝纫或非生物材料连接。
groups.nuance_en: suture: formally join tissue using surgical thread (wound / artery / laceration) · stitch: quickly sew closed a cut using needle and thread (cut / tear / wound) · close up: bring edges together to seal an opening (incision / wound / tissue) · ligate: bind or tie off a blood vessel to prevent bleeding (vessel / artery / duct) · staple: rapidly fasten tissue edges with medical staples (incision / bowel / scalp)
groups.nuance_zh: suture: 用外科缝合线规范对合组织 (wound / artery / laceration) · stitch: 用针线对伤口进行普通缝合 (cut / tear / wound) · close up: 使伤口边缘对拢闭合 (incision / wound / tissue) · ligate: 结扎血管或导管以止血或阻断 (vessel / artery / duct) · staple: 用医用吻合钉快速钉合创口 (incision / bowel / scalp)

groups.name: Swallowing & Ingestion Manner · 吞咽与痛饮 (Gulp, Quaff, Chug)
groups.tip: 大口咕咚咽下食物或液体

items.def_zh: 吞下，咽下；吞没，耗尽；轻信；忍受，抑制
items.def_en: 1. To cause food, drink, or an object to move down the throat into the stomach. 2. To take in, engulf, or completely use up. 3. To accept or believe something uncritically; to suppress a feeling.
items.ex_en: She had to swallow a large glass of warm water before taking the medication.
items.ex_zh: 服药前，她不得不吞下一大杯温水。

items.def_en: Quickly drink an alcoholic beverage by tilting the head backward
items.ex_en: He decided to toss back two shots of tequila before joining the dance floor.
items.ex_zh: 在步入舞池之前，他决定先仰头一饮而尽两杯龙舌兰酒。

items.def_en: Drink or swallow something completely, usually in one single effort
items.ex_en: After running five miles in the heat, he downed an entire bottle of water.
items.ex_zh: 在酷热中跑了五英里后，他一口气喝下了一整瓶水。

items.def_en: Drink a beverage, especially an alcoholic one, heartily and in copious quantities
items.ex_en: The cheerful guests continued to quaff sparkling wine late into the festive night.
items.ex_zh: 欢快的宾客们在节日夜晚开怀畅饮起泡酒，直到深夜。

items.def_en: Swallow food or drink quickly and greedily, often producing an audible sound
items.ex_en: Thirsty from the hike, he began to gulp the cold spring water greedily.
items.ex_zh: 徒步走得口干舌燥的他，开始大口大口地猛灌清凉的泉水。

items.def_en: Drink an entire container of liquid without pausing or taking a breath
items.ex_en: His college friends dared him to chug the entire pitcher of iced soda.
items.ex_zh: 大学好友们起哄挑战他，让他一口气狂饮整整一壶冰镇汽水。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses the physiological and behavioral manners of ingesting liquids or food down the esophagus, highlighting contrasts in speed, greed, volume, and audible effort.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖吞咽液体或食物的不同方式，体现大口狼吞、豪饮或艰难吞服。
groups.desc_en: Passing liquids or food from the mouth down the throat with specific pace, volume, or relish, distinct from plain chewing or slow tasting.
groups.desc_zh: 以特定的节奏、体量或豪迈劲头将液体或食物经咽喉吞入，区别于缓慢咀嚼或细致品味。
groups.nuance_en: swallow: perform the basic muscular act of passing food/drink down the throat (pill / food / water) · gulp: swallow large mouthfuls greedily or hastily (air / coffee / beer) · quaff: drink a hearty or alcoholic beverage with genuine relish (ale / wine / brew) · chug: rapidly swallow a drink without pausing for breath (beer / pint / bottle) · down: consume a quantity of drink or food in one continuous motion (shot / glass / drink)
groups.nuance_zh: swallow: 执行基础吞咽肌运动 (pill / food / water) · gulp: 狼吞虎咽或大口急咽 (air / coffee / beer) · quaff: 畅快大口享用饮品/酒水 (ale / wine / brew) · chug: 一口气不间断地狂饮 (beer / pint / bottle) · down: 一饮而尽或一气吞下 (shot / glass / drink)

groups.name: Swim & Dive · 游泳与潜水 (Swim, Dive, Plunge)
groups.tip: 水面游弋或下潜水中

items.def_en: To propel oneself through water using limbs or fins
items.ex_en: Every morning, the retired athlete would swim across the wide lake for exercise.
items.ex_zh: 每天早晨，这位退役运动员都会游过宽阔的湖泊进行锻炼。

items.def_en: (+ into/beneath) To plunge headfirst into water or swim deep underwater using equipment
items.ex_en: The daring boy leaned forward and decided to dive headfirst into the chilly water.
items.ex_zh: 那个勇敢的男孩身体前倾，决定一头扎进冰冷的水中。

items.def_en: To keep oneself upright and floating in deep water by moving the legs and arms
items.ex_en: The exhausted swimmer was forced to tread water while awaiting the arrival of rescuers.
items.ex_zh: 筋疲力尽的游泳者不得不踩水漂浮，等待救援人员的到来。

items.def_en: (+ into) To jump, dive, or fall steeply and forcefully into water
items.ex_en: On a sweltering afternoon, the laughing children would plunge into the cold river.
items.ex_zh: 在闷热的午后，笑逐颜开的孩子们会猛然扎入冰凉的河水中。
items.ex2_en: The angry chef plunged the dirty butcher knife into the wooden chopping board.
items.ex2_zh: 愤怒的主厨把脏兮兮的砍肉刀狠狠刺进了木制砧板中。

items.def_en: To wade in shallow water or propel oneself with short splashing arm movements
items.ex_en: The happy toddlers loved to paddle along the shallow edge of the sandy beach.
items.ex_zh: 快乐的蹒跚学步幼童们喜欢在沙滩边的浅水区戏水涉游。

items.def_zh: 浮潜，使用水下呼吸管游泳
items.def_en: To swim near the surface of the water while breathing through a tube called a snorkel.
items.ex_en: Tourists love to snorkel along the shallow coral reefs to observe exotic marine life.
items.ex_zh: 游客们喜欢在浅水珊瑚礁一带浮潜，观赏奇异的海洋生物。

groups.summary_en: Covers intentional human locomotion through or immersion beneath water, ranging from surface leisure to deep underwater exploration.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖人在水中推进或深潜水下的运动行为与技能动作。
groups.desc_en: Propelling the body through, or immersing it suddenly into, water using deliberate movements, distinct from passive floating or marine transit.
groups.desc_zh: 依靠身体动作在水中推进或骤然没入水中，区别于被动漂浮或借助舟楫航行。
groups.nuance_en: swim: propel oneself horizontally through water (laps / river / ocean) · dive: enter headfirst into water from a height or descend underwater (pool / reef / wreck) · plunge: cast oneself or drop suddenly into deep water (ocean / icy water / pool) · tread water: keep head above water while staying upright in place (surface / pool / deep water) · paddle: move through shallow water with short, quick strokes of feet or hands (stream / shallows / edge)
groups.nuance_zh: swim: 依靠自身在水中水平游动 (laps / river / ocean) · dive: 头朝下跳水或潜入水底深处 (pool / reef / wreck) · plunge: 猛烈扑入或扎入深水中 (ocean / icy water / pool) · tread water: 直立踩水以维持头部露出水面 (surface / pool / deep water) · paddle: 在浅水中轻拍涉水划行 (stream / shallows / edge)

groups.name: Symbolize & Represent · 象征与代表 (Signify, Stand For, Typify)
groups.tip: 作为意象或代表来指代事物

items.def_en: To be a sign, symbol, or picture of something; to designate an abstract quality or reality.
items.ex_en: These simple colorful diagrams represent complex biochemical processes within the human body.
items.ex_zh: 这些色彩鲜艳的简单图表代表着人体内复杂的生化过程。

items.def_en: To represent a word, acronym, idea, belief, or principle as a recognized sign.
items.ex_en: The school management will not stand for any form of bullying on campus.
items.ex_zh: 学校管理层绝不容忍校园内出现任何形式的霸凌行为。

items.def_en: To represent a quality, idea, or feeling in a tangible, clear, or bodily form.
items.ex_en: Her dedicated community service continues to embody the true spirit of selflessness and compassion.
items.ex_zh: 她全心全意的社区服务体现了无私与同情的真正精神。

items.def_en: To be a sign of something; to convey an explicit or implicit meaning.
items.ex_en: Dark gathering clouds in the eastern sky often signify an impending tropical storm.
items.ex_zh: 东方天空中聚集的乌云通常预示着一场热带风暴即将来临。

items.def_en: To represent or be a symbol of something, such as an idea or quality.
items.ex_en: The pristine white dove is widely used to symbolize peace and universal harmony.
items.ex_zh: 洁白无瑕的鸽子被广泛用来象征和平与普世和谐。

items.def_en: To be an archetype or characteristic example of a particular group, style, or quality.
items.ex_en: Her historic victory would typify the remarkable rise of female leadership in politics.
items.ex_zh: 她的历史性胜利堪称女性领导力在政坛异军突起的典型代表。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate that an object, mark, or concept acts as a visible or cultural sign for another, often abstract meaning. 'Symbolize' focuses on allegorical or figurative representation, whereas 'signify' emphasizes linguistic meaning and 'embody' stresses tangible manifestation.
groups.summary_zh: 指事物或符号作为代表、代号或具象化化身体现抽象内涵。
groups.desc_en: Serving as an overt sign, token, or concrete manifestation of an abstract quality or collective entity, distinct from directly causing or being the thing itself.
groups.desc_zh: 充当抽象概念或集体实体的外在记号、象征或具象化化身，区别于直接导致或其本身。
groups.nuance_en: represent: officially stand in place of someone or portray a concept (constituents / ideal / faction) · symbolize: serve as an indirect metaphorical sign of a deeper meaning (peace / freedom / purity) · embody: express an abstract quality in a tangible, living form (spirit / virtues / ideals) · signify: convey an explicit conventional meaning or imply a consequence (change / consent / arrival) · typify: serve as a quintessential characteristic example of a category (style / era / genre)
groups.nuance_zh: represent: 代言、代表某群体或指代概念 (constituents / ideal / faction) · symbolize: 作为深层涵义的象征标记 (peace / freedom / purity) · embody: 具象化体现抽象精神或品质 (spirit / virtues / ideals) · signify: 预示、具有特定含义或表明 (change / consent / arrival) · typify: 作为…的典型代表或范例 (style / era / genre)

groups.name: Tackle & Wrest · 扑倒与扭倒 (Tackle, Grapple, Bring down)
groups.tip: 用身体扑倒并按倒压制

items.def_en: To cause someone running or charging to fall to the ground
items.ex_en: Two linebackers worked together to bring down the charging runner near the goal line.
items.ex_zh: 两名中后卫合力在球门线附近扑倒了猛冲的持球进攻球员。

items.def_en: To engage in a close fight or struggle without weapons, wrestling hand to hand
items.ex_en: The two determined wrestlers began to grapple fiercely on the center of the mat.
items.ex_zh: 两位坚决的摔跤手开始在垫子中央展开激烈的肉搏扭打。

items.def_en: To press someone down against a surface so firmly that they cannot move
items.ex_en: The police officer managed to pin down the aggressive suspect onto the concrete pavement.
items.ex_zh: 警官设法将那名极具攻击性的嫌疑人牢牢按倒在水泥地面上制服。

items.def_en: To force someone or an animal to the ground by physical grappling and wrestling
items.ex_en: The experienced rancher had to wrestle down the rogue bull in the dusty corral.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的农场主不得不在这座尘土飞扬的畜栏里扭倒制服那头不受管束的公牛。
