items.def_en: To seize and throw or force someone down to the ground
items.ex_en: The agile safety lunged forward to tackle the speeding receiver around the waist.
items.ex_zh: 那名敏捷的安全卫猛冲上前，一把抱住高速奔跑的外接手腰部将其扑倒。

items.def_zh: （摔跤中抓住牛角并扭脖子）摔倒（牛）；扑倒
items.def_en: (North American rodeo) To wrestle a steer to the ground by gripping its horns and twisting its neck.
items.ex_en: The daring young cowboy leaped from his horse to bulldog the charging steer.
items.ex_zh: 那名胆识过人的年轻牛仔纵身跳下马背，一把扭住奔跑的公牛将其按倒在地。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on forceful physical maneuvers to seize, grapple, and wrestle a person or animal to the ground through bodily leverage or violent impact.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过身体扭打、擒抱或猛扑将人或动物制服扑倒在地。
groups.desc_en: Physically seizing and forcing an opposing body to the ground using leverage and momentum, distinct from striking with fists or restraining from afar.
groups.desc_zh: 利用杠杆力和自身动能强行将对手缠抱并压倒在地，区别于挥拳打击或远距离控制。
groups.nuance_en: tackle: seize and knock someone to the ground in motion (runner / ball-carrier / suspect) · grapple: engage in close-quarters wrestling struggle without clear control (opponent / assailant / rival) · wrestle down: force someone to the floor by prolonged physical exertion (attacker / intruder / beast) · pin down: hold someone firmly against a surface so they cannot move (suspect / arms / opponent) · bulldog: throw an animal by seizing its horns and twisting its neck (steer / calf / beast)
groups.nuance_zh: tackle: 截击扑倒正在移动的目标 (runner / ball-carrier / suspect) · grapple: 与对手近身扭打扭成一团 (opponent / assailant / rival) · wrestle down: 经过持续肉搏将其摔翻在地 (attacker / intruder / beast) · pin down: 将对方牢牢按压在平面使其动弹不得 (suspect / arms / opponent) · bulldog: 抱角扭颈扑倒牲畜 (steer / calf / beast)

groups.name: Taint & Defile · 玷污与败坏 (Besmirch, Tarnish, Blemish)
groups.tip: 沾染污迹或损毁纯洁

items.def_en: To spoil or contaminate the moral quality, good name, or purity of something
items.ex_en: The ongoing corruption scandal threatened to taint the pristine reputation of the university.
items.ex_zh: 持续发酵的腐败丑闻恐将玷污这所大学原本文雅清白的声誉。

items.def_en: To make someone or something seem less good, respected, or pure
items.ex_en: Careless personal behavior could easily tarnish a public figure's hard-won professional image.
items.ex_zh: 轻率的个人行为很容易玷污公众人物来之不易的职业形象。
items.ex2_en: Polished silver forks tarnish gradually when exposed to ambient moisture and airborne sulfur.
items.ex2_zh: 抛光的银叉暴露在环境湿气和空气中的硫化物下会逐渐失去光泽。

items.def_en: 1. (formal) To damage or spoil the purity, integrity, or reputation of someone or something; to defile or make dirty.
items.ex_en: The traitor's shameful actions would sully the proud honor of the noble family.
items.ex_zh: 叛徒的可耻行径必将玷污这个高贵家族引以为傲的声誉。

items.def_en: To spoil the flawless appearance, reputation, or perfection of something
items.ex_en: A single careless administrative error managed to blemish her otherwise flawless career record.
items.ex_zh: 一次疏忽的行政失误在她原本无可挑剔的职业生涯记录上留下了污点。

items.def_en: To desecrate or ruin something considered holy, clean, or pure
items.ex_en: The invading barbarians entered the temple, threatening to defile the ancient sacred altar.
items.ex_zh: 入侵的野蛮人闯入神庙，扬言要亵渎这座古老神圣的祭坛。

items.def_en: To damage the reputation or clean name of someone in the opinion of others
items.ex_en: Malicious political rivals circulated baseless rumors to besmirch her impeccable moral character.
items.ex_zh: 怀有敌意的政敌散布毫无根据的谣言，企图抹黑她无可指摘的高尚品德。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on marring, degrading, or corrupting the purity, moral standing, or spotless reputation of an entity.
groups.summary_zh: 指破坏人或事物的纯洁性、声誉或名节，予以玷污或损坏。
groups.desc_en: Compromising or degrading the moral purity, cleanliness, or honor of a person, name, or entity, distinct from simple surface physical soiling.
groups.desc_zh: 破坏或贬损人格、声誉或实体的道德纯洁性与名誉，区别于单纯的物理表面弄脏。
groups.nuance_en: taint: subtly infect or contaminate the integrity of something (evidence / reputation / blood) · tarnish: dull the luster or reputation through misconduct or time (reputation / legacy / image) · sully: soil or dishonor something previously pristine (honor / name / innocence) · blemish: spoil the perfection of an otherwise clean record (record / skin / reputation) · defile: treat something sacred or clean with utter disrespect or foulness (shrine / temple / sanctity)
groups.nuance_zh: taint: 微量渗透致使纯洁性受损或污染 (evidence / reputation / blood) · tarnish: 使光泽或名誉蒙羞退色 (reputation / legacy / image) · sully: 玷污原本无暇的名誉或纯洁 (honor / name / innocence) · blemish: 在完美记录或外观上留下瑕疵 (record / skin / reputation) · defile: 严重亵渎神圣或纯洁之物 (shrine / temple / sanctity)

groups.name: Tame & Subdue · 驯化与制服 (Tame, Domesticate, Subdue)
groups.tip: 驯化野性或彻底压服反抗

items.def_zh: 严格控制；收紧缰绳；抑制
items.def_en: To control, restrain, or limit someone or something that has become too wild, powerful, or extravagant
items.ex_en: The treasury had to introduce strict fiscal policies to rein in excessive public spending.
items.ex_zh: 财政部不得不出台严格的财政政策，以抑制过度的公共开支。

items.def_en: To control or limit something unruly, unwanted, or harmful before it grows out of hand
items.ex_en: The central bank raised interest rates yesterday to curb rapidly escalating market inflation.
items.ex_zh: 央行昨日提高了利率，以遏制迅速攀升的市场通胀。

items.def_en: 1. To train a wild animal to be gentle and obedient to humans. 2. To bring a wild, dangerous, or powerful emotion or situation under control.
items.ex_en: It takes patience and quiet consistency to tame a frightened feral barn cat.
items.ex_zh: 驯服一只受惊的谷仓野猫需要足够的耐心和持久的温和。

items.def_en: To bring wild animals or plants under human control and care, adapting them to live alongside humans
items.ex_en: Early agrarian societies sought to domesticate wild boars and indigenous grains for sustained survival.
items.ex_zh: 早期的农耕社会试图驯化野猪和本土谷物以维持生存。

items.def_en: To train a wild horse or animal to accept a rider, harness, and human commands
items.ex_en: The experienced rancher spent several patient weeks working to break in the spirited mustang.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的牧场主耐心地花了数周时间来调教这匹桀骜不驯的野马。

items.def_en: To bring a person, feeling, or wild force under control, especially by using physical force or authority
items.ex_en: Special forces were rapidly deployed to subdue the violent uprising before casualties mounted further.
items.ex_zh: 特种部队被迅速部署以在伤亡进一步增加前压制暴力暴动。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe bringing wild animals, unruly forces, or rebellious impulses under control, domestication, or calm. While 'tame' and 'domesticate' focus on rendering something wild gentle and cooperative, 'subdue' and 'quell' emphasize overpowering resistance.
groups.summary_zh: 指将野生动物驯养顺服，或用控制力压制野性、混乱及叛逆力量。
groups.desc_en: Bringing wild, unruly, or rebellious impulses or creatures under domestic control or quiet obedience, distinct from outright destroying them.
groups.desc_zh: 将野性、失控或反叛的冲动/生灵规训至顺服听命，区别于彻底消灭或物理毁坏。
groups.nuance_en: tame: domesticate a wild animal or moderate wild behavior (beast / instincts / wilderness) · domesticate: adapt animals or plants over generations to live with humans (species / animals / crops) · subdue: bring a rebellious or forceful opponent under control by force (rebels / riot / emotions) · curb: check, restrain, or hold back an excess or impulse (inflation / spending / temper) · rein in: use tight pull to control or slow down unrestrained growth (spending / power / ambition)
groups.nuance_zh: tame: 驯化野生动物或收敛野性 (beast / instincts / wilderness) · domesticate: 历经代际驯养使动植物适应人类生活 (species / animals / crops) · subdue: 用武力压制叛乱或克制强烈情绪 (rebels / riot / emotions) · curb: 勒住、遏制过热或冲动 (inflation / spending / temper) · rein in: 勒紧缰绳以收紧失控的扩张或开支 (spending / power / ambition)

groups.name: Tangle & Knot · 缠绕与纠结 (Snarl, Knot, Ravel)
groups.tip: 线缕交织难解或被绊住

items.def_en: Mix things together in an untidy, disorganized, or confused way
items.ex_en: Don't muddle up the recipe cards or we will ruin the whole dinner tonight.
items.ex_zh: 别把食谱卡片弄混了，否则我们今晚的晚餐就全毁了。

items.def_en: Fasten or tie together with a knot, or form tight, hard tangled lumps
items.ex_en: Sailors must securely knot the heavy mooring lines to withstand the approaching coastal storm.
items.ex_zh: 水手们必须把厚重的系泊绳牢牢打结，以抵御即将来袭的沿海风暴。
items.ex2_en: The long telephone wires knotted together during the chaotic move into our home.
items.ex2_zh: 在搬进我们新家的混乱过程中，长长的电话线缠结在了一起。

items.def_en: Twist together untidily into a confused mass, or cause threads or objects to do so
items.ex_en: The strong sea breeze caused the loose fishing lines to tangle beyond all repair.
items.ex_zh: 强劲的海风把松散的钓鱼线缠成一团，完全无法解开。

items.def_en: Become entangled or clogged with something, particularly of ropes, cables, or mechanisms
items.ex_en: Discarded fishing nets can easily foul the vessel's propeller during navigation in shallow waters.
items.ex_zh: 在浅水区航行时，废弃的渔网极易缠住船只的螺旋桨。
items.ex2_en: The old boat engine fouled when thick coastal seaweed wrapped around its drive.
items.ex2_zh: 当厚厚的海草缠住传动轴时，老旧的船用发动机卡住了。

items.def_zh: 使纠缠，缠住；使卷入，使陷入
items.def_en: To twist things together in an untidy mass, or to involve someone or something in a complicated or difficult situation.
items.ex_en: Careless financial dealings will inevitably entangle the young entrepreneur in protracted legal disputes.
items.ex_zh: 粗心的财务交易不可避免地会使这位年轻创业者卷入旷日持久的法律纠纷中。

items.def_en: Become tangled or intertwined in an unruly way, or cause ropes, hair, or traffic to jam
items.ex_en: A multi-vehicle accident managed to snarl morning commuter traffic for several grueling hours.
items.ex_zh: 一起多车连环相撞事故导致早高峰交通陷入数小时的严重瘫痪。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on the physical twisting, knotting, or snarling of strands, cords, or hair into a disordered mass, as well as light figurative confusion.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重线缆、毛发等物理股线的互相交织扭结成一团，或思维事务的紊乱化。
groups.desc_en: Intertwining strands, cords, or logical lines into a snarled, disordered, and difficult-to-separate mass, distinct from orderly weaving or binding.
groups.desc_zh: 将线索、纤维或逻辑脉络无序绞缠成难以解开的团块，区别于有序的编织或捆扎。
groups.nuance_en: tangle: mix strands together into an irregular confused mass (hair / ropes / yarn) · knot: tie or twist into tightly locked, defined lumps (thread / rope / muscles) · entangle: trap someone or something inextricably within a mesh or complex web (legs / bird / affairs) · snarl: twist into an intensely stubborn, tightly knotted mess (lines / traffic / hair) · foul: jam or impede machinery/rigging through accidental winding (line / propeller / anchor)
groups.nuance_zh: tangle: 散乱杂乱地纠结成团 (hair / ropes / yarn) · knot: 打成硬结或形成纠结肿块 (thread / rope / muscles) · entangle: 使陷入复杂缠结或困境网罗中 (legs / bird / affairs) · snarl: 极度顽固、恶性交错地缠死 (lines / traffic / hair) · foul: 因绳索缠绕导致机械阻滞受阻 (line / propeller / anchor)

groups.name: Tap & Dab · 点触与轻蘸 (Dot, Blot, Pat down)
groups.tip: 短促轻微地触碰点按

items.def_en: To mark or apply something in tiny spots or drops across an area
items.ex_en: The pastry chef used dark chocolate glaze to dot delicate patterns across the cake.
items.ex_zh: 糕点师用黑巧克力淋酱在蛋糕上点缀出精致的花样。

items.def_en: To touch, wipe, or apply something gently and quickly with small strokes.
items.ex_en: She took a clean cotton pad to dab antiseptic gently onto the minor scrape.
items.ex_zh: 她拿起一块干净的棉垫，将消毒剂轻轻擦拭在轻微的擦伤处。

items.def_en: To press something down gently with repeated small, flat hand motions
items.ex_en: The gardener used a wooden board to pat down the freshly planted grass seeds.
items.ex_zh: 园丁用一块木板将新播种的草籽轻轻按实。

items.def_en: To spread a thick, greasy, or wet substance softly over a surface
items.ex_en: Children love to smear colorful berry jam across freshly toasted slices of sourdough bread.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们喜欢在刚烤好的酸面包片上涂抹色彩鲜艳的浆果果酱。

items.def_en: To dry or clean a surface by pressing an absorbent material lightly against it
items.ex_en: He pressed a clean paper towel against the shirt to blot up spilled coffee.
items.ex_zh: 他用一张干净的纸巾紧压在衬衫上，以吸干洒出来的咖啡。

items.def_en: To clean or apply medication to a surface using a small wad of absorbent cotton
items.ex_en: The clinic nurse prepared to swab the patient's throat for further bacterial analysis.
items.ex_zh: 诊所护士准备用棉签擦拭患者的喉咙，以进行进一步的细菌分析。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on light, precise, localized applications of a pad, cloth, or fingertip, either to absorb moisture or apply small amounts of paint, cosmetics, or medicine.
groups.summary_zh: 指用布块、棉片或指尖轻蘸、轻点、吸拭微量液体或粉膏。
groups.desc_en: Applying, touching, or removing a substance with soft, repeated, light vertical contacts rather than broad dragging strokes, distinct from hard rubbing or scraping.
groups.desc_zh: 以轻柔、垂直的点触方式施加或吸附液体/物质，区别于大面积拖拽涂抹或用力擦刮。
groups.nuance_en: dab: apply or take off a liquid with soft, light, quick touches (lotion / paint / eyes) · dot: mark or scatter with tiny isolated points (landscape / paper / canvas) · pat down: flatten or smooth by gentle repeated hand taps (hair / pockets / soil) · blot: absorb excess moisture by pressing an absorbent material (ink / stain / tears) · swab: cleanse or take specimens using a small pad or absorbent stick (wound / deck / cheek)
groups.nuance_zh: dab: 轻蘸、轻触以涂覆或拭去液体 (lotion / paint / eyes) · dot: 用小点打记号或星罗棋布分布 (landscape / paper / canvas) · pat down: 轻轻拍平表面或拍身检查 (hair / pockets / soil) · blot: 用吸水纸按压吸除多余墨迹或液体 (ink / stain / tears) · swab: 用医用拭子擦洗创面或取样 (wound / deck / cheek)

groups.name: Tap & Drum · 击打与节律 (Tap, Pat, Thrum)
groups.tip: 有节奏地敲打发出声响

items.def_en: To strike a surface lightly and repeatedly, often creating a sharp, rhythmic sound
items.ex_en: Anxious waiting passengers began to tap their fingers impatiently on the wooden ticket counter.
items.ex_zh: 焦急等待的乘客们开始不耐烦地用手指轻敲木质售票柜台。

items.def_zh: 吧嗒吧嗒地响；轻快敲击
items.def_en: To make repeated, rapid, lightweight tapping sounds, like rain on a roof or tiny steps
items.ex_en: Gentle spring rain began to patter rhythmically against the old metal shed roof.
items.ex_zh: 温柔的春雨开始有节奏地敲击着旧铁皮棚顶，发出轻快的吧嗒声。

items.def_en: To make a short, rapid double-tap sound on an object
items.ex_en: A cold gust caused loose window panes to tat-tat against the dark frame.
items.ex_zh: 一阵冷风吹来，松动的窗玻璃在漆黑的窗框上嗒嗒作响。

items.def_en: To drum or tap continuously, creating a repetitive, dull humming percussion
items.ex_en: The powerful engines continued to thrum beneath the deck as darkness enveloped the ship.
items.ex_zh: 当黑夜笼罩船只时，强劲的引擎继续在甲板下发出持续低沉的轰鸣震颤。

items.def_en: To strike a hard surface smartly and sharply, making a loud knocking sound
items.ex_en: The stern officer used his heavy brass knuckles to rap loudly on the door.
items.ex_zh: 严厉的警官用他沉重的黄铜指虎梆梆地重重叩响大门。

items.def_zh: 有节奏地敲击，连续敲打；击鼓，打鼓
items.def_en: 1. To make a continuous rhythmic sound by repeatedly tapping on a surface. 2. To play a drum or drums.
items.ex_en: Nervous students drum their pens on wooden desks while awaiting the final exam results.
items.ex_zh: 紧张的学生们在等待期末考试成绩时，用笔在木桌上有节奏地敲击。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe producing continuous, light, and rhythmic percussion against a surface using fingers, sticks, or small objects. The emphasis lies on auditory periodicity and tactile cadence rather than destructive impact.
groups.summary_zh: 手指或工具连续、有节奏地轻叩表面，发出周期性响声。
groups.desc_en: Striking a surface lightly and rhythmically, generating a sequence of audible percussive sounds, distinct from hard clattering or forceful slamming.
groups.desc_zh: 轻柔而有节奏地击打表面并产生清晰的打击声响，区别于沉重砸击或杂乱碎响。
groups.nuance_en: tap: strike a surface lightly and sharply once or briefly (fingers / shoulder / microphone) · rap: strike with a sharp, brisk, resounding blow (knuckles / door / gavel) · patter: make rapid, soft, successive tapping sounds (rain / feet / drops) · drum: beat rapidly, rhythmically, and continuously with fingers or sticks (fingers / table / beat) · thrum: produce a continuous, rhythmic, vibrating dull hum or beat (engine / guitar / pulse)
groups.nuance_zh: tap: 短促清脆地轻扣或轻敲 (fingers / shoulder / microphone) · rap: 用指节等坚硬部位厉声敲击 (knuckles / door / gavel) · patter: 发出快速轻柔连续的滴答或吧嗒声 (rain / feet / drops) · drum: 用手指或棍棒快速有节律地连续敲打 (fingers / table / beat) · thrum: 发出持续而有节律的低频震响 (engine / guitar / pulse)

groups.name: Tap & Flick · 轻弹与微碰 (Snap, Flip, Twitch)
groups.tip: 手指或手腕轻弹敲击

items.def_en: To hit someone or something gently, often making a light clicking sound
items.ex_en: She gave his shoulder a friendly tap to get his attention amid the noise.
items.ex_zh: 她在喧闹中轻轻拍了拍他的肩膀，以引起他的注意。

items.def_en: 1. To hit or move something with a quick, light movement of the finger, wrist, or hand. 2. (flick through) To turn pages quickly.
items.ex_en: He used his index finger to flick the tiny speck of dust away immediately.
items.ex_zh: 他用食指迅速将那粒微小的灰尘弹开。

items.def_en: To remove dirt, ash, or insects with a fast sweeping stroke of the hand
items.ex_en: He tried to brush off the criticism as petty jealousy.
items.ex_zh: 他试图对这些批评不予理会，将其归咎于小人的嫉妒。

items.def_en: To remove something by giving it a light, quick snap with the fingers
items.ex_en: She managed to flick off a persistent green caterpillar that crawled onto her sleeve.
items.ex_zh: 她伸手弹掉了爬到自己袖子上的那只顽固青虫。

items.def_en: To turn or throw something with a quick, flicking motion of the fingers or wrist
items.ex_en: He paused before the darkened hall to flip the light switch on the wall.
items.ex_zh: 在漆黑的大厅前，他停下脚步，随手按下了墙上的电灯开关。
items.ex2_en: The overloaded fishing boat flipped completely upside down in the roaring coastal surf.
items.ex2_zh: 超载的渔船在呼啸的近海巨浪中完全翻倒了个底朝天。

items.def_en: To move or cause something to strike with a quick, sharp, cracking motion
items.ex_en: The magician managed to snap his fingers, producing a flash of bright red sparks.
items.ex_zh: 魔术师啪地打了个响指，变出一道耀眼的红色火花。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe abrupt, light, spring-like movements of fingers or wrists to dislodge an object, switch a mechanism, or deliver a quick tactile snap.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过手指或手腕的轻巧、急促抽弹来击打、拨动或振落细物。
groups.desc_en: Propelling away, toggling, or striking with a sudden, elastic, snapping motion of the fingers or wrist, distinct from steady pushing or full-arm swinging.
groups.desc_zh: 利用手指或手腕瞬间的弹射动作来弹飞物体或快速扳动，区别于平稳推移或大手臂挥击。
groups.nuance_en: flick: strike or propel away with a light, swift, snapping motion (crumb / ash / wrist) · flip: toss with a flicking motion to turn something upside-down or toggle (coin / switch / pancake) · snap: move, click, or break with a sharp, abrupt popping motion (fingers / branch / lid) · tap: make a brief, light contact without elastic release (screen / glass / shoulder) · brush off: sweep away casually with a light sweeping touch (dust / lint / criticism)
groups.nuance_zh: flick: 借指腕弹力轻弹或拂掉 (crumb / ash / wrist) · flip: 弹指翻转或快速扳动 (coin / switch / pancake) · snap: 借韧劲或咬合发出脆响折断或合上 (fingers / branch / lid) · tap: 无弹射力的简短轻触 (screen / glass / shoulder) · brush off: 漫不经心地随手拂去 (dust / lint / criticism)

groups.name: Technological Upgrade & Automation · 工业机械化与技术革新 (Mechanize, Automate, Streamline)
groups.tip: 工业改造与现代化升级

items.def_en: To convert an apparatus, process, or system to operate primarily by self-regulating machinery
items.ex_en: The manufacturing enterprise invested heavily to automate the vehicle assembly line by next year.
items.ex_zh: 该制造企业投入巨资，计划在明年之前使汽车装配线实现自动化。

items.def_en: To make an organization or process simpler and more effective by employing better tools or methods
items.ex_en: Consultants proposed modern digital solutions to streamline administrative workflows across the entire regional branch.
items.ex_zh: 顾问们提出了现代数字化解决方案，以精简整个区域分部的行政工作流程。

items.def_en: To adapt something to modern needs, methods, or conditions using contemporary technology
items.ex_en: The port authority allocated substantial funding to modernize its aging cargo handling facilities.
items.ex_zh: 港务局拨出巨额资金，对其老化的货物装卸设施进行现代化升级。
items.ex2_en: The traditional farming village modernized rapidly once reliable broadband internet became widely available.
items.ex2_zh: 一旦普及了可靠的宽带互联网，传统的农业村庄便迅速现代化。

items.def_en: To equip, manage, or automate a process or system with computers
items.ex_en: The metropolitan library intends to computerize all archival card records over the coming months.
items.ex_zh: 大都会图书馆打算在未来几个月内将所有纸质档案卡片实现计算机化管理。

items.def_en: To develop industry on a wide scale in a country or region using mechanical systems
items.ex_en: Government leaders introduced ambitious policies to industrialize agrarian provinces through massive infrastructural investment.
items.ex_zh: 政府领导人出台了宏大政策，通过大规模基础设施投资推进农业省份的工业化。
items.ex2_en: Developing nations industrialized rapidly during the second half of the twentieth century worldwide.
items.ex2_zh: 发展中国家在二十世纪下半叶于全球范围内实现了迅速工业化。

items.def_en: to change a process, factory, or activity so that the work is done by machines rather than by people or animals
items.ex_en: Local cooperatives plan to mechanize harvesting operations to reduce grueling manual field labor.
items.ex_zh: 当地合作社计划使收割作业实现机械化，以减少繁重艰苦的人工田间劳作。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses transforming manual labor, traditional workflows, or physical processes through machinery, computing, and advanced engineering. It highlights the shift from human effort to automated or standardized mechanical production.
groups.summary_zh: 强调通过引入机器设备、自动化程序或现代技术来革新传统人工与生产方式。
groups.desc_en: Transforming manual processes into mechanized, algorithmic, or automated systems to enhance efficiency, distinct from minor tool refinement.
groups.desc_zh: 将纯手工或低效流程升级为机械化、算法化或自动化体系以倍增效率，区别于微小的工具修补。
groups.nuance_en: automate: replace human intervention with self-operating electronic or robotic systems (processes / factory / tasks) · mechanize: replace manual labor with machine-powered tools (agriculture / farming / industry) · computerize: convert records and operations to digital computational systems (records / system / office) · industrialize: develop large-scale factory-based production across an economy (nation / economy / production) · streamline: strip away inefficiencies to make a process smoother and faster (workflow / operations / bureaucracy)
groups.nuance_zh: automate: 用自运行机器人或程序取代人力干预 (processes / factory / tasks) · mechanize: 用动力机器取代手工体力劳动 (agriculture / farming / industry) · computerize: 将运营及数据转化为数字化电算系统 (records / system / office) · industrialize: 在全行业推行规模化工厂流水线生产 (nation / economy / production) · streamline: 剔除冗余环节以使流程高度精炼顺畅 (workflow / operations / bureaucracy)

groups.name: Tether & Hobble · 羁绊与拴系 (Tether, Hobble, Shackle)
groups.tip: 用绳套笼头限制行动

items.def_en: To put a bridle and bit on a horse to control its direction
items.ex_en: The quiet stable hand paused to bridle the restless stallion before the morning hunt.
items.ex_zh: 沉静的马夫在晨猎前停下来，为焦躁的公马套上笼头。

items.def_zh: 给……套上笼头（或缰绳）；用绳套拴住
items.def_en: To put a halter on an animal, especially a horse, in order to lead or tie it.
items.ex_en: The weary herder moved swiftly to halter the young mare beneath the evening stars.
items.ex_zh: 疲倦的牧民在夜空繁星下敏捷地上前，用缰绳套拴住了年轻的母马。

items.def_en: To fasten something or someone securely with ropes or straps to keep them stationary
items.ex_en: He didn't want to buy a house because he hated being tied down to one location.
items.ex_zh: 他不想买房，因为讨厌被束缚在同一个地方。

items.def_en: To tie an animal with a rope or chain to a fixed post so that it cannot wander beyond a certain radius
items.ex_en: Remember to tether the grazing goat securely to the wooden post near the meadow.
items.ex_zh: 记得把吃草的山羊牢牢拴在草地旁的木桩上。

items.def_en: To tie together two legs of an animal to prevent it from wandering or galloping away
items.ex_en: Cowboys had to hobble their pack horses overnight to prevent them from wandering away.
items.ex_zh: 牛仔们不得不在夜间束缚驮马的双足，以防它们游荡走失。

items.def_en: To put metal restraints or chains around someone's wrists or ankles to prevent movement
items.ex_en: Guards arrived swiftly to shackle the dangerous prisoner before escorting him into the courtroom.
items.ex_zh: 警卫迅速赶来，在押送这名危险囚犯进入法庭前给他戴上了镣铐。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers binding, tethering, or harnessing animals or individuals using ropes, straps, or chains to restrict their movement. Nuances highlight whether mobility is totally halted or merely restrained.
groups.summary_zh: 指用缰绳、套索或镣铐束缚人或牲畜，以限制其走动或逃逸。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote physically binding or restraining an entity’s limbs or range of movement, contrasting with generic 'restrain' by evoking specific pastoral, equestrian, or penal gear that curtails liberty.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指通过系缚肢体或固定范围来限制行动，与一般'限制/约束'的区别在于带有明确的畜牧、骑乘或刑具意象，强调剥夺行动自由的物理或机制手段。
groups.nuance_en: tether: fasten to an anchor point allowing limited radius (goat / boat / smartphone) · hobble: bind legs together to impede smooth walking (horse / economy / progress) · shackle: chain limbs securely to prevent escape or movement (prisoner / industry / hands) · bridle: control or curb through a headstall-like restraint (passions / horses / temper) · tie down: anchor firmly or encumber with obligations (cargo / commitments / family)
groups.nuance_zh: tether: 系系于固定锚点并保留有限活动范围 (goat / boat / smartphone) · hobble: 绑缚双足阻碍跛行前行，引申为掣肘 (horse / economy / progress) · shackle: 上脚镣重重铐住，剥夺行动力 (prisoner / industry / hands) · bridle: 勒马辔加以抑止控驭 (passions / horses / temper) · tie down: 捆扎固定或因琐事责任牵绊 (cargo / commitments / family)

groups.name: Threaten & Menace · 威胁与恐吓 (Intimidate, Terrorize, Browbeat)
groups.tip: 露出凶相或声称将造成危害

items.def_en: To state an intention to inflict harm, damage, or other hostile action on someone, especially to force compliance
items.ex_en: Corrupt landlords continue to threaten impoverished tenants with illegal eviction across the city.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的房东继续在全城范围内以非法驱逐来威胁贫困的租客。

items.def_en: To force someone into doing something by using threats, superior strength, or influence
items.ex_en: Dishonest supervisors often bully vulnerable interns into working mandatory unpaid overtime on weekends.
items.ex_zh: 不道德的主管常常恐吓逼迫弱势的实习生在周末强制进行无薪加班。

items.def_en: To frighten or overawe someone, especially in order to make them do what one wants
items.ex_en: Aggressive opposing lawyers tried to intimidate the key eyewitness before she gave sworn testimony.
items.ex_zh: 咄咄逼人的对方律师试图在这位关键目击证人宣誓作证前恐吓她。

items.def_en: To threaten someone or something with serious harm or danger.
items.ex_en: Rising ocean temperatures menace fragile coral reef ecosystems throughout tropical regions worldwide.
items.ex_zh: 海平面水温上升危及全球热带地区脆弱的珊瑚礁生态系统。

items.def_en: To fill someone with extreme fear, often through violence or persistent threats
items.ex_en: Armed rebel factions continue to terrorize rural villages with violent late-night raids.
items.ex_zh: 武装叛乱派系继续通过暴力的深夜突袭使农村村庄陷入极度恐慌。

items.def_en: To intimidate someone into doing something with harsh, domineering words or looks
items.ex_en: The authoritarian chairman attempted to browbeat reluctant board members into approving the risky takeover.
items.ex_zh: 独断专行的董事长试图严词恫吓心存疑虑的董事会成员批准这起高风险收购。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe expressing an intention to inflict injury, damage, or punishment, or behaving aggressively to instill fear and force compliance. Nuances span from explicit verbal warnings to pervasive psychological intimidation.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及以言语、举动或声势施加危险信号，迫使对方产生恐惧或屈服。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote projecting peril, force, or overbearing hostility to compel submission, contrasting with neutral 'warn' by carrying predatory intent and psychological coercion.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指通过宣示危险、武力或盛气凌人的威逼迫使对方屈服，与中性的'警告'不同，带有侵害意图与强烈的心理压迫性。
groups.nuance_en: threaten: declare intent to inflict harm or pose danger to (safety / livelihood / retaliate) · intimidate: induce fear to discourage resistance or compel compliance (witness / rival / voter) · menace: loom ominously as an imminent peril (streets / peace / future) · terrorize: rule or harass through systematic paralyzing dread (neighborhood / population / villagers) · browbeat: bully with overbearing words or arrogant demeanor (suspect / subordinate / jury)
groups.nuance_zh: threaten: 正式宣告加害意图或构成现实威胁 (safety / livelihood / retaliate) · intimidate: 制造恐惧以瓦解斗志或强迫就范 (witness / rival / voter) · menace: 阴森迫近并构成步步紧逼的险情 (streets / peace / future) · terrorize: 以系统性恐怖手段施行震慑残害 (neighborhood / population / villagers) · browbeat: 盛气凌人、吹胡子瞪眼地横加威逼 (suspect / subordinate / jury)

groups.name: Throw & Hurl · 抛掷与猛掷 (Throw, Hurl, Fling)
groups.tip: 发力将物体掷出抛飞

items.def_en: To throw something lightly, casually, or carelessly
items.ex_en: He casually reached into his deep coat pocket to toss the spare house key.
items.ex_zh: 他随手伸进厚大衣口袋，把备用的房间钥匙抛了过去。

items.def_en: To throw something with careful aim, or toss something forward vigorously
items.ex_en: The star relief pitcher stepped up and prepared to pitch a devastating curveball.
items.ex_zh: 明星中继投手走上前，准备投出一记极具杀伤力的曲球。

items.def_en: To throw something carelessly or with a lot of force and sudden movement
items.ex_en: In a fit of sudden temper, the artist decided to fling wet paint.
items.ex_zh: 在突如其来的一阵怒火中，这位艺术家猛然甩掷湿颜料。

items.def_zh: 猛投，猛掷；猛甩，猛冲（fling的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense and past participle of fling; threw forcefully or moved suddenly and vigorously.
items.ex_en: Exhausted from the match, the athlete flung his heavy duffel bag onto the floor.
items.ex_zh: 比赛后精疲力竭的运动员将沉重的行李包猛地扔到了地板上。

items.def_en: To lift and throw something heavy with great physical effort
items.ex_en: Two burly dock workers struggled mightily to heave the wet timber aboard the boat.
items.ex_zh: 两名健壮的码头工人费了九牛二虎之力才把湿木料吃力地抛扔到船上。

items.def_en: To throw something with a great amount of force, usually in anger or aggression
items.ex_en: Furious rioters began to hurl heavy paving stones directly at the advancing police lines.
items.ex_zh: 狂怒的暴徒开始猛力将沉重的铺路石掷向推进中的警戒防线。

groups.summary_en: Denotes propelling an object through the air using one's arm or hand, varying from routine casting to violent, forceful heaving.
groups.summary_zh: 指用手臂或力量将某物猛烈、迅速地抛投向空中或远处。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote propelling a physical object through the air with muscular force, distinguished from simple 'release' or 'drop' by directional impetus and varying degrees of effort, aim, or violence.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指凭借肌体爆发力将物体抛掷于空中，与简单的'松手/投递'区别在于赋予其定向动能，并在发力姿态、力度和精准度上各有侧重。
groups.nuance_en: toss: throw lightly, carelessly, or upward (coin / salad / ball) · pitch: fling forward with deliberate aim or trajectory (baseball / tent / hay) · fling: cast forcibly with sudden reckless passion or haste (door / clothes / arms) · heave: lift and throw with great strenuous exertion (rock / cargo / anchor) · hurl: propel violently with intense velocity or fury (missile / stone / insults)
groups.nuance_zh: toss: 随手轻掷、往上抛扔 (coin / salad / ball) · pitch: 定向投掷、以特定轨迹用力投出 (baseball / tent / hay) · fling: 猛然发力、带着情绪或仓促甩掷 (door / clothes / arms) · heave: 极力搬起并沉重推抛 (rock / cargo / anchor) · hurl: 暴烈且极具杀伤力地猛砸掷去 (missile / stone / insults)

groups.name: Tile, Shingle & Overlap · 叠覆与层叠交接 (Overlap, Shingle, Imbricate)
groups.tip: 层叠交错部分覆盖

items.def_zh: 重叠，交叠；（波浪等）轻拍，拍打；舔食
items.def_en: 1. To lie partly over something, or to fold over and cover something. 2. (of water or waves) To wash gently against something with a soft splashing sound. 3. (of an animal) To drink liquid with quick movements of the tongue.
items.ex_en: Gentle ocean waves continued to lap softly against the wooden hull of the boat.
items.ex_zh: 轻柔的海浪继续轻轻拍打着木船的船体。

items.def_zh: 使边缘渐薄交叠；削薄边缘接合
items.def_en: To taper or blend an edge smoothly so that successive layers overlap imperceptibly
items.ex_en: The artisan used fine sandpaper to feather the joint between the two thin veneers.
items.ex_zh: 工匠用细砂纸打磨削薄边缘，使两块薄饰面板的接缝完美重叠交融。

items.def_en: To cover part of the edge or surface of another thing, or coincide partly in time or scope
items.ex_en: Roofers ensure that each asphalt tile will overlap the layer below to prevent leaks.
items.ex_zh: 屋顶工确保每块沥青瓦都会部分重叠下层瓦片，以防止漏水。
items.ex2_en: The morning and afternoon conference sessions overlap by thirty minutes on Friday schedule.
items.ex2_zh: 周五日程表上的上午和下午会议环节在时间上重叠了三十分钟。

items.def_en: To extend underneath an adjacent part or edge in an overlapping structure
items.ex_en: The builder made sure the lower waterproofing membrane would underlap the metal counter-flashing completely.
items.ex_zh: 施工人员确保下层防水膜完全衬于金属遮雨板下方叠压。

items.def_zh: 用木瓦（或鱼鳞状物）叠盖
items.def_en: To lay overlapping rows of roof shingles, tiles, or similar materials
items.ex_en: Carpenters spent three exhausting days working to shingle the steep roof of the cottage.
items.ex_zh: 木匠们花了精疲力竭的三天时间，用木瓦叠盖小屋陡峭的屋顶。

items.def_en: (formal/technical) To place or arrange scales, plates, or edges in an overlapping pattern like roof tiles
items.ex_en: Ancient armorers would carefully imbricate individual metal plates to provide both protection and flexibility.
items.ex_zh: 古代军械工匠会精细地将各个金属甲片如鱼鳞般重叠排列，以兼顾防护与灵活性。
items.ex2_en: Natural fish scales imbricate neatly along the body to reduce hydrodynamic friction efficiently.
items.ex2_zh: 天然鱼鳞沿着鱼身整齐地呈鳞状叠压，从而有效减少流体动力摩擦。

groups.summary_en: This spatial and physical frame concerns surfaces, margins, or boundaries extending partly over another so as to form a continuous, layered sequence. Typical contexts include building materials (tiles, scales), temporal intervals, and structural segments.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体边缘、结构或时间跨度部分覆盖于另一物之上以形成层叠。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe placing flat or sheet-like elements partially over one another in a stepped pattern, contrasting with flush 'join' by relying on structural redundancy for shedding weather or seamless transitions.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指将片状构件按梯次边缘重叠铺设，与平整齐缝的'拼接'不同，它依赖部分覆叠构造来实现导水排污或无缝过渡。
groups.nuance_en: overlap: cover part of the same area or edge (edges / jurisdiction / duties) · shingle: lay thin units overlapping downward like roof tiles (roof / hair / siding) · imbricate: arrange regularly overlapping like scales or tiles in nature or craft (leaves / scales / plates) · lap: fold or place an edge across another to form a seam (boards / metal / joints) · feather: taper edges so they blend into an overlapping surface smoothly (paint / edge / drywall)
groups.nuance_zh: overlap: 局部边缘重叠或跨界交叉 (edges / jurisdiction / duties) · shingle: 像屋顶木瓦般自上而下层层压叠 (roof / hair / siding) · imbricate: 呈鱼鳞状或规整瓦状叠覆 (leaves / scales / plates) · lap: 将边缘搭接覆盖以形成密封缝 (boards / metal / joints) · feather: 边缘打磨削薄以实现平滑叠顺 (paint / edge / drywall)

groups.name: Toast & Crisp · 烘烤与酥脆 (Toast, Brown, Singe)
groups.tip: 烘烤加热至外表酥脆

items.def_en: To become crisp, or to make food crisp again by baking or frying
items.ex_en: Return the soggy leftover fries to a hot air fryer to crisp up nicely.
items.ex_zh: 把发软的吃剩薯条放回热空气炸锅里，让它重新变得酥脆可口。
items.ex2_en: A brief blast of hot air will crisp up the soggy bacon strips.
items.ex2_zh: 一阵短暂的热风烘烤能使浸软的培根条重新变得香脆。

items.def_en: To cook food until its surface turns brown and slightly crisp
items.ex_en: Cooks usually brown the seasoned beef chunks over high heat before adding aromatic vegetables.
items.ex_zh: 厨师通常会在加入芳香蔬菜前，先用高温把调味过的牛肉块煎成黄褐色。
items.ex2_en: The fragrant sourdough bread browned perfectly inside the wood-fired stone baking oven.
items.ex2_zh: 香气四溢的酸种面包在柴火石制烘烤炉内被烘烤成了完美的褐色。

items.def_en: To make food brown and crisp by heating it on both sides
items.ex_en: Place the sliced brioche rolls beneath the broiler to toast them until golden brown.
items.ex_zh: 将切片的布里欧修面包卷置于烤箱上火下烘烤，直到呈金黄焦脆。
items.ex2_en: Thick slices of artisan bread toasted nicely inside the vintage chrome kitchen toaster.
items.ex2_zh: 厚切的手工面包在复古镀铬厨房烤面包机中烤得焦香诱人。

items.def_en: 1. To become crisp or make something crisp, especially by heating. 2. To curl or form into small crisp ripples or folds.
items.ex_en: A few extra minutes in the convection oven will crisp the homemade pizza crust.
items.ex_zh: 在热风烤箱里多烤几分钟就能使自制披萨的饼底变得香脆。
items.ex2_en: Fresh potato slices crisped beautifully in the skillet filled with hot vegetable oil.
items.ex2_zh: 新鲜的土豆片在装满滚烫植物油的煎锅里炸得格外松脆。

items.def_en: To make dry and crisp by exposing to heat, especially grains or seeds
items.ex_en: Nomadic traders would parch harvested barley grains over dry desert fires for light nourishment.
items.ex_zh: 游牧商人会在干燥的荒漠篝火上烘烤收获的大麦粒，作为轻便的口粮。

items.def_en: To burn or cause something to burn slightly until blackened and brittle
items.ex_en: Careless campfire cooks often manage to char the skewered marshmallows into blackened lumps.
items.ex_zh: 粗心的篝火烹饪者经常会把串好的棉花糖烤焦成一团漆黑。
items.ex2_en: Tender oak branches charred completely to black ash during the intense hillside fire.
items.ex2_zh: 娇嫩的橡树枝在山坡的烈火中完全烧焦变成了黑色的灰烬。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve applying dry heat to food or surfaces so they develop a brittle, crisp exterior or browned finish.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过干热烘烤或煎炸使食物表层变得酥脆、焦黄或微焦干燥。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote applying dry heat to remove moisture and alter surface texture or color, contrasting with generic 'cook' by focusing on surface browning, crisping, or dehydration.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指施加干热以脱水并改变表面色泽与酥脆质感，与一般的'烹饪'区别在于聚焦于表层的烘黄、焦香、焦枯或烘干脆化。
groups.nuance_en: toast: brown and crisp moderately with radiant heat (bread / marshmallows / nuts) · brown: cook until the outer surface turns appetizingly golden-brown (meat / onions / butter) · crisp: heat until firm, brittle, and dry (bacon / skin / pastry) · char: scorch or burn slightly until blackened on the surface (wood / peppers / steak) · parch: dry out completely with excessive scorching heat (earth / throat / corn)
groups.nuance_zh: toast: 辐射烘烤至焦黄酥润 (bread / marshmallows / nuts) · brown: 煎烤使表面呈现诱人棕黄色 (meat / onions / butter) · crisp: 烤至干硬酥脆 (bacon / skin / pastry) · char: 烧灼使表层局部发黑炭化 (wood / peppers / steak) · parch: 烈日或强热烘烤至水分枯竭 (earth / throat / corn)

groups.name: Toil & Labor Gruelingly · 辛劳与苦役 (Toil, Slave, Grind, Slog)
groups.tip: 从事繁重体力苦工劳作

items.def_en: to perform taxing physical effort, often under tough or unyielding constraints
items.ex_en: Immigrant laborers had to labor under harsh sun to complete the transcontinental railway line.
items.ex_zh: 移民劳工不得不在烈日下艰苦劳作，以完成跨洲铁路干线的修筑。

items.def_zh: 做苦工；干繁琐乏味的工作
items.def_en: to do menial, repetitive, and uninspiring hard labor for extended stretches
items.ex_en: He was forced to drudge through monotonous clerical tasks in the dim, dusty basement.
items.ex_zh: 他被迫在昏暗布满灰尘的地下室里日复一日地干着枯燥繁琐的文书苦活。

items.def_zh: 拼命做苦工；像奴隶般劳作
items.def_en: to work excessively long, punishing hours without adequate reward or rest
items.ex_en: She had to slave away in a sweltering restaurant kitchen for barely minimum wage.
items.ex_zh: 她不得不在闷热难耐的餐厅厨房里像奴隶般辛苦拼命，却仅挣着最低工资。

items.def_en: to work extremely hard and continuously on strenuous physical labor
items.ex_en: Generations of tenant farmers continued to toil tirelessly on the rocky and unyielding land.
items.ex_zh: 一代又一代的佃农继续在那片贫瘠多石的土地上不知疲倦地辛劳耕作。

items.def_en: to work hard over a prolonged period, typically at a dull, arduous, or difficult task
items.ex_en: I had to slog through hundreds of tedious spreadsheets before leaving the office.
items.ex_zh: 离开办公室前，我不得不硬着头皮啃完数百份乏味的电子表格。

items.def_en: 1. To work hard and painfully. 2. To undergo the labor and pain of childbirth.
items.ex_en: The exhausted miners continued to travail in the damp darkness of the pit.
items.ex_zh: 筋疲力竭的矿工们继续在阴暗潮湿的矿井深处苦苦劳作。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on sustained, physically or mentally grinding manual effort under arduous conditions. It denotes exhausting labor that drains human reserves over time.
groups.summary_zh: 强调在沉重或恶劣条件下付出耗竭体力的长期艰苦劳作。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote sustained, exhausting bodily or mental labor against weariness or harsh conditions, contrasting with plain 'work' by foregrounding grueling drudgery and physical attrition.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指在恶劣条件或沉重压力下从事极度耗费精力的艰辛劳作，与普通'工作'不同，强调受苦、疲于奔命以及近乎折磨的肉体消耗。
groups.nuance_en: toil: work continuously with heavy, strenuous effort (fields / quarries / night) · slave away: work excessively hard in subjection or for low reward (kitchen / desk / hot stove) · drudge: perform dull, menial, and spirit-crushing chores (scullery / housework / office) · slog: trudge painstakingly through a slow, tedious task (mud / thesis / textbook) · travail: suffer grueling hardship and agonizing labor (spirit / birth / struggle)
groups.nuance_zh: toil: 汗流浃背、体力消耗巨大的长久苦干 (fields / quarries / night) · slave away: 像奴隶般受压榨、缺乏回报地拼命干活 (kitchen / desk / hot stove) · drudge: 埋头于枯燥卑微、磨灭灵性的琐务 (scullery / housework / office) · slog: 步履维艰地在枯燥冗长工作中死熬 (mud / thesis / textbook) · travail: 历经撕心裂肺般的阵痛劳苦 (spirit / birth / struggle)

groups.name: Toil & Labor · 劳作与劳苦 (Toil, Slag Away, Grind)
groups.tip: 长期从事艰苦繁重体力劳动

items.def_en: (+ at) To keep working hard at a difficult task in an uncomplaining way
items.ex_en: If you keep plugging away at your revision, you will pass the exam.
items.ex_zh: 如果你坚持不懈地埋头复习，就一定能通过考试。

items.def_en: To work extraordinarily hard, producing bodily sweat from strenuous effort
items.ex_en: The farmhands sweated under the scorching midday sun to harvest the remaining barley.
items.ex_zh: 农工们顶着正午的烈日流汗苦干，收割剩下的大麦。

items.def_zh: 像奴隶般苦干；拼命劳作
items.def_en: To work extremely hard like a slave for little pay, recognition, or rest
items.ex_en: She slaved away in the stifling kitchen all afternoon without receiving any thanks.
items.ex_zh: 她在闷热的厨房里拼命忙活了整个下午，却连一句感谢都没得到。

items.def_en: (+ away) To work or study with relentless, monotonous, exhausting continuity
items.ex_en: Medical students often grind away for twelve hours straight during exam week.
items.ex_zh: 医学生在考试周往往会连续埋头苦读十二个小时。

items.def_zh: 苦干，辛勤劳作；艰难缓慢地行走，跋涉
items.def_en: 1. (+ away/at) To work very hard and continuously for a long time, especially doing physical labor. 2. (+ up/along) To move or walk with great difficulty and effort.
items.ex_en: Generations of impoverished peasants toiled upon this barren soil to earn bread.
items.ex_zh: 几代贫苦的农民在这片贫瘠的土地上辛勤劳作以求糊口。

items.def_en: (+ away/at) To work hard over a long period, especially doing repetitive toil
items.ex_en: He slogged away at the assembly line until his entire body ached.
items.ex_zh: 他在装配线上苦干了很久，直到浑身酸痛。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame highlight sustained, physically grinding, and exhausting exertion over extended periods under punishing conditions.
groups.summary_zh: 强调在艰苦严苛的环境下，长时间从事筋疲力尽、单调消耗的体力繁难劳动。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame express high-intensity, unremitting effort over time, contrasting with uncommitted 'labor' through the physical or mental friction endured to grind out results.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词表示经久不息的高强度硬拼与付出，与中性的'劳动'相比，突出了在枯燥摩擦中死磕到底的耐力与压迫感。
groups.nuance_en: grind: work methodically and relentlessly without glamour (shifts / coursework / daily life) · sweat: exert oneself to the point of perspiration or stress (details / workout / brow) · plug away: persist doggedly at an uphill task (studies / project / novel) · toil: expend heavy physical or mental energy under difficulty (vineyard / manuscript / lab) · slog: press on through heavy, resistant, or wearisome duties (homework / hills / backlog)
groups.nuance_zh: grind: 枯燥机械、日复一日高强度苦熬硬抗 (shifts / coursework / daily life) · sweat: 挥汗如雨、高度紧张焦虑地使劲 (details / workout / brow) · plug away: 不动声色、锲而不舍地啃硬骨头 (studies / project / novel) · toil: 顶着重负耗费大把心血气力 (vineyard / manuscript / lab) · slog: 在沉闷阻力中费劲艰难跋涉 (homework / hills / backlog)

groups.name: Toil & Strive · 勤勉与苦干 (Beaver away, Toil, Slog)
groups.tip: 如河狸般勤奋埋头苦干

items.def_en: (informal) (+ at) To keep working hard at a difficult or repetitive job without giving up
items.ex_en: Despite repeated setbacks, the young engineer plugged away at the faulty circuit board.
items.ex_zh: 尽管屡遭挫折，那位年轻工程师依然坚持不懈地摆弄那块故障电路板。

items.def_zh: 拼命干；当牛做马般劳作
items.def_en: (+ away / over) To work excessively hard for long hours like a slave
items.ex_en: She slaved over the detailed financial report until the early hours of morning.
items.ex_zh: 她当牛做马般拼命赶制那份详尽的财务报告，一直忙到凌晨。

items.def_zh: 埋头苦干，辛勤工作（常与 away 连用）
items.def_en: (also 'beaver away') (informal) To work very hard and persistently at a task for a long time.
items.ex_en: Tom has been beavering away at his term paper in the quiet library.
items.ex_zh: 汤姆一直在安静的图书馆里埋头赶写他的学期论文。

items.def_en: To work extremely hard and continuously for long periods, often with physical exhaustion
items.ex_en: The weary laborers toiled through the night under the dim amber lanterns.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的工人们在昏暗的琥珀色灯笼下辛勤劳作了整整一夜。

items.def_en: (+ away / through) To work hard over a long period on something tedious or demanding
items.ex_en: We slogged through dense thickets of legal jargon to finish the contract draft.
items.ex_zh: 我们艰难地啃完了晦涩密集的法律术语，才完成了合同草案。

items.def_en: To perform hard, menial, tedious, or distasteful labor persistently
items.ex_en: The wretched clerk drudged endlessly over dusty ledgers for a meager pittance.
items.ex_zh: 那个可怜的抄写员为了微薄的薪水，在布满灰尘的账本前无休止地做着苦工。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures unglamorous, grueling, and sustained labor. Verbs highlight relentless exertion, dogged perseverance, and endurance against weariness or tedious tasks.
groups.summary_zh: 埋头苦干、坚韧不懈地从事繁重、枯燥或耗时的工作。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame characterize industrious, steadfast diligence applied to a challenging project, contrasting with passive 'try' through relentless determination and busy industry.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词侧重于勤勤恳恳、埋头苦干的进取劲头，与消极被动的'尝试'相比，突显出像工蜂般的勤勉忙碌与咬定不放的毅力。
groups.nuance_en: beaver: work industrious and briskly on an assignment (away at desk / report / garden) · plug away: work steadily and stubbornly against sluggish progress (dissertation / problem / exams) · drudge: plod through joyless routine labor with quiet persistence (office / routine / basement) · toil: labor steadfastly against steep obstacles (code / garden / factory) · slave: expend full exertion without respite for someone else's benefit (boss / household / master)
groups.nuance_zh: beaver: 像海狸般热火朝天、不知疲倦地忙碌 (away at desk / report / garden) · plug away: 面对进展缓慢仍死死坚持不放弃 (dissertation / problem / exams) · drudge: 默默忍受无聊苦役耐着性子苦熬 (office / routine / basement) · toil: 面对困难坚持不懈倾注辛劳 (code / garden / factory) · slave: 毫无歇息地为他人当牛做马卖命 (boss / household / master)

groups.name: Touch & Contact · 触摸与接触 (Graze, Caress, Brush, Feel)
groups.tip: 指尖接触产生触觉感知

items.def_en: To deliberately touch something with one's fingers or hands to discover its texture, shape, or state
items.ex_en: She gently felt the silk fabric to check its softness and weaving quality.
items.ex_zh: 她轻轻摸了摸丝绸面料，以检验其柔软度和织造质量。

items.def_en: 1. To put your hand or another part of your body on someone or something; to come into physical contact with something. 2. To produce an emotional feeling, especially of sympathy or gratitude, in someone.
items.ex_en: Please do not touch the delicate oil painting while touring the gallery.
items.ex_zh: 参观美术馆时，请勿触摸脆弱的油画展品。

items.def_en: To touch someone or something very lightly in passing
items.ex_en: Her long hair brushed his shoulder lightly as she walked past him.
items.ex_zh: 她走过他身边时，长发轻轻拂过他的肩膀。

items.def_en: To move your hand gently along the surface of something in a smooth repeated motion
items.ex_en: The old sailor stroked his sleeping cat while gazing out across the harbor.
items.ex_zh: 老水手一边抚摩着熟睡的猫，一边眺望着港口。

items.def_en: To touch or scrape lightly against something while moving rapidly past it
items.ex_en: The speeding bullet merely grazed his shoulder, leaving a superficial red scratch.
items.ex_zh: 飞驰的子弹只是掠过了他的肩膀，留下一道浅浅的红抓痕。

items.def_en: To touch or stroke someone or something gently and affectionately
items.ex_en: A fragrant evening breeze caressed her cheeks as dusk settled over the hills.
items.ex_zh: 暮色笼罩山峦，一缕芬芳的晚风轻柔地抚摩着她的面颊。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses physical sensory contact between the body and another surface. The manner of contact ranges from deliberate tactile exploration (feeling, stroking) to momentary or superficial friction (brushing, grazing).
groups.summary_zh: 身体表面或手与物体发生物理接触，体验触觉或产生轻触。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote tactile interaction varying from casual contact to deliberate sensory exploration, contrasting with passive 'meet' by involving deliberate feeling, skin friction, or tenderness.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指从偶然擦碰到主动爱抚的各种触觉感知与接触，与单纯的'相交/挨着'不同，突显了皮肤触感、意向性及情感色彩。
groups.nuance_en: touch: make physical contact with or feel briefly (skin / ceiling / heart) · feel: explore tactile qualities consciously with the hands (fabric / pulse / surface) · graze: touch or scrape lightly in passing (shoulder / cheek / bullet) · brush: sweep past or sweep lightly against a surface (hair / crumbs / sleeve) · caress: touch or stroke gently with deep affection (face / cheek / breeze) · stroke: rub gently and repeatedly in one direction (cat / ego / beard)
groups.nuance_zh: touch: 最基础的触碰或产生肉体/心灵触动 (skin / ceiling / heart) · feel: 主动用手触摸以感知质地温度 (fabric / pulse / surface) · graze: 掠过、擦碰破皮或轻微擦过 (shoulder / cheek / bullet) · brush: 拂扫而过、轻触拂弄 (hair / crumbs / sleeve) · caress: 带着深情与爱怜的抚慰爱抚 (face / cheek / breeze) · stroke: 顺着单一方向轻柔抚摩 (cat / ego / beard)

groups.name: Tour & Sightsee · 游览与观光 (Tour, Sightsee, Explore)
groups.tip: 以观光旅游为目的的游历

items.def_en: To go to see a landmark, museum, or tourist destination for interest
items.ex_en: Thousands of excited tourists visit the historic cathedral in central Florence each day.
items.ex_zh: 每天都有数千名兴高采烈的游客前来参观佛罗伦萨市中心的历史大教堂。

items.def_en: To travel through or visit multiple historic or scenic sights in a region
items.ex_en: The travel group spent two wonderful weeks touring historic castles across Scotland.
items.ex_zh: 旅行团花了两个美妙的星期巡游苏格兰各地的历史城堡。

items.def_en: To travel through an unfamiliar area to discover its attractions or landmarks
items.ex_en: We spent the entire afternoon exploring the winding alleys of the old bazaar.
items.ex_zh: 我们花了整个下午去探寻古老集市中蜿蜒曲折的巷弄。

items.def_en: To visit and consciously appreciate the sights, exhibits, or features of a place
items.ex_en: They paused on the hill to take in the breathtaking panorama below.
items.ex_zh: 他们在山丘上驻足，细细欣赏下方令人惊叹的全景。

items.def_en: To walk around an attraction, building, or town to see what is there
items.ex_en: Let us look round the ancient castle before the evening fog rolls in.
items.ex_zh: 咱们赶在晚雾涌起之前，去这座古堡里随处参观一下吧。

items.def_en: To travel around visiting monuments, famous sites, and attractions as a tourist.
items.ex_en: We spent our entire weekend sightsee in the bustling streets of Rome.
items.ex_zh: 我们把整个周末都花在罗马繁华的街头观光游览上。

groups.summary_en: Covers traveling around places, monuments, and cultural attractions for recreation, leisure, and exploratory curiosity.
groups.summary_zh: 指为休闲、猎奇或学习而走访各地景点、名胜古迹的观光活动。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote traveling through places for recreational observation, cultural enrichment, or curiosity, contrasting with plain 'travel' by focusing on visiting landmarks and visual consumption.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指以观摩消遣、增长见识或寻奇猎胜为目的的游历活动，与一般的'移动/旅行'区别在于其强烈的观光属性、名胜寻访和视觉体验。
groups.nuance_en: tour: travel extensively through an area inspecting its sights (country / factory / museum) · sightsee: go about looking at places of interest as a tourist (capital / ruins / town) · explore: examine unfamiliar territory closely to discover its features (caves / district / options) · visit: go to see a specific place or person socially or culturally (shrine / relatives / city) · take in: absorb or view a spectacle as part of an itinerary (show / sights / panorama)
groups.nuance_zh: tour: 巡回巡游、系统性走访参观 (country / factory / museum) · sightsee: 作为游客四处游览名胜古迹 (capital / ruins / town) · explore: 深入未知陌生区域寻幽探胜 (caves / district / options) · visit: 专程前往特定地点或探望某人 (shrine / relatives / city) · take in: 顺路领略、兼收并蓄地观摩吸收 (show / sights / panorama)

groups.name: Toy & Flirt With · 把玩与漫不经心对待 (Toy, Dally, Flirt with)
groups.tip: 漫不经心摆弄思索

items.def_en: To experiment casually with different ideas, methods, or devices to see how they function
items.ex_en: He spent Sunday playing around with the new sound editing software on his laptop.
items.ex_zh: 他周日一整天都在笔记本上随意摆弄那款新的音频剪辑软件。

items.def_zh: 漫不经心地考虑；摆弄，玩弄
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To consider an idea or plan casually or without deep seriousness. 2. (+ with) To fiddle with or handle something absentmindedly.
items.ex_en: She toyed with the idea of quitting her job and traveling abroad.
items.ex_zh: 她曾漫不经心地考虑过辞去工作去国外旅行的想法。

items.def_en: (+ with) To touch, manipulate, or adjust something aimlessly, nervously, or inexpertly
items.ex_en: Stop fiddling with your watch strap and listen to what I am saying.
items.ex_zh: 别再心不在焉地摆弄表带了，听我说话。

items.def_en: (+ with) To make small, exploratory alterations or superficial repairs to something without a systematic plan
items.ex_en: My dad loves to tinker with broken radios in the garage all weekend.
items.ex_zh: 我爸爸喜欢整个周末都待在车库里摆弄修补坏收音机。

items.def_en: (+ with) To treat a serious matter, plan, or person's emotions in an idle, playful, or noncommittal way
items.ex_en: Do not dally with the young woman's affections unless your intentions are serious.
items.ex_zh: 若非真心实意，就休要轻浮玩弄那位年轻姑娘的感情。

items.def_zh: 浅尝辄止地考虑，玩弄（想法/危险）
items.def_en: To entertain an idea or course of action superficially or tempt a risky outcome without firm commitment
items.ex_en: The reckless mayor flirted with disaster by ignoring repeated warnings about the dam.
items.ex_zh: 这位行事鲁莽的市长无视对大坝的反复警告，简直是在拿灾难开玩笑。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses treating concepts, proposals, or objects non-seriously, speculatively, or idly without deep engagement or steadfast resolve.
groups.summary_zh: 浅尝辄止地摆弄事物或漫不经心地推敲构想。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote superficial, uncommitted, or playful engagement with ideas, mechanisms, or feelings, contrasting with serious 'investigate' by highlighting frivolous or half-hearted amusement.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指对事物、观念或感情进行浮光掠影、心不在焉或浅尝辄止的玩弄戏弄，与严肃认真的'研究/处理'不同，带有漫不经心或游戏人生的消遣色彩。
groups.nuance_en: toy: consider an idea or touch an object idly without serious intent (idea / food / pen) · tinker: make small, experimental, often amateurish repairs or adjustments (engine / system / code) · fiddle: touch or manipulate restlessly and nervously (fingers / lock / dials) · dally: waste time playfully or act without seriousness (affections / along / with danger) · flirt with: dabble playfully with a risky or radical possibility (idea / disaster / socialism)
groups.nuance_zh: toy: 心不在焉地把玩摆弄或不当真地琢磨 (idea / food / pen) · tinker: 业余摆弄修修补补、随意微调 (engine / system / code) · fiddle: 坐立不安地摸来弄去或无章法摆弄 (fingers / lock / dials) · dally: 虚掷光阴、对感情或事物漫不经心 (affections / along / with danger) · flirt with: 浮泛涉足、试探性地玩弄危险想法 (idea / disaster / socialism)

groups.name: Transfer & Alienate · 让渡与过户 (Convey, Assign, Cede)
groups.tip: 依法移转产权或身份

items.def_en: To transfer legal rights, benefits, or property officially to designated parties
items.ex_en: The patent holder agreed to assign all licensing rights to the pharmaceutical firm.
items.ex_zh: 专利持有人同意将所有许可权转让给该制药公司。

items.def_en: (law) To transfer property, land, or ownership rights to another person.
items.ex_en: The feudal lord had no legal authority to alien the ancestral crown estate.
items.ex_zh: 这位封建领主没有法定权力让渡祖传的王室地产。

items.def_en: To formally relinquish ownership or rights to someone by signing a document
items.ex_en: She formally signed over her share of the family business to her brother.
items.ex_zh: 她正式签署文件，将自己在家族企业中的份额转让给了弟弟。

items.def_en: To transfer ownership of real estate or property by formal legal deed
items.ex_en: The wealthy benefactor deeded the vast beachfront property to the local conservation trust.
items.ex_zh: 那位富有的捐助人依法律契据将这片庞大的海滨地产转让给当地自然保护信托机构。

items.def_en: To transfer the legal title or ownership of property to another person
items.ex_en: The legal contract conveyed the parcel of farmland directly to the buyer.
items.ex_zh: 该法律合同将这块农田的产权直接转让给了买方。

items.def_en: To yield or surrender territory, sovereignty, or rights to another party
items.ex_en: Under the treaty, the defeated empire had to cede two border provinces.
items.ex_zh: 根据该条约，战败的帝国必须割让两个边境省份。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to formal or legal transfers of property, title, rights, or territory from one party to another.
groups.summary_zh: 指依据法律或契约正式转让财产所有权、权利或领地的行为。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote the formal, legally binding reallocation of property, titles, or sovereign rights to another party, contrasting with informal 'give' through institutional documentation and legal finality.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指依据法律规程或条约将财产、产权、领土或权力正式转交他人，与非正式的'给予'区别在于其严密的法定效力、契约性与不可逆性。
groups.nuance_en: convey: formally transfer title or ownership via legal deed (estate / property / rights) · assign: transfer legal rights, claims, or contracts to another (copyright / patent / debt) · cede: yield territory or sovereign rights under diplomatic pressure or treaty (territory / authority / control) · deed: convey real estate by formal sealed instrument (land / farm / house) · sign over: surrender legal title or control by formal endorsement (shares / custody / car)
groups.nuance_zh: convey: 依据产权让渡契据正式转让财产 (estate / property / rights) · assign: 依约将债权、版权等法定权益指派转让 (copyright / patent / debt) · cede: 迫于条约或战和压力割让领土权力 (territory / authority / control) · deed: 以房地契证正式移交不动产 (land / farm / house) · sign over: 签字画押移交资产支配权 (shares / custody / car)

groups.name: Transfer & Denationalize · 私有化与产权转让 (Deregulate, Outsource, Divest)
groups.tip: 将产权或权利移交他人

items.def_en: To transfer an industry or company from state control or ownership to private hands
items.ex_en: The government announced sweeping plans to denationalize the country's main railway network.
items.ex_zh: 政府宣布了将国家主要铁路网络推行非国有化的全面计划。

items.def_en: To hand over work or responsibilities to someone outside the organization
items.ex_en: The design agency decided to farm out the coding work to independent freelancers.
items.ex_zh: 这家设计机构决定把代码编写工作分包给独立的自由职业者。

items.def_en: To contract out public services or company operations to an external supplier
items.ex_en: The corporation opted to outsource customer service operations to a specialized call center.
items.ex_zh: 该跨国公司选择将客户服务业务外包给一家专业的呼叫中心。

items.def_en: To get rid of an asset, subsidiary, or business investment by selling it
items.ex_en: To pay down debt, the conglomerate decided to divest its non-core logistics subsidiary.
items.ex_zh: 为了偿还债务，该企业集团决定剥离其非核心物流子公司。

items.def_en: To sell a state-owned business, industry, or service to private individuals or companies.
items.ex_en: The finance ministry plans to privatize the state postal service by next year.
items.ex_zh: 财政部计划在明年之前将国家邮政服务彻底私有化。

items.def_zh: 使商业化；使转入市场化运营
items.def_en: To manage or organize an activity primarily to generate financial profit
items.ex_en: Critics argued that university laboratories should not commercialize fundamental scientific research so aggressively.
items.ex_zh: 批评人士指出，大学实验室不该如此激进地将基础科学研究商业化。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this economic and legal frame deal with releasing state, corporate, or public control by transferring ownership, assets, or operation into private or commercial hands.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及公有资产转为私有，或将控制权、资产剥离转让给商业机构。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe the transfer of state-owned enterprises, public assets, or functions into the private commercial sector, contrasting with plain 'sell' through macroeconomic and political privatization policies.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指将国有企业、公共资产或政府职能剥离并移交给私人商业部门运营，与一般商业'买卖'相比，立足于宏观体制改革、非国有化与市场化战略。
groups.nuance_en: privatize: sell state-owned corporations or utilities to private investors (railways / telecommunications / utilities) · outsource: subcontract internal operational functions to outside commercial suppliers (services / IT / customer support) · divest: strip away or sell off subsidiary assets or investments (assets / holdings / business) · denationalize: restore nationalized state industries to private enterprise (industry / coal / banks) · commercialize: reorient an enterprise or discovery primarily toward market profitability (invention / technology / research)
groups.nuance_zh: privatize: 实施国企民营化改造、公营转私营 (railways / telecommunications / utilities) · outsource: 将非核心内部职能外包给第三方外协 (services / IT / customer support) · divest: 战略性剥离、甩卖子公司或资产包 (assets / holdings / business) · denationalize: 撤销国有化、将产业回归私有 (industry / coal / banks) · commercialize: 推向市场运作、使其彻底商业化盈利 (invention / technology / research)

groups.name: Transfer & Shift · 转移与位移 (Relocate, Displace, Reposition)
groups.tip: 改变位置微调挪移

items.def_zh: 挪动，移动；转变，转移；换挡
items.def_en: 1. To move slightly or change position, or move something from one position to another. 2. To change opinions, plans, or direction. 3. To change gears in a vehicle.
items.ex_en: He shifted his chair closer to the fireplace to escape the draft.
items.ex_zh: 他把椅子往壁炉方向挪了挪，以避开穿堂风。
items.ex2_en: Public opinion shifted dramatically toward environmental protection after the catastrophic oil spill disaster.
items.ex2_zh: 在那场灾难性的漏油事故之后，公众舆论急剧转向环境保护。

items.def_en: To change the position of objects or shift one's weight back and forth restlessly
items.ex_en: The nervous speaker shuffled his notes while waiting for the audience to settle.
items.ex_zh: 紧张的演讲者一边慢吞吞地整理讲稿，一边等待听众安静下来。

items.def_en: To move even slightly, usually used in negative contexts or with effort
items.ex_en: Despite pushing together with all our might, the heavy boulder would not budge.
items.ex_zh: 尽管我们用尽全力一起推，那块沉重的巨石依然纹丝不动。
items.ex2_en: The strong movers could not budge the heavy piano up the steep steps.
items.ex2_zh: 强壮的搬运工们无法把那架沉重的钢琴挪上陡峭的台阶分毫。

items.def_en: To move something into a different location, orientation, or stance
items.ex_en: The nurse repositioned the pillows behind the patient to relieve his back strain.
items.ex_zh: 护士重新摆放了病人背后的枕头，以缓解他的背部疲劳。

items.def_en: To force something or someone out of its usual or proper place
items.ex_en: The sudden inland floods displaced hundreds of families from their low-lying homes.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的内陆洪水迫使数百户家庭流离失所，搬离低洼的住所。

items.def_en: To move oneself or something else to a new place to live or work
items.ex_en: The tech firm offered generous bonuses to employees willing to relocate to Seattle.
items.ex_zh: 该科技公司向愿意迁移至西雅图工作的员工提供了丰厚的奖金。
items.ex2_en: The global logistics company will relocate its primary European headquarters to Frankfurt soon.
items.ex2_zh: 这家全球物流公司不久将把其主要的欧洲总部迁至法兰克福。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to moving an entity slightly or substantially from one position, place, or orientation to another. Nuances range from subtle realignments to formal physical transfers.
groups.summary_zh: 指位置、方向或重心的改变与微调，涵盖轻微移动及正式挪移。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote altering the spatial coordinates, stance, or alignment of a physical or conceptual entity, contrasting with broad 'move' by specifying subtle increments, spatial dislocation, or tactical readjustment.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指改变物体或概念的空间位置、朝向或排列，与泛化的'移动'不同，侧重于微调、强迫性位移、策略性重置或细微挪动。
groups.nuance_en: shift: change position, direction, or emphasis slightly (weight / balance / policy) · relocate: move established operations or residents to a new permanent site (headquarters / family / factory) · displace: force out of an accustomed position, job, or home (population / workers / water) · reposition: adjust placement or strategic stance for better advantage (brand / troops / patient) · budge: move the slightest bit, usually under resistance (door / stubborn child / opinion)
groups.nuance_zh: shift: 改变重心、微调方位或转换焦点 (weight / balance / policy) · relocate: 将机构或家园迁址至新地点安置 (headquarters / family / factory) · displace: 挤占排挤、迫使其背井离乡或被迫退场 (population / workers / water) · reposition: 调整姿态或战略定位以争取主动 (brand / troops / patient) · budge: 顶着阻力产生丝毫微小的挪动 (door / stubborn child / opinion)

groups.name: Translate & Interpret · 翻译与诠释 (Interpret, Transpose, Paraphrase)
groups.tip: 跨语言转化与深层含义解读

items.def_en: 1. To change speech or writing from one language into another. 2. To change or be changed into a different form, condition, or result.
items.ex_en: She had to translate the complex diplomatic speech into Spanish within an hour.
items.ex_zh: 她必须在一小时内将那篇复杂的外交演讲翻译成西班牙语。
items.ex2_en: Theoretical scientific discoveries do not always translate easily into practical medical treatments worldwide.
items.ex2_zh: 理论上的科学发现并不总是能够轻而易举地转化为全球实用的医疗手段。

items.def_en: (+ into) Express or translate words or concepts into another language or artistic medium
items.ex_en: The talented scholar rendered the classical Chinese verses into elegant English prose.
items.ex_zh: 这位才华横溢的学者将那些古典诗句翻译成了优美的英文散文。

items.def_en: Translate orally what someone is saying in another language, or explain meaning
items.ex_en: A skilled linguist was hired to interpret the minister's remarks simultaneously during negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 一位专业语言学家受聘在谈判期间对部长的发言进行同声传译。

items.def_en: Express the meaning of written or spoken text using different words to make it clearer
items.ex_en: Try to paraphrase the author's complex argument using your own everyday vocabulary.
items.ex_zh: 试着用你自己的日常词汇来意译作者复杂的论点。

items.def_en: Put thoughts, speech, or data into written form or a different transcription code
items.ex_en: The research assistant had to transcribe several lengthy audio interviews into clear text.
items.ex_zh: 研究助理必须将几份冗长的采访录音逐字转写成清晰的文本。

items.def_en: Change or alter thoroughly in form, substance, appearance, or symbolic meaning
items.ex_en: Through intense heat, the alchemist hoped to transmute base metals into gleaming gold.
items.ex_zh: 炼金术士希望通过高温将贱金属转化为闪闪发光的黄金。
items.ex2_en: Raw emotional grief transmuted into powerful artistic expression through her inspiring musical compositions.
items.ex2_zh: 通过她鼓舞人心的音乐创作，内心的悲痛转化为了强大的艺术表达。

groups.summary_en: Relates to converting meaning from one linguistic or symbolic system into another, whether written, spoken, or figurative.
groups.summary_zh: 指将口头或书面信息从一种语言转换为另一种语言，或进行深层诠释。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote restating thoughts, speech, or texts across linguistic, medium, or stylistic boundaries, contrasting with simple 'say' by requiring semantic conversion and interpretative fidelity.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指在不同语种、媒介或文体之间转换复述意义与语篇，与简单的'说/讲'相比，涉及对深层意旨的解码、转译与重塑。
groups.nuance_en: translate: convert written or spoken words into another language (novel / speech / thoughts into action) · interpret: render spoken words extemporaneously into another language, or decipher underlying meaning (speech / dream / evidence) · render: translate artistically or express in a particular form or language (phrase / portrait / verdict) · paraphrase: reword a text to clarify or condense its meaning (passage / quote / author) · transcribe: write down spoken material or convert into a different script (interview / audio / notes)
groups.nuance_zh: translate: 跨语言书面/口头翻译，或将理念付诸现实 (novel / speech / thoughts into action) · interpret: 即席口译，或对玄奥证据意图进行阐发解读 (speech / dream / evidence) · render: 熔裁意译、艺术性地表现重现 (phrase / portrait / verdict) · paraphrase: 换用浅近语言改写意译以求明晰 (passage / quote / author) · transcribe: 将语音如实笔录记录，或转写符号 (interview / audio / notes)

groups.name: Trap & Decoy · 设伏引诱与诱捕 (Decoy, Trap, Ensnare)
groups.tip: 用假象设下诱饵引诱目标落入圈套

items.def_en: (+ in/into) To catch someone or an animal in a trap, or place them into a dangerous situation they cannot escape
items.ex_en: Heavy avalanches trapped several adventurous skiers inside the remote mountain chalet.
items.ex_zh: 汹涌的雪崩将几名喜欢冒险的滑雪者困在了偏僻的高山木屋里。

items.def_en: To persuade or trick someone into joining in an activity, chore, or project against their initial inclination
items.ex_en: My brother managed to rope me in to help paint his garage.
items.ex_zh: 我哥哥设法拉我入伙，帮他粉刷车库。

items.def_en: To lie in wait for and attack someone by surprise from a concealed position
items.ex_en: Rebel guerrillas hid behind rocks to ambush the armed military convoy at sunrise.
items.ex_zh: 叛军游击队藏在岩石后，在日出时伏击了那支全副武装的军用护送车队。

items.def_en: (+ into) To lure or trick a person or animal into a trap or danger by using bait or a distraction.
items.ex_en: The cunning hunter used a carved wooden bird to decoy the wild ducks.
items.ex_zh: 狡猾的猎人用一只雕刻的木鸟做诱饵，引诱野鸭落入陷阱。

items.def_en: To catch or trap someone or something in a snare or cunning trap from which escape is difficult
items.ex_en: The wicked moneylender used deceitful contract terms to ensnare the gullible shopkeeper.
items.ex_zh: 邪恶的高利贷者用欺诈性的合同条款诱使轻信的店主落入圈套。

items.def_zh: 诱陷，使入圈套（特指诱人犯法）
items.def_en: To trick someone into a situation, often an unlawful act, so they can be apprehended or prosecuted
items.ex_en: Undercover federal agents devised an elaborate sting operation to entrap the corrupt official.
items.ex_zh: 联邦卧底特工精心设计了一场诱捕行动，使那名腐败官员入罪。

groups.summary_en: This scenario frame captures the act of drawing a person, animal, or enemy into an inescapable predicament, snare, or ambush through strategic deception or false pretense. It highlights the calculated mechanics of entrapment.
groups.summary_zh: 指利用诱饵、伪装或诡计将目标引诱并困入圈套或险境的行为。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote luring or surprising a quarry into an inescapable predicament through stealth or bait, contrasting with overt 'capture' by depending on deception, concealed devices, or tactical trickery.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指利用伪装、诱饵或暗器使猎物陷入插翅难飞的绝境，与公开的'捕抓'不同，关键在于欺骗性、隐蔽性陷阱与诱敌深入。
groups.nuance_en: trap: catch in a mechanical snare or confine in an inescapable situation (animal / miners / market) · decoy: entice or lead into danger using a deceptive bait or lure (enemy / ducks / ships) · ambush: attack unexpectedly from a concealed hiding place (patrol / convoy / politician) · ensnare: entangle securely as if in a mesh or web (prey / unwary investors / heart) · entrap: trick someone into committing an offense or making an irreversible error (suspect / criminal / official)
groups.nuance_zh: trap: 设夹阱捕获，或使陷入封死困境 (animal / miners / market) · decoy: 以诱饵引开或诱敌深入险境 (enemy / ducks / ships) · ambush: 设伏伏击、隐蔽突袭 (patrol / convoy / politician) · ensnare: 像蛛网罗网般死死缠绕困住 (prey / unwary investors / heart) · entrap: 设局下套诱使人落水犯法 (suspect / criminal / official)

groups.name: Treat with Contempt & Scorn · 轻蔑与不敬 (Despise, Scorn, Disdain, Flout)
groups.tip: 从失礼冒犯到从心底鄙视

items.def_en: to consider oneself distinctly superior in status, intelligence, or morality to another
items.ex_en: She never looks down on anyone just because they come from a humble background.
items.ex_zh: 她绝不会仅仅因为别人出身平凡而看不起对方。

items.def_en: To treat or speak to someone with a lack of respect or courtesy.
items.ex_en: You should never disrespect your elderly grandparents by speaking in such a rude tone.
items.ex_zh: 你绝不该用这种粗鲁的语气说话，对年迈的祖父母如此不敬。

items.def_en: to look upon someone or something with proud aloofness as unworthy of one's notice
items.ex_en: The proud aristocrat disdained the crude flattery of the newly rich merchants.
items.ex_zh: 那位心高气傲的贵族对暴发户商人们粗鄙的奉承嗤之以鼻。

items.def_en: to feel a strong dislike accompanied by complete lack of respect for someone or something
items.ex_en: She despised dishonest politicians who made grandiose promises during election campaigns.
items.ex_zh: 她鄙视那些在竞选期间许下冠冕堂皇诺言的不诚实政客。

items.def_en: to treat someone or something with utter contempt or reject them with derision
items.ex_en: The arrogant aristocrat openly scorned the humble pleas of the impoverished villagers.
items.ex_zh: 傲慢的贵族公然蔑视贫困村民卑微的恳求。

items.def_zh: 公然蔑视；无视（法规或传统）
items.def_en: to openly disregard and mock a rule, law, or convention without hiding one's disobedience
items.ex_en: Several prominent corporations flout environmental regulations to maximize their short-term quarterly profits.
items.ex_zh: 几家知名企业公然无视环保法规，以最大化其季度短期利润。

groups.summary_en: Captures expressing deep lack of respect, active defiance, or disdain toward a person, rule, or institution. It ranges from verbal insolence to outright refusal to recognize authority.
groups.summary_zh: 指对人、规则或权威公然流露蔑视、嗤之以鼻或肆意冒犯。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame express viewing or treating others as beneath regard, worth, or legitimate authority, contrasting with mere 'dislike' by embodying haughty superiority, active derision, or deliberate defiance.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词表达对人对事居高临下的鄙弃、蔑视或公然藐视，与单纯的'不喜欢'区别在于自带傲慢优越感、耻与为伍的冷嘲或公然挑战法纪。
groups.nuance_en: despise: feel intense disgust coupled with profound moral contempt (cowardice / hypocrisy / liar) · scorn: reject or mock with bitter derision as unworthy of consideration (advice / offer / rules) · disdain: consider something as beneath one's dignity or status to do (bribe / excuse / company) · look down on: harbor a sense of class, moral, or intellectual superiority over (poor / foreigners / outsiders) · flout: openly and insolently violate a rule, convention, or authority (law / regulations / tradition)
groups.nuance_zh: despise: 结合深恶痛绝与极度鄙夷的鄙视 (cowardice / hypocrisy / liar) · scorn: 嗤之以鼻、尖刻地嘲讽抛弃 (advice / offer / rules) · disdain: 自持身份高贵而不屑一顾 (bribe / excuse / company) · look down on: 带有阶层或智力优越感的居高临下看不起 (poor / foreigners / outsiders) · flout: 明目张胆、毫不掩饰地公然藐视践踏法度 (law / regulations / tradition)

groups.name: Trigger & Activate · 触发启动与促动 (Actuate, Trigger, Motivate)
groups.tip: 触发启动并促使部件运转

items.def_en: To cause a device, system, or chain of events to function or happen suddenly
items.ex_en: A sudden drop in temperature can trigger severe power grid failures across the region.
items.ex_zh: 气温骤降会触发该地区严重的电网故障。

items.def_en: To provide someone with a strong reason, desire, or purpose for acting in a certain way
items.ex_en: Generous performance bonuses motivate employees to exceed their annual sales targets consistently.
items.ex_zh: 丰厚的绩效奖金激励着员工不断超越年度销售目标。

items.def_en: To encourage, cause, or induce someone to take immediate action or say something
items.ex_en: Mounting public outrage prompted the ministry to initiate an immediate independent inquiry.
items.ex_zh: 日益高涨的公众愤怒促使该部立即展开独立调查。

items.def_en: To make a device, chemical process, or system start operating or become active
items.ex_en: Smoke detectors in the hallway activate the automated sprinkler system within seconds.
items.ex_zh: 走廊里的烟雾探测器会在几秒钟内启动自动喷淋系统。
items.ex2_en: The home security alarm activates automatically whenever someone opens the front entrance door.
items.ex2_zh: 每当有人打开正门时，家庭安防报警系统就会自动激活启动。

items.def_en: To cause a mechanical switch, alarm, explosive, or sequence of actions to go off
items.ex_en: The mischievous stray cat set off the sensitive burglar alarm at midnight.
items.ex_zh: 那只淘气的流浪猫在半夜触响了灵敏的防盗警报器。

items.def_zh: 驱动，促使运转；激励，驱使
items.def_en: 1. (technical) To cause a machine, device, or mechanism to operate. 2. (formal) To motivate someone to act in a certain way.
items.ex_en: An intricate hydraulic mechanism actuates the heavy steel blast doors of the bunker.
items.ex_zh: 一套复杂的液压机构驱动着地堡沉重的钢制防爆门。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on initiating an operational process or motivating behavior, operating both mechanically (setting a device in motion) and psychologically (prompting someone to act). The frame spans from physical trip mechanisms to inner psychological drivers.
groups.summary_zh: 指机械装置被触发运转，或内在动机、外界刺激促使某人采取行动。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe initiating a dynamic operation, chain reaction, or behavioral cascade from a latent state, contrasting with gentle 'begin' by embodying a catalytic spark or mechanical ignition.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词指触动特定机关使事物从潜伏静止状态突变为连锁反应或启动运行，与平缓的'开始'不同，强调发火点、导火索或机械联动效应。
groups.nuance_en: trigger: release a mechanism that sets off an explosive or chain event (recession / alarm / memory) · activate: put a dormant device, system, or biological agent into active service (card / emergency response / enzyme) · set off: ignite a blast or provoke a volatile, immediate reaction (fireworks / riot / chemical explosion) · actuate: put into mechanical motion or incite to a specific course of conduct (mechanism / valve / motives) · prompt: serve as the immediate inducing cause for an action or remark (investigation / inquiry / resignation)
groups.nuance_zh: trigger: 抠动扳机、引爆连锁反应或激起记忆 (recession / alarm / memory) · activate: 激活潜伏的系统、设备或细胞机能 (card / emergency response / enzyme) · set off: 点燃引信、骤然引发骚乱或爆炸 (fireworks / riot / chemical explosion) · actuate: 驱动机械部件运转，或内在动机促发行为 (mechanism / valve / motives) · prompt: 促使催生下一步应对言行 (investigation / inquiry / resignation)

groups.name: Trudge & Slog · 泥泞跋涉与艰难慢行 (Slush, Trudge, Slog, Wade)
groups.tip: 脚步沉重艰难地缓行

items.def_zh: 在雪泥（或泥浆）中跋涉；溅泼（泥浆等）
items.def_en: 1. To walk or trudge through melting snow, slush, or mud. 2. To splash liquid or slush around, or cover with slush.
items.ex_en: Weary commuters had to slush through dirty melting snow along the busy avenue.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的通勤者不得不沿着繁忙的大街在肮脏的融雪中艰难跋涉。

items.def_en: (+ through) To make a wet sucking sound while walking through thick mud or wet ground
items.ex_en: Heavy boots squelched through thick sodden mud during the sudden autumn downpour.
items.ex_zh: 在突如其来的秋季暴雨中，沉重的靴子踏过泥泞湿地，发出湿答答的声响。

items.def_en: (+ through) To walk through relatively deep water, mud, or snow with effort as it impedes motion
items.ex_en: Rescuers had to wade through waist-deep floodwaters to reach stranded elderly residents.
items.ex_zh: 救援人员不得不蹚过齐腰深的洪水去救助被困的老年居民。

items.def_en: (+ through/along) To walk slowly with heavy, laboured steps, especially through mud, deep snow, or when exhausted
items.ex_en: Exhausted soldiers trudged through the blizzard, barely able to carry their heavy rifles.
items.ex_zh: 精疲力竭的士兵在暴风雪中吃力地跋涉，几乎扛不动沉重的步枪。

items.def_en: (+ through/along) To walk with slow, heavy steps in a monotonous and unhurried way
items.ex_en: The tired farmer plodded along the dusty rural lane toward his cottage.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的农夫迈着沉重缓慢的步伐，沿着尘土飞扬的乡间小道走向村舍。

items.def_en: (+ through) To walk or progress with strenuous, exhausting effort through rough ground or bad conditions
items.ex_en: We had to slog through miles of swamp before reaching dry campsite ground.
items.ex_zh: 我们不得不艰难穿过数英里的沼泽，才到达干燥的露营地。

groups.summary_en: Describes walking through deep mud, snow, wet slush, or water where heavy resistance forces slow, clumsy, and exhausting steps. 'Slog' stresses punishing physical toll, whereas 'wade' involves moving through depth.
groups.summary_zh: 指在烂泥、积雪或泥水等阻力重重的湿泞地面艰难跋涉。
groups.desc_en: Locomotion performed against heavy physical resistance or through viscous media, contrasting with neutral walking by emphasizing exhausting effort, dragging weight, and auditory or tactile drag.
groups.desc_zh: 在黏滞介质或沉重阻力下艰难跋涉，区别于普通行走的轻松，侧重拖曳感、体力耗竭及泥泞环境特有的阻滞力。
groups.nuance_en: trudge: weary, heavy-footed pacing under burden (snow / miles / weary steps) · slog: grueling, sustained grinding through resistance (mud / uphill / coursework) · plod: slow, mechanical, unimaginative stepping (donkey / rhythm / routine) · wade: walking against viscous immersion (shallow water / mud / paperwork) · squelch: wet, sucking acoustic stepping (mud / bog / sodden turf)
groups.nuance_zh: trudge: 步履沉重疲惫地长途跋涉 (snow / miles / weary steps) · slog: 顶着阻力艰辛磨人地迈进 (mud / uphill / coursework) · plod: 迟缓机械、乏味单调地前行 (donkey / rhythm / routine) · wade: 克服阻力在浸润介质中涉水跋涉 (shallow water / mud / paperwork) · squelch: 伴随泥泞吸吮声的湿漉行走 (mud / bog / sodden turf)

groups.name: Tunnel & Bore · 掘进与凿穿 (Bore, Burrow, Pierce)
groups.tip: 在土石障碍中钻探开辟通道

items.def_en: To systematically force or excavate a tunnel, shaft, or adit horizontally through solid earth
items.ex_en: Engineers drive a railway tunnel directly through solid granite beneath the rugged mountain.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们在险峻山峦下的坚硬花岗岩中直接掘进一条铁路隧道。

items.def_en: To dig deep into the earth to extract minerals or construct military subterranean saps
items.ex_en: Miners mined deep underground shafts to reach rich seams of high-grade copper ore.
items.ex_zh: 矿工们挖掘深邃的地下矿井，以开采富集的高品位铜矿脉。

items.def_en: To make a deep, cylindrical hole or passage in something solid by hollow drilling or digging
items.ex_en: Specialized machinery bored a deep cylindrical passage through the reinforced concrete foundation.
items.ex_zh: 专用机械在钢筋混凝土基座上钻出了一条深邃的圆柱形通道。

items.def_zh: 开凿隧道，掘地道穿过；在……中挖掘
items.def_en: 1. To dig or burrow a tunnel through, under, or into something.
items.ex_en: Workers tunneled through the rocky hillside to create a safe underground drainage channel.
items.ex_zh: 工人们在多石的山坡中开凿隧道，以建造一条安全的地下排水暗渠。
