items.def_en: To fit closely together or intertwine like interlocking threads or net strands
items.ex_en: The heavy brass gears mesh seamlessly to power the grandfather clock's pendulum.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的黄铜齿轮紧密啮合，驱动着落地式大座钟的摆轮运行。

items.def_en: To capture animals or obtain resources by casting or surrounding them with a net
items.ex_en: Local fishermen net hundreds of fresh sardines near the coastline every single morning.
items.ex_zh: 当地渔民每天清晨都在海岸线附近用网捕捞数百条新鲜沙丁鱼。

items.def_zh: 结网，织网；使落入圈套，使缠入网中
items.def_en: 1. To construct or form a web; to trap or envelop in a web.
items.ex_en: Dark shadows web the narrow cobblestone alleyways beneath the pale autumn moonlight.
items.ex_zh: 苍白的秋夜月光下，阴暗的阴影如网般笼罩着狭窄的鹅卵石巷弄。

items.def_en: To catch or trap an animal or person using a snare, net, or cunning web of deception
items.ex_en: The poacher set concealed steel traps along the forest pathway to ensnare deer.
items.ex_zh: 偷猎者沿林间小道设下隐秘的钢夹，用来诱捕过往的鹿群。

items.def_en: To catch, entangle, or trap someone or something as if in a tight net or complex snare
items.ex_en: Greed threatened to enmesh the ambitious young lawyer in an intricate web of corruption.
items.ex_zh: 贪婪险些将这位野心勃勃的年轻律师深陷于错综复杂的腐败罗网之中。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame evoke the specialized act of producing interconnected, delicate, lattice-like networks or webbings, often with the secondary sense of entrapping or binding tightly.
groups.summary_zh: 专指纺丝结网、形成多孔网格结构，常引申为使深陷罗网或重重包裹。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the creation of an interlocking mesh or network, often extending metaphorically to complex trapping or complicity, unlike linear 'link'.
groups.desc_zh: 强调将纤维、经纬结成网状物，并延伸至制造复杂圈套、使深陷困境，区别于单一串联的'link'。
groups.nuance_en: spin: draw out and twist fibers into continuous thread, or construct a web (yarn / web / cocoon) · mesh: interlock smoothly like gear teeth or open-weave strands (gears / ideas / networks) · enmesh: deeply entangle or entrap in a complicated web-like situation (conspiracy / scandal / nets) · ensnare: capture firmly in a trap or deceptive scheme (victim / prey / mind) · net: capture with a meshed fabric or secure an ultimate gain (fish / profit / suspect)
groups.nuance_zh: spin: 纺纱、吐丝结网 (yarn / web / cocoon) · mesh: 像网孔或齿轮般紧密吻合、互锁 (gears / ideas / networks) · enmesh: 使深陷错综复杂的困境或丑闻中 (conspiracy / scandal / nets) · ensnare: 设下罗网或诡计予以诱捕陷害 (victim / prey / mind) · net: 用网捕捞，或最终收割净利 (fish / profit / suspect)

groups.name: Wet & Moisten · 浸湿与润湿 (Douse, Drench, Moisten)
groups.tip: 由表层微润到内外彻底濡湿

items.def_en: To scatter tiny drops of water or liquid over a surface
items.ex_en: Remember to sprinkle cool fresh water over the delicate lettuce leaves before serving.
items.ex_zh: 上菜前记得在娇嫩的生菜叶上喷洒些清凉的清水。

items.def_en: To make something slightly wet or less dry
items.ex_en: Gently moisten a soft cotton cloth to clean the valuable ancient oil painting.
items.ex_zh: 轻轻润湿一块柔软的棉布，以清理珍贵的古代油画。
items.ex2_en: Her tired eyes began to moisten with tears of pure relief.
items.ex2_zh: 她疲惫的双眼因全然释怀而开始湿润起来。

items.def_en: To flow over or splash across something in a spreading sheet of water
items.ex_en: A sudden foamy wave began to wash over the wooden deck during high tide.
items.ex_zh: 涨潮时分，一股突如其来的泡沫海浪涌过木制甲板将其冲湿。

items.def_en: to make something wet; to urinate in or on something accidentally
items.ex_en: Do not wet the fresh surgical bandage while taking a morning shower today.
items.ex_zh: 今天早上洗淋浴时，切记不要把刚换上的外科敷料弄湿。

items.def_en: To pour a large amount of liquid over someone or something abruptly
items.ex_en: Campers douse the glowing embers with buckets of cold water before leaving camp.
items.ex_zh: 露营者在离开营地前用多桶冷水彻底浇灭发光的余烬。

items.def_en: To make someone or something completely and thoroughly wet
items.ex_en: A torrential midnight downpour threatened to drench the hikers without proper waterproof gear.
items.ex_zh: 一场午夜倾盆大雨眼看就要将缺乏有效防雨装备的徒步者完全淋透。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the application of water or fluid to an object or surface, spanning the spectrum from slight dampening to pouring liquid generously over it.
groups.summary_zh: 指将液体洒在或涂在物体上使其变湿，程度可从微润延伸至彻底浇湿。
groups.desc_en: Describes the application of liquid to an absorbent or dry surface, differentiated along a continuum of intensity and saturation from slight moisture to total soaking.
groups.desc_zh: 指液体附着或渗入干燥物体的过程，依照液体浸润量及渗透程度（微湿至彻底湿透）构成强度级差。
groups.nuance_en: moisten: dampen slightly without saturating (lips / cloth / soil) · wet: apply liquid to make damp or moist (hair / whistle / bed) · sprinkle: scatter fine droplets or particles lightly over a surface (water / sugar / lawn) · drench: soak thoroughly and heavily with liquid (rain / sweat / storm) · douse: plunge into liquid or drench suddenly with copious liquid (flames / lights / head)
groups.nuance_zh: moisten: 轻度微润、防止干涸 (lips / cloth / soil) · wet: 使变湿、沾水 (hair / whistle / bed) · sprinkle: 稀疏喷洒或洒水于表面 (water / sugar / lawn) · drench: 彻底湿透、暴雨浇透 (rain / sweat / storm) · douse: 猛烈兜头倾泼液体，或用水灭火 (flames / lights / head)

groups.name: Whirlpool & Vortex · 漩涡与回旋流动 (Swirl, Eddy, Vortex)
groups.tip: 绕轴打转或形成漩涡

items.def_en: To move in a circular direction against the main current of water or wind
items.ex_en: Fallen autumn leaves eddy gently behind the mossy rocks in the shallow mountain stream.
items.ex_zh: 飘落的秋叶在浅浅的山间溪流中，绕着生满苔藓的岩石打着旋儿逆流漂动。

items.def_en: To move quickly around and around in a circular or spiraling pattern
items.ex_en: Cold gusts of winter wind swirl the freshly fallen snowflakes across the empty parking lot.
items.ex_zh: 凛冽的冬风吹拂着，使新落的雪花在空旷的停车场上旋转打转。
items.ex2_en: Dense grey smoke began to swirl lazily above the cold stone chimney.
items.ex2_zh: 浓密的灰烟在冰冷的石烟囱上方懒散地打着旋。

items.def_en: To open or churn in deep, engulfing swirling movements
items.ex_en: The stormy black sea seemed to chasm and swirl around the tiny fishing boat.
items.ex_zh: 狂风肆虐的漆黑大海仿佛在微小的渔船周围深旋吞卷，形成万丈深渊。

items.def_en: To revolve rapidly around a center or axis in a wild circular motion
items.ex_en: The powerful storm system began to gyrate wildly as it reached the open ocean.
items.ex_zh: 强烈的风暴系统在抵达开阔洋面时开始疯狂地急转回旋。

items.def_en: To spiral rapidly inward or outward in the manner of a powerful vortex
items.ex_en: Angry floodwaters vortex into the drainage opening, creating a terrifying hollow roar beneath.
items.ex_zh: 汹涌的洪水向排水口急转打旋形成漩涡，在下方发出可怖的空洞咆哮。

items.def_en: To swirl, spin, or move rapidly in a circular motion like a whirlpool.
items.ex_en: Dark murky waters whirlpool through the narrow rocky gorge after the heavy dam release.
items.ex_zh: 大坝强力放水后，幽暗浑浊的激流在狭窄的岩石峡谷中奔腾打转形成旋涡。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame characterize fluids, air, or loose material spiraling inward or outward in circular, turbulent motion resembling a vortex or maelstrom. While 'swirl' covers rapid rotational sweeps, 'eddy' suggests counter-current spiraling rings.
groups.summary_zh: 指液体、气流或物质如漩涡般飞速盘旋流动。
groups.desc_en: Captures rapid, circular, or spiraling fluid dynamics involving suction or rotational turbulence, contrasting with laminar 'flow' or linear 'rush'.
groups.desc_zh: 描摹流体快速旋转、回旋并伴有向心吸力的涡流动态，区别于层流平稳的'flow'或直线的'rush'。
groups.nuance_en: swirl: move in graceful or rapid curving and twisting paths (dust / currents / skirt) · eddy: move in small circular counter-currents against a main stream (water / smoke / wind) · vortex: rapidly draw into a violently rotating central sink (current / hurricane / void) · gyrate: rotate or oscillate rapidly around a fixed axis (hips / markets / wheels) · whirlpool: churn violently in a circular aqueous suction basin (river / sea / waters)
groups.nuance_zh: swirl: 翻滚盘旋或蜿蜒旋转 (dust / currents / skirt) · eddy: （逆主流而动的）小漩涡或逆流团 (water / smoke / wind) · vortex: 形成巨大向心吸力的旋转涡心 (current / hurricane / void) · gyrate: 围绕中心轴高速旋转或震荡扭动 (hips / markets / wheels) · whirlpool: 水流剧烈交汇翻滚形成的致命吸力水旋 (river / sea / waters)

groups.name: Wind & Meander · 蜿蜒与曲折穿行 (Wind, Snake, Meander)
groups.tip: 蜿蜒曲折缠绕前行

items.def_en: 1. To twist, wrap, or coil around something. 2. To follow a curving, bending, or twisting course.
items.ex_en: Paved country roads wind pleasantly through the rolling green hills and silent pine forests.
items.ex_zh: 平整的乡村公路怡人地蜿蜒穿行于起伏的青翠山丘与静谧松林之间。
items.ex2_en: The seamstress carefully wound the colorful thread around the smooth wooden spool.
items.ex2_zh: 女裁缝小心翼翼地把彩线缠绕在光滑的木线轴上。

items.def_en: To follow a winding, turning course with gentle curves, characteristic of rivers or leisurely paths
items.ex_en: Shallow clear streams meander quietly across the peaceful meadows toward the distant blue lake.
items.ex_zh: 清澈的浅溪在宁静的草甸间静静蜿蜒流淌，奔向远处的碧蓝湖泊。

items.def_en: To bend, curve, or turn repeatedly while progressing forward or being shaped
items.ex_en: Ancient cobbled paths twist unpredictably around the steep cliffs of the old mountain village.
items.ex_zh: 古老的鹅卵石小道沿着古老山村陡峭的悬崖曲折盘旋向前。

items.def_en: To move or extend in long, sinuous bends and curves across an area
items.ex_en: The silver tracks snake through the vast desert plain, disappearing into the distant horizon.
items.ex_zh: 银色的铁轨在广袤的荒漠平原上如蛇般曲折延伸，消失在遥远的地平线。

items.def_en: To arrange or wind into a series of concentric circles or tight loops
items.ex_en: The sailor carefully coiled the heavy mooring rope into tidy circles on the wooden dock.
items.ex_zh: 水手把沉重的系泊绳小心地在木码头上盘成整齐的同心圆。
items.ex2_en: The thick rope coiled smoothly on the wooden deck without any tangles.
items.ex2_zh: 粗绳平顺地盘绕在木质甲板上，没有任何缠结。

items.def_en: To move by turning frequently and dodging between obstacles or people
items.ex_en: The courier weaved swiftly through the crowded market stalls on his battered delivery bicycle.
items.ex_zh: 快递员骑着破旧的送货自行车，在拥挤的集市摊位间灵活穿梭。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe following a circuitous, sinuous, or weaving route, or physically wrapping something around an axis in loops. Key distinctions hinge on whether the motion is fluid natural meandering, deliberate zigzagging, or physical coiling.
groups.summary_zh: 表示路径或轨迹的曲折蜿蜒，或物体本身的盘绕与缠裹。
groups.desc_en: Describes continuous movement along an indirect, sinuous, or curvilinear course across terrain, contrasting with direct, rectilinear 'advance'.
groups.desc_zh: 指沿着弯曲、回旋或蛇形路线蜿蜒穿行于空间，区别于笔直推进的'advance'。
groups.nuance_en: wind: follow an intricate curved course with frequent bends (road / path / river) · meander: wander aimlessly or take an idle winding route (stream / conversation / path) · snake: move with serpentine, side-to-side sinuous curves (train / queue / river) · twist: contort or turn sharply and unpredictably (lane / ankle / plot) · weave: move skillfully by continuously changing direction to bypass obstacles (traffic / crowd / way)
groups.nuance_zh: wind: 沿曲折多弯的既定路线延伸或盘行 (road / path / river) · meander: 漫无目的、慵懒从容地曲折流淌或闲逛 (stream / conversation / path) · snake: 如长蛇般蜿蜒穿梭或排成长龙 (train / queue / river) · twist: 突兀急转或扭曲变道 (lane / ankle / plot) · weave: 在人群或车流障碍中左右穿插规避 (traffic / crowd / way)

groups.name: Witness & Observe · 目击与见证 (Eyewitness, Witness, Testify to)
groups.tip: 亲眼目睹事件发生的实况

items.def_en: To see something happen, especially a crime, accident, or significant event, with one's own eyes
items.ex_en: Several passersby stepped forward to witness the formal signing of the historic peace accord.
items.ex_zh: 几位路人走上前去，亲眼见证了这份历史性和平协议的正式签署。

items.def_en: To notice or watch an occurrence attentively, taking note of details as an onlooker
items.ex_en: The laboratory technician quietly observed the cellular reaction through a high-powered electronic microscope.
items.ex_zh: 实验室技术员通过高倍电子显微镜静静观察细胞反应。

items.def_en: To watch an activity or incident taking place without taking part yourself
items.ex_en: Helpless pedestrians could only look on as floodwaters rapidly submerged the parked vehicles.
items.ex_zh: 无助的行人们只能站在一旁，眼睁睁看着洪水迅速淹没停放的车辆。

items.def_en: To provide evidence or personal confirmation of something based on what one has observed
items.ex_en: The preserved ancient ruins testify to the remarkable architectural skills of that lost civilization.
items.ex_zh: 保存完好的古代遗址见证了那个消失文明卓越的建筑技艺。

items.def_en: (+ to) To declare or prove that something is genuine or true based on personal observation or evidence
items.ex_en: Two independent appraisers attested to the authenticity of the newly discovered Renaissance painting.
items.ex_zh: 两位独立的鉴定专家证实了这幅新发现的文艺复兴时期画作的真实性。

items.def_en: To see an event, crime, or accident personally with one's own eyes.
items.ex_en: The night watchman happened to eyewitness the daring museum robbery from across the street.
items.ex_zh: 值夜班的守卫恰好从街对面目睹了这场大胆的博物馆抢劫案。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on directly perceiving an event, crime, accident, or historical moment in person, thereby becoming an evidentiary observer. Nuances contrast being a formal bystander witness with bearing legal or moral testimony.
groups.summary_zh: 强调亲眼目睹特定事件、突发事故或历史瞬间，具备见证与作证意味。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on presence at an event coupled with sensory reception, often serving as a factual basis for testimony, unlike casual 'glance' or disengaged 'hear'.
groups.desc_zh: 强调亲历事件现场并亲眼目睹其发生，具备作为后续证实或证言的认知效力，区别于随意的'glance'或不相关的'hear'。
groups.nuance_en: witness: be personally present and see an occurrence firsthand (crime / accident / miracle) · observe: watch carefully and analytically for scientific or legal record (behavior / phenomena / patient) · look on: spectate passively as a bystander without participating (crowd / scene / passers-by) · testify to: formally declare truth or factuality based on firsthand knowledge (character / truth / efficacy) · attest: certify or serve as clear evidence of validity (signature / document / quality)
groups.nuance_zh: witness: 亲历并目睹事件全过程 (crime / accident / miracle) · observe: 带有科学或审慎目的系统性观察 (behavior / phenomena / patient) · look on: 作为旁观者袖手旁观 (crowd / scene / passers-by) · testify to: 基于亲眼所见提供正式证言或证明 (character / truth / efficacy) · attest: 官方证实或提供确凿凭据 (signature / document / quality)

groups.name: Witness & Testify · 见证与目击 (Witness, Behold, Attest)
groups.tip: 亲身在场见证事件发生

items.def_zh: 经历；亲眼看见（时代变迁等）
items.def_en: To be the setting or time of an event, or to observe an incident firsthand
items.ex_en: The early nineteenth century saw rapid industrial development throughout northern English manufacturing towns.
items.ex_zh: 十九世纪初目睹了英格兰北部各制造重镇迅速的工业发展。

items.def_zh: 目击，亲眼看见；见证（重大事件、变革等）；作证
items.def_en: 1. To see something happen, especially a crime, accident, or historical event. 2. To experience or be the time or setting of an event or change. 3. To give evidence or sign a document as an official witness.
items.ex_en: The city witnessed unprecedented civil unrest during the final weeks of the disputed election.
items.ex_zh: 这座城市在争议选举的最后几周里经历了前所未有的骚乱。

items.def_en: To watch an activity or event taking place without participating directly
items.ex_en: Dozens of curious spectators gathered to look on as firefighters battled the blazing warehouse.
items.ex_zh: 数十名好奇的围观群众聚集在现场，看着消防员扑救燃烧的仓库。

items.def_en: (+ to) To show, testify, or furnish evidence that something occurred or is authentic
items.ex_en: The crumbling cathedral stones bear witness to centuries of brutal sieges and divine devotion.
items.ex_zh: 大教堂残破的石砖见证了数百年残酷的围城与虔诚的信仰。

items.def_zh: 目睹；看见（尤指非同寻常之物）
items.def_en: To gaze upon or perceive someone or something, often with awe, admiration, or surprise
items.ex_en: The mountaineers paused on the snowy ridge to behold the magnificent sunrise across valleys.
items.ex_zh: 登山者们在雪脊上驻足，肃然凝视着山谷间瑰丽磅礴的日出。

items.def_en: (+ to) To declare, confirm, or provide evidence that something exists or is true from observation
items.ex_en: Extensive field excavations attest to the existence of an advanced trade network here.
items.ex_zh: 广泛的实地发掘证实了此地曾存在过高度发达的贸易网络。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on being physically present to see an occurrence personally (often crimes, historical turning points, or natural phenomena), thereby possessing firsthand experiential knowledge that can substantiate testimony.
groups.summary_zh: 指亲临现场目睹事件发生，成为第一手历史或法律见证者。
groups.desc_en: Emphasizes the formal, solemn, or judicial role of verifying truth through direct personal sighting and solemn confirmation, contrasting with private 'watch'.
groups.desc_zh: 突显通过亲眼所见并在法庭、仪式或历史中予以郑重证实与作证的庄严维度，区别于私下的'watch'。
groups.nuance_en: bear witness: offer solemn verbal or written testimony to a historical or spiritual truth (truth / history / suffering) · witness: see firsthand and validate under legal or moral scrutiny (will / signature / event) · attest: confirm officially that something is genuine or true (credentials / veracity / fact) · behold: gaze upon with wonder, awe, or solemn reverence (splendor / vision / beauty) · see: perceive fundamentally with the eyes without necessary formal obligation (evidence / light / changes)
groups.nuance_zh: bear witness: 郑重见证并为历史或真理代言作证 (truth / history / suffering) · witness: 亲身在场见证并签署或确认法律事实 (will / signature / event) · attest: 官方或权威地出具证明确认真实性 (credentials / veracity / fact) · behold: 带着敬畏、肃穆或惊叹之情注视 (splendor / vision / beauty) · see: 基础的视觉感知与获悉 (evidence / light / changes)

groups.name: Work & Drudge · 劳作与苦役 (Drudge, Moil, Scullion)
groups.tip: 从事枯燥繁重乏味的苦工

items.def_en: To engage in routine, tedious domestic or farm maintenance tasks
items.ex_en: He spent every Saturday chores around the barn instead of playing with his friends.
items.ex_zh: 他每个星期六都在谷仓周围干零碎杂活，而不是和朋友们一起玩耍。

items.def_en: (+ at) To perform repetitive, tedious work persistently without inspiration
items.ex_en: The tired clerk continued to hack away at the endless backlog of data entries.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的文员继续机械地埋头处理积压如山的单调数据录入。

items.def_en: (+ at) To continue doing monotonous, painstaking tasks with quiet persistence
items.ex_en: She decided to peg away at her revisions despite having a severe splitting headache.
items.ex_zh: 尽管头痛欲裂，她还是决定静下心来默默苦干进行复习。

items.def_en: To work hard in wet, dirty, or tedious conditions; to drudge endlessly
items.ex_en: The weary peasants were forced to moil endlessly in the muddy rice fields.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的农夫们被迫在泥泞的稻田里日复一日地辛劳苦作。

items.def_en: (+ away/along) To drudge along doing lowly, dirty, or dull work
items.ex_en: He had to grub away at low-paying warehouse gigs to pay his overdue rent.
items.ex_zh: 他只得在低薪仓库里当苦工打拼，以此偿还拖欠的房租。

items.def_zh: 做苦工，做繁重枯燥的工作
items.def_en: (+ away/at) To do hard, dull, and monotonous work for long periods.
items.ex_en: The solitary archivist drudged away at indexing crumbling manuscripts inside the dimly lit vault.
items.ex_zh: 孤单的档案员在昏暗的地窖里，日复一日枯燥地编目那些风化脆弱的手稿。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame emphasize enduring thankless, subordinate, boring, and soul-crushing drudgery in humble or domestic settings.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重于从事枯燥低微、缺乏报酬与成就感的牛马式杂务劳碌与下等苦差事。
groups.desc_en: Denotes continuous, monotonous, physically exhausting labor under tedious or humble conditions, contrasting with creative or intellectual 'work'.
groups.desc_zh: 指在枯燥、卑微或艰苦环境下从事持续且身心俱疲的繁重劳役，区别于富有创造性的'work'。
groups.nuance_en: drudge: perform hard, menial, and thoroughly uninspiring tasks (kitchen / office / all day) · moil: work strenuously amid dirty or chaotic physical conditions (pit / mine / farm) · grub: dig, root, or toil clumsily in dirt or obscurity (potatoes / roots / living) · peg away: persistently and doggedly labor at a tedious task (job / revision / project) · hack away: chop laboriously or struggle steadily through a huge chore (jungle / backlog / code)
groups.nuance_zh: drudge: 做牛做马般从事单调卑下的苦活 (kitchen / office / all day) · moil: 在脏乱艰险环境下流汗苦干 (pit / mine / farm) · grub: 像在泥土中翻扒般吃力地刨挖或谋生 (potatoes / roots / living) · peg away: 坚韧顽固地埋头死磕枯燥活计 (job / revision / project) · hack away: 笨拙费劲地砍削或逐步啃下沉重任务 (jungle / backlog / code)

groups.name: Yield & Relent · 屈服与松口 (Relent, Succumb, Cede)
groups.tip: 协商中放弃坚持并放宽要求

items.def_en: (+ to) To finally agree to something after adamantly refusing, surrendering to insistence
items.ex_en: The exhausted mother finally gave in to her toddler's relentless pleas for another cookie.
items.ex_zh: 筋疲力尽的母亲最终还是妥协让步，答应了幼儿吵着再要一块饼干的请求。

items.def_en: (+ to) To cease resisting someone's relentless pressure, demands, or influence
items.ex_en: The defensive line refused to yield to the immense pressure from the advancing enemy.
items.ex_zh: 防守部队拒不屈服于推进中敌军施加的巨大压力。

items.def_zh: 变宽厚，松口妥协，让步；（恶劣天气或严酷态势）减弱，放缓
items.def_en: To finally agree to something you previously refused, or to become less severe, strict, or harsh.
items.ex_en: The manager sternly refused his request initially but eventually relented after hearing the explanation.
items.ex_zh: 经理起初严词拒绝了他的请求，但在听完解释后最终松口妥协了。

items.def_en: (+ to) To suddenly collapse one's resistance and capitulate entirely under heavy pressure
items.ex_en: The town council had to cave in to the angry protesters after massive demonstrations.
items.ex_zh: 在经历了大规模游行示威后，市议会不得不向愤怒的抗议者彻底服软。

items.def_en: (+ to) To lose the determination or physical ability to fight against a superior power
items.ex_en: Weakened by hypothermia, the lost hiker finally succumbed to the freezing Arctic temperatures overnight.
items.ex_zh: 因体温过低而虚弱不堪的迷路徒步者，终究招架不住一夜之间北极般的严寒。

items.def_en: (+ to) To stop fighting or resisting and accept the opposing side's demands
items.ex_en: The besieged garrison chose to capitulate to the overwhelming rebel forces at daybreak yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 被重重围困的守军于昨日破晓时分选择停止抵抗，向兵力占优的叛军投降。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe giving way to mounting pressure, fatigue, or moral persuasion after an initial phase of strict resistance. The nuance highlights psychological softening, abandoning an intransigent stance, or eventually bowing to force.
groups.summary_zh: 强调原先态度强硬或坚决抵抗，最终在压力或劝说下心软松动、让步服软。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves retreating or ceasing resistance under external force or moral pressure, differing from plain 'stopping' by implying a prior struggle and an acknowledged loss of agency.
groups.desc_zh: 核心认知图式为在外部压力、诱惑或道义感化下放弃抵抗与对峙；区别于单纯的“停止”，本框架强调先前的僵持抗衡及最终自主权的妥协让步。
groups.nuance_en: give in: everyday surrender to insistent pressure (demands / tears) · yield: formal or physical submission to superior force (ground / sovereignty / pressure) · relent: softening of initial harshness or determination (persecution / attitude) · cave in: sudden complete collapse of resistance (pressure / demands) · succumb: final loss to overwhelming illness, temptation, or force (temptation / illness / injuries) · capitulate: formal structured surrender under set conditions (rebels / government / ultimatum)
groups.nuance_zh: give in: 日常口语中对软磨硬泡的让步妥协 (demands / tears) · yield: 正式或物理意义上向优势力量退让屈服 (ground / sovereignty / pressure) · relent: 态度由严厉强硬转向和解松口 (persecution / attitude) · cave in: 在巨大压力下心理防线全面崩塌屈从 (pressure / demands) · succumb: 最终被重病、诱惑或压倒性力量击垮 (temptation / illness / injuries) · capitulate: 严格条件下的正式投降或彻底缴械 (rebels / government / ultimatum)

groups.name: Zigzag & Tack · 蜿蜒转折与交替折向 (Zigzag, Weave, Tack, Dogleg)
groups.tip: 呈Z字形曲折蛇形前行

items.def_en: change the course of a boat or travel diagonally back and forth across a direct heading
items.ex_en: The schooner was forced to tack repeatedly across the bay against the fierce gale.
items.ex_zh: 那艘纵帆船被迫在海湾中顶着狂风反复抢风曲折航行。

items.def_en: bend sharply at an angle resembling the hind leg of a dog
items.ex_en: The narrow mountain trail doglegs sharply to the right just past the wooden bridge.
items.ex_zh: 过了木桥之后，狭窄的山间小道便猛地向右拐出一道急弯。

items.def_en: move across a region with intersecting paths going repeatedly in opposite directions
items.ex_en: Delivery vans crisscross the labyrinthine downtown streets constantly during the busy holiday morning rush.
items.ex_zh: 在繁忙的假日早高峰期间，送货车在迷宫般的老城区街道中纵横交错穿行。

items.def_en: move quickly with abrupt direction changes to evade obstacles, pursuit, or blows
items.ex_en: The agile football player managed to dodge through several aggressive defenders toward the endzone.
items.ex_zh: 这位敏捷的橄榄球选手忽左忽右灵巧闪躲，突破数名凶狠的防守球员冲向底线。

items.def_zh: 穿梭前行，忽左忽右移动
items.def_en: move along by frequently changing direction from side to side around obstacles or traffic
items.ex_en: The reckless motorcyclist began to weave between stalled cars along the crowded highway shoulder.
items.ex_zh: 鲁莽的摩托车手开始在拥堵的高速路肩上、在停滞的车流间穿梭前行。

items.def_en: to move forward by making sharp, alternating turns to the left and right
items.ex_en: The escapees zigzagged wildly down the rocky slope to avoid the searching border spotlights.
items.ex_zh: 逃亡者呈Z字形在岩石斜坡上曲折狂奔，以避开边境搜寻探照灯的扫射。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on sharp, angular changes of heading across a progression path, alternating sharply left and right rather than curving smoothly. It applies to runners dodging defenders, roads ascending precipitous slopes, or yachts tacking against the wind.
groups.summary_zh: 指以明显的锐角、交替折向或左右曲折前进的运动方式。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves discontinuous, non-linear progression along an alternating directional path, differing from plain 'turning' by its continuous, repeating angular deviations.
groups.desc_zh: 核心认知图式为沿交替折转的非线性轨迹行进；区别于单纯的“转弯”，本框架强调反复、连续的折角变向与规避机动。
groups.nuance_en: tack: navigating by alternating sharp angular legs (wind / course) · dogleg: sharp, single crooked bend or deviation (path / fairway) · crisscross: moving back and forth across an area intersecting previous tracks (country / streets) · weave: fluid serpentine motion threading through obstacles (traffic / crowd) · zigzag: sharp, regular back-and-forth angular turns (trail / lightning / road)
groups.nuance_zh: tack: 航海或策略中交替折向迎风推进 (wind / course) · dogleg: 类似狗腿状的单次急剧拐弯或急折 (path / fairway) · crisscross: 纵横交错地穿梭往返 (country / streets) · weave: 如穿针引线般在障碍物间蜿蜒绕行 (traffic / crowd) · zigzag: 连续且规律的“之”字形尖角折向 (trail / lightning / road)

groups.name: Absolve & Shrive · 赦免与解罪 (Absolve, Forgive, Shrive)
groups.tip: 神职人员听取忏悔并赦罪

items.def_en: To stop feeling angry or resentful toward someone for an offense, flaw, or mistake
items.ex_en: She found it truly impossible to forgive her business partner for the treacherous deceit.
items.ex_zh: 她发现自己实在无法原谅合伙人这番阴险背叛的欺骗行径。

items.def_en: To forgive an offense or impolite action; or to grant remission of an ecclesiastical fault
items.ex_en: The governor chose to pardon the repentant prisoner after twenty years of exemplary behavior.
items.ex_zh: 鉴于该囚犯二十年来表现模范且真诚悔罪，州长决定予以赦免。

items.def_en: To cancel or pardon a punishment, debt, or spiritual sin
items.ex_en: The high court formally agreed to remit the punitive fine imposed on the charity.
items.ex_zh: 高级法院正式同意免除此前对该慈善机构处以的惩罚性罚金。

items.def_en: (+ from/of) To officially free someone from guilt, sin, or legal and moral obligations
items.ex_en: The tribunal's comprehensive report ultimately absolved the captain of all blame for the shipwreck.
items.ex_zh: 调查法庭详尽的报告最终免除了船长对本次海难所负的全部责任。

items.def_zh: 听取（某人）忏悔并赦免；忏悔
items.def_en: 1. (archaic / religion) When a priest shrives someone, he hears their confession and grants them absolution.
items.ex_en: The dying king asked the elderly monk to shrive him before the final hour.
items.ex_zh: 垂死的国王请求那位年迈的僧侣在最后时刻来临前听其忏悔并赦免其罪。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on spiritual or moral forgiveness, where a religious authority or aggrieved party formally remits guilt, clears sin after confession, or releases someone from a deep moral obligation.
groups.summary_zh: 指在宗教忏悔或道德伦理层面宽恕罪过、赦免灵魂或免除沉重负疚。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves institutional or spiritual release from guilt, sin, or legal penalty, differing from plain 'excusing' by invoking moral authority and complete expiation.
groups.desc_zh: 核心认知图式为基于宗教圣礼或司法权威对罪愆、债务或刑罚施予免除；区别于日常的“原谅”，本框架强调权威背书与法律/道德上的彻底解负。
groups.nuance_en: forgive: personal cessation of resentment or blame (sins / debt / offender) · pardon: executive or formal legal remission of punishment (criminal / offense) · remit: formal cancellation of a debt, tax, or penalty (fine / sins / sentence) · absolve: authoritative judicial or spiritual clearing of guilt (sins / guilt / responsibility) · shrive: sacramental hearing of confession and granting absolution (penitent / sinner)
groups.nuance_zh: forgive: 个人情感上不再怀恨或免除过失 (sins / debt / offender) · pardon: 行政长官或国家最高机关特赦刑罚 (criminal / offense) · remit: 正式免除或豁免债务、罚款或刑期 (fine / sins / sentence) · absolve: 司法或宗教权威正式宣布免除罪责 (sins / guilt / responsibility) · shrive: 天主教神父听取告解并施予解罪圣事 (penitent / sinner)

groups.name: Absorb & Imbibe · 吸收与汲取 (Absorb, Imbibe, Assimilate)
groups.tip: 将水分、知识或养分纳进内部

items.def_en: To be thoroughly absorbed into a porous material or fully comprehended by the mind
items.ex_en: It took several minutes for the unexpected news of promotion to soak in fully.
items.ex_zh: 过了好几分钟，大家才完全领悟并消化了这则意外的晋升消息。
items.ex2_en: The dry garden soil soaked in the warm gentle rain quite rapidly.
items.ex2_zh: 干燥的花园土壤非常迅速地吸收了温和的小雨。

items.def_en: To absorb eagerly or savor with total attention, such as sights or atmosphere
items.ex_en: We stood silently at the summit, drinking in the magnificent view.
items.ex_zh: 我们静静地站在山顶上，尽情饱览那壮丽的景色。

items.def_zh: 吸收（液体、气体、养分等）；汲取（知识、信息）；吸引（全部注意力）
items.def_en: 1. To take in a liquid, gas, or other substance from the surrounding space. 2. To take in and understand information or ideas. 3. To engross someone's attention fully.
items.ex_en: Dry sponges quickly absorb vast amounts of water spilled upon the marble kitchen counter.
items.ex_zh: 干燥的海绵能迅速吸收泼洒在大理石厨房台面上的大量积水。

items.def_en: To take in and fully incorporate nutrients or information into an existing body or system
items.ex_en: New employees need several weeks to assimilate the complex operational protocols of this firm.
items.ex_zh: 新员工需要花费数周时间来充分消化吸收这家公司的复杂操作规程。
items.ex2_en: Foreign cultural traditions often assimilate slowly into the established mainstream society over generations.
items.ex2_zh: 外来文化传统往往经过几代人才能慢慢融入既定的主流社会。

items.def_en: To take in or absorb liquid, moisture, or ideas into the system
items.ex_en: The eager young botanist appeared to imbibe every single word uttered by her mentor.
items.ex_zh: 那位求知若渴的年轻植物学者似乎全盘汲取了导师说出的每一个字句。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe taking in liquid, moisture, knowledge, or influence throughout a body's interior volume, drawing it in until it is completely assimilated.
groups.summary_zh: 将水分、养料或知识文化深入吸收进体内或心智内部。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves drawing an external fluid, idea, or impression into an internal entity and integrating it, differing from plain 'taking' by total structural incorporation.
groups.desc_zh: 核心认知图式为将外部流体、知识或环境意象吸纳并融入主体内部；区别于单纯的“获取”，本框架强调完全渗透、内化及结构性吸收。
groups.nuance_en: soak in: passive deep permeation of ambient atmosphere or moisture (atmosphere / warmth) · drink in: eager, sensory ingestion of sights, sounds, or experiences (view / words / beauty) · absorb: general incorporation of fluids, energy, or information (shock / moisture / costs) · assimilate: cognitive or social integration into an existing system (facts / immigrants / culture) · imbibe: formal liquid ingestion or gradual taking in of ideas/habits (alcohol / ideas / values)
groups.nuance_zh: soak in: 被动地沉浸并让氛围或水分深度渗透 (atmosphere / warmth) · drink in: 贪婪沉醉地用感官汲取景象或声音 (view / words / beauty) · absorb: 通用的物理或抽象吸收、消化与承受 (shock / moisture / costs) · assimilate: 认知或社会学上的同化、内化与全面消化 (facts / immigrants / culture) · imbibe: 书面语中饮酒或潜移默化地摄取观念、习俗 (alcohol / ideas / values)

groups.name: Abstain & Refrain · 戒绝与禁欲 (Abstain, Refrain, Forgo)
groups.tip: 克制欲望彻底戒除烟酒

items.def_en: (+ from) to stop oneself from doing or saying something one is tempted to do
items.ex_en: Diplomats were strongly advised to refrain from making provocative statements during the sensitive peace talks.
items.ex_zh: 在敏感的和平谈判期间，外交官们被强烈建议克制情绪，不要发表挑衅性言论。

items.def_en: (+ from) to deliberately choose not to indulge in something enjoyable, especially alcoholic drink or food
items.ex_en: He decided to abstain from sugary snacks and rich pastries for forty consecutive days.
items.ex_zh: 他决定连续四十天克制口腹之欲，坚决戒绝含糖零食和油腻糕点。

items.def_en: to willingly decide to go without something desirable or pleasurable
items.ex_en: She had to forgo all weekend leisure activities to finish her urgent legal brief.
items.ex_zh: 为了赶完紧急的法律摘要，她不得不自愿放弃所有周末休闲享乐。

items.def_en: to completely abstain from drinking alcohol
items.ex_en: After years of heavy social drinking, Martin decided to teetotal completely for his health.
items.ex_zh: 在经历了多年的频繁社交应酬后，马丁为了健康决定彻底戒酒，滴酒不沾。

items.def_zh: 宣布放弃，断绝（恶习或欲望）
items.def_en: to formally and publicly state that one will no longer engage in or indulge a habit or pleasure
items.ex_en: The reformed criminal publicly promised to renounce all ties to his former street gang.
items.ex_zh: 改过自新的罪犯公开发誓，宣布彻底断绝与他原先街头帮派的一切瓜葛。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on voluntary, disciplined self-restraint and complete renunciation of bodily pleasures, intoxicating substances (especially alcohol), or sensory temptations due to moral, health, or ascetic commitments.
groups.summary_zh: 指本着意志或原则自律戒断酒瘾、不良嗜好或肉体欲望。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves deliberate self-control to hold oneself back from a pleasurable or controversial act, differing from plain 'stopping' by purposeful, sustained avoidance.
groups.desc_zh: 核心认知图式为通过自我意志克制欲望，故意不涉足某种享乐或争议行为；区别于普通的“停止”，本框架强调出于自律、戒律的主动规避。
groups.nuance_en: refrain: temporary or momentary self-restraint from an immediate impulse (laughing / smoking / comment) · abstain: formal, principled, or sustained avoidance (voting / alcohol / sex) · forgo: consciously passing up a desirable convenience or privilege (pleasure / opportunity / dessert) · teetotal: absolute moral commitment to alcohol avoidance (lifestyle / pledge) · renounce: public, permanent surrender of a claim, habit, or belief (citizenship / violence / worldly goods)
groups.nuance_zh: refrain: 暂时或当场克制即时的冲动 (laughing / smoking / comment) · abstain: 出于原则或程序规范的长期禁绝或弃权 (voting / alcohol / sex) · forgo: 自愿放弃原本应得的便利、特权或享受 (pleasure / opportunity / dessert) · teetotal: 严格恪守绝对不沾酒精的戒律 (lifestyle / pledge) · renounce: 公开且永久性地声明放弃权利、信仰或习气 (citizenship / violence / worldly goods)

groups.name: Abstain & Starve · 绝食与斋戒 (Starve, Fast, Abstain)
groups.tip: 从忍受饥饿到极端挨饿禁食

items.def_en: To deliberately restrict food intake to lose weight or for health reasons
items.ex_en: Many professional boxers must diet rigorously prior to weigh-in to remain in their class.
items.ex_zh: 许多职业拳击手在过磅前必须严格节食，以确保符合所属量级。

items.def_en: To abstain voluntarily from all or certain kinds of food or drink for a period
items.ex_en: Monks at the secluded mountaintop monastery fast from sunrise until sunset on sacred days.
items.ex_zh: 幽居山巅修道院的僧侣们在神圣的日子里从日出到日落全天禁食。

items.def_en: (+ of) To keep someone from having essential nourishment or sustenance
items.ex_en: The ruthless siege threatened to deprive innocent residents of clean water and basic food.
items.ex_zh: 残酷的围困行径眼看就要切断并剥夺无辜居民获取饮水与基本食物的途径。

items.def_en: 1. To suffer or die from lack of food, or to cause someone to suffer from hunger. 2. (+ of) To deprive someone or something of something essential.
items.ex_en: Drought conditions continue to starve impoverished rural communities of adequate grain supplies this winter.
items.ex_zh: 严重的干旱态势致使贫困的农村社区在这个冬季面临粮食极度匮乏的困境。
items.ex2_en: Thousands of trapped wild animals will starve without emergency food drops soon.
items.ex2_zh: 如果不久后没有紧急空投食物，数千只被困的野生动物将会挨饿。

items.def_en: To refuse to eat as a prolonged, organized protest
items.ex_en: Imprisoned political dissidents resolved to hunger-strike until international human rights monitors arrived.
items.ex_zh: 被关押的异见人士决意绝食抗议，直至国际人权监察员抵达为止。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers deliberate or enforced cessation of eating, ranging from medical/spiritual fasting to political hunger strikes and fatal deprivations.
groups.summary_zh: 包含出于宗教、抗议自愿断食，或遭受残酷断粮折磨的行为。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves severe caloric restriction ranging from disciplined moderation to fatal deprivation, differing from plain 'eating less' by systemic physiological sacrifice.
groups.desc_zh: 核心认知图式为对身体热量与摄食的严苛限制乃至剥夺；区别于日常的“少吃”，本框架强调带有宗教、苦修、政治抗争或生死考验的生理极限施压。
groups.nuance_en: diet: regulated nutritional intake for health or cosmetic goals (regimen / calories) · fast: voluntary abstention from food for spiritual, medical, or political reasons (Lent / Ramadan / day) · deprive: external withholding of necessary sustenance or rights (nutrients / sleep / liberty) · starve: extreme, life-threatening food scarcity or causing severe hunger (population / resources / death) · hunger-strike: refusal of food as an overt weapon of political protest (protesters / prisoners)
groups.nuance_zh: diet: 出于健康或体态目的之规律性节食 (regimen / calories) · fast: 基于宗教仪轨、医疗排毒或静思的自愿辟谷断食 (Lent / Ramadan / day) · deprive: 外部剥夺或克扣维系生命所必需的养分或权利 (nutrients / sleep / liberty) · starve: 濒临饿死或使之陷入严重匮乏的极限饥饿 (population / resources / death) · hunger-strike: 将绝食作为明确政治抗议武器的殊死对抗 (protesters / prisoners)

groups.name: Academic Research & Systematic Study · 学术调研与系统研究 (Research, Study, Scrutinize)
groups.tip: 系统性深入探寻事实真相

items.def_en: To examine a subject, trend, or phenomenon systematically in detail to understand it thoroughly.
items.ex_en: Marine biologists study migratory marine mammals along the Pacific coastline using satellite tracking tags.
items.ex_zh: 海洋生物学家利用卫星追踪标签，系统研究太平洋沿岸迁徙的海洋哺乳动物。

items.def_en: To study something thoroughly and systematically in order to discover new facts, test ideas, or find out the truth.
items.ex_en: The university team will research sustainable agricultural practices suitable for extremely arid developing regions.
items.ex_zh: 该大学团队将深入研究适用于极度干旱的发展中地区的可持续农业方案。

items.def_en: To look at or consider a concept, subject, or specimen carefully in order to understand its nature.
items.ex_en: Forensic specialists examine the microscopic physical evidence gathered from the abandoned crime scene meticulously.
items.ex_zh: 法医专家正细致考查从废弃犯罪现场采集到的微观物理物证。

items.def_en: To examine the structural components or underlying patterns of data, text, or a phenomenon critically.
items.ex_en: The literary scholar sought to analyze the recurring motifs of longing inside the poem.
items.ex_zh: 这位文学学者试图深入剖析诗歌内部反复出现的渴望这一核心意象。

items.def_en: To examine someone or something very closely and critically, paying attention to every detail.
items.ex_en: Financial regulators scrutinize every offshore transaction to detect potential money laundering and illicit activities.
items.ex_zh: 金融监管机构仔细推敲审查每一笔离岸交易，以察觉潜在的洗钱及非法活动。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the rigorous, intellectual, and methodical exploration of topics or phenomena to generate new knowledge or test theories. Unlike criminal inquiries, the focus here is scholarly, empirical, and analytical.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重遵循学术或科学方法对课题进行严谨、系统的研讨与求证。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves structured, disciplined intellectual interrogation of a subject, differing from plain 'looking' by methodical verification, analysis, and depth.
groups.desc_zh: 核心认知图式为对研究对象展开有组织、有纪律的理性考订与透彻剖析；区别于粗略的“观察”，本框架强调方法论规范与深度求证。
groups.nuance_en: study: broad acquisition of knowledge or examination of phenomena (effects / trends / subject) · research: rigorous, methodical investigation to establish facts or uncover new data (market / disease / topic) · examine: close visual, clinical, or forensic inspection (specimen / evidence / witness) · analyze: disassembling a complex whole into constituent elements (data / samples / discourse) · scrutinize: hyper-critical, fine-grained inspection searching for flaws (finances / credentials / text)
groups.nuance_zh: study: 广义的潜心研读或对现象的观察思考 (effects / trends / subject) · research: 运用学术或实验方法进行的系统性调查与立论 (market / disease / topic) · examine: 临床、司法或针对具体细节的实物细检 (specimen / evidence / witness) · analyze: 将复杂整体解构为要素的数理或逻辑剖析 (data / samples / discourse) · scrutinize: 带着挑剔审视眼光、极度细致地查验瑕疵 (finances / credentials / text)

groups.name: Accommodate & Billet · 寄宿与留宿 (Lodge, Billet, Quarter)
groups.tip: 在旅店或借宿处留宿居住

items.def_en: To stay and receive regular meals at someone's house or school in return for payment
items.ex_en: The foreign student chose to board with a local family during his academic year.
items.ex_zh: 这位外国留学生在学年期间选择包饭寄宿在当地一户人家中。

items.def_en: To provide housing or shelter for people, especially soldiers, in specified lodgings
items.ex_en: The local garrison agreed to quarter displaced civilians inside the vacant fort barracks temporarily.
items.ex_zh: 地方守军同意暂时将流离失所的平民安置在空置的要塞营房内留宿。

items.def_zh: 借宿，寄宿；供……留宿；卡住，嵌于；正式提出（申诉等）
items.def_en: 1. To stay somewhere temporarily, especially paying for a room. 2. To provide someone with a place to sleep. 3. To become stuck firmly in a place. 4. To formally submit a complaint or claim.
items.ex_en: The visiting botanist will lodge at a rustic countryside inn during the field expedition.
items.ex_zh: 这位来访的植物学家在实地考察期间将借宿在一家乡村客栈中。
items.ex2_en: The university agreed to lodge international students in the newly renovated dormitories.
items.ex2_zh: 大学同意将国际学生安置在刚翻新的宿舍里。

items.def_en: To provide someone with a room or place to sleep and live
items.ex_en: The luxury seaside resort can easily accommodate over five hundred foreign conference delegates simultaneously.
items.ex_zh: 这家海滨豪华度假酒店能轻松同时为五百余名外国会议代表提供住宿。

items.def_en: (+ at / with / on) To assign someone, typically military personnel, to lodge in a civilian house
items.ex_en: The commander ordered his weary infantry troops to billet with villagers in the valley.
items.ex_zh: 指挥官命令疲惫的步兵部队在山谷村民家中安排分散借宿。

groups.summary_en: This frame addresses providing or taking temporary domestic accommodation, rented rooms, or arranged quarters for individuals, travelers, or troops, usually under formal or contractual terms.
groups.summary_zh: 指为旅客、租客或军队提供或接受临时食宿安排及安置借住。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves providing shelter and living space under administrative, financial, or military arrangements, differing from plain 'hosting' by formal allocation.
groups.desc_zh: 核心认知图式为依据行政指令、金钱契约或军事调度为人员分配住处；区别于友善的日常“留宿”，本框架强调制度化安排或战时强行安置。
groups.nuance_en: board: providing regular meals and lodging in exchange for payment (students / guests / horse) · quarter: stationing personnel—especially military—in assigned quarters (troops / soldiers / refugees) · lodge: providing temporary, modest shelter or residing as a paying guest (traveler / tourist / tenant) · accommodate: broad capacity to house or adapt physical space for people (guests / tourists / crowd) · billet: assigning soldiers by official order to private, civilian lodgings (soldiers / battalion)
groups.nuance_zh: board: 附带包餐的有偿寄宿供膳宿 (students / guests / horse) · quarter: 将军队等成建制人员按编制派驻扎营 (troops / soldiers / refugees) · lodge: 提供或租住临时性的简易处所 (traveler / tourist / tenant) · accommodate: 空间容量上容纳、接待众多宾客 (guests / tourists / crowd) · billet: 凭借官方军令强行或按配额将士兵指派至民宅借宿 (soldiers / battalion)

groups.name: Accost & Approach · 唐突搭讪与迎面拦阻 (Accost, Buttonhole, Waylay)
groups.tip: 主动上前纠缠搭话或冒昧质问

items.def_en: Approach someone directly and intentionally to initiate contact or start a dialogue
items.ex_en: A courteous stranger decided to walk up to the tourist to offer helpful directions.
items.ex_zh: 一位热心的陌生人径直走向那位游客，主动上前攀谈并提供指路帮助。

items.def_en: Detain someone in conversation, often unexpectedly and against their inclination
items.ex_en: The eager lobbyist managed to buttonhole the weary senator right outside the committee room.
items.ex_zh: 急切的说客在委员会会议室外一把拉住疲惫的参议员，硬要纠缠长谈。

items.def_zh: 半路拦截（以便交谈或盘问）
items.def_en: Stop or interrupt someone on their way unexpectedly in order to speak with them
items.ex_en: Determined reporters sought to waylay the foreign minister as he walked toward his limousine.
items.ex_zh: 执着的记者们试图在外交部长走向专车途中半路截住他进行盘问。

items.def_zh: 当面对质，迎面截住问难
items.def_en: Face up to or approach someone directly in a hostile, challenging, or assertive manner
items.ex_en: Angry tenants gathered in the lobby to confront the negligent landlord about heating failures.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的租户聚集在一楼大厅，迎面截住疏于管理的房东就供暖故障当面对质。

items.def_zh: （冒昧、唐突或具挑衅性地）上前搭话，走过去质问
items.def_en: 1. To approach and speak to someone boldly, aggressively, or unexpectedly, often in a public place.
items.ex_en: An aggressive reporter accosted the senator on the courthouse steps yesterday afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 一名气势汹汹的记者昨天下午在法院台阶前拦住这位参议员当面质问。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe confronting, approaching, or stopping another person unexpectedly and uninvitedly—often assertively, aggressively, or awkwardly—to initiate an unwanted conversation.
groups.summary_zh: 指突兀、主动甚至挑衅性地上前拦住对方攀谈搭话。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves moving boldly into another's personal space to demand attention or halt progress, differing from polite 'approaching' by abrupt intrusion.
groups.desc_zh: 核心认知图式为以突兀、强硬或纠缠姿态侵入他人个人空间逼其停步；区别于礼貌的“走近”，本框架强调破坏边界的拦截与唐突冒犯感。
groups.nuance_en: walk up to: neutral, ordinary physical approach to someone (stranger / counter / podium) · buttonhole: detaining someone in tedious, inescapable conversation (guests / MP / boss) · waylay: intercepting someone by ambush or unexpected obstruction (commuters / minister / traveler) · confront: facing someone aggressively with hostile or challenging intent (rival / suspect / accuser) · accost: boldly and aggressively addressing an unsuspecting stranger (passerby / tourists / stranger)
groups.nuance_zh: walk up to: 中性平淡的物理走向某人 (stranger / counter / podium) · buttonhole: 揪住不放、强拉某人听其喋喋不休 (guests / MP / boss) · waylay: 伏击或在半路半道强行拦截截停 (commuters / minister / traveler) · confront: 带着问罪或对抗企图与人迎面直面对质 (rival / suspect / accuser) · accost: 突兀冒犯、甚至带有威胁性地迎面搭讪拦阻陌生人 (passerby / tourists / stranger)

groups.name: Accrete & Build Up Gradually · 沉积与层积累聚 (Accrete, Accumulate, Agglomerate)
groups.tip: 微粒附着层层缓慢积聚

items.def_en: To become blocked or filled gradually with fine sand, mud, or sediment
items.ex_en: Without regular dredging, the shallow harbor began to silt up quite rapidly.
items.ex_zh: 由于缺乏定期疏浚，这座浅水港湾开始迅速淤塞。
items.ex2_en: Seasonal flooding silted up the agricultural irrigation canal with thick sticky mud.
items.ex2_zh: 季节性洪水带来的粘稠厚泥淤塞了农田灌溉水渠。

items.def_zh: 积聚，逐渐增大；使积聚，使合生
items.def_en: To grow, accumulate, or form gradually by layers or particles sticking together over time.
items.ex_en: Over centuries, fine mineral residues accrete into thick subterranean stone formations.
items.ex_zh: 数个世纪以来，细微的矿物残渣逐渐积聚成厚重的地下岩层。
items.ex2_en: Massive gravitational forces slowly accrete surrounding cosmic dust into a dense planet.
items.ex2_zh: 巨大的引力慢慢将周围的宇宙尘埃吸积成一颗致密的行星。

items.def_en: To become covered with a thick, hard, or dried layer of a substance, or form into a crust
items.ex_en: Dry mud began to cake thickly onto the tires of the truck.
items.ex_zh: 干涸的泥浆开始在卡车的轮胎上结成厚厚一层硬壳。
items.ex2_en: The sticky wet clay caked the farmer's heavy leather boots very thickly.
items.ex2_zh: 黏湿的泥土在农夫厚重的皮靴上结成了厚厚的一层。

items.def_en: To change from a soft or liquid state into a solid or firm mass, typically as it cools
items.ex_en: The residual grease in the pan began to congeal as it cooled.
items.ex_zh: 锅里残留的油脂随着温度降低开始逐渐凝固。
items.ex2_en: Extreme cold temperatures quickly congeal the warm beef broth inside the pot.
items.ex2_zh: 极低的温度很快使锅里温热的牛肉汤凝结起来。

items.def_en: To collect or gather into a cluster, rounded mass, or dense ball
items.ex_en: Fine soot particles often agglomerate into denser clusters within the industrial chimney.
items.ex_zh: 微细的烟尘颗粒往往会在工业烟囱内部凝结成更致密的团块。
items.ex2_en: The specialized processing machine agglomerates small chemical powders into stable uniform granules.
items.ex2_zh: 这台专用加工机将细小的化学粉末聚集成稳定均匀的颗粒。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses processes where matter, layers, or components attach gradually to a core over time, building into a dense, solid mass. It highlights incremental, physical accumulation rather than abstract piling.
groups.summary_zh: 物质通过逐层附着、沉积或团聚而缓慢凝结成块的渐进累积过程。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves matter accumulating through external deposits or hardening layers over time, differing from intentional 'assembling' by organic, gradual physical coalescence.
groups.desc_zh: 核心认知图式为物质由于物理沉积、硬化结块而随时间推移逐渐层累包裹；区别于主动的“组装”，本框架强调被动、渐进的物理聚合凝结过程。
groups.nuance_en: silt up: gradual blockage of waterways by fine sediment (harbor / estuary / channel) · accrete: organic, outward growth by external deposition of layered matter (tissue / capital / land) · cake: drying and hardening into a crusty, thick outer layer (mud / blood / powder) · congeal: turning from liquid to a thick, gelatinous or solid state (grease / blood / soup) · agglomerate: collecting or clustering separate disparate particles into a compact mass (mass / particles / ore)
groups.nuance_zh: silt up: 水道或港口因泥沙淤积而堵塞 (harbor / estuary / channel) · accrete: 外部沉积物层层累加包裹形成的渐进生长 (tissue / capital / land) · cake: 潮湿物质风干板结成厚硬结痂 (mud / blood / powder) · congeal: 液体冷却或凝结为黏稠冻状或固态 (grease / blood / soup) · agglomerate: 散碎颗粒紧密聚结、团聚成块 (mass / particles / ore)

groups.name: Ache & Hurt · 隐痛与持续作痛 (Ache, Throb, Smart)
groups.tip: 身体部位隐隐作痛钝痛

items.def_en: To cause or feel continuous physical pain in a body part
items.ex_en: My lower back began to hurt after lifting several heavy moving boxes.
items.ex_zh: 搬完几个沉重的搬家箱子后，我的下背部开始隐隐作痛。
items.ex2_en: The tight new hiking shoes hurt my blistered feet after walking downhill.
items.ex2_zh: 走完下坡路后，紧绷的新登山鞋把我的长水泡的脚弄得很疼。

items.def_en: To feel a sharp, stinging pain, like that of a graze or burn
items.ex_en: The fresh scrape on his elbow continued to smart in the wind.
items.ex_zh: 他手肘上新擦伤的伤口在风中仍感到火辣辣地刺痛。

items.def_en: To experience a sudden, brief, sharp spasm of localized pain
items.ex_en: She felt a sharp twinge in her injured shoulder whenever she moved.
items.ex_zh: 每当她活动时，受伤的肩膀总会感到一阵抽搐般的锐痛。

items.def_zh: 隐隐作痛，钝痛；渴望，想念（ache for/to）
items.def_en: 1. To feel a continuous, dull pain in a part of your body. 2. (+ for/to do) To want something or someone very deeply and painfully.
items.ex_en: His aching limbs made it nearly impossible to climb the steep stairs.
items.ex_zh: 他四肢隐隐作痛，几乎无法攀爬陡峭的楼梯。

items.def_en: To feel pain in a series of regular, pulsating beats
items.ex_en: A vicious migraine caused his left temple to throb incessantly all afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 严重的偏头痛导致他的左侧太阳穴整个下午都在剧烈地跳痛。

groups.summary_en: Captures the continuous somatic experience of dull, radiating, or pulsing discomfort in tissues and limbs. Contrasts deep continuous aching with rhythmic throbbing or sharp stinging sensations.
groups.summary_zh: 指身体内部持续不断的钝痛、跳痛或隐隐作痛的感觉体验。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves perceiving continuous or pulsating physical distress, differing from acute 'sharp pain' by dull persistence, internal resonance, or localized rhythm.
groups.desc_zh: 核心认知图式为体验深层、隐约持续或具节律性跳动的肉体不适；区别于突发的“尖锐刺痛”，本框架聚焦于钝性延宕、隐隐作痛及搏动感。
groups.nuance_en: hurt: general, unspecified physical pain or emotional injury (knee / back / feelings) · smart: sharp, stinging superficial pain accompanied by burning (eyes / wound / slap) · twinge: brief, sudden sharp spasm of localized pain (knee / conscience / tooth) · ache: continuous, dull, generalized discomfort inside muscles or joints (head / joints / limbs) · throb: deep pain pulsating in rhythmic synchronization with the heartbeat (headache / finger / wound)
groups.nuance_zh: hurt: 最通用的痛感表述，涵盖肉体伤痛与情感伤害 (knee / back / feelings) · smart: 表层伤口灼热、刺辣的持续作痛 (eyes / wound / slap) · twinge: 突如其来、转瞬即逝的一记抽痛或刺痛 (knee / conscience / tooth) · ache: 肌肉、骨节内部弥散、沉闷的持续隐痛 (head / joints / limbs) · throb: 与心脏脉搏同频的剧烈律动性胀痛、跳痛 (headache / finger / wound)

groups.name: Acquit & Exonerate · 判免与开脱 (Exonerate, Vindicate, Clear)
groups.tip: 法庭判决无罪还其清白名誉

items.def_en: (+ of) To prove or officially state that someone is innocent of a crime, debt, or wrongdoing
items.ex_en: Fresh forensic evidence finally cleared the young man of all remaining charges.
items.ex_zh: 最新的法医物证终于洗清了这名年轻人的所有未结罪名。
items.ex2_en: The accused diplomat finally cleared of bribery suspicions after the thorough internal audit.
items.ex2_zh: 经过彻底的内部审计，被指控的外交官终于摆脱了受贿嫌疑。

items.def_en: To choose not to punish someone, or to give them only a very light punishment
items.ex_en: The sympathetic officer decided to let the speeding driver off with a warning.
items.ex_zh: 那位富有同情心的警官决定免于处罚，仅对超速司机给予口头警告。

items.def_en: 1. (+ of) (law) To officially decide and state in a court of law that someone is not guilty of a crime. 2. ('acquit oneself') To perform or behave in a specified way.
items.ex_en: The jury took only an hour to acquit the defendant of murder.
items.ex_zh: 陪审团仅用了一个小时便裁定被告谋杀罪名不成立。

items.def_en: To prove that someone is innocent, right, or justified, especially after they have been criticized or doubted
items.ex_en: Subsequent internal audits fully vindicated her claims regarding the financial irregularities.
items.ex_zh: 随后的内部审计完全证实了她针对财务违规行为所指控的事实。

items.def_en: (+ from/of) To officially clear someone from blame, accusation, or criminal responsibility
items.ex_en: The committee presented clear evidence to exonerate the official from any wrongdoing.
items.ex_zh: 委员会出示了明确证据，免除了该官员的一切违纪指控。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the formal clearing of an individual from criminal charges, blame, or suspicion through a judicial ruling, investigative findings, or concrete evidence.
groups.summary_zh: 通过法庭裁判、官方调查或确凿事实消除刑事指控或免除嫌疑。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves institutional or societal lifting of criminal guilt or public stigma, differing from 'pardoning' by declaring the person legally or morally innocent from the start.
groups.desc_zh: 核心认知图式为通过法庭判决或真相大白彻底洗脱嫌疑与耻辱；区别于承认有罪后的“免罪特赦”，本框架强调溯及既往的无罪认定与还其清白。
groups.nuance_en: clear: broad removal of suspicion, debt, or obstacle through disclosure (name / suspect / reputation) · let off: informal release without deserved punishment or with a mild warning (driver / warning / hook) · acquit: formal judicial verdict finding a defendant not guilty (defendant / suspect / jury) · vindicate: clearing someone of blame or proving a belief correct by subsequent events (reputation / decision / claims) · exonerate: absolute official absolution from legal culpability or moral blame (prisoner / report / evidence)
groups.nuance_zh: clear: 通过事实查清大范围洗刷嫌疑或昭雪名誉 (name / suspect / reputation) · let off: 口语中从轻发落、网开一面不予追究 (driver / warning / hook) · acquit: 司法法庭正式裁决宣判“无罪释放” (defendant / suspect / jury) · vindicate: 后续事实证明某人蒙受不白之冤或证明其先见之明 (reputation / decision / claims) · exonerate: 彻底在法理与道德层面上完全免除罪责与指控 (prisoner / report / evidence)

groups.name: Adapt & Accustom · 适应与习惯 (Inure, Acclimate, Habituate)
groups.tip: 久经磨砺而渐渐麻木与顺应

items.def_en: (+ to) To adapt or get used to a new climate, conditions, or environment
items.ex_en: It takes several grueling weeks for high-altitude climbers to acclimate completely.
items.ex_zh: 高山攀登者需要花费数周艰难的时间才能完全适应高原环境。

items.def_en: (+ to) To make someone accustomed to or psychologically tolerant of something
items.ex_en: Constant training habituated the young soldiers to stressful, high-intensity operational environments.
items.ex_zh: 持续的训练使这些年轻士兵习惯了高压力、高强度的作战环境。

items.def_en: (+ to) To make someone less sensitive to pain, cold, hardship, or emotional distress
items.ex_en: Years of grueling labor in the Arctic had hardened him to cold.
items.ex_zh: 北极多年艰苦的劳作使他习惯了严寒，变得毫不畏惧。
items.ex2_en: The moist clay will harden quickly under the hot afternoon summer sun.
items.ex2_zh: 潮湿的黏土在夏日下午炽热的阳光下会迅速变硬。

items.def_en: (+ to) To cause someone to experience something so often that they stop reacting emotionally
items.ex_en: Excessive exposure to violent films can gradually desensitize viewers to real suffering.
items.ex_zh: 过度接触暴力影片会逐渐使观众对现实中的苦难感到麻木。

items.def_zh: 使习惯于，使适应（苦难、不快等）
items.def_en: (usually passive, 'be inured to') To accustom someone to accept something undesirable, painful, or difficult without suffering.
items.ex_en: Living in the war zone had completely inured the residents to danger.
items.ex_zh: 长期生活在战乱地带使当地居民对危险彻底变得麻木不仁。

groups.summary_en: This frame concerns becoming accustomed to conditions, progressing from normal cognitive and physical adaptation to becoming hardened or desensitized to hardship and pain.
groups.summary_zh: 指逐渐适应新环境，或对苦难与不良刺激习以为常。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves physiological or psychological conditioning to withstand harsh, unfamiliar, or unpalatable environments, differing from simple 'adjusting' by deadening sensitivity.
groups.desc_zh: 核心认知图式为生理或心理在长期暴露于恶劣、陌生或痛苦刺激后建立防御机制；区别于简单的“微调适应”，本框架强调钝化感官、麻木神经与增强耐受力。
groups.nuance_en: acclimate: physiological adjustment to a new physical climate or altitude (altitude / environment / body) · habituate: psychological normalization through repeated exposure (routine / mind / organism) · harden: actively fortifying physical endurance or resolve against hardship (resolve / soldiers / body) · desensitize: systematically reducing emotional shock or tactile sensitivity (public / patients / children) · inure: complete, resigned toughening that renders hardship unfelt (hardship / violence / cold)
groups.nuance_zh: acclimate: 对高海拔、气候等自然物理环境的生理适应 (altitude / environment / body) · habituate: 通过反复接触使刺激转化为习以为常的心理脱敏 (routine / mind / organism) · harden: 主动锻炼体魄或心性以抵御严酷磨难 (resolve / soldiers / body) · desensitize: 系统的心理钝化，使对暴力或痛苦丧失敏感反应 (public / patients / children) · inure: 长期处于苦难中以致变得麻木不仁、彻底习以为常 (hardship / violence / cold)

groups.name: Adorn & Caparison · 锦衣与华饰 (Deck Out, Bedizen, Caparison)
groups.tip: 从日常穿衣到华丽装饰

items.def_en: Cover or wrap someone or something loosely with ornate, flowing fabric
items.ex_en: They draped the ancient altar with magnificent, gold-embroidered velvet tapestries.
items.ex_zh: 他们用华丽的金线刺绣天鹅绒挂毯把古老祭坛披裹起来。

items.def_zh: 盛装打扮；修饰得漂漂亮亮
items.def_en: Dress someone or decorate something in a remarkably festive, showy, or colorful manner
items.ex_en: The eager children were decked out in their finest colorful party costumes.
items.ex_zh: 兴奋的孩子们穿戴上了最漂亮的华丽派对服装，盛装打扮。

items.def_en: Dress oneself or style someone in an unusually stylish, showy, or elaborate way
items.ex_en: She spent over two hours trying to gussy up for the banquet.
items.ex_zh: 她花了两个多小时精心装扮自己，准备出席晚宴。

items.def_en: Dress up or decorate gaudily and tastelessly with vulgar ornaments
items.ex_en: She was gaudily bedizened with cheap plastic jewelry and excessively bright makeup.
items.ex_zh: 她浑身佩戴着廉价的塑料首饰，化着艳俗的妆容，显得过分招摇。

items.def_zh: 给（马）披上华丽鞍鞯；使穿华服
items.def_en: (literary or historical) To dress a horse in rich ornamental coverings, or to dress someone in splendid clothing.
items.ex_en: The royal steed was richly caparisoned in heavy purple velvet and silver.
items.ex_zh: 那匹皇家骏马披着厚重的紫色天鹅绒与银饰鞍鞯，显得极其华丽。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe lavishing elaborate decorations, opulent trappings, or gorgeous finery upon a person, horse, or carriage. They emphasize theatrical extravagance and rich visual appeal.
groups.summary_zh: 指为人物、坐骑施以华美锦饰或极具观赏性的华丽装扮。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves embellishing an animate or inanimate body with lavish or excessive accoutrements, differing from basic 'decorating' by ostentation, theatricality, or ceremonial dress.
groups.desc_zh: 核心认知图式为用奢华、繁复或炫目的饰品对人、物进行盛装打扮；区别于普通的“装饰”，本框架突出仪式感、华贵乃至招摇浮夸的戏剧化视觉效果。
groups.nuance_en: drape: loosely hanging fabrics gracefully around an object or body (fabric / shoulders / room) · deck out: dressing or decorating lavishly for a special occasion (hall / kids / car) · gussy up: colloquially primping, dressing up, or over-embellishing something ordinary (self / apartment / report) · bedizen: decorating gaudily and tastelessly with vulgar showiness (attire / figure / room) · caparison: outfitting horses, figures, or vehicles in ornate, ceremonial trappings (steed / parade / horses)
groups.nuance_zh: drape: 将布料、织物优雅垂挂包裹于身形或物件之上 (fabric / shoulders / room) · deck out: 为迎合盛大场合而从头到脚地盛装打扮 (hall / kids / car) · gussy up: 口语中把平平无奇的人或物梳妆打扮、过度粉饰 (self / apartment / report) · bedizen: 用艳俗、粗劣的花哨饰品俗不可耐地打扮 (attire / figure / room) · caparison: 为战马、仪仗或马车披挂华丽马衣、饰带与仪仗装具 (steed / parade / horses)

groups.name: Advance & Extend Credit · 贷款与拆借 (Loan, Advance, Finance)
groups.tip: 暂时让渡资金或物品

items.def_en: To pay money to someone before the regular time or prior to completion of work
items.ex_en: The publisher agreed to advance five thousand dollars before the manuscript was completed.
items.ex_zh: 出版商同意在手稿完成前预付五千美元稿酬。
items.ex2_en: The tired infantry troops began to advance slowly toward the enemy's perimeter.
items.ex2_zh: 疲倦的步兵部队开始向敌军防线缓缓推进。

items.def_en: To lend money, an object, or an artwork to someone temporarily.
items.ex_en: The private collector agreed to loan the priceless painting to the museum.
items.ex_zh: 这位私人收藏家同意将这幅无价的名画出借给博物馆展览。

items.def_en: To provide the capital or credit needed for a purchase, enterprise, or project
items.ex_en: Several major international banks agreed to finance the massive railway infrastructure project.
items.ex_zh: 数家主要国际银行同意为这一庞大的铁路基建项目提供资金。

items.def_en: To support financially by contributing public or institutional funds
items.ex_en: The municipal government decided to subsidize public transit to encourage sustainable travel.
items.ex_zh: 市政府决定对公共交通进行财政补贴，以鼓励绿色出行。

items.def_en: To accept financial liability or guarantee funding for an enterprise or security
items.ex_en: The philanthropic foundation chose to underwrite the artistic director's controversial new play.
items.ex_zh: 该慈善基金会选择为这位艺术总监极具争议的新剧提供资金承保。

groups.summary_en: Formal financial transactions where money, securities, or capital assets are advanced temporarily under contractually defined interest terms and repayment schedules.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重金融机构或合同语境下的资金拆借、信贷与借出资本。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves disbursing capital ahead of time or providing liquidity backed by risk underwriting, differing from plain 'giving' by transactional expectation of return or guarantee.
groups.desc_zh: 核心认知图式为在项目结算前先行垫付流动性资金或提供信用风险担保；区别于无偿的“赠与”，本框架强调商业信贷、回流预期与风险对冲。
groups.nuance_en: advance: releasing funds before expected work is done or revenue is received (funds / money / royalties) · loan: lending money or assets temporarily with agreed interest terms (sum / money / books) · finance: providing systemic capital to execute a large-scale project or purchase (deal / expansion / deficit) · subsidize: providing non-repayable public or third-party funding to lower costs (farmers / transport / industry) · underwrite: guaranteeing financial support and assuming associated risk (offering / loan / policy)
groups.nuance_zh: advance: 预支、垫付尚未到期的报酬或款项 (funds / money / royalties) · loan: 按约定利息与期限出借款项或资产 (sum / money / books) · finance: 为大宗商业项目、并购或赤字提供系统性资金支持 (deal / expansion / deficit) · subsidize: 官方或第三方为补贴亏损、压低成本而发放补贴 (farmers / transport / industry) · underwrite: 为IPO发售、保单或信贷提供承销担保并承担违约风险 (offering / loan / policy)

groups.name: Advocate & Champion · 提倡与力挺 (Champion, Espouse, Back)
groups.tip: 从倡导理念到挺身捍卫事业

items.def_en: To defend or support a person, right, or principle against criticism or opposition
items.ex_en: It is essential to stand up for your beliefs even when others disagree.
items.ex_zh: 即使别人不同意，也要勇于捍卫自己的信念。

items.def_en: To publicly recommend, support, or push for a particular cause, policy, or action.
items.ex_en: Community leaders continue to advocate stronger policies for local environmental protection.
items.ex_zh: 社区领袖们继续公开倡导针对当地环境保护采取更严格的政策。

items.def_en: To embrace and adopt a belief, cause, or theory as one's own
items.ex_en: The emerging political party openly espoused radical principles of social reform.
items.ex_zh: 这个新兴政党公开发表声明，信奉激进的社会改革理念。

items.def_zh: 游说拉票；到处奔走宣传
items.def_en: To travel around campaigning or speaking publicly in favor of a candidate or cause
items.ex_en: The energetic senator traveled across three states to stump for the nominee.
items.ex_zh: 这位充满活力的参议员辗转于三个州，为该候选人到处奔走拉票。

items.def_en: To vigorously support or defend a cause, idea, or group of people
items.ex_en: The passionate activist has long championed equal educational rights for underprivileged children.
items.ex_zh: 这位充满热情的活动家长期以来一直竭力捍卫贫困儿童的平等受教育权。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe public commitment to promoting or defending a policy, cause, or belief, ranging from moderate verbal backing to zealous campaigning.
groups.summary_zh: 公开推荐、拥护或极力争取某项主张与权益。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves actively taking up the shield for a cause, doctrine, or persona and fighting for its advancement, differing from passive 'agreeing' by public, combative promotion.
groups.desc_zh: 核心认知图式为主动披挂上阵，为某种事业、学说或当事人冲锋陷阵与背书；区别于消极的“赞同”，本框架强调公共性、战斗性与不遗余力的声援力挺。
groups.nuance_en: stand up for: defending someone or a basic right against unfair attacks (rights / friends / beliefs) · advocate: publicly recommending and pleading for policy change (reform / policies / rights) · espouse: adopting and integrating an intellectual ideology or belief system (cause / theories / lifestyle) · stump for: touring actively to campaign or rally political votes (candidate / party / bill) · champion: acting as the foremost frontline defender and promoter of a cause (cause / rights / underdog)
groups.nuance_zh: stand up for: 在遭受不公或打压时挺身而出、挺立捍卫 (rights / friends / beliefs) · advocate: 在公共政策中理性倡议、奔走呼吁推行某项主张 (reform / policies / rights) · espouse: 欣然拥护并采纳某种学说、意识形态或信条 (cause / theories / lifestyle) · stump for: 政治巡回演讲拉票、积极奔走推介候选人 (candidate / party / bill) · champion: 扮演先锋勇士角色，不遗余力地捍卫与高调力挺弱势或崇高事业 (cause / rights / underdog)

groups.name: Affect & Alter · 影响与波及变化 (Affect, Impact, Infiltrate)
groups.tip: 产生作用导致改变

items.def_en: To produce an effect on someone or something, often across a broad scale or scope
items.ex_en: The severe economic recession touched almost every household in the manufacturing district.
items.ex_zh: 这场严峻的经济衰退波及了该工业区几乎每一个家庭。

items.def_zh: 影响；侵袭，感染；深深打动；假装，装出
items.def_en: 1. to produce a change or have an effect on someone or something 2. (of an illness) to attack or infect someone 3. to cause strong feelings of sadness or pity in someone 4. to pretend to have or feel something
items.ex_en: Unpredictable seasonal weather can drastically affect the annual yield of local crops.
items.ex_zh: 变化无常的季节性天气会严重影响当地农作物的年产量。

items.def_en: To have a direct, noticeable, and often disruptive effect on an environment, system, or situation
items.ex_en: Rising transport costs will heavily impact the profitability of small export businesses.
items.ex_zh: 运输成本的上升将对小型出口企业的盈利能力产生剧烈冲击。

items.def_en: To cause changes in the characteristics, condition, or course of something without replacing it entirely
items.ex_en: The tailor carefully altered the suit to fit the client's proportions.
items.ex_zh: 裁缝仔细修改了这套西装，以契合顾客的身体尺寸。
items.ex2_en: Local weather conditions often alter dramatically in this high mountainous national park.
items.ex2_zh: 在这个高山国家公园里，当地的天气状况往往会发生剧烈变化。

items.def_en: To disturb the normal operating process or state of an activity or system by causing a sudden change
items.ex_en: A sudden power outage managed to disrupt the entire hospital's surgical schedule.
items.ex_zh: 一场突如其来的停电彻底扰乱了整家医院的手术日程安排。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on an event, condition, or substance producing tangible alterations or disturbances in the state or function of something. It covers mechanical, biological, and systemic disruption rather than purely psychological sway.
groups.summary_zh: 指外因直接对状态、机能或事物演变带来实质改变。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves force or agency impinging on a system to produce measurable shifts in state, differing from plain 'doing' by causal reverberation through an existing balance.
groups.desc_zh: 核心认知图式为某种外力或作用源介入稳定系统，诱发连锁的形态或机能偏差；区别于普通的“行动”，本框架聚焦于因果链条对平衡的撼动与波及效应。
groups.nuance_en: touch: moving emotionally or reaching minimally without systemic upheaval (lives / heart / core) · affect: acting directly on something to modify its condition or function (climate / health / decisions) · impact: forceful, consequential collision generating widespread repercussions (economy / performance / environment) · alter: bringing about a defined, noticeable mutation in form, character, or course (plans / course / landscape) · disrupt: shattering the continuity or normal operation of a system (service / supply chains / markets)
groups.nuance_zh: touch: 在情感深处拨动心弦，或微幅触及某领域 (lives / heart / core) · affect: 最通用的直接作用，使客体的机能、状态产生变化 (climate / health / decisions) · impact: 产生巨大、显著且难以逆转的深远撞击与冲击 (economy / performance / environment) · alter: 使事物的形态、性质、航向或蓝图发生确凿更改 (plans / course / landscape) · disrupt: 瓦解或打断正常运作的连续性，造成混乱阻断 (service / supply chains / markets)

groups.name: Affiliate & Partner · 联合与挂靠 (Align, Associate, Team up)
groups.tip: 建立联盟或附属合作关系

items.def_en: (+ with) To connect or partner oneself or an organization with another group
items.ex_en: He deliberately refused to associate with anyone involved in the corruption scandal.
items.ex_zh: 他断然拒绝与任何卷入这起贪腐丑闻的人有所来往。

items.def_zh: 使隶属，使并入；发生联系，建立从属关系
items.def_en: To link a person or organization closely with a larger group or network, or to become formally joined with it.
items.ex_en: The regional medical clinic decided to affiliate with a prestigious university hospital.
items.ex_zh: 这所地方医疗诊所决定正式挂靠并隶属于一家知名大学附属医院。

items.def_en: (+ with) To join together with another person or group to achieve a common purpose
items.ex_en: The two rival tech companies decided to team up to develop the open-source platform.
items.ex_zh: 这两家相互竞争的科技公司决定联手合作，共同开发该开源平台。

items.def_en: (+ with) To bring an organization or faction into agreement or alliance with another
items.ex_en: The trade union chose to align itself closely with the progressive faction.
items.ex_zh: 该工会选择与进步派势力保持紧密的结盟与步调一致。
items.ex2_en: The wheels of the heavy racing car align automatically during high-speed turns.
items.ex2_zh: 重型赛车的车轮在高速转弯时会自动调整对齐。

items.def_en: To unite separate organizations or states into a formal federation or governing alliance
items.ex_en: Several independent agricultural cooperatives decided to federate into a unified national union.
items.ex_zh: 数家独立的农业合作社决定联合结成一个全国性的统一联盟。
items.ex2_en: The visionary leaders federated the scattered regional provinces into one powerful nation.
items.ex2_zh: 有远见的领袖们将分散的各省联合成一个强大的国家。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers organizations or individuals connecting formally or semi-formally with larger bodies to share resources, gain institutional backing, or pursue shared interests.
groups.summary_zh: 指个人或机构通过挂靠、结盟或联合融入更大体系或组织。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema involves binding autonomous entities into an organizational, legal, or strategic confederation, differing from 'merging' by retaining distinct individual identities.
groups.desc_zh: 核心认知图式为独立的法人或政治实体在保持各自自主身份的前提下结成战略同盟或归附挂靠；区别于融为一体的“合并”，本框架强调协同与契约纽带。
groups.nuance_en: associate: linking loosely in thought, business relations, or fellowship (brand / company / members) · affiliate: officially connecting a subsidiary branch to a larger parent organization (hospital / university / network) · team up: informal, tactical joining of forces to accomplish a single task (colleagues / companies / rivals) · align: bringing goals, policies, or strategic positions into parallel agreement (interests / strategy / nations) · federate: formally uniting independent states or unions under a central governing league (states / organizations / unions)
groups.nuance_zh: associate: 在业务往来、社交或观念联想上形成广泛关联 (brand / company / members) · affiliate: 将分立机构正式挂靠、附属于更大的母体体系 (hospital / university / network) · team up: 为攻坚具体任务而临时搭班子、携手协作 (colleagues / companies / rivals) · align: 使各方的利益、战略或立场对齐一致 (interests / strategy / nations) · federate: 多个主权实体或工会按宪章联合组建联邦/总会 (states / organizations / unions)

groups.name: Afflict & Torment · 折磨与使受苦 (Afflict, Torment, Plague)
groups.tip: 疾痛或苦难长久煎熬折磨

items.def_en: To make someone feel burdened, exhausted, or oppressed by trouble or grief
items.ex_en: She felt weighed down by domestic responsibilities and work pressures.
items.ex_zh: 她感到家庭责任和工作压力压得自己喘不过气来。

items.def_en: To cause continual discomfort, hardship, or severe trouble to someone over a long period
items.ex_en: Recurring mechanical failures continue to plague the commuter rail line this month.
items.ex_zh: 反复出现的机械故障在这个月里持续不断地困扰着这条通勤铁路线。

items.def_en: 1. (often passive, 'be afflicted with/by') To cause severe physical pain, chronic illness, or emotional distress to someone.
items.ex_en: A rare neurological disorder afflicted him during the prime of his career.
items.ex_zh: 在他事业的黄金时期，一种罕见的神经系统疾病折磨了他。

items.def_en: To cause someone severe and prolonged physical suffering or intense mental distress
items.ex_en: Painful memories of the disaster continued to torment the lone survivor daily.
items.ex_zh: 关于那场灾难的痛苦回忆每天都在无情地折磨着这位唯一的幸存者。

items.def_en: (formal) To cause great suffering or devastation to a people or region
items.ex_en: A prolonged drought scourged the rural heartland, devastating crops and driving famine.
items.ex_zh: 长期的干旱重创了这片农业腹地，摧毁了农作物并带来了饥荒。

groups.summary_en: Relates to causing acute or long-term bodily misery, severe physical pain, chronic illness, or profound mental anguish.
groups.summary_zh: 指疾病、苦痛、灾祸对人的身心造成长期的剧烈折磨。
groups.desc_en: Denotes subjecting an entity to sustained physical, mental, or societal distress, shifting from passive encumbrance to active, devastating victimization rather than transient hurting.
groups.desc_zh: 指使人或群体遭受持续的身心或社会性苦难，强调长期的折磨与摧残，而非短暂的伤痛。
groups.nuance_en: weigh down: overburden with oppressive emotional or physical burdens (grief / guilt / responsibilities) · plague: cause persistent, irritating, or disruptive distress (doubts / injuries / supply shortages) · afflict: strike with formal, enduring suffering or disease (patients / populations / poverty) · torment: actively inflict severe mental or bodily anguish (souls / prisoners / demons) · scourge: devastate systematically like a punitive whip or disaster (communities / coastlines / civil war)
groups.nuance_zh: weigh down: 以沉重的情感或生理负担重压 (grief / guilt / responsibilities) · plague: 长期困扰、反复侵扰使其不得安宁 (doubts / injuries / supply shortages) · afflict: 使遭受持久疾病或严重不幸 (patients / populations / poverty) · torment: 刻意或剧烈地折磨身心 (souls / prisoners / demons) · scourge: 像鞭笞或天灾般造成大面积毁灭性灾难 (communities / coastlines / civil war)

groups.name: Afforest & Plant Woodlands · 植树造林与绿化 (Reforest, Afforest, Revegetate)
groups.tip: 植树造林促进植被恢复

items.def_en: To make an area greener by planting trees, grass, and other vegetation
items.ex_en: The municipal authority launched an initiative to green several vacant urban lots.
items.ex_zh: 市政当局启动了一项计划，对市区内数块闲置空地进行植绿美化。
items.ex2_en: The dry hillside pastures will green quickly after the first spring rains.
items.ex2_zh: 初春的雨水过后，干涸的山坡牧场很快就会泛起绿意。

items.def_zh: 造林；在从未有森林的土地上植树
items.def_en: To establish a forest on land that has not previously been forested
items.ex_en: Environmental scientists planned to afforest the barren plateau with native hardy pines.
items.ex_zh: 环境科学家们计划用本土耐寒松树在那片从未成林的荒原高原上植树造林。

items.def_zh: 恢复植被；使重新长出植物
items.def_en: To replant or restore natural vegetation on barren, disturbed, or damaged ground
items.ex_en: The conservation crew worked tirelessly to revegetate the strip-mined mountain slopes.
items.ex_zh: 生态修复团队不知疲倦地工作，以恢复露天开采后的受损山坡植被。
items.ex2_en: The abandoned coal field will revegetate naturally within several decades without intervention.
items.ex2_zh: 无需人工干预，这个废弃的煤田将在几十年内自然恢复植被。

items.def_zh: 将（区域）全部栽种植物；植满
items.def_en: To fill an area of ground completely with trees, shrubs, or crops
items.ex_en: Volunteers will plant up the neglected community park with native flowering shrubs.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者们将在这个无人打理的社区公园里全部栽满本土灌木花卉。

items.def_en: to replant trees on land where an existing forest has been destroyed, cut down, or burned
items.ex_en: Local communities banded together to reforest the mountainside destroyed by summer wildfires.
items.ex_zh: 当地社区联合起来，在被夏季山火摧毁的山坡上重新植树造林。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the intentional cultivation and establishment of tree cover or vegetation on open or depleted land. They range from formal ecological terms like afforest to everyday acts of planting saplings.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及在荒地或受损土地上规模化植树绿化、恢复植被的动作。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the ecological act of introducing or restoring plant and tree cover to bare, degraded, or urban environments, differing from mere domestic planting through scale and conservation intent.
groups.desc_zh: 指在大面积土地、退化荒地或城市中引种并恢复植被或森林的生态治理行为，强调规模性与生态修复，区别于普通的庭园栽种。
groups.nuance_en: green: transform urban or barren space by introducing vegetation (rooftops / cities / deserts) · afforest: establish a completely new forest on land previously non-wooded (wastelands / pasture / hillsides) · revegetate: restore protective plant cover to stripped or damaged soil (strip mines / riverbanks / slopes) · plant up: densely stock an allotted ground with trees or shrubs (borders / plots / embankments) · reforest: replant trees on cleared or deforested woodland (logged tracts / burned areas / river basins)
groups.nuance_zh: green: 推进城市或荒芜区域的整体绿化与植被改造 (rooftops / cities / deserts) · afforest: 在从未成林的土地上首次大面积人工造林 (wastelands / pasture / hillsides) · revegetate: 在受损或裸露土地上恢复护坡防蚀地表植被 (strip mines / riverbanks / slopes) · plant up: 在特定地块上密集种植林木灌木 (borders / plots / embankments) · reforest: 在砍伐或烧毁的原有林区上重新植树造林 (logged tracts / burned areas / river basins)

groups.name: Afforest & Reforest · 植树造林与绿化 (Forest, Afforest, Reforest)
groups.tip: 播种移栽树木绿化造林

items.def_en: to plant trees and vegetation over land to improve appearance, biodiversity, or environmental health
items.ex_en: Urban planners hope to green the industrial corridor with dense roadside plantings.
items.ex_zh: 城市规划人员希望通过茂密的路旁绿植来绿化该工业走廊的环境。
items.ex2_en: The barren countryside fields begin to green as warm spring weather returns.
items.ex2_zh: 随着温暖春天的回归，贫瘠的乡村田野开始返青。

items.def_en: to cover an area of land with growing trees and create a forest
items.ex_en: The forestry commission decided to forest the open hillsides with native firs.
items.ex_zh: 林业委员会决定用本土冷杉将开阔的山坡全部覆盖成森林。

items.def_en: to establish a brand new forest by planting tree saplings on previously barren or deforested land
items.ex_en: The ambitious government initiative aimed to afforest several hundred acres of wasteland.
items.ex_zh: 这项雄心勃勃的政府计划旨在将数百英亩的荒地全部植树造成新林。

items.def_en: to plant tracts of trees across an open expanse of landscape
items.ex_en: Generations of landowners worked carefully to wood the rolling, barren chalk downs.
items.ex_zh: 几代土地所有者精心经营，用繁茂的林木覆盖了连绵起伏的白垩荒丘。

items.def_en: to replant an area with trees where a forest has been lost to harvesting, fire, or clearing
items.ex_en: Volunteers worked through the rainy spring to reforest the logged woodland valley.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者们在多雨的春季辛勤劳作，以对被采伐一空的林谷重新造林。

groups.summary_en: This ecological and silvicultural frame covers planting large swathes of saplings to establish new woodlands, regenerate logged forest ecosystems, or revegetate degraded land on an environmental scale.
groups.summary_zh: 指在荒地或采伐区大规模种植林木，营造森林或恢复林被生态。
groups.desc_en: Denotes covering or stocking land with woodland canopies, contrasting with generic cultivation by focusing specifically on the formation, maintenance, or restoration of timber and forest ecosystems.
groups.desc_zh: 指在土地上培育或重构森林生态体系，强调林木覆盖与造林工程，区别于一般的农作物耕种。
groups.nuance_en: forest: cover extensively with standing trees (bare hillsides / catchments / tracts) · afforest: convert unwooded land into permanent forest (marginal land / moors / valleys) · reforest: regenerate cleared or destroyed woodland (clear-cut sites / devastated slopes / timberlands) · wood: historically stock or furnish an area with growing timber (landscapes / estates / hills) · green: impart vegetated character to an environment (deserts / urban corridors / spaces)
groups.nuance_zh: forest: 使大片土地被林木完全覆盖成林 (bare hillsides / catchments / tracts) · afforest: 将非林地开辟并营造为人工森林 (marginal land / moors / valleys) · reforest: 对遭砍伐或破坏的林区进行再造林与树种补植 (clear-cut sites / devastated slopes / timberlands) · wood: 为特定地产或原野配置种植林木 (landscapes / estates / hills) · green: 实施生态绿化以改善地貌景观 (deserts / urban corridors / spaces)

groups.name: Age & Senesce · 成熟与衰老 (Decline, Grey, Wither)
groups.tip: 岁月流逝带来的生理演变

items.def_zh: 变老，老化；使变老；使陈酿成熟
items.def_en: 1. To grow older or show signs of aging. 2. To allow food, wine, or cheese to mature over time.
items.ex_en: Fine artisan cheeses must age in controlled subterranean cellars for six months.
