items.ex_zh: 优质的手工奶酪必须在温控地下酒窖中陈化成熟六个月。
items.ex2_en: The experienced distillers age the smooth bourbon in charred oak barrels carefully.
items.ex2_zh: 经验丰富的酿酒师将口感顺滑的波旁威士忌在烧焦的橡木桶中精心陈化。

items.def_en: To become old or cause hair to turn grey through advancing years
items.ex_en: Stress from his demanding executive position caused him to grey prematurely.
items.ex_zh: 高管职位带来的巨大工作压力使他年纪轻轻便头发斑白。
items.ex2_en: His dark brown hair began to grey gracefully during his late forties.
items.ex2_zh: 他的深棕色头发在四十多岁尾声时优雅地开始变白。

items.def_en: To gradually deteriorate in physical health, strength, or vigor due to advancing years
items.ex_en: Her elderly grandfather began to decline physically during the harsh winter months.
items.ex_zh: 在严酷的寒冬时节，她年迈的祖父身体状况开始逐渐衰退。

items.def_en: To become dry, shriveled, or physically frail and wasted from age
items.ex_en: Without sufficient nourishment and care, his frail body seemed to wither away.
items.ex_zh: 由于缺乏充足的营养与照料，他孱弱的躯体仿佛日渐枯萎消瘦。
items.ex2_en: The harsh winter frost withered the delicate flowers across the garden overnight.
items.ex2_zh: 严酷的冬霜一夜之间使花园里娇嫩的花朵全部枯萎。

items.def_en: (biology) To deteriorate with age at a cellular or organismal level
items.ex_en: As cultured human fibroblasts divide continuously, they eventually senesce and arrest proliferation.
items.ex_zh: 随着培养的人体成纤维细胞持续分裂，它们最终会老化并停止增殖。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on biological aging, physical decline, and progressive wear over the lifespan of living organisms or perishable commodities.
groups.summary_zh: 指生物机体老化衰退、显露岁月痕迹的动词群。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the natural, progressive transition toward biological obsolescence, functional deterioration, and physical decay, contrasting with sudden destruction or abrupt termination.
groups.desc_zh: 指机体或事物随时间推移必然经历的生理衰退、机能老化与枯萎过程，区别于突发性破坏或中止。
groups.nuance_en: age: undergo normal chronological maturation or gradual deterioration (wood / skin / populations) · grey: display loss of hair pigment indicating aging (temples / men / muzzle) · decline: gradually lose vigor, quality, or functional capacity (health / cognitive power / empire) · wither: shrivel and lose vital moisture or youthful freshness (leaves / limbs / beauty) · senesce: undergo biological cellular aging and terminal cessation of division (cells / tissues / organisms)
groups.nuance_zh: age: 随岁月流逝自然变老或品质陈化 (wood / skin / populations) · grey: 因衰老而毛发斑白 (temples / men / muzzle) · decline: 机能、活力或健康水平逐渐滑坡衰退 (health / cognitive power / empire) · wither: 枯萎干瘪，失去水分与生命活力 (leaves / limbs / beauty) · senesce: 经历细胞与生物学层面的生理衰老 (cells / tissues / organisms)

groups.name: Age & Wither · 衰老与枯竭 (Grey, Wither, Waste away, Senesce)
groups.tip: 身体器官退化衰老凋零

items.def_en: to become grey or white-haired as a natural part of growing older
items.ex_en: His dark brown beard began to grey noticeably around his late thirties.
items.ex_zh: 他那浓密的深褐色胡须在三十岁后半期开始明显变白。
items.ex2_en: Severe emotional distress and insomnia will grey a person prematurely over time.
items.ex2_zh: 严重的精神压力和失眠久而久之会让一个人过早白头。

items.def_en: to gradually lose the hair on one's head
items.ex_en: He began to bald noticeably along his receding hairline in his twenties.
items.ex_zh: 从二十多岁起，他额前不断后移的发际线处便开始明显掉发变秃。

items.def_en: to develop small folds or lines in the skin as a consequence of aging
items.ex_en: Deep lines began to wrinkle his weathered face after decades of working outdoors.
items.ex_zh: 在户外工作数十年后，深刻的纹路开始在他饱经风霜的脸上生出。

items.def_en: to become dry, shriveled, or diminished in strength and youthful vitality
items.ex_en: The elderly champion began to wither, losing both his muscular frame and vitality.
items.ex_zh: 这位昔日的冠军日渐衰弱，昔日强健的身躯与活力皆已不再。
items.ex2_en: Prolonged severe neglect withered the elderly patient's once strong physical health completely.
items.ex2_zh: 长期的严重疏忽彻底摧毁了这位年迈病人曾经强健的体魄。

items.def_en: to gradually become severely thin and weak through illness or extreme old age
items.ex_en: Without proper treatment, the patient began to waste away rapidly.
items.ex_zh: 若不接受适当治疗，患者便会迅速衰弱消瘦。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail visible physical senescence, including hair loss, greying, skin shrinkage, and the loss of youthful vigor or bodily substance.
groups.summary_zh: 指人或生物随岁月流逝出现头发脱落、花白、机体枯萎等肉体衰老与衰败现象。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the visible, physical manifestation of somatic degradation, atrophy, and desiccation as age or chronic illness strips away tissue mass and vitality.
groups.desc_zh: 指因年老或重疾导致身体组织萎缩、干瘪脱水和活力丧失的外在衰退过程。
groups.nuance_en: grey: turn silver or white as melanin ceases production (hair / beard / coat) · bald: progressively lose scalp hair (scalp / pate / plumage) · wrinkle: form furrows and creases through loss of skin elasticity (skin / brow / face) · wither: desiccate, shrink, and lose structural firmness (limbs / crops / flesh) · waste away: undergo severe emaciation and irreversible bodily atrophy (patients / bodies / muscles)
groups.nuance_zh: grey: 毛发因色素减退而变灰变白 (hair / beard / coat) · bald: 头发渐进脱落以致秃顶 (scalp / pate / plumage) · wrinkle: 皮肤失去弹性而生出褶皱 (skin / brow / face) · wither: 枯干萎缩，失去饱满水分与生机 (limbs / crops / flesh) · waste away: 因病或衰老极度消瘦萎靡、消耗殆尽 (patients / bodies / muscles)

groups.name: Agree & Concord · 和谐与一致 (Harmonize, Accord, Coincide)
groups.tip: 各方达成协定与和谐共处

items.def_en: (+ with) To correspond, harmonize, or be entirely consistent with something such as facts or rules
items.ex_en: The findings of the inquiry accord entirely with the evidence presented by witnesses.
items.ex_zh: 调查得出的结论与证人们提供的证据完全相符。

items.def_en: To arrange things so that they match, or to bring opinions into agreement with a specific stance
items.ex_en: The party leadership worked hard to align the members' opinions behind the proposal.
items.ex_zh: 党派领导层努力使党员们的意见与该项提案保持一致。
items.ex2_en: The front wheels must align properly to ensure safe highway driving performance.
items.ex2_zh: 前轮必须正确定位校准，以确保公路行驶的安全性能。

items.def_en: (+ with) To be identical in opinion, nature, or interest, matching another viewpoint perfectly
items.ex_en: His personal interests coincide closely with the broader financial goals of the enterprise.
items.ex_zh: 他的个人利益与该企业的长远财务目标高度一致。

items.def_en: (+ with) (formal or archaic) To agree, harmonize, or be in accord with something.
items.ex_en: These new statutory provisions concord fully with the fundamental principles of justice.
items.ex_zh: 这些新的法定条款与正义的基本原则完全相吻合。

items.def_en: To be suitable together, or to cause different parts, policies, or groups to work together agreeably
items.ex_en: The commission worked continuously to harmonize internal trade policies across all member states.
items.ex_zh: 该委员会不断开展工作，以协调所有成员国内部的贸易政策。
items.ex2_en: The contrasting musical tones harmonize beautifully inside the grand acoustic concert hall.
items.ex2_zh: 在宏伟的声学音乐厅内，截然不同的音乐声调和谐美妙地交织。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on mutual compatibility, constitutional alignment, and absence of friction between ideas, treaties, or parties. Verbs describe states or actions of falling into peaceful structural agreement.
groups.summary_zh: 思想、条款或主体之间保持协调、相符与无分歧的契合状态。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the state or realization of structural, conceptual, or relational congruence between distinct elements, contrasting with unilateral enforcement or disparate divergence.
groups.desc_zh: 指不同元素、观点或系统在结构与理念上达成相互呼应、一致或共振的状态，区别于单方面的强加或冲突分歧。
groups.nuance_en: accord: formally correspond with or grant consistent parity (status / privileges / values) · align: adjust into precise parallel orientation or doctrinal agreement (policies / incentives / parties) · coincide: occur at the identical temporal point or match perfectly by nature (views / schedules / interests) · concord: operate in formal peaceful agreement or constitutional symmetry (nations / factions / clauses) · harmonize: blend disparate elements into a pleasing, coherent unity (regulations / voices / interests)
groups.nuance_zh: accord: 正式相符、一致或赋予对等地位 (status / privileges / values) · align: 校准使立场、政策等高度协同一致 (policies / incentives / parties) · coincide: 时间重合或观点、利益完全相符 (views / schedules / interests) · concord: 达成正式、和谐的立约或共处 (nations / factions / clauses) · harmonize: 调和不同矛盾使之协调一体 (regulations / voices / interests)

groups.name: Agree & Settle · 协商与商定 (Concur, Clinch, Hash out)
groups.tip: 多方协商达成一致

items.def_zh: 商定，协同安排，协力策划
items.def_en: (formal) To plan, arrange, or settle something by mutual agreement or cooperation.
items.ex_en: The allied ambassadors met in private to concert a common defensive diplomatic strategy.
items.ex_zh: 同盟国的大使们私下会面，共同商定统一的防御性外交策略。

items.def_en: To discuss the terms of an agreement with other parties in order to reach a settlement
items.ex_en: Both delegations met early yesterday morning to negotiate the intricate terms of ceasefire.
items.ex_zh: 两方代表团昨天一早会面，就停火协议的繁复条款展开谈判。

items.def_zh: 反复推敲商定；达成妥协
items.def_en: To reach agreement through detailed, persistent, and exhaustive discussion
items.ex_en: We sat in the conference room for hours to hash out our differences.
items.ex_zh: 我们在会议室里坐了几个小时，反复推敲以化解彼此的分歧。

items.def_zh: 消除（分歧）；解决（细节问题）
items.def_en: To resolve remaining differences or minor complications through discussion
items.ex_en: The legal teams gathered before midnight to iron out remaining details of merger.
items.ex_zh: 法务团队于午夜前碰面，以解决合并案中遗留的细节问题。

items.def_en: To successfully conclude or settle an argument, deal, or negotiation decisively
items.ex_en: A single midnight telegram sufficed to clinch the delicate treaty between rival powers.
items.ex_zh: 一封午夜发出的电报便足以敲定敌对大国之间脆弱的条约。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses collaborative deliberation, mutual adjustment, and formal settlement where multiple stakeholders hammer out policies or contractual agreements.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及多方经磋商、协调与磨合后达成统一意见或敲定协议的行为。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the process of working through conflicting demands and discrepancies through discussion to reach a definitive, binding resolution, contrasting with unilateral decrees.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过谈判、沟通消除分歧并最终达成具有约束力的协议或结论的过程，区别于单方面独断。
groups.nuance_en: negotiate: confer formally to resolve disagreements and establish terms (treaties / contracts / terms) · concert: plan and coordinate jointly in prearranged cooperation (actions / efforts / strategies) · hash out: resolve intricate contentious issues through candid, prolonged discussion (details / differences / budgets) · iron out: smooth over minor residual difficulties or discrepancies (wrinkles / kinks / problems) · clinch: decisively secure or finalize a pending deal or victory (deal / agreement / nomination)
groups.nuance_zh: negotiate: 就条款正式谈判协商 (treaties / contracts / terms) · concert: 协同商定并统筹联合行动 (actions / efforts / strategies) · hash out: 深入激烈讨论以解决具体细节分歧 (details / differences / budgets) · iron out: 消除残余的分歧、小问题或瑕疵 (wrinkles / kinks / problems) · clinch: 最终敲定并锁定协议或胜局 (deal / agreement / nomination)

groups.name: Alternate & Cycle · 轮换与交替 (Alternate, Rotate, Cycle)
groups.tip: 按次序交替更迭或周期循环

items.def_en: To perform an action or hold a duty alternately with one or more other individuals
items.ex_en: The parents take turns driving the neighbourhood children to primary school each morning.
items.ex_zh: 父母们每天早晨轮流开车送邻里这群孩子去上小学。

items.def_en: (+ through) To move periodically through a set sequence of conditions, phases, or modes
items.ex_en: The automated system will cycle through various diagnostics before completing the full boot.
items.ex_zh: 该自动化系统在完成全面启动前，会循环执行各项诊断程序。

items.def_en: To occur or happen in turns, one after another; to switch repeatedly between two conditions, states, or actions.
items.ex_en: The patient began to alternate between periods of lucidity and intense febrile delirium.
items.ex_zh: 病人开始在神志清醒与高烧谵妄的状态之间反复交替。
items.ex2_en: The coach will alternate the players frequently during the intense tournament final.
items.ex2_zh: 在激烈的锦标赛决赛中，教练会频繁轮换上场球员。

items.def_en: To pass or take turns in a recurring regular order among different personnel or crops
items.ex_en: Senior diplomats rotate between foreign embassy postings and domestic administrative departments every triennium.
items.ex_zh: 资深外交官每三年在驻外使馆职位与国内行政部门之间轮换一次。
items.ex2_en: Smart organic farmers rotate different crops every spring to preserve soil health.
items.ex2_zh: 聪明的有机农夫每年春天轮作不同的农作物以保持土壤健康。

items.def_zh: 摆动，摇摆，在两种观点间摇摆
items.def_en: (+ between) To swing repeatedly back and forth between distinct states, extremes, or opinions
items.ex_en: Economists continue to oscillate between extreme pessimism and cautious optimism regarding interest rates.
items.ex_zh: 经济学家们就利率走势持续在极度悲观与谨慎乐观之间摇摆不定。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on things or people taking turns in regular sequence, recurring successively, or shifting back and forth between two or more contrasting states.
groups.summary_zh: 指事物或人员按照周期、顺序反复更替、交替出现或轮流值替。
groups.desc_en: Denotes recurring sequential succession between states, agents, or positions in a regular, rhythmic loop, contrasting with linear, non-repeating progression.
groups.desc_zh: 指不同状态、主体或位置按照规律、周期性节奏交替重现的过程，区别于不可逆的单向线性发展。
groups.nuance_en: take turns: act successively one after another by voluntary sequence (drivers / players / chores) · alternate: swing continuously back and forth between two opposing states or items (sunshine and rain / duties / weeks) · rotate: switch jobs, roles, or orientations around a fixed axis or orderly roster (crops / shifts / tyres) · cycle: pass sequentially through a closed recurrent series of stages (phases / batteries / seasons) · oscillate: swing continuously between two extremes or ideological limits (pendulums / temperatures / opinions)
groups.nuance_zh: take turns: 按次序轮流进行 (drivers / players / chores) · alternate: 在两种状态或主体间两两交替 (sunshine and rain / duties / weeks) · rotate: 围绕固定轴线或名册周转轮换 (crops / shifts / tyres) · cycle: 经历闭合循环的各发展阶段 (phases / batteries / seasons) · oscillate: 在两极点或界限间持续摆动摇摆 (pendulums / temperatures / opinions)

groups.name: Anatomical Traction & Pull · 向内牵引与内收 (Adduct, Contract, Retract)
groups.tip: 用力向自身方向拉拽或牵引

items.def_en: To bend a joint or limb through muscle contraction, decreasing the angle between bones
items.ex_en: The physical therapist asked him to flex his knee joint without overextending.
items.ex_zh: 物理治疗师要求他屈曲膝关节，但注意不要过度用力拉伸。
items.ex2_en: The dancer's slender legs flex naturally during the graceful classical ballet performance.
items.ex2_zh: 舞者纤细的双腿在优美的古典芭蕾表演中自然弯曲。

items.def_en: (anatomy) To move a limb or part away from the midline of the body
items.ex_en: The surgeon directed the patient to abduct the injured limb during examination.
items.ex_zh: 检查过程中，外科医生指导患者将受伤的肢体向外展动。

items.def_en: To draw or pull a body part or tissue back or inward
items.ex_en: The alarmed snail quickly began to retract its sensitive tentacles inside its shell.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的蜗牛迅速开始将敏感的触角缩回到外壳内部。
items.ex2_en: The cat's sharp curved claws retract smoothly into their soft protective sheaths.
items.ex2_zh: 猫锋利的弯爪顺畅地缩回到柔软的保护鞘中。

items.def_en: To make narrower or tighter by drawing surrounding muscles or walls inward
items.ex_en: Cold ambient temperatures cause peripheral vessels to constrict and preserve core body heat.
items.ex_zh: 寒冷的环境温度会促使外周血管向心收缩，以保存体核热量。
items.ex2_en: His swollen throat began to constrict painfully after eating the roasted peanuts.
items.ex2_zh: 吃下烤花生后，他肿胀的喉咙开始痛苦地收紧。

items.def_en: (anatomy) To move or pull a limb or other body part toward the median axis of the body.
items.ex_en: Upon instruction, the athlete managed to smoothly adduct the extended leg inward.
items.ex_zh: 依照指令，这名运动员顺利地将外展的腿部向身体内侧收拢。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this specialized frame describe directed anatomical or biomechanical drawing movements, particularly drawing limbs, flaps, or tissues toward the center axis or pulling them back.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及生物解剖层面肌肉牵引、肢体向身体中轴靠拢或组织内缩。
groups.desc_en: Denotes physiological or anatomical movement that pulls or constricts an anatomical structure toward a median axis, inner origin, or compact volume, contrasting with distal extension.
groups.desc_zh: 指机体解剖结构向中轴线、原点牵引、收拢或挤缩的力学运动，区别于向外的伸展与外展。
groups.nuance_en: adduct: pull a limb or organ inward toward the sagittal median plane (limbs / vocal cords / digits) · retract: draw a tissue or structural feature straight back or inward (claws / tongue / foreskin) · constrict: squeeze, tighten, or narrow a lumen or perimeter (pupils / blood vessels / airways) · flex: bend a joint to decrease the internal angle between bones (muscles / elbow / knees) · abduct: draw a limb or digit outward away from the median plane (hips / fingers / shoulder)
groups.nuance_zh: adduct: 使肢体或器官向中正中矢状面内收 (limbs / vocal cords / digits) · retract: 沿直线向后或向内缩回组织 (claws / tongue / foreskin) · constrict: 挤压收紧使腔径或外周变窄 (pupils / blood vessels / airways) · flex: 弯曲关节收拢骨骼角度 (muscles / elbow / knees) · abduct: 使肢体或指趾向外侧展开外展 (hips / fingers / shoulder)

groups.name: Animal Calls: Horses & Small Creatures · 动物鸣叫：马与小兽 (Whinny, Chitter, Neigh)
groups.tip: 鸟兽等动物发出的鸣叫嘶鸣

items.def_en: to make a soft, low, affectionate whinny
items.ex_en: The old mare gave a low nicker whenever her groom approached the stable.
items.ex_zh: 每当马夫走近马厩时，那匹老母马总会发出低柔亲昵的轻嘶。

items.def_en: 1. When a horse whinnies, it makes a soft, gentle, high-pitched neighing sound.
items.ex_en: The restless stallion began to whinny softly as morning feed was delivered.
items.ex_zh: 早晨的饲料送来时，那匹躁动的公马开始轻声欢叫嘶鸣。

items.def_zh: （鸟或小动物）发出唧唧声，啾啾叫；牙齿打战
items.def_en: 1. When small birds, bats, or insects chitter, they make rapid, high-pitched twittering sounds. 2. (of teeth) To chatter with cold or fear.
items.ex_en: Frightened chimney swifts began to chitter anxiously within the blackened brick flue.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的烟囱雨燕在漆黑的砖石烟道内急促而惊惶地唧唧鸣叫。

items.def_en: to make a long, loud, high-pitched call typical of a horse
items.ex_en: The startled stallion reared back on its hind legs and gave a loud neigh.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的公马后腿立起，发出一声响亮而悠长的嘶鸣。

items.def_en: to force air violently and noisily through the nostrils in impatience or alarm
items.ex_en: The impatient horse gave an angry snort and tossed its mane backward.
items.ex_zh: 那匹不耐烦的马愤怒地喷着鼻息，猛烈地向后甩动鬃毛。

groups.summary_en: Animals, particularly horses and small creatures (like rodents or small birds), produce characteristic vocal sounds expressing excitement, greeting, agitation, or rapid communication.
groups.summary_zh: 马匹或啮齿类等小型动物发出特征性的嘶鸣或轻促啼声，表达惊恐或交流意图。
groups.desc_en: Denotes non-verbal acoustic vocalizations emitted by equines and small mammals to convey agitation, recognition, or alarm, contrasting with broad predatory roaring.
groups.desc_zh: 指马匹及小型啮齿类哺乳动物发出的表达辨识、兴奋或警觉的特征性鸣叫，区别于大型掠食者的咆哮。
groups.nuance_en: neigh: emit a loud, high-pitched, triumphant horse cry (stallion / mount / team) · whinny: produce a softer, plaintive, lower-volume horse call (mare / foal / pony) · nicker: utter a low, gentle, vibrating affectionate equine sound (horses / mares / colts) · snort: exhale forcefully and noisily through the nostrils in warning or defiance (stallion / pig / bull) · chitter: make rapid, high-pitched clicking or squeaking noises (squirrels / bats / mice)
groups.nuance_zh: neigh: 发出响亮激昂的高亢嘶鸣 (stallion / mount / team) · whinny: 发出较轻柔或哀怨的咴咴悲鸣 (mare / foal / pony) · nicker: 发出低沉温顺、富于情感的喉音轻哼 (horses / mares / colts) · snort: 鼻孔大力喷气以示惊疑或反抗 (stallion / pig / bull) · chitter: 小型动物发出急促细碎的吱吱声 (squirrels / bats / mice)

groups.name: Animate & Energize · 振奋与激活 (Ginger, Liven, Galvanize)
groups.tip: 注入活力使充满生机

items.def_en: To make someone or an occasion more energetic, cheerful, and engaging, or to become so
items.ex_en: We hired a brass band to liven up the quiet village festival.
items.ex_zh: 我们请了一支铜管乐队，让沉寂的乡村节日顿时活跃起来。
items.ex2_en: The boring office party livened up immediately when the lively music started.
items.ex2_zh: 欢快的音乐一响起，沉闷的办公室聚会立刻活跃了起来。

items.def_en: To regain energy, cheerfulness, or freshness after fatigue, or to cause this in someone else
items.ex_en: A cup of strong black coffee helped the drowsy clerk perk up immediately.
items.ex_zh: 一杯浓烈的黑咖啡让昏昏欲睡的职员立刻重新振作了精神。
items.ex2_en: The sleepy children perked up immediately when their favorite cartoon theme started.
items.ex2_zh: 当最喜欢的动画片主题曲响起时，困倦的孩子们立刻精神了起来。

items.def_zh: 使更有活力，鼓舞；给……加姜
items.def_en: 1. (+ up) (informal) To make something more lively, energetic, or exciting.
items.ex_en: The producer brought in a comedian to ginger up the sluggish morning broadcast.
items.ex_zh: 制片人请来一位喜剧演员，好给死气沉沉的早间广播提振活力。

items.def_en: To give new life, health, vigor, or strength to an institution, community, or flagging effort
items.ex_en: The municipal council launched targeted subsidies to revitalize the depressed waterfront manufacturing district.
items.ex_zh: 市政委员会启动定向补贴计划，以振兴萧条的滨水制造业园区。

items.def_en: (+ into) To shock, stimulate, or energize someone suddenly into forceful action
items.ex_en: The unexpected tragedy served to galvanize local residents into immediate community action.
items.ex_zh: 这场突如其来的悲剧促使当地居民迅速行动起来，投身社区互助。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve infusing vitality, enthusiasm, or fast-paced momentum into something dull, sluggish, or demoralized.
groups.summary_zh: 指为沉闷、迟缓的人或事注入活力、热情与动力。
groups.desc_en: Denotes infusing vitality, enthusiasm, and dynamic responsiveness into an inert, fatigued, or stagnant entity, contrasting with mere calm maintenance.
groups.desc_zh: 指为原本倦怠、沉闷或僵滞的实体注入生机、热情与应激活力，区别于平稳的维系状态。
groups.nuance_en: liven up: dispel dullness and make an occasion cheerful and spirited (party / crowd / meeting) · perk up: regain brisk alertness and cheerfulness after languishing (patients / ears / market) · ginger: stimulate or spur into bolder aggressive action through a sharp prod (campaign / economy / team) · revitalize: restore comprehensive vitality and operational strength to decaying systems (economy / neighborhood / brand) · galvanize: shock into immediate, urgent purposeful action as if by electric impulse (public / voters / opposition)
groups.nuance_zh: liven up: 驱散沉闷，使场面活跃热闹 (party / crowd / meeting) · perk up: 从萎靡中振作恢复生机精神 (patients / ears / market) · ginger: 注入尖锐刺激以促使其提速发力 (campaign / economy / team) · revitalize: 使衰落系统彻底重获新生与生机 (economy / neighborhood / brand) · galvanize: 如电击般震撼并促发群体立即行动 (public / voters / opposition)

groups.name: Annex & Seize Territory · 吞并与强占 (Annex, Usurp, Appropriate)
groups.tip: 强行占领领土或夺取主权

items.def_en: To take possession of territory or property for one's own use, typically without authority or permission
items.ex_en: Corrupt officials attempted to unlawfully appropriate state-owned land for private industrial ventures.
items.ex_zh: 腐败官员企图非法侵吞国有土地，将其用于私营工业投资。

items.def_en: To enter and take military control of an area or country
items.ex_en: Hostile armed forces crossed the border at dawn to occupy key coastal ports.
items.ex_zh: 敌对武装力量拂晓时分跨越边境，军事进驻并控制了关键沿海港口。

items.def_zh: 吞并，兼并（领土等）；附加，附着
items.def_en: 1. To take possession of an area of land or a country, usually by force or without permission. 2. (formal) To attach or add something to a larger or more important thing.
items.ex_en: The aggressive imperial regime moved swiftly to annex bordering territories without prior warning.
items.ex_zh: 这一极具侵略性的帝国政权在未予预警的情况下，迅速吞并了周边领土。

items.def_en: To seize and hold power, position, or land by force or without legal right
items.ex_en: The rebel commander attempted to usurp legitimate authority during the nationwide political crisis.
items.ex_zh: 叛军指挥官企图在全国性政治危机期间非法篡夺合法权力。

items.def_en: To officially take away private property or land, often without adequate compensation
items.ex_en: The authoritarian regime declared plans to expropriate private farmland for state housing projects.
items.ex_zh: 该威权政权宣布了征用私人农田用于国家保障房项目的计划。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the unilateral, often unlawful or forcible appropriation of land, territory, or political sovereignty by a stronger state or entity. Nuances range from formal geopolitical annexation to brazen seizure.
groups.summary_zh: 强国或掌权者单方面武力吞并、占领或侵占领土与主权。
groups.desc_en: Denotes unilaterally seizing, incorporating, or claiming sovereignty over land, property, or authority without legitimate consent, contrasting with mutual conveyance or consensual transfer.
groups.desc_zh: 指在未经合法同意的情况下，单方面强行侵占、吞并或剥夺土地、财产及公权力的行为，区别于合法让渡。
groups.nuance_en: annex: formally incorporate adjacent external territory into an existing state (territory / Crimea / province) · occupy: move military forces into foreign territory to hold it under martial control (city / territory / capital) · usurp: seize sovereign power, throne, or office unlawfully (throne / power / authority) · expropriate: officially dispossess private owners of land or property for alleged public use (land / assets / estates) · appropriate: take possession of something for oneself without right or permission (funds / resources / land)
groups.nuance_zh: annex: 将邻近外邦领土正式强行划入本国版图 (territory / Crimea / province) · occupy: 派遣军队实施武装占领与管制 (city / territory / capital) · usurp: 违法篡夺君位、政权或法定权力 (throne / power / authority) · expropriate: 官方名义没收或征收私人土地资产 (land / assets / estates) · appropriate: 私自侵占或挪用不属于自己的资金资源 (funds / resources / land)

groups.name: Annotate & Gloss Texts · 文本注释与附注 (Annotate, Gloss, Marginalize)
groups.tip: 在学术文本中添加尾注说明

items.def_en: To provide notes directing the reader to related information in another part of the same book or document
items.ex_en: Careful scholars consistently cross-reference key citations across earlier chapters for total clarity.
items.ex_zh: 严谨的学者会在各早期章节之间相互参照关键引文，以保清晰无误。

items.def_zh: 为（难词或短语）作简注或训释
items.def_en: To supply an explanation, translation, or brief marginal definition for an obscure word or phrase
items.ex_en: The editor took great care to gloss unusual archaic terminology for modern readers.
items.ex_zh: 编辑极其细致地为现代读者就罕见的古老字词作了简要训释。

items.def_en: 1. To add explanatory or source notes at the bottom of pages in a text; to document with footnotes.
items.ex_en: The meticulous historian chose to footnote obscure archival references on every printed page.
items.ex_zh: 这位严谨的历史学家选择在每一印刷页下方为生僻的档案文献加注。

items.def_zh: 给（文章、书籍等）加批注或注释
items.def_en: To add critical or explanatory notes and commentary to a text, diagram, or book
items.ex_en: The medievalist spent years working to annotate rare manuscripts held in private archives.
items.ex_zh: 这位中世纪学者耗费数年心血，为私人档案馆藏的珍贵手稿作注。

items.def_zh: 对（经典或文献）撰写评注或系统阐释
items.def_en: To write an extensive, scholarly, or theological commentary analyzing a text in depth
items.ex_en: The theologian was invited to systematically commentate canonical texts for the academy.
items.ex_zh: 这位神学家受邀为学术界就正典文本撰写系统而深入的评注。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to furnishing a written manuscript, document, or publication with explanatory notes, commentary, critical apparatus, or cross-references.
groups.summary_zh: 对文本添加解释性批注、词解或旁注以澄清义理与源流。
groups.desc_en: Denotes appending explanatory, critical, or contextual scholarly apparatus to an established text, contrasting with writing fresh source literature from scratch.
groups.desc_zh: 指为已有文献文本添加解释性、批判性或考证性学术边注与说明，区别于创作全新源文本。
groups.nuance_en: annotate: provide explanatory notes, critical variants, and comments to a text (manuscripts / texts / editions) · gloss: supply brief translations or synonym notes for difficult words in a text (terms / archaic words / verses) · footnote: place supplementary citations or digressions at the bottom of a page (arguments / claims / chapters) · commentate: offer analytical, continuous interpretation on a primary work or broadcast (scriptures / matches / proceedings) · cross-reference: establish systematic intertextual links to other passages or works (entries / sections / records)
groups.nuance_zh: annotate: 为文本系统添加考证注释与批评按语 (manuscripts / texts / editions) · gloss: 为艰涩古旧词汇提供行间简注或释义 (terms / archaic words / verses) · footnote: 在页末作脚注补充引证或说明 (arguments / claims / chapters) · commentate: 对典籍或事件作连贯评注解读 (scriptures / matches / proceedings) · cross-reference: 建立不同段落文献间的互见参校索引 (entries / sections / records)

groups.name: Anoint & Consecrate · 敷油与圣化 (Anoint, Consecrate, Sanctify)
groups.tip: 宗教临终敷油仪式祝圣

items.def_en: to officially invest someone with ministerial or priestly authority in an established religious order
items.ex_en: The presiding bishop arrived yesterday to solemnly ordain seven new parish priests.
items.ex_zh: 主礼主教于昨日抵达，为七位新任教区司铎庄严授予圣职。

items.def_en: to smear or rub with holy oil or ointment as part of a religious rite or coronation
items.ex_en: The high priest stepped forward to anoint the young king with holy oil.
items.ex_zh: 大祭司走上前来，以圣油庄重地为年轻的国王行涂圣礼。

items.def_en: to officially declare a person, church, or bread and wine holy through solemn religious ceremony
items.ex_en: The cardinal traveled overseas to consecrate the newly rebuilt cathedral before thousands.
items.ex_zh: 枢机主教远赴海外，在数千人见证下为重建的大教堂举行祝圣礼。

items.def_en: to set apart or purify spiritually for holy or sacred purposes
items.ex_en: Monks gathered inside the ancient abbey to sanctify the newly constructed mountain shrine.
items.ex_zh: 修道士们齐聚在古老修道院内，为新建的山间圣所举行净化封圣仪式。

items.def_zh: 给（临终者）行敷油礼，涂圣油
items.def_en: (archaic) to anoint someone with consecrated oil, especially when administering the last rites
items.ex_en: The parish priest hastened through the night to anele the dying soldier.
items.ex_zh: 教区神父趁夜匆匆赶往现场，为垂死的士兵施行临终敷油礼。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this sacred ritual frame describe the ceremonial application of oil, chrism, or blessings to sanctify a person, monarch, or religious vessel. They emphasize formal conferral of divine grace, ordination, or dedication to sacred office.
groups.summary_zh: 指在宗教或登基仪式中施以圣油、赐福，赋予神圣属性或官职。
groups.desc_en: Denotes dedicating a person or object to divine service or sacred status via ritual oiling and liturgical rites, contrasting with profane, secular commissioning.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过涂抹圣油或举行宗教礼仪，将人物或器物从世俗界划归为神圣所有的仪式行为，区别于世俗任职。
groups.nuance_en: anoint: apply sacred oil as a ritual consecration for kingship or priesthood (kings / priests / sick) · consecrate: formally declare or dedicate an object, person, or ground wholly sacred (church / bishop / bread and wine) · sanctify: purify an entity from sin and infuse it with ultimate holiness (marriage / lives / rituals) · ordain: confer holy orders upon a member of the clergy through liturgical investiture (priests / ministers / deacons) · anele: historically administer the sacrament of extreme unction with oil before death (dying / souls / patients)
groups.nuance_zh: anoint: 涂抹圣油以举行加冕或祝圣圣职礼 (kings / priests / sick) · consecrate: 正式宣圣或将人事物奉献给神 (church / bishop / bread and wine) · sanctify: 荡除罪愆并使之具有神圣纯洁性 (marriage / lives / rituals) · ordain: 举行按立仪式授予教职神职 (priests / ministers / deacons) · anele: 临终前行涂油圣事以赦罪 (dying / souls / patients)

groups.name: Antagonize & Alienate · 挑衅与树敌 (Antagonize, Alienate, Estrange)
groups.tip: 主动激怒对方挑起敌意冲突

items.def_en: To irritate, annoy, or provoke someone without necessarily intending to
items.ex_en: His arrogant, dismissive attitude never failed to rub his new colleagues the wrong way.
items.ex_zh: 他那傲慢且轻视一切的态度总是在不经意间惹恼身边的新同事。

items.def_en: To make someone extremely angry, agitated, or hostile through annoying actions
items.ex_en: His inflammatory comments never failed to rile up the crowd into noisy protest.
items.ex_zh: 他那煽动性的言论每次都能把人群彻底激怒，引发喧闹的抗议。

items.def_en: To provoke, annoy, or upset someone so that they become hostile or opposed to you
items.ex_en: The politician deliberately sought to antagonize his opponents during the televised debate.
items.ex_zh: 在电视辩论中，这位政治家故意挑衅对手，企图挑起对立情绪。

items.def_en: To make someone stop supporting you or make them feel isolated and hostile
items.ex_en: Harsh disciplinary measures will quickly alienate loyal workers from company management.
items.ex_zh: 严酷的纪律惩处手段会迅速让忠诚的员工与公司管理层产生疏离与敌意。

items.def_en: To cause someone to stop being friendly, affectionate, or close with another person
items.ex_en: Sordid arguments over inheritance served to permanently estrange the siblings from each other.
items.ex_zh: 围绕遗产继承的下作争吵，使得这几位同胞手足彻底反目成仇。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers interpersonal actions that generate hostility, breach goodwill, or turn friends and allies into adversaries. The core mechanism is behavior so abrasive or oppositional that it provokes defensive anger or estrangement.
groups.summary_zh: 指因言行摩擦或对抗态度而激怒他人，致使关系破裂或树立对立面。
groups.desc_en: Denotes generating active hostility, resentment, and emotional distance between oneself and others through provocative, insensitive, or divisive behavior, contrasting with reconciliation.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过挑衅、不当言行或原则冲突，主动激起他人的敌意、反感并导致心理疏离，区别于亲善调解。
groups.nuance_en: antagonize: provoke active opposition, hostility, or counterattacks through abrasive conduct (voters / neighbors / colleagues) · alienate: isolate people emotionally or politically, causing them to withdraw allegiance (allies / electorate / base) · estrange: rupture an intimate, warm relationship through severe alienation (families / spouses / siblings) · rile up: provoke into temporary irritation, pique, and volatile anger (crowds / tempers / passions) · rub the wrong way: inadvertently irritate someone's temperament through habitual friction (colleagues / people / boss)
groups.nuance_zh: antagonize: 以对抗性言行招致直接抵触与敌意 (voters / neighbors / colleagues) · alienate: 使盟友、群体在情感或政治上疏远冷淡 (allies / electorate / base) · estrange: 造成至亲、夫妻间的情感决裂与形同陌路 (families / spouses / siblings) · rile up: 激起群体的即时恼怒与躁动 (crowds / tempers / passions) · rub the wrong way: 因处事风格不合无意间引起反感 (colleagues / people / boss)

groups.name: Applaud & Acclaim · 鼓掌与击节喝彩 (Clap, Applaud, Acclaim)
groups.tip: 拍手叫好表达赞赏与欢迎

items.def_en: To clap your hands together to show appreciation for a performance
items.ex_en: The enthusiastic host asked the audience to give a hand to our performers.
items.ex_zh: 热情的主持人邀请全场观众用热烈的掌声为我们的表演者喝彩。

items.def_zh: 拍手，鼓掌；轻拍；啪地放上（或关上）
items.def_en: 1. To hit your hands together repeatedly to show approval, praise, or enjoyment. 2. To strike or slap lightly with an open hand. 3. To place, slam, or strike quickly and forcefully.
items.ex_en: Children began to clap eagerly as the clown stepped into the circus ring.
items.ex_zh: 小丑一踏入马戏团场地，孩子们便兴奋地开始用力拍手欢迎。

items.def_en: To hit the palms together repeatedly to show praise, agreement, or appreciation
items.ex_en: Spectators rose from their seats to applaud the orchestra after the magnificent finale.
items.ex_zh: 气势磅礴的终曲结束后，观众们纷纷起身向交响乐团热烈鼓掌致意。

items.def_en: To voice loud approval and excitement alongside or in place of applause
items.ex_en: Passionate football supporters continued to cheer loudly until the final whistle blew.
items.ex_zh: 热情的足球支持者们持续高声欢呼喝彩，直至终场哨音吹响。

items.def_en: To praise enthusiastically and publicly as an outstanding achievement
items.ex_en: Leading critics across the continent acclaim her debut novel as a literary triumph.
items.ex_zh: 全欧各地的顶级评论家一致盛赞她的处女作是文学界的一大杰作。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe rhythmic physical clapping or formal public commendation delivered to artists, speakers, or champions. Nuances contrast simple percussive hand-slapping with reverent, high-intensity ovations.
groups.summary_zh: 通过击掌或公开盛赞来表示赞赏、欢迎与嘉许。
groups.desc_en: Denotes auditory social expressions of approval, praise, and collective tribute, shifting from mere manual clapping to enthusiastic vocal adulation.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过拍击手掌或发声呼喝来公开表达对精彩表现的赞赏与喝彩，从单纯鼓掌延伸至狂热拥戴。
groups.nuance_en: clap: strike open palms together repeatedly to indicate polite approval (hands / audience / crowd) · applaud: show vigorous, structured appreciation through clapping or formal praise (performers / decisions / efforts) · cheer: shout loud vocal acclaim, joy, and encouragement (fans / team / spectators) · acclaim: praise enthusiastically and publicly as extraordinary (critics / winner / novel) · give a hand: informally provide brief, polite applause as a courtesy (speaker / band / performer)
groups.nuance_zh: clap: 拍手击掌以示意 (hands / audience / crowd) · applaud: 热烈拍手鼓掌或高度赞许认可 (performers / decisions / efforts) · cheer: 高声欢呼喝彩为之加油 (fans / team / spectators) · acclaim: 赢得社会性广泛而狂热的公认赞誉 (critics / winner / novel) · give a hand: 口语中客套性地为某人鼓掌助兴 (speaker / band / performer)

groups.name: Appoint & Designate · 任命与指派 (Appoint, Assign, Commission)
groups.tip: 官方委任并指定特定角色

items.def_en: To publicly appoint or choose someone to occupy a specific post or role
items.ex_en: The board plans to publicly name a successor before the annual meeting concludes.
items.ex_zh: 董事会计划在本次年会闭幕前公开指定并宣布继任者的人选。

items.def_en: To grant someone an official military rank, or to authoritatively empower someone to perform a service
items.ex_en: The military academy prepared to commission twenty exemplary graduates as naval officers.
items.ex_zh: 军事学院准备正式任命二十名优秀毕业生为海军军官职务。

items.def_en: To choose someone formally and officially for a position of responsibility or a job
items.ex_en: The directors voted unanimously to appoint her as head of global marketing operations.
items.ex_zh: 董事们一致表决通过，正式任命她为全球营销业务的负责人。

items.def_en: To give someone a specific role, duty, position, or piece of work to undertake
items.ex_en: The editor decided to assign the investigative reporting project to senior staff members.
items.ex_zh: 主编决定将这一深度调查报道项目指派给资深采编人员承担。

items.def_zh: 指定，任命，委派；选定，标出；命名，称作
items.def_en: 1. To officially choose or appoint someone for a particular role, task, or position. 2. To indicate or specify something as having a particular purpose or name.
items.ex_en: The executive committee will officially designate a team leader at tomorrow morning's briefing.
items.ex_zh: 执行委员会将在明天早上的简报会上正式指定并宣布团队组长。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this official administrative frame refer to assigning a person to an office, role, title, or specialized responsibility through legitimate authority. Nuances vary between high-level political appointments, military commissions, and formal task allocations.
groups.summary_zh: 通过行政或法定权力选定某人担任官职或执行任务。
groups.desc_en: Denotes delegating an official title, post, or operational task to an individual through formal authority, contrasting with democratic consensus or informal volunteering.
groups.desc_zh: 指凭借正式职权将特定职位、头衔或行动任务派定给特定人选，区别于自发志愿或民主选举。
groups.nuance_en: appoint: select an individual officially for a high-ranking post or committee (judges / ambassadors / director) · designate: officially specify an individual or thing for a future role or purpose (heir / successor / sites) · assign: allot a particular task, duty, or jurisdiction to a person (tasks / roles / rooms) · commission: grant formal officer authority or officially contract a creative undertaking (officers / artists / study) · name: publicly declare a designated appointee to a post (cabinet / successor / candidate)
groups.nuance_zh: appoint: 依职权正式任命某人出任官职或要职 (judges / ambassadors / director) · designate: 明确钦定、标定接班人或特定用途 (heir / successor / sites) · assign: 分配派定具体职责、工种或任务 (tasks / roles / rooms) · commission: 委任军官职务或特约委托创作 (officers / artists / study) · name: 公开提名宣布某人出任职务 (cabinet / successor / candidate)

groups.name: Apprentice & Gain Experience · 实习与见习 (Apprentice, Article, Shadow)
groups.tip: 实习或演练以提升技能

items.def_en: (+ as) To undergo systematic instruction and practice to qualify for a particular profession
items.ex_en: She left her corporate job to train as an emergency care paramedic.
items.ex_zh: 她辞去了大公司的工作，开始接受成为急救护理人员的系统培训。

items.def_zh: 与…签见习契约（英式法律/会计）
items.def_en: (British) To bind a trainee by formal contract as an articled clerk in law or accountancy
items.ex_en: The prestigious London firm agreed to article promising university graduates in commercial law.
items.ex_zh: 这家著名的伦敦律所同意与有前途的大学毕业生签订商法见习契约。

items.def_en: To follow closely and observe an experienced professional to learn their job role
items.ex_en: New medical interns must shadow experienced attending physicians throughout their preliminary hospital rotations.
items.ex_zh: 新来的医学实习生在医院初级轮转期间必须全程跟岗观摩资深主治医师。

items.def_en: 1. (+ at/with) (chiefly North American) To work as a student or trainee to gain practical professional experience. 2. To confine or detain someone, especially during wartime.
items.ex_en: She decided to intern at a prestigious architectural firm during her summer break.
items.ex_zh: 她决定在暑假期间去一家享有盛誉的建筑事务所实习。

items.def_en: (+ to) To work for a skilled master or employer for a fixed period to learn a trade
items.ex_en: The young carpenter was apprenticed to a master craftsman to learn traditional joinery.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻木匠被送去跟一位工艺大师当学徒，学习传统榫卯工艺。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to working in a supervised, entry-level, or trainee capacity within an organization to acquire practical occupational skills. They contrast structured professional training with passive observational learning.
groups.summary_zh: 指以见习、学徒或跟岗方式进行职业实践以获取工作经验。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the structured immersion of a novice in a professional environment to acquire craft or vocational competence under senior guidance, contrasting with unguided self-study.
groups.desc_zh: 指新手在资深导师指导下，通过在岗实践系统学习专业技艺或行业规章的过程，区别于脱离实战的闭门自学。
groups.nuance_en: apprentice: bind a novice under formal contract to learn a skilled craft from a master (carpenters / artisans / electricians) · intern: work temporarily within an organization to gain professional exposure, often during study (students / graduates / doctors) · shadow: observe an experienced professional closely on the job without independent duties (physicians / teachers / managers) · article: indenture a trainee clerk to a professional practice under formal articles (solicitors / clerks / accountants) · train: undergo targeted systematic skill acquisition and drilling (athletes / personnel / recruits)
groups.nuance_zh: apprentice: 依师徒制拜师入行学徒 (carpenters / artisans / electricians) · intern: 作为在校生或毕业生在机构内短期见习实习 (students / graduates / doctors) · shadow: 如影随形地观摩老员工日常工作细节 (physicians / teachers / managers) · article: 依法律等行业传统合同受聘为受训实习员 (solicitors / clerks / accountants) · train: 接受针对性技能规训与专业训练 (athletes / personnel / recruits)

groups.name: Argue & Dispute · 争论与辩论 (Argue, Bicker, Quarrel)
groups.tip: 从口头争执到正式规则辩论

items.def_en: (+ about/over) To argue persistently and irritably about unimportant or petty details
items.ex_en: The siblings constantly bicker over who gets to sit in the front seat.
items.ex_zh: 这几兄妹总是为了谁坐前排这种琐事争吵不休。

items.def_en: (+ over/about) To argue noisily and childishly about trivial matters
items.ex_en: The committee members wasted valuable time squabbling about trivial seating arrangements during the summit.
items.ex_zh: 委员们在峰会期间为了微不足道的座位安排争吵不休，浪费了宝贵的时间。

items.def_zh: 争辩，争论；论证，提出理由
items.def_en: 1. To speak angrily to someone because you disagree. 2. To give reasons in support of or against an idea or action.
items.ex_en: They began to argue bitterly over how to allocate the remaining household budget.
items.ex_zh: 他们开始为如何分配剩余的家庭预算而激烈争吵。

items.def_en: (+ with/about) To have an angry disagreement or dispute with someone over personal or specific matters
items.ex_en: He quarreled with his brother over the division of their late father's estate.
items.ex_zh: 他因已故父亲遗产的分配问题与兄弟发生了争执。

items.def_en: (+ with/about) To engage in a very loud, noisy, and angry argument
items.ex_en: The neighbors rowed loudly in the hallway, disturbing everyone on the entire floor.
items.ex_zh: 邻居们在走廊里大吵大闹，吵得整层楼都不得安宁。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses verbal disagreements, escalating from petty, trivial squabbling to aggressive, loud, or deeply hostile confrontations between individuals.
groups.summary_zh: 指双方因意见分歧展开言语交锋，从拌嘴吵架到激烈争吵。
groups.desc_en: Verbal friction arising from disagreement, ranging from petty, persistent squabbling over trivialities to loud, emotionally charged confrontation, distinct from rational debate or academic disputation.
groups.desc_zh: 因分歧而引发的言语言语交锋，从鸡毛蒜皮的琐碎龃龉延伸至声嘶力竭的情绪化争吵，区别于理性的学术辩论或正式辩驳。
groups.nuance_en: bicker: petty, bad-tempered exchange over trifles (details / money) · squabble: noisy, undignified quarrel over trivial turf or resources (seat / toys) · argue: systematic or heated verbal dispute presenting opposing viewpoints (case / point) · quarrel: angry, personal falling-out threatening relationships (family / neighbors) · row: exceptionally loud, public altercation (couple / neighbors)
groups.nuance_zh: bicker: 为鸡毛蒜皮的事拌嘴、斗嘴 (details / money) · squabble: 为微不足道的利益或地盘吵闹争夺 (seat / toys) · argue: 就分歧进行激烈或条理化的争论 (case / point) · quarrel: 伤害情感的宿怨或严肃争吵 (family / neighbors) · row: 嘈杂、公开的大吵大闹 (couple / neighbors)

groups.name: Arm & Equip · 武装与整备 (Arm, Fortify, Weaponize)
groups.tip: 配置军备准备战斗

items.def_en: To provide a person, group, or nation with weapons and military equipment
items.ex_en: The government sought to arm local defense units with modern assault rifles.
items.ex_zh: 该国政府试图用现代突击步枪来武装地方防卫部队。

items.def_en: To fully equip someone or a unit with the necessary uniform, gear, or operational supplies
items.ex_en: The coach kitted out the entire junior team with brand-new football uniforms.
items.ex_zh: 教练为整个青少年队配齐了崭新的足球装备。

items.def_en: To strengthen a place against attack by constructing defensive barriers, walls, or military installations
items.ex_en: Engineers worked around the clock to fortify the coastal base against amphibious assaults.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们夜以继日地加固沿海基地，以抵御两栖进攻。

items.def_zh: 使军事化，给…配置军队；使军国主义化
items.def_en: 1. To equip an area, institution, or border with military forces and weapons, or organize it on military lines.
items.ex_en: The regime continued to militarize the border region despite vehement international diplomatic objections.
items.ex_zh: 尽管面临强烈的国际外交反对，该政权仍继续将边境地区军事化。

items.def_en: To adapt or convert an object, substance, or capability into an offensive weapon
items.ex_en: Experts warned that terrorists might weaponize commercial delivery drones with lethal nerve agents.
items.ex_zh: 专家警告称，恐怖分子可能会给民用投送无人机装载致命神经毒剂以实施袭击。

groups.summary_en: Encompasses supplying, upgrading, or outfitting troops, fortifications, or entities with martial capabilities, defensive armor, and offensive weaponry.
groups.summary_zh: 指为团体、边界或设施配备武备兵械，强化军事打击与防御能力。
groups.desc_en: Providing an entity, location, or system with weapons, military apparatus, or strategic defensive enhancements, distinguishing deliberate martial outfitting from generic provisioning or supply.
groups.desc_zh: 为实体、据点或系统配备武器、军备或战略性防御加固，区别于普通的物资供应或生活整备。
groups.nuance_en: arm: equip directly with combat weapons or defensive capabilities (militia / population) · kit out: provide comprehensive practical gear and uniforms (troops / expedition) · fortify: reinforce physical structures or positions against assault (castle / border) · militarize: transform a civilian zone or group into a permanent military posture (zone / police) · weaponize: convert non-lethal tools, information, or traits into instruments of attack (data / virus / trade)
groups.nuance_zh: arm: 直接配备作战武器或自卫手段 (militia / population) · kit out: 全面配发成套实用装备或军装 (troops / expedition) · fortify: 修筑防御工事加固据点 (castle / border) · militarize: 使民用设施、地区或警察军事化 (zone / police) · weaponize: 将非致命工具、信息或日常事物武器化 (data / virus / trade)

groups.name: Armor & Plate · 防护与装甲 (Armor, Plate, Shield)
groups.tip: 加装铠甲外壳以抵御外击

items.def_en: To protect someone or something from physical impact, radiation, or harm by interposing a defensive barrier
items.ex_en: Lead panels were installed to shield laboratory personnel from dangerous high-energy gamma radiation.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员安装了铅板，以保护实验室人员免受高能伽马射线的伤害。

items.def_en: To cover or overlay a vehicle, vessel, or structure with protective metal sheets or armor
items.ex_en: Technicians plated the military transport vehicle with thick sheets of hardened composite steel.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员用厚实的硬化复合钢板给这辆军用运输车装上了护板。

items.def_en: To sheath or reinforce a warship, vehicle, or structure with heavy iron plates
items.ex_en: Shipwrights labored tirelessly to ironclad the massive wooden warship against exploding artillery shells.
items.ex_zh: 造船匠们不辞辛劳地给这艘巨大的木制战舰加装铁甲，以抵御爆炸性炮弹。

items.def_en: 1. To cover a vehicle, ship, or person with protective metal plating or armor.
items.ex_en: Contractors were hired to armor the diplomatic limousines against high-caliber sniper fire.
items.ex_zh: 防务承包商受雇为外交礼宾车加装装甲，以防御大口径狙击步枪的射击。

items.def_en: To cover the exterior of a structure or surface with a protective or insulating outer layer
items.ex_en: Workers clad the tower's weathered facade with gleaming sheets of brushed copper plates.
items.ex_zh: 工人们用光亮如新的拉丝铜板包覆了这座高塔风化斑驳的外立面。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote encasing military personnel, combat vehicles, or installations in protective metal, composite, or ballistic plating to repel kinetic, chemical, or explosive attacks.
groups.summary_zh: 为人体、车辆或设施加装装甲或防护层，以抵御枪弹和外力创伤。
groups.desc_en: Applying a rigid, dense, or impenetrable outer casing to deflect physical impacts or technical radiation, distinct from soft covering, wrapping, or mere ornamental coating.
groups.desc_zh: 施加坚硬、致密或不可穿透的刚性外壳以抵御物理冲击或技术辐射，区别于柔软的包裹或纯装饰性覆层。
groups.nuance_en: shield: interpose a protective barrier to intercept incoming harm (eyes / reactor / body) · plate: apply protective metallic or ceramic layers directly onto a surface (hull / vehicle) · ironclad: encase heavily in iron plates, implying unyielding immutability (ship / contract) · armor: outfit comprehensively with protective combat plating (tank / warrior) · clad: encase or face externally with protective architectural or thermal shielding (building / cables)
groups.nuance_zh: shield: 设立屏障阻隔外界冲击或辐射 (eyes / reactor / body) · plate: 在表面镶嵌金属板或防护装甲板 (hull / vehicle) · ironclad: 包裹铁甲以达牢不可破之境 (ship / contract) · armor: 全面装备战斗装甲板 (tank / warrior) · clad: 在外部覆层包覆以实现防火隔热或防护 (building / cables)

groups.name: Armor & Protective Shielding · 着甲防护与厚重披装 (Barde, Armor, Sheathe)
groups.tip: 为人马战备披上重甲

items.def_en: To cover or overlay a structure with protective sheets of metal
items.ex_en: The hull was plated with heavy titanium alloy to withstand deep underwater pressure.
items.ex_zh: 船体包裹了坚固的钛合金护板，以承受深水高压。

items.def_en: To equip a person, vehicle, or vessel with protective metal plates or shields
items.ex_en: Engineers moved swiftly to armor the patrol vehicle with reinforced ceramic ballistic tiles.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们迅速采取行动，用强化陶瓷防弹板为巡逻车装上了防护装甲。

items.def_en: To encase or cover something closely in a protective outer layer
items.ex_en: The ancient tree trunk was sheathed in a thick mantle of clinging ivy.
items.ex_zh: 古老的树干被一层紧密缠绕的厚厚常春藤严密包裹着。

items.def_zh: 为（战马）披挂鞍鞯/华丽马甲
items.def_en: To put rich ornamental coverings or protective trappings onto a horse
items.ex_en: The royal stable master caparisoned the magnificent black stallion in velvet and gold.
items.ex_zh: 皇家马厩总管为这匹雄健的黑马披挂上了天鹅绒与金饰织就的华丽马具。

items.def_zh: 为（战马）披护甲；（烹饪时）用培根或肥肉片包裹（瘦肉）
items.def_en: 1. (historical) To equip a warhorse with protective armor (barding). 2. (cooking) To cover meat with bacon or fat before cooking.
items.ex_en: Squire William helped to barde the heavy warhorse with hinged plates of polished steel.
items.ex_zh: 侍从威廉协助用铰接的抛光钢板为那匹重装战马披挂上护身战甲。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve covering, fitting, or encasing an animal, vehicle, or structure with rigid armor plating or protective cladding to defend against physical assault or environmental impact.
groups.summary_zh: 指为战马、人员或机械加装防护装甲板、护套以防御打击。
groups.desc_en: The ritualized or heavy mechanical encasement of beasts, bodies, or specialized components in protective barding or sheathing, emphasizing historical, mounted, or close-fitted external protection rather than structural industrial cladding.
groups.desc_zh: 为战兽、肉体或精细部件施加厚重礼仪性或紧身防护覆甲，强调古典骑乘装具、贴身护具而非普通工业结构包层。
groups.nuance_en: plate: affix heavy metal defensive sections (chassis / torso) · armor: protect a war-ready target with defensive layers (cavalry / vehicle) · sheathe: encase snugly in a protective skin or scabbard (sword / cables) · caparison: adorn a warhorse with rich, decorative ceremonial trappings (steed / mount) · barde: equip a warhorse specifically with metal defensive body armor (destrier / warhorse)
groups.nuance_zh: plate: 装配沉重的金属防御板 (chassis / torso) · armor: 为作战主体装甲防护 (cavalry / vehicle) · sheathe: 紧密裹入护套或保护外皮 (sword / cables) · caparison: 为战马披上华美仪仗披风与装饰 (steed / mount) · barde: 特指为战马披挂金属防御重铠 (destrier / warhorse)

groups.name: Arouse & Kindle · 激发与唤起 (Arouse, Evoke, Kindle)
groups.tip: 点燃情绪引发强烈心理反应

items.def_en: To provoke or stimulate someone's curiosity or interest sharply
items.ex_en: The mysterious coded transmission piqued the intelligence analyst's curiosity almost immediately.
items.ex_zh: 那份神秘的加密电报几乎立刻激起了情报分析员的好奇心。

items.def_en: To cause deep, often turbulent feelings, memories, or public controversies to awaken
items.ex_en: His provocative political speech threatened to stir up old ethnic resentments across the region.
items.ex_zh: 他那番挑衅性的政治演说恐将在整个地区挑起昔日的民族怨恨。

items.def_en: To spark or awaken a warm, intense feeling, curiosity, or hope in someone
items.ex_en: The teacher's inspiring lecture kindled a profound passion for astronomy in young hearts.
items.ex_zh: 老师那堂鼓舞人心的讲座在年轻人心中点燃了对天文学的深切热爱。
items.ex2_en: Sudden romantic affection kindled quietly between the two long-distance pen pals.
items.ex2_zh: 这两位远距离笔友之间悄然萌生了突如其来的爱意。

items.def_en: To bring a specific feeling, memory, or mental image clearly into someone's conscious mind
items.ex_en: The haunting melody managed to evoke vivid memories of her quiet countryside childhood.
items.ex_zh: 那段令人难忘的旋律唤起了她对宁静乡村童年时光的清晰回忆。

items.def_zh: 引起，唤起；激起（欲望或兴趣）；唤醒
items.def_en: 1. To provoke a strong feeling, reaction, or suspicion in someone. 2. To excite someone sexually, or wake someone from sleep.
items.ex_en: His sudden unexplained disappearance aroused intense suspicion among the local law enforcement detectives.
items.ex_zh: 他毫无征兆的失踪引起了当地执法部门侦探的高度怀疑。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate stirring up dormant feelings, passions, curiosity, or reactions in someone through evocative words, events, or sensory cues.
groups.summary_zh: 指激发并唤醒内心情感、兴趣、警觉或生理欲望。
groups.desc_en: Triggering, inciting, or awakening latent emotional states, intellectual interest, or instinctual reactions, contrasting with cognitive deduction or passive feeling.
groups.desc_zh: 触发、煽动或唤醒潜伏的情感状态、求知兴趣或本能反应，区别于理性的逻辑推导或被动的情绪感知。
groups.nuance_en: pique: prick or provoke targeted intellectual curiosity or irritable pride (curiosity / interest) · stir up: agitate dormant feelings or social discord into active turbulence (trouble / memories) · kindle: ignite a warm, growing passion or inspiration from a spark (hope / enthusiasm) · evoke: summon forth vivid memories, imagery, or emotional resonance through associations (atmosphere / memory) · arouse: wake basic biological drives, strong passions, or widespread public alert (suspicion / passion)
groups.nuance_zh: pique: 挑起、激起特定好奇心或自尊心 (curiosity / interest) · stir up: 搅动沉寂的纷争或唤醒潜在骚动 (trouble / memories) · kindle: 像点燃火苗般催生希望或热情 (hope / enthusiasm) · evoke: 凭借联想唤起清晰记忆、意境或共鸣 (atmosphere / memory) · arouse: 唤醒本能冲动、炽烈情绪或戒备意识 (suspicion / passion)

groups.name: Arraign & Indict · 传讯过堂与正式指控 (Arraign, Indict, Impeach)
groups.tip: 法庭公开传讯提审并正式起诉

items.def_en: To record the formal charges against an arrested suspect in police records
items.ex_en: The officers took his fingerprints and booked him for grand theft at midnight.
items.ex_zh: 警官采集了他的指纹，并在午夜以重大盗窃罪将他立案登记入册。

items.def_en: (+ with) To state officially that someone may be guilty of a crime
items.ex_en: The state prosecutor decided to charge the corrupt mayor with accepting massive corporate bribes.
items.ex_zh: 州检察官决定正式指控这位腐败市长收受大笔企业贿赂。

items.def_en: To officially charge someone with a serious crime, usually through a grand jury
items.ex_en: A federal grand jury voted to indict the rogue financier on multiple counts of fraud.
items.ex_zh: 联邦大陪审团表决通过，以多项欺诈罪名正式起诉这位不法金融家。

items.def_en: To formally charge a high public official with serious misconduct in office
items.ex_en: Congress initiated proceedings to impeach the federal judge for chronic bribery and gross misconduct.
items.ex_zh: 国会启动了弹劾程序，指控这名联邦法官长期受贿及严重渎职。

items.def_zh: 提审，传讯并宣读控罪；指责，责难
items.def_en: 1. (law) To bring an accused person before a court to formally read criminal charges and receive their plea. 2. (formal) To criticize or accuse someone publicly.
items.ex_en: Authorities transported the accused cartel leader to the courthouse to arraign him on drug charges.
items.ex_zh: 当局将这名被捕的卡特尔头目押送至法院，就涉毒罪名对他进行正式提审。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers formal judicial actions where an accused person is summoned into court, presented with an official indictment, and called upon to enter a plea.
groups.summary_zh: 指司法程序中正式传唤被告到庭提审、宣读书状及答辩。
groups.desc_en: Progressing through formalized juridical or constitutional stages of formal accusation, charging, and procedural confrontation in a court of law, distinct from informal blaming or social accusation.
groups.desc_zh: 在法庭或宪制框架下推进正式指控、过堂与定罪的司法程序，区别于非正式的社会责备或私下谴责。
groups.nuance_en: book: log suspect details, fingerprints, and initial detention procedurally (suspect / prisoner) · charge: formally assert criminal accusations under law (defendant / suspect) · indict: formally issue a true bill of indictment via a grand jury for a serious crime (official / criminal) · impeach: constitutionally charge a sitting public official with high crimes before a legislature (president / judge) · arraign: bring a prisoner before a court to hear charges and enter a formal plea (defendant / suspect)
groups.nuance_zh: book: 警方登记嫌疑人档案并正式录案 (suspect / prisoner) · charge: 执法机关正式控告涉嫌违法 (defendant / suspect) · indict: 大陪审团就重罪正式提起公诉 (official / criminal) · impeach: 立法机关对在职高级官员提起弹劾指控 (president / judge) · arraign: 传讯被告正式过堂听取起诉书并答辩 (defendant / suspect)

groups.name: Arrest Growth & Restrict · 阻碍发育与压制 (Stunt, Inhibit, Stifle)
groups.tip: 阻碍阻滞正常生长发育

items.def_en: To hold back or arrest the normal development, expression, or activity of something
items.ex_en: Strict governmental price controls served to suppress normal entrepreneurial activity within the struggling economy.
items.ex_zh: 严厉的政府物价管制抑制了萧条经济体系内正常的创业活力。

items.def_zh: 阻碍…的正常生长发育，抑制…的成长
items.def_en: 1. To prevent a plant, person, or thing from growing, developing, or progressing normally.
items.ex_en: A severe prolonged drought threatened to stunt the growth of young wheat crops everywhere.
items.ex_zh: 严重的持续干旱恐将阻碍各地幼嫩小麦作物的正常生长发育。

items.def_en: To slow down the growth, development, or progress of something, or make it hard for a process to occur
items.ex_en: Extreme cold temperatures can inhibit the normal cellular activity of delicate bacterial cultures.
items.ex_zh: 极端低温会抑制脆弱细菌培养物正常的细胞活动过程。

items.def_en: To bring something such as growth, supply, or initiative to an abrupt end by constriction or stoppage
items.ex_en: Soaring interest rates threatened to choke off credit access for ambitious young startup founders.
items.ex_zh: 急剧飙升的利率恐将扼断雄心勃勃的初创企业创始人获得信贷的途径。

items.def_en: To prevent something from developing, functioning freely, or being expressed
items.ex_en: Heavy-handed censorship measures stifle artistic creativity and open public debate across the nation.
items.ex_zh: 严厉的高压审查手段扼杀了全社会范围内的艺术创造力与公开讨论。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe arresting, checking, or preventing the natural growth, development, or creative flourishing of an organism, talent, or economy.
groups.summary_zh: 阻碍生理、智力、才能或经济的自然成长与发育。
groups.desc_en: Restricting, cutting short, or preemptively choking the natural biological, economic, or developmental trajectory of an entity, contrasting with gentle slowing down or late-stage destruction.
groups.desc_zh: 扼杀、抑制或阻截生物、经济或事物本应具有的自然生长与发展轨迹，区别于温和的减速或彻底的晚期摧毁。
groups.nuance_en: suppress: forcibly crush existing expressions or overt activity from above (rebellion / evidence) · stunt: prematurely halt natural physical or intellectual maturation (growth / development) · inhibit: chemically or functionally hinder an organic reaction or spontaneous action (growth / enzymes) · choke off: starve a process by cutting off essential flow or supply lines (supply / recovery) · stifle: suffocate or smother dynamic creative spark or vocal dissent (innovation / dissent)
groups.nuance_zh: suppress: 自上而下暴力镇压既成行为或掩盖事实 (rebellion / evidence) · stunt: 使身体或心智等自然发育永久受阻 (growth / development) · inhibit: 在机制上或生化层面阻滞反应与行动 (growth / enzymes) · choke off: 掐断供给通道以窒息经济或供应进程 (supply / recovery) · stifle: 扼制萌芽状态的创新、异见或生机活力 (innovation / dissent)

groups.name: Articulate Notes · 吹奏运舌与断音 (Articulate, Slur, Double-tongue)
groups.tip: 口齿清晰准确地咬字发声

items.def_en: To use the fingers in a designated manner on the keys, stops, or holes of a musical instrument
items.ex_en: The novice flutist struggled to finger the rapid descending passages smoothly without hesitating.
items.ex_zh: 这位初学长笛的人很难在不犹豫的情况下顺畅地按指弹奏快速下行乐段。

items.def_zh: 用舌吹奏（管乐器），用舌音发声；舔；斥责
items.def_en: To articulate notes distinctly using the tongue while playing a wind instrument.
items.ex_en: The clarinetist began to tongue each staccato note with crisp and breathtaking clarity.
items.ex_zh: 单簧管演奏家开始用舌吐音，将每个断音吹奏得格外干脆清脆。

items.def_en: To play two or more successive musical notes smoothly and continuously without tongue interruptions
items.ex_en: The composer instructed the flutist to slur the delicate chromatic passage seamlessly.
items.ex_zh: 作曲家指示长笛手要毫无顿挫地连音吹奏那段精巧的半音阶旋律。

items.def_en: To play or sing distinct, detached successive notes cleanly without blurring
items.ex_en: The skilled trumpeter must articulate every single note distinctly during the rapid baroque concerto.
items.ex_zh: 在这首快速的巴洛克协奏曲中，技术精湛的小号手必须将每个音符都清晰吐奏出来。

items.def_en: To articulate rapid passages on a brass or wind instrument using alternating movements of the tip and back of the tongue
items.ex_en: To master the virtuoso trumpet solo, one must double-tongue those extremely rapid sixteenth notes.
items.ex_zh: 要驾驭那段独奏小号大师级华彩乐段，演奏者必须用双吐法吹奏那些极速十六分音符。

groups.summary_en: Specifically denotes vocal tract or instrumental mechanics where wind/brass players separate, slur, or articulate musical notes using tongue actions.
groups.summary_zh: 指管乐演奏中通过运舌控制音符分合与吐字发音。
groups.desc_en: Executing deliberate oral and digital mechanics to separate, slur, or articulate musical notes on a wind instrument, contrasting with continuous singing or undifferentiated blowing.
groups.desc_zh: 在管乐演奏中通过指法与运舌的微细机械控制来实现音符的断连与发音，区别于持续平直的发声或浑沦吞吐。
groups.nuance_en: finger: depress key configurations accurately to govern pitch (keys / flute) · tongue: strike the reed or mouthpiece with the tongue to demarcate note starts (reed / notes) · slur: execute successive distinct pitches in a single smooth, unbroken breath without tongue attacks (passage / phrase) · articulate: execute intentional separation and distinct acoustic envelope on every note (passage / motif) · double-tongue: deploy alternating lingual strokes (T-K) for rapid-fire staccato delivery (passage / run)
groups.nuance_zh: finger: 运指按键以精确掌控音高 (keys / flute) · tongue: 以舌尖触碰哨片或吹嘴规范吐音 (reed / notes) · slur: 一气呵成连奏音符而不重新吐音 (passage / phrase) · articulate: 清晰断离并赋予每个音符特定的发音轮廓 (passage / motif) · double-tongue: 利用舌头交替（如T-K法）极速双吐断奏 (passage / run)

groups.name: Asphyxiate & Smother · 窒息与扼毙 (Smother, Throttle, Asphyxiate)
groups.tip: 缺氧无法呼吸致昏厥甚至死亡

items.def_en: Severely restrict, obstruct, or cut off the passage of air or flow of a vital supply
items.ex_en: The collapsing debris threatened to choke off the trapped miner's dwindling air supply.
items.ex_zh: 坍塌的瓦砾险些彻底切断那名被困矿工日渐匮乏的空气供应。

items.def_en: Attack or kill someone by compressing their throat tightly to cut off their breath
items.ex_en: The violent burglar attempted to throttle the sleeping homeowner into unconsciousness with bare hands.
items.ex_zh: 凶狠的入室盗贼企图徒手将熟睡的房主掐至窒息昏迷。

items.def_en: Kill someone by covering their nose and mouth so they are completely unable to breathe
items.ex_en: The cold-blooded assassin attempted to smother the ailing king with a heavy silk pillow.
items.ex_zh: 冷血的刺客企图用沉重的丝绸枕头将抱病的国王活活捂死。

items.def_en: Squeeze the neck of a person or animal tightly, typically causing fatal airway collapse
items.ex_en: The forensic pathologist concluded that the assailant used a nylon cord to strangle her.
items.ex_zh: 法医病理学家断定，袭击者曾使用一根尼龙绳将其残忍勒死。

items.def_en: To kill, die, or become unconscious from being deprived of air or unable to breathe.
items.ex_en: Thick noxious smoke filled the sealed basement apartment, threatening to asphyxiate the sleeping residents.
items.ex_zh: 浓烈有害的烟雾弥漫在密闭的地下室公寓内，恐将熟睡的住户窒息致死。
items.ex2_en: The injured trapped climber asphyxiated slowly inside the narrow snowbound mountain cave.
items.ex2_zh: 受伤被困的登山者在狭窄且被大雪封锁的山洞里慢慢窒息。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on extreme, often fatal deprivation of oxygen caused by external obstruction of the airway, toxic environments, or mechanical strangulation.
groups.summary_zh: 强调因气道受阻、缺氧或外力压迫导致丧失呼吸乃至致死。
groups.desc_en: Depriving a living organism or operational system of life-sustaining oxygen or flow through mechanical constriction or covering, distinct from generic poison, killing, or non-fatal blockage.
groups.desc_zh: 通过机械压迫、覆盖或扼住通气通道，使机体或系统因缺氧而窒息致死，区别于毒杀、泛化击杀或轻度堵塞。
groups.nuance_en: choke off: sever crucial external supply or air corridors through constriction (supply / lifeblood) · throttle: crush or strangle an airway manually or mechanically with severe grip (victim / engine) · smother: deprive of air by entirely covering the breathing orifices or fire source (flames / baby) · strangle: kill by tightly compressing the neck with hands or a ligature (victim / cord) · asphyxiate: cause physiological death or unconsciousness through profound oxygen deprivation (gases / smoke)
groups.nuance_zh: choke off: 扼阻供应通道或气流使其濒临绝境 (supply / lifeblood) · throttle: 死死掐住气管或机械节流阀压制其运作 (victim / engine) · smother: 严密蒙住口鼻或覆盖火源致其窒息熄灭 (flames / baby) · strangle: 用手或绳索紧勒颈部扼毙 (victim / cord) · asphyxiate: 因环境缺氧或有毒气体导致机体窒息死亡 (gases / smoke)

groups.name: Assemble & Convene · 召集与集会 (Convene, Assemble, Muster)
groups.tip: 召集众人重新召开会议

items.def_en: To come together in a single place as a group, or to bring people together
items.ex_en: The general ordered his commanders to assemble the elite battalion in the central courtyard.
items.ex_zh: 将军命令各级指挥官在中央大院将这支精锐营队集合完毕。
items.ex2_en: Excited fans began to assemble outside the stadium early this sunny morning.
items.ex2_zh: 在这个晴朗的早晨，兴奋的球迷们一大早就开始在体育场外聚集。

items.def_en: To arrange or summon an official meeting, panel, or assembly, or to meet together officially
items.ex_en: The prime minister will convene a special cabinet meeting tomorrow to address the crisis.
items.ex_zh: 首相将于明天召开内阁特别会议以应对眼前的危机。
items.ex2_en: The academic ethics committee will convene tomorrow morning to review the allegations.
items.ex2_zh: 学术道德委员会将于明早召开会议以审查指控。

items.def_en: To assemble soldiers or collective resources, especially for inspection or military action
items.ex_en: The weary captain attempted to muster his remaining troops for one final defensive stand.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的连长试图将剩余的士兵集合起来，进行最后一次坚壁防守。
items.ex2_en: The brave villagers mustered quickly in the square to fight the wildfire.
items.ex2_zh: 勇敢的村民们迅速在广场集合以扑灭野火。

items.def_zh: （使）重新集会，（使）重新召集，（使）复会
items.def_en: To gather together again, or to call a meeting or court back into session after a pause.
items.ex_en: The presiding judge stated that the court will reconvene tomorrow morning at ten o'clock.
items.ex_zh: 主审法官宣布，法庭将于明早十点整重新开庭审理。
items.ex2_en: The committee chairperson reconvened the adjourned discussion after the short lunch break.
items.ex2_zh: 午餐短暂休息后，委员会主席重新召开了中止的讨论会。

items.def_en: To call together an official, ecclesiastical, or legislative assembly by authority
items.ex_en: The Holy Father resolved to convoke an extraordinary ecumenical council to address global conflicts.
items.ex_zh: 教宗决意召集一次特别大公会议，以商讨应对全球范围内的冲突。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers formal, institutional, or deliberative gatherings where participants are summoned or come together for meetings, governance, military muster, or civic rallies.
groups.summary_zh: 指依规程召集或聚集人员参加会议、议事、演训等正式集体活动。
groups.desc_en: Summoning and bringing together dispersed people, troops, or representative delegates into a unified, functional collective body, contrasting with spontaneous crowds or informal social gatherings.
groups.desc_zh: 将分散的人员、军队或代表统一召集聚合为具有既定职能的集体，区别于自发的群众扎堆或非正式社交聚会。
groups.nuance_en: assemble: gather dispersed components or personnel into one ordered space (crowd / team) · convene: formally call official members together for an institutional meeting (committee / parliament) · muster: summon, review, and mobilize military forces or internal resolve (troops / courage) · reconvene: re-gather a formal assembly after a designated adjournment (session / court) · convoke: authoritatively summon a high-level solemn, religious, or political council (assembly / synod)
groups.nuance_zh: assemble: 将散落的人员或组件汇聚整队 (crowd / team) · convene: 官方正式召集委员或代表议事 (committee / parliament) · muster: 检阅、集结军队，或鼓起内在勇气 (troops / courage) · reconvene: 休会后重新召集复会 (session / court) · convoke: 凭借最高权威召集神圣会议或政治大典 (assembly / synod)

groups.name: Assert & Claim · 断言与坚称 (Claim, Assert, Maintain)
groups.tip: 从主观声称到坚定断言事实

items.def_zh: 宣称，断言；要求，索取；索赔；认领
items.def_en: 1. To state or assert that something is true, often without giving proof. 2. To demand or take something as one's rightful property or right.
items.ex_en: He had the audacity to claim that he invented the entire software architecture single-handedly.
items.ex_zh: 他竟敢大言不惭地宣称是自己一手独立发明了整套软件架构。

items.def_en: To express firmly and repeatedly that something is true despite opposition
items.ex_en: Despite mounting empirical counter-evidence, the stubborn researcher continued to maintain that his hypothesis was right.
items.ex_zh: 尽管反面实验证据堆积如山，这名固执的研究人员依然坚称自己的假说是正确的。

items.def_zh: 声称（多指未经证实的指控）
items.def_en: To state without proof that someone has done something wrong or illegal
items.ex_en: Disgruntled former employees allege that the company routinely mismanaged public pension reserve funds.
items.ex_zh: 心怀不满的前员工声称该公司经常对公共养老储备基金管理不善。

items.def_en: To state something firmly as a reasoned opinion in an argument
items.ex_en: Defense counsel will contend that the client acted purely out of justified self-defense.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师将在法庭上据理力争，主张其当事人纯粹出于正当防卫。

items.def_en: To state a fact or belief confidently, forcefully, and without hesitation
items.ex_en: She stood before the committee to assert her unwavering innocence in the financial scandal.
items.ex_zh: 她站在委员会面前，坚定而毫不动摇地坚称自己在金融丑闻中是无辜的。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on insisting that something is true, justified, or due, often in the face of doubt, dispute, or absence of incontrovertible proof.
groups.summary_zh: 指缺乏确凿证据或面临质疑时，坚称某事属实或主张权利。
groups.desc_en: Advancing a propositional truth or entitlement firmly in the face of possible challenge, contrasting with definitive empirical proof or meek suggestion.
groups.desc_zh: 在可能面临质疑的情境下坚定提出命题性主张或权利诉求，区别于无可争议的经验证实或试探性建议。
groups.nuance_en: claim: state an entitlement or unverified factual assertion as truth (damages / right) · maintain: adhere tenaciously to a stated position against ongoing skepticism (innocence / stance) · allege: assert an unproven accusation or wrongdoing without immediate substantiation (fraud / crime) · contend: argue a contested claim forcefully within an adversarial debate (point / theory) · assert: declare a point with firm, unhesitating conviction (authority / innocence)
groups.nuance_zh: claim: 提出尚未核实的产权、赔偿主张或事实断言 (damages / right) · maintain: 顶住外界质疑长期坚称某立场 (innocence / stance) · allege: 在无直接确凿证据下指控涉嫌罪行 (fraud / crime) · contend: 在对立辩论中坚决抗辩其观点 (point / theory) · assert: 笃定、果断地表明立场或权威 (authority / innocence)

groups.name: Assert & Declare · 陈述与声明 (State, Declare, Assert)
groups.tip: 正式陈述并对外郑重声明

items.def_en: 1. To express thoughts, facts, or opinions clearly and formally in speech or writing.
items.ex_en: The corporate manifesto clearly states the core fundamental ethical principles guiding all overseas operations.
items.ex_zh: 该公司的企业宣言明确陈述了指导其所有海外业务的核心道德基本准则。

items.def_en: To announce something publicly, officially, or emphatically
items.ex_en: The president will declare a national state of emergency during tonight's televised address.
items.ex_zh: 总统将在今晚的电视讲话中郑重宣布国家进入紧急状态。

items.def_en: To give a formal, official, or authoritative decision, opinion, or judgment
items.ex_en: The attending physician solemnly stepped forward to pronounce the injured patient dead on arrival.
items.ex_zh: 主治医生神色庄重地走上前去，正式宣告送医的伤者在送达时已死亡。

items.def_en: To state a fact or belief firmly, positively, and with confidence
items.ex_en: The distinguished scholar boldly stepped forward to assert that the ancient scroll was authentic.
items.ex_zh: 这位著名学者勇敢地站出来，言之凿凿地断言这幅古代卷轴确系真迹。

items.def_en: To state publicly and firmly that something is true, or to formally reassert a commitment
items.ex_en: The diplomatic treaty served to affirm both sovereign nations' longstanding commitment to perpetual peace.
items.ex_zh: 这项外交条约旨在正式重申两个主权国家对实现持久和平的长期承诺。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate making a direct, definitive, and authoritative formulation of facts, positions, or beliefs in speech or writing.
groups.summary_zh: 正式、明确且郑重地陈述事实、观点或官方立场。
groups.desc_en: Formalizing and audibly broadcasting an explicit truth, commitment, or institutional decree to make it on-the-record, contrasting with private thought or casual conversation.
groups.desc_zh: 将明确的真相、诺言或体制裁决正式公开宣诸于世以供存档，区别于私下的念头或随意的闲聊。
groups.nuance_en: state: express definite factual details clearly and carefully in words (terms / position) · declare: announce an official, decisive status or policy explicitly to the public (war / emergency) · pronounce: utter an authoritative, definitive judgment or official status solemnized by position (sentence / verdict) · assert: state one's opinion or presence with positive force and certitude (dominance / rights) · affirm: validate, uphold, or re-pledge dedication to a formal truth or legal vow (loyalty / ruling)
groups.nuance_zh: state: 准确无误地陈述具体条款或事实 (terms / position) · declare: 向公众正式宣告重大状态或决议 (war / emergency) · pronounce: 权威人士庄严宣布判决或裁定 (sentence / verdict) · assert: 坚决声明其主见、权益或存在感 (dominance / rights) · affirm: 庄严确认某命题或重申宣誓誓词 (loyalty / ruling)

groups.name: Asset Liquidation & Disinvestment · 资产剥离与撤资 (Divest, Offload, Liquidate)
groups.tip: 撤回投资或剥离下属资产

items.def_en: Sell one's investment or business equity to convert the total value into physical cash
items.ex_en: The early investor decided to cash out his substantial shares before the market crashed.
items.ex_zh: 那位早期投资者决定赶在股市大跌之前将其持有的巨额股份变现离场。

items.def_en: Convert assets or an entire business entity into cash, often to settle debts
items.ex_en: The insolvent airline was forced to liquidate its auxiliary assets to appease restless creditors.
items.ex_zh: 这家资不抵债的航空公司被迫将其附属资产清算变现，以安抚焦躁的债权人。

items.def_en: (+ of) Rid oneself of business assets, shares, or investments, often for strategic reasons
items.ex_en: The conglomerate chose to divest itself of redundant coal mining holdings this financial year.
items.ex_zh: 该企业集团选择在本财年剥离旗下多余的煤矿资产。

items.def_zh: 转手抛售，摆脱（包袱/资产）
items.def_en: Dispose of unwanted financial assets, inventory, or liabilities by selling them off
items.ex_en: The bank struggled to offload its toxic mortgage debts before the financial quarter ended.
items.ex_zh: 该银行赶在财季结束前艰难地抛售其不良抵押贷款债务。

items.def_zh: 撤资，缩减投资；剥离资产
items.def_en: (economics) To withdraw, reduce, or liquidate financial investments, assets, or capital from a business or fund.
items.ex_en: The pension fund resolved to disinvest completely from fossil fuel enterprises this year.
items.ex_zh: 该养老基金决定在今年内彻底撤出对化石燃料企业的全部投资。

groups.summary_en: Covers financial and corporate moves to deliberately withdraw capital, shed non-core holdings, sell off assets, or reduce investment positions.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及企业与金融领域，指主动撤出资本、剥离子公司或清算变现资产。
groups.desc_en: Selling off, transferring, or winding down commercial assets and operational holdings to eliminate financial exposure or raise immediate capital, distinct from ordinary retail trading.
groups.desc_zh: 出售、剥离或清盘商业资产与持股以规避财务风险或迅速变现，区别于普通的零售交易或日常采买。
groups.nuance_en: cash out: sell an equity stake or token holding to realize immediate cash profit (shares / investment) · liquidate: dissolve an enterprise's physical or financial assets to satisfy creditors (assets / inventory) · divest: strategically sell off a corporate division, subsidiary, or ethical portfolio (business / stake) · offload: shed risky, undesirable, or burdensome assets onto another party (debt / shares) · disinvest: systematically withdraw dedicated capital expenditures from an industry or region (sector / region)
groups.nuance_zh: cash out: 套现股票或投资份额以兑现即期现金利润 (shares / investment) · liquidate: 破产清算变卖资产以偿还债务 (assets / inventory) · divest: 战略性或伦理性剥离业务单元与股权 (business / stake) · offload: 甩卖风险资产或不良包袱给他人 (debt / shares) · disinvest: 系统性从特定行业或地区抽离资本投入 (sector / region)

groups.name: Assist & Facilitate · 协助与促成 (Aid, Expedite, Foster)
groups.tip: 提供帮助让事情变容易

items.def_en: To advance the interests, progress, or success of an endeavor
items.ex_en: The diplomatic treaty will forward the ongoing peace process between the two nations.
items.ex_zh: 该外交条约将推进两国之间正在进行的和平进程。

items.def_en: To provide support, money, or resources that help someone complete a task
items.ex_en: Substantial international grants helped aid the reconstruction of the war-torn regional hospital.
items.ex_zh: 巨额国际拨款帮助资助了饱受战火摧残的地区医院的重建。

items.def_en: (+ for) To remove difficulties so that an event or transition can unfold without friction
items.ex_en: Early bipartisan discussions helped smooth the way for the historic trade agreement.
items.ex_zh: 早期的两党磋商为这项历史性贸易协议的达成铺平了道路。

items.def_zh: 促进，促成；使便利，使容易
items.def_en: To make an action, process, or task easier or more likely to happen.
items.ex_en: The new digital platform will facilitate international scientific collaboration across multiple time zones.
items.ex_zh: 新数字平台将促进跨越多个时区的国际科研合作。

items.def_en: To cause a process or action to progress more quickly by clearing obstacles
items.ex_en: We paid an extra fee to expedite the delivery of our travel visas.
items.ex_zh: 我们支付了额外费用以加快旅行签证的办理进度。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here describe lending momentum, lowering practical barriers, or providing resources so that an operation, transaction, or development runs smoothly to completion.
groups.summary_zh: 表示通过清理障碍、提供便利或给予协同，使事务或进程更容易推进。
groups.desc_en: Active intervention to lower operational friction, remove administrative hurdles, and accelerate the progression of an external process, contrasting with passive spectator support.
groups.desc_zh: 主动介入以降低运作阻力、清除行政梗阻并加速外部事务的进程，区别于被动的围观声援。
groups.nuance_en: forward: actively advance an objective or send along material resources (cause / plan) · aid: provide vital material, physical, or logistical help to a struggling agent (refugees / recovery) · smooth the way: tactfully eliminate prospective friction and social obstacles (transition / path) · facilitate: create optimal structural conditions that make a complex process seamless (dialogue / learning) · expedite: urgently accelerate the administrative or physical delivery speed (process / delivery)
groups.nuance_zh: forward: 推动事业进展或转发传递关键资源 (cause / plan) · aid: 为受困者提供关键的物资或人力救助 (refugees / recovery) · smooth the way: 巧妙扫清前行道路上的潜在阻力与壁垒 (transition / path) · facilitate: 搭建优良架构以促成复杂事务顺畅运行 (dialogue / learning) · expedite: 拔除繁文缛节以特批急办、加速交付 (process / delivery)

groups.name: Atone & Make Amends · 赎罪与赔罪 (Make amends, Compensate, Redeem oneself)
groups.tip: 通过诚心忏悔弥补过错罪衍

items.def_en: Act so as to neutralize an error, omission, or disappointment
items.ex_en: He worked overtime all weekend to make up for the lost hours.
items.ex_zh: 他整个周末都在加班，以弥补损失的工时。

items.def_en: (+ for) Do something positive to repair harm done to someone or balance a past wrong
items.ex_en: He worked tirelessly to make amends for the distress his reckless actions caused.
items.ex_zh: 他不知疲倦地工作，以弥补自己鲁莽行为所带来的痛苦。

items.def_en: Do something that restores respect and offsets one's previous fault or failure
