items.ex_en: The striker scored twice late in the match to redeem himself after earlier errors.
items.ex_zh: 前锋在比赛尾声连入两球，挽回了此前失误造成的声誉损失。

items.def_en: (+ for) To do something good to show you are sorry for having committed a sin, mistake, or bad act.
items.ex_en: He spent years in voluntary service seeking to atone for his past negligence.
items.ex_zh: 他参加了数年志愿服务，试图为自己过去的疏忽渎职赎罪。

items.def_en: Perform self-imposed punishment as a manifestation of repentance for wrongdoing
items.ex_en: The exiled monk chose to penance his transgressions through solitary fasting and prayer.
items.ex_zh: 被流放的僧侣选择通过独处禁食和祈祷来为自己的过错苦修赎罪。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here denote taking moral, practical, or personal corrective action to demonstrate remorse and counterbalance past offenses.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动采取善行、弥补过失以消解道德负疚感或恶果。
groups.desc_en: Undergoing moral, spiritual, or compensatory actions to balance an ethical ledger, rectify wrongdoing, and restore broken trust, contrasting with simple legal restitution or detached apologies.
groups.desc_zh: 通过道德、灵性或补偿性行动以平衡伦理亏欠、弥补过错并挽回信任，区别于纯法律赔偿或轻飘飘的道歉。
groups.nuance_en: make up for: compensate for a practical lack, delay, or disappointment with substitute value (time / losses) · make amends: perform concrete reparative deeds directly toward a wronged party (wrongdoing / past) · redeem oneself: rebuild one's lost honor and standing through a subsequent righteous act (reputation / blunder) · atone: suffer or perform solemn expiation to erase deep moral or spiritual guilt (sins / crime) · penance: subject oneself to prescribed religious mortification or self-imposed discipline (soul / sins)
groups.nuance_zh: make up for: 用替代价值弥补时间、金钱或期待的亏欠 (time / losses) · make amends: 直接向受害者付诸具体行动以赔罪补偿 (wrongdoing / past) · redeem oneself: 通过后续立功或正义之举洗刷前耻、重塑信誉 (reputation / blunder) · atone: 承受严正赎罪以洗清深重的道德或宗教罪责 (sins / crime) · penance: 履行宗教忏悔苦修以惩戒自我、救赎灵魂 (soul / sins)

groups.name: Atrophy & Wither · 萎缩与枯萎 (Wither, Shrivel, Waste away)
groups.tip: 器官或肌肉缺乏锻炼导致缩减

items.def_en: to gradually become very thin, frail, and weak because of serious illness or starvation
items.ex_en: Without proper treatment, the patient began to waste away rapidly.
items.ex_zh: 若不接受适当治疗，患者便会迅速衰弱消瘦。

items.def_en: to become dry, shriveled, or dead due to lack of moisture, or cause plants/tissues to do so
items.ex_en: Without regular rainfall, the delicate crops began to wither under the scorching sun.
items.ex_zh: 由于缺乏定期降雨，娇嫩的庄稼在烈日下开始干枯衰败。
items.ex2_en: Severe prolonged droughts wither the green grass pastures across the entire valley.
items.ex2_zh: 严重而持久的干旱使整个山谷的青草牧场枯萎凋零。

items.def_en: to deteriorate physically, mentally, or functionally over time
items.ex_en: Without continued physical therapy, his motor functions will gradually degenerate over the coming months.
items.ex_zh: 若不持续进行物理治疗，他的运动机能在未来几个月将逐渐衰退。

items.def_en: (medical / formal) to waste away or weaken from lack of use, or cause a body part or ability to do so
items.ex_en: Muscles quickly atrophy when a broken limb remains immobilized in a tight plaster cast.
items.ex_zh: 断肢固定在紧绷的石膏中时，肌肉会迅速发生萎缩。
items.ex2_en: Complete lack of physical exercise can atrophy human muscle tissue quite rapidly.
items.ex2_zh: 完全缺乏体育锻炼会使人体肌肉组织相当迅速地萎缩。

items.def_en: to wrinkle and contract, especially as a result of loss of moisture or heat
items.ex_en: The fallen leaves shrivel rapidly under the intense dry heat of early autumn.
items.ex_zh: 初秋强烈的干热让落叶迅速卷缩干瘪。
items.ex2_en: The intense summer heat shriveled the juicy red grapes on the vine.
items.ex2_zh: 盛夏的酷热使藤蔓上多汁的红葡萄干瘪脱水。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe organic tissue, physical strength, vitality, or cognitive faculties shrinking, desiccating, and wasting away due to disuse, aging, illness, or drought.
groups.summary_zh: 指机体组织、动植物或器官功能因缺水、疾病、废用或衰老而干瘪、退化与枯萎。
groups.desc_en: Progressive, unarrested decay, loss of substance, or functional degradation of living tissue or dynamic vitality, contrasting with sudden catastrophic collapse or mechanical wear.
groups.desc_zh: 活体组织或事物生机不可逆转地渐进式流失、脱水萎缩或功能退化，区别于突发性毁灭或机械磨损。
groups.nuance_en: waste away: experience gradual, extreme bodily emaciation and consumption from disease (body / patient) · wither: desiccate, dry up, and lose all vitality, whether plant life or human prospects (leaves / hopes) · degenerate: deteriorate in structural complexity, moral virtue, or biological function (condition / society) · atrophy: waste away in cell mass or operational efficacy through prolonged disuse (muscles / skills) · shrivel: shrink into wrinkle-strewn, waterless remnants under heat or age (skin / fruit)
groups.nuance_zh: waste away: 因重病或消耗而日渐消瘦衰竭 (body / patient) · wither: 枯萎脱水，象征性失去一切生机活力 (leaves / hopes) · degenerate: 在组织结构、道德水准或功能上全面退化堕落 (condition / society) · atrophy: 因长期废弃不用导致机能萎缩或退化 (muscles / skills) · shrivel: 受干旱、酷热或苍老影响干缩成褶皱 (skin / fruit)

groups.name: Attend & Turn Out · 参与与出席 (Attend, Show Up, Turn Out)
groups.tip: 投身加入群体活动

items.def_en: To go to and be present at an event, meeting, class, or official ceremony
items.ex_en: Senior cabinet ministers were formally required to attend the official state banquet tonight.
items.ex_zh: 内阁高级部长被正式要求出席今晚的国宴。

items.def_en: To arrive and make an appearance at an expected gathering or rendezvous
items.ex_en: Only a few close friends managed to show up to his surprise birthday gathering.
items.ex_zh: 只有几个亲密朋友赶来参加了他的惊喜生日聚会。

items.def_en: To go out to a public event, protest, election, or gathering in a substantial group
items.ex_en: Thousands of citizens turned out in the rain to support the environmental march.
items.ex_zh: 成千上万的市民冒雨到场支持这场环保游行。

items.def_en: (+ on) To attend a meeting, lecture, or trial as an observer rather than a full participant
items.ex_en: Several trainee lawyers were invited to sit in on the landmark court hearing.
items.ex_zh: 几位实习律师受邀旁听了这场具有里程碑意义的法庭庭审。

items.def_zh: 单独出席（聚会），不带伴侣参加活动
items.def_en: (informal, especially North American) To attend a dance, party, or social event unaccompanied by a date or partner.
items.ex_en: Mark decided to stag at the annual charity gala after his date canceled.
items.ex_zh: 伴侣临时取消赴约后，马克决定只身一人参加年度慈善晚会。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures physical presence and social participation at planned events, gatherings, or functions. The verbs contrast formal registration/presence with spontaneous or informal appearances.
groups.summary_zh: 参与社交集会、现场活动或特定场合的到场出席。
groups.desc_en: Physical or formal participation as an observer or constituent member in an organized collective event, distinct from accidental presence or lingering nearby.
groups.desc_zh: 作为观察者或正式成员具身参与有组织的集体活动，区别于偶然路过的在场或无所事事的闲逛。
groups.nuance_en: attend: be officially present at an scheduled event or institution (meeting / school) · show up: physically arrive and make oneself visible, often tardily or unexpectedly (party / work) · turn out: come out in mass numbers to participate in a civic event or vote (voters / crowds) · sit in: attend a meeting or university class solely as a silent, non-participating observer (class / meeting) · stag: attend a formal social dance or gathering alone, without an escort (prom / party)
groups.nuance_zh: attend: 正式出席已定行程的会议或按时上学 (meeting / school) · show up: 肉身露面现身，常带迟到或出其不意的色彩 (party / work) · turn out: 大批民众倾巢而出参与公共集会或投票 (voters / crowds) · sit in: 以非正式代表或旁听生身份静听 (class / meeting) · stag: 不带伴侣单身一人出席正式社交舞会 (prom / party)

groups.name: Attenuate & Dampen · 衰减与削弱强度 (Attenuate, Dampen, Diminish, Weaken)
groups.tip: 风暴、强度或痛感趋于平息减弱

items.def_en: To make or become less strong, powerful, or effective
items.ex_en: Persistent internal scandals continue to weaken public confidence in the established government institutions.
items.ex_zh: 持续不断的内部丑闻继续削弱公众对现有政府机构的信任。
items.ex2_en: His rapid pulse weakened significantly as the strong sedative began to work.
items.ex2_zh: 随着强效镇静剂开始起作用，他急促的脉搏明显减弱了。

items.def_en: To make something less harmful, serious, painful, or severe
items.ex_en: Emergency relief operations were launched immediately to mitigate the disastrous consequences of the flood.
items.ex_zh: 紧急救援行动立即展开，以减轻洪灾造成的灾难性后果。

items.def_en: To make a liquid weaker by adding water, or make a quality, belief, or effect weaker and less forceful
items.ex_en: Adding too many compromises will dilute the original intent of this landmark environmental bill.
items.ex_zh: 过多的妥协将会削弱这项里程碑式环保法案的初衷。
items.ex2_en: The intense flavor will dilute noticeably if you add too much water.
items.ex2_zh: 如果你加了太多的水，浓郁的风味就会明显变淡。

items.def_zh: 抑制；减弱（振动、情绪、势头）
items.def_en: To make something such as a sound, vibration, feeling, or activity less strong or urgent
items.ex_en: Unexpected interest rate hikes threatened to dampen investor enthusiasm across regional stock markets.
items.ex_zh: 出人意料的加息可能抑制区域股市中投资者的热情。

items.def_en: (formal) To reduce the force, intensity, effect, or thickness of something, or become weaker.
items.ex_en: The thick concrete walls noticeably attenuate high-frequency radio signals inside the laboratory.
items.ex_zh: 厚重的混凝土墙明显削弱了实验室内部的高频无线电信号。
items.ex2_en: The radio signal attenuates noticeably as it travels through heavy concrete structures.
items.ex2_zh: 无线电信号穿过厚重的混凝土结构时会明显衰减。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify diminishing the force, amplitude, electrical signal, or destructive virulence of something. The focus is on a reduction in physical intensity, energy, or impact rather than mere count.
groups.summary_zh: 指削弱信号、冲击力、病毒毒力或物理振荡能量。
groups.desc_en: Progressive reduction in the amplitude, violent force, or concentration of a physical signal, emotion, or shock wave, contrasting with absolute elimination or binary stoppage.
groups.desc_zh: 物理信号、情绪波澜或冲击力的振幅、烈度与浓度出现渐进式衰退减弱，区别于彻底灭绝或机械截停。
groups.nuance_en: weaken: sap the intrinsic physical strength or structural soundness of a host (resolve / economy) · mitigate: temper the harshness, severity, or painful fallout of an adverse condition (risk / impact) · dilute: thin out the potency, purity, or distinctiveness of a substance or idea (solution / influence) · dampen: deaden vibrational resonance, enthusiasm, or acoustic energy (spirits / noise) · attenuate: physically weaken the amplitude of a wave, pathogen virulence, or signal across distance (signal / virus)
groups.nuance_zh: weaken: 削弱主体内在的结构坚固度或意志力量 (resolve / economy) · mitigate: 减轻不利局面的残酷烈度或危害后果 (risk / impact) · dilute: 稀释溶液浓度或淡化思想主张的纯粹性 (solution / influence) · dampen: 抑制共振声波，或浇灭情绪兴致 (spirits / noise) · attenuate: 使信号振幅、光波或病原体毒力随介质距离衰减 (signal / virus)

groups.name: Auction & Bid · 竞价拍卖 (Bid, Knock down, Liquidate)
groups.tip: 拍卖等特定交易手段

items.def_en: Sell something quickly or cheaply, often in bulk or to clear stock
items.ex_en: The bankrupt retailer tried to flog off its remaining stock before the final closing.
items.ex_zh: 这家破产的零售商在最终停业前试图廉价抛售其剩余存货。

items.def_en: Offer a particular amount of money for something that is being sold at an auction
items.ex_en: Eager collectors prepared to bid fortunes for the master's newly uncovered canvas.
items.ex_zh: 热切的藏家们准备掷下重金竞标这位大师新发现的画作。

items.def_en: (+ to) Declare sold to a bidder by striking a mallet at an auction
items.ex_en: The old factory was knocked down to make way for a modern shopping center.
items.ex_zh: 旧工厂被拆除，为一座现代化的购物中心腾出了空间。

items.def_en: (also 'auction off') To sell something to the highest bidder at an auction.
items.ex_en: The municipal authority decided to auction the historic building to the highest private bidder.
items.ex_zh: 市政当局决定将这座历史建筑拍卖给出价最高的私人买家。

items.def_en: Convert assets into cash by selling them, typically to settle debts
items.ex_en: The court ordered the troubled company to liquidate its remaining real estate holdings.
items.ex_zh: 法院责令该陷入困境的公司变卖其剩余的房地产资产以清偿债务。

items.def_en: To sell something to the highest bidder at a public auction event
items.ex_en: The bankrupt company plans to auction off its fleet of luxury cars next week.
items.ex_zh: 这家破产公司计划下周将其拥有的豪华车队全数拍卖掉。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on selling property or commodities through competitive bidding processes, public sales, and gavel disposals.
groups.summary_zh: 聚焦于通过公开竞价、拍卖槌裁决等方式变卖资产或物品。
groups.desc_en: Competitive, rule-governed liquidation or acquisition of assets through escalating public offers, contrasting with fixed-price retail selling.
groups.desc_zh: 通过递增叫价进行公开竞争性变现或竞得资产，区别于明码标价的常规零售交易。
groups.nuance_en: auction: sell off publicly to the highest bidder (artwork / estate / cattle) · bid: offer a specific competitive sum to buy (contract / price / stake) · knock down: declare sold by auction hammer blow (lot / antique / painting) · liquidate: convert assets into cash, often under duress (inventory / holdings / assets) · flog off: dispose of hastily or cheaply without regard to full value (surplus stock / state assets)
groups.nuance_zh: auction: 依法或公开通过竞价拍卖售出 (artwork / estate / cattle) · bid: 出价竞买或投标 (contract / price / stake) · knock down: （拍卖师）落槌宣告成交 (lot / antique / painting) · liquidate: （常指清偿债务时）清算变现 (inventory / holdings / assets) · flog off: 廉价急售或草率脱手 (surplus stock / state assets)

groups.name: Audition & Try Out · 试镜与选拔选拔 (Audition, Try out, Screen, Screen-test)
groups.tip: 通过试镜或测试检验能力

items.def_en: To examine applicants, candidates, or materials systematically to eliminate unsuitable choices
items.ex_en: The HR committee will carefully screen all incoming applicants before scheduling formal interviews.
items.ex_zh: 人力资源委员会将在安排正式面试前仔细筛选所有求职者。

items.def_en: (+ for) To compete in a trial or sports/theatrical assessment to show capability for a team or cast
items.ex_en: Hundreds of hopeful young athletes arrived to try out for the varsity soccer squad.
items.ex_zh: 数百名满怀希望的年轻运动员赶来参加校足球队的选拔。

items.def_en: To record an actor on camera during a trial scene to judge photogenic suitability for a film
items.ex_en: The casting director decided to screen-test several promising actors under studio lighting conditions.
items.ex_zh: 选角导演决定在摄影棚灯光下对几位颇具潜力的演员进行试镜。

items.def_en: To thoroughly investigate a person's background, past records, and qualifications before hiring
items.ex_en: Independent security agencies thoroughly vet every potential candidate before granting high-level clearance.
items.ex_zh: 独立安全机构在授予高级安全权限前会对每位候选人进行严格审查。

items.def_zh: 试演，试唱，试音；对……进行面试（或试镜）
items.def_en: 1. (+ for) To perform a short piece of acting, singing, or playing to test your suitability for a role. 2. To test an actor, musician, or performer in an audition.
items.ex_en: She spent weeks preparing an operatic aria to audition for the prestigious conservatory.
items.ex_zh: 她花数周准备了一首歌剧咏叹调，以参加这所著名音乐学院的面试选拔。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses participating in or running competitive performance trials and initial screening evaluations to select candidates for theatrical or specialized roles.
groups.summary_zh: 通过现场演艺展示、试听或初步摸底，考核并筛选适合特定角色的人选。
groups.desc_en: Evaluating and testing a candidate's suitability, talent, or background for a role or position, distinct from formal administrative hiring.
groups.desc_zh: 对候选人的才能、素质或背景进行实际考察与选拔测试，区别于行政化正式录用。
groups.nuance_en: audition: perform competitively to demonstrate artistic suitability (actor / singer / dancer) · screen-test: evaluate camera presence via recorded rehearsal (lead role / candidate / newcomer) · try out: test athletic or performance ability in a practical trial (player / candidate / scheme) · screen: filter candidates broadly against baseline criteria (applicants / calls / luggage) · vet: investigate background, integrity, and security risk meticulously (appointee / nominee / candidate)
groups.nuance_zh: audition: 试镜或试演展示才艺 (actor / singer / dancer) · screen-test: （摄像机前）试镜测试上镜效果 (lead role / candidate / newcomer) · try out: 选拔选拔或实践试用 (player / candidate / scheme) · screen: 初筛或排查过滤 (applicants / calls / luggage) · vet: 严谨审查政治背景或资历 (appointee / nominee / candidate)

groups.name: Autograph & Inscribe · 签名与题献 (Inscribe, Dedicate, Pen)
groups.tip: 亲笔签名题词以示确认或留念

items.def_en: To write one's personal name on a photo, album, or merchandise as a memento
items.ex_en: The famous guitarist agreed to sign the vintage vinyl record for an admirer.
items.ex_zh: 这位著名吉他手答应为一位仰慕者在那张老黑胶唱片上签名。

items.def_en: (+ to) To write or announce that an artistic creation or book is offered in tribute to someone
items.ex_en: The celebrated novelist chose to dedicate her latest masterpiece to her devoted grandmother.
items.ex_zh: 这位著名小说家选择将自己的最新杰作题献给她挚爱的祖母。

items.def_en: To compose or write a letter, note, or signature by hand with a pen
items.ex_en: The solitary poet sat beneath the weeping willow to pen his final verses.
items.ex_zh: 孤独的诗人坐在垂柳下，亲笔写下了他最后的诗行。

items.def_en: (of a famous person) To sign one's name on a book, photograph, or item for someone as a souvenir.
items.ex_en: The visiting author stayed after the lecture to autograph copies of his memoir.
items.ex_zh: 这位来访的作家在讲座结束后留下来为读者在其回忆录上签名。

items.def_en: (+ with/to) To write, print, or engrave words or one's name informally on a gift, coin, or book
items.ex_en: She asked the jeweler to inscribe the silver pendant with her daughter's initials.
items.ex_zh: 她请珠宝商在银质吊坠上刻上她女儿名字的首字母。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on signing one's name or writing a personalized message on keepsakes, books, photographs, or memorabilia as a token of admiration or personal dedication.
groups.summary_zh: 指名人题名留念，或作者在书画、纪念品上题写亲笔赠言。
groups.desc_en: Inscribing one's personal identity or a dedicatory sentiment onto an object, distinct from routine bureaucratic signing.
groups.desc_zh: 在物品上亲笔手书姓名或赠言寄语，区别于例行公事的行政签署。
groups.nuance_en: sign: append one's legal or formal signature (contract / treaty / check) · autograph: sign one's name specifically as a celebrity or token for an admirer (book / photograph / jersey) · inscribe: write, carve, or print a personal dedication or message permanently (monument / title page / watch) · dedicate: formally address or designate a creative work as an honor to someone (novel / song / volume) · pen: compose and write down by hand or authorship (letter / memoir / verse)
groups.nuance_zh: sign: 签署或画押以示法律效力 (contract / treaty / check) · autograph: （名人等）亲笔签名留念 (book / photograph / jersey) · inscribe: 题词、题献或铭刻文字 (monument / title page / watch) · dedicate: 正式题献（作品）致敬 (novel / song / volume) · pen: 执笔撰写 (letter / memoir / verse)

groups.name: Autopsy & Post-Mortem · 验尸与尸检 (Necropsy, Dissect, Examine)
groups.tip: 专业解剖深挖病理真相

items.def_zh: 尸体解剖；验尸（多用于动物）
items.def_en: Perform a post-mortem surgical examination on a body, especially of an animal
items.ex_en: Veterinary pathologists will necropsy the deceased racehorse to ascertain the exact cause of death.
items.ex_zh: 兽医病理学家将解剖这匹死亡的赛马以查明确切死因。

items.def_en: Dissect a cadaver in order to display and examine its anatomical parts
items.ex_en: Medical researchers meticulously anatomize the preserved heart to demonstrate its complex vascular architecture.
items.ex_zh: 医学研究人员仔细解剖分析这颗保存完好的心脏，以展示其复杂的血管结构。

items.def_en: To perform a post-mortem medical examination on a dead body to determine the cause of death.
items.ex_en: Forensic specialists will autopsy the unidentified victim to determine whether foul play occurred.
items.ex_zh: 法医专家将对这具无名受害者尸体进行解剖，以确定是否存在他杀嫌疑。

items.def_en: Cut open and anatomically separate tissues of a body or organ to study its structure
items.ex_en: Biology students must dissect a preserved frog to study its complex internal organs.
items.ex_zh: 生物系学生必须解剖一只浸制的青蛙以研究其复杂的内部器官。

items.def_en: Dig up a buried human corpse from the ground, especially for forensic examination
items.ex_en: Investigators obtained a special court order to exhume the body for toxicological tests.
items.ex_zh: 调查人员获得了特别法院令，以便掘出尸体进行毒理学检测。

groups.summary_en: Forensic medical verbs describing the systematic dissection and clinical examination of a corpse to ascertain the cause, manner, and timeline of death.
groups.summary_zh: 指法医或病理学家对尸体解剖检验以确定死因的专业检查。
groups.desc_en: Systematic post-mortem medical or forensic investigation of a corpse, contrasting with clinical diagnostics on living patients.
groups.desc_zh: 对遗体进行系统的法医病理切开与检验，区别于对活人患者的临床诊疗。
groups.nuance_en: autopsy: surgically dissect a human corpse to determine cause of death (corpse / body / victim) · necropsy: perform a post-mortem examination, especially on animals (carcass / animal / tissue) · dissect: cut apart anatomical structures systematically for analysis or study (cadaver / specimen / heart) · anatomize: examine anatomical composition or dissect minutely in an analytical sense (cadaver / problem / motive) · exhume: disinter a buried body specifically for investigative re-examination (remains / corpse / coffin)
groups.nuance_zh: autopsy: 人体尸检以确定死因 (corpse / body / victim) · necropsy: （尤指动物）验尸剖检 (carcass / animal / tissue) · dissect: 解剖病理结构或标本 (cadaver / specimen / heart) · anatomize: 细致解剖或缜密剖析 (cadaver / problem / motive) · exhume: 掘墓出尸以复检 (remains / corpse / coffin)

groups.name: Avert & Prevent · 避开与化解 (Ward off, Stave off, Head off)
groups.tip: 及早察觉并扭转避开危机

items.def_zh: 抵挡，击退（危机、攻击或质问）
items.def_en: To protect oneself against an attack, criticism, or unwanted demand
items.ex_en: The embattled politician managed to fend off harsh questions from the aggressive reporters.
items.ex_zh: 四面楚歌的政客设法挡住了好斗记者们提出的苛刻质问。

items.def_en: To prevent something bad or dangerous from affecting you for a period of time
items.ex_en: The central bank introduced urgent rate cuts to stave off a catastrophic recession.
items.ex_zh: 央行紧急降息以延缓并防范灾难性经济衰退的降临。

items.def_en: To prevent an attack, danger, or unwanted occurrence from affecting you
items.ex_en: She took herbal supplements daily to ward off severe seasonal respiratory infections naturally.
items.ex_zh: 她每天服用草本补充剂，以自然抵御严重的季节性呼吸道感染。

items.def_en: To take pre-emptive action to prevent something from happening or continuing
items.ex_en: Diplomats worked through the night to head off an imminent international diplomatic crisis.
items.ex_zh: 外交官们通宵达旦地工作，以拦阻并防范一场迫在眉睫的国际外交危机。

items.def_zh: 避开，防止（危机、灾难）；移开（视线）
items.def_en: 1. To prevent something unpleasant or dangerous from happening. 2. ('avert one's eyes/gaze') To turn your eyes away from something you do not want to see.
items.ex_en: Prompt international intervention helped avert an escalating military conflict in the border region.
items.ex_zh: 迅速的国际干预帮助避免了边境地区不断升级的军事冲突。

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote proactive or decisive intervention to deflect, postpone, or prevent an impending crisis, disaster, or undesirable situation.
groups.summary_zh: 指采取积极措施防患于未然，化解或推迟危机与灾祸。
groups.desc_en: Active, anticipatory intervention to prevent an imminent threat or disaster, contrasting with passive evasion or post-facto recovery.
groups.desc_zh: 主动采取先发制人的措施化解即将降临的危机，区别于被动逃避或事后弥补。
groups.nuance_en: avert: successfully prevent a catastrophic event or redirect attention (crisis / disaster / catastrophe) · fend off: repel an active physical or metaphorical attack by pushing back (attackers / hostile bid / critics) · stave off: delay or temporarily keep at bay an inevitable undesirable outcome (bankruptcy / defeat / hunger) · ward off: deflect or keep away impending harm or disease with protective measures (infection / evil / danger) · head off: intercept early to prevent development or progress (strike / rebellion / conflict)
groups.nuance_zh: avert: 成功化解或避免灾祸 (crisis / disaster / catastrophe) · fend off: 奋力击退或招架攻击 (attackers / hostile bid / critics) · stave off: 暂时延缓或拖延厄运 (bankruptcy / defeat / hunger) · ward off: 采取防护挡开病害或邪祟 (infection / evil / danger) · head off: 提前拦截化解事态升级 (strike / rebellion / conflict)

groups.name: Avoid & Bypass · 避开与绕行 (Circumvent, Skirt, Detour)
groups.tip: 迂回绕过障碍或避开通道

items.def_zh: 避开，绕开（危险或麻烦人物）
items.def_en: To deliberately take action to avoid touching, meeting, or dealing with someone or something
items.ex_en: Hikers are strongly warned to steer clear of the steep cliffs during blizzards.
items.ex_zh: 暴风雪期间强烈警告徒步旅行者远离陡峭悬崖。

items.def_en: To go around the outer edge of something, or avoid discussing a contentious topic directly
items.ex_en: The spokesperson skillfully skirted the controversial question regarding the sudden cabinet reshuffle today.
items.ex_zh: 发言人今天巧妙地回避了关于内阁突然改组的争议性问题。

items.def_zh: 绕过，避开（道路或障碍物）；越过，略过（规则或程序）
items.def_en: 1. To go around a town, obstacle, or problem instead of passing through or directly confronting it. 2. To ignore or skip an official rule, process, or hierarchy.
items.ex_en: Drivers were advised to bypass the congested city center by taking the ring-road.
items.ex_zh: 当局建议司机走环城路以绕开拥堵的市中心。

items.def_zh: 规避，设法绕开（规则或障碍）
items.def_en: To avoid a difficulty, obstacle, or rule cleverly or by taking an alternate route
items.ex_en: The crafty company used offshore shell corporations to circumvent strict national taxation laws.
items.ex_zh: 这家狡黠的公司利用离岸空壳公司来规避国家严苛的税法。

items.def_en: To take a longer or roundabout route in order to avoid an obstruction
items.ex_en: We had to detour around the collapsed mountain road to reach the village safely.
items.ex_zh: 我们不得不绕开坍塌的山路以安全抵达村庄。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey navigating around a physical obstacle, geographic congested area, or regulatory/bureaucratic hurdle rather than confronting it directly.
groups.summary_zh: 指绕过物理障碍或规避繁琐规则与问题而非直接穿行。
groups.desc_en: Deliberately evading, going around, or navigating past an obstacle or rule, distinct from confronting or obeying it directly.
groups.desc_zh: 故意绕开、迂回避开障碍物或规则约束，区别于正面交锋或顺从依循。
groups.nuance_en: bypass: go around a blockage or channel entirely via an alternate route (city / pipeline / chain of command) · circumvent: strategically outwit, avoid, or find loopholes in legal or physical obstacles (regulations / sanctions / tax laws) · skirt: travel around the edge of a place or avoid addressing a controversial topic directly (border / issue / question) · detour: take a roundabout circuitous route due to an obstruction (traffic / roadblock / town) · steer clear of: deliberately maintain distance from a known hazard or person (trouble / controversy / conflict)
groups.nuance_zh: bypass: 越过或绕道绕过既有节点 (city / pipeline / chain of command) · circumvent: 巧妙规避法网、禁令或障碍 (regulations / sanctions / tax laws) · skirt: 绕开边缘走或避而不谈 (border / issue / question) · detour: 因阻碍而绕道而行 (traffic / roadblock / town) · steer clear of: 有意避开惹不起的麻烦 (trouble / controversy / conflict)

groups.name: Backfire & Recoil · 适得其反与招致恶果 (Backfire, Rebound, Recoil)
groups.tip: 手段反弹波及自身致落空

items.def_zh: （+ on/upon）反弹，对原主产生反作用
items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to have an adverse retroactive effect upon the originator of an action
items.ex_en: His malicious slander could easily rebound on his own fragile professional reputation later.
items.ex_zh: 他恶意的诽谤日后极可能反弹到他自己脆弱的职业声誉上。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to spring back dynamically with detrimental repercussions to the doer
items.ex_en: Unchecked corporate greed will eventually recoil upon the executives who promoted those reckless policies.
items.ex_zh: 毫无节制的企业贪欲最终会反噬那些推行鲁莽政策的高管们。

items.def_zh: 未达预期，失灵弄巧成拙
items.def_en: to fail to achieve the intended goal, effect, or impression
items.ex_en: The marketing team's ambitious advertising stunt seemed to misfire completely with younger consumers.
items.ex_zh: 营销团队雄心勃勃的广告噱头似乎在年轻消费者群体中完全失灵了。

items.def_zh: （计划）弄巧成拙，当头引爆反噬
items.def_en: to fail catastrophically and cause sudden public embarrassment or disaster for its author
items.ex_en: His deceptive scheme threatened to blow up in his face before the board meeting.
items.ex_zh: 他的欺诈阴谋险些在董事会召开前彻底败露引火烧身。

items.raw_cluster: 适得其反与落空 Fail & Backfire
items.def_zh: 产生事与愿违的不良后果；（引擎等）发生逆火
items.def_en: 1. (+ on) to have the opposite and adverse effect from what was originally intended 2. (of an engine or vehicle) to undergo a mistimed explosion in the cylinder or exhaust system
items.ex_en: Their aggressive cost-cutting measures began to backfire on the company's long-term product quality.
items.ex_zh: 他们激进的削减成本举措开始对公司的长期产品质量产生适得其反的负面影响。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on strategic actions, schemes, or remarks producing an unintended, reverse, and heavily damaging effect upon the initiator.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重行动、计谋或言论产生反向冲击，彻底弄巧成拙并反噬自身。
groups.desc_en: An action unexpectedly reversing trajectory to cause severe harm to the initiator, contrasting with mere unfulfilled failure.
groups.desc_zh: 行为发生剧烈逆转反而重创发起者自身，区别于单纯的未达预期或失败。
groups.nuance_en: backfire: produce an unintended result opposite to the plan that harms the perpetrator (plan / policy / scheme) · recoil: spring back violently from an impact, or flinch back mentally in horror (weapon / horror / shock) · rebound: bounce back off a surface or have an adverse secondary impact upon the agent (criticism / ball / shares) · misfire: fail to discharge correctly or fail completely to produce the intended effect (engine / campaign / plan) · blow up in someone's face: suddenly and catastrophically ruin the originator upon execution (scandal / conspiracy / plot)
groups.nuance_zh: backfire: （策略等）适得其反反噬自身 (plan / policy / scheme) · recoil: 武器后坐或因恐惧反感而后缩 (weapon / horror / shock) · rebound: 反弹或恶果弹回到始作俑者 (criticism / ball / shares) · misfire: 哑火或未能如期奏效 (engine / campaign / plan) · blow up in someone's face: 阴谋等彻底崩盘毁掉始作俑者 (scandal / conspiracy / plot)

groups.name: Badge & Accredit · 授徽与颁证 (Badge, Accredit, Emblazon)
groups.tip: 贴标签或佩戴徽章

items.def_en: To attest formally or endorse with a designated certificate or official mark of approval
items.ex_en: The national aviation board will formally certify the new passenger aircraft next Monday.
items.ex_zh: 国家航空委员会将于下周一正式为新型客机颁发适航认证。

items.def_en: To furnish or invest with insignia, badges, or symbolic markers of office
items.ex_en: The chancellor proceeded to insigniate the newly appointed university rector during the ceremony.
items.ex_zh: 在典礼上，名誉校长庄严地为新任命的大学校长佩戴职位徽章。

items.def_zh: 在……上佩戴徽章，为……打上标牌；标明
items.def_en: To mark, brand, or furnish someone or something with a badge or distinguishing mark.
items.ex_en: The solemn order sought to badge every loyal knight with the sacred crimson cross.
items.ex_zh: 庄严的骑士团意在以神圣的深红十字徽号标明每一名效忠的骑士。

items.def_zh: 官方认可；核准；认证资格
items.def_en: To officially recognize, license, or provide credentials confirming an authorized standard
items.ex_en: The ministry refuses to accredit training programs that fail these rigorous academic standards.
items.ex_zh: 教育部拒绝官方认证未达到这些严苛学术标准的培训项目。

items.def_zh: 将（纹章、标志）饰于；以图徽标明
items.def_en: (+ with) To display or inscribe an emblem, coat of arms, or motto conspicuously on a surface
items.ex_en: The kingdom chose to emblazon the ancestral royal shield upon every military vessel.
items.ex_zh: 王国决定在每艘军舰上醒目地饰以世代相传的皇家盾形徽章。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve marking, insignia-bearing, or validating someone or something with official credentials, insignia, emblems, or formal signs of rank, competence, or entitlement.
groups.summary_zh: 赋予勋章徽标、加盖资质标记或以图徽彰显身份与资格。
groups.desc_en: Conferring institutional authority, credentials, or visible symbolic insignias upon an entity, contrasting with ordinary descriptive naming.
groups.desc_zh: 向实体授予权威资质证书或配以彰显身份的标志，区别于普通的命名或描述。
groups.nuance_en: accredit: officially recognize an institution or person as meeting established quality standards (university / diplomat / laboratory) · certify: guarantee formally and legally that specified conditions are met (competence / product / copy) · badge: mark, identify, or equip with an insignia or security pass (delegate / attendee / car) · emblazon: display or decorate prominently with heraldic or bright designs (shield / flag / banner) · insigniate: formally vest with insignia of office or honor (knight / dignitary / officer)
groups.nuance_zh: accredit: 官方认证资质或派驻公使 (university / diplomat / laboratory) · certify: 发证证明符合法定合格标准 (competence / product / copy) · badge: 配发胸章或佩戴标识 (delegate / attendee / car) · emblazon: 在表面醒目绘制纹章或图案 (shield / flag / banner) · insigniate: 佩授官职或荣誉徽章 (knight / dignitary / officer)

groups.name: Balance & Counteract · 制衡与对冲 (Offset, Counterbalance, Neutralize)
groups.tip: 施加配重使两端保持平衡

items.def_en: Balance one influence or cost against an opposing one so that an overall equilibrium is maintained
items.ex_en: Substantial overseas investment will help offset the steep losses incurred in our domestic sector.
items.ex_zh: 巨额海外投资将有助于对冲抵消我们在国内业务领域遭受的惨重损失。

items.def_en: Stop something from having any effect by acting against it with an opposing measure or substance
items.ex_en: The government raised interest rates to neutralize the inflationary pressures in the economy.
items.ex_zh: 政府提高了利率，以化解经济中的通胀压力。

items.def_en: (especially in 'redress the balance') Correct an imbalance, injustice, or disadvantage by applying compensatory action
items.ex_en: New subsidies were introduced to redress the balance between rural and urban schools.
items.ex_zh: 出台新补贴旨在扭转城乡学校之间的失衡局面。

items.def_en: Have an equal but opposite effect or weight against something, keeping it in balance
items.ex_en: Strong exports helped to counterbalance the sharp decline in domestic consumer spending.
items.ex_zh: 强劲的出口有助于抗衡国内消费支出的急剧下滑。

items.def_zh: 给……加上配重；平衡，抵消，抗衡
items.def_en: to balance or counteract something by providing an opposing weight or equal force.
items.ex_en: They installed heavy lead plates to counterweight the extended arm of the crane.
items.ex_zh: 他们安装了重铅板，为起重机伸展的悬臂配重抗衡。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on supplying an opposing weight, force, or influence to cancel out, neutralize, or equilibrate an existing inequality, disadvantage, or force. The tone is strategic, functional, or mechanical.
groups.summary_zh: 借助相反的重量、作用力或措施相抵消，实现收支或力量平衡。
groups.desc_en: Opposing a negative, excessive, or imbalanced force with an equal counter-measure to restore neutrality, contrasting with unilateral elimination.
groups.desc_zh: 通过施加对等相反的反向力量以抵消损耗或失衡，区别于单方面的彻底消灭。
groups.nuance_en: offset: counterbalance one value, cost, or effect against another to neutralize it (costs / emissions / losses) · neutralize: render completely ineffective or chemically inert (threat / acid / advantage) · counterbalance: exert equal physical or metaphorical weight against an opposing force (influence / weight / risk) · counterweight: supply an actual or figurative ballast to preserve stability (load / hegemony / opposition) · redress: actively compensate for or right a past injustice or imbalance (grievance / inequality / wrong)
groups.nuance_zh: offset: 抵扣、冲减或对冲相抵 (costs / emissions / losses) · neutralize: 中和或化解威胁使之失效 (threat / acid / advantage) · counterbalance: 以相反力量抗衡以维系均衡 (influence / weight / risk) · counterweight: 充当配重以对抗失衡 (load / hegemony / opposition) · redress: 纠正、补偿不公以恢复平正 (grievance / inequality / wrong)

groups.name: Balance & Equilibrate · 维持平衡与均衡 (Equilibrate, Poise, Steady)
groups.tip: 使两端重量或状态均等稳定

items.def_zh: 使平衡，保持平衡；权衡，斟酌；相抵
items.def_en: 1. To put something into a steady position so that it does not fall, or remain in such a position. 2. To compare or weigh two different things against each other.
items.ex_en: She carefully balanced the tray of glasses as she stepped through the door.
items.ex_zh: 她穿过门口时，小心翼翼地稳住托着玻璃杯的盘子。
items.ex2_en: The spinning coin balances steadily on its edge for a few seconds.
items.ex2_zh: 旋转的硬币在它的边缘稳稳地平衡了几秒钟。

items.def_en: To hold or brace something securely to stop it from shaking, swaying, or falling over
items.ex_en: He grasped the handrail tightly to steady himself against the swaying train carriage.
items.ex_zh: 他抓紧扶手，在这节摇晃的火车车厢里稳住身子。
items.ex2_en: His trembling hands finally steadied after taking several deep and calm breaths.
items.ex2_zh: 在做了几次平静深沉的呼吸后，他颤抖的双手终于稳定了下来。

items.def_en: To bring two or more opposing forces, weights, or states into exact mutual balance
items.ex_en: The silent retreat allowed opposing desires to equilibrate into serene inner peace.
items.ex_zh: 静修让相互冲突的欲望归于均衡，化作内心的宁静。
items.ex2_en: The dedicated chemical technician equilibrated the warm test solution before collecting data.
items.ex2_zh: 专职化学技术人员在收集数据前使温热的测试溶液达到平衡。

items.def_en: To return to or maintain a steady, horizontal, and balanced posture or state
items.ex_en: The pilot leveled off at ten thousand feet after clearing the dense storm clouds.
items.ex_zh: 穿过厚密的暴风云层后，飞行员在万英尺高空恢复平稳飞行。

items.def_en: To hold something or balance yourself in a stable, carefully controlled position ready for action
items.ex_en: The diver poised momentarily on the edge of the platform before executing the plunge.
items.ex_zh: 跳水运动员在跳台边缘短暂保持平稳姿势，随即纵身跃入水中。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses holding an object or body in a state of stable physical equilibrium so that it neither tilts, wobbles, nor falls, or adjusting opposing forces equally.
groups.summary_zh: 保持身体或物体稳定平衡，防止倾斜晃动或跌落。
groups.desc_en: Bringing or holding physical masses or states in steady, non-falling alignment, contrasting with fluctuating or shifting instability.
groups.desc_zh: 将物理质量或系统状态维持在稳定不落的对等状态，区别于持续波动或倾斜失稳。
groups.nuance_en: balance: adjust weight distribution so an object remains upright without tipping (tray / books / budget) · equilibrate: bring two opposing systems or chemical phases into equal equilibrium (temperatures / forces / pressures) · poise: hold in delicate, suspended readiness or graceful balance without falling (pen / dancer / bird) · steady: hold firmly or eliminate trembling and wobble (ladder / nerves / hand) · level off: flatten out after a period of rise or fall into horizontal constancy (trajectory / prices / growth)
groups.nuance_zh: balance: 保持平衡或使收支持平 (tray / books / budget) · equilibrate: 使（系统或物理化学相）达成均势 (temperatures / forces / pressures) · poise: 优雅悬停于蓄势待发或精妙平衡状态 (pen / dancer / bird) · steady: 使平稳、扶稳或平复颤抖 (ladder / nerves / hand) · level off: 趋于平缓或维持水平平稳 (trajectory / prices / growth)

groups.name: Balance & Poise · 稳固与平衡 (Equilibrate, Stabilize, Steady)
groups.tip: 保持均势或沉着平稳

items.def_en: Keep or put something in a steady position so that it does not fall or tilt
items.ex_en: The gymnast learned to balance steadily on the narrow beam without wobbling.
items.ex_zh: 体操运动员学会了在狭窄的平衡木上保持身形稳定而不摇晃。
items.ex2_en: The skilled acrobat balanced the tall wooden ladder effortlessly on his chin.
items.ex2_zh: 技艺高超的杂技演员毫不费力地把高高的木梯平衡在下巴上。

items.def_en: Hold or support something firmly to prevent it from shaking, swaying, or falling
items.ex_en: She placed a firm hand on the ladder to steady it for him.
items.ex_zh: 她用一只手牢牢扶住梯子，替他稳住不再晃动。
items.ex2_en: The fluctuating stock prices steadied gradually after the government released positive data.
items.ex2_zh: 政府公布利好数据后，波动的股票价格逐渐平稳下来。

items.def_en: Support something physically from underneath or against a side to prevent it from falling over
items.ex_en: We used thick wooden beams to prop up the sagging garden shed roof.
items.ex_zh: 我们用粗木梁支撑住花园棚屋下垂的屋顶，以防塌陷。

items.def_en: Make something firm, level, and unlikely to overturn, wobble, or change abruptly
items.ex_en: The surgeon placed internal pins to stabilize the fractured bone before setting the cast.
items.ex_zh: 外科医生植入内固定钢针以巩固骨折部位，然后才打上石膏。
items.ex2_en: The fluctuating patient's blood pressure stabilized gradually after taking the heart medication.
items.ex2_zh: 服用心脏药物后，病人体内波动的血压逐渐稳定了下来。

items.def_en: 1. to balance or hold something steadily in a particular position. 2. to be or put in a state of balance or readiness for action.
items.ex_en: The hawk was poised motionless in the brisk wind, searching for prey below.
items.ex_zh: 那只鹰在凛冽的疾风中悬立不动，搜寻着下方的猎物。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express holding, positioning, or maintaining a physical body or structure in delicate or steady equilibrium, avoiding tipping over, wobbling, or collapsing.
groups.summary_zh: 指将物体或身躯稳置于特定姿态，保持重心平稳而不倾覆摇晃。
groups.desc_en: Fixing, reinforcing, or supporting a structure or system against collapse or shaking, contrasting with letting it sway or fall freely.
groups.desc_zh: 加固或支撑系统与实体以防倾倒或震颤，区别于任其摇晃或自由坍塌。
groups.nuance_en: stabilize: make firm, resistant to fluctuation, or secure from deterioration (patient / economy / structure) · steady: arrest tremors or wavering motion by gripping or calming (voice / rifle / platform) · prop up: sustain physically with an external support or artificially keep failing entities alive (beam / regime / currency) · balance: keep weight distributed evenly to avert toppling (stack / gymnast / scales) · poise: suspend in poised readiness or critical equilibrium (body / missile / force)
groups.nuance_zh: stabilize: 使稳定或阻止病情/局势恶化 (patient / economy / structure) · steady: 稳住身形或平抑颤动 (voice / rifle / platform) · prop up: 靠外物支起或勉强支撑病态实体 (beam / regime / currency) · balance: 保持平衡以防翻倒 (stack / gymnast / scales) · poise: 悬空凝定或保持引而不发状态 (body / missile / force)

groups.name: Bandage & Dress · 包扎与敷裹 (Dress, Bind up, Swaddle)
groups.tip: 用绷带纱布缠裹保护伤口

items.def_en: To clean, treat, and apply a sterile dressing to a wound
items.ex_en: The nurse cleaned the deep laceration and carefully dressed it with sterile gauze.
items.ex_zh: 护士清理了那道很深的伤口，并用无菌纱布细心包扎敷药。

items.def_en: To wrap cloth tightly around an injury to stop bleeding or support it
items.ex_en: The paramedic carefully bound up the deep wound to stem the bleeding.
items.ex_zh: 医护人员小心地包扎好深伤口以止血。

items.def_zh: 用胶带/绷带固定（关节或肌肉）
items.def_en: To bind an injured limb or joint firmly with adhesive tape or straps to provide support
items.ex_en: The athletic trainer strapped the runner's swollen ankle securely before the race began.
items.ex_zh: 比赛开始前，运动教练用胶带紧紧固定住跑步运动员肿胀的脚踝。

items.def_en: (+ up) To wrap an injured body part with a strip of cloth to protect it.
items.ex_en: She gently bandaged up his scraped knee after rinsing away the gravel.
items.ex_zh: 冲洗掉碎石后，她轻柔地用绷带包扎好他擦破的膝盖。

items.def_en: To wrap or bind someone or something in several layers of cloth or bandages
items.ex_en: The injured soldier lay swathed in layers of coarse wool and clean linen.
items.ex_zh: 受伤的士兵身上紧密包裹着层层粗羊毛和干净的亚麻布。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the medical or protective care of wounds and injuries through wrapping, covering, and applying therapeutic dressings. They range from formal clinical procedures to pragmatic field first-aid.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖对创口或患处进行包扎、敷药与护创的医疗处理动作。
groups.desc_en: Applying protective, medicinal, or compressive textile wraps around wounds or limbs, contrasting with ordinary decorative dressing.
groups.desc_zh: 用织物布条等对伤口或肢体进行药理保护与加压敷裹，区别于日常穿着打扮。
groups.nuance_en: dress: clean and apply sterile covering or medication to an open trauma (wound / burn / lesion) · bandage: secure and cover an injury using strips of gauze or cloth (arm / ankle / head) · bind up: tie or wrap tightly to compress or immobilize (wounds / fractured limb / cuts) · strap: secure or compress tightly using adhesive tape or rigid straps (wrist / knee / ankle) · swathe: wrap up extensively in multiple layers of cloth (burn victim / bandage / body)
groups.nuance_zh: dress: （清洁并给药）换药敷裹创口 (wound / burn / lesion) · bandage: 用绷带包扎创伤 (arm / ankle / head) · bind up: 捆紧或紧密包扎伤口 (wounds / fractured limb / cuts) · strap: 用胶带或背带紧扣固定关节 (wrist / knee / ankle) · swathe: 重重叠叠层层裹住 (burn victim / bandage / body)

groups.name: Banish & Expel · 驱逐与遣返 (Deport, Expel, Banish)
groups.tip: 强制遣送出境或驱逐离开

items.def_en: To force someone to live away from their native country, often for political reasons
items.ex_en: The military regime decided to exile the prominent dissident leader to a remote island.
items.ex_zh: 军政府决定将这名著名的异见领袖流放到偏远岛屿。

items.def_en: To officially and permanently force someone to leave an organization, school, or country
items.ex_en: The university committee voted unanimously to expel the student for severe academic fraud.
items.ex_zh: 大学委员会一致投票决定，因严重学术欺诈而开除该学生。

items.def_zh: 驱逐出境，遣返；表现，举止
items.def_en: 1. To officially force a foreign national to leave a country. 2. (formal, 'deport oneself') To behave or conduct oneself in a particular manner.
items.ex_en: Authorities announced plans to deport undocumented immigrants who had committed serious offenses.
items.ex_zh: 当局宣布计划将犯下严重罪行的无证移民驱逐出境。

items.def_en: To officially order someone to leave a territory or community permanently as an official punishment
items.ex_en: The medieval king chose to banish the rebellious noble from the realm forever.
items.ex_zh: 中世纪的国王选择将这名叛逆的贵族永远放逐出王国领地。

items.def_en: To officially surrender an accused or convicted person to another jurisdiction where the crime was committed
items.ex_en: The foreign ministry agreed to extradite the suspected embezzler to face trial abroad.
items.ex_zh: 外交部同意引渡涉嫌贪污者，以便其在国外接受审判。

groups.summary_en: This legal and political frame describes the sovereign act of forcing an alien, dissident, or convict out of a territory, country, or jurisdiction. Nuances vary from formal administrative repatriation ('deport') to legal exile ('banish', 'exile').
groups.summary_zh: 指国家或主权机构依法将外国人、异见人士或罪犯驱逐出境或流放海外。
groups.desc_en: Legally or forcefully casting an individual out of a territory or political community, contrasting with voluntary migration.
groups.desc_zh: 运用主权或政权强制将个体逐出特定疆土或共同体，区别于自愿迁徙。
groups.nuance_en: banish: officially cast out someone from a place, often as an authoritarian penalty (traitor / courtier / thought) · exile: enforce long-term separation of a person from their homeland for political reasons (dissident / monarch / poet) · expel: drive out or eject forcefully from a country, school, or organization (diplomats / student / member) · deport: legally remove a non-citizen or alien back to their country of origin (illegal immigrant / criminal / alien) · extradite: formally hand over an accused fugitive to foreign judicial jurisdiction (fugitive / suspect / criminal)
groups.nuance_zh: banish: 严惩性放逐或屏除 (traitor / courtier / thought) · exile: （出于政治原因）流放或逼走异乡 (dissident / monarch / poet) · expel: 开除、驱逐出境或逐出团体 (diplomats / student / member) · deport: 依法遣送非法居留或犯罪外侨出境 (illegal immigrant / criminal / alien) · extradite: 引渡逃犯予他国管辖 (fugitive / suspect / criminal)

groups.name: Banter & Tease · 逗趣与调侃 (Chaff, Jape, Trade barbs)
groups.tip: 带着轻松玩笑的语气打趣

items.def_en: To laugh at someone and make playful or slightly unkind remarks to them
items.ex_en: The older boys liked to tease him playfully about his bright red hair.
items.ex_zh: 大男孩们喜欢拿他一头鲜艳的红发开玩笑逗乐。

items.raw_cluster: 戏弄与开玩笑 Tease & Joke
items.def_en: (+ with) To exchange humorous, playful, and friendly remarks with someone.
items.ex_en: He stopped to banter with the local market vendors every single Saturday morning.
items.ex_zh: 每个周六早晨，他都会停下来和当地的菜市场摊贩打趣逗乐。

items.def_en: To tease someone good-naturedly in a lively exchange
items.ex_en: The old friends continued to chaff each other fondly throughout the evening meal.
items.ex_zh: 老友们在整个晚餐期间亲切地互相打趣逗弄。

items.def_en: To exchange sharp or witty remarks and teasing insults back and forth
items.ex_en: The two rival politicians continued to trade barbs during the lively televised debate.
items.ex_zh: 这两名政治对手在热闹的电视辩论中不断互打机锋、唇枪舌剑。

items.def_en: (informal) (+ on) To tease or play jokes on someone persistently
items.ex_en: His older brothers would always rag on him about his awkward dancing skills.
items.ex_zh: 他的哥哥们总是拿他笨拙的舞技开涮。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers mutual verbal repartee, lighthearted mocking, and witty back-and-forth remarks shared in a playful or sociable atmosphere.
groups.summary_zh: 指双向诙谐交谈、互相打趣与幽默逗乐的动词群。
groups.desc_en: Good-natured, playful, or mildly mocking verbal sparring, contrasting with vicious personal assault or formal speech.
groups.desc_zh: 善意、打趣或微带讥诮的口头来回调侃，区别于恶毒的人身攻击或严肃对话。
groups.nuance_en: banter: exchange quick, witty, and playful remarks without malice (colleagues / hosts / friends) · tease: provoke or irritate someone playfully or maliciously about sensitive points (sibling / child / friend) · chaff: poke good-humored, gentle fun at someone's peculiarities (comrade / colleague / friend) · rag: tease persistently and aggressively, sometimes bordering on hazing (freshman / peer / teammate) · trade barbs: exchange sharp, sarcastic, and pointed jabs back and forth (politicians / rivals / spouses)
groups.nuance_zh: banter: 轻松诙谐的逗趣打趣 (colleagues / hosts / friends) · tease: 逗弄、戏弄或揭短打趣 (sibling / child / friend) · chaff: 善意开玩笑或打趣调侃 (comrade / colleague / friend) · rag: 粗暴捉弄或持续开涮恶搞 (freshman / peer / teammate) · trade barbs: 互唇枪舌剑反唇相讥 (politicians / rivals / spouses)

groups.name: Baptize & Name · 施洗与命名仪式 (Christen, Dub, Inaugurate)
groups.tip: 宗教洗礼仪式上洗礼并赋予姓名

items.def_zh: 接纳参加；施行入门仪式
items.def_en: To admit someone into a secret society, religious group, or organization with formal rites
items.ex_en: The fraternity held a midnight ritual to initiate new members into the order.
items.ex_zh: 兄弟会举行午夜仪式，正式接纳新成员参加组织。

items.def_en: To give someone or something a specific unofficial name, nickname, or title
items.ex_en: The media quickly dubbed the ambitious young entrepreneur the next tech visionary.
items.ex_zh: 媒体很快将这位雄心勃勃的年轻创业家冠以“下一位科技远见者”的称号。

items.def_zh: 为……施洗礼；给……命名；使经受考验
items.def_en: 1. To administer baptism to someone, often officially giving them a name. 2. To give a name to; to subject to an initiating ordeal.
items.ex_en: The priest gathered the family at the chapel altar to baptize the infant.
items.ex_zh: 牧师将这家人召集在教堂祭坛前，为婴儿施洗礼。

items.def_en: To name someone at baptism, or to dedicate and name a ship or project formally
items.ex_en: The royal patron smashed champagne against the hull to christen the new warship.
items.ex_zh: 王室赞助人将香槟砸向船体，正式为这艘新战舰命名。

items.def_en: To officially dedicate or declare something to be sacred in a religious ceremony
items.ex_en: The bishop arrived to consecrate the newly built cathedral before the congregation gathered.
items.ex_zh: 在会众聚集前，主教赶来为这座新建的大教堂祝圣。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scenario denote official, sacramental, or honorific acts of naming, initiating, or conferring a designated identity upon an individual, vessel, or creation. While 'christen' carries strong ritual/naming baggage, 'dub' conveys conferring a moniker or title.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过仪式或正式行为赋予名字、称号或进行入门授礼。
groups.desc_en: Ritually naming, inducting, or sanctifying an individual or object into a sacred or formal role, contrasting with casual nickname assigning.
groups.desc_zh: 通过神圣或隆重仪式为个体/对象赋予名字、名分或神圣职分，区别于非正式起绰号。
groups.nuance_en: baptize: ritually purify and admit into the Christian church via immersion or sprinkling of water (infant / convert / believer) · christen: name at baptism, or formally dedicate and name a ship or project (baby / vessel / yacht) · dub: confer knighthood upon or colloquially designate someone with a descriptive epithet (knight / hero / phenomenon) · consecrate: solemnly dedicate to a divine purpose or make sacred (bishop / bread and wine / shrine) · initiate: formally admit someone into a secret society, group, or esoteric knowledge (novice / member / recruit)
groups.nuance_zh: baptize: 行浸礼施洗接纳入教 (infant / convert / believer) · christen: 洗礼命名或为新船主持掷瓶命名礼 (baby / vessel / yacht) · dub: 册封骑士或封授特定绰号称号 (knight / hero / phenomenon) · consecrate: 祝圣或将场所/圣物奉献给神 (bishop / bread and wine / shrine) · initiate: 举行仪式接纳入会或传授秘仪 (novice / member / recruit)

groups.name: Bark & Snap · 咆哮与厉喝 (Snap, Bellow, Snarl)
groups.tip: 大声厉喝与如犬吠叫

items.def_en: To utter sharp, impatient, or irritable words abruptly
items.ex_en: "Stop bothering me right now," she snapped angrily without looking up from work.
items.ex_zh: “现在别来烦我了，”她头也不抬地厉声训斥道。

items.def_zh: 厉声喊叫，厉声下令；（狗等）吠叫；剥（树皮）
items.def_en: 1. (+ out/at) To shout words, orders, or insults in a harsh, angry voice. 2. (of a dog) To make a short, loud, sharp sound. 3. To scrape or strip the bark off a tree.
items.ex_en: The drill sergeant barked commands at the weary recruits across the muddy field.
items.ex_zh: 操练教官隔着泥泞的操场，对疲惫的新兵厉声下令。

items.def_en: To issue a command or statement in a loud, harsh, military fashion
items.ex_en: The captain barked out sudden retreat orders over the roar of artillery fire.
items.ex_zh: 上尉盖过炮火的轰鸣声，厉声喝出了撤退的命令。

items.def_en: To emit a deep, loud roar in anger or pain
items.ex_en: The furious manager bellowed at the top of his lungs across the office.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的经理在办公室里扯着嗓子大声怒吼。

items.def_zh: 龇牙怒吠；恶狠狠地低吼
items.def_en: To speak in an aggressive, threatening, guttural tone
items.ex_en: "Get off my property immediately," the guard snarled through his clenched teeth.
items.ex_zh: “立刻滚出我的地盘，”警卫咬牙切齿地恶狠狠低吼道。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on shouting rapid, harsh commands or criticisms in an aggressive, sharp, and intimidating manner, resembling the abrupt vocalization of a canine.
groups.summary_zh: 指像犬吠般短促、粗暴、凶狠地厉声下达命令、训斥或怒吼。
groups.desc_en: Emitting sudden, harsh, aggressive, and abrasive vocalizations born of fury or command, contrasting with articulate conversational speech.
groups.desc_zh: 因暴怒、急躁或发号施令而发出突发、刺耳且凶狠的短促喊叫，区别于常态对话。
groups.nuance_en: bark: utter abrupt, loud, commanding shouts with dog-like harshness (officer / sergeant / dog) · bark out: shout out brief commands or questions sharply and aggressively (orders / commands / question) · snap: speak suddenly with sharp irritation and aggressive brevity (reply / remark / retorts) · bellow: roar deeply and thunderously like a wounded beast or enraged boss (rage / command / orders) · snarl: growl threateningly with bared teeth, speaking with vicious hostility (threat / defiance / voice)
groups.nuance_zh: bark: 像犬吠般粗暴厉声呼喝 (officer / sergeant / dog) · bark out: 粗厉短促地喝令下达 (orders / commands / question) · snap: 没好气地厉声反唇相讥 (reply / remark / retorts) · bellow: 如雷震怒般低沉狂吼 (rage / command / orders) · snarl: 龇牙咧嘴般凶恶咆哮咒骂 (threat / defiance / voice)

groups.name: Barricade & Blockade · 筑障与封堵 (Barricade, Blockade, Cordone)
groups.tip: 设路障彻底封锁通道

items.def_en: To enclose or isolate an area with barriers or police tape to prevent unauthorized people from entering
items.ex_en: Police used yellow tape to cordon off the crime scene from curious onlookers.
items.ex_zh: 警方用黄色警戒线封锁了犯罪现场，隔开好奇的围观群众。

items.def_en: To block a road, passage, or sightline by placing physical impediments in the way
items.ex_en: Fallen tree branches obstructed the narrow mountain pathway following the violent midnight gale.
items.ex_zh: 午夜狂风过后，倒下的树枝挡住了狭窄的山间小道。

items.def_en: To close off all access to a building, crime scene, or region completely to ensure total control
items.ex_en: Armed guards sealed off the street following the security alert.
items.ex_zh: 安全警报拉响后，武装警卫封锁了整条街道。

items.def_en: To seal off a place, port, or territory with military forces or heavy barriers to prevent goods and people from entering
items.ex_en: Naval forces moved into position to blockade the harbor during the escalating conflict.
items.ex_zh: 海军部队就位，在不断升级的冲突中封锁了该海港。

items.def_zh: 设路障阻挡，封锁；把…关在路障内
items.def_en: 1. To block a road, entrance, or building with a barrier or heavy objects. 2. (reflexive, 'barricade oneself in') To shut oneself securely inside a place behind barriers.
items.ex_en: Protesters used overturned vehicles and furniture to barricade the main street against police.
items.ex_zh: 抗议者用翻倒的车辆和家具设路障阻挡主要街道，以抵御警察。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote establishing physical or militarized obstacles across thoroughfares, doors, or borders to forcefully deny ingress, fortify a stronghold, or bottle up an enemy.
groups.summary_zh: 通过重物或工事强行封锁道路、出入口或建筑，阻止通行或侵入。
groups.desc_en: Erecting physical obstructions or security cordons to deny passage or isolate an area, contrasting with open, unhindered access.
groups.desc_zh: 构筑实体工事或警戒线封锁通道并隔绝特定区域，区别于保持通畅无阻。
groups.nuance_en: barricade: hastily throw up makeshift defensive barriers across a passage (streets / doors / building) · blockade: cut off naval, road, or commercial communications to starve or isolate an enemy (port / harbor / coast) · seal off: completely isolate a location to prevent any entry or exit (crime scene / borders / sector) · cordon off: enclose with police tape, rope, or sentries to preserve evidence or control crowds (area / perimeter / street) · obstruct: put an impediment in the way to slow or hinder passage (traffic / view / aisle)
groups.nuance_zh: barricade: 用临时掩体街垒封锁路口 (streets / doors / building) · blockade: 实施军事或封锁切断海陆往来 (port / harbor / coast) · seal off: 全面封堵使其水泄不通 (crime scene / borders / sector) · cordon off: 拉警戒线封锁现场 (area / perimeter / street) · obstruct: 挡住或妨碍通行视野 (traffic / view / aisle)

groups.name: Bask & Savor · 沐浴享受与沉醉 (Bask, Revel, Savor)
groups.tip: 像晒太阳般舒适地沉醉于暖意中

items.def_zh: 晒太阳，取暖；沉浸在，尽情享受（赞誉、温暖等）
items.def_en: 1. (+ in) To lie exposed to pleasant warmth, especially sunlight. 2. (+ in) To enjoy and revel in warmth, comfort, praise, or success.
items.ex_en: The tourists loved to bask in the warm afternoon sun on the terrace.
items.ex_zh: 游客们喜欢在露台上晒太阳，尽情享受午后惬意的温暖。

items.def_en: To sit or lie in the warmth of the sun in order to relax and tan the skin
items.ex_en: Holidaymakers chose to sunbathe beside the pool while sipping cool tropical fruit drinks.
items.ex_zh: 度假者们选择在泳池边晒日光浴，一边啜饮着冰凉的热带果汁。

items.def_en: To enjoy an experience, feeling, or taste fully and unhurriedly
items.ex_en: He paused to savor the rich flavors of the delicate homemade pasta dish.
items.ex_zh: 他停顿下来，细细品味这份精致自制意面的浓郁风味。

items.def_en: (+ in) To get great pleasure and satisfaction from an experience, sensation, or triumph
items.ex_en: The triumphant team continued to revel in their unexpected championship victory all night.
items.ex_zh: 凯旋的队伍整夜都陶醉在他们出人意料的夺冠胜利之中。

items.def_en: (+ in) To immerse oneself completely in a pleasurable state, luxury, or emotion
items.ex_en: Instead of finding solutions, he chose to wallow in bitterness and regret.
items.ex_zh: 他没有去寻找解决之道，反而选择放任自己沉溺于痛苦与懊悔中。

groups.summary_en: This frame concerns lounging passively in radiant heat or sunshine, or wallowing indulgently in adulation, triumph, and sensory pleasure.
groups.summary_zh: 指惬意享受阳光暖意，或尽情沉醉于赞美与喜悦中。
groups.desc_en: Soaking up, deeply indulging in, and deriving luxurious sensory or psychological pleasure from a condition, contrasting with indifferent exposure.
groups.desc_zh: 全身心沉浸并极其陶醉于愉悦的感官环境或赞誉中，区别于无动于衷的置身其中。
groups.nuance_en: bask: lie exposed to pleasant warmth, or luxuriate in glory and admiration (sunlight / glory / approval) · sunbathe: expose one's body directly to sunlight specifically to tan or warm up (beach / lawn / skin) · savor: taste, enjoy, and linger slowly over every detail of a delightful sensation (moment / food / victory) · revel: celebrate noisily or take supreme, unrestrained delight in something (triumph / freedom / chaos) · wallow: roll around in mud/water, or indulge unrestrainedly in an emotional state (misery / luxury / mud)
groups.nuance_zh: bask: 沐浴于阳光或沉醉于掌声荣耀 (sunlight / glory / approval) · sunbathe: 进行日光浴晒太阳 (beach / lawn / skin) · savor: 细细品味、久久回味乐趣 (moment / food / victory) · revel: 纵情狂欢或深感快意 (triumph / freedom / chaos) · wallow: 在泥水中打滚，或沉湎于情绪/奢华中 (misery / luxury / mud)

groups.name: Baste & Moisten · 浇汁与润湿 (Baste, Moisten, Drizzle)
groups.tip: 烹饪时反复刷油浇汁防干

items.def_en: To spread sauce, melted butter, or egg lightly over food using a pastry brush
items.ex_en: Remember to brush the pastry crust lightly with egg wash before baking it.
items.ex_zh: 烘烤前，记得在油酥面皮上轻轻刷上一层薄薄的蛋液。

items.def_en: To lift pan juices or sauce with a spoon and pour them repeatedly over cooking meat
items.ex_en: She used a silver ladle to spoon over the rich gravy onto meat.
items.ex_zh: 她用一把银勺将浓郁的肉汁一次次浇淋在肉块上。

items.def_en: To pour a liquid over food in a fine, light stream or delicate drops
items.ex_en: The chef finished the salad to drizzle extra virgin olive oil over greens.
items.ex_zh: 厨师给沙拉收尾，将特级初榨橄榄油薄薄淋在蔬菜上。
items.ex2_en: Cold spring rain began to drizzle gently over the sleepy coastal village.
items.ex2_zh: 冰凉的春雨开始淅淅沥沥地下在这座静谧的海滨村庄上。

items.def_en: To make something slightly wet or damp, often by adding small amounts of liquid
items.ex_en: Use a damp sponge to moisten the dried clay before reshaping the sculpture.
items.ex_zh: 重新塑形前，用湿海绵把干燥的黏土弄湿润。
items.ex2_en: The dry cracked earth moistens quickly under the steady gentle morning drizzle.
items.ex2_zh: 干涸干裂的土地在清晨持续温柔的细雨中迅速湿润。

items.def_en: 1. to pour melted fat or juices over meat while it is cooking to keep it moist 2. to sew pieces of fabric together with long, loose stitches temporarily
items.ex_en: The recipe advised cooks to baste the roasting chicken every twenty minutes carefully.
items.ex_zh: 食谱建议烹饪者每二十分钟细心给烤鸡浇上一遍油汁。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail culinary and manual techniques of intermittently pouring, brushing, or spooning hot fats, marinades, or liquids over food during cooking to prevent it from drying out.
groups.summary_zh: 特指烹饪中在食材表面反复浇淋汤汁、油脂以保持湿润入味的行为。
groups.desc_en: Applies culinary liquids onto food surfaces to maintain moisture and flavor during cooking or plating, differing from general pouring or soaking by its deliberate, targeted, and metered application.
groups.desc_zh: 烹饪或装盘时向食物表面施加液体以保水增味，区别于普通的倾倒或浸泡，强调有目的、局部且分量的涂施。
groups.nuance_en: baste: periodically pour melted fat or pan juices over roasting meat (turkey / roast / chicken) · moisten: introduce slight dampness to prevent dryness (lips / dough / surface) · drizzle: trickle a thin, decorative stream of liquid (olive oil / honey / glaze) · brush: apply a liquid layer evenly using bristles (pastry / marinade / butter) · spoon over: ladle a measured liquid topping gently onto food (sauce / syrup / dressing)
groups.nuance_zh: baste: 烤制时周期性淋浇油汁以防干柴 (turkey / roast / chicken) · moisten: 使微湿以防干燥脱水 (lips / dough / surface) · drizzle: 细流轻淋作调味或点缀 (olive oil / honey / glaze) · brush: 用刷子均匀刷涂薄层液体 (pastry / marinade / butter) · spoon over: 用勺舀取液体轻柔浇覆 (sauce / syrup / dressing)

groups.name: Bathe & Cleanse · 沐浴与清洁 (Bathe, Wash, Shower)
groups.tip: 用水洗澡沐浴以洗净身体

items.def_en: To wash one's body while standing under a spray of running water
items.ex_en: He prefers to shower with cold water immediately after finishing his morning jog.
items.ex_zh: 他喜欢在晨跑结束后立即去冲个凉水澡。

items.def_en: 1. (chiefly BrE) To wash someone (especially a child or baby) in a bath. 2. (chiefly BrE) To wash oneself in a bath.
items.ex_en: Every evening at seven, she would lovingly bath her toddler before bedtime stories.
items.ex_zh: 每天傍晚七点，在讲睡前故事前，她都会充满爱意地给幼儿洗澡。

items.def_en: To clean an entire person or large surface thoroughly using water and soap
items.ex_en: He washed down the spicy tacos with a cold glass of lemonade.
items.ex_zh: 他喝了一大口冰柠檬水，咽下了辛辣的墨西哥卷饼。

items.def_en: To wash someone clean using a wet sponge or cloth without full immersion
items.ex_en: The nurse gently sponged down the feverish child to bring his temperature down.
items.ex_zh: 护士用湿海绵轻柔地擦洗发烧孩子全身，以帮助他降温。

items.def_en: To wash oneself or another person thoroughly in a bath of water
items.ex_en: The caregivers helped bathe the elderly residents safely in the specialized walk-in tubs.
items.ex_zh: 照护人员帮助老人们在特制的无障碍浴缸中安全地沐浴洗澡。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers personal hygiene activities centered on washing the human body, bathing in tubs, or taking showers to become completely cleansed.
groups.summary_zh: 指在澡盆或喷头下清洁全身的沐浴个人卫生行为。
groups.desc_en: Involves total or partial body washing for personal hygiene, contrasting with general surface cleaning by focusing on grooming human flesh or entire animal bodies through water-directed rituals.
groups.desc_zh: 以人身或动物为对象的个人卫生清洗行为，与一般物体表面清洁不同，侧重水洗仪轨与身体清洁护理。
groups.nuance_en: bathe: immerse or wash the body in water, often leisurely or therapeutically (patient / wound / child) · shower: wash standing under a continuous spray of water (daily / athlete / guest) · bath: perform the full ablution ritual in a tub (baby / dog / toddler) · wash down: hose or vigorously flush an entire body or animal (horse / elephant / deckhands) · sponge down: gently clean a body using a wet sponge without immersion (feverish child / invalid / patient)
groups.nuance_zh: bathe: 浸浴或温和清洗身体或创面 (patient / wound / child) · shower: 站在喷头喷淋下冲凉 (daily / athlete / guest) · bath: 在浴缸中进行全身盆浴 (baby / dog / toddler) · wash down: 用大水冲洗全身或大型牲畜 (horse / elephant / deckhands) · sponge down: 用湿海绵轻拭身体擦浴 (feverish child / invalid / patient)

groups.name: Bathe & Soak · 沐浴与浸洗 (Bathe, Wash, Soak)
groups.tip: 水流冲洗清洁体表污垢

items.def_en: (literary) To wash or bathe gently with water, especially a body part or wound.
items.ex_en: She knelt by the gentle brook to lave her dust-covered face with water.
items.ex_zh: 她跪在潺潺小溪旁，用清水轻轻洗涤落满尘土的脸庞。

items.def_en: To clean someone's body or oneself by wiping with a damp sponge or cloth.
items.ex_en: After hiking all day, the tired camper quickly sponged down inside his tent.
items.ex_zh: 徒步跋涉整日后，疲惫的露营者在帐篷里用湿布擦洗全身。

items.def_en: To wash oneself under a spray of water falling from an overhead fixture.
items.ex_en: I always shower thoroughly to wash off the chlorine after swimming in pools.
items.ex_zh: 在泳池游泳后，我总是会彻底淋浴以冲掉身上的氯气。

items.def_en: To lie immersed in a bath or liquid for an extended time to soften, relax, or cleanse.
items.ex_en: She loved to soak in the hot lavender bath after exhausting workdays.
items.ex_zh: 在筋疲力尽的工作日之后，她喜欢泡在热气腾腾的薰衣草浴中放松。
items.ex2_en: Soak the dry beans overnight in cold water before boiling them tomorrow.
items.ex2_zh: 明天煮干豆之前，先用冷水将它们浸泡一整夜。

items.def_zh: 洗澡，沐浴；用水清洗（伤口）；游泳
items.def_en: 1. To wash yourself or someone else in a bath. 2. To gently wash or soothe a part of the body with liquid. 3. (chiefly British) To swim in the sea, a lake, or a river.
items.ex_en: The medic instructed him to bathe the painful wound with antiseptic saline solution.
items.ex_zh: 军医吩咐他用消毒生理盐水轻轻清洗这处疼痛的伤口。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers personal grooming or therapeutic treatment involving immersing oneself or parts of the body in water or soothing liquids, focusing on cleansing, relaxation, or wound care.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及全身或身体局部浸泡于水中以进行清洁、舒缓或护理。
groups.desc_en: Highlights the physical manner of cleansing through extended contact, immersion, or gentle liquid friction, contrasting with quick abrasive scrubbing by emphasizing soothing liquid saturation.
groups.desc_zh: 强调通过长时间液体浸泡或温和润拭来清洗的方式，区别于快速粗暴的擦洗，突显水液浸润与舒缓功效。
groups.nuance_en: soak: submerge deeply for prolonged liquid penetration (feet / sprain / beans) · bathe: immerse or wash gently to soothe or cleanse (eyes / weary limbs / skin) · lave: wash or lap against with poetic, gentle liquid flow (shore / hands / brow) · shower: douse with a deluge or spray of droplets (torso / body / hair) · sponge down: wipe down carefully with a saturated absorbent pad (invalid / horse / forehead)
groups.nuance_zh: soak: 长时间深层浸透以舒缓或去污 (feet / sprain / beans) · bathe: 浸洗或温和湿敷以镇静洁净 (eyes / weary limbs / skin) · lave: (文雅/诗意) 拂洗或轻柔流洗 (shore / hands / brow) · shower: 细密水流喷淋冲洗 (torso / body / hair) · sponge down: 用吸水海绵仔细擦抹擦拭 (invalid / horse / forehead)

groups.name: Be Situated & Lie · 地理坐落与展布 (Lie, Sit, Nest, Sprawl)
groups.tip: 处于特定地理位置

items.def_zh: 坐落于；位于（高地或明显位置）
items.def_en: To be positioned or situated proudly in a particular setting or elevated position
items.ex_en: The majestic stone fortress sits prominently atop the craggy hill overlooking the bay.
items.ex_zh: 这座巍峨的石头要塞傲然坐落于崎岖的山顶，俯瞰着海湾。

items.def_en: To be located or situated in a particular place, position, or direction.
items.ex_en: The picturesque vineyard lies nestled peacefully between two rolling green mountain ridges.
items.ex_zh: 这座风景如画的葡萄园安然坐落于两座起伏青翠的山脊之间。

items.def_zh: 高耸坐落于；临高栖息于
items.def_en: To be balanced or positioned high up on the edge of a steep hill, cliff, or tall support
items.ex_en: The tiny historic monastery perched precariously on the edge of the sheer cliff.
items.ex_zh: 这座古老的小修道院险峻地高耸坐落于陡峭悬崖边缘。
items.ex2_en: The proud eagle perched its large heavy body high upon the crag.
items.ex2_zh: 骄傲的雄鹰将庞大沉重的身躯稳稳栖息在高高的悬崖上。

items.def_zh: 漫延铺展；不规则扩展坐落
items.def_en: To spread out or lie irregularly across an expansive area in an untidy or loose manner
items.ex_en: The modern industrial complex sprawls across dozens of acres on the city outskirts.
items.ex_zh: 这座现代工业园区在城市郊区漫延铺展了数十英亩之广。

items.def_zh: 依偎坐落于；掩映在……之间
items.def_en: To be located comfortably, securely, or snugly sheltered within hills, trees, or a valley
items.ex_en: Ancient stone cottages nestle peacefully among the rolling hills of the quiet valley.
items.ex_zh: 古老的石屋宁静地掩映在幽静山谷起伏的群山之间。
items.ex2_en: The exhausted mother nestled her sleeping infant gently against her warm chest.
items.ex2_zh: 筋疲力尽的母亲温柔地把熟睡的婴儿依偎在自己温暖的胸口。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures stative geographic verbs describing how physical features, buildings, or territories are located or oriented across a landscape, highlighting their natural pose or vista.
groups.summary_zh: 描写建筑、城镇或地理地貌在特定地形中自然坐落、铺展的状态。
groups.desc_en: Depicts how a geographic feature or structure physically occupies its landscape position, contrasting with abstract existence by evoking concrete spatial posture, elevation, and terrain integration.
groups.desc_zh: 描绘地貌或建筑物在地理环境中的空间形态与坐落姿态，区别于抽象的“存在”，强调地形嵌合、高下俯仰的具象空间感。
groups.nuance_en: sit: occupy a settled, prominent, or flat position (castle / village / house) · lie: extend horizontally across a terrain or direction (valley / ruins / city) · perch: sit precariously or elevated on a high ledge or crag (cottage / monastery / eagle) · nestle: sit snugly, sheltered, or half-hidden in surroundings (hamlet / valley / cottage) · sprawl: spread outward irregularly across a wide area (suburbs / metropolis / shantytown)
groups.nuance_zh: sit: 稳固有致地坐落于基底上 (castle / village / house) · lie: 沿地势横向展布或卧伏 (valley / ruins / city) · perch: 高耸或临空险踞于悬崖高台 (cottage / monastery / eagle) · nestle: 依偎隐匿于山谷密林环抱中 (hamlet / valley / cottage) · sprawl: 杂乱无序地向外大面积漫延 (suburbs / metropolis / shantytown)

groups.name: Beat & Emulsify Ingredients · 打发与拌和乳化 (Cream, Whip, Beat)
groups.tip: 击打搅和使原料充分交融

items.def_zh: 搅打成奶油状；把（黄油和糖）搅成乳霜状
items.def_en: To mix or beat ingredients (such as butter and sugar) together until they form a smooth, soft, creamy mixture.
items.ex_en: Cream the softened butter and sugar until the mixture becomes pale and fluffy.
items.ex_zh: 将软化的黄油和糖搅打成乳霜状，直至混合物变得蓬松泛白。

items.def_zh: 掺和；用搅拌机打碎混合
items.def_en: Mix various ingredients together thoroughly until they form a single uniform substance
items.ex_en: Blend all the chopped vegetables with olive oil until completely smooth.
items.ex_zh: 把所有切碎的蔬菜与橄榄油彻底打碎混合，直至质地完全细腻。
items.ex2_en: The colors blend together smoothly on the wet canvas without harsh lines.
items.ex2_zh: 各种颜色在湿润的画布上平滑交融，没有生硬的线条。

items.def_en: Combine two unblendable liquids (such as oil and vinegar) into a stable, suspended mixture
items.ex_en: Whisk vigorously to emulsify the fragrant walnut oil into the tart vinegar.
items.ex_zh: 用力搅拌以使芳香的核桃油与酸醋完美乳化融合。
items.ex2_en: Oil and cold water do not emulsify naturally without adding an agent.
items.ex2_zh: 如果不添加乳化剂，油和冷水自然状态下不会乳化。

items.def_en: Mix food vigorously with repeated strokes of a spoon, fork, or electric mixer until smooth
items.ex_en: Beat the fresh eggs and whole milk thoroughly with a silver fork.
items.ex_zh: 用一把银叉将鲜鸡蛋和全脂牛奶彻底打散搅匀。

items.def_en: Beat cream, eggs, or batter rapidly with a whisk or mixer to introduce air and produce foam
items.ex_en: Whip the chilled heavy cream into stiff peaks for the holiday dessert.
items.ex_zh: 将冰镇的淡奶油打发至硬性发泡，用来制作节日甜点。

groups.summary_en: This culinary frame focuses on vigorously beating fat, sugar, eggs, or cream together until the mixture changes physical consistency, incorporating air to become fluffy, uniform, and velvety.
groups.summary_zh: 用力搅拌油脂、糖或蛋液，使空气充入形成轻盈细腻的乳霜质地。
groups.desc_en: Mechanically incorporates air or blends immiscible food phases into a homogenous, light, or bound state, contrasting with simple stirring by requiring sustained, high-energy shear forces.
groups.desc_zh: 通过持续的高剪切力将空气打入或使互不相溶的食材相融合，区别于普通的搅拌，强调相态转变与质地轻盈化。
groups.nuance_en: whip: beat rapidly to incorporate maximum air and volume (cream / egg whites / meringue) · beat: vigorously agitate with utensils to thoroughly mix and smooth (eggs / batter / mixture) · cream: rub fat and sugar together until light, fluffy, and pale (butter and sugar / shortening / mixture) · emulsify: force oil and water phases into a stable suspension (vinaigrette / mayonnaise / sauce) · blend: combine different ingredients uniformly without incorporating excessive air (smoothie / spices / ingredients)
groups.nuance_zh: whip: 极速搅打打发以混入大量空气 (cream / egg whites / meringue) · beat: 用力抽打搅拌以调匀顺滑 (eggs / batter / mixture) · cream: 将油脂与糖搅打至乳化泛白蓬松 (butter and sugar / shortening / mixture) · emulsify: 使油水两相剧烈分散形成稳定乳浊液 (vinaigrette / mayonnaise / sauce) · blend: 均匀拌和混合多种成分 (smoothie / spices / ingredients)

groups.name: Beat & Thrash Crops/Surfaces · 连打与摔打脱粒 (Thresh, Thrash, Flail)
groups.tip: 用力击打脱粒或捣毁

items.def_en: To separate particles or grains by repeatedly striking
items.ex_en: She beat out hundreds of applicants to land the prestigious role.
items.ex_zh: 她在数百名求职者中脱颖而出，拿下了这个令人羡慕的职位。

items.def_zh: 用连枷打；乱挥；猛烈击打
items.def_en: To beat or swing something vigorously and erratically as with a flail
items.ex_en: The drowning swimmer began to flail his arms frantically against the surface.
items.ex_zh: 溺水的泳者开始在水面上疯狂地胡乱挥舞双臂击打水花。
items.ex2_en: The loose sails began to flail wildly in the sudden ocean gale.
items.ex2_zh: 松散的船帆在突如其来的海上大风中开始疯狂乱摆。

items.def_zh: 脱粒，打谷；猛烈挥动，抽打
items.def_en: To separate grain from the rest of the crop plant by beating it; to thrash or beat violently.
items.ex_en: The laborers gathered at dawn to thresh the golden wheat by hand.
items.ex_zh: 工人们拂晓时分聚集在一起，用手工给金黄的小麦脱粒。

items.def_en: To strike someone or something repeatedly with hard, punishing blows
items.ex_en: Relentless ocean waves batter the ancient stone seawall throughout the fierce storm.
items.ex_zh: 在整场暴风雨中，无情的狂澜连续重击着古老的石砌海堤。

items.def_en: To beat repeatedly and violently with a stick or whip, or thrash grain
items.ex_en: The brutal master would thrash the poor runaway with a heavy cane.
items.ex_zh: 残暴的庄园主会用一根沉重的藤条痛打那个可怜的逃跑者。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on vigorously beating or whipping plants, fibers, or objects with continuous swinging strokes, whether historically to separate grain or metaphorically to flail violently.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过挥舞工具连续摔打、抽打农作物或物体以脱粒、分离或剧烈击打。
groups.desc_en: Repeatedly strikes crops or surfaces with an implement or violent motion to separate components or punish, contrasting with single impacts by featuring continuous, swinging blows.
groups.desc_zh: 用器具或剧烈摆动连续敲打作物或表面以实现脱粒或重创，区别于单次撞击，强调持械或狂乱的连续甩击。
groups.nuance_en: thresh: mechanically separate grain from chaff by beating (wheat / grain / harvest) · flail: strike repeatedly with a swinging agricultural tool or wild limbs (arms / corn / grain) · beat out: strike repeatedly to separate or extinguish (flames / dust / grain) · thrash: beat violently and flail about wildly (water / opponent / limbs) · batter: subject to heavy, repeated, damaging impact (door / shore / walls)
groups.nuance_zh: thresh: 用连枷或机械捶打谷物脱粒 (wheat / grain / harvest) · flail: 用连枷挥打脱粒或四肢狂乱摆动 (arms / corn / grain) · beat out: 连续捶打以打出谷粒或扑灭 (flames / dust / grain) · thrash: 剧烈抽打或在水中拼命挣扎扑腾 (water / opponent / limbs) · batter: 连续猛烈撞击造成破损残败 (door / shore / walls)

groups.name: Beckon & Summon by Gesture · 招引与示意召唤 (Beckon, Wave over, Flag down)
groups.tip: 挥手摆头以肢体语言示意，招引他人走近

items.def_en: to indicate with a tilt or nod of the head that someone should approach you
items.ex_en: He glanced across the crowded room and gave a quick nod over.
items.ex_zh: 他扫视了拥挤的房间，迅速点头示意对方过来。

items.def_en: to signal to someone with a movement of the hand to come closer or join you
items.ex_en: She stood near the cafe entrance and began to wave over her colleagues.
items.ex_zh: 她站在咖啡馆门口，挥手示意同事们走过来。

items.def_en:
1. to move your hand or head to signal someone to approach or follow you
2. to appear appealing, inviting, or likely to happen
items.ex_en: The warm fire seemed to beckon the exhausted travelers from the cold.
items.ex_zh: 温暖的炉火似乎在召唤那些受冻的疲惫旅人走近。

items.def_en: to signal to the driver of a moving vehicle to pull over and stop, usually by waving your arms
items.ex_en: We managed to flag down a passing yellow cab on the rainy street.
items.ex_zh: 我们设法在下雨的街道上挥手拦下了一辆路过的黄色出租车。

items.def_en: to order or gesture to someone to come to you, often using authority or a decisive signal
items.ex_en: The stern magistrate used an authoritative hand gesture to summon the nervous witness.
items.ex_zh: 严厉的法官以威严的手势招呼那名紧张的证人上前。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe using silent physical gestures—such as nodding, waving, or crooking a finger—to summon someone toward you or signal them to follow. They range from polite social summons to urgent hailing on the street.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过招手、颔首等肢体动作示意他人靠近、停步或跟随。
groups.desc_en: Summons or directs an individual toward oneself using non-verbal physical signs or gestures, contrasting with verbal commands through silent visual signaling.
groups.desc_zh: 通过肢体动作或手势非言语地招引呼唤目标靠近，区别于口头指令，强调无声的视觉示意。
groups.nuance_en: beckon: summon by a subtle gesture of hand or head, often alluringly (waiter / follower / guest) · wave over: signal someone in the distance to approach by waving an arm (colleague / friend / server) · flag down: signal moving vehicles or operators to halt by vigorous waving (taxi / train / motorist) · nod over: tilt the head toward a direction to indicate approach or attention (stranger / accomplice / partner) · summon: authoritatively call someone to appear or come forward (witness / attendant / courage)
groups.nuance_zh: beckon: 招手或微仰头示意靠近，常带诱引感 (waiter / follower / guest) · wave over: 招手示意远处之人走过来 (colleague / friend / server) · flag down: 挥臂拦停正在行驶的车辆 (taxi / train / motorist) · nod over: 点头示意某人过来或看过去 (stranger / accomplice / partner) · summon: 威严或正式传唤某人到场 (witness / attendant / courage)

groups.name: Beef & Grumble · 抱怨与牢骚不满 (Beef, Grumble, Whine)
groups.tip: 牢骚满腹或低语咕哝

items.def_en: 1. (+ about) (informal) To complain persistently or grumble about something.
items.ex_en: The grumpy tenants continually beef about the building's unreliable central heating system.
items.ex_zh: 脾气暴躁的租客们不停地抱怨大楼那靠不住的集中供暖系统。

items.def_en: (+ about) Complain about something in a bad-tempered, muttering, or disgruntled way
items.ex_en: Commuters frequently grumble about the constant delays during the evening rush hour.
items.ex_zh: 通勤者们经常嘟囔抱怨晚高峰期间持续不断的列车延误。

items.def_zh: 哭诉抱怨；唧唧歪歪地发牢骚
items.def_en: (+ about) Complain in an annoying, petulant, or high-pitched tone without taking action
items.ex_en: The spoiled children whine endlessly about doing their basic daily household chores.
items.ex_zh: 那些被惯坏的孩子们总是在做简单的日常家务时唧唧歪歪地发牢骚。

items.def_en: (informal, + about) Complain repeatedly and irritably, often about trivial matters
items.ex_en: The mechanics gripe about the terrible working conditions in the freezing garage.
items.ex_zh: 机械师们不断发牢骚，抱怨冰冷刺骨的车库里糟糕的工作条件。

items.def_en: (informal, + about) Complain spitefully, unfairly, or maliciously behind someone's back
items.ex_en: They love to bitch about their demanding boss behind her back.
items.ex_zh: 他们特别喜欢在背后恶言抱怨那位要求苛刻的女老板。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on expressing petty, persistent, irritable dissatisfaction or grievances. Distinct from formal complaints, this frame captures informal venting, muttering, whining, and griping.
groups.summary_zh: 指非正式口语中喋喋不休地发牢骚、碎碎念或抱怨琐事。
groups.desc_en: Expresses petty, chronic, or sharp dissatisfaction through verbal venting, contrasting with constructive critique by focusing on irritably offloading annoyance.
groups.desc_zh: 通过口头抱怨发泄琐碎、长期或刻薄的不满，区别于建设性批评，侧重宣泄负面情绪与牢骚。
groups.nuance_en: grumble: mutter low, indistinct complaints under one's breath (passengers / workers / stomach) · whine: complain in a high-pitched, childish, or self-pitying tone (child / voice / critics) · gripe: persistently air petty, irritating grievances (soldiers / employees / consumers) · beef: complain aggressively or harbor an overt grudge (customers / players / crew) · bitch: vent sharp, cynical, and malicious displeasure informally (friends / coworkers / flatmates)
