groups.nuance_zh: grumble: 嘟囔着发闷骚、低声咕哝抱怨 (passengers / workers / stomach) · whine: 哼唧、带哭腔或自怜般抱怨 (child / voice / critics) · gripe: 针对琐事没完没了地吐苦水 (soldiers / employees / consumers) · beef: (口语) 粗暴叫嚷抱怨或挑衅发难 (customers / players / crew) · bitch: (俚语) 尖酸刻薄、毫无顾忌地发泄牢骚 (friends / coworkers / flatmates)

groups.name: Befit & Behoove · 适宜与理应 (Befit, Behoove, Beseem)
groups.tip: 符合身份理应履行的义务

items.def_en: To be appropriate to or look attractive on someone; befit their status
items.ex_en: Such rude and aggressive behavior does not become a distinguished diplomat.
items.ex_zh: 这种粗鲁且具攻击性的举止绝不符合一位杰出外交官的身份。

items.def_en: To be acceptable, convenient, or proper for someone or something
items.ex_en: This flexible meeting schedule will suit the busy overseas clients very well.
items.ex_zh: 这种弹性的会议日程安排会非常适合那些忙碌的海外客户。

items.def_en: (archaic or formal) To be suitable, fit, or becoming for
items.ex_en: It does not beseem a noble knight to utter such cowardly words.
items.ex_zh: 说出如此懦弱的话语，实在有失一位尊贵骑士的体统。

items.def_en: To be suitable, appropriate, or proper for someone or a particular situation
items.ex_en: Her dignified and graceful response did befit the solemn nature of the occasion.
items.ex_zh: 她庄重大方的回应完全契合了该场合严肃郑重的性质。

items.def_en: ('it behooves someone to do') (formal) To be right, proper, or necessary for someone to do something.
items.ex_en: It behooves every responsible citizen to examine the proposed legislation with care.
items.ex_zh: 仔细审视这项拟议的法案，是每位负责任公民的理应之举。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express that an action, manner, or quality is morally incumbent, appropriate, or fitting given a person's standing, role, or station.
groups.summary_zh: 指与身份、地位相相称，或某人理当履行的适宜职责。
groups.desc_en: Signifies moral, social, or conventional propriety regarding a person's status or duty, contrasting with practical utility by centering on deontic appropriateness and decorum.
groups.desc_zh: 表示在道德、礼节或社会身份层面上理应如此，区别于实用层面的合身或好用，侧重义务性与体面合宜。
groups.nuance_en: befit: match the dignity, status, or character of someone (king / office / station) · behoove: denote a pressing moral or prudential obligation, typically as 'it behooves' (government / citizen / us) · become: enhance or look visually/morally appropriate on a person (dress / behavior / modesty) · beseem: (archaic) appear fitting or seemly according to decorum (knight / maiden / modesty) · suit: fulfill personal preferences, convenience, or physical harmony (tastes / schedule / needs)
groups.nuance_zh: befit: 与身份、头衔或体统相衬相宜 (king / office / station) · behoove: (常作 it behooves) 理应、有义务或责任去做 (government / citizen / us) · become: 使显得得体、与举止风度相宜 (dress / behavior / modesty) · beseem: (古风) 显现得体合体、合乎礼数 (knight / maiden / modesty) · suit: 适合个人品味、便利或实际要求 (tastes / schedule / needs)

groups.name: Befriend & Take In · 结交并关照 (Adopt, Champion, Patronize)
groups.tip: 主动结交盟友并给予扶持

items.def_en: To begin to like someone and behave in a friendlier, more welcoming manner toward them
items.ex_en: The standoffish cat took days to finally warm to its new owner.
items.ex_zh: 那只高冷孤僻的猫过了好几天才终于开始亲近它的新主人。

items.def_en: 1. To become friendly with someone and help or support them, especially when they are lonely or new.
items.ex_en: She made a conscious effort to befriend the shy transfer student.
items.ex_zh: 她特意主动示好，去结交并照拂那个害羞的转学生。

items.def_zh: 悉心庇护；认作门徒悉心关照
items.def_en: To take a newcomer or younger person into one's protective care and guidance
items.ex_en: The senior engineer chose to take the young intern under his wing.
items.ex_zh: 这位资深工程师决定悉心庇护并指导这位年轻的实习生。

items.def_en: To support, defend, and publicly advocate for someone's interests or rights
items.ex_en: The influential senator continues to champion affordable healthcare for low-income families.
items.ex_zh: 这位颇具影响力的参议员继续公开大力捍卫低收入家庭的平价医疗权益。

items.def_en: To treat someone with intense affection, excessive care, and overprotective shelter
items.ex_en: The doting grandmother tended to cosset the delicate boy beyond measure.
items.ex_zh: 溺爱孙儿的祖母往往过度娇惯这个身体孱弱的小男孩。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on proactively extending warmth, sponsorship, or compassionate companionship to newcomers, vulnerable persons, or outsiders. It combines interpersonal bonding with protective or mentoring action.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动亲近、庇护或关照新来者及弱者，兼具交好与支持之意。
groups.desc_en: Adopts an affectionate, protective, or mentoring relationship toward a more vulnerable newcomer, contrasting with neutral networking through paternalistic or warm embrace.
groups.desc_zh: 对弱势者或新人建立充满关爱、庇护或导师色彩的关系，区别于中性的社交结识，强调温情与庇护。
groups.nuance_en: befriend: actively offer friendly companionship to a stranger or loner (newcomer / orphan / outcast) · take under one's wing: adopt a junior person into personal protection and mentorship (protege / apprentice / recruit) · champion: publicly support, defend, and fight for someone's cause (cause / rights / underdog) · warm to: develop a spontaneous liking or positive disposition toward someone (idea / stranger / colleague) · cosset: pamper and protect excessively from hardship (child / pet / favorites)
groups.nuance_zh: befriend: 主动向陌生人或孤立者示好并结为朋友 (newcomer / orphan / outcast) · take under one's wing: 将后辈纳于翼下庇护提携 (protege / apprentice / recruit) · champion: 为某人的权益或事业挺身辩护力挺 (cause / rights / underdog) · warm to: 对某人或事物逐渐萌生好感与热情 (idea / stranger / colleague) · cosset: 过度娇惯、溺爱保护 (child / pet / favorites)

groups.name: Beget & Reproduce · 配种受精与生殖繁育 (Sire, Pollinate, Beget)
groups.tip: 雄性配种繁衍留下血统

items.def_zh: 成为（雄性亲本）繁育出；作为……的雄性父本
items.def_en: (especially of a male domestic animal, such as a stallion) To be the father of offspring.
items.ex_en: The champion thoroughbred stallion went on to sire dozens of victorious racehorses.
items.ex_zh: 这匹冠军纯血种公马随后繁育出了数十匹屡获殊荣的赛马。

items.def_en: to cause an egg, female animal, or plant to develop new life by introducing male cells
items.ex_en: A single vigorous sperm is required to successfully fertilize the mature egg.
items.ex_zh: 需要一颗强健的精子才能成功使成熟的卵子受精。

items.def_en: (of insects, wind, or humans) To carry pollen to a flower or plant so that it can produce seeds or fruit.
items.ex_en: Bumblebees help to pollinate the bright orchard blossoms throughout the warm spring.
items.ex_zh: 大黄蜂在整个温暖的春天协助给果园里艳丽的花朵传粉。

items.def_en: (formal/archaic) to father or produce offspring through sexual reproduction
items.ex_en: Ancient scriptures record that the patriarch did beget many sons and daughters.
items.ex_zh: 古代经文记载，这位先祖繁衍生育了许多儿女。

items.def_en: to introduce semen into the reproductive tract of a female animal or person
items.ex_en: Trained veterinary technicians carefully inseminate the dairy cows to ensure pregnancy.
items.ex_zh: 受过专业训练的兽医技术人员谨慎地为奶牛进行人工授精以确保受孕。

groups.summary_en: Organisms, human parents, or breeders cause reproduction by contributing genetic material, fertilizing flowers, or conceiving offspring. Verbs specify male parentage (animals or humans), botanical fertilization, or direct genealogical procreation.
groups.summary_zh: 动植物或人类通过配种、授粉、传宗接代产生后代或促成繁衍。
groups.desc_en: Triggers or accomplishes biological procreation through the transfer of genetic material, contrasting with child-rearing by specifying the causal inception of life.
groups.desc_zh: 通过传递遗传物质触发或完成生物繁殖，区别于后期的抚养照顾，严格指涉生命孕育的源头动作。
groups.nuance_en: beget: father offspring, or poetically give rise to a state (children / violence / despair) · sire: act as the male parent, especially of domesticated mammals (foal / stallion / champion) · fertilize: introduce pollen or sperm to an egg or ovule to initiate development (egg / soil / flower) · inseminate: introduce semen into a female reproductive tract (cow / mare / patient) · pollinate: convey pollen grains onto a plant stigma (crops / flowers / blossom)
groups.nuance_zh: beget: 作为父亲生养后代，或引申为衍生诱发 (children / violence / despair) · sire: (特指雄性良种牲畜) 繁育传种 (foal / stallion / champion) · fertilize: 使受精、受粉以发育成胚胎 (egg / soil / flower) · inseminate: 进行人工或自然授精 (cow / mare / patient) · pollinate: 使植物受粉传粉 (crops / flowers / blossom)

groups.name: Behave & Carry Oneself · 举止与表现 (Behave, Conduct, Act)
groups.tip: 言谈举止的表现方式

items.def_en: To behave in a specified way, whether appropriately or inappropriately
items.ex_en: You must learn to act professionally during high-stakes negotiations with foreign partners.
items.ex_zh: 在与外国伙伴进行关键谈判时，你必须学会表现得专业得体。

items.def_zh: 举止端正，持身（尤指反身）
items.def_en: (bear oneself) To carry oneself or behave with a specific demeanor or posture
items.ex_en: The young princess learned to bear herself with regal grace and dignity.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的公主学会了以皇家特有的优雅与尊严来持身自重。

items.def_zh: 举止，为人处事（尤指反身）
items.def_en: (conduct oneself) To behave and direct one's actions in a specified, usually proper, manner
items.ex_en: The ambassadors must conduct themselves with impeccable dignity throughout the peace talks.
items.ex_zh: 在整个和平谈判期间，大使们必须举止得体，保持无可挑剔的尊严。

items.def_zh: 表现，举止；守规矩，表现规矩
items.def_en: To act in a particular way; to conduct oneself properly or politely.
items.ex_en: The tired toddler promised his mother that he would behave in church.
items.ex_zh: 疲倦的幼儿向母亲保证，他在教堂里一定会规矩听话。

items.def_en: To behave in an excited, unreasonable, or inappropriate manner
items.ex_en: Despite facing severe financial difficulties, they decided to carry on with the project.
items.ex_zh: 尽管面临严重的财务困难，他们还是决定把项目继续做下去。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses acting or handling oneself in social interactions, evaluated against standards of decorum, etiquette, or expected propriety.
groups.summary_zh: 指日常社会交往中符合规矩礼仪的言谈举止表现。
groups.desc_en: Executes social self-presentation and bodily deportment under normative standards, contrasting with involuntary movement by involving ethical and decorous agency.
groups.desc_zh: 在社会规范或体统约束下展现举止与仪态，区别于无意识的身体动作，包含道德素养与自觉自律。
groups.nuance_en: behave: conform conduct to rules of politeness and orderliness (children / properly / themselves) · conduct: manage and regulate one's public or moral actions with dignity (investigation / oneself / affairs) · bear: carry or posture one's body and emotional poise, often with dignity (hardship / oneself / resemblance) · act: perform socially or dissemble a specific temporary role (brave / fool / leader) · carry on: behave in an unruly, improper, or noisy manner (scandalously / like a child / noisily)
groups.nuance_zh: behave: 循规蹈矩、举止得体规矩 (children / properly / themselves) · conduct: (正式) 恪守道德或准则行事表态 (investigation / oneself / affairs) · bear: 维持体面沉稳的体态风度或承受举止 (hardship / oneself / resemblance) · act: 表现出特定举止或伪装作态 (brave / fool / leader) · carry on: 举止失常、胡闹或大惊小怪 (scandalously / like a child / noisily)

groups.name: Belch & Spew · 嗳气与喷吐 (Burp, Spew, Gush)
groups.tip: 打嗝反气喷发胃部气体

items.def_en: To pass gas noisily from the stomach through the mouth, or help a baby do so
items.ex_en: The well-fed infant let out a loud burp after drinking milk.
items.ex_zh: 吃饱喝足的婴儿在喝完奶后响亮地打了一个饱嗝。

items.def_en: To send out liquid or vapor forcibly in a stream, or emit profusely
items.ex_en: The broken municipal pipe began to spout muddy water into the air.
items.ex_zh: 破裂的市政管道开始向空中喷射出一股股浑浊的水柱。
items.ex2_en: Hot mineral water spouts continuously from the natural geyser into the air.
items.ex2_zh: 热矿泉水不断从天然间歇泉中喷涌至半空。

items.def_en: (+ out/from) To flow out rapidly in a plentiful stream or burst
items.ex_en: Cold fresh spring water continued to gush from the rocky mountain crevice.
items.ex_zh: 清凉甘洌的泉水不断从岩石密布的山体裂缝中喷涌而出。
items.ex2_en: The burst main pipe gushed gallons of muddy brown water onto streets.
items.ex2_zh: 爆裂的主水管向街道喷涌出数加仑浑浊的黄泥水。

items.def_zh: 打嗝，嗳气；大量喷出，喷吐
items.def_en: 1. To let air or gas come noisily up from the stomach through the mouth; to burp. 2. (+ out/forth) To emit or discharge smoke, gas, or flames forcefully in large amounts.
items.ex_en: The factory chimneys belch thick black smoke into the pristine morning sky.
items.ex_zh: 工厂烟囱向清新的清晨天空中大量喷吐出一股股浓黑的烟尘。

items.def_en: (+ out) To expel large quantities of gas, liquid, or substance rapidly and forcibly
items.ex_en: Old rusty sewer drains spew foul waste into the river during floods.
items.ex_zh: 洪水期间，锈迹斑斑的老旧下水道将恶臭的废弃物猛烈喷入河中。
items.ex2_en: Thick black smoke spewed continuously from the crumbling factory chimney into the sky.
items.ex2_zh: 浓黑的烟雾从破败的工厂烟囱中源源不断地喷向天空。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the forceful, noisy expulsion of gas or liquids, either biologically from the digestive tract or metaphorically from chimneys, volcanoes, and pipes.
groups.summary_zh: 指胃部积气发出声响喷出，或烟雾、液体等剧烈喷涌倾泻。
groups.desc_en: Ejects gas, liquid, or particulate matter forcefully from an interior cavity, contrasting with passive leaking through explosive internal pressure.
groups.desc_zh: 在内部压力下将气体、液体或碎屑从腔体内猛烈喷吐排出，区别于被动渗漏，强调腔内压骤然爆发。
groups.nuance_en: belch: expel gas noisily from the stomach, or puff out huge plumes (smoke / flame / beer) · burp: gently release gas from the digestive tract orally (baby / loudly / meal) · spew: forcibly vomit or violently discharge large volumes outward (lava / obscenities / insults) · gush: surge forth in a sudden, copious liquid torrent (blood / oil / tears) · spout: emit a continuous stream from an opening, or recite pompously (water / whale / nonsense)
groups.nuance_zh: belch: 饱嗝大作，或大量喷出浓烟烈火 (smoke / flame / beer) · burp: 饱食后嗳气打嗝，或给婴儿拍嗝 (baby / loudly / meal) · spew: 猛烈呕吐或火山式向外狂喷 (lava / obscenities / insults) · gush: 涌流迸出大量液体 (blood / oil / tears) · spout: 经管口激射喷出，或高谈阔论唾沫横飞 (water / whale / nonsense)

groups.name: Bellow & Low · 鸣吼与哞叫 (Moo, Bellow, Bleat)
groups.tip: 发自喉咙的啼叫与粗暴吼叫

items.def_en: (of cattle) To make a deep, low moo sound.
items.ex_en: Gentle dairy cows low softly while grazing in the misty green pasture.
items.ex_zh: 温顺的奶牛在薄雾笼罩的绿色牧场吃草时发出低沉轻柔的哞鸣。

items.def_en: To make the characteristic deep sound of a cow
items.ex_en: The hungry calves moo loudly whenever they see the farmer bring feed.
items.ex_zh: 饥饿的牛犊每当看见农夫端来饲料，都会大声哞哞叫唤。

items.def_en: To make the quavering cry of a sheep or goat, or complain weakly
items.ex_en: Lost white lambs bleat pitifully along the steep and rocky hillside.
items.ex_zh: 迷路的白色羊羔在陡峭多石的山坡上发出凄楚的咩咩哀鸣。

items.def_en: To make a high-pitched, loud sound characteristic of a horse
items.ex_en: The wild black stallions neigh fiercely before charging across the open plains.
items.ex_zh: 野生的黑种马在狂奔穿过开阔平原之前发出了激昂的嘶鸣。

items.def_en: To emit a deep, loud, roaring sound in anger or pain, like a bull
items.ex_en: Enraged by the stinging whip, the captured beast began to bellow fiercely.
items.ex_zh: 被抽痛的皮鞭激怒后，这头被捕获的野兽开始发出愤怒的狂吼。

groups.summary_en: This frame characterizes the deep, resonant, or plaintive vocalizations made by cattle, sheep, and other livestock, or deep booming cries emitted by humans.
groups.summary_zh: 指牛羊等家畜发出的深沉长鸣或人类发出的低沉吼叫。
groups.desc_en: Emits deep, acoustic animal vocalizations characteristic of specific species, contrasting with articulate human speech by being instinctual and resonant.
groups.desc_zh: 发出特定物种标志性的低沉、洪亮或高亢的动物叫声，区别于人类言语，具本能共鸣与野性特质。
groups.nuance_en: bellow: roar in a deep, booming, hollow voice like an enraged bull (rage / pain / bull) · low: emit the gentle, deep, vibrating sound of cattle (cattle / cows / herd) · moo: make the characteristic open-mouthed vocal sound of cows (calf / cow / pasture) · bleat: produce a wavering, shrill cry like sheep, or whimper weakly (sheep / goat / lamb) · neigh: give the loud, high-pitched whinny of a horse (horse / stallion / mare)
groups.nuance_zh: bellow: 狂牛般低沉如雷地咆哮或狂吼 (rage / pain / bull) · low: (牛群) 发出柔和低回的长鸣声 (cattle / cows / herd) · moo: 典型的黄牛/奶牛发声“哞哞”叫 (calf / cow / pasture) · bleat: 羊类颤抖凄切的咩咩叫，或软弱哀鸣 (sheep / goat / lamb) · neigh: 马匹昂首发出清脆激越的长嘶 (horse / stallion / mare)

groups.name: Belong & Appertain · 归属与从属 (Belong, Appertain, Pertain)
groups.tip: 明确所有权或从属关系

items.def_zh: 属于，归…所有；是…的成员；应在…处，适合
items.def_en: 1. (belong to) to be the property of someone, or be a member of a group or organization 2. to be in the right or suitable place, position, or situation
items.ex_en: These vintage leather journals belong to my great-grandfather who served as cartographer.
items.ex_zh: 这些复古的皮质日记本属于曾担任制图师的我的曾祖父。

items.def_en: (+ to) To be associated with or belong to someone or something as a condition, right, or liability
items.ex_en: Tremendous administrative responsibilities naturally attach to the high office of the president.
items.ex_zh: 重大的行政管理职责自然附属于总统这一崇高职位。

items.def_en: (+ to) To belong to or be an appropriate part of something, especially by law or tradition
items.ex_en: Certain hereditary privileges and duties still appertain to this historical noble title.
items.ex_zh: 某些世袭的特权与义务至今仍然归属于这一历史悠久的贵族头衔。

items.def_en: (+ in) To exist as a natural, permanent, or inseparable quality, right, or element within something
items.ex_en: Basic fundamental liberties inhere in every single human soul by divine birthright.
items.ex_zh: 基本的天赋自由作为与生俱来的权利，固存于每个人的灵魂之中。

items.def_zh: 从属于，属于（特定群体或权利）
items.def_en: (+ to) To belong to someone or something as an accompaniment, right, or legal possession
items.ex_en: Immense mineral rights exclusively pertain to the sovereign lands of the indigenous tribe.
items.ex_zh: 巨大的矿产权依法完全从属于该原住民部落的主权领地。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate rightful ownership, inclusion within a specific category, or formal association with a larger entity or jurisdiction. Register contrasts sharply between everyday possession and high-register legal or institutional relations.
groups.summary_zh: 表物品归属、成员从属或法理上的附带与关联。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an inherent, juridical, or relational tie of ownership, connection, or categorization, contrasting with temporary possession by conveying constitutive status.
groups.desc_zh: 指示事物间固有、法理或从属的排他性纽带或范畴归属，区别于暂时的持有，强调本质与体统从属。
groups.nuance_en: belong: be rightful property or naturally fit into a category (family / club / possessions) · pertain: have reference, relevance, or connection to a matter (law / facts / case) · appertain: legally belong as a formal accessory, right, or privilege (estate / sovereignty / office) · inhere: exist as an intrinsic and inseparable constituent attribute (rights / qualities / power) · attach: adhere legally or naturally to a position or status (stigma / conditions / blame)
groups.nuance_zh: belong: 归属于某人作财产，或自然融入群体 (family / club / possessions) · pertain: 与特定事项直接相关或从属涉及 (law / facts / case) · appertain: (法律/正式) 作为附属权利或特权归属于 (estate / sovereignty / office) · inhere: 作为内生固有的本质属性而存在 (rights / qualities / power) · attach: 法律上或名义上附随归属于 (stigma / conditions / blame)

groups.name: Bend & Refract · 折射与偏折 (Refract, Deflect, Bend, Diffract)
groups.tip: 光线或路径发生弯曲折射

items.def_en: Alter the straight direction of travel of a light ray or wave path
items.ex_en: Heavy gravitational forces bend the path of light traveling near massive stars.
items.ex_zh: 强大的引力场使途经大质量恒星附近的光线行进路径发生偏折。
items.ex2_en: Light waves bend noticeably as they pass from air into clear water.
items.ex2_zh: 光波从空气进入清澈的水中时会发生明显的偏折。

items.def_en: Break up or bend light or sound waves as they pass around the edge of an obstacle
items.ex_en: Narrow microscopic apertures diffract the coherent laser beam into alternating bright rings.
items.ex_zh: 微小的狭窄孔洞使相干激光束发生衍射，形成明暗相间的圆环。
items.ex2_en: Sound waves diffract easily around thick obstacles within the densely crowded indoor arena.
items.ex2_zh: 声波在拥挤的室内场馆中很容易绕过厚重的障碍物发生衍射。

items.def_en: Cause something to change its course or direction from an intended path
items.ex_en: Traffic police officers must divert oncoming vehicles away from the dangerous landslide.
items.ex_zh: 交警必须改变驶来车辆的行进路线，使其远离危险的山体滑坡现场。

items.def_en: Cause something moving to change direction after striking something or meeting a field
items.ex_en: The heavy iron shield managed to deflect the warrior's fatal sword strike.
items.ex_zh: 厚重的铁盾成功使那位武士致命的一记剑击偏转了方向。
items.ex2_en: The fast tennis ball deflected harmlessly off the net cord into the court.
items.ex2_zh: 飞速击出的网球碰到球网边缘后偏转方向，落入场内。

items.def_en: (physics) to make a ray of light, sound wave, etc. change direction when it enters water, glass, or air at an angle
items.ex_en: Cool water drops refract the blinding morning sunlight into brilliant rainbow colors.
items.ex_zh: 清凉的水珠将刺眼的晨曦阳光折射为绚烂斑斓的彩虹色泽。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on physical waves, beams of light, or traveling trajectories changing direction upon encountering an interface, obstacle, or new medium.
groups.summary_zh: 指光线、波或运动轨迹在穿过介质或碰撞时发生偏折。
groups.desc_en: Changes the linear path or wavefront of radiation, light, or trajectories through physical boundaries, contrasting with straight propagation by boundary-induced deviation.
groups.desc_zh: 射线、波阵面或弹道因穿越介质界面或受阻而偏离直线传播路径，区别于直射，强调界面导致的偏折变换。
groups.nuance_en: refract: change light or wave direction when entering a different medium (light / wave / prism) · deflect: cause an object or path to veer aside upon collision or resistance (bullet / blow / attention) · diffract: break up and spread waves encountering an obstacle or slit (beam / wave / light) · bend: curve physically or flexibly veer ray trajectories (wire / knee / light) · divert: intentionally reroute flow, traffic, or attention away from a course (traffic / funds / river)
groups.nuance_zh: refract: 射线由不同介质折射改变方向 (light / wave / prism) · deflect: 碰撞受阻而偏转弹开、偏离原向 (bullet / blow / attention) · diffract: 波遇到障碍物缝隙时发生衍射绕射 (beam / wave / light) · bend: 物理弯曲，或引力导致光线偏折 (wire / knee / light) · divert: 人为将水流、车流或注意力改道转道 (traffic / funds / river)

groups.name: Benefit & Profit · 获利与受益 (Benefit, Gain, Capitalize)
groups.tip: 从中获取利润或好处

items.def_en: (+ from) to receive an advantage, improvement, or assistance; or bring advantage to
items.ex_en: Underprivileged local communities will benefit greatly from the new clean water initiative.
items.ex_zh: 贫困的地方社区将从这项新的清洁水源倡议中极大受惠。

items.def_en: to obtain a useful advantage, improvement, or financial advancement
items.ex_en: Savvy investors hope to gain a clear competitive edge in renewable technology.
items.ex_zh: 精明的投资者希望能在此项可再生技术领域赢得明显的竞争优势。

items.def_zh: 获利，赚钱；得益，受益；有益于
items.def_en: 1. (+ from/by) to gain a financial benefit, advantage, or profit from an activity 2. to be of service, advantage, or benefit to someone
items.ex_en: Prudent students will profit immensely by carefully reviewing the instructor's extensive feedback.
items.ex_zh: 审慎的学生仔细研读导师详尽的反馈意见，必将获益匪浅。

items.def_en: (+ on) to take exploit a situation or trend purely for immediate personal or financial gain
items.ex_en: Opportunistic scalpers sought to cash in on the unprecedented demand for tickets.
items.ex_zh: 投机的黄牛企图趁着前所未有的门票抢购狂潮大捞一把。

items.def_en: (+ on) to turn an event, circumstance, or mistake into an advantage or profit for oneself
items.ex_en: The nimble forward managed to capitalize on the defender's disastrous tactical mistake.
items.ex_zh: 敏捷的前锋成功利用了防守队员灾难性的战术失误乘机破门。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote reaping an advantage, financial gain, educational enrichment, or practical utility from an event, circumstance, investment, or opportunity.
groups.summary_zh: 指从某一行动、机会、投资或境遇中获取金钱收益、实际益处或优势。
groups.desc_en: Secures an advantageous yield, return, or utility from an opportunity, contrasting with passive receiving by extracting favorable outcomes.
groups.desc_zh: 从情势或机会中主动获取有利回报、价值或功利增益，区别于被动承受，强调有利价值的变现汲取。
groups.nuance_en: benefit: derive good, improvement, or well-being from a condition (community / health / patient) · profit: make a net financial gain or practical advantage from something (deal / company / experience) · gain: acquire an increase in useful attributes, weight, or progress (weight / traction / experience) · capitalize: exploit a transient opportunity or vulnerability to secure maximum gain (mistake / trend / weakness) · cash in: monetize an asset or abruptly turn an advantage into money (stocks / chips / popularity)
groups.nuance_zh: benefit: 获得福祉、增益或改善 (community / health / patient) · profit: 赚取经济利润或从经验中获益 (deal / company / experience) · gain: 获得进益、增重或优势累积 (weight / traction / experience) · capitalize: 抓住对手漏洞或瞬时商机大做文章以借势牟利 (mistake / trend / weakness) · cash in: 趁机套现获利、兑现手中优势 (stocks / chips / popularity)

groups.name: Bereave & Deprive of Kin · 丧亲与遗孀化 (Bereave, Widow, Deprive)
groups.tip: 至亲故去或所依之物被强制剥夺

items.def_zh: 遗下；身后留下（孤儿寡母等）
items.def_en: Leave behind a surviving spouse, children, or dependents upon dying
items.ex_en: His sudden and untimely demise did leave a grieving widow with orphans.
items.ex_zh: 他突如其来的过早离世，遗下了一位悲痛欲绝的寡妇和孤儿。

items.def_en: (+ of) Prevent someone from having, keeping, or enjoying something vital, such as love, family, or basic rights
items.ex_en: The prolonged solitary confinement served only to deprive the inmate of basic human dignity.
items.ex_zh: 长期的单独监禁只会剥夺该囚犯基本的人严与尊严。

items.def_en: (+ of) Cruelly or unjustly take away a cherished person, hope, or life experience from someone
items.ex_en: The fatal car accident robbed the young mother of her only surviving child.
items.ex_zh: 那场致命的车祸残酷地夺走了这位年轻母亲唯一的孩子。

items.def_zh: 使丧偶，使丧夫（或丧妻）；剥夺
items.def_en: (usually passive) To cause someone to become a widow or widower by the death of their spouse.
items.ex_en: She was widowed at twenty-five when the fishing boat sank in northern waters.
items.ex_zh: 渔船在北方海域沉没时，年仅二十五岁的她便丧偶了。

items.def_zh: 使丧失（亲人）；使痛失至亲
items.def_en: (usually passive) Deprive someone of a close relative or friend through their death
items.ex_en: The horrific epidemic bereaved countless families of their breadwinners during that bitter winter.
items.ex_zh: 在那个严冬，可怕的疫情夺走了无数家庭的主要劳动力。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe leaving someone utterly desolate or emotionally depleted through the death of a spouse or close relative. They frequently appear in the passive voice to convey profound, involuntary loss.
groups.summary_zh: 强调因配偶或至亲离世而痛失亲人、陷入孤苦境地。
groups.desc_en: Strips an individual of beloved family members or vital companions through mortality, contrasting with general property loss by dealing with existential relational ruin.
groups.desc_zh: 因死亡剥夺某人至亲骨肉或生命羁绊，区别于普通财产遗失，侧重生命毁灭带来的存在性丧亲之痛。
groups.nuance_en: bereave: leave desolate and heartbroken through the death of a close relation (family / parents / war) · widow: deprive someone of a spouse by death (wife / husband / accident) · rob: cruelly and unjustly strip someone of an intangible right, joy, or loved one (dignity / youth / family) · deprive: deny or prevent someone from possessing essential needs or companions (rights / sleep / liberty) · leave: abandon behind at death or exit as surviving remnants (family / orphans / legacy)
groups.nuance_zh: bereave: 夺走至亲使其陷于丧亲绝望巨恸 (family / parents / war) · widow: 因配偶死亡而使人丧偶/成遗孀 (wife / husband / accident) · rob: 残酷且不公地强行剥夺某人的尊严、挚爱或青春 (dignity / youth / family) · deprive: 剥夺、剥夺拥有某基本权益或亲缘的机会 (rights / sleep / liberty) · leave: 死后遗留下遗孤或身后产业 (family / orphans / legacy)

groups.name: Berth & Dock · 停泊与靠岸 (Moor, Tie up, Drop anchor)
groups.tip: 载具抵达泊位停靠

items.def_en: Mooring a vessel firmly to a dock or post with ropes
items.ex_en: Most of his capital is tied up in long-term real estate investments.
items.ex_zh: 他的大部分资金都被长期房地产投资套住了。

items.def_en: Lower an anchor into the water to immobilize a ship in position
items.ex_en: The yacht dropped anchor in the sheltered cove just before the gale began.
items.ex_zh: 游艇赶在大风来临前，在避风的港湾内抛了锚。

items.def_zh: （使船只）停靠码头，进港；对接（航天器）；扣减（工资等）
items.def_en: 1. (of a ship or spacecraft) To sail into or tie up at a dock; to join together in space. 2. To reduce or deduct an amount of money from someone's pay or benefits.
items.ex_en: The cargo ship docked safely at the pier despite the blinding coastal fog.
items.ex_zh: 尽管沿海浓雾弥漫，货轮仍安全地靠泊在码头。
items.ex2_en: The experienced pilot docked the massive cruise liner safely at the terminal.
items.ex2_zh: 经验丰富的引水员将庞大的游轮安全停靠在码头。

items.def_en: Fasten a boat or floating structure to the shore or sea bottom with cables or anchors
items.ex_en: Fishermen hurried to moor their wooden skiffs along the jetty before the storm.
items.ex_zh: 渔民们赶在风暴来临前，匆忙将木船系泊在防波堤旁。
items.ex2_en: Several small sailboats moor permanently along the calm waters of the private marina.
items.ex2_zh: 几艘小型帆船长年停泊在私人游艇码头平静的水域中。

items.def_en: Bring a ship into its allocated resting place at a wharf or harbor quay
items.ex_en: The harbor master berthed the ocean liner at the deepwater terminal before dusk.
items.ex_zh: 港务长在黄昏前将远洋客轮停泊在深水码头。
items.ex2_en: The giant freighter berthed quietly along the modern container terminal after midnight.
items.ex2_zh: 午夜过后，这艘巨型货轮静静地停泊在现代化的集装箱码头旁。

groups.summary_en: Relates to securing watercraft (or spacecraft) to a fixed shore structure, pier, or seabed. The frame emphasizes nautical protocols of arrival, tethering, and anchoring securely.
groups.summary_zh: 指船舶或航天器驶入停泊位并系缆缆绳或抛锚固定。
groups.desc_en: Securing a vessel at a designated maritime resting position, contrasting with generic stopping by emphasizing physical mooring infrastructure, navigational finality, and nautical restraint.
groups.desc_zh: 将船只固定在指定水域或泊位的航海操作，与普通的“停下”不同，它强调港口停靠设施、物理系泊约束及航程终止状态。
groups.nuance_en: dock: maneuver into a slip or basin for cargo/passenger handling (ferry / cruise ship / freighter) · moor: secure firmly using cables, ropes, or anchors to a fixed point (yacht / vessel / boat) · berth: assign or guide into a specific designated sleeping/parking slot (liner / supertanker / vessel) · tie up: secure to a pier or wharf with lines (skiff / motorboat / vessel) · drop anchor: lower ground tackle to hold position in open water (fleet / ship / sailboat)
groups.nuance_zh: dock: 靠泊进坞并装卸作业 (ferry / cruise ship / freighter) · moor: 用缆绳或锚系泊固定于浮筒/码头 (yacht / vessel / boat) · berth: 停泊或停靠于指定专用泊位 (liner / supertanker / vessel) · tie up: 用缆绳简单系缚在栈桥边 (skiff / motorboat / vessel) · drop anchor: 在开阔水域抛锚驻泊 (fleet / ship / sailboat)

groups.name: Besmirch & Tarnish Reputation · 玷污与抹黑 (Besmirch, Tarnish, Blacken)
groups.tip: 编造恶言败坏他人名誉

items.def_en: To make someone's reputation, honor, or good record less respected or tarnished
items.ex_en: The accounting scandal threatens to tarnish the governor's once pristine political record permanently.
items.ex_zh: 这起财务丑闻很可能会永久玷污州长以往无可挑剔的政绩。
items.ex2_en: His formerly unblemished political reputation tarnished rapidly following the explosive corruption trial.
items.ex2_zh: 在轰动一时的腐败案审理之后，他原本无可指摘的政治声誉迅速蒙尘。

items.def_en: To spread false and damaging stories about a person, especially in politics, to ruin their credibility
items.ex_en: Opponents sought to smear her character with unfounded rumors during the primary election.
items.ex_zh: 初选期间，对手试图散播毫无根据的谣言来抹黑她的人格。

items.def_en: To damage the purity, integrity, or spotless reputation of someone or something
items.ex_en: He refused to sully his spotless honor by participating in their corrupt scheme.
items.ex_zh: 他不愿参与他们的腐败阴谋，以免玷污自己无瑕的名誉。

items.def_en: To say damaging things about someone to ruin their good character in the eyes of others
items.ex_en: Spiteful rivals sought to blacken his good name across the entire royal court.
items.ex_zh: 心怀怨恨的对手企图在整个朝廷面前彻底抹黑他的美名。
items.ex2_en: Her delicate reputation blackened quickly among neighbors after those baseless rumors surfaced.
items.ex2_zh: 那些毫无根据的谣言浮出水面后，她在邻里间的声誉迅速败坏。

items.def_en: (formal) To damage or tarnish someone's good name, honor, or reputation.
items.ex_en: These base accusations were fabricated specifically to besmirch the magistrate's lifelong integrity.
items.ex_zh: 这些卑劣的指控纯属捏造，旨在抹黑这位法官一生的清誉。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame invoke metaphors of physical staining, soiling, or corroding to depict inflicting enduring dishonor, loss of luster, or disgrace upon someone's virtue, lineage, or public standing.
groups.summary_zh: 借用污损灰暗意象，指抹黑、玷污他人名节、清白或崇高荣誉。
groups.desc_en: Damaging the honor, purity, or social standing of a person or institution through slander or dishonorable conduct, contrasting with physical damage by targeting moral integrity and public esteem.
groups.desc_zh: 通过诽谤或不端行为破坏人或机构的声誉与名节，与物理损坏不同，它专指对道德纯洁度、社会信誉的玷污与贬损。
groups.nuance_en: tarnish: dull the luster of an established good standing (reputation / legacy / image) · sully: soil or contaminate something previously immaculate (honor / good name / innocence) · besmirch: cast persistent mud or moral dishonor upon (character / record / memory) · smear: spread malicious, unfounded accusations against (candidate / opponent / reputation) · blacken: actively portray as villainous or thoroughly corrupt (character / name / integrity)
groups.nuance_zh: tarnish: 失去光泽、使既有声望蒙尘 (reputation / legacy / image) · sully: 玷污本来纯洁无暇的事物 (honor / good name / innocence) · besmirch: 泼脏水、抹黑人格与记录 (character / record / memory) · smear: 恶意造谣诽谤以败坏名誉 (candidate / opponent / reputation) · blacken: 彻底抹黑或丑化其品行 (character / name / integrity)

groups.name: Bestow & Confer · 赐予与恩准 (Bestow, Confer, Accord)
groups.tip: 居高临下施恩授予特权或物

items.def_en: Grant or provide someone what is appropriate, due, or requested
items.ex_en: The constitution accords every citizen the fundamental right to speak without undue censorship.
items.ex_zh: 宪法赋予每位公民不受不正当审查的言论基本权利。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) Grant an official title, degree, benefit, or right
items.ex_en: The university decided to confer an honorary doctorate on the celebrated human rights advocate.
items.ex_zh: 大学决定向这位著名的人权倡导者授予荣誉博士学位。

items.def_en: (formal or archaic) To give, grant, or reveal something to someone as a special favor or condescension.
items.ex_en: The king vouchsafed no explanation for dismissing his most trusted chancellor from office.
items.ex_zh: 国王对于罢免最受信任的大臣一事，未作任何屈尊解释。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) Confer or present an honor, right, or gift upon someone formally
items.ex_en: The royal council chose to bestow their highest military honor upon the injured general.
items.ex_zh: 皇家议会决定向负伤的将军授予他们最高级别的军事荣誉。

items.def_zh: (+ to do) 屈尊俯就，垂赐
items.def_en: (+ to do) Condescend to give, do, or grant something in a gracious yet proud manner
items.ex_en: The proud duchess would not deign to reply to such impertinent commoners.
items.ex_zh: 傲慢的公爵夫人绝不肯屈尊理睬这群粗鄙平民的无礼之词。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the unilateral transfer of honors, boons, rights, or special favors from a superior authority to an inferior.
groups.summary_zh: 指居高临下地施予恩惠、头衔、特权或圣意恩典。
groups.desc_en: Giving, granting, or condescending from an asymmetrical position of authority or prestige, contrasting with everyday giving by encoding hierarchy, solemnity, and unmerited favor.
groups.desc_zh: 凭借不对等的权威、地位或特权向下赋予或恩赐，与日常“赠予”不同，它强调等级差距、礼节庄重性或恩典色彩。
groups.nuance_en: bestow: present formally as a noble gift or honor (honor / title / blessing) · confer: grant an official prerogative, degree, or status upon someone (degree / award / authority) · accord: grant appropriate respect, privilege, or status as due (status / privilege / recognition) · vouchsafe: condescend graciously to grant or permit something (favor / reply / glimpse) · deign: stoop beneath one's dignity to do something (response / answer / acknowledgment)
groups.nuance_zh: bestow: 正式赐予贵重礼物或殊荣 (honor / title / blessing) · confer: 依法或依职权授予学位、头衔或特权 (degree / award / authority) · accord: 给予应有的待遇、认可或特权 (status / privilege / recognition) · vouchsafe: 恩准、屈尊施与恩惠或回话 (favor / reply / glimpse) · deign: 屈尊降贵做某事 (response / answer / acknowledgment)

groups.name: Bias & Distort · 偏见与扭曲 (Jaundice, Warp, Prejudice, Color)
groups.tip: 戴着有色眼镜审视而导致误判

items.def_en: Influence or taint someone's opinion or memory in an unfair or subjective way
items.ex_en: Personal grudges should not color your assessment of his actual technical abilities.
items.ex_zh: 个人恩怨不应为你对他实际技术能力的评估染上主观色彩。
items.ex2_en: His deep childhood memories colored gradually over time with quiet nostalgia and warmth.
items.ex2_zh: 随着时间的流逝，他童年深处的记忆逐渐染上了淡淡的怀旧与温情。

items.def_zh: 使产生偏见；损害（客观性）
items.def_en: Give an unfavorable or preconceived bias toward someone or something before the facts are known
items.ex_en: Sensational press coverage could easily prejudice potential jurors against the accused defendant.
items.ex_zh: 煽动性的媒体报道很容易让潜在陪审员对被告产生偏见。

items.def_en: Distort or cause an assessment, statistic, or perception to be biased or inaccurate
items.ex_en: Unreliable reporting methods will inevitably skew the final statistical results of our survey.
items.ex_zh: 不可靠的报告方式必然会使我们调查的最终统计结果产生偏差。
items.ex2_en: Survey results skew predictably toward older participants when conducted exclusively by landline telephone.
items.ex2_zh: 完全通过固定电话进行的调查，其结果自然会明显偏向年长的受访者。

items.def_zh: 使怀偏见，使心怀嫉妒或愤世嫉俗；使患黄疸
items.def_en: (often passive) To distort one's attitude or view with prejudice, cynicism, or bitterness.
items.ex_en: Decades of relentless betrayal had jaundiced his view of human kindness forever.
items.ex_zh: 数十年不断的背叛，让他对人世间的善意永远抱有偏见与猜忌。

items.def_en: Cause someone's judgment, personality, or understanding to become distorted or abnormal
items.ex_en: Extreme isolation during his early childhood seemed to warp his entire worldview.
items.ex_zh: 童年早期的极度孤独似乎扭曲了他整个人的世界观。
items.ex2_en: His moral judgment warped progressively under the constant corrupting influence of unchecked greed.
items.ex2_zh: 在无法遏制的贪婪的持续侵蚀下，他的道德判断逐渐扭曲。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on internal biases, bitterness, or prior grievances corrupting an agent's perception, judgment, or evaluation. Verbs emphasize how the observer's mind is skewed rather than an external deception.
groups.summary_zh: 指个人偏见、嫉恨或不良经历扭曲客观判断与认知视角。
groups.desc_en: Altering perspective, judgment, or factual representation away from neutrality, contrasting with random error by implying systemic, preconceived, or emotional deflection.
groups.desc_zh: 使认知、判断或事实表述偏离客观中立，与随机误差不同，它特指受固有成见、主观情绪或外部因素影响的系统性歪曲。
groups.nuance_en: color: subtly influence or shade perception through emotion or experience (judgment / view / perception) · skew: systematically pull data or perspective off true balance (data / results / perspective) · warp: contort or pervert thinking into an unnatural shape (mind / sense of reality / perspective) · prejudice: predispose toward an unfair, premature negative appraisal (jury / outcome / mind) · jaundice: tint an outlook with bitterness, cynicism, or envy (eye / outlook / view)
groups.nuance_zh: color: 受主观情感或经验潜移默化地影响判断 (judgment / view / perception) · skew: 使统计数据或视角系统性偏离失真 (data / results / perspective) · warp: 使思维或观念扭曲畸变 (mind / sense of reality / perspective) · prejudice: 使产生先入为主的偏见与不利倾向 (jury / outcome / mind) · jaundice: 因嫉妒或愤世嫉俗而带上有色眼镜 (eye / outlook / view)

groups.name: Bicker & Feud · 口角与争执 (Quarrel, Bicker, Squabble)
groups.tip: 从口角争执激化为公开争端

items.def_en: (+ about/over) To argue peevishly and repeatedly about trivial or unimportant matters
items.ex_en: The roommates constantly bicker over whose turn it is to empty the dishwasher.
items.ex_zh: 室友们经常为该轮到谁去清空洗碗机这种小事斗嘴。

items.def_en: (+ over/about) To engage in a noisy and petty quarrel, typically over something slight
items.ex_en: The children continued to squabble noisily over who would hold the TV remote.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们继续为谁该拿电视遥控器而在那儿吵吵闹闹。

items.def_en: (+ with) To have an angry disagreement with someone and consequently cease friendly relations
items.ex_en: She fell out with her closest colleague after discovering their private emails were shared.
items.ex_zh: 发现自己的私人邮件被分享后，她便与最亲密的同事闹翻了。

items.def_en: (+ with/about/over) To have an angry argument or serious disagreement with someone.
items.ex_en: The couple quarreled bitterly about household finances well into the early morning hours.
items.ex_zh: 夫妻俩就家庭财务开销激烈争吵，一直吵到了凌晨时分。

items.def_en: (+ with) To maintain a prolonged and bitter quarrel, mutual hostility, or dispute over an extended time
items.ex_en: The two rival families feuded openly with each other for nearly three decades.
items.ex_zh: 这两个敌对家族公开结怨争斗了近三十年之久。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate vocal, emotionally charged disagreements and interpersonal spats, frequently revolving around petty matters or longstanding personal grievances.
groups.summary_zh: 指人际间因琐事或旧怨发生的口角争吵、拌嘴或长期不和。
groups.desc_en: Engaging in verbal discord over trivial or entrenched matters, contrasting with rational debate by emphasizing pettiness, chronic irritation, or persistent hostility.
groups.desc_zh: 围绕琐碎或根深蒂固的问题进行言语冲突，与理性辩论不同，它侧重于斤斤计较、口角琐屑或长期宿怨。
groups.nuance_en: bicker: engage in nagging, petty, petulant exchanges (couple / siblings / committee) · squabble: clash noisily over petty trifles or entitlements (children / politicians / roommates) · quarrel: engage in an angry, verbal breach of amicable relations (friends / lovers / neighbors) · feud: maintain prolonged, bitter, often generational hostility (families / clans / factions) · fall out: sever friendship or cooperation over a dispute (friends / partners / colleagues)
groups.nuance_zh: bicker: 为鸡毛蒜皮之事喋喋不休地斗嘴 (couple / siblings / committee) · squabble: 为微小利益嘈杂争吵 (children / politicians / roommates) · quarrel: 愤怒激化并伤及和气的口角争吵 (friends / lovers / neighbors) · feud: 结下长期不解的世仇或宿怨 (families / clans / factions) · fall out: 因争执而闹翻、反目成仇 (friends / partners / colleagues)

groups.name: Bill & Invoice · 开票与计费 (Invoice, Bill, Charge)
groups.tip: 商业交易中的开具账单与收费

items.def_en: To demand an amount of money as a price for a service or commodity
items.ex_en: The clinic will charge an additional fee for emergency weekend consultations.
items.ex_zh: 该诊所将在周末急诊咨询时加收额外费用。

items.def_en: To send a statement of charges to someone for goods or services
items.ex_en: The hospital billed the patient for treatments that were never actually administered.
items.ex_zh: 医院向该病人寄送了其实从未实施过的治疗费用账单。

items.def_en: To calculate or bill a cost or fee owed
items.ex_en: The mechanic reckoned twenty quid for the spare fuse and five minutes of labor.
items.ex_zh: 汽修工算了个账，备用保险丝外加五分钟工时收了二十英镑。

items.def_zh: 开具发票（或发货清单）给……；开发票列出（货物或服务）
items.def_en: (+ for) To send an itemized bill to a customer detailing goods or services provided and requesting payment.
items.ex_en: Our accounting department will invoice the client for all remaining consulting services tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 我们的财务部门明天将就所有剩余的咨询服务向客户开具发票。

items.def_zh: 制表计费；把账单细目化
items.def_en: To arrange financial figures or charges systematically in a table or list
items.ex_en: The auditors tabulated every miscellaneous expense incurred during the international summit.
items.ex_zh: 审计人员将国际峰会期间发生的所有杂项开支逐一制表细化。

groups.summary_en: This commercial communication frame denotes issuing payment demands, itemizing fees, or debiting someone for goods or services delivered.
groups.summary_zh: 开具费用明细清单、发出账单或计收费用。
groups.desc_en: Formally demanding financial settlement or computing owed sums, contrasting with casual asking by involving itemized accounting, transactional tracking, and financial liability.
groups.desc_zh: 正式提出付款要求或核算应付账目，与随意索要不同，它涉及明细清单、交易追踪与法定义务确认。
groups.nuance_en: charge: demand an amount as payment for specific goods/services (fee / customer / rate) · bill: send an itemized notification of payment due (client / patient / customer) · invoice: issue an official commercial document detailing quantities and prices (company / buyer / client) · tabulate: arrange numerical costs systematically in tables or columns (expenses / totals / data) · reckon: calculate or estimate a total sum informally or methodically (cost / damages / bill)
groups.nuance_zh: charge: 索取某项商品或服务的费用 (fee / customer / rate) · bill: 寄送账单以催缴费用 (client / patient / customer) · invoice: 开具正式商业发票或发货清单 (company / buyer / client) · tabulate: 制表列出账目与数据 (expenses / totals / data) · reckon: 估算、核算总账或费用 (cost / damages / bill)

groups.name: Binding Legal Adjudication & Arbitration · 法律仲裁与终局裁决 (Arbitrate, Adjudicate, Judge)
groups.tip: 第三方斡旋调和或权威仲裁

items.def_en: To act as an impartial referee or final authority to enforce rules and resolve contested issues.
items.ex_en: A respected diplomat was selected to umpire the bitter territorial boundary negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 一位受人尊敬的外交官被推选来主审激烈的领土边界谈判。

items.def_en: To officially judge and settle a dispute between two people or groups who cannot agree.
items.ex_en: An independent tribunal agreed to arbitrate the commercial dispute between the two airlines.
items.ex_zh: 一个独立法庭同意仲裁这两家航空公司之间的商业纠纷。

items.def_en: To hear and decide the legal merits of a contested case in a court of law.
items.ex_en: The appellate panel gathered to judge the legal validity of the patent claim.
items.ex_zh: 上诉审判小组齐聚一堂，对该专利主张的法律有效性进行裁断。

items.def_en: (+ on/that) To make an official authoritative legal decision or declaration.
items.ex_en: The high court ruled that the new surveillance law violated the constitution.
items.ex_zh: 最高法院裁定这项新的监控法案违反了宪法。

items.def_en: To make a formal, authoritative, and legally binding judgment on a disputed matter or claim.
items.ex_en: The maritime committee will adjudicate all salvage claims arising from the shipwreck.
items.ex_zh: 海事委员会将对海难引发的所有救助索赔案作出正式裁决。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the binding, authoritative intervention of an authorized tribunal, referee, or designated neutral party who possesses legal power to pronounce a definitive resolution on a conflict.
groups.summary_zh: 指具有法权或受托资格的第三方做出具有约束力的权威断案与终局裁决。
groups.desc_en: Delivering an authoritative, binding determination over a legal dispute or contest, contrasting with casual opinion by carrying formal jurisdictional finality and procedural legitimacy.
groups.desc_zh: 由权威第三方对争议或竞赛做出具有法律约束力或终局效力的裁定，与一般评判不同，它具备程序合法性与强制执行力。
groups.nuance_en: adjudicate: hear evidence to pronounce an official legal ruling (claim / dispute / bankruptcy) · arbitrate: serve as a neutral party to settle a conflict outside formal court (dispute / grievance / strike) · rule: make an authoritative judicial order or definitive finding (on a motion / in favor of / objection) · judge: evaluate evidence and deliver a verdict or competitive assessment (case / contest / defendant) · umpire: preside over a contest to enforce rules and resolve on-field disputes (match / game / dispute)
groups.nuance_zh: adjudicate: 升庭审理并下达裁定 (claim / dispute / bankruptcy) · arbitrate: 作为中立仲裁员进行庭外裁决 (dispute / grievance / strike) · rule: 法官就法律程序或异议做出权威裁定 (on a motion / in favor of / objection) · judge: 审理案件下达判决或评判赛事优劣 (case / contest / defendant) · umpire: 临场执法执裁体育比赛 (match / game / dispute)

groups.name: Birdwatch & Spot · 观鸟与野外搜寻 (Bird, Birdwatch, Spot)
groups.tip: 户外追踪与观测目标

items.def_zh: 在野外发现；辨识出（特定目标物种）
items.def_en: To catch sight of and identify a particular elusive bird or animal in the wild
items.ex_en: We managed to spot a rare peregrine falcon nesting atop the cathedral spire.
items.ex_zh: 我们设法在大教堂尖顶上辨识出了一只筑巢的罕见游隼。

items.def_zh: 观鸟，户外追踪观察鸟类
items.def_en: To observe, track, and identify wild birds in their natural habitats as a hobby.
items.ex_en: Every weekend in spring, enthusiasts bird along the wooded shoreline of the lake.
items.ex_zh: 每年春天的周末，爱好者们都会沿着湖畔树林开展观鸟活动。

items.def_en: To manage to see or catch sight of a rare bird or wildlife specimen
items.ex_en: Rangers sighted an elusive snow leopard prowling near the high mountain ridge yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 护林员昨天在靠近高山山脊的地方目击到了一只行踪隐秘的雪豹。

items.def_zh: 实地侦察；寻觅探索（栖息地或观测点）
items.def_en: To search an area systematically in advance to locate birds, animals, or favorable vantage points
items.ex_en: We must scout out the best wetland perches before the autumn migration starts.
items.ex_zh: 在秋季迁徙开始之前，我们必须先踏勘搜寻出最佳的湿地观测点。

items.def_en: To practice the hobby of observing wild birds in their natural environment
items.ex_en: She loves to birdwatch along the coastal wetlands during early morning hours.
items.ex_zh: 她喜欢清晨时分沿着沿海湿地观察野生鸟类。

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote the hobby or scientific activity of locating, observing, listening to, and cataloging wild animal and bird species in their natural habitats.
groups.summary_zh: 指在自然生境中专门搜寻、辨识并观察野鸟或野生动物。
groups.desc_en: Actively seeking, identifying, and cataloging avian or wild species in natural habitats, contrasting with passive looking by demanding patience, fieldcraft, and taxonomic intention.
groups.desc_zh: 在自然生境中搜寻、识别并记录鸟类或野生动物，与被动观看不同，它强调野外追踪技能、耐心鉴别与物种辨析目的。
groups.nuance_en: birdwatch: observe birds casually or recreationally in nature (in the woods / in the garden / along the coast) · bird: pursue the active, dedicated hobby of identifying species in the field (enthusiasts / experts / year-round) · spot: successfully catch sight of a specific elusive subject (rare species / eagle / nest) · sight: register an official or confirmed visual observation (migrant / condor / bird) · scout out: reconnoiter a location ahead of time to locate wildlife (territory / location / spot)
groups.nuance_zh: birdwatch: 休闲性或作为爱好去野外观鸟 (in the woods / in the garden / along the coast) · bird: 专业、系统地开展野外观鸟及刷种活动 (enthusiasts / experts / year-round) · spot: 在隐蔽环境中眼尖地发现目标 (rare species / eagle / nest) · sight: 确认目击并记录珍稀鸟种 (migrant / condor / bird) · scout out: 提前踩点踩线以搜寻野生动物踪迹 (territory / location / spot)

groups.name: Bite & Sting · 叮咬与蜇刺 (Sting, Bite, Prick)
groups.tip: 昆虫或动物咬刺机体

items.def_en: To make a tiny hole in skin with a sharp point, causing a brief prickling sensation
items.ex_en: A single stray thorn pricked her thumb while she pruned the rosebush.
items.ex_zh: 修剪玫瑰丛时，一根冷不丁伸出的刺扎破了她的拇指。

items.def_en: To bite or pinch someone quickly, lightly, or playfully
items.ex_en: The playful puppy nipped my ankle as I walked toward the back door.
items.ex_zh: 当我走向后门时，那只调皮的小狗轻轻咬了我的脚踝一下。

items.def_en: To cut or pierce skin with teeth, mandibles, or mouthparts
items.ex_en: Swarming mosquitoes bit our exposed skin relentlessly as night fell over the swamp.
items.ex_zh: 夜幕降临沼泽地时，成群的蚊子无情地叮咬着我们裸露的皮肤。

items.def_zh: （昆虫、植物等）蜇，刺；（使）感到刺痛；激怒，使痛苦
items.def_en: 1. (of an insect, plant, or animal) To prick or wound someone with a sharp organ, usually injecting poison. 2. To feel or cause a sharp, burning pain. 3. To upset, hurt, or provoke someone.
items.ex_en: A disturbed hornet can sting you repeatedly without losing its barbed weapon.
items.ex_zh: 受到惊扰的大黄蜂可以反复蜇你，且其毒刺不会脱落。

items.def_en: To introduce venom into a body through a sting or bite
items.ex_en: The serpent swiftly struck, seeking to envenom the intruder's flesh with lethal venom.
items.ex_zh: 毒蛇迅速发起攻击，企图用致命毒液注入入侵者的肉体。

groups.summary_en: Verbs concerning physical puncture of the flesh by insects, snakes, sharp thorns, or barbed apparatuses, often injecting venom or causing acute local pain.
groups.summary_zh: 指昆虫、刺物或毒腺扎入皮肉引起锐痛、红肿或注毒的动作。
groups.desc_en: Inflicting sharp physical trauma using biological mouthparts, pincers, or needles, contrasting with blunt impact by focusing on puncturing surface tissue and optional chemical injection.
groups.desc_zh: 利用口器、毒刺或利齿刺穿生物表皮组织，与钝力打击不同，它强调尖锐创口、刺痛感及可能的毒液注入。
groups.nuance_en: bite: pierce, grip, or sever with teeth or jaws (dog / mosquito / snake) · sting: puncture with a venomous barb or evoke a burning prick (wasp / jellyfish / nettle) · nip: pinch or take a small, quick, sharp bite of (puppy / frost / skin) · prick: pierce slightly with a fine, sharp point (needle / thorn / conscience) · envenom: inject poison directly into tissues through a wound (fang / wound / bite)
groups.nuance_zh: bite: 咬破、撕咬或叮咬 (dog / mosquito / snake) · sting: 用毒刺刺入并产生剧痛或灼痛 (wasp / jellyfish / nettle) · nip: 轻咬、夹咬或微刺 (puppy / frost / skin) · prick: 细针或尖刺微扎 (needle / thorn / conscience) · envenom: 施毒、将毒素注入体内 (fang / wound / bite)

groups.name: Blacklist & Ostracize · 抵制与排斥 (Blacklist, Ostracize, Blackball)
groups.tip: 集体抵制并列入失信黑名单

items.def_en: To deliberately treat someone coldly to force them out of a group or venture.
items.ex_en: Partners conspired to freeze out the founding director after securing fresh venture capital.
items.ex_zh: 合伙人们在获得新的风投资金后，合谋排挤冷落那位创始董事。

items.def_en: 1. To put a person, organization, or country on a blacklist, refusing to employ, trade with, or deal with them.
items.ex_en: The government decided to blacklist the rogue shipping firm for violating environmental sanctions.
items.ex_zh: 政府决定将这家违反环境制裁规定的流氓航运公司列入黑名单。

items.def_en: To deliberately exclude someone from a group, community, or society.
items.ex_en: Villagers chose to ostracize the whistleblower after he exposed the local factory's corruption.
items.ex_zh: 举报人揭露当地工厂的腐败后，村民们选择将他排斥在圈子之外。

items.def_zh: 投弃权/反对票否决，排挤
items.def_en: To vote secretly against admitting someone to an exclusive club or organization.
items.ex_en: Several conservative members conspired to blackball the controversial applicant from the private club.
items.ex_zh: 几位保守派成员暗中合谋，投反对票否决了这位争议申请者的入会资格。

items.def_en: (formal) To officially bar or prevent someone from enjoying a right, office, or privilege.
items.ex_en: Conviction for treason will debar any citizen from holding high public office.
items.ex_zh: 凡被判叛国罪者，均将被正式剥夺担任高级公职的资格。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote institutional or community-driven exclusion, where a person or entity is formally marked, systematically barred, or socially shunned to banish them from a circle or industry.
groups.summary_zh: 通过列入黑名单或群体排挤来剥夺资格与交往机会。
groups.desc_en: Expelling an individual or entity from social, professional, or commercial engagement by collective consensus, contrasting with legal banishment through covert or social ostracism.
groups.desc_zh: 通过集体默契或非正式制裁将某人或机构排除在行业、社交圈或交易之外，与法定流放不同，它体现社群孤立与隐性封杀。
groups.nuance_en: blacklist: place on an official list of individuals barred from employment or trade (actor / company / activist) · ostracize: banish or shun completely from a social group (defector / outcast / nonconformist) · blackball: cast an adverse vote secretly to reject membership (applicant / candidate / club) · freeze out: gradually push aside and exclude from participation or information (colleague / partner / rival) · debar: formally or legally exclude from a right, office, or contest (lawyer / candidate / competitor)
groups.nuance_zh: blacklist: 列入黑名单予以封杀或抵制 (actor / company / activist) · ostracize: 群体性排挤、孤立和排斥 (defector / outcast / nonconformist) · blackball: 投反对票秘密拒绝其加入组织 (applicant / candidate / club) · freeze out: 故意冷落、架空以挤出圈外 (colleague / partner / rival) · debar: 依法或依规剥夺资格或禁止进入 (lawyer / candidate / competitor)

groups.name: Blare & Blast · 高鸣与喧闹 (Blare, Blast, Peal)
groups.tip: 喇叭高亢刺耳轰鸣作响

items.def_en: to produce a prolonged high-pitched shrieking sound, typical of sirens or strong wind
items.ex_en: Police sirens wailed through the deserted city streets in the dead of night.
items.ex_zh: 深夜里，警笛在空无一人的城市街道上尖锐呼啸。

items.def_zh: 发出刺耳尖声；尖声吹响
items.def_en: to make a harsh, loud, grating sound reminiscent of a donkey or metallic horn
items.ex_en: Ancient trumpets brayed harshly across the valley, calling the distant tribes to war.
items.ex_zh: 古老的号角在山谷间发出刺耳的嘶鸣，召唤远方的部落投入战斗。

items.def_en: to sing, play, or produce loud music vigorously with immense force
items.ex_en: The rock band belted out their biggest anthem to twenty thousand roaring fans.
items.ex_zh: 摇滚乐队面向两万名狂热歌迷放声高唱他们最响亮的成名曲。

items.def_en: to emit or play sound at an overwhelming, explosive volume
items.ex_en: Loudspeakers blasted deafening pop music throughout the crowded beachfront festival all afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 整个下午，扬声器都在人头攒动的海滩音乐节上狂放着震耳欲聋的流行乐。

items.def_zh: 高声鸣叫，尖叫；大声播放
items.def_en: To make a very loud, unpleasant sound, or to cause a horn, siren, or radio to sound loudly.
items.ex_en: Car horns blared incessantly as bumper-to-bumper traffic paralyzed the downtown avenue.
items.ex_zh: 首尾相接的车流瘫痪了市中心大街，汽车喇叭刺耳地鸣叫个不停。
items.ex2_en: The angry truck driver blared his loud horn at the stalled vehicle.
items.ex2_zh: 愤怒的卡车司机冲着熄火抛锚的车辆大按响亮的喇叭。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures emission of extraordinarily loud, penetrating, and often jarring noise from horns, speakers, or musical instruments. It contrasts deafening acoustic power with intrusive harshness.
groups.summary_zh: 指喇叭、扩音器或仪器爆发出的刺耳轰鸣、巨响或长鸣。
groups.desc_en: Emitting loud, continuous, and harsh acoustic output, contrasting with musical sound by emphasizing intrusive volume, brassy stridency, or mechanical clamor.
groups.desc_zh: 发出响亮、持续且刺耳的声响，与悦耳的音乐不同，它强调侵入性的高分贝、铜管式高亢或机械喧闹感。
groups.nuance_en: blare: sound loudly, harshly, and brassily through an amplifier or horn (siren / horn / trumpet) · blast: emit a sudden, deafening explosive shock of sound (stereo / speaker / whistle) · wail: utter a prolonged, high-pitched piercing cry or howl (siren / engine / mourner) · bray: make a harsh, grating, donkey-like clamor (laughter / megaphone / instrument) · belt out: sing or produce music forcefully with full vocal power (anthem / tune / ballad)
groups.nuance_zh: blare: 鸣响刺耳、嘹亮的铜管声或喇叭声 (siren / horn / trumpet) · blast: 震耳欲聋地轰鸣或炸响 (stereo / speaker / whistle) · wail: 发出尖厉、凄厉且拉长的鸣响或哀号 (siren / engine / mourner) · bray: 发出难听刺耳的嘶叫或驴鸣声 (laughter / megaphone / instrument) · belt out: 放开嗓门高亢有力地引吭高歌 (anthem / tune / ballad)

groups.name: Blaze & Flame · 熊熊燃烧与喷薄 (Blaze, Flare, Smolder)
groups.tip: 烈火熊熊发出光芒

items.def_en: To burn slowly with dense smoke but without visible flame
items.ex_en: The campfire continued to smolder silently beneath the wet layer of autumn leaves.
items.ex_zh: 潮湿的秋叶层下，营火仍在无声地闷燃。

items.def_en: To produce visible tongues of fire, or burn vigorously with active flames
items.ex_en: The dried firewood suddenly flamed into life as kerosene touched the dry timber.
items.ex_zh: 煤油触及干燥的木材，干燥的柴火顿时化作明火烈烈燃烧。

items.def_en: To burn with a sudden, bright, unsteady flame, or burst abruptly into light
items.ex_en: The gas lantern flared briefly in the sudden draft before flickering out completely.
items.ex_zh: 在骤然吹来的穿堂风中，煤气灯猛地闪烁了一下，随后彻底熄灭。
items.ex2_en: The signal technician flared emergency torches along the runway to guide approaching aircraft.
items.ex2_zh: 信号技术员在跑道沿线点燃应急火炬，以引导正在靠近的飞机。

items.def_zh: 熊熊燃烧；闪耀，发光；怒视
items.def_en: 1. To burn brightly and fiercely with strong flames. 2. If light, color, or anger blazes, it shines with dazzling intensity.
items.ex_en: Dry pine needles blazed fiercely under the scorching midday desert sun.
items.ex_zh: 干燥的松针在正午灼热的沙漠骄阳下熊熊烈烈地燃烧。

items.def_en: To burn with destructive, uncontrolled ferocity over a wide area
items.ex_en: Fierce wildfires continue to rage uncontrollably across the drought-stricken pine forests.
items.ex_zh: 凶猛的野火继续在受旱灾困扰的松树林区失控地肆虐狂燃。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame portray the visual and thermal dynamics of active burning, differentiating between roaring high-intensity infernos, sudden luminous outbursts, and subdued, smokey smoldering.
groups.summary_zh: 描绘火焰的动态燃烧样态，如烈火猛烧、突发迸燃或无焰暗燃。
groups.desc_en: Exhibiting intense, self-sustaining combustion or luminous heat, contrasting with steady burning by emphasizing dynamic behavioral states from suppressed glowing to violent eruption.
groups.desc_zh: 展现剧烈且具自持性的燃烧或炽热放光状态，与平缓燃烧不同，它涵盖从被压抑的暗燃到暴烈失控的多种动态烈度。
groups.nuance_en: blaze: burn with brilliant, vigorous, and prominent light and heat (fire / sun / torch) · flare: burst into a sudden, unsteady, widening flame (match / flare / tempers) · flame: burn visibly with glowing tongues of fire (wood / fuel / cheeks) · smolder: burn slowly with smoke but without flame (embers / ruins / resentment) · rage: spread uncontrollably with destructive fury (wildfire / blaze / storm)
groups.nuance_zh: blaze: 熊熊燃烧并伴有耀眼火光与高温 (fire / sun / torch) · flare: 突然蹿腾起闪耀而不稳定的火焰 (match / flare / tempers) · flame: 吐出明显炽热的火苗 (wood / fuel / cheeks) · smolder: 无明火地闷烧、隐隐作痛或积怨 (embers / ruins / resentment) · rage: 火势失控、肆虐肆暴 (wildfire / blaze / storm)

groups.name: Blemish & Mar Surface/Reputation · 玷污与致瑕 (Blemish, Mar, Taint, Sully)
groups.tip: 损害外观或功能完整

items.def_en: To spoil the appearance, quality, or harmony of something, rendering it imperfect
items.ex_en: One careless scratch on the polished mahogany tabletop marred its otherwise flawless beauty.
items.ex_zh: 抛光红木桌面上一道不经意的刮痕，破坏了它原本毫无瑕疵的完美。

items.def_en: 1. To spoil the appearance, perfection, or reputation of someone or something with a mark or flaw.
items.ex_en: This bribery accusation will surely blemish his otherwise exemplary diplomatic career forever.
items.ex_zh: 这起受贿指控无疑将永久玷污他原本堪称楷模的外交生涯。

items.def_en: To contaminate or corrupt something morally or physically, spoiling its integrity
items.ex_en: The corporate scandal threatened to taint the university's reputation through association.
items.ex_zh: 这起企业丑闻因彼此的关联而可能玷污该大学的声誉。

items.def_en: To damage the purity or integrity of someone's reputation, character, or pristine state
items.ex_en: He refused to sully his pristine honor with such deceitful compromises.
items.ex_zh: 他拒绝用这种欺诈性的妥协来玷污自己纯洁的名誉。

items.def_en: To cause damage or dishonor to someone's good name, honor, or reputation
items.ex_en: Malicious rumors were deliberately circulated to besmirch the minister's upright character.
items.ex_zh: 有人故意散布恶意谣言，企图败坏这位部长正直的人格。

groups.summary_en: This frame refers to spoiling the aesthetic perfection, purity, or pristine reputation of an entity by leaving an indelible physical mark, defect, or moral stain.
groups.summary_zh: 留下小斑痕或污点，损害事物外观完好或声誉清白。
groups.desc_en: Impairing the pristine quality, aesthetic perfection, or integrity of a surface or abstract entity, contrasting with complete destruction by leaving an otherwise intact whole flawed.
groups.desc_zh: 破坏表面或抽象实体的完美性、整洁度或良好状态，与彻底摧毁不同，它是在主体尚存的情况下留下破绽或瑕疵。
groups.nuance_en: mar: detract significantly from perfection, appearance, or enjoyment (record / surface / holiday) · blemish: introduce an isolated defect or mark upon a clear expanse (skin / record / reputation) · taint: contaminate subtly with corruption, disease, or rottenness (evidence / reputation / milk) · sully: stain something morally noble or physically clean (purity / honor / name) · besmirch: smear with disgraceful allegations (good name / integrity / legacy)
groups.nuance_zh: mar: 破坏美感、圆满或扫兴 (record / surface / holiday) · blemish: 留下瑕疵、斑点破坏纯洁平整 (skin / record / reputation) · taint: 遭受微量但致命的污染或变质 (evidence / reputation / milk) · sully: 玷污高尚洁白之物 (purity / honor / name) · besmirch: 泼脏水、丑化名誉与遗产 (good name / integrity / legacy)

groups.name: Blemish & Speckle · 雀斑与瑕疵斑痕 (Blemish, Speckle, Mottled)
groups.tip: 日光照射后皮肤长出浅褐雀斑

items.def_en: to mark or stain a surface with unsightly spots or ink stains
items.ex_en: A leaky fountain pen began to blot the crisp parchment paper.
items.ex_zh: 漏水的钢笔开始在这张平整的羊皮纸上留下污迹。

items.def_en: to become marked, or mark someone's skin, with small brownish spots, especially from exposure to the sun
items.ex_en: Her pale nose and cheeks freckle noticeably during the hot summer.
items.ex_zh: 在炎热的夏天，她苍白的鼻子和脸颊会长出明显的雀斑。
items.ex2_en: Strong ultraviolet rays will freckle pale skin quickly without proper sunscreen protection.
items.ex2_zh: 如果没有适度的防晒保护，强烈的紫外线很快会让白皙的皮肤生出雀斑。

items.def_en: to spoil the flawless appearance or perfection of something with a mark or fault
items.ex_en: A deep scratch threatened to blemish the pristine surface of the mahogany table.
items.ex_zh: 一道深深的划痕破坏了这张红木桌原本无瑕的表面。

items.def_en: to mark a surface with many small dots or patches of color
items.ex_en: Tiny brown spots speckle the delicate petals of the rare mountain orchid.
items.ex_zh: 细小的褐色斑点点缀着这种罕见高山兰花娇嫩的花瓣。

items.def_en: to mark with spots, blotches, or streaks of different colors or shades
items.ex_en: Cold winds began to mottle her pale hands with purplish blotches.
items.ex_zh: 寒风开始使她苍白的手上浮现出斑驳的紫斑。

groups.summary_en: Verbs describing marking, spotting, or disfiguring skin or smooth surfaces with tiny pigmentations, scars, spots, or imperfections.
groups.summary_zh: 指皮肤或物体表面长出小雀斑、斑点或瑕疵。
groups.desc_en: Interrupting uniform surface pigmentation or texture with irregular dots, patches, or spots, contrasting with smooth coating by focusing on variegated visual imperfection.
groups.desc_zh: 在均匀的表面覆上不规则的斑点、斑纹或污渍，与平整涂刷不同，它聚焦于斑驳错落的视觉斑纹与瑕疵分布。
groups.nuance_en: speckle: sprinkle with numerous tiny, scattered dots of color (egg / leaf / skin) · mottle: mark with irregular blotches of different shades or colors (skin / marble / sunlight) · freckle: develop small brownish pigmentation spots from sun exposure (nose / cheeks / face) · blot: mark with a heavy, spreading stain or drop of fluid (ink / page / landscape) · blemish: create a visible physical flaw on a smooth skin or coat (fruit / complexion / pearl)
groups.nuance_zh: speckle: 布满细碎斑点 (egg / leaf / skin) · mottle: 形成杂色斑驳或网状纹理 (skin / marble / sunlight) · freckle: 长出雀斑或晒斑 (nose / cheeks / face) · blot: 滴下浓重晕染的墨水或大块污渍 (ink / page / landscape) · blemish: 使平滑表面产生明显的瑕疵或疤痕 (fruit / complexion / pearl)

groups.name: Blind & Obscure · 遮蔽与致盲 (Dazzle, Obscure, Shroud)
groups.tip: 阻隔光线剥夺视线能力

items.def_en: To prevent something from being seen or heard clearly by covering or blocking it
items.ex_en: Dense smog descended rapidly to obscure the panoramic view of the harbor.
items.ex_zh: 浓重的雾霾迅速笼罩下来，遮蔽了港口的全景。

items.def_en: To blind temporarily by an excess of light
items.ex_en: The high beams of approaching trucks dazzle motorists on unlit country roads.
items.ex_zh: 在没有路灯的乡村道路上，迎面卡车开的远光灯会晃得驾驶员目眩。

items.def_en: To extinguish all lights or cover all windows to prevent light from being seen
items.ex_en: He blacked out for a few seconds after hitting his head on the doorframe.
items.ex_zh: 他的头撞在门框上后昏厥了数秒。

items.def_zh: 使失明；使目眩，使眩晕；蒙蔽，使失去判断力
items.def_en: 1. To make someone permanently or temporarily unable to see. 2. (of light) To dazzle someone so they cannot see clearly. 3. To make someone unable to understand or perceive things clearly.
items.ex_en: The blinding afternoon glare through the windshield forced him to brake suddenly.
items.ex_zh: 透过挡风玻璃射入的刺眼午后强光迫使他猛踩刹车。

items.def_zh: 掩饰，遮盖（如被浓雾或阴影笼罩）
items.def_en: To cover or hide something so that it cannot be clearly seen, like a shroud or thick mist
items.ex_en: Perpetual mountain mists shroud the ancient monastery from the valleys below.
items.ex_zh: 终年不散的山雾将这座古老修道院遮蔽，使山谷下的人无法看清。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe depriving someone of vision or rendering an object invisible, either by overpowering light, dense visual barriers, or deliberate concealment.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过强光眩目或浓密遮蔽物使人失明或使物隐没。
groups.desc_en: Preventing visual clarity or cognitive discernment through overwhelming light, physical barriers, or concealment, contrasting with natural darkness by implying active hindrance.
groups.desc_zh: 通过过量强光、物理屏障或遮挡物阻断视觉清晰度或认知辨别，与自然黑暗不同，它强调主动性的致盲或掩盖。
groups.nuance_en: dazzle: temporarily blind or overpower sight with excessively brilliant light (headlights / sunlight / display) · blind: deprive of eyesight permanently or make unable to perceive truth (flash / prejudice / tears) · obscure: make indistinct, difficult to see, or dim (fog / view / meaning) · shroud: wrap and completely envelop in concealing secrecy or mist (fog / mystery / darkness) · black out: plunge into total darkness or suppress coverage entirely (city / broadcast / memory)
groups.nuance_zh: dazzle: 强光刺眼致使眩目目眩 (headlights / sunlight / display) · blind: 使失明、致盲或利令智昏 (flash / prejudice / tears) · obscure: 遮蔽视线、使模糊不清 (fog / view / meaning) · shroud: 如裹尸布般笼罩掩盖 (fog / mystery / darkness) · black out: 全面断电断光或信息封锁 (city / broadcast / memory)

groups.name: Blind Feeling & Tactile Exploration · 盲目摸索与探路 (Grope, Feel, Fumble)
groups.tip: 在黑暗中用手盲目摸索

items.def_en: Search widely and urgently in various directions using touch or sight
items.ex_en: He cast about in the darkness, seeking any sign of a familiar path.
items.ex_zh: 他在黑暗中四下摸索搜寻，想要找到一丝熟悉的路径痕迹。

items.def_en: Move forward slowly and carefully by touching surfaces rather than seeing clearly
items.ex_en: She had to feel her way along the pitch-black corridor toward the exit.
items.ex_zh: 她不得不顺着漆黑的走廊摸索前进，朝出口走去。

items.def_zh: 摸索，盲目触摸；乱摸（猥亵）
items.def_en: 1. To feel about blindly or hesitantly with the hands, as in the dark. 2. (informal) To touch someone sexually without their consent.
items.ex_en: He had to grope along the wall to find the light switch.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不在墙上胡乱摸索以找到电灯开关。

items.def_en: Move or climb hurriedly using both hands and feet over rough or unfamiliar ground
items.ex_en: We had to scramble over wet rocks using both hands and feet.
items.ex_zh: 我们不得不手脚并用，跌跌撞撞地爬过湿滑的岩石。

items.def_en: Touch or handle someone or something clumsily, roughly, or repeatedly
items.ex_en: The drunken customer began to paw awkwardly at the bartender's sleeve.
items.ex_zh: 那个醉酒的顾客开始笨手笨脚地乱抓酒保的衣袖。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on feeling around blindly, hesitantly, or in darkness using the hands or feet to navigate or locate an object without visual guidance.
groups.summary_zh: 强调在黑暗或视线受阻时，用手或脚犹豫、盲目地探寻摸索。
groups.desc_en: Navigating or seeking physically without the aid of vision, relying on tentative, awkward tactile sensory input, contrasting with deliberate grasping through clumsiness and uncertainty.
groups.desc_zh: 在缺乏视觉辅助的情况下仅凭触觉进行试探性搜寻或前行，与从容抓取不同，它侧重于摸黑探路的笨拙、犹疑与不确定性。
groups.nuance_en: grope: search or feel about hesitantly with hands in the dark (in the dark / for a light switch / toward the door) · fumble: handle awkwardly and nervously with trembling or clumsy fingers (with keys / for words / in one's pocket) · feel one's way: advance cautiously by testing each step through touch (through the corridor / down the steps / in the fog) · paw: feel, touch, or handle clumsily or inappropriately (through papers / at clothes / with hands) · cast about: search around mentally or physically in various directions (for an answer / for a solution / for help)
groups.nuance_zh: grope: 在黑暗中迟疑地摸索前进或搜寻 (in the dark / for a light switch / toward the door) · fumble: 笨手笨脚、慌乱失手地摸索 (with keys / for words / in one's pocket) · feel one's way: 步步试探摸索前行 (through the corridor / down the steps / in the fog) · paw: 粗鲁、笨拙或不敬地乱抓乱摸 (through papers / at clothes / with hands) · cast about: 四处物色、苦思冥想寻找途径 (for an answer / for a solution / for help)

groups.name: Blitz & Storm · 闪击与突袭强攻 (Blitz, Storm, Ambush)
groups.tip: 以闪电般极快速度发起猛扑

items.def_en: To descend or pounce upon a target suddenly in a surprise raid or assault
items.ex_en: Federal agents prepared to swoop on the warehouse at dawn.
items.ex_zh: 联邦探员准备在黎明时分对该仓库进行突击搜捕。

items.def_en: To attack an unsuspecting enemy unexpectedly from a concealed position
items.ex_en: Guerilla fighters planned to ambush the supply convoy inside the narrow mountain gorge.
items.ex_zh: 游击队员计划在狭窄的山谷内埋伏突袭补给车队。

items.def_en: To attack and enter a fortified place with a sudden, violent, coordinated rush
items.ex_en: Riot police prepared to storm the barricaded entrance of the occupied building.
items.ex_zh: 防暴警察准备强行攻占被占领大楼那筑有路障的入口。

items.def_en: To attack continuously with heavy artillery fire, missiles, or aerial bombs
items.ex_en: Heavy artillery batteries continue to bombard defensive positions outside the city center.
items.ex_zh: 重型炮兵连持续密集炮击市中心外围的防御阵地。

items.def_zh: 以闪电战袭击，闪击；密集轰炸；突击攻克
items.def_en: 1. To attack with a sudden, overwhelming military assault or heavy bombardment. 2. (informal) To deal with or complete something with sudden, concentrated energy.
items.ex_en: Enemy jet fighters blitzed the naval base with overwhelming airstrikes overnight.
items.ex_zh: 敌方喷气式战机连夜对海军基地进行了压倒性的密集轰炸。

groups.summary_en: This military and tactical frame characterizes launching sudden, furious, and overwhelming offensive strikes against an enemy position before defenses can react. It emphasizes rapidity, shock value, and devastating force.
groups.summary_zh: 指采取出其不意、迅雷不及掩耳的密集火力或突袭攻克目标。
groups.desc_en: Executing an abrupt, concentrated, and overwhelming offensive assault against a position or target, contrasting with attrition warfare by prioritizing lightning speed and decisive violence.
groups.desc_zh: 对特定目标发起突然、集中且具有压倒性威力的进攻，与持久消耗战不同，它强调极高的突袭速度、强攻烈度与破防能力。
groups.nuance_en: blitz: launch an overwhelming, concentrated rapid attack (city / defense / market) · storm: assault and breach a fortified place with sudden massed fury (bastille / building / capital) · ambush: attack by surprise from a concealed, waiting position (convoy / patrol / troops) · swoop on: drop suddenly out of the sky or distance to seize (prey / suspect / hideout) · bombard: attack continuously with artillery shells or rapid-fire demands (position / city / questions)
groups.nuance_zh: blitz: 闪击作战、雷霆突袭 (city / defense / market) · storm: 强攻破城、一鼓作气冲破据点 (bastille / building / capital) · ambush: 设伏伏击、隐蔽突袭 (convoy / patrol / troops) · swoop on: 猛扑、俯冲抓捕 (prey / suspect / hideout) · bombard: 持续炮轰或轰炸轰击 (position / city / questions)

groups.name: Blob & Splotch · 斑污与块滴 (Splotch, Smear, Daub)
groups.tip: 溅落污物留下斑块弄脏

items.def_en: To mark, stain, or spot a surface with drops of ink, paint, or liquid
items.ex_en: A clumsy slip caused black ink to blot the freshly signed contract.
items.ex_zh: 一时笨拙失手导致黑墨水溅污了刚签好的合同。

items.def_zh: 使留有斑迹，溅污；把……抹成团状
items.def_en: To mark or stain a surface with a thick drop of liquid or paint; to form into thick, shapeless drops.
items.ex_en: He carelessly blobed thick yellow tempera paint across the clean canvas.
items.ex_zh: 他马马虎虎地把厚厚的黄色蛋彩颜料抹成一团，溅污了干净的画布。
items.ex2_en: Thick droplets of melted wax blobed messily onto the polished mahogany desk.
items.ex2_zh: 浓稠的融化蜡液乱糟糟地滴落在抛光的红木书桌上形成一块块斑迹。

items.def_en: To mark or cover a surface with irregular, messy patches of liquid or color
items.ex_en: Oil drips began to splotch the concrete floor beneath the damaged engine.
items.ex_zh: 受损引擎下方滴下的机油开始在混凝土地面上形成块块污斑。

items.def_en: To spread a thick, greasy, or sticky substance over a surface carelessly
items.ex_en: The clumsy toddler managed to smear grease across the clean glass door.
items.ex_zh: 那个笨拙的蹒跚幼童把油渍蹭得干净的玻璃门上到处都是。

items.def_en: To apply paint, mud, or grease quickly, crudely, or thickly to a surface
items.ex_en: Workers daub thick waterproof tar onto the damp foundation walls before backfilling.
items.ex_zh: 工人们在回填前把厚厚的防水焦油粗糙地抹在潮湿的地基墙上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to applying or marking a surface with thick, viscous liquid or pigment, creating messy drops, patches, or smears.
groups.summary_zh: 用粘稠液体或涂料在表面涂抹、滴落出斑块或厚重污迹。
groups.desc_en: Applying or depositing thick, viscous substances unevenly onto a surface, contrasting with meticulous painting by resulting in crude, messy drops and streaks.
groups.desc_zh: 将浓稠、黏性液体或颜料不均匀地涂抹、滴溅于表面，与精细绘画不同，它强调粗糙、杂乱或厚重的斑渍沉淀。
groups.nuance_en: smear: spread a greasy, wet substance across a surface messily (butter / paint / blood) · daub: apply paste, mud, or thick paint crudely and unskilfully (mud / ointment / paint) · blob: drop or form rounded, thick droplets of liquid (paint / glue / ink) · splotch: make an irregular, messy patch of liquid discoloration (ink / ketchup / mud) · blot: produce an absorbent, spreading circular stain (ink / page / tear)
groups.nuance_zh: smear: 乱涂乱抹黏稠油腻之物形成污迹 (butter / paint / blood) · daub: 粗劣、笨拙地涂抹泥浆或药膏 (mud / ointment / paint) · blob: 滴落形成厚重圆块或团滴 (paint / glue / ink) · splotch: 溅出大块不规则斑斑点点 (ink / ketchup / mud) · blot: 浸染渗透出墨渍斑痕 (ink / page / tear)

groups.name: Bloom & Blossom · 开花与繁盛 (Blossom, Flower, Thrive)
groups.tip: 生命由小变大繁衍兴旺

items.def_en: Produce blossoms or develop fully to reach an optimum state
items.ex_en: Her natural talent began to flower under the patient guidance of her mentor.
items.ex_zh: 在导师的悉心指导下，她的天赋开始充分展现并走向成熟。

items.def_en: Unfurl petals or blossoms into full display
items.ex_en: The fragile morning glory petals open up as soon as sunlight hits them.
items.ex_zh: 娇嫩的牵牛花瓣在阳光照射到的那一刻便舒展开来。

items.def_zh: 开花；繁荣，兴旺，容光焕发
items.def_en: 1. When a plant blooms, it produces flowers. 2. To develop, flourish, or become healthy and successful.
items.ex_en: Thousands of cherry trees bloom across the riverside park every April.
items.ex_zh: 每年四月，成千上万棵樱花树在滨河公园盛开。

items.def_en: Produce flowers, or develop into something healthy, promising, or beautiful
items.ex_en: Their small bakery began to blossom into a remarkably lucrative nationwide franchise.
items.ex_zh: 他们的小面包店开始繁盛发展为利润极为丰厚的全国性连锁店。

items.def_en: Begin to grow rapidly or flourish vigorously
items.ex_en: New technology startups continue to burgeon across the vibrant metropolitan tech corridor.
items.ex_zh: 新兴科技初创企业在这条充满活力的都市科技走廊中持续蓬勃涌现。

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote the emergence of floral buds and vegetative vitality, extending to periods of peak health, radiance, and thriving potential. 'Bloom' and 'blossom' share literal floral stages and figurative developmental flourish.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重植物绽放花朵，或事物进入旺盛繁荣阶段。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the botanical opening of buds into flowers, extended metaphorically to organic reaching of peak beauty, vigor, or rapid flourishing, unlike mere mechanical expansion or numeric growth.
groups.desc_zh: 指植物花苞绽放的生物学过程，隐喻式引申为人或事物达到极盛、健康繁盛的完满状态，区别于机械式扩张或纯粹数量增长。
groups.nuance_en: flower: attain full maturity and optimal aesthetic or intellectual state (talent / art / civilization) · bloom: produce actual blossoms or radiate healthy peak vitality (roses / cheeks / romance) · blossom: open into fruitful maturity with rich future promise (friendship / career / genius) · burgeon: expand rapidly with vigorous outward proliferation (demand / population / trade) · open up: unfold physical petals or reveal latent expressive potential (buds / opportunities / talents)
groups.nuance_zh: flower: 达到成熟鼎盛的精神或艺术状态 (talent / art / civilization) · bloom: 鲜花绽放或容光焕发呈最佳状态 (roses / cheeks / romance) · blossom: 结出硕果般成熟发展且极具前景 (friendship / career / genius) · burgeon: 萌芽式迅速膨胀与爆发性激增 (demand / population / trade) · open up: 花瓣舒展或潜能展露展开 (buds / opportunities / talents)

groups.name: Board & Glide · 滑行器械乘骑 (Skateboard, Rollerblade, Glide)
groups.tip: 踩滑板或操纵车辆行进

items.def_en: To glide smoothly over ice or hard ground wearing ice skates or roller skates
items.ex_en: Children skate happily across the frozen municipal pond during winter holidays.
items.ex_zh: 寒假期间，孩子们在结冰的市政池塘上欢快地滑冰。

items.def_en: To move continuously, smoothly, and effortlessly along a polished or frozen surface
items.ex_en: The luxury sedan seemed to glide effortlessly across the freshly paved highway.
items.ex_zh: 那辆豪华轿车似乎毫不费力地在刚铺好的高速公路上平稳滑移。

items.def_en: To ride or perform tricks on a skateboard.
items.ex_en: Local teenagers gather every weekend to skateboard down the steep concrete ramps.
items.ex_zh: 当地青少年每周末都会聚在一起，沿着陡峭的混凝土坡道玩滑板。

items.def_en: To glide down snow-covered slopes while standing strapped onto a single wide board
items.ex_en: Enthusiasts travel to the Alps each winter to snowboard on pristine powder.
items.ex_zh: 滑雪爱好者们每年冬天都会前往阿尔卑斯山，在纯净的粉雪上玩单板滑雪。

items.def_en: To skate on flat pavement using boots fitted with a single central line of wheels
items.ex_en: Fitness enthusiasts love to rollerblade along the scenic oceanfront boardwalk every evening.
items.ex_zh: 健身爱好者们喜欢每天傍晚沿着风景优美的海滨木板路滑直排轮。

groups.summary_en: This recreational locomotion frame covers riding, steering, and performing maneuvers on wheeled boards, skates, or similar non-motorized gliders, focusing on body balance and surface cruising.
groups.summary_zh: 指脚踩滑板、滑轮鞋等滑行板械依靠重心与推蹬移动并展示技巧。
groups.desc_en: Covers propelled or self-balanced traversal over solid, frozen, or paved surfaces using specialized wheeled or bladed equipment, distinguished from generic walking, running, or driving.
groups.desc_zh: 指脚踩带轮或带刃的专门器械在地面或冰雪上滑行穿越的运动方式，区别于徒步奔跑或驾驶机动车辆。
groups.nuance_en: skate: traverse ice or paved surfaces using blades or quad wheels (ice / rink / pond) · glide: move effortlessly and smoothly without audible friction or propulsion effort (hawk / skater / dancer) · skateboard: navigate urban obstacles or ramps standing sideways on a four-wheeled board (ramp / street / bowl) · snowboard: descend snow-covered slopes strapped to a single wide board (slopes / powder / mountain) · rollerblade: skate on paved surfaces using inline wheels for speed or fitness (promenade / pavement / trail)
groups.nuance_zh: skate: 穿冰刀或四轮滑冰鞋滑行 (ice / rink / pond) · glide: 丝滑无阻地顺畅滑过 (hawk / skater / dancer) · skateboard: 踩四轮滑板在街头或U型池滑行 (ramp / street / bowl) · snowboard: 双脚固定在单板上滑雪下山 (slopes / powder / mountain) · rollerblade: 穿单排轮滑鞋在路面滑行刷街 (promenade / pavement / trail)

groups.name: Boat & Traverse Water · 航行与驾舟 (Sail, Ferry, Canoe)
groups.tip: 乘风破浪驾船出行

items.def_zh: 乘船航行，划船；用船运载
items.def_en: 1. to travel, sail, or row in a boat for pleasure or transport 2. to carry or transport people or goods in a boat
