items.ex_en: The wealthy couple decided to boat along the picturesque Mediterranean coast.
items.ex_zh: 这对富有的夫妇决定乘船游览风景如画的地中海海岸。

items.def_en: to travel in or drive a motorized boat across water
items.ex_en: They decided to motor across the calm bay toward the secluded island.
items.ex_zh: 他们决定驾驶机动艇穿越平静的海湾，驶向那座僻静的小岛。

items.def_en: to transport passengers or goods across a body of water in a boat
items.ex_en: Small wooden vessels ferry travelers across the swollen river every morning.
items.ex_zh: 每天早晨，小木船都会摆渡运送旅客横渡水流暴涨的河流。

items.def_zh: 划独木舟，乘独木舟旅行
items.def_en: to travel or recreate on water in a light, narrow canoe
items.ex_en: We decided to canoe down the gentle river during our weekend camping trip.
items.ex_zh: 在周末露营旅行期间，我们决定划独木舟顺着平缓的河流而下。

items.def_en: to travel or paddle across rivers or coastal waters in a kayak
items.ex_en: Adventurers often kayak through rough coastal swells near the rugged northern cliffs.
items.ex_zh: 探险者经常划着皮划艇穿过北部崎岖悬崖附近的汹涌海浪。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers traveling over water specifically by waterborne craft, highlighting waterborne transport, leisure outings on small vessels, or conveying passengers across riverine passages.
groups.summary_zh: 泛指乘船、驾舟或摆渡穿过水体水域。
groups.desc_en: Relates to navigating or traversing bodies of water using small-to-medium vessels, differing from high-seas shipping or swimming by focusing on boat-handling and aquatic passage.
groups.desc_zh: 指使用中小船艇在水面航行、穿梭或摆渡的动作，区别于远洋巨轮航运或徒手游泳。
groups.nuance_en: boat: travel across water leisurely in a small vessel (lake / river / bay) · motor: propel a vessel using an internal combustion engine rather than wind or oars (harbor / bay / coast) · ferry: transport passengers or vehicles systematically back and forth across water (commuters / cars / supplies) · canoe: paddle an open, lightweight double-ended boat (river / lake / rapids) · kayak: maneuver a low-profile decked vessel using a double-bladed paddle (whitewater / sea / fjord)
groups.nuance_zh: boat: 泛舟或乘小船游历 (lake / river / bay) · motor: 依赖发动机马达驾艇航行 (harbor / bay / coast) · ferry: 摆渡定点往返输送人与车 (commuters / cars / supplies) · canoe: 用单叶桨划开敞式独木舟 (river / lake / rapids) · kayak: 用双叶桨操纵封闭式皮划艇 (whitewater / sea / fjord)

groups.name: Bond with Adhesives · 强力粘合与封胶 (Epoxy, Resinate, Sealant-bond)
groups.tip: 用强力树脂胶水硬化粘结

items.def_en: To close, fasten, or bind joints tightly using a cohesive or adhesive substance to exclude air or moisture
items.ex_en: Apply waterproof silicone to seal the gap between the bathtub and tile.
items.ex_zh: 涂抹防水硅胶以密封浴缸和瓷砖之间的缝隙。

items.def_zh: 涂树脂粘合，用树脂浸渍处理
items.def_en: To coat, reinforce, or join structural components together using hard synthetic or natural resin
items.ex_en: Technicians resin the composite carbon fibers to enhance the hull's overall structural strength.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员用树脂浸渍碳纤维复合材料，以增强船体的整体结构强度。

items.def_en: To join different materials into an inseparable unit through chemical dissolution or thermal adhesion
items.ex_en: High heat was applied to fuse the two synthetic polymer strips together.
items.ex_zh: 施加高温使这两根合成聚合物条牢固地熔结为一体。
items.ex2_en: The cracked metal joints fused seamlessly under intense heat inside the furnace.
items.ex2_zh: 开裂的金属接头在熔炉内的极度高温下天衣无缝地熔合在一起。

items.def_en: To bond layers of material firmly together under heat, pressure, or adhesive coating
items.ex_en: The factory uses heavy rollers to laminate protective plastic onto sheet metal.
items.ex_zh: 该工厂使用重型辊轴将保护性塑料薄膜压接在金属薄板上。

items.def_en: 1. To glue or bond surfaces together using strong synthetic epoxy resin.
items.ex_en: Mechanics often epoxy broken carbon fiber panels back into place securely.
items.ex_zh: 机械师经常用环氧树脂将断裂的碳纤维板牢固地粘回原位。

groups.summary_en: This technical frame centers on fixing, bonding, or embedding solid substrates using specialized chemical resins, thermo-curing compounds, or high-tensile glues. Focus is placed on structural and craft application.
groups.summary_zh: 利用专用树脂胶、密封剂或强效化学粘合剂牢固拼接两块基质。
groups.desc_en: Specifies uniting materials or securing seams using chemical bonding agents, resins, or thermal matrices, distinct from mechanical fastening like nailing or screwing.
groups.desc_zh: 指利用化学胶粘剂、树脂或热熔介质使物料永久接合或密封的过程，区别于钉铆等机械物理固定。
groups.nuance_en: seal: close hermetically against ingress of air, moisture, or dust (joint / seam / container) · resin: impregnate or bond structural fibers using synthetic resin (fiberglass / carbon / composite) · fuse: melt together into a unified indivisible mass through heat or chemical dissolution (materials / joints / plastic) · laminate: bond multiple overlapping thin sheets together under pressure and adhesive (wood / glass / document) · epoxy: secure heavy-duty joints using rigid thermosetting polymer resin (metal / concrete / tile)
groups.nuance_zh: seal: 严密胶封接缝防止渗漏 (joint / seam / container) · resin: 浸注树脂强化粘接 (fiberglass / carbon / composite) · fuse: 熔化合为不可分割的一体 (materials / joints / plastic) · laminate: 层压覆膜贴合多层片材 (wood / glass / document) · epoxy: 用环氧树脂高强固化胶合 (metal / concrete / tile)

groups.name: Boning & Meat Dressing · 去骨与剔肉 (Debone, Bone, Dress)
groups.tip: 沿骨剔除鱼肉或剥离表面

items.def_en: Remove the outer skin or hide from an animal or piece of meat
items.ex_en: The experienced hunter hung the deer to skin the hide carefully.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的猎人将鹿悬挂起来，小心地剥下兽皮。

items.def_en: Take out the bones from raw meat or fish
items.ex_en: The apprentice chef learned how to bone chicken breasts quickly and cleanly.
items.ex_zh: 学徒厨师学会了如何干净利落地快速剔除鸡胸肉的骨头。

items.def_en: Remove the entrails and internal organs from a fish or slaughtered animal
items.ex_en: Fishermen stand on the docks to gut the fresh catch immediately.
items.ex_zh: 渔民们站在码头上，立即将刚捕获的新鲜渔获开膛去内脏。

items.def_zh: 剔去（鱼、肉的）骨头，把……切成无骨肉片
items.def_en: To remove the bones from fish or meat.
items.ex_en: He watched the sushi master fillet the fresh salmon with razor precision.
items.ex_zh: 他看着寿司师傅以极其精准的手法剔去新鲜三文鱼的骨头并切片。

items.def_en: Remove bones from meat, poultry, or fish before cooking
items.ex_en: Use a sharp paring knife to debone the turkey thighs before roasting.
items.ex_zh: 烘烤前，用锋利的削皮刀剔除火鸡大腿上的骨头。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this culinary manipulation frame describe removing the bones, skeleton, or unwanted carcass sections from fish or meat to prepare prime cuts. Fillet specifically prepares long boneless slabs, debone is the generic term, and gut strips viscera.
groups.summary_zh: 烹饪前从肉类或鱼身上去除骨头、骨架或内脏处理。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to the butchering, eviscerating, and structural dressing of animal carcasses for culinary preparation, distinct from generic cutting, chopping, or cooking.
groups.desc_zh: 指对宰杀后的禽畜鱼肉进行开膛、剔骨、去皮等专业初加工，区别于一般切块烹饪。
groups.nuance_en: skin: strip the external hide or pelt completely from the carcass (rabbit / deer / carcass) · gut: extract internal organs and entrails cleanly (fish / fowl / deer) · fillet: slice flesh cleanly away from central skeletal spine into boneless slabs (salmon / beef / fish) · bone: manually strip meat from bones or disarticulate skeletal frame (meat / ham / poultry) · debone: commercially or systematically remove all bones from a piece of meat (chicken / turkey / steak)
groups.nuance_zh: skin: 剥除整张生皮或外皮 (rabbit / deer / carcass) · gut: 开膛取出内脏器官 (fish / fowl / deer) · fillet: 剔除主刺脊骨切成无骨肉柳或鱼片 (salmon / beef / fish) · bone: 厨用手工剔肉留骨或卸骨 (meat / ham / poultry) · debone: 系统性剔净全部骨头 (chicken / turkey / steak)

groups.name: Boo & Heckle · 起哄与喝倒彩 (Boo, Heckle, Howl down)
groups.tip: 现场发出嘘声与嘲笑表达不满

items.raw_cluster: 喝倒彩与嘘声 Jeer & Boo
items.def_zh: 向……喝倒彩，发嘘声；发出嘘声
items.def_en: To shout 'boo' at a performer, speaker, or team to show disapproval or contempt.
items.ex_en: Hostile spectators began to boo the controversial referee after the questionable penalty.
items.ex_zh: 在出现争议判罚后，充满敌意的观众开始向这名裁判大喝倒彩。

items.def_zh: 大声起哄抗议（尤指观众）
items.def_en: To shout continuous jeers or hostile remarks at a team or speaker
items.ex_en: Frustrated spectators began to barrack the visiting team throughout the entire second half.
items.ex_zh: 情绪沮丧的观众在整个下半场不停地向客队大声起哄抗议。

items.def_en: To provoke or challenge someone with insulting, contemptuous remarks
items.ex_en: Rival fans continued to taunt the defeated striker as he left the field.
items.ex_zh: 当失利的前锋离场时，对手球迷不断对他进行辱骂与冷嘲热讽。

items.def_en: To interrupt a speaker or performer with aggressive, challenging, or derisive comments
items.ex_en: Angry demonstrators repeatedly heckled the politician throughout his televised policy speech.
items.ex_zh: 在政客进行电视政策演讲期间，愤怒的示威者频频起哄打断他。

items.def_zh: 狂吼压制，怒吼倒彩使闭嘴
items.def_en: To prevent someone from speaking by shouting or yelling loudly in protest
items.ex_en: Furious protesters managed to howl down the mayor before he could begin speaking.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的抗议者在市长开口讲话之前就狂吼抗议，硬生生将他压制了下去。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame capture vocal, disruptive public contempt aimed at silencing or deriding speakers, athletes, or stage performers. The sounds range from full-throated communal boos to organized, aggressive taunts.
groups.summary_zh: 大声喧哗起哄或质问打断，迫使台上者退场或难堪。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on vocal, disparaging crowd interruptions intended to disrupt, humiliate, or silence a performer or speaker, contrasting with structured debate or orderly criticism.
groups.desc_zh: 指群体以起哄、喝倒彩等喧嚣噪音打断、嘲弄并压制台上发言者或表演者，区别于有序辩论或建设性批评。
groups.nuance_en: boo: utter deep collective vocal sounds expressing contempt or disapproval (speaker / referee / actor) · barrack: persistently shout jeering or unsupportive interruptions in Commonwealth sporting contexts (team / player / politician) · taunt: provoke deliberately with insolent, sarcastic jibes (opponent / rival / prisoner) · heckle: disrupt an orator with aggressive continuous questions or jibes (politician / performer / lecturer) · howl down: shout with overwhelming noise to prevent someone being heard at all (speaker / proposal / opposition)
groups.nuance_zh: boo: 发出嘘声倒彩以示反感 (speaker / referee / actor) · barrack: 持续高声起哄喝倒彩 (team / player / politician) · taunt: 挑衅性嘲讽讥笑 (opponent / rival / prisoner) · heckle: 连环插话刁难打断演讲 (politician / performer / lecturer) · howl down: 怒吼起哄彻底盖过讲话声 (speaker / proposal / opposition)

groups.name: Boomerang & Retribution · 自食恶果与因果反噬 (Boomerang, Blow Back, Reap)
groups.tip: 行为如回旋镖般反弹发生

items.def_zh: 反咬一口，产生报复性恶果
items.def_en: to react aggressively against someone or produce subsequent unexpected harms
items.ex_en: She felt a surge of anger, but bit back the sharp reply on the tip of her tongue.
items.ex_zh: 她感到一阵怒意上涌，但硬生生把到了嘴边的尖锐反驳咽了回去。

items.def_zh: 产生逆风回火，引火烧身
items.def_en: to cause negative and unintended blowback for the original instigators
items.ex_en: Their aggressive smear campaign threatened to blow back on their own candidate.
items.ex_zh: 他们咄咄逼人的抹黑行动极有可能引火烧身，反噬自己的候选人。

items.def_zh: 回头困扰，自食过去留下的恶果
items.def_en: to return later in time as an unavoidable problem or karmic consequence for past actions
items.ex_en: Those hasty budget cuts will definitely come back to haunt the agency later.
items.ex_zh: 那些仓促推行的预算削减日后必定会反弹成不可避免的恶果困扰该机构。

items.def_zh: 自食其果，种瓜得瓜种豆得豆
items.def_en: to inevitably endure the negative repercussions created by one's own previous choices
items.ex_en: Corrupt officials will inevitably reap what they sow when the investigation concludes.
items.ex_zh: 当调查结束时，腐败官员们势必会自食其恶果。

items.def_en: (+ on) to produce an unexpected and harmful recoil or negative result on the person who initiated the action
items.ex_en: His malicious schemes are bound to boomerang on him sooner or later.
items.ex_zh: 他那些恶毒的阴谋迟早必然会反噬到他自己身上。

groups.summary_en: Highlights the inexorable return trajectory of hostile or underhanded acts, causing them to return like a missile and inflict retributive harm upon the perpetrator.
groups.summary_zh: 强调恶意行为如飞镖般必然折返，引发因果报应并自食其果。
groups.desc_en: Reflects the inexorable recoil of a wrongful, aggressive, or careless action back upon its perpetrator, unlike random external misfortune or unrelated punishment.
groups.desc_zh: 指先前的错误、侵犯或算计行为产生因果恶果反弹回施害者自身，区别于偶发意外或外部施加的惩罚。
groups.nuance_en: boomerang: return upon the originator with destructive opposite results (plan / tactic / policy) · blow back: generate unforeseen hostile systemic blowback on the initiator (operation / policy / intervention) · bite back: suddenly inflict painful retaliatory harm after being provoked or neglected (mistake / complacency / arrogance) · come back to haunt: re-emerge years later to plague or incriminate its originator (past / decision / lie) · reap what one sows: experience exact karmic retribution commensurate with past deeds (harvest / consequences / whirlwind)
groups.nuance_zh: boomerang: 算计落空导致自食其果 (plan / tactic / policy) · blow back: 激化局势产生反冲逆火 (operation / policy / intervention) · bite back: 遭到恶果反咬或反噬 (mistake / complacency / arrogance) · come back to haunt: 往日过患如梦魇般回魂追讨 (past / decision / lie) · reap what one sows: 种瓜得瓜自受因果报应 (harvest / consequences / whirlwind)

groups.name: Bore & Weary · 厌烦与厌倦 (Bore, Weary, Jade)
groups.tip: 因冗长单调而产生的心理倦怠

items.def_en: (+ of) To lose patience or enthusiasm because something has continued for too long
items.ex_en: Investors quickly tired of the chief executive's endless excuses for falling profits.
items.ex_zh: 投资者很快就对该首席执行官为利润下滑找的无休止借口感到厌烦了。
items.ex2_en: Long daily commutes through congested city traffic tire dedicated employees before work begins.
items.ex2_zh: 每天穿过拥堵城市交通的漫长通勤，在工作开始前就让敬业的员工疲惫不堪。

items.raw_cluster: 使厌烦与厌倦 Bore & Tire
items.def_zh: 使厌烦，使无聊；钻（孔），凿（洞）
items.def_en: 1. To make someone feel weary, tired, or uninterested by being dull or repetitive. 2. To make a deep, round hole in a hard substance using a drill or tool.
items.ex_en: Long statistical presentations invariably bore everyone in the corporate boardroom.
items.ex_zh: 冗长的统计汇报总是让企业董事会里的每一个人都感到厌烦乏味。

items.def_en: To deaden someone's engagement or enthusiasm by being tedious and monotonous
items.ex_en: His monotonous lecturing style will quickly turn off even the most dedicated students.
items.ex_zh: 他那单调乏味的讲课风格很快就会让最用功的学生也大倒胃口、索然无味。

items.def_en: To cause someone to lose energy, interest, or patience through relentless repetition or exertion
items.ex_en: Relentless administrative squabbles weary the spirits of dedicated public servants.
items.ex_zh: 无休止的行政纷争使那些尽职尽责的公务人员身心疲惫、心生厌倦。
items.ex2_en: The exhausted marathon runner wearied noticeably during the steep final climb uphill.
items.ex2_zh: 疲惫不堪的马拉松选手在最后陡峭的爬坡路段明显显出了疲态。

items.def_en: (+ on) To become uninteresting or boring to someone as a result of excess or familiarity
items.ex_en: The endless banquets and shallow flatteries soon began to pall on the weary prince.
items.ex_zh: 无休止的宴饮与虚浮的谄媚很快让疲惫的王子心生厌倦。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to causing mental fatigue, apathy, or restive impatience through lack of stimulation, monotony, or overexposure. Variations range from transient dullness to profound existential weariness.
groups.summary_zh: 因单调无聊、过度重复或缺乏刺激而产生精神倦怠与厌烦。
groups.desc_en: Describes the emotional descent into tedium, dulled interest, or psychic exhaustion through overexposure, repetitiveness, or lack of stimulation, contrasting with pure acute physical fatigue.
groups.desc_zh: 指因单调重复、过度刺激或缺乏吸引力而产生的情感乏味、麻木与心理倦怠，区别于突发性的肉体劳累。
groups.nuance_en: bore: induce restless apathy and listless disinterest through lack of novelty (audience / listener / student) · tire: exhaust one's patience, tolerance, or vitality gradually (patience / listener / viewer) · turn off: alienate interest or enthusiasm abruptly via something distasteful (voter / customer / partner) · weary: grind down cognitive endurance or enthusiasm through chronic burden (spirit / soul / traveler) · pall: become tedious, tasteless, or stale through cloying familiarity (novelty / excitement / pleasure)
groups.nuance_zh: bore: 冗长乏味令人生厌 (audience / listener / student) · tire: 消磨耐性使人渐生厌烦 (patience / listener / viewer) · turn off: 因恶感骤然大倒胃口 (voter / customer / partner) · weary: 长期负荷令心力交瘁 (spirit / soul / traveler) · pall: 因久生腻而索然无味 (novelty / excitement / pleasure)

groups.name: Boundary Delimitation & Demarcation · 划界与勘界 (Demarcate, Delimit, Bound)
groups.tip: 划定界限以明确管辖范围

items.def_en: To form the outer edge or perimeter of a tract of land; to serve as its geographic boundary
items.ex_en: Rugged limestone cliffs bound the northern perimeter of the vast national park.
items.ex_zh: 险峻的石灰岩悬崖构成了这座广阔国家公园的北部边界。

items.def_zh: 打桩标出（界线）；声明所有权
items.def_en: To mark the physical boundaries of a piece of land with stakes, establishing an explicit claim
items.ex_en: The prospectors used wooden posts to stake out their claim along the riverbank.
items.ex_zh: 淘金者用木桩在河岸边打桩划界，宣示自己的所有权。

items.def_en: To describe, trace, or mark the precise borders, lines, or contours of an area or idea
items.ex_en: The treaty must clearly delineate the official maritime border between the two countries.
items.ex_zh: 该条约必须清晰划定两国之间官方的海上边界。

items.def_en: To determine or mark the exact external limits, parameters, or scope of something
items.ex_en: The committee established strict criteria to delimit the scope of the investigation.
items.ex_zh: 委员会确立了严格的标准以界定此次调查的范围。

items.def_zh: 划定……的界线，划定界限；区分，界定
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To mark or establish the exact boundaries or limits between two areas or concepts.
items.ex_en: A deep valley serves to demarcate the territory separating the two rival tribes.
items.ex_zh: 一条深谷将两个对立部落的领地清晰地划分开来。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on setting, measuring, or physically and conceptually marking exact perimeters, borders, or clear distinguishing thresholds between adjacent territories, jurisdictions, or abstract concepts.
groups.summary_zh: 在法律、领土或概念上精确勘定、界定外围边界与区分界限。
groups.desc_en: Involves defining, marking, or circumscribing spatial, legal, or conceptual perimeters, contrasting with vague containment or unmeasured division.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过物理标桩、法律条文或概念界限严密厘定与划分边境范畴，区别于模糊包容或粗略切割。
groups.nuance_en: bound: enclose or form the physical external limit of an area (territory / property / horizon) · stake out: mark territorial boundaries physically using posts or establish surveillance oversight (claim / perimeter / position) · delineate: describe, trace, or sketch an exact profile or division in precise detail (border / boundary / role) · delimit: fix the operational scope, limits, or legal jurisdiction of something conceptually (jurisdiction / area / scope) · demarcate: physically or visibly separate two zones or categories with unambiguous markers (frontier / zone / boundary)
groups.nuance_zh: bound: 构成物理外缘的天然阻隔界限 (territory / property / horizon) · stake out: 钉桩圈地以宣示领权 (claim / perimeter / position) · delineate: 细致勾勒描摹出确切轮廓边界 (border / boundary / role) · delimit: 从法律或概念上限定义界限 (jurisdiction / area / scope) · demarcate: 立界碑或划标线实施界线分划 (frontier / zone / boundary)

groups.name: Bow & Throw Oneself Down · 跪拜与仆伏 (Kneel, Genuflect, Kowtow, Bow Down)
groups.tip: 五体投地跪拜或伏倒致敬

items.def_en: (+ down) to go down on one or both knees in rest, prayer, or deference
items.ex_en: The devout pilgrims chose to kneel down together on the cold stone floor.
items.ex_zh: 虔诚的朝圣者们选择一同跪在冰冷的石地板上。

items.def_en: to bend one knee to the ground briefly as a gesture of religious worship or respect
items.ex_en: Before entering the sacred sanctuary, the visitors were requested to genuflect respectfully.
items.ex_zh: 在步入神圣的内殿之前，访客们被要求恭敬地单膝下跪致意。

items.def_en: (+ to/before) to bend the head or entire upper body very low in worship, awe, or complete submission
items.ex_en: The conquered warlords were forced to bow down before the victorious young emperor.
items.ex_zh: 被征服的军阀们被迫在年轻的凯旋帝王面前俯首称臣。

items.def_en: (+ before) to drop quickly to one's knees or flat on the floor before a deity or monarch
items.ex_en: The terrified courtiers rushed to fall down before the furious monarch pleading mercy.
items.ex_zh: 惶恐的朝臣们急忙扑通跪倒在盛怒的君王面前乞求宽恕。

items.def_zh: 俯伏，跪拜（prostrate oneself）；使竭力，使精疲力竭
items.def_en: 1. (prostrate oneself) to lie flat on the ground face downwards, especially in submission or worship. 2. to make someone completely weak, helpless, or exhausted.
items.ex_en: The penitent monks would prostrate themselves in front of the altar every dawn.
items.ex_zh: 忏悔的僧侣们每逢黎明都会伏地跪拜在祭坛之前。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to bodily postures of deep reverence, religious worship, or total physical subjugation by lowering or casting oneself flat.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过跪伏、磕头、下跪等肢体动作表达极度崇敬或顺服。
groups.desc_en: Captures the physical act of lowering one's torso or falling completely to the ground to express profound reverence, submission, or supplication, distinguished from a casual polite nod or tilt.
groups.desc_zh: 指将身体重心显著下移屈膝或平伏于地，以表达极端敬畏、臣服或乞求，区别于一般的礼节性欠身点头。
groups.nuance_en: kneel: rest weight on one or both knees in prayer, respect, or surrender (prayer / reverence / submission) · genuflect: briefly bend one knee to the floor in ritual Catholic reverence or slavish compliance (altar / authority / orthodoxy) · bow down: bend upper body deeply downward in religious idolatry or political subjugation (idols / tyrant / king) · fall down: collapse face-first to the floor in absolute reverence or helplessness (feet / knees / face) · prostrate: cast oneself entirely flat on the ground facedown in total self-abnegation (supplication / reverence / prayer)
groups.nuance_zh: kneel: 双膝或单膝着地呈下跪状 (prayer / reverence / submission) · genuflect: 屈单膝行礼或屈从权贵 (altar / authority / orthodoxy) · bow down: 鞠躬下拜向权神屈从 (idols / tyrant / king) · fall down: 倒伏跪仆于跟前 (feet / knees / face) · prostrate: 五体投地完全趴伏于地 (supplication / reverence / prayer)

groups.name: Boycott & Protest · 抵制与抗议 (Boycott, Picket, Walk out)
groups.tip: 群体集体拒绝合作示威抗议

items.def_en: To take part in a public march or gathering to protest against or support something.
items.ex_en: Thousands of citizens gathered peacefully to demonstrate against the proposed tax hike.
items.ex_zh: 数千名市民和平集会，游行抗议提议中的加税方案。

items.def_en: To stop working or leave a meeting suddenly as an act of protest.
items.ex_en: Disgruntled union members decided to walk out of the contentious wage negotiation.
items.ex_zh: 心怀不满的工会成员决定在中途退场，抵制这场激烈的工资谈判。

items.def_zh: 抵制，拒绝购买（或合作、参与）
items.def_en: 1. To refuse to buy, use, or take part in something as a way of protesting or forcing a change.
items.ex_en: Consumers banded together to boycott the firm over its questionable labor practices.
items.ex_zh: 消费者联合起来抵制这家公司，以抗议其有问题的手法与用工制度。

items.def_en: To deliberately avoid or keep away from someone, a practice, or an organization.
items.ex_en: The conservative community chose to shun anyone who openly defied its traditions.
items.ex_zh: 这个保守的社群选择孤立并断绝往来于任何公然违背其传统的人。

items.def_en: To stand outside a workplace or venue to protest and discourage people from entering.
items.ex_en: Striking factory workers planned to picket the main entrance early tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 罢工的工厂工人们计划明天清晨在正门处设立纠察线抗议。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate collective or organized acts of dissent by deliberately refusing participation, patronage, or compliance to demand change or express condemnation.
groups.summary_zh: 通过拒绝消费、参与或工作来发起集体抗议与施压。
groups.desc_en: Encompasses concerted collective economic or physical actions designed to pressure, ostracize, or publicly contest an authority or commercial entity, unlike lone passive non-compliance.
groups.desc_zh: 指群体为了施加压力而协同采取的经济孤立、停工抗议或公开封锁等反抗举动，区别于个人消极不合作。
groups.nuance_en: boycott: refuse commercially to buy, use, or patronize goods or events as collective punishment (products / games / elections) · picket: stand outside a workplace to discourage non-striking workers or patrons (gates / factory / headquarters) · walk out: abruptly exit a workplace or assembly in sudden strike or protest (talks / job / meeting) · shun: systematically avoid social or economic contact with an ostracized party (member / traitor / group) · demonstrate: march or rally visibly in public spaces to demand policy changes (streets / capital / parliament)
groups.nuance_zh: boycott: 经济或政治性联合抵制 (products / games / elections) · picket: 聚集厂门举牌阻止复工与纠察 (gates / factory / headquarters) · walk out: 愤而离场或突然举行罢工 (talks / job / meeting) · shun: 全体排挤孤立绝交 (member / traitor / group) · demonstrate: 上街游行公开集会示威 (streets / capital / parliament)

groups.name: Brake & Halt · 踩刹车与紧急制动 (Brake, Hit the Brakes, Pull Up)
groups.tip: 速度放缓甚至停下

items.def_en: To bring a vehicle to a stop, or to come to a stop
items.ex_en: The black limousine managed to pull up smoothly right beside the hotel entrance.
items.ex_zh: 那辆黑色豪华轿车平稳地停靠在酒店正门旁。

items.def_en: To stop or slow down a horse by pulling on the reins, or strictly limit someone's freedom or speed
items.ex_en: The rider leaned backward to rein in his galloping stallion before the fence.
items.ex_zh: 骑手向后倾身勒住疾驰的公马，使其在栅栏前停下步子。

items.def_en: To slow down or stop a vehicle by applying the brakes.
items.ex_en: Drivers must brake cautiously when navigating these steep and winding mountain roads.
items.ex_zh: 驾驶员在这些陡峭曲折的山路上行驶时必须小心制动减速。
items.ex2_en: The alert driver quickly braked the heavy delivery van to avoid oncoming traffic.
items.ex2_zh: 警觉的司机迅速踩下重型送货货车的刹车，以避开迎面驶来的车辆。

items.def_en: To slide sideways or forward without tires gripping the road while trying to stop
items.ex_en: The heavy truck began to skid dangerously across the icy interstate highway.
items.ex_zh: 那辆重型卡车在结冰的州际公路上开始危险地打滑失控。

items.def_en: To apply brakes suddenly and with great force in an emergency
items.ex_en: He had to slam on the brakes when a deer leaped into traffic.
items.ex_zh: 当一只鹿突然跃入车流时，他不得不猛踩刹车。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on the mechanical or physical action of applying brakes or counterforce to abruptly arrest or check the motion of a vehicle, bicycle, or moving body.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过施加制动装置或牵引力使车辆及行进物体减速驻停。
groups.desc_en: Concerns the physical deceleration or urgent cessation of vehicular or figurative momentum by applying mechanical friction or tight control, contrasting with drifting to an idle halt.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过机械摩擦力或紧勒缰绳实施主动减速与紧急制动，区别于熄火后的自然滑行停滞。
groups.nuance_en: brake: apply mechanical retarding force to slow or stop a vehicle (car / wheels / bicycle) · pull up: bring a moving horse, vehicle, or oneself smoothly to a complete halt (curb / horse / car) · rein in: check or decelerate speed or extravagance by pulling tightly on reins (spending / inflation / horse) · skid: slide uncontrollably across a slick surface while trying to brake or turn (wheels / road / ice) · slam on: engage brakes abruptly and with maximum violent force (brakes / emergency / vehicle)
groups.nuance_zh: brake: 踩刹车减速制动 (car / wheels / bicycle) · pull up: 驾驶车辆或驭马缓缓停靠 (curb / horse / car) · rein in: 勒缰制动或严格紧缩约束 (spending / inflation / horse) · skid: 刹车打滑失去抓地侧滑 (wheels / road / ice) · slam on: 猛踩急刹车紧急逼停 (brakes / emergency / vehicle)

groups.name: Branch & Diverge · 分叉与分支 (Fork, Ramify, Radiate)
groups.tip: 如树枝或河流向多方向岔开

items.def_en: To separate from a main route, road, or stem and proceed in a different direction
items.ex_en: A gravel trail appeared to branch off from the main hiking path.
items.ex_zh: 一条碎石小径似乎从主徒步路线上分岔延伸了出去。

items.def_en: To start to do an activity or kind of work that you have not done before
items.ex_en: The family-run bakery hopes to branch out into artisanal coffee and catering.
items.ex_zh: 这家家族式面包店希望能涉足精品咖啡与餐饮承办等新领域。

items.def_zh: 分叉，分支；长出枝条；（branch out）涉足新领域
items.def_en: 1. To divide into two or more parts, paths, or branches; (of a tree) to grow branches. 2. (branch out) To start a new activity or diversify into new areas.
items.ex_en: The river begins to branch into multiple shallow streams near the delta.
items.ex_zh: 河流在靠近三角洲的地方开始分叉形成多条浅溪。

items.def_en: To divide into two separate paths, rivers, or directions
items.ex_en: Keep straight when the old highway appears to fork into two separate lanes.
items.ex_zh: 当旧公路看似分叉成两条独立车道时，请保持直行。

items.def_en: To spread out or develop into a complex, tree-like network of branches or consequences
items.ex_en: Scholars studied how the corruption scandal would ramify throughout the entire ministry.
items.ex_zh: 学者们研究了这桩腐败丑闻将如何在该部门各层级间蔓延滋生后果。
items.ex2_en: The ambitious corporate restructuring will ramify operational authority across several regional branches.
items.ex2_zh: 这项雄心勃勃的企业重组计划将把运营权力分散延伸至多个区域分部。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical or conceptual structures dividing from a central stem into multiple stems, paths, or offshoots. They highlight natural growth, architectural splitting, or expanding outward into secondary directions.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重由主干向外自然生长、分岔或展开出支线与侧翼。
groups.desc_en: Specifies structural splitting, bifurcation, or outward tributary development from a main trunk or core entity, distinct from simple continuous linear growth or arbitrary fragmentation.
groups.desc_zh: 指主干事物呈现叉状分枝、支线分化或发散性扩展的拓扑结构演进，区别于单线延伸或无序碎裂。
groups.nuance_en: branch: divide into smaller offshoots or subsidiary divisions from a central body (path / tree / organization) · branch off: deviate laterally away from the main primary route or topic (road / topic / corridor) · branch out: diversify strategically into novel uncharted operational fields (business / career / repertoire) · fork: divide decisively into two distinctly divergent paths or prongs (road / river / lightning) · ramify: spread into a complex, intricate network of interconnected branches or consequences (system / roots / implications)
groups.nuance_zh: branch: 主体衍生出分支脉络 (path / tree / organization) · branch off: 从主路或正题向旁侧岔开 (road / topic / corridor) · branch out: 业务涉猎向外拓宽多元化 (business / career / repertoire) · fork: 一分为二呈丫形分流 (road / river / lightning) · ramify: 复杂交错式多维分化蔓延 (system / roots / implications)

groups.name: Brandish & Flourish · 挥舞与夸示 (Brandish, Flourish, Wave around)
groups.tip: 高举器械挥动示威

items.def_en: To move an object or weapon back and forth in the air conspicuously or recklessly
items.ex_en: The reckless boy continued to wave around that sharp stick despite repeated warnings.
items.ex_zh: 尽管屡次受到警告，那个鲁莽的男孩仍继续胡乱挥舞那根尖木棍。

items.def_zh: 炫耀地挥舞；挥动（引人注意）
items.def_en: To wave something about in an exaggerated, bold, theatrical manner to attract admiration or notice
items.ex_en: The magician managed to flourish his colorful silk handkerchief before a stunned crowd.
items.ex_zh: 魔术师在目瞪口呆的观众面前夸张地一挥彩色丝巾。

items.def_en: To hold and effectively handle a weapon or tool ready for imminent, deliberate use
items.ex_en: Trained guards wield heavy batons to maintain order during the tense event.
items.ex_zh: 受过训练的安保人员紧握沉重的警棍，以维持紧张局势下的秩序。

items.def_en: To display or wave something ostentatiously in order to provoke envy or assert dominance
items.ex_en: He loved to flaunt his expensive gold watch in front of humble colleagues.
items.ex_zh: 他喜欢在朴素的同事面前招摇显摆他那块昂贵的金表。

items.def_en: 1. To wave a weapon, tool, or object around in an excited, threatening, or triumphant way.
items.ex_en: The angry warrior rose up to brandish his gleaming sword at the sky.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的武士站起身来，向着天空挥舞他那柄寒光凛凛的利剑。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey waving or flourishing a weapon, flag, badge, or document conspicuously in the air, usually to intimidate, triumph, or demand immediate public attention. 'Brandish' inherently implies a menacing weapon, whereas 'flourish' highlights dramatic, showy gestures.
groups.summary_zh: 指在空中耀武扬威或引人注目地挥舞武器、旗帜或物件。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to brandishing, sweeping, or theatrically exhibiting weapons or status objects in an ostentatious or intimidating manner, differing from mere stationary carrying or modest concealment.
groups.desc_zh: 指带有炫耀、威吓或戏剧性身段在空中挥舞器械或展示所有物，区别于普通的持握佩带或隐蔽收藏。
groups.nuance_en: brandish: wave a lethal weapon menacingly or aggressively in clear threat (sword / gun / knife) · flourish: wave an object grandly and elegantly with decorative showmanship (pen / hat / handkerchief) · wave around: move an object about carelessly, indiscriminately, or clumsily (money / gun / hands) · wield: hold and exercise effective operational control over an instrument or abstract authority (weapon / power / influence) · flaunt: display an asset or advantage impudently to provoke envy (wealth / body / credentials)
groups.nuance_zh: brandish: 凶神恶煞般拔刀拔枪示威 (sword / gun / knife) · flourish: 潇洒优雅地抖动手腕招展展示 (pen / hat / handkerchief) · wave around: 漫不经心地乱挥乱晃 (money / gun / hands) · wield: 熟练操纵武器或实际执掌大权 (weapon / power / influence) · flaunt: 招摇显摆以博人眼球 (wealth / body / credentials)

groups.name: Breach & Default · 违约与违背 (Breach, Default, Infringe)
groups.tip: 违反契约未履行义务

items.def_en: (+ on) To fail to fulfill an obligation, especially to pay back a loan or debt on time.
items.ex_en: The struggling enterprise could easily default on its multimillion-dollar bank loan next month.
items.ex_zh: 这家陷入困境的企业极有可能在下个月拖欠数百万美元的银行贷款。

items.def_en: To break a law, agreement, promise, or legal duty
items.ex_en: Sharing confidential client records would directly breach the strict non-disclosure agreement.
items.ex_zh: 泄露客户的机密档案将直接违反严格的保密协议。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To act so as to limit or break a legal right, law, or rule
items.ex_en: The controversial new surveillance regulations inevitably infringe upon basic civil liberties.
items.ex_zh: 这项饱受争议的新监控法规不可避免地侵犯了基本公民自由。

items.def_zh: 拒付；不履行（票据或承诺）
items.def_en: To refuse or fail to accept or pay a financial obligation like a check or draft
items.ex_en: The foreign bank regrettably had to dishonor the fraudulent letter of credit.
items.ex_zh: 这家外资银行遗憾地必须对这份欺诈性的信用证拒付退单。

items.def_en: To do something contrary to a law, official rule, or agreement
items.ex_en: Dumping untreated industrial chemical waste will clearly contravene municipal environmental statutes.
items.ex_zh: 倾倒未经处理的工业化学废物显然抵触了市政环保法令。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on formally breaking legal agreements, financial covenants, or regulations. It ranges from contractual non-performance to failing to meet mandatory debt repayments.
groups.summary_zh: 指在法律、合同或金融上未履行义务或违反条款。
groups.desc_en: Addresses the legally or morally culpable failure to honor contracts, promises, statutory mandates, or financial duties, contrasting with legal renegotiation or mutual discharge.
groups.desc_zh: 指违背契约协议、侵害法定权利或未履行法定义务的违规失信行为，区别于合法协商解除或无害偏差。
groups.nuance_en: default: fail specifically to fulfill financial debt repayments or court appearances (loan / mortgage / debt) · breach: shatter or rupture a legally binding covenant or safety barrier (contract / trust / security) · infringe: trespass incrementally upon patents, copyrights, or legitimate personal rights (patent / copyright / rights) · dishonor: repudiate or refuse payment on an authentic formal bill, check, or promise (check / obligation / promise) · contravene: act in direct conflict with an explicit statutory law, rule, or regulation (law / regulation / principle)
groups.nuance_zh: default: 发生债务偿付违约或缺席 (loan / mortgage / debt) · breach: 撕毁协议信任或击穿防线 (contract / trust / security) · infringe: 蚕食侵犯专利知识产权 (patent / copyright / rights) · dishonor: 拒付票据或违背庄严承诺 (check / obligation / promise) · contravene: 触犯或违背明文法律规定 (law / regulation / principle)

groups.name: Brew & Concoct · 酿造与调制 (Steep, Concoct, Distill)
groups.tip: 调配各种成分酿造成饮品

items.def_zh: 酿造（啤酒等）；冲泡（茶、咖啡）；酝酿（事件、风暴）
items.def_en: 1. To make beer or other alcoholic drinks. 2. To make tea or coffee by soaking leaves or beans in hot water. 3. (of trouble, a storm, etc.) To start to form and threaten to happen soon.
items.ex_en: The historic monastery continues to brew traditional dark ale using centuries-old methods.
items.ex_zh: 这座历史悠久的修道院沿用数百年来的古法继续酿造传统黑啤。
items.ex2_en: Fresh herbal tea brews gently on the kitchen counter in ceramic pots.
items.ex2_zh: 新鲜的草本茶正在厨房台面上的陶瓷壶中慢慢沏泡着。

items.def_en: To soak dried leaves or herbs in hot water to extract their flavor or color
items.ex_en: Allow the delicate jasmine blossoms to steep in boiling water for several minutes.
items.ex_zh: 让这些娇嫩的茉莉花蕾在沸水中浸泡冲沏数分钟。
items.ex2_en: Fine green tea leaves steep quietly in hot water inside the porcelain cup.
items.ex2_zh: 上等绿茶茶叶在瓷杯的热水中静静地浸泡舒展。

items.def_en: To undergo or cause a chemical change whereby sugar converts into alcohol
items.ex_en: Winemakers let crushed grapes ferment naturally in oak barrels throughout the cold winter.
items.ex_zh: 酿酒师们让压碎的葡萄在橡木桶中自然发酵度过整个寒冬。
items.ex2_en: Fresh apple cider ferments slowly inside dark cool cellars during chilly autumn months.
items.ex2_zh: 在寒冷的秋日里，新鲜苹果酒在阴凉昏暗的酒窖中缓慢发酵。

items.def_en: To make something unusual by combining different ingredients or liquids
items.ex_en: The adventurous bartender tried to concoct a refreshing herbal cocktail for the guests.
items.ex_zh: 那位勇于尝试的调酒师试图为客人们调制一杯清爽的草本鸡尾酒。

items.def_en: To purify or produce an alcoholic spirit by heating a liquid until vaporized and condensed
items.ex_en: The skilled artisan used copper vats to distill pure aromatic lavender oil.
items.ex_zh: 那位熟练的工匠使用铜蒸馏桶来蒸馏提炼纯正芳香的薰衣草精油。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the artisanal or domestic process of preparing drinks, potions, or mixtures through fermentation, infusion, boiling, or blending.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过发酵、浸泡、蒸馏或混合等工艺制作饮品或混合物。
groups.desc_en: Depicts preparing liquids or concocting multi-ingredient preparations via extraction, fermentation, or imaginative culinary/figurative compounding, contrasting with plain single-step mixing or heating.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过浸润、发酵、萃取或多成分调制来制备液体或方案的复合过程，区别于单纯的加热或单步骤混合。
groups.nuance_en: brew: steep grains or tea in hot water to extract flavor or ferment beer; metaphorically, of trouble forming (beer / coffee / storm) · steep: immerse dry botanical matter deeply in liquid to extract its soluble properties (tea / herbs / leaves) · ferment: convert sugars into alcohol or acids via microorganisms; figuratively, foster unrest (wine / yeast / discontent) · concoct: fabricate an intricate potion, meal, or deceptive scheme from multiple disparate parts (dish / excuse / plot) · distill: vaporize and condense liquid to extract the purest essential essence (whiskey / water / essence)
groups.nuance_zh: brew: 冲泡蒸煮发酵，或酝酿危机 (beer / coffee / storm) · steep: 浸泡浸润以萃取成分 (tea / herbs / leaves) · ferment: 生物发酵，或煽动发酵骚乱 (wine / yeast / discontent) · concoct: 凭巧思拼凑调制奇妙药饮或编造借口 (dish / excuse / plot) · distill: 蒸馏提纯萃取精华 (whiskey / water / essence)

groups.name: Brief & Apprise · 概要通报与交代 (Brief, Apprise, Debrief)
groups.tip: 向上级或团队简要通报情况

items.def_zh: 向……简要通报，向……介绍情况
items.def_en: To give someone concise information or instructions about a situation, project, or task.
items.ex_en: The commander called his lieutenants together to brief them on the tactical maneuvers.
items.ex_zh: 指挥官将他的副官们召集在一起，向他们简要交代战术演习方案。

items.def_en: (+ on) To give someone essential details or background information that they missed
items.ex_en: Please fill me in on whatever occurred during the morning board session.
items.ex_zh: 请向我交代一下早间董事会会议期间发生的事情。

items.def_en: (informal; + on/to) To give someone information or advice about something not widely known
items.ex_en: An anonymous insider agreed to clue the journalists in on the secret merger.
items.ex_zh: 一名匿名知情人士同意向记者们透露这次秘密并购的内情。

items.def_zh: 听取汇报，询问（任务执行情况）
items.def_en: To question someone thoroughly about a completed mission, trip, or task in order to obtain intelligence or feedback
items.ex_en: Military intelligence officers arrived promptly to debrief the pilots after their harrowing flight.
items.ex_zh: 军事情报官员迅速赶来，以便在惊险飞行结束后向飞行员详细询问情况。

items.def_en: (formal; + of) To inform or tell someone about recent events or a development
items.ex_en: The ambassador took care to apprise the ministry of any sudden diplomatic developments.
items.ex_zh: 大使谨慎地向外交部汇报通报任何突发的外交进展。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify delivering targeted, essential information, background status, or instructions to prepare someone for an assignment or keep them updated.
groups.summary_zh: 指针对特定任务或局势提供要点汇报、背景交代或最新指示。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on providing short, mission-critical instructions, updates, or interrogations before or after an operational task, distinguished from protracted comprehensive classroom education.
groups.desc_zh: 指在行动前后开展短促高效的指令传达、案情更新或口述复盘，区别于系统的长篇理论教学。
groups.nuance_en: brief: instruct someone systematically beforehand with essential mission parameters (team / president / delegates) · debrief: interrogate an operative or crew extensively after a completed mission to extract data (pilot / agent / astronaut) · apprise: formally inform a superior or counterpart of recent factual developments (minister / chief / board) · fill in: provide someone with omitted background details or recent gossip (colleague / friend / boss) · clue in: alert an ignorant individual to a secret, inside reality, or emerging fact (amateur / public / bystander)
groups.nuance_zh: brief: 临行前下达行动简报指示 (team / president / delegates) · debrief: 任务归来后详细盘问复盘 (pilot / agent / astronaut) · apprise: 正式通报最新公情事态 (minister / chief / board) · fill in: 填补信息空缺交代来龙去脉 (colleague / friend / boss) · clue in: 透露内情指点迷津点醒旁人 (amateur / public / bystander)

groups.name: Broach & Introduce · 试探引入与提及 (Bring up, Touch on, Moot)
groups.tip: 初次提出话题或顺带提及

items.def_zh: 简单涉及；轻描淡写提及
items.def_en: To mention a subject briefly or in passing without elaborating
items.ex_en: The speaker only touched on the budget deficit without providing any concrete solutions.
items.ex_zh: 发言人只是简略提到了财政赤字，并未给出任何具体解决方案。

items.def_en: To mention or introduce a subject into a conversation
items.ex_en: She waited for an opportune moment to bring up the budget deficit.
items.ex_zh: 她在等待一个合适的时机，以便在交谈中提出预算赤字的问题。

items.def_en: To suggest an idea, plan, or topic for debate or consideration
items.ex_en: Several innovative tax reforms were mooted during the informal economic summit yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 在昨天的非正式经济峰会上，有人提出了几项创新的税制改革方案供讨论。

items.def_zh: 提出，引入（敏感或困难的话题）；开启，给（桶等）开孔引流
items.def_en: 1. To bring up a sensitive or difficult topic for initial discussion. 2. To pierce a container or cask to draw liquid from it.
items.ex_en: Nobody in the family had enough courage to broach the painful topic.
items.ex_zh: 家族中没有人拥有足够的勇气去挑起那个令人痛苦的敏感话题。

items.def_en: To dare to say or introduce something at the risk of criticism or doubt
items.ex_en: He did not venture to suggest that the renowned professor was entirely mistaken.
items.ex_zh: 他不敢冒昧指出那位知名教授的观点完全是错误的。

groups.summary_en: Emphasizes initiating discussion on a delicate, awkward, or novel topic, often testing the waters before deeper debate.
groups.summary_zh: 首次触及或试探性地提出敏感、重要的话题。
groups.desc_en: Involves cautiously venturing a delicate, controversial, or fresh topic into conversation for initial consideration, distinct from thoroughly prosecuting a debate or issuing unilateral edicts.
groups.desc_zh: 指在谈话中试探性引入、触及或抛出敏感或新颖的话题供各方审量，区别于深入全面论证或单方面宣布结论。
groups.nuance_en: broach: introduce an uncomfortable, sensitive, or taboo subject delicately for the first time (subject / topic / divorce) · bring up: mention a point or memory casually or deliberately in conversation (issue / past / matter) · touch on: mention a subject briefly or peripherally in passing without detailed exploration (topic / theme / point) · moot: propose an idea, hypothetical thesis, or legal point for speculative debate (idea / question / proposal) · venture: dare to utter an uncertain opinion or risky remark tentatively (opinion / guess / suggestion)
groups.nuance_zh: broach: 试探性揭开敏感棘手话题 (subject / topic / divorce) · bring up: 谈话中提出或翻出旧事 (issue / past / matter) · touch on: 蜻蜓点水般顺带掠过提及 (topic / theme / point) · moot: 抛出假说设想供各方商讨 (idea / question / proposal) · venture: 大胆且怯生生地提出推测建议 (opinion / guess / suggestion)

groups.name: Broadcast & Air · 节目播送与播出 (Air, Stream, Webcast)
groups.tip: 通过媒介向大众传播

items.def_en: Broadcast a television or radio show, or be scheduled and transmitted on a network
items.ex_en: The national television network will air the controversial investigative documentary tomorrow evening.
items.ex_zh: 国家电视网将于明晚播出那部颇具争议的调查性纪录片。
items.ex2_en: The popular dramatic television series airs prime time every Thursday night nationwide.
items.ex2_zh: 这部大受欢迎的电视剧于每周四晚黄金时段在全国播出。

items.def_en: Broadcast or receive continuous audio or video directly over the internet in real time
items.ex_en: Millions of loyal fans chose to stream the historic concert directly online.
items.ex_zh: 数百万忠实粉丝选择通过网络直接在线收看这场历史性的音乐会。
items.ex2_en: Live international sporting events stream smoothly across our high-speed digital entertainment platform.
items.ex2_zh: 国际体育赛事实况通过我们的高速数字娱乐平台流畅地在线直播。

items.def_en: Send out sound, images, or programs on radio, television, or digital channels to the public
items.ex_en: The regional radio station will broadcast the live football match nationwide this weekend.
items.ex_zh: 地方广播电台将在本周末向全国播送这场现场足球赛。
items.ex2_en: Emergency weather alerts broadcast continuously across every municipal channel during severe blizzards.
items.ex2_zh: 在严重暴风雪期间，紧急天气预警在各个市政频道上持续播报。

items.def_en: To make a digital audio recording and make it available on the internet for people to download or stream.
items.ex_en: The two investigative journalists decided to podcast their latest findings on true crime.
items.ex_zh: 两位调查记者决定将他们关于真实犯罪的最新调查制作成播客节目。

items.def_en: Transmit a live or pre-recorded performance, conference, or event via the World Wide Web
items.ex_en: The global tech company plans to webcast the annual shareholders convention internationally.
items.ex_zh: 这家全球科技巨头计划向全世界网络直播其年度股东大会。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the mass dissemination of recorded or live digital media content (audio, video, podcasts) to a widespread public audience across networks, airwaves, or online hosting platforms.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过电台、电视或互联网平台向大众播发流媒体或节目录像。
groups.desc_en: To transmit prepared audiovisual content to a dispersed audience across electronic or digital media, differing from point-to-point communication by targeting public or mass reception.
groups.desc_zh: 通过电子或数字媒体向分散的受众播送音视频内容，与点对点私人通信不同，其核心在于面向大众或公共接收。
groups.nuance_en: air: schedule or release for transmission on television or radio (episode / interview / grievance) · stream: deliver continuous digital media over the internet in real time (content / match / concert) · broadcast: send out signals widely over airwaves or electronic networks (speech / program / bulletin) · podcast: publish episodic audio content for download or streaming (series / episode / commentary) · webcast: broadcast an event live over the Internet (conference / symposium / seminar)
groups.nuance_zh: air: 在广播电视中安排播出或播送 (episode / interview / grievance) · stream: 通过互联网实时流式传输数字媒体 (content / match / concert) · broadcast: 通过无线电波或宽泛网络公开发送信号 (speech / program / bulletin) · podcast: 制作并发布分集播客节目 (series / episode / commentary) · webcast: 在互联网上进行网络直播或转播 (conference / symposium / seminar)

groups.name: Broadcast & Disseminate · 宣传与广泛传播 (Publicize, Broadcast, Trumpet)
groups.tip: 向外界公开宣布并广泛宣扬

items.def_en: To present or praise something publicly to encourage sales or interest
items.ex_en: The cosmetics brand chose to advertise its new moisturizing cream across all channels.
items.ex_zh: 该化妆品品牌选择在所有渠道为其新款保湿面霜大做广告。

items.def_en: To encourage the public acceptance, appreciation, or purchase of something
items.ex_en: Celebrities frequently attend gala events to promote their upcoming blockbuster films.
items.ex_zh: 名流们频繁出席盛大晚会，以宣传推广他们即将上映的重磅大片。

items.def_en: To disseminate information widely by radio, television, or word of mouth
items.ex_en: He did not hesitate to broadcast the confidential office gossip to everyone.
items.ex_zh: 他毫不犹豫地把办公室里的私密八卦大肆宣扬给了所有人。
items.ex2_en: Shocking news about corporate restructuring broadcast swiftly across every department yesterday morning.
items.ex2_zh: 关于公司重组的惊人消息昨天上午迅速传遍了各个部门。

items.def_zh: 宣传，大肆宣扬；公布，向公众宣传
items.def_en: To make information about something widely known to the public through the media; to advertise.
items.ex_en: The campaign organizers worked around the clock to publicize the charitable marathon.
items.ex_zh: 活动组织者们夜以继日地工作，以向公众大范围宣传这场慈善马拉松。

items.def_en: To proclaim loudly and boastfully in public
items.ex_en: The local mayor continues to trumpet his modest administrative achievements to voters.
items.ex_zh: 这位地方市长继续向选民大吹大擂自己那点微不足道的政绩。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on making information broadly known to the public through commercial, promotional, or media channels, often highlighting persuasion or fanfare.
groups.summary_zh: 强调借助媒介工具广泛散布、宣扬或推销信息以引起公众关注。
groups.desc_en: To make information, opinions, or achievements widely and conspicuously known to the public, contrasting with neutral reporting through deliberate promotion or boastful volume.
groups.desc_zh: 公开放大并宣扬信息、观点或功绩，与中立陈述不同，强调主动推销、宣传或高调夸耀。
groups.nuance_en: advertise: publicly announce to draw attention or commercial trade (product / vacancy / services) · promote: actively encourage the popularity, adoption, or sale of (initiative / brand / album) · broadcast: proclaim widely and indiscreetly (secret / intentions / news) · publicize: draw general public attention to through media coverage (event / campaign / findings) · trumpet: loudly and ostentatiously boast or proclaim (success / victory / achievements)
groups.nuance_zh: advertise: 公开登广告招揽注意或商业招揽 (product / vacancy / services) · promote: 积极宣传推销以促进普及或销售 (initiative / brand / album) · broadcast: 肆意散布或张扬无所隐讳 (secret / intentions / news) · publicize: 借助媒介造势引起公众广泛关注 (event / campaign / findings) · trumpet: 敲锣打鼓般大肆吹嘘或炫耀 (success / victory / achievements)

groups.name: Broadcast & Transmit · 电波传信与呼叫 (Transmit, Beam, Dispatch)
groups.tip: 通过无线电向大众传播信息

items.def_zh: 接通（无线电或电话线路）
items.def_en: Connect someone to a radio frequency, telephone line, or communication link
items.ex_en: The operator promised to patch through the urgent incoming transmission immediately.
items.ex_zh: 话务员承诺会立即为这通紧急呼入的传输接通通讯线路。

items.def_zh: 用无线电发送（信息），用无线电通讯；用无线电向……发送信息
items.def_en: To send a message to someone or communicate with someone by radio.
items.ex_en: The stranded ship captain needed to radio the nearby coastguard for assistance.
items.ex_zh: 搁浅的轮船船长需要用无线电向附近的海岸警卫队呼救。

items.def_en: Send a telegraphic message, instructions, or money electronically across distances
items.ex_en: His wealthy uncle decided to wire the tuition money straight to London.
items.ex_zh: 他富有的叔叔决定将学费直接电汇到伦敦。

items.def_en: Send a radio or television signal, or laser/light ray, directly in a specific direction or to a satellite
items.ex_en: The specialized antenna was designed to beam encrypted signals straight to orbit.
items.ex_zh: 这款专用天线旨在将加密信号定向直接发射至轨道卫星。

items.def_en: Send out an electronic, electrical, or radio signal, broadcast, or message over a communications system
items.ex_en: Specialized satellites continuously transmit meteorological data back down to ground stations.
items.ex_zh: 专用卫星持续向地面监测站发送传输气象数据。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail the technical transmission or sending of audio signals, shortwave messages, and electronic communiqués across long distances, typically via dedicated radio equipment, telegraphy, or tactical comms channels.
groups.summary_zh: 指利用无线电波、通信链路或仪器远距离向特定对象或公共网络发报。
groups.desc_en: To convey electronic signals, instructions, or messages through technical conduits like radio, wires, or focused energy, distinguished from mass broadcasting by targeted, directional delivery.
groups.desc_zh: 借助无线电、线路或聚焦波束等技术介质定向传导信号或指令，与大众广播相比强调指向性通信与连通。
groups.nuance_en: patch through: connect two parties telephonically or electronically (caller / call / line) · radio: contact or send instructions via two-way radio (headquarters / base / pilot) · wire: transmit funds or telegraphic messages over a network (money / message / funds) · beam: emit focused directional waves, signals, or light (signal / image / data) · transmit: send out an electronic signal or pass along data (data / frequency / coordinates)
groups.nuance_zh: patch through: 电话或通信线路中转接通 (caller / call / line) · radio: 通过双向无线电台呼叫或传令 (headquarters / base / pilot) · wire: 通过电报或电汇线路拍发或汇出 (money / message / funds) · beam: 定向发射电波、光束或信号 (signal / image / data) · transmit: 发射电磁信号或传输基础数据 (data / frequency / coordinates)

groups.name: Browbeat & Bully into Submission · 威逼施压与蛮横慑服 (Buffalo, Browbeat, Bulldoze)
groups.tip: 以强权手段使对方屈服顺从

items.def_en: Overcome or disconcert an opponent through a bolder, more resolute, and unflinching gaze
items.ex_en: The young knight stood firm, determined to outface the cruel tyrant with an unyielding glare.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的骑士坚定伫立，决心以不屈的凝视迫使残暴的统治者退缩。

items.def_en: (informal, chiefly North American) To intimidate, overpower, or bewilder someone into submission or confusion.
items.ex_en: Don't let that aggressive salesman buffalo you into signing an expensive long-term contract.
items.ex_zh: 别让那个咄咄逼人的推销员吓得你稀里糊涂签下昂贵的长期合同。

items.def_en: (+ into) Force or badger someone aggressively into an unwanted course of action
items.ex_en: The committee attempted to bludgeon the dissident members into approving the controversial development budget.
items.ex_zh: 委员会企图强迫持异议的成员们就范，批准那笔备受争议的开发预算。

items.def_zh: 强行压服，横冲直撞强推
items.def_en: Coerce or steamroller someone aggressively into doing something without regard for objections
items.ex_en: Management decided to bulldoze the unpopular restructuring plan despite widespread objections from the staff.
items.ex_zh: 尽管员工普遍反对，管理层仍决定强行推进不受欢迎的重组方案。

items.def_en: Bully or intimidate someone into obedience or silence with harsh, domineering words
items.ex_en: The stern prosecutor tried to browbeat the nervous witness into modifying his previous sworn testimony.
items.ex_zh: 严厉的检察官试图用威吓的言辞迫使紧张的证人修改先前的宣誓证词。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on overpowering, browbeating, or bamboozling someone into compliance through aggressive intimidation or bluffing.
groups.summary_zh: 依仗蛮横声势或虚张声势，强行吓服、压制或摆布他人。
groups.desc_en: To compel someone into submission, compliance, or silence through overbearing intimidation, aggressive bluster, or sheer psychological force, contrasting with rational persuasion.
groups.desc_zh: 以蛮横威慑、强横声势或心理施压强迫他人屈服听命，与讲理说服截然相反。
groups.nuance_en: browbeat: intimidate by stern words, arrogant looks, or domineering demeanor (witness / subordinate / opponent) · bulldoze: force through by relentless, heavy-handed pressure (committee / opposition / legislation) · buffalo: bewilder, baffle, or cow someone into submission through bluff (critics / public / opponent) · bludgeon: relentlessly batter or coerce as if using a heavy club (rivals / dissenters / legislature) · outface: overcome or defy by staring down or bolder boldness (accusers / danger / adversary)
groups.nuance_zh: browbeat: 凭厉色或专横态度恫吓逼服 (witness / subordinate / opponent) · bulldoze: 强力压制异见蛮横推进 (committee / opposition / legislation) · buffalo: 靠虚张声势或高压手段糊弄震慑 (critics / public / opponent) · bludgeon: 像棒击般粗暴压制或强推 (rivals / dissenters / legislature) · outface: 以更强硬的目光或胆色瞪视震慑倒对方 (accusers / danger / adversary)

groups.name: Bruise & Contuse · 挫伤与碰伤 (Bruise, Contuse, Batter)
groups.tip: 受外力击打产生青肿损伤

items.def_zh: （使）出现青肿，碰伤；伤害（感情、自尊）
items.def_en: 1. To develop a bruise, or cause a dark mark to appear on the skin or fruit by hitting it. 2. To hurt someone's feelings, confidence, or pride.
items.ex_en: The heavy fall caused her knee to bruise immediately, swelling into a purple knot.
items.ex_zh: 重重的一跤使她的膝盖立即青肿起来，鼓起一块紫色的包。
items.ex2_en: Rough shipping handlers bruised several delicate heirloom peaches inside the wooden crate.
items.ex2_zh: 粗鲁的装运工弄伤了木箱里好几个娇嫩的传统品种桃子。

items.def_en: To injure an area of the body without breaking the skin, causing a medical contusion
items.ex_en: The blunt trauma managed to severely contuse the subcutaneous tissues without breaking the outer skin.
items.ex_zh: 钝力挫伤在未破损表皮的情况下严重损伤了皮下组织。

items.def_en: To damage the surface of skin by roughly rubbing against a hard, coarse surface
items.ex_en: He tripped on the rugged pavement and managed to scrape the skin off his elbows.
items.ex_zh: 他在崎岖的人行道上绊倒，把双肘的表皮都擦破了。

items.def_en: To injure or scratch someone through physical collision or falls
items.ex_en: He got really banged up after tumbling off his skateboard onto the concrete path.
items.ex_zh: 他从滑板上摔到水泥路上后，身上碰伤了好几处。

items.def_en: To strike someone or something repeatedly with hard blows, causing extensive bruising
items.ex_en: The violent intruder began to batter the homeowner mercilessly with a heavy brass candlestick.
items.ex_zh: 凶暴的入侵者开始用沉重的黄铜烛台连续猛击房主。

groups.summary_en: Centers on blunt-force impact that discolors, compresses, or damages tissue beneath the surface without severely breaking the skin. Also extends metaphorically to delicate egos, reputations, or fruit.
groups.summary_zh: 指钝力撞击皮下软组织造成的青肿、挫伤，亦引申指自尊或外壳受损。
groups.desc_en: To injure tissue, surface skin, or an object by blunt impact without severing or deeply cutting, contrasting with sharp lacerations or penetrating wounds.
groups.desc_zh: 因钝力撞击使组织、表皮或物体表面受损但未裂开深创，与利刃切割或穿透伤不同。
groups.nuance_en: bruise: discolour tissue by blunt rupture of subcutaneous blood vessels (arm / ego / fruit) · contuse: cause a medical contusion or deep bruise via heavy impact (muscle / tissue / kidney) · scrape: abrade or skin the surface by rubbing against friction (knee / knuckle / paint) · bang up: inflict noticeable bumps, denting, or minor damage by impact (car / knees / shoulder) · batter: subject to repeated heavy, damaging blows (body / vehicle / coastline)
groups.nuance_zh: bruise: 钝击致皮下瘀血或伤痕青肿 (arm / ego / fruit) · contuse: 医学上受钝挫力导致深层组织挫伤 (muscle / tissue / kidney) · scrape: 摩擦蹭破表皮或刮损表面 (knee / knuckle / paint) · bang up: 磕碰摔打致使伤痕累累或凹陷 (car / knees / shoulder) · batter: 连续遭受重击致皮开肉绽或破损 (body / vehicle / coastline)

groups.name: Budge with Ill Will · 吝惜付出与心存怨嫉 (Grudge, Begrudge, Envying)
groups.tip: 心怀怨怼暗暗积压不平之气

items.def_en: Be overly frugal or grudging with spending, resources, or allowances
items.ex_en: The miserly director chose to pinch every penny instead of properly rewarding his diligent staff.
items.ex_zh: 吝啬的主管一味抠搜节约，而不愿对勤奋的员工给予恰当奖励。

items.def_en: Feel discontent or covetous resentment towards someone's advantages, success, or possessions
items.ex_en: He could not help but envy his colleague's rapid promotion and lavish corporate perks.
items.ex_zh: 他忍不住嫉妒同事的迅速晋升以及所享受的丰厚公司福利。

items.def_en: (+ on) Provide only an inadequate, grudgingly small amount of something
items.ex_en: The frugal landlord would always stint on heating oil during the coldest months of winter.
items.ex_zh: 那个节俭过度的房东总在最冷的寒冬腊月里克扣供暖用油。

items.def_zh: 心怀怨恨；勉强给予，吝惜；嫉妒
items.def_en: To feel resentful or bitter about giving, allowing, or seeing someone enjoy something.
items.ex_en: The defeated champion seemed to grudge the young newcomer every single word of praise received.
items.ex_zh: 落败的卫冕冠军似乎对年轻新人所获得的每一句赞誉都心怀怨恨。

items.def_en: Reluctantly grant or resent paying something; envy another's possession of a perk
items.ex_en: Nobody should begrudge her the hard-earned bonus after months of tireless dedication to this project.
items.ex_zh: 在为该项目连续数月辛勤付出之后，谁也不该对她应得的奖金心怀不满。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame evoke the bitter feeling of parting with something unwillingly, or seeing another enjoy a boon with silent jealousy and resentment.
groups.summary_zh: 极不情愿地让渡利益，或对他人的所得与待遇心怀酸楚与妒恨。
groups.desc_en: To give, concede, or allow something with extreme reluctance, spite, or resentment, contrasting with willing generosity or objective withholding.
groups.desc_zh: 极不情愿地让与、给予或承认某物，内心充满嫉恨与舍不得，与心甘情愿的施予截然相反。
groups.nuance_en: grudge: allow or give with palpable reluctance and hidden malice (praise / dime / help) · begrudge: resent having to give, or envy another's possession of (success / expense / pennies) · stint: restrict supply or be niggardly in provision (supplies / praise / funding) · pinch: practice petty, stingy economy over small amounts (pennies / pennies / budget) · envy: resent another for possessing an advantage or good (wealth / talent / happiness)
groups.nuance_zh: grudge: 勉强给予并心怀怨怼或舍不得 (praise / dime / help) · begrudge: 嫉妒他人拥有或极不情愿付出 (success / expense / pennies) · stint: 吝啬配给或节减用度 (supplies / praise / funding) · pinch: 抠门省吃俭用或小气紧缩 (pennies / pennies / budget) · envy: 对他人拥有的好处心怀眼红嫉恨 (wealth / talent / happiness)

groups.name: Buffet & Batter · 连番冲击与拍打 (Buffet, Batter, Pound)
groups.tip: 风浪或重拳连续反复击打

items.def_en: To hit heavily and repeatedly with great force
items.ex_en: Massive ocean waves continued to pound the crumbling concrete pier throughout the violent storm.
items.ex_zh: 整场暴风雨中，滔天巨浪持续猛烈撞击着摇摇欲坠的混凝土码头。

items.def_en: To strike hard, repeatedly, and violently, causing structural damage or injury
items.ex_en: Ferocious gale-force winds began to batter the coastal cottages, shattering several exterior wooden shutters.
items.ex_zh: 狂暴的大风开始猛烈冲击沿海小屋，砸碎了数扇室外木百叶窗。

items.def_en: To hit violently with sudden, whip-like force, as waves or heavy rain against a surface
items.ex_en: Torrential sheets of cold rain began to lash the fragile glass panels of the greenhouse.
items.ex_zh: 倾盆的冰冷雨水开始如鞭子般猛烈抽打温室脆弱的玻璃窗。

items.def_zh: 连番冲击，连续击打；搏斗
items.def_en: (often passive) To strike or hit repeatedly and forcefully, as by wind, waves, or misfortune.
items.ex_en: The tiny wooden vessel was endlessly buffeted by turbulent squalls across the dark open sea.
items.ex_zh: 那艘小木船在漆黑开阔的海面上不断遭受狂暴阵风的连番冲击。

items.def_en: To strike repeatedly with fists or a succession of heavy physical blows
items.ex_en: The enraged champion began to pummel his exhausted opponent against the ropes of the ring.
items.ex_zh: 暴怒的拳王将疲惫不堪的对手逼到拳台缆绳边并接连出拳重击。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express repeated, violent striking or pummeling by external physical elements (such as winds, surf, or artillery) or metaphorically by adverse fortunes.
groups.summary_zh: 指受到风浪、炮火或逆境的连番猛烈冲击与拍打。
groups.desc_en: To strike or pound repeatedly and violently with rhythmic or chaotic physical force, contrasting with a single isolated hit.
groups.desc_zh: 以无休止或混乱的剧烈力量反复敲打、撞击或冲击，与单一孤立的击打不同。
groups.nuance_en: buffet: strike repeatedly and toss about violently, like rough winds or waves (ship / coastline / economy) · batter: strike with heavy, repeated blows causing cumulative damage (defenses / shore / suspect) · pound: beat heavily, rhythmically, and thuddingly (door / pavement / heart) · lash: strike sharply and repeatedly like a whip (rain / tail / waves) · pummel: beat rapidly and repeatedly with fists or blunt force (opponent / body / bag)
groups.nuance_zh: buffet: 强风浪等连续摇撼冲击颠簸 (ship / coastline / economy) · batter: 连环重击造成累积性破坏毁损 (defenses / shore / suspect) · pound: 沉重、有节奏地反复擂打撞击 (door / pavement / heart) · lash: 如鞭挞般抽打或拍击 (rain / tail / waves) · pummel: 用拳头或钝物疾速连击痛打 (opponent / body / bag)

groups.name: Bulldoze & Force Through · 蛮横推挤与强攻 (Bull, Ram, Bulldoze)
groups.tip: 蛮力横冲直撞向前顶推

items.def_en: To move with irresistible momentum through an obstacle, crowd, or massive backlog of work
items.ex_en: Exhausted commuters had to plow through the dense crowd of tourists outside the central station.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的通勤客不得不强行穿过中央车站外密集拥挤的游客人流。

items.def_en: To push or force one's way aggressively or clumsily through an obstacle or crowd.
items.ex_en: He tried to bull his way through the congested ticket barrier without waiting in line.
items.ex_zh: 他没排队，硬是蛮横地朝拥挤的检票闸口生挤了过去。

items.def_zh: 压倒；以势压人强行通过
items.def_en: To overwhelm competitors or force through an initiative by sheer weight of power or influence
items.ex_en: The corporate giant managed to steamroll smaller competitors by slashing prices below sustainable market rates.
items.ex_zh: 这家行业巨头通过将价格压低至正常水平以下，以势压人打垮了较小的竞争对手。

items.def_en: To drive or crash heavily into something, or force an object or idea through with brutal impact
items.ex_en: The ruling faction used their parliamentary majority to ram the controversial bill through the legislature.
items.ex_zh: 执政派系利用其在议会中的多数席位，强行通过了这项饱受争议的法案。

items.def_en: To force something through ruthlessly, flattening any resistance or obstacles in the way
items.ex_en: The mayor managed to bulldoze the massive transit project through years of fierce local opposition.
items.ex_zh: 市长力排当地多年来的强烈反对，横冲直撞强行推进了大型交通项目。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey heavy-handed, blunt force pushing through physical barriers or driving proposals through opposition without regard for subtlety.
groups.summary_zh: 施加粗暴阻力强行推翻障碍，或强推提案通过。
groups.desc_en: To advance relentlessly and heedlessly by crushing, smashing, or violently dislodging obstacles in one's path, differing from agile navigation.
groups.desc_zh: 凭借蛮横体量或威势碾压、撞穿前路阻碍强行推进，与灵巧规避绕行不同。
groups.nuance_en: bulldoze: flatten and override obstacles with irresistible brute momentum (opposition / reforms / bill) · steamroll: crush opposition swiftly through overwhelming superiority or votes (rivals / committee / opponents) · ram: forcefully crash or drive into an obstruction to breach it (car / vehicle / gate) · bull: shove one's way forward with brute, clumsy physical strength (way / path / defense) · plow through: surge forward vigorously through thick resistance or mass (crowd / paperwork / waves)
groups.nuance_zh: bulldoze: 凭借蛮力大刀阔斧推平阻碍 (opposition / reforms / bill) · steamroll: 以压倒性优势或票数将对手碾平 (rivals / committee / opponents) · ram: 用重物或车头猛烈撞穿破拆 (car / vehicle / gate) · bull: 凭一身牛劲笨拙野蛮地硬往里挤 (way / path / defense) · plow through: 如犁地般冲开阻力强劲推进 (crowd / paperwork / waves)

groups.name: Bunch & Cluster · 聚集与聚拢 (Cluster, Clump, Gather)
groups.tip: 分散的人或物收拢成群扎堆

items.def_en: To draw together into one place, or to pull cloth into folds
items.ex_en: The skilled dressmaker began to gather the delicate lace along the hem of the gown.
items.ex_zh: 技术娴熟的女裁缝开始沿着礼服下摆将精致的蕾丝收拢起褶。
items.ex2_en: Dark storm clouds gather menacingly over the jagged mountain peaks before twilight.
items.ex2_zh: 黄昏之前，乌云密布，险恶地聚集在参差不齐的山峰上方。

items.def_zh: 聚集，扎堆；使成一束，使聚成一团；隆起，打褶
items.def_en: 1. To gather or form tightly into a group or cluster. 2. To form or pull fabric into tight folds.
items.ex_en: The terrified sheep began to bunch together tightly as the hungry predator crept closer.
items.ex_zh: 当饥饿的捕食者悄悄逼近时，受惊的羊群开始紧紧扎堆缩成一团。
items.ex2_en: The seamstress bunched the excess silk fabric gently around the waistline.
items.ex2_zh: 女裁缝把腰部周围多余的丝绸面料轻轻地打褶收拢起来。

items.def_en: To form into a small, tight group around a point, or to gather things closely
items.ex_en: Anxious parents started to cluster near the school gates, waiting for official word from authorities.
items.ex_zh: 焦虑的家长们开始在校门附近成团聚拢，等待有关部门的官方消息。
items.ex2_en: Urban planners clustered several affordable housing blocks near the new transit station.
items.ex2_zh: 城市规划人员在新公交枢纽附近集中建设了几片经济适用房街区。

items.def_en: To crowd closely together, often for warmth, safety, or confidential discussion
items.ex_en: The stranded hikers chose to huddle together under the rock overhang to keep warm.
items.ex_zh: 被困的徒步旅行者选择在悬垂的岩石下挤作一团以互相取暖。
items.ex2_en: The protective shepherd huddled his shivering sheep tightly inside the stone barn.
items.ex2_zh: 尽职的牧羊人把瑟瑟发抖的羊群紧紧地聚集在石砌谷仓内。

items.def_en: To form or gather into a thick, compact, and irregular mass or cluster
items.ex_en: Moist soil will clump together into stubborn balls if you attempt to cultivate it wet.
items.ex_zh: 如果你在潮湿时耕种，湿润的土壤就会结成难以散开的硬块。
items.ex2_en: The baker clumped the buttery dough firmly together before rolling it flat.
items.ex2_zh: 烘焙师在把黄油面团擀平之前，将其牢牢地揉捏聚拢成团。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote people, things, or flexible materials drawing close together into dense groups, folds, or tight physical clusters.
groups.summary_zh: 指人、物或织物紧紧聚拢成团、成簇或形成皱褶。
groups.desc_en: To draw or come together closely into an informal, compact group or dense formation, contrasting with orderly dispersal or geometric alignment.
groups.desc_zh: 自发或被动密集靠拢聚成无规则团块，与整齐队列或分散状态不同。
groups.nuance_en: cluster: gather closely around a central point or common feature (stars / children / houses) · bunch: crowd tightly together, often creating wrinkles or packs (muscles / fabric / flowers) · clump: gather into a thick, shapeless, or compact mass (trees / soil / cells) · huddle: crowd closely together for warmth, secrecy, or protection (crowd / players / sheep) · gather: assemble together broadly into one collective group (crowd / clouds / supporters)
groups.nuance_zh: cluster: 围绕某中心或特征紧凑簇拥 (stars / children / houses) · bunch: 挤拢聚成束或褶皱隆起 (muscles / fabric / flowers) · clump: 凝聚凝结成粗重成团的块状 (trees / soil / cells) · huddle: 为取暖、避难或密谈缩作一团蜷挤 (crowd / players / sheep) · gather: 泛指集合聚拢到一处 (crowd / clouds / supporters)

groups.name: Bundle & Aggregate · 分批与组包 (Batch, Bundle, Cluster)
groups.tip: 按批次归纳整理成组

items.def_en: To bring people or things together so that they form an orderly cluster or collective unit
items.ex_en: The researchers decided to group the clinical trial participants according to their previous medical histories.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员决定根据先前的病史将临床试验参与者编组分组。
items.ex2_en: Curious tourists grouped naturally around the historic monument to take commemorative photos.
items.ex2_zh: 好奇的游客们自然而然地聚拢在历史纪念碑周围拍照留念。

items.def_en: To treat or process different things or people as if they were all alike in a single undifferentiated group
items.ex_en: Critics often lazily lump together all modern art into one single pretentious, confusing movement.
items.ex_zh: 批评家们常常偷懒地把所有现代艺术混为一谈，归为一场自命不凡且混乱的运动。

items.def_en: To assemble or cause to assemble closely together into a tight pack or statistical cluster
items.ex_en: Astronomers observed how remote galaxies tend to cluster into massive filaments across the deep cosmos.
items.ex_zh: 天文学家观察到遥远的星系往往会在浩瀚宇宙中聚簇成巨大的丝状结构。
items.ex2_en: Experienced teachers clustered struggling students into small supportive study groups during class.
items.ex2_zh: 经验丰富的老师在课上将学习吃力的学生分成几个互相支持的学习小组。

items.def_en: To group multiple individual items, products, or transactions together to be sold or handled as a unit
items.ex_en: Telecommunication companies frequently bundle high-speed broadband, landline telephony, and streaming television services together cheaply.
items.ex_zh: 电信公司经常将高速宽带、固定电话和流媒体电视服务低价捆绑销售。

items.def_zh: 分批，成批处理；将……归类编组
items.def_en: 1. (computing / manufacturing) To group items or data together into batches to be processed simultaneously.
items.ex_en: The automated system will batch incoming customer invoices every midnight to optimize processing power.
items.ex_zh: 自动化系统会在每晚午夜将收到的客户发票分批处理，以优化计算性能。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this computational and operational frame refer to gathering discrete individual items, tasks, or transactions together into cohesive groups to be handled or processed in a single run.
groups.summary_zh: 指将零散任务、数据或物品打包组合，以便集中批量处理。
groups.desc_en: To combine distinct individual items or tasks into an aggregate whole for collective processing or commercial transaction, contrasting with handling items individually.
groups.desc_zh: 将离散个体、任务或产品归并为整体以便集中处理或交易，与单件处理相反。
groups.nuance_en: bundle: package distinct goods, services, or features together as a single offering (software / services / products) · batch: group items, data, or tasks to be processed in one run (orders / cookies / transactions) · lump together: indiscriminately classify different things under one blanket category (categories / groups / concepts) · cluster: aggregate similar data points or units based on proximity (data / cases / firms) · group: organize elements together systematically by shared traits (students / items / files)
groups.nuance_zh: bundle: 捆绑打包销售产品或服务 (software / services / products) · batch: 将任务或物料按批次汇集处理 (orders / cookies / transactions) · lump together: 不加区分地混为一谈归总 (categories / groups / concepts) · cluster: 按相似度或空间相近性聚类 (data / cases / firms) · group: 按共有特征系统分组分类 (students / items / files)

groups.name: Bundle & Bundle Together · 束绑与捆扎成捆 (Bundle, Sheaf, Truss)
groups.tip: 将零散之物扎成一捆

items.def_en: To collect and bind cut grain stalks or similar materials into a sheaf
items.ex_en: Peasants labored under the autumn sun to reap and sheaf the abundant golden wheat harvest.
items.ex_zh: 农夫们在秋阳下辛勤劳作，收割并将丰饶的金黄麦穗打成捆。

items.def_en: To gather loose objects together and tie or wrap them into a neat package or bundle
items.ex_en: She took a piece of sturdy twine to bundle up the discarded daily newspapers neatly.
items.ex_zh: 她拿了一根结实的麻绳，把废弃的旧报纸整整齐齐地捆扎包好。
items.ex2_en: Children bundle up warmly in thick coats before heading outside into snow.
items.ex2_zh: 孩子们穿上厚外套把自己裹得严严实实，然后跑出户外去雪地里玩耍。

items.def_en: To tie, wrap, or gather several things loosely or tightly into a bundle
items.ex_en: The workers helped bundle the dry firewood neatly before stacking it along the cabin wall.
items.ex_zh: 工人们在把干燥的木柴沿木屋墙壁堆放之前，帮忙将其整齐捆扎成捆。

items.def_en: To compress and bind large amounts of material such as hay, cotton, or paper tightly into a bale
items.ex_en: The heavy agricultural machinery can bale thousands of pounds of dry hay within an hour.
items.ex_zh: 这台大型农用机械能在一小时内将数千磅干草紧压打包成大捆。

items.def_zh: 把……捆成柴捆；用抽纱刺绣法缝合
items.def_en: 1. To bind twigs or sticks together into a bundle. 2. (textiles) To join fabric edges with decorative crisscross stitches.
items.ex_en: The forester stopped to faggot the dry twigs before hauling them back to his cabin.
items.ex_zh: 护林人停下脚步将干燥的细枝扎成柴捆，随后拖回自己的木屋。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to collecting loose sticks, stalks, twigs, or fabrics together and tying them into a compact, manageable bundle or decorative arrangement. They are tightly bound to agricultural, forestry, or crafting contexts.
groups.summary_zh: 把树枝、麦秆或零散物品收集并捆成结实的束或包。
groups.desc_en: To tie, bind, or compress items together physically into a tight, portable package or bale, contrasting with loose stacking.
groups.desc_zh: 用绳索或捆带将物品紧密裹扎、压实成捆，与松散堆叠相对。
groups.nuance_en: bundle: tie or wrap separate articles securely into a compact parcel (sticks / letters / clothes) · bale: compress and bind large volumes of material tightly (hay / cotton / paper) · sheaf: bind cut cereal stalks into formal sheaves (wheat / grain / corn) · truss: tie up tightly and rigidly, often with crossed bonds (fowl / limbs / beams) · faggot: bind sticks or twigs into a bundle for fuel (wood / branches / sticks)
groups.nuance_zh: bundle: 将零散物品打成包裹或捆牢 (sticks / letters / clothes) · bale: 机械压实并打成紧固大包 (hay / cotton / paper) · sheaf: 把割下的谷物庄稼扎成捆 (wheat / grain / corn) · truss: 捆扎紧实牢靠或五花大绑 (fowl / limbs / beams) · faggot: 将柴禾细枝捆成柴把 (wood / branches / sticks)

groups.name: Burl & Pick Clean · 摘疵与剔杂 (Burl, De-knot, Pluck)
groups.tip: 挑拣剔除布料或表面的杂质

items.def_en: To remove small flaws, unwanted pieces, or debris from something using fingers or fine tools.
items.ex_en: The victim was able to pick out the attacker from a lineup of suspects.
items.ex_zh: 受害者能够从一排嫌疑人中指认出袭击者。

items.def_en: To remove unwanted bits, loose yarns, or knots by making swift, short cuts with shears.
items.ex_en: The tailor used miniature shears to snip away loose stray threads from the silk lapel.
items.ex_zh: 裁缝用一把小剪刀修剪除去了丝绸翻领上散落的零星线头。

items.def_en: To smooth the rough edges or remove raised irregularities left on metal or material after working.
items.ex_en: The machinist used a specialized rotary tool to carefully deburr the freshly milled aluminium casing.
items.ex_zh: 机械工使用专用的旋转工具仔细去除了刚铣削好的铝制外壳上的粗糙毛刺。

items.def_en: To remove small knots, slubs, or loose impurities from woven cloth during textile finishing.
items.ex_en: Skilled textile inspectors meticulously burl every yard of premium worsted wool before the final pressing.
items.ex_zh: 熟练的纺织检验员在最终熨烫前，细致地剔除每一码优质精纺羊毛布上的瑕疵线结。

items.def_en: To pull off or detach small threads, feathers, or unwanted items with a quick, snapping motion.
items.ex_en: She paused before the dressing mirror to pluck a stray white hair from her eyebrow.
items.ex_zh: 她在梳妆镜前停下，顺手从眉毛上拔掉了一根零星的白毛。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers precise, delicate manual operations aimed at picking out small knots, slubs, loose threads, burrs, or foreign particles from textiles, raw fleece, or crafted surfaces.
groups.summary_zh: 指手工或工具精细摘除毛料、织物或原料上的疙瘩、毛刺及细小杂质。
groups.desc_en: To remove knots, burrs, loose threads, or small foreign imperfections from a surface or textile to make it smooth and clean, differing from wholesale cutting.
groups.desc_zh: 清除纺织品、毛料或工件表面的毛刺、结块或杂质使其平整光滑，区别于大面积切削。
groups.nuance_en: burl: inspect and pick out knots, loose threads, or burrs from woven fabric (cloth / wool / textile) · deburr: smooth the rough edges or ridges left on metal by machining (metal / edges / part) · pluck: pull or tug out individual small parts with quick motion (feathers / hairs / weeds) · snip away: cleanly clip off tiny unwanted extremities with scissors (threads / tags / ends) · pick out: carefully isolate and remove small unwanted inclusions by hand (debris / stones / knots)
groups.nuance_zh: burl: 剔除织物上的疙瘩、结头或瑕疵毛刺 (cloth / wool / textile) · deburr: 机械去毛刺修除金属边缘 (metal / edges / part) · pluck: 拔出或拔除单根杂质毛发 (feathers / hairs / weeds) · snip away: 用小剪刀快速剪掉毛边线头 (threads / tags / ends) · pick out: 细致挑出拣净杂物碎块 (debris / stones / knots)

groups.name: Burn & Scorch · 灼伤与晒伤 (Sunburn, Scorch, Scald)
groups.tip: 强日光照射导致皮肤发红刺痛

items.def_en: To swell and develop watery pockets beneath the outer layer of skin because of intense heat or sunburn
items.ex_en: Intense exposure to the desert afternoon sun caused his pale shoulders to burn and blister.
items.ex_zh: 烈日下暴露于沙漠午后的阳光，使他白皙的肩膀灼伤并起了水泡。
items.ex2_en: Boiling oil spilled abruptly onto his arm, blistering the sensitive outer skin.
items.ex2_zh: 沸腾的热油突然溅到他的手臂上，把娇嫩的表皮烫起了水泡。

items.def_en: To burn the surface of skin, fabric, or foliage slightly without consuming it completely
items.ex_en: The errant spark flew out of the open fireplace to scorch the expensive wool rug.
items.ex_zh: 飞溅出的火星从敞开的壁炉蹦出，烧焦了昂贵的羊毛地毯表面。
items.ex2_en: Delicate silk shirts scorch quickly under excessively hot household irons without care.
items.ex2_zh: 如果不加小心，娇嫩的真丝衬衫在家用电熨斗的过高温度下很容易被烫焦。

items.def_en: 1. To damage the skin or become damaged, red, and painful from too much exposure to the sun.
items.ex_en: Falling asleep on the midday beach without protective lotion will sunburn your exposed skin severely.
items.ex_zh: 正午未涂防晒霜就在海滩上睡着，会严重晒伤你暴露在外的皮肤。
items.ex2_en: Fair skin sunburns easily when exposed directly to intense midday tropical sunshine.
items.ex2_zh: 白皙的皮肤如果直接暴露在热带强烈的中午阳光下很容易被晒伤。

items.def_zh: 烫伤（由沸水或蒸汽引起）
items.def_en: To burn someone's flesh painful with boiling liquid, steam, or extremely hot vapor
items.ex_en: Careless handling of the pressurized kettle caused the escaping steam to scald his bare wrist.
items.ex_zh: 粗心摆弄加压水壶，导致喷出的蒸汽烫伤了他裸露的手腕。

items.def_zh: 轻微烧焦；烤焦（毛发边缘）
items.def_en: To burn slightly, particularly along hair, eyebrows, or edges, causing localized surface damage
items.ex_en: Leaning too close to the celebratory birthday candles served to singe the tips of her bangs.
items.ex_zh: 靠生日庆祝蜡烛太近，不小心烤焦了她刘海的发梢。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses tissue damage or surface searing caused by intense heat, radiation from the sun, caustic chemicals, or boiling liquids.
groups.summary_zh: 指人体肌肤或组织因日晒、高温或液体而受损灼痛。
groups.desc_en: To cause superficial or painful injury to organic tissue or surface materials by heat, radiation, or hot liquids, contrasting with total incineration.
groups.desc_zh: 由热力、辐射或沸液引起的表层组织或材质烫伤晒焦，与彻底焚化不同。
groups.nuance_en: scorch: burn the surface slightly, discoloring or drying it out (grass / earth / cloth) · scald: injure or burn painfully with hot liquid or steam (skin / throat / hand) · sunburn: burn and inflame the epidermis through excessive ultraviolet exposure (skin / face / shoulders) · singe: burn superficial ends, hair, or surface edges lightly (eyebrows / edges / coat) · blister: cause bubbling swelling on skin or paint from intense heat (skin / paint / lips)
groups.nuance_zh: scorch: 烤焦、灼烫至表面发干变色 (grass / earth / cloth) · scald: 被沸水、热汤或蒸汽烫伤 (skin / throat / hand) · sunburn: 紫外线过量暴露导致的晒伤 (skin / face / shoulders) · singe: 微火燎焦毛发或衣物边缘 (eyebrows / edges / coat) · blister: 高温炙烤使起水泡或表面鼓包 (skin / paint / lips)

groups.name: Burn to Destruction · 焚毁与烧尽 (Burn Down, Burn Out, Scorch)
groups.tip: 烈火吞噬燃烧化为灰烬

items.def_en: Stop burning because there is no more fuel left, or destroy the interior of something by fire.
