items.ex_en: The abandoned warehouse fire was left to burn out once all nearby buildings were secured.
items.ex_zh: 一旦附近所有建筑物脱离危险，废弃仓库的大火便任由其自燃殆尽。

items.def_zh: 燃烧；烧毁；灼伤（burn的过去式及过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. (chiefly British English) Simple past and past participle of burn: to be on fire, damage by heat, or consume by flame.
items.ex_en: The uncontrolled brushfire completely burnt several wooden barns before firefighters could arrive on the scene.
items.ex_zh: 失控的灌木丛大火在消防员赶到现场之前，已将几座木质谷仓彻底烧毁。
items.ex2_en: The dry firewood burnt steadily inside the stone fireplace all night long.
items.ex2_zh: 干燥的木柴在石砌壁炉里平稳地燃烧了整整一夜。

items.def_en: Burn the surface of something with heat or fire, causing discoloration or minor damage.
items.ex_en: Carelessly resting the hot flatiron directly on the linen shirt managed to scorch the fabric.
items.ex_zh: 粗心地将发烫的熨斗直接放在亚麻衬衫上，烤焦了衣服的布料。
items.ex2_en: The tender edges of the garlic bread scorched slightly in the oven.
items.ex2_zh: 大蒜面包娇嫩的边缘在烤箱里微微烤焦了。

items.def_en: Destroy a building or structure completely by fire, or be destroyed in this manner.
items.ex_en: Arsonists set ablaze the historic wooden landmark, causing it to burn down completely overnight.
items.ex_zh: 纵火犯点燃了这座历史悠久的木质地标，导致其在一夜之间彻底被烧成废墟。
items.ex2_en: Invading forces burned down the ancient defensive fortress during the final assault.
items.ex2_zh: 侵略军在最后一次猛攻中将古老的防御要塞彻底烧毁。

items.def_en: Destroy the interior of a building or room completely by fire.
items.ex_en: Raging flames spread rapidly through the boutique hotel to gut the top floor entirely.
items.ex_zh: 肆虐的火焰迅速在精品酒店内蔓延，将整个顶楼的内部完全焚毁殆尽。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on fires that cause structural damage, raze buildings to the ground, or deplete fuel until fire extinguishes itself naturally. It emphasizes physical destruction and ruin caused by flame.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重火势对建筑或物体的物理毁坏，直至完全夷平或燃料耗尽。
groups.desc_en: To consume, ravage, or hollow out something by fire until it is completely ruined, collapsed, or reduced to ashes, contrasting with minor scorching.
groups.desc_zh: 烈火完全吞噬、焚毁或镂空目标使其彻底毁坏化为灰烬，与表面微焦不同。
groups.nuance_en: burn down: destroy completely by fire to the ground (house / barn / building) · gut: destroy the internal structure or contents by raging fire (interior / building / cathedral) · burn out: consume all fuel or inner workings until dead and inoperative (engine / bulb / fuse) · scorch: destroy vegetation or land extensively through scorched-earth tactics (earth / landscape / forest) · burnt: severely damaged or blackened through fire consumption (toast / remains / wreckage)
groups.nuance_zh: burn down: 彻底付之一炬烧成平地 (house / barn / building) · gut: 大火焚毁内部结构留空壳 (interior / building / cathedral) · burn out: 内部烧空燃尽或电气烧蚀坏死 (engine / bulb / fuse) · scorch: 焦土策略性大面积烧荒焚毁 (earth / landscape / forest) · burnt: 被火烧毁、烧焦或损毁殆尽 (toast / remains / wreckage)

groups.name: Burrow & Tunnel · 打洞与钻穴 (Tunnel, Mine, Hole up)
groups.tip: 向地底挖洞钻探藏身

items.def_en: To move incrementally and wriggle through narrow spaces or subterranean passages like an earthworm
items.ex_en: The slender spelunker had to worm through the narrow limestone fissure on his stomach.
items.ex_zh: 身形瘦削的洞穴探险者不得不趴着身子，蜿蜒蠕动穿过狭窄的石灰岩缝隙。

items.def_en: To hide or take shelter inside a concealed hole, burrow, or isolated secure location
items.ex_en: The hunted bank robbers decided to hole up in a remote cabin until nightfall.
items.ex_zh: 被通缉的银行抢劫犯决定隐匿窝藏在一座偏僻的小木屋里，直到夜幕降临。

items.def_en: To dig subterranean pits and galleries beneath the surface to obtain minerals or undermine defenses
items.ex_en: Sappers worked silently beneath the castle walls to mine tunnels and plant explosive kegs.
items.ex_zh: 工兵们在城堡城墙下默默作业，开掘坑道并安放火药桶。

items.def_en: To dig or bore an underground passage through earth, rock, or other dense barriers
items.ex_en: Engineers used heavy machinery to tunnel through the granite mountain for the new railway route.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们使用重型机械凿穿花岗岩大山，为新的铁路线开凿隧道。

items.def_en: 1. To dig a hole or tunnel in the ground, especially for shelter. 2. To press under or snuggle closely into something
items.ex_en: The frightened little rabbit tried to burrow deep under the dense briar hedge for protection.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的小野兔试图深深钻进茂密的野蔷薇树篱下方以求庇护。

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies the manner in which animals or humans dig passageways or holes through solid earth, snow, or obstacles to shelter or navigate underground. 'Burrow' highlights snug, protective animal-style excavation, while 'tunnel' denotes boring an elongated subterranean pathway.
groups.summary_zh: 指动物或人通过泥土或障碍物打洞穿行、构筑掩体或钻营潜入。
groups.desc_en: To excavate, dig, or force an underground passageway or hollow retreat, contrasting with surface excavation by creating an enclosed tunnel or sanctuary.
groups.desc_zh: 在地下或物体内部挖掘、掘通通道或隐蔽巢穴，强调形成封闭涵洞或藏身之处。
groups.nuance_en: burrow: dig a hole or tunnel into the ground for shelter or passage (rabbit / mole / underground) · tunnel: excavate an underground corridor through an obstruction (mountain / way / earth) · mine: excavate subsurface earth to extract minerals or undermine walls (coal / tunnels / defenses) · worm: wiggle or ease oneself through narrow, tight spaces (way / into / through) · hole up: take refuge and hide securely in a secluded shelter (criminal / troops / winter)
groups.nuance_zh: burrow: 动物打洞做窝或钻入藏身 (rabbit / mole / underground) · tunnel: 挖掘贯通地下的涵洞通道 (mountain / way / earth) · mine: 采矿掘进或挖地道以破坚城 (coal / tunnels / defenses) · worm: 像蠕虫般在窄穴曲径中蠕动钻入 (way / into / through) · hole up: 蜷缩躲入封闭巢穴或据点避难 (criminal / troops / winter)

groups.name: Burst Into Fiery Radiance · 烈焰闪烁与燃腾 (Flame, Flare, Blaze)
groups.tip: 如烈火般闪耀炽热光彩

items.def_en: Emit an intense steady light and heat without producing active tall flames.
items.ex_en: The dying campfire embers continued to glow dimly throughout the chilling mountain night.
items.ex_zh: 在寒冷的深山之夜，渐渐熄灭的营火余烬依然持续发出微弱的红光。

items.def_zh: 突然窜起火苗；突然爆发
items.def_en: Burst suddenly into active flame, or suddenly recur or escalate.
items.ex_en: Tensions between rival political groups threatened to flare up into violent street clashes by dusk.
items.ex_zh: 敌对政治团体之间的紧张局势大有在黄昏前突然爆发为街头暴力冲突之势。

items.def_zh: 闪耀，泛起火红色；燃烧，泛红
items.def_en: 1. To shine brightly like fire, gleam intensely, or turn bright red. 2. To burn with a flame.
items.ex_en: Her pale cheeks began to flame with acute embarrassment under his direct, piercing gaze.
items.ex_zh: 在他直视而锐利的目光注视下，她苍白的面颊因极度尴尬而泛起绯红。

items.def_en: Burn with a sudden, unsteady flame or burst into sudden intense light.
items.ex_en: The signal match seemed to flare brightly for an instant before dying out in wind.
items.ex_zh: 信号火柴在狂风中熄灭之前，似乎短暂地猛烈闪光灼亮了一瞬。
items.ex2_en: The stage crew flared brilliant magnesium torches to signal the dramatic entrance.
items.ex2_zh: 舞台工作人员点燃了耀眼的镁光火炬，以提示演员震撼登场。

items.def_en: Burn with a bright, powerful, and intense flame or shine brilliantly.
items.ex_en: Huge dry logs were added to make the hearth blaze warmly against the winter chill.
items.ex_zh: 大块干燥的原木被添了进去，让壁炉熊熊燃烧起来以驱散冬日严寒。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict the sudden or intense visual emission of fire and brilliant light. They highlight vivid visual perception, sudden eruptions of bright light, or burning passionately.
groups.summary_zh: 描述火焰骤然燃腾、爆发出耀眼强光或火星四射的视觉特征。
groups.desc_en: To suddenly or powerfully erupt into intense, brilliant fire and illumination, contrasting with dull, smoldering heat.
groups.desc_zh: 突发或猛烈地喷发迸射出耀眼烈焰与光辉，与阴燃暗火相对。
groups.nuance_en: blaze: burn or shine with intense, steady, and brilliant brightness (fire / sun / anger) · flare up: erupt suddenly with renewed flame, violence, or pain (conflict / fire / symptoms) · flare: burn with a sudden, unsteady, expanding bright burst (match / torch / temper) · flame: burn visibly with active licks of fire (candle / eyes / logs) · glow: emit steady, warm, incandescence without active open leaping flames (embers / skin / coals)
groups.nuance_zh: blaze: 旺盛剧烈地熊熊燃烧或炽盛夺目 (fire / sun / anger) · flare up: 突然死灰复燃迸发烈火或恶化 (conflict / fire / symptoms) · flare: 突发性窜起闪烁外张的强光烈焰 (match / torch / temper) · flame: 舌焰腾起可见跳动火光 (candle / eyes / logs) · glow: 虽无蹿动明火但炽热通红发亮 (embers / skin / coals)

groups.name: Bury & Conceal · 埋藏与隐匿 (Bury, Cache, Stash)
groups.tip: 将物体埋入地下掩盖起来

items.def_zh: 埋藏，掩盖，隐藏；埋葬，安葬
items.def_en: 1. To put something underground and cover it with earth, or conceal it from sight. 2. To place a dead body in a grave or tomb.
items.ex_en: The legendary pirates decided to bury their stolen gold deep beneath an unmarked coastal dune.
items.ex_zh: 富有传奇色彩的海盗们决定把掠夺来的黄金深埋在一处没有标记的沿海沙丘之下。

items.def_en: To put something in a private, safe, or hidden spot where it is unlikely to be seen
items.ex_en: She tucked away the emergency cash behind a loose brick in the pantry.
items.ex_zh: 她把应急现金藏在食品储藏室一块松动的砖块后面。

items.def_en: To store or hide away weapons, food, or valuables in a secret or underground place
items.ex_en: The rebels cached rifles and dried provisions within the mountain's secluded cavern.
items.ex_zh: 叛军将步枪和风干口粮隐匿存放在山中隐秘的洞穴里。

items.def_en: To store something safely and secretly in a hidden location
items.ex_en: He stashed the stolen jewels inside a rusted coffee tin under the floorboards.
items.ex_zh: 他把偷来的珠宝藏在地板下一个生锈的咖啡罐里。

items.def_en: To conceal an object skillfully in a secure hiding place
items.ex_en: The courier secreted the classified microchip inside the lining of his leather jacket.
items.ex_zh: 信使巧妙地将机密芯片藏匿在皮夹克的内衬中。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to concealing objects underground or beneath layers of materials to keep them hidden from discovery, sight, or hostile interference. While 'cache' suggests systematic strategic storage, 'stash' implies rapid or secretive hiding.
groups.summary_zh: 指将物品置于地下或深层遮盖物下藏匿，使之脱离视线。
groups.desc_en: To place something out of sight underground or in a secret, covert location to prevent discovery, contrasting with public storage.
groups.desc_zh: 将物品深藏地下或密匿于隐蔽之处以防被发现，与公开存放不同。
groups.nuance_en: bury: conceal deep underground or submerge completely beneath a mass (treasure / body / head) · stash: store something safely or secretly away for future quick retrieval (cash / weapons / loot) · cache: store away strategically in a secure, hidden hiding place (munitions / food / data) · secrete: conceal small items carefully in an unexpected, obscure cranny (documents / drugs / jewels) · tuck away: stow neatly in a secluded, snug, and unobtrusive location (savings / letter / corner)
groups.nuance_zh: bury: 埋藏于地下或深深隐没覆盖 (treasure / body / head) · stash: 隐秘存留以备日后随时取用 (cash / weapons / loot) · cache: 战术性地秘密储藏重要物资 (munitions / food / data) · secrete: 巧妙密匿在隐蔽缝隙死角 (documents / drugs / jewels) · tuck away: 妥帖收纳塞在偏僻不起眼处 (savings / letter / corner)

groups.name: Bury & Entomb · 掩埋与复葬 (Rebury, Resepulcher, Entomb)
groups.tip: 掘地埋入土中或重新安葬

items.def_en: To cover completely beneath a mass of loose material, earth, or fluid
items.ex_en: A sudden landslide submerged the entire hillside village in wet, churning mud.
items.ex_zh: 突发的山体滑坡将整个半山村落完全淹没在翻滚的湿泥之下。
items.ex2_en: The modern exploratory submarine submerged quietly beneath icy Arctic waters before dawn.
items.ex2_zh: 现代化的勘探潜艇在黎明前悄然潜入冰冷的北极水域之下。

items.def_en: To bury a deceased person's remains again in a new or consecrated grave
items.ex_en: Officials resolved to re-inter the fallen monarch's remains in the royal cathedral.
items.ex_zh: 官员们决定将陨落君主的遗骸重新安葬在皇家大教堂中。

items.def_en: To bury someone or something again in the ground or in a tomb; (past tense and past participle of rebury).
items.ex_en: The recovered ancient artifacts were carefully reburied at the consecrated archaeological site.
items.ex_zh: 找回的古代遗骸被小心地重新掩埋在那处受封圣的考古现场。

items.def_en: To place remains back into a tomb or sealed subterranean resting place
items.ex_en: The monks gathered at midnight to re-entomb the saint's bones within marble.
items.ex_zh: 僧侣们在午夜聚集，将圣徒的遗骨重新封入大理石墓穴之中。

items.def_en: To enclose or entomb someone or something within or as if within walls
items.ex_en: The tyrant decreed to immure his traitorous brother within the fortress foundations.
items.ex_zh: 暴君下令将叛逆的胞弟永远封入要塞的地基高墙之中。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on depositing or returning corpses, artifacts, or substances into a grave or subterranean cavity, often following exhumation, structural collapse, or specialized physical transfer. It emphasizes the physical act of sealing or covering within earth or stone.
groups.summary_zh: 指将遗骸或重物重新埋葬、永久封存或落入地下掩盖。
groups.desc_en: To formally deposit a corpse or relics into a tomb, vault, or the earth with solemn ritual containment, contrasting with mundane hiding.
groups.desc_zh: 依礼制或严密壁障将遗体、骨殖庄重安葬于墓穴、地宫中，与普通掩藏有别。
groups.nuance_en: entomb: enclose a dead body permanently within a tomb, stone sepulcher, or crypt (remains / body / king) · re-inter: rebury skeletal remains or a corpse after disinterment (remains / ashes / bones) · immure: enclose, wall up, or imprison permanently within masonry walls (nun / prisoner / alive) · submerge: completely cover or plunge deeply under water or soil (coffin / wreckage / island) · reburied: placed back into the earth following exhumation or translation (bones / martyr / casket)
groups.nuance_zh: entomb: 严密安放封入石墓或地宫陵寝 (remains / body / king) · re-inter: 遗体迁葬或起掘后重新依礼安葬 (remains / ashes / bones) · immure: 砌入高墙石壁永绝于世 (nun / prisoner / alive) · submerge: 完全没入深水或淤泥埋没 (coffin / wreckage / island) · reburied: 起棺重新入土掩埋掩葬 (bones / martyr / casket)

groups.name: Bury & Inter · 埋葬与安葬 (Inter, Entomb, Inhume)
groups.tip: 丧葬仪式中入土为安

items.def_en: To place a deceased body into the earth; bury formally
items.ex_en: The hermit requested that the villagers inhume his body beneath the ancient oak.
items.ex_zh: 隐士请求村民们将他的遗体土葬在那棵古老橡树之下。

items.def_en: To lay or inter a corpse in a sepulcher or stone tomb
items.ex_en: They bore the fallen knight home to sepulcher him in the ancestral crypt.
items.ex_zh: 他们护送陨落的骑士归乡，将他安葬在祖传的石墓之中。

items.def_en: To bury someone who has died, used especially as a polite or ceremonial euphemism
items.ex_en: The beloved statesman was finally laid to rest beside his wife yesterday afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 昨天下午，这位深受爱戴的政治家终于在他妻子身旁入土为安。

items.def_en: (formal) To place a dead body into a grave or tomb; bury.
items.ex_en: The family gathered at the cemetery to inter the soldier with full honors.
items.ex_zh: 家属齐聚墓园，以全套军礼安葬了这名士兵的遗体。

items.def_en: To place a dead body in a tomb, sepulcher, or crypt, especially permanently
items.ex_en: Centuries ago, priests entombed the pharaoh alongside glittering golden treasures and talismans.
items.ex_zh: 几个世纪前，祭司们将法老与灿烂的金宝护符一同封入幽深墓穴。

groups.summary_en: This formal and ritualistic frame relates to placing human remains into the ground, a tomb, or a sepulcher as part of funeral rites. Verbs like 'inter' and 'inhume' convey solemn, ceremonious mortuary disposal rather than mere physical concealment.
groups.summary_zh: 指正式且庄重地将逝者遗体或骨灰安葬于坟墓或墓穴中。
groups.desc_en: Solemn placement of a deceased body into an earthen grave, crypt, or permanent resting place, emphasizing ritual dignity over mere concealment.
groups.desc_zh: 将遗体庄严安置于墓穴、地宫或永久安息处，侧重礼仪肃穆感而非单纯的遮蔽掩埋。
groups.nuance_en: inter: formal ritual placement into a grave (remains / ashes / body) · entomb: enclose within a tomb, crypt, or masonry chamber (pharaoh / victim / remains) · inhume: archaic or forensic burial in earth (corpse / bones) · lay to rest: euphemistic, dignified final committal (loved one / departed / monarch) · sepulcher: poetic or archaic enshrinement in a burial vault (ancestors / saint)
groups.nuance_zh: inter: 正式入土安葬 (remains / ashes / body) · entomb: 封入石墓、地宫或彻底深埋 (pharaoh / victim / remains) · inhume: 术语或古风之掘地埋葬 (corpse / bones) · lay to rest: 委婉深情的长眠入土 (loved one / departed / monarch) · sepulcher: 诗意或古雅的陵寝安放 (ancestors / saint)

groups.name: Bury & Lay to Rest · 安葬与入土 (Inter, Bury, Inhume)
groups.tip: 将逝者遗体入土埋葬入墓

items.def_en: Deposit a dead body in the earth, a grave, or underneath ground cover
items.ex_en: They chose to bury their grandfather on the hill overlooking his apple orchard.
items.ex_zh: 他们选择把祖父埋葬在俯瞰他苹果园的山丘上。

items.def_en: Bury someone formally and respectfully with customary funeral ceremonies
items.ex_en: Dignitaries gathered at dawn to lay the revered diplomat to rest forever.
items.ex_zh: 政要们在黎明破晓时齐聚，庄重地让受人崇敬的外交官入土为安。

items.def_en: Bury a body in the earth, distinguished from cremation or sea dispersal
items.ex_en: The pious wanderer wished only that the brethren inhume him without stone monuments.
items.ex_zh: 这位虔诚的行者只求同道弟兄将他掘地土葬，勿立石碑。

items.def_en: Place a dead corpse into a grave or tomb, typically with funeral rites
items.ex_en: After solemn prayers, the grieving congregation prepared to inter their departed pastor.
items.ex_zh: 庄严肃穆的祈祷结束后，悲痛的会众准备下葬离世的牧师。

items.def_zh: 将……安葬于墓穴；埋葬，掩埋
items.def_en: To place a dead body in a tomb; to bury or trap someone or something completely under earth or debris.
items.ex_en: A violent avalanche threatened to entomb the expedition beneath tons of packed snow.
items.ex_zh: 一场猛烈的雪崩恐将探险队彻底掩埋在数吨坚冰积雪之下。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the ritual or physical act of laying a deceased body or remains into the earth, a crypt, or a formal burial vault. Nuances differentiate ordinary ground burial, formal ritual interment, and total sepulchral enclosure.
groups.summary_zh: 指将逝者遗体入土、下葬于墓穴或置于陵墓的丧葬仪式与埋葬行为。
groups.desc_en: Depositing a body into the earth or tomb for eternal rest, contrasting with utilitarian discarding or concealment of objects.
groups.desc_zh: 将逝者安葬于地下或墓穴以求永久安息，不同于普通物品的杂乱掩埋或遮藏。
groups.nuance_en: bury: general physical committal to the ground (dead / casket / pet) · lay to rest: tender committal emphasizing closure and peace (patriarch / fallen soldier) · inter: formal, ceremonial burial service (ashes / remains) · entomb: sealed inside a sepulchral structure or permanent enclosure (miners / king / remains) · inhume: technical or literary interment into earth (body / skeleton)
groups.nuance_zh: bury: 最常用的下葬或掩埋 (dead / casket / pet) · lay to rest: 强调抚慰与告别的安息仪式 (patriarch / fallen soldier) · inter: 庄重正式的下葬仪式 (ashes / remains) · entomb: 封入墓室或被岩石掩埋 (miners / king / remains) · inhume: 偏文言或法医学的入土埋葬 (body / skeleton)

groups.name: Bypass & Skirt · 绕行与避开 (Skirt, Bypass, Circumvent)
groups.tip: 沿边缘绕过中心区

items.def_en: To travel along an indirect route around a physical obstruction or detour
items.ex_en: We had to go around the fallen tree blocking the mountain road.
items.ex_zh: 挡在山路上的大树倒了，我们不得不绕行过去。

items.def_zh: 绕过……的边缘，沿……边缘走；回避，绕开（难题）
items.def_en: 1. To go around the outer edge of something rather than through it. 2. To avoid talking about or dealing with a difficult subject directly.
items.ex_en: The narrow path skirted the steep cliff before descending toward the coast.
items.ex_zh: 那条狭窄的小路绕过陡峭悬崖的边缘，随后向下延伸至海岸。

items.def_en: To go around a place, obstacle, or established procedure instead of going through or following it
items.ex_en: Drivers took the newly opened ring road to bypass downtown rush-hour gridlock.
items.ex_zh: 司机们走新开通的环城公路，以绕开市中心的早晚高峰拥堵。

items.def_en: To avoid answering a difficult question or dealing directly with an unpleasant situation
items.ex_en: The politician tried to sidestep the thorny issue during the live debate.
items.ex_zh: 这位政客在现场辩论中试图回避这个棘手的麻烦问题。

items.def_en: To cleverly avoid a difficulty, law, or restriction by finding an indirect path around it
items.ex_en: Shrewd investors exploited regulatory loopholes to circumvent the newly imposed capital controls.
items.ex_zh: 精明的投资者利用监管漏洞巧妙规避了新出台的资本管制。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe travelling along the periphery of a physical obstacle, geographic region, or problem rather than crossing straight through it. By figurative extension, they denote evading sensitive issues, rules, or direct confrontations.
groups.summary_zh: 指沿外沿边缘绕行，或引申为规避敏感问题、规则及正面交锋。
groups.desc_en: Evading an obstacle, regulation, or physical path by navigating around it rather than confronting it directly.
groups.desc_zh: 通过绕行或迂回途径避开障碍、关卡或规则限制，而非迎面硬碰或顺从通行。
groups.nuance_en: bypass: avoid via an alternate route or official hierarchy (town / regulations / committee) · skirt: move along the outer edge or evasively touch upon an issue (periphery / forest / topic) · circumvent: strategically evade or outwit restrictions (sanctions / rules / firewall) · sidestep: dodge adroitly to evade blame or difficulty (question / issue / obstacle) · go around: plain physical detour or procedural detour (blockade / system)
groups.nuance_zh: bypass: 绕过枢纽、关卡或越级处理 (town / regulations / committee) · skirt: 沿边缘绕过或回避敏感话题 (periphery / forest / topic) · circumvent: 巧妙钻空子规避法规或限制 (sanctions / rules / firewall) · sidestep: 敏捷闪避棘手问题或责任 (question / issue / obstacle) · go around: 口语化绕开物理或程序障碍 (blockade / system)

groups.name: Calculate & Compute · 算计与推算 (Compute, Tally, Reckon)
groups.tip: 依公式数字精密计算

items.def_en: To calculate an amount or solve a numerical problem through effort
items.ex_en: Scientists are trying to figure out why the virus mutated so rapidly.
items.ex_zh: 科学家们正试图弄明白这种病毒为何变异得如此之快。

items.def_en: To calculate an answer or amount by using mathematics or specialized machinery
items.ex_en: Sophisticated software must compute the spacecraft's orbital trajectory before the morning launch.
items.ex_zh: 精密的软件必须在明晨发射前精确计算出航天器的轨道轨迹。

items.def_en: To calculate an amount, number, or cost roughly by reasoning or counting
items.ex_en: By my rough guess, I reckon the repairs will cost fifty bucks.
items.ex_zh: 依我粗略估计，这笔维修费用大概要花五十块钱。

items.def_en: To calculate, add up, or keep a continuous record of a total score or quantity
items.ex_en: The election judges stayed up past midnight to tally the remaining ballots.
items.ex_zh: 计票裁判员们熬夜过了午夜，清点剩余的选票。
items.ex2_en: The candidate's personal expense records tally precisely with the published financial receipts.
items.ex2_zh: 该候选人的个人开支记录与公布的财务收据完全吻合。

items.def_zh: 计算，做算术；把……译成密码
items.def_en: 1. (old-fashioned) To calculate or do arithmetic sums. 2. To encode a message into secret cipher writing.
items.ex_en: The lonely clerk would sit by candlelight to cipher complex compound interest.
items.ex_zh: 孤独的职员常常坐在烛光下，埋头计算复杂的复利数额。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses carrying out mathematical computations, determining numeric quantities by rules of arithmetic, or working out formal numerical solutions.
groups.summary_zh: 运用数学运算规则推导求出总和、数量或数值结果。
groups.desc_en: Arriving at a quantitative or logical result through deliberate mathematical reckoning or counting, contrasting with pure intuitive guessing.
groups.desc_zh: 通过细致的数学运算、计数或逻辑步骤得出确切结果，而非凭直觉臆测。
groups.nuance_en: compute: systematically calculate using complex math or machines (value / trajectory / odds) · tally: record and continuously sum counts (scores / votes / expenses) · reckon: estimate mathematically or traditionally calculate (cost / losses / distance) · cipher: archaic or dialectal arithmetic calculation (sums / figures) · figure out: solve through deduction and practical arithmetic (cost / solution / problem)
groups.nuance_zh: compute: 用精密算法或计算机测算 (value / trajectory / odds) · tally: 逐项清点、累加积分或票数 (scores / votes / expenses) · reckon: 统算花费或综合推算 (cost / losses / distance) · cipher: 古旧用法之做算术题或打小算盘 (sums / figures) · figure out: 摸索计算并最终想通解决 (cost / solution / problem)

groups.name: Calculate & Deduce Mentally · 琢磨与推断 (Figure, Reckon, Deduce)
groups.tip: 心中揣摩并得出推断

items.def_zh: 料想，认为，认定；计算；出现，起重要作用
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To think, conclude, or decide that something is the case. 2. To calculate or work out an amount. 3. To be featured or play an important part in something.
items.ex_en: Seeing the dark storm clouds gathering, she figured it would rain soon.
items.ex_zh: 看到乌云密布，她料想很快就会下雨了。

items.def_en: Infer or deduce a conclusion based on clues, conversations, or observation
items.ex_en: From their uncomfortable silence, I gather that the negotiations went very badly.
items.ex_zh: 从他们尴尬的沉默中，我推断出谈判进行得非常糟糕。
items.ex2_en: A lively crowd of eager music fans gathered outside the stadium gates.
items.ex2_zh: 一大群热切的乐迷聚集在体育场大门外。

items.def_en: Find an answer, explanation, or result through deliberate mental calculation and reasoning
items.ex_en: Detectives spent days attempting to work out the killer's intricate escape route.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们花了好几天时间，试图推敲琢磨出凶手复杂的逃跑路线。

items.def_en: Form a considered opinion or conclude from judgment that something is likely true
items.ex_en: I reckon he will change his mind once he hears our proposal.
items.ex_zh: 我琢磨着他一旦听到我们的提议，肯定会改变心意的。

items.def_en: Reach a necessary logical conclusion by systematically examining known principles or evidence
items.ex_en: From the chemical residue, the forensic scientist deduced the bomb's origin.
items.ex_zh: 法医科学家根据化学残留物，演绎推断出了炸弹的来源出处。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on working something out cognitively—either informal estimation of likelihood or structured mental deduction from available facts.
groups.summary_zh: 根据既有线索或事实在脑中推想、揣摩或得出结论。
groups.desc_en: Deducing an unspoken conclusion or forming a judgment mentally, distinct from formal algorithmic calculation.
groups.desc_zh: 在脑海中依循线索揣摩、推理并得出主观判断，不同于纯粹的数字测算。
groups.nuance_en: deduce: infer logically from established premises or facts (conclusion / motive / identity) · reckon: form an informal, experiential judgment or estimate (chances / time / he was right) · figure: ponder and reach an intuitive conclusion (reasons / angle / odds) · gather: infer tentatively from surrounding clues or hearsay (impression / fact) · work out: solve or understand after prolonged mental effort (logic / puzzle / truth)
groups.nuance_zh: deduce: 依逻辑严密推导 (conclusion / motive / identity) · reckon: 凭经验主观估摸或裁断 (chances / time / he was right) · figure: 琢磨判断并得出结论 (reasons / angle / odds) · gather: 从言行线索中体会出、获悉 (impression / fact) · work out: 苦思冥想后参透或理清 (logic / puzzle / truth)

groups.name: Calculate & Reckon · 计算与推算 (Calculate, Compute, Reckon)
groups.tip: 通用计算推演运作

items.def_en: To calculate an amount, or to conclude something logically after consideration
items.ex_en: We figured the total moving expenses would exceed our monthly household budget.
items.ex_zh: 我们核算了一下，总搬家花销恐怕会超出我们每月的家庭预算。

items.def_en: 1. To find a number or amount using mathematics. 2. To estimate or judge a future situation or probability.
items.ex_en: Engineers must calculate the structural load capacity before adding the extra floor.
items.ex_zh: 工程师在加盖额外楼层之前，必须准确核算结构的承载能力。

items.def_en: To calculate the total cost, quantity, or solution to a problem
items.ex_en: The accountant worked out the final tax deductions for the entire quarter.
items.ex_zh: 会计师算出了整个季度最终可抵扣的各项税款金额。

items.def_en: To calculate an amount, value, or answer, often using an automated or systematic process
items.ex_en: The main server requires several seconds to compute the large mathematical dataset.
items.ex_zh: 主服务器需要几秒钟的时间来运算处理这组庞大的数学数据集。

items.def_en: To calculate roughly, estimate an amount, or form a considered judgment
items.ex_en: The builder reckoned that the foundation repairs would take at least fortnight.
items.ex_zh: 建筑工估摸着修好这处地基至少需要两周时间。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses working out numerical quantities, evaluating likelihoods, or mentally estimating outcomes through mathematical procedures or careful reasoning.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过数学演算、逻辑推导或估算得出具体数值与结果。
groups.desc_en: Determining an amount, outcome, or probability by combining numerical reckoning with practical estimation.
groups.desc_zh: 结合数理运算与现实评估来推求数量、成本或结果。
groups.nuance_en: calculate: determine precisely using mathematical procedures or reasoned risk-assessment (risk / distance / trajectory) · compute: process complex data mathematically, often via machine (taxes / algorithm / figures) · reckon: estimate pragmatically based on experience (cost / age / damages) · figure: informally compute or evaluate numbers (budget / tips / percentage) · work out: calculate a final sum or resolve steps through calculation (total / math / payment)
groups.nuance_zh: calculate: 严谨计算或深思熟虑地权衡 (risk / distance / trajectory) · compute: 数据化精密计算 (taxes / algorithm / figures) · reckon: 结合经验估量推算 (cost / age / damages) · figure: 日常心算、结账或打小算盘 (budget / tips / percentage) · work out: 细致算出最终总额或步骤 (total / math / payment)

groups.name: Call & Phone · 电话与呼叫 (Phone, Ring, Dial)
groups.tip: 通过电话等媒介即时呼叫沟通

items.def_en: To communicate with someone by calling them on a telephone
items.ex_en: She promised to phone her grandmother every Sunday afternoon without fail.
items.ex_zh: 她答应每个周日下午都必定会给祖母打电话问候。

items.def_en: (chiefly British) To call someone on the telephone
items.ex_en: I will ring the doctor's surgery first thing tomorrow morning for an appointment.
items.ex_zh: 我明早第一件事就是给诊所致电预约看病时间。

items.def_en: To call or speak to someone using a telephone.
items.ex_en: The nervous witness telephoned the emergency helpline from a nearby public booth.
items.ex_zh: 神色紧张的目击者从附近的公共电话亭拨打了紧急求助热线。

items.def_en: To make a phone call to someone
items.ex_en: Don't forget to call up the supplier to confirm our furniture delivery.
items.ex_zh: 别忘了给供应商打个电话，确认我们家具的送货情况。

items.def_en: To enter a phone number on a keypad to make a telephone call
items.ex_en: In a panic, the frightened child managed to dial the emergency services.
items.ex_zh: 惊慌失措之中，那个吓坏的孩子设法拨打了紧急求救电话。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe reaching out or conversing specifically via telephone or voice call hardware, encompassing dialing, ringing, and holding spoken calls.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过电话或语音通讯工具拨号、呼叫并进行实时语音交谈。
groups.desc_en: Initiating voice communication across a telecommunication channel, contrasting with broadcasting, shouting, or texting.
groups.desc_zh: 通过电信网络发起语音呼叫联络，不同于当面呼喊、广播或文本消息。
groups.nuance_en: dial: enter digits to establish a telephone connection (number / extension / code) · ring: call via phone, highlighting the acoustic alerting of the receiver (office / friend / bell) · phone: initiate a telephone call directly (home / doctor / client) · call up: summon or reach someone by phone, often deliberately (recruits / colleague / archives) · telephone: formal or dated term for telephoning (embassy / headquarters)
groups.nuance_zh: dial: 拨打号码以建立通话 (number / extension / code) · ring: 打电话侧重使对方铃响 (office / friend / bell) · phone: 直接致电联络 (home / doctor / client) · call up: 挂电话联系或特意致电 (recruits / colleague / archives) · telephone: 较为正式或书面化的通电话 (embassy / headquarters)

groups.name: Camp & Bivouac · 扎营与驻扎 (Pitch camp, Bivouac, Settle)
groups.tip: 在某处扎营驻扎长期定居

items.def_zh: 使驻扎；为…提供临时住宿
items.def_en: Provide soldiers or workers with temporary lodging or living accommodations
items.ex_en: The commander ordered his officers to quarter the infantry in civilian billets.
items.ex_zh: 指挥官命令他的军官们将步兵部队安置在民用营房暂住。

items.def_en: Sleep outside in a tent or temporary shelter, especially for recreation
items.ex_en: The family loves to camp out under the stars by the lake.
items.ex_zh: 这家人喜欢在湖畔的星空下搭帐篷宿营度过周末。

items.def_en: Set up tents and prepare temporary accommodation outdoors
items.ex_en: Weary hikers decided to pitch camp before total darkness settled over the valley.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的徒步者决定在黑暗彻底笼罩山谷之前扎营宿夜。

items.def_en: (formal) To set up camp or settle in tents, or cause someone to do so.
items.ex_en: The royal legion encamped upon the windy ridge overlooking the misty plains.
items.ex_zh: 皇家军团在俯瞰雾气弥漫平原的迎风山脊上安营扎寨。

items.def_zh: 露宿；野营（尤指军人无帐篷宿营）
items.def_en: Stay in a temporary camp without tents or proper cover, especially in military contexts
items.ex_en: The exhausted soldiers had to bivouac on the rocky slope without tents.
items.ex_zh: 筋疲力竭的士兵们不得不在没有帐篷的岩石斜坡上露宿露营。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe setting up temporary living quarters outdoors or in the field, ranging from pitching tents for recreation to stationing military troops overnight.
groups.summary_zh: 指在野外或临时地点搭帐篷、安营扎寨或露宿驻扎。
groups.desc_en: Setting up temporary outdoor or tactical shelters for overnight stays, distinct from establishing permanent residences.
groups.desc_zh: 在野外搭建或依托简易掩体临时宿营驻扎，不同于建造永久居所。
groups.nuance_en: pitch camp: erect tents to establish a formal temporary campsite (explorers / army / scouts) · bivouac: camp overnight outdoors without tents or with rudimentary shelter (mountaineers / platoon / hikers) · encamp: settle troops or large parties in an organized camp (regiment / travelers) · quarter: lodge troops in specific assigned buildings or billets (soldiers / garrison) · camp out: sleep in tents or open air for recreation or protest (campers / fans / demonstrators)
groups.nuance_zh: pitch camp: 支起帐篷扎下正规营地 (explorers / army / scouts) · bivouac: 无帐篷露宿或搭简陋避难所宿营 (mountaineers / platoon / hikers) · encamp: 成规模的大部队安营扎寨 (regiment / travelers) · quarter: 将军队分派进驻房舍宿营 (soldiers / garrison) · camp out: 野营露宿或为排队/抗议露天过夜 (campers / fans / demonstrators)

groups.name: Capitulate & Cave In · 彻底妥协与屈服 (Capitulate, Cave In, Succumb)
groups.tip: 认输受降举白旗

items.def_en: (+ to) To finally stop opposing something and agree to demands after resistance
items.ex_en: Management refused to cave in to the striking union's unreasonable pay demands.
items.ex_zh: 管理层拒绝向罢工工会提出的不合理薪资要求服软让步。

items.def_en: (+ to) To accept someone else's authority or pressure and do what they dictate
items.ex_en: The proud craftsman refused to knuckle under to the landlord's petty threats.
items.ex_zh: 那位心高气傲的手艺人绝不向房东琐屑的恐吓低头屈从。

items.def_en: (+ under) To collapse mentally or surrender to extreme pressure or opposition
items.ex_en: The young defense lawyer would not buckle under the prosecutor's immense pressure.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的辩护律师在检察官施加的巨大压力下并未退缩屈服。
items.ex2_en: Extreme hydraulic force buckled the steel support beams inside the collapsed tunnel.
items.ex2_zh: 极大的水压压垮了坍塌隧道内的钢支撑梁。

items.def_en: (+ to) To stop opposing someone or something stronger and accept defeat
items.ex_en: After hours of stubborn questioning, the weary suspect finally succumbed to fatigue.
items.ex_zh: 经过数小时的顽强审问，疲惫的嫌疑人最终屈服于精力枯竭。

items.def_en: 1. (+ to) (formal) To stop resisting an enemy or strong pressure and surrender, especially on agreed conditions.
items.ex_en: Besieged by relentless forces, the garrison had no choice but to capitulate.
items.ex_zh: 在敌军无休止的猛烈围攻下，守备部队别无选择只能开城投降。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on ceasing all resistance after sustained pressure or confrontation and accepting defeat or dictated terms.
groups.summary_zh: 强调在顽强抵抗或长期施压后最终妥协认输、不再反抗。
groups.desc_en: Surrendering resistance and yielding completely under overwhelming physical, moral, or coercive pressure.
groups.desc_zh: 在压倒性的外部压力、强权或困境下放弃抵抗、彻底认输妥协。
groups.nuance_en: capitulate: surrender conditionally or unconditionally to demands after resisting (garrison / government / negotiator) · cave in: collapse completely and yield under intense pressure or intimidation (management / witness / demands) · knuckle under: submit obsequiously to an authority or bully (regime / boss / pressure) · buckle: crumple physically or emotionally under heavy strain (knees / resolve / pressure) · succumb: be overcome fatally or yield passively to temptation/illness (temptation / illness / injuries)
groups.nuance_zh: capitulate: 正式停火认输或向严苛要求彻底屈服 (garrison / government / negotiator) · cave in: 顶不住施压而全线崩塌让步 (management / witness / demands) · knuckle under: 认怂低头听命于强权 (regime / boss / pressure) · buckle: 承受不住重荷而垮掉或屈膝 (knees / resolve / pressure) · succumb: 终因无力招架而陷落、病故或屈服 (temptation / illness / injuries)

groups.name: Card & Tease Fibers · 梳理纤维与除杂 (Card, Comb, Scutch)
groups.tip: 用梳齿梳理纤维并剔除杂物

items.def_en: Shake or comb fibers or soft materials to make them light, airy, and loose
items.ex_en: The maid took time to fluff up the goose-down pillows each morning.
items.ex_zh: 女仆每天早晨都会花时间把鹅绒枕头用力抖得蓬松柔软。

items.def_zh: 梳理（羊毛、棉花等纤维）；记于卡片上
items.def_en: To comb and clean raw wool, cotton, or other fibers using a wire-toothed brush before spinning.
items.ex_en: The weaver sat by the hearth to card the coarse, tangled wool.
items.ex_zh: 织工坐在壁炉旁，耐心地用钢丝梳梳理粗糙打结的羊毛。

items.def_en: Prepare textile fibers for spinning by aligning long fibers and eliminating short ones and impurities
items.ex_en: Textile workers comb raw flax fibers thoroughly before feeding them into spinners.
items.ex_zh: 纺织工人在把亚麻原料喂入纺纱机前会将其彻底梳理平整。

items.def_en: Separate raw cotton fibers from seeds using a mechanical cotton gin
items.ex_en: The plantation laborers worked all afternoon to gin the freshly picked cotton.
items.ex_zh: 种植园的劳工们整个下午都在忙着轧除新采棉花中的棉籽。

items.def_en: Separate the woody husk from flax, hemp, or cotton by beating with a wooden blade
items.ex_en: Using flat wooden blades, the farmers scutched harvested hemp along the riverbank.
items.ex_zh: 农夫们挥舞着扁平木刀，在河岸边用力打落收割麻杆的木质硬壳。

groups.summary_en: Industrial and craft verbs denoting combing raw fleece, wool, cotton, or bast fibers with spiked cards to remove debris, separate strands, and ready them for spinning.
groups.summary_zh: 指在纺纱前使用毛刷或梳理机清洁生纤维并理顺杂质。
groups.desc_en: Mechanical disentangling, cleaning, and aligning of raw fibers to prepare them for spinning, distinct from simple hair grooming.
groups.desc_zh: 机械梳理、松解并去除原纺纤维中的杂质以备纺纱，区别于日常梳头打扮。
groups.nuance_en: card: disentangle and align raw staple fibers using toothed wire boards (wool / cotton / fleece) · comb: remove short fibers and parallelize long fibers for fine spinning (worsted wool / flax / locks) · scutch: beat woody impurities out of retted fibers (flax / hemp / straw) · gin: separate seed and chaff from raw fibers mechanically (cotton) · fluff up: tease and shake fibers to restore volume (feathers / wool / pillow)
groups.nuance_zh: card: 用钢丝梳理板粗梳原毛或棉花 (wool / cotton / fleece) · comb: 精梳排除短绒使纤维顺直 (worsted wool / flax / locks) · scutch: 拍打打麻以去骨除壳 (flax / hemp / straw) · gin: 轧花机脱籽除渣 (cotton) · fluff up: 抖松理散以恢复膨松 (feathers / wool / pillow)

groups.name: Carry & Lug · 吃力搬运 (Cart, Haul, Tote, Schlepp)
groups.tip: 费力拖运沉重行李物品

items.def_en: To carry or haul something substantial around by hand or over one's shoulder
items.ex_en: She had to tote a heavy bag of textbooks across campus daily.
items.ex_zh: 她每天都不得不扛着一满包沉甸甸的教科书穿过校园。

items.def_en: To convey or haul heavy, clumsy, or unwanted items from one place to another
items.ex_en: The volunteers carted wheelbarrows of broken plaster out to the curbside dumpster.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者们用车推着一车车碎石膏块，费力运到路边的垃圾箱。

items.def_en: To pull or transport something heavy or cumbersome slowly and with continuous effort
items.ex_en: Tugboats worked tirelessly to haul the disabled container vessel into the harbor.
items.ex_zh: 拖船不知疲倦地工作，奋力将那艘抛锚的集装箱货轮拖入港口。

items.def_zh: 费劲拉扯，苦哈哈地搬运
items.def_en: To haul or drag oneself or a heavy load along awkwardly and reluctantly
items.ex_en: I hated having to schlepp my oversized luggage through crowded subway corridors.
items.ex_zh: 我实在讨厌苦哈哈地拖着超大行李箱穿过拥挤的地铁走廊通道。

items.def_en: To carry or drag something heavy with a lot of effort.
items.ex_en: He had to lug the heavy iron toolbox up five flight stairs.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不费力地把那个沉重的大铁工具箱扛上五层楼梯。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame emphasize the intense physical strain, awkwardness, and sustained effort involved in moving bulky, heavy objects over distance without mechanical aid.
groups.summary_zh: 着重搬运笨重、沉重或不规则物品时所耗费的体力与费力拖带感。
groups.desc_en: Transporting heavy, cumbersome loads requiring notable physical exertion or tedious effort, contrasting with effortless conveying.
groups.desc_zh: 费力搬运沉重、笨重或繁琐的物品，强调体力消耗或劳顿感，区别于轻松携带。
groups.nuance_en: lug: drag or carry a heavy, awkward load with strain (suitcase / crate / battery) · haul: pull or transport heavy loads over distance, often by vehicle (freight / timber / catch) · tote: carry light-to-medium gear around habitually (bag / gun / groceries) · schlepp: drag oneself or an annoying burden tediously (packages / gear / kids) · cart: transport bulk materials in a wheeled conveyance (dirt / debris / groceries)
groups.nuance_zh: lug: 极其费劲地提拎沉重或别扭之物 (suitcase / crate / battery) · haul: 大力拖拉或长途载运大宗重物 (freight / timber / catch) · tote: 随身背负、挎携物品 (bag / gun / groceries) · schlepp: 劳累拖沓地折腾搬运沉重杂物 (packages / gear / kids) · cart: 用板车、手推车推运装载 (dirt / debris / groceries)

groups.name: Categorize & Pigeonhole · 分门别类 (Assort, Categorize, Pigeonhole)
groups.tip: 按属性归类分门别类

items.def_en: To put documents or records into a filing system under specific headings
items.ex_en: She filed away the advice for future reference.
items.ex_zh: 她把这条建议记在心里，以备日后参考。

items.def_en: To place people or things into particular classes or groups according to shared characteristics
items.ex_en: Biologists strictly categorize specimens based on their unique cellular structures and genetics.
items.ex_zh: 生物学家严格根据标本独特的细胞结构和遗传特征来进行分类归样。

items.def_zh: 把……分类，把……分门别类；相称，协调
items.def_en: 1. To classify, sort, or arrange things into categories. 2. (assort with) (archaic) To match or harmonize with.
items.ex_en: The curator carefully assorted the antique coins according to their respective dynasties.
items.ex_zh: 馆长按照各自所处的朝代，悉心将那些古钱币分门别类。

items.def_en: To classify someone or something into a rigid, often oversimplified category
items.ex_en: Critics often pigeonhole her diverse musical output as mere bubblegum pop.
items.ex_zh: 评论家们常常死板地将她多样的音乐作品归类为微不足道的泡泡糖流行乐。

items.def_en: To divide into discrete, isolated sections, categories, or compartments
items.ex_en: Senior executives must learn to compartmentalize complex organizational workflows across departments.
items.ex_zh: 高级管理人员必须学会将跨部门的复杂组织工作流明确划分开来。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to sorting, grouping, or labeling items according to characteristics, criteria, or predetermined categories, sometimes rigidly or schematically.
groups.summary_zh: 指依据性质、类别或固定框架对物品或概念进行归类与分档。
groups.desc_en: Systematically sorting diverse entities into distinct structural compartments or classes, contrasting with random grouping.
groups.desc_zh: 将纷乱事物按预设体系分门别类归档，不同于随意堆放或粗放组合。
groups.nuance_en: categorize: assign items systematically to defined logical classes (data / expenses / species) · pigeonhole: rigidly force into an oversimplified classification (ideas / talents / manuscripts) · compartmentalize: separate conflicting thoughts or items into isolated domains (feelings / life / duties) · assort: sort and arrange items into graded varieties (goods / seeds / gems) · file away: store systematically in records or mental repositories (documents / memories / receipts)
groups.nuance_zh: categorize: 系统且有条理地归类 (data / expenses / species) · pigeonhole: 僵化或过分狭隘地分类搁置 (ideas / talents / manuscripts) · compartmentalize: 心理隔绝或切分为独立单元 (feelings / life / duties) · assort: 按品种、等级分拣搭配 (goods / seeds / gems) · file away: 建档存放或在记忆中归类 (documents / memories / receipts)

groups.name: Categorize & Pigeonhole · 归类与标签化 (Label, Stereotype, Brand)
groups.tip: 给物品或概念贴上标签符号

items.def_en: (+ as) To identify or describe someone publicly and permanently as bad, untrustworthy, or criminal
items.ex_en: The controversial tabloid article branded the young diplomat as a dangerous spy.
items.ex_zh: 那篇引发争议的八卦报道将这位年轻外交官污蔑为危险的间谍。

items.def_zh: 贴标签于，打上标记；归类，把……称为
items.def_en: 1. To attach a label to something. 2. (+ as) To describe or assign a category to someone or something, often unfairly.
items.ex_en: Media outlets swiftly labeled the sudden industrial shutdown as a total catastrophe.
items.ex_zh: 各大媒体迅速将这次突如其来的工业停产定性为一场彻头彻尾的灾难。

items.def_en: To place people or things into specific classes or divisions according to shared attributes
items.ex_en: Researchers carefully categorize the botanical specimens based on their unique cellular structures.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员根据植物标本独特的细胞结构对其进行仔细分类。

items.def_zh: 把……不合理地归类；妄加分类
items.def_en: To classify someone or something rigidly into an oversimplified category or mental compartment
items.ex_en: Do not pigeonhole this talented author as simply a conventional mystery writer.
items.ex_zh: 不要把这位才华横溢的作家狭隘地归类为一个普通的悬疑小说家。

items.def_en: To repeatedly assign an actor or person only to one specific, predictable role or character type
items.ex_en: He feared that playing another villain would forever typecast him in Hollywood.
items.ex_zh: 他担心再次饰演反派会让他在好莱坞永远被定型。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on classifying, characterizing, or assigning descriptive identities to people, behaviors, or things—frequently with an oversimplified, restrictive, or stigmatizing nuance.
groups.summary_zh: 将人或事物贴标签归类、定性描述，常带有片面化或刻板印象意味。
groups.desc_en: Fixing a reductive, indelible social or conceptual tag onto someone or something, distinct from objective scientific taxonomy.
groups.desc_zh: 给主体强加单一、简化或固化的定性标签，不同于客观中立的学术分类。
groups.nuance_en: label: attach a simplistic or evaluative descriptor to someone (traitor / extremist / genius) · brand: mark publicly and pejoratively with enduring stigma (coward / fraud / liar) · pigeonhole: constrain someone within an excessively narrow category (writer / politician / youth) · stereotype: treat an individual as an unvarying exemplar of a group (minorities / gender / culture) · typecast: repeatedly assign an actor or person to one stereotyped role (actor / performer / villain)
groups.nuance_zh: label: 贴上简化或评判性标签 (traitor / extremist / genius) · brand: 公开指责并打上耻辱印记 (coward / fraud / liar) · pigeonhole: 狭隘定性、限制其发展可能 (writer / politician / youth) · stereotype: 刻板印象化 (minorities / gender / culture) · typecast: 让演员或个人固定饰演某类脸谱化角色 (actor / performer / villain)

groups.name: Cause & Render · 致使与转化 (Make, Leave, Turn)
groups.tip: 引发变化使其陷入某种状态

items.def_en: to cause someone or something to be in a specified condition, state, or mood
items.ex_en: The surprising announcement made the anxious employees feel instantly relieved and hopeful.
items.ex_zh: 这一令人意外的公告让焦虑的员工们立刻感到释然并重燃希望。

items.def_en: (+ into) to cause someone or something to change into a completely different state, nature, or appearance
items.ex_en: Sudden heavy rainfall turned the dusty playground into a muddy swamp overnight.
items.ex_zh: 突降的暴雨一夜之间将尘土飞扬的操场变成了泥泞的沼泽。
items.ex2_en: The quiet rural village turned into a bustling tourist resort after construction.
items.ex2_zh: 建设完工后，这个宁静的乡村小镇变成了一个繁华的旅游胜地。

items.def_zh: 使处于（某种残留状态或结果）
items.def_en: to cause someone or something to remain in a particular state or condition as a result of an action
items.ex_en: The bitter arguments left the once united family completely divided and unhappy.
items.ex_zh: 激烈的争吵让曾经团结的家庭彻底陷入分裂与痛苦之中。

items.def_zh: 逼得，促使（陷入极端状态）
items.def_en: to force or propel someone into an extreme mental, emotional, or physical state
items.ex_en: Relentless academic pressure drove the exhausted student to severe emotional burnout.
items.ex_zh: 持续不断的学业压力迫使那位精疲力竭的学生陷入严重的心理崩溃。

items.def_zh: 致使，使处于某种状态；给予，提供；翻译；表现
items.def_en: 1. to cause someone or something to be in a particular state or condition 2. to give, provide, or submit assistance, a service, or a verdict 3. to translate, depict, or perform something
items.ex_en: The unprecedented software crash rendered the hospital's scheduling system entirely useless.
items.ex_zh: 前所未有的软件崩溃导致医院的排班系统完全瘫痪。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe causing a person, object, or situation to pass into a particular state, condition, or status. While 'render' often implies an involuntary or debilitating result, others emphasize physical transformation, intentional causation, or resulting residual states.
groups.summary_zh: 表示使人或事物转入某种特定状态或境地。
groups.desc_en: Inducing an alteration that leaves an entity in a transformed condition, distinct from generating an object de novo.
groups.desc_zh: 施加作用或变故，致使对象转变为某种状态，区别于凭空创造实体。
groups.nuance_en: render: cause to enter a helpless, defective, or specific state, often formal (speechless / obsolete / useless) · make: universally cause to be or feel a certain way (happy / sick / possible) · turn: transform inherently in color, temperament, or loyalty (sour / traitor / green) · leave: result in a lingering aftermath or residual condition (scars / destitute / devastated) · drive: forcefully compel someone into an extreme mental state (mad / crazy / to despair)
groups.nuance_zh: render: 正式用法，使沦为无力、废止或特定状态 (speechless / obsolete / useless) · make: 最广泛使用的致使、使变为 (happy / sick / possible) · turn: 性质、颜色或立场发生骤变 (sour / traitor / green) · leave: 事后留下某种余态或残留后果 (scars / destitute / devastated) · drive: 剧烈刺激逼至极端心境 (mad / crazy / to despair)

groups.name: Cavalry & Blade Cleaving · 劈砍与剑击 (Saber, Cleave, Hack)
groups.tip: 挥动马刀或利刃砍削劈杀

items.def_zh: 用马刀劈砍，用军刀击杀
items.def_en: to strike, cut, or kill someone with a saber
items.ex_en: The mounted hussar saber the enemy captain before breaking through their line.
items.ex_zh: 骑兵骠骑挥动马刀击杀了敌军上尉，随后突破了防线。

items.def_en: To cut or chop roughly, violently, and repeatedly with a heavy blade
items.ex_en: Tired explorers used sharp machetes to hack through the dense tropical undergrowth.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的探险家们用锋利的开山刀乱砍穿过茂密的热带灌木丛。

items.def_en: To strike or sever with an ax, sword, or other heavy cutting weapon
items.ex_en: The legendary warrior hewed his armored opponents without a trace of mercy.
items.ex_zh: 那位传奇勇士毫无怜悯地挥刀砍向身披重甲的对手。

items.def_en: To kill or seriously incapacitate someone with a blow or weapon in combat
items.ex_en: The brave commander was struck down by enemy gunfire during the battle.
items.ex_zh: 英勇的指挥官在战斗中被敌人的炮火击毙。

items.def_en: To split or sever something forcefully with a sharp, heavy bladed weapon
items.ex_en: With one mighty swing, the knight cleaved the iron helmet in two.
items.ex_zh: 骑士猛力一挥，将铁盔劈成了两半。
items.ex2_en: Brittle sea ice cleaved cleanly into two massive floes under heavy pressure.
items.ex2_zh: 脆弱的海冰在巨大的压力下干脆利落地裂成了两大块浮冰。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe delivering sweeping, brutal strokes with heavy bladed instruments (swords, sabers, axes) to pierce armor, wound, or execute combatants.
groups.summary_zh: 指使用军刀、阔剑或重斧等兵刃进行凶猛砍劈与肉搏杀伤。
groups.desc_en: Inflicting destructive cuts and split fractures using heavy bladed weaponry, distinct from fine surgical slicing or stabbing.
groups.desc_zh: 挥舞沉重刃具进行劈打、削斩以致肢解剖开，不同于精细切削或刺戳。
groups.nuance_en: cleave: split cleanly and forcefully into two parts (skull / bone / rock) · hack: chop roughly and repeatedly with crude, heavy blows (path / limbs / flesh) · hew: strike and shape heavily with an axe or blade (timber / stone / head) · saber: slash or cut down with a curved cavalry sword (fugitives / enemy / troops) · strike down: fell lethally with a heavy weapon blow or plague (foe / victim / warrior)
groups.nuance_zh: cleave: 凌厉劈开、断为两半 (skull / bone / rock) · hack: 粗乱残暴地乱砍乱劈 (path / limbs / flesh) · hew: 用大斧或刀重力劈斫削凿 (timber / stone / head) · saber: 骑兵挥动马刀挥砍扑杀 (fugitives / enemy / troops) · strike down: 猛击将其劈倒杀死 (foe / victim / warrior)

groups.name: Cavort & Frisk · 嬉戏欢蹦 (Frisk, Caper, Disport)
groups.tip: 欢快雀跃或轻快打闹玩乐

items.def_en: (literary) To enjoy oneself unrestrainedly, especially by sporting or leaping about
items.ex_en: Joyful youths disported themselves along the sunlit shores until dusk descended peacefully.
items.ex_zh: 欢快的年轻人们在阳光明媚的海岸边尽情嬉戏，直至暮色宁静降临。

items.def_en: To skip, jump, or dance about in an energetic, playful, and carefree way
items.ex_en: Carefree children capered across the lush green meadow under the morning sunshine.
items.ex_zh: 无忧无虑的孩子们在晨光下的郁郁葱葱的草地上雀跃起舞。

items.def_en: (of an animal or child) To skip or leap playfully and briskly
items.ex_en: Young lambs frisked energetically across the rolling pastures during early spring mornings.
items.ex_zh: 初春的清晨，小羊羔在起伏的牧场上欢快地蹦跳。

items.def_en: To make playful leaps or perform mischievous, amusing antics
items.ex_en: The court jester cut capers across the throne room to amuse guests.
items.ex_zh: 宫廷弄臣在王座大厅里滑稽蹦跳翻筋斗以逗乐宾客。

items.def_zh: 欢跃，雀跃玩耍，打闹嬉戏
items.def_en: (+ around/about) To jump, dance, and play around in a lively, noisy, and uninhibited way.
items.ex_en: Playful dolphins cavorted about the fishing boat as it sailed into harbor.
items.ex_zh: 渔船驶入海港时，嬉闹的海豚在船只周围欢快地翻滚跃动。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here emphasize dynamic, sometimes flamboyant or illicit kinetic abandon—bounding, whirling, or cutting capers without restraint. The movement is visibly loud, uninhibited, and theatrical.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重动作幅度大、张扬放肆或略带喧闹的跳跃、翩跹与欢快移动。
groups.desc_en: Leaping, bounding, and playing in a frolicsome, unrestrained display of exuberant energy, distinct from regulated athletic dancing.
groups.desc_zh: 精力旺盛地欢腾跳跃、嬉耍蹦跳，不同于规范的舞蹈或常规体育锻炼。
groups.nuance_en: cavort: romp around excitedly with boisterous bounding (lambs / dancers / children) · caper: leap or skip about playfully in high spirits (faun / kids / dancers) · frisk: skip and frolic lightly, especially young animals (colts / lambs / puppies) · disport: engage ostentatiously in self-indulgent diversion or swimming (bathers / dolphins / court) · cut capers: execute playful physical antics or pranks (clowns / youths / performers)
groups.nuance_zh: cavort: 兴高采烈地欢腾跳跃或打闹 (lambs / dancers / children) · caper: 欢欣雀跃、蹦蹦跳跳 (faun / kids / dancers) · frisk: 幼兽或孩童轻盈欢快地嬉戏蹦跳 (colts / lambs / puppies) · disport: 悠游玩耍、自娱自乐 (bathers / dolphins / court) · cut capers: 耍闹嬉戏、做滑稽的雀跃动作 (clowns / youths / performers)

groups.name: Celebrate & Commemorate · 庆祝与纪念 (Commemorate, Mark, Honor)
groups.tip: 以欢庆或庄严仪式缅怀重要节点

items.def_en: Celebrate or officially recognize an important anniversary, milestone, or turning point
items.ex_en: The university planned a grand symposium to mark its centennial anniversary successfully.
items.ex_zh: 该大学策划了一场盛大的专题研讨会，以隆重庆祝其建校一百周年。

items.def_en: 1. To do something enjoyable to mark an important day or event. 2. To praise or honor someone or something publicly.
items.ex_en: Friends and neighbors gathered together to celebrate her miraculous recovery from illness.
items.ex_zh: 朋友和邻居们聚在一起，庆祝她从重病中奇迹般康复。

items.def_en: Show deep respect, admiration, or public appreciation for someone's accomplishments
items.ex_en: The academy gathered to honor the distinguished scientist for lifetime civic contributions.
items.ex_zh: 学院齐聚一堂，表彰这位杰出科学家终生为公众所作出的贡献。

items.def_en: Remember and pay respect to an important person or historical event by a special ceremony or tribute
items.ex_en: A marble monument was erected to commemorate the fallen soldiers of peace.
items.ex_zh: 人们竖立起一座大理石纪念碑，以缅怀捍卫和平的阵亡将士。

items.def_zh: 大加赞美，盛情款待设宴庆祝
items.def_en: Praise, welcome, or celebrate someone lavishly and publicly with special entertainment or banquets
items.ex_en: The city council feted the victorious Olympic athletes with an extravagant banquet.
items.ex_zh: 市议会设盛宴隆重款待凯旋的奥运健儿。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame relate to acknowledging significant dates, triumphs, or notable persons through formal ceremonies, festive gatherings, solemn remembrances, or public tributes.
groups.summary_zh: 指以欢庆聚会、仪式或庄重形式纪念盛事、重大功绩及先贤。
groups.desc_en: Publicly observing an event, milestone, or person with festive joy or reverent tribute, distinct from routine acknowledgment.
groups.desc_zh: 以欢庆仪式或虔诚祭仪公开缅怀、表彰历史事件或杰出人物，区别于日常随意的提及。
groups.nuance_en: celebrate: rejoice enthusiastically over an achievement or happy occasion (victory / birthday / anniversary) · commemorate: honor the solemn memory of a historical event or deceased person (fallen / centenary / sacrifice) · mark: denote or signify a temporal milestone formally (jubilee / milestone / passing) · honor: pay profound respect, recognition, or award to (veterans / heroes / tradition) · fete: lavishly wine, dine, and entertain a celebrated figure (guest / champion / dignitary)
groups.nuance_zh: celebrate: 欢欣鼓舞地庆祝喜事或成就 (victory / birthday / anniversary) · commemorate: 严肃庄重地纪念历史事件或逝者 (fallen / centenary / sacrifice) · mark: 成为标志、标志着重要节点 (jubilee / milestone / passing) · honor: 致敬、褒奖以示崇高敬意 (veterans / heroes / tradition) · fete: 盛宴款待、大张旗鼓地礼赞主角 (guest / champion / dignitary)

groups.name: Center & Focus · 聚焦与汇拢 (Focus, Converge, Cluster)
groups.tip: 将中心或焦点移向正中央

items.def_en: (+ around/round) to gather or arrange together in a close group around a central spot
items.ex_en: Anxious reporters clustered around the embassy gates awaiting the ambassador's final statement.
items.ex_zh: 焦急的记者们聚集在大使馆大门周围，等待大使的最终声明。
items.ex2_en: The biology teacher clustered the experimental plant pots closely beneath the grow lamp.
items.ex2_zh: 生物老师把实验用的植物花盆紧密地聚集在植物生长灯下方。

items.def_zh: 居中，将……置于中央；（使）集中于，聚焦于
items.def_en: 1. to place or position something at or in the center. 2. (center on/around) to have something as the main subject or focus, or direct attention toward it.
items.ex_en: The ongoing discussions center on resolving critical regional environmental protection issues effectively.
items.ex_zh: 正在进行的讨论主要围绕如何有效解决关键的区域环境保护问题展开。
items.ex2_en: The architect centered the crystal chandelier directly above the mahogany dining table.
items.ex2_zh: 建筑师把水晶吊灯直接居中安装在红木餐桌正上方。

items.def_en: (+ on) to direct attention, energy, or light directly onto a central point or objective
items.ex_en: Students must focus on developing solid analytical thinking skills during graduate school.
items.ex_zh: 学生们在研究生期间必须集中精力培养扎实的分析思维能力。
items.ex2_en: The optical lens focuses ambient sunlight onto a small ignition point outdoors.
items.ex2_zh: 光学透镜将周围的阳光聚焦在室外的一个微小着火点上。

items.def_en: (+ on) to move from different directions towards an identical central meeting point
items.ex_en: Protesters from across the state converged on the capitol square at noon.
items.ex_zh: 来自全州各地的抗议者于正午时分汇聚在州议会广场上。

items.def_en: (+ on) to direct full attention or aim with high precision toward a particular target or center
items.ex_en: The investigative audit quickly zeroed in on several unexplained offshore financial transfers.
items.ex_zh: 调查审计迅速锁定了数笔无法解释的离岸资金转移。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate placing an entity precisely at a focal midpoint, or concentrating attention, forces, and resources toward a single pivot.
groups.summary_zh: 指使物体居中，或将注意力、力量聚集汇合于一点。
groups.desc_en: Directing perception, energy, or distributed elements inward toward a single pivotal locus, contrasting with scattering or parallel diffusion.
groups.desc_zh: 将注意力、能量或分散要素向核心焦点收敛汇聚，区别于平行发散或分散稀释。
groups.nuance_en: focus: bring rays, vision, or mental attention to a sharp point (attention / lens / efforts) · center: position structurally around a middle point or primary theme (discussion / life / axis) · converge: move toward each other and meet at one geographic or intellectual point (crowds / paths / opinions) · zero in: systematically narrow aim directly onto a target (target / problem / location) · cluster: gather closely into a compact clump or aggregate (satellites / stars / spectators)
groups.nuance_zh: focus: 调焦使清晰、将精力高度聚焦 (attention / lens / efforts) · center: 以……为中心布局或围绕核心轴展开 (discussion / life / axis) · converge: 从不同方向汇聚相交于一点 (crowds / paths / opinions) · zero in: 锁定靶心、步步逼近核心破局点 (target / problem / location) · cluster: 密集成群簇拥于一处 (satellites / stars / spectators)

groups.name: Centralize & Consolidate · 集权与统合 (Consolidate, Concentrate, Streamline)
groups.tip: 权力收拢中央并巩固统治

items.def_en: to bring together power, control, or resources into one focal place or authority
items.ex_en: The new legislation concentrated vast regulatory authority within a single central agency.
items.ex_zh: 新立法将庞大的监管权力集中到了一个中央机构手中。
items.ex2_en: Commercial wealth and intellectual resources concentrate heavily in thriving capital cities nationwide.
items.ex2_zh: 商业财富和智力资源在全国繁荣的首都城市高度集中。

items.def_en: to combine multiple things into a single more effective whole, or solidify power
items.ex_en: The prime minister sought to consolidate political power before calling early elections.
items.ex_zh: 首相试图在宣布提前举行大选之前进一步巩固政治权力。
items.ex2_en: The fragmented regional companies consolidated successfully into a dominant national telecommunications powerhouse.
items.ex2_zh: 这些分散的地方公司成功合并，成为占据主导地位的全国性电信巨头。

items.def_en: to bring separate parts, regions, or systems together into a single cohesive unit
items.ex_en: The ambitious treaty aims to unify diverse regional economies under shared standards.
items.ex_zh: 这项雄心勃勃的条约旨在按共同标准将多元的区域经济统一起来。
items.ex2_en: The separate southern provinces unified peacefully under one democratic government following years of negotiations.
items.ex2_zh: 经过多年的谈判，南部各省在一个民主政府的领导下和平统一。

items.def_zh: 实行中央集权；集中，把……集中管理
items.def_en: to bring the control, administration, or power of an organization or country under one single central authority
items.ex_en: The government chose to centralize administrative operations to curb local government corruption.
items.ex_zh: 政府选择将行政业务收归中央管理，以遏制地方政府腐败。

items.def_en: to acquire complete exclusive control of an entire enterprise, authority, or field
items.ex_en: The tech giant attempted to monopolize cloud services across the entire continent.
items.ex_zh: 这家科技巨头试图垄断整个大陆的云计算服务。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers bringing disparate authorities, powers, resources, or operational units under a single unified center or commanding body.
groups.summary_zh: 指收拢权力或整合资源，将控制权归并至单一中央机构。
groups.desc_en: To gather dispersed elements, power, or authority into a single focal point or unified control, contrasting with simple 'gathering' or 'uniting' by emphasizing systematic centralization, structural integration, and the reduction of autonomy.
groups.desc_zh: 将分散的要素、权力或资产汇聚收拢至单一核心或统制架构之下，区别于普通“聚集”或“合并”，它强调结构性集中、体制统合及对自主分散状态的削夺。
groups.nuance_en: concentrate: bringing mass, effort, or attention into a dense focal area (power / resources / effort) · consolidate: combining distinct units into a firmer, more coherent whole (debts / gains / operations) · unify: merging diverse components into harmonious single identity (factions / country / system) · centralize: pulling operational or political authority to a single administrative center (control / administration / decision-making) · monopolize: gathering exclusive commercial or topical possession to the exclusion of others (market / conversation / attention)
groups.nuance_zh: concentrate: 将力量、资源或注意力高度汇聚于焦点 (power / resources / effort) · consolidate: 盘整加固分散的组织、债务或成果使之精简牢固 (debts / gains / operations) · unify: 消除歧异融合成高度一致的有机整体 (factions / country / system) · centralize: 将行政或决策权力收归权力中枢 (control / administration / decision-making) · monopolize: 独占并垄断资源、市场或话语权排除竞争 (market / conversation / attention)

groups.name: Certify & Attest Formally · 认证与确证 (Attest, Authenticate, Validate)
groups.tip: 出具证明确认真实性

items.def_zh: 发给证书确认，批准，证明
items.def_en: To provide someone or something with an official certificate, or to confirm and authorize officially.
items.ex_en: The ministry will certificate qualified maritime officers upon completion of intensive training.
items.ex_zh: 在完成强化培训后，该部将向合格的海事官员颁发正式证书。

items.def_en: To make something officially acceptable, legally binding, or confirmed as accurate
items.ex_en: The notary public signed the official deed to validate the property transaction.
items.ex_zh: 公证人在官方契约上签字，使这笔房产交易正式生效。

items.def_en: To officially recognize an educational, medical, or corporate institution as meeting standards
items.ex_en: The national medical board moved to accredit the newly founded regional hospital.
items.ex_zh: 国家医学委员会决定正式认可这家新成立的地区医院的资质。

items.def_en: To declare or show formally that something is true, genuine, or correct
items.ex_en: Ancient historical manuscripts attest to the cultural vitality of the early dynasty.
items.ex_zh: 古代历史文献证实了该早期王朝蓬勃的文化活力。

items.def_en: To prove officially that something is genuine, valid, or authentic
items.ex_en: Art experts utilized ultraviolet scanning to authenticate the rare Renaissance oil painting.
items.ex_zh: 艺术专家利用紫外线扫描鉴别了这幅罕见的文艺复兴时期油画的真伪。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the formal, legal, or institutional act of verifying, authenticating, or officially attesting that a qualification, document, or condition meets authorized standards.
groups.summary_zh: 由权威机构或正式程序核实其真伪、资历或合法有效性。
groups.desc_en: To officially vouch for the truth, validity, or professional standard of an entity through established authority or formal documentary proof, contrasting with informal 'confirming' or 'promising'.
groups.desc_zh: 由权威机构或法定程序出具凭据，正式确认其真实性、有效性或合规标准，区别于普通的“确认”或“口头保证”，具有法定效力与资质认可色彩。
groups.nuance_en: certificate: officially licensing or declaring qualified by credential (teacher / product / compliance) · validate: empirically or legally confirming operational legitimacy and soundness (data / claim / theory) · accredit: officially recognizing an institution as meeting rigorous professional standards (college / laboratory / program) · attest: bearing sworn, first-hand witness to accuracy or character (truth / signature / innocence) · authenticate: verifying genuine origin and provenance against forgery (artwork / manuscript / document)
groups.nuance_zh: certificate: 颁发证书以确认资质或合格资格 (teacher / product / compliance) · validate: 经由检验或法定程序确认其真实有效 (data / claim / theory) · accredit: 权威评审机构授予机构或课程合格认证 (college / laboratory / program) · attest: 作为证人以声明或签名证实某事属实 (truth / signature / innocence) · authenticate: 鉴定文物、作品或文件确系真迹而非伪造 (artwork / manuscript / document)

groups.name: Channel & Direct Flow · 导引与调拨 (Channel, Route, Direct)
groups.tip: 顺着渠道指引方向

items.def_zh: 用管道输送，传导（液体、数据等）
items.def_en: To convey liquid, gas, or electronic signals through a conduit or system to a destination
items.ex_en: The network operators pipe high-speed data securely between the two remote servers.
items.ex_zh: 网络运营商在两个远程服务器之间安全地输送高速数据。

items.def_en: To send or direct people, goods, or communications along a specified path or course
items.ex_en: Logistics managers decided to route the urgent medical supplies through northern highways.
items.ex_zh: 物流经理决定按北部公路路线转送这批紧急医疗物资。

items.def_zh: 引导，把…引向；输送，灌注；开凿水渠
items.def_en: to direct, guide, or focus money, energy, or resources toward a particular purpose or through a particular route
items.ex_en: The foundation plans to channel substantial philanthropic funds into clean energy research.
items.ex_zh: 该基金会计划将大批慈善资金引向清洁能源的研究领域。

items.def_en: To guide the movement, progress, or behavior of someone or something in a desired direction
items.ex_en: The experienced mentor helped steer the young entrepreneur away from costly mistakes.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的导师引导着这位年轻的创业者避开了代价高昂的失误。
items.ex2_en: The heavy cargo ship steered smoothly through narrow harbor channels toward open sea.
items.ex2_zh: 重型货船平稳地驶过狭窄的港口航道，驶向开阔的公海。

items.def_zh: 使改道，转移（资金、注意力、水流）
items.def_en: To cause something or someone to change direction or switch away from one path to another
items.ex_en: Engineers constructed deep canals to divert floodwaters safely away from populated suburbs.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们修建了深水运河，以便将洪水安全引离人口稠密的郊区。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate steering tangible or intangible flows—such as water, resources, enthusiasm, or energy—along a chosen path toward a targeted destination.
groups.summary_zh: 将资金、精力、情感或水流疏导并定向输送至特定管道或用途。
groups.desc_en: To guide, funnel, or reallocate a moving fluid, resource, or effort along a deliberate conduit or new trajectory, differing from mere 'sending' by emphasizing containment and guided flow.
groups.desc_zh: 将流体、资源或力量沿预设管道或轨道定向导流或转移，区别于单纯的“发送”或“投递”，强调受控的管束、通路与流向干预。
groups.nuance_en: pipe: physically conveying fluids or data through dedicated conduits (water / gas / audio) · route: mapping out and dispatching through specific waypoints or channels (traffic / calls / parcel) · channel: guiding energy, water, or funds purposefully through an established passage (funds / aggression / water) · steer: actively piloting heading and correcting drift (vessel / economy / policy) · divert: abruptly turning flow aside from an original course (traffic / funds / river)
groups.nuance_zh: pipe: 经由物理管道或专用线路传输液体、气体或信号 (water / gas / audio) · route: 规划路径并通过指定中继节点派送 (traffic / calls / parcel) · channel: 将资金、情绪或水流疏导注入特定管道 (funds / aggression / water) · steer: 动态掌舵以调整前行方向与策略走势 (vessel / economy / policy) · divert: 将水流、交通或资金从中途引开偏离原路线 (traffic / funds / river)

groups.name: Chant & Intone · 吟诵与咏唱 (Intone, Chant, Recite)
groups.tip: 抑扬顿挫慢声吟哦与念诵

items.def_zh: 吟诵，用单调的声音念；使（身体或肌肉）结实；给……定色调
items.def_en: 1. (archaic or literary) To utter words in a rhythmic, monotonous, or chanting voice; intone. 2. To make muscles or the body firmer and stronger.
items.ex_en: The monk began to tone ancient verses softly as dusk settled overhead.
items.ex_zh: 夜幕降临之际，僧人开始轻声单调地吟诵古老的经文诗篇。

items.def_en: To chant or recite liturgical text according to musical accents
items.ex_en: The cantor cantillated the sacred scriptural verses before the silent, reverent congregation.
items.ex_zh: 领唱者在肃穆安静的会众面前依照乐调庄重地吟唱圣经经文。

items.def_en: To repeat words or phrases rhythmically and often in unison, or to sing sacred prose
items.ex_en: Crowds of dedicated fans chanted the team's victory anthem across the stadium.
items.ex_zh: 热忱的球迷们在整个体育场内齐声高唱着车队的胜利之歌。

items.def_en: To say or chant words in a slow, solemn, and measured tone, especially in religious services
items.ex_en: The solemn priest intoned the traditional opening prayers in a low voice.
items.ex_zh: 庄严肃穆的神父用低沉的声音缓缓诵唱了传统的开场祈祷文。

items.def_en: To speak or utter rhetorically with high emotion and theatrical cadence
items.ex_en: The passionate actor declaimed his dramatic monologue with sweeping gestures and fervor.
items.ex_zh: 那名充满激情的演员以夸张的手势与热烈的情感慷慨朗诵独白。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to vocalizing words in a measured, rhythmic, or monotonous pitch, characteristic of rituals, religious liturgy, or poetic recitation. They contrast normal conversational speech with ritualized, sing-song cadence.
groups.summary_zh: 以仪式化、单调或富有韵律的声调吟诵、咏唱祷词或诗歌。
groups.desc_en: To utter or recite words in solemn, rhythmic, or musical cadences, contrasting with ordinary 'speaking' or 'singing' through its ritualistic, monotonous, or stylistically heightened vocalization.
groups.desc_zh: 用单调、有节奏或带有旋律的庄严声调诵读词句，区别于日常“说话”或艺术“唱歌”，强调仪轨性、抑扬顿挫的单峰音高及仪式声态。
groups.nuance_en: tone: vocalizing with a specific pitch or resonant intonation (voice / phrase / scale) · cantillate: reciting sacred Hebrew scriptures using ritual chanting modes (Scripture / verses / Torah) · chant: repeating slogans or liturgical verses in unison or rhythmic cadence (slogan / mantra / prayer) · intone: reciting prayer or verse in a slow, level, sonorous pitch (prayer / psalm / blessing) · declaim: speaking rhetorically and theatrically to project oratorical gravitas (speech / poetry / monologue)
groups.nuance_zh: tone: 以特定音调或共鸣发声朗念 (voice / phrase / scale) · cantillate: 依犹太教等仪轨诵调吟咏经文 (Scripture / verses / Torah) · chant: 节奏齐整、反复吟诵经文或口号 (slogan / mantra / prayer) · intone: 以缓慢、庄重平稳的单调声调诵读祷文 (prayer / psalm / blessing) · declaim: 饱含剧场感与演说腔调地慷慨陈词 (speech / poetry / monologue)

groups.name: Chap & Desiccate · 皲裂与干裂 (Chap, Crack, Chafe)
groups.tip: 干燥或受力产生表面细纹

items.def_en: (of skin or lips) To become dry, cracked, and sore from cold or wind, or to cause this to happen.
items.ex_en: Biting northern winter winds can severely chap exposed skin on your face.
items.ex_zh: 刺骨的北方冬风会使脸上裸露的皮肤严重干裂。
items.ex2_en: Dry winter lips chap easily without regular application of soothing protective balm.
items.ex2_zh: 冬天如果不经常涂抹舒缓保护膏，干燥的嘴唇很容易皲裂。

items.def_en: (+ off/away) To shed small flat, dry pieces from cracked or peeling skin
items.ex_en: Dead skin started to flake away from his sunburned shoulders after showering.
items.ex_zh: 淋浴之后，死皮开始从他晒伤的肩膀上一层层脱屑剥落。
items.ex2_en: The pastry chef flaked cold butter evenly into the flour mixture.
items.ex2_zh: 面点师将冰黄油切成薄片，均匀地拌入面粉混合物中。

items.def_en: To make or become sore, raw, or irritated by friction or dry weather
items.ex_en: Rough denim fabric can chafe sensitive skin during long and humid hikes.
items.ex_zh: 在漫长而潮湿的徒步中，粗糙的牛仔面料会磨伤娇嫩的皮肤。
items.ex2_en: His bare neck chafed painfully against the stiff wool collar all afternoon.
items.ex2_zh: 整个下午，他光着的脖子在坚硬的羊毛衣领摩擦下生疼发红。

items.def_en: To make or become uneven, dry, and coarse in texture
items.ex_en: Years of harsh manual labor roughened the old carpenter's once smooth hands.
items.ex_zh: 多年的繁重体力劳动让这位老木匠曾经光滑的双手变得粗糙。
items.ex2_en: Her delicate skin roughened visibly after weeks of exposure to freezing winds.
items.ex2_zh: 在经历了数周凛冽寒风的侵袭后，她娇嫩的皮肤明显变得粗糙。

items.def_en: To develop narrow breaks or fissures on the surface of skin or lips
items.ex_en: My dry lips always crack painfully whenever cold winter weather sets in.
items.ex_zh: 每逢寒冬来临，我干燥的双唇总会痛得裂开口子。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on superficial cracking, roughening, and soreness of human skin or lips due to harsh cold, wind, or dry conditions.
groups.summary_zh: 受风寒干燥等影响，皮肤或嘴唇粗糙开裂起皮。
groups.desc_en: To suffer surface cracking, roughness, or soreness from acute exposure to cold, wind, or dry friction, distinct from deep structural 'breaking' by focusing on epidermal and surface desiccation.
groups.desc_zh: 表皮因严寒、干燥或摩擦而失去水分、变得粗糙开裂，区别于结构性破裂，特指体表或浅层材质因环境脱水剥蚀导致的皲裂与红肿。
groups.nuance_en: chap: cracking and reddening of skin due to harsh cold and wind (lips / hands / skin) · flake: detaching in small, dry, peeling scales (paint / skin / pastry) · chafe: rubbing raw and irritated by mechanical friction or moisture (thighs / skin / collar) · roughen: turning texture coarse, dry, and uneven (hands / texture / surface) · crack: splitting open along visible fissure lines (skin / lips / dry mud)
groups.nuance_zh: chap: 因寒风与干冷导致皮肤红肿开裂 (lips / hands / skin) · flake: 表皮或涂层干枯后成片剥落脱屑 (paint / skin / pastry) · chafe: 因衣物机械摩擦或湿气引起擦伤红肿 (thighs / skin / collar) · roughen: 表面由光滑变得粗糙硬化 (hands / texture / surface) · crack: 缺水严重导致表层形成明显干裂细缝 (skin / lips / dry mud)

groups.name: Chaperone & Oversee · 监护陪同与风纪监督 (Chaperone, Supervise, Mind)
groups.tip: 作为监护人陪同青年社交

items.def_en: Take care of or keep watch on a child, vulnerable person, or place for a temporary period
items.ex_en: Could you please mind the baby while I run to the store?
items.ex_zh: 我去商店这会儿，你能帮我照看一下宝宝吗？

items.def_en: Care for, protect, and monitor someone or something closely to prevent harm or misbehavior
items.ex_en: She asked her neighbor to watch over the children while she ran an errand.
items.ex_zh: 她外出办事时请邻居照看一下孩子们。

items.def_en: Take responsibility for the physical safety, welfare, or proper behavior of someone
items.ex_en: Nurses diligently look after vulnerable pediatric patients throughout the long night shift.
items.ex_zh: 护士们在漫长的夜班期间尽心照料着身体虚弱的儿科患者。

items.def_en: Watch over and direct an activity or person to make sure work or behavior is done safely and correctly
items.ex_en: Senior laboratory directors must supervise all chemical experiments involving toxic airborne compounds.
items.ex_zh: 资深实验室主任必须监督所有涉及有毒空气化合物的化学实验。

items.def_zh: 伴护，监护（陪同青年社交）
items.def_en: 1. (variant spelling of chaperone) To accompany and supervise young people at a social gathering or in public to ensure proper behavior.
items.ex_en: Several responsible volunteer parents agreed to chaperon the high school graduation dance.
items.ex_zh: 几位有责任心的家长志愿者同意为高中毕业舞会担任监护陪同人员。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on accompanying minors, students, or unmarried individuals to social events or public outings specifically to supervise behavior, ensure propriety, and maintain safety.
groups.summary_zh: 特指出于监护责任、道德约束或行为风纪进行的随行监督。
groups.desc_en: To escort, safeguard, and monitor individuals (especially minors) to enforce decorum or ensure safety, contrasting with punitive 'policing' or passive 'watching' by blending custody with propriety.
groups.desc_zh: 陪同并监护特定对象（尤指未成年人）以确保人身安全并约束道德行止，区别于强制惩罚性的“戒备”或消极的“围观”，融合了看护与风纪规训。
groups.nuance_en: mind: paying diligent, temporary heed to someone or a task (baby / shop / dog) · watch over: providing continuous, protective guarding from peril (flock / patient / orphan) · look after: tending to the day-to-day welfare and needs of another (child / sick relative / garden) · supervise: overseeing activities from a position of formal authority (workers / examination / operations) · chaperon: formally escorting young people at social events to maintain propriety and safety (dances / teenagers / prom)
groups.nuance_zh: mind: 短暂照看某人或留意顾照摊位事务 (baby / shop / dog) · watch over: 慈悲或尽责地持续守护庇护 (flock / patient / orphan) · look after: 料理日常生活起居福利 (child / sick relative / garden) · supervise: 以管理者或主管身份实施专业督导把关 (workers / examination / operations) · chaperon: 作为长辈在社交活动中陪同监护青年风纪与安全 (dances / teenagers / prom)

groups.name: Char & Carbonize · 炭化与烧焦 (Char, Carbonize, Blacken)
groups.tip: 受热燃烧直至表面变黑焦化

items.def_en: Turn dark or black as a result of fire, scorching, or smoke exposure.
items.ex_en: Thick billowing smoke blackened the ancient stone facade of the cathedral wall.
items.ex_zh: 滚滚浓烟将大教堂古老的石砌外墙熏得一片漆黑。
items.ex2_en: The old wooden logs blackened slowly over glowing embers in the hearth.
items.ex2_zh: 壁炉里发光的余烬让陈旧的原木慢慢变黑了。

items.def_zh: 微焦，燎焦毛发或衣物边缘
items.def_en: Burn something very lightly, especially at the edges, tips, or surface fibers.
items.ex_en: The stray spark singed the woolly fringe of his warm winter scarf.
items.ex_zh: 飞溅的火星燎焦了他保暖冬用围巾边缘的羊毛流苏。

items.def_en: 1. To burn or convert into charcoal. 2. To take on or supply with coal as fuel.
items.ex_en: The ancient timber coaled slowly within the suffocating heat of the kiln.
items.ex_zh: 古老的木材在窑炉令人窒息的高温中缓缓炭化成炭。
items.ex2_en: Skilled local artisans coaled dense hardwood logs inside traditional earthen pit kilns.
items.ex2_zh: 熟练的当地工匠在传统土窑内将致密的硬木原木烧制成炭。

items.def_en: Partially burn an object so that its surface becomes blackened and converted to carbon.
items.ex_en: Fierce open flames quickly charred the outer oak planks of the cabin.
items.ex_zh: 凶猛的明火迅速将小木屋外层的橡木板烧焦成炭。
items.ex2_en: The surface of the campfire potatoes charred slightly over the red-hot coals.
items.ex2_zh: 篝火里的土豆表面在炽热的炭火上微微烤焦了。

items.def_en: Convert an organic substance into carbon or charcoal through heating.
items.ex_en: Fierce volcanic heat threatened to carbonize the ancient pine forest into desolate ash.
items.ex_zh: 炽烈的火山热浪眼看要将古老的松林碳化为凄凉的灰烬。
items.ex2_en: Dense organic matter carbonizes completely under sustained extreme underground heat and pressure.
items.ex2_zh: 致密的有机物质在地下持续的高温高压下会完全碳化。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on partial or superficial burning that converts organic material into charcoal, soot, or a blackened, brittle state without fully disintegrating into powdery ash.
groups.summary_zh: 指有机物质受热发生炭化，表层变黑干裂而非完全化作轻灰。
groups.desc_en: To burn or expose organic matter to extreme heat until it transforms into carbon or turns black, differing from 'incinerating' (which turns to ash) by preserving a charred residual surface or structure.
groups.desc_zh: 使有机物经受高温灼烧脱水、转化为黑炭质，区别于彻底烧成灰烬的“焚毁”，强调留下焦黑的碳化残留物或焦面。
groups.nuance_en: blacken: darkening the exterior color heavily through heat or smoke (toast / timber / walls) · singe: burning superficially along the outermost fibers, hair, or edges (eyebrows / feathers / wool) · coal: converting bulk wood or fuel slowly into combustible charcoal (wood / furnace / heap) · char: scorching deeply to leave a blackened, brittle carbon surface (meat / timber / bone) · carbonize: chemically reducing organic matter completely into elemental carbon via pyrolysis (organic matter / fossils / remains)
groups.nuance_zh: blacken: 受热或烟熏使外表面完全熏黑 (toast / timber / walls) · singe: 燎焦毛发、边缘或细小纤维 (eyebrows / feathers / wool) · coal: 使木材等物焖烧还原为木炭 (wood / furnace / heap) · char: 烧焦物体表层使其干硬发脆形成炭黑层 (meat / timber / bone) · carbonize: 经干馏或极度高热在化学层面上彻底碳化 (organic matter / fossils / remains)

groups.name: Chase & Follow · 追逐与跟追 (Chase, Tail, Shadow)
groups.tip: 紧追不舍追踪猎捕

items.def_en: To follow someone closely and secretly wherever they go
items.ex_en: The private investigator continued to shadow the suspect through the crowded terminal.
items.ex_zh: 私家侦探继续穿过拥挤的航站楼暗中跟踪嫌疑人。

items.def_en: To follow closely behind someone in order to observe their movements
items.ex_en: Two plainclothes cops were assigned to tail the courier across the city.
items.ex_zh: 两名便衣警察奉命盯梢那个穿行于全城的信使。

items.def_en: To hunt or chase game with hounds using sight rather than scent
items.ex_en: Hounds course the swift hare across the frost-dusted expanse of the moor.
items.ex_zh: 猎犬在覆着薄霜的荒原上追猎那只奔跑迅捷的野兔。

items.def_en: 1. To run after or follow someone or something in order to catch them. 2. To drive away.
items.ex_en: Fierce mastiffs chase the prowling wolves away from the slumbering mountain village.
