items.ex_zh: 凶猛的獒犬将四处游荡的恶狼驱逐出沉睡的山村。

items.def_en: To search persistently for someone or something until they are tracked down and caught
items.ex_en: Detectives worked around the clock to hunt down the suspect.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们夜以继日地工作，力求将嫌疑人缉拿归案。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses rapidly following someone or something with the intent to catch, overtake, or monitor them, spanning casual pursuit to discreet surveillance.
groups.summary_zh: 指紧跟或追赶目标以期追上、抓捕或暗中监视。
groups.desc_en: To pursue a target actively with speed or stealth in order to overtake, capture, or observe it, contrasting with static 'waiting' or aimless 'wandering' through persistent directed locomotion.
groups.desc_zh: 以速度追捕或隐蔽追踪移动的目标以便截获、制服或监视，区别于静止的“守候”或漫无目的的“游走”，强调定向性与追击意图。
groups.nuance_en: shadow: secretly and closely tailing a suspect without their awareness (suspect / agent / detective) · tail: tracking someone's vehicular or pedestrian movement at a discreet distance (car / target / mark) · course: pursuing game swiftly across open country with trained hounds (hares / deer / quarry) · chase: rushing rapidly and openly after a fleeing quarry to catch them (thief / ball / dreams) · hunt down: tracking relentlessly over time and terrain until final cornering (fugitive / criminal / predator)
groups.nuance_zh: shadow: 隐蔽暗中尾随紧盯使目标毫无察觉 (suspect / agent / detective) · tail: 紧随目标车辆或步行路线实施侦查 (car / target / mark) · course: 借助猎犬在原野上追逐捕杀野兽 (hares / deer / quarry) · chase: 速度极快地明面追赶以截住逃跑者 (thief / ball / dreams) · hunt down: 穷追不舍直至将逃犯缉拿归案 (fugitive / criminal / predator)

groups.name: Cheat & Defraud · 欺诈与骗取 (Swindle, Fleece, Defraud)
groups.tip: 施用诡计手段骗取财物

items.def_en: To blatantly cheat someone by overcharging them or selling inferior goods
items.ex_en: Unsuspecting tourists are often ripped off by unlicensed taxi operators.
items.ex_zh: 毫无防备的游客经常被无照出租车司机敲竹杠。

items.def_en: (informal, variant of gyp) To cheat, swindle, or defraud someone of something.
items.ex_en: That crooked mechanic tried to gip me out of two hundred bucks.
items.ex_zh: 那个黑心修理工想敲我两百块竹杠。

items.def_en: To deprive someone of a large sum of money through exorbitant charges or dishonest tactics
items.ex_en: Tourist traps near the plaza fleece unsuspecting travelers with wildly inflated prices.
items.ex_zh: 广场附近的宰客摊位靠虚高的离谱价格搜刮毫无防备的游客。

items.def_en: To illegally obtain money, rights, or property from someone through deliberate misrepresentation
items.ex_en: The rogue accountant schemed to defraud elderly clients of their retirement savings.
items.ex_zh: 这名不良会计师密谋诈骗老年客户的退休积蓄。

items.def_en: To obtain money or assets from someone deceitfully through a fraudulent scheme
items.ex_en: The con artist managed to swindle thousands of investors through bogus investments.
items.ex_zh: 那个骗子通过虚假投资项目成功骗取了数千名投资者的钱财。

groups.summary_en: Centers on illicitly extracting money, property, or goods through fraudulent schemes, financial con-artistry, or overcharging.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过欺诈手段、暴利或骗局非法攫取他人钱财或财物。
groups.desc_en: To deprive someone of money, property, or legal rights through deceptive trickery or breach of trust, differing from violent 'robbery' by relying entirely on deceit and misrepresentation.
groups.desc_zh: 通过虚假陈述、作弊或滥用信任剥夺他人钱财或合法权益，区别于暴力“抢劫”，它依赖欺诈策略与信息不对称。
groups.nuance_en: rip off: exorbitantly overcharging or crudely cheating a customer (tourist / customer / buyer) · gip: swindling out of expected dues or cheating out of small sums (waiter / cabby / partner) · fleece: systematically stripping a naive victim of large amounts of money (investors / marks / tourists) · defraud: executing calculated, illegal schemes to steal wealth or assets (bank / investors / government) · swindle: using elaborate fraudulent pretenses or confidence tricks to steal funds (heir / victims / public)
groups.nuance_zh: rip off: 宰客、漫天要价或低劣诓骗 (tourist / customer / buyer) · gip: 小额赖账或从交易中短斤少两坑骗 (waiter / cabby / partner) · fleece: 像剪羊毛般将易受骗者的钱财盘剥殆尽 (investors / marks / tourists) · defraud: 法律意义上利用阴谋、做假账等进行经济诈骗 (bank / investors / government) · swindle: 构筑骗局设套骗取巨额资产 (heir / victims / public)

groups.name: Cheer & Root · 欢呼与呐喊助威 (Cheer, Root, Egg on)
groups.tip: 用欢呼和热情鼓舞他人斗志

items.def_en: To enthusiastically support or hope for the success of a team or competitor
items.ex_en: We stayed up late to root for our local underdog basketball team.
items.ex_zh: 我们熬夜为本地那支不被看好的篮球队加油助威。

items.def_zh: 欢呼，喝彩；为……加油，鼓舞，使振奋
items.def_en: 1. To shout loudly to show approval, encouragement, or joy. 2. To encourage or give comfort and hope to someone.
items.ex_en: The passionate spectators began to cheer loudly when the champion entered the arena.
items.ex_zh: 当冠军步入赛场时，热情的观众开始大声欢呼。

items.def_en: To shout words of encouragement to an athlete or participant during an event
items.ex_en: Loud fans lined the wet track to cheer on the exhausted marathon runners.
items.ex_zh: 热情的拥趸沿潮湿跑道站成一排，为疲惫的马拉松选手呐喊助威。

items.def_en: To bring people together or come together to revive energy, courage, or concerted effort
items.ex_en: The veteran captain sought to rally the exhausted troops for one final assault.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的老队长试图凝聚疲惫部队的士气以进行最后的冲锋。
items.ex2_en: Depressed technology stocks rallied sharply following the central bank's surprise interest rate cut.
items.ex2_zh: 在央行出人意料地降息之后，低迷的科技股大幅反弹。

items.def_zh: 欢呼雀跃，发出兴奋喊叫
items.def_en: To utter a loud, unrestrained cry of joy, triumph, or excited encouragement
items.ex_en: The excited teenagers began to whoop wildly as their favorite band took the stage.
items.ex_zh: 当最喜欢的乐队登台时，兴奋的年轻人们开始大声欢呼雀跃。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame cover loud vocal support, rallying cries, and spirited encouragement given to competitors, comrades, or loved ones during trials and contests.
groups.summary_zh: 高声呼喊为选手或同伴加油打气、提振士气。
groups.desc_en: To shout encouragement, praise, or enthusiasm loudly to energize participants or celebrate success, contrasting with silent 'supporting' or critical 'heckling'.
groups.desc_zh: 以高声喝彩、欢呼或齐声呐喊向参与者注入士气或庆祝胜利，区别于无声的“心理支持”或反面的“起哄喝倒彩”。
groups.nuance_en: root for: holding an intense, enduring partisan wish for a team's victory (underdog / team / contender) · cheer: shouting loudly with approval or spontaneous joy (crowd / audience / fans) · cheer on: actively urging competitors forward with persistent vocal shouts (runners / athletes / team) · rally: mobilizing scattered people or flagging spirits into concerted collective action (troops / base / supporters) · whoop: emitting short, high-pitched vocal shrieks of wild excitement (revelers / crowd / fans)
groups.nuance_zh: root for: 坚定支持某支队伍或选手胜出 (underdog / team / contender) · cheer: 群众爆发式地喝彩欢呼表达嘉许 (crowd / audience / fans) · cheer on: 在场边伴随着比赛进程持续加油助威 (runners / athletes / team) · rally: 召集散乱士气使支持者重振旗鼓 (troops / base / supporters) · whoop: 发出短促高亢的狂欢呼叫 (revelers / crowd / fans)

groups.name: Chemical Coordination & Complexing · 螯合与化学络合 (Chelate, Ligand, Sequester)
groups.tip: 化学离子发生螯合配对

items.def_en: To form one or more coordinate covalent bonds with a central metal atom or ion
items.ex_en: Four chloride ions coordinate directly to the central platinum atom in this complex.
items.ex_zh: 在该配合物中，四个氯离子直接配位到中心铂原子上。
items.ex2_en: The central cobalt ion coordinates six ammonia molecules in the stable solution.
items.ex2_zh: 稳定的溶液中，中心钴离子配位了六个氨分子。

items.def_en: To combine with an atom, ion, or molecule to form a coordination complex
items.ex_en: Dissolved iron ions readily complex with organic tannins in the deep forest river.
items.ex_zh: 溶解的铁离子在深幽的森林河流中极易与有机单宁结合成络合物。
items.ex2_en: The specialized synthetic polymer complexes toxic metal ions to purify industrial wastewater.
items.ex2_zh: 这种专用合成聚合物与有毒金属离子发生络合反应，以净化工业废水。

items.def_en: To chemically attach to or trap a substance, preventing it from remaining free or active
items.ex_en: The paramedic carefully bound up the deep wound to stem the bleeding.
items.ex_zh: 医护人员小心地包扎好深伤口以止血。

items.def_en: To bind a chemical substance or ion so that it cannot undergo its typical chemical reactions
items.ex_en: Specialized synthetic polymers efficiently sequester toxic lead ions from contaminated municipal water.
items.ex_zh: 专用合成聚合物能高效掩蔽受污染城市用水中的有毒铅离子。

items.def_en: 1. (chemistry) To bind a metal ion firmly to an organic molecule to form a ring-like complex.
items.ex_en: Organic ligands chelate heavy metal ions to render them completely harmless in water.
items.ex_zh: 有机配体与重金属离子发生螯合，使它们在水中完全无害。
items.ex2_en: Bivalent metal cations chelate rapidly in aqueous solution containing strong EDTA molecules.
items.ex2_zh: 二价金属阳离子在含有强EDTA分子的水溶液中会迅速发生螯合。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this specialized chemical and biochemical frame specify the bonding of central metal ions or atoms to multi-dentate ligands or carrier molecules to form ring complexes. They highlight stabilization, binding, or sequestration of chemical species.
groups.summary_zh: 特指化学与生化过程中通过多齿配体将金属离子络合、锁定的反应行为。
groups.desc_en: To trap or stabilize a metal ion or molecule within a coordinated chemical ring or molecular complex, differing from simple physical 'filtering' through specific covalent or coordinate bonding.
groups.desc_zh: 通过配位键将金属离子或分子结合锁定在环状络合物中，区别于物理意义上的“机械过滤”，属于分子层面的配位化学固定与失活作用。
groups.nuance_en: coordinate: sharing lone electron pairs from ligands to a central metal atom (ligands / atoms / metal) · complex: forming a composite molecular structure via non-covalent or coordinate bonds (proteins / ions / molecules) · bind up: immobilizing reactive chemicals chemically so they cannot react freely (moisture / free radicals / ions) · sequester: isolating chemical ions from their surroundings to render them inert (calcium / toxins / heavy metals) · chelate: gripping a metal ion in a claw-like polydentate ring structure (iron / lead / copper)
groups.nuance_zh: coordinate: 提供孤对电子与中心金属离子配位成键 (ligands / atoms / metal) · complex: 通过配位相互作用使各组分络合为复合体 (proteins / ions / molecules) · bind up: 将游离化学分子紧紧束缚阻断其活性反应 (moisture / free radicals / ions) · sequester: 鳌合隔绝环境中的游离离子使其无法游离致害 (calcium / toxins / heavy metals) · chelate: 像蟹钳般通过多齿配体环扣并钳住重金属离子 (iron / lead / copper)

groups.name: Cherish & Entertain Feelings · 怀有与深藏心底 (Nurse, Entertain, Cherish)
groups.tip: 内心深处存留特定念头

items.def_en: To give consideration to or keep an idea, hope, or feeling in the mind
items.ex_en: The board refused to entertain any wild proposals during the emergency financial summit.
items.ex_zh: 在紧急财政峰会期间，董事会拒绝考虑任何荒唐的提议。

items.def_zh: 心怀（怨恨、希望等），长期蓄抱
items.def_en: To keep a feeling, grudge, or ambition in one's mind for a long time
items.ex_en: He continued to nurse a bitter grudge against his former business partner.
items.ex_zh: 他一直在心头对以前的合伙人蓄抱深深的怨恨。

items.def_en: To encourage the development of an emotion, belief, or relationship internally
items.ex_en: The prolonged isolation threatened to foster deep distrust between the two rival factions.
items.ex_zh: 长期的隔绝势必会在敌对两派之间助长极深的猜忌。

items.def_zh: 心怀，怀有（情感、疑虑或怨恨）；窝藏，庇护
items.def_en: 1. To keep a thought, feeling, or secret in one's mind for a long time. 2. To give shelter or refuge to someone.
items.ex_en: She continued to harbor grave doubts about the sincerity of his formal apology.
items.ex_zh: 她内心深处依然对他正式道歉的诚意心存严重疑虑。

items.def_zh: 珍怀，抱持（珍贵的希望、回忆）
items.def_en: To protect and care for someone lovingly, or hold a thought or hope dear in mind
items.ex_en: She will always cherish memories of quiet evenings spent with her loving grandparents.
items.ex_zh: 她将永远珍怀与慈爱的祖父母共同度过的那些宁静夜晚的记忆。

groups.summary_en: Involves mentally holding, nurturing, and preserving specific emotions, doubts, grievances, or ideals over an extended period. Some verbs skew toward bitter grudges, others toward tender affection.
groups.summary_zh: 在内心长期保留、滋养并抱持某种强烈情感、怨恨或崇高理想。
groups.desc_en: To harbor, nurture, and cling to an emotion, idea, or memory deep within one's mind over a long period, contrasting with passing 'thinking' by its emotional warmth, persistence, or secret preservation.
groups.desc_zh: 在内心深处长久怀抱、滋养或珍存某种情绪、念头或回忆，区别于短暂一闪的“思考”，强调情感黏性、隐秘性与持续培育。
groups.nuance_en: entertain: receptively considering or harboring a notion or doubt (idea / proposal / doubts) · nurse: brooding on and keeping a negative sentiment or wound alive (grudge / grievance / hatred) · foster: actively encouraging and cultivating the growth of attitudes (hope / talent / relationships) · harbor: secretly concealing dangerous thoughts, grudges, or fugitives internally (illusions / resentments / doubts) · cherish: holding an affection, principle, or memory with deep tenderness and reverence (memory / belief / values)
groups.nuance_zh: entertain: 愿意在心智中容纳考量某种可能性或怀疑 (idea / proposal / doubts) · nurse: 暗中郁积并持续助长负面委屈或宿怨 (grudge / grievance / hatred) · foster: 主动关照并培育情感或积极倾向 (hope / talent / relationships) · harbor: 内心暗藏怀疑、敌意等负面心绪 (illusions / resentments / doubts) · cherish: 极其深情且珍重地守候记忆、信仰或情感 (memory / belief / values)

groups.name: Childproof & Modify for Safety · 防护与改装 (Childproof, Babyproof, Tamper-proof)
groups.tip: 改造设施杜绝安全隐患

items.def_zh: 使对婴儿安全；防婴儿触碰改装
items.def_en: To adapt a living space, furniture, or equipment so that it poses no danger to infants
items.ex_en: New parents must thoroughly babyproof the living room before their toddler begins crawling.
items.ex_zh: 初为父母者在蹒跚学步的婴儿开始爬行前，必须彻底做好客厅的防婴儿触碰改装。

items.def_en: To design or modify a machine or process so that it cannot go wrong or be mishandled even by an incompetent user
items.ex_en: Engineers spent months working to foolproof the automated shutoff system against human error.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们花费数月时间改良自动关闭系统，以确保防呆且绝无差错。

items.def_en: To design or modify packaging, locks, or software so that unauthorized interference is prevented or immediately detectable
items.ex_en: The pharmaceutical company designed special seals to tamper-proof the emergency medicine bottles.
items.ex_zh: 该制药公司设计了特殊密封条，使急救药品瓶具备防篡改功能。

items.def_zh: 使安全；消除…的危险隐患
items.def_en: To inspect and adjust an area or mechanism to eliminate all hazardous points and safety risks
items.ex_en: Technicians worked diligently to safety-proof the playground equipment before the grand reopening.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员在盛大重新开放前辛勤工作，全面排除了游乐场设施的安全隐患。

items.def_zh: 对…做儿童防护改装，使儿童无法打开或触碰
items.def_en: 1. To modify a room, container, or piece of equipment so that young children cannot injure themselves or open it.
items.ex_en: You ought to childproof those low kitchen cabinets containing harsh household cleaning chemicals.
items.ex_zh: 你应该对装有强效家用清洁化学品的低矮橱柜做好儿童安全防护。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe adapting environments, enclosures, or mechanisms to render them safe from accidental damage, unauthorized tampering, or injury by vulnerable occupants.
groups.summary_zh: 通过改造空间或加装保护装置，消除特定安全隐患以防意外伤害。
groups.desc_en: To modify an environment, object, or system to make it immune to misuse, damage, or accidental injury by a designated group, contrasting with simple 'repairing' by its anticipatory preventive design.
groups.desc_zh: 对环境、设备或系统进行预见性改造，使其能防御特定群体的破坏或误操作伤害，区别于事后“维修”，强调先验性的防错改造。
groups.nuance_en: babyproof: modifying furniture and house fittings to prevent infant accidents (apartment / home / nursery) · foolproof: designing a process or tool so simple that no human error can ruin it (system / plan / mechanism) · tamper-proof: adding seals or barriers to prevent unauthorized opening or alteration (packaging / meter / ballot-box) · safety-proof: overhauling an installation to eliminate structural or hazard liabilities (facility / premises / site) · childproof: installing guards or latches specifically to prevent children from opening or hurting themselves (cabinet / container / cap)
groups.nuance_zh: babyproof: 将房间家具包角或安装安全装置以防婴儿磕碰 (apartment / home / nursery) · foolproof: 采取傻瓜化防呆设计使任何操作失误都无法酿祸 (system / plan / mechanism) · tamper-proof: 设置防篡改封条或机械阻碍防止擅拆擅改 (packaging / meter / ballot-box) · safety-proof: 全面改装排除安全漏洞隐患 (facility / premises / site) · childproof: 装备安全锁扣以阻止儿童开启药瓶或橱柜 (cabinet / container / cap)

groups.name: Chopping & Hashing Food · 切碎与剁碎 (Hash, Mince, Chop)
groups.tip: 切碎剁细食材木料

items.def_en: To reduce food to small shreds or fine particles by rubbing it briskly against a rough, perforated surface
items.ex_en: She decided to grate fresh parmesan cheese directly over the steaming hot pasta.
items.ex_zh: 她决定把新鲜的帕尔马森奶酪直接擦碎在热气腾腾的意面上。

items.def_en: To cut something into smaller pieces with rapid, forceful downward strokes of a knife or axe
items.ex_en: The sous chef began to chop crisp onions on the wooden cutting board.
items.ex_zh: 副主厨开始在木砧板上剁切脆生生的洋葱。

items.def_en: To cut, grate, or tear material into thin, narrow strips or rough scraps
items.ex_en: The cook used a sharp kitchen knife to shred the crisp red cabbage.
items.ex_zh: 厨师用锋利的菜刀把清脆的紫甘蓝切成细丝。

items.def_zh: 切碎，剁碎；搞糟，弄乱；（hash out）深入讨论解决
items.def_en: 1. (cooking) To chop meat, vegetables, or other food into small pieces. 2. (hash out) To discuss something thoroughly until an agreement or solution is reached.
items.ex_en: He helped hash leftover roast beef into uniform cubes for the morning skillet.
items.ex_zh: 他帮忙把剩下的烤牛肉剁切成均匀的小方块，留作早晨煎锅料理。

items.def_en: To cut or chop roughly, forcefully, and unevenly with heavy blows
items.ex_en: The inexperienced butcher began to hack the pork carcass with an unwieldy cleaver.
items.ex_zh: 毫无经验的屠夫用一把笨重的大菜刀开始胡乱劈砍猪肉架子。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe reducing food or other materials to small, irregular bits through repeated, brisk strokes of a knife, cleaver, or chopper. Unlike fine decorative dicing, these verbs focus on rapid breaking down, shredding, or mincing.
groups.summary_zh: 指用刀斧反复快切、乱刀剁碎或切成细碎肉菜的粗粝切割手法。
groups.desc_en: To sever, cleave, or dice food or material into small fragments using rapid blade impacts, contrasting with continuous linear 'slicing' through its percussive, chopping motion.
groups.desc_zh: 通过刀具快速冲击敲击将食材或材料切剁、撕扯成细碎块状，区别于平推顺拉的“切片(slice)”，强调下斩动作的撞击性与断裂性。
groups.nuance_en: grate: reducing food into fine shreds or powder by scraping across abrasive ridges (cheese / nutmeg / carrots) · chop: cutting decisively into irregular chunks with sharp downward blows (onions / firewood / vegetables) · shred: tearing or cutting into long, narrow ribbons (cabbage / pork / documents) · hash: chopping cooked meat and vegetables together into a rough, blended mince (meat / potatoes / leftover) · hack: cutting violently, clumsily, and unevenly with heavy tools (brush / carcass / wood)
groups.nuance_zh: grate: 在擦菜板的锋利凸起上摩擦搓碎成细屑 (cheese / nutmeg / carrots) · chop: 挥刀垂直下剁切成粗块 (onions / firewood / vegetables) · shred: 细切或顺纤维撕拉成细条碎丝 (cabbage / pork / documents) · hash: 将肉类配料粗粗剁碎并混杂搅拌 (meat / potatoes / leftover) · hack: 笨拙、粗暴且毫无章法地胡乱劈斩 (brush / carcass / wood)

groups.name: Chorus & Chime · 齐声呼应 (Chorus, Echo, Chiming In)
groups.tip: 异口同声附和或共同发声

items.def_en: to interrupt or join a conversation, typically to express agreement or offer opinion
items.ex_en: Several eager coworkers decided to chime in with their own helpful ideas.
items.ex_zh: 几位热心的同事决定插话附和，并提出了自己的有用建议。

items.def_en: to repeat an utterance or sentiment emphatically across a crowd
items.ex_en: Loud cries of defiance re-echo across the moonlit valley from the gathered rebels.
items.ex_zh: 集结的义军发出的响亮抗争呼声，在月光笼罩的山谷间反复回响。
items.ex2_en: Enthusiastic audience members re-echoed the speaker's stirring slogan throughout the auditorium.
items.ex2_zh: 热情的听众在整个礼堂内一遍遍呼应重申演讲者激动人心的口号。

items.def_en: to formally or verbally back a proposal, statement, or speaker
items.ex_en: The council member rose formally to second the urgent motion for environmental reform.
items.ex_zh: 市议员正式起立，对要求环境改革的紧急动议表示附议。

items.def_en: to repeat or agree closely with someone else's sentiments, words, or opinions
items.ex_en: Editorial writers across the country began to echo the mayor's cautious economic warnings.
items.ex_zh: 全国各地的社论作者开始附和市长对经济提出的谨慎警告。
items.ex2_en: Solemn funeral bells echoed mournfully across the quiet mountain village at sunrise.
items.ex2_zh: 日出时分，肃穆的丧钟在宁静的山村间悲凉地回荡着。

items.def_en: to say or sing something all together at the same time
items.ex_en: The delighted schoolchildren began to chorus enthusiastic answers to their teacher's simple question.
items.ex_zh: 高兴的小学生们异口同声地回答了老师提出的简单问题。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures group coordination in spoken discourse, where multiple speakers utter phrases in unison, harmonize agreement, or interrupt collectively with matching sentiments.
groups.summary_zh: 多人异口同声发言、集体应和或协同发声表达赞同附和。
groups.desc_en: To speak, chant, or affirm an utterance simultaneously with others or immediately in resonant agreement, contrasting with solitary 'answering' or argumentative 'debating'.
groups.desc_zh: 数人异口同声一齐发声，或紧随他人之后表达高度共振呼应，区别于孤立的“单人回答”或对抗性的“争辩”，体现同频共鸣感。
groups.nuance_en: chime in: interjecting harmoniously into an ongoing dialogue to add agreement or comment (remark / opinion / voice) · re-echo: resounding repeatedly across space or being reiterated faithfully (cries / sentiments / applause) · second: formally endorsing a motion or concurring with another's proposal (motion / nomination / view) · echo: repeating closely what another has said, either mechanically or reverently (words / sentiment / statement) · chorus: speaking, shouting, or chanting identical words collectively at the exact same instant (approval / assent / response)
groups.nuance_zh: chime in: 在别人谈话时顺势插话附和表达赞同 (remark / opinion / voice) · re-echo: 回音长久回荡，或观点引发多方持续共鸣 (cries / sentiments / applause) · second: 在正式议事中附议前者的提议以付诸表决 (motion / nomination / view) · echo: 如同回声般亦步亦趋地复述别人的观点 (words / sentiment / statement) · chorus: 众人犹如齐唱一般齐声异口同声表态 (approval / assent / response)

groups.name: Cinematographic Recording · 拍摄影片与录像 (Film, Shoot, Record)
groups.tip: 利用镜头影音记录景象

items.def_en: To store sounds or moving images electronically onto a storage medium
items.ex_en: The digital camera can record high-definition video even under extremely dim concert lighting.
items.ex_zh: 这款数码相机即使在极度昏暗的音乐会灯光下也能录制高清视频。

items.def_zh: 拍摄（电影等）；拍下；蒙上薄膜
items.def_en: 1. To record scenes, people, or events using a video camera or motion-picture film. 2. To cover or become covered with a thin layer of something.
items.ex_en: The documentary crew planned to film migratory birds along the remote coastal marshland.
items.ex_zh: 纪录片摄制组计划在偏远的海滨湿地拍摄候鸟。

items.def_en: To use a camera to record a video, movie, or particular scene
items.ex_en: The ambitious young director decided to shoot the dramatic final confrontation at dawn.
items.ex_zh: 这位雄心勃勃的年轻导演决定在黎明时分拍摄戏剧性的决战场景。

items.def_en: To record sounds or television footage on magnetic or digital tape
items.ex_en: Journalists gathered at the courthouse to tape the governor's brief public statement.
items.ex_zh: 记者们聚集在法院门前，把州长的简短公开声明录在磁带上。

items.def_en: To record moving images and sound on magnetic tape or video format
items.ex_en: Investigators managed to videotape the clandestine transaction from inside an unmarked utility van.
items.ex_zh: 调查人员在一辆毫无标识的多功能厢式车内成功录下了那笔秘密交易。

groups.summary_en: This production frame focuses on capturing moving images, live events, or staged cinematic performances onto electronic media or celluloid. Nuances contrast comprehensive documentary taping, multi-camera television production, and cinematic on-location shooting.
groups.summary_zh: 指利用摄像机、胶片或数字化设备摄制动态影视画面的行为。
groups.desc_en: To capture visual motion and audio on photographic film, video, or digital media for cinematic production, contrasting with still 'photographing' through its sustained kinetic capture.
groups.desc_zh: 利用胶片或数码传感介质摄录运动图像与音轨制作影视影像，区别于单张静态“摄影(photograph)”，强调连续运动的动态捕获。
groups.nuance_en: record: capturing sound, video, or data onto an enduring storage format (footage / performance / voice) · film: shooting cinematic scenes specifically intended for movies or artistic documentaries (scene / movie / commercial) · shoot: operating a camera dynamically on set or on location to capture footage (sequence / scene / footage) · tape: capturing audiovisual material historically onto magnetic cassette tape (interview / segment / trial) · videotape: producing video recordings using camcorders or magnetic broadcast media (broadcast / event / deposition)
groups.nuance_zh: record: 通用统称，将视音频转化为永久媒介记录下来 (footage / performance / voice) · film: 带有艺术电影拍摄色彩，用电影机或胶片拍片 (scene / movie / commercial) · shoot: 剧组现场开机拍摄机位视讯 (sequence / scene / footage) · tape: 特指用磁带盒或录像机摄制记录视讯 (interview / segment / trial) · videotape: 使用便携录像机记录活动或庭审实录 (broadcast / event / deposition)

groups.name: Circulate & Diffuse · 流动与传布 (Flow, Disperse, Disseminate)
groups.tip: 流通循环往复不息

items.def_en: To move steadily and continuously in a stream or circuit
items.ex_en: Cool ambient air began to flow steadily through the newly installed ventilation shafts.
items.ex_zh: 凉爽的环境空气开始顺畅地穿过新安装的通风井平稳流动。

items.def_zh: 在人群或圈子中流传，巡回走动
items.def_en: To be passed around from person to person, as news, rumors, or drinks
items.ex_en: Scandalous rumors about the CEO began to make the rounds within corporate headquarters.
items.ex_zh: 关于首席执行官的丑闻流言开始在公司总部内部到处流传开来。

items.def_en: 1. To move continuously around a closed system or area, or cause something to do so. 2. To pass or spread from person to person.
items.ex_en: Warm hydraulic fluid must circulate evenly through the complex machinery to prevent overheating.
items.ex_zh: 温热的液压油必须在复杂的机械装置中均匀循环以防过热。
items.ex2_en: The editorial office circulated copies of the confidential draft report among senior staff.
items.ex2_zh: 编辑部在高级职员之间传阅了这份机密报告草案的复印件。

items.def_en: To distribute or spread over a wide area, or break up in different directions
items.ex_en: Riot police deployed tear gas canisters to disperse the defiant crowd across avenues.
items.ex_zh: 防暴警察投掷催泪瓦斯罐，将不肯散去的抗议人群驱散到各条大街上。
items.ex2_en: The morning fog dispersed quickly once bright sunlight broke through the clouds.
items.ex2_zh: 当明媚的阳光穿透云层时，晨雾迅速消散了。

items.def_zh: 大面积散播，传播（信息、理论）
items.def_en: To distribute or spread information, knowledge, or ideas widely among people
items.ex_en: The health agency worked tirelessly to disseminate critical safety guidelines to the public.
items.ex_zh: 卫生机构不知疲倦地开展工作，向公众大面积普及关键的安全指南。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on the spatial movement of fluids, objects, or information through a network, closed loop, or population. Contrasts physical closed-loop transport with public social dissemination.
groups.summary_zh: 描述液体在系统内循环流动，或消息、物品在人群与网络中传布流转。
groups.desc_en: To spread, pass along, or flow continuously among many members of an open circuit or population, contrasting with stationary 'accumulating' by its fluid, distributed kinetic propagation.
groups.desc_zh: 信息、物质或血液在系统回路或人群中循环往复、持续扩散散播，区别于滞留“积聚”，突显流动性与全域覆盖特征。
groups.nuance_en: flow: moving smoothly and continuously in a natural current without obstruction (blood / river / traffic) · make the rounds: visiting a series of places sequentially or passing from person to person (rumor / doctor / story) · circulate: moving throughout a closed circuit or spreading widely across social circles (blood / petition / memo) · disperse: scattering widely in all directions until vanishing or thinning out (crowd / fog / seeds) · disseminate: systematically broadcasting knowledge, ideas, or propaganda to ensure wide adoption (information / findings / propaganda)
groups.nuance_zh: flow: 顺畅无阻地形成连续流体运动 (blood / river / traffic) · make the rounds: 巡回查房，或小道流言在众人间接续传递 (rumor / doctor / story) · circulate: 处于回路中循环流动，或在人际圈中广泛传阅 (blood / petition / memo) · disperse: 聚合体向四面八方溃散化解 (crowd / fog / seeds) · disseminate: 有规划地将研究成果、信息或思想大面积播撒传扬 (information / findings / propaganda)

groups.name: Cite & Quote Authority · 征引与引证 (Quote, Cite, Invoke)
groups.tip: 引用前人原话或权威文献做证据

items.def_en: 1. to repeat or copy words that someone else has said or written 2. to state the price of a job, service, or goods
items.ex_en: The persuasive debater proceeded to quote a renowned philosopher during the opening arguments.
items.ex_zh: 这位善辩的辩手在开场陈词中引用了一位著名哲学家的言论。

items.def_en: To refer to a book, author, or legal case as an authority, source, or proof of an argument
items.ex_en: The attorney intended to cite an important Supreme Court precedent to support her case.
items.ex_zh: 律师打算引证最高法院的一项重要判例来支持自己的案情。

items.def_en: To put forward or cite facts or evidence in support of an argument or theory
items.ex_en: The defense attorney failed to adduce compelling forensic evidence to support his theory.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师未能引证有说服力的法医物证来支持他的理论。

items.def_en: To turn to an author, source, or document for authoritative information or confirmation
items.ex_en: Researchers often refer to historical archives to verify disputed dates in their manuscripts.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员经常查阅历史档案，以核实他们书稿中存有争议的日期。

items.def_zh: 援引，诉诸（法律、原则或权威）
items.def_en: To mention or use a law, principle, or authority to support an opinion or justify an action
items.ex_en: The prosecutor decided to invoke a rare constitutional statute during the closing argument.
items.ex_zh: 检察官决定在结案陈词中援引一项罕见的宪法法规。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to reproducing external texts or summoning precedents, authorities, and empirical evidence to substantiate an argument.
groups.summary_zh: 引用外部文本、学说、法条或权威人物以佐证论点。
groups.desc_en: To appeal to, quote, or point toward an established text, authority, or precedent to validate an argument, contrasting with asserting based solely on original, unsupported personal conjecture.
groups.desc_zh: 援引权威文本、判例或经典论据来佐证自身论点的成立，区别于没有任何凭据的个人“主观臆断”，强调借助外来既定权威的合法性加持。
groups.nuance_en: quote: repeating the precise, verbatim words of an author or speaker (passage / author / price) · cite: formally documenting a published source or calling attention to a legal precedent (source / precedent / statistics) · adduce: bringing forward concrete evidence or reasons into a formal debate to sustain proof (evidence / reasons / instances) · refer to: directing attention toward an external matter or consulting a reference work (notes / dictionary / authority) · invoke: summoning a powerful law, doctrine, spirit, or revered name to compel obedience (clause / right / precedent)
groups.nuance_zh: quote: 原原本本逐字引用作者或说话者的原话 (passage / author / price) · cite: 在学术或法律文书中正式标明文献出处或援引判例 (source / precedent / statistics) · adduce: 在正式辩论中提出具体证据或例证以佐证事实 (evidence / reasons / instances) · refer to: 查阅辞书笔记，或在论述中提及某处 (notes / dictionary / authority) · invoke: 援引法条、宪法特权或求助神圣权威来确立自身行动合法性 (clause / right / precedent)

groups.name: Cite & Quote · 引用与述及 (Cite, Quote, Reference, Invoke)
groups.tip: 学术文献引用与原文转述

items.def_en: Provide a reference to or mention a source, work, or authority
items.ex_en: Scholars should properly reference original archival manuscripts in all published academic journal articles.
items.ex_zh: 学者在所有公开发表的学术期刊文章中，均应规范列出原始档案文献。

items.def_en: Repeat or reproduce the exact words spoken or written by someone else
items.ex_en: The speaker chose to quote the exact words of the founding charter accurately.
items.ex_zh: 演讲者选择准确引述建国宪章上的原话。

items.def_zh: 引用，引证；传唤，传讯；嘉奖，表彰
items.def_en: 1. to mention or quote something as an example, proof, or authority 2. (law) to officially summon someone to appear in court 3. to praise someone publicly for their brave actions or meritorious work
items.ex_en: Scholars routinely cite several empirical studies to substantiate their revolutionary new scientific theories.
items.ex_zh: 学者们通常引用多项实证研究来证实他们开创性的全新科学理论。

items.def_en: Cite or present facts, reasons, or evidence to substantiate an argument
items.ex_en: Counsel will adduce several sworn affidavits to substantiate the claim of patent infringement.
items.ex_zh: 律师将举出数份经宣誓的宣誓书，以证实侵犯专利权的指控。

items.def_en: Mention or call upon a law, rule, or authority to support an argument or justify an action
items.ex_en: Defense lawyers will invoke international human rights treaties to justify their urgent petition.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师将援引国际人权条约，来证明其紧急请愿的正当性。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe referring to authoritative texts, previous statements, precedents, or examples to support an argument or establish credibility.
groups.summary_zh: 指引用权威言论、文献、先例或事实以论证支撑观点。
groups.desc_en: Calling upon external authoritative texts, speech, or precedents to substantiate an argument, contrasting with simply mentioning or paraphrasing information.
groups.desc_zh: 征引外部权威文献、言论或先例以佐证论点，不同于普通的提及或转述。
groups.nuance_en: quote: reproduce exact words verbatim (passage / source / speech) · cite: formal referral to an authority or precedent (precedent / statistic / paper) · reference: mention or allude to briefly (work / event / study) · adduce: bring forward as decisive evidence (proof / reason / example) · invoke: appeal to a higher authority, law, or principle (privilege / treaty / deity)
groups.nuance_zh: quote: 逐字照录原文 (passage / source / speech) · cite: 正式引用文献、判例或证据 (precedent / statistic / paper) · reference: 提及或指称参考 (work / event / study) · adduce: 引证或举出确凿事实 (proof / reason / example) · invoke: 援引法律、神明或权威原则 (privilege / treaty / deity)

groups.name: Civilize & Cultivate · 教化与开化 (Cultivate, Humanize, Refine)
groups.tip: 通过教育脱离野蛮状态

items.def_zh: 使社会化，教导社交准则
items.def_en: Train individuals to behave in ways that are accepted and valued by their society
items.ex_en: Elementary schools strive to socialize young pupils into responsible and empathetic community members.
items.ex_zh: 小学校园致力于教导年幼的学生遵守社会规范，使其成为负责且富有同理心的社会成员。

items.def_en: Improve something by making small changes, removing coarse or uncouth elements
items.ex_en: Formal rhetoric courses help students refine their clumsy conversational habits into persuasive eloquence.
items.ex_zh: 正规修辞课程有助于学生去除拙劣的谈吐习惯，使其转化为令人信服的文雅口才。

items.def_en: Refine and educate one's mind, tastes, or manners through deliberate training
items.ex_en: She endeavored to cultivate an appreciative taste for classical literature and fine art.
items.ex_zh: 她努力熏陶培养自己对古典文学与精美艺术的鉴赏品味。

items.def_en: To educate a person or society and bring them to a more developed cultural and social state.
items.ex_en: Enlightened educators believe broad literacy can effectively civilize even the most turbulent frontier.
items.ex_zh: 开明的教育家们坚信，普及识字能有效教化甚至最动荡的边陲荒蛮之地。

items.def_zh: 赋予人性，使更富人情味
items.def_en: Make a system, culture, or person more civilized, gentle, or compassionate
items.ex_en: Reformers introduced creative therapeutic programs to humanize the harsh environment of maximum-security prisons.
items.ex_zh: 改革者引进了创新性治疗项目，以期为戒备森严的监狱严酷环境赋予更多人情味。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on elevating raw, unrefined, or barbaric behaviors into culturally advanced, polite, and law-governed social conduct.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过文化、礼俗与道德培育使之告别粗蛮、步入开化。
groups.desc_en: Elevating an individual or society from a crude, raw state into an advanced, polished moral or intellectual condition, contrasting with merely teaching or domesticating.
groups.desc_zh: 使个体或社会脱离原始粗鄙状态，迈入高度教化、文雅或道德境界，不同于单纯的教学或驯化。
groups.nuance_en: civilize: elevate whole societies out of barbarism (population / society / wilderness) · cultivate: develop skills, faculties, or tastes over time (mind / talent / taste) · refine: eliminate impurities, roughness, or vulgarity (manners / palate / language) · humanize: soften harsh conditions or endow with humane qualities (system / character / penal code) · socialize: train into acceptable communal norms (child / citizen / recruit)
groups.nuance_zh: civilize: 使整个社会或族群开化 (population / society / wilderness) · cultivate: 长期培育涵养品味或心智 (mind / talent / taste) · refine: 淬炼去杂、使之精雅 (manners / palate / language) · humanize: 赋予人道关怀或去冷酷化 (system / character / penal code) · socialize: 促使个体社会化以适应规范 (child / citizen / recruit)

groups.name: Clean & Sanitize · 清洁与消杀 (Clean, Wipe, Sanitize)
groups.tip: 扫除污垢并彻底清理干净

items.def_en: To remove dirt, soap, or chemical residue by washing lightly with clean water.
items.ex_en: Always rinse off leftover detergent from the dishes using cold running tap water.
items.ex_zh: 务必用冰凉的自来水把餐具上残留的洗涤剂冲洗干净。

items.def_en: To clean or dry a surface by moving a cloth, sponge, or hand firmly across it.
items.ex_en: He grabbed a dry cloth to wipe the spilled milk off the counter.
items.ex_zh: 他抓起一块干布，擦净了柜台上洒出的牛奶。

items.def_zh: 打扫，清洗，使干净；去内脏，收拾（鱼等）
items.def_en: 1. To remove dirt, grime, or unwanted marks from something. 2. To remove the entrails of fish or poultry before cooking.
items.ex_en: He had to clean and scale the fresh trout before cooking dinner.
items.ex_zh: 做晚饭前，他必须把新鲜鳟鱼去内脏并刮掉鱼鳞。

items.def_en: To make thoroughly clean, pure, or free of blemishes, toxins, or moral guilt.
items.ex_en: She sought quiet solitude to cleanse her troubled mind of lingering guilt.
items.ex_zh: 她寻求片刻宁静，以净化内心久久不散的内疚。

items.def_en: To make hygienic and safe by disinfecting to kill bacteria and pathogens.
items.ex_en: Hospital staff must sanitize every surgical instrument before the next operation begins.
items.ex_zh: 在下一场手术开始前，医务人员必须消毒所有手术器械。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this ubiquitous frame designate eliminating dirt, foreign substances, contamination, or debris from items, surfaces, or food prep items using a variety of basic mechanical or chemical techniques.
groups.summary_zh: 通过擦抹、冲淋或消毒等日常手法清除灰尘污垢及杂质。
groups.desc_en: Eliminating dirt, toxins, or microbial contamination through physical friction, liquids, or chemicals, contrasting with superficial tidying or arranging.
groups.desc_zh: 通过物理摩擦、水流或化学手段彻底清除污垢、毒素或病原体，不同于表面的收拾整理。
groups.nuance_en: clean: generic removal of visible dirt or impurities (room / wound / surface) · wipe: remove surface moisture or dirt with lateral friction (counter / tear / windscreen) · rinse off: wash away soap or residue with clean running water (soap / dirt / plate) · cleanse: deeply purify physically, medicinally, or spiritually (pore / wound / soul) · sanitize: treat with agents to destroy pathogens (hands / equipment / prep area)
groups.nuance_zh: clean: 泛指清除肉眼可见的污垢 (room / wound / surface) · wipe: 借助横向摩擦擦拭表面水渍或污物 (counter / tear / windscreen) · rinse off: 用清水冲洗残留物 (soap / dirt / plate) · cleanse: 深度清洁净化，常含医疗或精神色彩 (pore / wound / soul) · sanitize: 消毒灭菌以达到卫生标准 (hands / equipment / prep area)

groups.name: Clench & Grind Teeth · 咬紧牙关与磨牙 (Grit, Clench, Grind, Gnash)
groups.tip: 咬紧牙关或咬牙切齿

items.def_en: To rub the upper and lower teeth together with force, causing an abrasive grating noise
items.ex_en: He tended to grind his teeth loudly whenever he endured intense stress.
items.ex_zh: 每当承受巨大压力时，他往往会大声磨牙。

items.def_zh: 咬紧（牙关）；使发出摩擦嘎吱声；撒砂砾于
items.def_en: 1. ('grit one's teeth') To clench your teeth tightly together in determination, pain, or anger. 2. (chiefly British) To spread sand or grit on a road or path.
items.ex_en: She had to grit her teeth and push through the grueling marathon.
items.ex_zh: 她不得不咬紧牙关，坚持跑完艰苦的马拉松。

items.def_en: To press the teeth together very firmly, usually due to anger, stress, or resoluteness
items.ex_en: He clenched his teeth tightly to prevent himself from shouting in anger.
items.ex_zh: 他紧咬牙关，克制自己不愤怒地喊出声来。

items.def_en: To clamp one's jaws or teeth rigidly and immovably together in extreme shock or tension
items.ex_en: In sheer terror, his jaw locked shut and he could not scream.
items.ex_zh: 极度恐惧之下，他的上下颚僵住了，一声也喊不出来。
items.ex2_en: Furious shouting caused the angry boxer to lock his heavy teeth tightly.
items.ex2_zh: 狂怒的吼叫使那名愤怒的拳击手咬紧了沉重的牙关。

items.def_zh: 咬牙切齿（表示极度愤恨）
items.def_en: (+ one's teeth) To strike or grind one's teeth together violently in wrath, anguish, or desperation
items.ex_en: The defeated warrior gnashed his teeth in utter fury and bitter despair.
items.ex_zh: 战败的勇士在极度狂怒与绝望中咬牙切齿。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on somatic manifestations of intense emotional tension, determination, pain, or aggression expressed by pressing the upper and lower teeth firmly together or frictionally sliding them back and forth.
groups.summary_zh: 因痛苦、愤怒、下定决心或入睡神经紧张而用力紧咬或相互摩擦牙齿。
groups.desc_en: Pressing the upper and lower teeth firmly together or rubbing them forcibly, typically conveying pain, rage, or stoic resolve, contrasting with mastication.
groups.desc_zh: 上下齿紧紧咬合或用力摩擦，通常表达痛苦、愤怒或顽强隐忍，不同于生理性的咀嚼嚼碎。
groups.nuance_en: clench: clamp teeth tightly shut from fury, agony, or determination (teeth / jaws) · grit: press teeth firmly together to endure severe hardship or pain (teeth / jaws) · grind: rub teeth noisily against each other involuntarily or from stress (teeth in sleep / molars) · gnash: strike or grind teeth together violently in overt rage or anguish (teeth) · lock: seize or clamp rigid immovably (jaws)
groups.nuance_zh: clench: 咬紧牙关，体现愤怒、痛苦或决绝 (teeth / jaws) · grit: 咬牙隐忍剧痛或困境 (teeth / jaws) · grind: 压力下或睡梦中无意识磨牙 (teeth in sleep / molars) · gnash: 极度狂怒或悲苦中切齿发狠 (teeth) · lock: 下颌肌肉痉挛或僵死锁咬 (jaws)

groups.name: Clench & Grip · 握紧与咬紧 (Clamp, Clasp, Grit)
groups.tip: 攥紧拳头或咬紧牙关的紧绷用力

items.def_en: To fasten, grip, or hold something tightly in place or shut
items.ex_en: The guard dog clamped its jaws onto the intruder's heavy leather boot.
items.ex_zh: 警犬死死咬住了闯入者厚重的皮靴。

items.def_en: To press one's teeth tightly together, especially when facing pain or difficulty
items.ex_en: She gritted her teeth against the sharp pain as the doctor stitched.
items.ex_zh: 医生缝合伤口时，她咬紧牙关忍住剧痛。

items.def_en: To grasp something firmly with one's hand or hold someone tightly in one's arms
items.ex_en: The weeping mother clasped the shivering child tightly to her protective breast.
items.ex_zh: 哭泣的母亲将瑟瑟发抖的孩子紧紧抱在怀里。

items.def_zh: 紧握（拳头）；咬紧（牙关）；抓牢
items.def_en: To close one's hands, teeth, or jaw tightly, especially when angry, determined, or in pain; to grip firmly.
items.ex_en: He clenched his fists tightly as fury surged through his entire body.
items.ex_zh: 怒火涌遍全身，他紧紧攥起了拳头。

items.def_en: To become tighter and narrower, or to compress muscles or parts together
items.ex_en: Cold air caused the patient's bronchial passages to constrict, making breathing difficult.
items.ex_zh: 冷空气导致患者的支气管收缩，造成呼吸困难。
items.ex2_en: Blood vessels constrict naturally in response to sudden exposure to freezing temperatures.
items.ex2_zh: 面对突然暴露在严寒温度下的情况，血管会自然收缩。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on locking hands, jaws, or gripping surfaces tightly together, often reflecting tension, defiance, bodily control, or physical grasp.
groups.summary_zh: 死死抓紧、紧握手拳或咬紧牙关以抗压。
groups.desc_en: Applying forceful, unyielding mechanical or muscular compression inward around an object or body part, contrasting with gentle holding or caressing.
groups.desc_zh: 对物体或肢体施加向内收拢且强力不屈的机械或肌肉收紧力，不同于轻柔的握持或抚触。
groups.nuance_en: clench: contract muscles tightly into a fist or jaw set (fist / jaw / hand) · clasp: grasp firmly and warmly around something with fingers or arms (hand / baby / amulet) · clamp: fix or hold rigidly with mechanical force (jaws / vice / brakes) · grit: press teeth stubbornly together (teeth / jaw) · constrict: tighten around circumferentially, squeezing inward (throat / vessel / chest)
groups.nuance_zh: clench: 紧攥成拳或紧咬下颌 (fist / jaw / hand) · clasp: 用手或臂弯紧紧扣握 (hand / baby / amulet) · clamp: 用机械力死死夹紧或钳闭 (jaws / vice / brakes) · grit: 咬紧牙根以硬撑 (teeth / jaw) · constrict: 呈环状收缩挤压 (throat / vessel / chest)

groups.name: Click & Clatter · 喀哒与脆响 (Clatter, Clack, Snap)
groups.tip: 机械硬物敲击的清脆轻响

items.def_zh: 发出轻微的咔哒声；使发出咔哒声；点击；豁然开朗
items.def_en: 1. To make or cause to make a short, sharp clicking sound. 2. (computing) To press a mouse button. 3. (informal) To suddenly become clear or understood.
items.ex_en: You just click on the blue link to download the software update.
items.ex_zh: 你只需点击那个蓝色链接即可下载软件更新。
items.ex2_en: You can click the mouse button to select the item on the screen.
items.ex2_zh: 你可以点击鼠标按钮来选中屏幕上的项目。

items.def_en: To make a short, sharp, dry sound, like two hard pieces of wood or plastic striking together
items.ex_en: The wooden mahjong tiles clacked crisply across the table during the game.
items.ex_zh: 打牌时，木质麻将牌在桌上发出清脆的咔嗒声。
items.ex2_en: The dancer clacked castanets rhythmically above her head during the lively flamenco performance.
items.ex2_zh: 舞者在热烈的弗拉门戈表演中富有节奏地在头顶打响响板。

items.def_en: To make or cause to make a sudden, crisp cracking sound, often as something breaks or locks
items.ex_en: The brittle twig snapped loudly under his heavy boot in the woods.
items.ex_zh: 树林里，脆弱的细枝在他沉重的靴子下啪地折断。

items.def_en: To make a rapid succession of short, sharp knocking sounds while shaking
items.ex_en: Loose window panes began to rattle wildly in the howling autumn wind.
items.ex_zh: 松动的窗玻璃在呼啸的秋风中开始剧烈地咯咯作响。
items.ex2_en: The nervous speaker rattled his car keys while standing before the audience.
items.ex2_zh: 紧张的演讲者站在观众面前时不自觉地摇晃车钥匙发出响声。

items.def_en: To make a continuous loud, rattling sound by hard objects knocking repeatedly against one another
items.ex_en: A pile of metal pans clattered noisily onto the kitchen tile floor.
items.ex_zh: 一堆金属平底锅哗啦一声重重砸在厨房的地砖上。
items.ex2_en: The clumsy waiter clattered dirty plates onto the tray before dropping one.
items.ex2_zh: 笨拙的服务员把脏盘子弄得叮当响地堆在托盘上，随后掉了一个。

groups.summary_en: This frame details the production of sharp, dry, percussive noises generated by hard objects impacting one another. Verbs contrast repetitive rattling versus solitary sharp breaks or snaps.
groups.summary_zh: 描述坚硬物体碰撞时发出的短促、清脆或连续撞击声响。
groups.desc_en: Producing sharp, short, percussive acoustic strikes through rapid impact of hard surfaces, contrasting with continuous resonant ringing or dull thuds.
groups.desc_zh: 硬物撞击发出的短促、清脆、敲击性声响，不同于延绵的共鸣回响或沉闷的钝响。
groups.nuance_en: click: produce a light, crisp, precise sound (switch / lock / tongue) · clack: produce an abrupt, sharp, dry percussive knock (heels / typewriter keys / castanets) · snap: yield a sudden sharp cracking sound from sudden breaking or tension release (twig / fingers / elastic) · clatter: make a loud, disorderly, rattling din of multiple hard objects (dishes / hooves / machinery) · rattle: emit a series of rapid, loose, vibrating knocks (window / bones / cage)
groups.nuance_zh: click: 发出轻微而精密的轻嗒声 (switch / lock / tongue) · clack: 质地坚硬物体的清脆干燥敲击声 (heels / typewriter keys / castanets) · snap: 骤然断裂或松脱时的脆响 (twig / fingers / elastic) · clatter: 多个硬物碰撞散乱嘈杂的哗啦声 (dishes / hooves / machinery) · rattle: 快速连续的松动震颤声 (window / bones / cage)

groups.name: Cling & Adhere · 附着与死死依附 (Cling, Cleave, Hang On)
groups.tip: 牢牢附着或紧抓不放

items.def_en: To become physically joined or adhered to a surface
items.ex_en: Wet fallen leaves stick to the slick pavement throughout the rainy autumn.
items.ex_zh: 在多雨的秋日里，湿漉漉的落叶紧紧贴在湿滑的路面上。

items.def_en: (+ to) To hold tightly to something for support or balance
items.ex_en: Hang on a second, let me grab a pen to write that down.
items.ex_zh: 稍等一下，我拿支笔把它记下来。

items.def_en: (+ to) To hold on tightly to somebody or something, or stick closely to a surface
items.ex_en: Frightened by the thunder, the child clung tightly to her father's jacket.
items.ex_zh: 被雷声吓到的孩子紧紧抓住了父亲的夹克。

items.def_zh: 紧抓，抓紧不放；附着，紧贴（cling的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: 1. Past tense and past participle of cling; held tightly to someone or something, or stuck closely.
items.ex_en: Damp fabric clung tightly to her shivering shoulders in the freezing downpour.
items.ex_zh: 在冰冷的暴雨中，潮湿的衣料紧紧贴在她颤抖的肩膀上。

items.def_en: (+ to) (literary) To stick firmly to something, or remain faithful and committed to someone
items.ex_en: The faithful knight swore to cleave to his ancient honor until death.
items.ex_zh: 忠诚的骑士誓死恪守他古老的荣誉。
items.ex2_en: The strong magnetic clamp cleaves metal sheets together during heavy industrial welding.
items.ex2_zh: 强力磁夹在重工业焊接过程中将金属板紧紧固定在一起。

groups.summary_en: Pertains to holding tenaciously onto an object or surface, or adhering persistently physically or emotionally without letting go.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体表面粘附，或紧紧依附、固执抓住某物不放。
groups.desc_en: Maintaining persistent, tenaciously tight physical contact or ideological devotion without letting go, contrasting with momentary touching or superficial resting.
groups.desc_zh: 在物理附着或思想信条上死死维系、绝不撒手，不同于短暂触碰或表层放置。
groups.nuance_en: cling: hold on tenaciously out of fear, weakness, or strong adhesion (rock / mother / wet shirt) · cleave: bind fast with profound loyalty or immutable bond (faith / tradition / partner) · hang on: maintain grip through turbulence, fatigue, or resistance (rail / rope / dear life) · stick to: adhere firmly to a surface or stubbornly to an agenda (skin / rules / plan) · clung: past form of cling emphasizing sustained tenacious adherence (surface / hope / memory)
groups.nuance_zh: cling: 因恐惧、依赖或强吸附力死死抱住或贴住 (rock / mother / wet shirt) · cleave: 矢志不渝地依恋、坚守 (faith / tradition / partner) · hang on: 在风浪或阻力中拼命抓牢不放 (rail / rope / dear life) · stick to: 物理粘附或死守既定方针 (skin / rules / plan) · clung: cling 的过去式，强调持存的死死依附 (surface / hope / memory)

groups.name: Clog & Block · 肠阻与堵塞 (Clog, Obstruct, Bung up)
groups.tip: 消化道排泄受阻或肠胃板结

items.def_en: To cause the bowels to become constipated and hard to move
items.ex_en: Eating excessive amounts of unripe persimmons can seriously bind your digestive bowels.
items.ex_zh: 吃过量未成熟的柿子会严重引起肠道便秘。

items.def_en: To block a bodily organ or pipe completely so normal flow is halted
items.ex_en: Hard water deposits can completely bung up the copper pipes over time.
items.ex_zh: 久而久之，硬水沉淀物会彻底堵塞铜水管。

items.def_en: To block a tube, pipe, or channel with an accumulation of thick or solid matter
items.ex_en: Grease and food scraps will quickly clog the main kitchen sink drain.
items.ex_zh: 油脂和食物残渣很快就会堵塞厨房水槽的主排水管。
items.ex2_en: The narrow drainage pipes clog easily whenever heavy autumn leaves wash inside.
items.ex2_zh: 每当沉重的秋叶被冲入其中，狭窄的排水管就很容易堵塞。

items.def_en: To block a passage, pipe, or bodily tract so that nothing can get through
items.ex_en: Debris and fallen branches completely obstruct the narrow drainage pipe after storms.
items.ex_zh: 暴风雨过后，瓦砾和断枝完全堵塞了狭窄的排水管道。

items.def_zh: 使便秘，使肠道受阻；使迟钝，抑制
items.def_en: To make someone unable to empty their bowels easily or regularly; (figurative) to slow down, restrict, or stifle.
items.ex_en: A sudden lack of dietary fiber will quickly constipate most elderly patients.
items.ex_zh: 突然缺乏膳食纤维很快会导致大多数老年患者便秘。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical or biological obstruction where passages, vessels, or digestive tracts become impeded or jammed, halting natural flow.
groups.summary_zh: 指身体通道、器官管道或排泄系统发生堵塞与滞留。
groups.desc_en: Impeding or halting the internal flow through a conduit or bodily passage by accumulation of matter, contrasting with intentional gating or closing.
groups.desc_zh: 杂物堆积淤塞管道或生理通道导致流动停滞，不同于人为设置闸门的主动封闭。
groups.nuance_en: clog: choke a passage with gradual accumulation of viscous or solid debris (drain / artery / filter) · obstruct: put an impediment across a channel or view (airway / bowel / view) · bung up: completely stop up colloquially, often from cold or mess (nose / pipes / ear) · constipate: abnormally harden or arrest bowel contents (bowels / digestion / patient) · bind: compress or compact matter, physically arresting evacuation (intestines / stool)
groups.nuance_zh: clog: 粘稠或杂碎污物渐进式堵死通道 (drain / artery / filter) · obstruct: 挡住或阻碍管腔流通 (airway / bowel / view) · bung up: (口语) 完全被污物或鼻涕堵死 (nose / pipes / ear) · constipate: 导致肠道秘结不通 (bowels / digestion / patient) · bind: 使物料凝结板结阻滞排空 (intestines / stool)

groups.name: Close & Shut · 关闭与封闭 (Slam, Seal, Snap shut)
groups.tip: 合上门窗或封堵住开口

items.def_zh: 关上，封闭；关闭，停止营业；结束
items.def_en: 1. To shut something, or to become shut so that an opening is covered. 2. To stop operating or doing business, or to end an activity.
items.ex_en: Please close the heavy front door to keep the cold winter outside.
items.ex_zh: 请关上厚重的前门，把冬日的严寒挡在门外。

items.def_en: Move a door, window, lid, or mouth into a closed position
items.ex_en: Remember to shut the bedroom window before the torrential rainstorm starts today.
items.ex_zh: 今天暴雨开始之前，记得把卧室的窗户关上。
items.ex2_en: The heavy oak door shut softly behind the visitors as they entered.
items.ex2_zh: 访客进门后，厚重的橡木门在他们身后轻轻合上了。

items.def_en: Close an opening securely so that nothing can enter, escape, or leak through
items.ex_en: They had to seal the container tightly to prevent hazardous chemical leaks.
items.ex_zh: 他们必须将容器紧紧封住，以防止危险化学品泄漏。

items.def_en: Shut something violently and noisily
items.ex_en: A sudden gust of wind caused the bedroom door to slam shut.
items.ex_zh: 一阵突如其来的狂风把卧室门砰地关上了。
items.ex2_en: The angry tenant slammed the heavy front door after losing the argument.
items.ex2_zh: 愤怒的租客在争辩失败后重重地关上了厚重的前门。

items.def_zh: 停止运转，关闭（机器或设施）
items.def_en: Cease business operations or turn off mechanical or computerized systems completely
items.ex_en: Management decided to shut down the outdated factory permanently after fifty years.
items.ex_zh: 在运营五十年后，管理层决定永久关闭这家老旧工厂。
items.ex2_en: The internal computer systems will shut down automatically during an unexpected blackout.
items.ex2_zh: 遇到意外断电时，内部电脑系统将自动完全关闭。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate physical acts that draw an opening to a halt or block access, moving doors, lids, covers, or apertures from an open to a secure or fastened state.
groups.summary_zh: 使门、窗、盖子或开口进入遮盖合拢或气密闭合的状态。
groups.desc_en: Moving a barrier to seal off an aperture or terminate an opening, contrasting with leaving ajar or merely screening.
groups.desc_zh: 移动遮障将开口截断封死，不同于虚掩或单纯的遮蔽。
groups.nuance_en: close: standard movement of a barrier to cover an opening (door / eyes / window) · shut: bring firmly into a closed, locked, or resting position (gate / mouth / cupboard) · slam: close with violent, audible kinetic force (door / lid / book) · seal: fasten hermetically to prevent any ingress or escape (envelope / container / borders) · shut down: terminate operation completely of an apparatus or facility (engine / system / plant)
groups.nuance_zh: close: 泛指合拢或关闭开口 (door / eyes / window) · shut: 紧密地关拢或合上 (gate / mouth / cupboard) · slam: 伴随巨大撞击声重重甩上 (door / lid / book) · seal: 严密封闭阻绝出入 (envelope / container / borders) · shut down: 彻底切断运行或关机 (engine / system / plant)

groups.name: Close & Shutter · 关停与破产 (Shutter, Mothball, Wind up)
groups.tip: 强行中止营业或封闭出口

items.def_en: To halt operations or use of equipment, plants, or plans while preserving them for future reactivation
items.ex_en: The naval department chose to mothball several older warships for future emergencies.
items.ex_zh: 海军部门决定封存几艘老旧军舰，以备将来应急之需。

items.def_en: To stop a machine, factory, or organization from operating, either temporarily or forever
items.ex_en: The company had to shut down production lines due to supply shortages.
items.ex_zh: 由于供应链短缺，公司不得不停掉生产线。
items.ex2_en: The entire regional electrical grid shut down following the severe lightning strike.
items.ex2_zh: 遭受严重的雷击之后，整个区域电网全部停止了运行。

items.def_zh: 关闭，关停（企业或店铺）；用百叶窗关闭（窗户）
items.def_en: 1. To close down a business, store, or service permanently or temporarily. 2. To close windows with shutters.
items.ex_en: The historic neighborhood bakery shuttered its doors after decades of dedicated service.
items.ex_zh: 这家历史悠久的社区烘焙坊在尽心服务数十年后关门停业了。

items.def_en: To permanently cease operating or trading as a business or facility
items.ex_en: The local bookstore was forced to close down due to rising rent.
items.ex_zh: 因为租金上涨，这家当地书店被迫停业倒闭。
items.ex2_en: The municipal council decided to close down the hazardous chemical plant permanently.
items.ex2_zh: 市议会决定永久关闭这家危险的化学品工厂。

items.def_en: To bring a business or venture to a legal close by settling debts and liquidating assets
items.ex_en: The struggling partners decided to wind up the unprofitable firm this month.
items.ex_zh: 陷入困境的合伙人决定在本月清算并关闭这家不盈利的公司。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate terminating or temporarily mothballing the commercial or institutional operations of a business, factory, or facility due to financial failure, regulatory action, or strategic cessation.
groups.summary_zh: 指因经营不善、亏损或行政指令而关闭、停运工厂设施或终结业务。
groups.desc_en: Ceasing the operations of a business, factory, or project either temporarily or permanently, contrasting with momentary pauses in work.
groups.desc_zh: 暂时封存或永久终结企业、工厂或项目的运营，不同于日常工作中的短暂歇息。
groups.nuance_en: shutter: close down business premises definitively, often under distress (factory / storefront / division) · mothball: deactivate and preserve equipment/facilities for possible future use (fleet / plant / programme) · shut down: cease productive operations temporarily or indefinitely (reactor / facility / line) · close down: terminate an enterprise entirely and liquidate presence (shop / branch / operation) · wind up: formally settle debts and dissolve a business entity (company / estate / affairs)
groups.nuance_zh: shutter: (因不景气等) 关门大吉、彻底关闭店面 (factory / storefront / division) · mothball: 封存闲置设施以备日后重启 (fleet / plant / programme) · shut down: 中止厂矿设备运行 (reactor / facility / line) · close down: 停业关闭清理网点 (shop / branch / operation) · wind up: 清算债务并注销结业 (company / estate / affairs)

groups.name: Clothe & Attire · 穿衣与妆理 (Attire, Clothe, Array)
groups.tip: 穿戴衣物遮体装饰身体

items.def_en: Provide someone with garments to wear, or cover someone with clothing
items.ex_en: Charitable monks helped clothe the destitute travelers who arrived during winter frosts.
items.ex_zh: 慈悲的僧侣们为寒冬时节赶来的赤贫旅客提供衣物避寒。

items.def_en: Equip or dress someone in a distinctive, special, or elaborate outfit
items.ex_en: They rigged out the children in pirate costumes for the school carnival.
items.ex_zh: 他们把孩子们打扮成海盗模样去参加学校嘉年华。

items.def_en: (literary, usually passive) Dress someone in an impressive or ornate assortment of fine clothes
items.ex_en: The queen was arrayed in magnificent silk robes adorned with precious jewels.
items.ex_zh: 女王身披缀满珍贵宝石的华美丝绸长袍。

items.def_en: (literary or archaic) To clothe or dress someone in garments.
items.ex_en: The ancient high priest was richly garmented in pure white ceremonial linens.
items.ex_zh: 古老的大祭司身着华丽纯白礼袍。

items.def_en: (usually passive) Clothe someone in formal, elegant, or ceremonial garments
items.ex_en: Distinguished guests were attired in splendid black tie for the annual gala.
items.ex_zh: 贵宾们身着华丽的正式晚礼服出席年度盛会。

groups.summary_en: This frame pertains to furnishing a person with garments or dressing them completely, often with an emphasis on modesty, formal provision, or ritualistic preparation.
groups.summary_zh: 强调为他人或自己穿戴齐备衣物，兼具遮蔽与礼容整理色彩。
groups.desc_en: Donning garments, especially with an emphasis on visual presentation, richness, or elaborate ensemble, contrasting with purely utilitarian covering.
groups.desc_zh: 穿戴服饰，尤指讲究华丽视觉效果、特定行头或整肃打扮，不同于纯粹保暖蔽体。
groups.nuance_en: clothe: provide with clothing or dress generally (needy / body / child) · attire: dress in fine, formal, or dignified garments (courtier / bride / guest) · array: adorn splendidly in rich, imposing apparel (troops / queen / dignitary) · rig out: equip with an elaborate or peculiar outfit (sailor / partygoer / performer) · garment: poetically or archaically drape in clothes (statue / figure / form)
groups.nuance_zh: clothe: 泛指给……提供衣物或穿衣 (needy / body / child) · attire: 盛装打扮，穿戴庄重大方 (courtier / bride / guest) · array: 华服着身、盛妆严整 (troops / queen / dignitary) · rig out: 穿上别致或齐整的行头 (sailor / partygoer / performer) · garment: (文雅/诗意) 披裹衣袍 (statue / figure / form)

groups.name: Clothe & Uniform · 穿戴与着装 (Clothe, Habit, Vest)
groups.tip: 将衣裳穿戴于身，特指特色盛装

items.def_en: (formal/archaic, usually passive) Clothe someone in a religious habit or distinctive style of costume
items.ex_en: The novice was formally habited in the traditional dark robes of sisterhood.
items.ex_zh: 见习修女正式穿上了女修道会的传统深色教服。

items.def_en: Provide someone with a complete set of clothes or necessary working gear
items.ex_en: The charity helped outfit local rescue volunteers with durable warm winter coats.
items.ex_zh: 该慈善机构为当地救援志愿者配备了耐磨保暖的冬衣。

items.def_en: (informal, often passive) Dress someone completely in specific or fancy garments for an occasion
items.ex_en: He got togged out in his finest three-piece suit for graduation.
items.ex_zh: 为了毕业典礼，他穿戴齐整，换上了最体面的三件套西装。

items.def_en: Clothe someone, especially a cleric, in formal liturgical or ceremonial robes
items.ex_en: The bishop was vested in rich golden vestments for the Easter mass.
items.ex_zh: 主教身披华美的金色圣袍主持复活节弥撒。

items.def_en: (usually passive) To dress or clothe someone in distinctive or particular garments.
items.ex_en: Traditional royal guards were garbed in bright red historic military tunics.
items.ex_zh: 传统皇家卫队身着鲜红色的历史军装礼服。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on clothing someone in attire indicative of a specific role, order, profession, or status. The emphasis lies on distinctive dress, habit, or institutional uniform.
groups.summary_zh: 指身穿或使穿戴具有特定身份、职务或制式特征的衣着。
groups.desc_en: Endowing an individual with garments that denote a specific role, office, religious order, or activity, contrasting with everyday casual dressing.
groups.desc_zh: 穿戴标示特定身份、圣职、职业规范或特殊功能的外套行头，不同于日常随意穿着。
groups.nuance_en: outfit: supply with a complete specialized set of clothes and gear (expedition / hikers / team) · habit: dress in distinct religious or monastic robes (nun / monk / priest) · vest: invest officially with ecclesiastical robes or legal authority (clergy / bishop / magistrate) · garb: clothe in distinctive, easily recognizable stylistic attire (monk / soldier / actor) · tog out: dress up thoroughly in specialized or formal kit (player / climber / reveller)
groups.nuance_zh: outfit: 全套配齐专门服饰与装备 (expedition / hikers / team) · habit: 披上特制修道僧袍 (nun / monk / priest) · vest: 穿上圣职礼袍并赋予职权 (clergy / bishop / magistrate) · garb: 穿戴辨识度极高的特征装扮 (monk / soldier / actor) · tog out: 穿戴整套特定运动或外出服饰 (player / climber / reveller)

groups.name: Cloud & Obscure · 蒙翳与模糊 (Cloud, Mist, Blur)
groups.tip: 雾气或阴云笼罩遮挡

items.def_zh: （使）起雾笼罩，（使）变模糊；使困惑
items.def_en: 1. To become covered with steam or condensation, or cause something to do so. 2. To make something unclear, confused, or indistinct.
items.ex_en: Boiling kettle steam quickly began to fog the small kitchen window glass.
items.ex_zh: 烧水壶的水汽迅速开始让厨房的小窗玻璃蒙上雾气。
items.ex2_en: The bathroom mirrors always fog quickly during every hot and humid shower.
items.ex2_zh: 每次洗热水澡时，浴室里的镜子总是很快蒙上一层水汽。

items.def_en: Become covered with tiny droplets of condensation that obscure vision
items.ex_en: Her reading glasses mist up whenever she steps into the warm room.
items.ex_zh: 每当她走进温暖的房间，她的老花镜就会蒙上雾气。
items.ex2_en: Boiling soup will mist up the clear glass lid in just seconds.
items.ex2_zh: 沸腾的汤仅用几秒钟就会使透明的玻璃锅盖蒙上水汽。

items.def_en: Become obscured with hot condensation and vapor
items.ex_en: The bathroom mirror steamed up quickly as the hot shower ran.
items.ex_zh: 热水淋浴一开，浴室镜子很快就蒙上了一层水汽。

items.def_zh: 使模糊；蒙上云翳；使迷乱
items.def_en: Make a transparent surface opaque, or impair sound judgment and understanding
items.ex_en: Deep personal prejudice must not cloud your objective judgment on this matter.
items.ex_zh: 深重的个人偏见绝不能蒙蔽你对此事的客观判断。
items.ex2_en: Her bright blue eyes began to cloud with tears during the funeral.
items.ex2_zh: 在葬礼上，她明亮的蓝眼睛开始泛起朦胧的泪水。

items.def_en: Make the edges or features of an image indistinct and difficult to see clearly
items.ex_en: Fatigue and sudden tears began to blur her vision on the highway.
items.ex_zh: 疲劳和突如其来的泪水使她在高速公路上的视线变得模糊。
items.ex2_en: Fine printed details often blur when images are enlarged beyond their resolution.
items.ex2_zh: 当图片放大超出其分辨率时，精细的印刷细节常常变得模糊。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the process where moisture, haze, or metaphorical confusion obscures optical transparency or mental lucidity. 'Fog' and 'mist' evoke surface condensation, while 'blur' and 'cloud' cover loss of clear vision or judgment.
groups.summary_zh: 指因水汽凝结或云翳遮蔽而变得模糊、不清。
groups.desc_en: Impairing physical optical transparency via moisture, condensation, or haze, contrasting with complete mechanical blockage by an opaque object.
groups.desc_zh: 因水汽、冷凝或薄雾导致物理表面透明度丧失、视线模糊，不同于不透明硬物的机械遮挡。
groups.nuance_en: cloud: become dull or opaque from dispersed moisture or particulate (lens / water / mirror) · mist up: cover with a fine film of condensed droplets (windscreen / spectacles / glass) · steam up: cover rapidly with heavy vaporized hot condensation (mirror / goggles / window) · fog: blind a surface with dense vaporous obscurity (camera lens / visor / glass) · blur: lose distinct sharp outlines visually (vision / edges / landscape)
groups.nuance_zh: cloud: 因杂质或水汽使透光物变浑浊 (lens / water / mirror) · mist up: 覆上一层细腻冷凝薄雾 (windscreen / spectacles / glass) · steam up: 被热气迅速熏蒸蒙雾 (mirror / goggles / window) · fog: 弥漫水汽导致彻底白茫茫不透亮 (camera lens / visor / glass) · blur: 轮廓失焦发虚模糊 (vision / edges / landscape)

groups.name: Cloud & Obscure · 遮蔽与混淆 (Cloud, Obscure, Shroud)
groups.tip: 如云雾罩顶遮挡视线与真相

items.def_zh: 起雾变模糊，使蒙上雾气
items.def_en: To become covered with condensation or steam so that transparency is lost
items.ex_en: Hot moisture caused the bathroom mirror to fog up almost instantly today.
items.ex_zh: 热气几乎瞬间就让今天浴室的镜子起了一层雾。
items.ex2_en: The hot kettle steam will fog up the kitchen windows very quickly.
items.ex2_zh: 水壶滚烫的蒸汽会很快使厨房的窗户蒙上一层雾气。

items.def_zh: 遮蔽，蒙上阴影；使变暗，使模糊；（情绪）使变阴沉
items.def_en: 1. To make something less clear, distinct, or transparent, like mist or clouds. 2. To make an issue, judgment, or feeling uncertain, gloomy, or confused. 3. To become overcast or filled with clouds.
items.ex_en: Dense smoke from the burning brush began to cloud the blue sky.
items.ex_zh: 燃烧树丛产生的浓烟开始遮蔽蔚蓝的天空。
items.ex2_en: The bright morning sky began to cloud over as cold winds blew.
items.ex2_zh: 随着冷风吹来，明朗的早晨天空开始阴沉下来。

items.def_en: To prevent something from being clearly seen, understood, or noticed
items.ex_en: Tall concrete buildings completely obscure our panoramic view of the distant sea.
items.ex_zh: 高耸的水泥建筑完全遮挡了我们远眺大海的开阔视野。

items.def_en: To envelop in fog, or to confuse and make a matter unclear
items.ex_en: Misleading media reports only serve to befog the clear truth of events.
items.ex_zh: 误导性的媒体报道只会把事件明朗的真相搅得扑朔迷离。

items.def_en: To cover, conceal, or envelop something completely in fog, darkness, or secrecy
items.ex_en: Dense rolling fog arose to shroud the silent coastal village completely tonight.
items.ex_zh: 今晚，翻滚的浓雾弥漫开来，将寂静的沿海村庄完全笼罩。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate impairing visual clarity, transparency, or intellectual comprehension by covering with mist, shadow, or confusing complexities.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过雾气、阴影或复杂因素使视线模糊、事实晦暗或判断受干扰。
groups.desc_en: Concealing facts, judgment, or reality behind a metaphorical or literal veil of ambiguity, contrasting with outright denial or destruction of truth.
groups.desc_zh: 用隐喻或物理的迷雾遮蔽事实、判断或真相，不同于彻底否认或毁灭证据。
groups.nuance_en: obscure: make unclear, dark, or difficult to perceive (truth / horizon / view) · shroud: wrap in secrecy or impenetrably cover from sight (mystery / summit / origin) · cloud: impair clarity of judgment, memory, or issues (judgment / mind / issue) · fog up: disorient or blunt intellectual focus (mind / perception) · befog: deliberately confuse or bewilder with complex rhetoric (issue / jury / debate)
groups.nuance_zh: obscure: 湮没、掩蔽使得事物晦暗难辨 (truth / horizon / view) · shroud: 如同裹尸布般密不透风地笼罩 (mystery / mystery / origin) · cloud: 情绪干预下使理智、记忆蒙阴走偏 (judgment / mind / issue) · fog up: 产生脑雾或知觉钝化 (mind / perception) · befog: 故意用含混言辞把水搅浑 (issue / jury / debate)

groups.name: Clumsy Handling & Rummaging · 笨拙摸索与翻找 (Fumble, Rummage, Scrabble)
groups.tip: 盲目摸索笨拙乱翻

items.def_en: Search by feeling around awkwardly inside a bag, pocket, or dark space
items.ex_en: She had to fish around in her huge tote bag for keys.
items.ex_zh: 她只得在巨大的手提袋里摸索翻找钥匙。

items.raw_cluster: 摸索与笨拙处理 Fumble & Grope
items.def_zh: 笨拙地摸索，乱翻；笨拙地处理；漏球
items.def_en: To use the hands awkwardly while doing or looking for something; to mishandle a situation or drop a ball.
items.ex_en: He fumbled clumsily with the tiny brass keys in the pitch darkness.
items.ex_zh: 他在漆黑中笨拙地摸索摆弄着细小的黄铜钥匙。

items.def_en: Rummage persistently through a space in search of an elusive item
items.ex_en: I spent hours ferreting around in the dark attic for old photos.
items.ex_zh: 我花了好几个小时在昏暗的阁楼里翻搜旧照片。

items.def_en: Scratch or grope around frantically with one's fingers to find or hold something
items.ex_en: The frantic hikers scrabbled desperately at loose rocks on the steep cliff.
items.ex_zh: 惊慌失措的徒步者们在陡峭的悬崖上拼命抓摸松动的岩石。

items.def_en: Search untidily through a mass or container to find something
items.ex_en: He had to rummage through old cardboard boxes to find tax documents.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不翻找旧纸箱以找到税务文件。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe awkward, uncoordinated hand movements while trying to find, grasp, or manipulate an object, often due to nervousness, haste, or clumsiness.
groups.summary_zh: 描述因慌乱、紧张或笨拙而手忙脚乱地摸索、翻找或摆弄物体。
groups.desc_en: Searching through items or space in an uncoordinated, hurried, or tactilely clumsy manner, contrasting with systematic methodical inspection.
groups.desc_zh: 在物品堆或空间中手忙脚乱、缺乏条理地摸索翻寻，不同于系统性的严谨检视。
groups.nuance_en: fumble: handle clumsily or awkwardly with fingers while seeking (pocket / keys / latch) · rummage: search untidily by turning things over and displacing items (drawer / bag / attic) · scrabble: scratch, scrape, or grope frantically with hands (dirt / pocket / desk) · ferret around: poke about inquisitively into crevices or corners (cupboard / archive / papers) · fish around: reach blindly into a container trying to grasp something (purse / bottom of bag / pocket)
groups.nuance_zh: fumble: 手指笨拙无章法地乱摸瞎鼓捣 (pocket / keys / latch) · rummage: 乱翻乱倒把东西翻个底朝天 (drawer / bag / attic) · scrabble: 慌乱地用手指扒拉乱抠 (dirt / pocket / desk) · ferret around: 像雪貂钻洞般到处搜寻打探 (cupboard / archive / papers) · fish around: 盲目探手摸索勾取 (purse / bottom of bag / pocket)

groups.name: Clutter & Jumble · 弄乱与混杂堆放 (Clutter, Jumble, Litter)
groups.tip: 杂物堆积使空间杂乱

items.def_en: (+ with/into) To fill a space uncomfortably full of objects or people
items.ex_en: Discarded wooden boxes crowd the narrow hallway, blocking the main emergency exit.
items.ex_zh: 废弃的木箱挤满了狭窄的走廊，堵住了主要紧急出口。
items.ex2_en: Thousands of excited fans crowd into the stadium to watch the final.
items.ex2_zh: 成千上万兴奋的球迷涌入体育场观看最后的决赛。

items.def_en: To clog, tangle, or throw a space or mechanism into disorder
items.ex_en: Tangled fishing lines and seaweed can foul up the boat's outboard motor.
items.ex_zh: 缠结的鱼线和海草会缠住并弄坏船的舷外发动机。

items.def_en: (+ with) To spread rubbish or scattered objects untidily across an area
items.ex_en: Careless tourists litter the scenic mountain trails with plastic bottles and wrappers.
items.ex_zh: 粗心的游客将塑料瓶和包装纸乱扔在风景优美的山间小径上。

items.def_en: (+ up/with) To fill a place or surface with an untidy collection of things.
items.ex_en: Piles of unread newspapers clutter up the small living room coffee table.
items.ex_zh: 堆积如山的未读报纸把客厅的小咖啡桌塞得乱七八糟。

items.def_en: (+ up) To mix things together in a confused, disordered way
items.ex_en: Moving movers managed to jumble all my carefully sorted files together completely.
items.ex_zh: 搬家工人把我不容易分类归档的文件彻底全弄混了。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate filling or covering a space with an untidy, disorganized heap of disparate items, obstructing neatness or utility.
groups.summary_zh: 杂物乱堆乱放占用空间，导致场面杂乱无章。
groups.desc_en: Filling a space disorderly with disorganized, excessive, or discordant items, contrasting with structured storage or clean emptiness.
groups.desc_zh: 杂物无序堆积充塞空间致使其混乱逼仄，不同于井然有序的归纳或清爽留白。
groups.nuance_en: clutter: choke a space with too many disordered, non-essential things (desk / room / mind) · jumble: mix up disparate items indiscriminately into a tangled heap (clothes / thoughts / wires) · litter: scatter unwanted waste carelessly over an area (street / floor / landscape) · crowd: press tightly into a space to the point of discomfort (passage / hallway / thought) · foul up: contaminate or entangle messily (works / gears / shoreline)
groups.nuance_zh: clutter: 塞满零碎无用之物造成逼仄凌乱 (desk / room / mind) · jumble: 将不同之物胡乱混杂一团 (clothes / thoughts / wires) · litter: 随手乱扔杂物垃圾散落一地 (street / floor / landscape) · crowd: 拥挤填塞至无容身缝隙 (passage / hallway / thought) · foul up: 弄脏弄乱使机械或空间堵结 (works / gears / shoreline)

groups.name: Coach & Drill · 指导训练与带教 (Coach, Train, Drill, Mentor)
groups.tip: 教练指引提升技能

items.def_en: To teach a person or animal the skills and behaviors needed for an art, job, or sport
items.ex_en: The facility will train new technicians to operate the advanced robotic systems.
items.ex_zh: 该机构将培训新入职的技术人员操作先进的机器人系统。

items.def_en: To train, instruct, or supervise someone in a sport, subject, or skill
items.ex_en: She agreed to coach the young tennis player ahead of the national tournament.
items.ex_zh: 她同意在全国锦标赛前指导这位年轻的网球选手。

items.def_en: To train someone by forcing them to practice exercises or techniques repeatedly
items.ex_en: The sergeant will drill the recruits in defensive maneuvers until dusk.
items.ex_zh: 军士将操练新兵练习防守战术，直至黄昏。

items.def_en: To act as a trusted, experienced guide and counselor to a younger or less experienced person
items.ex_en: Senior engineers regularly mentor junior developers to foster professional growth across the team.
items.ex_zh: 资深工程师定期指导初级开发者，以促进整个团队的专业成长。

items.def_en: To teach someone individually or in a small group, especially in academic subjects
items.ex_en: She was hired to tutor the struggling student in advanced calculus every evening.
items.ex_zh: 她受雇于每天晚上辅导那个学习吃力的学生高等微积分。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve actively preparing someone for performances, matches, or specific tasks through targeted practice, feedback, and drills.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过针对性练习、带教示范与反复强化来传授技能。
groups.desc_en: Systematically developing another person's performance, physical capability, or professional acumen, contrasting with lecturing or passive educating.
groups.desc_zh: 系统化地锤炼提升他人的运动表现、专业技能或实践能力，不同于单纯的填鸭讲授。
groups.nuance_en: coach: guide performance, strategy, and mental mindset individually (athlete / executive / singer) · train: condition physical fitness, discipline, or functional skill sets (crew / dog / runner) · drill: instill mechanical precision and reflex through relentless repetition (recruits / squad / students) · mentor: nurture overall career and personal wisdom over long periods (protege / colleague / youth) · tutor: give intensive, targeted academic remediation (pupil / student in math)
groups.nuance_zh: coach: 针对表现与策略进行针对性点拨指导 (athlete / executive / singer) · train: 操练体能、动作规范或实操技能 (crew / dog / runner) · drill: 借助机械重复形成本能肌肉记忆 (recruits / squad / students) · mentor: 亦师亦友指引长期心智与事业格局 (protege / colleague / youth) · tutor: 学业单科补习辅导 (pupil / student in math)

groups.name: Coat & Glaze · 涂层与上釉 (Glaze, Enamel, Varnish)
groups.tip: 上釉或覆上一层涂层

items.def_en: To cover a surface thoroughly with a thin layer of liquid, powder, or protective film
items.ex_en: Carefully coat the pastry with melted butter before placing it in the oven.
items.ex_zh: 在将糕点放入烤箱前，先仔细地刷上一层融化的黄油。

items.def_zh: 给……上釉，涂糖汁；给……装玻璃；（目光等）变呆滞
items.def_en: 1. to cover pottery or food with a thin shiny coating 2. to fit glass into a window or frame 3. (of eyes) to become fixed and expressionless
items.ex_en: The chef decided to glaze the roasted ham with sweet honey and mustard.
items.ex_zh: 主厨决定在烤火腿上涂上一层香甜的蜂蜜芥末汁。
items.ex2_en: The ceramic tiles glaze beautifully under the intense heat of the kiln.
items.ex2_zh: 在窑炉的高温烘烤下，这些陶瓷砖呈现出美丽的光泽。

items.def_en: To coat a metal, glass, or pottery surface with a glassy, opaque decorative substance baked on
items.ex_en: Artisans continue to enamel decorative copper vases using ancient, highly demanding techniques.
items.ex_zh: 工匠们继续采用古老而要求极高的工艺为装饰性铜瓶烧上珐琅。

items.def_en: To apply a clear liquid that dries into a hard, shiny protective coating onto wood or metal
items.ex_en: He decided to varnish the mahogany table to protect it from moisture damage.
items.ex_zh: 他决定给这张红木桌刷上清漆，以防其受潮损坏。

items.def_en: To apply lacquer to a wooden or metal object to give it a durable, glossy finish
items.ex_en: Craftsmen carefully lacquer the wooden bowls to achieve an exceptionally durable, glossy finish.
items.ex_zh: 工匠们仔细地给木碗上漆，以获得极其耐磨且富有光泽的饰面。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers applying a smooth, lustrous, or protective surface finish to ceramics, woodwork, food, or crafts. The focus is on producing a glossy, sealed, or vitreous protective exterior layer.
groups.summary_zh: 指在器具、食物或材料表面涂抹光亮、封闭或具保护性的釉料及罩光层。
groups.desc_en: Applying a protective, shiny, or vitrified liquid layer onto an object's surface that hardens, contrasting with merely painting with plain color.
groups.desc_zh: 在物体表面涂布一层硬化后光亮致密、耐磨防渗的涂层，不同于普通的刷色着漆。
groups.nuance_en: coat: cover evenly with an external layer of substance (metal / seed / pill) · glaze: apply a glossy, glassy, or sugary top film (pottery / pastry / ham) · varnish: apply a tough, transparent resin coating for sheen and protection (wood / floor / painting) · lacquer: coat with an ultra-smooth, high-gloss durable solvent finish (furniture / wood / brass) · enamel: coat with a vitreous, high-temperature hard glossy finish (metal / sink / tooth)
groups.nuance_zh: coat: 均匀被覆一层外衣 (metal / seed / pill) · glaze: 淋浇糖浆或上釉形成光泽薄层 (pottery / pastry / ham) · varnish: 涂刷清漆以显露底色并增光护木 (wood / floor / painting) · lacquer: 喷涂厚重高光且致密的亮漆 (furniture / wood / brass) · enamel: 烧制或施敷坚硬如搪瓷般的平滑保护釉 (metal / sink / tooth)

groups.name: Codify & Enact · 编纂与建制 (Codify, Legislate, Institutionalize)
groups.tip: 成文化确立法律规范

items.def_en: To arrange according to an organized, clear system, rule, or plan
items.ex_en: The researcher sought to systematize the vast collection of historical records logically.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员试图将这一大批历史档案合理地系统化。

items.def_en: To establish something as an accepted, permanent convention, standard, or organization
items.ex_en: The administration aims to institutionalize these transparent practices across all government agencies.
items.ex_zh: 该届政府旨在将这些透明的做法在所有政府机构中制度化。

items.def_en: to arrange laws, rules, or principles systematically into an official written code
items.ex_en: The committee worked tirelessly to codify traditional maritime practices into written statute.
items.ex_zh: 该委员会不知疲倦地工作，以将传统的海事惯例整理规范为成文法规。

items.def_en: To give official status, definite form, or recognized structure to an arrangement
items.ex_en: The two nations agreed to formalize their defense partnership through a signed treaty.
items.ex_zh: 两国同意通过签署条约将它们的防务合作关系正式确立。

items.def_en: To put a proposal or decree officially into law through a governing body
items.ex_en: Parliament voted decisively to enact comprehensive environmental protections late last night.
items.ex_zh: 议会昨晚深夜果断投票，正式颁布了全面的环境保护法。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to organizing, writing down, or formally enacting customs, principles, or regulations into legally binding or institutionally recognized codes.
groups.summary_zh: 指将规则、惯例系统整理成法典，或在制度层面上确立实施。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the transformation of informal practices, ideas, or ad hoc rules into authoritative, systemic, and legally binding structures, contrasting with merely inventing or proposing ideas.
groups.desc_zh: 指将零散惯例、非正式做法或构想上升为具权威性、成体系且具约束力的制度与法典，区别于单纯的提出或发明。
groups.nuance_en: codify: arrange into an authoritative systematic code or rulebook (laws / rules / conventions) · enact: make into law through official legislative process (legislation / statutes / reforms) · institutionalize: embed firmly within an organization or culture as a standard fixture (practices / norms / bias) · formalize: give official or written status to an existing custom (agreement / relationship / procedure) · systematize: organize disparate elements into a coherent, orderly framework (knowledge / records / methods)
groups.nuance_zh: codify: 编纂成典或系统化成文规则 (laws / rules / conventions) · enact: 经立法程序使之正式通过生效 (legislation / statutes / reforms) · institutionalize: 将做法内化为制度或常态机制 (practices / norms / bias) · formalize: 将已有习惯或意向赋予正式名分与规范 (agreement / relationship / procedure) · systematize: 将零乱要素条理化、体系化 (knowledge / records / methods)

groups.name: Collaborate & Partner · 结盟与联合 (Partner, Team Up, Ally)
groups.tip: 结成伙伴协同共事

items.def_en: (+ with) To join with another person or group in order to work together on an activity
items.ex_en: The two rival tech companies decided to team up to develop the open-source platform.
items.ex_zh: 这两家相互竞争的科技公司决定联手合作，共同开发该开源平台。

items.def_en: To combine efforts, resources, or people with another party to accomplish a shared goal
