items.ex_en: Both charities decided to join forces to combat regional poverty more effectively.
items.ex_zh: 两家慈善机构决定联合力量，以更有效地应对地区贫困。

items.def_zh: 与……结成伙伴，使合作；做伙伴
items.def_en: 1. To form a partnership with someone, or bring two people or organizations together to work as partners.
items.ex_en: The university agreed to partner with local tech firms on innovative artificial intelligence projects.
items.ex_zh: 该大学同意与当地科技公司在创新人工智能项目上开展合作。

items.def_en: To join together in a formal agreement to support one another in politics, war, or mutual interests
items.ex_en: The neighboring nations decided to ally formally against the growing regional threat.
items.ex_zh: 这些邻国决定正式结盟，以抵御日益增长的地区威胁。
items.ex2_en: The prime minister sought to ally his party with influential labor unions.
items.ex2_zh: 首相试图使自己的政党与具有影响力的工会结成联盟。

items.def_en: (+ with / on) To work jointly with someone else on an intellectual, artistic, or professional project
items.ex_en: The two leading scientists will collaborate closely on the groundbreaking cancer study.
items.ex_zh: 这两位顶尖科学家将在这项开创性的癌症研究中密切合作。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail cooperative alignments between individuals, commercial enterprises, or political entities. They emphasize coordinating resources, sharing mutual objectives, or pooling efforts toward a common endeavor.
groups.summary_zh: 指个人、企业或机构为实现共同利益或目标建立合作联手关系的动作。
groups.desc_en: Denotes combining resources, effort, and authority across separate entities to pursue a mutual objective, contrasting with working in isolation or subordinate assistance.
groups.desc_zh: 指不同独立主体聚合资源、意志与力量以谋求共同目标，区别于单打独斗或从属性的协助。
groups.nuance_en: collaborate: work together intellectually or creatively across organizational lines (scientists / artists / competitors) · partner: enter a formal, balanced strategic or business alliance (firms / agencies / universities) · ally: align politically, militarily, or strategically against common challenges (nations / factions / groups) · team up: join casually or operationally for a specific task (colleagues / rivals / volunteers) · join forces: combine independent capabilities to amplify collective impact (charities / departments / campaigns)
groups.nuance_zh: collaborate: 跨界协同创作或联合科研 (scientists / artists / competitors) · partner: 确立平等规范的战略或商业合作 (firms / agencies / universities) · ally: 在政治、军事或利害上结盟抗衡外敌 (nations / factions / groups) · team up: 为完成具体任务搭班组队 (colleagues / rivals / volunteers) · join forces: 联合各自力量以形成更大声势与效能 (charities / departments / campaigns)

groups.name: Collateralize & Back · 抵押与资产担保 (Collateralize, Securitize, Underwrite)
groups.tip: 用资产作为债务担保

items.def_en: To guarantee financial support or value for a currency, security, or loan.
items.ex_en: The central bank chose to back the national currency with substantial gold reserves.
items.ex_zh: 中央银行选择以大量的黄金储备来支撑本国货币。

items.def_en: To pool various types of contractual debt and sell them as consolidated financial instruments.
items.ex_en: Investment banks frequently securitize high-risk mortgages to distribute liabilities across global markets.
items.ex_zh: 投资银行经常将高风险抵押贷款进行证券化，以将债务分散至全球市场。

items.def_en: To accept financial liability for another entity's debt or issue of securities.
items.ex_en: A syndicate of major banks agreed to underwrite the sovereign bond issuance.
items.ex_zh: 一家由各大银行组成的辛迪加同意包销该主权债券的发行。

items.def_en: (law) To place a legal claim or lien on a property or asset as security for a debt.
items.ex_en: The lender will formally encumber the commercial property until the loan is satisfied.
items.ex_zh: 在贷款清偿之前，贷款人将在该商业地产上正式设定抵押负担。

items.def_zh: 用……作抵押，以资产担保（贷款）
items.def_en: 1. (finance) To secure a loan or obligation by pledging assets as collateral.
items.ex_en: The corporation pledged prime corporate real estate to collateralize the revolving credit facility.
items.ex_zh: 该企业质押优质商业地产，以此为循环信贷额度提供担保。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame operate in formal finance and lending, denoting the legal dedication or securitization of real assets to guarantee repayment or underwrite obligations.
groups.summary_zh: 在金融融资中以具体资产作担保或发行担保证券。
groups.desc_en: Denotes pledging, structuring, or guaranteeing financial assets to mitigate credit risk and facilitate financing, contrasting with simple uncollateralized lending or spending.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过抵押、结构化打包或担保来对冲信贷风险并融通资金，区别于普通的无担保借贷或直接支出。
groups.nuance_en: collateralize: pledge specific assets as security to guarantee debt repayment (loans / debt / bonds) · securitize: pool illiquid contractual debts into tradeable financial securities (mortgages / receivables / assets) · underwrite: assume financial risk and guarantee payment in case of default or unsold issues (shares / debt offerings / insurance policies) · back: support or guarantee value through underlying reserves or credibility (currency / bonds / ventures) · encumber: burden a property or asset with a legal claim or lien (assets / estates / titles)
groups.nuance_zh: collateralize: 以特定资产作质押以担保履约 (loans / debt / bonds) · securitize: 将非流动性债权打包转化为可交易证券 (mortgages / receivables / assets) · underwrite: 承销证券或承保理赔以兜底风险 (shares / debt offerings / insurance policies) · back: 用准备金、信誉等背书支撑价值 (currency / bonds / ventures) · encumber: 在资产上设定留置权或权利负担 (assets / estates / titles)

groups.name: Collocate & Cohere · 搭配与共现 (Co-occur, Pair with, Go together)
groups.tip: 语言学中词语的习惯性搭配

items.def_en: To exist, happen, or appear in combination alongside another element in discourse or data
items.ex_en: Linguistic analysis reveals that these distinctive grammatical structures frequently co-occur in formal texts.
items.ex_zh: 语言学分析表明，这些独特的语法结构经常在正式文本中同时出现。

items.def_en: To combine or join two linguistic elements or items so they work together harmoniously
items.ex_en: Writers often pair this adjective with abstract nouns to convey subtle emotional nuances.
items.ex_zh: 作者常将此形容词与抽象名词搭配，以传达微妙的情感细微差别。
items.ex2_en: Crisp white wines pair well with grilled seafood and light summer salads.
items.ex2_zh: 清爽的白葡萄酒与烤海鲜和清淡的夏日沙拉搭配十分得当。

items.def_en: To naturally match, harmonize, or frequently appear together as expected partners
items.ex_en: These two complementary colors naturally go together in traditional landscape painting.
items.ex_zh: 这两种互补色在传统山水画中自然相得益彰。

items.def_en: To fit or link together neatly and seamlessly like interlocking pieces
items.ex_en: The proposed infrastructure upgrades dovetail perfectly with the municipality's long-term sustainability goals.
items.ex_zh: 提议的基础设施升级与该市的长期可持续发展目标严丝合缝地吻合。
items.ex2_en: The architect carefully dovetails traditional building aesthetics with modern environmental engineering standards.
items.ex2_zh: 建筑师精心将传统建筑美学与现代环境工程标准完美结合起来。

items.def_en: (linguistics) (of words) To naturally and frequently appear together; to arrange words or things in relation to one another.
items.ex_en: In corpus linguistics, scholars observe how modal verbs collocate with specific progressive participles.
items.ex_zh: 在语料库语言学中，学者们观察情态动词如何与特定的进行体分词习惯搭配。
items.ex2_en: Language teachers collocate strong verbs with precise prepositions to improve writing skills.
items.ex2_zh: 语言教师将强动词与精准的介词搭配以提升写作技能。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this linguistic and compositional frame denote how words or structural elements fit, co-occur naturally, or systematically combine to form idiomatic, semantically harmonious wholes.
groups.summary_zh: 指语言成分或结构元素之间自然共现、习惯搭配或契合衔接。
groups.desc_en: Denotes elements appearing naturally together or fitting into a harmonious, logical whole, contrasting with random juxtaposition or forced union.
groups.desc_zh: 指事物自然共现、习惯性搭配或在逻辑与结构上严丝合缝，区别于生硬拼凑或随机并置。
groups.nuance_en: collocate: co-occur with statistically habitual frequency in linguistic usage (words / terms / idioms) · co-occur: exist or happen simultaneously within a shared context (symptoms / phenomena / variables) · pair with: combine naturally or intentionally to complement each other (flavors / wines / fonts) · go together: match well aesthetically or logically (colors / styles / tastes) · dovetail: fit together seamlessly with precise, interlocking harmony (plans / operations / schedules)
groups.nuance_zh: collocate: 语言学上以高概率习惯性共现 (words / terms / idioms) · co-occur: 在同一时空或样本中共同发生 (symptoms / phenomena / variables) · pair with: 有意或天然形成互补搭配 (flavors / wines / fonts) · go together: 风格或逻辑上相得益彰 (colors / styles / tastes) · dovetail: 榫卯般严丝合缝、紧密衔接 (plans / operations / schedules)

groups.name: Collude & Conspire · 串通与勾结 (Connive, Intrigue, Scheme)
groups.tip: 暗中密谋串通搞权力斗争

items.def_en: To make clever, devious plans to gain personal advantage, often at the expense of others
items.ex_en: The corrupt treasurer continued to scheme behind closed doors to secure personal kickbacks.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的司库继续在闭门密室中耍弄阴谋，以获取个人回扣。

items.def_en: To engage in underhand machinations or secret political plotting
items.ex_en: Discontented courtiers continued to intrigue against the monarch in the palace corridors.
items.ex_zh: 心怀不满的廷臣继续在宫廷走廊里暗中捣鬼，密谋反对君主。

items.def_en: To make secret agreements or plans together with others to carry out an unlawful or harmful design
items.ex_en: The rogue officers met clandestinely to conspire against the democratically elected government.
items.ex_zh: 叛逆军官秘密会面，共谋推翻民主选举产生的政府。

items.def_en: To cooperate secretly or unlawfully with someone in order to deceive or cheat others.
items.ex_en: The investigation revealed that competing suppliers chose to collude on fixing public bids.
items.ex_zh: 调查显示，相互竞争的供应商竟然串通一气，操纵公共竞标。

items.def_en: To cooperate secretly in an illegal or wrongful activity, or knowingly allow wrongdoing to proceed unchecked
items.ex_en: Senior administrators were accused of choosing to connive at systemic financial embezzlement.
items.ex_zh: 高层管理人员被指控蓄意纵容体制内的财务侵占行为。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate covert cooperation among parties to commit illegal, unethical, or deceptive acts, often involving institutional misconduct, corporate price-fixing, or betrayal of trust.
groups.summary_zh: 多方暗中勾结以牟取不当利益或损害公众、他人权益。
groups.desc_en: Denotes secret and deceitful coordination among multiple actors to achieve an unlawful, unfair, or subversive outcome, contrasting with open cooperation or benign planning.
groups.desc_zh: 指多方暗中密谋勾结以达成非法、不公或颠覆性目的，区别于公开协作或合法的共同筹划。
groups.nuance_en: collude: secretly cooperate to defraud, fix prices, or circumvent regulations (firms / officials / cartel members) · conspire: plot together secretly to commit an illegal or treasonous act (rebels / criminals / elites) · connive: secretly allow or turn a blind eye to wrongdoing while tacitly complicit (authorities / insiders / guards) · scheme: devise crafty, underhanded plans for selfish gain (rivals / opportunists / politicians) · intrigue: engage in covert, complex political or romantic machinations (courtiers / factions / diplomats)
groups.nuance_zh: collude: 通谋串通以操纵价格或规避监管 (firms / officials / cartel members) · conspire: 密谋策划违法乱纪或叛逆之举 (rebels / criminals / elites) · connive: 默许纵容并暗中通融不法行为 (authorities / insiders / guards) · scheme: 为谋私利而施展狡黠心机 (rivals / opportunists / politicians) · intrigue: 搞宫廷式争宠或暗中政治倾轧 (courtiers / factions / diplomats)

groups.name: Come to an End by Time Limit · 期满与失效 (Expire, Lapse)
groups.tip: 效力或生命的到期终结

items.def_en: to reach the end of a valid period (e.g., of a visa, lease, or passport)
items.ex_en: My work visa will run out unless I file the renewal paperwork immediately.
items.ex_zh: 除非我立即提交续签材料，否则我的工作签证就要到期了。

items.def_en: to come to a temporal end, disappear, or cease to have effect over time
items.ex_en: The interim trading privileges granted to foreign merchants will pass away at midnight.
items.ex_zh: 赋予外国商人的临时贸易特权将于今夜午夜终止失效。

items.def_zh: 期满，失效，终止；断气，死亡
items.def_en: 1. To come to an end and no longer be valid or effective. 2. (formal) To die or breathe one's last breath.
items.ex_en: The valid terms of this nondisclosure agreement will expire at the end of the year.
items.ex_zh: 该保密协议的有效条款将于今年年底期满失效。

items.def_en: (formal) to come to an official end or reach its concluding point
items.ex_en: The contractual obligations will officially terminate when the final installment is paid.
items.ex_zh: 当最后一笔分期款项付讫时，合同义务将正式终止。
items.ex2_en: The board decided to terminate the executive contract following serious financial misconduct.
items.ex2_zh: 在发生严重的财务违规行为后，董事会决定终止该高管合同。

items.def_zh: 期满失效，终止；陷入（某种状态）；背离（信仰、准则）
items.def_en: 1. To stop being valid or active, especially through failure to renew. 2. (+ into) To gradually pass or fall into a particular state or condition.
items.ex_en: His comprehensive auto insurance policy will lapse if he neglects the upcoming premium payment.
items.ex_zh: 如果他疏忽了即将到期的保费，他的全额汽车保单就会失效。

groups.summary_en: These intransitive verbs describe an official document, contract, entitlement, or validity reaching its temporal end and ceasing to be active. 'Expire' is the neutral standard term for passing a designated deadline, while 'lapse' emphasizes cessation through non-renewal, negligence, or passage of time.
groups.summary_zh: 指文件、合约或效力因期限届满或未续期而自然终止失效。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the automatic cessation of legal force, validity, or availability caused by the passage of a defined temporal boundary, contrasting with active, premature cancellation.
groups.desc_zh: 指权利、效力或时限因法定/约定时间耗尽而自然终结，区别于人为主动干预的中途撤销。
groups.nuance_en: expire: reach the end of an official term of validity (contract / passport / lease) · lapse: become void due to non-renewal or failure to meet conditions within time limits (policy / membership / patent) · run out: be completely exhausted or reach temporal depletion (time / patience / supply) · terminate: come to an abrupt or scheduled formal end (agreement / pregnancy / employment) · pass away: fade gently or cease to exist, often euphemistic for death (custom / era / patient)
groups.nuance_zh: expire: 达到法定期限而自然作废终止 (contract / passport / lease) · lapse: 因未及时续费或未履约导致失效中止 (policy / membership / patent) · run out: 时间、资源等用尽耗光 (time / patience / supply) · terminate: 达到合同终期或经程序正式终止 (agreement / pregnancy / employment) · pass away: 逝去、消逝或委婉指死亡 (custom / era / patient)

groups.name: Comfort & Soothe Distress · 安慰与释怀 (Console, Soothe, Comfort)
groups.tip: 抚平焦虑情绪并给予鼓励支持

items.def_en: Ease the sorrow or distress of someone by offering sympathetic presence and words
items.ex_en: She sat quietly beside her weeping friend to comfort her in her distress.
items.ex_zh: 她静静地坐在哭泣的朋友身边，在她痛苦时给予安慰。

items.def_en: Comfort someone who is grievously disappointed, mourning, or heartbroken
items.ex_en: Nothing the priest said could console the grieving mother after her tragic loss.
items.ex_zh: 在遭遇不幸的惨事后，牧师的任何话都无法抚慰这位悲痛的母亲。

items.def_en: (+ that/about) To say or do something that removes someone's doubts or fears and makes them feel calmer.
items.ex_en: The doctor spoke calmly to reassure the nervous patient about the upcoming surgery.
items.ex_zh: 医生温和地交谈，以消除这位紧张病人对即将到来的手术的疑虑。

items.def_en: Gently calm someone's agitation, pain, or emotional distress
items.ex_en: Her gentle, measured words helped soothe his mounting anxiety during the chaotic crisis.
items.ex_zh: 在混乱的危机中，她温和而有分寸的话语帮助抚平了他日益加剧的焦虑。

items.def_en: Make an unpleasant feeling, fear, or guilt less intense through appeasement
items.ex_en: The minister attempted to assuage widespread public fears regarding the impending tax increases.
items.ex_zh: 部长试图平息公众对即将到来的增税计划普遍存在的恐惧。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe verbal or behavioral intervention designed to relieve another person's anguish, fear, grief, or uncertainty. Variations depend on whether the intent is lifting sorrow, restoring calm, or resolving doubts.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过话语或行为抚慰他人的悲痛、焦虑或疑虑，使之恢复平静与信心。
groups.desc_en: Denotes actively easing someone's grief, anxiety, or emotional pain through empathy, presence, or mitigating actions, contrasting with mere indifferent pity.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过同理心、言行陪伴或缓解措施来减轻他人的悲痛、焦虑与痛苦，区别于冷漠的同情。
groups.nuance_en: console: offer warm sympathy specifically to someone grieving or suffering major loss (mourners / losers / widow) · comfort: provide physical or emotional relief and solace to alleviate sorrow (child / patient / family) · reassure: dispel doubts, fears, or anxieties with encouraging certainty (investors / public / patient) · soothe: calm acute physical irritation or ruffled feelings (nerves / pain / distress) · assuage: lessen the intensity of a painful emotion or gnawing appetite (guilt / fears / grief)
groups.nuance_zh: console: 对遭遇重创或丧亲者给予针对性抚慰 (mourners / losers / widow) · comfort: 提供温情陪伴以抚平创痛或给予寄托 (child / patient / family) · reassure: 打消顾虑与恐慌以安定人心 (investors / public / patient) · soothe: 抚平激荡的情绪或缓解生理刺痛 (nerves / pain / distress) · assuage: 平息内疚、恐惧或饥渴感 (guilt / fears / grief)

groups.name: Command & Decree · 规定与敕令 (Decree, Ordain, Enact)
groups.tip: 权威主体发号施令或立下规定

items.def_en: To state clearly and definitively that something must be done as part of an official agreement or contract
items.ex_en: The lease agreements clearly stipulate that tenants must bear routine maintenance costs.
items.ex_zh: 租赁协议明确规定租户必须承担日常维护费用。

items.def_zh: 必须，应当（用于法律、章程等强制性规定）；将要，会（与第一人称连用）；要不要，好吗（征求意见）
items.def_en: 1. (formal / law) Used to express a mandatory command, legal requirement, or official rule. 2. Used to express the simple future tense (primarily with 'I' and 'we'). 3. Used in questions to make an offer, request, or suggestion.
items.ex_en: The contractor shall complete all scheduled renovations prior to the first of September.
items.ex_zh: 承包商必须在九月一日之前完成所有预定的装修工程。

items.def_en: To pass a law or make a formal proposal officially into statute by sovereign or parliamentary process
items.ex_en: The legislature convened early this morning to enact urgent financial reform legislation.
items.ex_zh: 立法机构于今晨早早开会，以颁布紧急金融改革法案。

items.def_en: To officially order, establish, or decide something by an authoritative edict or legal proclamation
items.ex_en: The monarch issued an official proclamation to decree absolute religious tolerance throughout the realm.
items.ex_zh: 君主颁布了一项官方文告，裁定在全国范围内实行绝对的宗教宽容。

items.def_en: To order, establish, or decree officially by virtue of superior law, religious authority, or fate
items.ex_en: The constitution ordains that judicial authority resides solely within an independent supreme court.
items.ex_zh: 宪法规定司法权仅属于独立的最高法院。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures the formal codification and proclamation of authoritative decrees, statutory duties, and legal obligations. It spans legislative enactment, sovereign decree, and the solemn establishment of binding rules.
groups.summary_zh: 以法定条文、主权裁决或庄严法令形式确立不可逾越的义务。
groups.desc_en: Denotes issuing binding, authoritative instructions backed by sovereign, legal, or divine power, contrasting with mere advice, request, or negotiation.
groups.desc_zh: 指凭藉主权、法律或神权发布具有绝对约束力的敕令与法则，区别于寻常的建议、请求或协商。
groups.nuance_en: decree: officially order by sovereign fiat or judicial authority (ban / amnesty / state of emergency) · ordain: establish unalterably by divine will, fate, or high religious authority (fate / priesthood / laws) · enact: translate into law by constitutional legislative procedure (statute / bill / reform) · stipulate: require strictly as an indispensable contractual condition (conditions / terms / requirements) · shall: express mandatory, imperative legal duty in normative texts (party / court / licensee)
groups.nuance_zh: decree: 依主权独断或最高裁判颁布政令或判决 (ban / amnesty / state of emergency) · ordain: 依神意、天命或宗教圣秩法定立命定规程 (fate / priesthood / laws) · enact: 经立法程序使法案生效 (statute / bill / reform) · stipulate: 在契约中明确列明硬性条款 (conditions / terms / requirements) · shall: 在法规条文中表述强制性法定义务 (party / court / licensee)

groups.name: Commemorate & Observe · 纪念与隆重仪式 (Observe, Remember, Mark)
groups.tip: 举行仪式感念历史人物事迹

items.def_en: To celebrate or officially recognize an important anniversary or turning point
items.ex_en: Communities across the country will mark the historic centennial with parades and fireworks.
items.ex_zh: 全国各地的社区将举行游行和烟花表演来庆祝这一具有历史意义的百年纪念。

items.def_en: To show deep public respect, gratitude, or tribute to someone's memory or sacrifice
items.ex_en: Citizens gathered solemnly at dawn to honor the soldiers who died defending the nation.
items.ex_zh: 民众破晓时分肃穆集会，向保卫国家而牺牲的军人们致敬。

items.def_en: To formally commemorate or keep a holiday, solemn occasion, or ritual tradition
items.ex_en: Descendants continue to observe the solemn holiday in accordance with ancient ancestral rituals.
items.ex_zh: 后人们继续按照古老的祖先仪式来庄严纪念这个神圣的节日。

items.def_en: To say or do something explicitly to express admiration, homage, and remembrance
items.ex_en: Dignitaries gathered at the monument to pay tribute to the fallen peacekeepers.
items.ex_zh: 各界要人齐聚纪念碑前，向牺牲的维和人员致以崇高敬意。

items.def_en: 1. To honor and preserve the memory of an important event or person with a ceremony, holiday, or monument.
items.ex_en: The city erected a marble statue to commemorate the brave firefighters who perished.
items.ex_zh: 该市竖立了一座大理石雕像，以纪念那些英勇牺牲的消防员。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on formal societal, ritual, or public remembrance of a historic milestone, fallen soldiers, or significant event through ceremonies, holidays, or official moments of silence.
groups.summary_zh: 通过官方礼仪、节日、默哀等公共仪式正式缅怀先驱或纪念历史事件。
groups.desc_en: Denotes intentionally acknowledging a momentous past event or person through solemn rituals, public monuments, or reverent collective memory, contrasting with casual recollection.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过庄严仪式、树碑立传或集体追思来隆重铭记重大事件或人物，区别于随意的联想或回忆。
groups.nuance_en: commemorate: honor the memory of a past event or hero, often with a formal monument or ceremony (anniversary / victims / fallen soldiers) · observe: conform to ceremonial or religious customs on a marked day (holiday / minute of silence / festival) · pay tribute to: make a public statement or gesture showing deep gratitude and respect (veterans / mentor / legacy) · honor: bestow high distinction or revere with deep respect (heroes / agreement / memory) · mark: signify or celebrate a distinctive milestone in time (centenary / milestone / occasion)
groups.nuance_zh: commemorate: 通过典礼或纪念物隆重纪念历史人物与事件 (anniversary / victims / fallen soldiers) · observe: 按礼制守节或肃穆恪守纪念时刻 (holiday / minute of silence / festival) · pay tribute to: 公开致敬以示尊崇与追怀 (veterans / mentor / legacy) · honor: 授予殊荣或以崇敬之情缅怀 (heroes / agreement / memory) · mark: 昭示、纪念关键的历史节点或里程碑 (centenary / milestone / occasion)

groups.name: Comment & Remark · 评论与评述 (Comment, Remark, Observe, Opine)
groups.tip: 发表个人见解与批判性点评

items.def_zh: 发表评论，发表意见；评论，评述
items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To express an opinion, judgment, or reaction about someone or something.
items.ex_en: The spokesperson declined to comment directly on the controversial allegations during the briefing.
items.ex_zh: 发言人在简报会上拒绝就这些有争议的指控直接发表评论。

items.def_en: To make a thoughtful remark or draw attention to an obvious or noticed fact in conversation
items.ex_en: The critic paused to observe that the author's later novels lacked narrative vitality.
items.ex_zh: 评论家停顿了一下并指出，该作者后期的长篇小说缺乏叙事活力。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To mention or say something as a brief, casual observation or opinion
items.ex_en: Visitors frequently remark on the unusual quietness that pervades the ancient cloister.
items.ex_zh: 访客们经常谈论弥漫在古老修道院回廊中的非寻常宁静。

items.def_en: (+ on) To actively join a discussion, debate, or argument by voicing one's view or perspective
items.ex_en: Several prominent economists weighed in on the inflation debate.
items.ex_zh: 数位知名经济学家介入了这场关于通胀的辩论。

items.def_en: To formally state one's personal view, philosophical judgment, or interpretation of a subject
items.ex_en: Constitutional scholars opine that the disputed statute violates core fundamental civil liberties.
items.ex_zh: 宪法学者发表意见认为，该争议法规侵犯了核心基本民权。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to expressing an explicit thought, reaction, or passing observation regarding an event, topic, or person without necessarily providing formal analysis.
groups.summary_zh: 就某事、某人或当前形势随口或明确地发表看法、评语与感言。
groups.desc_en: Denotes expressing an articulated judgment, interpretation, or personal reflection on an observed situation, contrasting with rigorous formal reporting or emotional venting.
groups.desc_zh: 指对所见所闻发表个人的见解、评断或随感，区别于严谨的事实汇报或单纯的情绪宣泄。
groups.nuance_en: comment: offer an opinion, reaction, or explanation on a topic (situation / statement / case) · remark: make a casual, passing verbal observation (appearance / changes / irony) · observe: state a perceptive, considered fact or insight derived from watching (trend / behavior / discrepancy) · opine: express a formal or subjective judgment as an opinion (ruling / merits / policy) · weigh in: intervene to add one's voice or clout to an ongoing debate (debate / controversy / issue)
groups.nuance_zh: comment: 针对特定议题发表评论、表态或解读 (situation / statement / case) · remark: 随口说出看法或轻描淡写地提及 (appearance / changes / irony) · observe: 基于敏锐观察道出见地或指明客观事实 (trend / behavior / discrepancy) · opine: 正式陈述主观看法或建言 (ruling / merits / policy) · weigh in: 介入正在进行的争论以表明立场 (debate / controversy / issue)

groups.name: Commercialize & Monetize · 商业化与营利性利用 (Commercialize, Monetize, Exploit)
groups.tip: 将公共资源推向商业化利用

items.def_en: To develop resources for profit, or to use someone or something selfishly for financial gain
items.ex_en: The multinational corporation sought to exploit untapped lithium reserves in the remote valley.
items.ex_zh: 这家跨国公司试图开采并利用偏远山谷中未开发的锂储量。

items.def_en: To take opportunistic advantage of a situation or trend to secure financial profit
items.ex_en: Opportunistic vendors rushed to cash in on the viral dance craze with themed merchandise.
items.ex_zh: 见机行事的商贩们争先恐后地推出主题商品，借着病毒式走红的舞蹈热潮大捞一笔。

items.def_zh: 商品化推销；贩卖衍生品
items.def_en: To promote, brand, and sell products linked to popular media, names, or events
items.ex_en: The movie studio aggressively sought to merchandise every popular superhero across retail outlets.
items.ex_zh: 电影制片厂竭力在各零售网点大力推销每一位热门超级英雄的衍生商品。

items.def_en: To utilize an asset, service, or audience to generate financial income
items.ex_en: The media startup plans to monetize its vast subscriber network through tiered subscriptions.
items.ex_zh: 该媒体初创公司计划通过分级订阅制将其庞大的订阅读者群变现。

items.raw_cluster: 商业化与利用 Commercialize & Exploit
items.def_zh: 使商业化，使商品化；利用……营利
items.def_en: To organize, develop, or exploit something mainly for financial profit, often at the expense of its quality or character.
items.ex_en: Purists argued that aggressive marketing would commercialize the sacred indigenous folk festival.
items.ex_zh: 原教旨主义者认为，激进的营销手段会使这一神圣的本土民俗节日过度商业化。

groups.summary_en: This institutional frame revolves around converting ideas, art, resources, or practices into money-making ventures, often trading intrinsic authenticity for financial return.
groups.summary_zh: 将事物转化为营利性商业产品，往往以牺牲纯粹性为代价变现。
groups.desc_en: Denotes adapting goods, IP, or activities into lucrative revenue streams and consumer products, contrasting with purely artistic, academic, or non-profit dissemination.
groups.desc_zh: 指将知识产权、科研成果或活动推向市场以实现变现和商业回报，区别于纯学术、公益或艺术性传播。
groups.nuance_en: commercialize: bring an invention, product, or service to the mass market for sale (technology / discovery / research) · monetize: convert an asset, audience, or traffic into cash (content / platform / data) · exploit: utilize a resource fully to maximize profit, sometimes ruthlessly (reserves / copyright / vulnerability) · merchandise: promote and market branded consumer goods tied to media or celebrities (characters / brand / apparel) · cash in on: capitalize swiftly and opportunistically on a trend or fame (trend / success / craze)
groups.nuance_zh: commercialize: 将成果或发明推向市场产业化应用 (technology / discovery / research) · monetize: 将流量、数据或内容等资产转化为现金流 (content / platform / data) · exploit: 充分利用或榨取资源/版权的商业价值 (reserves / copyright / vulnerability) · merchandise: 开发销售带有特定IP的衍生商品 (characters / brand / apparel) · cash in on: 迅速抓住热点或名气套现获利 (trend / success / craze)

groups.name: Commercialize Integrity · 沦落出卖与谋私弃义 (Whore, Pander, Pimp)
groups.tip: 堕落沉沦出卖尊严与底线

items.def_zh: 卖淫；出卖原则，同流合污
items.def_en: 1. to work or engage as a prostitute 2. (+ out) to compromise one's principles or integrity for monetary gain or personal advantage
items.ex_en: Critics argued the veteran journalist would whore out his credibility for cheap tabloid headlines.
items.ex_zh: 批评人士称，这位资深记者为了廉价的小报头条不惜出卖自己的信誉。

items.def_zh: 充当皮条客，借……牟利敛财
items.def_en: to act as a pimp, or figuratively exploit and market someone or something dishonorably
items.ex_en: The dishonest agent tried to pimp out his client's personal tragedies for lucrative publicity.
items.ex_zh: 那个不择手段的经纪人试图靠消费自己客户的个人悲剧来牟取丰厚的名利。

items.def_en: (+ to) to gratify or indulge immoral, depraved, or vulgar tastes to win favour or profit
items.ex_en: The tabloid deliberately pandered to vulgar public curiosity by publishing unauthorized private photographs.
items.ex_zh: 该小报通过刊登未经授权的私人照片，蓄意迎合公众的低俗猎奇心理。

items.def_en: to exploit something primarily for economic gain at the expense of artistic or moral value
items.ex_en: Critics argued that the festival had commercialized sacred rituals purely for tourist revenue.
items.ex_zh: 批评人士认为，该节日纯粹为了旅游收入而将神圣的仪式商业化了。

items.def_en: to lower the real value, esteem, or dignified perception of someone or something
items.ex_en: Sensational advertisements often cheapen the prestige that the historic brand carefully cultivated.
items.ex_zh: 耸人听闻的广告往往会贬损该历史品牌悉心树立的声望。
items.ex2_en: Local currencies often cheapen rapidly when severe economic inflation strikes the nation.
items.ex2_zh: 当严重的通货膨胀袭击国家时，当地货币往往会迅速贬值。

groups.summary_en: Strongly pejorative frame describing the mercenary commodification of one's own or others' values, gifts, or reputation to satisfy low desires or earn dirty money.
groups.summary_zh: 强烈贬义，指为私利或满足恶俗而曲意迎合、廉价抛售品德才艺。
groups.desc_en: Denotes debasing one's personal values, art, or professional standards for mercenary gain or public applause, contrasting with legitimate professional commerce.
groups.desc_zh: 指为谋取金钱利益或迎合低俗受众而践踏底线、廉价出卖人格与艺术标准，区别于正常的商业营利。
groups.nuance_en: whore: sell out one's talent, body, or principles indiscriminately for base gain (talent / soul / oneself) · pander: gratify or cater to vulgar desires or lower public prejudices to gain favor (populism / audience / prejudice) · cheapen: degrade the intrinsic worth, dignity, or quality of something (brand / debate / reputation) · commercialize: strip of artistic or spiritual depth by making purely market-driven (holidays / sacred art / traditions) · pimp: exploit or market someone or something dishonorably for personal cut (services / talent / ideals)
groups.nuance_zh: whore: 不顾节操地出卖才华、灵魂或尊严以谋利 (talent / soul / oneself) · pander: 迎合低级趣味、偏见或民粹以讨好受众 (populism / audience / prejudice) · cheapen: 贬损内在格调、贬低事物价值与尊严 (brand / debate / reputation) · commercialize: 因市侩化运作而侵蚀其神圣性或纯粹性 (holidays / sacred art / traditions) · pimp: 卑劣地拉客贩卖、充当皮条客般剥削利用 (services / talent / ideals)

groups.name: Commit & Obligate · 承诺与承担 (Commit, Bind, Obligate)
groups.tip: 立誓表态承担责任

items.def_zh: 束缚，使受责任/承诺牵制
items.def_en: To restrict someone's freedom of action by imposing demanding commitments or obligations
items.ex_en: He didn't want to buy a house because he hated being tied down to one location.
items.ex_zh: 他不想买房，因为讨厌被束缚在同一个地方。

items.def_zh: 承诺，使承担义务；投入，调拨（资源）；犯（错误、罪行）
items.def_en: 1. To bind or obligate oneself to a specific course of action or relationship. 2. To dedicate time, money, or resources to something. 3. To do something illegal, wrong, or foolish.
items.ex_en: The administration refused to commit further federal funds to the unproven infrastructure scheme.
items.ex_zh: 政府拒绝向这项尚未得到验证的基础设施方案投入更多联邦资金。

items.def_zh: 使受诺言约束，承担保证
items.def_en: To bind oneself by formal promise, contract, or pledge to do something
items.ex_en: By signing the charter, each member nation engages to preserve international maritime boundaries.
items.ex_zh: 签署该宪章后，每个成员国均保证维护国际海洋边界。

items.def_zh: 约束，使承担法律或道德义务
items.def_en: To place someone under an inescapable legal, contractual, or moral obligation
items.ex_en: The non-disclosure agreement will strictly bind all researchers for the next five years.
items.ex_zh: 保密协议将在未来五年内对所有研究人员产生严格的法律约束。

items.def_zh: 使有义务，迫使承担责任
items.def_en: To constrain someone legally or morally to carry out a specific duty or action
items.ex_en: Statutory regulations obligate the company to disclose all financial transactions to regulatory auditors.
items.ex_zh: 法定规章迫使该企业必须向监管审计机构披露全部财务往来。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures formally or morally binding oneself or allocating resources to a designated course of action, policy, or duty.
groups.summary_zh: 主动承担义务或在政策、资源上使自身受约束。
groups.desc_en: Denotes tying oneself or an organization down to a future course of action through duty, contract, or pledged resources, contrasting with open-ended discretion.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过职责、契约或质押资源，使自身或组织承担不可擅退的未来义务，区别于保留自主退路的意向。
groups.nuance_en: commit: pledge resources, loyalty, or oneself irreversibly to a course (resources / troops / support) · bind: constrain legally or morally with strict, unbreakable obligations (parties / contract / oath) · obligate: compel someone to perform a specific duty by law or conscience (funds / debtor / recipient) · engage: enter into a formal contract, promise, or employment (services / contractor / enemy) · tie down: restrict freedom of action through accumulated burdens or commitments (capital / forces / assets)
groups.nuance_zh: commit: 倾注资源、誓守立场或明确表态投入 (resources / troops / support) · bind: 在法律或道德上形成硬性约束力 (parties / contract / oath) · obligate: 强制其必须履行特定的法定义务或金钱给付 (funds / debtor / recipient) · engage: 通过聘用或承诺使之承担相应事务 (services / contractor / enemy) · tie down: 被责任或资本占用绊住手脚以致丧失灵活性 (capital / forces / assets)

groups.name: Commit & Perpetrate · 作恶与犯罪 (Commit, Inflict, Pull off)
groups.tip: 实施违背法纪的严重罪行

items.def_en: To do something illegal, harmful, or morally wrong, such as a crime or an error
items.ex_en: The fugitive was eventually convicted after having committed several cross-border armed bank robberies.
items.ex_zh: 该逃犯在犯下数起跨国武装银行抢劫罪后，最终被定罪。

items.def_zh: 成功实施（骗局、抢劫等难办之事）
items.def_en: To succeed in carrying out a difficult or audacious enterprise, often a crime, scam, or trick
items.ex_en: No one believed they could win the championship, but they actually pulled it off.
items.ex_zh: 没有人相信他们能赢得总冠军，但他们竟然成功做到了。

items.def_en: To force someone to experience something very unpleasant, painful, or damaging
items.ex_en: The prolonged drought continues to inflict severe economic distress upon local farming families.
items.ex_zh: 持续的干旱继续给当地农户带来严重的经济困苦。

items.def_en: to commit a crime, violent act, or harmful deception
items.ex_en: A sophisticated criminal syndicate perpetrated the massive fraud against regional credit unions.
items.ex_zh: 一个老练的犯罪团伙针对地方信用合作社实施了这起特大诈骗案。

items.def_en: To cause great damage, destruction, or chaos, often as a direct result of violent actions
items.ex_en: The catastrophic cyclone wreaked unprecedented destruction along the densely populated coastal settlements.
items.ex_zh: 灾难性的气旋给人口稠密的沿海聚落造成了前所未有的毁灭性破坏。

groups.summary_en: Refers to carrying out illicit, destructive, fraudulent, or morally reprehensible actions. Differentiates formal legal infractions from heinous crimes and audacious hoaxes.
groups.summary_zh: 指实施违法、有害或极具破坏性的罪行与不道德恶行。
groups.desc_en: Denotes executing a harmful, wrongful, or criminal act that leaves severe negative consequences, contrasting with accidental damage or lawful coercion.
groups.desc_zh: 指付诸实施造成恶劣后果的有害行为、罪行或破坏，区别于意外过失或正当强制力。
groups.nuance_en: perpetrate: carry out an intentionally harmful, deceitful, or criminal act (fraud / atrocities / crime) · commit: perform an illegal, immoral, or grave deed (suicide / murder / sin) · inflict: force someone to suffer painful damage or distress (pain / casualties / damage) · wreak: unleash immense destruction or chaos upon something (havoc / vengeance / destruction) · pull off: successfully accomplish a daring, complex, or illicit scheme (heist / scam / coup)
groups.nuance_zh: perpetrate: 蓄谋实施惨绝人寰的罪行或欺诈行径 (fraud / atrocities / crime) · commit: 犯下法律或道义所不容的严重罪行 (suicide / murder / sin) · inflict: 把痛苦、创伤或打击强加于他人 (pain / casualties / damage) · wreak: 倾泻肆虐、造成巨大浩劫或破坏 (havoc / vengeance / destruction) · pull off: 侥幸或高超地得手一桩惊天大案 (heist / scam / coup)

groups.name: Commit Infidelity · 不忠与背叛 (Betray, Cheat, Two-time)
groups.tip: 伴侣不忠或亲密关系背叛

items.def_en: (+ on) To be sexually or romantically unfaithful to a partner or spouse
items.ex_en: She promptly filed for divorce upon learning that her husband had cheated on her.
items.ex_zh: 在得知丈夫背叛自己出轨后，她当即提出了离婚。

items.def_en: To deceive someone by carrying on a secret romantic relationship with another person simultaneously
items.ex_en: He discovered that his deceitful partner had been two-timing him for several months.
items.ex_zh: 他发现那个诡计多端的伴侣竟然脚踏两条船欺骗了他好几个月。

items.def_en: To break faith with a partner by being disloyal or sexually unfaithful
items.ex_en: He completely betrayed his wife's trust by conducting a secret affair with her colleague.
items.ex_zh: 他和妻子的同事暗通款曲，彻底辜负了妻子的信任。

items.def_en: To begin an unfaithful sexual or romantic liaison outside one's committed relationship
items.ex_en: Despite a stable marriage, he began to stray during his frequent overseas assignments.
items.ex_zh: 尽管婚姻稳定，他却在频繁出差海外期间开始移情别恋搞婚外情。

items.def_zh: 对（丈夫）不忠，使戴绿帽子
items.def_en: (dated or literary) To be sexually unfaithful to one's husband.
items.ex_en: Rumors spread that the unfaithful duchess had repeatedly cuckolded her absent, aristocratic husband.
items.ex_zh: 有传言称，那位不忠的公爵夫人屡次给远在异乡的贵族丈夫戴绿帽子。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote violating relational or marital fidelity through romantic or sexual betrayal and deceit.
groups.summary_zh: 指在恋爱或婚姻关系中违背忠诚、出轨背叛伴侣。
groups.desc_en: Denotes violating the exclusivity, trust, and fidelity foundational to a romantic or marital bond, contrasting with consensual parting or minor non-sexual grievances.
groups.desc_zh: 指违背恋爱或婚姻关系中的排他性承诺与信任基石，区别于协议分手或一般性夫妻矛盾。
groups.nuance_en: cheat: engage in surreptitious sexual or romantic infidelity (spouse / partner / boyfriend) · betray: violate trust, loyalty, or intimacy by breaking implicit or explicit faith (trust / spouse / confidence) · stray: wander morally or sexually away from a committed union through weakness (husband / path / affections) · two-time: deceive a lover by actively carrying on two simultaneous relationships (partner / fiancé / girlfriend) · cuckold: make a husband look foolish by having adultery committed by his wife (husband / rival / king)
groups.nuance_zh: cheat: 瞒天过海搞婚外情或情感出轨 (spouse / partner / boyfriend) · betray: 违背誓言与信任背叛至亲伴侣 (trust / spouse / confidence) · stray: 意志不坚定时在情感或肉体上偶尔走偏 (husband / path / affections) · two-time: 极其狡诈地脚踩两只船、同时欺瞒两方 (partner / fiancé / girlfriend) · cuckold: 与有夫之妇通奸使男方蒙羞戴绿帽 (husband / rival / king)

groups.name: Commune & Bond · 亲近与交融 (Bond, Connect, Harmonize)
groups.tip: 心灵深度契合建立深厚羁绊

items.def_en: To feel a close affinity, emotional sympathy, or mutual understanding with someone
items.ex_en: During their quiet conversation, she instantly connected with his profound sense of grief.
items.ex_zh: 在静谧的交谈中，她立刻对他的深切悲痛产生了情感共鸣。
items.ex2_en: The skilled therapist managed to connect the shy patient with support groups.
items.ex2_zh: 熟练的治疗师成功使这位害羞的患者与支持小组建立了联系。

items.def_en: To be in or bring into agreement, concordance, and peaceful accord with another
items.ex_en: The treaty aimed to harmonize conflicting domestic laws with overarching international maritime conventions.
items.ex_zh: 该条约旨在使相互冲突的国内法律与首要的国际海洋公约协调一致。
items.ex2_en: Their distinct melodic voices harmonize beautifully during the acoustic chorus performance.
items.ex2_zh: 在原声合唱表演中，他们各自鲜明的歌声和谐地交融在一起。

items.def_zh: 建立紧密关系；产生感情联结
items.def_en: To develop a close, warm relationship or emotional connection with someone
items.ex_en: Volunteers quickly bonded with the displaced animals while rebuilding the flooded rescue sanctuary.
items.ex_zh: 在重建被水淹没的救援庇护所时，志愿者们很快与流离失所的动物建立了感情。
items.ex2_en: Shared hardship will quickly bond the young soldiers during their grueling training.
items.ex2_zh: 共同经历的磨难会在艰苦的训练中迅速拉近年轻士兵们的心。

items.def_zh: （与……）心灵交融，亲密交流，心神契合
items.def_en: (literary) To feel in close spiritual or emotional harmony with someone or something, especially nature.
items.ex_en: The hermit spent solitary afternoons seeking to commune with nature in the mountains.
items.ex_zh: 隐士独自度过午后时光，渴望在深山幽谷中与大自然心神契合。

items.def_en: To understand and share the feelings and psychological perspective of another person
items.ex_en: Experienced counselors instinctively empathize with the intense emotional distress of traumatized patients.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的心理咨询师能自然地对创伤患者强烈的精神痛苦感同身受。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this interpersonal and reflective frame describe forging intimate emotional closeness, spiritual rapport, or mutual understanding with others or the natural world. They highlight shared energy, alignment of feelings, and deep relational ties.
groups.summary_zh: 指人与人或与自然之间建立深层的情感共鸣与心灵纽带。
groups.desc_en: Denotes forging deep, intuitive emotional resonance and spiritual union with another being or nature, contrasting with superficial socializing or transactional networking.
groups.desc_zh: 指与自然、生灵或他人建立起深层精神共鸣与情感交融，区别于肤浅的客套社交或功利结交。
groups.nuance_en: commune: experience deep, silent spiritual harmony with nature or the divine (nature / spirits / soul) · bond: form a durable, affectionate emotional tie through shared adversity or time (parent / teammates / friends) · connect: establish genuine emotional, intellectual, or interpersonal rapport (audience / peers / partner) · harmonize: blend together in peaceful, aesthetic, or cooperative agreement (values / views / interests) · empathize: project oneself intuitively into the emotional state of another (victims / patients / grief)
groups.nuance_zh: commune: 与大自然或神明心灵相通、达成忘我交融 (nature / spirits / soul) · bond: 历经淬炼或亲密相处而结下深厚情感纽带 (parent / teammates / friends) · connect: 达成心灵契合或思想同频 (audience / peers / partner) · harmonize: 调和异同、形成协奏与融洽共处 (values / views / interests) · empathize: 设身处地感同身受、体察对方情绪 (victims / patients / grief)

groups.name: Compensate & Indemnify · 赔偿与补偿 (Reimburse, Compensate, Recoup)
groups.tip: 弥补损失或承担赔偿责任

items.def_en: Pay or reward someone for effort, damage, or trouble suffered
items.ex_en: The tribunal ordered the state to recompense landowners for their expropriated agricultural holdings.
items.ex_zh: 法庭责令该国政府就征用的农业地产向土地所有者支付赔偿。

items.def_en: (+ for) Give someone money or equivalent recognition in balance for loss, injury, or suffering
items.ex_en: The airline agreed to compensate passengers generously for the inconvenience of overnight delays.
items.ex_zh: 航空公司同意对通宵延误造成的诸多不便向乘客进行充分赔偿。

items.def_en: Repay someone money they have already spent on legitimate organizational expenses
items.ex_en: The corporate finance department will promptly reimburse employees for official travel meal expenses.
items.ex_zh: 企业财务部门将及时为员工报销公务出差的餐饮费用。

items.def_en: Regain an amount of money spent, lost, or advanced through later returns
items.ex_en: The studio hopes to recoup its massive production budget from international streaming rights.
items.ex_zh: 该制片厂希望通过国际流媒体版权收回庞大的制作成本。

items.def_zh: 赔偿，补偿；保障……免受损失（或法律责任）
items.def_en: (+ against/for) To compensate someone for damage or loss incurred, or to protect them against legal responsibility.
items.ex_en: The insurance contract indemnifies the manufacturer against potential product liability claims worldwide.
items.ex_zh: 该保险合同保障制造商免受全球范围内潜在产品责任索赔的损失。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on monetary or material restitution legally paid to make good an injury, financial deficit, or collateral damage.
groups.summary_zh: 指依法或按约支付款项，以填补财务亏损、伤害或法律责任。
groups.desc_en: Denotes making amends through monetary, legal, or material equivalents to redress a loss, suffering, or liability, contrasting with gratuitous reward or moral praise.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过金钱、物质或等额价值来填补亏欠、损失或法律责任，区别于无偿犒劳或口头褒奖。
groups.nuance_en: compensate: provide an equivalent recompense for loss, injury, or service rendered (victims / workers / damages) · indemnify: protect against or legally reimburse for specified financial liabilities or loss (losses / policyholder / directors) · reimburse: pay back money that someone has already spent on official or authorized business (expenses / costs / fees) · recompense: reward or compensate someone for exertion, sacrifice, or suffered harm (efforts / loss / services) · recoup: recover an outlay, loss, or expenditure through later gains (investment / losses / costs)
groups.nuance_zh: compensate: 给予等值补偿以弥补伤害、付出或损失 (victims / workers / damages) · indemnify: 通过保险或协议免受赔偿责任或据实全额赔付 (losses / policyholder / directors) · reimburse: 凭发票单据实报实销垫付的公帑或费用 (expenses / costs / fees) · recompense: 对付出的艰辛、折损或功勋予以酬报 (efforts / loss / services) · recoup: 经由后续收益收回前期垫资或挽回亏损 (investment / losses / costs)

groups.name: Compensate & Reimburse · 补偿与报销 (Recompense, Indemnify, Make up for)
groups.tip: 弥补损失或报销花费

items.def_en: to do or provide something that reduces or cancels out the bad effect of something
items.ex_en: He worked overtime all weekend to make up for the lost hours.
items.ex_zh: 他整个周末都在加班，以弥补损失的工时。

items.def_en: to give something to someone as an expression of gratitude or to cover loss or effort
items.ex_en: The foundation decided to recompense the dedicated volunteer with a formal commemorative award.
items.ex_zh: 基金会决定向这位奉献良多的志愿者颁发正式纪念奖项以示酬谢。

items.def_en: 1. (+ for) to provide something good to balance or reduce the bad effect of damage or loss. 2. to pay someone money in exchange for work or to make up for loss
items.ex_en: Higher annual bonuses cannot entirely compensate for the chronic stress of excessive hours.
items.ex_zh: 再丰厚的年终奖金也无法完全弥补长期超时工作带来的身心消耗。

items.def_en: to pay back money to someone that they have already spent for an official purpose
items.ex_en: The university will reimburse visiting scholars for their round-trip international flight tickets.
items.ex_zh: 大学将为来访学者全额报销国际往返机票费用。

items.def_en: to promise to protect someone against financial loss or to pay money for damage sustained
items.ex_en: Under the agreement, the contractor must indemnify the developer against third-party property damage.
items.ex_zh: 根据协议，承包商必须赔偿开发商免受第三方财产损失的损害。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe giving money, goods, or services to someone to balance out loss, injury, or out-of-pocket expenses. They range from informal amends to formal legal and corporate restitutions.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过支付金钱或提供对等物以抵消损失、伤害或垫付支出的补偿行为。
groups.desc_en: Denotes restoring balance to an individual who suffered loss, outlay, or systemic deficit by repaying the exact cost or restoring utility, contrasting with punitive damages.
groups.desc_zh: 指针对受损方或垫资方填平其发生的账面开支或功能缺失，恢复原状，区别于惩罚性赔款。
groups.nuance_en: reimburse: refund direct, out-of-pocket expenses incurred on authorized business (travel expenses / tuition / medical bills) · compensate: provide financial or symbolic counterbalance to counter a deficit or trauma (workers / shareholders / pain) · make up for: offset a deficiency, mistake, or lost time through extra effort or value (lost ground / delays / deficit) · indemnifying: legally secure someone against past or future financial losses (liabilities / damages / claims) · recompense: confer an honorable or equitable reward for past contributions or sacrifices (loyalty / service / hardship)
groups.nuance_zh: reimburse: 依凭据全额报销自垫款项 (travel expenses / tuition / medical bills) · compensate: 针对损失或缺陷施以对等补偿平衡 (workers / shareholders / pain) · make up for: 以加倍努力或替代物弥补延误、过失或短板 (lost ground / delays / deficit) · indemnify: 依契约承保或免除其直接财务索赔责任 (liabilities / damages / claims) · recompense: 为历史贡献或道义牺牲奉上合宜酬答 (loyalty / service / hardship)

groups.name: Compile & Correlate · 校勘与汇编 (Collate, Compile, Cross-check)
groups.tip: 对照整理核对文献资料

items.def_en: To verify the accuracy of information by comparing it with multiple other sources
items.ex_en: Investigators carefully cross-checked the suspect's testimony against the bank's digital transaction records.
items.ex_zh: 调查人员仔细将嫌疑人的口供与银行的数字交易记录进行了交叉核对。

items.def_zh: 拼凑整理出（真相或全貌）
items.def_en: To assemble facts, evidence, or fragments to reconstruct a coherent picture of what happened
items.ex_en: Detectives gradually pieced together the missing sequence of events from fragmented security footage.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们从残缺的监控录像中逐步拼凑出案件缺失的事发经过。

items.def_en: To assemble information, data, or texts collected from many different sources into a coherent list or book
items.ex_en: Archivists worked tirelessly to compile thousands of historical letters into a searchable database.
items.ex_zh: 档案管理人员不知疲倦地工作，将数千封历史信件整理汇编成可检索的数据库。

items.def_en: To compare two sets of figures or accounts to ensure that they agree and show no discrepancy
items.ex_en: Accountants must reconcile the quarterly balance sheet with the internal corporate transaction ledger.
items.ex_zh: 会计人员必须核对季度资产负债表，使其与企业内部交易总账保持一致。

items.def_zh: 核对，对照；整理，装订（页码）
items.def_en: 1. To collect, compare, and arrange pages, data, or texts in the correct logical order.
items.ex_en: Scholars gathered to collate the surviving manuscript variants before publishing the critical edition.
items.ex_zh: 学者们齐聚一堂校勘现存的各种手稿异文，以便出版校勘本。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this informational and editorial frame deal with bringing together disparate records, sheets, or data points to verify their sequence, reconcile differences, and synthesize a coherent whole.
groups.summary_zh: 指汇集散乱文件或数据，核对次序与差异并整理成条理化的成果。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on gathering, comparing, and harmonizing disparate pieces of information to establish truth or coherence, unlike mere collecting or sorting.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重于对零散信息与文本进行收集、比照校勘与调和求真，不同于机械的收集或简单归类。
groups.nuance_en: compile: gather and organize systematically into a single work (anthology / dossier / statistics) · collate: meticulously compare texts or order sequential leaves (manuscripts / findings / pages) · cross-check: verify accuracy against independent sources (facts / records / references) · reconcile: resolve discrepancies between conflicting datasets (accounts / statements / discrepancies) · piece together: reconstruct a complete picture from fragmented clues (narrative / timeline / evidence)
groups.nuance_zh: compile: 系统性搜集并整编成册 (anthology / dossier / statistics) · collate: 细致对勘文本异同或按序核排纸页 (manuscripts / findings / pages) · cross-check: 利用独立多源信息互相交叉核实 (facts / records / references) · reconcile: 调和并消除账目或数据间的分歧 (accounts / statements / discrepancies) · piece together: 从零散碎线索中拼凑还原全貌 (narrative / timeline / evidence)

groups.name: Complement & Enhance · 补充与相配 (Supplement, Round out, Offset)
groups.tip: 相得益彰地弥补不足

items.def_en: to add something extra to something in order to improve it or make it more complete
items.ex_en: Athletes often supplement their daily training regimens with specialized protein and mineral supplements.
items.ex_zh: 运动员常在日常训练方案之外额外补充特制的蛋白质与矿物质营养品。

items.def_en: to add final details, variety, or elements to make something balanced and thoroughly complete
items.ex_en: She took extra courses in finance to round out her business degree.
items.ex_zh: 她选修了额外的金融课程，使自己的商科学位更加完备。

items.def_en: to make something look attractive or distinctive by standing in contrast to it
items.ex_en: The elegant dark velvet background served to set off the diamond necklace brilliantly.
items.ex_zh: 优雅的深色天鹅绒背景将这条钻石项链衬托得格外璀璨耀眼。

items.def_en: to combine smoothly with another element to form a unified working whole
items.ex_en: The new software module must integrate seamlessly with existing legacy operational management systems.
items.ex_zh: 该新型软件模块必须与现有的传统运营管理系统实现无缝整合。

items.def_en: to add to something in a way that enhances, improves, or completes it
items.ex_en: The crisp acidity of the white wine complements the rich, buttery poached salmon.
items.ex_zh: 这款白葡萄酒清爽的酸度与浓郁肥美的黄油水煮三文鱼相得益彰。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers verbs where one element fits with, adds to, or balances another so that the combination becomes harmonious, complete, or improved.
groups.summary_zh: 指两者相互补充、协调搭配或增补不足，使整体更趋完备或更具美感。
groups.desc_en: Denotes supplying what is lacking or harmoniously enhancing an existing whole, contrasting with simple addition which merely increases quantity.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过增补欠缺之处或相互衬托以达到和谐完满，不同于仅增加数量的单纯相加。
groups.nuance_en: complement: supply a mutual counterweight or perfect match (skills / wine / style) · supplement: add an extra element to make up for a shortfall (income / diet / vitamins) · round out: add finishing touches to achieve balance or completeness (collection / education / team) · set off: enhance beauty or quality through sharp contrast (features / complexion / jewel) · integrate with: merge smoothly into a unified operational system (curriculum / workflow / system)
groups.nuance_zh: complement: 优势互补或形成天作之合 (skills / wine / style) · supplement: 额外增补以填补不足或赤字 (income / diet / vitamins) · round out: 补齐收尾以使整体圆满充实 (collection / education / team) · set off: 借由鲜明对比烘托映衬特质 (features / complexion / jewel) · integrate with: 无缝融入并成为有机整体 (curriculum / workflow / system)

groups.name: Complete Destructive Burning · 焚化与化为灰烬 (Incinerate, Cremate, Reduce to Ashes)
groups.tip: 烈火延烧，最终化为灰烬

items.def_en: Be completely destroyed or consume something completely by fire or atmospheric heat.
items.ex_en: The discarded satellite will eventually burn up upon re-entering the Earth's dense atmosphere.
items.ex_zh: 这颗废弃的卫星在重新进入地球稠密大气层时最终将焚毁殆尽。

items.def_en: Completely destroy or engulf something by fire.
items.ex_en: Fierce wildfires rapidly consumed acres of dry woodland during the unseasonably hot weekend.
items.ex_zh: 在异常炎热的周末，肆虐的山火迅速吞噬了数英亩干枯的林地。

items.def_en: Destroy a structure or object entirely by fire so that only ash remains.
items.ex_en: The historic wooden cathedral was completely reduced to ashes by an overnight electrical fire.
items.ex_zh: 这座历史悠久的木制大教堂在一场夜间电火中彻底化为了灰烬。

items.def_en: Dispose of a dead body by burning it to ashes, typically after a funeral ceremony.
items.ex_en: The family decided to cremate the deceased according to his explicit final wishes.
items.ex_zh: 遵照死者生前明确的遗愿，家属决定将其遗体火化处理。

items.def_en: 1. To burn waste or a corpse completely until it is reduced to ashes in an incinerator.
items.ex_en: The medical facility uses high-temperature ovens to incinerate contaminated biohazard waste safely.
items.ex_zh: 该医疗机构利用高温焚化炉对受到污染的生物危害性废物进行安全焚毁。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate the complete, high-temperature destruction of matter or bodies, turning them entirely to ash. They typically involve official, ritualistic, or catastrophic annihilation.
groups.summary_zh: 表示通过高温彻底焚毁废弃物或尸首，使其化为灰烬的高强度破坏动作。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the total, catastrophic reduction of physical matter to ashes through extreme heat, moving beyond simple burning or charring.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过极高热量将物质彻底、毁灭性地化为灰烬，不同于表层灼烧或普通着火。
groups.nuance_en: incinerate: burn up completely into ash, often via high-tech industrial or destructive means (waste / documents / remains) · cremate: ceremonially burn a deceased corpse to ashes (body / remains / corpse) · reduce to ashes: obliterate entirely into cinders and ruins (city / forest / building) · consume: devour and assimilate entirely by raging fire (flames / warehouse / structure) · burn up: destroy thoroughly by combustion or atmospheric friction (fuel / spacecraft / trash)
groups.nuance_zh: incinerate: 高温焚化使化为灰烬，多见工业或彻底销毁 (waste / documents / remains) · cremate: 礼仪性火化遗体 (body / remains / corpse) · reduce to ashes: 彻底化为灰烬废墟 (city / forest / building) · consume: 烈火完全吞噬覆灭 (flames / warehouse / structure) · burn up: 彻底燃尽或坠入大气层烧毁 (fuel / spacecraft / trash)

groups.name: Comport & Demean Oneself · 庄重自持与合轨 (Comport, Acquit, Demean)
groups.tip: 言行举止与特定身份相符

items.def_en: To agree, harmonize, or correspond precisely with a rule, code, or standard
items.ex_en: His reckless personal behavior does not square with the code of professional conduct.
items.ex_zh: 他鲁莽的个人行为与行业专业守则的要求完全不相符合。

items.def_en: (also 'comport oneself') (formal) To conduct or behave oneself in a specified manner.
items.ex_en: The ambassador comports herself with great dignity even during intense diplomatic disputes.
items.ex_zh: 即使在激烈的外交争端期间，这位大使依然举止庄重大方。

items.def_zh: 举止自持，端正仪态（反身）
items.def_en: (deport oneself) To behave or carry oneself in a formal, dignified manner
items.ex_en: The monarch instructed the young prince to deport himself with humility and restraint.
items.ex_zh: 君主教导年轻的王子要处处端正仪态，表现出谦卑与克制。

items.def_en: (demean oneself) (formal) To conduct or carry oneself with a particular demeanour
items.ex_en: Throughout the hostile public inquiry, the minister demeaned himself with remarkable poise.
items.ex_zh: 在充满敌意的公开质询过程中，这位部长始终持身端肃、从容镇定。

items.def_en: (acquit oneself) To perform or conduct oneself in a specified way, especially successfully under pressure
items.ex_en: The rookie defense attorney acquitted herself exceptionally well during her first jury trial.
items.ex_zh: 这位新手辩护律师在她的首场陪审团审判中表现得极为出色。

groups.summary_en: A formal frame dealing with deliberate bodily and moral self-presentation in high-stakes or dignified contexts, often matching personal dignity with social status.
groups.summary_zh: 指严肃庄重场合下的立身处世、举止言行及规矩自律。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on governing one's posture, dignity, and personal conduct in accordance with societal or ethical expectations, distinct from mere behavioral reflex.
groups.desc_zh: 指在举止、威仪及言行上自持自制并符合外在礼度或伦理标准，区别于本能性的行为反应。
groups.nuance_en: comport: conduct oneself with dignity and propriety, often reflexively (oneself / dignity) · acquit: perform or discharge duty notably well under scrutiny (oneself in trial / duty) · deport: bear oneself formally in physical posture and aristocratic demeanor (oneself with grace / posture) · demean: degrade one's standing, moral character, or dignity (oneself / office / profession) · square with: align strictly with external rules or conscience (facts / conscience / principles)
groups.nuance_zh: comport: 自我举止庄重得体 (oneself / dignity) · acquit: 在审查或困境中表现出色、克尽职守 (oneself in trial / duty) · deport: 仪态举止端庄合乎规范 (oneself with grace / posture) · demean: 降格自贬身段或屈辱门面 (oneself / office / profession) · square with: 与规则、良知或事实高度契合 (facts / conscience / principles)

groups.name: Compose Verse & Rhyme · 押韵与作诗 (Rhyme, Verse, Scan)
groups.tip: 构思谱写诗词韵律与篇章

items.def_en: To conform to a regular rhythm or metrical pattern in verse
items.ex_en: The professor pointed out that the second poetic line failed to scan correctly.
items.ex_zh: 教授指出诗中的第二行诗句未能按既定的格律规律押合。

items.def_en: To correspond in sound through identical or similar vowel phonemes
items.ex_en: The vowels in the closing couplet assonate subtly, creating a haunting auditory effect.
items.ex_zh: 结尾对句中的元音形成了精妙的准押韵，营造出萦绕心头的听觉效果。

items.def_en: To turn a story or prose into poetry, or compose verses
items.ex_en: The medieval chronicler decided to versify the heroic legend for royal court entertainment.
items.ex_zh: 这位中世纪编年史家决定将这段英雄传奇改写成诗歌，供宫廷消遣。

items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To have or end with the same sound as another word; make words rhyme. 2. To compose rhyming poetry.
items.ex_en: Children naturally enjoy simple nursery verses that rhyme easily and repeat rhythmic patterns.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们天然喜欢那些押韵简单明快、节奏反复循环的简易童谣。
items.ex2_en: The clever poet rhymes complex syllables to create a lively musical rhythm.
items.ex2_zh: 聪明的诗人押上复杂的音节以创造出生动明快的音乐节奏。

items.def_en: To repeat the same consonant sound at the start of adjacent words
items.ex_en: Old English bards relied on lines that alliterate heavily rather than end-rhyming verses.
items.ex_zh: 古英语吟游诗人主要依赖大量使用头韵的诗行，而非尾韵形式。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on poetic composition, phonological correspondence, and metric arrangement in linguistic art. Spans end-rhyme pairing, versification, and metrical structuring of poetic lines.
groups.summary_zh: 指诗歌创制、韵脚匹配及音步格律构建的文学语言行为。
groups.desc_en: Describes the deliberate crafting of language according to metric, rhythmic, or phonetic conventions, distinct from prose composition.
groups.desc_zh: 指依据韵律、音步或特定语音结构进行诗律创作，区别于散文式的自由写作。
groups.nuance_en: rhyme: match terminal sounds of lines or words (couplets / lines / words) · versify: turn prose or thought into metrical verse form (prose / chronicle / narrative) · scan: conform to or analyze for strict metrical rhythm (meter / verse / line) · alliterate: repeat initial consonant sounds across adjacent words (phrases / headlines / poetry) · assonate: echo internal vowel sounds without consonant matching (vowels / syllables / lyrics)
groups.nuance_zh: rhyme: 押韵，使句尾或词尾发音相合 (couplets / lines / words) · versify: 赋诗，将散文或思想改写为格律诗 (prose / chronicle / narrative) · scan: 依格律审音或诗句符合音步 (meter / verse / line) · alliterate: 头韵，连续使用相同声母辅音 (phrases / headlines / poetry) · assonate: 准押韵，使元音发音相应和 (vowels / syllables / lyrics)

groups.name: Compress & Abridge · 压缩与浓缩 (Compress, Compact, Digest)
groups.tip: 挤压体积或凝炼内容

items.def_en: (+ to) To reduce or summarize complex information to its essential core points
items.ex_en: The strategic analyst managed to boil down the thick report to three points.
items.ex_zh: 战略分析师成功地将那份厚重的报告浓缩归纳为三大要点。
items.ex2_en: The entire legal argument boils down to one simple question of ownership.
items.ex2_zh: 整个法律争论归根结底就是一个简单的所有权问题。

items.def_en: To shorten a book, speech, or text by omitting less central parts while retaining the core meaning
items.ex_en: The publishing house will abridge the classic philosophical text for introductory undergraduate seminars.
items.ex_zh: 出版公司将为本科生入门研讨班节略出版这部经典哲学著作。

items.def_en: To pack or press small loose particles tightly together to form a solid mass
items.ex_en: Heavy construction rollers compact the road foundation layers before applying the smooth asphalt.
items.ex_zh: 在铺设平整沥青之前，重型筑路压路机会紧紧压实路基土层。
items.ex2_en: Fine snow crystals compact rapidly under the heavy weight of winter boots.
items.ex2_zh: 在沉重冬靴的重压之下，细腻的雪晶迅速被压实成块。

items.def_en: To press or squeeze something so that it takes up less space or occupies a smaller volume
items.ex_en: Powerful industrial machines compress dry municipal waste into uniform, high-density fuel blocks.
items.ex_zh: 强力的工业机械将干燥的城市垃圾压缩成规格统一的高密度燃料块。
items.ex2_en: Soft down feathers compress easily into a remarkably compact camping travel bag.
items.ex2_zh: 柔软的羽绒很容易被压缩装入一个极其紧凑的露营旅行包中。

items.def_zh: 压缩，精简；（使）冷凝，（使）凝结；浓缩
items.def_en: 1. (+ into) To make a text, speech, or book shorter by removing less important details. 2. To change or cause a gas or vapor to change into a liquid.
items.ex_en: The editor asked him to condense his sprawling political manifesto into two pages.
items.ex_zh: 编辑要求他将那篇冗长繁复的政治宣言精简浓缩至两页以内。
items.ex2_en: Hot water vapor will condense quickly on the cold bathroom mirror surface.
items.ex2_zh: 热的水蒸气会迅速凝结在冰冷的浴室镜子表面上。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses reducing the physical bulk or textual length of something into a denser, more economical form. Verbs contrast physical squeezing of matter with editorial pruning and summarizing of informational content.
groups.summary_zh: 通过物理受压或文字删减来缩减体积或篇幅以提升致密度。
groups.desc_en: Refers to packing or reducing the bulk of text or material while preserving essential substance, differing from simple cutting or shortening.
groups.desc_zh: 指在紧缩物质体积或删节文本篇幅的同时保留核心精髓，不同于盲目的删减或截短。
groups.nuance_en: compress: apply physical or digital pressure to diminish volume (gas / files / spine) · condense: concentrate substance by removing extraneous moisture or words (steam / text / report) · abridge: shorten a written work while keeping the narrative or legal essence (novel / classic / dictionary) · compact: press solid particles firmly together into a dense mass (soil / snow / powder) · boil down: reduce complex issues to their bare, irreducible core (arguments / essence / facts)
groups.nuance_zh: compress: 施压紧缩体积或压缩数字文件 (gas / files / spine) · condense: 除去水分或枝节文字以浓缩精华 (steam / text / report) · abridge: 节录删编文本但保留主干脉络 (novel / classic / dictionary) · compact: 强力压实固形物至致密状态 (soil / snow / powder) · boil down: 提炼归结出最核心本质 (arguments / essence / facts)

groups.name: Concede & Yield · 承认与让步 (Concede, Grant, Yield)
groups.tip: 勉强认同或退让妥协

items.def_zh: 承认（某论点的合理性），同意
items.def_en: To accept or admit the truth of a point or fact in an argument, often preceding a counterargument
items.ex_en: I grant that the proposal sounds promising, but funding remains extremely scarce.
items.ex_zh: 我承认该提议听起来很有前景，但目前的资金依然极其匮乏。

items.def_en: To give way to an argument, demand, or pressure by relinquishing a previously held stance
items.ex_en: Under intense cross-examination, the witness finally yielded and retracted his former assertion.
items.ex_zh: 在严苛的交叉盘问之下，证人最终妥协让步并撤回了先前的断言。

items.def_en: (+ to) To cease resisting and finally accept someone's terms, demands, or assertions
items.ex_en: The stubborn council refused to give in to the protestors' escalating political demands.
items.ex_zh: 顽固的市议会拒绝向抗议者日益升级的政治诉求低头妥协。

items.def_en: (+ from) To withdraw a claim, threat, or demand in the face of opposition or superior reasoning
items.ex_en: The foreign minister backed down from his aggressive trade ultimatum following quiet negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 在经过私下磋商之后，外交部长放弃了原先咄咄逼人的贸易最后通牒。

items.def_zh: （勉强）承认；让步，认输；让与，割让
items.def_en: 1. To admit that something is true, valid, or proper, often unwillingly. 2. To acknowledge defeat in a contest or election. 3. To give up or surrender a right, point, or territory.
items.ex_en: The incumbent senator conceded that his opponent had run an remarkably disciplined campaign.
items.ex_zh: 现任参议员不得不勉强承认，他的竞选对手打了一场极具纪律性的选战。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on reluctantly accepting the validity of an opponent's argument or admitting an unfavorable outcome, especially in debates, negotiations, or elections.
groups.summary_zh: 在辩论、谈判或竞选中不情愿地认可对方观点或承认败局。
groups.desc_en: Describes relinquishing a dispute, claim, or territory under pressure or compelling truth, contrasted with proactive, unforced giving.
groups.desc_zh: 指在压力、证据或权衡下放弃争辩、主张或阵地，区别于主动的给予或赠送。
groups.nuance_en: concede: grudgingly acknowledge defeat, truth, or a disputed point (defeat / point / election) · grant: formally allow or acknowledge as true for argument's sake (premise / request / visa) · yield: surrender control, resistance, or physical space under pressure (ground / territory / right of way) · give in: collapse under continuous pressure or demand (temptation / pressure / demands) · back down: retreat from a contentious claim or confrontation (threat / challenge / standoff)
groups.nuance_zh: concede: 勉强认输、承认事实或让出争议点 (defeat / point / election) · grant: 正式准予或在辩论中姑且承认前提出真 (premise / request / visa) · yield: 承受重压而屈服让步或让出空间 (ground / territory / right of way) · give in: 抵挡不住长期施压而退缩依从 (temptation / pressure / demands) · back down: 在正面冲突或言论对峙中认怂撤退 (threat / challenge / standoff)

groups.name: Conceive & Gestate · 孕育与怀胎 (Conceive, Carry, Nurture)
groups.tip: 胎儿在母体子宫中孕育生长

items.def_en: To be pregnant with an unborn baby or young inside the womb
items.ex_en: The expectant mother was delighted to discover she was carrying healthy twin girls.
items.ex_zh: 准妈妈惊喜地发现自己肚子里正怀着一对健康的双胞胎女婴。

items.def_en: To become pregnant with a child, or form an idea or plan in the mind
items.ex_en: The committee met to conceive a viable strategy for regional economic revival.
items.ex_zh: 委员会齐聚一堂，构想出一套切实可行的区域经济振兴战略。

items.def_en: To care for and encourage the growth or development of someone or something
items.ex_en: She sought to nurture young musical talent through prestigious international fellowships.
items.ex_zh: 她试图通过声誉卓著的国际奖学金项目来悉心培育年轻的音乐人才。

items.def_en: To develop slowly under favorable conditions, as eggs or nascent schemes
items.ex_en: The university laboratory serves to incubate promising biotechnology ventures before commercial launch.
items.ex_zh: 该大学实验室旨在商业化推出前孵化极具前景的生物技术创业项目。
items.ex2_en: Wild bird eggs incubate quietly in warm grass nests during early spring.
items.ex2_zh: 早春时节，野鸟蛋在温暖的草巢中静静地孵化着。

items.def_zh: 孕育，怀孕；（在心中）酝酿，孕育（想法、计划等）
items.def_en: 1. To carry a developing fetus in the womb during pregnancy. 2. (figurative) To develop an idea, plan, or system slowly in the mind.
items.ex_en: The philosopher allowed the complex thesis to gestate over several quiet years.
items.ex_zh: 这位哲学家用数年清幽的岁月在心中酝酿这一复杂的论题。
items.ex2_en: The mother bear gestates her unborn cubs throughout the long winter denning.
items.ex2_zh: 母熊在漫长的冬眠期间孕育着腹中尚未出生的幼崽。

groups.summary_en: Encompasses both the physiological process of becoming pregnant and bearing an embryo, and the figurative incubation of thoughts, creative projects, or plans over time.
groups.summary_zh: 指生理上的受孕怀胎，或隐喻新思想、计划在脑海中酝酿成形。
groups.desc_en: Captures the internal generation, internal carrying, and maturation of an embryo or an embryonic idea, distinct from subsequent external rearing.
groups.desc_zh: 指在母体或思维内部构想、孕育并使其逐渐发育成熟，区别于诞生后的外部抚育。
groups.nuance_en: conceive: originate an idea mentally or form an embryo biologically (plan / child / notion) · gestate: carry an embryo in the womb or allow a concept to mature over time (fetus / idea / project) · carry: physically hold a growing fetus within the womb until birth (baby / twins / child) · incubate: maintain under controlled warmth/conditions for gradual hatching or growth (eggs / culture / virus) · nurture: feed and foster early development to ensure survival (talent / seedling / relationship)
groups.nuance_zh: conceive: 形成思想雏形或生理受孕 (plan / child / notion) · gestate: 怀胎胎儿或任概念在脑中酝酿发酵 (fetus / idea / project) · carry: 腹中怀有胎儿至分娩 (baby / twins / child) · incubate: 恒温孵卵或在适宜条件下静默培育 (eggs / culture / virus) · nurture: 精心哺育呵护以促早期成长 (talent / seedling / relationship)

groups.name: Conciliate & Placate Disaffected Parties · 抚慰安抚与绥靖退让 (Conciliate, Placate, Appease, Mollify)
groups.tip: 抚慰情绪以促成各方和解

items.def_en: To prevent conflict by granting the urgent demands or concessions insisted upon by an aggressive opponent.
items.ex_en: The prime minister made territorial concessions to appease the hostile neighboring regime.
items.ex_zh: 首相做出了领土妥协，以姑息绥靖敌对的邻国政权。

items.def_en: To make someone less angry, hostile, or aggrieved by performing a kind act or conceding a point.
items.ex_en: Management offered vouchers to placate customers furious over the severe flight cancellations.
items.ex_zh: 管理层提供了代金券，以安抚因航班严重取消而愤怒的旅客。

items.def_en: To soften the temper or reduce the severity of someone's anger or anxiety.
items.ex_en: The manager attempted to mollify the aggrieved client with an immediate personal apology.
items.ex_zh: 经理试图立即亲自道歉，以平息这位受委屈客户的情绪。

items.def_en: To end disagreement or make someone less angry by being pleasant or by making concessions.
items.ex_en: The diplomat worked tirelessly to conciliate the estranged factions before violence erupted.
items.ex_zh: 在暴力冲突爆发前，外交官不知疲倦地斡旋以调和疏离的各派系。

items.def_en: To win or regain the favor of an aggrieved person, authority, or deity by showing submission or offering amends.
items.ex_en: Ancient priests made solemn sacrifices to propitiate the wrath of the sea gods.
items.ex_zh: 古代祭司举行庄严的祭礼，以求得海神宽恕其怒火。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on mitigating hostility, outrage, or indignation through psychological soothing, gracious concessions, or strategic appeasement, shifting the opposing party from angry defiance to calm cooperation.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过示好、倾听让步或抚平敌意，缓和对方怒火与对立情绪。
groups.desc_en: Involves mitigating fury, resentment, or hostility of aggrieved parties through soothing words, concessions, or rituals, unlike standard persuasion.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过抚慰言辞、实质让步或祭祀礼仪平息怨怼者的愤怒，不同于一般的说理劝导。
groups.nuance_en: appease: buy temporary peace by yielding to aggressive demands (aggressor / dictator / faction) · placate: calm someone's indignant anger with soothing concessions (critics / voters / customer) · mollify: soften intense anger or wounded feelings by soothing gestures (hurt feelings / crowd / concerns) · conciliate: win over distrustful or alienated factions through dialogue (opponents / strikers / alienated allies) · propitiate: avert supernatural wrath or appease a deity through ritual/offering (gods / spirits / ancestors)
groups.nuance_zh: appease: 绥靖退让，向侵略性要求妥协以苟安 (aggressor / dictator / faction) · placate: 安抚平息当事人的激愤抗议 (critics / voters / customer) · mollify: 软化强烈的怒气或受损情绪 (hurt feelings / crowd / concerns) · conciliate: 通过调解拉拢消除疏离与敌对 (opponents / strikers / alienated allies) · propitiate: 献祭或赎罪以祈求神灵鬼怪息怒 (gods / spirits / ancestors)

groups.name: Conclude & Cut Off Debate · 终止议程与辩论 (Adjourn, Table, Prorogue)
groups.tip: 正式终止对话或让行动告终

items.def_zh: 搁置（美）/ 提请审议（英）
items.def_en: (US) To postpone indefinitely consideration of a legislative motion or proposal
items.ex_en: The Senate voted overwhelmingly to table the contentious tax bill until next spring.
items.ex_zh: 参议院以压倒性多数投票决定将这份有争议的税收法案搁置至明年春天。

items.def_en: 1. (politics / parliamentary) To end a debate formally by calling for an immediate vote.
items.ex_en: The parliamentary speaker moved to closure the filibuster and force a final vote.
items.ex_zh: 议长动议正式终止阻挠议事并强制进行最终表决。

items.def_en: To pause or end a meeting or legal proceeding until a later scheduled time
items.ex_en: The judge chose to adjourn the court proceedings until the following Monday morning.
items.ex_zh: 法官决定将法庭审理程序休会，延期至下周一上午继续。
items.ex2_en: The parliamentary debate will adjourn until tomorrow morning for lack of quorum.
items.ex2_zh: 因出席人数不足，议会辩论将休会推迟至明日上午。

items.def_en: (British parliamentary) To fix a strict time limit on debate for a bill, forcing an immediate vote
items.ex_en: Ministers chose to guillotine the contentious healthcare debate after merely three hours.
items.ex_zh: 部长们决定在仅讨论三小时后就强行中止对这项争议医保法案的辩论。

items.def_en: (formal) To discontinue a parliamentary session by royal or executive prerogative without dissolution
items.ex_en: The monarch acted on prime ministerial advice to prorogue Parliament until autumn.
items.ex_zh: 君主遵从首相的建议，宣布议会休会直至秋季。
items.ex2_en: The national parliament will prorogue next week following the final legislative vote.
items.ex2_zh: 在最终立法表决之后，国家议会将于下周正式休会。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses formal procedural actions used in deliberative assemblies, committees, or formal debates to curtail discussion, postpone motions, or dissolve sessions. They are characterized by strict parliamentary authority.
groups.summary_zh: 指在议会或正式会议中行使程序性权力中止辩论或休会。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on halting, cutting short, or formalizing the suspension of parliamentary or formal procedural debate, differing from informal interruptions.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过议事规程正式终止、冻结或截断辩论与会期，区别于非正式的随意打断。
groups.nuance_en: adjourn: formally suspend a sitting until a future designated time (meeting / session / court) · prorogue: discontinue a legislative session by executive/monarchical prerogative without dissolving (parliament / assembly) · table: postpone discussion indefinitely or shelf a proposal (motion / bill / resolution) · closure: invoke a standing parliamentary vote to terminate debate immediately (debate / motion / speech) · guillotine: enforce a rigid statutory time limit to cut off debate and force a vote (bill / debate / legislation)
groups.nuance_zh: adjourn: 宣告休会并将议程延至指定日期 (meeting / session / court) · prorogue: 依国家元首特权宣告议会休会 (parliament / assembly) · table: 搁置暂不审议提案 (motion / bill / resolution) · closure: 动用闭会程序强行终止辩论 (debate / motion / speech) · guillotine: 动用断头台程序强制限制辩论时间并表决 (bill / debate / legislation)

groups.name: Condemn & Doom · 判决与注定落败 (Doom, Destine, Condemn)
groups.tip: 权威判决引向注定的厄运

items.def_en: (usually passive, + to/for) To intend or predeterminedly fix someone for a particular fate
items.ex_en: The harsh prophecy seemed to destine the young hero to perpetual sorrow.
items.ex_zh: 残酷的预言似乎注定了这位年轻英雄将承受无尽的悲哀。

items.def_en: (+ to) To officially state in a court of law what someone's punishment will be
items.ex_en: The high court judge proceeded to sentence the convicted felon to life imprisonment.
items.ex_zh: 高等法院法官继而判处这名定罪重犯终身监禁。

items.def_en: (+ to) To declare someone guilty or force someone inevitably into an unpleasant condition
items.ex_en: Chronic macroeconomic instability will condemn the developing nation to persistent impoverishment.
items.ex_zh: 长期的宏观经济动荡将使这个发展中国家不可避免地陷入持续贫困。

items.def_zh: 注定（失败、受苦、灭亡等）；判定，判决
items.def_en: (usually passive) To make someone or something certain to fail, suffer, or die.
items.ex_en: Catastrophic navigation errors doomed the ill-fated polar expedition to icy oblivion.
items.ex_zh: 灾难性的导航失误注定了这支厄运缠身的极地探险队葬身冰海。

items.def_zh: 使永远受折磨；彻底毁掉
items.def_en: To consign to eternal punishment, ruin, or inescapable disgrace
items.ex_en: The public corruption scandal would irrevocably damn his once brilliant political career.
items.ex_zh: 这起公众贪腐丑闻将彻底毁掉他一度辉煌的政治生涯。

groups.summary_en: Involves consigning individuals or projects inevitably to ruin, suffering, failure, or death. Distinguishes fatalistic inevitability from judicial or formal moral condemnation.
groups.summary_zh: 指将人、事物无可挽回地判决或注定推向失败、毁灭或苦难的境地。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an inescapable pronouncement of judgment, destruction, or ruin by authority, fate, or guilt, differing from conditional criticism.
groups.desc_zh: 指权威、命运或天道对某主体作出不可逃脱的毁灭性或罪责判决，区别于一般的指责。
groups.nuance_en: condemn: declare judicially guilty or pronounce an inescapable harsh fate (criminal / policy / building) · doom: preordain to an inevitable catastrophic failure, destruction, or death (mission / project / species) · destine: predetermine an irrevocable path, whether tragic or glorious, by fate (heir / city / fate) · sentence: pronounce a formal legal penalty from the bench (defendant / convict / offender) · damn: consign to eternal spiritual perdition or utter ruin (soul / heretic / reputation)
groups.nuance_zh: condemn: 司法定罪或宣告落入注定不幸的结局 (criminal / policy / building) · doom: 命中注定悲剧性失败、毁灭或夭折 (mission / project / species) · destine: 命理前定不可逆转的归宿（可好可坏） (heir / city / fate) · sentence: 法官正式下达刑罚裁决 (defendant / convict / offender) · damn: 判处万劫不复的下地狱或彻底毁弃 (soul / heretic / reputation)

groups.name: Condescend & Deign · 屈尊与俯就 (Condescend, Stoop, Vouchsafe)
groups.tip: 放下身段屈尊纡贵去行动

items.def_zh: 屈尊，俯就，放下面子（做某事）
items.def_en: (+ to do) (disapproving) to agree to do something that you consider beneath your dignity or social position.
items.ex_en: The arrogant duchess would not even deign to acknowledge her impoverished cousins.
items.ex_zh: 傲慢的公爵夫人甚至不屑于屈尊去理会她那些穷困的表亲。

items.def_en: (+ to do) to behave in a manner perceived as degrading to one's self-respect or status
items.ex_en: The honorable statesman refused to lower himself to hurling petty personal insults.
items.ex_zh: 这位可敬的政治家拒绝自贬身价去进行琐碎的人身攻击。

items.def_en: (+ to do) to agree to do something beneath one's dignity or social position, often with conscious superiority
items.ex_en: The senior diplomat would rarely condescend to address junior embassy staff directly.
items.ex_zh: 这位资深外交官极少会屈尊降贵直接与大使馆初级职员说话。

items.def_en: to give, reveal, or grant something graciously or condescendingly to someone viewed as inferior
items.ex_en: The sovereign would not vouchsafe an explanation to his bewildered courtiers.
items.ex_zh: 君主不肯施予恩准，向他困惑的侍臣们作出一句解释。

items.def_en: (+ to) to lower one's moral standards or dignity far enough to perform an unworthy act
items.ex_en: A respectable journalist would never stoop to fabricating sensational headlines for clicks.
items.ex_zh: 一个体面的新闻记者绝不会堕落到编造耸人听闻的标题来博取点击。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe lowering oneself socially or morally to perform an action deemed beneath one's rank, pride, or dignity, often patronizingly.
groups.summary_zh: 指自居尊贵而放下身段、纡尊降贵或屈就做下情之事。
groups.desc_en: Describes stepping down from social, moral, or rank superiority to interact with inferiors, either with graciousness or an insulting air of vanity, differing from simple humility.
groups.desc_zh: 指自恃身段、地位高人一等而俯就下级，或施恩宽容或傲慢蔑视，区别于真正的谦卑。
