groups.nuance_en: condescend: assume an air of patronizing superiority while mingling with inferiors (to subordinates / to explain) · deign: reluctantly condescend to perform an act deemed beneath one's dignity (to reply / to notice / to speak) · stoop: degrade one's ethical dignity or status by engaging in low actions (to cheating / to petty insults / to beg) · lower oneself: sacrifice one's standard of self-respect (to their level / to violence) · vouchsafe: graciously grant something as a favor from a position of absolute power (favor / answer / mercy)
groups.nuance_zh: condescend: 居高临下地施舍耐心或俯尊接见 (to subordinates / to explain) · deign: 勉为其难地放下身段垂顾 (to reply / to notice / to speak) · stoop: 卑劣自轻至做出下三滥之举 (to cheating / to petty insults / to beg) · lower oneself: 降低自尊底线与人计较 (to their level / to violence) · vouchsafe: 居高临下施予恩宠或首肯赐予 (favor / answer / mercy)

groups.name: Confect & Candy · 糖渍与蜜制 (Candy, Crystallize, Glacé)
groups.tip: 在物体外表涂抹糖衣或防护层

items.def_en: To coat, dust, or preserve food with granulated sugar or sweet syrup
items.ex_en: The pastry chef began to sugar the warm brioche with powdered cinnamon.
items.ex_zh: 糕点师开始往热气腾腾的布里欧修面包上撒肉桂糖粉。

items.def_zh: 用糖煮，把……做成蜜饯；（表面）结晶为砂糖
items.def_en: to cook or coat fruit or food in sugar or sugar syrup, or to become encrusted with sugar
items.ex_en: Traditional confectioners candy fresh citrus peel in copper pans over low heat.
items.ex_zh: 传统糖果商用铜锅慢火将新鲜的柑橘皮制成果脯蜜饯。

items.def_en: To soak fruit repeatedly in concentrated syrup so it becomes tender, translucent, and glossy
items.ex_en: Artisans gently glacé ripe Provencal cherries to preserve their glistening crimson beauty.
items.ex_zh: 手艺人精细地将成熟的普罗旺斯樱桃蜜制糖浸，以保留其晶莹剔透的绯红色泽。

items.def_zh: 渍制（在糖浆或油脂中慢烹慢浸）
items.def_en: To cook and preserve food slowly immersed in rich syrup or fat over extended heat
items.ex_en: The chef decided to confit tender duck legs in fragrant rendered fat.
items.ex_zh: 大厨决定将鲜嫩的鸭腿浸在芳香的鸭油中慢烹渍制。

items.def_en: To preserve fruit or edible blossoms by coating or impregnating them with crystalline sugar
items.ex_en: She carefully began to crystallize edible violet petals with fine baker sugar.
items.ex_zh: 她小心翼翼地用优质细砂糖将可食用的紫罗兰花瓣裹糖晶制成蜜饯。
items.ex2_en: Pure raw honey will gradually crystallize when stored in cold kitchen pantries.
items.ex2_zh: 纯天然生蜂蜜存放在寒冷的厨房储藏柜中时会逐渐析出结晶。

groups.summary_en: This culinary preservation frame relates to steeping, boiling, or coating fruits, nuts, or edible flowers in dense sugar syrup until they absorb the sweet solution and become encrusted or preserved.
groups.summary_zh: 指用浓缩糖浆浸渍、熬制或在表面结晶包衣，制成果脯或糖果。
groups.desc_en: Captures the culinary preservation or sweetening of fruit and ingredients via sugar saturation and syrup drying, distinct from general cooking.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过高糖浸透、结晶或糖浆熬制以加工保存食材并增甜，不同于普通的烹调蒸煮。
groups.nuance_en: candy: preserve fruit or peel by boiling in rich sugar syrup until saturated (peel / ginger / fruit) · crystallize: coat or penetrate with glistening solid sugar crystals (ginger / violets / fruit) · glacé: coat or infuse with a glossy, translucent sugar glaze (cherries / chestnuts / fruits) · confit: cook slowly and preserve in sugar syrup (fruit) or submerged rendered fat (duck / peel) · sugar: sprinkle, coat, or preserve broadly with granular sugar (strawberries / rims / pastries)
groups.nuance_zh: candy: 用浓糖浆久渍透心制成果脯 (peel / ginger / fruit) · crystallize: 析出并裹覆亮晶晶的糖霜结晶 (ginger / violets / fruit) · glacé: 滚裹一层透亮发光的糖衣糖浆 (cherries / chestnuts / fruits) · confit: 糖浆慢渍蜜饯或油脂低温慢封油封 (duck / peel) · sugar: 表面撒糖粉或入糖调味腌渍 (strawberries / rims / pastries)

groups.name: Confer Nobility & Monarchy · 封爵与加冕 (Crown, Knight, Ennoble)
groups.tip: 授予王位勋衔与荣誉

items.def_zh: 为……加冕；使圆满，使达到顶峰
items.def_en: 1. To officially place a crown on someone's head in a royal ceremony, making them monarch. 2. To complete or make something perfect or successful.
items.ex_en: The archbishop will crown the youthful monarch in the venerable ancient cathedral.
items.ex_zh: 大主教将在古老庄严的大教堂里为这位年轻的君主加冕。

items.def_zh: 封……为爵士，授以骑士爵位
items.def_en: To bestow knighthood upon someone in an official ceremony.
items.ex_en: The sovereign decided to knight the distinguished neurosurgeon for extraordinary humanitarian services.
items.ex_zh: 君主决定册封这位杰出的神经外科医生为爵士，以表彰其非凡的人道主义贡献。

items.def_en: to confer knighthood upon someone by tapping their shoulders with a sword
items.ex_en: The Queen will dub the victorious explorer during the grand royal investiture.
items.ex_zh: 女王将在盛大的王家授勋仪式上持剑轻点这位凯旋的探险家封其为骑士。

items.def_en: to apply oil to someone in a religious ceremony as a divine sign of consecration to monarchy or high office
items.ex_en: The venerable patriarch anointed the sovereign with fragrant oil before the altar.
items.ex_zh: 德高望重的宗主教在祭坛前用圣油为君王行涂油礼以祝圣。

items.def_en: to confer a peerage or noble rank upon someone
items.ex_en: The monarch resolved to ennoble the generous benefactor with an inherited title.
items.ex_zh: 君王决定赐封这位慷慨的捐资者世袭爵位，将其升为贵族。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers formal, ritualistic acts of bestowing royal status, a title of nobility, or knighthood upon an individual in a monarchical governance context. The verbs take the recipient person as the direct object.
groups.summary_zh: 君主制仪式中授予君权、爵位或骑士称号等贵族特权的行为。
groups.desc_en: Covers formal, legally binding rituals that elevate an individual into sovereign power or high hereditary/knightly rank, distinct from secular hiring or promoting.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过神圣或国家仪式正式册封、加冕某人以赋予君权或贵族阶位，区别于世俗意义的升迁任命。
groups.nuance_en: crown: place a regal diadem on a monarch during coronation to invest sovereignty (king / monarch / queen) · knight: confer chivalric rank upon someone via sovereign touch (scientist / champion / actor) · dub: confer a title or knighthood through ceremonial shoulder tapping (sir / knight / champion) · anoint: apply consecrated oil ceremonially during consecration (monarch / king / priest) · ennoble: officially elevate commoners to the hereditary nobility or aristocratic peerage (families / loyal subjects / commoners)
groups.nuance_zh: crown: 举行加冕大典授戴王冠立为君主 (king / monarch / queen) · knight: 经元首册封骑士爵位 (scientist / champion / actor) · dub: 执剑轻拍肩头以赐封爵号头衔 (sir / knight / champion) · anoint: 涂抹圣油以施行神圣受膏仪式 (monarch / king / priest) · ennoble: 破格擢升为世袭贵族阶层 (families / loyal subjects / commoners)

groups.name: Confess & Absolve · 忏悔告解与赦罪 (Shrive, Absolve, Remit)
groups.tip: 宗教或道德上的宽恕与赦罪

items.def_en: To tell a priest all of one's sins in the sacrament of penance
items.ex_en: The devout penitent knelt to confess his transgressions to the parish priest.
items.ex_zh: 虔诚的悔罪者跪下向教区神父告解自己的罪过。

items.def_en: To cancel or refrain from exacting a penalty or sin in an authoritative capacity
items.ex_en: The spiritual authority held the canonical power to remit severe ecclesiastical penalties.
items.ex_zh: 教会当局拥有根据教会法赦免严厉宗教处罚的权力。

items.def_en: To state formally in a religious or legal setting that someone is free from guilt, blame, or sin
items.ex_en: The presiding priest moved to absolve the tearful penitent from all guilt.
items.ex_zh: 主礼神父上前正式赦免了这位泪流满面的悔罪者的所有罪愆。

items.def_zh: 听取告解并给予赦免，忏悔（动词shrive的过去式）
items.def_en: (Archaic) Past tense of shrive; heard confession and granted absolution to.
items.ex_en: The ancient monk shrove the dying crusader before he drew his last.
items.ex_zh: 年迈的僧侣在垂死十字军咽气前听取了他的告解并赐予赦罪。

items.def_en: To hear the confession of, impose penance on, and give absolution to a penitent
items.ex_en: The kindly prior arrived at the bedside to shrive the ailing sovereign.
items.ex_zh: 和蔼的修道院院长来到床榻边，为病重的君王听告解并赦免罪过。

groups.summary_en: This religious and sacramental frame denotes hearing a penitent's confession, administering penance, and pronouncing divine release or forgiveness from sins.
groups.summary_zh: 专指宗教语境中听取信徒忏悔并授予赦罪、免除罪责。
groups.desc_en: Details the ecclesiastical or moral confession of transgressions and subsequent sacerdotal cleansing or divine pardon, distinct from courtroom plea bargains.
groups.desc_zh: 指信徒向神职人员坦白罪愆并获得神圣赦免与净化，区别于法庭上的认罪协议。
groups.nuance_en: confess: acknowledge and vocalize one's sins or wrongdoing to a priest/authority (sins / guilt / crime) · absolve: pronounce formal spiritual or legal release from guilt, sin, or penalty (sinner / penitent / defendant) · shrive: hear the confession of, impose penance upon, and absolve a penitent (penitent / sinner / soul) · remit: cancel or pardon a spiritual penalty or legal debt/sin (sins / debt / penalty) · shrove: past tense/archaic ritual of hearing confession before Lent (parishioner / penitent)
groups.nuance_zh: confess: 坦白告解自身罪行与灵魂过错 (sins / guilt / crime) · absolve: 神职人员或法官宣告彻底赦罪免责 (sinner / penitent / defendant) · shrive: 神父听取告解、施以补赎并宣布赦宥 (penitent / sinner / soul) · remit: 宽免减免罪责、惩处或债务 (sins / debt / penalty) · shrove: （古旧）在四旬斋前听取告解赦罪 (parishioner / penitent)

groups.name: Confide & Disclose · 倾诉与吐露 (Unburden, Disclose, Pour out)
groups.tip: 向信任之人袒露心声秘密

items.def_en: (+ to) Speak candidly about one's intimate feelings or personal past
items.ex_en: He finally decided to open up to his counselor about his childhood.
items.ex_zh: 他终于决定向心理咨询师敞开心扉，倾诉自己的童年往事。

items.def_en: Make secret or hidden personal information known to another person
items.ex_en: The witness agreed to disclose sensitive personal correspondence to the judicial committee.
items.ex_zh: 证人同意向司法委员会透露敏感的个人通信记录。

items.def_en: To share private thoughts, feelings, or secrets with someone because you trust them.
items.ex_en: She could safely confide her darkest marital anxieties only to her sister.
items.ex_zh: 她只敢放心地向自己的妹妹吐露婚姻中最隐秘的焦虑。

items.def_zh: 倾吐（心事）；卸下（心理负担）
items.def_en: (+ oneself/mind to) Relieve oneself of a burden by talking about one's troubles or secrets
items.ex_en: The weary traveler sought to unburden his troubled conscience to the stranger.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的旅人试图向那个陌生人倾吐心事，以卸下内心的沉重不安。

items.def_en: Freely and copiously express thoughts, worries, or emotions to someone
items.ex_en: She poured out her troubles to her best friend over coffee.
items.ex_zh: 她一边喝咖啡一边向闺蜜倾诉自己的烦恼。
items.ex2_en: Tearful grievances poured out uncontrollably as she confronted her estranged family members.
items.ex2_zh: 当她面对疏远的家人时，满腹委屈泪如雨下地倾泻而出。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote revealing private vulnerabilities, intimate thoughts, or closely guarded secrets to someone trusted. They range from formal disclosures of concealed information to emotional outpourings of distress.
groups.summary_zh: 强调出于信任或宣泄需要，向人吐露私密心声、秘密或苦衷。
groups.desc_en: Refers to sharing deeply private, vulnerable feelings, secrets, or worries with a trusted party, contrasting with routine public disclosure.
groups.desc_zh: 指基于高度信任而向他人倾吐极其私密的情感、秘密或心理重压，不同于公开发布信息。
groups.nuance_en: confide: reveal intimate secrets or worries to someone trusted not to betray them (secret / anxiety / suspicion) · unburden: release oneself from heavy emotional baggage or guilt by telling it all (oneself / soul / conscience) · pour out: release suppressed feelings or secrets in an uncontrollable rush (heart / grief / feelings) · open up: drop emotional barriers and speak candidly (to friends / emotionally) · disclose: reveal previously guarded or confidential facts to others (information / conflict of interest / identity)
groups.nuance_zh: confide: 倚重信任托付内心情感或私密心事 (secret / anxiety / suspicion) · unburden: 倾诉以卸下压抑在心头的负疚与包袱 (oneself / soul / conscience) · pour out: 倾盆宣泄般一吐为快、倒尽苦水 (heart / grief / feelings) · open up: 卸下心理防备敞开心扉 (to friends / emotionally) · disclose: 正式或非自愿地揭示披露保密实情 (information / conflict of interest / identity)

groups.name: Confine & Localize · 局限与圈定 (Localize, Contain, Circumscribe)
groups.tip: 限制在特定局部范围

items.def_en: To keep something harmful, such as a fire, virus, or hostile movement, within limits and prevent it from spreading
items.ex_en: Local authorities deployed barriers to contain the chemical spill within the harbor.
items.ex_zh: 地方当局部署了阻隔屏障，以将化学品泄漏遏制在海港范围内。

items.def_en: To surround someone or something closely so that movement or expansion is impossible
items.ex_en: Formidable mountain ridges hem in the picturesque village on all four sides.
items.ex_zh: 险峻的山岭四面环绕，严密地阻绝了这座风景如画的村落。

items.def_en: To restrict someone or something within designated borders, limits, or parameters
items.ex_en: The medical staff had to confine the infectious outbreak to solitary quarters.
items.ex_zh: 医务人员不得不将这场传染性疫情严格限制在隔离病房区域内。

items.def_zh: 将…限制在局部；确定…的发生位置；使本土化
items.def_en: 1. To confine or restrict something, such as an infection or conflict, to a specific area. 2. To find the exact place or origin of something. 3. To adapt a product or service for a particular local market.
items.ex_en: Advanced brain imaging helped the clinical team localize the source of seizures.
items.ex_zh: 先进的脑部成像技术帮助临床团队精准确定了癫痫发作的局部病灶。
items.ex2_en: The dangerous viral infection failed to localize within the patient's respiratory tract.
items.ex2_zh: 这种危险的病毒感染未能局限在患者的呼吸道之内。

items.def_en: To draw a line around something or strictly limit its range, power, or operational scope
items.ex_en: The stringent charter will circumscribe the legal powers of the municipal magistrate.
items.ex_zh: 这份严谨的宪章将严格限制市政治安官的法定职权范围。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict deliberate boundaries placed around a problem, disease, or influence to keep it within a narrow, defined spatial area.
groups.summary_zh: 将危害、疾病或活动圈定在局部狭小范围之内。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on restricting movement, spread, or operational scope strictly within spatial or conceptual bounds, unlike total stoppage.
groups.desc_zh: 指在空间或认知范围上对事物的发展、扩散严加限定或圈死，区别于整体终止活动。
groups.nuance_en: confine: restrict someone or something within narrow boundaries or physical spaces (prisoner / search / efforts) · contain: arrest the outward spread or transmission of something hostile (outbreak / fire / damage) · localize: pinpoint and prevent spreading beyond a specific geographic area (spread / infection / pain) · circumscribe: establish explicit, impassable outer legal or physical boundaries (powers / authority / freedom) · hem in: surround tightly and restrict mobility from all sides (troops / village / options)
groups.nuance_zh: confine: 监禁或将活动硬性局限于特定范围 (prisoner / search / efforts) · contain: 围堵遏制疫病、火势等灾害往外扩散 (outbreak / fire / damage) · localize: 使局限在某一发生地而不蔓延 (spread / infection / pain) · circumscribe: 画定权限与自由的不可逾越边界 (powers / authority / freedom) · hem in: 四面合围使动弹不得、陷入受制 (troops / village / options)

groups.name: Congratulate & Commend · 道贺与嘉许 (Congratulate, Felicitate, Applaud)
groups.tip: 对喜人成果表达赞许与贺意

items.def_en: To offer formal congratulations to someone on a happy occasion or achievement
items.ex_en: The ambassador took great pleasure to felicitate the premier on his election.
items.ex_zh: 大使非常荣幸地就首相的当选向其致以正式祝贺。

items.def_zh: 轻拍后背表扬；赞赏鼓勵
items.def_en: To praise, acknowledge, or show warm appreciation to someone for doing a job well
items.ex_en: The supervisor gave her a pat on the back for finishing early.
items.ex_zh: 主管因她提前完成工作而轻拍她的后背以示赞赏表扬。

items.def_en: To tell someone that you are pleased about their success, good luck, or happiness.
items.ex_en: Colleagues gathered together in the conference room to congratulate Maria on her promotion.
items.ex_zh: 同事们聚集在会议室里，向玛丽亚的升职表示祝贺。

items.def_en: To express strong, public approval and admiration for someone's decision or action
items.ex_en: Environmental advocates applaud the city council's bold initiative to ban single-use plastics.
items.ex_zh: 环保倡导者对市议会禁止一次性塑料制品的果敢举措大加称赞。

items.def_zh: 表彰；赞许（上级或官方褒奖）
items.def_en: To officially praise someone for an exceptional deed, service, or standard of conduct
items.ex_en: The governor was proud to commend the brave firefighter for heroic conduct.
items.ex_zh: 州长非常自豪地正式表彰这名勇敢消防员的英勇壮举。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on interpersonal communicative acts expressing personal delight, official recognition, or shared happiness toward someone regarding their notable achievement or good fortune.
groups.summary_zh: 针对他人取得的成就或吉事，向其当面表达喜悦祝贺与嘉许。
groups.desc_en: Denotes offering praise, celebration, or official approbation to an individual for a triumph, achievement, or good fortune, contrasting with detached reporting.
groups.desc_zh: 指因对方取得的成就、喜讯或德行，对其报以庆贺、嘉许或击节赞赏，不同于中立的报告。
groups.nuance_en: congratulate: warmly express pleasure to someone on their personal success or good fortune (winner / couple / friend) · felicitate: extend formal or ceremonial congratulations to someone (dignitary / author / team) · commend: express high official approval and praise for exemplary conduct (soldier / efforts / bravery) · applaud: show vigorous public or moral approval for an action (decision / courage / initiative) · pat on the back: offer informal, friendly praise or self-satisfaction (colleague / subordinate / oneself)
groups.nuance_zh: congratulate: 针对特定喜事当面道贺道喜 (winner / couple / friend) · felicitate: 正式典雅地呈送祝贺与吉祥颂词 (dignitary / author / team) · commend: 官方或上级嘉奖表彰其突出表现 (soldier / efforts / bravery) · applaud: 击节称赞或对某举措深表赞同 (decision / courage / initiative) · pat on the back: 随和亲切地拍肩勉励或自我陶醉 (colleague / subordinate / oneself)

groups.name: Congregate & Swarm · 群聚与汇聚 (Congregate, Flop, Swarm)
groups.tip: 群体向某一处聚拢集合

items.def_en: (of fish) To swim together in a disciplined, coordinated group
items.ex_en: Gleaming silver sardines school tightly together beneath the sunlit crests of waves.
items.ex_zh: 闪烁银光的沙丁鱼紧密成群，在阳光照耀的浪尖之下游动。

items.def_en: To move or go together in large crowds to a specific destination
items.ex_en: Enthusiastic pilgrims flock in their thousands to the sacred mountain shrine annually.
items.ex_zh: 每年都有成千上万热忱的朝圣者成群结队涌向这座神圣的山间神殿。

items.def_en: To move or gather in large numbers like insects, fish, or a crowd
items.ex_en: Disillusioned protestors swarm through the municipal square waving banners and demanding reform.
items.ex_zh: 深感幻灭的抗议人群蜂拥穿过市政广场，挥舞着标语要求改革。

items.def_en: 1. (of fish) To gather and swim together in a large group. 2. (of water) To become shallower.
items.ex_en: Golden mackerel shoal near the coastal shallows when early morning light breaks.
items.ex_zh: 破晓晨光初现之时，金色的鲭鱼聚成大群在近海浅滩游弋。

items.def_en: To gather together in large numbers in a particular location
items.ex_en: Concerned citizens will congregate outside the parliament building for the candlelight vigil.
items.ex_zh: 忧心忡忡的公民们将聚集在议会大厦外举行烛光守夜活动。

groups.summary_en: This frame depicts animals or organisms assembling and moving collectively in large groups, shoals, flocks, or swarms across physical spaces.
groups.summary_zh: 指动物、水生生物或人群大量群聚、成群移动或扎堆活动。
groups.desc_en: Denotes aggregate living entities converging into dense collective masses or synchronized formations, contrasting with static clustering or chaotic dispersal.
groups.desc_zh: 指生命体汇聚成密集群体或进行同步协同流动，区别于静态堆叠或杂乱消散。
groups.nuance_en: congregate: formal general gathering of people in one place (crowd / worshipers / protesters) · flock: mass movement in large numbers toward an attraction (tourists / shoppers / birds) · swarm: chaotic, dense, dynamic mass movement (bees / fans / locusts) · school: synchronized collective swimming movement (fish / tuna) · shoal: loose social grouping in shallow waters (herring / minnows)
groups.nuance_zh: congregate: 人群在某处的正式聚集 (crowd / worshipers / protesters) · flock: 大群人或鸟蜂拥奔赴某处 (tourists / shoppers / birds) · swarm: 密集喧闹、蜂拥而动的混乱聚集 (bees / fans / locusts) · school: 鱼群高度同步游动 (fish / tuna) · shoal: 鱼群松散的浅水聚集 (herring / minnows)

groups.name: Conjecture & Infer on Gaps · 揣摩与凭据推测 (Conjecture, Surmise, Deduce)
groups.tip: 根据零星线索推理假设

items.def_en: To venture or dare to offer a guess despite knowing one may well be wrong
items.ex_en: I dare not hazard a guess regarding the outcome of tomorrow's election.
items.ex_zh: 关于明天的选举结果，我不敢妄自冒昧揣测。

items.def_en: To form opinions about what might happen or what is true without firm knowledge
items.ex_en: Financial analysts speculate that the central bank will raise interest rates tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 金融分析师们推测中央银行很可能会在明天提高基准利率。

items.def_en: To form an opinion or conclusion based on incomplete evidence or guesswork.
items.ex_en: Historians can only conjecture about the true motives behind the ancient treaty.
items.ex_zh: 历史学家们只能对该古老条约背后的真正动机作出推测猜想。

items.def_en: To deduce or conclude something from implicit evidence and reasoning rather than explicit statements
items.ex_en: From these inconclusive financial audits, auditors could not infer intentional corporate fraud.
items.ex_zh: 从这些未有定论的财务审计中，审计人员无法推断出存在蓄意的企业欺诈。

items.def_en: To suppose that something is true without having certain confirming evidence
items.ex_en: Without empirical evidence, researchers can only surmise the cause of the anomaly.
items.ex_zh: 缺乏实证依据，研究人员只能对这一异常现象的原因进行臆测。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe forming conclusions or opinions when facts are incomplete, ranging from intuitive guesses to reasoned extrapolations.
groups.summary_zh: 在证据不足或存在盲区时，结合线索做出推断或揣度。
groups.desc_en: Denotes bridging cognitive or evidential voids by forming tentative judgments, contrasting with proven factual deduction or baseless fantasizing.
groups.desc_zh: 指凭借不完全线索或逻辑跨越信息空白以作出推测判断，区别于严密实证或凭空幻想。
groups.nuance_en: infer: derive logically from existing premises or facts (intent / meaning / truth) · surmise: form a notion on slight, incomplete evidence (motives / reason / identity) · conjecture: formulate an opinion based purely on unproven guesswork (fate / outcome / theory) · speculate: engage in broad, discursive musing on unknown scenarios (future / market / cause) · hazard a guess: offer a hesitant, self-consciously tentative estimate (number / price / identity)
groups.nuance_zh: infer: 根据已知前提或事实逻辑推论 (intent / meaning / truth) · surmise: 基于微弱薄弱的线索揣测 (motives / reason / identity) · conjecture: 缺乏实据地凭空臆测 (fate / outcome / theory) · speculate: 对未知场景进行宽泛思索推求 (future / market / cause) · hazard a guess: 试探性地大胆盲猜 (number / price / identity)

groups.name: Connect & Join · 连接与结合 (Link, Connect, Couple)
groups.tip: 将两端物体关联接通一体

items.def_zh: 连接，结合；关联，建立联系
items.def_en: 1. To connect, join, or fasten two or more things together physically. 2. To make or show a connection between two people, things, or ideas.
items.ex_en: The new express railway will link the capital city to southern ports.
items.ex_zh: 这条新的高速铁路将把首都与南部各个港口连接起来。

items.def_en: To fasten, unite, or bring two pieces together so they become one
items.ex_en: The carpenter used waterproof adhesive to join the two timber sections together.
items.ex_zh: 木匠使用了防水胶水将这两截木料紧密接合在一起。
items.ex2_en: The two shallow rivers join just south of the historic stone bridge.
items.ex2_zh: 两条浅水河就在那座历史悠久的石桥南侧汇合在一起。

items.def_en: (usually passive + with) To join, link, or combine two elements closely
items.ex_en: Economic hardship, coupled with political instability, forced thousands of families to leave.
items.ex_zh: 经济困难加之政局动荡，迫使数千个家庭背井离乡。
items.ex2_en: The two train compartments couple smoothly along the main railway track line.
items.ex2_zh: 两节火车车厢在铁路线主轨道上平稳地挂接在一起。

items.def_en: (+ to/with) To join together two or more things physically or logically
items.ex_en: You need to connect this cable directly to the router's main port.
items.ex_zh: 你需要将这根电缆直接连接到路由器的主端口上。
items.ex2_en: These two rural train tracks connect at the central municipal transport station.
items.ex2_zh: 这两条乡村铁路线在中央市政交通枢纽站处连接在一起。

items.def_en: To attach, connect, or plug electronic or mechanical components into a system
items.ex_en: Can you help me hook up the sound system to my laptop?
items.ex_zh: 你能帮我把音响系统连接到笔记本电脑上吗？

groups.summary_en: This frame covers physical or conceptual interconnection where two or more distinct entities are brought together, united, or interrelated into a functional whole.
groups.summary_zh: 指将两个或多个物理实体或抽象概念连接结合在一起。
groups.desc_en: Denotes establishing physical, logical, or infrastructural continuity between two or more distinct entities, contrasting with total fusion or loose adjacency.
groups.desc_zh: 指在两个或多个独立实体间建立物理、逻辑或管网连通，区别于完全融合或简单邻近。
groups.nuance_en: connect: establish a functional, electronic, or physical link (wires / points / dots) · join: bring together to form a continuous whole or union (ends / forces / edges) · link: associate causally, conceptually, or systematically (evidence / systems / sites) · couple: pair together mechanically or conceptually to transfer force or effect (cars / concepts / factors) · hook up: informal mechanical or electronic fastening (cables / equipment / trailer)
groups.nuance_zh: connect: 建立功能、电路或物理上的接通 (wires / points / dots) · join: 将两端或多方结合为连续整体 (ends / forces / edges) · link: 在因果、概念或网络系统上形成关联 (evidence / systems / sites) · couple: 机械挂接或双双联动耦合 (cars / concepts / factors) · hook up: 非正式的接通管线或接驳设备 (cables / equipment / trailer)

groups.name: Conspire & Connive · 共谋与纵容 (Connive, Collude, Scheme)
groups.tip: 暗中串通策划或默许勾结

items.def_en: To pretend not to notice improper or illegal conduct, thereby implicitly allowing it
items.ex_en: Corrupt magistrates chose to wink at smuggling operations throughout the remote coastal district.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的地方官对偏远沿海地区的走私活动选择睁一眼闭一眼。

items.def_en: To make clever, underhanded secret plans, especially to deceive or gain advantage
items.ex_en: Disgruntled executives began to scheme together to oust the company's chief executive.
items.ex_zh: 心怀不满的高管们开始密谋罢免公司的首席执行官。

items.def_zh: 共谋，暗中勾结；纵容，默许
items.def_en: 1. To secretly plot or conspire with someone to do something wrongful or illegal. 2. ('connive at') To ignore or turn a blind eye to wrongdoing.
items.ex_en: Senior officials connived with contractors to embezzle millions from the public infrastructure fund.
items.ex_zh: 高级官员与承包商相互勾结，从公共基础设施基金中贪污数百万公款。

items.def_en: (+ with/against) To secretly plan with other people to carry out an unlawful or harmful act
items.ex_en: Several rebel officers conspired to overthrow the fragile government during the national crisis.
items.ex_zh: 几名叛乱军官在国家危机期间密谋推翻脆弱的政府。

items.def_en: (+ with) To work together secretly with someone in order to achieve an illicit or deceitful purpose
items.ex_en: The two rival firms colluded to fix prices across the entire domestic market.
items.ex_zh: 两家竞争企业暗中勾结，操纵整个国内市场的价格。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame deal with covert, illicit cooperation or culpable inaction, in which parties secretly plan illegal deeds or turn a blind eye to wrongdoing, compromising moral or legal standards.
groups.summary_zh: 指暗中串通策划不法行为，或明知违法犯罪而故意纵容、视而不见。
groups.desc_en: Denotes covert plotting or tacit complicity to achieve deceptive, illegal, or unethical ends, contrasting with transparent alliance or lawful coordination.
groups.desc_zh: 指暗中策划勾结或心照不宣地默许纵容以行不轨，区别于光明正大的结盟或合法协作。
groups.nuance_en: conspire: plan secretly and unlawfully with others to commit harm (rebels / enemies / factions) · collude: act in secret concert to deceive or rig a process (bidders / officials / monopolies) · scheme: devise underhanded, manipulative machinations (rivals / politicians) · connive: secretly cooperate or encourage illicit deeds through deliberate inaction (guards / authorities) · wink at: deliberately pretend not to notice wrongdoing (corruption / abuses / violations)
groups.nuance_zh: conspire: 密谋实施不法或反叛行径 (rebels / enemies / factions) · collude: 暗中串通以操纵舞弊或欺诈 (bidders / officials / monopolies) · scheme: 耍手腕心机狡诈策划 (rivals / politicians) · connive: 暗中纵容、参与包庇勾结 (guards / authorities) · wink at: 故意闭眼假装看不见违规 (corruption / abuses / violations)

groups.name: Construe & Analyze Meaning · 解读与推定意图 (Take, Decipher, Read into)
groups.tip: 赋予深层含义与理解

items.def_en: (+ as/to be) To understand or interpret a remark, action, or person in a specified way
items.ex_en: Please do not take her sudden silence as a sign of complete agreement.
items.ex_zh: 请不要将她的突然沉默理解为完全同意。

items.def_zh: 理解，领会，阐释；作句法分析
items.def_en: 1. (+ as) (formal) To understand or explain the meaning of words, actions, or events in a particular way. 2. (grammar) To analyze the syntax of a sentence.
items.ex_en: Legal scholars construed his ambiguous statement as an implicit admission of ultimate liability.
items.ex_zh: 法学学者将他含糊不清的声明解读为对最终责任的默认。

items.def_en: To analyze text or behavior component by component to determine its structural or latent meaning
items.ex_en: Analysts carefully parsed every sentence of the chairperson's address for subtle policy shifts.
items.ex_zh: 分析人士逐句细致剖析主席的讲话，以寻找微妙的政策转变迹象。

items.def_en: To attribute more meaning, intention, or significance to something than is warranted by the facts
items.ex_en: You are reading too much into a casual email sent without much thought.
items.ex_zh: 你对一封没怎么多想就发出的随常邮件过度解读了。

items.def_en: To succeed in reading, decoding, or understanding something encoded, messy, or obscure
items.ex_en: Specialists worked tirelessly to decipher the fragmented inscriptions found inside the ancient tomb.
items.ex_zh: 专家们不知疲倦地工作，以破译古墓内发现的残缺铭文。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on inferring, parsing, or assigning a specific intention or semantic meaning to actions, texts, or ambiguous conduct. Nuances range from legal deduction to subjective projection.
groups.summary_zh: 从言行或文本中推论、剖析并赋予特定意图或含义。
groups.desc_en: Denotes intellectually analyzing signs, text, or behavior to decode meaning or intent, contrasting with passive perception or objective literal translation.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过智力剖析符号、文本或举止以阐释意图与涵义，区别于被动感知或字面直译。
groups.nuance_en: parse: break down and analyze syntax or subtext minutely (statement / sentence / data) · construe: interpret the specific meaning or intent of actions or words (silence / remarks / contract) · decipher: decode obscure, cryptic, or distorted information (script / code / motives) · read into: impute excessive, unintended significance to something (words / gestures / comments) · take: understand or react to something in a specified manner (advice / joke / praise)
groups.nuance_zh: parse: 细致切分语法结构或深层隐义 (statement / sentence / data) · construe: 将言行定性解读为某种意图 (silence / remarks / contract) · decipher: 破译难辨、隐秘的信息或动机 (script / code / motives) · read into: 过度解读出多余的弦外之音 (words / gestures / comments) · take: 以某种特定方式理解或接受 (advice / joke / praise)

groups.name: Contact & Reach · 联络与触达 (Reach, Get hold of, Ring)
groups.tip: 设法通过各种渠道取得联系

items.def_en: To successfully communicate with someone by phone, letter, or email
items.ex_en: I tried all morning to reach him by phone, but nobody answered.
items.ex_zh: 我整个上午都试图通过电话联系到他，但一直无人接听。

items.def_en: To communicate with someone by calling, writing, or sending a message.
items.ex_en: Please contact our customer support team immediately if your delivery does not arrive.
items.ex_zh: 如果您的货物未送达，请立即联系我们的客户支持团队。

items.def_en: To manage to find or contact someone, often after some effort
items.ex_en: I finally got hold of the plumber after calling him four times today.
items.ex_zh: 在今天打了四次电话之后，我终于设法联系上了那位管工。

items.def_en: (+ with) To initiate contact or establish communication with another person
items.ex_en: The investigator managed to get in touch with a key witness yesterday evening.
items.ex_zh: 调查员昨晚成功与一名关键证人取得了联系。

items.def_en: (+ to) To make an effort to communicate with someone for help, cooperation, or networking
items.ex_en: Our marketing team decided to reach out to local charities for future collaboration.
items.ex_zh: 我们的营销团队决定主动联系当地慈善机构以寻求未来的合作。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate the act of initiating communication with an individual or party across distance via phone, messaging, or written correspondence.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过电话、信息或书面形式主动联系或寻找某人。
groups.desc_en: Denotes successfully bridging distance or communicative barriers to establish an interactive channel with someone, contrasting with unrequited broadcasting or physical travel.
groups.desc_zh: 指克服物理或社交阻隔与对方建立起通讯联系，区别于单向广播或肉身前往访问。
groups.nuance_en: contact: formal act of initiating communication (office / lawyer / police) · reach: successfully get through to someone despite difficulty or distance (customer / representative / target) · get hold of: locate and manage to communicate with an elusive person (director / doctor / witness) · reach out: initiate supportive, exploratory, or proactive communication (community / allies / voters) · get in touch: re-establish or begin ordinary communicative contact (friends / colleagues / supplier)
groups.nuance_zh: contact: 正式发起联络通讯 (office / lawyer / police) · reach: 排除阻碍或距离成功接通对方 (customer / representative / target) · get hold of: 费力寻找到难以联系的人 (director / doctor / witness) · reach out: 主动示好或寻求外延合作 (community / allies / voters) · get in touch: 建立或重新恢复日常联络 (friends / colleagues / supplier)

groups.name: Contemptuous Rejection · 鄙弃与蔑绝 (Spurn, Scorn, Disdain)
groups.tip: 从单纯拒绝递进至傲慢唾弃摒绝

items.def_en: To dismiss or reject someone or their suggestions curtly and rudely
items.ex_en: He tried to brush off the criticism as petty jealousy.
items.ex_zh: 他试图对这些批评不予理会，将其归咎于小人的嫉妒。

items.def_en: To refuse to do something because of feelings of superiority or contempt
items.ex_en: The proud aristocrat disdained to answer allegations leveled by his former domestic servants.
items.ex_zh: 那位傲慢的贵族不屑于回应前家仆们对他的指控。

items.def_en: To deliberately insult, ignore, or cold-shoulder an invitation, overture, or person
items.ex_en: The celebrity openly snubbed reporters by walking past them without uttering a word.
items.ex_zh: 这位名人一言不发地从记者身旁走过，公然予以怠慢。

items.def_en: To reject a person, offer, or idea with disdain or contempt.
items.ex_en: The proud queen spurned his humble peace offering with cold and bitter mockery.
items.ex_zh: 骄傲的王后带着冰冷刺骨的嘲讽，轻蔑地拒绝了他的求和提议。

items.def_en: To refuse or reject something contemptuously as beneath one's dignity
items.ex_en: The principled scholar scorned lucrative offers from corporations seeking to bias his research.
items.ex_zh: 这位有原则的学者不屑一顾地拒绝了企图左右其研究的企业重金诱惑。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this high-intensity frame describe refusing an advance, offer, proposal, or person with haughty disdain, contempt, or mockery. Nuances emphasize emotional revulsion, haughty rejection, or cold derision rather than polite denial.
groups.summary_zh: 强调带着傲慢、不屑、鄙夷或厌恶的强烈情绪断然拒绝。
groups.desc_en: Denotes dismissing, refusing, or spurning an offer or person from an explicit stance of superiority and disdain, contrasting with polite refusal or neutral avoidance.
groups.desc_zh: 指居高临下、带极度优越感与蔑视态度予以拒绝或摒弃，区别于礼貌婉拒或中性回避。
groups.nuance_en: scorn: reject with biting mockery and profound contempt (invitation / advice / weakness) · spurn: decisively and haughtily reject an advance or offer (advances / plea / offer) · disdain: refuse to acknowledge or treat as utterly beneath one's dignity (compromise / response / flattery) · snub: deliberately cold-shoulder or rebuff socially (guest / peer / ally) · brush off: casually and disrespectfully dismiss someone's concerns (criticism / complaint / reporter)
groups.nuance_zh: scorn: 讥诮轻蔑地回绝或鄙视 (invitation / advice / weakness) · spurn: 决绝傲慢地踢开求欢或提议 (advances / plea / offer) · disdain: 自持身份而不屑于为之 (compromise / response / flattery) · snub: 故意冷落或公然轻慢羞辱 (guest / peer / ally) · brush off: 漫不经心地打发摆脱麻烦 (criticism / complaint / reporter)

groups.name: Contest & Dispute · 提出异议与抗辩 (Dispute, Contest, Challenge)
groups.tip: 围绕观点分歧展开激烈交锋

items.def_zh: 对……表示强烈反对；对……有异议
items.def_en: To disagree strongly with a specific opinion, claim, or action
items.ex_en: Prominent economists took issue with the administration's overly optimistic forecasts regarding inflation trends.
items.ex_zh: 著名经济学家对该政府关于通胀趋势过于乐观的预测提出了强烈异议。

items.def_en: To call into question the truth, validity, or legality of a view or assertion
items.ex_en: Defense attorneys challenged the reliability of the forensic evidence presented in court yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 辩方律师昨天在法庭上对所出示法医证据的可靠性提出了质疑。

items.def_en: To formally oppose, question, or assert defense against a decision, election, or statement
items.ex_en: The opposition party decided to contest the election results in the supreme court.
items.ex_zh: 反对党决定在最高法院对选举结果提出正式抗辩。

items.def_en: 1. To question the truth, validity, or authority of something. 2. To argue or disagree strongly with someone about something.
items.ex_en: The union leaders disputed the official employment figures published by the labor ministry.
items.ex_zh: 工会领导人对劳工部公布的官方就业数据提出了质疑。

items.def_en: To declare a statement or fact to be untrue; to oppose or speak against
items.ex_en: No honest observer could gainsay the extraordinary impact of her profound scientific discovery.
items.ex_zh: 任何诚实的观察者都无法否认她重大科学发现的非凡影响。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve actively challenging the truth, validity, fairness, or authority of a claim, result, or decision through formal opposition or sharp intellectual contention.
groups.summary_zh: 指对某项声明、裁决或权力的真实性、有效性提出质疑或抗辩。
groups.desc_en: Denotes formally raising active objections, doubts, or legal counterclaims against an assertion, outcome, or authority, contrasting with silent submission or aggressive attacking.
groups.desc_zh: 指对主张、判决或权威提出正式抗辩、质疑或法律争讼，区别于隐忍顺从或单纯武力攻击。
groups.nuance_en: challenge: call into question the validity, legality, or capability of something (decision / authority / assumption) · contest: formally dispute an election, claim, or verdict in competition (will / election / seat) · dispute: argue against the correctness or ownership of something (claim / bill / boundary) · take issue with: express specific intellectual or political disagreement (view / assertion / policy) · gainsay: formally or categorically deny or contradict an undisputed truth (findings / evidence / fact)
groups.nuance_zh: challenge: 对合法性、真伪或能力公开发起挑衅质疑 (decision / authority / assumption) · contest: 通过法定程序抗辩或争夺 (will / election / seat) · dispute: 就事实、账目或主权进行争论驳诘 (claim / bill / boundary) · take issue with: 就某一具体观点表达反对异议 (view / assertion / policy) · gainsay: 断然否认无可辩驳的既成事实 (findings / evidence / fact)

groups.name: Convene & Deliberate · 集会与党团商议 (Convene, Confer, Assemble)
groups.tip: 党派骨干闭门集会商定策略

items.def_en: to gather together in one place as a unified body for a specific purpose
items.ex_en: Delegates from fifty nations assembled in the grand hall for the treaty signing.
items.ex_zh: 来自五十个国家的代表聚集在大厅举行条约签署仪式。
items.ex2_en: The factory technicians assemble precision mechanical watches inside the clean room environment.
items.ex2_zh: 工厂技术人员在洁净室环境中组装精密机械手表。

items.def_en: (+ with) to discuss something with someone in order to reach a decision or exchange ideas
items.ex_en: The judge retired to confer with her fellow magistrates before issuing the verdict.
items.ex_zh: 法官在宣布判决前退席，以便与其他法官进行商议。

items.def_en: to call together or gather for a formal meeting or assembly
items.ex_en: The committee will convene next Monday to deliberate on the proposed budget amendments.
items.ex_zh: 委员会将于下周一召开会议，审议拟议的预算修正案。
items.ex2_en: The general convened a mandatory meeting of senior military officers this afternoon.
items.ex2_zh: 将军今天下午召集了高级军官的强制性会议。

items.def_zh: 召开党团会议，集会商讨策略
items.def_en: (chiefly US politics) to meet privately with members of a political party to choose candidates or decide on policy
items.ex_en: Party leaders caucused behind closed doors to decide their nominee for the senate.
items.ex_zh: 党派领导人闭门举行党团会议，以确定其参议员候选人。

items.def_en: to gather closely together in a private group to confer or plan tactics
items.ex_en: The coaching staff huddled near the sideline to adjust their second-half offensive tactics.
items.ex_zh: 教练组在场边聚拢碰头，以调整下半场的进攻战术。
items.ex2_en: Cold autumn winds huddle the stray sheep against the rocky stone fence.
items.ex2_zh: 寒冷的秋风把走失的羊群赶得挤在岩石石栅栏边。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this political and governance frame depict gathering formal groups, party members, or committees to deliberate policy, negotiate strategy, or select leaders.
groups.summary_zh: 指政党代表或委员会正式聚集、协商策略与研拟方针。
groups.desc_en: Denotes assembling a body of people specifically for formal, tactical, or legislative consultation and consensus-building, contrasting with passive spectator gathering.
groups.desc_zh: 指为特定商议、战术布置或立法议事而召集人员集会，区别于无目的闲逛或被动围观。
groups.nuance_en: convene: formally summon a body or council to assemble (parliament / committee / court) · assemble: gather dispersed members into a single formation or body (troops / delegates / crowd) · confer: hold mutual discussions to compare opinions or decide (lawyers / doctors / leaders) · caucus: meet within a political faction to align policy or strategy (delegates / members / party) · huddle: gather closely and privately for quick tactical coordination (team / executives / players)
groups.nuance_zh: convene: 正式召集会议或委员会 (parliament / committee / court) · assemble: 集合离散的成员形成队伍 (troops / delegates / crowd) · confer: 专家或决策者交换意见商榷 (lawyers / doctors / leaders) · caucus: 党团派系举行内部闭门策略会 (delegates / members / party) · huddle: 紧凑聚拢进行即时战术密商 (team / executives / players)

groups.name: Converse & Speak Together · 交谈与对话 (Talk, Converse, Chat)
groups.tip: 双方或多人互动交流探讨

items.def_en: To say words in speech; to have a conversation or discuss a matter with someone.
items.ex_en: We need to talk about the budget constraints facing our department this quarter.
items.ex_zh: 我们需要谈一谈我们部门本季度面临的预算限制问题。

items.def_en: (+ to/with) To articulate sounds and words, or hold dialogue with another person
items.ex_en: She went backstage to speak with the keynote lecturer immediately after the seminar.
items.ex_zh: 研讨会结束后，她立即前往后台与主讲嘉宾交谈。

items.def_en: (+ with/to) To talk in a friendly, relaxed, and informal manner
items.ex_en: We sat on the front porch and chatted for hours over warm coffee.
items.ex_zh: 我们坐在前廊上，一边喝着热咖啡一边闲聊了好几个小时。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To speak authoritatively, formally, or at considerable length on a subject
items.ex_en: The visiting scholar discoursed at length upon seventeenth-century political philosophies in Europe.
items.ex_zh: 访问学者就十七世纪欧洲的政治哲学进行了深入长篇论述。

items.def_en: (+ with) To engage in formal or extended spoken conversation with someone
items.ex_en: She conversed pleasantly with foreign ambassadors throughout the entire formal state dinner.
items.ex_zh: 在整场正式国宴中，她与各国大使进行了愉快的交谈。

groups.summary_en: This broad frame covers oral linguistic communication between two or more individuals exchanging thoughts, remarks, or updates interactively.
groups.summary_zh: 指两人及以上之间面对面或远程进行的口头言语交流、交谈与探讨。
groups.desc_en: Denotes engaging in mutual, spoken verbal exchange between two or more participants, contrasting with unilateral monologue, speechmaking, or writing.
groups.desc_zh: 指双向或多向的口头言语互动与对话交谈，区别于单向独白、宣讲或文字笔谈。
groups.nuance_en: speak: use oral language or address someone with authority/formality (mind / truth / language) · talk: engage in common, interactive oral exchange (politics / shop / business) · converse: engage in serious, intellectual, or formal dialogue (scholars / guests / strangers) · chat: indulge in light, informal, and amicable small talk (friends / neighbor / online) · discourse: deliver lengthy, formal, reasoned verbal exploration (philosophy / theology / ethics)
groups.nuance_zh: speak: 具有语言能力或较为正式权威地发言 (mind / truth / language) · talk: 进行日常双向的言语沟通 (politics / shop / business) · converse: 进行严肃、知性或端庄的对话交谈 (scholars / guests / strangers) · chat: 轻松愉悦、无拘无束地闲聊 (friends / neighbor / online) · discourse: 作长篇大论的学术或逻辑性探讨 (philosophy / theology / ethics)

groups.name: Convert & React · 化学转化与反应 (Acidify, Oxidize, Polymerize)
groups.tip: 化学处理促成质变转化

items.def_en: To make or become acidic by treating with an acid or increasing hydrogen ion concentration
items.ex_en: Excess industrial runoff continues to acidify the surrounding lakes and delicate forest soils.
items.ex_zh: 过量的工业径流继续使周围的湖泊和脆弱的森林土壤酸化。
items.ex2_en: Fresh milk will acidify quickly if left outside the refrigerator during summer.
items.ex2_zh: 在夏天如果将新鲜牛奶放在冰箱外，它很快就会变酸。

items.def_en: (chemistry) To treat or combine a substance with nitric acid or introduce a nitro group into a chemical compound.
items.ex_en: Chemists nitrate aromatic hydrocarbons at low temperatures to produce specialized intermediate compounds.
items.ex_zh: 化学家在低温下对芳香烃进行硝化，以生产专门的中间体化合物。

items.def_en: To combine with oxygen or lose electrons during a chemical reaction
items.ex_en: Exposed iron fixtures will rapidly oxidize when left in damp and salty environments.
items.ex_zh: 暴露在外的铁制构件在潮湿含盐的环境中会迅速氧化。
items.ex2_en: Strong chemical reagents oxidize metal surfaces rapidly to form a protective film.
items.ex2_zh: 强化学试剂能迅速氧化金属表面以形成一层保护膜。

items.def_en: To treat or combine a substance or water supply with chlorine
items.ex_en: Municipal workers regularly chlorinate the reservoir to ensure tap water remains pathogen free.
items.ex_zh: 市政工人定期对水库进行氯化消毒，以确保自来水不含病原体。

items.def_en: To treat an organic compound with hydrogen to introduce hydrogen atoms into the molecule
items.ex_en: The food manufacturer hydrogenates vegetable oils to prolong shelf life in packaged snacks.
items.ex_zh: 食品制造商对植物油进行氢化处理，以延长包装零食的保质期。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this specialized chemical domain describe treating substances to alter their molecular composition, bind functional groups, or induce specific chemical transformations.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过添加试剂、引入特定基团以改变物质分子结构的化学处理过程。
groups.desc_en: Denotes deliberately subjecting chemical matter to specific reagent reactions that alter molecular structures, contrasting with general physical state change (e.g., melting).
groups.desc_zh: 指通过特定化学试剂反应改变物质的分子结构或化学性质，区别于熔化等纯物理相变。
groups.nuance_en: oxidize: cause to combine with oxygen or lose electrons (metal / fat / alcohol) · acidify: increase the acid concentration of a substance (ocean / soil / solution) · chlorinate: treat or combine with chlorine for purification or reaction (water / pool / solvent) · hydrogenate: treat unsaturated compounds with hydrogen to solidify or stabilize (oils / fats / compounds) · nitrate: introduce nitro groups into an organic compound (toluene / cellulose / benzene)
groups.nuance_zh: oxidize: 发生氧化作用或失去电子 (metal / fat / alcohol) · acidify: 使酸化、提升酸度 (ocean / soil / solution) · chlorinate: 用氯处理消毒或进行氯化反应 (water / pool / solvent) · hydrogenate: 催化加氢使油脂硬化或有机物饱和 (oils / fats / compounds) · nitrate: 硝化处理、引入硝基 (toluene / cellulose / benzene)

groups.name: Convey & Express · 表达与传达 (Express, Communicate, Impart, Put across)
groups.tip: 传递思想情感或意图

items.def_en: to show or tell what one feels or thinks using words, looks, or actions
items.ex_en: He found it difficult to express his sincere gratitude in spoken words alone.
items.ex_zh: 他觉得单凭口头言辞很难表达自己由衷的感激之情。

items.def_en: to successfully share or exchange information, opinions, or ideas with someone
items.ex_en: The manager failed to communicate the new project requirements clearly to the team.
items.ex_zh: 经理未能向团队清晰传达新项目的要求。

items.def_en: to explain an idea or message in a way that is clearly understood by others
items.ex_en: He used simple analogies to put across complex scientific concepts.
items.ex_zh: 他运用简单的打比方，将复杂的科学概念表达得清晰易懂。

items.def_en: 1. to express or communicate a thought, feeling, or idea so that it is understood by others. 2. (formal) to transport or carry someone or something from one place to another
items.ex_en: The author used vivid metaphors to convey the profound sorrow of wartime separation.
items.ex_zh: 作者用生动的比喻传达了战乱离别的深切悲痛。

items.def_en: to communicate information, knowledge, or a distinctive quality to someone or something
items.ex_en: The veteran master craftsman strove to impart his time-honored skills to young apprentices.
items.ex_zh: 这位经验丰富的老工匠努力将自己的传世技艺传授给年轻学徒。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify transmitting thoughts, meaning, emotional tone, or signals from one person to another across language, signs, or artistic media.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过语言、神态、媒介或作品将思想、感受、信息准确传递给受众。
groups.desc_en: Denotes transforming inner states, sentiments, or artistic intentions into externalized, perceptible manifestations, contrasting with factual data logging or signal routing.
groups.desc_zh: 指将内在的情感、心境或意图物化表露出来让外界领悟，区别于纯客观数据归档或信号布线。
groups.nuance_en: express: externalize feelings, thoughts, or artistic ideas explicitly (feelings / opinion / gratitude) · convey: carry across an impression, tone, or underlying sense (meaning / message / sympathy) · impart: transfer a quality, flavor, or intangible wisdom to a recipient (knowledge / wisdom / flavor) · communicate: successfully share feelings or thoughts to create understanding (vision / pain / ideas) · put across: successfully and persuasively explain an idea or personality (message / point / views)
groups.nuance_zh: express: 直截了当地抒发或表达心声 (feelings / opinion / gratitude) · convey: 传达出某种神韵、口信或意蕴 (meaning / message / sympathy) · impart: 赋予特质、风味或传授知识 (knowledge / wisdom / flavor) · communicate: 坦诚沟通使思想情感产生共鸣 (vision / pain / ideas) · put across: 巧妙而令人信服地讲透观点 (message / point / views)

groups.name: Convey & Transmit Info · 传达与沟通 (Communicate, Convey, Transmit)
groups.tip: 双方互通信息与思想

items.def_zh: 交流，沟通；传达，传递；传染
items.def_en: 1. To share or exchange information, ideas, or feelings. 2. To pass a message, emotion, or disease to another person.
items.ex_en: Nurses must communicate critical patient updates clearly during shift handovers each morning.
items.ex_zh: 每天早晨交接班时，护士必须清晰传达关键的病人最新情况。

items.def_zh: 播送，发送，传递（信号、信息）
items.def_en: To send or forward an electrical signal, message, or piece of data across a medium
items.ex_en: The satellite will transmit real-time meteorological observations directly to weather stations worldwide.
items.ex_zh: 该卫星将直接向全球气象站发送实时气象观测数据。

items.def_zh: 传达，表达（思想、情感、含义）
items.def_en: To communicate or make an idea, feeling, or impression known and comprehensible to someone
items.ex_en: The spokesperson conveyed the president's heartfelt condolences to families of the victims.
items.ex_zh: 发言人向遇难者家属转达了总统由衷的慰问。

items.def_en: To bestow, pass on, or disclose information, knowledge, or a specific quality to others
items.ex_en: The retired professor agreed to impart his rare bibliographic knowledge to the researchers.
items.ex_zh: 退休教授同意将他珍贵的目录学知识传授给研究人员。

items.def_en: (+ with) To establish and maintain mutual communication to ensure close operational cooperation
items.ex_en: Our logistics coordinator must liaise with international suppliers to prevent severe shipping delays.
items.ex_zh: 我们的物流协调员必须与国际供应商保持联络，以防止严重的货运延误。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to transmitting ideas, data, impressions, or emotional states across people or channels, ensuring understanding or connection.
groups.summary_zh: 指思想、消息、情感或信号在人际、媒介间的传达、传递与交互沟通。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the objective movement and systematic handoff of factual data, directives, or intelligence between parties, contrasting with emotive expression or artistic portrayal.
groups.desc_zh: 指在组织或主体间客观移交、传递事实数据、指令或情报，区别于主观情感抒发。
groups.nuance_en: transmit: electronically or systematically dispatch formal information (data / signals / orders) · communicate: transmit operational instructions or facts clearly (decision / policy / findings) · convey: act as a medium to deliver news, orders, or terms (greetings / instructions / regards) · impart: formally disclose confidential or vital information (secrets / facts / details) · liaise: serve as an active informational conduit between coordinating units (departments / police / agency)
groups.nuance_zh: transmit: 通过系统或电波传送数据或指令 (data / signals / orders) · communicate: 正式传达通报事实或决策 (decision / policy / findings) · convey: 充当介质中转转达消息或口信 (greetings / instructions / regards) · impart: 正式吐露机密或实质信息 (secrets / facts / details) · liaise: 在部门之间联络互通有无 (departments / police / agency)

groups.name: Convey & Transmit Signals · 传导与发信 (Transmit, Broadcast, Beam)
groups.tip: 中转信源并准确表达传达意图

items.def_en: To send out radio or television programs or signals over an area
items.ex_en: The television network will broadcast the presidential debates live across all nationwide channels.
items.ex_zh: 该电视网将在全国所有频道现场直播总统辩论。
items.ex2_en: The regional transmitter broadcasts continuously across all rural mountain valleys every day.
items.ex2_zh: 该区域发射台每天持续向所有偏远的山谷播发信号。

items.def_en: To transmit a radio signal or light beam in a specific direction
items.ex_en: The naval vessel beamed a powerful searchlight toward the unidentified approaching vessel.
items.ex_zh: 该海军舰艇向接近中的不明船只定向照射出一束强力探照灯光。

items.def_zh: 通过线路传输（音频/数据）
items.def_en: (+ to/into) To send signals, sound, or data through cables or direct connections
items.ex_en: Engineers piped the live audio feed directly into headphones in the control room.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们将实时音频信号直接通过线路传输至控制室的耳机中。

items.def_zh: 传递，转达；传导（光、热、声音等）；播送，发送（信号）；传染（疾病）
items.def_en: 1. To send out electronic signals, messages, or broadcasts. 2. To pass information, beliefs, or disease from one person or thing to another. 3. To allow heat, light, or sound to pass through.
items.ex_en: High-frequency transmitters transmit encoded radio signals across vast ocean expanses every day.
items.ex_zh: 高频发射机每天都在辽阔的大洋上发送加密无线电信号。

items.def_en: To send out rays of light, heat, or electromagnetic energy in all directions
items.ex_en: The cooling core began to radiate intense electromagnetic energy throughout the containment facility.
items.ex_zh: 冷却堆芯开始向整个安全壳设施内向外辐射出强烈的电磁能量。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe emission and propagation of electromagnetic signals, electronic data, light waves, or contagions through a medium or space.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过物理媒介或电磁波辐射发出信号、广播或散播病原。
groups.desc_en: Denotes radiating electro-magnetic waves, media signals, or energy outward across space or channels, contrasting with material transportation or wired physical flow.
groups.desc_zh: 指将电磁波、视听媒体信号或能量向空间或信道发射外传，区别于实物运输或有形管道物流。
groups.nuance_en: broadcast: scatter audio/video signals broadly to the public across airwaves (news / show / speech) · transmit: send focused signals or power through a medium (pulses / frequency / telemetry) · beam: direct a concentrated, line-of-sight electronic or light signal (satellite / signal / laser) · pipe: feed audio, video, or data continuously via dedicated cables/networks (footage / audio / feed) · radiate: emit electromagnetic energy or waves in all outward directions (heat / waves / energy)
groups.nuance_zh: broadcast: 向公众广泛无线电播发 (news / show / speech) · transmit: 通过特定介质发射定向电波或信号 (pulses / frequency / telemetry) · beam: 定向发射激光或微波卫星束 (satellite / signal / laser) · pipe: 通过专线/有线网络闭路引流信号 (footage / audio / feed) · radiate: 能量或波纹向四面八方辐射发散 (heat / waves / energy)

groups.name: Convince & Sway · 说服与使信服 (Convince, Sway, Assure)
groups.tip: 通过摆事实讲道理令人信服

items.def_en: 1. To persuade someone to do something. 2. To make someone believe that something is true.
items.ex_en: Her detailed presentation helped convince the skeptical investors to back the clean-energy initiative.
items.ex_zh: 她详尽的展示帮助说服了持怀疑态度的投资者支持这项清洁能源倡议。

items.def_en: Free someone from doubt by supplying adequate evidence or satisfying explanations
items.ex_en: Rigorous forensic testing finally satisfied the detectives regarding the suspect's complete innocence.
items.ex_zh: 严谨的法医检测终于使侦探们确信该嫌疑人完全清白。

items.def_en: Tell someone positively and confidently in order to dispel their lingering anxiety or doubt
items.ex_en: The lead engineer assured the board that structural integrity met all regulatory standards.
items.ex_zh: 主任工程师向董事会保证，结构完整性符合所有的监管标准。

items.def_en: Persuade someone who initially opposed you to support or agree with you
items.ex_en: His witty presentation helped win over even the most skeptical investors.
items.ex_zh: 他机智风趣的演说赢得了哪怕是最持怀疑态度的投资者的支持。

items.def_en: Influence someone's mind or opinion so that they change their allegiance or judgment
items.ex_en: Emotional testimony from key witnesses can significantly sway the jury's final verdict.
items.ex_zh: 关键证人情绪化的证词可能会显著动摇陪审团的最终判决。
items.ex2_en: Tall pine trees sway gently in the refreshing evening mountain breeze today.
items.ex2_zh: 高大的松树今天在清新宜人的傍晚山风中轻轻摇曳。

groups.summary_en: This frame highlights bringing someone into a state of firm intellectual or emotional belief, overcoming their doubts, skepticism, or reluctance through sound arguments or conclusive evidence.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重消除疑虑，以论据或事实使人在思想认知上完全信服。
groups.desc_en: Denotes overcoming skepticism, doubts, or contrary positions to bring someone to assent or full confidence, contrasting with compelling by brute force or issuing orders.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过论理、抚慰或魅力消解对方疑虑、使其转为信服，区别于强权逼迫或行政命令。
groups.nuance_en: convince: overcome disbelief with proof or argument until accepted as true (jury / skeptics / public) · assure: dispel personal anxiety or doubt by declaring firmly (allies / investors / clients) · sway: induce hesitation or shift an opinion by rhetoric or emotion (voters / jury / crowd) · win over: gradually overcome resistance through charm or patient persuasion (critics / audience / opposition) · satisfy: answer all objections or evidential standards fully (inquirers / demands / curiosity)
groups.nuance_zh: convince: 以确凿论据使人确信无疑 (jury / skeptics / public) · assure: 郑重表态以打消对方疑虑焦躁 (allies / investors / clients) · sway: 靠情感修辞左右摇摆受众立场 (voters / jury / crowd) · win over: 靠耐心魅力争取到反对者的支持 (critics / audience / opposition) · satisfy: 解答所有疑虑使之感到无懈可击 (inquirers / demands / curiosity)

groups.name: Convoy & Shield · 护航与编队保护 (Convoy, Flank, Screen)
groups.tip: 结队伴随保护安全通行

items.def_en: Protect or shield a main body of troops, warships, or transports by forming an outer defensive line
items.ex_en: Destroyers deployed in a wide perimeter to screen the aircraft carrier from submarines.
items.ex_zh: 驱逐舰在外围大范围展开，以掩护航空母舰免受潜艇袭击。

items.def_en: Protect someone or something from danger, harm, attack, or exposure by placing oneself in between
items.ex_en: The security officers shielded the diplomat from the angry crowd outside the embassy.
items.ex_zh: 安保人员在大使馆外保护外交官免遭愤怒人群的伤害。

items.def_zh: 领航护送；集中护送指引
items.def_en: Guide or direct a group of people, ships, or vehicles carefully and protectively
items.ex_en: Volunteers carefully shepherded the disoriented refugees away from the flooded border crossing.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者们细心地引导护送迷茫的难民远离被洪水淹没的边境通道。

items.def_en: Be positioned or move along the sides of someone or something, often for protection or support
items.ex_en: Armed bodyguards flanked the prime minister as she walked swiftly through the lobby.
items.ex_zh: 当首相快步穿过大厅时，武装保镖在两侧护卫。

items.def_en: 1. To travel with and protect a group of ships, vehicles, or travelers on a journey.
items.ex_en: Warships were assigned to convoy merchant vessels traversing the dangerous, pirate-infested waters.
items.ex_zh: 军舰受命为穿越海盗横行之危险水域的商船进行护航。

groups.summary_en: Involves accompanying multiple vessels, vehicles, or transport groups with armed or specialized protection to repel hostile attacks or hazards along a dangerous transit.
groups.summary_zh: 专指为车队、船队或要员编队护航、警戒并阻挡侧翼威胁。
groups.desc_en: Denotes deploying protective escorts or defensive screens around a vulnerable moving asset, contrasting with passive hiding or lone front-line attacking.
groups.desc_zh: 指在移动或易损资产周围部署护卫队列或阻隔屏障实施掩护，区别于被动隐匿或孤胆冲锋。
groups.nuance_en: convoy: escort ships or transport vehicles together for mutual defense (merchantmen / fleet / supplies) · shield: place oneself or an object between a danger and the target (body / children / ally) · screen: position light forces ahead or around to conceal main forces and absorb skirmishes (fleet / armor / flank) · shepherd: closely guide and protect a vulnerable group along a route (evacuees / refugees / flock) · flank: station protective units along the sides of an advance (troops / column / formation)
groups.nuance_zh: convoy: 组织编队并护送车船物资 (merchantmen / fleet / supplies) · shield: 挺身遮挡阻挡正面冲击 (body / children / ally) · screen: 派出警戒轻骑或烟幕掩护主力 (fleet / armor / flank) · shepherd: 像牧羊般沿途小心翼翼护送引导 (evacuees / refugees / flock) · flank: 在侧翼布防以护卫中军行进 (troops / column / formation)

groups.name: Cool Down & Chill · 冷却与降温 (Cool, Chill, Refrigerate)
groups.tip: 通过降温使其变凉

items.def_en: To become cooler in temperature, or to calm down after anger or excitement
items.ex_en: Give him a few minutes to cool down before discussing the issue.
items.ex_zh: 在讨论这个问题之前，先给他几分钟冷静一下。
items.ex2_en: A cold drink will cool down the exhausted marathon runners after finishing.
items.ex2_zh: 一杯冷饮会让跑完马拉松后筋疲力竭的跑者们冷静降温。

items.def_zh: （使）冷却，（使）降温；（使）冷静，（使）平息
items.def_en: 1. To become or make something lower in temperature. 2. To become or make someone calmer, less enthusiastic, or less angry.
items.ex_en: Let the freshly baked bread cool on a wire rack before slicing it.
items.ex_zh: 在切片之前，先让刚烤好的面包在烤网上冷却一下。
items.ex2_en: The refreshing autumn breeze will cool the heated city streets by nightfall.
items.ex2_zh: 清爽的秋风将在傍晚时分使炎热的城市街道凉爽下来。

items.def_en: To make something cold or cooler without freezing it, or to become cold
items.ex_en: Let the white wine chill in the ice bucket for twenty minutes before serving.
items.ex_zh: 上酒前把白葡萄酒放在冰桶里冰镇二十分钟。
items.ex2_en: Cold winter temperatures chill the shallow surface water of the mountain lake.
items.ex2_zh: 寒冷的冬日气温使高山湖泊的表层浅水变得冰冷刺骨。

items.def_en: To keep food, drink, or medicine cold in a refrigerator to preserve it
items.ex_en: You should refrigerate the opened vaccine vials immediately to maintain their potency.
items.ex_zh: 你应该立即冷藏已开封的疫苗药瓶以保持其药效。

items.def_zh: 淬火；迅速冷却（灼热物体）
items.def_en: To cool hot metal or material rapidly by plunging it into liquid
items.ex_en: The blacksmith used tongs to quench the glowing steel blade in cold oil.
items.ex_zh: 铁匠用铁钳将灼热的钢刀片浸入冷油中淬火。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe lowering the physical temperature of an object or substance, or metaphorically calming down heightened emotion or activity. They range from natural thermal dissipation to artificial refrigeration.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体温度下降或使之变凉，亦引申指情绪或局势平息降温。
groups.desc_en: Denotes lowering thermal energy or temperature through ambient dissipation, active refrigeration, or rapid immersion, contrasting with heating or mere steady insulation.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过环境散温、人工制冷或急冷介质降低物体热量，区别于升温加热或静置保温。
groups.nuance_en: cool: lower temperature naturally or moderately (food / air / engine) · cool down: gradually lose heat or return to ambient equilibrium (temples / reactor / temper) · chill: make decisively cold, often for food preservation or refreshment (wine / dough / drinks) · refrigerate: preserve perishable goods inside an artificially chilled chamber (meat / samples / medicine) · quench: rapidly cool extremely hot metals in liquid to temper them (steel / blade / hot iron)
groups.nuance_zh: cool: 自然或适度降低温度 (food / air / engine) · cool down: 逐渐退温冷却回归平稳 (temples / reactor / temper) · chill: 冰镇降至冷凉口感或加工状态 (wine / dough / drinks) · refrigerate: 冷藏保鲜易腐物品 (meat / samples / medicine) · quench: 将灼热金属在液体中骤冷淬火 (steel / blade / hot iron)

groups.name: Coordinate & Harmonize · 协调与调控 (Synchronize, Liaise, Orchestrate)
groups.tip: 协调各方以促进合作

items.def_en: 1. To organize different people, groups, or activities so that they work together efficiently and effectively.
items.ex_en: The project director must coordinate the efforts of various international research teams.
items.ex_zh: 项目主管必须协调各国际研究团队的工作。
items.ex2_en: The steering systems coordinate well during high-speed emergency maneuvers on slick roads.
items.ex2_zh: 在湿滑路面上进行高速紧急机动时，转向系统协调良好。

items.def_en: (+ with) To fit together or harmonize smoothly like interlocking gear wheels
items.ex_en: Her innovative teaching methods mesh perfectly with the school's progressive educational philosophy.
items.ex_zh: 她创新的教学方法与该校先进的教育理念完美契合。

items.def_en: To plan and organize a complicated campaign or event smoothly and strategically
items.ex_en: The campaign manager worked tirelessly to orchestrate a nationwide media blitz before election day.
items.ex_zh: 竞选经理不知疲倦地工作，在选举日前精心策划了一场全国性的媒体宣传攻势。

items.def_en: To cause distinct actions, events, or mechanisms to occur at the same time or rate
items.ex_en: The software is designed to synchronize data across all your connected devices seamlessly.
items.ex_zh: 该软件旨在无缝同步您所有关联设备之间的数据。
items.ex2_en: The clock mechanisms synchronize automatically whenever connected to the secure central network.
items.ex2_zh: 只要连接到安全的中央网络，时钟机制就会自动同步。

items.def_en: (+ with/between) To act as a bridge between groups to exchange information and align efforts
items.ex_en: Our representative will liaise with local authorities to ensure full legal compliance.
items.ex_zh: 我们的代表将与地方当局保持联络，以确保完全符合法律规定。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on bringing separate actors, operational processes, or schedules into alignment so they function smoothly as a unified whole. It ranges from basic inter-departmental communication to complex tactical synchronization.
groups.summary_zh: 指调解、沟通各方行动与资源，使其协调一致、顺畅运转。
groups.desc_en: Denotes organizing distinct operations, agencies, or mechanical elements to function in synchronous harmony, contrasting with unilateral action or anarchic chaos.
groups.desc_zh: 指调配使不同作业、部门或构件精密同步以谐调运作，区别于单打独斗或杂乱无章。
groups.nuance_en: coordinate: bring various elements or teams into effective, unified action (efforts / response / relief) · synchronize: align actions, clocks, or data to happen at the exact same instant (clocks / watches / attacks) · orchestrate: masterfully and elaborately engineer a complex, multi-party operation (campaign / conspiracy / release) · mesh: interlock two or more systems or schedules smoothly like gears (schedules / gears / strategies) · liaise: maintain communicative harmony and cooperation between external groups (departments / officials / partners)
groups.nuance_zh: coordinate: 组织调配各方形成协同行动 (efforts / response / relief) · synchronize: 使时间步调或数据毫秒级精准对齐 (clocks / watches / attacks) · orchestrate: 幕后操盘筹划复杂的重大行动 (campaign / conspiracy / release) · mesh: 像齿轮般严密嵌合与互融 (schedules / gears / strategies) · liaise: 充当联络人沟通使各方协调 (departments / officials / partners)

groups.name: Cork & Suppress · 堵塞与压抑 (Plug, Bung, Bottle up)
groups.tip: 塞紧开口防止漏出

items.def_zh: 用软木塞封（瓶等）；抑制，克制（感情等）
items.def_en: 1. To close or seal a bottle tightly with a cork. 2. (cork up) To suppress or hold back strong feelings or emotions.
items.ex_en: After sampling the vintage wine, the vintner corked the bottle securely again.
items.ex_zh: 品尝过这款陈年佳酿后，酿酒师再次用软木塞将瓶子封紧。

items.def_en: To block or close an opening completely by pressing something firmly into it
items.ex_en: He quickly used some wet mud to plug up the leak in the pipe.
items.ex_zh: 他赶紧用些湿泥把管子上的漏口堵死了。

items.def_en: To close or seal a receptacle, cask, or opening tightly using a large stopper
items.ex_en: The cellar worker carefully bunged the oak cask to keep the ale fresh.
items.ex_zh: 酒窖工人小心地用大塞子塞紧橡木桶，以保持麦芽酒的新鲜。

items.def_zh: 隐忍不发，强行抑制（情绪）
items.def_en: To refuse to express feelings such as anger, sorrow, or anxiety, keeping them tightly repressed inside
items.ex_en: It is unhealthy to bottle up your grief instead of seeking help from friends.
items.ex_zh: 强行压抑内心的悲痛而不向朋友寻求帮助，对身心并无益处。

items.def_zh: 强行咽下，忍住（泪水或言语）
items.def_en: To struggle hard to stop oneself from showing strong emotion, speaking, or weeping
items.ex_en: She fought hard to choke back her tears during the solemn memorial service.
items.ex_zh: 在庄严的追悼会上，她拼命咽下夺眶而出的泪水。

groups.summary_en: This frame describes physically inserting a stopper or plug into an aperture to close it, extended metaphorically to containing or suppressing pent-up emotions.
groups.summary_zh: 指塞住孔道瓶口进行封口，亦引申指压抑抑制情绪或言语。
groups.desc_en: Applies a physical or psychological stopper to contain an internal pressure or surging emotion, contrasting with mere 'hiding' by emphasizing the risk of containment failure.
groups.desc_zh: 通过实体塞子或心理强压封堵外涌的情感或压力，与单纯的“隐藏”不同，强调蓄力封堵与潜在的爆发风险。
groups.nuance_en: cork: abruptly seal off an outburst (emotions / temper) · plug up: obstruct an opening to halt outward flow (leak / gap / hole) · bung: crudely or casually jam a stopper in (barrel / cask) · bottle up: internally repress feelings over time until explosive (anger / grief / resentment) · choke back: struggle physically to swallow down vocalized distress (tears / sobs / rage)
groups.nuance_zh: cork: 骤然封堵外露的冲动 (emotions / temper) · plug up: 填塞孔隙以阻止外泄 (leak / gap / hole) · bung: 粗暴或随手用塞子堵住 (barrel / cask) · bottle up: 长期向内压抑情绪至临界点 (anger / grief / resentment) · choke back: 极力哽咽压制即将发作的情绪 (tears / sobs / rage)

groups.name: Correct & Disabuse · 破除迷思与启蒙辟谣 (Disillusion, Undeceive, Set Straight)
groups.tip: 指出真相消除对方错误观念

items.def_zh: 纠正…的错误看法；跟…讲明真相
items.def_en: To correct someone's misunderstanding or mistaken impression by telling them the truth
items.ex_en: I had to set him straight about what actually happened at the meeting.
items.ex_zh: 我不得不向他讲明会议上实际发生的真相以纠正他的误解。

items.def_zh: 使不受蒙蔽；为…澄清真相
items.def_en: To tell someone the truth and free them from an erroneous deception or assumption
items.ex_en: No one dared undeceive the proud monarch about his military's disastrous defeat.
items.ex_zh: 没人敢向骄傲的君王道出军队惨败的真相以破除其执念。

items.def_en: To make a difficult or mysterious subject clear, accessible, and free of misconception
items.ex_en: The professor aimed to demystify quantum physics for his undergraduate students.
items.ex_zh: 教授旨在为本科生揭开量子物理学的神秘面纱。

items.def_zh: 使省悟，消除……的错误观念
items.def_en: 1. ('disabuse someone of') (formal) To persuade someone that a belief or idea they hold is false or mistaken.
items.ex_en: The lawyer quickly disabused her client of the notion that the trial would be easy.
items.ex_zh: 律师迅速打消了当事人认为审判会很轻松的错误念头。

items.def_en: To free someone from an illusion or naive ideal, often causing disappointment
items.ex_en: Working closely with politicians soon disillusioned the idealistic young activist.
items.ex_zh: 与政客们密切共事很快让那位理想主义的年轻活动家幻想破灭。

groups.summary_en: This frame denotes liberating someone from a false belief, cherished misconception, or persistent illusion through targeted factual correction or candid disclosure.
groups.summary_zh: 指点迷津，破除他人的错误认识、幻觉或成见以澄清事实真相。
groups.desc_en: Relieves someone of a persistent misconception, falsehood, or idealized delusion, differing from mere 'teaching' by requiring the dismantling of a preexisting error.
groups.desc_zh: 使人摆脱根深蒂固的误解、迷思或不切实际的幻想，与普通的“讲授”不同，侧重于先破除已有的错误认知。
groups.nuance_en: set straight: correct factual errors directly to restore accuracy (record / facts / friend) · undeceive: awaken someone who has been actively tricked or misled (victim / public) · demystify: strip away obscurantism to make a complex topic accessible (process / science / jargon) · disabuse: free someone firmly from an unfounded belief (notion / mind / illusion) · disillusion: shatter cherished romanticized ideals through painful reality (admirer / youth / idealist)
groups.nuance_zh: set straight: 直接纠正事实错误以正视听 (record / facts / friend) · undeceive: 使受蒙骗者认清骗局 (victim / public) · demystify: 破除神秘化使复杂事物通俗易懂 (process / science / jargon) · disabuse: 坚决打消某人的错误念头 (notion / mind / illusion) · disillusion: 用残酷现实击碎美好幻想 (admirer / youth / idealist)

groups.name: Correct & Rectify · 纠正与纠偏 (Amend, Remedy, Put Right)
groups.tip: 改正偏颇错漏，回归正轨与标准

items.def_en: To restore something to its proper upright position, order, or state of correctness
items.ex_en: The crew worked together to right the capsized sailboat after the sudden squall passed.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的阵风过后，船员们协力扶正了倾覆的帆船。
items.ex2_en: The unstable sailing vessel righted itself after the sudden giant wave passed.
items.ex2_zh: 在突然袭来的巨浪过去之后，不稳的帆船自行恢复了正立。

items.def_en: To make something right, accurate, or standard by removing errors or defects
items.ex_en: The copy editor had to correct several glaring factual errors in the draft.
items.ex_zh: 文字编辑不得不纠正草稿中几处明显的采写事实错误。

items.def_en: To fix a mistake, breakdown, or problem so that normal function is restored
items.ex_en: The technician was summoned promptly to put right the faulty communication system.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员被迅速召来解决有故障的通信系统，使其恢复正常。

items.def_en: To alter a document, text, or statement slightly in order to correct or improve it
items.ex_en: The parliamentary committee voted unanimously to amend the outdated environmental legislation.
items.ex_zh: 议会委员会一致投票赞成修改这部过时的环境法规。

items.def_en: 1. (formal) To correct a mistake, fault, or unfair situation.
items.ex_en: The management promised to rectify the payroll discrepancy before the next pay cycle.
items.ex_zh: 管理层承诺在下一个薪资发放周期前纠正工资单上的差错。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to bringing an error, flaw, calculation mistake, or physical alignment back to a proper, accurate, or standard state through deliberate operational adjustments.
groups.summary_zh: 通过操作性调整纠正错误、改正偏差或使之恢复准确标准状态。
groups.desc_en: Restores a flawed, deviant, or unjust state to standard, proper, or equitable functioning, unlike mere 'modification' which lacks an inherent normative goal.
groups.desc_zh: 使处于错误、偏离或不公状态的事物恢复正常、合规或公正，不同于无明确规范导向的普通“修改”。
groups.nuance_en: correct: eliminate an error or mark it against an objective rule (mistake / posture / test) · rectify: fundamentally put right an institutional error or imbalance (injustice / imbalance / situation) · amend: officially alter text or behavior to improve quality (constitution / law / conduct) · remedy: cure or provide a practical fix for a deficiency (deficiency / shortfall / grievance) · put right: informally restore order or repair damage (mess / wrong / record)
groups.nuance_zh: correct: 对照客观标准改错 (mistake / posture / test) · rectify: 从根本上纠正机制性偏差或不公 (injustice / imbalance / situation) · amend: 通过法定或正式程序修正改良 (constitution / law / conduct) · remedy: 补救缺陷或医治弊端 (deficiency / shortfall / grievance) · put right: 口语化地纠偏整饬或平反 (mess / wrong / record)

groups.name: Correlate & Relate · 关联与相关 (Connect, Link, Tie in)
groups.tip: 理清事物间的对应相关性

items.def_en: Make, suggest, or demonstrate a causal or thematic connection between two things
items.ex_en: Recent medical studies clearly link chronic lack of sleep to cardiovascular diseases.
items.ex_zh: 近期的医学研究明确表明长期缺乏睡眠与心血管疾病存在关联。

items.def_en: Connect someone or something in one's mind with another concept or condition
items.ex_en: Most people naturally associate the smell of lavender with relaxation and peaceful sleep.
items.ex_zh: 大多数人自然而然地会将薰衣草的香味与放松和安眠联系在一起。

items.def_en: Join or see two ideas, events, or facts as having a direct relationship
items.ex_en: The detectives found new evidence that connects the prime suspect directly to the robbery.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们发现了将主要嫌疑人与抢劫案直接联系起来的新证据。
items.ex2_en: The old highway connects directly with the new beltway around the city.
items.ex2_zh: 这条老旧的高速公路直接与环绕城市的新环线连接在一起。

items.def_zh: 使结合，与……保持一致/紧密联系
items.def_en: (+ with) Align closely, match, or link smoothly with another fact, plan, or piece of information
items.ex_en: The proposed product launch will tie in smoothly with our nationwide autumn marketing campaign.
items.ex_zh: 拟议的产品发布将与我们秋季全国营销活动紧密结合。

items.def_en: To have a mutual relationship or connection, or to show that two things are related to each other.
items.ex_en: Statistical data clearly correlate high levels of physical activity with improved mental well-being.
items.ex_zh: 统计数据清楚表明，高度的体育活动与改善的心理健康显著相关。
items.ex2_en: Household income levels correlate strongly with educational attainment in recent sociological studies.
items.ex2_zh: 在近期的社会学研究中，家庭收入水平与受教育程度高度相关。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote establishing, demonstrating, or possessing a systematic statistical, cognitive, or causal relationship between two or more variables, observations, or facts.
groups.summary_zh: 表示变量、现象或认知概念之间存在逻辑或统计上的相互关联。
groups.desc_en: Establishes a systematic, statistical, or conceptual correspondence between two or more variables, moving beyond simple 'juxtaposition' into mutual implication.
groups.desc_zh: 在两个或多个变量之间建立系统性、统计性或概念上的对应关联，超越了简单的“并置”，强调相互依存或呼应。
groups.nuance_en: correlate: demonstrate systematic mutual or statistical co-variance (data / variables / findings) · link: connect directly as cause, consequence, or chain (smoking to cancer / suspect to crime) · associate: form a mental connection or habitual pairing (risk with investment / smell with memory) · connect: join logically or physically into an overarching network (dots / clues / ideas) · tie in: harmonize consistently with an existing narrative or campaign (strategy / promotion / story)
groups.nuance_zh: correlate: 统计学或逻辑上紧密协变互联 (data / variables / findings) · link: 建立因果、证据或链条连接 (smoking to cancer / suspect to crime) · associate: 心理联想或概念绑定 (risk with investment / smell with memory) · connect: 逻辑串联或网络化接合 (dots / clues / ideas) · tie in: 与既有叙事或活动保持一致呼应 (strategy / promotion / story)

groups.name: Counteract & Balance · 抵消与中和 (Counteract, Counterbalance, Offset)
groups.tip: 力量正负相抵，化解原有作用

items.def_en: To balance one influence or cost against an opposing one so an equilibrium is kept.
items.ex_en: The company increased overseas sales to offset declining demand in the domestic market.
items.ex_zh: 该公司增加了海外销售额，以抵消国内市场需求的下降。

items.def_en: To lessen the impact of a shock or maintain chemical stability against abrupt changes.
items.ex_en: Substantial financial reserves will buffer the small enterprise against sudden economic shocks.
items.ex_zh: 充裕的财务储备将缓冲突发经济冲击对这家小企业的负面影响。

items.def_en: To act in opposition to something in order to reduce or eliminate its negative effect.
items.ex_en: The physician prescribed a specific medication to counteract the adverse side effects.
items.ex_zh: 医生开了一种特效药，以对抗并抵消不良副作用。

items.def_en: To balance or neutralize the weight or impact of something by exerting equal opposite force.
items.ex_en: The crane uses massive concrete blocks to counterbalance the weight of heavy cargo.
items.ex_zh: 起重机使用巨大的混凝土块来平衡沉重货物的重量。

items.def_zh: 抵消，使中和；使失效，解除威胁
items.def_en: 1. (British English) To stop something from having any effect or causing damage; to counteract or neutralize.
items.ex_en: The hazardous materials team deployed alkaline powder to neutralise the spilled acid safely.
items.ex_zh: 危险品处置小组施放碱性粉末，以安全中和泄漏的酸液。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate chemical or functional interaction where opposing forces, properties, or compounds act upon each other so that the net harmful or potent effect is cancelled out.
groups.summary_zh: 通过施加相反特性或力量以中和毒性、酸碱或不良效应。
groups.desc_en: Mitigates or neutralizes the disruptive effect of an opposing force by providing a compensatory weight, unlike mere 'resistance' which simply blocks motion.
groups.desc_zh: 通过施加对等的补偿力量来削弱或抵消相反作用力的破坏性影响，区别于单纯阻碍运动的“抵抗”。
groups.nuance_en: counteract: act against an adverse agent to stop its harmful progress (poison / trend / inflation) · counterbalance: supply an equivalent opposing physical or systemic weight (risk / deficit / power) · offset: make up for a loss or expenditure through equal gain elsewhere (costs / carbon / losses) · neutralise: render a threat chemically, militarily, or politically inert (threat / acid / effect) · buffer: soften the shock of an incoming blow (impact / volatility / blow)
groups.nuance_zh: counteract: 积极反作用以化解有害进程 (poison / trend / inflation) · counterbalance: 在天平另一端施加对等力量以维持均衡 (risk / deficit / power) · offset: 用另维度的收益弥补既有亏损 (costs / carbon / losses) · neutralise: 使威胁丧失活性或归零 (threat / acid / effect) · buffer: 充当缓冲垫减缓冲击烈度 (impact / volatility / blow)

groups.name: Counteract & Offset · 抗衡与抵消 (Counteract, Offset, Counterbalance)
groups.tip: 施加反向力量以求制衡抵消

items.def_en: To have an equal but opposite effect to something so that the final result is zero
items.ex_en: The extra revenue from new sales was canceled out by rising operational costs.
items.ex_zh: 新销售带来的额外收益被不断上升的运营成本抵消了。
items.ex2_en: Their opposing political votes will cancel out during the final committee ballot count.
items.ex2_zh: 在委员会最终计票时，他们相反的政治选票将相互抵消。

items.def_en: To balance the effect of something with an equal, opposite quality or amount
items.ex_en: Extra government subsidies helped to offset the steep rise in manufacturing costs.
items.ex_zh: 额外的政府补贴有助于抵消制造成本的大幅上涨。

items.def_en: To act against something in order to reduce its force or neutralize its bad effects
items.ex_en: Drinking plenty of fluids helps counteract the dehydrating effects of intense summer heat.
items.ex_zh: 多喝水有助于抵消盛夏酷暑引起的脱水效应。

items.def_en: To act with equal power or importance against something else so neither dominates
items.ex_en: The new trade agreement will counterbalance the influence of rival regional economic blocs.
items.ex_zh: 新的贸易协议将抗衡竞争对手所在区域经济集团的影响力。
