items.def_en: 1. (formal) To act against an opposing force or influence with equal strength so as to offset or counterbalance its effect.
items.ex_en: Strong democratic institutions are essential to countervail the arbitrary exercise of executive power.
items.ex_zh: 强有力的民主制度对于制衡行政权力的任意行使至关重要。

groups.summary_en: Highlights exerting an opposing force, influence, or positive weight against another to neutralize or equalize its effect.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过施加反向作用力或同等权重来中和、平衡或抵消负面影响。
groups.desc_en: Pits one structural force, obligation, or effect against another to nullify impact and reach equilibrium, contrasting with 'annihilation' by keeping both weights in dynamic tension.
groups.desc_zh: 使一种结构性力量、义务或效用与另一方正面对冲以抵消影响，不同于彻底的“毁灭”，二者在张力中维持平衡。
groups.nuance_en: offset: systematically compensate for a deficit with a corresponding asset (carbon emissions / tax / costs) · counteract: directly oppose an unfolding force to arrest its traction (influence / effects / measures) · counterbalance: maintain structural symmetry between opposing powers (hegemony / weight / forces) · cancel out: mutually destroy net effects, yielding a zero outcome (gains / advantages / debts) · countervail: wield substantial institutional force to defeat an opposite pressure (pressure / monopoly / influence)
groups.nuance_zh: offset: 结构性用对等资产冲抵支出或缺陷 (carbon emissions / tax / costs) · counteract: 针锋相对化解不利动能 (influence / effects / measures) · counterbalance: 维持对立体系间的均势平衡 (hegemony / weight / forces) · cancel out: 效果正负抵消归零 (gains / advantages / debts) · countervail: 借助相当的对抗力量挫败对方干预 (pressure / monopoly / influence)

groups.name: Court & Solicit Favor · 拉拢与讨好 (Woo, Court, Solicit)
groups.tip: 主动示好以争取支持或选票

items.def_zh: 讨好，争取……的支持；献殷勤
items.def_en: To deliberately seek the favor, approval, or cooperation of someone, especially in public or political life
items.ex_en: The ambitious young diplomat sought to court the influential patron at the banquet.
items.ex_zh: 那位雄心勃勃的年轻外交官在宴会上极力讨好有势力的赞助人。

items.def_zh: 恳请，索求（选票、赞助、支持）
items.def_en: To formally ask for or try to obtain something from someone, such as votes, money, or help
items.ex_en: The charity organization sent representatives to solicit donations from prominent local businesses.
items.ex_zh: 该慈善机构派出代表向当地知名企业恳请募捐。

items.def_en: To gently and persistently persuade someone to do something through patience and flattery
items.ex_en: The mother managed to coax her reluctant child into eating the cooked vegetables.
items.ex_zh: 母亲耐心地哄劝不情愿的孩子吃下了煮熟的蔬菜。

items.def_en: (+ with) To ingratiate oneself with an influential figure through flattery or servile behavior
items.ex_en: The junior clerk shamelessly sought to curry favor with the demanding department head.
items.ex_zh: 那名初级文员无耻地试图讨好要求苛刻的部门主管。

items.def_zh: 争取……的支持，拉拢；求爱，追求
items.def_en: 1. To try to gain the support, votes, or custom of someone. 2. (literary or old-fashioned) To try to persuade someone to marry or enter into a relationship.
items.ex_en: Both presidential candidates traveled extensively to woo undecided voters in key swing states.
items.ex_zh: 两位总统候选人都广泛巡回以拉拢关键摇摆州中犹豫不决的选民。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures intentional, flattering, or persistent actions designed to win over someone's political support, business partnership, or affection.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动示好、游说或迎合以争取选民、客户或关键人物支持与青睐。
groups.desc_en: Applies flattery, strategic attention, or persuasion to win favor, alignment, or romance, differing from plain 'asking' by its calculated, seductive persistence.
groups.desc_zh: 运用奉承、示好或策略性关注以博取青睐、结盟或芳心，区别于简单的“索求”，强调心机与持续诱导。
groups.nuance_en: court: systematically woo or run the risk of inviting something through flattery (investors / voters / disaster) · woo: passionately and persistently pursue support or affection (allies / electorate / partner) · solicit: formally or earnestly request support or contributions (donations / votes / opinions) · curry favor: subserviently ingratiate oneself to gain advantage (boss / authority / patrons) · coax: gently and patiently wheedle compliance (child / cooperation / consent)
groups.nuance_zh: court: 刻意招揽、巴结，或招致不良后果 (investors / voters / disaster) · woo: 热情而执着地争取倾心或支持 (allies / electorate / partner) · solicit: 郑重或正式地恳求、招揽 (donations / votes / opinions) · curry favor: 低三下四地拍马屁以求好感 (boss / authority / patrons) · coax: 耐心诱导、哄劝以达成顺从 (child / cooperation / consent)

groups.name: Covenant & Contract · 承诺与立约 (Covenant, Contract, Stipulate)
groups.tip: 契约或誓约情境下的庄严承诺

items.def_zh: 立约订立合同，以协议承诺
items.def_en: To enter into a formal, legally enforceable mutual agreement to perform specified duties
items.ex_en: The software firm will contract with independent developers to build the mobile application.
items.ex_zh: 该软件公司将与独立开发者订立合同来构建移动应用程序。
items.ex2_en: Cold winter weather will contract metal rails along the rural train track.
items.ex2_zh: 寒冷的冬日天气会使乡村铁轨上的金属轨道发生收缩。

items.def_en: To form an explicit treaty, alliance, or formal agreement between parties
items.ex_en: The warring factions met privately to pact a formal end to the hostility.
items.ex_zh: 交战各派举行闭门会晤，立约正式结束敌对状态。

items.def_zh: 缔结（契约/条约），签署参与
items.def_en: To formally bind oneself by signing or engaging in a legal contract, agreement, or alliance
items.ex_en: The two neighboring countries decided to enter into a comprehensive bilateral trade partnership.
items.ex_zh: 这两个邻国决定缔结一项全面的双边贸易伙伴关系。

items.def_en: To enter into a solemn, formal, and legally binding agreement or contract.
items.ex_en: The founders covenants solemnly to preserve the historical integrity of the sacred site.
items.ex_zh: 创立者们郑重立约，承诺保护该圣地的历史完整性。

items.def_zh: 在协议中明文规定，约定
items.def_en: To lay down or demand a specific condition as an essential requirement in an agreement
items.ex_en: The rental agreement stipulates that tenants must pay their monthly rent on time.
items.ex_zh: 租赁协议明文规定租户必须按时足额支付每月租金。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this legal and institutional frame denote establishing formal, legally enforceable pacts, charters, or solemn bilateral covenants.
groups.summary_zh: 订立正式契约、公约或具有法律约束力的双边协议。
groups.desc_en: Binds parties to a solemn, legal, or sacred promise with defined stipulations, contrasting with informal 'promising' by its enforceable, formalized gravity.
groups.desc_zh: 通过具有约束力、法律或宗教神圣性的契约明确双方责任，区别于口头随意的“许诺”，具有强制力与庄严性。
groups.nuance_en: covenant: enter a solemn, often moral, religious, or archaic binding pledge (God / community / partners) · contract: undertake a legally binding, commercial agreement (builder / services / employment) · stipulate: specifically lay down terms as an essential condition (terms / condition / requirements) · enter into: formally commence participation in an official compact (agreement / partnership / negotiations) · pact: form an explicit reciprocal treaty or compact (countries / allies / rivals)
groups.nuance_zh: covenant: 缔结庄严神圣或带有道义约束的契约 (God / community / partners) · contract: 签订具法律效力的商业或用工合同 (builder / services / employment) · stipulate: 在条款中明文硬性规定 (terms / condition / requirements) · enter into: 正式签署或涉足协议框架 (agreement / partnership / negotiations) · pact: 建立明文互惠的同盟协定 (countries / allies / rivals)

groups.name: Cover with Blood · 染血与血渍 (Gore, Bloody, Besmear)
groups.tip: 染上污渍破坏洁净

items.def_zh: 玷污，使留下血印或污迹
items.def_en: To leave a persistent colored mark such as blood on clothing, skin, or fabric
items.ex_en: The injured soldier's jacket was stained with dark blood from the shrapnel wound.
items.ex_zh: 受伤士兵的夹克上沾满了弹片伤口流出的暗红血迹。

items.def_en: To stain or smear with blood, especially to initiate hunting hounds or soldiers into combat
items.ex_en: The seasoned commander blooded the fresh recruits in their very first skirmish.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的指挥官在第一场小冲突中让新兵初试锋芒、染血历练。

items.def_zh: 沾上血迹，用血弄脏；使流血，打伤
items.def_en: 1. To cover or stain something with blood. 2. To cause someone to bleed, especially by wounding them.
items.ex_en: The vicious blow to the face quickly bloodied the boxer's nose and lips.
items.ex_zh: 击中面部的凶猛一拳迅速把拳击手的鼻子和嘴唇打得鲜血淋漓。

items.def_en: To thoroughly wet or drench something through with a liquid such as blood
items.ex_en: Gushing blood from the deep wound threatened to soak through the temporary bandages.
items.ex_zh: 深长伤口中涌出的鲜血几乎要将临时绷带完全浸透。
items.ex2_en: Let the dry pinto beans soak thoroughly in warm water overnight.
items.ex2_zh: 让干斑豆在温水里彻底浸泡一整夜。

items.def_zh: 刺伤，扎破（尤指被角顶伤流血）
items.def_en: To pierce or wound someone deeply with a horn or tusk, causing bloody injury
items.ex_en: The enraged bull managed to gore the reckless matador through the upper thigh.
items.ex_zh: 被激怒的公牛用角狠狠刺穿了鲁莽斗牛士的大腿上部。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify causing physical wounding or staining surfaces and bodies directly with blood, carrying strong visceral and violent overtones.
groups.summary_zh: 指伤及皮肉使之出血，或用鲜血浸透、染污人体与物件。
groups.desc_en: Marks or saturates a surface with vital blood, distinguishing itself from generic 'staining' through connotations of biological trauma, violence, or ritual initiation.
groups.desc_zh: 用鲜血浸染、玷污表面，区别于普通的“染色”或“弄脏”，带有强烈的肉体创伤、暴力或血洗仪式色彩。
groups.nuance_en: bloody: violently smear or wound so as to cover in blood (hands / nose / battlefield) · blood: initiate a hunting dog or novice by exposure to slaughter (hounds / recruits) · gore: pierce or rend flesh deeply with a horn or tusk (matador / victim / hunter) · stain: indelibly discolour with blood drops (sheets / pavement / honor) · soak: permeate deeply with copious blood (bandages / garments / ground)
groups.nuance_zh: bloody: 暴力打伤或染上血迹 (hands / nose / battlefield) · blood: 使猎犬或新兵初次经受见血试炼 (hounds / recruits) · gore: 用角、牙等尖锐物抵穿刺伤 (matador / victim / hunter) · stain: 斑驳玷污并留下难除血痕 (sheets / pavement / honor) · soak: 大量鲜血渗透浸透物料 (bandages / garments / ground)

groups.name: Crack & Fracture · 开裂与断裂 (Crack, Fracture, Fissure)
groups.tip: 受力产生细微裂痕直至碎裂

items.def_zh: （使）破裂，（使）开裂；（使）发出爆裂声；破译
items.def_en:
1. to break without dividing into separate parts, or to cause a surface to show lines of fracture
2. to make a sharp, snapping sound
items.ex_en: Drop that heavy mug and you will definitely crack the kitchen tile floor.
items.ex_zh: 把那个重马克杯掉下去，你肯定会把厨房的地砖砸出裂纹。

items.def_en: To break or cause something to break, crack, or split, especially a hard object or bone
items.ex_en: The violent impact of the collision caused the driver's left collarbone to fracture.
items.ex_zh: 猛烈的撞击导致司机的左侧锁骨发生骨折。
items.ex2_en: The heavy industrial hammer fractured the thick stone slab with one blow.
items.ex2_zh: 沉重的工业大锤一击就砸裂了那块厚厚的石板。

items.def_en: To split or crack into long, deep, narrow openings, physically or metaphorically
items.ex_en: Severe drought caused the parched earth across the vast plain to fissure deeply.
items.ex_zh: 严重的干旱导致广袤平原上干涸的土地裂开深深的缝隙。
items.ex2_en: Intense thermal stress can fissure the thick granite walls of the kiln.
items.ex2_zh: 强烈的热应力会导致窑炉厚重的花岗岩壁开裂出缝隙。

items.def_en: To suddenly break with a sharp, cracking sound, especially under tension
items.ex_en: Under the immense weight of the snow, the dry branch suddenly snapped loudly.
items.ex_zh: 在积雪的巨大重压下，那根枯枝突然啪的一声崩断了。

items.def_en: To split or sever something cleanly and sharply, especially along a natural grain or line
items.ex_en: With one mighty blow, the woodsman cleaved the heavy oak log in twain.
items.ex_zh: 樵夫猛力一挥，将沉重的橡木圆木利落地劈成两半。
items.ex2_en: Brittle sea ice cleaved suddenly along the freezing polar navigation passage yesterday.
items.ex2_zh: 昨天脆弱的海冰沿着冰冷的极地航行通道突然裂成了两半。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical materials or institutional structures splitting, developing surface fissures, or breaking without necessarily shattering entirely.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及物体或抽象关系在压力下开裂、断裂或出现缝隙的过程。
groups.desc_en: Breaches structural integrity along stress lines to form partial or complete divisions, contrasting with clean 'cutting' by its brittle, violent rupture.
groups.desc_zh: 承受应力极限而沿裂纹发生局部或完全破裂，与利刃切削不同，强调脆性与破坏性的断裂分离。
groups.nuance_en: crack: form narrow surface or structural fissure lines without full separation (glass / skull / foundation) · fracture: structurally rupture hard tissue or mineral matter under stress (bone / rock / alliance) · fissure: open deep, long chasms or social cleavages (earth / rock / society) · snap: break abruptly into parts with a sharp acoustic crack (twig / rope / bone) · cleave: split completely along natural grain lines (rock / wood / waters)
groups.nuance_zh: crack: 表面或内部生出细裂纹但未完全碎开 (glass / skull / foundation) · fracture: 硬质结构或骨骼在压力下骨折、破裂 (bone / rock / alliance) · fissure: 产生深长裂隙或发生社会断裂 (earth / rock / society) · snap: 应声脆断、猝然绷断 (twig / rope / bone) · cleave: 沿纹理精准劈开或劈分 (rock / wood / waters)

groups.name: Crash & Collide · 撞击与坠毁 (Crash, Collide, Smash)
groups.tip: 剧烈猛撞导致损毁

items.def_en: To collide forcefully with something while moving forward relentlessly with high momentum
items.ex_en: The runaway truck managed to plow into several parked cars along the curb.
items.ex_zh: 那辆失控的卡车一路硬生生撞向停在路边的几辆轿车。

items.def_en: to hit something violently and cause damage or noise; to lose control and collide with another object
items.ex_en: The speeding sports car crashed into a concrete divider along the dark highway.
items.ex_zh: 超速行驶的跑车在昏暗的高速公路上猛烈撞上了混凝土隔离带。
items.ex2_en: The reckless driver crashed his new convertible sports car into the ditch.
items.ex2_zh: 那名鲁莽的司机将自己崭新的敞篷跑车撞进了沟里。

items.def_en: (+ into) To violently hit, break into pieces, or shatter against a hard barrier
items.ex_en: The heavy stone statue toppled over and smashed into countless fragments upon impact.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的石雕倾倒下来，在剧烈撞击下摔得粉碎。
items.ex2_en: The angry demonstrator smashed the storefront window with a heavy iron crowbar.
items.ex2_zh: 愤怒的示威者用一根沉重的铁撬棍砸碎了店面的橱窗。

items.def_en: To deliberately or forcefully drive or push an object into something else
items.ex_en: The desperate bank robbers used an armored vehicle to ram the fortified security gate.
items.ex_zh: 绝望的银行劫匪使用装甲车狠狠猛撞坚固的安全防护门。

items.def_en: (+ with) To hit something or someone with serious impact while moving
items.ex_en: Dense fog caused two cargo ships to collide with each other near the harbor.
items.ex_zh: 浓雾导致两艘货船在港口附近相互发生猛烈碰撞。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict high-energy, violent physical impacts involving vehicles, objects, or surfaces that result in severe force, noise, or wreckage.
groups.summary_zh: 表示物体或交通工具间发生的高速剧烈撞击、破坏及毁损。
groups.desc_en: Undergoes violent kinetic impact between moving bodies or into an obstacle, differing from static 'touching' by the sudden, destructive release of energy.
groups.desc_zh: 运动中的物体猛烈撞击障碍物或其他实体，与平缓接触不同，强调动能瞬间释放引发的破坏与毁灭。
groups.nuance_en: collide: smash into each other while both in motion (vehicles / galaxies / opinions) · crash: hit violently and disintegrate or fall with loud ruin (plane / market / car) · smash: shatter violently into fragments on impact (windshield / door / records) · ram: deliberately drive a heavy mass headlong into a barrier (ship / barricade / gate) · plow into: barrel uncontrollably through obstacles without braking (crowd / hedge / vehicles)
groups.nuance_zh: collide: 两物体在运动中正面对撞 (vehicles / galaxies / opinions) · crash: 猛撞失事并伴随巨大声响或损毁 (plane / market / car) · smash: 冲撞导致粉碎性破裂 (windshield / door / records) · ram: 蓄意用重物前端猛顶狠撞 (ship / barricade / gate) · plow into: 毫无刹车减速地横冲直撞冲入 (crowd / hedge / vehicles)

groups.name: Crawl & Inching · 蜗行与慢爬 (Inched, Plod, Creep)
groups.tip: 像蜗牛般极其缓慢挪步

items.def_en: 1. To move along extremely slowly like a snail.
items.ex_en: Morning commuter traffic snailed across the congested suspension bridge under heavy pouring rain.
items.ex_zh: 在大雨倾盆中，早高峰的通勤车流在拥堵的悬索桥上极其缓慢地挪动。

items.def_en: To move forward very slowly and carefully in tiny increments or short stages
items.ex_en: The anxious driver had to inch the vehicle forward through the narrow alleyway.
items.ex_zh: 焦急的司机只得小心翼翼地驾车在这条狭窄的小巷中一寸寸挪动。
items.ex2_en: Traffic inched painfully along the congested highway during the snowy evening commute.
items.ex2_zh: 在下雪的晚高峰通勤期间，车辆在拥堵的高速上艰难地缓慢挪动。

items.def_en: To advance at an imperceptibly slow pace, often silently or close to the ground
items.ex_en: Chilly evening shadows began to creep slowly across the quiet, deserted valley.
items.ex_zh: 傍晚清冷的暗影开始悄然缓慢地笼罩这片寂静荒芜的山谷。

items.def_en: To move along the ground on hands and knees, or advance at an exasperatingly slow speed
items.ex_en: Traffic started to crawl along the highway during the evening rush hour.
items.ex_zh: 晚高峰期间，高速公路上的车流开始像蜗牛一样缓慢爬行。

items.def_zh: 沉重缓慢地走；蹒跚而行
items.def_en: To walk slowly and heavily with prolonged effort, as if weighed down or exhausted
items.ex_en: The exhausted hikers had to plod through deep mud to reach camp.
items.ex_zh: 精疲力竭的徒步者不得不踏着深泥艰难跋涉以抵达营地。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe forward motion characterized by extreme sluggishness, reluctant progress, or advancing infinitesimally like a snail. While 'inch' signifies microscopic linear progress, 'creep' conveys hushed slowness, and 'plod' stresses heavy, weary trudging.
groups.summary_zh: 指以极度缓慢、滞重或寸进的方式吃力前行或爬行。
groups.desc_en: Progresses with agonizing slowness or along the ground, contrasting with standard 'walking' by its heavy, laborious friction or stealthy stealth.
groups.desc_zh: 极其迟缓或贴地前行，区别于正常的“行走”，带有沉重吃力、步步为营或隐匿前驱的特征。
groups.nuance_en: crawl: move flat on all fours, or proceed at a suffocatingly dead pace (traffic / baby / pace) · creep: advance quietly, stealthily, or imperceptibly (shadow / burglar / doubt) · inch: move forward painstakingly in tiny, measured increments (forward / progress / upward) · plod: walk heavily, dully, and perseveringly without joy (mud / steps / through work) · snail: advance at a literal gastropodic slowness (pace / convoy)
groups.nuance_zh: crawl: 匍匐爬行或车辆水泄不通地龟速挪动 (traffic / baby / pace) · creep: 悄无声息、鬼鬼祟祟或不知不觉渗透 (shadow / burglar / doubt) · inch: 一寸一寸极度艰难地推进 (forward / progress / upward) · plod: 脚步沉重、乏味但坚持不懈地迈进 (mud / steps / through work) · snail: 像蜗牛一样磨洋工式极其缓慢前行 (pace / convoy)

groups.name: Craze & Web-crack · 龟裂与网裂 (Alligator, Craze, Check)
groups.tip: 受力或老化开裂，表面出现裂纹

items.def_en: To develop small surface cracks, especially in seasoned wood or dried coatings
items.ex_en: The untreated oak timber began to check after weeks in dry air.
items.ex_zh: 未经处理的橡木在干燥空气中放置数周后表面开始干裂。

items.def_zh: （釉面、塑料等）出现细碎网纹/龟裂
items.def_en: To produce a network of fine cracks on the surface of pottery, glaze, or plastic
items.ex_en: Decades of gentle heat caused the antique vase's delicate glaze to craze.
items.ex_zh: 数十年的温热使那尊古董花瓶精致的釉面生出了细碎的龟裂。
items.ex2_en: Sudden boiling temperatures can craze porcelain enamel finishes on vintage kitchen cookware.
items.ex2_zh: 突如其来的沸水温度可能会使复古厨具上的搪瓷釉层开裂。

items.def_en: To rub off or degrade unevenly in fine surface fragments
items.ex_en: The cheap paint on the chair tends to crock if you rub it.
items.ex_zh: 这把椅子上的劣质油漆如果用力摩擦，往往会掉色剥落。

items.def_zh: （油漆、涂层等）龟裂，开裂成鳄皮状
items.def_en: (of paint, varnish, or asphalt) To crack into a rough pattern resembling alligator skin.
items.ex_en: Under the blistering desert sun, the thick lacquer began to alligator rapidly.
items.ex_zh: 在沙漠烈日的炙烤下，厚厚的漆面迅速裂出鳄皮般的纹路。

items.def_en: To form or show a network of wrinkles or cracks, as in photo film emulsions
items.ex_en: Sudden temperature shifts during development caused the gelatin emulsion to reticulate completely.
items.ex_zh: 显影时急剧的温差导致明胶乳剂完全形成了网状裂纹。
items.ex2_en: Extreme chemical exposures can reticulate the delicate polymer film during photographic development.
items.ex2_zh: 极端的化学接触会使照相显影过程中的脆弱聚合物薄膜产生网状裂纹。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here specialize in surfaces such as paint, ceramics, asphalt, or timber developing complex networks of fine surface cracks resembling mesh or scales.
groups.summary_zh: 油漆、陶瓷或沥青表面老化出现网状龟裂纹。
groups.desc_en: Develops a fine, intricate web of surface micro-fractures due to aging, stress, or drying, differing from deep 'fracturing' by being primarily a superficial network pattern.
groups.desc_zh: 材料因老化、应力或干燥而在表面滋生细密网状微裂纹，不同于贯穿断裂，主要表现为表层蛛网状瑕疵。
groups.nuance_en: craze: cover a brittle glaze, plastic, or paint in minute micro-cracks (pottery / glaze / acrylic) · alligator: crack severely into coarse, rectangular reptilian scales due to paint failure (paint / asphalt) · check: develop longitudinal surface fissures from weathered drying (timber / wood / grain) · reticulate: divide or crack into an intricate, interwoven netlike structure (pattern / veins / surface) · crock: rub off pigment or crumble along brittle fracture margins (dye / leather / fabric)
groups.nuance_zh: craze: 陶瓷釉面或塑料因老化出现细碎冰裂纹 (pottery / glaze / acrylic) · alligator: 涂料老化开裂形成粗大的鳄鱼皮状龟裂 (paint / asphalt) · check: 木料在风干干燥时顺纹表层干裂 (timber / wood / grain) · reticulate: 形成错综交织的网络状纹理或裂道 (pattern / veins / surface) · crock: 表皮脆化掉色或裂损脱落 (dye / leather / fabric)

groups.name: Critique & Denounce · 痛斥与斥责 (Deplore, Lament, Rail)
groups.tip: 对恶劣行径深表痛惜与道德谴责

items.def_en: To complain angrily and bitterly, loudly protesting against perceived injustice or absurdity
items.ex_en: Opposition leaders gathered to rail against the government's controversial new labor policy.
items.ex_zh: 反对党领袖齐聚一堂，愤怒抨击政府备受争议的新劳工政策。

items.def_zh: 严厉声讨，电闪雷鸣般指责
items.def_en: To issue a fiery and vehement protest or verbal attack against an authority or practice
items.ex_en: The reclusive prophet continued to fulminate against the corrupt practices of modern society.
items.ex_zh: 这位隐世先知继续以雷霆万钧之势痛斥现代社会的腐朽行径。

items.def_en: To express deep sorrow, regret, or discontent publicly about an unfortunate situation
items.ex_en: Economists gather annually to lament the steady decline of small manufacturing communities.
items.ex_zh: 经济学家们每年聚会，痛陈小型制造业社区的持续衰落。

items.def_zh: 谴责，对……深表愤慨；痛惜，对……深感遗憾
items.def_en: To strongly disapprove of and criticize something morally unacceptable, or feel deep regret about something.
items.ex_en: Human rights organizations openly deplore the arbitrary detention of peaceful political dissidents.
items.ex_zh: 人权组织公开谴责对和平政治异见人士的肆意拘禁。

items.def_en: To criticize a person or institution with scathing, blistering, and unrelenting severity
items.ex_en: The editorial board chose to excoriate the mayor for his utter incompetence.
items.ex_zh: 编辑委员会选择对市长的极度无能予以严厉痛批。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on expressing profound grievance, righteous aversion, and bitter disapproval toward regrettable conditions, policies, or injustices.
groups.summary_zh: 表达对不公或恶劣局势的深切痛惜、憎恶与严正痛斥。
groups.desc_en: Vents intense moral outrage or sorrowful condemnation against a target, contrasting with measured 'criticism' through its emotional fury or mournful despair.
groups.desc_zh: 对某事宣泄极度道德愤怒或痛切控诉，区别于理性的“批评”，充满情绪化的盛怒或深切哀痛。
groups.nuance_en: rail against: angrily complain and protest with continuous abusive words (injustice / fate / establishment) · fulminate against: explode in thunderous, righteous verbal denunciation (corruption / policy / decadence) · excoriate: tear apart fiercely with blistering, scathing criticism (speech / performance / failure) · deplore: strongly express formal regret and moral condemnation (violence / loss / decision) · lament: mournfully express deep sorrow or regretful protest (demise / state of affairs / loss)
groups.nuance_zh: rail against: 连珠炮般愤怒抱怨控诉 (injustice / fate / establishment) · fulminate against: 严词厉色地如雷霆般痛斥 (corruption / policy / decadence) · excoriate: 毫不留情地严苛痛批 (speech / performance / failure) · deplore: 严肃谴责并深表遗憾 (violence / loss / decision) · lament: 悲叹哀婉地指责与惋惜 (demise / state of affairs / loss)

groups.name: Critique & Review · 评论与审评 (Critique, Review, Appraise, Assess)
groups.tip: 对作品或观点进行审视评议

items.def_en: To write an evaluative article expressing an informed opinion about a book, film, exhibition, or play
items.ex_en: She was commissioned by the magazine to review the newly released drama.
items.ex_zh: 她受杂志社委托撰文评述这部新上映的话剧。

items.def_en: To find every tiny defect, contradiction, or mistake in an argument, creative work, or theory
items.ex_en: The demanding professor proceeded to pick apart every paragraph of his draft.
items.ex_zh: 那位苛刻的教授开始挑剔他初稿中的每一段落。

items.def_en: To evaluate and review a book, artwork, theory, or performance critically.
items.ex_en: Art scholars convened at the symposium to critique the controversial new installation.
items.ex_zh: 艺术学者们在研讨会上齐聚，严谨评判这件引人争议的新装置作品。

items.def_en: To analyze or criticize a text, statement, or performance minutely in order to expose its flaws or structure
items.ex_en: The investigative reporter sought to dissect the official narrative line by line.
items.ex_zh: 这名调查记者试图逐行仔细推敲官方给出的说辞以揭开破绽。

items.def_en: To carefully evaluate the quality, condition, or importance of a person, performance, or work
items.ex_en: Senior consultants were hired to appraise the firm's overall organizational performance.
items.ex_zh: 资深顾问受聘对该公司的整体组织绩效进行严谨评估。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on detailed, professional, and analytical evaluation of creative works, performances, or policies, pointing out both virtues and defects.
groups.summary_zh: 对艺术、学术作品或方案进行审读分析，作出专业性评判与优劣剖析。
groups.desc_en: Conducts a deliberate analytical examination of a work or performance to judge its merit, distinct from mere 'praising' or 'scolding' by its analytical rigor.
groups.desc_zh: 对作品或表现进行审慎而系统的剖析与评判，有别于纯粹的表扬或指责，讲究分析的专业性与鉴别力。
groups.nuance_en: review: systematically survey and evaluate for publication or audit (book / performance / policy) · critique: analyze theoretical structure, strengths, and flaws deeply (manuscript / model / theory) · appraise: professionally evaluate quality, value, or performance against criteria (property / performance / situation) · dissect: anatomize step-by-step to expose every hidden mechanism (argument / text / strategy) · pick apart: scrutinize ruthlessly to locate every minute flaw (logic / proposal / defense)
groups.nuance_zh: review: 公开对作品或体系进行全面复盘评论 (book / performance / policy) · critique: 针对理论、结构进行专业深度批判剖析 (manuscript / model / theory) · appraise: 专业鉴定价值、资质或考核表现 (property / performance / situation) · dissect: 庖丁解牛般逐层切开解析 (argument / text / strategy) · pick apart: 吹毛求疵地挑骨头挑毛病 (logic / proposal / defense)

groups.name: Cross & Traverse · 横越与跨越 (Traverse, Span, Ford)
groups.tip: 穿过区域或界限

items.def_en: To take a shorter, direct route across an area instead of going around
items.ex_en: Environmental concerns cut across traditional party lines.
items.ex_zh: 环境问题超越了传统的政党界限。

items.def_zh: 跨越，横跨（桥梁、时间或空间）
items.def_en: To extend across, over, or from one side of something to the other
items.ex_en: The majestic stone bridge continues to span the wide river below.
items.ex_zh: 那座雄伟的石桥依然巍然横跨在下方宽阔的河流之上。

items.def_zh: 穿过，越过，横渡；交叉，使相交
items.def_en: 1. To go or travel across a space, boundary, or obstacle. 2. To place or move one thing across another.
items.ex_en: Pedestrians must only cross the busy avenue at designated pedestrian crossings.
items.ex_zh: 行人必须只在指定的斑马线处穿过这条繁忙的大街。

items.def_en: To cross a shallow body of water by wading or riding through it
items.ex_en: The weary riders had to ford the icy stream before nightfall.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的骑手们必须赶在天黑前涉过那条冰冷的小溪。

items.def_zh: 横穿，穿越（险阻或大片地域）
items.def_en: To travel across or through a large or difficult expanse of land or water
items.ex_en: Daring explorers planned to traverse the perilous Antarctic plateau on foot.
items.ex_zh: 勇敢的探险家们计划徒步横穿危险莫测的南极高原。

groups.summary_en: Covers passing from one side of a surface, obstacle, or geographical area to the other. Distinctions center on terrain difficulty, the medium crossed, and whether one journeys across or physically bridges the expanse.
groups.summary_zh: 表示自一端越过至另一端，侧重地形介质、涉水或物理跨越。
groups.desc_en: Navigates across an expanse or natural barrier by traversing its width, contrasting with parallel 'along' movement by cutting directly through a divide.
groups.desc_zh: 横向跨过开阔空间或自然险阻，与“顺流/并排移动”不同，强调切断阻隔、由一侧达至彼岸。
groups.nuance_en: cross: pass from one distinct side of a boundary to the other (border / street / river) · traverse: travel across a wide, challenging, or rugged expanse (terrain / desert / continent) · span: physically or temporally stretch completely across a chasm (bridge / river / centuries) · ford: wade directly through a shallow section of a watercourse (river / stream / shallows) · cut across: take a direct transversal shortcut through an area (lawn / fields / spectrum)
groups.nuance_zh: cross: 越过分界线或由这一侧到那一侧 (border / street / river) · traverse: 穿行横渡宽广险恶的地理纵深 (terrain / desert / continent) · span: 桥跨或在时间/空间上两头贯通 (bridge / river / centuries) · ford: 涉浅水而渡 (river / stream / shallows) · cut across: 抄近路抄直线横切穿过 (lawn / fields / spectrum)

groups.name: Cross & Traverse · 穿过与跨越 (Cross, Span, Traverse)
groups.tip: 横穿与走过广阔区域

items.def_en: Go from one side of a road, river, border, or area to the other
items.ex_en: Be careful when you cross the railway tracks near the school.
items.ex_zh: 经过学校附近的铁轨时一定要多加小心。

items.def_en: Extend or stretch across an entire space, distance, or body of water from margin to margin
items.ex_en: Two massive cables span the entire width of the foggy canyon.
items.ex_zh: 两根巨大的缆绳横跨了雾气弥漫的整个峡谷。

items.def_en: Travel or move across the surface or top of a boundary or tract of land
items.ex_en: A flock of wild geese began to pass over the frozen marshlands.
items.ex_zh: 一群野雁开始掠过结冰的沼泽地上空。

items.def_en: Successfully travel across or journey over a tract of water, air, or land
items.ex_en: The experienced pilot managed to navigate the turbulent storm clouds safely.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的飞行员设法安全穿过了湍急的暴风雨云层。

items.def_en: (formal) To travel, move, or extend across or through an area of land or water.
items.ex_en: The survey team will traverse the dense jungle during the expedition.
items.ex_zh: 勘测队将在这次考察中穿过那片茂密的热带丛林。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote traveling or extending across the breadth of a physical territory, watercourse, barrier, or span of terrain from one side to the other.
groups.summary_zh: 指由一侧移动到另一侧，横跨或穿过广袤地形与界限。
groups.desc_en: Overcomes an expanse, waterway, or temporal bridge by extending or traveling over it, contrasting with 'staying within' by achieving comprehensive passage.
groups.desc_zh: 通过横向延伸或行进以跨越水系、空间或时间隔阂，区别于“居留其内”，强调实现两极通达。
groups.nuance_en: cross: make a complete transit across a line or waterway (channel / threshold / line) · span: bridge a gap completely from bank to bank or epoch to epoch (distance / globe / generations) · traverse: move thoroughly through the whole extent of a domain (countryside / globe / slopes) · pass over: skim above or cross an elevated trajectory (head / territory / obstacle) · navigate: skillfully steer through or negotiate a difficult passage (straits / channels / maze)
groups.nuance_zh: cross: 完整通渡一条线或水域 (channel / threshold / line) · span: 飞架两岸或时代跨距长达 (distance / globe / generations) · traverse: 历经波折巡回横贯整片空间 (countryside / globe / slopes) · pass over: 从高空掠过或横越 (head / territory / obstacle) · navigate: 操舵跨越或智取复杂航道水道 (straits / channels / maze)

groups.name: Crouch in Fear · 蜷缩震慑与俯首惊伏 (Cower, Flinch, Truckle)
groups.tip: 因恐惧而本能地蜷缩躲避

items.def_en: To lower one's body close to the ground with bent limbs to avoid detection or violence
items.ex_en: The frightened burglar decided to crouch behind the sofa in silence.
items.ex_zh: 那个受惊的窃贼决定一声不吭地蜷缩在沙发后面躲避。

items.def_en: (+ from) To draw back or fail to endure unpleasant confrontations or duties
items.ex_en: An honorable soldier does not flinch from danger or difficult duties.
items.ex_zh: 一名光荣的军人绝不会在危险或艰巨的职责面前退缩动摇。

items.def_en: (+ to) To act subserviently and yield submissively to an overbearing superior
items.ex_en: He refused to truckle to the tyrannical demands of the magistrate.
items.ex_zh: 他拒绝屈从于地方官那蛮横暴虐的要求。

items.def_en: To yield to daunting forces and show weakness or terror instead of resistance
items.ex_en: The stalwart knights did not quail before the terrifying dark army.
items.ex_zh: 刚毅的骑士们在恐怖的黑暗军团面前未曾显露半分胆寒。

items.def_en: To crouch down or shrink back in fear or distress from someone or something threatening.
items.ex_en: The terrified stray dog began to cower beneath the wooden bench.
items.ex_zh: 那只受惊的流浪狗缩在木长椅下瑟瑟发抖。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this set evoke emotional yielding to intimidation, accompanied by crouching low, drawing away, or failing to hold one's ground against overwhelming authority.
groups.summary_zh: 突显遭受恐吓或威压时，心理屈服并做出蜷伏、避让或不敢正视的反应。
groups.desc_en: Compresses the physical body downward or backward under the visceral intimidation of dread, contrasting with proud 'standing' by showing sheer subjugation.
groups.desc_zh: 因恐惧受慑而向后退缩或蜷缩下蹲，与坚毅昂首形成鲜明反差，流露出被支配与惊惶无措。
groups.nuance_en: cower: shrink down and huddle close to shelter in base terror (in corner / before master) · flinch: make a quick, involuntary wince backward from anticipated pain (from blow / in horror) · quail: lose heart and physically buckle under sheer intimidation (before threats / at sight) · crouch: bend the knees low in defensive readiness or dread (in shadows / behind wall) · truckle: yield servilely and cravenly submit to authority (to demands / to bully)
groups.nuance_zh: cower: 惊恐万状地瑟缩蜷曲在一角 (in corner / before master) · flinch: 预判疼痛或打击时下意识一缩/退缩 (from blow / in horror) · quail: 气馁胆怯、吓破了胆似地退缩 (before threats / at sight) · crouch: 压低重心蹲伏防卫或惊恐潜伏 (in shadows / behind wall) · truckle: 屈躬卑颜、奴颜婢膝地屈从顺应 (to demands / to bully)

groups.name: Crowd & Throng · 簇拥与挤满 (Throng, Cram, Mob)
groups.tip: 人潮涌入扎堆挤满

items.def_en: 1. To gather together in large numbers, or to fill a place completely. 2. To push or force someone closely in an uncomfortable way.
items.ex_en: Eager spectators began to crowd the entrance of the exhibition hall.
items.ex_zh: 热切的观众开始挤满展厅的入口处。
items.ex2_en: Commuters crowd onto the subway platform during every busy weekday rush hour.
items.ex2_zh: 在每个繁忙的工作日高峰期，通勤者都会挤到地铁站台上。

items.def_en: (+ into) To fill a venue, room, or vehicle so full that there is little or no space left
items.ex_en: Hundreds of excited fans managed to pack into the tiny club.
items.ex_zh: 数百名兴奋的歌迷挤满了这家狭小的俱乐部。

items.def_en: (+ into) To push or squeeze people or things tightly into a space that is barely large enough
items.ex_en: Commuters often cram into the subway train during morning rush hour.
items.ex_zh: 早高峰期间，通勤人员常常硬挤进拥挤的地铁车厢。

items.def_en: To fill or crowd into a place in extremely large, closely packed numbers
items.ex_en: Thousands of festive villagers throng the ancient plaza every New Year.
items.ex_zh: 每逢新年，成千上万喜庆的村民都会蜂拥聚集在古老的广场上。

items.def_en: To crowd around someone in an unruly, enthusiastic, or aggressive mass
items.ex_en: Enthusiastic supporters continued to mob the victorious candidate at the exit.
items.ex_zh: 热情的支持者们在出口处将胜选的候选人团团围住。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame portray high-density gatherings where spaces are tightly filled, individuals press closely against each other, or eager masses overwhelm a space or figure.
groups.summary_zh: 指极高密度的人群挤满空间、涌上前来或簇拥围困某人。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an escalating density of entities gathering into or filling a finite space, differing from generic 'gather' by emphasizing constriction, overwhelming volume, and loss of personal space.
groups.desc_zh: 指群体向有限空间高度汇聚或填塞的密度递增过程，与普通“聚集”相比，强调拥挤压迫感、空间饱和度以及个体活动受限。
groups.nuance_en: crowd: congregate closely, narrowing space (corridors / streets / fans) · pack: compress densely into full capacity (hall / stadium / commuters) · cram: force into an uncomfortably tight space (clothes / passengers / schedule) · throng: press together as a surging, dynamic mass (streets / marketplace / pilgrims) · mob: aggressively surround or swarm in an unruly press (celebrities / stage / doors)
groups.nuance_zh: crowd: 紧密聚集致使空间狭窄 (corridors / streets / fans) · pack: 密集填满至极限容量 (hall / stadium / commuters) · cram: 强行塞入局促狭窄空间 (clothes / passengers / schedule) · throng: 涌动群聚形成蜂拥人潮 (streets / marketplace / pilgrims) · mob: 具进攻性或狂热地围攻蜂拥 (celebrities / stage / doors)

groups.name: Crush & Mash · 压瘪与压碎 (Crush, Flatten, Trample)
groups.tip: 挤压受重力碎扁成饼

items.def_zh: 压扁，压碎；挤入，塞进；平息，镇压
items.def_en: 1. To crush or press something flat or out of shape. 2. (+ into) To push or squeeze into a small or crowded space. 3. To suppress, silence, or put a stop to a rumor, protest, or rebellion.
items.ex_en: The falling crate threatened to squash the delicate fruit underneath it.
items.ex_zh: 坠落的板条箱险些将压在下面的娇嫩水果压扁。
items.ex2_en: Ripe berries squash easily if packed carelessly into deep woven harvest baskets.
items.ex2_zh: 如果随意装进较深的编织采摘篮中，成熟的浆果很容易被压烂。

items.def_en: To bring something completely down or compress it flat against a surface by heavy impact
items.ex_en: Heavy rolling bulldozers quickly flatten the ground for the new foundation.
items.ex_zh: 笨重的推土机迅速将地基压平以备施工。
items.ex2_en: The metal sheet flattened completely under the immense pressure of the hydraulic press.
items.ex2_zh: 在液压机的巨大压力下，那块金属薄板彻底变平了。

items.def_en: To compress a soft, moist item out of shape, often producing a damp squelching sound
items.ex_en: He accidentally stepped back and began to squish the ripe tomato.
items.ex_zh: 他不小心往后退了一步，把熟透的番茄踩得软烂。
items.ex2_en: Wet river mud squished pleasantly between his bare toes as he walked.
items.ex2_zh: 当他走动时，潮湿的河泥在他光着的脚趾间滋滋地挤出。

items.def_en: To compress something with great force so that it is broken, flattened, or damaged
items.ex_en: The giant mechanical press can easily crush discarded scrap metal flat.
items.ex_zh: 这台巨型机械压机能轻而易举地把废金属块压碎压平。

items.def_en: (+ on/down) To step on heavily and repeatedly, crushing and damaging beneath the feet
items.ex_en: Careless tourists often trample on the delicate wildflowers along the trail.
items.ex_zh: 粗心的游客常常践踏步道旁娇嫩的野花。

groups.summary_en: This frame highlights forceful, destructive compression that deforms, breaks down, or flattens an object out of its original shape.
groups.summary_zh: 指施加破坏性重压使物体变形、压瘪或碎裂毁坏。
groups.desc_en: Denotes physical destruction or deformation by compressive downward or inward force, contrasting with 'break' or 'shatter' by emphasizing flattening and loss of structural volume rather than fragmenting.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过向下或向内的重压使物体变形或压瘪的物理破坏，与普通的“打碎”不同，侧重于结构被压平、体积萎缩而非断裂碎裂。
groups.nuance_en: squash: compress a soft or yielding body flat (box / insect / fruit) · flatten: level completely to horizontal uniformity (dough / grass / buildings) · squish: yield wetly under soft compression (mud / berries / wet shoes) · crush: overwhelm rigid structure with heavy force (car / rocks / spirit) · trample: tread heavily and repeatedly underfoot (flowers / rights / crops)
groups.nuance_zh: squash: 将柔软或有弹性物体压瘪 (box / insect / fruit) · flatten: 施压彻底展平至水平平整 (dough / grass / buildings) · squish: 受压时发出湿软变形声 (mud / berries / wet shoes) · crush: 施以重力彻底压碎硬物或摧毁意志 (car / rocks / spirit) · trample: 频繁践踏踩踏导致损毁 (flowers / rights / crops)

groups.name: Crush & Mash · 捣烂与化泥 (Crush, Muddle, Puree)
groups.tip: 施重压捣烂成泥状

items.def_en: To lightly press and crush herbs or fruit with a pestle to release juices and essential oils
items.ex_en: The bartender paused to muddle fresh mint leaves with brown sugar.
items.ex_zh: 调酒师停下动作，将新鲜薄荷叶与红糖一同轻轻捣烂出味。

items.def_en: To crush food roughly into smaller textured pieces with flat force
items.ex_en: She used a heavy knife blade to smash several garlic cloves.
items.ex_zh: 她用厚重的刀面把几瓣大蒜粗粗拍碎。
items.ex2_en: The fragile ceramic vase smashed into pieces when it fell off the table.
items.ex2_zh: 脆弱的陶瓷花瓶从桌子上掉下来时摔得粉碎。

items.def_en: (+ up) To crush food into a soft, smooth mass, especially using a fork or masher.
items.ex_en: You need to mash up the boiled potatoes until thoroughly smooth.
items.ex_zh: 你需要把煮熟的土豆捣烂成十分细腻的泥状。

items.def_en: To process cooked food into a smooth, thick liquid or cream using a sieve or blender
items.ex_en: Use an electric blender to puree the cooked carrots and squash.
items.ex_zh: 用电动搅拌机将煮熟的胡萝卜和南瓜打成细腻的浓泥。

items.def_en: To crush something soft completely into a wet, uniform mass
items.ex_en: The industrial machine continues to pulp raw timber for newsprint production.
items.ex_zh: 这台工业机器不断将原木捣成浆状以生产新闻纸。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on reducing soft, edible solids into a pulp, paste, or puree by methodical pressing, crushing, or blending with utensils.
groups.summary_zh: 指使用工具将较软食材压碎捣烂成泥状或糊状。
groups.desc_en: Denotes pulverizing culinary ingredients into a paste, soft mound, or liquid reduction, differing from 'cutting' by breaking cell walls through mashing rather than sharp shear.
groups.desc_zh: 指在烹饪中通过捣击压榨将食材转化为泥状或糊状，与“切割”不同，强调破坏细胞壁碾碎压烂而非锋利分离。
groups.nuance_en: muddle: gently bruise herbs or citrus to release oils (mint / lime / cocktail) · smash: break down coarsely with blunt force (avocado / garlic / potatoes) · mash: crush into a uniform soft pulp (potatoes / bananas / pumpkin) · puree: blend or sieve into a smooth, liquid paste (soup / fruit / baby food) · pulp: beat into a wet, fibrous mass (wood / fruit / vegetables)
groups.nuance_zh: muddle: 轻柔碾压香草或柑橘以萃取精油 (mint / lime / cocktail) · smash: 粗暴钝压捣碎成粗颗粒 (avocado / garlic / potatoes) · mash: 碾压捣成均匀绵软稠泥 (potatoes / bananas / pumpkin) · puree: 搅打或过滤成细腻丝滑糊浆 (soup / fruit / baby food) · pulp: 捣烂成果肉状湿润纤维糊 (wood / fruit / vegetables)

groups.name: Crystallize & Take Shape · 结晶与具体成型 (Crystallize, Take Shape, Coalesce)
groups.tip: 由液态变为固态或规则晶体

items.def_en: To form into grains, small particles, or crystal-like pellets
items.ex_en: As cooling progressed, the viscous syrup began to granulate along edges.
items.ex_zh: 随着逐渐冷却，粘稠的糖浆边缘开始凝成微小的结晶颗粒。
items.ex2_en: The specialized machine granulates dry recycled plastics into tiny uniform processing pellets.
items.ex2_zh: 这台专用机器将干燥的回收塑料粉碎造粒为细小均匀的加工颗粒。

items.def_en: To develop into a definite, recognizable, or organized form
items.ex_en: Her innovative research proposal began to take shape after weeks of discussion.
items.ex_zh: 经过数周的研讨，她那极具创新性的研究构想开始成形。

items.def_en: To become firmer like a jelly, or of ideas or teams, to come together successfully
items.ex_en: The diverse working group finally started to gel after many disagreements.
items.ex_zh: 在经历了诸多分歧后，这个多元的工作团队终于开始融合默契。

items.def_en: To come together to form one larger, unified group, substance, or coherent system
items.ex_en: Scattered regional resistance groups began to coalesce into a formidable rebel army.
items.ex_zh: 分散的地区抵抗力量开始凝聚联合成一支强大的起义军。

items.def_zh: （使）结晶；（使）（想法、计划等）成形，明确化
items.def_en: 1. To form or cause to form solid crystals. 2. (of ideas, plans, or opinions) To become or make clear, definite, and concrete.
items.ex_en: Their ambiguous strategic concepts began to crystallize into a concrete action plan.
items.ex_zh: 他们原本模糊的战略构想逐渐明确化，形成了具体的行动方案。
items.ex2_en: Freezing winter temperatures crystallize moisture on the outer glass of the window.
items.ex2_zh: 严寒的冬日气温使窗户外部玻璃上的水分凝结成了冰晶。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict atoms or molecules organizing into clear crystalline structures, and prominently extend to nebulous ideas, thoughts, or plans resolving into crisp, tangible, well-defined forms.
groups.summary_zh: 指物质形成晶体，亦喻指模糊想法清晰化、成型定相。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the emergence of distinct, solid, and organized structure from a formless, dispersed, or fluid state, unlike plain 'develop' which lacks the nuance of phase-transition or crystallizing precision.
groups.desc_zh: 指从松散、无序或流体状态凝聚成明确、具象且有条理结构的相变过程，与普通“发展”相比，带有凝结与具象化的质变色彩。
groups.nuance_en: granulate: form into discrete, rough grains (sugar / metals / wounds) · take shape: progressively assume identifiable form (plans / ideas / project) · gel: set into a cohesive, workable state (team / concept / pudding) · coalesce: merge disparate elements into a unified whole (views / factions / clouds) · crystallize: abruptly solidify into clear, definitive form (thoughts / policy / solution)
groups.nuance_zh: granulate: 形成离散坚硬的细小颗粒 (sugar / metals / wounds) · take shape: 逐渐显现清晰轮廓或雏形 (plans / ideas / project) · gel: 凝结成具有粘聚力与默契的整体 (team / concept / pudding) · coalesce: 散乱元素聚合成统一体 (views / factions / clouds) · crystallize: 思想或方案骤然明晰且定型 (thoughts / policy / solution)

groups.name: Culinary Cutting & Cubing · 切分与切块 (Dice, Cube, Julienne)
groups.tip: 用刀切丁与细细切片

items.def_en: To cut food into pieces of roughly uniform size before cooking
items.ex_en: Please chop up the fresh celery before tossing it into soup.
items.ex_zh: 把新鲜芹菜切碎之后再丢进汤里煮。

items.def_zh: 切成小方块，切丁；掷骰子；冒险（dice with）
items.def_en: 1. (cooking) To cut food such as vegetables or meat into small neat cubes. 2. (dice with) To take great, dangerous risks with something.
items.ex_en: The chef demonstrated how to dice fresh onions into neat cubes.
items.ex_zh: 主厨示范了如何把新鲜洋葱切成均匀的小方丁。

items.def_en: To cut food into distinct, uniform square-sided blocks that are larger than diced pieces
items.ex_en: Carefully cube the beef chuck before browning it in hot oil.
items.ex_zh: 在放入热油煎黄之前，先把牛夹心肉切成大块方块。

items.def_en: To cut vegetables or other foods into thin, matchstick-like strips
items.ex_en: The culinary student practiced how to julienne crisp carrots with precision.
items.ex_zh: 那名烹饪学校的学生练习着如何精准地将脆胡萝卜切成细丝。

items.def_en: To cut or chop food into extremely tiny, fine pieces
items.ex_en: Use a sharp cleaver to mince the fresh ginger very finely.
items.ex_zh: 用锋利的菜刀把生姜细细切成极小的碎末。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers precise culinary techniques of cutting solid food items into specific geometric shapes—especially uniform cubes, sticks, or wedges. It highlights geometric precision and kitchen preparation rather than rough hacking or slicing.
groups.summary_zh: 指烹饪中将食材精准切削成方块、条状或规则几何形状的操作。
groups.desc_en: Denotes cutting culinary materials into deliberate, precise geometric geometries, contrasting with generic 'cut' through culinary intent and uniform spatial dimensions.
groups.desc_zh: 指在烹饪中依规整几何规格切分食材的操作，区别于普通“切开”，侧重刀工形制与尺寸的严格一致性。
groups.nuance_en: chop up: sever roughly into irregular bite-sized pieces (onions / wood / meat) · dice: cut into small, neat, even cubes (carrots / tomatoes / ham) · cube: cut into large, distinct cubic blocks (beef / cheese / melon) · julienne: slice into thin, matchstick-like batons (carrots / peppers / vegetables) · mince: chop extremely fine into tiny fragments (garlic / herbs / meat)
groups.nuance_zh: chop up: 粗切切碎成不规则小块 (onions / wood / meat) · dice: 切成齐整细致的小方块丁 (carrots / tomatoes / ham) · cube: 切成立体均匀的大厚方块 (beef / cheese / melon) · julienne: 切成纤细均匀的火柴棍状丝 (carrots / peppers / vegetables) · mince: 细剁成极微小的碎末 (garlic / herbs / meat)

groups.name: Curl & Frizzle · 卷曲与焦卷 (Crisp, Frizz, Kink)
groups.tip: 受力产生卷曲或褶皱弯折

items.def_en: To form a sharp twist, curl, or bend in hair, wire, or a line
items.ex_en: Do not let the long electrical cord kink around the corner.
items.ex_zh: 别让那根长电线在拐角处扭结缠绕起来。
items.ex2_en: Impatient handling can kink the flexible water hose while watering the garden.
items.ex2_zh: 给花园浇水时，不耐烦的拉扯可能会使柔韧的水管打结扭曲。

items.def_en: To form small, thin folds, ridges, or tightly curled ripples
items.ex_en: Excessive moisture will cause thin parchment paper to crinkle immediately.
items.ex_zh: 过多的湿气会使轻薄的羊皮纸表面瞬间皱起细密波纹。
items.ex2_en: The smiling old man crinkled his eyes with joy during the celebration.
items.ex2_zh: 在庆祝活动中，那位微笑的老人高兴地眯起了眼角布满细纹的眼睛。

items.def_en: To form or cause hair to form tight, wiry curls or fuzzy tufts
items.ex_en: The oppressive summer humidity caused her styled hair to frizz terribly.
items.ex_zh: 夏季闷热潮湿的空气使她打理好的头发毛躁卷曲成一团。
items.ex2_en: Her naturally straight hair tends to frizz whenever she walks outside in humid weather.
items.ex2_zh: 每当她在潮湿的天气里走到室外，她原本笔直的头发就容易起毛卷曲。

items.def_zh: （使）卷曲，（使）起褶；（油煎时发滋滋声并）炸焦，炸卷
items.def_en: 1. To form or cause hair or fiber to form tight, crisp curls. 2. To fry food until it sizzles, curls up, and becomes crisp.
items.ex_en: Watch the bacon strips frizzle and brown in the hot skillet.
items.ex_zh: 看着培根片在滚烫的煎锅里滋滋作响并卷焦变脆。
items.ex2_en: The chef frizzled the thin bacon slices until they were delightfully crisp and golden.
items.ex2_zh: 厨师把薄培根片煎得滋滋作响，直到焦脆金黄。

items.def_en: To curl up or become brittle and rigid through heat or drying
items.ex_en: Leave the tortilla edges in the oven to crisp without burning.
items.ex_zh: 将玉米饼边缘留在烤箱中烘至焦卷香脆而不过火。
items.ex2_en: The baker crisped the artisan rolls under high heat right before serving dinner.
items.ex2_zh: 面包师在开饭前用高温将手工面包卷烤得香脆。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers processes where hair, fibers, or materials shrink, crimp, or twist tightly, often under the effect of heat, humidity, or chemical treatment.
groups.summary_zh: 指毛发或材质受热或潮湿后形成紧密卷曲或焦卷状态。
groups.desc_en: Denotes tight, irregular curling or crimping of fibers, hair, or surfaces often under heat or tension, contrasting with smooth 'curl' by implying brittleness, frizz, or structural distortion.
groups.desc_zh: 指纤维、毛发或物体表面受热或张力影响而发生密集、不规则卷缩起皱，不同于平滑的“卷曲”，带有毛躁、脆弱或干卷质感。
groups.nuance_en: kink: form an abrupt sharp twist or loop (hose / cable / hair) · crinkle: develop fine, rustling wrinkles (foil / paper / eyes) · frizz: form a mass of tight, untamed, fuzzy curls (hair / fleece / synthetic fiber) · frizzle: curl or crisp tightly through intense frying heat (bacon / edges / hair) · crisp: turn stiff, dry, and brittle around edges (leaves / bacon / skin)
groups.nuance_zh: kink: 形成急剧扭折或卡顿硬结 (hose / cable / hair) · crinkle: 形成微细且发出沙沙声的皱纹 (foil / paper / eyes) · frizz: 毛躁蓬乱地密集卷曲 (hair / fleece / synthetic fiber) · frizzle: 经受高温干煎而焦卷焦脆 (bacon / edges / hair) · crisp: 边缘变干、变脆且挺立 (leaves / bacon / skin)

groups.name: Curse & Damn · 咒骂与诅咒 (Execrate, Condemn, Imprecate)
groups.tip: 用恶毒言语发泄愤怒咒骂

items.def_zh: 咒骂，诅咒；判处……下地狱；严厉批评，指责
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To express anger or frustration by cursing someone or something. 2. (in religion) To condemn someone to eternal punishment in hell. 3. To condemn, ruin, or heavily criticize something.
items.ex_en: He muttered an oath to damn the bad luck ruining everything.
items.ex_zh: 他低声咒骂了一句，诅咒这毁掉一切的倒霉透顶的运气。

items.def_en: To call upon a supernatural power to inflict harm, suffering, or disaster upon someone
items.ex_en: The angry sorceress attempted to curse the treacherous prince for eternity.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的女巫企图施下恶咒，让那个奸诈的王子万劫不复。

items.def_en: To express complete disapproval of someone or declare them doomed to a severe spiritual or fatal punishment
items.ex_en: Ecclesiastical authorities moved to condemn the unrepentant heretic to perpetual damnation.
items.ex_zh: 宗教当局决定谴责该冥顽不灵的异端分子并判处其遭受永恒天罚。

items.def_en: To formally invoke evil, disaster, or divine curses against someone
items.ex_en: The dying prophet knelt to imprecate vengeance on his ruthless persecutors.
items.ex_zh: 濒死的先知跪倒在地，祈求降下天谴复仇于残酷的迫害人。

items.def_en: To feel or express intense loathing for, or to utter fierce curses against someone or something
items.ex_en: Citizens gathered in the square to execrate the brutal dictator who ruined their country.
items.ex_zh: 市民们聚集在广场上，痛骂毁灭了他们国家的残暴独裁者。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on invoking supernatural, eternal, or absolute ruin upon a target, condemning them spiritually or expressing scathing, virulent denunciation.
groups.summary_zh: 施加毁灭性诅咒、宣告神圣绝罚或表达强烈的唾弃与谴责。
groups.desc_en: Denotes formal, solemn, or righteous verbal invocation of doom, divine punishment, or total condemnation against an entity, distinct from petty cursing through its institutional or moral weight.
groups.desc_zh: 指庄严、严正或出于道德愤怒而降下灾厄、祈求神罚或予以彻底定罪，区别于市井粗口，具有宗教、法度或道义分量。
groups.nuance_en: damn: doom to eternal punishment or complete ruin (soul / critic / arrogance) · curse: invoke supernatural harm or disaster upon (enemy / fate / family) · condemn: officially pronounce guilty or utterly unfit (violence / building / criminal) · imprecate: invoke evil or calamity upon someone by oath (vengeance / doom / curses) · execrate: declare utterly detestable and abhorrent (tyrant / treason / cruelty)
groups.nuance_zh: damn: 判定永坠地狱或彻底毁绝 (soul / critic / arrogance) · curse: 祈求超自然力量降灾于人 (enemy / fate / family) · condemn: 官方定罪或极力谴责 (violence / building / criminal) · imprecate: 念咒祈降灾祸恶疾于他人 (vengeance / doom / curses) · execrate: 强烈痛恨斥责为万恶之源 (tyrant / treason / cruelty)

groups.name: Curse & Hex · 施咒与下蛊 (Hex, Curse, Bewitch, Bedevil)
groups.tip: 施展巫术下蛊，念咒招致灾祸与不幸

items.def_en: To utter wishful harm or use magic power to bring disaster, illness, or perpetual misfortune upon someone
items.ex_en: The dying sorcerer cursed the entire bloodline with eternal misfortune and crippling disease.
items.ex_zh: 垂死巫师对整个血脉下咒，让他们遭受永恒不幸与残疾的折磨。

items.def_en: To chant or perform magic rituals that bring a targeted person under magical control or harm
items.ex_en: The village witch put a dark spell on the hunter, robbing his senses.
items.ex_zh: 村里的女巫对猎人施了黑魔法，夺走了他的神智。

items.def_en: To put a magic curse or evil spell on someone or something.
items.ex_en: Old legends claim an angry spirit hexed the crop fields with endless drought.
items.ex_zh: 古老传说称，愤怒的怨灵对农田施下诅咒，带来了无尽干旱。

items.def_en: To cast a magical spell over someone, or control their mind and emotions through enchantment
items.ex_en: The enchanting woodland spirit seemed to bewitch every traveler who wandered into her realm.
items.ex_zh: 迷人的森林精灵似乎给每一位误入其领地的旅人都施了魅惑之术。

items.def_en: To torment, harass, or plague persistently as if driven by demonic or sinister forces
items.ex_en: Dark nightmares and phantom whispers continued to bedevil the lonely scholar throughout the winter.
items.ex_zh: 整个冬天，阴暗的噩梦与虚幻的低语如恶魔附体般持续折磨着孤独的学者。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses invoking supernatural malice, incantations, or dark magic to inflict misfortune, illness, or harm upon a targeted victim.
groups.summary_zh: 施用黑魔法、巫术或恶咒，使特定目标遭受灾祸、疾病或厄运。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the affliction of targets through magical, occult, or lingering sinister influences, distinguishing itself from verbal scolding by focusing on persistent metaphysical torment or enchantment.
groups.desc_zh: 指施加巫术、妖法或难以捉摸的持续恶运于目标身上，区别于口头谩骂，聚焦于超自然纠缠、魅惑或持久困扰。
groups.nuance_en: curse: blight with lingering supernatural misfortune (dynasty / treasure / life) · put a spell on: subject to magical influence or fascination (victim / audience / village) · hex: cast an unlucky or malevolent charm on (opponents / machinery / team) · bewitch: enchant completely, clouding reason by charm (spectators / prince / lover) · bedevil: torment persistently with elusive troubles (project / economy / negotiations)
groups.nuance_zh: curse: 降下殃及长久的超自然诅咒 (dynasty / treasure / life) · put a spell on: 施展法术诱导或使之着迷 (victim / audience / village) · hex: 施展恶蛊破运坏事 (opponents / machinery / team) · bewitch: 施魅惑之术使人心智迷乱 (spectators / prince / lover) · bedevil: 如恶魔缠身般令问题棘手频发 (project / economy / negotiations)

groups.name: Curse & Malign · 咒骂与咒怨 (Revile, Denounce, Rail)
groups.tip: 污言秽语发泄咒怨

items.def_en: To strongly criticize or accuse someone publicly, branding their conduct as wicked or shameful
items.ex_en: Human rights groups openly denounced the government's unlawful detention of peaceful political dissidents.
items.ex_zh: 人权组织公开谴责该国政府对和平异见人士实施非法拘禁。

items.def_en: To speak or write about someone or something with immense hostility and biting bitterness
items.ex_en: The editorial inveighed bitterly against the rising tide of corruption among high-ranking officials.
items.ex_zh: 这篇社论言辞激烈地猛烈抨击高级官员中日益猖獗的腐败风气。

items.def_en: To protest, scold, or complain against someone or something using angry, impassioned language
items.ex_en: The bitter man railed at his unfair fate during the long, sleepless night.
items.ex_zh: 在漫长而难眠的长夜里，怨恨的男子怒斥自己不公的命运。

items.def_zh: 咒骂，辱骂；诅咒；使遭殃，折磨
items.def_en: 1. To use offensive words or profanities in anger. 2. To express a wish that evil, harm, or misfortune happen to someone. 3. (often passive) To cause someone continuous hardship, pain, or suffering.
items.ex_en: The disappointed driver cursed his terrible luck after another flat tire on the highway.
items.ex_zh: 高速公路上车胎又瘪了，沮丧的司机咒骂起自己的倒霉运气。

items.def_en: To criticize someone in an abusive, furiously insulting, or venomous manner
items.ex_en: Angry protesters reviled the disgraced politician as he walked silently into the courtroom.
items.ex_zh: 当那位身败名裂的政客默默步入法庭时，愤怒的抗议者对他破口辱骂。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on aggressive verbal assaults aimed at degrading or defaming others through venomous tirades, sustained verbal abuse, and bitter recrimination.
groups.summary_zh: 通过恶毒抨击、公开辱骂或尖刻责难来宣泄怨恨与诋毁他人。
groups.desc_en: Denotes prolonged, bitter, and vocal condemnation motivated by deep animosity, contrasting with brief exclamations by emphasizing sustained public or interpersonal vilification.
groups.desc_zh: 指怀着深切敌意或义愤进行持久、恶毒且公开的口诛笔伐，区别于短暂骂娘，侧重连珠炮式的道德声讨与名誉诋毁。
groups.nuance_en: denounce: publicly proclaim as evil, corrupt, or illegal (corruption / treaty / tyranny) · inveigh against: attack with formal, impassioned, oratorical fury (injustice / decadence / regime) · rail at: complain loudly, furiously, and persistently (fate / incompetence / establishment) · curse: utter malignant vitriol against (adversary / judges / heavens) · revile: subject to abusive, contemptuous insult (politicians / press / traitors)
groups.nuance_zh: denounce: 公开痛斥并宣告违法不道德 (corruption / treaty / tyranny) · inveigh against: 义正词严地慷慨声讨痛批 (injustice / decadence / regime) · rail at: 满腹牢骚地持久怒骂控诉 (fate / incompetence / establishment) · curse: 咬牙切齿地口吐恶毒怨咒 (adversary / judges / heavens) · revile: 极尽轻蔑下流之词肆意辱骂 (politicians / press / traitors)

groups.name: Curse & Swear · 咒骂与粗口 (Cuss, Blaspheme, Exclaim)
groups.tip: 气极败坏口出恶言甚至诅咒

items.def_en: To direct crude insults and profanities verbally toward an individual or target
items.ex_en: He lost his temper and swore at the referee during the match.
items.ex_zh: 比赛中他一时失控，冲裁判爆了粗口。

items.def_en: To utter offensive, angry expletives or swear words in response to a mishap or irritation
items.ex_en: He cursed loudly when he accidentally smashed his sore thumb with the heavy hammer.
items.ex_zh: 当他不小心用重锤砸伤剧痛的大拇指时，他大声咒骂起来。

items.def_en: (informal) To use vulgar, offensive, or swear words, especially in irritation
items.ex_en: My dad started to cuss angrily when the lawnmower engine refused to start.
items.ex_zh: 割草机引擎发动不起来时，我爸开始恼火地骂起脏话。

items.def_en: 1. (+ at) To use offensive, vulgar, or obscene language. 2. To make a solemn, formal promise or declare that something is true under oath.
items.ex_en: The frustrated mechanic began to swear angrily at the stubborn, rusted engine bolt.
items.ex_zh: 沮丧的修理工对着那个顽固生锈的引擎螺栓破口大骂起来。

items.def_en: To speak irreverently or profanely about sacred things or use religious terms as vulgar oaths
items.ex_en: The zealous priest warned the parishioners never to blaspheme the sacred name of God.
items.ex_zh: 热忱的神父告诫教区居民绝不可亵渎上帝的神圣之名。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures the spontaneous or habitual utterance of crude, taboo, or profane language to vent acute emotion, frustration, or pain, distinguished from ritualized invocations of supernatural harm.
groups.summary_zh: 使用粗鄙、忌讳或侮辱性字眼宣泄愤怒、挫折与剧烈情绪。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the impulsive venting of profanity, taboo oaths, or sacrilegious words, contrasting with structured condemnation by highlighting emotional catharsis, vulgarity, or taboo violation.
groups.desc_zh: 指因情绪失控而脱口而出粗言秽语、渎神咒誓或市井脏话，区别于义正词严的指责，强调口头情绪宣泄与禁忌破坏。
groups.nuance_en: swear at: direct raw vulgar expletives aggressively at someone (referee / driver / police) · curse: voice coarse or venomous malice (breath / pain / adversary) · cuss: use low, colloquial foul language (colloquial / loudly / irritation) · swear: use profane or obscene language generally (profanely / constantly / shock) · blaspheme: speak irreverently against God or sacred things (God / church / faith)
groups.nuance_zh: swear at: 冲着特定对象直接爆粗开骂 (referee / driver / police) · curse: 因痛或恼怒而低声或恶毒咒骂 (breath / pain / adversary) · cuss: 口语中随性吐露市井脏字 (colloquial / loudly / irritation) · swear: 习惯性或情急下使用亵渎秽语 (profanely / constantly / shock) · blaspheme: 出言侮辱亵渎神明或圣物 (God / church / faith)

groups.name: Curve & Arc · 弯曲与拱起 (Arc, Curve, Arch, Bow)
groups.tip: 轨迹或形体呈弧形

items.def_en: Form a smooth continuous bend or follow a rounded path
items.ex_en: The scenic mountain highway curves gently around the base of the misty hills.
items.ex_zh: 这条风景优美的盘山公路顺着薄雾笼罩的山麓优美地弯曲延伸。
items.ex2_en: The skilled pitcher curved the baseball sharply across the outside corner of the plate.
items.ex2_zh: 技术娴熟的投手将棒球猛烈划出一道弧线，穿过本垒板的外角。

items.def_en: Bend into a curved shape under pressure or along its length
items.ex_en: The ancient wooden ceiling beams began to bow under the immense weight of snow.
items.ex_zh: 古老的木质屋顶横梁在大雪的重压下开始弯曲成弓形。
items.ex2_en: The relentless heavy winds bowed the supple young saplings nearly flat against the hillside.
items.ex2_zh: 无情的狂风把柔韧的幼树吹得几乎平贴在山坡上弯曲下去。

items.def_zh: 呈弧形移动；形成弧形，拱起；（电）产生电弧
items.def_en: to move, curve, or form into the shape of an arch or a curved line; to produce an electric arc
items.ex_en: The high fly ball arced gracefully through the summer sky toward deep center field.
items.ex_zh: 高飞球在夏日晴空中划出一道优美的弧线，飞向中外野深处。

items.def_en: Curve smoothly into the shape of an arch or bridge
items.ex_en: Tall stone bridges arch gracefully over the calm canals of the historic European town.
items.ex_zh: 高耸的石桥优美地横拱在欧洲历史名城平静的运河之上。
items.ex2_en: The gymnast arched her flexible back smoothly during the spectacular floor routine.
items.ex2_zh: 体操运动员在精彩的自由体操表演中流畅地拱起柔韧的后背。

items.def_en: Form an arched or domed roof or curve high over an open space
items.ex_en: Magnificent ribbed stone arches vault high over the grand cathedral's central nave.
items.ex_zh: 宏伟的肋骨石拱高耸起成穹顶状，覆于宏大大教堂的中殿之上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict moving along a curved trajectory or assuming a stationary convex, semicircular, or bowed contour.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体沿弯曲轨迹运动，或自身形成弧形、弓形姿态。
groups.desc_en: Denotes assuming or creating a smooth, sweeping curvilinear trajectory or curved structural profile, contrasting with straight lines or angular bends by its fluid, gradual curvature.
groups.desc_zh: 指形成平滑连续的圆弧形轨迹或弓形结构，与直线或尖锐折角形成鲜明对比，强调曲度的连贯性与几何张力。
groups.nuance_en: curve: deviate continuously from straightness (road / spine / horizon) · bow: bend downward or inward under flexural load (beam / head / branches) · arc: trace a high parabolic flightpath (ball / spark / trajectory) · arch: form a proud, curved bridge or canopy overhead (eyebrows / bridge / cat's back) · vault: leap over gracefully in an arc, or construct arched roofs (fence / ceiling / nave)
groups.nuance_zh: curve: 平缓偏离直线形成弯曲弧度 (road / spine / horizon) · bow: 弯折向内或因重压向下垂弯 (beam / head / branches) · arc: 在空中划出抛物线状轨迹 (ball / spark / trajectory) · arch: 高耸隆起呈拱桥或穹顶状 (eyebrows / bridge / cat's back) · vault: 撑跃弧线飞越，或筑就拱形高顶 (fence / ceiling / nave)

groups.name: Cushion & Dampen · 缓冲与减震 (Buffer, Soften, Dampen)
groups.tip: 加设缓冲垫防撞击

items.def_en: To take in and dissipate the force of a collision, shock, or liquid without shattering
items.ex_en: The vehicle's reinforced front bumper is designed to absorb high-impact collisions safely.
items.ex_zh: 该车加固的前保险杠旨在安全地吸收强烈碰撞的冲击力。

items.def_en: (+ against/from) To protect someone or something from the harmful impact of a force or sudden change
items.ex_en: Generous emergency savings helped buffer the struggling family from unexpected medical expenses.
items.ex_zh: 丰厚的应急积蓄帮助这个困境中的家庭缓冲了突如其来的医疗支出。

items.def_zh: 起缓冲作用，减轻……的震动（或影响）；加垫褥于
items.def_en: 1. (+ against/from) To soften the force of a physical blow, or protect someone from the harsh impact of a shock or loss.
items.ex_en: Thick rubber padding cushions the fragile equipment from sudden drops and harsh shocks.
items.ex_zh: 厚实的橡胶衬垫起到了缓冲作用，保护易碎设备免受意外跌落和剧烈震动的损伤。

items.def_en: To make a physical blow, fall, or harsh emotional outcome less severe or devastating
items.ex_en: A pile of autumn leaves helped soften the boy's fall from the tree.
items.ex_zh: 一堆落叶减缓了男孩从树上跌落时的撞击。
items.ex2_en: His rigid posture began to soften noticeably as the tense discussion finally concluded peacefully.
items.ex2_zh: 随着紧张的讨论最终和平结束，他僵硬的姿态明显缓和了下来。

items.def_en: To lessen or diminish the physical force, vibration, or intensity of a blow or shock
items.ex_en: The vehicle's new hydraulic suspension system effectively dampens violent road vibrations.
items.ex_zh: 该车辆新型液压悬挂系统有效减弱了剧烈的路面震动。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote softening or mitigating the mechanical force of an impact, or shielding people and systems from the jarring consequences of shocks or setbacks.
groups.summary_zh: 减轻物理冲击碰撞，或削弱负面打击与震荡的影响。
groups.desc_en: Denotes attenuating, isolating, or diffusing kinetic energy, mechanical shock, or negative impact, contrasting with mere 'stopping' by emphasizing progressive softness and dissipation.
groups.desc_zh: 指对机械冲撞、动能震动或负面后果进行衰减、隔离与分散，区别于生硬的“阻挡”，强调渐进式软化与能量耗散。
groups.nuance_en: absorb: take in and dissipate kinetic or acoustic force entirely (shock / vibration / blow) · buffer: isolate and protect against jarring interference (impact / fluctuations / economy) · cushion: soften the blow through yielding, protective mass (fall / blow / transition) · soften: diminish harshness, stiffness, or blunt force (landing / blow / tone) · dampen: suppress the amplitude of oscillations or acoustic resonance (vibrations / noise / enthusiasm)
groups.nuance_zh: absorb: 全面吸收并耗散能量或冲击 (shock / vibration / blow) · buffer: 充当中介隔离震荡并平抑剧烈变动 (impact / fluctuations / economy) · cushion: 依托柔软承垫化解下落或打击力 (fall / blow / transition) · soften: 减弱硬度、猛烈度或生硬语气 (landing / blow / tone) · dampen: 阻尼衰减机械振幅或声学共振 (vibrations / noise / enthusiasm)

groups.name: Customize & Tailor · 定制与按需调整 (Tailor, Adapt, Personalize)
groups.tip: 调整定制以改进原貌

items.def_en: To alter something slightly so that it fits a new purpose, user, or situation
items.ex_en: The clever teacher adapted the complex lesson plan to suit elementary school students.
items.ex_zh: 聪明的老师对复杂的教案进行了改编，以适应小学生的认知水平。

items.def_zh: 个性化设计，赋予个人特色
items.def_en: To design, alter, or mark something so that it reflects someone's personal taste
items.ex_en: Customers can personalize their new leather wallets by embossing their initials on top.
items.ex_zh: 顾客可以通过在上方压印姓名首字母，来个性化定制自己的新皮夹。

items.def_en: To furnish, modify, or equip a room, vehicle, or vessel with custom equipment
items.ex_en: The laboratory was fitted out with the latest analytical instruments.
items.ex_zh: 该实验室配备了最先进的分析仪器。

items.def_en: To adapt, modify, or design something so it precisely meets someone's requirements
items.ex_en: Our instructors tailor each training session to meet the individual athlete's goals.
items.ex_zh: 我们的教练量身制定每一次训练课程，以符合运动员个人的目标。

items.def_zh: 定制，按需制作，根据个人需要调整
items.def_en: To modify or build something to suit the specific needs or preferences of an individual or customer.
items.ex_en: The software allows users to customize the user interface according to personal preferences.
items.ex_zh: 该软件允许用户根据个人喜好定制和调整用户界面。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail adapting, reshaping, or personalizing goods, software, or services to match the unique criteria, preferences, or specifications of a user.
groups.summary_zh: 指依特定用户或需求改动、调制产品设计与功能，使其量身契合。
groups.desc_en: Denotes modifying an existing product, service, or system to precisely match unique user specifications or physical dimensions, contrasting with mass-producing by its bespoke specificity.
groups.desc_zh: 指为契合特定用户的独特规格、场景或物理体型而对产品与系统进行个性化调校，区别于流水线“通造”，强调量体裁衣的定制感。
groups.nuance_en: adapt: adjust to fit new functional conditions or media (novel / system / species) · personalize: mark or style with unique personal identity (gifts / settings / service) · fit out: equip and furnish interior space for specialized use (ship / office / shop) · tailor: strategically design to fit precise, exacting needs (strategy / curriculum / suit) · customize: modify components to user-chosen bespoke specs (settings / car / software)
groups.nuance_zh: adapt: 改造以适应新的环境或用途 (novel / system / species) · personalize: 融入个人偏好或个人标识进行个性化 (gifts / settings / service) · fit out: 为特定空间完备配置设施与装备 (ship / office / shop) · tailor: 精准考量目标痛点进行量体裁衣 (strategy / curriculum / suit) · customize: 依据客户选型调整软硬件规格 (settings / car / software)

groups.name: Cycle & Treadle · 踩踏踏板与骑车 (Pedal, Cycle, Treadle)
groups.tip: 脚踏踏板驱动车辆前行

items.def_en: To travel or commute using a bicycle or tricycle
items.ex_en: Many dedicated commuters choose to cycle across the city to reduce traffic congestion.
items.ex_zh: 许多忠实的通勤者选择骑自行车穿城而过，以减少交通拥堵。

items.def_en: To ride or push a wheeled vehicle such as a bicycle across a surface
items.ex_en: He wheeled his heavily loaded bicycle down the steep dirt path into town.
items.ex_zh: 他推着满载重物的自行车沿着陡峭的土路走进了镇里。
items.ex2_en: A flock of startled seagulls wheeled gracefully overhead against the clear blue sky.
items.ex2_zh: 一群受惊的海鸥在晴朗的蓝天下优雅地盘旋转圈。

items.def_en: To ride a bicycle as recreation, sport, or daily transport
items.ex_en: During the pleasant summer vacation, they often bike along scenic coastal paths.
items.ex_zh: 在惬意的暑假期间，他们经常沿着风景迷人的海岸小径骑车。

items.def_en: To operate or drive a bicycle, boat, or machine by pushing pedals with your feet.
items.ex_en: The exhausted cyclist had to pedal hard up the steep, winding mountain road.
items.ex_zh: 精疲力竭的自行车手不得不使劲蹬着脚踏板翻越陡峭盘旋的山路。

items.def_zh: 踩踏板（操作缝纫机等工具）
items.def_en: To operate an engine, sewing machine, or loom by working a foot-operated lever rhythmically
items.ex_en: The solitary weaver treadled the wooden loom rhythmically throughout the peaceful afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 孤独的织布工在宁静的午后富有节奏地踩动着木质织布机的踏板。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail propelling a vehicle or machine through the rhythmic human exertion of pushing foot pedals, ranging from riding traditional bicycles to operating foot-driven pedal machinery.
groups.summary_zh: 指双脚交替踩踏板以驱动自行车、小艇或脚踏机械向前行进或运转。
groups.desc_en: Denotes propelling oneself or operating mechanical machinery by alternating rhythmic foot power on pedals, contrasting with passive riding by emphasizing bodily cadence and mechanical transmission.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过双脚交替踩踏踏板产生机械驱动力进行前行或操作机器，区别于被动乘车，强调人体踏力与机械传动的结合。
groups.nuance_en: cycle: ride a bicycle across journeys (commute / countryside / miles) · wheel: push or steer a wheeled device alongside oneself (bicycle / luggage / barrow) · bike: travel informally via two wheels (work / trails / around) · pedal: push foot cranks actively to drive motion (furious / uphill / bicycle) · treadle: rhythmically depress a foot-lever to power machinery (sewing machine / lathe / loom)
groups.nuance_zh: cycle: 较为正式地进行自行车骑行锻炼或通勤 (commute / countryside / miles) · wheel: 推行、推滚轮式器械或沿路推车 (bicycle / luggage / barrow) · bike: 口语中轻松自如地骑单车出行 (work / trails / around) · pedal: 专注于脚部对脚踏曲柄的施力踩踏 (furious / uphill / bicycle) · treadle: 踩踏工业或缝纫机脚踏板以驱动机械 (sewing machine / lathe / loom)

groups.name: Dabble & Toy With · 涉足与浅尝 (Toy, Dip Into, Meddle)
groups.tip: 抱着玩票心态浅尝辄止地涉猎

items.def_en: 1. (+ in/with) To take a casual, superficial interest in an activity or subject without serious commitment. 2. To splash hands or feet gently in water.
items.ex_en: During his college years, my brother liked to dabble in oil painting.
items.ex_zh: 大学期间，我哥哥喜欢浅尝辄止地涉猎油画创作。

items.def_en: To read, study, or take part in something briefly and selectively
items.ex_en: She decided to dip into the thick historical novel during her lunch break.
items.ex_zh: 她决定在午休时间翻阅一下那本厚重的历史小说。

items.def_zh: 随便玩玩，漫不经心地对待
items.def_en: To engage with an idea, skill, or enterprise casually without firm commitment
items.ex_en: The wealthy entrepreneur only toyed with the concept of opening a coffee shop.
items.ex_zh: 那位富有的企业家只是随便动过开一家咖啡馆的念头，并未认真投入。

items.def_en: (+ with) To make amateurish or experimental adjustments without structured expertise
items.ex_en: Grandpa loves to tinker with old electronic clocks in his dusty garage workshop.
items.ex_zh: 爷爷喜欢在布满灰尘的车库工作间里摆弄那些旧电子钟表。

items.def_en: (+ in/with) To interfere inappropriately in matters where one has neither right nor expertise
items.ex_en: She strictly warned her neighbor not to meddle in private family affairs.
items.ex_zh: 她严厉警告邻居不要插手她家里的私事。

groups.summary_en: Describes participating in a field, hobby, or domain superficially or casually without professional discipline, deep devotion, or serious intent.
groups.summary_zh: 指非专业、浅尝辄止地涉足某一领域、爱好或事务。
groups.desc_en: Denotes engaging with a craft, idea, or domain superficially or playfully without deep mastery, professional commitment, or solemn intent, contrasting with serious, dedicated practice.
groups.desc_zh: 指浅尝辄止或漫不经心地涉足某个知识领域、技艺或事物，缺乏长久投入与专业敬畏，区别于深度的钻研与专精。
groups.nuance_en: dabble: engage casually as an amateur without serious intent (arts / politics / stocks) · dip into: sample a portion of text or reserves lightly (book / savings / literature) · toy with: entertain a whimsical idea or object indecisively (idea / concept / food) · tinker: make amateurish, experimental small repairs (engine / gadget / code) · meddle: interfere intrusively where one has no business (affairs / election / dispute)
groups.nuance_zh: dabble: 业余爱好者式地浮泛涉足 (arts / politics / stocks) · dip into: 走马观花地翻阅或略微动用储备 (book / savings / literature) · toy with: 漫不经心地盘算考量某设想 (idea / concept / food) · tinker: 业余摆弄敲打修修补补 (engine / gadget / code) · meddle: 擅自插手干涉无关人事 (affairs / election / dispute)

groups.name: Dam & Embank Waterways · 阻挡与筑堤 (Dyke, Dam, Levee)
groups.tip: 筑起堤坝阻拦水流物料

items.def_en: To build a barrier across a river or stream to hold back or direct the flow of water
items.ex_en: Local authorities constructed a barrier to dam the rushing river before the storm.
items.ex_zh: 地方当局在暴风雨来临前筑起一道屏障来阻挡汹涌的河水。

items.def_en: To enclose, confine, or protect a river, road, or low-lying land with a bank of earth or stone
items.ex_en: Ancient engineers carefully embanked the winding river to protect fertile plains from flooding.
items.ex_zh: 古代工程师精心为蜿蜒的河流筑起堤岸，保护肥沃的平原免遭洪水侵袭。

items.def_en: To construct an earthen embankment along the edge of a river or waterway to prevent flooding
items.ex_en: Townspeople labored together to levee the rising creek before heavy floodwaters submerged homes.
items.ex_zh: 在暴涨的洪水淹没房屋之前，市民们合力修筑防洪堤来阻拦上升的溪水。

items.def_zh: 筑护堤；在…周围设拦泥堤
items.def_en: To construct an embankment or retaining wall around an area to contain fluid or soil run-off
items.ex_en: Plant workers quickly bunded the chemical storage yard to contain any hazardous spills.
items.ex_zh: 工厂工人们迅速在化学品储藏区周围筑起护堤，以拦截任何有害泄漏物。

items.def_en: 1. (chiefly British) To enclose, defend, or protect land with a dyke or embankment.
items.ex_en: The coastal community resolved to dyke the low marshes against invading spring tides.
items.ex_zh: 沿海社区决定给低洼沼泽筑堤防守，以抵御汹涌而来的春季潮汐。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote building civil engineering barriers, dikes, levees, and weirs to retain, divert, or block bodies of water, controlling floods or reclaiming submerged land.
groups.summary_zh: 修建堤坝或挡水墙阻隔水流、控制水位或防洪排涝。
groups.desc_en: Denotes constructing hydraulic earthworks or barriers along rivers, canals, or coasts to control, retain, or redirect water, contrasting with generic blockage by its engineered flood-control purpose.
groups.desc_zh: 指沿河流、湖海修筑防洪土石水工屏障以阻截、围蓄或引导水流，区别于普通“堵塞”，强调水利工程性的防洪排涝与治水筑堤。
groups.nuance_en: dam: construct a transverse barrier to impound waterflow (river / stream / tears) · embank: enclose or reinforce waterways with raised earthen slopes (river / canal / railway) · levee: build broad earthen mounds along rivers to prevent flood spills (riverbanks / floodplain / delta) · bund: construct a containment dike to contain liquid spills or irrigation (field / oil tanks / coastline) · dyke: build ditch-wall defenses to keep sea or floods off lowlands (lowlands / marshes / polder)
groups.nuance_zh: dam: 拦河筑坝截流蓄水 (river / stream / tears) · embank: 为河道或路基两岸夯筑斜坡护堤 (river / canal / railway) · levee: 修筑平原防汛大堤以防漫溢 (riverbanks / floodplain / delta) · bund: 构筑田埂防漏围堰或油罐防溢池 (field / oil tanks / coastline) · dyke: 筑防海大堤以御潮侵垦荒低洼地 (lowlands / marshes / polder)

groups.name: Dance & Groove · 舞动与跳舞 (Disco, Dance, Groove, Boogie)
groups.tip: 伴随节拍翩翩起舞摆动

items.def_en: (informal) To dance energetically and rhythmically to pop, rock, or dance music
items.ex_en: Everyone crowded onto the packed dance floor to boogie until late at night.
items.ex_zh: 大家都挤在拥挤的舞池里，欢快地跳舞直到深夜。

items.def_en: (informal) To dance or move rhythmically and enjoyably along with popular music
items.ex_en: The happy crowd began to groove together along with the smooth jazz rhythm.
items.ex_zh: 欢快的人群开始随着轻柔流畅的爵士乐节奏尽情律动。

items.def_en: 1. (informal, dated) To dance to disco music, especially at a nightclub.
items.ex_en: In the nineteen seventies, young people would often disco under dazzling mirrored balls.
items.ex_zh: 在二十世纪七十年代，年轻人们经常在耀眼的镜面球下大跳迪斯科舞。

items.def_en: To dance fast, energetic swing or rock-and-roll dances
items.ex_en: Dozens of lively couples came out onto the hall floor to jive cheerfully.
items.ex_zh: 数十对活力满满的舞伴来到大厅舞池中，欢快地跳起吉特巴舞。

items.def_en: To dance with rapid circular or swirling movements of the hips and body
items.ex_en: Performers in colorful costumes gyrate wildly to the thunderous beat of festival drums.
items.ex_zh: 身穿华丽服饰的表演者随着节日鼓点的震天轰鸣狂野地扭动身躯。

groups.summary_en: Pertains to rhythmic bodily movement executed to musical beats, particularly informal, club, or party dancing. 'Groove' and 'boogie' evoke spontaneous, rhythmic, and joyful movement.
groups.summary_zh: 指随节奏舞动身躯，尤指在派对或夜店随现代流行乐起舞。
groups.desc_en: Denotes moving the body rhythmically and expressively to a musical beat, particularly in popular, social, or nightclub idioms, contrasting with formal theatrical dance by its recreational hedonism.
groups.desc_zh: 指在社交、派对或夜总会情境中随流行乐节奏自由律动起舞，与学院派或舞台戏剧舞蹈相对，侧重尽情摇摆与沉浸式享乐。
groups.nuance_en: boogie: dance enthusiastically and fast to pop, rock, or funk (night away / floor / music) · groove: sync deeply and effortlessly into the musical pocket (rhythm / beat / tunes) · disco: dance in flashy, stylized seventies retro-club fashion (night / outfit / moves) · jive: perform bouncy, energetic swing and rock-and-roll footwork (floor / rhythm / music) · gyrate: rotate hips and torso with sexually charged, circular motion (hips / crowd / stage)
groups.nuance_zh: boogie: 随欢快流行乐尽情快节奏摇摆 (night away / floor / music) · groove: 极致契合节拍自如顺滑地律动 (rhythm / beat / tunes) · disco: 随迪斯科舞曲跳复古夸张热舞 (night / outfit / moves) · jive: 踩着摇滚爵士乐步点跳轻快牛仔步 (floor / rhythm / music) · gyrate: 随着伴奏煽情地旋转扭动腰跨 (hips / crowd / stage)

groups.name: Dart & Pop Out · 突进与窜出 (Pop Up, Dart, Burst Out)
groups.tip: 迅雷不及掩耳窜出

items.def_en: Emerge or become visible suddenly and unexpectedly from a hidden or enclosed space
items.ex_en: She just popped out to the post office to mail a parcel.
items.ex_zh: 她刚出去去邮局寄个包裹，一会儿就回来。

items.raw_cluster: 突然移动与跳出 Pop & Dart
items.def_zh: 突然出现，迅速窜出；突然蹦出；发出砰声
items.def_en: 1. To move, appear, or come out suddenly and unexpectedly. 2. To make or cause to make a short, sharp explosive sound.
items.ex_en: A tiny brown rabbit popped out from the dense green hedge unexpectedly.
items.ex_zh: 一只褐色的小兔子出其不意地从浓密的绿树篱中窜了出来。
items.ex2_en: The playful boy popped colorful balloons with a sharp needle during the noisy party.
items.ex2_zh: 淘气的男孩在吵闹的派对上用利针刺破彩色的气球。

items.def_en: Move rapidly or leap upward or forward in a single, sudden energetic motion
items.ex_en: The athletic cat suddenly sprang forward to catch the fluttering butterfly outside.
items.ex_zh: 那只敏捷的猫突然纵身跃出，扑向外面翩翩起舞的蝴蝶。

items.def_en: Move suddenly, rapidly, and abruptly in a specific direction
items.ex_en: The frightened little deer darted deep into the thick forest when branches snapped.
items.ex_zh: 树枝折断的声响传来，受惊的小鹿猛冲进幽密的森林深处。

items.def_en: Rush, spring, or break out suddenly and forcefully from confinement or an enclosure
items.ex_en: Cheering soccer players burst out of the locker room onto the sunlit field.
items.ex_zh: 欢呼雀跃的足球运动员们猛然冲出更衣室，奔向阳光灿烂的球场。

groups.summary_en: This frame denotes sudden, abrupt emergence or brisk springing motions, where a person or object appears, shoots out, or darts forth without warning.
groups.summary_zh: 指冷不防、出其不意地快速窜出或突兀显现。
groups.desc_en: Denotes sudden, explosive, or rapid emergence outward or forward from a hidden, confined, or stationary position, contrasting with linear travel through abrupt acceleration or surprising visibility.
groups.desc_zh: 指从隐匿、封闭或静止状态中突如其来地向外或向前窜出，区别于平稳位移，强调起步极快、毫无征兆的爆发感与惊奇感。
