groups.nuance_en: pop out: emerge suddenly and unexpectedly into view (sun / toast / eyes) · pop: make an abrupt, quick short appearance (head in / shop / blister) · spring: leap rapidly from tension or concealment (trap / ambush / feet) · dart: shoot forward with linear, arrow-like speed (room / glance / doorway) · burst out: erupt violently outward shattering containment (room / flames / tears)
groups.nuance_zh: pop out: 突兀冒头并惊奇地映入眼帘 (sun / toast / eyes) · pop: 稍作探头或简短闪现进出 (head in / shop / blister) · spring: 如弹簧般弹跃而起或脱困暴发 (trap / ambush / feet) · dart: 犹如离弦之箭般敏捷急窜 (room / glance / doorway) · burst out: 冲破束缚炸裂式破门涌出 (room / flames / tears)

groups.name: Data Transmission · 双工传输与信道传送 (Duplex, Multiplex, Channel)
groups.tip: 通信设备双向传送信号，交换数据指令

items.def_en: To direct signals, data, or electronic impulses along a particular path
items.ex_en: The secure network switch channels digital signals efficiently toward their intended server destination.
items.ex_zh: 该安全网络交换机将数字信号高效地定向输送至目标服务器端。

items.def_en: To send or receive continuous audio or video data over a network in real time
items.ex_en: The popular online platform streams high-definition movies smoothly across various mobile devices.
items.ex_zh: 这个热门在线平台能够在各类移动设备上流畅地实时传输高清电影。
items.ex2_en: Clear water streamed steadily from the broken municipal pipe onto the bustling downtown street.
items.ex2_zh: 清澈的水不断从破损的市政管道流向繁忙的闹市街道。

items.def_en: To transmit multiple signals or messages simultaneously over a single channel
items.ex_en: Advanced telecommunication systems multiplex numerous digital channels through a single fiber-optic strand.
items.ex_zh: 先进的电信系统通过单根光纤多路复用传输众多数字信道。

items.def_en: To send data packets or communication streams along a specific network path
items.ex_en: Core internet routers carefully route critical data packets along the fastest available pathway.
items.ex_zh: 核心互联网路由器精细地将关键数据包沿着最快捷的可用路径进行路由传输。

items.def_zh: 进行双工通信（或传输）；双面打印
items.def_en: 1. (telecommunications) To transmit signals or data in both directions simultaneously. 2. (computing) To print on both sides of a sheet of paper.
items.ex_en: Modern transceivers duplex high-frequency microwave data across vast oceanic communication links simultaneously.
items.ex_zh: 现代收发器可以在广阔的海洋通信链路上同时进行高频微波数据的双工传输。

groups.summary_en: Technical verbs describing the transmission, encoding, or routing of telecommunication and computing signals through bi-directional or shared pathways.
groups.summary_zh: 指通信与计算领域中信号或数据的通道化传输与复用。
groups.desc_en: Directing or combining digital signals across specific conduits, contrasting with simple 'send' by focusing on infrastructural modulation, path selection, and bandwidth sharing.
groups.desc_zh: 通过特定介质引导或复用传输数字信号，与普通'发送(send)'相比，侧重信道调制、路径规划及带宽共享等底层通信架构。
groups.nuance_en: channel: to direct flow through a specific designated path (funds / energy / data) · stream: to transmit continuous uninterrupted real-time media (video / audio / content) · multiplex: to combine multiple signals concurrently across a single carrier (signals / data streams / channels) · route: to select optimal pathways through an interconnected network (packets / traffic / calls) · duplex: to transmit bidirectional data simultaneously or alternately (communication / signals / channels)
groups.nuance_zh: channel: 引导经由特定管道或路径输送 (funds / energy / data) · stream: 连续流式即时传输 (video / audio / content) · multiplex: 多路复用合并至单一物理载体 (signals / data streams / channels) · route: 为数据包指派规划网络传输路由 (packets / traffic / calls) · duplex: 组织进行双向交替或双工传输 (communication / signals / channels)

groups.name: Date & Time Assign · 标注日期与确定时限 (Predate, Backdate, Timestamp)
groups.tip: 标记或推迟文书事件的具体日期

items.def_en: To assign a date earlier than the actual date, or to precede in chronological time
items.ex_en: Fossil evidence proves that primitive reptiles clearly antedate modern mammalian species by millions.
items.ex_zh: 化石证据证明，原始爬行动物在时间上显然比现代哺乳动物早数百万年。

items.def_en: To record the precise date and time at which a digital event or transaction occurs
items.ex_en: The automated banking server timestamps each financial transaction to guarantee accurate auditing records.
items.ex_zh: 自动银行服务器为每笔金融交易打上时间戳，以确保审计记录准确无误。

items.def_en: To exist, happen, or occur at a time earlier than someone or something else
items.ex_en: Ancient stone tools found in the cave predate recorded human history significantly.
items.ex_zh: 洞穴中发现的古老石器远远早于有记录的人类历史发生。

items.def_en: To give a document or agreement a date that is earlier than the date it was signed
items.ex_en: The corrupt official tried to backdate the fraudulent contract by several whole months.
items.ex_zh: 那名腐败官员试图把那份虚假合同的签署日期倒填整整几个月。

items.raw_cluster: 确定日期与计时 Date & Time
items.def_zh: 填迟……的日期；晚于，在……之后发生
items.def_en: 1. To write a date on a document, check, or letter that is later than the actual date. 2. To occur or exist at a later date than something else.
items.ex_en: The cautious tenant chose to postdate the rent check until next Friday afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 谨慎的房客选择将房租支票的日期填迟至下周五下午。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame relate to recording, altering, or establishing a chronological date or time reference on formal instruments, events, or artifacts.
groups.summary_zh: 在文件或记录上注明、回溯或调整所生效的日期与时间。
groups.desc_en: Marking an explicit chronological point or temporal offset relative to real-time events, differing from generic 'schedule' by altering legal validity or archival timestamps.
groups.desc_zh: 标注确切时间节点或设定相对偏移时限，与普通'安排日程(schedule)'不同，侧重法律生效时效或档案时间戳的设定与篡改。
groups.nuance_en: timestamp: to affix an immutable digital record of exact occurrence time (transaction / block / log) · predate: to exist or occur prior to an objective event (era / event / discovery) · antedate: to assign a document an earlier date or precede historically (document / civilization / arrival) · backdate: to deliberately assign an earlier calendar date for retroactive legal/financial effect (check / contract / policy) · postdate: to assign an explicitly future calendar date (check / payment / invoice)
groups.nuance_zh: timestamp: 附加不可篡改的精确数字时间戳 (transaction / block / log) · predate: 在客观时间轴上早于…发生 (era / event / discovery) · antedate: 先于历史发生或将文件日期倒填 (document / civilization / arrival) · backdate: 为追溯法律/财务效力而特意倒签生效日期 (check / contract / policy) · postdate: 将票据或文件填上将来的日期 (check / payment / invoice)

groups.name: Daze & Bewilder · 使眩晕与使发昏 (Daze, Stupefy, Disorient)
groups.tip: 头昏眼花导致意识陷入模糊

items.def_en: To confuse or muddle someone's mind or senses
items.ex_en: The strong fumes and chaotic noise seemed to buddle his already weary mind.
items.ex_zh: 刺鼻的烟雾和嘈杂的声响似乎让他本就疲惫的心智一片昏乱。

items.def_en: To make someone feel unsteady, confused, and as if everything is spinning.
items.ex_en: Riding the wild roller coaster twice in a row will surely dizzy anyone.
items.ex_zh: 连续坐两次疯狂过山车绝对会让任何人感到头晕目眩。

items.def_en: To stun or confuse someone so they cannot think clearly, especially by a blow or shock
items.ex_en: The sudden blow to his helmet seemed to daze him for several critical seconds.
items.ex_zh: 头盔上遭受的突如其来的重击似乎让他眩晕了好几秒关键时间。

items.def_zh: 使迷失方向；使产生困惑
items.def_en: To make someone lose their sense of direction, spatial awareness, or clear bearings
items.ex_en: The thick fog and winding corridors threatened to disorient the rescue team entirely.
items.ex_zh: 浓雾和蜿蜒的走廊极有可能使救援队彻底迷失方向。

items.def_zh: 使神志不清；使目瞪口呆
items.def_en: To make someone unable to think or feel clearly, especially through drugs, alcohol, or shock
items.ex_en: The sudden shock of the announcement seemed to stupefy the entire assembly.
items.ex_zh: 这一消息带来的突如其来的震惊似乎让全体与会人员目瞪口呆。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe inducing a state of mental confusion, vertigo, or sensory disorientation, either through physical blows, overwhelming sensory stimuli, or dizzying complexity.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过击打、感官过载或强烈冲击令人头晕目眩、感知错乱或不知所措。
groups.desc_en: Impairs cognitive alertness or spatial balance via sudden physical or mental trauma, contrasting with mere 'confuse' by inducing bodily vertigo, stupor, or profound numbness.
groups.desc_zh: 因突发物理冲击或心理震荡使大脑丧失清醒或空间平衡感，与一般的'困惑(confuse)'相比，强调伴随生理眩晕、木僵或知觉顿挫。
groups.nuance_en: dizzy: to induce a physiological spinning sensation or equilibrium loss (height / motion / speed) · daze: to stun into a semi-conscious, unresponsive daze (blow / punch / shock) · disorient: to destroy awareness of spatial, directional, or situational relations (traveler / patient / sensor) · stupefy: to dull faculties into complete paralysis or vegetative sluggishness (drugs / shock / wine) · buddle: to fluster or befuddle through bewildering disorder (mind / senses / thoughts)
groups.nuance_zh: dizzy: 引起天旋地转的生理性眩晕 (height / motion / speed) · daze: 击打或震撼使人短暂发懵迟钝 (blow / punch / shock) · disorient: 使迷失方向感、时空感或情境感知 (traveler / patient / sensor) · stupefy: 药物或极度震惊导致麻木呆滞 (drugs / shock / wine) · buddle: 因混乱困扰使思维发昏失序 (mind / senses / thoughts)

groups.name: Dazzle & Overwhelm with Light · 耀眼夺目与使目眩 (Blind, Glare, Overwhelm)
groups.tip: 强光刺眼令人目眩神迷

items.def_zh: 以气势或光芒压倒；震撼
items.def_en: To overcome someone completely by an overpowering brilliance, sensory display, or emotional force
items.ex_en: The brilliant light from the grand chandelier seemed to overwhelm every visitor entering the hall.
items.ex_zh: 华丽吊灯散发出的耀眼光芒似乎让每一位步入大厅的访客都为之震撼。

items.def_en: To shine with a harsh, uncomfortably bright and dazzling light
items.ex_en: The midday sun continued to glare uncomfortably across the vast white salt flats.
items.ex_zh: 正午的烈日继续在广阔的白色盐滩上发出令人不适的刺眼强光。

items.def_zh: 使目眩，使眩晕；使倾倒，使惊叹
items.def_en: 1. (of strong light) To blind someone temporarily. 2. To impress or enchant someone greatly with brilliance, beauty, or talent.
items.ex_en: The headlights from the approaching truck threatened to dazzle oncoming drivers completely.
items.ex_zh: 迎面驶来的卡车车灯极其刺眼，几乎要让对向司机暂时目眩。

items.def_en: To thoroughly impress, confuse, or blind someone with brilliant light, charm, or splendor
items.ex_en: The glittering costumes and dazzling stage lights bedazzle the enthusiastic audience every night.
items.ex_zh: 闪闪发光的演出服和绚烂的舞台灯光每晚都让热情的观众眼花缭乱。

items.def_en: To deprive someone temporarily or permanently of sight, especially by shining an overpowering light into their eyes
items.ex_en: The sudden flash of high beams can blind drivers navigating the dark mountain road.
items.ex_zh: 突然闪烁的远光灯会让在黑暗山路上行驶的司机瞬间目眩失明。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe intense illumination that overpowers vision or, figuratively, stuns an observer through brilliant talent, beauty, or spectacle. Nuances range from temporary sensory impairment to awe-inspiring showmanship.
groups.summary_zh: 以强烈光芒刺目致眩，或以卓越华彩震撼人心。
groups.desc_en: Inundating visual or cognitive faculties through intense radiance or brilliance, moving beyond 'illuminate' by causing physical blindness or sensory paralysis.
groups.desc_zh: 以强烈光芒或璀璨表现压倒视觉或认知感知，与单纯的'照亮(illuminate)'不同，侧重致使目眩、暂时失明或感官瘫痪。
groups.nuance_en: glare: to emit an excessively harsh, uncomfortable, and unyielding light (sun / headlight / surface) · dazzle: to temporarily blind with brilliant brightness or virtuosity (headlights / brilliance / smile) · bedazzle: to overwhelmingly enchant and mesmerize with opulent spectacle (audience / onlookers / crowd) · blind: to completely obliterate vision, permanently or transiently (flash / light / glare) · overwhelm: to engulf visual or mental capacity beneath sheer excessive magnitude (senses / spectator / mind)
groups.nuance_zh: glare: 发出刺眼不适的强光 (sun / headlight / surface) · dazzle: 耀眼光芒或卓越技艺使人眼花缭乱 (headlights / brilliance / smile) · bedazzle: 华丽夺目的景象让人倾倒神迷 (audience / onlookers / crowd) · blind: 强光瞬间夺去视力致盲 (flash / light / glare) · overwhelm: 视听冲击过于庞大而彻底压倒感官 (senses / spectator / mind)

groups.name: Deactivate & Inhibit · 抑制与失活 (Inactivate, Deactivate, Inhibit)
groups.tip: 钝化使其丧失反应活性

items.def_zh: 关闭停止运转，使中止活动
items.def_en: To bring a machine, biological pathway, or facility to a complete cessation of operations
items.ex_en: Engineers were forced to shut down the cooling system after detecting a major leak.
items.ex_zh: 在检测到严重泄漏后，工程师们被迫关闭了冷却系统。
items.ex2_en: The antiquated factory will shut down permanently at the end of this fiscal quarter.
items.ex2_zh: 这座陈旧的工厂将在本财政季度末永久停工关闭。

items.def_zh: 抑制（反应、生长或酶活性）
items.def_en: To slow down, impede, or completely block a chemical reaction or biological activity
items.ex_en: The new synthetic compound can effectively inhibit the replication of pathogenic bacteria.
items.ex_zh: 这种新型合成化合物能够有效抑制病原菌的复制。

items.def_en: To render an acid, toxin, virus, or weapon ineffective by countervailing action
items.ex_en: The specialized serum was administered immediately to neutralize the lethal venom.
items.ex_zh: 医务人员立即注射了特效血清，以中和这种致命的毒液。

items.def_zh: 停用，解除激活（装置或系统）
items.def_en: To cause a technical mechanism, security system, or chemical agent to become inactive
items.ex_en: Technicians must deactivate the perimeter alarm system before regular maintenance can begin.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员在开始例行维护前，必须先停用周界报警系统。

items.raw_cluster: 使停止与抑制 Deactivate & Inhibit
items.def_zh: 使失活，灭活；使丧失反应活性
items.def_en: To make an enzyme, virus, chemical substance, or device inactive or nonfunctional.
items.ex_en: Exposure to extreme heat will rapidly inactivate the viral particles in the sample.
items.ex_zh: 暴露于极高温度下会使样本中的病毒颗粒迅速失活。

groups.summary_en: This scientific and technical frame involves disabling the functional activity, catalytic capacity, or active state of enzymes, pathogens, devices, or chemical agents.
groups.summary_zh: 通过生化或物理机制使生物活性、反应或功能终止。
groups.desc_en: Stopping biological, chemical, or operational functioning via targeted suppression, differing from generic 'stop' by rendering mechanisms inert or legally/structurally inoperative.
groups.desc_zh: 通过针对性抑制使生物、化学或功能系统陷入休眠或失效状态，与普通'停止(stop)'相比，强调使其结构钝化或丧失活性机制。
groups.nuance_en: shut down: to systematically terminate operation of an organized system or facility (reactor / plant / computer) · inhibit: to chemically or behaviorally restrain a progressive reaction (enzyme / growth / spread) · neutralize: to counteract an active threat or chemical agent to harmlessness (toxin / acid / threat) · deactivate: to turn off a system, device, or military capability (alarm / account / weapon) · inactivate: to render a biological or biochemical agent permanently inert (virus / protein / vaccine)
groups.nuance_zh: shut down: 系统性彻底关停运转或设施 (reactor / plant / computer) · inhibit: 生化或行为上阻抑/抑制反应进程 (enzyme / growth / spread) · neutralize: 中和或抵消威胁使其失去破坏效力 (toxin / acid / threat) · deactivate: 停用设备、解除装置或注销系统 (alarm / account / weapon) · inactivate: 使生物试剂、病毒或蛋白质灭活 (virus / protein / vaccine)

groups.name: Deaden & Dull · 迟钝化与麻痹感觉 (Deaden, Dull, Numb, Muffle)
groups.tip: 削弱力量或钝化外界感官

items.def_zh: 使迟钝；减缓（痛感、注意力）
items.def_en: To make a pain, feeling, or edge less sharp, clear, or acute
items.ex_en: A mild analgesic should help to dull the throbbing pain in your shoulder.
items.ex_zh: 温和的止痛药应该有助于减轻你肩膀的跳痛。
items.ex2_en: The sharp throbbing in his knee began to dull after thirty quiet minutes.
items.ex2_zh: 静卧三十分钟后，他膝盖剧烈的抽痛开始慢慢减轻。

items.def_en: To make an emotion, sensation, or sharp response weaker or less sharp
items.ex_en: Years of routine administrative tasks had begun to blunt his once sharp intellectual curiosity.
items.ex_zh: 多年的日常行政工作已经开始削弱他曾经敏锐的求知欲。
items.ex2_en: His sharp grief blunted gradually as several peaceful months passed without major incident.
items.ex2_zh: 几个平静的月份在平安无事中过去，他尖锐的悲伤渐渐减弱了。

items.def_en: To make a sound quieter or less distinct, especially by wrapping or covering the source
items.ex_en: He pressed a thick wool blanket against the speaker to muffle the sound.
items.ex_zh: 他用一条厚毛毯捂住扬声器以减弱声音。

items.def_zh: 减弱，缓和（声音、痛感等）；使麻木，使迟钝
items.def_en: To make a sound, feeling, pain, or sensation weaker, less intense, or duller.
items.ex_en: The doctor gave her a mild sedative to deaden the sharp abdominal pain.
items.ex_zh: 医生给她服用了一种温和的镇静剂，以缓解剧烈的腹痛。

items.def_en: To make a part of the body or a feeling lose sensation or the ability to feel anything
items.ex_en: The biting arctic wind began to numb his fingers despite the heavy gloves.
items.ex_zh: 尽管戴着厚手套，刺骨的北极寒风还是开始让他的手指失去知觉。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to impairing, numbing, or absorbing sensory perception, pain, or acoustic sharpness. They emphasize taking away sensitivity, sharpness, or resonance so an experience becomes faint or unresponsive.
groups.summary_zh: 指使感觉迟钝、止痛麻木或消除声响锋芒。
groups.desc_en: Attenuating sensory sharpness, physical pain, or sound volume, contrasting with 'destroy' by softening the sharp edge or reducing transmission fidelity.
groups.desc_zh: 削弱感觉敏锐度、肉体疼痛或声音强度，与彻底'消灭(destroy)'不同，侧重磨去尖锐锋芒、隔绝传递或降低感知响应度。
groups.nuance_en: blunt: to deliberately remove the cutting edge or sharpness of impact (blow / criticism / impact) · dull: to diminish clarity, vividness, or intellectual responsiveness (pain / senses / ache) · muffle: to deaden sound by wrapping or covering the source (sound / voice / cries) · deaden: to insulate against or suppress sensation or acoustic vitality (pain / sound / nerve) · numb: to physically deprive of tactile feeling or emotional responsiveness (fingers / limb / grief)
groups.nuance_zh: blunt: 磨钝锋刃或缓和直接冲击力 (blow / criticism / impact) · dull: 降低疼痛的剧烈度或精神敏锐度 (pain / senses / ache) · muffle: 借遮蔽或包裹使声音发闷、降低响度 (sound / voice / cries) · deaden: 隔绝或压抑痛觉、声响的传导 (pain / sound / nerve) · numb: 因严寒或悲伤彻底失去触觉感知 (fingers / limb / grief)

groups.name: Deadening & Numbing · 麻木与知觉丧失 (Numb, Deaden, Desensitize)
groups.tip: 肢体感知减弱乃至麻木

items.def_en: To diminish the sharp edge or acute responsiveness of a sensation, pain, or sense organ
items.ex_en: The prescription drops will dull the irritation in your eyes within a few minutes.
items.ex_zh: 处方眼药水会在几分钟内缓解你眼部的刺激感。
items.ex2_en: His keen senses dulled over the decades spent away from the harsh wilderness.
items.ex2_zh: 远离严酷荒野数十年后，他敏锐的感官逐渐变得迟钝。

items.def_zh: 使麻木，使失去知觉；使迟钝
items.def_en: To make a part of the body unable to feel physical sensations, or to make someone unable to feel emotion or think clearly.
items.ex_en: The freezing water began to numb his bare feet within just a few seconds.
items.ex_zh: 冰冷的水在短短几秒钟内就让他的光脚失去了知觉。

items.def_en: To make someone or a body part less capable of feeling physical sensation or emotional reaction
items.ex_en: Repeated exposure to violent media can desensitize individuals to real-world suffering.
items.ex_zh: 反复接触暴力媒体会使人对现实世界中的苦难变得麻木不仁。

items.def_en: To extinguish or severely reduce the intensity of pain, sound, or feeling in an area
items.ex_en: The dentist injected a strong anesthetic to deaden the nerve before drilling.
items.ex_zh: 牙医在钻牙前注射了强效麻醉剂以消除神经痛感。

items.def_en: To administer drugs to eliminate all physical sensation, rendering an area or person completely numb
items.ex_en: The surgeon will anesthetize the patient before proceeding with the complex abdominal procedure.
items.ex_zh: 在进行复杂的腹部手术之前，外科医生会对患者实施全身麻醉。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe rendering sensory receptors or emotional capacities unresponsive, blocking all sensation, pain, or empathetic feeling.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过物理阻滞、药物或心理打击使局部感官或情感知觉完全丧失反应能力。
groups.desc_en: Depriving physical tissue or psychological sensibilities of responsiveness to stimuli, contrasting with 'injure' by inducing an absence of feeling rather than physical destruction.
groups.desc_zh: 使生理机体或心理感知丧失对刺激的响应能力，与单纯'致伤(injure)'不同，强调诱导知觉丧失、痛感隔绝或情绪脱敏。
groups.nuance_en: dull: to take off the edge of intense pain or awareness (pain / grief / edge) · numb: to render flesh insensitive via cold, trauma, or sorrow (toes / fingers / feeling) · desensitize: to gradually condition toward indifference to disturbing stimuli (patient / nerve / public) · deaden: to suppress neural responsiveness or emotional vitality (pain / conscience / nerves) · anesthetize: to medically induce temporary insensibility to surgical pain (patient / area / tooth)
groups.nuance_zh: dull: 弱化痛感或迟钝化情感触角 (pain / grief / edge) · numb: 因受冻或剧痛使肢体彻底麻木失觉 (toes / fingers / feeling) · desensitize: 脱敏使对外部不良刺激渐趋麻木不仁 (patient / nerve / public) · deaden: 彻底压低神经知觉或良知 (pain / conscience / nerves) · anesthetize: 施以麻醉剂使丧失痛觉知觉 (patient / area / tooth)

groups.name: Debit & Deduct · 扣除与扣划 (Deduct, Dock, Withhold)
groups.tip: 从账目中扣除相应金额

items.def_zh: 从…账户中扣除；记入…账下
items.def_en: To enter a debit or expense directly against an existing credit balance or departmental budget
items.ex_en: The controller decided to charge against the marketing budget for the unexpected travel expenses.
items.ex_zh: 财务总监决定将这笔意料之外的差旅开销从市场预算中扣除。

items.def_zh: 扣减（工资、待遇）作为惩罚
items.def_en: To reduce an employee's wages or benefits, typically as a penalty for being late or underperforming
items.ex_en: The supervisor warned that she would dock their pay if they arrived late again.
items.ex_zh: 主管警告说，如果他们再迟到，就会扣减他们的工资。
items.ex2_en: The massive cargo vessel will dock securely at the busy deepwater port tomorrow morning.
items.ex2_zh: 这艘巨型货轮将于明天早晨安全停靠在繁忙的深水港。

items.def_en: To take money out of a bank account; to charge a sum of money against an account.
items.ex_en: The financial institution will debit your account automatically for the recurring monthly fee.
items.ex_zh: 金融机构将每月自动从您的账户中扣划常规服务费。

items.def_en: To deliberately keep back an amount of money from salary before payment, notably for national taxes
items.ex_en: Employers are legally mandated to withhold income tax directly from monthly employee paychecks.
items.ex_zh: 雇主依法必须直接从员工的月工资中代扣个人所得税。

items.def_en: To take away an amount or part from a total sum (such as taxes deducted from pay)
items.ex_en: The company will deduct the cost of uniform laundering from your monthly paycheck.
items.ex_zh: 公司将从你的月薪中扣除制服清洗费用。

groups.summary_en: Covers removing a specified sum of money directly from a financial account, wages, or balance in settlement of fees, penalties, taxes, or payments owed. Contrasts discretionary deductions with automated banking ledger debits.
groups.summary_zh: 指自账户、薪酬或总账中直接扣减、扣划款项或税费。
groups.desc_en: Officially subtracting a specified sum from an account, total, or wage before disbursement, differing from 'steal' by operating through administrative or legal authority.
groups.desc_zh: 在发放或结算前，依照行政权限或会计账目法定扣减金额，与'盗取(steal)'不同，强调基于正当核算程序的扣划与截留。
groups.nuance_en: deduct: to legitimately subtract an allowable amount from a taxable total or bill (expenses / taxes / cost) · dock: to penalize by withholding pay or privileges for an infraction (wages / pay / points) · debit: to officially record an outgoing charge against a ledger account (account / balance / card) · withhold: to legally hold back a mandated portion before disbursing funds (tax / payment / consent) · charge against: to allocate an incurred expense against a dedicated balance (account / quota / reserve)
groups.nuance_zh: deduct: 合法从应税总额或账单中减除 (expenses / taxes / cost) · dock: 惩戒性克扣或削减工资/点数 (wages / pay / points) · debit: 记入账户借方并直接扣划账款 (account / balance / card) · withhold: 依法暂扣代缴税款或扣留应付款项 (tax / payment / consent) · charge against: 在指定配额或账户名下冲销开支 (account / quota / reserve)

groups.name: Debunk & Disprove Claims · 辟谣与戳穿假象 (Debunk, Discredit, Puncture)
groups.tip: 戳穿虚假迷思与谎言，公开揭示真相

items.def_en: Show a belief, myth, or scientific theory to be completely baseless and destroy general faith in it
items.ex_en: Rigorous laboratory testing helped to explode the myth surrounding that miracle diet supplement.
items.ex_zh: 严谨的实验室检测彻底打破了围绕该神奇减肥保健品的迷思。

items.def_en: Harm the good reputation of someone or prove that an idea, claim, or piece of evidence is unreliable or false
items.ex_en: The newly discovered correspondence served to discredit the historian's longstanding academic theory.
items.ex_zh: 新发现的信件彻底证明了这位历史学家长期以来的学术理论不可信。

items.def_en: Prove a statement, charge, or theory to be completely wrong or false using methodical argument or clear evidence
items.ex_en: The defense attorney presented conclusive video evidence to refute the prosecutor's allegations.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师出示了决定性的视频证据，以驳斥检察官的指控。

items.def_zh: 戳破（谎言、幻想、膨胀的傲气）
items.def_en: Suddenly destroy or deflate an illusion, myth, inflated claim, or person's pride
items.ex_en: A single pointed question from the reporter served to puncture his boastful claims.
items.ex_zh: 记者一个尖锐的提问便戳破了他夸夸其谈的说辞。
items.ex2_en: His foolish youthful pride punctured instantly when the harsh test results were posted.
items.ex2_zh: 严酷的考试成绩一公布，他幼稚盲目的自尊心瞬间破碎了。

items.def_zh: 揭穿，戳穿，驳斥（谬论或虚假谎言）
items.def_en: To prove that an idea, belief, or claim is false or exaggerated.
items.ex_en: The popular podcast set out to debunk several widespread internet conspiracy theories.
items.ex_zh: 这档热门播客着手揭穿几个流传甚广的互联网阴谋论。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express dismantling false claims, superstitions, fraudulent theories, or inflated reputations through evidence and critical analysis. They focus on shattering falsehoods rather than merely presenting facts.
groups.summary_zh: 用事实与证据驳斥谣言、戳穿伪科学或假象，打破虚假认知。
groups.desc_en: Systematically demonstrating the falsity of a myth, boast, or unfounded claim, differing from neutral 'criticize' by completely dismantling credibility through exposure.
groups.desc_zh: 系统性戳穿迷信、夸口或虚妄言论，与中立的'批评(criticize)'不同，强调以无可辩驳的证据击碎其公信力并瓦解谎言假象。
groups.nuance_en: debunk: to expose the emptiness or falsity of a cherished myth or pretension (myth / theory / claim) · puncture: to deflate inflated pretension or hubris with sharp precision (ego / illusion / rhetoric) · explode: to completely shatter an entrenched fallacy or false belief (notion / superstition / fallacy) · discredit: to ruin the reputation, validity, or evidentiary authority of a source (witness / theory / report) · refute: to logically disprove an argument using counter-evidence (allegation / thesis / claim)
groups.nuance_zh: debunk: 戳穿长久流传的谬说与虚伪神话 (myth / theory / claim) · puncture: 如针刺破气球般戳穿浮夸虚饰或自负 (ego / illusion / rhetoric) · explode: 彻底粉碎陈腐迷信或根深蒂固的谬论 (notion / superstition / fallacy) · discredit: 摧毁证言、理论的可靠性与公信力 (witness / theory / report) · refute: 摆出反面证据严密反驳并驳倒论点 (allegation / thesis / claim)

groups.name: Deceive & Dupe · 蒙骗与愚弄 (Gull, Cozen, Con)
groups.tip: 利用诡计哄弄欺诈，诱使他人上当

items.def_en: To persuade someone to do something or give up money by means of a confidence trick
items.ex_en: The smooth-talking salesman managed to con the elderly couple out of their savings.
items.ex_zh: 那个巧舌如簧的推销员设法骗走了老夫妇的全部积蓄。

items.headword: pull the wool over someone's eyes
items.lemma: pull the wool over someone's eyes
items.def_en: To deceive someone by preventing them from discovering what is truly happening
items.ex_en: Do not attempt to pull the wool over my eyes regarding these missing funds.
items.ex_zh: 休想在这些失踪资金的问题上蒙骗我的双眼。

items.def_en: To trick or deceive someone into believing or doing something foolish.
items.ex_en: Online fraudsters managed to dupe hundreds of investors with the fake cryptocurrency scheme.
items.ex_zh: 网络诈骗分子利用虚假加密货币骗局，成功哄骗了数百名投资者。

items.def_zh: 欺骗，使容易轻信者上当
items.def_en: To fool or cheat someone who is unusually trusting or naive
items.ex_en: The cunning rogue sought to gull the impressionable young traveler out of his fortune.
items.ex_zh: 狡黠的无赖企图欺骗那位不谙世事的年轻旅人，图谋其财产。

items.def_en: To win over, cheat, or deceive someone by subtle artifice or wheedling
items.ex_en: The courtier sought to cozen the monarch into granting him vast foreign estates.
items.ex_zh: 那位侍臣企图巧言哄骗君主，使其赐予自己大片海外庄园。

groups.summary_en: Highlights the gullibility and vulnerability of the victim who is easily outwitted, taken advantage of, or made a fool of by an imposter.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重利用受害者单纯轻信而施加诱骗、愚弄及耍弄手段。
groups.desc_en: Taking advantage of another's credulity to extract material or personal gain, contrasting with plain 'lie' through asymmetric predatory trickery and social exploitation.
groups.desc_zh: 利用他人的轻信心理施以不对称诱骗手段牟取私利，与单纯'撒谎(lie)'相比，侧重圈套设局与欺诈性的愚弄玩弄。
groups.nuance_en: dupe: to easily victimize an innocent, unsuspecting person (buyer / public / victim) · gull: to exploit sheer foolish credulity for manipulation (tourist / investors / crowd) · con: to systematically swindle someone via calculated false confidence (investor / mark / tourist) · cozen: to cheat or beguile out of property with subtle artifice (heir / customer / merchant) · pull the wool over someone's eyes: to deliberately blind someone to real circumstances using facade (investigators / parents / public)
groups.nuance_zh: dupe: 蒙骗毫无防备的受害人充当冤大头 (buyer / public / victim) · gull: 欺负轻信之人愚钝容易上当 (tourist / investors / crowd) · con: 以精心设计的骗局套路诈取钱财 (investor / mark / tourist) · cozen: 巧言令色诱骗侵吞他人财产 (heir / customer / merchant) · pull the wool over someone's eyes: 遮掩真相欺瞒他人耳目 (investigators / parents / public)

groups.name: Deceive & Mislead · 欺骗与蒙瞒 (Deceive, Mislead, Delude)
groups.tip: 用虚假手段误导并骗取利益

items.def_zh: 欺骗，诱骗；作弊；对（配偶）不忠
items.def_en: 1. To act dishonestly or unfairly in order to gain an advantage. 2. To deprive someone of something by trickery or deceit.
items.ex_en: He was expelled from the university after attempting to cheat on the examination.
items.ex_zh: 他因企图在期末考试中作弊而被大学开除。

items.def_zh: 误导，给虚假希望以欺骗
items.def_en: To encourage someone to believe something false, especially regarding intentions or affection
items.ex_en: She realized too late that he was only trying to lead her on.
items.ex_zh: 她意识到得太晚了，原来他一直只是在感情上蒙骗她。

items.def_en: To cause someone to form a wrong impression or action by giving inaccurate information
items.ex_en: The misleading brochure could easily mislead tourists about the hotel's actual location.
items.ex_zh: 这份具有误导性的小册子很容易误导游客关于酒店实际位置的判断。

items.def_en: To deliberately make someone believe something that is false for one's own advantage
items.ex_en: The executive conspired to deceive the board of directors regarding the mounting debt.
items.ex_zh: 这位主管串通一气，企图在不断攀升的债务问题上欺骗董事会。

items.def_en: To cause someone to accept a false belief, often self-servingly or unrealistically
items.ex_en: Do not delude yourself into believing that this reckless plan will actually succeed.
items.ex_zh: 不要自欺欺人地认为这个鲁莽的计划真的能够成功。

groups.summary_en: Encompasses general breach of faith and systemic dishonesty, ranging from unfair advantage in rules to causing someone to harbor mistaken beliefs.
groups.summary_zh: 指破坏规则以谋私利，或故意掩盖真相以误导他人信念。
groups.desc_en: Causing someone to hold a false belief regarding reality, differing from 'err' by involving active fabrication, directional distortion, or sustained bad faith.
groups.desc_zh: 故意使人对客观现实产生错误认知，与自己'犯错(err)'不同，强调主动散布虚假信息、方向性误导或蓄意隐瞒。
groups.nuance_en: deceive: to intentionally lead someone into accepting a falsehood (partner / public / voters) · mislead: to guide someone toward an erroneous conclusion via skewed data (investors / jury / consumers) · delude: to nurture a dangerously false self-perception or unrealistic hope (oneself / followers / public) · cheat: to violate explicit rules dishonestly for an unfair advantage (system / test / spouse) · lead on: to falsely foster romantic or aspirational expectations dishonestly (admirer / applicant / suitor)
groups.nuance_zh: deceive: 蓄意作伪欺瞒使人信以为真 (partner / public / voters) · mislead: 以片面或失实信息引人误入歧途 (investors / jury / consumers) · delude: 使陷入虚幻妄想或自欺欺人 (oneself / followers / public) · cheat: 违规舞弊作假以谋取不当利益 (system / test / spouse) · lead on: 虚情假意给人虚妄念想或诱人上钩 (admirer / applicant / suitor)

groups.name: Deceive & Trick · 欺诈与诱骗 (Hoodwink, Bamboozle, Beguile)
groups.tip: 设局弄虚作假、诱人上当

items.def_zh: 使上当，蒙骗（常用被动态）
items.def_en: To successfully fool or deceive someone into believing a falsehood
items.ex_en: She was completely taken in by his fabricated story of immense personal wealth.
items.ex_zh: 她完全被他捏造的拥有巨额个人财富的谎言给蒙骗了。

items.def_en: To deceive or cheat someone, especially by using clever or dishonest methods.
items.ex_en: The clever magician managed to trick the observant audience with a false mirror.
items.ex_zh: 这位聪明的魔术师用一面假镜子成功愚弄了观察敏锐的观众。

items.def_en: To charm, enchant, or attract someone, sometimes in order to mislead them
items.ex_en: The enigmatic siren sang enchanting melodies to beguile the weary sailors toward the rocks.
items.ex_zh: 神秘的海妖唱起迷人的旋律，诱使疲惫的水手驶向礁石。

items.def_en: To confuse or mystify someone so thoroughly as to mislead or cheat them
items.ex_en: The fast-talking salesman tried to bamboozle the customer with confusing technical jargon.
items.ex_zh: 那个巧舌如簧的推销员试图用晦涩难懂的专业术语把顾客绕晕并加以蒙骗。

items.def_en: To deceive someone completely through clever misdirection or a trick
items.ex_en: The dishonest contractor tried to hoodwink the inspectors with forged compliance certificates.
items.ex_zh: 那个不诚实的承包商试图用伪造的合格证书来蒙骗检查人员。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on outsmarting, deluding, or cunningly manipulating another's perception to induce error or action through calculated ruses.
groups.summary_zh: 强调运用巧计、圈套或言语诱惑蒙蔽他人判断并使其上当。
groups.desc_en: Outsmarting a victim through elaborate craft, theatrical disguise, or disorienting charm, contrasting with brute 'force' through psychological misdirection.
groups.desc_zh: 以精巧计谋、伪装障眼法或迷惑性魅力击溃对方防备，与粗暴的'强迫(force)'相对，强调心理误导与策略性玩弄。
groups.nuance_en: trick: to outwit via a simple clever ruse or deceptive device (guard / dog / system) · hoodwink: to blindside someone through calculated concealment or artful camouflage (regulators / voters / authorities) · bamboozle: to disorient and cheat someone using complex bewildering tactics (customers / tourist / jury) · beguile: to charm or enchant someone into letting their guard down (traveler / audience / victim) · take in: to successfully fool and gain the naive trust of someone (investor / elder / customer)
groups.nuance_zh: trick: 耍小花招或机巧计谋骗过 (guard / dog / system) · hoodwink: 设障眼法蒙蔽视线以暗度陈仓 (regulators / voters / authorities) · bamboozle: 搬出复杂伎俩使人晕头转向而受骗 (customers / tourist / jury) · beguile: 以迷人魅力诱使卸下戒备 (traveler / audience / victim) · take in: 轻易骗取老实人的信任使其上当 (investor / elder / customer)

groups.name: Decelerate & Ease Up · 减速与缓行 (Decelerate, Slow Down, Ease Up)
groups.tip: 移动速度逐渐放慢

items.def_zh: 放慢速度；放松油门/努力
items.def_en: To reduce one's speed, pressure, or level of exertion gradually
items.ex_en: The coach told the exhausted runner to ease up during the final lap.
items.ex_zh: 教练告诉精疲力竭的跑者在最后一圈适当放慢速度。

items.def_en: To become slower, less intense, or less productive
items.ex_en: The workers tended to slack off whenever the strict foreman left the construction site.
items.ex_zh: 每当严厉的工头离开施工现场，工人们往往就会松懈怠工。

items.def_en: To move or happen at a slower speed, or to cause something to do so
items.ex_en: Drivers must slow down when approaching this dangerous intersection during heavy snowfall.
items.ex_zh: 在暴雪天气驶近这个危险路口时，司机必须减速慢行。
items.ex2_en: Heavy police patrols on the highway slowed down reckless drivers during the evening.
items.ex2_zh: 高速公路上密集的警车巡逻在傍晚时分让鲁莽驾驶的司机减慢了车速。

items.def_en: To reduce speed; to slow down, or cause a vehicle or process to slow down.
items.ex_en: The high-speed train began to decelerate smoothly as it approached the terminal station.
items.ex_zh: 高铁列车在接近终点站时开始平稳减速。
items.ex2_en: The careful pilot decelerated the passenger jet gradually before touching the tarmac runway.
items.ex2_zh: 细心的飞行员在接触停机坪跑道前逐步降低了客机的滑行速度。

items.def_zh: 减油减速；调低功率缓速
items.def_en: To reduce the power or fuel flow to an engine to decrease speed
items.ex_en: The experienced pilot decided to throttle back as the aircraft entered severe turbulence.
items.ex_zh: 当飞机进入强气流颠簸区时，经验丰富的飞行员决定收油门减速。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate a continuous, measured rate of decreasing physical speed, cadence, or economic momentum over time, contrasting with sudden mechanical braking.
groups.summary_zh: 指运动速率或发展进程逐渐降低、放缓步伐。
groups.desc_en: Progressively reducing operational velocity, intensity, or output rate, contrasting with abrupt 'halt' by describing a continuous, graded deceleration curve.
groups.desc_zh: 渐进式降低运转速率、强度或输出负荷，与突兀的'刹停(halt)'相对，侧重平滑受控的降速或降温过程。
groups.nuance_en: slow down: to visibly diminish speed or pace of forward progress (car / growth / production) · decelerate: to systematically decrease velocity along a mathematical or economic rate (rate / expansion / vehicle) · throttle back: to intentionally reduce mechanical power or resource input (engine / spending / operations) · ease up: to soften applied pressure, harshness, or physical strain (pressure / training / restrictions) · slack off: to allow effort, discipline, or momentum to carelessly flag (worker / discipline / efforts)
groups.nuance_zh: slow down: 明显降低行进速度或活动节奏 (car / growth / production) · decelerate: 物理或经济指标的系统性减速 (rate / expansion / vehicle) · throttle back: 主动调低引擎转速或资源支出 (engine / spending / operations) · ease up: 缓和施加的高压、严苛程度或负荷 (pressure / training / restrictions) · slack off: 懈怠放松纪律或减弱劲头 (worker / discipline / efforts)

groups.name: Decode & Decipher · 破译与理顺 (Decipher, Decrypt, Untangle)
groups.tip: 厘清混乱信息破译内涵

items.def_en: To translate a coded signal, message, or sequence into plain intelligible language
items.ex_en: Intelligence analysts worked tirelessly around the clock to decode the intercepted enemy transmission.
items.ex_zh: 情报分析人员夜以继日地工作，以破译拦截到的敌方传输信号。

items.def_zh: 理清，厘清（混乱思绪或复杂局面）
items.def_en: To make an extremely tangled or confused set of facts, thoughts, or relationships clear
items.ex_en: The forensic accountant needed weeks to untangle the convoluted web of shell companies.
items.ex_zh: 法务会计师需要数周时间才能理清这团错综复杂的空壳公司关系网。

items.def_zh: 破译，理顺，恢复（混乱信息或信号等的）原貌
items.def_en: To put mixed-up letters, words, or electronic signals back into a clear, understandable order or decoded state.
items.ex_en: The technician used a specialized filter to unscramble the distorted radio broadcast.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员使用专用滤波器将失真的无线电广播信号恢复原貌。

items.def_en: To succeed in reading, decoding, or understanding something hard to read or obscure
items.ex_en: Linguists have spent several grueling decades trying to decipher the ancient stone inscriptions.
items.ex_zh: 语言学家们花费了数十年艰辛的岁月，试图破译这些古老的石刻铭文。

items.def_en: To decode electronically encrypted data or ciphertexts back into plain readable text
items.ex_en: The security team used an advanced algorithm to decrypt the stolen database files.
items.ex_zh: 安全团队采用先进的算法来解密被窃取的数据库文件。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on cognitive and analytical efforts to convert encoded, garbled, or disorganized data back into meaningful, orderly sense. It emphasizes penetrating chaos, obfuscation, or dense ciphers.
groups.summary_zh: 通过智力推演或技术手段破译乱码、密码，理顺混乱信息。
groups.desc_en: Resolving scrambled, highly convoluted, or encrypted representations back to intelligible order, contrasting with 'translate' by wrestling through deliberate obfuscation.
groups.desc_zh: 将混乱、纠缠或加密的符号还原为清晰有序的原意，与中立的'翻译(translate)'不同，侧重破解刻意混淆或极度纷乱的障碍。
groups.nuance_en: decode: to convert an encoded format or symbolic cue back into plain meaning (signal / message / genome) · decipher: to painstakingly reconstruct meaning from degraded, messy, or obscure script (handwriting / inscription / code) · decrypt: to unlock mathematically encrypted data using cryptanalysis or keys (file / transmission / drive) · untangle: to trace out and resolve deeply convoluted threads or knots (yarn / finances / mess) · unscramble: to restore scrambled signals or jumbled structures to clarity (signal / eggs / message)
groups.nuance_zh: decode: 将编码信号或符号转码还原为明文 (signal / message / genome) · decipher: 艰难辨认晦涩古字、潦草字迹或密码 (handwriting / inscription / code) · decrypt: 借算法或密钥解密受密码学保护的数据 (file / transmission / drive) · untangle: 理顺理清错综复杂的线索、财务或乱局 (yarn / finances / mess) · unscramble: 消除杂波干扰恢复信号原型 (signal / eggs / message)

groups.name: Decode & Decrypt · 解码与破解 (Decrypt, Decode, Decipher)
groups.tip: 解开密码并读懂深层隐晦信息

items.def_en: To find the solution to a code, problem, or mystery, especially after difficult mental effort
items.ex_en: After hours of intense calculation, the brilliant student finally managed to crack the code.
items.ex_zh: 经过数小时高强度的计算，这位聪明的学生终于成功破解了密码。

items.def_zh: 解开；阐明（谜团、复杂问题）
items.def_en: To solve, explain, or uncover the details of something complicated or mysterious
items.ex_en: Detectives worked tirelessly for months to unravel the mysterious circumstances of his disappearance.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们不知疲倦地工作了数月，试图揭开他失踪背后的神秘谜团。
items.ex2_en: The tightly woven sweater began to unravel after catching on a rusty metal nail.
items.ex2_zh: 紧密编织的毛衣被生锈的铁钉挂住后，开始脱线散开。

items.def_en: To convert a coded message into intelligible language, or extract meaning from complex signals
items.ex_en: The sophisticated radio receiver can easily decode complex digital signals from deep space.
items.ex_zh: 这台精密的无线电接收机能够轻松解码来自深空的复杂数字信号。

items.def_zh: 辨认出；破译（难辨字迹或密码）
items.def_en: To succeed in reading or understanding something that is poorly written or difficult to understand
items.ex_en: The archivist struggled for hours to decipher the faded handwriting in the journal.
items.ex_zh: 档案管理员费力辨认了几个小时日记中褪色的笔迹。

items.def_en: to decode or convert encrypted data or a secret code into readable plain text
items.ex_en: Cybersecurity experts developed specialized software to decrypt the ransomed corporate records.
items.ex_zh: 网络安全专家开发了专门的软件来解密被勒索的企业记录文件。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to interpreting, unravelling, and converting encrypted, obscure, or encoded signals and texts into intelligible meaning.
groups.summary_zh: 指将加密、模糊或晦涩的符号、代码与信息转译还原为可读内容。
groups.desc_en: Breaching formal cryptographic barriers or algorithmic defenses, contrasting with 'read' by actively penetrating deliberate cryptographic security protections.
groups.desc_zh: 攻破正规密码协议或算法防护壁垒，与普通'读取(read)'不同，侧重克服主动设置的信息加密与技术屏障。
groups.nuance_en: decrypt: to mathematically transform ciphertext back to plaintext using cryptographic keys (file / traffic / payload) · decode: to translate structurally encoded data into an understandable syntax (instructions / sequence / packet) · decipher: to deduce meaning from an unknown, obscure, or cryptic cipher system (hieroglyphs / cipher / puzzle) · crack: to forcefully break through an algorithmic code or defense by exploit (password / cipher / code) · unravel: to progressively solve a deeply entangled puzzle or covert plot (mystery / conspiracy / enigma)
groups.nuance_zh: decrypt: 用密钥将密文经密码学算法解密还原 (file / traffic / payload) · decode: 对结构化编码数据进行反解与语法解析 (instructions / sequence / packet) · decipher: 破译难懂的古怪密文或远古密码体系 (hieroglyphs / cipher / puzzle) · crack: 暴力破解或利用漏洞攻破密码壁垒 (password / cipher / code) · unravel: 顺藤摸瓜解开错综复杂的谜团与阴谋 (mystery / conspiracy / enigma)

groups.name: Deconstruct & Dissect · 分解与剖析 (Factor, Deconstruct, Dissect)
groups.tip: 化整为零剖析要件

items.def_en: To divide a total figure, process, or complex problem into smaller, more manageable parts
items.ex_en: The consultant helped the team break down the massive project into manageable phases.
items.ex_zh: 顾问帮助团队将这个庞大的项目细分为易于管理的各个阶段。
items.ex2_en: The complex negotiation process broke down completely due to irreconcilable territorial disputes between nations.
items.ex2_zh: 由于两国的不可调和领土争端，复杂的谈判进程彻底破裂了。

items.def_zh: 分解因式，把……化为因子；把……作为因素计入（factor in）
items.def_en: 1. (mathematics) To resolve a number or mathematical expression into its factors. 2. (factor in / into) To include a particular fact or situation when calculating or planning something.
items.ex_en: The mathematician demonstrated a novel method to factor extremely large composite numbers.
items.ex_zh: 这位数学家展示了一种分解超大合数因子的新方法。

items.def_en: To analyze a sentence, string of data, or argument into its component parts to reveal its grammatical or logical structure
items.ex_en: The computational algorithm will parse the complex sentence into individual syntactic components.
items.ex_zh: 该计算算法会将这个复杂的句子解析为各个句法成分。

items.def_en: To break down and critically analyze the underlying components, assumptions, or structure of an idea or work
items.ex_en: Scholars seek to deconstruct the ideological assumptions underlying modern consumer culture.
items.ex_zh: 学者们试图解构现代消费文化背后的意识形态假设。

items.def_en: To examine, analyze, or criticize something in minute detail, piece by piece
items.ex_en: The committee met to dissect every vulnerability exposed in the recent audit.
items.ex_zh: 委员会开会仔细剖析了近期审计中暴露出的每一个漏洞。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this cognitive frame involve breaking down complex mathematical structures, arguments, or texts into their fundamental constituent elements to understand their underlying architecture.
groups.summary_zh: 指将复杂数字、理论或文本拆解为底层构成要素以深入剖析机理。
groups.desc_en: Methodically breaking an intricate whole down into its constituent elements for analytical scrutiny, contrasting with destructive 'smash' by serving interpretive comprehension.
groups.desc_zh: 为分析探究而有条不紊地将复杂整体拆解为构成要件，与暴力'捣碎(smash)'不同，服务于理性剖析与结构理解。
groups.nuance_en: break down: to divide an aggregate figure or complex process into manageable stages (costs / steps / data) · factor: to isolate specific mathematical elements or causal variables (polynomial / equation / risk) · parse: to syntactically analyze components of a sentence or raw data stream (log / sentence / data) · deconstruct: to critically expose ideological premises and inner tensions of a text (myth / ideology / narrative) · dissect: to anatomically cut apart or critically scrutinize in painstaking detail (cadaver / policy / argument)
groups.nuance_zh: break down: 将综合数据或流程逐项拆解为细分模块 (costs / steps / data) · factor: 分解因式或剥离出关键诱发变量 (polynomial / equation / risk) · parse: 句法级分析数据流或语句结构 (log / sentence / data) · deconstruct: 解构文本的底层意识形态预设与逻辑矛盾 (myth / ideology / narrative) · dissect: 解剖肌体或极度苛刻地细致剖析论点 (cadaver / policy / argument)

groups.name: Decouple & Disentangle · 解耦与脱钩 (Decouple, Uncouple, Disengage)
groups.tip: 解开连接使其彼此脱离

items.def_en: To detach or unfasten something by releasing its hook or fastener
items.ex_en: She carefully reached behind her back to unhook the silver necklace.
items.ex_zh: 她小心地将手伸到脑后，解开那条银项链的搭扣。

items.def_en: To break the connection, correlation, or dependency between two currencies, policies, or entities
items.ex_en: Policymakers decided to delink the domestic currency from the foreign exchange basket.
items.ex_zh: 决策者决定切断本国货币与外汇篮子的挂钩关系。

items.def_en: To release or detach something from a state of interlocking connection, such as gears or clutches
items.ex_en: The operator must depress the pedal to disengage the clutch safely.
items.ex_zh: 操作员必须踩下踏板以安全地分离离合器。
items.ex2_en: The mechanical gears disengaged smoothly as soon as the emergency shutoff switch flipped.
items.ex2_zh: 紧急断电开关一扳动，机械齿轮便顺畅地脱开咬合。

items.def_zh: 使脱钩，使分离；（使）脱离连接
items.def_en: 1. To separate or disconnect two linked systems, economies, or objects so they operate independently.
items.ex_en: Several nations are actively working to decouple economic growth from carbon emissions.
items.ex_zh: 一些国家正在积极努力使经济增长与碳排放脱钩。
items.ex2_en: The two connected computer sub-systems decoupled cleanly during the automated maintenance reboot cycle.
items.ex2_zh: 在自动维护重启周期中，这两个互联的计算机子系统顺利解耦。

items.def_en: To disconnect two things that are joined together, especially train cars or linked mechanical devices
items.ex_en: The railway workers moved forward to uncouple the locomotive from the train.
items.ex_zh: 铁路工人们上前将机车与列车车厢解开脱钩。
items.ex2_en: The damaged rear freight carriages uncoupled suddenly while traveling over the mountain pass.
items.ex2_zh: 受损的后部货车车厢在翻越山口时突然脱钩解体。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to disconnecting or unlinking interconnected components, systems, or mechanisms so they can operate independently. They frequently collocate with economies, systems, software modules, and physical couplings.
groups.summary_zh: 强调解除两系统或部件间的关联，使其各自独立运作。
groups.desc_en: Severing the reciprocal operational or mechanical ties connecting two entities, contrasting with plain 'separate' by dismantling structural interdependency.
groups.desc_zh: 切断两个系统之间的相互机械连接或功能依赖，与普通'分离(separate)'不同，强调解构二者共振的内在耦合机制。
groups.nuance_en: uncouple: to physically detach linked railcars, wagons, or mechanical joints (train cars / links / trailers) · unhook: to release a fastener, clasp, or caught attachment (clasp / bra / chain) · decouple: to sever structural, macroeconomic, or computational dependencies (economies / architecture / growth) · delink: to disconnect ideological, administrative, or contractual associations (aid / currency / policy) · disengage: to release interlocked mechanical parts or withdraw from conflict (gears / troops / clutch)
groups.nuance_zh: uncouple: 机械摘解车厢联结器或物理挂钩 (train cars / links / trailers) · unhook: 解开锁扣、挂钩或脱落附着物 (clasp / bra / chain) · decouple: 宏观经济脱钩或软件架构解耦 (economies / architecture / growth) · delink: 解除行政契约、汇率绑定或政策关联 (aid / currency / policy) · disengage: 啮合齿轮离合断开或军事力量脱离接触 (gears / troops / clutch)

groups.name: Deep Insight & Complete Grasp · 彻悟与透彻领会 (Fathom, Grasp, Internalize)
groups.tip: 从表面知晓到心领神会彻底弄懂

items.def_en: To understand the meaning or nature of something completely and firmly
items.ex_en: She struggled to grasp the underlying principles behind the quantum theory lecture.
items.ex_zh: 她竭力去领会那场量子理论讲座背后的基本原理。

items.def_en: To succeed in understanding something obscure, complex, or hidden
items.ex_en: Few historians have managed to penetrate the secretive motives of the regime.
items.ex_zh: 很少有历史学家能够洞悉该政权隐秘的动机。

items.def_en: To understand a difficult problem or someone's motives fully after deep thought
items.ex_en: We could not fathom the true motives behind his sudden, uncharacteristic resignation.
items.ex_zh: 我们无法彻底弄清他突然且反常辞职背后的真正动机。

items.def_en: To integrate knowledge, attitudes, or values so thoroughly that they become part of one's nature
items.ex_en: Students gradually internalize ethical principles through daily social interactions and practical guidance.
items.ex_zh: 学生们通过日常的社会交往和实践指导逐步内化伦理原则。

items.def_zh: 领悟，心领神会，彻底理解
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To understand something intuitively, deeply, and completely.
items.ex_en: Once you grok the core concept, writing the code becomes remarkably straightforward.
items.ex_zh: 一旦你彻底领悟了这个核心概念，编写代码就会变得非常简单。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express an exhaustive, intuitive, or penetrating comprehension that transcends superficial knowing to attain complete mastery.
groups.summary_zh: 表示超越表面了解，直达底层逻辑或全盘内化的深度领会与彻悟。
groups.desc_en: Achieving absolute intellectual mastery or existential comprehension of complex realities, contrasting with surface 'hear' through profound depth of assimilation.
groups.desc_zh: 对深奥真理或复杂事实达成彻底的理性洞察与心理同化，与浮于表面的'听闻(hear)'不同，强调参透实质与全盘融会贯通。
groups.nuance_en: grasp: to mentally seize and comprehend an intricate idea or situation (concept / significance / basics) · fathom: to probe and comprehend something unfathomably deep or enigmatic (mystery / motives / abyss) · penetrate: to see through complex disguises to reach the core truth (essence / disguise / reality) · internalize: to deeply assimilate ideas or values into one's subconscious identity (values / norms / lessons) · grok: to empathically and holistically understand something until subject and object merge (culture / concept / problem)
groups.nuance_zh: grasp: 准确领会抓住复杂概念的核心要义 (concept / significance / basics) · fathom: 测透并参悟深邃莫测之谜或行事动机 (mystery / motives / abyss) · penetrate: 洞穿迷雾表象直击事物本质 (essence / disguise / reality) · internalize: 将外在价值与规范深度内化融入心智 (values / norms / lessons) · grok: 直觉性、全身心共情并彻底神会 (culture / concept / problem)

groups.name: Default & Back Out · 食言与毁约 (Renege, Weasel Out, Back Out)
groups.tip: 食言反悔或不履行契约

items.def_en: (+ of) To decide not to do something that you had previously agreed to do
items.ex_en: The nervous investor decided to back out of the high-stakes property deal.
items.ex_zh: 那位焦虑的投资者决定退出这笔高风险的房地产交易。
items.ex2_en: The experienced driver carefully backed the delivery truck out of the tight loading bay.
items.ex2_zh: 经验丰富的司机小心翼翼地把送货卡车倒出了狭窄的装卸区。

items.def_en: (+ of) To evade an agreed responsibility or commitment through deceitful excuses
items.ex_en: He made up an excuse to weasel out of his weekend shift.
items.ex_zh: 他编造了一个借口，想从周末的值班中狡猾溜号。

items.def_en: (+ on) To fail to fulfill a contract, legal obligation, or debt repayment
items.ex_en: The firm warned that it might default on its upcoming bond payment.
items.ex_zh: 该企业警告称，它可能会在即将到期的债券偿付中违约。

items.def_en: (+ on) To fail to fulfill an obligation or avoid paying a debt or bet
items.ex_en: He vanished into the crowd after trying to welsh on the bet.
items.ex_zh: 他试图赖掉赌注后便消失在了人群中。

items.def_en: (+ on) To break a promise, agreement, or formal commitment.
items.ex_en: The administration warned foreign leaders not to renege on their treaty commitments.
items.ex_zh: 政府警告外国领导人不要食言违背其条约承诺。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures bad-faith evasions and withdrawals from pledges, bargains, or binding duties after prior agreement.
groups.summary_zh: 聚焦达成共识后违背诺言、耍赖反悔或推脱协议的违约行为。
groups.desc_en: Actors retract a prior commitment or contractual obligation through evasive withdrawal, distinct from mutual termination or negotiated release.
groups.desc_zh: 行为人通过回避或毁约单方面撤回先前的承诺或契约，区别于协商解约或和平终止。
groups.nuance_en: back out: informal retreat from an agreement before completion (deal / commitment) · weasel out: cowardly evasion using excuses or technicalities (responsibility / obligation) · default: legal or financial failure to fulfill duty (loan / contract) · welsh: dishonorable non-payment of a debt, especially a bet (wager / debt) · renege: formal breaking of a solemn promise or covenant (pledge / treaty)
groups.nuance_zh: back out: 在完成前非正式退缩毁约 (deal / commitment) · weasel out: 借借口或漏洞狡黠逃避 (responsibility / obligation) · default: 法律或财务上未能履约违约 (loan / contract) · welsh: 赖账，特指赌债不还 (wager / debt) · renege: 背弃庄严承诺或契约 (pledge / treaty)

groups.name: Default & Renounce · 赖账与毁约 (Default, Renege, Back out)
groups.tip: 从失信赖账到恶意背叛

items.def_en: (+ of) To decide not to do something that you had previously agreed to do
items.ex_en: They feared the partner would back out of the signed joint venture.
items.ex_zh: 他们担心合作伙伴会中途反悔并退出已签署的合资项目。
items.ex2_en: She skillfully backed her sports car out of the crowded underground parking space.
items.ex2_zh: 她熟练地将跑车倒出了拥挤的地下停车位。

items.def_en: To avoid doing something you should do by providing a poor excuse
items.ex_en: Claiming sudden illness was just a lame way to cop out completely.
items.ex_zh: 声称突发疾病不过是一种彻底临阵脱逃的拙劣借口。

items.def_en: (also 'welsh on') (informal) To fail to pay a debt, fulfill an obligation, or keep a promise.
items.ex_en: His friends stopped inviting him after he welched on his card debts.
items.ex_zh: 在他屡次赖掉牌债之后，朋友们便不再邀请他了。

items.def_en: (+ on) To fail to fulfill a financial obligation, especially repayment of a loan
items.ex_en: Small business owners may default on bank loans during severe financial downturns.
items.ex_zh: 在严重的经济低迷时期，小企业主可能会拖欠银行贷款。

items.def_en: (+ on) To fail to keep a promise, agreement, or formal undertaking
items.ex_en: The union refused to accept terms if employers intended to renege later.
items.ex_zh: 如果雇主打算事后反悔，工会便拒绝接受这些条款。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on failing to fulfill commitments, pay debts, or keep pledges, especially through evasive, dishonorable, or unilateral withdrawal.
groups.summary_zh: 指违背诺言、拒绝履行经济责任或背弃协议毁约。
groups.desc_en: Escalating abandonment of financial and moral obligations, progressing from timid withdrawal to flagrant, legally actionable non-performance.
groups.desc_zh: 财务或道义责任的递进式弃绝，程度从怯懦退缩升级至公然、具法律责任的彻底违约。
groups.nuance_en: cop out: weak evasion under pressure (duty / test) · back out: withdrawing prior consent (agreement / partnership) · welsh: deliberate evasion of unrecorded or illicit debts (bet / wager) · renege: explicit disavowal of an accepted bargain (promise / pact) · default: systematic or catastrophic contractual non-compliance (debt / sovereign bond)
groups.nuance_zh: cop out: 压力下的逃避与撂挑子 (duty / test) · back out: 撤回先前的同意与介入 (agreement / partnership) · welsh: 故意赖掉口头或非法债务 (bet / wager) · renege: 公然反悔背弃已达成的约定 (promise / pact) · default: 系统性或灾难性的法律/金融违约 (debt / sovereign bond)

groups.name: Defecate & Bowel Movement · 排便与排遗 (Crap, Defecate, Excrete)
groups.tip: 肠道蠕动排出大便废物

items.def_en: To pass feces from the bowels, used especially by or to children or casually
items.ex_en: The puppy ran happily onto the grass to poop after breakfast.
items.ex_zh: 小狗吃完早饭后高兴地跑到草地上拉臭臭。

items.def_en: To discharge waste matter from the body by a normal bodily function
items.ex_en: Healthy kidneys excrete metabolic waste products continuously into the collected urine.
items.ex_zh: 健康的肾脏会不断将新陈代谢废物排泄到收集的尿液中。

items.def_en: To discharge feces from the bowels through the anus
items.ex_en: Patients with severe spinal injuries may temporarily lose the ability to defecate.
items.ex_zh: 脊髓严重受损的患者可能会暂时失去正常排便的能力。

items.def_en: 1. (informal, often taboo) To defecate; to have a bowel movement.
items.ex_en: The stray dog decided to crap right in the middle of our driveway.
items.ex_zh: 那只流浪狗偏偏在我们家车道正中央拉了泡屎。

items.def_en: To pass waste from the bowels; vulgar and taboo in standard contexts
items.ex_en: The terrified soldier felt an overwhelming urge to shit during the sudden ambush.
items.ex_zh: 在那场突遭的伏击中，吓坏了的士兵极度想拉屎。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers physiological excretion of solid bowel waste, ranging from technical medical terms to highly informal and taboo slang.
groups.summary_zh: 表示排出固体排泄物生理活动，涵盖从医学术语到日常通俗及粗俗俚语。
groups.desc_en: Biological evacuation of solid intestinal waste, differentiated by clinical neutrality, nursery delicacy, or vulgar coarseness.
groups.desc_zh: 人体或动物排泄固体肠道废物的生理行为，依临床中立性、儿语委婉或粗俗冒犯度区分。
groups.nuance_en: excrete: physiological expulsion of metabolic waste (waste / toxins) · defecate: clinical or medical voiding of feces (bowels / stool) · poop: benign, colloquial or child-directed terminology (pants / diaper) · crap: blunt, mildly crude colloquialism (bed / pants) · shit: intensely vulgar, taboo expletive verb (pants / bed)
groups.nuance_zh: excrete: 生理学代谢废物的排出 (waste / toxins) · defecate: 临床医学术语的排便 (bowels / stool) · poop: 温和、通俗或儿语的便便 (pants / diaper) · crap: 粗俗随意的拉屎 (bed / pants) · shit: 极度粗鄙的冒犯性排泄禁忌语 (pants / bed)

groups.name: Define & Delimit · 界定与定义 (Define, Delimit, Delineate, Demarcate)
groups.tip: 划定概念范围并明确定义

items.def_zh: 界定；给……下定义；阐明，明确
items.def_en: 1. To establish the limits, nature, or character of something. 2. To state or explain the exact meaning of a word, phrase, or concept.
items.ex_en: The guidelines explicitly define the scope of authority granted to each investigator.
items.ex_zh: 这些指引明确界定了授予每位调查员的权力范围。

items.def_en: To describe, trace, or portray outline edges and specifics with exact precision
items.ex_en: The blue lines delineate the administrative boundary between the two historic districts.
items.ex_zh: 蓝线精准描画了这两个历史街区之间的行政边界。

items.def_en: To draw a line around something and restrict its scope or freedom tightly
items.ex_en: Strict national laws circumscribe the executive powers of the regional military commander.
items.ex_zh: 严格的国家法律严密限制了地区军事指挥官的行政权力。

items.def_en: To determine and mark the precise borders, limits, or scope of something
items.ex_en: Surveyors were deployed to delimit the exact frontier separating both nations.
items.ex_zh: 测量人员被派去划定分隔两国领土的准确边界。

items.def_en: To set distinct boundaries separating one zone, category, or sphere from another
items.ex_en: Bright yellow cones demarcate the pedestrian corridor from the ongoing construction site.
items.ex_zh: 明黄色的锥形桶将行人通道与施工现场明确隔开。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this precise analytical frame describe establishing the exact boundaries, meaning, scope, or constituent properties of concepts, territories, and jurisdictions.
groups.summary_zh: 着重确立概念内涵、权限边界或实体轮廓，使其范围明晰而不含混。
groups.desc_en: Establishing boundaries of concepts, areas, or rights, differing from mere describing by imposing restrictive conceptual or spatial borders.
groups.desc_zh: 确立概念、地域或权限的清晰边界，区别于一般描述，强调施加限制性或分割性的界线。
groups.nuance_en: define: state essential nature and semantic scope (term / role) · delineate: trace specific outlines or steps in detail (boundary / procedure) · circumscribe: tightly restrict within confining limits (power / freedom) · delimit: fix measurable terminal boundaries (jurisdiction / zone) · demarcate: physically or conceptually separate into distinct zones (territory / border)
groups.nuance_zh: define: 阐释本质特征与语义范畴 (term / role) · delineate: 详尽描绘具体轮廓或步骤 (boundary / procedure) · circumscribe: 严格限制于狭隘范畴内 (power / freedom) · delimit: 确定可计量的终端边界 (jurisdiction / zone) · demarcate: 在物理或概念上划出分界线 (territory / border)

groups.name: Dehumanize & Degrade · 剥夺人性与极度贬抑 (Dehumanize, Degrade, Brutalize)
groups.tip: 抹杀人性与道德败坏

items.def_en: To treat someone with such utter disrespect that they lose their dignity or self-respect
items.ex_en: Prison guards deliberately subjected the detainees to treatment designed to degrade them.
items.ex_zh: 狱警故意对被拘留者施以旨在贬低其人格的侮辱性对待。

items.def_en: To treat someone merely as a tool or object without regard to their humanity or feelings
items.ex_en: Critics argued that the provocative marketing campaign tended to objectify female athletes.
items.ex_zh: 批评人士认为，这场博眼球的营销活动倾向于将女性运动员物化。

items.def_en: To lower someone's position, esteem, or pride through severe humiliation or subservience
items.ex_en: The captive refused to abase himself before the tyrant to beg mercy.
items.ex_zh: 俘虏拒绝向暴君卑躬屈膝以乞求宽恕。

items.def_en: To treat someone with such sustained cruelty that they become numb or violent like a beast
items.ex_en: Months in solitary confinement threatened to brutalize the fragile young inmate.
items.ex_zh: 数月的单独监禁极有可能野蛮摧残这名脆弱的年轻囚犯。

items.def_en: 1. (chiefly British) To deprive people of positive human qualities, rights, or dignity.
items.ex_en: Overcrowded conditions and harsh rules served only to dehumanise the vulnerable patients.
items.ex_zh: 拥挤不堪的环境和严苛的规定只会剥夺这些脆弱病患的人性尊严。

groups.summary_en: This frame denotes subjecting people to conditions or treatment that strips away their fundamental human qualities, agency, dignity, and rights, reducing them symbolically or functionally to beasts or objects.
groups.summary_zh: 极度贬低人的尊严，剥夺其作为人的基本权利与体面。
groups.desc_en: Systematic degradation that strips human dignity, escalating from objectifying mistreatment to reducing individuals to beasts or things.
groups.desc_zh: 剥夺人类尊严的系统性贬损，从物化慢待升级为将人彻底退化为牲畜或器物的极度暴行。
groups.nuance_en: objectify: reduce an autonomous human to an instrument or sexual object (women / workers) · degrade: lower in status, dignity, or moral character (prisoner / victim) · abase: actively humiliate and bring low (oneself / rival) · brutalize: desensitize to cruelty and make savage (inmates / population) · dehumanise: systematically erase humanity and treat as subhuman (refugees / enemy)
groups.nuance_zh: objectify: 将具有主体性的人工具化或性物化 (women / workers) · degrade: 贬低身份、尊严或道德人格 (prisoner / victim) · abase: 贬抑降格并施加极度屈辱 (oneself / rival) · brutalize: 残酷虐待致使兽化麻木 (inmates / population) · dehumanise: 系统性抹杀人性并视为非人物种 (refugees / enemy)

groups.name: Demand Performance & Recall · 喝彩返场与呼求 (Encore, Recall, Clamor)
groups.tip: 从礼貌请求升级为坚决要求

items.def_zh: 鼓掌喝彩（以示赞许或催促）
items.def_en: To show strong approval or urge further performance by repeatedly clapping hands
items.ex_en: Delighted spectators stood up to applaud enthusiastically after the stunning violin solo.
items.ex_zh: 惊艳的小提琴独奏结束后，欣喜的观众纷纷起立热烈鼓掌。

items.def_en: To bring a performer back onto the stage after a performance through sustained audience ovation
items.ex_en: Thunderous cheering and rhythmic clapping finally called back the exhausted lead singer.
items.ex_zh: 雷鸣般的欢呼和有节奏的掌声最终将疲惫的主唱叫回了舞台。

items.def_en: To summon a performer back to the stage by continuous applause or cheering
items.ex_en: The enthusiastic audience managed to recall the celebrated soprano three distinct times.
items.ex_zh: 热情的观众先后三次召唤这位著名的女高音歌唱家返场谢幕。

items.def_zh: 要求（演员）再演一次，要求重唱；为……喝彩加演
items.def_en: To call for a performer to repeat a song or give an extra performance at the end of a show.
items.ex_en: The excited crowd rose to encore the guitarist after his virtuosic solo.
items.ex_zh: 在吉他手技惊四座的独奏后，兴奋的观众纷纷起立喝彩要求加演。

items.def_en: To demand something loudly, insistently, and noisily as part of a collective crowd
items.ex_en: Frustrated commuters began to clamor for immediate improvements to the rail network.
items.ex_zh: 沮丧的通勤者们开始大声喧嚷，要求立即改善铁路网络。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe audiences vocally or enthusiastically demanding an additional performance, an immediate reappearance, or an urgent public presentation from performers or speakers.
groups.summary_zh: 指观众或公众通过喝彩、掌声热切呼吁表演者返场或加演。
groups.desc_en: Audience or collective vocal pressure urging a performer or decision-maker back into action, spanning polite acclaim to riotous insistence.
groups.desc_zh: 受众或群体通过声浪施压促使表演者或决策者重返台前或顺从意向，涵盖从礼貌喝彩到喧嚣逼迫。
groups.nuance_en: applaud: express basic appreciation through clapping (performance / decision) · call back: summons back to stage for further bows (actor / soloist) · recall: formally summon back from a post or stage (ambassador / artist) · encore: vocally demand a supplementary performance (singer / band) · clamor for: noisily and urgently demand immediate return or concession (reform / release)
groups.nuance_zh: applaud: 鼓掌表达基本的赞赏 (performance / decision) · call back: 唤回演员谢幕或加演 (actor / soloist) · recall: 正式召回离场者或离任者 (ambassador / artist) · encore: 喝彩高呼要求返场加演 (singer / band) · clamor for: 喧闹且迫切地喧嚷要求 (reform / release)

groups.name: Demobilize & Disarm · 复员与解散军备 (Stand Down, Decommission, De-escalate)
groups.tip: 战争结束后遣散复员军队

items.def_en: To officially order military troops or security personnel to relax alert or leave high-readiness duty
items.ex_en: The CEO decided to stand down after the company's financial scandal was exposed.
items.ex_zh: 公司财务丑闻曝光后，首席执行官决定引咎辞职。

items.def_en: To formally discharge soldiers from military service, especially at the conclusion of a campaign
items.ex_en: After five years abroad, Sergeant Miller was officially mustered out this morning.
items.ex_zh: 在海外服役五年后，米勒中士于今晨正式退伍遣散。

items.def_en: To take weapons away from troops or a group, or to reduce military weaponry drastically
items.ex_en: Peacekeepers arrived at the remote outpost to safely disarm the rebel fighters.
items.ex_zh: 维和人员赶赴偏远哨所，安全解除了叛军武装人员的武装。
items.ex2_en: The rival nations agreed to disarm voluntarily after signing the historic peace accord.
items.ex2_zh: 各交战国在签署具有历史意义的和平协议后同意自愿解除武装。

items.def_zh: 正式退役，停止服役（军舰、武器设施）
items.def_en: To officially withdraw a military vessel, weapon system, or installation from operational service
items.ex_en: The navy finalized plans to decommission the aging aircraft carrier next spring.
items.ex_zh: 海军最终敲定了于明年春天让这艘老化的航空母舰正式退役的计划。

items.def_en: (military) To release soldiers from military service, or convert armed forces from a war footing to peace.
items.ex_en: The government ordered the army to demobilize tens of thousands of conscripts.
items.ex_zh: 政府下令军队安排数万名应征入伍的士兵复员。
items.ex2_en: The infantry division will demobilize rapidly following the formal declaration of lasting regional peace.
items.ex2_zh: 在正式宣布实现持久的地区和平后，步兵师将迅速复员。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the formal transition of military forces, personnel, or assets from combat readiness back to a peacetime status. They emphasize orderly drawdown, disarmament, and release from armed service.
groups.summary_zh: 军队或武装力量从战备状态转为和平状态，裁撤或复员。
groups.desc_en: Reverting military units, equipment, or postures from wartime readiness to civil or peaceful operational status.
groups.desc_zh: 将军事编制、作战装备或战备态势从战时待发状态转入和平或民用状态。
groups.nuance_en: stand down: temporarily relax military readiness or alert (forces / alert) · mustered out: formally discharge soldiers upon service end (conscript / regiment) · disarm: strip combatants of offensive weaponry (militia / combatant) · decommission: permanently withdraw military hardware from active service (warship / nuclear reactor) · demobilize: disband standing wartime armies into civilian society (troops / army)
groups.nuance_zh: stand down: 暂时解除战备警报或戒备 (forces / alert) · mustered out: 服役期满后正式退伍解甲 (conscript / regiment) · disarm: 缴除武装人员的进攻性武器 (militia / combatant) · decommission: 使军用舰艇/重器退役或封存 (warship / nuclear reactor) · demobilize: 大规模复员解散战时正规军 (troops / army)

groups.name: Demonetize & Strip Validity · 废止法定地位与去货币化 (Decertify, De-register, Invalidate)
groups.tip: 官方宣告法令或货币失效

items.def_en: To officially revoke the certified status, license, or recognition of an organization or product
items.ex_en: The regulatory board voted unanimously to decertify the non-compliant aviation training academy.
items.ex_zh: 监管委员会一致投票决定吊销该违规航空培训学院的认证资质。

items.def_en: To remove an individual, vehicle, or entity from an official government or administrative registry
items.ex_en: Authorities moved swiftly to de-register the vehicle following severe safety violations.
items.ex_zh: 由于严重违规，当局迅速注销了这辆车的登记信息。

items.def_en: To make a document, ticket, contract, or law officially and legally no longer valid
items.ex_en: Failure to provide a valid signature will invalidate the entire purchase agreement.
items.ex_zh: 未能提供有效签名将导致整份采购协议作废失效。

items.def_zh: 宣布无效，使丧失法律效力
items.def_en: To cause something to have no value or effect, or officially void a legal decree
items.ex_en: The supreme court ruling effectively served to nullify the controversial regional decree.
items.ex_zh: 最高法院的裁决实际上废除了这项饱受争议的地方政令。

items.def_zh: 废除（货币等的）法定地位，使停止流通；取消（视频等）营利资格
items.def_en: 1. To officially stop using a particular coin or banknote as legal money. 2. To prevent a content creator from earning money from their online material.
items.ex_en: The central bank decided to demonetize the highest-denomination banknotes without warning.
items.ex_zh: 中央银行在未作预警的情况下决定废除最高面额纸币的法定地位。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this regulatory frame describe stripping a financial instrument, license, credential, or content asset of its official legal standing or commercial earning privileges.
groups.summary_zh: 指官方或平台剥夺资产、凭证或资格的法定效力与商业化权利。
groups.desc_en: Institutional revocation of official currency status, certification, or legal validity, rendering assets or documents null and void.
groups.desc_zh: 官方体制性废除法币地位、资质认证或法律效力，致使资产或文件彻底失效。
groups.nuance_en: decertify: revoke professional qualification or collective license (union / pilot) · de-register: remove from an official registry or roster (vehicle / charity) · invalidate: undermine the substantive truth or legal force (claim / election) · nullify: legally declare completely void ab initio (contract / law) · demonetize: strip banknotes of legal tender status (currency / notes)
groups.nuance_zh: decertify: 撤销专业执照或资质认定 (union / pilot) · de-register: 从官方名录或注册簿中注销 (vehicle / charity) · invalidate: 使证据或结果失去事实或法律效力 (claim / election) · nullify: 依法宣布自始完全无效 (contract / law) · demonetize: 废止货币的法定流通支付地位 (currency / notes)

groups.name: Demonize & Vilify · 妖魔化与极度丑化 (Demonize, Vilify, Slander, Malign)
groups.tip: 从轻视贬低上升到妖魔化抹黑

items.def_en: To tell damaging untruths or voice spiteful criticisms that harm a person's good reputation
items.ex_en: Vindictive tabloids attempted to malign the respected doctor with unverified allegations.
items.ex_zh: 心怀怨恨的小报企图用未经证实的指控来诽谤这位受人尊敬的医生。

items.def_en: To unjustifiably disparage, degrade, or diminish the significance and virtue of someone
items.ex_en: He went out of his way to denigrate his rival's scientific achievements.
items.ex_zh: 他竭力贬低竞争对手所取得的科学成就。

items.def_en: To deliberately tarnish someone's public reputation by propagating scandalous falsehoods
items.ex_en: Rival candidates spread baseless rumors to smear her spotless public reputation.
items.ex_zh: 竞争对手散布毫无根据的谣言，企图抹黑她无可挑剔的公众声誉。

items.def_en: To speak or write about someone in an extremely derogatory, malicious, and defamatory manner
items.ex_en: The partisan press continued to vilify the reformer throughout the bitter campaign.
items.ex_zh: 在残酷的竞选期间，党派媒体不断恶毒中伤这位改革者。

items.def_zh: 妖魔化，将……描绘为凶恶者
items.def_en: To portray someone or something as wicked, threatening, or completely evil.
items.ex_en: Sensational media outlets routinely demonize opposing politicians to generate higher viewership.
items.ex_zh: 耸人听闻的媒体机构惯于妖魔化对立派政客以博取更高的收视率。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate intensely aggressive rhetorical attacks intended to brand targets as inherently evil, dangerous, or contemptible in the public eye.
groups.summary_zh: 通过舆论或言辞将目标刻画为邪恶、危险或下劣之人，极力败坏其人格声望。
groups.desc_en: Aggressively damaging another's reputation, escalating from biased detraction to painting the target as an existential evil.
groups.desc_zh: 极力损害他人名誉与公众形象，从偏颇贬损升级至将其塑造成纯粹邪恶的妖魔。
groups.nuance_en: denigrate: disparage character or unfairly diminish worth (reputation / achievement) · malign: speak ill of with malicious hostility (character / intentions) · smear: spread false and sordid accusations (candidate / record) · vilify: defame in brutally abusive public language (opponents / press) · demonize: portray a group or figure as wicked and subhuman (minority / adversary)
groups.nuance_zh: denigrate: 贬抑抹黑其成就或品格 (reputation / achievement) · malign: 怀有恶意地中伤与诽谤 (character / intentions) · smear: 捏造丑闻污蔑其政治声誉 (candidate / record) · vilify: 用极具辱骂性的语言口诛笔伐 (opponents / press) · demonize: 将特定对象渲染为邪恶罪魁 (minority / adversary)

groups.name: Denote & Stand For · 代表与表示 (Denote, Signify, Represent)
groups.tip: 符号或词语明确指代特定含义

items.def_en: To be a symbol or expression of a particular fact, concept, or quality
items.ex_en: The interconnected rings represent unity among nations across the five continents.
items.ex_zh: 这些相互环扣的圆环代表着五大洲各国人民的团结。

items.def_en: To represent or mean a particular word, idea, or concept as a symbol or abbreviation
items.ex_en: The school management will not stand for any form of bullying on campus.
items.ex_zh: 学校管理层绝不容忍校园内出现任何形式的霸凌行为。

items.def_en: (formal) To be a sign, mark, or symbol of something; to mean or represent a specific thing directly
items.ex_en: In mathematical diagrams, red arrows denote the precise direction of movement.
items.ex_zh: 在数学图表中，红色箭头直接指代具体的运动方向。

items.def_en: To represent or stand for an abstract quality or idea as an emblem
items.ex_en: In many cultures, the white dove is used to symbolize enduring peace.
items.ex_zh: 在许多文化中，白鸽都被用来象征长久的和平。

items.def_en: To be a representative symbol or characteristic example of a category
items.ex_en: These minimalist brick structures typify early twentieth-century industrial architecture perfectly.
items.ex_zh: 这些极简风格的砖砌建筑完美代表了二十世纪初工业建筑的典型特征。

groups.summary_en: This linguistic and semiotic frame describes serving as a direct formal sign, symbol, or literal definition of a concept. Denoting centers on literal representation and semantic reference, standing in contrast to connotative or emotional overtones.
groups.summary_zh: 指符号、代号或术语在字面意义或约定俗成上的直接指代与象征。
groups.desc_en: Serving as a semantic, symbolic, or institutional surrogate for an underlying meaning or entity, contrasting with direct identification.
groups.desc_zh: 充当底层概念或主体的语义、符号或体制替代指代，区别于直接等同。
groups.nuance_en: denote: refer directly to an explicit primary meaning (referent / concept) · represent: stand in as an official delegate or visual proxy (client / value) · stand for: serve as an abbreviation, token, or principle (abbreviation / freedom) · symbolize: embody an abstract quality through a physical token (peace / hope) · typify: serve as the quintessential embodiment of a class (style / era)
groups.nuance_zh: denote: 直接指涉字面外延与概念 (referent / concept) · represent: 作为法定代表或图像具象代理 (client / value) · stand for: 作为缩写或所坚守信念的代表 (abbreviation / freedom) · symbolize: 以具象意象象征抽象品质 (peace / hope) · typify: 成为某类别或时代的典型代表 (style / era)

groups.name: Dental Hygiene & Interdental Care · 洁牙与口腔护理 (Brush, Gargle, Swish)
groups.tip: 用牙线剔牙等细致的身体洁护

items.def_en: To clean and polish the teeth with a toothbrush and dentifrice
items.ex_en: Dentists strongly recommend that you brush your teeth thoroughly twice a day.
items.ex_zh: 牙医强烈建议每天彻底刷两次牙。

items.def_en: To clear residual debris or mouthwash from the oral cavity with water
items.ex_en: Use lukewarm water to rinse out your mouth thoroughly after spitting toothpaste.
items.ex_zh: 吐掉牙膏后，用温水将口腔彻底漱洗干净。

items.def_en: 1. To clean between one's teeth using dental floss.
items.ex_en: It is essential to floss every night before going straight to bed.
items.ex_zh: 每晚睡前用牙线剔牙是至关重要的。

items.def_en: To move liquid rapidly back and forth inside the mouth to cleanse teeth and gums
items.ex_en: She began to swish the antiseptic mouthwash vigorously around her gums.
items.ex_zh: 她开始在牙龈周围大力鼓漱抗菌漱口水。
items.ex2_en: Cold ocean waves swished rhythmically against the wooden pilings of the quiet pier.
items.ex2_zh: 冰冷的海浪有节奏地哗哗拍打着安静码头的木桩。

items.def_en: To wash the throat and mouth with a liquid held in the back of the mouth and kept in motion by breathing out through it
items.ex_en: You should gargle with warm salt water to relieve your sore throat.
items.ex_zh: 你应该用温盐水漱口，以缓解喉咙疼痛。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe intentional hygiene practices targeting the teeth, gums, and oral cavity to dislodge food particles, eliminate plaque, and freshen breath.
groups.summary_zh: 清洁牙缝、牙面及口腔黏膜以去除牙垢或食物残渣。
groups.desc_en: Executing targeted procedural hygiene on teeth and gums, contrasting with generic bathing by focusing on mechanical and fluid oral cleansing.
groups.desc_zh: 对牙齿与牙龈实施针对性的局部卫生护理，区别于普通洗漱，强调机械清扫与流体冲淋。
groups.nuance_en: brush: clean surface enamel using bristle friction (teeth / tongue) · floss: remove interdental plaque with fine thread (teeth / gums) · swish: agitate liquid vigorously inside mouth (mouthwash / saline) · gargle: bubble liquid in the throat using exhaled breath (solution / warm salt water) · rinse out: wash away residual paste or debris with water (mouth / cup)
groups.nuance_zh: brush: 使用刷毛机械摩擦清洁釉质表面 (teeth / tongue) · floss: 使用细线清除齿缝牙菌斑 (teeth / gums) · swish: 鼓动口腔令液体反复冲洗 (mouthwash / saline) · gargle: 仰头呼气在咽喉部震荡液体含漱 (solution / warm salt water) · rinse out: 用清水冲洗排出口腔残渣 (mouth / cup)

groups.name: Denude & Bare · 剥蚀与脱去覆盖 (Denude, Strip, Defoliate)
groups.tip: 剥去外层覆盖使其裸露

items.def_en: Uncover something completely so that its underlying structure or bare surface is exposed
items.ex_en: Winter winds stripped the forest, laying bare the jagged granite cliffs beneath.
items.ex_zh: 凛冽的冬风吹尽了林木，使下方嶙峋的花岗岩峭壁显露无遗。

items.def_en: (formal) (+ of) Strip someone or something of clothes, attributes, or possessions
items.ex_en: The tribunal chose to divest the disgraced official of all honorary titles.
items.ex_zh: 法庭决定剥夺这名身败名裂的官员所有的荣誉头衔。

items.def_en: Remove all coverings, vegetation, or contents from something until nothing remains
items.ex_en: Looters completely stripped the historic mansion bare within just a few hours.
items.ex_zh: 劫掠者在短短几小时内就将这座历史宅邸洗劫一空。

items.def_zh: 使裸露，剥去……的覆盖物；剥夺
items.def_en: (formal) To strip something of its covering, possessions, or assets, making it bare.
items.ex_en: Extensive open-pit mining operations quickly denuded the once lush mountain slopes.
items.ex_zh: 大面积的露天采矿作业迅速使曾经郁郁葱葱的山坡变得光秃裸露。

items.def_en: Cause the leaves of trees and growing plants to fall off, typically via chemicals or blight
items.ex_en: Military forces sprayed toxic chemicals to defoliate dense jungle areas during warfare.
items.ex_zh: 战时，军队喷洒有毒化学品以使茂密的丛林落叶殆尽。
items.ex2_en: The deciduous forest trees defoliated quickly under the severe pressure of persistent drought.
items.ex2_zh: 在持续严重干旱的重压下，落叶林木迅速落光了叶子。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on thoroughly removing the protective covering, foliage, surface layer, or vital assets of a landscape, tree, or entity, rendering it utterly bare and exposed.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重彻底除去地表植被、表面遮盖层或资产，使其裸露。
groups.desc_en: Removing an organic, protective, or decorative covering to expose the bare underlying core, distinct from general surface cleansing.
groups.desc_zh: 剥除有机物、保护层或外饰以裸露出粗糙底层，区别于一般的表面清洗。
