groups.nuance_en: strip bare: forcibly remove all garments, fittings, or bark (trees / room) · lay bare: expose previously concealed underlying reality (truth / secrets) · divest: strip away legal rights, power, or holdings (assets / authority) · defoliate: strip foliage from plants using chemicals or pests (trees / forest) · denude: strip landscape of vegetation or protective layers leaving it vulnerable (hillside / landscape)
groups.nuance_zh: negative: 投出反对票或否决提议 (proposal / bill) · turn down: 礼貌或冷淡地回绝请求与要约 (offer / invitation) · veto: 动用宪法或特权行政否决 (legislation / resolution) · disallow: 权威机构依规裁定无效不准 (claim / goal) · repudiate: 毅然拒绝承认效力、声明断绝 (debt / treaty)

groups.name: Deny & Veto · 否认与否决 (Disallow, Refute, Turn down)
groups.tip: 表达否定意见或行使否决权

items.def_zh: 否决，驳回；否定，证明……为假
items.def_en: (formal) To refuse to accept or approve; veto; to disprove or contradict.
items.ex_en: Subsequent empirical experiments will definitively negative the researcher's preliminary hypothesis.
items.ex_zh: 随后的实证实验将彻底推翻该研究人员的初步假设。

items.def_en: To reject or refuse an offer, request, or formal proposal
items.ex_en: She decided to turn down the lucrative job offer in New York.
items.ex_zh: 她决定拒绝纽约那份薪水优厚的录用通知。

items.def_en: To exercise an official right to forbid or reject a proposed law, plan, or action
items.ex_en: The president decided to veto the legislation passed by the opposing majority.
items.ex_zh: 总统决定否决反对派多数通过的这项法案。

items.def_en: To officially reject or refuse to acknowledge something as valid, legal, or permissible
items.ex_en: The referee chose to disallow the goal because of an obvious offside.
items.ex_zh: 裁判由于明显的越位判罚进球无效。

items.def_en: To refuse to accept or acknowledge the truth, validity, or authority of something
items.ex_en: The prime minister swiftly moved to repudiate the controversial treaty revisions entirely.
items.ex_zh: 首相迅速采取行动，断然拒绝承认那些充满争议的条约修改条款。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on officially or formally refusing to accept, ratify, or affirm a claim, motion, or proposal. They range from legal disallowance and legislative vetoes to categorical refutations.
groups.summary_zh: 正式否认主张的真实性，或以权威驳回、否决提案与申请。
groups.desc_en: Authoritatively or categorically rejecting an offer, legislative measure, or legal claim, contrasting with gentle hesitation.
groups.desc_zh: 权威性或断然驳回提议、立法议案或法律诉求，区别于犹豫不决或协商推诿。
groups.nuance_en: turn down: refuse an offer, request, or application (offer / invitation) · disallow: declare an action invalid under existing rules (goal / deduction) · veto: exercise statutory power to block enactment (legislation / bill) · negative: formally reject by voting or official decision (motion / proposition) · repudiate: refuse to accept, acknowledge, or honor (doctrine / debt)
groups.nuance_zh: turn down: 礼貌或直接回绝申请与邀请 (offer / invitation) · disallow: 裁判或主管机构依规裁定不予准许 (goal / deduction) · veto: 行使法定权力否决议案 (legislation / bill) · negative: 通过表决或官方决议予以否定 (motion / proposition) · repudiate: 坚决断绝关系或拒不承认约束力 (doctrine / debt)

groups.name: Depart & Disperse · 离别与分离 (Part, Part Ways, Separate)
groups.tip: 彼此分开离开

items.def_zh: 分离，分别，分手；使分开，隔开；（使头发）分缝
items.def_en: 1. To leave someone or go away from each other; separate. 2. To separate people or things that are together.
items.ex_en: They promised to write frequently before they parted at the train station.
items.ex_zh: 他们在火车站分别前，答应彼此要常常写信。
items.ex2_en: The young mother carefully parted her daughter's silky tangled hair with a wooden comb.
items.ex2_zh: 年轻的母亲用木梳小心地分开了女儿柔顺缠结的头发。

items.def_en: To end a relationship, companionship, or professional association and go separate paths
items.ex_en: The two co-founders decided to part ways after a bitter financial dispute.
items.ex_zh: 两位联合创始人在一场激烈的财务纠纷后决定分道扬镳。

items.def_en: To separate from a main route, party, or stream and take a different direction
items.ex_en: A narrow hiking trail branches off toward the summit just past the creek.
items.ex_zh: 刚过小溪，一条狭窄的登山小径便岔开通向山顶。

items.def_en: To quickly move or cause to move apart in various directions
items.ex_en: The loud thunderclap made the flock of birds scatter in all directions.
items.ex_zh: 一声响雷让这群鸟惊慌地四散飞开。
items.ex2_en: A sudden gust of wind scattered the neatly organized papers across the courtyard floor.
items.ex2_zh: 一阵突如其来的大风将整理整齐的文件吹散在整个院子里。

items.def_en: To move apart and go away in different directions, causing a crowd or group to break up
items.ex_en: Police used loud sirens and barriers to disperse the gathering unlawful crowd.
items.ex_zh: 警察使用高音警报器和路障驱散聚集的非法抗议人群。
items.ex2_en: The dense morning fog dispersed rapidly once the bright sun rose above the horizon.
items.ex2_zh: 明亮的太阳升出地平线后，浓密的晨雾迅速散去。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical or emotional separation between two or more parties who had been traveling or spending time together. They highlight the moment of parting and going separate ways.
groups.summary_zh: 强调相聚的人群或同伴各自离开、分道扬镳的物理或情感过程。
groups.desc_en: Actors moving away from a common locus or companion, transitioning from shared cohesion into divergent spatial trajectories.
groups.desc_zh: 多个主体离开共同原点或同伴，从聚合状态走向各自发散的空间轨迹。
groups.nuance_en: part: separate from an intimate companion after an encounter (friends / lovers) · part ways: conclude a collaborative relationship or joint trajectory (colleagues / allies) · branch off: divert into an alternative path or divergent route (trail / road) · scatter: disperse chaotically in multiple directions (crowd / seeds) · disperse: break up an assembly systematically into a wider area (protesters / clouds)
groups.nuance_zh: part: 会面结束时与同伴依依告别 (friends / lovers) · part ways: 终结合作关系并分道扬镳 (colleagues / allies) · branch off: 从主路分岔进入支线 (trail / road) · scatter: 受惊扰后杂乱无章向各处四散 (crowd / seeds) · disperse: 集会人群有序或受控地消散化解 (protesters / clouds)

groups.name: Depose & Eject · 罢免与逐出权力 (Oust, Topple, Unseat)
groups.tip: 用强力将掌权者逐出职位

items.def_en: To defeat an incumbent in an election or formally remove an officeholder from their position
items.ex_en: The progressive challenger managed to unseat the five-term senator in yesterday's primary.
items.ex_zh: 这位进步派挑战者在昨天的初选中成功将连任五届的参议员拉下马。

items.def_en: To force someone out of a room, seat of authority, or property, often with physical authority
items.ex_en: Security guards were ordered to eject the unruly protester from the auditorium.
items.ex_zh: 安保人员奉命将这名不守规矩的抗议者逐出礼堂。

items.def_zh: 驱逐，罢黜，剥夺（职位或权力）
items.def_en: To force someone out of a position of power, an office, or a piece of land.
items.ex_en: Rebel forces moved quickly to oust the authoritarian president from power.
items.ex_zh: 叛军迅速采取行动，罢黜了这位当权的专制总统。

items.def_zh: 废黜；罢免（君主或政权领导人）
items.def_en: To remove a monarch or political ruler abruptly and often forcefully from high office
items.ex_en: Military officers staged a swift coup d'état to depose the reigning monarch.
items.ex_zh: 军官们发动了一场迅速的政变，废黜了在位的君主。

items.def_zh: 推翻；颠覆（政权或统治者）
items.def_en: To cause a government, regime, or dictator to fall from power completely
items.ex_en: Popular uprisings eventually helped to topple the oppressive military regime last spring.
items.ex_zh: 大众起义最终在去年春天协助推翻了残暴的军事政权。
items.ex2_en: The unstable stack of antique porcelain dishes toppled loudly onto the kitchen floor.
items.ex2_zh: 那叠放得不稳的古董瓷盘哗啦一声倒在了厨房的地板上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe forcibly removing an incumbent leader, executive, or faction from an elected office, government, or position of dominance. The actions range from institutional removal to sudden coups or regime overthrow.
groups.summary_zh: 指动用权力、投票或强制手段，将处于主导地位的领导人或对手赶下台。
groups.desc_en: Compelling an incumbent ruler or official to vacate power, escalating from electoral defeat to coercive revolutionary overthrow.
groups.desc_zh: 迫使在位执政者交出权力并离开职位，程度从选举罢免升级至暴力革命推翻。
groups.nuance_en: unseat: defeat an incumbent in an election or procedural challenge (incumbent / MP) · eject: physically or procedurally throw someone out of a position (protester / chairman) · oust: force out of a coveted post through political maneuvering (rival / CEO) · depose: formally remove a monarch or ruler from state sovereignty (king / dictator) · topple: bring down an entire regime or government by mass upheaval (regime / government)
groups.nuance_zh: unseat: 通过选举或程序性挑战罢免在任者 (incumbent / MP) · eject: 物理性驱逐或程序性逐出职位 (protester / chairman) · oust: 通过政治手腕或内斗排挤出局 (rival / CEO) · depose: 正式废黜君主或元首的主权资格 (king / dictator) · topple: 借由民众暴动或剧变推翻政权大厦 (regime / government)

groups.name: Deposit & Save Funds · 存汇与资金积蓄 (Deposit, Stash Away, Sock Away)
groups.tip: 把资金存入机构储备

items.def_zh: 把（钱）存入银行；在银行开户；（飞机等）倾斜转弯
items.def_en: 1. To deposit money in a bank, or have an account with a bank. 2. (of an aircraft) To tilt sideways when making a turn.
items.ex_en: He usually banks a portion of his monthly salary into a savings account.
items.ex_zh: 他通常会将每月工资的一部分存入银行储蓄账户。
items.ex2_en: The nimble fighter jet banked sharply to the left during the combat training exercise.
items.ex2_zh: 在作战训练演习中，敏捷的战斗机向左急剧倾斜机身飞行。

items.def_en: To put money or an asset into a bank account or financial fund
items.ex_en: She plans to deposit her annual performance bonus directly into her account.
items.ex_zh: 她计划将自己的年终绩效奖金直接存入个人账户。

items.def_en: To steadily save a sum of money over time in a secure account
items.ex_en: He managed to sock away five hundred dollars every single month.
items.ex_zh: 他每个月都能设法稳稳存下五百美元。

items.def_en: To reserve a designated portion of funds or income for a distinct future purpose
items.ex_en: They set aside a third of their monthly income for a mortgage.
items.ex_zh: 他们每月留出三分之一的收入用于偿还房贷。

items.def_en: To save an amount of money regularly in order to keep it secure
items.ex_en: She always puts away a little cash from each paycheck for emergencies.
items.ex_zh: 她每发一次薪水都会存起一点现金以备不时之需。

groups.summary_en: This frame concerns placing money, capital, or negotiable instruments into financial institutions or dedicated savings reserves for safekeeping and investment growth.
groups.summary_zh: 指将资金存入银行或储蓄账户等金融场所妥善保管。
groups.desc_en: Sequestering liquid financial assets into official repositories or private stashes for future accumulation, rather than current expenditure.
groups.desc_zh: 将流动性资金储存于法定机构或私密隐蔽处以备未来积累，区别于日常开支与即期消费。
groups.nuance_en: bank: place funds into a commercial banking system (earnings / check) · deposit: put money into an official account or reserve (funds / savings) · set aside: earmark a portion of income for a specific future purpose (money / portion) · put away: routinely save money rather than spending it (savings / cash) · sock away: discreetly stash money for emergencies or retirement (nest egg / windfall)
groups.nuance_zh: bank: 将资金存入正规商业银行体系 (earnings / check) · deposit: 向官方账户或资金池缴存金钱 (funds / savings) · set aside: 为特定目的留出、拨出部分专款 (money / portion) · put away: 定期定额存钱以防耗用 (savings / cash) · sock away: 隐秘或克制地积攒养老金或应急储备 (nest egg / windfall)

groups.name: Deride & Scorn · 鄙薄与讥刺 (Scoff, Ridicule, Mock)
groups.tip: 带着蔑视态度嘲弄，冷眼嗤笑对方短处

items.def_en: To tease or laugh at someone in a scornful or contemptuous manner, often by mimicking
items.ex_en: The rude boys continued to mock his heavy foreign accent during lunch.
items.ex_zh: 那些无礼的男孩在午餐时继续嘲弄他浓重的外国口音。

items.def_en: To make fun of someone or something unkindly in an attempt to make them appear foolish
items.ex_en: Critics publicly ridiculed the author's clumsy attempt at writing a science fiction novel.
items.ex_zh: 评论家公开嘲弄这位作者在撰写科幻小说方面所作的拙劣尝试。

items.def_en: To feel or express extreme contempt and derision toward someone or something
items.ex_en: Aristocrats tended to scorn the humble manners of the visiting provincial merchants.
items.ex_zh: 贵族们往往鄙弃那些来访的外省商人谦卑的举止。

items.def_en: (+ at) To speak about someone or something in a way that shows clear contempt and disbelief
items.ex_en: Skeptics scoffed at his ambitious claim that he could cure the disease.
items.ex_zh: 怀疑者对他声称能治愈这种疾病的狂妄说法嗤之以鼻。

items.def_en: (+ as) To treat or talk about someone or something with scorn or contempt as being ridiculous or worthless.
items.ex_en: Critics derided his simplistic economic plan as utterly naive and fundamentally flawed.
items.ex_zh: 批评者嘲弄他简陋的经济计划，斥其极其幼稚且漏洞百出。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on formal or severe expression of contempt, portraying the target as ludicrous, worthless, or completely beneath serious regard.
groups.summary_zh: 强调以居高临下的轻蔑态度将对方视作荒诞可鄙而予以嘲笑驳斥。
groups.desc_en: Expressing contemptuous dismissal through parody, hostile laughter, or haughty disdain, differing from constructive critique.
groups.desc_zh: 通过滑稽模仿、恶意哄笑或傲慢鄙视来表达对目标的彻底贬损，区别于建设性批评。
groups.nuance_en: scoff: dismiss an idea with overt vocal contempt (idea / claim) · mock: imitate or caricature someone with cruel satire (voice / accent) · ridicule: make someone the butt of general laughter and absurd humor (proposal / appearance) · scorn: treat with cold superiority as utterly beneath contempt (offer / plea) · deride: systematically belittle as worthless or foolish (efforts / theory)
groups.nuance_zh: scoff: 发出轻蔑嗤笑断然否定观点 (idea / claim) · mock: 残忍地模仿揶揄并取笑 (voice / accent) · ridicule: 将其当作荒谬笑柄公开戏弄 (proposal / appearance) · scorn: 居高临下、冷酷地鄙夷视之 (offer / plea) · deride: 体系化地嘲弄其毫无价值与愚蠢 (efforts / theory)

groups.name: Desecrate & Profane · 亵渎与玷污 (Desecrate, Defile, Violate)
groups.tip: 冒犯神圣事物玷污信仰尊严

items.def_en: To treat a sacred place, tomb, or sanctum with contemptuous disregard or physical transgression
items.ex_en: Grave robbers dared to violate the ancient royal tomb under cover of darkness.
items.ex_zh: 盗墓贼竟敢在夜色掩护下侵犯古代皇陵。

items.def_en: To make something sacred dirty, unholy, or corrupt through offensive acts
items.ex_en: Invading barbarians were determined to defile the ancient and revered holy temple.
items.ex_zh: 入侵的蛮族决意玷污这座古老而受人尊崇的圣殿。

items.def_en: (formal) To treat something sacred, holy, or revered with irreverence or disrespect.
items.ex_en: Vandals sought to profane the sacred cemetery by carving blasphemous symbols everywhere.
items.ex_zh: 破坏者企图通过到处刻画亵渎符号来玷污这座神圣的公墓。

items.def_en: To damage, deface, or treat a sacred place, object, or concept with radical disrespect
items.ex_en: Masked intruders entered the chapel at midnight to desecrate the central altar.
items.ex_zh: 蒙面入侵者在半夜闯入礼拜堂亵渎中央祭坛。

items.def_en: To speak irreverently or contemptuously of God, holy figures, or sacred principles
items.ex_en: The religious council condemned anyone who chose to blaspheme the Holy Prophet.
items.ex_zh: 宗教委员会谴责了任何敢于亵渎神圣先知的人。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this moral and religious frame denote treating holy places, cherished artifacts, or deeply held principles with gross disrespect, contempt, or malicious violation. They vary from outright physical vandalism of shrines to moral debasement.
groups.summary_zh: 指对神圣事物、崇高信仰或遗址进行不敬侵犯与亵渎。
groups.desc_en: Violating the inviolable spiritual, sacred, or reverential sanctity of an object or shrine through defilement, distinct from physical damage.
groups.desc_zh: 通过亵渎与玷污破坏崇高物或圣所不可侵犯的精神神圣性，区别于纯粹的物理破坏。
groups.nuance_en: violate: infringe upon moral purity or sacred boundary (sanctuary / trust) · defile: spoil the spiritual purity or cleanness of a holy site (tomb / shrine) · profane: treat sacred things with irreverence or coarse secularity (name / rites) · desecrate: deliberately vandalize or degrade a consecrated site (graves / temple) · blaspheme: utter sacrilegious insults against divinity (God / sacred things)
groups.nuance_zh: violate: 侵犯神圣边界或玷污纯洁性 (sanctuary / trust) · defile: 污染毁损圣地在精神上的洁净 (tomb / shrine) · profane: 以世俗粗俗言行慢待神圣物 (name / rites) · desecrate: 故意损毁、践踏已被祝圣的遗迹与宗庙 (graves / temple) · blaspheme: 出言侮慢咒骂神明与圣物 (God / sacred things)

groups.name: Deserve & Merit · 值得与配得 (Deserve, Merit, Warrant, Earn)
groups.tip: 具备相称的价值与资格

items.def_zh: 配得上，值得（常用于否定）
items.def_en: To be considered worthy of receiving a specific rank, notice, or mention
items.ex_en: Such trivial workplace gossip hardly rates a formal mention in the report.
items.ex_zh: 这种琐碎的职场流言根本不配在正式报告中提及。

items.def_en: To gain or incur something justifiable because of one's efforts, achievements, or behavior
items.ex_en: Her relentless dedication helped her earn the deep respect of her colleagues.
items.ex_zh: 她持之以恒的奉献为她赢得了同事们的由衷敬佩。

items.def_en: To have earned something or to be entitled to a specific reward, punishment, or treatment based on one's conduct
items.ex_en: All hardworking employees deserve fair compensation and safe working conditions every day.
items.ex_zh: 所有勤奋的员工每天都理应得到公平的报酬和安全的工作环境。

items.def_en: To make a particular action, inquiry, or reaction necessary, reasonable, or justifiable
items.ex_en: These alarming audit findings certainly warrant a deeper investigation into corporate spending.
items.ex_zh: 这些令人担忧的审计结果无疑有必要对公司开支展开更深入的调查。

items.def_en: To deserve or be worthy of something such as attention, reward, or punishment.
items.ex_en: The groundbreaking scientific discovery clearly merits thorough peer review and broader publication.
items.ex_zh: 这项开创性的科学发现显然值得同行彻底评议并更广泛发表。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote having a legitimate claim to a particular reaction, treatment, reward, or penalty due to innate qualities, actions, or severity.
groups.summary_zh: 指因行为、品质或严重程度而应受特定对待或裁决。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an entitlement to a specific evaluation, reaction, or reward based on inherent qualities or prior actions, distinct from simple receiving or accidental acquisition.
groups.desc_zh: 表示基于内在品质或既往行为而应得某种评价、对待或回报，区别于单纯获得或偶然蒙受。
groups.nuance_en: rate: qualifies informally or quantitatively for consideration (mention / consideration) · earn: gains rightfully through labor or virtue (respect / salary / trust) · deserve: possesses moral or equitable entitlement, good or bad (punishment / praise / break) · warrant: provides adequate legal, logical, or practical grounds (investigation / scrutiny / arrest) · merit: displays intrinsic excellence justifying formal attention (attention / study / reward)
groups.nuance_zh: rate: 非正式或定量评估中算得上/配得上 (mention / consideration) · earn: 靠付出汗水或德行挣得 (respect / salary / trust) · deserve: 道德或公理层面的应受/罪有应得 (punishment / praise / break) · warrant: 具有充分法律、逻辑或现实依据 (investigation / scrutiny / arrest) · merit: 凭内在价值或优点理应得到关注 (attention / study / reward)

groups.name: Desiccate & Shrivel · 皱缩与干瘪 (Shrivel, Wizen, Shrink)
groups.tip: 失水枯瘪导致体积极缩

items.def_en: To gather or contract into small folds, wrinkles, or ridges
items.ex_en: The sour lemon juice caused her mouth to pucker up instantly.
items.ex_zh: 酸柠檬汁让她的嘴巴瞬间皱缩了起来。
items.ex2_en: The bitter taste of the medicine puckered the young boy's lips in disgust.
items.ex2_zh: 药水的苦味让小男孩嫌恶地噘起了嘴唇。

items.def_en: To form small, thin creases or wrinkles over a surface, often as moisture is lost
items.ex_en: Excessive sun exposure caused the delicate skin around her eyes to crinkle.
items.ex_zh: 过度的日晒使她眼周娇嫩的皮肤形成了细碎的皱褶。
items.ex2_en: The child crinkled the shiny wrapping paper noisily while tearing open birthday gifts.
items.ex2_zh: 孩子在撕开生日礼物时把锃亮的包装纸弄得沙沙作响。

items.def_en: To become dry, shrunken, and wrinkled with age or dehydration, or to cause something to do so
items.ex_en: Years of harsh desert winds began to wizen his weathered, leathery face.
items.ex_zh: 多年的凄冷沙漠狂风，逐渐使他饱经风霜的苍老面容干枯起皱。
items.ex2_en: The ripe plums wizened slowly into sweet prunes under the scorching desert sun.
items.ex2_zh: 成熟的李子在灼热的沙漠阳光下慢慢风干缩成甜西梅干。

items.def_en: (+ up) To become dry, smaller, and covered in wrinkles, or to make something do this.
items.ex_en: Without enough water, the delicate blossoms will shrivel up under the sun.
items.ex_zh: 如果没有充足的水分，娇嫩的花朵在阳光下就会枯萎干瘪。
items.ex2_en: Intense tropical heat will quickly shrivel fragile green seedlings left without adequate shade.
items.ex2_zh: 强烈的热带高温会迅速晒萎没有充足遮阴的脆弱绿色幼苗。

items.def_en: To dry out thoroughly and drain completely of moisture or vital vitality
items.ex_en: Scorching desert heat will rapidly desiccate exposed organic material within a day.
items.ex_zh: 灼热的沙漠酷暑会在一天之内使暴露的有机物彻底脱水干瘪。
items.ex2_en: The clay soil desiccated completely under the intense summer drought without any rainfall.
items.ex2_zh: 在没有丝毫降雨的酷夏干旱下，黏土完全干涸枯竭了。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical drying out, loss of moisture, and shrinking into a wrinkled, puckered state. They emphasize the physical texture and contorted reduction in volume of organic matter or skin.
groups.summary_zh: 强调因失去水分或生机而起皱、缩减及干瘪的外在物理形态变化。
groups.desc_en: Denotes wrinkling, shrinking, and loss of vital moisture or firmness, moving beyond ordinary drying to visible structural collapse and aging.
groups.desc_zh: 指因水分流失或衰老而发生缩水、起皱与干瘪萎缩，区别于普通变干，强调物理结构的塌缩干瘪。
groups.nuance_en: pucker: draws into small localized folds or creases (lips / skin / fabric) · crinkle: forms a network of fine superficial wrinkles (paper / eyes / foil) · wizen: displays aging, dry, and weathered shrinkage (features / face / skin) · shrivel: collapses and curls inward from loss of moisture or vitality (leaves / fruit / corpse) · desiccate: thoroughly leaches of moisture to brittle dryness (specimen / soil / bones)
groups.nuance_zh: pucker: 局部收拢起皱 (lips / skin / fabric) · crinkle: 表面形成细密褶皱 (paper / eyes / foil) · wizen: 呈现苍老干瘦风化之态 (features / face / skin) · shrivel: 因失水或枯萎而蜷缩干瘪 (leaves / fruit / corpse) · desiccate: 深度抽干水分至干硬脆弱 (specimen / soil / bones)

groups.name: Despair & Lose Hope · 绝望与丧气 (Lose heart, Despond, Give up)
groups.tip: 彻底丧失信心，陷入无助心境

items.def_en: To stop believing that you can succeed and feel discouraged
items.ex_en: Despite multiple frustrating rejections, you must not lose heart in your search.
items.ex_zh: 尽管遭遇多次令人沮丧的拒绝，你在求职中也决不能丧失信心。

items.def_en: (+ of) To completely stop expecting or believing that something positive will happen
items.ex_en: Searchers refused to give up hope of finding the lost mountaineers alive.
items.ex_zh: 搜救人员拒绝放弃找到生还失踪登山者的希望。

items.def_zh: 绝望，放弃生还/成功的希望
items.def_en: To entirely cease to have or maintain any hope whatsoever
items.ex_en: Trapped miners never abandoned hope that rescuers would eventually break through.
items.ex_zh: 被困的矿工从未放弃救援人员最终会凿通通道的希望。

items.raw_cluster: 绝望与丧气 Despair & Lose Hope
items.def_en: 1. (+ of) To feel that there is no hope at all that a situation will improve.
items.ex_en: Trapped without supplies, the stranded hikers began to despair of ever surviving.
items.ex_zh: 在断绝补给的情况下被困，滞留的徒步者开始对生还感到绝望。

items.def_en: To become extremely disheartened and abandon hope
items.ex_en: The beleaguered general began to despond as enemy forces surrounded the citadel.
items.ex_zh: 当敌军包围城堡时，陷入困境的将军开始陷入深深的沮丧和绝望。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures experiencing a complete cessation of hope, feeling helpless in the face of insurmountable adversity, or abandoning all expectation of improvement.
groups.summary_zh: 面对逆境彻底丧失希望、放弃期待或陷入极度沮丧。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the progressive psychological surrender of expectation and courage, moving from dwindling morale to absolute hopelessness, contrasting with temporary sadness.
groups.desc_zh: 指心理上对期望与勇气的逐步放弃，从士气低落滑向彻底绝望，区别于一般的悲伤情绪。
groups.nuance_en: lose heart: wavers in initial courage or morale (soldiers / team / player) · give up hope: consciously discontinues expectation of recovery (relatives / searchers) · abandon hope: formally or irrevocably surrenders all remaining optimism (rescuers / prisoners) · despond: sinks into dejected, passive melancholy (widower / patient) · despair: completely relinquishes hope, often under acute existential anguish (refugee / prisoner / bankrupt)
groups.nuance_zh: lose heart: 泄气并丧失勇气与斗志 (soldiers / team / player) · give up hope: 主动停止抱持希望 (relatives / searchers) · abandon hope: 彻底决绝地放弃一切指望 (rescuers / prisoners) · despond: 陷入意志消沉与丧气抑郁 (widower / patient) · despair: 陷于极端痛苦且毫无指望的彻底绝望 (refugee / prisoner / bankrupt)

groups.name: Destine & Fate · 注定与宿命 (Doom, Preordain, Foreordain)
groups.tip: 命中注定无法被更改

items.def_en: (chiefly passive) To predetermine or decree by fate, typically towards an unhappy end
items.ex_en: The young prince was fated to lose his crown in bloody exile.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的王子注定要在血腥的流亡中失去他的王冠。

items.def_en: To decide, decree, or fix an event beforehand by divine providence or cosmic authority
items.ex_en: Ancient theologians believed that celestial movements preordained the rise and fall of nations.
items.ex_zh: 古代神学家相信天体的运转预先注定了国家的兴衰起伏。

items.def_en: To determine an outcome in advance as if by inexorable fate
items.ex_en: Prophets warned that reckless arrogance would foreordain the empire's ultimate ruin.
items.ex_zh: 先知们警告说，盲目的傲慢必将宿命般地注定帝国的最终覆灭。

items.def_en: (chiefly passive) To make certain that someone or something will fail, die, or be destroyed
items.ex_en: Poor logistical planning was enough to doom the ambitious expedition from inception.
items.ex_zh: 糟糕的后勤规划足以注定这趟雄心勃勃的远征从一开始就走向失败。

items.def_en: 1. (chiefly passive) To predetermine or intend someone or something for a particular fate, purpose, or journey.
items.ex_en: She felt that heaven had destined her for a life of service.
items.ex_zh: 她感到上天注定她要过一种奉献一生的生活。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on outcomes fixed irrevocably beforehand by divine will, natural laws, or supernatural decree, often with grim or inescapable finality.
groups.summary_zh: 指由命运、神意或不可抗力预先判定无可更改的结局。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the metaphysical or inevitable pre-assignment of an entity to a particular end, contrasting with spontaneous outcome or calculated planning.
groups.desc_zh: 指超自然力量或不可抗力对最终结局的预先注定，区别于自发结果或人为规划。
groups.nuance_en: destine: sets apart for a specific inevitable purpose or station, often neutral or noble (greatness / glory / success) · fate: predetermines an inescapable, often somber destiny (failure / obscurity / exile) · preordain: decrees beforehand by immutable cosmic or religious law (outcome / events / path) · foreordain: divinely appoints in advance from eternity (election / destruction / decree) · doom: irrevocably consigns to tragic, catastrophic ruin (species / expedition / project)
groups.nuance_zh: destine: 注定用于特定目的或崇高前程 (greatness / glory / success) · fate: 宿命般判定难逃的归宿 (failure / obscurity / exile) · preordain: 宇宙法则或规律预先注定 (outcome / events / path) · foreordain: 神意自古预先裁定 (election / destruction / decree) · doom: 铁定注定走向灾难性覆灭 (species / expedition / project)

groups.name: Detach & Disassociate · 疏远与拉开距离 (Distance, Detach, Disengage)
groups.tip: 拉开心理或社交距离以示冷淡

items.def_zh: 超然物外；冷眼旁观；保持冷淡距离
items.def_en: (+ from) To keep oneself deliberately apart and uninvolved in social affairs or disputes
items.ex_en: The elderly scholar preferred to stand aloof from petty departmental rivalries.
items.ex_zh: 这位老学者更愿意对系里微不足道的内讧冷眼旁观、超然物外。

items.def_en: (+ from) To make yourself, or cause someone to be, emotionally, socially, or physically distant from someone or something.
items.ex_en: The politician tried hard to distance herself from the unfolding financial scandal.
items.ex_zh: 这位政客极力试图将自己与正在发酵的财务丑闻拉开距离。

items.def_zh: 使脱离；摆脱（情感依附或关联）
items.def_en: (+ from) To separate oneself emotionally, mentally, or socially from someone or something
items.ex_en: A true professional must learn to detach personal feelings from clinical decisions.
items.ex_zh: 一名真正的专业人士必须学会将个人情感从临床决策中抽离出来。
items.ex2_en: The mechanical capsule detached smoothly from the main spacecraft upon entering orbital trajectory.
items.ex2_zh: 机械太空舱在进入轨道后顺利脱离了主航天器。

items.def_en: (+ from) To free oneself from a connection, involvement, or confrontation
items.ex_en: Diplomats worked hard to disengage armed forces from the disputed border area.
items.ex_zh: 外交官们努力促使武装部队从有争议的边境地区脱离接触。
items.ex2_en: The interlocking metal hooks disengaged automatically once the crane touched down on ground.
items.ex2_zh: 起重机一接触地面，联锁的金属吊钩就自动脱开。

items.def_zh: 划清界限；声明脱离关系
items.def_en: (+ from) To formally or publicly declare that you are not connected with someone or something
items.ex_en: The board issued an announcement to disassociate the company from fraudulent practices.
items.ex_zh: 董事会发表声明，明确使公司与欺诈行为彻底划清界限。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe deliberately creating emotional, social, or reputational separation between oneself and another entity. They emphasize purposeful non-involvement, stepping back, or disassociating from controversial matters.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重主动划清界限、拉开心理或社交距离以避免牵涉。
groups.desc_en: Denotes deliberate emotional, intellectual, or operational distancing from an entity or situation, distinct from physical departure.
groups.desc_zh: 指在情感、认知或行动上有意识地拉开距离或划清界限，区别于单纯的身体离开。
groups.nuance_en: stand aloof: remains consciously indifferent and uninvolved (observer / critic / politician) · distance: puts visible spatial or reputational gap between parties (candidate / company / self) · detach: severs emotional or physical bonds to achieve neutrality (observer / retina / equipment) · disengage: cleanly withdraws from an entanglement or conflict (gears / troops / mind) · disassociate: formally breaks ideological, social, or mental connection (firm / politician / self)
groups.nuance_zh: stand aloof: 袖手旁观且冷漠不介入 (observer / critic / politician) · distance: 主动保持声誉或心理距离 (candidate / company / self) · detach: 超然抽离情感或断开物理连接 (observer / retina / equipment) · disengage: 从纠缠、战事或机械中脱身 (gears / troops / mind) · disassociate: 划清界限或切断认知关联 (firm / politician / self)

groups.name: Deter & Dissuade · 阻吓与打消念头 (Deter, Dishearten, Daunt)
groups.tip: 用言语劝诫或威慑阻止行动

items.def_en: Make someone dislike something or decide against proceeding with an endeavor
items.ex_en: The exorbitant ticket price was enough to put off many potential attendees.
items.ex_zh: 高昂的票价足以让许多潜在的参与者打退堂鼓。

items.def_zh: 劝阻，打消……的念头；使灰心，使气馁；阻碍
items.def_en: 1. (+ from) To persuade someone not to do something. 2. To make someone feel less confident, hopeful, or enthusiastic.
items.ex_en: Persistent rainy weather discouraged tourists from exploring the scenic mountain trails today.
items.ex_zh: 持续的阴雨天气打消了游客今天前去探索风景优美的山间小径的念头。

items.def_en: Cause someone to lose hope, confidence, or enthusiasm for carrying out a goal
items.ex_en: Repeated project delays began to dishearten the passionate team of young researchers.
items.ex_zh: 项目的一再延期开始让这支满怀激情的年轻研究团队感到泄气沮丧。

items.def_en: (usually negative) Disturb, disconcert, or unnerve someone so as to stall their confidence
items.ex_en: Hostile questioning from reporters did not faze the experienced defense attorney at all.
items.ex_zh: 记者的恶意质问丝毫没有让这位经验丰富的辩护律师犯怵。

items.def_en: Make someone feel apprehensive or intimidated by the sheer difficulty of a task
items.ex_en: The colossal scale of the nationwide reconstruction project did not daunt the young architect.
items.ex_zh: 这项全国性重建工程的庞大规模并未吓退这位年轻的建筑师。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses dampening someone's confidence, enthusiasm, or will to proceed, discouraging them through negative reinforcement, intimidating obstacles, or sobering forecasts.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重以现实困难、消极态度或风险后果挫败其热情、制止行动。
groups.desc_en: Denotes checking an actor's motivation or courage through the prospect of difficulty, fear, or penalty, contrasting with physical restraint.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过困难、恐惧或后果威慑来挫败行动者的意愿与勇气，区别于物理阻拦。
groups.nuance_en: put off: discourages mildly through unpleasantness or inconvenience (cost / smell / manner) · discourage: lowers enthusiasm or dampens prospects (investors / students / attempts) · dishearten: saps morale and emotional stamina through adversity (defeats / news / losses) · faze: momentarily unsettles composure through surprise or intimidation (interrogation / criticism / crowd) · daunt: overwhelms with a formidable, intimidating prospect (scale / challenge / task)
groups.nuance_zh: put off: 因嫌恶或麻烦令人打消念头 (cost / smell / manner) · discourage: 打击积极性或劝阻尝试 (investors / students / attempts) · dishearten: 因接连挫折而瓦解士气心力 (defeats / news / losses) · faze: 因意外或恐吓而瞬间慌乱 (interrogation / criticism / crowd) · daunt: 面对艰巨压倒性挑战望而生畏 (scale / challenge / task)

groups.name: Detonate & Blast · 引爆与炸毁 (Trigger, Set off, Blast)
groups.tip: 雷管点火引爆轰鸣

items.def_en: To cause a detonator, bomb, or explosive reaction to go off
items.ex_en: A stray electrical spark could accidentally trigger the explosive device inside the warehouse.
items.ex_zh: 一道零星的电火花可能会意外引爆仓库内的爆炸装置。

items.def_en: To cause a bomb, charge, or alarm to explode or activate suddenly
items.ex_en: The demolition squad will set off the dynamite charges at dawn tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 爆破小队将于明天拂晓时分引爆那些炸药。

items.def_en: To destroy, shatter, or break open using explosives or heavy ordnance
items.ex_en: Engineers used dynamite to blast the solid rock face and open the new tunnel.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们使用炸药炸碎了坚硬的岩石表面，打通了新隧道。

items.def_en: To burn rapidly with intense heat and sparks without producing a true supersonic shockwave
items.ex_en: The loose gunpowder began to deflagrate, sending brilliant cascades of sparks across the stone floor.
items.ex_zh: 散落的火药开始骤热闪燃，在石质地板上激起耀眼的飞溅火星。
items.ex2_en: Technicians cautiously deflagrated the chemical propellant inside the secure testing chamber.
items.ex2_zh: 技术人员在安全的测试室内小心地引燃促爆了化学推进剂。

items.def_en: 1. To explode violently with a sudden loud noise, or to cause a bomb or explosive to do so.
items.ex_en: Terrorists planned to detonate a concealed bomb near the crowded central railway station.
items.ex_zh: 恐怖分子图谋在拥挤的中央火车站附近引爆一枚隐蔽的炸弹。
items.ex2_en: The volatile homemade explosive detonated prematurely inside the abandoned underground warehouse yesterday evening.
items.ex2_zh: 昨晚，不稳定的自制炸药在废弃的地下仓库内过早起爆了。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on the deliberate or mechanical ignition and destruction caused by explosive devices, charges, or weapons of war.
groups.summary_zh: 聚焦人为引爆弹药、炸药并对目标造成毁灭性爆破破坏。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the initiation and propagation of destructive explosive release, progressing from the initial spark to violent shockwave propagation.
groups.desc_zh: 指爆炸破坏性能量的引发与扩散过程，从初始激发推进到剧烈冲击波炸毁，区别于平稳燃烧。
groups.nuance_en: trigger: initiates an explosive train or sudden chain reaction (device / avalanche / reaction) · set off: causes to ignite or explode via external stimulus (bomb / alarm / fireworks) · blast: shatters or destroys violently via explosive air pressure (rock / building / tunnel) · deflagrate: combusts rapidly at subsonic speed without a shockwave (propellant / gunpowder / gas) · detonate: explodes with supersonic speed, violent shockwaves, and extreme shattering effect (warhead / TNT / dynamite)
groups.nuance_zh: trigger: 扳动触发行程或连锁爆炸 (device / avalanche / reaction) · set off: 经外部刺激引爆或引燃 (bomb / alarm / fireworks) · blast: 依靠爆炸冲击波强力炸碎或摧毁 (rock / building / tunnel) · deflagrate: 亚音速迅速爆燃无冲击波 (propellant / gunpowder / gas) · detonate: 超音速猛烈爆轰并释放剧烈冲击波 (warhead / TNT / dynamite)

groups.name: Detour & Bypass · 绕道与绕过 (Detour, Bypass, Circumvent)
groups.tip: 避开障碍绕道迂回前行

items.def_en: To follow a curved or indirect path to pass an obstruction or barrier
items.ex_en: We had to go around the fallen tree blocking the narrow mountain pathway.
items.ex_zh: 我们不得不绕过挡在狭窄山路上的倒伏树木。

items.def_en: To go along or around the outer edge of an obstacle, boundary, or difficult topic
items.ex_en: The narrow forest trail skirts the boundary of the private estate for several miles.
items.ex_zh: 那条狭窄的林间小径沿着私人庄园的边界延伸了数英里。

items.def_en: To go around a town, obstacle, or problem to avoid delays, or to ignore an established rule
items.ex_en: Long-distance freight trucks usually bypass the congested city center by taking the ring road.
items.ex_zh: 长途货车通常通过环城公路绕开拥堵的市中心。

items.def_en: To find an ingenious or indirect way of avoiding an obstacle, rule, or restriction
items.ex_en: Shrewd corporate lawyers managed to circumvent the new tax regulation through offshore subsidiaries.
items.ex_zh: 精明的公司律师通过设立离岸子公司巧妙规避了新税收法规。

items.def_en: To travel or take a longer, indirect route to avoid an obstacle or detour.
items.ex_en: Due to major bridge repairs ahead, morning commuters must detour through a neighboring village.
items.ex_zh: 由于前方桥梁大修，早间通勤者必须绕行邻近的村庄。

groups.summary_en: Encompasses physical travel around an obstacle, congestion, or restricted zone via an indirect route, as well as figurative sidestepping of rules, procedures, or bottlenecks.
groups.summary_zh: 指避开路障、拥堵或规则而采取间接路线绕行或迂回通过。
groups.desc_en: Denotes taking an indirect course to bypass an obstruction, rule, or territory, contrasting with direct confrontation or normal navigation.
groups.desc_zh: 指采取迂回路线以避开障碍、规则或特定区域，区别于正面对抗或直线穿行。
groups.nuance_en: go around: takes a longer non-direct physical path (blockade / corner / puddle) · detour: departs temporarily from the established route to avoid an obstacle (traffic / construction / route) · skirt: passes closely along the outer edge or evasively ignores (border / topic / controversy) · bypass: avoids completely by means of an alternate route or structural channel (city / regulations / committee) · circumvent: strategically evades constraints or traps through ingenuity (sanctions / rules / law)
groups.nuance_zh: go around: 绕开眼前实体障碍物 (blockade / corner / puddle) · detour: 临时偏离既定路线绕道而行 (traffic / construction / route) · skirt: 沿边缘掠过或回避敏感话题 (border / topic / controversy) · bypass: 经由旁路彻底绕过枢纽或环节 (city / regulations / committee) · circumvent: 运用智谋规避法律、制裁或限制 (sanctions / rules / law)

groups.name: Deviate & Stray · 偏离与走入歧途 (Diverge, Stray, Digress)
groups.tip: 脱离正常轨道或规定路线

items.def_en: Gradually lose focus or wander away from the central track or subject
items.ex_en: Exhausted after hours of deliberation, his mind began to drift off during the presentation.
items.ex_zh: 经过数小时的商议后，他精疲力竭，在报告过程中思绪开始飘走。

items.def_en: (+ from) Move away aimlessly from a group, path, or acceptable moral standard
items.ex_en: Young hikers were strictly warned never to stray from the designated alpine path.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的徒步者受到严厉告诫，绝不可偏离指定的高山路线。

items.def_en: To depart or diverge from an established path, standard, rule, or expected course of action.
items.ex_en: The lab technician must never deviate from the established safety protocol during high-risk experiments.
items.ex_zh: 实验员在高危实验期间绝不可背离既定的安全操作规范。

items.def_en: (+ from) Separate and go in a different direction; depart from an established course
items.ex_en: His private research findings slowly began to diverge from accepted academic consensus.
items.ex_zh: 他的个人研究结论逐渐开始偏离公认的学术共识。

items.def_en: (+ from) Depart temporarily from the main subject in speech or writing
items.ex_en: Allow me to digress for a moment from our economic analysis to illustrate this history.
items.ex_zh: 请允许我暂时离开经济分析的主题，来说明这段历史背景。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers moving away from a correct physical route, an established standard, or a central topic. Nuances distinguish between wandering aimlessly away from a moral/spatial path and diverging conceptually from a fixed norm.
groups.summary_zh: 指离开既定路线、常规准则或主旨，包含物理迷路与抽象偏离。
groups.desc_en: Denotes straying or branching away from an established trajectory, standard, or norm, contrasting with remaining on track.
groups.desc_zh: 指偏离既定轨迹、标准或常态走入歧途，区别于循规蹈矩或保持航向。
groups.nuance_en: drift off: slowly and passively wanders away without intent (topic / course / consciousness) · stray: roams aimlessly beyond safe boundaries or moral limits (flock / path / spouse) · deviate: distinctly departs from an established statistical, moral, or procedural standard (norm / protocol / standard) · diverge: splits and draws permanently apart from another path (paths / opinions / views) · digress: temporarily wanders away from the main spoken or written theme (argument / speaker / lecture)
groups.nuance_zh: drift off: 无意识地慢慢飘离或散漫走偏 (topic / course / consciousness) · stray: 漫无目的地游荡出安全边界或道德底线 (flock / path / spouse) · deviate: 显著背离正统规范、数据或流程 (norm / protocol / standard) · diverge: 分道扬镳且差距日益扩大 (paths / opinions / views) · digress: 演讲或写作中短暂离题 (argument / speaker / lecture)

groups.name: Deviate & Veer · 偏离与骤然转向 (Veer, Swerve, Sheer)
groups.tip: 中途改变方向偏离航向

items.def_en: Change course by turning into the wind, or alter one's policy or approach radically
items.ex_en: The wooden schooner had to tack repeatedly across the bay against the fierce gale.
items.ex_zh: 木质帆船不得不迎着狂风在海湾中反复走之字形路线前行。

items.def_en: (+ off/away) Turn suddenly away from a course or an obstacle
items.ex_en: The startled stallion began to sheer away from the sudden glare on the path.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的种马突然急转向一旁，避开小径上突如其来的强光。

items.def_zh: 突然转向，偏离方向；改变（话题、态度）
items.def_en: To change direction or course suddenly; to shift suddenly in opinion or behavior.
items.ex_en: The speeding taxi suddenly veered across three lanes into oncoming traffic.
items.ex_zh: 那辆超速行驶的出租车突然猛拐横跨三条车道，冲入逆向车流。

items.def_en: Change direction abruptly, especially in order to avoid an obstacle or collision
items.ex_en: The bus driver had to swerve sharply to avoid hitting an icy patch.
items.ex_zh: 公交车司机不得不猛打方向盘急转弯，以避开结冰路面。
items.ex2_en: The reckless rally driver swerved his lightweight racing vehicle around the narrow mountain bends.
items.ex2_zh: 鲁莽的拉力赛车手驾着轻型赛车在狭窄的山路弯道上急速转向。

items.def_en: (of a moving ship or aircraft) Twist or oscillate temporarily about its vertical axis
items.ex_en: In heavy seas, the vessel began to yaw violently beneath the turbulent breakers.
items.ex_zh: 在汹涌的风浪中，船只在翻滚的巨浪下开始剧烈左右摇摆。

groups.summary_en: Captures sharp, abrupt, or unexpected directional changes while in motion. Verbs in this frame contrast sudden evasive turns with gradual shifts in direction, policy, or public sentiment.
groups.summary_zh: 强调行驶或运动中突然、急剧地改变方向或偏离既定路线。
groups.desc_en: Denotes rapid, abrupt, or oscillating changes in physical heading, contrasting with smooth, gradual curves.
groups.desc_zh: 指物理航向发生突然、剧烈或摇摆不定的变向，区别于平缓柔和的转弯。
groups.nuance_en: tack: alters heading systematically in an alternating zigzag pattern (boat / policy / yacht) · sheer: swerves suddenly and wildly off a set course (ship / car / vessel) · veer: shifts direction steadily or abruptly under external force (wind / car / discussion) · swerve: jerks aside suddenly to evade an immediate collision (driver / car / pedestrian) · yaw: oscillates erratically about a vertical axis off course (aircraft / rocket / vessel)
groups.nuance_zh: tack: 迎风成之字形规律变换航向 (boat / policy / yacht) · sheer: 剧烈而失控地偏向一侧 (ship / car / vessel) · veer: 受外力影响突然转向或变向 (wind / car / discussion) · swerve: 为避开前方危险而猛打方向盘 (driver / car / pedestrian) · yaw: 绕垂直轴发生异常左右偏航晃动 (aircraft / rocket / vessel)

groups.name: Diffuse & Pervade · 扩散与渗透弥漫 (Permeate, Pervade, Suffuse)
groups.tip: 由中心向外均匀渗透散开

items.def_en: To pass slowly and subtly through small pores or openings, diffusing gradually into a broader area
items.ex_en: Toxic chemicals began to seep through the concrete wall and contaminate the basement floor.
items.ex_zh: 有毒化学物质开始渗出混凝土墙体，逐渐扩散污染地下室地面。

items.def_zh: 扩散，弥漫；传播，散播；缓解，平息（紧张气氛）
items.def_en: 1. To spread or diffuse widely through air, water, or space. 2. To spread ideas, information, or knowledge widely. 3. To make a tense situation calmer.
items.ex_en: The lavender aroma will diffuse throughout the quiet room within several minutes.
items.ex_zh: 薰衣草香气将在几分钟内弥漫至整个安静的房间。
items.ex2_en: The teacher tried to diffuse tension among students before the high-stakes final examination.
items.ex2_zh: 老师试图在重要期末考试前缓解化解学生们之间的紧张气氛。

items.def_en: To spread gently all over or through a surface, especially with light, color, or deep emotion
items.ex_en: A delicate rosy blush began to suffuse her cheeks in the warm candlelight.
items.ex_zh: 在温暖的烛光下，一抹娇柔的绯红悄然充盈她的脸颊。

items.def_en: To pass or diffuse through every part of a substance, space, or organization
items.ex_en: A pungent smell of damp earth and rot permeated the entire abandoned cellar.
items.ex_zh: 潮湿泥土和腐烂的刺鼻气味弥漫在整间废弃的地窖中。

items.def_en: To spread through every part of something and be noticeable in all aspects of it
items.ex_en: A subtle sense of anxiety seemed to pervade every corner of the corporate headquarters.
items.ex_zh: 一种微妙的焦虑情绪似乎弥漫在公司总部的每一个角落。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on the passive or chemical dispersal of particles, gases, scents, light, or cultural influences into a surrounding medium until thoroughly intermingled, soft, or pervasive.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重气体、光线、气味或思想在介质中自发弥散、渗透并均匀分布。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the spreading of a fluid, scent, light, or influence throughout every part of a space, contrasting with localized containment.
groups.desc_zh: 指流体、气味、光线或影响渗透并充斥整个空间，区别于局限在局部。
groups.nuance_en: seep through: penetrates slowly through tiny pores or crevices (liquid / oil / moisture) · diffuse: scatters broadly and evenly outward to lower concentration (light / scent / heat) · suffuse: spreads across a surface or volume with a color, glow, or feeling (blush / glow / warmth) · permeate: passes thoroughly through physical membranes or social strata (water / smell / ideology) · pervade: completely saturates and characterizes an entire atmosphere or culture (mood / corruption / cynicism)
groups.nuance_zh: seep through: 经细孔裂隙极其缓慢地渗漏 (liquid / oil / moisture) · diffuse: 均匀向外发散降低浓度 (light / scent / heat) · suffuse: 某种色彩、光泽或情绪缓缓洋溢充盈 (blush / glow / warmth) · permeate: 彻底渗透穿过隔膜或阶层 (water / smell / ideology) · pervade: 无孔不入地充斥并笼罩整个氛围 (mood / corruption / cynicism)

groups.name: Digest & Assimilate · 消化与吸收 (Digest, Assimilate, Absorb)
groups.tip: 肠胃分解食物并吸收养分

items.def_en: To take in nutrients, moisture, or informational concepts and retain them
items.ex_en: Dense dry soil can absorb an enormous amount of moisture after the autumn rain.
items.ex_zh: 干燥致密的土壤在秋雨过后能够吸纳大量的水分。

items.def_en: 1. to break down food in the stomach and intestines into substances the body can use 2. to fully understand and absorb new information
items.ex_en: She sat quietly alone for hours trying to digest the sudden tragic news.
items.ex_zh: 她独自静坐了数小时，试图完全理解并领悟这一突如其来的噩耗。

items.def_en: To absorb food into the bodily tissues, or to integrate complex ideas fully into the mind
items.ex_en: New graduate students must quickly assimilate complex theoretical frameworks introduced during seminar discussions.
items.ex_zh: 新入学的研究生必须迅速吸收研讨课上引入的复杂理论框架。
items.ex2_en: The immigrant family assimilated comfortably into the local community within a few short years.
items.ex2_zh: 短短几年之内，这个移民家庭就完全融入了当地社区。

items.def_en: To take food, liquid, or medical substances into the stomach through the mouth
items.ex_en: The nocturnal beast will ingest large stones to facilitate mechanical breakdown within its gizzard.
items.ex_zh: 这头夜行兽会吞食大石块，以助其砂囊内进行机械研磨。

items.def_en: To process food or chemical compounds biochemically into energy or tissue building blocks
items.ex_en: Living cells continuously metabolize glucose to sustain essential biological activity and generate energy.
items.ex_zh: 活细胞不断代谢葡萄糖以维持基本的生物活性并生成能量。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses the breakdown of food into nutrient forms by the digestive system, alongside figurative extensions meaning to thoroughly internalize, absorb, and make sense of information or experiences.
groups.summary_zh: 指机体分解食物吸纳养分，或引申指心智对信息深度的吸收领悟。
groups.desc_en: Denotes taking external substances or concepts into a host system, breaking them down, and integrating them into the organism or mind, contrasting with superficial accumulation.
groups.desc_zh: 指将外界物质或思想纳纳于体内或系统内，加以分解转化并同化融合，区别于表层的堆积。
groups.nuance_en: ingest: physically swallows or takes into the alimentary tract (food / poison / chemicals) · absorb: draws in passively through surface contact and retains (liquid / shock / information) · digest: breaks down chemically or reflects upon thoroughly (proteins / news / facts) · metabolize: converts biochemically into energy or byproducts (fats / drugs / alcohol) · assimilate: fully incorporates alien material or culture into one's own system (nutrients / immigrants / knowledge)
groups.nuance_zh: ingest: 经口器摄入或吞咽 (food / poison / chemicals) · absorb: 接触吸收并留存吸收物 (liquid / shock / information) · digest: 化学性分解食物或咀嚼理解信息 (proteins / news / facts) · metabolize: 生物代谢转化为能量或产物 (fats / drugs / alcohol) · assimilate: 深度同化吸收并融入宿主系统 (nutrients / immigrants / knowledge)

groups.name: Digress & Stray · 离题与漫谈走调 (Digress, Stray, Wander)
groups.tip: 偏离核心主旨开始东拉西扯

items.def_en: to lose track of the thread of a discussion and begin addressing unrelated matters
items.ex_en: The keynote speaker started to wander off onto trivial childhood memories during his speech.
items.ex_zh: 主讲人在演讲过程中开始跑题，东拉西扯起微不足道的童年琐事。

items.def_en: to drift gradually away from the primary topic, argument, or set limit
items.ex_en: Do not stray from the core topic of municipal funding in your opening presentation.
items.ex_zh: 在你的开场报告中，切勿偏离关于市政拨款的核心主题。

items.def_en: to talk or write at great length in a confused, disordered, and unfocused way
items.ex_en: He tends to ramble for hours whenever anyone asks him about ancient history.
items.ex_zh: 每当有人向他问起古代历史，他就容易漫无边际地东拉西扯好几个小时。

items.def_en: to turn aside or deviate from the main subject in speech or writing
items.ex_en: The visiting lecturer promised not to digress from the scheduled syllabus during today's seminar.
items.ex_zh: 客座讲师保证在今天的研讨会上绝不偏离既定的大纲主题。

items.def_en: to depart noticeably from an established path, standard principle, or subject matter
items.ex_en: Her oral argument did not deviate once from the legal precedents previously cited.
items.ex_zh: 她的口头辩论未曾丝毫偏离此前引用的法律判例。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this discourse frame capture wandering away from the core topic or narrative line in spoken speech, debate, or writing. They contrast deliberate conversational detours with unintentional lapses in focus.
groups.summary_zh: 指在谈话、演讲或写作中偏离主要论题、主线而东拉西扯。
groups.desc_en: Denotes wandering away from the central theme in speech, thought, or writing, contrasting with structured, purposeful exposition.
groups.desc_zh: 指在言论、思维或写作中偏离主线漫谈散漫，区别于结构严谨的目标导向表达。
groups.nuance_en: wander off: loses focus inadvertently and drifts from the core thread (mind / speaker / thoughts) · stray: leaves the structured boundary of a subject unintentionally (conversation / discussion / focus) · ramble: talks or writes aimlessly at tedious length without structure (speaker / essay / narrative) · digress: deliberately or self-consciously pauses the main topic to discuss a tangent (lecturer / author / point) · deviate: sharply parts ways from a prescribed outline or policy (speech / narrative / script)
groups.nuance_zh: wander off: 无意中思绪涣散偏离主题 (mind / speaker / thoughts) · stray: 讨论漫无目的地滑出界定范围 (conversation / discussion / focus) · ramble: 啰里啰嗦、漫无边际地瞎扯闲扯 (speaker / essay / narrative) · digress: 有意识或插入性地跳出主线插话 (lecturer / author / point) · deviate: 明显脱离预定讲稿或主题路线 (speech / narrative / script)

groups.name: Dilute & Water Down · 稀释与冲淡削弱 (Dilute, Water Down, Thin, Weaken)
groups.tip: 加入溶剂降浓以削弱效力

items.def_en: To make a liquid less dense or viscous by stirring in a thinning agent or solvent
items.ex_en: You should thin the thick oil paint with turpentine before applying the base layer.
items.ex_zh: 在涂刷底漆之前，你应该用松节油将粘稠的油画颜料稀释。
items.ex2_en: The morning mist thinned noticeably as the warm autumn sun climbed higher overhead.
items.ex2_zh: 随着温暖的秋阳升得更高，清晨的薄雾明显消散变淡了。

items.def_en: 1. To make a liquid thinner or weaker by adding water or another solvent. 2. To weaken the strength, effect, or quality of something.
items.ex_en: The chemist instructed students to dilute the concentrated acid with purified distilled water.
items.ex_zh: 化学家指示学生们用纯净蒸馏水稀释浓酸。
items.ex2_en: The strong berry syrup will dilute readily when mixed with cold sparkling water.
items.ex2_zh: 浓郁的浆果糖浆与冰镇气泡水混合时很容易被稀释。

items.def_zh: 掺水稀释；变相削弱（法案、论点）
items.def_en: To make a liquid weaker by adding water, or make a proposal less forceful and more agreeable
items.ex_en: Politicians attempted to water down the climate resolution before submitting it for final voting.
items.ex_zh: 政客们试图在提交最终表决前削弱该气候决议案的力度。

items.def_en: To diminish the force, intensity, virulence, or thickness of something
items.ex_en: Dense concrete walls will significantly attenuate high-frequency radio signals passing into the building.
items.ex_zh: 厚重的混凝土墙会大幅减弱穿入建筑物内部的高频无线电信号。
items.ex2_en: The violent sound waves attenuated rapidly as they traveled through the acoustic dampeners.
items.ex2_zh: 剧烈的声波在穿过吸音减震器时迅速衰减变弱。

items.def_en: To lower the quality or strength of food, drink, or substances by introducing inferior elements
items.ex_en: Unscrupulous merchants would adulterate expensive olive oil with cheap soybean oil for higher profits.
items.ex_zh: 不法商贩为了更高利润，会在昂贵的橄榄油中掺入廉价大豆油。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers acts that reduce the concentration, potency, or impact of a physical mixture or an abstract entity (like an idea, law, or emotion) by intermixing thinner solvents or compromising elements.
groups.summary_zh: 通过添加溶剂降低液体浓度，或掺入妥协因素以削弱效力与烈度。
groups.desc_en: Denotes reducing the concentration, strength, purity, or effectiveness of a substance or message, contrasting with fortifying or concentrating.
groups.desc_zh: 指降低某种物质或观点的浓度、纯度、效力或直率度，区别于浓缩或加强。
groups.nuance_en: thin: reduces viscosity by adding solvent or spreading out (paint / blood / liquid) · dilute: decreases concentration of a liquid or concept by mixing (acid / juice / influence) · water down: compromises the strength, radicalism, or punch of an argument (proposals / bill / whiskey) · attenuate: weakens the force, virulence, or amplitude gradually (signal / virus / impact) · adulterate: debases purity or quality by adding inferior substances (food / wine / drugs)
groups.nuance_zh: thin: 稀释稠度或使其变薄 (paint / blood / liquid) · dilute: 掺液稀释浓度或淡化影响力 (acid / juice / influence) · water down: 冲淡锋芒或妥协削弱提案效力 (proposals / bill / whiskey) · attenuate: 减幅衰减信号、毒性或冲击力 (signal / virus / impact) · adulterate: 掺假使杂质混入劣化纯度 (food / wine / drugs)

groups.name: Dim & Darken · 变暗与阴沉 (Darken, Dim, Cloud over)
groups.tip: 光彩逐渐消退，明亮转为昏沉

items.def_en: To become covered with clouds, or of a person's face, to suddenly look troubled or unhappy
items.ex_en: Her serene expression began to cloud over as she read the unexpected message.
items.ex_zh: 阅读这封出人意料的信件时，她平静的神色突然转为阴沉。
items.ex2_en: Rising ocean vapors quickly clouded over the sunny shoreline during late summer afternoons.
items.ex2_zh: 在夏末的午后，升腾的海洋水汽迅速遮蔽了阳光普照的海岸线。

items.def_en: To become less bright or clear, or to make something less bright
items.ex_en: The theater staff will dim the chandeliers right before the musical performance begins.
items.ex_zh: 剧场工作人员将在音乐演出开始前调暗吊灯的光线。
items.ex2_en: The dazzling evening twilight dimmed steadily until total darkness blanketed the peaceful valley.
items.ex2_zh: 耀眼的傍晚晚霞逐渐暗淡下来，直到完全的黑暗笼罩了宁静的山谷。

items.def_en: To become or make gloomy, dark, or solemn in atmosphere or hue
items.ex_en: Heavy twilight shadows began to somber the quiet courtyards of the ancient monastery.
items.ex_zh: 浓重暮色开始使古老修道院幽静的庭院变得阴沉灰暗。
items.ex2_en: His cheerful mood sombered instantly upon hearing the tragic news regarding his colleague.
items.ex2_zh: 一听到关于同事的悲惨消息，他开朗的心情瞬间阴沉凝重起来。

items.def_zh: （使）变暗，（使）变黑；（使情绪等）转为阴沉
items.def_en: To become dark or darker, or to make something dark or darker; to become or make gloomy.
items.ex_en: Ominous storm clouds rapidly approached and began to darken the peaceful coastal sky.
items.ex_zh: 不祥的雷雨云迅速逼近，宁静的海滨天空随之变得昏暗。
items.ex2_en: The evening sky darkened quickly as the powerful thunderstorm rolled in from sea.
items.ex2_zh: 强烈的雷暴从海上袭来，傍晚的天空迅速变暗了下来。

items.def_en: To become black or very dark, or to make something black, as by smoke, fire, or storm clouds
items.ex_en: Billowing soot from the chimney will blacken the pristine white ceiling over time.
items.ex_zh: 烟囱中滚滚排出的煤烟久而久之会将洁白的屋顶完全熏黑。
items.ex2_en: The white toast blackened rapidly beneath the intensely hot heating elements inside the toaster.
items.ex2_zh: 白吐司在烤面包机内灼热的加热元件下迅速烤焦变黑。

groups.summary_en: Verbs describing a decrease in ambient light, brightness, or clarity, often extending metaphorically to solemn or gloomy moods and expressions.
groups.summary_zh: 描述光线减弱变暗，或引申指脸色、情绪变得阴沉凝重。
groups.desc_en: Denotes a decrease in illumination and visual clarity, often accompanied by gloom, contrasting with clearing or brightening.
groups.desc_zh: 指光照度降低并伴随阴郁暗沉的外观，区别于放晴或增亮。
groups.nuance_en: cloud over: becomes obscured by overcast skies or troubled expressions (sky / face / future) · dim: reduces in brightness, distinctness, or vividness (lights / prospects / memory) · somber: grows dark, solemn, and melancholic in visual tone or mood (room / mood / colors) · darken: progresses naturally into a state of deeper shade or shadow (sky / room / skin) · blacken: becomes intensely dark, charred, or thoroughly defamed (horizon / teeth / reputation)
groups.nuance_zh: cloud over: 阴云遮蔽或脸色阴沉 (sky / face / future) · dim: 光源变暗或前景/记忆转为模糊 (lights / prospects / memory) · somber: 色调或情绪转为阴郁沉重 (room / mood / colors) · darken: 变暗、发黑或阴沉下来 (sky / room / skin) · blacken: 彻底变黑、熏黑或名誉抹黑 (horizon / teeth / reputation)

groups.name: Dim & Fade · 变暗与减弱 (Fade, Dull, Subdue)
groups.tip: 光线减退逐渐隐入昏暗

items.def_en: Make or become less bright, clear, keen, or sensitive
items.ex_en: Chronic fatigue can dull a scholar's mental sharpness during long academic research projects.
items.ex_zh: 在漫长的学术研究过程中，长期的疲惫会使学者的敏锐思维变得迟钝。
items.ex2_en: Her keen mental focus dulled noticeably after sixteen straight hours of exhausting study.
items.ex2_zh: 连续十六小时筋疲力尽的学习后，她敏锐的专注力明显变得迟钝了。

items.def_zh: （使）变暗淡，（使）变模糊；（使希望等）减弱
items.def_en: To become less bright, clear, or strong, or to make something do so.
items.ex_en: Repeated setbacks failed to dim her unwavering determination to finish the research dissertation.
items.ex_zh: 接连的挫折未能削弱她完成学术毕业论文的坚定决心。
items.ex2_en: The theater footlights dimmed gently right before the evening orchestral overture began playing.
items.ex2_zh: 剧场的脚灯在晚间交响乐序曲开奏前柔和地暗了下去。

items.def_en: Lose brightness, color, or sharpness gradually over time
items.ex_en: Vibrant colors in the antique tapestry gradually fade under continuous direct sunlight exposure.
items.ex_zh: 古董挂毯上的鲜艳色彩在持续的阳光直射下逐渐褪色变淡。
items.ex2_en: Strong summer sunlight will gradually fade the vivid colors of delicate cotton fabrics.
items.ex2_zh: 强烈的夏季阳光会逐渐使精致棉织物的鲜艳色彩褪色。

items.def_en: Tone down the glare, brilliance, or intensity of light or sound
items.ex_en: Thick velvet curtains were drawn shut to subdue the harsh afternoon desert glare.
items.ex_zh: 厚重的丝绒窗帘被合上，以减弱午后刺眼的沙漠强光。

items.def_zh: 眼前发黑；熄灭所有灯光
items.def_en: Extinguish all illumination completely, or lose conscious vision temporarily
items.ex_en: He blacked out for a few seconds after hitting his head on the doorframe.
items.ex_zh: 他的头撞在门框上后昏厥了数秒。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses gradual reductions in sensory luminance, perceptual clarity, or intensity. 'Dim' focuses on declining light levels or fading vision, while 'fade' and 'dull' emphasize gradual loss of vividness and sharpness.
groups.summary_zh: 强调光线、亮度或知觉清晰度逐渐变弱、减退。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the gradual loss of intensity, vividness, loudness, or sensory energy, moving toward silence or imperceptibility, contrasting with abrupt cessation.
groups.desc_zh: 指能量、色彩、声音或意识强度的逐步衰退直至微弱，区别于骤然中断。
groups.nuance_en: dull: robs of sharpness, luster, or acute sensitivity (pain / shine / senses) · dim: gently decreases illumination or mental acuity (light / hope / vision) · fade: steadily loses color, brightness, or audible presence over time (memories / flower / music) · subdue: intentionally tones down glare, excitement, or vibrancy (colors / lighting / enthusiasm) · black out: experiences sudden total loss of vision, light, or consciousness (city / pilot / patient)
groups.nuance_zh: dull: 钝化痛感、磨灭光泽或灵敏度 (pain / shine / senses) · dim: 调低照度或使敏锐度减退 (light / hope / vision) · fade: 色彩日晒褪色、声音远去或记忆淡忘 (memories / flower / music) · subdue: 刻意调柔光线色彩或压制情绪 (colors / lighting / enthusiasm) · black out: 全城断电或人瞬间眼前发黑断片 (city / pilot / patient)

groups.name: Disallow & Invalidate · 裁定无效与不予许可 (Disallow, Reject, Overrule)
groups.tip: 官方依据条令严加禁止与驳回

items.def_en: to decide definitively that an option, proposal, or claim is unacceptable or impossible
items.ex_en: The medical committee decided to rule out surgery due to the patient's age.
items.ex_zh: 鉴于患者的年龄，医疗委员会决定排除手术治疗这一方案。

items.def_en: to declare that a contract, document, or transaction has no legal force
items.ex_en: A judge may void any employment contract that violates basic constitutional protections.
items.ex_zh: 法官可以裁定宣告任何违反基本宪法保障的劳动合同无效。

items.def_en: to legally or logically prove that something is no longer binding, valid, or acceptable
items.ex_en: The missing signature will formally invalidate the entire commercial lease agreement immediately.
items.ex_zh: 缺少签字将立即在法律层面上使整份商业租赁协议彻底作废。

items.def_en: to use higher authority to reject a decision, objection, or previous ruling
items.ex_en: The appellate bench chose to overrule the lower court's contentious evidential ruling.
items.ex_zh: 上诉法庭裁定驳回下级法院那项存在争议的证据裁决。

items.def_zh: 不予批准，驳回；判定……无效
items.def_en: to officially refuse to admit, permit, or recognize something, especially in sports or a legal court
items.ex_en: The presiding judge must disallow hearsay evidence submitted without proper foundation or verification.
items.ex_zh: 主审法官必须判定驳回未经充分证实或缺乏核验的传闻证据。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on procedural decisions in governance, courts, or competitive sports where an authority officially rules an action, claim, or score inadmissible or void. It emphasizes regulatory invalidation rather than moral condemnation.
groups.summary_zh: 指在比赛、法庭或行政程序中裁定某行为、进球或主张不合规而无效。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an authoritative or judicial refusal to accept, validate, or permit an item, claim, or verdict, contrasting with standard consensus rejection.
groups.desc_zh: 指基于权威或法定权力对某项主张、证据或裁决予以否决或判定无效，区别于一般常理拒绝。
groups.nuance_en: rule out: eliminates a candidate or hypothesis from consideration (possibility / candidate / theory) · void: completely annuls legal force ab initio (contract / ballot / transaction) · invalidate: destroys the official validity or logical cogency of an asset (license / election / argument) · overrule: uses superior authority to reject a lower ruling or objection (objection / verdict / decision) · disallow: formally refuses to admit an expense, deduction, or sporting point (goal / claim / deduction)
groups.nuance_zh: rule out: 排除某种可能性或候选对象 (possibility / candidate / theory) · void: 宣告合同或选票自始绝对无效 (contract / ballot / transaction) · invalidate: 使证件失效或论证无法成立 (license / election / argument) · overrule: 上级权威驳回异议或推翻下级判决 (objection / verdict / decision) · disallow: 官方核查后不予承认或判进球/报销无效 (goal / claim / deduction)

groups.name: Disappear & Vanish · 隐没与消失 (Disappear, Vanish, Evaporate)
groups.tip: 从视野中隐没至完全不见

items.def_zh: 渐次消退；渐渐远去消失
items.def_en: To become gradually weaker, fainter, or indistinct until totally lost to view or hearing
items.ex_en: The sound of distant church bells began to fade away into the twilight.
items.ex_zh: 远处教堂的钟声在暮色中逐渐消退，直至完全消失。

items.def_en: To disappear smoothly and inconspicuously into the surroundings until gone
items.ex_en: The midday crowd began to melt away as cold raindrops started to fall.
items.ex_zh: 冰凉的雨点落下时，正午聚集的人群开始悄然散去。

items.def_en: to stop being visible; to cease to exist or be found
items.ex_en: The solitary traveler watched the midnight express disappear into the foggy tunnel entrance.
items.ex_zh: 形单影只的旅人目送那趟午夜列车消失在雾气弥漫的隧道口中。

items.def_en: To disappear suddenly, completely, and without explanation
items.ex_en: The stolen jewels seemed to vanish into thin air from the guarded vault.
items.ex_zh: 被盗的珠宝似乎从戒备森严的保险库中凭空消失了。

items.def_en: To turn to vapor or, metaphorically, to vanish entirely as if without a physical trace
items.ex_en: Her initial enthusiasm seemed to evaporate when faced with tedious administrative bookkeeping work.
items.ex_zh: 面对繁琐乏味的行政簿记工作，她最初的热情似乎彻底消散无踪了。
items.ex2_en: The midday heat evaporated the thin layer of dew from the garden leaves.
items.ex2_zh: 正午的热浪蒸发了花园树叶上薄薄的一层露水。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the total cessation of visibility or presence, where an entity passes out of sight, leaves no immediate trace, or ceases to exist, ranging from ordinary loss of sight to abrupt vanishing.
groups.summary_zh: 强调实体脱离视线、无影无踪或彻底失去存在迹象的过程与状态。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the cessation of visibility or presence, spanning the spectrum from gradual dissipation to total instantaneous vanishing, contrasting with mere departure.
groups.desc_zh: 指物体或现象从视野中或存在中彻底隐匿消除，区别于单纯的离去走开。
groups.nuance_en: fade away: thins out and becomes imperceptible very slowly (sound / figure / smile) · melt away: dissolves fluidly and smoothly into surroundings (crowd / mist / savings) · disappear: passes out of sight or ceases existence in common usage (keys / species / ship) · vanish: disappears suddenly, completely, and inexplicably (magician / trace / cash) · evaporate: vaporizes into thin air, leaving zero physical or metaphorical trace (mist / funds / enthusiasm)
groups.nuance_zh: fade away: 声音或身影极其缓慢地渐隐淡出 (sound / figure / smile) · melt away: 人群或迷雾如融水般悄然化解散去 (crowd / mist / savings) · disappear: 视线内不见或物种灭绝 (keys / species / ship) · vanish: 突如其来且不留痕迹地凭空消失 (magician / trace / cash) · evaporate: 蒸发或热情/资金彻底化为乌有 (mist / funds / enthusiasm)

groups.name: Disapprove & Condemn · 反对与不赞同 (Frown on, Deprecate, Take Issue)
groups.tip: 表明不满立场并提出抗议

items.def_en: To view something with mild to moderate ethical disapproval or cultural disfavor
items.ex_en: Traditional villagers frown on loud public arguments between spouses during festive community gatherings.
items.ex_zh: 在节日聚会上，传统村民很不赞成夫妻间发生大声的公开争吵。

items.def_en: To strongly disagree with and dispute a specific claim, action, or assumption
items.ex_en: Several prominent economists take issue with the statistical methodology used in that report.
items.ex_zh: 数位著名经济学家对该报告中采用的统计方法持有强烈异议。

items.raw_cluster: 反对与不赞同 Disapprove & Object
items.def_en: (+ of) To think that someone or something is bad, wrong, or morally unacceptable.
items.ex_en: Conservative board members strongly disapprove of the proposed corporate restructuring strategy.
items.ex_zh: 保守的董事会成员强烈反对拟议中的企业重组战略方案。

items.def_en: To express firm, reasoned disapproval of an action, policy, or attitude
items.ex_en: Senior diplomats openly deprecate the reckless use of aggressive trade sanctions against allies.
items.ex_zh: 资深外交官公开表示反对针对盟友草率动用具有侵略性的贸易制裁。

items.def_en: To state forcefully that something is entirely wrong, wicked, or unacceptable
items.ex_en: Human rights organizations worldwide unanimously condemn the brutal treatment of civilian prisoners.
items.ex_zh: 全球人权组织一致对野蛮虐待平民囚犯的行径予以严厉谴责。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate holding or manifesting a negative judgment, ethical aversion, or unfavorable opinion regarding someone's behavior, standards, or choices. Nuances differentiate internal moral censure from vocal, critical disparagement.
groups.summary_zh: 在道德或价值评判上对某人某事持否定、不赞同态度。
groups.desc_en: Expressing adverse moral, ethical, or practical judgment against an action or stance, ranging from quiet social disapproval to authoritative public censure, rather than merely debating factual truth.
groups.desc_zh: 对某种行为或立场表达道德、伦理或事实层面的负面评判，涵盖从低调的社会性不悦到权威性的公开谴责，而非单纯的事实辩论。
groups.nuance_en: frown on: quiet, customary social disapproval (behavior / practice) · take issue with: explicit verbal disputation of a point (claim / statement) · disapprove: generic refusal to endorse or accept (plan / conduct) · deprecate: mild regretful disapproval or self-effacing minimization (criticism / attitude) · condemn: severe, absolute moral or judicial denunciation (violence / atrocities)
groups.nuance_zh: frown on: 惯例或社交层面的不赞成与不悦 (behavior / practice) · take issue with: 针对特定论点公开提出异议与抗辩 (claim / statement) · disapprove: 通用范畴的拒绝认可或反对 (plan / conduct) · deprecate: 温和委婉的反对或贬抑/轻描淡写 (criticism / attitude) · condemn: 严厉绝对的道德审判或公开谴责 (violence / atrocities)

groups.name: Disband & Break Up · 组织解散与分道扬镳 (Dissolve, Scatter, Part Ways)
groups.tip: 组织解体并遣散旗下成员

items.def_en: To cease functioning as a unified group, partnership, or organization and separate
items.ex_en: After years of artistic differences, the legendary rock band decided to break up permanently.
items.ex_zh: 在经历了多年的艺术分歧后，这支传奇摇滚乐队决定永久解散。
items.ex2_en: The coastal storm quickly broke up the brittle ice sheets floating along the shore.
items.ex2_zh: 沿海风暴迅速粉碎了漂浮在岸边脆弱的薄冰层。

items.def_en: To separate quickly and move off in varied directions, ending a collective formation
items.ex_en: The startled pigeons scattered in all directions as the loud siren suddenly sounded nearby.
items.ex_zh: 附近突然响起刺耳的警报声，受惊的鸽群瞬间四散飞去。
items.ex2_en: A ferocious gust of wind scattered colorful autumn leaves across the wet driveway.
items.ex2_zh: 一阵狂暴的大风把五彩斑斓的秋叶吹散在潮湿的车道上。

items.def_zh: 解散（议会、机构、伙伴关系）
items.def_en: To officially terminate an assembly, committee, business partnership, or legal body
items.ex_en: The prime minister officially advised the monarch to dissolve parliament ahead of snap elections.
items.ex_zh: 首相正式建议君主在提前大选前解散议会。
items.ex2_en: The sugar crystals dissolved smoothly into the boiling hot tea without leaving residue.
items.ex2_zh: 糖晶体顺畅地溶解在滚烫的热茶中，没留下任何沉淀。

items.def_en: To break up a gathering or crowd, causing individuals to head in separate ways
items.ex_en: Riot police deployed tear gas canisters to disperse the rowdy crowd before nightfall.
items.ex_zh: 防暴警察在日落前发射了催泪瓦斯罐以驱散喧闹的人群。
items.ex2_en: The morning fog dispersed quickly once bright sunlight broke through the clouds.
items.ex2_zh: 当明媚的阳光穿透云层时，晨雾迅速消散了。

items.def_zh: 解散，遣散（组织、军队、团体等）
items.def_en: (of an organized group, committee, or military unit) To break up and cease to exist, or cause to do so.
items.ex_en: The rebel militia agreed to surrender their heavy weapons and permanently disband the unit.
items.ex_zh: 叛军民兵组织同意交出重武器并永久解散该编制。
items.ex2_en: The secret student society disbanded quietly after graduating from the prestigious university campus.
items.ex2_zh: 这个秘密学生社团在从著名大学校园毕业后悄悄解散了。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures groups, committees, musical bands, or units ceasing collective operation and going their separate ways. It highlights cessation of corporate identity rather than employer-employee terminations.
groups.summary_zh: 团队、社团、乐团或集会停止合作并正式解散。
groups.desc_en: The dissolution of an organized collective or assembled crowd into separate, wandering components, contrasting with mere cessation of activity or physical destruction.
groups.desc_zh: 有组织的群体或聚集的人群解散、分裂并各自离去，强调从集体聚合态退化为离散个体，区别于单纯的活动中止或物理破坏。
groups.nuance_en: disband: formal or voluntary dissolution of an organized body (army / band / committee) · dissolve: institutional, legal, or authoritative termination of an entity (parliament / partnership) · disperse: scattering in multiple directions under external force or naturally (crowd / mob) · scatter: disorderly and sudden flying apart in fear or confusion (demonstrators / herd) · break up: abrupt termination and parting of an assembled group (party / meeting)
groups.nuance_zh: disband: 正式或自愿解散有建制的组织 (army / band / committee) · dissolve: 依据法律或权力终止机构/实体存在 (parliament / partnership) · disperse: 在外力驱散或自然散开下四散离去 (crowd / mob) · scatter: 因惊恐或混乱发生毫无秩序的奔逃四散 (demonstrators / herd) · break up: 聚会、集会等现场骤然终结并分道扬镳 (party / meeting)

groups.name: Discharge & Demob · 军役退伍与遣返 (Muster Out, Release, Invalided Out)
groups.tip: 军队遣散军人解甲归田

items.def_en: To officially free someone from obligatory armed service or contractual military duties
items.ex_en: The military authorities decided to release the veteran early from his obligatory service duties.
items.ex_zh: 军方当局决定提前解除这位退伍军人的服役义务。

items.def_en: To leave military service or be officially discharged at the end of a conflict or tour
items.ex_en: After five grueling years overseas, the decorated soldier was finally mustered out of service.
items.ex_zh: 在海外度过了艰苦的五年后，这名授勋士兵终于获准除役退伍。
items.ex2_en: Thousands of reserve troops mustered out after the armistice agreement was officially ratified.
items.ex2_zh: 在停战协定正式批准后，数千名预备役部队官兵正式退役解甲。

items.def_en: To formally discharge a member of the armed forces because of injury or serious illness
items.ex_en: He was formally invalided out of the armed forces following a catastrophic spinal injury.
items.ex_zh: 因脊髓严重受损，他被军队正式批准因伤退役。

items.def_en: To formally grant an official release from service in the armed forces
items.ex_en: The naval officer received an honorable discharge after twenty distinguished years of dedicated service.
items.ex_zh: 这位海军军官在卓越服役二十年后光荣退役。

items.def_zh: 使退役，遣散（军人，尤用于战后）
items.def_en: (British informal) To demobilize someone from military service, especially at the end of a war.
items.ex_en: My grandfather was finally demobbed in late 1945 and returned home to Yorkshire.
items.ex_zh: 我祖父终于在1945年底退伍，回到了约克郡的家中。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on the administrative or personal milestone of an individual service member leaving the military, returning to civilian life after combat, enlistment, or medical unfitness. Often carries conversational or administrative war-exit flavor.
groups.summary_zh: 军人个人层面的正式退伍、除役或遣返民用生活。
groups.desc_en: The formal or administrative release of personnel from military or institutional service, differing from routine civilian resignation or involuntary termination.
groups.desc_zh: 军人或特定机构人员依行政程序退出现役或离职归乡，区别于普通民间辞职或惩戒性解职。
groups.nuance_en: discharge: authoritative release from service, whether honorable or dishonorable (soldier / patient) · demob: wartime transition returning troops to civilian life (veterans / troops) · muster out: formal terminal assembly marking completion of military duty (regiment / recruits) · invalided out: termination of military service specifically due to injury or illness (officer / pilot) · release: administrative liberation from duty, detention, or contractual hold (captives / reservists)
groups.nuance_zh: discharge: 正式的服役终结与释放，含光荣或不光荣退伍 (soldier / patient) · demob: 战时或动员后成批军队复员归民 (veterans / troops) · muster out: 完成服役期并办理正式退伍点名手续 (regiment / recruits) · invalided out: 专指因伤病残疾无法履职而被勒令退役 (officer / pilot) · release: 行政层面的解除职务、拘禁或役期约束 (captives / reservists)

groups.name: Discharge Urine · 排尿与撒尿 (Piss, Pee, Urinate)
groups.tip: 排出体内的尿液与代谢废物

items.def_en: To urinate; used strictly in medical or highly technical formal contexts
items.ex_en: The post-operative patient was clinically monitored until he regained the natural ability to micturate.
items.ex_zh: 术后患者一直受到临床监护，直到他恢复自主排尿功能。

items.def_en: To pass urine, used especially in British English and by or with children
items.ex_en: The toddler told his mother that he urgently needed to go and wee.
items.ex_zh: 那个蹒跚学步的孩子告诉妈妈，他急着要去嘘嘘。

items.def_en: To pass liquid waste from the bladder out of the body
items.ex_en: The attending physician instructed the patient to urinate into a clean, sterile container.
items.ex_zh: 主治医生嘱咐病人将尿液排入一个无菌洁净的容器中。

items.def_en: To pass urine from the body, in informal but ordinary speech
items.ex_en: We pulled over at a roadside petrol station because the children needed to pee.
items.ex_zh: 我们在路边的加油站靠边停车，因为孩子们需要解手。

items.def_zh: 排尿，撒尿；惹恼（常与 off 连用）
items.def_en: 1. (informal, often considered vulgar) To discharge urine from the body. 2. ('piss off') To annoy or irritate someone intensely.
items.ex_en: The drunken rowdy stepped into the dark alley behind the pub to piss.
items.ex_zh: 那个醉汉走进酒吧后面的幽暗小巷里撒尿。

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies the bodily act of discharging urine, differentiated across registers from clinical terminology to casual colloquialisms and vulgar profanity.
groups.summary_zh: 表示排尿的生理活动，区分临床正式、日常口语和粗俗口吻。
groups.desc_en: Physiological voiding of liquid waste from the bladder, varying by register from clinical formality to informal or coarse vernacular.
groups.desc_zh: 从膀胱排出液体排泄物的生理行为，核心差异体现于从医学临床规范到粗鄙俚语的不同语域与交际场合。
groups.nuance_en: urinate: neutral clinical or formal standard term (patient / subject) · micturate: technical medical or legal register (specimen / bladder) · wee: childish or euphemistic colloquialism (toddler / dog) · pee: common, mildly informal everyday term (child / adult) · piss: blunt, coarse, or vulgar register (drunk / bystander)
groups.nuance_zh: urinate: 中立、正式或临床标准用语 (patient / subject) · micturate: 高度专业化的医学或解剖学术语 (specimen / bladder) · wee: 带有儿语或委婉色彩的口语 (toddler / dog) · pee: 最常用的通俗日常口语 (child / adult) · piss: 直白、粗俗且带有冒犯性的粗话 (drunk / bystander)

groups.name: Discourage & Demoralize · 沮丧与气馁 (Dampen, Daunt, Dishearten)
groups.tip: 受挫后热情熄灭、意气消沉

items.raw_cluster: 使沮丧与沮丧 Discourage & Chill
items.def_zh: 使沮丧，使泄气，使寒心；使变冷，冷冻
items.def_en: 1. To discourage, dishearten, or dampen enthusiasm. 2. To make or become cold without freezing.
items.ex_en: The grim economic forecast served to chill investor enthusiasm across the emerging markets.
items.ex_zh: 严峻的经济预测使新兴市场投资者的热情大受打击。
items.ex2_en: The refreshing bottle of white wine will chill nicely inside this ice bucket.
items.ex2_zh: 这瓶爽口的白葡萄酒放在这个冰桶里会冷藏得恰到好处。

items.def_en: To intimidate or subdue someone's courage by presenting daunting difficulties
items.ex_en: The sheer scale of the mountainous trek did not daunt the experienced expedition.
items.ex_zh: 高山跋涉的巨大难度丝毫没有吓倒这支经验丰富的探险队。

items.def_en: To make feelings, spirits, or enthusiasm less strong and buoyant
items.ex_en: The sudden heavy downpour threatened to dampen the spirits of the festival attendees.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的倾盆大雨恐将浇灭节日参加者的兴致。

items.def_en: To cause someone to lose hope, confidence, or motivation
items.ex_en: A series of consecutive funding rejections failed to dishearten the stubborn young scientist.
items.ex_zh: 一连串的经费申请遭拒并未使这位执着的青年科学家灰心丧气。

items.def_en: To destroy the confidence, self-belief, or fighting discipline of a person or group
items.ex_en: Heavy logistical failures and constant enemy shelling threatened to demoralize the frontline troops completely.
items.ex_zh: 严重的后勤失误和持续的敌军炮击严重瓦解了前线部队的斗志。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe actions or events that cool enthusiasm, diminish resolve, undermine confidence, or crush optimism.
groups.summary_zh: 指泼冷水使人热情冷却、信心受挫或意志消沉。
groups.desc_en: Depleting someone's confidence, enthusiasm, or psychological stamina through adversity, differing from physical exhaustion or logical refutation.
groups.desc_zh: 通过逆境、恐惧或阻碍削弱他人的自信、热情或心理韧性，区别于纯粹的体力耗尽或逻辑驳斥。
groups.nuance_en: dampen: suppress or reduce the intensity of enthusiasm or spirits (enthusiasm / hopes) · daunt: intimidate and subdue courage through perceived difficulty (prospect / challenge) · dishearten: cause loss of resolve and cheer through repeated setback (failure / news) · demoralize: thoroughly shatter psychological cohesion and will to fight (troops / team) · chill: freeze or stifle ardour, speech, or investment through fear (market / debate)
groups.nuance_zh: dampen: 压制或削弱热情、期望的强度 (enthusiasm / hopes) · daunt: 因前景极其艰险而使人望而生畏、气馁 (prospect / challenge) · dishearten: 因接连受挫而使人心灰意冷、丧失斗志 (failure / news) · demoralize: 彻底击垮集体凝聚力与作战士气 (troops / team) · chill: 产生寒蝉效应，因恐惧使热情或自由表达冻结 (market / debate)

groups.name: Disgust & Repel · 厌恶与反感 (Disgust, Repel, Revolt)
groups.tip: 深恶痛绝引起生理排斥

items.def_en: To arouse a strong, visceral feeling of physical distaste or moral indignation in someone
items.ex_en: The putrid smell of rotting fish in the heat began to disgust everyone.
items.ex_zh: 在酷热中腐烂鱼肉散发的恶臭令每个人都感到作呕。

items.def_en: To cause someone to lose interest or experience mild distaste and attraction towards someone or something
items.ex_en: His arrogant demeanor and rude comments immediately turned off every guest at dinner.
items.ex_zh: 他傲慢的举止和粗鲁的言论让晚宴上的每位客人都大感败兴。

items.def_en: To cause someone intense shock and disgust that verges on physical sickness
items.ex_en: The gruesome details revealed during the murder trial revolted even the hardened reporters.
items.ex_zh: 谋杀案审判中披露的骇人细节令见多识广的记者们都深感反胃。

items.def_en: To cause someone to feel intense aversion or an impulse to back away in distaste
items.ex_en: His extreme cruelty toward helpless animals continues to repel everyone in the community.
items.ex_zh: 他对无助动物的极度残忍行径令社区里的每个人都感到厌恶。

items.def_zh: 使厌恶，使反感；使恶心，使作呕
items.def_en: To make someone feel disgusted, repelled, or sick to their stomach.
items.ex_en: The sickening smell of burnt rubber began to nauseate the trapped factory workers.
items.ex_zh: 橡胶烧焦的刺鼻气味令被困的工厂工人们感到阵阵作呕。
