groups.nuance_zh: chip in: 私下大家凑份子凑钱 (money / advice) · contribute: 为共同目标或事业出资出力 (funds / articles / time) · donate: 正式向慈善机构捐献资产或体液 (blood / organs / millions) · bestow: 带有尊贵意味地恩赐或授予 (title / favor / blessing) · bequeath: 订立遗嘱将遗产传授给后人 (estate / fortune / legacy)

groups.name: Doubt & Disbelieve · 怀疑与否定不信 (Question, Discredit, Reject)
groups.tip: 从心存疑虑到彻底拒绝相信

items.def_en: To express doubt about the truth, correctness, or honesty of something
items.ex_en: Independent journalists began to question the official explanation regarding the factory explosion.
items.ex_zh: 独立记者们开始对有关工厂爆炸的官方解释提出质疑。

items.def_zh: 嘲弄并不信，对……嗤之以鼻
items.def_en: To speak about someone or something in a way that shows contemptuous disbelief
items.ex_en: Skeptical scientists scoff at the outlandish claims of perpetual energy machine inventions.
items.ex_zh: 持怀疑态度的科学家对永动机发明的离奇说法嗤之以鼻。

items.def_en: To dismiss or refuse to accept a premise, story, or belief as untrue
items.ex_en: The scientific panel will formally reject unverified theories about the sudden climate shift.
items.ex_zh: 科学小组将正式否定关于气候突变的未经验证的理论。

items.def_zh: 使不可置信，怀疑……的真实性
items.def_en: To cause an idea, statement, or claim to seem untrue, false, or unreliable
items.ex_en: Recent forensic findings effectively discredit the suspect's claim of having an alibi.
items.ex_zh: 最新的法医鉴定结果有力地动摇了嫌疑人不在场证明的真实性。

items.def_en: To refuse or be unable to believe that something is true, real, or accurate.
items.ex_en: The jury chose to disbelieve the witness's contradictory statements during the cross-examination.
items.ex_zh: 在盘问过程中，陪审团拒绝相信该证人自相矛盾的陈述。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on cognitive refusal to accept claims, propositions, or asserted facts as true. Emphasizes an epistemological judgment of factual untruth rather than interpersonal suspicion.
groups.summary_zh: 着重于在认知与判断上拒绝相信某一陈述或事实的真实性。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an epistemic stance of refusing assent, escalating from intellectual skepticism to active scorn and outright repudiation, unlike objective factual investigation.
groups.desc_zh: 表示拒绝认同或不予信任的认知姿态，从理性质疑递进至轻蔑嘲弄及彻底否决，不同于客观的事实调查。
groups.nuance_en: question: intellectually interrogate validity or truth (motives / legitimacy / wisdom) · disbelieve: withhold credence or find incredible (rumors / reports / miracles) · discredit: actively undermine credibility or repute (allegations / evidence / theory) · scoff at: dismiss with contemptuous mockery (notion / proposal / warning) · reject: decisively refuse to accept as valid (hypothesis / claim / offer)
groups.nuance_zh: question: 针对正当性或真实性提出理性质疑 (motives / legitimacy / wisdom) · disbelieve: 难以置信或拒绝相信 (rumors / reports / miracles) · discredit: 主动破坏可信度或名誉 (allegations / evidence / theory) · scoff at: 报以嘲弄与不屑一顾 (notion / proposal / warning) · reject: 明确断然地拒绝认可 (hypothesis / claim / offer)

groups.name: Downplay & Marginalize · 边缘化与淡化 (Marginalize, Sideline, Downplay)
groups.tip: 故意压低其重要性

items.def_zh: 使退居次要地位，淡化…的重要性；提供背景情况
items.def_en: To relegate something to a less prominent or important position; downplay the significance of.
items.ex_en: The administration tried to background the minor diplomatic blunder during the peace summit.
items.ex_zh: 政府试图在和平峰会期间淡化这一轻微外交失误的重要性。

items.def_en: To minimize the importance or value of something deliberately
items.ex_en: The government tried to play down the seriousness of the economic crisis.
items.ex_zh: 政府试图淡化这场经济危机的严重性。

items.def_zh: 靠边站，使退居次要地位
items.def_en: To remove someone or something from the center of activity or influence
items.ex_en: The ambitious prime minister managed to sideline his political rivals from key appointments.
items.ex_zh: 野心勃勃的首相设法排挤了他的政敌，使其无法获得关键任命。

items.def_en: To make something appear less important, severe, or noticeable than it really is
items.ex_en: The spokesperson attempted to downplay the severity of the sudden economic downturn.
items.ex_zh: 发言人试图对这次突如其来的经济下滑的严重性轻描淡写。

items.def_zh: 使边缘化，排挤至从属地位
items.def_en: To treat a person, group, or concept as insignificant or peripheral
items.ex_en: Urban renewal projects often marginalize vulnerable low-income communities residing in inner cities.
items.ex_zh: 城市更新项目往往会将居住在内城区的脆弱低收入群体边缘化。

groups.summary_en: Refers to strategic or cognitive actions that push an issue, party, or factor into a secondary, less visible status, deliberately diminishing its perceived importance or attention.
groups.summary_zh: 将事物置于次要地位、冷处理或边缘化，故意淡化其重要性。
groups.desc_en: Involves strategically reducing the visibility, priority, or perceived gravity of an issue or actor, shifting them from center stage to the periphery rather than entirely eliminating them.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过战术性手段降低某事物或主体的可见度、重要性或严重程度，将其从核心推向边缘，而非直接彻底清除。
groups.nuance_en: downplay: intentionally minimize perceived importance or severity (risks / concerns / impact) · play down: colloquially soften or gloss over significance (differences / problems / role) · background: intentionally relegate to a subordinate contextual role (details / figures / history) · sideline: exclude from central activity or decision-making (rivals / ministers / debate) · marginalize: structurally push to the social or political periphery (minorities / voices / communities)
groups.nuance_zh: downplay: 刻意淡化其严重性或重要度 (risks / concerns / impact) · play down: 口语化地掩饰或弱化影响 (differences / problems / role) · background: 故意将其降为衬托背景 (details / figures / history) · sideline: 靠边站或剥夺参与核心决策的机会 (rivals / ministers / debate) · marginalize: 在结构或社会层面上予以边缘化 (minorities / voices / communities)

groups.name: Downscale & Shrink · 缩小与精简规格 (Downscale, Scale Down, Compact)
groups.tip: 数量削减或规模由大变小

items.def_en: To make a system, organization, or design more efficient by eliminating redundant elements
items.ex_en: The manufacturing company hired consultants to streamline its outdated internal supply chain processes.
items.ex_zh: 这家制造公司聘请顾问来精简优化其陈旧的内部供应链流程。

items.def_en: To make something smaller in size, amount, or scope than originally planned
items.ex_en: The company had to scale down its overseas expansion plans due to recession.
items.ex_zh: 由于经济衰退，该公司不得不削减其海外扩张计划的规模。

items.def_en: To press or squeeze something into a smaller space, or encode data into fewer bytes
items.ex_en: Advanced software can compress large multimedia files without significant loss of visual clarity.
items.ex_zh: 先进的软件可以压缩大型多媒体文件，且不会显著降低画面的清晰度。
items.ex2_en: The dense foam cushions compress easily under the heavy weight of furniture.
items.ex2_zh: 厚重的泡沫垫在沉重家具的压力下很容易被压缩。

items.def_en: To reduce the size, scale, or extent of an operation, image, or design
items.ex_en: The studio had to downscale the high-budget cinematic production into a television miniseries.
items.ex_zh: 工作室不得不将这部高预算的电影制作缩减为电视迷你剧。

items.def_zh: 使缩小，使变小；（计算机）精简（代码以减小体积）
items.def_en: 1. To make smaller or reduce the size of something. 2. (computing) To remove redundant or unnecessary characters from source code to reduce file size.
items.ex_en: The developer chose to minify the source code to accelerate the website's performance.
items.ex_zh: 开发者选择精简源代码，以提升网站的加载性能。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on deliberately downsizing, compacting, or stripping down the scale, bulk, or technical footprint of an object, codebase, or model. It highlights reduction in scale, overhead, or redundancy.
groups.summary_zh: 指缩小尺寸规格、精简多余代码或压缩体积规模。
groups.desc_en: Denotes intentionally shrinking the physical, organizational, or operational scale of a system to make it tighter or more manageable, unlike accidental loss or wear.
groups.desc_zh: 指人为削减系统在物理、组织或运作上的规格规模以求精简高效，不同于意外损耗或自然缩减。
groups.nuance_en: downscale: reduce the broad scope, ambition, or grade of an operation (operations / lifestyle / ambitions) · scale down: proportionally diminish volume, staffing, or expenditure (production / budget / workforce) · streamline: eliminate redundancies for operational efficiency (processes / organization / workflow) · compress: condense volume, duration, or data by physical/digital force (files / schedule / spring) · minify: strip down to the bare minimal footprint (code / footprint / script)
groups.nuance_zh: downscale: 缩减整体格局、档次或运作规模 (operations / lifestyle / ambitions) · scale down: 按比例削减支出、产量或编制 (production / budget / workforce) · streamline: 剔除冗余以精简流程 (processes / organization / workflow) · compress: 借助外力或技术压缩体积、时长或数据 (files / schedule / spring) · minify: 剔除一切无用冗余以达到极小化 (code / footprint / script)

groups.name: Draft & Enlist · 征召与征募兵员 (Draft, Call up, Mobilize)
groups.tip: 国家战时强制征调公民服兵役

items.def_en: To officially order someone into mandatory military service, especially during an emergency
items.ex_en: The government announced plans to draft thousands of young citizens during wartime.
items.ex_zh: 政府宣布了在战时征召数千名年轻公民服兵役的计划。

items.def_en: To summon someone for active military duty or reserve training
items.ex_en: The army chose to call up trained reservists during the escalating border crisis.
items.ex_zh: 在边境危机升级期间，军方决定征召训练有素的预备役人员服役。

items.def_en: To assemble soldiers or sailors specifically for roll-call, inspection, or preparation for battle
items.ex_en: The commanding officer ordered the bugler to muster all available troops at dawn.
items.ex_zh: 指挥官命令号兵在黎明时分召集所有现存部队集合。
items.ex2_en: Tired soldiers muster quickly on the parade ground before the morning drill.
items.ex2_zh: 疲倦的士兵在早操前迅速在操场上集合。

items.def_en: To assemble and organize civilian and military troops into readiness for active war service
items.ex_en: The threatened nation had to mobilize its standing military forces within twenty-four hours.
items.ex_zh: 面临威胁的国家必须在二十四小时内动员其常备军事力量进入临战状态。
items.ex2_en: The reserve infantry divisions mobilized swiftly along the threatened northern border.
items.ex2_zh: 预备步兵师在受到威胁的北部边境迅速动员集结。

items.def_en: to officially and legally require someone to serve in the armed forces
items.ex_en: The totalitarian regime attempted to conscript every young male into forced military service.
items.ex_zh: 极权政权试图强征每一名年轻男性服强制兵役。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures the mobilization of individuals into military or civilian defense service, ranging from compulsory government orders to targeted call-ups during wartime emergencies.
groups.summary_zh: 强调国家或军队依规召集、强制征派公民入伍服役。
groups.desc_en: Involves state-sanctioned or institutional mechanisms to summon citizens into military service or assembly, contrasting with voluntary recruitment or civilian hiring.
groups.desc_zh: 指国家或体制依据权威指令强行或依律征集公民服役、集结受训，不同于自愿入伍或普通雇佣。
groups.nuance_en: draft: select and induct through an institutionalized lottery or quota (recruits / civilians / soldiers) · conscript: compel legally into military service by compulsory mandate (citizens / youth / population) · call up: summon reservists or designated cohorts to active duty (reservists / troops / cohort) · muster: assemble and inspect dispersed personnel for immediate readiness (troops / militia / force) · mobilize: rapidly activate and organize national or collective resources for war (army / resources / population)
groups.nuance_zh: draft: 依配额或抽签强制征召入伍 (recruits / civilians / soldiers) · conscript: 依法实行强制兵役 (citizens / youth / population) · call up: 召集预备役或指定批次人员服现役 (reservists / troops / cohort) · muster: 集合并检阅分散人员以备战 (troops / militia / force) · mobilize: 全面动员国家或武装力量进入战时状态 (army / resources / population)

groups.name: Drastically Cut & Terminate · 强行砍掉与废弃 (Scrap, Can, Nix)
groups.tip: 强行中断或彻底根除

items.def_en: (informal) To terminate, shelve permanently, or dismiss someone summarily
items.ex_en: The network decided to can the failing drama after only one dismal season.
items.ex_zh: 在播出惨淡的第一季后，电视台决定彻底砍掉这部反响不佳的电视剧。

items.def_en: (informal) To abandon or discard something abruptly because it is no longer useful or desired
items.ex_en: She finally decided to ditch her unreliable car and buy a reliable hybrid.
items.ex_zh: 她终于决定抛弃她那辆毛病不断的破车，去买一辆性能可靠的混动车。

items.def_en: To discard or cancel a long-held plan, policy, or project as unusable or unviable
items.ex_en: The city council voted unanimously to scrap the controversial urban development plan.
items.ex_zh: 市议会一致投票决定彻底废除这项备受争议的城市建设计划。

items.def_en: 1. (informal) To suddenly cancel a project, cut funding, or dismiss employees.
items.ex_en: The struggling corporation decided to ax three unprofitable regional branches this month.
items.ex_zh: 这家陷入困境的公司决定在本月裁撤三个处于亏损状态的区域分支机构。

items.def_en: (chiefly North American informal) To put an abrupt end to an idea, proposal, or proposal
items.ex_en: The executive committee voted to nix the proposed budget increase without discussion.
items.ex_zh: 执行委员会未经讨论便投票否决并取消了拟议的预算增长。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate the decisive, often ruthless cancellation or defunding of ongoing projects, jobs, or initiatives. They highlight abrupt managerial finality rather than natural phase-out.
groups.summary_zh: 指以果断甚至无情的方式突然取消项目、砍除预算或终止业务。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an abrupt, decisive, and often ruthlessly pragmatic termination of a project, policy, or role, distinguished from orderly, scheduled phase-outs.
groups.desc_zh: 指以果断、决绝且往往严酷的手段直接叫停、废弃或取缔项目或人员，区别于有序且渐进的退役淘汰。
groups.nuance_en: scrap: discard an ongoing venture as useless or unviable (plans / treaty / project) · ax: drastically cut or dismiss due to financial austerity or pruning (jobs / funding / subsidy) · ditch: abandon unceremoniously to rid oneself of a liability (partner / idea / car) · can: abruptly terminate or dismiss, often with finality (show / project / employee) · nix: veto or cancel before launch or continuation (deal / proposal / funding)
groups.nuance_zh: scrap: 将毫无价值或不可行的计划当破烂废弃 (plans / treaty / project) · ax: 因削减开支等原因强行砍掉或裁撤 (jobs / funding / subsidy) · ditch: 弃如敝履般甩掉负担或包袱 (partner / idea / car) · can: 突然叫停、腰斩项目或解雇 (show / project / employee) · nix: 断然否决、否决推翻提案 (deal / proposal / funding)

groups.name: Draw & Unsheathe · 抽拔与出鞘 (Unsheathe, Draw, Pull)
groups.tip: 拔刀出鞘或抽出利刃

items.def_en: To produce or brandish a weapon suddenly from one's clothing or holster.
items.ex_en: The startled detective prepared to pull his service weapon from his coat.
items.ex_zh: 大吃一惊的侦探准备从大衣中掏出他的配枪。

items.def_en: To take out a weapon smoothly from its holster or scabbard ready for use.
items.ex_en: The chivalrous knight was forced to draw his sword to defend the travelers.
items.ex_zh: 这位富有骑士风范的武士被迫拔剑出鞘以保护旅客。

items.def_en: To remove a handgun or firearm from its holster.
items.ex_en: The officer swiftly unholstered his service pistol when the suspect reached into his jacket.
items.ex_zh: 当嫌疑人把手伸进夹克时，警官迅速拔出了佩枪。

items.def_en: To draw or pull a sword, knife, or other weapon out of its sheath.
items.ex_en: With a cold whisper of steel, the knight unsheathed his ancestral blade before battle.
items.ex_zh: 伴随着冰冷的剑鸣，骑士在战前拔出了他的家传宝剑。

items.def_en: To draw or reveal a weapon or item with extreme swiftness and agility.
items.ex_en: The detective suddenly whipped out his badge to silence the unruly crowd at once.
items.ex_zh: 侦探猛然掏出警徽，立刻震慑住了骚动的人群。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the swift manual extraction of a bladed weapon, tool, or weaponized object from its sheath, holster, or scabbard, often preparing for combat.
groups.summary_zh: 自刀鞘、枪套或皮夹中拔出利刃或武器备战。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on the rapid, deliberate mechanical extraction of a weapon or tool from its sheath, holster, or concealed position, contrasting with casually taking something out.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重于从剑鞘、枪套或隐蔽处迅速、警惕且有目的地抽拔出武器或工具的机械动作，区别于随手拿取。
groups.nuance_en: draw: smoothly and deliberately extract a weapon ready for action (sword / weapon / gun) · unsheathe: bare a blade explicitly by pulling it from its scabbard (sword / dagger / blade) · unholster: release and extract a firearm from a holster (gun / pistol / sidearm) · pull: extract with brisk force, often defensively (gun / knife / weapon) · whip out: pull out with sudden, dramatic, and blinding speed (revolver / badge / wallet)
groups.nuance_zh: draw: 沉稳利落地拔出待用武器 (sword / weapon / gun) · unsheathe: 特指将刀剑等锋刃抽出鞘 (sword / dagger / blade) · unholster: 将枪械从枪套中解脱拔出 (gun / pistol / sidearm) · pull: 迅速发力抽出防身或攻击 (gun / knife / weapon) · whip out: 以极其迅猛、出其不意之势猛然掏出 (revolver / badge / wallet)

groups.name: Draw, Paint & Depict · 绘制与刻画 (Paint, Draw, Sketch)
groups.tip: 用颜料画笔描绘出图像

items.def_en: To produce a picture or diagram by making lines and marks on paper with a pen or pencil
items.ex_en: The architect began to draw a detailed floor plan on the heavy drafting paper.
items.ex_zh: 建筑师开始在厚重的绘图纸上画出一份详细的平面图。

items.def_en: To make a quick, rough drawing of something without giving fine detail
items.ex_en: She took out her notebook to sketch the outlines of the distant mountain range.
items.ex_zh: 她拿出笔记本，快速勾勒出远方山脉的轮廓。

items.def_zh: 画，绘画；涂漆于，给……刷油漆；描绘
items.def_en: 1. To produce a picture of something using paints. 2. To cover a surface with paint. 3. To describe or depict someone or something in a particular way.
items.ex_en: The local artist decided to paint the vibrant harbor scene using rich oil pigments.
items.ex_zh: 这位当地艺术家决定用浓郁的油画颜料描绘充满生机的水港风光。

items.def_en: To represent someone or something in a painting, drawing, sculpture, or piece of writing
items.ex_en: The monumental mural depicts the harrowing struggles of the early nineteenth-century industrial workers.
items.ex_zh: 这幅宏伟的壁画刻画了十九世纪初工业工人的艰辛抗争。

items.def_en: To represent likeness or character in an artwork or to describe in a particular artistic way
items.ex_en: The biography attempts to portray the controversial prime minister as a misunderstood visionary leader.
items.ex_zh: 这本传记试图将这位备受争议的首相塑造为一位被误解的有远见的领袖。

groups.summary_en: This core artistic frame denotes the deliberate creation of visual representations or descriptive portraits by applying medium (pigment, ink, graphite) to a surface. Figuratively, it covers rendering people, events, or impressions through vivid words.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过颜料或笔墨在表面创制图像，或引申用生动语言描摹刻画。
groups.desc_en: Involves producing an optical representation through artistic media, ranging from foundational line-making to vivid pigment work and nuanced verbal/artistic characterization.
groups.desc_zh: 通过艺术媒介构建视觉或具象表征，涵盖从线条勾勒、色彩涂抹到深层意象描摹的各类再现过程。
groups.nuance_en: draw: delineate shapes primarily using lines, pencils, or dry media (portrait / diagram / cartoon) · sketch: capture rough, preliminary outlines without fine detail (scene / design / likeness) · paint: apply liquid pigments with brushes onto a surface (canvas / portrait / landscape) · depict: convey an image, person, or event through representational art (scene / battle / everyday life) · portray: capture character, mood, or psychological likeness deeply (figure / hero / character)
groups.nuance_zh: draw: 以线条和硬笔勾勒成图 (portrait / diagram / cartoon) · sketch: 快速捕捉轮廓与主要特征的草图勾画 (scene / design / likeness) · paint: 用颜料与画笔涂抹着色 (canvas / portrait / landscape) · depict: 具象描绘再现场景或历史画面 (scene / battle / everyday life) · portray: 深入传神地刻画人物风貌或性格 (figure / hero / character)

groups.name: Drill & Pierce · 打孔与穿透 (Pierce, Perforate, Bore)
groups.tip: 用钻头或尖锥在表面穿透出孔

items.def_en: To make a round hole in or through something using a rotating tool
items.ex_en: The carpenter used an auger to bore a smooth hole through the oak beam.
items.ex_zh: 木匠用螺丝钻在橡木梁上钻出了一个光滑的圆孔。

items.def_en: 1. To make a hole in something using a drill or pointed tool. 2. To practice an activity repeatedly or instruct someone through rigorous training.
items.ex_en: Workers must drill several deep holes into the concrete foundation before mounting the steel posts.
items.ex_zh: 工人们在固定钢柱前必须在混凝土基座上钻出几个深孔。

items.def_en: To make a hole in or through something with a sharp pointed object
items.ex_en: A sharp rusty nail managed to pierce the thick rubber sole of his boot.
items.ex_zh: 一根锋利的生锈铁钉刺穿了他靴子厚厚的橡胶底。

items.def_en: To pierce a hole in something, especially causing air or fluid to escape
items.ex_en: Sharp jagged rocks on the narrow trail threatened to puncture our front bicycle tires.
items.ex_zh: 狭窄山路上尖锐嶙峋的岩石随时可能刺破我们自行车的车胎。
items.ex2_en: The thin rubber raft punctured easily on the sharp coral reef.
items.ex2_zh: 薄薄的橡胶筏在锋利的珊瑚礁上很容易被刺破。

items.def_en: To make a line or pattern of small holes through a material
items.ex_en: The specialized machine will perforate the cardboard sheet along its seam for effortless detachment.
items.ex_zh: 这台专用机器将沿纸板接缝处打孔，以便于轻松将其撕下。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers mechanical or physical operations where a pointed or rotating tool makes a hole through, penetrates, or perforates a solid surface or material.
groups.summary_zh: 指使用尖锐或旋转工具在固体表面打孔、贯穿或刺穿。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on penetrating or creating a hollow passage through a solid material via sharp rotational or compressive force, distinguished from surface cutting or splitting.
groups.desc_zh: 指利用旋转力或尖锐冲压力穿透固体材料或打出空洞，区别于表面划割或纵向劈裂。
groups.nuance_en: drill: cut a neat cylindrical hole using a rotating fluted tool (hole / tooth / bedrock) · bore: create a deep, wide, or tunnel-like cavity through slow rotary gouging (tunnel / cylinder / hole) · pierce: penetrate sharp-pointed force through a barrier or flesh (ears / skin / armor) · puncture: make a small, disruptive prick causing deflation or leakage (tire / lung / balloon) · perforate: pierce a series of distinct holes through a surface (paper / bowel / sheet)
groups.nuance_zh: drill: 使用旋转钻具精准钻出圆孔 (hole / tooth / bedrock) · bore: 慢速旋转挖掘深孔或隧道内膛 (tunnel / cylinder / hole) · pierce: 用尖锐物强力刺穿或穿透 (ears / skin / armor) · puncture: 戳破造成泄露或漏气的小孔 (tire / lung / balloon) · perforate: 打出一排小孔或造成穿孔病变 (paper / bowel / sheet)

groups.name: Drip & Trickle Drops · 滴落与沥落 (Trickle, Dribble, Weep)
groups.tip: 液体连续流淌或逐滴落下

items.def_en: 1. To fall or let liquid fall in small drops; to be wet enough for liquid to drop off.
items.ex_en: Cold rainwater continued to drip slowly from the rusty drainpipe onto the cobblestone pavement.
items.ex_zh: 冰凉的雨水继续从生锈的排水管慢慢滴落到鹅卵石路面上。
items.ex2_en: Carefully drip a few drops of lemon juice into the sauce.
items.ex2_zh: 小心地将几滴柠檬汁滴进酱汁里。

items.def_en: To exude tiny drops of moisture, resin, or fluid very slowly from a surface or wound
items.ex_en: Clear golden resin began to weep slowly from the ancient cedar's weathered trunk.
items.ex_zh: 清亮金黄的树脂开始从古老雪松风化的树干上缓缓沁出。

items.def_en: To flow or leak slowly through small holes, pores, or minute fissures in small wet drops
items.ex_en: Toxic contaminants continue to seep quietly through the cracked underground barrier into groundwater supplies.
items.ex_zh: 有毒污染物继续通过破裂的地下阻隔层悄悄渗入地下水源。

items.def_en: To flow or make liquid fall in a thin, gentle, and often intermittent stream or series of drops
items.ex_en: A thin stream of spring water trickled down the steep rocky wall below us.
items.ex_zh: 一股细细的泉水沿着我们下方的陡峭石壁缓缓淌下。
items.ex2_en: The nurse slowly trickled saline solution over the patient's dry wound.
items.ex2_zh: 护士将生理盐水缓慢淋在病人干燥的伤口上。

items.def_en: To fall or run in small drops or a thin, feeble, uncontrolled trickle
items.ex_en: Dark melted chocolate began to dribble down the sides of the towering dessert display.
items.ex_zh: 融化的黑巧克力开始顺着高耸的甜点架边缘微量滴淌而下。
items.ex2_en: The chef dribbled fragrant olive oil over the freshly tossed garden salad.
items.ex2_zh: 大厨在刚拌好的蔬菜沙拉上淋上香浓的橄榄油。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate the downward gravitational falling or oozing of liquid in discrete drops, beads, or feeble, interrupted streams.
groups.summary_zh: 液体成滴状或微细断续水流下落、滴沥或渗流。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the discharge of liquid in discrete, intermittent drops or weak trickling streams driven by gravity or slow leakage, contrasting with forceful gushing or spraying.
groups.desc_zh: 指液体在重力或微弱压力作用下呈点滴状或微弱细流排出，不同于喷涌或汹涌喷洒。
groups.nuance_en: drip: fall in distinct, rhythmic, gravitational globules (water / blood / sweat) · trickle: flow in a fragile, thin, continuous stream (stream / tears / blood) · dribble: spill or run in thin, irregular droplets down a chin or surface (saliva / milk / liquid) · seep: slowly ooze through tiny pores or hidden cracks (moisture / water / oil) · weep: slowly exude liquid drops from a wound, wall, or porous boundary (wound / mortar / sores)
groups.nuance_zh: drip: 呈离散、有节奏的水滴下滴 (water / blood / sweat) · trickle: 形成微弱、连续的涓涓细流 (stream / tears / blood) · dribble: 不受控地沿表面或嘴角少量淌下 (saliva / milk / liquid) · seep: 经由微孔或缝隙极其缓慢地渗出 (moisture / water / oil) · weep: 伤口或多孔表面渗出汁液或脓液 (wound / mortar / sores)

groups.name: Drive Forward & Propel · 推进与驱动 (Propel, Drive, Thrust)
groups.tip: 施力驱动物体向前运动

items.def_en: To force someone or something into a particular direction or emotional state by applying constant pressure
items.ex_en: Relentless academic pressure threatened to drive the exhausted medical students to total emotional collapse.
items.ex_zh: 无休止的学业压力几乎要将疲惫不堪的医学生推向崩溃边缘。

items.def_en: To push something forward suddenly and violently into a specified position
items.ex_en: He thrust the glowing iron brand into the cold depths of the water basin.
items.ex_zh: 他猛然将烧红的烙铁塞进水盆冰冷的深处。

items.def_en: 1. To push or drive something forward or in a particular direction. 2. To force someone into a new situation or career.
items.ex_en: Powerful hydro jets propel the small exploration submarine through the ocean's abyssal depths.
items.ex_zh: 强劲的喷水推进器驱动着小型勘探潜艇穿梭于大洋深渊之中。

items.def_en: To cast or propel something through the air with immense physical force
items.ex_en: Furious protesters began to hurl heavy cobblestones at the retreating rows of riot police.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的抗议者开始将沉重的鹅卵石猛砸向正在后撤的防暴警察队伍。

items.def_en: To launch or suddenly propel someone or something into a prominent situation or prominent status
items.ex_en: Her breakout role in the indie drama will catapult her to international Hollywood stardom.
items.ex_zh: 她在该独立剧中的突破性角色将让她迅速跃升为好莱坞国际巨星。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe generating strong kinetic or directional force that pushes an object forward or catapults someone into a new role or state.
groups.summary_zh: 施加强劲前行动力推动物体，或促使某人跃升至新状态。
groups.desc_en: Entails imparting intense kinetic or systemic energy to launch an object or initiative forward, contrasting with gentle guiding, pulling, or gradual steering.
groups.desc_zh: 指施加强劲的动能或系统推动力使目标向前猛进或发射，区别于温和引导、牵引或平稳转向。
groups.nuance_en: drive: exert continuous, relentless operational force pushing forward (growth / engine / vehicle) · propel: supply mechanical or kinetic force that thrusts an object forward (rocket / boat / project) · thrust: push violently or suddenly in a direct vector (sword / hand / forward) · hurl: throw something heavy or hostile through the air with furious power (abuse / spear / rock) · catapult: launch suddenly and violently into a drastically elevated state (career / success / stardom)
groups.nuance_zh: drive: 提供持续不息的驱动力或推进力 (growth / engine / vehicle) · propel: 施加推进力驱动实体向前冲 (rocket / boat / project) · thrust: 突然且猛烈地朝前刺入或推进 (sword / hand / forward) · hurl: 夹带怒气或巨力将沉重之物掷出 (abuse / spear / rock) · catapult: 如弹射器般将某人猛推至更高阶段 (career / success / stardom)

groups.name: Droop & Loll · 萎蔫与耷拉 (Loll, Wilt, Flap)
groups.tip: 因重力萎靡向下耷拉

items.def_en: To dangle, droop, or extend loosely downward
items.ex_en: Tangled telephone wires hang down loosely over the narrow alley after the ferocious storm.
items.ex_zh: 猛烈的风暴过后，错综杂乱的电话线松松垮垮地垂挂在窄巷上方。

items.def_en: To droop, become weak, or lose vigor and firmness
items.ex_en: After hours of marching under the brutal sun, the soldiers' enthusiasm began to flag.
items.ex_zh: 在酷日下行军数小时后，战士们的高昂士气开始萎顿下去。

items.def_en: To become limp and bend toward the ground through lack of water or heat
items.ex_en: Without fresh water, the tender sunflower seedlings quickly began to wilt under the sun.
items.ex_zh: 缺乏清水的嫩向日葵幼苗在烈日暴晒下很快便蔫了下去。
items.ex2_en: The scorching afternoon heat wilted the delicate cut flowers on the porch.
items.ex2_zh: 午后灼热的暑气使门廊上娇嫩的鲜切花枯萎了。

items.def_en: To bend or hang downwards from weakness, tiredness, or lack of support; to decline or lose spirit.
items.ex_en: His tired shoulders began to droop visibly after enduring another exhausting twelve-hour warehouse shift.
items.ex_zh: 在经历又一个疲惫的十二小时仓库班次后，他疲倦的肩膀明显耷拉了下来。

items.def_en: To hang loosely, limp, or droop loosely down
items.ex_en: The hound let its wet tongue loll peacefully from its jaw during the heat.
items.ex_zh: 在酷暑中，猎犬任由湿漉漉的舌头从嘴边松弛地耷拉在外。

groups.summary_en: Centers on biological, organic, or limp entities that hang down limply due to fatigue, dehydration, wilt, or loss of vital tone. It contrasts with structural sagging by highlighting limp flaccidity and lifelessness.
groups.summary_zh: 指生命体或柔软织物因疲倦、脱水或无力而无精打采地耷拉。
groups.desc_en: Characterizes an organic or physical loss of turgor, vitality, or muscular tension resulting in downward sagging, distinct from deliberate, controlled lowering.
groups.desc_zh: 指有机体或物理结构因失去水分、生机或肌肉张力而呈现出疲软下垂的形态，区别于受控的主动降低。
groups.nuance_en: droop: sag downward under its own weight due to exhaustion or weakness (eyelids / branches / shoulders) · wilt: go limp and lose rigidity from dehydration or heat (plants / flowers / resolve) · loll: hang loosely and inertly in a slack, unbraced manner (tongue / head / limbs) · flag: decline conspicuously in energy, pace, or vigor (energy / spirits / interest) · hang down: orient downward vertically under simple gravity (hair / fabric / head)
groups.nuance_zh: droop: 因疲乏或虚弱失去支撑而耷拉下垂 (eyelids / branches / shoulders) · wilt: 因缺水、枯热而蔫头耷脑、意志瓦解 (plants / flowers / resolve) · loll: 软绵绵地无力耷拉或伸出 (tongue / head / limbs) · flag: 精力、速度或兴趣明显松懈走下坡路 (energy / spirits / interest) · hang down: 在单纯重力作用下自然下垂 (hair / fabric / head)

groups.name: Dry & Dehumidify · 干燥与除湿 (Desiccate, Dehydrate, Parch)
groups.tip: 抽取水分让环境变干燥

items.def_en: to become completely dry or remove all the liquid or moisture inside an object
items.ex_en: We must allow the damp timber to dry out completely before constructing the frame.
items.ex_zh: 在搭建框架之前，我们必须让潮湿的木料彻底风干透。
items.ex2_en: The hot dry wind dried out the wet laundry in thirty minutes.
items.ex2_zh: 干热的风在三十分钟内把湿衣服彻底吹干了。

items.def_en: to lose or extract water or moisture from food, the body, or a substance
items.ex_en: Hikers must consume electrolytes to avoid becoming severely dehydrated during long desert expeditions.
items.ex_zh: 徒步旅行者必须补充电解质，以避免在漫长的沙漠探险中严重脱水。
items.ex2_en: The scorching desert sun will dehydrate unprotected travelers within a single afternoon.
items.ex2_zh: 炎热的沙漠阳光会在一个下午之内使毫无防护的旅客脱水。

items.def_en: to remove moisture from the air or a space.
items.ex_en: Industrial facilities dehumidify their storage warehouses to prevent valuable electronics from suffering moisture damage.
items.ex_zh: 工业厂区为仓储车间进行除湿，以防贵重电子产品遭受潮气侵蚀损坏。

items.def_en: to make something extremely dry, especially through exposure to intense heat or sun
items.ex_en: The merciless summer sun threatened to parch the barren soil across the vast plains.
items.ex_zh: 无情的夏日骄阳无情地烤干了广袤平原上贫瘠龟裂的土地。

items.def_en: to remove all moisture thoroughly from something, leaving it completely dry and preserved
items.ex_en: Specialized laboratory equipment was employed to desiccate the botanical specimens for long-term archival preservation.
items.ex_zh: 专门的实验仪器被用来彻底干燥植物标本，以便进行长期的档案保存。
items.ex2_en: The delicate leaves desiccate rapidly under the harsh conditions of the desert.
items.ex2_zh: 娇嫩的叶片在恶劣的沙漠环境中迅速干瘪脱水。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers processes that extract moisture or humidity from air, biological matter, or objects, turning damp environments or substances thoroughly arid.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过物理、化学或机械方式去除空气、物质或物体中的湿气与水分。
groups.desc_en: Involves the extraction or depletion of moisture from a substance, ranging from controlled air conditioning to destructive total desiccation, unlike surface wiping.
groups.desc_zh: 指从物质中抽离或耗尽水分的过程，涵盖从人工除湿到破坏性完全干涸，区别于表面的擦拭擦干。
groups.nuance_en: dry out: gradually lose moisture until entirely dry (soil / timber / skin) · dehydrate: lose vital biological water or artificially preserve food by removing moisture (body / food / fruit) · dehumidify: extract moisture specifically from ambient air using equipment (room / basement / air) · parch: shrivel and scorch with extreme, unremitting heat (earth / throat / lips) · desiccate: drain all moisture until powdery, lifeless, or biologically inert (corpse / soil / tissues)
groups.nuance_zh: dry out: 逐渐失去水分直至干透 (soil / timber / skin) · dehydrate: 身体脱水，或人工脱水保存食物 (body / food / fruit) · dehumidify: 专门通过设备给环境空气除湿 (room / basement / air) · parch: 遭烈日或强热烘烤至皲裂焦干 (earth / throat / lips) · desiccate: 彻底榨干水分使其干枯风化 (corpse / soil / tissues)

groups.name: Duel & Contend · 决斗与交锋 (Clash, Grapple, Spar)
groups.tip: 双人约定决斗或短兵相接

items.def_zh: 实战切磋；你来我往争吵
items.def_en: (+ with) To engage in practice fighting or trade verbal barbs without serious injury
items.ex_en: The seasoned contenders like to spar with each other before every major televised debate.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的竞争对手喜欢在每场大型电视辩论前彼此言辞切磋一番。

items.def_en: (+ with) To engage in formal conflict, debate, or direct struggle with a rival
items.ex_en: The veteran barrister prepared to cross swords with the ambitious prosecutor over crucial evidence.
items.ex_zh: 资深出庭律师准备就关键证据与雄心勃勃的公诉人展开正式交锋。

items.def_en: (+ with) To engage in close hand-to-hand combat or wrestle physically
items.ex_en: The security guards had to grapple with the violent trespasser near the stage entrance.
items.ex_zh: 保安人员不得不在舞台入口附近与那名暴力的非法闯入者扭打纠缠。

items.def_en: (+ with) To engage in a short, violent fight or contentious confrontation
items.ex_en: Rioters continued to clash violently with armed police officers outside the municipal parliament building.
items.ex_zh: 闹事者继续在市政议会大楼外与武装警察发生激烈的暴力冲突。

items.def_en: (+ with) To fight a formal combat against another person, or to contend intensely with a rival.
items.ex_en: The two ambitious media moguls duel aggressively with each other for national market dominance.
items.ex_zh: 这两位野心勃勃的媒体大亨为了争夺全国市场的支配权展开了激烈较量。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers engaged combat, head-to-head showdowns, and competitive sparring between two opposing individuals or factions.
groups.summary_zh: 指单挑对决、狭路相逢或直接对抗交锋的动词群。
groups.desc_en: Describes direct, confrontational engagement between two or more opposing parties, ranging from formal combats to intellectual or physical skirmishing, distinct from organized group warfare.
groups.desc_zh: 指两个或多个对抗主体之间直接的针锋相对或交手试探，从殊死决斗到脑力/拳脚切磋，区别于大规模集团作战。
groups.nuance_en: duel: engage in formal or ritualized single combat with high stakes (opponents / politicians / masters) · spar: engage in non-fatal practice fighting or verbal banter (boxers / debaters / partners) · cross swords: come into deliberate combat or dispute with a worthy rival (opponents / lawyers / critics) · grapple: seize tightly in raw physical wrestling or wrestle mentally with difficulty (wrestlers / issues / conscience) · clash: collide sharply in violent, direct confrontation (rivals / opinions / forces)
groups.nuance_zh: duel: 赌上尊严或性命的正式决斗交锋 (opponents / politicians / masters) · spar: 练习性对练拳击或口头轻度抬杠试探 (boxers / debaters / partners) · cross swords: 与劲敌针锋相对地交锋交手 (opponents / lawyers / critics) · grapple: 近身扭打撕扯，或苦苦绞尽脑汁应对 (wrestlers / issues / conscience) · clash: 发生剧烈、硬碰硬的碰撞与冲突 (rivals / opinions / forces)

groups.name: Duplicate & Replicate · 复制与复印 (Photocopy, Duplicate, Replicate)
groups.tip: 照样抄写克隆翻印原件

items.def_zh: 复制，复印；抄写；抄袭，模仿
items.def_en: 1. To make a duplicate or reproduction of something written, printed, or recorded. 2. To imitate or mimic someone's actions, style, or work.
items.ex_en: Please ensure you copy the financial ledger accurately before archiving the paper originals today.
items.ex_zh: 请务必在今天归档纸质原件之前，准确地抄录下这份财务账簿。

items.def_en: To generate an identical technological or functional replica of something
items.ex_en: The digital artist managed to clone every nuance of the master's signature brushstroke technique.
items.ex_zh: 这位数码艺术家成功地完整复刻了大师标志性笔触技法的所有细微之处。

items.def_en: To make an exact facsimile or reproduce the precise characteristics of an original
items.ex_en: Researchers struggled for years to replicate the elusive experimental conditions observed in earlier trials.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员多年来一直难以在实验室中精确重现先前试验所观察到的微妙条件。
items.ex2_en: The harmless virus replicates rapidly within human respiratory tract cells.
items.ex2_zh: 这种无害病毒在人体呼吸道细胞内迅速自我复制。

items.def_en: To make an exact matching copy or duplicate replica of an existing item or file
items.ex_en: The clerk will duplicate the signed contractual documents before sending them to both parties.
items.ex_zh: 办事员将在把已签署的合同文件寄送给双方之前制作一份副本。

items.def_en: To produce a photographic paper reproduction of a document using a photocopier
items.ex_en: Could you photocopy these confidential audit reports for all board members attending the meeting?
items.ex_zh: 你能把这些机密审计报告复印给所有参会的董事会成员吗？

groups.summary_en: Emphasizes producing exact facsimiles, carbon copies, or photographic reproductions of documents, files, or objects. Collocates include document, certificate, key, transcript, and disk.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重对原件、文件或物品制作高度一致的副本或复印件。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on producing an exact, functional, or optical facsimile of an original item, code, or experimental result, contrasting with creative adaptation or mere approximation.
groups.desc_zh: 指对原件、遗传物质或实验结果进行精确、具功能性或光学的完全复制，区别于改编或近似模仿。
groups.nuance_en: copy: transcribe or generate a likeness of existing material (file / text / homework) · duplicate: produce an exact second instance for operational backup or parallel use (key / document / record) · replicate: repeat an entire experimental process or biological structure identically (experiment / study / findings) · clone: create an identical genetic or architectural double (organism / cell / software) · photocopy: reproduce documents optically via xerographic machinery (page / contract / passport)
groups.nuance_zh: copy: 抄录、照搬或制成现有资料的复件 (file / text / homework) · duplicate: 制作一模一样的第二份作备份或并用 (key / document / record) · replicate: 严格重现实验过程或生物分子复制 (experiment / study / findings) · clone: 克隆生物体或软硬件架构完全拷贝 (organism / cell / software) · photocopy: 用静电复印机光学复印纸质文件 (page / contract / passport)

groups.name: Dynamite & Demolish · 爆破拆除与炸平 (Blast, Blow, Demolish)
groups.tip: 炸药爆破夷为平地

items.def_en: To clear or remove rock, earth, or masonry by repeated controlled explosions
items.ex_en: Construction crews used explosives to blast away stubborn granite rock along the proposed highway.
items.ex_zh: 施工队使用炸药轰开了拟建高速公路沿线坚硬顽固的花岗岩岩层。

items.def_en: To destroy a bridge, building, or obstacle completely using explosive charges
items.ex_en: Retreating combat units had to blow up the historic stone bridge across the river.
items.ex_zh: 后撤的作战部队不得不炸毁横跨在这条河上的历史悠久的石桥。
items.ex2_en: The volatile chemical mixture blew up violently inside the underground testing facility.
items.ex2_zh: 不稳定的化学混合物在地下测试设施内剧烈爆炸。

items.def_en: To deliberately knock down or blow apart a building or large structure
items.ex_en: The municipality plans to demolish the abandoned textile factory using controlled explosive charges tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 市政当局计划明天使用定向爆破方式彻底拆除废弃的纺织工厂。

items.def_en: To strike and explode with a torpedo, or figuratively destroy a plan deliberately
items.ex_en: Leaked internal emails could completely torpedo our fragile negotiations with the overseas investment conglomerate.
items.ex_zh: 泄露的内部邮件可能会彻底破坏我们与这家海外跨国投资集团脆弱的谈判。

items.def_en: 1. To blow up, shatter, or destroy a rock, bridge, or structure using dynamite.
items.ex_en: Miners prepared to dynamite the limestone ridge to access rich mineral seams buried beneath.
items.ex_zh: 矿工们准备炸开石灰岩山脊，以开采埋藏在其下方的丰富矿脉。

groups.summary_en: Refers to intentionally shattering, blowing apart, or razing physical structures, geological features, or obstacles using high explosives or dynamite.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重使用特定炸药定向爆破开路、摧毁建筑或粉碎岩体。
groups.desc_en: Signifies the aggressive, structural destruction of buildings, structures, or strategic plans via high explosives or catastrophic disruption, contrasting with gentle dismantling.
groups.desc_zh: 指利用高能炸药或灾难性打击将建筑物、工事或战略构想彻底炸毁夷平，区别于温和的拆除解构。
groups.nuance_en: blow up: shatter or rupture into pieces by explosive detonation (bridge / building / balloon) · blast away: shatter, erode, or remove violently through concentrated explosive force (rock / debris / wall) · dynamite: deliberately blow apart using nitroglycerin charges (mine / dam / boulder) · demolish: mechanically or explosively tear down an entire structure to rubble (building / stadium / myth) · torpedo: destroy underwater with a projectile, or metaphorically sink a plan completely (ship / legislation / deal)
groups.nuance_zh: blow up: 引起爆炸将其炸碎或炸飞 (bridge / building / balloon) · blast away: 用集中爆破力轰碎或强行炸除 (rock / debris / wall) · dynamite: 特指用黄色炸药进行爆破拆毁 (mine / dam / boulder) · demolish: 将整个建筑彻底摧毁夷为平地 (building / stadium / myth) · torpedo: 用鱼雷击沉，或喻彻底毁掉协议提案 (ship / legislation / deal)

groups.name: Eavesdrop & Wiretap · 偷听与窃听 (Eavesdrop, Bug, Tap)
groups.tip: 私下越界窃听他人谈话

items.def_en: (+ on) Secretly eavesdrop on someone's telephone line or live conversation
items.ex_en: The nosy clerk was caught trying to listen in on the board's private conversation.
items.ex_zh: 那个爱管闲事的职员在企图偷听董事会私密谈话时被当场抓住。

items.def_en: Secretly connect a listening device to a telephone line to monitor calls
items.ex_en: Federal agents obtained a warrant to tap the suspected syndicate boss's private landline phone.
items.ex_zh: 联邦探员获得了搜查令，用以搭线窃听嫌疑辛迪加头目的私人座机电话。

items.def_en: (+ on) Secretly listen to a conversation that one is not intended or invited to hear
items.ex_en: She leaned close against the wooden partition to eavesdrop on her colleagues' secret conversation.
items.ex_zh: 她紧贴着木隔板，试图偷听同事们之间的秘密交谈。

items.def_en: Conceal a miniature listening device or microphone in a room or device to record conversations
items.ex_en: Undercover operatives managed to bug the ambassador's secure meeting room using a miniature transmitter.
items.ex_zh: 卧底特工设法利用微型发射器在大使的安全会议室里安装了窃听器。

items.def_zh: 搭线窃听，在……上装窃听器
items.def_en: To secretly connect a listening device to a telephone or communication line in order to listen to private conversations.
items.ex_en: Investigators obtained emergency legal authorization to wiretap the criminal syndicate's primary communication network.
items.ex_zh: 调查人员获得了紧急法律授权，搭线窃听该犯罪团伙的主要通信网络。

groups.summary_en: Centers on intentionally and surreptitiously intercepting or listening to private spoken conversations, whether through proximity and listening ears or electronic surveillance devices.
groups.summary_zh: 指出于隐秘动机，在旁偷听或利用电子设备窃听私人谈话。
groups.desc_en: Involves covert, uninvited acoustic or electronic monitoring of private communications, contrasting with open, transparent listening.
groups.desc_zh: 指在未获授权的情况下，秘密通过声学或电子手段监听他人私密通讯，区别于公开透明的倾听。
groups.nuance_en: eavesdrop: surreptitiously listen to others' nearby spoken private conversations (conversation / neighbors / dialogue) · listen in: quietly tune into an ongoing call or discussion without speaking (meeting / phone call / transmission) · tap: attach a physical interception device to a wired communications line (phone / line / wire) · wiretap: intercept telephone or internet communications under legal or covert operations (phone / suspects / room) · bug: plant hidden electronic micro-transmitters in an interior space (room / office / hotel)
groups.nuance_zh: eavesdrop: 在近处偷听他人现场私密谈话 (conversation / neighbors / dialogue) · listen in: 旁听或静默接入正在进行的通话讨论 (meeting / phone call / transmission) · tap: 在物理线路上搭接设备进行搭线窃听 (phone / line / wire) · wiretap: 司法侦查或间谍活动中的电话/网络监听 (phone / suspects / room) · bug: 在室内空间暗中安置微型窃听器 (room / office / hotel)

groups.name: Ebb & Wane · 衰退与消退 (Wane, Dwindle, Peter out, Subside)
groups.tip: 如潮水般退去与减弱

items.def_en: to diminish gradually and come to an end in an unremarkable, sputtering way
items.ex_en: The noisy public protests began to peter out as cold winter rain started falling.
items.ex_zh: 随着冰冷的冬雨落下，喧闹的公众抗议活动开始逐渐平息消散。

items.def_en: to become calmer, quieter, or less fierce after an intense outburst
items.ex_en: The patient's violent fever began to subside after the medical team administered strong antibiotics.
items.ex_zh: 在医疗团队注射了强效抗生素后，患者的剧烈高烧开始逐渐消退。

items.def_en: (often ebb away) to flow back toward the sea, as the tide; to gradually decrease, weaken, or decline
items.ex_en: The old monarch felt his earthly strength ebb away as the long night deepened.
items.ex_zh: 随着漫漫长夜渐深，老君王感到自己在人世的生命力正在悄然衰退。

items.def_en: to become gradually weaker, less significant, or less prominent over time
items.ex_en: Public enthusiasm for the prolonged imperial campaign began to wane after several costly defeats.
items.ex_zh: 在经历数次代价惨重的败仗之后，公众对这场旷日持久的帝国远征的热情开始式微。

items.def_en: to steadily shrink in size, amount, or strength until very little remains
items.ex_en: The town's emergency drinking supplies will dwindle rapidly unless substantial rainfall arrives this week.
items.ex_zh: 除非本周降下大雨，否则该城镇的应急饮用水储备将迅速缩减殆尽。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses gradual, progressive losses of strength, intensity, volume, or momentum, typically likened to tides, moon phases, or energy flows.
groups.summary_zh: 指强度、力量、激情或数量如潮水退落般逐渐减弱、凋零或减退至微弱状态。
groups.desc_en: Depicts a natural, progressive diminishment in intensity, strength, tide, or volume toward complete cessation, distinct from abrupt cessation.
groups.desc_zh: 指某种强度、力量、潮水或数量呈现出自然、渐进式的由盛转衰或直至止息，区别于突然中断。
groups.nuance_en: ebb: recede smoothly like an outgoing tide; decline from a high watermark (tide / enthusiasm / strength) · wane: diminish progressively in brightness, phase, or authoritative power (moon / influence / power) · dwindle: shrink gradually in quantity, headcount, or reserves down to almost nothing (numbers / savings / supplies) · subside: settle downward to a calm level after peaking (storm / swelling / anger) · peter out: gradually dwindle and sputter out to an anti-climactic stop (trail / conversation / momentum)
groups.nuance_zh: ebb: 如潮水般退落，从巅峰自然衰减 (tide / enthusiasm / strength) · wane: 如月亏般光泽渐暗，或权威势力逐渐衰退 (moon / influence / power) · dwindle: 存量、数量或储蓄缩水至所剩无几 (numbers / savings / supplies) · subside: 暴风雨或肿痛等在达顶峰后平息消退 (storm / swelling / anger) · peter out: 势头微弱地断断续续收场直至枯竭 (trail / conversation / momentum)

groups.name: Eclipse & Outshine in Prominence · 掩盖与盖过风头 (Outshine, Eclipse, Overshadow)
groups.tip: 光芒盖过同类显得更出众

items.def_en: To win praise or attention away from someone else by preempting their achievements or speech
items.ex_en: He casually announced their merger ahead of schedule, completely stealing his rival partner's thunder.
items.ex_zh: 他提前随口宣布了合并的消息，完全抢了竞争对手兼搭档的风头。

items.def_en: To cause someone or something to seem less important or successful because of one's presence
items.ex_en: Her sensational courtroom testimony managed to overshadow all other news reports throughout the week.
items.ex_zh: 她在法庭上的轰动证言彻底使整个星期里的所有其他新闻报道相形见绌。

items.def_en: To deprive someone or something of significance, power, or prominence by greater achievement
items.ex_en: The prodigy's breathtaking debut performance managed to eclipse the achievements of all seasoned masters.
items.ex_zh: 这位神童惊艳的首次亮相使得所有经验丰富的大师们的成就都相形见绌。

items.def_zh: 使显得矮小；使相形见绌
items.def_en: To cause something to seem negligible or small in size or significance by comparison
items.ex_en: The gargantuan new container vessel seemed to dwarf all other cargo ships harbored nearby.
items.ex_zh: 这艘巨大的新型集装箱货轮让停泊在附近的其它所有货船都显得相形见绌。

items.def_zh: 胜过，比……更出色；使相形见绌；比……发光更亮
items.def_en: 1. To be much better, more impressive, or more successful than someone or something else. 2. To shine more brightly than.
items.ex_en: Her brilliant soprano vocals managed to outshine all other chorus singers during tonight's performance.
items.ex_zh: 在今晚的演出中，她那绝妙的女高音演唱完全盖过了所有其他合唱歌手。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here signify surpassing someone or something so brilliantly that the lesser entity is obscured, diminished, or rendered completely insignificant by comparison.
groups.summary_zh: 以超群的光彩或卓越成就使他者黯然失色被遮蔽。
groups.desc_en: Describes one entity drastically outclassing, obscuring, or casting a shadow over another’s brilliance or prominence, contrasting with equal, balanced co-existence.
groups.desc_zh: 指某一主体以其压倒性的光彩、体量或表现完全遮蔽另一方并抢占风头，区别于平分秋色的并存。
groups.nuance_en: outshine: be conspicuously superior in brilliance, skill, or excellence (peers / rivals / stars) · overshadow: cast an oppressive or somber pall over an achievement or occasion (success / event / career) · eclipse: utterly surpass, render obsolete, or block the light of another (achievements / predecessor / legacy) · dwarf: make another appear insignificantly tiny by comparative magnitude (competitors / buildings / numbers) · steal someone's thunder: preemptively usurp another's attention, idea, or planned spotlight (announcement / idea / show)
groups.nuance_zh: outshine: 表现或才智明显更出类拔萃而令其相形见绌 (peers / rivals / stars) · overshadow: 为喜悦或成就蒙上一层压抑阴影 (success / event / career) · eclipse: 彻底超越并遮蔽前任的光辉使其黯然失色 (achievements / predecessor / legacy) · dwarf: 在体量或规模上将对比方衬得渺小微不足道 (competitors / buildings / numbers) · steal someone's thunder: 抢先一步抢占他人的风头或创意成果 (announcement / idea / show)

groups.name: Economize & Conserve · 节约与善用 (Economize, Conserve, Steward)
groups.tip: 精打细算勤俭持家

items.def_en: to consume a drink or conserve a resource slowly and carefully to make it last
items.ex_en: The thirsty traveler had to nurse his remaining canteen water throughout the desert journey.
items.ex_zh: 口渴的行者在穿越沙漠的漫长旅途中，只能慢慢省着喝水壶里仅剩的水。

items.def_en: to protect something from harm, destruction, or wasteful overuse
items.ex_en: Arid regions must carefully conserve their precious freshwater resources through advanced irrigation technology.
items.ex_zh: 干旱地区必须通过先进的灌溉技术，极其审慎地保护并节约其珍贵的淡水资源。

items.def_en: (+ on) to reduce expenses or use resources more carefully and avoid waste
items.ex_en: The municipal council must economize on public utilities to prevent an imminent fiscal deficit.
items.ex_zh: 市议会必须节约市政公用事业开支，以防止迫在眉睫的财政赤字。

items.def_zh: 精心照管，审慎管理（资源或财务）
items.def_en: to supervise, manage, or look after properties, finances, or natural resources responsibly
items.ex_en: The newly appointed board resolved to steward the university endowment funds with utmost prudence.
items.ex_zh: 新任命的董事会决心以极大的审慎来管理大学捐赠基金。

items.def_zh: 节约使用，勤俭管理（资源）
items.def_en: to manage and conserve resources, money, or energy carefully and economically
items.ex_en: The beleaguered garrison had to husband their meager water supplies through the scorching summer.
items.ex_zh: 被围困的守军不得不勤俭节省微薄的水源储备，以度过炎炎夏日。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on managing, conserving, and stretching limited resources, energy, or funds carefully and prudently to avoid waste. Unlike stingy withholding, it highlights thoughtful administration and sustainability.
groups.summary_zh: 强调审慎、精明地管理与调度物资、能源或金钱以杜绝浪费。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the disciplined, strategic management and preservation of limited resources to prevent depletion, contrasting with passive non-use or mere miserly hoarding.
groups.desc_zh: 指对有限资源进行有计划、负责任的节约与合理统筹，区别于消极不用或一毛不拔的守财奴行为。
groups.nuance_en: conserve: to protect from depletion or environmental waste (energy / water / resources) · economize: to cut down on expenditure or reduce operational cost (fuel / costs / budget) · steward: to responsibly manage assets entrusted to one's care (assets / land / environment) · husband: to manage cautiously and prudently to make supplies last (resources / strength / funds) · nurse: to consume or expend slowly and sparingly (drink / battery / lead)
groups.nuance_zh: conserve: 防止耗竭或保护生态资源 (energy / water / resources) · economize: 削减开销或精打细算节约成本 (fuel / costs / budget) · steward: 作为受托人负责任地统筹善用 (assets / land / environment) · husband: 极为审慎节约地调度调配以求长久 (resources / strength / funds) · nurse: 极其吝惜地慢慢消耗或维系 (drink / battery / lead)

groups.name: Economize & Scrimp · 节约与省吃俭用 (Pinch, Pinch pennies, Economize)
groups.tip: 极力压缩开支精打细算

items.def_en: (+ on) to reduce expenses and use money or resources more carefully
items.ex_en: The department was instructed to economize on administrative expenditures during the coming fiscal year.
items.ex_zh: 该部门接到了在下一财政年度节约行政支出的指示。

items.def_en: to be extremely careful with every small amount of money one spends
items.ex_en: My grandparents had to pinch pennies for years just to afford their small suburban cottage.
items.ex_zh: 我的祖父母省吃俭用了好些年，才买得起郊区的那所小农舍。

items.def_en: to spend much less money and endure austerity because of financial hardship
items.ex_en: After Dad lost his job, the entire family had to tighten their belts considerably.
items.ex_zh: 父亲失业之后，全家人都不得不大大勒紧裤腰带度日。

items.def_en: (+ on) to spend very little money and live extremely frugally, often doing without necessities to save
items.ex_en: They had to scrimp on groceries each week to pay off their mountain of debt.
items.ex_zh: 为了还清堆积如山的债务，他们每周都不得不在买菜上过度克扣节省。

items.def_en: to manage to live with just barely enough food or money to survive
items.ex_en: During college, I managed to scrape by on instant noodles and casual tutoring gigs.
items.ex_zh: 大学期间，我靠着吃方便面和打零工做家教勉强度日。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame characterize an extreme, defensive frugality where an individual drastically curtails living expenses, endure privation, or cut everyday necessities to make ends meet or hoard savings.
groups.summary_zh: 强调节衣缩食、克扣日常开支以求省钱度日。
groups.desc_en: Denotes austere personal deprivation and extreme cost-cutting driven by financial hardship or parsimony, contrasting with broad institutional conservation.
groups.desc_zh: 指因生计所迫或过度吝啬而勒紧裤带、省吃俭用的极端节缩行为，区别于宏观层面的科学资源节约。
groups.nuance_en: scrimp: to severely cut necessities and live austerely (on food / on essentials) · pinch pennies: to obsessively withhold even trivial sums out of extreme parsimony (budget / savings) · tighten one's belt: to adopt collective or personal austerity in lean times (spending / budget) · scrape by: to barely survive or manage financially with minimal means (living / income) · economize: to systematically reduce everyday expenses (household budget / groceries)
groups.nuance_zh: scrimp: 在基本生活需求上极度克扣缩减 (on food / on essentials) · pinch pennies: 对微小钱财过分锱铢必较 (budget / savings) · tighten one's belt: 在经济拮据时勒紧裤腰带度日 (spending / budget) · scrape by: 勉强度日或仅能糊口 (living / income) · economize: 系统性地削减日常各项花销 (household budget / groceries)

groups.name: Edge-Finishing & Stropping · 荡刀与精细开刃 (Strop, Hone, Whetting)
groups.tip: 在皮条上荡刀使其磨快锋利

items.def_zh: 微调修磨；给（刀刃）快速补磨
items.def_en: To give a knife or tool edge a brief, light sharpening or realignment to restore peak keenness
items.ex_en: She spent a few minutes touching up her makeup before the live broadcast.
items.ex_zh: 在直播开始前，她花了几分钟补了补妆。

items.def_zh: 用磨刀棒给…正刃；在磨刀棒上修整
items.def_en: To realign the edge of a kitchen knife by drawing it along a butcher's honing steel
items.ex_en: The master butcher steeled his slicing knife with practiced rhythm before dressing the carcass.
items.ex_zh: 屠宰大师在处理牲畜胴体前，以熟练的节奏在磨刀棒上修整切肉刀刃。

items.def_en: To sharpen a straight razor by stroking its blade along a leather strap.
items.ex_en: The barber stropped his open razor against the hanging leather until it glinted cleanly.
items.ex_zh: 理发师在悬挂的皮条上荡磨他的折叠剃刀，直到刀刃泛出明亮的光泽。

items.def_en: To finish or polish a blade back or joint to extreme flatness and mirror smoothness using a fine abrasive paste
items.ex_en: The craftsman carefully lapped the chisel back against the diamond paste for optimal precision.
items.ex_zh: 工匠用金刚石研磨膏仔细精研凿子背面，以达到最佳的平整精度。

items.def_en: To remove the rough, ragged edge or tiny raised ridge left on a piece of metal after cutting or sharpening
items.ex_en: He deburred the freshly machined iron bracket until the seam yielded a soft silhouette.
items.ex_zh: 他修平了刚加工完成的铁支架上的毛刺，直至边缘显出柔和的轮廓。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on the meticulous, micro-level mechanical alignment or finishing of an already-formed cutting edge using straps, fine stones, or steels. Contrasts with bulk sharpening by emphasizing delicate edge realigning and deburring rather than heavy stock removal.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重在刃口成型后通过皮条、荡刀布等进行精细修整、去毛刺与微观校正。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the ultra-fine finishing, alignment, or realigning of a blade's micro-edge, contrasting with coarse material removal like grinding or sharpening.
groups.desc_zh: 指对刀刃微观边缘进行极细微的抛光、顺直或毛刺清除，区别于大量去除金属的粗磨或开刃。
groups.nuance_en: strop: to polish and align an edge on leather or canvas (razor / chisel / blade) · steel: to realign a folded edge using a hard steel rod without removing metal (knife / blade) · lap: to polish flat surfaces to extreme precision using fine abrasive slurries (valve / stone / mirror) · deburr: to remove unwanted rough edges left from machining (edge / pipe / metal) · touch up: to quickly dress or restore a slightly dulled edge (blade / finish / bevel)
groups.nuance_zh: strop: 在皮条或帆布上荡刀抛光与顺直刀口 (razor / chisel / blade) · steel: 用磨刀棒微调对齐卷曲刀刃而不磨削金属 (knife / blade) · lap: 用研磨剂对接触面进行高精度研磨抛光 (valve / stone / mirror) · deburr: 机械加工后去除边缘残留的毛刺 (edge / pipe / metal) · touch up: 快速对微钝刃口进行微调修复 (blade / finish / bevel)

groups.name: Edify & Enlighten · 启迪与教化 (Edify, Enlighten, Elevate)
groups.tip: 启迪心智并给予道德思想教化

items.def_en: To develop or improve a skill, quality, or person through sustained educational guidance
items.ex_en: The academy seeks to cultivate intellectual rigor and critical discernment in its young scholars.
items.ex_zh: 该学院旨在通过持续引导，在青年学者中培养严谨的治学精神与批判性鉴别力。

items.def_en: To make something clear and simple to understand, or to mentally enrich and enlighten someone
items.ex_en: The professor's brilliant lecture helped illuminate the arcane principles of constitutional jurisprudence.
items.ex_zh: 教授精彩的演讲阐明了宪政法学中晦涩难懂的法理。

items.def_en: To give someone greater knowledge, understanding, or insight about a subject or truth
items.ex_en: A series of public seminars sought to enlighten voters on the complex constitutional amendment.
items.ex_zh: 一系列公开研讨会旨在就复杂的宪法修正案启发选民的认知。

items.def_en: To elevate someone's moral, cultural, or spiritual feelings and bring inspiration
items.ex_en: The choral performance was designed to uplift the solemn spirits of the mourners.
items.ex_zh: 这场合唱演出的目的在于提升哀悼者的崇高心绪并带来精神慰藉。

items.def_zh: 教化，启迪，启发（道德或心智）
items.def_en: (formal) To instruct, improve, or enlighten someone morally, intellectually, or spiritually
items.ex_en: The venerable abbot composed philosophical treatises intended to edify novitiates in theological virtue.
items.ex_zh: 德高望重的修道院长撰写了哲学论文，旨在教化初学修士的神学美德。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this formal frame describe uplifting someone mentally, culturally, or morally through virtuous instruction and intellectual enrichment.
groups.summary_zh: 强调在道德、心智或精神层面给予启迪教化与升华。
groups.desc_en: Denotes cultivating, morally uplifting, or intellectually clarifying another mind, contrasting with mere neutral instruction or mechanical rote training.
groups.desc_zh: 指在道德、心智或灵魂层面给予熏陶、教化与启迪，区别于中立的知识灌输或机械训练。
groups.nuance_en: edify: to morally or spiritually elevate and instruct (public / readers / congregation) · enlighten: to free from ignorance or provide clear intellectual understanding (mind / populace / audience) · illuminate: to cast bright explanatory light on complex or obscure truths (issue / passage / subject) · uplift: to spiritually or emotionally elevate the spirits (soul / mood / community) · cultivate: to foster refined tastes and intellectual capacity through deliberate nurture (mind / talent / sensibilities)
groups.nuance_zh: edify: 在道德或灵性上进行熏陶教化 (public / readers / congregation) · enlighten: 破除蒙昧或开启心智使其洞悉事理 (mind / populace / audience) · illuminate: 阐发照亮晦涩复杂的难题与义理 (issue / passage / subject) · uplift: 提振人的精神、灵魂或情绪境界 (soul / mood / community) · cultivate: 有意培植熏陶心智与品位审美 (mind / talent / sensibilities)

groups.name: Electoral District Manipulation · 选区划分与选举操纵 (Redistrict, Gerrymander, Stack)
groups.tip: 不公划分选区以操纵选举

items.def_en: Divide or organize an area into new political or legislative districts
items.ex_en: The state legislature voted to redistrict the metropolitan counties ahead of next year's elections.
items.ex_zh: 州立法机构投票决定在明年的大选前重新划分大都会郡的选区。

items.def_zh: 密集塞入（使反对派集中于个别选区以削弱其席位）
items.def_en: Concentrate voters of one category into a single district to diminish their influence elsewhere
items.ex_en: Strategists conspired to pack opposition supporters into a solitary district to neutralize their power.
items.ex_zh: 战略顾问密谋将反对派支持者密集塞入单一选区，以抵消其实力。

items.def_zh: 拆分拆散（把某一投票群体瓜分进多个选区）
items.def_en: Spread voters of an opposing party thinly across multiple districts to dilute their voting power
items.ex_en: The ruling party managed to crack the urban progressive vote across five rural districts.
items.ex_zh: 执政党成功将城市进步派选票拆分散落进五个农村选区之中。

items.def_zh: 安排亲信把持，人为安插倾斜（委员会或选区结构）
items.def_en: Arrange a committee, district, or panel unfairly to guarantee a desired partisan advantage
items.ex_en: Lawmakers tried to stack the electoral committee to guarantee an outright legislative majority.
items.ex_zh: 议员们企图人为安插倾斜选区委员会，以确保获得绝对的立法席位多数。
items.ex2_en: These plastic storage boxes stack neatly inside the small closet.
items.ex2_zh: 这些塑料收纳盒可以整齐地堆叠在小壁橱里。

items.def_zh: 不公正地划分选区（以利于某政党）
items.def_en: 1. To unfairly redraw the boundaries of voting districts to give one political party an advantage.
items.ex_en: Partisan operatives attempted to gerrymander the congressional map to safeguard their vulnerable incumbents.
items.ex_zh: 党派操盘手试图不公正地重划国会选区图，以保护地位不稳的现任议员。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the administrative, structural, or boundary manipulations within electoral and institutional systems designed to systematically dilute or bolster specific voting blocs.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过重划边界或行政洗牌，系统性谋取选区或政治代表权优势。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the deliberate manipulation of electoral boundaries to confer unfair partisan advantage, contrasting with neutral census-based re-apportionment.
groups.desc_zh: 指为了特定党派私利而操纵重划选区边界的政治作弊行为，区别于中立合法的人口普查区划。
groups.nuance_en: gerrymander: to redraw political district boundaries unfairly for partisan advantage (district / map / state) · pack: to concentrate opposition voters densely into as few districts as possible (voters / district / electorate) · crack: to dilute opposition voting strength across multiple districts (bloc / minority vote / communities) · stack: to assemble advantageous voter demographics within a single created district (district / boundaries) · redistrict: to formally redraw legislative boundaries, legitimate or manipulated (state / city / wards)
groups.nuance_zh: gerrymander: 不公地恶意重划选区以谋取党派私利 (district / map / state) · pack: 将对手选民高度集中塞入极少数选区以消耗其票源 (voters / district / electorate) · crack: 将对手选民打散稀释到多个选区使其无法形成多数 (bloc / minority vote / communities) · stack: 拼凑利己选民组合以构建铁票选区 (district / boundaries) · redistrict: 重新划分立法选区边界（中性或具操纵性） (state / city / wards)

groups.name: Electroplate & Coat Metal · 金属电镀与表面硬化 (Plate, Galvanize, Anodize)
groups.tip: 给物体外层镀膜或覆盖

items.def_en: To cover a metal object with a thin coating of precious or protective metal
items.ex_en: The silversmith will plate the brass chalice with a lustrous layer of pure gold.
items.ex_zh: 银匠将在黄铜圣杯上镀上一层富有光泽的纯金。

items.def_en: 1. To coat a metal or other object with a shiny protective layer of chromium.
items.ex_en: Custom motorcycle shops frequently chrome vintage exhaust pipes to maximize durability and high gloss.
items.ex_zh: 定制摩托车店经常给老式排气管镀铬，以最大程度提升耐用度和高光泽感。

items.def_en: To coat iron or steel with a protective layer of molten zinc to prevent rusting
items.ex_en: Engineers specified that all outdoor structural beams must be galvanized against rust and weathering.
items.ex_zh: 工程师规定所有室外结构梁都必须镀锌以防锈蚀和风化。

items.def_en: To coat an object with a thin layer of metal by electrolytic deposition
items.ex_en: The artisan used galvanic currents to electroplate the delicate brooch in shimmering pale silver.
items.ex_zh: 工匠利用电流将这枚精致的胸针电镀上一层泛着微光的浅银色。

items.def_en: To coat a metal (especially aluminum) with a protective or decorative oxide layer by an electrolytic process
items.ex_en: Specialists anodize the aircraft components to resist salt spray in the corrosive ocean air.
items.ex_zh: 专家对飞机部件进行阳极氧化处理，以抵御腐蚀性海洋空气中的盐雾。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to applying a thin metallic layer or chemical finish onto a base material to guard against corrosion, enhance hardness, or provide a decorative finish. They center on industrial and metallurgical surface treatments.
groups.summary_zh: 指在金属表面施加化学或电镀保护层以防锈、硬化或装饰。
groups.desc_en: Denotes applying a functional, protective, or decorative metal coating onto a substrate via electrochemical or thermal processes, contrasting with simple liquid painting.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过电化学、热浸或氧化等工艺在工件表面覆覆金属膜层以实现防腐或强化，区别于普通的表面喷漆。
groups.nuance_en: electroplate: to deposit a thin coherent metal coating via electrolysis (copper / silver / nickel) · plate: to coat an object with a thin outer layer of metal (gold / silver / alloy) · galvanize: to coat iron or steel with protective zinc, often via hot-dipping (steel / sheet / nail) · anodize: to electrolytically form a durable, corrosion-resistant oxide layer on light metals (aluminum / titanium / casing) · chrome: to plate a surface with chromium for hardness, gloss, or wear resistance (bumper / fitting / trim)
groups.nuance_zh: electroplate: 通过电解作用在表面沉积一层致密金属 (copper / silver / nickel) · plate: 在物件表面镀覆一层薄金属膜 (gold / silver / alloy) · galvanize: 采用热浸等方式给钢铁镀锌防锈 (steel / sheet / nail) · anodize: 对轻金属进行阳极氧化以形成致密抗磨氧化层 (aluminum / titanium / casing) · chrome: 镀硬铬或装饰铬以提升硬度与反光光泽 (bumper / fitting / trim)

groups.name: Elevate & Ennoble · 册封、擢升与晋爵 (Elevate, Knight, Exalt)
groups.tip: 提升社会阶层或受封贵族

items.def_en: To promote someone to an ecclesiastical, administrative, or noble office of distinction
items.ex_en: The monarch chose to prefer the modest canon to the influential bishopric of York.
items.ex_zh: 君主决定将这位谦和的教士正式擢升至极具影响力的约克教区主教职位。

items.def_en: To confer the formal rank of knighthood upon a person as an official royal honor
items.ex_en: The King decided to knight the distinguished surgeon for his lifelong contributions to medicine.
items.ex_zh: 国王决定授予这位杰出外科医生爵士勋位，以表彰他对医学的终身贡献。

items.def_en: To raise someone to a higher rank, superior social status, or more important post
items.ex_en: The prime minister announced plans to elevate the competent diplomat to the foreign ministry.
items.ex_zh: 首相宣布计划提拔这位能干的外交官进入外交部担任要职。

items.def_en: To raise someone to a very high rank, position, or standard of dignity
items.ex_en: Ancient chroniclers sought to exalt their conquerors to the realm of immortal demigods.
items.ex_zh: 古代编年史家极力推崇他们的征服者，将他们的地位拔高至不朽半神的境地。

items.def_zh: 封……为贵族，授予爵位；使高贵，使崇高
items.def_en: 1. To give someone a noble title, making them a member of the nobility. 2. To make someone or something finer, more noble, or more worthy of respect.
items.ex_en: Selfless sacrifice can ennoble even the most humble individual in the eyes of humanity.
items.ex_zh: 无私的牺牲即便在世人眼中也能使最微卑的人变得崇高尊贵。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate raising someone to a superior aristocratic rank, high public office, or elevated moral and spiritual standing. They convey institutional authority, formal investiture, or profound honoring.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过权威赐予贵族爵位、大幅擢升社会地位，或使品格与声望极大升华。
groups.desc_en: Denotes formally conferring aristocratic, chivalric, or official preeminence upon a person, contrasting with mere operational promotion within a mundane job.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过主权者或权威机构正式册封贵族爵位、骑士勋位或提升门第，区别于日常职场的普通升迁。
groups.nuance_en: ennoble: to formally raise someone to noble or aristocratic rank (citizen / family / subject) · knight: to confer knighthood upon someone with ceremonial dubbing (actor / scientist / civil servant) · elevate: to formally raise to a higher institutional or social dignity (status / peer / cardinal) · exalt: to glorify or place in an exceptionally high station or honor (ruler / position / hero) · prefer: to advance or promote an ecclesiastic or courtier to high ecclesiastical preferment (cleric / candidate)
groups.nuance_zh: ennoble: 封赐贵族爵位或提升社会门第 (citizen / family / subject) · knight: 举行册封仪式授予骑士勋位 (actor / scientist / civil servant) · elevate: 正式擢升至极高贵的名分或阶位 (status / peer / cardinal) · exalt: 拔擢推崇至显赫荣耀之位 (ruler / position / hero) · prefer: 拔擢神职人员或廷臣至显要教职 (cleric / candidate)

groups.name: Elevate to Saintly or Supreme Status · 册封与神化 (Deify, Enshrine, Idolize)
groups.tip: 官方赞许并给以极高声誉

items.def_en: to treat someone as a celebrated person or public hero with widespread public praise
items.ex_en: The international press began to lionize the young activist after her impassioned speech.
items.ex_zh: 在年轻活动家发表慷慨激昂的演说后，国际媒体开始将她奉为公众偶像并大加追捧。

items.def_en: to place, preserve, or revere someone or something as sacred or inviolable, especially in cultural memory or law
items.ex_en: The foundational principles of individual freedom are enshrined within the nation's historic constitution.
items.ex_zh: 个人自由的基本原则被郑重载入并珍藏在该国具有历史意义的宪法中。

items.def_en: to admire, revere, or love someone or something excessively or uncritically
items.ex_en: Adolescents around the world idolize the pop star despite his well-publicized personal controversies.
items.ex_zh: 尽管该流行歌星个人争议频出，全球各地的青少年依然将他奉为偶像极度崇拜。

items.def_zh: 封为圣徒；推崇，尊崇，奉为权威
items.def_en: 1. (religion) to officially declare a deceased person to be a saint. 2. to regard or accept someone or their work as authoritative, classic, or sacred.
items.ex_en: Critics rushed to canonize the reclusive novelist's debut masterpiece as the century's defining work.
items.ex_zh: 评论家们争相将这位隐居小说家的处女作奉为权威，称其为定义本世纪的巨作。

items.def_en: to worship or treat someone or something as a god or supreme being
items.ex_en: Fanatical followers deify their political leaders, refusing to acknowledge any human error or flaw.
items.ex_zh: 狂热的追随者将他们的政党领袖奉若神明，拒绝承认其犯下的任何人为过错。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe elevating someone or their achievements to sacred, unassailable, or revered historical status, whether formally in religion or metaphorically in cultural memory.
groups.summary_zh: 指将人或事物提升至神圣、崇高或不可动摇的殿堂地位。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the religious, institutional, or uncritical cultural elevation of an entity to sacred, infallible, or godlike stature, contrasting with ordinary respect.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过宗教仪式或狂热崇拜将凡人、事物升格为神圣、无上或绝不可侵犯的存在，区别于普通尊重。
groups.nuance_en: deify: to formally or conceptually transform someone into a god (ruler / emperor / hero) · canonize: to declare an individual officially a saint, or treat as canonical (saint / writer / text) · enshrine: to protect, cherish, and set apart as holy or inviolable (right / principle / memory) · idolize: to admire or venerate with blind, uncritical devotion (star / leader / parent) · lionize: to treat an individual as an extraordinary celebrity in public life (author / visitor / champion)
groups.nuance_zh: deify: 奉为神祇或神化崇敬 (ruler / emperor / hero) · canonize: 册封为圣徒或确立为无可争议的经典权威 (saint / writer / text) · enshrine: 奉若神明并作为神圣不可动摇之原则加以珍藏 (right / principle / memory) · idolize: 盲目崇拜或偶像化爱慕 (star / leader / parent) · lionize: 将某人捧为大名人或公众焦点予以奉承 (author / visitor / champion)

groups.name: Elicit & Draw Out · 诱导与引出 (Elicit, Evoke, Extract)
groups.tip: 启发引导从而诱发反应

items.def_zh: 设法索取，强行引出（真相、认罪等）
items.def_en: To obtain information, money, or a confession from someone with difficulty or pressure
items.ex_en: The interrogators exerted severe psychological pressure to extract a complete confession from the captive.
items.ex_zh: 审讯人员施加了巨大的心理压力，以从俘虏口中强行引出完整的招供。

items.def_zh: 启发…开口，诱引出（信息或想法）
items.def_en: To skillfully encourage someone to speak freely or reveal information and feelings
items.ex_en: The skilled therapist managed to draw out the traumatized child during their quiet sessions.
items.ex_zh: 技艺高超的治疗师在安静的交谈中成功启发受创儿童敞开心扉倾诉心声。

items.def_zh: 唤起，引起（回忆、感情或共鸣）
items.def_en: To bring a feeling, memory, or image into someone's mind through suggestion or art
items.ex_en: The evocative orchestral score seemed to evoke forgotten memories of a sunlit seaside afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 这首动人心弦的管弦乐曲似乎唤起了人们对某个阳光明媚的海滨午后的遗忘记忆。

items.def_zh: 引出，探出（信息）；诱发，引起（反应）
items.def_en: (+ from) To manage to get information, facts, or a reaction from someone.
items.ex_en: The investigative committee attempted to elicit concrete facts from the reluctant corporate executive.
items.ex_zh: 调查委员会试图从态度迟疑的企业高管那里探询出具体确凿的事实。

items.def_zh: 费力取得，硬逼出（口供或同意）
items.def_en: To obtain something such as a concession or facts with extreme difficulty or struggle
items.ex_en: The defiant rebel leader refused to let torturers wrest military secrets from his lips.
items.ex_zh: 桀骜不驯的叛军领袖坚决不让酷刑者从他口中硬逼出任何军事机密。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve drawing out answers, latent emotions, confessions, or reactions from people through targeted questioning, skill, or evocative stimuli.
groups.summary_zh: 通过提问、刺激或技巧，从对方处探取信息或激发情绪反应。
groups.desc_en: Denotes drawing forth latent responses, facts, or reactions from an unyielding or passive source, contrasting with receiving freely given disclosures.
groups.desc_zh: 指采取技巧、刺激或外力手段，从被动或抗拒的源头诱发或榨取出隐藏的信息或反应，区别于直接倾听自愿表达。
groups.nuance_en: elicit: to skillfully draw out an answer, reaction, or response (response / confession / smile) · evoke: to spontaneously call forth memories, imagery, or emotional sensations (memory / nostalgia / emotion) · extract: to forcefully or painstakingly obtain guarded information (confession / promise / information) · draw out: to patiently encourage someone reticent to speak or manifest latent qualities (speaker / shy guest / conversation) · wrest: to forcibly pull or extort compliance or answers from an unwilling opponent (admission / concession / control)
groups.nuance_zh: elicit: 运用技巧引导出言语反应或内情 (response / confession / smile) · evoke: 自发唤起记忆、思绪或情感共鸣 (memory / nostalgia / emotion) · extract: 费尽心力或施压强行榨取隐藏信息 (confession / promise / information) · draw out: 耐心开导使沉默内向者吐露心声 (speaker / shy guest / conversation) · wrest: 强行从抗拒者手中硬夺或逼出答复 (admission / concession / control)

groups.name: Elongation & Spatial Extension · 拉长与延展 (Elongate, Lengthen, Distend)
groups.tip: 两端向外拉伸，长度显著增加

items.def_en: To make something last longer or to stretch out a malleable material
items.ex_en: The blacksmith used tongs to draw out the hot iron rod into a spear.
items.ex_zh: 铁匠用火钳将烧红的铁棒拉长锻打成一把锋利的长矛。

items.def_en: To pull something so that it becomes longer, wider, or tighter without breaking
items.ex_en: Carefully stretch the elastic fabric around the wooden frame until it fits perfectly taut.
items.ex_zh: 小心地将弹力面料在木框四周拉长拉紧，直到它完全绷紧贴合。
items.ex2_en: The elastic athletic fabric stretches easily without losing its original shape.
items.ex2_zh: 这种有弹性的运动面料很容易拉伸且不会变形。

items.def_en: To make or become longer in physical distance or duration
items.ex_en: Tailors must lengthen the trousers slightly to match the client's unusual physical height.
items.ex_zh: 裁缝必须把这条裤子稍微放长，以匹配这位顾客异于常人的身高。
items.ex2_en: Days lengthen noticeably as spring transitions into the warm summer months.
items.ex2_zh: 随着春天进入温暖的夏季，白天明显变长了。

items.def_en: To make something longer, or to become longer and narrower.
items.ex_en: Specialized pulling equipment can elongate synthetic polymers into durable structural fibers without tearing.
items.ex_zh: 专用的拉伸设备能将合成聚合物拉长变细为耐用的结构纤维而不致断裂。
items.ex2_en: The shadows elongate dramatically across the grassy meadow during late afternoon.
items.ex2_zh: 傍晚时分，草地上拉长的阴影变得格外显眼。

items.def_en: To prolong or draw out something, especially in time or spatial extension
items.ex_en: The defense attorney employed stalling tactics designed to protract the controversial criminal proceedings.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师采用了拖延战术，企图无限期拖延这场充满争议的刑事诉讼程序。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers processes where physical dimensions or temporal durations are stretched out, making an entity longer, leaner, or prolonged. Nuances contrast geometrical elongation, temporal protraction, and flexible expansion under tension.
groups.summary_zh: 强调在几何形态、物理长度或时间跨度上使其伸展或变长。
groups.desc_en: Denotes expanding physical dimensions or duration along a longitudinal axis, contrasting with isotropic enlargement like volumetric swelling.
groups.desc_zh: 指沿一维轴向在物理长度或时间跨度上进行拉伸与延展，区别于各向同性的整体体积膨胀。
groups.nuance_en: lengthen: to make or become longer in physical dimension or duration (shadow / hem / days) · elongate: to stretch or deform a physical form into an unusually slender shape (shape / neck / limb) · stretch: to pull elastic or flexible material taut across spatial bounds (fabric / muscle / canvas) · draw out: to pull metal or matter into wire, or deliberately lengthen temporal events (wire / discussion / proceedings) · protract: to prolong or spin out an activity in time beyond desirable limits (dispute / negotiations / agony)
groups.nuance_zh: lengthen: 使物理长度或时间段变长 (shadow / hem / days) · elongate: 使形体在纵向变细长或拉长形变 (shape / neck / limb) · stretch: 拉紧或拉伸弹性韧性物体 (fabric / muscle / canvas) · draw out: 将金属拔丝延展或刻意拖长过程 (wire / discussion / proceedings) · protract: 将事件、争端等在时间上过度拖延拖长 (dispute / negotiations / agony)

groups.name: Email & Message · 邮件与电子通信 (Message, Text, Ping)
groups.tip: 现代邮件与即时通讯手段

items.def_en: To send an electronic text message to someone via an app, platform, or mobile device
items.ex_en: Please message me your itinerary so that I can arrange transportation accordingly tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 请把你的行程安排发信息给我，以便我明天相应地安排接送车辆。

items.def_zh: 给……发电子邮件；用电子邮件发送
items.def_en: To send an email message to someone, or to send something by email.
items.ex_en: Could you please email me the revised contract before this afternoon's board conference?
items.ex_zh: 能否请你在今天下午的董事会会议之前把修改后的合同发邮件给我？

items.def_en: To send a written message directly to someone's mobile phone
items.ex_en: I will text you my apartment gate code as soon as I get home.
items.ex_zh: 我一到家就把我公寓的大门密码发短信给你。

items.def_en: To send a duplicate copy of an email to an additional recipient
items.ex_en: Please cc the regional director on all correspondence concerning the new construction project.
items.ex_zh: 在所有关于新建筑项目的往来邮件中，请务必抄送给大区总监。

items.def_en: To send a quick message or notification electronically to check availability or alert someone
items.ex_en: I will ping you on the company chat whenever the quarterly audit report concludes.
items.ex_zh: 季度审计报告一出结果，我就会在公司聊天群里给你发个简讯。
items.ex2_en: The sonar system pinged rhythmically against the hull of the submerged submarine.
items.ex2_zh: 声呐系统有节奏地在潜艇外壳上发出叮的一声回响。

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies modern digital text-based communication, capturing nuances from formal asynchronous correspondence to immediate, informal instant messaging.
groups.summary_zh: 指利用邮件、短信或即时通讯工具发送电子文字信息的行为。
groups.desc_en: Denotes transmitting brief textual or electronic communications across asynchronous digital channels, contrasting with synchronous voice calls or physical mail.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过数字化平台或即时渠道发送异步文本讯息，区别于同步语音通话或实体信件寄送。
groups.nuance_en: email: to transmit digital correspondence via internet mail protocols (client / report / invoice) · text: to send an SMS or mobile phone instant message (friend / code / update) · message: to send a direct message across any messaging app or platform (colleague / team / contact) · ping: to send a quick, informal electronic query to check availability or grab attention (colleague / server / manager) · cc: to copy an additional recipient on an email thread (boss / team / lawyer)
groups.nuance_zh: email: 通过电子邮件系统发送正规或商务信件 (client / report / invoice) · text: 发送手机短信或移动端短信息 (friend / code / update) · message: 在社交软件或通讯应用内发送私信 (colleague / team / contact) · ping: 发送简短快速的网络提示讯息以引起注意 (colleague / server / manager) · cc: 发送电邮时抄送相关人员 (boss / team / lawyer)

groups.name: Embody & Represent · 体现与代表 (Personify, Incarnate, Manifest)
groups.tip: 具体化呈现某种精神或特征

items.def_en: To show or demonstrate an internal quality, state, or symptom plainly and noticeably
items.ex_en: Early childhood stress can manifest as chronic physical tension in adult domestic relationships.
items.ex_zh: 童年早期的压力可能会在成年后的家庭关系中表现为长期的生理紧张。

items.def_zh: 体现，代表（某种思想或品质）；包含，收录
items.def_en: 1. To represent or express an idea, quality, or principle in concrete or visible form. 2. (formal) To include or contain something as part of a larger whole.
items.ex_en: The constitutional bill seeks to embody the fundamental aspirations of equal democratic rights.
