items.ex_zh: 该宪法法案旨在具体体现民主平等权利的核心愿景与崇高追求。

items.def_en: To embody or represent a quality or spiritual concept in tangible human form
items.ex_en: To his young acolytes, the philosopher seemed to incarnate pure wisdom and virtue.
items.ex_zh: 在他年轻的侍从弟子眼中，这位哲人仿佛就是纯粹智慧与美德的人格化化身。

items.def_en: To be the perfect living example or physical incarnation of a quality, idea, or feeling
items.ex_en: Throughout her illustrious humanitarian career, she seemed to personify grace, empathy, and courage.
items.ex_zh: 在她卓越的人道主义生涯中，她似乎就是优雅、同理心与勇气的完美化身。

items.def_en: To be an exceptionally characteristic or quintessential example of a group or style
items.ex_en: These ornate gothic spires typify the architectural spirit of fourteenth-century northern European cathedrals.
items.ex_zh: 这些华丽的哥特式尖塔是十四世纪北欧大教堂建筑风格的典型代表。

groups.summary_en: Centers on giving concrete, living, or visible form to abstract principles, virtues, or cultural identities. Contrasts bodily manifestation with formal political or symbolic representation.
groups.summary_zh: 指将抽象的概念、精神或特质具象化地呈现于人或物之上。
groups.desc_en: Denotes serving as a tangible, living, or archetypal manifestation of an abstract concept, contrasting with merely describing or symbolizing it via words.
groups.desc_zh: 指作为具象化、人格化或典范性的肉身化载体来展现抽象概念，区别于单纯的语言描述或符号指代。
groups.nuance_en: embody: to serve as the tangible, unified vessel of an abstract principle or ideal (spirit / values / essence) · personify: to represent a concept or quality in the human persona or character (evil / grace / ambition) · incarnate: to take bodily, flesh-and-blood human form (deity / principle / virtue) · manifest: to reveal an inner, invisible quality plainly through outward evidence (symptoms / discontent / anger) · typify: to serve as the defining, quintessential representative example of a group (style / era / behavior)
groups.nuance_zh: embody: 具象化地体现或承载抽象精神与原则 (spirit / values / essence) · personify: 将某种抽象特质人格化、拟人化 (evil / grace / ambition) · incarnate: 肉身化或在凡躯中展现神圣与抽象品质 (deity / principle / virtue) · manifest: 通过外在表征或迹象将内在品质显露出来 (symptoms / discontent / anger) · typify: 作为最典型的范例代表某种时代或风格 (style / era / behavior)

groups.name: Embrace & Clasp · 搂抱与紧拥 (Embrace, Clasp, Enfold)
groups.tip: 张开双臂紧搂入怀中相拥

items.def_en: To put your arms around someone as a sign of affection, greeting, or reconciliation
items.ex_en: The diplomat stepped forward to embrace his counterpart in a gesture of reconciliation.
items.ex_zh: 外交官走上前去拥抱了他的对手，以此作为双方达成和解的姿态。

items.def_en: To hold someone firmly and closely with hands or arms against one's chest
items.ex_en: She clasped the weeping orphan tightly to her breast beneath the starry sky.
items.ex_zh: 在繁星闪烁的夜空下，她将哭泣的孤儿紧紧地抱在自己的胸前。

items.def_zh: 怀抱，紧抱入怀；珍藏，藏于心头
items.def_en: (poetic/archaic) To hold closely to one's chest; to cherish or conceal in one's heart
items.ex_en: The lonely exile bosomed the sacred memory of his native hills until death.
items.ex_zh: 孤独的流亡者将对故土山峦的神圣记忆终生珍藏在心头，直至离世。

items.def_en: (literary) To close one's arms tightly around someone to surround and comfort them
items.ex_en: The loving mother leaned down to enfold the shivering child within her cloak.
items.ex_zh: 慈爱的母亲俯下身来，用自己的斗篷将瑟瑟发抖的孩子环抱入怀。

items.def_en: To clasp someone or something passionately against the breast
items.ex_en: The weeping widow pressed the faded portrait to her chest in solitary grief.
items.ex_zh: 悲泣的遗孀在无尽的孤独与哀伤中，将泛黄的画像紧紧搂在胸前。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey dignified, protective, or intense enclosing of another person within one's chest and arms. Often elevated or poetic, they highlight total physical enclosure or cherished harborage.
groups.summary_zh: 突出胸怀环拢的庄重姿态，表现将对方紧紧贴在胸口予以庇护或深情搂抱。
groups.desc_en: Denotes folding one's arms around another body to express deep affection, protection, or solace, contrasting with purely functional physical restraint.
groups.desc_zh: 指用双臂环抱他人躯体以表达爱抚、护佑或慰藉的亲昵肢体动作，区别于功能性的抓握或强行束缚。
groups.nuance_en: embrace: to wrap one's arms around someone lovingly, warmly, or ceremonially (partner / child / friend) · clasp: to hold firmly and tightly with hands or intertwined arms (hand / baby / neck) · enfold: to completely wrap around or enclose protectively within arms or folds (infant / lover / figure) · press to one's chest: to pull another tightly against one's own torso in an emotional grip (child / locket / beloved) · bosom: to press tenderly against one's breast in intimacy (child / infant / bird)
groups.nuance_zh: embrace: 充满爱意、温暖或礼节性地双臂相拥 (partner / child / friend) · clasp: 用双手或双臂紧紧握住或环扣 (hand / baby / neck) · enfold: 护佑性地用双臂将某人整个包拢入怀 (infant / lover / figure) · press to one's chest: 情绪激动地将某人紧压在自己胸膛前 (child / locket / beloved) · bosom: 亲昵地将某人揽入胸前温柔相贴 (child / infant / bird)

groups.name: Emigrate & Expatriate · 移出与去国 (Emigrate, Expatriate, Depart)
groups.tip: 离开原籍移居他乡

items.def_en: To leave one's region, community, or country to reside in another region
items.ex_en: Young graduates continue to outmigrate from struggling rural hamlets toward bustling industrial metropolises.
items.ex_zh: 青年毕业生不断从陷入困境的乡村村落迁出，涌向繁华的工业大都会。

items.def_zh: 拔营启程；离开故土移居别处
items.def_en: To leave an established home, community, or country completely and move elsewhere
items.ex_en: Tired of the expensive city life, they decided to pull up stakes immediately.
items.ex_zh: 厌倦了昂贵的城市生活后，他们决定立刻拔营启程移居他乡。

items.def_zh: 重新安置；迁移到外地/国
items.def_en: (+ to) To move permanently to a new place or country to live or establish business operations
items.ex_en: The multinational corporation offered generous subsidies for employees willing to relocate to Tokyo.
items.ex_zh: 跨国公司为愿意重新安置并迁移至东京工作的员工提供了丰厚的补贴。
items.ex2_en: The company relocated its corporate headquarters to a modern business district downtown.
items.ex2_zh: 该公司将其公司总部迁至市中心的一处现代商业区。

items.def_en: To leave your own country permanently to settle and live in another.
items.ex_en: Thousands of citizens chose to emigrate to Canada during the severe economic crisis.
items.ex_zh: 在严重的经济危机期间，数千名公民选择移居加拿大。

items.def_en: To leave one's native country to live elsewhere, often for employment or prolonged residence
items.ex_en: Many skilled engineers expatriate annually to seek higher salaries in the Persian Gulf.
items.ex_zh: 每年都有许多熟练工程师移居国外，前往波斯湾寻求更高的薪水。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on the outward departure from one's homeland or country of origin to take up residence abroad, highlighting the point of origin and the act of relocating permanently elsewhere.
groups.summary_zh: 指自原籍国迁徙移出，强调离开本土并去往他国定居的过程。
groups.desc_en: Denotes leaving one's native homeland to establish permanent or prolonged domicile abroad, contrasting with domestic internal moves or short-term travel.
groups.desc_zh: 指脱离本国母土远赴异国建立永久或长期居所的移居行为，区别于国内搬迁或短期跨境旅行。
groups.nuance_en: emigrate: to permanently leave one's native country to settle in another (from homeland / to Canada) · expatriate: to live abroad outside one's native country, often renouncing or detached from original citizenship (citizens / professionals / writers) · relocate: to change location of residence or operation, internationally or domestically (family / headquarters / staff) · pull up stakes: to abruptly or decisively terminate ties to a locality and move away (family / household) · outmigrate: to move out from an originating ecological or census area as part of an aggregate demographic shift (population / workers)
groups.nuance_zh: emigrate: 永久迁离原籍国定居国外 (from homeland / to Canada) · expatriate: 长期旅居海外或自愿脱离本国生活 (citizens / professionals / writers) · relocate: 重新安置住址或办公地点（中性兼顾国内外） (family / headquarters / staff) · pull up stakes: 拔营启程，彻底断绝当地根基搬往他方 (family / household) · outmigrate: （人口统计学）由特定源区域向外迁出 (population / workers)

groups.name: Emit & Emanate · 发散与散发 (Emanate, Radiate, Exude)
groups.tip: 气味光线或能量向外散发

items.def_en: to produce and send out gas, heat, light, or an odor into the surrounding air
items.ex_en: The rotting vegetation gave off a foul chemical odor.
items.ex_zh: 腐烂的植被散发出一股难闻的化学异味。

items.def_en: to discharge or send forth light, sound, radiation, or gas
items.ex_en: The industrial plant was heavily fined for continuing to emit toxic sulfurous gases.
items.ex_zh: 该化工厂因持续排放含硫有毒气体而被处以巨额罚款。

items.def_en: to send out rays or waves of heat, light, or unmistakable emotion in all directions
items.ex_en: The newly installed quartz radiators radiate consistent warmth throughout the vast gallery space.
items.ex_zh: 新安装的石英暖气片在整个宽敞的画廊空间里辐射出均匀的暖意。

items.def_en: To come out or spread from a source, such as a feeling, smell, light, or sound.
items.ex_en: A distinctive aromatic fragrance began to emanate from the botanical garden's rare blooms.
items.ex_zh: 一股独特的芳香开始从植物园的奇花异草中散发出来。

items.def_zh: 流露，散发出（气质或气味）
items.def_en: to display an emotion or trait conspicuously, or to slowly seep out a liquid or odor
items.ex_en: The ancient resinous pine trunks slowly exude sticky sap in the scorching heat.
items.ex_zh: 古老的含脂松树干在酷暑中缓缓渗出黏稠的树汁。

groups.summary_en: Denotes the outward transmission of intangible or volatile phenomena—such as odors, light, heat, or personal aura—spreading outward from an origin point.
groups.summary_zh: 强调气味、光热或特质从源头向外散发、流露或弥漫。
groups.desc_en: Denotes discharging or radiating energy, intangible essences, particles, or sensory cues outward from a source, contrasting with passive containment.
groups.desc_zh: 指能量、无形气韵、微粒或感官刺激从源头向外透散发出的过程，区别于内在蓄积或被动包含。
groups.nuance_en: emit: to discharge or send forth light, sound, radiation, or gas from a source (gas / radiation / signal) · emanate: to flow out gently or originate intangibly from a source (warmth / fragrance / authority) · exude: to ooze out slowly as droplets, or heavily project a potent emotional vibe (sweat / confidence / charm) · radiate: to emit intensely in all directions like waves or beams (heat / joy / light) · give off: to produce and release a detectable scent, vapor, or glow (smell / heat / fumes)
groups.nuance_zh: emit: 物理性地发射或排泄光、声、辐射或气体 (gas / radiation / signal) · emanate: 某种无形的气质、香气或源流幽幽散发 (warmth / fragrance / authority) · exude: 慢慢渗出汗液，或强烈流露出某种魅力气质 (sweat / confidence / charm) · radiate: 像射线或热浪般向四周四射辐射 (heat / joy / light) · give off: 自发散发出明显的气味、热量或烟雾 (smell / heat / fumes)

groups.name: Emote & Project Emotion · 显现情绪与流露 (Dramatize, Radiate, Gush)
groups.tip: 通过言行面容展现内在情绪体验

items.def_en: to become visibly unable to speak clearly due to being overwhelmed by strong emotion
items.ex_en: She began to choke up while thanking her parents during the award ceremony.
items.ex_zh: 在颁奖典礼上感谢父母时，她激动得哽咽了。

items.def_en: to clearly show a particular feeling or quality in one's face or general demeanour
items.ex_en: Her expressive countenance seemed to radiate serene joy during the solemn nuptial ceremony.
items.ex_zh: 在庄严的婚礼仪式上，她生动的面容仿佛洋溢着祥和的喜悦。

items.def_zh: 滔滔不绝地赞叹；过分热情地流露
items.def_en: to express praise, pleasure, or affection in an overly enthusiastic, effusive way
items.ex_en: The proud aunt would constantly gush about her nephew's impressive musical talents.
items.ex_zh: 这位自豪的姑姑总是滔滔不绝地夸赞侄子出众的音乐才华。
items.ex2_en: The ruptured pipeline gushed muddy water all over the newly paved highway.
items.ex2_zh: 破裂的管道将泥水喷涌喷溅在刚铺好的公路上。

items.def_zh: 充分流露；四溢着（自信、魅力等）
items.def_en: to display a quality or emotion strongly and visibly in one's bearing
items.ex_en: The diplomat managed to exude absolute composure despite the hostile questioning by reporters.
items.ex_zh: 尽管面对记者充满敌意的提问，这位外交官依然展现出十足的沉着从容。

items.def_zh: 表达感情，流露情绪；（表演时）做作地表现情感
items.def_en: to express emotion openly and demonstratively, especially when acting on stage or screen
items.ex_en: The veteran stage actor was instructed to emote less melodramatically in modern scenes.
items.ex_zh: 这位资深舞台剧演员被要求在现代戏份中不要表现得过于做作煽情。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate visibly portraying, exuding, or demonstratively expressing feeling, especially in theatrical performance or heightened expressive display.
groups.summary_zh: 指在外表、动作或舞台表演中公开、富有表现力地展现或流露情绪。
groups.desc_en: Denotes theatrical, intense, or uninhibited outward displays of emotion, contrasting with stoic suppression or mild, quiet sentiment.
groups.desc_zh: 指将内心强烈情绪戏剧化、夸张或毫无保留地向外宣泄流露，区别于克制隐忍或内敛平淡的情感。
groups.nuance_en: emote: to portray or exhibit emotion in a deliberate, exaggerated, or theatrical manner (actor / performer / speaker) · gush: to express enthusiasm or praise with excessive, unrestrained effusiveness (enthusiasm / praise / feelings) · choke up: to be suddenly overcome by rising emotion, impeding clear speech (speaker / mourner / veteran) · exude: to effortlessly and continuously project an unmistakable aura or emotion (confidence / positivity / despair) · radiate: to project radiant, infectious positive emotion outward onto others (happiness / warmth / optimism)
groups.nuance_zh: emote: 演戏般夸张或刻意地表露情绪 (actor / performer / speaker) · gush: 滔滔不绝、极其夸张地迸发赞美与狂热 (enthusiasm / praise / feelings) · choke up: 哽咽失语，因情绪激涌导致喉咙哽塞 (speaker / mourner / veteran) · exude: 举手投足间无声弥漫出强烈的气场或情绪 (confidence / positivity / despair) · radiate: 像光芒四射般向周围辐射出感染力强的情感 (happiness / warmth / optimism)

groups.name: Employ & Appoint · 任职与任用赋职 (Appoint, Install, Staff)
groups.tip: 招聘录用付酬使用

items.def_en: to provide an organization, project, or department with the necessary workforce
items.ex_en: The hospital struggled to staff the emergency department during the unexpected winter outbreak.
items.ex_zh: 在突如其来的冬季疫情期间，该医院难以给急诊科配备足额人员。

items.def_en: (formal) to employ someone or contract their services for a specific role
items.ex_en: The board decided to engage an independent auditing firm to review corporate finances.
items.ex_zh: 董事会决定聘请一家独立审计机构来审查公司的财务状况。

items.def_en: to assign someone formally to a specific public, political, or corporate office
items.ex_en: The prime minister will officially appoint the new foreign minister tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 首相将于明天上午正式任命新的外交部长。

items.def_en: to pay someone to work for you; to use a particular method, skill, or object for a purpose
items.ex_en: The logistics firm plans to employ twenty additional drivers for the busy season.
items.ex_zh: 这家物流公司计划在旺季额外雇用二十名司机。

items.def_en: to place someone formally in an official post or position through a ceremony
items.ex_en: The university will formally install the new chancellor at next week's grand ceremony.
items.ex_zh: 大学将在下周的盛大典礼上正式为新任校长举行就职仪式。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this governance and institutional frame describe placing people in workforce roles, commissioning duties, and utilizing personnel and organizational resources.
groups.summary_zh: 指委派职务、配置人员及使人才在机构中担纲职责。
groups.desc_en: Denotes legally and officially selecting someone to fill a designated post, office, or operational role, contrasting with informal contracting or unguided hiring.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过法定程序或权威裁定选定某人入职特定职位、充实团队或就任公职，区别于非正式的临时雇请。
groups.nuance_en: appoint: to officially designate someone to an office, position, or committee (minister / judge / successor) · employ: to hire and provide paid work under a formal labor contract (workers / staff / methods) · install: to ceremonially or formally induct someone into high office (president / bishop / chancellor) · staff: to furnish an organization or facility with necessary personnel (department / hospital / desk) · engage: to retain services or contract professional counsel (lawyer / consultant / firm)
groups.nuance_zh: appoint: 正式委任或指派某人担任特定职务 (minister / judge / successor) · employ: 签订劳务关系雇佣员工 (workers / staff / methods) · install: 举行就职典礼使官员或领袖正式就任 (president / bishop / chancellor) · staff: 为机构或部门配置配备所需的工作人员 (department / hospital / desk) · engage: 聘请或延揽专业顾问、机构提供服务 (lawyer / consultant / firm)

groups.name: Employ & Operate · 使用与操作 (Use, Employ, Wield)
groups.tip: 利用工具手段达成具体目的

items.def_zh: 使用，利用，运用；消耗，耗费
items.def_en: to employ a tool, method, or resource for a particular purpose; to consume or expend
items.ex_en: Please use the emergency stairs instead of the elevator during the safety drill.
items.ex_zh: 在安全演习期间，请走应急楼梯，不要使用电梯。

items.def_en: to control the functioning of a machine, vehicle, or mechanical system
items.ex_en: Only licensed technicians are permitted to operate this complex heavy industrial machinery.
items.ex_zh: 只有持证技术人员才被允许操作这台复杂的中型工业机械。
items.ex2_en: The delicate electronic equipment operates smoothly under varying room temperature conditions.
items.ex2_zh: 这种精密电子设备在不同室温条件下均运转平稳。

items.def_en: to hold, touch, or operate something skillfully with your hands
items.ex_en: She learned to handle the delicate laboratory instruments with steady, precise movements.
items.ex_zh: 她学会了以沉稳精确的手法操纵那些精密实验仪器。

items.def_en: to make use of a particular method, technique, or instrument for a task
items.ex_en: Researchers employ advanced statistical modeling to interpret the vast oceanographic data.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员采用先进的统计建模方法来解析庞大的海洋学数据。

items.def_zh: 挥舞，操持（武器或工具）；行使
items.def_en: to hold and use a weapon or tool effectively with your hands; to exercise power
items.ex_en: The monarch continued to wield absolute administrative authority over the remote territories.
items.ex_zh: 君主继续对这些偏远领土行使绝对的行政管辖权。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses the direct physical or instrumental handling and employment of tools, instruments, or methods to perform tasks or carry out functions.
groups.summary_zh: 强调直接操控、操纵工具或采取具体手段达成目的。
groups.desc_en: Denotes taking up and skillfully manipulating an instrument, method, or power to achieve a practical effect, contrasting with idle ownership or speculative contemplation.
groups.desc_zh: 指为了达成既定效能而动手操纵工具、设备或行使权力手腕，区别于单纯占有或纸上谈兵。
groups.nuance_en: use: to put an object, tool, or method into practice for an everyday purpose (tool / hammer / password) · operate: to control the working mechanisms of complex machinery or systems (machinery / equipment / vehicle) · handle: to touch, manipulate, or manage physically with manual skill (weapon / luggage / animal) · wield: to effectively hold and brandish a physical weapon or exercise formidable power (sword / influence / authority) · employ: to purposively deploy a strategy, instrument, or technique to achieve an end (technique / strategy / force)
groups.nuance_zh: use: 最通用的将工具或手段投入实际使用 (tool / hammer / password) · operate: 操纵复杂机械、仪器或运行运转系统 (machinery / equipment / vehicle) · handle: 亲手抚弄、拿握或熟练摆弄实物 (weapon / luggage / animal) · wield: 挥舞重型武器或挥动掌控巨大权力与威势 (sword / influence / authority) · employ: 善用某种精妙策略、战术手段或媒介达成目标 (technique / strategy / force)

groups.name: Enact & Promulgate Law · 颁布与颁发法令 (Promulgate, Enact, Decree)
groups.tip: 官方郑重公开发表声明，颁布法定法令

items.def_zh: 正式颁发；下达（指令或声明）
items.def_en: To supply or produce something officially for public circulation or enforcement
items.ex_en: The health department will issue new safety guidelines for food vendors next week.
items.ex_zh: 卫生部门将于下周向食品摊贩正式发布新的安全指南。
items.ex2_en: Thick black smoke issued continuously from the factory's damaged chimney pipe.
items.ex2_zh: 浓黑的烟雾从工厂受损的烟囱管道中不断冒出。

items.def_en: To make a proposed law into official legislation
items.ex_en: Parliament voted decisively to enact comprehensive environmental protection legislation before summer recess.
items.ex_zh: 议会在暑期休会前果断投票通过了一项全面的环境保护法案。

items.def_zh: 命令；裁定（尤指依法或以专制权力发布）
items.def_en: To order, establish, or decide something by official legal decree
items.ex_en: The supreme court may decree that the disputed policy violates constitutional guarantees.
items.ex_zh: 最高法院可能会裁定该争议政策侵犯了宪法保障的权利。

items.def_en: To make or enact laws covering a specific area or jurisdiction
items.ex_en: Lawmakers met specifically to legislate against deceptive online marketing and automated telemarketing.
items.ex_zh: 立法者举行专门会议，就打击虚假网络营销和自动电话推销立法规制。

items.def_zh: 公布，颁布（法律、法令等）；宣扬，传播（信仰、教条）
items.def_en: 1. To officially announce and put into effect a new law, decree, or policy. 2. To spread or promote an idea or belief widely.
items.ex_en: The government will formally promulgate the revised maritime code early next month.
items.ex_zh: 政府将于下月初正式颁布修订后的海商法典。

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote the formal institutional process of putting laws, decrees, or official doctrines into public effect and widespread recognition.
groups.summary_zh: 专指立法机构或掌权者正式颁布施行法律、教义或法令。
groups.desc_en: To bring a legal rule or statute into formal force and public effect through sovereign or parliamentary authority, unlike informal rule-making or declaration.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过主权或立法权力机关正式确立、通过并对外公布法令使其具有强制效力，区别于非正式规章的宣布。
groups.nuance_en: legislate: create laws via parliamentary deliberation (law / reform) · enact: pass a bill into statutory law (legislation / statute / bill) · promulgate: publicly proclaim an enacted law to bring it into formal effect (edict / decree / constitution) · decree: dictate law unilaterally by sovereign fiat (order / measure / state of emergency) · issue: release an official administrative directive or warrant (writ / permit / regulation)
groups.nuance_zh: legislate: 经议会审议程序立法 (law / reform) · enact: 正式通过法案确立为法律 (legislation / statute / bill) · promulgate: 向公众正式颁布公布使法令生效 (edict / decree / constitution) · decree: 凭借最高权威单方面强行颁发政令 (order / measure / state of emergency) · issue: 官方签发具有行政效力的指令或凭证 (writ / permit / regulation)

groups.name: Encase & Liquidate into Money · 兑现与变现 (Cash, Redeem, Liquidate)
groups.tip: 把票据或资产变现

items.def_en: To exchange a check, bond, or money order for cash.
items.ex_en: She went directly to the neighborhood bank branch to cash her payroll check.
items.ex_zh: 她直接前往附近的银行分行兑现工资支票。

items.def_zh: 兑换现金，变现（筹码、证券）
items.def_en: To exchange securities, tokens, or policies for the monetary value they represent
items.ex_en: He decided to cash in his casino chips before leaving the gaming table.
items.ex_zh: 他决定在离开赌桌之前把赌场筹码全部兑换成现金。

items.def_en: To exchange a coupon, voucher, or share for money, goods, or equivalent value
items.ex_en: Investors may formally redeem their mature treasury bonds at any participating commercial bank.
items.ex_zh: 投资者可在任何一家指定的商业银行正式兑付已到期的国债。

items.def_en: To convert assets or securities into cash, often to settle debts or wind up a venture
items.ex_en: The distressed company was forced to liquidate valuable overseas assets to satisfy creditors.
items.ex_zh: 这家陷入困境的公司被迫变卖宝贵的名下海外资产以清偿债务。

items.def_zh: 实现货币化，靠……盈利变现
items.def_en: To convert an asset, activity, or online presence into regular income or legal tender
items.ex_en: The media startup seeks to monetize its popular podcast through targeted corporate sponsorships.
items.ex_zh: 这家初创媒体试图通过定向的企业赞助将其热门播客实现商业变现。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe converting non-cash assets, financial instruments, vouchers, or claims into immediate paper money or readily usable funds.
groups.summary_zh: 指将支票、证券、凭证或非流动资产兑换、提现或变卖为现金。
groups.desc_en: To convert a financial instrument, non-liquid asset, or intangible value into ready cash or revenue, distinct from ordinary trading or barter.
groups.desc_zh: 将金融凭证、非流动性资产或抽象价值转变为即时可用的现金或收益，区别于普通的商品交易或以物易物。
groups.nuance_en: cash: exchange an immediate paper instrument for physical money (cheque / draft) · redeem: surrender a voucher or obligation to reclaim cash or underlying value (bond / shares / voucher) · liquidate: sell off physical or illiquid capital under urgency or dissolution (assets / stock / inventory) · monetize: systematically extract commercial cash flow from an intangible asset or debt (debt / user base / platform) · cash in: realize gains opportunistically from an accumulated position (chips / policy / investment)
groups.nuance_zh: cash: 拿票据或支票直接兑换现款 (cheque / draft) · redeem: 凭凭证或债券赎回本金或等值物 (bond / shares / voucher) · liquidate: 在破产或清盘时折价变卖清算资产 (assets / stock / inventory) · monetize: 对无形资产或用户流量进行商业变现 (debt / user base / platform) · cash in: 将已获优势或长期积累套现脱手 (chips / policy / investment)

groups.name: Encircle & Bind with Bands · 箍紧与环束 (Hoop, Band, Gird)
groups.tip: 铁箍绳索紧紧捆扎

items.def_en: 1. To bind, fasten, or encircle a barrel or object with metal or wooden hoops.
items.ex_en: The aged cooper labored tirelessly to hoop the fragrant oak wine casks securely.
items.ex_zh: 年迈的箍桶匠不知疲倦地劳作，用箍把芳香的橡木酒桶紧紧箍牢。

items.def_en: To encircle, bind, or reinforce an object with a flat strip or band of metal, plastic, or tape
items.ex_en: Workers band the heavy cargo crates with flexible steel strips before maritime shipping.
items.ex_zh: 工人们在海运前用柔韧的钢带将沉重的货物箱捆扎牢固。

items.def_en: To fasten, secure, or bind tightly together using a flexible strap or belt
items.ex_en: Remember to strap the luggage tightly to the roof rack before driving off.
items.ex_zh: 开车出发前，记得用带子把行李牢牢固定在车顶行李架上。

items.def_en: To encircle, bind, or secure with a belt or band, or to surround structurally for support
items.ex_en: Ancient stone ramparts continue to gird the sleepy Mediterranean harbor against raging winter tides.
items.ex_zh: 古老的石砌城垣依然环绕着宁静的地中海港湾，抵御着冬日的狂潮。

items.def_en: To tie, bind, or fasten tightly so as to immobilize, reinforce, or hold securely in shape
items.ex_en: The butcher used coarse hemp twine to truss the seasoned turkey for roasting.
items.ex_zh: 屠夫用粗麻绳将腌制好的火鸡扎紧，准备放进烤箱烘烤。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe securing, reinforcing, or enclosing an object by placing rigid or flexible bands, rings, or belts around its perimeter. They often carry technical or artisanal connotations relating to barrels, bales, or structural supports.
groups.summary_zh: 用金属圈、带子或箍环紧固或加固物体的外周。
groups.desc_en: To secure, reinforce, or immobilize an object by wrapping rigid or semi-rigid bands tightly around its circumference, differing from loose binding or tying.
groups.desc_zh: 使用刚性或半刚性带状物紧密环绕物体周身进行加固、箍牢或限制，区别于松散的打结或简单绑扎。
groups.nuance_en: hoop: encircle with rigid circular rings to resist outward bursting (barrel / cask / vat) · band: apply distinct identifying or securing strips (package / bale / trunk) · strap: bind down tightly with heavy flexible webbing (luggage / cargo / patient) · gird: encircle the waist or structural core for support and readiness (loins / sword / waist) · truss: bind limbs or bulk packages tightly to immobilize completely (fowl / prisoner / rafters)
groups.nuance_zh: hoop: 加装金属或木制圆箍以防桶体崩裂 (barrel / cask / vat) · band: 套上环带以标识或束紧成捆物品 (package / bale / trunk) · strap: 用皮带或厚编织带重重缚牢 (luggage / cargo / patient) · gird: 环束腰身或结构以提供支撑和备战姿态 (loins / sword / waist) · truss: 将四肢或大包紧密捆缚使之无法动弹 (fowl / prisoner / rafters)

groups.name: Enclose & Encase · 密闭与包裹封装 (Encase, Enclose, Sheathe)
groups.tip: 密闭封装入箱壳容器之中

items.def_en: To surround or hold inside a container, barrier, or boundary completely
items.ex_en: High concrete walls enclose the secure research facility to deter unauthorized civilian entry.
items.ex_zh: 高耸的水泥墙将整座安保科研设施严密包围，以防无关人员闯入。

items.def_en: To wrap up, cover, or surround something completely
items.ex_en: Thick silver mists slowly envelope the tranquil highland valley at dusk.
items.ex_zh: 黄昏时分，浓重的银色薄雾缓缓笼罩了静谧的高原山谷。

items.def_en: To enclose something tightly inside or as if in a capsule
items.ex_en: The pharmaceutical laboratory uses advanced polymer membranes to encapsulate sensitive therapeutic enzymes.
items.ex_zh: 制药实验室利用先进的聚合物薄膜将敏感的治疗用酶严密封装。

items.def_zh: 把……装入箱（或套）中；包住，完全围住
items.def_en: To enclose or cover something completely in a case, box, or protective layer.
items.ex_en: Conservators carefully encase the centuries-old manuscript in airtight tempered glass containers.
items.ex_zh: 文物保护人员小心翼翼地将有数百年历史的手稿封装在气密钢化玻璃容器中。

items.def_en: To put a weapon or object into a protective case, covering, or sheath
items.ex_en: The silent sentinel stood motionless, ready to sheathe his polished steel ceremonial blade.
items.ex_zh: 沉默的哨兵纹丝不动地站立着，准备将擦得锃亮的钢制仪仗剑收入鞘中。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe placing an object inside a tight, fitted, or protective exterior covering, box, or sheath.
groups.summary_zh: 指用壳体、容器或保护套层完全包裹、容纳或密闭物体。
groups.desc_en: To surround an object completely within a protective, snug, or protective outer barrier or container, beyond merely putting something inside a room.
groups.desc_zh: 将某物完全包覆、密封在紧密的外壳、护套或保护屏障内，区别于简单的置入空间。
groups.nuance_en: enclose: fence in or put inside an envelope/barrier to demarcate or contain (letter / parcel / compound) · encase: embed or enclose inside a rigid, protective outer shell (concrete / bronze / glass) · sheathe: slip snugly into a fitted outer protective cover (sword / cable / dagger) · encapsulate: compress or capture fully within a protective or summary capsule (capsule / idea / sample) · envelope: completely wrap around as a continuous, obscuring mantle (fog / darkness / silence)
groups.nuance_zh: enclose: 围入围栏或封入信封以限制或盛放 (letter / parcel / compound) · encase: 嵌入坚固外壳中进行严密防护 (concrete / bronze / glass) · sheathe: 插入贴合紧密的保护鞘或护层 (sword / cable / dagger) · encapsulate: 胶囊化密封或高度凝练概括 (capsule / idea / sample) · envelope: 像斗篷般从四面八方完全笼罩、吞没 (fog / darkness / silence)

groups.name: Encode & Encrypt · 编码与加密 (Encode, Encrypt, Scramble)
groups.tip: 将明文转化成密码信息隐藏

items.def_en: To convert ordinary text into ciphertext using a cryptographic cipher
items.ex_en: Military intelligence specialists must encipher all tactical communications before digital transmission.
items.ex_zh: 军事情报专家在进行数字传输之前必须将所有战术通信译成密文。

items.def_en: To modify a broadcast signal or transmission electronically so it cannot be received without a decoder
items.ex_en: The television network scrambled the live championship satellite feed for non-subscribers.
items.ex_zh: 该电视台对非订阅用户的锦标赛卫星直播信号进行了扰频加密处理。

items.def_en: To convert information or instructions into a coded form
items.ex_en: The sophisticated software algorithm can encode raw audio files into compressed formats seamlessly.
items.ex_zh: 这款先进的软件算法能够将原始音频文件无缝编码为压缩格式。

items.def_en: 1. (computing) To convert electronic data or messages into a secret code to prevent unauthorized access.
items.ex_en: The system will automatically encrypt confidential customer records to thwart illicit cyber breaches.
items.ex_zh: 该系统会自动对机密客户记录进行加密，以防范非法的网络入侵。

items.def_zh: 用密码书写，将……译成密码；做算术，计算
items.def_en: 1. (variant of cipher) To encode a message into secret code. 2. (archaic) To calculate or do arithmetic.
items.ex_en: The royal spy labored long into midnight to cypher the delicate diplomatic dispatch.
items.ex_zh: 皇家密探在深夜里辛苦劳作，将这份微妙的外交急件译成密码。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to converting data, text, or signals into a cipher or secret format to ensure security, prevent unauthorized access, or facilitate machine transmission. 'Encrypt' emphasizes cryptographic security, whereas 'encode' generally applies to systemic data format conversion.
groups.summary_zh: 将信息、数据转化为密文或编码以防窃听或便于传输。
groups.desc_en: To transform readable information into unintelligible symbolic or cryptographic representations to prevent unauthorized comprehension, unlike clear communication.
groups.desc_zh: 将可读明文信息转化为无法直接理解的符号或密文，以防止未授权解读，区别于明文传输或简单记录。
groups.nuance_en: encode: map data into a specific formal system or digital representation (signal / sequence / message) · encrypt: obscure digital data mathematically to prevent interception (file / traffic / drive) · encipher: transform plaintext into ciphertext using a cryptographic algorithm (dispatch / text) · cypher: older synonym for enciphering through numerical/secret substitution (code / message) · scramble: disrupt audio or electronic signals into unreadable white noise (transmission / signal / channel)
groups.nuance_zh: encode: 按特定代码系统或数字格式将信息编码 (signal / sequence / message) · encrypt: 通过数学算法加密数据以防窥视窃取 (file / traffic / drive) · encipher: 利用密钥算法将明文密写为密文 (dispatch / text) · cypher: 通过密码体制或数字置换进行古典加密 (code / message) · scramble: 扰乱音频或电讯信号使之变成乱码杂音 (transmission / signal / channel)

groups.name: Encounter & Live Through · 经历与亲历 (Undergo, Encounter, Taste)
groups.tip: 亲身感受并经历事情

items.def_en: 1. To undergo, live through, or feel something.
items.ex_en: Travelers often experience severe jet lag after crossing multiple international time zones.
items.ex_zh: 跨越多个国际时区后，旅客们往往会经历严重的时差反应。

items.def_en: To experience a momentary or brief sensation of something, such as success, defeat, or freedom
items.ex_en: The underdog team finally got to taste sweet victory after consecutive disappointing seasons.
items.ex_zh: 这支不被看好的队伍在经历了连续几个失落赛季后，终于领略了胜利的甘甜。

items.def_en: To try or experience a small portion of an activity or lifestyle to see what it is like
items.ex_en: Visitors can sample vibrant urban nightlife during their weekend stay in Madrid.
items.ex_zh: 游客在马德里度周末期间，可以体验这里充满活力的都市夜生活。

items.def_en: To unexpectedly experience or be faced with a specific problem, condition, or situation
items.ex_en: Navigators frequently encounter treacherous ocean currents along this poorly charted rocky coastline.
items.ex_zh: 航海人员在这条海图记录不详的多石海岸线沿线经常会遭遇凶险的洋流。

items.def_zh: 度过；亲身经历（艰难境况）
items.def_en: To survive and endure a traumatic, difficult, or momentous historical experience
items.ex_en: He lived through two world wars and several major crises.
items.ex_zh: 他经历了两次世界大战和几场重大危机。

groups.summary_en: These verbs describe actively meeting, feeling, or passing through significant life events, hardships, or perceptual phenomena. They express the cognitive and emotional imprint left by passing events.
groups.summary_zh: 指身历其境、亲身感受或遭遇某类生活变故与情感体验。
groups.desc_en: To live directly through a situation, sensation, or epoch so that it leaves a cognitive imprint, distinct from merely observing or hearing about it.
groups.desc_zh: 亲身涉足并度过某种情境、感觉或历史时期而留下切实认知印记，区别于旁观或听闻。
groups.nuance_en: experience: undergo cognitive or emotional realization of an event firsthand (hardship / joy / symptoms) · live through: survive a traumatic, prolonged historical or physical ordeal (war / crisis / earthquake) · encounter: meet unexpectedly or confront face-to-face (resistance / obstacle / hostility) · taste: try or sample the brief, sharp sensation of something (success / defeat / freedom) · sample: deliberately test a small part of an experience (cuisine / life / culture)
groups.nuance_zh: experience: 亲身体会或经受具体的认知与情感过程 (hardship / joy / symptoms) · live through: 挺过并活着度过漫长残酷的历史创伤 (war / crisis / earthquake) · encounter: 突发性地迎面遭遇险阻或抵抗 (resistance / obstacle / hostility) · taste: 短暂而真切地尝到某种滋味或际遇 (success / defeat / freedom) · sample: 主动浅尝体验部分样本 (cuisine / life / culture)

groups.name: Encourage & Spur · 鼓舞与激励 (Spur, Goad, Galvanize)
groups.tip: 鼓励鼓舞策马扬鞭

items.def_en: to poke, encourage, or remind a reluctant person to take action
items.ex_en: The manager had to prod the complacent sales team to meet their targets.
items.ex_zh: 经理不得不督促自满的销售团队去完成既定目标。

items.def_en: to encourage or urge someone strongly to do something foolish or dangerous
items.ex_en: Bystanders tried to egg on the two teenagers into an unnecessary street brawl.
items.ex_zh: 旁观者们试图怂恿这两个青少年在街头打一场毫无意义的架。

items.def_zh: 激励，鼓舞，促使；用马刺策（马）加速
items.def_en: to encourage someone to do something, or to encourage something to happen faster or improve; to urge a horse forward with spurs
items.ex_en: The promise of substantial bonuses will spur workers to exceed their monthly quotas.
items.ex_zh: 丰厚奖金的许诺将激励工人们超额完成月度生产定额。

items.def_en: to persistently provoke or annoy someone into doing something
items.ex_en: Opponents sought to goad the hot-tempered politician into making an embarrassing public blunder.
items.ex_zh: 对手们试图激怒这位脾气火爆的政客，让他当众犯下尴尬的失误。

items.def_en: to shock or excite someone into taking immediate, vigorous action
items.ex_en: The urgent climate report helped galvanize young activists into staging nationwide protests.
items.ex_zh: 这份紧急气候报告激励青年活动家们迅速在全国范围内发起抗议。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here signify injecting kinetic momentum, courage, or urgency into an agent to trigger decisive action. They contrast gentle verbal cheering with sharp, provokative jolts.
groups.summary_zh: 言辞鼓舞、利诱逼迫或强力震动以驱使他人迅速采取行动。
groups.desc_en: To stimulate, provoke, or propel a person into heightened motion or decisive action through external pressure or inspiration, beyond passive advising.
groups.desc_zh: 通过外界施压或强力激发促使他人加速行动或突破停滞，区别于被动的劝告或温和建议。
groups.nuance_en: spur: accelerate ongoing action by giving a sharp incentive (growth / investment / recovery) · prod: poke repeatedly to overcome inertia or sluggishness (bureaucracy / conscience / witness) · goad: tease or provoke aggressively to elicit an angry reaction (rival / temper / aggression) · egg on: irresponsibly urge someone to perform a foolish or risky act (peers / fight / bet) · galvanize: electrify a lethargic group into sudden, unified action (community / public / base)
groups.nuance_zh: spur: 策马扬鞭式给予强刺激以加速进程 (growth / investment / recovery) · prod: 反复轻戳敦促以克服惰性和拖延 (bureaucracy / conscience / witness) · goad: 恶意挑衅或激怒以诱发冲动反应 (rival / temper / aggression) · egg on: 煽动、怂恿他人从事冒险或愚蠢行径 (peers / fight / bet) · galvanize: 施以电击般彻底震动唤醒大众采取联合行动 (community / public / base)

groups.name: Encroach & Poach · 侵蚀领地与非法截取 (Poach, Encroach, Usurp)
groups.tip: 越界非法侵占他人资源

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to actively violate or breach another party's legal privileges or space
items.ex_en: The rival company's new mobile patent may directly infringe on existing proprietary designs.
items.ex_zh: 竞争对手的新手机专利可能会直接侵犯现有的专有设计。

items.def_en: (+ on) to enter someone's land, property, or affairs without permission
items.ex_en: Hikers must ensure they do not trespass on private farmland without explicit permission.
items.ex_zh: 徒步旅行者必须确保在未获得明确许可的情况下，不得非法侵入私人农田。

items.def_zh: 偷猎，非法捕猎；挖走（人员、客户等）；侵占；水煮，炖（蛋、鱼等）
items.def_en: 1. to hunt or fish illegally on someone else's land or water. 2. to persuade employees or clients to leave a rival organization. 3. to cook food gently in simmering liquid.
items.ex_en: Headhunters aggressively attempt to poach talented software engineers from competing regional startups.
items.ex_zh: 猎头公司积极地试图从同地区的竞争初创企业中挖走优秀的软件工程师。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to advance gradually beyond acceptable limits into someone's territory or rights
items.ex_en: Urban developers continually encroach upon fertile agricultural wetlands despite strong environmental protests.
items.ex_zh: 尽管环保人士强烈抗议，城市开发商仍旧在不断蚕食肥沃的农业湿地。

items.def_en: to seize and hold power, position, or property illegally and by force
items.ex_en: The ambitious general conspired secretly to usurp constitutional executive authority from parliament.
items.ex_zh: 野心勃勃的将军秘密密谋，企图从议会手中篡夺宪法赋予的行政权力。

groups.summary_en: This frame denotes trespassing onto another's jurisdiction, property, or customer base to seize resources, wildlife, or personnel covertly, unlawfully, or gradually.
groups.summary_zh: 指未经许可侵入他人领地、领域，盗猎或截挖利益与人才。
groups.desc_en: To advance gradually or illicitly across boundaries to seize another party's rightful territory, domain, or assets, unlike legitimate open acquisition.
groups.desc_zh: 循序渐进或非正当地越过界限，侵占吞并他人的合法领地、权益或资源，区别于公开合法的获取。
groups.nuance_en: encroach: advance incrementally onto another's space or domain (territory / liberty / habitat) · poach: steal game, employees, or customers illicitly from another's preserve (talent / clients / wildlife) · trespass: enter onto private land or cross limits without permission (property / privacy / boundary) · infringe: violate, narrow, or chip away at established legal rights (patent / copyright / sovereignty) · usurp: seize sovereign power or status wholly without legitimate entitlement (throne / authority / role)
groups.nuance_zh: encroach: 蚕食式逐步渗透侵占边界或权益 (territory / liberty / habitat) · poach: 违规从他人地盘偷猎猎物或暗挖骨干资源 (talent / clients / wildlife) · trespass: 未经许可擅闯他人私有领地 (property / privacy / boundary) · infringe: 违犯或局部削弱他人合法权利 (patent / copyright / sovereignty) · usurp: 彻底颠覆并篡夺最高统治权力与名分 (throne / authority / role)

groups.name: Endure & Weather Trials · 经受与经受折磨 (Weather, Sustain, Braved)
groups.tip: 饱经风霜遭受考验

items.def_en: To suffer, experience, or receive damage, an injury, or a severe setback
items.ex_en: The offshore patrol vessel did not sustain structural damage during the violent typhoon.
items.ex_zh: 这艘近海巡逻艇在强台风袭击期间并未蒙受结构性损坏。

items.def_zh: 勇敢面对；经受（严酷环境）
items.def_en: To endure unpleasant, dangerous, or arduous conditions courageously
items.ex_en: Rescuers had to brave treacherous blizzards to reach the stranded alpine climbers.
items.ex_zh: 救援人员不得不顶着凶险的暴风雪去营救被困的高山攀登者。

items.def_en: 1. Past participle of undergo; to have experienced or been subjected to something.
items.ex_en: The historic cathedral has undergone extensive architectural renovations over the past three decades.
items.ex_zh: 在过去的三十年里，这座历史悠久的大教堂经历了广泛的建筑修复。

items.def_zh: 平安经受；顶住（风暴、危机）
items.def_en: To come safely through a dangerous storm, financial crisis, or intense trial
items.ex_en: The retail chain managed to weather the protracted recession without closing any stores.
items.ex_zh: 这家连锁零售企业成功顶住了长期的经济衰退，没有关闭任何一家门店。

items.def_en: To tolerate or endure an offensive, harrowing, or deeply unpleasant reality
items.ex_en: I simply cannot stomach his blatant hypocrisy during these solemn company meetings.
items.ex_zh: 在这些庄重的公司会议上，我实在忍受不了他那赤裸裸的虚伪嘴脸。

groups.summary_en: Focusing on passive or stoic endurance, verbs in this frame denote being subjected to physical changes, severe tests, traumas, or damages without succumbing. They emphasize structural or personal fortitude.
groups.summary_zh: 指承受剧烈变化、创伤或危机而坚持下来，强调耐受与扛住考验。
groups.desc_en: To withstand severe hostile conditions, physical assaults, or crises without breaking or surrendering, unlike mere passive non-resistance.
groups.desc_zh: 硬性抵御恶劣环境、冲击或风浪而保持不崩解或不退缩，区别于被动的逆来顺受。
groups.nuance_en: weather: survive and ride out a fierce external storm or crisis (storm / scandal / recession) · brave: deliberately face known danger with outward courage (elements / blizzard / bullets) · sustain: bear up under heavy damage or burden without collapsing (loss / injuries / blow) · undergo: pass through an arduous objective trial or transformation (surgery / audit / transformation) · stomach: endure an intrinsically repulsive or unpalatable condition (insults / violence / sight)
groups.nuance_zh: weather: 顶住狂风巨浪并最终挺过险关 (storm / scandal / recession) · brave: 毫无畏惧地迎风冒险直面险境 (elements / blizzard / bullets) · sustain: 承受重创打击或负荷而不致瓦解 (loss / injuries / blow) · undergo: 客观经历漫长艰难的考验或改造 (surgery / audit / transformation) · stomach: 忍受令人作呕或难以容忍的屈辱现状 (insults / violence / sight)

groups.name: Endure Hardship & Agonize · 煎熬与受难 (Suffer, Languish, Agonize)
groups.tip: 承受生理或心理的磨难

items.def_en: To experience or be subjected to an unpleasant, painful, or demanding process
items.ex_en: The patient had to undergo rigorous medical treatments to combat the rare infection.
items.ex_zh: 该患者不得不经受严格的医学治疗，以对抗这种罕见的感染。

items.def_en: 1. To experience physical or mental pain, illness, or severe hardship. 2. To experience or undergo something bad, unpleasant, or damaging.
items.ex_en: Many innocent civilians suffer terribly during prolonged periods of brutal civil conflict.
items.ex_zh: 在旷日持久的残酷内战期间，许多无辜平民遭受着巨大的痛苦。

items.def_en: To undergo and withstand lasting pain, hardship, or adversity without giving in
items.ex_en: The brave explorers had to endure extreme cold during their trek across Antarctica.
items.ex_zh: 勇敢的探险家们在徒步穿越极地时，必须忍受极端严寒。

items.def_zh: 在困境中受煎熬；衰颓憔悴
items.def_en: (+ in) To be forced to remain in an unpleasant, neglected place and suffer continuous deterioration
items.ex_en: The political prisoner was left to languish in a dark and damp dungeon.
items.ex_zh: 这名政治犯被弃置在阴暗潮湿的地牢中苦苦煎熬。

items.def_zh: 备受精神折磨；极度焦虑苦恼
items.def_en: (+ over/about) To experience extreme physical pain or, more commonly, severe mental torment
items.ex_en: She continued to agonize over whether to accept the demanding overseas job offer.
items.ex_zh: 她一直在极度纠结焦虑，不知是否该接受那份要求苛刻的海外工作。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses enduring prolonged physical pain, intense mental anguish, or deep privation. Nuances vary between helpless decline, acute agony, and patient fortitude.
groups.summary_zh: 强调长期经受身心痛苦、煎熬或在困境中备受折磨。
groups.desc_en: To endure protracted physical, mental, or spiritual torment marked by helplessness and profound distress, distinct from active, combat-ready struggle.
groups.desc_zh: 陷入漫长无助、痛苦压抑的生理或精神磨难，区别于积极战斗式的抗争。
groups.nuance_en: suffer: experience ongoing severe bodily or emotional distress (pain / loss / deprivation) · endure: bear persistent agonizing conditions over prolonged time (torture / hardship / loneliness) · languish: waste away and lose vitality in neglected or forced confinement (jail / obscurity / illness) · agonize: writhe in severe mental anguish over a dilemma (decision / choice / dilemma) · undergo: passively be subjected to a painful intervention or test (ordeal / treatment / examination)
groups.nuance_zh: suffer: 承受生理创伤或痛楚折磨 (pain / loss / deprivation) · endure: 隐忍苦撑长期的非人道考验 (torture / hardship / loneliness) · languish: 在受冷落、监禁或生病中日渐消沉虚耗 (jail / obscurity / illness) · agonize: 在艰难抉择中饱受精神煎熬内耗 (decision / choice / dilemma) · undergo: 被动接受痛苦的干预、疗程或审查 (ordeal / treatment / examination)

groups.name: Enforce & Execute · 强制执行与恪遵 (Execute, Implement, Impose)
groups.tip: 从日常推行到强制执行法律政策

items.def_en: To put a plan, system, treaty, or policy into official operation and practical effect
items.ex_en: The department will implement the comprehensive security protocol early next fiscal year.
items.ex_zh: 该部门将于下一财年初期正式实施全面的安全协议。

items.def_en: (+ on) To enforce laws or regulations much more strictly to stamp out illicit behavior
items.ex_en: Local authorities plan to crack down on unlicensed street vendors along the promenade.
items.ex_zh: 地方当局计划严厉打击沿海步道上的无照街头小贩。

items.def_en: To perform or carry out the requirements of a legal order, sentence, or administrative instruction
items.ex_en: The bailiff arrived this morning to execute the eviction order issued by the court.
items.ex_zh: 执行官今天上午抵达，以执行法院签发的驱逐令。

items.def_en: To officially force a rule, tax, punishment, or curfew to be accepted using governmental power
items.ex_en: The government decided to impose a strict overnight curfew across the troubled region.
items.ex_zh: 政府决定在动荡地区强制施行严格的夜间宵禁。

items.def_zh: 强制执行，贯彻（法律、规定）；强加，迫使
items.def_en: 1. To make sure that a law, rule, or system is obeyed. 2. To force something to happen or be accepted.
items.ex_en: The highway patrol works tirelessly to enforce speed limits on dangerous mountain roads.
items.ex_zh: 公路巡警不知疲倦地工作，以强制执行危险山路上的限速规定。

groups.summary_en: Refers to compelling compliance with laws, decrees, or mandates through authoritative mechanisms, state power, or sanctions, ensuring rules are actively applied rather than remaining dead letters.
groups.summary_zh: 依凭法定职权或惩戒机制强制落实法规、判决或规约，确保执行。
groups.desc_en: To compel adherence to laws, orders, or policies by utilizing institutional power and punitive pressure, distinct from voluntary compliance.
groups.desc_zh: 凭借体制强力和惩处手段迫使法规或决策落到实处，区别于听凭自愿遵守。
groups.nuance_en: enforce: apply institutional authority to compel legal compliance (law / discipline / compliance) · implement: put a planned policy or decision into practical operation (policy / agreement / strategy) · execute: carry out an authoritative command, sentence, or formal plan (order / decree / will) · impose: authoritatively inflict an onerous burden or requirement (sanctions / curfew / ban) · crack down: act decisively and harshly to suppress illicit behavior (corruption / dissent / smuggling)
groups.nuance_zh: enforce: 动用职权机制强行推行法规并惩戒违抗 (law / discipline / compliance) · implement: 将既定方针政策落到实处全面推行 (policy / agreement / strategy) · execute: 严格贯彻执行上级法令、判决或行动计划 (order / decree / will) · impose: 居高临下强加沉重负担或禁令 (sanctions / curfew / ban) · crack down: 采取高压严厉手段雷霆打击违法活动 (corruption / dissent / smuggling)

groups.name: Enforce & Impose · 强制与实施 (Reimpose, Enforce, Implement, Reinstate)
groups.tip: 再度强制执行法令规章

items.def_en: Put a formal plan, regulation, or policy into active practical effect
items.ex_en: The regional council pledged to implement sustainable urban transport initiatives without delay.
items.ex_zh: 地区议会承诺立即落实可持续的城市交通倡议。

items.def_en: Make people obey a legal rule, law, or obligation through authority or punishment
items.ex_en: Inspectors possess statutory powers to enforce occupational safety standards across all manufacturing facilities.
items.ex_zh: 督察员拥有法定权力，可在所有制造工厂强行实施职业安全标准。

items.def_en: Officially impose an administrative tax, tariff, fee, or legal fine
items.ex_en: The municipal authority decided to levy an additional tourism tax on luxury hotels.
items.ex_zh: 市政当局决定对豪华酒店征收额外的旅游税。

items.def_en: Restore a previous law, condition, practice, or authority to operational effect
items.ex_en: The prime minister moved swiftly to reinstate the controversial environmental regulation nationwide.
items.ex_zh: 首相迅速采取行动，在全国范围内恢复实施这项颇具争议的环境法规。

items.def_zh: 重新实施，重新征收，再次强制推行
items.def_en: to bring back and enforce a law, tax, restriction, or penalty that had previously been lifted
items.ex_en: Officials were forced to reimpose border restrictions following a fresh outbreak of infection.
items.ex_zh: 新一轮疫情爆发后，官员们不得不重新实施边境限制措施。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on applying authority, legal mandates, penalties, or restrictions, especially reinstating regulations to ensure societal compliance.
groups.summary_zh: 指官方动用职权推行法令、禁令或再度施行约束措施。
groups.desc_en: To apply external coercion or re-establish mandatory obligations, levies, or decrees by sovereign fiat, contrasting with persuasive alignment.
groups.desc_zh: 通过主权或国家意志强制推行或重新恢复具有法定义务性的指令与赋税，区别于协商性推行。
groups.nuance_en: enforce: ensure legal mandates are actively obeyed under threat of penalty (standard / curfew / ruling) · implement: systematically introduce an administrative framework (reforms / guidelines / protocol) · levy: officially assess and collect a mandatory financial extraction (tax / duty / tariff) · reimpose: force the return of a previously lifted restriction (lockdown / sanctions / tariffs) · reinstate: restore a revoked status, officer, or law to full active standing (officer / law / privileges)
groups.nuance_zh: enforce: 靠威慑手段强令落实法令准则 (standard / curfew / ruling) · implement: 制度化、体系化推进政策落地方案 (reforms / guidelines / protocol) · levy: 依法强制征课赋税或关税 (tax / duty / tariff) · reimpose: 再次对公众强加先前已废止的限制措施 (lockdown / sanctions / tariffs) · reinstate: 恢复原已被废除注销的法律、职位或特权 (officer / law / privileges)

groups.name: Engage & Interlock · 啮合与咬合 (Mesh, Interlock, Cog)
groups.tip: 齿轮部件互相扣合

items.def_en: To fit together or cause mechanical parts to interlock so that motion is transmitted
items.ex_en: The driver depressed the clutch so the gears would engage smoothly without grinding.
items.ex_zh: 驾驶员踩下离合器，以便齿轮能够平稳接合而不产生磨损。

items.def_en: To connect or adapt components smoothly to achieve a specific mechanical or functional relationship
items.ex_en: The mechanical system is carefully geared to handle sudden increases in electrical load.
items.ex_zh: 该机械系统经过精心协调配置，以应对用电负荷的骤增。

items.def_zh: （齿轮等）啮合，相扣；紧密配合，吻合；用网捕
items.def_en: 1. (of gear teeth) To fit together and engage. 2. To fit together or work together smoothly and harmoniously. 3. To catch in a net.
items.ex_en: The large cogs mesh smoothly together to transfer rotational power through the turbine.
items.ex_zh: 巨大的齿轮紧密咬合在一起，将旋转动力传递穿过涡轮机。

items.def_zh: 相互交错咬合，连接锁定
items.def_en: To fit together firmly with parts that cross, overlap, or hook into one another
items.ex_en: These sturdy concrete barriers interlock securely to form a protective perimeter wall.
items.ex_zh: 这些坚固的混凝土路障相互咬合锁定，构成一堵坚固的防护外墙。
items.ex2_en: Workers interlock the modular plastic panels to construct a temporary flood barrier.
items.ex2_zh: 工人们将模块化塑料板互相扣紧以建造临时防洪堤。

items.def_en: To fit together compactly and harmoniously like a carpenter's joint
items.ex_en: The two administrative proposals dovetail neatly to create a comprehensive development plan.
items.ex_zh: 这两项行政提案完美嵌合，构成了一份全面的发展计划。
items.ex2_en: The skilled carpenter dovetailed the sturdy cedar boards with great precision.
items.ex2_zh: 技艺精湛的木匠以极高的精度将结实的雪松木板用鸠尾榫嵌合。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate mechanical parts, components, or abstract systems fitting together precisely so that motion or purpose is transmitted smoothly. Collocations typically involve gears, teeth, cogs, or integrated strategies.
groups.summary_zh: 强调齿轮或构件紧密嵌合，亦指计划体系环环相扣。
groups.desc_en: To bring mechanical parts, teeth, or complementary components into precise physical contact to transmit motion or form an integrated whole, unlike smooth slipping.
groups.desc_zh: 使机械齿轮或互补部件紧密接合、彼此咬合并传递动力，区别于平滑的滑动或单纯贴合。
groups.nuance_en: mesh: interlock gear teeth smoothly or harmonize closely (gears / plans / schedules) · engage: bring mechanical drive components into active locking connection (clutch / gears / transmission) · interlock: fit complementary parts together so they cannot move independently (pieces / fingers / tiles) · dovetail: fit together smoothly and seamlessly to form a cohesive unit (interests / schedules / evidence) · gear: mechanically adjust or equip something to drive a specific function (operations / strategy / apparatus)
groups.nuance_zh: mesh: 齿轮啮合，或抽象事物间严丝合缝协调运作 (gears / plans / schedules) · engage: 使传动离合机制进入咬合连通状态 (clutch / gears / transmission) · interlock: 互锁交错固定使彼此无法分离 (pieces / fingers / tiles) · dovetail: 如燕尾榫般完美吻合、有机契合 (interests / schedules / evidence) · gear: 通过齿轮传动调节，或为特定目的进行机械化配置 (operations / strategy / apparatus)

groups.name: Engulf & Submerge · 吞噬与淹没 (Engulf, Swallow up, Submerge)
groups.tip: 巨浪深渊，彻底吞饮没顶

items.def_en: To plunge, sink, or completely cover something under liquid or water
items.ex_en: The rising tide threatened to submerge the ancient stone pathway within an hour.
items.ex_zh: 上涨的潮水眼看就要在一小时内将古老的石道彻底淹没。
items.ex2_en: The heavy submarine submerged quietly into the deep waters of the ocean.
items.ex2_zh: 沉重的潜艇悄无声息地潜入了海洋深水区。

items.def_en: To completely cover, envelop, or cause something to vanish, as if consumed whole
items.ex_en: Dark swirling clouds threatened to swallow up the tiny plane during the storm.
items.ex_zh: 暴风雨中，翻滚的乌云似乎要将那架小型飞机彻底吞噬。

items.def_zh: 吞没，淹没；（情绪等）席卷，彻底笼罩
items.def_en: (often passive) To surround and completely cover something, as by water or flames; to overwhelm or consume completely.
items.ex_en: Raging forest fires threatened to engulf the historic mountain village by nightfall.
items.ex_zh: 肆虐的森林大火眼看就要在夜幕降临前将这座历史悠久的山村吞没。

items.def_en: To flood an area with water so that everything is submerged
items.ex_en: Torrential monsoon rains threatened to inundate low-lying neighborhoods along the swollen river.
items.ex_zh: 倾盆而下的季风暴雨势要将暴涨河流沿岸的低洼街区尽数淹没。

items.def_en: To completely destroy or devour something, especially by fire or catastrophic force
items.ex_en: Fierce orange flames threatened to consume the historic library within a few hours.
items.ex_zh: 凶猛的橙色火舌眼看就要在数小时内将这座历史图书馆焚烧殆尽。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical forces—such as floodwaters, fire, or geological collapses—completely surrounding, burying, or consuming an object or person so it disappears. They are frequently used figuratively for overwhelming emotions or catastrophe.
groups.summary_zh: 指火势、洪水或灾变将事物全方位吞噬、淹没或完全埋没。
groups.desc_en: To drown, overflow, or swallow something completely within an overwhelming mass of liquid, fire, or force, distinct from superficial covering.
groups.desc_zh: 被大量液体、火焰或不可抗力彻底淹没、吞灭或包裹，区别于表层的覆盖。
groups.nuance_en: engulf: surround and consume completely in all directions (flames / darkness / crisis) · submerge: push or sink entirely beneath the surface of liquid (vessel / island / farmland) · inundate: overwhelm a space with a massive surging flood of fluid or volume (delta / market / requests) · swallow up: absorb and completely obliterate an entity into a larger mass (chasm / company / deficit) · consume: destroy utterly as if eaten away by destructive energy (fire / rage / fuel)
groups.nuance_zh: engulf: 四面八方席卷并彻底吞没 (flames / darkness / crisis) · submerge: 整体完全没入水面之下 (vessel / island / farmland) · inundate: 洪峰漫灌式淹没，或大量涌入令其难以招架 (delta / market / requests) · swallow up: 彻底吞噬吸收使之在巨物中荡然无存 (chasm / company / deficit) · consume: 像烈焰般将其烧尽吞噬或彻底消耗 (fire / rage / fuel)

groups.name: Enjoin & Mandate · 严令与戒律传达 (Direct, Mandate, Decree)
groups.tip: 行使权威强制吩咐与下令

items.def_en: To instruct or tell someone to do something with formal authority
items.ex_en: The presiding judge chose to direct the jury to disregard the biased testimony.
items.ex_zh: 主审法官决定指示陪审团不予理会那份带有偏见的证词。

items.def_en: To lay down authoritatively as a rule, requirement, or course of action
items.ex_en: The newly updated building regulations prescribe specific fire safety measures for high-rises.
items.ex_zh: 新修订的建筑法规对高层建筑规定了具体的消防安全措施。

items.def_en: To issue an authoritative, statutory, or official command to carry out an action
items.ex_en: Federal statutes clearly mandate regular auditing for all publicly traded financial institutions.
items.ex_zh: 联邦法规明确强制要求所有上市金融机构进行定期审计。

items.def_en: To order or establish something officially with legal or sovereign power
items.ex_en: The monarch issued an official decree declaring a month of national mourning.
items.ex_zh: 君主颁布了一项官方法令，宣布进行为期一个月的全国哀悼。

items.def_zh: 吩咐，命令，责成；（法律上）禁止，下禁令
items.def_en: 1. (+ on/to do) (formal) To instruct or strongly urge someone to do something. 2. (+ from) (law) To issue an official court order preventing or prohibiting someone from doing something.
items.ex_en: The federal court moved swiftly to enjoin the corporation from disposing of assets.
items.ex_zh: 联邦法院迅速采取行动，下令禁止该企业处置其资产。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses formal, authoritative, or legal directives instructing or obliging someone to perform an action or legally prohibiting them from doing so.
groups.summary_zh: 指依据权威、法律条令或高度职责严正命令、强制执行或司法禁令。
groups.desc_en: To authoritatively order, prohibit, or prescribe behavior backed by legal, judicial, or moral commandment, contrasting with optional recommendation.
groups.desc_zh: 依据法律、司法或道德权威发布具有强制拘束力的禁制令或指示，区别于建议性倡导。
groups.nuance_en: enjoin: issue an authoritative judicial injunction commanding or prohibiting an act (parties / strike / unlawful acts) · direct: authoritatively point an official or subordinate toward a designated course (staff / jury / inquiry) · mandate: make a course of action officially compulsory under legal authority (vaccination / mask-wearing / curriculum) · decree: issue an unchallengeable sovereign ruling by absolute fiat (amnesty / dissolution / mourning) · prescribe: lay down precise, mandatory rules or remedies to be strictly followed (doses / standards / penalties)
groups.nuance_zh: enjoin: 法院下达禁令强制要求当事人作为或不作为 (parties / strike / unlawful acts) · direct: 上级权威指导或责令下属依规行动 (staff / jury / inquiry) · mandate: 依国家法定授权将某举措设为强制义务 (vaccination / mask-wearing / curriculum) · decree: 凭借最高政权颁布不可更改的特权法令 (amnesty / dissolution / mourning) · prescribe: 规范性地开具硬性标准、规约或处方 (doses / standards / penalties)

groups.name: Enjoy & Relish · 享受与玩味 (Relish, Savor, Bask)
groups.tip: 沉浸于美好体验并细细品味咀嚼

items.def_en: To lie in warmth, or to enjoy and derive immense gratification from praise, attention, or success
items.ex_en: The triumphant athlete paused on the podium to bask in the crowd's applause.
items.ex_zh: 凯旋的运动员在领奖台上驻足，尽情沐浴在观众的掌声之中。

items.def_zh: 享受，喜爱；享有，拥有（有益之物）
items.def_en: 1. To take pleasure or delight in something. 2. To possess and benefit from something good or advantageous.
items.ex_en: Citizens in this peaceful region enjoy substantial legal rights and civil liberties.
items.ex_zh: 这个和平地区的公民享有丰厚的合法权益和公民自由。

items.def_en: To take immense pleasure in an experience, prospect, or thought
items.ex_en: The ambitious young trial lawyer seemed to relish the prospect of fierce courtroom combat.
items.ex_zh: 这位雄心勃勃的年轻诉讼律师似乎非常渴望在法庭上展开激烈交锋。

items.def_en: To enjoy a food, aroma, moment, or feeling slowly and deliberately so as to appreciate it fully
items.ex_en: He paused beside the garden fountain to savor the rich taste of dark chocolate.
items.ex_zh: 他在花园喷泉旁停下脚步，细细品味黑巧克力的浓郁风味。

items.def_en: To take fierce delight or satisfaction in a situation, state, or activity
items.ex_en: The victorious football team continued to revel in their unexpected championship win all night.
items.ex_zh: 获胜的足球队整夜都沉醉在出人意料夺冠的狂喜之中。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this affective frame denote experiencing deep pleasure, appreciation, or satisfaction from an experience, sensation, or triumph. Nuances range from lingering over sensory tastes to actively reveling in personal recognition or comfort.
groups.summary_zh: 强调对愉悦体验、感官滋味或荣誉的尽情领略与回味。
groups.desc_en: To take conscious, lingering, and keen emotional pleasure in an experience, savoring every aspect rather than experiencing it neutrally.
groups.desc_zh: 对某种感官、体验或荣光表现出细腻品味、流连忘返的沉浸式愉悦，区别于平淡度日。
groups.nuance_en: enjoy: derive straightforward happiness or satisfaction from an experience (meal / holiday / health) · relish: look forward to or consume an experience with robust, enthusiastic gusto (challenge / victory / opportunity) · savor: taste or contemplate every fine nuance slowly and deliberately (moment / success / flavor) · bask in: soak in and luxuriate in warm admiration, light, or glory (glory / praise / sunshine) · revel in: take undisguised, wild, or boisterous delight in a situation (freedom / chaos / triumph)
groups.nuance_zh: enjoy: 最普遍直接地享受乐趣或保有福祉 (meal / holiday / health) · relish: 满怀兴味、津津有味地品味挑战或机遇 (challenge / victory / opportunity) · savor: 细嚼慢咽般静心体会每一丝细微乐趣 (moment / success / flavor) · bask in: 沐浴在赞美、荣耀或阳光之中尽享温暖 (glory / praise / sunshine) · revel in: 纵情沉溺或狂喜于某种混乱或胜利 (freedom / chaos / triumph)

groups.name: Enlighten & Illuminate · 启迪与开导 (Enlighten, Illuminate, Edify)
groups.tip: 传授知识并启迪开导他人心智

items.def_zh: 使大开眼界，让某人认清现实
items.def_en: Make someone realize an unexpected truth or discover facts previously hidden from them
items.ex_en: The investigative documentary will definitely open someone's eyes to widespread political corruption.
items.ex_zh: 这部调查纪录片必定会让人们认清普遍存在的政治腐败这一真相。

items.def_en: To give someone greater knowledge, understanding, or insight about a subject or situation.
items.ex_en: The guest lecture served to enlighten students about complex global macroeconomic policies.
items.ex_zh: 这场特邀讲座在复杂的全球宏观经济政策方面启迪了广大学生。

items.def_en: Instruct or improve someone morally, spiritually, or intellectually
items.ex_en: The philosopher sought to edify his eager listeners through subtle moral allegories.
items.ex_zh: 这位哲学家试图通过精妙的道德寓言来陶冶那些求知若渴的听众。

items.def_en: Make something clear, lucid, and easy to understand intellectually
items.ex_en: Her detailed visual presentation helped to illuminate several highly ambiguous contractual terms.
items.ex_zh: 她详实的图文演示有助于阐明几条极其模糊的合同条款。

items.def_zh: 纠正，破除（某人的错误观念）
items.def_en: (+ of) Persuade someone that an idea or belief they hold is completely mistaken
items.ex_en: Hard scientific evidence quickly disabused the naive investors of their foolish notions.
items.ex_zh: 确凿的科学证据迅速破除了那些天真的投资者愚蠢的错误观念。

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote conferring deep understanding, spiritual or intellectual clarity, and moral perspective, lifting someone out of ignorance or confusion.
groups.summary_zh: 强调解开困惑、点拨思维以启发心智与认知。
groups.desc_en: To dispel cognitive darkness, ignorance, or error by imparting profound intellectual or moral insight, distinct from imparting basic raw data.
groups.desc_zh: 通过传授深刻的理智或道德认知驱散愚昧、偏见或蒙昧，区别于单纯提供冷冰冰的数据。
groups.nuance_en: enlighten: free someone from ignorance or misconception through superior understanding (mind / audience / citizens) · illuminate: cast bright conceptual light on a dense or obscure subject (matter / mystery / dynamics) · edify: uplift and cultivate someone's moral or spiritual character (public / soul / reader) · disabuse: free someone explicitly from a persistent falsehood or illusion (notion / illusion / preconceptions) · open someone's eyes: cause an abrupt, shocking realization of harsh reality (truth / reality / danger)
groups.nuance_zh: enlighten: 启蒙并引导脱离蒙昧无知 (mind / audience / citizens) · illuminate: 用理性之光照亮幽暗复杂的疑难学问 (matter / mystery / dynamics) · edify: 陶冶情操、在道德和精神层面予以开导教益 (public / soul / reader) · disabuse: 当头棒喝以消除其固有的执念或错误幻觉 (notion / illusion / preconceptions) · open someone's eyes: 让人猛然看清并醒悟残酷真相 (truth / reality / danger)

groups.name: Enshrine & Venerate · 供奉与铭记 (Enshrine, Commemorate, Venerate)
groups.tip: 载入史册入龛供奉与纪念

items.def_en: to recall and show respect for an event or person through a special act or monument
items.ex_en: Citizens gathered by the stone monument to commemorate soldiers fallen in battle.
items.ex_zh: 市民们聚集在石碑旁，深切缅怀在战斗中阵亡的士兵们。

items.def_zh: 把……置于神龛中供奉；珍藏，铭记
items.def_en: (literary) to enclose in or as if in a shrine; to cherish or enshrine
items.ex_en: Devoted followers often shrine the poet's memory in their personal daily reflections.
items.ex_zh: 虔诚的追随者常在日常冥想中将对这位诗人的记忆珍藏供奉。

items.def_en: to praise highly or raise someone or something to a very high level of honor
items.ex_en: Choral voices rose in majestic harmony to exalt the glory of creation.
items.ex_zh: 合唱的歌声庄严谐和地响起，极力颂扬造物的荣耀。

items.def_en: to preserve a right, tradition, or principle in a form that is respected and protected
items.ex_en: The progressive constitution seeks to enshrine equal educational opportunities for every citizen.
items.ex_zh: 这部与时俱进的宪法旨在将每位公民平等的受教育权奉为神圣准则载入法典。

items.def_en: to regard someone or something with deep respect, awe, or religious devotion
items.ex_en: Pilgrims from distant lands continue to venerate the sacred relics housed within the crypt.
items.ex_zh: 来自远方的朝圣者们持续崇敬着安放在地宫内的神圣遗物。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on holding persons, ideals, relics, or memories in sacred or honored esteem, preserving them respectfully in texts, institutions, or ceremonial memory.
groups.summary_zh: 强调将圣物、英烈或信条虔敬供奉、载入法典或永久铭记。
groups.desc_en: To establish and protect a memory, value, or person as holy and inviolable in collective memory or law, far beyond normal administrative recording.
groups.desc_zh: 将记忆、神圣价值或历史人物奉若神明并确立为神圣不可侵犯，远超一般的立档建案。
groups.nuance_en: enshrine: fix a cherished ideal or right firmly in a constitution or collective memory (rights / principles / memory) · venerate: regard an ancient person or relic with profound religious awe and respect (relics / elders / saint) · exalt: raise a person, idea, or god to the highest rank or status of praise (virtue / leader / station) · commemorate: formally celebrate and preserve the memory of a historic event or sacrifice (fallen / anniversary / sacrifice) · shrine: obsolete/rare variant of placing reverently within an altar or protective sanctum (relics / heart)
groups.nuance_zh: enshrine: 写入宪制或宝库奉为圭臬使其神圣不可撼动 (rights / principles / memory) · venerate: 带着宗教式的敬畏仰视并供奉尊崇 (relics / elders / saint) · exalt: 将某人或美德拔高推崇至至高无上的地位 (virtue / leader / station) · commemorate: 隆重举行仪式以铭记历史功绩或祭奠牺牲 (fallen / anniversary / sacrifice) · shrine: 罕见用法，将圣物安奉入龛内守护 (relics / heart)

groups.name: Entangle & Tangle · 纠缠与交织缠结 (Snarl, Enmesh, Intertwine)
groups.tip: 线缕杂乱交织无法解开

items.def_zh: 缠作一团；造成严重阻塞混乱
items.def_en: To twist or entangle into an intractable mess, or cause severe, tangled blockage
items.ex_en: A minor roadside fender bender managed to snarl up commuter traffic for hours.
items.ex_zh: 一起路边轻微刮蹭事故就足以让通勤交通严重堵塞数小时。

items.def_en: 1. To twist threads, hair, or wires together into an untidy mass, or become involved in a complicated dispute.
items.ex_en: The strong sea breeze will easily tangle your fishing lines into knots.
items.ex_zh: 强劲的海风很容易把你的钓鱼线吹得打结缠成一团。

items.def_en: To twist or twine together closely, whether physically or metaphorically
items.ex_en: Gnarled ivy branches intertwine tightly across the crumbling stone walls of the castle.
items.ex_zh: 盘根错节的常春藤枝条紧紧缠绕在城堡风化的石墙上。
items.ex2_en: The creative florist intertwined white ribbons with fresh red roses beautifully.
items.ex2_zh: 富有创意的花艺师巧妙地将白丝带与新鲜红玫瑰缠绕在一起。

items.def_zh: 使缠住；使卷入复杂困境
items.def_en: To cause something to become caught in a snare, netting, or a complicated situation
items.ex_en: Careless business dealings can entangle unwary executives in massive fraudulent schemes.
items.ex_zh: 疏忽大意的商业交易可能会让不谨慎的高管卷入巨大的欺诈阴谋中。

items.def_zh: 落入网中；使陷入（网络、困境）
items.def_en: To catch or involve someone or something deeply in a net or complex web of trouble
items.ex_en: Corrupt political dealings enmesh the naive diplomat in a dangerous web of deceit.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的政治勾当使这位天真的外交官深陷险恶的欺诈罗网之中。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers physical or figurative twisting and knotting together of threads, wires, limbs, or affairs, resulting in confusion, entrapment, or messy complication.
groups.summary_zh: 指线缆、毛发等互相盘绕死结，或比喻卷入复杂棘手的纷争陷阱。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the physical or metaphorical interlacing, knotting, or snaring of elements, contrasting with simple mixing by emphasizing disorder, entrapment, and difficulty of separation.
groups.desc_zh: 指实体或抽象事物相互缠绕、结扣或被网罗的图式，与单纯的“混合”不同，核心在于强调混乱受阻、陷入困境及极难解开。
groups.nuance_en: tangle: form an untidy knotted mass (hair / cords / yarn) · entangle: involve in a complicating web or trap (foot / affairs / legal disputes) · enmesh: ensnare deeply within an inescapable net or system (gears / bureaucracy / scandal) · intertwine: closely twist mutually together, often harmoniously (branches / fates / narratives) · snarl up: cause a dense, completely gridlocked mess (traffic / supply chains / operations)
groups.nuance_zh: tangle: 杂乱打结缠成一团 (hair / cords / yarn) · entangle: 卷入复杂罗网或受绊困住 (foot / affairs / legal disputes) · enmesh: 深度陷入难以自拔的体制或网罗 (gears / bureaucracy / scandal) · intertwine: 紧密交织或相融互结 (branches / fates / narratives) · snarl up: 严重打结瘫痪致停滞 (traffic / supply chains / operations)

groups.name: Enunciate & Formulate · 阐明与清晰陈述 (Articulate, State, Pronounce)
groups.tip: 字正腔圆咬字清晰地阐发观点

items.def_en: To make the distinct sounds of a word correctly, or to declare something authoritatively
items.ex_en: The high court justice prepared to pronounce the official verdict before a packed courtroom.
items.ex_zh: 最高法院法官准备在座无虚席的法庭前郑重宣布正式判决。

items.def_en: To express an idea, thought, or policy fluently, coherently, and in distinct terms
items.ex_en: The spokesperson struggled to articulate the administration's revised economic doctrine to journalists.
items.ex_zh: 发言人努力向记者们清晰阐释政府修正后的经济方针。

items.def_en: To express an opinion, doctrine, or policy in a carefully prepared, precise, and systematic way
items.ex_en: The senior cabinet committee met behind closed doors to formulate foreign trade policy.
items.ex_zh: 内阁高级委员会闭门举行会议，以系统规划对外贸易政策。

items.def_zh: 清晰阐明，明确表达；清晰发音
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To state an idea, principle, or belief clearly and definitely. 2. To pronounce words or sounds clearly and distinctly.
items.ex_en: The professor paused deliberately to enunciate every foundational concept of the scientific theory.
items.ex_zh: 教授特意停顿了一下，以清晰阐明该科学理论的每一个基石概念。

items.def_en: To formulate and state official rules, principles, or conditions firmly and clearly
items.ex_en: The government has laid down strict safety guidelines for the industry.
items.ex_zh: 政府为该行业制定了严格的安全指南。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame emphasize crystal-clear vocal diction or well-structured conceptual formulation. They contrast the physical clarity of phonation with the formal doctrinal exposition of policy or ideas.
groups.summary_zh: 口齿分明地发音，或系统清晰地陈述理论与主张。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the deliberate, structured externalization of thoughts into spoken or written language, contrasting with casual speech through its emphasis on precision, clarity, and systematic formulation.
groups.desc_zh: 指将思想条理化、清晰外化为话语或文字的图式，与普通“言说”不同，强调语音精准度、逻辑构拟与权威立论。
groups.nuance_en: pronounce: declare officially or utter phonetic sounds distinctly (verdict / words / vowels) · articulate: express ideas coherently with structural clarity (vision / grievances / arguments) · formulate: systematically devise and put into precise words (policy / strategy / hypothesis) · enunciate: articulate syllables with crisp clarity or publicly set forth a doctrine (principles / words / dogmas) · lay down: authoritatively establish binding rules or standards (rules / conditions / guidelines)
groups.nuance_zh: pronounce: 正式宣判或清晰发出字音 (verdict / words / vowels) · articulate: 逻辑严谨、条理分明地表达 (vision / grievances / arguments) · formulate: 系统化构拟并精准陈述 (policy / strategy / hypothesis) · enunciate: 字正腔圆地咬字或明确阐述主张 (principles / words / dogmas) · lay down: 权威性制定或明文规定 (rules / conditions / guidelines)

groups.name: Envy & Covet · 嫉妒与觊觎 (Covet, Crave, Hanker After)
groups.tip: 从暗中羡慕嫉妒到生出非分觊觎

items.def_en: To have a persistent, lingering, and restless longing for something unattainable
items.ex_en: After years of stressful corporate work, he began to hanker after country life.
items.ex_zh: 在经历了多年压力重重的公司工作后，他开始向往乡村生活。

items.def_en: To feel a powerful, urgent, and consuming desire for something
items.ex_en: Exhausted desert wanderers desperately crave a few drops of pure, fresh water.
items.ex_zh: 筋疲力竭的沙漠跋涉者们极度渴望得到几滴清澈甘冽的水。

items.def_en: To wish you had someone else's qualities, possessions, or advantages; to feel envious of.
items.ex_en: Many rival business leaders secretly envy her remarkable ability to inspire workers.
items.ex_zh: 许多竞争对手企业的领导人暗中嫉妒她鼓舞员工的非凡能力。

items.def_en: To yearn possessively to have something, especially something belonging to another person
items.ex_en: The greedy nobleman continued to covet the fertile ancestral lands of his neighbor.
items.ex_zh: 贪婪的贵族持续觊觎着邻居那片肥沃的祖传土地。

items.def_en: To have an overwhelming, unbridled desire or greed to possess something
items.ex_en: Ruthless dictators often lust after total unchecked control over their nation's wealth.
items.ex_zh: 残酷的独裁者往往极度贪求对国家财富的绝对掌控权。

groups.summary_en: This frame spans the desire spectrum from wistfully wishing for another's advantages to hungrily coveting and striving to possess what rightfully belongs to someone else. The intensity scales from passive longing to grasping greed.
groups.summary_zh: 体现从羡慕他人物事逐步升级至贪婪觊觎、极度渴望占有的心理阶梯。
groups.desc_en: Denotes intense acquisitive desire directed at possessions or qualities held by another or currently out of reach, contrasting with ordinary wanting by its gnawing hunger or invidious fixation.
groups.desc_zh: 指对他人拥有或自身匮乏之物的强烈占有欲与渴慕图式，与普通的“想要”相比，带有挥之不去的焦渴、觊觎或妒意。
groups.nuance_en: envy: resentfully wish for another's advantages or possessions (success / lifestyle / youth) · covet: yearn keenly to possess what belongs to someone else (neighbor's goods / throne / title) · crave: suffer an urgent, compulsive physical or emotional hunger for (sugar / attention / affection) · hanker after: hold a persistent, restless, often wistful longing for (freedom / luxury / past) · lust after: pursue with overwhelming, predatory, or sensual obsession (power / wealth / flesh)
groups.nuance_zh: envy: 因他人所得而心生羡慕嫉妒 (success / lifestyle / youth) · covet: 垂涎或贪图他人之所有 (neighbor's goods / throne / title) · crave: 身体或心理上极度渴求渴瘾 (sugar / attention / affection) · hanker after: 持续心痒神往或执念渴望 (freedom / luxury / past) · lust after: 带着强烈肉欲或贪念极度渴求 (power / wealth / flesh)

groups.name: Envy & Resent · 嫉妒与怨恨 (Resent, Grudge, Chafe at)
groups.tip: 心生嫉妒而暗怀怨尤

items.def_en: To feel irritated, impatient, or resentful because of constraints, unfairness, or rules
items.ex_en: Independent spirits inevitably chafe at the stifling bureaucratic rules of the institution.
items.ex_zh: 崇尚独立的人难免对该机构令人窒息的官僚规则感到焦躁怨懑。

items.def_en: To feel bitter, indignant, or angry about something or someone regarded as unfair
items.ex_en: Junior associates began to resent the exhausting and unpaid overtime demanded by management.
items.ex_zh: 初级员工开始对管理层要求的令人精疲力竭且无报酬的加班心生怨恨。

items.def_en: To give or allow with reluctance, or feel ill will toward someone for possessing something
items.ex_en: The miser seemed to grudge every single coin paid to his loyal staff.
items.ex_zh: 这个守财奴支付给忠诚员工的每一枚硬币似乎都极为不情愿。

items.def_en: To express discontent, sorrow, or bitter regret about one's unfavorable situation relative to others
items.ex_en: Disillusioned poets gather in dimly lit taverns to bemoan their lack of recognition.
items.ex_zh: 幻灭的诗人们聚集在昏暗的小酒馆里，哀叹自己怀才不遇。

items.def_zh: 嫉妒，妒忌；对……心存不满，怨恨；勉强给，吝惜
items.def_en: 1. To feel unhappy or resentful that someone has something, or to envy someone their success. 2. To give or spend something unwillingly or reluctantly.
items.ex_en: No fair observer would begrudge the tireless volunteer her well-deserved public recognition.
items.ex_zh: 没有任何公正的旁观者会嫉妒这位不知疲倦的志愿者应得的公众赞誉。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express bitter, brooding displeasure directed at another person's advantage, privilege, or success, or giving something with persistent reluctance. The tone highlights bitter indignation and simmering grievance.
groups.summary_zh: 表现因他人拥有优势、成功或待遇而心生不满、耿耿于怀或勉强给予。
groups.desc_en: Denotes simmering bitterness, irritation, or grievance caused by perceived unfairness or another's good fortune, contrasting with open anger by being prolonged, internalized, and begrudging.
groups.desc_zh: 指因感知到不公、受制于人或他人优越境遇而在内心积聚怨尤的图式，与暴怒不同，侧重持久内化的酸楚、不服与怨懑。
groups.nuance_en: resent: feel deep, enduring indignation over perceived slight or injustice (interference / treatment / intrusion) · begrudge: grant or concede reluctantly, or resent another's holding something (success / penny / praise) · grudge: harbor harboring latent malice or ill will over a grievance (praise / compensation / favor) · chafe at: feel impatient irritation and restlessness under constraints (restrictions / rules / delay) · bemoan: express deep sorrow or lamenting disapproval over (decline / fate / lack)
groups.nuance_zh: resent: 对不公待遇或冒犯感到愤恨不满 (interference / treatment / intrusion) · begrudge: 极不情愿给予或妒忌他人享有 (success / penny / praise) · grudge: 怀恨在心、舍不得给 (praise / compensation / favor) · chafe at: 对束缚规限感到焦躁不服 (restrictions / rules / delay) · bemoan: 为……鸣不平或哀叹遗憾 (decline / fate / lack)

groups.name: Equivocate & Evade · 含糊其辞与规避 (Equivocate, Hedge, Pussyfoot)
groups.tip: 含糊其辞企图蒙混过关

items.def_en: To discuss a topic at length while deliberately avoiding the central point
items.ex_en: Please stop trying to beat around the bush and address the main issue directly.
items.ex_zh: 请别再兜圈子拐弯抹角了，直接谈谈核心问题吧。

items.def_zh: 含糊其辞，回避；篡改，捏造（以蒙混过关）
items.def_en: To avoid giving a clear statement, answer, or commitment; to adjust or manipulate figures or facts deceptively.
items.ex_en: Stop trying to fudge the sales numbers just to impress the board of directors.
items.ex_zh: 别再想着用篡改销售数据来糊弄董事会了。

items.def_en: To avoid giving a direct answer or making a firm commitment by qualifying one's statements
items.ex_en: The minister hedged when reporters pressed him on the proposed tax hikes.
items.ex_zh: 当记者追问提议的增税事宜时，部长含糊其辞。

items.def_zh: 说模棱两可的话；含糊其辞
items.def_en: To use ambiguous language intentionally to deceive or conceal the truth
items.ex_en: The witness chose to equivocate under oath rather than reveal the damaging truth.
items.ex_zh: 证人选择在宣誓后含糊其辞，而不愿透露具有破坏性的真相。

items.def_en: To speak evasively or untruthfully in order to avoid an awkward truth
items.ex_en: Please answer the direct question immediately instead of continuing to prevaricate.
items.ex_zh: 请立刻正面回答这个问题，不要再继续闪烁其词了。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe intentionally using vague, ambiguous, or non-committal language to skirt a direct question, dodge accountability, or delay a hard decision.
groups.summary_zh: 故意运用模棱两可或留有余地的话语来回避正面回答或责任。
groups.desc_en: Denotes intentional evasion of direct commitment, truth, or confrontation through ambiguous, noncommittal, or misleading language, contrasting with straightforward lying by exploiting ambiguity.
groups.desc_zh: 指故意用含糊其辞、闪烁不定的语言逃避直接表态或对抗的图式，与直接撒谎不同，强调利用模棱两可来打马虎眼。
groups.nuance_en: equivocate: use ambiguous language deliberately to conceal the truth (answers / words / statements) · prevaricate: deliberately stall and speak evasively to avoid a blunt fact (under oath / questions / witnesses) · hedge: protect oneself against commitment by qualifying statements (bets / claims / statements) · fudge: manipulate, gloss over, or blur details to conceal weakness (figures / issues / boundaries) · beat around the bush: deliberate and roundabout delay in addressing the central point (issue / topic / question)
