groups.nuance_zh: equivocate: 玩弄双关语或模棱两可之词 (answers / words / statements) · prevaricate: 闪烁其词以推托搪塞 (under oath / questions / witnesses) · hedge: 说话留后路、两头下注不予承诺 (bets / claims / statements) · fudge: 含混搪塞或篡改粉饰细节 (figures / issues / boundaries) · beat around the bush: 拐弯抹角而不切入正题 (issue / topic / question)

groups.name: Eradicate & Wipe Out · 灭绝与根除 (Annihilate, Obliterate, Wipe out)
groups.tip: 斩草除根无一幸免

items.def_en: Destroy or eliminate someone or something completely
items.ex_en: One bad market crash could easily wipe out our entire family savings overnight.
items.ex_zh: 一次严重的市场崩盘很容易在一夜之间彻底抹去我们全家的积蓄。

items.def_en: To completely destroy or get rid of something harmful, such as a disease, poverty, or crime.
items.ex_en: Global health initiatives have worked tirelessly to eradicate infectious diseases worldwide.
items.ex_zh: 全球卫生组织不知疲倦地努力在世界范围内根除传染病。

items.def_zh: 抹杀；使不留痕迹地消亡
items.def_en: Remove or destroy all traces of something completely
items.ex_en: The devastating tsunami completely obliterated several coastal fishing villages within minutes.
items.ex_zh: 毁灭性的海啸在数分钟内将数座沿海渔村抹得不留痕迹。

items.def_en: Destroy something utterly so that nothing of it remains
items.ex_en: The surprise aerial assault threatened to annihilate the defending garrison completely.
items.ex_zh: 这场突如其来的空袭眼看要将守备驻军彻底歼灭。

items.def_en: Destroy completely a group of people, pests, or living things
items.ex_en: City authorities hired specialized contractors to exterminate the persistent rodent population.
items.ex_zh: 市政当局雇用了专业的承包商来彻底灭除顽固的鼠患。

groups.summary_en: Verbs depicting the absolute obliteration or wiping off the map of diseases, social plagues, or enemy populations until no remnant survives.
groups.summary_zh: 指彻底摧毁、消灭有害事物或种群，使之一点不留。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the total destruction, elimination, or uprooting of an entity so that nothing remains, contrasting with partial damage by asserting absolute nullification.
groups.desc_zh: 指对目标进行彻底销毁、连根拔除或肉体消灭的图式，与局部的破坏或抑制不同，强调完全抹杀其存在痕迹。
groups.nuance_en: wipe out: completely sweep away or destroy an entire group or asset (population / savings / species) · eradicate: tear up by the roots to prevent any recurrence (disease / poverty / corruption) · obliterate: blot out completely, erasing all surface trace or memory (record / city / memory) · annihilate: reduce to utter nonexistence or inflict total crushing defeat (army / enemy / opposition) · exterminate: systematically kill off every member of a living population (pests / vermin / race)
groups.nuance_zh: wipe out: 全盘席卷抹平或荡尽 (population / savings / species) · eradicate: 连根拔除使绝迹 (disease / poverty / corruption) · obliterate: 彻底抹去表面印记或摧毁无痕 (record / city / memory) · annihilate: 使化为乌有或毁灭性歼灭 (army / enemy / opposition) · exterminate: 彻底有组织地灭杀活物 (pests / vermin / race)

groups.name: Err & Blunder · 犯错与失误 (Err, Slip up, Trip up)
groups.tip: 从轻微差错到愚蠢大错

items.def_en: To make a careless or minor error through inattention or forgetfulness
items.ex_en: Someone in the accounting department must have slipped up.
items.ex_zh: 财务部肯定有人粗心犯了错。

items.def_en: To make a mistake in judgment, understanding, or moral decision-making
items.ex_en: Even the most experienced appellate judges can occasionally err in their statutory interpretations.
items.ex_zh: 即便是经验最丰富的老牌上诉法官，在法定解释上也偶有失误。

items.def_en: To make an unwitting, clumsy misstep or misjudgment in speech or conduct
items.ex_en: The nervous spokesperson stumbled badly during the live television interview yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 这位紧张的发言人在昨天的电视直播采访中明显失策说错了话。

items.def_zh: 犯愚蠢的错误，搞砸；跌跌撞撞地走
items.def_en: 1. To make a serious, clumsy, or embarrassing mistake. 2. (+ into/along) To move awkwardly, clumsily, or blindly as if unable to see.
items.ex_en: The inexperienced diplomat blundered during negotiations by misreading the treaty's core clause.
items.ex_zh: 那位缺乏经验的外交官因误解条约的核心条款而犯下了低级错误。

items.def_en: To judge or assess a situation, probability, or timing incorrectly
items.ex_en: Military strategists grossly miscalculated the strength of the opposing force's defenses.
items.ex_zh: 军事战略家严重误判了敌方防御力量的强弱。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on lapses in judgment, oversight, or uncalculated decisions that result in grave, foolish, or embarrassing mistakes.
groups.summary_zh: 强调因疏忽、误判或笨拙而犯下明显错误或重大失策。
groups.desc_en: Denotes deviating from correctness, sound judgment, or standard procedure, contrasting with deliberate wrongdoing by stemming from negligence, misjudgment, or human fallibility.
groups.desc_zh: 指偏离正确标准、合理判断或预期轨道的失准图式，与蓄意作恶不同，核心在于因疏忽、误判或偶发失控造成的过失。
groups.nuance_en: err: commit an intellectual or moral deviation from standard truth (side of caution / judgment / scripture) · blunder: make a stupid, clumsy, or catastrophic careless mistake (politically / negotiations / calculation) · slip up: commit a small, momentary, often inadvertent lapse (details / dates / scheduling) · stumble: falter momentarily or clumsily falter into error (words / speech / response) · miscalculate: assess a situation or mathematical quantity wrongly (risks / odds / distance)
groups.nuance_zh: err: 在判断、道德或道义上出现差池 (side of caution / judgment / scripture) · blunder: 犯下愚蠢、笨拙且后果严重的失误 (politically / negotiations / calculation) · slip up: 疏忽大意露出小破绽或失手 (details / dates / scheduling) · stumble: 出现小磕绊或中途失足 (words / speech / response) · miscalculate: 对形势、风险或数据发生误判 (risks / odds / distance)

groups.name: Erupt & Burst Forth · 爆发与迸发 (Burst, Break Out, Flare up)
groups.tip: 能量或情感突然剧烈释放

items.def_en: (+ into/out) To emerge suddenly, spontaneously, and with great energy or emotion
items.ex_en: She suddenly burst into tears upon hearing the tragic news about her friend.
items.ex_zh: 一听到关于朋友的噩耗，她突然痛哭流涕。
items.ex2_en: A sudden burst of anger caused him to burst the fragile bubble.
items.ex2_zh: 一阵突然的愤怒使他打破了这个脆弱的泡沫。

items.def_en: To begin suddenly and violently, used of wars, fires, riots, or epidemics
items.ex_en: Violent protests broke out across the capital following the disputed election results.
items.ex_zh: 选举结果引发争议后，首都各地突然爆发了暴力抗议。

items.def_en: To suddenly burn more intensely or suddenly erupt into conflict or anger
items.ex_en: Tensions between rival factions flared up again during the late afternoon demonstration.
items.ex_zh: 对立派系之间的紧张局势在午后的示威中再次骤然加剧。

items.def_en: 1. To burst out suddenly and violently, as in laughter, anger, or fighting. 2. When a volcano erupts, it suddenly throws out lava, ash, and gases.
items.ex_en: The long-dormant volcano suddenly erupted, sending massive ash plumes high into the sky.
items.ex_zh: 这座沉寂已久的火山突然喷发，将巨大的烟羽送入高空。

items.def_en: To burst into suddenly and forcibly, or to increase abruptly and uncontrollably
items.ex_en: Armed bandits suddenly irrupted into the banquet hall, terrifying the gathered nobility.
items.ex_zh: 武装盗匪突然闯入宴会厅，吓坏了在场的贵族。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe sudden, violent emergences into active existence, spanning geopolitical conflicts, fiery natural phenomena, and abrupt collective emotional outpourings.
groups.summary_zh: 描述冲突、火势或强烈情绪突发性地爆发或喷涌而出。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the sudden, violent breach of containment by accumulated pressure or energy, contrasting with gradual emergence by its abrupt, explosive force.
groups.desc_zh: 指蓄积的压力或能量瞬间破壳而出、激烈外涌的图式，与渐进式的发生不同，强调突发性、不可控与爆发力。
groups.nuance_en: burst: split or break open violently from internal pressure (pipes / balloon / bubble) · erupt: violently discharge built-up matter or suddenly break into noisy conflict (volcano / violence / applause) · break out: suddenly and uncontrollably start to spread across an area (war / fire / pandemic) · flare up: abruptly ignite or rekindle with bright, sharp intensity (tensions / tempers / symptoms) · irrupt: forcibly, suddenly, and invasively enter in great numbers (population / invaders / thoughts)
groups.nuance_zh: burst: 承压极限导致的爆裂冲破 (pipes / balloon / bubble) · erupt: 积蓄已久的地心式爆发或暴发 (volcano / violence / applause) · break out: 灾难性事态突然公开蔓延 (war / fire / pandemic) · flare up: 既有矛盾或病痛突然窜起加剧 (tensions / tempers / symptoms) · irrupt: 突然蜂拥闯入或外溢激增 (population / invaders / thoughts)

groups.name: Escort & Accompany · 护送与礼仪陪同 (Escort, Accompany, Conduct)
groups.tip: 随行守护移动过程

items.def_en: (formal) Lead or guide someone through, around, or to a specific place
items.ex_en: The chief protocol officer will conduct the foreign dignitaries through the royal gallery.
items.ex_zh: 首席礼宾官将引导外国贵宾参观皇家画廊。

items.def_en: Show someone the right way or lead them through a route or unfamiliar setting
items.ex_en: A local mountaineer volunteered to guide the research team through the treacherous pass.
items.ex_zh: 一位当地登山向导自愿带领科考队穿过险峻的隘口。

items.def_en: Go somewhere with someone as a companion, assistant, or escort
items.ex_en: Senior legal counsel will accompany the chief executive to the parliamentary hearing.
items.ex_zh: 资深法律顾问将陪同首席执行官出席议会听证会。

items.def_en: 1. To go with someone or a vehicle in order to protect, guide, or guard them, or as a courtesy.
items.ex_en: Armed federal marshals were ordered to escort the star witness to court safely.
items.ex_zh: 全副武装的联邦法警奉命护送这名关键证人安全前往法庭。

items.def_en: Guide or escort someone to a particular place, often politely and courteously
items.ex_en: The polite concierge quickly ushered the distinguished guests into the private dining salon.
items.ex_zh: 礼貌的礼宾人员迅速引着尊贵的客人们走进了私人用餐沙龙。

groups.summary_en: Describes traveling alongside someone to provide protection, security, authoritative guidance, or ceremonial respect. Contrasts casual walking with deliberate safeguarding or formal guidance.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重出于安保、护卫或礼节礼貌而护送、导引特定对象。
groups.desc_en: Denotes accompanying another person through space, contrasting with simply traveling alongside by introducing relational roles of protection, ceremonial deference, or spatial guidance.
groups.desc_zh: 指随同行进的空间移动图式，与单纯的“并肩而行”不同，蕴含保护性、礼仪敬重或路线引导等特定社会角色功能。
groups.nuance_en: accompany: go along with as a companion or concurrent event (guest / friend / piano) · escort: accompany for protection, security, or ceremonial honor (dignitary / convoy / prisoner) · conduct: formally lead or direct someone through a complex space or process (visitors / tour / orchestra) · guide: point out the path or direct the movement of another (tourists / vessel / expedition) · usher: politely show or guide someone to their designated seat or station (guests / audience / era)
groups.nuance_zh: accompany: 作为同伴结伴或事物相伴随 (guest / friend / piano) · escort: 出于护卫、押送或礼节性随行 (dignitary / convoy / prisoner) · conduct: 正式引路或带领穿行 (visitors / tour / orchestra) · guide: 指明道路方向或作为向导引带 (tourists / vessel / expedition) · usher: 礼貌引位或引领开启新阶段 (guests / audience / era)

groups.name: Estrange & Divide · 离间与使反目 (Alienate, Estrange, Disaffect)
groups.tip: 感情渐行渐远导致隔阂疏离

items.def_zh: 在……之间挑拨离间；造成分裂
items.def_en: To act in a way that damages good relations and creates mistrust between two parties
items.ex_en: His malicious rumors managed to drive a wedge between the two longtime business partners.
items.ex_zh: 他的恶意谣言成功在这两位长期商业伙伴之间挑起了隔阂。

items.def_zh: 使疏远，离间；使格格不入
items.def_en: (+ from) To make someone feel isolated, unfriendly, or detached from people, a group, or society.
items.ex_en: His harsh management tactics served only to alienate the staff from company leadership.
items.ex_zh: 他严苛的管理手段只会让员工与公司领导层渐生嫌隙。

items.def_zh: 使不忠；使产生反感与不满
items.def_en: To make someone discontented and disloyal toward an authority, leader, or organization
items.ex_en: Unfair distribution of resources will quickly disaffect the younger members of the faculty.
items.ex_zh: 资源分配不公会很快引起青年教师的不满与离心。

items.def_en: To cause someone to stop liking or supporting another and become hostile toward them
items.ex_en: The harsh smear campaign turned lifelong supporters against the veteran party leader.
items.ex_zh: 激烈的抹黑行动使长期的支持者反目，背弃了这位资深政党领袖。

items.def_zh: 使疏远；使夫妻或亲友反目
items.def_en: (+ from) To cause someone to become unfriendly, hostile, or indifferent where intimacy once existed
items.ex_en: Years of mutual suspicion finally estranged the two siblings from each other completely.
items.ex_zh: 多年的相互猜疑最终使这对兄妹彻底形同陌路。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on driving a wedge between people or groups, dissolving mutual affection, loyalty, or trust. The consequence is deep emotional rift and enduring hostility.
groups.summary_zh: 指破坏亲密关系或忠诚，导致情感疏离、反目成仇。
groups.desc_en: Denotes breaking the emotional, social, or political bond between formerly united entities, contrasting with plain physical separation by emphasizing emotional hostility and severed loyalty.
groups.desc_zh: 指破坏人际或政治群体间原有的亲睦或归属联结的图式，与空间分离不同，侧重情感上的冷落、背离与树敌反目。
groups.nuance_en: alienate: make someone feel indifferent, hostile, or isolated from a group (voters / allies / affections) · estrange: gradually cool and rupture close familial or romantic bonds (husband / child / family) · disaffect: cause loyal followers to become discontented and rebellious (workers / troops / citizens) · drive a wedge between: actively sow discord to split two parties apart (partners / factions / friends) · turn against: cause someone to shift allegiance into active hostility (benefactor / mentor / public)
groups.nuance_zh: alienate: 使原本友好的对象变得疏远冷漠或对立 (voters / allies / affections) · estrange: 使亲情或夫妻间日渐陌路失和 (husband / child / family) · disaffect: 使部属心怀不满并动摇忠诚 (workers / troops / citizens) · drive a wedge between: 挑拨离间使双方产生裂痕 (partners / factions / friends) · turn against: 使倒戈相向或反目成仇 (benefactor / mentor / public)

groups.name: Eulogize & Commemorate · 颂扬与致颂词 (Eulogize, Panegyrize, Pay tribute)
groups.tip: 从日常赞扬表彰升华至致悼词歌功颂德

items.def_en: To remember and honor an important person or past event with a ceremony or specialized work
items.ex_en: The city erected a monument to commemorate the brave firefighters who perished.
items.ex_zh: 该市竖立起一座纪念碑，以缅怀那些牺牲的英勇消防员。

items.def_en: To preserve the memory of an honored person or momentous event, often in words or a monument
items.ex_en: The marble monument was designed to memorialize the soldiers fallen during the conflict.
items.ex_zh: 这座大理石纪念碑旨在让人们铭记在冲突中牺牲的将士。

items.def_en: To express admiration, respect, or gratitude for someone's character or achievements formally
items.ex_en: World leaders gathered at the summit to pay tribute to the retiring diplomat.
items.ex_zh: 各国领导人齐聚峰会，向这位即将退休的外交官致敬。

items.def_en: To speak or write a formal speech or text of elaborate and extravagant praise
items.ex_en: The laureate composed an elaborate ode to panegyrize the emperor's military triumphs.
items.ex_zh: 桂冠诗人创作了一首长篇颂歌，极力赞颂皇帝的辉煌战功。

items.def_en: 1. (formal) To praise someone or something highly in a speech or piece of writing, especially at a funeral.
items.ex_en: Colleagues gathered at the memorial service to eulogize the late professor's achievements.
items.ex_zh: 同事们聚集在追思会上，深情颂扬已故教授生前取得的成就。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on eloquent, sustained, and highly formal tributes praising someone’s character or life work, most notably upon retirement, death, or momentous civic occasions.
groups.summary_zh: 在生离死别或重大典礼等正式场合，发表赞词对人一生或功绩进行颂扬。
groups.desc_en: Denotes public and formal praise or honoring of the dead, notable deeds, or institutions, contrasting with private compliments through elevated rhetoric and communal reverence.
groups.desc_zh: 指以崇高的公共仪式或庄重言辞对逝者、功绩或历史进行褒扬与纪念的图式，与私下夸奖不同，具有礼仪性、颂德性与集体肃穆感。
groups.nuance_en: commemorate: honor the historical memory of an event or person through ritual (anniversary / fallen / victory) · memorialize: preserve the memory of someone permanently in physical or literary form (victims / hero / sacrifice) · pay tribute to: publicly express deep gratitude, admiration, and respect for (mentor / legacy / service) · eulogize: deliver high, formal praise, typically in a funeral oration (deceased / leader / achievements) · panegyrize: offer elaborate, effusive, and ceremonial flattery or praise (conqueror / patron / deeds)
groups.nuance_zh: commemorate: 通过仪式或特定活动纪念历史与人物 (anniversary / fallen / victory) · memorialize: 设立纪念碑或著书立传以流传后世 (victims / hero / sacrifice) · pay tribute to: 正式向……致敬或表达由衷感念 (mentor / legacy / service) · eulogize: 发表正式悼词或深情颂扬 (deceased / leader / achievements) · panegyrize: 撰写华丽的颂文或高度赞颂 (conqueror / patron / deeds)

groups.name: Excavate & Hollow Out · 开凿与疏浚 (Excavate, Scoop out, Gouge)
groups.tip: 清淤捞渣或大面积深挖

items.def_en: To hollow out an interior space or remove loose material by using a concave tool or cupped hands
items.ex_en: She used a small wooden ladle to scoop out the melon's sweet interior.
items.ex_zh: 她用一把小木勺把甜瓜甜美的果肉舀了出来。

items.def_en: To extract stone, slate, or other materials by cutting or blasting from a large open excavation
items.ex_en: Workers continue to quarry massive blocks of white marble from the steep mountainside.
items.ex_zh: 工人们继续从陡峭的山腰上开采大块的白色大理石。

items.def_zh: 疏浚，清淤；捞取；翻出，重提（旧事）
items.def_en: 1. To clean out the bed of a harbor, river, or other area of water by scooping up mud and debris. 2. (usually 'dredge up') To bring up or recall unwelcome memories or facts
items.ex_en: Heavy machinery was brought in to dredge the silted harbor entrance thoroughly.
items.ex_zh: 重型机械被运来对淤塞的港口入口进行彻底清淤。

items.def_en: To make a deep hole or channel in the ground using earthmoving equipment, or uncover artifacts scientifically
items.ex_en: Construction workers used heavy machinery to excavate a deep foundation for the skyscraper.
items.ex_zh: 建筑工人开动重型机械，为摩天大楼挖掘深基坑。

items.def_en: To dig, scoop, or cut a deep groove, hole, or channel out of a solid surface with force or a sharp tool
items.ex_en: The sharp chisel managed to gouge a deep groove into the wooden plank.
items.ex_zh: 锋利的凿子在木板上硬生生凿出了一条深槽。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers systematically removing soil, silt, rock, or internal substance using heavy machinery, vessels, or tools to deepen channels or reveal subterranean structures. 'Excavate' emphasizes archaeological or construction digging, whereas 'dredge' focuses on scooping silt from submerged beds.
groups.summary_zh: 指运用机械或工具对水体、地基或物体进行疏浚、开凿或挖空。
groups.desc_en: Denotes removing material from the earth or a solid surface to hollow out, clear, or create a depression, contrasting with surface scratching by altering the three-dimensional interior space.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过掏空、切削或挖除泥土及坚硬基质以形成凹槽或深腔的图式，与表面划刻不同，强调对三维内部空间的成形与清障。
groups.nuance_en: excavate: dig systematically into ground or ruins to expose or hollow out (site / foundation / tunnel) · dredge: clear out silt, mud, and debris from underwater channels (harbor / riverbed / lake) · quarry: extract building stone or slate by cutting into a deep rock pit (stone / marble / limestone) · gouge: chisel or hollow out a deep groove with a sharp tool or heavy force (wood / flesh / groove) · scoop out: hollow out cleanly with a concave motion or tool (melon / earth / hollow)
groups.nuance_zh: excavate: 规范开挖地基或系统性挖出地下构造 (site / foundation / tunnel) · dredge: 疏浚水底泥沙沉淀物 (harbor / riverbed / lake) · quarry: 在矿场采石或凿石 (stone / marble / limestone) · gouge: 用利器或重力猛力凿挖出深凹痕 (wood / flesh / groove) · scoop out: 呈勺状利落掏出或挖空 (melon / earth / hollow)

groups.name: Excavate & Unearth · 发掘与出土 (Excavate, Unearth, Exhume)
groups.tip: 深层发掘铲出地下之物

items.def_en: To remove something from the earth by breaking up and scooping soil
items.ex_en: The media managed to dig up some scandalous details about his past.
items.ex_zh: 媒体设法翻出了他过去的一些丑闻细节。

items.def_en: To dig carefully in the ground to uncover buried objects, ancient ruins, or fossils; to hollow out earth to make a hole or channel
items.ex_en: Archaeologists will excavate the royal burial site to uncover ancient golden artifacts.
items.ex_zh: 考古学家将发掘这处皇家墓葬，以挖掘出古代黄金文物。

items.def_en: To find something that was buried in the ground by digging it up
items.ex_en: Construction workers managed to unearth several ancient Roman pottery jars yesterday afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 建筑工人们昨天下午在地下发掘出了几只古罗马陶罐。

items.def_en: To remove a dead body from the ground, especially in order to examine it formally
items.ex_en: The coroner obtained a warrant to exhume the remains for a forensic examination.
items.ex_zh: 验尸官获得了法庭搜查令，以掘出遗骸进行法医检验。

items.def_en: To take something out of the ground or a grave where it was buried
items.ex_en: The historical committee decided to disinter the soldier's remains for proper reburial.
items.ex_zh: 历史委员会决定掘出这名士兵的遗骸以便重新体面安葬。

groups.summary_en: This high-intensity physical frame denotes systematically removing earth to uncover buried ruins, artifacts, bones, or large subsurface spaces. It strongly collocates with archaeology, construction, and forensic disinterment.
groups.summary_zh: 指有目的、深层且系统性地清除土方，使地下文物、遗址或遗体出土。
groups.desc_en: Denotes bringing hidden, buried, or forgotten objects and bodies back into visibility from beneath the earth, contrasting with ordinary finding by requiring physical digging and unmasking concealment.
groups.desc_zh: 指将深埋于地下或岁月中隐匿的事物发掘出土、重见天日的图式，与偶遇发现不同，侧重克服覆土掩埋与重获见证。
groups.nuance_en: dig up: extract from the ground with standard tools, or unearth buried secrets (potatoes / dirt / bones) · excavate: professionally uncover ancient remains through archaeological discipline (tomb / fossil / settlement) · unearth: bring to light something buried underground or long hidden from public view (relics / scandal / evidence) · exhume: officially remove a dead body from the grave for forensic examination (corpse / remains / body) · disinter: dig up from a grave or bring back forgotten memories into discourse (casket / records / grievances)
groups.nuance_zh: dig up: 普通挖掘出土或翻出底细陈年丑闻 (potatoes / dirt / bones) · excavate: 考古专业性开掘出土 (tomb / fossil / settlement) · unearth: 挖出古物或揭露暗藏的真相黑幕 (relics / scandal / evidence) · exhume: 官方依法掘尸检验 (corpse / remains / body) · disinter: 起棺迁葬或重提被掩埋的旧事 (casket / records / grievances)

groups.name: Excerpt & Anthologize · 节录与采辑 (Excerpt, Extract, Cull)
groups.tip: 从文章或讲话中节选摘录内容

items.def_en: To copy, take, or plagiarize a phrase or passage directly out of someone else's writing
items.ex_en: The unscrupulous blogger lifted entire paragraphs verbatim from my newly published investigative article.
items.ex_zh: 那个毫无职业道德的博主一字不差地从我新发表的调查文章中抄走整段。
items.ex2_en: The dense morning fog lifted completely as the warm sun rose.
items.ex2_zh: 随着暖阳升起，清晨的浓雾完全消散退去了。

items.def_en: To select and copy out a specific passage, sentence, or data point from a book or text
items.ex_en: The editor decided to extract several compelling statistics from the annual financial report.
items.ex_zh: 编辑决定从年度财务报告中摘录几组引人注目的数据。

items.def_en: To select and include texts, poems, or stories in an anthology or collection
items.ex_en: Her celebrated early lyric poetry has been anthologized in several national literature textbooks.
items.ex_zh: 她广受赞誉的早期抒情诗已被收录入多本国家级文学教科书。

items.def_en: to take or select a short passage from a book, speech, film, piece of music, etc.
items.ex_en: The academic journal chose to excerpt several passages from his groundbreaking theoretical thesis.
items.ex_zh: 该学术期刊决定从他开创性的理论论文中节选若干段落。

items.def_en: To pick out, select, or gather excerpts and facts from various sources
items.ex_en: Scholars culled essential historical facts from numerous medieval church registers and municipal records.
items.ex_zh: 学者们从大量中世纪教会名册和市政档案中采选了关键史实。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on selecting, copying out, or compiling representative passages, chapters, or soundbites from a larger work.
groups.summary_zh: 从书籍、演讲或宏大作品中采选、摘取片段以供出版或引用。
groups.desc_en: Denotes selectively picking out parts from larger textual or artistic corpora to recontextualize them, contrasting with comprehensive copying by intentional curation and trimming.
groups.desc_zh: 指从宏大文本、曲目或材料库中有意识地节取片段并加以归汇的图式，与全盘照抄不同，强调裁量筛选与重构呈现。
groups.nuance_en: excerpt: take out a short representative passage from a longer work (novel / speech / interview) · extract: pull out a specific piece of information or quote deliberately (data / quotes / passages) · cull: select and gather the best or reject the inferior items from a collection (samples / facts / herd) · anthologize: compile selected literary or musical pieces into a collection (poems / essays / stories) · lift: plagiarize or take verbatim without credit from another's work (paragraphs / lines / design)
groups.nuance_zh: excerpt: 摘录有代表性的一段文字以供引证 (novel / speech / interview) · extract: 从大篇幅中抽取特定数据或语段 (data / quotes / passages) · cull: 甄选挑选精华或剔除杂质 (samples / facts / herd) · anthologize: 编选成文集或诗选集 (poems / essays / stories) · lift: 顺手牵羊、生搬硬套抄袭语段 (paragraphs / lines / design)

groups.name: Excise & Extirpate · 切除与全剔 (Resect, Gouge, Cut Out)
groups.tip: 彻底切掉或手术剔除

items.def_zh: 切除，删掉（病变组织或段落）
items.def_en: To remove a piece of text or body tissue by cutting
items.ex_en: He decided to cut out caffeine completely to improve his sleep.
items.ex_zh: 为了改善睡眠，他决定彻底戒掉咖啡因。

items.def_en: To force or scoop something out deeply and violently with a blade or sharp tool
items.ex_en: The attacker used a rusted blade to gouge out the prisoner's eye.
items.ex_zh: 袭击者用生锈的刀刃残忍地剜出了囚犯的眼睛。

items.def_en: To cut out or surgically remove tissue or an organ; to completely remove a passage or part from a text.
items.ex_en: Surgeons managed to excise the malignant tissue before it could spread further.
items.ex_zh: 外科医生在恶性组织进一步扩散之前成功将其切除。

items.def_zh: 手术切除（器官或组织一部分）
items.def_en: To surgically cut out part or all of an organ, bone, or tissue structure
items.ex_en: The surgical team decided to resect the necrotic portion of the patient's bowel.
items.ex_zh: 手术团队决定切除该患者坏死的部分肠道组织。

items.def_en: To surgically cut off an arm, leg, finger, or toe
items.ex_en: Doctors had no choice but to amputate his badly infected lower leg.
items.ex_zh: 医生们别无选择，只能将他严重感染的小腿截肢。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on radical, thorough surgical, editorial, or physical resection where an entire offending structure, diseased tissue, or banned text is excised cleanly.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过手术或彻底剪除手段，将病灶、组织或文字段落彻底挖除割掉。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the radical, surgical cutting away or eradication of an unhealthy, unwanted, or offending part, contrasting with light trimming by depth, finality, and totality of removal.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过利器手术般彻底切掉、剔除病灶或赘生物的图式，与轻度修剪不同，强调割除的深度、彻底性与绝断感。
groups.nuance_en: cut out: remove by cutting, or eliminate an unnecessary habit or section (tumor / middleman / scenes) · excise: surgically cut out tissue, or forcefully expunge content or impose tax (tumor / passage / levy) · resect: surgically cut off part of an organ or anatomical structure (bowel / colon / lung) · amputate: surgically sever an entire limb or appendage due to disease or trauma (leg / limb / arm) · gouge out: tear or dig out aggressively, causing a ragged cavity (eye / chunk / cavity)
groups.nuance_zh: cut out: 普通剪掉、切除或戒绝省去 (tumor / middleman / scenes) · excise: 深度切除病灶或硬性删减文字 (tumor / passage / levy) · resect: 针对内脏器官进行外科部分切除 (bowel / colon / lung) · amputate: 截肢截断肢体 (leg / limb / arm) · gouge out: 猛烈抠挖出或剜出 (eye / chunk / cavity)

groups.name: Exclaim & Cry Out · 感叹与惊呼 (Blurt Out, Cry Out, Proclaim)
groups.tip: 高声呼喊并带有感叹情绪

items.def_zh: 脱口而出；不假思索地说出
items.def_en: To utter abruptly and impulsively without thinking
items.ex_en: In her panic, she blurted out the secret location of the hidden documents.
items.ex_zh: 慌乱之下，她脱口说出了隐藏机密文件的具体位置。

items.def_en: To make a sudden loud exclamation of pain, alarm, or surprise
items.ex_en: The injured hiker cried out in sudden agony when he twisted his ankle.
items.ex_zh: 扭伤脚踝时，受伤的徒步旅行者痛得失声惊叫。

items.def_en: To say something breathlessly while drawing in breath sharply from surprise
items.ex_en: "He really took the money?" she gasped, clapping a hand over her mouth.
items.ex_zh: “钱真是他拿的？”她倒抽了一口凉气惊呼道，用手捂住了嘴。

items.def_en: (literary/dated) To say something suddenly and passionately
items.ex_en: "Great heavens, you are alive!" ejaculated the old sailor in utter astonishment.
items.ex_zh: “天哪，你还活着！”老水手在极度震惊中脱口喊道。

items.def_zh: （因惊讶、激动或愤怒而）高声呼喊，惊呼，感叹
items.def_en: To cry out or speak suddenly and loudly because of surprise, strong emotion, or pain.
items.ex_en: "We won the championship!" the overjoyed coach exclaimed before the cheering crowd.
items.ex_zh: “我们夺冠了！”欢欣鼓舞的教练在欢呼的观众面前激动地高呼。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey spontaneous, vocalized reactions to sudden surprise, amazement, alarm, or overwhelming emotion, emphasizing the bursting nature of the utterance.
groups.summary_zh: 指因震惊、狂喜或突发刺激而情不自禁地脱口惊呼或抒发感叹。
groups.desc_en: Denotes vocalizing sudden, involuntary emotion or shock, contrasting with deliberate speech through its explosive prosody, breath disruption, and lack of premeditation.
groups.desc_zh: 指在震惊、疼痛或激愤等冲动下不由自主发声的图式，与从容说话不同，强调瞬时性、声调突兀且往往不假思索。
groups.nuance_en: exclaim: speak suddenly and vehemently under the influence of strong emotion (in surprise / in delight / aloud) · cry out: emit a loud, instinctive vocal sound of pain, terror, or protest (in agony / for help / against injustice) · gasp: utter while suddenly catching one's breath in astonishment or pain (in horror / for air / words) · blurt out: utter impulsively and tactlessly without thinking (secret / confession / truth) · ejaculate: suddenly and abruptly utter a brief exclamation (an oath / a remark / a cry)
groups.nuance_zh: exclaim: 情绪激动或惊讶之下发出感叹惊呼 (in surprise / in delight / aloud) · cry out: 因痛苦、恐惧而本能叫喊呼救 (in agony / for help / against injustice) · gasp: 倒吸冷气、气喘吁吁地吐出话语 (in horror / for air / words) · blurt out: 脱口而出、不加思索捅出秘密 (secret / confession / truth) · ejaculate: 突然唐突短促地失声吐出 (an oath / a remark / a cry)

groups.name: Exemplify & Epitomize · 体现与典范 (Exemplify, Distill, Mirror)
groups.tip: 作为典型化身并集中代表

items.def_en: To reflect or correspond closely to the qualities, moods, or patterns of something else
items.ex_en: Her expressive face seemed to mirror every subtle shift in the ongoing debate.
items.ex_zh: 她表情丰富生动的脸庞似乎折射出这场辩论的每一个微妙变化。

items.def_en: To serve as a perfect summary or representation of the essential character of something
items.ex_en: His selfless devotion during the crisis sums up the true spirit of volunteerism.
items.ex_zh: 他在危机期间无私的奉献生动体现了志愿服务的真正精神。

items.def_en: To illustrate, explain, or stand as a prime example of a general rule or trend
items.ex_en: These well-documented case studies clearly exemplify the practical challenges of urban renewal projects.
items.ex_zh: 这些记录详实的案例研究清楚地例证了城市更新项目的实际挑战。

items.def_en: To express or condense the essential qualities of something in a concise, compact form
items.ex_en: The concise motto seemed to encapsulate the entire philosophy behind the company's design.
items.ex_zh: 这句简短的座右铭似乎浓缩体现了公司设计背后的全部理念。

items.def_zh: 成为……的典型（或缩影），集中体现；概括，摘要
items.def_en: 1. To be a perfect or typical example of something. 2. (formal) To give a summary or epitome of a piece of work.
items.ex_en: Her elegant performance epitomises the timeless classical grace of traditional European ballet.
items.ex_zh: 她优雅的表演集中体现了传统欧洲芭蕾经久不衰的古典魅力。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on serving as the supreme, quintessential model or classic illustration of a broader phenomenon. Contrasts serving as an informative example with functioning as its ultimate paradigm.
groups.summary_zh: 指充当某一类事物最为典型、完美或浓缩的代表与例证。
groups.desc_en: Denotes serving as a quintessential, representative, or concentrated manifestation of an abstract quality, contrasting with mere illustration by embodying the very perfection or essence of the type.
groups.desc_zh: 指作为某类抽象特质的至高典型、缩影或高度凝练体现的图式，与普通“举例说明”不同，强调自身即代表了极致与全貌。
groups.nuance_en: exemplify: provide a clear, typical example of a quality or concept (trend / excellence / standard) · epitomise: embody the pure, consummate archetype of a whole genre or quality (elegance / spirit / generation) · encapsulate: capture and express the essential substance of something concisely (essence / argument / era) · mirror: accurately reflect or correspond to an external condition or reality (anxieties / changes / society) · sum up: condense and articulate the conclusive whole of an experience (situation / feeling / mood)
groups.nuance_zh: exemplify: 作为最典型的实证范例说明 (trend / excellence / standard) · epitomise: 成为……的绝佳缩影或登峰造极的典型 (elegance / spirit / generation) · encapsulate: 将庞大要义高度浓缩封存 (essence / argument / era) · mirror: 逼真反映、折射出外部现实 (anxieties / changes / society) · sum up: 综括提炼总体精髓 (situation / feeling / mood)

groups.name: Exempt & Release · 豁免与免除 (Exempt, Excuse, Discharge)
groups.tip: 免除法定责任或特定义务

items.def_en: (+ from) To officially allow someone not to do something that is normally mandatory
items.ex_en: The doctor wrote a formal note to excuse him from mandatory physical training.
items.ex_zh: 医生开具了一份正式证明，准许他免予参加强制性体能训练。

items.def_en: To choose not to punish someone for an offense, or punish them very lightly
items.ex_en: The lenient traffic judge decided to let him off with a stern warning.
items.ex_zh: 宽容的交通法官决定网开一面，只对他予以严厉警告。

items.def_zh: 解除；准许离开(债务/职责)
items.def_en: To officially release someone from a legal duty, contract, debt, or institutional stay
items.ex_en: The bankruptcy court issued an order to discharge him from all previous debts.
items.ex_zh: 破产法院下达裁定，正式免除他之前所欠的一切债务。

items.def_en: To officially excuse someone or something from a duty, payment, or rule that others have to obey.
items.ex_en: Charitable organizations are legally exempt from paying corporate tax on their annual donations.
items.ex_zh: 慈善机构在法律上获准免除对其年度捐款征收的企业所得税。

items.def_en: To formally state that a normal rule, fee, requirement, or right will not be enforced
items.ex_en: The university agreed to waive the late application fee for low-income students.
items.ex_zh: 大学同意为低收入学生免除逾期申请费。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers legal and administrative acts whereby an authority formally relieves an individual or organization from an otherwise mandatory obligation, penalty, liability, or tax.
groups.summary_zh: 指官方或权威机构依法免除某人应履行的责任、税赋或惩罚。
groups.desc_en: Denotes legally, officially, or mercifully releasing an individual from a normal duty, liability, or penalty, contrasting with forgiving an offense by canceling an ongoing institutional obligation.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过权威、法规或格外开恩免去某人本应承担的法定义务、惩戒或规约的图式，不同于情感层面的宽恕，侧重制度性约束的解除。
groups.nuance_en: exempt: officially free someone from a general rule, tax, or obligation (tax / military service / duty) · discharge: officially release from an institutional custody, duty, or debt (patient / bankrupt / soldier) · waive: voluntarily forgo an otherwise enforceable legal claim or requirement (rights / fee / privilege) · excuse: overlook a fault or grant permission to be absent from an obligation (absence / behavior / slip) · let off: refrain from punishing an offender or impose a very mild penalty (light sentence / hook / warning)
groups.nuance_zh: exempt: 依照规章制度豁免义务或税役 (tax / military service / duty) · discharge: 正式解雇、令出院或注销债务 (patient / bankrupt / soldier) · waive: 主动自愿放弃合法权益或费用 (rights / fee / privilege) · excuse: 宽免小过失或准予免除 (absence / behavior / slip) · let off: 从轻发落、网开一面不予追究 (light sentence / hook / warning)

groups.name: Exhume & Unearth · 发掘与掘出 (Exhume, Unearth, Dig up)
groups.tip: 掘开土壤取出掩埋之物

items.def_en: To remove something from under the ground by digging, or to uncover hidden information with effort
items.ex_en: The media managed to dig up some scandalous details about his past.
items.ex_zh: 媒体设法翻出了他过去的一些丑闻细节。

items.def_en: To bring a dead body back to life, or figuratively revive a forgotten practice, memory, or idea
items.ex_en: The committee sought to resurrect an abandoned policy to curb inflation.
items.ex_zh: 委员会试图重新起用一项被废弃的政策来遏制通胀。

items.def_en: To find or dig something out of the ground through excavation, or to discover long-hidden facts
items.ex_en: Archaeologists managed to unearth several ancient bronze vessels near the riverbank.
items.ex_zh: 考古学家在河岸附近成功发掘出几件古代青铜器。

items.def_en: To dig up a buried corpse from the ground, especially for medical or legal examination
items.ex_en: The court ordered officials to exhume the body for a postmortem examination.
items.ex_zh: 法院命令官员掘出尸体以进行尸检。

items.def_zh: 掘出，发掘（尤指尸体）；使显露，揭露
items.def_en: (formal) To dig up something, especially a dead body, that has been buried; to bring back or uncover something hidden or forgotten
items.ex_en: Investigators obtained permission to disinter the remains to extract crucial DNA evidence.
items.ex_zh: 调查人员获准掘出遗骸以提取关键的DNA证据。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to digging up buried corpses, hidden artifacts, or long-forgotten secrets out of the earth or obscurity. While 'exhume' is legally and medically specific to buried bodies, 'unearth' and 'dig up' extend freely to archaeology, evidence, and historical secrets.
groups.summary_zh: 指自地下或隐秘处掘出遗骸、文物或揭开被遗忘秘辛。
groups.desc_en: Removing buried physical remains or long-concealed facts from subterranean obscurity into active view, contrasting with plain 'find' or 'discover' by requiring physical or metaphorical excavation through layers of suppression.
groups.desc_zh: 将埋于地下或长期隐匿的实体遗骸、隐秘真相掘出并重见天日；与普通“发现/寻找”不同，本框架强调穿透沉积层或压制状态的深挖与起掘过程。
groups.nuance_en: dig up: informal physical excavation or persistent digging into secrets (bones / dirt / scandal) · unearth: uncovering long-hidden facts or archaeological artifacts (evidence / treasure / past) · exhume: formal, legally authorized disinterment of a corpse (body / remains / corpse) · disinter: formal or literary exhumation or revival from oblivion (cadaver / memories) · resurrect: restoring dead, dormant, or obsolete practices to life (career / issue / tradition)
groups.nuance_zh: dig up: 通俗的挖出实物或深挖隐私猛料 (bones / dirt / scandal) · unearth: 经发掘使长期湮没的文物或真相重见天日 (evidence / treasure / past) · exhume: 官方或法律层面上开棺掘尸 (body / remains / corpse) · disinter: 文雅正式的掘尸或使遗忘之物重现 (cadaver / memories) · resurrect: 赋予死亡、沉睡或废除之物以新生 (career / issue / tradition)

groups.name: Exonerate & Vindicate · 洗雪与昭雪 (Vindicate, Exonerate, Clear)
groups.tip: 据理力争洗刷污名证明正确

items.def_en: (+ of) To prove that someone is innocent of a crime, accusation, or misconduct
items.ex_en: Surveillance footage helped clear the suspect of all armed robbery charges.
items.ex_zh: 监控录像帮助洗清了嫌疑人的所有持械抢劫指控。
items.ex2_en: The stormy skies cleared rapidly after the heavy afternoon downpour ended.
items.ex2_zh: 午后大雨停歇后，暴风雨弥漫的天空迅速放晴。

items.def_en: (+ of) To officially decide in a court of law that someone is not guilty of a specific charge
items.ex_en: The jury took merely two hours to acquit the defendant of murder.
items.ex_zh: 陪审团仅用了两小时就判决被告谋杀罪名不成立。

items.def_zh: 证实……正确，证明……无辜，辩白
items.def_en: To prove that someone or something is right, reasonable, or innocent after being blamed or questioned.
items.ex_en: Subsequent financial audits fully vindicated her controversial investment strategy.
items.ex_zh: 随后的财务审计充分证实了她那备受争议的投资策略是正确的。

items.def_en: (+ of/from) To formally declare someone free from guilt, blame, or moral obligation
items.ex_en: The independent tribunal absolved the company from any blame for the disaster.
items.ex_zh: 独立法庭免除了该企业在这起灾难中的任何责任。

items.def_en: (+ from) To officially declare that someone is free from blame, fault, or legal responsibility
items.ex_en: Newly discovered documents exonerated the former director from charges of corruption.
items.ex_zh: 新发现的文件免除了前主管受到的贪腐指控。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe officially proving innocence, establishing truth, or releasing someone from sustained blame, suspicion, or false accusation through decisive evidence or subsequent events.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过确凿证据或事实证明清白、洗刷嫌疑或昭雪冤屈。
groups.desc_en: Formally releasing an individual from culpability, suspicion, or historical slander through decisive proof or authoritative decree, contrasting with mere 'forgive' or 'pardon' by actively proving innocence or restoring honor.
groups.desc_zh: 通过确凿证据或权威裁定，彻底洗清当事人的嫌疑、罪责或历史污名；与单纯的“宽恕/赦免”不同，本框架侧重确立清白或昭雪昭彰，恢复受损名誉。
groups.nuance_en: clear: plain removal of suspicion or operational approval (name / charges / hurdle) · acquit: formal judicial pronouncement of not guilty (defendant / suspect / prisoner) · exonerate: authoritative, total absolution from severe blame or criminal conviction (inmate / official / suspect) · vindicate: proving correctness, honor, or innocence against past doubt or criticism (claim / decision / honor) · absolve: moral, religious, or formal release from guilt, sin, or liability (sinner / penitent / debtor)
groups.nuance_zh: clear: 最通俗的澄清嫌疑或解除指控 (name / charges / hurdle) · acquit: 法庭通过司法程序正式宣判无罪 (defendant / suspect / prisoner) · exonerate: 彻底免除沉重的道义谴责或洗雪冤狱 (inmate / official / suspect) · vindicate: 借铁证洗刷冤屈，有力证明当初的决定或人品正确 (claim / decision / honor) · absolve: 宗教、道德或责任上的赦罪与彻底免责 (sinner / penitent / debtor)

groups.name: Expatiate & Disclose At Length · 详述与长篇论述 (Expatiate, Dilate, Hold Forth)
groups.tip: 就特定主题作长篇论说

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To engage in a lengthy, formal discussion or exposition regarding a subject
items.ex_en: The visiting scholar will discourse upon medieval philosophy during tomorrow's keynote lecture.
items.ex_zh: 这位访问学者将在明天的专题讲座中系统论述中世纪哲学。

items.def_zh: 大发议论；滔滔不绝地讲
items.def_en: (+ on) To express opinions lengthily and authoritatively, often to an assembled group
items.ex_en: He was holding forth on politics to anyone who would listen.
items.ex_zh: 他逢人便大发议论，大谈特谈政治。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To speak or write at great length or in extensive detail about a topic
items.ex_en: The professor continued to expatiate upon the nuances of contractual obligations.
items.ex_zh: 教授继续详述合同义务中的各种细微差别。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) (formal) To speak or write at length and expand expansively upon a theme
items.ex_en: The speaker tended to dilate on ancient history whenever given the opportunity.
items.ex_zh: 每当有机会，演讲者往往会就古代历史详加论述。
items.ex2_en: The optometrist used special eye drops to dilate the patient's pupils.
items.ex2_zh: 验光师使用专门的眼药水来放大患者的瞳孔。

items.def_zh: 长篇论述，详细述评；唱高音部
items.def_en: (also 'descant on') (formal) To talk or write at great length about a subject.
items.ex_en: He proceeded to descant upon the virtues of classical education for hours.
items.ex_zh: 他接着就古典教育的长处长篇论述了数小时。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this rhetorical frame signify speaking, pontificating, or writing at exhaustive length about a subject. They often carry connotations of formal disquisition, academic fullness, or self-indulgent verbosity.
groups.summary_zh: 指详尽、冗长或滔滔不绝地就某一话题阐发论述。
groups.desc_en: Sustained, highly discursive speech or writing that unfolds at exhaustive length, contrasting with basic 'talk' or 'discuss' by emphasizing deliberate, expansive rhetorical ornamentation and lack of concision.
groups.desc_zh: 长时间、广涉枝节地长篇大论或详尽推阐；与单纯的“交谈/讨论”不同，本框架突显讲论者主导话语权、铺陈展开、不惮繁冗的修辞倾向。
groups.nuance_en: discourse: reasoned, elevated formal monologue or lecture (philosophy / theology / politics) · hold forth: pontificating self-importantly or sustainedly in public (opinion / topic / company) · expatiate: dwelling copiously and lingering over details (subject / theme / virtues) · dilate: expanding methodically upon an idea or text (topic / matter / scripture) · descant: delivering a sustained, ornate rhetorical commentary (merits / woes / themes)
groups.nuance_zh: discourse: 具学者风范的高雅论述或严肃演讲 (philosophy / theology / politics) · hold forth: 在众人前高谈阔论、夸夸其谈 (opinion / topic / company) · expatiate: 兴致勃勃地不厌其详、铺陈漫谈 (subject / theme / virtues) · dilate: 就某一观点或主题详加推衍剖析 (topic / matter / scripture) · descant: 带有修辞色彩地长篇阐发或抒发议论 (merits / woes / themes)

groups.name: Expend & Consume · 花费与消耗 (Spend, Exhaust, Deplete)
groups.tip: 用尽物力财力与时间

items.def_zh: 花费，耗费（金钱、时间、精力）
items.def_en: to pay out money or utilize time and energy on a specific activity or purchase
items.ex_en: They spend considerable time and money on modernizing their manufacturing facilities.
items.ex_zh: 他们花费了相当多的时间和资金来升级其制造设施。

items.def_en: to completely use up supplies, funds, or reserves so that nothing remains
items.ex_en: Prolonged military conflict threatened to exhaust the nation's strategic fuel reserves.
items.ex_zh: 长期的军事冲突可能会耗竭该国的战略燃料储备。

items.def_en: to exhaust the whole of a available supply of materials, energy, or money
items.ex_en: We used up all the flour baking cookies this morning.
items.ex_zh: 今天早上烤饼干把我们所有的面粉都用光了。

items.def_en: to reduce the amount or supply of something valuable significantly
items.ex_en: Severe droughts continue to deplete regional groundwater supplies at an alarming rate.
items.ex_zh: 严重的干旱继续以惊人的速度大幅消耗该地区的地下水供应。

items.def_zh: 花费，耗费，消耗（时间、金钱、精力等）
items.def_en: to spend or use up resources, such as money, time, or energy, for a specific purpose
items.ex_en: The team had to expend immense energy to meet the strict deadline.
items.ex_zh: 团队不得不耗费巨大的精力来赶上紧迫的截止日期。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate paying out funds or using up finite resources like time, energy, fuel, or patience toward an end until significantly diminished or depleted.
groups.summary_zh: 指为某项目的而支出金钱，或彻底消耗利用有限的时间、精力与资源。
groups.desc_en: Draining finite physical, mental, or material resources until severely reduced or completely gone, contrasting with neutral 'use' or 'pay' by emphasizing cumulative reduction toward ultimate exhaustion.
groups.desc_zh: 对有限的体能、财力或物资储备进行不可逆的持续消耗直至告罄；与中性的“使用/花费”不同，本框架强调储备的递减与濒临枯竭的终态。
groups.nuance_en: spend: ordinary allocation of money, time, or standard energy (money / time / effort) · expend: formal deployment of substantial reserves for an objective (resources / fuel / capital) · use up: informal consumption until nothing remains (supplies / patience / balance) · deplete: significant quantitative reduction threatening viability (reserves / stockpile / ozone) · exhaust: complete, draining depletion leaving zero capacity (options / energy / supply)
groups.nuance_zh: spend: 最基础的耗费金钱、时间或普通精力 (money / time / effort) · expend: 为达成目的正式调动并投入大量资源 (resources / fuel / capital) · use up: 口语中彻底用光吃净、所剩无几 (supplies / patience / balance) · deplete: 造成存量严重跌落、威胁后续运转的锐减 (reserves / stockpile / ozone) · exhaust: 穷尽一切力量、资财或选择，达到彻底衰竭 (options / energy / supply)

groups.name: Expense & Disburse · 报销入账与资金拨付 (Expense, Write off, Disburse)
groups.tip: 清算账目付清款项

items.def_en: Record an item as an expenditure on a specific account or credit card
items.ex_en: Please charge the dinner expenses to the department credit card tonight.
items.ex_zh: 今晚请把晚餐开销记入部门的信用卡账户。

items.def_en: 1. To charge or write off an amount as an expense, especially on an expense account or in financial accounts.
items.ex_en: He was permitted to expense the travel costs incurred during the conference.
items.ex_zh: 他获准报销会议期间发生的差旅费用。

items.def_zh: 核销，作为坏账/开支勾销
items.def_en: Officially recognize and record an outlay, debt, or loss in accounts as unrecoverable expense
items.ex_en: The bank decided to write off the overdue balance as bad debt.
items.ex_zh: 银行决定将这笔逾期未还的款项作为坏账勾销。

items.def_en: Repay an individual for money that they have spent on legitimate work-related expenses
items.ex_en: The firm will reimburse all employees for travel expenses incurred during training.
items.ex_zh: 公司将为所有员工报销培训期间垫付的差旅费用。

items.def_en: Pay out money formally from an official fund or allocated account
items.ex_en: The treasury will disburse the emergency relief funds by next Monday.
items.ex_zh: 财政部将于下周一前拨付这笔紧急救灾专款。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail formal financial transactions where outlays are officially debited, reimbursed via expense reports, or disbursed from institutional funds.
groups.summary_zh: 指按财务流程将支出记入账目、报销或自公款中拨付。
groups.desc_en: Formal financial accounting and allocation movements, involving charging, expensing, compensating, or distributing institutional capital, contrasting with generic 'give' or 'buy' by requiring bureaucratic accounting procedures.
groups.desc_zh: 在规范的组织、企业或公营财务体系内进行账目处理、报销或资金调拨；与泛泛的“给钱/购买”不同，本框架依赖严格的做账凭证与经办程序。
groups.nuance_en: charge: debiting an account or demanding payment (card / account / fee) · expense: writing off a purchase as a business operating cost (lunch / travel / equipment) · write off: formally canceling an asset or debt as uncollectible (debt / loss / asset) · reimburse: repaying an individual for out-of-pocket costs incurred (expenses / mileage / employee) · disburse: paying out large institutional funds from a formal treasury (grants / loans / aid)
groups.nuance_zh: charge: 将款项记入借方账户或索要费用 (card / account / fee) · expense: 将个人垫付支出按公司营运成本报销入账 (lunch / travel / equipment) · write off: 财会中将坏账或无用资产正式核销勾销 (debt / loss / asset) · reimburse: 补偿雇员垫付的工作开支或差旅费 (expenses / mileage / employee) · disburse: 从金库或专用基金中大额正式拨付 (grants / loans / aid)

groups.name: Expiate & Purge · 赎罪与涤罪 (Expiate, Propitiate, Purge)
groups.tip: 通过受罚或补偿洗刷罪过

items.def_en: Free someone or a community from an unwanted moral taint, guilt, or defilement
items.ex_en: The ancient religious ritual was intended to purge the community of sin.
items.ex_zh: 这一古老的宗教仪式旨在洗净整个社群的罪孽。

items.def_en: Declare someone free from guilt, obligation, or the moral penalty of a sin
items.ex_en: The priest pronounced sacred prayers to absolve the penitent from spiritual guilt.
items.ex_zh: 神父念诵神圣的祷文以赦免忏悔者的心灵罪责。

items.def_en: (formal) To accept punishment or make amends in order to atone for a sin or wrongdoing.
items.ex_en: He devoted his remaining years to charity to expiate his past sins.
items.ex_zh: 他将余生奉献给慈善事业，以抵偿自己过去的罪过。

items.def_en: Win or regain the favor of a deity or authority by doing something that pleases them
items.ex_en: The tribesmen offered precious gifts to propitiate the angry mountain gods.
items.ex_zh: 部落族人奉献珍贵祭品以抚慰愤怒的山神。

items.def_en: Hear the confession of, assign penance to, and absolve a sinner
items.ex_en: The dying knight asked the aged priest to shrive him before dawn.
items.ex_zh: 垂死的骑士请求老神父在拂晓前为他听忏并赦罪。

groups.summary_en: This formal and liturgical frame involves the mystical, ritual, or legally formal cleansing of guilt, spiritual pollution, or sacrilegious transgressions.
groups.summary_zh: 指在宗教、法理或神圣层面洗涤罪衍、消除业障与平息惩戒。
groups.desc_en: Ritually, morally, or spiritually extinguishing accumulated guilt, sin, or spiritual pollution through sacrifice or formal penance, contrasting with secular 'reform' or 'correct' by operating in a sacred, transcendental register.
groups.desc_zh: 通过祈和牺牲、忏悔或仪式性惩罚，在宗教或神圣道德维度涤除罪孽与污染；与世俗的“纠正/改造”不同，本框架涉及超越性的神圣秩序与心灵救赎。
groups.nuance_en: purge: sweeping elimination of defilement, guilt, or unwanted elements (sin / impurity / ranks) · absolve: authoritative priestly release from spiritual guilt (sinner / penitent / parishioner) · expiate: making active atonement or paying the penalty for an offense (guilt / crime / sins) · propitiate: appeasing an angry deity or superior power through offerings (gods / wrath / spirit) · shrive: granting sacramental absolution following confession (penitent / soul / confessant)
groups.nuance_zh: purge: 彻底肃清宗教污秽、精神罪垢或异端杂质 (sin / impurity / ranks) · absolve: 神职人员权威宣告罪孽宽免、卸下良心重负 (sinner / penitent / parishioner) · expiate: 通过接受惩罚、苦行或补偿来为罪过抵罪赎愆 (guilt / crime / sins) · propitiate: 献祭迎合以平息神明或权威的怒气 (gods / wrath / spirit) · shrive: 听取忏悔并正式施予赦罪礼 (penitent / soul / confessant)

groups.name: Explain & Clarify · 解释与讲明 (Clarify, Elucidate, Spell Out)
groups.tip: 从普通说明到消除歧义澄清

items.def_en: To explain something in very clear, plain terms so that misunderstanding is impossible
items.ex_en: You don't need to spell out every detail; we get the general idea.
items.ex_zh: 你不需要把每个细节都阐释得那么细，我们明白大意。

items.def_en: To make something clear or easy to understand by describing or giving information about it.
items.ex_en: The teacher used simple diagrams to explain how the solar system works.
items.ex_zh: 老师用简单的图表来解释太阳系是如何运转的。

items.def_en: To make something clear or easier to understand by removing ambiguity
items.ex_en: The minister issued an official statement to clarify the ambiguous new tax policy.
items.ex_zh: 部长发表了一份官方声明，以澄清模糊不清的新税收政策。

items.def_en: To clarify or shed light on an obscure topic or difficult problem
items.ex_en: Historical records help illuminate the origins of this obscure religious dispute.
items.ex_zh: 历史记录有助于阐明这场鲜为人知的宗教争端的起源。

items.def_en: To make a complex point or concept totally clear by explaining it in lucid detail
items.ex_en: The treatise attempts to elucidate the fundamental principles of quantum mechanics.
items.ex_zh: 该专著试图系统阐释量子力学的基本原理。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey articulating facts, motives, or mechanisms to make something intelligible to another person. The semantic gradient moves from baseline communication to rigorous, transparent detailing.
groups.summary_zh: 通过叙述细节或原因使事物变得容易理解、清晰透彻。
groups.desc_en: Systematically dispelling obscurity and cognitive confusion by translating dense, ambiguous material into clear, accessible understanding, contrasting with simple 'say' or 'describe' by targeting intellectual transparency.
groups.desc_zh: 通过逻辑梳理与语言转译消除歧义与晦涩，使复杂难懂之事豁然开朗；与简单的“说/描述”不同，本框架以化繁为简、通俗透彻为认知目标。
groups.nuance_en: explain: standard clarifying of reasons, mechanisms, or meaning (situation / rules / concept) · clarify: removing lingering ambiguity to ensure precision (position / statement / doubts) · spell out: making unmistakably explicit down to every single detail (terms / consequences / instructions) · illuminate: casting penetrating light onto intricate or profound topics (issue / context / truth) · elucidate: scholarly, methodical explanation of obscure or learned subjects (theory / text / mystery)
groups.nuance_zh: explain: 最通用的交代原因、机制或原委 (situation / rules / concept) · clarify: 澄清误解或模糊之处，使立场/细节明确 (position / statement / doubts) · spell out: 极其直白、逐字逐句地挑明（常带有不耐烦或极度严密之意） (terms / consequences / instructions) · illuminate: 如光照亮般启发性地阐发深层规律或真相 (issue / context / truth) · elucidate: 学术化、条理清晰地细致解读晦涩理论或古籍 (theory / text / mystery)

groups.name: Explode & Blow Apart · 爆炸与剧变 (Blow up, Burst, Go off)
groups.tip: 能量瞬间集中迸发出巨大声浪

items.def_zh: 发爆裂声胀破；砰地爆开
items.def_en: To burst or cause to burst with a sharp, quick, explosive sound
items.ex_en: The child watched the colorful balloon suddenly pop with a loud bang.
items.ex_zh: 孩子看着五颜六色的气球随着一声巨响突然爆开。
items.ex2_en: The mischievous toddler popped the colorful soap bubble with his tiny finger.
items.ex2_zh: 淘气的小孩用细小的手指戳破了彩色的肥皂泡。

items.def_en: To break open or apart suddenly and violently, typically from intense internal pressure
items.ex_en: Excessive water pressure caused the main underground pipeline to burst violently.
items.ex_zh: 过高的水压导致地下主输水管道猛烈胀破。
items.ex2_en: Freezing winter temperatures burst several unprotected water pipes in the basement.
items.ex2_zh: 严寒的冬日气温导致地下室几根未受保护的水管爆裂了。

items.def_en: To shatter violently into pieces, or suddenly lose one's temper in a furious outburst
items.ex_en: The gas leak caused the entire industrial warehouse to blow up instantly.
items.ex_zh: 煤气泄漏导致整个工业仓库瞬间发生爆炸。
items.ex2_en: Careless demolition workers blew up the condemned concrete tower ahead of schedule.
items.ex2_zh: 粗心的爆破工人提前炸毁了那座已被判定为危楼的混凝土塔。

items.def_en: To suddenly discharge, trigger, or explode loudly
items.ex_en: The home alarm started to go off loudly in the middle night.
items.ex_zh: 家里的警报器在半夜突然刺耳地响了起来。

items.def_zh: 爆炸，爆裂；迸发，爆发；激增
items.def_en: 1. To burst or break apart violently with a loud noise, or to cause something to do so. 2. To react suddenly and intensely with emotion. 3. To increase suddenly and rapidly in number or extent.
items.ex_en: Faulty electrical wiring caused the chemical container to explode without warning.
items.ex_zh: 有故障的电线导致化学品容器毫无预警地发生爆炸。

groups.summary_en: Covers physical detonations, sudden ruptures under inner pressure, or sharp violent outbursts of temper and rapid exponential expansion.
groups.summary_zh: 强调因内部压力或能量剧增而产生的猛烈炸裂、喷发或失控暴怒。
groups.desc_en: Violent, rapid rupture accompanied by sudden release of internal energy, pressure, or destructive force, contrasting with gradual 'break' or 'crack' by its explosive velocity, noise, and transformative suddenness.
groups.desc_zh: 因内部蓄积压力或剧烈化学反应而瞬间破裂解体，释放巨大破坏力与巨响；与平缓的“打破/裂开”不同，本框架侧重毁灭性的突发速度与能量爆发。
groups.nuance_en: pop: light, sudden rupturing or snapping sound with minimal destruction (balloon / cork / bubble) · burst: rupturing from overwhelming internal pressure (pipe / dam / bubble) · go off: sudden detonation or activation of an explosive or alarm (bomb / gun / alarm) · explode: full violent detonation or sudden unrestrained escalation (bomb / rage / population) · blow up: destructive demolition using explosives or violent eruption of temper (bridge / building / temper)
groups.nuance_zh: pop: 伴随轻微响声的爆裂或猝然破裂 (balloon / cork / bubble) · burst: 因内部压力过大承受不住而胀破、决口 (pipe / dam / bubble) · go off: 炸弹引爆、枪械走火或警报突响的触发展开 (bomb / gun / alarm) · explode: 剧烈的化学/物理爆轰，或情绪、人口的失控爆发 (bomb / rage / population) · blow up: 炸毁建筑物，或人勃然大怒、情绪彻底失控 (bridge / building / temper)

groups.name: Exploit & Capitalize · 利用与剥削榨取 (Exploit, Capitalize, Milk)
groups.tip: 从合理利用升级为榨取

items.def_en: To take advantage of an opportunity or situation for personal gain
items.ex_en: The company moved quickly to capitalize on shifting consumer preferences toward organics.
items.ex_zh: 该公司迅速采取行动，利用消费者转向有机产品的偏好获利。

items.def_en: To profit unfairly or opportunistically from a trend or misfortune
items.ex_en: Unscrupulous traders tried to cash in on the sudden medicine shortage.
items.ex_zh: 不法商贩试图借药品突然短缺之机大发横财。

items.def_en: To take ruthless advantage of vulnerable, weak, or unsuspecting people
items.ex_en: Online fraudsters frequently prey on elderly people living alone without digital knowledge.
items.ex_zh: 网络骗子经常侵害那些缺乏数字知识的独居老人。

items.def_en: To extract as much money, benefit, or information as possible from someone ruthlessly
items.ex_en: Corrupt officials continued to milk the state treasury for personal enrichment.
items.ex_zh: 腐败官员继续榨取国库资金以谋求个人私利。

items.def_en: 1. To treat someone unfairly by using their work or ideas to other's advantage. 2. To use something fully or effectively for one's benefit.
items.ex_en: Unscrupulous employers continue to exploit undocumented migrant workers for cheap labor.
items.ex_zh: 不道德的雇主继续剥削无证移民工人以获得廉价劳动力。

groups.summary_en: Describes using people, resources, or weaknesses to gain selfish advantage. Ranges from neutral strategic resource utilization to abusive predatory extraction of labor or wealth.
groups.summary_zh: 指为私利策略性利用资源，或以不公手段榨取、剥削他人价值。
groups.desc_en: Opportunistically extracting value, profit, or strategic leverage from an external situation or vulnerability, contrasting with neutral 'use' or 'employ' by its predatory, self-serving, or unfair character.
groups.desc_zh: 伺机从外部情势、他人弱点或资源中谋取最大私利与战略筹码；与中性的“利用/使用”不同，本框架带有浓厚的功利、剥削或乘虚而入色彩。
groups.nuance_en: capitalize on: astutely seizing an opportunity or rival weakness for personal gain (mistake / trend / success) · cash in on: crassly monetizing an event, fad, or circumstance (fame / disaster / crisis) · exploit: utilizing fully, or ruthlessly taking unfair advantage of someone/something (workers / vulnerability / loophole) · prey on: victimizing and targeting the weak, gullible, or defenseless (fears / victims / elderly) · milk: systematically squeezing every drop of benefit or sympathy dry (situation / company / sympathy)
groups.nuance_zh: capitalize on: 敏锐利用对手失误或有利局势赢得胜局 (mistake / trend / success) · cash in on: 唯利是图地借风潮、危机大发横财 (fame / disaster / crisis) · exploit: 充分挖掘潜能，或不道德地榨取劳动力、钻营漏洞 (workers / vulnerability / loophole) · prey on: 弱肉强食般盯住老弱妇孺的软肋进行侵害欺诈 (fears / victims / elderly) · milk: 机关算尽地把某一资源、同情或关系压榨殆尽 (situation / company / sympathy)

groups.name: Expose & Uncover Wrongs · 揭露丑闻与曝光真相 (Expose, Uncover, Bring to Light)
groups.tip: 将隐情公开置于视线中

items.def_en: Cause concealed facts or crimes to become known clearly to everyone
items.ex_en: The independent commission helped bring to light extensive corporate corruption.
items.ex_zh: 独立委员会协助曝光了广泛存在的企业腐败行为。

items.def_zh: 揭露，揭发；暴露，显露；使面临（危险等）；（胶片）曝光
items.def_en: 1. To reveal the hidden or true nature of something, especially something dishonest or illegal. 2. To make something visible or leave it unprotected. 3. To subject photographic film to light.
items.ex_en: The journalist published an article to expose financial fraud within the charity.
items.ex_zh: 记者发表了一篇文章，揭露该慈善机构内部的财务欺诈。

items.def_zh: 挖掘出；揭开（掩盖的事实）
items.def_en: Discover or reveal secrets, fraud, or facts that have been deliberately covered up or concealed
items.ex_en: Internal audits helped uncover systematic bribery schemes orchestrated by senior managers.
items.ex_zh: 内部审计协助揭开了高管们精心策划的系统性受贿方案。

items.def_zh: 彻底披露；赤裸裸地暴露
items.def_en: Completely reveal the hidden, vulnerable, or painful reality of a situation with nothing held back
items.ex_en: The candid memoir served to lay bare the tragic reality of his addiction.
items.ex_zh: 这本坦率的回忆录彻底披露了他深陷毒瘾的悲惨现实。

items.def_zh: 彻底引爆并曝光（大丑闻）
items.def_en: Expose a conspiracy or major scandal so dramatically that it can no longer be hidden or denied
items.ex_en: Leaked internal emails blew the bribery scandal wide open this morning.
items.ex_zh: 泄露的内部邮件在今天上午将这起受贿丑闻彻底引爆。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on making hidden corruption, systemic wrongdoing, or suppressed factual realities open to public scrutiny. It ranges from neutral investigation to aggressive journalistic or investigative exposure.
groups.summary_zh: 将隐藏的不法勾当、丑闻或真相公之于众，接受舆论和法律监督。
groups.desc_en: Stripping away institutional secrecy, cover-ups, or systemic wrongdoing to force it into public scrutiny, contrasting with neutral 'reveal' by emphasizing transgression, public shock, and moral condemnation.
groups.desc_zh: 撕破隐瞒与遮掩，将体制性黑幕、腐败或道德劣迹置于公众监督的强光之下；与普通的“揭晓/公布”不同，本框架伴随道德丑闻与舆论震荡。
groups.nuance_en: uncover: revealing buried facts through investigation or removal of a literal cover (plot / evidence / scam) · bring to light: guiding forgotten, hidden, or obscured information into public awareness (truth / facts / abuse) · lay bare: stripping away every pretense or defense to display the raw reality (secrets / soul / hypocrisy) · expose: publishing or denouncing scandalous, corrupt, or illegal conduct (corruption / fraud / hypocrisy) · blow wide open: shattering an ongoing cover-up and precipitating a massive public crisis (case / scandal / investigation)
groups.nuance_zh: uncover: 经调查抽丝剥茧，揭开隐匿的阴谋或铁证 (plot / evidence / scam) · bring to light: 使尘封已久、难以得见的真相重现光明 (truth / facts / abuse) · lay bare: 剥光所有防护伪装，将其最赤裸严酷的本质展现无遗 (secrets / soul / hypocrisy) · expose: 曝光违法犯罪或丑陋黑幕，引发社会谴责 (corruption / fraud / hypocrisy) · blow wide open: 彻底引爆黑幕，打破隐瞒并引发轩然大波 (case / scandal / investigation)

groups.name: Expose & Unmask Deception · 揭穿与揭发伪善 (Unmask, Expose, Debunk)
groups.tip: 撕下伪装彻底曝光隐秘真相

items.def_zh: 驳斥，揭穿（虚假理论或迷信）
items.def_en: To show that a claim, belief, or theory is false, exaggerated, or pretentious
items.ex_en: The scientist conducted rigorous laboratory tests to debunk the miraculous health claim.
items.ex_zh: 科学家进行了严谨的实验室检测以驳斥这一神奇的保健说辞。

items.def_en: To make something hidden, private, or painful completely visible and understood
items.ex_en: Her testimony managed to lay bare the hidden deceit within the organization.
items.ex_zh: 她的证词将该机构内部隐秘的欺诈行径暴露无遗。

items.def_en: To discover and force hidden enemies, suspects, or secret information out into the open
items.ex_en: Federal agents worked tirelessly to smoke out the informants inside the agency.
items.ex_zh: 联邦特工不知疲倦地工作，以揪出机构内部潜藏的线人。

items.def_zh: 揭露，揭发（丑闻、罪行或虚假）
items.def_en: To reveal the hidden truth about someone or something dishonorable, corrupt, or harmful
items.ex_en: Undercover reporters worked together to expose the fake medicine racket operating downtown.
items.ex_zh: 卧底记者联手揭露了在市中心运作的假药犯罪团伙。

items.def_zh: 揭露，揭发（真实面目）；摘下面具
items.def_en: 1. To reveal the true identity, character, or nature of someone or something hidden or disguised. 2. To take off a mask from oneself or someone else.
items.ex_en: The prosecutor produced undeniable evidence to unmask the deceitful corporate executive.
items.ex_zh: 检察官出示了确凿的证据，揭穿了那个道貌岸然的企业高管。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe stripping away false appearances, fraud, or disguises to lay bare underlying corruption, hypocrisy, or malevolence. They convey a strong, adversarial, and definitive revelation.
groups.summary_zh: 强调剥去伪装或谎言，彻底暴露欺诈、虚伪或丑恶面目。
groups.desc_en: Shattering a false persona, fraudulent claim, or deceptive doctrine to reveal its underlying vacuity or malice, contrasting with broader 'disprove' by focusing specifically on pretense and bad-faith posturing.
groups.desc_zh: 撕掉伪装、破除伪科学或道貌岸然的面具，还其虚伪或诈欺的原形；与一般的“反驳/证伪”不同，本框架针对的是带有恶意的伪善与蒙蔽。
groups.nuance_en: expose: broadly demonstrating that something or someone is deceptive (fraud / liar / racket) · unmask: dramatically stripping off an imposter's disguise or false moral persona (villain / spy / hypocrite) · smoke out: forcing deceitful, evasive actors out of concealment into the open (enemy / opposition / culprit) · debunk: empirically puncturing overrated claims, urban myths, or pseudoscience (myth / theory / rumor) · lay bare: dismantling rationalizations to expose the raw, ugly motive beneath (deceit / motives / fallacy)
groups.nuance_zh: expose: 广泛揭穿骗局、骗子或虚假行径 (fraud / liar / racket) · unmask: 戏剧性地撕下伪君子或间谍的面具，现出真实身份 (villain / spy / hypocrite) · smoke out: 采取强力手段迫使隐匿的对手或说谎者无处遁形 (enemy / opposition / culprit) · debunk: 拿出事实依据戳穿谣言、伪科学或迷信神话 (myth / theory / rumor) · lay bare: 彻底拆穿虚饰，将其背后的险恶动机显露无遗 (deceit / motives / fallacy)

groups.name: Expose to Peril · 涉险与置身险境 (Hazard, Risk, Venture)
groups.tip: 使安全或利益陷入严重险境

items.def_en: To act in a way that exposes something valuable to damage, injury, or loss
items.ex_en: Drivers should never risk their lives by texting behind the wheel.
items.ex_zh: 司机绝不应在开车时发短信，拿自己的生命冒险。

items.def_en: To expose a valuable stake to hazard in a bold or unpredictable enterprise
items.ex_en: The merchant decided to venture his entire fortune upon the perilous voyage.
items.ex_zh: 商人决定押上自己的全部家产去冒这场危险航行的风险。

items.def_en: (+ on) To risk a crucial possession, honor, or life itself on the outcome of an event
items.ex_en: The seasoned commander refused to stake his reputation on an uncertain battle.
items.ex_zh: 这位经验丰富的指挥官不愿把自己的声誉押注在胜负未卜的战斗上。

items.def_en: To expose one's life, fortune, or reputation to great danger or destructive loss
items.ex_en: Few explorers would hazard their health in such extremely harsh arctic environments.
items.ex_zh: 极少有探险家愿意在如此恶劣的北极环境中拿自己的健康冒险。

items.def_en: (literary) To expose someone or something to serious danger or risk.
items.ex_en: Careless handling of radioactive waste could peril countless lives across the region.
items.ex_zh: 对放射性废料的草率处理可能会危及该地区的无数生命。

groups.summary_en: A literary and elevated frame describing deliberate or reckless exposure of lives, honor, or fortunes to catastrophic outer dangers. Collocates include life, limb, fortune, and mortal peril.
groups.summary_zh: 偏文雅/书面语，指将生命、名誉或安危暴露于巨大凶险之中。
groups.desc_en: Willfully subjecting valuable assets, life, or security to the unpredictable hazard of loss or disaster, contrasting with cautious 'protect' or 'guard' by leaning forward into uncertainty for a potential return.
groups.desc_zh: 将生命、财产或安全等宝贵事物主动置于损失、失败或毁灭的险境之中；与“防范/保护”对立，强调为了特定回报而孤注一掷或踏入危局。
groups.nuance_en: risk: common exposure to possible harm, failure, or loss (life / reputation / career) · hazard: exposing to substantial chance of ruin or putting forward a tentative claim (fortune / guess / opinion) · venture: daring to proceed into dangerous physical spaces or uncertain undertakings (opinion / journey / capital) · stake: pledging vital assets or reputation on the outcome of a gamble or battle (reputation / future / fortune) · peril: poetic or heightened formal exposure to severe mortal danger (soul / lives / safety)
groups.nuance_zh: risk: 最常见的冒着受损、丢命或失败的危险 (life / reputation / career) · hazard: 使陷入重大毁弃风险，或试探性地提出 (fortune / guess / opinion) · venture: 敢于涉足险境、孤注一掷开创新局或试探性发声 (opinion / journey / capital) · stake: 将名誉、前途或身家性命押在某一赌注或成败上 (reputation / future / fortune) · peril: 高度书面或诗意色彩的将生命、灵魂置于极度凶险之中 (soul / lives / safety)

groups.name: Expound & Elaborate · 阐明与详加论述 (Elaborate, Explicate, Disquisition)
groups.tip: 系统剖析并详尽阐释观点主张

items.def_en: To add substance, illustrative details, or evidence to a bare outline or argument
items.ex_en: The author needs to flesh out these brief chapter outlines with dialogue.
items.ex_zh: 作者需要用对话来充实这些简短的章节大纲。

items.def_en: To present or describe something in thorough, structured detail by adding further points
items.ex_en: The architect will elaborate on the structural design during the board meeting.
items.ex_zh: 建筑师将在董事会会议上详尽阐述该结构设计。

items.def_zh: 阐述，详细说明，系统阐明
items.def_en: To explain or present a theory, idea, or doctrine systematically and in comprehensive detail.
items.ex_en: The philosopher wrote several comprehensive essays to expound his revolutionary moral theories.
items.ex_zh: 这位哲学家撰写了数篇详尽的文章来系统阐述其革命性的道德理论。

items.def_en: To formulate, explain, or state an idea, principle, or policy clearly and formally
items.ex_en: The president will enunciate the new foreign policy doctrine in tonight's broadcast.
items.ex_zh: 总统将在今晚的广播中正式阐明新的外交政策原则。

items.def_zh: 细致解析，剖析（文本或原理）
items.def_en: To analyze and systematically reveal the meaning of a complex idea, literary piece, or argument
items.ex_en: The critic paused to explicate the allegorical meaning behind the modernist poem.
items.ex_zh: 评论家停下来细致解析这首现代主义诗歌背后的讽喻意义。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate academic, philosophical, or formal discourse where doctrines, texts, or complex theories are articulated exhaustively. They differ from plain explanation by their scholarly depth and systematic rigor.
groups.summary_zh: 对理论、学说或文本进行全面、深入且系统性的阐述与推演。
groups.desc_en: Systematically detailing, developing, and analyzing complex ideas, theories, or texts to ensure thorough structural comprehension, contrasting with brief 'mention' or 'summarize' by exhaustive intellectual amplification.
groups.desc_zh: 对复杂的思想、理论、文本或构想进行有条理的深入剖析与血肉充填；与简单的“提及/总结”不同，本框架强调结构化的充分展开与严谨论证。
groups.nuance_en: elaborate: developing a rudimentary idea by supplying richer detail (plan / theory / point) · flesh out: adding substantial substance and detail to a bare skeleton or outline (proposal / character / sketch) · expound: providing a comprehensive, authoritative presentation of a doctrine or philosophy (views / doctrine / theory) · explicate: methodically unpacking the deep layered meaning of a text or argument (poem / text / concept) · enunciate: pronouncing clearly, or formally stating a core doctrine or principle (policy / principle / word)
groups.nuance_zh: elaborate: 在原有基础上详加推敲扩充，提供更多细节 (plan / theory / point) · flesh out: 填补骨架使之“有血有肉”，充实方案或构思 (proposal / character / sketch) · expound: 权威系统地阐发一整套学说、主张或教条 (views / doctrine / theory) · explicate: 逐层解剖、逐字细读文本或深奥义理 (poem / text / concept) · enunciate: 字正腔圆地发音，或郑重清晰地确立核心原则/政策 (policy / principle / word)

groups.name: Extend & Flex · 伸展与屈曲 (Flex, Stretch, Overextend)
groups.tip: 肢体过度伸展或拉伸关节

items.def_en: To bend a joint or tighten a muscle to demonstrate strength or prepare for movement
items.ex_en: The athlete stood before the mirror to flex his arm muscles before training.
items.ex_zh: 运动员在训练前站在镜子前紧绷手臂肌肉。
items.ex2_en: The flexible fiberglass fishing rod flexes easily without breaking under pressure.
items.ex2_zh: 柔韧的玻璃纤维钓竿在受压时极易弯曲而不折断。

items.def_en: To unbend a joint or make a bent limb completely flat or upright
items.ex_en: The physical therapist asked the patient to straighten her injured leg slowly.
items.ex_zh: 理疗师要求患者慢慢伸直她受伤的腿。
items.ex2_en: His crooked back straightened instantly when the commanding officer entered the room.
items.ex2_zh: 当指挥官走进房间时，他驼着的背立刻挺直了。

items.def_en: To straighten a joint such as a knee or elbow completely until it becomes rigid
items.ex_en: Be careful not to lock your knees when lifting heavy weights.
items.ex_zh: 举起重物时，务必注意不要锁死膝关节。
items.ex2_en: The heavy steel door locks automatically whenever an unauthorized visitor approaches it.
items.ex2_zh: 每当未经授权的访客靠近时，沉重的钢门便会自动上锁。

items.def_en: To stretch a limb or joint beyond its normal, safe limit, causing physical strain or injury
items.ex_en: Be careful not to overextend your elbow while lifting those heavy dumbbells.
items.ex_zh: 举那些重哑铃时，注意不要让肘部过度伸展。

items.def_en: (medicine / sports) To stretch or straighten a joint forcefully beyond its normal range of motion.
items.ex_en: The dancer feared she might hyperextend her knee during the vigorous leap.
items.ex_zh: 舞者担心在剧烈的跳跃动作中膝关节会过度伸展。
items.ex2_en: Her flexible knee joint hyperextended unexpectedly during the awkward gymnastics landing.
items.ex2_zh: 在体操笨拙着地时，她灵活的膝关节意外发生过伸。

groups.summary_en: Covers physical movements involving the bending, straightening, or extreme elongation of limbs and joints. Nuances range from healthy muscle engagement to forceful injury-inducing strain.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及肢体与关节的弯曲、延展或过度拉伸，涵盖正常运动与运动损伤。
groups.desc_en: Modulating the angle, tension, and spatial alignment of anatomical joints and muscular structures, contrasting with static 'hold' or whole-body 'move' by focusing on the kinematics of bending, stretching, and locking limbs.
groups.desc_zh: 对身体关节与肌群进行屈伸、绷直或角度调整的生物力学控制；与静态的“保持”或整体“移动”不同，本框架聚焦于肢体受力的伸展与屈曲状态。
groups.nuance_en: flex: contracting a muscle or bending a joint (bicep / muscle / joint) · straighten: unbending a limb into linear alignment (leg / spine / arm) · lock: extending a joint rigidly to its mechanical stopping point (knees / elbows / jaw) · overextend: stretching a limb or asset beyond safe physiological or structural limits (arm / joint / finances) · hyperextend: medically forcing a joint beyond its normal anatomical range of extension (knee / elbow / neck)
groups.nuance_zh: flex: 屈曲关节或绷紧、鼓起肌肉 (bicep / muscle / joint) · straighten: 将弯曲的肢体、脊柱伸直拉正 (leg / spine / arm) · lock: 将关节完全蹬直、死死锁合 (knees / elbows / jaw) · overextend: 伸展过度，或引申指资源、阵线拉得过长 (arm / joint / finances) · hyperextend: 临床意义上的关节超伸过展导致扭伤 (knee / elbow / neck)

groups.name: Extend & Span · 跨越与横亘 (Bridge, Cross, Traverse)
groups.tip: 空间或时间的跨越延伸

items.def_en: To extend over a specific spatial distance or interval of time
items.ex_en: The intense training workshop will cover three days of hands-on technical instruction.
items.ex_zh: 这次紧张的培训研讨会将涵盖为期三天的实操技术指导。

items.def_en: To build a passage across an expanse, or eliminate a divide or time difference between two items
items.ex_en: We organized regular community events to bridge the social divide between neighborhoods.
items.ex_zh: 我们组织了定期的社区活动，以弥合邻里之间的社会隔阂。

items.def_zh: 横跨，跨越；持续，贯穿；用手掌量
items.def_en: 1. To extend across or over a period of time or a distance. 2. (of a bridge or structure) To cross over an area of water or land.
items.ex_en: The ancient suspension bridge continues to span the turbulent waters below safely.
items.ex_zh: 那座古老的吊桥依然安全地横跨在下方湍急的水流之上。

items.def_en: To pass or extend horizontally across or over a specified area or obstruction
items.ex_en: Steel railway tracks traverse the rugged mountain range to connect remote villages.
items.ex_zh: 钢铁铁轨横越崎岖的山脉，将偏远的村庄连接起来。

items.def_en: To exist on or spread across both sides of a river, boundary line, or historical era
items.ex_en: The historic old town straddles the river that divides the two provinces.
items.ex_zh: 这座历史悠久的古城横跨在划分两个省份的河流两岸。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on connecting two distinct endpoints in space or time, covering a continuous interval, physical divide, or thematic breadth.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重实体结构或时间范围在两点之间横跨、连接或完整覆盖。
groups.desc_en: Extending continuous physical, temporal, or conceptual coverage over a gap, gulf, or broad domain, contrasting with static 'be' or small-scale 'touch' by unifying disparate points through overarching reach.
groups.desc_zh: 在物理空间、历史时间或观念领域上横跨鸿沟、连通两端；与静态的“存在”或局部“接触”不同，本框架强调凌驾其上、横亘联结的跨越性与统摄性。
groups.nuance_en: cover: extending over an area, topic, or distance comprehensively (ground / distance / area) · span: extending across an entire physical distance, obstacle, or period of time (river / centuries / gap) · bridge: connecting two separated entities or resolving a profound division (divide / gap / cultures) · traverse: journeying across or extending through physical terrain (continent / terrain / globe) · straddle: extending across or belonging simultaneously to both sides of a division (border / issue / fence)
groups.nuance_zh: cover: 在面积、距离或主题上达到全面覆盖 (ground / distance / area) · span: 物理结构跨越水域两岸，或时间横跨数个世纪/时代 (river / centuries / gap) · bridge: 架设桥梁连通隔阂，化解鸿沟或文化差异 (divide / gap / cultures) · traverse: 身体力行地横贯穿行于艰难的地理地貌之中 (continent / terrain / globe) · straddle: 双腿横跨两边，或在两派立场、国界间骑墙而立 (border / issue / fence)

groups.name: Externalize & Project · 显露与外化 (Manifest, Exteriorize, Project, Act out)
groups.tip: 将内心想法外化显露出来

items.def_en: to transfer an inward feeling or unacknowledged impulse onto someone or something else
items.ex_en: In therapy, patients often project their suppressed childhood anger onto their counselors.
items.ex_zh: 在心理治疗中，患者常常将压抑的童年愤怒投射到咨询师身上。

items.def_en: to show an inward feeling, quality, or symptom clearly through outward signs
items.ex_en: His deep anxiety began to manifest through frequent insomnia and nervous twitches.
items.ex_zh: 他内心的极度焦虑开始通过频繁失眠和神经性抽搐表现出来。

items.def_en: to bring an internal concept, sensation, or psychological state into external reality
items.ex_en: The sculptor sought to exteriorize his grief through jagged, dark bronze figures.
items.ex_zh: 这位雕塑家试图通过粗糙尖锐的黑色青铜人像来外化他的悲伤。

items.def_en: (psychology / formal) to express or project internal feelings, thoughts, or conflicts outward into words, actions, or physical form
items.ex_en: The therapist encouraged the patient to externalize her inner turmoil through journaling.
items.ex_zh: 治疗师鼓励患者通过写日记将内心的混乱情绪表达出来。

items.def_zh: 以行动宣泄内心冲突；把……表演出来
items.def_en: to express subconscious emotions or behavioral tensions through disruptive actions
items.ex_en: Troubled teenagers often act out their frustration by breaking rules at school.
items.ex_zh: 遇到困扰的青少年往往会通过在学校违反纪律来宣泄内心的沮丧。

groups.summary_en: This frame concerns projecting private psychological conflicts, unstated assumptions, or internal mental states into observable physical actions, symptoms, or objects.
groups.summary_zh: 指将内在的情感、心理冲突或观念转化为外在可见的言行、体征或具体形式。
groups.desc_en: Translating private internal psychological states, conflicts, or mental constructs into observable external behavior, physical symptoms, or outward forms, contrasting with simple 'feel' or 'think' by requiring public exteriorization.
groups.desc_zh: 将内在隐秘的心理冲突、动机或无意识状态投射转化为外在可见的行为、症状或具象化实体；与内省的“感受/思考”不同，强调内里向外在的转移与显化。
groups.nuance_en: manifest: clearly displaying symptoms, qualities, or forms in observable reality (symptoms / intentions / destiny) · externalize: transposing internal mental states into outside objects, data, or processes (feelings / anxiety / costs) · project: unconsciously attributing one's own disowned impulses or insecurities onto others (insecurities / anger / feelings) · exteriorize: formally giving physical form to thoughts or surgically directing outward (thoughts / symptoms / anatomy) · act out: expressing repressed conflicts or trauma through impulsive, disruptive behavior (frustration / feelings / impulses)
groups.nuance_zh: manifest: 症状、品质或神圣意图显现于外在客观世界 (symptoms / intentions / destiny) · externalize: 将内在焦虑、情感具象化投射至体外或账面 (feelings / anxiety / costs) · project: 心理学上的投射作用，将自身排斥的负面心理推给他人 (insecurities / anger / feelings) · exteriorize: 使观念实体化，或医学上将体内器官外露移出 (thoughts / symptoms / anatomy) · act out: 心理学中以冲动、反叛的不良行为宣泄被压抑的创伤与情绪 (frustration / feelings / impulses)

groups.name: Extradite & Transfer Offender · 移交逃犯与引渡 (Extradite, Deport, Hand over)
groups.tip: 跨国司法合作引渡刑事嫌犯

items.def_en: To formally yield up or hand over a suspect or fugitive to the power or custody of another
items.ex_en: The embassy agreed to surrender the wanted fugitive to local law enforcement.
items.ex_zh: 使馆同意将通缉要犯正式移交给当地执法部门。

items.def_zh: 移交，交出（在押犯人、控制权）
items.def_en: To pass responsibility or custody of a suspect or convict to another authority
items.ex_en: Federal agents will hand over the convicted hacker to state prison officials.
items.ex_zh: 联邦探员将把被定罪的黑客移交给州监狱官员羁押。

items.def_en: To legally expel a foreigner or unwanted person from a country
items.ex_en: The government decided to deport the foreign national for repeated visa violations.
