items.ex_zh: 政府决定将该名外籍人员驱逐出境，因其屡次违反签证规定。

items.def_en: (law) to officially hand over an accused or convicted person to another country or jurisdiction where the crime was committed
items.ex_en: Authorities worked tirelessly to extradite the suspected cartel leader for federal trial.
items.ex_zh: 当局不懈努力，以将这名疑似贩毒集团头目引渡接受联邦审判。

items.def_en: To send someone back to their own country of origin or citizenship
items.ex_en: The humanitarian committee helped repatriate displaced refugees back to their devastated homeland.
items.ex_zh: 人道主义委员会协助将流离失所的难民遣返回他们饱受摧残的祖国。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame cover legal, sovereign procedures whereby an accused fugitive or prisoner is surrendered across jurisdictional boundaries.
groups.summary_zh: 司法或国家主权机构将嫌疑人、罪犯合法引渡、遣返或移交给别国。
groups.desc_en: Formal institutional transfer of a fugitive, alien, or offender across jurisdictional borders between governing states, contrasting with private 'move' or domestic 'arrest' by relying on international law and bilateral sovereignty.
groups.desc_zh: 主权国家或司法辖区之间依据条约法律，对逃犯、外籍违法者或遣返人员进行正式移交与押解；与普通的“抓捕/移送”不同，本框架涉及主权边界与双边法律条约。
groups.nuance_en: hand over: neutral, practical transfer of custody or control (suspect / prisoner / keys) · surrender: yielding an accused person or oneself to legal authority under compulsion (fugitive / weapons / sovereignty) · deport: expelling a non-citizen from sovereign territory for legal violations (migrant / criminal / alien) · extradite: transferring an accused or convicted fugitive to the requesting state for trial (fugitive / criminal / suspect) · repatriate: returning an individual, prisoner of war, or cultural artifact to their home country (refugees / citizens / remains)
groups.nuance_zh: hand over: 较为中性、通用的羁押人犯交接或移交控制权 (suspect / prisoner / keys) · surrender: 被迫向司法当局投降认罪或移送逃犯 (fugitive / weapons / sovereignty) · deport: 主权国家通过行政命令将违法外国人驱逐出境 (migrant / criminal / alien) · extradite: 国与国之间依据引渡条约，将逃犯遣送回审判国受审 (fugitive / criminal / suspect) · repatriate: 将难民、战俘、本国公民或流失文物遣返回母国 (refugees / citizens / remains)

groups.name: Extrude & Expel · 挤出与喷注 (Squeeze out, Ooze out, Expel)
groups.tip: 施强大压力挤出孔模

items.def_en: To flow or leak out very slowly through small cracks, pores, or openings under slight pressure
items.ex_en: Sticky yellow sap began to ooze out from cracks in the bark.
items.ex_zh: 粘稠的黄色树汁开始从树皮的裂缝中缓缓冒出。

items.def_en: To discharge slowly and steadily through pores or incisions as drops of moisture or resin
items.ex_en: Fragrant resins exudate softly from the ancient incisions made upon the trunk.
items.ex_zh: 芬芳的树脂从树干上古老的割口处缓缓渗出。
items.ex2_en: The injured pine tree exudates sticky golden sap to seal the wound.
items.ex2_zh: 受伤的松树渗出黏稠的金色树汁来封闭伤口。

items.def_en: To force liquid or paste out of a flexible tube, fruit, or container by compressing it
items.ex_en: She managed to squeeze out the last bit of toothpaste this morning.
items.ex_zh: 今天早上她费劲地挤出了最后一小截牙膏。

items.def_en: To release or eject a liquid, gas, or stored substance outwards through an outlet
items.ex_en: Industrial pipes discharge treated chemical wastewater directly into the designated holding pond.
items.ex_zh: 工业管道将经过处理的化学废水直接排放到指定的蓄水池中。

items.def_zh: 挤出，压出（通过模孔成形）；突出，伸出
items.def_en: To force, press, or push molten metal, plastic, or other material out through a shaped hole or die
items.ex_en: The specialized machine can extrude molten aluminum through precision-shaped circular dies.
items.ex_zh: 这种专用机器可以通过精密成型的圆形模具挤压出熔融铝材。
items.ex2_en: The molten plastic extrudes smoothly through the tiny nozzle onto the plate.
items.ex2_zh: 熔融塑料通过细微的喷嘴顺畅地挤出到平板上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote forcing viscous liquids, plastics, paste, or bulk substances out through an orifice, nozzle, or opening under internal or compressive pressure. 'Extrude' is technically shaped by a die, while 'squeeze out' applies everyday physical force, and 'discharge' denotes fluid expulsion.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过加压使熔体、膏状物或流体自喷口或缝隙中被挤出、喷射。
groups.desc_en: Forcing liquid, viscous, or semi-solid substances out through a narrow orifice or boundary by pressure, contrasting with mere 'flow' or 'leak' by the active mechanical force or biological pressure driving the outward discharge.
groups.desc_zh: 在内部压强或机械外力驱动下，迫使液体、黏性物或半固态物通过窄缝、孔洞向外喷注、渗挤；与自然“流出/漏水”不同，强调挤压外推的主动受力过程。
groups.nuance_en: ooze out: very slow, viscous seeping through porous surfaces or cuts (blood / pus / mud) · squeeze out: forcibly expressing substance by external pressure or extraction (juice / paste / concession) · exudate: slowly discharging moisture, fluid, or chemical resin through biological pores (sap / resin / moisture) · extrude: forcing malleable material through a shaped die in industrial molding (plastic / aluminum / dough) · discharge: systematically releasing accumulated fluids, waste, or electricity from containment (fluid / pollutant / cargo)
groups.nuance_zh: ooze out: 黏稠缓慢地从裂隙、伤口中渗出、淌出 (blood / pus / mud) · squeeze out: 用手或外力挤出糊状物，亦引申指挤出微利或让步 (juice / paste / concession) · exudate: 动植物机体组织缓慢分泌、溢出汁液或树脂 (sap / resin / moisture) · extrude: 工业上通过模具高压挤出成型（如塑料条、铝材） (plastic / aluminum / dough) · discharge: 容器、病灶或电池蓄积物的集中排泄、排放或放电 (fluid / pollutant / cargo)

groups.name: Exude & Seep · 渗出与溢流 (Exude, Seep, Ooze)
groups.tip: 液体自毛孔孔隙中缓缓渗出

items.def_en: To emit moisture through skin pores, or for moisture to condense and bead up on a cold surface.
items.ex_en: Cold glass bottles sweat heavily when placed under the humid summer sun.
items.ex_zh: 冰凉的玻璃瓶放在潮湿炎热的夏日阳光下，表面渗出了大量水汽。

items.def_en: To trickle or flow out very slowly through small openings or moist surfaces.
items.ex_en: Thick black mud began to ooze slowly between his bare toes.
items.ex_zh: 厚重的黑泥开始从他光着的脚趾缝间缓缓渗出。
items.ex2_en: The wounded soldier oozed dark blood through his makeshift battlefield bandages.
items.ex2_zh: 受伤的士兵身上简易的战地绷带渗出了暗红色的血。

items.def_en: (+ into/through) To flow or pass slowly through a porous boundary, small crack, or cloth.
items.ex_en: Toxic runoff continued to seep into the underground aquifer after the storm.
items.ex_zh: 暴风雨过后，有毒径流继续渗入地下蓄水层中。

items.def_en: To produce and discharge a biological liquid or substance from an internal gland or cell.
items.ex_en: Specialized endocrine cells secrete essential hormones directly into the nearby bloodstream.
items.ex_zh: 特化的内分泌细胞将必需的激素直接分泌到附近的血液中。

items.def_zh: （使）渗出，流出；充分显露，流露出
items.def_en: 1. To release or ooze out slowly through pores or an opening, or to discharge liquid in this way. 2. To display a quality, feeling, or attitude strongly and openly.
items.ex_en: Pine bark will exude golden droplets of fragrant resin in warm weather.
items.ex_zh: 在温暖的天气里，松树皮会渗出一颗颗金黄色的芬芳树脂。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses fluids or odors slowly issuing, trickling, or sweating forth through tiny pores, cracks, or tissue membranes, as well as radiating intangible traits like confidence or charm.
groups.summary_zh: 指液体、气味或神态气质自孔隙或表层缓慢渗透、散溢出来。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the gradual, viscous, or porous emergence of liquid or qualities from within a boundary, contrasting with rapid or forceful discharge like 'gush' or 'spurt'.
groups.desc_zh: 指液体或内在特质穿透边界缓慢、粘稠或经孔隙渗出，区别于喷涌（gush）或喷射（spurt）等快速剧烈的释放。
groups.nuance_en: sweat: moisture expulsion via pores or condensation (beads / brow / pipes) · ooze: sluggish emission of viscous fluid, or radiating charm (pus / charm / mud) · seep: slow percolation through porous boundaries (water / chemicals / doubt) · secrete: physiological synthesis and discharge (hormones / enzymes / venom) · exude: outward radiation of liquid, aroma, or palpable aura (confidence / resin / scent)
groups.nuance_zh: sweat: 经气孔排汗或凝结水汽 (beads / brow / pipes) · ooze: 粘稠液体缓慢外溢，或流露个人魅力 (pus / charm / mud) · seep: 穿透多孔介质细微渗入 (water / chemicals / doubt) · secrete: 生理合成并分泌物料 (hormones / enzymes / venom) · exude: 液体溢出或向外散发浓烈气质 (confidence / resin / scent)

groups.name: Eye Fluttering & Flashing · 眨眼与闪烁 (Blink, Wink, Flutter)
groups.tip: 眼睑快速开合眨眼动作

items.def_en: 1. To shut and open your eyes quickly. 2. To shine with a light that flashes intermittently on and off.
items.ex_en: Bright warning lights blink constantly along the edge of the dark runway.
items.ex_zh: 明亮的警示灯在漆黑的跑道边缘不断闪烁。

items.def_en: To open and close one's eyelashes flirtatiously or coquettishly
items.ex_en: She could bat her long eyelashes effortlessly to charm everyone in attendance.
items.ex_zh: 她能轻松地眨巴那长长的睫毛，迷倒在场的所有人。

items.def_en: To close and open one eye quickly as a private signal, gesture of friendliness, or flirtation
items.ex_en: He managed to wink discreetly at his friend across the crowded room.
items.ex_zh: 他在拥挤的房间里隐蔽地朝对面的朋友眨了眨眼使了个眼色。

items.def_en: To shine with an unsteady or wavering light, or to show a brief, fleeting expression in the eyes
items.ex_en: A fleeting flicker of amusement appeared in his usually stern brown eyes.
items.ex_zh: 他那双平日严肃的棕色眼眸中闪过了一丝转瞬即逝的笑意。

items.def_en: To move one's eyelashes or eyelids up and down quickly and lightly
items.ex_en: The startled child began to flutter her eyelids against the blinding glare.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的孩子在刺眼的强光下不住地眨巴着眼皮。
items.ex2_en: Dozens of colorful flags fluttered wildly in the gusty autumn coastal wind.
items.ex2_zh: 数十面五彩缤纷的旗帜在阵阵秋季海风中剧烈翻飞飘动。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses rapid involuntary or deliberate eyelid movements, as well as the metaphorical intermittent flashing of light sources.
groups.summary_zh: 指眼睑迅速开合的生理或示意动作，亦引申为光线的明灭闪烁。
groups.desc_en: Covers rapid, repetitive, or flirtatious movements of eyelids and small lights, differing from steady gazing or continuous illumination.
groups.desc_zh: 指眼睑或微光的快速开合、扑动或频闪，区别于持续注视或恒定照明。
groups.nuance_en: blink: involuntary or startled closure of eyes (surprise / dust / disbelief) · bat: coquettish or dramatic flapping of eyelids (eyelashes / eyes) · wink: deliberate single-eye closure signaling complicity (conspirator / eye) · flicker: wavering, brief intermittent shining (candle / flame / screen) · flutter: light, tremulous waving of lashes or wings (eyelids / lashes / wings)
groups.nuance_zh: blink: 不由自主或因受惊而眨眼 (surprise / dust / disbelief) · bat: 卖弄风情或做作地眨动 (eyelashes / eyes) · wink: 故意使眼色或示意会心 (conspirator / eye) · flicker: 光线摇曳不稳地微闪 (candle / flame / screen) · flutter: 睫毛或翅膀轻盈颤动 (eyelids / lashes / wings)

groups.name: Face & Orient · 朝向与面对 (Face, Look, Overlook)
groups.tip: 身形正面对准特定方位

items.def_en: To have the front or face pointing in a specific direction or looking towards an object
items.ex_en: The large front windows face the morning sun across the quiet valley.
items.ex_zh: 宽大的前窗穿过寂静的山谷，朝向清晨初升的太阳。

items.def_zh: 面向，朝向；面对，对抗；领衔
items.def_en: 1. To face in a particular direction, or have the front facing towards something. 2. To lead or be the public face of an organization, band, or movement.
items.ex_en: These elegant luxury townhomes front directly onto a quiet, tree-lined avenue.
items.ex_zh: 这些典雅的豪华联排别墅正门直接面向一条安静的林荫大道。

items.def_en: To have a view overlooking or opening directly onto a particular scene or location
items.ex_en: Our cozy bedroom balconies look out on the shimmering blue Mediterranean Sea.
items.ex_zh: 我们温馨的卧室阳台向外正对着波光粼粼的蔚蓝地中海。

items.def_en: To position or align something facing a particular point of the compass or direction
items.ex_en: Builders should orient the rooftop solar panels directly towards the bright south.
items.ex_zh: 建筑工人应该将屋顶的太阳能电池板正对着明亮的南方。

items.def_en: To provide a view of a place from above or have a vantage point facing it
items.ex_en: The cliffside dining terrace will overlook the sparkling turquoise waters below.
items.ex_zh: 悬崖边的用餐露台可以俯瞰下方波光粼粼的碧绿水面。

groups.summary_en: This frame relates to spatial orientation and architectural alignment, where a person, building, or facade looks out in a specified physical direction. Verbs capture direct exposure, command of a view, or spatial alignment.
groups.summary_zh: 描述建筑或物体的朝向、方位布局，或视线正对某一景观方向。
groups.desc_en: Specifies spatial alignment, exposure, or commanding vantage points toward an exterior direction, contrasting with active physical motion or turns.
groups.desc_zh: 指建筑或主体朝向特定方位或享有俯瞰视野的静止空间指向，区别于主动的物理旋转或转向动作。
groups.nuance_en: face: direct directional fronting toward a target (street / audience / north) · front: forming or abutting the anterior facade directly onto a space (quay / boulevard / beach) · look out on: possessing a windowed vantage point toward an exterior scene (courtyard / sea / garden) · orient: deliberately align in relation to compass points or needs (building / compass / layout) · overlook: towering above with a panoramic downward gaze (valley / ocean / city)
groups.nuance_zh: face: 正面直接朝向或对准 (street / audience / north) · front: 临街构筑前脸或直面 (quay / boulevard / beach) · look out on: 倚窗朝向外部景物 (courtyard / sea / garden) · orient: 依罗盘方位或需求特定朝向 (building / compass / layout) · overlook: 居高临下俯瞰开阔视野 (valley / ocean / city)

groups.name: Fade & Grow Wan · 衰退与渐淡 (Wan, Wane, Fade away)
groups.tip: 色泽日渐浅淡，光芒黯然失色

items.def_zh: 逐渐枯竭；慢慢减弱直至停止
items.def_en: To gradually become smaller, weaker, or less active before ending completely
items.ex_en: The heavy rainstorm began to peter out by late evening yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 倾盆暴雨在昨天傍晚时分开始逐渐减弱直至停止。

items.def_en: (archaic or literary) To grow pale, faint, or dim.
items.ex_en: The dying twilight began to wan behind the silent western hills.
items.ex_zh: 微弱的暮色开始在寂静的西山后渐渐暗淡下去。

items.def_en: To slowly disappear, lose distinctness, or grow weaker until vanishing
items.ex_en: The loud cheering crowds began to fade away into the cool night.
items.ex_zh: 喧闹欢呼的人群渐渐散去，消失在清凉的夜色之中。

items.def_en: To gradually become smaller in size, amount, or intensity
items.ex_en: Their emergency food supplies continue to dwindle rapidly as winter drags on.
items.ex_zh: 随着冬天的拖延，他们的应急粮食储备继续急剧减少。

items.def_en: To decrease gradually in size, strength, power, or brilliance
items.ex_en: His royal authority began to wane as political rivals consolidated their power.
items.ex_zh: 随着政敌巩固权力，他的王室权威开始日渐衰落。

groups.summary_en: Verbs marking gradual loss of radiance, vigor, or strength until a subject becomes faint, pale, or weak.
groups.summary_zh: 强调光泽、血色或生命力逐渐消减、微弱至趋于泯灭。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on the progressive diminishing of energy, luminescence, volume, or vitality toward total disappearance, unlike sudden termination or destruction.
groups.desc_zh: 强调力量、光线、数量或生机逐渐衰退渐趋消失的消逝过程，区别于骤然中断或剧烈破坏。
groups.nuance_en: peter out: gradual reduction into nothingness or exhaustion (enthusiasm / trail / supply) · wan: grow noticeably pale, sickly, or faint (complexion / smile / light) · fade away: dissolve gently into silence, distance, or memory (music / echo / memories) · dwindle: shrink steadily in numerical size or volume (resources / savings / numbers) · wane: cyclic or progressive loss of authority, intensity, or lunar visibility (moon / influence / popularity)
groups.nuance_zh: peter out: 逐渐耗竭归于无形 (enthusiasm / trail / supply) · wan: 脸色发白、失去血色或光芒转微 (complexion / smile / light) · fade away: 缓慢隐没于距离或记忆 (music / echo / memories) · dwindle: 数量或存量持续缩减 (resources / savings / numbers) · wane: 权威、热度或周期性光辉由盛转衰 (moon / influence / popularity)

groups.name: Fail & Flounder · 成败与受挫 (Collapse, Flounder, Falter)
groups.tip: 行动结果成败分明

items.def_zh: 失败；未能做到；不合格；失灵，衰退
items.def_en: 1. To not succeed in doing something. 2. (+ to do) To not do what is expected or required. 3. To not pass a test or exam. 4. To stop working properly.
items.ex_en: The old backup generator may fail if electrical power drops suddenly tonight.
items.ex_zh: 如果今晚电力突然中断，那台陈旧的备用发电机可能会失灵。

items.def_en: To fail suddenly and completely in negotiations, business, or organization
items.ex_en: Bilateral trade talks might collapse entirely if neither side compromises on tariffs.
items.ex_zh: 如果双方都不在关税问题上妥协，双边贸易谈判可能会彻底破裂。
items.ex2_en: Uncontrolled financial speculation collapsed the fragile national banking system within days.
items.ex2_zh: 失控的金融投机在数日之内瓦解了脆弱的国家银行体系。

items.def_en: (of plans or deals) To come to nothing and fail to be completed
items.ex_en: The sale of the property fell through when the buyer's loan was rejected.
items.ex_zh: 由于买方的贷款申请被拒，房产交易最终泡汤了。

items.def_en: To lose strength, momentum, or resolve, showing early signs of breakdown
items.ex_en: The coalition government began to falter amid intense public criticism of corruption.
items.ex_zh: 在公众对腐败的强烈批评声中，联合政府开始动摇。

items.def_zh: 挣扎受挫；陷入混乱困顿
items.def_en: To experience great difficulties, confusion, and hesitation, risking complete failure
items.ex_en: The inexperienced campaign team continued to flounder without clear strategic guidance.
items.ex_zh: 缺乏经验的竞选团队由于没有明确的战略指导而陷入混乱困顿。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify falling short of an objective, breaking down under pressure, or struggling helplessly toward collapse.
groups.summary_zh: 指计划受挫、进程停滞或最终崩溃失败的动词群。
groups.desc_en: Depicts organizational, functional, or structural breakdown where efforts collapse or struggle haphazardly to avoid disaster, distinct from orderly retreats.
groups.desc_zh: 描绘组织、计划或结构由于机能失调而瓦解或挣扎求生，区别于有秩序的撤退或受控收缩。
groups.nuance_en: fail: non-fulfillment of a required function, expectation, or threshold (exam / system / attempt) · collapse: sudden catastrophic disintegration under strain (building / economy / talks) · fall through: failure of an arranged plan or transaction to materialize (deal / plan / sale) · falter: lose momentum, stability, or resolve mid-course (engine / recovery / steps) · flounder: thrash about clumsily in deep distress or confusion (campaign / economy / company)
groups.nuance_zh: fail: 未达到标准或未能成事 (exam / system / attempt) · collapse: 在重压下轰然瓦解坍塌 (building / economy / talks) · fall through: 原定计划或交易未果泡汤 (deal / plan / sale) · falter: 中途势头动摇、步履蹒跚 (engine / recovery / steps) · flounder: 深陷困境中慌乱挣扎 (campaign / economy / company)

groups.name: Fail & Underperform · 受挫与表现不佳 (Underperform, Falter, Flounder)
groups.tip: 未达预期失利退败

items.def_zh: 表现不如预期；表现欠佳
items.def_en: To achieve lower financial yields or poorer practical results than predicted or required
items.ex_en: The newly acquired mutual funds continued to underperform historical market averages.
items.ex_zh: 新收购的共同基金表现持续低于历史市场平均水平。

items.def_zh: 表现未达预期，未充分发挥潜力；（学业、工作中）未达应有水平
items.def_en: To perform or achieve less well than expected, or fail to fulfill one's potential.
items.ex_en: Bright students often underachieve when their unique educational needs are continually ignored.
items.ex_zh: 聪明的学生在独特教育需求持续被忽视时往往难以发挥应有水平。

items.def_en: (+ of) To fail to achieve an intended target, expectation, or standard of performance
items.ex_en: Quarterly revenues fall short of ambitious targets set by senior corporate management.
items.ex_zh: 季度营业收入未能达到公司高管层设定的宏伟目标。

items.def_en: To lose strength, momentum, or effectiveness, showing signs of potential failure
items.ex_en: Economic growth began to falter under rising interest rates and inflation.
items.ex_zh: 在利率上升和通胀压力下，经济增长势头开始受挫衰退。

items.def_zh: 挣扎；手忙脚乱陷入困境
items.def_en: To struggle clumsily and experience sustained difficulties in proceeding or succeeding
items.ex_en: The inexperienced debater started to flounder when asked tough economic questions.
items.ex_zh: 当被问及棘手的经济问题时，缺乏经验的辩手开始手忙脚乱陷入困境。

groups.summary_en: Describes performing below anticipated potential, falling short of baseline metrics, or stumbling during execution without outright catastrophe.
groups.summary_zh: 指表现未达预期、能力发挥不佳或在执行中受挫蹒跚。
groups.desc_en: Specifies falling below benchmark standards, potential, or expected pacing without necessarily suffering utter collapse, differing from total catastrophe.
groups.desc_zh: 强调产出、表现或成长低于预期基准或潜力，区别于彻底毁灭性的崩盘失败。
groups.nuance_en: underperform: deliver results inferior to financial or market expectations (stock / sector / fund) · underachieve: perform consistently below inherent intellectual or physical potential (student / athlete / team) · fall short: fail to hit a distinct quantitative or ethical target (expectations / target / standards) · falter: demonstrate hesitation or sudden weakness in execution (rhythm / progress / leadership) · flounder: struggle helplessly without clear strategic direction (strategy / ministry / startup)
groups.nuance_zh: underperform: 业绩低于市场基准或同行 (stock / sector / fund) · underachieve: 表现未达自身天资或潜力 (student / athlete / team) · fall short: 未达到既定数字指标或期望 (expectations / target / standards) · falter: 运行中出现顿挫或后劲不足 (rhythm / progress / leadership) · flounder: 毫无头绪地应付挣扎 (strategy / ministry / startup)

groups.name: Fall Behind & Lag · 滞后与落后 (Lag Behind, Fall Behind, Drag Behind)
groups.tip: 跟在后方慢步拖延

items.def_en: to stay behind reluctantly or slowly when others have already moved on
items.ex_en: Two tired hikers linger behind the main group to take scenic photographs.
items.ex_zh: 两名疲惫的徒步者落在队伍后面逗留，拍摄沿途的风景照片。

items.def_zh: 落后于，滞后；尾随，跟踪；拖曳，拖在后面
items.def_en: 1. to lag or linger behind someone, or to be losing in a competition or match. 2. to follow or track someone or something. 3. to drag or be dragged along a surface.
items.ex_en: Our home basketball team continued to trail by ten points throughout halftime.
items.ex_zh: 我们的主队在整个半场休息期间依然落后对手十分。

items.def_en: to trail behind or stray from the main body while moving in an irregular or scattered fashion
items.ex_en: Weary exhausted soldiers began to straggle along the dusty country road.
items.ex_zh: 精疲力竭的疲惫士兵们开始三三两两散漫地掉队在尘土飞扬的乡间道路上。

items.def_en: to fail to keep pace with a group, competition, or expected schedule of progress
items.ex_en: He will fall behind his classmates if he misses more algebra lectures.
items.ex_zh: 如果他再缺席代数课，他的学习进度就会落后于同班同学。

items.def_en: to move, progress, or develop more slowly than others in front
items.ex_en: Domestic manufacturing sectors still lag behind foreign competitors in automated technology.
items.ex_zh: 国内制造业在自动化技术领域仍然落后于国外竞争对手。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame capture moving more slowly than peers, slipping into arrears, or failing to maintain the forward pace of a group or competitor.
groups.summary_zh: 指行进缓慢、落于人后或无法跟上既定步调。
groups.desc_en: Highlights dropping behind the pace of a moving group, schedule, or competitor through sluggishness or drag, contrasted with choosing to stay behind.
groups.desc_zh: 强调因速度慢或被拖拽而落后于群体的行进节奏或既定进程，区别于主动留守（stay behind）。
groups.nuance_en: linger behind: stay tardily behind due to reluctance to advance (crowd / pack / companion) · trail: follow in the wake of leaders in a race or trend (rival / leaders / polls) · straggle: drift along in an untidy, disorganized rearward fashion (hikers / troops / procession) · fall behind: drop behind a schedule, payment, or competitor (schedule / payments / competitor) · lag behind: sluggishly drag behind benchmark tempos or peers (economy / peer / standard)
groups.nuance_zh: linger behind: 磨磨蹭蹭不愿前进而掉队 (crowd / pack / companion) · trail: 在竞争或选情中居于下风殿后 (rival / leaders / polls) · straggle: 散漫无序地脱队掉后 (hikers / troops / procession) · fall behind: 进度、账单或名次落后于人 (schedule / payments / competitor) · lag behind: 步调迟钝落后于标杆或同侪 (economy / peer / standard)

groups.name: Falter & Stumble in Speech · 结巴与口吃 (Stutter, Stammer, Falter)
groups.tip: 因紧张舌头打结结结巴巴

items.def_en: To make mistakes or hesitate repeatedly while attempting to pronounce words or phrases
items.ex_en: Nervous speakers often stumble over complex technical terms during oral presentations.
items.ex_zh: 紧张的演讲者在口头陈述中常常会在复杂的专业术语上结巴念错。

items.def_zh: 结巴地说，口吃；（机器）断断续续地运转
items.def_en: 1. To speak with involuntary pauses and repeated initial sounds because of a speech difficulty, nervousness, or shock. 2. To move or operate with unsteady, irregular sounds.
items.ex_en: Anxious under intense interrogation, the suspect began to stutter his improbable alibi.
items.ex_zh: 在严密审讯的焦虑下，嫌疑人开始结结巴巴地说出难以置信的不在场证明。

items.def_en: To speak in a hesitant, unsteady voice because of strong emotion or loss of confidence
items.ex_en: Her voice began to falter as she recounted the tragic fatal accident.
items.ex_zh: 当她讲述那起致命的惨烈事故时，她的声音开始颤抖停顿。

items.def_en: To speak with difficulty, repeating sounds or pausing unexpectedly, often due to embarrassment or nerves
items.ex_en: The nervous boy began to stammer when the teacher called his name.
items.ex_zh: 当老师点到那个紧张男孩的名字时，他开始结结巴巴地说不出话来。

items.def_zh: 语无伦次地嘟囔；急迫结巴地说
items.def_en: To make rapid, indistinct spitting or choking sounds while speaking when angry, shocked, or confused
items.ex_en: The furious customer could only splutter indignant complaints across the service counter.
items.ex_zh: 暴怒的顾客只能隔着服务台语无伦次地急迫吐出愤怒的抱怨。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses manner verbs characterizing disfluent speech marked by involuntary repetitions, prolonged syllables, or sudden blocks. The manner reflects physical speech impediments or acute psychological states like fear, embarrassment, or shock.
groups.summary_zh: 描述因言语障碍或紧张、震惊等心理因素导致的言语停顿或结巴。
groups.desc_en: Describes speech interrupted by involuntary spasms, anxiety, or emotional tumult, differing from intentional pauses or fluent speaking.
groups.desc_zh: 指受生理痉挛、焦虑或情绪冲击导致的言语受阻、结巴或断续，区别于刻意停顿或顺畅言谈。
groups.nuance_en: stumble over: trip verbally over complex phrases or awkward words (words / syllables / pronunciation) · stutter: repeat initial consonants spasmatically due to pathological impediment (consonants / child / syllable) · falter: voice wavering or trailing off due to fear or sorrow (voice / speech / resolve) · stammer: pause and repeat words hesitatingly under acute embarrassment (excuse / apology / answer) · splutter: emit explosive, incoherent sounds through rage, coughing, or water (rage / indignation / protest)
groups.nuance_zh: stumble over: 嘴瓢、被拗口字词绊住 (words / syllables / pronunciation) · stutter: 口吃、病理或紧张引起的音节重复 (consonants / child / syllable) · falter: 因悲戚或胆怯语声颤抖转微 (voice / speech / resolve) · stammer: 局促窘迫下结结巴巴 (excuse / apology / answer) · splutter: 气急败坏或呛噎时语无伦次地喷吐 (rage / indignation / protest)

groups.name: Farm & Graze · 农牧与经营 (Homestead, Graze, Raise)
groups.tip: 农田耕作与牧场经营劳作

items.def_en: Breed and bring up livestock or cultivate specific crops for commercial use
items.ex_en: Local farmers raise free-range cattle on these expansive green pastures every summer.
items.ex_zh: 当地农民每年夏天都在这些广袤的绿色牧场上饲养散养肉牛。

items.def_zh: 务农，耕作土地或饲养牲畜
items.def_en: Manage or work on land used for growing crops or keeping animals for food
items.ex_en: Several generations of his family chose to farm this fertile river valley.
items.ex_zh: 他们家族好几代人都选择在这片肥沃的河谷耕作土地、务农为生。

items.def_en: To manage, operate, or work on a ranch (a large farm for raising livestock such as cattle or horses).
items.ex_en: They moved out west hoping to ranch hundreds of healthy beef cattle.
items.ex_zh: 他们搬到了西部，希望能经营牧场，饲养数百头健康的肉牛。

items.def_en: Put cattle, sheep, or horses out to feed on growing grass, or (of animals) eat field grass
items.ex_en: Dairy cows graze peacefully on the grassy rolling hills across the highway.
items.ex_zh: 奶牛在公路对面起伏平缓的青翠山丘上悠闲地吃草。

items.def_en: Establish, settle, and cultivate a self-sufficient tract of agricultural land
items.ex_en: They moved out west hoping to homestead a hundred acres of untamed prairie land.
items.ex_zh: 他们迁往西部，希望能在一片百英亩的未开垦大草原上拓荒定居。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame encompass the sustained production and management of agrarian holdings, specifically tending pastures, breeding livestock, cultivating soil, and sustaining homesteads.
groups.summary_zh: 从事农牧耕作、放养牲口、经营田庄土地等农业生产活动。
groups.desc_en: Encompasses managing rural land, cultivating crops, breeding livestock, or claiming territory, distinct from industrial manufacturing or retail trade.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及农地开垦、作物栽培、放牧畜牧或拓荒定居的生产经营活动，区别于工业制造或商业零售。
groups.nuance_en: raise: breed, rear, and care for growing animals or plants (cattle / poultry / crops) · farm: cultivate land and generate agricultural crops or products (land / acreage / fish) · ranch: operate an extensive open spread primarily for livestock (land / cattle / herd) · graze: pasture animals on growing grass or feed continuously (meadow / cattle / pasture) · homestead: establish a self-sufficient dwelling on claimed frontier land (land / acreage / wilderness)
groups.nuance_zh: raise: 饲养家畜家禽或培育作物 (cattle / poultry / crops) · farm: 耕作土地经营农场 (land / acreage / fish) · ranch: 经营大牧场放养牲畜 (land / cattle / herd) · graze: 放牧牛羊啃食青草 (meadow / cattle / pasture) · homestead: 拓荒自耕自建家园 (land / acreage / wilderness)

groups.name: Fast & Diet · 节食与禁食 (Diet, Abstain, Slim)
groups.tip: 主动克制进食以养生

items.def_en: to abstain completely or partially from all or certain kinds of food or drink, especially for religious or medical purposes
items.ex_en: Patients must fast completely for twelve hours before undergoing the routine blood test.
items.ex_zh: 患者在接受常规验血前必须完全禁食十二小时。

items.def_en: to deliberately restrict one's intake of food in order to lose weight or for medical reasons
items.ex_en: She decided to diet strictly for two months before her sister's wedding.
items.ex_zh: 她决定在姐姐婚礼前的两个月里严格控制饮食减重。

items.def_en: (+ on) to reduce the consumption of certain foods, calories, or substances
items.ex_en: His doctor advised him to cut back on refined sugar and fatty meats.
items.ex_zh: 他的医生建议他减少精制糖和高脂肉类的摄入量。

items.def_en: to suffer or die from lack of food, or deliberately deprive someone or oneself of nourishment
items.ex_en: The trapped miners began to starve after their emergency rations ran out completely.
items.ex_zh: 在应急口粮彻底耗尽后，被困的矿工们开始挨饿。
items.ex2_en: Cruel captors deliberately starved the helpless prisoners inside the underground dungeon.
items.ex2_zh: 残酷的捕获者故意让地下地牢中无助的囚徒挨饿。

items.def_en: (+ from) to deliberately choose not to indulge in food, alcohol, or other bodily pleasures
items.ex_en: Athletes are strictly instructed to abstain from alcohol during intensive training periods.
items.ex_zh: 运动员被严格要求在集训期间戒绝饮酒。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on voluntarily restricting or eliminating food and drink intake for religious, spiritual, medical, or weight-loss purposes.
groups.summary_zh: 指为宗教、养生或减重目的而主动禁食、节食或控制饮食进摄。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the deliberate restriction or total cessation of food intake for religious, health, or aesthetic purposes, contrasting with involuntary famine.
groups.desc_zh: 指出于宗教、健康或瘦身目的而主动削减或停止食物摄入，区别于非自愿的饥荒困厄。
groups.nuance_en: fast: totally refrain from food/drink for religious or medical discipline (dawn / day / protest) · diet: regulate food intake strictly to lose weight or manage health (weight / regime / plan) · cut back: trim the consumption or intake of specific nutrients (sugar / calories / spending) · starve: suffer or induce severe deprivation of sustenance (hunger / captive / oneself) · abstain: exercise voluntary restraint from indulgence or specific substances (alcohol / meat / sweets)
groups.nuance_zh: fast: 宗教或医疗性的斋戒禁食 (dawn / day / protest) · diet: 为减脂健康控制日常饮食 (weight / regime / plan) · cut back: 削减特定营养成分的摄入 (sugar / calories / spending) · starve: 遭受或人为施加极度饥饿 (hunger / captive / oneself) · abstain: 意志克制不沾烟酒荤腥 (alcohol / meat / sweets)

groups.name: Fatten & Fill Out · 催肥与丰满增重 (Plump, Flesh Out, Beef Up)
groups.tip: 喂食高营养促使牲畜长膘发福

items.def_en: To make something stronger, thicker, or more substantial in size or force
items.ex_en: The studio hired top comedy writers to beef up the weak third act.
items.ex_zh: 制片厂雇了顶尖喜剧编剧来充实薄弱的第三幕。

items.def_en: To become fatter, rounder, or more mature in bodily stature
items.ex_en: The boy began to fill out noticeably after he turned sixteen years old.
items.ex_zh: 那个男孩满十六岁后，身板明显变得健壮丰满起来。

items.def_en: To feed an animal or person deliberately to make them noticeably heavier
items.ex_en: Farmers often fatten up cattle on high-protein grain right before autumn auctions.
items.ex_zh: 农民通常在秋季拍卖前用高蛋白谷物给牛催肥。
items.ex2_en: The farm geese fatten up quickly during the cool autumn harvest months.
items.ex2_zh: 农场的鹅在凉爽的秋收月份体重迅速增加变肥。

items.def_en: (often + up) To make something pleasantly soft, rounded, and full, or to become full
items.ex_en: She gave the down pillows a vigorous punch to plump them up nicely.
items.ex_zh: 她用力拍了拍羽绒枕，使其变得松软饱满。

items.def_en: To make an animal or person fatter, or to become fatter, especially by eating a lot.
items.ex_en: The pigs fatten quickly on this rich mixture of corn and soybeans.
items.ex_zh: 这些猪吃了这种玉米和大豆的浓缩混合饲料后长得很快。
items.ex2_en: High carbohydrate diets fatten laboratory animals rapidly during nutritional metabolic trials.
items.ex2_zh: 在营养代谢试验中，高碳水化合物饮食能使实验动物迅速增重。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on making an animal or human heavier, rounder, and fleshier through feeding, or augmenting volume and substance metaphorically.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过喂食使人畜增重催肥，或引申为增加充实度。
groups.desc_en: Denotes expanding physical girth, substance, or structural robustness, distinct from merely extending length or increasing speed.
groups.desc_zh: 指肉体丰满充盈，或为组织、文案及防线增添实质内涵与厚度，区别于长度延伸或单纯增速。
groups.nuance_en: beef up: forcefully reinforce strength, personnel, or security (security / presence / team) · fill out: expand bodily into rounder curves, or complete missing form details (face / questionnaire / figure) · fatten up: feed aggressively to gain heavy body mass (livestock / pig / savings) · plump: become or make round, taut, and cushiony (pillow / cheeks / cushions) · fatten: induce caloric weight gain or enrich financially (poultry / purse / wallet)
groups.nuance_zh: beef up: 强力扩充编制、增强安防或力量 (security / presence / team) · fill out: 身形丰腴饱满，或填补表单细节 (face / questionnaire / figure) · fatten up: 大量喂食促使肉体长膘 (livestock / pig / savings) · plump: 拍松使圆润鼓起、显现丰润 (pillow / cheeks / cushions) · fatten: 使牲口增肥或使钱包鼓胀 (poultry / purse / wallet)

groups.name: Fault & Blame · 归咎与挑剔 (Fault, Blame, Reproach)
groups.tip: 吹毛求疵挑毛病并归咎于人

items.def_en: To criticize someone or find a mistake, flaw, or imperfection in something
items.ex_en: Even the harshest reviewers could not fault the soloist's flawless technique.
items.ex_zh: 即便最挑剔的评论家也找不出这位独奏家精湛技艺的任何瑕疵。

items.def_en: To criticize every detail of something or find all its small flaws
items.ex_en: The opposing lawyers will pick apart every sentence in your written statement.
items.ex_zh: 对方律师会吹毛求疵地挑剔你书面声明里的每一个句子。

items.def_en: To hold someone responsible for a mistake, failure, or bad situation
items.ex_en: Angry commuters blame the transit authority for the persistent train delays this morning.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的通勤者将今晨列车的一再延误归咎于公交管理局。

items.def_en: To criticize someone especially for not being successful or not doing what was expected
items.ex_en: The coach reproached his senior players for their careless mistakes during the final.
items.ex_zh: 教练责怪主力队员们在决赛中犯下了粗心的失误。

items.def_en: To express strong, formal disapproval of someone's actions or failures
items.ex_en: Parliament voted overwhelmingly to censure the foreign minister for misleading the public.
items.ex_zh: 议会以压倒性多数投票严厉谴责该外交部长误导公众的行为。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on identifying errors, defects, or negligence in someone's conduct or performance. It spans from finding flaws in workmanship to holding a specific individual morally or practically culpable.
groups.summary_zh: 指在行为、做工中挑剔瑕疵，或将错误与过失归咎于当事人。
groups.desc_en: Covers assigning moral responsibility, locating defects, or verbally reprimanding an entity for an error, contrasting with praising or exonerating.
groups.desc_zh: 指锁定缺陷、归咎责任并施加言语指责或制度性惩戒，区别于赞美、谅解或免责。
groups.nuance_en: fault: pinpoint a flaw in logic, design, or character (logic / decision / craftsmanship) · pick apart: meticulously dissect and criticize flaws in an argument (argument / theory / plan) · blame: attribute culpability for a misfortune or error (victim / government / weather) · reproach: express gentle or hurt moral disappointment directly (friend / oneself / partner) · censure: formally and publicly condemn misconduct (minister / senator / government)
groups.nuance_zh: fault: 找茬、在逻辑或做工上挑剔毛病 (logic / decision / craftsmanship) · pick apart: 逐条拆解批判论点或方案 (argument / theory / plan) · blame: 归咎并认定过失责任 (victim / government / weather) · reproach: 带责备与失望情绪地数落 (friend / oneself / partner) · censure: 官方或公开严厉谴责 (minister / senator / government)

groups.name: Favor & Shield · 庇护与特殊优待 (Subsidize, Cushion, Shield)
groups.tip: 工会过度提供待遇保护

items.def_en: Make the harmful or painful effect of market shocks or setbacks less severe for someone
items.ex_en: Emergency savings helped cushion the family against the sudden loss of income.
items.ex_zh: 应急积蓄帮助这个家庭缓冲了突然失去收入带来的冲击。

items.def_zh: 庇护，遮挡（外界压力与竞争）
items.def_en: Protect an organization or person from unpleasant scrutiny, competitive pressures, or harm
items.ex_en: High tariffs shield domestic automotive manufacturers from fierce international price competition.
items.ex_zh: 高额关税庇护了国内汽车制造商免受激烈的国际价格竞争。

items.def_en: Give public or financial aid to an industry or entity to keep costs down and protect it from collapse
items.ex_en: The regional administration continues to subsidize solar energy installations for rural homeowners.
items.ex_zh: 地方政府继续补贴农村房主安装太阳能发电设备。

items.def_zh: 过度保护（工人或产业）；给……提供过分优厚待遇
items.def_en: To protect an industry, organization, or workers excessively with subsidies or easy conditions.
items.ex_en: Union contracts featherbed these obsolete rail workers with guaranteed overtime and perks.
items.ex_zh: 工会合同给这些过剩的铁路工人提供过度保护，保障其加班费和福利待遇。

items.def_en: Provide emergency financial assistance to rescue a failing company, sector, or country from collapse
items.ex_en: The central government refused to bail out the reckless property developer again.
items.ex_zh: 中央政府拒绝再次为这家鲁莽冒进的房地产开发商注资兜底。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on institutional, economic, or policy indulgence where specific sectors, unions, or organizations are shielded from competitive rigors through subsidies, restrictive rules, or unearned protective privileges.
groups.summary_zh: 强调通过体制、补贴或壁垒过度保护、优待行业或组织以避开竞争。
groups.desc_en: Covers providing artificial insulation, financial shelter, or institutional padding against harsh market or real-world shocks, unlike leaving to free competition.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过财政补贴、制度壁垒等手段提供保护垫，使其免受现实或市场冲击，区别于放任自流或充分竞争。
groups.nuance_en: cushion: absorb and soften the brunt of an economic or physical blow (blow / impact / loss) · shield: erect a defensive screen against public attack or penalty (criticism / eyes / candidate) · subsidize: underwrite costs with financial grants to lower market burden (industry / farming / housing) · featherbed: pamper excessively with soft conditions or surplus labor (workers / industry / cronies) · bail out: rescue financially from immediate insolvency or catastrophe (bank / company / economy)
groups.nuance_zh: cushion: 缓冲吸收外部沉重打击 (blow / impact / loss) · shield: 充当挡箭牌遮挡指责或惩罚 (criticism / eyes / candidate) · subsidize: 运用财政补贴减轻市场成本 (industry / farming / housing) · featherbed: 过度娇惯优待、提供优渥冗员岗位 (workers / industry / cronies) · bail out: 紧急注资救市挽救破产危机 (bank / company / economy)

groups.name: Fear & Dread · 害怕与恐惧 (Fear, Dread, Apprehend)
groups.tip: 面对危险时本能的惊惧与深层恐慌

items.def_zh: 害怕，恐惧，畏惧；担忧，忧虑；敬畏
items.def_en: 1. To be afraid of someone or something; to feel apprehension or anxiety about. 2. To revere or stand in awe of (God or a deity).
items.ex_en: Local villagers genuinely fear the sudden flash floods that occur every summer.
items.ex_zh: 当地村民由衷恐惧每年夏天骤然爆发的山洪。

items.def_en: To shake or tremble violently with acute fear or panic
items.ex_en: The captured conspirators quake with terror whenever the merciless dungeon master approaches.
items.ex_zh: 每当冷酷的地牢看守走近时，被俘的同谋者们便吓得瑟瑟发抖。

items.def_zh: 极度惧怕；畏惧（即将发生之事）
items.def_en: To anticipate with great apprehension, anxiety, or horror
items.ex_en: Commuters dread the grueling Monday morning journey across the congested city center.
items.ex_zh: 通勤族极度畏惧周一早晨穿越拥堵市中心的折磨人旅程。

items.def_en: To crouch down or shrink away in acute fear or intimidation
items.ex_en: The terrified puppies cower under the wooden bench whenever thunder rumbles loudly.
items.ex_zh: 每当雷声隆隆作响，受惊的小狗们就会蜷缩在木凳下。

items.def_en: To fill someone with acute, overwhelming fear
items.ex_en: Sudden turbulence during the transatlantic flight will terrify even seasoned travelers.
items.ex_zh: 跨大西洋航班途中的突发颠簸连经验老到的旅客也会吓破胆。

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote experiential fear, ranging from rational anticipation of danger to visceral terror, chronic anxiety, or existential dread.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖对危险或未知的畏惧心理，从隐忧到极端惊恐。
groups.desc_en: Conveys intense anxiety and anticipation of looming peril or agony, often evoking profound somatic tremors, differing from mild concern or anger.
groups.desc_zh: 指面临迫近的危险、痛苦或未知威胁时产生的强烈精神惊惧与躯体颤栗，区别于普通担忧或愤怒。
groups.nuance_en: fear: basic, generic cognitive and emotional awareness of danger (death / failure / dark) · quake: physically shudder from violent terror or apprehension (boots / fear / voice) · dread: experience heavy, anticipatory anguish over an imminent horror (exam / future / interview) · cower: crouch and cringe in submissive, paralyzed fear (corner / master / shelter) · terrify: fill another with extreme, overwhelming panic (audience / child / victims)
groups.nuance_zh: fear: 认知并感到危险恐惧的最基本动词 (death / failure / dark) · quake: 因极度惊吓害怕而身躯颤抖 (boots / fear / voice) · dread: 对迫在眉睫的灾祸满怀焦虑煎熬 (exam / future / interview) · cower: 吓得瑟缩退避、蜷缩身子 (corner / master / shelter) · terrify: 使对方惊骇欲绝、极度恐慌 (audience / child / victims)

groups.name: Fear & Quail · 畏惧与丧胆 (Quail, Tremble, Dread, Shrink)
groups.tip: 预感不祥心生胆怯而战栗

items.def_en: (+ from) To hesitate or hold back from doing something because of intense aversion or fear
items.ex_en: Principled leaders never shrink from making difficult decisions during severe financial crises.
items.ex_zh: 有原则的领导人在严重的财政危机面前绝不退缩回避困难决定。
items.ex2_en: The dry woolen sweater shrank noticeably after being washed in hot water.
items.ex2_zh: 羊毛毛衣在用热水洗涤后明显缩水了。

items.def_en: To shake involuntarily as a direct physical effect of extreme fear or shock
items.ex_en: Her hands began to tremble with shock after witnessing the horrific crash.
items.ex_zh: 目睹了那场惨烈的撞车事故后，她的双手因惊骇而颤抖起来。

items.def_en: To lose strength, confidence, or purpose and waver in the face of daunting adversity
items.ex_en: Her voice began to falter when she delivered the devastating casualty figures.
items.ex_zh: 当她公布令人痛心的伤亡数字时，声音开始发颤动摇。

items.def_en: (literary) (+ at/before) To feel or show great fear or apprehension; to shrink back or tremble in dread.
items.ex_en: Even veteran warriors quail before the monstrous dragon lurking in the deep.
items.ex_zh: 即便是久经沙场的勇士，面对潜伏在深渊的凶暴巨龙也不免胆怯畏缩。

items.def_en: To anticipate future danger, pain, or ordeal with intense anxiety and aversion
items.ex_en: Many patients dread root canal surgery far more than routine dental cleanings.
items.ex_zh: 许多患者对根管治疗手术的恐惧远甚于常规洗牙。

groups.summary_en: Literary and affective verbs showing severe loss of courage, paralyzing dread, and internal faltering when faced with intimidation or dire threat.
groups.summary_zh: 多具书面语彩，突出面临威吓与凶险时丧失勇气、内心发怵与发抖震颤。
groups.desc_en: Emphasizes the collapse of inner courage, resulting in physical recoil, paralysis, or faltering when facing terrifying odds, unlike standing firm.
groups.desc_zh: 强调在恐惧压迫下面对强敌或困难时勇气丧失、退缩动摇或心生怯意，区别于坚毅不屈。
groups.nuance_en: shrink: flinch backward psychologically or physically from a task (duty / responsibility / horror) · tremble: shake uncontrollably with nervousness or shock (hands / voice / anger) · falter: lose confidence and begin wavering or halting (stride / resolve / courage) · quail: suffer sudden gut-wrenching loss of heart in mortal peril (threat / gaze / thought) · dread: hold an oncoming ordeal in paralyzing apprehension (prospect / meeting / visit)
groups.nuance_zh: shrink: 因退怯或嫌恶而本能退避逃避 (duty / responsibility / horror) · tremble: 因紧张、震惊而全身不住颤抖 (hands / voice / anger) · falter: 勇气或信心出现动摇迟疑 (stride / resolve / courage) · quail: 在威吓或死亡阴影下丧胆畏缩 (threat / gaze / thought) · dread: 惶恐不安地惧怕未来的磨难 (prospect / meeting / visit)

groups.name: Feature & Headline · 领衔与挂帅 (Headline, Showcase, Topline)
groups.tip: 领衔挂帅重点凸显

items.def_en: to play the principal role in a performance, cast, or presentation
items.ex_en: The award-winning actress will lead the ensemble in this season's Broadway revival.
items.ex_zh: 这位屡获殊荣的女演员将领衔出演本季百老汇的重合剧目。

items.def_zh: 领衔主演；担任主唱/头条
items.def_en: to appear as the main performer or attraction in a concert, festival, or theatrical show
items.ex_en: Famous rock bands will headline the annual summer music festival next weekend.
items.ex_zh: 著名摇滚乐队将在下周末的年度夏季音乐节上担任主打表演嘉宾。

items.def_en: to present someone or something in a way that highlights their best qualities, talents, or abilities
items.ex_en: The annual exhibition serves to showcase groundbreaking designs from young European architects.
items.ex_zh: 这一年一度的展览旨在重点展示年轻欧洲建筑师的开创性设计。

items.def_en: to be featured as the top-billed star or leading actor in a commercial production
items.ex_en: Two acclaimed veterans topline the new multi-million-dollar espionage thriller hitting theaters.
items.ex_zh: 两位广受赞誉的老戏骨领衔主演了即将上映的数千万美元级谍战大片。

items.def_zh: 主演，领衔主演；由……担任主角；给……标星号
items.def_en: 1. to play the main role in a film, play, or show, or to feature someone as the main performer. 2. to mark something with a star or asterisk.
items.ex_en: She was chosen to star as the tragic heroine in the adaptation.
items.ex_zh: 她入选在这部改编剧中领衔饰演那位悲剧女主角。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate prominent casting or central positioning in entertainment, media, and public events where an individual or highlight serves as the primary attraction.
groups.summary_zh: 指在演出、电影或活动中担任主角、担纲领衔或作为重点推出。
groups.desc_en: Highlights taking the prominent top-billed position in a performance, festival, or media event to draw public attention, unlike remaining in supporting roles.
groups.desc_zh: 指在演出、媒体宣传或阵容中位居第一看板或领衔挂帅以吸引公众，区别于幕后或配角出演。
groups.nuance_en: lead: direct and march at the forefront of a project or cast (investigation / team / charge) · headline: occupy the premier topmost billing in a concert or festival (festival / concert / lineup) · showcase: deliberately exhibit prime talents or features to advantage (talent / abilities / collection) · topline: serve as the top-credited headlining attraction (cast / event / conference) · star: perform prominently as the principal actor or attraction (movie / show / production)
groups.nuance_zh: lead: 率先挂帅统领主导 (investigation / team / charge) · headline: 作为压轴明星或头条领衔演出 (festival / concert / lineup) · showcase: 聚焦展示优异才华或特性 (talent / abilities / collection) · topline: 名列海报首位主唱/领衔 (cast / event / conference) · star: 作为主角担当演出 (movie / show / production)

groups.name: Feel & Sense · 感觉与体会 (Feel, Sense, Experience)
groups.tip: 主观感知与身心体会的词群

items.def_zh: 感觉到，体会到；触摸；以为，觉得
items.def_en: 1. To experience a physical sensation or emotion. 2. To touch something in order to examine it. 3. To believe or have an opinion.
items.ex_en: I can feel the cold winter draft creeping beneath the front door.
items.ex_zh: 我能感觉到冬日的冷风正从正门底下丝丝渗入。

items.def_en: To undergo or encounter a particular emotion, sensation, or situation directly
items.ex_en: First-time marathon runners often experience acute physical exhaustion around mile twenty.
items.ex_zh: 初次参加马拉松的人往往会在跑过二十英里时体验到极度的体力透支。

items.def_en: To notice or consciously record a feeling or impression in the mind, or make it apparent
items.ex_en: Her composed face failed to register any shock at the scandalous revelation.
items.ex_zh: 面对那起骇人听闻的爆料，她镇定自若的脸上未显露出一丝震惊。

items.def_en: To become conscious of an emotion, impression, or environmental fact through awareness
items.ex_en: Dogs can perceive subtle shifts in human emotion far quicker than people.
items.ex_zh: 狗感知人类情绪细微变化的速度远比人自身要快得多。

items.def_en: To pass through, suffer, or endure an arduous experience or physiological process
items.ex_en: Patients must undergo thorough psychological evaluation before qualifying for the clinical trial.
items.ex_zh: 患者必须经过周密的心理评估后方有资格参与该临床试验。

groups.summary_en: This fundamental frame covers receiving tactile sensations, experiencing emotional and physical states, or having internal intuitions about an occurrence.
groups.summary_zh: 指由感官接触引发躯体感觉、体验内在情感心境或产生直觉领会。
groups.desc_en: Covers internalizing sensory data, emotional awareness, and subjectively experiencing external stimuli, contrasting with rational detached calculation.
groups.desc_zh: 指主体通过身心接收外界刺激并产生主观知觉、情感体会与生理感应，区别于冷酷理性的计算分析。
groups.nuance_en: feel: broad sensory or emotional conscious awareness (pain / joy / touch) · experience: undergo and live through an actual event or phenomenon (loss / hardship / growth) · register: cognitively take in, process, or outwardly reveal an effect (emotion / shock / surprise) · perceive: detect subtle cues through the senses or mental insight (danger / threat / shift) · undergo: be subjected to and pass through an ordeal or transformation (surgery / change / scrutiny)
groups.nuance_zh: feel: 最通用的主观感官与情绪体会 (pain / joy / touch) · experience: 亲身经历感受时代或事件 (loss / hardship / growth) · register: 认知并反应、在脸上显露出心神会意 (emotion / shock / surprise) · perceive: 敏锐察觉不易察觉的迹象 (danger / threat / shift) · undergo: 经受严峻考验、手术或变革 (surgery / change / scrutiny)

groups.name: Ferment & Brew · 发酵与暗中酝酿 (Brew, Smolder, Seethe)
groups.tip: 生物发酵引发内部躁动

items.def_en: To develop gradually beneath the surface, especially of an unpleasant crisis, storm, or conflict
items.ex_en: Dark storm clouds indicate that a severe coastal tempest is beginning to brew.
items.ex_zh: 乌云密布表明一场严峻的沿海风暴正在暗暗酝酿。
items.ex2_en: The local artisan brews exceptional craft beer using pure mountain spring water.
items.ex2_zh: 当地手艺人使用纯净的山泉水酿造出绝妙的精酿啤酒。

items.def_en: 1. To undergo or cause to undergo the chemical process of fermentation. 2. To cause or experience political or social unrest or excitement.
items.ex_en: Crushed grapes ferment in stainless steel tanks for three weeks during winemaking.
items.ex_zh: 酿酒过程中，压榨好的葡萄会在不锈钢桶内发酵三周。
items.ex2_en: The skilled baker ferments sourdough overnight before baking fresh breakfast loaves.
items.ex2_zh: 熟练的面包师在烘烤新鲜早餐面包之前将酸面团发酵过夜。

items.def_en: To become progressively worse, bitter, or more toxic over time through neglect
items.ex_en: Unresolved grievances will only fester and poison workplace morale over coming months.
items.ex_zh: 未能化解的怨气只会在接下来的数月里不断恶化，毒害职场士气。

items.def_en: To be filled with intense, barely contained anger, agitation, or turbulent excitement
items.ex_en: He continued to seethe with silent rage throughout the humiliating press conference.
items.ex_zh: 在整场受辱的记者会上，他内心持续翻腾着无声的狂怒。

items.def_en: To exist in a suppressed state without clear outward manifestation, ready to break out
items.ex_en: Resentment continued to smolder among the laid-off factory workers for months afterwards.
items.ex_zh: 被解雇的工厂工人心中暗自压抑着怨恨，持续了数月之久。

groups.summary_en: Covers organic chemical breakdown or metaphorical agitation where unrest, tension, or trouble develops beneath the surface before erupting.
groups.summary_zh: 指有机物化学发酵，或局势、情绪在暗中积累酝酿。
groups.desc_en: Captures the clandestine, slow buildup of hazardous friction, conflict, or rot beneath the surface before erupting, unlike overt open explosions.
groups.desc_zh: 指矛盾、骚乱或毒素在暗处地表下长久酝酿发酵、蓄积压力，区别于公开明面的瞬间爆发。
groups.nuance_en: brew: accumulate ominously unseen ready to break out (storm / trouble / scandal) · ferment: boil with political, intellectual, or social agitation (rebellion / revolution / ideas) · fester: decay continuously while breeding rancorous bitterness (wound / grievance / resentment) · seethe: churn with intensely repressed, boiling fury (rage / indignation / crowd) · smolder: burn slowly without flame, harboring suppressed conflict (resentment / embers / ruins)
groups.nuance_zh: brew: 暴风雨或事端在暗处积蓄酝酿 (storm / trouble / scandal) · ferment: 思想、反叛情绪剧烈暗潮发酵 (rebellion / revolution / ideas) · fester: 溃烂化脓、宿怨深埋腐蚀内心 (wound / grievance / resentment) · seethe: 怒火压抑不住地在胸中翻滚 (rage / indignation / crowd) · smolder: 留存暗火未熄、积怨未绝地潜伏 (resentment / embers / ruins)

groups.name: Fetch & Retrieve · 取回与寻来 (Retrieve, Bring back, Collect)
groups.tip: 前往某处将物品带回

items.def_en: To go to a place and pick up an item or passenger waiting to be retrieved
items.ex_en: Can you collect the children from their primary school after three o'clock?
items.ex_zh: 你能在三点之后去小学接一下孩子们吗？
items.ex2_en: Stray raindrops collected steadily in the shallow puddle beneath the leaking roof.
items.ex2_zh: 零星的雨滴在漏雨屋顶下浅浅的水洼中不断积聚。

items.def_en: To carry something with oneself on returning from another place
items.ex_en: Remember to bring back authentic olive oil when you return from your vacation.
items.ex_zh: 你休假归来时记得带回正宗的橄榄油。

items.def_en: To go somewhere to collect an item from a store, office, or designated holding place
items.ex_en: Business usually picks up in the spring, and sales figures improve rapidly.
items.ex_zh: 生意通常在春季好转，销售额也会迅速回升。

items.def_en: To find and bring something back from a location where it was stored, lost, or misplaced
items.ex_en: Divers managed to retrieve the sunken vessel's flight recorder from deep waters.
items.ex_zh: 潜水员成功从深水中打捞找回了沉船的黑匣子。

items.def_zh: 取回，接来，去拿；售得（某一价钱）
items.def_en: 1. To go to a place, get someone or something, and bring them back. 2. To be sold for a particular price.
items.ex_en: The butler was sent upstairs to fetch the guest's heavy woolen coat.
items.ex_zh: 管家被派上楼去取那位客人的厚呢子大衣。

groups.summary_en: Describes the complete round-trip motion of going to a specific location, obtaining an object or individual, and bringing them back to the point of origin.
groups.summary_zh: 指前往某地寻找并取回、领回人或物品的双向过程。
groups.desc_en: Involves traveling to an item's location and carrying it back, distinguishing it from static receiving or mere transport.
groups.desc_zh: 强调“前往某地、取得目标并带回原处”的双向闭环位移，区别于单向运送或被动接收。
groups.nuance_en: fetch: simple round-trip retrieval (stick / water / doctor) · retrieve: locating and recovering something lost, stored, or distant (data / body / ball) · collect: gathering scattered items or picking up waiting goods/people (children / parcels / samples) · pick up: casually collecting on one's way (groceries / hitchhiker / dry cleaning) · bring back: returning an item to its origin or memory (souvenir / book / memories)
groups.nuance_zh: fetch: 往返取来，含去程与回程闭环 (stick / water / doctor) · retrieve: 重新找回或调取远方、丢失之物 (data / body / ball) · collect: 集中收拢分散之物或按计划提取 (children / parcels / samples) · pick up: 顺路捎带或接人取物 (groceries / hitchhiker / dry cleaning) · bring back: 强调将物品带回出发地或恢复记忆 (souvenir / book / memories)

groups.name: Feud & Quarrel · 宿怨与争斗 (Bicker, Clash, Spar)
groups.tip: 长期世仇结怨导致反复争斗

items.def_en: To argue about petty, unimportant matters in an irritable, persistent way
items.ex_en: The siblings constantly bicker over who gets to choose the television channel.
items.ex_zh: 这几位兄弟姐妹经常为了谁有权选电视频道而抬杠争吵。

items.def_en: To engage in repeated, often sharp verbal exchanges or testing arguments with someone
items.ex_en: The two presidential candidates continued to spar over contentious economic policies yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 两位总统候选人昨天就争议性经济政策继续展开言语交锋。

items.def_en: To engage in a sharp, open conflict or direct confrontation over deeply incompatible views or interests
items.ex_en: Rival demonstrators clash violently outside city hall over controversial environmental legislation.
items.ex_zh: 对立的示威者因具争议性的环保法案在市政厅外爆发了激烈冲突。

items.def_en: To carry on a prolonged, bitter, and mutual quarrel or hostility with someone.
items.ex_en: The rival aristocratic families have continued to feud bitterly for three generations.
items.ex_zh: 这两个敌对的贵族家族已经相互结怨争斗了整整三代人。

items.def_en: To struggle persistently or engage in continuous hostility and conflict against a rival party
items.ex_en: Opposing warlords war ceaselessly across the barren desert sands for territorial supremacy.
items.ex_zh: 敌对的军阀在荒凉的大漠上持续交兵，争夺领土霸权。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on engaging in prolonged, bitter disputes or hostile rivalries between individuals, families, or groups. Nuances range from petty, persistent squabbling to intense, ideological warfare.
groups.summary_zh: 描绘长期对立、互相结怨或持续交锋，程度由零星口角至深仇大恨。
groups.desc_en: Denotes ongoing, reciprocal interpersonal or intergroup hostility, contrasting with isolated, non-recurrent disputes.
groups.desc_zh: 指持续性、交互性的对立交锋或世仇宿怨，区别于偶发且不具有延续性的普通冲突。
groups.nuance_en: bicker: petty, irritable arguing over trifles (siblings / details / rules) · spar: verbal sparring or non-lethal testing exchanges (debaters / rivals / politicians) · clash: sharp, direct head-on collision of interests or egos (factions / protesters / personalities) · feud: prolonged, bitter vendetta across generations or factions (families / dynasties / clans) · war: all-out, destructive campaign of sustained hostility (cartels / gangs / nations)
groups.nuance_zh: bicker: 为鸡毛蒜皮琐事喋喋不休地争吵 (siblings / details / rules) · spar: 试探性争辩或非致命交手 (debaters / rivals / politicians) · clash: 利益、立场或性格的激烈正面对撞 (factions / protesters / personalities) · feud: 世仇或长期积怨的持久恶斗 (families / dynasties / clans) · war: 全面且毁灭性的持久对抗 (cartels / gangs / nations)

groups.name: Filibuster & Procedural Obstruct · 阻挠与妨碍议程 (Filibuster, Stall, Obstruct)
groups.tip: 利用程序或发言拖延阻挠

items.def_en: To intentionally delay an action, decision, or vote in order to gain time or exhaust opponents
items.ex_en: Opposition lawmakers attempted to stall the crucial vote until the following week.
items.ex_zh: 反对派议员试图拖延这项关键表决，直到下周。
items.ex2_en: The old car engine stalled unexpectedly right in the middle of traffic.
items.ex2_zh: 老旧的汽车发动机在车流正中央毫无预兆地熄火了。

items.def_zh: 以滔滔不绝的长篇发言使（法案）流产
items.def_en: To defeat or shelve a parliamentary bill by consuming debate time until the deadline expires
items.ex_en: Instead of staying angry, they sat down together to talk out their differences.
items.ex_zh: 他们没有继续生闷气，而是坐下来通过坦诚交谈化解了分歧。

items.def_en: To deliberately impede or hinder the progress of a legislative bill, policy, or legal inquiry
items.ex_en: Corrupt officials attempted to obstruct the federal investigation by destroying crucial documents.
items.ex_zh: 腐败官员试图通过销毁关键文件来阻挠联邦层面的调查。

items.def_en: To severely restrict the efficiency or power of a governing body or process by procedural sabotage
items.ex_en: Procedural amendments threatened to hamstring the regulatory agency's ability to impose fines.
items.ex_zh: 程序性修正案恐将极大掣肘监管机构行使处以罚金的权力。

items.def_zh: （以冗长演说或议事程序）阻挠议案表决
items.def_en: 1. (politics) To delay or prevent a vote or decision in a legislature by making long speeches or using obstructive tactics.
items.ex_en: The senator planned to filibuster the contentious bill by reading long speeches.
items.ex_zh: 该参议员打算通过冗长演说来阻挠这项争议性法案的表决。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe exploiting parliamentary procedures, lengthy discourse, and bureaucratic rules to intentionally paralyze political votes, legislative sessions, or governmental actions.
groups.summary_zh: 利用冗长发言、程序漏洞或特权刻意阻碍议案表决与立法进程。
groups.desc_en: Employs procedural rules, delay tactics, or deliberate non-cooperation to prevent action, rather than substantive debate or physical blocking.
groups.desc_zh: 利用既定程序、拖延战术或刻意不作为来阻碍决议推进，区别于实质性辩论或实体物理阻拦。
groups.nuance_en: filibuster: prolonged speechifying or procedural delay in a legislature (bill / debate / senate) · talk out: killing a proposal by exhausting remaining legislative time (motion / measure) · stall: intentionally dragging out time to defer a decision (negotiations / inquiry / tactics) · obstruct: purposefully impeding legal or legislative processes (justice / investigation / passage) · hamstring: crippling an entity's operational ability to act (agency / enforcement / reforms)
groups.nuance_zh: filibuster: 立法机构中通过漫长演说阻挠议案表决 (bill / debate / senate) · talk out: 耗尽剩余辩论时间致使议案失效 (motion / measure) · stall: 故意拖延时间以延缓决策落实 (negotiations / inquiry / tactics) · obstruct: 蓄意设置程序或法律障碍 (justice / investigation / passage) · hamstring: 削弱或束缚关键能力使其瘫痪 (agency / enforcement / reforms)

groups.name: Fill & Cram · 挤入与塞满 (Cram, Jam, Stuff)
groups.tip: 填塞入内直至严实拥挤

items.def_en: To enter or force oneself into an enclosed space together with many others
items.ex_en: Excited fans tried to crowd into the tiny auditorium for the concert.
items.ex_zh: 激动的粉丝们争相挤进狭小的礼堂观看音乐会。

items.def_en: To push or force a lot of things or soft material tightly into a container or space
items.ex_en: She managed to stuff all her winter clothes into one small suitcase.
items.ex_zh: 她设法把所有的冬装都塞进了一个小行李箱里。

items.def_en: To fill a container, room, or space completely with objects or people
items.ex_en: Over three hundred enthusiastic spectators pack the tiny community center every Saturday.
items.ex_zh: 每周六，三百多名热情的观众都会挤满这个狭小的社区活动中心。

items.def_en: To push people or things into a space so tightly that movement becomes impossible
items.ex_en: Commuters jam the subway car so tightly that nobody can move easily.
items.ex_zh: 通勤者把地铁车厢挤得水泄不通，谁也动弹不得。
items.ex2_en: The rusted printer feed mechanism jammed instantly after processing five paper sheets.
items.ex2_zh: 生锈的打印机送纸机构在处理了五页纸后瞬间卡住了。

items.def_zh: 塞入，塞满，填满；（考前）突击死记硬背
items.def_en: 1. (+ into) To push or force people or things into a small space until it is completely full. 2. (+ for) (informal) To study intensively in a short period of time, especially right before an examination.
items.ex_en: College students often cram desperate facts into their heads before early exams.
items.ex_zh: 大学生经常在清晨的考试前临阵磨枪，死记硬背考点知识。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on forceful physical compression where an agent forces people or matter into an already tight or restricted volume past comfortable capacity. Nuances range from forcing pliable material ('stuff') to jammed immobility ('pack', 'jam').
groups.summary_zh: 指用力将大量物品或人塞进狭小空间内使其极度拥挤或饱和。
groups.desc_en: Forcing material or entities into a container or space past normal comfortable capacity, contrasting with orderly placement.
groups.desc_zh: 超出舒适容量将物体或人群强行挤入有限空间，区别于井然有序的正常容纳或放置。
groups.nuance_en: pack: pressing items firmly into a tight, organized mass (suitcase / stadium / court) · stuff: forcefully thrusting soft or pliable items into an enclosure (cushion / pockets / turkey) · cram: wedging things into limited space to absolute capacity (notes / commuters / drawers) · jam: wedging entities so tightly that movement becomes impossible (corridor / gears / door) · crowd into: mass flocking of living beings into a confined area (hall / bus / square)
groups.nuance_zh: pack: 紧凑压实或满负荷装载 (suitcase / stadium / court) · stuff: 将柔软/可塑物强行塞填入容器 (cushion / pockets / turkey) · cram: 毫无空隙地死记硬背或挤满狭小空间 (notes / commuters / drawers) · jam: 挤至动弹不得或造成机械卡滞 (corridor / gears / door) · crowd into: 人群或生物密集拥入狭窄场所 (hall / bus / square)

groups.name: Fill & Overflow · 充溢与外溢 (Overflow, Teem, Swarm)
groups.tip: 从充盈满溢发展至过载泛滥

items.def_en: (+ with) To become so full of a liquid or emotion that it spills past the edges
items.ex_en: Her expressive eyes brim over with tears during the moving final scene.
items.ex_zh: 在感人的最后一幕中，她那双传神的眼睛里泪水夺眶而出。

items.def_en: (+ into) To exceed normal limits and spread beyond the original space or situation
items.ex_en: The political unrest threatened to spill over into neighboring regions across the border.
items.ex_zh: 政治动荡有向边境对侧邻近地区蔓延的危险。

items.def_en: (+ with) To contain large numbers of animals, people, or moving things
items.ex_en: The ancient woodland seemed to teem with unseen creatures beneath the leafy canopy.
items.ex_zh: 繁茂的树冠之下，那片古老林地似乎充斥着隐秘的生灵。

items.def_en: To flow over the edges or bounds of a container because it is too full
items.ex_en: Heavy rains caused the stone basin in the courtyard to overflow within hours.
items.ex_zh: 暴雨使得院子里的石盆在数小时内便漫溢开来。
items.ex2_en: Careless tourists overflowed the recycling bins with mountains of discarded beverage cups.
items.ex2_zh: 粗心的游客将废弃饮料杯堆满了回收箱致使其溢出。

items.def_en: To be full to the brim with liquid, or to be full of a particular emotion or quality.
items.ex_en: Her bright eyes began to brim with tears of joy during the ceremony.
items.ex_zh: 典礼期间，她明亮的眼眸中开始充盈着喜悦的泪水。

groups.summary_en: This frame depicts reaching full capacity or spilling past borders, whether referring to a liquid exceeding a vessel's rim or a state abundant with life and emotion.
groups.summary_zh: 指容量达极值进而满溢而出，或因事物充满而极为丰盛。
groups.desc_en: Exceeding physical limits or capacity such that substance spills out or vitality surges visibly, contrasting with mere fullness.
groups.desc_zh: 液体或生机超出容器边界而向外漫溢流淌，强调“满溢而出”的动态，区别于静止的饱和。
groups.nuance_en: brim: reaching the absolute top edge of a vessel (eyes / tears / cup) · brim over: spilling over the rim from sheer abundance (confidence / river / enthusiasm) · overflow: surging beyond spatial or capacity limits (riverbanks / sewage / crowd) · spill over: extending uncontrollably into adjacent areas (violence / conflict / anger) · teem: swarming with visible abundance of living organisms (streets / fish / ideas)
groups.nuance_zh: brim: 充盈至容器边缘即将溢出 (eyes / tears / cup) · brim over: 丰沛至由边缘漫出 (confidence / river / enthusiasm) · overflow: 漫过堤岸或容量上限外溢 (riverbanks / sewage / crowd) · spill over: 局势失控波及相邻领域 (violence / conflict / anger) · teem: 充满生机、密集涌动 (streets / fish / ideas)

groups.name: Fill & Pervade · 弥漫与充斥 (Pervade, Permeate, Suffuse, Imbue)
groups.tip: 气味、情感无孔不入地渗透

items.def_en: Fill someone or something with a strong emotion or quality throughout
items.ex_en: His passionate keynote speech managed to infuse the exhausted team with fresh confidence.
items.ex_zh: 他激情澎湃的主题演讲使疲惫的团队重新注入了信心。

items.def_en: Spread through every part of an area, material, or system
items.ex_en: A damp earthy smell began to permeate every corner of the abandoned basement.
items.ex_zh: 一股潮湿的泥土气味开始弥漫在废弃地下室的每个角落。

items.def_en: Fill someone or something completely with a particular quality, value, or feeling
items.ex_en: The mentor sought to imbue his young apprentices with quiet humility and grace.
items.ex_zh: 导师力求让年轻学徒的内心彻底充满谦逊与优雅。

items.def_en: Gradually spread all over or through something, especially with light, color, or feeling
items.ex_en: The morning sun rose, and a soft amber glow began to suffuse the room.
items.ex_zh: 朝阳升起，一抹柔和的琥珀色光晕悄然弥漫了整个房间。

items.def_en: to spread through and be noticeable in every part of something
items.ex_en: A lingering sense of deep melancholy seemed to pervade the old family estate.
items.ex_zh: 一股久久不散的深沉忧郁似乎充斥着这座古老的家族庄园。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey qualities, smells, emotions, or influences diffusing deeply throughout every part of a space, mind, or physical medium.
groups.summary_zh: 指气味、氛围、情感或特质全面散布并充斥整个空间。
groups.desc_en: Gradual, deep diffusion of an intangible quality, scent, or fluid throughout an entire volume, contrasting with surface coating.
groups.desc_zh: 无形品质、气味或液体由内而外全面渗透并浸染整体空间，区别于外在表层的涂抹覆盖。
groups.nuance_en: pervade: spreading unobtrusively through every corner of an environment (smell / dread / influence) · permeate: passing through porous barriers to saturate completely (water / ideology / odor) · suffuse: washing over a surface with light, color, or gentle feeling (light / glow / warmth) · imbue: deeply endowing someone or something with values or spirit (spirit / culture / values) · infuse: actively steeping or injecting a revitalizing element (enthusiasm / herbs / energy)
groups.nuance_zh: pervade: 弥散充斥于空间或氛围的每个角落 (smell / dread / influence) · permeate: 穿透屏障或孔隙深入浸透 (water / ideology / odor) · suffuse: 光芒、色泽或情绪缓缓漫染铺开 (light / glow / warmth) · imbue: 深刻赋予思想、文化或精神气质 (spirit / culture / values) · infuse: 注入或浸泡出新生力量与特质 (enthusiasm / herbs / energy)

groups.name: Fill & Seal · 填缝与密封 (Caulk, Seal, Grout)
groups.tip: 用填料填满缝隙以防漏水

items.def_en: To fill the spaces between tiles, bricks, or stones with thin mortar or paste
items.ex_en: The contractor spent the morning learning how to grout the newly laid bathroom tiles.
items.ex_zh: 承包商花了一上午学习如何给新铺的浴室瓷砖填缝。

items.def_en: To fill narrow cracks or seams, especially between logs in a cabin wall, with mud or sealant
items.ex_en: Pioneers used clay and straw to chink the rough walls of their cabin.
items.ex_zh: 拓荒者们用黏土和麦秆填补小木屋粗糙墙壁的缝隙。
items.ex2_en: The narrow wooden shutters chinked faintly in the chilly autumn night breeze.
items.ex2_zh: 狭窄的木百叶窗在清凉的秋夜微风中发出微弱的叮当声。

items.def_en: To close an opening or joint securely so that gas, liquid, or dirt cannot enter or escape
items.ex_en: Apply this waterproof silicone adhesive to seal the joint between the glass panels.
items.ex_zh: 涂抹这种防水硅胶，以密封玻璃面板之间的接缝。

items.def_zh: （用填缝料）填塞，封堵（接缝或裂隙以防水防漏）
items.def_en: To seal cracks, joints, or seams in a boat, building, or pipe with a waterproof substance to prevent leakage.
items.ex_en: The shipwright used pitch to caulk the wooden hull before launching the vessel.
items.ex_zh: 造船匠在船只下水前用沥青填塞了木制船体。

items.def_en: To close a crack, opening, or container completely so that nothing can get in or out
items.ex_en: Workers used heavy concrete to seal up the entrance of the abandoned mine.
items.ex_zh: 工人们用厚重的混凝土将废弃矿井的入口彻底封死。

groups.summary_en: This construction and craftsmanship frame involves applying specialized, waterproof, or adhesive compound (mastic, silicone, mortar, or pitch) into narrow seams, joins, or gaps to make a structure airtight or impermeable to liquids.
groups.summary_zh: 指将防水胶泥或灰浆填入接缝裂纹中以实现密闭防水。
groups.desc_en: Applying impermeable compounds to fill joints and prevent leakage, contrasting with structural building or broad surface painting.
groups.desc_zh: 使用密封物料嵌填接缝以隔绝气水漏失，区别于结构搭建或大面积表面涂刷。
groups.nuance_en: seal: making an opening airtight or watertight by any means (envelope / border / deal) · seal up: completely closing off an enclosure from external access (cave / room / cracks) · caulk: filling waterproof compound into gaps of boats or joints (seams / bathtub / window) · grout: applying fluid mortar between tiles or masonry (tiles / joints / bricks) · chink: stuffing small slits in log cabins or stone walls (logs / cabin / walls)
groups.nuance_zh: seal: 封闭接口使其气密或水密 (envelope / border / deal) · seal up: 完全封死开口阻断进出通道 (cave / room / cracks) · caulk: 涂抹胶料填补板缝或卫浴缝隙 (seams / bathtub / window) · grout: 用灰浆填嵌瓷砖或砖石间隙 (tiles / joints / bricks) · chink: 嵌塞木屋原木或石墙狭缝 (logs / cabin / walls)

groups.name: Filter & Strain · 过滤与滤除 (Filter, Strain, Sift)
groups.tip: 借助滤网分离杂质与滤液

items.def_zh: 过滤，滤除；滤入，滤出；（消息等）走漏
items.def_en: 1. To pass liquid or gas through a device to remove impurities, or to remove something in this way. 2. To move gradually or in small numbers through something.
items.ex_en: We used an advanced ceramic membrane to filter harmful toxins from the water.
items.ex_zh: 我们使用先进的陶瓷滤膜滤除了水中的有害毒素。
items.ex2_en: Golden afternoon sunlight filtered softly through the thick leaves of the tree.
items.ex2_zh: 金色的午后阳光从树木茂密的枝叶间轻柔地透了进来。

items.def_en: (+ off/out) To separate solids from a liquid by passing it through a perforated utensil or sieve
items.ex_en: Use a metal colander to strain the hot water off the freshly boiled pasta.
items.ex_zh: 用金属滤盆将刚煮好的意面沥干水分。

items.def_en: To remove undesirable particles, elements, or noise by passing through a selective filter
items.ex_en: The software is designed to filter out spam emails automatically.
items.ex_zh: 该软件旨在自动过滤掉垃圾邮件。

items.def_en: (+ through) To put fine dry material through a mesh screen to remove larger lumps or foreign matter
items.ex_en: She used a fine wire mesh to sift flour through onto the board.
items.ex_zh: 她用细铁丝网将面粉筛到案板上。

items.def_en: (+ through) To trickle or pass slowly through a porous substance or filter medium
items.ex_en: Rainwater began to percolate slowly through the porous volcanic rock into deep aquifers.
items.ex_zh: 雨水开始穿过多孔的火山岩缓慢渗滤进深层含水层。
items.ex2_en: The automated machine percolated fresh dark coffee for the early morning travelers.
items.ex2_zh: 自动咖啡机为清晨出行的旅客过滤冲煮新鲜的浓咖啡。

groups.summary_en: Relates to passing a liquid, gas, or granular substance through a porous medium or mesh to isolate suspended solids, extract unwanted particles, or separate components.
groups.summary_zh: 指借助滤网或介质使流体或粉末通过，以分离杂质或固体颗粒。
groups.desc_en: Passing mixtures through a porous medium to separate solids from liquids or small particles from large, contrasting with random sorting.
groups.desc_zh: 通过多孔介质将固液分离或按颗粒大小筛滤杂质，区别于无介质的随意挑拣。
groups.nuance_en: filter: passing fluid through a porous barrier to trap solids or signals (water / sunlight / noise) · filter out: removing undesirable elements via systematic screening (impurities / contaminants / resumes) · strain: separating liquid by holding back larger solids under gravity or pressure (pasta / broth / muscles) · sift: shaking dry particulate matter through a mesh to refine it (flour / evidence / sand) · percolate: liquid filtering slowly through porous earth or grounds (coffee / water / ideas)
groups.nuance_zh: filter: 使流体经多孔介质截留杂质或过滤信号 (water / sunlight / noise) · filter out: 拦截剔除不需要的成分 (impurities / contaminants / resumes) · strain: 阻挡较大固形物以滤清汤汁或液体 (pasta / broth / muscles) · sift: 用筛网摇筛细粉颗粒或抽丝剥茧研判证据 (flour / evidence / sand) · percolate: 液体缓慢渗滤流过或想法逐渐酝酿散开 (coffee / water / ideas)

groups.name: Filter Down & Narrow Down · 初选与入围 (Narrow Down, Screen, Weed Out)
groups.tip: 层层筛选圈定入围者

items.def_en: To check candidates or items systematically to ensure suitability
items.ex_en: The human resources department will screen hundreds of applicants before holding interviews tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 人力资源部门将在明天举行面试之前筛选数百名申请人。

items.def_zh: 缩减范围，缩小（选择范围）
items.def_en: To reduce the number of possibilities, options, or candidates to a smaller selection
items.ex_en: The hiring committee managed to narrow down the list to three promising candidates.
items.ex_zh: 招聘委员会成功将候选人名单缩减至三名有潜力的求职者。
items.ex2_en: The wide winding river narrows down significantly as it enters the gorge.
items.ex2_zh: 宽阔蜿蜒的河流在进入峡谷时河道显著变窄了。

items.def_en: To eliminate unwanted, unqualified, or inferior members from a larger group
items.ex_en: The intensive entrance exam is designed to weed out unprepared applicants very quickly.
items.ex_zh: 强化入学考试旨在迅速淘汰毫无准备的应试者。

items.def_en: To remove unwanted items or individuals through a systematic selection process
items.ex_en: The software is designed to filter out spam emails automatically.
items.ex_zh: 该软件旨在自动过滤掉垃圾邮件。

items.def_zh: 将…列入候选名单，圈定入围
items.def_en: 1. To put someone or something on a shortlist of final contenders for a job, award, or competition.
items.ex_en: The prestigious literary committee voted to shortlist only four novels for the prize.
items.ex_zh: 享有盛誉的文学评审委员会投票圈定仅四部小说入围该奖项。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this procedural scenario frame describe evaluating multiple applicants, candidates, or options to produce a reduced roster of prime contenders.
groups.summary_zh: 指在选拔或评审过程中淘汰不合格者，筛出最终候选名单。
groups.desc_en: Progressive, staged elimination of candidates or items based on criteria to yield a qualified few, contrasting with instant selection.
groups.desc_zh: 依据标准分阶段逐步淘汰不合格项以锁定最终入围人选，区别于一步到位直接点选。
groups.nuance_en: screen: initial broad vetting to eliminate unsuitable options (applicants / baggage / blood) · weed out: systematically rooting out substandard or corrupt elements (weaklings / corrupt / defects) · filter out: blocking unwanted entries through automatic parameters (spam / noise / unqualified) · narrow down: reducing an extensive field of choices to a manageable number (options / suspects / list) · shortlist: formally selecting the final top contenders for a role or prize (candidates / novelists / applicants)
groups.nuance_zh: screen: 初步广谱审查以过滤不合格对象 (applicants / baggage / blood) · weed out: 拔除淘汰劣质、冗余或有害分子 (weaklings / corrupt / defects) · filter out: 通过既定参数将无效信息筛除 (spam / noise / unqualified) · narrow down: 将宽泛范围收窄至少数几个备选项 (options / suspects / list) · shortlist: 正式将入围者列入终选名单 (candidates / novelists / applicants)

groups.name: Fine Pricking & Pinpointing · 针刺与轻戳 (Jab, Poke, Pinprick)
groups.tip: 尖物扎破穿刺表面

items.def_en: Push a finger or pointed object into or through something
items.ex_en: He used a pointed branch to poke a small hole into the sack.
items.ex_zh: 他用一根尖树枝在麻袋上戳出了一个小洞。

items.def_zh: 刺，扎，戳；使感到刺痛；竖起（耳朵）
items.def_en: 1. To make a very small hole in the surface of something with a sharp point, or to cause a sharp stinging pain. 2. (of an animal) To raise (its ears) to listen.
items.ex_en: Be careful not to prick your finger on the sharp cactus thorns nearby.
items.ex_zh: 当心别被旁边锋利的仙人掌刺扎破了手指。

items.def_en: Push someone or something gently with a finger, stick, or pointed instrument
items.ex_en: He decided to prod the slumbering dog gently with his walking cane.
items.ex_zh: 他决定用手杖轻轻捅了捅那只沉睡中的狗。

items.def_en: Push a pointed object into something so that it stays there
items.ex_en: He had to stick the garden fork deep into the compacted garden soil.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不把园艺叉深深地扎入板结的庭院泥土中。
items.ex2_en: The rusted sliding door sticks badly whenever the humid summer weather arrives.
items.ex2_zh: 每当潮湿的夏季来临，那扇生锈的推拉门就卡得很厉害。

items.def_en: Poke or thrust abruptly with something pointed or blunt
items.ex_en: The boxer tried to jab his opponent repeatedly in the opening intense round.
items.ex_zh: 拳击手在激烈的第一回合试图反复猛刺对手。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures light, deliberate or accidental puncture of a surface with a fine, pointed object. While prick involves a tiny pinpoint entry, jab implies a sharp, rapid thrust and prod suggests gentle repetitive probing.
groups.summary_zh: 用尖细物体轻戳、扎出小孔或造成轻微刺痛。
groups.desc_en: Making small, targeted penetrations or thrusts using a slender, sharp or blunt tip, contrasting with deep laceration or blunt impact.
groups.desc_zh: 用尖锐或尖端器物施加轻微而精准的刺戳，强调局部触感与微创，区别于大面积割裂或重击。
groups.nuance_en: prick: puncturing the surface slightly with a sharp point (finger / conscience / balloon) · poke: prodding bluntly with a finger or stick to prompt a reaction (bear / fire / ribs) · prod: forceful poking or urging to stimulate motion (cattle / government / ribs) · jab: delivering a sudden, sharp, direct thrust (needle / elbow / chin) · stick: inserting or pinning a pointed object firmly into a base (pin / fork / note)
groups.nuance_zh: prick: 尖端轻微刺破表皮 (finger / conscience / balloon) · poke: 用手指或棍棒轻戳探弄 (bear / fire / ribs) · prod: 钝器用力戳刺以驱策催促 (cattle / government / ribs) · jab: 快速有力的突刺或短拳抽击 (needle / elbow / chin) · stick: 将尖锐之物稳固扎入或钉住 (pin / fork / note)

groups.name: Fish for Specific Shellfish/Seafood · 捞捕特定水产 (Prawn, Crab, Clam)
groups.tip: 在自然水陆环境中捕获猎物

items.def_en: To fish for, catch, or harvest crabs
items.ex_en: My uncle loves to crab off the wooden pier every single summer morning.
items.ex_zh: 我叔叔每年夏天的早晨都喜欢在木码头旁捕蟹。

items.def_en: To catch or harvest small marine shrimp, especially with nets along shallow waters
items.ex_en: Local fishermen head out at midnight to shrimp in the calm tidal bay.
items.ex_zh: 当地渔民半夜出发，在平静的潮汐湾里捕小虾。

items.def_en: To search for and dig up clams from mud flats or sand along the shore
items.ex_en: At low tide, families walk out along the sandy mudflats to clam.
items.ex_zh: 退潮时，一家老小沿着泥泞沙滩散步挖蛤。

items.def_en: 1. To fish for or catch prawns.
items.ex_en: Several local crews go out to prawn off the southern coastline during autumn.
items.ex_zh: 秋季期间，几支当地船队出海前往南部海岸附近捕大虾。

items.def_en: To fish by pulling a large net along the seabed or through deep open water
items.ex_en: Large commercial vessels trawl the ocean floor, catching massive amounts of flatfish daily.
items.ex_zh: 大型商业渔船在海底拖网捕捞，每天捕获大量的比目鱼。

groups.summary_en: This frame contains specialized maritime or coastal harvesting verbs that describe searching for, catching, or gathering specific marine organisms, especially shellfish and crustacea, from their natural habitats.
groups.summary_zh: 在水域或滩涂搜寻并捕捞特定海鲜水产（如虾蟹贝类）。
groups.desc_en: Harvesting specific benthic or marine invertebrate organisms in coastal or seabed habitats, contrasting with open-water finfishing.
groups.desc_zh: 在滨海或海底捕捞特定水生底栖甲壳类或软体动物，区别于开阔水域的捕鱼（finfish）。
groups.nuance_en: crab: setting traps or nets specifically for crabs (pots / coastal / boat) · shrimp: dragging nets in coastal shallows targeting shrimp (creek / net / trawler) · prawn: harvesting larger saltwater or freshwater decapods (estuary / traps / commercial) · clam: digging in mudflats at low tide for bivalves (mudflats / rake / tide) · trawl: dragging heavy industrial nets along the seafloor non-specifically (seabed / nets / waters)
