groups.nuance_zh: crab: 设笼或捕抓螃蟹 (pots / coastal / boat) · shrimp: 在沿海浅滩拖网捕小虾 (creek / net / trawler) · prawn: 捕捞对虾或大虾 (estuary / traps / commercial) · clam: 潮落时在滩涂挖蚌或花蛤 (mudflats / rake / tide) · trawl: 用底拖网扫荡捕捞水产 (seabed / nets / waters)

groups.name: Fissure & Split · 开裂与深裂 (Fissure, Cleave, Cleft)
groups.tip: 受力开裂形成裂隙

items.def_en: To divide or break lengthways into two or more parts
items.ex_en: The sudden heavy blow caused the dry wooden board to split in two.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的重击让干燥的木板一下裂成了两半。
items.ex2_en: The head chef carefully split the ripe vanilla bean with a knife.
items.ex2_zh: 主厨用刀小心地将成熟的香草荚切成两半。

items.def_zh: （使）开裂，（使）形成裂隙；（使）产生分歧
items.def_en: To split or crack open into deep, narrow openings; (figurative) to divide or break apart.
items.ex_en: Bitter ideological debates threatened to fissure the delicate coalition within the ruling party.
items.ex_zh: 激烈的意识形态争论有可能使执政党内部脆弱的联盟产生分歧裂痕。
items.ex2_en: The parched earth fissured deeply beneath the relentless heat of the drought.
items.ex2_zh: 干涸的土地在无情旱灾的高温炙烤下裂开了深深的缝隙。

items.def_en: To break or burst suddenly under pressure
items.ex_en: The extreme internal pressure caused the old water main to rupture without warning.
items.ex_zh: 极高的内部压力导致老旧自来水主管线毫无预警地破裂了。
items.ex2_en: Excessive hydraulic pressure ruptured the heavy steel pipeline behind the factory wall.
items.ex2_zh: 过大的液压震裂了工厂墙壁后沉重的钢管。

items.def_en: To split or sever something along a natural line or grain
items.ex_en: With one mighty swing, the woodcutter’s axe would cleave the oak log cleanly.
items.ex_zh: 樵夫猛力一挥，手中的斧头顺势将橡木原木齐整地劈成两半。
items.ex2_en: The brittle gemstone cleaved cleanly along its natural crystalline plane under pressure.
items.ex2_zh: 这颗脆弱的宝石在受压时沿着天然晶面整齐地裂开了。

items.def_en: To tear something apart with violent force; split asunder
items.ex_en: Screams of pure anguish seemed to rend the heavy silence of the night.
items.ex_zh: 极度痛苦的尖叫声似乎硬生生撕裂了黑夜沉沉的寂静。

groups.summary_en: This frame highlights physical materials or social units cracking apart into deep, elongated crevices, divides, or structural ruptures.
groups.summary_zh: 岩体、地面或团体开裂出深窄缝隙或走向分裂。
groups.desc_en: Splitting apart along structural fault lines or under severe tensile force, contrasting with clean cutting with a blade.
groups.desc_zh: 结构因应力或裂缝沿自然弱线崩裂破碎，强调断裂面的粗糙撕裂，区别于刀刃的平整切削。
groups.nuance_en: split: dividing cleanly along the grain or separating into factions (wood / party / bill) · fissure: developing deep narrow fractures through geological or structural stress (rock / skull / alliance) · cleave: forcefully splitting solid substance along a natural plane (rock / wood / air) · rupture: bursting violently from internal pressure or tensile breakdown (appendix / pipe / relations) · rend: tearing apart with violent, wrenching emotional or physical force (garments / heart / silence)
groups.nuance_zh: split: 顺应纹理剖开或分裂为派系 (wood / party / bill) · fissure: 受张力地质裂变或形成深窄断裂 (rock / skull / alliance) · cleave: 劈砍劈裂坚硬物或割裂空气 (rock / wood / air) · rupture: 承受内压暴烈破裂或断绝 (appendix / pipe / relations) · rend: 撕心裂肺或以狂暴之力撕碎 (garments / heart / silence)

groups.name: Flameless Low Burning · 闷烧与残燃 (Smolder, Glow, Simmer)
groups.tip: 无明火地内部闷烧

items.def_en: Continue to burn gently with reduced heat and minimal flame.
items.ex_en: The embers continued to burn low in the hearth throughout the chilly night.
items.ex_zh: 寒夜里，壁炉中的余烬整夜都在微弱残燃。

items.def_en: Emit vapor or gaseous exhaust while burning slowly without vigorous flames.
items.ex_en: Damp leaves began to smoke heavily inside the pit without igniting into flames.
items.ex_zh: 潮湿的树叶在坑内大量冒烟，却没有燃起明火。

items.def_en: 1. (US spelling of smoulder) To burn slowly with smoke but no flame. 2. To exist or develop in a hidden, suppressed state; to feel strong, lingering anger or passion.
items.ex_en: Charcoal embers continued to smolder in the pit long after the flames died.
items.ex_zh: 火势熄灭后很久，坑里的木炭余烬仍在闷烧。

items.def_en: Become increasingly rotten, or allow painful feelings to grow more intense in secret.
items.ex_en: Unresolved grievances began to fester within the community over several long bitter months.
items.ex_zh: 几个漫长痛苦的月份里，未解决的怨气在社区内部暗中恶化。

items.def_en: Be filled with intense but strictly unexpressed anger or agitation.
items.ex_en: He stood silently in the corner, forced to seethe with rage inwardly.
items.ex_zh: 他默默站在角落里，只能在心底强抑着狂暴的怒火。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify slow, flameless combustion that produces smoke and latent heat, or metaphorically describe suppressed feelings of rage, resentment, or rebellion waiting to erupt.
groups.summary_zh: 指无明火、有烟有热的低速缓慢燃烧，多喻指隐忍未发的怒火或敌意。
groups.desc_en: Combusting or simmering without active flame beneath the surface, often producing smoke or repressed heat, contrasting with raging blaze.
groups.desc_zh: 缺乏明火而在表层下方缓慢阴燃或蕴蓄热量，常伴随浓烟，区别于烈焰熊熊的公开燃烧。
groups.nuance_en: smolder: burning slowly with smoke but no active flame (embers / ruins / resentment) · burn low: diminishing in intensity to faint embers (fire / lamp / candle) · smoke: emitting vapors while smoldering poorly (chimney / debris / fire) · fester: decaying internally while generating worsening heat and toxicity (wound / grievances / slum) · seethe: boiling beneath a restrained exterior with suppressed agitation (anger / frustration / crowd)
groups.nuance_zh: smolder: 无明火闷燃冒烟或怨恨在暗中滋长 (embers / ruins / resentment) · burn low: 火势转微弱，残烬微照 (fire / lamp / candle) · smoke: 阴燃而持续冒烟 (chimney / debris / fire) · fester: 伤口化脓或矛盾内生腐溃加剧 (wound / grievances / slum) · seethe: 怒火中烧或局势在内里剧烈翻腾 (anger / frustration / crowd)

groups.name: Flapping & Fluttering Motion · 拍动与飘拂 (Flap, Flutter, Wave)
groups.tip: 像鸟翅或旗帜上下拍打

items.def_en: To move freely back and forth or up and down, especially in the air or wind
items.ex_en: Tall branches began to wave wildly under the force of the autumn gale.
items.ex_zh: 在高大的树枝在秋季狂风的肆虐下开始猛烈摇摆。

items.def_zh: 拍打，振动；飘动，摆动；慌乱，焦虑
items.def_en: 1. To move or cause to move quickly up and down or back and forth, like wings or a flag. 2. (informal) To behave in an excited, nervous, or panicky way.
items.ex_en: The frightened bird began to flap its injured wings frantically in the cage.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的鸟儿在笼子里拼命扑打受伤的双翼。
items.ex2_en: The tattered nautical flag flapped noisily against the wooden mast during storm.
items.ex2_zh: 破损的航海旗在暴风雨中撞击着木桅杆，啪啪作响。

items.def_en: To move or make something move with quick, light, wavering movements
items.ex_en: Bright silk ribbons flutter softly in the gentle afternoon breeze across the garden.
items.ex_zh: 明亮的丝带在午后穿过花园的轻柔微风中曼妙飘扬。
items.ex2_en: The nervous speaker fluttered his paper notes repeatedly during the opening remarks.
items.ex2_zh: 紧张的发言者在开场白中不断翻动抖弄手中的演讲纸稿。

items.def_zh: 鼓胀翻滚；如波涛般翻腾
items.def_en: To swell out or bulge like a sail or cloth filled with air, moving in rolling waves
items.ex_en: Thick black plumes of smoke billow from the industrial chimney into the sky.
items.ex_zh: 浓黑的烟柱从工业烟囱中如波涛般翻腾升入天空。

items.def_en: To wave or swing wildly and erratically, especially arms or limbs
items.ex_en: The drowning swimmer began to flail his arms wildly in desperate panic.
items.ex_zh: 溺水的泳客在极度恐慌中开始胡乱挥舞双臂。
items.ex2_en: The loose sails began to flail wildly in the sudden ocean gale.
items.ex2_zh: 松散的船帆在突如其来的海上大风中开始疯狂乱摆。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express rapid, oscillating back-and-forth or up-and-down movements of flexible objects, wings, sails, or fabrics caught in air currents. Nuances contrast light, delicate trembling movements with broad, forceful flapping or waving strokes.
groups.summary_zh: 指羽翼、旗帜或轻薄织物在空气中快速扇动、扑棱或飘摆。
groups.desc_en: Oscillating rapidly or rippling loosely in an air stream, contrasting with rigid mechanical rotation.
groups.desc_zh: 柔性物体在气流或外力驱使下产生不规则的拍击、翻卷或飘动，区别于刚性的规则机械转动。
groups.nuance_en: flap: moving back and forth noisily or broadly in wind (wings / flag / sails) · flutter: light, rapid, trembling vibration through the air (ribbon / eyelashes / heart) · wave: swinging deliberately or swaying in gentle undulating arcs (hand / banner / wheat) · billow: puffing outwards and undulating in heavy folds (smoke / sails / curtains) · flail: swinging wildly and erratically without control (arms / legs / limbs)
groups.nuance_zh: flap: 宽大幅度拍击且发出声响 (wings / flag / sails) · flutter: 细碎轻盈地快速飘颤 (ribbon / eyelashes / heart) · wave: 规则摆动或在微风中轻缓摇曳 (hand / banner / wheat) · billow: 如波涛般鼓起翻卷 (smoke / sails / curtains) · flail: 肢体慌乱失控地胡乱甩动 (arms / legs / limbs)

groups.name: Flatten & Level · 压平与夷平 (Level, Even Out, Raze, Smooth Out)
groups.tip: 消除凹凸起伏，使表面平整

items.def_en: to knock down or demolish buildings completely, or make an uneven surface flat and horizontal
items.ex_en: Bulldozers arrived early this morning to level the uneven ground for the playground.
items.ex_zh: 推土机今天一大早就赶来，为建操场夷平起伏不平的地面。

items.def_en: to eliminate irregularities or bumps so that a surface becomes smooth and uniform
items.ex_en: The gardener used a heavy roller to even out the newly laid lawn.
items.ex_zh: 园丁用重型滚压机将新铺的草坪压得平整均匀。
items.ex2_en: The fluctuating share prices evened out steadily after the initial market panic.
items.ex2_zh: 在最初的市场恐慌过后，波动的股票价格稳步趋于平稳。

items.def_en: to press out wrinkles, ridges, or bumps on an object using one's hands or a tool
items.ex_en: She carefully used both hands to smooth out the wrinkled linen table runner.
items.ex_zh: 她小心地用双手抚平起皱的亚麻桌旗。

items.def_zh: （使）变平，展平，压平；击倒，彻底打败
items.def_en: 1. to make something level or flat, or to become flat. 2. to knock down, destroy, or completely defeat someone or something.
items.ex_en: Use a heavy rolling pin to flatten the chilled pastry dough into circles.
items.ex_zh: 用沉重的擀面杖将冷藏过的油酥面团压平成圆形。
items.ex2_en: The swelling on his sprained wrist flattened noticeably after applying ice packs.
items.ex2_zh: 敷了冰袋后，他扭伤手腕上的肿胀明显平复了下去。

items.def_en: to completely destroy a building, town, or structure so nothing remains standing
items.ex_en: Invading forces moved in rapidly to raze the historic fortress to the ground.
items.ex_zh: 入侵部队迅速推进，将这座历史悠久的要塞彻底夷为平地。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve reducing contours, elevations, or standing structures to a flat, uniform surface, or demolishing objects to ground level.
groups.summary_zh: 指消除凹凸起伏使其平滑，或彻底夷平捣毁建筑物。
groups.desc_en: Eliminating elevation or irregularities to make an expanse flush and horizontal, contrasting with simple crushing.
groups.desc_zh: 削平高低差或起伏以使其齐平一律，强调高度降平与平整化，区别于单纯的压扁。
groups.nuance_en: flatten: reducing three-dimensional contours into a flat plane (dough / vegetation / curve) · level: bringing to an equal horizontal height or tearing structures to ground line (ground / city / accusations) · even out: balancing irregularities to achieve uniform smoothness (surface / discrepancies / odds) · smooth out: brushing or rolling away wrinkles and friction (creases / transition / difficulties) · raze: destroying a town or structure completely down to soil level (city / village / fortress)
groups.nuance_zh: flatten: 压成平整平面或压瘪三维形态 (dough / vegetation / curve) · level: 铲平至水平高度或彻底夷平建筑 (ground / city / accusations) · even out: 填平凹凸以消除不公与差额 (surface / discrepancies / odds) · smooth out: 抚平褶皱或消除摩擦障碍 (creases / transition / difficulties) · raze: 将城镇构筑物彻底夷为平地 (city / village / fortress)

groups.name: Flatten & Smooth · 压平与碾光 (Glaze, Iron, Mangling)
groups.tip: 辊压机热压压平压光织物

items.def_en: To remove wrinkles from cloth by pressing with an iron
items.ex_en: She had to iron out the stubborn creases in her cotton dress carefully.
items.ex_zh: 她不得不仔细熨平棉质连衣裙上的顽固褶皱。

items.def_en: To make or become flat or flatter by pressing, rolling, or beating
items.ex_en: Heavy traffic will flatten the soft gravel path over the next few weeks.
items.ex_zh: 繁忙的车流在接下来的几周内会把松软的碎石小径彻底压平。
items.ex2_en: The tall grass flattened completely beneath the heavy weight of winter snow.
items.ex2_zh: 茂密的高草在冬雪的沉重压迫下完全平倒了下去。

items.def_en: To press clothes or laundry through heavy mechanical rollers to remove water or smooth wrinkles
items.ex_en: Laundresses would carefully mangle wet bedsheets between two heavy rotating wooden cylinders.
items.ex_zh: 洗衣妇们会小心地用两个沉重的旋转木辊把湿床单轧平压干。

items.def_en: To make a surface smooth and shiny by rubbing or pressing hard with a tool
items.ex_en: The artisan used soft leather to burnish the dull silver cup until brilliant.
items.ex_zh: 手艺人用柔软的皮革碾磨打亮暗淡的银杯，直至光彩耀目。

items.def_zh: （用轧光机）压平，轧光（纸张、织物等）
items.def_en: To press cloth, paper, or other material between rollers to make it smooth, glossy, or flat.
items.ex_en: The mill uses heated steel cylinders to calender freshly woven cotton textiles effectively.
items.ex_zh: 工厂使用加热的钢制滚筒对新织出的棉织物进行有效轧光压平。

groups.summary_en: This frame pertains to mechanical smoothing, rolling, or pressing operations aimed at eliminating creases, reducing thickness, or imparting a uniform glossy finish.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过滚轴、熨压或碾光去除褶皱并使表面平整光亮。
groups.desc_en: Using mechanical heat, rolling pressure, or friction to give material a smooth, polished, crease-free finish, contrasting with coarse flattening.
groups.desc_zh: 利用机械滚压、热力或摩擦力消除褶皱并碾出平光质感，区别于粗暴的重力压扁。
groups.nuance_en: flatten: pressing flat under direct broad mechanical weight (cardboard / metal / turf) · iron out: removing textile wrinkles with heated iron; metaphorically settling snags (sheets / differences / kinks) · mangle: running wet laundry through heavy mechanical squeeze-rollers (linen / sheets / clothes) · calender: pressing paper or cloth between heated heavy rollers to impart glaze (fabric / paper / plastics) · burnish: rubbing a hard surface vigorously to make it glossy (metal / image / reputation)
groups.nuance_zh: flatten: 施加外力使曲面变平 (cardboard / metal / turf) · iron out: 熨平衣物折痕，引申为协商化解分歧 (sheets / differences / kinks) · mangle: 机械滚筒挤压脱水碾平布匹 (linen / sheets / clothes) · calender: 工业超级压光机热压织物或纸张使其光滑 (fabric / paper / plastics) · burnish: 研磨抛光金属或打磨公众形象 (metal / image / reputation)

groups.name: Flay & Skin · 剥皮与严酷鞭笞 (Flay, Skin, Excoriate)
groups.tip: 从表面撕扯剥去外皮表层

items.def_en: Remove the skin from an animal, vegetable, or fruit
items.ex_en: The chef demonstrated to students how to skin a ripe peach very cleanly.
items.ex_zh: 厨师向学生们演示了如何干脆利落地剥掉成熟桃子的果皮。

items.def_en: Shear the wool from sheep, or metaphorically strip someone of their money by deception
items.ex_en: Shady ticket touts managed to fleece tourists outside the sold-out stadium gate.
items.ex_zh: 不法黄牛在门票售罄的体育场门外成功敲了游客们一笔竹杠。

items.def_en: Whip someone severely with a lash, causing skin lacerations, or cause massive suffering
items.ex_en: The cruel tyrant ordered guards to scourge the captive rebel without any mercy.
items.ex_zh: 残酷的暴君命令卫兵毫不留情地鞭笞被俘的叛乱分子。

items.def_en: 1. To strip the skin off an animal or person. 2. To criticize someone severely or harshly.
items.ex_en: Hunters hung the wild stag from a beam to flay the hide.
items.ex_zh: 猎人们把野雄鹿吊在梁上，以剥去它的兽皮。

items.def_en: Tear or wear off the skin of someone, or express very strong, blistering disapproval of them
items.ex_en: Editorials in the major daily newspapers excoriate the mayor for his utter incompetence.
items.ex_zh: 各大主流日报的社论纷纷严厉痛斥市长毫无能力的拙劣表现。

groups.summary_en: This high-intensity physical and metaphorical frame involves tearing or stripping away skin or hides from flesh, extended figuratively to savage, merciless public castigation.
groups.summary_zh: 指物理上的剥皮与抽打，或比喻极度严苛的公开痛斥。
groups.desc_en: Stripping skin from flesh or subjecting to severe, lacerating punishment/censure, contrasting with surface scratching.
groups.desc_zh: 将皮肤/表皮剥离血肉或施以体罚剥皮般的残酷鞭笞与痛斥，区别于表层轻度擦伤。
groups.nuance_en: skin: peeling outer hide or rind cleanly from carcass or fruit (rabbit / potatoes / knees) · flay: brutally peeling the skin off a living body or whipping mercilessly (prisoner / skin / carcass) · excoriate: abrasively tearing skin off, or issuing scathing verbal condemnation (knees / critics / conduct) · fleece: stripping someone of their assets through swindling, or shearing wool (tourists / investors / sheep) · scourge: punishing severely with lashes, or afflicting as a pervasive torment (factions / population / nation)
groups.nuance_zh: skin: 剥下猎物毛皮或刨削果皮 (rabbit / potatoes / knees) · flay: 残酷剥皮或体罚鞭笞体无完肤 (prisoner / skin / carcass) · excoriate: 擦破表皮，引申为严厉口诛笔伐 (knees / critics / conduct) · fleece: 剪羊毛，比喻巧取豪夺压榨钱财 (tourists / investors / sheep) · scourge: 鞭笞严惩或作为苦难肆虐折磨 (factions / population / nation)

groups.name: Fleeting & Remote Sighting · 远眺与微见 (Espy, Discern, Catch Sight Of)
groups.tip: 无意间敏锐瞥见并认出

items.def_en: To catch sight of something distant, indistinct, or difficult to make out
items.ex_en: Through the dense sea fog, the lookout could barely descry a distant sail.
items.ex_zh: 透过浓重的大海雾气，瞭望员隐约远眺出远方的一只风帆。

items.def_en: To identify or recognize someone or something within a crowded or obscure field of view
items.ex_en: The victim was able to pick out the attacker from a lineup of suspects.
items.ex_zh: 受害者能够从一排嫌疑人中指认出袭击者。

items.def_en: To see someone or something fleetingly or indistinctly
items.ex_en: Fans waited outside for hours just to glimpse the famous actress leaving rehearsals.
items.ex_zh: 影迷们在外面等候数小时，只为隐约瞥一眼走出排练场的著名女演员。

items.def_en: To perceive or recognize something faintly, indistinctly, or with visual effort
items.ex_en: Through the thick nocturnal darkness, she could barely discern the outline of mountains.
items.ex_zh: 穿透浓重的夜色，她勉强能辨出群山的轮廓。

items.def_en: (literary or archaic) to catch sight of or notice something, especially something distant or partly hidden
items.ex_en: Looking across the misty valley, the scout espied an isolated cottage among the pines.
items.ex_zh: 眺望薄雾笼罩的山谷，斥候隐约瞥见松林间有一座孤零零的村舍。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on catching sight of obscure, partially concealed, or distant objects, often demanding careful observation or happening unexpectedly.
groups.summary_zh: 指在远处、遮掩处或模糊视线中捕捉或辨识出隐蔽景象。
groups.desc_en: Catching a sudden, distant, or barely perceptible visual glimpse through visual barriers, contrasting with sustained steady looking.
groups.desc_zh: 突破距离、隐蔽或昏暗阻碍，捕捉到短暂、遥远或隐约的视觉轮廓，区别于注视或长时间审视。
groups.nuance_en: glimpse: catching a fleeting, momentary half-view of something moving (celebrity / ocean / truth) · catch sight of: suddenly noticing something after visually scanning (friend / shore / ship) · discern: detecting and identifying an indistinct figure through mental/visual effort (shapes / intent / outline) · espy: spotting something remote, hidden, or small from a distance (cove / flaw / sail) · descry: catching sight of something far off on the horizon with difficulty (land / ship / coastline)
groups.nuance_zh: glimpse: 极短暂地瞥见浮光掠影 (celebrity / ocean / truth) · catch sight of: 在视线扫视中突然捕捉看见 (friend / shore / ship) · discern: 费力辨认出昏暗或模糊之物 (shapes / intent / outline) · espy: 敏锐地窥见远方或隐匿之物 (cove / flaw / sail) · descry: 极目远眺艰难辨认地平线上的远景 (land / ship / coastline)

groups.name: Flicker & Waver · 摇曳与闪烁将熄 (Flicker, Gutter, Waver)
groups.tip: 微光忽明忽暗或随风摇摆不定

items.def_zh: 渐渐变弱而熄灭；逐渐断送
items.def_en: To diminish gradually until fading out or coming to a complete stop
items.ex_en: The prolonged street protests gradually petered out as subzero winter temperatures finally arrived.
items.ex_zh: 随着严冬零下低温的降临，旷日持久的街头抗议逐渐平息。

items.def_zh: （烛光等）摇曳，闪烁不定；形成沟槽，流淌
items.def_en: 1. (of a flame or candle) To flicker and burn unsteadily, often on the verge of going out. 2. To form channels or grooves in a surface.
items.ex_en: The lone tallow candle began to gutter violently in the freezing cellar draft.
items.ex_zh: 在冰冷的地窖穿堂风中，那根孤零零的牛脂蜡烛剧烈摇曳起来。

items.def_en: To shine with a light that is unsteady, varying rapidly in brightness
items.ex_en: The overhead fluorescent bulbs began to flicker erratically during the violent summer thunderstorm.
items.ex_zh: 在狂暴的夏季雷雨中，头顶的荧光灯管开始不稳定地明灭闪烁。

items.def_en: To shake, tremble, or become unsteadily bright and faint, as a flame in a draft
items.ex_en: The solitary lantern flame wavered whenever the bitter north wind rattled the shutters.
items.ex_zh: 每当凛冽的北风撼动百叶窗，那盏孤灯的火焰便摇晃微颤。

items.def_zh: 噼啪作响并闪烁；断续明灭
items.def_en: To burn with irregular spitting sounds and sudden spitting bursts of light before extinguishing
items.ex_en: The soaked emergency flare sputtered twice in the wet snow before dying completely.
items.ex_zh: 被浸湿的应急信号弹在湿雪中噼啪闪烁了两下，随后彻底熄灭。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame portray luminous sources, especially candles or open flames, burning erratically, shuddering in drafts, and trembling on the verge of dying out. They convey delicate, unstable luminescence.
groups.summary_zh: 指火光或烛泪在微风中摇摇欲坠、明灭不定、濒临熄灭。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an unstable, intermittent emission of light, energy, or resolve bordering on extinction, contrasting with steady burning or clean extinguishment.
groups.desc_zh: 指光线、能量或决心不稳定、断断续续且濒临熄灭的颤动状态，区别于稳定的燃烧或干脆的熄灭。
groups.nuance_en: flicker: rapid, unsteady wavering of light or hope (flame / light / smile) · gutter: flickering weakly while choking on melting wax or dying fuel (candle / lamp) · sputter: spitting or popping fitfully while failing (engine / wick / protest) · waver: moving back and forth unsteadily in strength or intent (resolve / shadow / courage) · peter out: gradually fading into nothingness (energy / momentum / trail)
groups.nuance_zh: flicker: 微光或希望急促而不稳定的闪烁 (flame / light / smile) · gutter: 烛蜡将尽、微光摇曳欲熄 (candle / lamp) · sputter: 噼啪作响、断断续续地衰竭 (engine / wick / protest) · waver: 强度或意志前后摇摆晃动 (resolve / shadow / courage) · peter out: 逐渐衰退至完全消失 (energy / momentum / trail)

groups.name: Flit & Pass Swiftly · 飞掠与疾逝 (Fleet, Flit, Skim)
groups.tip: 轻快穿梭掠过转瞬即逝

items.def_en: To move quickly and lightly just above a surface
items.ex_en: The low-flying swallows skim the calm lake surface to feed on evening insects.
items.ex_zh: 低飞的燕子掠过平静的湖面，捕食傍晚出没的昆虫。

items.def_en: To make a sudden, quick, darting movement
items.ex_en: Frightened lizards dart across the sunlit gravel path toward the safety of the rocks.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的蜥蜴倏地穿过阳光照耀的碎石小径，奔向安全的岩石堆。

items.def_en: To move or take someone or something somewhere very quickly and smoothly
items.ex_en: Secret service agents whisked the foreign dignitary through the secured underground loading dock.
items.ex_zh: 特勤局特工护送外宾迅捷穿过戒备森严的地下装卸区。

items.def_en: To move quickly and lightly from one place or topic to another
items.ex_en: Bright yellow butterflies flit gracefully among the wild lavender bushes in the orchard.
items.ex_zh: 明黄色的蝴蝶在果园里的野生薰衣草丛间轻盈翻飞。

items.def_en: (literary) To move swiftly or pass away quickly.
items.ex_en: Dark storm clouds fleet across the pale moon, casting fleeting shadows upon the moor.
items.ex_zh: 乌云飞快掠过苍白的月亮，在荒原上投下一道道转瞬即逝的暗影。

groups.summary_en: This literary/poetic frame denotes rapid, light, or evanescent passing, capturing fleeting motions through air, space, or transient time.
groups.summary_zh: 描绘如浮光掠影般轻盈、短暂且转瞬即逝的掠行与流逝。
groups.desc_en: Denotes rapid, light, and transient skimming motion through space or time, contrasting with steady traversal or heavy, deliberate passage.
groups.desc_zh: 指在空间或时间中轻盈、短促且快速地掠过，区别于匀速行进或沉稳费力的穿行。
groups.nuance_en: flit: moving quickly and lightly from one place to another (butterfly / shadow / thought) · skim: gliding smoothly and lightly over a surface (surface / water / cream) · dart: sudden, swift, shooting movement (eyes / glance / minnow) · whisk: brisk, sweeping movement away or along (pastry / child / broom) · fleet: fading or vanishing rapidly through time (youth / hour / phantom)
groups.nuance_zh: flit: 轻巧敏捷地从一处掠向另一处 (butterfly / shadow / thought) · skim: 贴近表面平滑轻盈地掠过 (surface / water / cream) · dart: 突发、如飞镖般迅疾射向某处 (eyes / glance / minnow) · whisk: 迅速拂过或快捷地带走 (pastry / child / broom) · fleet: 时间或生命等快速流逝、消隐 (youth / hour / phantom)

groups.name: Flood & Engulf · 泛滥与覆没 (Flood, Inundate, Deluge)
groups.tip: 大水漫灌或巨量涌入完全吞没

items.def_en: To drive someone or animals away from a home or land through rising floodwaters.
items.ex_en: Rising spring floods soon drowned out the villagers who lived beside the riverbank.
items.ex_zh: 不断上涨的春汛很快将居住在河岸边的村民逼离了家园。

items.def_en: To spill over the edges or boundaries because of an excessive volume of liquid.
items.ex_en: Sudden torrential mountain rains caused the drainage ditch to overflow into neighboring streets.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的山地暴雨导致排水沟溢出，漫灌到了邻近街道。
items.ex2_en: Careless bartenders often overflow the pint glasses when pouring tap draft beer.
items.ex2_zh: 粗心的调酒师在倒生啤酒时经常倒得太满溢出玻璃品脱杯。

items.def_en: 1. To cover dry land with water, or become covered with water. 2. To arrive, fill, or enter in overwhelmingly large numbers or amounts.
items.ex_en: The surging river burst through the broken levee and flooded the adjacent farmland.
items.ex_zh: 汹涌的河水冲垮了决口的堤坝，淹没了邻近的农田。
items.ex2_en: Warm coastal seawater flooded quickly into the low basements during high tide.
items.ex2_zh: 涨潮期间，温暖的沿海水迅速倒灌进低洼的地下室中。

items.def_zh: 以暴雨或洪流淹没；倾泻而下充斥
items.def_en: To cover completely with water or a heavy downpour, or to overwhelm with an enormous quantity of something.
items.ex_en: Unrelenting torrential rains deluged the coastal plain, submerging several major transport arteries.
items.ex_zh: 连绵不绝的暴雨倾泻在沿海平原上，淹没了数条主要的交通干道。

items.def_en: To sweep over and completely envelop or swallow up something in water, flames, or devastation.
items.ex_en: A ferocious wall of muddy water engulfed the sleepy town within minutes.
items.ex_zh: 凶猛的浑浊水墙在数分钟内彻底吞没了这座沉睡的小镇。

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies the violent or overwhelming covering of land, spaces, or people by water, or an analogous sudden crush of objects and emotions. Verbs express high volume, rapid accumulation, and overpowering force.
groups.summary_zh: 指大量水体或事物迅猛倾泻、暴涨并彻底充斥或掩盖目标。
groups.desc_en: Denotes overpowering submersion or overwhelming cover by liquid or massive volume, contrasting with ordinary wetting or manageable accumulation.
groups.desc_zh: 指以大量液体或巨量规模进行压倒性的淹没或覆盖，区别于普通浸湿或可控的积聚。
groups.nuance_en: flood: pouring forth in excessive volume to cover land (river / market / light) · deluge: violently submerging under an overwhelming downpour or torrent (rain / complaints / valley) · engulf: completely swallowing up or enclosing within depths (flames / darkness / waves) · overflow: spilling over brim or boundaries through excess (banks / cup / emotions) · drown out: completely overpowering an auditory or sensory signal (noise / voice / dissent)
groups.nuance_zh: flood: 大量涌出以致泛滥成灾 (river / market / light) · deluge: 暴雨倾盆般猛烈淹没 (rain / complaints / valley) · engulf: 彻底吞没、吞噬并包围 (flames / darkness / waves) · overflow: 因过量而溢出边缘边界 (banks / cup / emotions) · drown out: 在声音或感官上彻底压倒并掩盖 (noise / voice / dissent)

groups.name: Flood with Messages · 滥发与信息轰炸 (Bombard, Barrage, Inundate)
groups.tip: 批量发送或派遣传递

items.def_zh: 群发垃圾邮件，批量发送垃圾信息
items.def_en: To send unwanted or repetitive advertising or messages to a large number of people over the internet.
items.ex_en: A shady marketing company spammed thousands of personal accounts with deceptive loan promotions.
items.ex_zh: 一家信誉不良的营销公司向数千个个人账户群发虚假贷款推广信息。

items.def_zh: 连珠炮般发来；密集倾泻
items.def_en: To direct an overwhelming outpouring of complaints, inquiries, or promotional communications at someone
items.ex_en: Angry consumers barraged the customer service hotline with complaints regarding the flight cancellations.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的消费者向客服热线发起连珠炮般的投诉，质问航班取消一事。

items.def_en: (+ with) To attack or pester someone continuously with excessive messages, questions, or advertisements
items.ex_en: Frustrated citizens bombarded their local representative with hundreds of angry electronic messages.
items.ex_zh: 沮丧的市民向当地代表密集发送了数百封愤怒的电子邮件。

items.def_en: To overwhelm someone with a sudden downpour of letters, phone calls, or digital notifications
items.ex_en: The HR department was deluged with thousands of electronic resumes overnight.
items.ex_zh: 人力资源部在一夜之间被数以千计蜂拥而至的电子简历所淹没。

items.def_en: (+ with) To overwhelm someone with a huge, unmanageable volume of requests or mail
items.ex_en: The municipal health clinic was inundated with calls regarding the seasonal flu outbreak.
items.ex_zh: 市立诊所被大量咨询季节性流感疫情的电话淹没，应接不暇。

groups.summary_en: Centers on overwhelming an audience or system by sending unsolicited, excessive, or repetitive messages. Highlights nuisance volume and aggressive communication channels.
groups.summary_zh: 指发送大量垃圾、不请自来或轰炸式的信息以压垮对方。
groups.desc_en: Denotes targeting a recipient with an unbearable, excessive volume of communications, contrasting with normal transmission or single-message contact.
groups.desc_zh: 指以压倒性的超量通讯对接收者进行密集倾倒轰炸，区别于普通收发或单条联络。
groups.nuance_en: spam: sending indiscriminate, unwanted bulk messages (inbox / user / forum) · bombard: relentlessly pelting with persistent inquiries or messages (office / minister / phone) · barrage: unleashing a continuous, coordinated hail of communication (questions / criticisms / emails) · deluge: swamping under an unmanageable flood of items (mailroom / server / inbox) · inundate: completely overwhelming capacity with incoming requests (helpline / staff / department)
groups.nuance_zh: spam: 滥发无差别的垃圾批量信息 (inbox / user / forum) · bombard: 持续且不依不饶地连珠炮式轰炸 (office / minister / phone) · barrage: 密集倾泻连续且协调的言辞或信息 (questions / criticisms / emails) · deluge: 暴流般使收件系统难以招架 (mailroom / server / inbox) · inundate: 巨量涌入彻底击垮负荷能力 (helpline / staff / department)

groups.name: Flourish & Prosper · 兴旺与茁壮成长 (Flourish, Prosper, Bloom)
groups.tip: 生命力蓬勃生长繁衍

items.def_en: To become healthy, radiant, or fully developed and prosperous
items.ex_en: After years of patient rehabilitation, her natural artistic talents finally bloomed in adulthood.
items.ex_zh: 经过多年的耐心调理与培养，她的艺术才华终于在成年后充分展现。

items.def_zh: 繁荣，茁壮生长，蓬勃发展
items.def_en: 1. To grow vigorously, stay healthy, and flourish or become very successful.
items.ex_en: Local craft breweries thrive under favorable regional tax regulations and enthusiastic community patronage.
items.ex_zh: 在有利的区域税收政策与社区的热情支持下，当地精酿啤酒厂蓬勃发展。

items.def_en: To grow luxuriantly, be healthy, and achieve sustained success or vigor
items.ex_en: Classical philosophy and the fine arts flourished throughout the golden age of Athens.
items.ex_zh: 古典哲学与美术在雅典的黄金时代蓬勃发展、盛极一时。

items.def_en: To develop in a highly successful way, especially financially or in status
items.ex_en: Export-oriented manufacturing enterprises prospered following the gradual removal of restrictive bilateral tariffs.
items.ex_zh: 随着双边限制性关税的逐步取消，外向型制造企业迎来了蓬勃繁荣。

items.def_en: To begin to grow, expand, or develop rapidly and luxuriantly
items.ex_en: A vibrant digital technology corridor burgeoned across the once impoverished industrial valley.
items.ex_zh: 在这座曾经贫困的工业山谷中，一条充满活力的数字技术走廊迅速崛起。

groups.summary_en: This frame relates to living organisms, businesses, or ecosystems growing robustly, developing vigorously, and achieving vigorous health and peak success.
groups.summary_zh: 描述生命有机体或实体展现旺盛生命力，茁壮发展与繁荣昌盛。
groups.desc_en: Denotes vigorous healthy growth, success, and peak productive vitality, contrasting with mere survival, stagnation, or decline.
groups.desc_zh: 指处于旺盛、健康且成功的生命力巅峰状态，区别于勉强存活、停滞或衰退。
groups.nuance_en: flourish: thriving conspicuously in a favorable environment (arts / business / civilization) · prosper: succeeding financially or materializing long-term fortune (economy / venture / trader) · thrive: vigorously growing and expanding even under pressure (child / industry / colony) · bloom: opening fully into beauty, maturity, or peak state (rose / youth / romance) · burgeon: rapidly expanding, putting forth buds or new shoots (middle class / demand / suburbs)
groups.nuance_zh: flourish: 在良好环境中繁荣昌盛、卓有建树 (arts / business / civilization) · prosper: 经济或物质层面的长足富足与成功 (economy / venture / trader) · thrive: 即使在逆境下亦极具韧性地茁壮生长 (child / industry / colony) · bloom: 盛开绽放、步入成熟璀璨阶段 (rose / youth / romance) · burgeon: 如雨后春笋般迅猛萌发与扩张 (middle class / demand / suburbs)

groups.name: Flourish & Prosper · 繁荣与蓬勃发展 (Thrive, Bloom, Blossom)
groups.tip: 生机勃勃或经济蓬勃发展

items.def_en: To produce blossoms, or metaphorically to achieve full beauty, health, or promise
items.ex_en: Wild almond trees bloom across the rocky hillsides during early Mediterranean spring.
items.ex_zh: 地中海初春时节，野生杏树在岩石遍布的山坡上盛开迎春。

items.def_en: To grow vigorously, be healthy, or do extremely well in a particular environment
items.ex_en: Hardy native pine species thrive easily in this dry, windswept mountain environment.
items.ex_zh: 顽强的本土松树物种在干旱且迎风的高山环境中茁壮生长。

items.def_zh: 繁荣，昌盛；蓬勃生长；挥舞
items.def_en: 1. When a business, plant, or civilization flourishes, it grows strongly and succeeds. 2. To wave something dramatically in the air.
items.ex_en: Maritime commerce flourished along the strategic trading routes of the ancient Mediterranean.
items.ex_zh: 海上商业在古代地中海战略贸易航线上蓬勃兴盛、长盛不衰。

items.def_en: To develop into something promising, rich, successful, or attractive
items.ex_en: Their tentative working relationship blossomed into a remarkably productive lifelong research partnership.
items.ex_zh: 他们试探性的工作关系逐步发展为成果丰硕的终生科研伙伴关系。

items.def_en: To begin to grow, expand, or develop rapidly and abundantly
items.ex_en: Specialized renewable energy start-ups burgeoned as private investment flowed into green technology.
items.ex_zh: 随着私人投资涌入绿色技术，专门从事可再生能源的初创企业急剧繁荣。

groups.summary_en: This frame highlights vigorous, healthy growth, vibrant development, and visible vitality in organisms, communities, or systems. It emphasizes vibrant energy and blossoming potential beyond mere financial gain.
groups.summary_zh: 强调生命力旺盛、生机勃勃地健康生长或事业文化的大放异彩。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the unfolding, maturing, and vigorous outward expansion of organic or economic potential, contrasting with dormancy, withering, or arrested development.
groups.desc_zh: 指有机体或经济潜能展现、成熟并蓬勃向外展开，区别于休眠、枯萎或发育迟缓。
groups.nuance_en: blossom: developing fully into promise, beauty, or fruition (friendship / talent / career) · thrive: vigorously maintaining robust health and expansion (ecosystem / market / child) · flourish: achieving widespread acclaim, energy, or vigor (trade / community / culture) · bloom: reaching radiant maturity and vitality (flower / face / health) · burgeon: budding forth in rapid multiplication (population / movement / industry)
groups.nuance_zh: blossom: 充分展开潜能、结出硕果或趋于美好 (friendship / talent / career) · thrive: 强健茁壮、充满活力地扩张生存 (ecosystem / market / child) · flourish: 步入鼎盛、展现旺盛创造力与生机 (trade / community / culture) · bloom: 鲜艳成熟、精神焕发 (flower / face / health) · burgeon: 迅速萌芽抽枝、规模暴增 (population / movement / industry)

groups.name: Fluctuate & Vacillate · 震荡与摇摆不定 (Fluctuate, Oscillate, Vacillate, Yo-yo)
groups.tip: 如跷跷板般在两极波动

items.def_zh: （在两极间）摇摆不定，频繁波动；玩跷跷板
items.def_en: To repeatedly change between two conditions, moods, or states; to move up and down alternately.
items.ex_en: Crude oil prices seesawed between sharp gains and heavy losses all week.
items.ex_zh: 原油价格整整一周都在大幅上涨和惨烈下跌之间剧烈拉锯摇摆。

items.def_en: To change continuously and irregularly from one level or value to another
items.ex_en: Consumer demand tends to fluctuate wildly depending on unpredictable global fuel prices.
items.ex_zh: 受不可预测的全球燃料价格影响，消费者需求往往会出现剧烈波动。

items.def_en: (+ between) To swing continuously between differing opinions, feelings, or behaviors
items.ex_en: Throughout the debate, the committee oscillated between implementing strict quotas and proposing tariffs.
items.ex_zh: 在整场辩论中，委员会在实行严格配额与提议加征关税之间游移不定。

items.def_en: (+ between) To waver indecisively between different choices or paths of action
items.ex_en: Senior executives vacillated between approving the overseas acquisition and retaining capital reserves.
items.ex_zh: 高级管理层在批准海外并购与保留资金储备之间犹豫不决、举棋不定。

items.def_zh: 剧烈反弹浮动，忽上忽下
items.def_en: To change erratically between high and low levels or conditions over a short time
items.ex_en: Consumer confidence ratings yo-yoed rapidly with each new quarterly macroeconomic inflation report.
items.ex_zh: 随着每季度新的宏观经济通胀报告出炉，消费者信心指数忽上忽下。

groups.summary_en: This domain governs continuous, unstable shifting back and forth between two opposing positions, emotional states, price points, or levels.
groups.summary_zh: 指观点、情绪、政策或指标在两极状态间不断剧烈反弹与起伏摇摆。
groups.desc_en: Denotes shifting, unstable oscillation between two extremes or irregular points, contrasting with steady progress, convergence, or fixed rest.
groups.desc_zh: 指在两个极端或不规则点位之间来回动荡或反复横跳，区别于稳定演进、收敛或静止。
groups.nuance_en: fluctuate: moving up and down irregularly (prices / temperature / exchange rate) · oscillate: swinging steadily back and forth between two distinct states or poles (pendulum / mood / opinions) · vacillate: wavering indecisively between alternative courses of action (leader / voter / mind) · seesaw: alternating sharply and repeatedly up and down or back and forth (stock / battle / fortune) · yo-yo: plunging and rebounding erratically and sharply (diet / market / inflation)
groups.nuance_zh: fluctuate: 数量或水准不规则地上下波动 (prices / temperature / exchange rate) · oscillate: 在两个固定极值或状态间机械式摆动 (pendulum / mood / opinions) · vacillate: 在决策或立场间优柔寡断地摇摆 (leader / voter / mind) · seesaw: 跷跷板式剧烈交替起伏、互有消长 (stock / battle / fortune) · yo-yo: 溜溜球般暴涨暴跌、反复拉锯 (diet / market / inflation)

groups.name: Fluctuate & Waver · 波动与摇摆 (Oscillate, Waver, Swing)
groups.tip: 状态或数值起伏不定

items.def_en: To repeatedly increase and decrease, or wax and wane, in rhythmic recurrence
items.ex_en: The strategic influence of ancient regional powers ebb and flow across centuries.
items.ex_zh: 古代地区强权的战略影响力在几个世纪的岁月中历经盛衰起伏。

items.def_en: 1. (+ between/around) To rise and fall irregularly in amount, number, or strength.
items.ex_en: Interest rates fluctuate unpredictably around five percent based on quarterly inflationary pressures.
items.ex_zh: 受季度通胀压力影响，利率在百分之五上下呈现不可预测的波动。

items.def_en: (+ between) To lose strength or falter between alternate choices or positions
items.ex_en: Undecided delegates continued to waver between the two competing constitutional reform proposals.
items.ex_zh: 尚未决定的代表们仍在两份相互竞争的宪政改革方案之间摇摆不定。

items.def_en: To change abruptly or dramatically from one state, opinion, or price level to another
items.ex_en: Public political opinion swung dramatically toward the opposition party following the scandal.
items.ex_zh: 丑闻爆发后，公众的政治倾向急剧倒向了在野党阵营。
items.ex2_en: The construction worker swung the heavy sledgehammer against the cracked concrete barrier.
items.ex2_zh: 建筑工人挥动沉重的大锤砸向开裂的混凝土护栏。

items.def_en: (+ between) To swing continuously between conflicting beliefs, feelings, or courses of action
items.ex_en: The young philosopher oscillated between hopeless cosmic cynicism and ardent romantic idealism.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻的哲学家在绝望的宇宙虚无感与热烈的情感理想主义之间摇摆不定。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail irregular or rhythmic changes back and forth between states, levels, decisions, or prices.
groups.summary_zh: 指数值、状态、倾向或情绪在两个极端间反复震荡。
groups.desc_en: Denotes dynamic rhythmic or periodic movement between varying positions or conditions, contrasting with static equilibrium or unidirectional motion.
groups.desc_zh: 指在不同位置、状态或强度之间进行周期性或动态的摇摆变动，区别于静态平衡或单向运动。
groups.nuance_en: swing: sweeping widely from one extreme to another (pendulum / opinion / voter) · waver: trembling or showing signs of losing steadiness or conviction (courage / allegiance / voice) · oscillate: moving rhythmically between limits (voltage / compass needle / policy) · fluctuate: continually shifting within a range (levels / demand / currencies) · ebb and flow: receding and surging in natural rhythmic alternation (tide / fortunes / support)
groups.nuance_zh: swing: 大幅度从一个极端转向另一个极端 (pendulum / opinion / voter) · waver: 因动摇或虚弱而失去平稳与坚定 (courage / allegiance / voice) · oscillate: 在界限之间作有规律的往复摆动 (voltage / compass needle / policy) · fluctuate: 在某一区间内持续浮动变化 (levels / demand / currencies) · ebb and flow: 如潮水般自然地涨落消长 (tide / fortunes / support)

groups.name: Fluff & Plump Up · 拍松与蓬松化 (Fluff, Plump up, Tease)
groups.tip: 拍打调节使之蓬松

items.def_zh: 拍松（枕头、靠垫等），使丰满
items.def_en: To shake, pat, and reshape a cushion, pillow, or mattress so that it becomes soft, rounded, and full
items.ex_en: The hotel chambermaid expertly plumped up the down pillows before turning down the bed.
items.ex_zh: 酒店客房保洁员在铺夜床前熟练地将鸭绒枕头拍得蓬松饱满。
items.ex2_en: The soft down cushions plumped up quickly under gentle morning patting.
items.ex2_zh: 轻拍之下，柔软的羽绒垫很快就鼓胀饱满了起来。

items.def_en: To hold a cloth, rug, or sheet and shake it vigorously to remove dust, creases, and restore fullness
items.ex_en: Let's wait and see how the market shakes out before investing.
items.ex_zh: 我们先静观市场洗牌后的局面，然后再做投资。
items.ex2_en: She went outside to vigorously shake out the dusty living room rug.
items.ex2_zh: 她走到室外，用力抖掉客厅地毯上的灰尘。

items.def_zh: 倒刮（头发使蓬松）；梳松（毛发）
items.def_en: To comb hair backwards towards the scalp or gently pull fibers apart to give them extra volume
items.ex_en: The eccentric stylist gently teased her blonde hair to create dramatic retro volume.
items.ex_zh: 这位特立独行的发型师轻轻倒刮她的金发，打造出夸张的复古蓬松感。

items.def_en: To form hair or fibers into crisp, tight curls or a fluffy, frizzy halo
items.ex_en: High atmospheric humidity immediately frizzed the model's straightened hair during the outdoor shoot.
items.ex_zh: 在户外拍摄期间，高湿度立刻使模特拉直的头发变得卷缩蓬乱。
items.ex2_en: Her naturally fine hair frizzed uncontrollably in the sudden humid summer rain.
items.ex2_zh: 在突如其来的夏季潮湿雨水中，她原本细软的头发变得毛躁蓬乱。

items.def_zh: 抖松，拍蓬松；念错，搞砸；变松散
items.def_en: 1. (+ up) To shake, pat, or adjust a pillow, cushion, or feathers so they become soft and full. 2. (informal) To fail to perform or speak words correctly, especially in an acting performance.
items.ex_en: Remember to fluff up the decorative sofa cushions before the dinner guests arrive.
items.ex_zh: 在晚餐客人到来之前，记得把沙发上的装饰靠垫拍拍松。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve gently shaking, patting, beating, or teasing soft, fibrous, or feathery materials (such as pillows, duvets, or hair) to restore volume, airiness, and comfortable fullness.
groups.summary_zh: 指轻拍、揉松或抖动羽绒、枕垫或毛发，使其恢复蓬松丰盈感。
groups.desc_en: Denotes restoring volume, lightness, and fullness to compressed soft fibers, contrasting with compressing, matting, or flattening.
groups.desc_zh: 指对被压实的柔软纤维进行打松、充气并恢复蓬松饱满，区别于压缩、毡结或压扁。
groups.nuance_en: fluff: shaking or patting light fibers into airy softness (cushion / pillow / feathers) · plump up: shaking or kneading bedding/pillows into rounded fullness (pillows / cushion / duvet) · tease: gently combing or tangling hair/fibers to add artificial volume (hair / fibers / wool) · friz: forming into tight, wiry, rough crinkles (curls / hair / edges) · shake out: unfolding or agitating vigorously to remove folds and loosen mass (rug / blanket / coat)
groups.nuance_zh: fluff: 轻轻拍打使纤维蓬松轻盈 (cushion / pillow / feathers) · plump up: 拍捏整理使垫枕恢复丰满饱满 (pillows / cushion / duvet) · tease: 倒刮逆梳毛发以造出蓬松体积 (hair / fibers / wool) · friz: 使毛发卷曲起毛或变得毛躁 (curls / hair / edges) · shake out: 抖散抖平以去除褶皱或使之松散 (rug / blanket / coat)

groups.name: Flutter & Flap · 扑翼与颤动 (Flap, Flit, Waver)
groups.tip: 轻快振翅或快速振动动作

items.def_zh: 扑翼，振翅；飘动，颤动；（心跳）悸动
items.def_en: 1. To move wings quickly and lightly, or to flap gently in the air. 2. (of a heart or stomach) To beat or move rapidly and irregularly due to anxiety or excitement.
items.ex_en: Hundreds of brightly colored paper flags flutter in the gentle afternoon breeze.
items.ex_zh: 数百面色彩鲜艳的小纸旗在午后温柔的微风中轻轻飘动。
items.ex2_en: The startled bird fluttered its broad wings against the narrow wooden cage.
items.ex2_zh: 受惊的小鸟在狭窄的木笼中扑棱着宽大的翅膀。

items.def_en: To shake or vibrate with a slight, rapid motion
items.ex_en: Delicate maple leaves quiver softly as the chilly morning wind sweeps through.
items.ex_zh: 当清晨清冽的风穿过林间，娇嫩的枫叶轻轻地颤动着。

items.def_en: To move swiftly and lightly from one place to another
items.ex_en: Hummingbirds flit endlessly among the sweet crimson blossoms in the warm conservatory.
items.ex_zh: 蜂鸟在温暖的温室里深红色的甘美花朵之间轻快地飞来飞去。

items.def_en: To move wings or another flat surface up and down or back and forth noisily or rhythmically
items.ex_en: The startled pigeons flapped noisily across the stone square toward the cathedral eaves.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的鸽子扑棱着翅膀，喧闹地掠过石板广场飞向大教堂的屋檐。
items.ex2_en: The fierce eagle flapped its massive wings to lift off the cliff.
items.ex2_zh: 凶猛的雄鹰拍打着巨大的翅膀，从悬崖上振翅起飞。

items.def_en: (of the heart) To beat rapidly, strongly, or irregularly, typically from excitement or exertion
items.ex_en: Her heart palpitated violently with profound anxiety upon receiving the unexpected emergency summons.
items.ex_zh: 接到突如其来的紧急传唤后，她深陷焦虑，心脏剧烈狂跳起来。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote quick, repeated, and often irregular back-and-forth or up-and-down motions, such as bird wings beating lightly, fabric trembling in the breeze, or nervous palpitations.
groups.summary_zh: 指翅膀轻快扇动、布料随风摆动或身体部位的微颤。
groups.desc_en: Denotes quick, light, repeated beating or vibrating motions of thin surfaces or organs, contrasting with deep sweeping beats, rigid stillness, or heavy pounding.
groups.desc_zh: 指薄膜、扁平表面或器官快速、轻盈、往复的拍动或震颤，区别于深沉振翅、僵直不动或重击。
groups.nuance_en: flutter: waving or flapping rapidly and lightly in erratic motion (eyelids / wings / flag) · flap: swinging or beating broad flexible surfaces up and down or back and forth (wings / sail / arms) · quiver: shaking rapidly with tiny, slight tremors (lips / leaf / voice) · palpitate: beating rapidly, strongly, or irregularly from excitement or exertion (heart / pulse) · flit: moving swiftly and lightly from spot to spot with quick wingbeats (bat / bird / shadow)
groups.nuance_zh: flutter: 扇动或飘动得轻盈、迅疾且不规则 (eyelids / wings / flag) · flap: 宽阔表面大幅度地拍打、掀动 (wings / sail / arms) · quiver: 细微、快速而颤栗地抖动 (lips / leaf / voice) · palpitate: 心脏因激动或耗竭而剧烈、不规则地悸动 (heart / pulse) · flit: 伴随轻捷拍翅敏捷飞掠 (bat / bird / shadow)

groups.name: Focus & Center · 调焦与重新聚焦 (Zero in, Center, Converge)
groups.tip: 收束散漫心神并重新聚焦核心

items.def_en: (+ on/around) To place or concentrate at a central point or main subject
items.ex_en: The historical symposium centered on socioeconomic inequalities prevalent in early industrial societies.
items.ex_zh: 本次历史研讨会围绕早期工业社会中普遍存在的社会经济不平等展开。
items.ex2_en: The keynote speaker centered his presentation on the emerging renewable energy market.
items.ex2_zh: 主讲人将演讲的核心聚焦在不断兴起的新能源市场上。

items.def_en: (+ on) To direct all attention, effort, or aim toward a singular focal point
items.ex_en: Investigative reporters zeroed in on subtle accounting discrepancies within the company's annual audit.
items.ex_zh: 调查记者们敏锐地将目标锁定在该公司年度审计中微妙的账目差错上。

items.def_en: (+ on) To direct all focus, search, or thought precisely onto a specific target
items.ex_en: Detectives gradually homed in on the principal suspect using geo-targeted cell phone data.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们利用地理定位手机数据，逐渐锁定了主要嫌疑人的踪迹。

items.def_en: (+ on) To come together from different directions to focus on a shared point
items.ex_en: Allied tactical divisions converged on the heavily fortified border crossing before dawn broke.
items.ex_zh: 盟军各战术师在破晓前从不同方向汇聚至重兵把守的边境关卡。

items.def_zh: 重新聚焦，调整关注点；重新对准焦距
items.def_en: To adjust attention, effort, or a lens again onto a central subject or priority.
items.ex_en: The chief executive urged management to refocus on core product reliability and performance.
items.ex_zh: 首席执行官敦促管理层重新聚焦于核心产品的可靠性与性能表现。
items.ex2_en: The determined director quickly refocused the team on delivering the final project.
items.ex2_zh: 坚定的主管迅速让团队重新聚焦于交付最终项目。

groups.summary_en: Pertains to mentally or optically redirecting attention, energy, or lenses onto a specific point of interest. It highlights narrowing the cognitive aperture from a dispersed state to a single crisp target.
groups.summary_zh: 指将涣散的注意力、视线或重心调整收敛至核心焦点。
groups.desc_en: Denotes narrowing cognitive attention or physical trajectory toward a single central coordinate, contrasting with diffuse scanning or dispersion.
groups.desc_zh: 指将认知注意力或物理轨迹收束锁定于单一核心坐标，区别于发散扫描或分散。
groups.nuance_en: center: placing at or directing interest around a central hub (discussion / policy / attention) · zero in: systematically adjusting focus to pin down an exact target (target / problem / candidate) · home in: locking onto and navigating directly toward a guiding beacon or source (signal / objective / missile) · converge: approaching from different directions toward a shared focal point (crowds / opinions / rays) · refocus: adjusting concentration or optical clarity back to an essential priority (efforts / mind / lens)
groups.nuance_zh: center: 使围绕某个核心或轴心展开 (discussion / policy / attention) · zero in: 逐步校准并将焦点锁定于明确目标 (target / problem / candidate) · home in: 循着信号导向紧追并逼近目标 (signal / objective / missile) · converge: 从不同方向汇聚至同一个焦点 (crowds / opinions / rays) · refocus: 将分散的注意力或视距重新调整聚焦 (efforts / mind / lens)

groups.name: Focus & Concentrate · 聚焦与专注 (Concentrate, Center, Zero in)
groups.tip: 将注意力和精力集中于一点

items.def_en: (+ on/around) To place something at the pivot of attention, discussion, or action
items.ex_en: Subsequent rounds of diplomatic negotiations centered around establishing a durable humanitarian corridor.
items.ex_zh: 随后的数轮外交谈判紧紧围绕建立一条持久的人道主义走廊展开。
items.ex2_en: The mediators centered their primary peace talks around an immediate ceasefire agreement.
items.ex2_zh: 调解员们将主要的和平谈判集中在即刻停火协议上。

items.def_zh: 集中（注意力、精力等）；（使）聚焦，（使）调焦
items.def_en: 1. To direct your attention, effort, or interest towards a particular person, subject, or thing. 2. To adjust a lens or eye to see a clear image, or of an image to become clear.
items.ex_en: The young medical researcher focused her efforts on identifying rare hereditary cardiovascular disorders.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻的医学研究员将精力集中在甄别罕见的遗传性心血管疾病上。
items.ex2_en: Her tired eyes focused slowly on the distant headlights through dense fog.
items.ex2_zh: 她疲惫的双眼穿过浓雾，慢慢聚焦在远处的车灯上。

items.def_en: (+ on) To direct all mental energy or attention toward a particular task or thought
items.ex_en: You must concentrate completely on your defensive technique to survive competitive tournaments.
items.ex_zh: 你必须把全部精力集中在防守技术上，才能在竞争激烈的锦标赛中立足。
items.ex2_en: The coach concentrated all his efforts on training the promising young athletes.
items.ex2_zh: 教练将所有的精力都集中在训练这些有前途的年轻运动员身上。

items.def_en: (+ on) To direct all attention, effort, or aim specifically at a precise detail or problem
items.ex_en: Federal antitrust regulators zeroed in on the software giant's aggressive predatory pricing schemes.
items.ex_zh: 联邦反垄断监管机构精准锁定了该软件巨头激进的掠夺性定价方案。

items.def_en: (+ on) To guide attention or movement steadily toward a single target or objective
items.ex_en: Researchers carefully homed in on the exact genetic mutation causing the neuromuscular illness.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员抽丝剥茧，精准锁定了导致该神经肌肉疾病的确切基因突变。

groups.summary_en: This cognitive frame highlights directing mental acuity, visual attention, or organizational energy onto a single target while filtering out peripheral distractions.
groups.summary_zh: 指将注意力、思维或行动力量集中在特定核心目标或议题上。
groups.desc_en: Denotes mobilizing mental faculties or energy toward an exclusive object, contrasting with distraction, mind-wandering, or broad dilution.
groups.desc_zh: 指将心智机能或能量高度集中于排他性对象，区别于分心走神或泛化分散。
groups.nuance_en: concentrate: bringing intense, unified mental effort or mass to bear upon one point (mind / efforts / power) · focus: adjusting perception or attention to yield sharp clarity on an object (eyes / thoughts / energy) · center: anchoring fundamental interest or theme upon a base (analysis / life / debate) · zero in: targeting an issue or culprit with pinpoint scrutiny (investigation / weakness / error) · home in: aggressively closing in on a critical vulnerability or revelation (evidence / clue / truth)
groups.nuance_zh: concentrate: 凝聚全神贯注的意志或力量于一点 (mind / efforts / power) · focus: 调节目光或思维以清晰看清主体 (eyes / thoughts / energy) · center: 将主要立足点或旨趣置于核心 (analysis / life / debate) · zero in: 精准定位缺陷、漏洞或审视对象 (investigation / weakness / error) · home in: 顺藤摸瓜紧逼关键线索或症结 (evidence / clue / truth)

groups.name: Follow & Ensue · 紧接与随之发生 (Follow, Result, Supervene)
groups.tip: 因某一事件而紧接着发生

items.def_en: (+ from/in) To happen or exist because of something that occurred previously
items.ex_en: Significant environmental damage resulted from the catastrophic oil spill along the coastline.
items.ex_zh: 沿海地区发生的灾难性石油泄漏事件造成了严重的生态环境破坏。

items.def_en: To happen or occur next in time, order, or as a consequence
items.ex_en: A brief period of relative economic stability followed the decisive structural currency reform.
items.ex_zh: 在推行果断的结构性货币改革后，紧接着出现了一段相对的经济稳定期。

items.def_zh: 意外发生；伴随发生而打断
items.def_en: To happen unexpectedly in a way that interrupts, alters, or complicates an existing situation
items.ex_en: Severe respiratory complications supervened while the elderly patient was recovering from major surgery.
items.ex_zh: 这位年长患者在大手术恢复期间，意外并发了严重的呼吸系统并发症。

items.def_zh: 源自；作为…的自然结果产生
items.def_en: To arrive or develop as a natural, logical consequence of an event or policy
items.ex_en: Substantial efficiency gains flow naturally from adopting modernized inventory automation throughout warehouses.
items.ex_zh: 在全仓库采用现代化的库存自动化系统，自然会带来显著的效率提升。

items.raw_cluster: 发生与随之而来 Follow & Ensue
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To happen immediately afterward or as a direct result of another event.
items.ex_en: Total panic ensued inside the crowded hall when the electrical power suddenly failed.
items.ex_zh: 当电力供应突然中断时，拥挤的大厅内随即爆发了极度恐慌。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe events, consequences, or conditions that take place immediately after or as an inevitable outcome of a preceding incident. They range from neutral temporal succession to causal developments and unforeseen complications.
groups.summary_zh: 表示在某事之后紧接着发生、因果随之而来或作为意外情况插足发生。
groups.desc_en: Denotes coming immediately after in chronological sequence or causal necessity, contrasting with preceding, coinciding, or unconnected occurrence.
groups.desc_zh: 指在时间序列或因果关系上紧随而至或必然派生，区别于在先、巧合并存或无因果关联。
groups.nuance_en: ensue: happening naturally as a subsequent consequence or outcome (riot / confusion / silence) · follow: coming behind in natural order, logic, or time (meeting / advice / trail) · result: emerging as a direct final consequence of an antecedent (injury / failure / loss) · flow from: deriving smoothly and logically from a premise or source (conclusions / rights / power) · supervene: occurring unexpectedly to interrupt or complicate an already existing state (complications / illness / crisis)
groups.nuance_zh: ensue: 作为随后的必然结果或局面接踵而至 (riot / confusion / silence) · follow: 在时序、逻辑或顺序上尾随其后 (meeting / advice / trail) · result: 作为前因产生的直接最终结论或恶果 (injury / failure / loss) · flow from: 从源头、前提出发顺理成章地派生出来 (conclusions / rights / power) · supervene: 在既有事态上意外横生变故或并发 (complications / illness / crisis)

groups.name: Fondle & Pet · 抚弄与亲昵抚摩 (Fondle, Pet, Dally)
groups.tip: 亲昵轻柔地抚摸身体或器官

items.def_en: Touch or stroke an animal or person gently and lovingly; or engage in affectionate kissing and touching
items.ex_en: She knelt on the rug to pet the stray cat behind its ears.
items.ex_zh: 她跪在地毯上，温柔地抚摸那只流浪猫的耳后。

items.def_en: Touch or stroke someone or something gently and lovingly with the hands
items.ex_en: The gentle evening breeze seemed to caress her tear-stained cheeks with tender sorrow.
items.ex_zh: 温和的晚风似乎带着温柔的哀意，轻抚着她带泪的面颊。

items.def_en: 1. To touch, stroke, or handle someone or something gently and affectionately, often in a sexual way.
items.ex_en: He continued to fondle her bare shoulders as they whispered in the dark.
items.ex_zh: 他们在黑暗中窃窃私语时，他继续温柔爱抚着她赤裸的肩膀。

items.def_en: (informal) Kiss, caress, and cuddle someone affectionately and playfully
items.ex_en: The young couple sat in the back row to canoodle during the film.
items.ex_zh: 这对年轻情侣坐在后排，在看电影时亲昵地搂抱亲吻。

items.def_en: Touch someone for sexual pleasure, especially crudely, clumsily, or without their consent
items.ex_en: A drunken man attempted to grope the young woman in the crowded subway.
items.ex_zh: 一名醉汉试图在拥挤的地铁里非礼抚弄那名年轻女子。

groups.summary_en: Denotes gentle, sensual, or sexually affectionate touching and stroking of another person or an animal. Nuances range from warm tender handling to erotic intimate contact.
groups.summary_zh: 指带有爱抚、亲昵或性意味地轻触、摩挲人或动物。
groups.desc_en: Denotes touching or stroking another person or animal lovingly, playfully, or sensually, contrasting with accidental brushing, hostile striking, or clinical contact.
groups.desc_zh: 指带有爱抚、嬉戏或肉欲色彩地抚摩人或动物，区别于无意擦碰、暴力击打或医疗接触。
groups.nuance_en: pet: stroking or patting an animal or person gently and affectionately (dog / hair / cat) · caress: touching or stroking with delicate tenderness and love (cheek / skin / face) · fondle: stroking or handling in a fond, erotic, or lingering manner (lover / necklace / body) · grope: touching clumsily or pawing someone sexually without consent (stranger / victim) · canoodle: kissing and cuddling intimately and playfully (couple / teenagers)
groups.nuance_zh: pet: 温柔爱抚宠物或亲近之人 (dog / hair / cat) · caress: 充满温情、轻柔细致地抚摩 (cheek / skin / face) · fondle: 留恋或带有情色挑逗意味地抚弄 (lover / necklace / body) · grope: 笨拙摸索或非礼猥亵乱摸 (stranger / victim) · canoodle: 亲昵地拥吻、温存缠绵 (couple / teenagers)

groups.name: Foot-Operate & Pedal · 踏板操控与脚力操作 (Pedal, Pump, Stomp)
groups.tip: 踩踏或手工操控机械运转

items.def_en: Depress a pedal or switch by pressing down firmly with the foot
items.ex_en: You must step on the brake pedal firmly before shifting into reverse gear.
items.ex_zh: 在挂入倒挡之前，你必须用力踩下刹车踏板。

items.def_en: Push down a foot pedal, lever, or button to activate a mechanism
items.ex_en: The machinist will depress the foot switch to activate the heavy cutting blades.
items.ex_zh: 机械师将踩下脚踏开关，以启动沉重的切割刀片。

items.def_en: Operate or propel a mechanism by pushing pedals with the feet
items.ex_en: The delivery courier had to pedal uphill against the strong and chilly wind.
items.ex_zh: 外卖员不得不迎着刺骨的强风用力踩脚踏车上坡。

items.def_en: 1. To operate a sewing machine, loom, or wheel by pressing a foot pedal up and down.
items.ex_en: She learned to treadle the antique loom with steady and rhythmic foot movements.
items.ex_zh: 她学会了用稳定且富有节奏的双脚动作踩动那台古老织机的踏板。

items.def_en: Operate a foot pedal or lever rhythmically by repeated up-and-down pressure
items.ex_en: If the brakes suddenly fail, quickly pump the pedal to rebuild hydraulic pressure.
items.ex_zh: 如果刹车突然失灵，迅速上下踩动踏板以重新建立液压。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers physical manipulation driven by the feet, specifically pushing, pumping, or oscillating foot levers, pedals, and treadles to power or regulate mechanical machinery.
groups.summary_zh: 指运用双脚踩踏踏板或脚控装置来驱动、控制机械设备的动作。
groups.desc_en: Denotes applying downward or circular mechanical leg/foot force to drive a mechanism, contrasting with hand manipulation or automated propulsion.
groups.desc_zh: 指利用下肢或足底施加下压或圆周机械力以驱动装置，区别于手动操作或电动自驱。
groups.nuance_en: pedal: driving rotary foot cranks to power a vehicle or machine (bicycle / boat / loom) · depress: pressing down firmly on a pedal, plunger, or lever with foot or finger (brake / clutch / accelerator) · pump: applying rhythmic, repeated foot or hand strokes to build pressure (brakes / pedals / bellows) · step on: putting foot weight down to activate a mechanism immediately (gas / pedal / insect) · treadle: operating an oscillating foot lever to drive machinery (loom / sewing machine / lathe)
groups.nuance_zh: pedal: 脚蹬回转曲柄以驱动行进 (bicycle / boat / loom) · depress: 踩下或按压制动踏板、离合器 (brake / clutch / accelerator) · pump: 节奏性地反复连续踩踩刹车或压泵以加压 (brakes / pedals / bellows) · step on: 踏在踏板上以猛烈或立即触发 (gas / pedal / insect) · treadle: 用双足交替踩动摇板以带动机器运转 (loom / sewing machine / lathe)

groups.name: Forceful Tearing & Snapping · 强行撕扯与崩断 (Rip, Snap, Tear off)
groups.tip: 猛力扯烂织物或硬脆折断

items.def_en: Pull something apart or into pieces with rapid, deliberate force
items.ex_en: Don't tear the gift wrap so quickly, or you might damage the box.
items.ex_zh: 别把包装纸撕得这么猛，否则你可能会弄坏盒子。

items.def_en: Remove something forcefully and roughly from a surface or attachment
items.ex_en: Unsuspecting tourists are often ripped off by unlicensed taxi operators.
items.ex_zh: 毫无防备的游客经常被无照出租车司机敲竹杠。

items.def_en: To tear or be torn violently, quickly, or forcefully.
items.ex_en: The sharp nail caught his sleeve and caused the tough fabric to rip.
items.ex_zh: 锋利的钉子勾住了他的衣袖，把结实的布料撕裂了。
items.ex2_en: The careless child ripped the colorful paper wrapping off the birthday gift.
items.ex2_zh: 粗心的小孩撕开了生日礼物上色彩斑斓的包装纸。

items.def_en: Break suddenly and cleanly with a sharp, cracking sound under tension or pressure
items.ex_en: The dry wooden branch suddenly began to snap under the weight of wet snow.
items.ex_zh: 干枯的树枝在湿雪的重压下突然喀嚓一声折断了。

items.def_en: Burst or break suddenly under internal or external physical pressure
items.ex_en: Extreme internal pressure caused the aging steel pipeline to rupture without warning.
items.ex_zh: 极端的内部压力导致老化的钢制管道毫无预警地崩裂。
items.ex2_en: Excessive water pressure will rupture the fragile household plumbing pipes within minutes.
items.ex2_zh: 过高的水压会在数分钟内导致脆弱的家用管道破裂。

groups.summary_en: Expresses sudden, high-force physical breakage where tensile integrity fails, causing materials like fabric, flesh, or bone to rupture or snap apart abruptly.
groups.summary_zh: 强调外力瞬间拉扯导致的撕裂、崩开或突发性折断脱离。
groups.desc_en: Denotes sudden, violent tensile failure of material through pulling or stress, contrasting with clean cutting, peeling, or gradual wear.
groups.desc_zh: 指在拉力或应力下材料发生突发、暴力的撕裂或断裂破坏，区别于整齐裁切、剥离或磨损。
groups.nuance_en: tear: pulling apart fibrous or flexible material by tensile force (paper / fabric / ligament) · rip: violently tearing cloth, seam, or wood with tearing sound and force (seam / jacket / page) · rip off: tearing away forcefully and completely from an attachment (mask / roof / bandage) · snap: breaking sharply under bending tension with an abrupt crack (bone / twig / cable) · rupture: bursting or tearing open under severe internal pressure or trauma (spleen / pipeline / tendon)
groups.nuance_zh: tear: 经受拉力导致柔性或纤维材料撕破 (paper / fabric / ligament) · rip: 伴随刺耳声响被猛力撕裂扯开 (seam / jacket / page) · rip off: 暴力扯下、强行剥除附着物 (mask / roof / bandage) · snap: 在应力弯折下应声崩断或折断 (bone / twig / cable) · rupture: 承受极端内压或钝伤而爆裂、撕裂 (spleen / pipeline / tendon)

groups.name: Forcible Separation & Forcing Open · 强行撬开与扒开 (Pry, Prise, Force open)
groups.tip: 利用杠杆原理撬起硬物

items.def_en: Break open or gain entry to a lock, lid, or barrier through physical violence
items.ex_en: Burglars managed to force the rear basement window while the owners were asleep.
items.ex_zh: 趁着房主熟睡，盗贼强行破开了地下室后侧的窗户。

items.def_en: Force and fix an aperture open by jamming an object into its seam
items.ex_en: Firefighters used a thick wooden block to wedge open the heavy fire door.
items.ex_zh: 消防员用一根厚木块卡住沉重的防火门使其保持开启。

items.def_en: Force apart or expel by steady physical pressure and encroachment
items.ex_en: The aggressive weeds will crowd out the native wild flowers along the riverbank.
items.ex_zh: 侵略性杂草会通过挤占生长空间将河岸边的本土野花排挤出去。

items.def_en: 1. To use force or a tool to lift, open, or separate something. 2. To inquire intrusively or meddle into someone's private affairs.
items.ex_en: He used a sturdy screwdriver to pry the rusted metal lid off easily.
items.ex_zh: 他用一把结实的螺丝刀轻而易举地撬开了生锈的金属盖。

items.def_en: Force something open or away from a surface with an edged implement
items.ex_en: She managed to prise the stubborn oyster shell open using a dull knife.
items.ex_zh: 她用一把钝刀好不容易把那只顽固的生蚝壳撬开了。

groups.summary_en: Centered on separating stuck surfaces or opening tight containers/fixtures by wedging an implement into a crevice and applying levering force.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过插入楔子或工具利用杜杆力强行剥离、撬开卡紧或钉死的缝隙。
groups.desc_en: Denotes using leverage or mechanical force to compel stubborn, joined, or resistant boundaries open, contrasting with smooth unlocking or permissive entry.
groups.desc_zh: 指借助杠杆或机械暴力强行撬动、分开紧闭或抗拒的缝隙，区别于顺畅开锁或自愿开放。
groups.nuance_en: pry: using leverage to move, raise, or open something firmly fastened (lid / fingers / door) · prise: levering firmly to force open or separate firmly wedged surfaces (cask / gate / shell) · force: overcoming resistance by pure brute strength to breach an enclosure (door / lock / safe) · wedge open: inserting an object to prevent closure or force a gap wider (door / window / crack) · crowd out: using space-filling pressure to push aside and exclude (competitors / rivals / plants)
groups.nuance_zh: pry: 运用杠杆原理撬起或撬开紧固之物 (lid / fingers / door) · prise: 撬动或强力拨开卡紧的接缝 (cask / gate / shell) · force: 用蛮力破开抵抗与封锁 (door / lock / safe) · wedge open: 插入楔形物硬生生撑开或固开缝隙 (door / window / crack) · crowd out: 借由密集空间排挤挤占出去 (competitors / rivals / plants)

groups.name: Forge & Counterfeit · 伪造与仿造 (Counterfeit, Forge, Fake)
groups.tip: 弄虚作假，制造冒牌伪劣物

items.def_en: To make something falsely appear genuine or authentic
items.ex_en: The fraudster attempted to fake several historical documents to deceive the wealthy collectors.
items.ex_zh: 这名骗子企图伪造几份历史文献来蒙骗富有的收藏家。

items.def_en: To make illegal, unauthorized copies of software, books, or media to sell
items.ex_en: Unscrupulous vendors continue to pirate popular video games and sell them online cheaply.
items.ex_zh: 不法商家继续非法盗版畅销电子游戏并在网上低价售卖。

items.def_en: To illegally copy a document, signature, or work of art to deceive people
items.ex_en: He was arrested after attempting to forge his employer's signature on company checks.
items.ex_zh: 他企图在公司支票上伪造雇主的签名，随后被捕。

items.def_zh: 伪造，仿造；假装，假装具有
items.def_en: 1. To make an exact illegal copy of money, documents, or goods in order to deceive. 2. (formal) To feign or pretend to have a feeling or quality.
items.ex_en: The criminal syndicate used advanced printers to counterfeit foreign currency on high-grade paper.
items.ex_zh: 该犯罪团伙利用高档纸张和先进印刷机伪造外国货币。

items.def_en: To change records or documents dishonestly in order to mislead people
items.ex_en: The dishonest accountant conspired with management to falsify the firm's quarterly revenue figures.
items.ex_zh: 这名不诚实的会计与管理层合谋篡改了公司的季度收入数据。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers intentionally manufacturing deceptive duplicates of banknotes, legal signatures, art, or commercial goods with the fraudulent intent to deceive.
groups.summary_zh: 指出于欺诈目的故意伪造钱币、证件、签名或工艺品。
groups.desc_en: Denotes illicitly fabricating, imitating, or altering documents, goods, or truths to deceive, contrasting with authentic creation, lawful copying, or honest depiction.
groups.desc_zh: 指非法制造、仿冒或篡改真迹、实物或真相以行欺诈，区别于真实创造、合法翻印或诚实描述。
groups.nuance_en: forge: deceptively producing a fraudulent signature, art, or monetary instrument (signature / passport / check) · counterfeit: unlawfully replicating currency or branded products with intent to pass off as original (money / coins / luxury goods) · falsify: altering genuine records or facts dishonestly to disguise truth (accounts / data / documents) · fake: staging, fabricating, or simulating an appearance dishonestly (illness / documents / painting) · pirate: illegally reproducing and distributing copyrighted intellectual property (software / film / music)
groups.nuance_zh: forge: 伪造笔迹、签名或具有法律效力的文书 (signature / passport / check) · counterfeit: 违法仿造假币或大牌商品冒充原装 (money / coins / luxury goods) · falsify: 为掩盖真相而篡改数据、记录或账目 (accounts / data / documents) · fake: 假冒、做假或佯装外表以蒙混过关 (illness / documents / painting) · pirate: 非法盗版翻录并分发受版权保护之作品 (software / film / music)

groups.name: Fork & Bifurcate · 叉开与分歧 (Bifurcate, Trifurcate, Diverge)
groups.tip: 主干分支向不同方向分叉

items.def_en: To divide or separate into two or more parts along a line
items.ex_en: Hit the solid wooden block hard enough and it will split along the grain.
items.ex_zh: 只要用力击打这块实木，它就会顺着纹理裂成两半。
items.ex2_en: The strong lumberjack split the heavy oak log with a single blow.
items.ex2_zh: 强壮的伐木工人一击就劈开了沉重的橡木原木。

items.def_en: To move or extend in different directions from a common point
items.ex_en: The two mountain paths diverge sharply near the base of the rocky peak.
items.ex_zh: 这两条山间小径在岩石山峰的底部附近陡然向两边岔开。

items.def_en: (formal or technical) To divide or fork into two or more branches, prongs, or parts.
items.ex_en: Ancient oak boughs furcate into twisted branches that shade the entire silent glade.
items.ex_zh: 古老橡树的粗干分叉成扭曲的枝丫，遮蔽了整片寂静的林中空地。

items.def_en: To divide or cause to divide into two distinct branches or prongs
items.ex_en: Downstream from the dam, the wide river begins to bifurcate into two streams.
items.ex_zh: 在大坝下游，宽阔的河流开始一分为二，分成两条溪流。
items.ex2_en: A sharp ridge bifurcates the mountain hiking trail into two distinct paths.
items.ex2_zh: 一道陡峭的山脊将登山步道分成了两条截然不同的小径。

items.def_en: To split or sever something along a natural line of growth or grain
items.ex_en: The woodsman's sharp axe would cleave the frozen pine log in one stroke.
items.ex_zh: 樵夫锋利的斧头一击便将那根冻结的松木劈裂开来。
items.ex2_en: The dry cedar timber cleaved cleanly along the natural wood grain lines.
items.ex2_zh: 干燥的雪松木料顺着天然的木纹整齐地裂开了。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate technical, precise, or formal dividing into specific prongs or dual branches (often anatomical, geological, or mathematical). They focus strictly on the geometric split of a single conduit or structure.
groups.summary_zh: 多用于书面或科技语境，精确表示一分为二（或多叉）的几何状分叉。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the structural division of a single continuum, path, or line into branching paths or divergent directions, differing from plain 'separate' by emphasizing physical or figurative angular bifurcation.
groups.desc_zh: 指单一实体、路径或谱系结构性地分岔或呈角向分歧，区别于一般的“分离/分开”，强调由一入多、形成支路的分裂形态。
groups.nuance_en: bifurcate: precise technical splitting into exactly two branches (stream / path / pipeline) · diverge: progressive moving apart from a common point (opinions / paths / trajectories) · furcate: botanical or anatomical branching (vessels / roots / shoots) · split: forceful or general parting into distinct parts (vote / wood / party) · cleave: deep binary division along a natural plane or schism (rock / society / air)
groups.nuance_zh: bifurcate: 精确一分为二的分叉 (stream / path / pipeline) · diverge: 从交汇点逐渐偏离分道 (opinions / paths / trajectories) · furcate: 植物学或解剖学意义上的叉状分歧 (vessels / roots / shoots) · split: 强力或一般性的分化分裂 (vote / wood / party) · cleave: 沿特定纹理或断层的深层劈开 (rock / society / air)

groups.name: Formal Inquiry & Crime Investigation · 官方立案调查与侦查 (Investigate, Inquire, Look into)
groups.tip: 讯问探查事件原委

items.def_en: To carry out a systematic or formal inquiry to discover the truth about a crime, accident, problem, etc.
items.ex_en: Special detectives were assigned to investigate the suspicious warehouse fire from last night.
items.ex_zh: 特派刑警被指派去调查昨晚那起可疑的仓库火灾。

items.def_en: To examine the facts and circumstances of a problem, complaint, or situation in order to determine what happened.
items.ex_en: The customer service supervisor promised to look into the billing discrepancy immediately.
items.ex_zh: 客户服务主管承诺会立即深入调查账单不符的问题。

items.def_en: To carry out a deep, thorough, and often critical investigation into a suspected wrongdoing or controversy.
items.ex_en: Independent regulators decided to probe into allegations of widespread insider trading within banks.
items.ex_zh: 独立监管机构决定深入探查针对银行内部广泛存在的内幕交易指控。

items.def_en: To visit an establishment or examine items officially to check that standards and regulations are met.
items.ex_en: Health officials arrived unannounced to inspect the commercial food processing plant for safety.
items.ex_zh: 卫生官员突击走访，以审查这家商业食品加工厂的安全合规情况。

items.def_en: (+ into) To make a formal or detailed inquiry to establish the truth of a situation or event.
items.ex_en: The parliamentary committee will formally inquire into the root causes of the disaster.
items.ex_zh: 议会委员会将正式立案调查造成这起灾难的根本原因。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses formal, official, or legal procedures undertaken to uncover the facts behind an incident, crime, malpractice, or disaster. The purpose is accountability, fact-finding, and legal determination.
groups.summary_zh: 指官方、执法机关或委员会针对事故、案件或不端行为的立案侦办与调查。
groups.desc_en: Denotes systematic, institutional, or judicial searching into facts, misconduct, or crime, differing from casual 'ask' or 'check' by its procedural rigor, official mandate, and forensic depth.
groups.desc_zh: 指基于程序授权对事实、罪行或隐情进行的系统化官方探查与侦办，区别于普通“询问/查看”，强调程序正当性、官方权威与法证深度。
groups.nuance_en: investigate: full-scale formal inquiry into facts or crimes (allegations / murder / fraud) · probe into: deep, penetrating, and often adversarial scrutiny (finances / background / affairs) · inspect: on-site physical or regulatory compliance checking (premises / records / facilities) · inquire: official asking for information or formal examination (inquest / health / status) · look into: preliminary or informal administrative assessment (matter / complaint / feasibility)
groups.nuance_zh: investigate: 全面正式立案侦查或核查 (allegations / murder / fraud) · probe into: 追根究底的深入穿透式调查 (finances / background / affairs) · inspect: 现场或合规性巡查检查 (premises / records / facilities) · inquire: 官方求证询问或形式化听证 (inquest / health / status) · look into: 初步了解或行政性跟进 (matter / complaint / feasibility)

groups.name: Formal Postponement & Deferral · 延期审议与推迟 (Table, Defer, Adjourn)
groups.tip: 延后审议暂缓处理

items.def_zh: 搁置，推迟审议（美式）；正式提出供讨论（英式）
items.def_en: 1. (North American) To postpone consideration of a bill, motion, or proposal. 2. (British) To present a proposal or bill for formal discussion.
items.ex_en: The congressional committee voted to table the proposed amendment until the next legislative session.
items.ex_zh: 国会委员会投票决定将这项拟议的修正案搁置到下个立法会期审议。

items.def_en: To arrange for an event or action to take place at a date or time later than scheduled
items.ex_en: Heavy snowfall forced airport authorities to postpone all departing international flights until noon.
items.ex_zh: 暴雪迫使机场当局将所有离港国际航班推迟至中午。

items.def_en: To officially put off an action, decision, or payment to a later appointed time
items.ex_en: The court decided to defer sentencing until the psychiatric evaluation was fully completed.
items.ex_zh: 法院决定延期宣判，直至精神状况评估完全出炉。

items.def_en: To break off a meeting or legal trial with the explicit intention of resuming it later
items.ex_en: The presiding judge decided to adjourn the trial proceedings until next Monday morning.
items.ex_zh: 主审法官决定休庭，审理程序延期至下周一上午继续进行。
items.ex2_en: The parliamentary committee adjourned abruptly after several members staged a sudden walkout.
items.ex2_zh: 在几名议员突然离场后，议会委员会骤然休会。

items.def_en: To discontinue a parliamentary session without formally dissolving the assembly
items.ex_en: The head of state intervened to prorogue the unruly parliament before the elections.
items.ex_zh: 国家元首在大选前介入，宣布使躁动不安的议会正式休会。
items.ex2_en: The contentious legislative session prorogued quietly without passing the controversial tax bill.
items.ex2_zh: 争议不断的立法会议悄然闭会，未能通过那项备受争议的税收法案。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote official procedural decisions to push back meetings, debates, or legal determinations to a scheduled later date.
groups.summary_zh: 按法定或正式程序推迟会议、审议或行动。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the procedural suspension, delay, or dismissal of official proceedings or agenda items, differing from general 'delay' through strict grounding in parliamentary or corporate protocol.
groups.desc_zh: 指依据议事规则或法定程序对会议、法案或议程进行暂停或延期，区别于一般的“拖延”，带有明确的制度约束与议事规范。
groups.nuance_en: table: shelf indefinitely or set aside for later consideration (motion / amendment / bill) · defer: intentionally transfer decision or payment to a future date (judgment / decision / taxes) · adjourn: formally suspend a sitting until a specified future time (court / session / meeting) · prorogue: discontinuing a legislative session without dissolving parliament (parliament / assembly) · postpone: straightforward rescheduling to a later time (hearing / vote / game)
groups.nuance_zh: table: 搁置议案以待日后处理 (motion / amendment / bill) · defer: 审慎推迟决议或给付义务 (judgment / decision / taxes) · adjourn: 宣布休庭或休会至特定时日 (court / session / meeting) · prorogue: 宣告议会休会但不断绝议会期 (parliament / assembly) · postpone: 常规改期推后 (hearing / vote / game)

groups.name: Format & Layout · 排版编排与格式化 (Typeset, Structure, Arrange)
groups.tip: 对物理或文本版面规范排布

items.def_en: To organize elements of a text, program, or dataset according to a coherent framework
items.ex_en: The researcher took great care to structure the complex findings within logical sections.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员极为细致地在逻辑分明的各章节中构建了复杂的研究结果。

items.def_zh: 编排格式；格式化（磁盘等）
items.def_en: 1. To arrange the shape, size, or general layout of text or data. 2. (computing) To prepare a storage medium for reading and writing.
items.ex_en: The diligent scribe sought to format each sacred verse with exquisite gold margins.
items.ex_zh: 勤勉的抄写员力求以精美的金色边框来编排每一节神圣的诗篇。

items.def_en: To assign page numbers or organize content into discrete sequential pages
items.ex_en: The automated software makes it simple to paginate the extensive academic manuscript correctly.
items.ex_zh: 这款自动化软件使整部厚重的学术书稿能够轻松正确地分页排版。

items.def_en: To design or arrange how text, images, and white space appear across a surface
items.ex_en: The graphic designer took hours to layout the feature article and its photographs.
items.ex_zh: 平面设计师花了数小时来为这篇特写报道及其配图规划版面布局。

items.def_en: To arrange text and graphics into a visual layout for printing or digital display
items.ex_en: It took several weeks to typeset the comprehensive classical dictionary for commercial publication.
items.ex_zh: 为了商业出版，排版人员花费了数周时间对这部大型古典词典进行排字。

groups.summary_en: This domain involves configuring the structural visual layout or computational schema of data, documents, or storage media. While 'typeset' focuses on typographic arrangement for print, 'paginate' controls page divisions, and 'structure' shapes hierarchical organization.
groups.summary_zh: 指对文本、媒体或数据进行版式编排、格式设定与结构规划。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the deliberate typographic, spatial, or structural organisation of text, data, or media, contrasting with mere 'order' by focusing on aesthetic, technological, or publishing specifications.
groups.desc_zh: 指针对文本、数据或版面进行的排版、架构与几何编排，区别于普通的“整理/安排”，强调符合出版工法、美学构图或软硬件规格。
groups.nuance_en: typeset: mechanical or digital composition of text into printable type (manuscript / galley / book) · format: applying consistent digital styling or structural storage rules (disk / document / code) · layout: arranging visual components within spatial bounds (page / magazine / dashboard) · paginate: numbering and ordering physical or digital pages (text / document / volume) · structure: organizing underlying systemic hierarchy and relations (argument / essay / database)
groups.nuance_zh: typeset: 排字植字与印刷组版 (manuscript / galley / book) · format: 统一样式设定或磁盘格式化 (disk / document / code) · layout: 图文版面空间布局设计 (page / magazine / dashboard) · paginate: 编排页码与分页 (text / document / volume) · structure: 构筑底层逻辑层级与脉络 (argument / essay / database)

groups.name: Fractionate & Clarify · 离心与分馏 (Centrifuge, Fractionate, Distill)
groups.tip: 用离心等物理手段提纯分离

items.def_en: To divide or separate a chemical mixture into its individual fractions or component parts
items.ex_en: The alchemist labored long to fractionate the pungent liquor into pure fragrant essences.
items.ex_zh: 炼金术士辛勤劳作，以将那刺鼻的液体分馏为纯净芬芳的精华。

items.def_en: To cause a substance to be deposited or separated out in solid form from a solution
items.ex_en: Adding dilute sulfuric acid will precipitate heavy barium ions out of the solution.
items.ex_zh: 加入稀硫酸会使溶液中的重钡离子沉淀析出。

items.def_zh: 用离心机分离，对……进行离心分离
items.def_en: 1. (science) To spin a liquid mixture at very high speed in a machine to separate heavier particles from lighter liquids.
items.ex_en: The physician would centrifuge the vial of blood, separating crimson cells from amber serum.
items.ex_zh: 医生将那一小瓶血液置于离心机分离，使深红血细胞与琥珀色血清彻底分开。

items.def_en: To purify a liquid by heating it into vapor and then condensing the vapor back into liquid
items.ex_en: The chemist utilized specialized laboratory glassware to distill the volatile organic solvent safely.
items.ex_zh: 化学家利用专门的实验室玻璃器皿安全地蒸馏出挥发性有机溶剂。

items.def_en: To gradually pour liquid from one container into another, especially without disturbing the sediment
items.ex_en: The sommelier took care to decant the aged wine without disturbing the fine sediment.
items.ex_zh: 侍酒师小心翼翼地把陈年老酒滗入醒酒器，完全没有惊动细微的沉淀物。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this technical and chemical processing frame refer to separating mixed substances into distinct physical or chemical components based on density, boiling point, or particle size.
groups.summary_zh: 利用物理或化学原理（如离心、蒸馏）将混合物各组分纯化分离开来。
