groups.desc_en: Denotes the scientific or industrial separation of complex chemical/physical mixtures into constituent fractions or purer states, contrasting with basic 'filter' through its reliance on thermodynamic, centrifugal, or phase equilibria.
groups.desc_zh: 指利用热力学相平衡、重力或离心力将混合物拆解为各馏分或高纯度相态的理化操作，区别于一般的“过滤”，强调多组分深度分离。
groups.nuance_en: fractionate: sequentially separating mixtures into defined distillates or cuts (petroleum / plasma / isotopes) · distill: vaporizing and condensing to extract volatile essences or purify liquids (spirits / water / crude) · centrifuge: utilizing rapid rotational acceleration to isolate dense particulates (blood / suspension / samples) · precipitate: inducing dissolved matter to solidify out of liquid phase (proteins / salts / crystals) · decant: gently pouring off liquid to leave sediment behind (wine / solution / supernatant)
groups.nuance_zh: fractionate: 按沸点或物理特性分馏/分级分离 (petroleum / plasma / isotopes) · distill: 蒸馏提纯或萃取易挥发精华 (spirits / water / crude) · centrifuge: 高速离心沉淀分离 (blood / suspension / samples) · precipitate: 化学沉淀析出结晶物 (proteins / salts / crystals) · decant: 倾析倒出上清液以留存残渣 (wine / solution / supernatant)

groups.name: Fray & Unravel · 磨损与起毛 (Fray, Tatter, Unravel)
groups.tip: 经年累月摩擦，边缘起毛破损

items.def_zh: （使）（织物、绳索等边缘）起毛，磨破；（神经、脾气等）变得紧张，急躁
items.def_en: 1. To become or cause to become unraveled or worn at the edge. 2. (of nerves, tempers, etc.) To become strained or irritated.
items.ex_en: Constant rubbing against the rough desk caused the wool cuffs to fray quickly.
items.ex_zh: 在粗糙的书桌上反复摩擦导致羊毛袖口很快磨破起毛。
items.ex2_en: Rough concrete floors will quickly fray the edges of the woven carpet.
items.ex2_zh: 粗糙的水泥地面会迅速磨损编织地毯的边缘。

items.def_en: To become gradually thin, eroded, or damaged through friction or time
items.ex_en: Over countless centuries, relentless crashing waves will wear away even the hardest coastal rocks.
items.ex_zh: 经过无数个世纪，无情拍击的海浪终将把最坚硬的海岸岩石侵蚀磨损殆尽。
items.ex2_en: The soft stone steps wore away under centuries of heavy pilgrim footstep.
items.ex2_zh: 在朝圣者数百年来沉重的脚步踩踏下，柔软的石阶逐渐被磨损了。

items.def_en: To undo or separate woven or knitted threads; figuratively, to fall apart
items.ex_en: A single loose thread caused the handmade knit sweater to unravel from the hem.
items.ex_zh: 一根松脱的线头导致这件手工编织毛衣从下摆处散脱开来。
items.ex2_en: The mischievous kitten began to unravel the colorful ball of knitting yarn.
items.ex2_zh: 调皮的小猫开始拆散那团色彩斑斓的毛线球。

items.def_en: To tear, wear down, or cut into long, narrow strips
items.ex_en: Vicious thorns threatened to shred his lightweight cotton shirt during the jungle trek.
items.ex_zh: 在丛林跋涉期间，凶猛的荆棘险些把他轻薄的棉衬衫扯碎成条。

items.def_en: To make ragged or torn into shred-like pieces
items.ex_en: Howling winter gales would tatter the proud banner atop the castle's lonely rampart.
items.ex_zh: 呼啸的冬日狂风将城堡孤寂壁垒上那面骄傲的旗帜撕成破烂。
items.ex2_en: The antique tapestry tattered gradually after decades of direct sunlight exposure.
items.ex2_zh: 这幅古董挂毯在经历数十年阳光直射后逐渐破烂不堪。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the progressive mechanical disintegration of fabric edges, ropes, or materials through rubbing, commonly extended to strained patience or nerves.
groups.summary_zh: 边缘因摩擦散线起毛脱落，亦指神经脾气被磨损。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the physical breakdown, wearing down, or disentanglement of woven, fibrous, or metaphorical bonds under friction or stress, contrasting with plain 'damage' by its threadbare or progressive string-by-string collapse.
groups.desc_zh: 指织物、纤维结构或人际纽带在摩擦应力下发生磨损、抽丝与解构，区别于一般的“破坏/损坏”，强调从边缘起毛到逐缕崩解的退化过程。
groups.nuance_en: fray: surface rubbing causing edge threads to loosen; nerves under stress (cuffs / tempers / edges) · unravel: progressive disentangling of knit structures or intricate schemes (sweater / plot / mystery) · tatter: reducing fabric or paper to hanging, ragged remnants (garment / flag / clothing) · shred: violent tearing into thin ribbons or strips (documents / cabbage / flesh) · wear away: slow, erosive degradation through constant attrition (fabric / stone / patience)
groups.nuance_zh: fray: 边角摩擦起毛抽线；神经紧绷 (cuffs / tempers / edges) · unravel: 编织物或复杂体系散架瓦解 (sweater / plot / mystery) · tatter: 破烂成缕呈碎片状 (garment / flag / clothing) · shred: 撕碎切成窄条 (documents / cabbage / flesh) · wear away: 磨蚀损耗渐次耗尽 (fabric / stone / patience)

groups.name: Frolic & Cavort · 欢跃与嬉闹 (Frolic, Cavort, Caper)
groups.tip: 欢欣雀跃或欢快蹦跳打闹

items.def_en: to play and move around in a lively, cheerful, and light-hearted way
items.ex_en: Young lambs would frolic across the dew-kissed meadows under the radiant morning sun.
items.ex_zh: 在灿烂的朝阳下，小羊羔在带露的草地上欢快地嬉戏奔跳。

items.def_en: to play roughly, energetically, and boisterously
items.ex_en: The three golden retrievers love to romp through the muddy fields together every afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 这三只金毛寻回犬每天下午都喜欢聚在一起在泥泞的田野里喧闹撒欢。

items.def_zh: 扮小丑滑稽动作，做滑稽蹦跳动作
items.def_en: (archaic) to perform silly, playful, or grotesque gestures and movements like a clown
items.ex_en: The masked jester began to antic across the grand hall, amusing the royal court.
items.ex_zh: 蒙面小丑开始在大厅里做起滑稽怪异的跳跃动作，逗乐了整个宫廷。

items.def_en: to skip or dance around in a playful, energetic, or comedic manner
items.ex_en: Playful mountain goats caper along the rocky cliff ledges with breathtaking natural grace.
items.ex_zh: 顽皮的岩羊以令人屏息的优雅姿态在岩石峭壁边缘欢蹦雀跃。

items.def_en: to jump or dance around excitedly and exuberantly
items.ex_en: Wild nymphs were said to cavort beneath the pale moonlight in enchanted forest glades.
items.ex_zh: 相传野仙女们常在施了魔法的森林空地中，于苍白月光下兴奋雀跃。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this manner frame depict vigorous, exuberant, playful jumping, dancing, and prancing around in high spirits or buffoonish glee.
groups.summary_zh: 指兴高采烈、滑稽或无拘无束地雀跃、蹦跳与打闹嬉戏。
groups.desc_en: Denotes lighthearted, unrestrained, and often physically boisterous jumping, dancing, or prancing, contrasting with basic 'play' through its expressive, acrobatic leap-bound physical mechanics.
groups.desc_zh: 指欢畅轻快、无拘无束的跳跃、打闹或嬉戏动作，区别于一般的“玩耍”，强调带有欢愉色彩的肢体奔跃与腾挪跳跃感。
groups.nuance_en: frolic: cheerful, light-footed, innocent romping in pleasant spaces (lambs / children / waves) · cavort: leaping about boisterously, sometimes with erotic or drunken connotations (actors / dancers / revelers) · caper: skip or leap playfully in acrobatic bursts (lambs / calves / clowns) · romp: rough-and-tumble, vigorous physical running and tumbling (dogs / puppies / toddlers) · antic: performing bizarre, ludicrous, or grotesque pranks and clowning (jesters / troupes / performers)
groups.nuance_zh: frolic: 轻松欢快、无忧无虑的嬉戏跳跃 (lambs / children / waves) · cavort: 狂欢喧闹地雀跃跳动，常带放浪色彩 (actors / dancers / revelers) · caper: 欢欣雀跃、小步雀步蹦跳 (lambs / calves / clowns) · romp: 奔跑扑腾打滚的放肆嬉闹 (dogs / puppies / toddlers) · antic: 扮丑作怪、滑稽滑诞地跳闹 (jesters / troupes / performers)

groups.name: Fruit & Bear · 结果与产出 (Yield, Bear, Produce)
groups.tip: 植物成熟孕育果实的过程

items.def_en: Produce crops, flowers, or fruit as part of natural growth
items.ex_en: These mature apple trees usually bear sweet, juicy fruit by late September every year.
items.ex_zh: 这些成熟的苹果树通常每年九月下旬结出甜美多汁的果实。

items.def_en: To produce or bear fruit, or cause a plant to do so.
items.ex_en: If properly pollinated, the delicate citrus blossoms will fruit abundantly throughout the long autumn.
items.ex_zh: 如果受粉得当，娇嫩的柑橘花将在漫长的秋季结出累累硕果。

items.def_en: Produce or shed seeds after flowering
items.ex_en: In late summer, the tall dandelions begin to seed across the untended lawn.
items.ex_zh: 夏末时分，高大的蒲公英开始在这片无人打理的草坪上结籽播散。

items.def_en: Produce or provide a natural product or crop as a result of cultivation
items.ex_en: Fertile volcanic soil allows these irrigated terraces to yield bountiful harvests of golden grain.
items.ex_zh: 肥沃的火山土壤使这些灌溉梯田能够出产大量金黄的粮食。

items.def_en: Become or make fruit or grain fully developed and ready to harvest
items.ex_en: Warm summer sunshine helps the green hanging tomatoes ripen on the vine quickly.
items.ex_zh: 温暖的夏日阳光有助于藤上垂挂着的青西红柿迅速成熟。
items.ex2_en: Warm greenhouse conditions quickly ripen the green bananas before the seasonal market.
items.ex2_zh: 温暖的温室环境在应季上市前迅速催熟了青香蕉。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the reproductive output of plants and natural organisms as they mature. The verbs contrast botanical yield ('fruit', 'bear') with agricultural and metaphorical productivity ('yield', 'crop').
groups.summary_zh: 指植物成熟后开花结果、结出果实或产出作物。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the organic biological cycle of producing botanical fruit, seeds, or agricultural yield, extended to fulfilling investments or labor, contrasting with generic 'make' through inherent maturation and natural outgrowth.
groups.desc_zh: 指植物开花结实、孕育种子的自然生命历程，引申为努力带来回报，区别于通用的“制造/产出”，强调内在的滋养孕育与自然成熟。
groups.nuance_en: bear: supporting the growth and bringing forth of harvest or offspring (fruit / burden / child) · fruit: developing physical fruit or reaching profitable realization (orchard / vine / investment) · yield: giving forth quantifiable produce under cultivation or capital return (crops / profit / wheat) · seed: shedding or forming seeds for propagation (plants / grass / clouds) · ripen: reaching full maturity, sweetness, or peak developmental state (melons / cheese / plans)
groups.nuance_zh: bear: 孕育并结出果实或承受负荷 (fruit / burden / child) · fruit: 形成实果或心血结出硕果 (orchard / vine / investment) · yield: 产出可度量的收成或经济效益 (crops / profit / wheat) · seed: 结籽结种或人工播云 (plants / grass / clouds) · ripen: 瓜熟蒂落、走向成熟充盈 (melons / cheese / plans)

groups.name: Fuel & Tend Fire · 添柴与煽火 (Stoke, Feed, Tend)
groups.tip: 生火添柴助火势更旺

items.def_zh: 封火，压火（使火经久微燃）
items.def_en: To heap ashes or coal over a fire so that it continues to burn slowly for hours
items.ex_en: Before heading upstairs to bed, she took care to bank the hearth fire thoroughly.
items.ex_zh: 上楼睡觉之前，她细心地用炭灰将壁炉里的火严严实实地封好。
items.ex2_en: The glowing coals banked smoothly and burned quietly throughout the freezing night.
items.ex2_zh: 发光的炭火被封好后，在严寒的冬夜里静静地燃烧着。

items.def_en: To blow air onto a flame or fire to intensify combustion and make it burn fiercer
items.ex_en: He used a folded cardboard box to fan the dying embers back to life.
items.ex_zh: 他用一个折叠的纸板箱给渐熄的余烬扇风，使火复燃。

items.def_en: To supply fuel, wood, or combustible material continuously to an existing flame
items.ex_en: The camper continued to feed dry pine needles to the flickering campfire all night.
items.ex_zh: 露营者整夜都在往忽明忽暗的营火里添干松针。

items.def_en: To look after a fire by arranging logs, clearing embers, and ensuring steady burning
items.ex_en: The old innkeeper stayed awake to tend the hearth fire during the freezing storm.
items.ex_zh: 在严寒的风暴中，老店主彻夜未眠照看壁炉里的火。

items.raw_cluster: 点燃与加燃料 Ignite & Fuel
items.def_zh: 给（炉火等）添加燃料；激起，煽动
items.def_en: 1. (+ up) To add coal, wood, or other fuel to a fire or furnace and stir it so it burns brightly. 2. To encourage or stir up strong emotions or ideas.
items.ex_en: The boiler operator shoveled hard to stoke the roaring furnace with black coal.
items.ex_zh: 锅炉工奋力挥铲，向轰鸣的炉膛中填煤。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on the physical replenishment and mechanical maintenance of an active flame, hearth, or engine, often extending metaphorically to feeding passions or dissent.
groups.summary_zh: 向火堆、炉膛添加燃料、拨动火势，或比喻性地煽动情绪。
groups.desc_en: Denotes maintaining, augmenting, or controlling combustion by supplying fuel or air to a fire, contrasting with 'burn' by focusing on active human curation of thermodynamic intensity.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过添加燃料或调配空气来维持、调控或激化火势的工序，区别于单纯的“燃烧”，强调人为积极看护与调控火力的动作。
groups.nuance_en: stoke: aggressively stirring, poking, and shoveling fuel into a roaring fire (furnace / boiler / fire) · feed: supplying a steady stream of combustible fuel (engine / fire / blaze) · fan: blowing air or oxygen to stimulate and spread embers (flames / embers / breeze) · tend: mindfully monitoring, dampening, or managing hearth conditions (fire / hearth / stove) · bank: heaping ashes over embers to keep low fire alive overnight (fire / hearth / coals)
groups.nuance_zh: stoke: 拨旺火势、大力添炭加柴以助燃 (furnace / boiler / fire) · feed: 持续供给燃料供给维持火势 (engine / fire / blaze) · fan: 煽风送氧促燃火苗 (flames / embers / breeze) · tend: 细心料理看护灶火火候 (fire / hearth / stove) · bank: 用炉灰压火封火以留夜火 (fire / hearth / coals)

groups.name: Full & Scour Fabrics · 缩绒与精炼洗涤 (Full, Degrease, Bleach)
groups.tip: 纺织加工中的清洗与密实

items.def_zh: 漂洗缩绒（使毛织物等密实纯净）
items.def_en: To clean, scour, and thicken newly woven woolen cloth by moisture, heat, and beating.
items.ex_en: The artisan labored under moonlight to full the coarse wool with warm alkaline waters.
items.ex_zh: 工匠在月光下劳作，用温热的碱水为粗羊毛织物漂洗缩绒。

items.def_en: To mat and press fibers together into a dense, solid fabric using moisture, heat, and pressure.
items.ex_en: Workers apply steam and pressure to felt the loose fibers into sturdy hats.
items.ex_zh: 工人们施加蒸汽和压力，将松散的纤维毡化成坚挺的帽子。
items.ex2_en: The fine wool fibers felt together firmly under steady heat and agitation.
items.ex2_zh: 优质的羊毛纤维在持续受热和搅拌下紧密地毡化在一起。

items.def_en: To remove grease, lanolin, or oil from wool, raw skins, machinery, or industrial materials.
items.ex_en: Technicians use an alkaline solution to degrease the raw fleece before processing begins.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员在开始加工前，用碱性溶液为原羊毛脱脂。

items.def_en: To whiten textiles or raw pulps and strip impurities using chemical agents or sunlight.
items.ex_en: The textile mill uses hydrogen peroxide to bleach raw cotton before dyeing.
items.ex_zh: 这家纺织厂在染色前用过氧化氢漂白原棉。
items.ex2_en: The dark linen curtains will bleach gradually under intense daily desert sunlight.
items.ex2_zh: 深色的亚麻窗帘在沙漠强烈的日常日光下会逐渐褪色发白。

items.def_zh: 精炼；脱杂洗净（原毛或织物）
items.def_en: To purify unworked wool or textiles by washing in hot, alkaline baths to eliminate grease and dirt.
items.ex_en: Specialized mills scour raw sheared fleeces thoroughly to eliminate grease, sweat, and dirt.
items.ex_zh: 专业作坊彻底精炼剪下的原毛，以去除油脂、汗液和污垢。

groups.summary_en: This industrial and traditional craft frame relates to treating, scouring, and compacting raw fibers, cloth, or hides to purge natural oils, lanolin, dirt, and gum prior to finishing.
groups.summary_zh: 针对生纺织物或皮革进行缩绒、去脂与精炼，以清除天然杂质。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the historical textile manufacturing processes of scouring, beating, thickening, and purifying raw fibers or woven wool, contrasting with modern domestic 'wash' by its industrial fiber alteration.
groups.desc_zh: 指纺织业中通过清洗、皂化、捶打与化学处理使生毛料缩绒致密、去脂洁净的加工工序，区别于一般的“洗涤”，侧重改变纤维密度的工艺过程。
groups.nuance_en: full: thickening and felting woven wool fabric by moistening, heating, and pressing (cloth / wool / garments) · scour: vigorously washing raw wool or fabric to cleanse oils and dirt (wool / fleece / impurities) · degrease: removing natural animal grease or industrial oils using solvents (hides / fleece / engines) · felt: matting and condensing unspun loose fibers into dense, non-woven sheets (wool / hats / fibers) · bleach: using chemical oxidation to whiten and decolorize natural unbleached yarn (cotton / fabric / pulp)
groups.nuance_zh: full: 润湿捶打以使毛织品缩绒增密 (cloth / wool / garments) · scour: 强力精炼洗涤粗毛杂质 (wool / fleece / impurities) · degrease: 萃取去脂脱除羊毛脂或油脂 (hides / fleece / engines) · felt: 摩擦挤压压制无纺毡化 (wool / hats / fibers) · bleach: 漂白氧化消除天然杂色 (cotton / fabric / pulp)

groups.name: Funnel & Siphon · 漏斗汇流与漏注 (Funnel, Siphon, Choke down)
groups.tip: 顺着通道漏斗式集中

items.def_zh: 堵住通道，将…限制在狭小空间
items.def_en: To trap or restrict vehicles, troops, or flow in a confined space so that movement is blocked
items.ex_en: The ambush managed to bottle up the supply convoy in the narrow mountain canyon.
items.ex_zh: 伏击部队成功将补给车队堵截在狭窄的山谷中。

items.def_zh: 聚集，驱赶（人群向某处移动）
items.def_en: To move or make a group of people or animals move together in a compact body into a place
items.ex_en: Security guards quickly herd the evacuated passengers toward the designated emergency exit.
items.ex_zh: 安保人员迅速把疏散的乘客聚拢并引向指定的紧急出口。

items.def_zh: （使）汇集，（使）通过狭窄通道；引导，转输；用漏斗注入
items.def_en: to move, pass, or direct something through a narrow space or channel; to channel funds, people, or resources toward a particular destination
items.ex_en: Traffic cones were placed to funnel three lanes into a single open path.
items.ex_zh: 现场放置了交通锥，将三条车道引导汇入单条畅通道路。

items.def_en: To convey or divert liquid, money, or resources gradually away through a tube or covert channel
items.ex_en: The corrupt official managed to siphon public funds into offshore shell accounts undetected.
items.ex_zh: 这名贪官悄无声息地将公款抽调到了离岸空壳账户中。

items.def_zh: 收缩，掐紧通道限制流速
items.def_en: To make narrower or tighter, restricting the free flow of fluid, traffic, or movement
items.ex_en: Severe road construction will constrict the flow of evening commuter traffic across the bridge.
items.ex_zh: 严峻的道路施工将收缩桥上晚高峰通勤车流的通道。
items.ex2_en: Cold ocean water causes peripheral blood vessels to constrict rapidly to conserve heat.
items.ex2_zh: 冰冷的海水导致外周血管迅速收缩以保存热量。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame portray moving substances, masses of people, or funds through narrow bottlenecks, tapering spaces, or covert channels.
groups.summary_zh: 使人流、物资或资金经由收窄的孔道、瓶颈汇聚或暗中抽取转移。
groups.desc_en: Denotes guiding, channeling, or draining liquid, resources, or populations through narrowing passages or illicit diversionary conduits, contrasting with basic 'pour' by focused constriction or covert redirection.
groups.desc_zh: 指将液体、资源或人流通过狭窄通道进行引流聚集，或通过隐蔽渠道暗中转移，区别于一般的“倾倒”，强调收窄引流与暗度陈仓。
groups.nuance_en: funnel: guiding broad flow through a narrow aperture or designated channel (funds / traffic / supplies) · siphon: drawing off liquid or illicitly transferring capital through indirect conduits (funds / gas / resources) · constrict: narrowing boundaries to compress, choke, or strangle throughput (vessels / flow / supply) · bottle up: trapping and preventing outflow by blocking bottleneck exits (fleet / traffic / emotions) · herd: driving dispersed crowds or animals into confined channels (passengers / cattle / shoppers)
groups.nuance_zh: funnel: 汇聚漏斗式引流入狭槽 (funds / traffic / supplies) · siphon: 虹吸抽取或暗中挪用截留 (funds / gas / resources) · constrict: 紧缩勒细扼制流量 (vessels / flow / supply) · bottle up: 堵截在狭隘处使无法脱身 (fleet / traffic / emotions) · herd: 成群驱赶汇拢入窄道 (passengers / cattle / shoppers)

groups.name: Furlough & Lay Off · 临时停工与准假 (Lay Off, Stand Down, Suspend)
groups.tip: 暂时无薪休假或直接免职

items.def_zh: 暂时坐冷板凳，暂停上岗
items.def_en: To keep an employee or consultant inactive while waiting for a viable billable project
items.ex_en: The consulting firm decided to bench several junior analysts after the major merger collapsed.
items.ex_zh: 大型合并项目告吹后，咨询公司决定让几名初级分析师暂时坐冷板凳。

items.def_en: To officially bar someone from their job, office, or duties for a limited time, often pending inquiry
items.ex_en: The governing board voted to suspend the chief financial officer pending an inquiry.
items.ex_zh: 董事会经投票决定在调查期间中止首席财务官的职务。

items.def_zh: 解雇，下岗（常因经营不善或裁员）
items.def_en: To terminate employment temporarily or permanently due to lack of available work
items.ex_en: The airline had to lay off thousands of employees during the recession.
items.ex_zh: 该航空公司在经济萧条期间不得不解雇数千名员工。

items.def_en: To temporarily cease operational duties or step aside from an active corporate post
items.ex_en: The CEO decided to stand down after the company's financial scandal was exposed.
items.ex_zh: 公司财务丑闻曝光后，首席执行官决定引咎辞职。

items.def_zh: 准假，给予准假；使停薪休假，暂时解雇
items.def_en: 1. To give temporary leave of absence to an employee, soldier, or prisoner. 2. To temporarily lay off workers without pay, usually because of lack of funds or work.
items.ex_en: The airline will furlough hundreds of ground workers during the prolonged travel slump.
items.ex_zh: 在这场旷日持久的出行低迷期，该航空公司将让数百名地勤人员停薪休假。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on mandatory, temporary leaves of absence or workforce reductions driven by budget shortfalls or economic downturns, preserving or pausing the underlying employment link rather than outright termination.
groups.summary_zh: 因预算削减、危机或调查实施的临时停职、停工待命。
groups.desc_en: Denotes officially releasing, benching, or temporarily terminating employees or service personnel due to economic, operational, or budgetary halts, contrasting with punitive 'fire' by the absence of worker fault.
groups.desc_zh: 指因经济下行、停产整顿或编制缩减而对员工施加的非惩罚性停职、下岗或放无薪假，区别于惩处性的“开除”，不含对员工失职的追责色彩。
groups.nuance_en: furlough: placing personnel on mandatory temporary unpaid leave with intent to resume (staff / workers / troops) · lay off: terminating workers permanently or indefinitely due to lack of work (workforce / engineers / staff) · stand down: ordering military, police, or responders to halt operational readiness (troops / crew / team) · suspend: barring an individual from duty or office temporarily pending review (license / employee / operations) · bench: keeping qualified talent idle or off the active roster temporarily (players / consultants / recruits)
groups.nuance_zh: furlough: 强制放无薪长假并保留劳动关系 (staff / workers / troops) · lay off: 因业务缩减实施裁员下岗 (workforce / engineers / staff) · stand down: 下令解除戒备、撤离一线撤岗 (troops / crew / team) · suspend: 停职停薪以待调查核验 (license / employee / operations) · bench: 撤下一线坐冷板凳待命 (players / consultants / recruits)

groups.name: Furnish with Projections · 装配倒刺与尖端 (Barb, Spike, Bristle)
groups.tip: 装上倒钩倒刺配件

items.def_en: To provide something with a sharp tip or tapered point
items.ex_en: The blacksmith used a grinding wheel to point the iron fence posts sharply.
items.ex_zh: 铁匠用砂轮把铁栅栏柱顶端打磨出锋利的尖角。

items.def_en: To furnish, pierce, or stud an object with sharp-pointed projections
items.ex_en: The palace guards spike the tall boundary wall with rows of sharp steel.
items.ex_zh: 王宫守卫在沿墙高处装上一排排锋利的钢刺。
items.ex2_en: The dry mountain trail spiked with jagged limestone rocks along the path.
items.ex2_zh: 干涸的山道沿途突起着犬牙交错的石灰岩尖石。

items.def_en: To set or ornament a surface thickly with protruding metal studs or sharp bosses
items.ex_en: The punk rocker wore a heavy leather jacket stud with dull brass rivets.
items.ex_zh: 这位朋克摇滚乐手穿了一件嵌满暗色黄铜铆钉的厚皮夹克。

items.def_en: to fit an arrow, hook, or wire with a sharp backward-pointing projection
items.ex_en: Ancient hunters used sharp bone splinters to barb their primitive fish spears effectively.
items.ex_zh: 古代猎人利用锋利的骨头碎片为原始鱼叉装上有效的倒钩。

items.def_en: To equip, line, or cause a surface to be densely furnished with stiff, spiky projections
items.ex_en: The defender prepared to bristle the outer ramparts with iron pikes against assault.
items.ex_zh: 守军准备在外护墙上密布铁矛，以抵御强攻。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve arming, modifying, or retrofitting an object with sharp projections, hooks, or points to make it catch, snag, or inflict damage. They focus on functional edge modifications.
groups.summary_zh: 指为物体安装倒钩、尖刺或锐利凸起，以增强抓阻或杀伤能力。
groups.desc_en: Denotes attaching, raising, or arming an object or creature with sharp, pointed, or defensive protrusions, contrasting with smooth 'coat' by the creation of a menacing, piercing surface texture.
groups.desc_zh: 指在物体或生物体表面布设、武装或竖立起尖刺、倒钩等锐利突起物，区别于普通的“覆盖”，强调形成防卫性或杀伤性的刺状质感。
groups.nuance_en: barb: equipping points with backward-facing hooks to impede removal (wire / hook / arrow) · spike: fitting surfaces with sharp, upright pointed metal or wooden pins (barrier / fence / wall) · stud: evenly embedding projecting knobs, metal bosses, or stones (tires / collar / jacket) · bristle: raising hairs or quills erectly in defensive menace; dense protrusion (fur / hair / guns) · point: sharpening or tapering ends to a lethal piercing apex (stake / spear / needle)
groups.nuance_zh: barb: 附加上带有阻碍拔除的倒钩 (wire / hook / arrow) · spike: 布设挺直尖锐的尖钉长桩 (barrier / fence / wall) · stud: 密镶凸起的铆钉、防滑钉或凸圆饰 (tires / collar / jacket) · bristle: 倒竖毛发以示警戒；如猬毛直立密布 (fur / hair / guns) · point: 将末端削尖磨锐成针尖锋芒 (stake / spear / needle)

groups.name: Gag & Silence · 封口与堵言 (Muzzle, Suppress, Silence)
groups.tip: 强行堵嘴剥夺发声权利

items.def_en: To tell or order someone to be quiet, usually by uttering the sound 'shh'
items.ex_en: The librarian leaned over the circulation counter to shush the rowdy teenagers.
items.ex_zh: 图书管理员探身越过借还台，向吵闹的青少年嘘声示意安静。

items.def_en: To suppress news or information about something discreditable to keep the public unaware
items.ex_en: The administration scrambled frantically to hush up the embarrassing corporate accounting scandal.
items.ex_zh: 管理层手忙脚乱地设法掩盖这起令人难堪的公司做假账丑闻。

items.def_en: To suppress or extinguish speech, dissent, or opposition through power, intimidation, or censorship
items.ex_en: The autocratic regime used sweeping media bans to silence legitimate political opposition.
items.ex_zh: 专制政权利用全面的媒体禁令来压制合法的政治反对声音。

items.def_zh: 塞住……的嘴；使噤声，压制言论；作呕，恶心
items.def_en: 1. to put a cloth or other object into or over someone's mouth to prevent them from speaking, or to suppress freedom of speech. 2. to choke or feel as if you are about to vomit.
items.ex_en: The restrictive contract contains clauses meant to gag former employees from speaking out.
items.ex_zh: 这份限制性合同包含了旨在阻止前员工对外发声的封口条款。

items.def_en: To prevent a person or group, especially the press, from expressing opinions or publishing facts freely
items.ex_en: New national security laws effectively muzzle independent journalists covering civil unrest.
items.ex_zh: 新的国家安全法律切实钳制了报道国内动乱的独立记者的言论。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe forcibly preventing speech, whether physically obstructing a mouth or using legal, institutional, or authoritative coercion to extinguish expression and leaks.
groups.summary_zh: 以物理外力或强权手段压制发声，实施禁言与灭音封口。
groups.desc_en: Denotes forcibly, legally, or coercively preventing human beings or media from speaking, publishing, or whistleblowing, contrasting with gentle 'quiet' through overt subjugation and censorship.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过物理阻塞、行政法禁或高压强制手段压制当事人言论自由或消息曝光，区别于温和的“安静”，强调强力封口与钳制言论。
groups.nuance_en: gag: physically binding mouths, or issuing judicial bans on speech (press / witnesses / dissenters) · muzzle: binding an animal's mouth, or aggressively neutralizing the critical press (critics / newspapers / opposition) · silence: rendering permanently inaudible, either via power, bribery, or lethal force (whistleblowers / critics / guns) · hush up: suppressing scandal secretly to avert public outcry (scandal / cover-up / affair) · shush: asking someone informally to be quiet with a 'sh' sound (child / audience / crowd)
groups.nuance_zh: gag: 物理塞嘴，或下达封口令禁止发言 (press / witnesses / dissenters) · muzzle: 戴口套，或强权钳制新闻与批评 (critics / newspapers / opposition) · silence: 凭借权势或暗杀手段永久消除异见声音 (whistleblowers / critics / guns) · hush up: 遮丑抹平丑闻避免外泄 (scandal / cover-up / affair) · shush: 嘘声示意闭嘴噤声 (child / audience / crowd)

groups.name: Gain & Net · 净得与赚取 (Clear, Pocket, Gross)
groups.tip: 通过付出收获净收益

items.def_en: to earn an amount of money as pure profit after all expenses, costs, or taxes are deducted
items.ex_en: After paying heavy operational taxes, the startup expects to clear fifty thousand dollars.
items.ex_zh: 在缴纳高额运营税后，该初创公司预计能净赚五万美元。
items.ex2_en: Her net income will clear above six figures after all deductibles.
items.ex2_zh: 扣除所有款项后，她的净收入将净赚六位数以上。

items.def_en: to earn or obtain an amount of money as a net profit
items.ex_en: Selling the prime downtown property should net the investment firm three million dollars.
items.ex_zh: 出售那处市中心黄金地段的房产应该能让投资公司净赚三百万美元。

items.def_en: to take or retain an amount of money, profit, or prize for oneself, sometimes illicitly
items.ex_en: The cunning broker managed to pocket an exorbitant commission from the unvetted transaction.
items.ex_zh: 狡猾的经纪人设法从这笔未经审核的交易中捞取了一大笔佣金。

items.def_en: to earn an overall total amount of money before taxes, costs, and deductions are subtracted
items.ex_en: The summer blockbuster is projected to gross over eighty million dollars domestically.
items.ex_zh: 这部夏季大片预计在国内总票房将超过八千万美元。

items.def_en: to acquire or earn extremely large amounts of money easily or quickly
items.ex_en: The newly opened beachfront casino continues to rake in enormous cash every weekend.
items.ex_zh: 新开业的海滨赌场每个周末都在疯狂敛取巨额现金。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate earning or realizing an exact sum of money, revenue, or profit through business dealings, prize winning, or salary after expenses or deductions.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过经商贸易、薪酬扣税或博彩比赛而最终实质性落袋、净赚或赚取金额。
groups.desc_en: Denotes retaining money, yields, or margins as actual profit after deductions, taxes, and operational expenses, contrasting with plain 'earn' through mathematical subtraction and residual realization.
groups.desc_zh: 指在扣除生产成本、关税或负债后落袋为安的实际盈余，区别于单纯的“收入”，强调扣除各项支出后的净赚与截留。
groups.nuance_en: net: realizing a definite remainder after all expenses and liabilities are subtracted (profit / return / income) · clear: receiving pure profit after clearing overhead, or sailing over financial hurdles (profit / millions / margin) · pocket: discreetly or triumphantly tucking cash or winnings into one's possession (cash / prize / proceeds) · gross: generating total top-line revenue prior to any deductions (revenues / billions / earnings) · rake in: taking in exorbitant, continuous streams of money effortlessly (millions / cash / billions)
groups.nuance_zh: net: 净落扣减各项费用后的纯利润 (profit / return / income) · clear: 净赚无负债的收益 (profit / millions / margin) · pocket: 中饱私囊或稳妥入袋 (cash / prize / proceeds) · gross: 未经扣减的总揽毛收入 (revenues / billions / earnings) · rake in: 像耙子聚物般轻松大笔捞钱 (millions / cash / billions)

groups.name: Gash & Slash · 割伤与斫出深口 (Gash, Slash, Lacerate)
groups.tip: 利刃划开皮肤造成极深的豁口

items.def_en: Tear or cut something open forcefully and abruptly
items.ex_en: The excited child used both hands to rip open the colorful parcel instantly.
items.ex_zh: 兴奋的孩子双手齐上，瞬间撕开了那个五颜六色的包裹。

items.def_en: Cut someone or something with a violent, sweeping motion of a blade
items.ex_en: The masked assailant tried to slash the thick canvas tent with his dagger.
items.ex_zh: 蒙面袭击者试图用匕首挥刀猛划厚帆布帐篷。

items.def_en: Make a straight, deep, and deliberate cut into something narrow or thin, such as a throat or pouch
items.ex_en: The warehouse clerk used a utility blade to slit the taped cardboard package.
items.ex_zh: 仓库管理员用美工刀小心地划开了封着胶带的纸板包裹。

items.def_en: To make a long, deep cut in someone's skin or in a surface.
items.ex_en: Falling against the sharp ledge managed to gash his left leg quite deeply.
items.ex_zh: 撞在锋利的岩壁上将他的左腿划开了一道很深的口子。

items.def_en: (formal) Tear or deeply cut human skin or flesh with a jagged edge
items.ex_en: Flying debris from the collision did lacerate the driver's forearm quite severely.
items.ex_zh: 碰撞产生的飞溅碎片重重地割裂了司机的前臂皮肉。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify inflicting deep, jagged, or violent bodily incisions using blades, jagged edges, or glass, carrying high physical trauma and vivid visceral impact.
groups.summary_zh: 描述以锋利刃具或硬物猛烈割裂身体、造成较深伤口。
groups.desc_en: Denotes inflicting deep, jagged, or wide cutting wounds on flesh, fabric, or targets through slashing blade motions or tearing trauma, contrasting with neat 'cut' by its severity, gore, and violent depth.
groups.desc_zh: 指利用锋刃劈斫或钝性撕裂造成深邃、血腥或锯齿状的严重创口，区别于寻常的“切/划”，强调创口之深、撕裂之剧与暴烈色彩。
groups.nuance_en: slash: sweeping, aggressive stroke creating long incisions (tires / throat / budget) · gash: inflicting broad, deep, gaping wounds into flesh or material (wound / cheek / forehead) · lacerate: violently tearing or mangling tissues with jagged uneven borders (flesh / skin / feelings) · slit: cutting narrow, deliberate linear openings into surfaces (throat / eyes / envelope) · rip open: forcefully bursting seams or flesh apart with tearing power (package / shirt / chest)
groups.nuance_zh: slash: 挥砍横切造成长条裂伤 (tires / throat / budget) · gash: 劈斫砍开宽阔且深可见骨的豁口 (wound / cheek / forehead) · lacerate: 锯齿状撕裂碾挫软组织 (flesh / skin / feelings) · slit: 精准划开窄长缝口 (throat / eyes / envelope) · rip open: 强力撕裂拉扯开大口子 (package / shirt / chest)

groups.name: Gather & Glean · 搜集与捡拾 (Scrape together, Cobble together, Muster)
groups.tip: 点滴搜集散落各处的资源

items.def_en: To reconstruct a full picture, narrative, or truth by gradually joining isolated facts
items.ex_en: Investigators worked relentlessly to piece together the sequence of events before the crash.
items.ex_zh: 调查人员夜以继日地工作，力求拼凑出坠机发生前的事件全貌。

items.def_zh: 费力搜集（信息、知识等）；拾（落穗）
items.def_en: To gather information, facts, or news slowly and with difficulty from various sources; to collect leftover grain after harvesting.
items.ex_en: Historians patiently glean forgotten folklore from brittle, yellowed town hall registries.
items.ex_zh: 历史学家们耐心地从市政厅发黄变脆的登记册中费力搜集被遗忘的民间传说。

items.def_en: To assemble or produce something quickly and roughly from whatever fragments are available
items.ex_en: The committee managed to cobble together a temporary policy draft before the deadline.
items.ex_zh: 委员会设法在截止日期前草草拼凑出了一份临时政策草案。

items.def_en: To collect or amass small amounts of money, support, or facts with great difficulty
items.ex_en: The struggling student managed to scrape together enough coins for a train ticket.
items.ex_zh: 拮据的学生勉强凑齐了买一张火车票所需的硬币。

items.def_en: To collect, assemble, or summon up troops, courage, or scattered evidence
items.ex_en: She took a deep breath to muster the courage to face her accusers.
items.ex_zh: 她深吸了一口气，鼓起面对指控者的勇气。
items.ex2_en: The royal troops will muster at dawn before advancing toward the border.
items.ex2_zh: 皇家军队将在黎明时分集合，随后向边境推进。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers painstakingly gathering small amounts of information, resources, or support from diverse and often scarce sources. It highlights patient collation over effortless mass harvesting.
groups.summary_zh: 强调克服短缺困难，由琐碎、分散来源逐一收集或拼凑信息与资源。
groups.desc_en: Denotes piecing together scarce fragments, scattered facts, or meagre resources with patience, improvisation, or hard effort, contrasting with effortless 'collect' by the sparseness and fragmentation of the input.
groups.desc_zh: 指面对零星散落的素材、匮乏的资源或残缺的线索，凭借坚韧耐力或临时拼凑加以搜集归纳，区别于坐享其成的“收集”，强调物力匮乏与艰辛拼凑。
groups.nuance_en: glean: gathering leftover scraps, clues, or insights bit by bit with patient discernment (information / insights / facts) · scrape together: amassing barely sufficient funds or support with extreme difficulty (money / pennies / resources) · cobble together: crudely and hastily assembling disparate parts into a functional makeshift whole (coalition / plan / team) · piece together: reconstructing a complete picture or truth from dispersed fragments (puzzle / story / evidence) · muster: summoning internal courage, strength, or rallying personnel through discipline (courage / strength / support)
groups.nuance_zh: glean: 拾穗式点滴耐心萃取残留线索 (information / insights / facts) · scrape together: 砸锅卖铁般竭力抠搜凑齐 (money / pennies / resources) · cobble together: 粗拙拼凑临时搭建应急 (coalition / plan / team) · piece together: 拼图式按图索骥拼合原貌 (puzzle / story / evidence) · muster: 提振凝聚内部勇气或按册召集 (courage / strength / support)

groups.name: Gather & Steer · 驱赶与聚拢 (Herd, Round Up, Drive)
groups.tip: 驱策群体朝指定方向移动

items.def_en: To force a group of animals or people to move in a desired direction by shouting, chasing, or guiding
items.ex_en: The horsemen rode fast across the prairie to drive the wild cattle westward.
items.ex_zh: 骑手们在草原上疾驰，将野牛群向西驱赶。

items.def_en: To locate, bring together, and enclose scattered people, cattle, or objects into one designated place
items.ex_en: The police rounded up several suspects following the robbery.
items.ex_zh: 抢劫案发生后，警方搜捕了几名嫌疑人。

items.def_en: To carefully guide, escort, and watch over a group of people or animals along a path
items.ex_en: The volunteer guides help shepherd confused tourists through the crowded historic museum.
items.ex_zh: 志愿导游协助引导并看护困惑的游客穿过拥挤的历史博物馆。

items.def_zh: 赶在一起，驱赶（畜群或人群）；成群结队移动
items.def_en: 1. To make animals or people move together as a group. 2. To gather or move together in a herd.
items.ex_en: Mounted officers used whistles and megaphones to herd the protesters into the plaza.
items.ex_zh: 骑警利用哨子和扩音器将抗议者聚拢驱赶进广场。

items.def_en: To gather and confine cattle or people into an enclosed space or organized group
items.ex_en: Volunteers worked hard to corral the panicked stray animals inside the barn safe.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者们费力把受惊的流浪动物围聚并赶入谷仓妥善安置。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote managing the movement of a collective group of animals or people, gathering them from scattered areas and directing them toward a specific location or enclosure. Actions range from gentle corralling to forceful driving.
groups.summary_zh: 指将四散的牲畜或人群聚拢、围集并驱赶引导至特定方向或场所。
groups.desc_en: Denotes compelling, guiding, or surrounding reluctant groups of livestock or humans to move in unison into controlled areas, contrasting with cooperative 'lead' by its enclosure dynamics and authoritative pressure.
groups.desc_zh: 指对散漫或抗拒的牛羊群或人流施加外力围拢、驱动并将其驱引至特定规限区域，区别于和平协作的“引导”，强调合围态势与向心威逼。
groups.nuance_en: herd: keeping multiple moving animals or people together in a dense moving group (cattle / children / crowds) · round up: seeking out, capturing, and assembling scattered individuals from afar (suspects / stragglers / cattle) · drive: applying forceful pressure from behind to propel beasts along a trail (livestock / cattle / enemy) · corral: enclosing livestock or evasive actors into an inescapable enclosure (horses / votes / dissenters) · shepherd: tenderly guiding, protecting, and navigating vulnerable groups through hazards (visitors / flock / bills)
groups.nuance_zh: herd: 紧凑拥挤地聚众驱赶行进 (cattle / children / crowds) · round up: 将各处散逸人员或牲畜大肆兜捕合围 (suspects / stragglers / cattle) · drive: 驱打后路赶牲口前行 (livestock / cattle / enemy) · corral: 驱入围栏关卡限制行动自由 (horses / votes / dissenters) · shepherd: 悉心护持引路带领弱小穿行 (visitors / flock / bills)

groups.name: Gentle & Manual Laundering · 手洗与精细洗涤 (Hand-launder, Delicately wash, Hand-rinse)
groups.tip: 用手轻柔浸泡搓洗衣物

items.def_zh: 在肥皂水中轻轻漂晃（娇贵衣物）
items.def_en: To gently agitate delicate garments back and forth in soapy water without rubbing or wringing
items.ex_en: She preferred to swish the fine silk blouse gently in cold soapy water.
items.ex_zh: 她喜欢把精致的丝绸衬衫放在冷肥皂水中轻轻漂晃洗涤。
items.ex2_en: Her pleated silk skirt swished gracefully as she walked down the hallway.
items.ex2_zh: 当她穿过走廊时，那条百褶丝绸裙优雅地发出沙沙声。

items.def_zh: 手洗淘净（轻薄小件衣物）
items.def_en: To quickly wash and clear soap from a small garment by hand under running water
items.ex_en: Be sure to rinse out the sweaty headbands thoroughly under the bathroom tap.
items.ex_zh: 务必在卫生间的水龙头下把满是汗水的发带手洗冲淘干净。

items.def_en: To wash, rinse, and press clothing exclusively by hand rather than using commercial or household machinery
items.ex_en: Conscientious tailors prefer to hand-launder bespoke linen garments to preserve their structure.
items.ex_zh: 负责的裁缝更倾向于手工洗涤定制的亚麻服装以保持其版型。

items.def_en: 1. To wash clothing or other delicate items by hand rather than in a washing machine.
items.ex_en: Care labels explicitly instruct the owner to handwash the delicate cashmere jumper gently.
items.ex_zh: 洗水标明确指示主人应轻柔手洗这件娇贵的羊绒套衫。

items.def_en: To clean an article or fabric vigorously by rubbing hard with a brush, cloth, or one's knuckles
items.ex_en: She had to scrub the stained collar vigorously with a stiff nylon brush.
items.ex_zh: 她不得不用硬质尼龙刷用力搓洗那块弄脏的衣领。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict cleansing fabrics, garments, or delicate wares cautiously by manual agitation or non-machine care to avoid damage.
groups.summary_zh: 手工搓洗或轻柔洗涤织物，避免机器机械损伤。
groups.desc_en: Denotes non-mechanical, careful washing or rinsing of textiles by hand, contrasting with harsh automated or bulk laundering.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过手工进行的非机械、精细化衣物洗涤或漂洗，区别于粗放的机器水洗或大批量清洗。
groups.nuance_en: handwash: default manual washing (delicates / woolens) · hand-launder: formal or professional manual cleaning (linens / silks) · swish: gentle swirling in liquid without scrubbing (sweater / fabric) · rinse out: flushing out soap or light dirt with clean water (stain / residue) · scrub: vigorous manual friction to remove stubborn grime (collar / stain)
groups.nuance_zh: handwash: 默认手工水洗 (delicates / woolens) · hand-launder: 正式或专业的精细手工洗涤 (linens / silks) · swish: 在洗液中轻柔晃动漂荡以防受损 (sweater / fabric) · rinse out: 用清水洗去皂液或浮垢 (stain / residue) · scrub: 用力手搓以去除顽固污渍 (collar / stain)

groups.name: Gentle Prompting & Contact · 轻触与温和推动 (Nudge, Prod, Poke)
groups.tip: 向前推动或轻推提醒

items.def_zh: （用手肘等）轻推，轻触；推进，劝诱
items.def_en: 1. To push someone gently, usually with an elbow, to attract attention. 2. To gently encourage or persuade someone to take action.
items.ex_en: He gave his friend a gentle nudge to alert him during the sermon.
items.ex_zh: 在布道期间，他轻轻碰了碰朋友的胳膊肘以引起注意。

items.def_en: To push a finger or sharp object quickly into someone or something to get their attention
items.ex_en: Do not poke the sleeping guard with that long bamboo stick through bars.
items.ex_zh: 不要用那根长竹竿隔着铁栅栏去戳睡着的守卫。

items.def_en: To push or shake something slightly and briefly; often used figuratively to stimulate memory
items.ex_en: The old photograph was just enough to jog his fading childhood memories pleasantly.
items.ex_zh: 这张老照片足以适时唤起他那渐已模糊的愉悦童年记忆。

items.def_en: To poke someone or something with a finger or pointed object, often to stimulate action
items.ex_en: The manager had to prod the unmotivated interns into finishing their research assignments.
items.ex_zh: 经理不得不督促进度迟缓的实习生去完成他们的调研任务。

items.def_en: To strike or nudge someone gently or deliberately with one's elbow to alert them
items.ex_en: She had to elbow her drowsy brother to keep him from snoring aloud.
items.ex_zh: 她只得用手肘轻撞昏昏欲睡的弟弟，防止他大声打呼噜。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe touching or pushing someone lightly—often with an elbow, finger, or stick—either to draw attention or subtly urge them toward an action.
groups.summary_zh: 用手肘或指尖轻碰轻推以提醒或温和催促他人行动。
groups.desc_en: Denotes gentle, tactile contact intended to prompt attention or action, contrasting with violent striking or purely verbal prompting.
groups.desc_zh: 指带有提示意图的温和轻触或推动，区别于剧烈击打或纯言语催促。
groups.nuance_en: nudge: gentle push to direct attention or movement discreetly (elbow / arm) · prod: pressing with a finger or pointed object to stimulate action (ribs / flank) · poke: brief, sharp prodding usually expressing annoyance or curiosity (shoulder / chest) · jog: light jolt to refresh or stimulate (memory / elbow) · elbow: jostling aside or prompting using an elbow (way / neighbor)
groups.nuance_zh: nudge: 肘部或身体隐蔽轻推以提醒 (elbow / arm) · prod: 用手指或尖物戳刺以催促行动 (ribs / flank) · poke: 短促戳弄以唤起注意或表不满 (shoulder / chest) · jog: 轻微震动以刺激恢复 (memory / elbow) · elbow: 用手肘挤开或触碰提醒 (way / neighbor)

groups.name: Get & Access · 调取与获取 (Retrieve, Fetch, Query)
groups.tip: 调用和取回所需数据

items.def_zh: 在屏幕上调出（数据、网页或文件）
items.def_en: to find, display, or open an electronic file or record on a computer screen
items.ex_en: The clinic clerk was able to pull up the patient's medical file instantly.
items.ex_zh: 诊所文员很快在屏幕上调出了该病人的病历档案。

items.def_en: to obtain, retrieve, or open information or files, especially on a computer
items.ex_en: Authorized researchers can access the classified national database from secure terminals only.
items.ex_zh: 获得授权的研究人员只能通过安全终端访问机密的国家数据库。

items.def_en: to locate and bring back information, files, or records from computer memory or storage
items.ex_en: The forensic analyst needed special credentials to retrieve the encrypted surveillance logs.
items.ex_zh: 取证分析师需要特殊凭证才能调取加密的监控日志记录。

items.def_en: to seek out and return specific instructions, data, or files from storage
items.ex_en: The computer processor takes milliseconds to fetch the instruction from primary cache memory.
items.ex_zh: 计算机处理器仅需数毫秒即可从一级高速缓存中提取指令。

items.def_en: to search a database or index systematically to obtain specific answers or data
items.ex_en: Data engineers query the central archive regularly to generate quarterly sales metrics reports.
items.ex_zh: 数据工程师定期检索中央数据库，以生成季度销售指标报告。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe obtaining entry to, locating, and retrieving electronic files, databases, protected materials, or networked systems for operational use.
groups.summary_zh: 指进入系统、数据库或文件存储介质并调取、读取或提取所需信息与数据。
groups.desc_en: Denotes systematically retrieving or querying data or physical items from storage, contrasting with casual picking up or abstract obtaining.
groups.desc_zh: 指从存储系统或远端有目的地调取、检索数据或物品，区别于随手拿取或抽象意义的获得。
groups.nuance_en: access: gaining formal entry or permission to inspect (database / files) · retrieve: recovering specific stored data or objects (records / information) · pull up: displaying a record onto a screen (file / account) · fetch: going out to bring back an item or remote resource (data / page) · query: interrogating an index or database for matching items (database / server)
groups.nuance_zh: access: 获得权限以读取或进入 (database / files) · retrieve: 从存储介质中检索提取 (records / information) · pull up: 在屏幕上调出显示 (file / account) · fetch: 前往抓取并带回远程资源 (data / page) · query: 针对数据库提交结构化查询 (database / server)

groups.name: Gird & Brace · 严阵以待与自我戒备 (Gird, Brace, Steel, Fortify)
groups.tip: 全副武装并做好面对挑战的准备

items.def_en: To prepare oneself or become prepared to do something demanding
items.ex_en: The retail staff had to gear up quickly for the massive annual sale.
items.ex_zh: 零售店员工必须迅速做好准备，应对规模庞大的年度大促。

items.def_zh: 增强（意志/体魄）；使有勇气坚守
items.def_en: To strengthen someone physically or mentally against danger, temptation, or hardship
items.ex_en: Daily meditation and stoic philosophy helped fortify her resolve during the crisis.
items.ex_zh: 每日的冥想与斯多葛哲学帮助她在危机中坚定了意志。

items.def_zh: 下定决心；硬起心肠下狠劲
items.def_en: To fill oneself with courage or determination in order to face something unpleasant
items.ex_en: The surgeon paused to steel herself before delivering the tragic news outside.
items.ex_zh: 外科医生停下脚步，硬起心肠下足决心，才走出去告知噩耗。

items.def_zh: 使做好心理准备；准备抵御（冲击）
items.def_en: To prepare oneself physically or mentally for something unpleasant or difficult
items.ex_en: Commuters were told to brace themselves as the subway train braked abruptly.
items.ex_zh: 地铁突然急刹车，通勤乘客被告知做好准备稳住身体抵御冲击。

items.def_zh: 准备（迎接挑战）；（用带子）束紧；围绕，环绕
items.def_en: 1. (especially 'gird oneself' or 'gird one's loins') To prepare oneself mentally or physically for a struggle or conflict. 2. (literary or archaic) To fasten around the waist with a belt or band; to encircle.
items.ex_en: The beleaguered minister girded himself for a bruising parliamentary debate on taxation.
items.ex_zh: 这位陷入困境的部长打起精神，准备迎接关于税收的激烈议会辩论。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe mentally, emotionally, or physically hardening and readying oneself for an impending ordeal, shock, or difficult confrontation. They convey active resolve, fortitude, and protective psychological posture.
groups.summary_zh: 指打起精神、做好心理或体魄防备以迎战艰难考验。
groups.desc_en: Denotes mentally or structurally hardening oneself for an impending crisis or impact, contrasting with passive waiting or relaxed composure.
groups.desc_zh: 指在心理或结构上严密防备以迎接即将到来的冲击，区别于消极等待或从容松弛。
groups.nuance_en: brace: tensing muscles or mind against sudden violent impact (impact / oneself) · steel: hardening determination and suppressing emotion (nerves / resolve) · gird: binding up strength or arming oneself for struggle (loins / oneself) · fortify: reinforcing endurance or defenses against weariness (position / spirit) · gear up: organizing resources and equipment in proactive preparation (campaign / launch)
groups.nuance_zh: brace: 紧绷身心以抵御突来冲击 (impact / oneself) · steel: 铁心硬化意志以压抑情感 (nerves / resolve) · gird: 束紧身心做好搏斗准备 (loins / oneself) · fortify: 加固防线或强化心智耐力 (position / spirit) · gear up: 筹备资源与器械积极备战 (campaign / launch)

groups.name: Gloss Over & Whitewash · 掩饰过失与敷衍 (Gloss, Whitewash, Paper Over)
groups.tip: 粉饰搪塞，轻描淡写掩盖问题

items.def_zh: 掩饰，粉饰（后常接 over）；给……上光，给……涂光泽剂；加注释
items.def_en: (also 'gloss over') To deliberately avoid talking about a problem, mistake, or embarrassing detail by treating it as unimportant.
items.ex_en: The spokesman attempted to gloss over the glaring discrepancies found in the financial audit.
items.ex_zh: 发言人试图掩盖财务审计中发现的明显出入。

items.def_en: To make something difficult, unpleasant, or painful seem more acceptable or appealing than it is
items.ex_en: There is no point trying to sugarcoat the bad news about our company profits.
items.ex_zh: 试图粉饰我们公司利润的坏消息毫无意义。

items.def_en: To hide or gloss over difficulties or disagreements rather than resolving them fundamentally
items.ex_en: The joint statement merely papered over deep disagreements between the two leaders.
items.ex_zh: 这份联合声明只是粉饰了两位领导人之间的深刻分歧。

items.def_en: To conceal an embarrassing problem or mistake in the hope that it will remain unnoticed
items.ex_en: Management tried to sweep the accounting scandal under the rug before the board meeting.
items.ex_zh: 管理层试图在董事会会议之前将这桩会计丑闻掩盖过去。

items.def_en: To conceal unpleasant facts, mistakes, or crimes by giving a false or misleadingly clean account
items.ex_en: The official report seemed designed to whitewash serious instances of institutional negligence.
items.ex_zh: 该官方报告似乎旨在掩盖严重的体制性失职问题。

items.def_zh: 避重就轻地掩饰；掩饰带过
items.def_en: (+ sth) deliberately avoid dealing with unpleasant or dishonest truths by treating them lightly
items.ex_en: The manager chose to gloss over financial irregularities during the annual meeting.
items.ex_zh: 经理在年会上选择对财务违规问题避重就轻、轻描淡写地掩饰过去。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe disguising defects, errors, or ethical failures by offering superficial explanations, soft-pedaling facts, or omitting inconvenient truths.
groups.summary_zh: 轻描淡写地粉饰缺点过错，或遮掩矛盾漏洞。
groups.desc_en: Denotes deceptive concealment or superficial minimization of faults and scandals, contrasting with honest disclosure or genuine remediation.
groups.desc_zh: 指掩盖、粉饰过失或敷衍丑闻以蒙混过关，区别于坦白交代或实质性整改。
groups.nuance_en: gloss: passing over an awkward fault with superficial plausibility (over mistakes / inconsistencies) · whitewash: systematically exonerating or concealing wrongdoing (report / scandal) · paper over: hastily hiding structural flaws without fixing them (cracks / differences) · sugarcoat: making an unpleasant reality appear palatable (truth / bad news) · sweep under the rug: deliberately hiding an embarrassing problem out of sight (issues / scandal)
groups.nuance_zh: gloss: 浮皮潦草地带过矛盾漏洞 (over mistakes / inconsistencies) · whitewash: 系统性清洗掩盖罪责丑闻 (report / scandal) · paper over: 糊裱掩盖裂痕而不作实质弥合 (cracks / differences) · sugarcoat: 涂脂抹粉使刺耳真相顺耳 (truth / bad news) · sweep under the rug: 遮人耳目地隐匿家丑 (issues / scandal)

groups.name: Glower & Threaten with the Eyes · 怒视与沉下脸 (Scowl, Glower, Glare)
groups.tip: 沉着脸带着怒火瞪着对方

items.def_en: Furrow one's brow to convey disapproval, discontent, or serious concentration
items.ex_en: The professor frowned at the poorly formatted citations in the submitted term paper.
items.ex_zh: 教授对着提交的期末论文中格式混乱的引用皱起了眉头。

items.def_en: Look sullen, dark, or threatening by casting one's brow into an angry grimace
items.ex_en: The angry captain lowered at the trembling sailor who had abandoned his watch.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的船长沉着脸，怒视着那位擅离职守、瑟瑟发抖的水手。
items.ex2_en: The stern sergeant lowered his dark brow at the insubordinate young recruit.
items.ex2_zh: 严厉的军士朝那个不服从命令的新兵皱紧了阴沉的双眉。

items.def_zh: 怒视，怒目而视；皱眉，沉着脸
items.def_en: To look at someone or something with an angry, displeased, or threatening expression.
items.ex_en: She scowled at the noisy patrons who continued talking through the symphony performance.
items.ex_zh: 她对着交响乐演出期间不断讲话的吵闹观众怒目而视。

items.def_zh: 怒目而视，恶狠狠地盯视
items.def_en: (+ at) Stare at someone with a fierce, piercing expression of direct hostility or anger
items.ex_en: The store detective glared fiercely at the suspicious teenager loitering near the jewelry counter.
items.ex_zh: 便衣保安恶狠狠地瞪着在珠宝柜台附近闲逛的可疑少年。

items.def_en: (+ at) Look or stare at someone with sullen, brooding, or menacing displeasure
items.ex_en: The brooding tyrant glowered down at his trembling courtiers from his shadowed throne.
items.ex_zh: 阴郁的暴君从阴暗的王座上，面带煞气地俯视着瑟瑟发抖的朝臣。

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote fixing someone with an intensely hostile, menacing, or angry facial expression, often involving furrowed brows and steady eye contact.
groups.summary_zh: 紧蹙双眉、带有敌意或威胁性地沉脸怒视他人。
groups.desc_en: Denotes facial or ocular expressions projecting deep sullen hostility or anger, contrasting with casual looking or pleasant eye contact.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过面部或眼神流露阴郁敌意与愤怒，区别于寻常注视或友好目光接触。
groups.nuance_en: glare: piercing, fixed look of overt hostility or anger (at opponent / across room) · glower: sullen, dark, broodily hostile stare (in silence / at critic) · scowl: contracting brows into a visibly bad-tempered grimace (at interruption / face) · lower: looking gloomy, dark, and menacingly overcast (sky / brow) · frown: wrinkling the forehead showing displeasure or confusion (in disapproval / brow)
groups.nuance_zh: glare: 怒目圆睁的穿透性注视 (at opponent / across room) · glower: 阴郁发狠的沉郁瞪视 (in silence / at critic) · scowl: 拧紧双眉显出横眉怒目之态 (at interruption / face) · lower: 眉头紧锁如乌云压顶般阴鸷 (sky / brow) · frown: 蹙眉表示不悦或困惑 (in disapproval / brow)

groups.name: Gnaw & Nibble · 啃咬与咀嚼 (Gnaw, Nibble, Chew)
groups.tip: 像啮齿动物般持续啃磨硬物

items.def_en: To take small, gentle bites out of food repeatedly
items.ex_en: The timid mouse crept forward to nibble on the crust of fallen bread.
items.ex_zh: 胆怯的老鼠向前爬去，小口啃咬着掉落的面包皮。

items.def_en: To crush, grind, and masticate food in the mouth with the teeth
items.ex_en: He chewed the tough steak thoroughly before attempting to swallow another large mouthful.
items.ex_zh: 在咽下另一大口之前，他仔细咀嚼着那块坚韧的牛排。

items.def_zh: 大声咀嚼；津津有味地吃
items.def_en: To chew food steadily and audibly with obvious relish
items.ex_en: The kids sat on the living room rug and munched happily on popcorn.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们坐在客厅地毯上，津津有味地大嚼着爆米花。

items.def_en: To chew or bite upon noisily or vigorously, as a horse champing at the bit
items.ex_en: The spirited stallion champed at the iron bit while awaiting the morning charge.
items.ex_zh: 精神抖擞的种马在等待清晨冲锋时，嗒嗒地嚼着铁嚼子。

items.def_en: 1. (+ at/on) To bite or chew repeatedly on something hard. 2. To cause persistent worry, pain, or discomfort.
items.ex_en: A deep sense of guilt continued to gnaw at his conscience for years.
items.ex_zh: 深重的愧疚感多年来持续折磨着他的良心。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses persistent or repetitive biting mechanics, ranging from small exploratory nibbles on food to wear-down gnawing that erodes hard substances or metaphorically eats away at peace of mind.
groups.summary_zh: 指反复啃切或咬碎坚硬物，引申指焦虑如啃噬般折磨心神。
groups.desc_en: Denotes repetitive, mechanical biting or chewing that gradually wears down food or material, contrasting with swallowing whole or tearing apart.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过重复性咬噬或咀嚼逐步磨损磨碎物质，区别于囫囵吞咽或猛力撕裂。
groups.nuance_en: gnaw: persistent wearing away with front teeth (bone / wood) · nibble: taking tiny, cautious, repeated bites (cheese / crust) · chew: grinding food repeatedly between teeth before swallowing (cud / meat) · munch: chewing steadily and audibly with relish (popcorn / apple) · champ: biting noisily or champing restlessly (at the bit / oats)
groups.nuance_zh: gnaw: 用门齿持续啃蚀硬物 (bone / wood) · nibble: 细碎、小心翼翼地轻咬小口 (cheese / crust) · chew: 在口中反复研磨咀嚼 (cud / meat) · munch: 津津有味且出声地大口咀嚼 (popcorn / apple) · champ: 烦躁或大声地格格咬噬 (at the bit / oats)

groups.name: Goade & Prod Rashly · 怂恿与挑唆 (Egg On, Goad, Prod)
groups.tip: 暗中怂恿并激化对立冲突

items.def_en: Prick or deliberately annoy someone with teasing remarks until they take action.
items.ex_en: Her younger brother kept needling her about the fender bender until she snapped.
items.ex_zh: 她弟弟一直拿那起小追尾事故激她，直到她发了脾气。

items.def_en: Stimulate or urge someone into action when they are hesitant or reluctant.
items.ex_en: The editor had to prod the sluggish author into finishing the final chapters.
items.ex_zh: 编辑不得不催促拖延的作者完成最后几个章节。

items.def_en: Encourage or urge someone persistently to do something foolish or risky.
items.ex_en: His reckless friends egged him on to climb the dangerous electrical transmission tower.
items.ex_zh: 他那些鲁莽的朋友拱火怂恿他去攀爬危险的输电铁塔。

items.def_en: 1. (egg someone on) To encourage or urge someone to do something risky, foolish, or wrong. 2. To pelt or throw eggs at someone or something.
items.ex_en: She knew it was foolish, but her peers egged her into racing.
items.ex_zh: 她知道这很愚蠢，但在同伴的怂恿下她还是去飙车了。

items.def_en: Provoke or annoy someone continually until they react, often by doing something rash.
items.ex_en: The heckler's rude remarks eventually goaded the weary candidate into losing his temper.
items.ex_zh: 起哄者的粗鲁言论最终激怒了疲惫的候选人，使其大发雷霆。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers interpersonal urging that pushes another person into doing something reckless, mischievous, dangerous, or foolish, often driven by peer pressure or malicious teasing.
groups.summary_zh: 指在人际交往中挑唆、怂恿他人从事冒险、鲁莽或愚蠢轻率之举。
groups.desc_en: Denotes deliberately inciting someone into reckless, aggressive, or foolish action through persistent irritation, contrasting with polite advising or neutral persuasion.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过持续挑衅或刺激蓄意唆使他人采取莽撞行为，区别于温和建议或中性说服。
groups.nuance_en: goad: driving someone into action through irritating provocation (rival / crowd) · egg on: eagerly urging someone forward into foolish or risky mischief (friend / crowd) · needle: persistently teasing or irritating to elicit an angry reaction (opponent / colleague) · prod: pressing someone firmly into reluctant movement or choice (reluctant witness / officials)
groups.nuance_zh: goad: 刺痛激怒以迫使其采取极端行动 (rival / crowd) · egg on: 煽风点火唆使干下荒唐险事 (friend / crowd) · needle: 拿话带刺不断刺激以激怒对方 (opponent / colleague) · prod: 持续施压以催动消极怠工者 (reluctant witness / officials)

groups.name: Golf Scoring Feats · 高尔夫击球得分 (Eagle, Bogey, Ace)
groups.tip: 竞技赛场打出小鸟球获胜

items.def_zh: 以低于标准杆两杆击球入洞
items.def_en: To complete a hole in two strokes under par
items.ex_en: With an astonishing fairway approach shot, the young golfer eagled the eighteenth hole.
items.ex_zh: 凭借一记惊艳的球道进逼杆，这位年轻球手在第十八洞打出双鹰球。

items.def_en: To hit a hole-in-one on a golf hole
items.ex_en: He managed to ace the difficult par-three hole on his first tournament attempt.
items.ex_zh: 他在首次锦标赛尝试中就一杆打进了这个高难度的三杆洞。

items.def_en: To shoot the standard par score on a hole or course
items.ex_en: The seasoned champion parred the final three holes to secure an undisputed victory.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的老将在最后三个洞均保帕成功，锁定了毫无争议的胜利。

items.def_zh: （高尔夫球中）以低于标准杆一杆击球入洞，打出小鸟球
items.def_en: (golf) to score a birdie on a hole by taking one stroke fewer than par
items.ex_en: She sank a magnificent twenty-foot putt to birdie the difficult seventh hole.
items.ex_zh: 她推入一记精彩的二十英尺远推，在棘手的第七洞抓下小鸟球。

items.def_zh: 以高于标准杆一杆击球入洞
items.def_en: To take one stroke more than par on a hole
items.ex_en: A disastrous bunker shot caused him to bogey the otherwise simple par-four hole.
items.ex_zh: 一次糟糕的沙坑救球导致他在原本简单的四杆洞吃下了柏忌。

groups.summary_en: Specific scoring actions and hole completions in golf relative to the designated par. These verbs describe outperforming standard expectations through precision under pressure.
groups.summary_zh: 高尔夫运动中相对于标准杆的各类击球得分动作与结果。
groups.desc_en: Denotes scoring benchmarks relative to the established standard strokes of a golf hole, contrasting with non-golf athletic scoring.
groups.desc_zh: 指高尔夫运动中相对于规定标准杆数的特定击球成绩记录，区别于其他球类通用计分。
groups.nuance_en: par: matching the regulation baseline strokes on a hole (hole / course) · birdie: scoring one stroke under par on a hole (putt / hole) · eagle: scoring two strokes under par on a hole (hole / green) · bogey: scoring one stroke over par on a hole (hole / round) · ace: holing out from the tee in a single stroke (hole / drive)
groups.nuance_zh: par: 击球杆数与标准杆打平 (hole / course) · birdie: 抓鸟，低于标准杆一杆 (putt / hole) · eagle: 射鹰，低于标准杆两杆 (hole / green) · bogey: 吞柏忌，高于标准杆一杆 (hole / round) · ace: 一杆进洞 (hole / drive)

groups.name: Gossip & Idle Talk · 闲聊与八卦琐事 (Dish, Tattle, Chatter)
groups.tip: 日常闲扯与打听传播闲话

items.def_en: (slang) (+ about/on) To share juicy secrets, rumors, or confidential gossip openly
items.ex_en: She met her best friend over coffee to dish about their boss's divorce.
items.ex_zh: 她和闺蜜喝咖啡聚会，大聊特聊老板离婚的八卦猛料。

items.def_en: 1. (+ about) To talk informally about other people's private lives, actions, or rumors.
items.ex_en: The neighbours gathered on the sunny porch to gossip about the newcomer's past.
items.ex_zh: 邻居们聚集在阳光明媚的门廊上，闲聊着那个新来者的过往。

items.def_en: To talk quickly, incessantly, and casually about unimportant or trivial matters
items.ex_en: The nervous students chattered endlessly about trivial things while waiting for their exam results.
items.ex_zh: 紧张的学生们在等待考试结果时，没完没了地唠叨着琐事。

items.def_en: To reveal someone else's secrets or petty misdeeds childishly to an authority figure
items.ex_en: The spiteful boy rushed to tattle on his sister for breaking the vase.
items.ex_zh: 那个心怀恶意的男孩急忙跑去向大人告状，说姐姐打碎了花瓶。

items.def_en: To criticize, defame, or speak spitefully and dismissively about someone behind their back
items.ex_en: It is unprofessional to badmouth former employers during an interview for a job.
items.ex_zh: 在求职面试中说前雇主的坏话是极其不职业的行为。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe informal social communication centered on unverified rumors, trivial affairs, and other people's intimate lives. Nuances contrast playful chit-chat with malicious backbiting.
groups.summary_zh: 就他人私生活与未证实传闻进行的非正式闲谈或议论。
groups.desc_en: Denotes engaging in frivolous, malicious, or indiscreet conversation about others' private lives, contrasting with serious professional discourse.
groups.desc_zh: 指就他人私生活展开轻浮、多嘴或恶意的碎嘴闲谈，区别于严肃的正式交谈。
groups.nuance_en: gossip: casually sharing unconfirmed personal rumors (about neighbors / coworkers) · dish: eagerly revealing juicy or scandalous secrets (dirt / secrets) · tattle: childishly reporting another's minor misdeeds to authorities (on sibling / classmate) · chatter: talking incessantly and rapidly about trivial matters (teeth / nonsense) · badmouth: maliciously running down someone's reputation behind their back (boss / competition)
groups.nuance_zh: gossip: 散布或议论未核实的桃色私事 (about neighbors / coworkers) · dish: 滔滔不绝地抖露内幕八卦 (dirt / secrets) · tattle: 告刁状打小报告 (on sibling / classmate) · chatter: 喋喋不休地闲扯琐事 (teeth / nonsense) · badmouth: 背地里恶意中伤贬损他人 (boss / competition)

groups.name: Gradual Collapse & Decay · 瓦解与溃败 (Crumble, Disintegrate, Decay)
groups.tip: 土崩瓦解彻底分崩离析

items.def_en: To gradually wear away or deteriorate over time through steady friction or attrition
items.ex_en: Unchecked corruption continues to erode public trust in our nation's judicial institutions.
items.ex_zh: 不受遏制的腐败行为正持续侵蚀公众对国家司法机构的信任。
items.ex2_en: The steep riverbank eroded rapidly during the catastrophic spring flash floods.
items.ex2_zh: 在灾难性的春季山洪期间，陡峭的河岸迅速被侵蚀侵吞。

items.def_en: To break into pieces or fail completely because of structural weakness or internal stress
items.ex_en: The brittle antique chair completely fell apart under the heavy weight placed upon it.
items.ex_zh: 那张脆弱的古董椅承受不住上面的重压，彻底散架了。

items.def_en: To decline gradually in health, prosperity, quality, or structural stability
items.ex_en: The historic downtown area began to decay rapidly following the closure of factories.
items.ex_zh: 随着工厂的关闭，这片历史悠久的市中心区域开始迅速衰败。
items.ex2_en: Neglect and damp air will decay ancient wooden structures over several generations.
items.ex2_zh: 忽视和潮湿的空气会使几代之后的古老木结构彻底腐蚀毁坏。

items.def_zh: 崩解，瓦解；（使）粉碎，碎成细屑
items.def_en: 1. To collapse, break down, or fail gradually, such as a building, empire, or system. 2. To break or fall apart into small fragments or crumbs.
items.ex_en: The once mighty empire slowly crumbled under the combined weight of economic collapse.
items.ex_zh: 曾经强大的帝国在经济崩溃的沉重打击下逐渐瓦解崩溃。
items.ex2_en: The chef crumbled dry goat cheese over the freshly tossed garden salad.
items.ex2_zh: 大厨将干山羊奶酪捏碎，洒在刚拌好的蔬菜沙拉上。

items.def_en: To break up completely into tiny pieces or cease functioning as a coherent whole
items.ex_en: The old satellite began to disintegrate as it entered Earth's thick atmosphere.
items.ex_zh: 这颗旧卫星在进入地球稠密大气层时开始彻底解体碎裂。
items.ex2_en: The heavy industrial crusher can disintegrate solid granite boulders within a minute.
items.ex2_zh: 这台重型工业粉碎机能在短短一分钟内把坚固的花岗岩巨石粉碎殆尽。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the gradual, progressive deterioration and collapse of solids, organizations, or empires, crumbling into fragments through weakness or decay.
groups.summary_zh: 强调实体或组织体系因老化、脆弱而渐次碎裂、瓦解或名存实亡。
groups.desc_en: Denotes progressive structural breakdown into fragments or total decay over time, contrasting with sudden explosive destruction.
groups.desc_zh: 指物体或体制随时间推移逐渐风化、瓦解并散落成碎屑的过程，区别于突发性的爆炸式摧毁。
groups.nuance_en: crumble: breaking into small, fragile fragments under stress or age (empire / wall) · disintegrate: completely breaking apart into component particles or chaos (organization / rock) · decay: rotting away biochemically or rotting morally (matter / society) · erode: gradually wearing away via external frictional forces (confidence / coastline) · fall apart: losing internal coherence and collapsing completely (coalition / system)
groups.nuance_zh: crumble: 因年久或重压土崩瓦解碎裂成块 (empire / wall) · disintegrate: 彻底离析解体为原子微粒 (organization / rock) · decay: 生物学腐败或道德机能衰退 (matter / society) · erode: 遭外部风雨长期冲刷剥蚀 (confidence / coastline) · fall apart: 失去内部纽带而分崩离析 (coalition / system)

groups.name: Grant & Bestow · 给予与赠予 (Bestow, Confer, Accord)
groups.tip: 官方正式颁发荣誉奖项

items.def_en: (+ to) To grant or give someone particular status, treatment, or respect
items.ex_en: The visiting diplomat was accorded the highest honours reserved for heads of state.
items.ex_zh: 来访的外交官获得了专为国家元首保留的最高规格礼遇。

items.def_zh: 授予，颁发；判定，裁定给予
items.def_en: 1. To give a prize, honor, or money to someone after an official decision or competition.
items.ex_en: The panel awarded the prestigious literary medal to an emerging young female novelist.
items.ex_zh: 评审团将久负盛名的文学奖章授予了一位新晋年轻女作家。

items.def_en: To formally or legally allow someone to have or do something, such as permission, rights, or funds
items.ex_en: The city council formally granted permission for the annual parade to proceed unhindered.
items.ex_zh: 市议会正式批准年度游行毫无阻碍地进行。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To officially grant a title, degree, benefit, or right to someone
items.ex_en: The chancellor will confer an honorary doctorate on the celebrated visiting scientist tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 名誉校长将于明天授予这位著名的访问科学家荣誉博士学位。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To officially present an honor, right, or gift to someone as a mark of respect
items.ex_en: The university decided to bestow its highest teaching accolade upon the retired professor.
items.ex_zh: 大学决定将最高的教学荣誉称号授予这位退休教授。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the formal, institutional, or honorific act of transferring a prize, privilege, or status to someone, often based on merit, authority, or ceremonial protocol.
groups.summary_zh: 基于法定裁决、权威或仪式给予奖项、荣誉或特权。
groups.desc_en: Denotes authoritatively or ceremoniously transferring honors, privileges, or gifts from a higher status, contrasting with commercial exchanges or casual giving.
groups.desc_zh: 指上级或权威机构庄严赐予荣誉、特权或赠礼，区别于商业交易或随手送人。
groups.nuance_en: grant: formally or legally conceding a requested right or petition (permission / visa / funds) · confer: ceremonially bestowing a title, honor, or degree (degree / title / award) · bestow: graciously gifting a cherished treasure or distinction (favor / blessing / honor) · award: officially rendering a prize or settlement based on merit or law (prize / contract / damages) · accord: granting appropriate status, respect, or treatment due (respect / recognition)
groups.nuance_zh: grant: 正式依法批准申请的特权或款项 (permission / visa / funds) · confer: 依章程庄重授予学位或称号 (degree / title / award) · bestow: 慷慨恩赐珍贵荣誉或恩典 (favor / blessing / honor) · award: 依法或依裁判评定颁发奖项或判赔 (prize / contract / damages) · accord: 给予符合其地位的礼遇或承认 (respect / recognition)

groups.name: Grant & Enfeoff · 封赐与封授 (Bestow, Invest, Deed)
groups.tip: 封建领主正式分封赐地

items.def_en: To formally confer a title, official power, rank, or property upon someone with ceremony
items.ex_en: The parliament voted to invest the new prime minister with extraordinary emergency powers.
items.ex_zh: 议会投票决定正式赋予新总理非同寻常的紧急权力。

items.def_en: To convey or transfer real property, an estate, or title to another party by legal deed
items.ex_en: The wealthy benefactor deeded the expansive family estate to the local conservation trust.
items.ex_zh: 这位富有的捐赠者通过契据将广袤的家族地产转让给了当地保护信托机构。

items.def_en: To grant or bestow a title, award, degree, or benefit upon someone from an official position of authority
items.ex_en: The monarch will confer titles of nobility upon several distinguished civil service veterans.
items.ex_zh: 君主将把贵族爵位授予几位杰出的资深公务员。

items.def_en: To present an honor, right, or gift upon someone as an official mark of favor or respect
items.ex_en: The king chose to bestow royal favor upon the loyal knight after battle.
items.ex_zh: 战役结束后，国王选择将王家恩宠赐予这位忠诚的骑士。

items.def_en: (historical) to grant land or an estate to a vassal under the feudal system in exchange for pledged service.
items.ex_en: The medieval sovereign enfeoffed his most loyal baron with vast northern border territories.
items.ex_zh: 这位中世纪君主将辽阔的北部边境领地作为采邑封给了最忠心的男爵。

groups.summary_en: This institutional frame encompasses formally or legally conveying title, sovereign lands, feudal estates, honors, or vested authorities to a subordinate recipient.
groups.summary_zh: 以君主或法律权威正式册封、赏赐领地、官职或特权。
groups.desc_en: Denotes legally or feudally investing someone with noble titles, landed estates, or sovereign authority, contrasting with routine property sales.
groups.desc_zh: 指依据封建法律或宗法体系分封授土、确立贵族身份，区别于普通的产权买卖转让。
groups.nuance_en: enfeoff: formally granting a feudal tenancy or fief in return for homage (vassal / manor) · invest: ceremonially endowing with the insignia, robes, and powers of high office (with authority / knight) · deed: formally transferring title of real estate via legal instrument (property / land) · confer: bestowing sovereign or hereditary rank (knighthood / dukedom) · bestow: gifting ancestral patrimony or royal favor (estates / barony)
groups.nuance_zh: enfeoff: 依封建领主关系册封领地与臣属 (vassal / manor) · invest: 举行加冕授职典礼赋予大权 (with authority / knight) · deed: 通过法定地契过户授让产权 (property / land) · confer: 授予爵位或世袭世职 (knighthood / dukedom) · bestow: 恩赏皇室产业或封地 (estates / barony)

groups.name: Grasp & Seize Physically · 抓握与强取 (Grasp, Seize, Snatch)
groups.tip: 伸手牢牢抓取或擒获

items.def_en: To grab onto or attach oneself firmly to someone or something
items.ex_en: The toddler managed to latch onto his mother's skirt and refused to let go.
items.ex_zh: 蹒跚学步的孩子牢牢抓住了母亲的裙子，怎么也不肯松手。

items.def_en: To take a firm hold of somebody or something with your hand
items.ex_en: She grasped the sturdy wooden railing tightly to keep from falling down stairs.
items.ex_zh: 她紧紧握住坚固的木制栏杆，以免从楼梯上摔下去。

items.def_en: 1. (formal / archaic) To seize or grasp physically. 2. (formal) To comprehend mentally.
items.ex_en: The mechanical robotic arm was engineered specifically to prehend fragile glass objects safely.
items.ex_zh: 该机械臂经过专门设计，能够安全地抓取易碎的玻璃制品。

items.def_en: To take hold of something suddenly and firmly with force
items.ex_en: Armed federal agents moved in swiftly to seize illegal contraband hidden in warehouses.
items.ex_zh: 全副武装的联邦特工迅速行动，查获并扣押了藏在仓库中的违禁品。

items.def_en: To take hold of something quickly, roughly, or secretly
items.ex_en: The masked thief managed to snatch her diamond necklace and vanish into traffic.
items.ex_zh: 蒙面窃贼一把扯下她的钻石项链，随后消失在车流中。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on the physical act of closing fingers or an appendage firmly around an object, or taking hold of something suddenly or by force.
groups.summary_zh: 指用手掌或手指牢牢抓取、攥紧或强行攫取某物。
groups.desc_en: Denotes physically clamping onto or aggressively taking hold of an object with hands or claws, contrasting with passive holding or releasing.
groups.desc_zh: 指用手掌或利爪迅速、强硬地扣紧或夺取实体目标，区别于静止托握或松手放开。
groups.nuance_en: grasp: firmly gripping an object with fingers wrapped around (hand / hilt) · seize: grabbing suddenly and with overwhelming force (weapon / controls) · snatch: quick, abrupt, often illicit grabbing out of mid-air or someone's grasp (purse / opportunity) · latch onto: attaching firmly and tenaciously so as not to let go (wrist / idea) · prehend: anatomically grasping or seizing using an adapted extremity (tail / object)
groups.nuance_zh: grasp: 手指环绕紧紧握牢 (hand / hilt) · seize: 猝然暴发并以压倒性力量捕获夺取 (weapon / controls) · snatch: 迅雷不及掩耳之势一把抢走 (purse / opportunity) · latch onto: 如搭扣般死死咬住不放 (wrist / idea) · prehend: 动物解剖学结构上的抓取捕食 (tail / object)

groups.name: Grave Risk & Existential Threat · 重创与严重危及 (Imperil, Threaten, Undermine)
groups.tip: 对安全或重大利益构成危险

items.def_en: To pose a formidable danger or forebode catastrophe toward public safety or political order
items.ex_en: Rising ocean temperatures seriously threaten marine ecosystems and coastal communities across the globe.
items.ex_zh: 不断上升的海洋温度严重危及着全球的海洋生态系统和沿海社区。

items.def_en: To weaken authority, stability, or confidence gradually and insidiously
items.ex_en: Such unfounded conspiracy theories serve only to undermine institutional authority and social cohesion.
items.ex_zh: 这种毫无根据的阴谋论只会从根本上削弱体制权威和社会凝聚力。

items.def_en: To disrupt the steady functioning and security of a government or economic system
items.ex_en: Hyperinflation and sudden fuel shortages threatened to destabilize the fragile transition government entirely.
items.ex_zh: 恶性通货膨胀和突如其来的燃料短缺可能会彻底动摇脆弱的过渡政府。
items.ex2_en: The volatile financial market destabilized suddenly following the surprise central bank announcement.
items.ex2_zh: 在央行出人意料的公告发布后，波动的金融市场瞬间动荡失衡。

items.def_zh: 危及，使陷入险境，损害（jeopardize的英式拼写）
items.def_en: (British English) To put someone or something in serious danger of being harmed, damaged, or lost.
items.ex_en: Careless disclosure of intelligence could jeopardise the ongoing security operations across the border.
items.ex_zh: 不慎泄露情报可能会危及正在边境展开的安全行动。

items.def_en: To expose institutions, lives, or state security to imminent and catastrophic hazard
items.ex_en: The unilateral withdrawal from maritime treaties would imperil regional security and economic cooperation.
items.ex_zh: 单方面退出海洋条约将使地区安全与经济合作陷入毁灭性危局。

groups.summary_en: Highlights actions that inflict severe or fatal risk upon vital governance, national stability, constitutional order, or alliances. Collocates include sovereignty, stability, regime, and peace talks.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重对政局、稳定或根本利益构成高强度威胁或重创。
groups.desc_en: Denotes putting the survival, viability, or core integrity of something in catastrophic danger, contrasting with causing minor inconvenience or stable risk.
groups.desc_zh: 指使事物的生存、稳定性或核心机能遭受颠覆性威胁，区别于带来轻微不便或处于可控风险中。
groups.nuance_en: imperil: exposing directly to grave, often fatal peril (lives / safety) · jeopardise: placing stability, success, or future viability in serious hazard (career / future) · undermine: surreptitiously weakening foundations or legitimacy (authority / credibility) · destabilize: disrupting equilibrium to cause political or systemic collapse (regime / economy) · threaten: signaling impending destruction, harm, or punishment (species / security)
groups.nuance_zh: imperil: 直接置于致命绝境之中 (lives / safety) · jeopardise: 使得前途、生计陷于万劫不复 (career / future) · undermine: 暗中挖墙脚削弱根基 (authority / credibility) · destabilize: 扰乱均衡致使体制崩溃垮台 (regime / economy) · threaten: 构成生存威胁或预示灾难来临 (species / security)

groups.name: Gravitate & Incline · 趋向与靠拢 (Gravitate, Incline, Drift)
groups.tip: 受吸引力自然靠拢

items.def_en: (+ toward/to) To tend to support, favor, or choose a particular side, opinion, or preference
items.ex_en: Independent voters generally lean toward moderate candidates who advocate sensible fiscal reform measures.
items.ex_zh: 独立选民通常倾向于支持倡导合理财政改革措施的温和派候选人。
items.ex2_en: The campaign manager leaned the candidate toward a more progressive environmental policy.
items.ex2_zh: 竞选经理引导该候选人倾向于更为激进的环保政策。

items.def_zh: 不知不觉漂移，缓缓靠拢
items.def_en: (+ toward/into) To move slowly and aimlessly, or be carried effortlessly toward a specific direction or group
items.ex_en: Over time, the disillusioned young painter began to drift into more radical political circles.
items.ex_zh: 久而久之，这位心灰意冷的年轻画家不知不觉靠向了更为激进的政治圈子。

items.def_en: (+ toward/to) To feel favorably disposed toward or lean toward a particular opinion or course of action
items.ex_en: Academic scholars increasingly incline toward interdisciplinary research models when studying complex climate issues.
items.ex_zh: 学者们在研究复杂的气候问题时，越来越倾向于跨学科研究模式。
items.ex2_en: Her compelling economic argument inclined the skeptical committee toward approving the project.
items.ex2_zh: 她令人信服的经济论据促使持怀疑态度的委员会倾向于批准该项目。

items.def_zh: 被吸引到，移向；受重力作用下沉
items.def_en: 1. (+ toward/to) To be naturally attracted to and move toward a person, place, or thing. 2. (physics) To move in response to gravitational pull.
items.ex_en: Ambitious young tech professionals inevitably gravitate toward vibrant metropolitan centres offering career advancement.
items.ex_zh: 雄心勃勃的年轻科技人才不可避免地被吸引到能提供职业晋升的活力大都市。

items.def_en: (+ toward) To change direction or attitude, shifting progressively toward something new
items.ex_en: Public sentiment seemed to veer toward stricter environmental regulations after the toxic spill.
items.ex_zh: 在有毒物质泄漏事故发生后，公众舆论似乎明显转向了更严格的环保法规。

groups.summary_en: Denotes physical or psychological movement naturally drawn toward an attractor, idea, or group. 'Gravitate' implies an irresistible or unconscious pull, whereas 'drift' suggests gradual, passive convergence.
groups.summary_zh: 指受到无形力量、兴趣或趋势驱使，自然或不自觉地向某处靠拢。
groups.desc_en: Denotes natural, almost magnetic movement or bias toward a particular position, person, or ideology, contrasting with sudden forced redirection.
groups.desc_zh: 指受到某种内在引力或倾向驱使而自然靠拢或偏向，区别于突发的外力强行重定向。
groups.nuance_en: gravitate: naturally and steadily drawn toward a center of attraction (toward center / to crowd) · incline: possessing a gentle mental disposition or spatial slant (toward opinion / head) · lean: exhibiting a clear, sustained bias or physical tilt (toward policy / against wall) · drift: moving aimlessly and passively toward a state or place (apart / toward danger) · veer: sharply or erratically shifting course from the original line (off course / to right)
groups.nuance_zh: gravitate: 如受地心引力般自然向某极靠拢 (toward center / to crowd) · incline: 心理心性或空间姿态上的轻微偏向 (toward opinion / head) · lean: 表现出明显的持续偏好或侧倾 (toward policy / against wall) · drift: 随波逐流毫无目的性地漂移靠拢 (apart / toward danger) · veer: 突然转向或剧烈偏离原有方向 (off course / to right)

groups.name: Graze & Pasture · 放牧与吃草 (Graze, Browse, Pasture)
groups.tip: 牛羊在草场觅食吃草与放养

items.def_en: Send horses, cattle, or sheep out into a field or pasture to graze
items.ex_en: Every morning at dawn, the farmer turned out the milking cows into pasture.
items.ex_zh: 每天破晓时分，农夫都会将产奶的母牛赶到草场上吃草。

items.def_en: Drive or manage a group of domesticated animals together to grazing grounds
items.ex_en: The shepherds worked together through rain to herd the sheep up the mountain.
items.ex_zh: 牧羊人们冒着风雨协同工作，将羊群驱赶上山去放牧。

items.def_en: Feed on high-growing vegetation such as leaves, twigs, and bark rather than ground grass
items.ex_en: Wild deer often browse on tender leaves along the edges of the forest.
items.ex_zh: 野生鹿群经常在森林边缘啃食嫩树叶与灌木枝。

items.def_en: Feed on grass or growing plants, or put cattle or sheep out to feed on open pasture
items.ex_en: A flock of black-faced sheep grazed peacefully upon the verdant hillside meadows.
items.ex_zh: 一群黑脸绵羊在青翠的山坡草甸上平静祥和地吃草。

items.def_en: To put animals in a field to graze, or to feed on growing grass.
items.ex_en: The local ranchers pasture their prized breeding cattle on these open public grasslands.
items.ex_zh: 当地牧场主将他们珍贵的种牛放养在这些开阔的公共草场上。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses herbivores feeding on wild vegetation and herders turning livestock out to open grasslands or enclosed paddocks.
groups.summary_zh: 指食草动物啃食野草，或牧人放牧牲口。
groups.desc_en: Denotes herbivorous feeding on standing vegetation in fields or open land, contrasting with predatory carnivory or stall-feeding.
groups.desc_zh: 指食草动物在草场或野外采食原生植物的生态场景，区别于食肉捕食或圈养喂料。
