groups.nuance_en: graze: eating low-growing grass steadily in an open meadow (cattle / sheep) · browse: feeding selectively on high leaves, twigs, and shrubs (deer / goats) · pasture: turning livestock out to feed on controlled grasslands (flock / horses) · herd: gathering and steering grazing livestock in a cohesive group (cattle / sheep) · turn out: releasing domestic animals into fields to graze freely (stock / mares)
groups.nuance_zh: graze: 在草甸上低头啃食贴地青草 (cattle / sheep) · browse: 伸颈择食树芽、嫩枝灌木 (deer / goats) · pasture: 把牲畜赶入草场放牧吃草 (flock / horses) · herd: 驱赶并管拢放牧中的群畜 (cattle / sheep) · turn out: 把栏中牲畜放归田野草场 (stock / mares)

groups.name: Grease & Lubricate · 润滑与抹油 (Grease, Lubricate, Oil)
groups.tip: 表面涂润滑脂防磨损

items.def_en: To apply mineral or plant oil to mechanical parts or tools to smooth their motion
items.ex_en: You should regularly oil the bicycle chain to keep the pedals turning smoothly.
items.ex_zh: 你应该定期给自行车链条上油，以保持脚踏板转动顺畅。

items.def_en: To spread butter onto a slice of food or across the inside surface of a baking dish
items.ex_en: Please butter the baking dish thoroughly before pouring in the cake batter.
items.ex_zh: 在倒入蛋糕糊之前，请把烤盘内壁彻底抹上一层黄油。

items.def_en: to rub grease, oil, or fat onto a surface or machine part to make it run smoothly or prevent food from sticking
items.ex_en: The mechanic had to grease the squeaky iron hinges on the warehouse door.
items.ex_zh: 技工不得不给仓库大门上吱吱作响的铁铰链涂上润滑油。

items.def_en: To apply an oily substance to machine joints or surfaces to reduce wear and friction
items.ex_en: Engineers regularly lubricate the turbine joints to minimize mechanical friction and wear.
items.ex_zh: 工程师定期润滑涡轮机接头，以尽量减少机械摩擦和磨损。

items.def_en: To coat with lard or insert strips of fat into lean meat to enhance richness
items.ex_en: The chef chose to lard the lean venison before roasting it over embers.
items.ex_zh: 厨师选择在精瘦的鹿肉中穿插肥肉条，然后再放在余烬上烘烤。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on applying slippery substances such as oil, fat, or synthetic lubricants to machinery or cooking pans. The goal is to minimize mechanical friction, prevent sticking, or ensure smooth operation.
groups.summary_zh: 指在器械表面或容器内涂抹油脂，以降低摩擦或防止粘连结块。
groups.desc_en: Denotes applying oily or fatty substances to reduce mechanical friction or facilitate culinary preparation, contrasting with cleaning or drying.
groups.desc_zh: 指涂抹油性或脂类物质以减小机械摩擦或便于烹饪脱模，区别于清洁去油或干燥处理。
groups.nuance_en: lubricate: applying engineered fluid to moving mechanical joints to minimize friction (engine / bearings) · grease: applying thick heavy oil to mechanical parts or culinary baking pans (axle / pan) · oil: coating lightly with refined liquid oil for smooth operation or protection (hinges / mechanism) · butter: spreading butter over culinary food or cookery surfaces (toast / tin) · lard: inserting or smearing animal fat into meat or over surfaces (roast / pastry)
groups.nuance_zh: lubricate: 机械工程上注油润滑关节以减少磨损 (engine / bearings) · grease: 涂抹厚油脂或烹饪烤盘防粘 (axle / pan) · oil: 点滴轻质机油以消除锈滞异响 (hinges / mechanism) · butter: 涂抹黄油增香或防止烘焙粘连 (toast / tin) · lard: 烹饪中穿插油脂或涂抹猪油 (roast / pastry)

groups.name: Grieve & Mourn · 悲伤与哀痛 (Sorrow, Grieve, Mourn)
groups.tip: 从心头感伤升级为丧亲般的沉痛哀悼

items.def_en: (literary) To feel or express deep sadness, grief, or sorrow.
items.ex_en: The lonely king continued to sorrow for his fallen comrades until winter arrived.
items.ex_zh: 这位孤独的国王继续为阵亡的战友们哀痛，直到寒冬来临。

items.def_en: To express deep sorrow, regret, or disappointment about a tragic event or loss
items.ex_en: Historians continue to lament the irreparable destruction of ancient manuscripts during the war.
items.ex_zh: 历史学家们继续对战争期间古代手稿遭到无可挽回的破坏而痛惜。

items.def_zh: 因悲伤而憔悴；消沉至衰弱
items.def_en: To become steadily weaker and thinner because of profound grief, unrequited love, or longing
items.ex_en: Bereft of hope, the forsaken lover began to pine away in solitary grief.
items.ex_zh: 失去了希望，被遗弃的恋人在孤独的悲痛中日渐憔悴消沉。

items.def_en: To feel intense sorrow or distress, especially over the death of a loved one
items.ex_en: The sudden tragedy left the whole community to grieve for the lost children.
items.ex_zh: 这场突如其来的悲剧让整个社区都为逝去的孩子们感到极度悲痛。

items.def_en: To feel and exhibit deep sorrow for someone who has died, often following cultural mourning rituals
items.ex_en: Flags flew at half-mast as thousands gathered to mourn the beloved statesman.
items.ex_zh: 当数千人聚集在一起悼念这位受人爱戴的政治家时，国旗下半旗致哀。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote experiencing, enduring, or giving outward expression to deep emotional pain and acute distress over a profound loss or tragedy.
groups.summary_zh: 表示因遭受重大丧失或变故而内心深感悲痛、哀悼或流露悲戚。
groups.desc_en: Denotes psychological suffering over loss or death, differing from basic sadness by emphasizing prolonged processing, ritualized bereavement, or physical wasting.
groups.desc_zh: 指因失去或死亡引发的心灵创痛，与普通的悲伤不同，本框架强调长期的心理消化、仪式化的哀悼或身心消磨。
groups.nuance_en: sorrow: poetic, internal abiding sadness (loss / fate) · lament: vocal, external expression of deep grief (passing / tragedy) · pine away: gradual wasting away from longing or heartbreak (lover / exile) · grieve: intense emotional distress over acute loss (death / bereavement) · mourn: formal or ritualized sorrow for someone deceased (loss / victim)
groups.nuance_zh: sorrow: 偏诗意而内化沉潜的悲切 (loss / fate) · lament: 具发泄性的痛哭或公开叹惋 (passing / tragedy) · pine away: 因相思或绝望导致的精神日渐萎靡消瘦 (lover / exile) · grieve: 面临剧烈丧失时的内在剧痛与哀伤 (death / bereavement) · mourn: 针对死者的肃穆哀悼或仪式化致哀 (loss / victim)

groups.name: Grimace & Frown · 鬼脸与苦相 (Grimace, Wince, Scowl)
groups.tip: 痛苦或厌恶时扭曲面部做怪相

items.def_en: to furrow one's brows to register displeasure, confusion, or deep concentration
items.ex_en: The teacher began to frown as she examined the confusing answers on the test.
items.ex_zh: 老师审视试卷上令人困惑的答案时，眉头开始皱了起来。

items.def_en: to make a slight, involuntary grimace caused by sudden pain, distress, or embarrassment
items.ex_en: He could not help but wince when the antiseptic touched his open wound.
items.ex_zh: 当消毒剂碰到他敞开的伤口时，他忍不住痛得龇牙咧嘴。

items.raw_cluster: 皱眉与做鬼脸 Frown & Grimace
items.def_en: To make an ugly expression with your face, typically because you are in pain, disgusted, or embarrassed.
items.ex_en: The child made a sour grimace after swallowing the bitter herbal cough syrup.
items.ex_zh: 那孩子喝下苦涩的中草药止咳糖浆后，痛苦地做了个鬼脸。

items.def_en: to frown in an angry, sulky, or intensely displeased manner
items.ex_en: The store manager would scowl at anyone who dared to leave early without permission.
items.ex_zh: 店长会怒目而视任何敢于未经允许擅自早退的人。

items.def_en: to twist facial features out of their normal shape under agony or intense strain
items.ex_en: Intense agony caused the injured athlete's face to contort in visible distress.
items.ex_zh: 剧烈的痛苦使受伤运动员的脸部扭曲，神情十分痛苦。
items.ex2_en: Severe physical pain contorted his pale face into a terrifying silent scream.
items.ex2_zh: 剧烈的肉体痛苦让他苍白的脸扭曲成骇人的无声尖叫。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify involuntary or deliberate facial distortions reflecting negative emotional or physical states, contrasting sudden pain-induced spasms with deliberate brooding displeasure.
groups.summary_zh: 描摹因疼痛、反感或愤怒而引起的痛苦抽搐、皱眉或做鬼脸动作。
groups.desc_en: Refers to contracting facial muscles in negative affect, contrasting with intentional communicative gestures by emphasizing involuntary reactions to physical or emotional pain, distaste, or hostility.
groups.desc_zh: 指因负面刺激导致的脸部肌肉抽搐收缩，与有意的表情传达不同，本框架侧重对痛苦、厌恶或敌意的生理性或本能反应。
groups.nuance_en: frown: furrowing brows in disapproval or concentration (brow / forehead) · wince: involuntary flinch from acute pain or embarrassment (pain / memory) · grimace: sharp distortion expressing disgust or severe discomfort (pain / disgust) · scowl: dark, threatening contraction of anger (menace / displeasure) · contort: extreme, unnatural twisting out of shape (agony / fury)
groups.nuance_zh: frown: 锁眉以示不赞同或深思 (brow / forehead) · wince: 因骤痛或难堪而瞬间退缩抽搐 (pain / memory) · grimace: 因痛苦或恶心而剧烈挤眉弄眼扮苦相 (pain / disgust) · scowl: 显露敌意或愤怒的阴沉怒视 (menace / displeasure) · contort: 因极度痛苦或狂怒导致的面孔严重扭曲 (agony / fury)

groups.name: Grip & Clasp · 握紧与紧抱 (Grip, Clasp, Clench)
groups.tip: 用手指手掌用力扣合紧握

items.def_en: To keep one's hands firmly attached to something to prevent falling or letting go
items.ex_en: Hold on to the safety railing tightly while climbing the steep metal stairs.
items.ex_zh: 攀登陡峭的金属楼梯时，请紧紧抓住安全扶手。

items.def_en: To hold something very tightly and firmly
items.ex_en: She managed to grip the slippery ledge just before losing her balance completely.
items.ex_zh: 就在完全失去平衡之前，她设法死死抓住了湿滑的岩架。

items.def_en: 1. To hold someone or something tightly with your fingers or arms. 2. To fasten or close something with or as if with a clasp.
items.ex_en: The weeping mother continued to clasp her child tightly to her trembling chest.
items.ex_zh: 哭泣的母亲继续将孩子紧紧搂在她颤抖的胸口。

items.def_en: To hold something tightly, usually because you are frightened, excited, or in pain
items.ex_en: The terrified passenger began to clutch her seat cushions during the violent turbulence.
items.ex_zh: 在剧烈颠簸期间，惊恐的乘客开始死死抓住座椅靠垫。

items.def_en: To close or hold parts of the body (such as fists or teeth) tightly together, especially in anger or determination
items.ex_en: He could only clench his fists silently in suppressed fury and sheer frustration.
items.ex_zh: 他只能在压抑的狂怒与极度沮丧中默默攥紧双拳。

groups.summary_en: Describes holding an object or person tightly and securely with hands, fingers, or arms, emphasizing sustained pressure or an emotional embrace.
groups.summary_zh: 强调持续用力握紧、攥牢或紧紧抱住某人某物。
groups.desc_en: Denotes securing contact with an object through forceful hand closure, differing from passive touching or casual holding by stressing tension, control, or desperation.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过手部强力闭合抓取并控制物体，与随意的“拿/放”不同，本框架强调张力、紧绷感或恐惧下的死抓不放。
groups.nuance_en: hold on to: maintaining continuous attachment (railing / asset) · grip: firm, secure manual control (handle / racket) · clasp: affectionate or formal interlocking closure (hands / necklace) · clutch: desperate, panicky grasping under threat (chest / purse) · clench: tight inward compression, often expressing fury or tension (fist / teeth)
groups.nuance_zh: hold on to: 持续把住或抓牢不放 (railing / asset) · grip: 稳固施力握持以掌控 (handle / racket) · clasp: 亲密或庄重地扣紧相握 (hands / necklace) · clutch: 慌乱、绝望或受惊时的死命攥紧 (chest / purse) · clench: 极度愤怒或紧张下的咬紧或攥紧 (fist / teeth)

groups.name: Ground & Found · 奠定依据与确立基石 (Base, Ground, Found)
groups.tip: 立足于特定基础或前提

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to establish a claim, system, or organization based firmly on an underlying idea
items.ex_en: Democratic societies found their legal systems upon the fundamental principle of equality.
items.ex_zh: 民主社会将其法律体系建立在平等的基本原则之上。

items.def_zh: 以……为基础（或根据）；将（基地、总部等）设在
items.def_en: 1. to use an idea, fact, or situation as the foundation for something. 2. to locate headquarters or operations in a particular place.
items.ex_en: You cannot base your scientific conclusions on such limited and unreliable sample data.
items.ex_zh: 你不能把科学结论建立在如此有限且不可靠的样本数据之上。

items.def_en: (+ in) to base an argument, theory, or belief on sound facts or principles
items.ex_en: Philosophers always strive to ground their ethical arguments in sound logical deductions.
items.ex_zh: 哲学家们总是努力将他们的伦理学论证扎根于合理的逻辑推导之上。

items.def_en: (+ in) to fix or base something strongly within a particular context, reality, or principle
items.ex_en: The new curriculum aims to anchor practical vocational skills in real-world workplace scenarios.
items.ex_zh: 新课程旨在将实用的职业技能牢固植根于真实的工作场所场景中。
items.ex2_en: The captain waited patiently for the heavy anchor to anchor in seabed.
items.ex2_zh: 船长耐心地等待着沉重的船锚在海床上稳稳固定住。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to base an action or belief on an underlying condition, idea, or assumption
items.ex_en: The peace treaty was strictly predicated upon both factions declaring an immediate ceasefire.
items.ex_zh: 这项和平条约严格以双方宣布立即停火为前提。

groups.summary_en: This frame deals with establishing intellectual, logical, or evidentiary roots for theories, claims, and actions, rooting abstract ideas in solid evidence or principle.
groups.summary_zh: 指为理论、论点或行动确立坚实的事实依据与立论根基。
groups.desc_en: Refers to establishing an argument, system, or claim on a foundational rationale, moving beyond mere creation by asserting structural validity, evidence, or underlying assumptions.
groups.desc_zh: 指为论点、体系或主张奠定立论依据，与单纯的“建立”不同，本框架侧重于提供合法性逻辑、证据支撑或底层假定。
groups.nuance_en: found: institutional inception on values or charters (institution / republic) · base: assigning an underlying source or premise (calculation / decision) · ground: providing rational, evidential, or realistic justification (argument / theory) · anchor: securely tying down to keep stable (expectation / policy) · predicate: making an assertion conditional on an assumption (claim / conclusion)
groups.nuance_zh: found: 基于章程或理念从无到有创立实体 (institution / republic) · base: 将论断建立在特定数据或前提之上 (calculation / decision) · ground: 为理论或观点提供坚实的现实或证据依托 (argument / theory) · anchor: 锚定并维系体系或预期的稳定性 (expectation / policy) · predicate: 使某种论断完全取决于特定假设条件 (claim / conclusion)

groups.name: Ground & Run Aground · 搁浅与触礁停滞 (Beach, Ground, Run Aground)
groups.tip: 船只冲滩停滞不前

items.def_en: Touch the seabed or riverbed in shallow water, preventing a boat or vessel from moving forward
items.ex_en: Shifting tides may easily ground the wooden sailboat on the treacherous sandbank.
items.ex_zh: 变幻的潮汐很容易使木制帆船在危险的沙洲上搁浅。

items.def_zh: 使（船或海洋动物）搁浅，冲上岸；上岸
items.def_en: To bring or run a boat or marine creature onto a beach or shallow water; to run aground.
items.ex_en: The heavy storm threatened to beach several helpless fishing boats along the shore.
items.ex_zh: 暴风雨扬言要将沿岸数艘无助的渔船冲上岸搁浅。
items.ex2_en: The injured whale beached on the sandy shore during the low tide.
items.ex2_zh: 受伤的鲸鱼在退潮期间搁浅在了平坦的沙滩上。

items.def_zh: 触礁进水沉没；失控沉没
items.def_en: Fill with water and sink, or break apart after striking ground or rocks at sea
items.ex_en: The battered cargo ship began to founder rapidly after striking an underwater reef.
items.ex_zh: 受损的货船在撞上水下暗礁后开始迅速下沉。

items.def_en: Crash or come into shallow coastal water or onto rocks so that the hull is trapped
items.ex_en: Dense fog caused the unwary navigation crew to run aground near the coastline.
items.ex_zh: 浓雾导致毫无防备的领航船员在海岸线附近触礁搁浅。

items.def_en: Leave a vessel, animal, or person trapped on a shore or reef without the means to move away
items.ex_en: A sudden low tide would strand hundreds of innocent jellyfish on the sand.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的退潮会使成百上千只无辜的水母滞留在沙滩上。

groups.summary_en: This scenario covers vessels or sea creatures coming onto coastal shallows, reefs, or mudbanks and becoming immobile. It highlights either accidental stranding due to hazards or deliberate intentional grounding.
groups.summary_zh: 船只或海洋生物触礁、冲上海滩或陷入浅滩而动弹不得。
groups.desc_en: Denotes a vessel or entity becoming immobilized by striking bottom, differing from open-sea sinking by focusing on friction, shoal entrapment, or shoreline stranding.
groups.desc_zh: 指船只或实体因触及水底浅滩而动弹不得，与公海沉没不同，侧重于水底摩擦阻滞、坐滩或被困。
groups.nuance_en: ground: bringing or coming onto shallow bottom (vessel / fleet) · beach: deliberately driving ashore onto sand (boat / whale) · founder: filling with water and sinking helplessly, or collapsing completely (ship / negotiation) · run aground: accidentally striking a reef or shallow bed (tanker / barge) · strand: leaving helplessly marooned in shallows or shore (crew / passenger)
groups.nuance_zh: ground: 使船或船只本身触底受阻 (vessel / fleet) · beach: 蓄意或因外力将船只冲上滩头 (boat / whale) · founder: 进水倾覆沉没，或彻底崩塌溃散 (ship / negotiation) · run aground: 意外撞上暗礁或浅滩导致停滞 (tanker / barge) · strand: 滞留浅滩使其陷于进退两难的瘫痪境地 (crew / passenger)

groups.name: Grovel & Cringe · 卑躬屈膝与奴颜婢膝 (Crawl, Cringe, Kowtow, Truckle)
groups.tip: 卑躬屈膝地低头逢迎屈服

items.def_en: to behave in an obsequious or servile way, shrinking back in submissive fear
items.ex_en: Subservient courtiers would constantly cringe before the tyrant to avoid severe punishment.
items.ex_zh: 卑屈的朝臣们总是在暴君面前谄媚退缩，以避免严厉的惩罚。

items.def_en: (+ to) to act obsequiously toward someone in power after falling out of favor
items.ex_en: He had to crawl to the supervisor to beg for his job back.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不向主管卑躬屈膝，恳求保住自己的工作。

items.def_zh: 卑躬屈膝，摇尾乞怜；匍匐，趴着
items.def_en: 1. to behave with excessive humility or subservience in order to gain favor or forgiveness. 2. to crawl or lie face down on the ground.
items.ex_en: The disgraced manager was forced to grovel before the board for forgiveness.
items.ex_zh: 名誉扫地的经理被迫在董事会面前低三下四地请求原谅。

items.def_en: (+ to) to act in an excessively subservient or obedient manner toward an authority
items.ex_en: A proud scholar would never kowtow to arrogant officials merely for personal advancement.
items.ex_zh: 清高的学者绝不会仅仅为了个人升迁而对傲慢的官僚唯命是从。

items.def_en: (+ to) to submit or yield tamely and servilely to another's demands or authority
items.ex_en: The principled governor steadfastly refused to truckle to corrupt party bosses.
items.ex_zh: 有原则的州长坚决拒绝屈从于腐败的党派头目。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate abject self-abasement, servile fawning, or humiliating submission adopted to curry favor or beg for mercy.
groups.summary_zh: 指极度卑屈、阿谀奉承或毫无自尊地摇尾乞怜。
groups.desc_en: Refers to debasing oneself through obsequious physical or social postures, differing from legitimate respect by underscoring servility, terror, or unprincipled capitulation.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过卑躬屈膝的肢体姿态或谄媚态度讨好权威，与合法的尊敬不同，强调奴性、怯懦或无原则的屈服。
groups.nuance_en: cringe: flinching inward from shame or fear (fear / embarrassment) · crawl: abject self-abasement to regain favor (pardon / mercy) · grovel: fully prostrating or humiliating oneself for clemency (boss / captor) · kowtow: submissively deferring to superior authority (regime / donor) · truckle: weak, unprincipled yielding to another's will (demand / master)
groups.nuance_zh: cringe: 因惧怕或尴尬而畏缩退避 (fear / embarrassment) · crawl: 卑微地爬行乞怜以求重获青睐 (pardon / mercy) · grovel: 彻底趴伏在地奴颜婢膝地求饶 (boss / captor) · kowtow: 毫无原则地向强权屈从叩头 (regime / donor) · truckle: 毫无脊梁地任由支配妥协顺从 (demand / master)

groups.name: Grow & Mature · 熟化与成熟 (Mature, Ripen, Mellow, Age)
groups.tip: 从生长发育逐渐走向完全成熟

items.def_en: To undergo storage over time to develop improved maturity, flavor, or texture
items.ex_en: Vintners age fine red wine in seasoned oak barrels for several uninterrupted years.
items.ex_zh: 酿酒师在风干的橡木桶中陈化上等红酒，历经数年不辍。
items.ex2_en: This traditional cheddar cheese ages wonderfully in cool, moisture-controlled underground cellars.
items.ex2_zh: 这种传统的切达奶酪在阴凉、湿度受控的地下酒窖中熟化得极为出色。

items.def_en: To soften in harshness and become rich, smooth, and gentle with age
items.ex_en: The fiery spirits gradually mellow into a wonderfully smooth blend after prolonged storage.
items.ex_zh: 经过长期存放后，烈酒逐渐变醇和，化为极为顺滑的调配酒。
items.ex2_en: Warm summer evenings mellowed the harsh temper of the stressed office workers.
items.ex2_zh: 温暖的夏夜缓和了压力重重的办公室员工们焦躁的情绪。

items.def_en: To dry or treat material (like wood) or accustom a person until fully fit and experienced
items.ex_en: Carpenters must properly season freshly cut timber before beginning any construction project.
items.ex_zh: 木匠在开始任何建筑工程之前，必须将新砍伐的木材充分风干熟成。

items.def_zh: 发育成熟，长成；使成熟；到期
items.def_en: 1. To develop and reach full growth or maturity, or make something do this. 2. (finance) To become due for payment.
items.ex_en: These government bonds will officially mature in five years with guaranteed steady returns.
items.ex_zh: 这些政府债券将在五年内正式到期，并享有稳定的保底回报。
items.ex2_en: Patient craftsmen mature the strong whiskey in charred barrels for a decade.
items.ex2_zh: 耐心的工匠将烈性威士忌在炭化木桶中陈酿熟化十年。

items.def_en: To develop to full fruitfulness or readiness for harvesting and eating
items.ex_en: Warm summer sunshine will help the green tomatoes ripen on the vine quickly.
items.ex_zh: 温暖的夏日阳光将有助于藤蔓上的青西红柿迅速成熟。
items.ex2_en: The orchard workers use natural gas heaters to ripen the harvested fruit.
items.ex2_zh: 果园工人使用天然气加热器来催熟采摘下来的水果。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this spectrum trace the progression of organisms, crops, wine, or minds toward peak development, ripeness, or mellow completion.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖动植物、心智或食品风味达到完熟、醇化及峰值状态的渐进转变。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an organic or systemic evolution toward peak flavor, wisdom, or stability, contrasting with simple biological growth by highlighting qualitative refinement over time.
groups.desc_zh: 指事物随时间推移在品质、风味或心智上达到巅峰与稳定，与单纯的长大不同，强调质性沉淀与去芜存菁。
groups.nuance_en: age: developing specific characteristics through passage of time (cheese / wine) · mellow: softening harshness into pleasant richness (temper / wine) · season: preparing and toughening through exposure and time (timber / cast iron) · mature: reaching full developmental completion or emotional balance (adult / bond) · ripen: reaching full biological or contextual readiness (fruit / plan)
groups.nuance_zh: age: 历经岁月陈化以生成独特质感 (cheese / wine) · mellow: 褪去锋芒而变得圆润醇和 (temper / wine) · season: 经受风霜而使木石等材质风干老熟 (timber / cast iron) · mature: 达到心智完全成熟或债券兑付期 (adult / bond) · ripen: 达到生理完全成熟或时机瓜熟蒂落 (fruit / plan)

groups.name: Grub & Root · 刨土与翻找 (Grub, Root, Rummage)
groups.tip: 翻刨泥土以寻物或行穿透

items.def_en: To search widely for food or supplies by scratching, rummaging, or scouring the ground
items.ex_en: Wild deer must constantly forage for scarce winter berries in the snowy woodland.
items.ex_zh: 野鹿必须在被雪覆盖的林地中不断搜寻稀缺的冬日浆果。

items.def_en: To dig or search untidily in the earth or among objects to find something
items.ex_en: The messy gardener began to grub through the thick soil for fallen bulbs.
items.ex_zh: 杂乱的花匠开始在厚厚的泥土中翻掘掉落的球茎。

items.def_en: To find or discover something by searching thoroughly and persistently among hidden places
items.ex_en: Investigative reporters worked tirelessly to ferret out the truth behind the financial fraud.
items.ex_zh: 调查记者们孜孜不倦地工作，以搜寻出金融诈骗背后的真相。

items.def_en: (+ around/in) To dig around in earth or a container using a snout or hands to search for something
items.ex_en: Curious raccoons like to root around inside open trash cans looking for scraps.
items.ex_zh: 好奇的浣熊喜欢在敞开的垃圾桶里翻来倒去寻找残羹剩饭。
items.ex2_en: The hungry wild boar rooted the damp soil in search of truffles.
items.ex2_zh: 饥饿的野猪拱起潮湿的泥土，寻找松露。

items.def_en: To dig a hole or tunnel into the ground or under something to hide or nest
items.ex_en: Frightened rabbits quickly burrow beneath the overgrown hedgerow to escape approaching predators.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的野兔迅速钻入杂草丛生的树篱下打洞，以躲避逼近的捕食者。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this tactile frame describe messy, shallow, or foraging-style digging in earth, litter, or cluttered surfaces. The physical action is often hurried, unscientific, and driven by searching for food or buried miscellanea.
groups.summary_zh: 指在土层或乱堆中杂乱翻扒、挖掘，多出于觅食或翻寻杂物。
groups.desc_en: Refers to digging into ground or cluttered spaces to uncover buried items, differing from clean searching by highlighting physical unearthing, scraping, and messiness.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过翻刨泥土或杂乱堆积物来搜寻深埋之物，与普通的查找不同，强调物理性扒拉、翻动与弄脏弄乱。
groups.nuance_en: forage: searching widely for provisions in the wild (food / supplies) · grub: digging into dirt or clutter with bare effort (roots / dirt) · ferret out: persistently hunting and chasing down hidden secrets (informant / truth) · root: prodding and snuffling through debris like an animal (truffles / belongings) · burrow: tunneling deeply or excavating a snug niche (soil / library)
groups.nuance_zh: forage: 在野外四处寻觅采集粮秣 (food / supplies) · grub: 徒手或用工具在泥土与杂物堆中硬刨 (roots / dirt) · ferret out: 如雪貂搜穴般穷追不舍搜出隐秘 (informant / truth) · root: 如猪拱地般用鼻子或双手拱翻找寻 (truffles / belongings) · burrow: 掘地钻穴深潜或深居于书籍堆 (soil / library)

groups.name: Grunt & Mutter · 低哼与咕哝 (Mutter, Mumble, Chunter)
groups.tip: 喉部哼哧作响与小声抱怨

items.def_zh: 咕哝，哼哼；（尤指猪等动物）发出呼噜声
items.def_en: 1. To make a short, low, rough sound in the throat, or speak in an irritable or tired voice. 2. (of an animal, especially a pig) To make a short, low grunt.
items.ex_en: The exhausted mover could only grunt wearily as he lifted the heavy sofa.
items.ex_zh: 精疲力竭的搬运工抬起沉重的沙发时，只能疲惫地咕哝了一声。

items.def_en: To speak unclearly and quietly so that words are difficult to distinguish
items.ex_en: He began to mumble under his breath so that nobody heard his explanation.
items.ex_zh: 他开始低声含糊其辞地嘟囔，以至于没人听清他的解释。

items.def_en: To speak in a low voice that is difficult to hear, especially when complaining or angry
items.ex_en: Disgruntled passengers began to mutter complaints about the endless flight delay at midnight.
items.ex_zh: 不满的乘客们在半夜开始低声咕哝着抱怨没完没了的航班延误。

items.def_en: To complain about something in a low, quiet, and dissatisfied voice
items.ex_en: Fussy customers often grumble about tiny imperfections in their expensive restaurant meals.
items.ex_zh: 挑剔的顾客经常低声抱怨昂贵餐点中微不足道的瑕疵。

items.def_en: To say something in a low, rough, and angry voice
items.ex_en: The furious guard would growl warnings whenever trespassers approached the private gate.
items.ex_zh: 每当擅闯者靠近私人大门时，狂怒的警卫就会低吼着发出警告。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on producing low, guttural, or indistinct vocalizations driven by reluctance, irritation, or physical effort. Contrasts quiet sulking with unintelligible, muffled complaining.
groups.summary_zh: 指因疲惫、烦躁或不情愿而从喉咙深处发出含混粗哑的哼声与咕哝。
groups.desc_en: Denotes issuing low, muffled, or indistinct vocalizations, differing from clear articulation by stressing repressed frustration, laziness, or animalistic discontent.
groups.desc_zh: 指发出低沉、含混不清的喉音，与清晰吐字相反，强调被压抑的沮丧、怠惰或动物性的不满。
groups.nuance_en: grunt: emitting a harsh, guttural sound of effort or reluctance (effort / pig) · mumble: speaking indistinctly with minimally moving lips (excuse / prayer) · mutter: speaking low and complaints under one's breath (complaint / curse) · grumble: airing continuous, low dissatisfaction (belly / employee) · growl: producing a low, menacing rasp of anger (dog / voice)
groups.nuance_zh: grunt: 因用力或勉强而自喉咙发出一声浊哼 (effort / pig) · mumble: 嘴唇微动、含糊不清地嘟囔 (excuse / prayer) · mutter: 压低声音小声咕哝牢骚或咒骂 (complaint / curse) · grumble: 持续不断地发牢骚或鸣不平 (belly / employee) · growl: 发出低沉、带威胁意味的咆哮 (dog / voice)

groups.name: Guard & Beware · 提防与戒备 (Look out, Watch out, Steer clear)
groups.tip: 保持戒备以防隐患

items.def_en: To be vigilant and pay close attention to potential dangers around you
items.ex_en: You must look out for hidden patches of slippery ice along this trail.
items.ex_zh: 你必须留神沿着这条小道隐藏的光滑暗冰。

items.def_en: To be extremely careful and alert to dangerous people, events, or obstacles
items.ex_en: Watch out! The floor is slippery after being mopped.
items.ex_zh: 当心！刚拖过的地面很滑。

items.def_en: To take active precautions in order to prevent an undesirable event or mistake
items.ex_en: System administrators implement strict protocols to guard against unauthorized access to databases.
items.ex_zh: 系统管理员实施严格的协议，以防范未经授权访问数据库。

items.def_en: To deliberately avoid someone or something that seems dangerous or problematic
items.ex_en: Cautious drivers deliberately steer clear of congested highway lanes during rainy rush hours.
items.ex_zh: 谨慎的司机在雨天的高峰时段会特意避开拥挤的高速公路车道。

items.def_en: (usually imperative or infinitive) To be very careful or on guard against potential danger, harm, or difficulty.
items.ex_en: Tourists should beware of dishonest merchants who deliberately overcharge unsuspecting foreign visitors.
items.ex_zh: 游客们应当谨防那些故意对毫无戒心的外国游客漫天要价的奸商。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate deliberate vigilance and mental or behavioral self-protection against hazards, deception, or detrimental situations.
groups.summary_zh: 保持高度警觉，在行动上严加提防或主动避开危险。
groups.desc_en: Refers to exercising vigilance against latent hazards, contrasting with active defense or combat by focusing on anticipatory awareness and evasive prudence.
groups.desc_zh: 指对潜在危险保持警惕戒备，与直接交火或防御不同，侧重于预警意识与主动规避的谨慎态度。
groups.nuance_en: look out: scanning actively for incoming hazards (traffic / signs) · watch out: momentary sharp vigilance against immediate danger (ice / step) · guard against: systematically taking precautions to prevent an outcome (complacency / fraud) · steer clear of: deliberately maintaining distance to avoid trouble (controversy / area) · beware: maintaining formal, wary caution against deception or threat (scams / dog)
groups.nuance_zh: look out: 留神观察周围来临的危险 (traffic / signs) · watch out: 对迫在眉睫的突发危险刹那警觉 (ice / step) · guard against: 建立机制系统性防范不良后果 (complacency / fraud) · steer clear of: 刻意绕道远离是非或险境 (controversy / area) · beware: 对特定骗局或潜在威胁保持戒心 (scams / dog)

groups.name: Guide & Shepherd · 引领与护送 (Shepherd, Guide, Escort, Usher)
groups.tip: 在前带路或像牧羊般指引

items.def_en: Direct or show someone the way to go by accompanying them or giving directions
items.ex_en: Experienced local sherpas will safely guide the climbing team across the treacherous glacier.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的当地夏尔巴人将安全地引导登山队穿过危险的冰川。

items.def_en: Accompany someone somewhere for protection, guidance, or courtesy
items.ex_en: Armed police officers will escort the crucial foreign dignitaries directly to their hotel.
items.ex_zh: 武装警察将护送重要的外国贵宾直接前往他们的酒店。

items.def_en: 1. to guide, direct, or escort a person or group carefully and protectively 2. to tend, guard, or herd sheep or other livestock
items.ex_en: Volunteer staff members patiently shepherd confused tourists through the noisy, overcrowded station.
items.ex_zh: 志愿工作人员耐心地护送困惑的游客穿过喧闹、过分拥挤的车站。

items.def_en: Gather and organize people carefully to lead them along an orderly route
items.ex_en: Organizers worked efficiently to marshal the excited parade participants into proper formation.
items.ex_zh: 组织者高效地工作，引导并统筹兴奋的游行参与者排成整齐的队形。

items.def_en: Show someone where to go politely by walking slightly ahead or showing the way
items.ex_en: Courteous flight attendants usher late passengers toward their designated seats before takeoff.
items.ex_zh: 彬彬有礼的空乘人员在起飞前引导迟到的乘客前往指定座位。

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote leading, escorting, or carefully navigating individuals or groups through an unfamiliar, crowded, or delicate passage with protective supervision.
groups.summary_zh: 指悉心护送、指引或调度人员穿行复杂或拥挤场合。
groups.desc_en: Denotes directing and escorting individuals through an environment or process, differing from commanding by stressing spatial accompanying, protective oversight, or protocol management.
groups.desc_zh: 指在空间或流程中引导并护卫人群，与居高临下的指挥不同，强调现场陪同、保护性关照或礼仪引导。
groups.nuance_en: guide: leading along a path with expert knowledge (tourist / policy) · escort: accompanying closely for protection or security protocol (convoy / guest) · shepherd: gently gathering and herding a group to safety (crowd / bill) · marshal: strategically assembling and organizing scattered resources (forces / support) · usher: formally showing someone into a designated seat or era (visitor / era)
groups.nuance_zh: guide: 凭借专业认知为他人领路导航 (tourist / policy) · escort: 出于安全或礼节贴身护送随行 (convoy / guest) · shepherd: 像牧羊般呵护看管并拢聚行进 (crowd / bill) · marshal: 调度归拢零散资源或队伍整齐就位 (forces / support) · usher: 具仪式感地引座或揭开新时代序幕 (visitor / era)

groups.name: Gurgle & Babble · 咯咯与轻响 (Babble, Lap, Trickle)
groups.tip: 喉部发出潺潺咕嘟如流水般细响

items.def_en: To splash gently against a shore, boat, or wall with an intermittent soft liquid sound
items.ex_en: Gentle evening waves began to lap quietly against the wooden dock pylons.
items.ex_zh: 傍晚轻柔的波浪开始悄然拍击木码头的桩柱。

items.def_en: To laugh quietly to oneself or make a subdued throaty sound of mild amusement
items.ex_en: The grandfather would chuckle softly whenever he remembered the children's silly antics.
items.ex_zh: 每当爷爷想起孩子们滑稽的闹剧时，都会轻声暗笑。

items.def_zh: （婴儿或鸽子）发出柔和咕咕声
items.def_en: To make a soft, gentle, and contented throat sound characteristic of infants or doves
items.ex_en: The sleepy infant began to coo happily in her mother's warm embrace.
items.ex_zh: 昏昏欲睡的婴儿在母亲温暖的怀抱中高兴地发出柔和的咕咕声。

items.def_en: To make a low, gentle, murmuring sound like a shallow stream over pebbles or a cooing baby
items.ex_en: A shallow brook continued to babble merrily over the smooth colorful river pebbles.
items.ex_zh: 一条浅浅的小溪继续欢快地流过光滑多彩的鹅卵石，发出潺潺水声。

items.def_zh: （尤指婴儿高兴时）发咯咯咕咕声；（水等）发出汩汩声，作潺潺声
items.def_en: 1. (of a person, especially a baby) To make a contented, bubbling sound in the throat. 2. (of a liquid) To flow or emit a hollow bubbling sound.
items.ex_en: We listened to clear water gurgle through the narrow plastic drainage pipes.
items.ex_zh: 我们聆听着清澈的水在狭窄的塑料排水管中汩汩流过。

groups.summary_en: Covers gentle, bubbly, rhythmic sounds emitted either playfully by happy throats (e.g., infants) or by irregular liquid streams. Highlights wet, pleasant, low-level resonance.
groups.summary_zh: 指咽喉发出欢愉的咯咯声，或水流轻撞发出的清脆细碎响声。
groups.desc_en: Refers to producing soft, continuous, irregular liquid or vocal sounds, differing from loud splashes by evoking gentle, resonant, and natural flow or infancy.
groups.desc_zh: 指发出轻柔、连续且不规则的水流声或婴孩欢鸣，与剧烈飞溅不同，强调自然水流的温和微澜或婴儿初语之乐。
groups.nuance_en: lap: liquid gently washing against a solid edge (shore / wave) · chuckle: producing quiet, suppressed sounds of amusement (toddler / audience) · coo: speaking or murmuring in soft, affectionate tones (dove / infant) · babble: flowing with a continuous low murmur or uttering unintelligible sounds (brook / baby) · gurgle: making a hollow bubbling sound through a constricted passage (creek / throat)
groups.nuance_zh: lap: 水浪轻柔拍打岸边或船帮 (shore / wave) · chuckle: 发出轻微抑制的吃吃笑声 (toddler / audience) · coo: 像鸽子或婴儿般发出温柔轻细的呢喃 (dove / infant) · babble: 溪水潺潺流淌或幼童牙牙学语 (brook / baby) · gurgle: 液体经狭窄管道涌动发出汩汩咯咯声 (creek / throat)

groups.name: Gut & Eviscerate · 掏空与摧毁核心 (Eviscerate, Gut, Disembowel)
groups.tip: 取出内脏使其失去核心活力

items.def_zh: 剥离出；清空内部关键组件
items.def_en: To completely empty an interior or take away the key functioning components of an organization
items.ex_en: The corporate turnaround plan will strip out redundant operational units across divisions.
items.ex_zh: 该企业的扭亏为盈计划将剥离出跨部门的多余运营业务单元。

items.def_en: To empty the interior of something, leaving only a shell or seriously weakening its core stability
items.ex_en: Decades of deep budget cuts have hollowed out the agency's core investigative capabilities.
items.ex_zh: 数十年的大幅预算削减已彻底架空了该机构的核心调查能力。
items.ex2_en: The dry mountain slopes hollowed out naturally through centuries of subterranean erosion.
items.ex2_zh: 干旱的山坡在数个世纪的地下水侵蚀下自然形成了空洞。

items.def_zh: 取出内脏；彻底摧毁内部
items.def_en: To remove the internal organs of an animal, or destroy the inside of a building or organization completely
items.ex_en: The butcher showed the apprentice how to quickly gut the freshly caught salmon.
items.ex_zh: 屠夫向学徒演示了如何迅速取出刚捕捞上来的鲑鱼内脏。

items.def_zh: 取出……的内脏；除去……的精华，重创
items.def_en: 1. To remove the internal organs of a body or carcass. 2. (formal) To deprive something of its essential force, strength, or meaning.
items.ex_en: The proposed constitutional amendment would effectively eviscerate the authority of the judiciary.
items.ex_zh: 该宪法修正案若通过，将实质上剥夺司法机关的核心权力。

items.def_en: To cut open the stomach and remove the bowels or entrails of a person or animal
items.ex_en: The ferocious mythical beast was said to disembowel any hunter entering its lair.
items.ex_zh: 据说那头凶残的神话巨兽会将来犯其巢穴的猎人悉数开膛破肚。

groups.summary_en: This domain encompasses actions that violently extract internal organs physically, or metaphorically strip an entity of its fundamental strength, provisions, or vital substance. Intensity peaks at utter existential destruction.
groups.summary_zh: 指物理上开膛破肚取出内脏，或比喻义上彻底抽空某物的核心与元气。
groups.desc_en: Denotes systematically stripping the vital interior or core strength of an entity, contrasting with surface damage by describing deep structural or existential ruination.
groups.desc_zh: 指系统性挖去实体的内在实质或核心元气，与表面受损不同，强调结构性或根本性的彻底掏空毁灭。
groups.nuance_en: strip out: methodically removing components or costs (cost / asset) · hollow out: weakening structural substance from within while leaving a shell (economy / industry) · gut: destroying or removing the entire interior of a structure or institution (building / bill) · eviscerate: brutally tearing out essential organs or completely demolishing a premise (critique / regulation) · disembowel: literally cutting open to expose inner viscera (corpse / enemy)
groups.nuance_zh: strip out: 拆卸剥除特定部件或剔除成本 (cost / asset) · hollow out: 外壳犹存但内部实体彻底空心化 (economy / industry) · gut: 内部全被焚毁淘尽或法规被抽干核心条款 (building / bill) · eviscerate: 极度凌厉地剖去脏器或毁灭性摧垮论点 (critique / regulation) · disembowel: 字面上开膛破肚取出内脏 (corpse / enemy)

groups.name: Hackle & Detangle · 梳理与解结 (Detangle, Unravel, Hackle)
groups.tip: 用梳齿清理并梳顺麻纤维

items.def_en: Untangle, straighten, or clean hair or fibers using a comb
items.ex_en: She sat patiently by the vanity to comb out all the stubborn knots.
items.ex_zh: 她耐心地坐在梳妆台前，梳顺头发上所有顽固的发结。

items.def_en: Gently pull fibers apart or comb hair backward to separate strands and add volume
items.ex_en: The stylist began to gently tease the crown sections to create extra volume.
items.ex_zh: 发型师开始轻轻逆梳头顶的发丝，以营造更蓬松的丰盈感。

items.def_en: Free something from tangles, snarls, or knots
items.ex_en: He applied a generous amount of conditioner to help detangle his daughter's curls.
items.ex_zh: 他涂抹了大量护发素，以帮女儿理顺那一头卷发。

items.def_en: Undo or separate knotted, intertwined, or woven threads
items.ex_en: She used a tiny needle to carefully unravel the tangled wool thread.
items.ex_zh: 她用一根细针小心翼翼地解开纠缠在一起的毛线。
items.ex2_en: The loose knitted scarf slowly unraveled when caught on the metal fence.
items.ex2_zh: 宽松的针织围巾挂在金属栅栏上后慢慢脱线散开了。

items.def_zh: （用铁齿梳）梳理（麻等纤维）；乱砍
items.def_en: To comb raw flax or hemp fibers using a spiked tool (hackle) to separate and straighten them.
items.ex_en: The artisan used heavy iron teeth to hackle the raw hemp into strands.
items.ex_zh: 工匠用粗重的铁齿梳理未加工的大麻纤维，使其化为顺滑的长缕。

groups.summary_en: Verbs designating the mechanical separation, straightening, and disentangling of fibrous materials, threads, or matted hair using combs or toothed implements.
groups.summary_zh: 指用齿梳等工具将缠结的纤维、麻线或毛发梳直并解开杂结。
groups.desc_en: Refers to separating and straightening entangled fibers or problems, differing from simple cleaning by focusing on resolving snarls through careful, iterative mechanical pulling.
groups.desc_zh: 指对纠缠结块的纤维或乱麻般的线索进行梳整抚平，与普通清理不同，强调耐心地逐层挑开结节与理顺。
groups.nuance_en: comb out: using a toothed tool to systematically smooth strands (hair / impurities) · tease: gently separating fibers or strands strand by strand (locks / fibers) · detangle: freeing tangled strands from a snarled knot (wires / hair) · unravel: undoing woven or complicated structures into constituent threads (mystery / knitwear) · hackle: coarsely combing out raw flax or hemp with steel pins (flax / hemp)
groups.nuance_zh: comb out: 用齿状工具系统性梳通发丝或杂质 (hair / impurities) · tease: 极有分寸地将乱毛轻柔挑松分开 (locks / fibers) · detangle: 解开纠结成团的乱线或乱发 (wires / hair) · unravel: 顺藤摸瓜拆解针织物或解开复杂谜团 (mystery / knitwear) · hackle: 用钢梳粗暴梳整生亚麻与粗麻纤维 (flax / hemp)

groups.name: Hail & Taxi · 乘出租车出行 (Cab, Hail, Hitch)
groups.tip: 搭乘各类交通工具出行

items.def_en: To signal to a moving driver to pull over and stop by waving one's hand
items.ex_en: We stepped into the pouring rain to flag down a passing yellow cab.
items.ex_zh: 我们冒着大雨走上街头，挥手拦下一辆路过的黄色出租车。

items.def_en: To travel to a destination by passenger taxi
items.ex_en: Since the subway was closed, we decided to taxi over to the club.
items.ex_zh: 既然地铁关了，我们便决定打辆出租车去俱乐部。

items.def_en: To signal to a taxi or public vehicle from the street in order to catch it
items.ex_en: The doorman stepped toward the curb to hail an approaching taxi for us.
items.ex_zh: 门童走向路沿，替我们招手叫停了一辆驶来的出租车。

items.def_en: (informal) To travel or go somewhere by taxi.
items.ex_en: We can easily cab to the theater if everyone is ready to leave.
items.ex_zh: 要是大家都准备好了，咱们直接打车去剧院就行。

items.def_en: To travel by getting free rides in passing vehicles from strangers
items.ex_en: After their van broke down, the students managed to hitch across the state.
items.ex_zh: 面包车抛锚后，这群学生一路搭便车穿过了整个州。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail traveling by hired or shared vehicle, specifically focusing on hailing, flagging down, or riding in taxis or informal rides.
groups.summary_zh: 指搭乘出租车、打车或叫车通行的行为。
groups.desc_en: Denotes soliciting and traveling by passenger vehicles, contrasting with general driving or mass transit by highlighting ad-hoc roadside hailing, hiring, or thumbing a ride.
groups.desc_zh: 指临时招揽并乘坐公共载客车辆出行，与自驾或固定班次公交不同，强调路边即时招手、付费雇用或搭便车。
groups.nuance_en: flag down: signaling forcefully from the roadside to make a vehicle stop (taxi / driver) · taxi: moving slowly on the runway before takeoff or traveling via cab (runway / city) · hail: signaling to summon a passing cab or public vehicle (cab / taxi) · cab: traveling informally by hiring a taxicab (airport / downtown) · hitch: soliciting free rides from passing strangers (ride / highway)
groups.nuance_zh: flag down: 在路边猛挥手叫停疾驰车辆 (taxi / driver) · taxi: 飞机滑行或乘计程车穿行市区 (runway / city) · hail: 抬手示意招呼过路出租车停下 (cab / taxi) · cab: 口语中乘坐出租车前往某处 (airport / downtown) · hitch: 在公路旁伸出大拇指免费搭便车 (ride / highway)

groups.name: Hallucinate & Delude · 幻觉与妄想 (Delude, Daydream, Envision)
groups.tip: 感官失真产生的虚妄知觉

items.def_en: Form an inaccurate, distorted, or wrong sensory impression or understanding of reality
items.ex_en: Fatigued drivers often misperceive braking distances and warning lights on unlit rural highways.
items.ex_zh: 疲劳驾驶者在没有路灯的乡村公路上常会误判刹车距离和警示灯信号。

items.def_zh: 想象，在脑海中显现景象
items.def_en: Picture mentally something as a future possibility or conceptual reality
items.ex_en: The architect could already envision a thriving cultural center on the abandoned lot.
items.ex_zh: 这位建筑师已经能在脑海中勾勒出废弃地块上繁华文化中心的景象。

items.def_en: (often reflexive) Make someone believe something that is totally untrue, false, or unreal
items.ex_en: Do not delude yourself into thinking that these initial compromises will satisfy them.
items.ex_zh: 别自欺欺人地以为初步妥协就能让他们感到满足。

items.def_en: (+ about) Indulge in vivid mental daydreams about unreal, desired, or impossible scenarios
items.ex_en: Stuck in his mundane office job, he would often fantasize about tropical beaches.
items.ex_zh: 困在枯燥的案头工作中，他常常会陷入对热带海滩的无尽遐想。

items.def_zh: 产生幻觉，出现幻觉；在幻觉中看到（或听到、感到）
items.def_en: To see, hear, or feel things that are not really there, especially because of illness or drugs.
items.ex_en: High fever caused the patient to hallucinate strange shadowy figures in the room.
items.ex_zh: 高烧导致患者产生幻觉，在房间里看到了怪异的人影。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses mental distortions, sensory illusions, and self-deceptive fantasies where unreal impressions are perceived or embraced as actual reality, whether through fever, intoxication, or deep psychological self-delusion.
groups.summary_zh: 表现感知错乱、凭空产生虚幻感官经验或深陷不切实际的自我欺骗。
groups.desc_en: Refers to experiencing perceptions or beliefs detached from objective reality, differing from creative imagination by denoting cognitive pathology, self-deception, or sensory distortion.
groups.desc_zh: 指体验脱离客观现实的感知或信念，与健康的艺术想象不同，强调认知失调、感官错位或自欺欺人。
groups.nuance_en: misperceive: wrongly interpreting an actual sensory signal (intent / risk) · envision: conceiving a vivid future possibility in the mind (future / success) · delude: misleading one's own or another's mind into false beliefs (oneself / voter) · fantasize: indulging in pleasant, unrealistic daydreams (wealth / romance) · hallucinate: experiencing vivid sensory phenomena with no external stimulus (symptoms / figures)
groups.nuance_zh: misperceive: 对原本存在的信号产生主观误判 (intent / risk) · envision: 在脑海中构想或展望未来的可能性 (future / success) · delude: 陷入自欺或执迷于荒谬假象 (oneself / voter) · fantasize: 沉溺于不切实际的美好空想 (wealth / romance) · hallucinate: 在缺乏外界物理刺激下产生逼真幻视幻听 (symptoms / figures)

groups.name: Halt & Freeze · 停滞与僵住 (Freeze, Seize up, Petrify)
groups.tip: 骤然止步定格不动

items.def_zh: 呆住；（因惊吓等）僵住不动
items.def_en: Become suddenly motionless with fear, astonishment, or shock
items.ex_en: She felt her body freeze the moment she heard footsteps on the stairs.
items.ex_zh: 一听到楼梯上传来脚步声，她整个人瞬间吓得僵住了。
items.ex2_en: The sudden cold blast froze the delicate garden roses overnight.
items.ex2_zh: 突如其来的寒流在一夜之间冻坏了花园里娇嫩的玫瑰花。

items.def_en: To stop moving suddenly and become completely still, typically through fear or shock.
items.ex_en: The hikers stood frozen in complete silence as a grizzly bear crossed ahead.
items.ex_zh: 当一头灰熊从前方经过时，徒步者们呆若木鸡，鸦雀无声。

items.def_zh: （机械）卡住锁死；（肌肉）抽搐僵死
items.def_en: Suddenly stick or seize into an unmovable position without the ability to turn
items.ex_en: The front brakes suddenly locked up, sending the bicycle skidding across the asphalt.
items.ex_zh: 前刹车突然卡死，导致自行车在沥青路面上滑倒甩了出去。

items.def_en: (of machinery, muscles, or joints) Stop moving or functioning properly due to friction or jamming
items.ex_en: Without enough motor oil, the old tractor engine began to seize up completely.
items.ex_zh: 因为缺少机油，这台老旧拖拉机的发动机开始彻底卡死失灵。

items.def_en: (usually passive) Render someone completely motionless or paralyzed with horror or extreme fear
items.ex_en: A terrible scream petrified the villagers, rooting them firmly to the muddy ground.
items.ex_zh: 一声凄厉的惨叫让村民们吓得呆若木鸡，双腿僵在泥泞的土地上动弹不得。
items.ex2_en: The ancient fallen trees petrified under centuries of volcanic mineral ash deposits.
items.ex2_zh: 古老的倒卧树木在数个世纪的火山矿物灰烬沉积下石化成了化石。

groups.summary_en: Denotes an immediate and involuntary cessation of movement, action, or mechanical operation, most frequently triggered by acute fear, shock, temperature drop, or severe friction.
groups.summary_zh: 因恐惧、震惊或机械故障而瞬间完全静止、僵滞无法动弹。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an abrupt and rigid cessation of physical motion or function, contrasting with gradual slowing down by highlighting a sudden, shock-induced, or mechanical paralysis.
groups.desc_zh: 指机械运转或肉体动作因惊吓、低温或干涉而骤然僵化停滞，与渐进减速不同，强调突发性卡死或动弹不得。
groups.nuance_en: freeze: stopping completely still in posture or status (movement / asset) · frozen: fixed rigidly in an immobilized state (frame / face) · lock up: mechanical components jamming into immobility (brakes / engine) · seize up: jamming solid due to overheating, friction, or panic (motor / joints) · petrify: paralyzing completely through absolute terror (fear / horror)
groups.nuance_zh: freeze: 因警觉受惊而刹那定格静止 (movement / asset) · frozen: 维持僵硬冻结的状态 (frame / face) · lock up: 机械结构相互锁死卡牢 (brakes / engine) · seize up: 因过热、缺油摩擦或恐慌而彻底咬死停转 (motor / joints) · petrify: 因极度惊骇而吓得宛如石化不能动弹 (fear / horror)

groups.name: Halt & Immobilize · 阻滞与固定 (Immobilize, Paralyze, Pin down)
groups.tip: 迫使物体停止移动或固定

items.def_en: To suddenly stop moving completely, often through fear or shock, or to order someone to halt all motion
items.ex_en: The armed officer shouted at the intruder to freeze and drop the weapon.
items.ex_zh: 持枪警官冲着入侵者大喝一声，命令其不许动并放下武器。
items.ex2_en: Severe Arctic winds will freeze the shallow lake solid within a week.
items.ex2_zh: 猛烈的北极寒风会在一周之内将浅水湖彻底冻结封冻。

items.def_en: To hold someone or something firmly so that they cannot move, or to suppress enemy movement with gunfire
items.ex_en: The wrestler managed to pin down his opponent firmly until the bell rang.
items.ex_zh: 摔跤手牢牢压制住对手使其动弹不得，直到铃声响起。

items.def_en: To prevent an aircraft, ship, or person from moving or leaving a place
items.ex_en: Severe winter blizzards forced the airline to ground all outgoing domestic flights immediately.
items.ex_zh: 恶劣的冬季暴风雪迫使航空公司立即停飞所有离港国内航班。

items.def_zh: 使不动，使固定；使瘫痪，使丧失机能
items.def_en: 1. To prevent someone, a limb, or an object from moving. 2. To make a vehicle, system, or organization unable to function normally.
items.ex_en: Paramedics used a rigid splint to immobilize the skier's severely fractured leg.
items.ex_zh: 医护人员使用坚硬的夹板将滑雪者严重骨折的腿固定住。

items.def_en: To cause a person, animal, or part of the body to lose the ability to move, or to bring an activity or system to a complete halt
items.ex_en: The prolonged transit strike threatened to paralyze the entire city's commuter rail system.
items.ex_zh: 旷日持久的交通罢工可能导致整个城市的通勤铁路系统陷入瘫痪。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to completely arresting physical motion or rendering an entity unable to act or move. Nuances range from mechanical restraint and medical fixation to systemic crippling.
groups.summary_zh: 使身体、物体或系统完全失去活动能力或行动自由。
groups.desc_en: Refers to externally depriving an agent or asset of the capacity to move or operate, differing from passive rest by implying forcible restraint, technical disabling, or strategic suppression.
groups.desc_zh: 指自外向内剥夺行动者或资产的移动及运转能力，与休整不同，强调强制性禁锢、技术性瘫痪或战略压制。
groups.nuance_en: freeze: legally or procedurally halting transactions and mobility (funds / assets) · pin down: physically holding someone to the ground or neutralizing maneuver (target / flank) · ground: prohibiting aircraft or ships from leaving port or air (flight / fleet) · immobilize: preventing physical locomotion through splints, locks, or disabling blows (patient / vehicle) · paralyze: causing complete functional incapacity across an entire system (transport / limb)
groups.nuance_zh: freeze: 依法律或指令冻结资产流转 (funds / assets) · pin down: 将敌方死死压制固定于原处难以动弹 (target / flank) · ground: 下令禁飞或强行滞港受阻 (flight / fleet) · immobilize: 通过器械夹板或技术手段彻底封死活动能力 (patient / vehicle) · paralyze: 致使整个神经系统或社会枢纽陷入彻底瘫痪 (transport / limb)

groups.name: Ham & Grandstand · 刻意卖弄与做作表演 (Ham up, Grandstand, Play to the gallery)
groups.tip: 登台演出或浮夸做作

items.def_zh: 昂首阔步；卖弄做作地走动
items.def_en: to walk or move about with a proud, theatrical, or conceited air to draw attention
items.ex_en: He loved to strut down the hallway whenever he wore his expensive suit.
items.ex_zh: 每当穿上那套昂贵的名牌西装，他就喜欢在走廊里大模大样地昂首阔步。

items.def_zh: 夸张地表演；做作地表现
items.def_en: to deliberately exaggerate one's performance, gestures, or emotions to entertain
items.ex_en: The actor decided to ham up his comical death scene for cheap laughs.
items.ex_zh: 那名演员决定夸张做作地演完滑稽的死亡戏，以此博取观众廉价的笑声。

items.def_zh: 迎合大众；迎合低级趣味
items.def_en: to behave in an exaggerated or sensational way solely to win cheap popularity from a crowd
items.ex_en: The ambitious mayor chose to play to the gallery rather than pursue reform.
items.ex_zh: 这位野心勃勃的市长选择迎合大众低级趣味，而非推行切实的改革。

items.def_en: (informal, often ham it up) to overact or exaggerate emotions in an artificial, theatrical way
items.ex_en: He tended to ham throughout the second act, waving his arms wildly onstage.
items.ex_zh: 他在第二幕里表演尤为过火，在舞台上极为浮夸地挥舞着双臂。

items.def_zh: 哗众取宠；卖弄以讨好观众
items.def_en: to conduct oneself or speak theatrically in order to impress onlookers and gain approval
items.ex_en: The senator used his committee questioning purely to grandstand for national cable news.
items.ex_zh: 这位参议员利用委员会质询的机会大肆卖弄，纯粹是为了在全国有线电视新闻上博人眼球。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on performers or speakers purposely exaggerating their actions, playing for laughs, or ostentatiously performing to pander to a crowd.
groups.summary_zh: 指演员或发言人故意夸大动作或表情，迎合受众以博取眼球或掌声。
groups.desc_en: Denotes ostentatious, theatrical self-display designed to solicit uncritical audience applause, contrasting with genuine performance through its deliberate lack of subtlety.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过过火、戏剧化的做作表现博取掌声与关注，与真诚表演相比带有明显的虚浮炫耀与缺乏自制。
groups.nuance_en: strut: arrogant physical parading (feathers / pride / arrogance) · ham up: deliberate overacting or exaggeration for effect (performance / scene / grief) · play to the gallery: pandering to cheap, lowbrow tastes (audience / crowd / voters) · grandstand: showy political or rhetorical posturing (politicians / debate / hearing)
groups.nuance_zh: strut: 趾高气昂地大摇大摆踱步 (feathers / pride / arrogance) · ham up: 故意夸张表演以博眼球 (performance / scene / grief) · play to the gallery: 迎合底层受众的低俗趣味 (audience / crowd / voters) · grandstand: 哗众取宠的政治或公开表态 (politicians / debate / hearing)

groups.name: Happen by Chance · 偶然发生 (Befall, Transpire, Crop Up)
groups.tip: 机缘巧合偶然发生

items.def_en: To happen, develop, or come into being unexpectedly or naturally
items.ex_en: Historians still debate how such an extraordinary geopolitical shift could come about peacefully.
items.ex_zh: 历史学家们仍在探讨这样一场非同寻常的地缘政治巨变何以和平产生。

items.def_en: To appear or occur suddenly and unexpectedly, especially an issue or topic
items.ex_en: Several unexpected technical glitches crop up whenever we launch a major software update.
items.ex_zh: 每当我们发布大型软件更新时，总会意外冒出几个技术小故障。

items.def_zh: 碰巧发生，偶然发生；冒险一试
items.def_en: 1. To happen by chance. 2. To take the risk of doing something.
items.ex_en: I chanced to meet an old classmate while wandering through the busy market.
items.ex_zh: 在穿过熙熙攘攘的集市时，我碰巧遇上了一位老同学。

items.def_en: (formal) To take place or occur, often gradually coming to light
items.ex_en: It soon transpired that the executive had fabricated his credentials on his resume.
items.ex_zh: 不久事实便浮出水面，原来这位主管在简历上伪造了自己的资历。

items.def_en: (literary) (of something bad or unexpected) To happen to someone
items.ex_en: The aging monarch feared that great misfortune would befall his fractured kingdom soon.
items.ex_zh: 年迈的君王担忧巨大的灾祸不久便会降临到他四分五裂的王国上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate events materializing serendipitously, unexpectedly, or without deliberate human orchestration. They contrast planned outcomes with accidental or coincidental occurrences.
groups.summary_zh: 指事件出乎意料、偶然发生或突如其来地降临与冒头。
groups.desc_en: Denotes events coming to pass fortuitously or unexpectedly without deliberate human orchestration, contrasting with purposeful causation.
groups.desc_zh: 指非人为预谋、出于偶然或不可测机缘而发生，与有意策划或合乎规律的发展形成对照。
groups.nuance_en: come about: gradual unfolding into reality (change / realization / crisis) · crop up: sudden unexpected popping up (issues / problems / names) · chance: purely accidental happening (meeting / coincidence) · transpire: coming to light or unfolding over time (events / truth / secret) · befall: fateful, usually adverse descent onto someone (misfortune / disaster / tragedy)
groups.nuance_zh: come about: 逐渐演变产生或实现 (change / realization / crisis) · crop up: 突然冒出或节外生枝 (issues / problems / names) · chance: 纯属偶然碰巧发生 (meeting / coincidence) · transpire: 事情逐渐显露或自然发生 (events / truth / secret) · befall: 厄运、灾祸不幸降临于某人 (misfortune / disaster / tragedy)

groups.name: Harass & Haze · 欺凌与折磨 (Bully, Torment, Persecute)
groups.tip: 团体内对新人恶整与霸凌

items.def_en: To repeatedly treat someone unkindly or criticize them unfairly
items.ex_en: Why do the older kids always pick on him during recess?
items.ex_zh: 为什么大孩子们课间总爱找他茬、欺负他？

items.def_en: To hurt, frighten, or compel someone weaker into doing something
items.ex_en: Older boys would constantly bully smaller children on their daily walk from school.
items.ex_zh: 高年级男生常在放学路上仗势欺凌弱小的孩子。

items.def_zh: （恶作剧式）折磨，霸凌（新生或新成员）；（使）变朦胧
items.def_en: 1. (North American) To subject new members or recruits to humiliating, harsh, or abusive initiation tasks. 2. To become or make hazy.
items.ex_en: Senior members secretly planned to haze the new fraternity pledges after dark.
items.ex_zh: 高年级成员暗中策划在天黑后对联谊会的新生进行苛刻恶劣的入会折磨。

items.def_en: To inflict severe physical or mental suffering on someone repeatedly
items.ex_en: Memories of the bitter betrayal continued to torment the lonely general for years.
items.ex_zh: 那场惨痛背叛的回忆多年来持续折磨着这位孤单的将军。

items.def_en: To treat someone cruelly and unfairly, especially because of their beliefs, race, or group status
items.ex_en: The authoritarian regime sought to persecute anyone who dared to express political dissent.
items.ex_zh: 该独裁政权企图迫害任何敢于表达不同政见的人。

groups.summary_en: Captures systematic intimidation, cruel initiation rituals, and coercive social torment directed at vulnerable or subordinate individuals.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过恃强凌弱、残酷虐待或苛待新人施行的人身与精神折磨。
groups.desc_en: Denotes deliberate, asymmetric infliction of distress, intimidation, or torment upon a weaker party, contrasting with fair competition or mutual dispute.
groups.desc_zh: 指凭借不对等的力量对弱者施加持续的欺侮、身心折磨或系统性迫害，与公平竞争或互有攻防的冲突不同。
groups.nuance_en: pick on: petty targeting of an individual (weaker child / newcomer / scapegoat) · bully: coercive physical or emotional intimidation (subordinates / classmates / victims) · haze: ritualized abuse in initiation rites (recruits / pledges / freshmen) · torment: persistent infliction of mental/physical agony (victim / soul / prisoners) · persecute: systematic, often ideological or religious oppression (minorities / dissidents / believers)
groups.nuance_zh: pick on: 挑软柿子捏、找茬挑剔 (weaker child / newcomer / scapegoat) · bully: 仗势凌人、恃强凌弱 (subordinates / classmates / victims) · haze: 入会或迎新时的恶性体罚与整人 (recruits / pledges / freshmen) · torment: 肉体或精神上的长期折磨 (victim / soul / prisoners) · persecute: 系统性、往往基于信仰或身份的政治宗教迫害 (minorities / dissidents / believers)

groups.name: Harass & Hound · 追逼与催逼 (Chevy, Hound, Chivvy)
groups.tip: 在后追逼围堵捕获

items.def_en: To persistently attack, trouble, or harass someone with repeated demands
items.ex_en: Guerilla bands continued to harry the retreating imperial army along the narrow pass.
items.ex_zh: 游击队沿着狭窄的隘口持续袭扰正在撤退的帝国军队。

items.def_en: (+ into/along) To urge or badger someone repeatedly to do something or move faster
items.ex_en: She had to chivvy her reluctant children along so they would catch school.
items.ex_zh: 她不得不一路催促磨蹭的孩子们快走，以免赶不上校车。

items.def_en: (+ into/with) To repeatedly ask, bother, or urge someone into doing something
items.ex_en: Reporters continued to badger the spokesperson with questions regarding the impending corporate scandal.
items.ex_zh: 记者们不断就即将爆发的公司丑闻向发言人连环发问、纠缠不休。

items.def_en: To pursue relentlessly or harass someone persistently without letting them rest
items.ex_en: Aggressive creditors began to hound the bankrupt businessman day and night for repayment.
items.ex_zh: 咄咄逼人的债权人开始日夜追讨纠缠，逼迫破产的商人偿还欠款。

items.def_en: (British dated) To chase, harass, or nag someone persistently.
items.ex_en: The supervisor would chevy his team members constantly about meeting tight project deadlines.
items.ex_zh: 主管总是为了赶紧迫的项目截止日期而没完没了地催促手下的队员。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on persistent chasing, badgering, or nagging someone to move them along, coerce them into action, or exhaust them through constant pursuit.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过不停追赶、催促或骚扰让人疲于奔命。
groups.desc_en: Denotes relentless, nagging pursuit or pressure aimed at wearing someone down to extract action, contrasting with a single straightforward demand.
groups.desc_zh: 指穷追不舍、软磨硬泡或反复催逼以迫使对方屈服就范，与单次的干脆要求形成鲜明对比。
groups.nuance_en: harry: wearing down through continual raids or pressure (troops / defenders / debtors) · chivvy: repeated gentle or petty urging to hurry along (children / staff / crowd) · badger: persistent, irritating pestering with questions or requests (witness / parents / officials) · hound: relentless tracking and pursuit without respite (suspect / debtor / celebrities)
groups.nuance_zh: harry: 连番侵扰、消耗性骚扰使之精疲力竭 (troops / defenders / debtors) · chivvy: 絮絮叨叨地催促赶快行动 (children / staff / crowd) · badger: 纠缠不休、反复烦扰索求 (witness / parents / officials) · hound: 像猎犬般穷追猛打、围追堵截 (suspect / debtor / celebrities)

groups.name: Harbinger & Public Preannouncement · 昭示来临与隆重宣示 (Herald, Usher in, Proclaim)
groups.tip: 提前发出预兆或象征未来事件

items.def_en: To mark or cause the beginning of a new period, era, or epoch
items.ex_en: The breakthrough treaty promised to usher in an unprecedented era of global peace.
items.ex_zh: 这项突破性条约有望开启一个前所未有的全球和平新时代。

items.def_zh: 预示……的来临；宣布，宣传；公开称赞
items.def_en: to be a sign that something important is about to happen; to announce or praise something publicly
items.ex_en: The arrival of migratory cranes heralds the return of warm spring weather.
items.ex_zh: 候鸟白鹤的到来预示着温暖春季的回归。

items.def_en: To announce formally, publicly, or unmistakably that something noteworthy is occurring
items.ex_en: The town crier rang his bell to proclaim the coronation of the king.
items.ex_zh: 传令官敲响铜铃，向公众郑重昭告国王的加冕。

items.def_en: To announce or celebrate an impending arrival or achievement loudly and proudly
items.ex_en: The marketing department began to trumpet the new product as an absolute triumph.
items.ex_zh: 市场部开始大肆吹嘘这款新产品，称其为前所未有的重大胜利。

items.def_en: To signal the immediate approach or dawn of a major event or seasonal change
items.ex_en: A crisp chill in the evening breeze harbinger the arrival of early autumn.
items.ex_zh: 晚风中透出的丝丝清冷，预示着初秋的悄然降临。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on serving as a momentous sign of incoming change, major historical shifts, or grand arrivals, as well as publicly championing or acclaiming that advent.
groups.summary_zh: 标志重大变革或历史纪元的到来，或对其来临进行隆重、显要的公开宣告与昭示。
groups.desc_en: Denotes serving as an unmistakable advance sign or formal public fanfare that initiates an era, contrasting with silent, unnoticed beginnings.
groups.desc_zh: 指作为显著先兆预示重大事件，或大张旗鼓地宣告新时代的开端，与悄无声息的发生截然不同。
groups.nuance_en: usher in: ceremoniously leading into a new epoch (new era / dawn / revolution) · herald: signaling the imminent arrival or triumph of something (arrival / breakthrough / change) · proclaim: official, authoritative declaration (sovereignty / victory / republic) · trumpet: boastful, loud public broadcasting (achievements / success / virtue) · harbinger: portending as a forerunner or early omen (spring / disaster / doom)
groups.nuance_zh: usher in: 领入、开启崭新时代或阶段 (new era / dawn / revolution) · herald: 作为先驱预示重大事物到来 (arrival / breakthrough / change) · proclaim: 庄严正式地向公众宣告 (sovereignty / victory / republic) · trumpet: 大吹大擂、高调宣扬 (achievements / success / virtue) · harbinger: 作为前兆预示（吉凶）来临 (spring / disaster / doom)

groups.name: Harbor Bitterness & Resentment · 愤恨不平与深怀怨怼 (Resent, Chafe, Bristle)
groups.tip: 因不公而长期怀恨或心生不满

items.def_en: (+ from/under) Feel continuing psychological pain, indignation, or wounded pride
items.ex_en: He continued to smart from the humiliating public rebuke delivered by his boss.
items.ex_zh: 老板当众做出的羞辱性斥责让他依然感到自尊受挫、刺痛愤懑。

items.def_en: To feel bitter, angry, or aggrieved about something or someone, especially due to perceived unfairness.
items.ex_en: She began to resent her colleague for constantly taking credit for joint projects.
items.ex_zh: 她开始对这位同事心生怨恨，因为对方总是霸占合作项目的功劳。

items.def_en: (+ at) React with defensive irritation or anger when feeling provoked or slighted
items.ex_en: The proud author tended to bristle at any mild criticism of his prose.
items.ex_zh: 那位自视甚高的作家对哪怕丝毫不敬的文风批评都会忿忿不平地动怒。

items.def_zh: 强抑怒火，内心情绪翻腾
items.def_en: Contain intense, agitated anger and inward resentment that threatens to boil over
items.ex_en: He sat quietly across the conference room, struggling to seethe with silent indignation.
items.ex_zh: 他静静地坐在会议室对面，极力压抑着翻腾的无名怒火。

items.def_en: (+ at/under) Feel irritable, restless, or resentful under restrictions or annoying conditions
items.ex_en: Eager young recruits soon began to chafe under the academy's relentless physical restrictions.
items.ex_zh: 热血的新学员不久便开始对军校严苛无休的身体限制感到焦躁不平。
items.ex2_en: The stiff leather collar chafed the poor puppy's neck during long walks.
items.ex2_zh: 坚硬的皮革项圈在长时间散步时磨痛了可怜小狗的脖子。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures deep-seated, persistent indignation felt toward an injury, unequal treatment, or an enforced condition perceived as deeply unfair.
groups.summary_zh: 对不公待遇或受制于人深感委屈、愤懑与怨恨难平。
groups.desc_en: Denotes internalizing emotional hurt or indignity that festers into persistent grievance, contrasting with transient anger or vocal catharsis.
groups.desc_zh: 指因受到轻蔑或不公而将羞辱内化，形成持久隐忍的发酵怨怼，与转瞬即逝的愤怒或痛快宣泄相对。
groups.nuance_en: smart: feeling acute, lingering sting from wounded pride (reproof / defeat / insult) · resent: deep-seated, enduring bitterness toward perceived unfairness (interference / privilege / intrusion) · bristle: sudden defensive agitation or indignation (criticism / accusation / suggestion) · seethe: inwardly boiling with suppressed, violent rage (anger / fury / indignation) · chafe: growing restless and irritated under constraint (rules / restrictions / delay)
groups.nuance_zh: smart: 因自尊受挫而感到隐隐作痛 (reproof / defeat / insult) · resent: 对不公待遇抱有根深蒂固的愤懑 (interference / privilege / intrusion) · bristle: 被激怒后如刺猬般立起防备 (criticism / accusation / suggestion) · seethe: 内心怒火中烧、暗自咬牙切齿 (anger / fury / indignation) · chafe: 在束缚或规训下烦躁不耐 (rules / restrictions / delay)

groups.name: Harbour & Conceal · 窝藏与庇护 (Shield, Protect, Conceal)
groups.tip: 提供住所或掩护避难

items.def_en: To store or hide someone or something safely in a secret place
items.ex_en: He managed to stash away a small bundle of cash beneath floorboards.
items.ex_zh: 他成功在地板下面秘密藏匿了一小捆现金。

items.def_zh: 收留，接纳（投宿或避难者）
items.def_en: To allow someone to stay in your home when they need refuge or have nowhere else to go
items.ex_en: The kind villagers agreed to take in the lost wanderers during storm.
items.ex_zh: 善良的村民们同意在暴风雨期间收留这几位迷路的旅人。

items.def_en: To stay in a safe place so that the police or enemies cannot find you
items.ex_en: The fugitive had been hiding out in an abandoned warehouse for weeks.
items.ex_zh: 逃犯在一家废弃仓库里潜藏了数周。

items.def_zh: 庇护，遮蔽（免受惩罚或追查）
items.def_en: To protect someone from blame, punishment, or scrutiny by hiding or defending them
items.ex_en: Corrupt officials attempted to shield the wealthy developer from impending legal prosecution.
items.ex_zh: 腐败官员企图庇护那位富商开发商，使其免受即将到来的法律起诉。

items.def_zh: 庇护，窝藏（罪犯）；心怀，怀有（情感或想法）；携带（细菌等）
items.def_en: 1. to give shelter, protection, or refuge to someone, especially a criminal. 2. to keep a thought, feeling, or grudge secretly in one's mind.
items.ex_en: Authorities warned that anyone caught trying to harbour the fugitive would face prison.
items.ex_zh: 当局警告说，任何被发现企图窝藏在逃通缉犯的人都将面临牢狱之灾。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe giving illicit or protective refuge to fugitives, criminals, or forbidden entities, often involving secrecy and active concealment from authorities.
groups.summary_zh: 指暗中向逃犯或危险人物提供庇护、藏匿以逃避追捕的非法或遮掩性保护。
groups.desc_en: Denotes providing illicit shelter or secretive refuge to persons or dangerous feelings, contrasting with neutral, open accommodation.
groups.desc_zh: 指为逃犯、违禁物或危险意图提供隐匿庇护，与正当公开的招待或包容形成对照。
groups.nuance_en: stash away: secretly storing physical items in a safe cache (cash / loot / supplies) · take in: providing compassionate or deceptive shelter (refugees / strays / lodgers) · hide out: staying in deliberate concealment from authorities (fugitives / criminals / gang) · shield: placing oneself between a target and harm/detection (suspect / eyes / truth) · harbour: giving illicit sanctuary to a fugitive or holding illicit thoughts (criminal / doubts / grudges)
groups.nuance_zh: stash away: 隐秘存放违禁物或财物 (cash / loot / supplies) · take in: 接纳收留受难者（亦含收留庇护） (refugees / strays / lodgers) · hide out: 藏匿潜伏以躲避缉捕 (fugitives / criminals / gang) · shield: 挺身遮挡以使之免受惩处或揭露 (suspect / eyes / truth) · harbour: 窝藏逃犯或心怀恶意险念 (criminal / doubts / grudges)

groups.name: Harden & Desensitize · 结茧变硬与麻木 (Callous, Harden, Inure)
groups.tip: 质地变硬或生茧变钝

items.def_zh: 变硬；使（态度、心肠）坚硬冷酷
items.def_en: To become firmer or less flexible, or to make someone less sympathetic, sensitive, or emotional
items.ex_en: Years of working in the juvenile court system served to harden her emotional outlook.
items.ex_zh: 在少儿法庭系统多年的工作经历使她的心肠和处世态度变得冷硬麻木。
items.ex2_en: The wet clay mixture hardened under the hot afternoon sun into bricks.
items.ex2_zh: 湿润的黏土混合物在午后炽热的阳光下硬化成了砖块。

items.def_en: to make or become hard and thick, like a callus, or to become hardened and unfeeling
items.ex_en: Decades of manual toil callous his broad palms into rough, leathery surfaces.
items.ex_zh: 数十年的体力劳作让他的手掌布满老茧，变得粗糙而硬实。
items.ex2_en: His hardworking hands calloused over years of heavy farm labour in fields.
items.ex2_zh: 经过在田间多年繁重的农作，他勤劳的双手中长满了厚茧。

items.def_en: To make someone less likely to feel shock or distress when exposed to upsetting things
items.ex_en: Frequent exposure to violent online media can desensitize young viewers to real suffering.
items.ex_zh: 频繁接触网络暴力媒体会使年轻观众对现实中的痛苦感到麻木。

items.def_zh: 使习惯于（痛苦或困难）；使适应
items.def_en: (+ to) To accustom someone to something unpleasant so that they no longer respond sensitively
items.ex_en: Years in the arid borderlands served to inure the soldiers to chronic physical hardship.
items.ex_zh: 在干旱边境驻守的岁月让士兵们习惯了长期的肉体苦难。

items.def_zh: 使下定决心；使硬起心肠
items.def_en: (steel oneself) To mentally prepare oneself to be strong, unfeeling, or resolute before a difficult task
items.ex_en: She had to steel herself before stepping into the cold, silent hospital room.
items.ex_zh: 踏入冰冷沉寂的病房之前，她不得不硬起心肠。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on skin thickening through friction or, metaphorically, human feelings and sensibilities becoming progressively unfeeling, cold, and immune to suffering.
groups.summary_zh: 指表皮因磨损变硬增厚，或心理情感逐步麻木、对苦难无动于衷。
groups.desc_en: Denotes progressive psychological or emotional toughening through sustained exposure to suffering, contrasting with natural sensitivity or sudden trauma.
groups.desc_zh: 指因长期接触苦难或严酷环境而变得麻木不仁、坚不可摧，与原生的敏感脆弱或突发应激相对。
groups.nuance_en: harden: rendering tough, unyielding, or devoid of sympathy (heart / resolve / stance) · callous: forming an unfeeling, protective crust against emotion (conscience / attitude / hands) · desensitize: systematically blunting perceptual or emotional responsiveness (viewers / nerves / soldiers) · inure: habituating someone to endure pain or privation as normal (hardship / poverty / cold) · steel: deliberately bracing one's resolve against impending ordeal (nerves / oneself / will)
groups.nuance_zh: harden: 使心灵冷硬坚决或失去同情 (heart / resolve / stance) · callous: 像起老茧般变得铁石心肠 (conscience / attitude / hands) · desensitize: 使神经或情感逐渐脱敏麻木 (viewers / nerves / soldiers) · inure: 习惯于逆境痛苦而变得麻木耐受 (hardship / poverty / cold) · steel: 为迎战考验而咬牙下定决心 (nerves / oneself / will)

groups.name: Harden & Ossify · 骨化与僵化 (Ossify, Fossilize, Petrify)
groups.tip: 物理骨化变硬或思想僵化

items.def_en: To make or become rigid, strictly unbending, or unresponsive to external conditions
items.ex_en: Excessive bureaucratic oversight threatens to rigidify the institute's once innovative research practices.
items.ex_zh: 过度的官僚监管恐将使该机构曾经充满创新的研究实践趋于僵化。
items.ex2_en: The institution's administrative procedures rigidified noticeably after the leadership change.
items.ex2_zh: 领导层更换后，该机构的管理流程明显变得僵化死板。

items.def_en: To harden by the deposition of calcium salts, or to become inflexible and unchanging
items.ex_en: Ancient grief seemed to calcify his tender heart into unyielding emotional stone.
items.ex_zh: 昔日的悲痛似乎将他柔软的心钙化成了坚硬顽固的顽石。
items.ex2_en: Damaged artery walls will calcify gradually without proper medical intervention and care.
items.ex2_zh: 若无适当的医疗干预与护理，受损的动脉壁会逐渐发生钙化。

items.def_en: To change organic matter into a stony substance, or to render someone or something immobile and rigid
items.ex_en: Centuries of mineral-rich water helped to petrify the fallen branches into stone.
items.ex_zh: 富含矿物质的流水历经数百年，将落下的树枝石化成了岩石。
items.ex2_en: The terrified campers petrified with utter shock as the bear approached them.
items.ex2_zh: 当狗熊靠近时，吓坏了的露营者因极度恐惧而僵在原地。

items.def_en: To become or cause to become a fossil, or to become fixed, rigid, and incapable of change
items.ex_en: Without fresh perspectives, the committee's outdated ideologies will fossilize into dogma.
items.ex_zh: 若无新鲜视角，该委员会过时的意识形态必将僵化为教条。
items.ex2_en: Extreme heat and mineral pressure fossilized the prehistoric dinosaur skeleton over millions.
items.ex2_zh: 极端的温度和矿物压力在数百万年间将这具史前恐龙骨骼石化了。

items.def_zh: 骨化，硬化；（思想、体制等）僵化
items.def_en:
1. to turn bone-hard, or convert tissue into bone
2. (disapproving) to become hardened, rigid, and conventional, opposing change
items.ex_en: Decades of political isolation caused the state's cultural institutions to ossify completely.
items.ex_zh: 数十年的政治孤立导致该国的文化体制彻底僵化。
items.ex2_en: Rigid dogmatic beliefs ossify young minds, preventing creative critical thinking from flourishing.
items.ex2_zh: 僵化的教条思想会让年轻的心灵僵死，阻碍创造性批判思维的发展。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe organic tissues turning into stone or bone, used predominantly in a pejorative sense for habits, attitudes, or systems growing inflexibly rigid and resistant to change.
groups.summary_zh: 描述机体变硬，或思想、体制变得顽固僵化、丧失适应力的过程。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the pathological transition of flexible structures or ideas into rigid, unadaptable mineral-like states, contrasting with fluid growth or intentional stability.
groups.desc_zh: 指机体、制度或观念由灵活蜕化为顽固僵死的石化状态，与富有生机的适应性或正常的稳固性相对。
groups.nuance_en: rigidify: making structurally or politically unbending (dogma / borders / rules) · calcify: hardening through mineral deposits; becoming stubbornly settled (tissue / thinking / bureaucracy) · petrify: paralyzing through sheer terror, or turning literally to stone (witness / crowd / victims) · fossilize: preserving outdated forms so they cannot evolve (institutions / ideas / language) · ossify: transforming into static, inflexible bone-like stagnation (bureaucracy / minds / traditions)
groups.nuance_zh: rigidify: 使结构或规章彻底僵板不可动摇 (dogma / borders / rules) · calcify: 钙化；使思想或组织僵固不灵 (tissue / thinking / bureaucracy) · petrify: 因极度惊吓而吓呆木化 (witness / crowd / victims) · fossilize: 化石化；使陈规旧俗凝固不再演进 (institutions / ideas / language) · ossify: 骨化；使体制或观念彻底丧失活力与弹性 (bureaucracy / minds / traditions)

groups.name: Harp & Dwell On · 絮叨与纠缠 (Harp, Dwell, Ramble)
groups.tip: 喋喋不休反复弹老调

items.def_en: To talk incessantly and tiresome about a specific topic
items.ex_en: Please do not go on about your old boyfriend during our dinner tonight.
items.ex_zh: 今晚我们吃饭时，请别再没完没了地念叨你前男友了。

items.def_en: To talk or write at great length in an aimless, unstructured, and confused way
items.ex_en: Nervous speakers often ramble from one disconnected thought to another without conclusion.
items.ex_zh: 紧张的演讲者往往会信马由缰地东拉西扯，毫无定论。

items.def_en: To think, speak, or write obsessively or at excessive length about something unpleasant
items.ex_en: It is entirely unproductive to dwell on past mistakes that cannot be undone.
items.ex_zh: 老是挂怀无法挽回的过往错误是完全徒劳无益的。

items.raw_cluster: 唠叨与反复诉说 Harp & Ramble
items.def_zh: 喋喋不休，反复唠叨（与on/upon连用）；弹竖琴
items.def_en: 1. (harp on/upon) To talk or complain repeatedly and tediously about the same subject. 2. To play the harp.
items.ex_en: He will constantly harp on minor budget errors during every single meeting.
items.ex_zh: 他在每次会议上都会对微不足道的预算差错喋喋不休。

items.def_en: To argue, elaborate, or dwell upon a point excessively and tediously
items.ex_en: There is truly no necessity to belabor this obvious point any further.
items.ex_zh: 确实完全没有必要再去过分赘述这个显而易见的观点。

groups.summary_en: This frame describes perseverative and tedious communication, specifically the habit of endlessly returning to, rehashing, or wandering around the same grievance or topic.
groups.summary_zh: 强调反反复复谈论同一琐事或旧怨，冗长啰嗦且令人生厌。
groups.desc_en: Denotes obsessively reiterating a single topic or grievance to the point of tedium, contrasting with constructive discourse or concise recapitulation.
groups.desc_zh: 指对某一话题或陈旧嫌隙咬住不放、絮叨反复纠缠，与建设性对话或简明重申形成对比。
groups.nuance_en: go on about: speaking endlessly and irritably about a pet subject (grievance / success / details) · ramble: wandering aimlessly through speech without direction (speaker / talk / letter) · dwell on: lingering mentally or verbally over distressing points (past / mistakes / failures) · harp: monotonously and tiresomely repeating the same complaint (theme / strings / faults) · belabor: over-arguing or excessively hammering a point past necessity (point / issue / argument)
groups.nuance_zh: go on about: 没完没了、喋喋不休地谈论 (grievance / success / details) · ramble: 语无伦次、东拉西扯地漫谈 (speaker / talk / letter) · dwell on: 沉溺或纠缠于消极往事 (past / mistakes / failures) · harp: 像弹单调弦一样反复唠叨抱怨 (theme / strings / faults) · belabor: 过分着力、过火反复推敲解释 (point / issue / argument)

groups.name: Harvest & Gather · 采摘与收割 (Harvest, Glean, Garner)
groups.tip: 付出辛劳换取最终成果

items.def_en: To gather leftover grain after reaping, or collect information painstakingly in small amounts
items.ex_en: Historians must patiently glean fragments of truth from forgotten diaries and letters.
items.ex_zh: 历史学家必须耐心地从被遗忘的日记和信件中点滴搜集真实的蛛丝马迹。

items.def_en: To bring in and store harvested crops or collected items
items.ex_en: Before autumn frosts arrived, the farmhands worked swiftly to gather in the harvest.
items.ex_zh: 在秋霜来临之前，农工们迅速协作将庄稼收拢入仓。

items.def_en: To collect crops, fruit, or agricultural produce from fields or gardens
items.ex_en: Local vintners expect to harvest exceptionally sweet grapes after this hot summer.
items.ex_zh: 经历炎夏之后，当地酿酒师预计将采收到格外甘甜的葡萄。

items.def_en: To collect or accumulate something valuable through sustained effort
items.ex_en: The reform proposal managed to garner overwhelming bipartisan support in the senate.
items.ex_zh: 这项改革提案成功在参议院积攒并赢得了两党的压倒性支持。

items.def_zh: 收获，获得（成果或报应）；收割（庄稼）
items.def_en: 1. To receive good or bad results as the consequence of past actions. 2. To cut and collect a grain crop.
items.ex_en: A nation that sows seeds of corruption must eventually reap bitter despair.
items.ex_zh: 一个播下腐败种子的国家，终究必将自食绝望的恶果。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame cover the agricultural gathering of crops as well as the figurative accumulation or earning of rewards, consequences, and data over time.
groups.summary_zh: 指收割成熟作物，或引申为聚敛、收获回报与后果。
groups.desc_en: Denotes systematically collecting, accumulating, and securing mature yields or accumulated value, contrasting with mere scattered finding or passive receiving.
groups.desc_zh: 指对成熟作物或累积成果进行系统性的收割、采撷与聚拢入仓，与零星拾取或被动接纳相对。
groups.nuance_en: glean: patiently collecting leftover scraps or hidden intelligence (information / facts / data) · gather in: bringing dispersed harvests or members into safe keeping (crops / harvest / sheaves) · harvest: reaping mature crops or exploiting accumulated resources (grain / grapes / organs) · garner: painstakingly acquiring, accumulating, and storing prestige or support (praise / support / votes) · reap: cutting down crops or naturally experiencing consequences (rewards / benefits / whirlwind)
groups.nuance_zh: glean: 拾荒式搜集零散事实或情报 (information / facts / data) · gather in: 归仓、聚拢收纳分散的收成 (crops / harvest / sheaves) · harvest: 正式收割成熟作物或统筹采集 (grain / grapes / organs) · garner: 历经艰辛积聚赞誉、支持等无形资产 (praise / support / votes) · reap: 挥镰割下成熟庄稼，或因果报应性地收获 (rewards / benefits / whirlwind)

groups.name: Harvest & Pick · 采摘与采择 (Pick, Pluck, Forage)
groups.tip: 从植株上摘取采收果实农产

items.def_en: To pull or remove a fruit, flower, or berry from where it is growing using the hands
items.ex_en: The children helped their grandmother pick ripe strawberries from the kitchen garden.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们帮祖母从菜园里采摘成熟的草莓。

items.def_en: To steal fruit, especially apples or berries, from an orchard or garden (informal British)
items.ex_en: Mischievous boys scaled the high stone wall to scrump pears all afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 淘气的男孩们整个下午都在翻越石墙偷摘梨子。

items.def_en: 1. To gather or look for wild berries. 2. (botany) To produce or yield berries.
items.ex_en: We usually berry in the dense undergrowth behind the old family cottage.
items.ex_zh: 我们通常会在老宅后面的茂密灌木丛中采摘野浆果。

items.def_en: To quickly pull or detach a single flower, leaf, or fruit with fingers
items.ex_en: She gently knelt down to pluck a single white daisy from the lawn.
items.ex_zh: 她轻轻跪下身来，从草坪上采下了一朵白雏菊。

items.def_en: To search widely across the countryside or woods for wild edible plants and berries
items.ex_en: In early autumn, deer often forage across open meadows for wild mushrooms.
items.ex_zh: 初秋时节，鹿群经常在开阔的草甸上四处寻觅野菇充饥。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on the hands-on manual extraction of wild foods, ripe fruits, flowers, or berries from plants, bushes, or the natural wild environment.
groups.summary_zh: 指亲手在植物或野外采摘果实、花卉或觅食野果。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the manual detachment of small produce from wild or cultivated plants, contrasting with mechanized industrial harvesting.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过手工逐个采撷植物果实或在野外觅食采摘，与机械化的大规模农田收割形成对照。
groups.nuance_en: pick: standard selective hand-harvesting of mature produce (fruit / flowers / apples) · scrump: stealing fruit from orchards without permission (apples / pears) · pluck: pulling off feathers, leaves, or fruit with quick snapping detachment (berries / petals / feathers) · forage: roaming widely in the wild to gather wild food (food / mushrooms / berries)
groups.nuance_zh: pick: 手工精心采摘熟果或挑选 (fruit / flowers / apples) · scrump: 偷摘他人果园中的果实 (apples / pears) · pluck: 俐落揪拔羽毛、花瓣或细枝果实 (berries / petals / feathers) · forage: 在荒野中漫游觅食或采寻野味 (food / mushrooms / berries)

groups.name: Hatch & Breed Young · 孵化与育幼 (Hatch, Brood, Foster)
groups.tip: 禽卵人工恒温孵化培育
