items.def_en: Keep animals for the purpose of producing young in a controlled manner
items.ex_en: Dedicated ranchers meticulously breed prize-winning cattle to maintain exceptional genetic traits.
items.ex_zh: 敬业的牧场主精心培育优良种牛，以保持卓越的遗传特性。
items.ex2_en: Mosquitoes breed rapidly in standing water during the warm, humid summer months.
items.ex2_zh: 在温暖潮湿的夏季月份，蚊子在死水中迅速繁殖。

items.def_en: Emerge from an egg, or cause young birds, insects, or fish to emerge
items.ex_en: Fragile pale wings unfolded gracefully as the delicate moth began to hatch.
items.ex_zh: 这只娇弱的飞蛾破壳而出，舒展开纤细而苍白的双翅。

items.def_en: Release or deposit eggs in water, as fish, amphibians, or mollusks do
items.ex_en: Mature salmon journey upstream every autumn to spawn in their native shallows.
items.ex_zh: 成年三文鱼每年秋天都会溯流而上，回到故乡的浅滩产卵。

items.def_en: Sit on eggs to hatch them by body warmth, or hover protectively over young
items.ex_en: The hen remained settled on the nest to brood over her fragile eggs.
items.ex_zh: 母鸡安静地卧在巢中，用体温细心伏窝孵蛋。

items.def_zh: 孵化，恒温培育；（疾病）潜伏；（思想、计划等）酝酿
items.def_en: 1. (of birds or machines) To keep eggs warm so that they will hatch. 2. (of bacteria, viruses, or diseases) To develop slowly within a body before signs appear. 3. To develop an idea, plan, or business over time.
items.ex_en: Specialized laboratory equipment was commissioned to incubate the delicate avian viral samples.
items.ex_zh: 实验室特意启用了专业设备来恒温培育那些娇贵的禽类病毒样本。
items.ex2_en: The contagious viral culture incubates quietly inside the sealed sterile chamber.
items.ex2_zh: 具传染性的病毒培养物在密封的无菌箱内悄然孵化繁殖。

groups.summary_en: This biological frame captures the actions of birds, reptiles, and specialized devices keeping eggs warm, fostering development, and bringing offspring out of shells. Nuances distinguish physical sitting on clutches from embryonic emergence.
groups.summary_zh: 指鸟兽或人工设备抱窝供温促成胚胎发育并破壳，涵盖孵化、菢卵与育雏。
groups.desc_en: Denotes biological or metaphorical gestation, emergence, and early rearing of progeny, contrasting with full adult maturation or random asexual replication.
groups.desc_zh: 指卵生繁殖的受精、孵化、伏巢育幼直至幼体诞生的全周期，与成年期的成长或无性繁殖相对。
groups.nuance_en: breed: controlled reproduction or mating of animals (livestock / cattle / dogs) · hatch: emerging from an egg, or secretly contriving a plot (eggs / chicks / plot) · spawn: mass deposition of eggs, or prolific generation of consequences (fish / controversy / offspring) · brood: sitting on eggs to warm them, or obsessively fretting (clutch / chicks / thoughts) · incubate: maintaining controlled temperature for development (eggs / bacteria / idea)
groups.nuance_zh: breed: 有计划地繁育配种动物 (livestock / cattle / dogs) · hatch: 破壳而出，或暗中策划阴谋 (eggs / chicks / plot) · spawn: 鱼类大批产卵，或衍生大量后果 (fish / controversy / offspring) · brood: 伏窝孵蛋，或忧心忡忡地深思 (clutch / chicks / thoughts) · incubate: 恒温箱孵卵，或潜伏酝酿新想法 (eggs / bacteria / idea)

groups.name: Heave & Manhandle · 负重搬抬 (Manhandle, Hoist, Heave, Shoulder)
groups.tip: 负重转移或费力搬运

items.def_en: To lift a weighty burden onto one's shoulder and carry it forward
items.ex_en: He bent his knees to shoulder the heavy timber sack without assistance.
items.ex_zh: 他屈膝蓄力，独自一人把沉重的木材袋扛上了肩头。

items.def_en: To raise or haul something heavy up to a higher position using ropes or sheer muscle
items.ex_en: Dockworkers utilized heavy pulleys to hoist the replacement engine onto the deck.
items.ex_zh: 码头工人利用重型滑轮组把备用引擎吊运到了甲板上。

items.def_zh: 费力搬运，负重转移；使弓起
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To carry or lift something heavy with great effort. 2. To bend into a hump or curve.
items.ex_en: We had to hump all that bulky camping gear up the steep hill.
items.ex_zh: 我们不得不吃力地把所有笨重的露营装备扛上陡峭的山坡。

items.def_en: To lift, drag, or throw something massive with a tremendous concerted effort
items.ex_en: Three muscular movers managed to heave the antique oak wardrobe upstairs slowly.
items.ex_zh: 三名健壮的搬运工合力，才将那件沉重的古董橡木衣柜吃力地搬上楼。

items.def_en: To move something cumbersome entirely using human physical strength, often roughly
items.ex_en: The crew had to manhandle the waterlogged sofa through the narrow doorway.
items.ex_zh: 搬运人员不得不使出浑身蛮力把泡水的沙发硬塞过狭窄的门道。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on exerting raw bodily force to lift, shoulder, or muscle unwieldy loads across distances, frequently implying back-straining labor or brute physical coercion.
groups.summary_zh: 强调凭借强悍蛮力拉起、硬抗或搬移极度沉重之物。
groups.desc_en: Denotes expending raw, straining physical bodily force to lift or relocate cumbersome burdens, contrasting with effortless or automated conveyance.
groups.desc_zh: 指依赖纯肉体蛮力对沉重、笨重物体进行费力扛抬或推挪，与轻巧搬运或机械自动化作业相对。
groups.nuance_en: shoulder: taking a physical or moral load squarely onto the shoulders (burden / responsibility / blame) · hoist: mechanical or strained upward lifting of high mass (flag / sail / crate) · hump: ungainly, grunting carriage of awkward weight (luggage / gear / pack) · heave: exerting massive collective or bodily surge to raise/throw (rope / anchor / chest) · manhandle: moving heavily through rough physical force without tools (crate / furniture / prisoner)
groups.nuance_zh: shoulder: 用肩膀担起重负或勇敢挑起大梁 (burden / responsibility / blame) · hoist: 费力或借助滑轮将重物向上起吊 (flag / sail / crate) · hump: 驼着笨重包裹弓背苦干搬运 (luggage / gear / pack) · heave: 爆发全身蛮力大幅度抛掷或掀拉 (rope / anchor / chest) · manhandle: 粗暴推搡搬动沉重物体或粗鲁推押人 (crate / furniture / furniture)

groups.name: Heavy Pulling & Dragging · 拖拽与死拉 (Drag, Haul, Lug)
groups.tip: 从轻拉到费力贴地拖曳

items.def_en: To pull something along loosely so that it drags across the ground behind
items.ex_en: The tired child began to trail his muddy blanket along behind him.
items.ex_zh: 疲倦的孩子开始任凭沾满泥土的毯子拖曳在身后的地上。

items.def_zh: 拖，拽，拉；缓慢费力地移动
items.def_en: 1. To pull someone or something along forcefully or with difficulty, usually along the ground. 2. To move slowly or with great effort; to pass tedious time.
items.ex_en: Rescuers had to drag the damaged inflatable raft across the jagged rocks.
items.ex_zh: 救援人员不得不艰难地把受损的充气橡皮艇拖过崎岖的礁石。

items.def_en: To pull a vehicle, trailer, or boat along behind by means of a rope, cable, or chain
items.ex_en: A specialized service truck arrived promptly to tow the disabled sedan away.
items.ex_zh: 一辆专业救援车迅速赶到，将抛锚的小轿车牵引拖走。

items.def_en: To pull or transport something exceptionally heavy with sustained, arduous physical effort
items.ex_en: Exhausted miners continued to haul carts laden with iron ore toward daylight.
items.ex_zh: 精疲力竭的矿工们继续吃力地将满载铁矿石的矿车拉向洞口。

items.def_en: To carry or drag something heavy and awkward with strenuous difficulty
items.ex_en: I hated having to lug that awkward, overstuffed suitcase across the terminal.
items.ex_zh: 我真讨厌费劲提着那个笨重又塞得满满的行李箱横穿候机楼。

groups.summary_en: This frame emphasizes laborious, forceful pulling of heavy, resistive loads across a surface or ground against friction or inertia.
groups.summary_zh: 表示克服地面阻力、摩擦或重负，费力且吃力地拖拽或搬运沉重之物。
groups.desc_en: Denotes applying sustained horizontal traction to overcome substantial friction or inertia against ground contact, contrasting with free airborne carrying.
groups.desc_zh: 指施加持续牵引力以克服地面阻力或惯性强行拖曳重物，与悬空轻快提携形成鲜明对照。
groups.nuance_en: trail: loosely dragging along the ground behind someone (skirt / rope / feet) · drag: pulling along a surface against heavy friction or resistance (body / suitcase / feet) · tow: pulling a vehicle or vessel via a coupling cable (car / barge / boat) · haul: moving very heavy tonnage over sustained distance (timber / cargo / freight) · lug: toilsomely carting an awkward, deadweight burden (luggage / groceries / crate)
groups.nuance_zh: trail: 垂地飘散或无力地拖在身后 (skirt / rope / feet) · drag: 克服阻力在地上硬拽拖行 (body / suitcase / feet) · tow: 依靠缆绳或拖钩牵引车辆船只 (car / barge / boat) · haul: 长距离搬运极为沉重的货载吨位 (timber / cargo / freight) · lug: 吃力地拖运笨重无弹性的死沉物品 (luggage / groceries / crate)

groups.name: Hedge & Insure Risk · 防范与对冲 (Hedge, Insure, Offset)
groups.tip: 采取平衡对策防范潜在风险

items.def_en: To protect someone or an investment from taxation, liability, or damaging market turbulence
items.ex_en: Savvy financial advisors structure trusts to shield generational wealth from tax burdens.
items.ex_zh: 精明的财务顾问设立信托基金，以庇护家族世代财富免受税赋冲击。

items.def_en: To balance, counteract, or compensate for one liability, cost, or effect with an opposing one
items.ex_en: Higher operating expenses were successfully offset by record-breaking international sales figures.
items.ex_zh: 创纪录的海外销售额成功抵消了水涨船高的运营支出成本。

items.def_zh: 防范，对冲（财务或潜在风险）；回避直接答复，含糊其词；用树篱围住
items.def_en: 1. (+ against) To protect oneself against financial loss or other risk by taking balanced counteractions. 2. To avoid giving a direct answer or committing oneself. 3. To enclose or surround an area with a hedge.
items.ex_en: Traders frequently hedge against sudden currency swings by purchasing defensive options contracts.
items.ex_zh: 交易员们通常通过买入防御性期权合约来对冲汇率的骤变风险。

items.def_en: To contract for financial compensation against possible loss, or take active measures against a contingency
items.ex_en: Prudent homeowners usually insure their properties against extensive flood damage every year.
items.ex_zh: 审慎的房主通常每年都会为房产投保以防范严重的洪灾损失。

items.def_en: To protect someone or a balance sheet from the full adverse impact of an economic or unexpected shock
items.ex_en: Healthy emergency reserves helped cushion the firm against severe economic recessions.
items.ex_zh: 充裕的应急储备金帮助该企业缓和了严重经济衰退带来的巨大冲击。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe mitigating exposure to financial, operational, or strategic risk by establishing counterbalancing positions, agreements, or reserves that absorb prospective shocks.
groups.summary_zh: 通过对冲操作、投保或建立备选方案来分散与化解潜在风险。
groups.desc_en: Denotes taking anticipatory financial or structural measures to neutralize downside exposure, contrasting with naked speculation or passive risk-bearing.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过反向配置或设防措施主动对冲、吸收潜在下行风险，与单纯裸投机或坐以待毙相对。
groups.nuance_en: shield: interposing a barrier to protect from attack or scrutiny (assets / eyes / company) · offset: counterbalancing one effect or cost against an opposing one (losses / gains / emissions) · hedge: taking a balancing position to limit financial/actionable loss (bets / risks / exposure) · insure: contracting contractual indemnity against specified catastrophe (property / life / future) · cushion: softening the kinetic or financial shock of impact (blow / fall / impact)
groups.nuance_zh: shield: 构筑屏障隔离外部攻击或风险波及 (assets / eyes / company) · offset: 抵消冲销某一负面成本或影响 (losses / gains / emissions) · hedge: 通过反向对冲工具锁定风险边界 (bets / risks / exposure) · insure: 通过购买保险获得损失代偿保证 (property / life / future) · cushion: 充当缓冲垫以减震化解剧烈冲击 (blow / fall / impact)

groups.name: Helm & Steer · 掌舵与统领全局 (Helm, Steer, Pilot)
groups.tip: 执掌大局掌舵与发号施令

items.def_en: To control the direction of a vehicle or guide the course and policy of an organization
items.ex_en: The veteran captain worked steadily to steer the ship away from danger.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的老船长沉着打舵，引导船只驶离危险水域。
items.ex2_en: The small fishing skiff steered smoothly through the narrow coastal passage.
items.ex2_zh: 这艘小型平底渔船平稳地驶过了狭窄的沿海航道。

items.def_en: To act as the captain or prominent leader of a team, vessel, or enterprise
items.ex_en: She was chosen to captain the national soccer squad during the tournament.
items.ex_zh: 她被选定在本次锦标赛期间担任国家足球队的队长。

items.def_en: To guide a project or ship carefully through a difficult process or initial trial period
items.ex_en: Senior administrators will pilot the new digital curriculum in five local schools.
items.ex_zh: 高级管理人员将在当地五所学校率先试行这套全新数字化课程。

items.def_zh: 掌舵，统领，掌管（组织、项目或影片等）
items.def_en: 1. To direct, lead, or manage an organization, project, ship, or film.
items.ex_en: The visionary director agreed to helm the upcoming historical science-fiction thriller.
items.ex_zh: 这位极具远见的导演同意亲自掌舵执导即将开拍的历史科幻惊悚片。

items.def_en: To serve as the active leader or driving force behind a campaign, attack, or initiative
items.ex_en: A prominent civil rights activist stepped forward to spearhead the nationwide campaign.
items.ex_zh: 一位知名民权活动家挺身而出，带头主导了这场席卷全国的运动。

groups.summary_en: Drawn originally from maritime navigation, these verbs characterize guiding, directing, and executing leadership over projects, organizations, or institutions through active strategic control and personal oversight.
groups.summary_zh: 源自航海隐喻，指对组织、项目或方向进行战略掌舵、主导与领航。
groups.desc_en: Denotes exercising direct, executive steering of a vessel, venture, or organization through complex waters, contrasting with passive following or figurehead oversight.
groups.desc_zh: 指如同掌舵航行般对复杂任务或组织进行第一线的方向把控与领航统驭，与随波逐流或挂名虚领不同。
groups.nuance_en: steer: physically turning a course or guiding policy trajectory (ship / car / economy) · captain: leading and commanding a unified crew or team (team / squad / vessel) · pilot: guiding safely through perilous or narrow passages; testing a trial (plane / bill / project) · helm: holding supreme executive control over an enterprise or state (organization / campaign / agency) · spearhead: leading from the absolute forefront of an offensive drive (campaign / attack / reform)
groups.nuance_zh: steer: 把控方向盘、掌控具体行进轨迹 (ship / car / economy) · captain: 作为队长指挥协调整个团队 (team / squad / vessel) · pilot: 领航穿越危险复杂航道；领头试水试点 (plane / bill / project) · helm: 坐镇最高领导席统摄全局 (organization / campaign / agency) · spearhead: 一马当先充当尖刀带头发起攻势 (campaign / attack / reform)

groups.name: Hesitate on Moral Grounds · 道德踌躇与疑虑 (Scruple, Balk, Demur)
groups.tip: 心存顾虑迟迟难决断

items.def_en: Lose momentum, confidence, or determination when faced with an ethical or arduous choice
items.ex_en: Under intense public pressure, several key committee members began to falter noticeably.
items.ex_zh: 在巨大的舆论压力之下，几位核心委员会成员的态度开始明显动摇。

items.def_en: Raise doubts or objections, or politely hesitate to agree with a proposed course
items.ex_en: While most approved the proposal, two senior auditors felt compelled to demur.
items.ex_zh: 尽管大多数人批准了提案，两位资深审计员仍深感有必要提出异议。

items.def_en: (+ at) Hesitate or be scrupled by an ethical issue or overwhelming doubt
items.ex_en: Conscientious officials boggle at endorsing policies that blatantly violate basic civil liberties.
items.ex_zh: 恪尽职守的官员们对签署公然侵犯基本公民自由的政策顾虑退缩。

items.def_en: (+ at) Hesitate or show reluctance to proceed with an action that feels wrong or difficult
items.ex_en: Ethical researchers balk at conducting experiments without obtaining explicit informed consent first.
items.ex_zh: 坚守道德的研究人员对未事先取得明确知情同意便开展实验畏缩不前。

items.def_en: (formal, chiefly negative) To hesitate or feel reluctant to do something because of moral doubts.
items.ex_en: Ruthless developers did not scruple to displace poor residents for high profits.
items.ex_zh: 唯利是图的开发商为了高额利润，对驱逐贫民毫无顾忌迟疑。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe pausing, hesitating, or refusing to act due to moral qualms, conscientious objections, or strong reluctance.
groups.summary_zh: 因道德良知或强烈顾忌而犹豫、踌躇或拒绝执行。
groups.desc_en: Denotes halting or hesitating before an action out of ethical qualms or moral revulsion, contrasting with strategic doubt or practical reluctance.
groups.desc_zh: 指在采取行动前因良知不安、道德疑虑或心理反感而驻足退缩，与纯利益权衡或技术性犹豫不同。
groups.nuance_en: falter: wavering or losing momentum in purpose or courage (resolve / voice / steps) · demur: politely or formally raising quiet doubts and objections (proposal / request / suggestion) · boggle: mind being stunned or recoiling in disbelief at immense scale (mind / imagination) · balk: obstinately stopping short and refusing to proceed (idea / cost / demand) · scruple: hesitating strictly because one's conscience rejects the act (deceit / lie / theft)
groups.nuance_zh: falter: 因勇气不足或信念动摇而步履蹒跚 (resolve / voice / steps) · demur: 礼貌、审慎地提出异议或表示保留 (proposal / request / suggestion) · boggle: 因事态匪夷所思而头脑发懵打退堂鼓 (mind / imagination) · balk: 像受惊的马匹般骤然刹车拒绝配合 (idea / cost / demand) · scruple: 纯粹出于良心或道德底线而心存顾忌 (deceit / lie / theft)

groups.name: Hibernate & Slumber · 冬眠与深睡 (Estivate, Torporize, Drowse)
groups.tip: 由日常睡眠延伸至动物冬眠休眠

items.def_en: Be half asleep, sluggish, or resting in a sleepy, non-alert condition
items.ex_en: In the sweltering heat, the sleepy village watchman began to drowse peacefully.
items.ex_zh: 在闷热的酷暑中，昏昏欲睡的村庄守夜人开始安然打起瞌睡来。

items.def_en: Sleep peacefully, deeply, and continuously, often quietly
items.ex_en: Under the pale moonlight, the quiet mountain hamlet seemed to slumber undisturbed.
items.ex_zh: 在清冷的月色下，静谧的山间小村庄仿佛在不受打扰中沉睡。

items.def_en: 1. (of animals) To spend the winter in a dormant state resembling deep sleep. 2. (informal) To stay indoors and remain inactive during the winter.
items.ex_en: Many arctic rodents hibernate inside insulated subterranean burrows until early spring returns.
items.ex_zh: 许多北极啮齿动物都会在保暖的地底洞穴中冬眠，直至早春归来。

items.def_en: Spend or survive the winter in a designated place or state of reduced vitality
items.ex_en: Hardy alpine perennials overwinter beneath deep layers of insulating mountain snow cover.
items.ex_zh: 耐寒的高山多年生植物在厚实而保暖的积雪层覆盖下安然越冬。

items.def_en: Spend a hot, dry summer period in a prolonged state of torpor or dormancy
items.ex_en: During prolonged arid droughts, desert snails retreat into deep soil to estivate.
items.ex_zh: 在旷日持久的干旱期间，沙漠蜗牛会钻入深层土壤进行夏眠休眠。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame delineate prolonged metabolic dormancy, deep biological winter sleep, or extreme states of inactivity and torpor observed in animals or dormant people.
groups.summary_zh: 进入休眠、极低代谢休整或长久深沉的昏睡状态。
groups.desc_en: Entering states of profound inactivity, physiological dormancy, or peaceful unconsciousness, contrasting with generic 'sleep' by emphasizing prolonged duration, environmental adaptation, or heavy somnolence.
groups.desc_zh: 进入深度静止、生理休眠或安宁沉睡的状态；与一般的'睡觉(sleep)'相比，侧重适应环境的漫长休眠、生理停滞或深沉的静止感。
groups.nuance_en: drowse: half-sleep or languid nodding off (afternoon / sunlight / heat) · slumber: peaceful, deep, poetic sleep (innocence / giant / centuries) · hibernate: prolonged winter dormancy to conserve energy (bear / wildlife / economy) · overwinter: survive the harsh cold season (flock / crop / larvae) · estivate: enter dormant torpor during hot, dry summer conditions (snail / amphibian / desert creature)
groups.nuance_zh: drowse: 昏昏欲睡或半睡半醒 (afternoon / sunlight / heat) · slumber: 安宁、深沉或诗意的长眠 (innocence / giant / centuries) · hibernate: 严冬生理休眠以避寒蓄能 (bear / wildlife / economy) · overwinter: 越冬、渡过严寒季节 (flock / crop / larvae) · estivate: 夏眠，在酷暑干旱时陷入休眠 (snail / amphibian / desert creature)

groups.name: High-Pitched Scream · 尖叫与尖厉呼喊 (Screech, Shriek, Squawk)
groups.tip: 由大声呼叫升级为刺耳尖叫

items.def_zh: 发出刺耳尖鸣；大声抗议
items.def_en: To make a loud, harsh, discordant noise, or to complain loudly in a shrill tone
items.ex_en: Disgruntled customers will surely squawk if shipping fees are increased without warning.
items.ex_zh: 如果不打招呼就上调运费，心怀不满的顾客们肯定会大声抗议。

items.def_en: To utter a loud, sharp, high-pitched cry as an instinctive reaction to fear or pain
items.ex_en: Frightened passengers began to scream as the turbulence violently shook the airplane.
items.ex_zh: 当颠簸剧烈摇晃机身时，受惊的乘客们开始失声尖叫起来。

items.def_zh: 发出尖叫声，尖声喊出；发出刺耳声
items.def_en: To make a loud, high-pitched, unpleasant cry or sound, or to say something in such a voice.
items.ex_en: Brakes began to screech loudly as the driver slammed them down urgently.
items.ex_zh: 当司机紧急死踩刹车板时，刹车片发出了刺耳难听的尖鸣。

items.def_zh: 尖叫；发出尖锐刺耳的声音
items.def_en: To make a short, very loud, high-pitched cry or sound when frightened or excited
items.ex_en: Startled by the shadow, she let out an ear-piercing shriek of terror.
items.ex_zh: 被黑影吓了一跳的她，猛然发出了一声震耳欲聋的惊恐尖叫。

items.def_zh: 发春猫般的刺耳尖嚎；怪叫
items.def_en: To make a shrill, howling, or wailing noise like that of cats fighting
items.ex_en: Stray tomcats caterwaul incessantly beneath my bedroom window during humid summer nights.
items.ex_zh: 在潮湿闷热的夏夜，流浪公猫总是在我卧室窗下发出刺耳怪叫。

groups.summary_en: Verbs conveying piercing, high-frequency vocal bursts or noises triggered by terror, shock, acute pain, or rage.
groups.summary_zh: 指因极度恐惧、疼痛或惊骇发出的刺耳高分贝尖叫与怪鸣。
groups.desc_en: Emitting sharp, high-pitched vocalizations of terror, protest, or harsh noise, differing from general 'crying' or 'shouting' through extreme acoustic frequency and distressing piercingness.
groups.desc_zh: 发出尖锐、刺耳、高频率的呼喊或叫声；与一般的'哭叫(cry)'或'大喊(shout)'相比，侧重声频极高、刺耳且多伴随恐慌或抗议。
groups.nuance_en: squawk: harsh, raspy bird-like screech or loud abrasive protest (gull / parrot / critic) · scream: loud, high-pitched, emotional cry of pure terror or pain (victim / child / siren) · screech: piercing, grating metallic or strident vocal sound (tires / brakes / owl) · shriek: sharp, shrill, momentary scream of sudden shock or agony (laughter / panic / wind) · caterwaul: harsh, discordantly wailing or discordant shrieking (cat / alley / disputant)
groups.nuance_zh: squawk: 粗哑刺耳的鸟鸣般抗议或叫嚷 (gull / parrot / critic) · scream: 恐惧或剧痛下极度失控的凄厉尖叫 (victim / child / siren) · screech: 尖锐刺耳、如同金属刮擦的嘶叫 (tires / brakes / owl) · shriek: 惊恐、剧痛或狂喜时瞬间爆发的尖细尖叫 (laughter / panic / wind) · caterwaul: 难听刺耳的嚎叫或猫叫般的哀嚎 (cat / alley / disputant)

groups.name: Hike & Trek · 徒步与远足 (Hike, Trek, Tramp)
groups.tip: 背包装备户外长途跋涉

items.def_en: To take a long walk in the countryside or wilderness for pleasure or exercise
items.ex_en: Let us hike along the scenic coastal cliffs early this Saturday morning.
items.ex_zh: 我们这周六清晨顺着风景迷人的海岸悬崖去徒步远足吧。

items.def_en: To make a long, arduous journey, typically on foot through wild or difficult terrain
items.ex_en: The exhausted explorers had to trek across miles of unforgiving frozen tundra.
items.ex_zh: 精疲力竭的探险队员们不得不徒步艰难跋涉过数英里残酷的冰原。

items.def_zh: 背包装备徒步旅行，背负背囊远足
items.def_en: to travel or hike around carrying clothes and equipment in a backpack
items.ex_en: College students often choose to backpack through picturesque European villages during summer.
items.ex_zh: 大学生们经常选择在暑假背起行囊，徒步游历风景如画的欧洲村庄。

items.def_zh: 沉重缓慢地长途步行；远足
items.def_en: To walk heavily or firmly over a long distance, often across rough country
items.ex_en: We had to tramp through muddy bogs for hours before reaching the remote shelter.
items.ex_zh: 我们不得不艰难地跋涉穿过泥泞的沼泽数小时，才到达偏远的避难所。

items.def_en: To make one's way through thick woods, brush, or pathless wilderness
items.ex_en: We had to bushwhack through dense brambles after losing sight of the overgrown trail.
items.ex_zh: 在看不清长满杂草的小径后，我们不得不披荆斩棘穿过浓密的荆棘丛。

groups.summary_en: Covers long-distance travel on foot across natural or rural landscapes, ranging from leisure trail walking to arduous wilderness expeditions. While hiking implies marked paths, trekking and tramping convey rigorous, multi-day overland journeys.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及野外徒步、远足与背包旅行，侧重负重长途行走与穿越跋涉。
groups.desc_en: Traveling by foot across varied, difficult, or off-path terrain over considerable distances, contrasting with leisurely 'walking' by requiring sustained physical exertion and wilderness navigation.
groups.desc_zh: 在复杂、崎岖或荒野地形中长距离徒步行进；与闲适的'散步(walk)'不同，强调体能消耗、长途跋涉与越野挑战。
groups.nuance_en: hike: long cross-country walk for recreation or exercise (trail / ridge / woods) · trek: arduous, multi-day overland journey across challenging wilderness (glacier / Himalayas / jungle) · backpack: hike while carrying one's gear and provisions for self-sufficient camping (wilderness / trail / Rockies) · tramp: walk heavily, resolutely, or vagrantly over long stretches (countryside / street / marsh) · bushwhack: force a difficult path through dense untamed undergrowth (underbrush / thicket / wilderness)
groups.nuance_zh: hike: 依循步道进行的远足或健身徒步 (trail / ridge / woods) · trek: 跨越险峻艰险地貌的艰苦长途跋涉 (glacier / Himalayas / jungle) · backpack: 背负全部装备宿营的背包徒步 (wilderness / trail / Rockies) · tramp: 步履沉重、长途漫步或流浪式远行 (countryside / street / marsh) · bushwhack: 在丛林杂草中硬劈开一条路穿行 (underbrush / thicket / wilderness)

groups.name: Hinder & Handicap · 阻碍与妨碍 (Handicap, Impede, Encumber)
groups.tip: 施加不利条件削弱行动能力

items.def_en: To burden someone or something with a heavy weight or difficulty, hindering easy movement or success
items.ex_en: She felt weighed down by domestic responsibilities and work pressures.
items.ex_zh: 她感到家庭责任和工作压力压得自己喘不过气来。

items.def_zh: 阻碍，使处于不利地位；对…施加让步条件
items.def_en: 1. (often passive) To put someone or something at a disadvantage that makes it harder to succeed. 2. To assign a handicap to a competitor in a contest.
items.ex_en: The startup was heavily handicapped by severe regulatory delays and an acute capital shortage.
items.ex_zh: 由于严重的监管拖延和极度匮乏的资金，这家初创公司陷入了严重的不利境地。

items.def_en: To prevent the free movement, action, or progress of someone or something
items.ex_en: Rescue operations were severely hampered by gale-force winds and relentless freezing rain.
items.ex_zh: 救援行动受到了大风和持续不断的冻雨的严重阻碍。

items.def_en: To slow the progress of someone or something, or to make movement difficult by creating obstacles
items.ex_en: Fallen boulders impeded the advance of emergency convoys toward the disaster zone.
items.ex_zh: 滚落的巨石阻碍了应急车队开往灾区的进程。

items.def_en: To weigh down or burden someone or something so that freedom of movement or action is restricted
items.ex_en: Soldiers were encumbered by heavy gear, making their retreat through the swamp agonizingly slow.
items.ex_zh: 士兵们被沉重的装备拖累，使得穿过沼泽撤退的过程异常缓慢。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on imposing disadvantages or burdens that make progress, movement, or success substantially harder without necessarily halting it outright.
groups.summary_zh: 施加不利条件或负担，使行动困难或难以成功。
groups.desc_en: Creating physical burdens, systemic obstacles, or operational disadvantages that impede smooth progress, distinguishing from absolute 'stopping' by emphasizing dragging drag and restricted efficiency.
groups.desc_zh: 设置物理负重、体制障碍或竞争劣势以拖累进展；与绝对的'停止(stop)'不同，侧重施加束缚、降低行动效率与造成行动不便。
groups.nuance_en: weigh down: burden physically or mentally, dragging down agility (baggage / debt / sorrow) · handicap: impose a specific disadvantage that impairs competitive performance (competitor / industry / growth) · hamper: disrupt fluid movement or operational execution (rescue effort / investigation / movement) · impede: slow down or obstruct forward progress by placing roadblocks (progress / flow / development) · encumber: burden with excessive baggage, legal ties, or physical load (traveler / estate / administration)
groups.nuance_zh: weigh down: 物理或心理上沉重压迫以致步履维艰 (baggage / debt / sorrow) · handicap: 给予不利条件使其在竞争中处于劣势 (competitor / industry / growth) · hamper: 妨碍、牵制动作或行动的流畅开展 (rescue effort / investigation / movement) · impede: 设置阻碍延缓前进或流通速度 (progress / flow / development) · encumber: 因过多包袱、债务或法律羁绊而累赘不堪 (traveler / estate / administration)

groups.name: Hinge & Turn On · 取决于与以……为枢纽 (Hinge, Turn On, Pivot)
groups.tip: 关键所在依赖于某节点

items.def_en: to have something as the central, deciding factor or condition
items.ex_en: The final outcome of the peace negotiations turns entirely on their territorial concessions.
items.ex_zh: 和平谈判的最终结果完全取决于他们在领土上的让步。

items.def_en: to depend completely on a central point, argument, or development
items.ex_en: The prosecution’s entire case pivots on the reliability of this single eyewitness testimony.
items.ex_zh: 检方的整个诉讼完全取决于这位唯一定罪目击者证词的可靠性。

items.def_en: to depend on or be based firmly upon a particular fact, assumption, or person
items.ex_en: The stability of their diplomatic agreement rests on mutual economic transparency.
items.ex_zh: 他们外交协议的稳定性建立在双方经济透明的基础之上。

items.def_zh: 系于，取决于（成功或名誉等）
items.def_en: to depend heavily on the outcome of something, often involving high stakes
items.ex_en: The team's future in the tournament rides on the outcome of tonight's game.
items.ex_zh: 该球队在锦标赛中的命运完全取决于今晚比赛的结果。

items.def_zh: 取决于，全视……而定（hinge on/upon）；装铰链于
items.def_en: 1. (hinge on/upon) to depend completely on something. 2. to attach a door, lid, or part using hinges.
items.ex_en: The success of our entire expedition hinges upon securing sufficient clean water tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 我们整个探险队的成败完全取决于明天能否获得足够的清洁水源。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers critical dependency where the ultimate outcome, success, or truth of an issue hangs entirely on a single pivotal condition, factor, or event.
groups.summary_zh: 指事态的发展、结果或结论完全以某关键支点为转移。
groups.desc_en: Having an ultimate outcome or central mechanism fundamentally dependent upon a single decisive focal point, contrasting with simple 'relating to' by highlighting causal contingency.
groups.desc_zh: 事物的成败、运转或结局完全系于某一关键枢纽；与单纯的'与……有关(relate to)'相比，侧重因果机制的绝对依附性与杠杆效应。
groups.nuance_en: turn on: depend for outcome or core argument upon a single condition (technicality / evidence / mood) · pivot on: rotate conceptually or strategically around a central axis (strategy / issue / moment) · rest on: ground credibility, validity, or stability upon an underlying foundation (premise / laurels / assumption) · ride on: have fate, fortunes, or high stakes depending entirely upon an outcome (reputation / gamble / election) · hinge: connect causally so that any movement depends entirely on a pivotal factor (decision / verdict / success)
groups.nuance_zh: turn on: 胜负或焦点取决于某个特定细节或论据 (technicality / evidence / mood) · pivot on: 围绕某一轴心或核心议题发生战略转移或展开 (strategy / issue / moment) · rest on: 依赖于某基石、假设或以往成就立足 (premise / laurels / assumption) · ride on: 押注于……、前途命运全系于某一孤注 (reputation / gamble / election) · hinge: 如铰链般关键咬合，全局依此而定 (decision / verdict / success)

groups.name: Hint & Allude · 暗示与侧面提及 (Intimate, Touch On, Insinuate)
groups.tip: 言语含蓄迂回，暗中影射指涉

items.def_en: To mention or discuss a subject briefly or tangentially in passing
items.ex_en: The speaker only touched on the budget deficit without providing any concrete solutions.
items.ex_zh: 发言人只是简略提到了财政赤字，并未给出任何具体解决方案。

items.def_zh: (+ at) 暗示，透露细微迹象
items.def_en: (+ at) To say something that suggests what you think or want without saying it directly
items.ex_en: The CEO strongly hinted at upcoming structural changes during the quarterly board meeting.
items.ex_zh: 首席执行官在季度董事会上强烈暗示了即将到来的架构变动。

items.def_en: To communicate or make something known subtly, indirectly, or quietly
items.ex_en: The ambassador discreetly intimated that trade sanctions might soon be lifted entirely.
items.ex_zh: 大使委婉地透露，贸易制裁可能很快就会被完全解除。

items.def_en: (+ to) (formal) To mention or refer to someone or something indirectly.
items.ex_en: During her keynote address, she subtly alluded to recent internal boardroom conflicts.
items.ex_zh: 在主题演讲中，她隐晦地提及了董事会最近发生的内部纷争。

items.def_en: To suggest something unpleasant or derogatory in an indirect, insidious way
items.ex_en: The editorial seemed to insinuate that the mayor accepted kickbacks from local developers.
items.ex_zh: 该社论似乎含沙射影地暗示市长收受了当地开发商的回扣。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate referring to someone, something, or a sensitive topic in an indirect, glancing, or veiled manner rather than stating it plainly.
groups.summary_zh: 指不指名道姓、避开直言，采用旁敲侧击、含蓄带过或隐晦的方式表达。
groups.desc_en: Communicating information obliquely, subtly, or by veiled suggestion without explicit statement, differing from direct 'saying' or 'declaring' by requiring interpretive inference from the receiver.
groups.desc_zh: 委婉、含蓄或拐弯抹角地传达意图；与直白的'告知(tell/state)'不同，要求听者根据语境推敲言外之意。
groups.nuance_en: touch on: mention briefly or tangentially in passing (subject / topic / theme) · hint: offer a faint, indirect clue to prompt realization (intention / solution / possibility) · intimate: communicate delicately, discreetly, or with sophisticated subtlety (displeasure / intention / doubt) · allude: refer to something indirectly without naming it outright (past / scandal / text) · insinuate: inject an unpleasant, sinister, or accusatory suggestion slyly (guilt / corruption / incompetence)
groups.nuance_zh: touch on: 顺带提及、浅尝辄止地触及 (subject / topic / theme) · hint: 给出隐晦线索以点拨他人 (intention / solution / possibility) · intimate: 委婉含蓄、体面而微妙地暗示 (displeasure / intention / doubt) · allude: 借代或旁敲侧击地暗指某事 (past / scandal / text) · insinuate: 阴阳怪气、含沙射影地植入恶意怀疑 (guilt / corruption / incompetence)

groups.name: Hire & Retain · 雇佣与出资招募 (Take on, Recruit, Retain)
groups.tip: 出资招纳人才填补职位空缺

items.def_zh: 雇佣，聘用；（短期）租用，租借
items.def_en: to employ someone to do a particular job for wages; to pay to use something for a short period of time
items.ex_en: The committee decided to hire an experienced consultant to audit their financial records.
items.ex_zh: 委员会决定雇佣一位经验丰富的顾问来审计他们的财务记录。

items.def_zh: 聘请（专业人员）；保留服务
items.def_en: to secure the future services of an expert, such as a lawyer, by paying a fee
items.ex_en: The corporation retained a prominent defense attorney to handle the high-profile antitrust lawsuit.
items.ex_zh: 该公司聘请了一位著名辩护律师来处理这场备受瞩目的反垄断诉讼。

items.def_en: to find and enroll suitable candidates to join a company, group, or armed force
items.ex_en: The tech firm aims to recruit several promising software engineers from top universities.
items.ex_zh: 这家科技公司计划从顶尖大学招募数名颇具潜力的软件工程师。

items.def_en: to engage or employ new staff members
items.ex_en: The factory plans to take on dozens of temporary workers for the harvest season.
items.ex_zh: 该工厂计划为收获季节招用数十名临时工。

items.def_en: to commit someone to work or perform by signing a binding legal contract
items.ex_en: The record label decided to sign up the young prodigy after her viral performance.
items.ex_zh: 在年轻神童的表演走红网络后，唱片公司决定签约下她。
items.ex2_en: Hundreds of excited volunteers signed up for the weekend coastal cleanup event.
items.ex2_zh: 数百名热情的志愿者报名参加了周末的海滩清洁活动。

groups.summary_en: This lexical frame centers on entering an employment agreement to pay someone for labor or retain services, especially through transactional hiring or contracts.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过支付报酬与合同约定招募劳动力或聘请外部专业服务。
groups.desc_en: Securing services or personnel by formal agreement, financial compensation, or strategic enlistment, contrasting with mere 'getting' by instituting a contractual, professional relationship.
groups.desc_zh: 通过正式合同、薪酬对价或定向招募获取专业服务与人力；与一般的'获得(get)'不同，侧重契约化与职业雇佣关系的建立。
groups.nuance_en: hire: engage someone's labor or services for pay (employee / consultant / worker) · retain: pay an advance fee to ensure ongoing availability of professional counsel (lawyer / services / firm) · recruit: actively solicit and enroll individuals into an organization or team (talent / soldiers / executives) · take on: assume the responsibility of employing or managing additional staff (staff / apprentice / worker) · sign up: commit someone or oneself to a formal contract or membership (player / recruit / client)
groups.nuance_zh: hire: 出资雇佣人员完成常规劳务或岗位工作 (employee / consultant / worker) · retain: 预付聘金或留用以保持专业顾问的长期服务 (lawyer / services / firm) · recruit: 主动招揽选拔人才或征召人员入伍 (talent / soldiers / executives) · take on: 接收、吸纳新员工并承担其用工责任 (staff / apprentice / worker) · sign up: 签约加盟或注册招募专业选手/会员 (player / recruit / client)

groups.name: Hiss & Jeer · 嘘声与喝倒彩 (Hiss, Catcall, Raspberry)
groups.tip: 群体发出嘘声公开喝倒彩

items.def_en: To drive someone or an animal away by uttering a sharp sibilant sound
items.ex_en: Grandmother had to shoo the stray pigeons off the balcony with a broom.
items.ex_zh: 祖母不得不挥舞着扫帚把阳台上的野鸽子赶走。

items.def_en: To make a derisive sputtering noise by sticking out the tongue between closed lips
items.ex_en: The unruly child blew a raspberry at his sister before running away laughing.
items.ex_zh: 那个任性的孩子冲着姐姐吐舌头吹了个响亮的倒彩，然后笑着跑开了。

items.def_zh: 发出嘘声喝倒彩；发出嘶嘶声；低声斥责
items.def_en: 1. To make a sharp sound of disapproval or boo at someone. 2. To make a long sharp sound like steam escaping or a snake. 3. To say something in a fierce, angry whisper.
items.ex_en: Angry theatregoers began to hiss loudly when the lead actor forgot his lines.
items.ex_zh: 当主角忘词时，愤怒的剧场观众开始大声发出嘘声喝倒彩。

items.def_en: To make loud, rude, and mocking remarks or sounds at someone
items.ex_en: Hostile protesters gathered outside the courthouse to jeer at the corrupt politician.
items.ex_zh: 怀有敌意的抗议者聚集在法院外，对这位腐败的政客大肆嘲弄哄笑。

items.def_zh: 吹口哨起哄，发尖叫喝倒彩
items.def_en: To make a shrill whistle, shout, or derisive sound to show disapproval or mockery
items.ex_en: Disappointed fans began to catcall whenever the opposing team scored another easy point.
items.ex_zh: 每当客队再轻松拿下一分，失望的球迷便开始吹口哨起哄喝倒彩。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate hostile, sibilant, or mocking non-verbal sounds aimed at performers, politicians, or rivals to display bitter disapproval and contempt. They frequently feature sharp aerodynamic vocal gestures.
groups.summary_zh: 发出尖锐刺耳的嘘声或怪声以表达轻蔑、反感与倒彩。
groups.desc_en: Vocalizing collective or individual derision, contempt, and hostile disapproval through mocking noises, contrasting with structured 'criticizing' by using crude, guttural sonic expressions.
groups.desc_zh: 通过发出嘲弄性声响、怪声或粗野杂音表达强烈的蔑视与喝倒彩；与理性的'批评(criticize)'不同，具有极强的声觉侮辱性与剧场性。
groups.nuance_en: shoo: drive away with hand gestures and dismissal noises (birds / stray / children) · blow a raspberry: make a flatulent, mocking sputtering sound with the tongue to ridicule (critic / crowd / opponent) · hiss: make a sharp, sibilant sound to convey collective contempt or disapproval (performer / villain / speech) · jeer: shout rude, abusive, and derisive remarks at someone (crowd / mob / spectator) · catcall: utter shrill, sexually harassing whistles or derisive theatrical shouts (performer / street / speaker)
groups.nuance_zh: shoo: 发出嘘声并挥手驱赶人畜 (birds / stray / children) · blow a raspberry: 吐舌发出噗噗声以示嘲弄 (critic / crowd / opponent) · hiss: 发出尖厉的嘶嘶声以表达众怒或厌恶喝倒彩 (performer / villain / speech) · jeer: 聚众起哄、大声用侮辱性言语嘲讽 (crowd / mob / spectator) · catcall: 吹轻佻口哨或在公共场合尖声起哄喝倒彩 (performer / street / speaker)

groups.name: Hitchhike & Carry · 驮载与搭附 (Piggyback, Shuttle, Tote)
groups.tip: 跨骑或借助外力搭乘附载

items.def_en: To haul, carry, or transport a heavy or awkward burden on one's body or vehicle
items.ex_en: She had to tote her heavy luggage up three flights of narrow stairs.
items.ex_zh: 她不得不扛着沉重的行李爬上三段狭窄的楼梯。

items.def_en: To convey people, vehicles, or goods across water or between points as a regular service
items.ex_en: Small boats regularly ferry supplies and passengers between the mainland and the island.
items.ex_zh: 小船定期在大脑和海岛之间摆渡运送物资与乘客。

items.def_en: To transport people or cargo frequently back and forth between two fixed destinations
items.ex_en: Vans shuttle hotel guests between the international terminal and the downtown resort every hour.
items.ex_zh: 面包车每小时在国际航站楼和市中心度假村之间穿梭往返运送酒店客人。
items.ex2_en: The swift electric train shuttles between both major airport terminals every morning.
items.ex2_zh: 这趟快捷的电车每天早晨穿梭在两大主要机场航站楼之间。

items.def_en: To travel by soliciting free rides from passing motor vehicles alongside a road
items.ex_en: Penniless students often hitchhike along coastal highways to save money during summer vacations.
items.ex_zh: 身无分文的学生在暑假期间常常沿沿海公路搭便车旅行以省钱。

items.def_zh: 背，骑在肩上；借助，搭乘（他人成果）
items.def_en: To ride or carry someone on one's back or shoulders; to use something that already exists to achieve a result.
items.ex_en: The startup hopes to piggyback on the multinational giant’s established logistics network.
items.ex_zh: 这家初创公司希望借助跨国巨头现成的物流网络来拓展业务。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses carrying a passenger on one's back, piggybacking onto another transport system, or hitching a ride along with an existing carrier. It captures physical carrying as well as metaphorical borrowing of infrastructure.
groups.summary_zh: 指背负人员、随带附载乘行，或借用已有载运系统搭便车附带前行。
groups.desc_en: Moving people, objects, or systems by physically bearing them, operating dedicated transit, or leveraging existing conveyances, differing from static 'holding' by active conveyance.
groups.desc_zh: 通过体能搬运、班次接驳或顺带捎载实现空间位移；与静止的'拿着(hold)'不同，侧重依托载体或利用现有运力进行的转移。
groups.nuance_en: tote: carry or lug heavy, bulky items around habitually (gun / bag / toddler) · ferry: transport passengers or goods repeatedly across a fixed short water/land route (passengers / supplies / commuters) · shuttle: transport people back and forth frequently between two set locations (tourists / crew / passengers) · hitchhike: solicit free rides in passing vehicles from strangers (ride / highway / journey) · piggyback: ride on someone's back or exploit an existing system/infrastructure (child / infrastructure / proposal)
groups.nuance_zh: tote: 随身携带或吃力提携笨重物品 (gun / bag / toddler) · ferry: 摆渡，短途反复运送人员或物资穿梭水陆 (passengers / supplies / commuters) · shuttle: 穿梭往返接送 (tourists / crew / passengers) · hitchhike: 在路边拦车搭便车长途旅行 (ride / highway / journey) · piggyback: 骑在背上驮着，或顺带借用现有系统顺水推舟 (child / infrastructure / proposal)

groups.name: Hobnob & Mingle with Elites · 结交与逢迎权贵 (Hobnob, Rub Shoulders, Fraternize)
groups.tip: 与显贵攀附亲近把酒言欢

items.def_en: (informal; + with) To hang out as close friends or companions, often strategically
items.ex_en: The young lobbyist tried hard to pal around with influential members of parliament.
items.ex_zh: 那位年轻的说客极力想与有影响力的国会议员们称兄道弟。

items.def_zh: 与…并肩结交，与名流过从
items.def_en: (+ with) To meet and spend social time with famous, powerful, or important people
items.ex_en: At the film premiere, she got to rub shoulders with distinguished Hollywood directors.
items.ex_zh: 在电影首映礼上，她得以与好莱坞知名导演们并肩结交。

items.def_en: (+ with) To spend time socially with people, especially when this is considered inappropriate or forbidden
items.ex_en: Military officers are strictly forbidden to fraternize with enlisted personnel during active duty.
items.ex_zh: 在现役期间，军官被严令禁止与入伍士兵过从甚密。

items.def_en: (+ with) To associate habitually with someone, typically someone disreputable
items.ex_en: Police warned the suspect not to consort with known gang members anymore.
items.ex_zh: 警方警告该嫌疑人不要再与已知的帮派分子厮混交往。

items.def_zh: （与显贵或名人）亲切交往，过从甚密
items.def_en: (+ with) (informal) To spend time being friendly with someone, especially those who are rich, famous, or influential.
items.ex_en: The ambitious author loved to hobnob with wealthy patrons at exclusive gallery openings.
items.ex_zh: 那位雄心勃勃的作家热衷于在高档画廊开幕式上与富有的赞助人亲切交往。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe mixing socially or cultivating familiarity with prestigious, powerful, or influential circles, often with undertones of social climbing or impropriety.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重与地位高、有权势者周旋结交或过从甚密，常含奉迎之意。
groups.desc_en: Associating socially and informally with influential, elite, or inappropriate circles, contrasting with neutral 'meeting' by carrying connotations of social climbing, intimacy, or questionable familiarity.
groups.desc_zh: 与上流名流、权贵或不合宜的人员混迹交往；与中性的'会见(meet)'不同，多带有向上逢迎、拉拢关系或过从甚密的色彩。
groups.nuance_en: pal around: spend leisure time companionably as casual buddies (friends / colleagues / youth) · rub shoulders: mingle and come into close social contact with luminaries (elites / royalty / celebrities) · fraternize: associate intimately with people from an opposing, forbidden, or unequal group (enemy / troops / subordinates) · consort: associate habitually with persons of disreputable, illicit, or criminal character (criminals / rebels / smugglers) · hobnob: mix socially and drink familiarly with influential or upper-class figures (royalty / politicians / elite)
groups.nuance_zh: pal around: 像老哥们儿一样结伴混在一起闲逛 (friends / colleagues / youth) · rub shoulders: 与名流、权贵等平起平坐地社交往来 (elites / royalty / celebrities) · fraternize: 违规与敌方人员或下属亲善交好 (enemy / troops / subordinates) · consort: 与品行不端、罪犯等不良分子同流合污 (criminals / rebels / smugglers) · hobnob: 专与政商名流高层杯酒交错、亲热结交 (royalty / politicians / elite)

groups.name: Hold Dear & Nurture · 珍爱与珍视 (Prize, Treasure, Foster)
groups.tip: 视若珍宝悉心呵护关爱

items.def_en: To value something extremely highly because it is rare, useful, or precious
items.ex_en: Scholars prize ancient manuscripts for their unique historical insights and remarkable linguistic rarity.
items.ex_zh: 学者们高度珍视古代手稿，因其蕴含独特的历史见解和罕见的语言学价值。

items.def_en: To nurture, encourage, or hold dear a feeling, belief, or hope over time
items.ex_en: Despite repeated setbacks, she continued to foster a profound hope for lasting reconciliation.
items.ex_zh: 尽管屡遭挫折，她仍旧心怀对实现持久和解的深切希望。

items.def_en: To value, cherish, or care about someone or something with deep devotion
items.ex_en: He will always hold dear the timeless values his grandfather instilled in him.
items.ex_zh: 他将永远深切珍视祖父灌输给他的永恒价值观。

items.def_en: To keep an affectionate thought, secret hope, or deep feeling in mind
items.ex_en: She secretly harbored the longing to establish her own independent publishing house someday.
items.ex_zh: 她暗中怀揣着有朝一日创办属于自己的独立出版社的渴望。

items.def_zh: 珍爱，珍视；怀抱（希望、想法等）
items.def_en: 1. To love, hold dear, and protect someone or something affectionately. 2. To keep a hope, belief, or memory fondly in one's mind.
items.ex_en: The elderly couple cherishes every single moment spent together in their quiet garden.
items.ex_zh: 这对老夫妇深切珍视在宁静的花园里共度的每一刻时光。

groups.summary_en: This frame denotes regarding someone or an inward belief/memory with profound warmth, protective affection, and continual emotional devotion.
groups.summary_zh: 表达对人或珍视的信念、回忆怀抱深厚爱意与保护性珍视。
groups.desc_en: Holding persons, memories, or ideals in deep emotional regard and actively sustaining them, differing from detached 'valuing' through intense emotional attachment and protective care.
groups.desc_zh: 在内心深处对人、记忆或理想怀有极高的情感依恋并予以悉心呵护；与客观的'重视(value)'相比，充满深情寄托与庇护感。
groups.nuance_en: prize: place extraordinary competitive or objective value on something (possession / trophy / independence) · foster: encourage the development, growth, and nurture of something positive (talent / relationship / growth) · hold dear: regard with profound, protective affection in one's heart (family / memories / freedom) · harbor: cling inwardly to lingering emotions or secretly shelter fugitives (resentment / hopes / illusions) · cherish: treat with tender, protective love and treasure fondly (memory / friendship / moment)
groups.nuance_zh: prize: 将某物视作珍品或稀世战利品般高度看重 (possession / trophy / independence) · foster: 悉心培养、抚育并促进其健康成长 (talent / relationship / growth) · hold dear: 视如珍宝，在心底奉为至爱 (family / memories / freedom) · harbor: 长期心存某种念头/情绪，或暗中包庇窝藏 (resentment / hopes / illusions) · cherish: 珍爱、珍视并温情守护美好回忆或关系 (memory / friendship / moment)

groups.name: Hone & Cultivate · 磨砺与精进 (Hone in, Perfect, Temper)
groups.tip: 反复切磋琢磨，技能更显精湛

items.def_en: To deliberately develop, sharpen, and improve a talent, habit, or area of competence over time
items.ex_en: Diplomats must cultivate patience and exceptional tact to navigate these delicate negotiations successfully.
items.ex_zh: 外交官必须培养耐心和卓越的机敏，以顺利推进这些棘手的谈判。

items.def_zh: 磨快，用磨刀石磨；磨砺，提升（技能）
items.def_en: 1. To sharpen a blade on a whetstone. 2. To refine or improve a skill, technique, or argument over time.
items.ex_en: The experienced orator practiced daily to hone his persuasive speaking style before debates.
items.ex_zh: 这位经验丰富的演说家每天练习，以便在辩论前磨砺出具有说服力的演讲风格。

items.def_en: To practice and refine a skill or technique until it is completely free of faults
items.ex_en: The surgeon spent decades refining delicate procedures to perfect her innovative transplantation technique.
items.ex_zh: 这位外科医生耗费数十年改良精细手术，以使她创新的移植技术臻于完美。

items.def_en: To develop a strong skill, alliance, or character through intense, demanding effort and discipline
items.ex_en: Challenging conditions helped the young soldiers forge an unbreakable bond of mutual trust.
items.ex_zh: 艰苦的条件锤炼出年轻士兵之间坚不可摧的互信纽带。

items.def_en: To strengthen and toughen metal or personal character through strenuous hardship and testing
items.ex_en: Years of severe personal adversity had tempered her resolve rather than weakening it.
items.ex_zh: 多年的重大个人困境不仅没有削弱她的决心，反而淬炼了她的意志。

groups.summary_en: Pertains to developing expertise, discipline, or an acute instinct through protracted practice, disciplined rigor, and continuous refinement, evolving from working on a fine whetstone to honing one's professional craft.
groups.summary_zh: 强调经由长期修习、刻意训练与砥砺，使技艺或心智臻于精熟。
groups.desc_en: Sharpening, refining, and hardening skills, qualities, or objects through rigorous repetitive training or testing, contrasting with simple 'learning' through progressive mastery under duress.
groups.desc_zh: 通过反复严酷的训练、淬火或打磨，使技能或品格臻于极致；与普通的'学习(learn)'相比，强调高强度的精雕细琢与去芜存菁。
groups.nuance_en: cultivate: develop deliberately over time through patient effort (relationship / taste / mind) · hone: sharpen a skill, argument, or blade to razor precision (skills / craft / edge) · perfect: bring to an ideal state devoid of any flaw or defect (technique / art / pitch) · forge: create something strong and enduring through extreme heat, labor, or trial (alliance / identity / sword) · temper: moderate or strengthen metal/character through exposure to hardship (justice / steel / enthusiasm)
groups.nuance_zh: cultivate: 长期耐心培养滋养出良好品位、关系或心智 (relationship / taste / mind) · hone: 磨砺刀锋般将技艺或论辩锤炼至极高精度 (skills / craft / edge) · perfect: 精益求精直至无可挑剔、臻于完美 (technique / art / pitch) · forge: 如铁匠锻造般在逆境考验中铸就牢固羁绊或坚毅品质 (alliance / identity / sword) · temper: 经受磨炼而使性格更坚韧成熟，或在烈度中调和平衡 (justice / steel / enthusiasm)

groups.name: Honor & Fete · 盛赞与款待 (Honor, Toast, Lionize)
groups.tip: 大张旗鼓地设宴庆祝赞颂

items.def_en: To show great respect and admiration for someone in a public ceremony or through an award
items.ex_en: The university planned to honor the renowned biologist for his groundbreaking genetic research.
items.ex_zh: 该大学计划表彰这位著名生物学家在基因研究领域取得的开创性成就。

items.def_en: To drink to the health, success, or honor of someone, or to celebrate someone publicly
items.ex_en: Guests raised their glasses to toast the newlyweds' good fortune and lifelong happiness.
items.ex_zh: 宾客们举起酒杯，为新婚夫妇的美满运势与终身幸福祝酒。
items.ex2_en: The crisp bread slices toast quickly in the modern convection toaster.
items.ex2_zh: 薄脆的面包片在现代热风烤面包机中很快就能烤香酥脆。

items.def_zh: 把……奉为名人，捧为重要人物
items.def_en: To treat someone as a celebrity or person of great public importance, showering them with social attention
items.ex_en: The local media began to lionize the young entrepreneur after her startup valuation soared.
items.ex_zh: 在那位年轻企业家的初创公司估值飙升后，当地媒体开始将她捧为大人物。

items.def_en: To praise someone or their achievements highly and publicly
items.ex_en: Critics united to laud the novelist’s latest masterpiece for its emotional depth and originality.
items.ex_zh: 评论家们一致盛赞这位小说家的最新杰作，称赞其情感深度与独创性。

items.def_zh: 设宴庆祝，盛情款待；赞扬，颂扬
items.def_en: 1. To honor, praise, and entertain someone publicly with parties and celebrations.
items.ex_en: The city council organized a lavish banquet to fete the returning Olympic champions.
items.ex_zh: 市议会组织了一场盛大的宴会，以盛情款待凯旋的奥运冠军们。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on publicly celebrating and showing homage to individuals through elaborate ceremonies, official banquets, or public accolades. It highlights visible, socialized displays of esteem.
groups.summary_zh: 通过宴请、举杯或隆重仪式公开表达崇敬与盛大款待。
groups.desc_en: Publicly celebrating, exalting, and showering distinction upon a person or their achievements, differing from modest 'praising' through formal ceremonies, grand toasts, or celebrity elevation.
groups.desc_zh: 公开举行仪式盛大赞誉、犒劳并推崇某人及其功绩；与一般的'表扬(praise)'不同，侧重高规格的社会仪式感、敬意与追捧。
groups.nuance_en: honor: pay formal respect, public distinction, or institutional homage (hero / contract / memory) · toast: drink socially to celebrate a person's health, fortune, or milestone (couple / victory / bride) · lionize: treat someone socially as a sensational celebrity and hero (author / guest / prodigy) · laud: extol and praise enthusiastically and publicly in speech or print (achievement / performance / effort) · fete: entertain and honor lavishly with grand parties and festivities (dignitary / champion / hero)
groups.nuance_zh: honor: 赋予崇高荣誉、表彰或遵从诺言 (hero / contract / memory) · toast: 举杯祝酒致敬以示庆祝 (couple / victory / bride) · lionize: 将某人捧为大名人或超级英雄般众星捧月 (author / guest / prodigy) · laud: 极力颂扬、在公开言辞中赞不绝口 (achievement / performance / effort) · fete: 设盛宴盛情款待并隆重庆贺 (dignitary / champion / hero)

groups.name: Host & Moderate · 主持与引导 (Emcee, Host, Moderate)
groups.tip: 担任司仪主持活动与场面

items.def_en: To act as the host or presenter for an event, television show, or social gathering
items.ex_en: The popular comedian was invited to host the prestigious annual music awards ceremony.
items.ex_zh: 这位广受欢迎的喜剧演员受邀主持备受瞩目的年度音乐颁奖典礼。

items.def_en: To preside over a debate, panel, or discussion to ensure orderly participation and fairness
items.ex_en: A respected journalist was chosen to moderate the contentious debate between both presidential candidates.
items.ex_zh: 一位受人尊敬的记者被选中来主持两位总统候选人之间激烈的辩论。
items.ex2_en: The scorching desert heat moderated noticeably as the evening breeze arrived.
items.ex2_zh: 随着晚风吹来，沙漠灼人的酷热明显变得温和缓和。

items.def_en: To act as the master of ceremonies or presenter for a variety show or performance
items.ex_en: He was asked to compere the charity talent show at the local theater.
items.ex_zh: 他受邀在当地剧场担任那场慈善达人秀的主持人。

items.def_en: (+ over) To be in the position of authority or chairman at a formal meeting, court, or ceremony
items.ex_en: The senior judge will preside over the high-profile constitutional tribunal tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 资深法官将于明晨主持这场备受瞩目的宪法特别法庭审理。

items.def_en: To act as master of ceremonies for a show, event, or celebration.
items.ex_en: My outgoing uncle agreed to emcee our wedding reception and entertain the guests.
items.ex_zh: 我那性格外向的叔叔答应担任我们婚宴的司仪，并为宾客助兴。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on leading, presiding over, or coordinating formal events, public shows, discussions, or gatherings to ensure smooth execution.
groups.summary_zh: 指在活动、会议或仪式中担任主持人并把控全场。
groups.desc_en: Serving as the master of ceremonies, presiding figure, or neutral facilitator regulating an event or public debate, contrasting with passive 'attending' through active structural control.
groups.desc_zh: 作为司仪、主持人或中立协调者组织并调控公共活动、庆典或辩论；与被动的'参与(participate)'不同，具有掌控全场节奏的职能。
groups.nuance_en: host: provide hospitality, venue, and lead the presentation of an event (dinner / show / talks) · moderate: facilitate balanced discussion neutrally and enforce ground rules (debate / panel / forum) · compere: act as an entertaining master of ceremonies for a variety show or pageant (ceremony / variety show / gala) · preside: occupy the official chair and exercise procedural authority over an assembly (meeting / court / session) · emcee: dynamically introduce acts, speakers, and maintain energetic pacing on stage (reception / awards / gala)
groups.nuance_zh: host: 设宴招待或作为东道主主持节目与会议 (dinner / show / talks) · moderate: 居中调停，以中立裁判身份主持研讨或辩论 (debate / panel / forum) · compere: 担任演艺晚会、杂耍或典礼的司仪穿针引线 (ceremony / variety show / gala) · preside: 依章程行使职权、严肃主持正式议事法庭 (meeting / court / session) · emcee: 在现场舞台上报幕串场、活跃气氛并掌控活动节奏 (reception / awards / gala)

groups.name: House-train & Condition · 训导与如厕习惯养成 (Housebreak, Train, Habituate)
groups.tip: 训练宠物养成良好居家习惯

items.def_en: To train a pet to accept and view an indoor crate as a safe resting shelter
items.ex_en: You should crate-train your puppy early so that it feels comfortable during travel.
items.ex_zh: 你应该尽早训练小狗适应笼具，这样它在旅行时就会感到安心舒适。

items.def_zh: 训练养成习惯，建立条件反射
items.def_en: To train an animal or person to behave in a certain way through repeated stimulus
items.ex_en: The behavioral psychologist attempted to condition the subjects to associate chimes with relaxation.
items.ex_zh: 这位行为心理学家试图对受试者建立条件反射，让他们把钟声与放松联系起来。

items.def_en: To teach a dog or other young animal not to relieve itself inside the house
items.ex_en: It took several patient weeks to house-train the rescued stray dog completely.
items.ex_zh: 花了几个星期耐心的训练，才完全教会这只获救的流浪狗在户外排便。

items.def_en: To train a kitten or small animal to urinate and defecate exclusively in a litter box
items.ex_en: It is surprisingly easy to litter-train young kittens using gentle positive reinforcement.
items.ex_zh: 采用温和的正向激励法训练小猫使用猫砂盆出奇地容易。

items.def_zh: 训导（宠物）不在室内排便，养成居家卫生习惯
items.def_en: (North American) To train a pet dog or cat to urinate and defecate outdoors or in a litter box rather than inside the house.
items.ex_en: New pet owners often seek professional advice to housebreak their energetic young puppies.
items.ex_zh: 新宠物主人通常会寻求专业建议，以训练精力充沛的小狗养成不在室内排便的卫生习惯。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on behavioral conditioning of domestic pets to adapt to household sanitary rules and human indoor living.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过行为纠正与习惯训导，使家宠遵守室内规矩和排泄准则。
groups.desc_en: Conditioning a pet or animal to adopt domestic hygiene habits, crate comfort, and house rules, differing from general 'training' by focusing specifically on elimination and domestic coexistence.
groups.desc_zh: 训练宠物养成在固定地点排便、适应笼舍及遵守室内居处规则的习惯；与宽泛的'训练(train)'相比，专指宠物室内卫生与定点排泄训育。
groups.nuance_en: crate-train: condition a dog to feel secure and rest calmly inside a designated crate (puppy / dog / rescue) · condition: train behavioral reflexes over time through repetitive positive/negative stimuli (behavior / reflex / animal) · house-train: teach an indoor pet to excrete outside or in an allocated space (puppy / pet / kitten) · litter-train: teach an animal, especially a cat, to use a designated litter box (kitten / cat / rabbit) · housebreak: traditional North American term for eliminating indoor soiling habits in a domestic pet (dog / puppy / pet)
groups.nuance_zh: crate-train: 训练幼犬适应笼内环境并将其视为安全巢穴 (puppy / dog / rescue) · condition: 借助条件反射机制塑造生物习惯与行为反应 (behavior / reflex / animal) · house-train: 训练宠物不在室内随地便溺、去户外排泄 (puppy / pet / kitten) · litter-train: 训练幼猫等在指定猫砂盆内定点如厕 (kitten / cat / rabbit) · housebreak: 驯化宠物改掉室内脏污恶习，学会规矩居家（美式传统用词） (dog / puppy / pet)

groups.name: Hug & Cuddle · 拥抱与相拥依偎 (Hug, Cuddle, Snuggle)
groups.tip: 张开双臂搂抱或紧密依偎

items.def_zh: 紧抱，拥抱；搂抱；紧贴，挨着
items.def_en: To squeeze someone tightly in your arms, usually with fondness; to stay very close to something
items.ex_en: She stepped forward to hug her sister warmly after months of painful separation.
items.ex_zh: 在经历了数月痛苦的分离后，她走上前去紧紧拥抱自己的姐姐。

items.def_en: To grip or hug someone firmly and closely with deep emotional intensity
items.ex_en: Terrified by the sudden thunder, the frightened toddler held tight to his mother.
items.ex_zh: 被突如其来的雷声吓坏了的蹒跚幼童紧紧抱着他的母亲。

items.def_en: To hold someone close in an affectionate, protective, and comfortable way for a prolonged period
items.ex_en: The exhausted couple decided to cuddle on the sofa while watching old movies.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的夫妇决定依偎在沙发上搂抱在一起看老电影。

items.def_en: (+ against/into) To press oneself gently and affectionately into a warm, snug position against another person
items.ex_en: The sleepy child gently nestled against her father’s warm shoulder on the train.
items.ex_zh: 昏昏欲睡的孩子在火车上温柔地依偎在父亲温暖的肩膀上。
items.ex2_en: The doting mother nestled her sleeping baby into the soft woolen blanket.
items.ex2_zh: 慈爱的母亲将熟睡的婴儿轻柔地抱进柔软的羊毛毯中。

items.def_en: (+ up to/against) To settle or press into a warm, comfortable position close to someone else
items.ex_en: The cold cat jumped onto the bed to snuggle up against my legs.
items.ex_zh: 受冻的猫跳上床，蜷缩着紧贴着我的双腿取暖。

groups.summary_en: This frame expresses physical warmth, affection, and comfort achieved by folding arms around someone or pressing closely against them, moving from brief greetings to sustained, cozy embraces.
groups.summary_zh: 指出于亲情、温存或安慰而展开的双臂环抱或亲昵贴靠，展现人际温度。
groups.desc_en: Holding another entity closely in an embrace of affection, warmth, comfort, and physical intimacy, contrasting with instrumental 'holding' through emotional tenderness and mutual shelter.
groups.desc_zh: 将他人或爱宠紧紧拥入怀中以表达爱抚、温存与慰藉；与机械的'抓持(hold)'不同，充满亲密爱意与寻求庇护的安全感。
groups.nuance_en: hug: clasp tightly in one's arms as a greeting, comfort, or sign of affection (child / friend / mother) · hold tight: grip firmly in an embrace to prevent slipping or convey desperate security (baby / partner / railing) · cuddle: hold close lovingly and fondle gently in a warm, relaxed posture (baby / partner / pet) · nestle: settle down snugly, comfortably, and protectedly into a soft recess (head / cushion / infant) · snuggle: curl up affectionately and closely against someone or into warm bedding (under blankets / against mother / puppy)
groups.nuance_zh: hug: 伸展双臂热烈或安慰性地拥抱 (child / friend / mother) · hold tight: 紧紧抱住不放以给予抓牢的安全感 (baby / partner / railing) · cuddle: 长时间温柔地搂抱抚爱以共享依偎之情 (baby / partner / pet) · nestle: 安然依偎、将头或身躯嵌在柔软怀抱或深处 (head / cushion / infant) · snuggle: 蜷缩身子亲昵贴紧他人或钻入被窝取暖 (under blankets / against mother / puppy)

groups.name: Hurdle & Vault · 跃过与飞跨 (Hurdle, Vault, Clear, Leap)
groups.tip: 腾空而起越过前方障碍

items.def_en: To push oneself into the air and pass completely over an object on the ground
items.ex_en: The athletic horse was able to jump over the high wooden fence effortlessly.
items.ex_zh: 那匹矫健的马毫不费力地纵身跳过了高高的木栅栏。

items.def_en: To jump high and across an intervening gap or barrier with sudden agility
items.ex_en: The frightened deer managed to leap over the wooden fence and vanish into the woods.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的鹿设法一跃跳过木栅栏，消失在树林中。

items.def_en: To jump over an obstacle or bar without touching, clipping, or knocking it down
items.ex_en: With a graceful final stride, the champion managed to clear the high bar effortlessly.
items.ex_zh: 凭借优美的最后一步跨越，冠军轻松跃过了横杆。
items.ex2_en: The dense morning fog cleared slowly over the sunlit rolling hillside.
items.ex2_zh: 浓郁的晨雾在洒满阳光的起伏山坡上慢慢消散了。

items.def_zh: 跨越（栏架、障碍）；克服（难关）
items.def_en: 1. To jump over a barrier or obstacle while running. 2. To successfully deal with or overcome a problem or difficulty.
items.ex_en: The startup must hurdle several regulatory obstacles before launching its medical product nationwide.
items.ex_zh: 这家初创公司在全国推广其医疗产品之前，必须克服若干监管难关。

items.def_en: (+ over) To leap over an obstacle using one's hands, arms, or a pole to push off
items.ex_en: The suspect used both hands to vault over the turnstile and fled onto the platform.
items.ex_zh: 嫌疑人双手一撑，飞跃过闸机，逃到了站台上。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on leaping cleanly over an obstacle, fence, or barricade while maintaining running momentum or using hands/poles as props. 'Clear' emphasizes not touching the bar; 'vault' involves springing using an arm or lever.
groups.summary_zh: 指奔跑中跨跃障碍物，或借力腾跃翻过栅栏矮墙等。
groups.desc_en: Overcoming high physical obstacles or systemic barriers by propelling oneself cleanly into the air and over them, differing from horizontal 'jumping' by clearing vertical elevation.
groups.desc_zh: 凭借自身爆发力跃向空中，干净利落地跨越垂直障碍；与水平方向的'跳跃(jump)'相比，侧重跨越有高度的实体阻碍或关卡。
groups.nuance_en: jump over: propel off the ground to bypass an obstacle in a basic motion (fence / puddle / wall) · leap over: spring gracefully, dynamically, and vigorously across a broad or high hazard (stream / barrier / ditch) · clear: pass completely over a barrier without touching or dislodging it (bar / hurdle / obstacle) · hurdle: leap over a dedicated barrier mid-sprint or conquer a formidable procedural hurdle (barrier / fence / obstacle) · vault: leap over an obstacle by pushing off with one's hands or a pole (gate / wall / fence)
groups.nuance_zh: jump over: 基础腾空越过障碍物 (fence / puddle / wall) · leap over: 舒展而大步流星地纵身飞跃障碍 (stream / barrier / ditch) · clear: 腾空越过且身体未触碰打落横杆或阻碍 (bar / hurdle / obstacle) · hurdle: 奔跑中跨栏疾跃，或逐一跨越程序性障碍 (barrier / fence / obstacle) · vault: 用手掌一撑或借助撑杆纵身翻越障碍 (gate / wall / fence)

groups.name: Identify & Flag · 附标与标识 (Tag, Flag, Tab)
groups.tip: 打上标签或符号以便辨识

items.def_en: To mark or signal something clearly so that it will receive notice, inspection, or action
items.ex_en: Auditors quickly flag any unusual transactions that exceed the company's daily spending limit.
items.ex_zh: 审计人员会迅速标出任何超出公司每日支出限额的异常交易。

items.def_zh: 给……加上标签，标明；尾随，紧跟
items.def_en: 1. To attach a label or tag to something to identify or describe it. 2. (+ along / after) To follow closely behind someone.
items.ex_en: My little brother always wants to tag along whenever I go out with friends.
items.ex_zh: 每当我和朋友出去时，我弟弟总是想跟在后头。

items.def_en: To furnish with a small protruding label or index marker for convenient identification
items.ex_en: Please tab the relevant tax documents so the accountant can review them immediately.
items.ex_zh: 请在相关税务文件上贴好标签页，以便会计师能够立即审阅。

items.def_en: To set aside, reserve, or mark something distinctively for a dedicated future purpose
items.ex_en: The city council voted to earmark surplus revenue specifically for renovating municipal parks.
items.ex_zh: 市议会投票决定将结余财政收入专门拨用于修缮市政公园。

items.def_zh: 给（文件等）编签；摘要标记
items.def_en: To attach a brief informative summary label or tracking number to a document or package
items.ex_en: The court clerk proceeded to docket each motion before submitting the files to the judge.
items.ex_zh: 法庭书记员在将卷宗呈送法官之前，依次为每份动议编签归档。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on attaching physical markers, digital markers, or visual indicators to objects, data, or files for tracking, indexing, identification, or highlighting for follow-up.
groups.summary_zh: 为物品、文件或数据附加标记、便签或元数据，以便检索追踪与提示。
groups.desc_en: Marking, labeling, or identifying specific items, data, or files for alert, categorization, or future administrative action, contrasting with simple 'seeing' by appending explicit markers.
groups.desc_zh: 为特定项目、数据或文档附加醒目标签或标记，以示警告、归类或备忘处理；与笼统的'观察(see)'不同，带有管理与警示目的的标识行为。
groups.nuance_en: flag: draw urgent attention to an item requiring review, warning, or inspection (error / post / email) · tag: attach an identifying label, digital metadata, or moniker to an entity (photo / luggage / price) · tab: mark with an indexed protruding strip for easy retrieval (page / file / document) · earmark: designate funds, resources, or items formally for a specific dedicated purpose (funds / budget / grant) · docket: formally register, summarize, and schedule a legal proceeding or item on a calendar (case / trial / petition)
groups.nuance_zh: flag: 标出可疑、违规或需紧急核查的事项报警报备 (error / post / email) · tag: 贴上物理标签或打上数字化检索标签 (photo / luggage / price) · tab: 加装突出索引标签以便迅速查阅 (page / file / document) · earmark: 专项划拨或指定预留款项资金以备专用 (funds / budget / grant) · docket: 将诉讼案件或待办事项排入官方日程或盖印归档 (case / trial / petition)

groups.name: Idle & Stagnate · 闲置与停滞 (Stagnate, Stall, Sit)
groups.tip: 不运转或发展停滞不前

items.def_en: To remain unused, untouched, and neglected on a shelf or in storage for a long period
items.ex_en: His expensive new exercise bike has been left to gather dust in the basement.
items.ex_zh: 他那台昂贵的新健身车一直被扔在地下室里积灰。

items.def_en: To come to an unintentional stop or cause a motor, process, or initiative to halt unexpectedly
items.ex_en: Negotiations between the two rival parties threaten to stall over disagreements on tax reform.
items.ex_zh: 两派之间的谈判因在税制改革上的分歧而面临停滞的危险。
items.ex2_en: The rookie driver accidentally stalled the manual car in heavy rush-hour traffic.
items.ex2_zh: 这位新手司机在高峰期拥堵的交通中不小心将手动挡车憋灭火了。

items.def_zh: 闲置，不运转；（发动机）空转；虚度（光阴）
items.def_en: 1. (of an engine or machine) To run slowly while not engaged in gear or doing active work. 2. To spend time doing nothing productive. 3. ('idle away') To waste time in inactivity.
items.ex_en: Delivery drivers are strictly forbidden to idle their diesel engines outside residential buildings.
items.ex_zh: 送货司机严禁在居民楼外让柴油发动机空转。

items.def_en: To stop developing, flowing, growing, or progressing, often deteriorating as a result
items.ex_en: Without substantial investment in modern technology, the domestic manufacturing sector will inevitably stagnate.
items.ex_zh: 若不对现代技术进行大量投资，国内制造业将不可避免地陷入停滞。

items.def_zh: 虚度光阴；无所事事过活
items.def_en: To live a totally passive, dull, and inactive life with little mental stimulation
items.ex_en: Instead of seeking a new job, he chose to vegetate on the couch all summer.
items.ex_zh: 他整个夏天都选择赖在沙发上虚度光阴，而不是去寻找一份新工作。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers persons, machines, or processes remaining inactive, unproductive, or stalled over time. Nuances differentiate mechanical ticking without load from economic and personal decay.
groups.summary_zh: 缺乏运动、生产力或进展，处于停止运转或荒废状态。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an absence of productive motion, growth, or vitality, contrasting with deliberate rest by implying neglect, decay, or unwanted inertia.
groups.desc_zh: 指缺乏生产性运动、增长或活力的状态；与主动的“休息”不同，本框架强调被动忽视、停滞衰退或非自愿的停顿。
groups.nuance_en: idle: run or exist without doing useful work (engine / workforce) · gather dust: remain disused and neglected over time (report / manuscript / project) · stall: bring or come to an abrupt, unintended halt (negotiations / momentum / car) · stagnate: cease developing or flowing, becoming stale (economy / career / water) · vegetate: live a dull, passive existence devoid of mental stimulation (patient / retiree)
groups.nuance_zh: idle: 空转或无所事事 (engine / workforce) · gather dust: 长期弃置落灰 (report / manuscript / project) · stall: 突然陷入停顿或阻滞 (negotiations / momentum / car) · stagnate: 停止流动或发展以致腐坏变质 (economy / career / water) · vegetate: 浑浑噩噩过无脑消极的生活 (patient / retiree)

groups.name: Illicit Forcing & Lock-Prying · 撬锁与破门 (Jimmy, Pick, Shimm)
groups.tip: 用撬棍等小工具强行撬锁开门

items.def_en: Bypass a spring latch or adjust alignment by inserting a very thin wedge or strip
items.ex_en: With practiced stealth, the thief used a thin plastic strip to shim the parlor latch.
items.ex_zh: 那贼熟练而隐秘地用一根塑料薄片滑撬开客厅的门闩。

items.def_en: Open a lock without its proper key by manipulating the internal tumblers with a thin tool
items.ex_en: The burglar managed to pick the antique padlock without leaving any noticeable scratch marks.
items.ex_zh: 窃贼设法挑开了那把古董挂锁，没有留下任何明显的划痕。

items.def_en: To force open a lock, window, or door using a crowbar or small tool.
items.ex_en: Someone managed to jimmy the back window while the homeowners were asleep upstairs.
items.ex_zh: 趁着房主在楼上熟睡，有人撬开了后窗。

items.def_en: Enter a locked building, vehicle, or room illegally by picking or smashing locks
items.ex_en: Masked thieves tried to break into the jewelry store during the heavy storm last night.
items.ex_zh: 昨晚暴风雨期间，蒙面窃贼企图破门强行闯入珠宝店。

items.def_zh: 用短撬棒撬开（英式写法）
items.def_en: Force open a window or door with a burglar's small pry bar
items.ex_en: The intruder used a short crowbar to jemmy the wooden side door open.
items.ex_zh: 闯入者用一根短撬棒撬开了侧面的木门。

groups.summary_en: Applies to breaking into locks, windows, or doors using improvised flat tools, lockpicks, or wire implements, especially associated with illicit entry or lock manipulation.
groups.summary_zh: 特指使用细扁工具、铁丝等撬开门窗锁具或强行突破防盗装置。
groups.desc_en: Involves gaining unauthorized physical entry via specialized manipulation or mechanical leverage rather than brute destructive smashing.
groups.desc_zh: 指利用技巧性手法或杠杆外力非法开启锁具或门窗，区别于单纯粗暴的砸门破入。
groups.nuance_en: pick: manipulate lock pins with fine tools without damage (lock / padlock / safe) · shim: slide a thin wedge into a latch mechanism to release it (latch / door / bolt) · jimmy: pry open using a crowbar or leverage (window / drawer / sash) · jemmy: British spelling/variant of jimmying with leverage (crowbar / lock / window) · break into: gain forced illegal entry generally (house / office / vehicle)
groups.nuance_zh: pick: 用细小工具无损拨弄锁芯 (lock / padlock / safe) · shim: 用薄垫片插拨锁舌撬开 (latch / door / bolt) · jimmy: 用撬棍等杠杆强行撬开 (window / drawer / sash) · jemmy: （英式）用撬棒撬启 (crowbar / lock / window) · break into: 强行非法闯入的大范畴表达 (house / office / vehicle)

groups.name: Illuminate & Brighten · 照亮与点亮 (Light, Illuminate, Brighten)
groups.tip: 引入光源照亮物体

items.def_en: 1. To provide light for something or make it brighter. 2. To start to burn or make something start burning.
items.ex_en: A single streetlamp was positioned outside to light the dark narrow alley at night.
items.ex_zh: 外面立着一盏路灯，在夜间照亮那条黑暗狭窄的小巷。

items.def_en: To illuminate an entire place brightly, or become full of radiant light
items.ex_en: Spectacular fireworks burst across the harbor to light up the midnight sky beautifully.
items.ex_zh: 璀璨的烟花在港口上空绽放，将午夜的夜空照得通明。
items.ex2_en: The dark city streets lit up brightly as the holiday lamps turned on.
items.ex2_zh: 随着节日彩灯亮起，昏暗的城市街道瞬间变得通明璀璨。

items.def_en: To light something up or provide light for an area so it becomes visible
items.ex_en: Powerful floodlights were installed to illuminate the ancient cathedral facade during evening tours.
items.ex_zh: 安装强力泛光灯是为了在晚间游览期间照亮古大教堂的正立面。

items.def_en: To make something lighter or more luminous, or to become visibly lighter
items.ex_en: The morning sun broke through thick clouds to brighten the damp forest floor.
items.ex_zh: 晨光穿透厚厚的云层，照亮了潮湿的森林地面。
items.ex2_en: Her expressive face brightened visibly upon hearing the heartwarming family news.
items.ex2_zh: 听到令人暖心的家庭喜讯后，她生动的脸庞明显容光焕发。

items.def_en: To illuminate something brightly with radiant beams or light rays
items.ex_en: Brilliant shafts of sunlight descend through the vaulted ceiling to irradiate the ancient sanctuary.
items.ex_zh: 灿烂的阳光穿透拱形天花板倾泻而下，照亮了古老的圣殿。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe supplying light to a dark space or object, varying from casting gentle ambient rays to flooding an entire area with brilliant luminescence.
groups.summary_zh: 向黑暗空间或物体提供光源，使其清晰、明亮或光芒四射。
groups.desc_en: Denotes casting light onto or into a space or object, differing from mere radiating by emphasizing the resulting visibility, clarity, or vividness.
groups.desc_zh: 指向空间或物体投射光线，与单纯的“发光”不同，本框架强调带来可见性、清晰度或明艳感。
groups.nuance_en: light: provide illumination naturally or artificially (room / path / candle) · light up: suddenly brighten or cause to glow intensely (face / sky / screen) · illuminate: flood with comprehensive, often clarifying light (manuscript / street / monument) · brighten: increase the degree of light or cheerfulness (room / horizon / smile) · irradiate: expose deeply to radiant energy or light (tumor / food / gloom)
groups.nuance_zh: light: 提供基础光亮以供照明 (room / path / candle) · light up: 突然照亮或绽放光彩 (face / sky / screen) · illuminate: 彻底照亮或使清晰显现 (manuscript / street / monument) · brighten: 使光度或神色变明朗 (room / horizon / smile) · irradiate: 深层放射照射或启迪 (tumor / food / gloom)

groups.name: Imagine & Fancy · 想象与设想 (Fancy, Envision, Picture)
groups.tip: 在脑海中构筑虚构意象

items.def_en: To form a clear visual image of an event, person, or setting in the mind
items.ex_en: I can easily picture him sitting peacefully by the lake on a sunny afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 我能轻易在脑海中勾勒出他在晴朗午后悠闲坐在湖边的景象。

items.def_en: To form a mental picture, concept, or idea of something not perceived through the senses
items.ex_en: It is difficult to imagine how early sailors navigated across treacherous oceans without modern instruments.
items.ex_zh: 很难想象早期的水手在没有现代仪器的情况下是如何在险恶的海洋中航行的。

items.def_zh: 想象，设想；想要，倾慕；自以为
items.def_en: 1. To imagine or picture something in your mind. 2. (informal) To want to have or do something, or feel sexually attracted to someone.
items.ex_en: Do you fancy getting a quick cup of coffee before the meeting starts?
items.ex_zh: 会议开始前你想不想去喝杯快咖啡？

items.def_en: To bring a vivid picture, memory, or idea vividly into conscious thought
items.ex_en: The aroma of freshly baked cinnamon bread served to conjure up fond childhood memories.
items.ex_zh: 新鲜出炉的肉桂面包香气在脑海中唤起了温馨的童年回忆。

items.def_en: To picture or visualize a future event or condition as a distinct mental possibility
items.ex_en: Urban planners envision a sustainable metropolitan district powered entirely by renewable wind and solar energy.
items.ex_zh: 城市规划者展望建立一个完全由可再生风能和太阳能供电的可持续大都市区。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate mentally conceptualizing, visualizing, or daydreaming hypothetical scenes, possibilities, or personal preferences.
groups.summary_zh: 指在大脑中勾画画面、假想可能情景或产生主观倾向与设想。
groups.desc_en: Involves forming a mental representation of something not currently present to the senses, ranging from whimsical daydreams to strategic projection.
groups.desc_zh: 指在头脑中构建感官未即时感知的事物表象，涵盖从随意遐想、具象重现到战略性预想的多种心理活动。
groups.nuance_en: imagine: mentally conceive of any possibility or scene (scenario / life / future) · picture: form a vivid, visual mental image (face / scene / outcome) · fancy: imagine playfully or entertain a notion with little basis (idea / yourself as) · envision: conceptualize a tangible future prospect or goal (success / reforms / society) · conjure up: evoke a vivid mental image as if by magic (memories / images / ghost)
groups.nuance_zh: imagine: 泛指构想各种可能性 (scenario / life / future) · picture: 在脑海中形成鲜活的视觉图景 (face / scene / outcome) · fancy: 异想天开或主观凭空设想 (idea / yourself as) · envision: 具象化展望未来愿景 (success / reforms / society) · conjure up: 宛若施法般凭空浮现出画面或记忆 (memories / images / ghost)

groups.name: Immigrate & Resettle · 迁入与定居 (Immigrate, Settle, Resettle)
groups.tip: 长途跋涉迁往新地定居

items.def_en: (+ in/down) To establish a permanent home and start living stably in a new place or country
items.ex_en: After years of constant travel, the couple decided to settle in a quiet coastal village.
items.ex_zh: 经过多年的奔波，这对夫妇决定在一个宁静的沿海村庄定居下来。

items.def_en: To establish oneself deeply and permanently as part of a new community or foreign land
items.ex_en: It took several years for the immigrant family to put down roots in the new city.
items.ex_zh: 这个移民家庭花了好几年时间才在这座新城市落地生根。

items.def_en: To send a group of settlers to a territory and establish political and social control over it
items.ex_en: Imperial explorers sought to colonize the remote archipelago and exploit its abundant natural resources.
items.ex_zh: 帝国探险家企图对这片偏远群岛进行拓殖，并掠夺其丰富的自然资源。

items.def_en: To come to live permanently in a foreign country.
items.ex_en: Thousands of skilled professionals choose to immigrate to Canada every year for better employment opportunities.
items.ex_zh: 每年有成千上万的技术人才选择移民加拿大，以寻求更好的就业机会。

items.def_zh: 重新定居；安置（移民、难民）
items.def_en: (+ in) To move to a new country or community and establish a life there, often after displacement
items.ex_en: International relief organizations helped thousands of displaced refugees resettle in safe host communities abroad.
items.ex_zh: 国际救援组织帮助数千名流离失所的难民在国外的安全接纳社区重新定居。
items.ex2_en: Many retired couples resettle comfortably in warm southern coastal towns every winter.
items.ex2_zh: 许多退休夫妇每年冬天都会搬到温暖的南部沿海小镇惬意定居。

groups.summary_en: Describes entering and establishing permanent residence in a new recipient nation or territory, emphasizing arrival, legal entry, and putting down roots in the destination.
groups.summary_zh: 强调迁入外国或异地并在目的地安家、扎根与定居。
groups.desc_en: Involves relocating geographically to establish a durable, permanent residence, contrasting with temporary dwelling or mere travel.
groups.desc_zh: 指跨地域迁移并建立持久、定居的生活根基，区别于短暂旅居或单纯旅行。
groups.nuance_en: immigrate: enter a foreign country to settle permanently (to the US / abroad) · resettle: establish a new home after displacement or disruption (refugees / community / families) · settle: establish a stable, long-term home or community (area / territory / frontier) · put down roots: become deeply established and integrated socially (town / community / city) · colonize: settle land and establish political/cultural dominance over it (territory / island / region)
groups.nuance_zh: immigrate: 迁入外邦定居 (to the US / abroad) · resettle: 流离失所后重新安置定居 (refugees / community / families) · settle: 扎根建立安稳家园 (area / territory / frontier) · put down roots: 生根发芽并深度融入社区 (town / community / city) · colonize: 拓殖并建立政治文化主导 (territory / island / region)

groups.name: Immortalize & Commemorate · 铭记与流芳不朽 (Commemorate, Memorialize, Eternalize)
groups.tip: 隆重纪念以使名垂青史

items.def_zh: 使永世长存；使永垂不朽
items.def_en: To bestow unending life or everlasting public renown upon someone or something
items.ex_en: The poet composed a timeless epic to eternalize the heroic valor of fallen warriors.
items.ex_zh: 诗人创作了一部不朽的史诗，以使阵亡勇士的英勇精神永垂不朽。

items.def_en: To honor the memory of a historic person or event through a ceremony, statue, or building
items.ex_en: Citizens gathered in the central square to commemorate the heroes who defended the city.
items.ex_zh: 市民聚集在中心广场，缅怀保卫这座城市的英雄们。

items.def_en: To preserve a respected tradition, name, or historic achievement with deep veneration
items.ex_en: Democratic principles of free speech are firmly enshrined within the foundational text of the constitution.
items.ex_zh: 言论自由的民主原则已被庄严铭刻在该宪法的基础文本中。

items.def_en: To make someone or something famous forever through a book, painting, film, or monument.
items.ex_en: The renowned biographer sought to immortalize the physicist's revolutionary theories in a comprehensive book.
items.ex_zh: 这位著名的传记作家试图通过一本详尽的著作使这位物理学家的革命性理论名垂青史。

items.def_zh: 使载入纪念碑；立碑铭记
items.def_en: To create a permanent tribute, plaque, or written account to remember a deceased figure
items.ex_en: The university decided to memorialize the generous donor with a dedicated bronze plaque in the library.
