items.ex_zh: 该大学决定在图书馆内安放一块专用铜牌，以铭记这位慷慨的捐赠者。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate acts of preserving persons, heroic deeds, or seminal events in perpetual collective memory via art, monuments, civic holidays, or high literature, conferring enduring glory or symbolic life across generations.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过纪念碑、文艺作品或典礼使人物或功绩万古流芳。
groups.desc_en: Denotes preserving a person, event, or virtue in collective memory to defy mortality or time, contrasting with short-term recognition.
groups.desc_zh: 指将人物、事件或美德永久保留在集体记忆中以对抗时间湮灭，区别于短期的表彰与记录。
groups.nuance_en: commemorate: honor the memory of an event or person publicly (anniversary / fallen / victory) · memorialize: create a lasting record or physical monument for (dead / heroes / sacrifice) · immortalize: endow with enduring fame through art, literature, or myth (poem / painting / deeds) · enshrine: protect and revere sacredly in law, tradition, or memory (rights / values / memory) · eternalize: make conceptually everlasting (name / beauty / truth)
groups.nuance_zh: commemorate: 公开举行仪式或活动纪念 (anniversary / fallen / victory) · memorialize: 通过立碑或著述使之流传 (dead / heroes / sacrifice) · immortalize: 借由艺术或功绩使其名垂千古 (poem / painting / deeds) · enshrine: 铭刻奉入神圣殿堂或法典中加以庇护 (rights / values / memory) · eternalize: 赋予永恒不朽的哲学意义 (name / beauty / truth)

groups.name: Impeach & Indict · 弹劾与正式指控 (Impeach, Indict, Arraign)
groups.tip: 提出司法指控或议会发起弹劾

items.def_en: To officially charge someone with a crime in court and attempt to prove their guilt
items.ex_en: Federal authorities announced their firm intention to prosecute the corrupt executives for extensive financial fraud.
items.ex_zh: 联邦当局宣布坚定意图，将依法起诉那些涉嫌巨额金融欺诈的腐败高管。

items.def_zh: 弹劾；控告，检举；怀疑（名誉、动机等）
items.def_en: 1. (politics/law) To formally charge a senior public official with serious misconduct in office. 2. (formal) To question or challenge the integrity, validity, or motive of someone or something
items.ex_en: Parliament initiated formal proceedings to impeach the governor for systematic abuse of executive power.
items.ex_zh: 议会启动了正式程序，就蓄意滥用行政权力对州长提出弹劾。

items.def_en: To provide evidence indicating or proving that someone was involved in a crime
items.ex_en: Investigators uncovered encrypted chat records that directly incriminate the suspect in the cyber heist.
items.ex_zh: 调查人员发现了直接证明该嫌疑人参与网络盗窃案的加密聊天记录。

items.def_en: To bring a prisoner before a court of law to hear the formal charges and enter a plea
items.ex_en: The magistrate will formally arraign the suspected smuggler on multiple felony charges tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 治安法官将于明天上午正式提审该涉嫌走私者，宣布多项重罪指控。

items.def_zh: 起诉；以大陪审团正式控告
items.def_en: To officially and legally charge someone with a serious crime, usually through an indictment
items.ex_en: A grand jury convened yesterday to indict the corporate officers on federal conspiracy charges.
items.ex_zh: 大陪审团昨天召开会议，以联邦共谋指控正式起诉这些企业高管。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this high-intensity institutional frame denote formally charging officials or defendants with serious crimes or high misconduct in constitutional/judicial arenas.
groups.summary_zh: 特指在政治或司法体制内针对公职与重大罪行提起正式指控或弹劾。
groups.desc_en: Involves formally holding someone accountable under law or institutional authority, escalating from evidential linkage to high constitutional challenge.
groups.desc_zh: 指在法律或体制权威下启动正式指控与追责程序，涵盖从证据关联到宪政级别罢免弹劾的司法阶梯。
groups.nuance_en: incriminate: suggest or prove complicity in a crime (evidence / testimony / statement) · arraign: call a defendant formally to court to answer an indictment (suspect / defendant / prisoner) · indict: formally charge with a serious crime via grand jury (official / suspect / executive) · prosecute: conduct legal proceedings against an accused party (case / offender / criminal) · impeach: charge a high public official with misconduct before a tribunal (president / judge / governor)
groups.nuance_zh: incriminate: 归罪、显示涉嫌犯罪 (evidence / testimony / statement) · arraign: 提审被告并正式宣读控罪 (suspect / defendant / prisoner) · indict: 大陪审团正式起诉严重罪行 (official / suspect / executive) · prosecute: 提起诉讼并进行法庭审理 (case / offender / criminal) · impeach: 弹劾高级公职人员 (president / judge / governor)

groups.name: Imperil & Menace · 陷于危厄与威胁 (Endanger, Jeopardize, Menace)
groups.tip: 使人或处境陷入极大危险中

items.def_en: To present a clear and looming hazard to survival, peace, or continuity
items.ex_en: Rising sea levels continue to threaten low-lying coastal communities throughout the entire island region.
items.ex_zh: 海平面上升继续威胁着整个岛屿地区低洼的沿海社区。

items.def_en: To bring severe danger upon an entity, species, or valuable interest
items.ex_en: Reckless dumping of untreated chemical waste could severely endanger the local river's delicate ecosystem.
items.ex_zh: 肆意倾倒未经处理的化学废料可能会严重危害当地河流脆弱的生态系统。

items.def_en: To act as an ominous or impending source of destruction toward someone or something
items.ex_en: Severe desertification and prolonged droughts menace agricultural stability across the arid interior provinces.
items.ex_zh: 严重的荒漠化和旷日持久的干旱严重威胁着干旱内陆省份的农业稳定。

items.def_en: To put a crucial outcome, safety, or enterprise into grave hazard of failure
items.ex_en: Revealing confidential client data would jeopardize the company's hard-earned credibility and market position.
items.ex_zh: 泄露机密的客户数据将危及公司来之不易的信誉和市场地位。

items.def_en: (formal) To put someone or something in serious danger of being harmed, damaged, or destroyed.
items.ex_en: Failure to maintain safety standards will imperil the lives of hundreds of factory workers.
items.ex_zh: 未能维持安全标准将使数百名工厂工人的生命陷入险境。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on formal and consequential threats that actively bring critical entities into imminent jeopardy or existential harm. Frequent collocates include species, ecosystem, future, democracy, and lives.
groups.summary_zh: 正式语体，指对生态、体制、前途或生命造成紧迫危险。
groups.desc_en: Involves exposing someone or something to risk, harm, or hostile intent, varying in whether the threat is an active aggressor or systemic vulnerability.
groups.desc_zh: 指将人或事物置于危险、受害或敌对意图的威胁中，区别于已知的事实伤害，侧重潜在受害的概率与胁迫感。
groups.nuance_en: threaten: express an intent to inflict harm or indicate bad portents (stability / peace / livelihoods) · menace: loom dangerously with imminent hostility or aggression (neighborhood / security / coastline) · endanger: put in a situation involving direct danger of harm or extinction (species / lives / safety) · jeopardize: put in serious risk of loss, failure, or destruction through an action (career / chances / future) · imperil: formally place into extreme and critical peril (ecosystem / economy / freedom)
groups.nuance_zh: threaten: 发出直接威胁或构成潜在威胁 (stability / peace / livelihoods) · menace: 带有敌意地逼近或构成严重威胁 (neighborhood / security / coastline) · endanger: 置于濒危或受害处境 (species / lives / safety) · jeopardize: 因某举动使成功或前景陷入险境 (career / chances / future) · imperil: （典雅语）使彻底陷于极危之境 (ecosystem / economy / freedom)

groups.name: Impersonate & Masquerade · 冒充与扮演 (Pose, Masquerade, Feign)
groups.tip: 扮演冒充或刻意模仿

items.def_en: Pretend to be a specific person or professional in order to mislead others
items.ex_en: The con artist managed to pose as a building inspector to gain entry.
items.ex_zh: 这名骗子设法冒充房屋检查员以混入其中。

items.def_en: Copy the way someone speaks, moves, or behaves, often to entertain or ridicule
items.ex_en: The comedian loved to mimic the distinctive vocal inflections of famous political leaders.
items.ex_zh: 这位喜剧演员喜欢模仿著名政治领导人独特的发音语调。

items.def_zh: 假冒，冒充；扮演，模仿（娱乐表演）
items.def_en: To pretend to be another person by copying their voice, appearance, or behavior, either to deceive others or to entertain.
items.ex_en: He was arrested after attempting to impersonate a federal agent during a routine traffic stop.
items.ex_zh: 他在常规交通拦截中企图冒充联邦特工，随后被逮捕。

items.def_en: Falsely represent a person or thing to be something genuine or prestigious
items.ex_en: The dishonest dealer tried to pass off cheap synthetic gems as rare natural emeralds.
items.ex_zh: 这个奸商企图把廉价的合成宝石冒充成罕见的天然祖母绿。

items.def_en: (+ as) Pretend to be someone or something else, especially under a false appearance
items.ex_en: Several malicious software programs masquerade as legitimate security updates to trick unsuspecting computer users.
items.ex_zh: 一些恶意软件程序伪装成正规的安全更新，以欺骗毫无戒心的电脑用户。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on assuming the identity, persona, or behavioral traits of someone else, typically with intent to deceive, fraud, or entertain. 'Impersonate' involves active mimicry of persona, whereas 'pose as' and 'masquerade' center on fraudulent disguise.
groups.summary_zh: 指故意假扮、冒充他人身份或声貌以行骗或表演。
groups.desc_en: Involves adopting an external identity or deceptive guise, contrasting with playful acting by often aiming to deceive, defraud, or conceal true motives.
groups.desc_zh: 指假冒他人身份或以虚假外表掩饰真面目，区别于戏剧表演，通常带有欺骗、牟利或隐秘行动色彩。
groups.nuance_en: mimic: copy voice, gestures, or actions for humor or imitation (accent / gestures / sounds) · pose as: pretend to be someone else to deceive or gain access (doctor / official / buyer) · masquerade: pretend to be someone or something grander or false over time (reformer / expert / tourist) · impersonate: assume the identity of another person illegally or entertainingly (officer / celebrity / monarch) · pass off as: fraudulently represent a person or good as something genuine (relative / diamond / authentic)
groups.nuance_zh: mimic: 戏仿或模仿声音神态 (accent / gestures / sounds) · pose as: 冒充某种身份以蒙混过关 (doctor / official / buyer) · masquerade: 伪装化装以掩盖真实本质 (reformer / expert / tourist) · impersonate: 特指违法或刻意冒名顶替 (officer / celebrity / monarch) · pass off as: 以假乱真将某物或某人伪称冒充 (relative / diamond / authentic)

groups.name: Implant & Transplant · 植入与移植 (Implant, Transplant, Graft)
groups.tip: 医学手术植入器官组织

items.def_en: (+ into) to place a device, tube, or instrument into a body cavity or organ
items.ex_en: The surgeon will carefully insert the catheter into the patient's femoral artery during the procedure.
items.ex_zh: 外科医生将在手术过程中小心地将导管置入患者的股动脉。

items.def_en: (+ in/into) to fix an object firmly and deeply inside surrounding bodily tissue or material
items.ex_en: Doctors performed emergency surgery to remove the shrapnel that had become deeply embedded in his thigh.
items.ex_zh: 医生进行了急诊手术，取出了深深嵌入他大腿里的弹片。

items.def_zh: 移植（器官、组织）；移栽（植物）；使迁移
items.def_en: 1. To surgically transfer an organ or tissue from one person or body part to another. 2. To dig up a plant and plant it in another place. 3. To move someone or something to a new environment.
items.ex_en: Specialists worked tirelessly through the night to transplant a donor liver into the critically ill child.
items.ex_zh: 专家们通宵达旦地不知疲倦工作，将供体肝脏移植到这名危重儿童体内。

items.def_zh: 植入，移入（组织或医疗装置）；灌输（思想、观念）
items.def_en: 1. To surgically insert an artificial device, tissue, or embryo into the body. 2. To fix an idea, attitude, or belief firmly in someone's mind.
items.ex_en: Cardiologists decided to implant an artificial pacemaker to regulate the patient's irregular heartbeat.
items.ex_zh: 心脏病专家决定植入人工起搏器，以调节患者不规则的心跳。

items.def_en: (+ on/onto/into) to surgically attach living tissue to a damaged body part where it will grow
items.ex_en: Plastic surgeons had to graft healthy skin from his thigh onto his severely burned forearm.
items.ex_zh: 整形外科医生不得不从他的大腿上移植健康皮肤到严重烧伤的前臂上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote surgically embedding or transferring biological tissue, an organ, or an artificial device into a body to repair damage, restore function, or alter biology.
groups.summary_zh: 指将活体组织、器官或人工装置手术嵌入或移植至生物体内。
groups.desc_en: Involves integrating a biological tissue, device, or concept deeply into a host system, contrasting with surface attachment or placement.
groups.desc_zh: 指将生物组织、装置或观念深度嵌入宿主系统内部，区别于表层的附着或简单放置。
groups.nuance_en: insert: put something into a tight or specific space (key / needle / catheter) · embed: fix firmly and deeply in a surrounding mass (chip / reporter / bullet) · implant: surgically fix a tissue or device deeply into the body; fix an idea (pacemaker / embryo / values) · transplant: remove an organ or plant and establish it elsewhere (heart / kidney / seedling) · graft: surgically attach living tissue to unite with another; link opportunistically (skin / bone / shoot)
groups.nuance_zh: insert: 插入狭缝或特定位置 (key / needle / catheter) · embed: 深深嵌入包围体内 (chip / reporter / bullet) · implant: 植入身体深处或将观念根植 (pacemaker / embryo / values) · transplant: 器官或植物移植 (heart / kidney / seedling) · graft: 嫁接或将活体组织嵌植融合 (skin / bone / shoot)

groups.name: Imply & Insinuate · 蕴涵、暗示与影射 (Insinuate, Entail, Connote)
groups.tip: 从含蓄提示到恶意夹枪带棒

items.def_en: 1. To suggest that something is true without saying it directly. 2. To involve something as a necessary consequence or condition.
items.ex_en: The spokesperson's deliberate choice of words seemed to imply that further layoffs were imminent.
items.ex_zh: 发言人特意挑选的措辞似乎暗示着进一步的裁员已迫在眉睫。

items.def_en: To suggest an idea or feeling in addition to the primary or literal meaning
items.ex_en: In literary analysis, the color white frequently serves to connote innocence, purity, and spiritual transcendence.
items.ex_zh: 在文学分析中，白色通常隐含有天真、纯洁和精神超脱的意味。

items.def_en: To be evidence of or suggest a particular quality, state, or circumstance
items.ex_en: His elegant attire and polished manners bespeak a privileged upbringing within an aristocratic household.
items.ex_zh: 他优雅的着装和温文尔雅的举止显示出其贵族家庭优渥的教养背景。

items.def_en: To involve something as a necessary part, result, or logical consequence
items.ex_en: Constructing the high-speed rail line will necessarily entail massive public expenditure and widespread land acquisition.
items.ex_zh: 修建这条高速铁路必然伴随着巨额的公共支出和广泛的征地工作。

items.def_zh: 含沙射影；旁敲侧击（贬义）
items.def_en: To suggest something bad, dishonest, or embarrassing in a crafty and indirect manner
items.ex_en: The editorial seemed to insinuate that the mayor accepted covert donations from property developers.
items.ex_zh: 该社论似乎在含沙射影地暗示市长接受了房地产开发商的秘密捐款。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses semantic entailment and intentional indirect communication, ranging from neutral logical consequence to loaded, sinister interpersonal insinuation.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖逻辑与语意上的必然后果与隐含意义，以及人际沟通中含沙射影的深意。
groups.desc_en: Involves communicating meaning indirectly rather than explicitly, ranging from logical necessity to subtly hostile insinuation.
groups.desc_zh: 指不直接明说而通过逻辑推导、言外之意或恶意旁敲侧击传达内涵，区别于直截了当的陈述。
groups.nuance_en: imply: suggest meaning indirectly through words or evidence (fault / guilt / dissatisfaction) · connote: invoke secondary associations beyond literal definition (luxury / youth / danger) · entail: involve as an inevitable or strictly logical consequence (risks / sacrifice / expenditure) · bespeak: demonstrate or serve as evidence of an underlying quality (taste / wealth / confidence) · insinuate: introduce an unpleasant, sly, or accusatory suggestion subtly (corruption / incompetence / infidelity)
groups.nuance_zh: imply: 逻辑推导或委婉暗示 (fault / guilt / dissatisfaction) · connote: 词语或符号内涵涵义 (luxury / youth / danger) · entail: 逻辑上或必然伴随必然涉及 (risks / sacrifice / expenditure) · bespeak: 显示、彰显出某种品质 (taste / wealth / confidence) · insinuate: 拐弯抹角影射、暗指不良行径 (corruption / incompetence / infidelity)

groups.name: Import & Introduce · 引进与输入 (Import, Bring in, Introduce)
groups.tip: 从外部引入技术或商品

items.def_en: Introduce a new law, product, or external specialist into an organization or country
items.ex_en: The government plans to bring in stricter environmental regulations to curb industrial carbon emissions.
items.ex_zh: 政府计划引入更严格的环境法规，以遏制工业碳排放。

items.def_en: Bring something such as a system, concept, or species into a place or context for the first time
items.ex_en: The government plans to introduce the revolutionary healthcare model across rural districts next autumn.
items.ex_zh: 政府计划明年秋天在农村地区推行这种革命性的医疗保健模式。

items.def_en: Formally accept and put into practice an idea, method, or standard originating elsewhere
items.ex_en: The ministry decided to adopt strict international safety guidelines across all manufacturing facilities.
items.ex_zh: 该部决定在所有制造设施中正式采纳严格的国际安全准则。

items.def_zh: 引进，输入；进口；导入（数据）
items.def_en: 1. to bring goods or services into a country from abroad to be sold 2. to introduce an idea, system, or custom from another place 3. (computing) to bring data or files into a program from another source
items.ex_en: The wandering scholars sought to import novel philosophical doctrines into their cloistered realm.
items.ex_zh: 游学士子们试图将新颖的哲学学说输入他们闭塞的国度。

items.def_en: Transfer an institution, idea, or community from one environment to settle in another
items.ex_en: Scholars debated whether they could successfully transplant the parliamentary system into tribal societies.
items.ex_zh: 学者们争论能否将议会制度成功移植到部落社会中。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers bringing goods, ideas, practices, or technologies into a new jurisdiction, culture, or organization from an external origin.
groups.summary_zh: 指自外部向某国度、领域或系统引进商品、理念或技术。
groups.desc_en: Involves bringing external concepts, practices, or goods into a recipient system, contrasting with endogenous creation.
groups.desc_zh: 指将外部的商品、理念或制度吸纳并引入本地系统，区别于内生性的自主创造。
groups.nuance_en: bring in: introduce as assistance, revenue, or legislation (experts / revenue / legislation) · import: bring in goods or ideas from another country/origin (commodities / concepts / inflation) · introduce: present or institute something new to a group or system (system / product / technology) · adopt: formally take up and implement an external practice (policy / model / approach) · transplant: relocate an established practice or institution into a foreign context (culture / institutions / legal code)
groups.nuance_zh: bring in: 引入外部专家、带来收益或立法 (experts / revenue / legislation) · import: 从外埠进口货品或输入观念 (commodities / concepts / inflation) · introduce: 向某领域首次推介或引进 (system / product / technology) · adopt: 正式采纳并沿用外来做法 (policy / model / approach) · transplant: 将外来制度、文化异地移植生根 (culture / institutions / legal code)

groups.name: Impose & Enforce · 强加与推行 (Impose, Inflict, Saddle, Clamp down)
groups.tip: 以权力强制推行与压制

items.def_zh: 使承担重任，使背负包袱
items.def_en: (+ with) Burden someone with an onerous responsibility, debt, or task
items.ex_en: The sudden managerial resignation saddled Arthur with enormous financial debt and chaotic operations.
items.ex_zh: 管理层的突然辞职让亚瑟背负了巨额财政债务和混乱的运营局面。

items.def_en: (+ on) Take firm authoritative measures to suppress or restrict an activity or group
items.ex_en: Local authorities vowed to clamp down on unauthorized street vendors operating around stations.
items.ex_zh: 地方当局誓言严加整治在车站周围经营的无照街头摊贩。

items.def_en: Force someone abruptly to accept an unwelcome role, responsibility, or condition
items.ex_en: An unwanted interim presidency was thrust upon Elena following the founder's sudden departure.
items.ex_zh: 创始人突然离开后，令人避之不及的临时总统一职被硬塞给了埃琳娜。

items.def_zh: 把…强加于；强制推行，征收（税收、罚款等）；（尤指无礼地）打扰，麻烦
items.def_en: 1. to officially introduce a new law, rule, tax, or punishment 2. to force someone to accept something unwanted 3. (impose on/upon) to take unfair advantage of someone or bother them
items.ex_en: The council voted unanimously to impose severe curfew regulations during the national crisis.
items.ex_zh: 委员会一致投票决定在国家危机期间强制推行严格的宵禁规定。

items.def_zh: 使遭受，施加（痛苦或惩罚）
items.def_en: Cause someone to experience something unpleasant, painful, or damaging
items.ex_en: Reckless economic policies inflicted severe financial distress upon millions of vulnerable working families.
items.ex_zh: 轻率的经济政策使数百万脆弱的工薪家庭遭受了严重的财务困境。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here emphasize asserting heavy burdens, obligations, or rigid governance upon recipients who have little choice but to submit.
groups.summary_zh: 指居高临下施加重负、禁令或严苛义务，迫其承受。
groups.desc_en: Involves applying non-negotiable authority, burdens, or restrictions from above, contrasting with consensual agreement.
groups.desc_zh: 指凭借强制力或权威自上而下施加负担、惩罚或管制，区别于自愿达成的协商契约。
groups.nuance_en: impose: establish as authoritative, compulsory, or burdensome (sanctions / taxes / curfew) · inflict: forcefully cause physical harm, pain, or damage (blow / defeat / damage) · saddle: encumber someone heavily with an unwanted burden (debt / responsibility / costs) · thrust upon: force a role, duty, or fortune upon an unwilling recipient (fame / leadership / burden) · clamp down: enforce rules harshly to suppress undesirable behavior (crime / dissent / corruption)
groups.nuance_zh: impose: 凭借权威强加税负、法令或制裁 (sanctions / taxes / curfew) · inflict: 予以打击、造成创伤与痛苦 (blow / defeat / damage) · saddle: 使背负沉重负担或债务 (debt / responsibility / costs) · thrust upon: 猝不及防地把责任推给某人 (fame / leadership / burden) · clamp down: 铁腕强行取缔或压制 (crime / dissent / corruption)

groups.name: Impose & Foist · 强加与迫使 (Foist, Offload, Palm off, Force on)
groups.tip: 把不想要的人事物强加于人

items.def_zh: 以次充好转手，哄骗硬塞
items.def_en: (+ on/onto) Deceitfully persuade someone into accepting an inferior or unwanted item or task
items.ex_en: The shady merchant tried to palm off a defective watch onto the tourist.
items.ex_zh: 那个不良商人试图把一块有瑕疵的手表哄骗硬塞给这位游客。

items.def_en: Dispose of an unwanted object or unwanted duty by offloading it onto an unsuspecting party
items.ex_en: He cleverly pawned off the tedious spreadsheet duties onto his unsuspecting new assistant.
items.ex_zh: 他巧妙地把繁琐的表格处理杂务推脱给了毫无防备的新助理。

items.def_en: Get rid of an unpleasant responsibility or unwanted person carelessly onto another
items.ex_en: She deliberately dumped all the tedious organizing chores onto her younger brother yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 她昨天故意把所有繁琐的整理杂务一股脑甩给了弟弟。

items.def_en: Get rid of an unwanted burden, asset, or task by transferring it to someone else
items.ex_en: The struggling corporation decided to offload its toxic assets onto an offshore subsidiary.
items.ex_zh: 陷入困境的公司决定将其不良资产转让给一家离岸子公司以卸除负担。

items.def_zh: 强加于，强迫接受；把…硬塞给
items.def_en: to force someone to accept or deal with something or someone unwanted or undesirable
items.ex_en: Authoritarian administrators attempted to foist their rigid curriculum reforms upon unwilling faculty members.
items.ex_zh: 专断的管理层企图将死板的课程改革强加给不情愿的教职员工。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures manipulative, evasive, or unfair acts of passing off unwanted responsibilities, deceitful ideas, or worthless items onto others.
groups.summary_zh: 指采用手段将不愿要的人、责任或劣货强行推卸给他人。
groups.desc_en: Involves deceptively or unscrupulously passing off an unwanted or inferior item or obligation onto someone else to unburden oneself.
groups.desc_zh: 指用欺骗、甩包袱或不光彩的手段把不想要的人事甩给对方，区别于公平的买卖与责任移交。
groups.nuance_en: foist: force someone to accept something spurious, inferior, or burdensome (ideas / substandard goods / blame) · palm off: dispose of deceptively through misrepresentation or sleight of hand (fake / dud / counterfeit) · pawn off: pass off something cheap or troublesome onto another party (responsibility / junk / work) · dump: dispose of abruptly in bulk without care for consequences (shares / assets / waste) · offload: deliberately transfer a surplus or troublesome burden to relieve oneself (stock / debt / employees)
groups.nuance_zh: foist: 强加劣质事物或不合意之物 (ideas / substandard goods / blame) · palm off: 用蒙骗手法把赝品出手甩掉 (fake / dud / counterfeit) · pawn off: 将累赘或次品转嫁推脱给他人 (responsibility / junk / work) · dump: 不管不顾地抛售或倾倒丢弃 (shares / assets / waste) · offload: 为减负而有目的地出脱或卸载包袱 (stock / debt / employees)

groups.name: Imprint & Frank · 盖印与邮戳 (Postmark, Frank, Cancel)
groups.tip: 在信件或物品上加盖邮戳标志

items.def_zh: 盖邮资免付印记；打印邮资戳
items.def_en: To stamp an official mark on a letter or parcel indicating postage is prepaid or waived
items.ex_en: The administrative officer must carefully frank official correspondence before dispatching it to embassies.
items.ex_zh: 行政官员在将公文发送至使馆前，必须认真打印邮资免付印记。

items.def_en: To mark a stamp, ticket, or voucher with a cancellation stamp to render it void for reuse
items.ex_en: The conductor used a heavy brass punch to cancel every passenger's transit ticket.
items.ex_zh: 乘务员用沉重的黄铜打孔器盖印注销了每位乘客的乘车票。

items.def_en: To stamp over an existing mark, text, or postage label with a fresh official imprint
items.ex_en: The clerk will overstamp the vintage postal envelope with a stark scarlet insignia.
items.ex_zh: 办事员将在古旧的信封上加盖醒目的猩红色印戳以覆盖原有标记。

items.def_en: To apply a postal transit or arrival mark onto the back of an envelope or postal piece
items.ex_en: Diligent couriers would backstamp each fragile dispatch to record its exact nocturnal arrival.
items.ex_zh: 尽职的信使会在每封易损信件的背面盖上邮戳，以记录其深夜抵达的准确时间。

items.def_en: (usually passive) To stamp an official mark on a letter or package, showing the date and place of posting.
items.ex_en: The antique love letter was clearly postmarked in Paris on a rainy morning.
items.ex_zh: 这封泛旧的情书上清晰地盖着一个雨天巴黎清晨的邮戳。

groups.summary_en: This frame pertains to applying official date stamps, postage cancellations, seals, or postal marks to mail, tickets, or documents to show processing, invalidate further use, or denote official authorization.
groups.summary_zh: 在信件或票证上加盖邮戳、注销章或免资印记以作凭证。
groups.desc_en: Involves applying an official postal or bureaucratic mark onto mail or documents to validate, record transit, or prevent reuse.
groups.desc_zh: 指在邮件或公文上加盖官方印戳以示生效、记录转递或注销邮资，区别于一般日常盖章。
groups.nuance_en: postmark: stamp mail officially indicating date and place of dispatch (letter / envelope / ballot) · frank: stamp or sign mail indicating postage is prepaid or legally free (mail / envelope / official letter) · cancel: deface a postage stamp with a mark to prevent reuse (stamp / voucher / coupon) · overstamp: stamp directly over an existing mark or surface for alteration/update (passport / document / stamp) · backstamp: stamp the reverse side of a cover to trace postal routing (envelope / cover / card)
groups.nuance_zh: postmark: 加盖邮戳记录寄件地与日期 (letter / envelope / ballot) · frank: 盖免资或已付邮资章 (mail / envelope / official letter) · cancel: 盖戳注销邮票以防重复使用 (stamp / voucher / coupon) · overstamp: 在旧印记上加盖以修改或更新 (passport / document / stamp) · backstamp: 在信封背面盖转递接收戳 (envelope / cover / card)

groups.name: Imprison & Lock Up · 监禁与羁押 (Incarcerate, Imprison, Detain)
groups.tip: 关入牢狱剥夺人身行动自由

items.def_en: To place someone in a jail or send them to serve a custodial sentence
items.ex_en: The district court decided to jail the repeat offender for twelve painful months.
items.ex_zh: 地方法院决定将这名屡犯者关进牢房服刑痛苦的十二个月。

items.def_en: To put someone in a secure place such as a prison or psychiatric hospital
items.ex_en: Guards will lock up violent suspects inside the maximum security facility tonight securely.
items.ex_zh: 警卫今晚会将暴力嫌疑人安全地关进最高安全级别的设施中。

items.def_en: To keep someone in official custody, typically for questioning or awaiting trial
items.ex_en: Border patrol agents possess lawful authority to detain foreign travelers for formal interrogation.
items.ex_zh: 边境巡逻执法人员依法有权扣留外国旅客进行正式审讯。

items.def_en: To put someone in a prison or confine them closely as a legal punishment
items.ex_en: The corrupt regime conspired to imprison prominent dissenting journalists without proper judicial trials.
items.ex_zh: 腐败政权密谋在未经正当司法审判的情况下监禁著名异见记者。

items.def_en: (formal) To put or keep someone in prison or close confinement.
items.ex_en: Judicial authorities voted to incarcerate the convicted traitor inside an underground solitary cell.
items.ex_zh: 司法当局投票决定将定罪的叛国者下狱监禁于地下单人牢房。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify depriving someone of freedom by placing them under legal custody or physical lock and key in a penitentiary, jail, or secure detention facility.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过司法或强制手段将某人关押在监狱或禁闭场所。
groups.desc_en: Involves legally or forcibly depriving a person of freedom by confining them in an enclosed space, contrasting with loose restriction.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过司法权力或强制手段剥夺人身自由并关入特定封闭场所，区别于轻度的行动限制。
groups.nuance_en: detain: hold someone temporarily under official custody without formal charges yet (suspect / travelers / demonstrators) · lock up: secure someone or something behind locked doors casually or decisively (criminal / prisoner / valuables) · jail: place someone in local or municipal confinement (offender / suspect / convict) · imprison: place in prison by judicial sentence; severely confine generally (felon / dissidents / hostages) · incarcerate: formally and institutionalize long-term confinement (convict / inmate / offenders)
groups.nuance_zh: detain: 依法短期羁押或扣留 (suspect / travelers / demonstrators) · lock up: 关入牢房或上锁关押 (criminal / prisoner / valuables) · jail: 投入看守所或地方监狱 (offender / suspect / convict) · imprison: 依判决投狱服刑或失去人身自由 (felon / dissidents / hostages) · incarcerate: （书面典雅）将罪犯长期监禁入狱 (convict / inmate / offenders)

groups.name: Improvise & Riff · 即兴与发挥 (Ad-lib, Extemporize, Freewheel)
groups.tip: 围绕既有主题即兴借题发挥

items.def_en: To invent music, words, or actions spontaneously without prior preparation
items.ex_en: When the projector failed unexpectedly, the keynote speaker had to improvise her presentation.
items.ex_zh: 放映机意外故障时，主讲人不得不即兴发挥完成她的演讲。

items.def_en: To speak or perform without a script or notes, often humorously
items.ex_en: During the rehearsal, the witty comedian chose to ad-lib several sharp punchlines playfully.
items.ex_zh: 在彩排期间，这位诙谐的风趣演员俏皮地即兴插话说了几句尖锐的妙语。

items.def_zh: 随心所欲地发挥；不拘一格地表达
items.def_en: To act or speak freely and loosely without adhering strictly to rules or plans
items.ex_en: The eccentric professor loved to freewheel through various historical topics during his lectures.
items.ex_zh: 这位古怪的教授喜欢在讲座中随心所欲、不拘一格地畅谈各种历史话题。

items.def_zh: （就某一主题）即兴发挥，借题发挥；弹奏即兴重复乐句
items.def_en: (+ on) (informal) To speak, joke, or perform music in an improvisational or creative way, developing a theme or idea.
items.ex_en: Late night hosts often riff on controversial political headlines to engage live audiences.
items.ex_zh: 深夜脱口秀主持人经常就争议性政治头条即兴借题发挥，以吸引现场观众。

items.def_en: To compose, perform, or speak in public without any advance preparation
items.ex_en: Deprived of his prepared remarks, the nervous diplomat was forced to extemporize.
items.ex_zh: 准备好的讲稿丢失后，这位紧张的外交官被迫当众即席发言。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to speaking, performing, or thinking spontaneously without preparation or script, often elaborating dynamically on a theme.
groups.summary_zh: 指脱稿演讲、即兴演奏或无准备发挥，自由生发内容。
groups.desc_en: Involves creating, performing, or solving something on the fly without prepared materials or script, contrasting with rehearsed execution.
groups.desc_zh: 指不依赖既定脚本或准备，当场即席创作、表现或解决问题，区别于排练好的按部就班。
groups.nuance_en: improvise: invent or provide offhand using whatever is available (solution / speech / tune) · ad-lib: speak or perform spontaneous lines not in the script (lines / joke / remark) · extemporize: compose and perform an address or music without notes (speech / sermon / solo) · riff: play with, elaborate on, or develop variations around a theme (theme / idea / joke) · freewheel: act spontaneously and loosely without strict rules or structure (performance / discussion / economy)
groups.nuance_zh: improvise: 就地取材或即席创作解决 (solution / speech / tune) · ad-lib: 现场脱口插科打诨或即兴改词 (lines / joke / remark) · extemporize: 不看讲稿即席发表演说或弹奏 (speech / sermon / solo) · riff: 围绕某一主题即兴发挥生发变奏 (theme / idea / joke) · freewheel: 漫无拘束、不受规则约束地自由发挥 (performance / discussion / economy)

groups.name: Incapacitating & Disabling · 丧失功能与致残 (Cripple, Incapacitate, Paralyze)
groups.tip: 力量减弱直至丧失原有运作能力

items.def_en: Prevent something or someone from moving or being moved freely
items.ex_en: Paramedics applied a rigid splint to immobilize the injured climber's fractured left leg.
items.ex_zh: 医护人员使用刚性夹板固定住受伤登山者骨折的左腿以防止其移动。

items.def_zh: 使失去能力，使残废；使丧失功能，使无效
items.def_en: 1. To injure someone so that they are permanently unable to walk or use part of their body. 2. To stop a machine, device, or system from functioning properly.
items.ex_en: A severe spinal lesion can permanently disable an athlete despite extensive medical intervention.
items.ex_zh: 尽管进行了广泛的医疗干预，严重的脊髓损伤仍可能使运动员永久致残。

items.def_en: Damage somebody so severely that they cannot walk properly, or ruin an operation completely
items.ex_en: The devastating transport strike threatens to cripple the entire nation's supply chain network.
items.ex_zh: 破坏性的交通大罢工可能会严重瘫痪并削弱整个国家的供应链网络。

items.def_zh: 使无能力；使丧失活动力
items.def_en: Deprive someone of the physical or legal power, strength, or fitness to act
items.ex_en: A sudden cerebral hemorrhage can severely incapacitate an otherwise healthy executive within moments.
items.ex_zh: 突发脑出血可能会在瞬间使一位原本健康的高管完全丧失行动能力。

items.def_en: Cause a person or system to lose all motor function or cease normal operation
items.ex_en: Massive blizzards can paralyze essential public transport across the metropolitan area for days.
items.ex_zh: 暴风雪可能会使整个大都市区的重要公共交通瘫痪数日之久。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express causing severe impairment to an organism, machine, or organization such that it cannot function, move, or operate. Disable means turning off operational ability; cripple conveys catastrophic functional destruction.
groups.summary_zh: 使人致残或使系统、机械严重损坏并彻底丧失正常运转能力。
groups.desc_en: Involves rendering an entity incapable of normal physiological, mechanical, or operational function, contrasting with mild disruption.
groups.desc_zh: 指彻底剥夺实体正常的生理、机械或作战运转能力，使其瘫痪失效，区别于轻度妨碍。
groups.nuance_en: disable: make physically unable or deactivate technical operation (device / alarm / enemy) · immobilize: prevent from moving or being moved (limb / vehicle / fleet) · incapacitate: render legally or medically unfit and powerless to act (victim / patient / worker) · cripple: severely impair physical movement or ruin structural effectiveness (industry / economy / transport) · paralyze: cause total loss of movement or bring operations to a complete standstill (traffic / fear / system)
groups.nuance_zh: disable: 伤残身体机能或使机械装置失效 (device / alarm / enemy) · immobilize: 使固定动弹不得 (limb / vehicle / fleet) · incapacitate: 在生理或法律上剥夺行为能力 (victim / patient / worker) · cripple: 使残废或严重削弱运作骨架 (industry / economy / transport) · paralyze: 使完全瘫痪、彻底陷入停摆 (traffic / fear / system)

groups.name: Incinerate & Destroy by Fire · 纵火与焚毁 (Torch, Incinerate, Gut)
groups.tip: 引燃火苗至烈火焚烧

items.def_en: To destroy the interior and contents of a building by fire, leaving only exterior walls
items.ex_en: Fierce nocturnal blazes completely gutted the historic library, sparing only its stone pillars.
items.ex_zh: 凶猛的夜火将这座历史悠久的图书馆内部彻底烧毁，只剩下了石柱。

items.def_en: 1. (informal) To deliberately set fire to a building, vehicle, or property.
items.ex_en: Rioters deliberately used petrol bombs to torch several parked vehicles along the avenue.
items.ex_zh: 暴乱分子故意投掷汽油弹纵火焚烧了停在林荫道旁的数辆汽车。

items.def_en: To burn a dead body to ashes, especially as part of a formal funeral ceremony
items.ex_en: The deceased scholar requested in his will that his family cremate his remains.
items.ex_zh: 已故学者在遗嘱中请求家人将其遗体火化。

items.def_en: To destroy a building or structure completely by fire, or be so destroyed
items.ex_en: Flames rapidly engulfed the abandoned timber warehouse and caused it to burn down.
items.ex_zh: 大火迅速吞噬了废弃的木材仓库，将其彻底焚为平地。
items.ex2_en: The raging summer wildfire burned down dozens of vintage wooden mountain cabins.
items.ex2_zh: 肆虐的夏季山火将数十座老式木质山间木屋彻底烧毁成灰烬。

items.def_en: To burn something completely until nothing remains except ash and bone
items.ex_en: The hazardous waste facility uses extreme heat to incinerate toxic biological materials safely.
items.ex_zh: 该危险废物处理设施利用极高温度将有毒生物材料彻底焚化以确保安全。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on severe, destructive fire acts—either malicious arson or deliberate industrial cremation—that leave structures, vehicles, or refuse entirely gutted and reduced to ashes.
groups.summary_zh: 通过蓄意纵火或高温焚烧彻底摧毁房屋、车辆或残渣废料。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the destructive consumption of physical structures or matter by fire, differing from neutral 'burn' through high intensity, deliberate destruction, or total structural hollow-out.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过火势对物理结构或实体物质进行毁灭性吞噬，与中性的“燃烧（burn）”相比，强调极高的破坏烈度、故意纵火或内部彻底烧空的终结状态。
groups.nuance_en: gut: consume and hollow out the interior completely (building / factory / warehouse) · torch: intentionally set fire to with malicious or criminal intent (car / building / evidence) · cremate: ceremonially or hygienically burn a dead body to ash (corpse / remains / body) · burn down: completely destroy to the ground by fire (house / barn / town) · incinerate: reduce waste or matter totally to ash through intense industrial or extreme heat (waste / trash / documents)
groups.nuance_zh: gut: 将建筑物内部彻底焚毁掏空 (building / factory / warehouse) · torch: 恶意或故意纵火焚烧 (car / building / evidence) · cremate: 礼仪或卫生性地火化遗体 (corpse / remains / body) · burn down: 将建筑物齐根烧毁夷平 (house / barn / town) · incinerate: 借助工业高温或极端烈火将物品化为灰烬 (waste / trash / documents)

groups.name: Incite & Initiate Action · 唆使引发与策动 (Instigate, Incite, Provoke)
groups.tip: 在幕后唆使并引发事端

items.def_en: Trigger a sudden burst of activity, public debate, or violent conflict.
items.ex_en: The minister's provocative statement could spark fierce debate regarding constitutional civil liberties.
items.ex_zh: 部长的挑衅性声明可能会就宪法所赋予的公民自由引发激烈辩论。

items.def_en: Cause a chain reaction of sudden events, protests, or emotional outbursts.
items.ex_en: The sudden closure of the factory set off widespread protests throughout the town.
items.ex_zh: 工厂的突然倒闭在全镇引发了一连串广泛的抗议活动。

items.def_en: Cause an undesirable reaction or angry response deliberately through words or actions.
items.ex_en: His sarcastic remarks were intentionally calculated to provoke an aggressive outburst from colleagues.
items.ex_zh: 他讽刺的言论经过精心设计，旨在故意激怒同事并诱发激烈的反应。

items.def_en: Encourage or prompt someone to commit violent, unlawful, or aggressive behavior.
items.ex_en: Extremist leaders used seditious speeches to incite violent rebellions against municipal security forces.
items.ex_zh: 极端分子头目利用煽动性演说唆使暴力叛乱对抗市政安保部队。

items.def_en: 1. (formal) To provoke or stir up trouble, rebellion, or bad behavior. 2. To initiate or cause an official action, investigation, or change to begin.
items.ex_en: Disgruntled employees conspired covertly to instigate an illegal walkout across the regional facilities.
items.ex_zh: 心怀不满的员工暗中密谋，在各区域设施发起非法罢工。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on being the prime mover behind an adverse action, formal inquiry, violent outburst, or dispute by urging participants or formally getting an initiative rolling.
groups.summary_zh: 指充当首要策划者或引爆点，发起调查、策划动乱或唆使做出激进行为。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the sparking, engineering, or active urging of a volatile event or conflict, moving beyond plain 'start' or 'cause' by implying an inflammatory trigger or manipulative agency.
groups.desc_zh: 指点燃、策划或极力煽动引爆冲突与动荡局势，与简单的“引起/开始（cause/start）”相比，带有明显的煽动性火药味或幕后策动色彩。
groups.nuance_en: spark: ignite suddenly via a small trigger (protest / riot / debate) · set off: trigger a chain reaction or explosive sequence (alarm / panic / wave of strikes) · provoke: deliberately elicit a sharp negative reaction or retaliation (anger / backlash / response) · incite: actively urge or inflame people toward illegal or violent action (violence / riot / insurrection) · instigate: intentionally initiate and orchestrate behind the scenes (inquiry / coup / rebellion)
groups.nuance_zh: spark: 借由微小导火索瞬间点燃 (protest / riot / debate) · set off: 触发连锁反应或突发群体情绪 (alarm / panic / wave of strikes) · provoke: 故意激怒以招致激烈反弹或报复 (anger / backlash / response) · incite: 煽动、策动人群走向违法或暴力 (violence / riot / insurrection) · instigate: 幕后策动、蓄意发起重大事端 (inquiry / coup / rebellion)

groups.name: Incline & Tend · 倾向与偏好 (Incline, Tend, Lean, Gravitate)
groups.tip: 思维习惯性偏向某一方

items.def_en: (+ to/toward) To be likely to act, think, or develop in a specific direction
items.ex_en: Young consumers tend to prioritize sustainable business practices when selecting their lifestyle brands.
items.ex_zh: 年轻消费者在选择生活方式品牌时往往更看重可持续商业行为。

items.def_zh: （使）倾向于，（使）有意于；（使）倾斜，低头
items.def_en: 1. To tend to think or behave in a certain way, or to influence someone toward an opinion. 2. To slope, lean, or bend forward or downward.
items.ex_en: These troubling audit results incline me toward revising our financial transparency regulations immediately.
items.ex_zh: 这些令人不安的审计结果使我倾向于立即修订我们的财务透明度规定。
items.ex2_en: Young consumers incline toward sustainable fashion products over disposable fast apparel.
items.ex2_zh: 年轻消费者相比一次性快时尚，更青睐可持续的时尚产品。

items.def_en: (+ toward/to) To show a preference, sympathy, or disposition toward an opinion or policy
items.ex_en: Moderate swing voters usually lean toward pragmatic fiscal policies during parliamentary general elections.
items.ex_zh: 温和的摇摆选民在议会大选中通常倾向于务实的财政政策。
items.ex2_en: The persistent lobbyist tried to lean the undecided senator toward their proposal.
items.ex2_zh: 执着的说客试图促使尚未表态的参议员支持他们的提议。

items.def_zh: 自然移向，受吸引而倾向
items.def_en: (+ to/toward) To be naturally drawn or attracted toward a particular person, place, or pursuit
items.ex_en: Ambitious international graduate students naturally gravitate toward world-renowned research institutions in capital cities.
items.ex_zh: 有抱负的国际研究生自然会被首都世界知名的研究机构所吸引。

items.def_en: (+ to/toward) To make someone liable or inclined to an attitude, action, or condition in advance
items.ex_en: Chronic environmental stress may predispose individuals to develop severe cardiovascular health complications later.
items.ex_zh: 长期的环境压力可能会使人在日后更易患上严重的心血管疾病。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey having a natural predisposition, mental drift, or developing preference toward a belief, decision, or behavioral trait.
groups.summary_zh: 思想认知或行为上有偏向、倾向于特定选择。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an inherent bias, dynamic drift, or directional pull toward a specific stance, behavior, or condition, differing from definitive 'choose' by expressing an unforced, probabilistic posture.
groups.desc_zh: 指朝向某种立场、行为或状态的自然倾向、动力学偏移或受力牵引，与确定性的“选择（choose）”不同，侧重未成定论但具概率性的倾斜态势。
groups.nuance_en: tend: exhibit a regular natural disposition or statistical likelihood (to agree / toward optimism) · incline: have a mild mental leaning or physical slope toward (view / opinion / ear) · lean: actively favor or tilt toward a political or ideological position (left / toward reform / toward conservatism) · gravitate: be naturally drawn as if by invisible gravitational pull toward (career / crowd / topic) · predispose: configure mental or physiological susceptibility in advance (patient / child / system)
groups.nuance_zh: tend: 表现出常态性的发展倾向或概率趋势 (to agree / toward optimism) · incline: 心态或身体微幅倾向、偏好 (view / opinion / ear) · lean: 在政治或理念上明显偏向一方 (left / toward reform / toward conservatism) · gravitate: 如受地心引力般自然被吸引向 (career / crowd / topic) · predispose: 从先天气质或机理上预先使之易感 (patient / child / system)

groups.name: Include & Encompass · 包罗与囊括 (Comprise, Span, Incorporate)
groups.tip: 范围广泛地容纳覆盖

items.def_en: To include something as part of a larger whole or system
items.ex_en: Engineers sought to incorporate adaptive solar panels into the newly designed commercial skyscraper.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们试图将自适应太阳能电池板纳入新设计的商业摩天大楼中。

items.def_en: To include or contain particular parts, members, or aspects
items.ex_en: The emerging research consortium will comprise leading academic specialists from across twelve nations.
items.ex_zh: 新兴的研究联合体将由来自十二个国家的一流学术专家构成。

items.def_en: To extend across a wide range of subjects, eras, or categories
items.ex_en: Her comprehensive documentary archives span four turbulent decades of socio-political revolution across Europe.
items.ex_zh: 她详实的纪录片档案跨越了欧洲社会政治革命动荡的四十年。

items.def_zh: 包含，涵盖，囊括；包围，环绕
items.def_en: 1. To include a wide range of subjects, ideas, or elements. 2. (formal) To surround or encircle an area completely.
items.ex_en: The novel urban development strategy will encompass green energy, housing, and transit reforms.
items.ex_zh: 这项新型城市发展战略将涵盖绿色能源、住房以及交通等多项改革。

items.def_en: To include or absorb something into a broader, overarching category
items.ex_en: The revised legislative framework will subsume several obsolete regional administrative statutes under one.
items.ex_zh: 修订后的立法框架将把数条过时的地区行政法规归入统一门类之下。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures the conceptual act of containing, covering, or integrating diverse elements within a single comprehensive scope, category, or timeframe.
groups.summary_zh: 表示事物在范围、概念或时空上容纳、包含或统揽多重元素。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the comprehensive physical, temporal, or conceptual holding of elements within a larger whole, differing from mere 'contain' by emphasizing completeness, breadth, or structural integration.
groups.desc_zh: 指在空间、时间或概念范畴内对要素进行广泛囊括或一体化统摄，与单纯的“包含（contain）”相比，强调广度、完整性或有机融合。
groups.nuance_en: incorporate: blend components seamlessly into a unified functioning system (feature / idea / data) · comprise: constitute or formally consist of specific parts (chapters / elements / committee) · span: stretch completely across a wide expanse of time, space, or disciplines (centuries / globe / disciplines) · encompass: circle around and comprehensively include a vast scope (topics / range / variety) · subsume: bring specific ideas or cases under a broader taxonomic category (cases / categories / rules)
groups.nuance_zh: incorporate: 将零散成分有机整合并入体系 (feature / idea / data) · comprise: 由某些特定要素构成、由下而上组成 (chapters / elements / committee) · span: 在时间、空间或学科跨度上横跨 (centuries / globe / disciplines) · encompass: 广泛包罗并涵盖极宽的范畴 (topics / range / variety) · subsume: 将具象情形归并纳入上位概念 (cases / categories / rules)

groups.name: Include & Subsume · 包含与归入 (Subsume, Encompass, Categorize)
groups.tip: 将细分子项纳进更宏观范畴内

items.def_en: (+ into/with) To merge various components together to form a harmonious, complete whole
items.ex_en: The modern corporation intends to integrate advanced artificial intelligence seamlessly into regular workflows.
items.ex_zh: 这家现代企业打算将先进的人工智能技术无缝融入日常工作流中。
items.ex2_en: The newly acquired software modules integrated smoothly into our existing enterprise database.
items.ex2_zh: 新采购的软件模块顺利融入了我们现有的企业数据库。

items.def_en: To assign someone or something to a rigid, overly simplistic category or theoretical compartment
items.ex_en: Critics unfairly pigeonhole the versatile actor into simplistic comedic villain roles every season.
items.ex_zh: 影评人每季都不公地把这位多才多艺的演员刻板归类为单纯的喜剧反派。

items.def_en: (+ into) To blend or combine one element into an existing unified system or structure
items.ex_en: Architects decided to incorporate traditional wooden elements into the minimalist glass concert hall.
items.ex_zh: 建筑师决定将传统木质元素并入这座极简主义玻璃音乐厅中。

items.def_en: To take in, absorb, and fully integrate new concepts, populations, or information into a main body
items.ex_en: Immigrant families often struggle to assimilate disparate cultural customs into their daily domestic lives.
items.ex_zh: 移民家庭往往难以在日常家庭生活中完全吸收并同化不同的文化习俗。
items.ex2_en: Over successive generations, the foreign cultural practices assimilated completely into the native society.
items.ex2_zh: 经过几代人的时间，这些外国文化习俗完全融入了本土社会。

items.def_zh: 将……归入，将……纳入（更广泛的范畴）
items.def_en: (formal) (often passive, 'be subsumed into/under') To include or incorporate something within a larger, more comprehensive category.
items.ex_en: Minor local grievances were quickly subsumed into the larger national civil rights campaign.
items.ex_zh: 地方上的微小不满很快被纳入了更为广泛的全国民权运动当中。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate theoretical, conceptual, or classification actions where individual items, sub-theories, or cases are absorbed under a broader umbrella or comprehensive category.
groups.summary_zh: 在逻辑、分类或理论层面将子项统摄、归并到更大架构中。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the cognitive, administrative, or structural absorption of specific entities into an existing hierarchy or framework, differing from neutral 'classify' by emphasizing loss of autonomy or systematic assimilation.
groups.desc_zh: 指将特定实体认知性、行政性或结构性地归入既有体系或范畴，与单纯“分类（classify）”相比，强调被上位系统吸收同化或丧失原有独立性。
groups.nuance_en: integrate: combine parts into a harmonious, well-coordinated whole (systems / technology / immigrants) · pigeonhole: rigidly and unfairly classify into a narrow, oversimplified box (actor / idea / candidate) · incorporate: absorb external elements into an existing institutional body (clause / suggestion / practice) · assimilate: absorb and fully adapt new elements until original distinctiveness fades (minority / information / culture) · subsume: bring a secondary concept wholly under an overarching rule or umbrella (issue / identity / category)
groups.nuance_zh: integrate: 使各组分彼此协调融入完整体系 (systems / technology / immigrants) · pigeonhole: 僵化、狭隘地把某人某事贴标签归类 (actor / idea / candidate) · incorporate: 将外部要素吸纳并编入既有体制 (clause / suggestion / practice) · assimilate: 彻底同化吸收以至消除差异特质 (minority / information / culture) · subsume: 将次级概念或事项完全归并入上位总则 (issue / identity / category)

groups.name: Incriminate & Implicate · 牵连与使归罪 (Incriminate, Implicate, Inculpate)
groups.tip: 在法律或道义上指明其罪责

items.def_en: To falsely make someone seem guilty of a crime by fabricating evidence
items.ex_en: Corrupt detectives planted a stolen revolver to frame the innocent suspect for robbery.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的刑警放置了一把被盗左轮手枪，企图栽赃陷害无辜的抢劫嫌疑人。

items.def_en: To attach blame, responsibility, or guilt for something onto someone, often unfairly
items.ex_en: Desperate executives tried to pin the massive accounting disaster on a junior bookkeeper.
items.ex_zh: 走投无路的高管们试图把巨大的会计灾难栽赃归咎于初级簿记员。

items.def_en: To accuse, blame, or present evidence showing someone's involvement in a crime
items.ex_en: The leaked encrypted communications directly inculpate former senior officials in the bribery scheme.
items.ex_zh: 泄露的加密通信直接证明了前高级官员卷入了这桩受贿阴谋。

items.def_en: To show or suggest that someone is involved in a crime or dishonest activity
items.ex_en: Forensic investigators found microscopic biological traces that clearly implicate the driver in hit-and-run.
items.ex_zh: 法医调查人员发现了微量生物痕迹，清楚地显示该司机卷入了肇事逃逸案。

items.def_zh: 使显示有罪，连累；控告，归罪于
items.def_en: To make someone seem guilty of a crime, wrongdoing, or illegal act, especially through evidence or testimony
items.ex_en: He refused to answer interrogations because his truthful answers might incriminate his brother.
items.ex_zh: 他拒绝回答审讯，因为真实的回答可能会让他哥哥显示有罪而被定罪。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe providing evidence, testimony, or circumstantial proof that connects someone directly to a crime or misdeed. While incriminate emphasizes showing clear culpability, implicate often suggests entanglement in a wider conspiracy.
groups.summary_zh: 强调通过证据或供词将某人与罪行关联，使其陷于有罪境地。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the evidentiary or accusatory linkage of a person to a crime, fault, or scandal, contrasting with direct 'accuse' by focusing on causal entanglements and incriminating traces.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过证据、线索或陈述将某人与罪行、过失或丑闻建立因果牵连，与直接的“指控（accuse）”相比，重在呈现证据链上的卷入与罪责锁定。
groups.nuance_en: frame: fabricate false evidence deliberately to make an innocent person appear guilty (suspect / victim / rival) · pin on: unfairly assign blame or responsibility to someone convenient (blame / murder / rap) · inculpate: formally declare or demonstrate evidence of guilt in legal contexts (defendant / accomplice / suspect) · implicate: reveal indirect involvement or connection in a illicit affair (official / partner / colleague) · incriminate: provide strong evidentiary proof of criminal culpability (evidence / tape / confession)
groups.nuance_zh: frame: 蓄意构陷、伪造证据嫁祸于人 (suspect / victim / rival) · pin on: 将罪责强加或推卸给某人背锅 (blame / murder / rap) · inculpate: 司法语境下正式证明或归罪于 (defendant / accomplice / suspect) · implicate: 揭示某人与非法事件存在牵涉或共谋 (official / partner / colleague) · incriminate: 构成强有力的犯罪铁证 (evidence / tape / confession)

groups.name: Inculcate & Instill · 灌输与反复灌注 (Inculcate, Instill, Imbue)
groups.tip: 潜移默化反复告诫将思想灌输

items.def_zh: 逐渐灌输；潜移默化植入
items.def_en: To gradually but firmly cause someone to develop a feeling, attitude, or conviction over time
items.ex_en: The devoted mentor sought to instill profound intellectual curiosity within her young apprentices.
items.ex_zh: 这位尽心竭力的导师试图在年轻学徒心中潜移默化地植入深厚的求知欲。

items.def_zh: 反复灌输；死板敲打进脑袋
items.def_en: To force someone to learn or memorize an idea or rule through relentless repetition
items.ex_en: Our coach drummed the importance of defense into our heads every single day.
items.ex_zh: 我们的教练每天都把防守的重要性死板地敲打进我们的脑袋。

items.def_en: To firmly fix beliefs, habits, or attitudes so deeply that they are difficult to alter
items.ex_en: Years of rigorous military training ingrained a reflex of absolute obedience in him.
items.ex_zh: 多年严苛的军事训练在他心中牢牢根植了绝对服从的本能。

items.def_en: (+ with) To fill someone or something thoroughly with a quality, value, or emotion
items.ex_en: Her delicate landscape paintings were imbued with a profound sense of tranquil solitude.
items.ex_zh: 她精致的风景画深深浸润着一种深邃而宁静的孤寂感。

items.def_en: To fix an idea, belief, or moral principle firmly in someone's mind through frequent repetition or persistent teaching
items.ex_en: The academy sought to inculcate civic virtues and personal honor in young scholars.
items.ex_zh: 该学院力求在年轻学者心中反复灌输公民美德与个人荣誉感。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe forceful, methodical, or deep-seated embedding of habits, tenets, or values into another person's psyche over time.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过反复灌输或长期渗透将思想理念深深植入心智。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the persistent, repetitive, and deep implantation of values, habits, or ideas into the subconscious mind, differing from neutral 'teach' through relentless insistence or deep saturation.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过反复叮咛、长期浸润或强制灌输将价值观、观念或习惯深植入潜意识，与中性“教授（teach）”相比，强调高频重复与深刻渗透。
groups.nuance_en: instill: introduce a desirable principle or feeling drop by drop over time (confidence / values / discipline) · drum into: force information into memory by harsh, unrelenting repetition (facts / rules / heads) · ingrain: establish an attitude or habit so deeply that it becomes second nature (habit / prejudice / belief) · imbue: deeply saturate the mind or character with an pervasive emotion or quality (spirit / soul / mind) · inculcate: systematically imprint moral duties or mental habits through earnest repetition (virtues / ideas / respect)

groups.name: Indebted & Beholden · 感激与受惠负恩 (Obligate, Indebt, Owe)
groups.tip: 深感承蒙恩惠，背负感激之情

items.def_en: To express direct gratitude or appreciation to someone for something they have provided
items.ex_en: I warmly thanked my mentor for guiding me through the complex research project.
items.ex_zh: 我由衷地感谢导师指导我完成了这项复杂的研究课题。

items.def_en: To have a duty to repay someone or feel bound to give gratitude, loyalty, or money
items.ex_en: The startup founder confessed that he owed his entire success to his team.
items.ex_zh: 这位初创企业创始人坦言，他把全部成功都归功于他的团队。

items.def_en: To place someone under an enduring moral obligation of gratitude for a kindness or benefit received
items.ex_en: Your timely assistance in this crisis will forever indebt our family to you.
items.ex_zh: 您在这场危机中的及时相助，将使我们全家对您永远深怀感激。

items.def_zh: 使负有义务；使在道义上受拘束
items.def_en: To bind someone morally or legally to perform a specific action or show reciprocity
items.ex_en: The signed contract legally obligates both parties to honor every agreed commercial term.
items.ex_zh: 签署的合同在法律上约束双方必须恪守所商定的每项商业条款。

items.def_zh: 感激……的，对……负有恩情（常以 be beholden to 形式出现）
items.def_en: (used chiefly as passive/participial verb with 'to') To be obligated, indebted, or deeply grateful to someone for help received.
items.ex_en: The proud craftsman refused charity, loath to be beholden to any wealthy patron.
items.ex_zh: 这位骄傲的工匠拒绝接受施舍，不愿对任何富有的资助人欠下人情。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers recognizing a debt of profound gratitude, duty, or moral obligation to another party for critical assistance, patronage, or kindness.
groups.summary_zh: 指因承蒙恩泽、鼎力相助而心怀感激，或在道义与责任上产生负欠之情。
groups.desc_en: Denotes psychological, moral, or financial entanglement in which one owes loyalty, duty, or restitution to a benefactor, differing from legal 'owe' by emphasizing moral weight and personal obligation.
groups.desc_zh: 指因受惠而产生的心理、道义或契约上的负债感与效忠义务，与单纯经济上的“欠债（owe）”相比，侧重情感负担与道义约束力。
groups.nuance_en: thank: express simple verbal or written gratitude to a helper (host / team / supporter) · owe: acknowledge an outstanding objective debt of money, gratitude, or duty (apology / debt / explanation) · indebt: place someone under a profound long-term sense of grateful obligation (voters / supporters / family) · obligate: bind someone legally or morally to a necessary course of action (contract / conscience / duty) · beholden: hold a binding, often burdensome sense of owing deference to a patron (donors / sponsor / party)
groups.nuance_zh: thank: 表达口头或礼节性的感谢 (host / team / supporter) · owe: 客观上欠下金钱、人情、道歉或解释 (apology / debt / explanation) · indebt: 使某人背负深切的知遇或受惠之恩 (voters / supporters / family) · obligate: 从道义或法规上施加必须履行的义务 (contract / conscience / duty) · beholden: 受制于施恩者而不得不唯命是从、深感负恩 (donors / sponsor / party)

groups.name: Indefinite Postponement & Shelving · 搁置与暂缓执行 (Shelve, Mothball, Sideline)
groups.tip: 延长时间或暂缓处理

items.def_en: To delay or put an enterprise on hold until a more favorable occasion arises
items.ex_en: The board decided to put the risky expansion project on ice for now.
items.ex_zh: 董事会决定暂时冻结这个高风险的扩张项目。

items.def_en: To give an issue low priority so that it receives attention only after urgent matters are settled
items.ex_en: We had to put the website redesign on the back burner this week.
items.ex_zh: 我们本周不得不先把重新设计网站的事缓一缓。

items.def_zh: 靠边放；排除在主流之外
items.def_en: To remove an issue or person from active consideration or center-stage participation
items.ex_en: The committee sidelined his progressive proposal in favor of a safer, traditional approach.
items.ex_zh: 委员会把他的激进提案搁置一旁，转而支持更稳妥的传统方案。

items.def_zh: 搁置，延缓（计划等）；把……放在架子上；倾斜
items.def_en: 1. To postpone or abandon a plan or project indefinitely. 2. To place an object on a shelf. 3. To slope gradually.
items.ex_en: The city council voted to shelve the costly subway expansion until next spring.
items.ex_zh: 市议会投票决定将造价高昂的地铁扩建计划搁置至明年春天。

items.def_en: To stop using or working on equipment or plans, preserving them for potential future revival
items.ex_en: The studio had to mothball the ambitious sequel after funding suddenly fell through.
items.ex_zh: 在资金链突然断裂后，制片厂不得不封存了那部雄心勃勃的续集计划。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on setting projects, legislation, or ideas aside indefinitely or putting them on ice rather than outright rejecting them.
groups.summary_zh: 将计划、动议或项目无限期搁置或封存暂缓推进。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the deliberate suspension, deferral, or prolonged freezing of an initiative or resource, differing from final 'cancel' by retaining the potential for future reactivation.
groups.desc_zh: 指对某项计划、项目或资产进行主动、长期的冻结或搁置，与彻底“取消（cancel）”不同，保留了未来解冻或重新启动的可能性。
groups.nuance_en: put on ice: deliberately suspend an active plan until conditions become favorable (deal / project / plans) · put on the back burner: relegate to low priority while urgent matters take precedence (reform / proposal / issue) · sideline: push a person or project out of active mainstream engagement (player / politician / initiative) · shelve: formally set aside an initiative or proposal indefinitely (legislation / proposal / project) · mothball: decommission and seal up physical assets in maintainable storage for future use (fleet / factory / plant)
groups.nuance_zh: put on ice: 暂时冻结某项计划以待转机 (deal / project / plans) · put on the back burner: 降为次要优先级而暂缓处理 (reform / proposal / issue) · sideline: 使某人或某事被边缘化、靠边站 (player / politician / initiative) · shelve: 正式搁置提案或项目，不再推进 (legislation / proposal / project) · mothball: 封存工厂或军备资产以备日后解封重用 (fleet / factory / plant)

groups.name: Indelible Marking & Etching · 刻印与铭留 (Etch, Inscribe, Imprint)
groups.tip: 在物体表面刻印或刺上标记图案

items.def_en: Write, engrave, or carve words or symbols formally onto a surface
items.ex_en: The jeweler meticulously inscribed the couple's wedding vows inside the platinum ring.
items.ex_zh: 珠宝匠小心翼翼地将新人的结婚誓词铭刻在铂金戒指内圈。

items.def_zh: 在……上刺花纹（或文身）；连续有节奏地敲击
items.def_en: 1. To mark the skin with an indelible pattern or design by inserting pigment beneath the epidermis. 2. To tap or rap continuously and rhythmically.
items.ex_en: The sailor chose to tattoo a classic nautical compass onto his right forearm.
items.ex_zh: 那名水手选择在自己的右前臂上刺上一个经典的航海罗盘。

items.def_en: Press a mark or design into something, or fix an impression deeply in mind
items.ex_en: The traumatic childhood accident would imprint a lasting fear of water upon him.
items.ex_zh: 童年时那场创伤性的意外在他心中深深印下了对水的持久恐惧。

items.def_en: Cut a pattern or design into a hard surface with acid or a sharp tool
items.ex_en: The artisan used acid to etch delicate floral patterns into the copper plate.
items.ex_zh: 工匠用酸液在铜板上蚀刻出细腻的花卉图案。

items.def_en: Mark skin or livestock permanently with a hot iron, or fix a reputation indelibly
items.ex_en: The unfair trial would forever brand the honest merchant as a common thief.
items.ex_zh: 那场不公的审判彻底给这位诚实的商人打上了寻常盗贼的耻辱烙印。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on applying permanent, indelible designs, text, or pigment onto skin, stone, or mental memory. Tattoo uses intradermal pigment, etch cuts with acid or tools, and imprint suggests lasting physical or cognitive impact.
groups.summary_zh: 在皮肤、物体表面或记忆深处刻下永久印记或图案。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the permanent, unalterable cutting, burning, or pressing of a design or mark into a surface or memory, contrasting with light 'draw' through permanence, trauma, or indelible depth.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过切削、烙印、压合等方式在表面或记忆中留下不可磨灭的永久标记，与浮于表面的“画出（draw）”相比，强调痕迹的不可逆性、创伤性或永久深度。
groups.nuance_en: inscribe: carve, engrave, or write words ceremonially into stone, metal, or a book (name / monument / dedication) · tattoo: pierce permanent pigment irrevocably into living skin (arm / skin / flesh) · imprint: press a pattern, seal, or psychological trauma deeply into a substrate (footprint / pattern / memory) · etch: cut lines sharply with acid, a tool, or indelible emotion into glass or consciousness (glass / memory / face) · brand: burn a distinctive ownership mark or stigma permanently onto livestock or someone's reputation (cattle / traitor / criminal)
groups.nuance_zh: inscribe: 题献、铭刻字句于石碑、器物或书籍扉页 (name / monument / dedication) · tattoo: 用墨水针刺刺青于皮肤 (arm / skin / flesh) · imprint: 在基底或记忆深处压印出深陷印记 (footprint / pattern / memory) · etch: 用酸液蚀刻，或将画面永恒铭刻于心 (glass / memory / face) · brand: 用烙铁打上烙印，或在名誉上定性贴上永久污名 (cattle / traitor / criminal)

groups.name: Indent & Pit · 凹陷与微小表面形变 (Indent, Pock, Dent, Corrugate)
groups.tip: 表面产生酒窝或凹痕

items.def_en: to form or cause to form small gentle waves or slight undulating depressions
items.ex_en: A sudden morning breeze rippled the glassy surface of the mountain lake gently.
items.ex_zh: 一阵清晨的微风轻轻吹拂，使高山湖泊如镜的湖面荡起层层细浪。
items.ex2_en: The glassy surface of the tranquil lake rippled softly under the dawn light.
items.ex2_zh: 平静湖面上那如镜的表面在晨光中泛起阵阵微波。

items.def_en: to make a hollow impression in the surface of something by striking or pressing it
items.ex_en: A stray flying baseball managed to dent the hood of my new car.
items.ex_zh: 一个乱飞的棒球把我新车的引擎盖砸出了一个凹坑。
items.ex2_en: Cheap aluminum siding dents very easily when heavy hail strikes during severe storms.
items.ex2_zh: 在强风暴中遭遇冰雹袭击时，廉价的铝质外墙非常容易凹陷。

items.def_zh: （使）现出酒窝；（使）起凹痕，起微波
items.def_en: to produce small hollow depressions or dimples on a surface (such as cheeks or water), or to become marked by them
items.ex_en: Heavy summer raindrops began to dimple the quiet surface of the garden pond.
items.ex_zh: 夏日的沉重雨滴开始在花园水池沉静的水面上砸出点点微漪。
items.ex2_en: Her rosy cheeks dimple delightfully whenever she smiles at funny childhood memories.
items.ex2_zh: 每当她因想起童年趣事而微笑时，红润的面颊就会可爱地泛起酒窝。

items.def_zh: 在表面留下凹痕；压出压印
items.def_en: to make a slight hollow, groove, or notch in a surface by pressing on it
items.ex_en: Tight rubber bands had deeply indented the clerk's tired wrists after long shifts.
items.ex_zh: 长时间轮班后，紧绷的橡皮筋在职员疲惫的手腕上压出了深深的勒痕。
items.ex2_en: Soft clay surfaces easily indent when heavy work boots press firmly down upon them.
items.ex2_zh: 当厚重的工作靴用力踩在柔软的黏土表面时，很容易留下压痕。

items.def_zh: 使生痘痕；使布满麻点凹斑
items.def_en: to mark or disfigure a surface with small, pitted scars or hollow craters
items.ex_en: Decades of severe acid rain continued to pock the ancient marble palace facade.
items.ex_zh: 数十年来严重的酸雨不断侵蚀，使这座古老的大理石宫殿立面斑驳凹陷。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers processes that distort a surface by creating tiny depressions, dips, pits, or localized hollows across its contour.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体表面受到挤压或物理影响而产生细小凹陷、凹痕、波纹等形变。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the localized deformation, depression, or pockmarking of an otherwise flat or smooth surface, differing from breaking or cracking by preserving structural continuity despite concavities.
groups.desc_zh: 指原本平整或光滑的表面出现局部凹陷、凹坑或微形变，与碎裂（breaking）不同，材料结构保持连续未断，但产生了凹凸起伏。
groups.nuance_en: ripple: form small, continuous undulating ridges across a flexible or liquid surface (water / muscle / silk) · dent: produce a hollow concave impression through blunt impact (car / bumper / pride) · dimple: produce tiny, shallow, often appealing depressions (cheeks / surface / water) · indent: press or notch a regular inward recession into an edge or boundary (text / coastline / margin) · pock: mar a surface thoroughly with numerous crater-like pitting marks (skin / road / landscape)
groups.nuance_zh: ripple: 形成细小连续的起伏涟漪或波纹 (water / muscle / silk) · dent: 因钝力撞击而形成凹痕、凹坑 (car / bumper / pride) · dimple: 形成微小浅陷的酒窝状凹点 (cheeks / surface / water) · indent: 使边缘或文本向内凹进、缩进 (text / coastline / margin) · pock: 使表面布满麻点状、弹坑状凹坑 (skin / road / landscape)

groups.name: Indicate & Signal · 表明与显露 (Indicate, Signal, Bespeak)
groups.tip: 用手势或信号暗示提示事物

items.def_zh: 标明，指示；表明，显示；暗示
items.def_en: To point out or show something; to be a sign, signal, or suggestion of something
items.ex_en: Recent economic indicators clearly indicate a steady recovery across several domestic sectors.
items.ex_zh: 近期的经济指标清晰表明，数个国内行业正在稳步复苏。

items.def_en: To be a sign of something or make clear a particular state or intention
items.ex_en: The ambassador raised his hand to signify that the delicate negotiations had concluded.
items.ex_zh: 大使举起手，示意那场微妙的谈判已经圆满结束。

items.def_en: To show or make clear that a particular event, change, or attitude is happening or likely
items.ex_en: The sudden military buildup seemed to signal a major shift in foreign policy.
items.ex_zh: 骤然的军事集结似乎预示着外交政策的重大转变。

items.def_zh: 表明，表露出（品质或感觉）
items.def_en: To reveal the presence of a quality, feeling, or state through clear signs
items.ex_en: The young pianist evinced remarkable poise throughout her demanding international competition debut.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻的钢琴家在她高难度的国际比赛首秀中展现了非凡的从容。

items.def_en: To suggest or show signs of something through appearance or behavior
items.ex_en: His tailored suit and impeccable manners bespeak a wealthy, highly cultured upbringing.
items.ex_zh: 他考究的西装与无瑕的举止显露出其富有且极具教养的出身。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to providing evidence, signs, or symptoms that something exists, is true, or is about to occur. Unlike direct verbal utterance, the transmission is achieved through cues, data, or observable markers.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过迹象、数据、征兆或行为侧面表明或暗示某种事实。
groups.desc_en: Denotes serving as a diagnostic, communicative, or symbolic symptom of an underlying reality, moving beyond plain 'show' by pointing to covert conditions, intentions, or systemic patterns.
groups.desc_zh: 指充当某种内在现实、征候或意图的外在显露与诊断性表征，与简单的“展现（show）”相比，侧重透过表象揭示深层实质或预示走势。
groups.nuance_en: indicate: point out or provide direct symptomatic evidence of a state of affairs (trend / gauge / direction) · signify: bear an important symbolic, conventional, or consequential meaning (change / agreement / intention) · signal: intentionally transmit a message or herald an impending shift (readiness / shift / departure) · evince: display subtle outward tokens of a feeling, attitude, or quality (interest / reluctance / surprise) · bespeak: serve as eloquent unwitting testament to an underlying standard or history (quality / wealth / past)
groups.nuance_zh: indicate: 指向或提供显示某种状态的直接迹象 (trend / gauge / direction) · signify: 具有特定符号学意义或预示重大含义 (change / agreement / intention) · signal: 明确发出信号或预示转折动向 (readiness / shift / departure) · evince: 细微流露出某种情绪、品质或态度 (interest / reluctance / surprise) · bespeak: 成为彰显某种背景、底蕴或质量的有力见证 (quality / wealth / past)

groups.name: Indict & Arraign · 控诉与起诉 (Indict, Charge, Arraign)
groups.tip: 从口头指责升级为正式起诉

items.def_en: (+ with) To state officially that someone is believed to be guilty of a crime
items.ex_en: Federal prosecutors decided to charge the corrupt mayor with multiple counts of fraud.
items.ex_zh: 联邦检察官决定正式指控这位腐败的市长犯有多项欺诈罪。

items.def_en: To officially charge someone with a crime and conduct legal proceedings against them in court
items.ex_en: The state attorney vowed to vigorously prosecute corporate polluters dumping hazardous toxic waste.
items.ex_zh: 州检察官誓言要严厉起诉倾倒危险有毒废物的涉案企业。

items.def_zh: 控告，起诉（尤指大陪审团正式指控）
items.def_en: (law) To officially accuse someone of a serious crime and charge them formally in court
items.ex_en: The federal grand jury voted to indict the executive for wire fraud.
items.ex_zh: 联邦大陪审团投票决定以电信欺诈罪正式起诉该主管。

items.def_en: To bring an accused person before a court to hear and answer a formal criminal charge
items.ex_en: Authorities will formally arraign the burglary suspect in district court tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 当局将于明早把这名入室盗窃嫌疑人押送至地方法院提审控罪。

items.def_en: To formally charge a public official with high crimes or serious misconduct while in office
items.ex_en: Parliament gathered in an emergency session to impeach the defiant prime minister.
items.ex_zh: 议会召开了紧急会议，以弹劾拒不妥协的首相。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this legal frame signify lodging an official criminal or civil charge against someone in a formal tribunal or court of law. The act moves the accusation from mere suspicion to binding judicial procedure.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过司法或官方程序正式对嫌疑人提出刑事或严重罪名指控。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the formal, institutional invocation of legal or constitutional mechanisms to accuse and try someone for a high-level offense, differing from colloquial 'blame' through strict statutory authority.
groups.desc_zh: 指借助司法或宪制权力与法定程序，正式对某人的违法或违宪罪行提出起诉、审讯或弹劾，与非正式的“责难（blame）”不同，具严格的法定效力与严肃后果。
groups.nuance_en: charge: formally accuse a suspect of a specific criminal offense in police custody (theft / assault / suspect) · prosecute: conduct full judicial proceedings against a defendant in a court of law (case / criminal / offender) · indict: formally return a true bill of indictment against a defendant via grand jury (politician / executive / murder) · arraign: bring an accused prisoner formally before a court to hear charges and enter a plea (court / suspect / tribunal) · impeach: formally charge a sitting constitutional public official with high crimes before a legislature (president / judge / governor)
groups.nuance_zh: charge: 警方或检方对嫌犯正式提出特定刑事控告 (theft / assault / suspect) · prosecute: 在法庭上正式对被告提起公诉审理 (case / criminal / offender) · indict: 大陪审团根据法定程序正式签署起诉书 (politician / executive / murder) · arraign: 传讯被告到庭听取控罪并正式答辩 (court / suspect / tribunal) · impeach: 议会机构对在职高级公职人员启动违宪或重大罪行弹劾 (president / judge / governor)

groups.name: Indoctrinate & Instill · 灌输与强加信仰 (Indoctrinate, Brainwash, Inculcate)
groups.tip: 反复灌输思想与系统性教育

items.def_zh: 逐渐灌输，潜移默化渗透
items.def_en: (+ in/into) Gradually and firmly establish an idea, virtue, or principle in someone's mind
items.ex_en: Wise parents gently instill empathy and selfless compassion into their young children.
items.ex_zh: 明智的父母会潜移默化地将同理心和无私的善意灌输给年幼的孩子。

items.def_zh: 谆谆教导，反复灌输（道德准则）
items.def_en: Instill an idea, attitude, or habit by persistent, repeated instruction
items.ex_en: Our teachers consistently endeavored to inculcate intellectual curiosity and honesty in us.
items.ex_zh: 老师们一贯致力于向我们谆谆灌输求知欲与诚实守信的品质。

items.def_zh: 反复强行灌输，硬塞进脑子
items.def_en: Drive an idea or rule into someone's head through constant, forceful repetition
items.ex_en: My dad repeatedly drummed road safety rules into my head before driving.
items.ex_zh: 在开车前，父亲一再强行把道路安全规则硬塞进我的脑袋里。

items.def_zh: 灌输，强行灌输（思想或信仰）；教导
items.def_en: To teach someone to accept a set of beliefs uncritically and without questioning.
items.ex_en: The totalitarian regime sought to indoctrinate young students with radical nationalist dogma.
items.ex_zh: 极权政权试图用激进的民族主义教条向年轻学生强行灌输思想。

items.def_en: Force someone to adopt radically different beliefs through coercive mental pressure
items.ex_en: The dangerous cult attempted to brainwash members into relinquishing all personal wealth.
items.ex_zh: 这个危险的邪教试图对成员进行洗脑，迫使他们交出所有个人财富。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail the persistent, one-sided, or coercive implantation of rigid doctrines, dogma, and beliefs, preempting critical skepticism.
groups.summary_zh: 强调单向度、系统性地植入教条以消除怀疑精神。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the systematic drilling or ideological conditioning of individuals to accept doctrine uncritically, differing from open-ended 'educate' by deliberately stifling critical reflection.
groups.desc_zh: 指系统性、强制性地灌输特定意识形态或教条，促使受众盲从接受，与开放式“教育（educate）”相比，具有抹杀批判性思维的专断本质。
groups.nuance_en: instill: introduce positive principles or habits gradually into a developing mind (morals / values / discipline) · inculcate: enforce dogma or duties through repetitive, earnest teaching (patriotism / ethics / ideas) · drum into: beat information persistently into a student's mind through coercive drill (facts / dogma / rules) · indoctrinate: systematically train individuals to embrace partisan ideology without questioning (recruits / youth / soldiers) · brainwash: break down a captive subject's mental resistance to force total ideological conversion (prisoner / cult / captive)
groups.nuance_zh: instill: 循序渐进地植入某种积极信念或品格 (morals / values / discipline) · inculcate: 借助系统严肃的教导灌输道德或教条 (patriotism / ethics / ideas) · drum into: 采取单调生硬的高压训练强行灌注 (facts / dogma / rules) · indoctrinate: 灌输特定宗派、党派思想使之全盘盲从 (recruits / youth / soldiers) · brainwash: 摧毁受控者的心理防线以实现彻底的洗脑重塑 (prisoner / cult / captive)

groups.name: Indoctrinate & Subjugate · 灌输与思想控制 (Brainwash, Indoctrinate, Condition)
groups.tip: 从循循善诱到思想洗脑

items.def_zh: 反复灌输；强行念叨输入
items.def_en: To force information or lessons into someone's memory by endless, insistent repetition
items.ex_en: She had to drum the irregular Spanish verbs into her head overnight.
items.ex_zh: 她不得不连夜通过反复念叨把那些西班牙语不规则动词硬背下来。

items.def_en: To train or habituate someone systematically to behave or react in a predetermined way
items.ex_en: Laboratory experiments can condition laboratory animals to anticipate food at specific chimes.
items.ex_zh: 实验室实验可以驯化实验动物在听到特定钟声时预期获得食物。

items.def_zh: 重塑思维模式；彻底洗脑
items.def_en: To alter a person's core attitudes or ideological conditioning fundamentally and systematically
items.ex_en: Intensive psychological therapy aimed to reprogramme his deeply destructive thought patterns completely.
items.ex_zh: 强化心理治疗旨在彻底重塑他那极具破坏性的思维模式。

items.def_en: (+ with/in) To teach someone to accept a set of beliefs uncritically and reject opposing viewpoints
items.ex_en: The strict religious commune indoctrinates young children in narrow sectarian traditions.
items.ex_zh: 这个封闭狭隘的宗教公社用狭隘的教派传统向幼童灌输思想。

items.def_en: 1. (+ into) To force someone to abandon their beliefs and accept new ones through intense psychological pressure and repetition.
items.ex_en: Extremists tried to brainwash the impressionable youth into committing acts of violence.
items.ex_zh: 极端分子企图对这个易受影响的年轻人洗脑，诱使其犯下暴力罪行。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe systematically forcing ideological dogmas upon someone through coercive, high-intensity mental conditioning or censorship.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过系统性压迫、灌输或心理控制强行重塑思维。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the psychological subjugation and restructuring of an individual's autonomy and cognitive faculties, differing from 'persuade' by utilizing coercive, Pavlovian, or totalist techniques.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过强迫性、巴甫洛夫条件反射或极权主义控制手段，对个体心理机制进行彻底改造与精神奴役，与理性的“说服（persuade）”具有本质区别。
groups.nuance_en: drum into: drive instructions relentlessly into someone until original thoughts yield (routine / orders / doctrine) · condition: train automatic psychological reflexes through repetitive behavioral stimulus-response (response / subjects / reflex) · reprogramme: systematically overwrite an individual's deep cognitive or emotional operating system (mind / beliefs / instincts) · indoctrinate: mold the world view through totalitarian, one-sided doctrine (population / youth / party) · brainwash: thoroughly shatter and replace an individual's identity and core convictions under extreme pressure (hostage / victim / cultists)
groups.nuance_zh: drum into: 持续机械性灌注直到个体失去自主思考 (routine / orders / doctrine) · condition: 借助行为刺激-反应反复训练生理或心理条件反射 (response / subjects / reflex) · reprogramme: 系统性覆写个体的底层认知结构与思维程序 (mind / beliefs / instincts) · indoctrinate: 运用单向教条从世界观层面进行统战模塑 (population / youth / party) · brainwash: 在极端封闭或高压下彻底瓦解并重组受害者的思想 (hostage / victim / cultists)

groups.name: Infect & Transmit · 感染与传染 (Infect, Contaminate, Transmit)
groups.tip: 病原体入侵或受到有害污染

items.def_en: To disperse widely or cause an infectious illness or attitude to reach more people
items.ex_en: Panic quickly spread through the crowded market as the alarm bells rang.
items.ex_zh: 警报声骤响，恐慌情绪瞬间在拥挤的集市中蔓延开来。
items.ex2_en: Careless travelers inadvertently spread the contagious flu virus across several major cities.
items.ex2_zh: 粗心大意的旅客无意中将这种传染性流感病毒散播到了几座大城市。

items.def_en: To transmit an infection, sickness, or habit to another individual
items.ex_en: Symptomatic individuals can easily pass on the contagious virus to vulnerable relatives.
items.ex_zh: 出现症状的个体很容易将这种传染性病毒传给体弱的亲属。

items.def_zh: 传染，使感染；使受不良影响
items.def_en: 1. To pass a disease or pathogen to a person, animal, or plant. 2. To affect someone with a particular feeling, idea, or harmful influence.
items.ex_en: Contaminated water supplies can quickly infect hundreds of unsuspecting villagers with cholera.
items.ex_zh: 受污染的水源很快就会让数百名毫无防备的村民感染上霍乱。

items.def_en: To pass an infectious disease, gene, or electrical/acoustic signal from one entity to another
items.ex_en: Infected mosquitoes frequently transmit the dangerous malaria parasite during nocturnal feedings.
items.ex_zh: 携带病菌的蚊子常在夜间吸血时传播危险的疟原虫。

items.def_en: To make a substance, environment, or person impure or poisonous by introducing harmful organisms or chemicals
items.ex_en: Industrial runoffs could severely contaminate the pristine freshwater river downstream within hours.
items.ex_zh: 工业污水可能在数小时内严重污染下游原始纯净的淡水河。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on passing biological pathogens, contaminants, or contagious behaviors/sentiments from a carrier to a host organism or medium.
groups.summary_zh: 指将病原体、污染物或极具扩散性的情绪传递并侵染宿主或媒介。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the biological, chemical, or systemic conveyance of a pathogen, toxin, or corrupting influence, differing from neutral 'move' by producing illness, degradation, or hazard.
groups.desc_zh: 指病原体、毒素或不良风气在生物、介质或系统中的扩散传导，与物理性的“移动（move）”相比，其结果必然伴随侵染、败坏或污染风险。
groups.nuance_en: spread: expand outward across a wider surface or populace (virus / disease / panic) · pass on: transfer a pathogen or trait directly along to another recipient (infection / gene / virus) · infect: enter an organism or computer system and corrupt it with replicating pathology (patient / blood / files) · transmit: broadcast or pass a disease or signal across intermediate vectors (pathogen / virus / signal) · contaminate: render an environment or pure substance impure by introducing toxins (water / food / evidence)
groups.nuance_zh: spread: 在广阔区域或人群中自发蔓延散布 (virus / disease / panic) · pass on: 人际间直接传递或代际转交病原体/特质 (infection / gene / virus) · infect: 病原体侵入机体或系统进行破坏性繁殖侵染 (patient / blood / files) · transmit: 通过特定媒介途径传导病原体或信号 (pathogen / virus / signal) · contaminate: 混入毒害异物从而破坏水源、食物或证据的洁净 (water / food / evidence)

groups.name: Infiltrate & Permeate · 渗入与渗透 (Infiltrate, Penetrate, Pervade)
groups.tip: 神不知鬼不觉悄悄进入

items.def_en: To begin to enter or affect something gradually and imperceptibly, often with harmful results
items.ex_en: Subtle biases can easily creep in when researchers evaluate self-reported psychological data.
items.ex_zh: 当研究人员评估自我报告的心理数据时，微妙的偏差很容易不知不觉潜入其中。

items.def_zh: 巧妙钻营钻入；谄媚渗入
