items.def_en: To gradually, insidiously, or deceitfully gain favor, trust, or an influential position inside a group
items.ex_en: The ambitious junior associate managed to worm his way into the board.
items.ex_zh: 那个野心勃勃的初级合伙人设法钻营钻进了董事会内部。

items.def_en: To spread through every part of an organization, culture, or substance so that the influence is everywhere
items.ex_en: A lingering scent of woodsmoke and dried lavender permeated the entire cabin.
items.ex_zh: 柴火烟与干薰衣草的持久香气弥漫了整座木屋。

items.def_en: To enter or force a way into an organization, secure zone, or market against resistance
items.ex_en: The tech firm struggled to penetrate emerging international markets despite heavy investments.
items.ex_zh: 尽管投入巨资，这家科技公司仍难以打入新兴的国际市场。

items.def_en: 1. (+ into) To enter an organization, territory, or group secretly in order to spy on it or gain influence. 2. To pass slowly into or through something, as a liquid or gas does.
items.ex_en: Undercover agents managed to infiltrate the notorious criminal cartel after months underground.
items.ex_zh: 经过数月的卧底，特工们终于成功潜入了那个臭名昭著的犯罪集团。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on covertly crossing physical or organizational barriers to gain access, or gradually spreading deeply throughout a structure or group.
groups.summary_zh: 指秘密潜入组织内部或物质逐步渗透扩散以实施控制。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the insidious, gradual, or covert entry of agents or elements through a barrier into the interior of a system, differing from forceful 'invade' by relying on stealth, molecular diffusion, or stealthy breach.
groups.desc_zh: 指外部人员、有害物或思想通过隐秘、缓步或分子扩散的方式突破界限渗入体系内部，与野蛮强攻的“侵略（invade）”不同，强调隐匿性与深层渗透。
groups.nuance_en: creep in: steal in imperceptibly through unnoticed cracks or lapses (doubt / errors / complacency) · worm one's way into: gain covert, flattering, or manipulative access into intimacy or power (favor / confidence / organization) · permeate: diffuse evenly throughout every pore or aspect of an entire medium (culture / smell / society) · penetrate: pierce decisively through a defensive perimeter or thick barrier (market / defense / skin) · infiltrate: slip secretly past security into an opposing network or territory (ranks / gang / network)
groups.nuance_zh: creep in: 趁人不备从缝隙中悄然不知不觉潜入 (doubt / errors / complacency) · worm one's way into: 极尽阿谀钻营之能事混入权力或圈子 (favor / confidence / organization) · permeate: 呈弥散状均匀渗透浸润整个媒介或社会 (culture / smell / society) · penetrate: 凌厉刺破、穿透外围防御或厚重屏障 (market / defense / skin) · infiltrate: 伪装身份卧底潜入敌对组织内部 (ranks / gang / network)

groups.name: Inform & Clue In · 提示内情与通气 (Tip Off, Put Wise, Fill In)
groups.tip: 不点破直接给出微小线索

items.def_en: (+ on) To give someone essential information or details that they missed
items.ex_en: Could you fill me in on what happened during the morning meeting?
items.ex_zh: 你能向我透露一下早会期间具体发生了什么吗？

items.def_en: (+ in / on) (informal) To give someone essential information or hints about something.
items.ex_en: Someone needs to clue the new manager in on our office politics.
items.ex_zh: 得有人给新来的经理提个醒，让他了解咱们办公室的政治人际。

items.def_en: (+ of) To inform or make someone aware of an ongoing condition or development
items.ex_en: The secretary entered promptly to apprise the diplomat of the sudden crisis.
items.ex_zh: 秘书迅速走入室内，正式向这位外交官通报这起突发危机。

items.def_en: (+ to) To give someone true information or advice that opens their eyes to reality
items.ex_en: A savvy veteran colleague finally put him wise to the corrupt scheme.
items.ex_zh: 一位经验丰富的老同事最终点醒了他，让他看清了这个腐败骗局的内幕。

items.def_en: To warn or alert someone secretly about something likely to happen
items.ex_en: An anonymous caller decided to tip off the police about the robbery.
items.ex_zh: 一名匿名来电者决定向警方通风报信，揭露那起抢劫计划。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe giving someone inside information, confidential hints, or clarifying updates so they understand a hidden situation or know how to act.
groups.summary_zh: 指私下告知关键信息、提供内幕提示或补齐背景情况，使人明晰真相。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the discreet, informal, or privileged transmission of non-public intelligence to prepare someone, differing from broad 'announce' by being private, tactical, and asymmetrical.
groups.desc_zh: 指私下、非正式或针对性地向某人通风报信、补全内幕信息，与公开的“通知/宣布（announce）”相比，具有私密性、战术性与情报优势差。
groups.nuance_en: fill in: supply missing background details or recent updates to bring someone up to speed (colleague / boss / details) · clue: give someone essential hints to solve a puzzle or comprehend a reality (someone in / detective / player) · apprise: formally inform a superior or party of ongoing developments (minister / commander / board) · put wise: informally enlighten a naive person to an active deception or street reality (newcomer / sucker / victim) · tip off: secretly warn someone in advance about impending danger, raid, or opportunity (police / press / suspect)
groups.nuance_zh: fill in: 提供缺失的来龙去脉使某人跟上最新进展 (colleague / boss / details) · clue: 提供关键线索助某人开窍或看清真相 (someone in / detective / player) · apprise: 比较公事公办地向上级或相关方通报局势 (minister / commander / board) · put wise: 给外行或受蒙蔽者私下点拨门道与内幕 (newcomer / sucker / victim) · tip off: 提前秘密通风报信以预警搜查、抓捕或提供内线情报 (police / press / suspect)

groups.name: Inform & Notify · 告知与通告 (Inform, Notify, Apprise)
groups.tip: 向对方正式告知通报最新情况

items.def_en: (+ of/about) To impart information or facts clearly to another person
items.ex_en: The doctor had to inform the anxious family about the serious prognosis.
items.ex_zh: 医生不得不正式告知焦急的家属关于病情的严峻预后。

items.def_en: (+ on) To give concise, necessary instructions or preparatory information to someone
items.ex_en: The general gathered his lieutenants to brief them on the imminent operation.
items.ex_zh: 将军把中尉们召集在一起，就即将展开的军事行动向他们作了简报。

items.def_en: (+ on) To provide someone with missing background facts, context, or recent details
items.ex_en: Let me quickly fill you in on the latest changes to our travel itinerary.
items.ex_zh: 让我快点跟你交代一下我们旅行行程的最新变动细节。

items.def_en: (+ of/that) To officially give information or notice about something to someone
items.ex_en: The university registrar will officially notify all admitted students via secure email.
items.ex_zh: 大学教务处将通过保密邮件正式通报所有被录取的学生。

items.def_en: (+ of) (variant spelling of apprise) To inform or formally give notice to someone about something.
items.ex_en: The foreign minister took swift action to apprize the cabinet of threats.
items.ex_zh: 外交部长迅速采取行动，正式向内阁通报了面临的安全威胁。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe conveying formal, factual information, updates, or notifications to a party who needs to know. They differ in register from everyday informing to solemn legal or official notice.
groups.summary_zh: 指正式告知、通知某人关键事实或最新情况。
groups.desc_en: To transmit factual knowledge or formal updates to another party, contrasting with open discourse or causal teaching by focusing strictly on the directional delivery of operational information.
groups.desc_zh: 指将事实信息或正式事态定向传递给受众，与双向讨论或系统施教不同，重在信息的传达与告知本身。
groups.nuance_en: inform: general transmission of essential facts (public / staff) · notify: formal or official declaration requiring record (authorities / next of kin) · apprize: formal updating on an unfolding situation (president / committee) · brief: concise operational run-through before action (team / pilot) · fill in: informal caught-up summary of missing details (colleague / friend)
groups.nuance_zh: inform: 最通用地传递必要事实 (public / staff) · notify: 正式、公函式或依规通知 (authorities / next of kin) · apprize: 高度正式地告知最新事态进展 (president / committee) · brief: 行动前扼要传达任务或要点 (team / pilot) · fill in: 口语中为某人补齐漏掉的细节背景 (colleague / friend)

groups.name: Infuse & Fortify · 掺入与强化 (Fortify, Lace, Spike)
groups.tip: 将微量添加物掺入原液中

items.def_en: To secretly add alcohol, a drug, or a poison to someone's drink
items.ex_en: The criminal attempted to spike her tropical cocktail with a potent sedative.
items.ex_zh: 那个罪犯企图在她的热带鸡尾酒里偷偷掺入强效镇静剂。
items.ex2_en: Global oil prices spiked sharply following unexpected disruptions at major offshore refineries.
items.ex2_zh: 在主要海上炼油厂遭遇意外中断后，全球石油价格急剧攀升。

items.def_zh: 掺入少量（酒精、毒物或药物）
items.def_en: (+ with) To add a small amount of a strong substance, alcohol, or drug to food or drink
items.ex_en: The bartender quietly laced the fruit punch with rum before serving the guests.
items.ex_zh: 调酒师在上菜前悄悄在果汁宾治中掺入了一点朗姆酒。

items.def_en: To increase the nutritional or mineral value of food or drink by adding vitamins or minerals
items.ex_en: Many manufacturers fortify breakfast cereals with essential vitamins and iron to prevent deficiencies.
items.ex_zh: 许多生产商在早餐谷物中强化必需维生素和铁，以预防营养缺乏。

items.def_en: To steep or introduce a quality, chemical, or flavor thoroughly into an existing medium
items.ex_en: The chef decided to infuse the olive oil with crushed rosemary and garlic.
items.ex_zh: 厨师决定将压碎的迷迭香和大蒜充分浸泡萃取到橄榄油中。

items.def_en: To add a small amount of fluoride to public drinking water or toothpaste to prevent tooth decay.
items.ex_en: Municipal authorities agreed to fluoridate the public drinking water to protect children's dental health.
items.ex_zh: 市政当局同意给公共饮用水加氟，以保护儿童的牙齿健康。

groups.summary_en: Denotes deliberately introducing a specific chemical, nutrient, flavoring, or foreign element into a bulk liquid or substrate to alter its properties.
groups.summary_zh: 向水体、食物或基质中有针对性地添加矿物、药剂或成分以改变效性。
groups.desc_en: To add a minor, potent substance into a medium to chemically fortify, alter, or covertly contaminate it, contrasting with mere inert physical mixing.
groups.desc_zh: 指将微量而强效的成分掺入媒介以强化营养、改变风味或暗中投毒，区别于一般的物理混合。
groups.nuance_en: fortify: enrich nutritionally or strengthen defensively (wine / cereal / defenses) · infuse: steep or slowly permeate to extract flavor or medicinal quality (tea / herbs / oil) · lace: subtly blend in an intoxicating or lethal substance (drink / coffee / poison) · spike: covertly add alcohol or drugs to a beverage (punch / drink) · fluoridate: deliberately treat a water supply with fluoride (water / supply)
groups.nuance_zh: fortify: 强化营养价值或增强防御 (wine / cereal / defenses) · infuse: 浸泡萃取使有效成分缓慢析出渗透 (tea / herbs / oil) · lace: 巧妙或隐秘地掺入麻醉物或毒药 (drink / coffee / poison) · spike: 偷偷往饮品中下烈酒或药物 (punch / drink) · fluoridate: 专指在公共供水中加氟 (water / supply)

groups.name: Infuse & Imbue · 注入与充盈 (Infuse, Imbue, Instill)
groups.tip: 浸泡萃取或思想浸润灌输

items.def_en: To bring renewed excitement, fresh vitality, or imagination into an otherwise flagging project
items.ex_en: Her radical creative vision promised to breathe into the weary, long-neglected urban redevelopment scheme.
items.ex_zh: 她激进的创作构想有望为这个疲软且久被忽视的城市改造方案注入新生机。

items.def_en: (+ into) To introduce a new quality, mood, or financial element suddenly to improve a situation
items.ex_en: The host managed to inject some much-needed humor into the tense panel discussion.
items.ex_zh: 主持人设法在紧张的小组讨论中注入了一些急需的幽默感。

items.def_en: 1. (+ with/into) To fill someone or something with a strong quality, emotion, or energy. 2. To soak tea leaves or herbs in hot liquid to extract flavor.
items.ex_en: The passionate address seemed to infuse the weary soldiers with renewed hope and determination.
items.ex_zh: 那场激昂的演讲似乎给疲倦的士兵们注入了重生的希望与决心。

items.def_en: (+ in/into) To gradually put a feeling, virtue, or idea into someone's mind until it becomes part of them
items.ex_en: Good teachers continually strive to instill a lifelong curiosity into their young students' hearts.
items.ex_zh: 优秀的教师总是竭力在年幼学子的心田里逐步灌输终生求知的热情。

items.def_en: (+ with) To fill someone or something completely with a specified quality, feeling, or conviction
items.ex_en: The solemn national anthem imbued the gathered crowd with a profound sense of reverence.
items.ex_zh: 庄严的国歌让聚集的群众心中充满了崇高的敬畏之情。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate imparting a pervasive quality, spirit, or feeling into an atmosphere, creative work, or person's demeanor.
groups.summary_zh: 指将某种特质、精神或情怀注入某物，使其完全充盈。
groups.desc_en: To pervade an entity with an immaterial quality, sentiment, or energy, transforming its psychological or aesthetic tone rather than physically changing it.
groups.desc_zh: 指将某种无形的品质、情感或精神力量渗透充盈于客体之中，重在心理或审美维度的浸染转化而非实体注入。
groups.nuance_en: infuse: spread a pervasive, uplifting quality throughout (optimism / vitality / soul) · imbue: deeply saturate beliefs, feelings, or values until inseparable (mind / culture / spirit) · instill: drip-feed values or habits gradually into a developing mind (discipline / confidence / values) · inject: introduce a sudden, sharp burst of energy or realism (humor / cash / momentum) · breathe into: revitalize or animate a stagnant entity (new life / movement / project)
groups.nuance_zh: infuse: 注入令人振奋的特质并使其弥漫扩散 (optimism / vitality / soul) · imbue: 将信念、情感深层熏陶浸染至浑然一体 (mind / culture / spirit) · instill: 润物无声般逐渐灌输准则或习惯 (discipline / confidence / values) · inject: 突发性强行注入急需的活力或元素 (humor / cash / momentum) · breathe into: 赋予停滞或垂死之物以全新生机 (new life / movement / project)

groups.name: Infuse & Saturate · 充注与注入渗透 (Infuse, Inject, Saturate)
groups.tip: 将气体或液体输送灌注到内部

items.def_en: To supply, treat, or enrich blood, water, or another substance with oxygen.
items.ex_en: The hospital ventilator helps oxygenate the patient's blood when natural breathing becomes severely impaired.
items.ex_zh: 当自然呼吸严重受损时，医院的呼吸机有助于为患者的血液充氧。

items.def_en: To introduce air or gas into a liquid or soil
items.ex_en: Gardeners often aerate compacted lawn soil to encourage deeper and healthier grass root growth.
items.ex_zh: 园丁经常给板结的草坪土壤透气，以促进草根更深、更健康地生长。

items.def_en: (+ into) To introduce a fluid, gas, or new element directly into something
items.ex_en: The technician had to inject pressurized carbon dioxide into the cooling system's main chamber.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员必须将加压的二氧化碳气体直接注入冷却系统的主腔室内。

items.def_en: (+ into/with) To fill something or someone with a particular quality, fluid, or energy
items.ex_en: The medical team prepared to infuse saline solution into the dehydrated runner's bloodstream.
items.ex_zh: 医疗团队准备向脱水的跑步运动员体内输注生理盐水。

items.def_en: (+ with) To cause something to absorb, hold, or be filled with the maximum amount of a substance
items.ex_en: Heavy prolonged rainstorms threatened to saturate the hillside soil with water and trigger landslides.
items.ex_zh: 持久的暴雨可能使山坡土壤含水量达到饱和，从而引发滑坡。

groups.summary_en: This frame involves permeating, enriching, or forcing a gas, fluid, or transformative quality into a body, liquid, or system to alter its composition or vigor.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过充入气体、液体或特质使受体渗透或富含该成分。
groups.desc_en: To force a gas, liquid, or energy into a substance to reach a state of physical immersion or limit-capacity saturation, distinguishing from superficial coating.
groups.desc_zh: 指将气体、液体或能量深层压入或浸润到物质内部以达充盈或饱和状态，区别于表层的涂抹覆盖。
groups.nuance_en: saturate: fill completely until no more can be physically absorbed (sponge / market / soil) · inject: force a fluid or substance inward under pressure (fluid / fuel / drug) · infuse: deliver a liquid steadily via drip or gentle pressure (vein / solution) · aerate: circulate air or gas through a liquid or soil (soil / lawn / water) · oxygenate: specifically enrich or bind with oxygen (blood / tissue / cells)
groups.nuance_zh: saturate: 完全浸透或充斥至物理吸收极限 (sponge / market / soil) · inject: 施加外力高压强行注入内部 (fluid / fuel / drug) · infuse: 恒速且平缓地滴注或渗入流体 (vein / solution) · aerate: 使空气或气体循环通入土壤或液体 (soil / lawn / water) · oxygenate: 专指通过生理或化学手段补充氧气 (blood / tissue / cells)

groups.name: Ingrain & Embed · 根植与植入 (Ingrain, Imbue, Inculcate)
groups.tip: 将观念与习惯深深扎根于心智中

items.def_en: To fix a practice, principle, or attitude firmly and securely inside a culture or psychological frame
items.ex_en: The company seeks to embed rigorous safety principles into every aspect of its culture.
items.ex_zh: 该公司力求将严格的安全准则牢固植入其企业文化的方方面面。

items.def_en: To fix an idea, feeling, or doubt firmly in someone's mind so that it takes root and grows
items.ex_en: A single careless rumor was enough to implant deep suspicion in the manager's mind.
items.ex_zh: 一句不经意的谣言就足以在经理心中植入深深的疑虑。

items.def_zh: 谆谆教诲；灌输（美德、原则）
items.def_en: (+ in/into) To fix ideas, habits, or moral principles deeply in someone's mind through persistent instruction
items.ex_en: Patience and humility were values that her grandmother diligently sought to inculcate in her.
items.ex_zh: 耐心和谦逊是她祖母多年来孜孜不倦向她谆谆灌输的品德。

items.def_en: (usually passive) To establish something so deeply that it cannot be easily removed or altered
items.ex_en: Such superstitious fears are rooted so deeply that logical arguments fail to dispel them.
items.ex_zh: 这些迷信的恐惧根深蒂固，合理的论点根本无法将其消除。
items.ex2_en: The gardener used special fertilizer to root the fragile young rose cuttings firmly.
items.ex2_zh: 园丁使用特种肥料让脆弱的幼嫩玫瑰插条牢牢生根。

items.def_zh: 使深深植根，使牢固确立
items.def_en: 1. (usually passive, 'be ingrained in') To fix a habit, belief, or attitude deeply in someone's mind so it is hard to change.
items.ex_en: A deep respect for traditional customs was firmly ingrained in the young village scholars.
items.ex_zh: 对传统习俗的深切敬重已牢固确立在这些年轻村塾学子的心中。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the deep, permanent embedding of values, traits, or habits into someone's consciousness through prolonged exposure, culture, or discipline.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过潜移默化或长期熏陶使观念、品性根深蒂固。
groups.desc_en: To fix an idea, habit, or object deeply and firmly into an underlying matrix so it becomes virtually impossible to dislodge, differing from transient adoption.
groups.desc_zh: 指将观念、习惯或实体深植并锚定于基质内使其根深蒂固、极难剥离，区别于浅层的接纳或暂时安置。
groups.nuance_en: ingrain: fix deeply through repetition until part of the intrinsic fabric (habits / prejudices / values) · inculcate: persistently drill doctrines or morals into someone's mind (morality / principles / discipline) · embed: seat an object or belief firmly into a surrounding context (code / chip / assumptions) · implant: surgically place or psychologically plant a seed of thought (organ / device / idea) · root: anchor firmly to an origin or foundation (tradition / conviction)
groups.nuance_zh: ingrain: 经年累月反复磨砺使其深入骨髓或纤维 (habits / prejudices / values) · inculcate: 坚持不懈地谆谆灌输教条或准则 (morality / principles / discipline) · embed: 将实体或观念严密嵌合进周边语境 (code / chip / assumptions) · implant: 外科式植入器械或在心智中植入想法 (organ / device / idea) · root: 深深扎根并以此为立足基石 (tradition / conviction)

groups.name: Initiate & Blood · 启蒙与受炼 (Blood, Initiate, Indoctrinate)
groups.tip: 初入社群接受考验

items.def_zh: 使（新兵、猎犬等）初次经受实战或严酷考验
items.def_en: To give someone, such as a soldier or hunting dog, their first experience of combat or strenuous activity.
items.ex_en: The brutal border skirmish finally blooded the young recruits against a ruthless enemy force.
items.ex_zh: 这场残酷的边境小规模冲突终于让新兵们在凶残的敌人面前初受战火洗礼。

items.def_en: (+ into) To admit someone into a group, society, or discipline with formal rites or instruction
items.ex_en: Elders will formally initiate the young apprentices into the sacred mysteries of their craft.
items.ex_zh: 长辈们将通过正式仪式引导年轻学徒入行，领悟其技艺的神圣奥秘。

items.def_en: To train a novice or adjust someone gently to new, demanding duties
items.ex_en: The senior clerk spent several weeks gently breaking in the newly appointed junior accountant.
items.ex_zh: 资深办事员花了数周时间耐心指导，使新上任的初级会计适应工作。

items.def_en: To subject someone to a severe introductory trial, especially in 'baptize by fire'
items.ex_en: The rookie quarterback was truly baptized by fire during his chaotic first playoff game.
items.ex_zh: 这位新秀四分卫在他混乱的首场季后赛中真正经受了战火的洗礼。

items.def_zh: 对新人整蛊折磨；霸凌初试
items.def_en: To subject a newcomer to humiliating, painful, or dangerous initiation tasks
items.ex_en: Fraternity members were formally disciplined after attempting to haze new pledges with dangerous stunts.
items.ex_zh: 联谊会成员在企图用危险动作整蛊霸凌新入会者后受到了正式处分。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict inducting someone into a closed group, profession, or rigorous ordeal through a definitive, often demanding or traumatizing first experience.
groups.summary_zh: 让新人经受严苛初试或入会仪式，使其完成洗礼并融入群体。
groups.desc_en: To introduce a novice into an exclusive group or rigorous reality through an ordeal or sacred rite of passage, contrasting with gradual self-directed learning.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过严酷考验、仪式或受洗使新手脱胎换骨并踏入特定圈子，区别于自发的缓和学习。
groups.nuance_en: initiate: formally admit someone into a secret, profession, or group (novice / member / recruit) · blood: introduce a novice to the harsh reality of violence or combat (troops / hound / youth) · baptize: subject to a severe initial trial that tests true mettle (under fire / combatants) · break in: accustom a newcomer or animal to regular operational discipline (recruit / horse / boots) · haze: harass or humiliate pledges in abusive initiation rituals (pledges / freshmen)
groups.nuance_zh: initiate: 经由正式仪式引介吸纳加入社团或领域 (novice / member / recruit) · blood: 初次令新手经受流血或战场残酷洗礼 (troops / hound / youth) · baptize: 经受最初但决定性的严峻炼试 (under fire / combatants) · break in: 磨合规训以使新人或马匹顺从就范 (recruit / horse / boots) · haze: 在入会式中施加恶性整蛊欺凌以示规训 (pledges / freshmen)

groups.name: Injure & Ache · 身体致伤与刺痛 (Throb, Sting, Burn)
groups.tip: 局部剧烈刺痛与灼痛

items.def_en: To experience a sudden brief spasm of sharp physical discomfort or pang of distress
items.ex_en: He felt his bad knee suddenly twinge as he stepped down onto the ice.
items.ex_zh: 当他迈步踩上冰面时，感到受伤的膝盖猛地抽痛了一下。

items.def_zh: 感到剧烈刺痛，灼痛；感到难过，感到屈辱
items.def_en: 1. To cause or feel a sharp, stinging, or burning pain. 2. (+ from/at) To feel upset, aggrieved, or wounded by a slight or defeat.
items.ex_en: The proud diplomat was still smarting from the public rebuke he received yesterday afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 这位心高气傲的外交官仍在为昨天下午受到的公开指责而感到委屈与难堪。

items.def_en: To cause or feel a sudden, sharp, pricking or burning localized pain
items.ex_en: The harsh antiseptic liquid made the open wound on his scraped forearm sting sharply.
items.ex_zh: 刺激性很强的消毒液使他擦伤的前臂伤口感到一阵剧烈的刺痛。

items.def_en: To produce a continuous, rhythmic, pulsing sensation of aching or pain
items.ex_en: A dull, persistent migraine began to throb behind her temples throughout the long flight.
items.ex_zh: 在漫长的飞行途中，一阵隐隐持续的偏头痛开始在她太阳穴后部阵阵抽痛。

items.def_en: To produce a severe, heated, stinging sensation resembling fire or acid on flesh
items.ex_en: The caustic chemical caused the researcher's exposed skin to burn like boiling oil.
items.ex_zh: 具有腐蚀性的化学物质让研究人员暴露的皮肤像滚油浇淋般灼痛不已。
items.ex2_en: Hot boiling grease burned the unwary chef's exposed arm during the dinner rush.
items.ex2_zh: 在晚餐用餐高峰期，滚烫的热油烫伤了毫无防备的厨师裸露的手臂。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express localized sharp, piercing, or pulsating somatic pain, as well as the immediate emotional aftermath of wounded pride. While 'smart' denotes stinging sharp pain, its neighbors encompass throbbing, burning, or dull soreness.
groups.summary_zh: 指伤口或肌体产生剧烈刺痛、灼痛、搏动性抽痛的生理与心理感受。
groups.desc_en: To manifest localized, unpleasant bodily sensations characterized by distinct physical patterns (pulsing, heat, or sharpness), differing from generalized systemic illness.
groups.desc_zh: 指身体局部显现出特定生理痛感（跳痛、灼热或尖锐刺痛），区别于全身性泛化疾病。
groups.nuance_en: throb: pulse rhythmically with heavy, dull, recurring pain (head / wound / finger) · sting: inflict or feel a sharp, acute, prickling burn (cut / eyes / slap) · burn: produce a searing, hot, continuous sensation (muscles / scrape / wound) · smart: ache with a persistent, stinging sharpness (eyes / wound / pride) · twinge: emit a sudden, brief, sharp spasm of pain (back / knee / tooth)
groups.nuance_zh: throb: 伴随脉搏节律的沉重抽痛或胀痛 (head / wound / finger) · sting: 犹如被螫般短暂而尖锐的刺痛灼痛 (cut / eyes / slap) · burn: 持续的火辣、灼热撕扯痛感 (muscles / scrape / wound) · smart: 持续难忍的辛辣刺痛 (eyes / wound / pride) · twinge: 突发、猝不及防的一阵抽搐性阵痛 (back / knee / tooth)

groups.name: Inlay & Embed · 镶嵌与置入 (Inlay, Inset, Encrust)
groups.tip: 嵌入本体，精密契合固牢

items.def_en: To set or insert something into the surface of an object so that it lies flush
items.ex_en: The artisan decided to inset a brass compass into the polished walnut desk top.
items.ex_zh: 工匠决定在打磨光亮的胡桃木桌面上平齐镶入一个黄铜罗盘。

items.def_en: To decorate wood with mosaic-like inlays of contrasting woods or other materials
items.ex_en: The master carpenter would patiently intarsia the ebony chest with pale bands of boxwood.
items.ex_zh: 那位木工大师耐心地用浅色黄杨木条给乌木箱作嵌花木工装饰。

items.def_en: To fix an object firmly and deeply into a surrounding solid mass
items.ex_en: Workers carefully embed the steel reinforcement rods directly into the wet structural concrete foundation.
items.ex_zh: 工人们小心地将钢筋深置于潮湿的建筑混凝土基座中。

items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To decorate a surface by setting pieces of wood, metal, or stone flush into carved spaces.
items.ex_en: Craftsmen used delicate silver wire to inlay the ornate wooden jewelry box with flowers.
items.ex_zh: 工匠们用精细的银丝在这个华丽的木制首饰盒上镶嵌出花朵图案。

items.def_zh: 以宝物镶饰；给……覆上一层硬壳
items.def_en: (+ with) To overlay or cover a surface richly with a decorative layer of gems or minerals
items.ex_en: The ancient ceremonial scabbard was richly encrusted with sparkling emeralds, rubies, and gold foil.
items.ex_zh: 这把古老的礼仪刀鞘上奢华地镶饰着闪烁的祖母绿、红宝石和金箔。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame relate to inserting contrasting decorative materials flush into cut-out recesses on a surface, or embedding stones, gems, and metals into a substrate. They convey precise craftsmanship and decorative integration.
groups.summary_zh: 指在表面开槽并将金属、玉石、木料等嵌入以起装饰作用。
groups.desc_en: To insert decorative materials flush into a hollowed surface or coat it with gems, highlighting craftsmanship and textural integration rather than random placement.
groups.desc_zh: 指将装饰材质严丝合缝地嵌入开凿出的凹面或覆盖其表，重在工艺配合与纹理契合而非随意放置。
groups.nuance_en: inlay: set contrasting pieces flush into hollowed recesses of an object (wood / ivory / pearl) · inset: insert a smaller element neatly into the surface or body of a larger piece (panel / map / gem) · encrust: coat a surface heavily with a hard layer of gems or minerals (jewels / diamonds / salt) · intarsia: assemble elaborate pictorial wooden marquetry or knitted patterns (wood / veneer / furniture) · embed: deeply fix an alien material into a surrounding matrix (pebbles / fossil / glass)
groups.nuance_zh: inlay: 在挖出的凹陷处平齐镶嵌异质装饰物 (wood / ivory / pearl) · inset: 将较小嵌件平整嵌入较大平面的局部 (panel / map / gem) · encrust: 用硬质宝石或结晶物厚密结壳覆盖 (jewels / diamonds / salt) · intarsia: 严密拼嵌木质细工画或嵌花织物 (wood / veneer / furniture) · embed: 将某物深深埋入周围包覆的基质中 (pebbles / fossil / glass)

groups.name: Innervate & Excite · 神经分布与冲动刺激 (Innervate, Stimulate, Fire)
groups.tip: 神经分布刺激肌体组织

items.def_en: to transmit a burst of electrical impulses along an axon or neuron
items.ex_en: Specific sensory neurons rapidly fire whenever sudden changes in ambient temperature are detected.
items.ex_zh: 每当检测到环境温度骤变时，特定的感觉神经元就会迅速放电。
items.ex2_en: The cognitive psychologist fired brief electrical impulses into the animal's auditory cortex.
items.ex2_zh: 认知心理学家向动物的听觉皮层发放短暂的电脉冲。

items.def_en: to initiate a specific neural response, muscular reflex, or physiological mechanism
items.ex_en: Cold water splashed on the face can quickly trigger the mammalian dive reflex.
items.ex_zh: 泼在脸上的冷水能迅速触发哺乳动物的潜水反射生理机制。

items.def_en: to induce biological activity in a dormant nerve pathway, receptor, or sensory organ
items.ex_en: The neurobiologist used targeted light pulses to activate the dormant neural pathways in mice.
items.ex_zh: 神经生物学家利用定向光脉冲激活了小鼠体内休眠的神经通路。
items.ex2_en: Dormant neural receptors rapidly activate when sudden chemical signals trigger biological responses.
items.ex2_zh: 当突如其来的化学信号引发机体反应时，休眠的神经受体迅速激活。

items.def_en: to excite or activate an organ, nerve, or physiological process into functional activity
items.ex_en: A mild electric current was carefully applied to stimulate the damaged auditory nerve fibers.
items.ex_zh: 他们小心地施加微弱电流，以刺激受损的听觉神经纤维恢复功能。

items.def_zh: 受神经支配，使分布神经；刺激
items.def_en: to supply a bodily organ or tissue with nerves, or stimulate it by nervous impulses
items.ex_en: Complex bundles of cranial nerves delicately innervate the subtle muscular movements of the tongue.
items.ex_zh: 复杂的颅神经束精密地支配着舌部肌肉的细微运动。

groups.summary_en: This physiological frame covers supplying biological tissues with nerve fibers or activating nerves and muscles through electrical and chemical impulses. Verbs contrast biological wiring with active neurological triggering.
groups.summary_zh: 指神经系统的结构分布，或通过电化学冲动激发组织器官活动。
groups.desc_en: To supply nerve pathways to an anatomical tissue or trigger rapid electrochemical transmission, contrasting with mere metabolic maintenance.
groups.desc_zh: 指为解剖组织铺设神经分布或触发其产生电生理脉冲，区别于基础的生化代谢滋养。
groups.nuance_en: innervate: supply an organ or tissue with functional nerves (muscle / diaphragm / organ) · fire: discharge an electrical impulse down an axon (neuron / synapse / nerve) · trigger: instantly spark an automated physiological or neural response (reflex / spasm / signal) · stimulate: excite or increase activity in a dormant nerve or organ (nerve / receptor / brain) · activate: turn a neural pathway or receptor from resting to functional state (cortex / pathway / neuron)
groups.nuance_zh: innervate: 生物学上指为器官或组织分布提供神经纤维 (muscle / diaphragm / organ) · fire: 神经元释放动作电位或点火放电 (neuron / synapse / nerve) · trigger: 瞬间引爆神经反射或级联反应 (reflex / spasm / signal) · stimulate: 施加外在刺激激发神经或器官活性 (nerve / receptor / brain) · activate: 使休眠的神经回路或受体进入工作态 (cortex / pathway / neuron)

groups.name: Inquire & Interrogate · 打探与质问 (Inquire, Question, Cross-examine)
groups.tip: 提出疑问并探求明确答案

items.def_en: To ask someone questions critically or express doubt about the truth of something
items.ex_en: Several board members gathered to openly question the financial accuracy of the annual report.
items.ex_zh: 几位董事会成员聚集在一起，公开质疑年度报告中财务数据的准确性。

items.def_en: To question a witness or person aggressively to verify or undermine previous statements
items.ex_en: The defense attorney prepared rigorously to cross-examine the prosecution's key eyewitness tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师做了周密准备，打算明早对检方的关键目击证人进行严密盘问。

items.def_en: To ask a question about something, especially in order to verify its accuracy or express doubt.
items.ex_en: The senior auditor felt compelled to query the sudden discrepancy in travel expense claims.
items.ex_zh: 高级审计员觉得有必要就差旅费报销中突然出现的出入提出质疑。

items.def_en: To seek information by asking questions in a formal or neutral manner
items.ex_en: A formal diplomatic envoy arrived to inquire about the terms of the trade agreement.
items.ex_zh: 一位正式的外交特使抵达，以正式询问该贸易协定的各项条款。

items.def_en: To ask someone questions thoroughly and aggressively, especially in an official setting
items.ex_en: Police detectives brought the prime suspect to headquarters to interrogate him about the robbery.
items.ex_zh: 警探把主要嫌疑人带回总局，就这起抢劫案对他进行了严加审问。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers seeking factual clarification, challenging assumptions, or expressing professional skepticism through direct questions.
groups.summary_zh: 指提出疑问、核实信息准确性或进行严肃质询与求证。
groups.desc_en: To solicit facts, explanations, or confessions under differing degrees of formal, legal, or authoritative pressure, contrasting with casual reciprocal chat.
groups.desc_zh: 指在不同强度的官方、司法或权威压力下逼取事实、解释或口供，区别于对等的闲聊攀谈。
groups.nuance_en: inquire: make a polite or neutral formal request for information (details / status / health) · question: press for an account or express doubts about truthfulness (witness / motives / authority) · interrogate: subject a detained subject to intense, systematic questioning (suspect / prisoner / spy) · cross-examine: rigorously probe an opposing witness's testimony in court (witness / testimony) · query: check or contest the accuracy of an entry or statement (database / invoice / order)
groups.nuance_zh: inquire: 礼貌中立地索取或打听具体信息 (details / status / health) · question: 因存疑而质询或盘问其动机属实度 (witness / motives / authority) · interrogate: 官方对嫌疑人或俘虏进行高压系统性审讯 (suspect / prisoner / spy) · cross-examine: 庭审中对对方证人进行步步紧逼的反诘盘问 (witness / testimony) · query: 对系统数据或某说法的准确性提出疑问核对 (database / invoice / order)

groups.name: Inquire & Interrogate · 打探与质问 (Sound out, Probe, Grill)
groups.tip: 深入探听内情与细致盘查追问

items.def_en: To question someone indirectly in order to find out their opinions or intentions
items.ex_en: The manager quietly sounded out a few team members before unveiling the restructuring plan.
items.ex_zh: 经理在公布重组方案之前，私下试探了几名团队成员的口风。

items.def_en: To survey or record the opinion or vote of people systematically
items.ex_en: Researchers plan to poll registered voters regarding the proposed changes to local tax laws.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员计划就当地税法的拟议修改向登记选民进行民意调查。

items.def_en: (informal) To ask someone persistent questions to extract information from them
items.ex_en: Curious neighbors kept trying to pump the nanny for gossip about the wealthy family.
items.ex_zh: 好奇的邻居们不断试图向保姆套问关于那个富裕家庭的八卦内幕。

items.def_en: To ask detailed and searching questions in order to discover hidden information
items.ex_en: Reporters continued to probe the minister about where the missing public funds had gone.
items.ex_zh: 记者们继续盘问部长，探究那些下落不明的公共资金究竟去了哪里。

items.def_zh: 游说，拉票；打探民意，进行调查
items.def_en: To try to obtain political support, votes, or opinions from people by visiting them or asking detailed questions.
items.ex_en: Volunteers went door to door to canvass local residents before the crucial parliamentary election.
items.ex_zh: 在关键的议会选举前，志愿者们挨家挨户上门走访以拉票并打探民意。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe systematic, inquisitive, or persistent efforts to elicit confidential information, survey public opinion, or examine someone's views thoroughly.
groups.summary_zh: 指系统性、探询性或带有倾向地探知他人意见或打探底细。
groups.desc_en: To extract hidden intentions, public sentiment, or sensitive facts through calculated social maneuvering or persistent elicitation, contrasting with direct formal interrogation.
groups.desc_zh: 指运用巧妙的社交周旋、试探或密集探究以摸清隐秘意图或公众动向，区别于正规审讯。
groups.nuance_en: sound out: discreetly test someone's covert views or openness beforehand (colleague / boss / opinion) · probe: investigate deeply and relentlessly into sensitive territory (affairs / past / motives) · canvass: systematically interview people across a district to poll opinions (voters / neighborhood / district) · poll: record and aggregate opinions systematically across a sample (public / voters / panel) · pump: relentlessly badger someone in casual conversation to spill secrets (friend / informant / secrets)
groups.nuance_zh: sound out: 私下旁敲侧击以摸底某人的意向或态度 (colleague / boss / opinion) · probe: 追根究底地深入探寻敏感真相或暗处 (affairs / past / motives) · canvass: 逐家走访游说以征询调查各方民意 (voters / neighborhood / district) · poll: 规范抽取样本以统计民调意见 (public / voters / panel) · pump: 借闲聊等连环发问套取内部秘密或情报 (friend / informant / secrets)

groups.name: Insert & Interpose · 插入与穿插 (Interpose, Sandwich, Interpolate)
groups.tip: 在缝隙或过程间穿插放入

items.def_en: To insert or include something quietly, discreetly, or smoothly
items.ex_en: She managed to slip in a brief mention of her proposal during the meeting.
items.ex_zh: 在会议期间，她设法巧妙地顺便提了一下自己的提案。

items.def_zh: 插入，穿插；作中场休息（或表演）
items.def_en: To insert an interval, pause, or short musical or theatrical piece between larger parts of an event.
items.ex_en: The theater director chose to interlude the somber historical drama with light choral music.
items.ex_zh: 戏剧导演选择在沉重的历史剧中间穿插轻松的合唱音乐作为间歇。

items.def_en: To fit or insert someone or something tightly between two other things or events
items.ex_en: Her doctor managed to sandwich a quick emergency consultation between two major operations yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 她的医生昨天设法在两场大手术的空隙间硬挤出时间安排了一次紧急会诊。

items.def_en: To insert words, passages, or data into a text or sequence
items.ex_en: The editor warned the translator not to interpolate modern slang into ancient classical manuscripts.
items.ex_zh: 编辑警告译者不要在古代古典手稿中随意插写现代俚语。

items.def_en: To place something between two things, or interject a remark between other utterances
items.ex_en: The mediator raised his hand to interpose a calm remark before tempers completely flared.
items.ex_zh: 调解人在大家彻底发脾气之前举手插话，平静地发表了一句意见。

groups.summary_en: Pertains to positioning an object, interval, remark, or segment between parts of an ongoing sequence, text, or gap.
groups.summary_zh: 在连续体、间隙或环节中间嵌入穿插成分。
groups.desc_en: To place an item, remark, or period of time between existing components, disrupting continuity or mediating between two sides, differing from initial linear placement.
groups.desc_zh: 指将物体、言论或时间段插入现有组件之间以打破连续性或起调停缓冲作用，区别于线性的常规安置。
groups.nuance_en: interpose: step in to mediate or place a physical obstacle between parties (authority / objection / body) · sandwich: squeeze tightly between two contrasting layers or entities (meeting / cars / bread) · interpolate: insert words, terms, or estimates into a finished text or dataset (data / text / passage) · slip in: introduce a subtle remark or item smoothly without drawing attention (joke / clause / comment) · interlude: punctuate an ongoing event with an entertaining pause (music / silence / scene)
groups.nuance_zh: interpose: 介入调停或在两方之间横插障碍/异议 (authority / objection / body) · sandwich: 紧密夹在两个鲜明对立或沉重的事物中间 (meeting / cars / bread) · interpolate: 向既有文本或数据流中插写篡改或内插推算 (data / text / passage) · slip in: 悄无声息地顺带捎入私货或言辞 (joke / clause / comment) · interlude: 在主线事件中穿插短暂停歇或插曲 (music / silence / scene)

groups.name: Install & Mount Equipment · 安装与安放 (Fit, Mount, Set up)
groups.tip: 设置并稳妥固定部件

items.def_en: Fix or attach a component or appliance into its proper position
items.ex_en: The skilled mechanic will fit a replacement fuel filter into the engine compartment tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 熟练的机械师明天会将一个新的燃油滤清器装配到发动机舱中。
items.ex2_en: This replacement metal bracket fits securely inside the narrow recess beneath the dashboard.
items.ex2_zh: 这个备用金属支架稳稳地契合在仪表盘下方的狭窄凹槽内。

items.def_en: Attach an object firmly onto a backing, wall, stand, or other support
items.ex_en: Technicians will mount the large flat-screen display securely onto the reinforced concrete conference wall.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员将把这台大平板显示器牢固地安装在加固混凝土会议室墙壁上。

items.def_zh: 安装，装设；使就职，任命；安置，安顿
items.def_en: 1. To put equipment or software into position and connect it so that it is ready to use. 2. To officially put someone into an important job or position.
items.ex_en: The IT department will instal the latest security patch across all office workstations tonight.
items.ex_zh: IT部门今晚将在所有办公室工作站上安装最新的安全补丁。

items.def_en: Assemble, connect, and prepare machinery, software, or equipment for immediate operation
items.ex_en: The audio crew worked quickly to set up the sound equipment before the show.
items.ex_zh: 音响团队在演出开始前迅速展开工作，组装并调试好了音响设备。
items.ex2_en: The thick commercial glue sets up firmly within twenty minutes after initial application.
items.ex2_zh: 这种工业强力胶在涂抹后二十分钟内便会牢牢凝固固化。

items.def_en: Fit or install household equipment, appliances, or systems indoors
items.ex_en: We hired a licensed plumber to put in a new dishwasher in our kitchen.
items.ex_zh: 我们请了一名持证水暖工在厨房里装上一台新的洗碗机。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve positioning, affixing, or connecting mechanical equipment, systems, or software so they become operational. Nuances range from physical mounting to systematic assembly and technical fitting.
groups.summary_zh: 指把设备、管件或软件置于适当位置并连接组装以供使用，涵盖固定与配装。
groups.desc_en: To position, fix, and integrate machinery or structural components into place so they are mechanically stable and ready to operate, contrasting with loose resting.
groups.desc_zh: 指将机械装置或构件定位、紧固并整合就位使其稳固且具备运转能力，区别于简单的放置搁置。
groups.nuance_en: install: set up complex machinery, software, or utilities for operational readiness (system / software / pipes) · mount: securely fasten an object onto an elevated support or backdrop (camera / display / engine) · fit: size and attach a bespoke part into its proper structural socket (lock / door / engine) · set up: configure and organize components so a system is functional (equipment / network / tent) · put in: everyday physical act of fitting or installing household amenities (kitchen / window / heating)
groups.nuance_zh: install: 安装并调试复杂设备、管线或软件使其运转 (system / software / pipes) · mount: 牢固固定于支架、基座或墙壁高处 (camera / display / engine) · fit: 严丝合缝地把定制零部件装入接口槽位 (lock / door / engine) · set up: 组装、连线并配置设备使其可用 (equipment / network / tent) · put in: 口语中指安装家庭装潢部件或卫浴 (kitchen / window / heating)

groups.name: Instruct & Direct · 指示与训令 (Instruct, Direct, Enjoin)
groups.tip: 从业务指导到强硬发号施令

items.def_zh: 向……作简明指示，简要通报
items.def_en: To give someone detailed instructions or essential information in preparation for a task
items.ex_en: The commanding officer took twenty minutes to brief his pilots before the dangerous mission.
items.ex_zh: 指挥官在执行危险任务前花了二十分钟向飞行员作了简明任务指示。

items.def_en: To give someone an official order or clear instruction to do something
items.ex_en: The presiding judge issued a formal order to direct the jury to disregard hearsay.
items.ex_zh: 主审法官下达正式命令，指示陪审团不要理会道听途说的传闻。

items.def_en: 1. To officially direct or command someone to do something. 2. To teach someone a subject, skill, or practical method
items.ex_en: The agency head formally instructed all field operatives to halt surveillance activities immediately pending review.
items.ex_zh: 该机构负责人正式指示所有外勤人员在审查期间立即停止监视活动。

items.def_en: To tell someone authoritatively that they must do something
items.ex_en: The fire chief had to order all personnel to evacuate the collapsing warehouse immediately.
items.ex_zh: 消防局长不得不下令所有人员立即撤离正在坍塌的仓库。

items.def_en: To instruct or urge someone authoritatively to perform a particular action
items.ex_en: The magistrate intervened to strictly enjoin both feuding parties to preserve absolute peace.
items.ex_zh: 地方法官出面干预，严词责令发生争执的双方务必保持绝对克制和平。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers giving authoritative, formal orders or structured guidance on how to carry out a specific task. Unlike blunt commanding, instructing often incorporates procedure, protocol, and explicit operational steps.
groups.summary_zh: 指依据权威或职责正式给出办事准则、步骤或下达指示性指令。
groups.desc_en: To issue authoritative mandates regarding how actions must be executed, grading from professional guidance to uncompromising legal compulsion.
groups.desc_zh: 指依凭职权对下达行动方案施加权威性指令，其语意强度从业务指导直至严厉的法律禁令。
groups.nuance_en: order: demand absolute obedience through direct hierarchical authority (evacuation / retreat / release) · enjoin: legally command or forbid a specific act through an injunction (parties / silence / conduct) · direct: channel someone's actions decisively toward an authorized objective (crew / traffic / staff) · instruct: give formal, authoritative procedural guidance to be followed (solicitor / team / jury) · brief: issue concise tactical guidelines and parameters before missions (agents / troops / delegates)
groups.nuance_zh: order: 凭借绝对层级权力下达不容置疑的命令 (evacuation / retreat / release) · enjoin: 法院或长辈以严正禁令命令或约束特定作为 (parties / silence / conduct) · direct: 明确指定方向与方案来导引行动 (crew / traffic / staff) · instruct: 正式、按部就班地指示或交代下属/律师 (solicitor / team / jury) · brief: 行动前快速交代明确战术指引与参数 (agents / troops / delegates)

groups.name: Insulate & Shield · 隔绝与防护 (Shield, Cushion, Buffer)
groups.tip: 绝缘隔热以提供保护

items.def_en: to protect someone or something from danger, harm, criticism, or unpleasant exposure
items.ex_en: Protective lead aprons are worn to shield medical patients from excessive X-ray radiation.
items.ex_zh: 患者穿戴铅制防护围裙，以保护自身免受过量X射线辐射的伤害。

items.def_en: to reduce the shock or harmful effect of something by acting as a protective barrier
items.ex_en: The central bank raised reserves to buffer the vulnerable domestic economy against global shocks.
items.ex_zh: 央行提高了准备金，以缓冲全球冲击对脆弱的国内经济造成的负面影响。

items.def_zh: 缓冲；减弱…的震动或打击
items.def_en: to soften the physical or financial impact of something damaging
items.ex_en: The government introduced subsidies to cushion low-income households from rising energy costs.
items.ex_zh: 政府出台了补贴政策，以缓解能源价格上涨对低收入家庭的冲击。

items.def_zh: 使隔热，使绝缘，使隔音；使免受不良影响，隔离
items.def_en: (+ against/from) to protect something with material that prevents heat, sound, or electricity from passing through; to protect someone from unpleasant experiences
items.ex_en: Specialized coating was applied to insulate the sensitive instruments from extreme thermal shifts.
items.ex_zh: 施加了专用涂层，以保护精密仪器免受剧烈温差的影响。

items.def_en: to insulate a room or structure so that sound cannot pass through it
items.ex_en: The musicians used dense foam panels to soundproof the basement recording studio thoroughly.
items.ex_zh: 音乐家们用厚重的泡沫板将地下室录音室彻底做了隔音处理。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote surrounding or separating someone or something with a protective barrier against cold, sound, electricity, or harsh financial and external shocks.
groups.summary_zh: 指设立物理或抽象防护层，以抵御恶劣环境、冲击或外部影响。
groups.desc_en: To construct an intermediate barrier around an entity to prevent the harmful transfer of physical energy or emotional trauma, contrasting with aggressive counter-attack.
groups.desc_zh: 指在主体外周建立屏障介质以阻隔能量传递或吸收冲击，区别于反击抵抗。
groups.nuance_en: insulate: create a non-conductive barrier against temperature, electricity, or adversity (cable / house / economy) · shield: place an impenetrable guard directly between danger and a vulnerable target (eyes / body / witness) · buffer: absorb the kinetic impact or volatile swings between two colliding forces (shock / blow / economy) · cushion: soften the blow or lessen the painful landing of a fall or crisis (fall / blow / landing) · soundproof: treat a space specifically to prevent sound entry or leakage (room / studio / walls)
groups.nuance_zh: insulate: 运用非传导材质阻隔热/电，或使免受不良外境波及 (cable / house / economy) · shield: 像盾牌一样挡在弱者与危险之间进行庇护 (eyes / body / witness) · buffer: 处于对立力量之间充当缓冲区以消解震荡 (shock / blow / economy) · cushion: 垫衬缓冲以减轻跌落或打击带来的剧痛 (fall / blow / landing) · soundproof: 专指采用声学手段隔绝声音内外穿透 (room / studio / walls)

groups.name: Insurge & Uprise · 反叛与起义 (Insurge, Rise, Take Up Arms)
groups.tip: 揭竿而起反抗既有统治

items.def_en: (+ against/in) To initiate collective active resistance or open rebellion against tyranny
items.ex_en: The oppressed populace decided to rise against the brutal dictator after decades of silence.
items.ex_zh: 在经历了数十年的沉默后，饱受压迫的民众决定奋起反抗残暴的独裁者。

items.def_en: (+ against) To fight against an established power structure or political system
items.ex_en: Citizens chose to rebel against the authoritarian regime when essential freedoms were revoked.
items.ex_zh: 当基本自由被剥夺时，公民们选择反抗专制政权。

items.def_en: (+ against) To mount an organized uprising aiming to displace those in control
items.ex_en: Impoverished farmers planned to revolt against the corrupt landlords who demanded excessive grain taxes.
items.ex_zh: 贫困的农民密谋发动起义，反抗索要过重粮税的腐败地主。

items.def_zh: 起义，暴动，反叛；升起，上升
items.def_en: 1. (literary) To rise up in revolt or rebellion against authority. 2. (archaic) To ascend or move upward.
items.ex_en: The downtrodden masses did uprise against their monarch, demanding freedom across the land.
items.ex_zh: 饱受摧残的劳苦大众起义反抗君主，在国土各处高呼自由。

items.def_en: (+ against) To prepare for and enter into active armed insurrection against a foe or government
items.ex_en: The villagers resolved to take up arms against the merciless invaders advancing south.
items.ex_zh: 村民们决心拿起武器，反抗向南推进的残暴侵略者。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on collective public or armed uprisings seeking to overthrow an oppressive regime or ruling force. These verbs emphasize the emergent mass mobilization and escalation into revolutionary upheaval.
groups.summary_zh: 群体性揭竿而起，发动武装叛乱或推翻现政权。
groups.desc_en: To mobilize in organized, violent resistance against an established governing order, scaling from civil defiance to full militarized rebellion.
groups.desc_zh: 指组织起来以暴力或激进手段公然反抗既有政权与统治秩序，从民众抗暴升级为全面武装起义。
groups.nuance_en: rise: spontaneously mobilize en masse against oppressors (people / masses / nation) · rebel: reject and turn against an established authority or convention (citizens / teenagers / faction) · revolt: explode into open, disgusted repudiation of ruler control (peasants / garrison / workers) · uprise: mount an organized, sudden systemic insurrection (proletariat / community / tribes) · take up arms: explicitly mobilize weapons for armed warfare (insurgents / civilians / militia)
groups.nuance_zh: rise: 群众自发聚集起来挺身反抗压迫者 (people / masses / nation) · rebel: 公然忤逆并反抗既定权威或规则体系 (citizens / teenagers / faction) · revolt: 因无法忍受而爆发公开的暴动或背叛 (peasants / garrison / workers) · uprise: 掀起有组织、针对统治制度的全面起义 (proletariat / community / tribes) · take up arms: 明确诉诸武力，操起武器进行武装斗争 (insurgents / civilians / militia)

groups.name: Integrate & Merge · 融合与吸纳 (Assimilate, Synthesize, Blend)
groups.tip: 将分散要素融合为一个有机体

items.def_en: To include or embody something as an integral part of a larger plan, system, or organization
items.ex_en: The committee agreed to incorporate the latest safety standards into the project proposal.
items.ex_zh: 委员会同意将最新的安全标准纳入项目提案中。

items.def_en: 1. To combine two or more things to make them work together effectively, or to become part of a group or system.
items.ex_en: The software engineer worked hard to integrate the legacy databases into the cloud.
items.ex_zh: 软件工程师努力将遗留数据库整合到云端系统中。
items.ex2_en: The two corporate divisions integrated smoothly after several months of cooperative management.
items.ex2_zh: 经过几个月的协同管理，这两个公司部门顺利合并为一体。

items.def_en: (+ with/into) To mix together so thoroughly that the original boundaries disappear
items.ex_en: Modern architectural elements seamlessly blend with the historical character of the old town.
items.ex_zh: 现代建筑元素与古老城镇的历史风貌完美融为一体。
items.ex2_en: The chef carefully blended fresh herbs and olive oil to create a dressing.
items.ex2_zh: 主厨精心将新鲜香草与橄榄油调和在一起制作调味汁。

items.def_en: To combine distinct ideas, substances, or components to form a coherent, complex whole
items.ex_en: The researcher attempted to synthesize distinct sociopolitical theories into one cohesive analytic framework.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员试图将不同的社会政治理论综合成一个连贯的分析框架。

items.def_en: To absorb or be absorbed fully into the cultural traditions or life of a larger group
items.ex_en: New arrivals often found it challenging to assimilate into the conservative local community.
items.ex_zh: 新来者往往觉得很难完全融入当地保守的社区。
items.ex2_en: The public school curriculum assimilates foreign exchange students through immersive language programs.
items.ex2_zh: 公立学校的课程通过沉浸式语言项目使外国交换生完全融入。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here describe fusing separate components, cultures, or data streams into an unbroken, harmonious, functioning single entity. They highlight structural alignment and complete systemic incorporation.
groups.summary_zh: 指将不同元素、系统或人群吸纳合并，使其合为一体顺畅运作。
groups.desc_en: To combine distinct elements into an orderly, unified whole where boundaries dissolve or become coherent, contrasting with crude juxtaposition.
groups.desc_zh: 指将分散孤立的要素融汇为一个结构协调、边界消解的有机整体，区别于生硬的拼凑拼贴。
groups.nuance_en: integrate: coordinate distinct components into a cohesive, functioning whole (system / immigrants / technology) · assimilate: absorb a minority or alien idea completely into a dominant host culture (culture / data / immigrants) · synthesize: construct a complex new idea or substance by logically fusing disparate parts (ideas / compounds / findings) · blend: mix elements so harmoniously that individual distinctions melt away (flavors / voices / colors) · incorporate: absorb an outside element into a preexisting body or corporate frame (features / feedback / company)
groups.nuance_zh: integrate: 消除隔阂使各构件系统化整合并协同运转 (system / immigrants / technology) · assimilate: 将少数群体或异质文化彻底同化吸纳进主体 (culture / data / immigrants) · synthesize: 逻辑性综合熔铸不同构件以生成全新产物 (ideas / compounds / findings) · blend: 柔和交融使个中界线自然融化隐去 (flavors / voices / colors) · incorporate: 将外部新功能、反馈或资产纳入已有架构 (features / feedback / company)

groups.name: Interconnect & Interlock · 关联合并 (Intertwine, Mesh, Link together)
groups.tip: 事物之间彼此相互关联

items.def_en: Fit closely together or work together in harmony, like interlocking gear teeth
items.ex_en: Her innovative strategy seemed to mesh smoothly with the long-term vision of the company.
items.ex_zh: 她的创新策略似乎与公司的长期愿景高度契合。

items.def_en: Be or become connected reciprocally with one another so that movement or data passes between them
items.ex_en: Subterranean cables interconnect the regional power grids to ensure steady electricity distribution nationwide.
items.ex_zh: 地下电缆将各区域电网相互连接，以确保全国电力的稳定分配。
items.ex2_en: The regional computer systems interconnect seamlessly to exchange crucial transaction records instantly.
items.ex2_zh: 各区域计算机系统无缝互联，以便即时交换关键的交易记录。

items.def_en: Twist or weave closely together so that the components are difficult to separate
items.ex_en: Their tragic destinies intertwine throughout the generations, bound by an ancient ancestral oath.
items.ex_zh: 在古老祖训的羁绊下，他们几代人悲剧性的命运紧密交织在一起。
items.ex2_en: The skilled weaver intertwines colorful silk ribbons into the thick woolen rug.
items.ex2_zh: 熟练的织工将五彩斑斓的丝带编织进厚厚的羊毛地毯中。

items.def_en: Fit or join together firmly in such a way that the parts motion or state is co-dependent
items.ex_en: The heavy steel teeth interlock securely to prevent unintentional slippage along the tracks.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的钢齿紧密咬合在一起，以防止沿轨道发生意外滑动。
items.ex2_en: The careful carpenter interlocked the wooden floorboards to prevent any structural squeaking.
items.ex2_zh: 细心的木匠将木地板相互咬合扣紧，以防结构产生任何吱嘎声。

items.def_en: To be connected in such a way that each thing affects or depends on the other, or to make things relate to each other.
items.ex_en: Economic stability and social welfare interrelate closely within contemporary development models.
items.ex_zh: 在当代发展模式中，经济稳定与社会福利紧密相互关联。
items.ex2_en: The comprehensive lecture interrelates climate change policies with broader geopolitical energy conflicts.
items.ex2_zh: 这场内容详实的讲座将气候变化政策与更广泛的地缘政治能源冲突联系了起来。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame characterize reciprocal, mutual systems or components where elements do not merely refer to one another, but fit together, weave into one another, or depend co-functionally on each other.
groups.summary_zh: 描述要素之间双向咬合、交织或协同运作的深层互联状态。
groups.desc_en: To link multiple separate entities via mechanical teeth, topological loops, or functional dependencies so that moving one affects all, contrasting with independent adjacency.
groups.desc_zh: 指多个分离实体通过机械咬合、拓扑缠绕或功能耦合紧扣在一起，动其一而牵全身，区别于互不干涉的相邻。
groups.nuance_en: interlock: fit parts together via matching projections so they lock tightly (fingers / gears / tiles) · mesh: engage gear teeth or align disparate schedules/ideas smoothly (gears / ideas / schedules) · intertwine: twist or weave strands around one another inextricably (threads / destinies / fates) · interconnect: link multiple nodes to form a cohesive network (systems / networks / roads) · interrelate: share mutually dependent reciprocal connections (factors / variables / concepts)
groups.nuance_zh: interlock: 凸凹相扣，通过几何突起使各部分死死锁住 (fingers / gears / tiles) · mesh: 齿轮完美咬合，或比喻计划/观点协调合拍 (gears / ideas / schedules) · intertwine: 像藤蔓编织般错综缠绕、命运相连 (threads / destinies / fates) · interconnect: 互联互通以形成错综复杂的庞大网络 (systems / networks / roads) · interrelate: 在逻辑或功能上相互依存、互为因果 (factors / variables / concepts)

groups.name: Interfere & Intervene · 干预与介入 (Intervene, Meddle, Intrigue)
groups.tip: 插手介入他人的事务

items.def_en: to interrupt a conversation or meddle bluntly in someone else's business without permission
items.ex_en: I hate it when strangers butt in on private conversations without being invited.
items.ex_zh: 我真讨厌陌生人未经邀请就生硬插嘴别人的私人谈话。

items.def_en: to become actively involved in an ongoing dispute or crisis to help resolve it
items.ex_en: The government had to step in to prevent the bank from collapsing.
items.ex_zh: 政府不得不出手干预，以防止该银行倒闭。

items.def_en: 1. (interfere in) to get involved in a situation without being invited or having the right to do so. 2. (interfere with) to prevent something from continuing or succeeding smoothly.
items.ex_en: Outside powers should not interfere in the domestic legal procedures of sovereign nations.
items.ex_zh: 外部势力不应干涉主权国家的内部司法程序。

items.def_en: (+ in) to become involved in a difficult situation intentionally in order to influence, prevent, or resolve it
items.ex_en: The central bank had to intervene in currency markets to curb runaway inflation.
items.ex_zh: 中央银行不得不介入外汇市场以抑制失控的通货膨胀。

items.def_en: (+ in/with) to involve oneself in matters that are not one's concern without invitation or right
items.ex_en: You have no right to meddle in financial arrangements that do not concern you.
items.ex_zh: 你无权插手与你无关的财务安排。

groups.summary_en: This frame highlights stepping into a situation, conflict, or private affairs, ranging from constructive and legitimate mediation to uninvited, unwelcome intrusion.
groups.summary_zh: 指介入他人事务或局势中，既包含正当调停，也包含盲目插手。
groups.desc_en: Entails stepping into an ongoing situation or conflict uninvited or intentionally, contrasting with passive observation or requested mediation.
groups.desc_zh: 指主动介入或横加干预正在进行的事务或冲突，区别于被动观望或受邀调解。
groups.nuance_en: intervene: formal, constructive action to alter an outcome (crisis / dispute) · interfere: obstructive, unwanted meddling that hinders progress (process / affairs) · meddle: intrusive tampering in another's private business (life / affairs) · step in: decisive, helpful intervention in an emergency (breach / gap) · butt in: rude, uninvited verbal interruption (conversation / discussion)
groups.nuance_zh: intervene: 建设性、正式的介入以改变结果 (crisis / dispute) · interfere: 阻碍性、令人反感的插手干扰 (process / affairs) · meddle: 瞎掺和他人私事 (life / affairs) · step in: 危急时刻果断出手援助 (breach / gap) · butt in: 鲁莽失礼的强行插话或插手 (conversation / discussion)

groups.name: Intermix & Mingle · 混杂与融合 (Intermix, Mingle, Interweave)
groups.tip: 多种成分均匀混为一体

items.def_en: To mix or cause to mix together without entirely losing distinct individual qualities.
items.ex_en: Spicy aromas from exotic curries mingle delightfully with sweet scents of freshly baked pastries.
items.ex_zh: 异域咖喱的辛香与新鲜糕点的甜香美妙地交融在一起。
items.ex2_en: The bartender mingled sweet fruit juices with sparkling soda in a tall glass.
items.ex2_zh: 调酒师在一个高玻璃杯中将甜果汁与苏打水混合在一起。

items.def_en: To mix together closely or combine thoroughly, often used of groups, liquids, or intangible feelings.
items.ex_en: Faint scents of lavender intermingle with the cool night breeze across the garden.
items.ex_zh: 薰衣草的清香在花园里与清凉的夜风交融在一起。
items.ex2_en: The experimental chemist intermingled reactive dyes to create a brand new pigment shade.
items.ex2_zh: 实验化学家将反应性染料混合在一起，创造出一种全新的颜料色调。

items.def_en: (+ with) To mix or blend two or more substances, qualities, or groups together.
items.ex_en: The chemical compound will intermix with the liquid solvent under moderate mechanical agitation.
items.ex_zh: 在适度的机械搅拌下，该化合物将与液体溶剂充分混合。
items.ex2_en: The careful baker intermixed ground spices and flour before adding the melted butter.
items.ex2_zh: 细心的面包师在加入融化的黄油之前，将磨碎的香料和面粉混合在一起。

items.def_en: To blend or weave different elements closely and intricately together.
items.ex_en: The skilled novelist skillfully interweaves personal grief with epic historical tribulations throughout the story.
items.ex_zh: 这位娴熟的小说家在整个故事中巧妙地将个人悲伤与宏大历史苦难交织在一起。
items.ex2_en: Mythology and folklore interweave continuously throughout the ancient oral narrative traditions.
items.ex2_zh: 神话与民间传说在古老的口头叙事传统中始终交织在一起。

items.def_zh: 合并；混合（尤指资金或物质）
items.def_en: To mix together or combine, especially funds, assets, or chemical ingredients, into a common mass.
items.ex_en: Strict fiduciary regulations forbid attorneys to commingle client retainers with personal operational funds.
items.ex_zh: 严格的信托规程禁止律师将客户的预付款项与个人运营资金相混淆。
items.ex2_en: Conflicting emotional impulses commingle deeply within his conflicted mind during difficult decisions.
items.ex2_zh: 在艰难抉择的关头，相互冲突的情感冲动在他矛盾的内心深处交织融汇。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on combining different components, materials, or qualities so that they become thoroughly integrated or interspersed. Verbs emphasize mutual penetration, harmonizing, or diffuse spreading among elements.
groups.summary_zh: 描述各要素彼此穿插交错、完全混溶或交织成一体的状态变化。
groups.desc_en: Denotes blending or combining distinct elements into a heterogeneous or unified collective without entirely destroying their identities, unlike total chemical dissolution.
groups.desc_zh: 指将不同成分或人群混合交织在一起，但仍可辨识各自痕迹，区别于发生化学湮灭的彻底溶解。
groups.nuance_en: mingle: social movement and casual blending among people or scents (crowd / guests / smells) · intermingle: mutual, intricate blending of abstract or physical strands (races / traditions / threads) · intermix: neutral mechanical or physical combination (chemicals / ingredients) · interweave: deep narrative, thematic, or structural intertwining (narratives / themes / destinies) · commingle: formal or legal blending of funds or discrete entities (assets / funds)
groups.nuance_zh: mingle: 人群应酬交际或气味、声音的自然融合 (crowd / guests / smells) · intermingle: 多种抽象或实体要素相互交融 (races / traditions / threads) · intermix: 中性的物理或成分混合 (chemicals / ingredients) · interweave: 叙事、主题或命运的纵横交错 (narratives / themes / destinies) · commingle: 财产、基金或要素的正式混合 (assets / funds)

groups.name: Internal Cavitation & Burrowing · 蜂窝化与侵蚀穿孔 (Tunnel, Hollow out, Excavate)
groups.tip: 穿刺使内部呈蜂窝状

items.def_en: Mark a surface with numerous small indentations, hollows, or craters
items.ex_en: Acid rain can severely pit historical marble monuments across urban centers over decades.
items.ex_zh: 几十年来，酸雨严重腐蚀了城市中心历史悠久的大理石纪念碑，留下斑斑凹坑。

items.def_en: Remove the interior part of something so that only an empty space or shell remains
items.ex_en: Artisans gently hollow out cedar logs to build traditional canoes for river fishing.
items.ex_zh: 工匠们小心地掏空雪松原木，制作捕鱼用的传统独木舟。
items.ex2_en: The massive limestone cliff gradually hollowed out after centuries of persistent coastal erosion.
items.ex2_zh: 在经历几个世纪持续的海岸侵蚀后，巨大的石灰岩悬崖逐渐凹陷变空。

items.def_en: Dig or burrow a subterranean passageway through rock, earth, or substance
items.ex_en: Engineers plan to tunnel through solid granite mountains to construct the high-speed railway.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们计划贯通坚硬的花岗岩山体以修建高速铁路。

items.def_en: Make a hole or series of passages into or under something
items.ex_en: Small rodents burrow into soft soil beneath the barn to escape harsh winters.
items.ex_zh: 小型啮齿动物在谷仓下的松软土壤中打洞，以躲避严酷的寒冬。

items.def_zh: 使成蜂窝状，使布满孔洞（或通道）
items.def_en: (usually passive) To pierce or fill something with a network of holes, tunnels, or passages.
items.ex_en: The ancient limestone cliffs were honeycombed with deep subterranean tunnels and natural caverns.
items.ex_zh: 古老的石灰岩悬崖布满了纵横交错的地下通道和天然洞穴。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate structural decay or modification from within, forming an interconnected network of cavities, tunnels, or air pockets. Honeycomb denotes carving an intricate cell-like grid, whereas hollow out focuses on scooping out core mass.
groups.summary_zh: 指在内部穿凿或侵蚀，形成网状孔洞、管道或蜂窝状结构。
groups.desc_en: Involves eroding, tunneling, or scooping out the interior substance of a solid mass, contrasting with surface abrasion or complete external destruction.
groups.desc_zh: 指从实体内部蛀空、掏挖或穿孔，区别于单纯的外部表面磨损或彻底摧毁粉碎。
groups.nuance_en: hollow out: scooping the core to leave a mere shell or husk (tree / log / economy) · tunnel: boring a continuous linear passageway through solid mass (mountain / rock) · burrow: small animal-like excavation for nesting or hiding (ground / sand) · pit: forming localized surface depressions or corrosive cavities (metal / face / stone) · honeycomb: perforating an interior thoroughly with a web of voids (limestone / rock / cliff)
groups.nuance_zh: hollow out: 挖空内部仅留外壳或实质架空 (tree / log / economy) · tunnel: 在实体中开凿贯通隧道 (mountain / rock) · burrow: 如小动物般钻穴打洞或潜行 (ground / sand) · pit: 腐蚀或碰撞形成微小凹坑或麻点 (metal / face / stone) · honeycomb: 使结构内部布满蜂窝状孔隙 (limestone / rock / cliff)

groups.name: Interpret & Elucidate · 阐释与破译说明 (Explicate, Unpack, Clarify)
groups.tip: 剖析内涵用言语明辨

items.def_en: To provide explanations or information that make a complicated problem easier to grasp
items.ex_en: Newly declassified archives shed light on the controversial diplomatic decisions made during wartime.
items.ex_zh: 最新解密的档案阐明了战时做出的那些颇具争议的外交决定。

items.def_zh: 理解，阐释；口译；演绎（艺术作品）
items.def_en: 1. To explain or understand the meaning of something. 2. To translate spoken words from one language into another. 3. To perform a piece of music, a role, etc., in a way that conveys one's own understanding of it.
items.ex_en: Scholars continue to interpret the ambiguous clauses of the constitutional amendment differently today.
items.ex_zh: 如今，学者们对宪法修正案中模棱两可的条款仍有不同的解读。

items.def_en: To make something obscure, confusing, or ambiguous clear and easily understandable
items.ex_en: The company issued a formal statement to clarify misleading reports regarding executive compensation.
items.ex_zh: 公司发表了一份正式声明，以澄清关于高管薪酬的误导性报道。

items.def_en: To examine, analyze, and explain the various elements of a complex idea, argument, or text
items.ex_en: The seminar aims to unpack the philosophical arguments presented in the controversial monograph.
items.ex_zh: 该研讨会旨在深入拆解那部引发争议的专著中所提出的哲学论点。

items.def_en: To analyze and explain a complex principle, literary text, or argument in exhaustive detail
items.ex_en: The professor took several hours to explicate the metaphysical implications of the poem.
items.ex_zh: 教授花了几个小时详细阐释这首诗所蕴含的形而上学意蕴。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on explaining, translating, or unfolding the latent significance, symbolism, or mechanics of complex data, artwork, dreams, or foreign utterances for others.
groups.summary_zh: 对复杂数据、艺术意涵或隐晦言论进行剖析、翻译并加以说明。
groups.desc_en: Involves systematically explaining, decoding, or dissecting obscure meaning, contrasting with plain factual description or superficial translation.
groups.desc_zh: 指系统性阐发、解构或澄清理据与晦涩意涵，区别于平铺直叙的事实描述或机械直译。
groups.nuance_en: interpret: deciphering meaning through subjective framing or contextual lenses (data / dream / text) · clarify: removing ambiguity to make an idea plain (confusion / position / statement) · unpack: systematically analyzing complex concepts layer by layer (theory / argument / metaphor) · explicate: formal, rigorous textual or logical analysis (poem / doctrine / text) · shed light on: offering crucial context or clues that illuminate an enigma (mystery / issue)
groups.nuance_zh: interpret: 带有主观视角或语境的解读破译 (data / dream / text) · clarify: 消除含混歧义以澄明立场 (confusion / position / statement) · unpack: 抽丝剥茧式剖析复杂概念 (theory / argument / metaphor) · explicate: 正式严谨的文本或逻辑细读 (poem / doctrine / text) · shed light on: 提供线索照亮谜团 (mystery / issue)

groups.name: Interrupt & Interject · 打断与插话 (Chime in, Cut in, Butt in)
groups.tip: 半路插嘴打断他人的讲话

items.def_en: To join in or interrupt a conversation by offering remarks or agreement
items.ex_en: Several board members chose to chime in with enthusiastic support for the proposal.
items.ex_zh: 几位董事会成员纷纷插话，对这项提议表示热烈支持。

items.def_en: To interrupt a discussion with a helpful or casual remark
items.ex_en: She decided to chip in with a practical suggestion during the lively budget discussion.
items.ex_zh: 在热烈的预算讨论中，她插话提出了一个切合实际的建议。

items.def_en: To interrupt someone while they are speaking
items.ex_en: She cut in before he could finish his explanation.
items.ex_zh: 他还没解释完，她就打断了话头。

items.def_en: To suddenly interrupt a conversation or speech by adding a remark.
items.ex_en: The defense attorney rose sharply to interject a timely objection during cross-examination.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师在交叉询问时突然起身，适时插话提出了异议。

items.def_en: (informal) To interrupt a conversation rudely without being invited
items.ex_en: Please do not butt in while the panel is delivering its final verdict.
items.ex_zh: 在专家组宣布最终裁决时，请不要硬插嘴。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate abrupt, momentary verbal intrusions into an ongoing dialogue to voice an opinion, clarify a point, or add a quick commentary.
groups.summary_zh: 指在他人说话或对话途中突然插话、搭话或插嘴发言。
groups.desc_en: Denotes abruptly breaking the continuity of ongoing speech by inserting an utterance, contrasting with planned turn-taking in conversation.
groups.desc_zh: 指在他人言语流中突然插嘴打断，区别于有条不紊的常规会话轮替。
groups.nuance_en: cut in: sharply severing another speaker's turn to speak (speech / conversation) · interject: inserting a sudden brief remark or exclamation (comment / thought / remark) · chime in: eagerly joining with an agreeable or timely addition (agreement / assent) · chip in: contributing a brief, helpful opinion or small resource (remark / contribution) · butt in: impudently interrupting without welcome or manners (discussion / conversation)
groups.nuance_zh: cut in: 突兀切断他人的发言 (speech / conversation) · interject: 迅速插入简短评述或感叹 (comment / thought / remark) · chime in: 附和着插话或凑趣补充 (agreement / assent) · chip in: 适时补上一两句话或小额出资 (remark / contribution) · butt in: 蛮横失礼地硬插嘴 (discussion / conversation)

groups.name: Interrupt & Punctuate · 打断与穿插 (Intersperse, Pepper, Punctuate)
groups.tip: 中途插话以打破原有节奏

items.def_en: (+ with) To enliven a speech or writing with humorous or striking remarks
items.ex_en: The experienced lecturer liked to season his dry academic presentations with witty anecdotes.
items.ex_zh: 这位经验丰富的讲师喜欢在他枯燥的学术演讲中穿插幽默的轶事以调节气氛。

items.def_en: (usually passive, + with) To scatter, decorate, or interrupt a narrative or surface with numerous instances
items.ex_en: The dark night sky was studded with countless brilliant stars above the desert.
items.ex_zh: 沙漠上方漆黑的夜空中布满了无数颗明亮的繁星。

items.def_en: (+ with) To scatter or place things at intervals among other things
items.ex_en: The director chose to intersperse dramatic musical cues between crucial dialogue scenes effectively.
items.ex_zh: 导演巧妙地在关键对白场景之间穿插了富有戏剧性的背景音乐。

items.def_zh: 不时打断，间歇打扰；给……加标点
items.def_en: 1. (often passive) To interrupt something repeatedly at intervals. 2. To add punctuation marks to a piece of writing.
items.ex_en: Loud bursts of thunder continued to punctuate the solemn silence of the night.
items.ex_zh: 阵阵隆隆的雷声不断打破深夜庄严的寂静。

items.def_en: (+ with) To hit or hit repeatedly with something; to distribute abundantly throughout
items.ex_en: Journalists began to pepper the exhausted spokesperson with aggressive questions about political scandals.
items.ex_zh: 记者们开始就政治丑闻连珠炮似地向筋疲力尽的发言人抛出尖锐问题。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on repeated occurrences, sounds, or events that regularly break the flow of a discourse or situation, rhythmically dividing or highlighting it.
groups.summary_zh: 指周期性或散布式地穿插、点缀于讲话或过程之中并形成打断。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on dispersing discrete elements or interruptions across an ongoing continuum to break monotony, contrasting with continuous uninterrupted flow.
groups.desc_zh: 指在连续的过程、文本或时空中穿插点缀离散元素以打破单调，区别于不间断的匀质延展。
groups.nuance_en: punctuate: interrupting regular intervals with sharp, distinct events (applause / groans / silence) · intersperse: distributing contrasting elements throughout a medium (illustrations / anecdotes / jokes) · pepper: spraying rapidly and densely with numerous small items (questions / bullets / criticisms) · stud: adorning a surface with prominent, gleaming points (jewels / stars / islands) · season: lightly flavoring speech or art with characteristic accents (wit / humour / irony)
groups.nuance_zh: punctuate: 以突发离散事件打断平缓流程 (applause / groans / silence) · intersperse: 在全篇散落穿插插图或趣闻 (illustrations / anecdotes / jokes) · pepper: 像撒胡椒般密集发射质问或批评 (questions / bullets / criticisms) · stud: 表面密布显眼亮眼的点缀物 (jewels / stars / islands) · season: 以特定意趣对语言艺术进行调味点缀 (wit / humour / irony)

groups.name: Intersect & Cross Paths · 相交与交汇 (Intersect, Converge, Cross)
groups.tip: 运动轨迹成十字相交

items.def_en: To pass or extend from one side of something to the other, or meet and form an X-shape
items.ex_en: Two narrow dirt paths cross near the clearing where the old cabin stands.
items.ex_zh: 两条狭窄的泥土小径在那座旧木屋附近的空地旁相交。

items.def_en: To move back and forth across an area or mark it with crossing lines in various directions
items.ex_en: Dozens of high-speed train tracks criss-cross the bustling industrial heartland of the nation.
items.ex_zh: 数十条高速铁路线交织穿行在国家繁华的工业腹地。

items.def_en: (+ on/at) To move toward or meet at a common focal point from different directions
items.ex_en: Demonstrators from various parts of the city began to converge on the parliament square.
items.ex_zh: 来自城市各处的示威者开始向议会广场聚集。

items.def_en: (+ with) To cross or cut across each other at a point or line.
items.ex_en: The busy suburban avenues intersect near the entrance of the commercial shopping district.
items.ex_zh: 这几条繁忙的郊区大道在商业购物区入口附近相交。
items.ex2_en: The town planner intersected the new pedestrian walkway with the main avenue.
items.ex2_zh: 城市规划师让新建的步行道与主干道相交穿过。

items.def_en: To divide or cut across something into two equal or distinct parts
items.ex_en: A wide interstate highway will bisect the rural community into two separate sectors.
items.ex_zh: 一条宽阔的州际公路将把这个乡村社区一分为二。

groups.summary_en: This frame involves physical paths, geometric lines, or metaphorical journeys cutting across, overlapping, or meeting at a single spatial or conceptual junction.
groups.summary_zh: 指线条、道路或人生轨迹在空间或逻辑上的交叉、贯通与交汇。
groups.desc_en: Describes physical or metaphorical trajectories meeting and crossing over each other, contrasting with remaining parallel or moving in divergence.
groups.desc_zh: 指物理或比喻意义上的轨迹在某一点发生交汇并穿过，区别于平行不交或背道而驰。
groups.nuance_en: cross: basic traversing or passing over each other's path (path / line / threshold) · intersect: geometric cutting across at a defined shared point (roads / paths / interests) · converge: moving from different directions toward a single focal point (lines / crowds / opinions) · criss-cross: traversing back and forth in a complex network (region / country / network) · bisect: cleanly dividing a space into two equal halves (angle / line / territory)
groups.nuance_zh: cross: 最基础的穿越或轨迹交叉 (path / line / threshold) · intersect: 几何意义上的交叉相割或利益重叠 (roads / paths / interests) · converge: 从不同方向会聚于一点 (lines / crowds / opinions) · criss-cross: 纵横交错地穿行于全境 (region / country / network) · bisect: 一分为二地平分对切 (angle / line / territory)

groups.name: Intervene & Mediate · 介入与调解 (Mediate, Arbitrate, Step in)
groups.tip: 介入争端进行调停干涉

items.def_zh: 挺身介入，出手相助或制止
items.def_en: Become involved in an ongoing difficult situation, argument, or task to help resolve it
items.ex_en: The government had to step in to prevent the bank from collapsing.
items.ex_zh: 政府不得不出手干预，以防止该银行倒闭。

items.def_zh: 介入，干预，调涉；调解；阻碍，插手
items.def_en: 1. to deliberately become involved in a difficult situation in order to improve it or prevent it from getting worse. 2. to happen between two events or points in time.
items.ex_en: The international community urged peacekeepers to intervene before the violent ethnic conflict worsened.
items.ex_zh: 国际社会敦促维和人员在暴力种族冲突进一步恶化之前进行干预。

items.def_en: Act as a neutral go-between to reconcile opposing sides and reach an agreement
items.ex_en: A veteran diplomat was appointed to mediate disputes between the two hostile border nations.
items.ex_zh: 一位资深外交官被任命调解这两个敌对边境国家之间的争端。

items.def_en: (+ for / with) Intervene on behalf of another person, especially by pleading or negotiating for mercy or aid
items.ex_en: The compassionate nun promised to intercede with the governor for the young convict.
items.ex_zh: 慈悲的修女答应向州长求情，赦免那个年轻的囚犯。

items.def_en: Officially judge and settle a dispute between two conflicting parties
items.ex_en: An independent judicial tribunal will arbitrate the contract dispute between both union representatives.
items.ex_zh: 一个独立司法法庭将仲裁双方工会代表之间的合同争议。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers constructive or deliberate involvement in disputes, crises, or diplomatic conflicts to resolve deadlocks, defuse tensions, or impose order. Unlike meddling, these actions are typically purposeful, authorized, or welcomed by at least one party.
groups.summary_zh: 指为化解矛盾、打破僵局或恢复秩序而主动介入调解。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an impartial third party stepping into a conflict to facilitate resolution, contrasting with taking a partisan side or fueling hostilities.
groups.desc_zh: 指第三方介入争议各方之中居间斡旋促成和解，区别于选边站队或推波助澜。
groups.nuance_en: mediate: acting as a neutral go-between to help parties reach consensus (dispute / talks / agreement) · arbitrate: exercising formal authority to issue a binding ruling (settlement / claim / dispute) · intercede: petitioning or pleading on behalf of an endangered party (on behalf of / mercy) · step in: actively entering a deteriorating crisis to restore order (conflict / fray) · intervene: authoritative systemic entry to halt escalating clashes (affairs / conflict)
groups.nuance_zh: mediate: 作为中立中间人调和争议达成共识 (dispute / talks / agreement) · arbitrate: 依法作为仲裁员作出具有约束力的裁决 (settlement / claim / dispute) · intercede: 代为求情或说项 (on behalf of / mercy) · step in: 局势恶化时及时出面干预救场 (conflict / fray) · intervene: 官方或权威系统性强势介入 (affairs / conflict)

groups.name: Intoxicate & Inebriate · 沉醉与陶醉 (Inebriate, Fuddle, Enrapture)
groups.tip: 酒精或药物带来的迷醉陶醉

items.def_en: To make someone slightly drunk or mellow
items.ex_en: Two small glasses of fruity cider were enough to tipsify the novice drinker.
items.ex_zh: 两小杯果味苹果酒就足以让这个初次饮酒的人微醺了。

items.def_zh: 使醉，使陶醉；使欣喜若狂
items.def_en: 1. (formal) (of alcohol or drugs) To cause someone to lose control of their faculties; to make drunk. 2. (often passive) To excite or elate someone beyond self-control.
items.ex_en: The potent spiced wine began to intoxicate the weary travelers within minutes.
items.ex_zh: 烈性加香葡萄酒在几分钟内就让疲惫的旅行者们醉意上头。

items.def_en: To make someone formally or medically drunk with alcoholic liquor
items.ex_en: Excessive quantities of imported spirits can quickly inebriate even the most seasoned sailors.
items.ex_zh: 过量的进口烈酒很快就能让哪怕最老练的水手也酩酊大醉。

items.def_en: To confuse or stupefy someone thoroughly, typically with drink or excessive emotion
items.ex_en: The potent mixture of spiced rum and heavy fumes served to befuddle him.
items.ex_zh: 浓烈的香料朗姆酒与刺鼻的气味混在一起，把他弄得醉意昏沉。

items.def_en: To fill someone with profound delight, reverence, or ecstatic wonder
items.ex_en: The sublime symphonic performance seemed to enrapture the entire audience throughout the evening.
items.ex_zh: 那场崇高的交响乐演出整晚都让全场观众听得如痴如醉。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures states of physical drunkenness caused by chemicals or metaphorical intoxication marked by overwhelming ecstasy and loss of composure.
groups.summary_zh: 指因酒精药物致醉，或受狂喜激情驱使而陶醉迷乱。
groups.desc_en: Captures the intoxicating, euphoric, or mind-altering emotional high produced by intense stimuli or pride, contrasting with rational sobriety.
groups.desc_zh: 指强烈刺激、成功或狂喜所引发的精神陶醉与狂热眩晕感，区别于清醒理智的自持状态。
groups.nuance_en: enrapture: filling completely with intense aesthetic or spiritual delight (audience / listener / crowd) · intoxicate: overwhelming the senses with thrilling, heady exhilaration (power / success / joy) · inebriate: producing dizzying, giddy emotional exhilaration (ambition / victory / pride) · befuddle: dulling mental sharpness through overwhelming confusion (senses / mind) · tipsify: inducing a slight, playful dizzying flush (senses / companion)
groups.nuance_zh: enrapture: 审美或精神上使人欣喜若狂、出神入化 (audience / listener / crowd) · intoxicate: 因权力、胜利带来强烈的冲头陶醉 (power / success / joy) · inebriate: 成功令人头晕目眩的飘飘然 (ambition / victory / pride) · befuddle: 被狂喜或复杂事物搞得晕头转向 (senses / mind) · tipsify: 带来轻度微醺或俏皮眩晕感 (senses / companion)

groups.name: Intoxicate & Inebriate · 醉酒与致醉 (Intoxicate, Befuddle, Tipsify)
groups.tip: 酒精催眠令人神志不清

items.def_en: To become less drunk or make someone return to a sober, lucid state
items.ex_en: A brisk walk in the cold wind helped him sober up quickly tonight.
items.ex_zh: 今晚在寒风中快步走了一会儿，帮他迅速清醒了过来。
items.ex2_en: The intoxicated patron sobered up rapidly after drinking three glasses of cold water.
items.ex2_zh: 这位喝醉的顾客在喝了三杯凉水后迅速清醒了过来。

items.def_en: To cause someone to lose control of their faculties through alcohol or drugs
items.ex_en: Illicit narcotic substances can severely intoxicate individuals and impair their basic judgment functions.
items.ex_zh: 违禁麻醉品会使人严重中毒致幻，并损害其基本的判断能力。

items.def_zh: 使大醉（常用被动态 sloshed）
items.def_en: To make someone heavily drunk (chiefly used colloquially in passive/participle form)
items.ex_en: He got completely sloshed after downing five pints of heavy ale at dinner.
items.ex_zh: 在晚饭时灌下五品脱浓艾尔啤酒后，他喝得酩酊大醉。
items.ex2_en: Cold rainwater sloshed violently inside his heavy leather boots with every hurried step.
items.ex2_zh: 随着匆忙的每一步，冰冷的雨水在他沉重的皮靴里剧烈晃荡。

items.def_zh: 使醉，灌醉；使陶醉，使发狂
items.def_en: (formal) To make someone intoxicated or drunk; to fill someone with exhilaration or confusion.
