groups.desc_en: Covers unauthorized disclosures of confidential, proprietary, or hidden information, distinguished from legitimate 'announcing' by its breach of trust, secrecy protocols, or lack of disciplined discretion.
groups.desc_zh: 指突破保密协议或纪律约束，擅自披露内部机密或隐私信息，区别于正常的“通报/公开”，强调背信、泄密管道与轻率失言。
groups.nuance_en: leak: covertly or unauthorizedly pass sensitive data to the press or public (memo / information / document) · blab: indiscreetly blurt out secrets through reckless chatter (secret / plan / gossip) · blow the whistle: courageously expose illicit organizational wrongdoing to authorities (malpractice / fraud / corruption) · spill the beans: inadvertently or prematurely disclose a surprise or secret (plan / surprise / truth) · spill: confess or let slip privileged details under questioning or emotion (details / truth / guts)
groups.nuance_zh: leak: 蓄意或暗中向外界泄露机密文件 (memo / information / document) · blab: 大嘴巴多嘴走漏风声 (secret / plan / gossip) · blow the whistle: 勇敢揭发组织内部违法违规黑幕 (malpractice / fraud / corruption) · spill the beans: 无意中过早说漏嘴泄密 (plan / surprise / truth) · spill: 在盘问或情绪驱使下全盘托出 (details / truth / guts)

groups.name: Lean & Recline · 倾倚与斜躺 (Recline, Lean back, Slouch, Lounge)
groups.tip: 身体倾斜依靠在支撑物上

items.def_en: To tilt one's torso backward against a supportive surface such as a chair back
items.ex_en: After a grueling shift, he decided to lean back in his chair and rest.
items.ex_zh: 繁重的轮班结束后，他决定仰靠在椅子上休息一下。

items.def_en: To stand, sit, or lie down in a relaxed, comfortable, and lazy manner
items.ex_en: During the holidays, the teenagers would lounge around the living room playing video games.
items.ex_zh: 放假期间，十几岁的孩子们经常懒洋洋地待在客厅里打电子游戏。

items.def_en: To lean or lie back in a relaxed position; to adjust the back of a seat into a sloping position.
items.ex_en: First-class passengers may recline their seats into fully flat beds during the flight.
items.ex_zh: 头等舱乘客可在飞行途中将座椅后仰调节为完全平躺的睡床。
items.ex2_en: Tired travelers reclined comfortably on soft leather sofas while waiting for their flights.
items.ex2_zh: 疲惫的旅客在等待航班时舒适地斜躺在软皮沙发上。

items.def_zh: 没精打采地坐/站，塌肩瘫靠
items.def_en: To sit, walk, or stand with a drooped head, rounded shoulders, and poor posture
items.ex_en: The tired clerk began to slouch over the counter as closing time approached slowly.
items.ex_zh: 随着打烊时间临近，疲惫的店员开始没精打采地趴在柜台上。

items.def_zh: 伸开四肢躺卧，四仰八叉地躺
items.def_en: To sit, lie, or fall with arms and legs spread out awkwardly or carelessly
items.ex_en: Exhausted from the marathon, runners would sprawl out across the grassy park lawn.
items.ex_zh: 跑完马拉松精疲力竭，选手们四仰八叉地躺在公园的草坪上。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on human posture where the torso slopes backward or sideward for relaxation, ease, or indolence, contrasting active leaning with passive repose.
groups.summary_zh: 身体向后倾倚或斜靠以求放松，或懒散躺靠。
groups.desc_en: Denotes bodily postures shifted away from an alert vertical stance toward passive, relaxed, or improper support, differing from upright 'sitting' or horizontal 'lying' through varying degrees of tilt, leisure, or slouching.
groups.desc_zh: 指脱离端正垂直坐姿向后倚靠或随意松垮的体态，区别于严谨的“端坐”或完全的“平躺”，强调身体的倾斜度、闲散感或不良仪态。
groups.nuance_en: recline: lean back comfortably in an intentional, supported resting posture (seat / couch / armchair) · lean back: tilt the upper torso backward away from an upright axis (chair / headrest / sofa) · lounge: sit or lie in an indolent, lazy, relaxed manner (couch / poolside / sofa) · slouch: collapse posture forward or downward with drooped shoulders (chair / desk / corner) · sprawl: spread limbs carelessly and widely across a surface (couch / floor / bed)
groups.nuance_zh: recline: 依靠靠背舒适地后仰斜躺 (seat / couch / armchair) · lean back: 上身往椅背向后倚靠 (chair / headrest / sofa) · lounge: 懒洋洋、闲散地斜靠瘫坐 (couch / poolside / sofa) · slouch: 没精打采地弓背颓坐 (chair / desk / corner) · sprawl: 四肢大张、毫无规矩地散漫摊开 (couch / floor / bed)

groups.name: Leap & Bound · 纵跃与羚羊式跃跳 (Pronk, Leap, Bound, Cavort)
groups.tip: 四肢用力蹬地向上腾空跃起

items.def_en: (+ up/out) To leap, jump, or move suddenly, rapidly, and elastically from a stationary stance
items.ex_en: The startled cat sprang up from the warm windowsill when the thunder boomed.
items.ex_zh: 雷声轰鸣时，受惊的猫从温暖的窗台上猛然跃起。

items.def_en: (+ along/over) To run or advance with long, vigorous, springy steps and bounding leaps
items.ex_en: The energetic puppy began to bound across the meadow toward the smiling children happily.
items.ex_zh: 精力充沛的小狗欢快地蹦跳着穿过草地，奔向微笑着的孩子们。

items.def_en: To jump or dance around excitedly, playfully, and noisily
items.ex_en: Young fawns cavorted gracefully across the dew-covered meadow in the cool morning light.
items.ex_zh: 清晨凉爽的光线中，幼鹿在布满露水的草地上欢快轻盈地雀跃。

items.def_zh: 四脚弹跳，跃起（尤指羚羊等四肢僵直跳跃）
items.def_en: 1. (zoology) (of a quadruped, especially a springbok) To leap high into the air with an arched back and stiff legs.
items.ex_en: The startled springbok began to pronk repeatedly across the dry African savanna.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的跳羚开始在干燥的非洲大草原上一次次四蹄僵直地腾空跃起。

items.def_en: (zoology) (of quadrupeds) To jump high straight into the air with all four legs held stiff and straight
items.ex_en: Spotting a cheetah nearby, the alert gazelle stotted straight into the open air.
items.ex_zh: 警惕的瞪羚发现附近有猎豹，四肢僵直地径直跃入半空。

groups.summary_en: Captures spring-like, buoyant four-legged or airborne jumping, where an animal or energetic person propels all feet off the ground in high, arching leaps. 'Bound' conveys long rhythmic strides; 'pronk' is specific to rigid-legged stotting.
groups.summary_zh: 指四足动物或活泼的人弹起腾空、四蹄腾空的高弹道腾跃。
groups.desc_en: Characterizes explosive, spring-loaded vertical or bounding leaps off the ground, contrasting with basic 'jumping' by displaying dramatic elastic recoil, aerial suspension, or stylized quadrupedal signaling displays.
groups.desc_zh: 指身体借由弹力爆发实现的凌空跃起或连环大步跳跃，区别于基础的“跳跃”，强调肌肉弹簧般的爆发力、空中悬停感或四足动物特有的示警跳姿。
groups.nuance_en: leap: jump forcefully through the air across distance or over an obstacle (barrier / chasm / fence) · spring: suddenly burst upward or forward using coiled muscular elasticity (feet / trap / air) · bound: progress forward through a series of long, rhythmic leaps (stride / steps / feet) · pronk: leap vertically with all four legs held stiff and straight in ungulate display (gazelle / springbok / deer) · stot: bound stiff-legged to signal fitness or predator detection (gazelle / fawn / prey) · cavort: leap, romp, and gambol about in high spirits (meadow / field / yard)
groups.nuance_zh: leap: 猛力凌空飞跃障碍 (barrier / chasm / fence) · spring: 借蓄积的弹力猝然弹起 (feet / trap / air) · bound: 迈着轻快大步连续腾跃奔跑 (stride / steps / feet) · pronk: 瞪羚等四肢完全绷直垂直腾空弹跳 (gazelle / springbok / deer) · stot: 有蹄类僵直四肢跳跃示警 (gazelle / fawn / prey) · cavort: 欢快地雀跃蹦跳嬉戏 (meadow / field / yard)

groups.name: Legal Subpoena & Citation · 传唤与司法传讯 (Summons, Subpoena, Cite)
groups.tip: 官方传唤或正式组织开会

items.def_en: To officially give or deliver a legal document, such as a writ, to someone
items.ex_en: The legal courier arrived early yesterday morning to serve the notice on the defendant.
items.ex_zh: 法律专递员昨天一早就赶到，向被告送达了通知书。

items.def_zh: 传讯（某人）出庭；下达违章传票
items.def_en: To officially order somebody to appear before a court of law to face charges
items.ex_en: The municipal authority will cite the landlord for failing to meet standard safety regulations.
items.ex_zh: 市政当局将传讯该房东，因其未能达到标准的安全法规。

items.def_en: To order someone to attend court as a witness by means of a formal legal writ
items.ex_en: The grand jury voted to subpoena the former chief executive to testify next week.
items.ex_zh: 大陪审团投票决定以传票传唤前首席执行官于下周出庭作证。

items.def_en: (law) To order someone to appear in a court of law with an official summons.
items.ex_en: The magistrate decided to summons the reluctant witness to court for official questioning tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 地方法官决定传唤那名不情愿的证人明天出庭接受正式讯问。

items.def_zh: 提审；提讯（被告核对罪名）
items.def_en: To bring an accused person before a court to hear and answer a formal criminal charge
items.ex_en: The prosecutor intends to arraign the suspect on multiple felony charges this Friday afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 检察官打算在本周五下午就多项重罪指控提审该嫌疑人。

groups.summary_en: Jurisprudential verbs describing formal orders backed by state coercion, directing a party or witness to appear before a court.
groups.summary_zh: 强调具有法定强制力、责令当事人或证人到庭受审的司法传票行为。
groups.desc_en: Involves formal judicial commands compelling a person's appearance, document production, or answer to criminal charges under sanction of law, differing from ordinary 'calling' through its coercive sovereign authority.
groups.desc_zh: 指司法机关依法对当事人发出的具有法律强制力的传唤、出庭通知或提审，区别于普通“邀请/叫来”，强调法律制裁的强制威慑力。
groups.nuance_en: subpoena: legally compel a witness to testify or surrender evidence under penalty (records / witness / documents) · summons: officially order an individual to attend court as a defendant or juror (juror / defendant / party) · cite: formally charge someone with a minor violation or summon to court (driver / violator / offender) · serve: formally deliver a legal writ or process to a named party (subpoena / writ / notice) · arraign: formally bring a prisoner before a court to hear and answer an indictment (defendant / suspect / prisoner)
groups.nuance_zh: subpoena: 司法强制传票要求证人出庭或交出证据 (records / witness / documents) · summons: 正式传唤被告或陪审员到庭 (juror / defendant / party) · cite: 开具传票或违章罚单 (driver / violator / offender) · serve: 依法正式送达法律文书 (subpoena / writ / notice) · arraign: 提审羁押人员到法庭听候宣读指控并答辩 (defendant / suspect / prisoner)

groups.name: Leverage & Implement · 务实利用与应用 (Utilize, Leverage, Harness)
groups.tip: 将工具或资源投入实际运作

items.def_zh: 调配，有效运用（资源或技能）
items.def_en: to bring resources, skills, or technologies into effective action
items.ex_en: The regional hospital will deploy additional medical staff to handle the seasonal flu outbreak.
items.ex_zh: 该地区医院将调配额外的医护人员来应对季节性流感的暴发。

items.def_en: to use a situation, opportunity, or resource fully, sometimes selfishly or unfairly
items.ex_en: The corporation sought to exploit the emerging market before major competitors could intervene.
items.ex_zh: 该企业试图在主要竞争对手介入之前充分开发这一新兴市场。

items.def_en: to use an existing asset, influence, or opportunity to gain maximum advantage
items.ex_en: The firm plans to leverage its strong brand recognition to enter foreign markets smoothly.
items.ex_zh: 该公司计划充分利用其强大的品牌知名度顺利进军海外市场。

items.def_zh: 驾驭，治理并利用（自然力等）
items.def_en: to control and utilize a natural or powerful resource to produce energy or achieve a goal
items.ex_en: Engineers designed advanced offshore turbines to harness tidal energy for the coastal city.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们设计了先进的海上水轮机，以驾驭潮汐能为沿海城市供电。

items.def_en: to make practical and effective use of something
items.ex_en: The laboratory will utilise high-precision sensors to record thermal variations during the chemical reaction.
items.ex_zh: 实验室将使用高精度传感器来记录化学反应过程中的温度变化。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers putting resources, skills, or opportunities to effective and purposeful work, often optimizing existing assets to achieve a tangible outcome.
groups.summary_zh: 强调调动或发挥人、物、技能的最大价值与效用。
groups.desc_en: Denotes strategically mobilizing an asset, capability, or resource to maximize functional impact and achieve specific outcomes, contrasting with simple 'using' through its emphasis on pragmatic leverage and strategic optimization.
groups.desc_zh: 指策略性地调用、驾驭既有资源、能力或技术以放大效应并达成目标，区别于基础的“使用”，强调战略杠杆效应与实用转化率。
groups.nuance_en: leverage: strategically exploit an advantage or asset to multiply outcomes (advantage / asset / network) · harness: capture, tame, and redirect a natural or technical power for productive use (power / energy / potential) · exploit: fully and aggressively milk a resource or opportunity for practical or commercial gain (opportunity / resource / weakness) · deploy: strategically mobilize and assign assets or systems into active field use (technology / resources / personnel) · utilise: adapt an available resource functionally to serve a practical purpose (tool / method / facility)
groups.nuance_zh: leverage: 撬动优势或资产以放大成效 (advantage / asset / network) · harness: 驾驭并转化自然力或潜能为生产力 (power / energy / potential) · exploit: 充分开发利用资源或敏锐利用战机 (opportunity / resource / weakness) · deploy: 部署并实战化调度系统或资产 (technology / resources / personnel) · utilise: 务实有效地调用现有手段或设施 (tool / method / facility)

groups.name: Leverage & Multiply Gains · 增值与倍增 (Parlay, Leverage, Compound)
groups.tip: 利用已有资本博取更大收益

items.def_en: To reinvest profits earned into the same business to foster growth and greater value
items.ex_en: The founders chose to plow back all quarterly revenue to expand their manufacturing capacity.
items.ex_zh: 创始人选择将所有季度收益再投资，以扩大他们的生产能力。

items.def_en: To increase gradually by generating earnings on both the initial principal and the accumulated interest
items.ex_en: Over three decades, prudent mutual fund investments will compound into a substantial retirement nest.
items.ex_zh: 三十年间，审慎的共同基金投资将通过复利积累成一笔可观的养老金。

items.def_en: To use something that you already possess in order to achieve a much better result or greater advantage
items.ex_en: The entrepreneur decided to leverage his existing patents to negotiate better venture capital funding.
items.ex_zh: 这位企业家决定发挥现有专利的杠杆优势，以洽谈更有利的风投资金。

items.def_zh: 使增值，利用……博取更大收益；连本带利地赌
items.def_en: 1. (+ into) (chiefly North American) To use an initial asset, success, or small advantage to gain something much greater. 2. To risk original money and its winnings on a subsequent bet.
items.ex_en: She managed to parlay a small summer internship into a prestigious permanent executive position.
items.ex_zh: 她成功利用一段短暂的暑期实习博得了一个显赫的常任高管职位。

items.def_zh: 利用浮盈加仓，滚雪球增资
items.def_en: To build up or multiply investments or gains progressively upon an original holding
items.ex_en: The ambitious trader began to pyramid his position as the stock kept surging upward.
items.ex_zh: 随着股价持续上涨，这位雄心勃勃的交易员开始利用浮盈一路加仓。
items.ex2_en: Unpaid corporate debts pyramid alarming rates whenever compounding monthly interest accrues unchecked.
items.ex2_zh: 每当未经控制的复利按月累积时，未偿企业债务便会以惊人的速度呈金字塔式剧增。

groups.summary_en: Centers on exploiting an existing small stake, resource, or early success strategically to generate vastly greater profits, influence, or opportunities.
groups.summary_zh: 指利用初始资产、成果或微小优势实现指数级增值或倍增。
groups.desc_en: Covers financial and tactical compounding where existing gains or borrowed capital are systematically reinvested to generate exponential returns, differing from basic 'investing' by its risk-compounding ladder structure.
groups.desc_zh: 指利用已有获利或杠杆工具进行再投资，以滚雪球方式实现收益倍增与规模扩增，区别于普通的“投资/获利”，强调复利累进与杠杆放大。
groups.nuance_en: parlay: transform a small initial win or asset into a much larger stake through successive bets (success / winnings / stake) · leverage: borrow capital or use borrowed force to multiply potential financial returns (balance sheet / buyout / debt) · compound: calculate or accumulate accelerating gains atop prior accumulated yields (interest / returns / earnings) · pyramid: build a massive speculative position by using paper profits as collateral (stock / position / wealth) · plow back: systematically reinvest profits back into the core enterprise rather than distributing them (earnings / profits / dividends)
groups.nuance_zh: parlay: 将前期小胜或资产连本带利滚投成大赢面 (success / winnings / stake) · leverage: 运用财务杠杆或借贷放大收益规模 (balance sheet / buyout / debt) · compound: 借由利滚利实现复利增值 (interest / returns / earnings) · pyramid: 用账面浮盈作抵押不断加码倒金字塔式建仓 (stock / position / wealth) · plow back: 将盈利全部回转再投资于企业实体 (earnings / profits / dividends)

groups.name: Levy & Exact · 征税与强制课征 (Levy, Exact, Assess)
groups.tip: 公权力强制征收税款物资

items.def_en: To receive or assemble taxes, fees, or contributions from designated citizens or entities
items.ex_en: Local authorities collect property taxes twice a year to fund public school operations.
items.ex_zh: 地方当局每年两次征收房产税，以资助公立学校的运营。
items.ex2_en: Thick rainwater collected steadily in large metal barrels beneath the rusted gutter drains.
items.ex2_zh: 生锈的天沟排水口下方，大量雨水在巨大的金属桶中不断汇集。

items.def_en: To demand and obtain something such as taxes, dues, or penalties forcefully from someone
items.ex_en: The feudal lord would exact heavy tributes from the impoverished farmers every autumn.
items.ex_zh: 这位封建领主每年秋天都会向贫困的农民强行勒索沉重的赋税。

items.def_en: To officially order that a new tax, duty, or legal penalty must be established and obeyed
items.ex_en: The federal government plans to impose a higher tariff on imported foreign steel.
items.ex_zh: 联邦政府计划对进口外国钢铁强制征收更高的关税。

items.def_en: To calculate and officially assign the tax amount, rate, or value of a taxable asset
items.ex_en: County officials will assess the property value before issuing the annual tax assessment notice.
items.ex_zh: 县政府官员将在发出年度税务评估通知前对房产价值进行核定。

items.def_zh: 征收，课征（税款、罚款等）；征集（军队）
items.def_en: 1. to officially impose and collect a tax, fee, or fine 2. (historical) to recruit or assemble soldiers
items.ex_en: The city council voted to levy a special assessment on downtown commercial real estate.
items.ex_zh: 市议会投票决定对市中心的商业地产课征一笔专项税费。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers sovereign authorities establishing and compelling the collection of public revenues, penalties, and civic charges. It emphasizes the mandatory, legally enforced exaction of tariffs, duties, and fines from the public.
groups.summary_zh: 强调依法强行核定并征收税款、规费或罚款。
groups.desc_en: Entails the mandatory legal or sovereign extraction of taxes, fines, or tribute from subjects or citizens, contrasting with voluntary 'paying' or 'demanding' by its unilateral state coercion and legal assessment basis.
groups.desc_zh: 指国家或主权机关凭借公权力依法对民众单方面征收、估定或强索赋税与罚款，区别于自愿交纳或普通的“要钱”，强调法定强制征调。
groups.nuance_en: levy: officially impose and demand payment of a statutory tax, tariff, or fine (tax / fine / tariff) · exact: demand and compel compulsory payment, concessions, or compliance by sheer power (price / tribute / toll) · assess: calculate and officially set the monetary value of property or tax obligation (tax / value / damage) · impose: unilaterally decree a burdensome duty, sanction, or fee (tariff / sanction / penalty) · collect: gather in assessed dues, taxes, or payments from payers (revenue / tax / debt)
groups.nuance_zh: levy: 依法正式征收税款或课处罚金 (tax / fine / tariff) · exact: 依仗权势强行勒索索取赔款或赋税 (price / tribute / toll) · assess: 核定估算资产应纳税额 (tax / value / damage) · impose: 单方面强制推行关税或制裁 (tariff / sanction / penalty) · collect: 收缴归拢法定税赋与应收款项 (revenue / tax / debt)

groups.name: Liaise & Coordinate · 联络与对接 (Coordinate, Network, Interface)
groups.tip: 在各方之间沟通充当联络人

items.def_zh: 结识人脉；建立业务联系
items.def_en: To meet and interact with people in business or professional fields to build useful connections
items.ex_en: Conferences allow professionals to network actively and discover new career advancement opportunities.
items.ex_zh: 行业会议让专业人士能够积极结识人脉，并发现新的职业晋升机会。

items.def_en: To organize people or departments so that they work together smoothly and effectively
items.ex_en: The logistics manager must coordinate multiple delivery schedules to avoid unnecessary regional warehouse delays.
items.ex_zh: 物流经理必须协调多项配送时间表，以避免不必要的区域仓库延误。
items.ex2_en: The various regional rescue operations coordinate closely through a central satellite command network.
items.ex2_zh: 各区域的救援行动通过中央卫星指挥网络紧密地协调配合。

items.def_en: (+ with) To interact, connect, and exchange information between departments or external systems
items.ex_en: The sales division must interface regularly with product designers to resolve client concerns.
items.ex_zh: 销售部门必须定期与产品设计师对接，以解决客户关切的问题。

items.def_en: (+ with) To work joint-venture style with another party on a shared project or objective
items.ex_en: Our engineering department will collaborate closely with researchers from the nearby technological university.
items.ex_zh: 我们的工程部门将与附近科技大学的研究人员开展密切合作。

items.def_zh: 联络，充当联络人，沟通协调
items.def_en: To work closely with another person or organization, acting as a link to share information and coordinate activities.
items.ex_en: An appointed officer will liaise between municipal leaders and local community groups regularly.
items.ex_zh: 一位获任命的专员将在市政领导和当地社区团体之间定期沟通协调。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on organizational and professional bridge-building, where an actor actively shares intelligence, harmonizes workflows, and aligns multiple stakeholders.
groups.summary_zh: 指在组织或业务中充当纽带，负责各方的信息互通与协调对接。
groups.desc_en: Encompasses serving as an operational bridge between separate organizations or teams to align workflows, information, and efforts, differing from isolated 'communicating' through its institutional interlock and synchronizing function.
groups.desc_zh: 指在独立组织或团队之间建立桥梁，打通信息与工作流，促成协同动作，区别于普通的“交流”，强调跨边界对接、统筹与系统互联。
groups.nuance_en: liaise: act as a designated communicative intermediary bridging two discrete parties (department / police / official) · coordinate: bring diverse operational elements into harmonious, efficient execution (efforts / schedule / activities) · interface: form an operational boundary where distinct groups or systems connect and interact (department / system / client) · collaborate: actively work together as peers on a joint intellectual or practical endeavor (partner / team / researcher) · network: establish professional contacts and social channels for mutual advantage (professionals / peers / colleagues)
groups.nuance_zh: liaise: 充当专职联络员在两方间沟通协调 (department / police / official) · coordinate: 统筹整合多方动作步调一致 (efforts / schedule / activities) · interface: 作为对口窗口与另一机构或系统无缝对接 (department / system / client) · collaborate: 紧密协作共同完成研发或项目 (partner / team / researcher) · network: 拓展建立人脉资源网 (professionals / peers / colleagues)

groups.name: Liberate & Emancipate · 解放与独立 (Free, Enfranchise, Unshackle)
groups.tip: 摆脱殖民统治获得民族独立

items.def_en: To free someone or a population from literal shackles or severe socio-political constraints
items.ex_en: The reform sought to unshackle the impoverished peasantry from centuries of hereditary debt.
items.ex_zh: 这项改革旨在使赤贫的农民摆脱数百年世代相传的债务枷锁。

items.def_zh: 解放，释放（受压迫国家或人民）
items.def_en: To free a country or people from foreign occupation, oppression, or strict control
items.ex_en: Allied soldiers fought bravely to liberate the besieged territory from brutal foreign occupation.
items.ex_zh: 盟军士兵英勇作战，从残酷的外国占领下解放了这片被围困的领土。

items.def_zh: 解放，赋予人身自由/法定权利
items.def_en: To give someone legal, political, or social freedom, especially from slavery or institutional disenfranchisement
items.ex_en: The historic decree finally acted to emancipate thousands of laborers from brutal indentured servitude.
items.ex_zh: 这项历史性法令终于生效，将数千名劳工从残酷的契约奴役中解放出来。

items.def_zh: 赋予选举权，给予政治自由
items.def_en: To grant political liberty, autonomy, or the legal right to vote to a disenfranchised group
items.ex_en: The constitutional amendment was drafted specifically to enfranchise millions of newly qualified voters.
items.ex_zh: 该宪法修正案专门起草，旨在赋予数百万新符合资格的选民以选举权。

items.def_zh: 使非殖民化，给予（殖民地）独立
items.def_en: To grant political independence to a colony or remove colonial control and influence from a country or institution.
items.ex_en: The newly elected assembly worked diligently to decolonize local educational curricula and institutions.
items.ex_zh: 新当选的议会努力工作，使当地的教育课程和机构去殖民化。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers sovereign, legal, and sociopolitical acts of freeing peoples, territories, or enslaved groups from imperial domination or subjugation. The focus ranges from constitutional decolonization to collective liberation.
groups.summary_zh: 政治、法律或集体层面解除殖民统治、奴役或压迫。
groups.desc_en: Involves releasing individuals, social groups, or territories from legal servitude, political oppression, or colonial subjugation into self-determination, contrasting with physical 'opening' through its profound sociopolitical and legal redefinition.
groups.desc_zh: 指使群体或领土摆脱人身奴役、殖民压迫或法律枷锁，重获自由与公民权，区别于物理上的“打开/解脱”，强调社会政治与法权的重塑。
groups.nuance_en: liberate: free a territory, people, or institution from military occupation or tyranny (city / captive / territory) · emancipate: grant legal and social freedom from chattel slavery or civil subjection (slaves / women / minorities) · enfranchise: bestow legal citizenship rights, primarily the right to vote (citizens / women / populace) · unshackle: cast off physical chains or heavy institutional constraints (economy / mind / prisoner) · decolonize: release a colonized territory from imperial rule, granting sovereignty (state / nation / curriculum)
groups.nuance_zh: liberate: 武力解放被占领土或解救被压迫民众 (city / captive / territory) · emancipate: 依法废除奴役使之获得人身自主权 (slaves / women / minorities) · enfranchise: 赋予公民权特别是选举投票权 (citizens / women / populace) · unshackle: 砸碎物理枷锁或彻底解开体制桎梏 (economy / mind / prisoner) · decolonize: 摆脱宗主国统治实现国家独立去殖民化 (state / nation / curriculum)

groups.name: Lick & Lap · 舔舐与触碰 (Lap, Lap up, Taste)
groups.tip: 用舌头舔舐或用身体触碰

items.def_en: to put a tiny amount of food or drink on the tongue to sample its flavor
items.ex_en: The chef paused briefly to taste the creamy soup before serving the guests.
items.ex_zh: 主厨在为客人上菜前稍作停顿，尝了尝浓汤的滋味。

items.def_en: to lick up every drop of liquid, or metaphorically to enthusiastically accept praise or attention
items.ex_en: The conceited actor seemed eager to lap up every word of flattering praise.
items.ex_zh: 那个自负的演员似乎迫不及待地欣然全盘接受每一句奉承赞美。

items.def_en: to stroke, lick, or touch something deliberately with the tongue
items.ex_en: The mother cat gently tongued the damp fur of her newborn sleeping kitten.
items.ex_zh: 母猫用舌头温柔地舔舐着刚出生熟睡小猫的潮湿毛发。

items.def_en: to drink by scooping up liquid with rapid tongue movements, or of gentle waves to brush lightly against shore
items.ex_en: Gentle ocean waves began to lap rhythmically against the weathered wooden boat hull.
items.ex_zh: 轻柔的海浪开始有节奏地拍打着那艘风化斑驳的木质船体。

items.def_zh: 舔，舔吃；轻拍，拂过；轻易击败
items.def_en: 1. to pass the tongue over the surface of something 2. (of flames, waves, etc.) to touch or lap lightly and repeatedly 3. (informal) to defeat or overcome someone easily
items.ex_en: The playful puppy tried to lick my face the moment I walked inside.
items.ex_zh: 我一走进门，那只顽皮的小狗就试图舔我的脸。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on applying the tongue across a surface to ingest, groom, or sense, and metaphorically denotes liquids, flames, or waves gently touching and brushing against a boundary.
groups.summary_zh: 指用舌头舔拭、吸吮，或指波浪与火焰轻柔舔触表面。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on contacting, drawing in, or consuming moisture using the tongue, contrasting with broad 'eating' or 'drinking' by specifying lingual motion, tasting contact, or rapid animal fluid uptake.
groups.desc_zh: 指运用舌部进行触碰、吸舔或卷舐液体，区别于一般的“吃”或“喝”，强调舌头的生理动作机制、表层触感或动物舔食方式。
groups.nuance_en: lick: pass the tongue over a surface to moisten, clean, or taste it (lips / ice cream / paw) · lap: take up liquid rapidly with quick tongue scoops, typical of animals (water / milk / bowl) · lap up: eagerly and thoroughly drink in a liquid, or figuratively consume praise or attention (praise / attention / cream) · tongue: explore, probe, or touch with the tip of the tongue (tooth / reed / wound) · taste: sample a tiny morsel or drop on the tongue to discern flavor (food / wine / dish)
groups.nuance_zh: lick: 用舌头擦拭、润湿或舔舐 (lips / ice cream / paw) · lap: 动物用舌尖快速卷吸液体 (water / milk / bowl) · lap up: 贪婪地舐光，或引申为极受用地全盘接受吹捧 (praise / attention / cream) · tongue: 用舌尖触探或拨弄 (tooth / reed / wound) · taste: 将食物点在舌尖品鉴风味 (food / wine / dish)

groups.name: Lie & Recline · 躺卧与平卧 (Recline, Sprawl, Repose)
groups.tip: 身体横躺或仰卧休息

items.def_en: To place oneself in a flat, resting horizontal position on a bed or ground
items.ex_en: I'm going to lie down for an hour before the guests arrive.
items.ex_zh: 客人来之前我想去躺下休息一个小时。

items.def_en: To lie quietly at rest or peace in sleep, tranquility, or dignified stillness
items.ex_en: The weary traveler sat down under the ancient oak tree to repose quietly.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的旅人在古老的橡树下坐下，静静地安歇休养。

items.def_en: To lean or lie back horizontally in a relaxed, comfortable resting posture
items.ex_en: Guests are invited to recline comfortably on cushioned loungers beside the heated pool.
items.ex_zh: 宾客们受邀在恒温泳池旁配有软垫的躺椅上舒适地仰卧小憩。
items.ex2_en: The weary passenger reclined his train seat to take an undisturbed afternoon nap.
items.ex2_zh: 疲倦的乘客调低了火车座椅的靠背，以便不受打扰地午睡片刻。

items.def_zh: 躺，平卧；位于；处于（某种状态）
items.def_en: 1. Past participle of lie; to have rested in a flat, horizontal position, or to have remained in a particular state or location.
items.ex_en: The forgotten stone tablets had lain buried beneath the shifting desert sand for millennia.
items.ex_zh: 那些被遗忘的石碑已经在流动的沙漠黄沙下平躺埋没了数千年。

items.def_en: To lie or sit with one's limbs spread out awkwardly, casually, or carelessly
items.ex_en: The sleepy children sprawled lazily across the living room carpet watching their favorite cartoons.
items.ex_zh: 困倦的孩子们懒散地四仰八叉摊在客厅地毯上看他们最爱的动画片。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict resting horizontally on a supportive surface. They differentiate between relaxed reclining, untidy sprawling, and calm, stationary resting postures.
groups.summary_zh: 指身体平放、斜倚或展肢舒躺于平面的静息姿态。
groups.desc_en: Denotes maintaining or assuming a full horizontal resting position upon a supporting surface, contrasting with dynamic 'falling' or vertical 'standing' through its sustained passivity, rest, or bodily extension.
groups.desc_zh: 指身体完全平摊在支撑面上呈水平静止或休养状态，区别于动态的“倒下”或垂直的“站立”，强调平躺的静态性、安歇感或身体舒展。
groups.nuance_en: lie down: transition the body into an intentional flat horizontal resting stance (bed / couch / grass) · recline: rest horizontally or near-horizontally on a tilted luxury support (couch / chaise / bed) · repose: rest in a serene, dignified, or motionless horizontal state (bed / tomb / state) · sprawl: lie spread out irregularly and ungovernably over a wide area (floor / rug / lawn) · lie: be horizontally situated and inert upon a surface (bed / ground / grave)
groups.nuance_zh: lie down: 主动屈身平躺下以休息 (bed / couch / grass) · recline: 优雅舒适地仰卧斜躺 (couch / chaise / bed) · repose: 安卧、安息于宁静或庄重状态中 (bed / tomb / state) · sprawl: 瘫手瘫脚、横七竖八地躺散在地上 (floor / rug / lawn) · lie: 处于平卧、横卧或陈列的状态 (bed / ground / grave)

groups.name: Lift & Hoist · 机械吊装与举升 (Hoist, Winch, Haul Up)
groups.tip: 用绳索或吊车起吊重物

items.def_en: To pull or drag something upward with continuous, heavy exertion
items.ex_en: The sailors had to haul up the heavy anchor using thick manual ropes.
items.ex_zh: 水手们不得不使用粗重的手动绳索把沉重的锚用力吊拉上来。

items.def_en: To raise something to a higher physical position or level
items.ex_en: The mechanical hydraulic ramp will slowly elevate the broken vehicle for routine undercarriage inspection.
items.ex_zh: 机械液压斜坡将缓慢升起故障车辆，以进行常规的底盘检查。

items.def_en: To raise or pull something up, especially by means of ropes, pulleys, or mechanical equipment.
items.ex_en: Workers used an industrial pulley to hoist the heavy steel beam into place.
items.ex_zh: 工人们利用工业滑轮把沉重的钢梁吊升固定到位。

items.def_en: To lift, raise, or pull something heavy with great muscular effort
items.ex_en: The dockworkers managed to heave the heavy wooden crate onto the platform.
items.ex_zh: 码头工人们费力地将沉重的木箱托举到了平台上。

items.def_en: To lift or pull something using a mechanical hauling apparatus with a cable or rope
items.ex_en: The rescue crew used a steel cable to winch the damaged vehicle up.
items.ex_zh: 救援队用钢缆将受损车辆吊拉了上来。

groups.summary_en: This frame denotes raising or lifting heavy objects aloft, frequently with mechanical leverage, ropes, pulleys, or concerted muscular effort.
groups.summary_zh: 指借助器械、绳索或爆发力向上起吊或强行举起。
groups.desc_en: Covers mechanical vertical lifting of exceptionally heavy loads using rigging, pulleys, cables, or manual brute strain, differing from simple 'raising' through its engineered apparatus and dead-weight resistance.
groups.desc_zh: 指使用滑轮、索具、卷扬机或人力重负将沉重负载垂直吊装提升，区别于轻巧的“拿/抬”，强调工程机械辅助与克服重力阻抗。
groups.nuance_en: hoist: raise a heavy object upward using pulleys, ropes, or crane equipment (flag / sail / cargo) · winch: haul or lift a load using a mechanical rotating spool and cable (vehicle / anchor / cable) · haul up: pull a heavy or resistant payload upward by manual or mechanized continuous traction (net / anchor / bucket) · heave: lift, heave up, or shift a cumbersome weight with great muscular exertion (load / anchor / rock) · elevate: mechanically or structurally raise an object or platform to a higher plane (platform / cargo / level)
groups.nuance_zh: hoist: 用滑车、吊索将重物起吊升空 (flag / sail / cargo) · winch: 用卷扬机绞盘收线绞升 (vehicle / anchor / cable) · haul up: 费力向上一阵阵连续拖曳拉起 (net / anchor / bucket) · heave: 用尽全身蛮力向上猛抬猛掀 (load / anchor / rock) · elevate: 借机械机构或升降机使平台平稳提升 (platform / cargo / level)

groups.name: Lift & Hoist · 起吊与绞拉 (Hoist, Haul up, Crane)
groups.tip: 用绞盘绳索机械发力吊起

items.def_en: To pull or drag something heavy upward using sustained force or gear
items.ex_en: Fishermen worked together to haul up the overflowing net from the rough sea.
items.ex_zh: 渔民们合力将沉甸甸的渔网从汹涌的大海中拽了上来。

items.def_en: To move or lift something heavy using a crane or mechanical arm
items.ex_en: Operators had to crane the massive steel beam up to the twelfth floor.
items.ex_zh: 操作员必须用起重机将巨大的钢梁吊运到十二楼。

items.def_en: To raise or pull something up, often with ropes, pulleys, or heavy effort
items.ex_en: Sailors worked in rhythm to hoist the heavy mainsail before the storm hit.
items.ex_zh: 水手们在风暴来临前协调一致地升起了沉重的主帆。

items.def_en: To lift, pull, or haul something using a mechanical winch.
items.ex_en: They had to winch the heavy boat out of the water onto the trailer.
items.ex_zh: 他们不得不用卷扬机将沉重的船只从水中拉到拖车上。

items.def_en: To lift, raise, or throw something heavy with great effort
items.ex_en: With a final grunt, he managed to heave the sack of cement upward.
items.ex_zh: 他最后闷哼一声，竭力将那袋水泥拽举了起来。

groups.summary_en: Specifies moving heavy loads vertically using mechanical aids, tackles, cables, or concentrated physical force.
groups.summary_zh: 借助滑轮、吊车或机械装置吊装拉升重物。
groups.desc_en: Emphasizes the specific nautical, industrial, or mechanical gear involved in hoisting, craning, and reeling heavy payloads aloft, contrasting with generalized 'lifting' by its heavy-machinery mechanisms and traction techniques.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重于利用重型工业起重机、绞车、滑轮等专用机械构件实施垂直起吊与卷拉作业，区别于泛义的“举起”，强调机械传动与拉拽细节。
groups.nuance_en: crane: use a crane boom or crane-like mechanical arm to hoist and maneuver heavy bulk (engine / cargo / girders) · hoist: lift a load vertically into position with rigging tackle or crane hooks (beam / container / crate) · winch: hoist or haul a load horizontally/vertically via a powered drum and cable (boat / glider / machinery) · haul up: draw upward against gravity with robust persistent tension (trawl / wreckage / dredge) · heave: physically shoulder and violently pull upward against massive inertial resistance (rope / chest / anchor)
groups.nuance_zh: crane: 调动起重机悬臂吊起并回转就位 (engine / cargo / girders) · hoist: 挂钩后用吊装索具将其垂直吊起 (beam / container / crate) · winch: 驱动绞车卷筒通过钢丝绳卷拉 (boat / glider / machinery) · haul up: 顶着重力将沉在下方的物件强力拉上 (trawl / wreckage / dredge) · heave: 弓身发力猛力拽拉起笨重物体 (rope / chest / anchor)

groups.name: Linger & Loiter · 逗留与徘徊 (Linger, Loiter, Tarry)
groups.tip: 迟迟不愿离开原地徘徊

items.def_en: To wait or spend time somewhere doing very little or without clear intent
items.ex_en: Several bored teenagers chose to hang around the mall entrance all afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 几个无聊的青少年整个下午都聚在商场门口闲逛。

items.def_en: To remain in a place for a period of time, especially after others have left
items.ex_en: Could you stick around after the meeting so we can discuss the budget?
items.ex_zh: 散会后你能留下来一会儿，好让我们讨论下预算吗？

items.def_zh: 逗留，徘徊；（感觉、气息等）萦绕，消逝缓慢
items.def_en: 1. To stay somewhere longer than necessary because you are reluctant to leave. 2. (of a smell, feeling, illness, etc.) To take a long time to leave, disappear, or die.
items.ex_en: The aromatic scent of roasted coffee beans seemed to linger in the hallway.
items.ex_zh: 烘焙咖啡豆的浓郁香气似乎在走廊里久久不散。

items.def_en: To stand or wait around in a public place without any apparent purpose
items.ex_en: Signs warned that citizens must not loiter near the restricted government building.
items.ex_zh: 标识警告市民严禁在政府管制大楼附近无故逗留。

items.def_en: (formal or literary) To stay longer than intended; to delay leaving a place
items.ex_en: The weary traveler could not tarry long in the welcoming village.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的旅人无法在这个热情的小村庄里久留。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures staying in a place longer than strictly necessary, whether driven by reluctance to leave, aimless idling, or slow persistence of a trace or sensation.
groups.summary_zh: 指在某处过久逗留、漫无目的地闲荡或残存不去。
groups.desc_en: Describes remaining in a physical space or delaying departure beyond necessity due to reluctance, hesitation, or aimless idling, differing from intentional 'staying' by its sluggish pace or questionable intent.
groups.desc_zh: 指因眷恋、拖拉或无所事事而在原地逗留延宕，迟迟不肯离去，区别于目的明确的“停留/等待”，强调拖延、徘徊或动机可疑。
groups.nuance_en: linger: remain somewhere past normal departure time out of fondness, hesitation, or reluctance (room / memory / scent) · loiter: stand or idle around in a public place with no apparent legal business or purpose (corner / doorway / hallway) · tarry: delay or prolong one's stay or departure through slow dawdling (journey / way / town) · hang around: wait or idle casually in an area without clear urgency (entrance / corner / crowd) · stick around: intentionally remain in a place until an event occurs or finishes (office / town / meeting)
groups.nuance_zh: linger: 依依不舍地流连逗留或久久不散 (room / memory / scent) · loiter: 在公共场所无所事事地游荡徘徊 (corner / doorway / hallway) · tarry: 迟迟不启程，耽搁延误 (journey / way / town) · hang around: 在某处闲呆转悠 (entrance / corner / crowd) · stick around: 主动留下来直到事情完结 (office / town / meeting)

groups.name: Liquidate & Wind Up · 清算与结算 (Liquidate, Wind Up, Settle)
groups.tip: 清算资产以结清债务

items.def_en: To balance and pay off an account, claim, or balance owed in full.
items.ex_en: He went to the front desk to settle his hotel bill before leaving.
items.ex_zh: 他在离开前前往前台结清了酒店账单。

items.def_en: To bring a company, transaction, or venture to an orderly legal close by resolving all debts.
items.ex_en: The partners decided to wind up the struggling joint venture by month's end.
items.ex_zh: 合伙人们决定在月底前将这家苦苦挣扎的合资企业清理歇业。

items.def_en: To exchange investments, stocks, or redeemable tokens for cash value.
items.ex_en: She decided to cash in her tech shares while the market was high.
items.ex_zh: 她决定趁股市处于高位时兑现手中的科技股。

items.def_en: To officially and legally bring an organization, partnership, or enterprise to an end.
items.ex_en: The governing board voted unanimously to dissolve the failing partnership immediately.
items.ex_zh: 理事会一致投票决定立即解散这一陷入困境的合伙关系。
items.ex2_en: The joint business venture dissolved amicably after both partners pursued different career paths.
items.ex2_zh: 在双方合伙人追求不同的职业道路后，该合资企业和平解散了。

items.def_zh: 清算（公司等）；变卖（资产）清偿；消灭，处决
items.def_en: 1. To close down a business and sell off its assets to settle debts. 2. To convert assets into cash. 3. To kill or violently eliminate someone.
items.ex_en: The bankrupt company had to liquidate its remaining warehouse stock to pay creditors.
items.ex_zh: 破产公司不得不变卖剩余的仓库库存以偿还债权人。

groups.summary_en: This legal and financial frame describes concluding business operations, converting inventory and assets into liquid currency, and settling outstanding accounts to dissolve an entity or debt structure.
groups.summary_zh: 通过变卖财产、核算款项来清偿债务并注销结清企业或账户。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to formally shutting down an enterprise, fulfilling liabilities, and converting assets to cash to close out legal or financial existence, differing from sudden 'stopping' through its structured legal closure protocol.
groups.desc_zh: 指依法终止企业运营，将资产变现并清偿所有债务以终结其法人主体资格，区别于突发性的“停止/关门”，强调法定的清算结算流程。
groups.nuance_en: liquidate: sell off real assets for cash to extinguish liabilities or dissolve a firm (assets / business / inventory) · wind up: settle all outstanding debts, contracts, and affairs to definitively conclude operations (affairs / company / business) · dissolve: formally and legally terminate an established legal entity or partnership (corporation / partnership / firm) · settle: pay off and fully resolve outstanding balances, claims, or debts (account / debt / claim) · cash in: redeem an investment or financial asset for its real cash equivalent (shares / chips / policy)
groups.nuance_zh: liquidate: 变卖资产变现以抵偿债务并破产清算 (assets / business / inventory) · wind up: 了结清偿所有未决业务以正式歇业收盘 (affairs / company / business) · dissolve: 依法解散并注销法人或合伙资格 (corporation / partnership / firm) · settle: 结清结账消灭债权债务 (account / debt / claim) · cash in: 兑现投资或金融凭证以换取现款 (shares / chips / policy)

groups.name: Listing & Cataloging · 罗列与登载 (List, Itemize, Catalog)
groups.tip: 逐条列举罗列清单要点

items.def_zh: 列出，罗列，列入清单；（使船等）倾斜
items.def_en: 1. To write or mention things one after another on a list. 2. (of a ship) To lean or tilt to one side, or cause it to do so.
items.ex_en: The battered vessel began to list heavily toward its battered port side.
items.ex_zh: 这艘受损严重的船只开始向破损的左舷严重倾斜。

items.def_en: To make a complete, detailed list of all goods, assets, or possessions held in stock
items.ex_en: Auditors spent three days attempting to inventory every spare part in the warehouse.
items.ex_zh: 审计员花了三天时间试图盘点仓库里的每一件备件。

items.def_en: To record an item systematically in a complete, indexed register or directory
items.ex_en: Archivists worked diligently to catalog the rare manuscripts newly donated to the library.
items.ex_zh: 档案管理员勤勉地将新捐赠给图书馆的珍贵手稿编入目录。

items.def_en: To list every individual item, charge, or expense separately with exact specifications
items.ex_en: The contractor was legally required to itemize all labor and material expenses clearly.
items.ex_zh: 承包商被依法要求逐条清晰列出所有人工和材料费用。

items.def_en: To arrange figures, survey results, or systematic items systematically in rows and columns
items.ex_en: The researchers began to tabulate the nationwide survey responses into orderly columns.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员开始将全国问卷调查的结果系统地制成表格。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to writing down, recording, or stating distinct items in an orderly written roll, inventory, or database for documentation, review, or commerce.
groups.summary_zh: 指将人、物或事项逐一登入名册、清单或数据库以供查考或记录。
groups.desc_en: Denotes systematically recording individual elements into an orderly series or register, distinguishing itself from random mentioning or mere grouping through structured enumeration.
groups.desc_zh: 指将离散要素按条目系统性地登记、建档或编目，区别于随意的提及或单纯的物理归拢。
groups.nuance_en: list: basic sequential enumeration (items / demands / names) · inventory: comprehensive auditing and stocktaking (assets / stock / supplies) · catalog: descriptive archival classifying (books / species / grievances) · itemize: detailing individual cost or components (deductions / expenses / damages) · tabulate: arranging into columns and statistical tables (results / votes / figures)
groups.nuance_zh: list: 最基础的逐项罗列 (items / demands / names) · inventory: 全面清点盘存与资产清查 (assets / stock / supplies) · catalog: 规范建档分类与系统编目 (books / species / grievances) · itemize: 逐项逐条分列明细 (deductions / expenses / damages) · tabulate: 制表整理与数据汇总 (results / votes / figures)

groups.name: Litigate & Sue · 诉讼与对簿公堂 (Litigate, Sue, Prosecute, Indict)
groups.tip: 对簿公堂进行司法诉讼程序

items.def_en: To start a civil legal process against a person or entity in court to obtain financial damages or rights
items.ex_en: The homeowner threatened to sue the contractor over severe structural flaws.
items.ex_zh: 房主威胁要就严重的结构缺陷起诉承包商。

items.def_en: To take a grievance or legal dispute before a judge or magistrate for official adjudication
items.ex_en: The union decided to take the employer to court over unpaid overtime wages.
items.ex_zh: 工会决定因拖欠加班工资而将雇主告上法庭。

items.def_en: To officially accuse someone of a criminal offense and pursue legal trial on behalf of the state
items.ex_en: State authorities vowed to prosecute the corporate executives for massive accounting fraud.
items.ex_zh: 州当局誓言将就大规模财务欺诈起诉这些企业高管。

items.def_en: To formally charge a person with a severe felony through the ruling of a grand jury
items.ex_en: A grand jury moved to indict the former mayor on corruption charges.
items.ex_zh: 大陪审团决定以腐败罪名对前市长提起正式控告。

items.def_zh: 提起诉讼，对簿公堂；诉讼解决
items.def_en: To take a dispute or claim to a court of law for legal resolution.
items.ex_en: Both corporations preferred to settle the patent dispute rather than litigate endlessly.
items.ex_zh: 两家公司都宁愿调解专利纠纷，也不愿无休止地对簿公堂。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the formal domain of initiating legal action, bringing civil claims, or pressing criminal charges against an adversary through court proceedings.
groups.summary_zh: 通过司法途径向法院提起民事起诉、主张权益或对违法行为进行追诉。
groups.desc_en: Involves pursuing formal legal action against a party in a judicial forum, contrasting with informal dispute resolution, arbitration, or extrajudicial confrontation.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过法庭审判等正式司法程序解决争端或追究刑责，区别于私下和解、民间调解或场外抗争。
groups.nuance_en: sue: initiate civil action for damages (company / doctor / landlord) · take to court: escalate a formal dispute to judicial trial (dispute / tenant / case) · prosecute: conduct criminal proceedings as the state (suspect / criminal / offender) · indict: formally charge with a serious felony via grand jury (politician / official / defendant) · litigate: engage extensively in ongoing legal contest (claims / dispute / patent)
groups.nuance_zh: sue: 提起民事诉讼索赔 (company / doctor / landlord) · take to court: 将争议正式推上公堂 (dispute / tenant / case) · prosecute: 检方提起公诉追究刑责 (suspect / criminal / offender) · indict: 大陪审团正式起诉或指控重罪 (politician / official / defendant) · litigate: 展开全面或长期的诉讼博弈 (claims / dispute / patent)

groups.name: Load & Burden Down · 载重与使之不堪重负 (Laden, Burden, Encumber, Weigh down)
groups.tip: 承载过多沉重负荷

items.def_zh: 硬塞给……负担；使承受重担
items.def_en: To impose an unwelcome, onerous cargo, debt, or responsibility upon someone
items.ex_en: The sudden resignation will saddle her with excessive managerial duties this quarter.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的辞职将使她在本季度背负过重的管理职责。

items.def_zh: 装载，使负担（多用作过去分词形式）
items.def_en: (archaic) To load heavily with cargo or burdens; mainly used as a participial adjective meaning heavily loaded or weighed down.
items.ex_en: The weary caravan, heavily laden with silks and spices, crossed the desert.
items.ex_zh: 满载丝绸与香料的疲惫商队穿过了沙漠。

items.def_en: To impede, restrict, or make free movement difficult by loading with luggage or burdens
items.ex_en: Excessive administrative protocols will needlessly encumber the progress of the research team.
items.ex_zh: 过多的繁文缛节会徒劳地阻碍研究团队的进展。

items.def_en: To cause someone to bend, slow down, or become exhausted by imposing physical or mental heaviness
items.ex_en: She felt weighed down by domestic responsibilities and work pressures.
items.ex_zh: 她感到家庭责任和工作压力压得自己喘不过气来。

items.def_en: To load someone or something with a heavy physical weight or distressing responsibility
items.ex_en: We must not burden new recruits with such critical and complex responsibilities.
items.ex_zh: 我们绝不能让新员工背负如此重大而复杂的责任。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame highlight loading cargo, weight, or figurative troubles to near or beyond maximum capacity, resulting in visible strain, sluggishness, or encumbrance.
groups.summary_zh: 指加载沉重货物或精神负担，使之沉重迟缓、不堪重压。
groups.desc_en: Describes placing excessive physical weight or psychological liabilities upon someone or something, differing from simple carrying or loading by the resulting impairment or oppression.
groups.desc_zh: 指将沉重的物理负荷或心理劳役施加于身，区别于普通装载，其核心在于造成不堪承受的压抑与拖累。
groups.nuance_en: saddle: impose an inescapable, onerous duty or debt (debt / responsibility / committee) · laden: heavily loaded, often poetically or sensory-rich (boughs / air / tables) · encumber: hamper free movement or title with obstacles (traveler / property / estate) · weigh down: physically sag or depress spirits through sheer mass (branches / spirit / heart) · burden: impose severe moral, practical, or emotional strain (family / conscience / taxpayer)
groups.nuance_zh: saddle: 使硬性背负棘手债务或沉重差事 (debt / responsibility / committee) · laden: 满载装载，多含诗意或感官充盈感 (boughs / air / tables) · encumber: 阻碍行动自由或在产权上设绊 (traveler / property / estate) · weigh down: 物理压弯或心理压垮 (branches / spirit / heart) · burden: 施加沉重的情感、道义或经济负担 (family / conscience / taxpayer)

groups.name: Load & Replenish · 装填与重载 (Reload, Recharge, Replenish)
groups.tip: 将货物或弹药装填就位

items.def_en: To load with electrical energy, fresh ammunition, or vital supplies again
items.ex_en: The remote sensor requires sunlight every few days to recharge its battery.
items.ex_zh: 这个远程传感器每隔几天就需要阳光来给电池充电。

items.def_zh: 再装填（弹药）；重新装载（货物）；重新加载（网页或程序）
items.def_en: 1. To put bullets or cartridges into a firearm again. 2. To load goods or data again; refresh a computer page or program.
items.ex_en: The soldier quickly ducked behind cover to reload his empty rifle chamber.
items.ex_zh: 士兵迅速躲到掩体后，为打空的步枪重新装填弹药。

items.def_en: To fill a container or receptacle again after it has been emptied
items.ex_en: The attentive waiter came over to refill our empty water glasses promptly.
items.ex_zh: 体贴的侍者迅速走过来把我们空了的水杯重新倒满。
items.ex2_en: The shallow garden fountain refills automatically whenever subterranean sensors detect low water levels.
items.ex2_zh: 每当地下传感器检测到低水位时，浅水花园喷泉就会自动重新注满。

items.def_en: To fill something up again with supplies, fuel, or liquid that has been used up
items.ex_en: The expedition stopped at a remote outpost to replenish their water supplies.
items.ex_zh: 探险队在一处偏远哨所停下以补充饮用水储备。

items.def_zh: 重整军备；重新装填武器
items.def_en: To equip an army, weapon, or oneself with weapons or ammunition once again
items.ex_en: The treaty strictly forbade the fallen empire from attempting to rearm itself.
items.ex_zh: 该条约严格禁止战败的帝国企图重新整军备战。
items.ex2_en: The defeated military units rearmed secretly in hidden mountain fortresses despite strict prohibitions.
items.ex2_zh: 尽管有严格禁令，战败的部队仍在隐蔽的山地要塞中暗中重新武装。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe supplying a chamber, container, or technical apparatus with an operational charge, ammunition, fuel, or cargo again after depletion. The focus is functional operational replenishment rather than haphazard filling.
groups.summary_zh: 指耗尽后重新装入弹药、能源、数据或货物以恢复可用状态。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on restoring depleted functional energy, ammunition, or supplies to full operational capacity, unlike initial creation, assembly, or expansion.
groups.desc_zh: 指对已消耗殆尽的能量、弹药或耗材进行功能性恢复与重注，区别于初始建造、配置或单纯扩容。
groups.nuance_en: recharge: restore depleted electrical power or psychological vigor (battery / phone / energy) · reload: insert fresh ammunition or programmatic data (weapon / page / camera) · refill: pour or place contents to top up an empty container (prescription / glass / ink) · replenish: comprehensively restock depleted stocks or resources (supplies / reserves / pantry) · rearm: equip anew with military weaponry (military / troops / nation)
groups.nuance_zh: recharge: 充入电能或恢复心理活力 (battery / phone / energy) · reload: 重新装填弹药或重载数据 (weapon / page / camera) · refill: 将空器皿再次倒满或重新配药 (prescription / glass / ink) · replenish: 大规模补充并恢复耗尽的物资储备 (supplies / reserves / pantry) · rearm: 重新整军备战或换装新武器 (military / troops / nation)

groups.name: Loiter & Mope in Reverie · 闲荡与神伤恍惚 (Mope, Daydream, Laze)
groups.tip: 无所事事闲逛与神游发呆

items.def_zh: 闲逛，发呆，虚度（光阴）；（露出光屁股）搞恶作剧
items.def_en: (also 'moon about') To spend time in an aimless, distracted, or daydreaming state.
items.ex_en: He would constantly moon over romantic novels instead of doing his homework.
items.ex_zh: 他总是沉溺于言情小说发呆，而不肯去做作业。

items.def_en: To move aimlessly from place to place or thought to thought without purpose or clear direction
items.ex_en: Without clear career goals, he tended to drift through various temporary jobs.
items.ex_zh: 由于缺乏明确的职业目标，他总是在各种临时工作中随波逐流。

items.def_en: To indulge in pleasant, fanciful, but distracting thoughts while awake
items.ex_en: She sat by the window to daydream about her upcoming summer vacation.
items.ex_zh: 她坐在窗边，沉浸在对即将到来的暑假的遐想中。

items.def_zh: 郁郁寡欢地闲荡；垂头丧气
items.def_en: To wander about or spend time in a gloomy, depressed, and listless manner
items.ex_en: Instead of taking action, he chose to mope around the apartment all weekend.
items.ex_zh: 他并没有采取行动，而是整个周末都在公寓里无精打采地闲晃。

items.def_en: (+ for/after) To yearn deeply and waste away emotionally with lingering grief or lovesickness
items.ex_en: The lonely exile continued to pine for his distant ancestral homeland daily.
items.ex_zh: 孤独的流亡者日复一日地深切思念着遥远的故土。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict passing time idly in an unfocused, wistful, or melancholy state of mind. They contrast idle romantic distraction with lethargic, dispirited wandering.
groups.summary_zh: 心不在焉、怅然若失地虚度光阴或陷入遐思。
groups.desc_en: Captures aimless, melancholic, or dreamlike lingering without productive intent, setting it apart from energetic physical pacing, purposeful rest, or focused reflection.
groups.desc_zh: 描述脱离现实行动、沉溺于伤感或幻梦中的游荡与消沉，区别于有明确目的的歇息、警惕性徘徊或专注沉思。
groups.nuance_en: moon: wander around distractedly sighing in love (lover / corridors / room) · drift: float aimlessly through life or place without direction (life / town / thought) · daydream: mentally retreat into pleasant waking fantasies (future / lecture / afternoon) · mope: brood gloomily and listlessly in dejection (house / corner / defeat) · pine: waste away yearning agonizingly for someone or something lost (love / lover / past)
groups.nuance_zh: moon: 害相思病般魂不守舍地漫游 (lover / corridors / room) · drift: 漫无目的随波逐流 (life / town / thought) · daydream: 逃避现实做白日梦 (future / lecture / afternoon) · mope: 垂头丧气地抑郁呆坐或闲晃 (house / corner / defeat) · pine: 因极度思念或渴求而神伤憔悴 (love / lover / past)

groups.name: Lose & Forfeit · 失去与丧失 (Forfeit, Relinquish, Shed)
groups.tip: 因违规或疏忽而丧失

items.def_en: To give up or let go of something valuable or cherished, often with reluctance
items.ex_en: I could never part with this old guitar; it was a gift from my grandfather.
items.ex_zh: 我绝不会卖掉这把旧吉他，这是我祖父送给我的礼物。

items.def_zh: 丢失，遗失；丧失，失去；输掉
items.def_en: 1. To be unable to find something; to cease to have or retain something. 2. To fail to win a game, contest, or dispute.
items.ex_en: She was devastated to lose her grandmother's precious gold pendant on vacation.
items.ex_zh: 度假时弄丢了祖母珍贵的金吊坠，她伤心欲绝。

items.def_en: To cast off, lose, or get rid of unwanted weight, staff, or attributes
items.ex_en: The restructuring plan will help the bloated firm shed unnecessary operational costs.
items.ex_zh: 重组计划将帮助这家臃肿的公司剥离不必要的运营成本。

items.def_en: To lose the right to a possession, advantage, or privilege as a consequence of wrongdoing
items.ex_en: Violating company policy will force the employee to forfeit their annual bonus.
items.ex_zh: 违反公司规定将迫使该员工丧失领取年度奖金的资格。

items.def_en: To involuntarily give up possession, control, or a right to another
items.ex_en: The defeated commander was forced to relinquish control of the naval base.
items.ex_zh: 战败的指挥官被迫交出了海军基地的控制权。

groups.summary_en: Covers the outright, often permanent deprivation or surrender of possessions, attributes, resources, or rights. The intensity spans from involuntary deprivation to legal surrender or decisive structural elimination.
groups.summary_zh: 强调对物、权益或优势的彻底丧失、被剥夺或不得不放弃。
groups.desc_en: Centers on the involuntary or sacrificial surrender of possession, privilege, or status, distinct from deliberate reciprocal exchange, voluntary gifting, or gradual decay.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重于因违规、受迫或被迫割舍而失去所占有的权益或物资，区别于平等的互惠交易、自愿赠予或自然消亡。
groups.nuance_en: part with: surrender something personal with deep reluctance (heirloom / cash / possession) · lose: suffer unintentional deprivation or defeat (keys / job / game) · shed: purposefully or naturally cast off excess baggage (tears / skin / jobs) · forfeit: lose a right, title, or deposit as a penalty for breach (deposit / title / match) · relinquish: formally yield control, claim, or power under pressure (control / power / claim)
groups.nuance_zh: part with: 忍痛割爱舍弃心爱之物或钱财 (heirloom / cash / possession) · lose: 无意间丢失或承受被动失去 (keys / job / game) · shed: 主动或自然蜕去多余负累 (tears / skin / jobs) · forfeit: 因受罚或违约被剥夺定金或资格 (deposit / title / match) · relinquish: 在压力下正式声明交出权力或放弃诉求 (control / power / claim)

groups.name: Lubricate & Grease · 上油与润滑 (Lubricate, Grease, Anoint)
groups.tip: 涂油润滑以减少机件摩擦

items.def_en: To thoroughly apply lubricant or oil to machinery or equipment
items.ex_en: The mechanic had to lube up the rusty gears before running the engine.
items.ex_zh: 机械师在启动引擎前必须给生锈的齿轮加足润滑油。

items.def_en: To put or rub oil onto machine parts or a surface to make it smooth, lubricated, or functional.
items.ex_en: You need to oil the squeaky door hinge to stop that noise.
items.ex_zh: 你需要给吱吱作响的门铰链上点油以消除噪音。

items.def_en: To put thick oil or animal fat on a surface or mechanism
items.ex_en: The baker used butter to grease the cake pans before pouring the batter.
items.ex_zh: 烘焙师在倒入面糊之前用黄油涂抹了蛋糕模具。

items.def_en: To apply a substance such as oil or grease to reduce friction and allow smooth movement
items.ex_en: Engineers regularly lubricate the turbine bearings to minimize dangerous friction and wear.
items.ex_zh: 工程师定期给涡轮轴承涂润滑剂，以最大程度减少危险的摩擦和磨损。

items.def_en: To smear or rub with oil, often as part of a formal or religious ceremony
items.ex_en: The high priest used consecrated oil to anoint the new king's brow.
items.ex_zh: 大祭司用圣油膏抹了新国王的额头。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the physical application of slippery, oily, or fatty substances onto surfaces or mechanisms. Core distinctions depend on whether the intent is reducing mechanical friction, waterproofing, or ceremonial coating.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过涂抹油质物以减少机械摩擦或养护表面。
groups.desc_en: Involves applying slippery or viscous substances onto surfaces to minimize frictional wear or consecrate ritually, contrasting with general liquid cleansing, spraying, or staining.
groups.desc_zh: 指在物体表面涂抹滑腻黏稠的油性介质以减阻或行圣礼，区别于普通的水性冲洗、喷洒或污损。
groups.nuance_en: lube up: casually apply lubricant for immediate slickness (chain / mechanism / gears) · oil: apply thin oil to prevent squeaking or rusting (hinge / machine / lock) · grease: apply heavy lubricant or culinary fat (axle / pan / wheels) · lubricate: technically facilitate smooth friction-free mechanical movement (engine / joint / bearings) · anoint: apply sacred oil in a ceremonial or religious ordination (king / forehead / sick)
groups.nuance_zh: lube up: 口语中上润滑剂以求顺滑 (chain / mechanism / gears) · oil: 给合页等点轻机油以防锈降噪 (hinge / machine / lock) · grease: 抹厚重油脂或在锅具涂油防粘 (axle / pan / wheels) · lubricate: 专业地为机械零件注入减摩介质 (engine / joint / bearings) · anoint: 涂抹圣油以施行宗教加冕或洗礼 (king / forehead / sick)

groups.name: Lurk & Skulk · 潜伏与窥伺 (Lurk, Skulk, Slink)
groups.tip: 暗中隐蔽鬼祟偷偷溜行

items.def_zh: 潜伏，埋伏；暗藏，潜存；（在网络社群中）潜水
items.def_en: 1. (+ around/in/behind) To wait or hide secretly in the shadows, especially with bad intentions, or remain hidden as a danger.
items.ex_en: A suspicious man was seen to lurk behind the abandoned warehouse building.
items.ex_zh: 有人看到一个可疑男子在那座废弃仓库后面暗中潜伏。

items.def_en: To stand or wait around in a public place without any clear purpose, often attracting suspicion
items.ex_en: Guards instructed suspicious pedestrians not to loiter around the high-security perimeter.
items.ex_zh: 警卫指示可疑的行人不得在高度戒备的安全防线周围徘徊逗留。

items.def_en: (+ off/away/around) To move quietly and stealthily, typically feeling guilty, ashamed, or fearful of detection
items.ex_en: Guilty about breaking the vase, the boy tried to slink upstairs unnoticed.
items.ex_zh: 由于打碎了花瓶感到心虚，男孩试图神不知鬼不觉地溜上楼去。

items.def_zh: 鬼鬼祟祟地潜行或潜伏
items.def_en: (+ around/about/behind) To hide or move around stealthily, often out of cowardice, shame, or sinister intention
items.ex_en: The thief continued to skulk through the dark alleyways, avoiding the streetlamps.
items.ex_zh: 窃贼继续在黑暗的小巷中鬼鬼祟祟地潜行，避开街灯的照射。

items.def_en: (+ for) To conceal oneself and wait patiently in ambush to surprise, attack, or seize someone
items.ex_en: Armed bandits chose to lie in wait for the royal carriage along the mountain pass.
items.ex_zh: 武装匪徒选择在山口埋伏，等候皇家马车的到来。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote waiting, hiding, or moving covertly in shadows or out of view, typically driven by suspicious, malevolent, or cowardly motives.
groups.summary_zh: 指暗中潜伏、窥伺或鬼祟隐匿，常带有不良或怯懦企图。
groups.desc_en: Involves staying or moving in shadows covertly with stealthy, sinister, or guilty undertones, differing from openly waiting, standing sentry, or innocent strolling.
groups.desc_zh: 指怀揣阴暗动机或畏罪心理在暗处潜藏潜行，区别于光明正大的警戒守候、中性驻足或闲庭信步。
groups.nuance_en: lurk: wait hidden ready to ambush or observe unseen (shadows / corner / internet) · loiter: hang around a public place without apparent purpose (street / corner / doorway) · slink: move stealthily with cringing or guilty posture (away / house / shadows) · skulk: move or hide furtively out of cowardice or malice (corridors / alley / bushes) · lie in wait: hide in ambush deliberately expecting a target (ambush / prey / enemy)
groups.nuance_zh: lurk: 匿于暗处窥伺或伺机伏击 (shadows / corner / internet) · loiter: 在公共场所无端徘徊逗留 (street / corner / doorway) · slink: 弓腰畏缩地蹑手蹑脚潜行 (away / house / shadows) · skulk: 鬼鬼祟祟、心怀鬼胎地潜行躲藏 (corridors / alley / bushes) · lie in wait: 设伏埋伏以专候目标 (ambush / prey / enemy)

groups.name: Maim & Injure · 致残与重伤 (Mutilate, Cripple, Disfigure)
groups.tip: 造成肢体缺失或永久残疾的伤害

items.def_zh: 使伤残，使丧失活动机能
items.def_en: to injure someone so severely that they permanently lose normal physical or sensory function
items.ex_en: The severe spinal injury threatens to disable the young athlete for life.
items.ex_zh: 严重的脊柱损伤可能会使这名年轻运动员终身残疾。

items.def_en: to severely damage someone's legs or spine so that they cannot walk or move properly
items.ex_en: A terrible fall from the scaffolding threatened to cripple the young laborer.
items.ex_zh: 从脚手架上的惨烈坠落险些使这位年轻劳工落下终身残疾。

items.def_en: to severely wound or injure someone, causing permanent loss or impairment of a limb or body part
items.ex_en: Landmines can easily maim innocent civilians who wander into former conflict zones.
items.ex_zh: 地雷极易使误入前冲突区域的无辜平民致残。

items.def_en: to permanently spoil or ruin the physical appearance of someone's face or body
items.ex_en: The chemical blast threatened to disfigure the factory worker's face forever.
items.ex_zh: 化学爆炸险些让这名工厂工人的面部永久毁容。

items.def_zh: 毁伤，残害（肢体或身体结构）
items.def_en: to severely damage, dismember, or violently tear away parts of someone's body
items.ex_en: The brutal industrial accident managed to mutilate the operator's left hand severely.
items.ex_zh: 那场惨烈的工伤事故严重残害了操作员的左手。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on inflicting catastrophic, irreversible physical trauma on living bodies, specifically targeting limbs, bodily integrity, or permanent physical capability. Verbs range from complete physical incapacitation to permanent aesthetic desecration.
groups.summary_zh: 表示造成永久性伤残、肢体毁损或丧失行动机能。
groups.desc_en: Signifies causing irreversible, devastating bodily trauma that permanently ruins form or utility, far exceeding temporary pain, surface cuts, or minor contusions.
groups.desc_zh: 指施加毁灭性肉体创伤，导致肢体功能永久丧失或外貌严重损毁，远重于表皮划伤、轻微淤青或暂态疼痛。
groups.nuance_en: disable: impair physical or mechanical capacity to function (soldier / vehicle / system) · cripple: ruin mobility, structural integrity, or operating power (limbs / economy / industry) · maim: inflict permanent loss of a vital limb or bodily member (victim / soldier / civilian) · disfigure: permanently spoil the visual appearance or symmetry of the face/body (face / body / landscape) · mutilate: violently excise, hack, or deface essential flesh or text (corpse / body / manuscript)
groups.nuance_zh: disable: 使身体或系统失去运转能力 (soldier / vehicle / system) · cripple: 使跛足致残或使经济陷入瘫痪 (limbs / economy / industry) · maim: 剥夺健全肢体并致终身残疾 (victim / soldier / civilian) · disfigure: 毁容或破坏表面外观的完整性 (face / body / landscape) · mutilate: 凌迟断肢、残割肢体或恶意损毁文献 (corpse / body / manuscript)

groups.name: Maintain & Sustain · 保持与维持 (Preserve, Uphold, Keep Up)
groups.tip: 维持原有状态不退化

items.def_zh: 保持，维持；保养，维修；坚持，主张
items.def_en: 1. to make something continue at the same level or standard. 2. to keep a road, machine, or building in good condition by regular repair. 3. to state firmly that something is true.
items.ex_en: The city struggles to maintain its aging infrastructure amid severe budget cuts.
items.ex_zh: 在严重的预算削减下，该市竭力维持其老化的基础设施。

items.def_en: To supply enough nourishment, energy, or support to keep something continuing over time
items.ex_en: The meager emergency rations were scarcely sufficient to sustain the trapped miners.
items.ex_zh: 微薄的应急口粮几乎不足以维持受困矿工的生命。

items.def_en: To continue to perform, supply, or sustain something at the same high level
items.ex_en: She had to sprint faster just to keep up with the leaders.
items.ex_zh: 她不得不加快冲刺步伐，以便跟上领先阵营的节奏。

items.def_en: To make something last longer than usual or expected
items.ex_en: The defense attorney introduced new evidence solely to prolong the lengthy trial.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师提出新证据纯粹是为了拖长冗长的审判。

items.def_en: To defend, maintain, or support a legal decision, principle, or high standard
items.ex_en: The appellate judges voted to uphold the landmark decision of the lower court.
items.ex_zh: 上诉法院法官投票维持了下级法院的历史性裁决。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to providing ongoing resources, care, or effort to prevent systems, standards, relations, or physical states from degrading or lapsing.
groups.summary_zh: 指持续投入精力、资源或维护措施，使状态、标准或实体长久维系不衰。
groups.desc_en: Emphasizes continuously supplying effort, resources, or fidelity to keep a condition, baseline, or principle alive against natural attrition, rather than initiating or elevating it.
groups.desc_zh: 强调持续投入精力、资源或坚持道义，抗击自然衰退以守住既定基准或状态，不同于从无到有的创建或拔高。
groups.nuance_en: maintain: service regularly to keep in working order or state (standards / building / composure) · sustain: endure and fuel over an extended duration without collapse (life / growth / injury) · keep up: match a relentless pace or preserve a routine (pace / appearances / tradition) · prolong: artificially extend the temporal lifespan or duration (life / agony / discussion) · uphold: actively defend and honor legal or moral validity (law / tradition / justice)
groups.nuance_zh: maintain: 定期维保以使其保持良好状态或克制情绪 (standards / building / composure) · sustain: 供给养分与支持使其长久不坠 (life / growth / injury) · keep up: 跟上步调节奏或勉力维系体面 (pace / appearances / tradition) · prolong: 人为拉长持续时间或延期 (life / agony / discussion) · uphold: 积极捍卫法律判决、道义或传统 (law / tradition / justice)

groups.name: Make Destitute & Abandon · 致孤与遗弃 (Orphan, Abandon, Cast Off)
groups.tip: 夺走基本权益致其孤立无援

items.def_en: Leave someone isolated and helpless in an inaccessible place or friendless situation
items.ex_en: The sudden blizzard marooned several unsuspecting hikers in a remote mountain cabin for days.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的暴风雪将几名毫无防备的徒步者困在偏僻的山间小屋数日。

items.def_en: Leave someone to fend for themselves without guidance, family anchors, or social support
items.ex_en: Bereft of maternal guidance, the youth felt cast adrift upon a cold and indifferent world.
items.ex_zh: 失去母亲的引领后，少年感到自己漂泊无依，置身于冷漠的世界中。

items.def_en: Leave a child, vulnerable person, or pet behind without support or intent to return
items.ex_en: Heartless owners had abandoned the sickly puppy in a cardboard box behind the grocery store.
items.ex_zh: 狠心的主人把生病的小狗遗弃在杂货店后面的纸箱里。

items.def_en: Leave someone you have a moral or legal obligation to support, especially a spouse or child
items.ex_en: He chose to desert his wife and infant daughter to pursue a selfish dream abroad.
items.ex_zh: 他竟选择抛弃妻女，独自去国外追逐自私的梦想。

items.def_zh: 使成为孤儿；使丧失依靠
items.def_en: (usually passive) To cause a child to become an orphan by the death of their parents.
items.ex_en: The catastrophic earthquake orphaned hundreds of helpless young children in the mountain valley overnight.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的灾难性地震一夜之间让山谷里数百名无助的幼童沦为孤儿。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame capture the condition of rendering dependents solitary, vulnerable, or utterly without parental care or custodial protection through death, desertion, or callous severance.
groups.summary_zh: 指致使弱小者失去抚养监护人，陷入孤独无援的孤境。
groups.desc_en: Centers on intentionally cutting off all ties and leaving a vulnerable dependent stranded in absolute deprivation, differing from gradual alienation, temporary absence, or orderly parting.
groups.desc_zh: 指主动割断一切维系，将弱小无助者彻底遗弃在绝境或孤立无援之中，区别于渐进疏远、短暂离开或体面告别。
groups.nuance_en: maroon: leave strand-bound on an isolated island or desolate outpost (island / passengers / traveler) · cast adrift: detach and push out into precarious helplessness (boat / youth / refugees) · abandon: walk away permanently from a site, cause, or person (child / post / project) · desert: betray allegiance by fleeing a military post or family duty (army / family / post) · orphan: rob of primary parental protectors or institutional sponsors (children / project / community)
groups.nuance_zh: maroon: 将人放逐抛弃于孤岛或绝境 (island / passengers / traveler) · cast adrift: 使漂流无依，将其推向漂泊险境 (boat / youth / refugees) · abandon: 永久撒手不管抛下责任 (child / post / project) · desert: 擅离职守、开小差背弃盟誓或家庭 (army / family / post) · orphan: 使丧失父母或母体支持而沦为孤儿 (children / project / community)

groups.name: Make Metallic Tapping & Knocking · 金属敲击与爆震 (Pink, Ping, Patter)
groups.tip: 用硬物发出短促金属撞击声

items.def_en: To make a light, crisp, metallic or glass-like tapping sound
items.ex_en: A fallen acorn tinked softly against the dark slate tiles of the quiet courtyard.
items.ex_zh: 一颗落下的橡子轻轻碰击在寂静庭院的黑石板瓦上，发出一声脆响。

items.def_zh: （发动机）发生爆震；轻敲，发出叮当声；扎，刺
items.def_en: 1. (of an engine) To make a sharp metallic knocking sound due to improper combustion. 2. To pierce or prick lightly with a pointed weapon.
items.ex_en: The worn engine pinked loudly whenever the heavily laden truck accelerated up the incline.
items.ex_zh: 每当重载卡车加速爬坡时，磨损的发动机就会发出刺耳的爆震声。

items.def_zh: 发出清脆的砰砰/当当声；发出轻微金属撞击声
items.def_en: To make a short, high-pitched metallic ringing sound
items.ex_en: Loose pebbles pinged sharply against the metal hull of the speeding motorboat.
items.ex_zh: 飞溅的石子清脆地击打在飞驰的汽艇金属船体上。
items.ex2_en: The automated sonar transmitter pinged the submerged submarine at regular intervals.
items.ex2_zh: 自动化声呐发射器定期向潜入水下的潜艇发送探测脉冲信号。

items.def_en: To make or cause to make a light ringing sound of metal or glass hitting
items.ex_en: Guests clinked their crystal champagne glasses together to celebrate the couple's golden anniversary.
items.ex_zh: 宾客们碰响手中的水晶香槟杯，庆祝这对夫妇的金婚纪念。
items.ex2_en: Heavy ceramic mugs clinked together loudly as patrons celebrated at the wooden bar.
items.ex2_zh: 当顾客们在木质吧台前庆祝时，厚重的陶瓷杯清脆地碰响在一起。

items.def_en: To make a regular thumping or rattling noise due to faulty combustion
items.ex_en: Low-grade fuel caused the old sedan's engine to knock violently during acceleration.
items.ex_zh: 劣质燃油导致那辆旧轿车在加速时发动机剧烈爆震敲缸。

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies generating repetitive, light, sharp, metallic tapping sounds, typified by engine misfires (knocking/pinking) or small hard objects rapidly hitting metal/glass.
groups.summary_zh: 指发动机爆震异响或小硬物快速击打硬物表面发出的轻微尖脆金属敲击声。
groups.desc_en: Describes sharp, resonant, high-frequency percussive sounds produced by hard metallic collision or engine pre-ignition, distinguishing itself from deep wooden thuds or dull rumbles.
groups.desc_zh: 指金属硬物撞击或引擎爆震时产生的尖锐清脆、高频共鸣的回响，区别于沉闷的木质钝响或浑厚的轰鸣。
groups.nuance_en: tink: emit a minute, delicate crystalline ring (bell / glass / coin) · pink: produce a sharp mechanical pre-ignition detonation noise (engine / cylinder) · ping: emit a clear, sharp, high-pitched metallic or digital chime (sonar / engine / bullet) · clink: produce the light sharp collision of glasses or light metals (glasses / coins / bottles) · knock: sound a heavy dull repeated rap or engine pre-detonation (door / pipe / engine)
groups.nuance_zh: tink: 发出极其细小清脆的叮当微响 (bell / glass / coin) · pink: 特指发动机气缸爆震发出的嗒嗒脆响 (engine / cylinder) · ping: 产生清脆高亢的金属鸣音或声呐脉冲声 (sonar / engine / bullet) · clink: 玻璃杯或硬币相碰发出的碰杯脆响 (glasses / coins / bottles) · knock: 较重的敲击叩门声或严重引擎敲缸声 (door / pipe / engine)

groups.name: Make Up & Touch Up · 梳妆打扮与上妆 (Powder, Paint, Touch up)
groups.tip: 涂抹脂粉与精心修饰仪容

items.def_en: Improve the appearance of makeup or an area by making small additions or adjustments
items.ex_en: She spent a few minutes touching up her makeup before the live broadcast.
items.ex_zh: 在直播开始前，她花了几分钟补了补妆。

items.def_en: Apply fine cosmetic powder to the face or skin
items.ex_en: She carefully powdered her nose before stepping under the bright studio lights for the interview.
items.ex_zh: 在走向明亮的演播室灯光接受采访之前，她仔细地在鼻尖扑了粉。
items.ex2_en: Fine medicinal chalk powders easily when crushed beneath a heavy porcelain pestle.
items.ex2_zh: 细腻的药用白垩在沉重的瓷研钵捣碎下极易化成粉末。

items.def_en: (dated) To color the cheeks or lips with rouge.
items.ex_en: She rouged her pale cheeks delicately before descending to meet the eagerly waiting suitors.
items.ex_zh: 下楼会见热切等候的求婚者之前，她给苍白的面颊轻施胭脂。

items.def_zh: 梳妆打扮；把…打扮得漂漂亮亮
items.def_en: Dress someone or oneself attractively and apply makeup in an elaborate way
items.ex_en: They spent hours dolling themselves up for the extravagant rooftop gala across town.
items.ex_zh: 她们花了数小时精心梳妆打扮，准备去参加城另一边奢华的屋顶派对。

items.def_en: Apply makeup, color, or cosmetics heavily onto the face, lips, or nails
items.ex_en: The actress painted her lips a deep crimson before stepping in front of the cameras.
items.ex_zh: 女演员在走向镜头前将嘴唇涂抹上了浓艳的深红色。

groups.summary_en: Verbs concerning the cosmetic enhancement of the face and body through cosmetics like powder, paint, blush, or quick touch-ups to improve personal appearance.
groups.summary_zh: 指使用粉底、彩妆等化妆品涂抹面容或修饰仪表容貌。
groups.desc_en: Denotes applying cosmetics and pigments to enhance, embellish, or repair facial appearance, contrasting with basic clinical hygiene or natural bare grooming.
groups.desc_zh: 指在面容或表面涂抹脂粉彩妆以修饰、美化或补救瑕疵，区别于常规洗漱洁面或素颜打理。
groups.nuance_en: touch up: make minor corrective cosmetic or pictorial adjustments (makeup / roots / paintwork) · powder: dust fine cosmetic talc over skin to reduce shine (nose / face / skin) · rouge: tint the cheeks with reddish cosmetic blush (cheeks / lips) · doll up: dress and apply extensive cosmetics showily for a big event (oneself / daughter / model) · paint: apply heavy, artificial, or artistic coats of color (face / nails / portrait)
groups.nuance_zh: touch up: 局部补妆修容或修补微小瑕疵 (makeup / roots / paintwork) · powder: 扑粉以定妆或消除油光 (nose / face / skin) · rouge: 抹胭脂或腮红使面庞红润 (cheeks / lips) · doll up: 精心盛装打扮以极具视觉冲击 (oneself / daughter / model) · paint: 浓妆艳抹或厚涂彩漆 (face / nails / portrait)

groups.name: Malinger & Feign Illness · 装病避役与偷懒欺瞒 (Malinger, Feign, Sham)
groups.tip: 装病装弱以逃避工作职责

items.def_en: To avoid work, school, or duty by slacking, slipping away, or making false excuses
items.ex_en: The rebellious teenager chose to skive off school to hang around the shopping mall.
items.ex_zh: 那个叛逆的少年选择翘课逃学，在购物中心四处闲逛。

items.def_en: To falsely claim, simulate, or display an illness or condition
items.ex_en: The lazy private decided to sham an agonizing headache to avoid rigorous morning drill.
items.ex_zh: 那个懒散的二等兵决定装出剧烈头痛的样子，以逃避严苛的早操训练。

items.def_en: To invent pretexts or feign incapacity to shirk assignment and idle on duty
items.ex_en: Instead of clearing the warehouse inventory, lazy employees preferred to goldbrick in the lounge.
items.ex_zh: 那些懒惰的员工不仅不清点仓库库存，反而喜欢躲在休息室装病偷懒。

items.def_en: To simulate or pretend to be affected by an illness, feeling, or state
items.ex_en: The accused diplomat attempted to feign sudden illness to avoid facing intense parliamentary questioning.
items.ex_zh: 遭指控的外交官企图装出突发重病的样子，以规避议会严苛的质询。

items.def_zh: 装病（以逃避工作或职责）
items.def_en: To pretend to be ill or injured in order to avoid work, duty, or responsibility.
items.ex_en: The medical board determined that the soldier was merely malingering to escape frontline combat.
items.ex_zh: 医疗委员会认定那名士兵只是在装病，以逃避奔赴前线作战。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to dishonestly simulating illness, incapacity, or distress specifically to evade work, military duty, or unpleasant obligations. They highlight deliberate deception aimed at dodging responsibility.
groups.summary_zh: 指为逃避工作、责任或兵役而故意装病、假装伤残的欺瞒行为。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on pretending to be incapacitated, ill, or busy specifically to shirk mandatory duties or labor, distinct from genuinely falling sick, resting, or openly striking.
groups.desc_zh: 指借伪装患病、受伤或虚耗工时来恶意逃避法定兵役或劳动差事，区别于真实生病、正当休假或公开罢工。
groups.nuance_en: skive off: play truant or duck out of work casually (school / work / afternoon) · sham: put on a deceitful pretense of condition or emotion (illness / death / innocence) · goldbrick: shirk duty by doing unproductive busywork on the job (soldier / employee / shift) · feign: skillfully simulate a state or feeling (illness / surprise / death) · malinger: formally feign physical incapacity to evade military or work obligations (duties / army / draft)
groups.nuance_zh: skive off: 溜号翘课或无端旷工 (school / work / afternoon) · sham: 虚情假意地假装状态或弄虚作假 (illness / death / innocence) · goldbrick: 在岗磨洋工、装模作样摸鱼 (soldier / employee / shift) · feign: 逼真地佯作某种情感或生理状态 (illness / surprise / death) · malinger: 确凿地装病以逃避兵役或苦工 (duties / army / draft)

groups.name: Man & Crew · 配备人员 (Staff, Man, Outfit)
groups.tip: 为船舰或项目充实值守人手

items.def_en: To fill or furnish a place or administrative body with people
items.ex_en: The monarch sought to people the newly reclaimed frontier province with loyal immigrant families.
items.ex_zh: 君王试图将忠诚的移民家庭迁入新开垦的边境省份以充实人口。

items.def_en: To supply a place, vehicle, or piece of equipment with personnel to operate it
items.ex_en: Volunteers will man the emergency phone lines around the clock during the severe hurricane.
items.ex_zh: 在严峻的飓风侵袭期间，志愿者们将全天候值守紧急求助热线。

items.def_en: To provide the personnel needed to run an organization, department, or office
items.ex_en: The hospital hired forty certified nurses to fully staff the newly expanded neonatal wing.
items.ex_zh: 医院聘请了四十名持证护士，以便为新扩建的新生儿病区配齐工作人员。

items.def_zh: 为……配备船员（或机组人员）；充当船员（或工作人员）
items.def_en: 1. To provide a ship, aircraft, or vehicle with a crew. 2. To serve as a member of a crew.
items.ex_en: Experienced local sailors were recruited to crew the luxurious research vessel on its voyage.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的当地水手受聘充当这艘豪华科考船航行期间的船员。

items.def_en: To provide a team or expedition with necessary equipment, supplies, and staff
items.ex_en: The foundation will completely outfit the scientific expedition with advanced sensors and cold-weather gear.
items.ex_zh: 该基金会将为这支科学考察队全套配备先进传感器及防寒装备与人员。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame deal with supplying, allocating, or assigning human personnel and specialized labor to operate an organization, facility, or craft.
groups.summary_zh: 指为机构、设施或载具调配、配置必要的工作人员。
groups.desc_en: Relates to mobilizing and assigning qualified human personnel to operate vessels, stations, or organizations, distinct from mere mechanical automated fitting or casual hosting.
groups.desc_zh: 指为船舶、战位或企事业单位配备合格的人力乘员，区别于单纯的机器自动化改装或无责任闲散挂名。
groups.nuance_en: people: inhabit or populate a fictional or physical landscape (novel / world / land) · man: station human operators physically at controls or defensive posts (guns / desk / barricades) · staff: provide a full administrative or service workforce for an entity (office / hospital / booth) · crew: assemble and assign the operational team for an aircraft, boat, or shoot (yacht / ship / production) · outfit: supply equipment and personnel ensembles for an enterprise (expedition / team / vessel)
groups.nuance_zh: people: 使定居、使住满或在作品中塑造群像 (novel / world / land) · man: 派人进驻战位、机位或坚守岗位 (guns / desk / barricades) · staff: 为机构配置运转所需的全套行政人员 (office / hospital / booth) · crew: 为机组、船艇或拍摄组配备专业班底 (yacht / ship / production) · outfit: 为探险队全套筹备人手与装备 (expedition / team / vessel)

groups.name: Manner of Speaking (Vocal Cadence) · 言谈腔调与语速 (Mumble, Slur, Twang)
groups.tip: 慢吞吞拖长声调发音的说话方式

items.def_en: To speak in a low voice that is not clear and is difficult for other people to hear
items.ex_en: He mumbled an embarrassed apology into his collar without ever looking at the teacher.
items.ex_zh: 他缩着脖子含糊咕哝了一句尴尬的道歉，从始至终都没看老师一眼。

items.def_zh: 慢吞吞地说，拖长声调说
items.def_en: To speak slowly with vowel sounds drawn out longer than usual.
