items.ex_en: The tired sheriff drawled his words languidly under the oppressive heat of the afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 在午后闷热的天气下，疲惫的警长慢吞吞地拖长着腔调说话。

items.def_en: To speak with a sharp, resonant nasal quality or strong regional accent
items.ex_en: The rancher twanged out his instructions with an unmistakably sharp West Texas nasal accent.
items.ex_zh: 那位牧场主操着一口浓重而尖锐的西得克萨斯鼻音口音吩咐着指令。
items.ex2_en: The loose guitar string twanged loudly across the empty auditorium during rehearsal.
items.ex2_zh: 排练期间，松动的吉他弦在空荡的礼堂里发出一声响亮的金属嗡鸣。

items.def_en: To speak for a long time in a dull, monotonous, and unchanging tone
items.ex_en: The bored lecturer droned on endlessly about nineteenth-century tariff regulations until students slept.
items.ex_zh: 无趣的讲师单调低沉、没完没了地唠叨十九世纪的关税条例，直到学生们睡着。

items.def_en: To speak indistinctly without pronouncing sounds clearly, often due to tiredness or alcohol
items.ex_en: Overcome by heavy fatigue, the weary traveler slurred his words into an unintelligible whisper.
items.ex_zh: 极度疲惫之下，疲倦的旅人言语含糊不清，渐渐化为难以分辨的呢喃。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame characterize distinct acoustic manners, cadences, or impediments in vocal delivery, such as speaking draggingly, indistinctly, or with particular regional inflections.
groups.summary_zh: 指说话时独特的语速、发音拖沓度或含糊方式。
groups.desc_en: Covers specific idiosyncrasies of phonetic articulation, melodic tempo, and regional speech resonance, differing from semantic communicative meaning, rhetorical structure, or loudness.
groups.desc_zh: 特指咬字清晰度、发音腔调及语速节奏上的特定发声风格，区别于语义表达、修辞逻辑或单纯的音量高低。
groups.nuance_en: mumble: utter words indistinctly with a low, closed-mouth tone (apology / words / response) · drawl: speak with slow, lazy, lengthened vowel cadences (accent / voice / vowels) · twang: articulate with a harsh, sharp, nasal regional resonance (accent / guitar / voice) · drone: talk in an unvarying, sleep-inducing, monotonous continuum (voice / lecturer / speech) · slur: run sounds together indistinctly due to intoxication or fatigue (words / speech / syllables)
groups.nuance_zh: mumble: 闭嘴含糊不清地嘟囔 (apology / words / response) · drawl: 懒洋洋拉长元音慢吞吞说话 (accent / voice / vowels) · twang: 带着浓重鼻音或尖锐乡音吐字 (accent / guitar / voice) · drone: 单调乏味、催人入眠般嗡嗡说个不停 (voice / lecturer / speech) · slur: 因醉酒或中风导致字词粘连不清 (words / speech / syllables)

groups.name: Map, Survey & Plot · 地籍测绘与规划标绘 (Plat, Plot, Chart)
groups.tip: 画地界图或平面测绘图

items.def_en: To measure and examine the features of an area of land scientifically in order to prepare a map
items.ex_en: Government engineers must survey the entire mountainous valley before highway construction can safely begin.
items.ex_zh: 在公路建设安全动工之前，政府工程师必须对整个山谷进行科学测绘。

items.def_en: To mark points or trace lines representing positions, courses, or measurements on a map or chart
items.ex_en: The navigator carefully plotted the ship's coordinates on the nautical chart every single hour.
items.ex_zh: 领航员每小时都会在海图上仔细标绘出轮船的实时坐标。

items.def_en: To record or map the geographic features, coastline, or movement across an area on a chart
items.ex_en: Early cartographers charted the treacherous coastal reefs to protect merchant vessels from devastating shipwrecks.
items.ex_zh: 早期的制图师勘绘了危险的沿海暗礁，以保护商船免遭海难覆灭。

items.def_en: To produce a comprehensive map of a territory or outline a precise, detailed plan
items.ex_en: The committee met to map out a clear strategy for the next five years.
items.ex_zh: 委员会开会为接下来的五年详细制定了清晰的战略规划。

items.def_zh: 绘制（土地分界图、地籍图）
items.def_en: 1. (chiefly US / surveying) To draw a detailed map or plan of a piece of land divided into building lots.
items.ex_en: The municipal surveyor platted the riverfront acreage into twelve residential and commercial lots.
items.ex_zh: 市政测绘员将这片临河地块绘制成包含十二个住宅与商业用地的规划地籍图。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this technical surveying and cartographic frame involve measuring, delineating, and drafting precise plans, layouts, or boundaries of geographic land, parcels, or navigational courses according to mathematical or legal conventions.
groups.summary_zh: 指对土地、航线或疆界进行精密测绘、标绘并绘制地块图纸的行为。
groups.desc_en: Concerns geometrically measuring, charting, and delineating spatial boundaries or courses on maps and blueprints, distinct from general daydreaming, speculative imagining, or physical excavation.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过几何勘测、海图绘制及平面标定来界定地界或勾画航路，区别于随意的凭空遐想或实际的施工开掘。
groups.nuance_en: survey: measure terrain contours, boundaries, and public opinions scientifically (land / site / landscape) · plot: calculate and mark strategic coordinates or trajectories precisely (course / points / graph) · chart: systematically document and map navigational waters or trends (waters / path / progress) · map out: strategically plan a sequential route or career trajectory (future / route / strategy) · plat: draft an official legal cadastral map parceling plots of ground (land / subdivision / town)
groups.nuance_zh: survey: 测绘地形地貌或勘验宗地红线 (land / site / landscape) · plot: 在图表坐标上精确定点或标定航线 (course / points / graph) · chart: 绘制水文海图或跟踪趋势走向 (waters / path / progress) · map out: 周密规划路线、步骤或人生前程 (future / route / strategy) · plat: 绘制用于产权分割的法定地籍图 (land / subdivision / town)

groups.name: Mark & Record with Chalk · 用粉笔书写与记账 (Chalk, Slate, Chalk up)
groups.tip: 用粉笔或石膏在表面标记描摹

items.def_zh: 取得（成功、胜利）；将……归咎于
items.def_en: To achieve, record, or credit a success, score, or mistake to someone or something
items.ex_en: The spirited underdog squad managed to chalk up another surprising victory over reigning champions.
items.ex_zh: 这支充满斗志的黑马队伍成功记上了一场战胜卫冕冠军的惊人胜利。

items.def_en: To sketch or outline the details of a plan or project in a preliminary way
items.ex_en: The committee met yesterday to chalk out the preliminary agenda for next year's summit.
items.ex_zh: 委员会昨天开会草拟了明年峰会的初步议程框架。

items.def_en: To schedule, plan, or designate someone or something for a particular event or role
items.ex_en: The studio slated the ambitious sci-fi sequel for nationwide theatrical release next November.
items.ex_zh: 制片厂已安排这部宏大的科幻续集于明年十一月在全国院线上映。

items.def_en: To record, count, or calculate an ongoing score, amount, or points
items.ex_en: Independent election observers gathered overnight to tally the final batch of disputed mail-in ballots.
items.ex_zh: 独立选举观察员连夜聚集在一起，清点计算最后一批有争议的邮寄选票。
items.ex2_en: The suspect's contradictory statements simply do not tally with verified forensic evidence.
items.ex2_zh: 嫌疑人自相矛盾的陈述与经过核实的法医证据根本对不上号。

items.def_zh: 用粉笔写，用粉笔画；记录
items.def_en: 1. To write, mark, or draw something with chalk. 2. ('chalk up') To achieve or record a success, score, or debt.
items.ex_en: The professor chalked complex geometric equations across the long slate blackboard before turning around.
items.ex_zh: 教授转身前，在长长的石板黑板上用粉笔写下复杂的几何方程式。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to writing, sketching, or tallying points and debts using chalk or an erasable board, often extending metaphorically to recording achievements or scheduling events.
groups.summary_zh: 指用粉笔或写字板进行书写、标记、记账或记录成绩的动作。
groups.desc_en: Emphasizes drawing provisional outlines, recording tallies, or marking liabilities using powdery chalk or slate, contrasting with permanent carving, inking, or formal ledger software.
groups.desc_zh: 指利用白垩粉笔或石板进行临时性划线、计分或记账，区别于刀刻雕凿、墨水深印或正式数据库录入。
groups.nuance_en: chalk up: formally record an achievement, score, or debt (victory / success / loss) · chalk out: roughly sketch a preliminary layout or schematic outline (plan / design / scheme) · slate: formally schedule an event or target someone for criticism/candidacy (meeting / release / candidate) · tally: continuously score and match corresponding counts numerically (votes / points / score) · chalk: physically stroke or mark a surface with powdery chalk (cue / board / pavement)
groups.nuance_zh: chalk up: 记下一笔战功、比分或损失归因 (victory / success / loss) · chalk out: 粗略勾勒草拟出方案框架 (plan / design / scheme) · slate: 排定日程计划或提名候选人 (meeting / release / candidate) · tally: 逐笔核对计数并汇总点票 (votes / points / score) · chalk: 用粉笔涂抹球杆或在地面划线 (cue / board / pavement)

groups.name: Master & Dominate Skill · 精通与完全掌握 (Command, Excel at, Perfect)
groups.tip: 从理解领会到运用自如

items.def_en: To definitively understand, settle, or execute a complex technique or detail
items.ex_en: We need to nail down the exact budget before presenting the proposal to the board.
items.ex_zh: 在向董事会提交方案之前，我们需要敲定确切的预算。

items.def_en: To be exceptionally good or proficient at doing an activity
items.ex_en: Gifted students usually excel at analyzing intricate literary texts and synthesizing scholarly arguments.
items.ex_zh: 天赋出众的学生通常非常擅长剖析晦涩的文学文本并综合学术论点。

items.def_en: To learn or understand something thoroughly so that you can do it skillfully; to control or overcome an emotion or difficulty.
items.ex_en: The dedicated pianist spent decades practicing relentlessly to master the demanding classical concerto.
items.ex_zh: 这位专注的钢琴家花费数十年不知疲倦地练习，终于彻底精通了这部高难度的古典协奏曲。

items.def_zh: 精通，娴熟掌握（语言、技能等）
items.def_en: To have a full, fluent, and powerful working mastery of a subject or language
items.ex_en: The international diplomat can command five distinct languages with remarkable fluency and precision.
items.ex_zh: 这位国际外交官能够极其流利且精准地娴熟掌握五门截然不同的语言。

items.def_en: To hone a skill, technique, or craft until it leaves no room for improvement
items.ex_en: The skilled glassblower spent countless hours striving to perfect the delicate antique vase design.
items.ex_zh: 熟练的吹玻璃工花费无数小时精益求精，力求让这款精致的仿古花瓶设计臻于完美。

groups.summary_en: This frame spans the upper echelons of cognitive and practical competence, moving beyond mere understanding into effortless command, refined execution, and total expertise.
groups.summary_zh: 超越基础认知，达到对技艺或知识的彻底精通与自如掌控。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema of ascending a hierarchy of proficiency to achieve total control over an art or domain, contrasting with mere learning or practicing.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为在技艺层级上不断攀升直至达成终极控制与无碍调遣，区别于基础的'学习'或'练习'。
groups.nuance_en: excel at: surpass normal standards through talent or diligence (sports / mathematics) · master: gain complete intellectual or technical control (craft / language / technique) · command: wield authoritative, effortlessly deployed proficiency (respect / vocabulary / orchestra) · perfect: eliminate every flaw to attain an ideal state (technique / pitch / recipe) · nail down: definitively secure or execute with precision (routine / landing / contract)
groups.nuance_zh: excel at: 凭借天赋或勤学脱颖而出 (sports / mathematics) · master: 获得完全的认知或技术掌控 (craft / language / technique) · command: 具备权威自如的调遣能力 (respect / vocabulary / orchestra) · perfect: 剔除瑕疵达致理想完满 (technique / pitch / recipe) · nail down: 稳准落实或精准锁定 (routine / landing / contract)

groups.name: Mat & Felt · 粘结与结成硬团 (Felt, Clump, Clog)
groups.tip: 线缕毛发互相盘绕缠结成团

items.def_en: To mat together wool, hair, or fibers into a dense, compacted non-woven fabric
items.ex_en: Excessive moisture and repeated friction will felt the raw sheep wool into dense sheets.
items.ex_zh: 过多的水分和反复的摩擦会使未加工的羊毛板结毡化成厚实的织料。
items.ex2_en: Fine animal fibers felt quickly when washed repeatedly in hot, soapy tap water.
items.ex2_zh: 细动物纤维在热肥皂水中反复洗涤时会迅速毡结成一团。

items.def_en: To form into a compact, hard crust or solid mass, especially through drying or pressing
items.ex_en: Thick wet mud quickly caked onto his heavy leather work boots during the torrential rain.
items.ex_zh: 暴雨期间，厚重潮湿的泥浆迅速在厚皮工作靴上结成了一层硬壳。
items.ex2_en: Dry desert winds cake the dusty soil across the barren valley every summer.
items.ex2_zh: 每年夏天，干燥的沙漠之风都会使贫瘠山谷中覆满灰尘的土壤结成坚硬板结的厚壳。

items.def_en: 1. To tangle or twist together into a thick, messy, and compact mass.
items.ex_en: Neglected for weeks, the dog's thick coat had begun to mat into painful tangles.
items.ex_zh: 数周未经打理，这条狗厚厚的毛发已经开始缠结成令人疼痛的毛团。
items.ex2_en: Frequent turbulent currents constantly mat the long aquatic weeds into dense green balls.
items.ex2_zh: 频繁汹涌的水流不断将长长的水草缠结成密实的大绿球。

items.def_en: To become tied or twisted into a tight, hard, inextricable lump or mass
items.ex_en: The damp climbing ropes knotted tightly after tumbling around loose inside the canvas backpack.
items.ex_zh: 潮湿的登山绳在帆布背包里随意翻滚后，紧紧地揪结在了一起。
items.ex2_en: The mischievous puppy managed to knot the delicate yarn into an impossible tangle.
items.ex2_zh: 调皮的小狗把精细的毛线团打成了一个无法解开的乱结。

items.def_en: To gather or compress into a thick, compacted group, lump, or messy knot
items.ex_en: Wet snow began to clump heavily on the telephone wires throughout the winter storm.
items.ex_zh: 在整场冬季风暴中，湿雪开始在电话线上大团大团地积聚结块。
items.ex2_en: The automated farm machine clumps moist topsoil into uniform pellets for easy handling.
items.ex2_zh: 自动化农业机械将潮湿的表土挤压成均匀的小土块，以便于处理。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail fibrous, filamentous, or hairy strands becoming pressed, compacted, and tightly felted together into a dense, solid, unyielding mass.
groups.summary_zh: 强调纤维、毛发或毛线紧密缠结、压实硬化成密不可分的板结团块。
groups.desc_en: Physical schema of loose fibers, particles, or strands tangling, congealing, or compressing into an intractable solid mass, contrasting with orderly weaving or simple gathering.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为松散纤维、毛发或碎屑杂乱缠结、凝固或板结成块，区别于有序的'编织'或普通的'聚集'。
groups.nuance_en: mat: interweave uncontrollably into a dense flat tangle (hair / fur / grass) · felt: compress woolly fibers into a cohesive dense fabric (wool / fibers) · clump: coalesce into discrete lumpy clusters (soil / blood cells / powder) · cake: dry and harden into a crusty cohesive layer (mud / blood / powder) · knot: interlace tortuously into localized snarls (muscles / hair / rope)
groups.nuance_zh: mat: 杂乱纠缠压缩成毡状扁平乱团 (hair / fur / grass) · felt: 缩绒压合成致密厚重体 (wool / fibers) · clump: 凝聚结成离散的硬块或颗粒团 (soil / blood cells / powder) · cake: 干燥硬化结成硬壳层 (mud / blood / powder) · knot: 局部错综盘结成死结 (muscles / hair / rope)

groups.name: Match & Equal Benchmark · 达标与持平 (Par, Match, Equal)
groups.tip: 达到既定水准或预期目标

items.def_en: To be equal to another in quality, value, performance, or quantity
items.ex_en: His technical performance on the parallel bars could easily match the world champion's standard.
items.ex_zh: 他在双杠上的技术表现足以媲美世界冠军的高水准。

items.def_en: To achieve exactly the same level, score, or standard as another or as a benchmark
items.ex_en: The young sprinter hoped to equal the Olympic record during the national championship finals.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻的短跑选手希望在全国锦标赛决赛中追平奥运会纪录。

items.def_en: (+ to) To reach the required, expected, or satisfactory standard
items.ex_en: The candidate simply did not measure up to the board's high expectations.
items.ex_zh: 这位候选人根本没有达到董事会的高期望。

items.def_en: To bring oneself or something to an equal score or status with a competitor
items.ex_en: I'll level with you: your chances of getting promoted this year are slim.
items.ex_zh: 我跟你说实话吧：你今年升职的希望很渺茫。

items.def_en: (in golf) To score the standard number of strokes on a hole.
items.ex_en: The veteran golfer managed to par the treacherous final hole under intense tournament pressure.
items.ex_zh: 这位老练的高尔夫球手在激烈的巡回赛压力下，以标准杆顺利完成了凶险的最后一洞。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on achieving a predetermined baseline, standard, or rival benchmark, whether matching a par score in golf or meeting an expected performance threshold in finance and skill.
groups.summary_zh: 指达到预设基准、标准，或在成绩、表现上与既定目标持平。
groups.desc_en: Schema of aligning with an established external standard, baseline, or competitor to achieve parity, contrasting with surpassing or lagging behind.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为在水平、数量或标准上与既定基准或对手齐平，区别于'超越'或'落后'。
groups.nuance_en: match: prove equal in quality, strength, or measure (wits / offer / skills) · equal: achieve identical quantitative or qualitative parity (record / score / output) · measure up: meet subjective expectations or qualification standards (expectations / standards / criteria) · level with: bring into an even or equal state with another (competitor / benchmark) · par: achieve the expected normative baseline score or standard (hole / benchmark)
groups.nuance_zh: match: 在素质或力度上与对手相当相配 (wits / offer / skills) · equal: 在数值或程度上达到完全同一 (record / score / output) · measure up: 经受检验并符合主观预期或资格 (expectations / standards / criteria) · level with: 使平齐或达到对等水平 (competitor / benchmark) · par: 达到预设的基准线或标准杆 (hole / benchmark)

groups.name: Match & Fit · 契合与对应 (Correspond, Mirror, Align)
groups.tip: 平行对比或遥相呼应

items.def_en: (+ to/with) To match, be similar to, or have a direct equivalent in another system
items.ex_en: The newly discovered ancient symbols correspond closely with dialect patterns recorded in earlier manuscripts.
items.ex_zh: 新发现的古老符号与早期手稿中所记载的方言模式高度相符。

items.def_en: (+ with) To agree with, match, or correspond correctly to a standard or counterpart
items.ex_en: Our current corporate strategy must align perfectly with updated environmental sustainability regulations.
items.ex_zh: 我们当前的企业战略必须与最新的环境可持续发展法规保持完全一致。
items.ex2_en: The meticulous surveyor aligned the measurement markers with the distant boundary posts.
items.ex2_zh: 严谨的测量员将测量标记与远处的边界柱对齐成一条直线。

items.def_en: To reflect, simulate, or closely duplicate the features or behaviour of something else
items.ex_en: The child's sudden erratic behavior seemed to mirror the stressful home environment completely.
items.ex_zh: 孩子突发的反常行为似乎完全映射出了充满压力的家庭环境。

items.def_en: 1. To be similar to, correspond with, or equal something. 2. To run or extend in the same direction alongside something.
items.ex_en: The economic trajectory of this developing nation closely parallels historical trends seen across post-war Europe.
items.ex_zh: 该发展中国家的经济轨迹与二战后欧洲所展现的历史趋势高度相似。

items.def_en: (+ with) To fit together smoothly, precisely, and harmoniously like interlocking joints
items.ex_en: Her innovative research proposals dovetail perfectly with the primary objectives of our departmental grant.
items.ex_zh: 她极具创新性的研究方案与我们系专项拨款的主要资助目标严密契合。
items.ex2_en: The project architect dovetailed the new modern wing with the historic stone museum.
items.ex2_zh: 项目建筑师使新建的现代侧翼建筑与历史悠久的石头博物馆完美衔接。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here highlight structural analogy, directional concurrence, or harmonious mirroring between distinct sets, systems, or historical trajectories.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重于事物在结构、形态、走势或特性上的对应、映射与高度呼应。
groups.desc_en: Schema of structural, logical, or geometric congruence between two independent entities, contrasting with casual similarity or forced uniformity.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为两个独立实体在结构、逻辑或几何形态上自然对应与咬合，区别于随机的'相似'或强行的'统一'。
groups.nuance_en: correspond: show formal or functional symmetry across contexts (descriptions / data / facts) · align: bring into directional, structural, or ideological agreement (incentives / values / interests) · mirror: reflect exact features or behavior in another medium (sentiments / movements / trends) · parallel: run alongside in similar development or pattern (career / trajectory / history) · dovetail: fit together smoothly and seamlessly like interlocking joints (plans / schedules / theories)
groups.nuance_zh: correspond: 在形式或功能上相符相称 (descriptions / data / facts) · align: 调整方向以与目标或理念契合对齐 (incentives / values / interests) · mirror: 如镜面般原样投射映照 (sentiments / movements / trends) · parallel: 在发展轨迹上并驾齐驱 (career / trajectory / history) · dovetail: 如榫卯般丝丝入扣完美嵌合 (plans / schedules / theories)

groups.name: Match & Fit · 相当与匹敌 (Match, Rival, Tie)
groups.tip: 程度相当或完全相等

items.def_en: (+ to) To be good enough or possess the qualities required to match an expected benchmark
items.ex_en: The candidate simply did not measure up to the board's high expectations.
items.ex_zh: 这位候选人根本没有达到董事会的高期望。

items.def_en: To be equal to something else in quality, value, size, or strength
items.ex_en: No modern synthetic fiber can quite match natural down for lightweight insulation in freezing weather.
items.ex_zh: 在严寒天气下，没有任何现代合成纤维能在轻盈保暖性上匹敌天然羽绒。

items.def_en: (+ with) To achieve the exact same score or position as a competitor
items.ex_en: The visiting soccer team managed to tie with the hosts in a thrilling finish.
items.ex_zh: 客场作战的足球队在惊心动魄的收尾阶段成功与东道主战成平局。
items.ex2_en: The sailor tied the thick mooring ropes securely to the heavy iron dock.
items.ex2_zh: 水手把粗大的系泊绳牢牢地系在沉重的铁质码头桩上。

items.def_zh: 等于，相等；比得上，敌得过
items.def_en: 1. To be the same in quantity, size, number, value, or status as something else. 2. To match or be as good as someone or something else.
items.ex_en: Few modern historical novels can equal the emotional depth of Tolstoy's magnificent masterpieces.
items.ex_zh: 很少有现代历史小说能比得上托尔斯泰鸿篇巨制的情感深度。

items.def_en: To be comparable or almost identical in outstanding excellence or power
items.ex_en: The opulent imperial palace features elaborate architectural craftsmanship that few modern buildings can rival.
items.ex_zh: 这座富丽堂皇的皇家宫殿展现了精妙绝伦的建筑工艺，极少有现代建筑能与之媲美。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on equivalence in capability, quantity, or merit, indicating that one party measures up to another across a measurable dimension.
groups.summary_zh: 表明在数量、价值、水平或地位上与另一方旗鼓相当、达到均等。
groups.desc_en: Schema of competitive tension where an entity displays enough strength, prowess, or quality to challenge or neutralize another, contrasting with decisive defeat or yielding.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为竞争对抗中展现出足以分庭抗礼或抵消优势的力量，区别于绝对的'击溃'或'臣服'。
groups.nuance_en: equal: share the exact rank or capability without superiority (record / competitor / achievement) · match: withstand another's challenge on even terms (skills / strength / pace) · rival: possess qualities nearly matching or threatening the supremacy of another (master / grandeur / power) · tie: achieve an identical outcome in formal competition (opponent / score / record) · measure up: satisfy the rigorous competitive standard demanded (competition / rival / test)
groups.nuance_zh: equal: 达到同等水准且不分伯仲 (record / competitor / achievement) · match: 在力量或速度上顶住挑战 (skills / strength / pace) · rival: 逼近对手实力并对其霸权构成威胁 (master / grandeur / power) · tie: 在正式赛局中打成平手 (opponent / score / record) · measure up: 扛住严格的竞争检验而不逊色 (competition / rival / test)

groups.name: Matriculate & Enroll · 录取与注册入学 (Matriculate, Enroll, Register)
groups.tip: 正式录取入学或吸纳加入

items.def_en: To allow someone to enter an institution, especially a university or college, as a student
items.ex_en: The prestigious university decided to admit only five percent of all overseas applicants this term.
items.ex_zh: 这所著名学府决定本学期仅录取所有海外申请者中的百分之五。

items.def_en: To record a person's name on an official institutional list to attend classes or a course of study
items.ex_en: Prospective students must officially register for advanced lecture courses before the formal academic semester begins.
items.ex_zh: 未来的学生必须在正规学期开始前正式登记注册高阶讲座课程。

items.def_en: To commit formally to a structured course of training or study
items.ex_en: The prominent scientist agreed to sign on as an advisor to the renewable energy startup.
items.ex_zh: 这位知名科学家同意签约担任该新能源初创企业的顾问。

items.def_en: To officially register or be registered as a member or student of a school, course, or program
items.ex_en: Over two hundred curious working adults chose to enroll in the weekend pottery course.
items.ex_zh: 两百多名抱有好奇心的职场人士选择报名参加周末陶艺课程。
items.ex2_en: The university registrar enrolled hundreds of promising candidates into the newly established honors program.
items.ex2_zh: 大学教务主管将数百名优秀的候选学生招收进了新建的荣誉项目中。

items.def_en: (formal) To officially admit or be admitted as a student into a college or university.
items.ex_en: Scholars from across the continent gathered proudly to matriculate at Oxford University that autumn.
items.ex_zh: 那年秋天，来自大陆各地的学者骄傲地齐聚牛津大学参加入学注册。
items.ex2_en: The prestigious academy matriculates outstanding international applicants into its medical program every September.
items.ex2_zh: 这所著名的学府每年九月都会录取杰出的国际申请者进入其医学项目。

groups.summary_en: Designates official academic and institutional accession, whereby an applicant is accepted, admitted, and recorded into formal registers at schools, colleges, or credentialed programs.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过审核正式被学术机构录取、缴费登记或办理学籍注册手续。
groups.desc_en: Institutional passage schema of officially recording, accepting, and initiating a person into a formal body or academic roster, contrasting with informal joining or passive admission.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为个人被正式接纳、认证并列入学术或官方名册的制度性仪式，区别于随意的'加入'或单纯的'允许进入'。
groups.nuance_en: admit: grant formal entry or license based on qualification (students / immigrants / patients) · register: record names onto an official public or operational list (voters / courses / guests) · enroll: put down one's name to formally join an ongoing institution or cohort (school / program / clinical trial) · matriculate: formally enter a university or college as a degree-seeking candidate (university / college / freshman) · sign on: commit oneself formally by contract or agreement (crew / contract / initiative)
groups.nuance_zh: admit: 基于资格审查正式准予准入 (students / immigrants / patients) · register: 在公共或机构系统完成名册登记 (voters / courses / guests) · enroll: 办理手续正式加入班级或项目 (school / program / clinical trial) · matriculate: 举行仪式或正式注册大学学籍 (university / college / freshman) · sign on: 签署合约或明确表态加入 (crew / contract / initiative)

groups.name: Matter & Count · 关乎与重要 (Matter, Count, Signify)
groups.tip: 具备分量与重要性

items.def_en: To be important, significant, or of consequence.
items.ex_en: Your sincere personal integrity and work ethic matter far more than mere social connections.
items.ex_zh: 你真挚的人格品质与职业道德远比单纯的人脉关系要重要得多。

items.def_en: (+ in) To be an important part of an ongoing process, plan, or calculation
items.ex_en: Unforeseen supply chain shortages will definitely figure in the final cost estimations for construction.
items.ex_zh: 不可预见的供应链短缺必然会在工程建设的最终成本核算中占据重要地位。

items.def_en: To have importance, value, or influence on a situation
items.ex_en: In a close election, every single vote will count toward the final result.
items.ex_zh: 在势均力敌的选举中，每一张选票都对最终结果起着关键作用。

items.def_en: To exert powerful influence, authority, or credibility in decision-making
items.ex_en: Her extensive background in clinical research carries considerable weight with the advisory board.
items.ex_zh: 她在临床研究方面的丰富背景在咨询委员会中极具分量。

items.def_en: To have great importance or significance, especially regarding an outcome
items.ex_en: Minor administrative errors rarely signify in the broader scope of this judicial inquiry.
items.ex_zh: 在这场司法调查的宏观层面，微小的行政疏漏通常无足轻重。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses stative verbs expressing significance, consequence, and meaningful weight within a given context. They denote whether something truly affects the outcome, is valued, or holds importance.
groups.summary_zh: 指事物具备分量、具有决定性意义或对全局产生不可忽视的实质影响。
groups.desc_en: Cognitive schema of possessing inherent relevance, gravity, or functional consequence within an evaluation system, contrasting with triviality or inert existence.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为在价值判断或因果链条中具备实在的份量与后果，区别于无足轻重或静态的'存在'。
groups.nuance_en: matter: carry essential personal, emotional, or practical consequence (details / opinion / truth) · count: possess recognized validity, value, or inclusion in calculation (votes / experience / contributions) · carry weight: exert substantial influence or authority in decisions (words / testimony / endorsement) · signify: denote substantial meaning or portend important effects (change / intention / breakthrough) · figure: play a prominent or active role in events (prominently / largely / historically)
groups.nuance_zh: matter: 关乎根本利害或情感后果 (details / opinion / truth) · count: 算数且被计入有效价值体系 (votes / experience / contributions) · carry weight: 在决断中拥有举足轻重的份量 (words / testimony / endorsement) · signify: 昭示深远意义或前兆 (change / intention / breakthrough) · figure: 在局势或历史中扮演重要角色 (prominently / largely / historically)

groups.name: Measure Dimensions & Tolerance · 精密测径与规测 (Gauge, Micrometer, Metrize)
groups.tip: 借助仪器度量判定规格

items.def_en: To determine the exact physical dimensions of an object or sort items according to size specifications
items.ex_en: The quality inspector carefully sized the metal bearings before packaging them for delivery.
items.ex_zh: 质检员在将金属轴承打包发货前，仔细测定了它们的尺寸规格。

items.def_en: To measure minute linear distances, thicknesses, or diameters using a micrometer screw gauge
items.ex_en: The meticulous artisan micrometers each golden filament to verify its gossamer precision.
items.ex_zh: 这位严谨的工匠用千分尺细细测量每一根金丝，以核验其纤薄的精度。

items.def_en: To take full, detailed physical measurements of an object, room, or workpiece
items.ex_en: The candidate simply did not measure up to the board's high expectations.
items.ex_zh: 这位候选人根本没有达到董事会的高期望。

items.def_zh: 用量规测定；精密测量（尺寸、间隙）
items.def_en: To measure the exact size, diameter, thickness, or capacity of an object using an instrument
items.ex_en: Mechanics use a specialized tool to gauge the clearance between the engine valves.
items.ex_zh: 机械师使用专用工具来精密测量发动机气门之间的间隙。

items.def_en: to measure the thickness or diameter of something using calipers
items.ex_en: The watchmaker calipers each minute brass cog to ensure seamless mechanical movement.
items.ex_zh: 钟表匠用测径规精心度量每一个微小的黄铜齿轮，以确保发条运转流畅。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to utilizing specialized engineering or precision contact instruments to determine physical dimensions such as thickness, bore, or diameter.
groups.summary_zh: 使用量规、分厘卡等精细工量具测定工件的厚度、口径或公差。
groups.desc_en: Technical schema of applying precise instruments to determine geometric boundaries, diameters, or tolerances against rigid standards, contrasting with casual estimating or rough surveying.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为利用精密量具测定物体的几何界限、厚度与公差，区别于粗略的'估算'或广义的'丈量'。
groups.nuance_en: gauge: measure dimensions, thickness, or internal capacity against a calibrated benchmark (thickness / pressure / depth) · caliper: measure precise external or internal diameters using a dual-jawed tool (bore / wall / diameter) · micrometer: execute ultra-precise sub-millimeter thickness or diameter measurements (wire / spindle / tolerance) · size: sort or cut to prescribed physical dimensions (timber / garments / particles) · measure up: inspect and verify actual dimensions against engineering specifications (cut / component / timber)
groups.nuance_zh: gauge: 对照校准基准测定厚度、压力或规格 (thickness / pressure / depth) · caliper: 使用游标卡尺测定内外径厚度 (bore / wall / diameter) · micrometer: 使用螺旋测微器进行微米级极度精确测径 (wire / spindle / tolerance) · size: 依指定几何尺寸分选或裁切 (timber / garments / particles) · measure up: 查验实际尺寸是否符合工程标准 (cut / component / timber)

groups.name: Mechanical Leverage & Shifting · 杠杆搬移与撬动 (Lever, Heave, Winkle)
groups.tip: 利用杠杆原理撬开或移动重物

items.def_zh: 挪动，撬动分毫（多用于否定）
items.def_en: Move even slightly under heavy pressure or effort (usually negative)
items.ex_en: Despite our combined strength, the rusty iron gate refused to budge an inch.
items.ex_zh: 尽管我们合力推扯，那扇生锈的铁门依然纹丝未动。
items.ex2_en: Three burly rescue workers finally budged the heavy boulder blocking the cave entrance.
items.ex2_zh: 三名魁梧的救援人员终于挪动了堵住洞口的那块沉重巨石。

items.def_en: Pry or extract something stuck fast in an awkward or recessed space
items.ex_en: He managed to winkle out the tiny screw jammed inside the printer mechanism.
items.ex_zh: 他设法将卡在打印机机械装置内部的微小螺丝费劲剔了出来。

items.def_en: To lift, move, or force something open using a lever or lever-like action.
items.ex_en: The rescue workers carefully levered the concrete slab away from the trapped survivor.
items.ex_zh: 救援人员小心地用杠杆将水泥板撬开，救出被困的幸存者。

items.def_en: Force, lever, or wedge something heavy using a metal crowbar
items.ex_en: We had to crowbar the jammed shipping crate open to retrieve the supplies.
items.ex_zh: 我们不得不找来撬棍硬把卡住的板条箱撬开，以取出物资。

items.def_en: Lift, pull, or throw a heavy load with immense physical exertion
items.ex_en: Three dockworkers heaved the massive wooden crate onto the back of the truck.
items.ex_zh: 三名码头工人合力将沉重的木箱费力搬移到了卡车后斗上。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on the physical exertion and use of leverage mechanisms (bars, fulcrums, mechanical advantage) to heave, dislodge, or move heavy, stubborn items.
groups.summary_zh: 强调运用杠杆原理、工具或极大臂力来撬离、挪动沉重或固定的物体。
groups.desc_en: Physical schema of applying mechanical advantage through a rigid pivot or pry-tool to dislodge recalcitrant mass, contrasting with direct muscular pulling or pushing.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为借助支点与刚性杠杆施加机械力以移动顽固重物，区别于徒手的直接'推拉'。
groups.nuance_en: lever: displace or pry upwards by employing a fulcrum and rigid bar (rock / lid / floorboard) · crowbar: forcibly pry open or shift using a heavy iron bar (door / crates / masonry) · budge: make the slightest initial movement in a resistant mass (boulder / rusty bolt / opinion) · heave: lift, haul, or throw a ponderous mass with intense concerted strain (boulder / anchor / cargo) · winkle out: extract something tenaciously embedded or concealed through persistent prying (secret / enemy / bolt)
groups.nuance_zh: lever: 依托支点以杠杆原理撬起或移动 (rock / lid / floorboard) · crowbar: 用重型撬棍强力撬开或拆除 (door / crates / masonry) · budge: 使顽固受阻之物产生一丝挪动 (boulder / rusty bolt / opinion) · heave: 倾注全身巨力搬动抛掷沉重负荷 (boulder / anchor / cargo) · winkle out: 耐心挑拨撬出深陷隐匿之物 (secret / enemy / bolt)

groups.name: Mechanical Press & Typography · 印刷与上版 (Typeset, Stamp, Run off)
groups.tip: 油墨排版印刷复制图文

items.def_zh: 印刷；打印；用印刷体书写；铭刻
items.def_en: 1. To produce books, newspapers, or documents using ink and a printing press or printer. 2. To write words without joining the letters together.
items.ex_en: The local publishing house plans to print five thousand copies of the novel.
items.ex_zh: 当地出版社计划将这部小说印刷五千册。

items.def_en: (+ on/with) To imprint a character, mark, or seal onto an item by forceful pressing
items.ex_en: The customs official stamped the passport with the official seal of entry approval.
items.ex_zh: 海关官员在护照上盖下了批准入境的官方印章。

items.def_zh: 印出，快速印刷（大量复本）
items.def_en: To quickly print or duplicate a specific batch of leaflets, proofs, or documents
items.ex_en: Can you run off twenty copies of the agenda before the morning meeting?
items.ex_zh: 你能在早会开始前赶印出二十份议程单吗？

items.def_en: (+ on/with) To stamp or press a mark, pattern, or text deeply onto a surface
items.ex_en: The artisan used a heavy wooden mallet to imprint the emblem onto leather.
items.ex_zh: 工匠用沉重的木槌将徽标深深压印在皮革表面上。

items.def_en: To arrange text and typography in preparation for printing
items.ex_en: She spent the entire afternoon typesetting the poetry manuscript for the independent press.
items.ex_zh: 她花了一整个下午为独立出版社排版这部诗集手稿。

groups.summary_en: Centers on the physical and mechanical act of transferring text, ink, or patterns onto paper or substrate using presses, plates, or printers. Typical collocates include newspaper, press, ink, page, and proof.
groups.summary_zh: 强调通过机器、印版或墨水将文字图形物理印刷在纸张上。
groups.desc_en: Mechanical production schema of transferring inked designs, movable type, or relief molds onto surfaces to yield physical text, contrasting with freehand writing or digital displaying.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为通过压力将字模、印版或墨水转移固化于纸质介质之上，区别于手写或数字显示。
groups.nuance_en: typeset: arrange individual movable characters or digital fonts into compositional pages (manuscript / galley / text) · print: produce ink-on-paper impression mechanically on a press (edition / pamphlet / currency) · stamp: impress a distinct mark, date, or relief onto a surface by striking (passport / coin / envelope) · imprint: press a pattern or mark firmly into a receptive surface (design / seal / memory) · run off: reproduce multiple printed copies rapidly on a mechanical device (copies / flyers / proofs)
groups.nuance_zh: typeset: 排布活字或字体完成版面组版 (manuscript / galley / text) · print: 在印刷机上涂墨加压批量成形 (edition / pamphlet / currency) · stamp: 击打冲压出清晰戳记或图案 (passport / coin / envelope) · imprint: 压印深陷的图记或纹样 (design / seal / memory) · run off: 利用机器迅速冲印转印出大量副本 (copies / flyers / proofs)

groups.name: Meddle & Tamper · 乱动与瞎插手 (Tamper, Meddle, Tinker, Mess with)
groups.tip: 暗中乱动或不当乱碰

items.def_en: To touch, tamper with, or meddle with something inappropriately, risking damage or trouble
items.ex_en: Don't mess with the circuit breaker unless you know what you are doing.
items.ex_zh: 除非你懂行，否则千万别瞎捣鼓那个断路器。

items.def_en: To handle or fool around with a delicate device or system heedlessly and without proper knowledge
items.ex_en: Stop monkeying with the thermostat, or you will end up breaking the system.
items.ex_zh: 别再乱调温控器了，否则你早晚会把整个系统弄坏。

items.def_zh: 暗中乱动，胡乱摆弄；篡改
items.def_en: (also 'tamper with') To touch, alter, or interfere with something secretly and without permission, often causing damage.
items.ex_en: Investigators discovered that someone had tampered with the laboratory's security recordings overnight.
items.ex_zh: 调查人员发现，有人在夜间暗中篡改了实验室的安防监控录像。

items.def_en: (+ with) To make small, experimental, or amateurish changes to a machine, plan, or system
items.ex_en: Dad likes to tinker with vintage radios in his workshop on Sunday afternoons.
items.ex_zh: 爸爸喜欢在周日下午躲进车间里摆弄、修补那些老式收音机。

items.def_en: (+ in/with) To interfere in or pry into matters that are not one's concern or business
items.ex_en: I wish my nosy relatives would stop meddling in my personal financial affairs.
items.ex_zh: 真希望那些爱管闲事的亲戚别再对我的个人财务状况指手画脚了。

items.def_en: to make unauthorized changes to something, especially so as to damage or improperly alter it
items.ex_en: Someone attempted to tamper with the electrical box behind the warehouse yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 昨天有人企图擅自改动仓库后面的配电箱。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers unauthorized, unwanted, or inexpert physical and figurative interference. Agents disturb a delicate mechanism, system, or another person's private affairs without permission, often causing accidental damage or unwarranted friction.
groups.summary_zh: 指未经许可或盲目胡乱干预、触碰或调整系统、机械及他人私事。
groups.desc_en: Disruptive schema of intruding into or casually manipulating another's system, process, or mechanism without authorization and risking harm, contrasting with professional repairing.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为未经授权擅自干预、摆弄或破坏既有机制与他人事务，区别于专业的'检修'或正当的'介入'。
groups.nuance_en: meddle: intrude officiously into affairs that do not concern one (affairs / election / life) · tamper: improperly alter, sabotage, or corrupt a physical device or evidence (evidence / lock / brakes) · tinker: make amateurish, experimental, or unguided mechanical adjustments (engine / clock / gadget) · mess with: carelessly alter, provoke, or disturb something delicate or hazardous (settings / wiring / head) · monkey with: casually and awkwardly fiddle with mechanisms out of curiosity (controls / thermostat / lock)
groups.nuance_zh: meddle: 专横干涉与己无关的他人家事或事务 (affairs / election / life) · tamper: 非法改动破坏设备、证据或安全锁 (evidence / lock / brakes) · tinker: 业余式地随意小修小改机械 (engine / clock / gadget) · mess with: 漫不经心地瞎动易损危险设备或招惹他人 (settings / wiring / head) · monkey with: 出于好奇笨手笨脚地乱动控制钮 (controls / thermostat / lock)

groups.name: Mediate & Diplomatic Reconciliation · 穿梭斡旋与促成和解 (Reconcile, Mediate, Intercede)
groups.tip: 重修旧好恢复社会关系和谐

items.def_en: (+ with) To bring hostilities to an end and re-establish a condition of friendly relations.
items.ex_en: The two feuding neighbors finally decided to make peace after years of litigation.
items.ex_zh: 争吵多年的两位邻居在经历数年诉讼后，最终决定言归于好。

items.def_en: To act as an impartial intermediary between disputing groups to help them reach an agreement.
items.ex_en: The diplomat was chosen to mediate between the opposing factions in the conflict.
items.ex_zh: 这位外交官被推选在冲突的敌对派系之间进行居中调停。

items.def_zh: 使和解，使重归于好；使一致，调和；使顺从
items.def_en: 1. To restore friendly relations between people or groups who have disagreed. 2. To find a way in which two conflicting ideas, beliefs, or facts can both exist together.
items.ex_en: The therapist helped the estranged brothers reconcile after a decade of complete silence.
items.ex_zh: 心理咨询师帮助这对疏远了十年的兄弟打破沉默，重归于好。

items.def_en: To bring divergent viewpoints, interests, or principles into peaceful and consistent agreement.
items.ex_en: Delegates worked tirelessly to harmonize differing regional policies into a single coherent trade treaty.
items.ex_zh: 代表们夜以继日地工作，旨在协调各方分歧政策，达成一致的贸易条约。
items.ex2_en: Their vocal tones harmonize beautifully whenever they sing together in the cathedral choir.
items.ex2_zh: 每当他们在大教堂唱诗班共同歌唱时，彼此的嗓音总是优美地交融在一起。

items.def_en: (+ with/for) To intervene on behalf of another party to plead for mercy, relief, or a favorable compromise.
items.ex_en: The defense attorney interceded with the judge on behalf of the remorseful defendant.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师代向法官求情，为痛改前非的被告人争取从宽处理。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to stepping in between alienated or warring sides to bridge differences, align opposing viewpoints, and restore amicable diplomatic, marital, or social relations.
groups.summary_zh: 指居间斡旋、弥合隔阂，使对立双方重修旧好或使矛盾观念达成一致。
groups.desc_en: Diplomatic schema of a neutral agent stepping between antagonistic parties to defuse hostility and forge structural concord, contrasting with partisan fighting or unilateral dictation.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为中立第三方介入对立阵营之间化解敌意、促成利益重构与和平，区别于单方面的'强加'或直接'参战'。
groups.nuance_en: mediate: negotiate actively between disputants to broker a structured treaty or accord (dispute / truce / settlement) · reconcile: restore harmony, trust, or ideological coherence between estranged parties (factions / spouses / accounts) · intercede: plead or intervene passionately on behalf of another party facing penalty (pardon / mercy / prisoner) · make peace: formally terminate hostilities and restore calm relations (enemies / factions / rivals) · harmonize: adjust disparate or clashing elements into pleasing, orderly coexistence (interests / rules / views)
groups.nuance_zh: mediate: 作为中间人促成双方停火或契约达成 (dispute / truce / settlement) · reconcile: 弥合裂痕使交恶者重修旧好 (factions / spouses / accounts) · intercede: 为受困弱势方代为求情申辩 (pardon / mercy / prisoner) · make peace: 彻底终止武装敌对恢复和平 (enemies / factions / rivals) · harmonize: 调和冲突利益使规则彼此相容 (interests / rules / views)

groups.name: Medical Burning & Tissue Ablation · 灼烙与消融 (Cauterize, Sear, Lance)
groups.tip: 用烙铁烧烙止血治愈伤口

items.def_en: To remove unwanted skin growths or blemishes using acid, cryotherapy, or targeted heat
items.ex_en: The dermatologist decided to burn off the small planter wart using liquid nitrogen.
items.ex_zh: 皮肤科医生决定用液氮冷冻灼除那个小足底疣。
items.ex2_en: Excess surface moisture burns off rapidly as morning sunlight beats down upon the grass.
items.ex2_zh: 随着清晨的阳光洒落在草地上，地表多余的水分很快便蒸发消散了。

items.def_zh: 用柳叶刀刺破，切开（脓肿）
items.def_en: To cut open a boil, abscess, or infected swelling with a surgical instrument to release fluid
items.ex_en: The emergency surgeon prepared to lance the infected abscess to relieve the pressure.
items.ex_zh: 急诊外科医生准备切开感染的脓肿，以排出积液并缓解压力。

items.def_en: To burn or scorch skin or a wound with extreme heat to arrest bleeding or destroy tissue
items.ex_en: The frontier medic seared the deep battlefield wound to quickly halt the arterial bleeding.
items.ex_zh: 战地医护人员用高温灼烙那道深裂的伤口，以迅速止住动脉大出血。

items.def_zh: 烧灼，烙（伤口以止血或防感染）
items.def_en: 1. (medicine) To burn a wound or tissue with a heated instrument or chemical to stop bleeding or prevent infection.
items.ex_en: The surgeon used silver nitrate to cauterize the persistent nasal bleeding site completely.
items.ex_zh: 外科医生使用硝酸银烧灼了顽固性鼻出血点以彻底止血。

items.def_en: To remove or destroy body tissue surgically, typically using lasers, heat, or radiofrequency
items.ex_en: The specialist utilized laser energy to ablate the abnormal tissue from her esophagus.
items.ex_zh: 专家利用激光能量消融切除了她食道内的异常病变组织。
items.ex2_en: Spacecraft heat shields ablate gradually when encountering extreme temperatures during atmospheric reentry.
items.ex2_zh: 航天器隔热罩在重返大气层遭遇极端高温时会逐渐发生烧蚀消融。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe medical or surgical interventions involving extreme heat, chemicals, or incisions to seal wounds, stop hemorrhage, or remove diseased tissue.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及以高温、化学制剂或创口处置来止血或清除病变组织的操作。
groups.desc_en: Surgical schema of employing intense heat, chemical agents, or energy to destroy pathological tissue or seal bleeding vessels, contrasting with cold excision or gentle dressing.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为利用热力、化学物质或高能射线破坏病理组织或封闭创口血管，区别于冷兵器的'切除'或常规'敷药'。
groups.nuance_en: cauterize: seal a wound or destroy abnormal tissue using extreme heat or caustic chemicals (wound / vessel / stump) · ablate: excise, vaporize, or erode diseased tissue via surgical energy or lasers (tumor / endometrium / lesion) · sear: burn tissue superficially with intense instant heat (flesh / wound) · burn off: destroy unwanted surface growths through thermal or chemical destruction (warts / lesions / skin) · lance: pierce an acute abscess or swelling with a blade to evacuate purulent fluid (abscess / boil / cyst)
groups.nuance_zh: cauterize: 用极高热力或烧灼剂封闭血管或烧毁组织 (wound / vessel / stump) · ablate: 借助高频射频或激光使深部病变组织消融气化 (tumor / endometrium / lesion) · sear: 瞬间强热灼焦表层血肉 (flesh / wound) · burn off: 热灼烧除体表赘生物 (warts / lesions / skin) · lance: 刺破或切开脓肿引流脓液 (abscess / boil / cyst)

groups.name: Medicate & Dose · 用药与服毒 (Dose, Medicate, Self-medicate)
groups.tip: 超量或规范服用药物场景

items.def_en: To administer a measured amount of medicine or drug to a person or animal
items.ex_en: The pediatric nurse dosed the young patient with a mild liquid antibiotic suspension.
items.ex_zh: 儿科护士给这名患儿服下了适量的抗生素口服混悬液。

items.def_en: To choose and consume medications, alcohol, or illicit drugs to manage illness or stress without professional supervision
items.ex_en: Many individuals unfortunately self-medicate with alcohol instead of seeking professional psychiatric help.
items.ex_zh: 不幸的是，许多人借酒精自行消解痛苦，而未寻求专业的精神科帮助。

items.def_en: 1. (+ on) To take an excessive and dangerous amount of a drug. 2. (+ on) (informal) To do, consume, or experience too much of something.
items.ex_en: I watched the whole trilogy yesterday and totally overdosed on fantasy movies.
items.ex_zh: 我昨天一口气看完了整部三部曲，真是彻底看伤奇幻电影了。

items.def_en: To treat someone or oneself with medical drugs or pharmaceutical substances
items.ex_en: Doctors usually hesitate to medicate mild anxiety before exploring behavioral therapy options.
items.ex_zh: 在尝试行为疗法之前，医生通常对用药物治疗轻度焦虑持审慎态度。

items.def_en: To give someone drugs in order to make them calm, sleepy, or unconscious
items.ex_en: Veterinarians sedated the panicked horse before attempting to treat its fractured leg.
items.ex_zh: 兽医在尝试医治受惊马匹骨折的腿部之前，先给它注射了镇静剂。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on administering or consuming pharmacological substances or toxins. Verbs characterize intentional medical dosing, self-treatment, or drug overuse.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及摄入或给予药物、药剂，涵盖遵医嘱服药、自行用药及过量用药。
groups.desc_en: Pharmacological schema of administering measured bioactive compounds to alter physiology or manage symptoms, contrasting with nourishment or uncontrolled poisoning.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为遵循特定剂量投喂生物活性药剂以调控病理机能，区别于日常饮食摄入或无节制的毒害。
groups.nuance_en: medicate: provide pharmacological treatment to manage disease or behavior (patients / symptoms / cattle) · dose: administer a measured, timed quantity of medicine (patient / medicine / mixture) · sedate: administer calming or anesthetic drugs to dull consciousness (patient / animal / victim) · self-medicate: take unprescribed drugs or alcohol to suppress emotional or physical distress (anxiety / depression / pain) · overdose: ingest a toxic or lethal quantity exceeding safe pharmacological limits (drugs / heroin / pills)
groups.nuance_zh: medicate: 给予规范药物治疗以控制病症 (patients / symptoms / cattle) · dose: 按规定剂量和时点给药 (patient / medicine / mixture) · sedate: 投用镇静剂或麻醉药物降低意识反应 (patient / animal / victim) · self-medicate: 自行滥用药物或酒精以压制身心痛苦 (anxiety / depression / pain) · overdose: 过量服用致毒或致死剂量的药剂 (drugs / heroin / pills)

groups.name: Memorialize & Immortalize · 载入史册与缅怀 (Immortalize, Chronicle, Monument)
groups.tip: 举行仪式铭记过往人物与事件

items.def_en: To treat someone as a celebrated hero or public celebrity worthy of great homage
items.ex_en: The media tended to lionize the young entrepreneur after his startup went public.
items.ex_zh: 在这家初创公司上市后，媒体往往将这位年轻的企业家奉为英雄名流。

items.def_en: To record a detailed historical account of momentous events or lives over time
items.ex_en: Her latest historical biography chronicles the tumultuous reign of the forgotten monarch.
items.ex_zh: 她最新的历史传记详实记述了那位被遗忘君主的动荡统治时期。

items.def_en: To confer endless fame upon a person or event through art, literature, or memory
items.ex_en: The poet sought to immortalize the courage of fallen soldiers through her verses.
items.ex_zh: 这位诗人试图通过她的诗句让阵亡士兵的英勇事迹名垂千古。

items.def_zh: 纪念，缅怀；向……递交请愿书
items.def_en: 1. To preserve the memory of a person or event with a monument, ceremony, or tribute. 2. (formal) To submit a formal memorial or petition to.
items.ex_en: The city erected a bronze statue to memorialize the victims of the disaster.
items.ex_zh: 该市竖立了一座青铜雕像，以深切缅怀这场灾难中的遇难者。

items.def_en: To praise someone highly in speech or writing, especially in tribute after death
items.ex_en: Friends and colleagues gathered to eulogize the beloved professor at the memorial service.
items.ex_zh: 亲友和同事们齐聚追思会，深情悼念并颂扬这位受人爱戴的教授。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on discursive, artistic, or material preservation of a person or heroic deed in the collective memory, creating an enduring legacy that resists oblivion.
groups.summary_zh: 通过立传、著书、艺术或丰碑让人物与事迹万古流芳，免遭遗忘。
groups.desc_en: Historical schema of transmuting fleeting human deeds or departed souls into enduring cultural, literary, or stone memory, contrasting with transient praise or oblivion.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为将转瞬即逝的历史功勋或逝者升华为超越时间的文本、石碑与神圣记忆，区别于短暂的'赞扬'或终归'遗忘'。
groups.nuance_en: immortalize: confer unending cultural fame and life beyond death through art or history (hero / deed / legacy) · memorialize: preserve the memory of the dead or an epochal event via a monument or ceremony (fallen / victims / anniversary) · chronicle: record historical events objectively in accurate chronological detail (history / journey / warfare) · eulogize: praise highly in formal spoken or written tributes, especially at a funeral (leader / friend / life) · lionize: treat an individual with overwhelming, highly public adoration as a heroic celebrity (author / explorer / star)
groups.nuance_zh: immortalize: 借助艺术或史册赋予人物或事迹永恒不朽 (hero / deed / legacy) · memorialize: 通过树碑、仪式以缅怀悼念逝者或重大事件 (fallen / victims / anniversary) · chronicle: 按年代纪事详实编撰记录历程 (history / journey / warfare) · eulogize: 在悼词或祭文中深情颂扬逝者功绩 (leader / friend / life) · lionize: 将人物作为英雄偶像进行举国奉迎追捧 (author / explorer / star)

groups.name: Mention & Allude · 提及与谈及 (Mention, Allude, Touch on)
groups.tip: 顺带说起或郑重声明某事

items.def_en: To introduce a particular subject or topic into a conversation or meeting for consideration
items.ex_en: She decided to bring up the budget deficit during the executive committee meeting.
items.ex_zh: 她决定在执行委员会会议上正式提出预算赤字这个议题。

items.def_en: To speak or write about a subject briefly, in passing, or as part of a wider discussion
items.ex_en: The speaker only touched on the budget deficit without providing any concrete solutions.
items.ex_zh: 发言人只是简略提到了财政赤字，并未给出任何具体解决方案。

items.def_en: 1. To speak or write about someone or something briefly or without going into detail.
items.ex_en: The professor forgot to mention the rescheduled exam date during today's lecture.
items.ex_zh: 教授在今天的讲座中忘记顺带提一下改期后的考试时间。

items.def_en: (+ to) To refer to someone or something indirectly or in passing
items.ex_en: The senator merely alluded to the financial scandal without naming any specific individuals.
items.ex_zh: 参议员只是影射了这桩财务丑闻，并未点出任何具体当事人的名字。

items.def_en: To mention or refer to something as an example, proof, or authority in support of an argument
items.ex_en: The lawyer cited three relevant precedents to persuade the reluctant judge.
items.ex_zh: 律师援引了三起相关先例，试图说服这位迟疑不决的法官。

groups.summary_en: This frame pertains to briefly or cursorily introducing a subject into conversation or text without giving full elaboration or exhaustive treatment.
groups.summary_zh: 简要提及、带过或间接暗示某人某事。
groups.desc_en: Discursive schema of introducing an entity or topic into discourse casually, tangentially, or cursorily without exhaustive elaboration, contrasting with in-depth analysis.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为在言语进程中对某个话题或客体进行短暂触碰、顺带提出或浮光掠影带过，区别于穷尽式的'深度剖析'。
groups.nuance_en: mention: name, state, or introduce something briefly in speech or writing (name / fact / topic) · bring up: intentionally initiate discussion on a delicate or specific topic (subject / past / grievance) · touch on: treat an issue very briefly as an incidental aside before moving forward (issue / theme / point) · allude: refer to something indirectly without explicit naming (incident / tragedy / text) · cite: quote or specifically refer to an authoritative source or evidentiary fact (source / law / example)
groups.nuance_zh: mention: 在交谈中顺口说及或点名提及 (name / fact / topic) · bring up: 主动抛出或挑起某一敏感或具体议题 (subject / past / grievance) · touch on: 蜻蜓点水式地短暂掠过附带议题 (issue / theme / point) · allude: 意在言外、不点名地暗指影射 (incident / tragedy / text) · cite: 引述权威出处或征引法条证据 (source / law / example)

groups.name: Mention & Refer · 提及与指涉 (Allude to, Refer to, Touch upon)
groups.tip: 言语间顺带提及或引出某话题

items.def_en: To mention something in an indirect, glancing, or roundabout way
items.ex_en: The critic's opening remarks subtly alluded to the director's troubled past productions.
items.ex_zh: 评论家的开场白巧妙地暗指了该导演以往作品所引发的非议。

items.def_en: To refer back to an earlier subject, memory, or historical period
items.ex_en: The film's haunting soundtrack harks back to classic Hollywood cinema from the forties.
items.ex_zh: 这部电影那令人难忘的配乐回溯了四十年代经典好莱坞电影的风韵。

items.def_en: To mention or speak about someone or something directly in discourse
items.ex_en: Please refer to the technical manual for complete instructions on device assembly.
items.ex_zh: 有关设备组装的完整说明，请直接查阅技术操作手册。

items.def_en: To mention something as a reason or example to support a point
items.ex_en: The researcher cited multiple peer-reviewed papers to corroborate her groundbreaking hypothesis.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员引用了多篇同行评审论文，以佐证她那开创性的学术假说。

items.def_zh: 提及，谈及（常与 to 连用）；引起注意
items.def_en: (also 'advert to') To refer to, make mention of, or draw attention to a subject.
items.ex_en: In closing, the keynote speaker adverted to the growing threat of climate change.
items.ex_zh: 在演讲结语中，主讲人特意提及了日益严峻的气候变化威胁。

groups.summary_en: Concerns directing attention toward an existing matter, document, or precedent, ranging from explicit citation to oblique passing reference.
groups.summary_zh: 以直接提及或暗指的方式引述某事或前情。
groups.desc_en: Semiotic schema of directing an audience's cognitive gaze toward an external source, antecedent, or latent fact, contrasting with direct and comprehensive description.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为通过语言符号将听者的注意力指向外部文本、历史源头或隐蔽事实，区别于自足展开的直接陈述。
groups.nuance_en: refer to: direct conversational attention to a specific person, place, or textual note (notes / dictionary / event) · allude to: point to something covertly or obliquely through suggestion (scandal / past / poem) · cite: point to written authority, case law, or evidentiary precedents (statute / paper / precedent) · hark back to: evoke or deliberately recall a style, era, or tradition from the past (tradition / origins / roots) · advert: turn the mind or speech toward a circumstance deliberately, often formally (fact / topic / argument)
groups.nuance_zh: refer to: 直观指示或翻检具体的人事物与书目 (notes / dictionary / event) · allude to: 隐晦暗示或借用典故旁敲侧击 (scandal / past / poem) · cite: 援引权威文献、法条或前例作支撑 (statute / paper / precedent) · hark back to: 溯及或追怀过往的传统与渊源 (tradition / origins / roots) · advert: 在正式论述中有意识地转而论及或注意 (fact / topic / argument)

groups.name: Mesmerize & Enchant · 入迷与沉醉 (Mesmerize, Spellbind, Captivate)
groups.tip: 心神完全被吸引，如坠梦境之中

items.def_zh: 使入迷，使沉醉；使发呆，使恍惚
items.def_en: To put someone into a trance, or enchant and captivate someone completely.
items.ex_en: The mystical melody seemed to trance the audience into a profound, motionless silence.
items.ex_zh: 那空灵神秘的旋律仿佛让全场观众陷入了出神入迷、寂然无声的状态。

items.def_en: To attract and hold someone's interest and affection intensely
items.ex_en: Her expressive storytelling captivatingly held the children throughout the entire reading session.
items.ex_zh: 她那绘声绘色的讲述在整场读书会期间深深吸引住了所有的孩子。

items.def_en: To hold someone's full attention completely as if by a hypnotic spell
items.ex_en: The flickering flames of the campfire seemed to mesmerize the weary travelers.
items.ex_zh: 营火跳跃闪烁的火焰似乎让疲惫的旅人们看得入了迷、发了呆。

items.def_en: To keep someone so deeply interested that they listen or watch with complete devotion
items.ex_en: The virtuoso violinist enthralled the packed concert hall with a flawless romantic performance.
items.ex_zh: 这位小提琴大师用一段天衣无缝的浪漫演奏令满场观众为之陶醉神往。

items.def_en: To capture complete fascination and attention, rendering listeners or viewers utterly silent
items.ex_en: The charismatic orator spellbound the large crowd with his vivid, emotionally charged speech.
items.ex_zh: 那位极富感染力的演说家以生动饱满的演讲让全场听众听得出神入化。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures high-intensity psychological states of awe, fascination, or cognitive paralysis induced by beauty, skill, or supernatural charm, rendering the subject spellbound and unable to divert attention.
groups.summary_zh: 指因极致的美、艺术或魅力而使人深度着迷、失魂落魄或恍惚凝神。
groups.desc_en: Psychological schema of completely commanding an onlooker's attention, inducing an immobile state of intense wonder or suspended consciousness, contrasting with mild distraction or interest.
groups.desc_zh: 认知图式体现为完全攫取并锁闭受众的注意力，致使其心智凝滞沉沦于强烈的陶醉与惊叹之中，区别于普通'吸引'。
groups.nuance_en: captivate: draw and hold affection or delighted attention through charm and beauty (audience / heart / imagination) · mesmerize: hold someone in a state of transfixed, almost hypnotic fixation (spectators / crowd / gaze) · enthrall: seize complete emotional and mental capture akin to being enslaved by fascination (viewers / listeners / mind) · spellbind: bind an audience motionless as if under a supernatural incantation (crowd / audience / readers) · trance: lull or freeze the faculties into a semi-conscious dreamlike stupor (senses / spectator / soul)
groups.nuance_zh: captivate: 凭借美感或魅力持久俘获注意力与芳心 (audience / heart / imagination) · mesmerize: 产生如受催眠般目不转睛的木然注视 (spectators / crowd / gaze) · enthrall: 令人神魂颠倒如受心智奴役般不能自拔 (viewers / listeners / mind) · spellbind: 如遭符咒定身般使听众屏息定格 (crowd / audience / readers) · trance: 使感官陷入半昏睡式的出神狂喜状态 (senses / spectator / soul)

groups.name: Mess & Dishevel Hair · 弄乱头发 (Ruffle, Tousle, Muss)
groups.tip: 揉搓抓乱头发或使之蓬乱

items.def_en: To spoil the neat or orderly state of hair or an appearance
items.ex_en: The strong sudden gust of wind messed up my freshly styled hair completely.
items.ex_zh: 一阵突如其来的强风把我刚刚做好的发型彻底吹乱了。

items.def_zh: 使凌乱，弄乱（尤指头发或衣服）
items.def_en: To make someone's hair or clothing untidy or messy, often used with 'up'
items.ex_en: The playful puppy jumped onto the bed and mussed up the neat sheets.
items.ex_zh: 调皮的小狗跳上了床，将原本整整齐齐的床单弄得凌乱不堪。

items.def_en: To touch or run fingers through someone's hair, feathers, or smooth surface, disturbing its smoothness
items.ex_en: Grandmother affectionately ruffled the little boy's curls before handing him a cookie.
items.ex_zh: 祖母亲昵地揉了揉小男孩的卷发，然后递给他一块饼干。

items.def_en: To make someone's hair untidy or disheveled.
items.ex_en: The sea breeze tousled her hair as she stood watching the distant horizon.
items.ex_zh: 当她伫立远眺地平线时，清冽的海风吹乱了她的秀发。

items.def_zh: 使蓬乱，使发型或衣冠不整
items.def_en: To throw someone's hair or clothing into untidy disarray, typically through wind, struggle, or neglect
items.ex_en: Fierce gale-force winds disheveled the traveler's heavy woolen coat and graying hair.
items.ex_zh: 凛冽的狂风吹乱了旅人的粗呢大衣，让他花白的头发显得凌乱不堪。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe disturbing the neat arrangement of hair or feathers, often playfully, affectionately, or through wind and rough handling.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过抚摩、抓弄或风吹将头发或羽毛弄乱、弄蓬松。
groups.desc_en: Denotes disturbing the neat arrangement of hair or plumage by physical contact, contrasting with generic disordering by focusing specifically on superficial, touch-based disarray.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过身体接触扰乱头发或羽毛的整齐排列，与一般的‘搞乱’相比，特指针对毛发表面、触碰式的蓬乱。
groups.nuance_en: mess up: informal generic disturbance (hair / bangs) · muss: mild untidying, often playful or accidental (hair / collar) · ruffle: gentle lifting or disturbing like a breeze (feathers / curls) · tousle: playful or affectionate vigorous rubbing (hair / mop) · dishevel: thorough disordering leading to an untidy appearance (hair / appearance)
groups.nuance_zh: mess up: 口语泛指弄乱 (hair / bangs) · muss: 轻微弄乱，常带嬉戏或无意感 (hair / collar) · ruffle: 如微风拂过般轻抚拨乱 (feathers / curls) · tousle: 亲昵或用力揉乱 (hair / mop) · dishevel: 使彻底蓬乱失整 (hair / appearance)

groups.name: Message & Notify Digitally · 发信通知与联络 (Message, Text, Ping)
groups.tip: 正式将消息或情况传达对方

items.def_en: To send a written electronic message to someone via phone, computer, or messaging app.
items.ex_en: I will message you the address details as soon as I arrive home.
items.ex_zh: 我一到家就把具体的详细地址发信息给你。

items.def_en: To send a written SMS or electronic message to someone using a mobile phone
items.ex_en: Don't forget to text me when your plane lands safely in Seattle.
items.ex_zh: 当你的飞机在西雅图安全降落后，别忘了给我发条短信。

items.def_zh: 私信，发送直接私密消息
items.def_en: To send a direct private message to someone on a social media platform
items.ex_en: If you have questions about the workshop, just DM me on Instagram.
items.ex_zh: 如果你对工作坊有任何疑问，直接在Instagram上私信我就行。

items.def_en: (+ to) To contact someone electronically or by phone in order to communicate or seek assistance
items.ex_en: The customer service representative reached out to resolve our complaint promptly this morning.
items.ex_zh: 客服代表今天早晨主动与我们取得联络，以迅速解决投诉问题。

items.def_en: To send a brief electronic message, notification, or alert to someone to get their attention
items.ex_en: I will ping you on Slack as soon as the report is ready.
items.ex_zh: 报告一准备好，我就会在Slack上发消息提醒你。
items.ex2_en: The metal microwave door pinged loudly to announce that the meal was cooked.
items.ex2_zh: 金属微波炉门发出一声响亮的清脆提示音，宣告饭菜已经加热完毕。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate transmitting brief electronic communications, notifications, or alerts directly to individuals via digital devices, chat tools, or networks.
groups.summary_zh: 特指通过手机、即时通信软件等数字化媒介快速发送消息或提示。
groups.desc_en: Denotes contacting someone via electronic communication channels, contrasting with traditional vocal phoning or formal postal dispatch.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过电子通信渠道与某人取得联系，区别于传统语音通话或正式邮寄公函。
groups.nuance_en: message: broad electronic transmission across apps (friend / client) · text: sending via SMS or cellular text service (number / coworker) · DM: sending a direct private message on social platforms (creator / follower) · reach out: proactive broad effort to establish contact (lead / community) · ping: brief casual prompt or alert to check availability (colleague / engineer)
groups.nuance_zh: message: 泛指通过各类应用发送电子信息 (friend / client) · text: 专指发送手机短信 (number / coworker) · DM: 在社交平台发送私信 (creator / follower) · reach out: 主动发起联络或沟通 (lead / community) · ping: 简短随意的轻量提醒或探询 (colleague / engineer)

groups.name: Misalign & Skew · 错位与偏离基准 (Misalign, Skew, Cock)
groups.tip: 失去规整对齐状态发生偏离

items.def_en: To tilt, lean, or pitch to one side out of a level or vertical position
items.ex_en: A violent gust of wind caused the wooden hull to cant precariously sideways.
items.ex_zh: 一阵狂风吹来，木质船体危险地向一侧倾斜。
items.ex2_en: The careless deckhand canted the heavy wooden ladder sideways against the slippery wall.
items.ex2_zh: 粗心的水手把沉重的木梯歪斜着靠在湿滑的墙壁上。

items.def_en: To tilt or turn something (such as the head, a hat, or an ear) obliquely upward or to one side
items.ex_en: The puppy cocked its head curiously upon hearing the unusual squeaking sound outside.
items.ex_zh: 小狗听到外面不同寻常的吱吱声，好奇地歪起了头。

items.def_en: To shift out of a straight row or orderly linear orientation
items.ex_en: Make sure the wooden fence posts do not get out of line during installation.
items.ex_zh: 安装时务必注意，别让那些木栅栏柱偏离了直线。

items.def_en: To turn or place at an angle rather than straight, or to suddenly swerve out of true alignment
items.ex_en: A sudden bump in the uneven road caused the steering column to skew sideways.
items.ex_zh: 凹凸不平路面上的突然颠簸导致转向柱偏向了一边。
items.ex2_en: Uneven sample selection skews experimental survey findings toward biased and misleading social conclusions.
items.ex2_zh: 不均匀的样本选择使实验调查结果产生偏差，导向了带有偏见且误导性的社会结论。

items.def_zh: 使排列不当，使错位；错位，未对齐
items.def_en: 1. To position or fall out of proper straight alignment or coordination.
items.ex_en: A loose screw caused the printer rollers to misalign, jamming the entire paper feed.
items.ex_zh: 一颗松动的螺丝导致打印机滚筒错位，卡住了整个进纸机构。
items.ex2_en: Careless installation will misalign the optical lenses inside the high-precision laser telescope.
items.ex2_zh: 粗心的安装会使高精度激光望远镜内部的光学透镜偏离准线。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses spatial positioning where an object, component, or system veers out of a true straight line, parallel plane, or coordinated orientation. Verbs contrast deliberate asymmetrical tilt with mechanical errors or accidental distortion.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体或部件偏离直线、基准面或既定坐标而失去对准。
groups.desc_en: Denotes deviating from a true mechanical axis, parallel, or balanced datum, contrasting with qualitative mismatching by focusing on spatial or geometric distortion.
groups.desc_zh: 指偏离机械轴线、平行准线或平衡基准，与质性不匹配不同，侧重空间或几何上的歪斜走样。
groups.nuance_en: cant: tilting or slanting at an angle from the vertical (mast / beam) · cock: deliberate or jaunty tilting to one side (hat / head) · get out of line: physical deviation from a straight queue or proper alignment (wheels / pipes) · skew: asymmetrical distortion or oblique bias (distribution / angle) · misalign: failure of complementary parts to match up correctly (wheels / gears / tracks)
groups.nuance_zh: cant: 自垂直面倾斜或翘起 (mast / beam) · cock: 故意的或俏皮地歪斜 (hat / head) · get out of line: 脱离直线队列或基准对齐 (wheels / pipes) · skew: 呈现非对称歪斜或偏斜 (distribution / angle) · misalign: 机械或部件未能精准对齐 (wheels / gears / tracks)

groups.name: Misbehave & Transgress · 违规与越轨 (Misbehave, Transgress, Flout)
groups.tip: 从行为不当到逾矩违纪

items.def_en: To behave badly, disruptively, or inappropriately
items.ex_en: The bored toddlers began to act up when the flight was delayed for hours.
items.ex_zh: 航班延误了数小时，无聊的幼儿们开始调皮捣乱。

items.def_zh: 行为不端，违规，举止失礼
items.def_en: To behave badly, inappropriately, or against rules.
items.ex_en: Students who deliberately misbehave during the exam will face immediate disciplinary measures tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 在考试期间蓄意违规的学生，明天将立即面临纪律处分。

items.def_en: (+ from) To depart noticeably from standard, accepted, or expected behavior
items.ex_en: Officers must never deviate from the established safety protocols under any circumstances.
items.ex_zh: 在任何情况下，警官都绝不能偏离既定的安全规程。

items.def_zh: 公然蔑视；无视（法规或习俗）
items.def_en: To openly disregard and break a rule, law, or accepted custom
items.ex_en: Several local factories openly flout environmental regulations by dumping untreated wastewater into rivers.
items.ex_zh: 几家当地工厂公然无视环保法规，将未经处理的废水排入河流。

items.def_zh: 越轨；逾越（道德或法律界限）
items.def_en: To cross moral, ethical, or legal boundaries
items.ex_en: Corrupt officials often transgress legal and moral boundaries in pursuit of personal wealth.
items.ex_zh: 腐败官员往往为了追求个人财富而逾越法律和道德界限。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote acting outside accepted codes of conduct, morality, or institutional rules, scaling from childish naughtiness to deliberate defiance and ethical violation.
groups.summary_zh: 指违背规矩、逾越道德界限或故意公然对抗守则。
groups.desc_en: Denotes breaching social rules, behavioral norms, or moral and legal boundaries, ranging from minor unruly conduct to grave institutional defiance.
groups.desc_zh: 指违反社会规范、行为守则或道德法律边界，语意从轻微淘气不规矩延伸至严重藐视与越轨。
groups.nuance_en: act up: informal unruly or erratic misbehavior, often by children or machines (kid / knee) · misbehave: standard failure to conform to manners or rules (child / student) · deviate: diverging from an established norm or standard path (norm / doctrine) · flout: openly and contemptuously disregarding a rule (law / ban / convention) · transgress: crossing a formal moral, spiritual, or legal boundary (boundary / code / limit)
groups.nuance_zh: act up: 口语中指调皮捣蛋或机器失灵作怪 (kid / knee) · misbehave: 标准用词，指言行失态或不守规矩 (child / student) · deviate: 偏离既定规范或既有路径 (norm / doctrine) · flout: 公然藐视、肆意践踏规章 (law / ban / convention) · transgress: 越过道德、宗教或法律红线 (boundary / code / limit)

groups.name: Mismatch & Clash · 错配与失调 (Mismatch, Clasp, Jar)
groups.tip: 使双方协调一致配合

items.def_en: (+ with) To be incompatible or in direct opposition in values, roles, or attributes
items.ex_en: Her demanding corporate work schedule conflicts with her obligations as a full-time parent.
items.ex_zh: 她繁重的公司工作日程与她作为全职家长的职责相冲突。

items.def_en: (+ with) To look awkward, disharmonious, or inappropriate together
items.ex_en: Those vibrant purple curtains clash terribly with the bright orange paint on the walls.
items.ex_zh: 那些亮紫色的窗帘与墙上鲜艳的橙色油漆极不协调。

items.def_en: (+ with) To be unpleasantly discordant, incongruous, or out of place
items.ex_en: The ultra-modern glass extension jars unpleasantly with the historic stone church next door.
items.ex_zh: 那座超现代的玻璃扩建建筑与隔壁历史悠久的石砌教堂显得突兀刺目。

items.def_zh: 使错配，使不相称地结合
items.def_en: To pair or combine people or things that are unsuitable, incompatible, or unequal to each other.
items.ex_en: The tournament organizers accidentally mismatched the novice player with an experienced grandmaster.
items.ex_zh: 锦标赛组织者不小心将这名新手选手与一位经验丰富的大师错配在了一起。

items.def_en: To position components out of correct linear or functional alignment with each other
items.ex_en: Improper installation will misalign the machine gears, leading to severe friction and breakdown.
items.ex_zh: 不当的安装会导致机器齿轮对准偏差，从而引起严重的摩擦和故障。
items.ex2_en: The bicycle gears misaligned suddenly while climbing up the steep rocky hill trail.
items.ex2_zh: 在攀爬陡峭多石的山坡小径时，自行车的齿轮突然错位了。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame address faulty pairing, incongruity, or disharmony where coupled entities fail to align, fit together, or work cooperatively.
groups.summary_zh: 指搭配失当、未能形成平衡契合，导致相互冲突或不相称的关系。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an aesthetic, logical, or functional discordance between entities, contrasting with geometric deviation by stressing discordant coexistence.
groups.desc_zh: 指实体间在美学、逻辑或功能上的不协调与冲突，区别于几何错位，强调二者并置时的刺耳或违和。
groups.nuance_en: conflict: active incompatibility of interests, schedules, or facts (interests / schedule) · clash: harsh, striking visual or conceptual collision (colors / styles / personalities) · jar: producing a harsh, grating, unsettling sensory or psychological discord (sensibility / nerves / tone) · mismatch: structural or quantitative disparity between paired elements (skills / expectations) · misalign: systemic failure of coordination or priorities between parties (incentives / goals)
groups.nuance_zh: conflict: 利益、日程或事实上的对立冲突 (interests / schedule) · clash: 色彩、风格或个性上刺目的撞车冲突 (colors / styles / personalities) · jar: 产生令人不适的刺耳感或违和冲击 (sensibility / nerves / tone) · mismatch: 成对要素在结构或素质上的错配失衡 (skills / expectations) · misalign: 激励、目标等战略层面的协同脱节 (incentives / goals)

groups.name: Misplace & Lose Track · 遗落与误放 (Mislay, Lose track of, Displace)
groups.tip: 因疏忽而失去或放错

items.def_en: To let something fall or be left inadvertently behind while moving
items.ex_en: He must have dropped his leather wallet somewhere while walking through the crowded market.
items.ex_zh: 他一定是穿行在拥挤的集市时，不小心把皮夹遗落在了某处。
items.ex2_en: The temperature dropped sharply overnight, causing thick frost across the farm fields.
items.ex2_zh: 气温在一夜之间骤降，导致整个农田表面结了厚厚一层白霜。

items.def_en: To forget to take something along when departing from a place
items.ex_en: Hurry back to the hotel lobby; you left behind your jacket on the chair.
items.ex_zh: 快回酒店大堂去，你把夹克遗忘在椅子上了。

items.def_en: To fail to stay aware of the location, progress, or state of something or someone
items.ex_en: I frequently lose track of my keys whenever I set them down casually.
items.ex_zh: 只要随手一放，我常常就会找不到自己的钥匙放哪儿了。

items.def_zh: 放错地方；错误地寄托（信任、希望等）
items.def_en: 1. To put something in an unintended place and temporarily lose it. 2. To direct trust, affection, or confidence toward an unworthy person or cause.
items.ex_en: The absent-minded professor misplaced his reading glasses amidst the towering stacks of manuscripts.
items.ex_zh: 心不在焉的教授把老花镜乱放在堆积如山的手稿里找不到了。

items.def_en: To put something in an unremembered location so that it cannot be found for a while
items.ex_en: She could not find her passport because she had mislaid it in the study.
items.ex_zh: 她找不到护照了，因为她不知把它随手塞在书房哪儿了。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the unintentional putting of an object in the wrong place, resulting in temporary inability to find it while retaining legal ownership. It stresses human carelessness and accidental spatial confusion.
groups.summary_zh: 强调因疏忽将物品误放错处而一时寻觅无果的动作情态。
groups.desc_en: Denotes involuntarily losing control or awareness of an object's location, contrasting with intentional storage, abandoning, or absolute loss.
groups.desc_zh: 指非自愿地失去对物品所在位置的感知或控制，区别于主动存放、遗弃或彻底灭失。
groups.nuance_en: drop: letting fall accidentally, often with immediate realization (keys / guard) · leave behind: inadvertently departing without an item (wallet / umbrella) · lose track of: gradual loss of temporal or spatial awareness regarding whereabouts (time / expenses / luggage) · misplace: putting an item in an unremembered or wrong place temporarily (glasses / phone) · mislay: putting something carefully down and subsequently forgetting the precise spot (documents / file)
groups.nuance_zh: drop: 无意中掉落脱手 (keys / guard) · leave behind: 离开时疏忽遗落 (wallet / umbrella) · lose track of: 逐渐失去对时间、位置或进展的掌握 (time / expenses / luggage) · misplace: 随手放错地方而暂时找不着 (glasses / phone) · mislay: 谨慎放置后却遗忘具体位置 (documents / file)

groups.name: Misquote & Distort Citation · 误引与断章取义 (Misquote, Misattribute, Twist)
groups.tip: 引用原句或用自己语言转述

items.def_zh: 张冠李戴，错误归属（引文出处）
items.def_en: To incorrectly assign words, an artwork, or a quote to the wrong author or speaker
items.ex_en: Online bloggers frequently misattribute that famous historical quotation to Winston Churchill instead of Lincoln.
items.ex_zh: 网络博主们常常张冠李戴，把那句著名的历史名言归于丘吉尔而非林肯。

items.def_zh: 错误地引用，断章取义地引述
items.def_en: to repeat or cite someone's words incorrectly or inaccurately
items.ex_en: The sensationalist tabloid misquoted the mayor to spark unnecessary controversy among local residents.
items.ex_zh: 那家耸人听闻的小报断章取义地引述市长的话，以在当地居民中挑起不必要的争议。

items.def_zh: 严重歪曲，读错或转述错（原话）
items.def_en: To ruin, butcher, or badly misstate a quotation, text, or pronunciation
items.ex_en: The nervous student managed to mangle the famous Shakespearean soliloquy beyond all recognition.
items.ex_zh: 那个紧张的学生把莎士比亚著名的独白念得面目全非。

items.def_zh: 曲解，窜改，把…传得面目全非
items.def_en: To reproduce a message or quote in an inaccurate, confused, or distorted manner
items.ex_en: A faulty transmission line garbled the urgent military message beyond all possible comprehension.
items.ex_zh: 一条出故障的传输线路使紧急军事情报被篡改得完全无法理解。

items.def_en: To intentionally alter the meaning of someone's words or statement to suit one's own agenda
items.ex_en: Political rivals deliberately twisted his words to make him seem indifferent to poverty.
items.ex_zh: 政治对手故意曲解他的话，使他显得对贫困漠不关心。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame identify faulty, disingenuous, or inaccurate citations where someone's original words or context are mangled or falsely credited.
groups.summary_zh: 错误转述原话、曲解语境或张冠李戴地引证他人名言。
groups.desc_en: Denotes inaccurately reporting, altering, or misrepresenting spoken or written texts, contrasting with outright fabrication by presupposing an existing original source.
groups.desc_zh: 指不准确地转述、篡改或曲解口头或书面文本，区别于凭空捏造，它以存在既有源文本为前提。
groups.nuance_en: misattribute: assigning a quote, work, or deed to the wrong author (quote / authorship) · misquote: inaccurately repeating words uttered or written (words / speech / figures) · mangle: severely butchering text or meaning through incompetence (text / name / language) · garble: confusing or distorting a transmission into incoherence (message / facts) · twist: deliberately altering context or syntax to mislead (words / meaning / truth)
groups.nuance_zh: misattribute: 张冠李戴，误归作者或来源 (quote / authorship) · misquote: 词句引述不准确或断章取义 (words / speech / figures) · mangle: 拙劣改动而改得面目全非、语义残缺 (text / name / language) · garble: 讯息或事实被混淆扰乱至支离破碎 (message / facts) · twist: 刻意曲解、歪曲原话含义 (words / meaning / truth)

groups.name: Misspell & Miswrite · 拼写错误与笔误 (Misspell, Misprint, Mistype)
groups.tip: 拼写出现错漏或字母拼错

items.def_en: To make a careless mistake while writing, calculating, or performing a routine task
items.ex_en: Someone in the accounting department must have slipped up.
items.ex_zh: 财务部肯定有人粗心犯了错。

items.def_en: To print a letter, word, or symbol incorrectly in a publication
items.ex_en: The publishing company had to reprint the volume after misprinting the author's surname.
items.ex_zh: 出版社在印错了作者的姓氏后，不得不重印该书。

items.def_en: To make a mistake when typing a word, number, or document
items.ex_en: I accidentally mistyped the recipient's email address, causing the confidential contract to bounce.
items.ex_zh: 我不小心打错了收件人的邮箱地址，导致机密合同被退信。

items.def_en: To spell a word with the wrong letters or in the wrong order
items.ex_en: Many foreigners consistently misspell the word 'definitely' by inserting an extra 'a'.
items.ex_zh: 许多外国人常常把“definitely”这个单词拼错，多塞进去一个“a”。

items.def_zh: 错乱地拼写/表达；使混乱
items.def_en: To reproduce text, messages, or sounds in a confused or distorted way that is hard to understand
items.ex_en: Static on the radio line garbled the pilot's coordinates before air traffic control responded.
items.ex_zh: 无线电中的静电干扰把飞行员的坐标弄得含混不清，空管甚至来不及回应。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe producing erroneous written forms, faulty orthography, or typographical slips during composition.
groups.summary_zh: 指在文字书写、拼读或排印过程中出现差错或笔误。
groups.desc_en: Denotes producing errors in the mechanical or orthographic reproduction of language, contrasting with ideological distortion by focusing on lexical and clerical slips.
groups.desc_zh: 指在文字的书写、输入或印刷等机械复现环节出现差错，区别于刻意曲解，侧重字词层面的笔误与排印错误。
groups.nuance_en: slip up: informal generic lapse or inadvertent clerical error (detail / date) · misprint: producing a typographical error during physical or digital publishing (edition / name) · mistype: hitting incorrect keyboard keys during digital text entry (password / URL) · misspell: arranging the letters of a word incorrectly according to orthography (name / word) · garble: rendering written content garbled or jumbled beyond recognition (cipher / text)
groups.nuance_zh: slip up: 口语泛指疏忽出错或小失误 (detail / date) · misprint: 印刷或排版环节出现的印错 (edition / name) · mistype: 键盘打字录入时的击键错误 (password / URL) · misspell: 违反正字法拼写错误 (name / word) · garble: 文字或电讯在转录时被弄得错乱不通 (cipher / text)

groups.name: Mix & Debase · 掺和与合金化 (Alloy, Adulterate, Blend)
groups.tip: 成分互相融合一体

items.def_en: To combine two or more distinct parts, elements, or ingredients into a single composite substance.
items.ex_en: Pharmacists must carefully compound these raw chemical substances under strictly controlled lab conditions.
items.ex_zh: 药剂师必须在严格受控的实验室条件下小心地配制这些原始化学原料。

items.def_en: To join together or blend completely by melting, heating, or applying intense pressure.
items.ex_en: Extreme heat and immense pressure fuse the synthetic materials into a solid block.
items.ex_zh: 极高的温度和巨大的压力将合成材料熔合成一体。
items.ex2_en: The fractured pelvic bones fused completely after six months of strict bed rest.
items.ex2_zh: 在经历了六个月的严格卧床静养后，骨折的骨盆骨骼完全愈合长在了一起。

items.def_zh: 将……铸成合金，使成合金；使减低成色，使受损
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To mix two or more metals together to form an alloy. 2. To impair, weaken, or lower the value or purity of something by adding an inferior element.
items.ex_en: The metalsmith chose to alloy pure gold with copper to enhance its durability.
items.ex_zh: 金匠选择将纯金与铜铸成合金，以增强其耐用性。

items.def_en: To mix or combine mercury with another metal, or more broadly to unite distinct elements into a whole.
items.ex_en: The leadership team plans to amalgamate the two regional branches into one corporation.
items.ex_zh: 领导团队计划将这两个区域分公司合并为一个整体企业。
items.ex2_en: The two independent research laboratories amalgamated into a single comprehensive institution.
items.ex2_zh: 这两个独立的研究所合并成了一个综合性机构。
