items.def_en: To corrupt, debase, or make impure by adding inferior, alien, or improper substances.
items.ex_en: Unscrupulous merchants adulterate pure olive oil with cheap soybean oil to maximize profits.
items.ex_zh: 不法商贩在纯橄榄油中掺入廉价大豆油以牟取暴利。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to combining metals or mixing substances, often with the effect or intention of altering purity, quality, or value. They range from metallurgical fusing to diluting or corrupting a base material.
groups.summary_zh: 强调混合金属或加入次等成分以改变纯度、品质或强度。
groups.desc_en: Denotes combining distinct substances, metals, or ideas, ranging from legitimate metallurgical fusion to corruptive economic adulteration.
groups.desc_zh: 指将不同物质、金属或思想进行结合，既涵盖合规的冶炼与熔合，也涵盖降低纯度的掺杂掺假。
groups.nuance_en: compound: combining elements to form an entirely new chemical or conceptual entity (matter / felony / error) · fuse: uniting distinct entities seamlessly under intense heat or energy (metals / styles) · alloy: mixing base metals or blending qualities, often modifying value or strength (gold / cynicism / realism) · amalgamate: legally or physically merging disparate organizations or elements into one (companies / unions) · adulterate: corrupting or cheapening a pure substance by adding inferior ingredients (food / wine / milk)
groups.nuance_zh: compound: 混合构成新复合物，或使问题复合恶化 (matter / felony / error) · fuse: 在高温或能量下熔合为一体 (metals / styles) · alloy: 熔炼合金；掺杂某种特质以调和 (gold / cynicism / realism) · amalgamate: 兼并或将异质要素彻底融为一体 (companies / unions) · adulterate: 掺杂劣质原料以次充好、败坏纯度 (food / wine / milk)

groups.name: Moisten & Douse · 浇润与漫灌 (Drench, Saturate, Water)
groups.tip: 浇灌水流润透土地

items.def_en: To pour or spray water onto soil, crops, or plants to promote growth
items.ex_en: Remember to water the fragile tomato plants early every morning before sunrise.
items.ex_zh: 记得每天清晨日出前给娇嫩的番茄植株浇水。

items.def_en: To wet or wash down heavily using a high-flow water hose
items.ex_en: The mechanics used a pressurized hose to hose down the mud-caked vehicle wheels.
items.ex_zh: 技工们用加压水管把糊满泥巴的车轮彻底冲洗干净。

items.def_en: To soak so thoroughly with moisture that no more liquid can be absorbed
items.ex_en: Continuous torrents of seasonal rainfall quickly saturate the low-lying agricultural plains with water.
items.ex_zh: 连绵不断的季节性暴雨很快使低洼的农田平原湿透饱和。

items.def_en: To soak completely and thoroughly with a large volume of liquid
items.ex_en: A passing truck drove through a puddle, drenching innocent pedestrians on the sidewalk.
items.ex_zh: 一辆驶过的卡车碾过水坑，把人行道上无辜的行人浇得浑身湿透。

items.def_en: 1. To supply dry land or crops with water through pipes, ditches, or sprinklers. 2. To wash out or clean a wound or body cavity with a flow of liquid.
items.ex_en: Farmers utilize deep concrete canals to irrigate vast fields during long summer droughts.
items.ex_zh: 在漫长的夏季干旱期间，农民们利用深混凝土水渠灌溉广阔的农田。

groups.summary_en: Covers applying water or moisture to soil, plants, surfaces, or wounds, varying from gentle hydration to complete soaking.
groups.summary_zh: 通过喷洒、浇注等方式为土壤、植物或表面补给水分以达滋润或浸透。
groups.desc_en: Denotes applying water or liquid to a surface, soil, or object, contrasting with light sprinkling by denoting systematic, heavy, or soaking delivery.
groups.desc_zh: 指将水或液体施加于表面、土壤或物体，区别于轻微喷洒，强调系统化、大量或浸透式的给水。
groups.nuance_en: water: routine provisioning of moisture for living things (plants / crops / horses) · hose down: forceful cleaning or cooling with a directed jet of water (deck / pavement / car) · saturate: soaking to the absolute limit of liquid absorption (soil / sponge / market) · drench: thoroughly wetting through rapidly with copious water (rain / clothes / audience) · irrigate: supplying land with water through engineered channels or pipes (fields / land / crops)
groups.nuance_zh: water: 常规浇水或给动植物补水 (plants / crops / horses) · hose down: 用水管强力冲洗或降温 (deck / pavement / car) · saturate: 彻底浸润浸透直至饱和极限 (soil / sponge / market) · drench: 短时间内彻底浇透淋湿 (rain / clothes / audience) · irrigate: 借助人工灌渠或工程系统进行农田灌溉 (fields / land / crops)

groups.name: Monetize & Liquidate · 变现与套现 (Monetize, Liquidate, Cash in)
groups.tip: 将无形资产转化为流动现金

items.def_zh: 变现；把（财产等）换成现钱
items.def_en: To convert property, shares, or goods into money through sale
items.ex_en: The bankrupt company sold its real estate portfolio to realize immediate cash reserves.
items.ex_zh: 这家破产公司出售了其房地产投资组合，以变现获得急需的现金储备。

items.def_zh: 兑现；（借助有利时机）套现
items.def_en: To exchange securities or vouchers for cash, or to profit from an advantage or situation
items.ex_en: Savvy investors decided to cash in on the stock's historic surge this morning.
items.ex_zh: 精明的投资者决定趁着今天上午该股票的历史性大涨抛售套现。

items.def_en: To sell one's stake, shares, or chips in exchange for currency and exit an investment
items.ex_en: After five profitable years, the startup founder chose to cash out his shares.
items.ex_zh: 在盈利五年后，这位初创公司创始人选择将股权变现离场。

items.def_en: To sell property or assets to obtain cash, especially to pay debts
items.ex_en: The court ordered the debtor to liquidate all foreign investments to settle obligations.
items.ex_zh: 法院命令债务人清算所有海外投资以清偿债务。

items.def_zh: 将……变现，通过……赚钱；定为法定货币
items.def_en: 1. To convert an asset, service, or website traffic into money or revenue. 2. To establish something as legal currency.
items.ex_en: Content creators explore creative sponsorship deals to monetize their large social media followings.
items.ex_zh: 内容创作者正在探索创新的赞助合作，以将他们庞大的社交媒体流量变现。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in business and finance describing the conversion of intangible assets, inventory, or investments into immediate cash or revenue.
groups.summary_zh: 指将无形资产、库存或金融投资兑换为现款或营业收入。
groups.desc_en: Denotes converting non-cash assets, rights, or inventory into spendable money, contrasting with abstract value accrual by focusing on concrete liquidity extraction.
groups.desc_zh: 指将非现金资产、权益或存货转化为可支配现金，区别于抽象的价值增值，侧重具体的流动性变现操作。
groups.nuance_en: realize: converting potential paper value or investments into actual capital (profits / assets) · cash in: redeeming an asset, token, or advantage for an immediate reward (chips / investments / reputation) · cash out: completely liquidating one's stake to exit a venture (equity / holdings / crypto) · liquidate: selling off non-cash assets, often under distress or corporate wind-up (assets / inventory / firm) · monetize: generating recurring commercial revenue from an uncommercialized asset (data / audience / traffic)
groups.nuance_zh: realize: 将账面浮盈或资产落实变现 (profits / assets) · cash in: 兑现筹码，或利用优势套取即期收益 (chips / investments / reputation) · cash out: 清仓套现出场 (equity / holdings / crypto) · liquidate: 强制清盘变卖资产或存货 (assets / inventory / firm) · monetize: 将流量、数据等无形资源探索商业化变现 (data / audience / traffic)

groups.name: Monopolize & Corner · 垄断与操纵 (Corner, Monopolize, Control)
groups.tip: 从占据优势到全面垄断

items.def_en: To gain complete control of a market, business opportunity, or deal so that others cannot participate
items.ex_en: The ambitious young entrepreneur managed to sew up the exclusive distribution contract yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 这位雄心勃勃的年轻企业家昨天成功搞定了独家分销合同。

items.def_en: To take or use more than one's fair share of something selfishly, preventing others from sharing it
items.ex_en: Do not hog the entire bathroom when everyone else is rushing for school.
items.ex_zh: 别人都急着去上学呢，你别一个人霸占整个浴室。

items.def_zh: 垄断（市场等）；将……逼入绝境，使走投无路
items.def_en: 1. To gain control of all or most of a particular stock, commodity, or market; monopolize. 2. To force a person or animal into a place from which escape is difficult or impossible.
items.ex_en: Speculators conspired to corner the domestic wheat market and artificially inflate grain prices.
items.ex_zh: 投机商密谋垄断国内小麦市场，人为哄抬粮食价格。

items.def_en: To buy up wholesale commodities in large quantities to secure a monopoly and raise prices
items.ex_en: Wealthy merchants attempted to engross local grain supplies during the severe wartime shortage.
items.ex_zh: 富商们企图在战时严重短缺期间囤积当地粮食以牟取暴利。

items.def_en: To obtain or maintain exclusive possession or complete control of a trade, market, or resource
items.ex_en: A single state-run conglomerate continues to monopolize the entire nationwide rail transit system.
items.ex_zh: 一家国有企业集团继续独占并垄断着整个全国铁路运输系统。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe aggressively seizing dominant control over a market, commodity, or supply to dictate terms or exclude competitors. While 'corner' emphasizes securing control of a limited supply, 'monopolize' refers to holding exclusive power over an entire sector.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过囤积或施加绝对控制来操纵、垄断市场或供应以排除竞争。
groups.desc_en: Denotes seizing exclusive or disproportionate control over supply, market access, or shared resources, contrasting with open competition through aggressive dominance.
groups.desc_zh: 指对供应、市场准入或公共资源攫取独占或极不成比例的掌控，以强势独霸区别于开放竞争。
groups.nuance_en: sew up: colloquially securing complete, impenetrable control or an agreement (market / deal / contract) · hog: selfishly taking up more than one's fair share of a shared resource (road / bandwidth / bathroom) · corner: buying up sufficient supply to dictate market prices (market / supply / wheat) · engross: historically buying up commodities in bulk before market to inflate prices (grain / market) · monopolize: exercising institutional or behavioral hegemony that excludes others (industry / conversation)
groups.nuance_zh: sew up: 口语指完全把控大局或敲定协议 (market / deal / contract) · hog: 贪婪独占或霸占公共资源 (road / bandwidth / bathroom) · corner: 囤积居奇以操纵市场行情 (market / supply / wheat) · engross: 历史上特指在上市前大宗囤积居奇 (grain / market) · monopolize: 形成垄断独占，排挤所有竞争者 (industry / conversation)

groups.name: Mooch & Solicit · 蹭要与索取小利 (Bum, Mooch, Scrounge)
groups.tip: 放低姿态向人求取物品

items.def_en: 1. (informal) To ask for and get something for free from someone. 2. ('bum around') To wander around lazily without doing useful work.
items.ex_en: Can I bum a cigarette from you while we wait for the bus?
items.ex_zh: 等车的时候我能找你白要一根烟抽吗？

items.def_en: To approach someone to ask for money, a loan, or a favor
items.ex_en: He had the audacity to hit up his distant relatives for another loan.
items.ex_zh: 他竟然厚着脸皮再次找远房亲戚开口借钱。

items.def_en: To obtain something from someone else without paying or working for it
items.ex_en: My lazy roommate always tries to mooch food instead of buying his own.
items.ex_zh: 我那懒散的室友总是想蹭别人的吃的，从不自己买。

items.def_en: To collect or obtain something scarce or needed by searching around or asking others
items.ex_en: We managed to scrounge a few folding chairs from neighboring classrooms for guests.
items.ex_zh: 我们好不容易从隔壁教室东凑西借了几把折叠椅给客人用。

items.def_en: To drain resources, money, or favors persistently from another like a parasite
items.ex_en: The grown son continued to leech off his elderly parents without seeking employment.
items.ex_zh: 那个成年儿子不去找工作，继续像寄生虫一样榨取年迈父母的钱财。

groups.summary_en: This colloquial frame highlights coaxing, cadging, or scrounging petty consumables (cigarettes, drinks, change) off friends or acquaintances without intent to repay.
groups.summary_zh: 指占便宜向熟人讨要烟酒零钱等小恩小惠。
groups.desc_en: Denotes acquiring small items, money, or sustenance from others without paying or reciprocating, contrasting with formal begging by exploiting social ties or opportunistic foraging.
groups.desc_zh: 指不付代价且不予互惠地向他人索取小额财物或蹭吃蹭喝，区别于正规乞讨，侧重利用社交关系或投机搜刮。
groups.nuance_en: bum: casually cadging a small disposable item from someone nearby (cigarette / ride / dollar) · hit up: directly asking someone for a loan, donation, or favor (friends / donor / boss) · mooch: persistently living off or borrowing from others without returning (food / off parents) · scrounge: foraging, hunting, or begging around resourcefully for scarce items (supplies / change / meal) · leech off: parasitically exploiting someone's wealth or hospitality long-term (host / relatives / system)
groups.nuance_zh: bum: 随手向人讨要小零碎 (cigarette / ride / dollar) · hit up: 直截了当开口借钱或索要赞助 (friends / donor / boss) · mooch: 蹭吃蹭喝、白嫖他人而不思回报 (food / off parents) · scrounge: 施展浑身解数四处搜罗、讨取急需物资 (supplies / change / meal) · leech off: 寄生虫般长期吸附榨取他人 (host / relatives / system)

groups.name: Moralize & Preach · 说教与好为人师 (Moralize, Preach, Sermonize)
groups.tip: 好为人师居高临下大谈道德教条

items.def_en: To talk to someone in an angry or dismissive way, reprimanding their conduct as if to a child
items.ex_en: My father began to lecture me angrily about punctuality after I arrived late.
items.ex_zh: 我迟到之后，父亲开始恼火地教训起我守时的重要性。

items.def_en: To give unwanted, patronizing moral advice to someone in a pious, self-righteous manner
items.ex_en: Nobody likes hanging out with colleagues who preach about personal lifestyle choices constantly.
items.ex_zh: 没人喜欢和那些整天就个人生活方式喋喋不休说教的同事待在一起。

items.def_en: To express moral judgments or talk about good and bad behavior in a self-righteous, lecturing way
items.ex_en: Critics argued the columnist used his platform to moralize rather than report facts.
items.ex_zh: 批评人士指出，这位专栏作家是在利用平台大发道德议论，而非报道事实。

items.def_zh: 布道般说教；发长篇大论
items.def_en: To deliver a pompous, tedious lecture on proper conduct to someone
items.ex_en: The headmaster began to sermonize pompously about traditional discipline during the morning assembly.
items.ex_zh: 校长在早会上开始煞有介事地就传统纪律发表冗长说教。

items.def_zh: 武断表态；自命不凡地宣讲
items.def_en: To express one's opinions in a dogmatic, pompous, or self-important manner
items.ex_en: The politician loved to pontificate on economic theory despite having no financial background.
items.ex_zh: 尽管毫无金融背景，那位政客却酷爱就经济理论自命不凡地高谈阔论。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey giving unsolicited, patronizing, or self-righteous ethical lectures, often causing irritation in the listener.
groups.summary_zh: 指自以为是地讲大道理、训诫或令人厌烦的说教。
groups.desc_en: Denotes offering unsolicited ethical instruction or expressing moral superiority, contrasting with objective teaching by assuming an intrusive, righteous stance.
groups.desc_zh: 指主动施加不请自来的道德训诫或展现道德优越感，区别于客观传授知识，带有居高临下的说教姿态。
groups.nuance_en: lecture: delivering a formal, condescending scolding or long speech (pupil / audience) · preach: aggressively advocating a dogma or moral stance to convert (virtue / sobriety / gospel) · moralize: passing unsolicited, self-righteous ethical judgments on ordinary conduct (behavior / youth) · sermonize: delivering tedious, sanctimonious moral lectures at length (congregation / flock) · pontificate: expressing dogmatic opinions pompously as if infallible (politics / ethics / matter)
groups.nuance_zh: lecture: 居高临下地训话或长篇大论说教 (pupil / audience) · preach: 极力布道宣扬某种道德信条 (virtue / sobriety / gospel) · moralize: 就寻常言行大发道德评判议论 (behavior / youth) · sermonize: 冗长乏味、道貌岸然地布道说教 (congregation / flock) · pontificate: 自命不凡地武断发表高见 (politics / ethics / matter)

groups.name: Mortgage & Pledge · 抵押与质押 (Mortgage, Pledge, Pawn)
groups.tip: 以财物作担保换贷款

items.def_zh: 抵押（借款）；以……为担保；使受拖累
items.def_en: 1. To give a lender the legal claim to property as security for a loan. 2. To pledge or put something at risk for future gains.
items.ex_en: To finance the new enterprise, the entrepreneur decided to mortgage his family home.
items.ex_zh: 为了给新企业筹资，这位创业者决定将自己的家宅抵押出去。

items.def_en: To give something valuable as a formal security deposit until a debt is paid.
items.ex_en: The borrower had to pledge company shares as collateral for the bank loan.
items.ex_zh: 借款人必须将公司股份质押，作为银行贷款的担保。

items.def_en: (formal/law) To pledge property as collateral without surrendering possession of it.
items.ex_en: The maritime shipping firm agreed to hypothecate its commercial vessels to secure credit.
items.ex_zh: 该海运公司同意在不转移占有的情况下抵押其商船，以获得信贷。

items.def_en: To change your mortgage provider or borrow extra money against your property.
items.ex_en: They opted to remortgage their suburban house to finance extensive home renovation projects.
items.ex_zh: 他们选择对郊区的房子进行重新抵押，以筹措大规模房屋翻修的资金。

items.def_en: To leave an article of personal property with a pawnbroker in exchange for borrowed cash.
items.ex_en: Desperate for rent money, he decided to pawn his grandfather's antique gold watch.
items.ex_zh: 因为急着用钱付房租，他决定把祖父留下的古董金表典当掉。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on transferring property rights or physical chattels to a creditor as a security pledge for borrowed money, risking forfeiture upon default.
groups.summary_zh: 将不动产或贵重动产典当、质押以获取借贷担保。
groups.desc_en: Denotes encumbering property or rights as collateral security for a debt, contrasting with outright selling by preserving an equity of redemption.
groups.desc_zh: 指将财产或权益作为债务担保进行抵押或质押，区别于直接出售，债务人保留赎回权。
groups.nuance_en: mortgage: legally conveying title of real property as debt security while retaining possession (house / property / future) · pledge: delivering an asset or promise formally as security or guarantee (shares / collateral / loyalty) · hypothecate: pledging an asset as collateral without transferring possession or title (revenues / securities) · remortgage: replacing an existing property loan with a new one, often to release equity (home / flat) · pawn: depositing personal physical goods with a pawnbroker for an immediate short-term loan (watch / jewelry / ring)
groups.nuance_zh: mortgage: 将不动产设押担保借款且保留使用权 (house / property / future) · pledge: 正式质押动产/权利，或郑重承诺 (shares / collateral / loyalty) · hypothecate: 设定浮动担保/抵押但不转移占有与物权 (revenues / securities) · remortgage: 房屋再按揭或转按揭以套现 (home / flat) · pawn: 将贵重随身细软押给当铺换取短期借款 (watch / jewelry / ring)

groups.name: Mothball & Postpone · 封存与搁置 (Shelve, Pigeonhole, Table)
groups.tip: 将项目搁置或封存设备

items.def_en: To postpone consideration of a motion or proposal indefinitely (especially US usage)
items.ex_en: The committee voted decisively to table the controversial infrastructure proposal until next year.
items.ex_zh: 委员会果断投票决定将这项颇具争议的基础设施提案暂缓审议至明年。

items.def_en: To postpone, delay, or keep a plan or project in an inactive state for a period of time
items.ex_en: Management decided to put the ambitious marketing project on ice for now.
items.ex_zh: 管理层决定暂时搁浅这项野心勃勃的营销项目。

items.def_en: To decide not to proceed with a project, proposal, or plan for the present or permanently
items.ex_en: Falling revenues forced the municipal council to shelve plans for the new library.
items.ex_zh: 财政收入下滑迫使市议会搁置了建设新图书馆的计划。

items.def_en: to put equipment, a facility, or a project into long-term storage or on hold, keeping it intact for possible future use.
items.ex_en: The navy chose to mothball three decommissioned frigates in case of future conflicts.
items.ex_zh: 海军决定封存三艘退役护卫舰，以备将来冲突之需。

items.def_en: To put aside a proposal, matter, or problem and intentionally neglect or defer taking action on it
items.ex_en: Bureaucrats often pigeonhole difficult citizen petitions rather than addressing the core problems directly.
items.ex_zh: 官僚们常常将棘手的公民请愿书束之高阁，而不直接解决核心问题。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this administrative frame describe placing operations, equipment, infrastructure, or policy initiatives into prolonged suspension while maintaining the capability to reactivate them later.
groups.summary_zh: 暂停并长期封存设施、项目或议案，留待未来重启处置。
groups.desc_en: Denotes suspending an active project, proposal, or equipment, contrasting with outright permanent cancellation by maintaining potential for future reactivation.
groups.desc_zh: 指将进行中的项目、提案或设备封存停顿，区别于彻底取消废除，保留了未来重启的可能性。
groups.nuance_en: table: postponing consideration of a legislative bill or proposal (motion / amendment / debate) · put on ice: temporarily freezing progress on an initiative pending developments (deal / project / plans) · shelve: setting aside a project indefinitely due to impracticality or lack of funds (plans / merger / project) · mothball: decommissioning physical assets into safe long-term preservation for future use (fleet / plant / ships) · pigeonhole: setting aside and neglecting an issue, often to deliberately forget it (bill / report / file)
groups.nuance_zh: table: 议事程序中暂时搁置动议不予审议 (motion / amendment / debate) · put on ice: 鉴于当前局势而将某事暂且冻结缓办 (deal / project / plans) · shelve: 因条件不成熟而无限期搁置计划 (plans / merger / project) · mothball: 将重资产或工厂妥善封存备用 (fleet / plant / ships) · pigeonhole: 将文件或提案束之高阁、刻意遗忘 (bill / report / file)

groups.name: Motion & Direct by Gesture · 手势指引与示意 (Motion, Gesture, Signal)
groups.tip: 借肢体手势动作传情达意

items.def_en: to extend a finger or hand to show someone a specific direction or location
items.ex_en: The guide pointed toward the distant mountain ridge to show the hidden trail.
items.ex_zh: 向导指向远处的山脊，指出那条隐秘的小径。

items.def_en: to make a movement or sound that sends a specific instruction or piece of information to someone
items.ex_en: The traffic officer signaled for the approaching freight trucks to halt immediately.
items.ex_zh: 交警示意疾驰而来的货车立即停下。

items.def_en: to make a movement of the hand, head, or body to give someone an instruction or direction
items.ex_en: The manager motioned for the nervous candidate to take a seat near the window.
items.ex_zh: 经理打手势示意紧张的应聘者在窗边的座位坐下。

items.def_en: to move your hands, head, or arms to express an idea, instruction, or feeling
items.ex_en: She gestured toward the open terrace, inviting the guests to step outside.
items.ex_zh: 她做手势指向开阔的露台，邀请宾客们移步室外。

items.def_en: to politely guide or direct someone where to go, often using sweeping hand gestures
items.ex_en: The courteous attendant ushered the elderly patrons to their reserved front-row seats.
items.ex_zh: 彬彬有礼的服务员引领上了年纪的顾客前往预留的前排座位。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on using bodily gestures—typically of the hands, head, or eyes—to direct someone's movement, indicate a seat, or convey a specific non-verbal instruction. They emphasize instructional direction rather than merely saying hello.
groups.summary_zh: 指用手势或眼神指引他人移动、就座或遵照具体无声指令行动。
groups.desc_en: Denotes guiding someone or conveying spatial directions through physical body language, contrasting with spoken commands by relying on silent, visual cues.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过肢体语言引导他人行动或指示空间方向，区别于口头指令，依赖无声的视觉示意。
groups.nuance_en: point: extending a finger or object directly toward a focal target (finger / direction / gun) · signal: using a deliberate standardized sign or gesture to convey information (turn / start / referee) · motion: moving a hand or head to prompt someone to move somewhere (forward / to a seat / silence) · gesture: expressive, non-verbal body movement communicating an attitude or intent (hands / impatience) · usher: actively guiding or escorting someone along a physical path (guest / into room / era)
groups.nuance_zh: point: 用手指或物体直接指向目标焦点 (finger / direction / gun) · signal: 发出约定俗成的信号或手势 (turn / start / referee) · motion: 招手或扬头示意某人移动 (forward / to a seat / silence) · gesture: 用手势表达某种态度、情绪或意图 (hands / impatience) · usher: 躬身带路引领引导就座或入场 (guest / into room / era)

groups.name: Mount & Ready Weaponry · 装置弹药与搭弦就位 (Nock, Mount, Prime)
groups.tip: 把箭尾准确扣上弓弦待发

items.def_en: To fit or press a mechanical part, valve, or round firmly and accurately into place
items.ex_en: The mechanic carefully seated the brass valve into the cylinder block.
items.ex_zh: 机械师小心翼翼地将黄铜阀门稳稳压入汽缸体中。

items.def_en: To set up or fix a weapon, camera, or piece of equipment firmly in place for use
items.ex_en: Soldiers mounted the heavy machine gun onto the armored vehicle before dawn.
items.ex_zh: 士兵们在黎明前将重机枪架设在装甲车上。

items.def_en: To insert a cartridge into the firing chamber of a firearm ready to be shot
items.ex_en: With steady hands, the lone sentry chambered a round into his rifle.
items.ex_zh: 孤单的哨兵沉着地将一枚子弹推入步枪枪膛。

items.def_en: To tilt, set, or raise the hammer of a gun back into firing position
items.ex_en: The duelist paused, slowly cocked the hammer, and awaited the final signal.
items.ex_zh: 决斗者停顿了一下，缓缓扳上击锤，等待最后的信号。

items.def_zh: 把（箭）搭在弦上；在……上刻凹痕
items.def_en: 1. To fit the notched end of an arrow onto a bowstring ready for shooting. 2. To make a notch in something.
items.ex_en: Drawing a deep breath, the archer nocked a black-fletched arrow onto the string.
items.ex_zh: 深吸一口气后，弓箭手将一支黑羽箭搭在了弓弦上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe seating, fitting, or locking a projectile, weapon, or component into its designated firing position or launch apparatus so it stands ready for discharge.
groups.summary_zh: 指将箭、弹药或部件对位卡入发射装置，使其处于待发就位状态。
groups.desc_en: Denotes seating, arming, or preparing a weapon or projectile into full firing readiness, contrasting with generic loading by emphasizing mechanical alignment for discharge.
groups.desc_zh: 指将武器或弹药装填、搭弦并调整至待击发的临战状态，区别于普通的搬运装载，强调就位即可发射的机械锁闭。
groups.nuance_en: seat: pushing a projectile or cartridge firmly into its final proper position (bullet / round / primer) · mount: affixing a weapon onto a stable support or platform (gun / cannon / optics) · chamber: moving a cartridge from magazine directly into the firing chamber (round / cartridge / shell) · cock: drawing back the firing hammer or bolt to make ready for discharge (hammer / pistol / trigger) · nock: setting the notched tail of an arrow onto the bowstring (arrow / string)
groups.nuance_zh: seat: 将弹头或底火严丝合缝地压入推杆定位 (bullet / round / primer) · mount: 将重武器安装固定在枪架或底座上 (gun / cannon / optics) · chamber: 将子弹从弹匣推入枪膛就位 (round / cartridge / shell) · cock: 扳起击锤或拉动枪栓至待发位置 (hammer / pistol / trigger) · nock: 将箭尾的箭扣卡入弓弦 (arrow / string)

groups.name: Multitasking & Juggling Demands · 协调多务与应付周旋 (Balance, Juggle, Keep in the air)
groups.tip: 用双手灵活操控或应付

items.def_zh: 平衡，兼顾（多项职责或需求）
items.def_en: Give equal attention or appropriate priority to competing commitments, needs, or duties
items.ex_en: Working parents constantly strive to balance demanding careers with important family obligations.
items.ex_zh: 在职父母一直在努力平衡繁重的工作与重要的家庭责任。
items.ex2_en: Their competing interests balanced over time without any formal intervention.
items.ex2_zh: 随着时间的推移，他们相互冲突的利益自然达成了平衡。

items.def_zh: 频繁调换，随机倒换（日程或任务）
items.def_en: Reorder, shift, or manipulate schedules and duties continuously to accommodate demands
items.ex_en: The store supervisor had to shuffle shift assignments to cover sudden employee absences.
items.ex_zh: 店长不得不重新倒换班次，以应对员工突如其来的缺勤。

items.def_zh: 维持，应付（多项繁杂事务不致断档）
items.def_en: Manage to sustain a rapid tempo of simultaneous commitments without failing
items.ex_en: She found it exhausting to keep up with multiple freelance projects simultaneously.
items.ex_zh: 她发现要同时兼顾多项自由职业项目令人精疲力竭。

items.def_zh: 多任务处理，同时处理多项事务
items.def_en: Perform more than one activity, project, or role at the same time
items.ex_en: Modern office workers are frequently expected to multitask across various digital platforms efficiently.
items.ex_zh: 现代上班族往往需要能够高效地在多个数字平台之间进行多任务处理。

items.def_zh: 耍弄，玩杂耍（抛接物体）；同时兼顾，巧妙应付
items.def_en: 1. To keep several objects in the air at the same time by tossing and catching them. 2. To manage several activities, responsibilities, or requirements at the same time.
items.ex_en: The young entrepreneur struggled to juggle product development and daily customer service.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻的创业者竭力兼顾产品研发与日常客户服务。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures handling, balancing, and shuffling multiple conflicting obligations, tasks, or resources simultaneously, requiring continuous dexterity and prioritization to prevent collapse.
groups.summary_zh: 指同时巧妙兼顾、周旋处理多项繁复任务或相互冲突的职责。
groups.desc_en: Denotes coping simultaneously with multiple competing responsibilities or roles, contrasting with plain 'manage' or 'work' by foregrounding the precarious mental dexterity needed to keep everything moving without dropping any single task.
groups.desc_zh: 指同时应对多项相互竞争的职责或角色，与单纯的“管理”或“工作”不同，它强调维持动态平衡、防止任一环节脱节落空的敏捷周旋感。
groups.nuance_en: juggle: handling multiple demanding commitments concurrently under precarious balance (jobs / responsibilities / schedules) · balance: weighing and distributing attention equally between opposing priorities (work and life / budget / demands) · multitask: performing multiple operational activities at the exact same time (duties / assignments / threads) · keep up: sustaining the pace required by relentless demands (appearances / payments / workload) · shuffle: constantly rearranging tasks or priorities to get by (schedules / priorities / papers)
groups.nuance_zh: juggle: 在多项繁重事务间艰难周旋应付 (jobs / responsibilities / schedules) · balance: 在对立诉求间权衡兼顾与平抑 (work and life / budget / demands) · multitask: 同一时间内并行处理多项任务 (duties / assignments / threads) · keep up: 勉力跟上不间断的负荷与节奏 (appearances / payments / workload) · shuffle: 反复调配打乱以变通应付 (schedules / priorities / papers)

groups.name: Mumble & Slur · 咕哝与含糊不清 (Slur, Mumble, Mutter)
groups.tip: 口齿不清且音节粘连含混

items.def_en: To form words with the lips without uttering clear sound, or to speak insincerely and indistinctly
items.ex_en: Unable to speak aloud during the performance, she mouthed a quiet warning.
items.ex_zh: 演出期间无法大声说话，她便做了口型给出无声的警告。

items.def_zh: 含糊不清地发音，含糊地念；诋毁，诽谤
items.def_en: 1. To pronounce words unclearly or indistinctly so that the sounds run together. 2. To make an insulting remark that damages someone's reputation.
items.ex_en: Exhausted and feverish, the wounded soldier could only slur a few disjointed syllables.
items.ex_zh: 精疲力竭且发着高烧的伤兵只能含糊不清地吐出几个零碎的音节。

items.def_en: To speak in a low, unclear voice with the mouth barely open
items.ex_en: He lowered his gaze and mumbled a brief apology before hurrying away.
items.ex_zh: 他垂下目光，嘟囔了一句简短的道歉后便匆匆离开了。

items.def_en: To say something in a quiet, indistinct voice, often in complaint or irritation
items.ex_en: The dissatisfied patron muttered quiet complaints about the cold soup under his breath.
items.ex_zh: 不满的顾客低声嘀咕着抱怨汤太凉。

items.def_en: To distort or jumble speech or a message so much that it becomes incomprehensible
items.ex_en: Poor transmission lines garbled the dispatcher's urgent instructions to the field crew.
items.ex_zh: 糟糕的传输线路彻底弄乱了调度员向外勤人员发出的紧急指令。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe producing speech where phonetic boundaries blur and syllables run together indistinctly, caused by intoxication, tiredness, shyness, or speech impediments.
groups.summary_zh: 因含糊、醉酒或说话不清导致音节混杂或吐字难以辨识。
groups.desc_en: Denotes producing indistinct, garbled, or low-volume speech, contrasting with plain 'speak' or 'whisper' by highlighting articulation failure, mouth immobility, or deliberate unintelligibility.
groups.desc_zh: 指发出含糊、走样或音量极低的话音，与普通的“说话”或“低语”不同，它侧重于发音器官活动不全、吐字不清或刻意让人难以听清。
groups.nuance_en: mumble: speaking indistinctly with a low, inward voice and motionless lips (excuse / apology / answer) · mutter: grumbling or complaining under one's breath in dissatisfaction (complaint / curse / threat) · slur: running syllables together through impairment or fatigue (words / speech / syllables) · garble: distorting a message into confusion or incoherence (message / transmission / instructions) · mouth: forming words silently with the lips without phonation (words / lyrics / platitudes)
groups.nuance_zh: mumble: 嘴唇微动、声音向内吞吐地咕哝 (excuse / apology / answer) · mutter: 不满或怨怼地低声嘟囔抱怨 (complaint / curse / threat) · slur: 因醉酒、困倦或病理导致的字句含混黏连 (words / speech / syllables) · garble: 将信息、语音曲解歪曲至混乱难懂 (message / transmission / instructions) · mouth: 仅动嘴皮而不发声地做嘴型 (words / lyrics / platitudes)

groups.name: Mural & Wall Painting · 壁画与湿壁画绘制 (Fresco, Mural, Stencil)
groups.tip: 美术技艺，在壁面创作

items.def_zh: 在墙壁上作画；绘制壁画
items.def_en: To execute or apply a large painting or decorative design directly onto a wall surface
items.ex_en: Local artists gathered each weekend to mural the barren walls of the alleyway.
items.ex_zh: 当地艺术家每逢周末便齐聚一堂，在光秃秃的巷壁上绘制壁画。

items.def_en: To draw or spray paint unauthorized words or images on a public wall or structure
items.ex_en: Reckless vandals graffitied the historic bridge with spray paint late last night.
items.ex_zh: 昨晚深夜，鲁莽的破坏者用喷漆在历史悠久的大桥上胡乱涂鸦。

items.def_en: To cover a decorative surface, molding, or painted surface with a thin layer of gold leaf or paint
items.ex_en: Skilled artisans worked meticulously to gild the ornate plaster moldings of the ballroom.
items.ex_zh: 技艺娴熟的工匠细致地为舞厅华丽的石膏饰条贴上金箔。

items.def_en: 1. (art) To paint a picture directly onto fresh, wet plaster on a wall or ceiling.
items.ex_en: The Renaissance master spent months frescoing the cathedral ceiling with heavenly scenes.
items.ex_zh: 这位文艺复兴大师花了数月时间在教堂天花板上绘制展现天堂盛景的湿壁画。

items.def_zh: 用模版印刷图案；模印涂绘
items.def_en: To apply designs, letters, or shapes onto a surface by brushing ink or paint through a cut-out pattern
items.ex_en: She used durable templates to stencil geometric patterns across the wooden floor.
items.ex_zh: 她使用结实的模版在木地板上模印出几何图案。

groups.summary_en: This specialized fine-arts frame focuses on applying artistic imagery, decorative designs, or pigments onto architectural surfaces such as interior walls, ceilings, and plasterwork using specific architectural and decorative techniques.
groups.summary_zh: 特指在建筑墙体、灰泥或天花板等基面上运用特定工艺绘制壁画与图案。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the artistic application of pigment, design, or leafing directly onto architectural surfaces, contrasting with portable canvas painting through scale, permanence, and physical integration with the substrate.
groups.desc_zh: 指直接在建筑物墙面或基底上施加颜料、图案或金属薄片，与便携式架上绘画不同，它强调宏大体量、永久性以及与墙体物理结构的共生关系。
groups.nuance_en: fresco: painting directly into fresh, wet lime plaster so pigments chemically bond (ceiling / wall / plaster) · mural: executing a large-scale artistic composition across a wall (façade / alley / lobby) · stencil: applying designs through cut-out template sheets for sharp reproduction (pattern / lettering / motif) · graffiti: spray-painting or scrawling marks, often illicitly, on urban walls (tag / subway car / overpass) · gild: coating a decorative wall surface with a thin layer of gold leaf (trim / frame / molding)
groups.nuance_zh: fresco: 趁石膏湿润时使颜料渗入基底的湿壁画法 (ceiling / wall / plaster) · mural: 在大幅墙体上绘制大型主题画作 (façade / alley / lobby) · stencil: 借助镂空模板印制规整图案或文字 (pattern / lettering / motif) · graffiti: （常指未经许可在城市表面）涂鸦或喷涂标语 (tag / subway car / overpass) · gild: 在墙体线脚或装饰表面贴金箔 (trim / frame / molding)

groups.name: Murmur & Chatter · 喃喃与絮语 (Babble, Gabble, Prattle)
groups.tip: 压低声音含混不清地自语

items.def_en: To talk informally, easily, and continuously about trivial or everyday matters
items.ex_en: The teenagers sat by the pool and chattered happily about their summer plans.
items.ex_zh: 青少年们坐在泳池边，欢快地闲聊着他们的暑期计划。

items.def_en: To talk quickly in a way that is confused, foolish, or difficult to understand
items.ex_en: Overcome with excitement, the toddler began to babble incoherently to her mother.
items.ex_zh: 兴奋不已的幼儿开始语无伦次地对妈妈咿呀学语。

items.def_en: To talk a great deal about unimportant things in an idle or childish manner
items.ex_en: The careless courtiers prattled endlessly about court gossip during the somber banquet.
items.ex_zh: 在肃穆的宴会上，心不在焉的侍臣们没完没了地闲扯着宫廷八卦。

items.def_zh: 嘟嘟囔囔地说，连珠炮似地念叨；发出潺潺声，作汩汩响
items.def_en: 1. To speak rapidly, excitedly, or foolishly for a long time. 2. (of water) To make a continuous soft, bubbling sound.
items.ex_en: The excited boy burbled endless stories about the animals he saw yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 兴奋的小男孩连珠炮似地念叨着他昨天见到的动物。

items.def_en: To speak so fast and indistinctly that others cannot understand clearly
items.ex_en: Panicking in the sudden dark, the frightened clerk could only gabble incoherently.
items.ex_zh: 在突如其来的黑暗中陷入恐慌，受惊的职员只能急促含糊地乱喊。

groups.summary_en: Highlights continuous, rapid, or inconsequential flow of speech resembling running water or childish babble. Contrasts rambling nonsense with cheerful stream-like babbling.
groups.summary_zh: 表示滔滔不绝、含糊或孩子气地絮叨，常比作流水潺潺。
groups.desc_en: Denotes rapid, superficial, or continuous vocalization, contrasting with substantive 'talk' by highlighting either childish nonsense, trivial chatter, or flowing, water-like acoustic rhythm over intellectual content.
groups.desc_zh: 指快速、肤浅或持续不断的说话发声，与严肃的“交谈”不同，它突显童稚无义、琐碎絮叨或如流水潺潺般的声响节奏，而非信息实质。
groups.nuance_en: chatter: talking rapidly, casually, and incessantly about trivial matters (monkeys / teenagers / teeth) · babble: talking incoherently, rapidly, or without sense like an infant (child / stream / patient) · prattle: talking childishly or at tedious length about insignificant trifles (gossip / child / caller) · gabble: speaking so rapidly and indistinctly that words run together (auctioneer / crowd / commentator) · burble: murmuring or speaking with an effusive, gurgling flow (creek / enthusiast / speaker)
groups.nuance_zh: chatter: 喋喋不休地闲聊琐事或牙齿打颤 (monkeys / teenagers / teeth) · babble: 如幼儿般胡言乱语或声音如流水潺潺 (child / stream / patient) · prattle: 幼稚空洞且没完没了地絮语 (gossip / child / caller) · gabble: 急促混乱、语无伦次地快说 (auctioneer / crowd / commentator) · burble: 语气奔涌、如冒泡般欢跃絮叨 (creek / enthusiast / speaker)

groups.name: Muscle & Force Passage · 挤入与凭力硬闯 (Muscle, Elbow, Barge)
groups.tip: 施加蛮力强行挤入通过

items.def_en: To insinuate or move oneself slowly and persistently into a tight space or exclusive organization
items.ex_en: The opportunistic lobbyist attempted to worm his way into the exclusive inner circle.
items.ex_zh: 那个投机的说客企图钻营混入排外的核心圈子。

items.def_en: To force a route through a dense crowd by pushing people aside with one's elbows
items.ex_en: Commuters had to elbow their way onto the crowded morning subway car.
items.ex_zh: 通勤者不得不硬用手肘挤进早高峰拥挤的地铁车厢。

items.def_en: To force a passage through a crowd by thrusting with one's shoulders
items.ex_en: The tall traveler managed to shoulder his way through the bustling station concourse.
items.ex_zh: 那位身材高大的旅客用肩膀硬挤着穿过了熙熙攘攘的车站大厅。

items.def_zh: 硬挤，强行推入；施加蛮力（介入）
items.def_en: To move, force, or elbow one's way into a place or situation through sheer strength or determination.
items.ex_en: Several aggressive hedge funds tried to muscle into the highly lucrative tech market.
items.ex_zh: 几家激进的对冲基金试图凭借雄厚财力强行挤入利润丰厚的科技市场。

items.def_en: To move forward aggressively and clumsily, knocking into people or obstacles along the way
items.ex_en: The impatient customer barged straight into the busy kitchen without knocking first.
items.ex_zh: 那个不耐烦的顾客连门都没敲就猛冲进了忙碌的厨房。

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies using raw physical power or aggressive bodily intrusion to carve a path through crowds, obstacles, or entrenched social circles.
groups.summary_zh: 凭借蛮力强行穿过人群拥挤处，或硬闯进某封闭圈子。
groups.desc_en: Denotes physically or socially forcing one's way into a tight, occupied space, contrasting with plain 'enter' or 'push' by highlighting rude, bodily exertion and the displacement of others.
groups.desc_zh: 指凭借身体蛮力或粗暴手段硬挤进狭窄或被占据的空间，与平缓的“进入”或普通“推”不同，它强调强行排开他人、蛮横破除阻力的身体侵入感。
groups.nuance_en: muscle: using brute force, leverage, or aggression to displace others (way in / into the market / past guards) · barge: moving forward heavily, clumsily, and intrusively without invitation (into the room / through the door / in) · elbow one's way: using pointed joints to aggressively shove past people in a dense crowd (through the crowd / to the front / forward) · shoulder one's way: using broad upper-body mass to push firmly past obstacles (aside / through the throng / past) · worm one's way into: maneuvering slyly, insidiously, and incrementally into an enclosed position (confidence / organization / inner circle)
groups.nuance_zh: muscle: 凭借强横势力或蛮力强行挤入或排挤 (way in / into the market / past guards) · barge: 冒失粗暴、不打招呼地横冲直撞 (into the room / through the door / in) · elbow one's way: 用肘部在拥挤人群中蛮横推搡开道 (through the crowd / to the front / forward) · shoulder one's way: 用肩膀宽厚的体格硬顶推挤向前 (aside / through the throng / past) · worm one's way into: 像钻洞般钻营隐秘地讨好钻入 (confidence / organization / inner circle)

groups.name: Musical Accord & Agreement · 和弦与融洽 (Harmonize, Blend, Chime in)
groups.tip: 声音或关系融洽一致

items.def_en: (+ with) To join in vocally, or express agreement with what is being said
items.ex_en: Several board members chimed in with supportive comments during the final budget review.
items.ex_zh: 在最后的预算审查中，几位董事会成员纷纷出言附和表示支持。

items.def_en: To combine smoothly into a cohesive, pleasing musical or tonal whole
items.ex_en: The rich tones of the cello and violin blend into a warm harmony.
items.ex_zh: 大提琴与小提琴醇厚的音色交融在一起，汇成温暖和谐的旋律。
items.ex2_en: The sound engineer carefully blended the cello and violin tracks together.
items.ex2_zh: 音响工程师仔细地将大提琴和小提琴的音轨融合在一起。

items.def_zh: 与……协调，和谐一致；弹奏和弦
items.def_en: 1. To harmonize or be in accord with something. 2. (music) To play or arrange in musical chords.
items.ex_en: The solemn architecture seemed to chord beautifully with the somber mood of the city.
items.ex_zh: 肃穆的建筑群似乎与这座城市低沉的氛围达到了绝妙的和谐一致。

items.def_en: (+ with) To sing, play, or sound in musical concord; to cause distinct parts to blend pleasingly
items.ex_en: The backup singers harmonized seamlessly with the lead vocalist during the emotional ballad.
items.ex_zh: 在那首深情的民谣中，伴唱与主唱完美和谐地融为一体。
items.ex2_en: The clever choir director harmonized the contrasting voices into a stunning chorus.
items.ex2_zh: 聪明的合唱团指挥将截然不同的声音协调成了动人的合唱。

items.def_en: (+ to) To adjust musical pitch accurately, or bring thoughts and feelings into sympathetic rapport
items.ex_en: The conductor worked tirelessly to attune the orchestra to the soloist's subtle phrasing.
items.ex_zh: 指挥不知疲倦地使整个管弦乐团与独奏家的微妙乐句协调合拍。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe musical sound blending into pleasant harmony or, metaphorically, ideas and sentiments resonating smoothly in agreement. Collocates include voices, tones, chords, and parallel opinions.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重音乐和声的共鸣协调，或隐喻意见与基调的高度契合。
groups.desc_en: Denotes acoustic alignment or psychological concord, contrasting with generic 'agree' or 'match' by using the metaphor of pitch and chord resonance to signify seamless aesthetic or interpersonal unity.
groups.desc_zh: 指声音的谐和或人际思想的融洽无间，与普通的“赞同”或“匹配”不同，它借用声学音高与和弦共振的隐喻，强调无缝的美学交融与默契呼应。
groups.nuance_en: harmonize: combining distinct musical voices or disparate elements into a pleasing whole (voices / flavors / colors) · blend: merging separate acoustic or physical qualities until individual boundaries dissolve (sounds / instruments / ingredients) · chime in: interrupting or joining an ongoing conversation to interject supportive remarks (agreement / support / comments) · attune: adjusting perception or tone to resonate sympathetically with another (ear / senses / instrument) · chord: sounding harmonious notes simultaneously to produce a rich composite tone (notes / strings / voices)
groups.nuance_zh: harmonize: 使不同声部或相异要素协调交融为悦耳整体 (voices / flavors / colors) · blend: 浑然交融以至边界消融 (sounds / instruments / ingredients) · chime in: 插话附和或中途加入呼应 (agreement / support / comments) · attune: 调谐感官或乐器以达成同频共鸣 (ear / senses / instrument) · chord: 弹奏和弦以产生共鸣协和音 (notes / strings / voices)

groups.name: Nag & Badger · 唠叨催逼与训斥 (Nag, Badger, Pester)
groups.tip: 没完没了念叨挑刺、数落责备

items.def_zh: 唠叨，数落，对……唠叨不休；使烦恼，折磨
items.def_en: 1. (+ at/about) To annoy someone by constantly criticizing them, complaining, or asking them to do something. 2. (of pain or worry) To cause persistent discomfort or anxiety.
items.ex_en: His parents would continually nag him about finishing his college applications on time.
items.ex_zh: 他的父母总是没完没了地唠叨他按时完成大学申请。

items.def_en: To trouble or annoy someone persistently with frequent, irritating interruptions or requests
items.ex_en: Persistent telemarketers pester busy homeowners with unwanted promotional calls every single evening.
items.ex_zh: 顽固的电话推销员每天傍晚都用不需要的推销电话烦扰忙碌的房主。

items.def_en: To repeatedly pester or harass someone with questions, requests, or demands
items.ex_en: Reporters continued to badger the mayor for answers regarding the ongoing corruption scandal.
items.ex_zh: 记者们不断纠缠市长，催促其就正在发酵的腐败丑闻给出答复。

items.def_en: To continually harass, dominate, and find fault with one's partner
items.ex_en: He felt his domineering partner would constantly henpeck him over minor household matters.
items.ex_zh: 他觉得专横的伴侣总是因为琐碎的家务事对他唠叨辖制。

items.def_en: To remonstrate with or rebuke someone angrily for wrongdoing
items.ex_en: The strict teacher paused to scold the pupils for whispering during silent reading.
items.ex_zh: 严厉的老师停下讲课，训斥了在静读时间低声耳语的学生。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve persistent verbal harassment, petty scolding, and annoying demands intended to prod, criticize, or compel someone into compliance.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过持续唠叨、挑剔抱怨或纠缠施压来迫使他人顺从。
groups.desc_en: Denotes wearisome, persistent badgering or scolding to extract compliance, contrasting with 'ask' or 'criticize' by highlighting exhausting repetition, petty focus, and emotional friction.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过无休止的烦人催促或数落来逼迫对方顺从，与普通的“请求”或“批评”不同，它突显磨人的重复性、琐碎针对性与持续施加的心理消耗。
groups.nuance_en: nag: perpetually finding fault, complaining, or urging someone to do a chore (spouse / kids / conscience) · badger: persistently harrying or grilling someone with relentless requests (witness / official / boss) · pester: annoying someone repeatedly with petty demands or unwanted intrusions (tourists / parents / neighbors) · scold: rebuking someone angrily and authoritative-fashion for wrongdoing (child / pupil / dog) · henpeck: continually browbeating and intimidating a partner through petty domineering (husband / mate)
groups.nuance_zh: nag: 没完没了地挑剔、唠叨琐事催促 (spouse / kids / conscience) · badger: 穷追不舍地盘问或纠缠施压 (witness / official / boss) · pester: 讨人嫌地频繁打扰或纠缠索要 (tourists / parents / neighbors) · scold: 居高临下、声色俱厉地斥责责备 (child / pupil / dog) · henpeck: 长期对伴侣进行琐屑而专横的管束压制 (husband / mate)

groups.name: Nail & Ace · 拔得头筹与出色发挥 (Breeze through, Crush, Nail)
groups.tip: 达成目标并取得佳绩

items.def_en: (informal) To do exceptionally well at a performance, presentation, or challenge
items.ex_en: The rookie pitcher managed to crush the challenging final inning without allowing a run.
items.ex_zh: 这名新秀投手漂亮拿下了极具挑战性的最后一局，未失一分。

items.def_en: (informal) To perform, execute, or complete something successfully and flawlessly
items.ex_en: With months of diligent practice, the gymnast nailed her complex uneven bars routine.
items.ex_zh: 经过数月的刻苦训练，这位体操运动员完美搞定了高低杠的高难动作。

items.def_en: To pass an exam or overcome a challenge effortlessly and quickly
items.ex_en: Thanks to thorough preparation, she managed to breeze through the difficult certification exam.
items.ex_zh: 得益于充分的准备，她轻松通过了难度颇高的资格认证考试。

items.def_zh: 顺利通过；毫无困难地完成
items.def_en: To succeed in a test or stage of an endeavor smoothly without stumbling
items.ex_en: With weeks of preparation, she sailed through the final exam.
items.ex_zh: 经过数周的充分准备，她轻而易举地通过了期末考试。

items.def_zh: 在……中表现极其优异，轻松取得高分；（网球）发球直接得分
items.def_en: (informal) To achieve an exceptionally high score in a test, interview, or competition; to perform brilliantly.
items.ex_en: The diligent student was thrilled to ace the grueling chemistry final this morning.
items.ex_zh: 勤奋的学生因在今天上午艰难的化学期末考中取得优异成绩而欣喜若狂。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this informal frame describe flawlessly executing a test, audition, challenge, or performance, yielding superior results with apparent ease.
groups.summary_zh: 指完美通过考验、出色发挥并大获全胜的口语动词群。
groups.desc_en: Denotes executing a challenging performance, test, or task with superlative skill or effortless ease, contrasting with basic 'pass' or 'succeed' by emphasizing flawless precision or crushing dominance.
groups.desc_zh: 指以极高水准或游刃有余的轻松姿态完成高难度考验、演练或任务，与普通的“通过”或“成功”不同，它强调无可挑剔的精准度或压倒性的出色表现。
groups.nuance_en: nail: executing a specific difficult maneuver, cue, or delivery with pinpoint precision (audition / landing / routine) · ace: earning a top-tier mark on a test or competition through mastery (exam / interview / test) · crush: overwhelmingly outperforming or dominating a competitive challenge (competition / opponent / performance) · breeze through: passing through a rigorous ordeal with complete, casual ease (interview / checkpoints / exam) · sail through: progressing unimpeded through an administrative hurdle or trial without friction (process / parliament / trial)
groups.nuance_zh: nail: 精准无误、丝毫不差地完美完成动作或表演 (audition / landing / routine) · ace: 凭借高超水准在测试中一举斩获最高分 (exam / interview / test) · crush: 以压倒性优势战胜对手或震撼全场 (competition / opponent / performance) · breeze through: 轻松自如、毫不费力地渡过难关 (interview / checkpoints / exam) · sail through: 如顺水推舟般毫无阻碍地顺利通过审查或程序 (process / parliament / trial)

groups.name: Name & Christen · 命名与受洗 (Dub, Baptize, Denominate)
groups.tip: 主持洗礼仪式正式命名，赋予船只名称

items.def_en: To give a specific name to a child, animal, enterprise, or object
items.ex_en: The proud parents chose to name their newborn daughter after her great-grandmother.
items.ex_zh: 自豪的父母决定用曾祖母的名字来给他们刚出生的女儿命名。

items.def_en: To give someone or something a particular unofficial name, descriptive nickname, or title
items.ex_en: Enthusiastic sports journalists dubbed the swift young runner the lightning bolt of track.
items.ex_zh: 热情的体育记者将这位迅捷的年轻短跑选手封为田径场上的闪电。

items.def_en: To administer the Christian sacrament of initiation using water, often giving a personal name in the rite
items.ex_en: The parish priest prepared to baptize the infant before the gathered congregation Sunday.
items.ex_zh: 教区牧师准备在周日聚集的会众面前为这名婴儿施洗礼。

items.def_zh: 为……施洗礼并命名；命名，给……起名字；初次使用
items.def_en: 1. To officially baptize and give a name to a baby in a Christian ceremony; to give a name to someone or a vessel. 2. (informal) To use something for the first time.
items.ex_en: The shipping company gathered dignitaries to christen the massive new ocean research vessel.
items.ex_zh: 航运公司召集要员，为这艘庞大的新型远洋科考船举行命名启航仪式。

items.def_en: To formally designate, name, or classify someone or something with an official label
items.ex_en: Ecologists formally denominate this fragile wetland as a critical biodiversity conservation zone.
items.ex_zh: 生态学家正式将这片脆弱的湿地命名为关键的生物多样性保护区。

groups.summary_en: This scenario covers conferring a formal name, ceremonial title, or ceremonial initiation on a person, object, or vessel. It ranges from religious rites of baptism to secular renaming and affectionate moniker creation.
groups.summary_zh: 在宗教仪式中洗礼起名，或以特定称号、昵称正式命名事物。
groups.desc_en: Denotes bestowing a formal name, title, or spiritual identity onto an entity, contrasting with generic 'call' or 'label' through ritual solemnity, baptismal authority, or legal/episcopal conferral.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过仪式或正式权力赋予某实体法定名称、称号或精神身份，与随意的“称呼”或“贴标签”不同，它强调仪式庄严性、洗礼特权或受命定名的制度效力。
groups.nuance_en: name: assigning an official individual identity or title (child / successor / replacement) · christen: ceremonially dedicating and naming a baby or ship with water (baby / ship / yacht) · baptize: ritually immersing or sprinkling someone as admission into the Christian church (convert / infant / believer) · dub: playfully, knightfully, or colloquially bestowing an epithet or status upon someone (knight / hero / 'The Boss') · denominate: classifying or specifying money or terms under an official categorical unit (currency / bonds / groups)
groups.nuance_zh: name: 赋予正式的人名、物名或指认接班人 (child / successor / replacement) · christen: 在洗礼或掷瓶仪式上为婴儿或船只正式命名 (baby / ship / yacht) · baptize: 施洗以确立教籍或予以精神洗礼 (convert / infant / believer) · dub: （如封爵般）赋予荣誉头衔或外号绰号 (knight / hero / 'The Boss') · denominate: 以特定面额、货币或类别名称对资产定名标价 (currency / bonds / groups)

groups.name: Narrate & Recount · 叙述与讲述 (Narrate, Recount, Relate)
groups.tip: 按次序道来亲身经历或故事

items.def_en: To give an account of something that has happened; to tell a story or report facts
items.ex_en: The survivor paused solemnly to relate the harrowing sequence of events to investigators.
items.ex_zh: 幸存者庄重地停顿了一下，向调查人员陈述了那段触目惊心的事件经过。

items.def_zh: 载入编年史；按时间顺序记录
items.def_en: To record or describe a series of historical events in the order they occurred
items.ex_en: The historian spent decades chronicling the devastating rise and fall of the dynasty.
items.ex_zh: 历史学家花费数十年时间，按时间顺序记录了该王朝悲壮的兴衰历程。

items.def_en: To tell someone about an event or experience in sequential detail
items.ex_en: The elderly veteran began to recount his harrowing wartime memories to his grandchildren.
items.ex_zh: 这位年迈的老兵开始向孙辈们详述自己惊心动魄的战争经历。

items.def_zh: 编造并绘声绘色地讲（故事）
items.def_en: To tell or create a story or narrative, especially an imaginative or deceptive one
items.ex_en: The seasoned sailor loved to spin fantastical tales of monstrous sea creatures nightly.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的老水手喜欢在每天夜里绘声绘色地编讲深海怪兽的奇幻故事。
items.ex2_en: A fascinating tale spun effortlessly in the creative mind of the writer.
items.ex2_zh: 一个引人入胜的故事自然而然地在作家的脑海中形成。

items.def_zh: 叙述，讲述；为（纪录片、节目等）作旁白解说
items.def_en: To tell a story or describe events in sequence; to provide spoken commentary for a film, documentary, or programme.
items.ex_en: The acclaimed British actor agreed to narrate the multi-part nature television documentary series.
items.ex_zh: 这位备受赞誉的英国演员同意为这部多集自然电视纪录片作旁白解说。

groups.summary_en: Verbs centered on setting forth sequences of events, personal stories, or factual experiences in continuous, descriptive detail.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重按时间或因果逻辑系统讲述、详细叙说经历或故事。
groups.desc_en: Denotes telling a connected sequence of events, contrasting with bare 'state' or 'report' by foregrounding linear temporal progression, rhetorical craft, and experiential detail.
groups.desc_zh: 指按时间顺序将一连串事件组织成故事或经历娓娓道来，与干瘪的“陈述”或“报告”不同，它强调时间流逝的连贯性、修辞手法与亲历细节的生动重构。
groups.nuance_en: narrate: providing the overarching voiceover or structural telling of a storyline (documentary / story / audio-book) · recount: giving a detailed, orderly retrospective account of real events personally experienced (experiences / events / journey) · relate: connecting and conveying facts, anecdotes, or tales to an audience (anecdote / facts / story) · chronicle: recording historical events methodically in strict chronological succession (history / decline / rise) · spin: shaping and presenting an event with deliberate bias or rhetorical flair (tale / yarn / narrative)
groups.nuance_zh: narrate: 宏观把控并以旁白或连贯口吻讲述故事框架 (documentary / story / audio-book) · recount: 详尽回忆叙述亲身经历过的真实往事 (experiences / events / journey) · relate: 传达引述轶事、见闻或事实关联 (anecdote / facts / story) · chronicle: 按编年史形式严格按时间顺序详录历史 (history / decline / rise) · spin: 带有主观润色、倾向性或巧妙编造地讲故事 (tale / yarn / narrative)

groups.name: Narrow & Constrict · 收拢收窄与缩小差距 (Narrow, Taper, Whittle down)
groups.tip: 受外力箍紧使口径孔洞变细

items.def_zh: 逐步缩减（范围/候选名单）
items.def_en: To reduce the number of possibilities, candidates, or options in a group by systematic elimination
items.ex_en: The hiring panel will narrow down the fifty applicants to three top finalists.
items.ex_zh: 招聘小组将逐步把五十名应聘者缩减为三位最终候选人。
items.ex2_en: The list of available options narrowed down to just two choices.
items.ex2_zh: 可供选择的项目缩小到了仅剩两个选项。

items.def_en: (+ off) To become gradually narrower or thinner toward one end, or to taper a physical contour
items.ex_en: The dirt path began to taper off as it wound higher into the hills.
items.ex_zh: 当泥土小径蜿蜒攀入山丘时，路面开始逐渐变窄。
items.ex2_en: Doctors gradually tapered off the high dosage to prevent sudden withdrawal symptoms.
items.ex2_zh: 医生逐渐减少了大剂量用药，以防止出现突发戒断症状。

items.def_zh: 使瓶颈化收紧；约束限制
items.def_en: To squeeze, compress, or funnel flow or passage into a restricted bottleneck
items.ex_en: The police barricades bottle down the rowdy crowd into a single, narrow exit.
items.ex_zh: 警方设置的路障把喧闹的人群强行约束挤进一条狭窄的单向出口。

items.def_en: To gradually diminish the size, scope, or number of candidates or expenses piece by piece
items.ex_en: The committee managed to whittle down the initial budget proposal by fifteen percent.
items.ex_zh: 委员会设法将最初的预算提案逐步削减了百分之十五。

items.def_en: 1. To become less wide or to make something less wide. 2. To reduce or become reduced in number, amount, or gap.
items.ex_en: The lead runner watched his advantage narrow rapidly during the final lap.
items.ex_zh: 领跑的运动员眼看着自己的优势在最后一圈被迅速缩小。
items.ex2_en: The city council decided to narrow the busy downtown streets for pedestrian safety.
items.ex2_zh: 市议会决定缩窄繁华的市区街道，以保障行人安全。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate a progressive reduction in physical width, options, or competitive leads. While 'narrow' covers both physical corridors narrowing and the shrinking of score gaps or shortlists, synonyms like 'taper' emphasize gradual geometric narrowing to a point.
groups.summary_zh: 指空间跨度由宽变窄，或比分分差、候选名单等逐渐收拢缩小。
groups.desc_en: Denotes decreasing spatial width, numerical options, or competitive margins, contrasting with general 'reduce' or 'shrink' by focusing on the converging, funnel-like reduction toward a sharp or manageable focus.
groups.desc_zh: 指收缩物理宽度、缩减候选数量或缩小分歧差距，与一般的“减少”或“收缩”不同，它突出如漏斗般向内收束、逐渐汇聚到焦点或精准范围的动态过程。
groups.nuance_en: narrow: reducing width, margin of difference, or diversity of opinions (gap / eyes / margin) · narrow down: systematically eliminating inferior possibilities to reach a final shortlist (list / suspects / choices) · taper: gradually becoming thinner or narrower toward one pointed end (candle / pants / funnel) · whittle down: gradually reducing a large quantity through repeated small cuts (numbers / surplus / deficit) · bottle down: constricting or impeding free movement through a tight passage (traffic / flow / troops)
groups.nuance_zh: narrow: 缩小差距、眯细眼睛或使物理宽度变窄 (gap / eyes / margin) · narrow down: 逐一排查剔除候选，最终锁定精准名单 (list / suspects / choices) · taper: 向末端逐渐尖削收细变窄 (candle / pants / funnel) · whittle down: 像削木头般反复切削直至压缩减小 (numbers / surplus / deficit) · bottle down: 在狭窄通路处压迫收拢以至受阻滞留 (traffic / flow / troops)

groups.name: Nationalize & Expropriate · 征用与国有化 (Nationalize, Expropriate, Commandeer)
groups.tip: 政府征用私产收归国有管制

items.def_en: To take custody of property or assets suddenly and legally, or by sovereign force
items.ex_en: Customs officials acted swiftly to seize the undeclared luxury assets at the border.
items.ex_zh: 海关官员迅速采取行动，在边境查封了未申报的奢侈资产。

items.def_en: To organize an industry or entire economy on socialistic principles of collective ownership
items.ex_en: The revolutionary government aimed to socialize key utilities to serve public interest.
items.ex_zh: 革命政府旨在将关键公用事业收归公有，以服务公共利益。

items.raw_cluster: 国有化与征用 Nationalize & Expropriate
items.def_zh: 将…收归国有，实行国有化
items.def_en: to bring an industry, company, or land under the control and ownership of the government
items.ex_en: Parliament voted decisively to nationalize the failing domestic rail operator last week.
items.ex_zh: 议会上周果断投票决定将这家陷入困境的国内铁路运营商收归国有。

items.def_en: To officially take possession of private property or vehicles for urgent state or military use
items.ex_en: Military officers were authorized to commandeer civilian vehicles during the unprecedented emergency.
items.ex_zh: 在空前的紧急状态下，军官们获权征用民用车辆。

items.def_en: To take away private property for official public use, often without full agreement
items.ex_en: The municipal authority voted to expropriate private farmland for the highway expansion project.
items.ex_zh: 市政当局投票决定征用私人农田用于高速公路扩建项目。

groups.summary_en: This frame involves state entities formally converting private enterprises, natural assets, or property into public ownership or sovereign control. Legal acquisition contrasts with unilateral government confiscation.
groups.summary_zh: 指国家依法或强制将私人产业、资产归为公有或收归国有。
groups.desc_en: Denotes a governing authority taking private or industrial property into sovereign ownership or wartime control, contrasting with unlawful 'steal' or 'rob' by rooting the act in supreme public mandate or eminent domain.
groups.desc_zh: 指国家或公权力依据最高主权或公共紧急权力，将私人、外资或产业资产收归公有或战时管制，与非法的“偷盗”不同，它具有制度性、强制性与国家意图。
groups.nuance_en: nationalize: converting private industries or assets into public, state-owned ownership (industry / railways / mines) · expropriate: officially taking private property for public use, often overriding owner consent (land / wealth / assets) · commandeer: seizing property or vehicles arbitrarily under emergency military or police authority (car / ship / supplies) · socialize: transforming economic means of production into collective or societal ownership (economy / medicine / agriculture) · seize: grabbing control of assets or territory swiftly by lawful power or sheer physical force (assets / contraband / power)
groups.nuance_zh: nationalize: 将私营行业或外资资产收归国家所有 (industry / railways / mines) · expropriate: 政府为公共利益强制征用或没收私人财产 (land / wealth / assets) · commandeer: 战时或紧急状态下军警征调占用私人交通工具物资 (car / ship / supplies) · socialize: 将生产资料社会化或转化为公有制 (economy / medicine / agriculture) · seize: 执法或军事力量依法迅速查封扣押财产 (assets / contraband / power)

groups.name: Naturalize & Assimilate · 入籍与同化 (Naturalize, Assimilate, Integrate)
groups.tip: 取得公民身份并融入异国文化

items.def_en: To successfully become part of a community or society, or bring different groups together
items.ex_en: The municipal council launched programs to integrate newly arrived refugees into local neighborhoods.
items.ex_zh: 市议会启动了各项计划，以帮助新到达的难民融入当地社区。
items.ex2_en: The new immigrant families integrated smoothly into the friendly local community.
items.ex2_zh: 新移民家庭顺利地融入了友好的当地社区。

items.def_en: To get used to a new climate, culture, or set of living conditions
items.ex_en: It took the mountaineers several quiet days to acclimatize to the thin air.
items.ex_zh: 登山者们花了几天平静的时间来适应稀薄的空气。

items.def_en: To feel that you belong to a particular group and are accepted by its members
items.ex_en: Despite moving schools often, she always managed to fit in with her classmates.
items.ex_zh: 尽管经常转学，她总能设法融入同班同学之中。

items.def_en: To adopt the customs and attitudes of the prevailing culture, or bring a group into conformity
items.ex_en: Immigrant families frequently struggled to assimilate fully into the dominant social culture.
items.ex_zh: 移民家庭往往要历经艰难才能完全融入主流社会文化之中。
items.ex2_en: The expansive empire sought to assimilate all conquered territories into its culture.
items.ex2_zh: 庞大的帝国试图将所有被征服的领土同化进自身的文化之中。

items.def_zh: 给予……国籍，使加入国籍；使（动植物等）顺化，移植
items.def_en: 1. To grant full citizenship to a person of foreign birth. 2. To introduce a non-native animal or plant into an area where it thrives.
items.ex_en: The state department decided to naturalize hundreds of eligible foreign residents this morning.
items.ex_zh: 国务院今晨决定给予数百名符合条件的外国居民公民身份。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to integrating foreigners, cultural minorities, or non-native species into a host nation, legal system, or biological habitat so that they acquire full status or conform to cultural norms.
groups.summary_zh: 指将外来人口、动植物或少数群体接纳入社会体系、法律或生态环境中。
groups.desc_en: Denotes a foreign organism, migrant, or outsider becoming fully incorporated into an adopted civic, cultural, or biological system, contrasting with external 'admit' by signifying profound internal transformation and belonging.
groups.desc_zh: 指外来者、移植物或异质群体深度融入并获得接纳国的法律、文化或生态身份，与外在的“接纳”不同，它强调由表及里、最终与主体融为一体的彻底转变。
groups.nuance_en: naturalize: legally granting foreign-born residents full citizenship (citizens / immigrants / foreigners) · assimilate: absorbing cultural, intellectual, or biological elements so they become indistinguishable from the host (minority / immigrants / culture) · integrate: unifying diverse groups into a cohesive, equitable whole without erasing differences (schools / communities / systems) · acclimatize: adjusting physiologically or psychologically to a new climate or working conditions (body / altitude / workers) · fit in: behaving smoothly in accordance with social expectations to belong unobtrusively (group / school / crowd)
groups.nuance_zh: naturalize: 依法赋予外国人正式公民资格或使外来动植物归化 (citizens / immigrants / foreigners) · assimilate: 吸收同化直至被主流群体完全融解 (minority / immigrants / culture) · integrate: 打破壁垒，使多元群体平等融入整体 (schools / communities / systems) · acclimatize: 生理或心理逐步适应新气候与新环境 (body / altitude / workers) · fit in: 顺应社会规范而自然合群、不显突兀 (group / school / crowd)

groups.name: Nautical Hauling & Rigging Pull · 航海牵引与收紧缆绳 (Bouse, Haul, Heave)
groups.tip: 用力拖拽绳索牵引物体

items.def_zh: 连续收拢拉紧；奋力拉索
items.def_en: (nautical) To pull continuously on a rope or tackle until an object is secured or hoisted
items.ex_en: The boatswain ordered the deckhands to haul away until the mainsail was set.
items.ex_zh: 水手长命令甲板水手奋力连续拉索，直到主帆升好为止。

items.def_zh: 横拉绳索收紧；用力紧缆
items.def_en: (nautical) To haul on a rope by pulling perpendicularly to take up slack before securing
items.ex_en: The experienced sailor stepped up to sweat the halyard before making it fast.
items.ex_zh: 富有经验的水手走上前去横拉缆绳收紧升降索，然后将其系牢。

items.def_zh: 用力拖拽；拉引（重物或缆绳）
items.def_en: To pull or drag something heavy with a continuous, steady effort
items.ex_en: Two burly sailors struggled to haul the heavy, sodden hawser onto the dock.
items.ex_zh: 两名健壮的水手费力地把沉重湿透的粗缆拖拽到码头上。

items.def_zh: 合力拉举；（用力）起吊缆索
items.def_en: (+ on/at) To pull, hoist, or drag a heavy line or object with a concerted physical heave
items.ex_en: The exhausted crew gathered together to heave on the thick anchor rope.
items.ex_zh: 精疲力竭的船员们聚在一起，合力拉动粗重的锚绳。

items.def_en: (nautical) To haul or pull firmly on a tackle or rope so as to hoist or tighten something.
items.ex_en: The hardy tars strained to bouse the heavy gun tackle into firm position.
items.ex_zh: 强壮的水手们奋力拉紧沉重的火炮索具，将其固定到位。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers mechanical or heavy manual traction, especially aboard vessels or in rigging, involving pulling firmly on lines, tackle, or ropes to hoist, tension, or drag heavy loads. Nuances contrast rhythmic collective hauling, tensioning, and sheer deadweight dragging.
groups.summary_zh: 特指在航海或工程索具中，用力收紧、拖曳或起升沉重缆绳。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the rhythmic, muscular pulling of heavy ropes, rigging, or shipboard loads, contrasting with standard 'pull' by demanding coordinated nautical team mechanics, mechanical purchase, and physical heave.
groups.desc_zh: 指水手在船上协同用力收紧缆绳、索具或牵拉重物，与普通的“拉”不同，它强调借助滑轮倍力装置、依仗全身重力与喊号同步的航海机械拉拽。
groups.nuance_en: haul: pulling a heavy load steadily over distance or along a line (cargo / ropes / catch) · heave: exerting intense, full-body strain to raise or cast a heavy marine weight (anchor / lead / line) · haul away: executing a sustained, coordinated team pull on a ship's running tackle (halyard / sheet / ropes) · sweat: pulling perpendicularly on a taut halyard to extract the absolute last inch of slack (halyard / line / sheet) · bouse: hauling taut vigorously using a block and tackle purchase (tackle / gear / rope)
groups.nuance_zh: haul: 稳定持续地拖拉重物或粗重缆绳 (cargo / ropes / catch) · heave: 弓身聚力、重重抬起或抛出锚与缆绳 (anchor / lead / line) · haul away: 水手集体听口号同步连续牵拉升降索 (halyard / sheet / ropes) · sweat: 在缆绳近乎收死时垂直扳拉以榨尽最后一寸余量 (halyard / line / sheet) · bouse: 借助滑轮组奋力拉紧紧绷的船上索具 (tackle / gear / rope)

groups.name: Need & Require · 需求与必要依靠 (Require, Demand, Call for)
groups.tip: 维持或成事所不可或缺

items.def_en: to require something because it is essential or very important, rather than just desirable
items.ex_en: Patients with severe trauma urgently need immediate medical attention and continuous monitoring.
items.ex_zh: 遭受严重外伤的病患急需即时的医疗救治和持续的监护。

items.def_en: to have need of something for a purpose or because of an official rule
items.ex_en: Federal regulations strictly require all chemical manufacturers to disclose hazardous emissions annually.
items.ex_zh: 联邦法规严格要求所有化学品制造商每年披露有害排放物。

items.def_en: to require substantial amounts of skill, patience, energy, or attention
items.ex_en: Mastering classical concert piano pieces will demand exceptional discipline and relentless daily practice.
items.ex_zh: 精通古典音乐会钢琴曲目需要极高的自律和日复一日的不懈练习。

items.def_en: to make something necessary or appropriate as a required response
items.ex_en: The unprecedented severity of the environmental crisis may call for drastic emergency measures.
items.ex_zh: 这场环境危机空前的严重性可能需要采取严厉的紧急措施。

items.def_en: to depend completely on someone or something for basic survival or success
items.ex_en: Vulnerable arctic wildlife species rely heavily on sea ice for their daily survival.
items.ex_zh: 脆弱的北极野生动物极度依赖海冰来维持日常生存。

groups.summary_en: This frame encapsulates cognitive and conditional dependencies where something is deemed essential, indispensable, or obligatory for sustenance, function, or fulfillment.
groups.summary_zh: 指某事态或行动属必不可少之条件、硬性需求或依靠。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an indispensable necessity, functional dependency, or non-negotiable prerequisite, contrasting with voluntary 'want' by defining conditions without which an outcome or system fails to exist.
groups.desc_zh: 指不可或缺的客观必然性、功能依赖或强制前提，与出于主观意愿的“想要”不同，它强调缺失该条件则系统崩溃或目标彻底无法达成。
groups.nuance_en: need: suffering an existential lack or fundamental requirement for survival or function (help / food / rest) · require: mandating an essential prerequisite by rule, law, or objective necessity (permit / skills / maintenance) · demand: claiming forcefully or imposing high operational tolls (explanation / ransom / stamina) · call for: indicating the specific remedy or action appropriate for a situation (celebration / intervention / patience) · rely on: placing functional dependency and trust entirely upon an external factor (support / data / machinery)
groups.nuance_zh: need: 因内在匮乏而迫切需要生存或运作要件 (help / food / rest) · require: 制度上规定必须具备或客观上不可缺少 (permit / skills / maintenance) · demand: 严苛要求或对精力资源提出极高索求 (explanation / ransom / stamina) · call for: 局势或情境理所当然地呼唤某项对策 (celebration / intervention / patience) · rely on: 在功能或存续上完全依赖并信赖外部要素 (support / data / machinery)

groups.name: Negate & Invalidate · 否定与作废 (Negate, Nullify, Annul)
groups.tip: 相互中和作用使不良影响归零

items.def_en: To balance each other out so that neither side has any final advantage or effect.
items.ex_en: The extra revenue from new sales was canceled out by rising operational costs.
items.ex_zh: 新销售带来的额外收益被不断上升的运营成本抵消了。
items.ex2_en: Their opposing political votes will cancel out during the final committee ballot count.
items.ex2_zh: 在委员会最终计票时，他们相反的政治选票将相互抵消。

items.def_en: To declare a contract, election, or document legally invalid.
items.ex_en: The magistrate ruled that fraudulent signatures would void the contested commercial lease.
items.ex_zh: 法官裁定，欺诈性签名将使引起争议的商业租赁合同宣告无效。

items.def_zh: 抵消，消除……的作用；否定，否认
items.def_en: 1. To stop something from having any effect or value; to cancel out. 2. (formal) To state or prove that something does not exist or is untrue.
items.ex_en: A single reckless blunder could negate years of meticulous progress in bilateral diplomacy.
items.ex_zh: 一次鲁莽的失误就可能抵消双边外交多年来取得的细致进展。

items.def_en: To make something lose its legal force, value, or real-world consequence.
items.ex_en: The constitutional court decided to nullify the controversial statute passed last month.
items.ex_zh: 宪法法院裁定宣布上个月通过的那项争议性法案完全无效。

items.def_en: (law) To officially declare a marriage, law, or decision formally invalid from the outset.
items.ex_en: The regional judicial tribunal moved swiftly to annul the fraudulently procured marriage.
items.ex_zh: 地区司法审判庭迅速采取行动，宣告这场欺诈性获取的婚姻自始无效。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this conceptual and legal frame signify rendering an assertion, contract, or effort entirely void, non-existent, or mathematically and logically cancelled.
groups.summary_zh: 在逻辑、法律或实质上消除其有效性，使之归零作废。
groups.desc_en: Denotes rendering an argument, legal contract, or empirical effect completely null, void, or functionally dead, contrasting with minor 'reduce' or 'modify' by achieving total, absolute neutralization.
groups.desc_zh: 指使论据、法律契约或原有效果彻底失效、化为乌有，与局部的“削减”或“修改”不同，它强调从效力根源上予以全盘否定与绝对抹杀。
groups.nuance_en: negate: disproving a premise or neutralizing a beneficial effect into insignificance (effects / gains / argument) · nullify: legally or functionally rendering something completely void of power or value (treaty / ruling / advantage) · annul: officially declaring a formal status or contract void from the very beginning (marriage / contract / election) · void: invalidating a legal document, warranty, or transaction through breach or lapse (contract / check / warranty) · cancel out: counterbalancing opposing factors so their net effect becomes zero (errors / advantages / debts)
groups.nuance_zh: negate: 否定命题真值，或抵消削弱前期收获至无效 (effects / gains / argument) · nullify: 使法规、判决在法律或实际效能上归于无效 (treaty / ruling / advantage) · annul: 依法宣告婚姻、条约自始无效彻底解除 (marriage / contract / election) · void: 因违约或过期而注销、作废票据文书 (contract / check / warranty) · cancel out: 正反两股力量或利弊恰好互相抵消为零 (errors / advantages / debts)

groups.name: Nestle & Nuzzle · 筑巢与依偎 (Nest, Nestle, Snuggle)
groups.tip: 飞鸟筑巢安家与落脚歇息

items.def_zh: 筑巢，做窠；巢居，落脚；嵌入，嵌套
items.def_en: To build or occupy a nest, or settle down comfortably like a bird in a nest.
items.ex_en: Several migratory swallows returned to nest quietly under the eaves of the barn.
items.ex_zh: 几只迁徙的燕子飞了回来，在谷仓的屋檐下安静地筑巢安居。

items.def_zh: 给……掖好被子；把……塞入被窝
items.def_en: To arrange bedcovers securely and snugly around someone sleeping
items.ex_en: Grandmother came softly into the dark bedroom to tuck in the drowsy children.
items.ex_zh: 祖母悄悄走进昏暗的卧室，给昏昏欲睡的孩子们掖好被子。

items.def_en: (+ into / under) To press under or dig into blankets or cushions to create a cozy hideaway
items.ex_en: On freezing winter nights, the shivering boy loved to burrow under thick quilts.
items.ex_zh: 在严寒的冬夜里，发抖的男孩喜欢一头钻进厚厚的被窝中。

items.def_en: (+ into / against) To settle or lie comfortably and snugly in a warm, protected position
items.ex_en: The tired child loved to nestle against her mother during violent winter storms.
items.ex_zh: 在狂暴的冬日风暴中，疲倦的孩子喜欢紧靠在母亲怀中安卧。
items.ex2_en: The mother gently nestled the sleeping infant into the soft wool blanket.
items.ex2_zh: 母亲轻轻地将睡熟的婴儿安置在柔软的羊毛毯中。

items.def_en: (+ down / up / against) To curl up or press closely against someone or something for warmth
items.ex_en: The playful kittens began to snuggle together inside the lined fleece basket.
items.ex_zh: 贪玩的小猫们开始蜷缩在垫有抓绒的篮子里相互依偎取暖。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on settling down comfortably, creating a cozy and protected resting niche, or nestling snugly against something warm and safe, mimicking the biological habits of nesting birds.
groups.summary_zh: 指营巢筑窝，或像幼鸟归巢般舒适地依偎安顿在温暖处。
groups.desc_en: Denotes settling intimately into a snug, sheltered, and warm recess, contrasting with cold 'sit' or 'lie' by evoking an innate animal craving for protective warmth, tactile affection, and safety.
groups.desc_zh: 指安然依偎、缩入舒适温暖且具庇护性的凹处或怀抱中，与机械的“坐”或“躺”不同，它唤起动物筑巢本能般的温暖防卫感、触觉亲昵与安全感。
groups.nuance_en: nestle: settling warmly, comfortably, and snugly against someone or in a sheltered spot (head / valley / infant) · snuggle: cuddling closely and affectionately to share warmth (blanket / bed / partner) · burrow: digging or tunneling deeply into something for hiding, warmth, or refuge (under covers / hole / underground) · tuck in: folding blankets snugly around someone or folding appendages into a compact shape (child / bed / shirt) · nest: settling into a secure domestic hollow or building a habitat to brood (birds / instincts / boxes)
groups.nuance_zh: nestle: 舒适安详地依偎在某人身旁或山谷庇护处 (head / valley / infant) · snuggle: 为取暖或示爱而紧紧相拥挨擦 (blanket / bed / partner) · burrow: 钻入被窝或泥土深处以求藏匿与温暖 (under covers / hole / underground) · tuck in: 为熟睡者掖好被角或收拢肢体 (child / bed / shirt) · nest: 鸟类做窝筑巢，或居家人筑造安乐窝 (birds / instincts / boxes)

groups.name: Neutralize & Disarm · 瓦解与制伏 (Neutralize, Disarm, Incapacitate)
groups.tip: 解除威胁或抵消敌对行动

items.def_en: To overcome, quieten, or bring an attacker or uprising under control by superior force.
items.ex_en: Riot police deployed tear gas to subdue the violent unrest outside parliament.
items.ex_zh: 防暴警察施放了催泪瓦斯，以制伏议会大楼外的暴力骚乱。

items.def_en: To take away weapons from an enemy, or render an explosive device harmless.
items.ex_en: The specialized security task force successfully disarmed the captured rebel militia leader.
items.ex_zh: 特种安全部队成功缴除了被俘叛乱民兵头目的武装。
items.ex2_en: The rival nations agreed to disarm under strict international supervision.
items.ex2_zh: 交战国同意在严格的国际监督下解除武装。

items.def_zh: 消除威胁，制服；抵消，使中和；使中立化
items.def_en: 1. To stop an enemy, threat, poison, or weapon from being dangerous or having an effect. 2. To counteract something so that it has no effect. 3. To declare a country or area politically neutral.
items.ex_en: Elite counterterrorist forces moved rapidly to neutralize the rogue sniper atop the tower.
items.ex_zh: 反恐精英部队迅速出击，消除了塔顶变节狙击手的致命威胁。

items.def_en: To deprive an adversary of physical strength or cognitive ability to fight.
items.ex_en: The non-lethal electrical taser managed to incapacitate the aggressive attacker almost instantly.
items.ex_zh: 这种非致命性电击枪几乎瞬间就让那名凶猛的袭击者丧失了行动能力。

items.def_en: To remove the fuse from a bomb, or calm a volatile confrontation before violence erupts.
items.ex_en: The skilled mediator worked tirelessly to defuse rising anger during tense negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的调解员不懈努力，以平息紧张谈判期间不断升温的怒火。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this military, tactical, or security frame denote rendering an opponent, combatant, or explosive device completely ineffective, non-threatening, or destroyed.
groups.summary_zh: 在安全或交锋中彻底制伏、缴械或解除敌方威胁。
groups.desc_en: Denotes stripping an adversary, weapon, or hazard of its ability to inflict harm, contrasting with 'fight' or 'kill' by focusing on functional disarmament, deactivation, or systemic pacification.
groups.desc_zh: 指剥夺对手、武器或潜在危险施加伤害的能力，与一味的“搏斗”或“杀死”不同，它强调功能层面的解除武装、平息危机或使其丧失行动机能。
groups.nuance_en: neutralize: counteracting, rendering harmless, or eliminating an active hostile threat (threat / acid / enemy) · disarm: depriving a hostile person of weapons, or emotionally dissolving their hostility (suspect / critic / bomb) · defuse: safely removing the fuse from an explosive, or de-escalating a volatile confrontation (bomb / crisis / tension) · incapacitate: depriving a person or machine of physical strength or functional capacity (opponent / victim / vessel) · subdue: bringing a struggling captive or unruly rebellion under firm physical control (attacker / suspect / crowd)
groups.nuance_zh: neutralize: 中和酸碱、消除隐患或使敌对威胁丧失威胁力 (threat / acid / enemy) · disarm: 缴除对方武器，或以友善化解对方防备敌意 (suspect / critic / bomb) · defuse: 拆除爆炸物引信，或平息一触即发的紧张危机 (bomb / crisis / tension) · incapacitate: 使人身体致残致昏或使系统彻底丧失行动能力 (opponent / victim / vessel) · subdue: 用强力压制制服抵抗者或平定骚乱 (attacker / suspect / crowd)

groups.name: Nip & Pinch · 捏掐与轻夹 (Nip, Pinch, Tweak)
groups.tip: 用两指或钳口紧紧夹挤

items.def_en: To twist or pull something sharply with a small pinching movement using fingers
items.ex_en: He gave his buddy’s ear a playful tweak while cracking another silly joke.
items.ex_zh: 他又讲了个蠢笑话，顺手调皮地扯了扯他哥们儿的耳朵。

items.def_zh: 捏，掐，轻咬；剪去，掐掉；急忙赶去
items.def_en: 1. To bite, pinch, or squeeze someone or something sharply and lightly. 2. To snip off or clip something. 3. (British informal) To go somewhere quickly for a short time.
items.ex_en: The playful puppy tried to nip my hand whenever I offered a treat.
items.ex_zh: 每当我递上零食时，那只顽皮的小狗总想轻咬一下我的手。

items.def_en: To cut or pinch off with a fast, light snipping or clipping action using scissors or teeth
items.ex_en: The head gardener used sharp shears to snip dead blossoms from the hedge.
items.ex_zh: 园丁长用锋利的修枝剪从树篱上剪掉枯萎的花朵。

items.def_en: To squeeze tightly between the thumb and a finger, or between two hard surfaces
items.ex_en: These stiff new dress shoes pinch my toes terribly whenever I walk.
items.ex_zh: 这双僵硬的新皮鞋每次走路时都把我的脚趾夹得生疼。

items.def_en: To hold or press something tightly and immovably with or as if with a clamp or jaws
items.ex_en: The heavy iron vice will clamp the wooden beam securely in place.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的铁虎钳会把木梁牢牢地夹紧固定在原位。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on seizing or compressing a small portion of flesh or material sharply between two rigid or fleshy surfaces (such as fingertips, claws, or pliers). It emphasizes rapid, localized, and biting pressure.
groups.summary_zh: 用手指、利齿或夹具敏捷、锋利地捏掐或夹紧。
groups.desc_en: Applies localized, compressive force between two opposing surfaces or digits, differing from general crushing or gripping by its precise, fine-scale contact points.
groups.desc_zh: 通过两个相对的作用面或指尖施加局部的挤压或夹捏力，区别于普遍的抓握或挤压，强调接触点的微小与精准。
groups.nuance_en: nip: quick, sharp bite or pinch, often severing or chilling (bud / frost / heel) · pinch: squeezing tightly between finger and thumb, causing distress or pressure (skin / pennies / bridge of nose) · tweak: pinching with a slight twisting adjustment (ear / settings / muscle) · snip: cutting cleanly with a light, quick scissor action (stem / thread / ribbon) · clamp: gripping firmly and immovably with an external tool or mechanism (jaws / pipe / timber)
groups.nuance_zh: nip: 快速尖锐地夹咬或掐断，常表受寒或阻截 (bud / frost / heel) · pinch: 用拇指与食指用力捏紧，常伴痛感或紧缩 (skin / pennies / bridge of nose) · tweak: 掐住并微调或扭扯 (ear / settings / muscle) · snip: 用剪刀轻巧利落地剪断 (stem / thread / ribbon) · clamp: 借助夹具或机械死死钳紧 (jaws / pipe / timber)
