groups.name: Nominate & Propose · 提名与举荐 (Put up, Name, Shortlist)
groups.tip: 推选合适人选担任职务

items.def_en: To officially choose or specify someone for a particular position or honor
items.ex_en: The board of directors met to name a successor for the retiring executive.
items.ex_zh: 董事会开会指定了一名接班人来接替即将退休的高管。

items.def_en: To enter or field someone as a competitor or candidate in an election
items.ex_en: The progressive political party plans to run three promising candidates in upcoming elections.
items.ex_zh: 该进步政党计划在即将举行的大选中推举三名有潜力的候选人参选。
items.ex2_en: The local doctor decided to run for the vacant city council seat.
items.ex2_zh: 这位当地医生决定竞选空缺的市议会席位。

items.def_en: 1. To officially propose someone as a candidate for an honor, office, or election. 2. To appoint someone to a job or duty.
items.ex_en: The faculty committee voted to nominate the distinguished researcher for the prestigious prize.
items.ex_zh: 教务委员会投票决定提名这位杰出的研究人员角逐该享有盛誉的奖项。

items.def_en: To propose or sponsor someone as a candidate in an election or for a role
items.ex_en: Local union leaders agreed to put up a reliable delegate for the council.
items.ex_zh: 当地工会领导人同意推选一位可靠的代表参选理事会席位。

items.def_en: To select someone as one of a small final group being considered for a job or prize
items.ex_en: The hiring committee will shortlist three qualified applicants for the final managerial interview.
items.ex_zh: 招聘委员会将把三名符合资格的申请人列入最终管理岗面试的入围名单。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on formally presenting candidates for elective office, awards, appointments, or governance selection.
groups.summary_zh: 正式提出人选以供选举、授奖或出任公职。
groups.desc_en: Formally introduces or advances a specific candidate's name for an office, award, or competition, contrasting with generic recommendation through institutional procedural backing.
groups.desc_zh: 循制度程序正式推举或列入特定职务、奖项的候选人名单，区别于非正式的泛泛推荐，带有明确的程序性与选拔指向。
groups.nuance_en: nominate: officially submit as a candidate for election or honor (candidate / successor / film) · name: formally designate or appoint someone to a role (replacement / squad / envoy) · put up: sponsor or sponsor oneself as a contender (candidate / collateral / resistance) · run: enter into an electoral contest as an active campaigner (campaign / for office / primary) · shortlist: reduce a wider field of applicants to a select final group (applicants / candidates / novel)
groups.nuance_zh: nominate: 正式提名某人为选举或奖项候选人 (candidate / successor / film) · name: 官方直接指名、任命或公布 (replacement / squad / envoy) · put up: 推举、资助某人参选或提出 (candidate / collateral / resistance) · run: 亲自竞选或运作参选 (campaign / for office / primary) · shortlist: 初审筛选并列入最终决选名单 (applicants / candidates / novel)

groups.name: Notice & Observe · 注意与觉察 (Perceive, Detect, Spot)
groups.tip: 从偶见端倪到留意关注

items.def_en: 1. To become conscious of, pay attention to, or observe something or someone.
items.ex_en: Did you notice any suspicious movement outside the window earlier this chilly evening?
items.ex_zh: 今天傍晚天气寒冷时，你有没有注意到窗外有任何可疑的动静？

items.def_en: To see, catch sight of, or identify something specific, especially when difficult to find
items.ex_en: The keen birdwatcher managed to spot a rare blue warbler amid dense foliage.
items.ex_zh: 这位敏锐的观鸟者在茂密的树叶间瞥见了一只罕见的蓝林莺。

items.def_en: To discern or become aware of a subtle clue, meaning, tone, or nuance that others missed
items.ex_en: She was the first to pick up on his quiet, guarded sarcasm today.
items.ex_zh: 她是今天第一个敏锐察觉到他含蓄而克制的讥讽之意的人。

items.def_en: To discover the presence or existence of something faint, subtle, or concealed
items.ex_en: Sophisticated medical sensors can detect minor cardiac abnormalities well before serious symptoms manifest.
items.ex_zh: 尖端的医疗传感器可以在严重症状显现之前及早探知微小的心脏异常。

items.def_en: To become conscious of something through sensory organs or mental insight
items.ex_en: Scholars struggle to perceive subtle nuances buried within this ancient, obscure poetic text.
items.ex_zh: 学者们难以觉察出深藏在这篇晦涩古诗文本中的微妙意蕴。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers shifting visual or cognitive perception from simple casual detection to keen, deliberate scrutiny of stimuli in the environment.
groups.summary_zh: 指由浅入深对周围外界事物产生感知、察觉与审视。
groups.desc_en: Transitions sensory stimuli into conscious cognitive awareness, contrasting with passive seeing or deep contemplation by marking the very threshold of recognition.
groups.desc_zh: 将外部感官刺激瞬间转化为清醒的认知感知，区别于被动的注视或沉思，强调跨过认知门槛的那一刻察觉。
groups.nuance_en: notice: casually register an object, fact, or change through normal attention (difference / change / slip) · spot: visually catch sight of something small, obscure, or elusive (error / target / trend) · detect: uncover something faint, hidden, or requiring sensitivity or instrumentation (sign / presence / fraud) · perceive: interpret complex sensory or conceptual input intellectually (threat / shift / nuance) · pick up on: instinctively register subtle cues or unspoken vibes (vibe / cue / mood)
groups.nuance_zh: notice: 在正常注意下自然留意到差异或变化 (difference / change / slip) · spot: 目光敏锐地发现细小、隐蔽或不易察觉之物 (error / target / trend) · detect: 探查出微弱、隐秘或需精密仪器的迹象 (sign / presence / fraud) · perceive: 从感官或理智上深层领会、察觉 (threat / shift / nuance) · pick up on: 敏锐捕捉到微妙的言外之意或氛围 (vibe / cue / mood)

groups.name: Nourish & Fatten · 滋养与增肥 (Fatten, Nourish, Plump)
groups.tip: 提供充分营养促使体态丰满

items.def_en: To feed an animal or person well to make them plump, fat, or ready for slaughter.
items.ex_en: The prosperous yeoman labored all autumn to fat his herd before impending slaughter.
items.ex_zh: 富足的自耕农整个秋天都在辛勤劳作，以期在宰杀前养肥他的牲畜。

items.def_en: To feed an animal or human abundantly so they gain substantial body weight
items.ex_en: Livestock farmers feed grain rich in protein to fatten up calves before winter.
items.ex_zh: 牲畜养殖户在入冬前喂食高蛋白谷物，以便把小牛喂得肥硕丰满。
items.ex2_en: The young animals fattened up nicely on the rich summer pasture grasses.
items.ex2_zh: 幼畜在茂盛的夏日牧草喂养下长得十分丰满。

items.def_en: To become rounder and fleshier, or to shake/fill something out fully
items.ex_en: The hotel chambermaid paused to plump up the luxurious down pillows meticulously.
items.ex_zh: 酒店客房女服务员停下脚步，细心地把豪华羽绒枕拍松弄丰满。
items.ex2_en: The dried raisins plumped up quickly after soaking in warm water.
items.ex2_zh: 干葡萄干浸泡在温水中后很快就鼓胀饱满起来。

items.def_en: To make something heavier, stronger, or more substantial in bulk or power
items.ex_en: The company decided to beef up its cybersecurity measures after the network breach.
items.ex_zh: 在网络遭遇入侵之后，公司决定大幅增强其网络安全防范措施。

items.def_en: To provide substances necessary for health, growth, and bodily maintenance
items.ex_en: Nutrient-rich foods are necessary to nourish developing tissue during periods of intense growth.
items.ex_zh: 富含养分的食物对于在剧烈生长时期滋养发育中的组织至关重要。

groups.summary_en: Covers feeding, enriching, or fattening animals or people through diet to build up flesh, body weight, or general vitality.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过大量喂食或充分营养补充使肉体丰满、增重或强健。
groups.desc_en: Supplies intensive sustenance or resources specifically to increase bulk, substance, or economic value, moving beyond baseline survival toward tangible expansion.
groups.desc_zh: 提供密集的营养或资源，专为增加体积、重量或经济价值，区别于基础的维生，强调肉眼可见的体量膨胀与充实。
groups.nuance_en: nourish: promote organic life, health, and holistic flourishing (body / soil / talent) · fatten: provide food specifically to build mass or market value (cattle / livestock / wallet) · plump up: mechanically or hydratively expand to a rounded, full shape (cushions / raisins / poultry) · beef up: augment strength, capacity, or security aggressively (security / staff / provisions)
groups.nuance_zh: nourish: 滋养以促进生理健康、土壤肥力或资质成长 (body / soil / talent) · fatten: 专门通过饲养增肥增重以待上市 (cattle / livestock / wallet) · plump up: 拍松、浸润或填塞使之丰满圆润 (cushions / raisins / poultry) · beef up: 大幅充实、加强实力或扩充规模 (security / staff / provisions)

groups.name: Nourish & Feed · 喂养与滋养 (Nourish, Sustain, Nurture)
groups.tip: 提供食物养分以滋润滋养

items.def_en: To give food or sustenance to a person, animal, or living thing
items.ex_en: Volunteers arrived before dawn to feed hungry stray dogs around the neighborhood park.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者们破晓前就赶到了社区公园附近，给饥饿的流浪狗喂食。

items.def_en: To provide the physical necessities or strength required to keep someone alive or functioning
items.ex_en: The small underground reservoir holds barely enough drinking water to sustain the community.
items.ex_zh: 那个小型地下水库蓄存的饮用水仅够维持该社区的基本生命所需。

items.def_en: To give assistance, comfort, and vital relief to someone in hardship or distress
items.ex_en: Brave relief workers ventured across hazardous terrain to succor the beleaguered earthquake survivors.
items.ex_zh: 英勇的救援人员冒着危险穿越险恶地形，济助那些陷于绝境的地震幸存者。

items.def_en: To care for, protect, and encourage the growth or development of someone or something
items.ex_en: Dedicated school mentors strive tirelessly to nurture emerging creative talent among underprivileged children.
items.ex_zh: 敬业的学校导师们孜孜不倦地努力，悉心培育贫困儿童中崭露头角的创造才能。

items.def_zh: 滋养，养育；助长，怀有（希望、情感等）
items.def_en: 1. To provide people, animals, or plants with food and nutrients necessary for life and growth. 2. To foster, encourage, or keep alive a feeling, idea, or belief.
items.ex_en: Wholesome natural foods nourish fragile infant bodies better than processed commercial formulas.
items.ex_zh: 健康的天然食物在滋养脆弱婴儿体质方面比工业加工的配方奶更为有效。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe supplying organic bodies or developing entities with the vital food, nutrients, or care necessary to sustain health, growth, and vigor. They extend naturally from physical feeding to emotional and intellectual enrichment.
groups.summary_zh: 指为生命或事物提供生存、成长所需的养分与支持。
groups.desc_en: Provides vital fuel, nutrients, or material support necessary to preserve existence and vitality, contrasting with mere inert physical maintenance.
groups.desc_zh: 供给维持生命、活力所必需的养料或物质支持，区别于静态的物理维护，侧重有机生命体的生机维系与延续。
groups.nuance_en: feed: directly supply physical food or functional raw input (family / cattle / meter) · nourish: supply what is essential for growth, development, and optimal health (cells / soul / mind) · sustain: uphold continuously against exhaustion, collapse, or death (life / effort / damage) · nurture: tenderly care for and encourage developing potential (talent / seedling / relationship) · succor: provide urgent relief and sustenance to those in dire distress (wounded / refugees / needy)
groups.nuance_zh: feed: 直接供给食物、饲料或运转所需的输入原料 (family / cattle / meter) · nourish: 提供成长和健康发育所必需的高质养分 (cells / soul / mind) · sustain: 持续支撑使其不致衰竭、中断或死亡 (life / effort / damage) · nurture: 悉心抚育并催生潜能发展 (talent / seedling / relationship) · succor: 向处于危难贫困者提供急迫的救助与维生支持 (wounded / refugees / needy)

groups.name: Nourish & Wean · 哺育与断乳 (Nurse, Suckle, Wean)
groups.tip: 幼崽喂奶后逐渐断绝母乳

items.def_en: To feed a baby or young mammal with milk from the breast or udder, or to suckle as an infant
items.ex_en: The exhausted mother sat in the nursery rocking chair to nurse her infant.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的母亲坐在育儿室的摇椅上，开始给自己的婴儿喂奶。

items.def_en: To gradually detach someone from a dependency, source of nourishment, or habit
items.ex_en: Physicians developed a careful clinical protocol to wean the patient off heavy narcotics.
items.ex_zh: 医生们制定了严谨的临床方案，以帮助该患者逐步戒除烈性麻醉药物。

items.def_en: To supply with the substances necessary for life, growth, and good health
items.ex_en: The balanced mixture of minerals and compost will nourish the seedlings during critical growth phases.
items.ex_zh: 这种矿物质与堆肥的均衡混合物将在关键生长期滋养幼苗。

items.def_en: 1. To gradually stop feeding a baby or young animal with mother's milk. 2. (+ from/off) To make someone gradually stop depending on or doing something.
items.ex_en: The pediatrician advised the young mother on how to safely wean her infant off formula.
items.ex_zh: 儿科医生就如何安全地给婴儿断配方奶向这位年轻母亲提出了建议。

items.def_en: To feed milk from the breast or teat, or to take nourishment by drinking mother's milk
items.ex_en: The gentle doe lay in the shaded hollow to suckle her trembling newborn fawns.
items.ex_zh: 温顺的母鹿卧在背阴的洼地里，为她瑟瑟发抖的初生幼鹿哺乳。

groups.summary_en: This developmental frame covers the spectrum of early nourishment—from providing maternal milk through nursing or suckling, to systematically transitioning the young off milk onto solid foods.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖生命初期以乳汁哺育幼崽及逐步停止哺乳、断乳的过程。
groups.desc_en: Governs the developmental transition of infant feeding, spanning from direct maternal lactation to the systematic cessation of dietary dependency.
groups.desc_zh: 围绕幼体喂养的发育周期展开，涵盖从母体亲授乳汁到逐步脱离母乳依赖的过渡机制，区别于一般进食。
groups.nuance_en: nurse: feed an infant at the breast or tend solicitously to the sick (baby / infant / wound) · suckle: give milk at the breast, or draw milk from a teat (young / infant / mother) · nourish: sustain life and growth through proper wholesome food (child / body / tissue) · wean: accustom an infant gradually to food other than mother's milk (baby / calf / foal) · wean off: systematically break a prolonged chemical or psychological habit (medication / subsidies / dependency)
groups.nuance_zh: nurse: 哺乳婴儿，或悉心护理伤病者 (baby / infant / wound) · suckle: 喂奶或吮吸乳汁 (young / infant / mother) · nourish: 用健康食物提供成长所需的充足养分 (child / body / tissue) · wean: 使幼儿或幼畜断奶并适应辅食 (baby / calf / foal) · wean off: 逐步戒除长期形成的药物依赖或不良习惯 (medication / subsidies / dependency)

groups.name: Nurture & Foster · 养育与培养 (Cultivate, Nourish, Rear)
groups.tip: 精心照料并助其成长

items.def_en: Bring up and educate a child, or breed and look after animals until they are fully grown
items.ex_en: Local farmers rear prize cattle following rigorous nutritional standards set by national livestock associations.
items.ex_zh: 当地农户遵循国家畜牧协会制定的严格营养标准饲养特等牲畜。

items.def_en: 1. To take care of a child for a period of time, without becoming their legal parent. 2. To encourage the development, growth, or feeling of something.
items.ex_en: The mentorship programme aims to foster innovative leadership qualities among early-career scientific researchers.
items.ex_zh: 该导师项目旨在培养早期科研人员的创新领导素养。

items.def_en: Acquire or develop a quality, skill, or relationship through deliberate practice and patience
items.ex_en: Senior executives must cultivate constructive relationships with municipal regulators to ensure future compliance.
items.ex_zh: 高管们必须与市政监管机构建立建设性的关系，以确保未来的合规性。

items.def_en: Care for and encourage the growth or development of someone or something
items.ex_en: Academic institutions must diligently nurture promising musical talents from disadvantaged regional backgrounds.
items.ex_zh: 学术机构必须悉心扶育来自贫困地区的优秀音乐人才。

items.def_en: Provide with the substances necessary for growth, health, and good condition
items.ex_en: Rich volcanic soils naturally nourish delicate tea plants situated along the steep mountain slopes.
items.ex_zh: 肥沃的火山土壤自然地滋养着陡峭山坡上娇嫩的茶树。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe providing emotional, developmental, or physical care to living beings, qualities, or ideas to help them grow, thrive, and reach their full potential.
groups.summary_zh: 给予关怀、呵护与资源，促使人、事物或才德茁壮成长。
groups.desc_en: Encourages the sustained moral, intellectual, or biological cultivation of human potential or concepts, contrasting with mere mechanical production.
groups.desc_zh: 持续浇灌和培育人的潜能、品德、理念或生物体，区别于机械化的生产，强调倾注心血的成长性诱导。
groups.nuance_en: nurture: patiently protect and encourage fragile developing life or talent (growth / creativity / genius) · foster: provide an adoptive environment promoting desirable conditions (climate / cooperation / child) · cultivate: systematically prepare, till, and refine qualities or relationships (friendships / tastes / mind) · rear: bear the responsibility of feeding and guiding children to adulthood (children / family / cattle) · nourish: sustain and enrich inner vitality and core strength (spirit / intellect / culture)
groups.nuance_zh: nurture: 悉心呵护并激发脆弱的幼小生命或创造潜能 (growth / creativity / genius) · foster: 营造寄养或支持性环境以促进某事物滋长 (climate / cooperation / child) · cultivate: 耕耘、磨砺并有意培养才智、修养或关系 (friendships / tastes / mind) · rear: 担负养育职责，将幼童抚养至成年 (children / family / cattle) · nourish: 滋养并充实精神内核或内在生命力 (spirit / intellect / culture)

groups.name: Nurture & Rear · 抚育与照料 (Nurture, Foster, Bring up)
groups.tip: 抚育后代并提供食物营养

items.def_en: Bring up and care for children or animals until they are fully grown
items.ex_en: She managed to rear three accomplished scholars despite profound financial hardships during wartime.
items.ex_zh: 尽管战时经济极为拮据，她仍设法将三位卓有成就的学者抚育成人。

items.def_en: Take care of and bring up a child for a period of time without becoming their legal parent
items.ex_en: The welfare agency sought dedicated guardians willing to foster vulnerable children during systemic crises.
items.ex_zh: 福利机构物色了愿意在系统性危机期间代养弱势儿童的热心监护人。

items.def_en: Care for a child and educate them through childhood until adulthood
items.ex_en: Her dedicated grandparents chose to bring up the orphaned twins after the tragic accident.
items.ex_zh: 悲剧事故发生后，她尽职的祖父母选择将这对失去双亲的双胞胎抚养成人。

items.def_en: 1. To feed, care for, and protect a child, animal, or plant while it is growing. 2. To encourage and support the development of a plan, idea, feeling, or talent.
items.ex_en: Dedicated art instructors strive to nurture raw creative talent through rigorous disciplined practice.
items.ex_zh: 尽心尽责的美术教师努力通过严格自律的训练来培养原始的创作天赋。

items.def_en: Provide someone or something with food and substances necessary for growth, health, and good condition
items.ex_en: Rich alluvial deposits constantly nourish the fertile fields lining the broad river basin.
items.ex_zh: 丰沛的冲积物不断滋养着广阔河流流域两岸的沃野。

groups.summary_en: Centers on caring for, feeding, educating, and fostering the development of children, young animals, or plants until maturity. It highlights sustained, protective commitment to healthy growth.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖照护、哺育幼小生命及培育其健康成长的全过程。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on the long-term domestic custody, parental socialization, and physical upbringing of offspring until independence, unlike short-term biological feeding.
groups.desc_zh: 聚焦于将后代从幼年抚育、教化直至独立成人的长期家庭抚养过程，区别于单纯短期的生理喂养。
groups.nuance_en: bring up: care for and educate a child in home morals and manners (children / family / daughter) · rear: undertake the extensive labor of breeding and raising children or stock (offspring / cattle / flock) · foster: care for a child legally and temporarily within a substitute home (ward / child / orphan) · nurture: supply affection and environmental warmth that helps developmental growth (seedling / ambition / relationship) · nourish: feed and sustain physical or spiritual vigor (body / mind / roots)
groups.nuance_zh: bring up: 在家庭中全面抚育、管教并培育孩子的品行 (children / family / daughter) · rear: 承担繁重的生养照料劳动，将子女抚养长大或饲养牲畜 (offspring / cattle / flock) · foster: 在替代性家庭中依法寄养或代管 (ward / child / orphan) · nurture: 用关爱与温暖环境促成身心全面健康成长 (seedling / ambition / relationship) · nourish: 供给体能或精神上的基本养分 (body / mind / roots)

groups.name: Object & Protest · 反对与抗议 (Protest, Challenge, Remonstrate)
groups.tip: 从心存异议到公开走上街头抗议

items.def_zh: 挺身抗议；公开表态反对
items.def_en: (+ against) To state one's resolute objection to something publicly and courageously
items.ex_en: Activists took to the streets to speak out against human rights abuses.
items.ex_zh: 活动人士走上街头，大声疾呼反对侵犯人权的行为。

items.def_en: To question whether something is right, true, or legitimate and invite scrutiny
items.ex_en: Opposition lawmakers decided to challenge the economic assumptions underpinning the proposed tax reform bill.
items.ex_zh: 反对派议员决定对拟议税改法案所依据的经济假设提出质疑。

items.def_zh: 反对，不赞成；提出……作为反对理由
items.def_en: 1. (+ to) To feel or express disapproval, dissatisfaction, or opposition. 2. (+ that) To state something as a reason for objecting or disagreeing.
items.ex_en: Several board members chose to object that the proposed acquisition carried excessive legal risks.
items.ex_zh: 几位董事会成员提出异议，指出拟议中的收购带有过高的法律风险。

items.def_en: (+ against/about) To state publicly and forcefully that you oppose or condemn something
items.ex_en: Thousands of outraged citizens gathered downtown to protest against sudden transit fare hikes yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 数千名愤怒的市民昨天聚集在市中心，抗议突如其来的公交票价上涨。

items.def_en: (+ with/against) To present strong reasons in complaint or protest against someone's act
items.ex_en: The senior diplomat ventured to remonstrate with the minister regarding the imprudent trade policy.
items.ex_zh: 这位资深外交官斗胆就草率的贸易政策向部长提出规劝抗议。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses openly articulating opposition, challenge, or resistance to a decision, ruling, plan, or injustice. The verbs range from formal parliamentary or judicial exceptions to public demonstrations of defiance.
groups.summary_zh: 通过言论、诉讼或公众抗议公开表达抵制与不服。
groups.desc_en: Articulates explicit cognitive dissent or moral resistance against a proposition or action, contrasting with silent non-compliance through overt verbal expression.
groups.desc_zh: 就某项主张或行为公开发表明确的反对意见或道德抗拒，区别于沉默的抵触，强调公之于众的言语交涉与抵抗。
groups.nuance_en: object: state a formal, procedural, or moral counter-argument to a specific act (to plan / to testimony / on grounds) · protest: voice strong, often collective public indignation against injustice (against policy / war / decision) · remonstrate: present reasoned arguments of solemn rebuke or plead against an act (with authorities / against conduct) · challenge: dispute the legality, accuracy, or validity directly (ruling / assumption / legitimacy) · speak out: bravely break silence to voice opposition publicly (against abuse / corruption / injustice)
groups.nuance_zh: object: 在程序或道德上对某具体事项提出异议 (to plan / to testimony / on grounds) · protest: 就非正义举措发起公开而强烈的抗议或抗辩 (against policy / war / decision) · remonstrate: 严肃规劝、据理力争或沉痛抗辩 (with authorities / against conduct) · challenge: 针锋相对地质疑某事的合法性、真实性或有效性 (ruling / assumption / legitimacy) · speak out: 挺身而出打破沉默，公开痛陈反对立场 (against abuse / corruption / injustice)

groups.name: Obliterate & Purge · 抹除与清洗 (Expunge, Eradicate, Wipe Out)
groups.tip: 从记录中彻底勾销抹净

items.def_en: To destroy or remove something completely and comprehensively
items.ex_en: The catastrophic flood threatened to wipe out entire rural villages across the lower valley.
items.ex_zh: 灾难性的洪水有可能将下游山谷的所有村庄彻底冲毁。

items.def_en: To rid an organization, memory, or conscience of unwanted, corrupt, or guilt-inducing elements
items.ex_en: The party leadership determined to purge corrupt regional officials ahead of the crucial congress.
items.ex_zh: 党派领导层决定在关键会议召开前清除腐败的地方官员。

items.def_en: To pull up by the roots or eliminate entirely, especially a disease, pest, or vice
items.ex_en: The international health agency strives to eradicate infectious diseases through comprehensive vaccination campaigns.
items.ex_zh: 该国际卫生机构致力于通过全面的疫苗接种行动根除传染病。

items.def_en: (formal) to completely erase, remove, or delete something, such as a name, record, or painful memory
items.ex_en: The district court agreed to expunge nonviolent misdemeanor offenses from his official background record.
items.ex_zh: 地方法院同意从他的官方背景记录中抹除其非暴力的轻罪罪行。

items.def_en: To destroy completely so that not a single trace or sign remains
items.ex_en: The powerful tidal wave threatened to obliterate the coastal defenses without leaving any trace.
items.ex_zh: 强劲的海啸有可能将沿海防卫工事彻底摧毁，不留任何痕迹。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the thorough, authoritative, or forceful eradication of records, memories, stains, or populations, leaving behind no physical or legal trace.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过权威、强力手段彻底抹除记录、记忆或痕迹，不留分毫。
groups.desc_en: Inflicts absolute, irreversible erasure or systemic elimination upon targets, leaving no structural trace, differing from partial damage or containment.
groups.desc_zh: 对目标施加绝对、不可逆的抹除或系统性根除，不留任何结构性痕迹，区别于局部的损害或控制。
groups.nuance_en: obliterate: completely erase all visible surfaces, memory, or presence (memory / traces / town) · expunge: strike out or delete thoroughly from an official written or mental record (record / name / memory) · purge: cleanse a system or state violently of undesirable elements (dissidents / ranks / bowels) · eradicate: pull up by the roots to ensure complete non-recurrence (disease / poverty / weed) · wipe out: devastate populations, financial stakes, or existence en masse (species / population / savings)
groups.nuance_zh: obliterate: 彻底抹去表面痕迹、存在或记忆，使其不复可见 (memory / traces / town) · expunge: 从官方档案或记忆记录中彻底划除、注销 (record / name / memory) · purge: 严酷清洗组织或机体内的异己或杂质成分 (dissidents / ranks / bowels) · eradicate: 连根拔起，使疾病或弊端永不复发 (disease / poverty / weed) · wipe out: 毁灭性消灭族群、击垮资产或一扫而空 (species / population / savings)

groups.name: Official Dismissal & Repudiation · 驳回与官方否决 (Reject, Dismiss, Disallow)
groups.tip: 不予接纳请求并予以当场驳回

items.def_zh: 拒绝接纳，驳回，否决；排斥，摈弃
items.def_en: To refuse to accept, approve, consider, or submit to something; to dismiss or turn down.
items.ex_en: The review committee chose to reject the ambitious grant proposal citing inadequate statistical methodologies.
items.ex_zh: 评审委员会以统计方法不充分为由，决定驳回这项雄心勃勃的资助申请。

items.def_zh: 驳回（诉讼/请求）；不予理会
items.def_en: To formally decline to consider a legal case, proposal, or suggestion
items.ex_en: The federal judge decided to dismiss the frivolous lawsuit with prejudice yesterday afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 联邦法官昨天下午决定永久驳回这项无理无据的诉讼。

items.def_en: To officially refuse to accept or allow something, stating it is illegal or against rules
items.ex_en: The referee chose to disallow the winning goal following a blatant offside technical infraction.
items.ex_zh: 裁判在出现明显的越位违规后，判定那粒致胜进球无效并予以驳回。

items.def_en: To reject or annul a decision, objection, or proposal using higher authority
items.ex_en: The appellate court possesses the constitutional authority to overrule arbitrary verdicts issued below.
items.ex_zh: 上诉法院拥有推翻下级法院所作武断判决的宪法权力。

items.def_zh: 否认；拒不承认（协议或主张）
items.def_en: To formally refuse to accept, fulfill, or be bound by an agreement, claim, or charge
items.ex_en: The sovereign administration decided to repudiate the bilateral border treaty signed by previous regimes.
items.ex_zh: 该国主权政府决定拒不承认前政权签署的双边边境条约。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on institutional, procedural, or authoritative refusal to admit, validate, approve, or entertain an application, claim, or doctrine. Nuances contrast judicial rejection, procedural invalidation, and ideological repudiation.
groups.summary_zh: 指权威机构、程序或主管方依据规定予以否定、驳回或不予受理。
groups.desc_en: Uses institutional authority to definitively refuse, strike down, or disavow a claim, motion, or obligation, contrasting with personal informal rejection.
groups.desc_zh: 依据制度或法定权威，终局性地拒绝、驳回或否认某项请求、主张或义务，区别于个人层面的非正式推辞。
groups.nuance_en: reject: outright decline an offer, proposal, or theory as deficient or unacceptable (application / offer / hypothesis) · dismiss: wave away a case, notion, or person as lacking sufficient merit (case / idea / employee) · disallow: legally declare an act, expense, or goal invalid or impermissible (claim / goal / deduction) · overrule: use superior appellate or executive power to reverse a decision (objection / verdict / precedent) · repudiate: formally refuse to recognize, honor, or be bound by an obligation (debt / treaty / doctrine)
groups.nuance_zh: reject: 因不合格或不可接受而直接拒斥提议或申请 (application / offer / hypothesis) · dismiss: 因证据不足或微不足道而驳回诉讼或不予考虑 (case / idea / employee) · disallow: 依规宣告某项主张、进球或报销无效 (claim / goal / deduction) · overrule: 上级长官或法庭行使更高级权力推翻决定 (objection / verdict / precedent) · repudiate: 严正拒不承认某项条约、债务或割断关系 (debt / treaty / doctrine)

groups.name: Official Dispatch & Notification · 简报通知与通报 (Bulletin, Notify, Advise)
groups.tip: 正式发公告通报重要事项

items.def_en: To give formal information or notice to someone regarding a matter
items.ex_en: The regulatory board will advise all financial institutions of updated reporting criteria next Monday.
items.ex_zh: 监管委员会将于下周一就最新的申报标准正式通报所有金融机构。

items.def_en: To send an official circular or written notice to many people simultaneously
items.ex_en: Headquarters determined to circularize new workplace safety protocols to every regional department immediately.
items.ex_zh: 总部决定立即向各个区域部门下发传阅新的职场安全准则。

items.def_en: To inform someone formally or officially of a fact or occurrence
items.ex_en: The registrar will notify admitted candidates regarding registration schedules via secure formal correspondence.
items.ex_zh: 教务处将通过安全的正式函件通知已录取考生有关注册日程的事宜。

items.def_en: To send off a prompt official message, report, or courier
items.ex_en: The command center decided to dispatch an urgent advisory regarding worsening hazardous weather conditions.
items.ex_zh: 指挥中心决定就日益恶化的危险天气状况发出紧急通报。

items.def_zh: 以公报公布，发通告宣布
items.def_en: To announce or publish news by means of an official bulletin.
items.ex_en: The cabinet planned to bulletin the emergency fiscal directives throughout major metropolitan newspapers.
items.ex_zh: 内阁计划通过各大都市报纸以公报形式发布紧急财政指令。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame deal with issuing regular, formal dispatches, bulletins, or official written notifications informing specific stakeholders of critical updates.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过公报、通知书或官方简讯发布重要情况或进展。
groups.desc_en: Disseminates formal administrative, logistical, or institutional intelligence via targeted communal dispatches, contrasting with casual interpersonal gossip.
groups.desc_zh: 通过规范的公告文书或定向通知机制传达官方行政或业务信息，区别于私下的随意寒暄或道听途说。
groups.nuance_en: notify: formally inform an individual or party of an official fact (authorities / next of kin / winner) · advise: formally apprise in professional capacity, or recommend courses of action (client / passenger / board) · dispatch: swiftly send off an official message, courier, or force (orders / troops / envoy) · circularize: distribute a uniform informational document to all members of a list (shareholders / staff / members) · bulletin: broadcast an urgent, brief official news report (findings / status / alert)
groups.nuance_zh: notify: 就特定法律或官方事实正式通告相关人员 (authorities / next of kin / winner) · advise: 依托专业身份正式告知情况或提出专业建议 (client / passenger / board) · dispatch: 快速派遣专使、调遣部队或发送特急公文 (orders / troops / envoy) · circularize: 向全体成员或客户传发通函 (shareholders / staff / members) · bulletin: 通过公报快速播发紧急、要害的官方简讯 (findings / status / alert)

groups.name: Official Record & Gazetting · 官方公报与登报发布 (Gazette, Chronicle, Tabulate)
groups.tip: 通过公报刊载正式昭告大众

items.def_en: To set down officially in writing or other permanent form for preservation
items.ex_en: The court clerk must accurately record every evidentiary statement made during criminal trial proceedings.
items.ex_zh: 法庭书记官必须如实将刑事审判过程中作出的每一条证据陈述记入档案。

items.def_zh: 把……记入（正式簿册或登记簿）
items.def_en: To write down or register a formal record into an official ledger
items.ex_en: Customs officials must enter declared commercial assets directly into the national computerized tracking registry.
items.ex_zh: 海关官员必须把申报的商业资产直接录入国家计算机化跟踪登记册。

items.def_zh: 将……写入会议纪要或正式记录
items.def_en: To take down or record officially in the minutes of a formal meeting
items.ex_en: The corporate secretary will formally minute all dissenting opinions raised during annual shareholder deliberations.
items.ex_zh: 公司秘书将把年度股东审议期间提出的所有反对意见正式记入会议纪要。

items.def_zh: 编年记述；按时间顺序记录
items.def_en: To record a series of events in factual and chronological order
items.ex_en: The exhaustive documentary aims to chronicle the major socio-economic transformations throughout the twentieth century.
items.ex_zh: 这部详尽的纪录片旨在按年代完整记录二十世纪的重大社会经济变革。

items.def_zh: 在政府公报上公布，刊登公报
items.def_en: To publish or announce an official appointment, decree, or notice in a government gazette.
items.ex_en: The state administration plans to gazette the official ministerial appointments early next Friday morning.
items.ex_zh: 州政府计划于下周五清晨在官方公报上正式公布部长任命。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to recording, listing, or promulgating official appointments, decrees, and administrative acts in state journals or formal records.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过政府公报、公文或权威记录正式刊发与备案任命、法令。
groups.desc_en: Inscribes events, legal actions, or public statutes permanently into authoritative archives or public record gazettes, giving them binding social reality.
groups.desc_zh: 将法律行为、事件或官衔任命永久录入权威公报或档案中，使其具备公示公信力与法定效力。
groups.nuance_en: record: commit facts or observations permanently to an enduring physical medium (data / statement / score) · gazette: publish appointments, bankruptcies, or laws in an official government journal (appointment / bankruptcy / order) · minute: formally inscribe discussions and decisions into official meeting records (proceedings / meeting / resolution) · enter: insert a formal transaction or name into an established ledger or system (plea / ledger / competition) · chronicle: record a continuous, detailed historical narrative in temporal order (history / era / journey)
groups.nuance_zh: record: 将事实、言论或数据永久保存在物理媒介上 (data / statement / score) · gazette: 在政府公报上正式刊载任命、破产或法令 (appointment / bankruptcy / order) · minute: 将会议议程与决议正式记录在会议纪要中 (proceedings / meeting / resolution) · enter: 将正式事项、辩词或名字登记入册 (plea / ledger / competition) · chronicle: 依编年次序详细记载历史沿革或大事纪 (history / era / journey)

groups.name: Omit & Leave Out · 遗漏与删减忽略 (Exclude, Drop, Pass Over)
groups.tip: 在表达或记录中略去或疏漏

items.def_en: To fail to include, mention, or take account of someone or something
items.ex_en: Please do not leave out any relevant previous employment details from your submitted resume.
items.ex_zh: 请不要在你提交的简历中遗漏任何相关的过往工作细节。

items.def_en: To ignore, skip, or fail to mention or promote someone or something
items.ex_en: The advisory committee chose to pass over the controversial amendment during initial policy readings.
items.ex_zh: 咨询委员会在政策初读期间选择略过这项有争议的修正案。

items.def_en: To omit, discard, or eliminate an item, person, or topic from a roster or discourse
items.ex_en: Editorial leadership chose to drop the contentious investigative series from upcoming weekend editions entirely.
items.ex_zh: 编辑部领导层决定将那篇颇具争议的调查系列报道从即将出版的周末版中完全删去。
items.ex2_en: The controversial topic dropped from popular conversation after several quiet months.
items.ex2_zh: 经过几个月的平静，这个有争议的话题从大众讨论中淡出了。

items.def_en: To deliberately leave out or keep someone or something out of a group, list, or consideration
items.ex_en: The initial medical assessment chose to exclude patients presenting minor non-respiratory symptoms from trials.
items.ex_zh: 初步医学评估决定将表现出轻微非呼吸道症状的患者排除在试验之外。

items.def_en: To leave out, exclude, or fail to include someone or something.
items.ex_en: Translators must not deliberately omit essential clarifying footnotes when rendering intricate historical treaties.
items.ex_zh: 译者在翻译复杂的历史条约时，绝不可故意删去关键的释义脚注。

groups.summary_en: Denotes leaving out, removing, or failing to mention specific items, facts, or individuals from a text, list, or account, whether intentionally for brevity or accidentally by oversight.
groups.summary_zh: 在清单、报告或表述中有意删减或无意漏掉特定细节或内容。
groups.desc_en: Fails or chooses not to include specific elements in a series, text, or collective entity, contrasting with explicit excision by being an act of leaving aside.
groups.desc_zh: 在一组序列、文本或整体中疏漏或有意不纳入某要素，区别于实体性的削减切割，强调“置于其外”的不计入。
groups.nuance_en: omit: leave out either by deliberate choice or accidental oversight (details / name / chapter) · leave out: informal, practical exclusion of an item from an arrangement or narrative (ingredient / word / guest) · exclude: deliberately bar or keep out from entrance, privilege, or scope (possibility / members / liability) · drop: cease to include, carry, or retain an element from a team, list, or agenda (charges / player / subject) · pass over: intentionally overlook or bypass someone for promotion or attention (candidate / topic / detail)
groups.nuance_zh: omit: 因故意筛选或疏忽而遗漏、未列入 (details / name / chapter) · leave out: 口语化地在安排或叙述中漏掉或省去 (ingredient / word / guest) · exclude: 明确将某人或某可能性排斥在外 (possibility / members / liability) · drop: 从名单、队伍或指控中撤下、放弃 (charges / player / subject) · pass over: 有意忽略某细节，或在晋升中绕过某人 (candidate / topic / detail)

groups.name: Open & Unlock · 开启与开启通道 (Open, Unlock, Unlatch)
groups.tip: 解除闭锁状态并敞开通道

items.def_en: To open the lock of a door, box, or device using a key or code
items.ex_en: The security technician used a master key card to unlock the reinforced storage vault.
items.ex_zh: 安保技术员使用主钥匙卡打开了加固储藏库的门锁。

items.def_zh: 解开；打开（钮扣、绳结、包裹）
items.def_en: To unfasten, untie, or loosen something wrapped, tied, or fastened
items.ex_en: The postal clerk paused carefully to undo the complicated knots securing the overseas package.
items.ex_zh: 邮政职员仔细停下来，解开固定国际包裹的复杂绳结。

items.def_en: To open or undo a latch on a door, gate, or window
items.ex_en: She reached across the wooden frame to unlatch the high window facing the courtyard.
items.ex_zh: 她伸手跨过木制窗框，推开了面向庭院的高窗插销。
items.ex2_en: The loose wooden gate unlatched unexpectedly during the heavy windstorm.
items.ex2_zh: 那扇松动的木门在大风暴中意外地自行松开了闩。

items.def_en: To open a door or window suddenly or wide
items.ex_en: The host hurried forward to throw open the front parlor doors for incoming guests.
items.ex_zh: 主人快步上前，为进门的客人们猛然敞开前厅大门。

items.def_en: 1. To move a door, lid, etc., so that it is no longer closed, or to become open. 2. To start or make available for business or public use.
items.ex_en: The librarian arrived promptly at dawn to open the heavy double doors for patrons.
items.ex_zh: 图书管理员清晨准时赶到，为读者打开沉重的双扇大门。
items.ex2_en: The heavy museum doors opened promptly at nine o'clock every morning.
items.ex2_zh: 沉重的博物馆大门每天早晨九点整准时开启。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers moving physical barriers such as doors, lids, or fasteners so that an enclosed space becomes accessible or unblocked.
groups.summary_zh: 开启门窗、锁具或容器，使出入或内部通道畅通。
groups.desc_en: Releases a physical fastener, portal, or barrier to establish free passage or access, differing from destructive breaching by using normal mechanical articulation.
groups.desc_zh: 解除门禁、紧固件或机械障碍以打开通道，区别于破坏性的破拆，侧重通过机械机关恢复畅通与通路。
groups.nuance_en: open: move a portal or lid to allow passage or view (door / window / eyes) · unlock: release an internal key-operated or electronic locking mechanism (gate / phone / secret) · unlatch: lift or disengage a simple mechanical latch or catch (door / gate / window) · undo: untie, unbutton, or unfasten a binding restraint (knot / button / zipper) · throw open: fling a door wide with sudden, dramatic force (doors / curtains / gates)
groups.nuance_zh: open: 移开门扇、翻开盖子以露出开口或通行 (door / window / eyes) · unlock: 用钥匙或密码解开内部锁闭机构 (gate / phone / secret) · unlatch: 拨开或扳起简易门闩或碰锁 (door / gate / window) · undo: 解开纽扣、拉链或绳结等束缚物 (knot / button / zipper) · throw open: 猛力大开门扉或窗帘，展现敞开姿态 (doors / curtains / gates)

groups.name: Opinion Polling & Social Survey · 民意测验与问卷抽样 (Poll, Survey, Canvass, Sample)
groups.tip: 社会调查与公众民意测验

items.def_en: To question a selected group of people in order to collect detailed information about their behavior, opinions, or lifestyles.
items.ex_en: Independent sociologists plan to survey rural households regarding their changing access to telecommunication infrastructure.
items.ex_zh: 独立社会学者计划对农村家庭进行民调，了解他们在获取电信基础设施方面的变化。

items.def_en: To test, question, or observe a representative subset of a population in order to draw conclusions about the whole.
items.ex_en: Statisticians must accurately sample registered voters across multiple competitive districts to forecast election results.
items.ex_zh: 统计人员必须跨多个竞争激烈的选区对登记选民进行抽样调查，以预测选举结果。

items.def_zh: 对……进行民意调查；获得（票数）；投票
items.def_en: 1. To ask a group of people specific questions to discover their opinions. 2. To receive a particular number of votes in an election.
items.ex_en: Research centers regularly poll eligible voters concerning trust in domestic legal institutions and leadership.
items.ex_zh: 研究中心定期就合格选民对本国法律机构和领导层的信任度进行民意测验。

items.def_en: To administer a structured series of written questions to respondents for statistical analysis.
items.ex_en: The department decided to questionnaire newly matriculated undergraduates regarding initial residential housing conditions.
items.ex_zh: 该部门决定通过问卷调查刚入学的本科生对初期待遇住宿条件的看法。

items.def_zh: 游说拉票；挨门征集民意
items.def_en: To visit individuals in an area or contact them systematically to solicit votes, solicit opinions, or assess support.
items.ex_en: Campaign volunteers plan to canvass competitive suburban neighborhoods ahead of early voting next week.
items.ex_zh: 竞选志愿者计划在下周提前投票之前，在竞争激烈的郊区社区挨门拜访拉票。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe collecting opinions, voting preferences, or statistical data from a representative sample of people. They highlight standardized data-gathering methods such as questionnaires, street interviews, and door-to-door consultations.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过问卷、访谈或挨户抽样等标准化手段采集大众观点或选民意向。
groups.desc_en: Systematically queries a representative population subset to measure distribution of sentiment, intent, or sociological data, contrasting with speculative guessing.
groups.desc_zh: 对具有代表性的人口样本展开系统化问卷或问询，以测定民意意向与社会数据分布，区别于凭空揣测。
groups.nuance_en: poll: question a designated sample to quantify immediate opinion or voting intent (voters / public / sample) · survey: comprehensively investigate conditions, opinions, or behaviors across a sector (population / landscape / respondents) · canvass: conduct door-to-door direct solicitations to secure votes or determine stances (neighborhood / support / opinions) · sample: extract a small representative portion of a population for empirical study (population / blood / cohort)
groups.nuance_zh: poll: 针对特定受众抽样定量统计即时民调或投票意向 (voters / public / sample) · survey: 对群体状况、态度或地理风貌作全面详实的勘测调查 (population / landscape / respondents) · canvass: 深入社区逐户游说拉票或排摸摸底 (neighborhood / support / opinions) · sample: 抽取具有统计代表性的小样本进行检验分析 (population / blood / cohort)

groups.name: Oppress & Subjugate · 压迫与奴役 (Subjugate, Enslave, Tyrannize)
groups.tip: 残暴统治并彻底剥夺自由

items.def_en: To suppress a group through force or discriminatory policy so that they cannot advance or gain rights
items.ex_en: Authoritarian regimes often implement harsh censorship laws to keep down restless opposition movements.
items.ex_zh: 威权政权往往通过严苛的审查法案来压制躁动不安的反对派运动。

items.def_zh: 压迫，欺压；使压抑，使沉重
items.def_en: 1. To treat a group of people cruelly and unfairly, especially by restricting their freedom or rights. 2. (often passive) To make someone feel anxious, depressed, or uncomfortable.
items.ex_en: Autocratic rulers frequently oppress marginalized religious minorities through severe social restrictions and surveillance.
items.ex_zh: 专制统治者频繁通过严苛的社会限制和监视来压迫边缘化的少数宗教群体。

items.def_en: (+ over) To treat people cruelly, harshly, and arbitrarily through abuse of authoritarian power
items.ex_en: The brutal colonial governor continued to tyrannize over the impoverished regional peasantry without restraint.
items.ex_zh: 残暴的殖民地总督肆无忌惮地继续苛待当地贫困的农民阶层。

items.def_en: To defeat and place an entire country or group completely under political or military control
items.ex_en: Imperial legions mobilized across the continent to subjugate autonomous territories along the frontier borders.
items.ex_zh: 帝国军团在大陆各地集结，企图征服边境沿线的自治领土。

items.def_en: To deprive someone of their basic personal liberty and force them into perpetual bondage as property
items.ex_en: Raiders crossed the border during wartime to enslave entire conquered settlements for forced plantation labor.
items.ex_zh: 突袭者在战时越过边境，奴役被征服定居点的全部居民从事庄园强迫劳动。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the systematic and harsh exercise of power to crush the autonomy, freedom, and human dignity of subjects. Distinctions turn on whether the dominance is institutionalized servitude, military subjugation, or arbitrary despotic cruelty.
groups.summary_zh: 凭借强权剥夺人身自由、施加苛政或彻底奴化奴役。
groups.desc_en: Enforces asymmetric, structural domination over a subjugated group through cruelty and coercion, distinguishing itself from fair governance by systemic injustice.
groups.desc_zh: 凭借不对等的强制暴力与严酷手段对屈从群体施加结构性统治，区别于公正的管辖，强调剥夺自由与制度性摧残。
groups.nuance_en: oppress: weigh heavily upon a subject people through systematic cruelty and denial of rights (minority / workers / populace) · subjugate: bring under total political or military dominion by force (territory / enemy / population) · enslave: reduce persons legally or functionally to commodified forced labor (people / captives / mind) · tyrannize: rule with capricious, cruel, and absolute despotic power (subjects / family / populace) · keep down: repress rebellion or economic advancement by continuous suppression (wages / dissidents / population)
groups.nuance_zh: oppress: 用专横残暴的制度长期压迫弱势群体并剥夺权利 (minority / workers / populace) · subjugate: 用武力或征服使敌人或领地彻底屈服并受统辖 (territory / enemy / population) · enslave: 将人沦为丧失自由的奴隶或商品化强迫劳工 (people / captives / mind) · tyrannize: 以暴君般专横跋扈、反复无常的手腕实施欺压 (subjects / family / populace) · keep down: 持续打压物价、薪资或用高压手段遏制民众反抗 (wages / dissidents / population)

groups.name: Orbit & Revolve · 环绕与天体运行 (Revolve, Circle, Circumambulate)
groups.tip: 绕轴或轨道打转

items.def_en: To move around someone or something in a circular or looping path
items.ex_en: Several reconnaissance aircraft continue to circle the troubled airspace above the naval blockade.
items.ex_zh: 数架侦察机继续在海上封锁区上空的不安空域盘旋环行。

items.def_en: To walk all the way around something, especially as part of a formal or religious ritual
items.ex_en: Devout pilgrims reverently circumambulate the ancient gilded shrine while chanting traditional morning prayers.
items.ex_zh: 虔诚的朝圣者一边吟诵传统的晨祷，一边庄严地绕着古老的镀金圣殿巡走。

items.def_en: To move in a curved path around a star, planet, or moon.
items.ex_en: Numerous weather satellites orbit the planet to transmit real-time meteorological observations to ground stations.
items.ex_zh: 众多气象卫星环绕地球轨道运行，向地面站实时传输气象观测数据。

items.def_en: (+ around) To travel in a curved path or circular orbit around a central point or body
items.ex_en: Astronomers calculated precisely how the minor planets revolve around the massive celestial center.
items.ex_zh: 天文学家精确计算出了这些小行星是如何围绕巨大的天体中心公转的。
items.ex2_en: The engineer designed a mechanical arm that revolved the circular display.
items.ex2_zh: 工程师设计了一个机械臂来旋转那个圆形展示台。

items.def_en: To sail or travel all the way around an island, continent, or celestial body
items.ex_en: The robotic exploration vessel managed to circumnavigate the icy planetary moon within several months.
items.ex_zh: 这艘自动化探测飞船成功在数月内绕行了这颗冰冻的行星卫星一周。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures objects moving around a central point, celestial body, or landmark in a closed circular or elliptical trajectory. 'Orbit' and 'revolve' typically govern gravitational paths in space, whereas 'circle' and 'circumambulate' apply widely to terrestrial movement.
groups.summary_zh: 指围绕中心天体或目标做闭合圆周或椭圆轨迹运动。
groups.desc_en: Traces a curved, closed path around a central pivot point or gravitational focus, differing from linear forward locomotion by continuous rotational geometry.
groups.desc_zh: 围绕中心支点或引力核心沿闭合弯曲路径作周向运动，区别于直线位移，强调连续的旋转几何轨迹。
groups.nuance_en: orbit: travel in an gravitationally bound, elliptical spatial path around a celestial body (planet / sun / Earth) · revolve: turn around a central external axis or point in a circular cycle (wheels / planets / earth) · circle: move flexibly in a curved track around an object or airspace (target / airport / prey) · circumnavigate: travel completely around the entire globe or landmass by sea or air (globe / island / cape) · circumambulate: walk solemnly and ceremonially around a sacred shrine or relic (altar / stupa / shrine)
groups.nuance_zh: orbit: 沿受引力束缚的特定轨道绕天体运行 (planet / sun / Earth) · revolve: 围绕外部中心点或轴心作周期性公转或旋转 (wheels / planets / earth) · circle: 盘旋或顺着圆形路径环绕某物 (target / airport / prey) · circumnavigate: 乘船或航空彻底环游地球或陆地一圈 (globe / island / cape) · circumambulate: 出于宗教礼仪肃穆地绕神坛或圣所巡行 (altar / stupa / shrine)

groups.name: Orbit & Wheel · 环绕与盘旋 (Orbit, Revolve, Hover)
groups.tip: 沿圆形轨道绕圈飞行

items.def_en: To fly or move in wide circles or curves
items.ex_en: Flocks of hungry seagulls wheel above fishing trawlers returning to the bustling harbor waters.
items.ex_zh: 成群饥饿的海鸥在返回繁忙港口水域的拖网渔船上空盘旋飞翔。
items.ex2_en: The skilled pilot wheeled the small aircraft around toward the runway.
items.ex2_zh: 熟练的飞行员驾驶轻型飞机转弯朝向跑道。

items.def_zh: 盘旋，绕圈移动；环绕，围绕
items.def_en: 1. To move in a circle or travel around someone or something, especially in flight. 2. To draw a circle around something.
items.ex_en: Vultures began to circle slowly above the arid canyon floor in search of carrion.
items.ex_zh: 秃鹫开始在干旱的峡谷谷底上方缓慢盘旋，寻觅腐尸。

items.def_en: To move around a star, planet, or object in a regular curved path
items.ex_en: Communications arrays continuously orbit the distant asteroid to map its jagged mineral composition.
items.ex_zh: 通信天线阵列持续沿轨道环绕遥远的小行星运行，以绘制其参差不齐的矿物成分。

items.def_en: (+ around) To move in a circular or curved course around a central point or axis
items.ex_en: Several small celestial bodies revolve around the massive star in steady, elliptical paths.
items.ex_zh: 几颗小型天体沿着稳定的椭圆轨道绕着那颗巨大的恒星旋转。
items.ex2_en: The technician slowly revolved the giant telescope toward the southern sky.
items.ex2_zh: 技术人员缓慢地将巨型望远镜转向南面的天空。

items.def_en: To turn around quickly in a circle or spiral motion
items.ex_en: The dancers began to gyrate in rhythmic circles around the flickering ceremonial fire.
items.ex_zh: 舞者们开始围着摇曳的祭祀篝火有节奏地盘旋起舞。

groups.summary_en: This frame relates to continuous, dynamic movement in a curved, circular, or hovering path around an axis, center, or focal point.
groups.summary_zh: 指沿弯曲或环形轨道持续旋转、绕行或在空中盘旋飞行。
groups.desc_en: Denotes circular or curvilinear movement around a focal point or axis, contrasting with linear travel by emphasizing continuous looping, orbital capture, or rotational momentum.
groups.desc_zh: 表示绕某一中心或轴心进行的圆周或弧线运动，与直线位移不同，强调回环盘旋、轨道捕获或轴向旋转的动态。
groups.nuance_en: orbit: gravitational circling around a celestial or authoritative center (Earth / sun / moon) · circle: sweeping closed-loop transit or tracking (prey / drain / airport) · wheel: sudden sweeping pivot or synchronized aerial banking (birds / flock / stars) · revolve: continuous rotation around an internal axis or central concept (sun / axis / idea) · gyrate: wild, rapid, or unstable spiral oscillation (hips / markets / dancer)
groups.nuance_zh: orbit: 绕天体或权威中心的轨道运行 (Earth / sun / moon) · circle: 盘旋追踪或打转闭环 (prey / drain / airport) · wheel: 骤然回转或成群变向盘旋 (birds / flock / stars) · revolve: 围绕内轴或核心运转转动 (sun / axis / idea) · gyrate: 狂暴、剧烈或不稳定的螺旋旋转 (hips / markets / dancer)

groups.name: Orient & Align · 定位与对准 (Align, Direct, Position)
groups.tip: 调整方向对齐准星

items.def_en: Move or turn in a specified heading or direction
items.ex_en: Hikers must bear left at the fork to reach the scenic mountain pass.
items.ex_zh: 徒步旅行者必须在岔路口向左行进才能到达风景秀丽的山口。

items.def_en: Direct sight, weapons, or attention precisely toward a specific point
items.ex_en: Detectives quickly zeroed in on the primary suspect after discovering the stolen vehicle.
items.ex_zh: 发现被盗车辆后，侦探们迅速锁定了主要嫌疑人。

items.def_en: Align or position something relative to the points of a compass or specified reference points
items.ex_en: Ancient architects chose to orient the sacred temple toward the rising summer sun.
items.ex_zh: 古代建筑师选择让这座神圣的庙宇朝向夏日初升的太阳。

items.def_en: Place or arrange things in a straight line or in correct relative positions
items.ex_en: Please align the margins of the printed document with the physical ruler edge.
items.ex_zh: 请将打印文档的边距与实物尺子的边缘对齐。
items.ex2_en: The solar panels aligned automatically with the bright morning sun.
items.ex2_zh: 太阳能电池板自动与清晨明亮的阳光对齐。

items.def_zh: 确定方向，定位；使朝向，使适应
items.def_en: 1. To determine one's position or find one's direction. 2. To direct or align something toward a particular goal, position, or audience.
items.ex_en: The scout used a magnetic compass to orientate himself in the dense forest.
items.ex_zh: 侦察员使用指南针在茂密的森林中确定自己的方位。
items.ex2_en: The building orientates toward the east to capture early morning sunlight.
items.ex2_zh: 这座建筑物朝向东方，以便采纳清晨的阳光。

groups.summary_en: Verbs describing determining one's bearing or positioning something physically or conceptually in relation to compass points, surroundings, or specific goals.
groups.summary_zh: 指确定自身方位，或使物体与目标在方向、位置上保持一致。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on adjusting spatial, mechanical, or cognitive direction toward an exact reference point, differing from generalized turning by emphasizing calibrated alignment or targeting.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重于调整空间、机械或认知指向以对准精确参照点，与普通转向不同，强调校准性对齐与定向。
groups.nuance_en: align: parallel or rectilinear coordination with an external standard (interests / wheels / strategy) · orient: establish cognitive, cultural, or physical bearing relative to surroundings (compass / newcomer / thoughts) · orientate: primarily British variant stressing conscious self-positioning (students / self / map) · zero in on: progressive convergence onto a specific target (target / problem / suspect) · bear: directional movement or angular orientation relative to a heading (north / compass / heading)
groups.nuance_zh: align: 与外部基准平齐或保持步调一致 (interests / wheels / strategy) · orient: 确定自身所处环境的物理或认知方位 (compass / newcomer / thoughts) · orientate: 自我定位或使适应（英式常用） (students / self / map) · zero in on: 逐步逼近并精准锁定目标 (target / problem / suspect) · bear: 沿特定罗盘航向行进或朝向 (north / compass / heading)

groups.name: Orient & Direct · 定位与定向 (Orient, Align, Geared toward)
groups.tip: 调整认知方向与思维定位

items.def_en: To aim, target, or set a product, speech, or tone at a particular level or audience
items.ex_en: The marketing team decided to pitch the commercial to tech-savvy young adults.
items.ex_zh: 营销团队决定将这则广告定位于精通科技的年轻群体。

items.def_zh: 给…定位，使朝向；使适应，使熟悉；确定方向
items.def_en: 1. to direct or adapt something toward a particular group, activity, or purpose 2. [T, often reflexive] to familiarize oneself with a new situation or environment 3. to find one's direction or position, or align something with a particular direction
items.ex_en: The university redesigned its curriculum to orient students toward sustainable environmental careers.
items.ex_zh: 大学重新设计了课程体系，引导学生走向可持续环保职业。

items.def_zh: 调整…以求一致，使协调对齐
items.def_en: To arrange or adjust things so that they form a line or are in agreement with goals
items.ex_en: We must align our operational strategy with the board’s long-term financial goals.
items.ex_zh: 我们必须调整运营策略，使之与董事会的长期财务目标保持一致。
items.ex2_en: The front wheels of the heavy delivery truck aligned correctly today.
items.ex2_zh: 这辆重型送货车的前轮今天校正到位了。

items.def_en: To design, organize, or adjust something so that it is suitable for a particular need or group
items.ex_en: The community workshops are geared toward helping retired citizens learn digital skills.
items.ex_zh: 这些社区研讨会旨在帮助退休市民学习数字技能。

items.def_zh: 量身定制，专门调整以适应
items.def_en: To adapt or design something specifically to suit individual needs or conditions
items.ex_en: The trainer will tailor the daily workout routine to your personal fitness level.
items.ex_zh: 教练会根据你的个人体能水平量身定制每日健身方案。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to establishing directional position, adjusting mental focus, or tailoring products and actions toward a specific goal or audience.
groups.summary_zh: 确定方位，调整心智认知，或使行动策略专门迎合特定受众与目标。
groups.desc_en: Denotes deliberately designing, tailoring, or angling an artifact, message, or policy toward a specific target audience, differing from basic creating by its purposeful strategic tuning.
groups.desc_zh: 表示为了契合特定受众或目标而精心构裁、调整表述或设定方案，与普通制作不同，强调目的明确的策略性匹配与剪裁。
groups.nuance_en: pitch: calibrate tone, register, or proposal for persuasive appeal (appeal / product / speech) · gear: mechanically or structurally adapt to serve a demographic or goal (economy / curriculum / production) · tailor: bespoke customization to fit unique requirements (suit / treatment / advice) · orient: direct thematic focus or strategic emphasis toward an end (policy / research / mind) · align: harmonize strategic objectives with external priorities (incentives / goals / curriculum)
groups.nuance_zh: pitch: 调整基调或方案以对特定受众产生吸引力 (appeal / product / speech) · gear: 从机制或结构上调整以适应用途 (economy / curriculum / production) · tailor: 为适应特殊需求进行量体裁衣式定制 (suit / treatment / advice) · orient: 将主题焦点或战略侧重点导向某处 (policy / research / mind) · align: 使战略目标与外部要求协同并轨 (incentives / goals / curriculum)

groups.name: Outlast & Endure · 历久与经久耐用 (Outlast, Outwear, Weather)
groups.tip: 比对方更耐磨损且存留时间更长

items.def_en: To continue to survive, resist, or function under difficult conditions or sustained pressure
items.ex_en: The besieged garrison managed to hold out until reinforcements arrived at dawn.
items.ex_zh: 被围困的守军咬牙坚持，直到增援部队在拂晓时赶到。

items.def_en: To remain alive or extant after the death, demise, or obsolescence of another
items.ex_en: The beloved patriarch lived to outlive most of his childhood companions and peers.
items.ex_zh: 这位受人爱戴的家族长辈比他童年时代的大多数同伴都要长寿。

items.def_en: To continue to exist, work, or be effective for a longer period of time than someone or something else
items.ex_en: High-quality leather boots will easily outlast cheaper footwear under harsh winter conditions.
items.ex_zh: 在严酷的冬季条件下，优质皮靴的使用寿命远长于廉价鞋子。

items.def_en: To endure a crisis, hardship, or deterioration successfully and continue to stand or operate
items.ex_en: The resilient local business managed to weather the severe economic recession without layoffs.
items.ex_zh: 这家富有韧性的本地企业安然度过了严重的经济衰退，没有裁员。

items.def_zh: 比……更耐用，比……耐久；穿破，耗尽
items.def_en: 1. To last longer or remain usable for a greater time than something else. 2. (archaic) To wear out, exhaust, or spend
items.ex_en: Such sturdy granite columns will surely outwear the transient wooden structures around them.
items.ex_zh: 如此坚固的花岗岩石柱必然比周围易朽的木质结构更为持久。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey surviving, remaining functional, or persisting across time longer than competitors or beyond harsh conditions.
groups.summary_zh: 强调耐磨损、经受住岁月冲刷或比他物更持久。
groups.desc_en: Signifies remaining functional or alive beyond the temporal lifespan, stress, or erosion threshold of a rival entity, contrasting with plain surviving by framing longevity as comparative endurance.
groups.desc_zh: 表示在时间寿命、压力磨损或生存抗争上超越对手或极限，与单纯存活不同，强调比较意义上的持久胜出与耐受力。
groups.nuance_en: outlast: endure longer in time or stamina than a competitor (rival / storm / battery) · outlive: survive past the death of another or the expiration of relevance (spouse / usefulness / children) · outwear: withstand physical abrasion or outlast material durability (fabric / welcome / patience) · weather: ride out severe external adversity without crumbling (crisis / recession / storm) · hold out: maintain resistance or survival against persistent siege or depleted supplies (garrison / supplies / hope)
groups.nuance_zh: outlast: 在时间或耐力上比竞争对手更持久 (rival / storm / battery) · outlive: 比他人长寿，或寿命长过实用期 (spouse / usefulness / children) · outwear: 经久耐穿磨损，或耗尽 (fabric / welcome / patience) · weather: 顶住严重外部风浪或危机而不垮 (crisis / recession / storm) · hold out: 在包围或资源匮乏下坚守不屈 (garrison / supplies / hope)

groups.name: Outright Refusal & Declining · 坚定拒绝与推辞 (Refuse, Decline, Turn Down)
groups.tip: 从委婉推却到断然予以拒绝

items.def_en: To politely refuse an invitation, offer, or request
items.ex_en: The ambassador had to decline the banquet invitation due to pressing state affairs.
items.ex_zh: 大使因公务繁忙，不得不婉言谢绝了晚宴邀请。

items.def_en: To reject or refuse an offer, request, applicant, or invitation
items.ex_en: She decided to turn down the job offer because of the long commute.
items.ex_zh: 由于通勤时间过长，她决定拒绝那份工作邀约。

items.def_en: To state or show firmly that one is not willing to do, give, accept, or grant something.
items.ex_en: The stubborn witness continued to refuse to answer any questions from the prosecutor.
items.ex_zh: 倔强的证人依然坚决拒绝回答检察官提出的任何问题。

items.def_zh: (+ at) 畏缩不前；断然拒绝去做
items.def_en: (+ at) To hesitate or flatly refuse to proceed with an action or idea
items.ex_en: Board members balked at the astronomical cost of constructing the new headquarters.
items.ex_zh: 董事会成员对建造新总部所需的天文数字费用断然表示反对。

items.def_en: To refuse to give, disclose, or grant something that is requested or required
items.ex_en: The regulatory agency decided to withhold approval until further safety tests were concluded.
items.ex_zh: 监管机构决定在进一步的安全测试完成之前暂不予批准。

groups.summary_en: This core communicative frame captures expressing an unwillingness to comply, accept, grant, or participate in something. Nuances range from formal polite declination to resolute, direct, and unyielding refusal.
groups.summary_zh: 明确表明不肯做、不愿给予或拒绝接受某种要求或提议。
groups.desc_en: Covers intentional acts of rejecting an offer, command, or request, varying from polite social demurring to obstinate obstruction, distinct from neutral inaction by explicit negative volition.
groups.desc_zh: 涵盖对提议、命令或请求的主动拒斥行为，从礼貌推辞到顽固阻抗不等，与被动不作为不同，体现明确的否定性意志。
groups.nuance_en: refuse: categorical and firm rejection of a command or demand (offer / permission / compliance) · decline: courteous, formal softening of a refusal (invitation / nomination / interview) · turn down: pragmatic everyday dismissal of a proposal or applicant (application / offer / request) · balk: stubborn, balky halt when facing an onerous condition (price / demand / suggestion) · withhold: deliberately retain or deny something required or requested (consent / evidence / funding)
groups.nuance_zh: refuse: 断然坚决地拒绝命令或要求 (offer / permission / compliance) · decline: 客气、委婉、正式地谢绝 (invitation / nomination / interview) · turn down: 日常务实地否决或推掉提议与申请 (application / offer / request) · balk: 因嫌苛刻而畏缩止步或顽抗 (price / demand / suggestion) · withhold: 故意扣留、保留或拒绝给予 (consent / evidence / funding)

groups.name: Overact & Embellish · 矫饰表演与过火作态 (Chew the scenery, Melodramatize, Camp up)
groups.tip: 戏剧表演时表现过于夸张

items.def_en: to perform or present something in a deliberately theatrical, flamboyant, or ironic style
items.ex_en: The comic actors chose to camp up their villainous roles for cheap laughs.
items.ex_zh: 喜剧演员们刻意做作夸张地扮演反派角色，以博取廉价的笑声。

items.def_zh: 做怪相引人发笑；夸张扮相
items.def_en: to make exaggerated facial expressions, especially when performing before an audience or camera
items.ex_en: He loved to mug for the camera whenever his friends took holiday photos.
items.ex_zh: 每当朋友们拍度假照片时，他总喜欢对着镜头挤眉弄眼扮鬼脸。

items.def_zh: 渲染成情节剧；过分夸大渲染
items.def_en: to present a situation or emotion in an excessively dramatic and sensationally emotional manner
items.ex_en: Sensational tabloids often melodramatize minor celebrity disputes to boost their daily readership.
items.ex_zh: 耸人听闻的小报经常将名人的微小争执大肆夸张渲染，以提高每日阅读量。

items.def_zh: 大肆卖弄演技；表演极尽夸张
items.def_en: to act in an exaggerated, uncontrolled, and theatrical way that draws excessive attention
items.ex_en: The veteran actor loved to chew the scenery during every villainous monologue.
items.ex_zh: 这位资深演员总喜欢在每段反派独白中大肆卖弄其夸张的演技。

items.def_en: to perform a dramatic role in an exaggerated, unnatural, and overly emotional way
items.ex_en: Critics noted that the amateur lead tended to overact during subtle emotional scenes.
items.ex_zh: 剧评人指出，那位业余主演在微妙的情感戏中往往表演得过于用力夸张。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe excessive, exaggerated theatricality or contrived posturing on stage or in public life, lacking subtlety and natural restraint.
groups.summary_zh: 指在表演、言辞或举止中过于夸张做作、极度情绪化，缺乏克制与自然感。
groups.desc_en: Refers to histrionic, exaggerated, or ostentatious performance and mannerisms, contrasting with standard portrayal by intentionally exceeding emotional realism or artistic restraint.
groups.desc_zh: 指戏剧化、过火夸张或浮夸作态的表演举止，与标准演绎不同，强调故意逾越情感写实与艺术节制的张扬过火。
groups.nuance_en: overact: generic failure of artistic restraint through excessive dramatic exertion (role / scene / grief) · chew the scenery: flamboyant, wildly uninhibited theatrics dominating the stage (actor / villain / monologue) · melodramatize: inflate mundane events into lurid, sentimental spectacles (situation / illness / crisis) · camp up: deliberately exaggerate with ironic, flamboyant, or kitschy theatricality (performance / costume / film) · mug: contort facial expressions excessively to solicit cheap laughs (camera / audience / face)
groups.nuance_zh: overact: 缺乏艺术节制，表演用力过猛 (role / scene / grief) · chew the scenery: 戏瘾大发、张牙舞爪地霸占舞台过火表演 (actor / villain / monologue) · melodramatize: 将寻常小事渲染为耸人听闻的情感闹剧 (situation / illness / crisis) · camp up: 刻意以反讽、夸张或坎普风作态 (performance / costume / film) · mug: 挤眉弄眼扮丑相以博取廉价笑声 (camera / audience / face)

groups.name: Overexpose & Lay Bare · 过度暴露与显露无遗 (Lay Bare, Unmask, Baresark)
groups.tip: 胶片过曝或使事物显露

items.def_en: To publicly disclose a secret or private aspect of someone's identity or life
items.ex_en: A malicious blogger threatened to out the politician’s secret offshore financial holdings.
items.ex_zh: 一名恶意博主威胁要曝光这位政客秘密持有的离岸资产。

items.def_zh: 彻底暴露；使赤裸裸显现
items.def_en: To reveal or expose something hidden or secret completely to scrutiny
items.ex_en: The investigative journalist's latest memoir will lay bare decades of institutional corruption.
items.ex_zh: 这位调查记者的最新回忆录将把数十年的体制性腐败彻底暴露无遗。

items.def_en: To remove all extra coverings or concealments to reveal the raw underlying structure
items.ex_en: Mechanics had to strip down the vintage engine to diagnose the recurring rattling sound.
items.ex_zh: 机械师们不得不将这台老式发动机彻底拆解，以排查反复出现的异响。

items.def_en: To show the true, often deceptive, character or identity of someone or something
items.ex_en: The investigative report served to unmask the fraudulent dealings of the prominent philanthropist.
items.ex_zh: 这篇调查报道揭穿了那位知名慈善家的欺诈交易面目。

items.def_zh: 使曝光过度；使过度暴露，使过度曝光
items.def_en: 1. (photography) To expose film or a sensor to too much light. 2. To expose someone or something to public view so frequently that interest is lost.
items.ex_en: Setting the shutter speed too slow will inevitably overexpose your midday landscape photos.
items.ex_zh: 快门速度设置得过慢不可避免地会导致正午的风景照片曝光过度。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve bringing hidden parts, vulnerabilities, or identity completely into view, or subjecting something to excessive, damaging exposure and scrutiny.
groups.summary_zh: 指将隐藏的事物、脆弱面或真实面目公之于众，或使其承受过多暴露与聚焦。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on stripping away protective disguises, privacy, or layers to expose underlying truth or vulnerability, contrasting with neutral revealing by stressing nakedness, exposure, or scandal.
groups.desc_zh: 侧重于剥去伪装、隐私或防护层，使潜在真相或脆弱本相暴露无遗，与普通揭示不同，强调曝光、赤裸与无所遮蔽。
groups.nuance_en: lay bare: completely uncover foundational truths, structures, or vulnerabilities (soul / secrets / flaws) · unmask: strip the fraudulent disguise or false persona from a bad actor (traitor / hypocrisy / villain) · out: non-consensually reveal an individual's closeted identity or secret affiliation (politician / spy / agent) · strip down: reduce to bare essentials by peeling away nonessential layers (car / bureaucracy / narrative) · overexpose: damage or fatigue through excessive photographic light or public ubiquity (film / celebrity / brand)
groups.nuance_zh: lay bare: 彻底揭开隐秘真相、内部架构或脆弱弱点 (soul / secrets / flaws) · unmask: 剥掉伪装揭露真面目 (traitor / hypocrisy / villain) · out: 强制曝光某人的隐秘身份或内情 (politician / spy / agent) · strip down: 剥离繁文缛节或表层直达本质 (car / bureaucracy / narrative) · overexpose: 因曝光过度而受损或引起公众审美疲劳 (film / celebrity / brand)

groups.name: Overextension & Strain · 过度拉伸与绷紧超负荷 (Overstretch, Strain, Overtax)
groups.tip: 过度拉长拉紧超出弹性极限

items.def_en: To injure or stretch a muscle or part of the body by working it too hard, or put extreme pressure on resources
items.ex_en: Lifting heavy boxes without proper technique can easily strain your lower back muscles.
items.ex_zh: 搬运重箱子若姿势不当，很容易拉伤下背部肌肉。

items.def_en: To make or become pulled tight with little or no slack
items.ex_en: The sailor pulled firmly on the rope to tauten the flapping canvas sail.
items.ex_zh: 水手用力拉紧绳索，使扑簌拍打的帆布重新绷紧。
items.ex2_en: The mooring ropes tautened visibly as the massive cargo ship departed.
items.ex2_zh: 当巨型货轮起航时，系泊缆绳明显绷紧了。

items.def_en: To stretch a limb or physical object past its natural reach, or commit resources beyond capacity
items.ex_en: Small retail companies often collapse when they overextend their resources into unfamiliar markets.
items.ex_zh: 小型零售公司将其资源过度扩张到陌生的市场时往往会崩溃。

items.def_zh: 拉伸过度；使负担过重，使透支
items.def_en: 1. To stretch a muscle, limb, or material beyond its normal or safe limit. 2. To put too great a demand on financial, human, or military resources.
items.ex_en: Taking on three freelance projects at once will severely overstretch your mental stamina.
items.ex_zh: 同时承接三个自由职业项目会使你的精力严重透支。
items.ex2_en: The thin rubber band overstretched and snapped across the wooden desk.
items.ex2_zh: 细橡皮筋被拉得过长，在木桌上绷断了。

items.def_en: To make excessive demands on someone's physical strength, resources, or capacity
items.ex_en: Constant overtime duties began to visibly overtax the health of the nursing staff.
items.ex_zh: 无休止的加班显然已经让护理人员的健康不堪重负。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate stretching physical materials, muscles, or abstract resources far beyond their safe or elastic limits, leading to tension, injury, or exhaustion. Nuances contrast anatomical strain, material overextension, and budgetary or mental overcommitment.
groups.summary_zh: 指将肌肉、弹性材质或精力资源绷拉至超出极限，引发损伤或过载。
groups.desc_en: Depicts stretching physical materials, physiological faculties, or resources beyond their elastic limit, contrasting with normal expansion by the imminent danger of rupture or collapse.
groups.desc_zh: 指将物理材质、生理机能或财务资源拉伸至弹性极限以上，与正常扩张不同，带有即将崩断或衰竭的张力危机感。
groups.nuance_en: strain: exert force to the limits of physical or relational tolerance (muscle / eyes / relations) · overextend: commit assets, military fronts, or credit beyond sustainable supply (credit / troops / self) · overstretch: pull resources or operational scope dangerously thin (budget / capacity / imagination) · overtax: exhaust vital functional capacities by imposing excessive burdens (energy / strength / system) · tauten: pull physical ropes or metaphorical nerves to stiff, rigid tension (rope / skin / nerves)
groups.nuance_zh: strain: 极度吃力地拉紧，使耐受度接近极限 (muscle / eyes / relations) · overextend: 战线、信用或精力铺得过大超出承受力 (credit / troops / self) · overstretch: 资源或运作范围拉伸过薄而捉襟见肘 (budget / capacity / imagination) · overtax: 施加过重负荷致使机能耗竭 (energy / strength / system) · tauten: 使绳索或神经紧绷绷直 (rope / skin / nerves)

groups.name: Overgrow & Proliferate · 疯长与丛生 (Overgrow, Invade, Proliferate)
groups.tip: 生物疯狂增殖乃至覆盖蔓生

items.def_en: To increase rapidly in numbers or reproduce profusely
items.ex_en: Unregulated digital platforms allow conspiracy theories to proliferate at an alarming rate worldwide.
items.ex_zh: 不受监管的数字平台让阴谋论在全球范围内以惊人的速度扩散。

items.def_en: To grow luxuriantly, wildly, and without control across an area
items.ex_en: Untamed blackberry bushes began to run riot across the abandoned courtyard all summer.
items.ex_zh: 整个夏天，野生的黑莓灌木在荒废的院子里肆意疯长。

items.def_en: (+ off/out) To prevent the growth of desirable plants by growing densely over them
items.ex_en: Invasive kudzu vines quickly choke off the native vegetation along the sunny riverbank.
items.ex_zh: 侵入性的野葛藤迅速扼杀了阳光充足的河岸边的原生植被。
items.ex2_en: The delicate flower seedlings choked out beneath the thick layer of weeds.
items.ex2_zh: 娇嫩的花苗在厚厚的杂草层下被窒息阻碍生长。

items.def_zh: （害虫、杂草等）成群滋生；大批侵扰
items.def_en: To exist in large, unwanted numbers in a place, spreading densely and causing damage
items.ex_en: Termites managed to infest the wooden floorboards of the historic seaside residence.
items.ex_zh: 白蚁大肆侵扰滋生在那座历史悠久的海滨住宅的木地板中。

items.def_zh: 在……上蔓延覆盖，长满；长得过大
items.def_en: 1. To cover an area by growing thickly and aggressively over it. 2. To grow too large.
items.ex_en: Creeping ivy continued to overgrow the crumbled brick walls of the monastery.
items.ex_zh: 攀爬的常春藤继续蔓延覆盖在修道院坍塌的砖墙上。

groups.summary_en: Denotes aggressive, dense, or unchecked biological expansion where vegetation, cells, or weeds overwhelm a space through rapid multiplication and rampant spreading.
groups.summary_zh: 指植物、细胞或生物不受控制地肆意蔓生、丛生或大量繁殖覆盖。
groups.desc_en: Denotes aggressive, uncontrolled, and crowding biological or figurative growth, differing from normal development by its suffocating, invasive, and destructive density.
groups.desc_zh: 表示侵略性、失控且呈压迫性拥挤的生物或引申增长，与正常生长不同，强调具窒息性、蔓延性和破坏性的过密繁殖。
groups.nuance_en: overgrow: cover, choke, or obscure through unkempt vegetation (path / garden / ruins) · run riot: grow or spread with anarchic, luxuriant abandon (weeds / imagination / flowers) · choke: strangle life or block passage through thick encroaching growth (weeds / traffic / growth) · infest: swarm destructively in large, unwelcome parasite colonies (pests / rodents / waters) · proliferate: rapidly multiply and reproduce in staggering numbers (cells / weapons / theories)
groups.nuance_zh: overgrow: 荒草蔓生从而遮蔽或淹没 (path / garden / ruins) · run riot: 放任肆虐地疯狂丛生或狂欢 (weeds / imagination / flowers) · choke: 茂密杂草阻断通径或扼杀生机 (weeds / traffic / growth) · infest: 害虫大量滋生并在空间肆虐寄生 (pests / rodents / waters) · proliferate: 数量急剧激增与快速繁衍 (cells / weapons / theories)

groups.name: Overlap & Intersect · 交错与重叠 (Intersect, Coincide, Crisscross)
groups.tip: 空间或时间上的交叉重叠

items.def_zh: （使）部分重叠；（时间或职责上）交叉，交错
items.def_en: 1. To cover part of the same area of something. 2. To happen at the same time as something else, or share some of the same qualities or responsibilities.
items.ex_en: Their professional duties overlap significantly in managing customer relations and regional sales.
items.ex_zh: 他们在管理客户关系和区域销售方面的职责存在很大重叠。
items.ex2_en: The roofers overlapped the slate tiles carefully to prevent rain leaks.
items.ex2_zh: 屋顶工人仔细地将石板瓦重叠排列，以防止雨水渗漏。

items.def_en: To occur at the same time or occupy the exact same space or position
items.ex_en: The annual technology conference will coincide with the city's lively international film festival.
items.ex_zh: 一年一度的科技盛会将与这座城市热闹的国际电影节同期举行。

items.def_en: To divide or cut across something by passing through it, or to meet and cross at a point
items.ex_en: Two bustling railway corridors intersect at the central transportation terminal downtown.
items.ex_zh: 两条繁忙的铁路通道在市中心的中央交通枢纽处相互交汇。
items.ex2_en: The surveyor intersected the wide highway with a new gravel access road.
items.ex2_zh: 测绘员用一条新的碎石便道横穿了这条宽阔的公路。

items.def_en: To fit together closely or harmoniously, especially of plans, schedules, or ideas
items.ex_en: The proposed tax reforms dovetail neatly with the administration's broader economic growth strategy.
items.ex_zh: 拟议的税改方案与政府更广泛的经济增长战略严密契合。
items.ex2_en: The carpenter dovetailed the sturdy wooden boards to form a solid drawer.
items.ex2_zh: 木匠将坚固的木板以燕尾榫咬合，制成了一个结实的抽屉。

items.def_en: To move back and forth across an area or mark something with intersecting lines
items.ex_en: Multiple narrow footpaths crisscross the rugged alpine meadows below the snow-capped peak.
items.ex_zh: 多条狭窄的步道在白雪皑皑的山峰下崎岖的高山草甸间纵横交错。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical areas, temporal schedules, or conceptual domains covering part of the same space or occurring concurrently. They range from literal geometric intersections to partial alignment in responsibilities or timelines.
groups.summary_zh: 指空间交叉、时间部分重叠或职责范围相重合。
groups.desc_en: Frames the partial sharing of territory, time, ideas, or physical lines, distinguishing from total merger by preserving distinct, crisscrossing, or intersecting identities.
groups.desc_zh: 指在地域、时间、观念或几何线条上出现部分重叠与相交，与完全融合不同，保留了各自独立、交错互涉的界线。
groups.nuance_en: overlap: partially cover the same physical area, domain, or timeframe (responsibilities / jurisdiction / borders) · intersect: cross over at a discrete junction or thematic tangent (roads / interests / paths) · coincide: occur at the exact same calendar point or align in opinion (dates / views / interests) · crisscross: transverse an area in multiple intersecting, web-like directions (country / sky / tracks) · dovetail: fit together cleanly and harmoniously like interlocking joints (plans / schedules / findings)

groups.name: Overlook & Condone · 宽容与默许姑息 (Condone, Overlook, Wink at)
groups.tip: 默许包容错误予以原谅

items.def_en: To choose deliberately to ignore a fault, offense, or error
items.ex_en: The forgiving manager chose to overlook his junior colleague's minor clerical mistake.
items.ex_zh: 宽容的经理选择对这位初级同事微小的文书错误不予追究。

items.def_zh: 包容，宽恕；纵容，容忍（不良行为）
items.def_en: To accept, forgive, or overlook behavior that is considered morally wrong, unlawful, or offensive.
items.ex_en: Responsible university officials can never condone academic dishonesty in any undergraduate program.
items.ex_zh: 负责任的大学校方绝不会纵容任何本科项目中的学术不端行为。

items.def_en: To pretend not to see something improper and deliberately allow it to continue
items.ex_en: Corrupt frontier officers chose to wink at the lucrative smuggling along the border.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的边境官员选择对沿边境利润丰厚的走私勾当闭眼纵容。

items.def_en: To secretly encourage or tacitly permit an illegal or unethical act
items.ex_en: Senior executives deliberately connived at fraudulent accounting practices to inflate year-end profits.
items.ex_zh: 高管们蓄意纵容造假账的行为，以此虚增年终利润。

items.def_zh: 容忍；允许（常用于否定句）
items.def_en: To tolerate or allow dissent or bad behavior (usually with negation)
items.ex_en: The strict schoolmaster would brook no interference with his established classroom rules.
items.ex_zh: 这位严厉的教长绝不容许任何人干涉他立下的课堂规矩。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on tolerating, sanctioning, or turning a blind eye to morally or legally reprehensible actions, treating them as acceptable.
groups.summary_zh: 强调对不正当或过错行为采取宽容、姑息、默许或视而不见态度。
groups.desc_en: Involves consciously ignoring or granting tacit permission to a transgression or flaw, contrasting with active forgiveness by displaying passive complicity or administrative disregard.
groups.desc_zh: 指明知存在违规、过错或缺陷却视而不见或默许姑息，与主动宽恕不同，体现出消极放任、私下纵容或行政包容的特质。
groups.nuance_en: overlook: disregard an error or misdeed either charitably or negligently (faults / mistake / transgression) · condone: treat objectionable conduct as acceptable or negligible (violence / behavior / cheating) · wink at: knowingly pretend not to see an illicit act out of collusion (corruption / bribery / violations) · connive at: covertly conspire in or tacitly encourage a wrongful scheme (theft / escape / abuses) · brook: tolerate dissent, delay, or insult without stern retaliation (delay / opposition / interference)
groups.nuance_zh: overlook: 宽宏大度或疏忽地放过、忽略过错 (faults / mistake / transgression) · condone: 对本应制止的劣行纵容认可 (violence / behavior / cheating) · wink at: 明知故犯地眨眼装瞎、默许违规 (corruption / bribery / violations) · connive at: 暗中纵容、串通包庇罪行 (theft / escape / abuses) · brook: 容忍异见或拖延（多用于否定） (delay / opposition / interference)

groups.name: Overprice & Gouge · 标价过高与乱收费 (Overprice, Gouge, Overcharge)
groups.tip: 评估资产价值并制定价格

items.def_en: To increase the retail price of something above its wholesale or previous cost
items.ex_en: Supermarkets typically mark up holiday merchandise right before the major festive shopping rush.
items.ex_zh: 超市通常会在节日购物高峰来临之前将应节商品提价标售。

items.def_zh: 宰客；收取极其昂贵的价格
items.def_en: To cheat someone by making them pay far more than something is worth
items.ex_en: Unsuspecting tourists are often ripped off by unlicensed taxi operators.
items.ex_zh: 毫无防备的游客经常被无照出租车司机敲竹杠。

items.def_en: To force people to pay unfairly high prices, especially in emergency situations
items.ex_en: Unscrupulous motel owners tried to gouge stranded motorists during the severe winter blizzard.
items.ex_zh: 无良汽车旅馆老板在严重的冬季暴风雪期间企图狠敲滞留车主的竹杠。

items.def_zh: 给……定价过高，对……估价过高
items.def_en: To set the price of goods or services higher than their real value.
items.ex_en: Dealerships often overprice imported sports cars because of artificial market scarcity and hype.
items.ex_zh: 由于人为造成的市场稀缺和炒作，经销商往往给进口跑车定价过高。

items.def_en: To demand too much money from someone for goods or services
items.ex_en: The unscrupulous cab driver attempted to overcharge the foreign tourists for a short ride.
items.ex_zh: 那名无良出租车司机试图对这段短途行程向外国游客漫天要价。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate setting or exacting monetary demands far above an item's reasonable market value, often exploiting scarcity, necessity, or ignorance.
groups.summary_zh: 指定价虚高或索取不合理的高额费用。
groups.desc_en: Describes demanding exorbitant, predatory, or unauthorized sums for goods or services, contrasting with legitimate commerce through abusive pricing power or exploitation of consumer distress.
groups.desc_zh: 描述对商品或服务索要敲诈性、不合理的高价，与正当商业定价不同，强调滥用定价权或乘人之危的盘剥掠夺。
