groups.nuance_en: overcharge: bill an amount exceeding the correct, stated, or fair rate (customer / account / fee) · gouge: exploit an emergency or monopoly to extract extortionate prices (consumers / victims / market) · overprice: assign a retail price higher than intrinsic market value warrants (goods / real estate / stock) · rip off: deliberately defraud or cheat someone out of money in bad faith (tourists / buyer / consumer) · mark up: elevate wholesale cost to a higher retail price level (price / cost / inventory)
groups.nuance_zh: overcharge: 索价高于原定公道价格或多收钱 (customer / account / fee) · gouge: 借灾难或垄断哄抬物价勒索暴利 (consumers / victims / market) · overprice: 虚高定价使之远超实际价值 (goods / real estate / stock) · rip off: 敲竹杠、狠宰或赤裸裸欺诈收费 (tourists / buyer / consumer) · mark up: 在进价成本基础上加价提高零售额 (price / cost / inventory)

groups.name: Overshadow & Eclipse · 遮蔽与夺彩 (Eclipse, Outshine, Dwarf)
groups.tip: 投下阴影遮盖光华色彩

items.def_en: Spoil a good situation or diminish happiness by introducing worry or gloom
items.ex_en: The unexpected resignation began to cast a shadow over the company's anniversary celebration.
items.ex_zh: 这次突如其来的辞职让公司的周年庆典蒙上了一层阴影。

items.def_zh: 使相形见绌；使显得矮小
items.def_en: Cause something to appear small, inferior, or unimportant in comparison
items.ex_en: The monumental glass skyscraper seems to dwarf the modest historical houses beside it.
items.ex_zh: 这座巨大的玻璃摩天大楼让旁边朴素的历史民居显得格外矮小。

items.def_zh: 使失色，使相形见绌；遮蔽，给…蒙上阴影
items.def_en: 1. To make someone or something seem less important, happy, or successful by comparison. 2. To cast a shadow over.
items.ex_en: Her younger sister's artistic achievements often threaten to overshadow her own quiet successes.
items.ex_zh: 妹妹在艺术上的成就往往会让自己的默默成功显得相形见绌。

items.def_en: Block the light of a celestial body, or make another achievement look insignificant by being superior
items.ex_en: The young prodigy's record-breaking victory will surely eclipse all past tournament records.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻神童破纪录的胜利必将让锦标赛以往的所有纪录黯然失色。

items.def_en: Be much brighter, more impressive, or more successful than someone else
items.ex_en: Her sensational violin solo managed to outshine all other performances throughout the evening.
items.ex_zh: 她那令人赞叹的小提琴独奏盖过了当晚所有其他演出的光芒。

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote dominating perceptual or conceptual attention such that another entity is thrown into darkness, obscurity, or insignificance by comparison. 'Overshadow' emphasizes looming gloom or diminished joy, while 'eclipse' emphasizes total preeminence.
groups.summary_zh: 指投下阴影、遮蔽光彩，使他者相形见绌或黯然失色。
groups.desc_en: Captures how an entity dims, reduces in stature, or steals public glory from another through superior magnitude, brilliance, or misfortune, contrasting with direct competition by passive eclipse.
groups.desc_zh: 刻画一事物因体量、光芒或厄运而遮蔽、缩小另一事物并抢夺其风头，与正面较量不同，强调压倒性的气场掩盖或光彩掩映。
groups.nuance_en: overshadow: cast a figurative gloom over an occasion or make another seem secondary (achievement / party / career) · eclipse: completely surpass and obscure another's fame or success (record / predecessor / rivals) · outshine: surpass another distinctly in brilliance, talent, or appearance (peers / competition / star) · dwarf: cause something to appear tiny and insignificant by sheer physical or statistical size (buildings / rivals / numbers) · cast a shadow over: inject doubt, sadness, or a foreboding pall onto an event (proceedings / future / relationship)
groups.nuance_zh: overshadow: 投下阴影使失色或令其屈居次席 (achievement / party / career) · eclipse: 光芒彻底吞没前人成就或记录 (record / predecessor / rivals) · outshine: 在才华或光彩上出类拔萃盖过他人 (peers / competition / star) · dwarf: 凭借巨大体量使对比物显得渺小微不足道 (buildings / rivals / numbers) · cast a shadow over: 带来阴霾或令前景笼罩不安 (proceedings / future / relationship)

groups.name: Oversimplify & Trivialize · 简化与浮泛化 (Dumb Down, Boil Down, Gloss Over)
groups.tip: 把复杂问题过度简化以便于理解

items.def_en: To condense extensive information into a bare, essential statement
items.ex_en: We can boil down this hundred-page policy document to three straightforward operational principles.
items.ex_zh: 我们可以把这份百页政策文件归结为三条简单明了的执行原则。
items.ex2_en: The complex international crisis boils down to a dispute over fresh water.
items.ex2_zh: 这场复杂的国际危机归根结底是对淡水资源的争夺。

items.def_zh: 把……过分简化，使过于简单化
items.def_en: To describe or explain a complex situation or problem in a way that is too simple, leaving out important facts or details.
items.ex_en: Political pundits often oversimplify deeply rooted socioeconomic problems during brief television debates.
items.ex_zh: 政治评论员在简短的电视辩论中往往将根深蒂固的社会经济问题过分简化。

items.def_en: To treat a complex difficulty or flaw cursorily to avoid dealing with uncomfortable complexities
items.ex_en: The spokesperson attempted to gloss over safety violations uncovered in the internal audit.
items.ex_zh: 发言人试图轻描淡写地敷衍带过内部审计中发现的安全违规问题。

items.def_zh: 降低难度以迎合，通俗化（贬义）
items.def_en: To deliberately make something less intellectually demanding in order to cater to a popular audience
items.ex_en: Producers decided to dumb down the documentary script to attract broader prime-time audiences.
items.ex_zh: 制作方决定降低这部纪录片解说词的理解门槛，以迎合更广泛的黄金档受众。
items.ex2_en: The academic curriculum dumbed down noticeably over the last two decades.
items.ex2_zh: 在过去的二十年里，学术课程明显变得浅显易懂了。

items.def_en: To make something seem unimportant, superficial, or less serious than it genuinely is
items.ex_en: We should not trivialize genuine mental health struggles by calling them simple mood swings.
items.ex_zh: 我们不应把真正的心理健康困扰轻描淡写为普通的情绪波动。

groups.summary_en: This manner frame describes reducing nuanced or technical concepts to an excessively rudimentary form. It often carries critical overtones of omitting vital subtleties, distorting truth, or patronizing the audience.
groups.summary_zh: 过分简化、删减关键细节，使复杂事物失去深度或失真。
groups.desc_en: Depicts stripping down complex ideas, narratives, or realities until nuance is lost or their gravity is degraded, differing from lucid summarizing by intellectual degradation.
groups.desc_zh: 指对复杂思想、叙事或现实进行过度精简以致丧失细微精义，与清晰概括不同，带有肤浅化、贬低降格的知识退化色彩。
groups.nuance_en: oversimplify: omit vital complexities, presenting a distorted, unnuanced caricature (issue / history / debate) · dumb down: degrade intellectual or cultural rigor to suit the lowest common denominator (content / curriculum / news) · boil down: distill an expansive argument to its crude, bare-bones essence (matter / argument / thesis) · trivialize: minimize the serious moral or emotional weight of a reality (tragedy / suffering / achievements) · gloss over: treat flaws or complexities superficially to minimize scrutiny (faults / problems / details)
groups.nuance_zh: oversimplify: 省略关键细微差别导致把问题简单化 (issue / history / debate) · dumb down: 降低智力或文化门槛以迎合低端受众 (content / curriculum / news) · boil down: 浓缩提炼为最粗线条的底线核心 (matter / argument / thesis) · trivialize: 轻浮视之，贬低其严肃重要性 (tragedy / suffering / achievements) · gloss over: 轻描淡写遮掩缺陷或粉饰太平 (faults / problems / details)

groups.name: Overstock & Hoard · 囤积与过量储备 (Hoard, Stockpile, Accumulate)
groups.tip: 积聚储备物品以备不时之需

items.def_en: (+ on) To buy or obtain a large supply of goods for future use
items.ex_en: Before the blizzard hit, locals rushed to the supermarket to stock up on groceries.
items.ex_zh: 暴风雪来临前，当地人涌进超市大量采购日常用品。

items.def_en: To gradually gather an increasing amount or quantity of items over time
items.ex_en: Over decades of research, the institute accumulated an unprecedented amount of meteorological data.
items.ex_zh: 经过数十年的研究，该研究所积累了规模空前的气象数据。
items.ex2_en: Thick layers of fine dust accumulated rapidly inside the abandoned house.
items.ex2_zh: 废弃房屋内迅速积聚起厚厚的一层细灰尘。

items.def_en: To accumulate a large supply of goods, weapons, or food for future emergencies
items.ex_en: The national government began to stockpile antiviral medications in anticipation of another outbreak.
items.ex_zh: 该国政府开始大量储备抗病毒药物，以防疫情再次爆发。

items.def_en: To collect and store large quantities of food, goods, or money, often secretly or greedily
items.ex_en: Panicked consumers began to hoard bags of flour and sugar during the shortage.
items.ex_zh: 物资匮乏期间，恐慌的消费者开始大量囤积面粉和食糖。

items.def_en: To buy or stock more goods than are needed or can be sold.
items.ex_en: Retailers often overstock winter apparel, leading to steep discounts when spring arrives.
items.ex_zh: 零售商往往会过量进购冬装，导致春季来临时不得不大幅打折。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on accumulating excessive quantities of goods, supplies, or raw materials far beyond immediate needs, often creating surpluses or artificial scarcity.
groups.summary_zh: 指囤积、超额备货或过量采购物资，导致存量过剩。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to accumulating large reserves of goods or supplies, contrasting with standard purchasing by excessive volume, defensive motivation, or speculative withholding.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及大量积累物资储备，与常规采购不同，其特征在于数量过剩、防御性防备或惜售囤积的投机心理。
groups.nuance_en: hoard: greedily or secretively store supplies driven by fear of scarcity (cash / food / gold) · stockpile: systematically accumulate critical reserves for planned emergency deployment (weapons / vaccines / grain) · overstock: procure inventory far beyond actual consumer demand (inventory / shelves / warehouse) · stock up: purchase standard goods in advance for anticipated domestic or commercial need (groceries / supplies / essentials) · accumulate: progressively amass volume over an extended duration (wealth / dust / evidence)
groups.nuance_zh: hoard: 出于恐慌或贪婪而隐秘、过度地囤积 (cash / food / gold) · stockpile: 为应对战略紧急情况有计划地大举储备 (weapons / vaccines / grain) · overstock: 进货超量导致仓库积压存货 (inventory / shelves / warehouse) · stock up: 为备不时之需在常规水平上备足货 (groceries / supplies / essentials) · accumulate: 随着时间推移自然或渐进地积攒累积 (wealth / dust / evidence)

groups.name: Overturn & Upend · 倾覆与彻底颠倒 (Overturn, Upend, Capsize, Invert)
groups.tip: 车船底朝天彻底翻转

items.def_en: 1. To turn upside down or fall over onto one side, or cause something to do so. 2. To officially reverse, invalidate, or abolish a legal decision, law, or result.
items.ex_en: The appellate court decided to overturn the lower court's ruling due to flawed evidence.
items.ex_zh: 上诉法院因证据存在瑕疵，决定推翻下级法院的判决。
items.ex2_en: The heavy delivery truck overturned suddenly on the icy highway curve.
items.ex2_zh: 那辆重型送货卡车在结冰的公路拐弯处突然翻倒了。

items.def_en: To turn something upside down or reverse its customary order, position, or condition
items.ex_en: The new economic policy threatens to invert the traditional relationship between labor and capital.
items.ex_zh: 这项新经济政策有可能彻底颠倒劳动力与资本之间的传统关系。

items.def_zh: 翻转过来，里外翻个底朝天
items.def_en: To fold or turn something so that the inner surface faces outward
items.ex_en: Please turn your sweaters inside out before putting them into the washing machine.
items.ex_zh: 把毛衣放进洗衣机之前，请先把它们里外翻过来。

items.def_en: To set, turn, or flip something completely on its end or upside down
items.ex_en: A rogue wave managed to upend the small fishing vessel within seconds.
items.ex_zh: 一道突如其来的巨浪在数秒之内便掀翻了那艘小型渔船。

items.def_en: (especially of a boat or vessel) To overturn completely in the water
items.ex_en: Gusty winds caused the overloaded sailboat to capsize just off the rocky coast.
items.ex_zh: 阵阵狂风导致那艘超载的帆船在岩石海岸附近彻底翻沉。
items.ex2_en: A rogue ocean wave quickly capsized the small fishing vessel yesterday.
items.ex2_zh: 昨天，一个异常巨浪迅速掀翻了那艘小型渔船。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail completely flipping an object upside-down or on its side by force, encompassing maritime capsizing, violent upsets, and complete inversion.
groups.summary_zh: 外力迫使物体底朝天完全颠倒、倾覆翻转。
groups.desc_en: Denotes completely inverting, upsetting, or overturning the physical equilibrium, orientation, or institutional status quo, contrasting with gradual reform by revolutionary topsy-turvy disruption.
groups.desc_zh: 表示将物理平衡、朝向方位或体制现状彻底倾覆与颠倒，与渐进改良不同，强调底朝天式的颠覆性与失衡。
groups.nuance_en: overturn: knock upside-down physically or legally reverse a long-standing ruling (verdict / decision / boat) · upend: abruptly turn completely on its end, throwing established order into chaos (market / assumptions / life) · capsize: turn bottom-side up in water, resulting in catastrophic loss of stability (boat / canoe / vessel) · invert: reverse the normal spatial position, order, or ideological logic (order / hierarchy / pyramid) · turn inside out: radically rearrange or invert every hidden component of an entity (house / pockets / industry)
groups.nuance_zh: overturn: 物理翻倒或从司法裁决上推翻撤销 (verdict / decision / boat) · upend: 竖直倒立颠倒，打乱既有格局秩序 (market / assumptions / life) · capsize: 舟船在水中倾覆倾倒 (boat / canoe / vessel) · invert: 将正常空间位置、顺序或逻辑上下反转 (order / hierarchy / pyramid) · turn inside out: 翻个底朝天，进行彻底翻箱倒柜的重构 (house / pockets / industry)

groups.name: Overwhelm & Discourage · 威慑退缩与令人气馁 (Daunt, Cow, Dismay)
groups.tip: 施加强势威胁令人望而却步

items.def_en: Cause someone distress, apprehension, and loss of morale in the face of daunting adversity
items.ex_en: The steep drop in poll numbers did not dismay the resolute campaign team.
items.ex_zh: 民调支持率的暴跌并未使坚定的竞选团队感到气馁。

items.def_en: Deprive someone of courage, composure, confidence, or psychological resolve
items.ex_en: The prolonged silence from the audience began to unnerve the nervous young speaker.
items.ex_zh: 台下观众持久的沉默让这位紧张的年轻演讲者心慌意乱。

items.def_en: Subdue or repress someone's spirits through sustained threats or shows of power
items.ex_en: The tyrant could not cow the rebellious citizens through displays of military might.
items.ex_zh: 暴君无法用武力炫耀来吓倒那些反叛的民众。

items.def_en: Frighten someone deliberately into submitting or doing what one wants
items.ex_en: The defense attorney tried to intimidate the key witness with aggressive cross-examination.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师试图通过具有攻击性的交叉盘问来威慑核心证人。

items.def_en: (often passive) To make someone feel intimidated, overwhelmed, or discouraged by a difficult task.
items.ex_en: The sheer scale of the historical restoration project did not daunt the architects.
items.ex_zh: 这项历史修复工程的庞大规模并未让建筑师们望而生畏。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame signify disarming someone's courage, resolve, or hope by presenting an intimidating presence or an overwhelmingly arduous obstacle.
groups.summary_zh: 以压倒性声势或艰巨挑战挫败他人勇气，使其畏葸不前。
groups.desc_en: Represents crippling another's morale, courage, or resolve through menacing scale or psychological dominance, contrasting with physical injury by purely cognitive paralysis.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过压倒性的声势或心理威压击垮他人的士气、勇气与决断，与物理伤害不同，侧重纯粹认知层面的胆怯与退缩。
groups.nuance_en: daunt: deter or intimidate someone by the sheer scale or difficulty of a task (task / prospect / challenge) · cow: browbeat someone into docile, submissive compliance through terror (critics / population / opposition) · intimidate: coerce or frighten an adversary by exploiting threats or superior power (witness / rivals / voters) · unnerve: shake someone's confidence and composure from within (player / witness / team) · dismay: paralyze initiative through sudden, sharp disappointment and dread (allies / parents / onlookers)
groups.nuance_zh: daunt: 因任务的艰难庞大而使人气馁畏难 (task / prospect / challenge) · cow: 施加高压恐吓使人俯首帖耳不敢作声 (critics / population / opposition) · intimidate: 仗势凌人以威逼胁迫对手 (witness / rivals / voters) · unnerve: 动摇定力，令人心慌意乱失常 (player / witness / team) · dismay: 突遭沉重打击令人沮丧惶惑 (allies / parents / onlookers)

groups.name: Overwhelm & Inundate · 淹没与压倒 (Swamp, Inundate, Overload)
groups.tip: 漫灌淹没压垮正常运转

items.def_zh: 使工作过多而无法招架
items.def_en: (often passive) To overwhelm someone with a massive amount of work, correspondence, or responsibilities
items.ex_en: I am completely snowed under with administrative paperwork ahead of the year-end audit.
items.ex_zh: 在年终审计之前，我被繁重的行政文书工作压得喘不过气来。

items.def_en: To overpower someone or something with superior numbers, force, or an excess of concurrent demands
items.ex_en: Enemy forces attempted to overwhelm the border outpost with sheer numerical superiority.
items.ex_zh: 敌军企图凭借绝对的人数优势彻底压垮边境前哨站。

items.def_zh: 使应接不暇，压垮；淹没，浸没
items.def_en: 1. (often passive, 'be swamped with/by') To overwhelm someone or something with a vast quantity of things or work. 2. To fill or sink a boat, or flood land, with a large volume of water.
items.ex_en: Customer support agents were swamped with refund requests following the software glitch.
items.ex_zh: 软件出现故障后，客服人员被海量的退款申请弄得应接不暇。

items.def_en: To overwhelm someone with a huge influx of things to deal with, or to cover an area completely with water
items.ex_en: Heavy monsoon rains quickly inundated the low-lying agricultural valleys across the province.
items.ex_zh: 持续的季风暴雨迅速淹没了全省地势低洼的农耕山谷。

items.def_en: To sweep over and swallow something completely, rendering it unseen or incapacitated
items.ex_en: Towering ocean swells threatened to engulf the fragile lighthouse during the fierce tempest.
items.ex_zh: 在狂暴的风暴中，汹涌的巨浪眼看就要吞没那座脆弱的灯塔。

groups.summary_en: This frame involves incapacitating someone or something by subjecting them to a deluge or vast excess of demands, tasks, physical water, or stimuli.
groups.summary_zh: 因数量或负荷过大而彻底压垮、淹没目标。
groups.desc_en: Employs hydrologic metaphors of flooding and deep immersion to depict an entity collapsing beneath overwhelming volume, tasks, or forces, contrasting with moderate burden by utter engulfment.
groups.desc_zh: 借用水流淹没与洪水漫灌的隐喻，描写个体在海量事务、信息或冲击下无力招架，与普通负担不同，强调灭顶式的吞噬感。
groups.nuance_en: inundate: flood metaphorically or literally under a crushing deluge of demands (market / office / calls) · overwhelm: crush beneath an irresistible emotional or physical supremacy (senses / forces / grief) · swamp: fill to sinking capacity with more volume than can be processed (system / court / clinic) · snow under: bury beneath an avalanche of administrative paperwork or commitments (desk / staff / paperwork) · engulf: swallow entirely inside a massive flame, wave, or systemic crisis (building / flames / region)
groups.nuance_zh: inundate: 洪水漫灌般涌入过量请求致使其无法招架 (market / office / calls) · overwhelm: 压倒性的物理或情感力量让人彻底瘫痪 (senses / forces / grief) · swamp: 像船进水一样被过载工作压得陷于瘫痪 (system / court / clinic) · snow under: 被雪崩般的文件堆积压埋得喘不过气 (desk / staff / paperwork) · engulf: 烈焰、巨浪或危机彻底吞噬包围 (building / flames / region)

groups.name: Overwhelm & Overpower · 压倒与击溃 (Engulf, Overcome, Overpower)
groups.tip: 情感或力量过于庞大，彻底将人冲垮

items.def_en: (usually passive) To affect someone so strongly with an emotion, fume, or fatigue that they cannot act normally
items.ex_en: Two firemen were overcome by dense smoke while inspecting the burning warehouse.
items.ex_zh: 两名消防员在排查着火仓库时因吸入浓烟而支撑不住。

items.def_zh: 击溃，压倒；（强烈情感）使难以承受，使不知所措；淹没
items.def_en: 1. To defeat someone or something completely by using vastly superior force. 2. To affect someone so strongly with an emotion that they cannot think clearly or cope. 3. To completely submerge or cover with water.
items.ex_en: A wave of profound grief overwhelmed the family when the tragic news arrived.
items.ex_zh: 悲痛的噩耗传来时，一股巨大的悲伤瞬间将全家人淹没。

items.def_en: To overwhelm someone with a huge, unmanageable volume of things to deal with
items.ex_en: Floodwaters breached the retaining wall and began to swamp the lower parking garage.
items.ex_zh: 洪水冲垮了挡土墙，开始灌入并淹没下层的地下车库。

items.def_en: To defeat, subdue, or gain control over someone through clearly superior strength or emotional force
items.ex_en: Security guards rushed forward to overpower the violent intruder before anyone was injured.
items.ex_zh: 安保人员迅速上前制伏了暴力闯入者，所幸无人受伤。

items.def_en: To sweep over and swallow up someone completely, both physically and emotionally
items.ex_en: A deep sense of existential dread seemed to engulf his entire waking existence.
items.ex_zh: 一种深重的存在主义恐惧感似乎彻底吞噬了他清醒时的整个世界。

groups.summary_en: This frame denotes subjecting a person, mind, or force to an irresistible surge of emotion, sensory input, or physical might that utterly subdues them.
groups.summary_zh: 指强烈情感、感官刺激或绝对力量让人无力招架。
groups.desc_en: Denotes an external force, emotion, or volume surging past an entity's coping threshold, differing from simple 'defeat' by emphasizing total sensory, spatial, or emotional submergence.
groups.desc_zh: 指外在力量、情绪或负荷超越个体的承载极限，与单纯的“击败”不同，它强调在感官、空间或情感上被全方位淹没与吞没。
groups.nuance_en: overwhelm: to submerge through excessive emotional or operational volume (emotions / senses / capacity) · overpower: to subdue by superior physical or coercive strength (attacker / defenses / odor) · overcome: to render helpless or insensible through emotion or gas (grief / fumes / exhaustion) · swamp: to inundate with an unmanageable flood of items (inbox / hotline / boat) · engulf: to completely swallow up in a surrounding medium (flames / darkness / waves)
groups.nuance_zh: overwhelm: 情绪或任务过载造成的淹没瘫痪 (emotions / senses / capacity) · overpower: 凭借绝对压倒性力量制服或熏倒 (attacker / defenses / odor) · overcome: 因悲痛或烟气等失去抵抗能力 (grief / fumes / exhaustion) · swamp: 数量如潮水般涌来使其无力招架 (inbox / hotline / boat) · engulf: 被周围介质完全吞噬湮没 (flames / darkness / waves)

groups.name: Overwinter & Winter · 度冬与避寒 (Overwinter, Hibernate, Estivate)
groups.tip: 熬过寒冬与季节性休眠

items.def_zh: 过冬，越冬；使（动植物等）过冬
items.def_en: 1. To spend the winter in a particular place. 2. To keep, feed, or protect animals or plants during the winter.
items.ex_en: Thousands of migratory sandpipers winter along the mild shores of the southern peninsula.
items.ex_zh: 成千上万只迁徙的鹬鸟在南部半岛温暖的海岸边度过寒冬。

items.def_en: (+ up) To retreat into a secluded lair or shelter to rest or survive cold weather conditions
items.ex_en: As late autumn frost gathered, the black bear denned up beneath the roots.
items.ex_zh: 随着深秋严霜降临，黑熊躲进盘根错节的树穴深处隐蔽过冬。

items.def_en: To stay in a secure or warm interior space without emerging, especially to escape severe weather
items.ex_en: We decided to hole up in a cozy mountain cabin during the snowstorm.
items.ex_zh: 暴风雪期间，我们决定躲进一间舒适的山间木屋闭门不出。

items.def_en: To pass the winter in a state of suspended animation or deep prolonged metabolic dormancy
items.ex_en: Woodchucks hibernate deeply during freezing winter months, reducing their metabolic rates dramatically.
items.ex_zh: 旱獭在严寒冬日里进入深度冬眠，其新陈代谢率会大幅下降。

items.def_en: To spend the winter season in a particular place, or keep organisms protected throughout winter
items.ex_en: Flocks of vibrant kingfishers overwinter along the unfrozen streams of the sheltered valley.
items.ex_zh: 成群羽色艳丽的翠鸟在避风山谷中未结冰的溪流旁越冬。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this biological and lifestyle frame describe passing the cold winter season in a specific sheltered location, enduring climatic hardship, or entering a dormant physiological state.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及人、动物或植物在特定环境中度过严冬、避寒或进入冬眠状态。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on surviving or spending the harsh cold season through metabolic dormancy, sheltering, or seasonal relocation, contrasting with generic 'dwelling' or 'resting'.
groups.desc_zh: 强调通过代谢休眠、躲避隐匿或季节性迁移来度过严冬，与普通的“居住”或“休息”不同，具有明确的抗寒与保命场景性。
groups.nuance_en: overwinter: to survive through the winter months in a specific site (birds / crops / pests) · winter: to intentionally dwell or graze during cold months (cattle / snowbirds / resort) · hibernate: to pass the winter in deep metabolic dormancy (bears / bats / groundhogs) · den: to withdraw into a secluded lair for shelter (wolves / bears / cubs) · hole up: to stay concealed or sheltered from adverse conditions (fugitives / storm / travelers)
groups.nuance_zh: overwinter: 动植物越冬存活 (birds / crops / pests) · winter: 人或牲口在某地过冬避寒 (cattle / snowbirds / resort) · hibernate: 代谢大幅降低的生理冬眠 (bears / bats / groundhogs) · den: 兽类退入兽穴栖息或产仔 (wolves / bears / cubs) · hole up: 躲进隐蔽处避风头或避暴风雪 (fugitives / storm / travelers)

groups.name: Overwork & Exhaust · 过度使用与耗尽 (Overuse, Exhaust, Wear Out)
groups.tip: 投入使用乃至过度磨损

items.def_en: to become damaged, useless, or exhausted through prolonged or excessive use
items.ex_en: Running after toddlers all afternoon completely wore me out.
items.ex_zh: 整个下午跟在幼儿屁股后面跑让我筋疲力尽。

items.def_en: to use something too much or too often so that it becomes less effective or damaged
items.ex_en: Doctors warned that if runners overuse their knee joints, severe chronic inflammation results.
items.ex_zh: 医生警告称，如果跑者过度使用膝关节，会导致严重的慢性炎症。

items.def_zh: 使负担过重，使劳累过度
items.def_en: to demand too much of someone's physical strength, endurance, or a system's capacity
items.ex_en: The demanding rehearsal schedule will overtax the stamina of the young ballet dancers.
items.ex_zh: 高强度的排练日程将使这些年轻芭蕾舞演员的体力承受过重负担。

items.def_en: to use or work something or someone so hard that it is ruined or completely exhausted
items.ex_en: If you keep working eighty hours weekly, you will run yourself into the ground.
items.ex_zh: 如果你继续每周工作八十个小时，迟早会把自己彻底累垮。

items.def_en: to use up completely so that nothing remains; to drain entirely of energy
items.ex_en: The prolonged drought threatened to exhaust the city's strategic reservoir within several weeks.
items.ex_zh: 长期的干旱眼看就要在数周之内耗尽该市的战略水库蓄水。

groups.summary_en: This frame highlights the harmful extreme of use, where tools, resources, body parts, or systems are strained past their limit, leading to degradation, fatigue, or depletion.
groups.summary_zh: 强调使用过频过猛导致耗损、疲劳或衰竭的极端状态。
groups.desc_en: Denotes depleting physical vitality, mental bandwidth, or mechanical utility through excessive or relentless exertion, contrasting with mere 'tiring' by implying lasting functional deficit.
groups.desc_zh: 指因无休止或超负荷使用而耗尽体力、精力或机械寿命，与一般的“疲倦”不同，强调功能性损伤或彻底枯竭。
groups.nuance_en: exhaust: to drain completely of reserves or fuel (supplies / patience / energy) · wear out: to gradually render useless or ragged through friction (shoes / patience / body) · overtax: to push beyond sustainable functional limits (heart / resources / budget) · overuse: to utilize excessively leading to strain or degradation (tendon / term / machinery) · run into the ground: to ruin or work to breakdown through ruthless exploitation (business / car / employee)
groups.nuance_zh: exhaust: 彻底耗尽储备或体力 (supplies / patience / energy) · wear out: 经久磨损至破旧或精疲力竭 (shoes / patience / body) · overtax: 施加超过承受上限的沉重负荷 (heart / resources / budget) · overuse: 过度使用引起劳损或贬值 (tendon / term / machinery) · run into the ground: 竭泽而渔地榨干直至彻底累垮瘫痪 (business / car / employee)

groups.name: Owe & Incur · 欠负与借债 (Incur, Run up, Fall behind)
groups.tip: 身负债务或欠下人情

items.def_zh: 欠（债、钱）；欠（人情、情谊）；归功于
items.def_en: 1. To have to pay someone money that you have borrowed or that is due. 2. To feel an obligation to give someone gratitude, respect, or an explanation.
items.ex_en: He still owes the university library several hundred dollars in overdue borrowing fees.
items.ex_zh: 他目前仍欠大学图书馆数百美元逾期未还的借阅罚金。

items.def_zh: 积欠，迅速累积（账单、债务）
items.def_en: To allow debts or bills to increase rapidly without paying them off
items.ex_en: The reckless tourist managed to run up enormous room service bills within days.
items.ex_zh: 这个挥霍无度的游客在短短几天内就积欠了高额的客房服务费。

items.def_en: To record an unpaid amount on a tab or register an ongoing debt
items.ex_en: The friendly bartender agreed to chalk up the drinks on my personal tab.
items.ex_zh: 那位热心的调酒师同意把我喝的酒水先记在私人账单上。

items.def_en: To fail to make regular payments on time, dropping into arrears
items.ex_en: Many struggling tenants fall behind on monthly rent payments when economic conditions deteriorate.
items.ex_zh: 当经济状况恶化时，许多举步维艰的租客便会拖欠每月租金。

items.def_zh: 招致，招惹（债务、费用或惩罚）
items.def_en: To bring a debt, expense, or undesirable consequence upon oneself
items.ex_en: The corporation may incur substantial regulatory fines if it violates environmental compliance guidelines.
items.ex_zh: 该企业若违反环保合规准则，可能会招致高额的监管罚款。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on financial and moral indebtedness, capturing the accumulation or burden of unpaid sums and contractual dues.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖产生债务、拖欠款项及累积债务的财务情景。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to entering a state of financial, legal, or moral indebtedness through accumulated actions or missed commitments, contrasting with simple 'spending' or 'losing'.
groups.desc_zh: 指因累积行为或逾期未还而在财务、法律或道义上陷入负债状态，与单纯的“花钱”或“损失”相对，强调债务契约的产生。
groups.nuance_en: owe: to be under an established obligation to repay (money / apology / gratitude) · incur: to bring upon oneself an unwanted cost or liability (debts / penalties / wrath) · run up: to rapidly accumulate an escalating bill through spending (tab / bill / deficit) · chalk up: to register or record an accrued liability or score (losses / points / debt) · fall behind: to fail to maintain scheduled payments (rent / mortgage / installments)
groups.nuance_zh: owe: 负有法律或道义上的偿还义务 (money / apology / gratitude) · incur: 因自身行为而招致不利开销或责任 (debts / penalties / wrath) · run up: 短期内快速刷爆或累积高额账单 (tab / bill / deficit) · chalk up: 记录或累积下债务、得分或损失 (losses / points / debt) · fall behind: 进度落后或拖欠到期款项 (rent / mortgage / installments)

groups.name: Pace & Stride · 踱步与大步走 (Stride, Stroll, Prowl)
groups.tip: 踱步测量或阔步昂首前行

items.def_zh: 踱步，缓慢走动；用步丈量；给……定步速
items.def_en: 1. To walk with slow or regular steps, often back and forth in anxiety or thought. 2. To measure a distance by walking over it and counting steps. 3. To set the speed for oneself or others in a race or activity.
items.ex_en: The worried surgeon began to pace the corridor outside the intensive care unit.
items.ex_zh: 焦虑的外科医生开始在重症监护室外的走廊上来回踱步。

items.def_en: To increase one's walking pace or stride out briskly and purposefully
items.ex_en: Seeing the dark clouds gathering overhead, the hikers began to step out briskly.
items.ex_zh: 看到头顶乌云密布，徒步者们开始加快脚步大步流星地前进。

items.def_en: To walk with long, energetic, and confident steps in a determined direction
items.ex_en: The lead diplomat strode into the assembly hall with an air of absolute authority.
items.ex_zh: 这位首席外交官气宇轩昂、大步流星地走进了大会议事大厅。

items.def_en: To walk heavily, steadily, and tirelessly over long distances
items.ex_en: Tired soldiers had to tramp through freezing mud for hours before reaching safety.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的士兵们只得在冰冷的泥泞中沉重跋涉数小时才到达安全区。

items.def_en: To move stealthily or restlessly around an area, like a hunter seeking prey
items.ex_en: Hungry coyotes prowl the outer perimeter of the suburban farm after nightfall.
items.ex_zh: 夜幕降临之后，饥肠辘辘的郊狼在郊区农场的外围暗中潜行游荡。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe rhythmic, purposeful, or emotionally charged walking patterns. 'Pacing' evokes repetitive, anxious steps, while related verbs highlight either expansive, confident strides or predatory, restless roaming.
groups.summary_zh: 指带有特定节奏、情绪或仪态的步行方式（如焦虑踱步、大步迈行）。
groups.desc_en: Involves walking with marked tempo, deliberate stride length, or spatial restlessness, distinguishing itself from casual 'walking' by projecting specific emotional or bodily tension.
groups.desc_zh: 指带有特定步幅、节奏或焦躁意图的行进方式，与漫无目的的“散步”不同，折射出内在的心绪波动或警戒姿态。
groups.nuance_en: pace: to walk back and forth repetitively due to anxiety or contemplation (floor / room / corridor) · stride: to walk vigorously with purposeful, long steps (stage / podium / room) · prowl: to move stealthily and restlessly like a hunter (streets / alleyways / perimeter) · tramp: to walk heavily or plod resolutely over distances (woods / road / mud) · step out: to walk boldly or briskly with confidence (doors / rhythm / style)
groups.nuance_zh: pace: 因焦虑或沉思在有限空间来回踱步 (floor / room / corridor) · stride: 意气风发、步幅坚毅的大步迈行 (stage / podium / room) · prowl: 如潜伏猎手般焦躁或隐秘地巡行 (streets / alleyways / perimeter) · tramp: 步履沉重、长途跋涉地踩行 (woods / road / mud) · step out: 意气风发地迈步外出或加快步频 (doors / rhythm / style)

groups.name: Page & Summon · 传呼与传唤 (Summon, Bleep, Call Overhead)
groups.tip: 通过广播或呼叫器指名找人

items.def_zh: （通过广播或寻呼机）呼叫，传唤；翻阅（书页）；给……编页码
items.def_en: 1. To call or summon someone by announcing their name over a loudspeaker or using an electronic pager. 2. (+ through) To turn the pages of a book or magazine. 3. To number the pages of a document.
items.ex_en: The hospital operator had to page the on-call physician for an urgent surgery.
items.ex_zh: 医院接线员不得不通过广播紧急呼叫值班医生前来主刀手术。

items.def_en: To summon someone to leave a place or activity urgently
items.ex_en: The surgeon was called away from dinner to deal with an emergency in the OR.
items.ex_zh: 这位外科医生在晚饭时被紧急叫走，前往手术室处理急症。

items.def_zh: 通过公用广播系统呼叫
items.def_en: (informal, British) To broadcast a message or summon someone over a public address system
items.ex_en: Station staff tannoyed passengers that the southbound express train had suffered severe delays.
items.ex_zh: 车站工作人员通过广播通知旅客，南下列车遭遇了严重晚点。

items.def_en: To authoritatively order someone to come or be present
items.ex_en: The magistrate summoned the corporate executive to provide official testimony under legal oath.
items.ex_zh: 地方法官传唤该企业高管出庭并在法律宣誓下提供正式证词。

items.def_en: (especially British) To contact someone via an electronic pager that emits a bleeping sound
items.ex_en: The head nurse bleeped the resident doctor to attend immediately to room four.
items.ex_zh: 护士长用寻呼机呼叫住院医生，让他立刻前往四号病房。
items.ex2_en: The electronic emergency pager bleeped loudly across the quiet hospital ward.
items.ex2_zh: 电子应急寻呼机在安静的医院病房里尖锐地鸣响起来。

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies alerting, locating, or summoning an individual through public address systems, electronic beepers, pagers, or organizational dispatch signals.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过广播扩音、电子寻呼机或调度系统公开呼叫并传唤特定人员。
groups.desc_en: Denotes contacting or ordering someone to report via electronic signaling or formal authority, contrasting with casual 'calling' or 'phoning' by its structured, urgent protocol.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过电子传呼装置、广播或正式指令传唤某人到场，与普通的“呼叫”不同，具有组织化、制度性或警报性的传讯特征。
groups.nuance_en: summon: to formally or authoritatively command someone to appear (witness / doctor / courage) · page: to alert an individual via public address or electronic pager (doctor / customer / passenger) · bleep: to contact someone using a radio pocket-pager (doctor / on-call staff / team) · tannoy: to announce or broadcast a request over a public loudspeaker (passenger / shopper / crowd) · call away: to summon someone away from an ongoing activity (business / emergency / consultation)
groups.nuance_zh: summon: 凭借权威或正式公权力召集传唤 (witness / doctor / courage) · page: 借助广播或寻呼机点名呼叫 (doctor / customer / passenger) · bleep: 触发寻呼机蜂鸣声以紧急传召 (doctor / on-call staff / team) · tannoy: 使用公共广播系统播报寻人 (passenger / shopper / crowd) · call away: 因紧急事务将某人从手头活动中调离 (business / emergency / consultation)

groups.name: Pair & Match · 配对与契合 (Couple, Mate, Yoke)
groups.tip: 两两组合对应成双互相契合

items.def_en: To join, link, or associate two things or concepts closely together
items.ex_en: Rigorous academic research must couple theoretical models with reliable empirical field observations.
items.ex_zh: 严谨的学术研究必须将理论模型与可靠的实证田野观察结合起来。
items.ex2_en: The railway passenger cars coupled smoothly at the central train station.
items.ex2_zh: 客运火车车厢在中央火车站顺利联挂在一起。

items.def_zh: 使相配，使结成对；使（两城镇）结为友好关系
items.def_en: 1. To pair or combine two things closely together. 2. (British English) To link one town or city officially with another in a different country.
items.ex_en: The historic market town was twinned with a picturesque vineyard commune in France.
items.ex_zh: 这座历史悠久的集镇与法国一个风景如画的葡萄园市镇结为了友好城市。

items.def_en: To pair two matching parts or animals together for operation or breeding
items.ex_en: Engineers carefully mated the transmission housing to the newly overhauled diesel engine.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们小心翼翼地将变速箱壳体与刚大修过的柴油发动机装配结合。
items.ex2_en: The gear teeth mated perfectly during the routine machine maintenance test.
items.ex2_zh: 在常规机械检修测试中，齿轮的齿合非常完美。

items.def_en: To form into pairs or form romantic couplings from a larger group
items.ex_en: During the social mixer, attendees began to pair off for private discussions.
items.ex_zh: 在社交酒会上，与会者们开始三三两两结对进行私下交谈。

items.def_en: To harness two animals together, or link two disparate entities intimately
items.ex_en: Imperial treaties sought to yoke divergent regional economies into one centralized empire.
items.ex_zh: 帝国条约试图将差异巨大的各地区经济强行绑入一个中央集权帝国中。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on linking, coupling, or combining two distinct entities into a coherent, functioning, or balanced unit.
groups.summary_zh: 指将两个独立实体连接、匹配或结合为互补对偶。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on binding, matching, or harmonizing two complementary entities into a functional or biological dyad, contrasting with general 'connecting' or 'grouping'.
groups.desc_zh: 强调将两个具有互补性的实体结合、配对或绑在一起形成功能或生物学二元体，与笼统的“连接”或“聚集”相对。
groups.nuance_en: pair off: to separate into matched couples or working dyads (contestants / dancers / guests) · couple: to join two distinct elements, often causally or mechanically (carriages / reforms / data) · twin: to closely link two entities in partnership or parallel design (towns / engines / policies) · mate: to bring animals together for biological reproduction (horses / birds / dogs) · yoke: to tightly bind two entities under joint constraint or burden (oxen / economies / fate)
groups.nuance_zh: pair off: 成对结伴或捉对分组 (contestants / dancers / guests) · couple: 机械挂钩或将两者在因果上关联 (carriages / reforms / data) · twin: 结为友好姊妹关系或成对配套 (towns / engines / policies) · mate: 使动植物交配配种 (horses / birds / dogs) · yoke: 用轭套上或强行捆绑共担苦难 (oxen / economies / fate)

groups.name: Palpitate & Flutter · 心脏悸动与异常剧跳 (Palpitate, Flutter, Race)
groups.tip: 心脏或脉搏急促剧烈跳动

items.def_en: Beat with a light, rapid, and irregular tremor, as felt during moments of nervousness
items.ex_en: Her heart fluttered with sudden apprehension as the envelope was handed over.
items.ex_zh: 当信封递到手中时，她的心因为突如其来的不安而怦怦乱跳。
items.ex2_en: The nervous breeze fluttered the fragile white curtains against the windowpane.
items.ex2_zh: 微风轻轻吹动脆弱的白色窗帘，拍打在窗玻璃上。

items.def_zh: 心跳漏了一拍（极度震惊）
items.def_en: Experience a momentary pause or hesitation in regular heartbeat caused by shock or surprise
items.ex_en: My heart missed a beat when the car suddenly swerved across lanes.
items.ex_zh: 当那辆车突然变道冲过来时，我的心猛地漏跳了一拍。

items.def_en: Beat much faster than usual because of excitement, fear, exertion, or anxiety
items.ex_en: His heart raced wildly after sprinting up three steep flights of stairs.
items.ex_zh: 一口气冲上三层陡峭的楼梯后，他的心跳陡然加速狂跳不止。
items.ex2_en: The skilled driver raced the sports car around the winding mountain course.
items.ex2_zh: 熟练的赛车手驾驶跑车在蜿蜒的山区赛道上飞驰。

items.def_en: Beat unusually heavily and loudly within the chest, often accompanied by strong physical distress
items.ex_en: Her heart pounded against her ribs as she crept through the dark basement.
items.ex_zh: 当她穿过黑暗的地下室时，她的心脏剧烈跳动，仿佛要撞破胸膛。

items.def_zh: （心脏）急促剧烈跳动，悸动；发抖
items.def_en: (of the heart) To beat rapidly, strongly, or irregularly, typically because of fear, anxiety, or excitement.
items.ex_en: The frightened patient could feel his heart palpitate during the stressful medical exam.
items.ex_zh: 在令人紧张的体检过程中，受到惊吓的病人能感到心跳急促悸动。

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies the involuntary, unnerving biological sensation of one's heart beating abnormally fast, fluttering, or pounding erratically due to acute fear, panic, illness, or intense exertion.
groups.summary_zh: 心脏因惊恐、亢奋或病理原因而出现急促、紊乱或剧烈的心悸跳动。
groups.desc_en: Describes abnormal, accelerated, or highly noticeable cardiac throbbing driven by stress, pathology, or shock, contrasting with the steady, unconscious rhythm of 'beating'.
groups.desc_zh: 描述心脏因惊吓、病理或激动而出现的急促、剧烈或节律异常的搏动，与无意识、平稳的心脏正常“跳动”相对。
groups.nuance_en: palpitate: to beat rapidly, strongly, or irregularly with noticeable distress (heart / pulse / chest) · pound: to thump heavily and forcefully against the ribs (heart / temples / chest) · race: to run at an excessively fast and uncontrolled tempo (heart / pulse / mind) · flutter: to beat with rapid, erratic, tremulous contractions (heart / pulse / eyelid) · miss a beat: to skip or drop a cardiac stroke from sudden shock (heart / pulse / rhythm)
groups.nuance_zh: palpitate: 心神不宁或病理性的心慌悸动 (heart / pulse / chest) · pound: 如重锤敲打般剧烈怦怦直跳 (heart / temples / chest) · race: 狂飙飞速狂跳 (heart / pulse / mind) · flutter: 细碎、颤动、不规则的扑动 (heart / pulse / eyelid) · miss a beat: 因震惊或心律失常骤停漏跳一拍 (heart / pulse / rhythm)

groups.name: Pamper & Baby · 溺爱与娇宠 (Baby, Coddle, Mollicoddle)
groups.tip: 像对待婴儿般娇惯纵容

items.def_en: To treat someone with excessive indulgence, care, or gentleness as if they were an infant.
items.ex_en: Stop babying your adult son and let him resolve his own financial problems.
items.ex_zh: 别再把你那成年的儿子当婴儿般娇惯了，让他自己解决财务困难吧。

items.def_en: To protect and care for someone in an overly warm, sheltering, and tender manner
items.ex_en: The reclusive heiress was cosseted by a devoted circle of domestic servants.
items.ex_zh: 这位深居简出的女继承人被一群忠心耿耿的仆人无微不至地娇宠着。

items.def_en: To provide someone with so much constant help that they need no self-reliance
items.ex_en: Professors refuse to spoon-feed graduate students who ought to conduct independent research.
items.ex_zh: 教授们拒绝给那些本应开展独立研究的研究生进行填鸭式的包办照料。

items.def_en: To treat someone with excessive care, protection, and softness
items.ex_en: Overprotective parents tend to coddle their children, hindering their emotional growth and resilience.
items.ex_zh: 过度保护孩子的父母往往会娇养溺爱他们，从而阻碍他们的心智成长与韧性。

items.def_en: To overprotect and pamper someone to an extreme, debilitating degree
items.ex_en: If you constantly mollycoddle the recruit, he will never adapt to tough conditions.
items.ex_zh: 如果你总是对这名新兵过分呵护、百般纵容，他永远也无法适应艰苦环境。

groups.summary_en: Covers treating someone with overprotective, infant-like care that shields them from hardship and fosters dependence.
groups.summary_zh: 像对待婴儿般过度呵护、免除责任，使其免受任何挫折与压力。
groups.desc_en: Denotes excessive indulgence, overprotection, or shielding an individual from hardship, differing from healthy 'nurturing' or 'caring' by stunting independence.
groups.desc_zh: 指过度娇宠、纵容或过度保护，使其免受任何磨难，与健康的“养育”或“关怀”不同，具有剥夺其自主能力的负面色彩。
groups.nuance_en: baby: to treat a mature individual as a helpless infant (husband / athlete / patient) · coddle: to treat with overly protective indulgence or tender care (ego / subordinates / child) · mollycoddle: to smother with absurdly soft, hypersensitive overprotection (sons / recruits / athletes) · cosset: to shower with luxury, warmth, and affectionate pampering (pets / celebrities / clients) · spoon-feed: to provide information or aid so completely that no independent effort is needed (students / candidates / users)
groups.nuance_zh: baby: 把心智健全者当婴儿般过度呵护 (husband / athlete / patient) · coddle: 悉心护短、免其受苦的姑息娇惯 (ego / subordinates / child) · mollycoddle: 神经质般的极度娇生惯养 (sons / recruits / athletes) · cosset: 锦衣玉食般的精细照拂宠溺 (pets / celebrities / clients) · spoon-feed: 填鸭式包揽一切以致丧失主动能力 (students / candidates / users)

groups.name: Pan-Frying Technique & Pan Sauces · 锅底释香与调汁 (Deglaze, Brown, Sear)
groups.tip: 运用特定手法烹饪料理食材

items.def_en: To boil liquid, sauce, or stock down so it becomes thicker and more intensely flavored
items.ex_en: Simmer the white wine sauce gently to reduce it to a glossy glaze.
items.ex_zh: 用文火慢慢煨煮白葡萄酒酱汁，使其浓缩收汁成一层富有光泽的稠汁。
items.ex2_en: The savory meat broth reduced slowly to a rich, fragrant brown sauce.
items.ex2_zh: 鲜美的肉汤慢慢熬浓，变成了一份浓郁芳香的褐色酱汁。

items.def_en: To cook food until its exterior turns a rich brown color and develops Maillard flavor
items.ex_en: Brown the meatballs on all sides before simmering them in the tomato sauce.
items.ex_zh: 将肉丸各面煎至金黄微褐，再放入番茄酱中慢炖。
items.ex2_en: The bread crust browned evenly inside the hot stone baking oven.
items.ex2_zh: 面包皮在热石烤箱中均匀地变成了金黄色。

items.def_en: To brown meat quickly at high heat to develop crust and render fond for sauce
items.ex_en: Sear the steak in a blazing hot cast-iron skillet to lock in juices.
items.ex_zh: 用烧得滚烫的铸铁锅高温煎封牛排，以锁住肉汁。

items.def_en: To cook chopped ingredients rapidly in a small amount of hot oil or butter in an open pan
items.ex_en: Sauté the diced shallots in melted butter until they become translucent and fragrant.
items.ex_zh: 将红葱头碎放入融化的黄油中煸炒，直至变得晶莹透亮、香气四溢。

items.def_zh: 调制锅底酱（烹饪中加液体溶解锅底残留肉汁）
items.def_en: 1. (cooking) To add wine, stock, or water to a hot pan and stir to dissolve browned food bits into a flavorful sauce.
items.ex_en: Deglaze the smoking skillet with red wine, scraping up the browned remnants smoothly.
items.ex_zh: 用红葡萄酒激入滚烫的煎锅，将锅底焦香的肉汁残渣顺滑溶开。

groups.summary_en: Culinary verbs in this frame relate to pan-cooking meat, creating caramelized residue (fond), and utilizing liquids to lift and incorporate these concentrated drippings into savory sauces.
groups.summary_zh: 烹饪中通过煎出焦香并在锅底加液体化解浓缩肉汁的系列技艺。
groups.desc_en: Refers to high-heat pan culinary maneuvers that caramelize surfaces and extract browned residues to build sauces, contrasting with plain 'cooking' or 'boiling'.
groups.desc_zh: 特指通过高温煎炒使食材表面褐化，并溶解锅底焦香残渣以制作浓郁酱汁的烹饪技法，区别于笼统的“烹饪”或“煮制”。
groups.nuance_en: sear: to quickly scorch meat surfaces at intense heat to lock in crust (steak / tuna / edges) · brown: to cook until food develops a rich, browned exterior via Maillard reaction (onions / meat / butter) · deglaze: to dissolve flavorful browned crust from the pan base using liquid (pan / skillet / drippings) · saute: to toss and cook food quickly in a minimal amount of hot fat (mushrooms / vegetables / garlic) · reduce: to thicken and concentrate flavors of a pan liquid through simmering (sauce / wine / glaze)
groups.nuance_zh: sear: 超高温迅速锁边炙烤形成焦脆外壳 (steak / tuna / edges) · brown: 借助美拉德反应慢炒或煎至表面金黄微焦 (onions / meat / butter) · deglaze: 用酒或高汤溶解锅底焦香附着物以制汁 (pan / skillet / drippings) · saute: 在少许热油中快速翻炒 (mushrooms / vegetables / garlic) · reduce: 慢熬浓缩酱汁使质地粘稠入味 (sauce / wine / glaze)

groups.name: Panhandle & Beg · 沿街行乞与强讨 (Panhandle, Beg, Cadge)
groups.tip: 低声下气地求助或沿街乞讨

items.def_en: To ask for and obtain money, food, or small items from others without paying
items.ex_en: He managed to cadge a free cigarette from a stranger outside the bar.
items.ex_zh: 他设法在酒吧外从一个陌生人那里讨要了一支免费香烟。

items.def_en: To ask people for money, food, or assistance in public out of urgent destitution
items.ex_en: The destitute woman had to beg for spare change outside the subway entrance.
items.ex_zh: 那位身无分文的贫困妇女不得不在地铁站外乞求零钱施舍。

items.def_en: (chiefly North American informal) To beg for money from strangers in a public street.
items.ex_en: Down on his luck, he began to panhandle along the busy downtown boulevard.
items.ex_zh: 走投无路的他开始在繁华的市中心大道上沿街讨钱。

items.def_en: To rely shamelessly on another person for money, food, or shelter
items.ex_en: He refused to work and continued to sponge off his aging parents relentlessly.
items.ex_zh: 他拒绝去工作，一味厚着脸皮长期啃老度日。

items.def_en: To make a humble, earnest, and submissive petition or entreaty to someone powerful
items.ex_en: The fallen lord knelt to supplicate the victorious king for his family's survival.
items.ex_zh: 战败的领主屈膝跪伏，哀求胜利的国王饶其全家性命。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures demanding or pleading for petty money, food, or goods from passersby in public streets, ranging from quiet entreaty to aggressive solicitation.
groups.summary_zh: 指在街头公然向陌生人乞求施舍零钱或口粮。
groups.desc_en: Describes soliciting money, goods, or favors from strangers or acquaintances with varying degrees of desperation or shamelessness, contrasting with formal 'requesting'.
groups.desc_zh: 指在街头或人际交往中向陌生人或熟人讨要钱财物品，依厚脸皮或卑微程度不同，与正规的“请求”或“募捐”截然不同。
groups.nuance_en: beg: to plead desperately or solicit alms from a position of destitution (money / food / forgiveness) · panhandle: to accost passersby on public streets asking for small change (pedestrians / subway / coins) · cadge: to casually wheedle or scrounge small items without paying (cigarettes / drinks / rides) · sponge off: to parasitically live at another's expense through prolonged freeloading (parents / relatives / friends) · supplicate: to humbly and subserviently plead before authority (deity / king / court)
groups.nuance_zh: beg: 居于赤贫或卑下地位苦苦哀求或乞讨 (money / food / forgiveness) · panhandle: 在街头或地铁向过路行人索要零钱 (pedestrians / subway / coins) · cadge: 顺水推舟地讨要或蹭取烟酒小物 (cigarettes / drinks / rides) · sponge off: 长期寄生在他人身上白吃白喝 (parents / relatives / friends) · supplicate: 极度谦卑地向权威祈求或请愿 (deity / king / court)

groups.name: Panic & Freak · 惊慌与失控 (Freak, Panic, Unhinge)
groups.tip: 恐惧导致失去理智、手足无措

items.def_en: To make someone lose their confidence, courage, or calm by unsettling them
items.ex_en: The sudden, eerie silence in the auditorium served to unnerve the nervous speaker.
items.ex_zh: 礼堂里突如其来的诡异寂静让本就紧张的演讲者更觉心慌气馁。

items.def_zh: 惊恐发作；吓坏；情绪失控
items.def_en: To lose control of your emotions through sudden intense panic, shock, or anger
items.ex_en: She totally freaked out when she spotted a massive spider in her shoe.
items.ex_zh: 当她看到鞋里有一只大蜘蛛时，顿时吓得歇斯底里。
items.ex2_en: The eerie sound outside freaked out the nervous children in the dark.
items.ex2_zh: 外面怪异的声音把黑暗中紧张的孩子们吓坏了。

items.def_en: To completely lose self-control or composure by exploding in anger, terror, or tears
items.ex_en: Exhausted by constant pressure, the manager finally lost it and screamed at everyone.
items.ex_zh: 在持续的重压折磨下，经理终于情绪失控，冲所有人大喊大叫。

items.def_zh: 使惊慌失措，使极度不安；惊慌失措，发疯
items.def_en: (informal) To suddenly feel or cause someone to feel extremely surprised, upset, angry, or panicked.
items.ex_en: Don't freak, but I think someone is standing outside in our dark driveway.
items.ex_zh: 别慌，但我好像看见有人站在咱们漆黑的车道外面。
items.ex2_en: The sudden loud explosion freaked the entire quiet neighborhood last night.
items.ex2_zh: 昨晚突如其来的剧烈爆炸把整个安静的社区吓得不轻。

items.def_en: To suddenly feel or cause to feel an overpowering fear that prevents rational thought and action
items.ex_en: Dense smoke caused the trapped crowd to panic and rush toward the exits.
items.ex_zh: 浓烟使得被困的人群陷入恐慌，争先恐后地冲向出口。
items.ex2_en: The sudden sounding of the alarm caused passengers to panic instantly.
items.ex2_zh: 警报突然响起，使乘客们瞬间惊慌失措。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express losing self-control, composure, or mental stability under sudden fear, shock, anger, or sensory overload.
groups.summary_zh: 指由于突发恐惧、震惊或巨大刺激而失去镇定、阵脚大乱或陷入歇斯底里。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to sudden, disorienting waves of irrational dread or acute emotional dysregulation, contrasting with controlled 'worry' or rational 'caution'.
groups.desc_zh: 指突发性、压倒性的非理性恐惧或严重情绪失控，使人丧失判断力，与理性的“担忧”或“谨慎”相对。
groups.nuance_en: panic: to succumb to sudden, contagious, unreasoning terror (crowd / investors / passengers) · freak: to experience an acute, irrational shock or bizarre mental reaction (parents / driver / public) · freak out: to lose emotional control in hysterical anger or anxiety (fans / team / boss) · lose it: to completely snap and forfeit composure or sanity (temper / mind / composure) · unnerve: to erode someone's confidence, steadiness, or composure (witness / player / opponent)
groups.nuance_zh: panic: 突发恐慌、群体盲乱 (crowd / investors / passengers) · freak: 突遭刺激引起心绪炸裂或极度惊愕 (parents / driver / public) · freak out: 彻底抓狂失控或神经质爆发 (fans / team / boss) · lose it: 心理防线彻底崩溃、破防失态 (temper / mind / composure) · unnerve: 悄然削弱动摇对方的镇定与底气 (witness / player / opponent)

groups.name: Paralyze & Incapacitate · 瘫痪与使完全失去机能 (Palsy, Paralyze, Incapacitate)
groups.tip: 神经失调导致肢体麻木至完全瘫痪

items.def_en: To make someone or something severely weak and infirm
items.ex_en: A severe bout of pneumonia threatened to debilitate the elderly patient permanently.
items.ex_zh: 一场严重的肺炎险些使这位年迈的患者身体彻底虚弱瘫倒。

items.def_zh: 使不能移动；使固定不动
items.def_en: To prevent someone or something from moving or operating normally
items.ex_en: Paramedics used a rigid neck brace to immobilize the driver's injured spine.
items.ex_zh: 急救人员使用硬质颈托固定住司机受伤的脊柱，使其无法动弹。

items.def_en: To cause a person or body part to lose motor power or feeling, or render a system unable to function
items.ex_en: A sudden transit strike threatened to paralyze the entire city during morning rush.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的公交罢工极可能使整个城市在早高峰陷入瘫痪。

items.def_zh: 使无能力；使伤残而丧失行动力
items.def_en: To deprive someone of the ability or fitness for normal physical or mental activity
items.ex_en: A devastating knee injury threatened to incapacitate the athlete for the upcoming season.
items.ex_zh: 毁灭性的膝盖伤势可能会使这名运动员彻底丧失下赛季的参赛能力。

items.def_en: (literary) To affect with paralysis or involuntary tremors; to make completely powerless or unable to act.
items.ex_en: A creeping dread seemed to palsy his limbs as the shadowy beast approached.
items.ex_zh: 当黑影般的怪兽逼近时，一阵蔓延的恐惧仿佛麻痹了他的四肢。

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote depriving an organism, limb, or organizational system of the capacity to move, act, or function normally, either physically or metaphorically through shock or dread.
groups.summary_zh: 指使肢体、生命体或运行系统失去行动或运作能力。
groups.desc_en: Refers to rendering a person, limb, or organizational system completely immobile, powerless, or functionally dead, contrasting with merely 'weakening' or 'hindering'.
groups.desc_zh: 指使人、肢体或组织系统彻底丧失活动能力、力量或机能，与普通的“削弱”或“阻碍”不同，具有彻底废除机能的终局性。
groups.nuance_en: paralyze: to completely arrest bodily motion or operational activity (limbs / traffic / government) · incapacitate: to deprive of legal, physical, or operational capacity (soldier / pilot / patient) · immobilize: to fix in place so movement is physically impossible (fracture / vehicle / fleet) · debilitate: to severely sap strength and vigor over time (disease / economy / stroke) · palsy: to strike with tremors, paralysis, or helpless shivering (hand / fear / limb)
groups.nuance_zh: paralyze: 使神经运动机能或运作中枢彻底瘫痪 (limbs / traffic / government) · incapacitate: 使完全丧失身体、法律或执行任务的能力 (soldier / pilot / patient) · immobilize: 物理固定使完全无法动弹 (fracture / vehicle / fleet) · debilitate: 持续消耗使其极度虚弱衰竭 (disease / economy / stroke) · palsy: 造成痉挛瘫痪或因剧烈恐惧而僵死 (hand / fear / limb)

groups.name: Paralyze & Numb · 麻痹与瘫痪 (Paralyze, Numb, Incapacitate)
groups.tip: 从局部麻木到彻底无法动弹

items.def_en: to deprive a body part or emotion of sensation and responsiveness
items.ex_en: Freezing winds continued to numb his bare fingers until he felt nothing at all.
items.ex_zh: 凛冽的寒风不断吹刮着他裸露的手指，直至完全冻得失去知觉。

items.def_zh: 使麻木呆滞；使失去知觉
items.def_en: to make someone unable to think or feel clearly, often through drugs or shock
items.ex_en: A heavy dose of sedatives worked to stupefy the erratic patient into submission.
items.ex_zh: 大剂量的镇静剂使躁动不安的病人神志呆滞、安静下来。

items.def_zh: 使瘫痪，使麻痹；使无法正常运转，使陷于瘫痪
items.def_en: 1. To cause a person or body part to lose the ability to move or feel. 2. To bring an activity, system, or organization to a complete standstill.
items.ex_en: Fallen power lines managed to paralyze the metropolitan rail network for several hours.
items.ex_zh: 倒下的电线导致大都市的轨道交通网络陷入了数小时的瘫痪。

items.def_en: to deprive someone of strength, fitness, or legal ability to function
items.ex_en: The toxic chemical fumes were potent enough to incapacitate an adult within seconds.
items.ex_zh: 有毒的化学烟雾威力极强，几秒钟内便能让人丧失行动能力。

items.def_zh: 使固定不动；使无法移动
items.def_en: to prevent something or someone from moving or operating normally
items.ex_en: Technicians clamped the broken wheel to immobilize the carriage before performing repairs.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员用夹具固定住坏掉的车轮，使其无法转动后才开始维修。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers depriving muscles, nerves, or entire operational entities of motility, feeling, or functional capacity. Physical sensory deadening extends metaphorically into complete systemic freeze.
groups.summary_zh: 肉体机能瘫痪、知觉钝化乃至系统机制彻底陷入僵死停摆。
groups.desc_en: Involves dulling or extinguishing sensory awareness and motor responsiveness through cold, trauma, drugs, or profound shock, contrasting with general 'sedating'.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过寒冷、创伤、药物或精神极度震荡使知觉和反应力迟钝甚至彻底泯灭，与一般的“镇静”不同，偏向感官麻木状态。
groups.nuance_en: numb: to deaden physical feeling or emotional sensibility (fingers / pain / grief) · stupefy: to stun into a dull, dazed, or uncomprehending state (alcohol / shock / poison) · paralyze: to freeze responsiveness through cold terror or neurological block (fear / muscles / shock) · incapacitate: to render unable to function or feel normally (victim / sensory system / target) · immobilize: to lock in emotional or physical stillness (prey / limb / joint)
groups.nuance_zh: numb: 使肉体知觉或情感神经麻木失去知觉 (fingers / pain / grief) · stupefy: 因药物、醉酒或巨震使人神智昏沉呆滞 (alcohol / shock / poison) · paralyze: 因极度惊吓或神经阻滞导致动弹不得 (fear / muscles / shock) · incapacitate: 剥夺感觉或自主动作的能力 (victim / sensory system / target) · immobilize: 封锁活动使其僵住无法反应 (prey / limb / joint)

groups.name: Parasitic Draining & Exploitation · 寄生榨取与搜刮 (Sponge, Bleed, Milk)
groups.tip: 如水蛭般榨干底层劳动成果

items.def_en: Exploit a situation, system, or person thoroughly to gain the maximum profit or sympathy
items.ex_en: The corrupt official tried to milk the tragedy for cheap political sympathy.
items.ex_zh: 那个腐败官员企图榨取这起悲剧的剩余价值，以博取廉价的政治同情。

items.def_en: (+ off/on) Habitually accept money, food, or hospitality from others without giving in return
items.ex_en: He was content to sponge off his roommates instead of finding steady employment.
items.ex_zh: 他安于在室友那里白吃白住，而不是去找一份稳定的工作。

items.def_en: Extort or continuously drain vast amounts of money or resources from someone
items.ex_en: The corrupt contractors threatened to bleed the city's construction budget dry entirely.
items.ex_zh: 贪婪的承包商企图彻底榨干整个城市的市政建设预算。

items.def_en: Deprive someone of large sums of money through deceit, overcharging, or extortion
items.ex_en: Unscrupulous souvenir vendors managed to fleece the naive tourists with fake gemstones.
items.ex_zh: 黑心纪念品小贩用人造假宝石狠狠宰了那些天真的游客一笔。

items.def_zh: 榨取，依附……吸血；用蚂蟥（水蛭）吸血
items.def_en: (+ off/on) To rely on and drain money, resources, or support from someone without giving anything back.
items.ex_en: She realized her freeloading brother would leech off her income indefinitely unless evicted.
items.ex_zh: 她意识到如果不把蹭吃蹭喝的弟弟赶走，他会无休止地吸食自己的薪水。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers predatory or parasitic extraction of wealth, resources, or emotional strength from another entity without reciprocal return. Leech evokes parasitical attachment, bleed stresses exhausting reserves till dry, and milk suggests calculating extortion.
groups.summary_zh: 像寄生虫一样无偿吸取、榨干他人钱财、精力或资源。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the systematic, predatory draining of another party's wealth, resources, or goodwill through deceit or parasitic dependence, contrasting with fair 'exchange'.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过欺瞒、榨取或长期寄生，有计划地吸干对方的财富、资源或心血，与合法的“交换”或“盈利”相对。
groups.nuance_en: bleed: to progressively drain financial resources or vitality dry (coffers / taxpayers / economy) · milk: to deliberately extract maximum advantage or profit from a resource (system / cow / tragedy) · fleece: to swindle or overcharge someone out of their money (tourists / investors / consumers) · leech: to attach parasitically and constantly drain nutrients or cash (funds / host / family) · sponge: to habitually live off others without providing value in return (relatives / charity / state)
groups.nuance_zh: bleed: 持续放血式抽干财务或元气 (coffers / taxpayers / economy) · milk: 机关算尽地榨取全部剩余价值 (system / cow / tragedy) · fleece: 宰客、诱骗卷走大笔钱财 (tourists / investors / consumers) · leech: 像水蛭般寄生吸附、吸干脂膏 (funds / host / family) · sponge: 蹭吃蹭喝、长期依附他人过活 (relatives / charity / state)

groups.name: Pardon & Spare · 宽恕与宽免饶恕 (Spare, Pardon, Forgive)
groups.tip: 免除惩罚或手下留情

items.def_en: To stop feeling angry or resentful toward someone for an offense or mistake
items.ex_en: It took many painful years for her to forgive his bitter betrayal.
items.ex_zh: 历经多年痛苦，她才终于原谅了他残酷的背叛。

items.def_zh: 饶恕，放过；免除，使免遭；抽出，省出
items.def_en: 1. To refrain from harming, punishing, or killing someone. 2. To save someone from experiencing something difficult or unpleasant. 3. To make something available or give it to someone.
items.ex_en: The victorious rebel general chose to spare the young conscripts from execution.
items.ex_zh: 取得胜利的起义军将领决定放过那些年轻的征召兵，免于处决。

items.def_en: To decide not to punish someone severely or at all for an offense
items.ex_en: The forgiving officer chose to let him off with merely a stern warning.
items.ex_zh: 宽容的警官决定网开一面，仅仅严厉警告了他就予以放行。

items.def_en: To grant official forgiveness for a crime or offense without punishment
items.ex_en: The president formally agreed to pardon the controversial whistleblower before leaving office.
items.ex_zh: 总统在离任前正式批准特赦了那位引发争议的吹哨人。

items.def_zh: 暂缓执行刑罚；缓刑宽免
items.def_en: To postpone or cancel the punishment of someone, especially a prisoner condemned to death
items.ex_en: New DNA evidence emerged just in time to reprieve the condemned prisoner.
items.ex_zh: 新的DNA证据及时出现，使这名死囚得以暂缓执行死刑。

groups.summary_en: These verbs describe using authority or mercy to refrain from executing, punishing, or destroying someone who is at one's mercy.
groups.summary_zh: 凭借宽容或权力开恩免罚，饶恕受制者的性命或过错。
groups.desc_en: Involves granting remission from deserved punishment, harm, or guilt through authoritative clemency or emotional grace, contrasting with 'ignoring' or 'acquitting'.
groups.desc_zh: 指基于权威赦免或仁慈宽大，免除本应承担的惩罚、伤害或罪责，与“无罪释放”或单纯的“忽视”不同，预设了罪过已被认定。
groups.nuance_en: forgive: to let go of subjective resentment and moral grievance (sins / offender / debts) · pardon: to officially exempt an offender from penal consequences via authority (convict / prisoner / criminal) · spare: to mercifully refrain from killing, punishing, or destroying (life / captive / feelings) · reprieve: to postpone or temporarily cancel impending punishment (execution / prisoner / company) · let off: to release with light rebuke or no penalty despite clear guilt (hook / warning / caution)
groups.nuance_zh: forgive: 从内心放下怨恨与过错 (sins / offender / debts) · pardon: 执政权威依照法定程序特赦减罪 (convict / prisoner / criminal) · spare: 动恻隐之心免于诛杀、伤害或破坏 (life / captive / feelings) · reprieve: 暂缓执行死刑或灾难性惩处 (execution / prisoner / company) · let off: 抓到现行后法外开恩、宽大放过 (hook / warning / caution)

groups.name: Park & Station · 停放与驻留 (Station, Garrison, Billet)
groups.tip: 车辆停止并安放

items.def_zh: 停放（车辆），泊车；暂搁，搁置（想法等）
items.def_en: 1. To bring a vehicle to a halt and leave it in a designated place. 2. (informal) To set an issue, idea, or proposal aside for later discussion.
items.ex_en: Let's park that tricky budget question until we review our quarterly revenue figures.
items.ex_zh: 咱们先暂时搁置那个棘手的预算问题，等核查完季度营收数据再说。

items.def_en: Assign a person, vehicle, or military unit to stand or remain in a particular place
items.ex_en: Security guards decided to station two armed men near the bank's vault.
items.ex_zh: 安保主管决定在银行金库附近部署派驻两名武装警卫。

items.def_en: (of a vehicle) Stop, pause, or draw to a halt at a curb or specific spot
items.ex_en: A sleek black limousine managed to pull up right beside the curb.
items.ex_zh: 一辆时髦的黑色豪华轿车平稳地靠着路边停了下来。

items.def_en: Provide a town, base, or fortress with a stationary force of troops
items.ex_en: The imperial commander intended to garrison the border fort with five hundred infantrymen.
items.ex_zh: 帝国指挥官打算派遣五百名步兵驻防这座边境堡垒。

items.def_en: Lodge soldiers temporarily in civilian houses or designated quarters
items.ex_en: Officials were forced to billet the retreating soldiers in nearby farmhouse barns.
items.ex_zh: 官员们被迫将撤退的士兵临时安置在附近农舍的谷仓中借宿。

groups.summary_en: Pertains to positioning a vehicle, machine, or military personnel in a specific location for an extended resting period or tactical deployment, alongside colloquial extensions of shelving ideas or placing people.
groups.summary_zh: 指将车辆、重型设备停放，或将人员、部队派驻某地长期停留。
groups.desc_en: Refers to halting vehicles or deploying military units into assigned, stable holding positions, contrasting with ongoing 'moving' or permanent 'residing'.
groups.desc_zh: 指将车辆、船舶停放，或将军事部队有组织地进驻、部署在指定停留点，与“行进”或永久“定居”相对。
groups.nuance_en: park: to maneuver and leave a vehicle in a designated resting spot (car / bus / funds) · pull up: to bring a moving vehicle to a brief halt alongside something (curb / driveway / vehicle) · station: to assign an individual or military force to a specific outpost (troops / guard / police) · garrison: to occupy a fortified town or post with troops for defense (town / fortress / outpost) · billet: to lodge military personnel in civilian or temporary quarters (soldiers / troops / officers)
groups.nuance_zh: park: 将车辆停放于特定车位 (car / bus / funds) · pull up: 车辆徐徐减速停靠在路旁 (curb / driveway / vehicle) · station: 派遣驻守在指定岗位或驻地 (troops / guard / police) · garrison: 派军队把守据点或要塞 (town / fortress / outpost) · billet: 将官兵临时派宿于民房或营房 (soldiers / troops / officers)

groups.name: Parody & Satirize · 戏仿与嘲弄 (Caricature, Lampoon, Send up)
groups.tip: 通过夸张模仿他人言行来进行滑稽讽刺

items.def_zh: 讽刺模仿，幽默滑稽地戏仿；哄骗
items.def_en: To imitate the style of someone or something humorously in order to make people laugh.
items.ex_en: The comedy sketch tried to spoof popular spy movies through absurd gadgets.
items.ex_zh: 这部喜剧小品用荒谬的道具幽默戏仿了多部热门间谍电影。

items.def_zh: 插科打诨地调侃；讽刺模仿
items.def_en: To imitate someone or something in an amusing, slightly mocking way
items.ex_en: The satirical play loved to send up self-important politicians and their grand promises.
items.ex_zh: 这部讽刺剧极其热衷于调侃戏弄那些自命不凡、空许大诺的政客。

items.def_en: To imitate the characteristic style of an author, artist, or work for comic effect or ridicule
items.ex_en: The mischievous comedian loved to parody Shakespearean tragedies with exaggerated, modern vulgarities.
items.ex_zh: 这位顽皮的喜剧演员喜欢用夸张粗鄙的现代语汇来滑稽戏仿莎士比亚悲剧。

items.def_en: To represent someone or something in a way that emphasizes their distinctive traits for comedic or grotesque effect
items.ex_en: The political cartoonist chose to caricature the pompous senator's excessively large ears.
items.ex_zh: 这位时政漫画家选择通过夸张描摹那位自大参议员的大耳朵来加以讽刺。

items.def_en: To criticize or ridicule a person or institution using pointed satire or humor
items.ex_en: The satirical magazine did not hesitate to lampoon the monarchy's expensive lavish coronation.
items.ex_zh: 这家讽刺杂志毫不留情地撰文痛斥冷嘲了王室耗资奢靡的加冕礼。

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote imitating, exaggerating, or ridiculing individuals, works, or genres through creative caricature, satire, and comedic performance.
groups.summary_zh: 通过夸张模仿、讽刺作秀来恶搞与戏谑的动词群。
groups.desc_en: Involves imitating an established work, genre, or public figure with deliberate comedic exaggeration to ridicule or unmask pretension, contrasting with serious 'homage' or 'copying'.
groups.desc_zh: 指带有刻意夸张、讽刺或滑稽模仿的手法戏弄既有作品、流派或公众人物，与严肃的“致敬”或“抄袭”截然不同。
groups.nuance_en: parody: to mimic the distinctive style of a work or author for humorous effect (genre / movie / song) · spoof: to produce a lighthearted, comedic take-off of a known trope (horror film / ad / spy thriller) · lampoon: to publicly satirize and attack using sharp, biting wit (politician / institution / elite) · caricature: to exaggerate characteristic flaws or features comically (face / speech / traits) · send up: to mock affectionately or playfully by overplaying mannerisms (tradition / establishment / drama)
groups.nuance_zh: parody: 风格化戏仿与颠覆性模仿 (genre / movie / song) · spoof: 轻松搞怪的恶搞翻拍 (horror film / ad / spy thriller) · lampoon: 用辛辣讽刺文章或小品痛击批判 (politician / institution / elite) · caricature: 抓住突兀特征进行夸张滑稽漫画化 (face / speech / traits) · send up: 玩味、调侃式地惟妙惟肖模仿 (tradition / establishment / drama)

groups.name: Parry & Deflect · 格挡与化解 (Deflect, Ward off, Block)
groups.tip: 以武器弹开攻势化解打击

items.def_en: Stop the movement of an opponent, punch, or ball by standing or holding something in its way
items.ex_en: The agile goalkeeper leaped quickly to block the striker's powerful penalty shot.
items.ex_zh: 身手敏捷的守门员飞身扑救，挡住了前锋极具力量的点球。

items.def_en: Push away or defend oneself against an attacker, danger, or unwanted inquiry
items.ex_en: The politician skillfully gave vague answers to fend off aggressive journalistic questions.
items.ex_zh: 政客巧妙地含糊其辞，以此挡开记者们咄咄逼人的提问。

items.def_en: Prevent someone or something from harming or touching you by putting up a defense
items.ex_en: She raised her leather briefcase defensively to ward off the rabid stray dog.
items.ex_zh: 她防卫性地举起皮质公文包，以抵挡那只疯癫的流浪狗。

items.def_zh: 使偏斜；转移（注意力/攻击）
items.def_en: Cause an incoming blow, object, or question to change direction and glance away
items.ex_en: The reinforced composite shield served to deflect the incoming high-velocity steel shrapnel.
items.ex_zh: 强化复合盾牌有效地弹开了迎面飞来的高速钢制弹片。
items.ex2_en: The tennis ball deflected off the net cord and dropped out.
items.ex2_zh: 网球蹭到球网绳后发生偏折，落到了界外。

items.def_zh: 挡开，避开（攻击）；回避，巧妙避开（提问）
items.def_en: To block or deflect a blow or weapon in fighting, or to skillfully avoid answering a difficult question.
items.ex_en: With an effortless flick of his rapier, he managed to parry the thrust.
items.ex_zh: 他手腕轻巧一抖刺剑，便从容化解格挡了迎面刺来的一击。

groups.summary_en: Verbs highlighting the skillful evasion or redirection of physical strikes, incoming projectiles, or contentious questions and criticisms.
groups.summary_zh: 指敏捷地挡开来击、偏转攻击，或巧妙避开尖锐提问与指责。
groups.desc_en: Turning aside or neutralizing an oncoming blow, question, or threat by redirection or obstruction rather than absorbing it.
groups.desc_zh: 通过阻挡、偏转或技巧性化解来招架外来攻击、质问或威胁，而非硬性承受。
groups.nuance_en: block: direct physical or metaphorical stoppage (shot / punch / road) · deflect: redirecting trajectory away from the target (criticism / attention / bullet) · parry: skillful, agile deflection of attacks or probes (thrust / question / blow) · ward off: proactively repelling a threat or illness (danger / evil / infection) · fend off: continuously struggling to hold back attacks or demands (attackers / creditors / inquiries)
groups.nuance_zh: block: 迎头硬性阻挡 (shot / punch / road) · deflect: 改变方向使其偏离目标 (criticism / attention / bullet) · parry: 灵巧格挡并化解攻击或质问 (thrust / question / blow) · ward off: 主动防范或驱逐潜在危险与疾病 (danger / evil / infection) · fend off: 持续抵御逼近的威胁或纠缠 (attackers / creditors / inquiries)

groups.name: Pass Water & Urinate · 排尿与小便 (Pee, Pass Water, Urinate)
groups.tip: 机体生理排遗与废物释放

items.def_en: To discharge urine; vulgar in polite company though very common in slang
items.ex_en: He ducked into a filthy alleyway behind the pub to piss.
items.ex_zh: 他闪身钻进酒吧后面一条肮脏的小巷子里去撒尿。

items.def_en: To discharge urine; used as a polite or medical euphemism
items.ex_en: The patient complained that it had become agonizingly painful to pass water.
items.ex_zh: 病人主诉称，最近解小便时变得极为痛苦刺痛。

items.def_en: To urinate; used primarily by or when speaking to small children
items.ex_en: The tired mother asked her toddler whether he needed to wee-wee again.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的母亲柔声问幼儿是不是又需要去嘘嘘了。

items.def_en: 1. (informal) To discharge urine from the body.
items.ex_en: We had to pull over at a highway rest stop to pee.
items.ex_zh: 我们不得不把车停在高速公路服务区，好去小个便。

items.def_en: To discharge liquid waste from the bladder through the urethra
items.ex_en: The physician requested that the postoperative patient attempt to urinate without assistance.
items.ex_zh: 主治医生要求术后患者尝试在无人协助的情况下自主排尿。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on mild, polite, and colloquial verbs describing the standard bodily function of relieving one's bladder, distinguishing formal, clinical, and idiomatic euphemisms.
groups.summary_zh: 描述解小便的生理动作，涵盖中性日常词、委婉表达与医学词汇。
groups.desc_en: Excreting urine from the body, differentiated across formal, clinical, and colloquial registers.
groups.desc_zh: 排出体内尿液，微差主要体现在临床、正式与口语等语体色彩上。
groups.nuance_en: urinate: clinical and formal physiological term (patient / frequently / specimen) · pass water: polite, slightly dated euphemism (difficulty / naturally) · pee: neutral, everyday informal term (bed / pants / bushes) · piss: coarse, vulgar slang (toilet / street / pants) · wee-wee: childish baby-talk register (potty / bed / toddler)
groups.nuance_zh: urinate: 临床及正式医学用语 (patient / frequently / specimen) · pass water: 委婉略带陈旧的礼貌用语 (difficulty / naturally) · pee: 日常中性口语 (bed / pants / bushes) · piss: 粗俗俚语 (toilet / street / pants) · wee-wee: 儿语或幼童语体 (potty / bed / toddler)

groups.name: Passage of Time · 时间流逝与过去 (Slip by, Tick away, Wear on)
groups.tip: 时间悄悄流走逝去

items.def_en: To pass quickly, quietly, and often unnoticed
items.ex_en: We were so absorbed in conversation that two whole hours managed to slip by.
items.ex_zh: 我们聊得过于投入，以至于不知不觉间整整两个小时悄然溜走了。

items.def_en: To continue steadily and relentlessly forward as time advances
items.ex_en: Though grief lingered heavily in their hearts, the indifferent seasons continued to roll on.
items.ex_zh: 尽管悲伤沉重地萦绕心头，漠然的岁月依然滚滚向前流转。

items.def_en: To pass steadily and audibly second by second, especially when counted down toward a deadline
items.ex_en: Anxious applicants watched the clock tick away while waiting for their interview results.
items.ex_zh: 焦虑的应聘者一边等待面试结果，一边眼睁睁看着时间分秒流逝。

items.def_en: To pass slowly, tediously, or wearily, as of a long day, season, or night
items.ex_en: As the dull, rainy afternoon continued to wear on, boredom grew unbearable.
items.ex_zh: 随着那个阴雨沉闷的下午漫长而难熬地消磨着，无聊感变得令人难以忍受。

items.def_en: (formal) (of time) to pass or slip by
items.ex_en: Several fraught weeks had to elapse before forensic analysts confirmed the victim's identity.
items.ex_zh: 数周焦灼的时光流逝过去，法医分析人员才最终证实了受害者的身份。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame capture the inexorable passage or sliding away of temporal intervals, whether swift, imperceptible, or painfully protracted.
groups.summary_zh: 指光阴、时限或岁月不知不觉或沉闷缓慢地逝去。
groups.desc_en: The continuous, inexorable progression of time conceived as flow, measurement, or endurance.
groups.desc_zh: 时间不可逆转地持续流逝，侧重于无声流逝、机械计时或漫长煎熬等认知视角。
groups.nuance_en: elapse: formal, objective passage of a defined duration (years / time / period) · slip by: quiet, unnoticed, or fleeting passage (hours / opportunity / youth) · tick away: mechanical, anxiety-inducing countdown (clock / seconds / minutes) · wear on: tedious, painfully slow dragging of time (afternoon / night / winter) · roll on: steady, inexorable forward march of seasons or eras (months / years / seasons)
groups.nuance_zh: elapse: 正式客观的时间段流逝 (years / time / period) · slip by: 悄无声息或飞快地溜走 (hours / opportunity / youth) · tick away: 机械倒计时且常带紧迫感 (clock / seconds / minutes) · wear on: 漫长、乏味而难熬地拖延 (afternoon / night / winter) · roll on: 季节或岁月不可阻挡地滚滚向前 (months / years / seasons)

groups.name: Patch & Piece Together · 拼凑与修补 (Piece, Patch, Cobble together)
groups.tip: 用零碎布片补缀或拼整原形

items.def_en: To repair a tear, leak, or damage hastily or temporarily by covering it with a patch
items.ex_en: The plumber used waterproof tape to patch up the burst garden hose temporarily.
items.ex_zh: 水管工用防水胶带临时将爆裂的花园软管勉强缝补修好。

items.def_en: To join separate parts or pieces together to make a whole; to repair by patching
items.ex_en: She patiently tried to piece the torn family photographs back together with tape.
items.ex_zh: 她耐心地尝试用胶带将那些撕碎的家庭老照片拼凑修补起来。

items.def_en: To assemble something quickly and roughly from whatever disparate materials or parts are available
items.ex_en: The desperate committee tried to cobble together a compromise bill overnight from drafts.
items.ex_zh: 走投无路的委员会连夜从零散草案中草草拼凑出一份折中方案。

items.def_en: To assemble separate parts, details, or clues to recreate a whole object, narrative, or truth
items.ex_en: Detectives worked tirelessly around the clock to piece together the suspect's movements.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们夜以继日地不懈工作，以拼凑还原出嫌疑人的行动轨迹。

items.def_en: To join different pieces of fabric by stitching, or figuratively assemble distinct factions or ideas
items.ex_en: Diplomats worked tirelessly to stitch together an uneasy coalition between rival regional factions.
items.ex_zh: 外交官们不知疲倦地斡旋，将互相对立的地区派系勉强缝合成一个脆弱联盟。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame capture the physical or figurative act of assembling fragmented, disparate, or makeshift items to reconstruct a workable whole.
groups.summary_zh: 指用零碎材料拼凑组装、粗糙缝补或凑成整体。
groups.desc_en: Assembling disparate, fragmentary, or makeshift elements into a functional whole rather than manufacturing anew.
groups.desc_zh: 将零散、残缺或手头的部件凑整修补成可用整体，强调临时性或拼凑感。
groups.nuance_en: piece together: systematically reconstructing clues or fragments into a coherent whole (evidence / story / puzzle) · cobble together: quickly improvising from whatever materials are available (deal / coalition / solution) · patch up: hastily mending damage or repairing strained relations (wound / quarrel / relationship) · stitch together: loosely uniting disparate parts or factions (coalition / narrative / majority)
groups.nuance_zh: piece together: 系统性搜集碎片拼合全貌 (evidence / story / puzzle) · cobble together: 用手头现成材料草草拼凑 (deal / coalition / solution) · patch up: 快速打补丁修补损伤或关系 (wound / quarrel / relationship) · stitch together: 勉强将分散派系或要素缝合在一起 (coalition / narrative / majority)

groups.name: Patrol & Guard · 巡视与巡逻 (Prowl, Police, Walk the beat)
groups.tip: 按路线巡查警戒

items.def_en: to maintain law and order in an area, or to enforce regulations and check for non-compliance
items.ex_en: Local authorities deployed extra patrol units to police the rowdy carnival streets effectively.
items.ex_zh: 地方当局部署了额外的巡逻队伍，以有效维护狂欢节嘈杂街区的治安。

items.def_en: to go regularly around an area to maintain security, keep order, or inspect it.
items.ex_en: Armed guards patrol the perimeter fence every hour to maintain strict site security.
items.ex_zh: 武装警卫每小时在周界围栏巡逻一次，以保持严格的现场安全。

items.def_en: to explore or reconnoiter an area in advance to observe conditions, threats, or locations
items.ex_en: The advance team went ahead to scout the narrow canyon for potential ambushes.
items.ex_zh: 先遣队提前出发，巡查狭窄的峡谷以防潜在伏击。

items.def_en: to patrol an assigned regular route or neighborhood on foot to monitor safety
items.ex_en: Officer Davis has walked the downtown beat for over ten years now.
items.ex_zh: 戴维斯警官在市中心片区步行巡逻已经超过十年了。

items.def_en: to move stealthily or restlessly around an area in search of prey, intruders, or illicit activity
items.ex_en: A hungry leopard began to prowl the edges of the village after nightfall.
items.ex_zh: 夜幕降临后，一只饥饿的豹子开始在村落边缘潜行游弋。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on traversing a perimeter, territory, or district repeatedly to prevent crime, safeguard security, enforce order, or detect danger.
groups.summary_zh: 指在特定防区或管界内按规程走动巡查，以维持治安与防范险情。
groups.desc_en: Systematically traversing an area to deter wrongdoing, ensure security, or hunt, distinguished by authority and intent.
groups.desc_zh: 在指定区域内按路线巡行以维稳防范或搜猎，依巡逻权限与意图产生微差。
groups.nuance_en: patrol: routine systematic monitoring for protection and deterrence (border / streets / perimeter) · police: maintaining law, order, and regulatory compliance (community / force / industry) · scout: exploratory reconnaissance to gather information (area / talent / location) · walk the beat: traditional foot patrol by an officer (officer / neighborhood / district) · prowl: stealthy, predatory, or furtive roving (predator / streets / burglar)
groups.nuance_zh: patrol: 常规周期性巡视戒备 (border / streets / perimeter) · police: 执行治安与秩序管控 (community / force / industry) · scout: 搜集情报的前哨侦察 (area / talent / location) · walk the beat: 警察划片步行巡查 (officer / neighborhood / district) · prowl: 潜行窥伺或图谋不轨地游荡 (predator / streets / burglar)

groups.name: Pattern & Model · 依样塑形与仿模 (Model, Shape, Tailor)
groups.tip: 依照样板参考仿制模仿

items.def_zh: 模仿，仿效，仿造；用图案装饰；形成图案
items.def_en: To design, model, or form something according to a particular pattern or plan.
items.ex_en: They patterned their new educational curriculum on successful methods used across Scandinavia.
items.ex_zh: 他们仿照斯堪的纳维亚半岛各国的成功经验设计了新课程。

items.def_en: Adapt or modify something to fit a specific blueprint or distinct requirement
items.ex_en: We can tailor the software package to satisfy your company's precise logistical requirements.
items.ex_zh: 我们可以量身定制该软件包，以满足贵公司精准的物流需求。

items.def_en: (+ on/after) Design, create, or structure something following a recognized exemplar
items.ex_en: The young entrepreneur modeled her business strategy on classical Silicon Valley growth principles.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻的创业者以经典的硅谷成长法则为榜样构建了自己的商业策略。

items.def_en: Form an object or conceptual entity within a preformed mold or template
items.ex_en: The bronze monument was expertly cast in a traditional foundry outside the city.
items.ex_zh: 这座青铜纪念碑是在城外一家传统铸造厂中精心浇铸而成的。

items.def_en: Influence or shape the character or form of something according to a design
items.ex_en: Dedicated mentors helped mold the ambitious student into an exceptional scientific researcher.
items.ex_zh: 敬业的导师们帮助将这位志向远大的学生塑造成出色的科研人员。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here emphasize constructing, configuring, or designing something explicitly based on an established prototype, blueprint, or paradigm. 'Pattern' and 'model' involve deliberate structural alignment with an exemplar.
groups.summary_zh: 指依据既定模板、样本或蓝图进行造型与设计。
groups.desc_en: Shaping, designing, or tailoring an entity in deliberate emulation of an archetype, template, or custom specification.
groups.desc_zh: 依据特定原型、模具或定制规格进行塑形、仿造或剪裁。
