groups.nuance_en: model: structuring or basing something directly on an exemplar (system / behavior / economy) · pattern: adopting the structural features or design of an established prototype (life / career / dress) · tailor: strategically adapting or customizing for a specific recipient (program / policy / suit) · mold: exerting deep influence to shape character or malleable form (opinion / clay / generation) · cast: pouring or solidifying into a rigid form or predetermined role (metal / die / actor)
groups.nuance_zh: model: 以范例为样板进行模仿建构 (system / behavior / economy) · pattern: 沿袭既定范式的结构或花样 (life / career / dress) · tailor: 针对特定需求进行量体裁衣式调整 (program / policy / suit) · mold: 塑造可塑性实物或深度塑造品格观念 (opinion / clay / generation) · cast: 浇铸定型或选派固定角色 (metal / die / actor)

groups.name: Pave & Surface · 铺设与铺筑 (Pave, Cobble, Flag)
groups.tip: 在物体表面铺垫或镀层

items.def_en: To apply a top layer such as asphalt, tar, or concrete to a road, court, or area to make it smooth and durable
items.ex_en: Workers arrived early this morning to surface the newly extended highway with asphalt.
items.ex_zh: 工人们今天一早就赶来，用沥青给新扩建的高速公路铺设面层。

items.def_en: To pave an area or walkway with large, flat slabs of stone (flagstones)
items.ex_en: The landscape contractor chose to flag the garden pathway with local grey slate.
items.ex_zh: 景观承包商选择用当地的灰色石板铺砌花园小径。

items.def_en: To cover a road, driveway, or airfield runway with tarmac or asphalt
items.ex_en: The municipal council voted to tarmac the gravel driveway leading to the school.
items.ex_zh: 市政委员会投票决定用柏油碎石铺设通往学校的碎石车道。

items.def_en: To pave a street or pathway with rounded cobblestones
items.ex_en: Masons worked for months to cobble the historic district's winding pedestrian alleys.
items.ex_zh: 石匠们劳作数月，用鹅卵石铺就了历史街区蜿蜒的步行巷道。

items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To cover a road, path, or surface with flat stones, bricks, or concrete to make it firm and level.
items.ex_en: They paved the entire courtyard with red bricks to match the surrounding architecture.
items.ex_zh: 他们用红砖铺砌了整个庭院，以契合周边的建筑风格。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe covering the ground or an outdoor pathway with durable materials like stone, brick, asphalt, or concrete to create a firm, even surface. Nuances distinguish between traditional stone-setting, mechanical surfacing, and modern roadwork.
groups.summary_zh: 指用石块、沥青或砖石铺砌道路或地表以使其平整坚固。
groups.desc_en: Laying down a hard, protective, or decorative surface coating over ground or infrastructure.
groups.desc_zh: 在地面或基础设施表面铺设坚硬、平整或装饰性的面层材料。
groups.nuance_en: pave: laying stones, asphalt, or concrete to create a smooth thoroughfare (street / courtyard / driveway) · surface: broadly applying an exterior top layer (road / runway / table) · tarmac: surfacing specifically with crushed stone and tar/bitumen (road / runway / apron) · cobble: paving with rounded, traditional natural cobblestones (lane / alley / street) · flag: paving flat stone slabs for pedestrian surfaces (path / patio / terrace)
groups.nuance_zh: pave: 铺设石块、沥青或水泥路面 (street / courtyard / driveway) · surface: 广义铺设或覆以表层 (road / runway / table) · tarmac: 铺筑柏油碎石路面 (road / runway / apron) · cobble: 用传统鹅卵石或粗石块铺砌 (lane / alley / street) · flag: 用平整石板铺路 (path / patio / terrace)

groups.name: Paw & Scrape · 抓挠与刨抓 (Paw, Scrape, Scratch)
groups.tip: 爪掌扒拉抓挠表面

items.def_zh: 用爪子轻扒，毛手毛脚抓取
items.def_en: To touch or scrape repeatedly with paws or clumsy, unwelcome hands
items.ex_en: The anxious dog began to paw at the closed bedroom door early morning.
items.ex_zh: 清晨，那只焦躁的狗开始用爪子抓扒紧闭的卧室门。

items.def_en: To rub or scrape the skin or a surface with claws, nails, or a rough implement
items.ex_en: Be careful not to scratch the polished wooden dining table with that sharp key.
items.ex_zh: 小心别用那把锋利的钥匙划伤抛光的木质餐桌表面。
items.ex2_en: Soft plastic phone screens scratch easily if stored alongside sharp metallic house keys.
items.ex2_zh: 柔软的塑料手机屏幕如果与锋利的金属家门钥匙放在一起很容易刮花。

items.def_zh: （用爪子）抓挠，扒；（笨拙地）乱摸，拉扯
items.def_en: 1. To scrape, touch, or strike something with a paw or hoof. 2. To touch or handle someone roughly, clumsily, or inappropriately.
items.ex_en: The drunken customer was immediately thrown out after trying to paw the young bartender.
items.ex_zh: 那个醉酒的顾客在企图对年轻的调酒师动手动脚后立刻被轰了出去。

items.def_en: To drag a hard or sharp object forcefully along a surface, abrading it or making a grating sound
items.ex_en: Heavy iron chairs began to scrape loudly across the tiled floor during lunch.
items.ex_zh: 午餐期间，沉重的铁椅在瓷砖地面上刮蹭出刺耳的声响。

items.def_en: To feel about clumsily or touch someone intimately without their consent in an unwanted way
items.ex_en: She panicked when a total stranger tried to grope her on the crowded subway.
items.ex_zh: 在拥挤的地铁上，当一个陌生人企图咸猪手乱摸她时，她慌乱不已。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers touching, raking, or striking surfaces repeatedly using animal paws, hooves, or blunt, clumsy hands.
groups.summary_zh: 用爪蹄或笨拙的手掌抓挠、刨地或毛手毛脚地触碰。
groups.desc_en: Scratching, raking, or fumbling contact using claws, paws, or awkward hands, ranging from animal behavior to clumsy groping.
groups.desc_zh: 用爪子或笨拙的双手进行刮蹭、抓挠或摸索，涵盖动物刨地到人类无礼抚弄。
groups.nuance_en: paw: animal raking with feet, or clumsy/unwelcome human touching (ground / shoulder / dress) · paw at: repeatedly striking or fumbling against a surface (door / clothes / face) · scrape: dragging a hard or sharp edge forcefully across a surface (skin / pan / boot) · scratch: lightly abrading with sharp claws or nails to relieve itch or mark (itch / surface / head) · grope: clumsy, disoriented, or illicitly invasive searching with hands (dark / body / pocket)
groups.nuance_zh: paw: 动物刨抓，或人类笨拙/不敬的拉扯抚弄 (ground / shoulder / dress) · paw at: 反复抓蹭或乱摸某处 (door / clothes / face) · scrape: 用硬物或指甲重重刮擦表面 (skin / pan / boot) · scratch: 用尖爪或指甲轻抓止痒或留痕 (itch / surface / head) · grope: 摸黑搜寻，或不体面的猥亵摸索 (dark / body / pocket)

groups.name: Pay Off & Amortize · 清偿与摊销 (Amortize, Liquidate, Redeem)
groups.tip: 按期分摊清偿贷款本息

items.def_en: To make regular scheduled interest and principal payments on an outstanding debt.
items.ex_en: The expanding company generates sufficient cash flow to comfortably service its long-term corporate debt.
items.ex_zh: 这家扩张中的公司产生了充足的现金流，足以轻松偿付其长期企业债务的本息。

items.def_en: To pay the entire remaining balance of a debt or loan so that nothing more is owed.
items.ex_en: It took ten years of relentless saving to finally pay off their mortgage.
items.ex_zh: 经过十年的不懈积攒，他们终于彻底还清了房屋抵押贷款。

items.def_en: To fulfill completely and relieve oneself of a financial or legal obligation or liability.
items.ex_en: The bankrupt company successfully liquidated assets to discharge its remaining statutory financial obligations.
items.ex_zh: 破产公司成功清算资产，履行并清偿了剩余的法定财务债务。

items.def_en: To pay off a loan, mortgage, bond, or pledged security in exchange for receiving title or freedom from obligation.
items.ex_en: The corporation plans to redeem the high-yield bonds before the next fiscal quarter.
items.ex_zh: 该企业计划在下一财季之前全额赎回这批高收益债券。

items.def_zh: 分期偿还（债务）；摊销（资产成本）
items.def_en: To gradually pay off a debt or spread the cost of an intangible asset over a fixed period through regular payments.
items.ex_en: The borrower chose to amortize the substantial commercial loan over twenty-five equal installments.
items.ex_zh: 借款人选择将这笔巨额商业贷款分二十五期等额偿还。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this financial frame denote discharging liabilities, settling debts systematically, or writing down capital expenditures over an agreed schedule. They contrast piecemeal installments against full, final clearance.
groups.summary_zh: 指按计划或协议逐步分期偿还债务、分摊资产成本或一次性清结。
groups.desc_en: Settling, clearing, or progressively expunging financial liabilities through structured payment or liquidation.
groups.desc_zh: 通过按期偿付、资金冲账或清算来彻底免除债务与金融负债。
groups.nuance_en: pay off: completely eliminating a debt, or bribing a party (loan / mortgage / official) · amortize: gradually writing off or expensing debt/assets over a fixed schedule (loan / cost / debt) · service: making regular ongoing interest and capital payments on debt (debt / loan / liability) · redeem: buying back an obligation, bond, or pledged item to clear it (pledge / voucher / bond) · discharge: legally releasing oneself from debt or obligation via completion (bankruptcy / liability / duty)
groups.nuance_zh: pay off: 彻底还清债务，或行贿买通 (loan / mortgage / official) · amortize: 依分期摊销计划分批冲账减债 (loan / cost / debt) · service: 按期支付债务的利息与本金 (debt / loan / liability) · redeem: 赎回债券、抵押物或履行承诺 (pledge / voucher / bond) · discharge: 依法解除清偿债务或责任 (bankruptcy / liability / duty)

groups.name: Peak & Summit · 登顶与征服顶峰 (Summit, Peak, Conquer)
groups.tip: 向上攀爬直至顶峰

items.def_en: Reach the very summit or peak of a mountain, ridge, or climbing pitch
items.ex_en: The exhausted climbers finally topped out just as the morning sun broke through.
items.ex_zh: 筋疲力竭的登山者终于在晨光破晓之际成功攀至山顶。

items.def_en: Ascend all the way up a steep elevation to its highest reach
items.ex_en: A team of daring mountaineers managed to scale the perilous northern cliff face.
items.ex_zh: 一支无畏的登山队成功登临了危险陡峭的北侧绝壁之顶。

items.def_en: Reach the top of a hill, ridge, wave, or mountain peak
items.ex_en: We watched the weary riders crest the windy hill against the setting sun.
items.ex_zh: 我们看着疲惫的骑手们迎着落日登上了那座多风的山脊顶端。

items.def_en: 1. To reach the summit or peak of a mountain.
items.ex_en: After weeks of intense acclimatization, the expedition successfully summited the towering Himalayan peak.
items.ex_zh: 经过数周艰苦的气候适应，探险队成功登顶了那座巍峨的喜马拉雅高峰。

items.def_en: Succeed in climbing to the summit of a challenging or dangerous mountain
items.ex_en: Few elite climbers have dared to conquer this notoriously treacherous alpine rock wall.
items.ex_zh: 鲜有顶尖攀登者敢于征服这面臭名昭著的险峻高山岩壁。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on successfully reaching the absolute crest or highest peak of a mountain or altitude barrier, conveying achievement, culmination, and altitude progression.
groups.summary_zh: 指经过艰难攀爬最终登上山巅、征服顶峰的顶点动作。
groups.desc_en: Ascending to and arriving at the highest geological or figurative point of achievement.
groups.desc_zh: 攀登并到达地理最高峰，或在象征意义上攀抵成就极点。
groups.nuance_en: summit: reaching the highest geographic crest, especially in mountaineering (Everest / mountain / peak) · crest: reaching the ridge or highest curve before descending (hill / wave / ridge) · scale: physically climbing a steep obstacle or peak (mountain / wall / heights) · top out: reaching a plateau, upper structural limit, or peak price (building / market / height) · conquer: subduing a challenging mountain or summit through grit (Everest / peak / fears)
groups.nuance_zh: summit: 成功登顶高山顶峰 (Everest / mountain / peak) · crest: 越过山脊或浪尖最高处 (hill / wave / ridge) · scale: 费力攀越陡峭的高峰或壁面 (mountain / wall / heights) · top out: 封顶、达至最高价格或停止上涨 (building / market / height) · conquer: 征服险峻山峰或克服难关 (Everest / peak / fears)

groups.name: Peck & Dab · 啄食与轻击 (Peck, Dab, Tap)
groups.tip: 用喙或硬物轻快击打

items.def_en: To press or touch lightly and swiftly against a surface
items.ex_en: Gently dab the damp sponge over the stained fabric to absorb excess moisture.
items.ex_zh: 用湿海绵在污损的织物上轻轻按拭，以吸干多余的水分。

items.def_en: To work gradually and persistently on a task in small, piecemeal increments
items.ex_en: I try to peck away at my dissertation draft for an hour every night.
items.ex_zh: 我每天晚上都抽出一小时慢慢啃下我的毕业论文初稿。

items.def_en: To strike lightly and repeatedly with a quick, rhythmic movement
items.ex_en: Nervous students often tap their pens against the desks during major exams.
items.ex_zh: 紧张的学生在重大考试期间常常用笔有节奏地轻敲桌面。

items.def_en: To jab or prod sharply with a finger, stick, or pointed implement
items.ex_en: Do not poke that slumbering watchdog with your dry hiking stick.
items.ex_zh: 不要用你那根干燥的登山杖去捅那只沉睡的看门狗。

items.def_en: 1. (+ at) To strike, bite, or pick up something with a beak. 2. To kiss someone quickly and lightly.
items.ex_en: The mother robin flew down to peck at breadcrumbs scattered across the lawn.
items.ex_zh: 知更鸟妈妈飞落下来，啄食散落在草坪上的面包碎屑。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here delineate short, pointed, strike-like contacts characteristic of bird beaks or rapid finger prods, extending naturally to hurried, slight kisses.
groups.summary_zh: 表示类似鸟喙啄食的短促轻敲、轻戳动作，亦指轻吻。
groups.desc_en: Executing brief, sharp, pointed downward contacts, from avian feeding to light human probing.
groups.desc_zh: 进行短促、尖锐的下向敲击，涵盖鸟类啄食到人类轻触刺探。
groups.nuance_en: peck: sharp rapid strike with a beak, or a brisk dry kiss (beak / grain / cheek) · dab: applying light, quick, gentle touches with a soft surface (sponge / paint / tears) · tap: making a light, crisp, rhythmic percussive contact (finger / shoulder / foot) · poke: thrusting a pointed object or finger sharply into something (ribs / fire / hole) · peck away at: persisting intermittently on a tedious, incremental task (work / manuscript / problem)
groups.nuance_zh: peck: 喙部啄食，或迅速轻吻 (beak / grain / cheek) · dab: 用柔软物轻按轻蘸 (sponge / paint / tears) · tap: 清脆短促有节奏地轻叩 (finger / shoulder / foot) · poke: 用手指或尖端物体戳刺 (ribs / fire / hole) · peck away at: 断断续续、细碎地磨完繁重工作 (work / manuscript / problem)

groups.name: Peel & Flake · 脱落与剥落 (Peel, Chip, Scale)
groups.tip: 表层风化成薄片剥离脱落

items.def_en: (+ off) To come off a surface in dry, scalelike pieces or coatings
items.ex_en: Old layers of paint began to scale off the weathered porch banister.
items.ex_zh: 风化廊柱扶手上的老旧漆层开始成鳞片状剥落。

items.def_en: (+ off/away) To lose skin, paint, or an outer layer in strips or thin sheets
items.ex_en: Severe sunburn caused the damaged skin on his broad shoulders to peel off.
items.ex_zh: 严重的晒伤导致他宽阔肩膀上受损的皮肤成片剥落。
items.ex2_en: The painter peeled the old wallpaper away from the bedroom wall.
items.ex2_zh: 粉刷工把卧室墙上的旧壁纸剥了下来。

items.def_zh: 剥落，成片脱落；使成薄片
items.def_en: 1. (+ off/away) to fall off in small, thin layers or pieces (such as paint, rust, or dry skin) 2. to break or cut something into small, thin slices or pieces
items.ex_en: Moisture inside the concrete caused the exterior stucco finish to flake away entirely.
items.ex_zh: 混凝土内部的湿气导致外墙抹灰层彻底剥落成碎片。
items.ex2_en: The harsh winter frost flaked the brittle stone surface of the monument.
items.ex2_zh: 严酷的冬霜使纪念碑易碎的石质表面脱落剥离。

items.def_en: To cast off dead skin or an unwanted outer layer naturally
items.ex_en: As the reptile grew larger, it would routinely slough off its outer skin.
items.ex_zh: 随着爬行动物体型渐长，它会定期蜕去外层死皮。
items.ex2_en: Old dead skin sloughs off naturally during the regular cellular renewal process.
items.ex2_zh: 老化坏死的角质在正常的细胞更新过程中自然脱落。

items.def_en: To lose small fragments or pieces from the edge or surface through a knock or decay
items.ex_en: The delicate porcelain mug began to chip after years of frequent everyday washing.
items.ex_zh: 经过多年频繁的日常洗涤，这个精致的瓷杯边缘开始出现碎裂剥落。
items.ex2_en: The clumsy mover chipped the corner of the polished marble countertop.
items.ex2_zh: 笨手笨脚的搬运工把光滑的大理石台面一角磕掉了一块。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail surfaces shedding dry layers, skin, coating, or fragments bit by bit through weathering, dryness, or physical damage.
groups.summary_zh: 指表层物质、漆皮或死皮逐渐翘起、剥落或成片掉落。
groups.desc_en: Progressive detachment and separation of a thin surface layer, coat, or outer skin.
groups.desc_zh: 表面薄层、涂料或表皮发生渐进式松动与剥除脱落。
groups.nuance_en: peel: continuous strip-like separation of skin or coating (skin / paint / wallpaper) · flake: breaking away in small, fragile, dry scales or flecks (paint / pastry / skin) · chip: losing tiny, hard, sharp fragments upon impact (mug / paint / stone) · scale: forming and shedding crusty, hard laminations (rust / fish / skin) · slough off: biologically casting off dead tissue, or discarding burdens (skin / tissue / image)
groups.nuance_zh: peel: 表皮或涂层整片剥离 (skin / paint / wallpaper) · flake: 干燥细小的片状碎屑掉落 (paint / pastry / skin) · chip: 受磕碰掉落坚硬小碎片 (mug / paint / stone) · scale: 结硬壳并层状脱落 (rust / fish / skin) · slough off: 生理脱落死皮组织，或甩掉负赘 (skin / tissue / image)

groups.name: Pension & Retire · 退休供养与遣散 (Superannuate, Retire, Sever)
groups.tip: 官方或机构拨发补贴

items.def_en: Cause someone to stop working, typically granting customary retirement benefits
items.ex_en: The manufacturing plant decided to retire several aging assembly workers ahead of schedule.
items.ex_zh: 该制造厂决定让几位年事已高的装配工人提前办理退休离职。

items.def_zh: 发给养老金；发退休金让……退休
items.def_en: 1. To grant or pay a pension to someone. 2. ('pension off') To dismiss or retire someone and pay them a regular pension.
items.ex_en: The board resolved to pension off the veteran manager with full lifetime benefits.
items.ex_zh: 董事会决定向这位资深经理发放足额终身津贴，劝其退休离岗。

items.def_en: Retire an employee with a pension, especially on grounds of age or infirmity
items.ex_en: The university moved to superannuate three senior professors facing persistent health issues.
items.ex_zh: 大学决定令三名长期身体抱恙的资深教授领取退休金离岗休养。

items.def_en: Pay an employee or executive an agreed lump sum to terminate their employment contract
items.ex_en: The struggling tech firm offered to buy out executive contracts during the restructuring.
items.ex_zh: 这家陷入困境的科技公司在重组期间提出出资买断高管合同。

items.def_en: Grant someone a generous severance payment when they leave an executive post
items.ex_en: The board decided to golden-handshake the ousted CEO to prevent a messy legal battle.
items.ex_zh: 董事会决定向被罢免的首席执行官发放优厚遣散金，以防引发棘手的官司。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here denote releasing someone from service accompanied by regular income, pension disbursements, or structured severance allowances.
groups.summary_zh: 指随附定期年金、退休金或遣散费用的解职与赡养安排。
groups.desc_en: Terminating an employee's service due to age, tenure, or redundancy, backed by financial settlement.
groups.desc_zh: 因年龄、工龄或裁员而终止劳动合同并给予退休金或遣散金。
groups.nuance_en: retire: general cessation of working life due to age (job / workforce / position) · pension: providing a periodic post-retirement stipend to an employee (off / worker / veteran) · superannuate: discharging an employee as outdated or past the statutory age (official / employee / fleet) · buy out: terminating a contract early via a negotiated lump-sum payout (executive / contract / partner) · golden-handshake: dismissing an executive with a lavish severance package (executive / director / board)
groups.nuance_zh: retire: 正常到龄退休 (job / workforce / position) · pension: 发放退休金供养 (off / worker / veteran) · superannuate: 因超龄或陈旧而令其退役遣散 (official / employee / fleet) · buy out: 协商买断工龄或提前解约 (executive / contract / partner) · golden-handshake: 高层离职时给予丰厚离职金 (executive / director / board)

groups.name: Perch & Settle · 栖息与歇足 (Roost, Perch, Alight)
groups.tip: 禽鸟在树枝或横木上落脚安歇

items.def_en: (+ on / upon) To land and come to rest securely on a spot after movement
items.ex_en: A flock of tired migratory birds began to settle on the calm waters.
items.ex_zh: 一群疲倦的候鸟开始在平静的水面上停落安歇。

items.def_en: To squat close to the ground or settle into a sheltered, protective posture for rest
items.ex_en: The frightened hikers had to hunker down inside the cave until morning.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的徒步者们只得在洞穴内蜷缩蛰伏，直至天明。

items.def_en: (+ on / atop) To alight or sit on a high, narrow, or precarious resting place
items.ex_en: A solitary bald eagle liked to perch atop the jagged granite cliff edge.
items.ex_zh: 一只孤独的白头海雕喜欢栖息在那座嶙峋的花岗岩悬崖边缘。
items.ex2_en: The boy perched the model airplane carefully on the high bookshelf.
items.ex2_zh: 男孩小心翼翼地把模型飞机安置在最高的那层书架上。

items.def_en: When birds or bats roost, they settle on a branch or in a shelter to rest or sleep.
items.ex_en: Hundreds of brown bats roost together in the dark abandoned mine every winter.
items.ex_zh: 每年冬天，成百上千只棕蝙蝠都会在废弃的阴暗矿井中结群栖宿。

items.def_en: (+ on / upon) To descend from the air and gently land or settle on a surface
items.ex_en: The radiant butterfly gracefully alighted upon the vibrant yellow sunflower petal.
items.ex_zh: 那只光彩夺目的蝴蝶轻盈地飞落栖止在鲜黄的向日葵花瓣上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe landing, settling down, or perching precariously or temporarily upon a branch, elevated ledge, or resting spot, especially of birds, winged creatures, or people sitting high up.
groups.summary_zh: 指鸟兽落在高处枝条停歇，或人居高悬坐、暂时落脚停留。
groups.desc_en: Coming to rest on a small, elevated, or temporary base, balancing rather than lying flat.
groups.desc_zh: 落居或休歇于高处、狭小支点上，强调平衡姿态而非平躺平卧。
groups.nuance_en: perch: balancing atop a narrow, high, or precarious position (branch / stool / ledge) · roost: birds settling down specifically for overnight sleep (poultry / bird / flock) · alight: gently landing after flight or descent (bird / butterfly / ground) · settle: gradually establishing oneself comfortably in a place (chair / dust / city) · hunker down: crouching low for physical shelter or protracted endurance (bunker / winter / position)
groups.nuance_zh: perch: 栖于或坐于狭窄高处保持平衡 (branch / stool / ledge) · roost: 禽鸟夜间归巢歇宿 (poultry / bird / flock) · alight: 飞翔或下降后轻盈停落 (bird / butterfly / ground) · settle: 安顿就座或尘埃落定 (chair / dust / city) · hunker down: 蹲伏隐蔽或坚守抗困 (bunker / winter / position)

groups.name: Perforate & Punch Holes · 打孔与穿孔撕裂 (Perforate, Punch, Riddle, Puncture)
groups.tip: 刺透破孔，分解隔断形体

items.def_en: To cut or press clean circular holes in paper, metal, or leather with a specific tool
items.ex_en: The clerk had to punch uniform binder holes along the side of documents.
items.ex_zh: 文员必须在文件边缘打出一排整齐的活页装订孔。

items.def_en: To make tiny holes in a surface using a needle, fork, or sharp tip
items.ex_en: The baker used a slender fork to prick small vents across the dough.
items.ex_zh: 面包师用细叉在面团表面刺出细密的小孔以供透气。

items.def_zh: 刺破；戳穿（使漏气或破裂）
items.def_en: To make a small hole in something with a sharp point, compromising its seal
items.ex_en: A stray roofing nail managed to puncture the right rear tire of my car.
items.ex_zh: 一枚脱落的屋顶道钉扎破了我汽车的右后轮胎导致漏气。
items.ex2_en: The bicycle inner tube punctured easily on the sharp gravel road.
items.ex2_zh: 自行车的内胎在锋利的碎石路上很容易被扎破。

items.def_zh: 打孔于，在……上穿孔；穿透，刺穿
items.def_en: To make a row of small holes in something so it can be torn easily, or to pierce completely through a surface.
items.ex_en: Machines perforate the sheets of postage stamps to make them easy to tear.
items.ex_zh: 机器在整张邮票之间打上密密麻麻的小孔，以便于撕开。

items.def_zh: 打得满是孔洞；使千疮百孔
items.def_en: To pierce something with numerous holes, typically through gunfire, shrapnel, or rot
items.ex_en: Intense enemy machine-gun fire threatened to riddle the abandoned brick guardhouse completely.
items.ex_zh: 敌军密集的机枪火力几乎要将那座废弃的砖砌哨所打得千疮百孔。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on creating rows or clusters of small openings or penetrating through a barrier with sharp tools or projectiles, often to weaken a seam or riddle an object with apertures.
groups.summary_zh: 用尖锐器物或冲具打穿一系列小孔，使之贯通或便于沿虚线撕开。
groups.desc_en: Creating a deliberate hole, aperture, or dotted line of piercings through a material.
groups.desc_zh: 对材料进行有意穿刺，制造单孔、孔洞排列或细微孔眼。
groups.nuance_en: perforate: piercing a line of tiny, patterned holes to facilitate tearing (paper / sheet / intestine) · punch: driving a tool through a material to cut a clean, round hole (ticket / hole / card) · puncture: creating a sharp piercing that causes leakage or deflation (tire / balloon / lung) · prick: making a shallow, sharp pinhole prick into flesh or fabric (finger / bubble / skin) · riddle: piercing extensively with numerous holes, often by shot (bullet / holes / controversy)
groups.nuance_zh: perforate: 打出一排易撕细孔或器官穿孔 (paper / sheet / intestine) · punch: 用工具冲裁出干净孔眼 (ticket / hole / card) · puncture: 尖锐物戳破导致漏气或泄露 (tire / balloon / lung) · prick: 针状微刺造成微孔 (finger / bubble / skin) · riddle: 密集洞穿，多指被子弹打得千疮百孔 (bullet / holes / controversy)

groups.name: Perforating Heavily · 弹孔密布与穿孔破坏 (Pepper, Perforate, Shot-through)
groups.tip: 打出孔洞使之千疮百孔

items.def_en: Pierce or breach a surface to break its containment
items.ex_en: Sharp coral reefs can easily puncture the rubber skin of an inflatable dinghy.
items.ex_zh: 尖锐的珊瑚礁很容易刺破充气橡皮艇的外皮使其破裂漏气。
items.ex2_en: The delicate rubber balloon punctured unexpectedly on the spiky cactus plant.
items.ex2_zh: 娇嫩的橡胶气球在多刺的仙人掌上意外扎破了。

items.def_en: Make a series of holes or cuts in something, often in a line or pattern
items.ex_en: Specialized needles perforate the leather hide along precise stitch patterns during luxury production.
items.ex_zh: 在奢侈品生产中，专用机针按精确的线迹在皮革上冲出一排小孔。

items.def_zh: 连环射击；密密麻麻击打
items.def_en: Hit repeatedly with rapid bursts of small missiles, bullets, or blows
items.ex_en: Rival gangs proceeded to pepper the storefront with dozens of automatic rifle rounds.
items.ex_zh: 敌对帮派用数十发自动步枪子弹密集扫射了临街店面。

items.def_zh: 使布满窟窿，使千疮百孔；充斥；筛选
items.def_en: 1. (usually passive) To make a lot of holes in something. 2. (be riddled with) To be full of something undesirable, such as errors, disease, or corruption.
items.ex_en: Termites managed to riddle the structural timber beams with extensive internal hollows.
items.ex_zh: 白蚁蛀蚀了建筑承重木梁，使其内部布满了千疮百孔的空洞。

items.def_en: Pierce throughout with projectiles or permeate with defects
items.ex_en: The soldier's tattered battle tunic was shot-through with fragments from the mortar blast.
items.ex_zh: 那名士兵破旧的战袍被迫击炮爆炸产生的弹片打得满是穿孔。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate causing a surface or structure to be full of numerous holes, usually through sustained ballistic gunfire or widespread defects. Riddle emphasizes multiple penetrations, while pepper stresses rapid scattered impacts.
groups.summary_zh: 指密集射穿、打成筛子或造成满布孔洞的破坏状态。
groups.desc_en: Inflicting extreme damage on an object or body through overwhelming, multiple ballistic penetrations.
groups.desc_zh: 通过大量弹丸、碎片或破孔对物体造成密集的穿透性摧毁破坏。
groups.nuance_en: riddle: penetrating so profusely with bullet holes that structural integrity is destroyed (bullets / shrapnel / corpse) · pepper: spraying rapidly and widely with small particles or shots (shotgun / bullets / questions) · perforate: penetrating clear through a membrane or wall with violent force (armor / bowel / wall) · shot-through: permeated or completely interpenetrated with perforations or qualities (holes / fabric / despair) · puncture: breaching a surface under intense localized impact (armor / hull / tank)
groups.nuance_zh: riddle: 弹孔极其密集以至千疮百孔 (bullets / shrapnel / corpse) · pepper: 散弹或连发子弹密集扫射泼洒 (shotgun / bullets / questions) · perforate: 穿透式击穿隔壁或护层 (armor / bowel / wall) · shot-through: 密布穿透孔洞，或深层渗透某种特征 (holes / fabric / despair) · puncture: 局部破甲刺穿破坏密封 (armor / hull / tank)

groups.name: Perfume & Scent · 散发气味与赋香 (Perfume, Scent, Aromatize)
groups.tip: 喷洒香精让芬芳弥漫

items.def_en: Give a pleasant, distinctive fragrance to an environment, cosmetic, or object
items.ex_en: Crushed lavender sprigs were used to gently scent the newly washed linen sheets.
items.ex_zh: 捣碎的薰衣草枝条被用来为新洗过的亚麻床单赋予淡淡清香。

items.def_zh: 使散发香气，使芳香；洒香水于
items.def_en: To give a pleasant, sweet smell to something, or to apply perfume to.
items.ex_en: Fresh blooming jasmine was placed around the terrace to perfume the evening breeze.
items.ex_zh: 露台周围摆放着盛开的新鲜茉莉，使晚风散发着阵阵清香。

items.def_zh: 净化除臭，使气味清新芳香
items.def_en: Make the smell of the air, breath, or a place fresh and pleasing
items.ex_en: She opened every window widely to sweeten the stale air inside the cottage.
items.ex_zh: 她把所有的窗户敞开，以净化小屋内沉闷浑浊的空气。
items.ex2_en: The stale morning air sweetened quickly as the pleasant breeze blew.
items.ex2_zh: 随着清新的微风吹过，原本沉闷的晨间空气迅速变得宜人。

items.def_en: Impart an aromatic odor or savory herbal aroma to air or a food product
items.ex_en: The chef decided to aromatize the olive oil with fresh rosemary and crushed garlic.
items.ex_zh: 大厨决定用新鲜迷迭香和蒜末为橄榄油增添风味。

items.def_en: Infuse a room, fabric, or cosmetic product with a sweet, delicate aroma
items.ex_en: Essential oils of lavender were used to fragrance the newly cleaned guest rooms.
items.ex_zh: 薰衣草精油被用来熏香打扫一新的客房。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers imparting pleasant fragrances to an atmosphere or space, as well as substances naturally diffusing sweet, aromatic odors.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动赋香使充满芳香，或自然弥漫幽香。
groups.desc_en: Imparting or diffusing a pleasing, fragrant odor into an object or environment.
groups.desc_zh: 向空间或物体散发、注入或人工添加宜人的芬芳香气。
groups.nuance_en: scent: imbuing naturally or subtly with a characteristic smell (air / soap / breeze) · perfume: heavily saturating or spraying with a rich, formulated floral fragrance (room / hair / garden) · aromatize: technically infusing aromatic chemical compounds or vapor into something (tea / room / wine) · fragrance: deliberately treating an environment or product with a pleasing scent (product / air / lotion) · sweeten: making an atmosphere, breath, or flavor pleasant and fresh (breath / air / potpourri)
groups.nuance_zh: scent: 赋予自然清淡的固有香气 (air / soap / breeze) · perfume: 浓烈地喷施香水或使花香浸透 (room / hair / garden) · aromatize: 运用芳香制剂或技术对空间/食品赋香 (tea / room / wine) · fragrance: 商业化地为产品或环境增添愉悦芳香 (product / air / lotion) · sweeten: 使空气、口气清新怡人 (breath / air / potpourri)

groups.name: Perjure & Prevaricate · 伪证与诡辩 (Prevaricate, Equivocate, Bear false witness)
groups.tip: 法庭作伪证或故意说谎，违背真实誓言

items.def_en: To give false testimony against someone, especially under sworn oath in a formal setting
items.ex_en: The corrupt officer was convicted because he chose to bear false witness against innocent citizens.
items.ex_zh: 这名腐败的官员因蓄意作伪证诬陷无辜公民而被定罪。

items.def_en: To alter a document, testimony, or record dishonestly so as to convey untruth
items.ex_en: The accountant attempted to falsify the financial ledger to conceal the massive embezzlement.
items.ex_zh: 会计试图篡改财务账簿，以掩盖巨额贪污行为。

items.def_en: (perjure oneself) (law) To deliberately make a false statement while under oath in a court of law.
items.ex_en: The key witness decided to perjure himself rather than disclose his boss's criminal activities.
items.ex_zh: 这位关键证人宁愿在法庭上作伪证，也不愿供出上司的犯罪行径。

items.def_zh: 说模棱两可的话，含糊其词
items.def_en: To use ambiguous language deliberately to conceal the truth or mislead an audience
items.ex_en: When pressed about budget deficits, the spokesperson chose to equivocate rather than answer directly.
items.ex_zh: 当被追问预算赤字问题时，发言人含糊其词，未作正面回答。

items.def_zh: 支吾其词，闪烁其词以推托
items.def_en: To speak or act evasively in order to avoid telling the absolute truth
items.ex_en: The minister continued to prevaricate until investigative journalists revealed the complete, unedited documents.
items.ex_zh: 直到调查记者公开了完整且未经删改的文档，部长才不再支吾其词。

groups.summary_en: Pertains to intentional deceit in legal, solemn, or forensic contexts, where an oath, sworn testimony, or strict obligation to truth is deliberately violated.
groups.summary_zh: 特指法庭作证、宣誓下提供伪证，或有意避重就轻狡辩弄假。
groups.desc_en: Deceptive verbal evasion or outright lying under formal or normative obligations of truthfulness, contrasting with ordinary lying by foregrounding legal solemnity or strategic ambiguity.
groups.desc_zh: 在法定或道德性如实陈述义务下进行欺瞒或词令推脱，与一般说谎相比，强调法律庄严性或刻意含糊其辞的策略性。
groups.nuance_en: perjure: willfully swear a falsehood under judicial oath (oneself / testimony) · bear false witness: formally give dishonest testimony damaging another (neighbor / court) · falsify: alter or manipulate factual records deceptively (records / accounts / test results) · prevaricate: evade the truth through deliberately ambiguous speech (spokesperson / witness) · equivocate: use ambiguous terms intentionally to mislead while preserving plausible deniability (politician / lawyer)
groups.nuance_zh: perjure: 司法宣誓下蓄意作伪证 (oneself / testimony) · bear false witness: 作虚假指控或证言陷害他人 (neighbor / court) · falsify: 伪造篡改真实记录 (records / accounts / test results) · prevaricate: 闪烁其词以推托搪塞 (spokesperson / witness) · equivocate: 蓄意使用双关歧义词以误导 (politician / lawyer)

groups.name: Permute & Reorder · 字符重排与置换 (Permute, Scramble, Rearrange)
groups.tip: 打乱顺序重新组合排列

items.def_en: To put things into a different order or position
items.ex_en: She decided to rearrange the classroom desks into circles for collaborative group discussions.
items.ex_zh: 她决定把教室里的课桌重新排成圆形，以便开展小组协作讨论。

items.def_en: 1. To rearrange the letters of a word or phrase to form a new word or phrase.
items.ex_en: The enigmatic poet loved to anagram famous royal titles into mocking satirical verses.
items.ex_zh: 这位行事神秘的诗人喜好将王室头衔重组为具有讽刺意味的变位诗句。

items.def_en: To restore jumbled letters, puzzle clues, or scrambled signals back to readable form
items.ex_en: It took the skilled cryptographer several hours to unscramble the intercepted military transmission.
items.ex_zh: 老练的密码破译员花费了数小时才将截获的军用电报信号还原。

items.def_en: To mix up the components, letters, or sequence of something so they are not orderly
items.ex_en: The editor warned that software errors might scramble the chronological order of our articles.
items.ex_zh: 编辑警告说，软件错误可能会打乱我们文章的时间顺序。

items.def_en: To change the order or arrangement of a set of items, especially in math or linguistics
items.ex_en: The mathematician tried to permute the symbols to uncover an underlying algebraic pattern.
items.ex_zh: 数学家试图置换这些符号的排列次序，以找出潜在的代数规律。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this linguistic and combinatorial frame denote the deliberate or puzzle-like repositioning of letters, digits, or sequence tokens to produce alternative words, codes, or arrangements. It stresses discrete, algorithmic manipulation.
groups.summary_zh: 指对字母、顺序或离散元素进行字谜式或置换式的重构。
groups.desc_en: Altering the sequential or spatial arrangement of items within an existing set, distinguishing from random scattering by operating upon structured order.
groups.desc_zh: 对既有集合内的元素进行序列或空间位序的变换重组，与散落不同，着眼于结构性顺序的变化。
groups.nuance_en: rearrange: shift items into a new or revised functional order (furniture / schedule / priorities) · permute: systematically reorder elements through all combinatorial possibilities (digits / letters / sequences) · scramble: jumble elements into total disorder or encrypted confusion (signals / letters / eggs) · anagram: transpose the letters of a word to form a new word (letters / words / names) · unscramble: restore jumbled or encrypted elements back to original order (signals / messages / thoughts)
groups.nuance_zh: rearrange: 重新调整编排顺序或布局 (furniture / schedule / priorities) · permute: 穷举性排列组合 (digits / letters / sequences) · scramble: 扰乱使之混乱或加密 (signals / letters / eggs) · anagram: 将字母换位重组构词 (letters / words / names) · unscramble: 还原理顺被混淆的次序 (signals / messages / thoughts)

groups.name: Perpetuate & Prolong · 维持延续与使永久化 (Prolong, Sustain, Immortalize)
groups.tip: 从日常维持到长久延续

items.def_en: To continue doing, keeping up, or maintaining a custom, activity, or lineage
items.ex_en: Despite facing severe financial difficulties, they decided to carry on with the project.
items.ex_zh: 尽管面临严重的财务困难，他们还是决定把项目继续做下去。

items.def_en: To maintain or keep something going over a continuous period of time without letting it fail
items.ex_en: Emergency donations helped sustain the wildlife sanctuary throughout the long, harsh winter.
items.ex_zh: 应急捐款支撑着这座野生动物保护区度过了漫长而艰难的寒冬。

items.def_en: To deliberately make something last longer than usual in duration
items.ex_en: The defense attorney used procedural delays deliberately to prolong the high-profile civil trial.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师利用程序性拖延手段，蓄意拉长这场备受瞩目的民事审判。

items.def_en: 1. (formal) To cause a situation, belief, or system—especially an unfair one—to continue for a long time.
items.ex_en: These biased school policies serve only to perpetuate outdated social prejudices against minorities.
items.ex_zh: 这些带有偏见的学校政策只会让针对少数群体的陈旧社会偏见长期留存。

items.def_en: To cause someone or something to be remembered, celebrated, or preserved forever
items.ex_en: The sculptor sought to immortalize the fallen soldiers through an elaborate bronze monument.
items.ex_zh: 雕塑家试图通过一座精致的青铜纪念碑使阵亡将士永垂不朽。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe actions that cause conditions, beliefs, institutions, or states of affairs to continue indefinitely, often prolonging their lifespan far into the future.
groups.summary_zh: 延续、维系或使某种状态、制度或观念长期存续下去。
groups.desc_en: Causing an existing state, action, or legacy to continue over an extended timeframe, contrasting with brief initiation or simple continuation by emphasizing deliberate preservation against temporal decay.
groups.desc_zh: 使某种既有状态、行动或遗产跨越时间得以延续，与一般继续不同，侧重抗拒时间流逝的主观维系或永久化。
groups.nuance_en: sustain: supply ongoing support to keep an effort or system alive (momentum / growth / effort) · prolong: stretch the duration of an ongoing condition beyond its normal limit (life / agony / negotiations) · perpetuate: cause an enduring practice, myth, or system to persist indefinitely (myths / stereotypes / system) · carry on: actively continue an ongoing task or lineage through perseverance (tradition / work / conversation) · immortalize: endow a subject with everlasting fame or memory through art or achievement (heroes / fame / deeds)
groups.nuance_zh: sustain: 持续提供支持以维持存续 (momentum / growth / effort) · prolong: 延缓结束而拉长过程 (life / agony / negotiations) · perpetuate: 使坏习气、神话或制度长存不衰 (myths / stereotypes / system) · carry on: 秉持毅力继续推进或继承 (tradition / work / conversation) · immortalize: 借由艺术或功绩使名垂不朽 (heroes / fame / deeds)

groups.name: Persistent Tugging & Plucking · 抽拉与扯动 (Tug, Pluck, Tweak)
groups.tip: 短促用力拉拽拖引

items.def_en: To apply force to someone or something so as to move them towards oneself
items.ex_en: He stepped back and used both hands to pull the heavy iron gate.
items.ex_zh: 他向后退了一步，双手用力拉动沉重的铁门。

items.def_en: To pull, pinch, or twist something with a quick, small movement
items.ex_en: Her affectionate grandmother would always tweak her cheek whenever she visited the house.
items.ex_zh: 每次去祖母家，慈祥的祖母总会掐捏一下她的小脸蛋。

items.def_en: To take hold of something and pull or pick it away with fingers in a quick motion
items.ex_en: She used fine metal tweezers to pluck stray hairs from around her eyebrows.
items.ex_zh: 她用精细的金属镊子拔去眉毛周围的杂毛。

items.def_en: To exert continuous or intermittent pulls upon a hem, sleeve, or cord
items.ex_en: The anxious child began to tug at his mother's coat during the speech.
items.ex_zh: 演讲期间，焦虑的孩子开始不断拉扯母亲的外套。

items.def_en: 1. (+ at/on) To pull something forcefully, quickly, or repeatedly. 2. To tow a boat or ship using a tugboat.
items.ex_en: A sturdy harbor vessel arrived to tug the disabled cargo ship toward port.
items.ex_zh: 一艘坚固的港口拖船赶来，将抛锚的货轮拖向港口。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers repeated, localized, or small-scale pulling actions, such as pulling on a rope in intervals, plucking strings, or gently tweaking clothing.
groups.summary_zh: 强调局部的、反复的或间断性的牵拉、抓扯、拔拽细微动作。
groups.desc_en: Applying repeated, sharp, or localized tensile force to a surface or object, contrasting with smooth, continuous drawing by highlighting intermittent, localized, or abrupt traction.
groups.desc_zh: 对局部物体施加断续、迅疾或局部的牵拉力，与平缓连续的拖拉相比，强调力度的突发性、间歇性或指尖细部动作。
groups.nuance_en: pull: apply continuous or generalized tensile force toward oneself (rope / cart / lever) · tug: pull sharply and vigorously, often repeatedly against resistance (coat / rope / boat) · tug at: repeatedly apply slight pulls to or emotionally grip something (sleeve / heartstrings) · pluck: seize and abruptly pull away with finger pinch (strings / feathers / eyebrows) · tweak: grip with a twisting pinch or give a fine corrective adjustment (ear / nose / settings)
groups.nuance_zh: pull: 沿自身方向施加常规持续拉力 (rope / cart / lever) · tug: 用力猛拉或反复扯动 (coat / rope / boat) · tug at: 轻轻频拉，亦指触动情感 (sleeve / heartstrings) · pluck: 指尖捏住后猝然拔取或弹拨 (strings / feathers / eyebrows) · tweak: 捏住拧扯，或微调细部设置 (ear / nose / settings)

groups.name: Persuade & Coax · 劝说与促成行动 (Persuade, Coax, Urge)
groups.tip: 循循善诱劝人信服

items.def_en: Convince someone to do something through conversation or argument
items.ex_en: Her persuasive friends managed to talk into buying an expensive designer winter coat.
items.ex_zh: 在她朋友们的劝说下，她终于被说服买下了那件昂贵的名牌冬装外套。

items.def_en: (formal) (+ upon) Persuade someone to do something after repeated requests
items.ex_en: We managed to prevail on the distinguished professor to deliver the keynote address.
items.ex_zh: 经过多次恳请，我们终于说服那位知名教授来作主旨演讲。

items.def_en: 1. To convince someone to do something by giving good reasons. 2. To make someone believe that something is true.
items.ex_en: He presented undeniable scientific facts to persuade the cautious committee to accept reforms.
items.ex_zh: 他出示了无可辩驳的科学事实，以说服谨慎的委员会接受改革。

items.def_en: Persuade someone gently and patiently to do something they may feel hesitant about
items.ex_en: The patient trainer tried to coax the frightened puppy out from under furniture.
items.ex_zh: 耐心的训犬员试图将受惊的小狗从家具下面轻声哄出来。

items.def_en: Persuade someone to do something by using flattering words, sweet talk, or false promises
items.ex_en: The lobbyist tried to cajole the hesitant senator into supporting the controversial bill.
items.ex_zh: 说客极力巧言诱劝那位犹豫不决的参议员支持这项备受争议的法案。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote actively motivating or inducing someone to take a specific course of action, employing reasoning, persistent urging, gentle enticement, or personal charm.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重积极运用说理、软磨硬泡或劝导手段促使当事人付诸行动。
groups.desc_en: Inducing another agent to adopt a belief or execute a course of action through interpersonal communication, differing from coercion by operating through argumentation, charm, or persistent flattery.
groups.desc_zh: 通过人际沟通引导他人接受观点或采取行动，与暴力强迫不同，依赖说理、温和诱导或持久奉承。
groups.nuance_en: persuade: convince through reasoned argumentation or substantial proof (voters / jury / client) · coax: gently and patiently guide someone into doing something through soothing words (child / animal / engine) · cajole: wheedle someone into compliance through flattery or teasing promises (colleague / boss / guard) · talk into: win verbal consent through persistence and rhetorical skill (friend / partner / buying) · prevail on: successfully sway someone through authoritative moral standing or repeated appeals (donor / friend / official)
groups.nuance_zh: persuade: 凭说理或有力论据予以说服 (voters / jury / client) · coax: 循循善诱、耐性哄劝 (child / animal / engine) · cajole: 甜言蜜语奉承笼络使之顺从 (colleague / boss / guard) · talk into: 通过口舌游说使之同意 (friend / partner / buying) · prevail on: 凭借人情、声望或恳请打动 (donor / friend / official)

groups.name: Pertain & Belong · 关联与属于 (Apply, Relate, Appertain)
groups.tip: 属于某个范畴或与此相关

items.def_en: (+ to) Have a logical or thematic connection to something
items.ex_en: The statistical findings in chapter three directly relate to our initial research hypothesis.
items.ex_zh: 第三章中的统计学结果与我们最初的研究假设直接相关。

items.def_en: (+ to) Be relevant to, have a bearing on, or affect a particular person, group, or circumstance
items.ex_en: These strict environmental safety regulations apply to every chemical plant within the district.
items.ex_zh: 这些严格的环境安全规程适用于该辖区内的所有化工厂。
items.ex2_en: The nurse gently applied the soothing herbal cream to the burn.
items.ex2_zh: 护士轻轻地将舒缓的草本药膏涂抹在烫伤处。

items.def_en: (+ to) Be the property of someone, or be a member or proper part of a group or category
items.ex_en: All historical records in this cabinet belong to the city's central archival library.
items.ex_zh: 该档案柜中的所有历史记录均归市中心档案图书馆所有。

items.def_zh: 适于，属于（法言法语，+ to）
items.def_en: (+ to) Belong to or be connected as a rightful part or attribute, used chiefly in legal contexts
items.ex_en: The lease includes all customary easements that legally appertain to this agricultural property.
items.ex_zh: 该租赁合同包含依法附属于该农业地产的所有常规地役权。

items.def_en: (also 'pertain to') To relate directly to or have a connection with a particular subject, thing, or situation.
items.ex_en: The documents submitted today pertain directly to the company's foreign financial transactions.
items.ex_zh: 今天提交的这些文件与该公司的对外金融交易直接相关。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate an intrinsic connection, ownership, or formal applicability between an element, condition, or rule and a broader domain or context. Prepositional linkage (typically with 'to') is central to these relational predications.
groups.summary_zh: 表示在归属、适用性或固有性质上与特定领域或主体直接相关。
groups.desc_en: Possessing a rightful connection, relevance, or inherent jurisdiction with regard to a larger domain, differing from physical containment by denoting relational applicability or institutional entitlement.
groups.desc_zh: 与某一范围、议题或主体存在固有联系、适用性或从属资格，与空间盛装不同，体现为抽象关系或法定权利归属。
groups.nuance_en: relate: have a conceptual, causal, or thematic connection to something (events / issues / facts) · apply: have practical relevance, validity, or binding effect on a specific case (rules / standards / conditions) · belong: be an intrinsic, classified member of a group or someone's rightful possession (member / species / artifacts) · pertain: be directly relevant, appropriate, or applicable to a subject matter (records / facts / duties) · appertain: legally or inherently belong as a formal right, privilege, or accessory (rights / privileges / estate)
groups.nuance_zh: relate: 存在事实、概念或因果上的关联 (events / issues / facts) · apply: 规则或标准在个案上适用生效 (rules / standards / conditions) · belong: 归属于某一类别或所有者 (member / species / artifacts) · pertain: 与特定事项直接相关、适用 (records / facts / duties) · appertain: 依法律或体制享有正式权利或从属属性 (rights / privileges / estate)

groups.name: Peter Out & Fizzle · 渐趋消逝与虎头蛇尾 (Peter Out, Fizzle, Taper Off, Wane)
groups.tip: 从声势浩大到草草收场

items.def_en: To gradually decrease in number, intensity, or activity towards a stop
items.ex_en: Consumer demand for luxury goods usually begins to taper off after the holidays.
items.ex_zh: 节假日过后，消费者对奢侈品的需求通常开始逐渐回落。

items.def_zh: （尤指虎头蛇尾地）夭折，告吹，不了了之；发微弱嘶嘶声
items.def_en: (also 'fizzle out') To gradually lose energy, enthusiasm, or strength and end in a weak or disappointing failure.
items.ex_en: Their bold expansion plans began to fizzle after unexpected venture capital funding collapsed.
items.ex_zh: 随着意料之外的风投资金链断裂，他们宏伟的扩张计划开始以失败告终。

items.def_zh: 逐渐消失；逐渐减弱以至完全停止
items.def_en: To gradually become smaller, weaker, or less active until it stops altogether
items.ex_en: The enthusiastic public protests started to peter out as heavy winter snow arrived.
items.ex_zh: 随着冬季大雪降临，激昂的公众抗议活动逐渐趋于平息并彻底停止。

items.def_zh: 衰退；减退（影响力或兴趣）
items.def_en: To gradually become weaker or less important, powerful, or noticeable
items.ex_en: His political influence began to wane as fresh leadership emerged in the party.
items.ex_zh: 随着党内新领导力量的崛起，他的政治影响力开始逐渐式微。

items.def_zh: 烟消云散；骤然化为乌有
items.def_en: To disappear or vanish completely, especially of feelings, hope, or enthusiasm
items.ex_en: All lingering doubts seemed to evaporate once the clear DNA evidence was presented.
items.ex_zh: 一旦清晰确凿的DNA证据呈堂，所有残存的疑虑似乎都烟消云散了。
items.ex2_en: The hot desert sun evaporated the shallow puddles of morning rainwater.
items.ex2_zh: 沙漠中灼热的太阳蒸发了清晨积下的浅雨水坑。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe events, processes, or enthusiasm that start with great promise or momentum but gradually lose vigor and end anticlimactically or weakly, rather than stopping abruptly.
groups.summary_zh: 指势头、计划或热情逐渐减退，无疾而终或虎头蛇尾。
groups.desc_en: Gradually losing force, momentum, or volume until completely extinguished, contrasting with abrupt cessation by emphasizing a slow, anti-climactic diminishment.
groups.desc_zh: 力量、声势或活力逐渐消减以至最终平息，与戛然而止不同，强调缓坡式衰退或虎头蛇尾的消亡过程。
groups.nuance_en: peter out: gradually dwindle away to nothing after initial vigor (stream / enthusiasm / career) · fizzle: end weakly or fail after an exciting or promising start (campaign / romance / protest) · taper off: diminish progressively in volume, frequency, or degree (spending / dosage / rain) · wane: decline in intensity, influence, or illumination naturally over time (popularity / interest / moon) · evaporate: vanish rapidly and completely as if dissolved into thin air (profits / hopes / trust)
groups.nuance_zh: peter out: 初始有力但后劲不足渐至耗尽 (stream / enthusiasm / career) · fizzle: 声势开头却虎头蛇尾告终 (campaign / romance / protest) · taper off: 数量、频率或幅度递减 (spending / dosage / rain) · wane: 影响力、兴趣或光度依规律衰减 (popularity / interest / moon) · evaporate: 资产、希望等如水汽般消散殆尽 (profits / hopes / trust)

groups.name: Philander & Womanize · 猎艳与调情 (Philander, Womanize, Flirt)
groups.tip: 不忠诚地到处留情嬉戏

items.def_en: (+ with) To behave playfully towards someone showing casual romantic or sexual attraction without serious intent
items.ex_en: He liked to flirt with the new receptionist whenever he passed the lobby.
items.ex_zh: 每当经过大堂，他总喜欢去跟新来的前台接待员搭讪调情一番。

items.def_zh: 乱搞男女关系；调情厮混
items.def_en: (+ with) To engage in casual, illicit, or irresponsible sexual activity or flirting
items.ex_en: She warned her teenage son not to fool around with irresponsible older crowds.
items.ex_zh: 她告诫正值青春期的儿子不要同那些不负责任的年长混混瞎厮混。

items.def_zh: 调情，玩弄女性，到处留情
items.def_en: (disapproving) To engage in casual, non-committal sexual or romantic relationships with many partners.
items.ex_en: The arrogant aristocrat continued to philander across Europe without ever considering settling down.
items.ex_zh: 这位傲慢的贵族继续在欧洲各地寻花问柳，从未考虑过安定下来。

items.def_en: To deceive a romantic partner by secretly having a relationship with someone else at the same time
items.ex_en: She broke off the engagement immediately upon discovering he was trying to two-time.
items.ex_zh: 在发现他企图脚踏两只船后，她立刻解除了婚约。

items.def_en: To habitually engage in numerous casual sexual affairs with different women
items.ex_en: Throughout his turbulent twenties, the wealthy heir chose to womanize rather than study.
items.ex_zh: 在动荡混乱的二十多岁时，这位富家子弟整日寻花问柳，荒废学业。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame characterize entering into multiple casual, noncommittal, or deceptive romantic and sexual liaisons, often carrying strong connotations of unfaithfulness or superficial seduction.
groups.summary_zh: 多含贬义，指四处寻花问柳、猎艳调情且不愿承担感情承诺。
groups.desc_en: Engaging in casual, non-committal, or deceitful romantic/sexual pursuits outside of established fidelity, differing from genuine romance by treating relationships as trivial conquests.
groups.desc_zh: 在承诺之外进行轻浮、不负责任或虚伪的情感与肉体追逐，与真诚恋爱不同，将两性关系视作消遣或征服游戏。
groups.nuance_en: flirt: behave playfully to convey casual sexual attraction without serious intent (colleague / stranger / waiter) · fool around: engage in casual sexual play or extramarital infidelity (neighbor / coworker / spouse) · philander: habitually engage in casual sexual affairs with multiple partners while in a committed bond (husband / bachelor / politician) · womanize: persistently seduce women as a predatory or compulsive habit (playboy / mogul / actor) · two-time: deceive a committed partner by maintaining an illicit concurrent romance (partner / spouse / lover)
groups.nuance_zh: flirt: 挑逗调情，表达不具实意的爱意 (colleague / stranger / waiter) · fool around: 胡搞瞎混，指轻浮的亲昵或婚外寻欢 (neighbor / coworker / spouse) · philander: 惯常四处留情、拈花惹草 (husband / bachelor / politician) · womanize: 沉溺于猎艳、玩弄女性 (playboy / mogul / actor) · two-time: 搞脚踩两只船的背叛欺骗 (partner / spouse / lover)

groups.name: Pierce & Impale · 刺穿与穿透 (Transfix, Pierce, Skewer)
groups.tip: 利器重度刺穿贯透

items.def_en: Force a sharp or pointed object through or into the skin or material surface
items.ex_en: The sharp surgical needle was designed to pierce tough skin with minimal resistance.
items.ex_zh: 这种锋利的手术针旨在以极小的阻力刺破坚韧的皮肤组织。

items.def_en: Thrust a spear or pointed implement into or through something with force
items.ex_en: The skilled diver managed to spear a giant flatfish lurking along the reef.
items.ex_zh: 这名熟练的潜水员成功用矛刺中了一条潜藏在暗礁旁的巨大比目鱼。

items.def_en: Fasten or pierce through meat or an object using a long pin, spit, or pointed skewer
items.ex_en: The cook used a wooden spike to skewer several pieces of marinated chicken.
items.ex_zh: 厨师用一根木签穿起几块腌好的鸡肉。

items.def_en: Pierce completely through with a pointed weapon or sharp object, pinning in place
items.ex_en: A stray iron arrow managed to transfix the warrior's shield during the siege.
items.ex_zh: 围城期间，一支流矢生生刺穿了勇士的盾牌并将其卡住。

items.def_zh: 刺穿，扎透（尤指被尖物穿透）
items.def_en: To pierce through someone or something with a sharp, pointed object like a stake, spear, or spike.
items.ex_en: The trap was built to impale charging wild animals with sharpened wooden stakes.
items.ex_zh: 这个陷阱布设了削尖的木桩，用来刺穿猛冲过来的野兽。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the violent or forceful act of penetrating completely through a solid surface or body using a sharp, pointed, or rigid weapon/implement, pinning or piercing it thoroughly.
groups.summary_zh: 强调以尖锐利器强力刺入或贯穿物体与肉体。
groups.desc_en: Forcing a pointed object completely through a target's boundary or body, contrasting with superficial cutting by highlighting depth of penetration and immobilization.
groups.desc_zh: 尖锐物贯通目标表面并深刺其中，与浅表划割不同，强调深度贯穿与穿透后的钉固状态。
groups.nuance_en: pierce: penetrate a surface sharply with a pointed tip (skin / darkness / armor) · spear: strike and penetrate aggressively using a long thrusting weapon (fish / meat / enemy) · skewer: thrust a long pin or rod entirely through an object to secure it (kebab / meat / critic) · transfix: pierce completely through so as to pin immovably; fig. paralyze with shock (prey / gaze / horror) · impale: drive a sharp stake completely through a body, leaving it suspended or transfixed (victim / enemy / body)
groups.nuance_zh: pierce: 尖端刺破表面或穿透阻碍 (skin / darkness / armor) · spear: 以长矛突刺穿扎 (fish / meat / enemy) · skewer: 串刺贯通，引申为犀利批驳 (kebab / meat / critic) · transfix: 扎透钉死在原地，引申为吓呆僵住 (prey / gaze / horror) · impale: 用尖桩贯穿人体并架起 (victim / enemy / body)

groups.name: Plagiarize & Crib · 抄袭与剽窃 (Crib, Plagiarize, Copycat)
groups.tip: 暗中剽窃并照搬他人作品

items.def_en: To take and use passages, motifs, or concepts directly from another creator's work without credit
items.ex_en: The amateur author was accused of trying to lift entire dialogues from classic novels.
items.ex_zh: 这位业余作家被指控企图全盘抄袭经典小说中的原话对白。
items.ex2_en: The heavy morning fog lifted completely as the warm sunshine appeared.
items.ex2_zh: 随着温暖的阳光出现，早晨浓重的雾气彻底消散了。

items.def_en: To reproduce, distribute, or exploit copyrighted intellectual property without authorization
items.ex_en: Unlicensed underground vendors often pirate bestselling textbooks and sell them cheaply to students.
items.ex_zh: 无牌照的地下书贩常常盗印畅销教科书，并低价卖给学生。

items.def_en: To blatantly copy, duplicate, or steal someone else's original creative work or design
items.ex_en: Unsuspecting tourists are often ripped off by unlicensed taxi operators.
items.ex_zh: 毫无防备的游客经常被无照出租车司机敲竹杠。

items.def_en: To copy someone else's written work, answers, or ideas dishonestly, especially in schoolwork or an exam.
items.ex_en: The dishonest student tried to crib several answers directly from his neighbor's exam.
items.ex_zh: 那个不诚实的学生企图在考试中直接抄袭邻座同学的几道题答案。

items.def_en: To copy ideas, text, or work from another author and pass them off dishonestly as original creations
items.ex_en: The university expelled the senior researcher after finding he dared to plagiarize published monographs.
items.ex_zh: 在发现该资深研究人员竟敢抄袭已出版的专著后，大学将其开除。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe illicitly appropriating someone else's written material, ideas, or intellectual output and presenting them as one's own.
groups.summary_zh: 未经许可抄袭、剽窃他人作品或学术观点为己用。
groups.desc_en: Illicitly taking another person's creative, textual, or intellectual work and passing it off as one's own, contrasting with legitimate influence by involving theft of authorship.
groups.desc_zh: 非法剽取他人的文字、创意或智力成果并冒充己作，与合理借鉴不同，带有对署名权与原产性的偷盗本质。
groups.nuance_en: plagiarize: dishonestly claim another's scholarly or literary work as one's own (thesis / paper / lyrics) · crib: illicitly copy text or test answers stealthily (answers / notes / passage) · lift: casually or blatantly take sections of text or ideas from a source (paragraphs / quotes / tune) · rip off: blatantly and shamelessly copy or steal someone's creative concept (design / concept / artwork) · pirate: illegally reproduce and distribute intellectual property without license (software / film / recordings)
groups.nuance_zh: plagiarize: 学术或文字上的剽窃冒名 (thesis / paper / lyrics) · crib: 暗中抄袭摘抄他人笔记或答案 (answers / notes / passage) · lift: 顺手牵羊式地挪用照抄文段 (paragraphs / quotes / tune) · rip off: 赤裸裸且恶劣地山寨盗用 (design / concept / artwork) · pirate: 盗版复制发行受版权保护的作品 (software / film / recordings)

groups.name: Plagiarize & Infringe · 抄袭与侵权盗用 (Plagiarize, Infringe, Appropriate)
groups.tip: 非法盗用他人智力创作成果

items.def_en: (informal) Steal or plagiarize words, tunes, or jokes directly from another source
items.ex_en: Stand-up comedians frequently complain when rival performers lift their best punchlines on stage.
items.ex_zh: 当竞争对手在台上抄袭自己的经典包袱时，单口喜剧演员往往会十分不满。
items.ex2_en: The thick gray clouds lifted over the mountain valley by noon.
items.ex2_zh: 到正午时分，山谷上空厚重的灰色云层消散开来。

items.def_en: Take someone else's intellectual or cultural ideas for one's own use without authorization
items.ex_en: The Western brand was heavily criticized for attempting to appropriate sacred indigenous design motifs.
items.ex_zh: 该西方品牌因企图挪用原住民的神圣传统设计图案而饱受批评。

items.def_en: Illegally reproduce, copy, or distribute copyrighted music, software, or printed material
items.ex_en: Illicit foreign websites continued to pirate newly released studio movies without paying royalties.
items.ex_zh: 非法境外网站在不支付版权费的情况下，持续盗版流出刚上映的院线大片。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) Violate or encroach upon someone else's legal rights, trademark, or patent
items.ex_en: The technological startup claimed the multinational corporation did infringe on its original patent.
items.ex_zh: 这家科技初创公司指控那家跨国企业确实侵犯了其原创专利。

items.def_en: To take someone else's work, ideas, or words and pretend that they are your own.
items.ex_en: Any academic writer who dares to plagiarize will undoubtedly face severe professional consequences.
items.ex_zh: 任何敢于抄袭他人成果的学者，无疑都会面临严重的行业处罚后果。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express dishonest intellectual or artistic theft—misappropriating another's creative writing, ideas, patents, or intellectual property and falsely presenting them as original.
groups.summary_zh: 指盗用侵占他人的智力成果、学术观点或版权并据为己有。
groups.desc_en: Unauthorized appropriation or violation of another's proprietary or intellectual rights, distinguishing from pure literary plagiarism by foregrounding statutory infringement and ownership breach.
groups.desc_zh: 未经许可占有或侵犯他人的法定专利、版权或排他权益，较单纯文风剽窃更偏重法定侵权行为与所有权侵占。
groups.nuance_en: infringe: violate or encroach upon legal boundaries, patents, or rights (patent / copyright / trademark) · appropriate: take possession of someone's property, culture, or symbols without right (assets / cultural symbols / motifs) · pirate: unlawfully duplicate and exploit proprietary content for profit (content / broadcasts / media) · lift: expropriate creative content directly without authorization (text / ideas / code) · plagiarize: misappropriate someone's intellectual creation under false attribution (manuscript / dissertation / style)
groups.nuance_zh: infringe: 侵犯法定专利、商标或版权 (patent / copyright / trademark) · appropriate: 擅自挪用资产或挪借文化符号 (assets / cultural symbols / motifs) · pirate: 盗版分发专有内容谋利 (content / broadcasts / media) · lift: 径直盗采他人的文本或代码 (text / ideas / code) · plagiarize: 假冒作者偷取知识成果 (manuscript / dissertation / style)

groups.name: Plan & Scheme Strategically · 筹划与策划 (Design, Plot, Map out)
groups.tip: 预先设定步骤与策略

items.def_en: To plan the details of how something will happen, be done, or proceed
items.ex_en: The committee met to map out a clear strategy for the next five years.
items.ex_zh: 委员会开会为接下来的五年详细制定了清晰的战略规划。

items.def_en: 1. To decide on and arrange a set of actions in advance to achieve something. 2. To intend or hope to do something.
items.ex_en: The logistics directors met today to plan their comprehensive global supply chain strategy.
items.ex_zh: 物流主管们今天开会规划他们全面的全球供应链战略。

items.def_en: To make clever, secretive, or deceitful plans to achieve personal gain
items.ex_en: The corrupt executives met secretly to scheme ways to inflate quarterly company profits.
items.ex_zh: 腐败高管们秘密会面，谋划虚报公司季度利润的手段。

items.def_en: To invent or plan a method, system, or solution cleverly in your mind
items.ex_en: Engineers worked overtime to devise an innovative filtration system for urban drinking water.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们加班加点，为城市饮用水设计出了一套创新的过滤系统。

items.def_en: To make a secret plan with others to do something harmful, illegal, or wrong
items.ex_en: Disloyal officers gathered in the shadows to plot a violent government overthrow.
items.ex_zh: 图谋不轨的军官们在暗中集结，密谋通过暴力手段推翻政府。

groups.summary_en: This frame involves projecting steps forward, structuring intentions, and organizing strategies to accomplish a specific objective, whether benign or devious.
groups.summary_zh: 预先设定步骤、组织资源或谋划行动策略以达成目标。
groups.desc_en: Methodically formulating designs, sequences, and logistics in advance to achieve a targeted objective, differing from spontaneous action through calculated foresight.
groups.desc_zh: 为实现特定目标，预先系统性规划步骤、架构与策略，与即兴行动不同，依靠深思熟虑的预见性。
groups.nuance_en: plan: formulate a structured method or timeline for future action (project / wedding / budget) · map out: detail a comprehensive step-by-step route or strategy in advance (career / route / strategy) · devise: invent an ingenious method, plan, or mechanism through intellect (solution / system / mechanism) · plot: secretly and deliberately plan an intricate, often hostile scheme (rebellion / revenge / murder) · scheme: calculate underhanded or self-serving maneuvers to achieve personal gain (promotion / ruin / advantage)
groups.nuance_zh: plan: 拟定未来行动的常规规划与流程 (project / wedding / budget) · map out: 详尽周密地勾画发展路径 (career / route / strategy) · devise: 凭借巧妙构想设计方案或机制 (solution / system / mechanism) · plot: 密谋策划复杂且常带恶意的图谋 (rebellion / revenge / murder) · scheme: 工于心计地谋划私利排挤他人 (promotion / ruin / advantage)

groups.name: Play & Strum · 弹拨与演奏 (Strum, Pluck, Pick, Fingerpick)
groups.tip: 手指划拉琴弦演奏

items.def_en: Sound individual strings cleanly with a plectrum or fingertips
items.ex_en: The classical guitarist used his thumb to pick the lowest bass string cleanly.
items.ex_zh: 这位古典吉他手用拇指清晰地拨奏了最低音的那根低音弦。

items.def_en: Pull and quickly release the strings of an instrument with the fingers or a plectrum
items.ex_en: The harpist used her slender fingers to pluck delicate, melodic tones throughout the concert.
items.ex_zh: 竖琴手用修长的手指在整场音乐会中弹拨出优美细腻的旋律。

items.def_zh: 弹拨，轻弹（吉他等弦乐器）；漫不经心地弹奏
items.def_en: to play a guitar or other stringed instrument by moving your fingers or a plectrum across the strings
items.ex_en: He sat quietly on the front porch to strum his vintage acoustic guitar.
items.ex_zh: 他静静地坐在前廊上，轻弹着他那把老式原声吉他。

items.def_en: Pluck a taut string so that it produces a sharp, vibrating sound
items.ex_en: The archer liked to twang the bowstring before stepping up to shoot.
items.ex_zh: 在走上前射箭之前，弓箭手喜欢把弓弦拨弄得铮铮作响。
items.ex2_en: The steel guitar string twanged sharply when his fingers accidentally slipped.
items.ex2_zh: 当他的手指不慎滑脱时，钢吉他弦发出了刺耳的铮鸣声。

items.def_en: Play a stringed instrument idly or monotonously by tapping or light strumming
items.ex_en: He sat on the porch, content to thrum his old banjo under the twilight sky.
items.ex_zh: 他坐在门廊上，满足地在暮色下漫不经心地轻弹着旧班卓琴。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the manual techniques used to strike, brush, or pluck strings across musical instruments to produce notes or chords.
groups.summary_zh: 指用手指或拨片拂动、弹拨乐器琴弦发声的手法。
groups.desc_en: Manipulating the strings of a musical instrument via fingers, plectrums, or continuous strokes to produce sound, differing from bowing or hitting keys through direct manual string excitation.
groups.desc_zh: 通过指尖或拨片触动乐器琴弦发声，不同于琴弓拉奏或琴键敲击，侧重手指对弦线的直接激振与触感操控。
groups.nuance_en: strum: sweep fingers or plectrum across multiple strings in a broad rhythmic stroke (guitar / chords / tune) · pluck: pull and quickly release an individual string with fingertips or plectrum (harp / strings / bass) · pick: pluck individual strings precisely to render melody or arpeggios (banjo / strings / notes) · twang: strike a taut string so that it yields a sharp, ringing, nasal reverberation (guitar / bowstring / wire) · thrum: rhythmically and repetitively drum or strum with dull, monotonous vibrations (strings / fingers / motor)
groups.nuance_zh: strum: 刷奏扫弦，弹奏整组和弦 (guitar / chords / tune) · pluck: 拔动单根弦线发声 (harp / strings / bass) · pick: 细致挑弦弹奏旋律或分解和弦 (banjo / strings / notes) · twang: 弹弦发出清脆带鼻音的回响 (guitar / bowstring / wire) · thrum: 漫不经心地单调弹拨或发出嗡嗡声 (strings / fingers / motor)

groups.name: Play to the Crowd & Posture · 哗众取宠与作秀 (Grandstand, Posture, Pander)
groups.tip: 卖弄吹嘘以引起大众关注

items.def_zh: 迎合低级趣味，讨好大众
items.def_en: To behave or speak in an exaggerated, populist way designed solely to win cheap applause
items.ex_en: The politician chose to play to the gallery rather than address the real economic crisis.
items.ex_zh: 这位政客选择迎合大众博取喝彩，而不是去解决真正的经济危机。

items.def_en: To adopt an artificial manner or take public stances solely to impress or deceive spectators
items.ex_en: Ministers continued to posture about fiscal discipline while quietly expanding state expenditures.
items.ex_zh: 部长们继续在财政纪律上装腔作势，暗地里却在扩大国家支出。

items.def_en: To express opinions publicly primarily to demonstrate one's good character or moral rectitude
items.ex_en: Critics argued the corporation was merely trying to virtue-signal through its latest advertising campaign.
items.ex_zh: 批评者认为，该公司最新的广告活动不过是在标榜自身道德。

items.def_zh: 趾高气扬地走，卖弄炫示
items.def_en: To walk or behave with an affected, arrogant swagger meant to draw admiration
items.ex_en: He loved to strut across the showroom floor whenever wealthy clients were present.
items.ex_zh: 每当有富裕的客户在场，他就喜欢在展厅里趾高气扬地大步穿行。

items.def_en: 1. (disapproving) To behave or speak showily in order to attract public applause and attention.
items.ex_en: The lawyer began to grandstand before the jury instead of presenting factual evidence.
items.ex_zh: 那名律师开始在陪审团面前大肆卖弄，而不是出示事实证据。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses theatrical public behavior, rhetorical posing, and calculated speech intended to garner applause, political clout, or moral superiority.
groups.summary_zh: 通过做作的姿态、夸张的言行博取公众掌声、选票或道德优越感。
groups.desc_en: Exaggerating one's conduct, speech, or moral stances primarily to solicit approval, applause, or moral status from an audience, contrasting with genuine self-expression by being audience-driven theater.
groups.desc_zh: 刻意夸大言行或道德姿态以博取受众喝彩与名誉，与真诚表达不同，本质上是以受众为导向的作秀表演。
groups.nuance_en: grandstand: speak or act flamboyantly before an audience to win cheap applause (politician / lawyer / candidate) · posture: adopt an insincere, exaggerated stance to impress observers (diplomat / executive / leader) · play to the gallery: pander to the basest, most populist tastes of the public (rhetoric / speaker / performer) · virtue-signal: conspicuously flaunt progressive or moral opinions to validate good standing (influencer / celebrity / brand) · strut: display oneself with arrogant, pompous physical self-importance (peacock / leader / model)
groups.nuance_zh: grandstand: 刻意大出风头以博得喝彩 (politician / lawyer / candidate) · posture: 摆出虚假强硬姿态以唬人 (diplomat / executive / leader) · play to the gallery: 迎合大众低俗趣味以取悦看客 (rhetoric / speaker / performer) · virtue-signal: 刻意展示道德立场以标榜善良 (influencer / celebrity / brand) · strut: 傲慢昂首阔步，高调炫耀 (peacock / leader / model)

groups.name: Pledge & Vow · 承诺与发誓 (Pledge, Swear, Vow)
groups.tip: 从口头承诺到立誓保证

items.def_en: To commit oneself formally to perform a task, fulfill an obligation, or enter into an agreement
items.ex_en: The contractor will undertake to complete all structural repairs before the upcoming winter.
items.ex_zh: 承包商将正式承诺在即将来临的冬季前完成所有结构修缮。

items.def_en: To state or promise with extreme solemnity, often invoking a sacred entity or formal oath
items.ex_en: Witnesses must swear under oath that their testimony is truthful and accurate.
items.ex_zh: 证人必须宣誓保证其证词真实准确。

items.def_en: 1. To make a formal, solemn promise to do something or give support. 2. To give something valuable as security against a loan.
items.ex_en: The foundation chose to pledge ten million dollars toward global climate research.
items.ex_zh: 该基金会庄严承诺捐赠一千万美元用于全球气候研究。

items.def_en: To make a determined and deeply serious commitment to do something or maintain a principle
items.ex_en: The newly elected mayor did vow to eliminate corruption within the municipal department.
items.ex_zh: 新当选的市长立誓清除市政部门内部的腐败。

items.def_zh: 立誓保证，以…起誓（常指婚约）
items.def_en: To solemnly pledge or give one's word or loyalty, especially in marriage or formal allegiance
items.ex_en: In the chapel, the young knight did plight his eternal troth to Lady Guinevere.
items.ex_zh: 在小教堂里，年轻的骑士立誓对吉尼薇尔夫人永世效忠。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate solemn, public, or legally binding promises committing the speaker to a specific cause, duty, or moral standard.
groups.summary_zh: 以庄严、公开或誓言形式立下坚定承诺与支持。
groups.desc_en: Solemnly binding oneself to a future commitment, code of conduct, or truth through personal honor or formal invocation, contrasting with casual promising by its elevated gravity.
groups.desc_zh: 以个人名誉、仪式或庄重誓言将自身约束于未来的义务或承诺，与一般许诺相比，具备极高的约束力与神圣性。
groups.nuance_en: pledge: formally and publicly promise resources, loyalty, or adherence (allegiance / support / donation) · vow: solemnly swear a deep personal or sacred obligation (revenge / chastity / devotion) · swear: invoke solemn authority to verify the truth or bind fidelity under peril (allegiance / loyalty / oath) · undertake: enter into a binding contractual or professional commitment to perform (project / repair / review) · plight: bind oneself in ancient formal fidelity or solemn troth (troth / faith / honor)
groups.nuance_zh: pledge: 庄严且公开地承诺捐赠或忠诚 (allegiance / support / donation) · vow: 发重誓立下神圣或个人的坚定誓言 (revenge / chastity / devotion) · swear: 宣誓保证真实性或起誓效忠 (allegiance / loyalty / oath) · undertake: 承担契约式或法律上的经办职责 (project / repair / review) · plight: 结定生死誓约或婚盟 (troth / faith / honor)

groups.name: Plot & Conspire · 密谋与策划 (Hatch, Machinate, Cook up)
groups.tip: 暗中串通策划阴谋

items.def_en: To secretly make plans with others to achieve an unlawful, treasonous, or harmful goal
items.ex_en: Disgruntled officers gathered in secret to plot the overthrow of the corrupt regime.
items.ex_zh: 心怀不满的军官们秘密聚集，图谋推翻这个腐败的政权。

items.def_en: To engage in intricate, sinister schemes or intrigue to bring about a desired result
items.ex_en: Ambitious courtiers continued to machinate behind closed doors to depose the ailing monarch.
items.ex_zh: 野心勃勃的朝臣们继续在密室中谋划诡计，企图废黜病重的君王。

items.def_en: To invent, fabricate, or concoct a false story, plot, or fraudulent scheme
items.ex_en: He had to cook up an excuse for being late to the morning briefing.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不编造一个早会迟到的借口。

items.def_zh: 策划，密谋酝酿（尤指诡计）
items.def_en: To devise or concoct a secret plan, deception, or plot, usually over a period of time
items.ex_en: The conspirators met after dark to hatch a desperate plan to seize the treasury.
items.ex_zh: 阴谋者们在天黑后碰头，策划了一套夺取金库的冒险方案。

items.def_zh: 密谋，图谋；（事物）合力促成（不良后果）
items.def_en: 1. To plan secretly with other people to do something illegal or harmful. 2. (of circumstances or events) To act together to bring about an unfortunate result.
items.ex_en: Bad weather and bureaucratic delays seemed to conspire against our travel plans.
items.ex_zh: 恶劣的天气和官僚作风的延误似乎合力阻挠了我们的出行计划。

groups.summary_en: This scenario frame covers hatching complex underhanded schemes against authorities or rivals, as well as the figurative sense where external circumstances combine unfavorably against an individual.
groups.summary_zh: 暗中运筹策划有害行动；或喻指外部客观条件对某人不利。
groups.desc_en: Clandestinely formulating covert machinations with others to overthrow authority or achieve illicit objectives, contrasting with legitimate organizing by its secret and treacherous nature.
groups.desc_zh: 与他人暗中串通策划推翻权威或达成非法图谋，与合法筹划不同，具有高度隐蔽性、串谋性与背叛色彩。
groups.nuance_en: conspire: secretly join forces with others to plot an unlawful or treasonous act (rebels / traitors / politicians) · plot: calculate covert steps toward executing an intricate malicious scheme (coup / murder / overthrow) · hatch: incubate a secret, devious plan until it is ready for execution (plot / conspiracy / scheme) · machinate: weave labyrinthine political intrigues and manipulative stratagems (courtiers / ministers / rivals) · cook up: invent a fictitious excuse, alibi, or hasty underhanded scheme (excuse / story / plot)
groups.nuance_zh: conspire: 串通密谋干叛逆或不法勾当 (rebels / traitors / politicians) · plot: 密谋制订险恶全盘计划 (coup / murder / overthrow) · hatch: 暗中酝酿策划阴谋使其成型 (plot / conspiracy / scheme) · machinate: 运用复杂的政治手腕设局陷害 (courtiers / ministers / rivals) · cook up: 编造谎言、托辞或仓促拼凑诡计 (excuse / story / plot)

groups.name: Pluck & Pick · 拔取与摘采 (Pluck, Cull, Gather)
groups.tip: 捏住并用力向外拽拔

items.def_en: To pinch or cut off a shoot, bud, or small growth sharply between the fingers or shears
items.ex_en: You should nip off the dead buds to encourage fresh growth on the plant.
items.ex_zh: 你应该掐掉残蕾，以促进植株新生枝芽。

items.def_en: To break or pull flowers, fruit, or leaves away from a plant with the fingers
items.ex_en: Every autumn, local villagers gather to pick ripe apples from the communal orchards.
items.ex_zh: 每年秋天，当地村民都会聚集在公共果园采摘成熟的苹果。

items.def_en: To pull or pinch something with a sudden, sharp twist or jerk
items.ex_en: She leaned over to playfully tweak his ear while teasing him about his mistake.
items.ex_zh: 她探过身去开玩笑地扯了扯他的耳朵，同时取笑他犯的错。

items.def_en: 1. To pull something, especially feathers, hairs, or fruit, quickly and firmly off or out. 2. To sound the strings of a musical instrument by pulling and releasing them.
items.ex_en: The chef began to pluck the feathers from the duck before roasting it thoroughly.
items.ex_zh: 主厨在彻底烤鸭子之前，开始拔掉上面的羽毛。

items.def_en: To select and remove individuals or parts from a larger group, especially to reduce numbers or improve quality
items.ex_en: Wildlife authorities must cull surplus deer annually to maintain ecological balance across the reserve.
items.ex_zh: 野生动物管理部门每年必须剔除多余的鹿群，以维持保护区的生态平衡。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on detaching or removing individual small items—such as feathers, hairs, leaves, or fruit—using a quick, pinching, or selective grasping motion. It contrasts bulk removal with selective, delicate gathering.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过掐、捏、拔等敏捷细巧的动作，逐个脱除毛羽或挑选采摘果实花叶。
groups.desc_en: Separating and removing an item, flower, or fruit from its source via small-scale manual dexterity or selection, contrasting with indiscriminate hacking by its targeted and delicate extraction.
groups.desc_zh: 用精细指法或挑选手段将果实、叶片等从母体摘下或剔除，与粗暴砍切不同，强调精准定位与轻巧剥离。
groups.nuance_en: pick: select and detach ripe produce or flowers cleanly with fingers (apples / flowers / fruit) · pluck: seize and tug sharply to detach feathers, hairs, or blossoms (feathers / guitar string / petals) · nip off: pinch off plant shoots or buds sharply using fingernails or shears (shoots / buds / leaves) · cull: selectively collect and eliminate inferior specimens from a wider stock (herd / flock / population) · tweak: sharply pinch and wrench slightly (nose / ear / whiskers)
groups.nuance_zh: pick: 采摘成熟果蔬或花卉 (apples / flowers / fruit) · pluck: 拔除羽毛、揪扯毛发或花瓣 (feathers / guitar string / petals) · nip off: 掐断幼苗、顶芽或枝叶 (shoots / buds / leaves) · cull: 择优除劣式地挑出剔除 (herd / flock / population) · tweak: 掐住稍加拧动扯动 (nose / ear / whiskers)

groups.name: Plug & Block · 填塞与堵截 (Plug, Tamp, Pack)
groups.tip: 紧塞空腔防止液体漏出

items.def_en: To compress soft material into a compact ball and stuff it into a cavity or aperture
items.ex_en: He decided to wad cotton into the narrow crevice to block the draft.
items.ex_zh: 他决定把棉花揉成团塞进窄缝里，以挡住透进来的穿堂风。

items.def_en: To press, strike, or pack down loose filling material firmly into a hole or cavity
items.ex_en: The gardener used a wooden mallet to tamp down the freshly turned soil firmly.
items.ex_zh: 园丁用木槌将新翻的泥土牢牢捣实。

items.def_en: To fill a body cavity or deep wound with gauze or absorbent dressings to control hemorrhage
items.ex_en: The surgeon had to pack the deep cavity with sterile gauze to control bleeding.
items.ex_zh: 外科医生必须用无菌纱布填塞较深的创口以控制出血。

items.def_en: To stop up an opening or leak by inserting a tightly fitting piece of material into it
items.ex_en: We used a wooden peg to plug the small leak in the water barrel.
items.ex_zh: 我们用一根木桩堵住了水桶上的小漏洞。

items.def_zh: （用止血棉塞等）填塞，塞住（伤口或腔孔）以止血
items.def_en: (medical) To plug or pack a wound or body cavity with a tampon or absorbent material to stop bleeding.
items.ex_en: Field medics moved swiftly to tampon the severe arterial wound before shock set in.
items.ex_zh: 战地医护人员迅速填塞止血以处理严重的动脉伤口，防止伤员休克。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on forcing an absorbent pad, mechanical plug, or dense mass into an orifice, puncture, or wound cavity to stem liquid leakage (notably blood), prevent airflow, or stabilize internal pressure.
groups.summary_zh: 指用材料填塞腔体、孔洞或伤口以止血或阻止流体外泄。
groups.desc_en: Sealing, stopping up, or filling an opening or void tightly with dense matter, contrasting with passive covering by highlighting forced mechanical intrusion and occlusion.
groups.desc_zh: 使用致密材料用力填塞、封堵孔洞或裂隙，与表面遮盖不同，强调机械性的挤压、堵死与密闭。
groups.nuance_en: plug: seal a hole or leak firmly with an insert or suitable material (hole / leak / gap) · pack: compress bulk materials tightly into a container, wound, or cavity (wound / trunk / snow) · tamp down: compact down loose matter with light, repeated downward strikes (soil / tobacco / ground) · wad: roll or press pliable material into a soft compact ball to stuff an aperture (paper / cloth / notes) · tampon: plug a cavity or surgical wound firmly with an absorbent pad or swab (wound / bleeding / cavity)
groups.nuance_zh: plug: 塞住孔洞防止泄漏 (hole / leak / gap) · pack: 将松软材料紧密充填进腔体或伤口 (wound / trunk / snow) · tamp down: 反复轻力向下捣实夯平 (soil / tobacco / ground) · wad: 将软物揉捏成团塞住缝隙 (paper / cloth / notes) · tampon: 用止血填塞物紧塞创口 (wound / bleeding / cavity)

groups.name: Pock & Pit Surfaces · 使呈麻点与凹陷坑痕 (Pock, Pit, Scar, Dappling)
groups.tip: 留下麻点凹坑破坏完好

items.def_en: To make a notch, hollow, or impression in the surface or edge of something
items.ex_en: Heavy furniture can permanently indent the soft fibers of this expensive wool carpet.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的家具会在这块昂贵的羊毛地毯的柔软纤维上压出永久性凹痕。
items.ex2_en: The soft wooden surface indents easily under the pressure of sharp fingernails.
items.ex2_zh: 在锋利指甲的按压下，柔软的木质表面很容易产生凹痕。

items.def_zh: 使留伤疤；留下永久痕迹
items.def_en: To mark skin or a landscape with permanent tissue damage, marks, or deep disfigurements
items.ex_en: Decades of open-pit mining continue to scar the once pristine mountain landscape.
items.ex_zh: 数十年的露天开采仍在使这片曾原生态的山峦地貌饱受摧残。

items.def_en: To mark a surface or skin with numerous small hollow depressions or cavities
items.ex_en: Acid rain will gradually pit the smooth limestone facade of the ancient cathedral.
items.ex_zh: 酸雨会逐渐腐蚀古老教堂光滑的石灰石外墙，使其布满坑洼。

items.def_zh: 使有麻点，使留痘痕或凹坑
items.def_en: 1. (usually passive) To mark a surface or skin with small pits, hollow marks, or scars.
items.ex_en: Ancient wars continued to pock the castle walls with deep, jagged bullet marks.
items.ex_zh: 昔日的战争给城堡外墙留下了斑斑驳驳的深陷弹坑与残痕。

items.def_en: To form large bowl-shaped depressions or cavities across a landscape or surface
items.ex_en: Relentless artillery fire managed to crater the barren fields surrounding the besieged outpost.
items.ex_zh: 持续不断的炮火在被围困的前哨基地周围的荒原上炸满了弹坑。
items.ex2_en: The old asphalt road cratered severely during the brutal winter freeze.
items.ex2_zh: 这条老旧沥青路在残酷的冬日严寒中出现了严重的坑洼破损。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe marking or disfiguring a surface or skin with many small indentations, hollow pits, craters, or corrosive depressions.
groups.summary_zh: 使物体表面或皮肤密布凹坑、麻点、疤痕或凹印。
groups.desc_en: Marking, eroding, or scarring a smooth exterior with depressions or blemishes, contrasting with smooth wear or clean cutting by producing rough, uneven surface topography.
groups.desc_zh: 通过凹坑、疤痕或斑痕破坏平整外表，与平滑磨损或利落切削不同，强调表面呈现凹凸不平的破损形态。
groups.nuance_en: indent: creates regular or mechanical recesses (margin / shoreline) · pit: erodes into tiny dispersed hollows through corrosion or age (metal / skin) · pock: disfigures with clustered round marks (surface / face) · scar: leaves lasting trauma or deep structural disfigurement (landscape / psyche) · crater: blasts or collapses into massive hollows (runway / economy)
groups.nuance_zh: indent: 压出规则或机械性凹痕 (margin / shoreline) · pit: 因腐蚀或老化形成细密凹点 (metal / skin) · pock: 留下密集的痘痕状凹斑 (surface / face) · scar: 留下持久创伤或破坏性瘢痕 (landscape / psyche) · crater: 轰击或崩塌成巨大深坑 (runway / economy)

groups.name: Poetic Phonetics & Verse Devices · 音律修辞与押韵 (Alliterate, Rhyme, Assonate)
