groups.tip: 押头韵或依音律节奏朗诵排列

items.def_en: To end with the same final vowel and consonant sound as another word
items.ex_en: The poet struggled to find a single suitable word that would rhyme with orange.
items.ex_zh: 这位诗人苦于找不到一个能与“orange”押韵的合适词语。
items.ex2_en: The lyricist rhymed simple verses to compose a memorable children's song.
items.ex2_zh: 词作者将简单的诗句押韵，谱写了一首朗朗上口的儿歌。

items.def_en: To produce harmonious, matching, or melodious poetic sounds
items.ex_en: The soft syllables chime together beautifully throughout the final stanza of the ballad.
items.ex_zh: 在这首民谣的最后一节中，轻柔的音节彼此优美谐音。
items.ex2_en: The clock mechanism chimed the gentle bells precisely on the hour.
items.ex2_zh: 时钟机构在每个整点准确地鸣响悦耳的铃声。

items.def_en: To exhibit resonance or resemblance of internal vowel sounds in nearby words
items.ex_en: The lyrical vowels in the chorus assonate softly, creating a melancholic musical effect.
items.ex_zh: 副歌中抒情的元音隐隐押韵，营造出一种忧郁的音乐效果。

items.def_en: To repeat consonant patterns in proximity while having differing vowel sounds
items.ex_en: The poet carefully arranged consonants that consonate throughout the sombre, haunting verse.
items.ex_zh: 诗人巧妙地编排了辅音，使其在整首阴郁而难忘的诗篇中协和作响。

items.def_en: (of words or phrases) To begin with the same consonant sound or letter for poetic or literary effect.
items.ex_en: He deliberately chose to alliterate neighboring words to enhance the rhythm of his prose.
items.ex_zh: 他特意让相邻的词押头韵，以增强散文的节奏感。

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies linguistic and poetic articulation techniques where words are deliberately arranged according to recurring consonant or vowel sound patterns.
groups.summary_zh: 指向诗歌文学中头韵、尾韵等声音共鸣与对称修辞手法。
groups.desc_en: Structuring verbal elements through calculated sonic correspondences, contrasting with general rhythmic meter by focusing specifically on phonemic matching across words.
groups.desc_zh: 通过精密的语音对应组织语言，与一般韵律节拍不同，特指跨词汇的音素匹配与声韵修辞。
groups.nuance_en: rhyme: matches identical terminal vowel and consonant sounds (verse / couplet) · chime: rings out with melodious acoustic agreement (bells / words) · assonate: echoes similar vowel sounds amidst differing consonants (syllables / lines) · consonate: harmonizes through repeated consonant frames (sounds / phonemes) · alliterate: repeats matching initial consonant sounds (words / phrases)
groups.nuance_zh: rhyme: 押尾韵，使末端元音与辅音呼应 (verse / couplet) · chime: 悦耳鸣响或声调谐和 (bells / words) · assonate: 押元音韵，在不同辅音间呼应元音 (syllables / lines) · consonate: 辅音谐音，通过辅音骨架形成共鸣 (sounds / phonemes) · alliterate: 押头韵，连续词首辅音重复 (words / phrases)

groups.name: Point & Gesture · 指向与标示 (Point, Indicate, Gesture)
groups.tip: 引导视线或标明具体方向

items.def_zh: 指，指向；指明，指出；对准，瞄准
items.def_en: 1. To direct someone's attention toward a place, direction, person, or thing by extending a finger or object. 2. To aim or direct something at someone or something
items.ex_en: She raised her finger to point toward the abandoned lighthouse along the distant shoreline.
items.ex_zh: 她抬起手指，指向远方海岸线上那座废弃的灯塔。

items.def_en: To indicate direction or intent using a gesture, movement, or signaling device
items.ex_en: The officer will signal for the convoy to stop at the checkpoint immediately.
items.ex_zh: 警官将示意车队立即在检查站停下。

items.def_zh: 打手势示意（方向或动作）
items.def_en: To direct someone toward a place or action with a movement of your hand or head
items.ex_en: The hostess chose to motion the guests toward the spacious dining room for dinner.
items.ex_zh: 女主人打手势示意客人们前往宽敞的餐厅就餐。

items.def_en: To direct someone's attention to someone or something by pointing with a finger or mentioning them
items.ex_en: I must point out that your current calculations contain a critical mathematical error.
items.ex_zh: 我必须指出，你目前的计算中包含一个严重的数学错误。

items.def_en: To move your hands, head, or arms to direct attention toward something or someone
items.ex_en: He had to gesture wildly toward the exit when the fire alarm began blaring.
items.ex_zh: 当火警警报大作时，他只得拼命打手势指向出口。

groups.summary_en: These verbs focus on directing physical or visual attention toward an object, person, or coordinate using gestures, limbs, or physical markers. The frame centers on spatial and physical orientation rather than symbolic meaning.
groups.summary_zh: 指借助肢体动作、手势或实体标记在空间上标示方位与对象。
groups.desc_en: Directing physical attention toward an external referent or conveying intent through bodily signifiers, contrasting with spoken articulation by using spatial orientation and non-verbal cues.
groups.desc_zh: 通过肢体符号或方位指涉引导外部注意力，与言语表述不同，依托空间指向与非语言手势传递意图。
groups.nuance_en: point: aims an index finger or sharp focus directly at a target (finger / weapon) · signal: transmits an encoded or urgent alert (intention / alarm) · motion: guides movement via sweeping bodily directives (hand / head) · point out: draws conscious cognitive notice to a specific detail (flaw / fact) · gesture: expresses a symbolic attitude or feeling via posture (disapproval / welcome)
groups.nuance_zh: point: 用手指或锐物直接指向目标 (finger / weapon) · signal: 传递编码化或紧急的信号 (intention / alarm) · motion: 以手势或点头示意移动方向 (hand / head) · point out: 唤起对特定细节的认知注意 (flaw / fact) · gesture: 通过姿态动作表达象征性态度 (disapproval / welcome)

groups.name: Poke & Nudge · 戳捅与轻推促动 (Prod, Poke, Nudge)
groups.tip: 用尖状物反复戳捅推撞

items.def_en: To push someone gently with your elbow or hand, especially to attract attention
items.ex_en: She had to nudge him gently to keep him awake during the lecture.
items.ex_zh: 在讲座期间，她不得不轻轻推他一下，好让他保持清醒。

items.def_en: To quickly push a finger, sharp object, or stick into someone or something
items.ex_en: The boy used a dry stick to poke the smoldering embers of the campfire.
items.ex_zh: 那个男孩用一根干木棍去捅营火中还在冒烟的余烬。

items.def_en: To give a slight push or shake to someone, or stimulate a memory gently
items.ex_en: Looking at old photographs might jog your memory about that forgotten childhood trip.
items.ex_zh: 看旧照片或许能唤起你对那次被遗忘的童年旅行的记忆。

items.def_en: 1. To push someone or something with a finger or a pointed object. 2. To encourage or remind someone to do something.
items.ex_en: The supervisor had to prod the lazy workers to meet the weekly production quota.
items.ex_zh: 主管不得不督促那些懒散的工人，以达到每周的生产配额。

items.def_en: To push a sharp or blunt object abruptly, roughly, and hard into something
items.ex_en: He tried to jab his elbow backward into the assailant to escape captivity.
items.ex_zh: 他试图猛地用手肘往后猛击袭击者以摆脱控制。

groups.summary_en: Involves tactile contact using a finger, elbow, or blunt implement to draw attention, stir movement, or prompt action, smoothly transitioning to mental urging or nagging.
groups.summary_zh: 指用手指、胳膊肘或棍棒轻推、戳捅以引起注意或督促行动。
groups.desc_en: Delivering a localized, short-range physical thrust to stimulate movement or alert awareness, contrasting with continuous pushing or striking by being intermittent, prompting, or disruptive.
groups.desc_zh: 施加局部、短距离的身体顶触以促成移动或唤起警觉，与持续推拉或重击不同，强调间歇性、促动性或扰动感。
groups.nuance_en: nudge: gives a gentle elbow-tap to prompt or hint (elbow / neighbor) · poke: thrusts a finger or pointed object inquisitively or annoyingly (ribs / fire) · jog: jolts slightly to shake loose or activate (memory / elbow) · prod: pushes insistently with a sharp tip to compel action (cattle / conscience) · jab: drives a quick, sharp, aggressive thrust (needle / chin)
groups.nuance_zh: nudge: 用肘轻推以暗示或提醒 (elbow / neighbor) · poke: 用手指或尖端探弄或戳弄 (ribs / fire) · jog: 轻震以唤醒或促动 (memory / elbow) · prod: 用尖物反复扎刺以强迫行动 (cattle / conscience) · jab: 短促、尖锐且带攻击性地猛刺 (needle / chin)

groups.name: Poke & Pierce · 刺破与扎穿 (Puncture, Pierce, Perforate)
groups.tip: 尖物扎入并贯穿孔洞

items.def_en: To make a very small hole in skin or a surface with a needle or sharp point
items.ex_en: Be very careful not to prick your fingers on those sharp sewing needles.
items.ex_zh: 务必小心，千万别被那些锋利的缝衣针扎破了手指。

items.def_zh: 刺穿，刺破；揭穿，削弱；（轮胎等）被刺破
items.def_en: 1. To make a small hole in something with a sharp point, or to develop such a hole. 2. To suddenly lessen or destroy someone's confidence, pride, or enthusiasm.
items.ex_en: A sharp piece of glass managed to puncture the front tire of my bicycle.
items.ex_zh: 一片尖锐的玻璃刺破了我自行车的车胎。
items.ex2_en: The bicycle tire punctured abruptly after rolling over sharp metal scrap.
items.ex2_zh: 自行车轮胎碾过锋利的金属碎屑后突然爆破了。

items.def_en: To make a hole in or through something with a sharp, pointed object
items.ex_en: The sharp arrow did pierce the thick leather shield during the intense battle.
items.ex_zh: 在激烈的战斗中，利箭射穿了厚重的皮质盾牌。

items.def_en: To make a series of small holes in something, or puncture an internal organ
items.ex_en: Severe untreated ulcers can eventually perforate the delicate wall of the human stomach.
items.ex_zh: 严重的未经治疗的溃疡最终可能导致人体脆弱的胃壁穿孔。

items.def_en: To push a sharp, pointed stake or weapon entirely through someone's body
items.ex_en: Ancient armies would impale fallen enemy soldiers on wooden stakes as a warning.
items.ex_zh: 古代军队会将阵亡的敌兵刺穿在尖木桩上作为警告。

groups.summary_en: Describes sharp mechanical penetration that breaches an outer envelope, membrane, or barrier. Encompasses surgical incisions, pneumatic punctures, and metaphoric deflation of arrogance.
groups.summary_zh: 指尖锐物体刺透外皮、隔膜或屏障造成孔洞，亦指戳破气焰。
groups.desc_en: Breaching a boundary or surface along a narrow trajectory with a pointed implement, contrasting with broad impact or blunt trauma by concentrating force into a puncturing point.
groups.desc_zh: 使用尖锐工具沿狭窄轨迹破开边界或表面，与面状撞击或钝器创伤不同，强调点状受力与穿透性破坏。
groups.nuance_en: prick: penetrates minutely on the outermost surface (finger / balloon) · puncture: makes an accidental or functional hole that compromises integrity (tire / lung) · pierce: passes cleanly through an obstacle or barrier (ears / darkness) · perforate: punches a systematic series of holes along a line (sheet / bowel) · impale: runs completely through on a fixed stake or blade (victim / spear)
groups.nuance_zh: prick: 表层微创刺破 (finger / balloon) · puncture: 刺破或戳出导致漏气、失能的孔洞 (tire / lung) · pierce: 利落地刺穿隔阂或屏障 (ears / darkness) · perforate: 沿线打出一排孔或穿孔透漏 (sheet / bowel) · impale: 用尖桩或尖刃彻底刺穿固定 (victim / spear)

groups.name: Polarize & Alienate · 分化与离间 (Factionalize, Estrange, Drive a wedge)
groups.tip: 挑动对立使阵营彻底两极化

items.def_en: To make someone feel isolated, estranged, or hostile toward others
items.ex_en: Such divisive political rhetoric will only serve to alienate moderate voters across the country.
items.ex_zh: 这种分化人心的政治言论只会使全国的温和派选民感到疏远。

items.def_en: To act in a way that damages or destroys harmonious relations between people or groups
items.ex_en: Invidious gossip can drive a wedge between even the most loyal lifelong friends.
items.ex_zh: 恶意的流言蜚语甚至会在最忠诚的毕生好友之间制造隔阂。

items.def_en: To break or cause a political party, group, or organization to divide into smaller warring factions
items.ex_en: Ideological disputes threaten to splinter the governing coalition into several hostile minor factions.
items.ex_zh: 意识形态分歧可能会使执政联盟裂解为若干互相敌对的小派系。
items.ex2_en: The brittle wooden railing splintered into jagged fragments during the impact.
items.ex2_zh: 在撞击中，脆弱的木制栏杆碎裂成了参差不齐的碎片。

items.def_en: To cause someone to stop being friendly or affectionate toward family or friends
items.ex_en: His reckless gambling addiction began to estrange him from his wife and children.
items.ex_zh: 他肆无忌惮的赌瘾开始使他与妻子和孩子反目疏离。

items.def_zh: （使）两极分化，（使）截然对立；（物理）（使）偏振，（使）极化
items.def_en: 1. To cause people or opinions to divide sharply into two completely opposing camps. 2. (physics) To restrict the vibrations of a wave, especially light, wholly or partially to one direction.
items.ex_en: Controversial cultural issues tend to polarise public opinion along strict party lines.
items.ex_zh: 具有争议的文化议题往往会使公众舆论按照严格的党派界线截然对立。
items.ex2_en: The voting electorate polarised sharply into two hostile ideological factions recently.
items.ex2_zh: 选民最近急剧分化为两个敌对的意识形态派系。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey dividing groups or individuals into sharply opposing, hostile factions, or severing emotional bonds. They emphasize the creation of ideological rifts, animosity, or social estrangement.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重制造对立阵营、瓦解团结或使群体与人际关系产生深刻裂痕。
groups.desc_en: Severing relational bonds or driving groups into antagonistic extremes, contrasting with natural drift by highlighting active division, social estrangement, and irreconcilable hostility.
groups.desc_zh: 斩断关系纽带或将群体推向对立极端，与自然的疏远不同，强调主动离间、社会隔阂与不可调和的对立化。
groups.nuance_en: alienate: turns sympathetic supporters into hostile outsiders (voters / allies) · drive a wedge between: exploits divisions to split two united parties (friends / partners) · splinter: breaks a coherent whole into competing fragments (party / faction) · estrange: slowly erodes personal emotional attachment (spouse / family) · polarise: forces opinion into two diametrically opposed camps (society / electorate)
groups.nuance_zh: alienate: 使同盟或支持者心生反感而疏离 (voters / allies) · drive a wedge between: 插入楔子挑拨瓦解二者关系 (friends / partners) · splinter: 使统一实体分裂成碎片化派系 (party / faction) · estrange: 渐进式切断亲近的情感纽带 (spouse / family) · polarise: 促使舆论走向两极对立 (society / electorate)

groups.name: Police & Patrol · 治安与巡卫 (Patrol, Guard, Regulate)
groups.tip: 治安巡查与秩序维护

items.def_en: 1. To keep order and maintain security in an area using police or armed patrols; to control or supervise an activity to ensure rules are kept.
items.ex_en: Local authorities must adequately police the festival grounds to ensure public safety throughout.
items.ex_zh: 地方当局必须在节日场地充分维持治安，以确保全程的公众安全。

items.def_en: To watch over in order to protect against assault, escape, or infringement
items.ex_en: Trained security dogs guard the perimeter of the research facility against unauthorized intruders.
items.ex_zh: 受训的警犬守卫着科研设施的周边，防止未经授权的入侵者进入。

items.def_en: To control an activity, industry, or public behavior using detailed rules and standards
items.ex_en: Independent regulatory agencies must regulate financial markets to prevent systematic consumer exploitation.
items.ex_zh: 独立的监管机构必须对金融市场进行规范，以防止系统性侵害消费者利益。

items.def_en: To walk or drive around an area regularly to prevent crime or ensure security
items.ex_en: Armed security officers patrol the premises regularly to deter any potential criminal activity.
items.ex_zh: 武装安保人员定期在建筑周围巡逻，以震慑任何潜在的犯罪行为。

items.def_en: To stay in a designated post alertly to monitor security and prevent intrusion
items.ex_en: Elite soldiers will stand guard outside the royal residence throughout the entire night.
items.ex_zh: 精锐士兵将在整个夜间坚守在皇家住所外站岗警戒。

groups.summary_en: This frame relates to exercising law enforcement, guarding public order, making regular rounds of security, or supervising compliance with rules.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过巡逻、护卫等行政安保手段维持秩序与监督法规。
groups.desc_en: Maintaining operational order and monitoring a defined perimeter for security, contrasting with passive waiting by entailing active surveillance, enforcement, and deterrence.
groups.desc_zh: 在划定区域内维持秩序并进行安全监控，与消极等待不同，强调主动巡查、规训执法与警戒威慑。
groups.nuance_en: police: enforces rules and maintains civil order (streets / community) · guard: shields a specific asset or entrance against attack (gate / prisoner) · regulate: controls processes through statutory standards (market / industry) · patrol: moves systematically along a beat for proactive reconnaissance (border / perimeter) · stand guard: holds an alert, stationary post as a vigilant sentry (duty / post)
groups.nuance_zh: police: 维持公共秩序并监督合规 (streets / community) · guard: 严密看守特定资产或出入口 (gate / prisoner) · regulate: 依据章程规制与约束机制 (market / industry) · patrol: 沿规定路线穿梭巡逻排查 (border / perimeter) · stand guard: 站岗放哨，保持静止警戒 (duty / post)

groups.name: Polish & Refine · 润色与完善 (Polish up, Finesse, Tweak)
groups.tip: 由粗糙磨砺到精益求精的完善

items.def_en: To make someone or something look much neater, cleaner, and more stylish with quick adjustments
items.ex_en: We should spruce up the living room with fresh flowers before guests arrive.
items.ex_zh: 在客人到来之前，我们应该用鲜花把客厅好好收拾打扮一下。

items.def_zh: 重温；打磨修整；使更完美
items.def_en: To practice, review, or edit something so as to bring it to a high, flawless standard
items.ex_en: I need to polish up my Spanish before travelling to Madrid.
items.ex_zh: 去马德里之前，我需要重新温习一下我的西班牙语。

items.def_zh: 擦亮，磨光；润色，修饰；变光滑发亮
items.def_en: 1. To make something smooth and shiny by rubbing it. 2. To improve or refine a piece of work by making minor changes.
items.ex_en: She spent the afternoon trying to polish her comprehensive academic essay before submission.
items.ex_zh: 她在下午花时间对自己的综合性学术论文进行了润色，然后才提交。

items.def_en: To make subtle improvements to an idea, method, or text in order to make it more elegant or precise
items.ex_en: Engineers continually work to refine the design to improve fuel efficiency and performance.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们不断改进设计，以提高燃油效率和整体性能。

items.def_en: To adjust or handle something with great delicacy, tactical skill, or artistic craftsmanship
items.ex_en: The diplomat managed to finesse the delicate peace negotiations to a successful conclusion.
items.ex_zh: 这位外交官巧妙地斡旋处理了棘手的和平谈判，最终圆满收场。

groups.summary_en: Covers both the physical act of brightening a surface and the pervasive figurative extension of improving drafts, speeches, or skills through small, elegant adjustments to eliminate residual clumsiness.
groups.summary_zh: 指物理抛光或对文字、技能、方案进行精修润色，祛除瑕疵。
groups.desc_en: Elevating the quality, aesthetic finish, or technical precision of an existing work, contrasting with wholesale creation or structural rebuilding by focusing on subtle, high-level enhancements.
groups.desc_zh: 提升已有成果的质感、外观或技术精度，与从零创造或结构重组不同，侧重于末梢层面的精工细琢。
groups.nuance_en: spruce up: gives a brisk cosmetic freshening (room / appearance) · polish up: rubs off rust and restores ready shine to a rusty skill (draft / skills) · polish: buffs a surface or text to flawless smoothness (prose / speech) · refine: purges crude impurities to reach higher elegance or purity (technique / method) · finesse: handles a delicate situation with cunning subtlety (deal / situation)
groups.nuance_zh: spruce up: 快速打扮修饰以焕然一新 (room / appearance) · polish up: 擦亮恢复荒废的技能或草案 (draft / skills) · polish: 精雕细琢使文字或表面光润无暇 (prose / speech) · refine: 提纯去杂，升华理论或技艺 (technique / method) · finesse: 凭借高超手腕巧妙周旋推敲 (deal / situation)

groups.name: Political Unification & Federation · 联邦化与政治联合 (Federalize, Confederate, Centralize)
groups.tip: 建立联邦达成组织联合

items.def_en: To combine diverse political, economic, or territorial systems into a harmonious, functioning whole
items.ex_en: The treaty aims to integrate the regional economies into a unified common market.
items.ex_zh: 该条约旨在将各区域经济体整合为一个统一的共同市场。
items.ex2_en: The different public transport networks integrated into a single seamless transit system.
items.ex2_zh: 不同的公共交通网络融合成了一个顺畅统一的出行系统。

items.def_en: To unite or form an alliance of states, bodies, or individuals into a loose political federation
items.ex_en: Several rebellious provinces chose to confederate in order to resist the tyrannical imperial regime.
items.ex_zh: 几个反叛的省份选择结成同盟，以抵抗暴虐的帝国统治。
items.ex2_en: The visionary regional leaders confederated the scattered territories into a defensive alliance.
items.ex2_zh: 有远见的地区领导人将分散的领土联合成了一个防御联盟。

items.def_en: To consolidate authority, administration, or control under a single central governing body
items.ex_en: The newly elected administration plans to centralize tax collection under a single ministerial office.
items.ex_zh: 新当选的政府计划将税收权集中归于单一的部级机构管辖。

items.def_en: To join together or organize distinct states or organizations into a unified federal framework
items.ex_en: The dispersed trade unions agreed to federate into a unified national assembly next spring.
items.ex_zh: 分散的工会同意在明年春天联合组建一个全国性的联邦组织。
items.ex2_en: The constitution successfully federated the independent provinces into a single sovereign state.
items.ex2_zh: 宪法成功地将各个独立的省份联合成为一个单一的主权国家。

items.def_zh: 使形成联邦，使联盟；归联邦管辖
items.def_en: 1. To unite separate states under a central federal government, or bring an issue or agency under federal authority.
items.ex_en: Lawmakers recently voted to federalize airport security across all major domestic transit hubs.
items.ex_zh: 议员们最近投票决定将所有主要国内交通枢纽的机场安保收归联邦管辖。
items.ex2_en: The scattered independent territories federalized gradually over several turbulent decades.
items.ex2_zh: 分散的独立领地在数个动荡的十年中逐渐形成了联邦制。

groups.summary_en: This constitutional and institutional frame involves binding distinct regional territories, states, or autonomous entities into an organized political union under a centralized governing authority, transferring local powers to the federal level.
groups.summary_zh: 特指将分散的地方、邦国或机构整合并入中央联邦体系的建制行为。
groups.desc_en: Subsuming distinct political polities into a shared overarching governance architecture, contrasting with military conquest by implying constitutional integration and division of jurisdictional sovereignty.
groups.desc_zh: 将独立政治实体收归统摄于共享治理架构之下，与武力兼并不同，特指通过宪政机制进行权力整合与主权再分配。
groups.nuance_en: integrate: blends disparate elements smoothly into a functioning whole (system / region) · confederate: leagues autonomous states in a loose alliance (states / tribes) · centralize: pulls authority and power inward toward a single core (power / bureaucracy) · federate: unites distinct territories under a constitutional covenant (colonies / unions) · federalize: brings local functions or state entities under national federal control (forces / program)
groups.nuance_zh: integrate: 融为有机运行的一体化系统 (system / region) · confederate: 邦联化，建立保留高度自主的松散同盟 (states / tribes) · centralize: 集权化，将分散权力向中枢收拢 (power / bureaucracy) · federate: 依宪法契约结成联邦体系 (colonies / unions) · federalize: 联邦化，将地方事务或军队收归联邦管辖 (forces / program)

groups.name: Pollute & Contaminate · 污染与玷污 (Pollute, Taint, Defile)
groups.tip: 混入有害物破坏纯净

items.def_en: 1. To make a substance or place impure, dirty, or dangerous by adding a harmful or toxic agent.
items.ex_en: Toxic runoff from the abandoned plant continues to contaminate the regional drinking water supply.
items.ex_zh: 废弃工厂排出的有毒废液继续污染着该地区的饮用水源。

items.def_en: To make land, air, or water dirty and dangerous by adding harmful chemicals or waste
items.ex_en: Untreated plastic waste and chemical discharge severely pollute coastal fishing grounds every year.
items.ex_zh: 未经处理的塑料垃圾和化学废水每年都严重污染近海渔场。

items.def_en: To spoil or damage the purity, taste, or reputation of something slightly but noticeably
items.ex_en: Unsubstantiated bribery allegations continue to taint the veteran politician’s once pristine public reputation.
items.ex_zh: 未经证实的受贿指控继续玷污着这位资深政治家昔日清白的公众声誉。

items.def_en: To spoil something sacred, pure, or beautiful with deliberate disrespect or filth
items.ex_en: Vandals entered the ancient sanctuary at midnight to defile the sacred marble altar.
items.ex_zh: 破坏者在半夜闯入这座古老圣所，亵渎了神圣的大理石祭坛。

items.def_en: To make foul, filthy, or disgusting with dirt or sewage
items.ex_en: Foul industrial sludge threatened to befoul the pristine crystal streams of the woodland valley.
items.ex_zh: 恶臭的工业污泥威胁要弄脏林地山谷中清澈纯净的溪流。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to introducing impurities, toxins, or moral corruptions that spoil the cleanliness, integrity, or safety of a substance, environment, or reputation.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过有毒有害物质或道德污渍破坏纯洁与安全。
groups.desc_en: Introducing foreign, toxic, or spiritually degrading matter into an otherwise pure medium, contrasting with dry wear or mechanical breakage by compromising purity, health, or sacred integrity.
groups.desc_zh: 将外来毒害或堕落成分注入纯净介质，与单纯物理磨损不同，强调对洁净度、健康性或神圣性的实质玷污。
groups.nuance_en: contaminate: adulterates a clean substance with dangerous contact (water / sample) · pollute: discharges widespread environmental harm into natural systems (air / rivers) · taint: mars a pure reputation or flavor with a slight trace of corruption (reputation / legacy) · defile: violates and desacralizes what is sacred or inviolate (sanctuary / honor) · befoul: coats or chokes with foul, disgusting filth (waters / nest)
groups.nuance_zh: contaminate: 触碰混入杂质或病原而致污染 (water / sample) · pollute: 大规模向自然系统排放有害废料 (air / rivers) · taint: 微量渗入致使风味败坏或名誉受污 (reputation / legacy) · defile: 亵渎神圣或纯洁之物使其蒙尘 (sanctuary / honor) · befoul: 用污秽恶臭之物弄脏搞臭 (waters / nest)

groups.name: Pool & Centralize · 归拢与统筹聚合 (Pool, Amalgamate, Centralize)
groups.tip: 聚集各方资源共同使用

items.def_en: To join with several people to collect a shared sum of money for a common purchase
items.ex_en: All the office staff decided to club together to buy a retirement gift.
items.ex_zh: 办公室的所有员工决定凑钱买一份退休礼物。

items.def_zh: 合伙汇集，共用（资金、资源或想法）；汇成水潭
items.def_en: 1. to collect together money, equipment, or ideas from different people or groups for shared use 2. (of liquid) to collect in a pool or puddle
items.ex_en: Participating hospitals will pool their patient data to accelerate breakthrough medical research across borders.
items.ex_zh: 参与医院将汇集其患者数据，以加速跨国的突破性医学研究。

items.def_en: To bring together different things such as funds, debts, or businesses into a single unified whole
items.ex_en: The university decided to consolidate several departmental libraries into one modern learning center.
items.ex_zh: 大学决定将几个院系图书馆整合为一个现代化的学习中心。
items.ex2_en: The smaller market debts consolidated naturally under the restructured loan agreement.
items.ex2_zh: 在重组的贷款协议下，较小的市场债务自然合并在了一起。

items.def_en: To bring the control and distribution of resources or activities under one single central authority
items.ex_en: The multinational corporation chose to centralize procurement operations to reduce needless administrative expenditure.
items.ex_zh: 这家跨国公司选择集权管理采购业务，以减少不必要的行政开支。

items.def_en: To merge different organizations, resources, or operations into one single group
items.ex_en: The two regional telecommunications firms announced plans to amalgamate into a competitive giant.
items.ex_zh: 这两家地区性电信公司宣布计划合并成为一个具有竞争力的行业巨头。
items.ex2_en: The corporate merger will amalgamate several regional banks into one national institution.
items.ex2_zh: 这次企业并购将把数家地方银行合并为一家全国性机构。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the strategic combining of disparate assets, funds, or materials into a unified collective cache. The focus is on consolidating divided resources so they can be managed more efficiently or deployed for common benefit.
groups.summary_zh: 强调将分散的资金、物资集中归拢以便统筹使用。
groups.desc_en: Aggregating fragmented individual resources into a common reservoir for optimized collective strength, contrasting with simple hoarding by demanding mutual contribution and unified strategic deployment.
groups.desc_zh: 将分散的个体资源聚拢至公共资源池以最大化协同效益，与单纯积攒不同，强调共同分摊与集中统筹调度。
groups.nuance_en: club together: chips in petty personal funds for a joint purchase (friends / money) · pool: combines collective assets, data, or risks for mutual leverage (resources / talent) · consolidate: welds scattered parts into a dense, solid, unified bloc (power / debts) · centralize: shifts control of distributed functions to a single governing hub (authority / operations) · amalgamate: blends structurally distinct bodies into one composite whole (companies / unions)
groups.nuance_zh: club together: 凑钱或搭伙凑份子以共同消费 (friends / money) · pool: 集中调配资源、资金或数据以共担共享 (resources / talent) · consolidate: 盘活整合零散板块以巩固强化 (power / debts) · centralize: 将分散的管理权归拢至指挥中枢 (authority / operations) · amalgamate: 兼并融合不同实体以成复合整体 (companies / unions)

groups.name: Portray & Delineate Vividly · 传神描摹与细致刻画 (Limn, Delineate, Depict)
groups.tip: 用生动文字刻画描摹形象

items.def_en: To make a brief or quick drawing or description giving only the essential outlines
items.ex_en: The architect took a few minutes to sketch the basic outline of the facade.
items.ex_zh: 建筑师花了几分钟粗略勾勒出建筑立面的基本轮廓。

items.def_en: To represent someone or something in a picture, sculpture, or detailed verbal description
items.ex_en: The classic Renaissance frescoes depict heroic scenes of martyrdom and profound spiritual devotion.
items.ex_zh: 经典的文艺复兴壁画描绘了殉道与虔诚信仰的英勇场景。

items.def_en: To show or describe someone or something in a particular way in art, film, or literature
items.ex_en: Biographical films rarely portray historical figures with complete and unvarnished emotional accuracy.
items.ex_zh: 传记电影很少能带着完整且不加掩饰的情感准确度去描绘历史人物。

items.def_en: To describe, portray, or outline with sharp precision and exact boundary definitions
items.ex_en: The updated maritime treaty serves to delineate international territorial boundaries with absolute precision.
items.ex_zh: 这份更新的海事条约用于极其精确地划定国际领土边界。

items.def_en: To depict or describe something vividly in words; to draw or paint.
items.ex_en: Poetic verses in the ancient chronicle vividly limn the sorrows of the forgotten empress.
items.ex_zh: 古老编年史中的诗篇生动地刻画了那位被遗忘皇后的哀愁。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses descriptive representation—in painting or literature—where artists and writers render scenes, contours, and character features with exceptional clarity.
groups.summary_zh: 用文字或笔触生动刻画轮廓细节，生动呈现形象。
groups.desc_en: Translating perception, character, or form into an evocative visual or verbal representation, contrasting with generic listing by capturing the exact contours, nuances, and vivid essence of the subject.
groups.desc_zh: 将感官、性格或形态转化为传神的视觉或文本再现，与一般罗列不同，侧重精准捕捉对象的轮廓特质与神韵。
groups.nuance_en: sketch: lays down rapid, minimal preliminary contours (outline / character) · depict: represents an objective likeness or scene in detail (scene / reality) · portray: captures subjective internal character through a chosen lens (hero / villain) · delineate: maps exact boundaries, arguments, or lines with analytic precision (border / features) · limn: renders with luminous clarity or ornate poetic delicacy (portrait / agony)
groups.nuance_zh: sketch: 快速勾勒轮廓或简要草描 (outline / character) · depict: 详尽具象地描摹再现场景或现实 (scene / reality) · portray: 带着特定视角刻画塑造人物内在 (hero / villain) · delineate: 精准条分缕析勾画界线或要点 (border / features) · limn: 用生动光彩或细腻文笔精妙刻画 (portrait / agony)

groups.name: Pose & Present · 提出与呈现 (Present, Postulate, Put forward)
groups.tip: 将方案或问题正式摆上台面

items.def_en: To introduce or cause an issue, challenge, or question to arise and be dealt with
items.ex_en: Rapidly shifting climate patterns present unprecedented logistical hurdles for emergency disaster relief workers.
items.ex_zh: 瞬息万变的气候模式给紧急灾难救援人员带来了前所未有的后勤困难。

items.def_en: To introduce a subject or question for consideration or debate
items.ex_en: Several board members intend to raise pressing safety concerns during tomorrow's executive meeting.
items.ex_zh: 几位董事会成员打算在明天的执行会议上抛出紧迫的安全隐患问题。

items.def_zh: 提出（问题、疑问等）；造成，引起（威胁、风险等）；摆姿势
items.def_en: 1. To put forward a question, problem, or suggestion for consideration. 2. To create or cause a threat, danger, or difficulty. 3. To assume a particular position for a picture or artist.
items.ex_en: Aging civil infrastructure will inevitably pose serious security hazards for future generations.
items.ex_zh: 老化的民用基础设施不可避免地会给子孙后代带来严重的安全隐患。

items.def_en: To suggest an idea, proposition, or candidate for people to discuss or decide upon
items.ex_en: The senior research committee decided to put forward a bold alternative economic strategy.
items.ex_zh: 资深研究委员会决定提出一项大胆的替代性经济战略。

items.def_en: To suggest or assume the existence, fact, or truth of something as a basis for reasoning
items.ex_en: Theoretical physicists postulate the existence of extra spatial dimensions to reconcile conflicting models.
items.ex_zh: 理论物理学家假定存在额外的空间维度，以调和相互矛盾的模型。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on setting forth problems, queries, or challenges for consideration, or projecting an obstacle directly into someone's path.
groups.summary_zh: 提出问题、假设或对局面构成直接挑战。
groups.desc_en: Introducing an issue, proposition, or hurdle into an intellectual or situational arena for confrontation, contrasting with quiet reflection by demanding public acknowledgment or resolution.
groups.desc_zh: 将问题、命题或障碍推至智识或现实场域之中，与私下沉思不同，强调迫使对方直面、接招或予以解答。
groups.nuance_en: present: exhibits information or introduces an opportunity formally (evidence / challenge) · raise: surfaces an overlooked concern or question from below (doubt / question) · pose: stands as an active threat or frames a perplexing question (threat / riddle) · put forward: tenders a constructive proposal or candidate for debate (hypothesis / proposal) · postulate: assumes an unproven premise as the foundation of an argument (existence / theory)
groups.nuance_zh: present: 正式呈递信息或摆出客观挑战 (evidence / challenge) · raise: 顺势提出被忽视的疑虑或议题 (doubt / question) · pose: 构成现实威胁或提出发人深省的问题 (threat / riddle) · put forward: 抛出假说或方案以供讨论 (hypothesis / proposal) · postulate: 预设某未证前提作为推论基石 (existence / theory)

groups.name: Possess Ability · 能力与胜任 (Can, Manage, Be able to)
groups.tip: 具备完成某事的潜能与条件

items.def_en: To possess the physical or mental skill, capacity, or opportunity to do something
items.ex_en: Our seasoned software engineers can troubleshoot complex distributed network failures within minutes.
items.ex_zh: 我们经验丰富的软件工程师能在数分钟内排查复杂的分布式网络故障。

items.def_zh: 能，可以；可能；（用于委婉请求、建议或许可）可以
items.def_en: (modal auxiliary) Used to express past ability, possibility, or polite requests and suggestions.
items.ex_en: In her prime, the veteran soprano could effortlessly sustain difficult high notes.
items.ex_zh: 在她的鼎盛时期，这位资深女高音能够毫不费力地保持住难度极高的高音。

items.def_en: (+ to do) To succeed in doing something difficult or demanding through effort
items.ex_en: Despite severe blizzard conditions, the rescue team did manage to reach stranded hikers.
items.ex_zh: 尽管遭遇了严重的暴风雪，救援队还是设法找到了滞留的徒步旅行者。

items.def_en: (informal, often with can/can't) To be able to endure, manage, or successfully perform under pressure
items.ex_en: The rookie surgeon simply could not hack the grueling twelve-hour operating room shifts.
items.ex_zh: 这名新手外科医生实在顶不住长达十二小时的艰苦手术室轮班。

items.def_en: (+ with) To successfully deal with a challenging problem or difficult situation
items.ex_en: Social service agencies must constantly expand to cope with surging homelessness across cities.
items.ex_zh: 社会服务机构必须不断扩建，以应对各大城市激增的无家可归问题。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses expressing inherent, learned, or situational competence and capability to perform actions or achieve results.
groups.summary_zh: 指主语具备执行某动作、克服困难或达成目标的潜能与能力。
groups.desc_en: Exercising personal capacity or resilience to fulfill a demand or survive hardship, contrasting with effortless mastery by often emphasizing friction, endurance, and pragmatic adequacy.
groups.desc_zh: 发挥个人潜能或韧性以应对需求或度过困境，与轻松驾驭不同，多带有一层克服阻力、勉力支撑或务求过关的色彩。
groups.nuance_en: can: expresses intrinsic physical, mental, or circumstantial capability (swim / understand) · could: denotes conditional or hypothetical latent potential (help / succeed) · manage: achieves success despite steep obstacles and limited resources (crisis / time) · hack: endures demanding rigors or meets ruthless standards informally (pace / job) · cope: keeps psychological or logistical footing under heavy stress (pressure / stress)
groups.nuance_zh: can: 表明内在的客观能力或条件许可 (swim / understand) · could: 表示假设性、潜在或委婉的能力 (help / succeed) · manage: 克服困难、勉力设法办成 (crisis / time) · hack: 在高压严苛环境中吃得消、扛得住 (pace / job) · cope: 在重压之下维持心理或现实运转而不崩溃 (pressure / stress)

groups.name: Pot & Transplant · 盆栽与移栽培育 (Pot, Repot, Bed out)
groups.tip: 把幼苗栽入花盆或土壤栽培

items.def_zh: 把……栽入盆中；（台球等）击球入袋
items.def_en:
1. to plant or transplant a flower, plant, or seedling in a pot
2. to hit a ball into a pocket in snooker or billiards
items.ex_en: The head gardener helped us pot the delicate tomato seedlings this morning.
items.ex_zh: 首席园丁今天早上帮我们把娇嫩的番茄幼苗栽入了花盆中。

items.def_en: to shift an established young plant into the next size container to support root expansion
items.ex_en: She carefully began to pot on the tender begonia into richer soil.
items.ex_zh: 她小心翼翼地将娇嫩的秋海棠移换入盛有更肥沃土壤的大盆中。

items.def_en: to transplant greenhouse or potted seedlings into open garden beds for seasonal flowering
items.ex_en: The gardeners began bedding out the summer annuals as soon as the frost risk passed.
items.ex_zh: 霜冻危险一过，园丁们便开始把夏季一年生花苗移栽到花坛中。

items.def_en: to dig up a growing plant from one location and root it firmly into another plot or vessel
items.ex_en: Volunteers arrived early to transplant hundreds of native saplings into the nature reserve.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者们早早赶来，将数百株本土树苗移栽进自然保护区。

items.def_en: to transfer a growing potted plant into a different, usually larger container with fresh compost
items.ex_en: You need to repot root-bound indoor ferns before new spring shoots emerge.
items.ex_zh: 在春季新芽破土之前，你需要为根部盘结的室内蕨类植物换盆。

groups.summary_en: This horticultural frame focuses on planting, housing, or moving seedlings and domestic flora into containers or dedicated nursery beds. It highlights hands-on gardening manipulation of delicate roots and soils.
groups.summary_zh: 指将植物幼苗移栽至花盆、苗床或花园容器中进行培植管理。
groups.desc_en: Relocating plants between growing media or containers to encourage vital development, contrasting with wild seeding by involving deliberate horticultural intervention and root disturbance.
groups.desc_zh: 在不同容器或土壤介质间转移植物以助长发育，与自然播种不同，包含人工园艺干预与对根系的主动移栽。
groups.nuance_en: pot: places a young seedling into a container with fresh soil (seedling / plant) · pot on: shifts a growing plant into the next size up to avoid root-binding (specimen / root) · bed out: moves greenhouse-hardened plants into outdoor open beds (annuals / borders) · transplant: uproots and moves a living organism to an entirely new site (organ / shrub) · repot: refreshes old soil or expands pot space for a mature plant (houseplant / orchid)
groups.nuance_zh: pot: 将幼苗栽入花盆土壤中 (seedling / plant) · pot on: 换至大一号盆以释放根系生长空间 (specimen / root) · bed out: 将温室苗移栽定植于户外花坛 (annuals / borders) · transplant: 起根移栽至全新土壤（或器官移植） (organ / shrub) · repot: 为成年植株翻盆、换土或换盆 (houseplant / orchid)

groups.name: Potter & Potter Around · 悠闲游逛与磨蹭 (Putter, Potter, Dally)
groups.tip: 悠闲随意漫无目的地行走

items.def_en: 1. (+ around/about) To walk around slowly and aimlessly, or spend time doing small, relaxed, unhurried tasks.
items.ex_en: Grandfather loves to putter around the workshop whenever he has spare leisure time.
items.ex_zh: 祖父只要有一点闲暇时间，就喜欢在工作室里慢悠悠地做些杂活。

items.def_en: To manage to get through a situation or activity without clear organization, plan, or urgency
items.ex_en: Lacking formal training, the inexperienced interns merely muddle through daily administrative chaos.
items.ex_zh: 由于缺乏系统培训，这群毫无经验的实习生只能胡乱应付日常的行政混乱。

items.def_zh: 慢悠悠地闲逛或做琐事
items.def_en: (+ around/about) To spend time in a relaxed, pleasant way doing small, unimportant tasks or wandering slowly
items.ex_en: On sunny Sunday mornings, I usually potter around the back garden tending flowers.
items.ex_zh: 在阳光明媚的周日清晨，我通常在后花园里悠闲地转悠打理花草。

items.def_en: (+ with/around) To make small, casual changes or minor repairs to something in an amateur or leisurely way
items.ex_en: My brother spends every weekend trying to tinker with his vintage motorcycle engine.
items.ex_zh: 我哥哥每个周末都花时间摆弄修理他那辆老式摩托车的发动机。

items.def_en: To act or move slowly and waste time aimlessly when one ought to be proceeding
items.ex_en: The weary traveler must not dally along the path as night approaches swiftly.
items.ex_zh: 黑夜迅速逼近，疲惫的旅人绝不可在小径上闲荡磨蹭。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe moving about slowly and unhurriedly while occupying oneself with pleasant, trivial, or aimless tasks. They highlight a relaxed, unstructured tempo without urgent intent.
groups.summary_zh: 指不紧不慢地游逛、闲逛或漫无目的地摆弄琐事。
groups.desc_en: Occupying oneself in an unstructured, leisurely, or unhurried fashion without pressing deadlines, contrasting with focused work by prioritizing casual amusement and meandering over efficiency.
groups.desc_zh: 以松散、闲散且无紧迫目标的方式打发时间，与专注高效的工作不同，以随性摸索、磨蹭和消遣为核心特征。
groups.nuance_en: putter: tinkers aimlessly around domestic chores in an unhurried manner (house / garage) · muddle through: scrambles clumsily along without a coherent plan yet survives (exam / crisis) · potter: strolls and attends leisurely to trivial bits and bobs (garden / shed) · tinker: fiddles experimentally with mechanisms without professional rigor (engine / gadget) · dally: lingers playfully, wasting time when speed is required (way / lover)
groups.nuance_zh: putter: 在家中闲散从容地忙前忙后 (house / garage) · muddle through: 缺乏条理、胡乱对付着涉险过关 (exam / crisis) · potter: 慢悠悠游逛或摆弄琐碎杂务 (garden / shed) · tinker: 业余摆弄修理或修修补补 (engine / gadget) · dally: 磨蹭耽搁、调情闲荡而虚掷光阴 (way / lover)

groups.name: Praise & Bless · 赞扬与祝祷 (Bless, Sanctify, Exalt)
groups.tip: 虔诚祈福与由衷赞美之词

items.def_zh: 祝福，祈福；保佑；赞美，称颂
items.def_en: 1. To ask God to protect someone or something. 2. To praise or thank God. 3. (usually passive) To endow or favor someone with something pleasant or advantageous.
items.ex_en: The bishop bowed his head to bless the humble congregation before concluding mass.
items.ex_zh: 在弥撒结束前，主教低下头为谦卑的会众祈求上帝赐福。

items.def_en: To worship and honor God, or to praise someone or something in an exalted way
items.ex_en: Choral hymns sung during Sunday services seek to glorify divine grace and majesty.
items.ex_zh: 主日礼拜中演唱的合唱赞美诗旨在颂扬神圣的恩典与威严。

items.def_en: To praise or honor someone or something very highly, often raising them to elevated status
items.ex_en: Court poets composed grand epic odes to exalt the monarch's legendary conquests.
items.ex_zh: 宫廷诗人创作了宏伟的史诗颂歌，极力赞扬君主具有传奇色彩的征战功绩。

items.def_en: To officially dedicate something to God or religious purposes, conferring sacred status
items.ex_en: The archbishop arrived early to consecrate the newly rebuilt cathedral before the public.
items.ex_zh: 总主教早早赶来，在公众面前为这座新重建的大教堂举行祝圣仪式。

items.def_zh: 使神圣化，批准/使合法化
items.def_en: To declare or make holy, or to give official moral or religious sanction to something
items.ex_en: Ancient religious ceremonies were explicitly designed to sanctify the crowning of sovereign monarchs.
items.ex_zh: 古老的宗教仪式被明确设计用来使统治君主的加冕礼获得神圣合法性。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame combine spoken adoration, religious veneration, and the invocation of divine favor or spiritual safeguarding. They bridge solemn prayerful reverence and elevated moral praise.
groups.summary_zh: 兼具祈福与敬颂之意，通过宗教或至高崇敬之辞施加护佑与赞美。
groups.desc_en: Channeling reverence, divine favor, or supreme honor toward a being or object, contrasting with everyday compliments by vesting the act with sacred, moral, or cosmic elevation.
groups.desc_zh: 将崇敬、神圣护佑或至高荣耀赋予特定对象，与日常称赞不同，带有宗教圣化、伦理升华或膜拜意涵。
groups.nuance_en: bless: bestows divine grace, protection, or paternal approval (children / union) · glorify: magnifies the majesty and fame of a deity or hero (god / victory) · exalt: lifts someone to a dizzying pinnacle of status or praise (virtue / leader) · consecrate: solemnly dedicates an item or person to holy purposes (ground / bishop) · sanctify: cleanses from moral sin and purifies with spiritual grace (soul / marriage)
groups.nuance_zh: bless: 赐福保佑，赋予神圣或长辈的认可 (children / union) · glorify: 赞美颂扬，极力彰显光辉伟大 (god / victory) · exalt: 拔高推崇至至高无上的地位 (virtue / leader) · consecrate: 举行圣礼奉献，使之专供神用 (ground / bishop) · sanctify: 圣化净化，赋予宗教上的合法与纯洁 (soul / marriage)

groups.name: Prank & Play Practical Jokes · 恶搞与捉弄 (Prank, Bamboozle, Hoodwink)
groups.tip: 设局恶作剧或整蛊戏弄人

items.def_en: To perform a mischievous act or deception designed to confuse or embarrass someone harmlessly
items.ex_en: The mischievous boys decided to play a trick on their unsuspecting geography teacher.
items.ex_zh: 调皮的男孩子们决定捉弄一下毫无防备的地理老师。

items.def_en: 1. (informal) To play a practical joke or mischievous trick on someone. 2. (archaic) To dress up or decorate showily.
items.ex_en: Cheeky fraternity students decided to prank their rival house with hundreds of balloons.
items.ex_zh: 顽皮的兄弟会学生决定用数百个气球对他们的竞争对手宿舍恶作剧。

items.def_en: To trick someone good-naturedly, or to satirize and mock something through clever imitation
items.ex_en: Satirical comedians frequently spoof famous espionage movies with absurdly exaggerated parody sketches.
items.ex_zh: 讽刺喜剧演员经常通过荒诞夸张的滑稽小品来戏弄嘲弄著名的间谍电影。

items.def_en: To subject someone to an elaborate practical joke or deceptive prank, often publicly
items.ex_en: The mischievous television producers decided to punk the celebrity during a fake interview.
items.ex_zh: 恶作剧电视制作人们决定在一次假采访中好好愚弄一番这位名人。

items.def_en: To deceive, trick, or fool someone into believing something that is not true
items.ex_en: Clever fraudsters managed to dupe gullible senior citizens into transferring significant life savings.
items.ex_zh: 狡猾的诈骗犯设法哄骗容易轻信的老年人转账了数额庞大的毕生积蓄。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers playing mischievous tricks or practical jokes on others, typically intended for amusement, embarrassment, or lighthearted mockery rather than malicious theft. Nuances range from silly social gags to elaborate deceptive hoaxes.
groups.summary_zh: 出于取乐或恶作剧目的捉弄、开涮或愚弄他人。
groups.desc_en: Deceiving a target through playful theatrics or misleading traps for amusement or humiliation, contrasting with criminal fraud by prioritizing the comic spectacle over actual malice or material theft.
groups.desc_zh: 通过戏谑手段或欺骗圈套捉弄目标以博取笑闹，与刑事诈骗不同，重在制造戏剧效果或恶搞，而非恶意掠夺。
groups.nuance_en: play a trick on: executes a light-hearted, traditional ruse (teacher / friend) · prank: stages a calculated, mischievous practical joke (roommate / caller) · spoof: mimics a recognizable genre or style parodically (movie / commercial) · punk: humiliates a victim aggressively with an elaborate setup (celebrity / mark) · dupe: misleads a naive victim into foolishly believing a falsehood (investor / public)
groups.nuance_zh: play a trick on: 对某人施以轻巧温和的传统捉弄 (teacher / friend) · prank: 策划并实施具有恶作剧性质的整蛊 (roommate / caller) · spoof: 滑稽仿拟特定风格进行讽刺恶搞 (movie / commercial) · punk: 通过精心设局让人当众出丑 (celebrity / mark) · dupe: 诱使天真盲信者受骗上当 (investor / public)

groups.name: Preach & Evangelize · 布道与宣讲 (Evangelize, Proselytize, Preach)
groups.tip: 热忱宣讲宗教福音，积极传播信仰教义

items.def_en: (+ to) To talk publicly about personal religious faith to persuade others
items.ex_en: Devoted believers gathered at the street corner to witness to passersby about Christ.
items.ex_zh: 虔诚的信徒们聚集在街角，向过路人见证宣讲基督的信仰。

items.def_en: To lecture someone tediously or give moral advice in an unwelcome way
items.ex_en: Parents should listen attentively to troubled teenagers instead of continuing to sermonize endlessly.
items.ex_zh: 父母应当耐心地倾听陷入困扰的青少年，而不是一味地没完没了训诫说教。

items.def_en: To deliver a religious sermon or advocate a moral principle earnestly
items.ex_en: Passionate environmental activists preach conservation values whenever addressing young public audiences.
items.ex_zh: 充满激情的环保活动家每次面向年轻公众演讲时，都会大力宣扬保护环境的理念。

items.def_zh: 劝诱改宗；极力兜售观点
items.def_en: To try to persuade someone to change their religious or political beliefs
items.ex_en: The secular state strictly prohibited zealous foreign missionaries from attempting to proselytize citizens.
items.ex_zh: 这个世俗国家严禁狂热的外国传教士试图劝诱本国公民改变信仰。

items.def_zh: 传教，宣讲福音，使皈依基督教；热心鼓吹，热忱倡导
items.def_en: 1. To preach the Christian gospel in order to convert people. 2. To advocate or promote an idea, cause, or product with great enthusiasm.
items.ex_en: Dedicated missionaries ventured into remote jungle settlements to evangelize native indigenous populations.
items.ex_zh: 充满奉献精神的传教士深入偏远的丛林聚落，向当地原住民宣讲福音。

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote proclaiming religious doctrine, moral tenets, or fervent ideological beliefs, often with the explicit intention of converting or convicting the listener.
groups.summary_zh: 指热情宣讲宗教教义或劝诱他人改变信仰与立场。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote vocalizing religious or ideological doctrines to persuade or convert others, contrasting with neutral informing or teaching by carrying passionate advocacy, moral authority, or proselytizing intent.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词表示以劝说或促其皈依为目的宣讲宗教或意识形态教条，区别于中性的告知或教学，带有强烈的倡导性、道德权威感与传教归信意图。
groups.nuance_en: preach: deliver a formal religious or moral discourse, often didactic (gospel / sermon / caution) · evangelize: passionately propagate a faith or ardent conviction to convert others (population / market / believers) · proselytize: actively attempt to recruit or convert someone to a religious or political belief, often pejoratively perceived as intrusive (converts / voters / followers) · sermonize: lecture someone dogmatically or tediously in a preachy manner (youth / audiences / listeners) · witness: attest personally to religious faith through testimony or conduct (Christ / faith / belief)
groups.nuance_zh: preach: 发表正式的宗教或道德布道，多具说教色彩 (gospel / sermon / caution) · evangelize: 满怀热忱地宣传信仰或理念以求归信 (population / market / believers) · proselytize: 积极游说他人改变宗教或政治立场，常含强行拉拢贬义 (converts / voters / followers) · sermonize: 居高临下、冗长乏味地说教 (youth / audiences / listeners) · witness: 通过个人见证或操守彰显信仰 (Christ / faith / belief)

groups.name: Precede & Lead · 先行与居前 (Precede, Lead, Antedate)
groups.tip: 在时间或位次上走在前面

items.def_en: To walk or travel in front of others, or be the first to do something innovative
items.ex_en: The local renewable energy startup aims to lead the way in green technology.
items.ex_zh: 这家本土可再生能源初创企业旨在绿色技术领域带头先行。

items.def_en: To have existed or happened before another event or period
items.ex_en: Archaeologists discovered ancient burial relics that clearly antedate the Roman conquest period.
items.ex_zh: 考古学家发现了明显先于罗马征服时期存在的古代墓葬文物。

items.def_en: To mark or cause the beginning of a new period, era, or development
items.ex_en: Groundbreaking discoveries in artificial intelligence may usher in a transformative industrial era.
items.ex_zh: 人工智能领域的突破性发现可能会开启一个变革性的工业时代。

items.def_zh: （在时间、顺序或空间上）先于，早于，走在……前面
items.def_en: To happen, exist, or go before someone or something in time, order, or position.
items.ex_en: Lengthy formal introductions always precede the keynote speeches at this annual scientific symposium.
items.ex_zh: 在这场年度科学研讨会上，冗长的正式介绍总是先于主旨演讲发生。

items.def_en: To be a sign that a particular event or change is about to begin
items.ex_en: Early blooming daffodils reliably herald the long-awaited arrival of pleasant spring weather.
items.ex_zh: 早开的水仙花可靠地预示着人们期盼已久的温暖春日即将到来。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses verbs describing an entity occurring, moving, or being ranked ahead of another in time, sequence, or spatial progression. They highlight temporal order or comparative precedence in hierarchical structures.
groups.summary_zh: 指在时间、序列或空间上位于另一事物之前，强调时序与排列前位。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe preceding something temporally, spatially, or hierarchically, often serving as a forerunner or initiator, unlike neutral occurrence which lacks sequential or transitional momentum.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词表示在时间、空间或位阶上居先，常充当前驱或开启者角色，区别于缺乏时间序向或承前启后动力的普通发生。
groups.nuance_en: precede: occur, exist, or go before something in time, order, or rank (arrival / era / ceremony) · lead the way: act as an innovator, guide, or forefront pioneer (industry / reform / exploration) · herald: serve as an overt sign, announcement, or foretoken of what is to come (dawn / arrival / victory) · usher in: formally mark the beginning of a new period or state (era / epoch / change) · antedate: assign or exist at an earlier chronological date than another (document / discovery / civilization)
groups.nuance_zh: precede: 在时间、顺序或位阶上先于 (arrival / era / ceremony) · lead the way: 充当开路先锋或创新典范 (industry / reform / exploration) · herald: 预示或公开宣告某事的来临 (dawn / arrival / victory) · usher in: 礼仪性或历史性地开启新纪元、新变革 (era / epoch / change) · antedate: 在时间年代上早于或提前倒填日期 (document / discovery / civilization)

groups.name: Precipitate & Spark · 骤然引发与促成 (Precipitate, Trigger, Spark)
groups.tip: 外界刺激促使快速发生

items.def_en: To start a sequence of events, an argument, or an alarm abruptly
items.ex_en: Controversial zoning changes are bound to set off fierce public arguments tonight.
items.ex_zh: 有争议的区划变更今晚注定会引爆激烈的公众争论。

items.def_zh: 触发，引起（连锁反应、事件）
items.def_en: To make something happen very quickly, especially a chain of events or a strong reaction
items.ex_en: The abrupt bank collapse will likely trigger a nationwide credit freeze among lenders.
items.ex_zh: 银行的突然倒闭极可能会触发全国放贷机构之间的信贷冻结。

items.def_en: To cause the start of something energetic, intense, or violent, such as protest or debate
items.ex_en: Unfair wage cuts will certainly spark massive labor walkouts across regional factories.
items.ex_zh: 不公平的降薪势必会在全区各地的工厂激起大规模的工人罢工。

items.def_zh: 煽动，发起（冲突或不良行为）
items.def_en: To deliberately initiate or provoke an action, inquiry, revolt, or bad situation
items.ex_en: Corrupt political agitators attempted to instigate violent civil unrest against municipal authorities.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的政治煽动分子企图挑起针对市政当局的暴力内乱。

items.def_zh: 促成，使突发；使沉淀；猛抛，使陷入
items.def_en: 1. to make something serious or bad happen suddenly or sooner than expected 2. (chemistry) to separate, or cause to separate, as a solid substance from a solution
items.ex_en: Severe currency devaluation could swiftly precipitate a devastating macroeconomic crisis across borders.
items.ex_zh: 货币的严重贬值可能会迅速促发一场波及多国的毁灭性宏观经济危机。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe acting as the sudden catalyst that accelerates, triggers, or brings about a major event or crisis prematurely.
groups.summary_zh: 作为诱因瞬间引爆危机、剧变或使事态急剧恶化。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote suddenly initiating, triggering, or drastically accelerating a latent, volatile, or explosive event, unlike gradual causation or sustained production.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词表示突然触发、引爆或急剧加速某种潜伏、剧烈或危机性事件，区别于渐进式的因果发展或持续生产。
groups.nuance_en: spark: ignite a rapid, explosive chain reaction through an incidental stimulus (protest / controversy / outrage) · trigger: activate a pre-existing mechanism or volatile cascade (crisis / reaction / memory) · precipitate: cause an unforeseen or premature outcome to happen abruptly (collapse / crisis / recession) · set off: physically detonate or unintentionally release an immediate reaction (alarm / explosion / debate) · instigate: intentionally provoke, incite, or stir up conflict or rebellion (violence / riot / investigation)
groups.nuance_zh: spark: 借助偶发微小诱因引爆剧烈反响 (protest / controversy / outrage) · trigger: 触动已有机制或多米诺式连锁反应 (crisis / reaction / memory) · precipitate: 促使危机或突发结果猝不及防地提前降临 (collapse / crisis / recession) · set off: 机械引爆或意外引发即时反应 (alarm / explosion / debate) · instigate: 蓄意煽动、挑起事端或抗争 (violence / riot / investigation)

groups.name: Precision Extraction & Plucking · 细微拔除与镊取 (Tweeze, Pluck, Weed out)
groups.tip: 用工具或手指夹拔拔除

items.def_en: To extract something embedded or anchored by gripping and pulling
items.ex_en: The multinational corporation decided to pull out of the unprofitable market.
items.ex_zh: 该跨国公司决定退出这一无利可图的市场。

items.def_en: To pull something out or remove hairs and feathers with a quick, sharp tug
items.ex_en: She sat quietly before the dressing mirror to pluck stray eyebrow hairs.
items.ex_zh: 她静静地坐在梳妆镜前，拔掉杂乱的眉毛。

items.def_en: To pluck, pull out, or remove tiny objects or hairs using tweezers.
items.ex_en: The esthetician used sanitized steel instruments to carefully tweeze fine ingrown hairs.
items.ex_zh: 美容师使用消毒钢制器具仔细地镊除细小的内生毛发。

items.def_en: To remove or pull something out carefully, especially with effort or instruments
items.ex_en: The surgeon used sterile forceps to carefully extract the embedded shrapnel from the wound.
items.ex_zh: 外科医生用无菌镊子小心翼翼地从伤口中取出了嵌塞的弹片。

items.def_en: To pull something out by the roots, or seek out and completely eradicate
items.ex_en: The new director vowed to root out institutional corruption across the entire department.
items.ex_zh: 新任局长誓要彻底铲除整个部门内根深蒂固的体制性腐败。

groups.summary_en: This manipulation frame deals with pulling or extracting small, delicate, or embedded items (such as hairs, splinters, or weeds) with precision tools or careful finger grips. Nuances distinguish cosmetic grooming, agricultural removal, and delicate tool-based extraction.
groups.summary_zh: 指使用镊子或手指导向，精细拔出或剔除细小毛发、杂物。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame specify the meticulous, selective extraction of small, embedded, or unwanted elements, contrasting with gross physical removal by emphasizing pinpoint precision or thorough weeding.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词强调对微小、嵌顿或不需要的部分进行精细、有选择的拔除，区别于粗暴的整体移除，凸显精准定位或彻底根除。
groups.nuance_en: tweeze: pull out tiny hairs or splinters using small pincers or extreme precision (eyebrows / splinters / hairs) · pluck: seize and abruptly pull off or out, often individually (feathers / strings / hairs) · extract: draw forth something deeply embedded, firmly set, or intrinsic (tooth / mineral / information) · pull out: forcefully draw something outward from a holder or position (nail / plug / weeds) · root out: thoroughly seek out and eradicate undesirable elements at the source (corruption / evils / dissidents)
groups.nuance_zh: tweeze: 用镊子微细精准地夹除 (eyebrows / splinters / hairs) · pluck: 捏住并猝然拔下或摘取 (feathers / strings / hairs) · extract: 拔除深嵌之物或提炼内在成分 (tooth / mineral / information) · pull out: 自容体或位置中径直拔出 (nail / plug / weeds) · root out: 从根源上彻底搜出并连根铲除 (corruption / evils / dissidents)

groups.name: Predate & Antiquate · 早于与溯源 (Predate, Antedate, Pre-exist)
groups.tip: 在时间或顺序上走在前面

items.def_zh: 在时间上早于；早于……出现
items.def_en: To have occurred, originated, or existed at a date prior to another
items.ex_en: Recent archaeological findings suggest that the ancient settlement antedates the neighboring royal tomb.
items.ex_zh: 最近的考古发现表明，该古代定居点的存在时间早于邻近的王室陵墓。

items.def_en: To exist prior to a particular event, point in time, or subsequent entity
items.ex_en: The physician determined that the patient had a pre-existing medical condition before treatment.
items.ex_zh: 医生判定该患者在接受治疗前就已存在基础疾病。

items.def_en: To have been made or started at a specific, earlier period in history
items.ex_en: Historians confirmed that the stone foundations date back to the early Roman period.
items.ex_zh: 历史学家证实，这些石质地基可以追溯到古罗马早期。

items.def_zh: 在时间上早于，先于；倒填……的日期
items.def_en: 1. To exist or happen at an earlier time than something else. 2. To put a date on a document that is earlier than the actual date.
items.ex_en: These newly uncovered geological layers clearly predate the advent of early human civilization.
items.ex_zh: 这些新发现的地质层在时间上显然早于早期人类文明的出现。

items.def_en: To act as an early indication or warning of a future event
items.ex_en: The ominous dip in trade volumes foreshadowed the severe economic crisis that followed.
items.ex_zh: 贸易量的不祥下滑预示了随后发生的严重经济危机。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify an exact historical or chronological priority where one event, artifact, or concept existed before another. They focus strictly on objective temporal sequence rather than spatial leadership.
groups.summary_zh: 专注于历史年代或客观时间线上早于某事物，强调渊源先后。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote chronological seniority or ancestral priority relative to another historical baseline, differing from mere sequence by focusing on antiquity, dating, or evolutionary priority.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词表示相对于某一历史参照物而言年代更早或存在于先，区别于单纯的先后顺序，着眼于古老性、年代考证或源流先在性。
groups.nuance_en: predate: exist or occur at an earlier chronological time than something else (civilization / internet / dynasty) · antedate: prove or assign an earlier date than an established point or document (event / origin / artifact) · pre-exist: possess actual existence prior to a specified reference point (universe / soul / dispute) · date back to: trace historical or chronological origin to a specific era (century / antiquity / middle ages) · foreshadow: provide an advance indication or literary prefiguration of the future (downfall / events / theme)
groups.nuance_zh: predate: 在客观时间年代上早于 (civilization / internet / dynasty) · antedate: 证明或断定其年代早于某基准，或将时间倒填 (event / origin / artifact) · pre-exist: 在特定时间点前即已客观存在 (universe / soul / dispute) · date back to: 将历史源头追溯至某一特定时期 (century / antiquity / middle ages) · foreshadow: 在叙事或前瞻中预兆、伏笔 (downfall / events / theme)

groups.name: Predetermine & Destine · 预先决定与注定 (Predetermine, Foreordain, Preordain)
groups.tip: 下定决心提前做裁定

items.def_en: To appoint, decree, or determine an outcome beforehand by fate or divine will
items.ex_en: The high priest proclaimed that eternal victory had been foreordained by divine will.
items.ex_zh: 大祭司宣称，神圣的意志早已冥冥中注定了永恒的胜利。

items.def_en: To decide, decree, or fix something irrevocably in advance
items.ex_en: The rigorous terms of the historic treaty seemed to preordain the nation's eventual collapse.
items.ex_zh: 这项历史性条约的严苛条款似乎早已注定了该国最终的崩溃。

items.def_en: To predetermine someone or something to an inevitable, often adverse outcome
items.ex_en: Their reckless military ambitions fated the entire expedition to a cold, catastrophic demise.
items.ex_zh: 他们鲁莽的军事野心注定了整支远征军惨遭冰冷毁灭的结局。

items.def_en: To intend or set apart someone or something for a particular fate or purpose
items.ex_en: From childhood, the gifted young prince was destined to inherit an empire in decline.
items.ex_zh: 从幼年起，这位天赋出众的小王子便注定要继承一个走向衰落的帝国。

items.def_en: (formal) to decide, establish, or control an outcome or fate in advance
items.ex_en: Complex genetic markers often predetermine a patient's biological susceptibility to certain rare diseases.
items.ex_zh: 复杂的遗传标记往往预先决定了患者对某些罕见疾病的生理易感性。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to settling, dictating, or establishing events, outcomes, or fates ahead of time through authority, destiny, or causal necessity. They emphasize advance control that leaves little room for contingency.
groups.summary_zh: 指在事态发生前通过命运、权威或因果规律预先确定结局或走向。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote fixing, decreeing, or shaping outcomes irreversibly in advance through divine decree, fate, or rigid programming, contrasting with open-ended planning or contingent forecasting.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词表示通过神旨、宿命或既定规则提前不可逆转地锁定或造就结局，区别于开放式规划或或然性预测。
groups.nuance_en: predetermine: establish or decide an outcome rigidly beforehand through prior factors or rules (fate / outcome / trajectory) · preordain: decree beforehand by transcendent, divine, or supernatural will (destiny / event / role) · foreordain: determine irrevocably in advance from eternity (glory / fate / destruction) · destine: assign someone or something firmly toward a future purpose or end (career / failure / greatness) · fate: consign helplessly to an inevitable, often tragic outcome (ruin / tragedy / doom)
groups.nuance_zh: predetermine: 凭借前置条件、规则预先注定或测定 (fate / outcome / trajectory) · preordain: 上苍或超自然神意命中预先注定 (destiny / event / role) · foreordain: 自永恒之初预设不可变更的归宿 (glory / fate / destruction) · destine: 预先指引或选定走向特定未来 (career / failure / greatness) · fate: 使不可避免地陷入特定命运（多偏悲剧性） (ruin / tragedy / doom)

groups.name: Preempt & Eliminate · 预防与免除 (Preclude, Forestall, Rule Out)
groups.tip: 提前采取措施使困难不再必要

items.def_en: To remove or get rid of completely, especially a risk, variable, or defect
items.ex_en: Installing the upgraded ventilation system will eliminate the residual toxic gases from the laboratory.
items.ex_zh: 安装升级后的通风系统将彻底消除实验室内的残留有毒气体。

items.def_en: To decide that something is impossible or unsuitable and eliminate it from consideration
items.ex_en: Preliminary medical tests quickly ruled out the possibility of a severe bacterial infection.
items.ex_zh: 初步的医学检查迅速排除了严重细菌感染的可能性。

items.def_en: To make something impossible in advance, especially by an existing condition
items.ex_en: Strict safety regulations preclude the unauthorized storage of volatile chemicals within the facility.
items.ex_zh: 严格的安全规章杜绝了在设施内未经授权存放易挥发化学品的可能。

items.def_en: To act beforehand to prevent an anticipated event or action from occurring
items.ex_en: The central bank raised interest rates aggressively to forestall runaway inflation this quarter.
items.ex_zh: 中央银行本季度果断大幅加息，以抢先遏制失控的通货膨胀。

items.def_zh: 消除，排除；使不再需要，避免
items.def_en: (formal) to remove a difficulty, risk, or need so that something is no longer necessary
items.ex_en: The automated diagnostic software effectively obviates the requirement for costly secondary medical evaluations.
items.ex_zh: 该自动化诊断软件有效免除了进行昂贵二次医疗评估的需要。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify taking anticipatory action to render difficulties, requirements, risks, or possibilities impossible or completely unnecessary.
groups.summary_zh: 通过前瞻性行动使困难、需要或可能性不再存在，起到免除或杜绝作用。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe taking anticipatory action or establishing conditions that completely render a prospective problem, requirement, or possibility impossible or unnecessary, contrasting with reactionary remediation.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词描述采取先发制人的举措或确立前提，从而使潜在问题、需求或可能性彻底失效、不可能发生或不再必要，区别于事后补救。
groups.nuance_en: preclude: make an event or action logically or practically impossible in advance (possibility / doubt / recovery) · forestall: prevent or obstruct something anticipated by acting beforehand (crisis / collapse / panic) · obviate: render a need, difficulty, or measure entirely unnecessary through prevention (necessity / risk / surgery) · rule out: categorically dismiss or exclude a candidate or possibility (option / scenario / hypothesis) · eliminate: systematically remove or wipe out an existing or potential impediment (threat / error / waste)
groups.nuance_zh: preclude: 从逻辑或现实上彻底排除其发生的可能性 (possibility / doubt / recovery) · forestall: 抢先行动以防范或扼止事态爆发 (crisis / collapse / panic) · obviate: 凭借预防措施消除必要性或困难 (necessity / risk / surgery) · rule out: 彻底排除或否决某种选项或假说 (option / scenario / hypothesis) · eliminate: 系统性地根除或剔除现存及潜在障碍 (threat / error / waste)

groups.name: Prelude & Foreshadow · 发起与成为序曲 (Herald, Usher in, Presage)
groups.tip: 作为序幕掀开某一进程

items.def_en: To signal or cause the beginning of a major period, change, or state
items.ex_en: The ratification of the landmark treaty will usher in an era of unprecedented cooperation.
items.ex_zh: 这项具有里程碑意义的条约的签署，将开启一个前所未有的合作时代。

items.def_en: To occur immediately before and serve as a sequential introduction to an event
items.ex_en: Tense diplomatic disputes continued to escalate during the months leading up to the war.
items.ex_zh: 在导致战争爆发的前几个月里，紧张的外交争端持续升级。

items.def_en: To be a sign that a major event or new era is about to happen
items.ex_en: The breakthrough in renewable battery technology heralded a transformative green energy revolution worldwide.
items.ex_zh: 可再生电池技术的突破预示着全球范围内一场变革性绿色能源革命的到来。

items.def_zh: 作为……的序幕，成为……的前奏
items.def_en: To serve as an introduction or opening event to something more important.
items.ex_en: The quiet border skirmishes merely preluded a devastating invasion that engulfed the region.
items.ex_zh: 沉寂的边境小冲突仅仅是随后席卷该地区的毁灭性入侵的前奏。

items.def_en: To act as a warning or omen of a future event
items.ex_en: Dark gathering clouds and dropping temperatures presaged the arrival of a violent blizzard.
items.ex_zh: 密布的乌云和骤降的气温预示着一场狂暴暴风雪的降临。

groups.summary_en: Covers events or actions that precede, introduce, or foreshadow a major subsequent development. Emphasizes an opening act or signaling of a significant shift.
groups.summary_zh: 作为重大事件的前奏或序幕，预示并开启新阶段。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe acting as a formal introductory movement, harbinger, or opening act that signals and introduces a larger forthcoming transition, distinct from pure temporal precedence.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词描述充当具有象征性或引介性的序曲、先兆或序幕，以此昭示并开启后续更重大的变革，区别于单纯的时间居先。
groups.nuance_en: herald: proclaim loudly or serve as a landmark sign of a breakthrough or arrival (breakthrough / era / victory) · usher in: actively introduce and escort into being a new epoch, standard, or paradigm (age / revolution / season) · prelude: serve as an artistic, musical, or experiential prelude to an event (disaster / climax / performance) · presage: serve as an intuitive, portending omen of an impending occurrence (doom / storm / change) · lead up to: form the progressive series of events culminating in a climax (climax / war / crisis)
groups.nuance_zh: herald: 宣示或充当标志性先声以宣告降临 (breakthrough / era / victory) · usher in: 迎介并正式开启新纪元、新变革 (age / revolution / season) · prelude: 作为序曲、前奏或开端引出主体事件 (disaster / climax / performance) · presage: 作为征兆或凶兆预示后续事态 (doom / storm / change) · lead up to: 构成逐步推向高潮的一连串前序事件 (climax / war / crisis)

groups.name: Prepare & Cook Food · 烹制与配餐 (Cook, Bake, Whip Up)
groups.tip: 煎炒烘焙烹调美味食物

items.def_en: 1. To prepare food by heating it, or to be heated and prepared as food.
items.ex_en: Let's cook some spicy noodles tonight instead of ordering greasy takeout from downtown.
items.ex_zh: 今晚咱们煮点辣面吃吧，别再点市中心油腻的外卖了。

items.def_en: Cook food by dry heat without direct exposure to a flame, typically in an oven.
items.ex_en: She decided to bake artisanal sourdough bread for her family every Sunday morning.
items.ex_zh: 她决定每周日早晨为家人烘烤手工酵母面包。
items.ex2_en: The fresh sourdough bread baked slowly in the brick wood-fired oven.
items.ex2_zh: 新鲜的酵母面包在柴火砖炉里慢慢烘烤着。

items.def_en: Prepare a meal or dish very quickly and effortlessly.
items.ex_en: Give me ten minutes and I will whip up a quick vegetable pasta.
items.ex_zh: 给我十分钟，我马上就能快速张罗出一盘蔬菜意面。

items.def_zh: 临时张罗，迅速做成（饭菜）
items.def_en: Quickly prepare a meal or snack using whatever ingredients are available.
items.ex_en: He managed to rustle up some scrambled eggs from the half-empty kitchen fridge.
items.ex_zh: 他设法用半空的厨房冰箱里仅剩的食材炒了几个鸡蛋。

items.def_en: Cook meat or vegetables in an oven or over an open fire.
items.ex_en: We can roast seasoned chicken and potatoes in the oven for dinner tonight.
items.ex_zh: 我们今晚可以在烤箱里烤些调味鸡肉和土豆当晚餐。
items.ex2_en: The seasoned pork roast roasted slowly over the crackling open campfire.
items.ex2_zh: 腌制好的猪肉块在劈啪作响的露天营火上慢慢烘烤着。

groups.summary_en: This broad culinary frame covers preparing meals through dry heat, baking, or assembling ingredients by cooking. It ranges from standard oven techniques to quick, informal food preparation.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖通过加热或快手制作准备膳食的核心烹饪动作与日常表达。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe transforming raw edible ingredients into prepared meals using heat, specialized methods, or swift improvisation, contrasting with generic chemical processing.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词表示利用热力、专门技法或快速临时构思将生鲜食材转化为餐食，区别于宽泛的化学工艺处理。
groups.nuance_en: cook: prepare food broadly by the application of heat (meal / dinner / vegetables) · bake: cook food using dry indirect heat in an enclosed oven (bread / cake / cookies) · roast: cook meat or vegetables uncovered using prolonged dry radiant heat (meat / chicken / vegetables) · whip up: quickly and skillfully prepare a meal with available provisions (dish / snack / feast) · rustle up: informally gather and prepare food at short notice (breakfast / meal / sandwich)
groups.nuance_zh: cook: 泛指施加热力烹调制备餐食 (meal / dinner / vegetables) · bake: 在烤箱中利用干燥间接热力烘焙 (bread / cake / cookies) · roast: 利用干热或明火长时间炙烤肉类或蔬菜 (meat / chicken / vegetables) · whip up: 熟练敏捷地快速做出一道菜或便餐 (dish / snack / feast) · rustle up: 就地取材临时张罗出一顿简单饮食 (breakfast / meal / sandwich)

groups.name: Preserve & Conserve · 防腐与生物定质保存 (Pickle, Embalm, Mummify)
groups.tip: 利用腌渍等手段长期储藏

items.def_en: to preserve meat, fish, or hides by salting, smoking, or drying
items.ex_en: Traditional local fishermen cure freshly caught salmon with sea salt and wood smoke.
items.ex_zh: 当地传统渔民用海盐和木烟来腌制风干新捕获的三文鱼。
items.ex2_en: The seasoned pork belly cures quietly in the cold cellar for weeks.
items.ex2_zh: 调味好的五花肉在阴凉的地窖里静置腌制数周。

items.def_zh: 腌制，用盐水（或醋）腌渍；酸洗
items.def_en: 1. To preserve vegetables, fish, or eggs in vinegar or salt water.
items.ex_en: Every autumn, my grandmother would pickle jars of fresh cucumbers in spiced vinegar.
items.ex_zh: 每年秋天，我祖母都会用香料醋把一罐罐新鲜黄瓜腌渍起来。

items.def_en: to treat a dead body with special chemicals to prevent decay
items.ex_en: Morticians carefully embalm the body with special preservatives to prepare for the viewing.
items.ex_zh: 殡葬师用特制防腐药剂精心处理遗体，为瞻仰遗容做好准备。

items.def_en: to convert organic remains into stone or a mineralized petrified state
items.ex_en: Over millions of years, dense mineral deposits can fossilize fragile organic bone structures.
items.ex_zh: 历经数百万年，致密的矿物沉积物可使脆弱的有机骨骼结构石化成化石。
items.ex2_en: Over millions of years, ancient bones fossilize into hard stone deep underground.
items.ex2_zh: 历经数百万年，古老的骨骼在地下深处石化成坚硬的岩石。

items.def_zh: （把尸体）制成木乃伊；干枯成木乃伊
items.def_en: 1. To preserve a dead body by drying or embalming it so it does not decay, or to dry up like a mummy.
items.ex_en: The extreme arid climate of the desert naturally mummified the ancient buried remains.
items.ex_zh: 沙漠极其干燥的气候使埋葬于此的古代遗骸自然风干成了木乃伊。
items.ex2_en: In the dry mountain cave, the fallen explorer's body mummified completely over decades.
items.ex2_zh: 在干燥的山洞中，遇难探险家的遗体历经数十年完全风化成了干尸。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail chemical or physical treatments applied to organic matter (food, dead bodies, tissues) to halt microbial decomposition and permanently maintain its state.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过浸渍、脱水或化学药物处理有机体以防止腐化变质。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame focus on treating biological organic matter with chemical agents, drying, or geological forces to arrest putrefaction and preserve physical integrity across time, contrasting with mechanical storage.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词侧重通过化学药剂、脱水或地质作用处理生物有机体以阻止腐败，长久维持其物理形态完整，区别于机械性的仓储堆放。
groups.nuance_en: cure: preserve meat, fish, or hides through salting, drying, or smoking (meat / bacon / leather) · pickle: preserve and flavor food by steeping in brine or acidic vinegar (cucumbers / vegetables / fish) · embalm: treat a deceased body with chemicals to prevent decay prior to burial (corpse / body / remains) · mummify: desiccate or wrap a corpse into a permanent dried state (body / pharaoh / remains) · fossilize: mineralize organic tissue over geological time into rock (bones / wood / organism)
groups.nuance_zh: cure: 通过盐渍、风干或熏制保存肉类或皮毛 (meat / bacon / leather) · pickle: 浸入盐水或酸醋中浸渍腌制以防腐入味 (cucumbers / vegetables / fish) · embalm: 用防腐化学药剂处理遗体以防腐朽 (corpse / body / remains) · mummify: 使遗体脱水、包扎制成永久木乃伊 (body / pharaoh / remains) · fossilize: 在漫长地质年代中使有机物石化变硬 (bones / wood / organism)

groups.name: Preserve & Mummify · 防腐与保存 (Embalm, Mummify, Preserve)
groups.tip: 使用药物技术长久保存

items.def_en: To treat food, biological specimens, or corpses to prevent organic decay and microbial spoilage
items.ex_en: Curators applied specialized chemical solutions to preserve the delicate biological tissue specimens permanently.
items.ex_zh: 馆员们使用专门的化学溶液对脆弱的生物组织标本进行永久防腐处理。

items.def_en: To treat, stuff, and mount the skin of a dead animal to recreate a lifelike appearance
items.ex_en: The craftsman used refined techniques to taxidermy the majestic falcon for museum display.
items.ex_zh: 工匠运用娴熟的工艺将那只雄伟的猎鹰制成栩栩如生的标本供博物馆展出。

items.def_en: To preserve organic specimens or biological material by submerging them in a chemical solution such as formalin or alcohol
items.ex_en: The biology lab pickled various aquatic organisms in sealed jars filled with formalin.
items.ex_zh: 生物实验室将各种水生生物浸泡在装满福尔马林的密封罐中防腐保存。

items.def_zh: 对（尸体）进行防腐处理；使不朽，使铭记
items.def_en: 1. To treat a dead body with chemicals, oils, or spices to prevent it from decaying. 2. (literary) To keep the memory of someone or something fresh forever.
items.ex_en: The ancient morticians used fragrant oils and herbs to embalm the noble ruler.
items.ex_zh: 古代殡葬师使用香油和草药对这位贵族统治者的遗体进行防腐处理。

items.def_en: To preserve a dead body by desiccating it and treating it with special oils, salts, or spices
items.ex_en: Priests followed elaborate rituals to desiccate and mummify the pharaoh's body for eternity.
items.ex_zh: 祭司们遵循繁复的仪式将法老的遗体脱水并制成木乃伊，以求永存。
items.ex2_en: The fallen leaves slowly mummified beneath the hot, parched desert sands.
items.ex2_zh: 落叶在炎热干燥的沙漠沙砾下慢慢风干成了木乃伊状。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve chemical, culinary, or funerary treatments designed to halt biological decomposition and decay, preserving human tissue, specimens, or perishable organic matter over prolonged periods.
groups.summary_zh: 采用药剂、化学品或特殊工艺处理尸体或有机物，防止腐烂分解。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame emphasize preserving corpses or specimens against decomposition to perpetuate likeness or physical form, contrasting with general food preservation by targeting lifelike display or mortuary permanence.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词强调对尸体或生物标本进行防腐定型处理以遏制分解腐败，区别于普通食品防腐，着眼于遗体容貌保持或标本瞻仰保存。
groups.nuance_en: preserve: maintain an organic entity in an intact, non-decaying state across time (specimen / body / relics) · embalm: infuse an intact corpse with preservatives to safeguard lifelike appearance (corpse / remains / deceased) · mummify: transform a body into a shriveled, stable state through desiccation (corpse / mummy / tissue) · taxidermy: prepare, stuff, and mount animal skins in lifelike forms (specimen / bird / trophy) · pickle: immerse a biological specimen in preservatives like alcohol or formalin (specimen / organs / tissue)
groups.nuance_zh: preserve: 使有机体长时间保持完好不腐状态 (specimen / body / relics) · embalm: 向遗体注入防腐剂以长期防腐保容 (corpse / remains / deceased) · mummify: 经脱水干化将遗体做成木乃伊 (corpse / mummy / tissue) · taxidermy: 剥制、填充并立体装裱动物皮囊标本 (specimen / bird / trophy) · pickle: 浸入酒精或福尔马林等药液中浸泡保存标本 (specimen / organs / tissue)

groups.name: Preside & Officiate Officially · 依职权主持与掌管 (Preside, Officiate, Convene)
groups.tip: 执掌主位主持大局

items.def_zh: 带领；引导（代表团、正式流程）
items.def_en: to be in charge of or guide a delegation, prayer, or official protocol
items.ex_en: The seasoned ambassador was selected to lead the international delegation during peace talks.
items.ex_zh: 这位经验丰富的大使被选派在和谈期间带领国际代表团。

items.def_zh: 主持，主管，掌管（会议、仪式、组织等）
items.def_en: (+ over/at) to be in charge of a meeting, ceremony, or organization and direct its proceedings.
items.ex_en: A respected retired judge will preside over the contentious high-stakes corporate mediation hearing.
items.ex_zh: 一位受人尊敬的退休法官将主持这场充满争议、关乎重大的企业调解听证会。

items.def_zh: 召集；主持召开（正式会议）
items.def_en: [I/T] to call together and open a formal assembly, court, or council
items.ex_en: The chief magistrate decided to convene the special judicial tribunal early next Monday.
items.ex_zh: 首席大法官决定于下周一上午主持召开特别司法法庭。
items.ex2_en: The national parliament will convene tomorrow to debate the proposed budget cuts.
items.ex2_zh: 国民议会将于明天召集开会，讨论拟议的削减预算案。

items.def_zh: 主持（仪式、宗教典礼）；行使职务；担任裁判
items.def_en: (+ at/in) to perform official duties and lead a formal event, such as a religious ceremony or sports match.
items.ex_en: A prominent local archbishop was invited to officiate at the solemn state memorial.
items.ex_zh: 当地一位著名的大主教受邀主持了这场庄严的国家纪念仪式。

items.def_en: [I/T] to act as a judge in a dispute or formal institutional hearing
items.ex_en: An independent panel of experts was appointed to adjudicate the complex patent dispute.
items.ex_zh: 一个独立的专家小组被任命来审理并裁决这起复杂的专利争端。

groups.summary_en: An official, judge, priest, or high executive exercises statutory or ceremonial authority over formal legal proceedings, solemn rites, or parliamentary bodies. Verbs highlight legal mandate ('preside over'), religious/ritual authority ('officiate'), or administrative power ('direct').
groups.summary_zh: 依官方或宗教职权主持法律诉讼、宗教典礼或正式会议。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe the authorized, structured exercise of formal executive, legal, or ceremonial authority over an official meeting, assembly, or court proceeding, differing from informal group leadership.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词描述依据法定或仪轨职权，对正式会议、议事或司法审判进行程序性主持与裁夺，区别于非正式的群体领导或带头。
groups.nuance_en: preside: occupy the seat of authority and direct formal proceedings (meeting / court / committee) · officiate: perform the formal duties of a referee, priest, or state officer (ceremony / game / wedding) · convene: formally summon and assemble participants together for a meeting (parliament / session / conference) · adjudicate: act as a judge to pronounce formal settlement upon a disputed issue (dispute / claim / case) · lead: hold the primary administrative, strategic, or operational charge (discussion / delegation / team)
groups.nuance_zh: preside: 依职权端坐主席台主持把控正式会议或庭审 (meeting / court / committee) · officiate: 以司仪、神职人员或裁判身份正式执裁/主礼 (ceremony / game / wedding) · convene: 依法正式召集并举行会议或立法会期 (parliament / session / conference) · adjudicate: 以司法权威正式裁定纠纷或案情 (dispute / claim / case) · lead: 担纲业务、讨论或团队的领衔主持 (discussion / delegation / team)

groups.name: Press & Compact · 压制与压实 (Pack, Ram, Compact)
groups.tip: 向下施压使之密实紧固

items.def_en: To press loose earth, snow, or powder firmly into a solid layer
items.ex_en: Workers used heavy wooden boards to pack down the fresh snow on trails.
items.ex_zh: 工人们用厚木板将步道上的新雪用力压实。
items.ex2_en: The soft powder snow packed down firmly under the heavy footsteps of hikers.
items.ex2_zh: 松软的粉雪在徒步者沉重的脚步下被踩得紧实。

items.def_en: To exert continuous pressure on something so that it forms a firm, tight, and solid mass
