items.ex_en: Heavy construction rollers continuously compact the loose gravel before asphalt is poured over.
items.ex_zh: 重型压路机在浇筑沥青之前不断将松散的碎石压实成坚固的一层。
items.ex2_en: Loose layers of soil compact naturally under the persistent weight of rainwater.
items.ex2_zh: 松散的土层在雨水的持续重压下自然压实。

items.def_en: To force the parts of something into less space by applying mechanical pressure
items.ex_en: Specialized hydraulic machinery is utilized to compress industrial metal waste into dense cubes.
items.ex_zh: 专用液压机械被用来将工业金属废料压缩成致密的立方体。
items.ex2_en: Dense air bubbles compress rapidly when subjected to intense underwater pressure.
items.ex2_zh: 致密的气泡在受到强烈的水下压力时会迅速压缩。

items.def_en: (+ down) To ram or press something down firmly by repeated light blows.
items.ex_en: The gardener used a wooden mallet to tamp down the freshly turned soil.
items.ex_zh: 园丁用木槌将刚翻整过的泥土轻轻捣实。

items.def_en: (+ down/in) To drive or push something down firmly with repeated violent impact
items.ex_en: The construction crew used a pneumatic tool to ram the moist soil down.
items.ex_zh: 施工队使用气动工具猛烈夯实潮湿的泥土。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe exerting forceful, repeated, or heavy downward pressure on loose material to compress it into a denser, firmer mass.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过向下挤压、夯击或碾压使松散物料紧实致密。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe applying concentrated downward or directional force to granular or loose matter to minimize voids and maximize structural density, differing from mere surface pressing by achieving solid consolidation.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词描述对松散或颗粒状物料施加定向重压，以消除空隙、极致提高致密度，区别于浅表受力，旨在实现坚实硬化或密实。
groups.nuance_en: compact: compress loose material solidly into a firm, cohesive mass (soil / waste / snow) · tamp: tap repeatedly with light or measured downward strokes to pack lightly (tobacco / soil / powder) · ram: drive or force down violently using severe blunt impact (earth / pole / charge) · compress: reduce physical volume through uniform inward mechanical force (air / garbage / layers) · pack down: consolidate loose layers by continuous pressure or treading (gravel / earth / snow)
groups.nuance_zh: compact: 将松散碎料压实成致密坚实整体 (soil / waste / snow) · tamp: 连续轻敲捣实以微幅平整致密 (tobacco / soil / powder) · ram: 利用猛烈钝性冲击力重重夯击或撞实 (earth / pole / charge) · compress: 承受均匀向内机械压力以缩减体积 (air / garbage / layers) · pack down: 通过持续施压或踩踏将散层压实 (gravel / earth / snow)

groups.name: Press & Compress · 挤压与压实 (Compress, Squeeze, Flatten)
groups.tip: 施加垂直压力使其受压变形

items.def_zh: 压，按，挤压；逼迫，催促；熨烫
items.def_en: 1. To push firmly against or apply steady force to something; to squeeze. 2. To urge or strongly persuade someone to do something
items.ex_en: The technician applied steady manual force to press the adhesive strip onto glass.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员施加稳定的推力，将胶条紧紧压在玻璃表面上。

items.def_en: To press firmly from both or all sides, especially with the hands to force liquid out or reduce size
items.ex_en: You should squeeze the ripe lemon firmly to extract all the fresh juice.
items.ex_zh: 你应该用力挤压成熟的柠檬，把新鲜的汁液全部榨出来。

items.def_en: To press or squeeze something together so that it takes up less space or becomes denser
items.ex_en: The powerful industrial piston operates continuously to compress gaseous refrigerants within the cooling system.
items.ex_zh: 强劲的工业活塞持续运转，以压缩制冷系统内部的气态制冷剂。
items.ex2_en: Gaseous substances compress noticeably when temperatures drop well below freezing points.
items.ex2_zh: 当温度降至冰点以下很多时，气态物质会明显压缩。

items.def_en: To make something level, even, or flat by applying downward or rolling pressure
items.ex_en: The heavy steamroller was deployed to flatten the freshly laid gravel on roads.
items.ex_zh: 重型压路机被调来压平路面上新铺设的碎石。
items.ex2_en: The tall prairie grass flattened under the relentless force of the autumn gale.
items.ex2_zh: 高高的草原牧草在秋季狂风的无情肆虐下平倒在地。

items.def_en: To pack or press loose particles or earth tightly together into a solid, firm mass
items.ex_en: Heavy vibrating machinery operates continuously to compact the loose foundation soil before pouring concrete.
items.ex_zh: 在浇筑混凝土之前，重型振动机械持续运转以压实松散的地基土。
items.ex2_en: Freshly poured gravel compactor layers compact readily after several heavy downpours.
items.ex2_zh: 几场大雨过后，新铺设的碎石层很容易压实成片。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures applying continuous, direct mechanical force onto an object to compact it, flatten it, extract its contents, or reduce its volume. 'Press' denotes direct perpendicular pressure, while 'compress' focuses on volumetric shrinkage, and 'flatten' on transforming 3D shape into a sheet.
groups.summary_zh: 指施加持续压力使物体压紧、压实、压扁或挤出汁液内部物质。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame detail the application of opposing physical forces to alter an object's dimensions, extract internal fluids, or flatten structure, contrasting with generic reshaping by focusing on volumetric reduction or flattening.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词强调施加相向机械力以挤出内部液体、减缩体积或使之平扁，区别于一般的塑形，着眼于体积极限压缩或形态扁平化。
groups.nuance_en: press: apply steady continuous force against a surface (button / clothes / fruit) · squeeze: compress firmly from opposite sides, often to extract liquid or force through a gap (lemon / hand / trigger) · compress: condense volume or data inward through applied force (gas / spring / spine) · flatten: eliminate thickness or curvature by spreading level (dough / cardboard / curves) · compact: crush or densify particles into an immovable, solid matrix (rubbish / snow / sediments)
groups.nuance_zh: press: 持续向物料表面施加稳定平压 (button / clothes / fruit) · squeeze: 自两侧用力挤捏，常为挤出汁液或迫使其穿过缝隙 (lemon / hand / trigger) · compress: 施力向内收拢以压缩体积或气压 (gas / spring / spine) · flatten: 强力辗平或拍扁以消除厚度与凹凸 (dough / cardboard / curves) · compact: 将散料强烈压实为紧实硬块 (rubbish / snow / sediments)

groups.name: Prevent & Bar · 阻碍与禁止 (Bar, Block, Ban)
groups.tip: 立设门槛严令阻绝

items.def_en: To exclude someone from entering a location, joining an activity, or having access to an opportunity
items.ex_en: Unfair institutional policies intentionally shut out qualified candidates from participating in the program.
items.ex_zh: 不合理的体制性政策故意将合格的候选人排斥在参与该项目之外。

items.def_en: To stop something from moving forward, or to close off an entrance, path, or process
items.ex_en: Fallen tree trunks completely blocked the narrow mountain pass after the violent storm.
items.ex_zh: 暴风雨过后，倒塌的树干把狭窄的山口彻底堵死了。

items.def_zh: 阻拦，阻挡；禁止，阻止；用门闩闩上
items.def_en: 1. To close or secure an entrance with bars or a door bolt. 2. To prevent someone from going somewhere, or ban them from doing something.
items.ex_en: The security guards immediately locked the iron gates to bar intruders from entering.
items.ex_zh: 保安人员立即锁上铁门，阻止侵入者进入建筑内部。

items.def_en: To forbid someone officially from doing something or entering a place, usually by law or regulation
items.ex_en: The city council voted decisively to ban heavy trucks from downtown historic districts.
items.ex_zh: 市议会果断投票，明令禁止重型卡车驶入市中心的历史文化街区。

items.def_zh: 正式剥夺资格；排斥在外
items.def_en: To officially exclude or prohibit someone from an activity, right, or privilege
items.ex_en: His previous criminal record will debar him from holding any public administrative office.
items.ex_zh: 他过去的犯罪记录将依法正式剥夺他担任任何公共行政职位的资格。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on officially, legally, or physically barring an agent from access, participation, or forward progress through authoritative or physical obstacles.
groups.summary_zh: 通过法律、权威或物理障碍强行禁止进入或阻隔行动。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe erecting absolute physical, institutional, or legal barriers that exclude access, participation, or transit, contrasting with partial deterrence or regulation.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词描述在物理、体制或法理上设置绝对屏障，严密封锁进出通道、准入资格或通行权益，区别于部分威慑或温和监管。
groups.nuance_en: bar: firmly secure an entrance or legally exclude someone from entry/rights (entry / candidates / exit) · block: physically obstruct a passage or prevent progress from moving forward (road / traffic / path) · ban: officially or legally prohibit an action, item, or practice (import / chemical / weapons) · shut out: physically lock out or systematically exclude from participation (competitors / cold / daylight) · debar: formally and legally disqualify someone from a privilege or office (attorney / participant / candidate)
groups.nuance_zh: bar: 封锁通道或在法律/资格上绝对排拒准入 (entry / candidates / exit) · block: 物理性堵截路口或实质阻挡通行进展 (road / traffic / path) · ban: 依照官方法令明确予以查禁、禁止 (import / chemical / weapons) · shut out: 闭门拒之门外，或使外界无从渗入 (competitors / cold / daylight) · debar: 依法剥夺权利或取消公职从业资格 (attorney / participant / candidate)

groups.name: Prevent & Preclude · 阻碍与杜绝 (Prevent, Preclude, Bar)
groups.tip: 防患未然阻断发生

items.def_zh: 正式阻止；封堵（权利或途径）
items.def_en: to officially forbid someone from doing something, or prevent an action or entry
items.ex_en: Strict newly enacted regulations bar foreign companies from acquiring domestic critical energy infrastructure.
items.ex_zh: 最新颁布的严格法规禁止外国公司收购本国的关键能源基础设施。

items.def_en: 1. (+ from) To stop something from happening or prevent someone from doing something.
items.ex_en: Wearing a heavy protective suit will prevent workers from absorbing hazardous chemical residues.
items.ex_zh: 穿戴厚重的防护服可以防止工人们吸入有害的化学残留物。

items.def_en: to take action to stop something unpleasant from happening before it starts
items.ex_en: Diplomats worked tirelessly through the night to head off an imminent military confrontation.
items.ex_zh: 外交官们通宵达旦地不知疲倦工作，以抢先化解一场迫在眉睫的军事冲突。

items.def_en: 1. (+ from) (formal) To make something impossible, or to prevent someone from doing something.
items.ex_en: Severe physical injuries unfortunately preclude the injured athlete from competing in the upcoming championships.
items.ex_zh: 严重的身体创伤遗憾地使这位受伤的运动员无法参加即将到来的锦标赛。

items.def_en: to prevent something from happening or someone from doing something by doing something first
items.ex_en: The corporation acquired its major rival early to forestall aggressive hostile takeover attempts.
items.ex_zh: 该企业及早收购了其主要竞争对手，以抢先防范激进的恶意收购企图。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to stopping an action, event, or condition from happening in advance, ranging from general proactive deterrence to absolute structural or logical exclusion.
groups.summary_zh: 指预先采取行动或因条件限制而使某事无法发生。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote proactively shutting down possibilities or thwarting emerging occurrences before they can materialize, contrasting with tackling crises already underway.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词表示抢先切断后续事态发展的路径、掐灭萌芽，使不利事件彻底无法成真，区别于对正在发生之事的应对平息。
groups.nuance_en: prevent: take proactive measures to stop an anticipated event from happening (disease / crime / accidents) · preclude: make impossible by prior circumstances or fundamental logic (misunderstanding / debate / recovery) · forestall: act swiftly in advance to counter and head off another's move or event (recession / crisis / coup) · head off: intercept and divert an approaching problem before it hits (conflict / disaster / panic) · bar: impose a definitive disqualifying barrier against an outcome (access / entry / advancement)
groups.nuance_zh: prevent: 采取常规或积极预防措施防止事件发生 (disease / crime / accidents) · preclude: 因既定前提或逻辑机理而彻底杜绝其发生 (misunderstanding / debate / recovery) · forestall: 抢先出招截断对方势头或化解迫近危机 (recession / crisis / coup) · head off: 半路拦截并引开即将撞击的问题或灾难 (conflict / disaster / panic) · bar: 设置不可逾越的禁令阻断通路或晋升可能 (access / entry / advancement)

groups.name: Preview & Pre-screen · 试映与预先审看 (Preview, Screen, Sample)
groups.tip: 提前预览把关整体效果

items.def_en: Try, hear, or inspect a small part of a work or product before experiencing the whole
items.ex_en: Subscribers can sample several unreleased audio tracks on the streaming platform before purchase.
items.ex_zh: 订户可以在购买前在流媒体平台上试听几首尚未发行的音频曲目。

items.def_en: Show a film or video to a selected audience before public release
items.ex_en: The studio organized an exclusive private event to screen the director's cut tonight.
items.ex_zh: 制片厂今晚组织了一场专属私人活动，预审试映导演剪辑版电影。

items.def_zh: 预览，预先审查；试映，预演
items.def_en: To inspect, view, or exhibit something before it is officially released or shown to the public.
items.ex_en: Industry critics gathered at the private theater to preview the upcoming independent drama.
items.ex_zh: 业内影评人齐聚私人影院，提前预览观摩即将上映的独立剧情片。

items.def_en: Get an informal, early look at an unreleased product, movie, or presentation
items.ex_en: Select industry insiders were invited to sneak-peek the studio's unreleased sci-fi trailer.
items.ex_zh: 少数行业内部人士受邀抢先观看了该工作室未发布的科幻电影预告片。

items.def_en: Examine material thoroughly before allowing it to be shown or disseminated publicly
items.ex_en: The legal department must thoroughly vet the manuscript before its international distribution.
items.ex_zh: 法律部门必须在手稿进行国际发行之前对其进行彻底审查。

groups.summary_en: Verbs centered on seeing, examining, or displaying creative works, media, or exhibits in advance of broad release to evaluate quality, readiness, or reaction.
groups.summary_zh: 指在正式公开放映、出版或展出前预先观摩、审查或试看。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe displaying, viewing, or evaluating creative material, media, or candidates selectively prior to broad public release, contrasting with official post-launch viewing.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词描述在大规模公开放映、发行或上岗前，针对作品或对象进行定向预展、试看或审查评估，区别于正式发布后的常规检视。
groups.nuance_en: preview: show or inspect an advance exhibition of a film, show, or product (exhibition / film / episode) · screen: project a film or video to evaluate it or show to a select audience (movie / footage / documentary) · vet: investigate the background and suitability of a candidate or material thoroughly (candidate / script / credentials) · sneak-peek: take an informal, secret, or early glimpse of upcoming work (footage / trailer / collection) · sample: test or experience a brief excerpt of content before committing (music / chapter / product)
groups.nuance_zh: preview: 正式上映前安排定向预演、试映或预展 (exhibition / film / episode) · screen: 内部放映影像作品以供审看或选拔 (movie / footage / documentary) · vet: 严谨审查候选人身家背景或文稿合格度 (candidate / script / credentials) · sneak-peek: 提前且带有内幕性质地窥看新片或新品局部 (footage / trailer / collection) · sample: 局部试听、试读或取样试用 (music / chapter / product)

groups.name: Prickling & Thrilling Sensations · 麻刺与微颤感 (Prickle, Throbbing, Thrill)
groups.tip: 皮肤如针扎般麻木微刺

items.def_zh: 嗡嗡鸣响；有微颤麻刺感
items.def_en: Vibrate or tingle continuously with energy, excitement, or sensory overload
items.ex_en: Her entire body buzzed with electric excitement after stepping onto the main stage.
items.ex_zh: 登上主舞台后，她全身上下都因强烈的兴奋而微微发颤。

items.def_zh: 感到刺痛，发麻；（因强烈情感而）激动
items.def_en: To have a slight prickling, stinging, or vibrating feeling on your skin, especially from cold, excitement, or fear.
items.ex_en: A sharp winter chill made the traveler's weary cheeks tingle with quiet fire.
items.ex_zh: 冬日的刺骨寒意让旅人疲惫的面颊隐隐泛起针扎般的灼痛。

items.def_en: Experience a slight, sharp prickling or itching feeling across the skin
items.ex_en: The thick wool sweater made his sensitive skin prickle under the collar.
items.ex_zh: 那件厚羊毛衫让他的敏感皮肤在衣领下感到阵阵发痒刺痛。
items.ex2_en: Tiny needle points can prickle delicate skin during traditional acupuncture treatments.
items.ex2_zh: 在传统的针灸治疗过程中，细小的针尖会刺痛娇嫩的皮肤。

items.def_en: (of skin/flesh) Feel as if tiny insects are creeping over it from fear or revulsion
items.ex_en: Seeing hundreds of spiders emerge from the crack made her skin crawl instantly.
items.ex_zh: 看到数百只蜘蛛从裂缝中钻出来，瞬间让她浑身起鸡皮疙瘩。

items.def_zh: 感到阵阵震颤；使激动颤抖
items.def_en: Produce or experience a sudden wave of keen physical excitement or shivering sensation
items.ex_en: A cold shiver thrilled down his spine as the eerie music swelled.
items.ex_zh: 随着诡异音乐的响起，一阵寒颤顺着他的脊梁阵阵激荡。
items.ex2_en: The terrifying ghost story thrilled the young listeners around the warm campfire.
items.ex2_zh: 可怕的鬼故事让围坐在温暖篝火旁的年轻听众感到毛骨悚然又刺激。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers slight prickling, tingling, or crawling sensations on the skin, triggered by cold, returning circulation, or intense emotion. Tingle and prickle describe subtle electrical or needle-like skin sensations, whereas thrum and thrill suggest vibrant resonance.
groups.summary_zh: 因寒冷、血液流通或情绪激动引起的皮肤发麻、刺痒或震颤感。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame express visceral, localized cutaneous or nervous paresthesia (tingling, goosebumps, shivering exhilaration), contrasting with diffuse emotional moods or blunt pain.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词表达皮肤表层或神经末梢所产生的针刺、发麻、微颤或毛骨悚然的生理/情绪混感，区别于弥散的心境或剧烈的钝痛。
groups.nuance_en: tingle: feel a mild stinging, prickly, or exhilarating electrical sensation (skin / spine / fingers) · prickle: produce sharp, pinpoint cutaneous needle-like sensations (scalp / skin / neck) · thrill: send a sudden, intense wave of excited pleasure or suspense through the nerves (audience / spine / spectator) · crawl: evoke a creepy, shuddering sensation as if insects were walking over skin (skin / flesh / scalp) · buzz: experience a vibrating, hum-like energetic or intoxicated sensation (ears / head / crowd)
groups.nuance_zh: tingle: 皮肤或神经感受到微弱麻刺或隐隐悸动 (skin / spine / fingers) · prickle: 皮肤如针扎般细密刺痛或汗毛竖起 (scalp / skin / neck) · thrill: 产生贯穿脊柱的电击般骤然兴奋或悬疑快感 (audience / spine / spectator) · crawl: 产生如蚁爬般的毛骨悚然或肉跳感 (skin / flesh / scalp) · buzz: 感觉耳鸣发嗡、颅内轰鸣或处于微醺兴奋中 (ears / head / crowd)

groups.name: Prime & Undercoat · 打底与涂封 (Undercoat, Prime, Precoat)
groups.tip: 给工件打底漆涂抹保护涂层

items.def_en: To lay down an initial priming foundation layer on canvas or board prior to painting
items.ex_en: The artist carefully grounded the linen canvas with white lead before sketching.
items.ex_zh: 画家在勾勒草图之前，先用白铅仔细地给亚麻画布打上一层底子。

items.def_en: To coat a porous material like paper, plaster, or canvas with gelatinous size to seal it
items.ex_en: You should size the raw watercolor paper with dilute gelatin before painting.
items.ex_zh: 在作画之前，你应该用稀明胶给未经处理的水彩纸刮胶封孔。

items.def_en: To brush or spray a clear protective sealant over a porous base to prevent fluid penetration
items.ex_en: Workers sealed the porous concrete floor with a protective clear acrylic coat.
items.ex_zh: 工人们在多孔水泥地面上喷涂了一层透明丙烯酸保护层进行封固。

items.def_en: To apply a preliminary coat of primer onto an untreated surface before the main paint layer
items.ex_en: Make sure to prime the bare drywall thoroughly before applying the yellow paint.
items.ex_zh: 在涂刷黄色面漆之前，务必给裸露的石膏板彻底打上底漆。

items.def_en: to apply a base layer of paint or protective primer to a surface before adding the top coat
items.ex_en: The painter undercoated the iron gate with red oxide to prevent future rust.
items.ex_zh: 油漆工在铁门上涂了一层红丹防锈底漆，以防止日后生锈。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this technical preparation frame concern applying a preliminary foundational layer of paint, sealant, or primer before adding finishing topcoats. This provides adhesion, prevents absorption, or blocks corrosion.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及在涂刷面漆前施加底漆或密封层，以增强附着力和防腐封闭性。
groups.desc_en: Applying a preparatory base or sealant layer to a substrate before the final finish, contrasting with generic 'paint' or 'cover' by emphasizing structural porosity reduction, bonding, or stabilization.
groups.desc_zh: 在施加终饰面之前对基底涂覆预备层或封闭层，与普通的“涂漆/覆盖”相比，强调降低孔隙率、增强附着力或稳固表面。
groups.nuance_en: prime: apply initial bonding coat (canvas / wall / metal) · undercoat: apply intermediate opacity/leveling layer (woodwork / vehicle / primer) · seal: block porosity or moisture ingress (grout / timber / concrete) · size: treat porous surfaces with gelatinous wash (paper / canvas / plaster) · ground: lay classical foundation pigment layer (linen / board / panel)
groups.nuance_zh: prime: 涂刷底漆以增强附着 (canvas / wall / metal) · undercoat: 涂中间层遮盖找平 (woodwork / vehicle / primer) · seal: 封堵毛孔防潮防渗 (grout / timber / concrete) · size: 用胶料涂刷处理多孔基面 (paper / canvas / plaster) · ground: 铺覆传统画作基底白垩层 (linen / board / panel)

groups.name: Privatize & Denationalize · 私有化与民营转制 (Privatize, Denationalize, Deregulate)
groups.tip: 把公有资产转为私有民营

items.def_zh: 非国有化；使脱离国家所有
items.def_en: to restore a nationalized enterprise, industry, or public property to private ownership
items.ex_en: The legislature passed historic legislation to denationalize the country's strategic freight rail network.
items.ex_zh: 立法机构通过了一项具有历史意义的法案，将国家战略货运铁路网非国有化。

items.def_en: to arrange for external private companies to supply public or municipal services
items.ex_en: The agency decided to contract out its IT support services.
items.ex_zh: 该机构决定将IT技术支持业务外包。

items.def_en: to sell off enterprise assets, business holdings, or subsidiary investments
items.ex_en: The conglomerate resolved to divest its unprofitable chemical divisions by the third quarter.
items.ex_zh: 该企业集团决定在第三季度前剥离其未盈利的化学品业务部门。

items.raw_cluster: 私有化与转移 Privatize & Transfer
items.def_en: to sell or transfer a state-owned business, industry, or public service to private ownership
items.ex_en: The government announced definitive plans to privatise the municipal water supply utility company.
items.ex_zh: 政府宣布了将市政供水公用事业公司私有化的明确计划。

items.def_en: to remove or reduce state regulations, restrictions, and statutory oversight in a sector
items.ex_en: Ministries collaborated to deregulate the telecommunications market and stimulate aggressive foreign investment.
items.ex_zh: 各部委协同合作以放宽电信市场的准入管制，从而刺激外资投入。

groups.summary_en: This macroeconomic policy frame describes divesting state assets, nationalized monopolies, or public utilities to private corporations or market investors, alongside reducing bureaucratic state controls.
groups.summary_zh: 指政府将国有资产、公共服务或专营权出售转让给民营企业或资本。
groups.desc_en: Transferring state-owned assets, public services, or statutory monopolies to private enterprise and market control, unlike general 'sell' or 'decentralize'.
groups.desc_zh: 将国有资产、公共服务或法定垄断经营权移交私营企业与市场机制，区别于宽泛的“出售”或“放权”。
groups.nuance_en: privatise: sell state enterprise to private investors (railway / utility / telecoms) · denationalize: return nationalized industry to private ownership (steel / banking / coal) · contract out: tender specific public operations to private vendors (waste management / catering / security) · divest: strip away or sell subsidiary holdings (assets / shares / division) · deregulate: remove statutory operational restrictions (market / sector / airline)
groups.nuance_zh: privatise: 将国企整体私有化出售 (railway / utility / telecoms) · denationalize: 逆转国有化政策返还私营 (steel / banking / coal) · contract out: 将公共职能外包给私商承接 (waste management / catering / security) · divest: 剥离或处置从属资产份额 (assets / shares / division) · deregulate: 废除管制放开市场竞争 (market / sector / airline)

groups.name: Procreate & Bear · 繁育与孕育 (Beget, Sire, Conceive)
groups.tip: 生物繁衍诞下新生命

items.def_zh: 做……的父亲，生（子）；创立，首创
items.def_en: 1. To be the biological father of a child; to make someone pregnant. 2. To initiate or create a new idea or invention.
items.ex_en: DNA analysis confirmed that the local craftsman had indeed fathered the missing boy.
items.ex_zh: DNA检测证实，那位当地手匠确实是那个失踪男孩的生父。

items.def_en: To become pregnant with a child in the womb
items.ex_en: The specialist helped the patient conceive her first child through targeted clinical intervention.
items.ex_zh: 专家通过针对性的临床干预帮助这位患者怀上了她的第一胎。

items.def_zh: 成为…的父亲；（雄性动物）配种繁殖
items.def_en: To be the male parent of an animal or, more rarely, a human child
items.ex_en: The pedigree thoroughbred stallion has sired over thirty champion racehorses in Kentucky.
items.ex_zh: 这匹纯种公马已在肯塔基州繁育出三十多匹冠军赛马。

items.def_en: To produce children as a father, or literary to cause something to happen
items.ex_en: Ancient patriarchs believed that ancestral pride would ultimately beget noble and virtuous sons.
items.ex_zh: 古代先祖坚信家族的荣耀终将孕育出高贵而贤德的子嗣。

items.def_en: To produce young or offspring through sexual reproduction
items.ex_en: Certain rare amphibians migrate to high mountain springs solely to procreate safely.
items.ex_zh: 某些稀有两栖动物迁徙到高山泉水中只为安全地繁衍后代。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the biological or metaphorical generation of offspring and lineages. It distinguishes between male paternal acts of siring, maternal acts of conceiving and bearing, and broader figurative procreation.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖生育、孕育后代以及引申的催生事物，区分父系与母系生殖角色。
groups.desc_en: Bringing biological offspring into existence through generation or impregnation, contrasting with cultural 'rear/raise' by focusing exclusively on biological origin and lineage.
groups.desc_zh: 通过生殖或受孕使生物后代诞生，与后天抚养区别在于严格聚焦生物学起源与血脉繁衍。
groups.nuance_en: procreate: reproduce biologically as a species (offspring / species / children) · beget: generate as male parent, or cause formally (son / heir / violence) · sire: father as male, especially thoroughbred stock (champion / foal / litter) · conceive: become pregnant with an embryo (child / twins / fetus) · father: acknowledge or provide biological paternity (child / son / daughter)
groups.nuance_zh: procreate: 种群繁衍生殖 (offspring / species / children) · beget: 男性生育后代或衍生结果 (son / heir / violence) · sire: 雄性配种繁育 (champion / foal / litter) · conceive: 母体受孕怀胎 (child / twins / fetus) · father: 作为生父孕育或确认亲子关系 (child / son / daughter)

groups.name: Procure & Source · 采购与物色 (Procure, Requisition, Purvey)
groups.tip: 寻找货源并采购

items.def_en: To obtain materials, components, or services from a particular supplier, place, or business.
items.ex_en: We source our organic coffee beans directly from fair-trade cooperatives in Colombia.
items.ex_zh: 我们直接从哥伦比亚的公平贸易合作社采购有机咖啡豆。

items.def_en: Obtain goods or services from an outside or foreign supplier instead of an internal source
items.ex_en: The tech firm decided to outsource routine customer service operations to Manila.
items.ex_zh: 这家科技公司决定将常规客户服务业务外包给马尼拉的团队。

items.def_en: Provide or supply food, goods, or services as a business
items.ex_en: The prestigious merchant has purveyed fine vintage wines to European royal households.
items.ex_zh: 这家享有盛誉的商行长期向欧洲王室供应高档陈年佳酿。

items.def_en: Obtain goods or supplies, especially with care or through formal organizational channels
items.ex_en: The hospital administration struggled to procure vital antibiotic supplies during the winter.
items.ex_zh: 医院管理层在冬季极力通过正规渠道调配获取关键的抗生素物资。

items.def_en: Demand the use or supply of materials by an official order
items.ex_en: Military authorities were authorized to requisition private transport vehicles during the national emergency.
items.ex_zh: 在国家紧急状态期间，军事部门被授权依法征用民用运输车辆。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the systematic, professional, or logistical acquisition of goods, materials, or suppliers for organizational or commercial purposes.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过特定渠道、供应链或正规流程系统性采购与物色物资。
groups.desc_en: Systematically obtaining needed provisions, resources, or vendors through commercial search or institutional requisition, differing from simple 'buy' by implying administrative process or supply-chain logistics.
groups.desc_zh: 通过商业搜寻或行政征调系统化获取所需物资与供应商，与单纯“购买”相比强调寻源与供应链流程。
groups.nuance_en: procure: obtain through effort, negotiation, or formal acquisition (materials / contract / supplies) · source: trace, evaluate, and obtain from suppliers (components / raw materials / talent) · requisition: officially demand or seize under authority (vehicles / supplies / building) · purvey: supply provisions or goods commercially (food / wine / gossip) · outsource: contract internal functions to external vendors (IT / production / services)
groups.nuance_zh: procure: 经公文谈判正规采办 (materials / contract / supplies) · source: 寻源物色原材与供应商 (components / raw materials / talent) · requisition: 凭公权力或官方指令征用 (vehicles / supplies / building) · purvey: 商业化供应用于配给 (food / wine / gossip) · outsource: 将内部业务外包第三方 (IT / production / services)

groups.name: Procurement & Pandering · 居间拉皮条与色情揽客 (Pimp, Procure, Pander)
groups.tip: 暗中拉拢涉足灰色非法交易

items.def_zh: 招揽顾客；兜售色情服务
items.def_en: To aggressively solicit business, patronage, or illicit services from passersby
items.ex_en: Shady operators often tout illicit services to unsuspecting tourists outside the station.
items.ex_zh: 可疑分子经常在车站外向毫不知情的游客兜售非法服务。

items.raw_cluster: 拉皮条与包办 Procure & Pimp
items.def_zh: 拉皮条；包办拉拢；（俚语）打扮，改装
items.def_en: 1. To act as a pimp by procuring clients for prostitutes. 2. (slang, usually 'pimp out/up') To customize, decorate, or make something showy.
items.ex_en: Undercover officers arrested the suspect for attempting to pimp vulnerable runaway teenagers.
items.ex_zh: 便衣警察逮捕了试图拉拢诱导弱势离家出走少女卖淫的嫌疑人。

items.def_en: To obtain or provide a person to act as a prostitute, especially in a legal context
items.ex_en: Federal prosecutors charged the broker with attempting to procure women for foreign syndicates.
items.ex_zh: 联邦检察官指控该掮客企图为外国犯罪团伙物色提供卖淫人员。

items.def_en: To accost someone in public or private to offer sex work or obtain clients for another
items.ex_en: Plainclothes detectives apprehended several individuals attempting to solicit patrons along the avenue.
items.ex_zh: 便衣刑警逮捕了数名企图沿着大街招揽嫖客的涉案人员。

items.def_zh: (+ to) 迎合恶俗；充当淫媒
items.def_en: (+ to) To cater to base desires or illicit vices, or to act as a pimp
items.ex_en: The unscrupulous publisher pandered to the lowest voyeuristic instincts of the tabloid readers.
items.ex_zh: 那个毫无职业操守的出版商迎合了小报读者最恶俗的窥探心理。

groups.summary_en: This legal and social frame involves acting as an intermediary to solicit, manage, or provide individuals for illicit sexual exploitation or prostitution. Nuances range from legal statutory procurement to street solicitation and metaphorical catering to vulgar desires.
groups.summary_zh: 指充当掮客操纵、物色或拉拢他人从事色情交易的非法行为。
groups.desc_en: Illicitly arranging sexual acts or commercial sex clients on behalf of others, differing from general 'negotiate' or 'solicit' by its exploitative criminal facilitation.
groups.desc_zh: 为他人居间撮合、引诱或拉拢从事商业性交易，区别于一般商业拉客，专指非法的色情中介与剥削。
groups.nuance_en: procure: legally arrange prostitutes or illicit sex acts (prostitutes / minors / women) · pimp: manage, control, and profit from prostitutes (workers / women / streets) · pander: cater to, exploit, or broker base desires (tastes / instincts / vice) · solicit: approach prospective clients directly for paid sex (customers / trade / men) · tout: aggressively importune passersby to buy sexual services (brothel / services / tourists)
groups.nuance_zh: procure: 设法诱使或居间提供色情人员 (prostitutes / minors / women) · pimp: 操控剥削皮条客拉客 (workers / women / streets) · pander: 迎合低级趣味或充当色情掮客 (tastes / instincts / vice) · solicit: 站街或主动向潜在客源招嫖 (customers / trade / men) · tout: 强行招揽兜售风月场所服务 (brothel / services / tourists)

groups.name: Promise & Assure · 承诺与保证 (Promise, Assure, Guarantee)
groups.tip: 从口头许诺到立下郑重誓言

items.def_en: To tell someone positively that something is true or will definitely happen to dispel doubt
items.ex_en: The lead engineer assured the board that the bridge was structurally sound.
items.ex_zh: 首席工程师向董事会保证，该桥梁在结构上是安全可靠的。

items.def_zh: 做出许诺，以个人名誉担保
items.def_en: To make a sincere, binding personal promise to carry out an action or keep confidence
items.ex_en: I give my word that all sensitive documents will remain strictly confidential.
items.ex_zh: 我以个人名誉担保，所有机密文件都将得到绝对保密。

items.def_en: 1. To state clearly that you will definitely do something or give something. 2. To show signs of a particular, usually positive, future outcome.
items.ex_en: She promised to return the borrowed reference book before the library closed.
items.ex_zh: 她答应在图书馆闭馆前归还借阅的参考书。

items.def_en: To give an absolute assurance that conditions will be met or a product/outcome is assured
items.ex_en: The contractor guarantees that the roof repair will withstand heavy seasonal storms.
items.ex_zh: 承包商担保屋顶修缮能够抵御季节性的特大暴风雨。

items.def_zh: 担保，立誓担保品质或事实
items.def_en: To state with confidence or legally attest that a specific fact, state, or standard holds true
items.ex_en: The vendor warrants that every refurbished smartphone conforms to rigorous manufacturing specifications.
items.ex_zh: 该销售方立誓担保每部翻新智能手机均符合严格的制造标准。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame cover verbal declarations designed to instill confidence that an event will occur or that expectations will be fully satisfied.
groups.summary_zh: 给予口头保证或承诺以使人安心信任。
groups.desc_en: Binding oneself to future performance or truth through explicit verbal pledges and varying degrees of liability, contrasting with mere 'assert' or 'state'.
groups.desc_zh: 通过明确口头承诺或信誉担保将自身绑定于未来行为或真实性，区别于单纯的“陈述”或“宣称”。
groups.nuance_en: promise: commit one's personal integrity to an act (help / payment / return) · assure: remove another's doubt with emphatic confidence (safety / client / public) · guarantee: assume full formal or financial liability for an outcome (success / loan / product) · warrant: officially attest that a standard or condition holds true (quality / arrest / safety) · give one's word: pledge solemn personal honor (honor / allegiance / promise)
groups.nuance_zh: promise: 凭个人信誉许诺 (help / payment / return) · assure: 消除对方疑虑作确信保证 (safety / client / public) · guarantee: 承担法律或经济连带担保 (success / loan / product) · warrant: 官方正式证明/担保品质 (quality / arrest / safety) · give one's word: 以个人名誉立誓 (honor / allegiance / promise)

groups.name: Promise in Marriage · 订婚与联姻许配 (Affiance, Espouse, Plight)
groups.tip: 家族传统下约定终身与定下婚约

items.def_en: To make a formal, solemn commitment to give someone in marriage
items.ex_en: The nobleman promised his eldest daughter to the duke in a political pact.
items.ex_zh: 这位贵族出于政治盟约将长女许配给了那位公爵。

items.def_en: To promise someone solemnly in marriage, typically used in passive forms
items.ex_en: The young princess was formally affianced to the prince across the sea.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的公主被正式许配给了海对岸的王子。

items.def_en: To solemnly pledge one's faith or promise to marry another person
items.ex_en: The knight plighted his eternal troth to the maiden beneath the cathedral.
items.ex_zh: 骑士在大教堂下向那位少女立下了生死相随的婚盟誓约。

items.def_en: To marry a person, or to give a woman in marriage to someone
items.ex_en: The widowed merchant chose to espouse the daughter of an impoverished diplomat.
items.ex_zh: 这位丧偶的商人选择迎娶一位家境贫寒的外交官之女。

items.def_en: (formal or archaic) To promise someone in marriage to another person.
items.ex_en: Her aristocratic parents had betrothed her to a wealthy viscount in infancy.
items.ex_zh: 她的贵族父母在她尚在襁褓中时便将她许配给了一位富有的子爵。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the formal, legal, or ceremonial commitment of promising someone (or oneself) to enter into matrimonial union.
groups.summary_zh: 缔结正式婚约，将自己或他人以誓言许配给对方。
groups.desc_en: Formalizing or pledging a future union in marriage through contractual, ritual, or customary covenants, distinct from casual dating or informal agreement.
groups.desc_zh: 通过契约、仪式或传统盟约确立未来的婚姻结合，区别于普通恋爱交往或口头闲谈。
groups.nuance_en: betroth: formally bind in mutual contract to marry (daughter / heir / couple) · affiance: solemnize betrothal under archaic/legal pledge (prince / daughter / lovers) · plight: pledge faith, loyalty, or marriage vows solemnly (troth / word / faith) · espouse: take up as spouse, or figuratively adopt a cause (bride / daughter / cause) · promise: informally or privately pledge marriage (hand / marriage / devotion)
groups.nuance_zh: betroth: 门当户对订立婚约 (daughter / heir / couple) · affiance: 庄重立约许配 (prince / daughter / lovers) · plight: 郑重海誓山盟 (troth / word / faith) · espouse: 迎娶结为连理，引申拥护 (bride / daughter / cause) · promise: 私下许以婚嫁 (hand / marriage / devotion)

groups.name: Promote & Upgrade · 晋升与提档 (Promote, Elevate, Advance)
groups.tip: 提升职级、档次或待遇

items.def_en: To help someone succeed or move forward in their career or life
items.ex_en: The research fellowship significantly advanced his scientific career within the prestigious faculty.
items.ex_zh: 该研究奖学金极大推进了他在该顶尖学系内的科研事业发展。
items.ex2_en: The determined young researcher advanced rapidly through the university academic ranks.
items.ex2_zh: 这位意志坚定的年轻研究员在大学学术阶梯上迅速晋升。

items.def_en: To advance someone to a higher position or rank in an organization
items.ex_en: The department head promoted the young analyst after her remarkable quarterly performance.
items.ex_zh: 年轻分析师季度业绩斐然，部门主管随即对其进行了职务提拔。

items.def_zh: 提升，提拔；使（系统、机器等）升级
items.def_en: To promote someone to a higher position or rank; to raise something to a higher standard or newer version.
items.ex_en: The general manager decided to upgrade the diligent technician to junior project supervisor.
items.ex_zh: 总经理决定将那位勤恳的技术员提拔为初级项目主管。

items.def_en: To promote someone to a position with an impressive title but less real power
items.ex_en: The board kicked him upstairs to honorary chairman to strip his executive authority.
items.ex_zh: 董事会将他明升暗降为名誉董事长，以剥夺他的实际行政权力。

items.def_en: To raise someone to a more important or higher moral, cultural, or professional level
items.ex_en: Her selfless dedication elevated her from a field volunteer to an international delegate.
items.ex_zh: 她无私的奉献将她从一名基层志愿者提升为国际代表。

groups.summary_en: Covers advancing a person to a higher rank, grade, or level, or raising a system or product to a more functional standard.
groups.summary_zh: 在职级、待遇或系统品质上进行提升与升级。
groups.desc_en: Advancing a person or asset to a higher rank, grade, or functional status within a formal hierarchy, contrasting with lateral movement or quantitative growth.
groups.desc_zh: 在科层制或评级体系中将人员或资财提升至更高层级/规格，区别于横向平调或单纯的数量增长。
groups.nuance_en: promote: raise to higher rank or office based on merit/need (officer / manager / student) · elevate: loft to distinguished social or spiritual status (status / status / peerage) · advance: push forward along a professional trajectory (career / standing / interests) · upgrade: substitute or improve with a higher-specification version (ticket / system / software) · kick upstairs: promote ostensibly to remove from operational power (rival / executive / minister)
groups.nuance_zh: promote: 考绩晋升职衔 (officer / manager / student) · elevate: 尊奉擢升社会声望或爵位 (status / status / peerage) · advance: 推动生涯阶梯向前迈进 (career / standing / interests) · upgrade: 提档升级至更高规格 (ticket / system / software) · kick upstairs: 明升暗降架空实权 (rival / executive / minister)

groups.name: Pronounce with Accent · 地方腔发音与卷舌 (Lisp, Drawl, Trill)
groups.tip: 带特有腔调清晰或含混发音

items.def_en: To articulate sibilants like 's' and 'z' as dental fricatives 'th'
items.ex_en: The toddler began to lisp whenever he tried saying words with 's'.
items.ex_zh: 这个蹒跚学步的孩子每当试图说出带“s”的词时就会咬舌发音。

items.def_zh: 发粗喉音（r音），带粗喉音腔调说话；发出嗡嗡声
items.def_en: To speak with a rough, rolling pronunciation of the letter 'r', or to produce a low whirring sound.
items.ex_en: The veteran boatman burred his sentences with a thick, melodic Scottish cadence.
items.ex_zh: 那位老船夫说话时带着浓重而悦耳的苏格兰喉音颤腔。

items.def_en: To speak in an unhurried manner, drawing out vowel sounds deliberately
items.ex_en: He drawled his answers lazily, leaning against the wooden porch railing nonchalantly.
items.ex_zh: 他懒洋洋地拖着长腔回答，漫不经心地靠在木质门廊栏杆上。

items.def_en: To speak with a sharp, resonant nasal quality characteristic of specific regional dialects
items.ex_en: The singer twanged each lyric with a heavy rustic Appalachian nasal accent.
items.ex_zh: 这位歌手用浓重的阿巴拉契亚乡村鼻音拖腔演唱每一句歌词。
items.ex2_en: The loose guitar strings twanged loudly when the clumsy child plucked them.
items.ex2_zh: 当笨手笨脚的孩子拨弄松弛的吉他琴弦时，琴弦发出了清脆的嗡嗡声。

items.def_en: To pronounce a consonant with rapid vibrating movements of the tongue against the palate
items.ex_en: The Italian soprano trilled her vibrant 'r's with effortless, breathtaking vocal precision.
items.ex_zh: 那位意大利女高音歌唱家毫不费力地以令人惊叹的精准度唱出清脆颤音。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on speech articulation characterized by idiosyncratic regional accents, guttural coloring, prolonged vowels, or specific tongue vibrations.
groups.summary_zh: 指带有浓厚口音特征、特异舌音或喉音的发声方式。
groups.desc_en: Articulating speech with marked phonological variations, regional cadences, or articulatory idiosyncrasies, contrasting with standard neutral pronunciation.
groups.desc_zh: 带有明显的地域韵律、发音器官缺陷或语音腔调发音，区别于标准中立的发音方式。
groups.nuance_en: drawl: speak with slow, lengthened vowel sounds (words / vowels / speech) · twang: speak with sharp, nasal resonance (accent / voice / dialect) · lisp: pronounce sibilants with tongue against teeth as 'th' (words / speech / sibilants) · burr: speak with a guttural, uvular, or trilled 'r' (accent / voice / consonants) · trill: articulate sounds with rapid vibration of the tongue (r's / consonants / syllables)
groups.nuance_zh: drawl: 拖长元音慢吞吞拉腔 (words / vowels / speech) · twang: 带有刺耳鼻音鼻音腔调 (accent / voice / dialect) · lisp: 咬舌发不清齿擦音 (words / speech / sibilants) · burr: 喉音/小舌卷舌咕噜腔 (accent / voice / consonants) · trill: 舌尖高速颤动打舌音 (r's / consonants / syllables)

groups.name: Proofread & Cross-Check · 校对与核查 (Proof, Copyedit, Cross-check)
groups.tip: 出版审核文字细节差错

items.def_en: Read printer's proofs or draft texts to detect and correct errors
items.ex_en: The editor stayed late to proof the final galley proofs before midnight.
items.ex_zh: 编辑加班到深夜，以便在午夜之前校阅最终的活版校样。

items.def_en: Edit written material by checking style, grammar, accuracy, and typography
items.ex_en: She spent weeks copyediting the exhaustive biographical anthology with meticulous typographic care.
items.ex_zh: 她花费数周时间，以对排版规范细致入微的审慎态度润色编辑这部传记文集。

items.def_en: Verify figures, facts, or information by using an alternative source or method
items.ex_en: Auditors cross-checked the ledger entries against the bank statements to ensure compliance.
items.ex_zh: 审计人员将总账分录与银行对账单进行交叉核对，以确保合规。

items.def_en: Investigate a document, report, or person carefully for accuracy or suitability
items.ex_en: The intelligence committee will vet the secret dossier before releasing redacted summaries.
items.ex_zh: 情报委员会将在发布删减版摘要之前仔细审查这份秘密卷宗。

items.def_en: To read a written or printed text carefully in order to find and correct spelling, grammar, or typing errors.
items.ex_en: Please proofread the final manuscript carefully to eliminate any remaining typographical errors.
items.ex_zh: 请仔细校对最终手稿，以消除任何残留的排版印刷错误。

groups.summary_en: Verbs detailing the meticulous scrutiny of text, data, or documents to identify typos, formatting inconsistencies, or factual errors before publication or distribution.
groups.summary_zh: 指出版或定稿前逐字逐句审阅排查错别字、语法或格式错误。
groups.desc_en: Systematically scrutinizing texts or data against exemplars, rules, or external facts to detect errors before release, distinct from substantive rewriting or initial writing.
groups.desc_zh: 依据母本、规则或外部事实对文本数据进行系统化检视以纠错防漏，区别于内容重写或起草。
groups.nuance_en: proofread: read printed proofs to flag typographical errors (manuscript / galleys / text) · proof: print and inspect preliminary impressions for defects (copy / negative / pages) · copyedit: correct grammar, syntax, and house-style adherence (article / book / prose) · cross-check: verify data accuracy against independent sources (facts / figures / references) · vet: investigate character, credentials, or suitability exhaustively (candidate / manuscript / report)
groups.nuance_zh: proofread: 校对排印清样挑出笔误 (manuscript / galleys / text) · proof: 制作试样并检视缺陷 (copy / negative / pages) · copyedit: 修正语法修辞与出版体例 (article / book / prose) · cross-check: 交叉核对不同来源数据 (facts / figures / references) · vet: 严密审查背景资质真实性 (candidate / manuscript / report)

groups.name: Prop & Shore · 物理撑起与加固维稳 (Shore, Prop, Truss)
groups.tip: 架起支柱顶住斜壁以防坍塌

items.def_en: To physically hold something in an upright position by placing something underneath or against it, often artificially sustaining it
items.ex_en: The workers propped up the sagging barn beam using two heavy timbers.
items.ex_zh: 工人们用两根粗重木料将谷仓下沉的横梁支了起来。

items.def_en: To support, brace, or steady a mast, wall, or upright structure with stays, guy wires, or braces
items.ex_en: Crew members stayed the main sailing mast with heavy galvanized steel cables.
items.ex_zh: 船员们用粗重的镀锌钢缆将主帆桅杆稳固地拉紧支牢。

items.def_zh: 用支柱加固；竭力挽救支撑
items.def_en: To support something physically using props or beams, or to intervene to keep a weak institution or system from failing
items.ex_en: The central bank acted decisively to shore up the struggling commercial lenders.
items.ex_zh: 中央银行果断采取行动，以支撑竭力维稳的商业贷款机构。

items.def_zh: 用支柱撑住，加固（常与up连用）；支持
items.def_en: 1. (+ up) To support or hold up something with props or beams. 2. (+ up) To strengthen or help a system, organisation, etc., that is weak or failing.
items.ex_en: Engineers hurried to shore the crumbling tunnel ceiling with heavy wooden props.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们赶忙用粗重的木支柱撑住摇摇欲坠的隧道顶板。

items.def_en: To physically reinforce or steady an object with structural supports to prevent movement under strain
items.ex_en: Carpenters braced the wooden framework securely against the approaching fierce gale winds.
items.ex_zh: 木工们用撑杆牢固加固了木构架，以抵御即将来袭的狂风。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on applying physical posts, struts, or timber to prevent a sagging or collapsing structure from falling, with extensive metaphorical extension to struggling systems or failing economies. 'Shore up' highlights buttressing weakened bases, while 'prop up' often carries overtones of artificial or precarious support.
groups.summary_zh: 通过斜撑支架防止坍塌倒下，常引申为挽救风雨飘摇的系统。
groups.desc_en: Applying physical supports or stabilizing interventions to prevent sagging, structural collapse, or decline, differing from fundamental rebuilding by acting as temporary or external reinforcement.
groups.desc_zh: 借助外部构件或临时支撑物撑牢防塌维稳，与推倒重建相比侧重应急性或外加式稳固。
groups.nuance_en: prop up: hold upright from leaning or falling with a leaning timber (wall / chin / ladder) · shore up: reinforce a weakened structure or system with heavy angled beams (cliff / wall / economy) · brace: secure firmly against shock, strain, or displacement (legs / beams / structure) · stay: hold in tension against wind or gravity via guy-wires (mast / chimney / post) · shore: support with timber shores against collapse (mine / trench / boat)
groups.nuance_zh: prop up: 斜靠立柱顶住下坠物 (wall / chin / ladder) · shore up: 加装重型斜撑维稳颓势 (cliff / wall / economy) · brace: 牢固拉撑以抗冲击形变 (legs / beams / structure) · stay: 绷紧缆索拉线固定 (mast / chimney / post) · shore: 设排桩支护坑道堤岸 (mine / trench / boat)

groups.name: Propel & Energize · 供能驱动与推进 (Power, Fuel, Propel)
groups.tip: 为机构或机器供给运行动力

items.def_zh: 驱动，向……提供动力；快速前行
items.def_en: 1. To supply a machine or vehicle with energy or mechanical power to make it work. 2. To move with great power and speed.
items.ex_en: Dual electric batteries power the heavy cargo drone across the mountain range.
items.ex_zh: 双组蓄电池为重型货运无人机飞越山脉提供充足动力。

items.def_en: To provide the physical or mechanical energy that causes a machine, shaft, or mechanism to run
items.ex_en: A massive steam turbine drives the main electrical generator inside the facility.
items.ex_zh: 一台巨大的蒸汽涡轮机驱动着厂房内部的主发电机运转。

items.def_en: To supply a vehicle, engine, or system with fuel or energy to keep it operating
items.ex_en: Refined aviation kerosene fuels the transatlantic jet engine throughout its long journey.
items.ex_zh: 精炼航空煤油在跨大西洋客机的整个长途航程中为发动机提供燃料。

items.def_en: To push, drive, or force an object or vehicle forward using physical or mechanical power
items.ex_en: Powerful underwater thrusters propel the unmanned submersible through deep oceanic trenches smoothly.
items.ex_zh: 大功率水下推进器推动着无人潜水器平稳穿过深邃的大洋海沟。

items.def_en: To adapt a system, line, or device to use electricity as its source of power
items.ex_en: The national railway announced plans to electrify its busiest commuter line by next autumn.
items.ex_zh: 国家铁路公司宣布计划在明年秋季前将其最繁忙的通勤线路实现电气化。

groups.summary_en: This frame refers to supplying physical, mechanical, or electrical energy to drive a vehicle, system, or mechanism forward. It ranges from continuous supply of energy ('fuel', 'electrify') to delivering mechanical driving force ('propel', 'drive').
groups.summary_zh: 指为机械、交通工具或系统提供能量与动力，使其运转或强力推进。
groups.desc_en: Imparting kinetic energy or chemical power to drive an object or vehicle forward through space, differing from passive guidance or manual steering.
groups.desc_zh: 施加动能或化学燃料驱使载具、物体向前受力运行，区别于被动的转向或引导。
groups.nuance_en: propel: impart strong forward thrust through physical force (rocket / ball / craft) · power: supply the prime mechanical or electric motive energy (engine / grid / vehicle) · fuel: furnish combustible energy to sustain combustion or momentum (furnace / engine / growth) · drive: transmit mechanical movement or push forward resolutely (piston / wheels / turbine) · electrify: adapt to or energize with electric power (railway / fence / network)
groups.nuance_zh: propel: 施加反冲/推力使向前飞驰 (rocket / ball / craft) · power: 作为主发电机或动力源供能 (engine / grid / vehicle) · fuel: 加注燃料维持运转或助长 (furnace / engine / growth) · drive: 机械传动迫使运转 (piston / wheels / turbine) · electrify: 电气化改造或通电 (railway / fence / network)

groups.name: Propel Body into Air · 跃起与腾空跃度 (Jump, Leap)
groups.tip: 从小跳步到大跨越

items.def_en: to move by making small, quick jumps on one foot or both feet together
items.ex_en: Having twisted his ankle, the boy had to hop all the way home.
items.ex_zh: 扭伤脚踝后，那个男孩只好一路单脚跳回家。

items.def_zh: 跳跃，跳起；跃过；猛涨，暴增；猛跳，受惊
items.def_en: 1. To push yourself off the ground into the air using your legs, or leap over something. 2. To increase suddenly and sharply. 3. To move suddenly from shock or excitement.
items.ex_en: The excited dog managed to jump over the high fence into the garden.
items.ex_zh: 那只兴奋的狗设法跳过了高高的栅栏进入花园。

items.def_en: to move suddenly and swiftly upward or forward in a single elastic movement
items.ex_en: The startled cat sprang from the sofa the moment the doorbell suddenly rang.
items.ex_zh: 门铃骤然响起的那一刻，受惊的猫从沙发上猛然跃起。

items.def_zh: 跳跃，腾跃，跃过；暴涨，猛增
items.def_en: 1. To jump high or a long distance into the air, or move suddenly and eagerly. 2. To increase suddenly by a large amount.
items.ex_en: The athlete leaped over the wide creek with remarkable grace and landed safely.
items.ex_zh: 这名运动员姿态优美地跃过了宽阔的小溪，并安全落地。

items.def_en: to run with long, energetic, leaping strides
items.ex_en: The energetic deer bounded across the open meadow and vanished into the woods.
items.ex_zh: 那只精力充沛的鹿大步飞跃过开阔的草地，消失在树林中。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses using leg muscles to spring off the ground into the air. 'Jump' denotes the basic upward or forward propulsion from a stationary or moving stance, while 'leap' designates a much wider, higher, or more athletic bounding flight across distance.
groups.summary_zh: 指运用双腿弹力使身体离地腾空，体现从普通跳起到大步腾空的幅度。
groups.desc_en: Projecting the physical body upward or forward into the air using muscular leg power, differentiated by trajectory, distance, and elastic momentum.
groups.desc_zh: 依靠腿部肌群力量将身体腾空弹射至空中，依据弹跳轨迹、位移距离与动能弹性而微差分化。
groups.nuance_en: jump: propel body off ground vertically or broadly (hurdle / fence / feet) · leap: spring forcefully across a wide gap or height (creek / chasm / air) · spring: bounce off suddenly with elastic recoil (trap / feet / bed) · hop: bounce lightly on one foot or in small increments (leg / step / kerb) · bound: run with continuous, high-leaping strides (stairs / meadow / wall)
groups.nuance_zh: jump: 屈膝起跳腾空 (hurdle / fence / feet) · leap: 大幅度纵身飞跃鸿沟 (creek / chasm / air) · spring: 借弹性猛然弹起跃出 (trap / feet / bed) · hop: 单脚轻巧微跃或短距离蹦 (leg / step / kerb) · bound: 连续迈大步大跨度飞奔 (stairs / meadow / wall)

groups.name: Propel Watercraft Manually · 撑篙与划桨 (Pole, Punt, Paddle)
groups.tip: 施加推力使物体向前运动

items.def_en: To move a canoe, kayak, or small boat through water using a handheld paddle
items.ex_en: They decided to paddle their rented canoe downstream toward the tranquil lake basin.
items.ex_zh: 他们决定划着租来的独木舟顺流而下，驶向宁静的湖盆。

items.def_en: To propel a flat-bottomed boat across shallow water by pushing against the riverbed with a long pole
items.ex_en: Students often punt flat-bottomed boats along the shallow river on warm summer afternoons.
items.ex_zh: 在温暖的夏日下午，学生们经常沿着浅河撑平底船。

items.def_en: To propel a boat with a pair of sculls or by sweeping a single stern oar side to side
items.ex_en: He went to scull his lightweight boat along the tranquil river every dawn.
items.ex_zh: 每天拂晓，他都会去宁静的河上划他的轻型双桨小艇。

items.def_en: To propel a boat across water using oars anchored to rowlocks
items.ex_en: The fishermen had to row their wooden boat back against the strong current.
items.ex_zh: 渔民们不得不顶着强劲的水流把木船划回去。

items.def_en: To propel or steer a boat through water using a pole.
items.ex_en: The guide used a long bamboo stick to pole the raft across the marshes.
items.ex_zh: 向导用一根长竹竿撑着竹筏穿过了沼泽地。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers manual techniques used to guide and push boats across shallow water using handheld implements like poles, paddles, or oars.
groups.summary_zh: 利用竹篙、船桨等工具手动撑行或划动小船。
groups.desc_en: Propelling small watercraft across water using manual implements like oars, poles, or blades, contrasting with motorized or wind-driven navigation.
groups.desc_zh: 利用桨叶、长篙等纯人力工具驾驭小型水上载具行进，区别于风帆或机动动力航行。
groups.nuance_en: row: propel boat using oars pivoted in rowlocks facing backward (skiff / boat / lake) · paddle: propel craft using handheld double or single-blade paddle facing forward (canoe / kayak / stream) · punt: propel flat-bottomed boat by thrusting pole against riverbed (punt / river / shallows) · pole: push vessel along shallow water using a rigid pole (barge / raft / river) · scull: propel boat using single stern oar or pair of sculls (dinghy / shell / river)
groups.nuance_zh: row: 倚靠桨扣面朝船尾背向划双桨 (skiff / boat / lake) · paddle: 手持无支点短桨面朝前划 (canoe / kayak / stream) · punt: 在平底船上用长篙顶河床推行 (punt / river / shallows) · pole: 撑长篙使浅水驳船前行 (barge / raft / river) · scull: 摇单艄橹或单人双桨 (dinghy / shell / river)

groups.name: Propel in Water & Submerge · 游动与潜水 (Fin, Swim, Dive)
groups.tip: 水中的行进方式

items.def_zh: 游泳、游动（原形词元补充）
items.def_en: [I/T] to propel oneself through water by rhythmic movements of the limbs, fins, or tail
items.ex_en: The children love to swim across the cool mountain pool during hot summer days.
items.ex_zh: 炎炎夏日里，孩子们喜欢在这座凉爽的高山泳池中游来游去。

items.def_en: (+ into) to plunge headfirst into water or swim underwater using breathing equipment
items.ex_en: She took a deep breath before preparing to dive into the icy river.
items.ex_zh: 在准备扎入冰冷的河水中之前，她深吸了一口气。

items.def_zh: （潜水时）用脚蹼划水；（鱼等）扇动鳍；割取（鲨鱼等）的鳍
items.def_en: 1. To swim underwater using fins or flippers; (of a fish) to move its fins. 2. To slice the fins off a fish or shark.
items.ex_en: Silver shadows finned silently through the crystalline waters of the subterranean cavern.
items.ex_zh: 银色的暗影在地下洞穴清澈见底的水流中悄然扇鳍穿行。

items.def_en: to propel oneself slowly in shallow water by moving hands and feet up and down
items.ex_en: The little boy learned to paddle slowly in the shallow end of the pool.
items.ex_zh: 那个小男孩学会了在泳池的浅水区慢慢划水游动。

items.def_en: to swim near the surface of the water using a breathing tube and face mask
items.ex_en: Tourists love to snorkel around the colorful coral reefs during their tropical holiday.
items.ex_zh: 游客们在热带度假期间喜欢戴着通气管在五彩斑斓的珊瑚礁周围浮潜。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scenario cover self-propulsion through water by animals or humans using limbs, fins, or gear, as well as plunging beneath the surface. Nuances range from aquatic limb movements to intentional submerging.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖人或生物通过肢体、鳍蹼在水中划水前进，以及潜入水下的动作场景。
groups.desc_en: Navigating the human body through water or plunging below the surface for recreation or travel, distinct from floating passively or riding a vessel.
groups.desc_zh: 人体在水体中划水移动或深扎水下潜行，与被动漂浮或乘船航行不同。
groups.nuance_en: swim: propel self through water using coordinated limbs (laps / river / sea) · dive: plunge headfirst or immerse deeply beneath surface (pool / wreckage / reef) · snorkel: swim underwater using breathing tube and mask (lagoon / reef / bay) · fin: propel through water specifically using dive fins (depths / current / wreck) · paddle: move hands and feet playfully or shallowly in water (shallows / pool / water)
groups.nuance_zh: swim: 协调肢体游动 (laps / river / sea) · dive: 头朝下扎入水中或深潜下水 (pool / wreckage / reef) · snorkel: 配呼吸管面镜浮潜 (lagoon / reef / bay) · fin: 穿脚蹼踩水潜行 (depths / current / wreck) · paddle: 扑腾手脚戏水游划 (shallows / pool / water)

groups.name: Proportion & Harmonious Balance · 均衡比例与结构调配 (Proportion, Balance, Scale)
groups.tip: 调整比例使其达均衡协调

items.def_en: To size or adjust an object, diagram, or system in fixed proportion to a standard or model.
items.ex_en: The architect had to scale the blueprint down to fit standard printing paper.
items.ex_zh: 建筑师不得不缩小蓝图比例，以适应标准的打印纸张。

items.def_en: To arrange or adjust contrasting elements, amounts, or dimensions so that they are in equilibrium or harmony.
items.ex_en: The chef tries to balance spicy seasonings with sweet components in each dish.
items.ex_zh: 厨师试图在每道菜中使辛辣的调料与甘甜的成分相平衡。
items.ex2_en: The opposing magnetic forces balance perfectly in this delicate laboratory experiment.
items.ex2_zh: 在这个精密的实验室实验中，相反的磁力达到了完美的平衡。

items.def_zh: 使成比例，使相称，使协调
items.def_en: To adjust the size, amount, or parts of something so that they are in the correct and pleasing relation to each other.
items.ex_en: The designer sought to proportion the columns properly relative to the broad facade.
items.ex_zh: 设计师力求使圆柱与宽阔的建筑正面比例相称。

items.def_en: To bring conflicting forces, loads, or chemical components into an exact state of mutual balance.
items.ex_en: The chemist waited patiently for the opposing pressures to equilibrate within the vessel.
items.ex_zh: 化学家耐心地等待容器内相互拮抗的压力达到精准的平衡状态。
items.ex2_en: Technicians must equilibrate the internal pressure gauges before initiating the chemical synthesis.
items.ex2_zh: 技术人员在启动化学合成之前必须使内部压力表达到平衡。

items.def_en: To adjust different design elements, qualities, or components so that they complement one another pleasingly.
items.ex_en: The interior decorator chose neutral curtains to harmonize the varied textures of the room.
items.ex_zh: 室内装饰师挑选了中性色调的窗帘，以协调房间内多样的质感。
items.ex2_en: The varied instruments harmonize beautifully during the orchestra's final musical movement.
items.ex2_zh: 在管弦乐队的最后一个乐章中，各种乐器配合得非常和谐。

groups.summary_en: This frame refers to modifying the relative sizes, volumes, weights, or dimensions of constituent parts so they achieve harmony, symmetry, or functional fitness within a unified whole.
groups.summary_zh: 指调节各要素在体量、尺度或份额上的相互比例以达到美观或结构平衡。
groups.desc_en: Adjusting internal components, dimensions, or forces into symmetrical, aesthetically pleasing, or functional equilibrium, contrasting with arbitrary resizing.
groups.desc_zh: 调节内部组分、尺寸或作用力以达到对称、美学或功能上的比例均衡，区别于随意的缩放。
groups.nuance_en: proportion: adjust component dimensions relative to the whole (features / columns / dosage) · balance: distribute weight, opposing forces, or ledger entries equally (books / budget / load) · harmonize: align disparate elements into an agreeable concord (colors / interests / layout) · scale: resize proportionally according to a baseline ratio (drawing / recipe / operation) · equilibrate: bring contending chemical, physical, or systemic forces into dynamic balance (pressure / solution / system)
groups.nuance_zh: proportion: 依整体比例调配各部大小 (features / columns / dosage) · balance: 配平重量、账目或拮抗力 (books / budget / load) · harmonize: 调和异质要素形成悦目协调 (colors / interests / layout) · scale: 按基准比例同比缩放 (drawing / recipe / operation) · equilibrate: 使多重相抗力量达到动态平衡 (pressure / solution / system)

groups.name: Propose & Propound · 提议与阐述 (Set forth, Advance, Submit)
groups.tip: 郑重提出理论、方案供人探讨

items.def_en: To formally present a proposal, document, or argument for others to judge
items.ex_en: The committee asked the researchers to submit their final proposal before next Monday.
items.ex_zh: 委员会要求研究人员在下周一之前呈交他们的最终提案。

items.def_en: To state or explain facts, arguments, or plans clearly and systematically
items.ex_en: The policy document clearly sets forth the guidelines for managing international research partnerships.
items.ex_zh: 该政策文件明确阐明了管理国际研究合作关系的指导原则。

items.def_en: To formally offer a bill, amendment, or motion for debate in a meeting
items.ex_en: The opposition party plans to table a formal motion during tomorrow's parliamentary session.
items.ex_zh: 反对党计划在明天的议会会议上正式提交一项动议供讨论。

items.def_en: To introduce a theory, plan, or hypothesis for consideration
items.ex_en: The economist advanced a novel theory to explain the persistent decline in inflation.
items.ex_zh: 这位经济学家提出了一种新理论来解释通胀的持续下降。
items.ex2_en: The vanguard troops advanced steadily through the dense forest toward the enemy outpost.
items.ex2_zh: 先锋部队穿过茂密的森林，稳步向前方的敌军哨所推进。

items.def_zh: 提出，提议（理论、观点等供讨论）
items.def_en: To put forward an idea, theory, or proposal for others to consider and examine.
items.ex_en: The philosopher propounded a radical thesis regarding the nature of human consciousness.
items.ex_zh: 这位哲学家提出了一个关于人类意识本质的激进理论供人探讨。

groups.summary_en: Involves articulating systematic ideas, theories, hypotheses, or formal schemes for rigorous evaluation and deliberation.
groups.summary_zh: 系统性阐述或提交方案、学说以供审议评判。
groups.desc_en: Formally putting forward arguments, theories, or legislative motions for deliberation and adoption, differing from casually mentioning or chatting.
groups.desc_zh: 将论点、学说或议案正式呈递以供研讨、审议与表决采纳，区别于随口闲聊提及。
groups.nuance_en: propound: formulate and state a doctrine or hypothesis for debate (theory / question / hypothesis) · advance: promote an idea or candidacy forward for serious consideration (argument / theory / candidate) · set forth: lay out in clear, detailed, and orderly fashion (terms / views / principles) · submit: deliver formally to an authority for consideration or approval (proposal / report / tender) · table: formally present a motion in UK, or postpone it in US usage (motion / amendment / bill)
groups.nuance_zh: propound: 提出新学说假说以供辨析 (theory / question / hypothesis) · advance: 推动某论点或候选人供深究 (argument / theory / candidate) · set forth: 详细阐述条列方案要旨 (terms / views / principles) · submit: 向上呈递报告或标书候审 (proposal / report / tender) · table: 英式正式搁案审议/美式搁置动议 (motion / amendment / bill)

groups.name: Proscribe & Outlaw · 严禁与法律取缔 (Proscribe, Outlaw, Ban)
groups.tip: 以法令正式宣布取缔禁止

items.def_en: to legally or officially forbid the use, publication, or occurrence of something
items.ex_en: The city council voted to ban single-use plastics throughout all municipal facilities.
items.ex_zh: 市议会投票决定在所有市政设施中明令禁止使用一次性塑料。

items.def_en: to make something illegal by passing a statute, or to strip legal protections from a group
items.ex_en: Several states moved to outlaw predatory lending practices to protect vulnerable borrowers.
items.ex_zh: 一些州采取行动通过立法取缔掠夺性放贷行为，以保护弱势借款人。

items.def_en: to impose an official government ban on trade or commercial relations with another nation
items.ex_en: The allied nations resolved to embargo oil shipments destined for the aggressive regime.
items.ex_zh: 盟国决定对运往该侵略政权的石油货物实施正式禁运。

items.def_zh: 正式禁止，取缔；剥夺……的法律保护
items.def_en: (formal) to officially forbid or prohibit something by law; to denounce or ban as dangerous or illegal
items.ex_en: The decree officially proscribed the distribution of extremist pamphlets within the realm.
items.ex_zh: 该法令正式取缔并在全境范围内禁止分发极端主义小册子。

items.def_en: to authoritatively prohibit or restrain an action by judicial decree or ecclesiastical censure
items.ex_en: The high tribunal issued an injunction to interdict unauthorized timber harvesting nearby.
items.ex_zh: 高级法庭颁布了一项禁令，依法禁止在附近区域擅自砍伐木材。

groups.summary_en: This high-intensity legal frame denotes authoritative decrees rendering specific actions, organizations, or ideologies strictly illegal, illegitimate, or subject to severe state penalties. The tone is formal, imperative, and punitive.
groups.summary_zh: 指官方或司法机构发布禁令，依法彻底取缔或定罪某行为与组织。
groups.desc_en: Imposing sovereign, authoritative, or legal prohibitions against an act, commodity, or group under pain of penalty, contrasting with moral disapproval.
groups.desc_zh: 凭借主权、法令或权威严厉禁绝某行为、物资或团体并附带惩处，区别于道德维度的不赞成。
groups.nuance_en: ban: officially prohibit by legal or institutional fiat (smoking / weapons / exports) · outlaw: make illegal or strip of legal standing and protection (gang / organization / practices) · proscribe: prohibit by formal decree as dangerous or harmful (organization / literature / drugs) · interdict: legally forbid an act or militarily intercept flow of goods (trade / contraband / supplies) · embargo: impose state stoppage on commerce or shipping with a nation (trade / arms / oil)
groups.nuance_zh: ban: 明文下达禁令严禁通行使用 (smoking / weapons / exports) · outlaw: 宣布为非法并剥夺合法权益 (gang / organization / practices) · proscribe: 官府出台禁令斥为有害/取缔 (organization / literature / drugs) · interdict: 司法判决禁止或军警强行截断运输 (trade / contraband / supplies) · embargo: 主权国家施行封港断航式贸易禁运 (trade / arms / oil)

groups.name: Prosecute & Try · 刑事起诉与法庭审判 (Prosecute, Try, Indict)
groups.tip: 司法起诉并在法庭审理

items.def_en: To examine evidence in a court of law and decide whether someone is guilty of a crime
items.ex_en: The regional court will try the corporate fraud suspect starting early next month.
items.ex_zh: 地区法院将于下月初开始审理这起企业欺诈案的嫌疑人。

items.def_zh: 起诉，检举；继续从事，进行
items.def_en: 1. To officially charge someone in a court of law and direct proceedings against them. 2. (formal) To continue doing, pursuing, or conducting something.
items.ex_en: The district attorney chose to prosecute the corrupt official for bribery and embezzlement.
items.ex_zh: 地区检察官决定因受贿和贪污罪名对这名腐败官员提起公诉。

items.def_zh: 正式起诉，控告（通常由大陪审团作出）
items.def_en: (+ for/on) To officially accuse someone in court of having committed a serious crime
items.ex_en: The federal grand jury moved to indict the executive on three felony counts.
items.ex_zh: 联邦大陪审团决定正式起诉这名高管，控其犯有三项重罪。

items.def_zh: 弹劾；控告公职人员渎职
items.def_en: To formally charge a public official with serious misconduct committed while in office
items.ex_en: Lawmakers prepared to impeach the governor for systematic abuse of his executive authority.
items.ex_zh: 立法者准备因该州长蓄意滥用行政权力而对其提出弹劾。

items.def_zh: 传讯，提堂（宣读起诉书并要求答辩）
items.def_en: (+ on/for) To bring a prisoner to a court of law to hear the charges and state whether they are guilty or not
items.ex_en: The magistrate will arraign the suspect on charges of armed robbery tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 地方法官将于明早提堂传讯该嫌疑人，宣读其武装抢劫的罪名。

groups.summary_en: Refers to state authorities formally charging a suspect with a crime, conducting court proceedings, and adjudicating guilt. While 'indict' focuses on issuing a formal grand jury charge, 'try' centers on hearing and judging the case in court.
groups.summary_zh: 指司法机关对刑事犯罪提起公诉、进行审理和裁决的法定程序。
groups.desc_en: Refers to formal legal proceedings brought by the state against an accused party, distinct from informal accusation or private dispute resolution.
groups.desc_zh: 指国家司法机关对刑事被告人提起并推进的正式诉讼与审理程序，区别于非正式的指责或民事私力纠纷。
groups.nuance_en: prosecute: conduct legal proceedings against an accused (case / defendant) · try: examine judicial evidence to determine guilt in court (suspect / case) · indict: formally charge with a serious crime by grand jury (official / suspect) · arraign: call a defendant to court to enter a plea (suspect / prisoner) · impeach: charge a public official with misconduct before a tribunal (president / judge)
groups.nuance_zh: prosecute: 提起公诉或推进诉讼程序 (case / defendant) · try: 开庭审理以裁决罪责 (suspect / case) · indict: 大陪审团正式起诉或控告重罪 (official / suspect) · arraign: 提审被告并要求其正式答辩 (suspect / prisoner) · impeach: 弹劾公职人员 (president / judge)

groups.name: Prosper & Accumulate Wealth · 繁荣与富足兴旺 (Boom, Thrive, Pan Out)
groups.tip: 生命力旺盛，蓬勃向前发展

items.def_zh: （经济、产业）景气猛增；急速繁荣
items.def_en: To experience sudden, intense economic growth, popularity, or profitability
items.ex_en: Local real estate markets began to boom following the construction of the highway.
items.ex_zh: 公路建成后，当地的房地产市场开始急速繁荣。

items.def_en: To be successful, especially in business, work, or financial standing
items.ex_en: Her independent retail boutique continues to do well despite rising commercial rental costs.
items.ex_zh: 尽管商业租金上涨，她的独立零售精品店依然生意兴隆。

items.def_zh: 出人头地；积累财富获得成功
items.def_en: To make progress and become successful in one's life, career, or finances
items.ex_en: In this competitive field, continuous learning is essential to get ahead.
items.ex_zh: 在这个竞争激烈的领域，持续学习是脱颖而出立于不败之地的关键。

items.def_en: To increase gradually in size, power, or prosperity, especially contrasting with wane
items.ex_en: The king watched his kingdom wax in strength through strategic alliances and trade.
items.ex_zh: 国王看着自己的王国通过战略联盟和贸易而日益强盛。

items.def_en: 1. To become wealthy, successful, and thriving, especially financially or economically.
items.ex_en: Small coastal towns often prosper when international shipping routes are successfully established.
items.ex_zh: 当国际航运航线成功建立时，沿海小镇往往能实现经济繁荣。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on achieving sustained economic success, material wealth, or business fortune over time. It stresses financial gain, commercial buoyancy, and advantageous advancement.
groups.summary_zh: 聚焦于经济上的兴旺发达、积累财富或在商业中持续成功。
groups.desc_en: Denotes achieving robust economic success, expansion, and flourishing vitality, contrasting with mere survival or static stability.
groups.desc_zh: 指获得强劲的经济成就、规模扩张与旺盛生机，区别于仅维持生存或停滞保底的状态。
groups.nuance_en: boom: undergo rapid, explosive expansion (economy / business / industry) · prosper: enjoy continuous sustained financial flourishing (business / community) · thrive: vigorously develop and flourish in a given environment (business / market) · get ahead: advance economically through competitive effort (career / life) · wax: undergo natural growth in power or volume (influence / power)
groups.nuance_zh: boom: 出现爆发式快速繁荣 (economy / business / industry) · prosper: 享有持续稳定的富足与兴盛 (business / community) · thrive: 在特定环境中蓬勃健壮发展 (business / market) · get ahead: 通过个人竞争拼搏出人头地 (career / life) · wax: 渐进增强或势力扩增 (influence / power)

groups.name: Protect & Defend · 保护与捍卫 (Protect, Safeguard, Shield)
groups.tip: 遮风挡雨防范侵害

items.def_zh: 保护，保卫，防护；（经济）保护（国内产业）
items.def_en: To keep someone or something safe from harm, injury, damage, or loss.
items.ex_en: Sunscreen helps protect your skin from harmful ultraviolet radiation during summer afternoons.
items.ex_zh: 在夏日的午后，防晒霜有助于保护你的皮肤免受有害紫外线的伤害。

items.def_en: to take action to protect someone or something from physical attack or legal challenge
items.ex_en: The garrison fought bravely to defend the fortress against the fierce enemy assault.
items.ex_zh: 守军英勇作战，保卫堡垒免受敌人的猛烈攻击。

items.def_en: to keep something intact, safe, or free from decay, harm, or alteration
items.ex_en: Conservators work tirelessly to preserve ancient stone monuments from environmental weathering.
items.ex_zh: 文物保护人员不知疲倦地工作，以维护古代石碑免受环境风化的侵蚀。

items.def_en: to protect someone or something by putting an obstacle or oneself between them and danger
items.ex_en: The mother instinctively raised her arm to shield her toddler from flying debris.
items.ex_zh: 这位母亲本能地抬起手臂，庇护蹒跚学步的孩子免受飞散碎片的伤害。

items.def_en: (+ against/from) To protect something valuable, such as rights, health, or interests, from harm, loss, or danger.
items.ex_en: New banking regulations were introduced to safeguard consumer deposits from reckless speculation.
items.ex_zh: 新出台的银行法规旨在保护储户存款免受鲁莽投机行为的侵害。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify keeping people, rights, or territory safe from harm, attack, erosion, or adverse conditions, spanning everyday security to institutional or physical defense.
groups.summary_zh: 指抵御外来攻击、危险或损害，保全人身、权益及体制的安全与完整。
groups.desc_en: Involves maintaining safety by creating physical, structural, or legal barriers against harm, differing from passive observation or post-hoc rescue.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过物理、体制或法律屏障抵御伤害以维持对象安全，区别于被动观望或事后施救。
groups.nuance_en: protect: keep safe from injury or damage via cover or care (children / environment) · defend: actively resist and repel an impending assault (borders / rights) · safeguard: provide structured institutional or precautionary security (interests / rights) · shield: place an intervening physical or moral screen against impact (criticism / eyes) · preserve: keep intact and safe from decay or alteration (heritage / order)
groups.nuance_zh: protect: 施加保护以使其免受损害 (children / environment) · defend: 积极反击并击退来犯攻击 (borders / rights) · safeguard: 建立制度性防范措施以维护 (interests / rights) · shield: 充当遮挡物以挡开直接冲击 (criticism / eyes) · preserve: 完整保存免遭侵蚀破坏 (heritage / order)

groups.name: Provision & Replenish · 筹措补给与配发物资 (Provision, Victual, Replenish)
groups.tip: 调配与发放生活或军需物资

items.def_en: to supply someone, a vessel, or an expedition with food, drink, or necessary equipment
items.ex_en: The quartermaster labored tirelessly to provision the polar expedition with nutritious dry rations.
items.ex_zh: 军需官不知疲倦地工作，为极地探险队提供营养丰富的干粮给养。

items.def_en: (+ on) to collect or buy a large quantity of provisions for future use
items.ex_en: Local residents hurried to stock up on canned food before the severe blizzard.
items.ex_zh: 在大暴雪来临之前，当地居民匆忙囤积罐头食品。

items.def_en: to fill something up again with supplies or stock after it has been depleted
items.ex_en: The logistics team arrived promptly to replenish medical stocks at the field clinic.
items.ex_zh: 后勤小组迅速赶到，补充野战诊所消耗的医疗物资储备。

items.def_zh: 为……提供食物（或军粮）；储备食物
items.def_en: (archaic) to supply a ship, army, or expedition with food and provisions; to obtain food supplies
items.ex_en: The harbor master helped victual the battered galleon before its perilous ocean crossing.
items.ex_zh: 港务长协助为这艘受损的大帆船储备口粮，以备其展开危险的越洋航行。

items.def_en: to supply food, services, or provisions as a regular business or official duty
items.ex_en: The catering firm was contracted to purvey fresh produce to regional military bases.
items.ex_zh: 这家餐饮公司签订了合同，定期为当地军事基地大宗供应新鲜农副产品。

groups.summary_en: This frame describes gathering, stocking, or issuing rations, stores, and logistical necessities required to sustain expeditions, ships, garrisons, or remote operations.
groups.summary_zh: 强调为长途航行、探险队或军队筹备、补发粮饷物资。
groups.desc_en: Specifies acquiring, staging, and distributing vital logistical supplies to maintain operational readiness, beyond mere single-item buying.
groups.desc_zh: 指为维持行动运转而统筹筹措、储备并配发关键后勤物资，区别于零星买卖。
groups.nuance_en: provision: equip a planned expedition or force with necessities (expedition / ship / crew) · stock up: accumulate large stores for anticipated future need (supplies / food) · replenish: restore depleted inventory to a complete level (stock / supplies / fuel) · victual: specifically supply food and rations to vessels or troops (ship / garrison) · purvey: commercially supply goods or provisions as a merchant (food / goods)
groups.nuance_zh: provision: 为远征或军队备齐给养与装备 (expedition / ship / crew) · stock up: 针对未来需求大量囤积 (supplies / food) · replenish: 补充耗尽的储量至原状 (stock / supplies / fuel) · victual: 专指为船舶或部队配发口粮与伙食 (ship / garrison) · purvey: 商业性经营供应或承揽物资 (food / goods)

groups.name: Prowl & Sneak · 潜行与逡巡 (Prowl, Sneak, Stalk)
groups.tip: 暗中鬼祟地潜伏潜行

items.def_zh: 蹑手蹑脚地走；缓慢爬行潜行
items.def_en: To move slowly, quietly, and carefully, usually staying close to the ground to escape notice
items.ex_en: The cat began to creep silently through the tall grass toward the sparrow.
items.ex_zh: 那只猫开始在茂密的草丛中悄无声息地爬行潜向麻雀。

items.def_en: To walk quietly on the balls and tips of one's toes to avoid making any audible noise
items.ex_en: She had to tiptoe past the nursery so as not to wake the infant.
items.ex_zh: 她不得不踮着脚尖走过育儿室，以免吵醒熟睡的婴儿。

items.def_zh: 鬼鬼祟祟地走；偷偷摸摸溜进
items.def_en: (+ into/out of/around) To go or move in a furtive, stealthy way so as not to be seen or heard
items.ex_en: The mischievous boy tried to sneak into the movie theater through the exit.
items.ex_zh: 那个调皮的男孩试图从安全出口偷偷摸摸地溜进电影院。

items.def_zh: 潜行，偷偷溜达；徘徊搜索
items.def_en: 1. (+ around/through) To move around quietly and secretly, like an animal hunting prey or a thief looking for an opportunity.
items.ex_en: Hungry coyotes frequently prowl around the suburban perimeter looking for food after dark.
items.ex_zh: 天黑之后，饥饿的土狼经常在郊区边缘潜行徘徊寻找食物。

items.def_en: To follow or approach quarry or a person stealthily and relentlessly, often intending harm
items.ex_en: The leopard used dense shadows to stalk its unsuspecting quarry across the savannah.
items.ex_zh: 这只花豹利用浓密的阴影在稀树草原上悄悄跟踪毫无防备的猎物。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures quiet, stealthy forward movement intended to avoid detection, characteristic of predators stalking prey, criminals casing a target, or intruders evading notice.
groups.summary_zh: 指为了捕猎、刺探或避免被发觉而悄声潜行巡查。
groups.desc_en: Covers stealthy, covert movement aimed at avoiding detection or hunting prey, contrasting with ordinary walking or open marching.
groups.desc_zh: 指为规避察觉或搜寻猎物而进行的隐秘、潜踪式移动，区别于公开行进或常规走动。
groups.nuance_en: sneak: move furtively to evade observation or detection (into room / away) · prowl: roam restlessly and stealthily in search of prey or opportunity (streets / corridor) · stalk: stealthily track and close in on quarry (prey / victim) · creep: advance slowly, quietly, and low to the ground (forward / past) · tiptoe: walk delicately on the balls of the feet to avoid noise (into bedroom / stairs)
groups.nuance_zh: sneak: 鬼祟溜走以避人耳目 (into room / away) · prowl: 潜行徘徊以寻猎物或下手机会 (streets / corridor) · stalk: 隐蔽跟踪并逼近猎物或目标 (prey / victim) · creep: 压低身姿缓慢匍匐潜行 (forward / past) · tiptoe: 踮起脚尖轻声蹑足而行 (into bedroom / stairs)

groups.name: Prune & Trim · 修剪与规整 (Trim, Lop, Cut Back)
groups.tip: 剪除枝权或多余多长部分

items.def_zh: 砍去，截掉（大树枝或赘物）
items.def_en: To chop or saw a substantial branch, limb, or bulky portion completely off
items.ex_en: The gardener had to lop off the hazardous dead limb from the oak.
items.ex_zh: 园丁不得不把橡树上那根危险的枯死大树枝砍去。

items.def_zh: 剪短植物；大幅削减开支
items.def_en: To cut plants to shorten growth, or reduce spending, size, or output
items.ex_en: The agency was forced to cut back its budget after losing significant funding.
items.ex_zh: 该机构在失去巨额资金支持后，被迫大幅削减了其财政预算。

items.def_en: To cut off the top branches of a tree to encourage a dense head of new foliage
items.ex_en: Every winter, the groundskeepers pollard the ancient willows lining the silent canal bank.
items.ex_zh: 每年冬天，场地管理员都会为寂静运河边排布的老柳树截顶修剪。

items.def_en: To cut off irregular, ragged, or overgrown edges to make something neat
items.ex_en: He asked the barber to trim his messy beard before the job interview.
items.ex_zh: 在求职面试前，他请理发师修剪了一下自己杂乱的胡须。

items.def_zh: 修剪（树枝等）；删减，削减（开支、人员等）
items.def_en: 1. to cut off dead or overgrown branches from a tree or shrub. 2. to reduce the size or extent of something by removing unnecessary parts.
items.ex_en: Gardeners must prune overgrown shrubs every spring to promote vigorous new flowering growth.
items.ex_zh: 园丁每年春天都必须修剪杂乱丛生的灌木，以促进茂盛的新枝开花。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve selectively clipping away excessive, dead, or overgrown growth on plants, gardens, or budgets to foster healthier shape, efficiency, and growth.
groups.summary_zh: 指剔除多余枯枝或冗杂部分，以促成植物健康形态或精简开支规模。
groups.desc_en: Entails selectively severing plant parts to control shape, optimize health, or enhance yield, differing from indiscriminate felling or mowing.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过有针对性地切除植物局部来控制形态、促进健康或提升产出，区别于无差别的砍伐或割草。
groups.nuance_en: prune: systematically cut back branches to promote health or shape (roses / tree / budget) · trim: neaten borders or contours by small clippings (hedge / lawn / beard) · lop off: bluntly and forcefully chop away major branches or limbs (branches / boughs) · pollard: sever upper tree branches to promote a dense crown (willows / oaks) · cut back: severely curtail growth or volume (hedges / expenditure)
groups.nuance_zh: prune: 系统修剪病弱杂枝以整形促产 (roses / tree / budget) · trim: 微幅修剪边缘以使其齐整 (hedge / lawn / beard) · lop off: 粗暴猛烈砍除粗大侧枝 (branches / boughs) · pollard: 截头重剪树干以促生密冠 (willows / oaks) · cut back: 大幅修除残枝或削减规模 (hedges / expenditure)

groups.name: Publish & Release · 发行与出版 (Reissue, Release, Put out)
groups.tip: 公之于世，印刷印发刊物

items.def_en: to distribute officially or produce publications, currency, or formal statements
items.ex_en: The treasury decided to issue commemorative coins marking the centennial of the republic.
items.ex_zh: 财政部决定发行纪念币，以纪念共和国成立一百周年。
items.ex2_en: A plume of dense black smoke began to issue from the chimney.
items.ex2_zh: 一股浓密的黑烟开始从烟囱里冒出来。

items.def_en: to make a film, record, software, or book publicly available for sale or viewing
items.ex_en: The studio plans to release the director's highly anticipated blockbuster early next summer.
items.ex_zh: 制片厂计划于明年初夏公开发行这位导演备受期待的大片。

items.def_en: to produce and circulate a publication, product, or official announcement
items.ex_en: The independent press managed to put out three influential literary journals this autumn.
items.ex_zh: 这家独立出版社今年秋天成功出版并发行了三本具有影响力的文学期刊。

items.def_en: to launch and make a new product or service widely available in phases
