items.ex_en: The telecommunications giant will roll out fifth-generation mobile coverage across major cities nationwide.
items.ex_zh: 这家电信巨头将在全国各大主要城市分批铺开并正式推出五代移动网络。

items.def_zh: 重新发行，再版；补发，再发
items.def_en: To publish, release, or issue a book, record, film, or document again.
items.ex_en: The record label decided to reissue the legendary jazz album on classic vinyl.
items.ex_zh: 这家唱片公司决定以经典黑胶唱片的形式重新发行这张传奇爵士专辑。

groups.summary_en: Centers on making media, printed literature, sound recordings, or official decrees accessible for commercial distribution or broad public consumption.
groups.summary_zh: 指将书籍、唱片、影视作品或声明公开发行、推出或面市。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the formal public dissemination and market release of media, data, or products, differing from private printing or internal sharing.
groups.desc_zh: 指将出版物、数据或产品正式对外公开发行与投放市场，区别于内部印制或私下流传。
groups.nuance_en: issue: formally put forth an official decree, statement, or stamp (statement / passport / shares) · release: make content or products newly available to the general public (movie / album / report) · put out: produce and distribute regular editions or announcements (statement / publication) · roll out: deploy and introduce a product to the market in structured phases (product / campaign / update) · reissue: publish an updated, amended, or newly packaged existing work (album / novel / edition)
groups.nuance_zh: issue: 官方正式颁布或签发 (statement / passport / shares) · release: 解禁向公众首发或投放 (movie / album / report) · put out: 制作并对外发布 (statement / publication) · roll out: 分阶段全面铺开上市 (product / campaign / update) · reissue: 再版或重新压盘发行 (album / novel / edition)

groups.name: Pulsate & Throb Rhythmically · 律动与节律性搏动 (Pulsate, Throb, Pulse)
groups.tip: 规律性震颤起伏

items.def_en: Make regular rhythmic sounds or movements, such as a heart pumping or wings flapping
items.ex_en: Her heart began to beat furiously as footsteps approached the door.
items.ex_zh: 脚步声临近门口时，她的心开始狂跳起来。

items.def_en: Shake or vibrate with a slight, rapid, tremulous motion
items.ex_en: Delicate autumn leaves quiver softly in the chill morning breeze.
items.ex_zh: 娇弱的秋叶在清晨寒冷的微风中轻轻颤动。

items.def_en: Move, vibrate, or shine with steady, measurable regular pulses
items.ex_en: Tiny green indicators pulse steadily along the dark server rack.
items.ex_zh: 微小的绿色指示灯在昏暗的服务器机架上规律地闪烁着。

items.def_en: Beat or sound with a strong, continuous, regular rhythm, or cause continuous pulsating pain
items.ex_en: A dull ache began to throb behind her temple all evening.
items.ex_zh: 整个傍晚，她的太阳穴后方都隐隐跳动着阵痛。

items.def_zh: 有节奏地跳动，搏动；充满活力，震颤
items.def_en: To expand and contract with strong regular movements; to beat with a steady rhythm or vibrate with energy.
items.ex_en: The nightclub dance floor seemed to pulsate with raw electronic beats.
items.ex_zh: 夜总会的舞池似乎随着强劲的电子节拍而震颤律动。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers rhythmic expansion, contraction, vibration, or illumination occurring at periodic intervals. It applies equally to physical organs, rhythmic lights, acoustic basslines, or throbbing pain.
groups.summary_zh: 身体器官、光线、声音或钝痛呈现出规律而强劲的周期性搏动震颤。
groups.desc_en: Describes recurring mechanical, biological, or rhythmic surges of movement and sensation, distinct from chaotic vibration or continuous pressure.
groups.desc_zh: 指呈现规律性周期起伏的机械、生理搏动或感官律动，区别于无序杂乱的震动或持续静态压力。
groups.nuance_en: pulse: expand and contract in distinct, regular rhythmic surges (artery / light / laser) · pulsate: beat strongly and visibly with recurring rhythmic energy (music / vein / heart) · throb: beat with continuous, heavy, and resonant rhythmic pulsation (headache / wound / engine) · beat: rhythmically strike or cycle in mechanical or cardiac cadence (heart / wings / drum) · quiver: vibrate with minute, rapid, trembling tremors (lips / voice / leaves)
groups.nuance_zh: pulse: 呈现规整清晰的脉冲式舒缩 (artery / light / laser) · pulsate: 带着强劲能量显着律动 (music / vein / heart) · throb: 沉重、深沉且发作性地抽痛跳动 (headache / wound / engine) · beat: 周期性规则搏击或撞击 (heart / wings / drum) · quiver: 细碎、微弱地快速颤动 (lips / voice / leaves)

groups.name: Pulsate Rhythmically · 搏动与抽痛跳动 (Pulse, Throb)
groups.tip: 心脏脉搏律动或神经抽痛

items.def_zh: 节律性搏动；有规律地膨胀收缩
items.def_en: to expand and contract with strong, regular rhythmic movements
items.ex_en: The translucent jellyfish pulsates gracefully as it glides through water.
items.ex_zh: 半透明的水母在水中滑行时优雅地节律性收缩舒张。

items.def_zh: 搏动，跳动；悸动，规律振动
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To beat, throb, or flow with a strong, regular rhythm.
items.ex_en: The entire stadium seemed to pulse with raw excitement and cheering.
items.ex_zh: 整座体育场似乎都因狂热的兴奋与欢呼而悸动。

items.def_zh: 阵痛，抽搐跳痛；悸动，有节奏地跳动
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To beat, pulse, or vibrate with a strong, regular, often painful rhythm.
items.ex_en: His bandaged ankle continued to throb with severe, unrelenting pain.
items.ex_zh: 他缠着绷带的脚踝继续传来一阵阵剧烈而持续的抽痛。

items.def_zh: （心脏等）咚咚狂跳；重重击打跳动
items.def_en: to beat heavily and thuddingly against the ribs with great force
items.ex_en: His heart began to pound violently against his ribs in terror.
items.ex_zh: 在恐惧中，他的心脏开始在胸膛里剧烈地咚咚狂跳。

items.def_en: to beat rapidly, strongly, or irregularly, typically from excitement, fear, or illness
items.ex_en: The patient complained that her heart would palpitate without exertion.
items.ex_zh: 病人主诉自己的心脏在没有剧烈运动时也会急速悸动乱跳。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate rapid or heavy, repeating mechanical or physiological contractions, especially of hearts, blood vessels, pain, or machinery. 'Pulse' signifies a steady, rhythmic surge or vibration, whereas 'throb' conveys a strong, pulsating ache or heavy pounding sensation.
groups.summary_zh: 指心脏、血管或身体部位呈周期性地起伏、强力跳动或隐痛抽动。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on intense, visceral internal throbbing or pounding—often linked to physical distress, heightened exertion, or agony—contrasting with gentle rhythms.
groups.desc_zh: 偏重指体内由于剧痛、重压或极度亢奋引发的强烈、沉重抽痛或剧烈跳动，区别于舒缓温和的律动。
groups.nuance_en: throb: ache with heavy, painful, rhythmic pulsations (temples / thumb / wound) · pound: beat with violent, heavy, concussive force (heart / head / chest) · palpitate: flutter abnormally rapidly and irregularly from excitement or anxiety (heart) · pulsate: vibrate with steady, palpable physical rhythm (rhythm / vessel) · pulse: surge rhythmically beneath surface tissue (blood / vein)
groups.nuance_zh: throb: 伤处或头部沉重且规律性地抽痛跳动 (temples / thumb / wound) · pound: 剧烈冲撞式重击跳动 (heart / head / chest) · palpitate: 因恐慌亢奋而急促紊乱悸动 (heart) · pulsate: 稳定且可感地规律跳动 (rhythm / vessel) · pulse: 节律性在皮下搏动翻涌 (blood / vein)

groups.name: Pump & Siphon Fluids · 机械泵送与虹吸抽取 (Siphon, Draw, Evacuate)
groups.tip: 用机械泵或虹吸法抽吸流体

items.def_zh: 抽取或排出（容器中的液体）
items.def_en: To remove or tap a specified quantity of liquid from a larger reservoir or tank
items.ex_en: The technician had to draw off excess fluid from the main reservoir.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员不得不从主储液罐中抽出多余的液体。

items.def_zh: 排放（系统中的多余空气或液体）
items.def_en: To let out excess liquid, air, or gas from a closed pipe, radiator, or hydraulic system
items.ex_en: Remember to bleed the radiators to remove trapped air before winter.
items.ex_zh: 入冬前切记给暖气片放气，以排出积存的空气。

items.def_en: 1. To force liquid, gas, or air into or out of something using a pump; to move quickly up and down or in and out like a piston.
items.ex_en: He had to pump cold water from the well every single morning.
items.ex_zh: 他每天早晨都得从水井里泵出冰凉的井水。

items.def_zh: 抽空或排空（容器中的气体或液体）
items.def_en: To remove air, gas, or liquid completely from a vessel or space so as to create a vacuum
items.ex_en: Scientists must evacuate the sealed chamber completely to create a vacuum.
items.ex_zh: 科学家必须将密封舱内的气体完全抽空以形成真空。

items.def_zh: 用虹吸管吸出或输送（液体）
items.def_en: To convey or draw off liquid from a container over an intermediate elevation through a siphon tube
items.ex_en: He managed to siphon gasoline directly into a plastic container.
items.ex_zh: 他设法用虹吸管把汽油直接抽进了一个塑料容器里。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe using mechanical differential pressure, vacuum mechanisms, or tubes to draw, transfer, or expel liquids and gases between containers.
groups.summary_zh: 利用泵力、负压或管路机械式抽取、输送或排空流体。
groups.desc_en: Involves using mechanical displacement, pressure gradients, or tube-gravity effects to transfer fluids out of a space, contrasting with open pouring.
groups.desc_zh: 指借助机械位移、压差或虹吸重力将流体从密闭或特定空间抽出，区别于普通的倾倒或泼洒。
groups.nuance_en: pump: force liquids through pipes using mechanical pressurization (water / fuel / heart) · siphon: convey liquid upward and over an obstacle using tube suction and gravity (gasoline / liquid / funds) · evacuate: draw out gases or fluids to create a vacuum or empty a vessel (chamber / bowels / air) · bleed: draw off trapped fluid or air to purge a hydraulic line (brakes / radiator / valve) · draw off: tap and drain liquid from a bulk container (wine / liquid / sediment)
groups.nuance_zh: pump: 施加机械压力泵送流体 (water / fuel / heart) · siphon: 利用虹吸管压差引出流体 (gasoline / liquid / funds) · evacuate: 抽空腔体内气体或液体以形成真空 (chamber / bowels / air) · bleed: 排净液压管道中积存的空气或残液 (brakes / radiator / valve) · draw off: 从主容器中放出或分流液体 (wine / liquid / sediment)

groups.name: Punish & Discipline · 惩戒与管教 (Discipline, Chastise, Penalize)
groups.tip: 通过立规与惩罚纠错

items.def_en: 1. To punish someone for doing something wrong. 2. To train someone to obey rules and control their behavior.
items.ex_en: The commanding officer will discipline any soldier who breaks basic regulations.
items.ex_zh: 指挥官将惩戒任何违反基本规章的士兵。

items.def_en: To inflict a penalty or unpleasant consequence on someone for wrongdoing or an offense
items.ex_en: The judge chose to punish the offender with mandatory community service.
items.ex_zh: 法官决定对罪犯处以强制性社区服务的惩罚。

items.def_en: To impose a formal sanction, disadvantage, or forfeit on someone for breaking a rule
items.ex_en: The referee will penalize players who commit deliberate fouls on court.
items.ex_zh: 裁判将对场上故意犯规的球员予以惩罚。

items.def_en: To rebuke, reprimand, or severely discipline someone for undesirable behavior
items.ex_en: The committee chose to chastise the delegate for his unethical conduct.
items.ex_zh: 委员会决定对该代表的不道德行为予以严厉斥责。

items.def_en: (+ on) To take severe and decisive disciplinary measures to enforce laws or eradicate bad behavior
items.ex_en: Local authorities plan to crack down on reckless driving downtown.
items.ex_zh: 地方当局计划严厉打击市中心的危险驾驶行为。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers imposing formal or parental sanctions, corrections, and behavioral conditioning to enforce compliance and deter transgressions.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过施加制裁、惩罚或严厉纠正来推行行为规范、惩戒过错或促使服从。
groups.desc_en: Signifies imposing formal pain, penalty, or restraint upon a wrongdoer to enforce obedience and justice, differing from personal revenge.
groups.desc_zh: 指为维护规训与公义，对违规者施加制度化的惩戒、惩处或限制，区别于私怨报复。
groups.nuance_en: punish: impose a legal, moral, or physical penalty for wrongdoing (criminal / offender) · discipline: correct behavior and instill order through training or sanction (soldiers / children / employee) · penalize: handicap or subject to disadvantage under established rules (team / company / offender) · chastise: reprimand severely or inflict corporal correction to reform (child / subordinate) · crack down: rigorously enforce laws to suppress illicit activity (gangs / corruption / dissent)
groups.nuance_zh: punish: 对过错依法或依理施加惩罚 (criminal / offender) · discipline: 为树立规矩而实行纪律惩戒 (soldiers / children / employee) · penalize: 按既定规则判处处罚或剥夺权益 (team / company / offender) · chastise: 严厉谴责或体罚训诫以责令改过 (child / subordinate) · crack down: 采取铁腕手段从严打击镇压 (gangs / corruption / dissent)

groups.name: Purge & Eradicate · 摆脱与清除 (Purge, Eliminate, Expel, Disencumber)
groups.tip: 免除负担除掉杂质

items.def_en: To make someone or something free of an unwanted person, thing, or condition.
items.ex_en: We hired specialists to rid the old wooden cabin of termites.
items.ex_zh: 我们请了专业人员来彻底清除这间老木屋里的白蚁。

items.def_en: To free someone or something from an encumbrance, heavy burden, or obstacle
items.ex_en: She wished to disencumber her mind from all lingering professional anxieties.
items.ex_zh: 她希望能让自己的心灵彻底摆脱挥之不去的职业焦虑。

items.def_en: To deliberately throw aside or free oneself from unwanted ties, habits, or clothing
items.ex_en: The crew cast off at dawn and sailed into the open ocean.
items.ex_zh: 船员们在黎明时分解缆启航，驶向浩瀚的大洋。

items.def_en: To thoroughly remove unwanted elements, impurities, or political opponents from a group or place
items.ex_en: The party leaders moved swiftly to purge corrupt officials from office.
items.ex_zh: 该党领导层迅速采取行动，从机关中肃清腐败官员。

items.def_en: To destroy, uproot, or wipe out an unwanted condition, disease, or problem completely
items.ex_en: Global health agencies strive to eradicate infectious diseases through mass vaccination.
items.ex_zh: 全球卫生机构力求通过大规模疫苗接种来根除传染病。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on ridding an entity of burdens, impurities, unwanted individuals, or harmful conditions to restore cleanliness, liberty, or baseline function.
groups.summary_zh: 指彻底清除、驱逐或肃清附着的赘物、负担、杂质或不受欢迎之人。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the thorough, radical removal of unwanted, contaminating, or burdensome elements to restore clean integrity, beyond superficial cleaning.
groups.desc_zh: 指彻底、根除性地剔除不受欢迎的杂质、异己或沉重负担以恢复纯粹，区别于表层的打扫整理。
groups.nuance_en: purge: violently or thoroughly cleanse a body or group of dissidents/impurities (party / system / soul) · eradicate: completely tear up, annihilate, or blot out from existence (disease / poverty / weeds) · rid: relieve oneself or an entity of a troublesome nuisance (body / self / home) · cast off: consciously discard unwanted bonds, clothes, or habits (inhibitions / shackles / doubts) · disencumber: free someone or something from heavy burdens or impediments (estate / traveler / mind)
groups.nuance_zh: purge: 彻底清洗组织内的异端或排净体内毒素 (party / system / soul) · eradicate: 连根拔起并彻底扑灭消除 (disease / poverty / weeds) · rid: 使摆脱困扰或免受杂物纠缠 (body / self / home) · cast off: 主动断然抛弃束缚或旧习 (inhibitions / shackles / doubts) · disencumber: 卸除重负以恢复轻松自在 (estate / traveler / mind)

groups.name: Pursue & Chase · 追捕与穷追 (Pursue, Track, Run down)
groups.tip: 从后方紧追不舍力图捕获

items.def_en: To follow the trail, footprints, or markers left by someone or an animal
items.ex_en: Experienced rangers managed to track the injured bear through thick mud.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的护林员循着厚厚的泥地追踪到了受伤的熊。

items.def_en: To pursue someone or something until they are finally overtaken or captured
items.ex_en: Federal detectives finally managed to run down the elusive jewel thief.
items.ex_zh: 联邦侦探终于设法将那名神出鬼没的珠宝大盗追捕归案。

items.def_en: To follow someone closely and unyieldingly over a long period
items.ex_en: Persistent financial troubles continued to dog the small company all year.
items.ex_zh: 持续不断的财务困境整整一年都在缠扰着这家小公司。

items.def_en: 1. To follow or chase someone or something in order to catch or kill them. 2. To engage in or work hard to accomplish a goal, activity, or plan.
items.ex_en: Mounted police officers were dispatched to pursue the fleeing armed suspects.
items.ex_zh: 骑警被派去全力追捕四处逃窜的武装嫌疑人。

items.def_en: To follow or pursue someone or prey stealthily, keeping hidden until ready to strike
items.ex_en: A silent leopard began to stalk grazing deer through tall grass.
items.ex_zh: 一只悄无声息的花豹开始穿过高草丛潜伏追踪吃草的鹿。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on purposeful, sustained pursuit aimed at overtaking an elusive or fleeing target, or systematically striving to achieve an ambition or course of action.
groups.summary_zh: 指为了捕捉或达成目标而进行的持续追赶与追求。
groups.desc_en: Involves continuous, high-effort physical or metaphorical following designed to capture or defeat a fleeing target, differing from passive trailing.
groups.desc_zh: 指为捕获或击败逃逸目标而进行的主动、高强度持续追赶，区别于被动跟随。
groups.nuance_en: pursue: follow persistently with intent to overtake or achieve (suspect / prey / goal) · run down: hunt relentlessly until the quarry is cornered or exhausted (fugitive / suspect / lead) · track: follow progressive sensory footprints, traces, or signals (game / satellite / suspect) · dog: plague and pursue tenaciously without relent (heels / steps / footsteps) · stalk: stealthily and patiently trail a target before striking (prey / victim)
groups.nuance_zh: pursue: 紧追不舍以求追上捕获 (suspect / prey / goal) · run down: 穷追不舍直至目标精疲力竭就擒 (fugitive / suspect / lead) · track: 循着足迹、线索或信号循迹追踪 (game / satellite / suspect) · dog: 如影随形地顽固缠追 (heels / steps / footsteps) · stalk: 潜伏并步步紧逼目标 (prey / victim)

groups.name: Pursue Closely & Covertly · 尾随与暗中盯梢 (Shadow, Tail)
groups.tip: 如影随形追踪行动踪迹

items.def_zh: 紧紧追随；形影不离地尾随
items.def_en: to follow someone closely and continuously without leaving them alone
items.ex_en: Persistent paparazzi continued to dog the famous actress throughout her vacation.
items.ex_zh: 执拗的狗仔队在著名女演员度假期间一直形影不离地尾随着她。

items.def_zh: 秘密尾随，跟踪；跟随观察，影子实习；投阴影于
items.def_en: 1. To follow someone closely and secretly without their knowledge. 2. To accompany someone to observe and learn their job. 3. To cast a shadow over.
items.ex_en: Undercover agents continued to shadow the suspect through the crowded terminal.
items.ex_zh: 便衣特工穿过拥挤的航站楼，暗中紧密尾随着嫌疑人。

items.def_zh: 尾随，盯梢，跟踪；装尾巴于
items.def_en: 1. To follow closely behind someone in order to observe their movements. 2. To provide or attach a tail to.
items.ex_en: Two plainclothes detectives were assigned to tail the courier across town.
items.ex_zh: 两名便衣侦探被指派跨城盯梢跟踪那个信使。

items.def_zh: 潜行追踪；盯梢伺机靠近
items.def_en: to follow stealthily and menacingly, as a predator following prey
items.ex_en: The shadowy figure seemed to stalk her through dark alleys unobserved.
items.ex_zh: 那个黑影似乎在黑暗的巷子里悄然尾随盯梢着她。

items.def_en: to pursue or follow relentlessly and aggressively, giving no respite
items.ex_en: Aggressive journalists continue to hound the retired politician day and night.
items.ex_zh: 激进的记者们日夜纠缠追逐着那位退休的政客。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote pursuing someone closely and usually without their consent or knowledge in order to monitor their movements. 'Shadow' emphasizes remaining unseen while mimicking the quarry's movements like a dark outline, whereas 'tail' evokes closely sticking behind a target's vehicle or path.
groups.summary_zh: 指紧跟在某人身后进行暗中监视、盯梢，以掌握其行踪。
groups.desc_en: Emphasizes covert, close-proximity surveillance where the follower conceals their presence to monitor movements, differing from open high-speed chasing.
groups.desc_zh: 偏重以隐蔽方式对目标进行近距离尾随与暗中盯梢以监视动向，区别于公开的高速追逐。
groups.nuance_en: shadow: secretly trail a person at close range without their knowledge (suspect / diplomat / movements) · tail: maintain surveillance by following closely behind a moving subject (car / spy / suspect) · stalk: obsessively, menacingly, and illicitly follow someone (ex-partner / celebrity) · hound: relentlessly harass and track down a subject without respite (debtor / celebrity / official) · dog: stay tenaciously attached to someone's immediate vicinity (steps / heels)
groups.nuance_zh: shadow: 暗中贴身盯梢且不被察觉 (suspect / diplomat / movements) · tail: 尾随车辆或行人以监视行踪 (car / spy / suspect) · stalk: 怀有恶意或病态执念地长期纠缠追踪 (ex-partner / celebrity) · hound: 紧追不放并不停骚扰逼迫 (debtor / celebrity / official) · dog: 寸步不离地死死咬住 (steps / heels)

groups.name: Put Down & Set Firmly · 猛放与撂下 (Plump, Flump, Set Down)
groups.tip: 平稳安放摆在某处

items.def_en: Put down or drop something heavily and carelessly in a heap or pile
items.ex_en: He would always dump his heavy backpack right onto the floor.
items.ex_zh: 他总是随手把沉重的双肩包扑通一声扔在地板上。

items.def_en: Set something down suddenly, heavily, or without care onto a surface
items.ex_en: She decided to plunk down a stack of bills right away.
items.ex_zh: 她当场把一沓钞票沉沉地撂在桌上。

items.def_en: Drop or place something down heavily and clumsily with a dull thud
items.ex_en: Exhausted after hiking, she managed to plump down the heavy pack.
items.ex_zh: 徒步后精疲力竭的她扑通一声放下了沉重的背包。

items.def_en: Forcefully and noisily smash or thrust an object down against a surface
items.ex_en: In a sudden fit of rage, he would slam down the phone.
items.ex_zh: 在一阵突如其来的怒火中，他狠狠把电话摔了下去。

items.def_en: (also 'plank down') To put or set something down heavily or firmly.
items.ex_en: He decided to plank down fifty dollars for the concert ticket.
items.ex_zh: 他索性啪地拍下五十美元买下了那张音乐会门票。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on setting, dropping, or slamming an object down emphatically, abruptly, or heavily onto a flat surface.
groups.summary_zh: 强调重重地、突兀或果断地放下某物。
groups.desc_en: Denotes setting an object or oneself down heavily, abruptly, or carelessly with kinetic impact, contrasting with gentle, deliberate placement.
groups.desc_zh: 指带着冲量重重地、粗鲁或随意地撂下物体或瘫坐下，区别于轻拿轻放或端正安置。
groups.nuance_en: dump: unload or drop heavy loads casually or unceremoniously (bags / rubbish / cargo) · plunk down: drop something down heavily or pay cash decisively (cash / bag / money) · plump down: collapse heavily and clumsily into a seat, or drop a soft heavy object (oneself / cushions / bag) · slam down: strike a surface violently when placing something (phone / cup / fist) · plank: firmly and forcefully set money or cards on a table (cash / cards)
groups.nuance_zh: dump: 粗鲁随意地倾倒或抛下重物 (bags / rubbish / cargo) · plunk down: 沉重丢下或果断拍出钱款 (cash / bag / money) · plump down: 沉重笨拙地瘫坐或重掷软物 (oneself / cushions / bag) · slam down: 带着怒气或重力猛然摔在桌上 (phone / cup / fist) · plank: 决断有力地在桌上拍出钱币 (cash / cards)

groups.name: Put Out Fire & Cool Down · 扑灭与熄灭 (Quench, Extinguish, Douse)
groups.tip: 用水或外力扑灭火与渴

items.def_en: Extinguish a fire, cigarette, or flame using water, smothered blankets, or effort.
items.ex_en: Firefighters worked together quickly to put out the small kitchen blaze.
items.ex_zh: 消防员们迅速协作，扑灭了厨房的那场小火。

items.def_en: Cause a fire or light to stop burning or shining completely.
items.ex_en: Fire crews rushed to extinguish the warehouse flames before midnight struck.
items.ex_zh: 消防队员在午夜来临前火速赶去扑灭仓库的大火。

items.def_en: Extinguish a fire by depriving it of oxygen using sand, earth, or a heavy blanket.
items.ex_en: He used a damp wool blanket to smother the kitchen grease fire.
items.ex_zh: 他用一条潮湿的羊毛毯将厨房的油锅火闷熄了。

items.def_en: 1. To put out or extinguish a fire or flame. 2. To satisfy a thirst by drinking liquid. 3. To cool hot metal rapidly in liquid to harden it.
items.ex_en: Soldiers rushed with heavy sandbags to quench the blazing ammunition depot.
items.ex_zh: 士兵们带着沉重的沙袋赶去扑灭熊熊燃烧的弹药库。

items.def_en: Pour a large amount of liquid over a fire or light to extinguish it rapidly.
items.ex_en: Campers used buckets of stream water to douse the roaring fire.
items.ex_zh: 露营者用水桶提来溪水，迅速浇灭了熊熊燃烧的营火。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the suppression of fire, glowing heat, or burning embers by using water, smothering blankets, foam, or depriving the flame of oxygen.
groups.summary_zh: 指泼水泼液、隔绝氧气以扑灭火苗，或使炽热物体冷却降温的操作。
groups.desc_en: Entails terminating combustion by depriving flames of fuel, heat, or oxygen, differing from letting a fire die out naturally through exhaustion.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过隔绝氧气、降温或阻断燃料来人为熄灭燃烧，区别于任由火焰自行燃尽。
groups.nuance_en: extinguish: formally and thoroughly terminate combustion or light (fire / flames / blaze) · put out: extinguish household fires, cigarettes, or lights through common action (cigarette / fire / blaze) · smother: choke out flames by depriving them of oxygen (fire / flames / embers) · douse: wet copiously with liquid to drench and quench fire instantly (fire / flames / camp) · quench: cool glowing embers or slake heat/thirst thoroughly (fire / embers / steel)
groups.nuance_zh: extinguish: 正式、彻底地扑灭火灾或熄灭光源 (fire / flames / blaze) · put out: 日常动作扑灭火苗、香烟或灯火 (cigarette / fire / blaze) · smother: 覆盖隔绝空气以窒息灭火 (fire / flames / embers) · douse: 泼洒大量水流浇透灭火 (fire / flames / camp) · quench: 大量浇水使炽铁或余烬冷却熄灭 (fire / embers / steel)

groups.name: Qualify & Certify · 认证与获得资质 (Certify, Accredit, License)
groups.tip: 具备资格达到标准

items.def_en: Grant formal legal permission to someone to practice a trade or carry out an activity
items.ex_en: State boards strictly license certified electricians to ensure residential public safety.
items.ex_zh: 州委员会对持证电工严格核发执照，以确保住宅公共安全。

items.raw_cluster: 胜任与使合格 Qualify & Certify
items.def_zh: 取得资格，具备资格；使合格；修饰，限定（陈述）
items.def_en: 1. To reach the necessary standard or have the required qualities to do or be something. 2. To give someone the legal right or ability to do something. 3. To limit or modify the meaning of an assertion or word.
items.ex_en: Years of rigorous training will qualify her as a skilled surgeon.
items.ex_zh: 多年的严格训练将使她具备成为一名熟练外科医生的资格。
items.ex2_en: She managed to qualify for the Olympic finals after setting a new record.
items.ex2_zh: 她在打破一项新纪录后，成功获得了参加奥运会决赛的资格。

items.def_zh: 颁发合格证书，证明合格
items.def_en: Officially attest that someone has reached a required standard or passed an exam
items.ex_en: The national medical board will certify physicians after rigorous testing procedures.
items.ex_zh: 国家医学委员会将在严格的测试程序后为内科医生认证资质。

items.def_en: Confirm the official validity, suitability, or legal competence of someone or something
items.ex_en: The inspector arrived on site to validate the company's manufacturing licenses.
items.ex_zh: 检查员亲临现场以确认该公司生产执照的合法有效性。

items.def_en: Officially recognize an institution or person as meeting essential quality standards
items.ex_en: The ministry decided to accredit the regional hospital for clinical training.
items.ex_zh: 该部委决定官方认可这家地区医院开展临床培训的资质。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures formally verifying, testing, and granting legal or institutional approval for a person or institution to practice an activity.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过权威考核、审核，正式授予法定资格或执业认证。
groups.desc_en: Specifies formal institutional validation and authoritative credentialing against set competency standards, differing from subjective praise.
groups.desc_zh: 指由权威机构依照既定专业标准对主体资质进行的合规审查与认证赋权，区别于主观认可或赞誉。
groups.nuance_en: qualify: attain necessary competence, attributes, or scores to be eligible (for finals / as doctor) · certify: attest authoritatively to accuracy, competence, or safety in writing (document / pilot / aircraft) · license: grant official legal permission to practice or operate (driver / doctor / software) · accredit: officially recognize an educational or medical institution as meeting standards (college / clinic / program) · validate: establish or verify the official legal force, correctness, or efficacy (claim / ticket / data)
groups.nuance_zh: qualify: 达到标准而取得入围或从业资格 (for finals / as doctor) · certify: 开具证书正式证明资质或质量 (document / pilot / aircraft) · license: 官方发放准许执业或运营的牌照 (driver / doctor / software) · accredit: 评估并正式认可机构达到行业基准 (college / clinic / program) · validate: 验证有效性以赋予法律或技术效力 (claim / ticket / data)

groups.name: Quantify & Enumerate · 计数与列举 (Count, Enumerate, Quantify)
groups.tip: 运用数字与统计算法定量核算

items.def_en: To add together individual items one after another to determine the entire total
items.ex_en: The cashier took a moment to count up all daily earnings.
items.ex_zh: 出纳花了一点时间清点出全天所有的营业收入总额。

items.def_en: To measure or describe something as a specific number or measurable quantity
items.ex_en: Economists attempted to quantify the total environmental damages caused by emissions.
items.ex_zh: 经济学家试图量化排污所造成的环境损害总量。

items.def_en: To name things separately, one by one, especially in a systematic list
items.ex_en: The official report proceeded to enumerate every single breach of contract.
items.ex_zh: 官方报告随后逐一列举了每一项具体的违约行为。

items.def_en: To write a list of things item by item, giving specific details for each
items.ex_en: Contractors must itemize all material expenses before submitting the final invoice.
items.ex_zh: 承包商在提交最终发票前必须逐项列明所有材料费用。

items.def_zh: 列举，数出，计算；读出（数字）
items.def_en: 1. To count, list, or enumerate items one by one. 2. To express or read out a number in words.
items.ex_en: The ancient scholar sought to numerate all stars visible at midnight.
items.ex_zh: 这位古代学者试图逐一数出午夜可见的所有星辰。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe determining the total number of items, itemizing entities in a systematic sequence, or expressing abstract concepts in precise numeric form.
groups.summary_zh: 逐一清点、列出清单或以明确数值表达总量。
groups.desc_en: Involves systematically calculating quantities or stating elements one by one in an ordered series, contrasting with vague impressionistic estimation.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过系统计算数量或按次序逐一罗列具体项目，区别于笼统模糊的感性估算。
groups.nuance_en: quantify: express or measure a phenomenon in precise numerical terms (risk / loss / benefits) · enumerate: mention or list a series of things one by one (reasons / examples / rights) · itemize: produce a detailed, breakdown list showing individual particulars (deductions / expenses / bill) · count up: calculate the aggregate numerical total item by item (votes / scores / points) · numerate: count or express quantities mathematically in an ordered sequence (items / data)
groups.nuance_zh: quantify: 用精确数字对现象进行量化测定 (risk / loss / benefits) · enumerate: 逐条列举罗列明细 (reasons / examples / rights) · itemize: 详尽列出分项清单 (deductions / expenses / bill) · count up: 逐个核算并得出总数 (votes / scores / points) · numerate: 进行数学性的序列计数或编号 (items / data)

groups.name: Quarantine & Cloister · 隔离与封闭 (Isolate, Quarantine, Cloister)
groups.tip: 从物理分开到彻底孤立隔绝

items.def_en: To seal off an area by means of police tape, barriers, or guards to prevent entry
items.ex_en: Police officers moved quickly to cordon off the dangerous blast site.
items.ex_zh: 警官们迅速行动，拉起警戒线封锁了危险的爆炸现场。

items.def_zh: 使隔离，使孤立；分离，脱析
items.def_en: 1. To separate someone or something physically or socially from others; place in quarantine. 2. (science) To separate a particular substance or organism from others for study.
items.ex_en: Doctors decided to isolate contagious patients immediately inside specialized hospital wards.
items.ex_zh: 医生们决定立即将具有传染性的患者隔离在专门的病房内。

items.def_en: To seclude or enclose someone in or as if in a monastery or convent away from the world
items.ex_en: She chose to cloister herself in a quiet remote seaside cottage.
items.ex_zh: 她选择幽居在一座偏远幽静的海滨小屋里避世。

items.def_en: To isolate a person, animal, or ship to prevent the spread of infectious disease
items.ex_en: Port authorities will quarantine incoming vessels until thorough health checks finish.
items.ex_zh: 港口当局将隔离进港船只，直至彻底的健康检查完成。

items.def_en: To keep someone or a group apart from other people, especially a jury during a trial
items.ex_en: Court officials agreed to sequester the high-profile murder trial jury completely.
items.ex_zh: 法庭官员同意将这起备受瞩目的谋杀案陪审团完全隔离起来。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey forceful, strict, or protective physical segregation of individuals or entities from the wider population or environment, often due to infection, security, or seclusion.
groups.summary_zh: 指出于防疫、安全或避世需要，对人或事物实施严格的物理隔离与封禁。
groups.desc_en: Denotes physical or institutional separation to contain contamination, danger, or worldly distraction, contrasting with generic 'separate' by its defensive enclosure and enforced confinement.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过物理或体制性壁垒实施防御性物理隔离以防污染、危险或尘俗侵扰，区别于中性的普通“分开”。
groups.nuance_en: cordon off: physical perimeter closure for security (area / scene / street) · isolate: general severing of contact or connection (patient / community / variable) · cloister: sheltered or religious withdrawal from worldly affairs (monk / scholar / life) · quarantine: medical containment against infectious contagion (traveler / cargo / pet) · sequester: legal or protective enforced seclusion (jury / assets / witness)
groups.nuance_zh: cordon off: 设置警戒线封锁物理外围 (area / scene / street) · isolate: 切断外界联系的中性孤立与隔绝 (patient / community / variable) · cloister: 遁入清修或不受打扰的庇护性深居 (monk / scholar / life) · quarantine: 针对传染病源的强制防疫隔离 (traveler / cargo / pet) · sequester: 司法或安全需要的法律强制隔离 (jury / assets / witness)

groups.name: Quarter & House Troops · 军宿安排与征集寄宿 (Quarter, Lodge, Canton)
groups.tip: 分配军人或人员临时宿营

items.def_en: Supply troops or groups with living quarters or institutional shelter
items.ex_en: The old military garrison can easily house two full infantry battalions.
items.ex_zh: 这座旧军营能够轻松容纳并安置两个完整的步兵营。

items.def_en: Assign military personnel or officials to a specific base, post, or territory
items.ex_en: Commanders chose to station specialized border patrols along the disputed zone.
items.ex_zh: 指挥官们决定将边境特侦巡逻队驻派在争议地区沿线。

items.def_zh: 派驻，为（军人）提供营房/住处
items.def_en: Provide housing or operational living quarters for military personnel
items.ex_en: Authorities planned to quarter incoming troops inside the renovated stone barracks.
items.ex_zh: 当局计划将调来的部队安置在修葺一新的石砌营房中。

items.def_en: Provide someone with temporary sleeping quarters or live in rented/provided rooms
items.ex_en: The innkeeper agreed to lodge displaced refugee families during harsh winters.
items.ex_zh: 旅店老板同意在严冬里为流离失所的难民家庭提供暂住处。
items.ex2_en: Visiting scholars often lodge in modest dormitories near the main university campus.
items.ex2_zh: 访问学者通常寄宿在大学主校区附近的简朴宿舍里。

items.def_zh: （尤指为军队）安排临时住宿；使寄宿
items.def_en: To assign or provide temporary lodging for soldiers or other personnel, especially in civilian accommodation.
items.ex_en: Commanders arranged to billet several infantry squads in nearby village homes.
items.ex_zh: 指挥官安排将几个步兵班临时安置在附近村庄的民房内寄宿。

groups.summary_en: This frame concerns requisitioning or assigning civilian, temporary, or communal quarters for military personnel or government workers. Nuances highlight forced requisition, civilian homestay lodging, and organized base quarters.
groups.summary_zh: 指依指令为军人或外勤人员分配、征集临时住处或借宿于民宅与驻地。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the assignment and provision of non-permanent lodging specifically for military personnel, contrasting with generic 'accommodate' through its institutional mandate, requisition, or strategic deployment context.
groups.desc_zh: 指依据军事命令或战时征用向武装人员分配驻屯宿营处，区别于普通商业或日常的“容纳/寄宿”。
groups.nuance_en: house: broadly provide living premises without military obligation (displaced persons / workers) · station: assign military personnel to a fixed base or post (regiment / fleet / guards) · quarter: provide room and board, often enforced by military command (soldiers / troops / garrison) · lodge: temporary, non-institutional guest accommodation (traveler / guest / refugee) · billet: lodge military personnel in private civilian dwellings via official order (troops / officers / airmen)
groups.nuance_zh: house: 提供基本居住安置，偏中性 (displaced persons / workers) · station: 战略性调配驻防于固定岗位或要塞 (regiment / fleet / guards) · quarter: 依军令安排营房供膳宿 (soldiers / troops / garrison) · lodge: 临时寄居借宿，非强制性 (traveler / guest / refugee) · billet: 依官方摊派征令将官兵安置于民居 (troops / officers / airmen)

groups.name: Quell & Stifle · 平息与扼杀 (Quell, Stifle, Squelch)
groups.tip: 果断彻底地压制反对声音

items.def_zh: 防患于未然；扼杀于萌芽中
items.def_en: To stop or destroy a problem, protest, or conspiracy at an early stage before it can grow
items.ex_en: The administration acted swiftly to nip the emerging protest in the bud.
items.ex_zh: 管理层迅速采取行动，将刚冒头的抗议苗头扼杀在萌芽之中。

items.def_en: To smother or prevent the open expression or development of protests, debate, or dissent
items.ex_en: The authoritarian regime deployed riot police to stifle public debate on the controversial law.
items.ex_zh: 该专制政权出动防暴警察，以遏止公众就这项争议性法律展开辩论。

items.def_en: To extinguish or eliminate something undesirable (like corruption or rebellion) forcefully and completely
items.ex_en: The newly elected mayor pledged to stamp out corruption in the city procurement office.
items.ex_zh: 新当选的市长誓要彻底铲除该市采购部门中的腐败现象。

items.def_en: To completely put an end to a riot, rebellion, or rising wave of fear and disorder
items.ex_en: Troops were dispatched immediately to quell the violent uprising brewing in the northern province.
items.ex_zh: 军队被立即派往北部省份，以平息正在酝酿的暴力起义。

items.def_zh: 平息，遏止，压制；发咯吱咯吱声；踩着泥泞噗嗤作响
items.def_en: 1. To stop, crush, or suppress a rumor, protest, or idea firmly and completely. 2. To make a wet, sucking sound when stepping in mud or wet shoes.
items.ex_en: The company issued a firm statement to squelch rumors regarding its impending bankruptcy.
items.ex_zh: 该公司发表了一份态度坚决的声明，以平息关于其即将破产的传闻。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers extinguishing, choking off, or silencing disturbances, rumors, protests, or expressions of dissent before they escalate. It highlights neutralizing the unrest quickly and decisively, restoring silence or order.
groups.summary_zh: 指迅速平息动乱、掐灭苗头或强行压制谣言与异见。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the forceful suppression, extinguishing, or preemption of unrest, dissent, or emerging threats, contrasting with mild 'pacify' by its decisive, crushing finality.
groups.desc_zh: 指以强力手段扼杀、扑灭或压制骚乱、异见与萌芽危机，区别于温和劝抚类的“平息”。
groups.nuance_en: nip in the bud: destroy an emerging threat at its earliest conception (crisis / rebellion / rumor) · stifle: smother or suffocate expression before it spreads (debate / creativity / yawn) · stamp out: eradicate through persistent crushing measures (corruption / disease / dissent) · quell: restore public order by crushing armed unrest (riot / rebellion / fears) · squelch: decisively silence opposition or speculation with heavy authority (rumor / protest / objection)
groups.nuance_zh: nip in the bud: 防患于未然，在萌芽阶段即予掐灭 (crisis / rebellion / rumor) · stifle: 窒息式压制言论或生命力 (debate / creativity / yawn) · stamp out: 像踩灭余烬般彻底根除消灭 (corruption / disease / dissent) · quell: 平息甚至镇压群体性骚乱以恢复秩序 (riot / rebellion / fears) · squelch: 以权威一锤定音地彻底压制反驳 (rumor / protest / objection)

groups.name: Quest & Search · 寻索与求索 (Scour, Seek, Pursue)
groups.tip: 主动追寻未知事物与答案

items.def_en: To search persistently and actively through various places to find a missing person, thing, or clue
items.ex_en: She spent the entire morning hunting for her misplaced car keys.
items.ex_zh: 她整个上午都在寻找不知随手放在哪里的车钥匙。

items.def_en: To attempt to find, obtain, or attain something valuable, tangible or intangible
items.ex_en: The research team will seek further funding to develop renewable energy technology next spring.
items.ex_zh: 该研究团队将于明年春天寻求进一步的资金支持，以开发可再生能源技术。

items.def_en: to search or seek for something, especially for a long time.
items.ex_en: The weary philosopher had quested after absolute truth through decades of solitary contemplation.
items.ex_zh: 这位疲惫的哲学家在数十载孤独的沉思中，始终在探求绝对真理。

items.def_en: To search through an area, records, or items minutely and systematically
items.ex_en: Investigators had to comb through thousands of financial records to locate the missing funds.
items.ex_zh: 调查人员不得不仔细梳理数千份财务记录，以寻找失踪的资金。

items.def_en: To search an entire area, place, or collection very thoroughly and rigorously in order to locate something
items.ex_en: Volunteers and officers continued to scour the dense forest for the missing hiker.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者和警官们继续在密林中进行地毯式搜寻，以找寻失踪的徒步旅行者。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers earnest, prolonged, or exhaustive searches for physical objects, knowledge, spiritual enlightenment, or ambitious goals across space or time.
groups.summary_zh: 怀有明确目标进行的执着搜寻、探索或人生求索。
groups.desc_en: Denotes active, purposeful, and exhaustive investigation to discover a lost object, truth, or vital quarry, contrasting with casual 'look for' through systematic intensity and high stakes.
groups.desc_zh: 指带着明确目的与紧迫感展开周密、竭尽全力的大面积搜寻，区别于漫不经心的日常“寻找”。
groups.nuance_en: hunt for: track down an elusive or concealed target (fugitive / clue / apartment) · seek: formal or abstract pursuit of intangible objectives (asylum / truth / advice) · quest: elevated or mythical pursuit of an arduous, noble goal (meaning / holy grail / glory) · comb through: scrutinize a defined area or dataset with fine-toothed thoroughness (records / wreckage / rubble) · scour: sweep relentlessly across an expansive territory in desperate search (coastline / archives / woods)
groups.nuance_zh: hunt for: 针对隐蔽或移动目标的追踪搜捕 (fugitive / clue / apartment) · seek: 书面语中对无形、抽象目标的追求与寻求 (asylum / truth / advice) · quest: 带有史诗或使命色彩的崇高精神求索 (meaning / holy grail / glory) · comb through: 梳子般细致地过梳排查文件或废墟 (records / wreckage / rubble) · scour: 焦灼而地毯式地彻底搜遍大片区域 (coastline / archives / woods)

groups.name: Rack & Afflict · 痛楚煎熬与折磨 (Rack, Afflict, Scourge)
groups.tip: 身体受剧烈苦痛与精神折磨

items.def_en: (often passive) Trouble, plague, or threaten someone persistently from all sides
items.ex_en: Throughout his brief reign, the young king was beset by treacherous conspiracies and rebellions.
items.ex_zh: 在短暂的统治期间，这位年轻的国王一直被阴谋背叛与叛乱重重困扰。

items.def_zh: 折磨，使痛苦；施刑，拷问；绞尽（脑汁）
items.def_en: 1. (often passive, 'be racked with/by') To cause someone extreme physical pain or mental anguish. 2. ('rack one's brains') To think very hard to find an answer or remember something. 3. (historical) To torture someone on a rack.
items.ex_en: The injured athlete was racked with immense pain after collapsing near the finish line.
items.ex_zh: 那名受伤的运动员在终点线附近倒地后，饱受剧痛的折磨。

items.def_en: (often passive) Cause severe physical pain, chronic suffering, or lasting unhappiness to someone
items.ex_en: A mysterious respiratory illness continues to afflict elderly residents across the rural district.
items.ex_zh: 一种神秘的呼吸道疾病继续折磨着该乡村地区的老年居民。

items.def_en: Cause great suffering, devastation, or punishment to a person or population
items.ex_en: Severe droughts and bitter famine scourged the impoverished nation throughout the harsh decade.
items.ex_zh: 严重的干旱和严酷的饥荒在这艰难的十年中重创了这个贫穷的国家。

items.def_zh: 使抽搐；使剧烈震颤痛楚
items.def_en: Cause sudden, violent, involuntary spasms or uncontrollable bouts of pain in the body
items.ex_en: Violent coughing fits began to convulse the patient's frail body during the night.
items.ex_zh: 夜间，剧烈的咳嗽发作开始令患者虚弱的身体阵阵抽搐。
items.ex2_en: His limbs began to convulse violently from the sudden drop in temperature.
items.ex2_zh: 由于气温骤降，他的四肢开始剧烈抽搐痉挛。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on being gripped or seized by intense, unbearable internal pain, spasms, coughing, fever, or guilt. Frequently used in passive constructions with 'with' or 'by'.
groups.summary_zh: 指身心被剧烈阵痛、痉挛、疾病或内疚强烈煎熬折磨。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the infliction of continuous, agonizing physical, psychological, or societal torment, contrasting with basic 'harm' through its crushing, chronic, and torturous persistence.
groups.desc_zh: 指长期、摧残性地施加肉体、精神或社会层面的剧烈折磨与苦难，区别于普通单次的“伤害”。
groups.nuance_en: beset: surround and harass persistently from all sides (problems / difficulties / doubts) · rack: stretch or strain body or soul through acute pain (guilt / cough / spasms) · afflict: burden with chronic misfortune, disease, or distress (nation / patient / economy) · scourge: devastate wide populations like a punitive whip or plague (famine / epidemic / war) · convulse: shake violently with internal spasms or political upheaval (country / market / laughter)
groups.nuance_zh: beset: 四面楚歌式的困扰与缠绕 (problems / difficulties / doubts) · rack: 酷刑架般的剧痛拉扯、撕心裂肺之苦 (guilt / cough / spasms) · afflict: 疾病或灾难对主体造成的深重折磨 (nation / patient / economy) · scourge: 鞭笞式的重创与浩劫 (famine / epidemic / war) · convulse: 剧烈痉挛震颤或引发社会政治性动荡 (country / market / laughter)

groups.name: Racket & Clatter · 嗡鸣与喧闹 (Clatter, Blare, Rattle)
groups.tip: 嘈杂吵闹声浪喧嚣嘈杂

items.def_en: To make a rapid succession of short, sharp, knocking sounds
items.ex_en: The fierce winter wind caused the loose windowpane to rattle loudly all night.
items.ex_zh: 凛冽的冬风使松动的窗玻璃整夜都格格作响。
items.ex2_en: The nervous speaker rattled his car keys inside his jacket pocket continuously.
items.ex2_zh: 紧张的演讲者不停地在夹克口袋里弄得车钥匙叮当响。

items.def_zh: 喧闹，大声吵嚷；过放荡喧闹的生活
items.def_en: (+ around/about) To make a loud, continuous noise; to engage in noisy, lively social revelry.
items.ex_en: Drunk revelers racketed about the quiet residential streets until the early morning hours.
items.ex_zh: 醉醺醺的狂欢者们在安静的居民区街道上喧闹折腾，直到凌晨时分。

items.def_zh: 发出哗啦撞击声；咔嗒作响
items.def_en: To make a continuous rapid sequence of loud, hard, rattling sounds
items.ex_en: Empty plastic crates clattered onto the pavement when the delivery truck turned sharply.
items.ex_zh: 送货卡车猛一转弯，空的塑料板条箱便哗啦作响地砸在人行道上。
items.ex2_en: The angry chef clattered copper pans onto the kitchen stove during rush hour.
items.ex2_zh: 在客流高峰期，愤怒的厨师将铜锅在厨房炉灶上砸得哐当作响。

items.def_zh: 发出刺耳轰鸣；高声尖叫
items.def_en: To make a very loud, harsh, piercing sound, often continuous
items.ex_en: Car horns continued to blare incessantly as rush-hour traffic ground to a complete halt.
items.ex_zh: 随着早晚高峰的交通彻底陷入瘫痪，汽车喇叭声刺耳地鸣个不停。
items.ex2_en: The impatient driver blared his horn at the stalled car ahead of him.
items.ex2_zh: 不耐烦的司机对着前方熄火的汽车使劲按响喇叭。

items.def_en: (+ for/against) To make a loud and confused noise, especially of people shouting loudly
items.ex_en: Desperate citizens began to clamor against the unfair taxation policies imposed by the crown.
items.ex_zh: 绝望的民众开始高声喧闹，抗议王室强加的不公税收政策。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on making loud, disorderly, and grating acoustic disturbances, often involving raucous movement, rattling metal, or continuous blaring uproar.
groups.summary_zh: 指制造喧嚣刺耳的噪音、持续轰鸣或伴随剧烈运动的骚乱之声。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the generation of loud, jarring, and disorganized mechanical or vocal cacophony, contrasting with pure 'sound' through its disruptive, chaotic harshness.
groups.desc_zh: 指产生刺耳、散乱且具破坏性的机械碰撞声或嘈杂声浪，区别于中性的泛称“发声”。
groups.nuance_en: rattle: produce rapid, short knocking sounds from loose vibrations (window / bones / engine) · racket: generate continuous, disorderly domestic or street disturbance (children / party / neighbors) · clatter: produce a loud, sharp resonant banging of hard objects colliding (dishes / hooves / pans) · blare: emit a brassy, deafeningly loud, unyielding acoustic blast (siren / horn / trumpet) · clamor: make a deafening, unified vocal demand or protest (crowd / mob / press)
groups.nuance_zh: rattle: 零碎硬物剧烈晃动发出的连续格格声 (window / bones / engine) · racket: 制造持续无序、烦扰邻里的喧嚣杂音 (children / party / neighbors) · clatter: 硬质器皿相撞或马蹄踏地的清脆当啷声 (dishes / hooves / pans) · blare: 喇叭或汽笛刺耳、高强度的鸣响 (siren / horn / trumpet) · clamor: 人群嘈杂愤怒的喧嚷或大声疾呼 (crowd / mob / press)

groups.name: Radicalize & Incite · 激化与煽动 (Radicalize, Incite, Inflame)
groups.tip: 推动立场激进化与极端化

items.def_zh: 煽风点火；助长（火势、情绪）
items.def_en: To make a grievance, dispute, or strong feeling burn hotter and spread further
items.ex_en: Sensational headlines only served to fan the flames of ethnic tension across the region.
items.ex_zh: 耸人听闻的头条新闻只会助长整个地区民族紧张情绪的火势。

items.def_en: To deliberately excite or rouse intense enthusiasm, fury, or hysteria among a group
items.ex_en: The charismatic orator tried to whip up fury among the crowd before the vote.
items.ex_zh: 这位极具感染力的演说家试图在投票前激起人群中的狂怒情绪。

items.def_en: To make feelings of anger, passion, or hostility significantly more intense and violent
items.ex_en: His provocative rhetoric served only to inflame ancient enmities between the rival factions.
items.ex_zh: 他煽动性的言论只会激化这两个敌对派系之间由来已久的仇恨。

items.def_en: 1. To cause someone or become someone who adopts extreme political, social, or religious views.
items.ex_en: Extremist online propaganda can rapidly radicalize vulnerable teenagers seeking a sense of belonging.
items.ex_zh: 极端的网络宣传能迅速使那些寻求归属感的脆弱青少年走向激进化。
items.ex2_en: Impressionable young students radicalized swiftly after attending controversial underground meetings.
items.ex2_zh: 易受影响的年轻学生在参加了有争议的地下集会后迅速变得激进。

items.def_en: (+ to) To encourage or stir up violent, unlawful, or disruptive behavior in a crowd or individual
items.ex_en: The agitator used inflammatory speeches to incite the restless mob to destructive riots.
items.ex_zh: 那个煽动分子用极具煽动性的演说鼓动躁动的暴民发动破坏性骚乱。

groups.summary_en: This frame refers to escalating political, social, or personal tensions, converting parties toward extreme doctrines or rousing them into violent unrest.
groups.summary_zh: 指使思想走向极端、煽动对抗或激化矛盾冲突。
groups.desc_en: Denotes deliberately intensifying extreme political or emotional passions to trigger aggressive disruption, contrasting with neutral 'persuade' by its subversive, incendiary intent.
groups.desc_zh: 指蓄意煽动仇恨、极化极端思想或激化对立情绪以引发对抗，区别于理性的“说服”或常规“劝导”。
groups.nuance_en: fan: gently or steadily feed existing smoldering grievances (flames / discontent / racism) · whip up: deliberately agitate an audience into a feverish emotional pitch (frenzy / hysteria / enthusiasm) · inflame: heat passions or tensions to an explosive, volatile level (tensions / passions / crowds) · radicalize: shift beliefs toward extreme ideological or militant dogmas (youth / recruits / politics) · incite: provoke direct, immediate unlawful or violent action (violence / riot / insurrection)
groups.nuance_zh: fan: 煽风点火以助长潜伏的不满 (flames / discontent / racism) · whip up: 蓄意挑起群体的狂热与歇斯底里 (frenzy / hysteria / enthusiasm) · inflame: 激化局势，使敌对或愤怒情绪如烈火般升温 (tensions / passions / crowds) · radicalize: 使思想转向激进化与极端暴力阵营 (youth / recruits / politics) · incite: 策动并直接促成暴乱等非法行为 (violence / riot / insurrection)

groups.name: Rage & Fume · 狂怒与盛怒 (Display or Contain Intense Fury)
groups.tip: 从怒气郁积到彻底暴怒发狂

items.def_en: to be extremely angry but unable or unwilling to express it openly
items.ex_en: Sitting silently in the corner, he continued to seethe over the humiliating insult.
items.ex_zh: 他静静地坐在角落里，因受到这番奇耻大辱而怒火中烧。

items.def_zh: 暴怒咆哮，气冲冲地行动
items.def_en: to shout angrily or move forcefully while showing intense anger
items.ex_en: The angry customer stormed out of the dealership after negotiations broke down completely.
items.ex_zh: 谈判彻底破裂后，这名愤怒的顾客气冲冲地冲出了汽车专卖店。

items.def_zh: 暴怒，大发雷霆；猛烈发作，肆虐
items.def_en: 1. To feel, display, or express violent, uncontrolled anger. 2. (of a storm, fire, or illness) To continue with extreme violence and intensity.
items.ex_en: The supervisor began to rage furiously at the staff when the deadline passed.
items.ex_zh: 当截止日期过去后，主管开始对员工们大发雷霆。

items.def_en: to speak or shout at length in an angry, impassioned way
items.ex_en: The disgruntled commuter continued to rant about the delayed train to anyone nearby.
items.ex_zh: 那名心怀不满的通勤者对着身边的任何人喋喋不休地怒骂延误的火车。

items.def_en: 1. (+ over/about/at) To feel or express strong, often silent or suppressed, anger and irritation. 2. To emit smoke, gas, or strong-smelling vapor.
items.ex_en: She sat quietly at her desk, fuming over the manager's blatantly unfair criticism.
items.ex_zh: 她静静地坐在办公桌前，对经理明目张胆的不公指责生着闷气。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey extreme anger, differing along internal burning versus violent outward explosion. 'Fume' suggests simmering, silent or suppressed indignation, whereas 'rage' and 'seethe' involve uncontrollable tempestuous fury.
groups.summary_zh: 表达由内敛压抑到狂暴爆发的极度愤怒情绪。
groups.desc_en: Denotes experiencing or visibly manifesting explosive, uncontrolled fury, contrasting with quiet 'displeasure' through its visceral volatility and dramatic somatic display.
groups.desc_zh: 指内心翻滚或外在爆发失控的狂暴怒火，区别于隐忍不发的轻度“不快”。
groups.nuance_en: seethe: boil with intense, suppressed internal rage beneath a calm exterior (resentment / anger / frustration) · storm: move and shout with violent, tempestuous aggression (out of room / into office / down hall) · rage: lose all emotional restraint in an ongoing, fiery tempest (battle / storm / fever) · rant: unleash a loud, continuous, self-indulgent verbal tirade (critic / politician / lunatic) · fume: exhibit simmering, visible irritation through silent or muttered hostility (passengers / delays / boss)
groups.nuance_zh: seethe: 表面压抑而内心如沸水般翻滚积怒 (resentment / anger / frustration) · storm: 气势汹汹、大吵大闹地横冲直撞 (out of room / into office / down hall) · rage: 爆发全面肆虐、难以遏制的狂暴怒火 (battle / storm / fever) · rant: 夸张、语无伦次地大发牢骚或咆哮痛骂 (critic / politician / lunatic) · fume: 气得冒烟却多半敢怒不敢言地闷哼生闷气 (passengers / delays / boss)

groups.name: Rally & Reorganize · 聚集与重整 (Rally, Reassemble, Regroup)
groups.tip: 溃散队伍重新清点集结整军

items.def_en: To come together again after separating, or to put the parts of something back together
items.ex_en: The divided committee members will reassemble tomorrow morning to finalize the annual budget.
items.ex_zh: 分散的委员会成员将于明晨重新聚集，以敲定年度预算。
items.ex2_en: Skilled mechanics will reassemble the vintage aircraft engine using original factory blueprints.
items.ex2_zh: 熟练的机械师将使用原始工厂蓝图重新组装这台老式飞机发动机。

items.def_en: To meet again or call a formal meeting together again after a pause
items.ex_en: The parliamentary assembly agreed to reconvene next Monday to discuss the proposed amendments.
items.ex_zh: 议会同意于下周一重新召集复会，以讨论拟议的修正案。
items.ex2_en: The council chair will reconvene the delayed hearing next Friday at noon.
items.ex2_zh: 委员会主席将于下周五中午重新召集延期的听证会。

items.def_en: To gather together and arrange people, facts, or resources in an organized way for a purpose
items.ex_en: The defense attorney worked tirelessly to marshal compelling evidence before the trial began.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师在审判开始前不知疲倦地收集并统筹调度有力证据。

items.def_zh: 重新集结，重组，重新部署
items.def_en: To organize people, soldiers, or resources into a new and effective formation after a setback or break, or to do this as a group.
items.ex_en: The defeated squad retreated behind the defensive wall to regroup for another assault.
items.ex_zh: 失利的小队退到防御墙后重新集结，以准备发起另一次突击。

items.def_en: To bring people or resources together to make a united effort, especially after a setback
items.ex_en: The opposition leader worked hard to rally divided supporters ahead of the vote.
items.ex_zh: 反对党领袖在投票前努力号召各派支持者团结起来。
items.ex2_en: The battered tech stocks rallied strongly following unexpectedly optimistic quarterly earnings.
items.ex2_zh: 在出人意料的乐观季度财报公布后，受挫的科技股强劲反弹。

groups.summary_en: This frame refers to gathering forces, supporters, or thoughts together again, especially after a setback, defeat, or period of disarray, in order to mount a renewed effort.
groups.summary_zh: 指在受挫或分散后重新集结力量、整顿队伍或重振旗鼓。
groups.desc_en: Denotes re-collecting, reforming, and revitalizing scattered forces after disruption to mount a unified recovery, contrasting with initial 'gather' through its restorative, combat-ready focus.
groups.desc_zh: 指在受挫或溃散后重新集合队伍、提振士气并整编应战，区别于单纯的初次“集合”。
groups.nuance_en: reassemble: put scattered physical parts or separated individuals back together (team / engine / delegates) · reconvene: re-open an official session or meeting after an adjournment (committee / parliament / court) · marshal: strategically organize, order, and line up disparate resources (arguments / forces / facts) · regroup: reorganize strategic disposition after a retreat or shock (troops / investors / coalition) · rally: ignite morale and muster people to reverse defeat or show support (troops / market / supporters)
groups.nuance_zh: reassemble: 将被打散的零散人员或机械部件重新组装归位 (team / engine / delegates) · reconvene: 会议或法庭休会后依照程序重新复会 (committee / parliament / court) · marshal: 运筹帷幄地调集整理分散资源或论据 (arguments / forces / facts) · regroup: 受挫后收拢兵力并调整战术以待再战 (troops / investors / coalition) · rally: 绝地反扑，唤起斗志或资金以逆转颓势 (troops / market / supporters)

groups.name: Rampage & Tear · 横冲直撞与暴冲 (Tear, Storm, Charge)
groups.tip: 失控乱窜极具破坏力

items.def_zh: 气势汹汹地冲；暴怒闯入
items.def_en: Move with great anger, noisy force, and aggressive intent
items.ex_en: Armed guards stormed through the heavy iron doors without any prior warning whatsoever.
items.ex_zh: 武装警卫在没有任何事先警告的情况下，气势汹汹地冲破了沉重的铁门。

items.def_en: Move or rush with wild, reckless speed and forceful momentum
items.ex_en: The reckless sports car tore down the narrow alleyway at an alarming speed.
items.ex_zh: 那辆鲁莽的跑车以惊人的速度在狭窄的小巷里狂奔猛冲。

items.def_en: (+ down/through) Move very fast and recklessly without heed of obstacles
items.ex_en: The runaway freight truck barreled down the steep mountain slope toward the town.
items.ex_zh: 失控的货运卡车沿着陡峭的山坡向小镇疾冲而下。

items.def_en: Move violently through a place, causing rapid, severe destruction
items.ex_en: The fierce tornado ripped through the coastal town in less than an hour.
items.ex_zh: 凶猛的龙卷风在不到一小时内席卷并重创了这座沿海小镇。

items.raw_cluster: 横冲直撞与暴走 Rampage & Riot
items.def_en: To rush around wildly and violently, causing widespread damage or destruction.
items.ex_en: A herd of frightened cattle rampaged wildly through the town, destroying several vendor stalls.
items.ex_zh: 一群受惊的牛在镇上横冲直撞，毁坏了好几个小贩的摊位。

groups.summary_en: This frame depicts violent, uncontrolled, high-velocity movement through a space, typically leaving disruption or physical damage in its wake. 'Rampage' captures widespread destructive frenzy, while 'tear' and 'barrel' emphasize unstoppable kinetic rush.
groups.summary_zh: 指狂暴、不受控制地高速冲撞并造成破坏。
groups.desc_en: Denotes violent, uncontrolled, high-velocity movement carving a destructive path through obstacles, contrasting with standard 'run' by its destructive, stampeding force.
groups.desc_zh: 指势不可挡、具有破坏力地高速狂奔并冲撞沿途障碍，区别于中性的单纯“奔跑”。
groups.nuance_en: storm: advance aggressively with menacing thunderous intent (capital / beach / fortress) · tear: rip forward at reckless, breakneck velocity heedless of caution (down highway / across lawn) · barrel: roll forward relentlessly with unstoppable heavy mass (truck / train / down road) · rip through: violently penetrate and shatter an entire structure or barrier (neighborhood / flesh / hull) · rampage: rush wildly in a berserk, destructive frenzy destroying everything (mob / elephants / gunman)
groups.nuance_zh: storm: 携雷霆万钧之势发起攻击性猛冲 (capital / beach / fortress) · tear: 撕裂空气般不顾后果地高速飞奔 (down highway / across lawn) · barrel: 巨型重物般势不可挡地滚滚碾压推进 (truck / train / down road) · rip through: 摧枯拉朽般撕裂穿透整体防线或建筑 (neighborhood / flesh / hull) · rampage: 丧失理智般发狂暴走并沿路肆意破坏 (mob / elephants / gunman)

groups.name: Rank & Grade · 评估与定级 (Rank, Rate, Grade, Classify)
groups.tip: 考核品质并排列先后位次

items.def_en: To judge the value, quality, or ability of someone or something on a recognized numerical or qualitative scale
items.ex_en: Independent food critics universally rate this downtown bistro as one of the best.
items.ex_zh: 独立美食评论家一致将这家市中心的小酒馆评为最佳餐厅之一。

items.def_en: To separate or assign items into categories according to standard qualities, sizes, or performance levels
items.ex_en: Inspectors carefully grade the harvested apples by size and sweetness before shipment.
items.ex_zh: 质检员在发货前根据大小和甜度对采摘的苹果进行严格分级。

items.def_zh: 把……分等级，评定……的位次；名列，位居
items.def_en: 1. To assign someone or something to a specific position or grade in a hierarchy. 2. To hold a particular position or grade within a ranking system.
items.ex_en: The institution currently ranks among the top five research universities in the world.
items.ex_zh: 该学府目前位列全球排名前五的顶尖研究型大学之中。

items.def_en: To arrange or organize individuals, concepts, or goods into structured groups based on common traits
items.ex_en: Biologists classify these unique marine organisms according to their specific genetic structures.
items.ex_zh: 生物学家根据这些独特海洋生物特定的遗传结构对其进行分类。

items.def_en: To structure or arrange services, access, or products into distinct successive levels or tiers
items.ex_en: The telecom provider decided to tier its internet subscription packages by download speed.
items.ex_zh: 这家电信运营商决定按下载速度将其互联网套餐分层设置。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame deal with systematically evaluating people, entities, or items according to specific scales of merit, quality, or hierarchy, positioning them accordingly.
groups.summary_zh: 依据标准对主体进行量化评估，划分等级、名次或归属位阶。
groups.desc_en: Denotes systematically positioning entities along a hierarchical, qualitative, or categorical scale, contrasting with generic 'measure' through its comparative sorting against established benchmarks.
groups.desc_zh: 指依据既定标准将对象在等级序列中进行对比定位、定级或归类，区别于单纯孤立的“测量”。
groups.nuance_en: rate: evaluate intrinsic quality or value on a recognized numerical or descriptive scale (hotel / performance / risk) · grade: assign a standard classification level based on formal examination or purity (paper / meat / ore) · rank: arrange in linear order of precedence, superiority, or competitive standing (university / tennis player / priority) · classify: group into systematic taxonomic categories by shared attributes (species / documents / assets) · tier: organize into distinct, layered operational or pricing strata (services / subscriptions / architecture)
groups.nuance_zh: rate: 依基准评价打分并定出优劣高低 (hotel / performance / risk) · grade: 依硬性质量指标考核并分等评级 (paper / meat / ore) · rank: 按排位名次高低进行单线位次排序 (university / tennis player / priority) · classify: 按类别属性将事物归入分类体系 (species / documents / assets) · tier: 依服务级别或定价划分为多层次阶梯结构 (services / subscriptions / architecture)

groups.name: Ransom & Extort · 赎金扣押与索赎 (Hold to ransom, Buy off, Extort)
groups.tip: 付代价换回被扣财物人质

items.def_en: Keep someone captive in order to force others to meet financial or political demands
items.ex_en: Rebel militants threaten to hold hostages to ransom unless their demands are satisfied.
items.ex_zh: 叛军武装分子扬言要将人质扣为人质索要赎金，除非其诉求得到满足。

items.def_en: Pay someone money to stop them from causing trouble, demanding release, or prosecuting
items.ex_en: They attempted to buy off the primary witness with a large sum of cash.
items.ex_zh: 他们试图用巨额现金收买主要证人。

items.def_en: Pay money to secure the release of an accused person from custody before trial
items.ex_en: His wealthy uncle agreed to bail him out of jail after the arrest.
items.ex_zh: 他被捕后，他富有的叔叔同意出钱将他保释出狱。

items.def_en: 1. To pay money to free someone who has been captured or kidnapped. 2. To hold someone captive and demand money for their release.
items.ex_en: The diplomat's wealthy family paid millions of dollars to ransom him from kidnappers.
items.ex_zh: 这位外交官富有的家族支付了数百万美元，才将他从绑匪手中赎回。

items.def_en: Obtain money or concessions by coercion, threats of violence, or abuse of power
items.ex_en: Corrupt officials used forged documents to extort heavy bribes from local shop owners.
items.ex_zh: 腐败官员利用伪造的文件向当地店主敲诈巨额贿赂。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on coercive custody where captive persons or hijacked assets are released only upon monetary payoff or extortion demands.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及劫持人质或财产，以强制性支付换取其安全解脱。
groups.desc_en: Denotes using leverage, coercion, or financial payments to redeem hostages or compel compliance under duress, contrasting with honest 'trade' by its extortionate asymmetry.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过绑架人质或施加强制性威逼，勒索或支付赎金以解除人身扣押，区别于合法对等的“买卖”。
groups.nuance_en: hold to ransom: detain captives or critical assets to force crippling political/financial concessions (passengers / company / government) · buy off: corruptly pay someone to cease opposition or look the other way (officials / opposition / witness) · bail out: rescue financially or provide surety to secure temporary release (banks / defendant / economy) · ransom: obtain freedom of a captive by paying the demanded price (hostage / prince / crew) · extort: illicitly extract money or actions via blackmail, intimidation, or violence (confession / funds / protection money)
groups.nuance_zh: hold to ransom: 劫持人质或要挟关键资源以绑架敲诈 (passengers / company / government) · buy off: 贿赂收买对手使其放弃追责或阻挠 (officials / opposition / witness) · bail out: 缴保释金使人免除羁押，或财政注资脱困 (banks / defendant / economy) · ransom: 支付赎金赎回被扣押人质 (hostage / prince / crew) · extort: 施加威胁勒索不当利益或逼供 (confession / funds / protection money)

groups.name: Rationalize & Excuse · 辩解与开脱 (Rationalize, Justify, Excuse)
groups.tip: 找寻合理化理由为行为开脱

items.def_en: To provide reasons to reduce the blame or responsibility attached to an offense
items.ex_en: Severe winter weather cannot entirely excuse your repeated failure to deliver the project.
items.ex_zh: 恶劣的冬季天气并不能完全为你屡次未能按时交付项目开脱。

items.def_en: To make a mistake, offense, or wrongdoing seem less serious by providing mitigating context
items.ex_en: The harsh circumstances might extenuate his hasty crime, but cannot clear him entirely.
items.ex_zh: 严峻的处境或许能减轻他一时冲动之罪，但不能完全免除其责任。

items.def_en: To give reasons why a fault, mistake, or doubtful behavior is not as bad as it seems
items.ex_en: He tried to explain away the budget deficit, but no one bought his excuses.
items.ex_zh: 他试图为预算赤字百般辩解，但没人相信他的借口。

items.def_en: To provide a good reason or acceptable explanation for an action that others might criticize
items.ex_en: The manager struggled to justify the exorbitant expenditures during the annual shareholder review.
items.ex_zh: 在年度股东审查期间，经理极力证明这些过高开支的正当性。

items.def_zh: 为……找借口辩解；使合理化，精简整顿
items.def_en: 1. To invent reasons to justify an action or belief. 2. To restructure a company or organization to improve efficiency.
items.ex_en: He desperately attempted to rationalise his dishonest conduct by blaming high corporate pressure.
items.ex_zh: 他极力把自己的不诚实行为归咎于公司的高压，以此为自己找借口。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers cognitive and verbal acts of making questionable, selfish, or erroneous behavior seem acceptable, logical, or blameless. Verbs range from internally inventing self-serving explanations to formally pleading extenuating circumstances.
groups.summary_zh: 强调为不当或自私行为寻找借口、使之合理化的言行。
groups.desc_en: Denotes offering intellectual reasons or mitigating grounds to palliate an error or breach of conduct, contrasting with rigorous 'prove' by its exculpatory, face-saving intention.
groups.desc_zh: 指寻找理由或借口为过错与失当行为辩解开脱，区别于以严密证据为核心的客观“证明”。
groups.nuance_en: excuse: forgive, overlook, or seek to release from moral blame (behavior / delay / absence) · extenuate: lessen the perceived seriousness of an offense through mitigating circumstances (crime / guilt / circumstances) · explain away: dispose of an embarrassing flaw or blunder with slick explanations (discrepancy / deficit / failure) · justify: show good, defensible reasons to prove an action was right or lawful (decision / use of force / cost) · rationalise: fabricate superficially logical, comforting pretexts for irrational behavior (defeat / indulgence / conduct)
groups.nuance_zh: excuse: 请求原谅宽恕，或为缺席过失找借口 (behavior / delay / absence) · extenuate: 凭借情有可原的特殊情节减轻罪责 (crime / guilt / circumstances) · explain away: 轻描淡写地将尴尬失误搪塞圆场过去 (discrepancy / deficit / failure) · justify: 阐述正当理由力证某做法合情合法 (decision / use of force / cost) · rationalise: 事后为不当或非理性行为构筑貌似合理的托词 (defeat / indulgence / conduct)

groups.name: Rationalize & Self-Justify · 辩解与合理化 (Explain away, Sugarcoat, Gloss over)
groups.tip: 为自身行为找合理理由

items.def_en: to make something dubious or objectionable seem acceptable, lawful, or proper
items.ex_en: The corrupt regime attempted to legitimize its disputed election victory through controlled media.
items.ex_zh: 这个腐败政权试图通过受控的媒体为其备受争议的选举胜利赋予合法性。

items.def_en: to give an explanation that minimizes, dismisses, or excuses a fault or questionable action
items.ex_en: He tried to explain away the budget deficit, but no one bought his excuses.
items.ex_zh: 他试图为预算赤字百般辩解，但没人相信他的借口。

items.def_en: to deliberately treat an unpleasant mistake or offense as trivial to deflect censure
items.ex_en: The spokesperson attempted to gloss over the catastrophic security breach during the interview.
items.ex_zh: 该发言人在接受采访时试图对那次灾难性的安全漏洞轻描淡写地掩盖过去。

items.def_zh: 为……辩解，找理由合理化；使合理化，精简整顿
items.def_en: 1. To invent plausible but false reasons to explain or excuse one's behavior. 2. To make an organization or system more efficient and logical.
items.ex_en: The disgraced executive tried to rationalize his unethical choices during the public inquiry.
items.ex_zh: 那位身败名裂的高管在公开听证会上试图为自己不道德的选择辩解。

items.def_en: to conceal or exonerate errors, misconduct, or atrocities through biased presentation
items.ex_en: The official report seemed designed solely to whitewash the serious safety violations.
items.ex_zh: 这份官方报告似乎完全是为了粉饰掩盖严重的违规安全问题而设计的。

groups.summary_en: Involves cognitive self-deception or linguistic manipulation to make dubious, selfish, or blameworthy actions appear acceptable and logical. It emphasizes superficial justification over genuine truth.
groups.summary_zh: 指在认知或言辞上寻找看似合理的借口，以美化或开脱不当行径。
groups.desc_en: Denotes disingenuously reinterpreting moral failings or misdeeds to mask wrongdoing and preserve self-respect, contrasting with objective 'clarify' through its deceitful, self-serving varnish.
groups.desc_zh: 指对自身过失或污点进行虚饰、粉饰与自欺欺人的合理化，区别于求真务实的“澄清”。
groups.nuance_en: legitimize: confer an aura of official, moral, or legal validity upon questionable acts (claim / regime / power) · explain away: minimize damaging facts until they seem harmless or negligible (mistake / symptom / warning) · gloss over: treat grave flaws with superficial brevity to avoid scrutiny (defects / atrocities / details) · rationalize: invent self-deceiving intellectual justifications for selfish conduct (greed / hypocrisy / failure) · whitewash: systematically suppress scandals and paint over grave wrongdoing (report / record / history)
groups.nuance_zh: legitimize: 为本不正当的行径披上合宪合法的合法外衣 (claim / regime / power) · explain away: 巧舌如簧地淡化不利证据以消弭质疑 (mistake / symptom / warning) · gloss over: 浮光掠影带过以掩盖核心硬伤 (defects / atrocities / details) · rationalize: 内心自我合理化以化解认知失调与负罪感 (greed / hypocrisy / failure) · whitewash: 彻底洗白、蓄意掩盖劣迹丑闻 (report / record / history)

groups.name: Rationalize & Streamline · 精简与优化提效 (Streamline, Rationalize, Trim down)
groups.tip: 精简流线以消减阻力工序

items.def_en: To adapt, refine, or configure a system or process to make it as effective and functional as possible
items.ex_en: Engineers spent months working to optimize system performance for the next hardware release.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们花了数月时间优化系统性能，以备下一代硬件的发布。

items.def_zh: 削减，精简（冗余开支或人员）
items.def_en: To reduce the size, costs, or components of something in order to make it leaner and more economical
items.ex_en: The startup must trim down its operating expenses to survive the upcoming winter.
items.ex_zh: 这家初创公司必须精简其运营开支，才能熬过即将到来的寒冬。

items.def_zh: 精简，使合理化；使成流线型
items.def_en: 1. To make an organization, process, or system simpler, faster, and more efficient. 2. To design a vehicle or aircraft with a smooth, streamlined shape.
items.ex_en: Management introduced specialized software to streamline customer inquiries and reduce response times.
items.ex_zh: 管理层引入了专用软件来精简客户咨询流程并缩短响应时间。

items.def_en: To identify and eliminate restrictions or delays in a process or operational flow
items.ex_en: Engineers redesigned the assembly line to de-bottleneck manufacturing during peak seasonal demand.
items.ex_zh: 工程师重新设计了装配线，以在季节性需求高峰期消除制造瓶颈。

items.def_zh: 合理化，重组以提高效益
items.def_en: To reorganize an organization or operational process to eliminate superfluous parts and improve efficiency
items.ex_en: The struggling corporation decided to rationalize its manufacturing operations across all regional divisions.
items.ex_zh: 这家陷入困境的跨国公司决定合理化重组其所有地区分支机构的制造业务。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote reorganizing processes, operations, or structures to eliminate bottlenecks, cut waste, and boost productivity. The emphasis is on structural lean-making, procedural speed, and modern efficiency.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重对流程、体系或机构进行结构性裁汰多余环节，提高运作效率。
groups.desc_en: Denotes restructuring systems or operations to eliminate redundancies and maximize economic efficiency, contrasting with blunt 'cut' by its deliberate, value-maximizing architecture.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过重组流程与精简冗余以最大化组织或产业的运营效率，区别于盲目粗暴的“削减”。
groups.nuance_en: optimize: fine-tune settings or parameters for maximal performance output (algorithm / yield / resource) · trim down: prune excess baggage or fat without redesigning core structures (workforce / budget / waistline) · streamline: eliminate bottlenecks and redundancies to make a workflow fluid (process / operations / bureaucracy) · de-bottleneck: identify and clear the single critical constriction choking throughput (system / pipeline / supply chain) · rationalize: re-engineer an entire fleet, product line, or workforce on cold economic logic (business / portfolio / capacity)
groups.nuance_zh: optimize: 调优参数以挖掘现有系统的最大效能 (algorithm / yield / resource) · trim down: 裁撤多余赘物以减重瘦身 (workforce / budget / waistline) · streamline: 理顺工作流、拔除官僚冗余使其高效流畅 (process / operations / bureaucracy) · de-bottleneck: 定点清除制约通量的最关键瓶颈环节 (system / pipeline / supply chain) · rationalize: 依经济效益重组产线或关闭亏损单位以实现结构精简 (business / portfolio / capacity)

groups.name: Reach Highest Point · 达到极点与高潮 (Peak, Culminate, Climax)
groups.tip: 发展攀升至最高点或高潮

items.def_en: to bring something to an appropriate, impressive, or climactic conclusion
items.ex_en: The legendary striker managed to cap his brilliant career with a championship victory.
items.ex_zh: 这位传奇前锋以一场冠军胜利为自己辉煌的职业生涯画上了圆满句号。

items.def_en: to reach the highest point, level, or value
items.ex_en: Electricity consumption is expected to peak during the sweltering heat of late July.
items.ex_zh: 用电量预计将在7月下旬酷暑难耐的高温期达到峰值。

items.def_en: to reach the highest point or level of a wave, trend, or development
items.ex_en: Public enthusiasm for the populist movement had crested before the autumn general election.
items.ex_zh: 公众对这场民粹运动的热情在秋季大选前就已涌至顶峰。

items.def_zh: 达到高潮，达到顶峰；以……告终
items.def_en: to reach the highest point, climax, or decisive final result after a series of events
items.ex_en: Months of intensive bilateral diplomatic negotiations will culminate in a formal peace treaty.
items.ex_zh: 数月紧张的双边外交谈判最终将以达成正式和平条约而告终。

items.def_en: to reach or bring something to the most exciting, important, or highest point
items.ex_en: The symphony orchestra performed brilliantly to climax the annual summer music festival.
items.ex_zh: 交响乐团的精彩演奏将年度夏季音乐节推向了最高潮。
items.ex2_en: The dramatic stage performance climaxed with a stunning display of fireworks.
items.ex2_zh: 戏剧性的舞台表演以一场绚丽的烟花秀达到最高潮。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express a process, state, or event rising to its utmost intensity, completion, or decisive high point after a progressive buildup.
groups.summary_zh: 表示事物随时间或历程累积递增，最终攀升至最高峰、终局或高潮时刻。
groups.desc_en: Denotes arriving at the absolute apex, summit, or decisive final breakthrough of an ascending progression, contrasting with mere 'finish' by its supreme developmental intensity.
groups.desc_zh: 指事物在发展、积累过程中攀升至顶点、顶峰或最高潮，区别于中途停摆的普通“结束”。
groups.nuance_en: cap: deliberately put a crowning seal, limit, or finish upon a series of feats (career / season / spending) · peak: touch the highest numerical level before declining (demand / inflation / production) · crest: reach the frothy summit of a physical or metaphorical wave before breaking (wave / popularity / hill) · culminate: conclude a long, sustained developmental buildup in a crowning result (effort / series / investigation) · climax: explode into the most dramatic, ecstatic final emotional or narrative peak (plot / celebration / performance)
groups.nuance_zh: cap: 为辉煌历程加上冠冕，或设定上限封顶 (career / season / spending) · peak: 指标或需求达到全周期数值峰值 (demand / inflation / production) · crest: 如浪潮或潮头般达到最高顶峰 (wave / popularity / hill) · culminate: 经长期聚力蓄势后最终达至高潮并收官 (effort / series / investigation) · climax: 叙事或情感发展到戏剧张力的最顶点爆发 (plot / celebration / performance)

groups.name: Reactivate & Restore · 激活与恢复 (Reactivate, Reinstate, Revive)
groups.tip: 从静止再次启动运转

items.def_en: To provide a strong initial push to help an inactive system or stagnant process get underway
items.ex_en: The government launched tax incentives to kick-start sluggish consumer spending this quarter.
items.ex_zh: 政府推出了税收激励措施，以在这一季度有力拉动低迷的消费支出。

items.def_en: To bring something back to life, consciousness, popular usage, or operational strength
items.ex_en: The local council launched an ambitious project to revive the historic downtown economy.
items.ex_zh: 地方委员会启动了一项雄心勃勃的项目，以复兴历史悠久的市中心经济。
items.ex2_en: Dying traditions revive spontaneously when younger generations take active interest in heritage.
items.ex2_zh: 当年轻一代对传统文化产生积极兴趣时，濒危的传统便会自发复兴。

items.def_en: To restart a computational system or relaunch an existing operation or program from scratch
items.ex_en: The beleaguered theater company attempted to reboot its signature production for modern audiences.
items.ex_zh: 这家陷入困境的剧团试图为当代观众彻底重组并开展其代表剧目。
items.ex2_en: The automated server will reboot automatically once software updates complete installing.
items.ex2_zh: 一旦软件更新安装完成，自动化服务器就会自动重启。

items.def_en: To restore someone or something to a previous position, post, or authorized condition
items.ex_en: The board voted unanimously to reinstate the wrongfully dismissed director with full back pay.
items.ex_zh: 董事会一致投票决定恢复那位被错误解雇的负责人的职位，并补发全部工资。

items.def_en: 1. To make an account, machine, dormant virus, or military unit active again.
items.ex_en: The bank required additional identity verification before it could reactivate her suspended account.
items.ex_zh: 银行要求先进行额外的身份核验，然后才能重新激活她被冻结的账户。
items.ex2_en: Dormant viral pathogens can reactivate unpredictably when the human immune system weakens.
items.ex2_zh: 当人体免疫系统减弱时，休眠的病毒病原体可能会不可预测地再次活跃。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on restoring dormant, suspended, or inactive operations, systems, rights, or mechanisms back into active functional service.
groups.summary_zh: 指重启停滞或休眠的系统、账户、机制并恢复其运作。
groups.desc_en: Denotes bringing an inactive, suspended, or lapsed process, rule, or mechanism back into operational life, contrasting with first-time 'create' by its restorative continuity.
groups.desc_zh: 指使休眠、中止或废止的机制、系统或权利重新恢复运转，区别于从无到有的全新“创建”。
groups.nuance_en: kick-start: apply sudden external energetic stimulus to ignite a stalled system (economy / talks / engine) · revive: breathe conscious life or vitality back into a languishing subject (tradition / consciousness / industry) · reboot: completely shut down and restart a technological or institutional franchise (computer / brand / series) · reinstate: formally restore a deposed person, dismissed law, or policy to official status (privilege / official / policy) · reactivate: switch a dormant account, weapon, or operational protocol back on (account / volcano / cell)
groups.nuance_zh: kick-start: 施加外力强劲启动处于停滞状态的系统 (economy / talks / engine) · revive: 给衰退或昏迷的事物重新注入生气活力 (tradition / consciousness / industry) · reboot: 彻底重置并重新启动软硬件或IP品牌 (computer / brand / series) · reinstate: 官复原职或依法恢复已被废止的权益与政策 (privilege / official / policy) · reactivate: 唤醒休眠状态的账户、组织网络或装置 (account / volcano / cell)

groups.name: Read & Scrutinize · 阅读与细读研读 (Scan, Peruse, Pore over)
groups.tip: 从字面浏览到精细研读

items.def_en: To read quickly over a surface or text, noting only the salient points and headings
items.ex_en: She took a few minutes to skim the chapter headings before the lecture.
items.ex_zh: 她在讲座开始前花了几分钟略读了各章节的标题。

items.def_en: To look through a text rapidly in order to locate specific information or get a general impression
items.ex_en: He quickly scanned the crowded arrival board to locate his sister's incoming flight.
items.ex_zh: 他快速扫视拥挤的到达显示牌，以寻找他妹妹乘坐的入境航班。

items.def_zh: 阅读，朗读；理解，领会；显示，读数为
items.def_en: 1. To look at and understand the meaning of written or printed words. 2. To understand or interpret something in a particular way. 3. (of an instrument) To show or register a specific measurement or value.
items.ex_en: She sat quietly by the window to read the morning newspaper before work.
items.ex_zh: 上班前，她静静地坐在窗边阅读晨报。

items.def_en: To read or examine written material with thorough care, attention, and diligence
items.ex_en: The attorney took several hours to peruse the lengthy contract before advising his client.
items.ex_zh: 律师在为客户提供建议之前，花了好几个小时仔细审阅那份冗长的合同。

items.def_en: To examine, study, or read printed words with intense absorption and meticulous concentration
items.ex_en: The detectives continued to pore over the dense financial records late into the night.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们直到深夜仍在全神贯注地研读那些繁复的财务记录。

groups.summary_en: This frame spans the spectrum of text processing, from superficial glancing and rapid skimming to deep, analytical, and exhaustive textual examination. Nuances center on depth of concentration.
groups.summary_zh: 由粗略浏览到字斟句酌地研读文字材料。
groups.desc_en: Denotes deciphering written text across a spectrum of attentional depth, contrasting with mere ocular 'look' through cognitive comprehension, appraisal, and textual engagement.
groups.desc_zh: 指对书面文字进行不同精细程度的视觉解码与认知研读，区别于走马观花的眼部“看”。
groups.nuance_en: skim: run eyes rapidly over a text only to catch the main gist (article / headlines / chapter) · scan: search a text briskly to locate a specific keyword or data point (barcode / horizon / list) · read: decode and comprehend textual content at normal, attentive speed (book / contract / sign) · peruse: read through completely with attentive, dignified care (report / menu / catalog) · pore over: bend over and scrutinize every minute detail with intense scholarly focus (maps / manuscripts / accounts)
groups.nuance_zh: skim: 浮光掠影快速掠读以捕捉大意梗概 (article / headlines / chapter) · scan: 带着靶向目标迅速扫视寻找特定字眼 (barcode / horizon / list) · read: 标准、专注地通读并理解文本内容 (book / contract / sign) · peruse: 慢条斯理、由头至尾地从容阅览品读 (report / menu / catalog) · pore over: 伏案弓身、极度专注地逐字研读审查 (maps / manuscripts / accounts)
