groups.name: Reaffirm & Uphold · 重申与确认 (Reaffirm, Reiterate, Restate)
groups.tip: 再次确证并重申既定立场

items.def_zh: 重申；换个方式重新表述
items.def_en: To state something again or in a different way, especially to emphasize a position
items.ex_en: The ambassador took care to restate her country's firm position regarding the disputed border.
items.ex_zh: 大使特意重申了本国关于争议边界的坚定立场。

items.def_en: To state a fact or belief firmly, confidently, and forcefully
items.ex_en: The spokesperson continued to assert the company's complete innocence despite mounting public skepticism.
items.ex_zh: 尽管公众质疑与日俱增，发言人仍坚决断言公司完全是清白的。

items.def_en: To say something again or several times, typically to emphasize or make it completely clear
items.ex_en: The minister used the press briefing to reiterate the administration's zero-tolerance policy on corruption.
items.ex_zh: 部长借新闻发布会再次重申了政府对腐败的零容忍政策。

items.def_en: To defend, confirm, or maintain a law, principle, or previous legal decision as valid
items.ex_en: The appellate judges agreed to uphold the lower court's ruling in the patent dispute.
items.ex_zh: 上诉法官一致同意在专利纠纷中维持下级法院的判决。

items.def_en: to state something again strongly and clearly to confirm a belief, agreement, or decision
items.ex_en: Both nations issued a joint statement to reaffirm their long-standing mutual defense treaty.
items.ex_zh: 两国发表联合声明，重申他们长期以来的共同防御条约。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express speaking, declaring, or confirming an allegiance, promise, or conviction with renewed force, clarity, and authority.
groups.summary_zh: 指以坚决明确的口吻再次陈述、强化或确认既有的立场与原则。
groups.desc_en: Asserting or validating a position, value, or statement again to bolster legitimacy, contrasting with mere repeating by carrying deliberate rhetorical endorsement or judicial defense.
groups.desc_zh: 再次断言或确认某种立场、价值或陈述以巩固其正当性，与单纯的“重复”不同，它带有刻意的修辞强化或司法/道义维稳色彩。
groups.nuance_en: restate: rephrasing or saying again plainly (intent / terms) · assert: stating forcefully as a fact (dominance / innocence) · reiterate: repeating emphatically for clarity or warning (warning / point) · uphold: defending or confirming the validity of an existing rule or ruling (verdict / tradition) · reaffirm: formally renewing an existing pledge or conviction (commitment / faith)
groups.nuance_zh: restate: 换言或清晰重申 (intent / terms) · assert: 强力宣称或主张 (dominance / innocence) · reiterate: 强调性反复重提 (warning / point) · uphold: 司法或道义上维持原判/维护 (verdict / tradition) · reaffirm: 庄严确认或再次坚定 (commitment / faith)

groups.name: Realize & Perceive · 察觉与顿悟 (Grasp, Fathom, Dawn on)
groups.tip: 从感官觉察到心中恍然大悟

items.def_en: To suddenly or gradually become perceived or understood by someone after initial oblivion
items.ex_en: It slowly began to dawn on him that he had left his keys inside.
items.ex_zh: 他渐渐意识到，自己把钥匙落在屋里了。

items.raw_cluster: 察觉与意识到 Realize & Perceive
items.def_zh: 领悟，认识到，意识到；实现；变卖为现款
items.def_en: 1. To become fully aware of something as a fact; to understand clearly. 2. To achieve or bring into reality something planned or hoped for. 3. To convert an asset into cash.
items.ex_en: The researchers began to realize the profound historical significance of their unexpected archaeological discovery.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员开始清楚地认识到他们意外的考古发现所具有的深远历史意义。

items.def_en: To comprehend or understand a complex fact, idea, or implication thoroughly
items.ex_en: The novice investor struggled to grasp the complex dynamics of the foreign exchange market.
items.ex_zh: 这名新手投资者难以透彻领会外汇市场的复杂动态。

items.def_en: To perceive, recognize, or become mentally conscious of the nature or meaning of something
items.ex_en: She could readily apprehend the subtle nuances behind his seemingly cordial greeting.
items.ex_zh: 她能轻易意会到他那看似亲切的问候背后的微妙用意。

items.def_en: To penetrate into the underlying meaning of something puzzling and understand it completely
items.ex_en: Historians have long struggled to fathom the enigmatic motives behind the emperor's sudden abdication.
items.ex_zh: 历史学家长期以来都难以洞悉那位皇帝突然退位背后的神秘动机。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this intensity frame capture the mental transition from unawareness or incomprehension to full clarity, comprehension, and conscious awareness.
groups.summary_zh: 意识由模糊转变为主观上的清晰洞悉与顿悟领会。
groups.desc_en: Transitioning from ignorance to mental comprehension of a truth or condition, distinguishing itself from sensory perception by emphasizing cognitive internalization and depth.
groups.desc_zh: 由未知或忽视转向对事实、真相或深层意涵的认知领会，与单纯的“感官察觉”不同，它侧重于心智内化与理解深度。
groups.nuance_en: dawn on: sudden spontaneous realization breaking into consciousness (truth / reality) · realize: general conscious awakening to an existing fact (mistake / ambition) · grasp: seizing mental hold of complex mechanics (concept / significance) · apprehend: mentally perceiving or dreading an impending reality (danger / meaning) · fathom: penetrating deeply to comprehend an elusive or profound mystery (motive / mystery)
groups.nuance_zh: dawn on: 灵光乍现般顿悟 (truth / reality) · realize: 一般性意识到客观事实 (mistake / ambition) · grasp: 领悟抓住复杂概念或重要性 (concept / significance) · apprehend: 感知领会或忧虑预知 (danger / meaning) · fathom: 彻底测透或探究晦涩深意 (motive / mystery)

groups.name: Receive & Accept · 接收与接纳 (Receive, Accept, Take in)
groups.tip: 收下并获得送来的物品

items.def_zh: 收到，接到；接纳，接待；遭受，承受
items.def_en: 1. To get or accept something that is sent, given, or offered. 2. To welcome or formally greet guests or visitors. 3. To experience or be given a particular kind of treatment or injury.
items.ex_en: The ambassador will receive international dignitaries at the grand banquet hall this evening.
items.ex_zh: 大使今晚将在宏伟的宴会厅接见各国政要。

items.def_zh: 接受，接纳；同意，认可；承认，承担
items.def_en: 1. To agree to take or receive something offered. 2. To believe, agree with, or approve of something. 3. To take responsibility for something.
items.ex_en: After careful consideration, the committee decided to accept the proposed revisions to the bylaws.
items.ex_zh: 经过仔细考虑，委员会决定接受对章程提出的修改建议。

items.def_zh: 将…装入口袋，收下（钱财或物品）
items.def_en: to take or accept money or small items, sometimes inappropriately
items.ex_en: The cashier was dismissed after he was caught trying to pocket customer tips.
items.ex_zh: 收银员在被发现试图将顾客小费据为己有后被解雇了。

items.def_en: to formally report or confirm that one has received something
items.ex_en: The department secretary will promptly acknowledge the receipt of your formal complaint letter.
items.ex_zh: 部门秘书将及时确认收到您的正式投诉函。

items.def_en: to receive deliveries, items, or lodgers into one's home or care
items.ex_en: She kindly agreed to take in several heavy parcels for her traveling neighbors.
items.ex_zh: 她热心地答应替外出旅行的邻居代收几件沉重的包裹。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate taking delivery of or willingly consenting to hold goods, payments, or communications provided by another party.
groups.summary_zh: 指收取他人送来或交付的物品、款项或信息，并予以收下或同意持有。
groups.desc_en: Taking or admitting incoming items, messages, or people into one's possession or consideration, differing from active acquiring by starting with external submission.
groups.desc_zh: 将外部送达的人、物或信息纳入自身持有或考量之中，与主动“获取”不同，其认知起点在于外部的给予或提交。
groups.nuance_en: receive: neutral physical or formal incoming intake (package / award) · accept: willing or favorable agreement to take (offer / invitation) · pocket: discreetly or illicitly taking for oneself (bribe / cash) · acknowledge: officially confirming receipt or validity (letter / receipt) · take in: absorbing, sheltering, or cognitively processing (lodger / information)
groups.nuance_zh: receive: 中性被动地接收或收到 (package / award) · accept: 主动欣然接受或认可 (offer / invitation) · pocket: 顺手私吞或隐蔽收入囊中 (bribe / cash) · acknowledge: 正式确认收讫或承认 (letter / receipt) · take in: 接纳庇护或心智吸收理解 (lodger / information)

groups.name: Reciprocal Exchange & Mutual Return · 互换与互惠回报 (Reciprocate, Interchange, Requite)
groups.tip: 双方互换位置或以物易物

items.def_zh: 相互交换（意见、目光、言语）
items.def_en: [I/T] to exchange remarks, insults, or glances back and forth between each other
items.ex_en: The rival candidates continued to trade sharp accusations throughout the intense televised debate.
items.ex_zh: 在激烈的电视辩论中，两位竞争对手不断相互进行尖锐的指责。

items.def_en: to show appreciation or make return for a kind action, feeling, or favor
items.ex_en: He hoped to repay their extraordinary hospitality by hosting a lavish farewell dinner.
items.ex_zh: 他希望通过举办一场丰盛的告别晚宴来报答他们非同寻常的热情好客。

items.def_zh: （使）互相交换，互换位置；交替，轮换
items.def_en: to exchange things with each other, or alternate in sequence.
items.ex_en: The two researchers would frequently interchange experimental duties during the lengthy laboratory trial.
items.ex_zh: 在漫长的实验室试验期间，两位研究人员经常互换实验职责。
items.ex2_en: The seasonal patterns interchange continuously between severe droughts and torrential downpours.
items.ex2_zh: 季节性格局在严重干旱与倾盆大雨之间不断交替。

items.def_zh: 回报，报答；互换；往复运动
items.def_en: 1. to return a favor, feeling, or action in kind. 2. (of a machine part) to move backwards and forwards alternately.
items.ex_en: The diplomat expressed genuine hope that neighboring states would reciprocate the goodwill gestures.
items.ex_zh: 这位外交官真诚地希望邻国能对这些善意举动作出同等回报。

items.def_zh: 报答，回报（恩情、关爱或怨恨）
items.def_en: to make an appropriate return for a favor, service, or affection (often formal or literary)
items.ex_en: The devoted knight vowed to requite the profound kindness shown by his sovereign.
items.ex_zh: 忠诚的骑士誓要报答君王所展现的深厚恩情。

groups.summary_en: Centers on mutual and corresponding give-and-take in relationships, sentiments, or standardized items. 'Interchange' emphasizes reciprocal switching or alternating of items or ideas, whereas 'reciprocate' and 'requite' emphasize answering a received favor, feeling, or action in kind.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重双向对等回馈、情感或行为的投桃报李及对等互换。
groups.desc_en: Two-way transfer or commensurate return of benefits, harms, or items between parties, distinguishing from unilateral giving by inherent expectations of equivalence or balance.
groups.desc_zh: 双方之间互换利益、损害或物品，不同于单向“给予”，其核心在于内在的等价期待或报偿平衡。
groups.nuance_en: trade: commercial swapping of commodities or assets (shares / insults) · repay: returning an equivalent debt or deed (loan / kindness) · interchange: swapping places or components systematically (ideas / roles) · reciprocate: returning equivalent sentiments, favors, or actions (hospitality / affection) · requite: formal or poetic repaying of emotional or moral dues (love / service)
groups.nuance_zh: trade: 商业性互换或以牙还牙 (shares / insults) · repay: 偿还债务或恩仇 (loan / kindness) · interchange: 规范性相互轮转互换 (ideas / roles) · reciprocate: 礼尚往来或对等回应 (hospitality / affection) · requite: 郑重/文雅地回报或报答 (love / service)

groups.name: Reckless Velocity & Uncontrolled Speed · 疾驰与失控狂奔 (Speed, Career, Tear)
groups.tip: 高速不受控地狂奔

items.def_en: (+ down/along) to move with frantic, reckless, and uncontrolled speed
items.ex_en: We watched the panicked youth tear down the street toward the subway station.
items.ex_zh: 我们看着那个惊慌失措的年轻人沿着街道向地铁站狂奔而去。

items.def_en: To move forward at high speed in an uncontrolled and dangerous manner.
items.ex_en: The driverless vehicle began to career wildly across the icy bridge toward disaster.
items.ex_zh: 这辆无人驾驶的汽车在结冰的桥面上失控疾驰，直奔险境。

items.def_zh: 疾行，飞驰；超速驾驶；加速，促进
items.def_en: 1. To move along very quickly. 2. To drive a motor vehicle faster than the legal speed limit. 3. To cause to move faster or accelerate.
items.ex_en: He was heavily fined after officers caught him speeding through the school zone.
items.ex_zh: 在被警官抓到在学校区域超速驾驶后，他被处以巨额罚款。

items.def_en: to move violently with tremendous force and dangerous velocity
items.ex_en: The massive locomotive hurtles along the precarious mountain tracks through the howling blizzard.
items.ex_zh: 巨大的机车在呼啸的暴风雪中沿着险峻的山间铁轨猛冲疾驰。

items.def_zh: 摇晃狂奔；倾斜失控地疾驰
items.def_en: to hurtle forward while swaying dangerously and swerving out of control
items.ex_en: The overloaded coach began to careen downhill toward the sharp bend without brakes.
items.ex_zh: 超载的大客车在刹车失灵的情况下摇晃失控地向急转弯处疾驰冲去。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this scale depict high velocity progressing from intentional swift driving to precarious, wild, and violently uncontrolled runaway motion.
groups.summary_zh: 从单纯超速平稳疾行递进至失控、癫狂前冲的危险速度梯次。
groups.desc_en: Moving at extreme, dangerous velocity often paired with a loss of steering or trajectory control, contrasting with mere fast movement by its chaotic peril.
groups.desc_zh: 以极高且危险的速度移动，通常伴随转向失控或脱轨风险，与一般的“快速移动”相比充满失控与混乱危机。
groups.nuance_en: tear: ripping recklessly and violently through space (highway / street) · career: swerving wildly out of control at high speed (downhill / slope) · speed: basic high-rate forward movement exceeding safe limits (freeway / corridor) · hurtles: flying forward violently with massive unstoppable momentum (asteroid / train) · careen: tilting, leaning, and rocking erratically while moving fast (corner / lane)
groups.nuance_zh: tear: 狂暴撕裂空间般疾驰 (highway / street) · career: 高速失控打滑狂奔 (downhill / slope) · speed: 超速或高速行驶 (freeway / corridor) · hurtles: 挟带巨大动能猛冲 (asteroid / train) · careen: 疾驰中摇摆颠簸倾斜 (corner / lane)

groups.name: Recommit & Rededicate · 重申承诺与再赋责 (Recommit, Rededicate, Reaffirm)
groups.tip: 再次许下承诺并竭力履行

items.def_zh: 续展，重振更新（誓言/协议）
items.def_en: To restore, re-establish, or repeat a formal pledge, vow, or contractual relationship
items.ex_en: The two allied countries agreed to renew their bilateral trade agreement next spring.
items.ex_zh: 两个盟国同意在明年春季续签其双边贸易协定。

items.def_zh: 重申（誓言/承诺），再次确认
items.def_en: To state emphatically again that one remains firmly dedicated to a commitment, belief, or policy
items.ex_en: The prime minister stood before parliament to reaffirm his binding pledge against tax hikes.
items.ex_zh: 首相在议会前重申了他绝不上调税收的具有约束力的承诺。

items.def_zh: 加倍下注，坚定强化既定立场
items.def_en: (+ on) To strengthen one's commitment to a risky strategy, stance, or policy despite pushback
items.ex_en: Instead of apologizing for the controversial remark, the politician doubled down on it.
items.ex_zh: 这位政客非但没有为自己的争议言论道歉，反而在原立场上更加强硬。

items.def_zh: 重新致力于，再次承诺；将（法案等）重新提交委员会审议
items.def_en: 1. To commit or dedicate oneself again to a cause, principle, or course of action. 2. To refer a bill or proposal back to a committee for further consideration.
items.ex_en: World leaders gathered in Geneva to recommit their nations to the global climate pact.
items.ex_zh: 各国领导人齐聚日内瓦，使各自国家再次致力于遵守全球气候协定。

items.def_en: To pledge oneself, one's energy, or resources anew to a particular mission, cause, or belief
items.ex_en: The aging volunteers chose to rededicate themselves to the community literacy project this year.
items.ex_zh: 年长的志愿者们选择在今年再次全身心奉献于社区识字项目。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on revitalizing previous obligations, formally reaffirming devotion to an ideal, or returning institutional mandates to committee review.
groups.summary_zh: 重新确立责任信念、再次表态投入或重审议案。
groups.desc_en: Formally or resolutely renewing one's dedication to a cause, duty, or belief after doubt or lapse, contrasting with baseline dedication by its conscious rebooting of allegiance.
groups.desc_zh: 在动摇、松懈或变故后，再次郑重宣誓并投入某项事业或信仰，与初次“奉献”不同，其核心是主观誓约的重置与强化。
groups.nuance_en: renew: restoring freshness or validity to an existing bond (vow / contract) · reaffirm: declaring loyalty or truth firmly once more (faith / commitment) · double down: defiantly intensifying commitment despite criticism (strategy / rhetoric) · recommit: resolving anew to allocate resources or efforts (resources / effort) · rededicate: solemn, often spiritual re-consecration to a mission (life / energy)
groups.nuance_zh: renew: 使既有誓约或关系焕新 (vow / contract) · reaffirm: 再次明确宣誓忠诚或信念 (faith / commitment) · double down: 顶住外界质疑加倍下注坚守 (strategy / rhetoric) · recommit: 重新下定决心投入精力 (resources / effort) · rededicate: 庄重再奉献于崇高使命 (life / energy)

groups.name: Record & Identify · 采证与鉴定 (DNA-profile, Log, Catalog)
groups.tip: 提取指纹痕迹用于身份核验

items.def_en: To officially register the personal details and criminal charges of a suspect in police custody
items.ex_en: The arresting officers proceeded to book the suspect on two counts of burglary.
items.ex_zh: 实施逮捕的警官随后以两项入室盗窃罪名对嫌疑人进行了立案登记。

items.def_en: To write down or enter forensic data or incidents systematically in an official record
items.ex_en: The duty officer must carefully log every unusual incident during the night patrol.
items.ex_zh: 值班警官必须认真记录夜间巡逻期间发生的每一起异常事件。

items.def_en: To analyze and record someone's distinctive DNA characteristics for criminal identification
items.ex_en: Forensic specialists were instructed to DNA-profile the biological material recovered from the crime scene.
items.ex_zh: 法医专家奉命对从犯罪现场提取的生物样本进行DNA图谱分析。

items.def_en: To record an item or evidence systematically in an inventory or registry
items.ex_en: The archivist began to systematically catalog the rare historical documents donated last month.
items.ex_zh: 档案管理员开始系统地编目归档上个月捐赠的珍贵历史文献。

items.def_zh: 采集……的指纹，提取……的指纹
items.def_en: To take the fingerprints of a person, especially a crime suspect, for identification.
items.ex_en: Technicians arrived promptly at the holding cell to fingerprint the newly detained suspect.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员迅速赶到拘留室，为新拘留的嫌疑人采集指纹。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail forensic and administrative procedures designed to record biometric data, physical traits, or official evidence to establish identity.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过提取生物特征或官方建档对嫌疑人或证物进行身份鉴定。
groups.desc_en: Systematically documenting identifying biometric or investigative traits into an official record, differentiating from casual writing by forensic, cataloging precision.
groups.desc_zh: 系统性记录个体的生物学或司法特征以形成官方档案，与普通“记笔记”不同，其侧重法医式鉴别与编目归档。
groups.nuance_en: book: formal administrative processing and logging of a suspect (suspect / arrestee) · log: systematic temporal chronological entry (incident / call) · DNA-profile: extracting and sequencing genetic identifiers (evidence / specimen) · catalog: methodical indexing and classifying of forensic items (inventory / artifact) · fingerprint: capturing dermal ridge patterns for definitive identity (suspect / weapon)
groups.nuance_zh: book: 警方正式收押登记建档 (suspect / arrestee) · log: 顺时系统性记录流水日志 (incident / call) · DNA-profile: 进行法医级DNA基因图谱分析 (evidence / specimen) · catalog: 分门别类编目鉴识物品 (inventory / artifact) · fingerprint: 提取指纹进行身份比对 (suspect / weapon)

groups.name: Record & Transcribe · 记录与转录 (Audio/Visual to Textual Conversion)
groups.tip: 以录像或逐字听写形式保存记录

items.def_en: to record sound or video onto magnetic tape or equivalent electronic media
items.ex_en: The detective quietly set up the hidden microphone to tape the entire conversation.
items.ex_zh: 侦探悄悄架设了隐藏麦克风，以录下整场谈话。

items.def_en: to take down and summarize official proceedings into formal written minutes
items.ex_en: The corporate secretary was assigned to minutize the tense board proceedings without omissions.
items.ex_zh: 公司秘书被指派巨细靡遗地将紧张的董事会议程整理成正式纪要。

items.def_zh: 文字编辑，校订转录文本
items.def_en: to check and correct a written or transcribed text for style, grammar, and accuracy
items.ex_en: The meticulous scholar took great pains to copyedit the transcribed memoirs of the poet.
items.ex_zh: 这位严谨的学者费尽心力去校订那位诗人被转录的回忆录文本。

items.def_zh: 给……录像，录影；把……录在录像带上
items.def_en: To record moving images and sound of something onto videotape or video recording equipment.
items.ex_en: The production crew set up multiple angles to videotape the live theatrical performance.
items.ex_zh: 制作团队架设了多个机位，为现场戏剧演出录像。

items.def_zh: 转录，笔录，抄写；改编（乐曲）
items.def_en: 1. To write down or type out spoken words, audio recordings, or shorthand notes into written text. 2. To adapt or arrange a piece of music for a different instrument or voice.
items.ex_en: The research assistant spent the entire weekend trying to transcribe the lengthy witness interviews.
items.ex_zh: 研究助理花了整个周末的时间试图将冗长的证人访谈录音转录成文本。

groups.summary_en: This technical communication frame covers capturing spoken utterances, events, or media into permanent visual, audio, or written formats, especially converting recorded sound into verbatim text.
groups.summary_zh: 将口语语音、视音频现场捕捉并转制为书面文字或媒体记录。
groups.desc_en: Capturing transient acoustic or visual data and rendering it into permanent audiovisual or textual formats, distinguishing from general writing by fidelity to an original sensory source.
groups.desc_zh: 捕捉瞬时的声学或视像信息并忠实转化为持久的影音或文本载体，不同于自由“写作”，侧重对源素材的如实转译。
groups.nuance_en: tape: capturing audio or video on magnetic/analog medium (conversation / interview) · minutize: taking formal, structured notes of an official meeting (meeting / proceedings) · copyedit: proofreading and polishing written transcriptions for style (manuscript / text) · videotape: specifically recording moving images and sound electronically (testimony / deposition) · transcribe: converting spoken speech into verbatim written text (audio / interview)
groups.nuance_zh: tape: 磁带或录音/像设备记录 (conversation / interview) · minutize: 提取整理官方会议纪要 (meeting / proceedings) · copyedit: 对文字转录稿进行编辑审校 (manuscript / text) · videotape: 录制动态视频图像证据 (testimony / deposition) · transcribe: 将口述音频逐字转录为文本 (audio / interview)

groups.name: Recover & Retrieve · 寻回获取与提取收回 (Retrieve, Recover, Reclaim)
groups.tip: 找回失落或存留之物

items.def_en: To regain possession of something stolen, lost, or misplaced after a search or process
items.ex_en: The police were finally able to recover the stolen paintings from an abandoned warehouse.
items.ex_zh: 警方最终在一处废弃仓库中找回了被盗的画作。

items.def_zh: 取回，找回；检索（数据）；挽回
items.def_en: 1. To find and bring something back from a place. 2. To extract or recover stored computer data or information.
items.ex_en: The database administrator was summoned to retrieve the critical financial records after the outage.
items.ex_zh: 系统中断后，数据库管理员被召集来检索关键的财务记录。

items.def_en: To go to where something or someone is and bring them back to the original place
items.ex_en: Could you please fetch the medical supply kit from the upstairs storage cabinet?
items.ex_zh: 你能去把楼上储物柜里的医疗急救箱拿过来吗？

items.def_en: To demand or obtain the return of one's property, territory, or rights from another party
items.ex_en: The indigenous tribe fought an extensive legal battle to reclaim their ancestral hunting lands.
items.ex_zh: 这个原住部落进行了漫长的法律斗争，以索回他们祖传的狩猎领地。

items.def_en: To regain money, expenditure, or losses spent or invested through subsequent revenue
items.ex_en: The studio hopes to recoup its massive production expenditure through international streaming distribution.
items.ex_zh: 制片厂希望通过国际流媒体发行来收回其庞大的制作成本。

groups.summary_en: This frame refers to locating, repossessing, or bringing back items, money, property, or electronic data from a former resting place or custodian. 'Retrieve' typically suggests going somewhere specifically to fetch data or physical objects, whereas 'reclaim' and 'recoup' emphasize reclaiming rights or offsetting losses.
groups.summary_zh: 指去往某处取回、寻回遗落财物或从系统数据库中检索提取信息。
groups.desc_en: Regaining control or possession of lost, taken, or distant assets or information, setting itself apart from initial discovery by returning something to its rightful status.
groups.desc_zh: 重新掌控或取回遗失、被夺或处于远处的资产或信息，与初次“寻找/发现”不同，侧重使其物归原主或复位。
groups.nuance_en: recover: regaining possession of lost, stolen, or compromised items (stolen goods / consciousness) · retrieve: fetching or accessing data or items from storage/remoteness (data / luggage) · fetch: going out, picking up, and bringing back something specific (ball / stick) · reclaim: asserting a legitimate right to take back land or property (land / deposit) · recoup: financially recovering invested or lost monetary costs (losses / investment)
groups.nuance_zh: recover: 寻回失窃遗失之物或恢复状态 (stolen goods / consciousness) · retrieve: 调取或检出远端/存储数据与物件 (data / luggage) · fetch: 前往取回某物并带回 (ball / stick) · reclaim: 主张法定权利开垦或收回 (land / deposit) · recoup: 财务上挽回或填补亏损成本 (losses / investment)

groups.name: Rectify & Remedy · 补救与除错 (Debug, Remediate, Rectify)
groups.tip: 修补破损恢复完好

items.def_en: to put right a mistake, problem, or undesirable condition
items.ex_en: The management team took immediate and decisive measures to rectify the accounting discrepancy.
items.ex_zh: 管理团队采取了果断而迅速的措施来纠正账目偏差。

items.def_en: to correct, balance, or set right an unfair or undesirable situation or grievance
items.ex_en: The new legislation was expressly drafted to redress the longstanding wage disparity in industry.
items.ex_zh: 这项新法规的起草明确旨在矫正该行业长期存在的薪酬差距。

items.def_zh: 排除故障，调试（计算机程序等）；清除（某处的）窃听器
items.def_en: 1. To find and remove errors or bugs from a computer program or hardware. 2. To locate and extract hidden listening devices from a room or equipment.
items.ex_en: The senior software engineer worked overnight to debug the core operating system software.
items.ex_zh: 高级软件工程师通宵工作，以排除核心操作系统软件的故障。

items.def_en: [I/T] to analyze a mechanical or technical problem systematically to discover and fix the defect
items.ex_en: The support specialist arrived promptly on site to troubleshoot the malfunctioning network server.
items.ex_zh: 支持专家迅速赶赴现场，对出现故障的网络服务器进行故障排查。

items.def_zh: 补救，纠正；治理，净化（受污染的环境）；辅导，矫正（学习困难）
items.def_en: (formal) To correct, reverse, or remedy something undesirable, especially environmental pollution, contamination, or academic deficiencies.
items.ex_en: The chemical company was legally mandated to remediate the heavily polluted industrial site.
items.ex_zh: 该化工企业被依法强制对严重污染的工业用地进行环境治理。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on finding defects, flaws, pollutants, or software errors and taking technical or corrective measures to eliminate them and set things right.
groups.summary_zh: 指排查系统漏洞、软件缺陷、污染或程序性失误，采取针对性措施予以矫正。
groups.desc_en: Identifying and eliminating errors, defects, or injustices within an existing operational system or state, going beyond mere repair by restoring correctness or balance.
groups.desc_zh: 识别并清除既有系统或状态中的错误、瑕疵或不公，与简单的“修理”相比，更侧重正义伸张、除错或标准恢复。
groups.nuance_en: rectify: setting right a flawed, deficient, or unjust situation (error / injustice) · redress: compensating or balancing a grievance or unfair harm (grievance / balance) · debug: locating and removing technical defects in code or circuits (software / system) · troubleshoot: systematically diagnosing operational malfunctions (engine / issue) · remediate: reversing environmental damage or addressing educational deficits (soil / deficiency)
groups.nuance_zh: rectify: 矫正错误或匡正不公局势 (error / injustice) · redress: 弥补冤屈或纠正失衡侵害 (grievance / balance) · debug: 排查并清除代码或软硬件故障 (software / system) · troubleshoot: 系统化诊断运行故障根源 (engine / issue) · remediate: 治理环境污染或补救缺陷 (soil / deficiency)

groups.name: Recur & Cycle · 周期轮转与循环 (Alternate, Rotate, Recur)
groups.tip: 周而复始按轨运转

items.def_zh: 逐一经历一系列循环阶段
items.def_en: To move sequentially through a series of stages, options, or states before repeating
items.ex_en: The automated traffic lights cycle through green, amber, and red at programmed intervals.
items.ex_zh: 自动交通信号灯按照设定的时间间隔在绿、黄、红三色之间循环变换。

items.def_zh: 循环，周而复始地运转；使循环；骑自行车
items.def_en: 1. to move, pass, or operate through a recurring series of events or a cycle; to cause to go through a cycle 2. to ride a bicycle
items.ex_en: Water molecules continuously cycle through evaporation, condensation, and precipitation in our biosphere.
items.ex_zh: 在生物圈中，水分子在蒸发、凝结和降水之间周而复始地循环运转。

items.def_en: To occur or cause to occur in turn repeatedly between two states or conditions
items.ex_en: The unpredictable spring weather continued to alternate between warm sunshine and freezing rain.
items.ex_zh: 多变的山地春季天气在温暖阳光和刺骨冻雨之间交替反复。
items.ex2_en: The thoughtful teacher will alternate indoor lessons with outdoor sports activities daily.
items.ex2_zh: 这位体贴的老师每天都会将室内课程与户外体育活动交替进行。

items.def_en: To pass or cause to pass through a regular sequence of duties, positions, or crops
items.ex_en: The agrarian cooperative chose to rotate traditional crops annually to preserve essential soil nutrients.
items.ex_zh: 农业合作社选择每年轮换种植传统作物，以保护土壤的基本养分。
items.ex2_en: The heavy steel turbine began to rotate rapidly as steam entered the chamber.
items.ex2_zh: 随着蒸汽进入腔体，沉重的钢制涡轮开始快速旋转。

items.def_en: To happen, occur, or appear again repeatedly at intervals
items.ex_en: Doctors expressed deep concern that the severe respiratory infection might recur next winter.
items.ex_zh: 医生们对严重的呼吸道感染可能在下个冬季复发表示深切担忧。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on processes, phases, or systems passing through a recurring sequence of stages or alternating states. Emphasizes cyclical repetition over continuous spatial flow.
groups.summary_zh: 强调事物按固定阶段周而复始、轮替交替或循环运转的动态。
groups.desc_en: Passing periodically through a patterned series of states, events, or positions that repeat over time, contrasting with linear continuity through predictable cyclical return.
groups.desc_zh: 按固定模式在多个状态、事件或位置间随时间周期性轮替重现，与单向线性推进不同，具有闭环或周期返现性。
groups.nuance_en: cycle through: systematically progressing sequentially through a set list of options (options / phases) · cycle: undergoing continuous periodic circular motion or rhythms (season / trend) · alternate: switching strictly back and forth between two states (rain and shine / shifts) · rotate: turning on an axis or systematically swapping duties in sequence (crops / roles) · recur: happening repeatedly or periodically at intervals (symptoms / themes)
groups.nuance_zh: cycle through: 顺次遍历一整套阶段或选项 (options / phases) · cycle: 经历完整的周而复始循环 (season / trend) · alternate: 在两极或两组状态间交替互换 (rain and shine / shifts) · rotate: 轴向轮转或轮值排班/轮作 (crops / roles) · recur: 间隔性重复发作或重现 (symptoms / themes)

groups.name: Redeem & Cash In · 赎回与兑换 (Cash in, Encash, Repurchase)
groups.tip: 付代价取回抵押或权益

items.def_en: Exchange a coupon, bond, or token for real money
items.ex_en: He decided to cash in his casino chips before heading back to the hotel.
items.ex_zh: 他决定在回酒店之前把自己的赌场筹码兑现成钱。

items.def_en: Convert a draft, check, or financial instrument into cash
items.ex_en: The executor visited the designated commercial bank to encash the deceased merchant's bearer bond.
items.ex_zh: 遗嘱执行人前往指定商业银行，兑现了这位已故商人的无记名债券。

items.def_en: Recover something pledged as security by paying off the underlying debt
items.ex_en: The borrower must fully unpledge the property once the principal is repaid.
items.ex_zh: 借款人在清偿本金后必须完全赎清该质押房产。

items.def_en: 1. To get something back by paying money or paying off a debt. 2. To exchange a coupon, voucher, or share for money or goods. 3. To make up for faults, mistakes, or bad behavior.
items.ex_en: Investors can redeem their mutual fund units after the lock-in period expires.
items.ex_zh: 投资者可在锁定期结束后赎回其共同基金份额。

items.def_en: Buy back goods, shares, or property that were previously sold
items.ex_en: The corporation resolved to repurchase its undervalued shares from the public market.
items.ex_zh: 该企业决定从公开市场回购其被低估的股票。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses recovering pledged items, converting vouchers or securities into tangible value, or discharging pledges via settlement.
groups.summary_zh: 指凭凭证兑现收益、清偿债务赎还抵押品或回购资产。
groups.desc_en: Surrendering a token, voucher, pledge, or security in exchange for cash, underlying assets, or freedom, contrasting with straightforward selling by closing out an obligation.
groups.desc_zh: 交出票券、抵押物或证券以换回现金、底层资产或解脱义务，与普通“买卖”不同，其核心是契约清偿与权利赎回。
groups.nuance_en: cash in: converting chips, vouchers, or gains into actual cash (chips / shares) · encash: technically processing a financial bill or draft into currency (cheque / draft) · unpledge: releasing previously mortgaged collateral upon satisfying debt (shares / assets) · redeem: exchanging vouchers, honor, or mortgaged property for value (coupon / mortgage) · repurchase: buying back previously sold equity or securities under pact (shares / debt)
groups.nuance_zh: cash in: 将筹码、凭证兑现或套现离场 (chips / shares) · encash: 票据或汇票在金融机构承兑换钱 (cheque / draft) · unpledge: 债务清偿后解除质押或解冻资产 (shares / assets) · redeem: 凭券兑换礼品或赎回抵押物 (coupon / mortgage) · repurchase: 依约回购先前售出的股权或证券 (shares / debt)

groups.name: Redress & Compensate · 纠偏与匡正补救 (Right, Remedy, Make Up For)
groups.tip: 平反冤屈并对损失做出补偿

items.def_en: To do something good to compensate for an injury, unfair loss, or mistake
items.ex_en: He worked overtime all weekend to make up for the lost hours.
items.ex_zh: 他整个周末都在加班，以弥补损失的工时。

items.def_en: To act to make amends or reparation for a moral wrong or offense
items.ex_en: The disgraced executive sought to atone for his betrayal through extensive philanthropy.
items.ex_zh: 这名身败名裂的高管试图通过广泛的慈善活动来弥补自己的背叛之过。

items.def_en: To provide an effective countermeasure or solution to an undesirable or unfair state of affairs
items.ex_en: Management acted swiftly to remedy the severe deficiencies in the workplace safety protocol.
items.ex_zh: 管理层迅速采取行动，以纠正工作场所安全协议中的严重缺陷。

items.def_en: To inflict punitive retribution in response to a wrong, injustice, or harm
items.ex_en: The monarch swore to avenge the fallen soldiers and restore the nation's honor.
items.ex_zh: 君主发誓要为阵亡的将士报仇，并重塑国家的尊严。

items.def_zh: 纠正，平反，补救（不公或损害）
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To correct an unfair situation, wrong, or imbalance by providing compensation or justice.
items.ex_en: The tribunal sought to redress the historical injustices suffered by indigenous communities.
items.ex_zh: 该法庭力求纠正原住民群体所遭受的历史不公。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on restoring moral, legal, or social justice by repairing grievances, setting right historic inequalities, or compensating victims for unfair damage.
groups.summary_zh: 纠正社会或法律上的不公，平反冤屈并通过补偿实现匡正求平。
groups.desc_en: Balancing moral, legal, or physical ledger sheets after an injury or imbalance has occurred, distinguishing from bare retaliation by striving for restorative fairness.
groups.desc_zh: 在损害或失衡发生后在道义、法律或实质层面上予以补平，与纯粹的“报复”不同，其目的在于抚平亏欠或恢复公允。
groups.nuance_en: make up for: offsetting a deficit, omission, or flaw with extra effort (delay / mistake) · atone for: expiating guilt or spiritual sin through penance (sins / crime) · remedy: applying a practical cure to reverse an unsatisfactory situation (deficiency / plight) · avenge: inflicting retributive punishment to satisfy honor or justice (death / insult) · redress: legally or morally remedying a systemic injustice or injury (wrong / balance)
groups.nuance_zh: make up for: 以额外努力或价值弥补缺憾 (delay / mistake) · atone for: 忏悔赎罪以消除内疚道德污点 (sins / crime) · remedy: 施加实际补救措施扭转不良局面 (deficiency / plight) · avenge: 为荣誉或死者施加报复惩治 (death / insult) · redress: 通过法律或道德手段匡正侵害 (wrong / balance)

groups.name: Reflate & Stimulate Economy · 宏观调控与通货回补 (Reflate, Pump-prime, Stimulate)
groups.tip: 宏观干预给经济再注水通胀

items.def_zh: 注资启动，采取景气刺激措施
items.def_en: To stimulate the expansion of a sluggish economy by heavy government spending and credit expansion
items.ex_en: The treasury decided to pump-prime the stagnant economy through massive infrastructural investments.
items.ex_zh: 财政部决定通过巨额基础设施投资来注资启动停滞的经济。

items.def_zh: 启动，促使快速启动（经济）
items.def_en: To take energetic, immediate steps to restart or revive a stalled project, economy, or process
items.ex_en: Tax cuts could quickly kick-start the sluggish economy ahead of the winter season.
items.ex_zh: 减税政策可以在冬季到来之前迅速启动低迷的经济。

items.def_en: To encourage greater economic activity or investment through policy interventions or capital expenditure
items.ex_en: Aggressive monetary easing was deployed to stimulate private domestic investment and growth.
items.ex_zh: 当局实施了激进的货币宽松政策，以刺激国内民间投资和增长。

items.def_en: (+ into) To introduce large sums of public money or liquidity into a financial market to restore stability
items.ex_en: The central bank had to inject emergency liquidity directly into interbank lending markets.
items.ex_zh: 央行不得不直接向银行间借贷市场注入紧急流动性。

items.def_zh: 使（经济）通货再膨胀，刺激（经济）复苏；经历通货再膨胀
items.def_en: (economics) To stimulate a depressed economy by increasing the money supply, lowering interest rates, or boosting public spending.
items.ex_en: Central bankers acted decisively to reflate the manufacturing sector during the downturn.
items.ex_zh: 央行官员在经济衰退期间果断采取行动，促使制造业通货再膨胀。
items.ex2_en: Domestic economic sectors slowly reflate once commercial banks lower basic lending rates.
items.ex2_zh: 一旦商业银行降低基本贷款利率，国内各经济部门就会慢慢恢复生机。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame pertain to macroeconomic governance where policymakers inject liquidity, ease fiscal constraints, or prime investment to reverse deflationary stagnation without triggering excessive inflation.
groups.summary_zh: 指宏观政策通过降息、注资或财税手段刺激需求以逆转经济停滞。
groups.desc_en: Injecting liquidity, capital, or incentives into a flagging economic system to reanimate demand and output, contrasting with natural growth through engineered intervention.
groups.desc_zh: 向低迷的经济体中注入流动性、资本或激励措施以重启需求与产出，不同于自然增长，具有宏观工程干预属性。
groups.nuance_en: pump-prime: priming a stalling economic pump with initial government capital (economy / market) · kick-start: providing an energetic initial jolt to revive stalled growth (growth / process) · stimulate: broadly encouraging activity, demand, or investment via policy (demand / investment) · inject: directly channeling capital or liquidity into institutions (liquidity / capital) · reflate: deliberately increasing money supply to counter deflation (currency / economy)
groups.nuance_zh: pump-prime: 政府注入初始资金启动经济抽水机 (economy / market) · kick-start: 给予强劲外力助推停滞进程重启 (growth / process) · stimulate: 广义通过政策刺激需求与活跃度 (demand / investment) · inject: 定向注资或注入流动性活水 (liquidity / capital) · reflate: 刻意推高通胀与货币供给以抗通缩 (currency / economy)

groups.name: Reforge & Reconstruct · 熔铸与浴火重建 (Rebuild, Re-create, Reconstitute)
groups.tip: 投入火炉重新淬炼改造

items.def_en: To reconstruct a coherent whole or narrative from scattered fragments or facts
items.ex_en: Detectives worked patiently to piece together the sequence of events before dawn.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们耐心地拼凑黎明前发生的事件全过程。

items.def_en: To form an organization, alliance, or substance anew in a different or restored shape
items.ex_en: The parliamentary committee was reconstituted after several senior members resigned in protest.
items.ex_zh: 数名资深成员抗议辞职后，该议会委员会进行了重组。

items.def_en: To form or create an alliance, agreement, or identity with great effort and resilience
items.ex_en: Diplomats worked tirelessly for months to forge a historic bilateral trade pact.
items.ex_zh: 外交官们不知疲倦地工作了数月，艰苦缔造了一项历史性的双边贸易协定。

items.def_en: To build something again after it has been destroyed, damaged, or broken down
items.ex_en: Local residents pooled their resources to rebuild the community center after the flood.
items.ex_zh: 洪水过后，当地居民聚集资源重建了社区中心。

items.def_en: 1. To heat and hammer metal into a new shape again, or rebuild an alliance or relationship with renewed strength.
items.ex_en: The weary kingdoms sought to reforge their ancient alliance against rising shadows.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的王国试图重新锻造古老的盟约，以抵御日益逼近的阴影。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on rebuilding, reconstituting, or renewing durable bonds, institutions, or physical materials through intense effort, hardship, or heat. The verbs emphasize overcoming complete rupture or breakdown to create a robust new entity.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重经历断裂或严酷考验后的强力重构与再造。
groups.desc_en: Smashing down and reconstituting damaged structures or relationships through intense, transformative labor, contrasting with ordinary repairing through fundamental metamorphosis.
groups.desc_zh: 在原有体系瓦解后，通过极具张力与深度的重塑劳动实现浴火重生，与普通修补不同，带有质的蜕变或重构性。
groups.nuance_en: piece together: painstakingly gathering fragmented clues or parts into a whole (clues / puzzle) · reconstitute: reassembling dissolved or dispersed entities back into working form (cabinet / committee) · forge: fashioning or building something robust through intense effort (alliance / bond) · rebuild: physically or structurally erecting anew after destruction (city / reputation) · reforge: reheating, remolding, and radically strengthening a shattered alliance or identity (partnership / ties)
groups.nuance_zh: piece together: 艰难地将零散碎片或线索拼凑复原 (clues / puzzle) · reconstitute: 重组已解散或分散的组织实体 (cabinet / committee) · forge: 磨砺打造成型稳固关系 (alliance / bond) · rebuild: 灾后从物理或结构上全面重建 (city / reputation) · reforge: 熔铸淬炼重塑破碎同盟或纽带 (partnership / ties)

groups.name: Reform & Amend · 改革与修订 (Modify Official Texts, Laws, or Systems)
groups.tip: 修正旧章法制度以求完善革新

items.def_zh: 改革，革新，改良；使改过自新，洗心革面
items.def_en: 1. To improve a system, organization, or law by making changes to it. 2. To change your behavior and become a better person, or to make someone do so.
items.ex_en: The legislature convened to reform the outdated pension system across the state.
items.ex_zh: 立法机关召开会议，以改革全州陈旧的养老金体制。
items.ex2_en: Hardened criminals rarely reform without sustained therapeutic guidance and communal support.
items.ex2_zh: 如果没有持续的心理治疗指导和社区支持，顽固罪犯很少会改过自新。

items.def_zh: 修订，修正（法规、政策或文稿）
items.def_en: to alter or update a text, policy, or law to correct errors or reflect changes
items.ex_en: The committee met yesterday to revise the municipal building regulations thoroughly.
items.ex_zh: 委员会昨天开会，彻底修订了市政建筑法规。

items.def_zh: 重新起草，重拟（法案、协议）
items.def_en: to write a piece of legislation, agreement, or document again in order to improve it
items.ex_en: Legal counsel was instructed to redraft the controversial clause before final submission.
items.ex_zh: 法律顾问接到指示，在最终提交之前重新起草这一争议条款。

items.def_zh: 修改，修订（法律、文件、宪法等）；修正
items.def_en: To change the words of a text, especially a law, contract, or bill, in order to improve or correct it.
items.ex_en: Parliament voted decisively to amend the constitution to safeguard judicial independence.
items.ex_zh: 议会果断投票修改宪法，以捍卫司法独立。

items.def_zh: 彻底革新，全面检修（系统、法律框架）
items.def_en: to examine thoroughly and make extensive changes or repairs to a system or institution
items.ex_en: The incoming administration promised to overhaul the crumbling national healthcare infrastructure.
items.ex_zh: 新一届政府承诺全面检修摇摇欲坠的国家医疗基础设施。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe officially altering, improving, or revising laws, institutions, constitutions, or practices to eliminate faults or modernize standards. 'Reform' targets institutional or systemic improvement, while 'amend' specifically modifies official texts, legislation, or constitutional clauses.
groups.summary_zh: 针对体制、法律或官方文件进行正式修正、改良或增删修订。
groups.desc_en: Making formal, deliberative modifications to legal texts, institutional codes, or societal structures to improve efficacy, contrasting with informal tweaking by structural legitimacy.
groups.desc_zh: 对法律文本、制度规章或社会架构进行正式且审慎的修改以提升效能，与非正式“调整”相比具有制度正当性。
groups.nuance_en: reform: overhauling systemic social or institutional practices for improvement (system / sector) · revise: re-examining and updating textual or conceptual content (text / policy) · redraft: completely rewriting a formal legislative document or contract (bill / clause) · amend: legally adding, removing, or modifying specific statutory clauses (constitution / law) · overhaul: thoroughly inspecting and rebuilding an entire operational structure (regulations / machinery)
groups.nuance_zh: reform: 针对体制或制度开展根基性改革 (system / sector) · revise: 重新审阅并修正文本或策略 (text / policy) · redraft: 对草案文本进行彻底重拟重写 (bill / clause) · amend: 通过法定程序修订增删法条 (constitution / law) · overhaul: 全面拆解大修制度或规约体系 (regulations / machinery)

groups.name: Refrain & Abstain · 戒除与断绝 (Abstain, Forgo, Renounce)
groups.tip: 主动克制欲望放弃投票享乐

items.def_en: To stop doing or consuming something you did regularly
items.ex_en: She decided to give up sugary soda to lower her blood pressure.
items.ex_zh: 为了降低血压，她决定戒掉含糖汽水。

items.def_zh: 戒绝，克制（欲望等）；（投票时）弃权
items.def_en: 1. To deliberately choose not to do something enjoyable, especially drinking alcohol. 2. To choose not to vote for or against something.
items.ex_en: Patients with liver complications must strictly abstain from alcohol during treatment.
items.ex_zh: 有肝脏并发症的患者在治疗期间必须严格戒酒。

items.def_en: To decide not to have or do something that you would otherwise enjoy
items.ex_en: The board agreed to forgo their annual bonuses during the fiscal crisis.
items.ex_zh: 董事会同意在财政危机期间放弃他们的年度奖金。

items.def_zh: 发誓戒掉；下决心不再碰
items.def_en: To promise decisively to avoid or give up something harmful, such as alcohol or gambling
items.ex_en: After losing his paycheck at poker, he vowed to swear off gambling.
items.ex_zh: 在扑克牌局中输掉薪水后，他发誓彻底戒赌。

items.def_en: To state publicly that you no longer have a belief, claim, or bad habit
items.ex_en: The dissident was pressured to renounce his political allegiance to the party.
items.ex_zh: 该异见人士被迫公开宣布放弃对该党的政治效忠。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures high-intensity, rigorous self-denial where one intentionally gives up pleasures, habits, votes, or practices on moral, physical, or religious grounds. Nuances span from voluntary asceticism to permanent renunciation.
groups.summary_zh: 指出于健康、宗教或伦理考量，彻底戒除嗜好或自愿放弃享乐与权利。
groups.desc_en: Voluntarily holding oneself back from indulging in specific appetites, rights, or actions through self-discipline, contrasting with involuntary deprivation by personal agency.
groups.desc_zh: 出于自律、道义或法定义务，主动克制并放弃享受某种欲望、权利或行为，与被动剥夺不同，强调自主自控。
groups.nuance_en: give up: yielding or stopping an ingrained habit or pursuit (smoking / habit) · abstain: deliberately declining to indulge in a vice or exercise a vote (alcohol / voting) · forgo: consciously passing up an immediate comfort or opportunity (dessert / privilege) · swear off: making a resolute, solemn pledge to stay away from a vice (drinking / meat) · renounce: formally and publically declaring the abandonment of a right or belief (citizenship / claim)
groups.nuance_zh: give up: 中断或舍弃某习惯与追求 (smoking / habit) · abstain: 在投票或嗜好中克制戒断或弃权 (alcohol / voting) · forgo: 自愿放弃即时的舒适或特权机会 (dessert / privilege) · swear off: 发誓立戒断绝某种不良习性 (drinking / meat) · renounce: 正式且公开地声明放弃权利或名义 (citizenship / claim)

groups.name: Refund & Rebate · 退款与折让 (Refund, Rebate, Reimburse)
groups.tip: 交易后退还或折让部分款项

items.def_en: To return money owed or given to someone earlier
items.ex_en: I promise to pay back the loan as soon as salary arrives.
items.ex_zh: 我保证工资一到账就还清这笔借款。

items.def_en: To pay back money previously received from someone, as for unsatisfactory goods
items.ex_en: The vendor agreed to refund the entire amount for the damaged merchandise.
items.ex_zh: 商家同意全额退还受损商品的款项。

items.def_en: To pay back part of an amount someone has already paid for goods, services, or taxes.
items.ex_en: The customs authority consented to rebate the excess duty paid upon arrival.
items.ex_zh: 海关当局同意退还抵港时多缴纳的关税。

items.def_en: (+ for) To pay back money that someone has spent on official or out-of-pocket expenses
items.ex_en: The firm will promptly reimburse employees for all valid domestic travel expenses.
items.ex_zh: 公司将及时为员工报销所有合规的国内差旅费用。

items.def_en: To cancel or refund a debt, fine, or tax obligation
items.ex_en: The magistrate agreed to remit the punitive fine owing to extreme hardship.
items.ex_zh: 鉴于当事人的极端贫困，法官同意免除惩罚性罚款。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail transferring funds back to a payer, including official refunds for returned merchandise, retroactive discounts, and expense compensations.
groups.summary_zh: 指在消费或商务活动中退还款项、返还差额或报销费用。
groups.desc_en: Returning disbursed funds back to a payer due to overpayment, return of goods, or formal contract terms, distinguishing from unilateral paying by its restorative direction.
groups.desc_zh: 因超额支付、退货、折扣或履行约定，将已支出的款项逆向返还给付款人，与一般的单向“付款”不同，属于逆流返还。
groups.nuance_en: pay back: general returning of borrowed or owed money (debt / friend) · refund: officially returning full or partial payment upon return/cancellation (ticket / deposit) · rebate: retroactive return of a portion of paid funds as an incentive or tax reduction (tax / discount) · reimburse: paying someone back for authorized out-of-pocket expenses (expenses / travel) · remit: formally transmitting or waiving a payment or penalty (funds / fee)
groups.nuance_zh: pay back: 一般性偿还借款或欠款 (debt / friend) · refund: 退货或取消服务时的正式退款 (ticket / deposit) · rebate: 作为促销激励或退税的事后返利 (tax / discount) · reimburse: 报销因公垫付的差旅杂费 (expenses / travel) · remit: 汇出款项或豁免免除罚费 (funds / fee)

groups.name: Refurbish & Redecorate · 翻新布置与居室整修 (Redecorate, Refurbish, Revamp)
groups.tip: 重新粉刷与摆设美化空间

items.def_en: To repair, repaint, and decorate an old room, building, or car
items.ex_en: We bought a ramshackle cottage by the lake and did it up.
items.ex_zh: 我们在湖边买下了一座摇摇欲坠的农舍并修缮装饰了一番。

items.def_en: To restore a room or building to a former better state by repairing and modernizing
items.ex_en: The heritage foundation raised funds to renovate the historic downtown theater.
items.ex_zh: 文物保护基金会筹集资金来翻新市中心这座历史悠久的剧院。

items.def_en: To give new form, structure, or visual style to a room, building, or system
items.ex_en: The network hopes to revamp its evening news show with fresh graphics.
items.ex_zh: 该电视台希望通过崭新的画面风格来全面改造其晚间新闻节目。

items.def_en: To renovate, re-equip, and clean up a building or room to restore its good condition
items.ex_en: The university spent millions to refurbish the aging physics laboratories this summer.
items.ex_zh: 大学今年夏天斥资数百万美元整修了老旧的物理实验室。

items.def_en: To paint, wallpaper, or furnish a room or building again to improve its appearance.
items.ex_en: They hired an interior designer to redecorate their master bedroom this spring.
items.ex_zh: 他们今年春天聘请了一位室内设计师来重新装饰主卧。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on renovating, refinishing, or overhauling an interior space, building, or room by repainting, papering, and installing fresh furnishings to restore or improve visual and functional appeal.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过重新粉刷、更换壁纸、置办家具等对室内空间进行翻新与整修。
groups.desc_en: To overhaul, repair, or aesthetically update an existing physical space or object, differing from raw construction or repair by focusing on restoring cosmetic freshness and modern functionality.
groups.desc_zh: 对既有空间或物件进行翻新、整修或美化装饰，不同于纯粹的基础建设或机械维修，强调外观焕新与居住使用功能的升级。
groups.nuance_en: do up: informal, total decorative overhaul (cottage / old house / flat) · renovate: deep structural repair and upgrading (property / kitchen / historic building) · revamp: rapid structural or visual restyling for better appeal (image / website / interior) · refurbish: systematic commercial or technical reconditioning (offices / hotel / equipment) · redecorate: purely surface-level aesthetic painting and wallpapering (room / bedroom / flat)
groups.nuance_zh: do up: 口语化全面翻新整修 (cottage / old house / flat) · renovate: 结构性深度改造修复 (property / kitchen / historic building) · revamp: 换汤不换药式的大幅改版重塑 (image / website / interior) · refurbish: 商业或技术层面的翻新重装 (offices / hotel / equipment) · redecorate: 纯粹粉刷墙面的外观再装饰 (room / bedroom / flat)

groups.name: Register & Log · 登记与建档归册 (Docket, Log, Roster)
groups.tip: 在法院或官方案卷中立案登记

items.def_en: To place documents officially in records or present a legal application or lawsuit to an authority
items.ex_en: The defense attorney will file an official petition with the regional court.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师将向地区法院正式递交一份诉状。

items.def_en: To record a name, fact, or details in an official book, list, or system
items.ex_en: Citizens are required by law to register births with the municipal authorities.
items.ex_zh: 法律要求公民必须向市政当局登记新生儿出生。

items.def_en: To make a systematic, official record of events, numbers, or actions in an official register
items.ex_en: The flight officer must log every altitude change in the official ledger.
items.ex_zh: 飞行员必须将每一次高度变化记录在正式日志中。

items.def_zh: 把……记入名册；注册入学/入伍
items.def_en: To officially register someone on the roll or list of members in a course or organization
items.ex_en: The academy decided to enroll fifty prospective engineering cadets this academic term.
items.ex_zh: 学院决定在这一学期招收并注册五十名未来的工程学员。
items.ex2_en: Thousands of enthusiastic students enroll in online foreign language courses every semester.
items.ex2_zh: 每学期都有成千上万热情的学生报名参加在线外语课程。

items.def_zh: 将……记入案卷，在案卷上登记；给……编摘要
items.def_en: (law) To enter a legal case or matter onto an official court schedule or register of proceedings.
items.ex_en: The court clerk was instructed to docket the appeal without further delay.
items.ex_zh: 法庭书记官接到指示，毫不拖延地将该上诉案件记入案卷。

groups.summary_en: This frame revolves around officially entering names, cases, transactions, or documents into formal records, lists, or databases for administrative tracking or judicial scheduling.
groups.summary_zh: 指将事务、案件或名单正式录入台账、日程或系统备查。
groups.desc_en: To enter names, items, or events into an official, searchable archive or roster, differing from informal writing down by carrying binding procedural or legal status.
groups.desc_zh: 将人员、事项或物品正式录入名册或归档系统，不同于普通随手记账，具有法定程序性与归册存查效力。
groups.nuance_en: file: formally lodge paperwork or legal instruments into a repository (suit / complaint / return) · register: record officially to grant legal entitlement or formal status (birth / voter / trademark) · log: systematically record sequential chronologic operational data (hours / calls / incidents) · enroll: enter a person onto an institutional membership roster (course / student / program) · docket: formally schedule or record on an official court agenda or legal calendar (case / trial / petition)
groups.nuance_zh: file: 依规将卷宗文书提交归档 (suit / complaint / return) · register: 官方正式登记确权 (birth / voter / trademark) · log: 顺时序记录运行与日志数据 (hours / calls / incidents) · enroll: 招募注册编入组织名册 (course / student / program) · docket: 将案件列入司法公文日程表 (case / trial / petition)

groups.name: Regurgitate & Ruminate · 反刍与倒流 (Regurgitate, Ruminate, Bring up)
groups.tip: 胃内容物倒流经食管喷涌而出

items.def_en: To chew again the cud regurgitated from the stomach, or to meditate deeply on a matter
items.ex_en: Cattle lie beneath the trees to ruminate in peace after mid-morning grazing.
items.ex_zh: 上午放牧过后，牛群躺在树下静静地反刍。

items.def_en: To regurgitate or cough up swallowed food or phlegm from the throat or stomach
items.ex_en: The sick child began to bring up her dinner during the night.
items.ex_zh: 生病的孩子在夜间开始把晚饭吐了出来。

items.def_en: To gently regurgitate small quantities of milk or swallowed food without violent retching
items.ex_en: The newborn tends to spit up a little milk after every feeding.
items.ex_zh: 这个新生儿每次吃完奶后往往都会吐出一点奶。

items.def_en: To flow back up through the esophagus, especially of acidic gastric liquids
items.ex_en: Lying flat after meals causes acidic bile to reflux into the esophagus.
items.ex_zh: 饭后平躺会导致酸性胆汁反流至食道。

items.def_zh: 涌出，反刍，呕出；机械地重复（事实或想法）
items.def_en: 1. To bring swallowed food back up through the throat into the mouth. 2. (disapproving) To repeat information or ideas mechanically without really understanding them.
items.ex_en: The upset toddler suddenly started to regurgitate sour milk across the rug.
items.ex_zh: 身体不适的幼儿突然开始在地毯上呕出酸奶。

groups.summary_en: This physiological frame refers to bringing swallowed food or digestive fluids back up from the stomach into the esophagus or mouth, often without the violent muscular convulsing of sickness, or metaphorically repeating unassimilated ideas.
groups.summary_zh: 指将吞下的食物倒回口中（反刍/返流），或生搬硬套复述信息。
groups.desc_en: To expel undigested gastric contents backward through the esophagus or chew previously swallowed matter, contrasting with deliberate ejection like spitting by involving involuntary or cyclical retrograde digestive movement.
groups.desc_zh: 胃内未消化物质逆向倒流回食道或口腔，或将食物重新咀嚼，不同于主动吐出，强调逆向消化流动或胃肠生理反射。
groups.nuance_en: ruminate: chew regurgitated cud meditatively (cud / grass / food) · bring up: colloquial physical regurgitation or gentle vomiting (milk / wind / phlegm) · spit up: infant-typical gentle regurgitation of milk (formula / milk / feed) · reflux: involuntary backward acid seepage without full vomiting (acid / bile / stomach contents) · regurgitate: return partially digested matter backward through the throat (food / meal / pellets)
groups.nuance_zh: ruminate: 反刍倒嚼胃中物 (cud / grass / food) · bring up: 口语中呕出或反胃吐出 (milk / wind / phlegm) · spit up: 婴儿特有的微量吐奶 (formula / milk / feed) · reflux: 胃酸胆汁非自主向上逆流 (acid / bile / stomach contents) · regurgitate: 动物或病理生理性将未消化食糜倒流 (food / meal / pellets)

groups.name: Rehash & Regurgitate · 炒冷饭与老调重弹 (Regurgitate, Churn out, Trott out)
groups.tip: 如炒冷饭般反复絮叨重提旧事

items.def_en: To reuse obsolete ideas, plotlines, or slogans instead of developing new ones
items.ex_en: Lazy screenwriters merely recycle tired tropes rather than penning compelling original stories.
items.ex_zh: 懒惰的编剧只是在翻用陈词滥调，而不是撰写引人入胜的原创故事。

items.def_zh: （改头换面地）重提，翻炒（旧观点、旧材料）
items.def_en: 1. (disapproving) To reuse old ideas, stories, or arguments in a slightly new form without adding anything original or useful.
items.ex_en: The documentary merely rehashes stale theories about the mystery without new evidence.
items.ex_zh: 这部纪录片只是翻炒有关该谜团的旧理论，毫无新证据。

items.def_zh: 搬出（老借口或陈词滥调）
items.def_en: To produce an old excuse, argument, or claim that has been heard many times before
items.ex_en: Politicians always trot out identical excuses whenever the quarterly tax revenues plunge.
items.ex_zh: 每当季度税收骤降时，政客们总是搬出如出一辙的老借口。

items.def_zh: 再端出（陈旧构想）；温旧货
items.def_en: To present old ideas, stories, or films again with only slight modifications
items.ex_en: The studio tried to warm over an eighties action plot for youngsters.
items.ex_zh: 制片厂试图为年轻人再端出一套八十年代的动作片旧套路。

items.def_zh: 机械重复；生搬硬套（旧言论）
items.def_en: To repeat facts, ideas, or statements mechanically without understanding or critique
items.ex_en: Students should analyze complex texts critically rather than simply regurgitate memorized lecture notes.
items.ex_zh: 学生应当批判性地分析复杂的文本，而不是简单机械地重复死记硬背的讲义。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here carry an explicitly disapproving evaluative load, referring to repeating stale arguments, hackneyed plots, or recycled ideas without any novel insight or artistic refinement. The framing highlights exhaustion of creativity or intellectually lazy recycling.
groups.summary_zh: 含贬义，指毫无新意地重复旧思想、陈旧言论或炒冷饭。
groups.desc_en: To present previously used ideas, texts, or arguments without original thought, differing from genuine creative revision by its derivative, cynical, or stale recycling.
groups.desc_zh: 毫无创见地机械重弹老调或倒卖旧材料，不同于积极的推陈出新，带有明显的敷衍、陈腐与缺乏诚意色彩。
groups.nuance_en: recycle: reuse tired materials or ideas with minimal change (ideas / arguments / cliches) · rehash: rearrange old content disguised as something fresh (plot / debate / points) · trot out: mechanically wheel out predictable excuses or clichés (excuses / platitudes / statistics) · warm over: serve up stale, uninspired ideas with little new flavor (proposals / theories / jokes) · regurgitate: unthinkingly spit back memorized facts or dogmas (facts / doctrine / slogans)
groups.nuance_zh: recycle: 换汤不换药地循环套用旧料 (ideas / arguments / cliches) · rehash: 重新拼凑包装炒冷饭 (plot / debate / points) · trot out: 机械化端出屡见不鲜的套话或借口 (excuses / platitudes / statistics) · warm over: 索然无味地重新搬出冷饭 (proposals / theories / jokes) · regurgitate: 未经消化便生吞活剥地死记硬背背诵 (facts / doctrine / slogans)

groups.name: Reheat & Warm Rapidly · 快速加热与温热 (Microwave, Reheat, Zap)
groups.tip: 日常加热与熟化过程

items.def_en: To make food or liquids pleasantly warm ready for consumption, or become warm
items.ex_en: Let me warm up some leftover stew for our quick lunch today.
items.ex_zh: 让我把吃剩的炖肉热一热，作为我们今天快捷的午餐。
items.ex2_en: The chilly mountain air will warm up considerably under bright morning sunlight.
items.ex2_zh: 在明亮的晨光照耀下，寒冷的山间空气会明显变暖。

items.def_zh: 用微波炉加热，微波烹调
items.def_en: 1. To cook or heat food or drink quickly in a microwave oven.
items.ex_en: She decided to microwave the cold soup for ninety seconds before eating.
items.ex_zh: 她决定把凉汤用微波炉加热九十秒后再吃。

items.def_en: To cook or heat thoroughly in a microwave oven
items.ex_en: Just nuke that frozen dinner in the microwave for four quick minutes.
items.ex_zh: 直接把那份冷冻餐放进微波炉转上四分钟就成了。

items.def_en: To cook or heat food quickly using a microwave oven
items.ex_en: He popped the cold coffee in to zap it for thirty seconds.
items.ex_zh: 他把冷掉的咖啡放进去快速转了三十秒。

items.def_en: To heat food or drink that has gone cold after being previously cooked
items.ex_en: You must thoroughly reheat cooked poultry before serving it to guests tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 明天在端给客人之前，你必须彻底重新加热烹制好的禽肉。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers domestic and commercial kitchen methods for quickly bringing cold or pre-cooked food and drinks to eating temperature using appliances or gentle heat.
groups.summary_zh: 利用微波炉或炊具将已烹好的冷食迅速温热或重新热透。
groups.desc_en: To elevate the temperature of cooked or cooled food quickly, differing from cooking from scratch by merely restoring lost heat to prior culinary state.
groups.desc_zh: 将已冷却或剩留的熟食迅速重新升温，不同于从生料做起的基础烹饪，侧重于快速恢复食物温热状态。
groups.nuance_en: warm up: gently raise the temperature of food to eating warmth (leftovers / soup / milk) · microwave: heat or cook using microwave radiation (meal / coffee / dinner) · nuke: informal, aggressive and rapid heating in a microwave (burrito / pizza / mug) · zap: quick targeted heating or reheating via electric microwave pulse (casserole / cup / bowl) · reheat: formally heat cooled cooked food back up to serving temperature (curry / leftovers / food)
groups.nuance_zh: warm up: 温和地加热残羹冷炙 (leftovers / soup / milk) · microwave: 采用微波辐射加热 (meal / coffee / dinner) · nuke: 俚语中用高火猛烈微波加热 (burrito / pizza / mug) · zap: 快捷随性地用微波叮热 (casserole / cup / bowl) · reheat: 正式将冷却食物重新彻底加热 (curry / leftovers / food)

groups.name: Reincarnate & Regenerate · 转世与再生 (Transmigrate, Rebirth, Resurrect)
groups.tip: 生命轮回或再次获得新生

items.def_en: To be born again into a new form of existence or spiritual awareness
items.ex_en: From the ashes of despair, her weary soul was spiritually reborn anew.
items.ex_zh: 从绝望的灰烬中，她疲惫的心灵获得了精神上的新生。

items.def_en: To bring a dead person back to life, or bring back an obsolete custom or practice
items.ex_en: The council sought to resurrect an archaic municipal bylaw governing street vendors.
items.ex_zh: 市议会试图恢复一项关于街头小贩的已废除的地方法规。

items.def_en: To grow again after damage or loss, or breathe new life and vigor into an organism or area
items.ex_en: The wounded forest began slowly to regenerate its canopy after the blight.
items.ex_zh: 虫害过后，受创的森林开始慢慢再生出茂密的树冠。
items.ex2_en: Certain marine organisms can regenerate damaged tissue structures within a few days.
items.ex2_zh: 某些海洋生物能在几天之内再生受损的组织结构。

items.def_zh: 使转世，使再生；转世，获得新生
items.def_en: 1. (usually passive) To cause a soul or spirit to be born again into another body after death. 2. To be born again into another body or form.
items.ex_en: Believers maintain that virtuous souls will reincarnate into nobler beings across lifetimes.
items.ex_zh: 信徒坚信，品德高尚的灵魂将在生生世世中转世为更高尚的存在。
items.ex2_en: Ancient mythologies reincarnate legendary heroes into powerful woodland spirits across generations.
items.ex2_zh: 古老的神话将传说中的英雄代代转生为强大的森林神灵。

items.def_en: To pass into another body after death, used of the soul or spirit
items.ex_en: Ancient mystics taught that righteous spirits transmigrate into peaceful realms after death.
items.ex_zh: 古代神秘学家教导说，正直的灵魂在死后会转世至宁静的国度。

groups.summary_en: This spiritual and biological frame covers the passing of life, consciousness, or essence into a new physical body or state after death. It extends to mythical resurrections and metaphorical revitalization of depleted vitality.
groups.summary_zh: 表示灵魂转世受身、肉身再造或生机重现的生命形态流转。
groups.desc_en: To enter a new cycle of biological, bodily, or spiritual existence after death or destruction, differing from ordinary recovery by involving total ontological rebirth.
groups.desc_zh: 在死亡、毁灭或消逝后跨入全新的生命轮回或躯体形态，不同于单纯的病体康复，强调本体论意义上的再生或转生。
groups.nuance_en: reborn: spiritually or conceptually renewed into a new identity (soul / spirit / believer) · resurrect: restore explicitly from the dead or total obsolescence (body / corpse / career) · regenerate: biologically regrow tissue or undergo systemic vitality renewal (tissue / organ / economy) · reincarnate: pass into a concrete new fleshly physical body across lifetimes (soul / spirit / avatar) · transmigrate: pass metaphysically from one body or plane to another upon death (soul / essence / consciousness)
groups.nuance_zh: reborn: 精神上或隐喻层面的脱胎换骨重生 (soul / spirit / believer) · resurrect: 使死者还阳起死回生或令枯木逢春 (body / corpse / career) · regenerate: 生物组织器官再生或体系自我更新 (tissue / organ / economy) · reincarnate: 灵魂历经轮回投胎转世 (soul / spirit / avatar) · transmigrate: 亡魂在不同肉身或维界间超脱迁移 (soul / essence / consciousness)

groups.name: Reinstate & Leave Intact · 保留原样与撤销删除 (Restore, Stand, Leave)
groups.tip: 校对符号示意保持原样不改

items.def_en: To remain valid, unaltered, or in full force despite challenges or proposed changes
items.ex_en: Despite the noisy protests outside, the referee's controversial call will still stand.
items.ex_zh: 尽管外面抗议声嘈杂，裁判引发争议的判罚仍将维持不变。

items.def_en: To decide not to cut, edit out, or delete a piece of text or footage
items.ex_en: The director decided to leave the scene in the final cut of the movie.
items.ex_zh: 导演决定在电影的最终剪辑版中保留那个镜头。

items.def_en: To refrain from changing, interfering with, or editing something
items.ex_en: The editor told the intern to leave alone the author's peculiar phrasing.
items.ex_zh: 编辑吩咐实习生不要动作者独特的措辞，搁置原样即可。

items.def_zh: 恢复（原职、原状或原条文）
items.def_en: To restore a deleted item, former condition, position, or rule to effective status
items.ex_en: The tribunal ordered the corporation to reinstate the wrongfully discharged safety inspector.
items.ex_zh: 仲裁庭责令该公司恢复被错误解雇的安全督察员的原职。

items.def_zh: （在校对稿上）注以“保留”字样，指示维持原状
items.def_en: (printing) to mark proofread text with 'stet' to instruct that a previously deleted or altered word should remain unchanged
items.ex_en: The meticulous proofreader chose to stet the struck phrase in the delicate manuscript margin.
items.ex_zh: 这位严谨的校对员在精致的手稿边缘注明“保留”被划掉的词组。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this technical and procedural frame govern countermanding an alteration, deletion, or amendment so that the original text, decision, or state remains in force.
groups.summary_zh: 指推翻修改或删除决定，指示维持原貌、恢复原有文本或条款。
groups.desc_en: To reverse a proposed deletion, strikeout, or suspension so that the original matter remains valid and authoritative, contrasting with creating new status.
groups.desc_zh: 撤销原定的划除、废止或休止决定，使原有条文、状态或人员原样保留并继续有效，区别于重新制定新章。
groups.nuance_en: stand: remain formally valid and unchanged despite challenge (ruling / order / decision) · leave in: intentionally retain disputed text or footage without cutting (scene / paragraph / clause) · leave alone: refrain from interfering with or altering existing conditions (settings / text / arrangement) · reinstate: formally restore a suspended person, law, or condition to full power (license / policy / employee) · stet: editorial instruction marking struck-out text to be preserved as originally written (copy / wording / passage)
groups.nuance_zh: stand: 经受质疑后原结论仍旧确立生效 (ruling / order / decision) · leave in: 审校或剪辑中特意保留原样未作删剪 (scene / paragraph / clause) · leave alone: 保持原状不加干涉变动 (settings / text / arrangement) · reinstate: 撤销停职停用决定而恢复原职原状 (license / policy / employee) · stet: 编校校对术语“抹去删改、保留原字” (copy / wording / passage)

groups.name: Reinstate & Put Back in Place · 重新就位与恢复安装 (Reinstate, Restore, Re-seat)
groups.tip: 放置安装于指定空间

items.def_en: Bring something back to its former location, functional condition, or active use
items.ex_en: Specialists worked diligently to restore the antique mechanical clock to full working order.
items.ex_zh: 专家们努力工作，使这座古董机械钟恢复了正常的运转状态。

items.def_en: Return an item or component to the exact physical place it previously occupied
items.ex_en: Please put the reference manual back on the top shelf after consulting it.
items.ex_zh: 查阅完毕后，请把参考手册放回最上层的书架上。

items.def_zh: 使复职，使恢复原职/原位
items.def_en: Restore someone or something to their previous position, post, or operational status
items.ex_en: The board resolved to reinstate the chief executive after the internal investigation cleared him.
items.ex_zh: 内部调查证明首席执行官清白后，董事会决定恢复其职务。

items.def_en: To put equipment, software, or an official back into place or position again.
items.ex_en: The technician had to reinstall the operational firmware to resolve persistent system errors.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员不得不重新安装运行固件以解决持续出现的系统错误。

items.def_en: Fit out, replace parts, or repair equipment and fixtures inside a vessel or structure
items.ex_en: The shipping company decided to refit the aging trawler with modern navigation gear.
items.ex_zh: 航运公司决定为这艘老化的拖网渔船重新装配现代导航设备。

groups.summary_en: This frame involves putting mechanical equipment, functional systems, or human officials back into their previous physical mounts or authorized operational positions after removal. The key nuance is repetition and return to a prior state.
groups.summary_zh: 指将设备、部件或人员重新安装到原有物理位置或恢复其既定职能与地位。
groups.desc_en: To physically restore or remount a displaced object, component, or person into their exact original installation point, differing from initial installation by re-establishing prior configuration.
groups.desc_zh: 将移位或拆卸的物件、配件重新安装复位回原位，不同于初次安装，强调重回旧有的空间与物理定位。
groups.nuance_en: restore: bring a dismantled item or fixture back to original placement and soundness (paving / monument / statue) · put back: colloquial everyday physical return of an object to its slot (receiver / tool / book) · reinstate: procedurally re-establish a dislocated physical element to its prior position (bollard / partition / boundary) · reinstall: perform the technical mechanical mounting or software re-setup (valve / software / engine) · refit: precisely equip or re-seat a mechanical or architectural component (propeller / panel / bolt)
groups.nuance_zh: restore: 将拆除移位之物复位并修护至原初状态 (paving / monument / statue) · put back: 日常随手把移开物件放回原处 (receiver / tool / book) · reinstate: 依规将地桩设施等重新安放就位 (bollard / partition / boundary) · reinstall: 重新进行技术组装或软件二次安装 (valve / software / engine) · refit: 精准装配复位船用或精密机械部件 (propeller / panel / bolt)

groups.name: Relay & Pass Along · 转达与中继传递 (Relay, Pass on, Forward)
groups.tip: 将信息、指令中转接力传达

items.def_en: To resend a received message, email, or letter to a new address
items.ex_en: Please forward the confidential inquiry directly to the director's official email address.
items.ex_zh: 请将该保密咨询函直接转寄至主管的官方电子邮箱。

items.def_en: To act as a conduit to pass words, ideas, or feelings from someone else
items.ex_en: The diplomat skillfully channeled the minister's concerns during the bilateral trade negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 外交官在双边贸易谈判中巧妙地转达了部长的关切。

items.def_en: To give someone something that another person has given or told you
items.ex_en: I will pass on your detailed suggestions to the committee during tomorrow's session.
items.ex_zh: 我会在明天的会议上将您的详细建议转达给委员会。

items.def_en: To deliver a formal decision or pass knowledge down through an intermediary
items.ex_en: The appellate court will hand down its ruling on the disputed contract tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 上诉法院将于明天就这起有争议的合同案传达正式裁决。

items.def_zh: 转达，传达；转播，接力传送
items.def_en: 1. To receive information, news, or a message and pass it on to someone else. 2. To receive and pass on a television or radio broadcast signal.
items.ex_en: The field commander will relay the vital tactical coordinates to the headquarters staff.
items.ex_zh: 野战指挥官将把至关重要的战术坐标传达给司令部参谋。

groups.summary_en: Verbs focusing on the intermediate step of receiving a message, instruction, or signal from one source and dutifully transmitting it along the chain to its destination.
groups.summary_zh: 指作为中间环节接收信息并向后继人员或节点转达。
groups.desc_en: To transmit messages, signals, or physical things through an intermediary sequence to a recipient, contrasting with direct origination by acting as a forwarding pipeline.
groups.desc_zh: 作为中间人或中继站，将信息、信号或物品转递给下一棒受众，不同于源头自主发布，强调中介性与流转链路。
groups.nuance_en: forward: re-send received communications onward to a new address (email / letter / request) · channel: direct resources, expressions, or data along a defined conduit (funds / energy / information) · pass on: informally transmit received information or tokens to another person (message / news / cost) · hand down: pass tradition, law, or heirloom through hierarchical or generational lineage (tradition / verdict / heirloom) · relay: pick up an incoming broadcast or message and beam it forward (instructions / signal / order)
groups.nuance_zh: forward: 顺延邮址电邮转寄 (email / letter / request) · channel: 疏导调配引流至特定渠道 (funds / energy / information) · pass on: 顺手转达口信或分摊成本 (message / news / cost) · hand down: 世代相传或法庭正式下达判决 (tradition / verdict / heirloom) · relay: 接力转达指令或中继发射信号 (instructions / signal / order)

groups.name: Relocate & Resettle Displaced People · 重新安置与妥善庇护 (Resettle, Relocate, Billet)
groups.tip: 重新安排居民或拆迁户住房

items.def_en: Provide shelter, living quarters, or residential space for individuals or families
items.ex_en: Local authorities managed to house dozens of displaced families in temporary residential quarters.
items.ex_zh: 地方当局设法在临时居住区安置了数十户流离失所的家庭。

items.def_en: Provide lodging, rooms, or sufficient physical space for persons needing shelter
items.ex_en: The newly built municipal shelter can comfortably accommodate over two hundred displaced citizens.
items.ex_zh: 新建的市政避难所可为两百多名流离失所的居民提供食宿。

items.def_en: Move people or whole establishments to a different place or accommodation
items.ex_en: The ministry decided to relocate flood victims to safer housing developments up north.
items.ex_zh: 该部决定将洪水灾民迁往北部更安全的住宅区定居。
items.ex2_en: Many growing tech startups relocate to coastal cities seeking skilled creative talent.
items.ex2_zh: 许多成长型科技初创公司为了寻求技术创新人才而迁往沿海城市。

items.def_zh: 重新定居，安置（移民/难民）
items.def_en: Settle people in a new area, community, or country, especially following displacement
items.ex_en: International relief organizations helped resettle hundreds of displaced refugees across several tranquil towns.
items.ex_zh: 国际救援组织帮助将数百名流离失所的难民安置在几个宁静的小镇上。
items.ex2_en: Displaced communities will gradually resettle in newly constructed residential suburbs nearby.
items.ex2_zh: 流离失所的社区居民将逐渐在附近新建的住宅郊区重新定居。

items.def_zh: 给……提供新住所，为……重新安排住房
items.def_en: To provide a new home or housing for people whose existing homes have been damaged, demolished, or are unsuitable.
items.ex_en: The city council plans to rehouse displaced residents whose tenements were severely damaged.
items.ex_zh: 市议会计划为房屋严重受损的流离失所居民重新安排住房。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to administrative or state actions providing new dwelling spaces, refuge, or community accommodation to displaced, homeless, or evacuated individuals. Distinctions reflect permanent community moving versus emergency sheltering.
groups.summary_zh: 指政府或机构为流离失所、拆迁或灾后群众安排新居所或整体迁移落户。
groups.desc_en: To systematically organize shelter and new living locations for displaced populations, differing from ordinary migration by its logistical, protective, or institutional intervention.
groups.desc_zh: 有组织地为流离失所者安排庇护所与新居所，不同于自发性迁徙，强调制度性救济、物流调配与安置保障。
groups.nuance_en: house: provide physical roof and shelter for people (refugees / homeless / displaced) · accommodate: provide temporary lodgings or space needs (evacuees / troops / families) · relocate: systematically move populations to an alternate geographical site (residents / villagers / population) · resettle: establish permanent livelihoods and housing in a new region (refugees / communities / families) · rehouse: provide permanent improved local authority dwellings for dislodged tenants (tenants / victims / families)
groups.nuance_zh: house: 为无家可归者提供遮风挡雨的住处 (refugees / homeless / displaced) · accommodate: 提供临时客舍或床位以满足容纳需求 (evacuees / troops / families) · relocate: 有组织地整体易地迁徙人口 (residents / villagers / population) · resettle: 异地安家扎根并恢复生计 (refugees / communities / families) · rehouse: 政府或机构重新为拆迁户配租安居 (tenants / victims / families)

groups.name: Rely & Count On · 依靠与寄托信任 (Depend, Rely, Lean)
groups.tip: 倚仗依托外界助力

items.def_zh: 依靠，指望（depend on/upon）；取决于，视……而定
items.def_en: 1. (depend on/upon) to rely on someone or something for help, support, or money. 2. (depend on/upon) to be determined or conditioned by something.
items.ex_en: Frail pensioners often depend on local welfare programs for their daily subsistence needs.
items.ex_zh: 体弱的退休人员往往依赖当地的福利项目来维持日常生计。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) to trust or need someone or something to provide help, support, or a required result
items.ex_en: Commuters rely upon the regional train service to reach the bustling downtown core.
items.ex_zh: 通勤人员仰仗地区列车服务前往繁华的市中心区域。

items.def_en: to expect and trust that someone or something will be reliable and help you
items.ex_en: You can always count on David to deliver results under pressure.
items.ex_zh: 在大卫身上，你总能指望他在压力下交出漂亮的成绩。

items.def_zh: 依靠，依仗（精神或外在支持）
items.def_en: to depend on someone heavily for emotional or financial support, especially in difficulty
items.ex_en: She had to lean heavily on her family during those tough months.
items.ex_zh: 在那段艰难的岁月里，她不得不极度依赖家人的支持。

items.def_en: to be confident about something happening and base your plans entirely upon it
items.ex_en: I wouldn't bank on getting a promotion this year given the company's financial state.
items.ex_zh: 考虑到公司的财务状况，我不会指望今年能获得晋升。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses relational and functional reliance, where an agent needs the assistance, support, or loyalty of someone or something to survive or function.
groups.summary_zh: 强调在生活、情感或事务上仰仗、托付他人或外物的支持。
groups.desc_en: To place psychological trust or operational expectation upon someone or something, differing from certain knowledge by relying on anticipated faithfulness or stability.
groups.desc_zh: 将心理信任或行动寄托于某人或某事，不同于板上钉钉的确凿认知，依赖于对预期忠诚度与稳定性的主观寄托。
groups.nuance_en: depend: hinge conditionally on another's support or actions (dependents / support / assistance) · rely: trust firmly based on past track record and competence (data / friend / judgment) · count on: confidently expect dependable support when needed (backing / cooperation / loyalty) · lean on: exert emotional or persuasive dependence during hardship (family / mentor / crutch) · bank on: gamble one's success confidently upon an expected future event (recovery / luck / outcome)
groups.nuance_zh: depend: 依附并取决于他方之助力 (dependents / support / assistance) · rely: 基于过往信誉而笃信依赖 (data / friend / judgment) · count on: 指望在关键时刻获得可靠后盾 (backing / cooperation / loyalty) · lean on: 困顿时寻求精神或人脉倚重 (family / mentor / crutch) · bank on: 孤注一掷押宝于某一未来事件 (recovery / luck / outcome)

groups.name: Rely & Depend · 依赖与倚仗 (Count On, Lean On, Bank On)
groups.tip: 笃信对方托付依靠

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To need someone or something in order to survive, function, or succeed
items.ex_en: Small farmers depend on seasonal monsoon rainfall to sustain their staple cereal crops.
items.ex_zh: 小农户依赖季节性季风降雨来维持其主要粮食作物的收成。

items.def_zh: 依赖，依靠（rely on/upon）；指望，信任
items.def_en: (rely on/upon) to depend on or trust someone or something to provide support, help, or a particular result
items.ex_en: Medical researchers rely on verified trial outcomes to support their latest scientific hypotheses.
items.ex_zh: 医学研究人员指望经过验证的试验结果来支持他们最新的科学假说。

items.def_en: To expect and trust someone to assist you or act reliably in times of need
items.ex_en: You can always count on David to deliver results under pressure.
items.ex_zh: 在大卫身上，你总能指望他在压力下交出漂亮的成绩。

items.def_en: To base your hopes or future plans on something definitely happening
items.ex_en: I wouldn't bank on getting a promotion this year given the company's financial state.
items.ex_zh: 考虑到公司的财务状况，我不会指望今年能获得晋升。

items.def_en: To turn to someone for guidance, comfort, or financial support during adversity
items.ex_en: She had to lean heavily on her family during those tough months.
items.ex_zh: 在那段艰难的岁月里，她不得不极度依赖家人的支持。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame emphasize instrumental dependence, where one leans upon another party, system, or expected outcome for vital support, assistance, or fulfillment.
groups.summary_zh: 指在生活、行动或决策上倚靠、指望特定人事物提供支撑或保障。
groups.desc_en: To rest functionally, physically, or conditionally upon an entity for survival or success, differing from purely mental expectation by involving actual vulnerability and structural contingency.
groups.desc_zh: 在功能、生存或条件上完全系于外部主体，不同于纯粹的主观期许，强调结构性依存与受制于人的脆弱性。
groups.nuance_en: depend: be structurally conditioned or sustained by an external factor (supply / weather / revenue) · rely: lean critically on an indispensable resource or system to function (subsidies / import / transport) · count on: presuppose availability of support as a working premise (revenue / allies / votes) · bank on: construct entire plans contingent upon an assumed windfall (growth / bailout / miracle) · lean on: draw continuously upon external resources or pressure someone for aid (parents / government / sponsors)
