groups.nuance_zh: depend: 随外部条件而定或受其维系支撑 (supply / weather / revenue) · rely: 高度倚赖不可或缺的核心资源运转 (subsidies / import / transport) · count on: 将某支持力视作既定前提 (revenue / allies / votes) · bank on: 把全盘身家押注在预期利好上 (growth / bailout / miracle) · lean on: 持续借力外援或施压索取资助 (parents / government / sponsors)

groups.name: Remark & Comment · 置评与指陈 (Remark, Comment, Observe)
groups.tip: 正式声明观点并顺带评点

items.def_en: (+ on) To utter an evaluative opinion or critical appraisal regarding a matter
items.ex_en: The official spokesperson declined to pass comment on the pending parliamentary ethics investigation.
items.ex_zh: 官方发言人拒绝对审理中的议会伦理调查发表品评意见。

items.def_en: To mention something important so that people notice it or pay attention to it
items.ex_en: The auditor felt obliged to note several major accounting discrepancies in the dossier.
items.ex_zh: 审计员认为有必要指出卷宗中的几处重大账目出入。

items.def_en: (+ on) To express an opinion, explanation, or judgment about an event, person, or situation
items.ex_en: Several prominent economists gathered to comment on the central bank's abrupt policy shift.
items.ex_zh: 几位著名经济学家聚集在一起，就央行突然的政策转变发表评论。

items.def_en: To make a formal remark or state an observation regarding what one has seen or deduced
items.ex_en: The seasoned ambassador rose to observe that diplomatic progress demanded exceptional mutual patience.
items.ex_zh: 这位资深大使起身评述道，外交进展需要双方非同寻常的耐心。

items.def_zh: 谈及，说起，发表评论；注意到
items.def_en: 1. To say or write something as a comment or observation. 2. (formal) To notice or observe something.
items.ex_en: The foreign visitor remarked that the historic cathedral architecture was remarkably well preserved.
items.ex_zh: 外国游客谈及这座历史悠久的大教堂建筑保存得异常完好。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe expressing an evaluative observation, spontaneous perception, or short critical thought in response to an event or circumstance.
groups.summary_zh: 针对观察到的现象发表评述、见解或感想。
groups.desc_en: To offer a considered oral or written observation on an ongoing event, differing from simple stating by conveying an evaluative or reactive perspective.
groups.desc_zh: 就眼下所见或突发事态公开发表带有观察性质的点评，不同于普通陈述，侧重反应性与主观评析视角。
groups.nuance_en: pass comment: venture a critical or casual opinion on someone else's affairs (situation / appearance / performance) · note: record or point out a factual observation dispassionately (fact / discrepancy / trend) · comment: offer explicit explanatory, analytical, or reactive remarks (situation / case / affairs) · observe: voice a measured insight gleaned through attentive watching (behaviour / change / phenomenon) · remark: spontaneously mention a notable characteristic or passing thought (resemblance / irony / change)
groups.nuance_zh: pass comment: 对他人之事随意插话指点置评 (situation / appearance / performance) · note: 冷静客观地指出并记录某一事实 (fact / discrepancy / trend) · comment: 正式就事件发表评论或意见 (situation / case / affairs) · observe: 细致观察后发表富有洞察力的见解 (behaviour / change / phenomenon) · remark: 随口道出惹人注意的特质或感触 (resemblance / irony / change)

groups.name: Remind & Prompt · 提醒与提示 (Prompt, Jog, Cue)
groups.tip: 唤起记忆或提示下一步行动

items.def_en: 1. To tell someone something they might have forgotten or to prompt them to take action. 2. To cause someone to remember or think of something.
items.ex_en: Please remind the senior accountant to sign the monthly payroll before noon today.
items.ex_zh: 请提醒高级会计师在今天中午之前签署月度工资单。

items.def_en: To remind an actor of their line, or nudge someone to remember or speak
items.ex_en: The stage manager stood in the wings to prompt the nervous lead actor.
items.ex_zh: 舞台监督站在侧幕后，准备给紧张的主角演员提示台词。

items.def_en: To give a signal or reminder to someone to say or do something
items.ex_en: The floor director will cue the news anchor to begin the live broadcast.
items.ex_zh: 现场导播将向新闻主播发出提示信号，开始现场直播。

items.def_en: To stimulate someone's memory through a clue or reference (+ one's memory)
items.ex_en: The familiar scent of lavender helped jog her memory about her grandmother's garden.
items.ex_zh: 熟悉的薰衣草香气唤起了她对祖母花园的记忆。

items.def_en: To gently remind or coax someone to take a necessary action
items.ex_en: She gently nudged her hesitant brother to finalize his written job application today.
items.ex_zh: 她温和地提示犹豫不决的弟弟今天务必完成书面求职申请。

groups.summary_en: Denotes stimulating someone's memory, jogging their awareness, or nudging them into saying or performing an intended action.
groups.summary_zh: 唤起对方记忆或及时给予提示以促成行动。
groups.desc_en: To trigger another person's dormant memory or prompt an intended action, contrasting with formal teaching by merely activating existing knowledge or plans.
groups.desc_zh: 触发他人的潜在记忆或督促进展，不同于系统的教授灌输，强调通过外力轻微催化既有知觉或意向。
groups.nuance_en: remind: actively trigger a latent conscious memory or duty (colleague / reader / driver) · prompt: supply an actor or speaker with missed lines or spur overdue action (speaker / investigation / payment) · cue: deliver a prearranged signal signaling the moment to act (actor / soloist / team) · jog: give a sharp stimulus to dislodge a stuck memory (memory / brain / recollection) · nudge: give an affectionate or gentle poke toward an overdue behavior (student / government / borrower)
groups.nuance_zh: remind: 提醒想起职责或淡忘之事 (colleague / reader / driver) · prompt: 提示台词或催生促发行动 (speaker / investigation / payment) · cue: 给出暗号以提示登场或动作 (actor / soloist / team) · jog: 敲打点拨唤醒沉睡模糊的记忆 (memory / brain / recollection) · nudge: 轻轻推一把以促成预定举动 (student / government / borrower)

groups.name: Reminisce & Recall · 回忆与追忆 (Recall, Look back, Recollect)
groups.tip: 抚今追昔重温往日记忆

items.def_en: (+ to) To remember or refer to an earlier event, topic, or bygone period
items.ex_en: Her nostalgic poems frequently hark back to quiet childhood afternoons in rural Yorkshire.
items.ex_zh: 她那怀旧的诗篇常常追溯起在约克郡乡村度过的宁静童年午后。

items.def_en: (+ on/at) To reflect on or think about events that happened in the past
items.ex_en: Elderly veterans gathered at the memorial to look back on their wartime camaraderie.
items.ex_zh: 年迈的老兵聚集在纪念碑前，回忆起战争时期的袍泽之情。

items.def_en: To retrieve a memory of someone or something from the past into consciousness
items.ex_en: The witness struggled to recall the exact sequence of events before the crash.
items.ex_zh: 目击者难以回想起撞车事故发生前的确切事件顺序。

items.def_en: To deliberately bring facts or events back into memory
items.ex_en: The retired magistrate could clearly recollect every detail of that historic criminal proceeding.
items.ex_zh: 这位退休法官能清晰地忆起那场历史性刑事审判的每一个细节。

items.def_en: (+ about/over) To talk, write, or think with pleasure about past events and experiences.
items.ex_en: The childhood friends sat together to reminisce about their carefree university holidays abroad.
items.ex_zh: 童年伙伴围坐在一起，怀念起他们在国外无忧无虑的大学假期。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on mentally retrieving past episodes and sentimentally sharing nostalgic memories of earlier times with wistfulness, pleasure, or reflection.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动调取往昔记忆或带有怀旧温情地重温、倾诉旧事。
groups.desc_en: To mentally retrieve past personal or collective episodes and savour or contemplate them, differing from clinical data retrieval by rich affective engagement.
groups.desc_zh: 从记忆深处调取往昔个人或群体经历并加以回味反思，不同于冷冰冰的数据检索，带有丰富的情感投入与怀旧色彩。
groups.nuance_en: hark back: deliberately or compulsively return to an earlier bygone era (youth / past / tradition) · look back: survey past life events from present temporal vantage (years / career / life) · recall: retrieve and state a concrete past fact or circumstance (name / detail / conversation) · recollect: deliberately piece together fragmented memories through effort (events / address / incident) · reminisce: indulge in warm, nostalgic conversation about shared past times (days / youth / experiences)
groups.nuance_zh: hark back: 动辄言必称当年或重拾旧章 (youth / past / tradition) · look back: 站在当下回溯检视流年岁月 (years / career / life) · recall: 清楚唤起并陈述特定细节事实 (name / detail / conversation) · recollect: 费力拼凑回想模糊的记忆碎片 (events / address / incident) · reminisce: 与故人促膝温情忆旧叙当年 (days / youth / experiences)

groups.name: Renege & Default · 违约与背信 (Renege, Welsh, Back out)
groups.tip: 赌输赖账背弃先前承诺

items.def_en: (+ of) To decide not to do something previously agreed upon
items.ex_en: The nervous investor decided to back out of the risky corporate venture early.
items.ex_zh: 这名紧张的投资者决定提早退出这项高风险的企业合资项目。
items.ex2_en: The experienced driver carefully backed the delivery truck out of the tight loading bay.
items.ex2_zh: 经验丰富的司机小心翼翼地把送货卡车倒出了狭窄的装卸区。

items.def_en: (informal) To avoid doing something that one ought to do through fear or dishonesty
items.ex_en: You promised to lead the community outreach, so do not cop out now.
items.ex_zh: 你答应过要带头开展社区推广，所以现在可不要临阵退缩。

items.def_en: (+ on) To fail to honor a debt, bet, or agreement
items.ex_en: The dishonest gambler tried to welsh on his substantial debts after the match.
items.ex_zh: 那名不诚实的赌徒在比赛结束后企图赖掉他的巨额赌债。

items.def_zh: 赖账，失信，违约（尤指赌债）
items.def_en: (+ on) (informal) To fail to pay a debt or honor an agreement (variant spelling of welsh).
items.ex_en: Nobody respected the shady promoter who attempted to welch on his explicit promises.
items.ex_zh: 没人尊重那个企图对其明确承诺违约失信的黑心推手。

items.def_en: (+ on) To fail to carry out a promise, agreement, or formal commitment
items.ex_en: The foreign supplier threatened to renege on its contractual deliveries amid rising costs.
items.ex_zh: 在成本上升的压力下，这家外国供应商扬言要违背供货合同。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe failing to honor a promise, deal, or financial debt, especially in an informal or dishonorable way. They contrast between backing out of a pledged agreement and dodging an outright payment.
groups.summary_zh: 指违背诺言、协定或赖账不还的背信与逃避行为。
groups.desc_en: To dishonorably abandon or fail to fulfill a pledged commitment, promise, or contractual bet, contrasting with lawful termination by breach of trust.
groups.desc_zh: 不守信用地单方面推翻、撕毁承诺或赌约，不同于合规解除合同，带有强烈的背信弃义或临阵脱逃色彩。
groups.nuance_en: back out: withdraw cowardly from an agreement prior to completion (deal / commitment / plan) · cop out: evade an onerous responsibility by choosing an easy excuse (responsibility / obligation / task) · welsh: deceitfully fail to pay off a gambling debt or promised obligation (bet / debt / promise) · welch: alternate variant of welsh, defaulting dishonorably on wagers (wager / agreement / loss) · renege: formally or blatantly breach an explicit solemn vow or deal (pledge / promise / contract)
groups.nuance_zh: back out: 在达成协议后临阵退缩毁约 (deal / commitment / plan) · cop out: 找借口避重就轻逃避担当 (responsibility / obligation / task) · welsh: 赖账逃赌而不履行赌注承诺 (bet / debt / promise) · welch: welsh的异体，昧着良心赖债不还 (wager / agreement / loss) · renege: 公然食言反悔正式契约或誓言 (pledge / promise / contract)

groups.name: Rent & Lease Property · 租借与租赁 (Rent, Lease, Hire, Charter)
groups.tip: 支付租金获取使用权

items.def_en: To allow someone to live in or use a room, house, or land in exchange for regular rent payments
items.ex_en: The elderly landlord intends to let the furnished downtown apartment to university graduates.
items.ex_zh: 这位老房东打算把市中心配备家具的公寓出租给大学毕业生。

items.def_en: To pay money to borrow something such as a car, tool, or clothes for a short period
items.ex_en: Tourists often hire heavy bicycles to explore the scenic coastal trails during autumn.
items.ex_zh: 游客们常在秋天短租厚重的自行车去游览风景优美的海岸步道。

items.def_en:
1. to pay money regularly to use land, a house, car, or other property
2. to allow someone to use something you own in exchange for regular payments
items.ex_en: They agreed to rent a charming seaside cottage for three weeks this summer.
items.ex_zh: 他们同意今年夏天租用一处迷人的海滨小屋，为期三周。

items.def_en: To make a formal legal agreement to use or let someone use land, buildings, or equipment for a set period
items.ex_en: The expanding enterprise signed a binding contract to lease the newly completed warehouse.
items.ex_zh: 这家扩张中的企业签署了具有约束力的合同，长期租用新落成的仓库。

items.def_en: To rent an entire aircraft, boat, or vehicle for a particular journey or group
items.ex_en: The scientific delegation arranged to charter a private jet for their polar mission.
items.ex_zh: 科学代表团安排包租一架私人飞机以执行他们的极地任务。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the contractual arrangement where temporary use of property, vehicles, or goods is granted in exchange for periodic payments. It contrasts long-term formal agreements with short-term hires.
groups.summary_zh: 以定期支付费用为条件，出租或承租房屋、车辆等资产的行为。
groups.desc_en: To grant or secure temporary operational custody and use of property, vehicle, or equipment in return for consideration, contrasting with outright purchase or lending without charge.
groups.desc_zh: 通过支付对价换取不动产、车辆或设备的阶段性合法使用权，不同于完全产权买断或无偿出借借用。
groups.nuance_en: let: British primary for landlord granting rental occupancy of real estate (flat / room / premises) · hire: pay for short-term temporary use of services or movable items (car / hall / equipment) · rent: universally pay regular fees for ongoing use of property or goods (apartment / car / tools) · lease: secure legal long-term contractual possession of commercial capital (building / land / fleet) · charter: contract exclusive total use of a vehicle or vessel along with its crew (plane / boat / bus)
groups.nuance_zh: let: 英系用法中房东放盘出租房屋地产 (flat / room / premises) · hire: 支付短期租金租用动产或场地设备 (car / hall / equipment) · rent: 通用定期付费租住不动产或器具 (apartment / car / tools) · lease: 签订具有法定约束力的长期租赁契约 (building / land / fleet) · charter: 斥资整车整机包租船舶飞机及乘员 (plane / boat / bus)

groups.name: Reopen & Resume · 开放与复业 (Reopen, Restart, Revive)
groups.tip: 公共场所重新开门营业或开放

items.def_zh: 重新开门营业；解封恢复
items.def_en: To reopen to the public or customers after being shut down
items.ex_en: The renovated public library will finally open back up to local readers tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 翻新后的公共图书馆终于将在明天重新向当地读者开门开放。
items.ex2_en: The management plans to open back up the city museum next week.
items.ex2_zh: 管理层计划下周重新向公众开放市立博物馆。

items.def_en: To begin again after an interruption or cessation
items.ex_en: The transit authority will resume normal passenger rail operations early tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 客运管理部门将于明早恢复正常的旅客铁路运营业务。
items.ex2_en: Regular passenger flights will resume tomorrow after severe blizzards clear the runway.
items.ex2_zh: 暴风雪清理跑道后，定期客运航班将于明日恢复运行。

items.def_en: To start operating, functioning, or providing services again
items.ex_en: Technicians had to restart the central generators following an abrupt provincial power outage.
items.ex_zh: 在全省突发停电后，技术人员不得不重新启动中央发电机。
items.ex2_en: The stalled diesel engine restarted smoothly after fresh fuel filled the tanks.
items.ex2_zh: 新燃油注入油箱后，熄火的柴油发动机顺利重新启动了。

items.def_zh: 重新开放，重开；重新审理
items.def_en: To open or begin again after being closed or paused, such as a business, school, or investigation.
items.ex_en: The historical museum will reopen its grand exhibition gallery to tourists next Tuesday.
items.ex_zh: 历史博物馆将于下周二向游客重新开放其宏伟的展览主厅。
items.ex2_en: Local schools will reopen early next month following the extended winter holiday.
items.ex2_zh: 经过漫长的寒假后，当地学校将于下月初重新开学。

items.def_zh: 使重新运作；恢复有效状态
items.def_en: To make something active, operational, or effective again
items.ex_en: The agency moved quickly to reactivate suspended user credentials following verified identity checks.
items.ex_zh: 在核实身份信息后，该机构迅速恢复了被暂停的用户凭据。
items.ex2_en: Dormant cell lines often reactivate when exposed to specific nutrient growth factors.
items.ex2_zh: 休眠的细胞系在接触到特定营养生长因子时往往会重新激活。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on restoring operations, public access, or legal and institutional processes after a period of closure, suspension, or recess.
groups.summary_zh: 结束休整、停摆或封锁，重新开放或恢复运营。
groups.desc_en: To bring a previously closed, suspended, or mothballed facility or operation back into functioning life, differing from initial founding by restoring interrupted momentum.
groups.desc_zh: 让先前关闭、停摆或封存的场所、服务与运营重新运转复苏，不同于新开业，强调克服中断后的重启与复常。
groups.nuance_en: open back up: informal, gradual reopening of doors to the public (economy / venue / border) · resume: pick up ongoing activity directly after an interruption (operations / talks / service) · restart: initiate the engine or operational cycle completely anew (economy / system / negotiations) · reopen: officially unseal doors and welcome users again (school / case / investigation) · reactivate: re-energize a dormant dormant account, unit, or military status (account / base / link)
groups.nuance_zh: open back up: 口语化指解封后重新向公众开放大门 (economy / venue / border) · resume: 中断后无缝恢复原先业务进程 (operations / talks / service) · restart: 重新点火或重置系统从头启动 (economy / system / negotiations) · reopen: 正式启封开门迎客或重开旧案卷宗 (school / case / investigation) · reactivate: 唤醒休眠已久的账户或重启停用建制 (account / base / link)

groups.name: Replace & Substitute · 替换、替代与换置 (Substitute, Exchange, Swap)
groups.tip: 以新换旧顶替原有

items.def_zh: 代替，取代；更换，替换；把……放回原处
items.def_en: 1. To take the place of someone or something, or put a new thing or person in place of another. 2. To put something back in its correct place.
items.ex_en: The workshop supervisor decided to replace the worn transmission belt with an upgraded component.
items.ex_zh: 车间主管决定用升级版部件更换掉磨损的传动皮带。

items.def_zh: 调换；更换（有缺陷物品等）
items.def_en: To give something and receive something of equal value or type in return
items.ex_en: The customer returned to exchange the defective winter coat for a larger size.
items.ex_zh: 顾客返回店里，调换这件有缺陷的冬大衣为更大的尺码。

items.def_en: (+ for) To use or act as an alternative in place of someone or something else
items.ex_en: The experienced pastry chef chose to substitute almond flour for traditional wheat powder.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的糕点师选择用杏仁粉替代传统的普通小麦面粉。

items.def_en: To replace one item, role, or component with another specific alternative
items.ex_en: The pit crew rushed to switch out the damaged front tire within seconds.
items.ex_zh: 维修站人员迅速冲上前去，在数秒之内换掉了损坏的前胎。

items.def_en: To give one thing in exchange for another, or exchange positions
items.ex_en: The two office colleagues agreed to swap desk locations to get better lighting.
items.ex_zh: 两位办公室同事同意互换工位，以便获得更好的采光条件。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to providing or using an alternative person, component, or item in place of another, whether permanently, symmetrically, or as a temporary expedient.
groups.summary_zh: 指用另一人、事、物来替代现有者，涵盖对调、以物易物或作为临时备用。
groups.desc_en: Involves putting one entity into the functional role, slot, or possession of another, contrasting with mere addition or alteration by requiring slot-filling succession or mutual trade.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及将一个实体置入另一实体的功能角色、槽位或占有权中，与单纯的增添或修改不同，它强调槽位更替或相互对调。
groups.nuance_en: replace: general permanent succession or renewal (part / employee / battery) · substitute: temporary or improvised proxy taking another's place (ingredient / player / teacher) · exchange: reciprocal mutual give-and-take (currency / vows / gifts) · swap: informal direct 1-to-1 trading of equivalents (seats / shirts / shifts) · switch out: physical or modular extraction and substitution (component / bulb / hard drive)
groups.nuance_zh: replace: 最通用的永久性更替或更新 (part / employee / battery) · substitute: 临时或权宜性质的替补代用 (ingredient / player / teacher) · exchange: 双方对等的互换与交换 (currency / vows / gifts) · swap: 非正式的一对一直接互换 (seats / shirts / shifts) · switch out: 具象模块化抽取并换上新件 (component / bulb / hard drive)

groups.name: Replace & Supplant · 取代与篡位 (Displace, Oust, Supersede)
groups.tip: 普通替代乃至强行排挤夺位

items.def_en: To take over the role or position of someone or something, forcing them out of place
items.ex_en: Automated digital systems continue to displace experienced administrative workers across numerous corporate sectors.
items.ex_zh: 自动化数字系统在众多企业部门中持续取代经验丰富的行政人员。

items.def_en: To take the place of an older concept, rule, or machine because of superior effectiveness
items.ex_en: High-speed fiber connections will completely supersede antiquated copper telephone networks within this decade.
items.ex_zh: 高速光纤连接将在未来十年内彻底替代过时的铜线电话网络。

items.def_en: To drive someone out from a position of authority, power, or possession forcibly
items.ex_en: Rebel factions conspired together to oust the authoritarian military dictator from supreme power.
items.ex_zh: 叛军各派系串通一气，企图将这位专制的军事独裁者赶下最高权力宝座。

items.def_en: To take the place of a person, system, or idea, especially by force or superior advantage.
items.ex_en: Innovative digital tablets gradually began to supplant traditional paper notebooks in modern classrooms.
items.ex_zh: 创新的数码平板电脑在现代课堂上逐渐开始取代传统的纸质笔记本。

items.def_en: To seize a throne, office, or legitimate authority wrongfully and without right
items.ex_en: The ambitious general plotted secretly to usurp the rightful authority of the parliament.
items.ex_zh: 野心勃勃的将军秘密策划，企图篡夺议会的合法权力。

groups.summary_en: Covers taking over the position, role, or authority of another, often through superiority, force, technological evolution, or political intrigue.
groups.summary_zh: 通过实力、权力更迭或优胜劣汰而取代、废黜原主。
groups.desc_en: Involves forcefully, competitively, or evolutionarily driving an incumbent out of position or relevance, contrasting with cooperative replacement by asserting unseating dominance.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及通过强力、竞争或演进将原在位者挤出其地位或使之失效，与协作性替换不同，它强调霸位驱逐与不平等取代。
groups.nuance_en: displace: mechanical or systemic pushing aside from a habitual space or role (workers / population / volume) · supersede: rendering obsolete through technological or systemic superiority (regulations / edition / technology) · oust: overt, forceful political or institutional expulsion (dictator / CEO / rival) · supplant: underhanded, gradual, or decisive replacement of primacy (dynasty / theory / rival) · usurp: illegitimate or unlawful seizure of sovereign authority (throne / power / prerogative)
groups.nuance_zh: displace: 机械或系统性地将某物挤出常态空间或角色 (workers / population / volume) · supersede: 凭借技术或代际优越性使旧物过时失效 (regulations / edition / technology) · oust: 强力且公开地通过政治或体制手段驱逐 (dictator / CEO / rival) · supplant: 渐进、暗中或决定性地取代原先主导地位 (dynasty / theory / rival) · usurp: 非法或僭越性地篡夺最高权威与权力 (throne / power / prerogative)

groups.name: Replay & Relive · 画面回放与重历 (Relive, Reenact, Re-create)
groups.tip: 历史或场景再次重放显现

items.def_en: To listen to sounds or watch images that have just been recorded
items.ex_en: The detective played back the surveillance video to catch any missed details.
items.ex_zh: 侦探回放了监控录像，以捕捉任何遗漏的细节。

items.def_zh: 重现，再现；重播，重放；重赛
items.def_en: 1. To experience, imagine, or perform an event or scene again. 2. To play recorded video or audio again. 3. To play a sports match again because of a draw or invalidation.
items.ex_en: Broadcasters decided to replay the decisive penalty kick in ultra-slow motion for viewers.
items.ex_zh: 转播方决定为观众以极慢的动作重放那个决定胜负的点球。

items.def_en: To make a copy of something or cause an effect, sound, or image to happen again
items.ex_en: Modern studio equipment can faithfully reproduce the rich tonal resonance of acoustic instruments.
items.ex_zh: 现代录音室设备能够忠实再现原声乐器那丰富浑厚的音调共鸣。
items.ex2_en: Microscopic bacteria reproduce rapidly under warm and humid laboratory incubator conditions.
items.ex2_zh: 微小的细菌在温暖潮湿的实验室培养箱条件下会迅速繁殖。

items.def_en: To experience an intense past event again in the imagination or emotional memory
items.ex_en: Traumatized survivors often relive the horrifying event through recurring nightmares and intrusive thoughts.
items.ex_zh: 饱受创伤的幸存者往往通过反复出现的噩梦与侵入性念头在心中重温惨剧。

items.def_en: To repeat the actions of an earlier event or historical battle as an actor or demonstrator
items.ex_en: Local historical society volunteers gathered to reenact the decisive eighteenth-century cavalry skirmish.
items.ex_zh: 地方历史协会的志愿者聚集在一起，重演了十八世纪那场决定性的骑兵冲突。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote mentally experiencing past events again, acting out historical or past occurrences, or playing recorded media once more. Nuances balance between psychological nostalgia/trauma, deliberate staged performance, and technological reproduction.
groups.summary_zh: 指在心中重现、舞台上重演或多媒体回放往昔场景。
groups.desc_en: Involves reproducing past events or sensory experiences in memory, media, or physical simulation, contrasting with pure remembering by emphasizing vivid phenomenological recurrence.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及在记忆、媒介或物理模拟中重现过往事件或感官体验，与单纯回忆不同，它强调具象生动的现象学再现与体验重历。
groups.nuance_en: play back: technical reproduction of recorded audiovisual data (tape / footage / recording) · replay: re-running a sequence physically or mentally for examination (match / moment / scenario) · reproduce: objective exact fabrication or copying of results (experiment / image / sound) · relive: intense psychological re-experiencing of past trauma or joy (nightmare / childhood / trauma) · reenact: deliberate physical theatrical restaging of a past event (battle / crime / ritual)
groups.nuance_zh: play back: 技术性回放音视频等记录数据 (tape / footage / recording) · replay: 在物理或心理上重放某片段以供复盘 (match / moment / scenario) · reproduce: 客观精确地复制或重现原结果 (experiment / image / sound) · relive: 心理上身临其境般重历过去的情感或创伤 (nightmare / childhood / trauma) · reenact: 具身性、戏剧性地按原样再现或重演历史/犯罪 (battle / crime / ritual)

groups.name: Repress & Crush · 镇压与强力遏制 (Repress, Subdue, Crush)
groups.tip: 动用国家或强力手段武力弹压

items.def_en: To forcefully put an end to an uprising, rebellion, or dissemination of critical information
items.ex_en: Authoritarian regimes often mobilize riot troops to suppress political dissent and ban assemblies.
items.ex_zh: 专制政权往往调动防暴部队镇压政治异见并查禁公众集会。

items.def_en: To bring a person, group, or rebellious faction under control by force or strategy
items.ex_en: Government forces acted swiftly to subdue the armed faction threatening regional stability.
items.ex_zh: 政府军迅速采取行动，制伏了威胁地区稳定的武装派系。

items.def_en: (+ on) To take sudden, stringent punitive measures to stop or restrict illegal or rebellious activity
items.ex_en: Authorities decided to clamp down on unlicensed street vendors across the capital.
items.ex_zh: 当局决定严厉打击首都各地的无照街头摊贩。

items.def_zh: 镇压，平息；抑制，克制（情感、欲望）
items.def_en: 1. To use force or authority to put down a protest, rebellion, or political movement. 2. To consciously control or suppress strong feelings, desires, or memories.
items.ex_en: The military regime used lethal force to repress the growing pro-democracy movement.
items.ex_zh: 军事政权使用致命武力镇压了日益壮大的民主运动。

items.def_en: To defeat or destroy an opposition movement or rebellion completely using overwhelming force
items.ex_en: Imperial legions mobilized along the border to crush the peasant rebellion completely.
items.ex_zh: 帝国军团沿边境集结，彻底粉碎了农民起义。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote using political, military, or authoritarian force to quell revolts, subdue dissidence, or choke out public opposition. They focus on systemic domination and forceful containment of resistance.
groups.summary_zh: 指统治者或军队使用强权或暴力扑灭叛乱及政治反抗。
groups.desc_en: Involves deploying overpowering authority or physical force to extinguish dissent, movement, or emotional expression, contrasting with mild persuasion by imposing coercive cessation.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及动用压倒性权威或物理暴力来扑灭异见、运动或情感表达，与温和规劝不同，它强调强制性遏制与消灭。
groups.nuance_en: suppress: systemic or institutional keeping down of information or uprisings (evidence / rebellion / dissent) · subdue: bringing unruly or violent elements under quiet physical control (suspect / crowd / passion) · clamp down: enacting harsh, sudden regulatory or police crackdowns (corruption / protests / smugglers) · repress: deep psychological blockage or ongoing state terror (desire / memory / population) · crush: total violent pulverization leaving no resistance (rebellion / spirit / opposition)
groups.nuance_zh: suppress: 体制性或系统性地封锁信息或平息叛乱 (evidence / rebellion / dissent) · subdue: 制服、驯服躁动或暴力的个体与群体 (suspect / crowd / passion) · clamp down: 突然实施严厉的铁腕监管或警方打击 (corruption / protests / smugglers) · repress: 心理层面的压抑潜抑，或长期的国家恐怖统治 (desire / memory / population) · crush: 毁灭性粉碎叛乱或反抗意志，不留余地 (rebellion / spirit / opposition)

groups.name: Reprieve & Stay · 缓刑与暂缓执行 (Reprieve, Stay, Commute)
groups.tip: 由权威暂缓或免除刑罚

items.def_en: To legally stop, suspend, or delay an action or judicial execution
items.ex_en: The appellate judge agreed to stay the deportation order pending further review.
items.ex_zh: 上诉法官同意暂缓执行驱逐令，等待进一步审查。

items.def_en: To defer the enforcement of a legal sentence or rule for a specified period
items.ex_en: The magistrate decided to suspend the prison sentence under strict probationary conditions.
items.ex_zh: 治安法官决定在严格的缓刑条件下暂缓执行监禁判决。

items.def_en: To grant a temporary relief or postponement from a sentence, obligation, or execution
items.ex_en: The sovereign granted a decree to respite the condemned traitor until dawn.
items.ex_zh: 君主颁布法令，将这名被定罪的叛国者的处决暂缓至黎明。

items.def_en: (+ to) To officially reduce a legal punishment to a less severe one, especially a death sentence to life imprisonment
items.ex_en: The governor chose to commute the inmate's death sentence to life imprisonment.
items.ex_zh: 州长选择将该囚犯的死刑减为终身监禁。

items.def_zh: 暂缓执行刑罚（尤指死刑）；暂缓，延期
items.def_en: 1. (law) To officially cancel or delay the punishment of a prisoner, especially a death sentence. 2. To give temporary relief or an postponement from something unpleasant or dangerous.
items.ex_en: A late judicial ruling intervened to reprieve the prisoner hours before execution.
items.ex_zh: 一项迟来的司法裁定在行刑前数小时暂缓了该囚犯的死刑。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame deal with executive or judicial interventions that postpone, reduce, or suspend an impending severe punishment (such as capital punishment) or detrimental administrative ruling.
groups.summary_zh: 行政长官或法庭依法暂缓、减轻或推迟严重刑罚及判决执行。
groups.desc_en: Involves granting a formal, temporary, or permanent mitigation or halt to an impending judicial or existential penalty, contrasting with outright acquittal by acknowledging guilt while withholding doom.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及对即将降临的司法刑罚或生存厄运给予正式的暂时延缓或永久减轻，与直接无罪释放不同，它是在承认过错的前提下暂缓或减轻惩罚。
groups.nuance_en: stay: legal court order temporarily halting an execution or ruling (execution / judgment / proceeding) · suspend: officially deferring the enforcement of a penalty or license (sentence / license / disbelief) · respite: providing brief transient relief from agonizing labor or doom (pain / sentence / heat) · commute: formally reducing a severe judicial punishment to a lesser one (death sentence / penalty / term) · reprieve: executive grant postponing or canceling capital punishment (condemned prisoner / execution / company)
groups.nuance_zh: stay: 法院下令在司法程序上暂时中止执行 (execution / judgment / proceeding) · suspend: 官方正式暂缓执行刑罚、效力或吊销执照 (sentence / license / disbelief) · respite: 在折磨、重负或厄运中提供短暂喘息之机 (pain / sentence / heat) · commute: 司法上正式减刑，将重刑转为较轻惩罚 (death sentence / penalty / term) · reprieve: 行政特权签发的死刑缓期执行或免于劫难 (condemned prisoner / execution / company)

groups.name: Repurpose & Reclaim · 再次使用与循环利用 (Reuse, Recycle, Repurpose)
groups.tip: 投入使用或物尽其用

items.def_en: to adapt an existing object, tool, or space for a completely new function
items.ex_en: Urban planners decided to repurpose the abandoned textile factory into affordable housing.
items.ex_zh: 城市规划者决定将废弃的纺织厂改作经济适用房。

items.def_en: to reuse discarded materials to create a product of higher quality or artistic value
items.ex_en: Local artisans upcycle discarded ocean plastics into bespoke decorative furniture pieces.
items.ex_zh: 当地手艺人将废弃的海洋塑料创意再造为定制装饰家具。

items.def_en: to process used materials so that they can be made into new products
items.ex_en: The municipality urged citizens to recycle aluminum cans and glass bottles properly.
items.ex_zh: 市政府敦促市民对铝罐和玻璃瓶进行合理回收利用。

items.def_en: to recover useful materials or substances from waste products or natural sources
items.ex_en: Specialized industrial facilities reclaim precious metals from obsolete electronic circuit boards.
items.ex_zh: 专门的工业设施从废旧电子电路板中回收提取贵金属。

items.def_en: to use an item, container, or material again instead of throwing it away
items.ex_en: Smart consumers reuse sturdy glass jars for storing dry kitchen pantry goods.
items.ex_zh: 精明的消费者重复使用结实的玻璃罐来储存厨房干货食品。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on using items, materials, or resources again rather than discarding them, ranging from industrial reprocessing to creative functional adaptation.
groups.summary_zh: 强调避免丢弃，将物品或资源重新利用或改造。
groups.desc_en: Involves diverting discarded or obsolete material items into renewed functional cycles, contrasting with simple cleaning or discarding by altering the object's life-cycle destination.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及将废弃或过时物品导入崭新的功能循环，与简单的清洁或丢弃不同，它强调通过改造生命周期实现价值再利用。
groups.nuance_en: repurpose: adapting an existing intact item for a totally different role (shipping container / warehouse / barn) · upcycle: creative conversion of waste into products of superior aesthetic/functional value (discarded fabric / furniture / scraps) · recycle: breaking down materials into raw feedstock to manufacture new goods (plastics / aluminum / paper) · reclaim: recovering usable land, building materials, or energy from waste states (timber / wasteland / heat) · reuse: putting an object back to work in its original form without reprocessing (bag / bottle / water)
groups.nuance_zh: repurpose: 改变已有完整物品的原定用途以充新用 (shipping container / warehouse / barn) · upcycle: 创意升维改造，将废料转化为更高价值产品 (discarded fabric / furniture / scraps) · recycle: 将废料深度分解粉碎为原材料以重新制造 (plastics / aluminum / paper) · reclaim: 从废弃状态中回收开垦可用土地、建材或余热 (timber / wasteland / heat) · reuse: 不经深度重工而按原样或稍作清洗再次使用 (bag / bottle / water)

groups.name: Rescale & Coordinate Transformation · 变换度量衡与比例缩放 (Rescale, Calibrate, Resize)
groups.tip: 校正量度、比例并依规调控

items.def_zh: 换基校正；调整指数基准
items.def_en: To recalculate or shift an economic or statistical index to a new baseline reference point.
items.ex_en: Statisticians must reindex the consumer price data to reflect the new baseline.
items.ex_zh: 统计人员必须调整消费价格指数的基准，以反映新的基期。

items.def_en: To change the physical, visual, or digital dimensions of an item or digital image.
items.ex_en: The graphic designer needed to resize the high-resolution banner for mobile displays.
items.ex_zh: 平面设计师需要调整高分辨率横幅的尺寸以适应移动端显示。

items.def_en: To transform values or data measured on different scales to a notionally common scale.
items.ex_en: Data analysts normalize raw experimental measurements across laboratories using standard statistical software.
items.ex_zh: 数据分析人员利用标准统计软件将各实验室的原始实验测量值进行归一化。
items.ex2_en: Blood pressure readings normalize gradually once patients finish taking prescribed medications.
items.ex2_zh: 一旦患者服完处方药，血压读数就会逐渐恢复正常。

items.def_en: To mark units of measurement on an instrument or adjust it so that its readings match a recognized standard.
items.ex_en: The astrolabe requires a skilled hand to calibrate each celestial measurement accurately.
items.ex_zh: 星盘需要一双巧手才能准确标定每一个天体度量。

items.def_zh: 重新调整尺度，按新比例调整
items.def_en: To adjust the size, proportions, or measurement scale of something, such as an image, data, or model.
items.ex_en: The software engineer had to rescale the vector model for larger screens.
items.ex_zh: 软件工程师不得不按新比例重新调整矢量模型以适应更大的屏幕。

groups.summary_en: This frame entails converting, expanding, or contracting numeric ranges, coordinate frameworks, or digital dimensions so that disparate datasets or visual models align to a consistent measurement standard.
groups.summary_zh: 指改变图像、数学模型或度量衡的比例尺度以实现量纲归一或适配。
groups.desc_en: Involves shifting mathematical, spatial, or instrumental coordinate baselines to align with new dimensions or standardized criteria, contrasting with arbitrary resizing by obeying proportional or algorithmic logic.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及移动数学、空间或仪器坐标基准以匹配新尺度或标准化准则，与随意的形体缩放不同，它遵循比例或算法逻辑。
groups.nuance_en: reindex: resetting the base period or lookup index of statistical data (database / series / inflation baseline) · resize: altering physical or digital spatial dimensions (image / window / partition) · normalize: scaling values to fit a standard statistical distribution or range [0, 1] (data / matrix / scores) · calibrate: finely adjusting measuring instruments against a verified standard (instrument / sensor / model) · rescale: proportionally transforming numerical coordinate axes or point values (axes / scores / metric)
groups.nuance_zh: reindex: 重置统计序列的基准期或重建数据库索引 (database / series / inflation baseline) · resize: 调整物理或数字界面的几何尺寸 (image / window / partition) · normalize: 数据归一化，将数值映射至标准分布或固定区间 (data / matrix / scores) · calibrate: 依据标准校准精密仪器、传感器或模型参数 (instrument / sensor / model) · rescale: 按固定比例重新缩放坐标轴、分值或度量单位 (axes / scores / metric)

groups.name: Rescue & Save · 营救与解救 (Save, Deliver, Extricate)
groups.tip: 将处于危险中的人救出

items.def_en: to keep someone or something safe from death, injury, disaster, or loss
items.ex_en: Only unwavering courage could save the doomed battalion from slaughter.
items.ex_zh: 唯有坚定的勇气，方能拯救那支注定覆灭的营队免于惨遭屠戮。

items.def_zh: 解救，拯救（脱离险境/苦难）
items.def_en: (+ from) to rescue or set someone free from evil, danger, captivity, or suffering
items.ex_en: The missionary prayed fervently to deliver the beleaguered captives from prolonged suffering.
items.ex_zh: 传教士虔诚祈祷，愿被困的俘虏能从长期的苦难中被解救出来。

items.def_en: to save someone or something from danger, harm, or difficulty
items.ex_en: Emergency teams scrambled up the mountain to rescue the stranded hikers safely.
items.ex_zh: 应急救援队火速赶上山，安全营救了受困的徒步旅行者。

items.def_en: to help a person, company, or organization out of a difficult, usually financial, emergency
items.ex_en: His wealthy uncle stepped in to bail out the struggling family bakery.
items.ex_zh: 他富有的叔叔出手相助，帮陷入困境的家族烘焙坊脱离了财务危机。

items.def_zh: 使脱困，拔出（从缠结或困境中）
items.def_en: (+ from) to release or free someone or something from an entangled, trapped, or awkward situation
items.ex_en: Firefighters worked frantically to extricate the injured passenger from the crushed vehicle.
items.ex_zh: 消防员拼命施救，将受伤的乘客从被压扁的车中解救出来。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame portray intervening proactively to liberate, protect, or pull people or objects out of immediate peril, confinement, disaster, or destructive harm.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动介入危险现场，将人员或财产从灾难、被困或厄运中营救、解脱出来。
groups.desc_en: Involves pulling a person or entity out of imminent physical danger, entrapment, or insolvency, contrasting with ongoing caretaking by intervening at a point of catastrophic peril.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及将人或实体从迫在眉睫的生命危险、受困状态或破产深渊中拉出，与持续性的照料不同，它强调在危机临界点的切入与解救。
groups.nuance_en: save: broad protective liberation from death, injury, or loss (life / soul / child) · deliver: formal or spiritual liberation from evil, oppression, or captivity (captive / people / oppressed) · rescue: prompt, physically demanding extraction from immediate peril (hostage / swimmer / climber) · bail out: financial rescue preventing imminent bankruptcy or collapse (bank / company / economy) · extricate: carefully disentangling someone from a complex, sticky, or physically tight entrapment (driver from wreckage / oneself from scandal / victim)
groups.nuance_zh: save: 最宽泛地使人或物免于死亡、伤亡或毁灭 (life / soul / child) · deliver: 庄严或宗教性地将人从邪恶、压迫或囚禁中救赎解脱 (captive / people / oppressed) · rescue: 紧急出动人力，将人从即时致命危险中营救脱险 (hostage / swimmer / climber) · bail out: 注入资金或兜底，挽救濒临破产的机构 (bank / company / economy) · extricate: 极其艰难耐心地从复杂纠缠、机械残骸或窘境中解脱出来 (driver from wreckage / oneself from scandal / victim)

groups.name: Reserve & Set Aside · 预留与保留 (Withhold, Retain, Set aside)
groups.tip: 留存预备后续使用

items.def_en: To hold back or set something aside for future use; to book a seat, room, or ticket in advance.
items.ex_en: We should reserve a quiet corner table for tonight's anniversary dinner.
items.ex_zh: 我们应该为今晚的周年晚宴预订一张安静的靠角餐桌。

items.def_en: To continue to keep, possess, or hold on to something rather than losing or giving it up
items.ex_en: The prestigious university managed to retain its most distinguished research faculty members.
items.ex_zh: 这所名牌大学设法留住了其最杰出的科研教职人员。

items.def_en: To reserve a part of something rather than parting with the whole amount
items.ex_en: He chose to keep back part of the inheritance for unexpected emergencies.
items.ex_zh: 他选择扣留下一部分遗产以备不时之需。

items.def_en: To dedicate or reserve something solely for a dedicated special purpose
items.ex_en: The city council agreed to set apart twenty acres for community gardens.
items.ex_zh: 市议会同意拨出二十英亩土地专门用作社区花园。

items.def_en: To deliberately hold back or refuse to grant something required or expected
items.ex_en: The corrupt administrator decided to withhold vital financial documents from the auditors.
items.ex_zh: 该腐败管理者决定对审计人员隐瞒扣留关键的财务文件。

groups.summary_en: This frame emphasizes keeping possession of, withholding, or protecting an asset, right, or resource specifically for a designated person, requirement, or future event.
groups.summary_zh: 保留、扣存或特意预留资源、权利以备将来使用。
groups.desc_en: Involves withholding an asset, resource, or judgment from immediate general use in order to earmark it for a future designated purpose, contrasting with spendthrift distribution by deliberate retention.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及将资产、资源或裁决保留而不立即付诸通用，特意留待未来指定用途，与挥霍或当下全数耗尽形成鲜明对照。
groups.nuance_en: reserve: formally designating resources, seats, or rights for a future party/use (right / room / funds) · retain: keeping hold of possession, custody, or control against loss (ownership / lawyer / control) · keep back: deliberately withholding a portion of goods, pay, or emotion (money / truth / tears) · set apart: dedicating or sanctifying a resource/person for a distinct noble purpose (funds / day / candidates) · withhold: actively refusing to release information, payment, or consent (information / approval / taxes)
groups.nuance_zh: reserve: 正式为未来特定用途或对象预留名额、权利或资金 (right / room / funds) · retain: 持续保有所有权、控制权或聘用顾问以防流失 (ownership / lawyer / control) · keep back: 刻意留下一小部分财物、真相或克制情绪 (money / truth / tears) · set apart: 拔高并特设出来以供专属用途或体现殊胜 (funds / day / candidates) · withhold: 故意压下、拒不提供信息、款项或批准 (information / approval / taxes)

groups.name: Reshape & Refashion · 重塑与改制 (Remodel, Rework, Transform)
groups.tip: 改变原有形态加以重新设计

items.def_en: To make significant changes to an existing text, composition, or design to improve it
items.ex_en: The playwright decided to rework the final scene before the grand premiere.
items.ex_zh: 编剧决定在盛大首演前重新修改最后一幕。

items.def_en: To completely transform the visual appearance or style of someone or something
items.ex_en: Stylists arrived to make over the weary contestants before their stage debut.
items.ex_zh: 造型师们赶来为疲惫的选手们换上新装，迎接登台首秀。

items.def_en: To alter the structure, interior design, or layout of a building or system
items.ex_en: The young couple hired contractors to remodel their outdated suburban kitchen completely.
items.ex_zh: 这对年轻夫妇雇佣了承包商，对他们过时的郊区厨房进行了全面翻新改造。

items.def_zh: 重新塑画；改写（结构或叙述）
items.def_en: To present something in a completely different way or reformulate its conceptual structure
items.ex_en: The historian sought to recast the complex revolution as a class conflict.
items.ex_zh: 这位历史学家试图将那场复杂的革命重新诠释为一场阶级冲突。

items.def_en: 1. To remake, reshape, or redesign something into a new form.
items.ex_en: The forward-thinking architect sought to refashion the historical facade with contemporary materials.
items.ex_zh: 具有前瞻视野的建筑师试图用现代材料重构这座历史建筑的外立面。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe altering the form, structure, or style of an existing object, garment, or conceptual framework to give it a fresh utility or look. It focuses on stylistic or functional adaptation rather than destructive overhaul.
groups.summary_zh: 强调对已有物品、样式或理念进行改良与重塑。
groups.desc_en: Involves thoroughly restructuring the contour, architecture, or conceptual style of an existing entity, contrasting with trivial touch-ups by effecting deep formal renewal.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及对已有实体的外观轮廓、结构或理念风格进行彻底重构，与表面微调不同，它强调深度的形式重塑与翻新。
groups.nuance_en: rework: revising, refining, or redrafting text or material to fix flaws (draft / strategy / engine) · make over: radically transforming external cosmetic styling or branding (room / image / wardrobe) · remodel: altering the architectural structure or floorplan of a building (kitchen / home / system) · recast: changing foundational conceptual framework, roles, or actors (argument / role / image) · refashion: artisan-like reshaping of existing elements into a novel artistic or practical form (identity / coat / economy)
groups.nuance_zh: rework: 修正缺陷、重写草稿或重新加工材料 (draft / strategy / engine) · make over: 彻底改造外在造型、妆容或品牌形象 (room / image / wardrobe) · remodel: 改变建筑物或系统的空间构造与格局 (kitchen / home / system) · recast: 重新置换角色演员，或从根基上重新构筑论点框架 (argument / role / image) · refashion: 如工匠般将旧有元素以新颖的艺术或实用形式重新塑造 (identity / coat / economy)

groups.name: Reshuffle & Reassign · 权力重组与职位洗牌 (Redistribute, Reallocate, Shuffle)
groups.tip: 重组内阁或重新分配人事

items.def_en: To mix up or change the relative positions of personnel, papers, or tasks
items.ex_en: The manager decided to shuffle duty assignments among all the warehouse staff.
items.ex_zh: 经理决定调换所有仓库员工之间的值班任务分配。

items.def_en: To share out work, power, or resources in a new or fairer arrangement
items.ex_en: The newly elected government sought to redistribute tax revenues toward public healthcare.
items.ex_zh: 新当选的政府试图将税收重新分配给公共医疗卫生领域。

items.def_en: To allocate someone to a different job, duty, or geographical post
items.ex_en: Command decided to reassign the senior diplomat to the turbulent embassy overseas.
items.ex_zh: 司令部决定将这位资深外交官重新指派到局势动荡的驻外使馆。

items.def_zh: 改组，重组（内阁或人员）；重新洗牌
items.def_en: 1. To reorganize government ministers, staff, or duties. 2. To shuffle playing cards again.
items.ex_en: The prime minister plans to reshuffle the cabinet following the controversial election.
items.ex_zh: 首相计划在争议性选举之后对内阁进行改组。

items.def_zh: 大举整顿；对…进行大洗牌
items.def_en: To institute radical changes in an organization or government to expose inefficiency
items.ex_en: The new CEO plans to shake up the entire management structure.
items.ex_zh: 新任首席执行官计划对整个管理架构进行大洗牌。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to rearranging personnel, portfolios, or administrative posts within a cabinet, corporate board, or institution. The primary implication is altering interpersonal dynamics or organizational responsibilities without necessarily changing the individuals involved.
groups.summary_zh: 指对内阁成员、团队人事或权责分配进行换位调动。
groups.desc_en: Involves reallocating personnel, responsibilities, or power positions across a matrix without necessarily adding new actors, contrasting with organic promotion by relying on organizational reconfiguration.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及在既有盘子内重新调配人员、职责或权力位置而不必增添新人，与常规晋升不同，它强调组织内部的洗牌重构。
groups.nuance_en: shuffle: thoughtless or mechanical mixing and moving around of items or people (papers / feet / cards) · redistribute: spreading resources or responsibilities more equitably across a system (wealth / workload / power) · reassign: formally shifting an individual worker to a different post or project (officer / task / duties) · reshuffle: systemic ministerial or senior leadership realignment (cabinet / board / portfolio) · shake up: aggressive, disruptive reorganization designed to eliminate complacency (agency / industry / executive team)
groups.nuance_zh: shuffle: 机械、随意地换换位子或洗牌式挪动 (papers / feet / cards) · redistribute: 在系统内部更公平或广泛地重新分配资源与担子 (wealth / workload / power) · reassign: 官方将某人调遣至新岗位或指派新任务 (officer / task / duties) · reshuffle: 政治内阁或高层管理班底的系统性职位洗牌调整 (cabinet / board / portfolio) · shake up: 具有冲击性的激进人事大整顿与机构震荡 (agency / industry / executive team)

groups.name: Reskill & Up-skill · 再培训与技能提升 (Retrain, Reskill, Upskill)
groups.tip: 传授知识技能并进行定向培训

items.def_en: (+ on) Refresh and improve one's practical knowledge of a skill that has grown rusty
items.ex_en: I need to brush up on my conversational Spanish before the trip.
items.ex_zh: 在旅行之前，我需要温习一下生疏的西班牙语日常会话。

items.def_zh: 使学习新技能，转岗培训
items.def_en: Teach someone or acquire new skills in order to qualify for a completely different job
items.ex_en: The regional initiative aims to reskill manufacturing workers for advanced robotics careers.
items.ex_zh: 该地区性倡议旨在为制造业工人提供转岗培训，以胜任先进机器人领域的工作。

items.def_en: Learn additional advanced skills to enhance competence within one's current career
items.ex_en: The engineering corporation launched intensive programs to upskill mid-level software developers.
items.ex_zh: 这家工程公司推出了强化培训项目，以提升中级软件开发人员的技能。

items.def_zh: 再培训，重新训练；改行接受培训
items.def_en: To teach or learn new skills, especially for a different job or profession.
items.ex_en: The state offered subsidized courses to retrain laid-off miners as electricians.
items.ex_zh: 政府提供了补贴课程，以对下岗矿工进行再培训，使之成为电工。
items.ex2_en: Displaced assembly workers must retrain quickly to secure emerging high-tech employment opportunities.
items.ex2_zh: 下岗装配工人必须迅速接受再培训，以抓住新兴的高科技就业机会。

items.def_zh: 技能重组，改组适应新需要
items.def_en: Equip oneself or an organization with modern skills, machinery, or conceptual tools
items.ex_en: The manufacturing enterprise must retool its operations for green energy production.
items.ex_zh: 这家制造企业必须改组其运营体系，以适应绿色能源生产。
items.ex2_en: The entire regional auto manufacturing industry must retool to survive competition.
items.ex2_zh: 整个区域汽车制造业必须进行设备与技术改造才能在竞争中生存。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame focus on acquiring new vocational competencies, refreshing technical expertise, or adapting worker skillsets to technological shifts.
groups.summary_zh: 针对职业转型或技术升级开展再次培训与赋能。
groups.desc_en: Involves systematically updating, augmenting, or modernizing an individual's or organization's technical competencies, contrasting with general initial schooling by focusing on professional obsolescence prevention.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及系统性地更新、增强或现代化个人或组织的技术能力，与基础学校教育不同，它聚焦于应对职场技能老化并实现转型升级。
groups.nuance_en: brush up: refreshing rusty, dormant knowledge or conversational fluency (French / skills / grammar) · reskill: teaching a completely new trade to adapt to vocational extinction (displaced workers / miners / staff) · upskill: teaching advanced, higher-tier competencies within the same career track (workforce / engineers / employees) · retrain: structured educational instruction for adapting to a new role or tool (cadres / teachers / pilots) · retool: modifying machinery or systematically overhaul mental/institutional infrastructure (factory / mindset / organization)
groups.nuance_zh: brush up: 温习重拾已生疏的某项外语或基础技能 (French / skills / grammar) · reskill: 彻底跨赛道转岗培训，使下岗人员掌握新工种 (displaced workers / miners / staff) · upskill: 在原岗位轨道上提升技能层级、掌握先进技术 (workforce / engineers / employees) · retrain: 接受正规系统性再培训以适应新规范或新任务 (cadres / teachers / pilots) · retool: 物理改装工厂机床设备，或系统性重组思维与组织工具箱 (factory / mindset / organization)

groups.name: Resonate & Reverberate · 回响与共鸣 (Echo, Resound, Vibrate)
groups.tip: 声波在空间内震荡余响

items.def_en: (+ through/around) To repeat or cause a sound to bounce back from a surface
items.ex_en: Her desperate cries began to echo through the empty subterranean marble chambers.
items.ex_zh: 她绝望的哭喊声开始在空荡的地下大理石室中回响。
items.ex2_en: The high stone walls echo every whisper across the empty historic cathedral.
items.ex2_zh: 高耸的石墙让空旷的历史大教堂各处都回荡着每一声低语。

items.def_en: To sound loudly, clearly, and suddenly in an environment
items.ex_en: A sharp gunshot suddenly rang out across the silent mountain valley.
items.ex_zh: 一声清脆的枪响突然响彻寂静的山谷。

items.def_en: (+ with) To produce a deep, clear, continuing sound, or strike an emotional chord
items.ex_en: The poet's stirring words continue to resonate with readers across generations.
items.ex_zh: 这位诗人激昂的文字在几代读者心中持续引发深刻共鸣。

items.def_en: (+ with) To fill an area with sound, echoing powerfully throughout
items.ex_en: The solemn cathedral began to resound with the thunderous choral hymns.
items.ex_zh: 庄严肃穆的大教堂中回荡起雷鸣般的合唱赞美诗。

items.def_zh: 回响，回荡；产生巨大反响，造成持续影响
items.def_en: 1. (+ through/around) (of a loud sound) To echo repeatedly through an enclosed space. 2. (of an event or idea) To have a prolonged, widespread, or serious effect.
items.ex_en: The explosive political revelation will reverberate around the capital for months.
items.ex_zh: 这起爆炸性的政治丑闻将在首都持续引起数月的巨大反响。

groups.summary_en: This frame involves the repetitive bouncing, persistence, and amplification of sound waves through physical acoustic spaces, as well as prolonged secondary emotional or social impacts.
groups.summary_zh: 指声音在空间中回旋震荡、久久不绝，或指事件产生深远反响。
groups.desc_en: Involves an acoustic vibration or ideological sentiment being sustained, amplified, or mirrored across spaces and minds, contrasting with quiet extinction by active propagation.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及声音振荡或意识形态情绪在物理空间与心灵之间持续激荡、放大与投射，与无声消逝相对，强调波动的主动扩散与回响。
groups.nuance_en: echo: repeating acoustic or ideological sound waves bouncing back faithfully (voices / sentiment / cliffs) · ring out: sudden, loud, penetrating sound piercing an ambient silence (shot / cheers / bells) · resonate: evoking deep empathetic psychological chords or harmonious acoustic vibration (message / theme / strings) · resound: filling an expansive physical volume with sonorous booming noise (cheers / applause / cavern) · reverberate: prolonged bouncing of shockwaves or cascading systemic repercussions (shock / blast / scandal)
groups.nuance_zh: echo: 声音撞击反射的原样回荡，或思想言论的亦步亦趋 (voices / sentiment / cliffs) · ring out: 清脆响亮、穿透寂静的枪声或钟声骤然响起 (shot / cheers / bells) · resonate: 引起精神层面的深度共情共鸣，或物理谐振 (message / theme / strings) · resound: 洪亮的声音充斥宏大空间，震耳欲聋 (cheers / applause / cavern) · reverberate: 冲击波或震荡在空间内持久激荡，或丑闻产生连锁余震 (shock / blast / scandal)

groups.name: Resort & Turn To · 诉诸与求助 (Resort, Turn to, Fall back on, Call upon)
groups.tip: 借助特定手段谋求解决

items.def_zh: 诉诸，采取（某种手段）；常去
items.def_en: 1. (+ to) To turn to or adopt a strategy or course of action, especially an unpleasant one, to resolve a problem. 2. (+ to) (formal) To go often or habitually to a place.
items.ex_en: Desperate leadership may resort to drastic military measures to quell unrest.
items.ex_zh: 走投无路的领导层可能会诉诸严厉的军事手段来平息动乱。

items.def_en: To ask a specific person or reliable source for help, advice, or comfort during a crisis
items.ex_en: Struggling students frequently turn to guidance counselors during the stressful exam period.
items.ex_zh: 陷入困境的学生在压力重重的考试期间经常向辅导员求助。

items.def_en: To make use of an alternative reserve or plan when primary options have collapsed
items.ex_en: If my freelance business doesn't take off, I have some savings to fall back on.
items.ex_zh: 如果我的自由职业做不起来，我还有一些积蓄可以支撑。

items.def_en: To officially or urgently invite someone to take action or draw upon internal reserves
items.ex_en: The mayor decided to call upon civic volunteers during the snowstorm.
items.ex_zh: 市长决定在暴风雪期间号召市民志愿者参与行动。

items.def_en: To utilize a specific mechanism, law, or solution as an available remedy for difficulty
items.ex_en: Aggrieved employees may have recourse to formal arbitration under the collective agreement.
items.ex_zh: 根据集体协议，受到不公待遇的员工可以借助于正式仲裁。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers choosing an extreme, undesirable, or secondary course of action, or asking an external party for assistance when standard methods have failed.
groups.summary_zh: 在穷尽常规办法后，迫不得已采用极端手段，或向外部资源寻求救助。
groups.desc_en: Involves turning outward to an alternative expedient, authority, or desperate remedy when primary measures fail, contrasting with proactive autonomous action by driven dependency.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及在首选方案失败时转向外部的替代手段、权威或无奈之举，与主动独立行事相对，强调情势所迫下的依附与求助。
groups.nuance_en: resort: reluctantly adopting an extreme, undesirable, or coercive expedient (violence / strike / deception) · turn to: seeking practical advice, solace, or help from another party (mentor / drugs / religion) · fall back on: relying on a safe secondary reserve after a primary strategy collapses (savings / plan B / family) · call upon: formally demanding or invoking assistance, duty, or action (allies / expertise / reserves) · have recourse to: formal, institutional invocation of legal or procedural mechanisms (arbitration / courts / law)
groups.nuance_zh: resort: 走投无路下不得不诉诸极端或有争议的手段 (violence / strike / deception) · turn to: 遇到困境时向某人求助、借由某物寻求慰藉 (mentor / drugs / religion) · fall back on: 在主计划破灭后退守依靠后备方案或储蓄 (savings / plan B / family) · call upon: 庄严号召、动用或请求盟友履行职责与施以援手 (allies / expertise / reserves) · have recourse to: 官方正式诉诸法律渠道或程序性救济机制 (arbitration / courts / law)

groups.name: Rest & Perch · 停留与栖息 (Roost, Alight, Settle)
groups.tip: 同场景高频动作归纳

items.def_en: Keep oneself or an object steady on a narrow or precarious edge without falling
items.ex_en: The acrobat managed to balance precariously on the narrow wooden beam.
items.ex_zh: 杂技演员设法在狭窄的木梁上摇摇欲坠地保持平衡。
items.ex2_en: The patient seal managed to balance a rubber ball on its nose.
items.ex2_zh: 耐心的海豹成功地把一个橡胶球平衡在自己的鼻子上。

items.def_en: (+ on) Land softly on a high branch or perch and remain resting there
items.ex_en: A flock of tired migratory birds began to settle on the branches.
items.ex_zh: 一群疲惫的候鸟开始在树枝上歇息落定。

items.def_zh: 栖息，停留；坐在……边缘；位于高处
items.def_en: To land and rest on a branch or high bar; to sit lightly on the edge of something high.
items.ex_en: The golden eagle likes to perch atop the jagged granite crag.
items.ex_zh: 金雕喜欢栖息在参差不齐的花岗岩峭壁之巅。
items.ex2_en: The clumsy gardener perched his muddy wooden ladder against the fragile fence.
items.ex2_zh: 笨拙的园丁把泥泞的木梯斜架在脆弱的栅栏上。

items.def_en: (of a bird or bat) Settle down to sleep or rest on a high perch
items.ex_en: Hundreds of bats roost under the concrete bridge until dusk arrives.
items.ex_zh: 数以百计的蝙蝠栖息在混凝土桥下，直到黄昏降临。

items.def_en: (+ on) Descend from the air and gently land or settle upon a surface
items.ex_en: A solitary Monarch butterfly prepared to alight on the blooming lavender flower.
items.ex_zh: 一只孤独的黑脉金斑蝶正准备飞落在盛开的薰衣草花朵上。

groups.summary_en: Depicts creatures (predominantly birds) or light objects coming to rest, usually atop an elevated, narrow, or precarious vantage point, maintaining balance rather than collapsing flat.
groups.summary_zh: 指鸟禽或人轻盈落在细窄高处停歇、栖息并保持平衡。
groups.desc_en: Involves an airborne or moving body decelerating and stationing itself atop a supportive perch or surface, contrasting with reckless crashing by achieving stable equilibrium.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及空中或移动中的躯体减速并在狭窄或支撑性表面上落定驻留，与失控坠毁不同，它强调实现稳定平衡与栖止。
groups.nuance_en: balance: maintaining unstable equilibrium over a narrow fulcrum (on edge / beam / tightrope) · settle: gradually drifting down and coming to an easy, motionless rest (dust / bird / snow) · perch: precariously or elevatedly sitting on a narrow, high vantage point (bird / spectator / cottage) · roost: congregating to rest or sleep overnight like birds in a shelter (bats / pigeons / hens) · alight: gracefully descending and landing lightly onto a specific spot (butterfly / bird / passenger)
groups.nuance_zh: balance: 在狭窄支点上小心翼翼保持微弱平衡 (on edge / beam / tightrope) · settle: 缓缓飘落并稳定、静止地停驻沉淀下来 (dust / bird / snow) · perch: 高高地或略显险峻地栖立于突出的枝头、边缘或高处 (bird / spectator / cottage) · roost: 鸟类或蝙蝠结群回窝歇息、夜栖入巢 (bats / pigeons / hens) · alight: 鸟类或昆虫轻巧优雅地降落着陆，或乘客优雅下车 (butterfly / bird / passenger)

groups.name: Rest & Relax · 歇息与放松 (Unwind, Recline, Recuperate)
groups.tip: 暂时中断活动恢复精力

items.def_zh: 休息，歇息；依靠，支撑；倚放
items.def_en: 1. To stop working or moving in order to relax and recover strength. 2. To lean or support something against or on a surface.
items.ex_en: Exhausted after the climb, the mountaineers stopped to rest near the summit.
items.ex_zh: 登山者在攀登后精疲力竭，停在山顶附近歇息。
items.ex2_en: The weary traveler rested his heavy leather rucksack against the wooden bench.
items.ex2_zh: 疲惫的旅行者把沉重的皮质背包靠在木凳上歇着。

items.def_en: To become less tense, anxious, or rigid, resting the body and mind
items.ex_en: Gentle acoustic melodies helped the stressed physician relax after surgery.
items.ex_zh: 轻柔的原声旋律帮助压力巨大的外科医生在手术后放松身心。
items.ex2_en: Tense neck muscles relax gradually during a warm lavender oil therapeutic massage.
items.ex2_zh: 在温热的薰衣草精油理疗按摩中，紧绷的颈部肌肉逐渐放松。

items.def_zh: 解乏，放松（从压力中解脱）
items.def_en: To gradually relax and let go of stress after a period of intense exertion or strain
items.ex_en: She poured a glass of wine to unwind after a crazy day.
items.ex_zh: 在疯狂忙碌了一天后，她倒了一杯葡萄酒来解乏放松。
items.ex2_en: Gentle acoustic guitar melodies help unwind tight nerves after long working hours.
items.ex2_zh: 轻柔的原声吉他旋律有助于在漫长的工作时间后舒缓紧绷的神经。

items.def_en: To lean back or lie down comfortably in a supported, restful posture
items.ex_en: The convalescent patient chose to recline quietly on the comfortable velvet sofa.
items.ex_zh: 处于恢复期的病人选择静静地斜躺在舒适的天鹅绒沙发上。
items.ex2_en: The passenger reclined the airplane seat backward to sleep during the flight.
items.ex2_zh: 乘客将飞机座椅向后倾斜，以便在飞行途中睡觉。

items.def_en: To recover from fatigue, exhaustion, or illness back to normal strength
items.ex_en: The athlete retreated to the mountain clinic to recuperate from severe injuries.
items.ex_zh: 这位运动员退隐至高山诊所，以从严重伤病中康复休养。

groups.summary_en: Concerns cessation of exertion to recuperate physical energy, relieve mental tension, or adopt an idle, restful posture.
groups.summary_zh: 指暂停劳作以恢复体力、消除紧张感或处于舒坦姿态。
groups.desc_en: Involves ceasing physical or mental exertion to dissipate strain and rebuild depleted physiological reserves, contrasting with intense activity by embracing restorative stillness.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及停止身心劳作以消解紧张压力、重建耗尽的生理能量，与剧烈活动相对，强调滋养修复性的静止与松弛。
groups.nuance_en: rest: general pausing of labor or exertion to alleviate exhaustion (mind / legs / eyes) · relax: shedding emotional stiffness, tension, and formal posture (muscles / attitude / grip) · unwind: decompressing and shedding accumulated daily stress through leisure (after work / with drink / nerves) · recline: physically leaning back or lying down horizontally in comfortable support (on sofa / in chair / body) · recuperate: active biological or financial recovery from illness, surgery, or major losses (from illness / strength / losses)
groups.nuance_zh: rest: 最通用的暂停劳作以缓解疲劳、养精蓄锐 (mind / legs / eyes) · relax: 舒缓紧绷的神经、肌肉或放松严肃姿态 (muscles / attitude / grip) · unwind: 在一天高压后通过闲暇活动逐渐卸下心防与松弛下来 (after work / with drink / nerves) · recline: 身体向后倚靠或横躺在舒适支撑物上 (on sofa / in chair / body) · recuperate: 从大病、创伤或重大亏损中恢复体力与元气 (from illness / strength / losses)

groups.name: Restate & Reaffirm · 重申与强调性声明 (Reiterate, Reaffirm, Underscore)
groups.tip: 重复言说再次强调原本观点

items.def_en: To talk or complain about a particular subject continuously and tediously
items.ex_en: Stop harping on my past mistakes during every single family dinner conversation.
items.ex_zh: 别在每次家庭晚餐谈话时都翻来覆去唠叨我过去的错误。

items.def_en: To say something again or several times in order to make the meaning thoroughly clear
items.ex_en: The company president took the podium to reiterate our core strategic objectives.
items.ex_zh: 公司总裁走上讲台，再次重申我们的核心战略目标。

items.def_en: To emphasize the decisive truth or essential nature of something said
items.ex_en: The catastrophic quarterly earnings report served to underscore our urgent financial challenges.
items.ex_zh: 这份灾难性的季度财报进一步凸显了我们迫在眉睫的财务挑战。

items.def_en: 1. To state an idea, rule, or argument again, especially in a different way to clarify or emphasize it.
items.ex_en: The professor paused briefly to restate the core thesis of his complex argument.
items.ex_zh: 教授稍作停顿，重新阐述了他那复杂论点的核心论题。

items.def_en: To declare state policy, commitment, or belief strongly again in a formal setting
items.ex_en: The prime minister delivered a speech to reaffirm the nation's commitment to peace.
items.ex_zh: 首相发表讲话，再次重申了该国对和平的承诺。

groups.summary_en: Unlike derogatory rehash frames, this frame centers on formal, deliberate, or clarifying restatements intended to ensure clarity, reassert commitment, or underline paramount importance in discourse.
groups.summary_zh: 指为强调原则、澄清误会或重表决心而正式重申言论。
groups.desc_en: Involves repeating a previously stated position, principle, or factual truth with enhanced emphasis and clarity, contrasting with novel articulation by reinforcing established stance.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及以更清晰、坚定的口吻再次陈述此前已表达过的立场、原则或事实，与首次提出不同，它重在加固既有主张。
groups.nuance_en: harp on: tiresomely and tediously dwelling on or repeating the same grievance (mistakes / past / point) · reiterate: deliberately stating an instruction or warning again for unmistakable clarity (plea / warning / instructions) · underscore: metaphorically drawing a line under a point to emphasize its gravity (importance / urgency / need) · restate: expressing a definition, principle, or claim in new or explicit terms (argument / hypothesis / position) · reaffirm: solemn, public confirming of an ongoing commitment, belief, or treaty (commitment / faith / allegiance)
groups.nuance_zh: harp on: 令人厌烦地一再唠叨、反复纠缠同一旧事或痛处 (mistakes / past / point) · reiterate: 为防误解或增强印象而明确重申指令或警告 (plea / warning / instructions) · underscore: 划重点般强化强调某论点的重要性或紧迫性 (importance / urgency / need) · restate: 用更新或更明确的词句再次表述论点或定义 (argument / hypothesis / position) · reaffirm: 庄严且公开地重申对誓言、信念或条约的坚定不移 (commitment / faith / allegiance)

groups.name: Restrain & Forbear · 克制与包容 (Forbear, Hold back, Patiently endure)
groups.tip: 压制内在冲动并保持克制隐忍

items.def_en: To make a desperate, conscious effort to stop yourself from saying what you really think
items.ex_en: I had to bite my tongue instead of telling him what I really thought.
items.ex_zh: 我不得不强忍着没说，没有把自己的真实想法告诉他。

items.def_en: To deliberately stop oneself from speaking, displaying emotion, or acting
items.ex_en: She struggled to hold back her tears during the farewell ceremony.
items.ex_zh: 在欢送仪式上，她竭力克制着自己的眼泪。

items.def_en: To keep an impulse, emotion, or reaction under firm control
items.ex_en: He took several deep breaths to keep his mounting frustration in check.
items.ex_zh: 他做了几次深呼吸，以抑制自己不断滋长的挫败感。

items.def_en: To manage to suppress strong feelings of anger, excitement, or grief
items.ex_en: She could barely contain her excitement when the winner was announced.
items.ex_zh: 当获奖者公布时，她几乎无法抑制心中的兴奋。

items.def_en: To refrain politely from doing or saying something, or to show patience and self-control.
items.ex_en: Out of respect for her grief, he chose to forbear from questioning her.
items.ex_zh: 出于对她悲痛心情的体谅，他克制住自己没有追问。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on internal deliberate restraint and patient endurance, where an agent chooses not to speak, react, or enforce a right out of politeness, discipline, or mercy. Nuances range from mild self-control to stoic self-suppression.
groups.summary_zh: 指出于礼貌、耐心或修养而主观抑制反应、言论或情绪的隐忍行为。
groups.desc_en: Involves exerting conscious self-mastery to suppress an immediate impulse, retort, or aggressive retaliation, contrasting with unrestrained indulgence by choosing patient inward containment.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及施加自觉的自制力来压抑当下的冲动、反驳或报复行为，与纵情发泄相对，强调内敛隐忍与宽厚克制。
groups.nuance_en: bite one's tongue: straining forcefully to stop oneself from blurting out an angry or truthful remark (in meeting / during argument / to keep peace) · hold back: restraining tears, physical advance, or an impending eruption of force (emotions / tears / troops) · keep in check: maintaining vigilant regulatory control over negative or wild variables (inflation / temper / weeds) · contain: preventing a spreading threat, fire, or passionate impulse from spilling outward (anger / outbreak / fire) · forbear: magnanimously refraining from exercising a right, judgment, or retaliatory strike (from comment / retaliation / debt collection)
groups.nuance_zh: bite one's tongue: 强忍住想要脱口而出的冲动反驳或尖锐话语 (in meeting / during argument / to keep peace) · hold back: 竭力遏止住眼泪、军队推进或即将爆发的情感 (emotions / tears / troops) · keep in check: 持续警惕地将不良趋势、脾气或恶性变量约束在合理界限内 (inflation / temper / weeds) · contain: 严密控制火势、疫情扩散或内心怒火使其不至外溢蔓延 (anger / outbreak / fire) · forbear: 出于宽厚涵养而大度克制，免去追究、报复或行使索债权 (from comment / retaliation / debt collection)

groups.name: Restrain & Refrain · 自律与克制 (Refrain, Desist, Withhold)
groups.tip: 自我克制欲望或避免冲动

items.def_en: To deliberately delay taking an action until a later, more favorable time
items.ex_en: Let's hold off on signing the contract until the lawyer looks it over.
items.ex_zh: 我们先别急着签合同，等律师仔细审查过再说。

items.def_en: To prevent yourself from doing something, or stop an impulse
items.ex_en: He could hardly keep from laughing at the absurd situation before him.
items.ex_zh: 面对眼前荒谬的情景，他几乎忍不住要笑出声来。

items.def_en: To stop oneself from doing or saying something.
items.ex_en: Passengers are formally requested to refrain from smoking throughout the flight.
items.ex_zh: 正式要求全体乘客在整个飞行期间克制吸烟行为。

items.def_en: To deliberately refuse to give, express, or disclose something
items.ex_en: The suspect deliberately chose to withhold vital information from the detectives.
items.ex_zh: 嫌疑人故意对侦探隐瞒了至关重要的信息。

items.def_en: (+ from) To stop doing something, especially after an official or formal request
items.ex_en: The court ordered the company to cease and desist from infringing on the patent.
items.ex_zh: 法院责令该公司停止侵犯该专利权。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here denote consciously halting or choosing not to perform an action, typically due to formal rules, etiquette, or moral consideration. The focus is on active non-action and intentional self-governance.
groups.summary_zh: 表示基于道德、规则或礼节而主动停止或不去做某种动作。
groups.desc_en: Deliberately checking an imminent action, impulse, or disclosure through self-control, contrasting with external blocking (prevent/bar).
groups.desc_zh: 通过自我克制主动抑制即将发生的行动、冲动或信息释放，区别于外部力量的物理阻拦或禁止（prevent/bar）。
groups.nuance_en: refrain: formal, deliberate self-denial from an urge (comment / criticism / smoking) · desist: formally or legally halting an ongoing nuisance (action / conduct) · withhold: refusing to release or grant something held (information / consent / payment) · hold off: delaying an action until a better time (decision / attack) · keep from: personal effort to suppress an instinctive impulse (laughing / crying)
groups.nuance_zh: refrain: 正式且克制地放弃某种冲动或行为 (comment / criticism / smoking) · desist: 正式或法律上勒令停止正在进行的骚扰或侵害行为 (action / conduct) · withhold: 扣留、拒绝给予或暂不透露 (information / consent / payment) · hold off: 暂时按兵不动以待时机 (decision / attack) · keep from: 努力抑制住本能的冲动或反应 (laughing / crying)

groups.name: Restructure & Streamline · 架构重组与体制理顺 (Reorganize, Overhaul, Rationalize)
groups.tip: 调整内部框架与组织结构

items.def_en: 1. To organize a company, system, finance, or organization in a new and different way to improve efficiency.
items.ex_en: The executive committee decided to restructure the company to improve operational efficiency.
items.ex_zh: 执行委员会决定重组公司架构以提升运营效率。

items.def_en: To make an organization, process, or production line simpler, more modern, and efficient
items.ex_en: The software update will streamline our daily administrative workflow considerably.
items.ex_zh: 这次软件更新将大幅精简我们的日常行政工作流程。

items.def_en: To change the way in which a business, department, or system is structured
items.ex_en: The new manager plans to reorganize the entire sales department next month.
items.ex_zh: 新经理计划下个月整顿重组整个销售部门。
items.ex2_en: The local police department reorganized swiftly after new community safety guidelines arrived.
items.ex2_zh: 在新的社区安全指南下达后，当地警察局迅速进行了重组。

items.def_zh: 合理化整顿（常涉裁员减支）
items.def_en: To make a business or system more effective by cutting superfluous staff or unprofitable units
items.ex_en: The bank had to rationalize its branch network by closing unprofitable locations.
items.ex_zh: 该银行不得不通过关闭亏损网点来合理化整顿其分支网络。

items.def_en: To thoroughly examine a machine, legal code, or system and implement repairs or updates
items.ex_en: Lawmakers have drafted a comprehensive bill to overhaul the national healthcare system.
items.ex_zh: 立法者起草了一项全面法案以彻底革新国家医疗保障系统。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on fundamental systemic, corporate, or financial reform aimed at increasing viability, eliminating redundancy, or saving a company from insolvency. The tone is strategic, administrative, and economic.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重针对企业机制、财务体系或机构运作的结构性重整。
groups.desc_en: Systematically altering internal configurations to improve efficiency or resolve distress, contrasting with superficial cosmetic adjustments (tweak/modify).
groups.desc_zh: 系统性重塑内部组织架构以提升效益或摆脱困境，区别于局部的微调修饰（tweak/modify）。
groups.nuance_en: restructure: altering fundamental financial or organizational architecture (debt / company / operations) · streamline: eliminating redundancies to make a process faster and leaner (workflow / process / bureaucracy) · reorganize: reshuffling existing components or departments (cabinet / division / files) · rationalize: eliminating inefficiency on logical or economic grounds (production / workforce / network) · overhaul: thorough examination followed by comprehensive repair (system / engine / curriculum)
groups.nuance_zh: restructure: 对财务或组织底层架构进行大刀阔斧的重构 (debt / company / operations) · streamline: 剔除冗余以精简并加快流程 (workflow / process / bureaucracy) · reorganize: 重新编排或调换现有部门与人员 (cabinet / division / files) · rationalize: 基于经济或逻辑合理化裁减无效部分 (production / workforce / network) · overhaul: 彻底检修并全面革新重整 (system / engine / curriculum)

groups.name: Result & Ensue · 产生与导致 (Ensue, Stem, Arise)
groups.tip: 因果链条引发的后果

items.def_zh: 发生，产生；（因……而）产生，（由……）造成；导致，结果是
items.def_en: To happen because of something else; to end in or lead to a particular outcome.
items.ex_en: Failure to follow the safety protocols could result in catastrophic consequences.
items.ex_zh: 不遵守安全规程可能会导致灾难性的后果。

items.def_en: To happen as a logical or necessary consequence of a stated premise or prior occurrence
items.ex_en: It does not necessarily follow that higher prices guarantee superior product quality.
items.ex_zh: 价格更高并不必然意味着产品质量更加优越。

items.def_en: To begin to exist or become apparent as a consequence of a particular situation
items.ex_en: Several unexpected legal complications may arise during the company's merger process.
items.ex_zh: 在公司合并过程中可能会产生若干意料之外的法律纠纷。

items.def_en: To develop or originate as a result of a particular condition, cause, or event
items.ex_en: Most of their marital conflicts stem from severe financial stress.
items.ex_zh: 他们夫妻间的大多数冲突都源自沉重的经济压力。

items.def_en: To happen after something else, especially as a direct or natural consequence
items.ex_en: A brief silence fell, and chaotic shouting ensued across the auditorium.
items.ex_zh: 一阵短暂的沉默之后，礼堂里随即爆发出一片混乱的呼喊声。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this causal frame trace how events, states, or outcomes follow from preceding conditions. They contrast direct consequences, temporal aftermaths, and logical developments growing organically out of a root source.
groups.summary_zh: 指某事件或状况由先前原因随之产生、引发或导出。
groups.desc_en: Expressing that an event or condition arises as a consequence or subsequent development, contrasting with direct active causation (cause/produce).
groups.desc_zh: 表达某事作为必然或随后的逻辑后果而生发，区别于施动者直接的主动引发（cause/produce）。
groups.nuance_en: result: direct, neutral outcome of an antecedent cause (injury / success / damage) · ensue: chronologically following as an immediate, often chaotic consequence (panic / silence / riot) · stem from: tracing back to an underlying origin or root cause (anxiety / tradition / dispute) · arise: emerging into existence from circumstances (complications / opportunity / suspicion) · follow: logical deduction or temporal sequence following a premise (logic / conclusion)
groups.nuance_zh: result: 最中性的前后直接因果产物 (injury / success / damage) · ensue: 在某事件后随即发生，常带有不可收拾或混乱意味 (panic / silence / riot) · stem from: 追溯至深层的根源或萌芽 (anxiety / tradition / dispute) · arise: 从某种情境或土壤中冒出、显现 (complications / opportunity / suspicion) · follow: 符合逻辑推导的必然跟随或时序承接 (logic / conclusion)

groups.name: Resume & Pick Back Up · 中断后继续 (Resume, Restart, Pick up)
groups.tip: 中断后重新拾起推进

items.def_zh: （中断后）重新开始，继续；恢复（职位或状态）
items.def_en: To begin again or continue after a pause or interruption; to return to a previous seat, place, or position
items.ex_en: The diplomatic negotiations are scheduled to resume tomorrow morning at nine.
items.ex_zh: 外交谈判预定于明早九点重新开始。
items.ex2_en: The factory owner decided to resume production after securing new raw materials.
items.ex2_zh: 工厂老板在获得新原材料后决定恢复生产。

items.def_en: To start an activity again after a pause, especially from the point where it stopped
items.ex_en: Business usually picks up in the spring, and sales figures improve rapidly.
items.ex_zh: 生意通常在春季好转，销售额也会迅速回升。

items.def_en: To continue an activity or task, especially after a disruption or interruption
items.ex_en: Despite facing severe financial difficulties, they decided to carry on with the project.
items.ex_zh: 尽管面临严重的财务困难，他们还是决定把项目继续做下去。

items.def_en: To begin operating or occurring again after stopping
items.ex_en: The technician advised us to restart the server to clear the system error.
items.ex_zh: 技术员建议我们重新启动服务器以清除系统错误。
items.ex2_en: Factory operations will restart tomorrow morning after scheduled maintenance checks finish completely.
items.ex2_zh: 在例行检修彻底完成后，工厂运营将于明早重新开始。

items.def_en: To begin again or cause something to begin again after a pause; formal equivalent of resume
items.ex_en: The trial will recommence next Monday after the scheduled judicial recess.
items.ex_zh: 该案件的审理将在预定的休庭结束后于下周一重新开始。
items.ex2_en: The construction crew will recommence bridge repairs early next spring after thaws.
items.ex2_zh: 解冻后的明年初春，施工队伍将重新开始桥梁维修工程。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame mark re-initiating an activity, process, or posture precisely after a temporary hiatus, pause, or disruption.
groups.summary_zh: 特指在暂停、打断或停顿后重新开始或继续进行。
groups.desc_en: Restarting an activity or narrative from the exact point where it was interrupted, contrasting with initiating de novo (start/commence).
groups.desc_zh: 在经历暂停或中断后从原停顿点继续推进，区别于完全从零发起的初次开始（start/commence）。
groups.nuance_en: resume: standard formal term for continuing after an intentional pause (talks / flight / duty) · pick up: informally returning to where one left off (thread / conversation / story) · carry on: persevering despite interruptions or difficulties (tradition / work / conversation) · restart: powering on or initiating again from the beginning or pause (engine / computer / process) · recommence: solemn or ceremonial resumption (hostilities / proceedings / trial)
groups.nuance_zh: resume: 正式且标准的中断后恢复原状 (talks / flight / duty) · pick up: 口语化地接续上次停下的线索或话茬 (thread / conversation / story) · carry on: 顶住干扰或困境继续进行下去 (tradition / work / conversation) · restart: 机器或流程的重新启动或重新置位 (engine / computer / process) · recommence: 极其庄重的重新开始，常指敌对状态或法定程序 (hostilities / proceedings / trial)

groups.name: Resurrect & Revive · 起死回生与复兴 (Revive, Resuscitate, Reanimate)
groups.tip: 失去生命机能后重获生机

items.def_en: To return someone to life or restore an extinct custom, fashion, or law to active use
items.ex_en: The school board decided to bring back the traditional dress code this semester.
items.ex_zh: 校董事会决定在本学期恢复传统的着装规范。

items.def_en: To become conscious, healthy, or active again, or make someone or something do so
items.ex_en: The government launched new initiatives to revive the struggling tourism sector.
items.ex_zh: 政府推出了多项新举措以使陷入困境的旅游业恢复生机。
items.ex2_en: Faded childhood memories revive vividly whenever she visits her grandmother's rural cottage.
items.ex2_zh: 每当她探访祖母的乡村小屋时，褪色的童年记忆便生动地复苏。

items.def_zh: （通过急救）使苏醒；使恢复生气
items.def_en: To make someone start breathing again after they have nearly died, or revive an ailing system
items.ex_en: Paramedics worked tirelessly for twenty minutes to resuscitate the drowning victim.
items.ex_zh: 急救人员不知疲倦地抢救了二十分钟，终于使溺水者苏醒过来。
items.ex2_en: Ailing regional businesses rarely resuscitate without substantial infusions of emergency government capital.
items.ex2_zh: 如果没有政府注入大量紧急资金，陷入困境的地区企业很难复苏。

items.def_zh: 赋予新生命；使恢复生气
items.def_en: To bring something back to life or inject fresh vitality into a lifeless body or project
items.ex_en: Fresh funding served to reanimate the abandoned urban redevelopment project.
items.ex_zh: 新的注资使那个被搁置的城市改建项目重新焕发出生机。

items.def_zh: 使复活，使起死回生；使复兴，恢复
items.def_en: 1. To bring a dead person back to life. 2. To bring an old idea, custom, or practice back into use.
items.ex_en: The candidate attempted to resurrect an outdated policy proposal from the previous decade.
items.ex_zh: 该候选人企图重新起用十年前一项已经过时的政策提议。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on restoring life, vitality, or active existence to someone or something dead, unconscious, or lapsed. Nuances span literal medical resuscitation to metaphorical restoration of dormant practices, memories, or institutions.
groups.summary_zh: 指将濒死或已亡者救活，或使废弃的制度、观念、记忆等重现生机与活力。
groups.desc_en: Restoring life, vigor, or currency to something dormant, dying, or long defunct, contrasting with simple maintenance (preserve/sustain).
groups.desc_zh: 使处于濒死、休眠或早已消亡的事物重获生机或时代活力，区别于单纯的日常维持（preserve/sustain）。
