groups.nuance_en: revive: restoring consciousness, vitality, or popularity (economy / tradition / consciousness) · resurrect: dramatically raising from the dead or long abandonment (career / corpse / ideology) · resuscitate: emergency medical rescue from the brink of death (patient / victim / fortunes) · reanimate: infusing mechanistic, physical, or magical life into dead matter (corpse / doll / flesh) · bring back: everyday idiom for restoring a past practice or style (fashion / memories / death penalty)
groups.nuance_zh: revive: 使恢复神志、生机或重新流行 (economy / tradition / consciousness) · resurrect: 戏剧性地让死者起死回生或重新翻出尘封已久的事物 (career / corpse / ideology) · resuscitate: 临危实施急救使生命或崩溃机构苏醒 (patient / victim / fortunes) · reanimate: 为无生命的死肉或躯壳注入活动机能 (corpse / doll / flesh) · bring back: 最通俗地带回旧风尚、旧规则或回忆 (fashion / memories / death penalty)

groups.name: Retain & Hold · 保留与持有 (Withhold, Keep Back, Hang Onto)
groups.tip: 维持持有状态不脱手

items.def_zh: 保留，预留（专供日后使用）
items.def_en: To keep something available for a particular person, purpose, or future time
items.ex_en: We should reserve these funds for emergency operational expenses next year.
items.ex_zh: 我们应该将这笔资金留作明年应对紧急运营开支之用。

items.def_zh: 保留，保持；记住；聘用（律师等）
items.def_en: 1. to keep or continue to hold something in one's possession. 2. to absorb and keep something within. 3. to secure the services of a professional, especially a lawyer, by paying a preliminary fee.
items.ex_en: The historic cathedral manages to retain its architectural magnificence despite recent renovations.
items.ex_zh: 尽管经历了近期的修缮，这座古老的大教堂仍保留着其建筑的宏伟。

items.def_en: To keep something in your possession instead of selling, discarding, or losing it
items.ex_en: You should hang onto those vintage comic books because their value will rise.
items.ex_zh: 你应该留着那些老漫画书，因为它们日后会升值。

items.def_en: To reserve or refuse to surrender a portion of something
items.ex_en: The landlord decided to keep back half the deposit for cleaning fees.
items.ex_zh: 房东决定扣下一半押金作为清洁费。

items.def_en: To refuse to give or release something that is expected, earned, or requested
items.ex_en: The agency cannot withhold these public records without a valid judicial order.
items.ex_zh: 若无正当的法院令状，该机构不得扣留这些公开记录。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses holding onto physical possessions, control, employees, or internal attributes rather than surrendering, transferring, or discarding them.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动拥有、守住或不予让渡财物、权利、人才或特质。
groups.desc_en: Keeping possession or control of something rather than parting with or releasing it, contrasting with acquiring (obtain/seize).
groups.desc_zh: 将原本掌握的事物留存手中而不交付或舍弃，区别于主动获取新事物（obtain/seize）。
groups.nuance_en: retain: formally preserving control, possession, or hired services (control / lawyer / title) · reserve: setting aside for a specific future purpose or person (right / seat / judgment) · hang onto: informally clinging tightly to a valuable or scarce possession (shares / lead / relics) · withhold: deliberately refusing to release something owed or expected (information / payment / evidence) · keep back: hiding or reserving a portion of something (truth / money / secret)
groups.nuance_zh: retain: 正式保有掌控权、权益或聘用关系 (control / lawyer / title) · reserve: 为特定目的或日后行使而预留 (right / seat / judgment) · hang onto: 口语中抓牢不放、舍不得出手 (shares / lead / relics) · withhold: 故意扣押应交出的钱物或隐匿信息 (information / payment / evidence) · keep back: 暗中留下一手或隐瞒部分真相 (truth / money / secret)

groups.name: Retaliate & Strike Back · 反击与报复 (Strike Back, Hit Back, Avenge)
groups.tip: 遭受攻击后以牙还牙反扑

items.def_en: (+ against/at) To deliver an immediate or determined counter-blow against an aggressor
items.ex_en: The company struck back at its competitors by slashing prices across the board.
items.ex_zh: 该企业通过全线大幅降价对竞争对手发起了回击。

items.def_en: (+ at) To retaliate vigorously against attacks, accusations, or hostile actions
items.ex_en: The senator used her press conference to hit back at her political critics.
items.ex_zh: 参议员利用新闻发布会有力地回击了针对她的政治批评。

items.def_en: To do something unpleasant to someone to punish them for having hurt or offended you
items.ex_en: He swore he would get back at them for ruining his reputation.
items.ex_zh: 他发誓一定要报复他们败坏自己声誉的行为。

items.def_en: To inflict punishment or damage on someone in return for an injury done to oneself or one's group
items.ex_en: The young prince swore a solemn oath to avenge his father's murder.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的王子立下重誓，誓要为惨遭杀害的父亲复仇。

items.def_en: (+ against/by) To attack, harm, or take action against someone in return for an injury, insult, or attack.
items.ex_en: The military warned that it would retaliate against any cross-border drone incursions.
items.ex_zh: 军方警告称，将对任何越境无人机袭击采取报复行动。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe inflicting counter-harm or attacking in response to a prior wrong, provocation, or aggression. Differences focus on the immediacy of the counterstrike versus planned personal revenge or punitive legal restitution.
groups.summary_zh: 针对此前遭受的攻击、伤害或侮辱进行反攻或施加报复。
groups.desc_en: Inflicting harm or striking back in response to an injury or attack, contrasting with unprovoked aggression (attack/assault).
groups.desc_zh: 针对遭受的侵害进行有针对性的以牙还牙式回击，区别于无事生非的主动挑衅侵略（attack/assault）。
groups.nuance_en: retaliate: planned, commensurate reprisal by an entity (against sanctions / attacks) · strike back: dynamic, swift counterblow against an adversary (against critics / competitor / enemy) · hit back: vigorous and immediate defense or counter-criticism (at allegations / opponent) · avenge: exacting moral or retributive justice on behalf of someone wronged (death / honor / defeat) · get back at: colloquial and petty personal score-settling (ex-partner / rival)
groups.nuance_zh: retaliate: 组织或国家层面有计划的对等报复 (against sanctions / attacks) · strike back: 迅速有力的战术性反手重击 (against critics / competitor / enemy) · hit back: 面对指责时疾速反驳与反咬 (at allegations / opponent) · avenge: 为受害者昭雪或雪耻式的道义复仇 (death / honor / defeat) · get back at: 私人之间琐碎狭隘的寻机报复 (ex-partner / rival)

groups.name: Retch & Gag · 干呕与反胃 (Retch, Gag, Heave)
groups.tip: 胃部痉挛反胃欲呕或吐出

items.def_en: To swallow down or suppress a wave of nausea, retching, or emotion
items.ex_en: She had to choke back her nausea as the foul odor hit her.
items.ex_zh: 刺鼻的恶臭扑面而来，她不得不强行压制住恶心。

items.def_zh: 作呕，喉咙被卡得恶心欲吐
items.def_en: To choke or experience an involuntary throat reflex as if about to vomit
items.ex_en: The pungent smell of rotting fish made him gag almost immediately.
items.ex_zh: 腐烂鱼肉的刺鼻气味几乎立刻让他作呕。

items.def_en: To undergo agonizing spasmodic efforts to vomit, characterized by heavy muscular contraction
items.ex_en: His chest began to heave violently as the sea sickness overwhelmed him.
items.ex_zh: 随着严重晕船袭来，他的胸膛开始剧烈起伏作呕。

items.def_en: To make the physical movement and sound of vomiting, especially without actually bringing anything up.
items.ex_en: The runner collapsed by the track and began to retch uncontrollably.
items.ex_zh: 那名跑者瘫倒在跑道旁，开始止不住地干呕。

items.def_en: To make painful vomiting motions repeatedly when the stomach is empty
items.ex_en: Exhausted from food poisoning, he could only dry-heave over the toilet bowl.
items.ex_zh: 他因食物中毒精疲力竭，只能对着马桶一阵阵痛苦地干呕。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on the spasmodic, involuntary muscular contractions and choking throat reflexes of vomiting, typically without expelling stomach contents, or in anticipation of actual regurgitation.
groups.summary_zh: 指咽喉受到刺激或极度恶心引发的肌肉痉挛性干呕与欲呕反应。
groups.desc_en: Involuntary spasmodic physical contractions of the stomach and throat trying to expel contents, contrasting with actual completed vomiting (vomit/throw up).
groups.desc_zh: 喉部与胃部剧烈痉挛欲吐而未完全吐出的本能生理抽搐，区别于已彻底呕吐出秽物（vomit/throw up）。
groups.nuance_en: retch: spasmodic, noisy abdominal heave without bringing up much (loudly / violently) · gag: sudden choking reflex in the throat triggered by taste, smell, or obstruction (on smoke / on food) · dry-heave: severe, empty retching when the stomach is barren (painfully / repeatedly) · heave: deep, heavy muscular lifting motion of the torso before vomiting (violently / chest) · choke back: exerting conscious effort to swallow down bile, tears, or a sob (tears / vomit / bile)
groups.nuance_zh: retch: 伴随声响的腹部剧烈痉挛干呕 (loudly / violently) · gag: 咽喉因恶臭、异物或反胃而触发的窒息性作呕反射 (on smoke / on food) · dry-heave: 胃中空无一物时的痛苦干抽 (painfully / repeatedly) · heave: 呕吐前胸腹部大幅度的起伏抽动 (violently / chest) · choke back: 强行用意志把泛上来的呕吐物或眼泪咽回去 (tears / vomit / bile)

groups.name: Retire & Withdraw · 退职与引退 (Retire, Resign, Step down)
groups.tip: 交出职权脱离工作并退隐

items.def_en: To withdraw gracefully from an activity, career, or contest
items.ex_en: After three decades in politics, the senator decided to bow out gracefully.
items.ex_zh: 在政坛打拼了三十年后，这位参议员决定体面退场。

items.def_en: To resign formally from a prominent post, office, or leadership position
items.ex_en: The CEO decided to step down after a decade of leading the corporation.
items.ex_zh: 执掌公司十年后，首席执行官决定引咎辞职。

items.def_zh: 退职，退休；引退，隐退；就寝
items.def_en: 1. To stop working, especially after reaching a certain age. 2. (+ to) To withdraw to a quiet or private place; to go to bed.
items.ex_en: After forty years of distinguished service, the chief engineer decided to retire.
items.ex_zh: 在恪尽职守工作了四十年之后，总工程师决定退休。

items.def_en: (+ from) To give up a job, post, or membership voluntarily
items.ex_en: The scandal prompted the finance director to resign from the governing board.
items.ex_zh: 这起丑闻促使财务总监主动辞去了理事会的职务。

items.def_en: To formally renounce a royal throne or supreme sovereign responsibility
items.ex_en: The aging monarch chose to abdicate the throne in favor of his eldest son.
items.ex_zh: 年迈的君主选择退位，将王位传给他的长子。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers relinquishing a professional career, office, or public post, or retreating from public life and noisy environments into privacy or seclusion.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动辞任职务、达到年限退休或退隐避世。
groups.desc_en: Voluntarily or formally relinquishing a high office, role, or active working life, contrasting with dismissal (fire/depose).
groups.desc_zh: 自愿或依照规程卸下职务、身份或退出职业生涯，区别于被外部强行免职或罢黜（fire/depose）。
groups.nuance_en: retire: formally concluding one's professional career due to age or tenure (from politics / from post) · resign: officially quitting an office or job prematurely (from post / in protest) · step down: yielding an influential leadership position to a successor (as CEO / as chairman) · bow out: gracefully and voluntarily exiting a race, role, or stage (of race / from public life) · abdicate: formally relinquishing supreme sovereign power or duty (throne / responsibility)
groups.nuance_zh: retire: 达到年限或功成名就后正式退休 (from politics / from post) · resign: 因个人意愿或抗议而正式提交辞呈 (from post / in protest) · step down: 腾退核心领导权交由后继者接班 (as CEO / as chairman) · bow out: 体面优雅地退出竞争、职务或公众视野 (of race / from public life) · abdicate: 君主正式退位或放弃重大法定职责 (throne / responsibility)

groups.name: Retraction of Words & Statements · 收回言论与撤销 (Retract, Take back, Disavow)
groups.tip: 收回已说过的话或取消承诺声明

items.def_en: Admit that something one said was wrong, hurtful, or untrue and withdraw it
items.ex_en: He apologized sincerely and offered to take back the hurtful remark immediately.
items.ex_zh: 他真诚地道歉，并主动提出立即收回那句伤人的话。

items.def_en: Formally declare that a previous public statement, claim, or accusation is invalid
items.ex_en: The newspaper was forced to retract the false allegations against the senator.
items.ex_zh: 该报社被迫正式撤回了针对那位参议员的不实指控。
items.ex2_en: The metallic landing gear retracted smoothly into the fuselage right after takeoff.
items.ex2_zh: 起飞后不久，金属起落架便平稳地收回了机身内。

items.def_en: Deny any responsibility, connection, or support for a statement or action
items.ex_en: The candidate rushed to disavow the controversial remarks made by his campaign manager.
items.ex_zh: 候选人急忙出面澄清，声明对竞选经理发表的争议言论概不负责。

items.def_zh: 宣布放弃（信仰/见解），公开翻供
items.def_en: Formally reject or renounce a previously held belief, confession, or sworn opinion
items.ex_en: Under intense public scrutiny, the philosopher agreed to recant his controversial theories.
items.ex_zh: 在严密的公众审视下，这位哲学家同意公开宣布放弃自己的争议理论。

items.def_zh: 收回（已说的话）；unsay的过去式和过去分词
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of unsay; to retract or take back something previously said.
items.ex_en: He stood in bitter remorse, wishing his rash words could be unsaid.
items.ex_zh: 他懊悔万分地站在那里，但愿自己那些鲁莽的话语能被收回。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve a speaker formally or informally rescinding, revoking, or wishing away a prior statement, accusation, or promise.
groups.summary_zh: 指发言者主动或被迫收回、撤销、否认或声明先前的言论作废。
groups.desc_en: Formally withdrawing, undoing, or disowning a prior utterance or commitment, contrasting with defending or doubling down (affirm/reiterate).
groups.desc_zh: 公开或正式收回、否认或推翻先前已发表的言论或立场，区别于坚持与重申立场（affirm/reiterate）。
groups.nuance_en: retract: formally disavowing a statement, libel, or claim as untrue (allegation / statement / claim) · recant: solemnly renouncing a previous religious or political heresy under pressure (confession / belief / heresy) · disavow: denying any connection with, knowledge of, or responsibility for an utterance or actor (knowledge / remark / responsibility) · take back: everyday expression of withdrawing spoken words or an insult (words / insult / promise) · unsaid: wishing a spoken utterance had never been uttered (leave unsaid / wish unsaid)
groups.nuance_zh: retract: 官方或法律上撤回不实言论、指控或声明 (allegation / statement / claim) · recant: 在压力下公开放弃原有的宗教或政治信条与异端供词 (confession / belief / heresy) · disavow: 矢口否认曾发表过某言论或划清责任界限 (knowledge / remark / responsibility) · take back: 口语中收回刚刚脱口而出的话或侮辱 (words / insult / promise) · unsaid: 将话咽下未说，或事后恨不得能收回从未说过 (leave unsaid / wish unsaid)

groups.name: Reunite & Rejoin · 重聚与复合 (Rejoin, Reconnect, Reassemble)
groups.tip: 分散群体重新聚合融为一体

items.def_zh: 重新建立联系；再续旧情
items.def_en: (+ with) To meet or communicate again with someone after a long break in contact
items.ex_en: She traveled across the country to reconnect with her former college roommate.
items.ex_zh: 她穿行大半个国家，只为与曾经的大学室友重新恢复联系。
items.ex2_en: Technicians worked quickly to reconnect severed fiber optic cables across the district.
items.ex2_zh: 技术人员迅速开展工作，重新连接该地区被切断的光纤电缆。

items.def_zh: （使）重聚，（使）再结合；（使）重新统一
items.def_en: To bring together or come together again after being separated.
items.ex_en: The charity organization works diligently to reunite refugee families across borders.
items.ex_zh: 该慈善机构竭力奔走，帮助跨越国界的难民家庭重新团聚。
items.ex2_en: Former high school classmates will reunite next summer for their twentieth anniversary.
items.ex2_zh: 曾经的高中同学将于明年夏天重新聚首，庆祝毕业二十周年。

items.def_en: To return to and become part of a group, organization, or companion after separation
items.ex_en: The diplomat returned to Geneva to rejoin the ongoing peace negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 那位外交官返回日内瓦，重新加入了正在进行的和平谈判。

items.def_en: To come together again or bring separated members back into a unified group
items.ex_en: The committee members will reassemble tomorrow morning to finalize the annual report.
items.ex_zh: 委员会成员将于明晨重新聚集，以定稿年度工作报告。
items.ex2_en: The curious child will reassemble the intricate mechanical watch piece by piece.
items.ex2_zh: 好奇的孩子将把那块精密的机械表一块一块地重新组装起来。

items.def_en: To restore an alienated or split faction or individual back into a cohesive whole
items.ex_en: Special programs were created to reintegrate former combatants into civilian society.
items.ex_zh: 特别方案得以设立，以使退伍士兵重新融入平民社会。
items.ex2_en: Immigrant families reintegrate naturally into local communities through shared cultural school festivals.
items.ex2_zh: 通过共同参与校园文化节，移民家庭自然而然地融入了当地社区。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on bringing people, factions, or divided territories back together after a period of estrangement, conflict, or physical separation.
groups.summary_zh: 指人、阵营或分裂地区在分离或冲突后再次相聚或重新统合。
groups.desc_en: Bringing dispersed, separated, or estranged members back into a collective whole, contrasting with gathering for the first time (convene/assemble).
groups.desc_zh: 将失散、分立或疏远的个体重新凝聚回归为一个整体，区别于初次的召集聚集（convene/assemble）。
groups.nuance_en: reunite: emotionally bringing separated families, lovers, or groups together (family / lovers / band) · rejoin: returning to a group, military unit, or companion after absence (regiment / party / companions) · reconnect: re-establishing broken social or emotional bonds (with classmates / with roots) · reassemble: physically gathering dispersed people or mechanical parts together again (crowd / components / team) · reintegrate: restoring individuals harmoniously back into broader society (refugees / veterans / into society)
groups.nuance_zh: reunite: 使失散的亲人、伴侣或解散乐队感人重聚 (family / lovers / band) · rejoin: 暂离后归队或重新加入原队伍 (regiment / party / companions) · reconnect: 重新搭上线并恢复情感或社交联络 (with classmates / with roots) · reassemble: 人员或零件重新集中并组装起来 (crowd / components / team) · reintegrate: 使离散或边缘群体重新融入社会体系 (refugees / veterans / into society)

groups.name: Reveal Private Identity or Secrets · 强制公开隐私与曝光 (Out, Expose, Blow the Whistle)
groups.tip: 揭露秘密公开隐情

items.def_zh: 揭露，公开（某人是同性恋或不愿公开的身份）；揭发（秘事）
items.def_en: To reveal someone's homosexuality, transgender identity, or other secret without their consent.
items.ex_en: The vindictive tabloid threatened to out the politician against his wishes.
items.ex_zh: 那家怀有恶意的八卦小报威胁要违背意愿公开该政客的同志身份。

items.def_zh: 告发；揭发内幕（当吹哨人）
items.def_en: Bring covert wrongdoing or a private institutional secret to public attention by alerting authorities or the press
items.ex_en: A former auditor decided to blow the whistle on the firm's widespread tax fraud.
items.ex_zh: 一位前审计员决定公开告发该公司普遍存在的偷税漏税丑闻。

items.def_zh: 人肉搜索并公开个人隐私
items.def_en: Search for and publish private or identifying information about an individual on the internet, typically with malicious intent
items.ex_en: Angry internet trolls threatened to dox the journalist after her critical report.
items.ex_zh: 在该记者发表批评报道后，愤怒的网民威胁要人肉搜索并曝光其隐私。

items.def_zh: 无意或故意泄露（秘密或个人身份）
items.def_en: Inadvertently or deliberately betray someone's true identity, hidden feelings, or secret
items.ex_en: His nervous trembling threatened to give away his true identity to the guards.
items.ex_zh: 他紧张的颤抖险些在警卫面前泄露了他的真实身份。

items.def_zh: 揭开面具；暴露真实身份
items.def_en: Reveal the true, often disreputable identity or deceptive nature of someone previously hidden
items.ex_en: The undercover investigation finally helped unmask the corrupt officials behind the scheme.
items.ex_zh: 这次卧底调查最终揭开了暗中策划该阴谋的腐败官员的真面目。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe forcibly disclosing someone's closely guarded private identity, hidden orientation, or concealed personal secrets without their consent. The tone typically ranges from invasive personal betrayal to controversial public disclosure.
groups.summary_zh: 违背当事人意愿曝光其隐秘身份、性取向或私人底细，带有强烈争议性。
groups.desc_en: Non-consensually exposing a person's hidden identity, secrets, or illicit conduct to public view, contrasting with voluntary confession (disclose/confess).
groups.desc_zh: 违背当事人意愿，将其隐秘身份、见不得光的行径或隐私公之于众，区别于主动坦白交代（disclose/confess）。
groups.nuance_en: expose: uncovering corruption, hypocrisy, or concealed facts to the public (scandal / fraud / corruption) · unmask: dramatically revealing the true sinister identity of a hidden actor (spy / hypocrite / villain) · dox: maliciously publishing an individual's private identifiable data online (activist / opponent / address) · out: disclosing someone's concealed sexual identity or covert allegiance against their will (politician / spy) · blow the whistle: an insider alerting authorities to institutional wrongdoing (on company / on corruption)
groups.nuance_zh: expose: 揭露抨击体制性腐败、丑闻或骗局 (scandal / fraud / corruption) · unmask: 戏剧性揭开伪装者、间谍或恶徒的面具 (spy / hypocrite / villain) · dox: 恶意在网络上人肉搜索并公布私人真实信息 (activist / opponent / address) · out: 违背他人意愿强制曝光其性取向或秘密身份 (politician / spy) · blow the whistle: 内部知情人站出来举报不法黑幕 (on company / on corruption)

groups.name: Revile & Berate · 痛骂与肆意辱骂 (Revile, Vituperate, Berate)
groups.tip: 言辞粗暴侮辱中伤

items.def_en: to speak to or treat someone in a disrespectful, offensive, or scornful manner
items.ex_en: It is completely inappropriate to insult your colleagues during a professional meeting.
items.ex_zh: 在专业会议上侮辱同事是极其不妥的行为。

items.def_en: to protest violently or scold bitterly and furiously against someone or something
items.ex_en: The editorial began to rail against the government's sweeping tax increases.
items.ex_zh: 这篇社论开始严厉谴责政府实施的全面增税政策。

items.def_en: to speak angrily and criticize someone at length for doing something wrong
items.ex_en: The demanding coach would berate the players loudly after every single mistake.
items.ex_zh: 那位要求苛刻的教练在球员犯下哪怕一个失误后都会严厉痛斥。

items.def_en: to speak or write about someone in an intensely disparaging and defamatory way
items.ex_en: The state media continued to vilify the dissident throughout the sham trial.
items.ex_zh: 在整场虚假审判中，官方媒体持续对那位异见人士进行恶意诋毁。

items.def_en: to criticize someone in an extremely hostile, hateful, and abusive manner
items.ex_en: Corrupt officials were publicly reviled by the crowd outside the courthouse.
items.ex_zh: 腐败官员在法院门外遭到了民众的公开痛斥。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers high-intensity, abusive speech acts intended to debase, vilify, or savagely condemn a person using cruel or contemptuous verbal attacks.
groups.summary_zh: 指使用恶毒、轻蔑或攻击性语言对他人进行激烈谩骂或痛斥。
groups.desc_en: Subjecting someone to furious, scathing, and abusive verbal condemnation, contrasting with measured criticism (critique/admonish).
groups.desc_zh: 以极其暴烈、刻薄或恶毒的污言秽语肆意咒骂攻击，区别于克制的批评规劝（critique/admonish）。
groups.nuance_en: berate: scolding lengthily, angrily, and condescendingly (subordinate / child / team) · revile: abusing with deeply hateful, contemptuous language (by opponents / as traitor) · vilify: systematically defaming someone's character in public discourse (in media / reputation) · rail against: loudly and furiously venting grievances against an injustice or system (system / injustice / fate) · insult: directly delivering an offensive, dignity-wounding remark (intelligence / honor)
groups.nuance_zh: berate: 居高临下、长时间且怒气冲冲地痛斥训斥 (subordinate / child / team) · revile: 用极度轻蔑、充满憎恨的恶毒字眼谩骂 (by opponents / as traitor) · vilify: 在舆论场上系统性妖魔化或败坏名誉 (in media / reputation) · rail against: 满腔怒火地大声抨击控诉制度或命运 (system / injustice / fate) · insult: 直接发出侮辱性言语以践踏对方尊严 (intelligence / honor)

groups.name: Revive & Resuscitate · 复苏与苏醒 (Revive, Resuscitate, Resurrect)
groups.tip: 起死回生恢复生命机能

items.def_en: to make someone conscious again after they have fainted or been anaesthetized
items.ex_en: Cold water splashed on his face quickly brought him round.
items.ex_zh: 泼在脸上的冷水很快使他苏醒了过来。

items.def_en: to regain life, strength, or consciousness, or restore someone or something to this state
items.ex_en: A sip of cool water helped to revive the exhausted hiker.
items.ex_zh: 喝了一口凉水让筋疲力尽的徒步旅行者恢复了活力。
items.ex2_en: Wilted flowers revive miraculously after absorbing fresh rainfall overnight in the garden.
items.ex2_zh: 花园里枯萎的花朵在一夜之间吸收了新鲜雨水后奇迹般地复苏了。

items.def_en: to bring back to life from death, or reinstate a forgotten custom, practice, or enterprise
items.ex_en: The committee decided to resurrect the long-abandoned cultural festival this year.
items.ex_zh: 委员会决定在今年复兴这个废弃已久的文化节。

items.def_en: to revive someone from unconsciousness or apparent death by emergency medical procedures
items.ex_en: Paramedics worked tirelessly to resuscitate the victim of the drowning accident.
items.ex_zh: 医护人员不知疲倦地抢救那位溺水事故的受害者。
items.ex2_en: Failing corporate investments rarely resuscitate after losing essential private investor backing entirely.
items.ex2_zh: 在彻底失去关键私人投资者的支持后，失败的企业投资项目很难起死回生。

items.def_zh: 使复活，使苏醒；给……以新生，鼓舞
items.def_en: 1. to bring someone or something back to life, consciousness, or physiological functioning 2. to give fresh vigor, enthusiasm, or activity to something
items.ex_en: Gentle spring rains seemed to reanimate the barren, winter-stricken valley.
items.ex_zh: 温和的春雨似乎让这片饱受冬日摧残的荒芜山谷重焕生机。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe restoring someone or something to life, consciousness, vigor, or functional vitality following death, unconsciousness, decay, or decline.
groups.summary_zh: 指使人从昏厥、垂死状态苏醒，或使衰败已久之物恢复生机与运作。
groups.desc_en: Restoring an inanimate, unconscious, or decaying entity to active life, consciousness, or operational force, contrasting with preservation (conserve/sustain).
groups.desc_zh: 使失去知觉、衰竭或已沉寂的客体重新恢复生命力、神志或运转能力，区别于维持现状（conserve/sustain）。
groups.nuance_en: revive: general term for restoring consciousness, vigor, or interest (patient / hopes / economy) · resuscitate: clinical or desperate revival from respiratory or financial arrest (drowning victim / institution) · resurrect: miraculous restoration of what was dead, extinct, or discarded (career / project / faith) · bring round: restoring an unconscious or swooning person to senses (fainting person / patient) · reanimate: re-instilling vital movement into dead or inert tissue (corpse / limbs / body)
groups.nuance_zh: revive: 适用最广，恢复意识、生机或使重现转机 (patient / hopes / economy) · resuscitate: 临床施救溺水/心脏骤停者或挽救濒危机构 (drowning victim / institution) · resurrect: 神迹般使死者复生或起死回生废弃的项目 (career / project / faith) · bring round: 使昏厥、眩晕者缓过神并苏醒 (fainting person / patient) · reanimate: 使失去活力的躯体或僵冷肉体重新动弹 (corpse / limbs / body)

groups.name: Revive & Resuscitate · 起死回生与急救苏醒 (Resuscitate, Revive, Reanimate)
groups.tip: 实施人工呼吸等急救挽回心跳

items.def_en: Restore someone who has lost consciousness back to an alert, waking state
items.ex_en: The nurse used smelling salts to bring round the unconscious patient.
items.ex_zh: 护士使用嗅盐使不省人事的病人苏醒了过来。

items.def_en: Apply an electric shock to the heart to stop fibrillation and restore regular cardiac rhythm
items.ex_en: The doctor had to defibrillate the patient to restore a normal heartbeat.
items.ex_zh: 医生不得不对病人进行电除颤以恢复正常的心跳节奏。

items.def_en: Bring someone back to consciousness, physical vigor, or life after fainting or illness
items.ex_en: Fresh air and sweet tea soon revived the dehydrated desert traveler.
items.ex_zh: 新鲜空气和甜茶很快让那位脱水的沙漠旅行者恢复了精力。
items.ex2_en: Dying garden plants revive quickly once regular watering schedules resume every morning.
items.ex2_zh: 一旦每天早晨恢复定期浇水，垂死的园艺植物就会迅速复苏。

items.def_zh: 使复苏，使苏醒；使恢复生机，复兴
items.def_en: 1. To make someone who has stopped breathing or is unconscious become conscious again. 2. To revive or revitalize something that is declining or dormant.
items.ex_en: The emergency crew managed to resuscitate the man after cardiac arrest.
items.ex_zh: 急救人员在男子心脏骤停后成功将其救醒。
items.ex2_en: Severely hypothermic patients seldom resuscitate without careful, gradual clinical warming techniques applied.
items.ex2_zh: 如果不采用细致、逐步的临床复温技术，严重失温的患者很难苏醒过来。

items.def_en: Restore to life or vitality something or someone that is inanimate or apparently dead
items.ex_en: Sunlight broke through the mist, reanimating the silent and frozen woods.
items.ex_zh: 阳光穿透薄雾，使寂静冰封的森林重新焕发出勃勃生机。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate restoring life, breath, or consciousness to a person who is moribund or unconscious, often extended metaphorically to dying ventures.
groups.summary_zh: 使濒死、昏厥或停止呼吸者恢复知觉与生命体征，亦指使绝处逢生。
groups.desc_en: Specifically executing acute emergency interventions to restore vital signs and biological consciousness, contrasting with long-term recovery (rehabilitate/heal).
groups.desc_zh: 特指通过紧急医疗或生理急救手段恢复基本生命体征与意识，区别于漫长的机能康复（rehabilitate/heal）。
groups.nuance_en: resuscitate: primary medical act of restoring breathing and pulse (drowning victim / patient) · defibrillate: using electric shock to restore regular cardiac rhythm (heart / patient) · bring round: nursing someone out of a temporary faint or coma (fainting victim / boxer) · revive: re-energizing collapsed vital strength and consciousness (exhausted runner / patient) · reanimate: restoring biological motor function to an apparently dead body (tissue / organism / corpse)
groups.nuance_zh: resuscitate: 最标准的急救医学动作，恢复自主呼吸与心跳 (drowning victim / patient) · defibrillate: 特指使用电击除颤纠正恶性心律失常 (heart / patient) · bring round: 促使昏迷或晕倒者恢复知觉神志 (fainting victim / boxer) · revive: 给虚脱或休克者补充生机使其还阳 (exhausted runner / patient) · reanimate: 使假死或心脏停搏后的机体组织重新激活 (tissue / organism / corpse)

groups.name: Revolt & Defy Authority · 反叛与抗争 (Rebel, Defy, Insurge)
groups.tip: 从不从反抗到集体兵变

items.def_en: (+ against) To actively resist and oppose the government, an authority, or social conventions
items.ex_en: Impoverished citizens resolved to rebel against the king's tyrannical new taxes.
items.ex_zh: 贫困的平民决意奋起反抗国王苛刻的新赋税。

items.def_en: To openly and courageously refuse to obey an order, law, or ruling authority
items.ex_en: The brave activist chose to openly defy the unjust local laws.
items.ex_zh: 这位勇敢的活动家选择公然违抗当地的不公法令。

items.def_en: (+ against) To unite and act aggressively to overthrow an oppressive government or master
items.ex_en: The citizens rose up against the corrupt military regime.
items.ex_zh: 市民们揭竿而起，反抗腐败的军事政权。

items.def_en: (+ against) To take violent action against the existing ruler or political leadership
items.ex_en: Oppressed peasants began to revolt against the ruthless regime across provinces.
items.ex_zh: 受压迫的农民开始在各省揭竿而起反抗残暴政权。

items.def_en: (+ against) To openly rebel against lawful authority, especially soldiers or sailors defying their officers.
items.ex_en: The starving crew threatened to mutiny against their cruel naval captain.
items.ex_zh: 饥肠辘辘的船员们威胁要对残酷的海军舰长发动哗变。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame depict refusing compliance and aggressively taking up arms or resistance against institutional hierarchy, commands, or sovereign masters. The lexical spectrum spans active armed insurrections to willful structural disobedience.
groups.summary_zh: 公然对抗建制权威、拒绝服从命令并采取叛乱行动。
groups.desc_en: Openly rejecting allegiance and taking up active defiance or armed resistance against lawful authority, contrasting with quiet non-compliance (dissent/disobey).
groups.desc_zh: 撕毁顺从服从契约，对既定权威或政权发起公开抗拒甚至武力反抗，区别于消极不合作（dissent/disobey）。
groups.nuance_en: revolt: mass uprising or visceral rebellion against oppressive authority (citizens / against taxes / against regime) · rebel: defying established conventions, rulers, or parental authority (youth / against tyranny) · mutiny: insubordination by military, naval, or crew personnel against officers (crew / soldiers / against captain) · rise up: collective mass movement taking up arms against oppression (people / against oppressor) · defy: directly and openly challenging a law, order, or power to stop you (court / authority / bans)
groups.nuance_zh: revolt: 针对压迫性体制的集体起义暴动或公然反叛 (citizens / against taxes / against regime) · rebel: 叛逆违抗传统、家长或统治者约束 (youth / against tyranny) · mutiny: 军队、舰船官兵对指挥官发起的哗变或抗命 (crew / soldiers / against captain) · rise up: 被压迫民众揭竿而起或武装抗暴 (people / against oppressor) · defy: 傲然不屈地公然蔑视并向法令或强权叫板 (court / authority / bans)

groups.name: Rewrite & Redraft · 重写与改写 (Revise, Rework, Redraft)
groups.tip: 重订书写以修正原稿

items.def_en: To reconsider and change text or plans to correct mistakes or add improvements
items.ex_en: The editor asked her to revise the final chapter before publication.
items.ex_zh: 编辑要求她在出版前校订最后一章。

items.def_en: To compose a new draft of an essay, document, or legal agreement
items.ex_en: The legal department had to redraft the contract to clarify terms.
items.ex_zh: 法务部不得不重新起草合同以阐明各项条款。

items.def_en: To produce a new or improved written version by writing directly over the original
items.ex_en: The scribe had to write over the faded lines with fresh ink.
items.ex_zh: 抄写员不得不蘸着新墨水把褪色的字迹重新写一遍。

items.def_en: To write something again in a different, updated, or improved form.
items.ex_en: The screenwriter agreed to rewrite the entire script for the studio.
items.ex_zh: 编剧同意为制片厂重写整部电影剧本。

items.def_en: To change, reorganize, or improve text, music, or a plan substantially
items.ex_en: The architect promised to rework the floor plan to increase light.
items.ex_zh: 建筑师承诺重新调整平面设计以增加采光。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses returning to existing written, coded, or scripted material to alter its structure, improve expression, or transform it into a significantly renewed iteration.
groups.summary_zh: 指对已有文章、代码或文稿进行全面修改、另行起草或重新撰写。
groups.desc_en: Producing a new version of an existing text or composition through structural overhaul and substantive modification, contrasting with mere copyediting (proofread/correct).
groups.desc_zh: 在原有文本或构想基础上进行实质性修改或结构重塑以形成新版，区别于细微的文字校对（proofread/correct）。
groups.nuance_en: rewrite: completely writing a text again from a different angle (script / history / article) · redraft: writing a refined formal draft incorporating feedback (bill / contract / essay) · revise: amending, updating, and polishing content based on critical review (manuscript / textbook / policy) · rework: altering, refining, and reshaping creative material extensively (melody / chapter / strategy) · write over: writing new content over top of existing text (canvas / notes)
groups.nuance_zh: rewrite: 完全推倒或从全新角度大幅重写 (script / history / article) · redraft: 根据审阅意见重新拟定法定草案或文稿 (bill / contract / essay) · revise: 查漏补缺式修订、润色已有的文稿或教材 (manuscript / textbook / policy) · rework: 对创意、章节或策略进行深入加工打磨与改造 (melody / chapter / strategy) · write over: 在原有文字表面涂抹或重叠覆写 (canvas / notes)

groups.name: Rig & Fraudulent Manipulation · 操纵舞弊与弄虚作假 (Rig, Fix, Tamper)
groups.tip: 暗中舞弊以掌控全局

items.def_zh: （通过欺诈或暗中手段）操纵，作弊；装配（船只、装置）
items.def_en: 1. To dishonestly arrange or manipulate the outcome of an election, contest, or process. 2. To provide or equip a ship, device, or structure with necessary gear or ropes.
items.ex_en: Critics claimed the ruling party conspired to rig the general election.
items.ex_zh: 批评人士声称执政党合谋操纵了大选。

items.def_zh: 虚报，做手脚窜改（数字、账目）
items.def_en: Manipulate or alter figures or facts dishonestly to make them fit a desired conclusion
items.ex_en: The accountant tried to fudge the quarterly figures to hide losses.
items.ex_zh: 会计试图在季度数据上做手脚以掩盖亏损。

items.def_en: Secretly arrange a deal or predetermine a decision unfairly behind closed doors
items.ex_en: The corrupt committee planned to stitch up the procurement deal privately.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的委员会计划暗中内定这笔采购交易。

items.def_zh: 暗中窜改，非法乱动（证据、投票系统等）
items.def_en: Interfere secretly or illicitly with a system, ballot, or evidence to cause harm or change outcomes
items.ex_en: It is a serious crime to tamper with official physical evidence.
items.ex_zh: 暗中篡改官方物证属于严重犯罪行为。

items.def_zh: 暗中内定，操纵（比赛、选举等）
items.def_en: Dishonestly organize or influence the result of an election, match, or trial ahead of time
items.ex_en: Gamblers paid the referee to fix the championship football match.
items.ex_zh: 赌徒们收买裁判以操纵那场足球冠军赛的结果。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail corrupt, clandestine, or underhanded tampering with contests, elections, or official mechanisms to predetermine an unfair outcome in violation of rules.
groups.summary_zh: 指暗中做手脚、串通舞弊以不正当控制比赛、选举或裁决结果。
groups.desc_en: Fraudulently tampering with or predetermining the outcome of a competitive system or process, contrasting with fair competition (compete/referee).
groups.desc_zh: 通过不正当手段在幕后操纵或篡改本应公平的规则与机制，区别于阳光下的正当竞争（compete/referee）。
groups.nuance_en: rig: prearranging the fraudulent outcome of a large-scale system (election / market / contest) · fix: corruptly securing a specific result via bribery or collusion (match / race / jury) · tamper with: illicitly interfering with physical evidence, devices, or data (evidence / brakes / meters) · fudge: dishonestly blurring or manipulating figures to pass scrutiny (figures / numbers / data) · stitch up: British slang for framing someone or colluding to unfairly shaft an opponent (rival / deal)
groups.nuance_zh: rig: 大规模系统性地舞弊操纵机制使其偏向一方 (election / market / contest) · fix: 通过贿赂或串通打假赛、内定胜负结果 (match / race / jury) · tamper with: 非法改动、做手脚破坏物理证据、设备或参数 (evidence / brakes / meters) · fudge: 弄虚作假、含糊粉饰账目或数据以蒙混过关 (figures / numbers / data) · stitch up: 英式俚语，指暗中串通构陷他人或做局做死对手 (rival / deal)

groups.name: Ring & Chime · 鸣响与回荡 (Ring, Chime, Toll)
groups.tip: 金属撞击般的清脆声响

items.def_en: to make a melodious, clear bell-like sound, especially signifying the hour
items.ex_en: The grandfather clock began to chime the hour in the hallway.
items.ex_zh: 门厅里的落地大摆钟开始鸣响报时。
items.ex2_en: The church bells chimed softly across the silent winter evening.
items.ex2_zh: 教堂的钟声在寂静的冬夜里柔和地鸣响。

items.def_zh: （使）鸣响，（使）发出清脆声响；响铃，按铃，敲钟；包围，环绕
items.def_en:
1. to make a clear, resonant sound, or to cause a bell or other object to do this
2. to surround or encircle
items.ex_en: A sharp whistle made the boy's ears ring for hours.
items.ex_zh: 一声刺耳的哨响让小男孩的耳朵嗡嗡响了好几个小时。

items.def_en: to echo loudly and fill an area with continuous clear sound
items.ex_en: Triumphant music resounded through the vaulted stone halls of the cathedral.
items.ex_zh: 凯旋的乐声在大教堂穹顶石厅间久久回荡。

items.def_en: to strike a large bell with slow, solemn, regular strokes, often for funerals
items.ex_en: The massive bronze bell began to toll for the fallen soldiers.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的铜钟开始为阵亡士兵鸣响沉郁的丧钟。
items.ex2_en: The grieving sexton tolled the funeral bell in memory of the fallen soldiers.
items.ex2_zh: 悲痛的守墓人鸣响丧钟，悼念阵亡的士兵。

items.def_en: to ring out in a loud, joyous, continuous burst of bells
items.ex_en: Church bells pealed across the valley to celebrate the royal wedding.
items.ex_zh: 教堂的钟声在山谷间欢腾齐鸣，庆祝这场王室婚礼。
items.ex2_en: The ringers pealed the cathedral bells across the valley to celebrate the wedding.
items.ex2_zh: 敲钟人让大教堂的钟声在山谷间回荡，庆祝这场婚礼。

groups.summary_en: This frame denotes clear, metallic, reverberating tones produced by percussion or acoustic resonance. Distinctions focus on pitch, interval, cadence, and solemnity.
groups.summary_zh: 金属器物敲击或钟表运作引发的清脆鸣奏、定点报时与悠长回响。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote emitting resonant metallic or bell-like sounds that sustain or reverberate through space, differing from generic 'sound/vibrate' by specifying acoustic resonance and harmonic decay.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词表示发出洪亮、持续或在空间中回荡的金石钟磬之音，与普通“发声/振动”相比，强调声学上的共振延展与和声衰减。
groups.nuance_en: ring: emit a clear, resonant acoustic vibration (bell / chime / phone) · chime: sound melodiously in harmonic agreement (clock / bells / carillon) · toll: sound slowly, deeply, and solemnly at regular intervals (knell / bell / funeral) · peal: ring out loudly, joyfully, and in rapid succession (bells / thunder / laughter) · resound: echo powerfully or fill an entire space with sound (voice / applause / hall)
groups.nuance_zh: ring: 发出清晰清脆的共鸣震响 (bell / chime / phone) · chime: 报时般发出悦耳和声 (clock / bells / carillon) · toll: 缓慢、沉重、按节律鸣响丧钟或大钟 (knell / bell / funeral) · peal: 欢快、连绵且响亮地齐鸣震响 (bells / thunder / laughter) · resound: 剧烈回响并充满整个空间 (voice / applause / hall)

groups.name: Ripen & Mellow · 成熟与醇化 (Flesh out, Mellow, Mature)
groups.tip: 植物或事物走向成熟

items.def_en: To treat, dry, or prepare wood, cast iron, or food by letting it cure naturally
items.ex_en: Carpenters must season the oak timber properly before building the furniture.
items.ex_zh: 木匠在制作家具之前必须将橡木充分风干处理。

items.def_en: To become milder, softer, or richer in flavor or temperament over time
items.ex_en: The harsh red wine will mellow into rich flavours over years.
items.ex_zh: 这瓶口感酸涩的红酒经过数年陈酿后风味会变得更加醇和。
items.ex2_en: Careful oak aging will mellow the harsh wine into a remarkably smooth drink.
items.ex2_zh: 用橡木桶悉心陈酿会使生涩的葡萄酒变得极为醇厚顺口。

items.def_en: To develop into a complete, balanced, and mature form
items.ex_en: She took extra courses in finance to round out her business degree.
items.ex_zh: 她选修了额外的金融课程，使自己的商科学位更加完备。

items.def_en: To reach full natural growth, development, or readiness
items.ex_en: These saplings will mature into tall shade trees within a decade.
items.ex_zh: 这些幼苗将在十年之内发育为参天的大树。
items.ex2_en: The warm summer sunshine will mature the green fruit within a few short weeks.
items.ex2_zh: 温暖的夏日阳光将在短短几周内使青涩的果实成熟。

items.def_en: To become fully grown and ready to eat or harvest, or to cause crops or fruit to do so.
items.ex_en: Warm summer sunshine will help the green tomatoes ripen on vines.
items.ex_zh: 夏日的温暖阳光将有助于藤上的青番茄熟透。
items.ex2_en: The orchard workers use natural gas heaters to ripen the harvested fruit.
items.ex2_zh: 果园工人使用天然气加热器来催熟采摘下来的水果。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe natural progression toward full development, flavor enhancement, or readiness for harvesting and utilization.
groups.summary_zh: 指农作物或事物逐渐长成、成熟醇化达到顶峰状态的动词群。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote progressive maturation that softens harshness, enhances richness, and develops depth over time, unlike simple 'grow/age' which lacks the nuance of refined balance.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词表示经由时间沉淀褪去青涩生硬、增添圆润醇厚与深度的演进过程，与普通“生长/老化”相比，强调质感达到均衡醇美。
groups.nuance_en: ripen: reach biological full flavor or readiness (fruit / cheese / conditions) · mature: develop full faculties, complexity, or fiscal validity (wine / mind / bond) · mellow: lose raw harshness and soften into gentle warmth (flavor / voice / temperament) · season: condition and temper through exposure or time (timber / wood / cast iron) · round out: balance and complete rough edges into wholeness (profile / character / portfolio)
groups.nuance_zh: ripen: 达到生物学上的成熟或时机成熟 (fruit / cheese / conditions) · mature: 发展出完备的能力、复杂风味或期满生效 (wine / mind / bond) · mellow: 褪去生涩生硬而变得圆润柔和 (flavor / voice / temperament) · season: 经受时间与环境的风干熟成或历练 (timber / wood / cast iron) · round out: 使各方面趋于平衡圆融 (profile / character / portfolio)

groups.name: Rise & Ascend · 浮出与重现 (Surface, Emerge, Re-emerge)
groups.tip: 物体由低处向高处运动

items.def_en: To rise up to the top of a liquid, or become visible after being hidden
items.ex_en: The submarine was ordered to surface near the distant naval base.
items.ex_zh: 潜艇接到指令在遥远的海军基地附近浮出水面。

items.def_en: (+ from) To come out into view from an obscured, concealed, or submerged place
items.ex_en: A solitary figure began to emerge from the dense evening fog.
items.ex_zh: 一个孤独的身影开始从浓重的暮雾中浮现出来。

items.def_en: To rise quickly or buoyantly to the surface of water
items.ex_en: The cork bobbed up to the surface as soon as it was released.
items.ex_zh: 软木塞一松手就立刻浮上了水面。

items.def_en: To ascend to a higher level, surface, or stage of visibility
items.ex_en: The scuba diver will come up slowly to avoid dangerous decompression.
items.ex_zh: 潜水员将慢慢浮出水面，以避免危险的减压病。

items.def_zh: 重新浮出水面，再次升起；重新露面，再次显现；重铺（路面等）
items.def_en: 1. To rise back up to the surface of water. 2. To reappear or become noticeable again after being hidden or absent. 3. To put a new surface on a road, floor, or other structure.
items.ex_en: Old unresolved grievances can resurface during stressful family gatherings.
items.ex_zh: 长期未决的旧怨可能会在令人紧张的家庭聚会中再次浮现。
items.ex2_en: The road maintenance crew resurfaced the damaged highway with fresh black asphalt.
items.ex2_zh: 道路养护队用新鲜的沥青为受损的高速公路重新铺了路面。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the motion of breaking through a liquid boundary or hidden background to become physically visible or publicly noticeable once again.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体或现象由隐匿、水下或沉寂状态重新浮出、显露或升至表层。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote breaking through an enclosing medium or moving from concealment into conscious perception, contrasting with simple 'ascend' by highlighting revelation from an obscured state.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词表示穿破包围性介质或从隐匿状态进入显现视野，与单纯的“上升/升起”相比，核心在于从不可见转为可见的豁然呈现。
groups.nuance_en: surface: break through the water line or become consciously apparent (diver / submarine / scandal) · emerge: come out from cover, obscurity, or confinement into distinct view (butterfly / trend / figure) · resurface: appear again after prolonged dormancy or submersion (issue / symptom / swimmer) · bob up: pop up quickly or buoyantly to the surface (cork / head / ball) · come up: rise into direct conversational attention or physical presence (topic / question / sun)
groups.nuance_zh: surface: 破水而出或潜伏隐秘事物浮出水面 (diver / submarine / scandal) · emerge: 摆脱遮蔽、幽暗或困顿脱颖显现 (butterfly / trend / figure) · resurface: 沉寂或潜伏良久后再度浮现 (issue / symptom / swimmer) · bob up: 借助浮力迅速忽地冒出水面 (cork / head / ball) · come up: 被提出讨论或升至眼前 (topic / question / sun)

groups.name: Roar & Bellow · 咆哮与怒吼 (Bellow, Snarl, Roar)
groups.tip: 怒气冲冲地发出低沉吼叫

items.def_en: To utter an order, retort, or command in a harsh, curt, snapping tone
items.ex_en: The drill sergeant began to bark out orders to the recruits.
items.ex_zh: 训练军士开始厉声向新兵吼出指令。

items.def_zh: （动物）低吼，咆哮；怒气冲冲地嘟囔；（肚子）咕咕叫
items.def_en: 1. (+ at) To make a low, deep, threatening sound in the throat, or say something angrily in this way. 2. (of a stomach) To make a rumbling sound.
items.ex_en: The guard dog started to growl menacingly at the midnight intruder.
items.ex_zh: 警犬开始对着午夜的闯入者发出威胁性的低吼。

items.def_en: To make a prolonged, deep, loud sound, or to shout out statements with uncontrolled anger
items.ex_en: The crowd heard the angry lion roar across the dry savannah.
items.ex_zh: 人们听见愤怒的雄狮在干燥的热带草原上咆哮。

items.def_en: To shout or roar in a loud, deep, resonant voice, typically out of rage or acute pain
items.ex_en: The injured giant bellowed in pain, startling the entire quiet camp.
items.ex_zh: 受伤的巨人痛极怒吼，惊醒了整个原本安静的营地。

items.def_en: To show the teeth and make an angry, vicious, deep sound, or to say words in a vicious, snapping manner
items.ex_en: The villain began to snarl bitter threats at the captured hero.
items.ex_zh: 恶棍龇牙咧嘴地对被俘的英雄厉声吼出恶毒的威胁。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe aggressive, low-pitched, or animalistic vocalizations made to express fury, intimidate rivals, or convey hostility. Contrast low resonant throat rumbles with explosive loud cries.
groups.summary_zh: 发出低沉、凶猛或震耳的声响以宣泄愤怒或进行威吓。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote projecting animalistic, guttural, or intensely aggressive vocalizations, contrasting with plain 'shout/call' by their primal, reverberating acoustic force and threat cues.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词表示发出野兽般粗粝、低沉或狂暴的喉音威吓，与普通的“喊叫/呼唤”相比，带有原始的声波压迫感与攻击性震慑。
groups.nuance_en: roar: emit a deep, prolonged, resonant boom of fury or power (lion / crowd / engine) · bellow: roar deeply with wide-open mouth in raw pain or booming rage (bull / sergeant / giant) · snarl: growl viciously while baring teeth in sharp hostility (wolf / dog / thug) · growl: utter a low, rumbling, menacing guttural vibration (bear / animal / stomach) · bark out: snap out harsh, clipped commands loudly (orders / command / officer)
groups.nuance_zh: roar: 发出深沉、持续且极具威力的巨响咆哮 (lion / crowd / engine) · bellow: 张大嘴巴发出公牛般的粗声吼叫 (bull / sergeant / giant) · snarl: 龇牙咧嘴发出凶狠凶暴的低吼 (wolf / dog / thug) · growl: 喉咙发出低沉咕噜的警告威胁音 (bear / animal / stomach) · bark out: 短促、严厉、如犬吠般厉声喝出 (orders / command / officer)

groups.name: Roast & High-Heat Processing · 煅烧与热解 (Calcine, Roast, Pyrolyze)
groups.tip: 高温焙烧引发生化质变

items.def_en: To decompose organic or inorganic matter thermally at high temperatures without oxygen
items.ex_en: Engineers pyrolyze plastic waste to produce synthetic fuel without harmful emissions.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们在无氧条件下热解塑料废料，生产无有害排放的合成燃料。
items.ex2_en: The dense organic material pyrolyzed rapidly inside the sealed, oxygen-free reaction chamber.
items.ex2_zh: 致密的有机材料在密闭无氧的反应室中迅速发生热解。

items.def_en: To heat metalliferous ore strongly in the presence of air to oxidize or desulfurize it
items.ex_en: Smelters roast the raw zinc ore before extracting the pure metal.
items.ex_zh: 冶炼工在提取纯金属之前先对锌原矿进行焙烧。
items.ex2_en: The crushed zinc ore roasts slowly under intense heat inside the industrial furnace.
items.ex2_zh: 粉碎的锌矿石在工业熔炉的高温下缓缓进行焙烧。

items.def_en: To burn or blacken something on its surface through exposure to intense dry heat
items.ex_en: Intense flames threatened to char the outer wooden walls of homes.
items.ex_zh: 烈火眼看就要将房屋外层的木墙烧焦炭化。
items.ex2_en: The dry bread slices charred quickly over the glowing charcoal embers.
items.ex2_zh: 干燥的面包片在炽热的炭火上很快就烤焦了。

items.def_en: To coalesce powdered material into a coherent solid mass by heating without liquifying
items.ex_en: Technicians sinter the metallic powders under high pressure to form gears.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员在高压下将金属粉末烧结成坚固的齿轮。
items.ex2_en: The fine ceramic powders sintered into a durable mass under the intense furnace heat.
items.ex2_zh: 精细的陶瓷粉末在熔炉的高温下烧结成了坚固的块体。

items.def_en: 1. (chemistry / metallurgy) To heat a mineral or substance to a high temperature without melting in order to oxidize it or drive off volatile matter.
items.ex_en: The chemist planned to calcine limestone into quicklime at extreme temperatures.
items.ex_zh: 化学家计划在极高温度下煅烧石灰石以制得生石灰。
items.ex2_en: The pure white limestone calcined steadily inside the high-temperature industrial kiln.
items.ex2_zh: 纯白的石灰石在高温工业窑炉中持续煅烧。

groups.summary_en: Pertaining to pyrometallurgy, geology, and material sciences, this frame encompasses heating solids and ores to high temperatures below melting point to induce oxidation, volatilization, or thermal decomposition.
groups.summary_zh: 在冶金或化工中高温焙烧矿石或固相物料，促使其氧化或热解。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote altering the chemical composition, density, or state of a substance using intense thermal energy, contrasting with culinary 'cook/bake' by targeting material transformation.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词表示利用强热能改变物质的化学组成、致密度或微观结构，与日常烹饪的“煮/烤”相比，专指工业与物理化学层面的物料相变加工。
groups.nuance_en: calcine: heat strongly to drive off volatile matter and oxidize without melting (ore / limestone / gypsum) · roast: heat metallurgically in air to volatilize impurities or oxidize (ore / coffee / sulfides) · pyrolyze: decompose organic materials thermally in the absence of oxygen (plastic / biomass / polymer) · sinter: coalesce powdered material into a solid mass via heat without liquefaction (powder / ceramic / metal) · char: burn partially to reduce the surface to carbonized blackness (wood / bone / surface)
groups.nuance_zh: calcine: 高温煅烧以驱逐挥发物并氧化粉化 (ore / limestone / gypsum) · roast: 在空气流中高温焙烧以脱硫或氧化 (ore / coffee / sulfides) · pyrolyze: 在隔绝氧气条件下通过高温裂解有机物 (plastic / biomass / polymer) · sinter: 借助高温使粉末未完全熔融即可烧结粘合成块 (powder / ceramic / metal) · char: 不完全燃烧使物料表面脱水炭化变黑 (wood / bone / surface)

groups.name: Rock & Cradle · 摇撼与前后摇晃 (Cradle, Lurch, Jolt, Pitch)
groups.tip: 左右前后往复摆动

items.def_en: To hold gently and securely in one's arms, typically rocking softly
items.ex_en: The mother gently cradled her sleeping baby against her warm chest.
items.ex_zh: 母亲温柔地搂抱着熟睡的婴儿，紧贴着自己温暖的胸口。

items.def_en: 1. To move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side, or cause something to do this. 2. To shock or distress someone greatly.
items.ex_en: Strong ocean waves began to rock the tiny wooden fishing boat.
items.ex_zh: 汹涌的海浪开始剧烈摇晃那艘小木渔船。
items.ex2_en: The wooden cradle rocked gently as the mother sang a soothing bedtime lullaby.
items.ex2_zh: 当母亲唱起舒缓的摇篮曲时，木制摇篮轻轻摇晃着。

items.def_en: To dip and rise rhythmically bow-to-stern or front-to-back in rough water or air
items.ex_en: The vessel started to pitch violently in the howling gale winds.
items.ex_zh: 船只在呼啸的狂风中开始剧烈地纵向颠簸。

items.def_en: To shake or dislodge violently with a sharp, sudden blow or jerk
items.ex_en: The sudden pothole gave the old carriage a sharp, jarring jolt.
items.ex_zh: 路上的坑洼猛烈震击了老旧的马车，令人十分颠簸。
items.ex2_en: The old carriage jolted violently as it struck an unexpected deep pothole.
items.ex2_zh: 老旧马车在撞上一个意外的深坑时剧烈颠簸起来。

items.def_zh: 突然颠簸前倾，猛烈晃动
items.def_en: To make an abrupt, uncontrolled, and jarring sway or forward heave
items.ex_en: The speeding train made a sudden lurch on the sharp curve.
items.ex_zh: 疾驰的火车在急弯处突然剧烈猛晃了一下。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate heavy, rhythmic front-to-back or side-to-side tilting—ranging from soothing rocking motions used to calm an infant to violent vessel pitching on turbulent seas.
groups.summary_zh: 指前后左右的有节奏摇动，既可指温和安抚摇晃，亦可指船车剧烈颠簸摇撼。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote rhythmic swaying, pitching, or sudden jarring physical oscillation, distinguishing from stable 'balance' through dynamic shifts in center of gravity.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词表示物体发生节律性晃荡、前后俯仰或突发性的剧烈震晃，与平稳的“平衡/静止”相对，突出重心在动荡中的位移摆动。
groups.nuance_en: cradle: hold gently while imparting a protective, rhythmic rocking motion (infant / baby / head) · rock: sway back and forth or side to side rhythmically or perturb violently (cradle / boat / earthquake) · pitch: plunge or oscillate nose-to-tail along an axis (ship / vessel / aircraft) · lurch: abruptly roll, lean, or stagger unpredictably forward or sideways (vehicle / drunkard / train) · jolt: jar violently with a sudden, sharp, rough blow (carriage / passenger / memory)
groups.nuance_zh: cradle: 抱在怀中轻轻摇抚以提供安全感 (infant / baby / head) · rock: 规则地前后/左右摇摆，或剧烈震荡 (cradle / boat / earthquake) · pitch: 船舶或飞机沿横轴前后颠簸俯仰 (ship / vessel / aircraft) · lurch: 突如其来地向一侧踉跄、倾斜或颠簸猛冲 (vehicle / drunkard / train) · jolt: 突发剧烈的颠簸震击使其剧烈震动 (carriage / passenger / memory)

groups.name: Roil & Turmoil · 搅混水体与掀起动荡 (Roil, Churn, Turbidate)
groups.tip: 剧烈搅动使液体浑浊翻滚

items.def_en: Make a liquid dark or opaque with mud, or confuse an issue so it becomes hard to understand
items.ex_en: Heavy weekend rains began to muddy the clear mountain trout streams.
items.ex_zh: 周末的暴雨使原本清澈的高山鳟鱼溪流变得浑浊不堪。

items.def_en: Cause sediment at the bottom of liquid to swirl up, or deliberately incite conflict or emotion
items.ex_en: Fast motorboats can stir up silt from the shallow lake bed.
items.ex_zh: 高速快艇容易把浅湖底部的淤泥给搅动泛起。

items.def_en: Shake or stir a fluid vigorously, or make people troubled, anxious, or rebellious
items.ex_en: Political agitators arrived to agitate the workers into holding a strike.
items.ex_zh: 政治煽动者前来鼓动工人们举行罢工。

items.def_zh: 搅乱，扰乱；搅浑，使（液体）翻滚浑浊
items.def_en: 1. To make a liquid cloudy or muddy by stirring up sediment. 2. To agitate, disturb, or throw someone or something into disorder.
items.ex_en: Sudden scandalous revelations roiled the nation's political landscape for weeks.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的丑闻揭露数周来彻底扰乱了全国的政局。
items.ex2_en: The dark river waters roiled fiercely after the heavy summer torrential downpour.
items.ex2_zh: 夏季的大暴雨过后，漆黑的河水剧烈翻滚混浊。

items.def_zh: 剧烈翻腾；搅动（水流或内心情感）
items.def_en: Move or agitate a liquid or sea violently, or experience deep inner turbulence or nausea
items.ex_en: Violent winds churn the dark ocean waters during severe winter storms.
items.ex_zh: 凛冽狂风在寒冬的风暴中使漆黑的海水剧烈翻腾。
items.ex2_en: The dark ocean waters churn violently whenever severe winter storms strike the coast.
items.ex2_zh: 每当严冬的风暴袭击海岸时，漆黑的海水就会剧烈翻腾。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures disturbing a settled fluid by stirring up sediment, making it opaque and swirling, and readily extends metaphorically to throwing markets, emotions, or social systems into violent agitation.
groups.summary_zh: 搅起沉淀使水体浑浊，比喻使局势、情绪或市场陷入混乱动荡。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote stirring up resting sediment or creating chaotic vortexes that muddy a medium, distinguishing from simple 'mix/stir' through the generation of turbidity and unrest.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词表示扰动静止沉积物或卷起漩涡使介质浑浊混乱，与普通的“搅拌/混合”相比，强调破坏澄澈感并激起混乱动荡。
groups.nuance_en: roil: make muddy or disturb violently into chaotic agitation (waters / market / debate) · churn: agitate liquid furiously into froth or foam (seas / stomach / butter) · muddy: cloud clarity by stirring up sediment or obscuring truth (waters / issue / waters) · stir up: deliberately provoke dormant trouble or particle suspension (sediment / trouble / crowd) · agitate: shake, perturb, or violently disturb physical fluids or peace of mind (liquid / mind / populace)
groups.nuance_zh: roil: 掀起泥沙搅浑水体，或使局势急剧动荡 (waters / market / debate) · churn: 剧烈翻腾卷起白浪或使腹中翻江倒海 (seas / stomach / butter) · muddy: 搅起淤泥使水变浑，或故意搅乱混淆视听 (waters / issue / waters) · stir up: 蓄意激起沉底杂物或挑起事端 (sediment / trouble / crowd) · agitate: 剧烈晃动破坏流体平稳或煽动扰乱心神 (liquid / mind / populace)

groups.name: Roof & Ground Surface Layering · 铺设草皮与木瓦 (Sod, Shingle, Slate)
groups.tip: 铺设瓦片或草皮覆盖表面

items.def_en: to cover a roof or surface with ceramic or composite tiles
items.ex_en: Local roofers came to tile the damaged cottage roof before winter.
items.ex_zh: 当地修顶工赶在入冬前为受损的小屋屋顶重新铺瓦。

items.def_en: to cover a roof with slate tiles
items.ex_en: The historic church committee raised funds to slate the leaky roof.
items.ex_zh: 这座历史悠久的教堂委员会筹集资金用石板瓦重铺漏水的屋顶。

items.def_en: to lay pieces of turf over an area of bare soil or lawn
items.ex_en: We hired landscape contractors to turf the patchy front garden lawn.
items.ex_zh: 我们雇佣了绿化承包商为门前斑驳的草坪重新铺上草皮。

items.def_zh: 用木瓦（或沥青瓦等）铺盖（屋顶或外墙）
items.def_en: (construction) To cover a roof or outer wall with overlapping wooden or asphalt shingles.
items.ex_en: Workers labored in the sun to shingle the rustic country cabin.
items.ex_zh: 工人们顶着烈日劳作，给这座乡间木屋铺设木瓦屋顶。

items.def_en: (chiefly North American) To cover bare ground with strips of grass and soil (sod).
items.ex_en: The city decided to sod the bare muddy park after construction.
items.ex_zh: 施工结束后，市政府决定在泥泞裸露的公园地面上铺上草皮。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this specialized exterior construction and landscape framing denote applying overlapping or interlocked protective outdoor surfacing materials—such as turf sods or roofing shingles—to ground or roof frameworks.
groups.summary_zh: 指在户外地面或屋面铺设草皮块、瓦片等专用表面防护层。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote cladding architectural roofs or ground grounds with modular overlapping protective layers, distinguishing from generic 'cover/pave' by unitized structural layering.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词表示利用模块化、重叠式的保护单元来铺覆屋顶或地面，与宽泛的“覆盖/铺路”相比，强调呈鱼鳞状或块状层层拼接的工法。
groups.nuance_en: shingle: cover roofs or walls with thin, tapered overlapping wood or composite slabs (roof / house / wall) · slate: cover a pitched roof with overlapping stone slate tiles (cottage / roof / church) · tile: lay fired ceramic or stone slabs across a surface (floor / roof / bathroom) · sod: lay down pre-grown patches of grass and roots onto bare soil (lawn / bank / yard) · turf: furnish ground with dense grass surface layers (field / lawn / area)
groups.nuance_zh: shingle: 用搭接的木瓦或沥青瓦铺盖屋顶外墙 (roof / house / wall) · slate: 用天然板岩瓦片错叠铺覆斜屋顶 (cottage / roof / church) · tile: 用烧制瓷砖或石砖整齐密拼铺设 (floor / roof / bathroom) · sod: 铺设带根系草皮卷快速绿化土壤 (lawn / bank / yard) · turf: 覆以成片的草皮或人工草坪 (field / lawn / area)

groups.name: Roster Demotion & Exclusion · 撤换上场与禁赛 (Bench, Sideline, Suspend)
groups.tip: 撤下替补席或处以停赛

items.def_zh: 撤下（场上队员），罚…坐替补席；使停赛
items.def_en: To withdraw a sports player from active play and keep them on the bench.
items.ex_en: The head coach decided to bench the slumping forward for tonight.
items.ex_zh: 主教练决定让状态低迷的前锋在今晚的比赛中坐替补席。

items.def_zh: 暂停参赛资格，停赛，停职
items.def_en: Officially bar someone from playing, working, or attending for a fixed period as a penalty
items.ex_en: The disciplinary league voted to suspend the aggressive player for three matches.
items.ex_zh: 纪律委员会经投票决定对这名具攻击性的球员停赛三场。

items.def_zh: 退出比赛，将…从参赛名单剔除
items.def_en: Withdraw a competitor or horse from an official event before it begins
items.ex_en: Officials had to scratch the favorite horse after it sustained an unexpected leg injury.
items.ex_zh: 夺冠热门赛马意外伤到腿部后，赛事官员不得不将其退赛。
items.ex2_en: The champion stallion scratched from the derby due to an unexpected leg injury.
items.ex2_zh: 冠军种马因腿部意外受伤而退出了德比赛马。

items.def_en: Take an active player off the field and replace them with a substitute
items.ex_en: The gaffer decided to sub off our exhausted winger before the final whistle blew.
items.ex_zh: 终场哨吹响前，教练决定把我们筋疲力尽的边锋换下场。

items.def_zh: 靠边站，使无法参赛/参与
items.def_en: Remove someone from participating actively, especially due to injury, tactical choice, or politics
items.ex_en: A severe knee sprain will sideline the star forward for at least six weeks.
items.ex_zh: 严重的膝盖扭伤将使这位明星前锋至少缺赛六周。

groups.summary_en: Relates to sports management and institutional contexts where an active participant or player is removed from play, sidelined, or disqualified temporarily from duties.
groups.summary_zh: 用于体育或机构场景，指将现役队员按在替补席、撤下首发或勒令停赛停职。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote officially removing a participant from active lineup or field play into inactive status, distinguishing from generic 'exclude' via formal roster management contexts.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词表示通过规则、战术决策或伤病将选手撤出比赛名单或置于闲置状态，与抽象的“排除”相比，特指阵容名单上的战术降级或隔离。
groups.nuance_en: bench: demote a player to the reserve bench for tactical reasons or poor form (quarterback / player / star) · sideline: force out of active competition due to injury or political maneuvering (striker / minister / candidate) · suspend: bar officially from participation for a designated disciplinary period (player / license / driver) · scratch: withdraw a competitor from an entry list just before a contest (horse / runner / competitor) · sub off: substitute a player out of ongoing live play (midfielder / captain / defender)
groups.nuance_zh: bench: 因状态不佳或战术安排将主力换下并按在替补席 (quarterback / player / star) · sideline: 因伤病或边缘化政治手腕迫使其靠边站 (striker / minister / candidate) · suspend: 因违规违纪官方裁定阶段性停赛停职 (player / license / driver) · scratch: 在比赛鸣枪前一刻将选手从参赛名单划除 (horse / runner / competitor) · sub off: 在常规比赛进行中换人将其替换下场 (midfielder / captain / defender)

groups.name: Rotary Abrade & Mill · 旋转钻切与研磨 (Mill, Grind, Countersink)
groups.tip: 机械旋转钻孔或打磨去刺

items.def_en: To enlarge the top rim of a drilled hole so a screw or bolt head can lie flush
items.ex_en: With solemn precision, the artisan countersank the aperture to bed the brass screw flush.
items.ex_zh: 工匠庄重精准地将孔眼扩成埋头孔，以便黄铜螺钉完全嵌平。

items.def_en: To make a deep, round hollow in a hard substance using a revolving tool
items.ex_en: The specialized machine can bore deep, perfectly circular holes through solid granite blocks effortlessly.
items.ex_zh: 这台专用机器能毫不费力地在坚硬的花岗岩石块上钻出深邃圆润的孔洞。

items.def_en: To shape or cut metal or stone using a high-speed rotating cutting tool
items.ex_en: Machinists will mill the dense titanium block into precise components for aircraft turbines.
items.ex_zh: 机械师将把这块高密度钛块铣削成精密飞机涡轮零件。

items.def_zh: 用钻头钻；用牙钻去腐；打磨去刺
items.def_en: 1. (dentistry / engineering) To drill, cut, or smooth metal, bone, or a tooth using a rotary bur tool.
items.ex_en: The surgeon deftly burred the rough bone margin before grafting the fragile tissue.
items.ex_zh: 在移植脆弱的组织之前，外科医生熟练地用骨钻打磨光滑粗糙的骨缘。

items.def_en: To make something smooth, sharp, or contoured by rubbing it against an abrasive stone or wheel
items.ex_en: He used a wet sharpening wheel to grind the dull edge of the chisel.
items.ex_zh: 他用湿式砂轮将凿子发钝的刃口磨得锋利。

groups.summary_en: A specialized tooling and machining frame describing the cutting, drilling, smoothing, or excavating of dense media (tooth enamel, bone, steel, wood) using fast-spinning abrasive heads or fluted rotary cutters.
groups.summary_zh: 指利用旋转刀头、磨具或金刚砂对坚硬材质进行钻孔磨光。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote shaping, piercing, or smoothing rigid materials via high-speed rotary cutting tools, contrasting with linear 'cut/saw' by utilizing rotational abrasion and torque.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词表示借助高速旋转切削工具对硬质材料进行钻孔、铣槽或磨削成形，与普通的直线型“切/锯”相比，依托回转切削与扭矩排屑。
groups.nuance_en: mill: machine metal or stone using rotating multi-point cutters into complex contours (metal / part / slot) · grind: wear down, shape, or sharpen a workpiece using an abrasive wheel (lens / tool / grain) · bore: enlarge or tunnel a cylindrical hole using a rotating bit (cylinder / hole / tunnel) · countersink: enlarge the mouth of a hole cone-shaped to seat a screw flush (hole / screw / plate) · bur: carve, deburr, or flute intricate details with a tiny rotary rotary bit (bone / tooth / edge)
groups.nuance_zh: mill: 利用高速旋转铣刀将工件切削出平面或凹槽 (metal / part / slot) · grind: 利用砂轮等磨具高速摩擦修磨刃口或光整表面 (lens / tool / grain) · bore: 使用旋转钻具镗大内孔或钻凿出深孔 (cylinder / hole / tunnel) · countersink: 在孔口切削出倒角沉孔以便埋平螺钉头 (hole / screw / plate) · bur: 使用精密旋转牙医钻/毛边钻打磨细部或去除毛刺 (bone / tooth / edge)

groups.name: Rotate & Pivot · 转动与枢转 (Swivel, Rotate, Revolve)
groups.tip: 以支点为核心转向旋转

items.def_en: To turn or cause to turn continuously around an internal axis or central line
items.ex_en: The giant celestial body continues to rotate steadily on its designated internal polar axis.
items.ex_zh: 这颗巨大的天体继续绕着其固有的极轴平稳自转。
items.ex2_en: The vigilant technician rotated the heavy radar dish to track the incoming storm.
items.ex2_zh: 警惕的技术人员转动重型雷达天线以追踪逼近的风暴。

items.def_en: To move in a curved or circular path centered around an external point
items.ex_en: Multiple artificial satellites quietly revolve around the distant planet along precise elliptical orbital paths.
items.ex_zh: 多颗人造卫星正沿着精确的椭圆轨道静静地环绕那颗遥远行星公转。
items.ex2_en: The clever engineer revolved the central cylinder to activate the ancient mechanical locking system.
items.ex2_zh: 聪明的工程师转动中心圆筒以启动古老的机械锁闭系统。

items.def_zh: 在枢轴上转动；以……为支点旋转；改变方向，调整策略
items.def_en: 1. (+ on/around) To turn or rotate on or as if on a central point or pivot. 2. (+ to) To change direction or adjust a strategy, business focus, or opinion.
items.ex_en: Facing sudden revenue drops, the tech firm must pivot quickly to artificial intelligence services.
items.ex_zh: 面对营收暴跌，这家科技公司必须迅速转向人工智能服务。
items.ex2_en: The captain pivoted the ship quickly to avoid colliding with the hidden reef.
items.ex2_zh: 船长迅速转动船身，以避免撞上隐蔽的暗礁。

items.def_en: To turn around quickly on a fixed socket, pin, or central point
items.ex_en: The detective swiveled abruptly in his chair to inspect the unexpected witness behind him.
items.ex_zh: 侦探在转椅上猛然旋过身，打量着身后不期而至的目击者。
items.ex2_en: The watchful security guard swiveled the camera to inspect the dimly lit corridor.
items.ex2_zh: 警惕的保安转动摄像头以检查昏暗的走廊。

items.def_en: To spin around abruptly and face the opposite direction in a sweeping arc
items.ex_en: Hearing footsteps close behind, she wheeled around to confront whoever was following her silently.
items.ex_zh: 听到身后紧挨的脚步声，她猛地转身迎向那个默默尾随她的人。
items.ex2_en: The mounted guard wheeled his horse around to confront the suspicious approaching stranger.
items.ex2_zh: 骑警调转马头，去盘查那个形迹可疑、正在靠近的陌生人。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers turning around a fixed axis or fulcrum. While 'pivot' stresses an immediate shift in focus or direction anchored by a pin, related verbs denote circular rotational mechanics or swiveling swings.
groups.summary_zh: 指围绕定点、轴心或支点进行的旋转、转动与急变方向。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote angular movement around an internal or external axis, distinguishing from directional 'move/turn' by precise kinematics of fixed-point rotational geometry.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词表示围绕内部或外部固定轴线进行角位移回转，与宽泛的“移动/转向”相比，聚焦于定轴旋转的运动学几何特征。
groups.nuance_en: rotate: turn continuously around an internal central axis (wheel / Earth / tires) · revolve: orbit around an external central point in an elliptical or circular path (planet / moon / cylinder) · pivot: turn sharply or balance on a single static pin or fulcrum (dancer / foot / strategy) · swivel: swing freely horizontally on a fixed base mounting (chair / camera / head) · wheel around: spin bodily or vehicles around abruptly to face backwards (car / horse / troop)
groups.nuance_zh: rotate: 围绕自身内部中心轴做自转周转 (wheel / Earth / tires) · revolve: 绕外部另一中心点做轨道公转运动 (planet / moon / cylinder) · pivot: 以某一固定支点或支撑足为轴心发生偏转 (dancer / foot / strategy) · swivel: 在基座上沿水平方向平滑自如地转动 (chair / camera / head) · wheel around: 身体或车马队伍猛然掉头转身 (car / horse / troop)

groups.name: Roughen & Texturize · 使变粗糙与磨损表面 (Roughen, Coarsen, Scuff)
groups.tip: 使质地或物理特征发生变化

items.def_en: Make or become harsh, thick, or coarse in texture or tone
items.ex_en: Decades of harsh sea winds and bitter salt water had coarsened his weathered skin.
items.ex_zh: 数十年的刺骨海风和苦涩海水，让他饱经风霜的皮肤变得粗糙不堪。
items.ex2_en: His weathered skin coarsened steadily after decades of working outdoors in harsh winds.
items.ex2_zh: 在恶劣的风中进行了数十年户外工作后，他饱经风霜的皮肤逐渐变粗糙了。

items.def_en: Make sore, warm, or worn by continual rubbing against an abrasive surface
items.ex_en: The stiff collar began to chafe his sweaty neck during the sweltering parade.
items.ex_zh: 在闷热的游行中，僵硬的衣领开始擦红他汗流浃背的脖颈。
items.ex2_en: His sensitive skin chafed uncomfortably against the rough wool collar all afternoon.
items.ex2_zh: 整个下午，他敏感的皮肤在粗糙的羊毛衣领摩擦下感到很不舒服。

items.def_en: Scrape or wear away the outer texture of a surface by sustained mechanical friction
items.ex_en: Windborne sand particles will gradually abrade the protective coating of the exposed industrial structures.
items.ex_zh: 风携沙粒会逐渐磨蚀外露工业建筑表面的保护层。

items.def_en: Mark or scrape the smooth surface of something by abrasive scraping or dragging
items.ex_en: Be careful not to scuff your polished leather shoes on the rough concrete steps.
items.ex_zh: 小心别在粗糙的水泥台阶上蹭坏了你擦亮的皮鞋。
items.ex2_en: Delicate leather shoes scuff easily when you walk across rough concrete steps.
items.ex2_zh: 当你走过粗糙的水泥台阶时，娇嫩的皮鞋很容易磨损起痕。

items.def_en: To make something rough or uneven, or to become rough.
items.ex_en: Constant exposure to freezing winter air can quickly roughen your delicate facial skin.
items.ex_zh: 持续暴露在冬日凛冽的寒风中，会使你娇嫩的脸部皮肤变得粗糙。
items.ex2_en: Her delicate hands roughened after weeks of harsh manual labor in cold water.
items.ex2_zh: 在冰水中进行了数周艰苦的体力劳动后，她娇嫩的双手变粗糙了。

groups.summary_en: These verbs detail modifying the tactile surface of an object or body part, stripping away smoothness to create coarse, uneven, or abrasive textures.
groups.summary_zh: 改变物体或皮肤表质，使其失去平滑而变得粗糙、不平整。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote degrading surface smoothness into jagged, textured, or eroded profiles, contrasting with 'damage' by specifically altering tactile surface friction.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词表示破坏物体表面的平滑光洁度使其变得粗糙或有微小磨损，与单纯的“损坏”相比，专注于触觉摩擦力与表面纹理的微观劣化。
groups.nuance_en: roughen: make an even surface coarse or textured to increase adhesion or grip (skin / surface / hands) · coarsen: degrade fine texture, granularity, or sensibilities into a cruder state (fabric / grain / features) · scuff: scrape off or mark a polished surface through superficial rubbing (leather / shoe / floor) · abrade: wear away surface material through harsh mechanical friction (rock / skin / metal) · chafe: make sore, raw, or worn down by repeated rubbing friction (skin / collar / rope)
groups.nuance_zh: roughen: 使原本光滑的表面变粗糙以增加附着力或抓地力 (skin / surface / hands) · coarsen: 使质地变粗劣、纹理变粗或气质庸俗化 (fabric / grain / features) · scuff: 因浅表擦蹭留下划痕或擦伤皮料 (leather / shoe / floor) · abrade: 经受剧烈机械摩擦将表面层层剥蚀磨损 (rock / skin / metal) · chafe: 持续摩擦导致破皮红肿或织物磨损 (skin / collar / rope)

groups.name: Row & Paddle · 划桨与荡舟 (Paddle, Scull, Oar)
groups.tip: 手握双桨划水破浪

items.def_en: to exert physical force on an oar to propel a rowboat through water
items.ex_en: Rowers had to pull hard against the river current to reach the riverbank.
items.ex_zh: 划手们不得不顶着湍急的河水奋力拉桨以靠岸。

items.def_en: 1. to propel or steer a boat using oars, or convey someone in a boat by rowing 2. (British informal) to quarrel noisily with someone
items.ex_en: The veteran boatman volunteered to row the stranded tourists across the swollen river.
items.ex_zh: 老船夫自告奋勇划船将滞留的游客摆渡过暴涨的河流。

items.def_en: to move a canoe or small boat through water using a handheld paddle with repeated short strokes
items.ex_en: The scout guided the wooden canoe and paddled quietly along the misty riverbank.
items.ex_zh: 向导操纵着木制独木舟，沿着薄雾笼罩的河岸轻轻划动短桨。

items.def_en: to drive or cause a boat to move forwards across the water by mechanical or manual force
items.ex_en: Dual electric outboard engines propel the lightweight vessel silently across the calm lake.
items.ex_zh: 双外挂电动机推动这艘轻便舟艇在平静的湖面上悄然前进。

items.def_en: to propel a racing boat using a pair of oars (sculls), or work a stern oar back and forth
items.ex_en: He loved to scull across the glassy morning lake in his lightweight racing boat.
items.ex_zh: 他喜欢在清晨镜子般的湖面上划着轻型赛艇飞驰。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe manually propelling and steering a vessel through water by human muscle power using oars or paddles. They contrast synchronized multi-oar pulling against single double-bladed stroking.
groups.summary_zh: 指运用人力操纵划桨、双桨或单叶桨以推进水上舟艇。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote manual aquatic propulsion leveraging the leverage of oars or paddles against water resistance, differing from motor 'propel' through human bio-mechanical lever strokes.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词表示借助人力操作桨具在水中进行杠杆划动以推动船只前行，与发动机式的“推进”相比，依赖生物力学的周期性划水动作。
groups.nuance_en: row: propel a boat with mounted oars pulling against fixed tholes with back to bow (boat / dinghy / scull) · paddle: propel a canoe or small craft using an unattached blade facing forward (canoe / kayak / board) · scull: propel with a pair of light oars or a single sweeping stern oar (skiff / boat / water) · pull: apply heavy physical stroke power to an oar to drive a vessel (stroke / oar / boat) · propel: drive forward through water by mechanical or fluid thrust (craft / vessel / swimmer)
groups.nuance_zh: row: 坐在固定桨栓后背向舟首划桨驭舟 (boat / dinghy / scull) · paddle: 双手握无支点单/双叶短桨面朝前切水泛舟 (canoe / kayak / board) · scull: 划单人双桨艇，或在船尾摆动单橹摇橹前行 (skiff / boat / water) · pull: 奋力拉桨以巨大的划水力量驱动重舟 (stroke / oar / boat) · propel: 利用推力推进器或肢体推水使船体在水中破浪前行 (craft / vessel / swimmer)

groups.name: Rub & Burnish · 摩擦抛光与擦亮 (Burnish, Buff, Shine)
groups.tip: 用力摩擦使金属表面发亮

items.def_en: To rub metal or wood vigorously so as to bring out its natural luster or clean away tarnish
items.ex_en: The butler will rub up the antique silver candlesticks before tonight's banquet begins.
items.ex_zh: 男管家会在今晚的宴会开始前把那对古董银烛台擦拭一新。

items.def_en: To clean and rub shoes, brass, or silverware with paste or cloth so they reflect light
items.ex_en: Every Sunday morning, he took time to shine his heavy black service boots.
items.ex_zh: 每周日早晨，他都会花时间把那双笨重的黑色勤务靴擦得锃亮。

items.def_zh: 擦亮；打磨光亮；提升（形象）
items.def_en: To rub something until it gleams brightly; also used figuratively to enhance an image or presentation
items.ex_en: The campaign manager hired consultants to buff up the candidate's fading public image.
items.ex_zh: 竞选经理聘请了顾问来提升候选人日益下滑的公众形象。

items.def_en: To polish a metal, leather, or painted surface using a soft cloth or a motorized wheel
items.ex_en: Use a dry microfiber cloth to buff the newly waxed car bonnet smoothly.
items.ex_zh: 用干超细纤维布把刚打蜡的汽车引擎盖均匀抛光。

items.def_zh: 擦亮，打磨；提升，改善（形象、声誉）
items.def_en: 1. To polish metal or another hard surface by rubbing it until it shines. 2. To enhance or improve your public image or reputation.
items.ex_en: The general sought to burnish his tarnished reputation with another dramatic military triumph.
items.ex_zh: 将军企图借由另一场轰动的军事胜利来重塑自己受损的威名。

groups.summary_en: Encompasses actions where hard friction, cloths, or rotating wheels are applied to solid surfaces to create a mirror-like shine or sheen, often extended metaphorically to elevating public stature, pride, or reputation.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过用力摩擦或抛光轮使表面生辉发亮，多引申为提升形象声誉。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote escalating physical friction over a surface to generate specular luster, distinguished from plain 'clean' by generating optical shine and micro-smoothness.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词表示对物体表面施加反复摩擦以去除微瑕并产生镜面光泽，与简单的“擦净”相比，核心在于光泽度的提升与微观平滑化。
groups.nuance_en: shine: rub a dull surface to give off bright reflected light (shoes / apples / silverware) · buff: polish with a soft cloth or rotating wheel to yield a soft, smooth sheen (car / nails / metal) · burnish: polish by intense friction with a hard, smooth tool to create high reflective gloss or prestige (gold / image / credentials) · buff up: apply concentrated polishing effort to renew luster or skills (armor / skills / brass) · rub up: restore brightness or refresh dormant capabilities through rubbing (metal / knowledge / contact)
groups.nuance_zh: shine: 擦拭暗哑表面使其亮洁生光 (shoes / apples / silverware) · buff: 使用软布或抛光轮打磨出柔和温润的亮光 (car / nails / metal) · burnish: 用硬质抛光工具强力压光金属，或引申为润饰光鲜形象 (gold / image / credentials) · buff up: 集中抛光打磨使表面光亮如新，或精进技能 (armor / skills / brass) · rub up: 擦拭拭除氧化斑驳，或温习重拾旧知 (metal / knowledge / contact)

groups.name: Rub Out & Remove · 擦除与消除 (Erase, Rub Out, Blot Out)
groups.tip: 抹去痕迹直至完全消失

items.def_en: To draw a line through written or printed words to indicate deletion
items.ex_en: Please cross out the incorrect phone numbers and write the new ones clearly.
items.ex_zh: 请把错误的电话号码划掉，并工整写上新号码。

items.def_en: To remove pencil marks, chalk, or stains by rubbing with an eraser or cloth
items.ex_en: You can easily rub out these soft pencil marks using a vinyl eraser.
items.ex_zh: 你可以用塑料橡皮轻松擦掉这些较浅的铅笔字迹。

items.def_en: To obscure from sight or completely suppress an unpleasant thought or memory
items.ex_en: He drank cheap whisky every night to blot out the painful memories of war.
items.ex_zh: 他夜夜借廉价威士忌浇愁，只为抹去那些痛苦的战争记忆。

items.def_zh: 擦除，抹去（字迹、数据等）；消除，使忘却（记忆）
items.def_en: 1. to rub out or remove marks, text, or recorded data 2. to remove something completely from the mind or from existence
items.ex_en: A single magnetic surge can permanently erase all confidential files from the storage drive.
items.ex_zh: 一次电磁涌流就能将存储盘中的所有机密文件永久抹除。

items.def_en: To wear away or eliminate a surface mark, inscription, or memory gradually
items.ex_en: Centuries of torrential rainwater have begun to efface the ancient inscription on the monument.
items.ex_zh: 数百年的倾盆暴雨已经开始逐渐侵蚀湮灭纪念碑上的古老铭文。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on the mechanical or deliberate removal of marks, texts, recorded signals, or impressions through physical friction or direct cancellation.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重通过物理摩擦、涂改或直接取消手段擦除字迹、痕迹或记忆。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote total physical or symbolic obliteration of recorded traces from a support medium, differing from generic 'delete' by tactile scouring, blotting, or scraping actions.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词表示从载体上彻底磨灭、涂抹或刮除痕迹与记忆，与现代数码“删除”相比，带有强烈的物理刮擦、遮盖或磨蚀泯灭感。
groups.nuance_en: erase: scrape or wipe away markings completely from a surface or memory (pencil / board / memory) · rub out: remove pencil or chalk marks through abrasive friction, or slang for eliminate (writing / line / mobster) · blot out: obscure completely with a dense mass, dark stain, or thick cover (sun / memory / landscape) · efface: wear away or cause something to disappear so as to be indistinct or self-effacing (inscription / self / trace) · cross out: draw a deliberate line through written text to cancel it (word / name / sentence)
groups.nuance_zh: erase: 擦掉物理书写痕迹，或使脑海中记忆彻底消失 (pencil / board / memory) · rub out: 用橡皮擦研磨擦掉字迹，或黑话中的抹杀消灭 (writing / line / mobster) · blot out: 用浓厚墨水涂黑遮蔽，或以重云浓雾遮天蔽日 (sun / memory / landscape) · efface: 岁月漫长磨损字迹雕痕，或使自身边缘化隐没 (inscription / self / trace) · cross out: 划上一道横线将写错的词句勾销 (word / name / sentence)

groups.name: Ruffle & Dishevel · 拨乱与弄蓬松 (Ruffle, Tousle, Muss)
groups.tip: 揉搓拨弄平整表面使凌乱

items.def_zh: （常与 up 连用）弄乱；弄皱
items.def_en: (+ up) To make something, such as hair or clothes, untidy or wrinkled
items.ex_en: Don't muss up your hair right before the family photograph is taken, please.
items.ex_zh: 拜托，在拍全家福前千万别把你的头发弄乱了。

items.def_zh: 弄乱，拨乱（头发、羽毛等）；使泛起波纹；使心烦意乱
items.def_en: 1. To disturb the smoothness of something, such as hair, feathers, or water. 2. To upset someone's calm or composure.
items.ex_en: A sudden gust of wind ruffled the surface of the quiet mountain pond.
items.ex_zh: 一阵突如其来的狂风吹皱了静谧山池的水面。

items.def_en: To make something untidy, disordered, or dirty
items.ex_en: The playful puppy managed to mess up the newly arranged living room completely.
items.ex_zh: 淘气的小狗把刚收拾整齐的客厅弄得一塌糊涂。

items.def_zh: 使蓬乱；使头发衣冠不整
items.def_en: To cause hair or clothes to hang loosely or look untidy
items.ex_en: Fierce gale winds violently disheveled her elegant hair and tore at her silk scarf.
items.ex_zh: 狂风无情地吹乱了她优雅的长发，撕扯着她的丝巾。

items.def_en: To make someone's hair untidy or messy, often playfully
items.ex_en: He smiled warmly and leaned down to tousle the little boy's curly hair.
items.ex_zh: 他温和地笑着，俯下身轻轻揉乱了那个小男孩的卷发。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures disrupting the smooth, orderly arrangement of hair, feathers, clothing, or composure through light, brushing, or careless manual disturbance.
groups.summary_zh: 拨弄、揉乱头发、衣着或平整表面，使之凌乱。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote disturbing the tidy arrangement of hair, feathers, or fabrics into playful or untidy disorder, contrasting with violent 'destroy' by maintaining gentle, disordered fluffiness.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词表示扰乱头发、羽毛或织物的齐整次序使其凌乱蓬松，与破坏性的“毁坏”相比，特指带有亲昵、随意或微风拂过的蓬乱效果。
