groups.nuance_en: ruffle: disorder flat surfaces like feathers or hair playfully or provoke minor agitation (hair / feathers / composure) · tousle: entangle hair into casual, disheveled clumps often affectionately (locks / hair / curls) · muss: rumple neatly pressed hair or clothing through careless contact (hair / collar / bed) · dishevel: cause personal hair or attire to hang in complete, untidy disarray (appearance / hair / dress) · mess up: scramble neatly arranged locks or situational plans into chaotic disorder (hair / plan / room)
groups.nuance_zh: ruffle: 逆拂羽毛或头发使其翘起，或轻微搅扰内心从容 (hair / feathers / composure) · tousle: 亲昵地把一头秀发揉成凌乱蓬松的一团 (locks / hair / curls) · muss: 因蹭乱或不当触碰弄乱齐整的衣冠发型 (hair / collar / bed) · dishevel: 使衣衫不整、长发蓬乱披散毫无齐整仪容 (appearance / hair / dress) · mess up: 弄得乱七八糟，揉乱头发或搞砸计划 (hair / plan / room)

groups.name: Rule & Reign Imperiously · 称尊与擅权 (Reign, Domineer, Preside)
groups.tip: 行使最高政治统治与皇权

items.def_zh: 立为女王（或王后）；（国际象棋中）使（兵）升变为后；摆谱，显威风
items.def_en: 1. (chess) To promote a pawn to a queen, or become a queen. 2. (often queen it) To behave in an imperious or superior manner.
items.ex_en: Ever since receiving her promotion, she started to queen it over the entire office.
items.ex_zh: 自打获得晋升后，她便开始在整个办公室里作威作福、摆足谱儿。
items.ex2_en: The clever chess player advanced his pawn across the board to queen it.
items.ex2_zh: 这位聪明的国际象棋棋手将兵推过棋盘，使其升变成后。

items.def_en: (+ over) To rule as a monarch, or to dominate a particular sphere or group
items.ex_en: The undisputed champion continued to reign over the global lightweight division for six years.
items.ex_zh: 这位无可争议的冠军继续称霸全球轻量级赛事长达六年。

items.def_en: To be in a position of supreme authority or control over a situation or group
items.ex_en: The chief justice will preside over the contentious constitutional hearings scheduled for next Monday.
items.ex_zh: 首席大法官将主持定于下周一举行的争议激烈的宪法听证会。

items.def_en: To exercise dominant power, rule, or influence over a realm or people
items.ex_en: For nearly three centuries, the merchant guild held absolute sway over the maritime port.
items.ex_zh: 近三个世纪以来，该商业行会一直牢牢统治着这座海运港口。
items.ex2_en: Tall pine branches swayed gently in the soft breeze under the afternoon sun.
items.ex2_zh: 午后阳光下，高大的松树枝在轻柔的微风中微微摇曳。

items.def_en: (+ over) To assert one's will arrogantly and tyrannically over other people
items.ex_en: The tyrannical supervisor constantly tries to domineer over junior researchers in the laboratory.
items.ex_zh: 专横的导师总是试图在实验室里对初级研究员颐指气使。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve assuming regal status or behaving in an imperious, haughty manner by asserting absolute social superiority over others.
groups.summary_zh: 表现出高高在上的女王/君王作风，擅权专断或执掌大权。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote exercising authoritative, imperious, or overbearing dominion over others, distinguishing from legitimate 'govern' by aristocratic conceit, domineering arrogance, or absolute oversight.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词表示以专断、跋扈或至尊的姿态行使支配权与压倒性权威，与中性的“治理/管理”相比，强调独断独行、高傲凌驾或极度霸道的控制力。
groups.nuance_en: reign: hold sovereign supreme sway or prevail uncontrollably as an atmosphere (monarch / terror / silence) · domineer: tyrannize and govern overbearingly through arrogant assertiveness (family / staff / subordinates) · preside over: hold primary formal authority, chairing a meeting or governing a historic era (meeting / court / empire) · sway: wield persuasive or magnetic control altering others' wills (jury / masses / opinions) · queen: behave imperiously, adopting the haughty, condescending airs of a royal (queen it / room / rivals)
groups.nuance_zh: reign: 作为君主至高无上地统治，或某种氛围在全场弥漫主宰 (monarch / terror / silence) · domineer: 颐指气使、专横跋扈地压制并支配他人 (family / staff / subordinates) · preside over: 坐镇首席以法定权威主持会议或见证掌管时代 (meeting / court / empire) · sway: 凭借巨大威权或魅力左右他人意志 (jury / masses / opinions) · queen: 摆出女王般不可一世的傲慢架子称霸 (queen it / room / rivals)

groups.name: Rush & Bustle · 匆忙与急行 (Hurry, Flurry, Scurry)
groups.tip: 步伐匆匆或忙碌奔走状态

items.def_zh: 奔忙，匆忙走动；熙熙攘攘，充满活力
items.def_en: 1. (+ about/around) To move around in a hurried, busy, and energetic manner. 2. (+ with) To be full of bustling activity or people.
items.ex_en: Waiters bustled around the dining room to prepare tables before dinner guests arrived.
items.ex_zh: 服务员们在餐厅里来回忙碌，抢在晚宴客人到来前布置好餐桌。

items.def_en: To move around in an agitated, confused, and bustling manner
items.ex_en: Flustered clerks flurried through the corridors carrying stacks of misplaced audit files.
items.ex_zh: 慌乱的职员们抱着大叠放错位置的审计文件在走廊里仓皇奔忙。
items.ex2_en: The sudden arrival of royal guests flurried the anxious household staff completely.
items.ex2_zh: 王室客人的突然到来让焦急的仆人们彻底慌乱起来。

items.def_en: To run with quick, hurried steps, typically seeking shelter or concealment
items.ex_en: Panicked mice scuttle along the kitchen skirting board whenever the lights click on.
items.ex_zh: 只要电灯一开，受惊的老鼠就会贴着厨房踢脚线仓皇窜逃。

items.def_zh: 小步急促跑动；仓促奔忙
items.def_en: To move quickly with short, hurried steps, often out of anxiety or haste
items.ex_en: Startled squirrels scurry up the nearest oak tree as dogs approach the lawn.
items.ex_zh: 当狗靠近草坪时，受惊的松鼠赶忙小步快跑窜上了最近的橡树。

items.def_en: To rush or dash about recklessly and frantically
items.ex_en: Excited children tear around the playground without paying attention to the wet grass.
items.ex_zh: 兴奋的孩子们在操场上狂奔乱跑，丝毫不在意湿漉漉的草地。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on energetic, agitated, or rapid movement, typically characterized by brisk steps, self-important busyness, or chaotic commotion.
groups.summary_zh: 表现因繁忙、急促或纷乱而迈着细碎脚步或慌忙动作的走动状态。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote moving rapidly with fragmented, hurried agitation, differing from directed 'run/sprint' through bustling, frantic, short-stepped, or chaotic velocity.
groups.desc_zh: 该框架动词表示带有慌乱、碎步或嘈杂忙乱态势的急促移动，与目标明确的高速“奔跑/冲刺”相比，突出脚步细碎、慌张或漫无头绪的骚动感。
groups.nuance_en: bustle: move purposefully with busy, energetic, noisy commotion (kitchen / staff / city) · scurry: move briskly with quick, tiny, agitated footsteps like a small creature (mouse / beetle / shoppers) · scuttle: run with rapid, hasty, clumsy short steps to escape danger (crab / rat / clouds) · flurry: rush about in an agitated, scattered, nervous flutter (workers / flakes / commuters) · tear around: charge about wildly and violently with chaotic speed (kids / car / streets)
groups.nuance_zh: bustle: 穿梭往来、兴冲冲且喧嚣地忙碌奔忙 (kitchen / staff / city) · scurry: 如同小动物般迈着碎步慌慌张张地疾走 (mouse / beetle / shoppers) · scuttle: 迈着快速而急促的短步仓皇逃窜 (crab / rat / clouds) · flurry: 心慌意乱、如同风卷残雪般阵发性地慌乱奔忙 (workers / flakes / commuters) · tear around: 毫无章法地狂冲乱撞、风风火火地疯跑 (kids / car / streets)

groups.name: Sabotage & Subvert · 暗中破坏与颠覆 (Undermine, Scupper, Torpedo)
groups.tip: 暗中潜伏破坏以颠覆政局

items.def_en: To gradually or insidiously weaken someone's power, authority, or credibility
items.ex_en: Persistent negative leaks were designed to undermine the prime minister's credibility before elections.
items.ex_zh: 持续的负面爆料旨在选举前暗中削弱首相的威信。

items.raw_cluster: 暗中破坏与破坏 Sabotage & Subvert
items.def_zh: 暗中破坏，暗中颠覆；潜入水下
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To undermine, sabotage, or defeat something secretly and unexpectedly. 2. To move or submerge underwater like a submarine.
items.ex_en: Hostile rivals conspired behind closed doors to submarine the proposed corporate merger completely.
items.ex_zh: 怀有敌意的对手暗中勾结，意图暗中颠覆拟议中的企业合并案。

items.def_en: To deliberately ruin or destroy a project, policy, or negotiation unexpectedly
items.ex_en: A surprise cabinet veto threatened to torpedo the fragile peace deal between rival factions.
items.ex_zh: 内阁突然行使的否决权可能彻底破坏对立派系之间脆弱的和平协议。

items.def_en: To secretly weaken and destroy the authority of a political system, institution, or established belief
items.ex_en: Corrupt state officials sought to subvert the independent electoral process through systematic bribery.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的国家官员企图通过系统性贿赂颠覆独立的选举程序。

items.def_en: To deliberately prevent something from succeeding or destroy a scheme completely
items.ex_en: A leak to the press could easily scupper our chances of closing the deal.
items.ex_zh: 向媒体泄密很容易让我们促成这笔交易的机会彻底化为泡影。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe covert, deceitful, or calculated actions aimed at wrecking plans, sinking operations, or destroying authority from within or under the surface.
groups.summary_zh: 指从内部或暗处策划破坏、掣肘或摧毁计划、行动及体制的隐秘颠覆行为。
groups.desc_en: Denotes covert, underhanded actions that weaken, derail, or sink plans, institutions, or agreements, contrasting with overt physical attacks by striking invisibly from beneath or behind the scenes.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过隐蔽、暗中作梗的手段削弱、搅黄或瓦解计划、体制或协议，与公开正面的暴力攻击不同，强调‘自下而上’或‘幕后突袭’的破坏性。
groups.nuance_en: undermine: gradual invisible erosion of strength or credibility (confidence / authority / stability) · submarine: stealthy sudden disruption or suppression beneath public view (deal / initiative / bill) · torpedo: abrupt fatal destruction of an ongoing project or policy (talks / career / legislation) · subvert: structural overthrow of established norms or governance from within (democracy / order / values) · scupper: deliberate pre-emptive wrecking of an opportunity or plan (chances / peace deal / ambitions)
groups.nuance_zh: undermine: 隐秘而渐进地侵蚀基础或公信力 (confidence / authority / stability) · submarine: 在公众视线之外隐蔽而猝然地压制或破坏 (deal / initiative / bill) · torpedo: 猝然以致命一击彻底摧毁进行中的计划 (talks / career / legislation) · subvert: 从内部自下而上颠覆既有体制、权威或价值观 (democracy / order / values) · scupper: 蓄意预先搅黄机会或使计划搁浅 (chances / peace deal / ambitions)

groups.name: Sabotage & Undermine · 蓄意破坏与暗中颠覆 (Sabotage, Undermine, Subvert)
groups.tip: 暗中破坏设施瘫痪敌方行动

items.def_zh: 彻底破坏；破坏（计划或关系）
items.def_en: To spoil or destroy a plan, relationship, or chance of success completely
items.ex_en: A sudden torrential rainstorm threatens to wreck our outdoor wedding reception this afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 一场突如其来的暴风雨恐怕会彻底破坏我们今天下午的户外婚宴。

items.def_en: To weaken or ruin someone or something gradually or insidiously, often by covert means
items.ex_en: Rampant political scandals continued to undermine public trust in the country's judicial system.
items.ex_zh: 猖獗的政治丑闻继续暗中侵蚀公众对国家司法体制的信任。

items.def_zh: 暗中破坏，蓄意毁坏；阻挠
items.def_en: to deliberately destroy or damage machinery, equipment, or systems; to spoil a plan or process secretly so that it cannot succeed
items.ex_en: Insurrectionists plotted to sabotage the main railway tracks ahead of the military convoy.
items.ex_zh: 叛乱分子密谋在军用车队到来之前破坏主力铁路线路。

items.def_zh: 颠覆；暗中破坏（体制、权威）
items.def_en: To undermine the power and authority of an established system, institution, or belief
items.ex_en: The extremist group sought to subvert democratic institutions by spreading coordinated online disinformation.
items.ex_zh: 该极端组织企图通过网络协同散布虚假信息来颠覆民主体制。

items.def_zh: 阻挠；故意挫败（计划或机会）
items.def_en: To deliberately prevent something such as a plan or opportunity from succeeding
items.ex_en: Last-minute budget freezes will scupper the research team's field expedition to Antarctica.
items.ex_zh: 临时的预算冻结将使该研究团队前往南极的野外考察计划彻底泡汤。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe covert, intentional actions taken to disrupt, damage, or weaken an adversary's equipment, operations, or plans from within.
groups.summary_zh: 强调通过隐蔽或间接手段蓄意阻挠、破坏设备或削弱计划。
groups.desc_en: Covers deliberately causing the ruin, failure, or systematic breakdown of operations, projects, or loyalty, differing from accidental damage through calculated malicious intent.
groups.desc_zh: 指蓄意导致行动、项目或忠诚彻底破产、停摆或系统性瓦解的情境，与意外事故不同，强调深谋远虑的恶意破坏。
groups.nuance_en: wreck: violent or careless total destruction of viability (economy / plans / marriage) · undermine: insidious eroding of foundational strength (credibility / rule of law / resolve) · sabotage: intentional clandestine destruction of equipment, systems, or processes (machinery / negotiations / effort) · subvert: corrupting and inverting authority or institutional loyalty from inside (regime / morals / integrity) · scupper: effectively causing a venture to fail or capsize before completion (bid / prospects / proposal)
groups.nuance_zh: wreck: 粗暴、致命且不可逆地彻底摧毁 (economy / plans / marriage) · undermine: 阴险地侵蚀根基与信任基础 (credibility / rule of law / resolve) · sabotage: 为阻碍进展而蓄意秘密破坏设备、系统或谈判 (machinery / negotiations / effort) · subvert: 从内部腐化并颠倒体制、道德或权力结构 (regime / morals / integrity) · scupper: 蓄意作梗使企图或前景功亏一篑 (bid / prospects / proposal)

groups.name: Sacrifice & Self-Immolate · 献祭与自焚 (Sacrifice, Burn, Consecrate)
groups.tip: 以火焚烧杀戮作为献祭

items.def_en: Slaughter an animal or person, or surrender a valued possession, as an offering to a deity
items.ex_en: Ancient priests gathered at sunrise to sacrifice a spotless white bull to the gods.
items.ex_zh: 古代祭司在日出时分聚集，向神灵献祭一头无瑕疵的白公牛。

items.def_en: Deliberately destroy someone or something by throwing or leaving them in fire
items.ex_en: With tears in his eyes, the poet consigned his unpublished manuscripts to the flames.
items.ex_zh: 诗人眼含泪水，将自己未出版的手稿决绝地付之一炬。

items.def_en: Destroy or be destroyed completely by fire
items.ex_en: The old wooden warehouse will burn up completely if firefighters do not intervene soon.
items.ex_zh: 如果消防员不及早干预，那座老旧木制仓库将会被完全焚毁。

items.def_en: Kill someone because of their religious beliefs or devotion to a cause
items.ex_en: Fanatical rulers sought to martyr dissident scholars who challenged orthodox dogma in public.
items.ex_zh: 狂热的统治者企图将公然挑战正统教条的异见学者折磨致死。

items.def_zh: 宰杀作祭品，杀戮以献祭；以火焚死
items.def_en: (formal) To kill or offer someone or oneself as a sacrifice, especially by burning.
items.ex_en: The monk chose to immolate himself in the public square to protest the war.
items.ex_zh: 为了抗议战争，这位僧人选择在公共广场上自焚献身。

groups.summary_en: Verbs involving solemn, destructive ritual offerings or fatal acts of self-sacrifice, predominantly characterized by consuming by fire or dedicating something valuable to a deity or ideal.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过火焚、祭祀等极端方式杀戮或自我牺牲以示信仰或抗议。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to giving up life, sacred possessions, or oneself, typically through ritual offering, fire, or supreme devotion to a higher cause, contrasting with ordinary death or disposal through consecrated surrender.
groups.desc_zh: 指为更高崇高的事业、信仰或神圣仪式而放弃生命、财物或自我（常伴随火祭），与普通死亡或报废不同，具有神圣奉献与毁灭性受难色彩。
groups.nuance_en: sacrifice: deliberate surrender of life or vital interest for a higher purpose (life / principles / career) · consign to the flames: formally cast into fire for total, often symbolic destruction (manuscript / heretic / effigy) · burn up: complete physical consumption by fire or internal fever (fuel / debris / body) · martyr: kill or suffer death specifically for steadfast religious or ideological beliefs (activist / saint / cause) · immolate: kill or destroy by fire as a ceremonial offering or extreme act of protest (oneself / victim / offering)
groups.nuance_zh: sacrifice: 为崇高目标或大局自愿舍弃生命或利益 (life / principles / career) · consign to the flames: 正式投入烈火以彻底或象征性毁灭 (manuscript / heretic / effigy) · burn up: 纯物理性地被大火或高热彻底焚尽 (fuel / debris / body) · martyr: 为坚持宗教信仰或政治理念受难殉道 (activist / saint / cause) · immolate: 以火焚身作为祭祀献祭或极端抗议手段 (oneself / victim / offering)

groups.name: Sag & Slump · 下垂与沉陷 (Slump, Settle, Cave in)
groups.tip: 因重力作用松弛下垂

items.def_en: To descend slowly to a lower level, especially through soft ground or under weight
items.ex_en: Heavy tractor tires began to sink deeply into the rain-soaked marshland mud.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的拖拉机轮胎开始深深陷入被雨水浸透的沼泽烂泥中。
items.ex2_en: The enemy submarine commander decided to sink the approaching cargo vessel with torpedoes.
items.ex2_zh: 敌方潜艇指挥官决定发射鱼雷击沉那艘正在逼近的货船。

items.def_en: To sink, bend, or hang down in the middle under weight, pressure, or fatigue; to decrease or weaken.
items.ex_en: The wooden floorboards began to sag under the weight of the massive bookcase.
items.ex_zh: 在那具沉重书架的重压下，木质地板开始向下凹陷。

items.def_en: To sink or fall heavily into a lower, shapeless position
items.ex_en: The old wooden mattress began to slump heavily in the center after years of use.
items.ex_zh: 经过多年的使用，那张旧木床的床垫中央开始严重向下凹陷。

items.def_en: To collapse inward or sink downward under external pressure
items.ex_en: The abandoned mine shaft started to cave in under the weight of torrential rains.
items.ex_zh: 在暴雨的重压下，废弃的矿井竖井开始向内坍塌。

items.def_en: To break or collapse downward under strain or pressure
items.ex_en: The rusted metal bridge threatened to give way under the heavy freight train's weight.
items.ex_zh: 生锈的铁桥在沉重货运列车的压迫下摇摇欲坠，几近断裂坍塌。

groups.summary_en: Captures the downward yielding or settling of structures and flexible bodies under gravity, continuous weight, or structural fatigue. It stresses hollow bending and loss of horizontal tension rather than total collapse.
groups.summary_zh: 描述物体受重力或负荷影响在中部弯曲、松弛下陷。
groups.desc_en: Describes physical or metaphorical yielding downwards under weight, age, or exhaustion, contrasting with intentional downward movement (like crouching) through structural or volumetric collapse.
groups.desc_zh: 指在重力、老化、压力或疲惫作用下结构或形态向下凹陷、下垂或坍塌，与主动下蹲不同，强调丧失支撑力而发生的被动沉降。
groups.nuance_en: sink: gradual downward displacement in fluid or soft substrate (ground / heart / sun) · sag: middle drooping under unsupported load or structural fatigue (mattress / ceiling / skin) · slump: sudden, heavy, exhausted dropping or sharp statistical decline (shoulders / posture / profits) · cave in: catastrophic inward collapse of an enclosing roof or wall (tunnel / roof / demands) · give way: sudden catastrophic failure of structural support under excessive load (bridge / floor / knees)
groups.nuance_zh: sink: 在液体或软地基中由于重力缓慢下沉 (ground / heart / sun) · sag: 中间部位因承重或疲劳发生弹性松弛下垂 (mattress / ceiling / skin) · slump: 无力地颓然跌坐、耷拉或指标急剧滑坡 (shoulders / posture / profits) · cave in: 顶部或周围围护结构受压向内彻底塌陷 (tunnel / roof / demands) · give way: 承重结构在重压下突然断裂失效或屈服 (bridge / floor / knees)

groups.name: Sail & Navigate · 航海与驾驭 (Sail, Cruise, Navigate)
groups.tip: 驾驶船舶在水面上航行

items.def_en: to travel over water in a ship or boat propelled by sails or engine, or to direct its course
items.ex_en: They plan to sail across the Mediterranean Sea in a newly built wooden schooner.
items.ex_zh: 他们计划驾驶一艘新建造的木制帆船横渡地中海。

items.def_en: to sail along leisurely around an area of water for recreation or pleasure rather than speed
items.ex_en: We spent the sunny afternoon cruising slowly along the picturesque coast of the island.
items.ex_zh: 我们花了一个阳光明媚的下午，沿着风景如画的岛屿海岸悠闲巡航。

items.def_en: to take a long, adventurous journey across the sea or ocean
items.ex_en: The ancient mariners voyaged into uncharted waters seeking legendary islands veiled in endless mist.
items.ex_zh: 古代的水手们远航驶入未知的海域，寻觅笼罩在无尽迷雾中的传说岛屿。

items.def_en: to sail, race, or cruise in a yacht for sport or recreation
items.ex_en: Wealthy patrons frequently yacht around the French Riviera during the warm summer months.
items.ex_zh: 富有的名流们在温暖的夏季经常驾游艇巡游法国里维埃拉。

items.def_en: to plan, direct, and steer the course of a ship through stretches of water
items.ex_en: The experienced captain carefully navigated the narrow passage between the dangerous coral reefs.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的船长小心翼翼地操舵引领船只穿过危险珊瑚礁之间的狭窄通道。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses navigating, piloting, or embarking on open waters via sophisticated marine vessels for transport, pleasure cruising, or competitive sport.
groups.summary_zh: 指驾驶游艇、帆船等船只在水面或公海航行、巡游。
groups.desc_en: Encompasses traversing water via wind, motor, or systematic route-finding, contrasting with land/air locomotion by specifically engaging maritime currents, helm operations, and navigational courses.
groups.desc_zh: 指借助风力、动力或定位系统在水上巡游或穿越，与陆空移动不同，特指驾驭水流、操舵及航线规划的航行活动。
groups.nuance_en: sail: harness wind to glide across water or begin a voyage (seas / yacht / fleet) · cruise: travel smoothly at moderate speed for pleasure or routine patrol (coast / waters / Caribbean) · voyage: undertake an extensive, solemn journey across oceans or unknown waters (ocean / world / deep seas) · yacht: sail recreationally aboard a private luxury or sporting vessel (harbor / Mediterranean / regatta) · navigate: steer and plot a precise directional course through complex waterways or obstacles (channel / river / waters)
groups.nuance_zh: sail: 张帆借助风力航行或指船只启航 (seas / yacht / fleet) · cruise: 以平稳速度为了游乐、巡逻在水域巡航 (coast / waters / Caribbean) · voyage: 进行长距离、探险性或史诗般的远洋航行 (ocean / world / deep seas) · yacht: 驾驶私人游艇进行休闲度假或竞速 (harbor / Mediterranean / regatta) · navigate: 测定方位并引导船只穿过复杂水域或障碍 (channel / river / waters)

groups.name: Salivate & Drool Excessively · 垂涎与流涎 (Drool, Drivel, Salivate)
groups.tip: 口水流淌分泌黏稠体液

items.def_en: To produce saliva naturally or copiously, especially in anticipation of food or a coveted prize
items.ex_en: The carnivore began to salivate profusely at the sight of fresh meat in the enclosure.
items.ex_zh: 那只食肉动物一看到围栏里的新鲜肉块便开始大量分泌唾液。

items.def_en: To let saliva dribble unconsciously from the lips, as an infant or dotard does
items.ex_en: The teething infant began to drivel constantly down the front of her clean bib.
items.ex_zh: 正在出牙的婴儿不停地流口水，打湿了干净围兜的前襟。

items.def_en: (often + over) To allow saliva to run out of the mouth; to exhibit unrestrained desire or lust
items.ex_en: The food critics practically drooled over the chef's exquisitely prepared signature dessert dish.
items.ex_zh: 美食评论家们几乎对主厨精心制作的招牌甜点垂涎欲滴。

items.def_en: 1. (+ over) To let saliva run from the mouth; to show excessive desire or admiration toward someone in a servile way.
items.ex_en: The ravenous hounds slavered greedily while watching the butcher carve the raw carcass.
items.ex_zh: 饥饿的猎犬贪婪地流着口水，紧盯着屠夫切削生肉躯干。

items.def_en: To let saliva or liquid run wetly and untidily from the mouth
items.ex_en: The clumsy Saint Bernard slobbered all over the newly cleaned hardwood floor.
items.ex_zh: 那只笨拙的圣伯纳犬把口水淌得刚擦洗好的实木地板上到处都是。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the physiological oozing of excess saliva from the lips, as well as figurative displays of uninhibited craving or doting desire.
groups.summary_zh: 口腔分泌过量唾液并外溢，亦引申指贪婪或垂涎欲滴。
groups.desc_en: Depicts producing and letting saliva escape the mouth, physically or figuratively in rapacious desire, contrasting with normal swallowing by involuntary or uncontrolled oral overflow.
groups.desc_zh: 指口水分泌过多并从口角流淌溢出，或喻指对欲望客体的极度垂涎与觊觎，与正常的吞咽相对，强调液体失控外溢的生理或贪婪态势。
groups.nuance_en: salivate: physiological secretion of saliva, especially when craving food or gain (mouth / dogs / investors) · drivel: allow saliva to run continuously like an infant, or speak nonsensically (baby / chin / mouth) · drool: passively dribble saliva from the mouth in sleep, sickness, or gaping lust (toddler / mouth / fans) · slaver: drool voraciously with slobbery sounds, expressing animalistic greed (beast / wolf / jaws) · slobber: messy, wet, noisy discharge of excessive saliva over a surface (dog / face / mouth)
groups.nuance_zh: salivate: 因食物诱惑或渴望获利而生理性分泌唾液 (mouth / dogs / investors) · drivel: 如婴幼儿般口水不断垂流，或引申为胡话连篇 (baby / chin / mouth) · drool: 睡眠中、病态下或色眯眯地任由口水下滴 (toddler / mouth / fans) · slaver: 凶兽般贪婪、粘稠地垂涎狂吠 (beast / wolf / jaws) · slobber: 邋遢、湿漉漉且伴随声响地将口水蹭得满地 (dog / face / mouth)

groups.name: Salute & Pay Homage · 致敬与庄重问候 (Hail, Honor, Acknowledge)
groups.tip: 以礼貌言行打招呼或致敬意

items.def_en: To show that one has seen, noticed, or recognized someone with a polite gesture or nod
items.ex_en: The professor merely acknowledged his former student with a curt, formal nod of recognition.
items.ex_zh: 教授只是礼貌而简短地点了点头，向他以前的学生致意。

items.def_zh: 敬礼，向……行军礼；向……致敬，赞颂；打招呼，问候
items.def_en: 1. To raise the right hand to the head as a formal sign of military respect. 2. (formal) To express admiration and public respect for someone or an achievement. 3. To greet someone politely.
items.ex_en: The young sentry stood upright to salute the commanding officer entering the compound.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的哨兵挺直身躯，向走进大院的指挥官行军礼致敬。

items.def_en: To express formal praise, respect, and gratitude publicly toward someone
items.ex_en: The prime minister rose to pay tribute to the courageous healthcare workers nationwide.
items.ex_zh: 首相起立，向全国勇敢的医护工作者公开表达敬意与感激。

items.def_en: To show deep respect, admiration, or public deference toward someone for their character or deeds
items.ex_en: The civic committee met to honor the brave firefighter with a lifetime service medal.
items.ex_zh: 市政委员会举行集会，向那位勇敢的消防员颁发终身服务奖章以表彰其功绩。

items.def_en: To greet or acclaim someone or something enthusiastically with loud praise and admiration
items.ex_en: Critics hailed the young pianist's remarkable performance as an unprecedented triumph of modern art.
items.ex_zh: 评论界盛赞这位年轻钢琴家的精彩演出，称其为现代艺术前所未有的辉煌成就。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote formal, deferential, or solemn gestures of respect and recognition toward rank, achievement, or authority. They contrast military physical protocol with public verbal tributes.
groups.summary_zh: 向权威、军职或卓越成就表达敬意与庄重问候。
groups.desc_en: Expresses deliberate public, ceremonial acts acknowledging worth, bravery, or rank, contrasting with ordinary greeting or thanking through formalized deferential reverence.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过仪式性、公开的方式表达敬意、赞誉或承认地位与壮举，与普通打招呼或致谢不同，具有高度的庄重感与崇敬色彩。
groups.nuance_en: acknowledge: recognize existence, legitimacy, or contribution formally (contribution / applause / debt) · salute: perform formal military or symbolic honor showing profound respect (flag / courage / heroes) · pay tribute to: make an explicit public gesture or speech of praise and gratitude (legacy / fallen soldiers / mentor) · honor: bestow high regard, awards, or ceremonies upon merit (veterans / memory / contract) · hail: acclaim or proclaim someone enthusiastically with widespread public cheers (leader / success / hero)
groups.nuance_zh: acknowledge: 正式公开承认贡献、身份或合法地位 (contribution / applause / debt) · salute: 行军礼或以庄严姿态向勇气与牺牲致敬 (flag / courage / heroes) · pay tribute to: 以特定言行、演说或悼念仪式表达崇敬与追思 (legacy / fallen soldiers / mentor) · honor: 给予崇高礼遇、褒奖或恪守承诺以示尊重 (veterans / memory / contract) · hail: 热情洋溢地欢呼、盛赞某人为杰出人物 (leader / success / hero)

groups.name: Salvage & Rescue · 打捞与挽救 (Retrieve, Recover, Reclaim)
groups.tip: 从废墟灾难中挽回物资

items.def_en: To regain possession of something lost or stolen, or recover submerged wreckage
items.ex_en: Deep-sea divers worked tirelessly to recover the missing flight recorder from the ocean floor.
items.ex_zh: 深海潜水员不知疲倦地工作，以从海底打捞寻获失踪的飞行记录仪。

items.def_en: To pull or extract something out of water or deep enclosed space
items.ex_en: He managed to fish out his lost car keys from the murky puddle.
items.ex_zh: 他设法从浑浊的水坑里捞出了遗失的车钥匙。

items.def_en: To find and bring something back from a particular place, especially after losing it
items.ex_en: Autonomous submersibles successfully retrieved vital scientific instruments from the deep ocean trench.
items.ex_zh: 自主潜水器成功从深海海沟中找回了关键的科学仪器。

items.def_en: To make abandoned, waste, or damaged materials usable again
items.ex_en: The modern recycling facility reclaims valuable metals from discarded industrial machinery and electronics.
items.ex_zh: 这座现代化的回收设施从废弃的工业机械和电子产品中回收利用贵重金属。

items.def_zh: 打捞，抢救，挽救（受损财物）
items.def_en: To save goods, a ship, or materials from being lost or destroyed in a disaster, shipwreck, or fire.
items.ex_en: Specialized divers attempted to salvage the sunken cargo ship before the approaching storm arrived.
items.ex_zh: 专业潜水员赶在风暴来临前设法抢救打捞那艘沉没的货船。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on finding, extracting, and recovering endangered, sunken, or abandoned possessions, vehicles, or materials from disaster sites or wreckage.
groups.summary_zh: 指从水下、废墟或灾难残骸中挽救、打捞或回收财物与材料。
groups.desc_en: Entails retrieving, extracting, and redeeming valuable remnants from wrecks, ruins, or disastrous situations, contrasting with simple finding by actively rescuing utility from destruction.
groups.desc_zh: 指在残骸、废墟或灾难危局中抢救、打捞并再利用有价值的物品或权益，与普通寻找不同，强调从毁弃边缘力挽狂澜。
groups.nuance_en: recover: regain possession of lost, stolen, or submerged items (bodies / wreckage / stolen assets) · fish out: physically extract an object immersed or lost inside a deep place (keys / body / wallet) · retrieve: fetch and return something specific from a remote or storage location (data / luggage / capsule) · reclaim: rehabilitate or demand back usable materials or lost ground (land / honor / materials) · salvage: rescue intact goods, reputations, or pride from utter ruin or shipwreck (wreck / reputation / pride)
groups.nuance_zh: recover: 找回遗失物、被打捞沉船遗骸或寻获遗体 (bodies / wreckage / stolen assets) · fish out: 从水中或深处摸索捞出特定物品 (keys / body / wallet) · retrieve: 前往存放处或深处取回并带回物品或数据 (data / luggage / capsule) · reclaim: 开垦荒地、回收废旧资源或收复失地 (land / honor / materials) · salvage: 从海难、火灾或彻底破产中抢救出余存物资或尊严 (wreck / reputation / pride)

groups.name: Sanctify & Glorify · 崇奉与封圣 (Canonize, Venerate, Deify)
groups.tip: 宗教式册封与极度尊崇

items.def_en: to regard someone with deep respect, religious reverence, or profound awe
items.ex_en: Generations of devout pilgrims travel far to venerate the sacred relics of the ancient patron saint.
items.ex_zh: 数代虔诚的朝圣者不远万里前来膜拜这位古代守护圣徒的神圣遗物。

items.def_en: to praise, glorify, or elevate someone to a remarkably high rank, moral dignity, or divine status
items.ex_en: The epic poem exalts the fallen hero into a celestial guardian of the eternal realm.
items.ex_zh: 这首史诗赞颂这位阵亡的英雄，将他推崇升华为永恒国度的神圣守护者。

items.def_zh: 封为圣徒；将……奉为经典/圣典
items.def_en: to officially declare a deceased person to be a saint, or to treat someone or something as authoritative and sacred
items.ex_en: The Vatican decided to canonize the beloved missionary decades after her dedicated charitable work.
items.ex_zh: 梵蒂冈在数十载之后决定将这位深受爱戴、毕生致力于慈善的传教士封为圣徒。

items.def_zh: （天主教）为……行宣福礼，宣布……为真福；使极其幸福，赐福
items.def_en: 1. (in the Catholic Church) to officially declare a deceased person to be blessed, as a step toward sainthood. 2. (formal) to make someone blissfully happy.
items.ex_en: The Pope will officially beatify the martyred priest during a solemn mass next Sunday.
items.ex_zh: 教皇将于下周日的一场庄严弥撒中正式为这位殉难神父行宣福礼。

items.def_en: to make a god of someone, or to revere or worship a person as divine or supreme
items.ex_en: Ancient citizens would deify their mortal rulers after death, erecting grand temples in their name.
items.ex_zh: 古代平民会在凡人统治者死后将其奉为神灵，并以其名义建造宏伟的庙宇。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses religious or ideological acts of elevating human beings to holy, divine, or supreme moral status through formal declaration or deep reverence.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过宗教仪式或至高崇奉，将某人封圣、神化或奉为至善典范。
groups.desc_en: Refers to conferring supreme sacredness, godly stature, or supreme moral exaltation upon mortals or objects, contrasting with secular praise by elevating to divine or holy rank.
groups.desc_zh: 指将凡人或事物奉为神圣、列入圣品或神格化，与世俗的赞赏不同，强调赋予其宗教维度的神圣性或至高无上的道德崇拜。
groups.nuance_en: venerate: regard with deep, reverent awe seasoned with sanctity (relics / saints / elders) · exalt: elevate to the highest rank, power, or ecstatic glory (virtue / position / name) · canonize: officially declare a deceased person an ecclesiastical saint; cement into orthodoxy (saint / author / text) · beatify: pronounce blessed as an initial step toward formal sainthood in the Church (pope / nun / martyr) · deify: transform a mortal, ruler, or ideal into an actual god or object of worship (emperor / money / reason)
groups.nuance_zh: venerate: 对圣徒、遗物或德高望重者怀着敬畏之心崇敬 (relics / saints / elders) · exalt: 将地位、美德或权势提升至至尊无上的境界 (virtue / position / name) · canonize: 由教会正式追封为圣徒；将作品确立为正统经典 (saint / author / text) · beatify: 教会正式宣福，作为册封圣品的前置阶段 (pope / nun / martyr) · deify: 将君主、凡人或抽象概念奉若神明、加以神化 (emperor / money / reason)

groups.name: Sate & Surfeit · 餍足与使厌腻 (Satiate, Sate, Glut)
groups.tip: 食欲充分满足甚至发腻

items.def_en: To eat greedily until uncomfortably stuffed and swollen with food
items.ex_en: The starving hikers gorged themselves on roasted meats until they could barely move.
items.ex_zh: 饥肠辘辘的徒步者们狼吞虎咽地吃着烤肉，直到撑得几乎动弹不得。

items.def_en: To supply or feed something with vastly more than is desired or needed
items.ex_en: Excess imports continue to glut the domestic marketplace with cheap, low-quality agricultural produce.
items.ex_zh: 过剩的进口商品继续向国内市场充斥大量廉价劣质的农产品。

items.def_zh: 使充分满足，使饱足；使厌腻
items.def_en: To satisfy a hunger, desire, or appetite fully or to excess so that one wants no more.
items.ex_en: A lavish banquet served to satiate the voracious appetites of the weary travelers.
items.ex_zh: 丰盛的宴席充分满足了疲惫旅人们贪婪旺盛的食欲。

items.def_en: To satisfy a desire or appetite fully or to excess
items.ex_en: Nothing could sate his restless longing for distant adventures and forgotten ancient cities.
items.ex_zh: 没有任何事物能充分满足他对远方冒险与被遗忘古城的无尽渴望。

items.def_en: To feed, supply, or indulge someone to disgustingly sickening excess
items.ex_en: The decadent feast surfeited the guests with rich sauces and cloying sweet confections.
items.ex_zh: 奢靡的盛宴用厚腻的酱汁和甜得发腻的甜点让宾客们饱胀生厌。

groups.summary_en: This frame denotes feeding an appetite, lust, or curiosity to total fullness or beyond—often resulting in cloying surfeit and lethargy.
groups.summary_zh: 指食欲、欲望被彻底满足甚至过量填充，致使生厌、腻烦的状态。
groups.desc_en: Represents satisfying an appetite or desire to the point of complete fulness or nauseating overabundance, contrasting with ordinary eating by reaching or breaching the threshold of capacity.
groups.desc_zh: 指欲望、胃口被完全满足乃至达到厌腻、反胃的过饱和状态，与普通进食不同，强调达到或超越生理/心理容量的极限。
groups.nuance_en: gorge: stuff oneself ravenously and greedily with vast quantities of food (oneself / food / sweets) · glut: flood a market or vessel beyond its absorption limit (market / system / senses) · satiate: fully satisfy a hunger or desire to its ultimate contentment limit (appetite / thirst / curiosity) · sate: thoroughly gratify an intense hunger, often leading to dull weariness (appetite / lust / curiosity) · surfeit: oversupply to sickening excess causing distaste and revulsion (senses / stomach / pleasure)
groups.nuance_zh: gorge: 狼吞虎咽地把食物大肆塞满肚皮 (oneself / food / sweets) · glut: 超量供给使市场或系统严重过剩、充斥成灾 (market / system / senses) · satiate: 完全满足饥饿、求知欲等，达到心满意足的极限 (appetite / thirst / curiosity) · sate: 彻底填满强烈的饥饿或欲望，使其感到厌倦停滞 (appetite / lust / curiosity) · surfeit: 供给过度以致让人感到腻烦、反胃或恶心 (senses / stomach / pleasure)

groups.name: Savor & Relish · 品味与赏析 (Relish, Appreciate, Luxuriate)
groups.tip: 细细咂摸体会美妙滋味

items.def_en: To recognize the full worth, subtle qualities, and refined value of food, art, or moments
items.ex_en: Only true connoisseurs can fully appreciate the subtle floral undertones of this aged vintage wine.
items.ex_zh: 只有真正的鉴赏家才能充分体会这款陈年佳酿中微妙的花香底蕴。
items.ex2_en: Rare vintage wines appreciate significantly in value over several decades of careful storage.
items.ex2_zh: 罕见的陈年老酒在经过数十年的妥善储存后，价值会大幅升值。

items.def_en: To take great and self-indulgent pleasure in a sensation of sumptuous comfort or sensory delight
items.ex_en: She decided to luxuriate in the warm, scented bath after an exhausting workweek.
items.ex_zh: 在忙碌了一周后，她决定尽情享受温暖芳香的热水澡。

items.def_en: To derive acute joy, keen amusement, or satisfaction from an action or sensory sensation
items.ex_en: The mischievous children delighted in splashing puddle water onto each other during the rainstorm.
items.ex_zh: 暴雨期间，淘气的孩子们以互相踩水坑溅水为乐。

items.def_en: To gain immense enjoyment or satisfaction from an experience, taste, or prospect
items.ex_en: The victorious team took a quiet moment to relish their hard-fought championship win.
items.ex_zh: 获胜的队伍静享片刻，极其享受这来之不易的冠军胜利。

items.def_zh: 细品，体味，慢慢享受；带有……味道或意味
items.def_en: 1. (British English spelling of savor) To enjoy food, an experience, or a moment slowly and thoroughly. 2. (+ of) To show or suggest a particular quality or flavor.
items.ex_en: He paused to savour the rich aroma of freshly roasted coffee beans this crisp morning.
items.ex_zh: 在这个清凉的早晨，他停下脚步，细细品味新鲜烘焙咖啡豆的浓郁香气。

groups.summary_en: This frame emphasizes deep psychological enjoyment and lingering appraisal of exquisite sensations, flavors, or experiences, deliberately prolonging contact to extract maximal pleasure.
groups.summary_zh: 从容咀嚼并全身心沉浸于美味、美好时光或感官体验的乐趣中。
groups.desc_en: Involves drawing out and lingering upon sensations of taste, beauty, or pleasure with slow, conscious appreciation, contrasting with hasty consumption through focused sensory mindfulness.
groups.desc_zh: 指调动感官与心灵，缓慢、专注且流连忘返地品味快乐、滋味或宁静，与仓促进食或粗略享受不同，强调拉长时间维度的沉浸感。
groups.nuance_en: appreciate: consciously recognize the artistic value, nuance, or goodness of something (art / wine / gesture) · luxuriate in: abandon oneself freely to sensual, lavish comfort or blissful ease (luxury / warm bath / sunshine) · delight in: derive acute, lively, and visible joy from an activity or circumstance (company / success / malice) · relish: anticipatorily or eagerly devour an experience or taste with profound zest (opportunity / challenge / victory) · savour: slowly taste, smell, or reflectively dwell upon an exquisite sensation (flavor / moment / triumph)
groups.nuance_zh: appreciate: 敏锐而有教养地领会、鉴赏艺术或善意之美 (art / wine / gesture) · luxuriate in: 纵情沉溺于奢华、舒适或慵懒的环境中 (luxury / warm bath / sunshine) · delight in: 从某种活动或境况中获得活泼明朗的欢愉 (company / success / malice) · relish: 满怀热望与津津有味的心态去品评、享受 (opportunity / challenge / victory) · savour: 细嚼慢咽、久久品味某份滋味、胜利或珍贵时刻 (flavor / moment / triumph)

groups.name: Scan & Render · 成像与投影 (Render, Scan, Visualize)
groups.tip: 在脑海或屏幕上呈现图像

items.def_zh: 显像，给……拍成像；在脑海中描绘，想象
items.def_en: 1. To make an image or scan of something, especially by means of a medical scanner or camera. 2. To form a mental picture of something.
items.ex_en: Advanced magnetic resonance techniques were utilized to image the internal tissues of the patient's brain.
items.ex_zh: 先进的磁共振技术被用来对患者脑部内部组织进行成像。

items.def_en: To capture and record the likeness of someone or something on film or digital media
items.ex_en: The wildlife photographer managed to photograph a rare snow leopard in its natural snowy habitat.
items.ex_zh: 野生动物摄影师成功在雪豹的自然积雪栖息地拍摄到了它的身影。

items.def_en: To pass a beam of light, radiation, or ultrasound over something to capture an image or data
items.ex_en: The technician used a handheld scanner to scan the patient's abdomen for internal injuries.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员使用手持扫描仪扫描患者腹部以排查内部损伤。

items.def_en: To generate a two- or three-dimensional digital image from a model by means of software
items.ex_en: The studio's powerful computer cluster took several hours to render the complex visual effects.
items.ex_zh: 工作室强大的计算机集群花了数小时才渲染出复杂的视觉特效。

items.def_en: To convert abstract data, signals, or internal structures into an interpretable visual display
items.ex_en: The modern analytical software can visualize complex molecular structures in full three dimensions.
items.ex_zh: 现代分析软件能将复杂的分子结构完全以三维图像可视化呈现。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe generating, capturing, or displaying visual representations through technical instruments, digital graphics, or imaging hardware.
groups.summary_zh: 指借助仪器或数字化技术捕捉并生成图像的动词群。
groups.desc_en: Covers converting physical entities, biological slices, or raw digital code into visible pictorial images or virtual simulations, contrasting with plain drawing through technological transmission and mapping.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过光学、断层扫描或算法将物理实体、生理组织或代码转化为可视化图像或三维虚拟图景，强调基于技术介质的映射与生成。
groups.nuance_en: image: capture and form an optical or diagnostic internal likeness (brain / tumors / landscape) · photograph: record an optical exposure onto light-sensitive emulsion or sensor (scene / subject / wedding) · scan: pass a sensor or beam over a surface to collect and digitize structural data (document / brain / horizon) · render: compute geometric data into a realistic display image, or artistically depict (3D model / graphics / scene) · visualize: form a mental concept or transform abstract numeric data into visible graphic plots (data / future / anatomy)
groups.nuance_zh: image: 通过仪器或医学影像技术对内部构造进行成像 (brain / tumors / landscape) · photograph: 通过光学镜头记录光影曝光以形成摄影照片 (scene / subject / wedding) · scan: 用光束或传感器扫掠表面以进行高精度数字化录入 (document / brain / horizon) · render: 利用图形管线或算法将三维模型渲染为逼真图像 (3D model / graphics / scene) · visualize: 将抽象数据、统计图谱转变为直观图像，或在脑海中构想 (data / future / anatomy)

groups.name: Scientific & Analytical Projection · 数据预测与趋势预报 (Forecast, Predict, Project)
groups.tip: 依据模型与趋势推断前瞻

items.def_en: To estimate or extrapolate a future situation or quantity based on current trends
items.ex_en: Fiscal analysts project significant economic growth for the region over the coming fiscal decade.
items.ex_zh: 财政分析师推测规划该地区在未来十年将迎来显著的经济增长。

items.def_en: To state what will happen in the future on the basis of existing evidence or reasoning
items.ex_en: Meteorologists predict heavy snowfall will blanket the mountainous regions by tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 气象学家预测明晨以前强降雪将覆盖山区。

items.def_en: to say what is likely to happen in the future, based on available information, models, or trends
items.ex_en: Economic models forecast a steady decline in unemployment rates over the next several months.
items.ex_zh: 经济模型预测未来几个月内失业率将稳步下降。

items.def_en: To prophesy or forecast future outcomes from present symptoms and analytical signs
items.ex_en: The clinical diagnostician hesitated to prognosticate the eventual outcome of the rare degenerative illness.
items.ex_zh: 临床诊断专家对这种罕见退行性疾病的最终走向持谨慎预断态度。

items.def_en: (+ to/from) To extend or project known data into an unknown area to deduce likely trends
items.ex_en: Researchers extrapolate long-term climate patterns from the historical ice core data they collected.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员根据收集到的历史冰芯数据外推预测长期的气候模式。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here signify extrapolating future occurrences, trends, or conditions using calculated models, analytical patterns, evidence, or professional expertise (such as weather, economic output, or demographics).
groups.summary_zh: 依托客观数据、科学模型、专业研判对未来趋势、气象或产出作出的理性预测。
groups.desc_en: Denotes predicting future trends, magnitudes, or developments by systematically evaluating empirical data and mathematical models, contrasting with fortune-telling or guessing through analytical methodology.
groups.desc_zh: 指依据经验数据、数理模型及逻辑推论对未来的发展趋势或规模进行系统性推演，与盲目猜测或算命不同，强调实证与分析方法。
groups.nuance_en: project: calculate future values by extending current statistical rates and parameters (growth / revenues / population) · predict: declare what will happen beforehand using evidence, logic, or intuition (outcome / earthquake / future) · forecast: scientifically anticipate impending conditions like weather or economic states (weather / sales / recession) · prognosticate: utter formal or medical deductions about the likely course of a condition (disease / trend / crisis) · extrapolate: estimate unknown future values by projecting known data trends outward (trends / results / data)
groups.nuance_zh: project: 依据当前统计参数向未来推算规模或走势 (growth / revenues / population) · predict: 运用证据、因果逻辑或直觉预言事态结果 (outcome / earthquake / future) · forecast: 依据精密气象或经济计量模型作出阶段性预报 (weather / sales / recession) · prognosticate: 对疾病病程、政经危机的未来走势进行专业预断 (disease / trend / crisis) · extrapolate: 基于已知的数据点和规律，向外推导未知区间的数据 (trends / results / data)

groups.name: Scoop & Gather · 舀取与拢抱 (Scoop up, Gather, Shovel)
groups.tip: 用长柄大勺捞取盛装

items.def_en: to bring together scattered things or draw them into one's arms or lap
items.ex_en: She gathered up her scattered papers and stuffed them into her briefcase.
items.ex_zh: 她收拾好散落的文件，塞进了公文包。

items.def_en: to quickly lift or gather someone or something up with a sweeping motion of arms or hands
items.ex_en: The loving mother rushed forward to scoop up her crying toddler into her warm embrace.
items.ex_zh: 慈爱的母亲快步上前，一把抱起哭泣的幼童搂入温暖的怀抱。

items.def_zh: （用勺等）舀，盛；快速捞起；抢先报道
items.def_en: 1. (+ out/up) to pick up, lift, or gather something using a scoop, spoon, or cupped hands 2. to publish a news story before competing journalists or news outlets
items.ex_en: He used a wooden ladle to scoop fragrant broth from the simmering soup kettle.
items.ex_zh: 他用木勺从慢炖的汤锅中舀出香气四溢的肉汤。

items.def_en: to lift, move, or clear away large quantities of earth, snow, or loose material using a shovel
items.ex_en: The tired homeowner spent all morning shoveling deep snow from the long driveway.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的房主花了一整个上午用铁锹清理长车道上的厚厚积雪。

items.def_en: to forcefully hollow out, scoop, or cut away material or flesh using a curved or pointed tool
items.ex_en: The craftsman used a sharp curved chisel to gouge out the center of the wooden bowl.
items.ex_zh: 工匠用锋利的弧形凿子将木碗的中心部分挖空。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers lifting, extracting, or gathering pliable, loose, or granular substances using a concave tool or cupped bodily limbs. It highlights sweeping concave motions directed outward or lifting upward in bulk.
groups.summary_zh: 指用凹面工具或双手兜起、拢聚并舀出松散物或物品。
groups.desc_en: Refers to gathering loose materials, fluids, or scattered small items using curved instruments or hands in a sweeping hollowed motion, contrasting with pinpoint picking by sweeping collective displacement.
groups.desc_zh: 指使用手掌、凹陷器皿或机械以抱拢、弧形舀挖的动作聚集散落物或流体，与精细捏取不同，强调以凹面容器进行大体积的拢聚或铲掘。
groups.nuance_en: gather up: sweep together dispersed objects into a collected bundle with hands (papers / belongings / children) · scoop up: quickly lift something off a surface with curved palms or a hollow tool (baby / prize / handful) · scoop: excavate or ladle out soft matter using a concave instrument (ice cream / water / hollow) · shovel: heave massive amounts of earth, snow, or bulk coal using an expansive flat spade (snow / coal / dirt) · gouge out: violently cut or scoop out deep grooves or materials with a curved sharp gouge (eyes / groove / wood)
groups.nuance_zh: gather up: 用手将分散四处的物品抱拢聚拢成堆 (papers / belongings / children) · scoop up: 用双手或凹形用具敏捷迅速地抄起或抱起 (baby / prize / handful) · scoop: 用勺子、铲子等凹面工具舀出或掏空松软物质 (ice cream / water / hollow) · shovel: 用铁锹大口大口地铲起并运送重度物料 (snow / coal / dirt) · gouge out: 用锋利或凹槽刃具凶狠地挖出或抠出深槽 (eyes / groove / wood)

groups.name: Scout & Reconnoiter · 侦察地形与踩点踏勘 (Scout, Case, Reconnoiter)
groups.tip: 暗中踩点调查周围环境

items.def_zh: （作案前）踩点，侦察探查；把……装入箱中
items.def_en: 1. (informal) to inspect or scout a place carefully, especially with the intention of robbing it. 2. to enclose or surround something in a case or container.
items.ex_en: The undercover detective watched the masked suspect carefully case the high-end jewelry store.
items.ex_zh: 便衣刑警注视着蒙面嫌疑人仔细踩点那家高档珠宝店。

items.def_en: to explore an area secretly or ahead of others to gather information about conditions or risks
items.ex_en: The vanguard was ordered to scout the dense forest for hidden enemy ambushes.
items.ex_zh: 先锋部队奉命前去密林深处侦察是否有隐匿的敌军伏击。

items.def_en: to keep a continuous, secretive watch on a building or place for suspicious activity
items.ex_en: Detectives decided to stake out the deserted warehouse throughout the entire rainy night.
items.ex_zh: 警探们决定冒雨彻夜在周围暗中盯梢那座废弃仓库。

items.def_en: to examine or look at something closely in order to evaluate its potential or situation
items.ex_en: We should scope out the neighborhood carefully before deciding to buy that old house.
items.ex_zh: 在决定买下那栋老房子之前，我们应该仔细打量查看一下周边的街区。

items.def_zh: 侦察，踏勘（军事或专业行动）
items.def_en: to make a military or strategic observation of an area to locate an enemy or evaluate terrain
items.ex_en: A small reconnaissance patrol moved forward to reconnoiter the hostile valley's rugged terrain.
items.ex_zh: 一支小型侦察巡逻队向前推进，去踏勘敌对山谷的险峻地形。

groups.summary_en: This frame involves covert, exploratory, or tactical surveillance of a target location or premise to gather intelligence prior to a military strike, crime, or expedition.
groups.summary_zh: 强调行动前对目标现场进行探查、踩点或战术侦察。
groups.desc_en: Describes conducting covert, preliminary visual examinations of geographical ground or premises before a military strike, crime, or commercial venture, contrasting with casual wandering through targeted surveillance.
groups.desc_zh: 指在实施军事行动、犯罪或开发之前，对特定地形、建筑或现场进行先遣勘测与隐秘踩点，与闲逛不同，强调目的明确的情报侦察。
groups.nuance_en: case: surreptitiously observe a building or location ahead of planned burglary or heist (bank / joint / house) · scout: explore an unfamiliar territory ahead to gather tactical information or spot prospects (terrain / talent / area) · stake out: keep a building or suspect under continuous secretive stationary surveillance (house / hideout / property) · scope out: thoroughly inspect or assess an unfamiliar scene or person before committing (competition / venue / crowd) · reconnoiter: conduct an official, formal military or scientific survey of an enemy zone or terrain (enemy lines / territory / coast)
groups.nuance_zh: case: 作案前对银行、住所等目标进行鬼祟的踩点侦查 (bank / joint / house) · scout: 深入前沿未拓区域刺探敌情、搜寻地形或发掘新人 (terrain / talent / area) · stake out: 对特定房屋或目标进行长时间暗中蹲守监视 (house / hideout / property) · scope out: 预先实地打量、摸底考察场地、对手或周边环境 (competition / venue / crowd) · reconnoiter: 执行正式的军事武装侦察，踏勘敌占区地形 (enemy lines / territory / coast)

groups.name: Scrabble & Grope Frantically · 仓促摸索与抓挠翻寻 (Scrabble, Fumble, Grope)
groups.tip: 手脚慌乱盲目抓挠摸索

items.def_en: Move hands or fingers clumsily while trying to find, hold, or manipulate an object
items.ex_en: She had to fumble awkwardly through her cluttered handbag to locate the car keys.
items.ex_zh: 她只得笨手笨脚地在杂乱的单肩包里乱翻以找出车钥匙。

items.def_en: Feel about blindly or hesitantly with the hands in search of something in the dark
items.ex_en: He began to grope cautiously along the pitch-black hallway seeking the bathroom light switch.
items.ex_zh: 他摸索着顺漆黑的走廊盲目摸寻，试图找到浴室的电灯开关。

items.def_zh: 盲目摸索，乱抓，扒寻；急忙攀爬
items.def_en: To scratch, claw, or grope frantically with the hands or paws to find or hold onto something.
items.ex_en: The stranded climber scrabbled wildly against the loose shale to prevent a fatal fall.
items.ex_zh: 受困的攀登者在松散的页岩上拼命乱抓，以防摔得粉身碎骨。

items.def_en: Scratch or dig violently with fingernails or paws in an effort to get hold of something
items.ex_en: The frightened kitten desperately clawed at the slippery porcelain rim of the deep bathtub.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的小猫拼命抓挠深浴缸光滑的瓷质边缘试图爬出。

items.def_en: Move, crawl, or struggle hurriedly and clumsily on hands and knees to reach or seize something
items.ex_en: The eager shoppers scrambled hurriedly across the floor to grab the limited discount items.
items.ex_zh: 急切的购物者们慌忙在商场地板间争夺抢占限量的折扣商品。

groups.summary_en: This physical action frame depicts frantic, clumsy, or desperate tactile searching, scratching, or pawing around blindly to locate an object or gain a physical handhold.
groups.summary_zh: 因慌乱或看不清而用双手盲目、抓挠式地摸索、搜寻抓握之物。
groups.desc_en: Captures chaotic, tactile clawing or clumsy manual search driven by frantic urgency, blindness, or panic, contrasting with calm methodical searching by desultory and desperate digital movements.
groups.desc_zh: 指在盲目、恐慌或极度紧迫的情绪驱动下，用手指仓促摸索、乱抓或翻扒，与从容系统的搜寻不同，强调手足无措的触觉挣扎感。
groups.nuance_en: fumble: drop things or handle clumsily due to trembling fingers, nervousness, or incompetence (keys / ball / wallet) · grope: feel about uncertainly with outstretched hands in darkness or blindness (in the dark / door / handle) · scrabble: frantically scrape and claw at dirt, gravel, or containers to find purchase or escape (gravel / dirt / pocket) · claw at: violently and desperately tear or rake fingernails across a surface (throat / door / earth) · scramble: make a disorderly, hurried, desperate physical rush or grab (up the bank / for the exit / for money)
groups.nuance_zh: fumble: 因手抖、紧张或笨拙而摸索时把物品弄掉、手忙脚乱 (keys / ball / wallet) · grope: 在黑暗或盲目状态下伸出双手盲目摸寻 (in the dark / door / handle) · scrabble: 用手指疯狂抓挠碎石、抽屉以寻找支点或物件 (gravel / dirt / pocket) · claw at: 绝望且撕扯性地用指甲猛抓、乱抠表面 (throat / door / earth) · scramble: 慌乱狼狈地手脚并用仓皇突击、争抢或突围 (up the bank / for the exit / for money)

groups.name: Scramble & Clamber · 艰难攀爬与手足并用攀登 (Scramble, Clamber, Claw)
groups.tip: 手脚并用费力向上攀爬

items.def_en: Climb to the top of a steep and tall surface like a cliff or a high wall
items.ex_en: The fearless mountaineers prepared their equipment to scale the sheer granite cliff face.
items.ex_zh: 无畏的登山队员备好装备，准备攀登陡峭的花岗岩悬崖绝壁。

items.def_zh: （手脚并用费力地）攀登，攀爬；争抢，抢占；仓促行动
items.def_en: 1. To climb or move quickly and with difficulty over rough ground using one's hands and feet. 2. (+ for) To compete hurriedly or aggressively with others for something.
items.ex_en: The hikers had to scramble up the steep, rocky slope using both hands.
items.ex_zh: 徒步旅行者们不得不手脚并用，费力攀爬上陡峭多石的斜坡。

items.def_zh: 攀附着向上爬（如抱树或抱杆）
items.def_en: Climb up or down quickly using both hands, arms, and legs to grip a pole or tree
items.ex_en: The adventurous boy quickly shinnied up the telephone pole to retrieve his lost kite.
items.ex_zh: 淘气的男孩敏捷地攀附抱爬上电线杆，取回他挂在上面的风筝。

items.def_en: Climb or crawl awkwardly and with difficulty, typically using both hands and feet
items.ex_en: The exhausted hikers had to clamber over massive granite boulders to reach the summit.
items.ex_zh: 筋疲力尽的徒步者们不得不手脚并用翻越巨大的花岗岩巨石以登顶。

items.def_en: Make one's way uphill or up an incline with great exertion by grasping at every handhold
items.ex_en: He had to claw his way up the muddy slope, grasping at exposed tree roots.
items.ex_zh: 他抓住裸露的树根，奋力手抓脚蹬地往泥泞的斜坡上爬。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here depict rough, awkward, or frantic climbing over steep, uneven terrain using both hands and feet, characterized by physical exertion and precarious balance.
groups.summary_zh: 指在陡峭坎坷地势上用手抠脚蹬、手足并用且略显费力的攀登。
groups.desc_en: Involves ascending steep, awkward, or precipitous heights using both hands and feet in rugged exertion, contrasting with effortless walking/marching through physically clumsy, tactile upward climbing.
groups.desc_zh: 指在陡峭、崎岖或坎坷的地形上手足并用、艰难费力地向上攀登，与平常步行或登山不同，强调姿态受限下的四肢协调与攀爬体能输出。
groups.nuance_en: scale: successfully climb up and over a formidable, sheer barrier or precipitous wall (wall / cliff / heights) · scramble: clamber hurriedly over rough, rocky slopes using hands for balance (up the slope / over rocks / up the hill) · shinny: climb quickly up a smooth vertical pole, rope, or tree by hugging with shins and thighs (up a tree / pole / mast) · clamber: awkward, clumsy climbing involving heavy, ungraceful labor of hands and knees (over rocks / aboard / into the truck) · claw one's way: advance upwards through brutal, inch-by-inch physical or social struggle (to the top / up the ridge / to success)
groups.nuance_zh: scale: 成功征服并翻越险峻垂直的悬崖、高墙或巅峰 (wall / cliff / heights) · scramble: 在陡峭乱石坡上手足并用地敏捷攀爬平衡 (up the slope / over rocks / up the hill) · shinny: 夹紧双腿双膝、抱着光秃树干或立柱快速哧溜攀援 (up a tree / pole / mast) · clamber: 笨手笨脚、略显狼狈地借助膝盖与双手费力爬上 (over rocks / aboard / into the truck) · claw one's way: 极其艰难、顽强而拼命地一寸寸攀升至高处 (to the top / up the ridge / to success)

groups.name: Scramble & Randomize · 打乱与混淆 (Jumble, Scramble, Shuffle)
groups.tip: 颠倒原有次序，使其毫无规律

items.def_en: To put things into the wrong order or confuse one thing with another
items.ex_en: Don't mix up the twin sisters' folders when you file their health records.
items.ex_zh: 归档这对双胞胎姐妹的健康档案时，千万别把文件夹搞混了。

items.def_en: To change the order of a set of items such as cards or files randomly
items.ex_en: Please shuffle the cards thoroughly before dealing them to the players at the table.
items.ex_zh: 发牌给桌上的玩家之前，请把牌彻底洗一下。

items.def_en: To alter the order or structure of something so it is mixed up or unintelligible
items.ex_en: A sudden software glitch scrambled the text messages into an unreadable string of symbols.
items.ex_zh: 突发的软件故障打乱了短信内容，使其变成了一串无法辨认的符号。

items.raw_cluster: 打乱与随机化 Scramble & Randomize
items.def_en: To arrange, choose, or organize items, numbers, or experimental subjects in an unpredictable and completely random order.
items.ex_en: The researchers will randomize the clinical trial participants into two distinct treatment groups.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员将把临床试验参与者随机分配到两个不同的治疗组。

items.def_en: To mix things together in a confused or disordered way
items.ex_en: The children managed to jumble all the puzzle pieces together in a cardboard box.
items.ex_zh: 孩子们把所有的拼图碎片乱糟糟地混杂在一个纸盒里。

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote disrupting an ordered state or systematic arrangement by mixing, shuffling, or encrypting items into a chaotic, arbitrary, or unpredictable sequence.
groups.summary_zh: 指打乱原有次序或组织，使其变得杂乱、随机或不可预测。
groups.desc_en: Involves disrupting an orderly arrangement, transmission sequence, or deck of components into an unpredictable, disordered state, contrasting with methodical ordering through disarranging chaos.
groups.desc_zh: 指破坏原有的顺序、结构或传输逻辑，使各个组成部分陷入随机混乱、不可解读的状态，与系统排序相对，强调秩序的人为打乱与混杂。
groups.nuance_en: mix up: mistakenly confuse identities, or stir different elements together erratically (names / signals / dates) · shuffle: rearrange the sequential order of flat cards, papers, or deck components (deck / cards / playlist) · scramble: purposefully encode communication signals into gibberish, or throw into chaos (radio signals / eggs / text) · randomize: statistically reorganize trials or inputs to eliminate bias or predictable pattern (order / sample / assignment) · jumble: toss diverse items together into an unsightly, uncoordinated heap of confusion (clothes / thoughts / letters)
groups.nuance_zh: mix up: 因疏忽混淆两者的身份认同，或胡乱掺和在一起 (names / signals / dates) · shuffle: 洗牌、调换纸张或播放列表的前后顺序 (deck / cards / playlist) · scramble: 对广播信号进行加密扰频，或将成分彻底搅碎乱置 (radio signals / eggs / text) · randomize: 依据统计学原则进行真随机化处理以消除偏差 (order / sample / assignment) · jumble: 把杂乱五花八门的东西乱糟糟地堆聚或混作一团 (clothes / thoughts / letters)

groups.name: Scream & Shriek · 尖叫与高声嘶吼 (Shriek, Screech, Yowl)
groups.tip: 从高声大喊到刺耳尖叫破音

items.def_zh: 发出粗厉尖叫；高声抱怨
items.def_en: To make a loud, harsh, discordant screech like an alarmed bird
items.ex_en: Customers began to squawk loudly when the airline canceled all remaining evening flights.
items.ex_zh: 当航空公司取消所有剩余的晚间航班时，乘客们开始大声抱怨。

items.def_zh: 尖叫，高声惊呼；发出尖厉呼啸声
items.def_en: 1. To give a loud, high-pitched cry or shout, especially because of fear, pain, or excitement. 2. To make a harsh, piercingly loud sound.
items.ex_en: The frightened girl started to scream loudly when lightning suddenly struck the oak tree.
items.ex_zh: 闪电突然击中那棵橡树时，受惊的女孩开始大声尖叫。

items.def_en: To utter words or a cry in a sudden, piercingly loud scream
items.ex_en: She screamed out in terror when the lights suddenly went out.
items.ex_zh: 灯突然熄灭时，她惊恐地尖叫出声。

items.def_zh: 发出刺耳尖啸声；尖声喊叫
items.def_en: To make a harsh, high-pitched strident cry or sound
items.ex_en: Brakes began to screech loudly as the driver swerved to avoid the stray dog.
items.ex_zh: 司机急转弯避让流浪狗时，刹车发出了刺耳的尖啸声。

items.def_en: To utter a high-pitched, piercing cry indicative of terror or acute pain
items.ex_en: She let out a piercing shriek when a giant spider landed on her shoulder.
items.ex_zh: 一只巨大的蜘蛛落在她肩上时，她发出了一声刺耳的尖叫。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve releasing piercing, high-frequency, extremely loud vocalizations driven by terror, acute pain, hysteria, or intense exhilaration.
groups.summary_zh: 指因极度恐惧、剧烈疼痛或亢奋而发出极高分贝、尖锐刺耳的喊叫。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the emission of extremely loud, high-pitched vocal or acoustic outbursts triggered by intense emotion or mechanical friction, contrasting with mere shouting or yelling by its piercing frequency and primal, involuntary quality.
groups.desc_zh: 指因强烈情绪爆发或机械摩擦而发出极度高亢、尖锐刺耳的叫声或噪音，与普通喊叫（shout/yell）相比，其特征在于音调极高、穿透力极强且常具本能失控性。
groups.nuance_en: squawk: harsh, raspy, indignantly loud protest or bird cry (bird / protester / chicken) · scream: loud, piercing, sustained cry of terror or pain (victim / child / fan) · scream out: eruptive, directional vocalization venting sudden distress (warning / agony / name) · screech: sharp, strident, scraping high-pitch noise or yell (brakes / tires / owl) · shriek: acutely shrill, momentary scream of terror or hysterical laughter (terror / laughter / wind)
groups.nuance_zh: squawk: 粗哑刺耳的抗议声或禽鸟呱叫 (bird / protester / chicken) · scream: 恐惧或剧痛引发的高亢持久尖叫 (victim / child / fan) · scream out: 爆发性呼喊以宣泄急痛或示警 (warning / agony / name) · screech: 刺耳尖刮的摩擦声或锐叫 (brakes / tires / owl) · shriek: 极高亢锐利、近乎歇斯底里的短促惊呼 (terror / laughter / wind)

groups.name: Scrimp & Stint · 节约与克扣 (Scrimp, Skimp, Pinch)
groups.tip: 极度节省甚至克扣用度

items.def_en: to be excessively careful about spending small amounts of money
items.ex_en: My grandparents always pinch pennies to ensure their modest pension lasts through every winter.
items.ex_zh: 我祖父母总是精打细算，以确保他们微薄的养老金能撑过每个冬天。

items.def_en: to manage to spend less money and endure economic hardship
items.ex_en: Rising rent forced the young couple to tighten their belts and cut dining out.
items.ex_zh: 房租上涨迫使这对年轻夫妇勒紧裤腰带，减少了外出就餐。

items.def_en: (+ on) to be frugal or sparing with something, especially by withholding or limiting the amount given or used
items.ex_en: The chef refused to stint on fresh herbs despite rising ingredient prices this season.
items.ex_zh: 尽管本季食材价格上涨，这位大厨仍拒绝在新鲜香草上克扣节约。

items.def_zh: 克扣，敷衍，省掉不该省的
items.def_en: (+ on) to spend too little money, time, or care on something, producing an inadequate result
items.ex_en: Builders should never skimp on safety equipment just to meet a tight construction deadline.
items.ex_zh: 施工方绝不能仅仅为了赶工期就在安全设备上偷工减料。

items.def_en: (+ on) to spend very little money on the necessities of life in order to save
items.ex_en: They had to scrimp on groceries for months to pay their daughter's tuition.
items.ex_zh: 为了支付女儿的学费，他们好几个月都在日常伙食上极度省钱。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe providing or spending as little money, food, or resources as possible, often borderlining on deprivation, miserliness, or excessive frugality. They often take prepositions like 'on'.
groups.summary_zh: 强调过度省吃俭用、极力缩减开支或克扣资源的节约与吝啬行为。
groups.desc_en: Centers on severe restriction of spending, consumption, or allocation of resources to survive on a tight budget, contrasting with neutral saving or economizing by its sense of painful privation, inadequacy, or deliberate shortchanging.
groups.desc_zh: 指在极度拮据下对开支、消费或资源分配进行的严苛限制，与中性的“节约（save/economize）”相比，带有明显的捉襟见肘、克扣削减甚至自讨苦吃的紧缩色彩。
groups.nuance_en: pinch pennies: obsessively minimize minor living expenses (shopper / miser / pensioner) · tighten one's belt: endure collective, austere spending cuts (government / family / household) · stint: withhold adequate provision or be begrudgingly frugal (food / care / praise) · skimp: cut corners or provide inferior, insufficient amounts (ingredients / quality / resources) · scrimp: live in severe personal hardship by extreme frugality (pension / wages / savings)
groups.nuance_zh: pinch pennies: 锱铢必较地抠减微小开支 (shopper / miser / pensioner) · tighten one's belt: 勒紧裤带应对整体生计紧缩 (government / family / household) · stint: 吝啬克扣、不舍得充分给予 (food / care / praise) · skimp: 偷工减料或投入不足以致品质受损 (ingredients / quality / resources) · scrimp: 极为节衣缩食、省吃俭用以维生 (pension / wages / savings)

groups.name: Scrub & Scour · 用力刷洗与擦刮 (Scrub, Scour, Rub)
groups.tip: 用力擦洗刷除顽固污渍

items.def_en: To clean, smooth, or dry a surface thoroughly by rubbing it firmly with a cloth or abrasive.
items.ex_en: He used a dry microfiber cloth to rub down the newly sanded wooden banister.
items.ex_zh: 他用一块干燥的超细纤维布彻底擦拭了新打磨好的木楼梯扶手。

items.def_en: To remove dirt, paint, or residue from a surface by dragging an edge or hard tool firmly across it.
items.ex_en: You need to scrape the peeling paint off the wooden fence before applying primer.
items.ex_zh: 在涂刷底漆之前，你需要把木栅栏上剥落的油漆刮掉。

items.def_zh: 用力擦洗，刷洗；取消（计划等）
items.def_en: 1. To clean a surface thoroughly by rubbing hard with a brush, soap, and water. 2. (informal) To cancel or abandon a planned event or idea.
items.ex_en: She had to scrub the greasy kitchen floor with hot soapy water after dinner.
items.ex_zh: 晚餐后，她不得不着用热肥皂水用力擦洗油腻的厨房地板。

items.def_en: To scrape away or wear down a surface layer by friction, sanding, or mechanical action.
items.ex_en: Blowing desert sand can severely abrade the protective coating on solar panels over time.
items.ex_zh: 随着时间的推移，刮起的沙漠风沙会严重磨蚀太阳能电池板的保护涂层。

items.def_zh: 用力擦洗；刮洗（锅、地板等）
items.def_en: To clean or brighten a hard surface thoroughly by rubbing it vigorously with an abrasive agent or rough pad.
items.ex_en: He used a steel wool pad to scour the burnt residue from the skillet.
items.ex_zh: 他用钢丝球用力刷洗煎锅上的烧焦残留物。

groups.summary_en: This frame represents forceful, abrasive cleaning by vigorously applying pressure and friction with an implement, wire pad, or bristled brush to remove stubborn grime, grease, or dirt.
groups.summary_zh: 使用刷子或研磨物施加重压与摩擦，以清除顽固污渍或硬壳。
groups.desc_en: Involves energetic, abrasive friction applied to a solid surface to eliminate stubborn dirt, coating, or matter, contrasting with gentle washing or wiping through its aggressive mechanical force and abrasive intent.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过强力的摩擦、刮削或研磨来去除固体表面顽垢或覆盖层，与温和的冲洗或擦拭（wash/wipe）相比，强调施加机械暴力的硬性清洁与磨蚀手段。
groups.nuance_en: rub down: briskly massage or wipe dry/smooth with pressure (horse / woodwork / athlete) · scrape: remove an outer layer using a sharp or rigid edge (paint / rust / ice) · scrub: vigorously clean with a stiff brush and liquid (floor / hands / deck) · abrade: wear away or damage an outer surface through sustained friction (skin / rock / coating) · scour: deeply clean encrusted grime using harsh abrasive force (pots / pans / surface)
groups.nuance_zh: rub down: 用力擦拭、擦干或抹平 (horse / woodwork / athlete) · scrape: 用利器或硬物刮除表层附着物 (paint / rust / ice) · scrub: 用硬刷和清洁液用力刷洗 (floor / hands / deck) · abrade: 摩擦导致机械性磨损或擦伤 (skin / rock / coating) · scour: 使用强力研磨剂彻底刮洗顽固焦垢 (pots / pans / surface)

groups.name: Sculpt & Carve · 雕刻与塑形 (Carve, Chisel, Mold)
groups.tip: 刀刻泥塑塑造立体形象

items.def_en: to shape a soft, malleable substance or pour liquid into a frame to set
items.ex_en: The sculptor took soft clay to mold the delicate contours of the child's face.
items.ex_zh: 雕塑家用柔软的黏土塑造出孩子面部的精致轮廓。

items.def_en: to carve an object by repeatedly slicing thin shavings off a piece of wood
items.ex_en: The grandfather loved to whittle pine branches into small wooden whistles for the kids.
items.ex_zh: 祖父喜欢把松树枝削成小木哨送给孩子们。

items.def_en: to shape a solid material such as wood or stone by cutting parts away
items.ex_en: Local artisans patiently carve intricate floral patterns into blocks of native white limestone.
items.ex_zh: 当地工匠耐心地在本土白色石灰岩块上雕刻复杂的植物图案。

items.def_zh: 雕刻，塑造；使具有特定外形
items.def_en: 1. to create a three-dimensional figure or object by carving or shaping material. 2. to shape or form something carefully to give it a particular contour
items.ex_en: The artist labored for three months to sculpt a lifelike lion from marble.
items.ex_zh: 这位艺术家辛勤劳作了三个月，用大理石雕刻出一只栩栩如生的狮子。

items.def_en: to cut or shape stone, wood, or metal with a sharp-edged tool called a chisel
items.ex_en: The mason had to chisel the rough edges of each stone before building the wall.
items.ex_zh: 砌砖工在砌墙之前，必须用凿子修平每块石头的粗糙边缘。

groups.summary_en: Verbs of physical creation and form modification involving cutting, chiseling, molding, or modeling materials into distinct three-dimensional artistic forms.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过雕、凿、塑等手法赋予材料三维艺术形态或外形轮廓。
groups.desc_en: Covers the intentional three-dimensional shaping of malleable or rigid materials into art or functional objects, differing from generic manufacturing by its reliance on artisanal shaping, subtractive reduction, or additive molding.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过切削减料或塑压增料等手工技艺，将刚性或可塑材料塑造成立体形态或艺术品，与一般机械制造相比，突显工匠式的成形微差与具象雕琢。
groups.nuance_en: mold: shape malleable, yielding substances into a specific form or cast (clay / plastic / opinion) · whittle: incrementally slice small shavings from wood using a knife (stick / wood / figure) · carve: cut solid matter deeply to produce shapes, lettering, or food portions (meat / stone / wood) · sculpt: artistically fashion a three-dimensional figure from diverse media (statue / bust / physique) · chisel: cut, chip, or carve with a hard bevel-edged tool (marble / stone / feature)
groups.nuance_zh: mold: 将可塑性物质注入模具或捏塑定型 (clay / plastic / opinion) · whittle: 用小刀由表及里逐层削剥木块 (stick / wood / figure) · carve: 对坚硬材料做大幅度切割或雕刻 (meat / stone / wood) · sculpt: 艺术化地塑造或精雕立体三维造型 (statue / bust / physique) · chisel: 用凿子刻凿坚硬石木或雕凿线条 (marble / stone / feature)

groups.name: Seal & Close Hermetically · 密封与封闭 (Caulk, Fasten, Waterproof)
groups.tip: 严密关紧以防气体液体漏出

items.def_zh: 封上，密封；盖印确认；确定
items.def_en: 1. To close an entrance or container securely to prevent entry or escape of gas, liquid, or people. 2. To make an agreement or decision official, final, or certain.
items.ex_en: Make sure to seal the storage container tightly to prevent moisture from ruining the tea.
items.ex_zh: 务必将储藏容器密封好，以防潮气毁掉茶叶。

items.def_en: To prevent people from entering or leaving an area or building by placing barriers across all access points
items.ex_en: Armed guards sealed off the street following the security alert.
items.ex_zh: 安全警报拉响后，武装警卫封锁了整条街道。

items.def_en: To make an enclosure completely airtight and impervious to external gases or fluids
items.ex_en: Technicians must hermetically seal the sample chamber to avoid contamination from atmospheric moisture.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员必须对样品室进行完全气密密封，以避免受到大气湿气的污染。

items.def_en: To fill the crevices between tiles or masonry stones with a thin, hardening mortar
items.ex_en: After laying the marble tiles, the contractor began to grout the narrow floor joints.
items.ex_zh: 铺好大理石地砖后，承包商开始用浆料填平狭窄的地板接缝。

items.def_en: To fill the seams, joints, or cracks in a structure with a waterproof sealant
items.ex_en: You should caulk the gaps around the bathtub to prevent water leaking through walls.
items.ex_zh: 你应该给浴缸周围的缝隙打胶密封，以防止水渗漏到墙壁内。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe securing containers, seams, or openings tightly so as to render them completely impermeable to air, moisture, contaminants, or intrusion.
groups.summary_zh: 通过涂胶、嵌缝等物理手段使容器或开口严密不漏气、不渗水。
groups.desc_en: Involves making an opening, joint, or container impervious to air, moisture, or unauthorized entry, differing from merely closing or locking by establishing an airtight, watertight, or physical barrier.
groups.desc_zh: 指填堵缝隙或施加防护层以彻底阻绝气体、液体或物理侵入，与普通的“关闭（close）”或“锁闭（lock）”相比，强调达到气密、水密或物理隔离的严封状态。
groups.nuance_en: seal: fasten securely or make impervious to fluids/air (envelope / deal / container) · seal off: cordon off or isolate an area to prevent passage (crime scene / border / leak) · hermetically seal: make completely airtight and impervious to atmosphere (capsule / chamber / tomb) · grout: fill tile crevices or masonry gaps with fluid mortar (tiles / joints / floor) · caulk: fill seams and cracks with waterproof compound to stop leaks (tub / boat / window)
groups.nuance_zh: seal: 严密闭合使其不漏气水或盖印封口 (envelope / deal / container) · seal off: 封锁隔离特定区域以防出入 (crime scene / border / leak) · hermetically seal: 达到绝对隔绝气体的密封状态 (capsule / chamber / tomb) · grout: 用灌浆填补瓷砖或石材缝隙 (tiles / joints / floor) · caulk: 用填缝胶填塞接缝以防水防风 (tub / boat / window)

groups.name: Search & Frisk · 搜查与搜身 (Pat down, Shake down, Rummage)
groups.tip: 执法人员对身体物品搜查

items.def_en: To search someone for weapons or illegal goods by running one's hands over the outside of their clothing
items.ex_en: Security guards pat down every fan entering the arena to search for concealed contraband.
items.ex_zh: 保安对进入场馆的每位球迷进行拍身搜查，以查找夹带的违禁品。

items.def_en: To carry out an intensive, disruptive search of someone or their quarters for concealed items
items.ex_en: Prison guards conducted a surprise operation to shake down the entire block for contraband.
items.ex_zh: 狱警展开了一次突击行动，彻底搜查整个监区以寻找违禁品。

items.def_en: To search someone for concealed items after requiring them to take off all their clothes
items.ex_en: Customs officers were authorized to strip-search the suspect after narcotics dogs signaled positive alerts.
items.ex_zh: 缉毒犬示警后，海关官员获准对嫌疑人进行脱衣搜身。

items.def_en: 1. To pass hands quickly over someone's body and clothes to search for concealed weapons or illegal items. 2. To leap or skip playfully.
items.ex_en: Young lambs frisk playfully across the lush green meadow under the morning sun.
items.ex_zh: 在清晨的阳光下，小羊羔在郁郁葱葱的绿草地上欢跃玩耍。

items.def_en: To search thoroughly and messily through a person's pockets, bags, or belongings
items.ex_en: She had to rummage through her overloaded backpack to find the missing car keys.
items.ex_zh: 她不得不翻寻自己塞得过满的双肩包以寻找遗失的车钥匙。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe physical searches of a person's body, clothing, or personal premises to detect concealed weapons, contraband, or hidden evidence. Nuances span lawful police procedures to aggressive street-level inspections.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及对人体、衣物或私密处所进行摸查翻找以查获违禁品或证物。
groups.desc_en: Depicts an invasive physical examination of a person's body, clothing, or surroundings to discover concealed contraband or weapons, contrasting with casual looking by its coercive, intrusive, and security-driven nature.
groups.desc_zh: 指为搜寻违禁品、武器或赃物而对人体、衣物或私密空间展开的强制性翻查，与中性的“寻找（search）”相比，带有高度侵入性、治安管制与胁迫色彩。
groups.nuance_en: pat down: feel a person's clothed body for hidden weapons or objects (suspect / passenger / detainee) · shake down: aggressively search a place or person, often extorting money (cell / prisoner / business) · strip-search: remove all clothing for exhaustive physical inspection (inmate / suspect / arrestee) · frisk: swiftly pass hands over an individual's outer clothing to check for weapons (suspect / officer / pedestrian) · rummage: search untidily and thoroughly by moving things about (drawers / bag / attic)
groups.nuance_zh: pat down: 拍触搜查被检者衣物表面以探查异物 (suspect / passenger / detainee) · shake down: 监所搜身清查或敲诈勒索式全面搜寻 (cell / prisoner / business) · strip-search: 强制脱光衣服进行彻底肉体搜查 (inmate / suspect / arrestee) · frisk: 快速搜检嫌疑人全身外部衣物防携暗器 (suspect / officer / pedestrian) · rummage: 乱翻翻找杂乱容器或角落 (drawers / bag / attic)

groups.name: Search & Navigate Electronically · 电子查图与定位导航 (Map, Navigate, Look Up)
groups.tip: 搜寻路径方位并锁定具体坐标

items.def_zh: 用谷歌搜索（地点或信息）
items.def_en: Search for information, locations, or directions about someone or something on the internet using a search engine
items.ex_en: I need to google the nearest pharmacy to see if it stays open late.
items.ex_zh: 我得用谷歌搜一下最近的药店，看看它是否开到很晚。

items.def_zh: 在网络地图上查询路线，网上定位导航
items.def_en: (informal) To search for driving directions, maps, or locations using an online mapping service.
items.ex_en: Before leaving town, we should mapquest driving directions to avoid heavy highway construction.
items.ex_zh: 出发离开城市前，我们应该在网上查好行车路线，以避开繁重的公路施工。

items.def_zh: 在地图上标出（路径或点位）
items.def_en: Mark positions, coordinates, or an intended course carefully on a digital or paper map
items.ex_en: The captain sat down to plot out their maritime route on the navigation chart.
items.ex_zh: 船长坐下来，在航海图上标出他们的航行路线。

items.def_en: Direct or follow a course toward a destination using electronic maps, GPS, or nautical compasses
items.ex_en: Modern drivers rely heavily on satellite maps to navigate unfamiliar downtown streets smoothly.
items.ex_zh: 现代司机非常依赖卫星地图来顺利导航陌生市区的街道。

items.def_zh: 精准定位；确认精确位置
items.def_en: Find or identify the exact location, place, or time of something with complete precision
items.ex_en: Rescue teams used thermal drones to pinpoint the exact location of the stranded climber.
items.ex_zh: 救援队利用热成像无人机精准定位了受困登山者的确切位置。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this modern pragmatic frame refer to searching, locating coordinates, and charting routes or geographical destinations using digital tools, internet search systems, or navigational services.
groups.summary_zh: 使用电子地图、数字终端或搜索引擎查询路线、地点及地理坐标。
groups.desc_en: Specifies locating geospatial coordinates, plotting routes, or querying digital spatial data via technology, contrasting with traditional map-reading or wandering by its algorithmic computation and instant electronic precision.
groups.desc_zh: 指利用电子设备、算法系统或数字地图进行空间检索、坐标锁定与路线规划，与传统看地图或盲目寻路相比，强调算法化定位与即时数字指引。
groups.nuance_en: google: query a search engine to locate web information or place data (address / restaurant / symptoms) · mapquest: plot driving directions electronically using legacy web mapping tools (route / directions / trip) · plot out: systematically chart an intended journey or plan on a map (course / itinerary / strategy) · navigate: steer or follow an electronically guided path through complex terrain (traffic / streets / terrain) · pinpoint: identify the exact geographic location or time with utmost precision (location / coordinates / problem)
groups.nuance_zh: google: 在线检索特定地理信息或地点资料 (address / restaurant / symptoms) · mapquest: 利用电子地图规划行车路线 (route / directions / trip) · plot out: 在图上精确标注勾勒路线规划 (course / itinerary / strategy) · navigate: 依循导航系统指引穿越复杂路况 (traffic / streets / terrain) · pinpoint: 以极高精确度定位坐标或核心点 (location / coordinates / problem)

groups.name: Season & Flavor · 调味与赋香 (Season, Flavor, Spice)
groups.tip: 烹饪中增添风味或熟成

items.def_zh: 给……调味，加调料于；风干，晒干（木材）；使成熟，使历练
items.def_en: 1. (+ with) To add salt, herbs, or spices to food to enhance its flavor. 2. To dry wood or timber to condition it for use. 3. To render someone experienced through long practice.
items.ex_en: Remember to season the chicken breast with coarse salt and black pepper before grilling.
items.ex_zh: 烧烤前记得用粗盐和黑胡椒给鸡胸肉调味。

items.def_en: To season food by adding salt to heighten flavor or to preserve it
items.ex_en: You should salt the simmering pasta water generously before dropping in the noodles.
items.ex_zh: 在把面条下锅之前，你应该往微沸的水里多放点盐调味。

items.def_en: (+ with) To give a particular taste to food or drink by adding an ingredient or flavoring agent
items.ex_en: The pastry chef likes to flavor the rich custard base with fresh vanilla pods.
items.ex_zh: 这位面点师喜欢用新鲜香草荚给浓郁的卡仕达基底增添风味。

items.def_zh: 加调料增添风味；使更振奋
items.def_en: To make food tastier or more pungent by adding zesty seasonings, or to add vigor to something
items.ex_en: A dash of hot chili sauce will quickly pep up this rather bland stew.
items.ex_zh: 少许辣椒酱能迅速让这道略显寡淡的炖菜增添风味。

items.def_en: (+ with / + up) To season food with aromatic spices to give it piquancy and warmth
items.ex_en: She decided to spice the holiday apple cider with crushed cloves and cinnamon sticks.
items.ex_zh: 她决定用丁香碎和肉桂棒给节日苹果酒加香料调味。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame deal with culinary manipulation through salt, herbs, spices, or condiments to elevate base flavors, balance taste profiles, and produce nuanced culinary depth.
groups.summary_zh: 指在烹饪中加入食盐、香草或香料，以去腥提鲜、赋予风味层次。
groups.desc_en: Involves enhancing, modifying, or enlivening the taste profile of food or experiences through additives, differing from cooking or preparing by focusing specifically on balancing and heightening sensory palate stimulation.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过添加佐料、香料或调味剂来提升食物或经历的滋味与层次，与一般烹调（cook/prepare）相比，核心落在对风味、口感与感官刺激的精细调制。
groups.nuance_en: season: enhance natural taste by adding salt, herbs, or pepper (dish / soup / meat) · salt: add sodium chloride to preserve, cure, or flavor food (water / meat / fries) · flavor: impart a distinctive sensory character using an essence or agent (sauce / ice cream / coffee) · pep up: enliven or make something mundane more zestful and energetic (dish / presentation / speech) · spice: add pungent or aromatic seasonings to impart heat and complexity (curry / wine / story)
groups.nuance_zh: season: 撒入盐或香草以调和提升料理本味 (dish / soup / meat) · salt: 撒盐调味、腌渍或提味 (water / meat / fries) · flavor: 赋予特定风味或人工香精赋味 (sauce / ice cream / coffee) · pep up: 注入活力或调味以使乏味之物生色 (dish / presentation / speech) · spice: 加入辛香料增加辛辣度或复杂趣味 (curry / wine / story)

groups.name: Secede & Splinter · 脱离与分裂 (Break away, Splinter, Secede)
groups.tip: 地方脱离联邦导致阵营分裂

items.def_en: To separate a subsidiary part or business department from a larger corporate entity
items.ex_en: The conglomerate decided to hive off its retail division to pay down corporate debt.
items.ex_zh: 该企业集团决定剥离其零售部门，以偿还公司债务。

items.def_en: (+ from) To separate from an established group, state, or organization to form an independent unit
items.ex_en: Several dissident delegates chose to break away from the main coalition over tax reforms.
items.ex_zh: 几位持不同政见的代表因税改问题选择脱离主要执政联盟。

items.def_en: To separate from a larger mass, organization, or body to form a distinct entity
items.ex_en: A small faction split off from the main party to form a new coalition.
items.ex_zh: 一个小派系从主要政党中脱离出来，成立了一个新的联盟。

items.def_en: To divide or cause an organization to split into smaller, conflicting factions
items.ex_en: Internal disputes caused the environmental coalition to splinter into several smaller rival factions.
items.ex_zh: 内部纷争导致该环保联盟分裂成几个互相对立的小派系。
