items.ex2_en: The dry wooden plank splintered completely under the sudden impact of the heavy hammer.
items.ex2_zh: 干燥的木板在沉重锤子的突然撞击下彻底碎裂成了碎片。

items.def_zh: 正式脱离，退出（联邦、组织等）
items.def_en: (+ from) to formally break away from a country, federation, or political organization in order to become independent
items.ex_en: The southern province voted overwhelmingly to secede from the national federation last autumn.
items.ex_zh: 去年秋天，南部省份以压倒性多数投票决定正式脱离国家联邦。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the formal, ideological, or organizational severance where a faction, region, or subsidiary separates from a parent entity to become autonomous or fragmented.
groups.summary_zh: 指派系、地区或团体自母体正式分离、独立或分裂解体。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the formal or fractious breaking away of a faction, region, or subsidiary from a larger entity, contrasting with ordinary physical detachment by its political, ideological, or institutional fragmentation.
groups.desc_zh: 指派系、区域或分支机构脱离原所属母体，与普通的物理分离（separate）相比，具有明确的政治独立、意识形态决裂或组织架构解体特征。
groups.nuance_en: hive off: spin off or reallocate a non-core commercial division into an independent entity (subsidiary / business / assets) · break away: escape physical or organizational control through decisive rupture (faction / cyclist / pack) · split off: branch away from a main group to pursue a divergent direction (coalition / branch / group) · splinter: disintegrate uncontrollably into tiny, warring antagonistic fragments (party / movement / union) · secede: formally withdraw membership from a federation, church, or sovereign state (state / province / republic)
groups.nuance_zh: hive off: 分拆非核心资产或子公司使其独立运营 (subsidiary / business / assets) · break away: 决绝挣脱旧有控制或大队脱颖而出 (faction / cyclist / pack) · split off: 另立门户、自母体脱离分化 (coalition / branch / group) · splinter: 组织四分五裂、化为零散对抗派系 (party / movement / union) · secede: 地方政府或加盟邦正式合法脱离联邦 (state / province / republic)

groups.name: Seclude & Cloister · 隐遁与深居 (Seclude, Retire, Shut away)
groups.tip: 遁入深闺空门或与世俗隔绝

items.def_en: (+ to) to withdraw to a quiet, private place away from company
items.ex_en: After dinner, the weary host decided to retire to the quiet library upstairs.
items.ex_zh: 晚饭后，疲惫的主人决定退避到楼上安静的书房中休息。

items.def_en: to confine someone or keep oneself isolated from contact with other people
items.ex_en: Grief caused the reclusive poet to shut himself away from society for years.
items.ex_zh: 悲痛致使这位隐居的诗人多年来将自己关起来与社会隔绝。

items.def_en: to hide or stay in a safe, secluded place for an extended period
items.ex_en: The wanted fugitive chose to hole up in an abandoned cabin during winter.
items.ex_zh: 这名被通缉的逃犯选择在冬天躲藏在一间废弃的木屋里。

items.def_en: to keep someone or oneself away from other people in a private, quiet place
items.ex_en: The author prefers to seclude herself in a mountain cottage while drafting novels.
items.ex_zh: 这位作家在起草小说时喜欢把自己隔离在一座山间小屋中独处。

items.def_zh: 使与尘世隔绝，使幽居，使遁入修道院
items.def_en: (often passive) to shut someone away in a quiet, secluded place away from the outside world
items.ex_en: The young princess was cloistered away from worldly vices inside the royal sanctuary.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的公主被幽居在皇家修道院内，与尘世的罪恶彻底隔绝。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on withdrawing oneself or confining someone to a remote, solitary, or monastic environment away from worldly bustle and public scrutiny.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动隐遁或幽闭于偏远、幽静之处，远离尘世纷扰。
groups.desc_en: Involves retreating into profound isolation away from societal contact, differing from mere solitude or staying indoors by its deliberate, protective, or monastic withdrawal from the public sphere.
groups.desc_zh: 指主动或被动退出世俗社交，隐遁入幽闭隔绝的空间，与普通的独处（be alone）相比，强调带有遁世、避祸、修行或自我保护性质的深居屏迹。
groups.nuance_en: retire: withdraw to a quiet, secluded place for rest, privacy, or sleep (room / country / study) · shut away: confine or hide someone or oneself far from public exposure (herself / attic / prisoner) · hole up: hide oneself in a fortified or remote shelter to evade trouble (cabin / hotel / hideout) · seclude: keep oneself or others sheltered apart from company or disruption (oneself / valley / estate) · cloister: confine someone within strict religious or monastic isolation (nun / scholar / mind)
groups.nuance_zh: retire: 离席退避至幽静私密处休息或就寝 (room / country / study) · shut away: 将某人或自己闭门深锁以与世隔绝 (herself / attic / prisoner) · hole up: 躲入隐蔽防卫处所避难或避风头 (cabin / hotel / hideout) · seclude: 使离群索居、幽居于不受干扰之境 (oneself / valley / estate) · cloister: 遁入修道院式彻底隔绝尘世的环境 (nun / scholar / mind)

groups.name: Sedate & Tranquilize · 镇静与麻醉 (Sedate, Anesthetize, Dope)
groups.tip: 用药使人镇静安定麻木

items.def_zh: 用药物使昏睡；麻醉过去
items.def_en: To cause a patient or animal to lose consciousness or fall into a deep drug-induced sleep
items.ex_en: Our team was knocked out of the tournament in the quarter-finals.
items.ex_zh: 我们队在四分之一决赛中被淘汰出局。

items.def_en: (also 'dope up') To give drugs to a person or animal to calm them, render them unconscious, or alter performance
items.ex_en: The nervous horse had to be doped up before boarding the cargo plane.
items.ex_zh: 这匹焦躁的马在登上货运飞机前必须打麻醉药让其镇静。

items.def_en: To calm someone down or make them sleepy by administering a medical sedative
items.ex_en: The physician had to sedate the agitated patient before performing the diagnostic scan.
items.ex_zh: 在进行诊断扫描之前，医生不得不给烦躁不安的患者使用镇静剂。

items.def_en: To administer an anesthetic to render a patient temporarily unable to feel pain or consciousness
items.ex_en: The surgeon will anesthetize the injured athlete locally before stitching the deep wound.
items.ex_zh: 在缝合深层伤口之前，外科医生将对受伤的运动员进行局部麻醉。

items.def_zh: 使镇定，使镇静（尤指通过药物）
items.def_en: 1. To make a person or animal calm, sleepy, or unconscious by administering a sedative drug.
items.ex_en: Park rangers had to tranquilize the stray bear before moving it safely away.
items.ex_zh: 公园巡逻员必须先用药物麻醉这只迷路的熊，然后才能安全将其移走。

items.def_zh: 用镇静药或毒品麻醉（某人）
items.def_en: (+ sb) to administer heavy sedatives, narcotics, or drugs to dull someone's senses
items.ex_en: The illicit gang tried to dope up the guard with a sleeping potion.
items.ex_zh: 这帮不法分子企图用安眠药将警卫麻醉倒。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to administering pharmacological agents to calm agitation, induce sleep, relieve pain, or render a patient or animal insensible. Nuances range from mild anxiolysis to total chemical immobilization.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过药物使人或动物镇定、入睡或失去知觉与行动力。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on inducing physical tranquility, insensibility, or unconsciousness through chemical agents, contrasting with non-pharmacological calming by its reliance on medical depressants, anesthetics, or intoxicating substances.
groups.desc_zh: 指使用药物或化学制剂诱导生理镇静、麻木或丧失知觉，与一般的精神抚慰（calm/soothe）相比，核心在于依赖镇静剂、麻醉剂或精神类药物的药理控制。
groups.nuance_en: knock out: render unconscious rapidly through chemical dosage or physical trauma (patient / boxer / tooth) · dope: administer drugs illicitly or heavily to dull senses or alter performance (racehorse / athlete / drink) · sedate: administer clinical sedatives to alleviate extreme anxiety or agitation (patient / animal / child) · anesthetize: medically eliminate all pain and sensation, inducing insensibility during surgery (patient / limb / area) · tranquilize: subdue dangerous, agitated animals or violent patients using neuroleptics (tiger / inmate / beast)
groups.nuance_zh: knock out: 快速施药或重击使之失去知觉昏睡 (patient / boxer / tooth) · dope: 喂食毒品或兴奋剂以麻痹神经或改变状态 (racehorse / athlete / drink) · sedate: 给予医用镇静剂平息焦躁或躁动 (patient / animal / child) · anesthetize: 施以麻醉剂完全阻断痛觉或神志 (patient / limb / area) · tranquilize: 用镇定枪或强效安定剂压制狂暴人畜 (tiger / inmate / beast)

groups.name: Seem & Appear · 表象与显得 (Appear, Look, Strike)
groups.tip: 感官接收到的外部表象

items.def_en: to give a specific visual impression or indicate a certain state by appearance
items.ex_en: Those dark storm clouds look very threatening as they roll over the hills.
items.ex_zh: 那些翻卷过山丘的乌云看起来非常吓人。

items.def_en: to give the impression of being or having a particular quality; to appear
items.ex_en: The committee members seem quite willing to approve the proposed environmental budget revisions.
items.ex_zh: 委员会成员们似乎非常愿意批准拟议的环境预算修正案。

items.def_en: to convey a particular impression when heard or described
items.ex_en: Her innovative proposals for improving office efficiency sound very promising to the executives.
items.ex_zh: 她关于提高办公室效率的创新提议在主管们听来非常有前景。
items.ex2_en: The watchman sounded the alarm when he spotted smoke rising from the warehouse.
items.ex2_zh: 值班人员发现仓库冒烟时，立即拉响了警报。

items.def_en: to give the impression of being or doing something, based on visible evidence
items.ex_en: The historic buildings appear structurally stable despite enduring several minor earthquakes this decade.
items.ex_zh: 尽管近十年经历了多次轻微地震，这些历史建筑看起来结构依然稳固。

items.def_en: to produce a particular mental impression or opinion upon someone
items.ex_en: His bizarre behavioral quirks did not strike anyone as unusual in that office.
items.ex_zh: 他怪异的行为癖好在那个办公室里并没有让任何人觉得不正常。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures verbs describing the impression an entity makes on an observer's senses or mind, conveying subjective appearances that may or may not reflect reality.
groups.summary_zh: 指事物或人在感官与心智中呈现的表象、印象或似乎具备的性质。
groups.desc_en: Expresses an epistemic evaluation of reality based on subjective impressions or outward manifestations, contrasting with factual assertion by indexing degrees of perceptual inference and uncertain reality.
groups.desc_zh: 指基于外在表象或主观印象对事物真实属性所做的认知推断，与确凿的事实陈述（be/state）相比，带有感知推测、表里不一或主观心智判定的模糊度。
groups.nuance_en: look: give a specific visual impression based on visible exterior evidence (tired / sharp / promising) · seem: present a generalized, introspective impression that may belie reality (reluctant / genuine / odd) · sound: produce an impression based on acoustic reception or spoken report (reasonable / alarming / false) · appear: present an outward, often deceptive or formal semblance (distant / guilty / calm) · strike as: hit someone's consciousness with an immediate, definitive impression (arrogant / odd / familiar)
groups.nuance_zh: look: 凭借肉眼可见的外貌展现特定表象 (tired / sharp / promising) · seem: 给人主观上内在感知到某种状态 (reluctant / genuine / odd) · sound: 听起来或由传闻判断呈现某种印象 (reasonable / alarming / false) · appear: 在外在客观观察或正式表象上显露出来 (distant / guilty / calm) · strike as: 猛然带给观察者某种鲜明的主观感受 (arrogant / odd / familiar)

groups.name: Seize & Confiscate · 查扣与罚没 (Impound, Confiscate, Commandeer)
groups.tip: 执法部门依法查封并没收财产

items.def_en: To take possession of illicit or contested property by legal authority or sudden force
items.ex_en: Federal agents obtained a warrant to seize counterfeit merchandise stored in the warehouse.
items.ex_zh: 联邦特工获得了搜查令，依法扣押存放在仓库里的假冒商品。

items.def_en: To seize goods or chattels from a debtor in order to compel payment or satisfy a debt
items.ex_en: The landlord obtained legal permission to distrain tenant goods for unpaid warehouse rent.
items.ex_zh: 房东获得了合法许可，扣押租户的财物以抵充拖欠的仓库租金。

items.def_en: To officially seize property without compensation as a penalty or legal measure
items.ex_en: Customs officials will immediately confiscate any undeclared luxury goods discovered at the border.
items.ex_zh: 海关官员将立即没收在边境查获的任何未申报奢侈品。

items.def_zh: 扣押，查封，没收（财产、车辆等）；圈禁（牲畜）
items.def_en: 1. (of police or the law) To seize and hold property or a vehicle officially. 2. To shut up stray animals in an enclosed pound.
items.ex_en: The police decided to impound the unregistered vehicle pending further legal investigation.
items.ex_zh: 警方决定扣押这辆未登记的车辆，等待进一步的法律调查。

items.def_en: To take possession of private property or transport officially for urgent or military use
items.ex_en: Soldiers were authorized to commandeer civilian vehicles to transport wounded personnel to safety.
items.ex_zh: 士兵们获准征用民用车辆，以便将伤员运送到安全地带。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the lawful or authoritative taking of property, vehicles, or goods by police, courts, customs, or military agents. It highlights formal custody, forfeiture, or compulsory appropriation.
groups.summary_zh: 执法机关或当权机构依法、依规强制扣押、没收或征用财物。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the legally sanctioned or forceful taking of private property into state, military, or creditor custody, differing from theft or simple taking through its authoritative mandate and disciplinary or confiscatory context.
groups.desc_zh: 指司法机关、军警或债权人依仗法律效力或权威，对私人财产实行的查封、没收或征用，与非法窃取或简单拾取不同，具国家强制力与罚没性制裁属性。
groups.nuance_en: seize: take possession of contraband or assets by legal right, warrant, or sudden force (contraband / assets / ship) · distrain: legally seize personal property to compel payment of overdue rent or debt (goods / property / chattels) · confiscate: seize private property permanently as a punitive measure or legal penalty (weapons / passport / drugs) · impound: take custody of a vehicle or animal in an official compound pending legal clearance (vehicle / car / livestock) · commandeer: forcefully requisition civilian property for emergency or military use (vehicle / building / vessel)
groups.nuance_zh: seize: 依据搜查令或强制权扣押物证或资产 (contraband / assets / ship) · distrain: 为追讨拖欠租金或债务依法扣押动产 (goods / property / chattels) · confiscate: 罚没、依法没收违禁品或犯罪所得 (weapons / passport / drugs) · impound: 将违章车辆或无主牲畜拖至指定扣押场 (vehicle / car / livestock) · commandeer: 军警在紧急危急状态下强行征用民产 (vehicle / building / vessel)

groups.name: Sell & Distribute · 批发与分销 (Wholesale, Retail, Distribute)
groups.tip: 大宗批发走量分销

items.def_en: To buy and sell goods in small batches or lots as a middleman or wholesale broker
items.ex_en: Brokers in the district regularly job surplus textiles to regional garment factories.
items.ex_zh: 该区域的中间商定期将过剩纺织品批发倒卖给各地方服装厂。

items.def_en: To sell goods directly to the public in small quantities
items.ex_en: The boutique chose to retail the designer collection exclusively through flagship downtown stores.
items.ex_zh: 该精品店选择仅通过市中心旗舰店向公众零售这款设计师系列产品。
items.ex2_en: The new luxury wristwatch retails for five thousand dollars in major department stores.
items.ex2_zh: 这款新型豪华手表在各大百货商店的零售价为五千美元。

items.def_en: To supply goods to stores, businesses, or agents for subsequent sale
items.ex_en: The logistics firm will distribute the medical supplies to clinics nationwide this week.
items.ex_zh: 该物流公司将于本周把医疗用品配发至全国各地的诊所。

items.def_en: To promote, market, or sell goods through display and advertising strategies
items.ex_en: The entertainment studio plans to merchandise the animated characters across global retail channels.
items.ex_zh: 这家娱乐公司计划通过全球零售渠道对这些动画角色进行周边商品推广。

items.def_en: To sell goods in large quantities to retailers or businesses rather than directly to individual consumers.
items.ex_en: The supplier preferred to wholesale organic produce directly to regional supermarket chains.
items.ex_zh: 该供应商更倾向于将有机农产品直接大宗批发给区域连锁超市。

groups.summary_en: Commercial verbs covering intermediary supply channels, from bulk trading down to merchant supply networks.
groups.summary_zh: 描述商业供应链中的大宗买卖、批量转售与渠道分销行为。
groups.desc_en: Covers commercial supply chain operations where goods are marketed, traded in volume, or allocated across retail networks, contrasting with consumer shopping by its commercial, tiered, and logistical transaction framework.
groups.desc_zh: 涵盖商业供应链中将货品进行批量调拨、分销或零售展示的系统性流转，与终端消费者的“购买（buy/shop）”相反，强调商业中介层级与流通渠道布局。
groups.nuance_en: job: buy goods wholesale from manufacturers and resell them to retailers as a middleman (goods / lots / merchandise) · retail: sell merchandise in small quantities directly to individual consumers (goods / products / items) · distribute: supply and transport goods systematically to a network of retailers or regions (goods / products / films) · merchandise: promote and market products through attractive packaging and strategic retail display (wares / goods / brands) · wholesale: sell commodities in bulk quantities to merchants rather than end-users (goods / clothing / produce)
groups.nuance_zh: job: 作为批发倒手商小批量买入再转卖零售商 (goods / lots / merchandise) · retail: 将商品零星单件直接销售给终端消费者 (goods / products / items) · distribute: 将商品统筹配送发往各大分销网点 (goods / products / films) · merchandise: 通过货架陈列、品牌联名开展商品化营销 (wares / goods / brands) · wholesale: 面向商业机构或商家做大宗批量批发 (goods / clothing / produce)

groups.name: Sense & Perceive · 感官察觉 (Sense, Detect, Perceive)
groups.tip: 依靠身体感官觉察事物

items.def_en: To become aware of something by using physical senses or intuition; to perceive.
items.ex_en: She could instantly sense growing tension among the board members during the meeting.
items.ex_zh: 在会议期间，她能立刻察觉到董事会成员之间不断加剧的紧张气氛。

items.def_en: To discover or notice the presence of something subtle, hidden, or faint
items.ex_en: The laboratory instruments can easily detect faint traces of poison in the water.
items.ex_zh: 实验室仪器可以轻松检测出水中极其微量的毒物痕迹。

items.def_en: To become directly aware of something through any of the senses or conscious observation
items.ex_en: Patients occasionally perceive subtle changes in light before the onset of a migraine.
items.ex_zh: 偏头痛发作之前，患者偶尔能感知到光线的细微变化。

items.def_en: To notice or intuit a subtle hint, change, or emotional cue that others might miss
items.ex_en: He did not pick up on her sarcastic tone until everyone started laughing.
items.ex_zh: 直到大家开始大笑，他才察觉到她话里的讽刺意味。

items.def_en: To perceive, recognize, or distinguish something clearly despite ambiguity or faintness
items.ex_en: Through the heavy mist, the lookout could barely discern the distant lighthouse beacon.
items.ex_zh: 透过浓雾，瞭望员勉强能辨认出远处的灯塔光芒。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote registering subtle physical stimuli, external presences, or intangible shifts through intuitive awareness or sensory faculties.
groups.summary_zh: 指借助感官或直觉隐约捕获、察觉外界迹象、微小变化或存在。
groups.desc_en: Involves capturing subtle, elusive physical stimuli or subliminal clues through the nervous system or intuition, differing from conscious thinking by occurring at the boundary of raw sensation and immediate cognitive awareness.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过感官器官或直觉敏锐捕捉微弱、隐蔽的物理刺激或潜意识线索，与深思熟虑（think）相比，处于原始感官刺激与即时认知察觉的交界层。
groups.nuance_en: sense: perceive something instinctively or physiologically without explicit proof (danger / shift / presence) · detect: discover the presence of something faint, concealed, or minute using keen senses or instruments (odor / change / radiation) · perceive: interpret complex sensory data or form mental awareness of surroundings (pattern / threat / difference) · pick up on: notice subtle, unspoken cues or undertones in an interaction (tension / vibe / cues) · discern: recognize and differentiate something hidden or obscure through focused scrutiny (truth / figure / difference)
groups.nuance_zh: sense: 凭潜意识直觉或感官体认到无形变化 (danger / shift / presence) · detect: 敏锐侦测出极其微弱、隐匿的迹象或成分 (odor / change / radiation) · perceive: 对外部感官信息进行心智觉察与统合认知 (pattern / threat / difference) · pick up on: 迅速心领神会、捕捉到空气中的微妙隐喻 (tension / vibe / cues) · discern: 穿透迷雾由表及里辨识出隐秘细微之物 (truth / figure / difference)

groups.name: Sensitize & Heighten · 敏化与提升觉知 (Sensitize, Attune, Alert)
groups.tip: 感官敏锐地体会并捕捉

items.def_en: (+ to) To make someone keenly aware of a potential danger, opportunity, or developing situation
items.ex_en: Security guards quickly alerted the residents to the fire spreading in the basement.
items.ex_zh: 保安人员迅速提醒住户注意地下室蔓延的火势。

items.def_en: (+ to) To arouse an interest, sensation, or conscious realization that previously lay dormant
items.ex_en: The rustic landscape awakened the wandering poet to deep, forgotten longings of home.
items.ex_zh: 这片乡村风景唤醒了这位流浪诗人内心深处被遗忘的浓烈乡愁。
items.ex2_en: The sleeping bear awakened slowly from its long hibernation as warm spring arrived.
items.ex2_zh: 随着温暖春天的到来，沉睡的熊从漫长的冬眠中缓缓苏醒。

items.def_en: To make an emotion, perception, or sensory awareness sharper and more intense
items.ex_en: Dim lighting in the gallery helped heighten visitors' emotional response to the artwork.
items.ex_zh: 画廊内昏暗的灯光有助于增强参观者对艺术作品的情感共鸣。
items.ex2_en: Tension heightened rapidly between the two rival factions as the critical deadline approached.
items.ex2_zh: 随着关键截止日期的临近，两个敌对派系之间的紧张局势迅速升温。

items.def_en: (+ to) To adjust or make someone receptive, aware, and responsive to subtle cues or environments
items.ex_en: Experienced diplomats must carefully attune themselves to shifting political currents during delicate negotiations.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的外交官在微妙的谈判中必须敏锐适应变幻莫测的政治风向。

items.def_en: 1. (+ to) To make someone aware of and sensitive to a problem, situation, or feeling. 2. To make a body, substance, or material chemically or biologically sensitive.
items.ex_en: The seminar aimed to sensitize corporate managers to subtle workplace discrimination and harassment.
items.ex_zh: 该研讨会旨在让企业管理人员敏锐意识到职场中潜藏的歧视与骚扰问题。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe calibrating, conditioning, or raising an organism's or person's responsiveness to specific stimuli, concerns, or subtleties.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过引导、磨砺或生理激发，使人或感官对特定外界刺激与细节更具敏感度。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on sharpening or calibrating sensory receptivity, emotional awareness, or cognitive vigilance to external stimuli, contrasting with passive reception by actively dialing up perceptual responsiveness.
groups.desc_zh: 指使感官敏锐度、情感感知或心智戒备提升至更高阶状态，与被动接受刺激不同，强调主动校准感知门槛、调高对外界变动的共振与警觉。
groups.nuance_en: alert: warn someone to be watchful and prepared for imminent danger or changes (public / authorities / guards) · awaken: revive dormant senses, emotions, or consciousness from passivity (interest / conscience / memories) · heighten: amplify or intensify an emotional state, sense, or tension (awareness / fear / senses) · attune: bring sensibilities into harmonious alignment with subtle external rhythms (ears / mind / senses) · sensitize: render someone physiologically or emotionally susceptible and responsive to an issue (students / public / body)
groups.nuance_zh: alert: 敲响警钟使人进入戒备临战状态 (public / authorities / guards) · awaken: 唤醒沉睡已久的麻木意识、良知或感官 (interest / conscience / memories) · heighten: 放大加深本已存在的敏感度或紧张情绪 (awareness / fear / senses) · attune: 调整感官使之与细微波动同频共振 (ears / mind / senses) · sensitize: 开展脱敏或敏感化教育使其对议题高度共情 (students / public / body)

groups.name: Sensory Overwhelm & Splendor · 耀目与眩惑 (Dazzle, Blind, Overwhelm)
groups.tip: 耀眼强光令人迷乱晃眼

items.def_zh: 压倒；在感官或情感上征服
items.def_en: To have such a strong emotional, sensory, or visual effect on someone that they are rendered helpless
items.ex_en: The sheer beauty of the mountain vista threatened to overwhelm her emotional composure.
items.ex_zh: 眼前雄奇壮丽的山景几乎彻底倾倒了她的情绪防线。

items.def_en: To temporarily overpower vision with intense light, or to greatly impress with brilliance or skill
items.ex_en: Bright headlights from the oncoming truck momentarily dazzled the nervous young driver.
items.ex_zh: 迎面驶来的卡车射出的刺眼大灯瞬间让那位紧张的年轻司机目眩。

items.def_en: To hold the complete attention of someone as if spellbound or hypnotized by beauty or brilliance
items.ex_en: The graceful movements of the prima ballerina continued to mesmerize the packed auditorium.
items.ex_zh: 首席芭蕾舞演员优美的身姿持续吸引着座无虚席的剧场观众。

items.raw_cluster: 使目眩与迷惑 Dazzle & Bedazzle
items.def_zh: 使目眩，使眩目；使陶醉，使迷乱
items.def_en: To greatly impress, confuse, or overpower someone with brilliance, bright light, or splendor.
items.ex_en: The glittering palace chandeliers managed to bedazzle every foreign guest at the gala.
items.ex_zh: 宫殿中璀璨夺目的水晶吊灯令宴会上的每一位外国宾客都为之目眩神迷。

items.def_en: To cause someone to be unable to see, either temporarily through strong light or permanently
items.ex_en: The sudden flash of intense lightning threatened to blind the navigator temporarily.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的强烈闪电几乎让领航员暂时失明。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote overpowering sensory faculties—particularly vision or comprehension—with intense radiance, brilliance, or staggering display.
groups.summary_zh: 以强烈光芒或惊艳表现压倒视觉感官，使人目眩神迷或暂时失神。
groups.desc_en: Describes the experience of sensory or cognitive faculties being temporarily incapacitated by extreme luminosity, sheer magnitude, or breathtaking beauty, contrasting with simple admiration by its paralyzing, cognitive-shattering impact.
groups.desc_zh: 指极度强烈的强光、恢弘景象或绝美特质对感官与心智造成的暂时性击溃与失控，与普通欣赏不同，具有令人目眩神迷、剥夺理性思考的压倒性冲击。
groups.nuance_en: overwhelm: crush or overpower senses or emotions by sheer volume or intensity (senses / crowds / defenses) · dazzle: blind someone temporarily with intense brilliance, or amaze with virtuosic display (eyes / audience / spectators) · mesmerize: hold someone's attention so entirely as to induce a transfixed, spellbound state (crowd / viewers / listeners) · bedazzle: thoroughly enchant or confuse through an excessive display of brilliance or adornment (spectators / fans / critics) · blind: deprive of physical sight or critical judgment through glare, prejudice, or passion (eyes / drivers / judgment)
groups.nuance_zh: overwhelm: 强度或体量过于巨大以致感官彻底承载过载 (senses / crowds / defenses) · dazzle: 耀目光芒刺眼夺目，或以精湛技艺技惊四座 (eyes / audience / spectators) · mesmerize: 极度迷人以致观察者如受催眠般出神定格 (crowd / viewers / listeners) · bedazzle: 繁复华美的光彩使人眼花缭乱、目迷五色 (spectators / fans / critics) · blind: 强光瞬间致盲，或情感冲昏理智批判力 (eyes / drivers / judgment)

groups.name: Sentence & Punish · 判刑与量刑处罚 (Sentence, Condemn, Penalize)
groups.tip: 法官居中裁判并宣判刑罚

items.def_en: to state officially in a court of law what someone's punishment will be
items.ex_en: The presiding judge will sentence the convicted felon to ten years in prison.
items.ex_zh: 主审法官将判处这名已定罪的重罪犯十年有期徒刑。

items.def_en: To officially declare someone to be guilty and specify a severe punishment like death or hard labor
items.ex_en: The military tribunal chose to condemn the treacherous commander to hard labor.
items.ex_zh: 军事法庭最终决定判处这名叛变的指挥官服苦役。

items.def_en: To order someone by judicial authority to pay a sum of money as a legal punishment
items.ex_en: The municipal magistrate chose to fine the reckless motorist for speeding excessively.
items.ex_zh: 地方法官决定对严重超速的鲁莽司机判处罚款。

items.def_en: To announce or deliver an official judgment, sentence, or verdict in court
items.ex_en: The supreme court is expected to hand down its historic ruling tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 预计最高法院将于明天上午正式下达这项具有历史意义的判决。

items.def_en: To impose a penalty, forfeiture, or handicap on someone for breaking a rule or law
items.ex_en: The referee decided to penalize the aggressive defender for an illegal late tackle.
items.ex_zh: 裁判决定对该防守队员违规的迟到铲球动作处以判罚。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the judicial imposition of formal punishment on a convicted offender. It shifts focus from evaluating guilt to decreeing penal consequences such as imprisonment or fines.
groups.summary_zh: 指司法机关对已定罪者依法下达监禁、罚款等具体刑罚判决。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the formal judicial determination and proclamation of a criminal punishment by an authorized tribunal, contrasting with informal retaliation or social rebuke by its codified, due-process institutional power.
groups.desc_zh: 指司法机关依据既定法条对罪犯做出的裁量与刑罚宣告，与私下报复或道德谴责相比，体现具有法律拘束力、法定程序的国家刑罚量定。
groups.nuance_en: sentence: formally declare the judicial punishment decreed for a convicted felon (killer / criminal / defendant) · condemn: pronounce legal doom, severe moral censure, or declare an unsafe property uninhabitable (killer / actions / building) · fine: order a monetary forfeiture as a statutory penalty for an infraction (driver / company / violator) · hand down: formally deliver and communicate an authoritative legal verdict or sentence (verdict / decision / ruling) · penalize: impose a regulatory sanction or disadvantage for rule-breaking (violators / players / teams)
groups.nuance_zh: sentence: 法官正式宣判被告应服的刑事刑期 (killer / criminal / defendant) · condemn: 判处极刑、宣告建筑物为危房或予以道德痛斥 (killer / actions / building) · fine: 依法裁定缴纳罚金以惩戒违规违法 (driver / company / violator) · hand down: 法院正式向外界宣读发布判决书 (verdict / decision / ruling) · penalize: 依规章制度处以罚款、扣分或降级制裁 (violators / players / teams)

groups.name: Serve & Work · 任职与服务 (Officiate, Serve, Preside)
groups.tip: 履行职务与日常行政工作

items.def_en: To perform official duties in a designated post, term of office, or organization
items.ex_en: She had the rare honor to serve as the country's chief diplomatic envoy.
items.ex_zh: 她有幸担任该国首席外交特使一职。

items.def_zh: 当文书，当办事员；当店员，做售货员
items.def_en: (chiefly US) To work as an office clerk, court clerk, or store assistant.
items.ex_en: The law graduate worked diligently to clerk for a prominent federal appellate judge.
items.ex_zh: 这位法律系毕业生辛勤工作，为一位著名的联邦上诉法院法官担任文书。

items.def_en: To occupy the seat of authority and oversee proceedings at a meeting, trial, or official assembly
items.ex_en: The senior partner was invited to preside over the firm's annual shareholder meeting.
items.ex_zh: 资深合伙人受邀主持律所的年度股东大会。

items.def_en: (informal) To hold a secondary job, often secretly, in addition to regular primary employment
items.ex_en: He had to moonlight as a private security guard to cover medical expenses.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不兼职做私人保安，以支付昂贵的医疗费用。

items.def_en: To perform the official duties of a referee, judge, priest, or presiding administrator
items.ex_en: The parish priest agreed to officiate at the memorial service next Sunday morning.
items.ex_zh: 教区牧师同意于下周日早晨主持追悼仪式。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this vocational and civic frame describe performing professional or institutional duties, carrying out administrative functions, or holding an active seat in public office or courts of law.
groups.summary_zh: 指在政府、法庭或机构中履职、主持事务或从事工作。
groups.desc_en: Denotes holding an official capacity, performing institutional duties, or executing a specific occupational role, differing from generic physical 'work' by foregrounding formal status, legal jurisdiction, or dual employment contexts.
groups.desc_zh: 指担任公职、履行机构职责或从事特定职业身份，与普通体力或泛泛‘工作’（work）相比，强调官方身份、管辖权或双重雇佣语境。
groups.nuance_en: serve: general fulfillment of an official term or duty (term / sentence / public) · clerk: perform clerical or judicial-assistant work (court / judge / firm) · preside: occupy the chair of authority or oversight (meeting / tribunal / court) · moonlight: work a secondary job surreptitiously or outside hours (teacher / bartender / weekends) · officiate: perform official ceremonial, priestly, or refereeing duties (wedding / match / funeral)
groups.nuance_zh: serve: 履行任期或法定义务 (term / sentence / public) · clerk: 担任书记员或文书助理 (court / judge / firm) · preside: 行使主持权或居中主审 (meeting / tribunal / court) · moonlight: 业余兼职以赚取外快 (teacher / bartender / weekends) · officiate: 担任主礼、执裁或主持仪式 (wedding / match / funeral)

groups.name: Service & Overhaul · 维护与检修 (Maintain, Overhaul, Tune up)
groups.tip: 对器械设备进行日常维护

items.def_zh: 维护，保养，检修（机器、车辆等）；偿付（债务利息）
items.def_en: 1. To check and repair a vehicle, machine, or appliance regularly. 2. (finance) To pay the interest on a debt.
items.ex_en: Mechanics regularly service the transport aircraft to prevent catastrophic engine failures mid-flight.
items.ex_zh: 机械师定期检修运输机，以防止飞行途中发生灾难性的发动机故障。

items.def_en: To keep an engine, building, or piece of equipment in good repair by regular care and checkups
items.ex_en: The municipal authority must maintain the suspension bridge to ensure public safety.
items.ex_zh: 市政当局必须妥善保养这座悬索桥，以确保公众安全。

items.def_en: To adjust and clean an engine or piece of machinery to ensure optimal running condition
items.ex_en: The technician arrived early to tune up the racing engine before qualification trials.
items.ex_zh: 技师早早赶来，在排位赛前调校好了赛车引擎。

items.def_en: To thoroughly examine a machine, engine, or system and make all necessary repairs or improvements
items.ex_en: Engineers plan to overhaul the aging turbine generator before peak winter demand begins.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们计划在冬季用电高峰开始前对老化的涡轮发电机进行全面大修。

items.def_en: To repair and clean a vehicle or piece of machinery so that it is in good working order again
items.ex_en: The vintage workshop aims to recondition antique roadsters to original factory specifications.
items.ex_zh: 这家老式机修车间致力于将老式敞篷跑车翻新至出厂标准。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers routine, preventative, or deep mechanical and technical inspections, repairs, and adjustments to keep machines, vehicles, and systems in working order.
groups.summary_zh: 定期或针对性地对机械、车辆进行检修、调校与维护保养。
groups.desc_en: Denotes systematic inspection, restorative adjustment, and rebuilding of mechanical systems to ensure operational readiness, contrasting with minor cosmetic repairs or hasty fixes.
groups.desc_zh: 指对机械系统进行系统性检查、校准调优与拆解大修以恢复运作性能，区别于表面小补或应急维修。
groups.nuance_en: service: routine scheduled maintenance and fluid replacement (engine / vehicle / boiler) · maintain: continuous upkeep to sustain operational condition (fleet / standards / infrastructure) · tune up: fine-tune and optimize operating performance (engine / instrument / system) · overhaul: complete teardown, inspection, and rebuilding (engine / tax system / machinery) · recondition: restore a worn item to serviceable factory-like condition (parts / battery / equipment)
groups.nuance_zh: service: 常规定期维护与保养 (engine / vehicle / boiler) · maintain: 维持长期正常运行状态 (fleet / standards / infrastructure) · tune up: 微调校准以达最佳性能 (engine / instrument / system) · overhaul: 彻底拆卸大修或制度检修 (engine / tax system / machinery) · recondition: 翻新修复至出厂可用状态 (parts / battery / equipment)

groups.name: Setting Out & Directing Motion · 启程前往与朝向行进 (Bound, Make for, Set off)
groups.tip: 朝特定方向行进

items.def_zh: 朝特定方向行进，前往；率领，主管
items.def_en: 1. To move or travel in a particular direction. 2. To lead, be in charge of, or be at the top of something.
items.ex_en: The weary travelers decided to head straight toward the nearest mountain village.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的旅客们决定径直前往最近的山村。

items.def_en: Continue in an orderly fashion or travel in a specified direction
items.ex_en: Passengers must proceed through the security checkpoint before boarding their connecting flight.
items.ex_zh: 乘客在登上转机航班之前，必须依序通过安检通道。

items.def_en: Move quickly with large leaping strides toward a place
items.ex_en: The excited retriever began to bound across the grassy meadow toward the lake.
items.ex_zh: 兴奋的寻回犬开始欢快地穿过草地，向湖边奔去。

items.def_en: Move directly and intentionally towards a place
items.ex_en: Seeing dark thunderclouds approach, the frightened hikers turned to make for shelter.
items.ex_zh: 看到乌云压境，受到惊吓的徒步者们转身朝避难所走去。

items.def_en: Begin a journey or start moving toward a destination
items.ex_en: The expedition crew packed their supplies and prepared to set off at dawn.
items.ex_zh: 探险队员收拾好补给，准备在黎明时分启程。

groups.summary_en: This frame describes orienting oneself and moving deliberately toward a specific destination. Head emphasizes general chosen trajectory, make for highlights purposeful advancing, and set off focuses on departure.
groups.summary_zh: 朝着特定目的地行进、动身启程或向某处奔去。
groups.desc_en: Denotes initiating a journey or orienting purposeful physical transit toward a specific destination, shifting focus from the act of walking itself to origin-departure and directional trajectory.
groups.desc_zh: 指踏上旅程或朝着特定终点有目的地行进，焦点从单纯走动的步态转向启程与指向性轨迹。
groups.nuance_en: set off: initiate departure on an expedition or trip (journey / trek / dawn) · head: steer or orient trajectory toward a destination (north / home / town) · make for: advance directly or deliberately toward a haven or goal (exit / shelter / coast) · bound: leap forward rapidly toward a location (stairs / door / woods) · proceed: continue forward along an established route (gate / destination / checkpoint)
groups.nuance_zh: set off: 启程动身出发 (journey / trek / dawn) · head: 调整朝向并向特定方向行进 (north / home / town) · make for: 径直奔向某处庇护所或目的地 (exit / shelter / coast) · bound: 大步跳跃着奔向 (stairs / door / woods) · proceed: 沿既定路线向前行进 (gate / destination / checkpoint)

groups.name: Settle & Finalize Disputes · 终结纠纷与平息争端 (Settle, Resolve, Patch up)
groups.tip: 化解分歧恢复平稳

items.def_zh: 解决，平息；定居，安顿；降落，沉降；付清
items.def_en: 1. To end an argument, dispute, or problem by reaching an agreement. 2. To go to live permanently in a place. 3. To become calm or comfortable. 4. To pay an amount of money owed.
items.ex_en: The opposing parties met privately yesterday to settle their protracted land dispute.
items.ex_zh: 争议双方昨天私下会面，以解决他们之间旷日持久的土地争端。

items.def_en: To find an acceptable or conclusive solution to a contentious problem, crisis, or conflict.
items.ex_en: Diplomats worked tirelessly through the night to resolve the escalating diplomatic crisis.
items.ex_zh: 外交官们通宵达旦地不知疲倦工作，以化解不断升级的外交危机。

items.def_en: To repair a damaged relationship or quickly heal a rift between arguing parties.
items.ex_en: The estranged brothers finally agreed to patch up their longstanding bitter quarrel.
items.ex_zh: 疏远的两兄弟终于同意修复他们之间长期的激烈矛盾。

items.def_en: To eliminate smaller problems, misunderstandings, or sticking points through patient discussion.
items.ex_en: Delegates spent several hours trying to iron out minor disagreements in the contract.
items.ex_zh: 代表们花了几个小时试图消除合同中的微小分歧。

items.def_en: To deal with and finish arranging a disputed, messy, or unfinished matter completely.
items.ex_en: We need to square away these accounting discrepancies before the auditors arrive tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 在审计人员明天到达之前，我们必须将这些账目差错处理妥当。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on bringing a conflict, disagreement, or unpaid obligation to a peaceful, mutually agreed, and definitive conclusion, eliminating the source of contention.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过谈判、协议或妥协彻底化解矛盾，恢复安定状态。
groups.desc_en: Denotes bringing an end to friction, legal dispute, or operational disarray by arriving at agreement or mutual clarity, contrasting with unresolved conflict or ongoing arbitration.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过达成协议或排除异议来彻底平息争端、理顺分歧，区别于悬而未决的争议或持续对抗。
groups.nuance_en: settle: bring formal closure, often through compromise or payment (claim / dispute / suit) · resolve: decisively solve the underlying friction or dilemma (issue / crisis / conflict) · patch up: hastily or emotionally repair a damaged relationship (quarrel / differences / marriage) · iron out: smooth away minor wrinkles, details, or obstacles (wrinkles / differences / kinks) · square away: arrange or finalize loose administrative ends fully (details / accounts / paperwork)
groups.nuance_zh: settle: 达成和解、正式了结诉讼 (claim / dispute / suit) · resolve: 根除矛盾、化解核心危机 (issue / crisis / conflict) · patch up: 暂时修补弥合情感裂痕 (quarrel / differences / marriage) · iron out: 消除细枝末节上的摩擦与分歧 (wrinkles / differences / kinks) · square away: 彻底理顺并办妥琐碎杂务 (details / accounts / paperwork)

groups.name: Sever & Divest · 割裂与脱钩 (Divorce, Sever, Disentangle)
groups.tip: 解除关系割裂脱离

items.def_en: 1. To separate or sever two things completely from each other. 2. To legally end a marriage with someone.
items.ex_en: Critics argued the director failed to divorce personal bias from the historical documentary.
items.ex_zh: 批评人士指出，导演未能将个人偏见与这部历史纪录片分离开来。

items.def_en: To separate products, services, or investments that were formerly offered together as a single package
items.ex_en: The telecommunications giant chose to unbundle its internet and television service packages.
items.ex_zh: 这家电信巨头选择将其宽带网络与电视服务的捆绑套餐进行拆分。

items.def_en: To break off or end a relationship, agreement, or connection completely
items.ex_en: The embattled prime minister decided to sever diplomatic ties with the rogue regime.
items.ex_zh: 身陷困境的首相决定彻底断绝与该问题政权的外交关系。

items.def_en: To rid oneself of a subsidiary, asset, or business holding; strip of rights or property
items.ex_en: The conglomerate was forced to divest its non-core media assets this quarter.
items.ex_zh: 该企业集团在本季度被迫剥离了其非核心媒体资产。

items.def_en: To free someone or something from a complicated, confused, or restricting situation
items.ex_en: Investigators worked relentlessly to disentangle the complex network of offshore shell companies.
items.ex_zh: 调查人员不懈努力，试图理顺离岸空壳公司构成的错综复杂的网络。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this conceptual frame emphasize total and deliberate severance between two deeply entwined ideas, institutions, or operations, declaring that one must not be confounded with or reliant upon the other.
groups.summary_zh: 强调在观念、体制或运营上使原本紧密纠缠的两事物彻底割裂分离。
groups.desc_en: Denotes cutting, decoupling, or formally disentangling intertwined legal, commercial, or structural bonds, contrasting with simple additive partitioning or soft distancing.
groups.desc_zh: 指在法律、商业或结构上强行割断、解绑或剥离原本交织的关系，区别于简单的物理拆分或温和疏远。
groups.nuance_en: sever: sharply and completely cut a vital connection or tie (ties / relations / cord) · divest: strip away or sell off an asset or responsibility (assets / subsidiary / interest) · divorce: legally or conceptually separate previously married or unified entities (spouses / theory / practice) · unbundle: split a bundled package into discrete priced units (services / products / assets) · disentangle: carefully unravel complex interconnected entanglements (finances / threads / affairs)
groups.nuance_zh: sever: 毅然斩断或割绝重要联系 (ties / relations / cord) · divest: 剥离或变卖资产与业务 (assets / subsidiary / interest) · divorce: 依法离婚或在观念上断然分离 (spouses / theory / practice) · unbundle: 拆分打包产品或服务 (services / products / assets) · disentangle: 耐心解开复杂交错的纠葛 (finances / threads / affairs)

groups.name: Severe Muscle Spasm · 剧烈痉挛与绞痛 (Cramp, Seize up, Convulse)
groups.tip: 肌肉突发剧烈收缩痉挛

items.def_en: To become tightly constricted or tense, forming a hard, painful lump in a muscle
items.ex_en: Her exhausted neck muscles began to knot painfully under the prolonged desk work.
items.ex_zh: 在长时间伏案工作后，她疲惫的颈部肌肉开始紧绷打结，隐隐作痛。
items.ex2_en: The nervous speaker knotted his fingers tightly together before stepping onto the stage.
items.ex2_zh: 紧张的演讲者在走上舞台前，双手紧紧绞在一起。

items.def_en: 1. To contract or cause a muscle to contract painfully and involuntarily. 2. To restrict or inhibit the development, freedom, or movement of someone or something.
items.ex_en: Swimming in freezing waters caused his calves to cramp violently without warning.
items.ex_zh: 在冰冷的水中游泳导致他的小腿毫无征兆地剧烈抽筋。
items.ex2_en: His tired leg muscles cramped painfully after running the grueling twenty-mile mountain marathon.
items.ex2_zh: 在跑完艰难的二十英里山地马拉松后，他疲惫的腿部肌肉痛苦地抽筋了。

items.def_zh: 僵住；突发痉挛无法活动
items.def_en: To suddenly become rigid, stiff, or unable to move due to muscle contraction or pain
items.ex_en: Midway through the marathon, his lower back muscles threatened to seize up entirely.
items.ex_zh: 马拉松跑至半途时，他的下腰部肌肉几乎要完全僵住无法动弹。

items.def_en: To become rigidly fixed in a single position through spasm or joint strain
items.ex_en: The injured runner grimaced as severe cramps made his left knee joint lock.
items.ex_zh: 受伤的跑者痛苦地皱起眉，剧烈的痉挛使他的左膝关节完全锁死。
items.ex2_en: The prison guard carefully locked the heavy iron gate behind the new inmate.
items.ex2_zh: 狱警在新囚犯身后小心翼翼地锁上了沉重的铁门。

items.def_en: To suffer violent, uncontrollable, and rhythmic contractions of the entire body or a limb
items.ex_en: The toxic reaction caused the patient's entire body to convulse violently on the bed.
items.ex_zh: 毒性反应导致病人在病床上剧烈地全身抽搐。
items.ex2_en: The dying patient began to convulse violently from the potent experimental neurotoxin.
items.ex2_zh: 垂死的病人因强效的实验性神经毒素而开始剧烈抽搐。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers intense, painful, and immobilizing muscle contractions. The focus is on the severity of tightening and the temporary loss of normal muscular function.
groups.summary_zh: 强调肌肉剧烈收缩、僵死绞痛以及伴随而来的肢体僵硬与抽搐。
groups.desc_en: Denotes sudden, involuntary, and immobilizing contraction of muscles causing acute physical distress, differing from voluntary flexing or mild sustained stiffness.
groups.desc_zh: 指肌肉突发、非自主且致使肢体僵死的剧烈收缩与绞痛，区别于主动收缩或普通的肌肉酸紧。
groups.nuance_en: cramp: sharp painful sustained involuntary muscle contraction (calf / stomach / swimmer) · seize up: freeze and lock rigidly into complete immobility (muscles / engine / joints) · convulse: violently shake and jerk with uncontrolled spasms (body / limbs / patient) · knot: tighten into hard, localized painful balls of tension (stomach / shoulder / back) · lock: rigidly fix in a non-bending position due to spasm (jaw / knee / joints)
groups.nuance_zh: cramp: 突发性抽筋与持续痉挛 (calf / stomach / swimmer) · seize up: 僵死卡住导致动弹不得 (muscles / engine / joints) · convulse: 全身剧烈抽搐战栗 (body / limbs / patient) · knot: 肌肉打结绷紧绞痛 (stomach / shoulder / back) · lock: 关节或肌肉痉挛僵直锁死 (jaw / knee / joints)

groups.name: Sew & Blindfold · 缝合与蒙目 (Stitch shut, Blindfold, Hood)
groups.tip: 用针线穿引缝合闭口

items.def_zh: 给（鹰等）戴头罩；罩住头部
items.def_en: To cover the head of a hawk or falcon with a specialized leather hood to calm it
items.ex_en: The falconer learned how to hood the nervous hawk to keep it calm.
items.ex_zh: 这位训鹰人学会了如何给紧张的猎鹰戴上头罩以保持其镇静。

items.def_en: To close off or obscure eyes or apertures firmly against light or inspection
items.ex_en: She chose to shutter her heavy eyelids against the harsh glare of noon.
items.ex_zh: 面对正午刺眼的强光，她选择紧闭起沉重的双眼。

items.def_en: To cover someone's or an animal's eyes with a piece of cloth so they cannot see
items.ex_en: Kidnappers decided to blindfold the terrified diplomat before dragging him into the van.
items.ex_zh: 绑匪决定先蒙住这位惊恐的外交官的双眼，然后再把他拖进面包车。

items.def_zh: （缝住猎鹰眼睑以驯化）缝眼；合上，蒙骗
items.def_en: 1. (falconry / archaic) To temporarily sew shut the eyelids of a newly caught hawk to tame it.
items.ex_en: Despair threatened to seel her eyes against any vision of future joy.
items.ex_zh: 绝望几乎蒙蔽了她的双眼，让她看不见未来任何快乐的景象。

items.def_en: To close an opening or eyelids completely by fastening with needle and thread
items.ex_en: The surgeon had to stitch shut the deep wound on the soldier's forehead.
items.ex_zh: 外科医生必须将士兵额头上那道深深的伤口缝合关闭。

groups.summary_en: This specialized historical/falconry frame describes forcibly closing an animal's eyelids, eyes, or orifices by sewing or shrouding to block out vision, suppress wild instincts, and induce docility.
groups.summary_zh: 多用于驯鹰或特殊处置，指缝合眼睑或遮蔽视觉以驯服野性、消除外界刺激。
groups.desc_en: Denotes obstructing vision by physical binding, covering, or surgically suturing the eyes, contrasting with mere ambient darkness or natural blinking.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过物理包扎、罩覆甚至缝合眼睑来人为剥夺或封堵视线，区别于环境变暗或自然闭眼。
groups.nuance_en: blindfold: cover someone's eyes with cloth to block vision (hostage / captive / eyes) · hood: slip an opaque covering over the head or eyes (falcon / prisoner / victim) · shutter: close protective visual screens or lids firmly (eyes / windows / optics) · seel: falconry-derived term for sewing a raptor's eyelids shut (eyes / falcon / hawk) · stitch shut: surgically sew the eyelids together to maintain closure (eyes / wound / incision)
groups.nuance_zh: blindfold: 用布条蒙住眼睛 (hostage / captive / eyes) · hood: 用头套蒙住头脸遮蔽视线 (falcon / prisoner / victim) · shutter: 紧紧闭上双眼如拉下百叶窗 (eyes / windows / optics) · seel: 缝合猎鹰眼睑以驯鹰 (eyes / falcon / hawk) · stitch shut: 针线缝合眼睑以彻底闭塞 (eyes / wound / incision)

groups.name: Sex & Sexualize · 唤起性欲与性化 (Arouse, Turn On, Eroticize)
groups.tip: 激发感官与生理冲动

items.def_en: To stimulate or excite someone sexually or sensually, often in a superficial or teasing way
items.ex_en: The steamy novel was designed solely to titillate readers with suggestive dialogue.
items.ex_zh: 这部露骨的小说纯粹是通过挑逗性的对话来撩拨读者的情欲。

items.def_en: To cause someone to feel sexually excited or intensely attracted
items.ex_en: His deep, husky voice seemed to turn on everyone across the crowded room.
items.ex_zh: 他低沉沙哑的嗓音似乎让挤满屋子的人都感到性感迷人。

items.def_zh: 引起……的性冲动，激起……的性欲；确定……的性别
items.def_en: 1. To arouse or stimulate sexually. 2. To determine the biological sex of an animal.
items.ex_en: The specialist had to sex every newly hatched chick before shipping them.
items.ex_zh: 专家在发运前必须先鉴定每只刚孵出雏鸡的性别。

items.def_en: To stimulate sexual desire or excite strong physical passion in someone
items.ex_en: His gentle touch on her neck began to arouse her deepest desires.
items.ex_zh: 他轻抚她的脖颈，激起了她内心深处的渴望。

items.def_en: To make something sexual in character or quality, or to view someone strictly in sexual terms
items.ex_en: Critics argued the controversial advertisement tended to sexualize very young female athletes.
items.ex_zh: 批评人士指出，这则备受争议的广告有将年轻女运动员过分性化的倾向。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers eliciting sexual desire or reinterpreting someone or something through an explicit sexual lens, spanning erotic stimulation and physical arousal.
groups.summary_zh: 指激发性欲、从性角度对待某人或使之充满性色彩。
groups.desc_en: Denotes evoking physical sexual desire, eroticizing a subject, or imbuing neutral concepts with carnal qualities, contrasting with purely intellectual or platonic attraction.
groups.desc_zh: 指激发肉体性欲、将对象色情化或为中性事物注入性色彩，区别于纯精神或柏拉图式的吸引。
groups.nuance_en: arouse: awaken dormant physical lust or sexual excitement (desire / passions / partner) · turn on: colloquially stimulate immediate erotic interest (partner / crowd / fans) · titillate: superficially stimulate erotic curiosity or tease senses (audience / senses / fancy) · sexualize: portray, interpret, or objectify something in sexual terms (children / culture / media) · sex: amplify raw erotic appeal or carnal content of something (image / copy / campaign)
groups.nuance_zh: arouse: 唤醒本能性欲与深层情欲 (desire / passions / partner) · turn on: 口语中指瞬间挑起性趣或性冲动 (partner / crowd / fans) · titillate: 浅尝辄止地刺激感官挑逗挑拔 (audience / senses / fancy) · sexualize: 将非性事物赋予性意味或客体化 (children / culture / media) · sex: 增强色情元素或性吸引力 (image / copy / campaign)

groups.name: Shade & Screen · 遮阳与挡光 (Shield, Screen, Block out)
groups.tip: 遮挡强光提供阴凉视界

items.def_en: To protect or conceal something by placing a screen or structure in front of it
items.ex_en: Tall wooden blinds screened the sun porch from the harsh midday glare.
items.ex_zh: 高大的木质百叶窗挡住了正午刺眼的强光，庇护着阳光房。

items.def_zh: 遮护，庇护（使免受强光照射）
items.def_en: To protect someone or something from strong light or heat by interposing a barrier
items.ex_en: She raised a gloved hand to shield her sensitive eyes from the blinding glare.
items.ex_zh: 她抬起戴着手套的手，遮挡刺眼的强光以保护敏感的双眼。

items.def_zh: 遮蔽（光线），给……遮阴；（在绘画中）加阴影；微变
items.def_en: 1. To protect something from direct sunlight or bright light. 2. To make a drawing or painting darker in some parts to create depth. 3. To change very gradually from one state or color into another.
items.ex_en: A broad canvas awning shaded the outdoor dining area from the scorching sun.
items.ex_zh: 宽大的帆布遮阳篷为户外就餐区遮挡了炎炎烈日。

items.def_en: To stop light from entering a room or reaching an area completely
items.ex_en: Heavy velvet drapes were drawn to block out the blinding morning sunlight completely.
items.ex_zh: 厚重的丝绒窗帘拉上了，把刺眼的晨光完全挡在外面。

items.def_en: To position an object so that its shadow falls across something, shading it
items.ex_en: The towering skyscraper will cast a shadow over the neighborhood park all afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 高耸入云的摩天大楼整个下午都会在社区公园上方投下浓重的阴影。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers protective actions aimed at blocking harsh light, glare, or intense sun from striking someone's eyes or an exposed surface.
groups.summary_zh: 指遮挡刺眼光线或强烈阳光以提供阴凉或视觉防护。
groups.desc_en: Denotes interposing a physical barrier to block direct sunlight or glare, creating a shadowed and protected zone, contrasting with total environmental blackout or nighttime.
groups.desc_zh: 指在光源与物体之间设置实体屏障以遮挡强光或烈日，投下阴凉，区别于夜幕降临或全域彻底致黑。
groups.nuance_en: shade: protect from direct heat or light by casting a shadow (eyes / porch / seedling) · shield: defend eyes or surface from blinding glare or impact (eyes / view / light) · screen: filter out or block unwanted sunlight or visibility using a mesh or divider (sunlight / glare / porch) · block out: completely eliminate and prevent rays from entering (sunlight / glare / UV) · cast a shadow over: throw shade physically, or metaphorically gloom an occasion (lawn / patio / proceedings)
groups.nuance_zh: shade: 投下阴影以遮阳纳凉 (eyes / porch / seedling) · shield: 抬手或设防以阻挡刺眼强光 (eyes / view / light) · screen: 运用屏风纱帘过滤光线 (sunlight / glare / porch) · block out: 彻底隔绝强光入射 (sunlight / glare / UV) · cast a shadow over: 物理上投下阴影，或在喻义上蒙上阴影 (lawn / patio / proceedings)

groups.name: Shake & Tremble · 发抖与战栗 (Tremor, Shudder, Quiver)
groups.tip: 因寒冷恐惧产生身体战栗

items.def_en: To tremble or shake slightly, especially from nervousness, fear, or weakness.
items.ex_en: Her delicate pale fingers began to tremor violently from intense cold and sheer panic.
items.ex_zh: 因刺骨的严寒和极度的惊恐，她纤细苍白的手指剧烈地战栗起来。

items.def_en: to shake slightly with rapid, delicate movements due to strong emotion or physical sensitivity
items.ex_en: Her delicate lips began to quiver as grief overcame her fragile composure.
items.ex_zh: 悲痛击垮了她脆弱的从容，她娇弱的嘴唇开始微微颤动。

items.def_en: to shake repeatedly and involuntarily because of feeling cold or fearful
items.ex_en: The traveler continued to shiver uncontrollably as icy mountain winds pierced his thin cloak.
items.ex_zh: 刺骨的山风穿透了单薄的斗篷，旅人止不住地瑟瑟发抖。
items.ex2_en: The deafening explosion shivered the delicate glass windowpanes throughout the ancient cathedral.
items.ex2_zh: 震耳欲聋的爆炸震碎并震颤了整座古老大教堂精致的玻璃窗。

items.def_en: to shake or vibrate intensely from great fear or physical upheaval
items.ex_en: The frightened soldiers quaked in sheer dread before the wrath of the conqueror.
items.ex_zh: 在征服者的滔天怒火面前，受惊的士兵们吓得心惊胆战、剧烈发抖。

items.def_en: to shake violently and convulsively, typically from horror, disgust, or intense cold
items.ex_en: She could not help but shudder at the grotesque sight before her eyes.
items.ex_zh: 看到眼前怪诞恐怖的景象，她忍不住打了个寒战。

groups.summary_en: Describes involuntary, rapid micro-movements of the body or ground caused by fear, cold, weakness, or seismic disturbance, ranging from subtle fluttering to violent convulsions.
groups.summary_zh: 描述因恐惧、寒冷、虚弱或震动而引起的身体或地面不自主的抖颤。
groups.desc_en: Denotes rapid, involuntary oscillatory movements of the body or ground caused by fear, cold, shock, or seismic strain, contrasting with purposeful rhythmic swaying.
groups.desc_zh: 指因严寒、恐惧、震惊或地质应力引发的机体或地面急促、不由自主的摆动震颤，区别于自主的节奏晃动。
groups.nuance_en: shiver: involuntarily tremble slightly from cold or fright (cold / fear / chill) · quiver: rapid, light vibration of fine muscles or delicate surfaces (lips / leaves / voice) · shudder: convulsive, violent shake caused by horror, disgust, or sudden impact (horror / disgust / impact) · quake: shake deeply and powerfully, applied to whole bodies or the earth (earth / ground / boots) · tremor: experience subtle rhythmic tectonic or neurological oscillations (hands / earth / ground)
groups.nuance_zh: shiver: 因寒冷或恐惧而不自主打寒颤 (cold / fear / chill) · quiver: 嘴唇、树叶等轻微细密地颤动 (lips / leaves / voice) · shudder: 因惊悚、厌恶或剧烈震荡而全身剧颤 (horror / disgust / impact) · quake: 大地或人体强力震动战栗 (earth / ground / boots) · tremor: 发生微小而有节律的震颤或地震 (hands / earth / ground)

groups.name: Shape & Construct · 构筑与地貌塑造 (Grade, Terrace, Contour)
groups.tip: 堆土造台改变地形构造

items.def_en: To level or create a uniform slope on ground or earth before building or planting
items.ex_en: Heavy bulldozers arrived early to grade the sloping construction site before laying foundations.
items.ex_zh: 重型推土机早早开赴现场，在浇筑地基前将倾斜的施工场地整平。

items.def_en: To build up earth, snow, or mud into a raised protective ridge, barrier, or slope
items.ex_en: Workers hastily banked packed mud along the swollen river to hold back rising waters.
items.ex_zh: 工人们在暴涨的河水边仓促堆筑泥土护坡，以阻挡不断上涨的洪水。
items.ex2_en: Fresh winter snow banked steeply against the north side of the remote cabin.
items.ex2_zh: 新鲜的冬雪在偏僻小屋的北侧高高堆积起来。

items.def_en: To shape a hillside or sloping bank into a series of flat, level stepped platforms
items.ex_en: Local farmers terrace the steep hillsides to prevent erosion and cultivate green tea.
items.ex_zh: 当地农户将陡峭的山坡修整成梯田，以防止水土流失并种植绿茶。

items.def_en: To shape or form earth or material along natural curved elevations and profiles
items.ex_en: Landscapers contoured the garden earth along the natural curves of the rolling hill.
items.ex_zh: 造园师沿着起伏山丘的自然曲线，对花园的地貌进行了等高修整。

items.def_zh: 修筑梯田，将（斜坡等）筑成阶梯状台地
items.def_en: (landscaping / architecture, variant of terrace) To shape sloping ground into a series of flat stepped platforms or levels.
items.ex_en: Generations of winegrowers chose to terrasse the stony slopes above the river valley.
items.ex_zh: 几代葡萄种植者致力于将河谷上方的石质斜坡修筑成错落的阶梯台地。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this civil engineering and landscape frame deal with physically carving, leveling, and sculpting raw ground, earthworks, or slopes into stepped, leveled, or sculpted agricultural and structural forms. They emphasize deliberate topographic contouring.
groups.summary_zh: 指对土地、斜坡等地形进行切削、平整或修筑台阶式地形。
groups.desc_en: Denotes reshaping natural topography by grading slopes, cutting steps, and following elevation lines for engineering or agriculture, contrasting with freeform artistic sculpting.
groups.desc_zh: 指为了工程施工或农业耕种，对天然地表进行整平、筑坎、造梯田或依等高线改造，区别于无拘束的艺术雕刻。
groups.nuance_en: grade: level and smooth an inclined surface to an engineered slope (road / site / soil) · terrace: carve a steep hillside into a stepped series of flat ledges (hillside / slope / vineyards) · contour: shape or cultivate earth strictly along elevation contour lines (land / slope / beds) · bank: heap up soil into an elevated protective or stabilizing slope (earth / turn / river) · terrasse: architecturally sculpt ground into terraced garden tiers (gardens / grounds / estate)
groups.nuance_zh: grade: 平整场地并放坡至设计坡度 (road / site / soil) · terrace: 将陡坡开凿成层层阶梯梯田 (hillside / slope / vineyards) · contour: 严格依照等高线起伏修整或耕作 (land / slope / beds) · bank: 筑起护堤、堆起土坡 (earth / turn / river) · terrasse: 园林建筑中将地面修筑成台地 (gardens / grounds / estate)

groups.name: Sharp Stinging Pain · 刺痛与灼痛 (Smart, Burn, Bite)
groups.tip: 蜂蜇般尖锐火辣的痛感

items.def_en: Hurt or sting with sharp, pinching sensation, typically through cold
items.ex_en: The biting frost began to nip his bare cheeks as he hurried home.
items.ex_zh: 在他匆忙赶路回家时，严寒的霜气开始冻得他面颊生疼。

items.def_en: Produce or feel a hot, painful sensation on the skin or inside the body
items.ex_en: The harsh antiseptic made the open scratch on his forearm burn fiercely.
items.ex_zh: 烈性消毒水使他前臂上的那道开放性划痕灼痛不已。
items.ex2_en: Careless campers accidentally burned the dry pine forest during the hot summer drought.
items.ex2_zh: 粗心的露营者在炎热的夏季干旱期间不慎烧毁了干燥的松树林。

items.def_en: Feel a sharp, stinging physical pain, or feel upset and hurt by criticism
items.ex_en: Her scraped knees began to smart as soon as the cold disinfectant touched them.
items.ex_zh: 冰凉的消毒水刚一碰到她擦破的膝盖，便引起一阵火辣辣的刺痛。

items.def_zh: 蜇，刺痛；感到灼痛；使心痛（sting的过去式和过去分词）
items.def_en: Past tense and past participle of sting: to cause or feel a sharp prickling pain; to upset or hurt someone emotionally.
items.ex_en: The icy wind stung his eyes, forcing hot tears down his frozen cheeks.
items.ex_zh: 刺骨的寒风吹得他眼睛生疼，逼得热泪顺着冰冷的面颊流下。

items.def_en: Cause a sharp, stinging physical sensation, especially of extreme cold or wind
items.ex_en: The bitter northern wind seemed to bite straight through his woolen winter coat.
items.ex_zh: 凛冽的北风似乎能直接穿透他的羊毛冬大衣，刺骨生疼。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe sharp, acute physical sensations or emotional hurt that prickles, burns, or hurts keenly. While sting denotes a sudden prickling jab, smart emphasizes persistent throbbing pain and bite evokes a harsh, cutting pang.
groups.summary_zh: 描述身体或心理上剧烈尖锐的刺痛、灼痛或咬噬感。
groups.desc_en: Denotes experiencing or inflicting a sudden, high-intensity prickling or searing pain on skin or sensory nerves, contrasting with dull, throbbing aches.
groups.desc_zh: 指皮肤或感觉神经遭受突发、尖锐、针刺样或灼烧般的剧痛，区别于深层的隐痛或钝痛。
groups.nuance_en: smart: sting with a sharp, continuing, stinging pain (eyes / wound / slap) · burn: produce a searing, scalding sensation of acute heat (skin / eyes / acid) · stung: subjected to a sudden sharp puncture or inflammatory bite (nettles / bee / tears) · nip: inflict a quick, pinching bite or chilling sting (frost / wind / dog) · bite: pierce keenly into nerve endings with sharp cold, venom, or teeth (cold / wind / insect)
groups.nuance_zh: smart: 伤口受刺激引发火辣刺痛 (eyes / wound / slap) · burn: 酸液或热力带来的灼痛感 (skin / eyes / acid) · stung: 被蜂蜇、毒草刺中般的突发尖锐刺痛 (nettles / bee / tears) · nip: 刺骨寒风或尖牙的猛然咬啮刺痛 (frost / wind / dog) · bite: 严寒或毒虫深深刺入肌肤神经的剧痛 (cold / wind / insect)

groups.name: Sharpen & Hone · 削尖与磨砺 (Whet, Hone, Sharpen)
groups.tip: 磨快刃口使其锐利锋芒

items.def_en: To sharpen an edge or smooth a hard surface by rubbing against a rough whetstone
items.ex_en: The old woodworker used a whetstone to grind the dull edge of his chisel.
items.ex_zh: 老木匠用磨刀石将他那把发钝的凿子重新研磨锋利。

items.def_en: To make or become sharp or sharper, physically on an edge or mentally in acuity
items.ex_en: The chef paused to sharpen his kitchen knife on the ceramic honing rod.
items.ex_zh: 主厨停下手中的活儿，在陶瓷磨刀棒上将厨刀磨快。
items.ex2_en: The chef's culinary instincts sharpened significantly after years of rigorous training in Paris.
items.ex2_zh: 在巴黎接受了多年严格训练后，这位主厨的烹饪直觉变得敏锐了许多。

items.def_en: To sharpen a blade, or to refine and polish a skill or technique over time
items.ex_en: She spent several years abroad to hone her advanced diplomatic skills and strategic instincts.
items.ex_zh: 她在国外磨砺了数年，以锤炼高超的外交技能和战略直觉。

items.def_zh: 磨快，磨砺；刺激（欲望、兴趣等）
items.def_en:
1. to sharpen the blade of a tool or weapon
2. to stimulate or increase someone's desire, interest, or appetite
items.ex_en: The savory aroma drifting from the royal kitchen served to whet our eager appetites.
items.ex_zh: 从御膳房飘来的诱人香气，激起了我们迫不及待的食欲。

items.def_en: To sharpen a razor or fine blade on or with a leather strap
items.ex_en: The traditional barber carefully stropped the vintage straight razor to a lethal keenness.
items.ex_zh: 老派理发师在皮条上精心研磨那把老式直剃刀，使其锋芒毕露。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame cover both grinding an edge to acute physical sharpness and figuratively refining a skill, appetite, or mental facility to peak keenness.
groups.summary_zh: 既指研磨刃具使其锋利，也比喻提升技能或激发欲望兴趣。
groups.desc_en: Denotes mechanically abrading or finishing a metal blade to produce a razor-fine cutting edge, contrasting with blunt mechanical crushing or cutting.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过打磨、研磨等机械加工方式使刃口锋利极致，区别于粗暴的重击或切断。
groups.nuance_en: sharpen: make a tool's edge keen by grinding or friction (knife / pencil / blade) · hone: refine a blade to precise razor sharpness on a fine stone (razor / skills / blade) · whet: rub on a whetstone to sharpen a cutting edge (scythe / blade / appetite) · grind: abrade vigorously on an abrasive wheel to shape or thin an edge (axe / metal / tool) · strop: polish and align an ultra-fine razor edge on a leather strip (razor / blade / steel)
groups.nuance_zh: sharpen: 广义的磨快、削尖 (knife / pencil / blade) · hone: 用细磨石精细研磨出绝锋，引申磨练技能 (razor / skills / blade) · whet: 在砺石上磨刃，引申激发胃口欲念 (scythe / blade / appetite) · grind: 用砂轮重力研磨开刃 (axe / metal / tool) · strop: 在皮条上荡刀以精修刀锋 (razor / blade / steel)

groups.name: Sharpen & Keen · 磨利与尖锐化 (Sharpen, Grind, Whetting)
groups.tip: 利其器必先打磨其锋芒

items.def_en: To provide something with a cutting edge or to renew its sharpness
items.ex_en: The metalsmith paused to edge the freshly forged combat blade with extreme precision.
items.ex_zh: 铁匠停下手中的活儿，极为精准地给新锻造的战刃开锋磨锐。
items.ex2_en: The jagged metal sheet edged sharply against the cold factory floor as it moved.
items.ex2_zh: 锯齿状的金属板在移动时与冰冷的工厂地面紧贴摩擦出锋利的边缘。

items.def_en: To sharpen or shape a tool or blade by pressing it against an abrasive rotating wheel or rough stone
items.ex_en: He pressed the rusted axe head against the spinning wheel to grind it sharp.
items.ex_zh: 他将生锈的斧头按在飞转的砂轮上，把它打磨得极为锋利。

items.def_zh: 磨快，削尖；提高，使敏锐；变锋利，变敏锐
items.def_en: 1. To make an edge, point, or blade sharp, or to become sharp. 2. To improve or make a skill, feeling, or sense more acute.
items.ex_en: Intense daily practice helped sharpen her critical thinking skills ahead of the debate.
items.ex_zh: 密集的日常练习有助于在辩论赛前使她的批判性思维更加敏锐。
items.ex2_en: Her eyesight sharpened gradually after the successful laser corrective surgery on both eyes.
items.ex2_zh: 双眼成功接受激光矫正手术后，她的视力逐渐变得敏锐清晰。

items.def_en: To make senses, feelings, or perceptions more acute, receptive, and lively
items.ex_en: The startling sudden noise seemed to quicken every dormant instinct within the solitary wanderer.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的惊响，瞬间激发了孤独漫游者体内潜伏的所有敏锐本能。

items.def_en: To sharpen a blade by friction; or figuratively, to stimulate and sharpen an appetite, desire, or interest
items.ex_en: The mysterious preview succeeded only in whetting the public's fierce appetite for answers.
items.ex_zh: 那支神秘的预告片仅仅起到了吊足公众胃口、激起探索欲望的作用。

groups.summary_en: Denotes making an instrument's cutting edge or point acute, or intensifying human senses, mental focus, and feelings. Stresses an increase in acute cutting ability or enhanced perceptual vigilance.
groups.summary_zh: 指将刃口或尖端磨尖锐，亦指感官、思维或感受的敏锐化与强化。
groups.desc_en: Denotes intensifying the piercing acuity or sharpness of an edge, sensory faculty, or mental state, shifting from pure metallurgy to sensory and cognitive quickening.
groups.desc_zh: 指强化刃口的切削锋利度，或使感官、心智敏锐化与尖锐化，从纯粹金属加工延伸至感官与精神层面的磨砺。
groups.nuance_en: sharpen: enhance keenness of an edge or focus of senses (focus / wits / knife) · whet: stimulate, pique, or sharpen anticipation and desire (appetite / curiosity / blade) · grind: heavily wear down against stone to sharpen (axe / blade / stone) · edge: give a sharp border or razor cutting capability to a blade (tool / blade / weapon) · quicken: awaken and make sensory perceptions intensely receptive (senses / pulse / step)
groups.nuance_zh: sharpen: 磨快刃口，或使专注力、才智敏锐 (focus / wits / knife) · whet: 磨砺刀刃，尤指刺激好奇心或食欲 (appetite / curiosity / blade) · grind: 砂石重磨以赋锋芒 (axe / blade / stone) · edge: 为器具开刃、赋予锋芒 (tool / blade / weapon) · quicken: 使感官敏锐觉醒、心跳步伐加快 (senses / pulse / step)

groups.name: Shear & Shave · 剪割与剃剪 (Fleece, Crop, Clip)
groups.tip: 大剪修齐或削去外层

items.def_en: To cut short or tidy hair, wool, or nails using scissors or clippers
items.ex_en: She took a pair of scissors to clip the dry, split ends of her hair.
items.ex_zh: 她拿起一把剪刀，修剪掉头发上干燥分叉的发梢。

items.def_en: To cut hair, plants, or edges very short or close to the base
items.ex_en: The stylist chose to crop his shaggy curls into a neat, short taper.
items.ex_zh: 发型师把他的蓬乱卷发剪短，修成整齐利落的渐变短发。

items.def_en: To remove thin layers or hair from a surface with a razor or sharp blade
items.ex_en: The carpenter used an adze to shave off thin excess layers of coarse timber.
items.ex_zh: 木匠用手斧刨去了粗糙木料上多余的薄层。

items.def_zh: 剪（羊毛等）；剪断，剪切；折断
items.def_en: 1. to cut wool or hair off an animal or person with shears. 2. to break or snap under lateral force or stress.
items.ex_en: Experienced farmhands shear hundreds of thick fleeces before summer heat becomes unbearable.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的农工在夏季酷暑难耐之前，剪下了数百只羊的厚羊毛。

items.def_en: To shear the wool from a sheep or other animal
items.ex_en: The farmhands worked all morning to fleece the whole flock of Merino sheep.
items.ex_zh: 农工们干了整整一个上午，把那一群美利奴羊的羊毛全剪了下来。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers mechanical cutting actions specifically using scissor-like blades or shears to strip coats, fleece, hair, or physical surface layers cleanly off.
groups.summary_zh: 指利用剪刃、羊毛剪等工具整片切断、剪掉毛发或表层覆物。
groups.desc_en: Denotes removing hair, fleece, or foliage cleanly by cutting close to the surface with shears or blades, contrasting with tearing off or ripping out by the roots.
groups.desc_zh: 指使用剪刀、推子或刀刃贴近表皮将毛发、羊毛或植物枝叶齐根平整剪除，区别于连根拔除或粗暴撕扯。
groups.nuance_en: shear: cut the thick wool fleece from an animal or lop off under stress (sheep / wool / bolts) · clip: snip away tips, hair, or edges neatly with small cuts (hedges / hair / coupons) · crop: cut hair, tail, or foliage very short (hair / ears / pasture) · shave off: slice away hair or ultra-thin layers flush to skin/surface (beard / seconds / wood) · fleece: strip wool off a sheep, or colloquially swindle completely of money (sheep / victim / tourists)
groups.nuance_zh: shear: 大面积剪下羊毛，或工程中因剪切力断裂 (sheep / wool / bolts) · clip: 用剪刀修剪碎发、灌木边缘或剪下票券 (hedges / hair / coupons) · crop: 将头发剪得很短、修平植株顶端 (hair / ears / pasture) · shave off: 贴皮刮除胡须毛发，或微量削减时间厚度 (beard / seconds / wood) · fleece: 剪取整只羊的羊毛，引申彻底诈取钱财 (sheep / victim / tourists)

groups.name: Shed Light Upon · 照亮与阐释 (Illuminate, Light Up, Clarify)
groups.tip: 投射光芒驱散黑暗处

items.def_en: Make something bright with light, or become bright and animated.
items.ex_en: Dozens of colorful lanterns light up the festive town square during the holiday festival.
items.ex_zh: 节日期间，数十盏色彩斑斓的灯笼照亮了热闹的小镇广场。
items.ex2_en: Her expressive face lights up with sheer joy whenever her grandchildren visit her.
items.ex2_zh: 每当孙辈们来探望时，她生动的脸庞上都会洋溢起纯粹的喜悦。

items.def_en: Provide clarifying information that makes an obscure situation easier to understand.
items.ex_en: The newly discovered archival documents shed light on the controversial decision to declare war.
items.ex_zh: 最新发现的档案文件，为那项引发争议的宣战决定提供了清晰解释。

items.def_en: 1. To shine light on something and make it bright or visible. 2. To make a complex subject, text, or issue clear and easy to understand.
items.ex_en: The professor used ancient legal manuscripts to illuminate the subtle evolution of maritime law.
items.ex_zh: 教授利用古代法律文献，阐明了海商法演变的微妙脉络。

items.def_en: Make something more luminous or clear, or become lighter in appearance.
items.ex_en: A sudden burst of bright morning sunshine helped brighten the gloomy attic room.
items.ex_zh: 一缕突然穿透云层的晨曦，照亮了阴暗沉闷的阁楼房间。
items.ex2_en: The morning sky brightened noticeably as the warm sun peeked over the horizon.
items.ex2_zh: 随着温暖的太阳从地平线探出头来，晨空明显亮堂了起来。

items.def_en: Light something up physically or enlighten someone spiritually or intellectually.
items.ex_en: A sudden profound revelation seemed to illumine his weary, sorrowful soul in darkness.
items.ex_zh: 在黑暗之中，突如其来的深刻顿悟仿佛照亮了他疲惫而悲伤的灵魂。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to casting physical radiance upon objects to make them clearly visible, or metaphorically shedding intellectual light upon obscure ideas, texts, and problems.
groups.summary_zh: 表示在物理上投射光芒使其明亮可见，或在比喻义上阐释、澄清疑难问题。
groups.desc_en: Denotes casting visible radiance upon physical objects or intellectually dispelling obscurity to render truths understandable, contrasting with keeping in the dark.
groups.desc_zh: 指物理上投射光线照亮物体，或在认知上驱散蒙昧、阐明隐秘真相，区别于遮蔽隐瞒。
groups.nuance_en: illuminate: flood with light physically, or clarify an intellectual mystery deeply (street / manuscripts / problem) · light up: suddenly brighten with physical brilliance or joyful expression (room / sky / face) · shed light on: provide explanatory clues that make a mystery comprehensible (mystery / origins / topic) · brighten: enhance the luminosity, color, or cheerfulness of a space (room / prospects / day) · illumine: poetically or spiritually enlighten and illuminate (mind / darkness / soul)
groups.nuance_zh: illuminate: 强光物理照亮，或在学术/智力上深刻阐明 (street / manuscripts / problem) · light up: 瞬间照亮夜空，或面露喜色容光焕发 (room / sky / face) · shed light on: 揭示线索、提供解释以解开谜团 (mystery / origins / topic) · brighten: 提高环境亮度，或使前景/心情变得明朗 (room / prospects / day) · illumine: 诗意或灵性层面上的启蒙与照耀 (mind / darkness / soul)

groups.name: Shelter & Canopy with Foliage · 绿荫庇护与笼罩 (Bower, Canopy, Shade)
groups.tip: 绿荫或掩蔽处提供庇护

items.def_en: To shelter someone or an area from direct sunlight or intense glare
items.ex_en: Sprawling willow branches shade the stone park benches from the midday summer heat.
items.ex_zh: 舒展的柳树枝条为公园里的石凳遮阴，挡住了正午的夏日炎热。

items.def_zh: 遮蔽，笼罩（多用于文学描写）
items.def_en: (literary) To cover or enclose completely from view, like vegetation, mist, or darkness
items.ex_en: Ancient weeping trees enshroud the ruined chapel in permanent, solemn emerald gloom.
items.ex_zh: 古老的垂柳将废弃的小教堂完全笼罩在一片幽深肃穆的浓绿树荫之中。

items.def_zh: 用树木/屏障隔开或遮挡
items.def_en: To shelter or obscure an area from sight or wind using hedges, trees, or screens
items.ex_en: They planted a dense row of junipers to screen off the noisy playground completely.
items.ex_zh: 他们种植了一排茂密的桧柏，将喧闹的游乐场严密地遮挡开来。

items.def_en: To cover, overarch, or form a protective natural roof over something
items.ex_en: Intertwining ancient elms canopy the secluded gravel road with thick, vibrant summer foliage.
items.ex_zh: 交错古老的榆树以茂密的夏日枝叶，如穹顶般覆蔽着僻静的碎石小道。

items.def_en: (literary) To enclose, shade, or shelter someone or something with leafy branches or trees.
items.ex_en: Climbing wild roses and ancient ivy bower the peaceful courtyard in fragrant green shade.
items.ex_zh: 攀爬的野蔷薇与古老常春藤以芬芳的绿荫，将宁静的庭院环抱遮蔽。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on natural or overhead shielding, specifically enclosing, arching over, or sheltering people or spaces beneath foliage, trees, or vegetative coverings.
groups.summary_zh: 指用树木枝叶、绿植或顶盖如凉亭般庇护、遮蔽或笼罩。
groups.desc_en: Denotes shading, sheltering, or overarching an area with a dense woven ceiling of branches and foliage, contrasting with bare masonry roofs or exposed open fields.
groups.desc_zh: 指利用枝叶形成的天然拱顶将空间遮蔽、笼罩并提供绿荫庇护，区别于冰冷的人工砖石屋顶或毫无遮蔽的荒原。
groups.nuance_en: canopy: form a dense high arching ceiling of leaves over an area (forest / trees / sky) · bower: shelter, enclose, or screen deeply inside leafy boughs (garden / lane / cottage) · shade: block direct solar radiation under foliage (lawn / patio / riverbank) · screen off: use a hedge or green barrier to isolate and hide from view (garden / patio / view) · enshroud: wrap completely in a dense, obscure mantle of mist or leaves (mountain / trees / valley)
groups.nuance_zh: canopy: 高大树冠如华盖般遮蔽上方 (forest / trees / sky) · bower: 绿荫环抱、掩映于枝叶形成的幽静凉亭中 (garden / lane / cottage) · shade: 绿树投下阴凉以遮挡烈日 (lawn / patio / riverbank) · screen off: 利用树篱屏障隔绝外界视线 (garden / patio / view) · enshroud: 如同裹尸布或浓雾般严密笼罩隐匿 (mountain / trees / valley)

groups.name: Shelter & Safeguard · 庇护与遮蔽 (Shield, Screen, Protect)
groups.tip: 提供遮蔽并防受伤害

items.def_en: To provide shelter or accommodation for people, animals, or objects
items.ex_en: The municipal community shelter was refurbished to house dozens of displaced families safely.
items.ex_zh: 市政社区避难所经过翻修，用以为数十户流离失所的家庭提供安全住宿。

items.def_en: To conceal, protect, or shelter someone or something behind a barrier
items.ex_en: A row of dense evergreens screens the private sun patio from nosy neighbors.
items.ex_zh: 一排茂密的常青树挡住了爱管闲事的邻居视线，庇护着私人露台。

items.def_zh: 保护，掩蔽，庇护；躲避（风雨、危险等）
items.def_en: 1. to protect someone or something from danger, bad weather, or harm. 2. to seek protection or take refuge.
items.ex_en: The crumbling stone overhang sheltered the shivering lost hikers from the driving rain.
items.ex_zh: 残破的悬岩为瑟瑟发抖的迷路徒步者遮挡了狂风暴雨。
items.ex2_en: The frightened villagers sheltered inside the ancient stone church during the raging bombardment.
items.ex2_zh: 在猛烈的炮击中，惊恐的村民们躲进古老的石头教堂里避难。

items.def_en: To hide or take shelter in a secure or secluded place until danger passes
items.ex_en: The armed fugitives chose to hole up in an abandoned cabin until nightfall.
items.ex_zh: 持枪逃犯们选择躲进一座废弃的小木屋里避难，直到夜幕降临。

items.def_en: To provide lodging, space, or shelter for someone
items.ex_en: The renovated grand lodge can easily accommodate over two hundred conference guests overnight.
items.ex_zh: 翻新后的大型度假旅舍能轻松容纳两百多名与会宾客过夜下榻。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on shielding living beings or fragile things from external harm, inclement weather, or immediate physical danger, whether providing refuge or actively seeking it.
groups.summary_zh: 指提供或寻求物理屏障与安全处所，免受风雨、灾害或外界危害侵袭。
groups.desc_en: Denotes providing physical refuge, lodging, or protective containment from hostile weather, danger, or inspection, contrasting with abandoning to exposure.
groups.desc_zh: 指为人员或物品提供抵御恶劣天气、外界危险或搜查的实体避难所或容纳空间，区别于暴露遗弃。
groups.nuance_en: shelter: protect from harsh elements, bombardment, or pursuit (refugees / family / storm) · shield: place a defensive screen directly in front of danger (victim / eyes / blast) · house: provide institutional, structural living quarters or storage (collection / residents / equipment) · screen: hide or protect from hostile surveillance or wind (camp / porch / operations) · hole up: hide away stubbornly in a concealed redoubt or retreat (cabin / gang / winter)
groups.nuance_zh: shelter: 提供避难所抵御风暴、战火或追捕 (refugees / family / storm) · shield: 充当防盾直接挡在危险前阻击 (victim / eyes / blast) · house: 提供固定住处安置人员或妥善收纳设备 (collection / residents / equipment) · screen: 设屏障掩蔽以防敌方窥视或狂风侵袭 (camp / porch / operations) · hole up: 蜷缩隐匿在隐蔽窝点或暗处避风头 (cabin / gang / winter)

groups.name: Shoe & Iron Livestock · 挂掌与装配 (Shoe, Calhoon, Plate)
groups.tip: 为器具进行装配、修补或调校

items.def_en: To fit a horse or other animal with iron horseshoes
items.ex_en: The experienced village blacksmith had to shoe several heavy work draft horses this morning.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的村里铁匠今天上午得给好几匹沉重的干活挽马钉蹄铁。

items.def_en: To replace worn horseshoes with a new set of protective metal shoes
items.ex_en: The groom hired an experienced farrier to re-shoe the mare before the competition.
items.ex_zh: 马夫在比赛前聘请了一位老练的蹄铁匠，为母马重新钉上新蹄铁。

items.def_en: To shoe a racehorse with lightweight aluminum or steel racing plates
items.ex_en: The trainer told the stable assistant to plate the thoroughbred before the derby race.
items.ex_zh: 练马师吩咐马厩助手在德比大赛前为这匹纯血赛马钉上轻质金属掌。

items.def_zh: 为（马）钉蹄铁；用渡船运送
items.def_en: 1. (rare) To shoe a horse (as a farrier); or to transport by ferry.
items.ex_en: The village blacksmith arrived at sunrise to ferrier the spirited young stallion.
items.ex_zh: 破晓时分，村里的铁匠便赶来为那匹精神抖擞的年轻公马钉上蹄铁。

items.def_en: To fit a horseshoe with pointed cleats or studs to prevent slipping
items.ex_en: The master ostler took care to calk the horseshoes before the icy patrol.
items.ex_zh: 在冰雪路面上巡逻之前，老马夫特意在马蹄铁上装好防滑铁齿。

groups.summary_en: This specialized mechanical-husbandry frame involves trimming hooves and nailing or fitting protective metal shoes onto draught animals and horses.
groups.summary_zh: 给牲畜修剪蹄质并钉上护蹄铁掌或专用金属垫片。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the craft of fitting, securing, or modifying metal protection onto hooves, distinct from general dressing or armoring by its specialized veterinary blacksmithing context.
groups.desc_zh: 指为牲畜蹄部装配、紧固或修整金属防护物的专业铁匠工序，区别于通用的穿戴或披甲防护。
groups.nuance_en: shoe: fit with protective metal horseshoes (horse / hoof / pony) · re-shoe: replace worn hooves with fresh shoes (mount / horse / mare) · plate: fit lightweight metal racing shoes (thoroughbred / racehorse / runner) · calk: fit cleats or sharp lugs to shoes for traction (shoe / boot / hoof)
groups.nuance_zh: shoe: 为蹄部装订标准铁掌 (horse / hoof / pony) · re-shoe: 拆除旧掌重新钉蹄 (mount / horse / mare) · plate: 为赛马钉上轻质薄合金掌 (thoroughbred / racehorse / runner) · calk: 在马掌上加装防滑抓地齿 (shoe / boot / hoof)

groups.name: Shortcut & Work Around · 取巧与变通提效 (Hack, Bodge, MacGyver)
groups.tip: 巧用妙招提高操作效率

items.def_zh: 绕开，变通避开（限制或困难）
items.def_en: To bypass or circumvent a problem or procedural restriction using an alternative method
items.ex_en: The software bug was serious, but the engineering team found a way to work around it.
items.ex_zh: 这个软件故障很严重，但工程团队找到了绕过它的解决办法。

items.def_en: To devise an ingenious, pragmatic modification or shortcut to handle a task or problem
items.ex_en: He managed to hack an old smartphone into a reliable home security camera system.
items.ex_zh: 他巧妙改造了一部旧智能手机，把它变成了可靠的家庭安防监控系统。

items.def_zh: 巧用妙招提高效率，运用生活窍门
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To use clever, simple tricks or shortcuts to manage daily tasks or work more efficiently.
items.ex_en: She learned how to lifehack her morning routine with simple, pre-packed meal jars.
items.ex_zh: 她学会了用事先分装好的便当罐作为妙招，大大提高了晨间流程的效率。

items.def_en: To make, fix, or adapt something in an improvised and inventive way using whatever objects are at hand
items.ex_en: We had to MacGyver a makeshift fan using cardboard and an old laptop cooler.
items.ex_zh: 我们不得不就地取材，用硬纸板和旧笔记本散热垫巧修拼凑出一个应急风扇。

items.def_zh: 仓促拼凑，草草搭凑应急
items.def_en: To assemble, build, or repair something hastily using makeshift or improvised materials
items.ex_en: The crew had to jury-rig a temporary steering rudder after the storm hit.
items.ex_zh: 暴风雨袭击过后，船员们不得不草草搭凑一个应急的方向舵。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on applying informal, clever improvisations or pragmatic shortcuts to circumvent complexity and solve problems quickly. Unlike institutional streamlining, these actions rely on personal ingenuity and resourceful workarounds.
groups.summary_zh: 强调运用聪明技巧、变通窍门或临时拼凑手段来快捷省事地解决问题。
groups.desc_en: Involves bypassing standard protocols or improvising resourceful technical fixes, contrasting with standard systematic troubleshooting or legitimate procedural redesign.
groups.desc_zh: 指绕过标准规程或利用现有材料拼凑临时解决方案，区别于规范系统的故障排除或制度化重构。
