groups.nuance_en: work around: circumvent a restriction or system flaw procedurally (issue / limitation / obstacle) · hack: cleverly alter or adapt code or systems non-standardly (system / solution / code) · MacGyver: improvise ingenious fixes from crude everyday items (repair / contraption / escape) · jury-rig: quickly cobble together an ad-hoc, rickety fix (rigging / shelter / engine)
groups.nuance_zh: work around: 绕开系统缺陷或规程限制行事 (issue / limitation / obstacle) · hack: 巧用非规范技巧破解或改造系统 (system / solution / code) · MacGyver: 利用随手简陋物件拼凑出精妙解法 (repair / contraption / escape) · jury-rig: 应急草率搭建凑合使用的临时装置 (rigging / shelter / engine)

groups.name: Shout & Yell · 大声呼喊与叫嚷 (Holler, Shout, Bellow)
groups.tip: 放开喉咙高声呼喊，声音响亮传远

items.def_en: To speak or cry out in a very loud voice, usually to be heard at a distance
items.ex_en: He had to shout into the howling wind to make himself heard clearly.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不迎着呼啸的狂风大声呼喊，才能让别人听清自己的声音。

items.def_en: To shout something very loudly, especially because of strong emotion or noise
items.ex_en: Desperate fans began to yell at the referee after the controversial offside call.
items.ex_zh: 在一次备受争议的越位判罚后，情绪失控的球迷们开始对裁判厉声叫嚷。

items.def_en: To shout in a deep, booming voice, typically in anger or pain
items.ex_en: The furious drill sergeant bellowed his orders across the noisy muddy training field.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的训练教官穿过嘈杂泥泞的训练场，如雷般咆哮着下达命令。

items.def_en: (informal) To shout or yell very loudly; to complain or protest.
items.ex_en: Stop hollering across the yard and just come inside to tell me.
items.ex_zh: 别隔着院子大喊大叫了，直接进来跟我说吧。

items.def_en: To shout or call out noisily and unrestrainedly, often accompanied by tears
items.ex_en: Street vendors bawled out their fresh produce to the bustling morning crowd.
items.ex_zh: 街头小贩扯着嗓子向熙熙攘攘的早市人群叫卖新鲜果蔬。

groups.summary_en: Everyday and colloquial verbs describing loudly projecting one's voice across distance to attract attention, impart urgency, or express anger.
groups.summary_zh: 表示拉开嗓门高呼、扯着喉咙喊叫以引起注意或发泄情绪。
groups.desc_en: Involves projecting the voice at maximum volume, distinguished from regular speech or crying by acoustic force and varying emotional triggers.
groups.desc_zh: 指凭借高声强爆发性发声，区别于常规说话或哭泣，强调声压强度与特定的情绪驱动。
groups.nuance_en: shout: produce a sudden loud vocal burst for distance or emphasis (warning / command / abuse) · yell: utter a sharp piercing cry of pain, anger, or excitement (protest / agony / insult) · bellow: emit a deep, reverberating roar like an animal (rage / laugh / order) · holler: call loudly across distance in an informal manner (greeting / distance / help) · bawl: weep noisily or roar out with crude force (cries / order / insult)
groups.nuance_zh: shout: 为传声或强调而突然大声叫喊 (warning / command / abuse) · yell: 因剧痛、狂怒或兴奋发出的尖厉叫嚷 (protest / agony / insult) · bellow: 发出如公牛般低沉震耳的吼叫 (rage / laugh / order) · holler: 非正式地扯着嗓子大声呼唤 (greeting / distance / help) · bawl: 粗野大吼或放声号啕大哭 (cries / order / insult)

groups.name: Show & Demonstrate · 展示与演示 (Demonstrate, Exhibit, Display)
groups.tip: 陈列展示公开呈现

items.def_en: to introduce, display, or set forth something formally for consideration, inspection, or viewing
items.ex_en: The committee presented its annual budget proposal to the board of directors.
items.ex_zh: 委员会向董事会正式提交了年度预算提案。

items.def_en: to clearly show the existence, truth, or practical operation of something by giving proof or an active exhibition
items.ex_en: The lab technician demonstrated the proper procedure for handling hazardous chemical waste.
items.ex_zh: 实验员现场演示了处理危险化学废物的规范流程。

items.def_en: to show something publicly in an exhibition, museum, or formal demonstration
items.ex_en: Several rare manuscripts will be exhibited at the national gallery next month.
items.ex_zh: 几件珍稀手稿将于下月在国家美术馆公开展出。

items.def_en: to guide someone through a process or demonstrate each step of a system systematically
items.ex_en: Let me walk you through the new software setup process step by step.
items.ex_zh: 让我带你一步一步熟悉这款新软件的安装配置流程。

items.def_zh: 演示，示范，展示；录制样本唱片
items.def_en: (informal) 1. to demonstrate how a product or software works. 2. to record a demonstration version of a song.
items.ex_en: Our lead developer will demo the new app features at tomorrow's meetup.
items.ex_zh: 我们的主程序员将在明天的见面会上演示这款应用的新功能。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on showing how something works or presenting its features to an audience or customer, often for instructional, persuasive, or promotional purposes.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过实操、展览或说明向他人具体展示产品功能或事物面貌。
groups.desc_en: Involves actively revealing features, functions, or evidence to an audience, contrasting with passive perception (see/notice) or mere static presence.
groups.desc_zh: 指主动向受众展示属性、功能操作或证据，区别于被动的“看见”或纯粹的静止存在。
groups.nuance_en: present: formally submit or introduce something for evaluation (findings / proposal / case) · demonstrate: prove a principle or illustrate how something works step-by-step (method / capability / technique) · exhibit: publicly display specimens, artworks, or qualities (work / symptoms / art) · walk through: explain a complex process in sequential detail (steps / code / scenario) · demo: give an informal operational preview of a product (prototype / software / device)
groups.nuance_zh: present: 正式引见或递交提案以供审阅 (findings / proposal / case) · demonstrate: 演示操作步骤或实证某一原理 (method / capability / technique) · exhibit: 公开展出作品、实物或显露特质 (work / symptoms / art) · walk through: 循序渐进地梳理复杂流程 (steps / code / scenario) · demo: 对产品或软件进行实机运行预览 (prototype / software / device)

groups.name: Shower with & Lavish Gifts · 倾倒式赏赐与厚赠 (Shower, Lavish, Heap)
groups.tip: 慷慨且大量地倾洒给予

items.def_zh: 大量给予，倾注；大量泼洒；淋浴
items.def_en: 1. To give someone a great number of gifts, compliments, or insults in lavish amounts. 2. To fall or pour down in a shower; to wash oneself in a shower.
items.ex_en: Proud grandparents showered the newborn baby with countless expensive clothes and toys.
items.ex_zh: 自豪的祖父母给新生儿送了数不清的昂贵衣物和玩具。

items.def_zh: 大量给予；堆积（赞誉或礼物）
items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To bestow large quantities of gifts, praise, or criticism upon someone
items.ex_en: Critics heaped lavish praise upon the young director's groundbreaking debut film.
items.ex_zh: 影评人们对这位年轻导演开创性的处女作大加赞赏。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To give something generously, profusely, or in extravagant amounts
items.ex_en: The monarch lavished vast estates and glittering jewels upon his favored general.
items.ex_zh: 君主将大片庄园和璀璨珠宝厚赐予他心爱的将军。

items.def_zh: 接连供给；不断塞给（食物/礼物）
items.def_en: (+ with) To continually provide or urge someone with food, drink, or gifts
items.ex_en: Our gracious host plied every guest with spiced wine and rich delicacies.
items.ex_zh: 热情的东道主不断给每位客人端上香料热酒和珍馐佳肴。

items.def_zh: 铺天盖地送给；使应接不暇
items.def_en: (+ with) To overwhelm someone with a huge, uncontrollable flood of gifts, letters, or offers
items.ex_en: The charitable organization was inundated with generous donations following the televised appeal.
items.ex_zh: 电视呼吁播出后，该慈善机构收到了铺天盖地的慷慨捐赠。

groups.summary_en: This frame emphasizes an excessive, overwhelming intensity of giving, bestowing gifts, praises, or favors in great abundance. It highlights the sheer volume, extravagance, and relentless generosity of the benefactor.
groups.summary_zh: 极尽慷慨地大量赠予礼品、宠爱、赞赏或资源。
groups.desc_en: Expresses overwhelming someone with abundant gifts, praise, or attentions, contrasting with balanced, measured distribution or stingy giving.
groups.desc_zh: 指以倾泻般的大量馈赠、赞誉或关注压倒对方，区别于克制匀称的给予或吝啬分发。
groups.nuance_en: shower: rain copious gestures or items down upon someone (praise / gifts / affection) · lavish: expend or bestow extravagant generosity (luxuries / hospitality / attention) · heap: pile up intangibles or honors profusely (honors / scorn / compliments) · ply: persistently press upon someone with offerings (drinks / food / questions) · inundate: overwhelm as if submerged by a flood (requests / offers / letters)
groups.nuance_zh: shower: 如雨倾盆般密集倾泻好意或物品 (praise / gifts / affection) · lavish: 极其豪奢无度地挥洒赏赐与款待 (luxuries / hospitality / attention) · heap: 堆积如山般奉上赞誉或泼洒耻辱 (honors / scorn / compliments) · ply: 连番不断地向人劝进供应 (drinks / food / questions) · inundate: 滔滔洪流般彻底淹没并压垮对方 (requests / offers / letters)

groups.name: Shrink & Constrict · 紧缩勒窄与挤压压迫 (Constrict, Contract, Stragulate)
groups.tip: 体积变小或管径收紧

items.def_en: To become smaller, shorter, or tighter through physiological tension, cooling, or compression
items.ex_en: Cold temperatures cause the metal beams to contract slightly during winter months.
items.ex_zh: 寒冷的温度会使金属梁在冬季略微收缩。
items.ex2_en: Cold winter temperatures quickly contract the rubber seals around the drafty exterior windows.
items.ex2_zh: 冬天的低温很快使通风不良的室外窗户周围的橡胶密封圈收缩。

items.def_en: To squeeze painfully between two hard surfaces, causing localized compression or tightness
items.ex_en: These stiff new dress shoes pinch my toes terribly whenever I walk.
items.ex_zh: 这些僵硬的新皮鞋每次走路都把我的脚趾勒得生疼。

items.def_en: To become firmer or narrower with increased tension, or to pull a strap, grip, or passage taut
items.ex_en: Make sure you tighten all the safety harness straps before climbing up.
items.ex_zh: 攀爬前一定要把所有安全带扣勒紧。
items.ex2_en: His chest tightened noticeably as anxiety washed over him during the difficult interview.
items.ex2_zh: 在艰难的面试中，随着焦虑感涌上心头，他的胸口明显发紧了。

items.def_en: To kill or restrict by squeezing the neck, throat, or supply conduits tightly so air or flow ceases
items.ex_en: Excessive bureaucracy threatened to strangle the innovative drive of the young startup.
items.ex_zh: 过度的官僚作风恐将扼杀这家初创企业的创新活力。

items.def_en: 1. To become tighter and narrower, or to make something tighter and narrower. 2. To limit or restrict someone's freedom or ability to act.
items.ex_en: Nicotine causes peripheral blood vessels to constrict, significantly elevating blood pressure levels.
items.ex_zh: 尼古丁会使外周血管收缩，从而显著升高血压水平。
items.ex2_en: His inflamed airway constricted dangerously, making it extremely difficult for him to breathe.
items.ex2_zh: 他发炎的气道危险地收缩狭窄，使他呼吸变得极其困难。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on physical tightening, compressive narrowing, or vascular spasm that pinches, limits, or chokes passage and blood supply. 'Constrict' emphasizes squeezing inwards (e.g., pupils or airways), distinct from thermal 'contract' or mechanical 'pinch'.
groups.summary_zh: 指生理肌体、管道或物理对象受压迫收紧挤窄，甚至窒息受限。
groups.desc_en: Denotes inward narrowing, squeezing, or circumferential reduction of volume or lumen, contrasting with simple dimensional shortening or unforced decay.
groups.desc_zh: 指沿周向收紧、勒紧或截面积缩小，区别于单纯的长度缩短或自然的萎缩消亡。
groups.nuance_en: contract: draw together internally, decreasing total volume or span (muscle / economy / pupil) · constrict: tighten circumferentially around a channel or aperture (vessel / airflow / freedom) · pinch: squeeze sharply between two opposing points (nerve / skin / shoes) · tighten: make taut or reduce slack in a loop or restriction (grip / belt / restrictions) · strangle: compress the throat or cut off life-giving flow (breath / airflow / growth)
groups.nuance_zh: contract: 肌肉收缩或经济体总体规模自然缩减 (muscle / economy / pupil) · constrict: 腔管受压勒紧或自由受箍缩紧窄 (vessel / airflow / freedom) · pinch: 在两点间受夹受挤产生压痛 (nerve / skin / shoes) · tighten: 收紧带状物或进一步拉紧限制 (grip / belt / restrictions) · strangle: 扼紧咽喉窒息或彻底扼杀生机 (breath / airflow / growth)

groups.name: Shuttle & Commute · 往返与定期穿梭 (Shuttle, Commute, Ferry)
groups.tip: 在两地之间频繁来回奔波

items.def_en: To transport people or goods frequently from one place to another across water or along a fixed route
items.ex_en: Small wooden boats ferry daily commuters across the river every ten minutes.
items.ex_zh: 小型木船每隔十分钟就摆渡通勤者过河一次。

items.def_zh: 穿梭往返，往返穿行；往返运送
items.def_en: to travel or carry people or goods frequently back and forth between two places
items.ex_en: A private van shuttles hotel guests back and forth to the airport.
items.ex_zh: 一辆私家面包车在酒店和机场之间往返接送客人。
items.ex2_en: Commuters shuttled back and forth between the two bustling train stations every morning.
items.ex2_zh: 每天早晨，通勤者们在两个繁华的火车站之间来回穿梭。

items.def_en: To travel regularly between one's place of work and one's home
items.ex_en: Many suburban residents commute into the city center by passenger train daily.
items.ex_zh: 许多郊区居民每天乘旅客列车往返市区上下班。

items.def_en: To travel regularly along a route, especially a nautical or commercial trade path
items.ex_en: Stately merchant vessels once plied these ancient Mediterranean coastal trading routes.
items.ex_zh: 威严的商船曾经定期往返穿行于这些古老的地中海沿海贸易航道。

items.def_en: To walk repeatedly or wearily from one place to another, often without enthusiasm
items.ex_en: I had to traipse all over town looking for that missing document.
items.ex_zh: 为了找那份丢失的文件，我只得疲惫不堪地跑遍了全城。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses repetitive transit between two specific fixed locations. It covers both individual travelers navigating habitual routes and transport vehicles designated to convey passengers back and forth.
groups.summary_zh: 指在两个固定地点之间周期性、固定路线往返运送或通勤。
groups.desc_en: Captures systematic, repetitive back-and-forth movement across a fixed route, distinct from open-ended wandering, one-way transit, or continuous progression.
groups.desc_zh: 指在固定路线上进行的周期性、规律性往返穿梭，区别于无终点的漫游、单向迁徙或单程行驶。
groups.nuance_en: shuttle: travel rapidly back and forth between two specific hubs (passengers / buses / diplomacy) · commute: travel regularly between home and workplace (distance / miles / daily) · ferry: convey people or goods across a water barrier or short gap (passengers / supplies / tourists) · ply: run regularly along a commercial shipping or travel route (waters / trade / route) · traipse: trek repeatedly or wearily without elegance (across town / upstairs / streets)
groups.nuance_zh: shuttle: 在两固定点间高频次往复运送穿梭 (passengers / buses / diplomacy) · commute: 在住所与工作地之间规律通勤 (distance / miles / daily) · ferry: 摆渡越过水域或短途运送人货 (passengers / supplies / tourists) · ply: 沿固定商路航线定期巡航往来 (waters / trade / route) · traipse: 疲惫拖沓地来回奔走于各地 (across town / upstairs / streets)

groups.name: Sift & Cherry-Pick · 挑拣与抽选 (Sift, Winnow, Cherry-Pick)
groups.tip: 去粗取精挑选可用之才

items.def_en: To choose someone or something from a larger group for special treatment or attention
items.ex_en: It is unfair to single out one player when the whole team performed poorly.
items.ex_zh: 在全队表现都很差的情况下，单单挑出一名球员来责备是不公平的。

items.def_zh: 择优挑选，挑选最有利的
items.def_en: To choose the best or most desirable items or people selectively and self-servingly
items.ex_en: He just cherry-picked the easiest assignments and left the rest to us.
items.ex_zh: 他光挑最轻松的差事做，把剩下的脏活全留给了我们。

items.def_zh: 挑选，甄选；（为控制种群而）捕杀
items.def_en: 1. (+ from) To select or gather best or useful items or information from various sources. 2. To kill selected animals from a group to control the population.
items.ex_en: The researcher culled historical evidence from hundreds of regional public archives.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员从数百份地方公共档案中甄选出了历史证据。

items.def_en: (+ through) To examine information or items closely to isolate what is useful or valuable
items.ex_en: Detectives spent weeks sifting through endless files to find the decisive clue.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们花了好几周时间细查无尽的案卷，以寻找决定性线索。

items.def_en: (+ out) To separate the good, useful, or desirable parts of something from the bad
items.ex_en: Time will inevitably winnow out transient fads from enduring literary masterpieces.
items.ex_zh: 时间终将淘洗甄别出一时的潮流与传世的文学杰作。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on sorting through a large mass of material, data, or individuals to extract the finest elements or purge the defective ones.
groups.summary_zh: 指以甄别或精细辨别的方式从庞杂对象中择优录取或剔除次品。
groups.desc_en: Describes isolating elements from a larger mass based on quality, utility, or bias, contrasting with random sampling or wholesale collection.
groups.desc_zh: 指依据品质优劣、特定功用或偏好从群体中筛选，区别于无差别的随机抽样或整体打包收拢。
groups.nuance_en: sift: filter meticulously through bulk matter to find hidden grains or truths (evidence / sand / ashes) · winnow: separate the fine and valuable from the worthless chaff (candidates / grain / list) · cull: remove inferior or surplus individuals to balance the whole (herd / data / weaklings) · cherry-pick: exploitatively select only the most favorable examples (data / facts / cases) · single out: focus on one particular item for praise, blame, or scrutiny (target / individual / flaw)
groups.nuance_zh: sift: 如筛网般细密过滤以找出隐匿证据 (evidence / sand / ashes) · winnow: 扬尘去秕般汰劣留精以缩减名单 (candidates / grain / list) · cull: 为控制整体结构而剔除老弱盈余 (herd / data / weaklings) · cherry-pick: 机会主义式挑拣最有利的事实或论据 (data / facts / cases) · single out: 独独挑出一项施以针对性审视或夸赞 (target / individual / flaw)

groups.name: Sigh & Moan · 叹息与呻吟 (Sigh, Groan, Moan)
groups.tip: 伴随情绪或痛楚的深沉叹息

items.def_en: To draw and release a deep, noticeable breath expressing weariness or resignation
items.ex_en: The weary traveler heaved a deep sigh and laid his burden down.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的旅人发出一声深长的叹息，放下了行囊。

items.def_en: To breathe out slowly and audibly, expressing sadness, tiredness, relief, or frustration; to say something with a sigh.
items.ex_en: She sighed with immense relief after hearing the medical test results.
items.ex_zh: 听到体检结果后，她如释重负地长叹了一口气。

items.def_en: To utter a long, low sound of distress, physical suffering, or sexual pleasure
items.ex_en: The injured hiker moaned softly until the rescue team finally arrived.
items.ex_zh: 受伤的徒步者痛苦地低声呻吟，直到救援队最终赶到。

items.def_en: To catch one's breath suddenly in shock, amazement, or breathlessness
items.ex_en: Spectators gasped in horror as the acrobat lost his precarious balance.
items.ex_zh: 当杂技演员失去不稳的平衡时，观众们吓得倒抽一口冷气。

items.def_en: To make a deep, involuntary sound expressing severe pain, grief, or annoyance
items.ex_en: The injured player groaned loudly as the paramedics examined his twisted knee.
items.ex_zh: 医护人员检查扭伤的膝盖时，受伤的队员疼得失声呻吟。

groups.summary_en: Verbs designating low, involuntary, or emotive vocal exhalations registering fatigue, despair, relief, frustration, or bodily pain.
groups.summary_zh: 描述因悲伤、疲乏、释然或肉体痛苦而深呼气或发出低沉哼声。
groups.desc_en: Covers deep involuntary or semi-voluntary vocalizations of respiration reflecting distress, weariness, or pain, distinguished from deliberate articulate complaints.
groups.desc_zh: 指反映苦楚、疲乏或痛苦的非自愿呼吸性发声，区别于条理分明的口头抱怨。
groups.nuance_en: sigh: release a long audible exhalation showing fatigue, relief, or resignation (relief / exasperation / resignation) · heave a sigh: draw a heavy, labored, theatrical sigh from deep within (despair / weariness / longing) · moan: emit a sustained low inarticulate sound of physical suffering or sorrow (pain / pleasure / loss) · groan: utter a low guttural sound under physical burden, misery, or deep annoyance (weight / dismay / irritation) · gasp: inhale sharply and audibly through shock or lack of air (astonishment / air / shock)
groups.nuance_zh: sigh: 长吁一气以抒解疲惫、释然或无奈 (relief / exasperation / resignation) · heave a sigh: 沉重、夸张地自胸腔深处叹出一口大气 (despair / weariness / longing) · moan: 因躯体痛楚或哀伤发出的持续低吟 (pain / pleasure / loss) · groan: 在重负折磨或极度反感下喉头迸出的低沉呻吟 (weight / dismay / irritation) · gasp: 因惊骇或缺氧而急促倒抽冷气 (astonishment / air / shock)

groups.name: Signal & Gesture · 视觉示意与旗语传达 (Semaphore, Flag, Signal)
groups.tip: 用旗语或手势无声传递指令信号

items.def_en: To convey an order, warning, or information by means of gestures, lights, or audible sounds
items.ex_en: The lighthouse signaled urgent warnings to approaching ships through the dense fog.
items.ex_zh: 灯塔透过浓雾向驶来的船只发出紧急警报信号。

items.def_zh: 摇旗示意；标出引起注意
items.def_en: To signal someone or a vehicle to stop or pay attention by waving one's arms or a cloth indicator
items.ex_en: The railway worker flagged the approaching freight train with a red cloth.
items.ex_zh: 铁路工人用一块红布向驶来的货运列车挥动示警。

items.def_zh: 发旗语，用信号机发信号；用手势示意
items.def_en: to send information or communicate using hand-held flags or visual mechanical apparatus
items.ex_en: The lookout signaled vital nautical coordinates by semaphoring across the choppy waters.
items.ex_zh: 瞭望员在波涛汹涌的海面上用旗语传递关键的航海坐标。

items.def_en: To wave your hand repeatedly to signal the driver of a moving vehicle to halt
items.ex_en: She managed to wave down an empty yellow cab in the rain.
items.ex_zh: 她在雨中成功挥手拦停了一辆空驶的黄色出租车。

items.def_zh: 打手势；用肢体动作示意
items.def_en: To use dramatic or agitated hand and arm movements while expressing oneself
items.ex_en: The agitated witness gesticulated wildly while recounting the traumatic events to police.
items.ex_zh: 情绪激动的目击者在向警方叙述惨痛经过时手舞足蹈。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve communicating messages or alerting others using visible movements, apparatuses, hand-held indicators, or non-verbal body language.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过挥舞旗帜、手势、器械或视觉动作传达明确的信息或警示。
groups.desc_en: Involves conveying instructions or information via explicit visual cues or body language, distinct from spoken acoustic communication or written text.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过可见的手势、旗语或设备动作传递特定讯号，区别于有声口语或书面文本。
groups.nuance_en: signal: transmit an explicit cue to initiate action or caution (intent / turn / arrival) · flag: mark or alert someone visually to an anomaly or need to halt (taxi / error / problem) · semaphore: transmit coded optical messages using flags or arms (message / warning / position) · wave down: physically hail a moving vehicle using hand motions (cab / patrol / driver) · gesticulate: make dramatic, excited gestures while expressing oneself (wildly / hands / arms)
groups.nuance_zh: signal: 发出明确的光信号或动作指示行动 (intent / turn / arrival) · flag: 标出异常或挥动手臂示意停下 (taxi / error / problem) · semaphore: 借由旗语或机械臂摆动传递编码信息 (message / warning / position) · wave down: 伸手招停行驶中的车辆 (cab / patrol / driver) · gesticulate: 情绪激动时手舞足蹈地比画姿态 (wildly / hands / arms)

groups.name: Signpost & Map Out · 指引路径与框架 (Signpost, Map out, Delineate)
groups.tip: 树立指示标牌以指引方向路径

items.def_en: To give the main points, structure, or essential shape of something without detailed commentary
items.ex_en: The architect outlined the project parameters during the brief initial consultation.
items.ex_zh: 建筑师在简短的初步磋商中概述了项目的基本框架。

items.def_en: To plan or explain carefully the steps, details, or structure of a course of action or presentation
items.ex_en: The committee met to map out a clear strategy for the next five years.
items.ex_zh: 委员会开会为接下来的五年详细制定了清晰的战略规划。

items.def_en: To draw someone's direct visual or cognitive attention to a fact, place, or detail
items.ex_en: The guide pointed out several historic landmarks along our scenic river cruise.
items.ex_zh: 导游在风景秀丽的游船巡航沿途向我们指明了数处历史地标。

items.def_en: To describe, explain, or establish the borders or characteristics of something in vivid, exact detail
items.ex_en: The boundary treaty clearly delineates the maritime borders between both neighboring countries.
items.ex_zh: 边界条约清晰界定了两国之间的海上分界线。

items.def_zh: 设路标于；（在演讲、文章中）提示结构，指引方向
items.def_en: To mark a path or road with signs; to clearly indicate the direction, structure, or main points of a text or speech
items.ex_en: Clear transitional sentences signpost the main argument throughout the academic essay.
items.ex_zh: 清晰的过渡句在整篇学术论文中明晰地提示了核心论点。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve providing clear orienting cues, structural landmarks, or advance outlines to guide a listener, reader, or traveler through complex material.
groups.summary_zh: 指设立标志、指引路径或预先理清逻辑结构与导向。
groups.desc_en: Encompasses sketching the spatial, conceptual, or temporal boundaries and direction of an endeavor, contrasting with executing the actual work or vague theorizing.
groups.desc_zh: 指规划并勾勒项目、旅程或论述的空间边界与进阶方向，区别于具体施工落地或空洞空谈。
groups.nuance_en: map out: chart the step-by-step route, layout, or strategy for the future (plan / future / career) · outline: sketch the principal outer structure or main points concisely (points / structure / plot) · delineate: mark out clear boundaries or trace precise definitions (borders / duties / scope) · signpost: insert prominent directional markers or thematic indicators to guide the user (themes / transitions / path) · point out: direct attention specifically toward a notable fact or object (error / fact / landmark)
groups.nuance_zh: map out: 详尽绘制分步规划或战略布局图景 (plan / future / career) · outline: 简要勾画骨干框架或提纲概要 (points / structure / plot) · delineate: 精准划定边界分界线或权责范围 (borders / duties / scope) · signpost: 设立鲜明路标或在行文中提前标识结构线索 (themes / transitions / path) · point out: 明确指点某项事实、错误或景物引起注意 (error / fact / landmark)

groups.name: Silence & Hush · 沉默与肃静 (Silence, Quiet, Shush)
groups.tip: 发出嘘声让全场安静闭嘴

items.def_en: To cause to become quiet and peaceful, or become calm and quiet yourself
items.ex_en: A gentle lullaby helped quiet the restless toddler after an exhausting day.
items.ex_zh: 一首温柔的催眠曲让折腾了一整天的烦躁幼儿安静了下来。
items.ex2_en: The noisy crowd quieted completely as the famous conductor stepped onto the stage.
items.ex2_zh: 当著名的指挥家走上舞台时，吵闹的人群彻底安静了下来。

items.def_en: To make someone stop speaking or prevent criticism from being voiced
items.ex_en: Authoritarian regimes often attempt to silence critical journalists through systematic legal threats.
items.ex_zh: 独裁政权往往企图通过系统性的法律威胁来压制批评记者的声音。

items.def_en: To stop talking, shouting, or making noise, especially when ordered to
items.ex_en: You two need to pipe down before you wake up the baby.
items.ex_zh: 你们两个赶紧闭嘴，别把宝宝吵醒了。

items.def_en: 1. To become quiet or silent, or make someone stop speaking or crying. 2. ('hush up') To suppress mention of or conceal something.
items.ex_en: A sudden silence hushed the crowded banquet hall when the king entered.
items.ex_zh: 国王步入时，原本喧闹的宴会大厅顿时鸦雀无声。
items.ex2_en: The chatter hushed instantly as the stern headmaster walked into the crowded assembly.
items.ex2_zh: 当严厉的校长走进拥挤的集会时，嘈杂的交谈声立刻停息了。

items.def_en: To tell someone to be quiet by saying 'shh' or whispering softly
items.ex_en: The librarian quickly shushed the rowdy students laughing near the study desks.
items.ex_zh: 图书管理员赶忙对书桌旁大声喧哗的学生嘘了一声叫他们安静。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve causing persons or noisy environments to become quiet, or falling silent oneself through suppression, tact, or emotional tension.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动使人闭嘴息声，或环境陷入肃静与沉寂。
groups.desc_en: Represents soothing or commanding a cessation of noise toward calm, contrasting with violent physical suppression or legal gagging.
groups.desc_zh: 指使喧哗平复或呼吁肃静以恢复宁静，区别于暴力的物理堵嘴或强制性的法律禁声。
groups.nuance_en: quiet: gently reduce agitation, volume, or restlessness to a peaceful state (crowd / fears / baby) · silence: cause all noise, opposition, or sound to halt completely (critics / audience / phone) · hush: whisper or coax a group into hushed, reverent stillness (whispers / crowd / infant) · shush: urgently tell someone to be quiet by whispering 'shh' (child / audience / companion) · pipe down: colloquial order or shift to stop talking and reduce noise (heckler / classroom / room)
groups.nuance_zh: quiet: 温和安抚骚动喧闹使其归于安宁 (crowd / fears / baby) · silence: 使一切声响、争论或手机音彻底归零 (critics / audience / phone) · hush: 劝导人群屏息止息、肃穆安静下来 (whispers / crowd / infant) · shush: 发出嘘声催促他人噤声 (child / audience / companion) · pipe down: 口语化地勒令停止聒噪少说两句 (heckler / classroom / room)

groups.name: Silence & Suppress · 压制与禁声 (Gag, Muffle, Muzzle)
groups.tip: 施加强权封口并扼杀言论

items.def_en: To tell or signal someone to be quiet by making a soft rushing sound or gesture
items.ex_en: She gently shushed her anxious sister before creeping past the open door.
items.ex_zh: 在蹑手蹑脚走过敞开的房门前，她轻声嘘了一下示意焦虑的妹妹别出声。

items.def_en: (informal) To stop talking or making noise, especially when ordered to do so
items.ex_en: Tell those noisy kids in the hallway to pipe down immediately.
items.ex_zh: 叫走廊里那些吵闹的孩子立刻住嘴安静下来。

items.raw_cluster: 压制与使沉默 Silence & Suppress
items.def_zh: 使沉默，使噤声；压制，压服（批评或异议）
items.def_en: 1. To make someone stop speaking, making noise, or expressing their opinion. 2. To suppress or put an end to criticism, protests, or opposition.
items.ex_en: The sudden military crackdown silenced all public opposition throughout the troubled capital.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的军事镇压压制了动荡首都内的一切公开反对声。

items.def_en: To prevent someone from speaking or expressing an opinion publicly, often via legal or coercive force
items.ex_en: The judge issued an injunction to gag witnesses from speaking to reporters.
items.ex_zh: 法官下达了一项禁言令，禁止证人向记者透露任何情况。

items.def_en: To stop people or the press from criticizing or expressing independent opinions freely
items.ex_en: Draconian censorship laws were passed to muzzle the country's independent press.
items.ex_zh: 当局通过了严苛的审查法，旨在扼杀该国独立媒体的言论自由。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame represent compelling someone to stop speaking or restricting free expression through intimidation, legal injunctions, or physical obstruction.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过法律、威胁、封口等手段强行剥夺发声权利。
groups.desc_en: Applies severe, coercive, or institutional power to forcibly suppress voice, publication, or opposition, distinct from voluntary quietude.
groups.desc_zh: 指运用强制性、压迫性或制度性权力扼杀发声、出版或抗议，区别于自发的静默。
groups.nuance_en: gag: legally or physically block someone from speaking publicly (press / dissent / witness) · muzzle: enforce censorship or control to prevent barking criticism (critics / media / watchdog) · silence: extinguish oppositional speech permanently or ruthlessly (opposition / critics / whistleblowers) · pipe down: aggressively insist an underling cease venting (underling / rowdy / speaker) · shush: shut up dismissively or authoritarianly (dissent / complainer / debate)
groups.nuance_zh: gag: 颁布封口令或物理塞嘴阻止对外作证 (press / dissent / witness) · muzzle: 像套口枷般实行新闻管制抑制反弹 (critics / media / watchdog) · silence: 强行灭除反对派呼声或吹哨者发言 (opposition / critics / whistleblowers) · pipe down: 蛮横喝令下属闭嘴收声 (underling / rowdy / speaker) · shush: 专断而轻蔑地将异议压制下去 (dissent / complainer / debate)

groups.name: Silence & Withhold · 缄默与隐瞒 (Clam up, Stonewall, Keep mum)
groups.tip: 闭口不言并拒绝透露信息

items.def_en: To hold back strong feelings or information instead of expressing them freely
items.ex_en: You should not bottle up your bitter resentment until it explodes violently.
items.ex_zh: 你不该把满腔怨恨硬憋在心里，免得日后猛烈爆发。

items.def_zh: 闭口不言，守口如瓶；捞蛤
items.def_en: (informal) To suddenly become silent and refuse to talk or disclose information.
items.ex_en: The suspect clammed up completely the moment his defense attorney entered.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师一走进来，嫌疑人立刻闭口不言了。

items.def_en: To suppress discussion of a scandal or crime to stop the public learning about it
items.ex_en: The corrupt mayor tried desperately to hush up the financial bribery scandal.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的市长竭力掩盖这桩涉嫌经济受贿的丑闻。

items.def_en: To stop talking abruptly or refrain completely from disclosing speech
items.ex_en: He told his noisy brother to shut up during the tense movie.
items.ex_zh: 在看紧张的电影时，他叫吵闹的弟弟闭嘴。

items.def_en: To refuse to answer questions, cooperate, or disclose information intentionally
items.ex_en: The senior cabinet official stonewalled the parliamentary inquiry regarding the budget deficit.
items.ex_zh: 这位内阁高官对议会关于预算赤字的质询闭口不谈、极力阻挠。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on deliberately maintaining secrecy, withholding testimony, or stonewalling interrogators by refusing to utter a word.
groups.summary_zh: 指抗拒询问、拒不招供或刻意保守秘密的缄默态度。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on intentional, guarded, or defensive non-disclosure of critical information, contrasting with ordinary silence or honest ignorance.
groups.desc_zh: 指主观警惕或防御性地隐瞒关键内幕、拒不交代，区别于普通的沉默或不知情。
groups.nuance_en: clam up: suddenly refuse to utter another word under questioning (witness / suspect / informant) · stonewall: actively stall or refuse cooperation by giving evasive dead ends (investigation / reporters / committee) · hush up: conspire to conceal an embarrassing scandal from public knowledge (scandal / affair / mistake) · bottle up: internalize and suppress volatile emotions secretly (anger / feelings / grief) · shut up: deliberately withhold talk, often grudgingly (mouth / talk / truth)
groups.nuance_zh: clam up: 审讯盘问下突然如蚌紧闭其口 (witness / suspect / informant) · stonewall: 设下石墙般消极抵触、拖延搪塞调查 (investigation / reporters / committee) · hush up: 串通捂盖子以掩饰丑闻或重大过失 (scandal / affair / mistake) · bottle up: 隐忍压抑内心情绪不向外倾诉 (anger / feelings / grief) · shut up: 闭口不语，生硬地切断交代 (mouth / talk / truth)

groups.name: Simulate & Replicate · 模拟与仿真 (Replicate, Emulate, Reproduce)
groups.tip: 再现运行过程与行为仿真

items.def_en: Exhibit biological, chemical, or operational properties remarkably like another
items.ex_en: Synthetic peptides can mimic the precise biochemical signaling of naturally occurring hormones.
items.ex_zh: 合成肽能够模拟天然激素的精确生化信号传导。

items.def_en: Produce an identical copy, image, or simulated manifestation of something
items.ex_en: Advanced 3D printers can faithfully reproduce complex geometric models with microscopic accuracy.
items.ex_zh: 先进的三维打印机能够微米级精准地再现复杂的几何模型。
items.ex2_en: These microscopic organisms reproduce rapidly in warm, nutrient-rich laboratory water baths.
items.ex2_zh: 这些微小生物在温暖、营养丰富的实验室水浴中迅速繁殖。

items.def_en: 1. To create a model of a process or situation that reproduces its conditions. 2. To imitate the appearance or character of something.
items.ex_en: Computer models simulate changing oceanic patterns under extreme global warming scenarios.
items.ex_zh: 计算机模型在极端全球变暖情景下模拟不断变化的海洋格局。

items.def_en: Duplicate or reproduce an exact condition, experiment, or outcome precisely
items.ex_en: Independent laboratories struggled to replicate the anomalous findings reported in the paper.
items.ex_zh: 独立实验室难以精确复现那篇论文中所报告的异常实验结果。
items.ex2_en: The experimental viral strains replicate quickly inside living host cells within hours.
items.ex2_zh: 实验性病毒毒株在数小时内在活宿主细胞内迅速自我复制。

items.def_en: Match or imitate the internal hardware, software, or operating mechanisms of another system
items.ex_en: The software architecture emulates vintage console processors with flawless computational fidelity.
items.ex_zh: 该软件架构以近乎完美的运算保真度仿真运行老式主机处理器。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote creating computational, theoretical, or experimental conditions that recreate real-world phenomena or behavior. 'Simulate' and 'emulate' highlight computational mimicry or functioning equivalence.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过模型或实验环境再现真实条件与运行机制。
groups.desc_en: Involves artificially modeling, copying, or mirroring behaviors, physics, or data, contrasting with authentic generation or mere surface parody.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过人造手段建模、复制或再现物理机制与行为特征，区别于真实的原创产生或单纯的滑稽模仿。
groups.nuance_en: simulate: model the appearance or dynamic conditions of a system theoretically (flight / conditions / reality) · replicate: reproduce an experimental finding or biological structure identically (study / results / virus) · emulate: match or mirror the functioning of another architecture or peer (hardware / predecessor / success) · reproduce: bring forth an exact copy or regenerate a phenomenon (image / sound / findings) · mimic: imitate functional behavior or superficial traits closely (pattern / style / sound)
groups.nuance_zh: simulate: 建立动态仿真以模拟真实工况 (flight / conditions / reality) · replicate: 严格复现实验结果或分子复制 (study / results / virus) · emulate: 通过兼容机制在底层仿真另一软硬件架构 (hardware / predecessor / success) · reproduce: 忠实重现声像细节或再次产生该现象 (image / sound / findings) · mimic: 惟妙惟肖地仿照外在机理或样式 (pattern / style / sound)

groups.name: Sing & Chant · 歌唱与咏唱 (Chant, Intone, Croon)
groups.tip: 伴随旋律歌唱与有节奏咏诵

items.def_en: To utter words with a slow, low, and even solemn musical cadence
items.ex_en: The officiating priest intoned the traditional Latin funeral liturgy before the congregation.
items.ex_zh: 主礼神父在会众面前庄重地吟诵传统的拉丁语葬礼祷文。

items.def_en: To sing or hum softly, gently, and intimately, typically romantic tunes
items.ex_en: She gently crooned a soothing jazz melody into the vintage microphone.
items.ex_zh: 她对着复古麦克风轻柔低吟起一首舒缓的爵士旋律。

items.def_en: 1. To make musical sounds with the voice, usually following a tune or words; (of birds/insects) to produce whistling or musical sounds.
items.ex_en: A solitary robin sang sweet melodies in the branches at early dawn.
items.ex_zh: 清晨破晓时分，一只孤零零的知更鸟在枝头唱着婉转甜美的歌。

items.def_zh: 咏唱，反复有节奏地吟诵
items.def_en: To utter or sing rhythmic, repetitive phrases, often in a unison or liturgical manner
items.ex_en: Monks gathered inside the dim sanctuary to chant their solemn evening prayers.
items.ex_zh: 僧侣们聚集在昏暗的圣所内，齐声诵念庄严的晚祷文。

items.def_en: To sing a song forcefully, loudly, and enthusiastically
items.ex_en: The enthusiastic crowd belted out the famous chorus along with the band.
items.ex_zh: 热情洋溢的观众跟着乐队一同引吭高歌那段著名的副歌。

groups.summary_en: Covers making melodic, rhythmic, or ritualistic musical sounds with the voice, varying from softly murmured ballads to solemn religious recitations.
groups.summary_zh: 指以人声发出具有节奏、旋律或仪式性的歌咏与朗诵诵唱。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on the vocalization of melodic lines or rhythmic incantations, distinguished from spoken recitation or unpitched noise.
groups.desc_zh: 指以旋律线条或节奏性音调进行喉音诵唱，区别于无旋律的平淡朗诵或杂乱嗓音。
groups.nuance_en: sing: vocalize musical notes with tune and rhythm (song / tune / aria) · chant: repeat rhythmic words or slogans in monotone unison (slogans / mantra / hymns) · intone: chant or utter words sonorously and ritualistically (prayer / verse / liturgy) · croon: hum or sing in a soft, low, intimate murmur (lullaby / ballad / lyrics) · belt out: sing loudly, forcefully, and with full resonant lung capacity (anthem / ballad / chorus)
groups.nuance_zh: sing: 依曲调韵律放声歌唱 (song / tune / aria) · chant: 齐声单调重复呼喊口号或念唱经文 (slogans / mantra / hymns) · intone: 庄重沉稳地吟诵祈祷文或宣读仪礼 (prayer / verse / liturgy) · croon: 轻柔低回、温情脉脉地哼唱慢歌 (lullaby / ballad / lyrics) · belt out: 气聚丹田、极具爆发力地高亢飙歌 (anthem / ballad / chorus)

groups.name: Single Out & Pick · 甄选与单选 (Single Out, Handpick, Winnow)
groups.tip: 从群体中单独挑出目标

items.def_en: (+ for) To designate or set something aside for a specific purpose or person
items.ex_en: The city council earmarked surplus revenue for urgent road repairs this year.
items.ex_zh: 市议会将财政盈余专项划拨用于今年的紧急道路抢修。

items.def_en: To choose one person or thing from a group for special attention, praise, or criticism
items.ex_en: It is unfair to single out one player when the whole team performed poorly.
items.ex_zh: 在全队表现都很差的情况下，单单挑出一名球员来责备是不公平的。

items.def_zh: 单独挑出，选出；（棒球中）击出一垒安打
items.def_en: (also 'single out') To choose, select, or separate someone or something from a group for special attention or treatment.
items.ex_en: The coach singled out the young midfielder for his exceptional defensive performance today.
items.ex_zh: 教练特别表扬了这位年轻中场今天出色的防守表现。

items.def_en: To select only the best or most favorable items from a set while ignoring others
items.ex_en: The politician cherry-picked favorable economic statistics while ignoring the rising unemployment rate.
items.ex_zh: 该政客只挑选有利的经济数据，却忽视了不断攀升的失业率。

items.def_en: To choose someone or something very carefully and personally for a particular purpose
items.ex_en: The director decided to handpick every member of the elite research team himself.
items.ex_zh: 主任决定亲自挑选这支精锐研究团队的每一位成员。

groups.summary_en: This cognitive and operational frame denotes separating or isolating one individual or item from a broader collective for special attention, praise, criticism, or assignment. The choice involves focused differentiation.
groups.summary_zh: 指从群体中单挑或特选出某一个体，给予特殊对待、褒贬或任命。
groups.desc_en: Highlights the intentional separation of an individual or choice item from a group for special treatment, contrasting with aggregate indiscriminate processing.
groups.desc_zh: 指有意识地从群体中遴选出特定个体进行特殊对待，区别于全盘笼统的粗放处置。
groups.nuance_en: single out: select one specifically for distinction, punishment, or attention (individual / praise / criticism) · handpick: meticulously select trusted personnel or premier assets personally (team / successor / aides) · cherry-pick: selectively pluck only the easiest or most advantageous options (cases / data / opportunities) · earmark: designate funds or resources for a specified, ring-fenced purpose (funds / budget / reserves) · winnow: weed down candidates progressively to isolated elites (shortlist / choices / field)
groups.nuance_zh: single out: 独选其一以施加特殊惩戒或嘉奖 (individual / praise / criticism) · handpick: 精挑细选可信赖的心腹班底或继任者 (team / successor / aides) · cherry-pick: 拣尽便宜、挑肥拣瘦地挑选利益点 (cases / data / opportunities) · earmark: 圈定专项资金专款专用 (funds / budget / reserves) · winnow: 渐次筛减以挑出最终少数入围者 (shortlist / choices / field)

groups.name: Sip & Sample · 啜饮与慢品 (Sup, Sip, Nibble)
groups.tip: 小口慢酌与悠闲饮酒

items.def_en: To drink a small amount of something to experience its quality or taste
items.ex_en: Guests were invited to sample several rare vintages before the charity auction began.
items.ex_zh: 在慈善拍卖会开始前，宾客们受邀品尝了几款珍稀佳酿。

items.def_en: To take up liquid with rapid, delicate tongue movements
items.ex_en: The thirsty kitten began to lap fresh milk eagerly from the ceramic saucer.
items.ex_zh: 口渴的小猫开始急切地从陶瓷碟子里舔饮新鲜牛奶。

items.def_en: To drink a liquid by taking very small mouthfuls at a time
items.ex_en: She sat quietly by the window and sipped her hot chamomile tea slowly.
items.ex_zh: 她静静地坐在窗边，慢慢啜饮着热甘菊茶。

items.def_en: 1. (literary or regional) To drink a liquid by taking small mouthfuls. 2. (archaic) To eat supper.
items.ex_en: The weary traveler supped the warm broth gratefully beside the glowing hearth.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的旅人在温暖的炉火旁心满意足地喝着热汤。

items.def_en: To taste or drink something slowly in order to appreciate its full flavor
items.ex_en: He closed his eyes to savor the rich, smoky undertones of the dark roast.
items.ex_zh: 他闭上双眼，细细品味着这款深烘咖啡浓郁醇厚的烟熏余韵。

groups.summary_en: This frame highlights delicate, measured liquid intake taken in tiny mouthfuls, focusing on tasting, savoring, or careful ingestion.
groups.summary_zh: 细品浅尝的饮用方式，以小口慢饮、啜品汤水或饮品为核心特征。
groups.desc_en: Describes ingesting liquids or foods in tiny, deliberate, tasting increments to evaluate or enjoy, contrasting with hurried gulping or full meals.
groups.desc_zh: 指以微小、克制且专注的品尝分量摄入液体或食物以评判风味，区别于大口吞咽或常规充饥用餐。
groups.nuance_en: sip: drink in very small mouth-level quantities at a time (tea / wine / water) · sample: test a tiny morsel or taste to judge overall quality (flavor / dish / vintage) · savor: taste slowly and attentively to relish the fullest sensory pleasure (taste / moment / vintage) · sup: consume liquid food or broth slowly with a spoon or careful sips (soup / broth / drink) · lap: take up liquid swiftly with delicate tongue flicks (milk / water / waves)
groups.nuance_zh: sip: 小口微啜温热或名贵的液体 (tea / wine / water) · sample: 取一小撮品尝以便核验品质 (flavor / dish / vintage) · savor: 细品曼咽，充分享受美味或意境 (taste / moment / vintage) · sup: 用调羹细细喝羹汤或小心品尝汁液 (soup / broth / drink) · lap: 用舌尖轻快舔饮水乳 (milk / water / waves)

groups.name: Siphon & Drain · 抽取与分流 (Siphon, Drain, Bleed)
groups.tip: 借助外力或管道抽引排出

items.def_en: To force liquid or gas to move in a particular direction using mechanical suction.
items.ex_en: The emergency crew used heavy machinery to pump floodwater out of the basement.
items.ex_zh: 应急救援队动用重型机械将地下室的积水抽吸排空。

items.def_en: To pierce a container or pipeline to draw off liquid, or draw on a resource.
items.ex_en: The crew worked quickly to tap the main pipeline and divert the fuel.
items.ex_zh: 工人们迅速行动，开阀抽取主管道中的燃料以完成改道。

items.def_en: To cause liquid to flow away from a container, or deplete someone's supplies or energy.
items.ex_en: He pulled the rubber plug to drain the murky water from the basin.
items.ex_zh: 他拔掉橡胶塞，排干了水盆里的浑水。
items.ex2_en: The murky water drained slowly from the cracked kitchen sink into the pipe.
items.ex2_zh: 浑浊的水从破裂的厨房水槽中缓缓排入下水管。

items.def_en: To draw fluid or air from a system, or extort and continuously exhaust money from someone.
items.ex_en: The mechanic had to bleed the hydraulic brakes to release trapped air pockets.
items.ex_zh: 修理工不得不对液压制动系统进行放气，以排除其中的气泡。

items.def_zh: （用虹吸管）虹吸，抽取；暗中挪用（资金、资源）
items.def_en: 1. (+ off/out) To draw liquid out of a container through a siphon tube. 2. To divert money or resources gradually and often dishonestly.
items.ex_en: He used a rubber hose to siphon stale gasoline out of the lawnmower.
items.ex_zh: 他用一根橡胶软管把割草机里的变质汽油虹吸抽了出来。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe conveying liquid away through conduit/suction or, metaphorically, illicitly draining capital, fuel, or vital resources from a reserve.
groups.summary_zh: 通过管道汲取液体，或暗中转移、抽干资金资源。
groups.desc_en: Diverting, extracting, or depleting liquid or vital resources from a reservoir or system, differing from simple removal by emphasizing continuous tapping, diversion, or systemic exhaustion.
groups.desc_zh: 从储存体或封闭系统中持续引流、抽取或耗竭液体或关键资源，与单纯的“移除”不同，强调分流抽取、管道导流或渐进性耗尽。
groups.nuance_en: siphon: divert illicitly or via differential pressure (funds / gas / profits) · drain: empty completely or exhaust over time (swamp / resources / battery) · bleed: deplete gradually or vent under pressure (system / radiator / economy) · tap: pierce or access a reserve for use (market / potential / vein) · pump: force out rapidly via mechanical power (water / investments / sewage)
groups.nuance_zh: siphon: 虹吸盗用或暗中分流 (funds / gas / profits) · drain: 排空或耗尽储备 (swamp / resources / battery) · bleed: 渐进放血或排气减压 (system / radiator / economy) · tap: 开辟利用或接入潜能 (market / potential / vein) · pump: 机械泵送或强力注入 (water / investments / sewage)

groups.name: Situate & Position · 安置与布局定位 (Situate, Locate, Position, Station)
groups.tip: 安置或使之坐落某处

items.def_en: To arrange for the headquarters or primary center of operations to be in a given area
items.ex_en: The tech conglomerate decided to base its new regional headquarters in Singapore.
items.ex_zh: 这家科技巨头决定将其新的区域总部设立在新加坡。

items.def_zh: 将……安置在合适位置；安放
items.def_en: To carefully place someone or something in a specific location for an operational advantage
items.ex_en: The photographer carefully positioned the external lights to minimize harsh facial shadows.
items.ex_zh: 摄影师精心布置了外接灯光的位置，以尽量减少脸部生硬的阴影。

items.def_zh: 驻扎；安置人员在固定岗位
items.def_en: To assign someone to a fixed post or deploy personnel at a designated spot
items.ex_en: The commander stationed armed guards outside the embassy compound to maintain order.
items.ex_zh: 指挥官在使馆大院外派驻了武装警卫以维持秩序。

items.def_en: To establish, set up, or build something in a particular place or area
items.ex_en: The university plans to locate its cutting-edge marine research facility along the coast.
items.ex_zh: 该大学计划将其尖端海洋研究设施建在沿海地区。

items.def_zh: 使位于，使坐落于；将……置于（特定背景中）
items.def_en: To place, locate, or build something in a particular position or environment.
items.ex_en: The architect chose to situate the villa atop a hill overlooking the valley.
items.ex_zh: 建筑师选择将别墅坐落在俯瞰整个山谷的山顶上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this causative frame denote the purposeful act of placing, founding, or stationing an object, institution, or observer in an intentional physical or contextual spot.
groups.summary_zh: 有目的地将设施、人员或事物设置、安置在确切方位或环境之中。
groups.desc_en: Assigning, fixing, or establishing an entity in a designated physical, strategic, or contextual locus, contrasting with generic 'put' through deliberate spatial orientation and operational readiness.
groups.desc_zh: 将实体安置或设立于特定的物理、战略或情境方位，与宽泛的“放置”不同，强调空间布局考量、功能依托与战备驻扎。
groups.nuance_en: situate: place in context or geographical relation (building / narrative / clinic) · locate: discover site or establish physically (headquarters / factory / position) · position: place strategically for advantage (troops / camera / product) · station: assign to a post for duty (guards / fleet / sentinel) · base: anchor operations or center logically (headquarters / argument / fleet)
groups.nuance_zh: situate: 置于特定地理或情境脉络 (building / narrative / clinic) · locate: 探明位置或物理选址落户 (headquarters / factory / position) · position: 为获取优势策略性布局 (troops / camera / product) · station: 派驻岗位执行警戒守卫 (guards / fleet / sentinel) · base: 设立总部基地或立论依托 (headquarters / argument / fleet)

groups.name: Skimp & Shortchange · 偷工减料与克扣 (Shortchange, Cut corners, Stint)
groups.tip: 精打细算甚至过度克扣

items.def_en: to do something in the easiest, cheapest, or quickest way, often disregarding safety or quality
items.ex_en: The contractors cut corners on building materials, leading to disastrous structural failure.
items.ex_zh: 承包商在建筑材料上偷工减料，导致了灾难性的结构坍塌。

items.def_en: (+ on) to restrict, limit, or be stingy in the amount of food, care, or resources provided
items.ex_en: During the harsh economic downturn, the shelter refused to stint on warm meals.
items.ex_zh: 在严重的经济衰退期间，收容所依然没有克扣温热的餐食。

items.def_en: (+ on) to use too little money, time, or resources on something, often compromising quality or sufficiency
items.ex_en: You really should not skimp on quality winter tires before driving north.
items.ex_zh: 在开车去北方之前，你实在不该在优质冬季轮胎上省钱。

items.def_en: to pinch, cut down, or pare costs in a petty, miserly fashion to the detriment of quality
items.ex_en: The grasping landlord would cheese-pare every repair cost until the roof caved in.
items.ex_zh: 贪婪的房东在每一笔维修费上都极度吝啬苛省，直到屋顶坍塌。

items.def_en: to treat someone unfairly by giving them less money, time, or value than they deserve
items.ex_en: I felt the cashier had shortchanged me when I counted the coins outside.
items.ex_zh: 在外面数零钱时，我觉得收银员少找了我的钱。

groups.summary_en: This frame involves stingily withholding, reducing, or under-allocating materials, effort, time, or funds to an endeavor, typically harming the quality, outcome, or recipient who receives less than their rightful due.
groups.summary_zh: 指在质量、投入或供给上克扣短缺、偷工减料或吝啬给予。
groups.desc_en: Providing inadequate resources, cutting necessary inputs, or defrauding an entitled party, contrasting with prudent saving through substandard quality, stinginess, or deception.
groups.desc_zh: 在投入、用料或应付额度上克扣偷省，与合理的“节俭”不同，强调因小失大、偷工减料或不公地克扣他人应得利益。
groups.nuance_en: skimp: economize excessively on quality/supplies (portions / materials / care) · cut corners: bypass rules or quality standards for speed (safety / budget / design) · stint: restrict supply sparingly (charity / praise / spending) · shortchange: give less than due or cheat out of entitlement (customers / students / workers) · cheese-pare: engage in petty, miserable penny-pinching (allowance / expenses)
groups.nuance_zh: skimp: 在用料或配给上过度节省 (portions / materials / care) · cut corners: 省略工序或偷工减料 (safety / budget / design) · stint: 节制克扣供应 (charity / praise / spending) · shortchange: 找零不足或缺斤短两剥夺应得 (customers / students / workers) · cheese-pare: 抠门琐碎地微幅削减 (allowance / expenses)

groups.name: Skipper & Helm Command · 统领与领航 (Captain, Steer, Pilot)
groups.tip: 担任领队或船长发号施令

items.def_en: To serve as the designated head of a sports team, vessel, or operational crew
items.ex_en: She was chosen to captain the national soccer team during the tournament.
items.ex_zh: 她被选定在本次锦标赛期间担任国家足球队队长。

items.def_en: To direct the course of an enterprise or steer a vessel/craft through challenging waters
items.ex_en: The seasoned executive was brought in to pilot the ambitious merger project.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的高管被请来掌舵这项雄心勃勃的企业合并计划。

items.def_en: To control the direction of a vessel or guide the course of an organization or project
items.ex_en: The new chief executive managed to steer the troubled company through the crisis.
items.ex_zh: 新任首席执行官成功引领陷入困境的公司渡过了危机。
items.ex2_en: The bulky sailboat steers easily even when high ocean winds batter the harbor.
items.ex2_zh: 即使海面强风拍打港口，这艘庞大的帆船依然很容易操纵转向。

items.def_en: To direct and guide a group or venture successfully through intricate conditions
items.ex_en: The firm successfully navigated complex international trade laws during the cross-border acquisition.
items.ex_zh: 该事务所在跨境收购期间成功驾驭了错综复杂的国际贸易法规。

items.def_zh: 担任队长；担任船长（或机长）
items.def_en: To act as the captain or leader of a ship, boat, aircraft, or sports team.
items.ex_en: He will skipper the luxury racing yacht during the upcoming ocean regatta.
items.ex_zh: 他将在即将举行的跨洋帆船赛中担任这艘豪华竞速游艇的船长。

groups.summary_en: Anchored in maritime, vehicular, and team-governance metaphors, this frame denotes direct operational command, tactical steering, and managerial stewardship.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重团队领军、航向把控与现场执行层面的指挥掌舵。
groups.desc_en: Directing, commanding, and piloting a vessel or collective enterprise through a course, contrasting with generic 'lead' through its nautical origin, physical heading control, and full operational command.
groups.desc_zh: 掌舵统领船舶或组织项目以引导航向，与宽泛的“领导”不同，深具航海渊源，强调对航线、舵向及全盘操作的现场调度与掌控。
groups.nuance_en: skipper: command familiarly as master (yacht / boat / side) · captain: exercise formal rank and leadership (vessel / team / project) · steer: manipulate the helm to change heading (wheel / course / car) · pilot: guide through difficult or unfamiliar waters (ship / plane / bill) · navigate: plot and follow a calculated path (waters / terrain / maze)
groups.nuance_zh: skipper: 统领掌舵中小船只或队伍 (yacht / boat / side) · captain: 行使正式船长或队长权柄 (vessel / team / project) · steer: 操舵把向或引导演进 (wheel / course / car) · pilot: 引航穿越危险水域或试行 (ship / plane / bill) · navigate: 测定方位并导航推进 (waters / terrain / maze)

groups.name: Slander & Defame · 口头诽谤与中伤 (Slander, Defame, Vilify)
groups.tip: 恶意捏造事实毁人名誉

items.def_en: To publish false and malicious written or visual statements that damage someone's reputation
items.ex_en: The tabloid was sued for publishing false articles intended to libel the politician.
items.ex_zh: 该小报因发表旨在诽谤该政客的虚假文章而被起诉。

items.def_en: To make false, spoken statements about someone that harm their character or reputation.
items.ex_en: His bitter rival attempted to slander him by spreading malicious rumors at work.
items.ex_zh: 他的死对头试图通过在工作中散布恶意谣言来口头诽谤他。

items.def_en: To speak or write about someone in an extremely derogatory, abusive, and malicious manner
items.ex_en: Corrupt state media continuously tried to vilify the outspoken human rights activist.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的官方媒体不断试图恶意丑化这位敢言的人权活动人士。

items.def_en: To harm the reputation of someone by making false, malicious, or derogatory statements
items.ex_en: The anonymous blog aimed to defame the respected scientist with fabricated allegations.
items.ex_zh: 该匿名博客企图用捏造的指控来中伤这位受人尊敬的科学家。

items.def_en: To criticize, disparage, or speak ill of someone behind their back in an informal setting
items.ex_en: It was completely unprofessional of him to badmouth his former employer during lunch.
items.ex_zh: 他在吃午饭时讲前雇主的闲话，显得极其不专业。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote intentionally making false, disparaging, or malicious statements that damage another party's reputation, character, or social standing, often specifically distinguishing spoken attacks from written libel.
groups.summary_zh: 指恶意捏造或散布虚假言论，公开破坏他人名誉与人格尊严。
groups.desc_en: Attacking an individual's character or standing through false, malicious, or derogatory statements, contrasting with valid criticism through intent to dishonor, untruthfulness, and reputational injury.
groups.desc_zh: 通过虚假、恶意或贬损性言论中伤他人声誉，与正当“批评”不同，强调蓄意败坏名声、捏造失实及人格侮辱。
groups.nuance_en: slander: utter false oral defamation (reputation / rival / character) · libel: publish permanent defamatory falsehoods (author / press / opponent) · defame: legally damage good name and honor (company / official / integrity) · vilify: speak ill in intensely abusive, denigrating terms (critics / press / minority) · badmouth: speak disparagingly and casually behind backs (boss / colleagues / product)
groups.nuance_zh: slander: 口头诽谤中伤 (reputation / rival / character) · libel: 书面或媒介刊载文字诽谤 (author / press / opponent) · defame: 法律上侵害名誉权 (company / official / integrity) · vilify: 极度贬损诋毁丑化 (critics / press / minority) · badmouth: 背后讲闲话贬损 (boss / colleagues / product)
