groups.desc_zh: 通过手动自慰获得粗俗宣泄，与中性医学术语“手淫”不同，带有强烈的市井俚语色彩、粗鄙语域与机械宣泄意向。
groups.nuance_en: wank: masturbate crudely in British/Commonwealth slang (idiot / off) · jerk off: autoerotically stimulate mechanically in US slang (time / buddy) · jack off: engage in male manual masturbation vulgarly (alone / corner) · beat off: furiously masturbate in vulgar American vernacular (behind closed doors) · rub off: masturbate manually with tactile friction emphasis (in secret)
groups.nuance_zh: wank: 英式俚语手淫宣泄或骂人废柴 (idiot / off) · jerk off: 美式俗语机械抽动自慰 (time / buddy) · jack off: 粗鄙指涉男性手动打手枪 (alone / corner) · beat off: 粗暴俚语宣泄打飞机 (behind closed doors) · rub off: 强调摩擦自慰宣泄 (in secret)

groups.name: Sleet & Hail · 降雨雪与冻雨固态降水 (Hail, Flurry, Precipitate)
groups.tip: 天空降下雨夹雪等气象

items.def_en: to fall from the sky as pellets of frozen ice
items.ex_en: Severe storms swept across the plains, causing frozen stones to hail down violently.
items.ex_zh: 剧烈的风暴席卷平原，导致冻结的冰粒猛烈地下落成雹。

items.def_en: (meteorology) to condense from atmospheric vapor and fall as rain, snow, or sleet
items.ex_en: Dense atmospheric moisture will precipitate across the northern mountains as temperatures plunge tonight.
items.ex_zh: 随着今夜气温骤降，浓厚的大气水汽将在北部山区凝结降水。

items.def_en: to rain very lightly in fine, mist-like drops
items.ex_en: Gray clouds gathered, and cold rain began to drizzle gently over the street.
items.ex_zh: 乌云密布，冰冷的细雨开始淅淅沥沥地下在街头。
items.ex2_en: The chef drizzled olive oil over the fresh garden salad before serving dinner.
items.ex2_zh: 在端上晚餐前，大厨在新鲜的田园沙拉上淋了些橄榄油。

items.def_en: to fall intermittently in brief, light bursts of snow
items.ex_en: Light snow began to flurry across the barren highway as dusk settled in.
items.ex_zh: 黄昏降临之际，荒凉的公路上开始飘起了零星阵雪。
items.ex2_en: A sudden gust of wind flurried the dry autumn leaves across the courtyard.
items.ex2_zh: 一阵突如其来的大风把干燥的秋叶吹得在院子里漫天飞舞。

items.def_en: (impersonal) to fall from the sky as a mixture of rain and snow or hail
items.ex_en: It began to sleet heavily, turning the highway into a hazardous icy slush.
items.ex_zh: 天上下起了密集的雨夹雪，把公路变成了危险的冰泥地。

groups.summary_en: Meteorological verbs designating atmospheric frozen, liquid, or mixed water particles descending from clouds to the ground as precipitation.
groups.summary_zh: 指冰雹、雨夹雪、飘雪等各类气象降水过程。
groups.desc_en: Undergoing winter atmospheric condensation yielding frozen, mixed, or partially thawed precipitation, differing from plain rain by crystalline, icy, or pelletized states.
groups.desc_zh: 经历冬季大气凝结并降下冰冻、混合或半融化的固态降水，与单纯的“下雨”不同，强调冰晶、霰粒或雨雪混杂的物理形态与气象特征。
groups.nuance_en: sleet: fall as freezing rain or icy pellets (roads / windshield / streets) · hail: pelt down in solid ice spheres (crops / car roofs / storm) · flurry: drop in brief, light swirling snow bursts (yard / air / winter) · drizzle: fall in microscopic, barely freezing mist droplets (morning / mist / windshield) · precipitate: condense and fall out of atmosphere formally (moisture / vapors / clouds)
groups.nuance_zh: sleet: 降下雨夹雪或冻雨硬冰粒 (roads / windshield / streets) · hail: 倾泻坚硬冰雹砸下 (crops / car roofs / storm) · flurry: 阵发性微雪随风飘舞 (yard / air / winter) · drizzle: 下起冰冷毛毛细雨 (morning / mist / windshield) · precipitate: 气象专业术语凝结沉降 (moisture / vapors / clouds)

groups.name: Sleuth & Probe · 探查与私下侦破 (Sleuth, Probe, Snoop)
groups.tip: 像侦探般敏锐侦查并深入求证

items.def_en: To search curious, secretive places trying to find out hidden facts or contraband
items.ex_en: The suspicious reporter continued to nose around the executive offices after normal hours.
items.ex_zh: 那位起疑的记者下班后仍继续在主管办公室周围到处打探。

items.def_en: (+ around/into) To look around stealthily or pry into other people's private affairs or possessions
items.ex_en: She caught her intrusive neighbor trying to snoop into her personal mail again.
items.ex_zh: 她抓到爱管闲事的邻居又在企图窥探她的私人信件。

items.def_en: (+ into) To examine or investigate a mystery, allegation, or problem thoroughly and incisively
items.ex_en: Independent investigators were appointed to probe into allegations of rampant financial corruption.
items.ex_zh: 独立调查员受命深入调查有关猖獗金融腐败的指控。

items.def_en: (informal) To act as a detective and investigate clues to solve a mystery or crime.
items.ex_en: The ambitious journalist loved to sleuth around abandoned buildings for forgotten historical clues.
items.ex_zh: 这位雄心勃勃的记者喜欢在废弃建筑中四处探查，寻找被遗忘的历史线索。

items.def_en: To discover or unearth hidden information, secrets, or people through persistent search
items.ex_en: The forensic accountants worked tirelessly to ferret out the hidden offshore financial accounts.
items.ex_zh: 司法会计师们不知疲倦地工作，以彻底查清隐藏的离岸金融账户。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail actively searching for obscure clues, prying into hidden circumstances, or employing investigative tactics to decipher crimes, mysteries, or undisclosed secrets.
groups.summary_zh: 指以侦探或暗中查访的方式细致排查线索，揭露隐秘真相。
groups.desc_en: Inquiring, spying, or investigating surreptitiously or methodically to uncover secrets, contrasting with transparent research through clandestine curiosity, prying, or tracking clues.
groups.desc_zh: 暗中打探、窥视或按图索骥以揭露隐秘，与公开坦荡的“研究”不同，强调暗中刺探、多管闲事或凭蛛丝马迹抽丝剥茧。
groups.nuance_en: sleuth: investigate clues like a detective (crime / origins / mystery) · probe: penetrate beneath surface barriers thoroughly (accounts / background / wound) · snoop: pry nosily into others' private affairs (closets / emails / diary) · nose around: wander inquisitive and sniffing for gossip (office / house / desk) · ferret out: discover by persistent, burrowing search (truth / scandal / files)
groups.nuance_zh: sleuth: 像侦探般追踪破案追踪线索 (crime / origins / mystery) · probe: 深入穿透表象深挖底细 (accounts / background / wound) · snoop: 窥探窥私打探隐私 (closets / emails / diary) · nose around: 到处闲逛窥探八卦嗅探 (office / house / desk) · ferret out: 像雪貂搜洞般锲而不舍搜寻出 (truth / scandal / files)

groups.name: Slow Liquid Cooking · 文火慢炖 (Simmer, Stew, Braise)
groups.tip: 文火慢熬细炖，改变食材质地

items.def_en: Cook an item such as fish or eggs gently in simmering or still hot liquid.
items.ex_en: The chef demonstrated how to poach delicate salmon fillets in seasoned broth.
items.ex_zh: 主厨示范了如何在调好味的清汤中用水波法轻煮鲜嫩的三文鱼柳。

items.def_en: Cook food, especially eggs, in water just below the boiling point.
items.ex_en: The recipe instructed the home cook to coddle two fresh farm eggs gently.
items.ex_zh: 食谱指导这位家庭厨师用文火慢煮两个新鲜的农场鸡蛋。

items.def_en: Cook food slowly in liquid in a closed dish or pan over low heat.
items.ex_en: She left the savory beef and vegetables to stew over a low flame.
items.ex_zh: 她把香气扑鼻的牛肉和蔬菜留在小火上慢慢煨煮。

items.def_zh: 煨，文火慢炖；即将爆发，按捺（怒火）
items.def_en: 1. (cooking) To cook food gently in liquid just below boiling point. 2. To be in a state of suppressed anger, excitement, or tension.
items.ex_en: Turn down the heat and allow the rich tomato sauce to simmer slowly.
items.ex_zh: 调小火候，让浓郁的番茄酱在文火上慢慢煨炖。
items.ex2_en: The experienced chef simmered the rich meat broth for five hours over low heat.
items.ex2_zh: 经验丰富的大厨用文火将浓郁的肉汤慢炖了五个小时。

items.def_en: Fry food lightly and then stew it slowly in a closed container with a small amount of liquid.
items.ex_en: He seared the meat before letting it braise in red wine for hours.
items.ex_zh: 他先将肉块煎至金黄，然后倒入红酒微火慢炖数小时。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe cooking food gently and slowly in liquid or steam just below or at a low boil, often to tenderize tough ingredients. They contrast primarily by whether the vessel is tightly sealed, the liquid volume, and the degree of steam involved.
groups.summary_zh: 指用文火慢煨、炖煮使食材软化入味的方式，在汤汁用量与密封程度上各有侧重。
groups.desc_en: Cooking food gently and prolonged in liquid beneath or just at the boiling point, contrasting with rapid boiling or frying through tenderizing heat transfer and flavor infusion.
groups.desc_zh: 在沸点或略低于沸点的液体中缓慢而持久地烹制食物，与烈火沸腾或油炸不同，强调以温和热量使肉质酥软并深度入味。
groups.nuance_en: simmer: cook liquid just below boiling with gentle bubbles (sauce / soup / broth) · stew: cook solids slowly submerged in liquid for long hours (beef / vegetables / meat) · braise: sear first then cook slowly in a covered pot with small amount of liquid (ribs / shanks / brisket) · poach: cook submerged in very gentle, barely moving hot liquid (eggs / pears / fish) · coddle: bathe very gently just below simmer to keep delicate texture (eggs / fruit)
groups.nuance_zh: simmer: 文火微沸冒泡慢炖 (sauce / soup / broth) · stew: 浸入大量汁液中慢炖烂熟 (beef / vegetables / meat) · braise: 先煎锁汁再加盖少汁焖软 (ribs / shanks / brisket) · poach: 微波热水中慢烫嫩煮 (eggs / pears / fish) · coddle: 极低温度轻柔温煨 (eggs / fruit)

groups.name: Slump & Lounge · 瘫坐与萎靡颓垮 (Slouch, Slump, Flop)
groups.tip: 无精打采地弓背耷拉或塌坐

items.def_zh: 扑通瘫坐；四仰八叉倒下
items.def_en: (+ down/into) To sit or lie down in a heavy, sudden, and relaxed or exhausted manner
items.ex_en: Exhausted after the marathon, she immediately flopped down onto the soft leather couch.
items.ex_zh: 跑完马拉松后筋疲力尽的她，扑通一声瘫坐在柔软的皮沙发上。

items.def_en: (+ over) To bend the back and shoulders into a rounded curve
items.ex_en: He began to hunch over his drafting table, examining the intricate blueprint details.
items.ex_zh: 他弓着身子趴在绘图桌前，仔细审视着繁复的图纸细节。
items.ex2_en: He hunched his sore shoulders against the freezing wind as he walked home.
items.ex2_zh: 他在走回家的路上耸起酸痛的双肩，以抵御刺骨的寒风。

items.def_zh: 耷拉着坐（或站、走），无精打采地弓背
items.def_en: To sit, stand, or walk with a lazy, drooping posture, bending your shoulders forward.
items.ex_en: Tired from the commute, he tended to slouch in his chair during meetings.
items.ex_zh: 通勤奔波让他十分疲倦，开会时他总爱没精打采地弓背瘫坐。

items.def_en: (+ down/into) To sit or fall down heavily and limply, usually due to exhaustion, injury, or despair
items.ex_en: Overcome by sheer fatigue, the breathless runner slumped into the nearest folding chair.
items.ex_zh: 上气不接下气的跑者疲惫不堪，瘫倒在最近的一张折叠椅上。

items.def_zh: 体力不支倒下；瘫软瓦解
items.def_en: To fall down suddenly and completely lose strength because of illness or severe fatigue
items.ex_en: Dehydrated from the heat, the young soldier suddenly collapsed onto the dusty trail.
items.ex_zh: 因高温脱水，那名年轻士兵突然体力不支瘫倒在尘土飞扬的小路上。
items.ex2_en: Demolition experts collapsed the abandoned factory building safely with carefully placed dynamite charges.
items.ex2_zh: 爆破专家通过精心安放的炸药安全地引爆摧毁了那座废弃的厂房。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe assuming limp, collapsed, or rounded body postures, typically expressing exhaustion, indolence, demoralization, or utter defeat.
groups.summary_zh: 指由于疲惫、懒散或沮丧而软塌塌地坐着、瘫倒或弯腰驼背。
groups.desc_en: Adopting or collapsing into a heavy, limp, or non-erect posture, contrasting with deliberate sitting through utter loss of muscular tone, exhaustion, or indolence.
groups.desc_zh: 因疲惫、松懈或萎靡而重重瘫坐或弓背垮塌，与端正的“坐”不同，强调肌肉张力丧失、身体垮陷与倦怠之感。
groups.nuance_en: slump: fall heavily or sag downward from weakness (chair / floor / posture) · slouch: sit, stand, or walk with drooped shoulders and curved spine (shoulders / posture / sofa) · flop: drop clumsily and limp with heavy thud (bed / couch / chair) · hunch: curve shoulders and back forward tensely (shoulders / over desk / back) · collapse: fall completely down due to structural or physical failure (deckchair / floor / heap)
groups.nuance_zh: slump: 颓然瘫倒或塌陷弓身 (chair / floor / posture) · slouch: 没骨头般懒散伛偻 (shoulders / posture / sofa) · flop: 浑身发软扑通甩躺 (bed / couch / chair) · hunch: 耸肩缩颈弓背蜷曲 (shoulders / over desk / back) · collapse: 彻底力竭崩溃倒地 (deckchair / floor / heap)

groups.name: Smile & Radiate Joy · 展颜微笑与满面春风 (Grin, Smirk, Glow)
groups.tip: 面露笑容或容光焕发

items.def_en: To form one's features into an expression of pleasure, amusement, or friendliness
items.ex_en: She could not help but smile warmly when her old friend arrived unexpectedly.
items.ex_zh: 当老朋友意外出现时，她忍不住露出了温暖的微笑。

items.def_zh: 面容容光焕发，喜形于色
items.def_en: To suddenly become bright, animated, and cheerful, especially of one's face or eyes
items.ex_en: His eyes seemed to light up with excitement upon hearing the wonderful news.
items.ex_zh: 一听到这个好消息，他的双眼顿时兴奋得容光焕发。
items.ex2_en: Bright lanterns lit up the dark village paths as the festive procession began.
items.ex2_zh: 节日游行开始时，明亮的花灯照亮了村庄漆黑的小径。

items.def_zh: 面露喜色，绽开笑容；发光，照射；播送
items.def_en: 1. To smile broadly and radiantly with great joy. 2. To send out beams of light or radio/television signals.
items.ex_en: The proud mother beamed with joy as her daughter walked across the stage.
items.ex_zh: 看着女儿走过舞台，骄傲的母亲脸上绽开了欣喜的笑容。

items.def_en: To look radiant with warmth, health, happiness, or pride
items.ex_en: Her face seemed to glow with genuine happiness throughout the entire wedding reception.
items.ex_zh: 在整场婚宴上，她的脸上都洋溢着发自内心的幸福光芒。

items.def_en: To smile broadly, often showing the teeth in genuine amusement or mischief
items.ex_en: He gave a wide, mischievous grin before confessing to the harmless April prank.
items.ex_zh: 在坦白这个无伤大雅的愚人节恶作剧前，他顽皮地咧嘴笑了起来。

groups.summary_en: Expressing positive emotion, approval, or delight through facial expressions ranging from subtle warm smiles to unrestrained, broad grins that illuminate the face.
groups.summary_zh: 通过面部表情流露愉悦、喜悦或得意，从含笑到满面红光、喜笑颜开。
groups.desc_en: Revealing pleasure, warmth, or amusement through facial radiance and upward curvature of lips, contrasting with passive calm through overt outward emotional illumination.
groups.desc_zh: 通过面部线条舒展、嘴角上扬散发喜悦与暖意，与面无表情的平静不同，强调面孔神采与发自内心的愉悦光彩。
groups.nuance_en: smile: curve lips gently in pleasant expression (warmly / camera / stranger) · grin: smile broadly showing teeth in open delight or amusement (cheshire / ear to ear / idiotically) · beam: radiate intense pride, affection, or delight across the face (pride / satisfaction / joy) · glow: project warm health, vitality, or inner happiness (happiness / pride / warmth) · light up: brighten suddenly with recognition, hope, or excitement (eyes / face / room)
groups.nuance_zh: smile: 展颜浅笑或示好微启 (warmly / camera / stranger) · grin: 咧嘴欢笑露出牙齿 (cheshire / ear to ear / idiotically) · beam: 满面红光眉开眼笑 (pride / satisfaction / joy) · glow: 容光焕发散发温暖神采 (happiness / pride / warmth) · light up: 眼神面容因兴奋希望骤然一亮 (eyes / face / room)

groups.name: Smoke & Inhale · 抽吸与吞云吐雾 (Smoke, Puff, Inhale)
groups.tip: 口鼻吞吐烟草气体

items.def_zh: 吸烟，抽（烟）；冒烟，冒气；熏制（食物）
items.def_en: 1. To inhale and exhale the smoke of tobacco or drugs. 2. To emit smoke. 3. To preserve meat or fish by exposing it to smoke.
items.ex_en: Patrons are strictly forbidden to smoke cigarettes inside the newly renovated theater lobby.
items.ex_zh: 顾客被严禁在翻新后的剧院大厅内吸烟。

items.def_en: (+ on/at) To draw on a cigarette, cigar, or pipe in short, intermittent breaths
items.ex_en: The old fisherman sat on the pier and puffed quietly on his pipe.
items.ex_zh: 老渔夫坐在码头上，安静地一口一口抽着烟斗。

items.def_en: To inhale and exhale vapor produced by an electronic cigarette
items.ex_en: Several college students stepped outside the crowded library to vape in designated zones.
items.ex_zh: 几名大学生走出拥挤的图书馆，到指定区域吸电子烟。

items.def_en: To suck air through a cigarette or cigar to ignite and smoke it
items.ex_en: She drew on her extensive background in marketing to craft the new campaign.
items.ex_zh: 她借鉴了自己在市场营销方面的深厚背景来策划新的推广活动。

items.def_en: To draw smoke or vapor deeply into the lungs
items.ex_en: He took a long drag on his cigarette and inhaled deeply into his lungs.
items.ex_zh: 他猛吸了一口香烟，深深地吸入了肺里。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote drawing vapor or smoke from tobacco, herbal blends, or related devices into the mouth and lungs and subsequently exhaling it.
groups.summary_zh: 用嘴将烟草、烟气吸入体内并吐出的抽吸动作。
groups.desc_en: Drawing in and expelling combustion vapors or aerosolized substances into the lungs, contrasting with simple biological breathing through deliberate inhalation of stimulants.
groups.desc_zh: 将烟草燃烧或雾化产生的气体吸入肺部并呼出，与常规的“呼吸”不同，强调对刺激性烟雾的人为摄取与吞吐过程。
groups.nuance_en: smoke: combust and inhale tobacco or herb (cigarette / pipe / cigar) · puff: blow out or draw in short, intermittent bursts (cigar / smoke / pipe) · vape: inhale vapor produced by electronic devices (nicotine / cartridge / juice) · inhale: breathe deeply into the lungs (smoke / fumes / deeply) · draw on: suck deliberately on a burning rolled cylinder (joint / cigarette / pipe)
groups.nuance_zh: smoke: 点燃抽吸烟草 (cigarette / pipe / cigar) · puff: 短促吞吐抽吸并吐出烟圈 (cigar / smoke / pipe) · vape: 吸食电子雾化烟 (nicotine / cartridge / juice) · inhale: 深度把烟气吸入肺底 (smoke / fumes / deeply) · draw on: 凑嘴长吸一口卷烟 (joint / cigarette / pipe)

groups.name: Smooth & Fair · 打磨与修顺 (Smooth down, Sand, Plane)
groups.tip: 修整打磨以消除表面凹凸

items.def_en: To make a rough, raised, or uneven surface flat and even by pressing or rubbing
items.ex_en: She carefully smoothed down the wrinkled wallpaper using a clean, soft cloth.
items.ex_zh: 她用一块干净的软布仔细抚平起皱的壁纸。

items.raw_cluster: 使平滑与光顺 Smooth & Fair
items.def_zh: 使光顺，把……修整打磨平滑；（天气）转晴
items.def_en: 1. To smooth, shape, or adjust the surface or joints of a structure so that external parts blend smoothly together. 2. (of weather) To clear up.
items.ex_en: The artisan faired the curved wooden seams until the hull felt entirely seamless.
items.ex_zh: 工匠将弧形木接缝仔细修磨平顺，直至船体摸起来浑然一体。

items.def_zh: 羽化边缘；将边缘打磨渐薄顺接
items.def_en: To sand or blend the edges of paint or filler so they taper smoothly into the surrounding surface
items.ex_en: The restorer gently feathered out the chipped lacquer so the layers merged imperceptibly.
items.ex_zh: 修复师轻轻将剥落的漆面边缘打磨渐薄，使各层完美衔接。
items.ex2_en: The soft grey cloud edges feathered out beautifully across the glowing sunset sky.
items.ex2_zh: 柔软的灰云边缘在绚丽的日落天空中美妙地逐渐淡化消散。

items.def_en: To make a piece of wood flat and smooth using a hand plane or planer
items.ex_en: The carpenter planed the uneven oak plank until the entire surface was level.
items.ex_zh: 木匠用刨子刨平不平整的橡木板，直到表面完全平整。

items.def_en: To make a surface smooth or ready for painting by rubbing it with sandpaper
items.ex_en: You need to sand the tabletop thoroughly before applying the first coat of varnish.
items.ex_zh: 在涂第一层清漆之前，你需要用砂纸把桌面彻底打磨光滑。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to removing irregularities, rough edges, or imperfections from physical surfaces using tools or abrasion to produce a flush, streamlined finish. They contrast primarily by tool type and trade (woodworking, bodywork, or drafting).
groups.summary_zh: 强调使用工具去除表面凹凸不平，使构件轮廓顺畅平整。
groups.desc_en: Refining, abrading, or shaping a surface to eliminate irregularities and achieve an even, aerodynamic, or flush plane, contrasting with rough cutting through precision leveling.
groups.desc_zh: 通过研磨、刨削去除表面粗糙瑕疵以实现平顺均匀或流线平整，与粗暴切削不同，强调精细修整、顺滑过渡与整平工艺。
groups.nuance_en: sand: abrade surface smooth with abrasive paper (wood / drywall / floor) · plane: shave flat and level with a bladed woodworking tool (door / edge / plank) · smooth down: press or rub flat to eliminate bumps (creases / hair / plaster) · fair: blend lines smoothly into an aerodynamic or hydrodynamic curve (hull / panel / joint) · feather out: taper an edge progressively thinner until imperceptible (paint / patch / plaster)
groups.nuance_zh: sand: 砂纸打磨砂光 (wood / drywall / floor) · plane: 用刨刀刨平木料 (door / edge / plank) · smooth down: 抚平抹平突起皱褶 (creases / hair / plaster) · fair: 修整船体或蒙皮使其符合流线平顺 (hull / panel / joint) · feather out: 边缘渐薄过渡收边 (paint / patch / plaster)

groups.name: Smuggle & Traffic · 走私与非法贩运 (Smuggle, Traffic, Run)
groups.tip: 非法偷运贩卖违禁物品

items.def_en: To transport and distribute contraband or prohibited supplies unlawfully, as in 'run guns'
items.ex_en: The cartel hired local fishermen to run illegal firearms across the shallow bay.
items.ex_zh: 卡特尔雇佣当地渔民通过浅水海湾偷运非法枪支。
items.ex2_en: Cold mountain streams run swiftly through the narrow rocky valley during spring runoff.
items.ex2_zh: 在春季径流期间，冰冷的山涧在狭窄的岩石山谷中急速流淌。

items.def_en: (+ in) To buy and sell illegal substances, arms, or vulnerable people unlawfully
items.ex_en: The criminal syndicate was convicted of conspiracy to traffic in endangered wildlife species.
items.ex_zh: 该犯罪团伙因密谋非法贩运濒危野生动物而被定罪。

items.def_en: To covertly convey prohibited items or unauthorized people into a restricted place
items.ex_en: The fans managed to sneak in forbidden flares past the sleepy stadium guards.
items.ex_zh: 球迷们设法绕过昏昏欲睡的球场保安，偷偷带入了违禁照明弹。

items.def_en: To take goods or people secretly and illegally into or out of a country or restricted place
items.ex_en: Corrupt officials helped them smuggle valuable antiquities out of the war-torn nation.
items.ex_zh: 腐败官员帮助他们将珍贵文物偷运出饱受战争蹂躏的国家。

items.raw_cluster: 走私与非法贩运 Smuggle & Traffic
items.def_zh: 非法私运；非法盗录，私卖（唱片、软件等）
items.def_en: 1. To manufacture, distribute, or sell alcoholic drinks, recordings, or software illegally without paying tax or copyright.
items.ex_en: He made quick cash by bootlegging unreleased tracks on shady internet forums.
items.ex_zh: 他通过在隐秘的网络论坛上私卖未发行的盗版曲目赚了笔快钱。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve the illicit transportation, concealment, and distribution of contraband goods, prohibited substances, or persons across controlled borders or black markets.
groups.summary_zh: 秘密夹带、逃避海关监管或在黑市非运贩卖违禁品与人员。
groups.desc_en: Transporting contraband, commodities, or persons illicitly across borders or restricted zones, contrasting with lawful transit through secrecy, illegality, and evasion of customs.
groups.desc_zh: 违禁或秘密运送货物、人员跨越国界与监管卡口，与合法“运输”不同，强调规避关卡、地下交易与非法走私属性。
groups.nuance_en: smuggle: convey covertly across borders defying laws (drugs / weapons / diamonds) · traffic: commercially deal and transport humans or illicit goods (slaves / narcotics / organs) · run: transport contraband repeatedly through blockades (guns / rum / blockade) · bootleg: produce and distribute illegally without paying tax (liquor / recordings / tobacco) · sneak in: slip inside past vigilance stealthily (contraband / alcohol / cell phone)
groups.nuance_zh: smuggle: 违禁越境偷运走私 (drugs / weapons / diamonds) · traffic: 贩卖人口或违禁品网络运销 (slaves / narcotics / organs) · run: 武装冲关或成批运送违禁物 (guns / rum / blockade) · bootleg: 偷酿、走私未纳税酒或非法盗版 (liquor / recordings / tobacco) · sneak in: 避开看守偷偷溜带夹带 (contraband / alcohol / cell phone)

groups.name: Snap & Snarl · 厉声训斥 (Bite, Bark, Snarl)
groups.tip: 神色凶恶且语气粗暴地回绝

items.def_zh: 厉声呵斥；吠叫般大声命令
items.def_en: (+ out) To utter words, orders, or reproaches loudly, abruptly, and harshly
items.ex_en: The sergeant barked out commands as the recruits scrambled into their defensive positions.
items.ex_zh: 当新兵仓促跑向防御阵地时，军士厉声下达了命令。

items.def_zh: 暴躁吼斥；无端厉声斥责
items.def_en: To respond to someone with disproportionate and ferocious verbal irritability
items.ex_en: I only asked for directions, so do not bite my head off.
items.ex_zh: 我只是问个路，你用不着冲我发这么大火。

items.def_en: (+ at) To suddenly attack someone verbally with extreme anger and bitterness
items.ex_en: The stressed politician lashed out at reporters when questioned about the campaign funds.
items.ex_zh: 当被问及竞选资金问题时，不堪重负的政客对记者们猛烈发难。

items.raw_cluster: 厉声说与怒斥 Snap & Snarl
items.def_zh: 厉声说，斥责；（使）咔嚓折断；（突然）失控崩溃
items.def_en: 1. To say something quickly in an angry, sharp, or irritable tone. 2. To break suddenly with a sharp cracking noise, or cause something to do so. 3. To suddenly lose control of one's emotions or patience.
items.ex_en: "Stop interrupting me right now," she snapped at the noisy intern.
items.ex_zh: “现在立刻别打断我，”她厉声斥责吵闹的实习生。

items.def_en: To speak or utter words in an angry, aggressive, and vicious tone
items.ex_en: "Get off my property immediately," the angry homeowner snarled through clenched teeth.
items.ex_zh: “立刻从我的地盘滚出去，”愤怒的房主咬牙切齿地怒吼道。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey abrupt, aggressive verbal outbursts delivered with acute irritation, spite, or fierce anger.
groups.summary_zh: 指因烦躁或盛怒而厉声喝叱、反唇相讥或粗暴打断。
groups.desc_en: Uttering sudden, hostile, or menacing words with animalistic sharpness, contrasting with calm rebuke through rapid irritability, loss of temper, and bared aggression.
groups.desc_zh: 以暴躁、尖酸或带有攻击性的语调厉声吼斥，与平静训诫不同，强调情绪骤然失控、如野兽护食般龇牙狂吠与短促发难。
groups.nuance_en: snap: retort impatiently with sudden sharp anger (head off / reply / retort) · snarl: growl words viciously with bared teeth (threats / back / abuse) · bark: utter sharp loud commands abruptly like a hound (orders / laughter / commands) · bite someone's head off: overreact with furious, unprovoked verbal violence (question / mistake / worker) · lash out: strike verbally with sudden undisciplined fury (critics / press / audience)
groups.nuance_zh: snap: 不耐烦地厉声抢白 (head off / reply / retort) · snarl: 龇牙咧嘴般恶狠狠咆哮 (threats / back / abuse) · bark: 像狗吠般短促喝斥下令 (orders / laughter / commands) · bite someone's head off: 因小事劈头盖脸暴怒训斥 (question / mistake / worker) · lash out: 狂躁猛烈地言语反扑发难 (critics / press / audience)

groups.name: Sniff & Snuffle · 嗅闻与抽鼻 (Sniff, Snort, Scent)
groups.tip: 抽噎吸鼻用鼻子嗅探闻嗅

items.def_en: To detect, smell, or track something using the sense of smell
items.ex_en: The hound suddenly raised its head after scenting a fox in the underbrush.
items.ex_zh: 猎犬嗅到了灌木丛中狐狸的气味，猛地抬起了头。

items.def_en: To draw air audibly up through the nose to smell something or clear nasal passages
items.ex_en: Suffering from a winter cold, he sniffed constantly throughout the long lecture.
items.ex_zh: 由于受了冬日风寒，他在整场漫长的讲座中不停地抽鼻子。

items.def_zh: 抽鼻子，闻嗅；带鼻音说话
items.def_en: 1. To breathe noisily or repeatedly sniff through a blocked nose. 2. (of an animal) To sniff around while exploring.
items.ex_en: The curious terrier snuffled around the garden hedge, searching for hidden mice.
items.ex_zh: 好奇的梗犬在花园树篱周围闻嗅打探，寻找藏匿的老鼠。

items.def_en: To discover or detect something by tracking its scent or investigating clues
items.ex_en: Trained detection dogs quickly sniffed out the hidden narcotics in the cargo hold.
items.ex_zh: 受过训练的缉毒犬迅速在货舱中嗅出了藏匿的毒品。

items.def_en: To make a sudden, explosive sound by forcing air violently through the nose
items.ex_en: She snorted contemptuously when her rival claimed victory before the final vote.
items.ex_zh: 当对手在最终计票前宣称获胜时，她轻蔑地哼了一声。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail taking air short and audibly through the nostrils, whether to clear nasal congestion, cry quietly, detect odors, or express scorn.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过鼻腔短促或有声地吸气，用于辨别气味、擤鼻吸涕或表达轻蔑。
groups.desc_en: Drawing air audibly through the nasal passages to detect an odor or clear mucus, contrasting with breathing through auditory friction, sensory detection, or disdainful exhalation.
groups.desc_zh: 通过鼻腔吸气以辨味或清理鼻涕，与通常的“呼吸”不同，强调明显的鼻息声响、气味搜寻或表达轻蔑的喷鼻动作。
groups.nuance_en: sniff: draw air into nose in short audible breaths to smell or clear (scent / air / milk) · snuffle: breathe noisily and congested through a wet nose (head cold / infant / dog) · snort: force air violently out through nostrils expressing contempt or amusement (disgust / laughter / derision) · scent: perceive a chemical trail by olfactory senses (prey / danger / blood) · sniff out: detect hidden items or truth through keen instinct (drugs / scandal / fraud)
groups.nuance_zh: sniff: 抽鼻吸气辨味或吸鼻涕 (scent / air / milk) · snuffle: 感冒鼻塞抽搭喘息 (head cold / infant / dog) · snort: 哼鼻子喷气表鄙夷不屑 (disgust / laughter / derision) · scent: 动物凭嗅觉感知追猎踪迹 (prey / danger / blood) · sniff out: 顺着气味蛛丝马迹搜寻揪出 (drugs / scandal / fraud)

groups.name: Snow & Frozen Precipitation · 降雪与冻水凝结 (Snow, Sleet, Flurry)
groups.tip: 天气现象发生降水降雪

items.def_zh: 下雪；似雪般飘落；被雪困住
items.def_en: 1. to fall as frozen precipitation in the form of white flakes (usually impersonal: 'it snows') 2. to fall or shower down like snowflakes 3. (usually passive: 'be snowed in') to cover, trap, or enclose with snow
items.ex_en: It snowed steadily throughout the dark night, covering the silent village in white.
items.ex_zh: 大雪在漆黑的夜里整夜地下着，给寂静的村庄披上了一层银装。

items.def_en: to snow severely accompanied by high-velocity freezing winds and near-zero visibility
items.ex_en: It blizzard-drifted furiously across the open plains, stranding drivers inside their freezing cars.
items.ex_zh: 开阔的原野上狂刮暴风雪，将司机们困在冰冷刺骨的车内。

items.def_en: to precipitate hard pellets of frozen rain from convective clouds
items.ex_en: Violent thunderstorms developed rapidly and it hailed marble-sized ice pellets across the valley.
items.ex_zh: 强雷暴迅速形成，整个山谷下起了弹珠般大小的冰雹。

items.def_en: to snow lightly and briefly in swirling, intermittent gusts
items.ex_en: It flurried intermittently throughout the afternoon, dusting the frozen ground with light flakes.
items.ex_zh: 下午断断续续飘着小雪阵，给冰冻的地面铺上了一层薄薄的雪花。
items.ex2_en: A sudden winter gust flurried the fresh snow across the empty highway lanes.
items.ex2_zh: 突如其来的冬季阵风将新雪吹得在空旷的高速公路车道上乱飞。

items.def_en: to fall as a mixture of rain and snow or as partly frozen precipitation
items.ex_en: The temperature hovered near freezing as it sleeted against the rattling windowpanes.
items.ex_zh: 气温徘徊在冰点附近，雨夹雪拍打着嘎嘎作响的窗玻璃。

groups.summary_en: Encompasses impersonal atmospheric occurrences involving frozen, crystalized water droplets falling from the sky in varying intensities and forms.
groups.summary_zh: 指冷空气作用下，液态水凝华结冰并以降雪、霰或雨夹雪等形式降落的气象。
groups.desc_en: Discharging frozen crystalline atmospheric moisture in varying densities, from soft flakes to violent whiteouts, contrasting with rain through icy crystallization and white ground accumulation.
groups.desc_zh: 大气水汽凝结为冰晶、雪花以降落，从轻盈飞雪到暴烈风雪不等，与降雨不同，强调冰晶形态、白雪蓄积及冬季风雪气候。
groups.nuance_en: snow: fall gently or steadily as white ice crystals (heavily / overnight / mountains) · blizzard: rage as a blinding, howling snowstorm with high winds (pass / plains / conditions) · flurry: drop briefly as a light, swirling scatter of snow (afternoon / squalls / snow) · sleet: pelt down as icy frozen raindrops (windows / roads / storm) · hail: drop forcefully as lumps of hard concentric ice (cornfield / windshield / roofs)
groups.nuance_zh: snow: 飘落片状冰晶白雪 (heavily / overnight / mountains) · blizzard: 漫天咆哮的狂风暴风雪 (pass / plains / conditions) · flurry: 随风打转的短时阵雪 (afternoon / squalls / snow) · sleet: 雨雪混杂或冰粒击打 (windows / roads / storm) · hail: 坚硬冰雹倾砸 (cornfield / windshield / roofs)

groups.name: Snub & Cold-Shoulder · 冷落与傲慢蔑视 (Slight, Snub, Spurn)
groups.tip: 态度傲慢不敬，有意轻视他人

items.def_en: To dismiss or ignore someone curtly, showing that you do not value their presence
items.ex_en: He tried to brush off the criticism as petty jealousy.
items.ex_zh: 他试图对这些批评不予理会，将其归咎于小人的嫉妒。

items.def_en: To treat someone with disrespect, contempt, or deliberate indifference.
items.ex_en: The host slighted the junior diplomat by omitting his name during the introductions.
items.ex_zh: 主人在介绍时漏掉了这位初级外交官的名字，明显怠慢了他。

items.def_en: To intentionally treat someone with unfriendliness or disdain, especially by ignoring them
items.ex_en: After their bitter argument, the entire committee decided to cold-shoulder the dissident member.
items.ex_zh: 在激烈的争吵之后，整个委员会决定故意冷落那名持异议的成员。

items.def_zh: 冷落；故意怠慢；给软钉子碰
items.def_en: To deliberately ignore or insult someone by refusing to acknowledge them or their overtures
items.ex_en: The arrogant director snubbed the eager actor by ignoring his outstretched hand.
items.ex_zh: 傲慢的导演对那位热切的演员伸出的手视而不见，当众让他碰了软钉子。

items.def_en: To reject an offer, person, or gesture with disdain or contempt
items.ex_en: The proud monarch spurned the enemy ambassador's offer of an uneasy truce.
items.ex_zh: 高傲的君主轻蔑地拒绝了敌国大使提出的勉强休战提议。

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote showing intentional disrespect, coldness, or insolent disregard toward another person. They focus on subtle or overt social insults that wound pride or status.
groups.summary_zh: 强调故意摆出冷淡傲慢姿态，给予社交侮辱或冷待。
groups.desc_en: Treating someone with deliberate disdain, haughty neglect, or contemptuous rejection, contrasting with mere oversight through intentional coldness and socially degrading slight.
groups.desc_zh: 以冷漠、怠慢或高傲的态度故意羞辱并拒斥他人，与无心的“忽视”不同，强调蓄意冷落、傲慢怠慢与带有阶层社交排斥色彩的轻蔑。
groups.nuance_en: snub: insult deliberately by ignoring or rebuffing (invitation / colleague / event) · slight: treat disrespectfully with careless, petty neglect (honor / family / guest) · cold-shoulder: ostracize intentionally with freezing unfriendliness (newcomer / partner / neighbor) · spurn: reject disdainfully as unworthy of consideration (offer / advances / advice) · brush off: dismiss curtly without taking seriously (concerns / reporter / objections)
groups.nuance_zh: snub: 傲慢无视或当面甩脸绝交 (invitation / colleague / event) · slight: 怠慢看轻让人觉得受轻视 (honor / family / guest) · cold-shoulder: 刻意冷遇晾在一边孤立 (newcomer / partner / neighbor) · spurn: 极度鄙弃嫌弃嗤之以鼻 (offer / advances / advice) · brush off: 敷衍打发轻率推脱 (concerns / reporter / objections)

groups.name: Soak & Steep · 浸泡与腌渍 (Steep, Pickle, Souse)
groups.tip: 浸入盐卤液体中吸汁入味

items.def_en: To treat food, leather, or other materials with salt, brine, or smoke to preserve them
items.ex_en: The farmers salted the pork belly to cure the meat for winter storage.
items.ex_zh: 农户们将五花肉用盐腌渍，以便固化保存供冬季食用。
items.ex2_en: The smoked pork bellies cured slowly in the cool, dry farmhouse basement.
items.ex2_zh: 熏五花肉在农舍阴凉干燥的地下室里慢慢风干腌透。

items.def_en: To cure or preserve meat by soaking it in seasoned brine or coating it with coarse salt
items.ex_en: The pioneer family corned several barrels of beef using fragrant salt and herbs.
items.ex_zh: 拓荒者家庭用芳香的粗盐与香草腌制了几大桶牛肉。

items.def_en: To leave something immersed in a liquid bath so it thoroughly absorbs fluid
items.ex_en: Soak the dried beans in warm water overnight to soften them before cooking.
items.ex_zh: 烹饪前，将干豆浸泡在温水中过夜以使其变软。
items.ex2_en: The heavy woolen blanket soaked thoroughly after hours of driving torrential winter rain.
items.ex2_zh: 在数小时倾盆冬雨的击打下，厚厚的羊毛毯彻底湿透了。

items.def_en: To soak dried leaves, grains, or ingredients in liquid to extract flavor or medicinal qualities
items.ex_en: She steeped the delicate herbal tea leaves in simmering water for ten minutes.
items.ex_zh: 她将精致的草药茶叶在微沸的水中浸泡了十分钟。
items.ex2_en: The fragrant tea leaves steeped gently in boiling water inside the porcelain pot.
items.ex2_zh: 芳香的茶叶在瓷壶的沸水中静静地浸泡出味。

items.def_zh: 用盐水浸泡，用卤水腌制
items.def_en: to soak or preserve food, especially meat, poultry, or vegetables, in salt water
items.ex_en: The chef brined the fresh turkey breast in seasoned salt water overnight.
items.ex_zh: 厨师将新鲜的火鸡胸肉在调味盐水中浸泡腌制了一整夜。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe immersing solid substances (especially food or leaves) into water or a chemical/saline bath to draw out flavor, extract essence, or achieve curing.
groups.summary_zh: 指把固体浸入盐水或液体中浸渍提取风味，或使液体成分充分渗入。
groups.desc_en: To submerge an item in liquid or chemical agents over time to alter its texture, extract flavor, or preserve it, contrasting with quick washing or surface coating.
groups.desc_zh: 指将物体长时间浸入液体或化学制剂中以改变质地、萃取风味或防腐，区别于短暂冲洗或表面涂抹。
groups.nuance_en: soak: generic deep wetting by prolonged submersion (beans / clothes / wood) · steep: soaking to extract or absorb flavor and essence (tea leaves / herbs / grains) · brine: preserving or seasoning specifically in saltwater (pork / olives / pickles) · corn: curing meat in coarse salt grains (beef / brisket) · cure: comprehensive chemical or salt preservation (ham / fish / hides)
groups.nuance_zh: soak: 长时间浸泡使其吸水透湿 (beans / clothes / wood) · steep: 浸泡萃取或吸收风味精华 (tea leaves / herbs / grains) · brine: 用浓盐水腌渍以入味或防腐 (pork / olives / pickles) · corn: 用粗盐粒腌制肉类 (beef / brisket) · cure: 用盐渍、烟熏等综合法熟化保鲜 (ham / fish / hides)

groups.name: Socialize & Pal Around · 结交往来与混在一起 (Hobnob, Chum, Fraternize)
groups.tip: 建立人际关系与日常为友

items.def_zh: 结交；亲密往来（尤指违背规矩）
items.def_en: (+ with) To associate with people in a friendly, brotherly way, especially when prohibited
items.ex_en: The border guards were strictly forbidden to fraternize with the civilian population.
items.ex_zh: 边防警卫被严令禁止与平民过度亲密往来。

items.def_en: (+ with) To spend a great deal of informal, unstructured leisure time in someone's company
items.ex_en: We used to hang out at the local coffee shop after school.
items.ex_zh: 我们过去放学后常在那家街角咖啡馆闲逛。

items.def_en: (+ with) (chiefly British informal) To quickly form a close, affectionate friendship with someone
items.ex_en: He managed to chum up with the dorm captain during their first week.
items.ex_zh: 他在开学第一周就设法与宿舍长打得火热并成了铁哥们。

items.def_en: 1. ('pal up/around with') (informal) To become close friends with someone and spend time together.
items.ex_en: During their summer backpacking trip, the two travelers palled around like old friends.
items.ex_zh: 在夏季背包旅行期间，这两名旅行者像老朋友一样形影不离地结伴而行。

items.def_zh: 亲切结交；周旋于（名流圈子）
items.def_en: (+ with) To spend time socializing familiarly with wealthy, prominent, or influential figures
items.ex_en: The aspiring producer loved to hobnob with wealthy movie executives at lavish parties.
items.ex_zh: 这位满怀抱负的制片人热衷于在豪华派对上与富有的电影高管结交周旋。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame indicate informal, companionable social mixing, hanging out, or forming casual buddy relationships. They often imply sharing leisure time or fraternizing across usual social boundaries.
groups.summary_zh: 指日常同伴式的频繁往来、打成一片或混迹于特定圈子。
groups.desc_en: To associate socially, often across social boundaries or in a relaxed, familiar manner, contrasting with formal meeting or solitary living.
groups.desc_zh: 指社交往来、混在一起或结为亲密玩伴，常带有跨阶层或非正式意味，区别于正式会晤或独处。
groups.nuance_en: hang out: informal idling together without specific purpose (friends / teenagers) · fraternize: associating intimately, often violating protocol or social divides (enemy / subordinates / troops) · hobnob: socializing intimately with high-status figures (celebrities / elites / royalty) · chum up: quickly striking up a close, friendly rapport (roommate / coworker) · pal: spending time together in close companionship (buddies / classmates)
groups.nuance_zh: hang out: 非正式聚在一起消磨时光 (friends / teenagers) · fraternize: 亲密往来，常指违规与下属或敌对阵营结交 (enemy / subordinates / troops) · hobnob: 与权贵名流亲热攀谈往来 (celebrities / elites / royalty) · chum up: 快速结成亲近友好的玩伴关系 (roommate / coworker) · pal: 作为伙伴亲密结伴玩耍 (buddies / classmates)

groups.name: Solemn Announcement · 郑重宣布与昭告天下 (Proclaim, Herald, Trumpet)
groups.tip: 公开正式向大众宣告与通报

items.def_en: To make widely known to the public at large without discretion
items.ex_en: You should not broadcast your friend's private financial troubles to the entire office.
items.ex_zh: 你不应该把朋友私底下的经济困难向整个办公室四处宣扬。
items.ex2_en: The breaking news broadcasted live to millions of television viewers across the nation.
items.ex2_zh: 这则突发新闻向全国数百万电视观众进行了现场直播。

items.def_en: To display or publicize conspicuously or pompously
items.ex_en: The tabloid blazoned the movie star's scandalous secret across its glossy front page.
items.ex_zh: 八卦小报在光滑的头版上大肆昭示这位影星的丑闻秘密。

items.def_en: To announce or signal that something momentous is starting or arriving
items.ex_en: The sudden dip in bond yields heralded an era of economic uncertainty.
items.ex_zh: 债券收益率的骤降预示着经济不确定时期的到来。

items.def_zh: 宣告，公布；明确显示，表明
items.def_en: 1. To announce something publicly, officially, and solemnly. 2. To make clear or show distinctly.
items.ex_en: The mayor solemnly proclaimed a state of emergency across the flooded metropolitan district.
items.ex_zh: 市长庄严宣布受水灾影响的大都市区进入紧急状态。

items.def_en: To welcome, announce, or salute someone or something enthusiastically with public praise
items.ex_en: Critics acclaimed the young pianist as the most promising virtuoso of her generation.
items.ex_zh: 乐评界公开盛赞这位年轻的钢琴家，推崇她为当代最具前途的大师。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this group express the solemn, grand, or momentous announcement of major events, titles, sovereign decisions, or historic truths.
groups.summary_zh: 指庄严、隆重且声势浩大地向全社会宣告重大决断、政绩或时期。
groups.desc_en: To declare or publicize an event, doctrine, or victory with great ceremony and public authority, contrasting with routine reporting or quiet informing.
groups.desc_zh: 指以极具权威、庄严或热烈的方式向大众宣告事件或教义，区别于日常通报或私下告知。
groups.nuance_en: proclaim: authoritative public declaration of official status or law (independence / state of emergency / republic) · herald: signaling the momentous arrival or dawn of something new (new era / dawn / victory) · blazon: conspicuously displaying or publicizing loudly (scandal / name / headlines) · broadcast: disseminating widely to the general public (news / message / intentions) · acclaim: publicizing through loud collective praise (champion / victor / breakthrough)
groups.nuance_zh: proclaim: 官方权威性公开发布或宣告 (independence / state of emergency / republic) · herald: 预示或庄严宣布新时代的到来 (new era / dawn / victory) · blazon: 宣扬招摇或醒目昭告 (scandal / name / headlines) · broadcast: 向公众广泛散布或播报 (news / message / intentions) · acclaim: 以热烈赞誉的方式公推或宣扬 (champion / victor / breakthrough)

groups.name: Solemnize & Consecrate · 举行圣典与仪式 (Solemnize, Commemorate, Consecrate)
groups.tip: 以庄严仪式隆重举行典礼

items.def_en: To celebrate a festival or adhere formally to a ritual, custom, or holiday
items.ex_en: Devout families gather together to observe the solemn rites of the sacred festival.
items.ex_zh: 虔诚的家庭齐聚一堂，庄重恪守神圣节日的肃穆仪式。

items.def_en: To honor the memory of a person or historic event with a formal ceremony or memorial
items.ex_en: The monument was unveiled to commemorate the fallen soldiers of the Great War.
items.ex_zh: 这座纪念碑揭幕旨在纪念在那场大战中阵亡的士兵们。

items.def_zh: 主礼，执事（宗教或法定仪式）
items.def_en: (+ at) To perform the official duties of a ceremony, such as a wedding or funeral
items.ex_en: The senior bishop was invited to officiate at the royal couple's wedding ceremony.
items.ex_zh: 资深主教受邀在这对皇室夫妇的婚礼仪式上主持主礼。

items.def_zh: 庄严举行（婚礼或仪式）；隆重庆祝
items.def_en: (formal) To perform an official ceremony, especially a marriage, with due formality; to celebrate solemnly.
items.ex_en: The magistrate will solemnly solemnize their civil marriage contract at city hall tomorrow.
items.ex_zh: 法官将于明天在市政厅为他们的民事婚姻契约庄严举行仪式。

items.def_en: To make or declare something sacred through a solemn religious ceremony
items.ex_en: The archbishop arrived to consecrate the newly built cathedral before the grand congregation.
items.ex_zh: 大主教在庞大的会众面前莅临，为这座新建的大教堂举行祝圣奉献礼。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey performing sanctified, formal, or ritualized public ceremonies, such as marriages, memorial rites, or religious celebrations.
groups.summary_zh: 指依法定程序或宗教礼节隆重举行典礼仪式。
groups.desc_en: To conduct, sanctify, or observe a rite with ritual formality or sacred authority, contrasting with casual performance or secular administrative processing.
groups.desc_zh: 指依循宗教圣礼或庄严仪式来举行、祝圣或纪念，区别于世俗化敷衍或日常办事。
groups.nuance_en: solemnize: formally performing a ritual, especially a wedding (marriage / vows / covenant) · consecrate: sanctifying and dedicating something as holy or sacred (church / altar / bread and wine) · officiate: acting as the presiding official in a ceremony (wedding / funeral / service) · commemorate: solemn ritual honoring of a past event or person (anniversary / fallen soldiers / centenary) · observe: respectfully adhering to a ritual or religious holiday (Sabbath / festival / silence)
groups.nuance_zh: solemnize: 依法定或宗教大礼正式举行仪式 (marriage / vows / covenant) · consecrate: 祝圣使之具有神圣性 (church / altar / bread and wine) · officiate: 以司仪或主礼人身份主持仪式 (wedding / funeral / service) · commemorate: 庄严悼念或纪念先烈与过往事件 (anniversary / fallen soldiers / centenary) · observe: 虔诚遵守或恪守圣日与礼制 (Sabbath / festival / silence)

groups.name: Solicit & Canvass · 恳请与游说 (Solicit, Appeal, Canvass)
groups.tip: 从礼貌请求到极力恳请支持

items.def_zh: 极力招徕，竭力争取（支持或业务）
items.def_en: To work hard to gather, encourage, or increase support, business, or interest through energetic effort
items.ex_en: The new bakery handed out free samples to drum up interest among neighbors.
items.ex_zh: 这家新面包店分发免费样品，以极力招徕邻里的光顾兴趣。

items.def_en: (+ for/against) To make a formal written request to an authority or court seeking a particular course of action
items.ex_en: Local residents petitioned against the council's decision to close the historic community park.
items.ex_zh: 当地居民正式向当局递交请愿书，抗议市议会关闭历史悠久的社区公园。

items.def_zh: 恳求，请求，征集；招揽（生意）
items.def_en: 1. (+ for/from) To ask someone earnestly for money, help, votes, or information. 2. (formal) To approach people to offer sexual services in exchange for money.
items.ex_en: The charitable organization launched an annual campaign to solicit funds from prominent patrons.
items.ex_zh: 该慈善组织发起了一项年度活动，向知名赞助人郑重募集善款。

items.def_en: (+ for) To systematically visit people or contact them to ask for votes, political support, or opinions
items.ex_en: Volunteers canvassed for votes across the neighborhood ahead of the municipal council election.
items.ex_zh: 在市议会选举前夕，志愿者们穿梭在街区内挨家挨户游说拉票。

items.def_en: (+ to/for) To make a serious, urgent, or heartfelt request to the public or an authority for money, help, or mercy
items.ex_en: The relief agency appealed to international donors for urgently needed emergency medical supplies.
items.ex_zh: 救援机构向国际捐助方紧急呼吁，恳求提供急需的医疗救援物资。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote formally or persistently approaching individuals or groups to request financial support, political backing, or specific contributions. They range from earnest public appeals to systematic door-to-door petitions.
groups.summary_zh: 指主动向个人或公众正式、执着地恳求援助、捐款或拉票。
groups.desc_en: To deliberately and proactively seek contributions, votes, or approval through direct petitioning or campaigning, contrasting with passive waiting or coercive demanding.
groups.desc_zh: 指主动走访、多方恳请或公开游说以获取支持、捐助或选票，区别于被动等待或强行索取。
groups.nuance_en: solicit: formally or urgently asking for aid, business, or opinions (funds / advice / business) · canvass: systematically surveying or soliciting people across a district (votes / opinions / neighborhood) · petition: formally requesting redress or action through an organized appeal (government / court / authorities) · appeal: earnest invocation of sympathy, fairness, or support (donors / public / reason) · drum up: actively stirring up and generating interest or support (business / enthusiasm / votes)
groups.nuance_zh: solicit: 正式或恳切地征求拉拢 (funds / advice / business) · canvass: 挨家挨户游说拉票或系统调查 (votes / opinions / neighborhood) · petition: 呈递请愿书提出正式诉求 (government / court / authorities) · appeal: 恳切呼吁或诉诸同情公理 (donors / public / reason) · drum up: 击鼓造势以招徕支持或买卖 (business / enthusiasm / votes)

groups.name: Solidify & Cement Bonds · 巩固与牢固结合 (Cement, Solidify, Entrench, Galvanize)
groups.tip: 用水泥强力胶结巩固

items.def_zh: 稳固，强化加固（地位/实力）
items.def_en: To strengthen the position, alliance, or power of something so that its foundation becomes unshakable
items.ex_en: The prime minister formed a coalition to consolidate his fragile hold on power.
items.ex_zh: 首相组建了执政联盟，以稳固并强化他对权力的脆弱掌控。
items.ex2_en: His loose alliance consolidated steadily into a powerful ruling party after the election.
items.ex2_zh: 大选之后，他那松散的联盟逐渐巩固为一个强大的执政党。

items.def_en: To make an agreement, plan, or relationship definite, permanent, and hard to disrupt
items.ex_en: A fruitful weekend summit helped solidify the diplomatic partnership between both sovereign nations.
items.ex_zh: 一次富有成果的周末峰会有助于巩固确立两主权国之间的外交伙伴关系。
items.ex2_en: The thick melted wax solidified quickly as cold air entered the workshop room.
items.ex2_zh: 随着冷空气进入车间，浓稠的熔融石蜡迅速凝固了。

items.def_en: To unite people or entities into a durable, cohesive relationship or legal commitment
items.ex_en: Shared hardship during the expedition bound the explorers into an unbreakable lifelong brotherhood.
items.ex_zh: 探险期间共同经历的艰难困苦，将探险家们紧密连结成坚不可摧的终生情谊。

items.def_zh: 巩固，加深（关系等）；用水泥粘结
items.def_en: 1. To strengthen a relationship, agreement, or position so it lasts. 2. To join bricks, stones, or surfaces together with cement.
items.ex_en: The signing of the historic peace accord cemented the friendship between both republics.
items.ex_zh: 历史性和平协议的签署巩固加深了两个共和国之间的友谊。

items.def_en: To establish an idea, bond, or status so firmly and securely that change is very difficult
items.ex_en: Decades of relentless lobbying entrenched corporate interests firmly within the national legal system.
items.ex_zh: 数十年来不懈的游说活动，使企业利益在国家法律体系中牢固确立、根深蒂固。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses both literal cementing and its powerful metaphorical extension: permanently consolidating, validating, and sealing alliances, agreements, reputations, or emotional bonds so they endure.
groups.summary_zh: 从字面胶固延伸至抽象层面，牢固巩固盟约、关系、地位或共识。
groups.desc_en: To make relationships, alliances, or institutional status unshakeable and structurally permanent, contrasting with temporary cooperation or superficial alignment.
groups.desc_zh: 指使人际关系、联盟或体制地位变得坚不可摧、牢不可破，区别于短期合作或表面结盟。
groups.nuance_en: cement: binding firmly together with durable permanence (relationship / friendship / alliance) · solidify: transforming vague ties into firm, definite unity (coalition / support / position) · consolidate: combining and strengthening existing power or bonds (power / gains / holdings) · entrench: establishing firmly beyond the reach of change (privilege / positions / authority) · bind: tying parties together by duty, love, or contract (contract / loyalty / community)
groups.nuance_zh: cement: 牢牢胶结凝固，使其坚不可摧 (relationship / friendship / alliance) · solidify: 使松散或模糊的联合变得确凿稳固 (coalition / support / position) · consolidate: 巩固整合已有权力或同盟根基 (power / gains / holdings) · entrench: 牢固确立并构筑壁垒使之根深蒂固 (privilege / positions / authority) · bind: 藉由契约、忠诚或情感紧紧维系结合 (contract / loyalty / community)

groups.name: Solidify & Firm Up · 变硬固化与夯实 (Solidify, Firm Up, Harden, Congeal)
groups.tip: 由松散变坚硬稳固

items.def_en: To become physically tighter or more solid, or to finalize and confirm arrangements
items.ex_en: We need to meet tomorrow to firm up the final details of our agreement.
items.ex_zh: 我们明天需要见个面，把协议的最终细节彻底敲定落实。
items.ex2_en: Her leg muscles firmed up noticeably after weeks of rigorous daily athletic training.
items.ex2_zh: 经过数周每天严格的体育训练后，她的腿部肌肉明显结实坚硬起来。

items.def_zh: （使）变坚实，（使）变牢固；（使）稳定，确定
items.def_en: 1. To make or become physically firmer, more solid, or compact. 2. (often 'firm up') To make or become settled, definite, or steady.
items.ex_en: The chill in the air helped the warm gelatin dessert firm properly overnight.
items.ex_zh: 凉爽的空气让温热的明胶甜点在过夜后变坚实定型。
items.ex2_en: You can firm the mixture by chilling it in the refrigerator overnight.
items.ex2_zh: 你可以通过将其在冰箱里冷藏一夜来使混合物变硬。

items.def_en: To become firm, stiff, or solid, or to make something so
items.ex_en: The wet cement will harden within several hours under the hot summer sun.
items.ex_zh: 潮湿的水泥在夏日炎炎的阳光下数小时内就会完全硬化。
items.ex2_en: Extreme heat will quickly harden the moist clay bricks into durable ceramics.
items.ex2_zh: 极度的高温会迅速将潮湿的泥砖硬化成耐用的陶瓷。

items.def_en: To become solid or hard, or to make an agreement, plan, or alliance strong and definite
items.ex_en: The melted chocolate began to solidify as it cooled on the marble counter.
items.ex_zh: 融化的巧克力在大理石台面上冷却时开始凝固成形。
items.ex2_en: The leaders signed an agreement to solidify their diplomatic partnership for years.
items.ex2_zh: 领导人们签署了一项协议，以巩固他们未来数年的外交伙伴关系。

items.def_zh: 凝结；凝滞（尤指油脂、血液）
items.def_en: To change from a liquid to a thick, soft solid, especially when cooled
items.ex_en: The greasy soup began to congeal into a thick layer of fat overnight.
items.ex_zh: 油腻的肉汤在过夜后开始凝结成一层厚厚的凝滞油脂。
items.ex2_en: Chilling the meat juices will congeal the remaining grease on top easily.
items.ex2_zh: 将肉汁冷却会很容易使其表层残留的油脂凝固。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote transitioning from a soft, fluid, or tentative consistency into a firm, rigid, or well-compacted state, applied both to physical substances and to stabilizing agreements or proposals.
groups.summary_zh: 指物理质地变结实硬化，或指计划方案确定夯实。
groups.desc_en: To transition physically from a fluid, soft, or uncertain state into a compact, rigid, or settled state, contrasting with liquefying, expanding, or softening.
groups.desc_zh: 指物质由液态、松软或摇摆状态转为致密、坚硬或确凿状态，区别于熔化、膨胀或软化。
groups.nuance_en: solidify: turning entirely firm or solid throughout (magma / mixture / concrete) · harden: increasing in rigidity or resistance (steel / clay / surface) · congeal: thickening into a viscous, semi-solid gelatinous state (blood / fat / soup) · firm: becoming physically dense or structurally taut (soil / flesh / mattress) · firm up: finalizing and making non-negotiable or structurally stable (plans / details / resolve)
groups.nuance_zh: solidify: 完全凝固固化 (magma / mixture / concrete) · harden: 变硬或硬化增强抗力 (steel / clay / surface) · congeal: 黏稠物冷却结冻凝滞 (blood / fat / soup) · firm: 变得紧密结实有弹性 (soil / flesh / mattress) · firm up: 夯实敲定，使之确定不移 (plans / details / resolve)

groups.name: Solo Sexual Stimulation · 手淫与自我性抚慰 (Masturbate, Please oneself, Autoeroticize)
groups.tip: 本能生理发泄与性爱

items.ex_en: The author described a private character learning to safely pleasure oneself without guilt.
items.ex_zh: 作者描绘了一个学会安全且毫无负罪感地自我取悦的私密角色。

items.def_en: Fondle or stroke one's own genital organs for sexual excitement
items.ex_en: He felt guilty whenever he locked the bedroom door to touch himself at night.

groups.summary_en: Covering formal, neutral, and polite idiomatic descriptions of stimulating one's own genitalia to attain sexual gratification without a partner.
groups.summary_zh: 通过自我抚弄生殖器官以获取性快感或宣泄冲动。
groups.desc_en: To perform manual or physical self-stimulation for sexual gratification, contrasting with partnered sexual acts or clinical genital examination.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过自我抚弄或刺激生殖器官以获取性快感，区别于伴侣性交或医学触诊。
groups.nuance_en: masturbate: standard technical term for self-stimulation to orgasm (genitals / private) · touch oneself: common polite or euphemistic expression for self-pleasuring (body / bed) · pleasure oneself: formal or literary euphemism emphasizing erotic self-gratification (senses / night) · onanize: archaic, literary, or clinical term referencing onanism (penis / solitary habit) · fondle: caressing genitally, which can occur solo or to another (genitals / breasts)
groups.nuance_zh: masturbate: 指涉自我刺激达高潮的标准医学/日常通称 (genitals / private) · touch oneself: 委婉自称抚摸私处 (body / bed) · pleasure oneself: 强调自我寻欢与性满足的文雅委婉语 (senses / night) · onanize: 带有宗教典故或古旧色彩的手淫书面语 (penis / solitary habit) · fondle: 抚摩揉弄私密部位 (genitals / breasts)

groups.name: Sorb & Soak Up · 渗透吸收与浸润 (Sorb, Soak up, Permeate)
groups.tip: 液体被介质吸附渗入

items.def_en: To draw in liquid through a porous surface like a sponge or paper
items.ex_en: Use a dry cloth to soak up the spilled milk from the wooden floor.
items.ex_zh: 用一块干布把木地板上洒出来的牛奶吸干。

items.def_en: To absorb an excess pool of liquid using an absorbent material
items.ex_en: She took a thick slice of warm crusty bread to sop up the gravy.
items.ex_zh: 她拿起一块厚厚的温热脆皮面包去蘸吸肉汁。

items.def_en: To pass liquid slowly into a substance through small interstices or pores
items.ex_en: Rainwater begins to infiltrate the porous sandstone, replenishing the underground water table.
items.ex_zh: 雨水开始慢慢渗入多孔砂岩中，补充了地下水位。

items.def_zh: （物理/化学）（通过吸收或吸附）吸纳，吸着
items.def_en: (chemistry, physics) To take up and hold a gas, liquid, or solute by either absorption or adsorption.
items.ex_en: The newly synthesized polymer matrix can efficiently sorb hazardous organic solvents from wastewater.
items.ex_zh: 这种新合成的聚合物基质能够高效吸纳废水中的有害有机溶剂。

items.def_en: To spread completely throughout every part of a porous substance
items.ex_en: Toxic chemicals began to permeate the loose subsoil, eventually contaminating the surrounding farmland.
items.ex_zh: 有毒化学品开始彻底渗透疏松的下层土壤，最终污染了周边的农田。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the dual processes of fluids penetrating porous matrices, encompassing both capillary action, surface intake, and complete volumetric saturated penetration.
groups.summary_zh: 液体渗入多孔性介质并滞留，兼具吸收、吸附与全透特性。
groups.desc_en: To draw in and integrate a substance or fluid into a porous matrix or across a boundary, contrasting with superficial wetting or repelling liquids.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过孔隙或物理化学机制将流体或成分彻底吸附并渗透扩散，区别于表面打湿或排斥流体。
groups.nuance_en: soak up: colloquially absorbing liquid easily and generously (liquid / water / mess) · sop up: mopping up liquid, typically with an absorbent material or bread (gravy / spillage / sauce) · sorb: technical capture of substances via absorption or adsorption (molecules / gas / heavy metals) · permeate: diffusing throughout every part of a matrix (odor / moisture / ideas) · infiltrate: gradually penetrating into a substance or porous medium through pores (groundwater / soil / tissues)
groups.nuance_zh: soak up: 痛快吸干吸净液体 (liquid / water / mess) · sop up: 蘸起、抹尽溢出液体 (gravy / spillage / sauce) · sorb: 物理化学上的吸附与吸收统称 (molecules / gas / heavy metals) · permeate: 彻底浸润散布于每一处细隙 (odor / moisture / ideas) · infiltrate: 经由孔隙徐徐渗入内部 (groundwater / soil / tissues)

groups.name: Soundproof & Acoustic Insulate · 防护与隔离 (Soundproof, Insulate, Deaden)
groups.tip: 安装隔音材料隔绝外界

items.def_en: To install panels, screens, or deflectors designed to deflect and disperse sound waves
items.ex_en: Engineers installed special acoustic panels to baffle loud noise originating from the heavy machinery.
items.ex_zh: 工程师安装了特殊的声学吸音板，以阻隔重型机械产生的嘈杂噪音。

items.def_en: To cover or surround an area with a material that prevents the passage of sound, heat, or electricity
items.ex_en: Workers used specialized fiberglass layers to insulate the recording booth against intrusive external vibrations.
items.ex_zh: 工人们使用特制的玻璃纤维层为录音室隔音，以阻挡外部震动的侵扰。

items.def_en: To wrap, cover, or line an object or room to deaden sound and prevent acoustic projection
items.ex_en: Heavy velvet curtains were hung over the window to muffle the roaring street traffic.
items.ex_zh: 窗户上挂起了厚重的丝绒窗帘，以减弱街道上嘈杂的交通噪音。

items.def_en: 1. To insulate a room, studio, or building so that sound cannot enter or escape.
items.ex_en: They decided to soundproof the basement so the band could practice late at night.
items.ex_zh: 他们决定对地下室做隔音处理，以便乐队能在深夜排练。

items.def_en: To reduce, muffle, or absorb sound reverberations through dampening panels or thick fabrics
items.ex_en: Thick foam tiles were attached to the walls to deaden echo and harsh reflections.
items.ex_zh: 墙面上贴了厚厚的泡沫砖，以减弱回声和刺耳的反射声。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve fitting acoustic dampening materials, baffling, or seals to prevent sound vibrations from penetrating, reflecting within, or escaping an enclosed space.
groups.summary_zh: 利用吸音阻隔材料做声学处理，阻断声音出入或消除杂音回响。
groups.desc_en: To trap, deflect, or suppress sound waves to prevent acoustic transmission, contrasting with sound amplification or echo enhancement.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过介质阻隔、衰减或吸收声波以防止噪音传播，区别于扩音或增强回响。
groups.nuance_en: soundproof: making a room completely impervious to sound entry or exit (studio / room / walls) · deaden: reducing the resonant vitality and volume of acoustic vibrations (echo / sound / vibrations) · muffle: wrapping or covering to make sound dull, muted, or muffled (voices / engine / noise) · baffle: redirecting or disrupting sound waves using acoustic panels (noise / airflow / reflections) · insulate: isolating against sound or heat transmission via non-conductive layers (room / ceiling / pipes)
groups.nuance_zh: soundproof: 使空间完全隔绝外界声音 (studio / room / walls) · deaden: 吸收消除回音或钝化声能 (echo / sound / vibrations) · muffle: 掩盖或包覆使声音沉闷低哑 (voices / engine / noise) · baffle: 加装反射或吸音隔板以打散声波 (noise / airflow / reflections) · insulate: 加装绝缘隔音层以隔阻声响外传 (room / ceiling / pipes)

groups.name: Sowing & Agricultural Planting · 播种与下种 (Seed, Sow, Drill)
groups.tip: 播下种子悉心培育成苗木

items.def_en: Put a seed, bulb, or young plant into ground so that it will grow
items.ex_en: The gardener advised us to plant the tulip bulbs in early autumn before frost.
items.ex_zh: 园丁建议我们在初秋霜降前将郁金香球茎种入地里。

items.def_en: 1. To plant seeds in an area of ground. 2. To produce or shed seeds. 3. To remove the seeds from fruit or vegetables.
items.ex_en: He prepared the rich soil carefully before choosing to seed the front lawn.
items.ex_zh: 在决定给前院草坪播种之前，他仔细地翻整了肥沃的土壤。

items.def_en: Sow seeds in regular furrows or rows using an agricultural seeding machine
items.ex_en: Farmers drill winter wheat across the expansive fields using modern tractor attachments.
items.ex_zh: 农民利用现代拖拉机配件在广阔的田野上条播冬小麦。

items.def_en: Throw seeds broadly across the surface of the soil by hand
items.ex_en: She walked across the prepared flowerbed to scatter wildflower seeds with sweeping hand motions.
items.ex_zh: 她穿过整好的花床，挥动手臂将野花种子撒播出去。
items.ex2_en: The autumn leaves scatter widely across the grass whenever strong gusts blow.
items.ex2_zh: 每当大风吹过，秋天的树叶就会散落在一整片草坪上。

items.def_en: Plant seeds in or on the ground by scattering or inserting them systematically
items.ex_en: In early spring, villagers gather together to sow barley across the terraced mountain slopes.
items.ex_zh: 早春时节，村民们聚集在一起，在层层梯田上播种大麦。

groups.summary_en: Covers the agricultural and horticultural act of scattering, burying, or placing seeds, bulbs, or seedlings into prepared earth to foster germination and crop growth.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及农事耕作，指将种子、种苗撒播、点播或植入土壤中以待生长。
groups.desc_en: To place, broadcast, or plant seeds in earth to initiate agricultural growth, contrasting with harvesting or soil tillage.
groups.desc_zh: 指将植物种子撒入或置入土中以待生根发芽，区别于收割或翻耕土地。
groups.nuance_en: sow: traditional spreading or planting of seed into tilled earth (seeds / wheat / discord) · seed: applying seed to a prepared field or lawn surface (lawn / cloud / pasture) · drill: planting seeds precisely into rows and depths using mechanical machinery (wheat / barley / furrow) · plant: placing seeds, bulbs, or seedlings deliberately in the ground (corn / bulbs / trees) · scatter: dispersing seeds loosely and haphazardly across the surface (seeds / grain / wild grass)
groups.nuance_zh: sow: 经典播种，将种子置入土中 (seeds / wheat / discord) · seed: 在地表铺施或喷播草籽种子 (lawn / cloud / pasture) · drill: 机械条播或定深开沟播种 (wheat / barley / furrow) · plant: 将种子、球茎或幼苗定植于土中 (corn / bulbs / trees) · scatter: 随意无序地向地表撒播种子 (seeds / grain / wild grass)

groups.name: Spawn & Give Rise To · 催生与促成 (Beget, Breed, Generate)
groups.tip: 孕育孵化并促成新事物

items.def_en: To produce, create, or bring an outcome or state into existence
items.ex_en: The proposed infrastructure investments will generate thousands of sustainable jobs across the entire region.
items.ex_zh: 拟议的基础设施投资将在整个地区带来数以千计的可持续就业机会。

items.def_en: To cause or cultivate feelings, conflicts, or social conditions to develop
items.ex_en: Persistent poverty and institutional neglect often breed deep resentment among marginalized urban communities.
items.ex_zh: 持续的贫困和体制性忽视往往会在边缘化的城市群体中滋生深层的怨恨。
items.ex2_en: Hostility and mistrust often breed in environments without open communication or mutual respect.
items.ex2_zh: 在缺乏坦诚沟通和相互尊重的环境中，敌意和不信任往往容易滋生。

items.def_en: To cause a particular feeling, situation, or phenomenon to happen or emerge
items.ex_en: Sudden regulatory changes could give rise to considerable uncertainty across global financial markets.
items.ex_zh: 监管政策的突然变动可能会给全球金融市场带来相当大的不确定性。

items.def_en: 1. To cause something new, large in quantity, or influential to develop or appear. 2. (of fish, frogs, etc.) To lay eggs.
items.ex_en: The breakthrough technology helped spawn an entire industry dedicated to artificial intelligence applications.
items.ex_zh: 这项突破性技术促生了一整个致力于人工智能应用的新兴产业。

items.def_en: To cause or bring about a subsequent state, reaction, or condition
items.ex_en: The harsh austerity measures will inevitably beget widespread discontent among the working-class citizens.
items.ex_zh: 严厉的紧缩措施将不可避免地在工薪阶层公民中引起普遍的不满。

groups.summary_en: This frame describes giving rise to new ideas, conflicts, movements, or phenomena, often resulting in widespread proliferation or unexpected consequences.
groups.summary_zh: 指催生、衍生或诱发大量新事物、观点与后续事态。
groups.desc_en: To cause something abstract or complex to emerge, propagate, and multiply into existence, contrasting with gradual self-evolution or intentional construction.
groups.desc_zh: 指促成并衍生出大量抽象事物、风气或连锁后果，区别于缓慢自我演变或工序构建。
groups.nuance_en: spawn: rapidly producing numerous offspring, offshoots, or unwanted developments (controversy / copycats / sequels) · beget: formally generating an inevitable consequential effect, biblical style (violence / children / mistrust) · breed: fostering conditions that cultivate undesirable outcomes (resentment / contempt / crime) · generate: systematically producing output, energy, or results (revenue / interest / heat) · give rise to: neutrally serving as the origin or catalyst of an occurrence (doubts / complications / rumors)
groups.nuance_zh: spawn: 滋生催生大量派生物或不良连锁反应 (controversy / copycats / sequels) · beget: 宿命式地繁衍出同类后继恶果 (violence / children / mistrust) · breed: 滋生温床式地酿成负面情绪或问题 (resentment / contempt / crime) · generate: 系统性地产出动能、效益或产物 (revenue / interest / heat) · give rise to: 作为直接起因引致某事发生 (doubts / complications / rumors)

groups.name: Spawn & Reproduce · 繁殖与产卵 (Spawn, Breed, Propagate)
groups.tip: 产生孢子产卵繁殖后代

items.def_en: To mate and produce offspring, or to keep animals or plants for the purpose of reproduction
items.ex_en: Certain rare birds only breed in undisturbed wetland habitats during the warm summer months.
items.ex_zh: 某些珍稀鸟类只在温暖的夏季月份于不受干扰的湿地栖息地繁育后代。
items.ex2_en: Local farmers breed prize-winning cattle to maintain the highest livestock quality standards.
items.ex2_zh: 当地农场主繁育获奖肉牛，以维持最高标准的牲畜品质。

items.def_en: To release or deposit eggs in water, or to produce or generate something in large numbers
items.ex_en: Every autumn, adult salmon travel upriver to spawn in shallow, gravel-bottomed freshwater streams.
items.ex_zh: 每年秋季，成年鲑鱼都会逆流而上，在浅水砾石底的淡水溪流中产卵。

items.def_en: To increase greatly in number by natural reproduction
items.ex_en: Harmful bacteria can multiply rapidly if raw food is left at warm room temperature.
items.ex_zh: 如果生鲜食物置于温暖的室温下，有害细菌会迅速大量繁殖。
items.ex2_en: Researchers multiply cellular cultures inside heated incubators to accelerate their scientific testing.
items.ex2_zh: 研究人员在恒温箱中增加细胞培养物的数量以加速科学测试。

items.def_en: To reproduce plants or animals naturally or through artificial horticultural cuttings
items.ex_en: Gardeners often propagate rare succulent varieties by taking stem cuttings in early spring.
items.ex_zh: 园艺师通常在早春通过扦插茎段来繁殖珍稀的多肉植物品种。
items.ex2_en: These hardier alpine ferns propagate easily without human intervention in wet conditions.
items.ex2_zh: 在潮湿的条件下，这些较耐寒的高山蕨类植物很容易自行繁殖。

items.def_en: (biology) To produce or release reproductive spores.
items.ex_en: Deprived of essential nutrients, the dormant fungal mycelium was compelled to sporulate profusely.
items.ex_zh: 由于缺乏必需营养，休眠的真菌菌丝体不得不大量形成孢子。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this biological frame refer to organisms producing offspring, releasing gametes, or multiplying through specialized life cycles. They distinguish between mass egg-laying in aquatic life, microscopic spore production, and controlled plant or animal breeding.
groups.summary_zh: 描述生物繁育后代、释放卵子孢子或进行组织繁殖。
groups.desc_en: To biologically procreate, deposit eggs, or propagate living organisms, contrasting with somatic growth or non-reproductive life functions.
groups.desc_zh: 指生物繁衍后代、排卵受精或培植扩繁，区别于个体营养生长或非生殖生理机能。
groups.nuance_en: spawn: aquatic animals depositing and fertilizing large quantities of eggs (salmon / frogs / fish) · breed: mating animals to rear subsequent generations (horses / dogs / stock) · propagate: intentionally multiplying plants or organisms via vegetative or sexual means (cuttings / species / yeast) · multiply: natural exponential increase in population or cell counts (bacteria / cells / insects) · sporulate: biological formation and release of reproductive spores (fungi / bacteria / mold)
groups.nuance_zh: spawn: 水生生物产卵受精 (salmon / frogs / fish) · breed: 动物交配繁育后代 (horses / dogs / stock) · propagate: 植物营养扦插或人工繁育扩群 (cuttings / species / yeast) · multiply: 生物成倍增殖或繁殖数量剧增 (bacteria / cells / insects) · sporulate: 真菌或微生物形成并释放孢子 (fungi / bacteria / mold)

groups.name: Spearhead & Coordinate · 统领筹划与调度 (Spearhead, Orchestrate, Steer)
groups.tip: 运筹帷幄主导团队行动方向

items.def_en: To guide the direction, progress, or policy of an organization, committee, or undertaking
items.ex_en: The new chief executive hopes to steer the company toward sustainable, eco-friendly energy solutions.
items.ex_zh: 新任首席执行官希望引领公司朝向可持续的环保能源方案发展。
items.ex2_en: The heavily laden ship steered steadily through the calm harbor entrance waters.
items.ex2_zh: 满载货物的轮船平稳地驶过了平静的港口入口处水域。

items.def_zh: 统领，主导，统筹；担任四分卫
items.def_en: 1. (informal) To lead, direct, or organize a project or activity. 2. (American football) To play the position of quarterback.
items.ex_en: Management asked Sarah to quarterback the high-stakes product launch scheduled for next month.
items.ex_zh: 管理层让萨拉统筹负责定于下个月举行的高风险产品发布会。

items.def_en: To plan and direct a complex, difficult, or covert operation
items.ex_en: Detectives believed a corrupt insider helped mastermind the elaborate downtown diamond heist.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们认为是一名腐败的内部人员策划了这起复杂的市中心钻石大劫案。

items.def_en: To arrange and coordinate all the elements of a complex plan or situation to achieve a desired result
items.ex_en: The seasoned diplomat worked tirelessly to orchestrate a fragile ceasefire between warring factions.
items.ex_zh: 这位经验丰富的外交官不知疲倦地工作，以在交战各派之间精心促成脆弱的停火协议。

items.def_zh: 带头，发起，作为先锋统率
items.def_en: To act as the proactive leader of an attack, project, campaign, or initiative
items.ex_en: She was chosen to spearhead the nationwide campaign aimed at reducing single-use plastics.
items.ex_zh: 她被推选带头发起这项旨在减少一次性塑料制品的全国性活动。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on driving, organizing, and executing a major project or campaign from the front, calling tactical plays and aligning team execution.
groups.summary_zh: 统筹谋划并在前线积极调度、牵头推进项目行动。
groups.desc_en: To direct, plan, and execute a complex strategic initiative from an apex leadership position, contrasting with operational execution or hands-off oversight.
groups.desc_zh: 指在战略枢纽位置全面调度、统领并操控复杂战役或计划，区别于基层实操或旁观巡视。
groups.nuance_en: orchestrate: meticulously arranging multifaceted elements behind the scenes for maximum effect (campaign / coup / comeback) · mastermind: intellectual architecting of a complex plot or grand scheme (robbery / strategy / operation) · spearhead: actively leading the vanguard charge of a collective enterprise (attack / drive / initiative) · quarterback: directing dynamic real-time playmaking and coordination on the field (deal / effort / legislation) · steer: guiding the course, trajectory, or policy direction of an organization (economy / committee / talks)
groups.nuance_zh: orchestrate: 幕后精心编排协调各方以达特定效果 (campaign / coup / comeback) · mastermind: 作为智囊主谋策划复杂大案或战略 (robbery / strategy / operation) · spearhead: 充当锋刃率先带头冲锋发起攻势 (attack / drive / initiative) · quarterback: 临场组织指挥调度团队推进项目 (deal / effort / legislation) · steer: 掌舵掌控大局走向与政策航向 (economy / committee / talks)

groups.name: Spearhead & Pioneer · 带头与率先开拓 (Champion, Pioneer, Helm)
groups.tip: 充当带头先锋发起重大攻势

items.def_en: To aggressively fight for, advocate, or lead support for a doctrine or cause
items.ex_en: The passionate senator continues to champion equal educational opportunities for underprivileged rural students.
items.ex_zh: 这位满怀热忱的参议员继续为贫困农村学生争取平等的受教育机会而积极发声。

items.def_en: To act as the primary director or leader steering an organization or production
items.ex_en: An experienced artistic director was appointed to helm the troubled theatrical production company.
items.ex_zh: 一位经验丰富的艺术总监被任命来统领这家陷入困境的戏剧制作公司。

items.def_en: To be the very first person or group to open up, develop, or introduce a new method or idea
items.ex_en: Renowned researchers helped pioneer minimally invasive surgical techniques that transform modern medicine.
items.ex_zh: 著名研究人员率先开创了改变现代医学的微创手术技术。

items.def_en: To break innovative ground in an unexplored area and guide others behind
items.ex_en: The young female scientist aimed to trailblaze new paths in quantum computing research.
items.ex_zh: 这位年轻的女性科学家立志在量子计算研究领域开辟崭新的道路。

items.def_zh: 带头，作……的先锋，做发起人
items.def_en: To lead or act as the driving force behind an attack, campaign, or major project.
items.ex_en: General Martinez was assigned to spearhead the counteroffensive against entrenched insurgent strongholds.
items.ex_zh: 马丁内斯将军被委派作为先锋统率部队向叛军盘踞的据点发起反攻。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here highlight energetic, forefront initiative—breaking ground, launching campaigns, and physically or symbolically driving forward collective enterprises.
groups.summary_zh: 处于行动最前端，带头发起、开拓或推进重大举措。
groups.desc_en: To be the very first to break new ground, advocate for, or lead a pioneering path, contrasting with following precedent or maintaining the status quo.
groups.desc_zh: 指一马当先开拓未踏疆域、扛起倡导大旗或挂帅远征，区别于步人后尘或墨守成规。
groups.nuance_en: pioneer: breaking completely new historical or intellectual ground (technology / treatment / research) · trailblaze: opening up an untrodden physical or conceptual route for others (path / movement / frontier) · spearhead: leading the cutting edge of a reform or enterprise (reform / campaign / project) · champion: publicly fighting for, advocating, and defending a cause (rights / cause / bill) · helm: taking the top commanding post of an existing enterprise or project (company / studio / expedition)
groups.nuance_zh: pioneer: 开天辟地成为某领域的开拓先驱 (technology / treatment / research) · trailblaze: 披荆斩棘踏出前所未有的道路 (path / movement / frontier) · spearhead: 充当领头羊率先启动重大变革 (reform / campaign / project) · champion: 执旗呐喊全力捍卫并倡导某项事业 (rights / cause / bill) · helm: 坐镇掌舵领军执掌机构或大项任务 (company / studio / expedition)

groups.name: Specialize & Delve · 钻研与精专 (Delve, Specialize, Major)
groups.tip: 由专注投入到融会精通

items.def_en: (+ in) To pursue a specific academic discipline as one's principal subject of study
items.ex_en: He decided to major in mechanical engineering after completing his foundational science courses.
items.ex_zh: 修完基础科学课程后，他决定主修机械工程专业。

items.def_en: (+ into) To examine or investigate data, topics, or root causes in thorough detail
items.ex_en: Financial auditors must drill down into unexpected variances to find potential systemic fraud.
items.ex_zh: 财务审计员必须深入钻研异常差异，以找出潜在的系统性造假。

items.def_en: To read, study, or examine written material with deep, concentrated absorption
items.ex_en: Historians pore over fragile ancient manuscripts to reconstruct forgotten medieval trade networks.
items.ex_zh: 历史学家们聚精会神地研读脆弱的古代手稿，以重构被遗忘的中世纪贸易网络。

items.def_zh: 专攻，专门研究；专门从事
items.def_en: (+ in) To devote time and attention to a particular subject, area of work, or skill.
items.ex_en: Senior corporate attorneys often choose to specialize in intellectual property litigation and patents.
items.ex_zh: 资深公司律师通常选择专攻知识产权诉讼和专利业务。

items.def_en: (+ into) To search deeply, systematically, and laboriously for information or knowledge
items.ex_en: Investigative journalists continue to delve into confidential corporate archives to expose widespread corruption.
items.ex_zh: 调查记者们继续深入探究企业机密档案，以揭露普遍存在的腐败现象。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe deep, committed intellectual exploration and sustained professional dedication to a narrow niche. They emphasize profound analytical digging rather than broad, superficial coverage.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重在特定专业或学术领域内做深层剖析与持久专攻。
groups.desc_en: To concentrate intellectual scrutiny deeply into a narrow subject rather than scanning broadly or skimming superficially.
groups.desc_zh: 指将精力与注意力深度聚焦于特定细分领域钻研深挖，区别于泛泛涉猎或浮于表面。
groups.nuance_en: specialize: focusing one's primary expertise or practice on a defined niche (law / surgery / ecology) · delve: deeply investigating or probing into hidden details (records / mystery / archives) · drill down: penetrating past surface summaries into granular analytical data (data / metrics / numbers) · pore over: reading or examining texts with exhaustive, meticulous closeness (manuscripts / books / maps) · major: dedicating standard academic training to a primary field (economics / history / biology)
groups.nuance_zh: specialize: 专攻某一狭长业务或学术细分方向 (law / surgery / ecology) · delve: 深入探究刨根问底 (records / mystery / archives) · drill down: 穿透表层剖析至颗粒度极细的数据细节 (data / metrics / numbers) · pore over: 凝神细读逐字审视文献图纸 (manuscripts / books / maps) · major: 在大学体系中确立主修专业 (economics / history / biology)

groups.name: Specialize in Academic Study · 专业修读与主修 (Major, Specialize, Minor)
groups.tip: 求知钻研专攻专业

items.def_en: (+ in) (especially North American) To have something as your main subject of study at a university or college.
items.ex_en: Elena decided to major in comparative literature during her sophomore year at college.
items.ex_zh: 埃琳娜在大二期间决定主修比较文学专业。

items.def_en: (+ on) Center one's academic attention or coursework on a particular topic
items.ex_en: Graduate researchers are advised to focus on renewable energy technologies for their dissertations.
items.ex_zh: 导师建议研究生将毕业论文重点聚焦于可再生能源技术。
items.ex2_en: The research supervisor focused the students on primary sources for their projects.
items.ex2_zh: 研究导师让学生们将注意力集中在各自项目的原始资料上。

items.def_en: (+ in) Pursue a subsidiary academic subject alongside a primary field in college
items.ex_en: While pursuing business administration, Mark chose to minor in applied computer science.
items.ex_zh: 在攻读工商管理学位的同时，马克选择辅修应用计算机科学。

items.def_en: (+ in/on) Direct one's academic studies toward a specific subfield or discipline
items.ex_en: Undergraduate economics students can concentrate in international monetary policy during their final semesters.
items.ex_zh: 经济学本科生可以在最后几个学期专注修读国际货币政策方向。
items.ex2_en: The academic program concentrates students in advanced analytical methods through practical workshops.
items.ex2_zh: 该学术项目通过实践研讨课让学生专攻高级分析方法。

items.def_en: (+ in) Devote oneself to a particular subject, skill, or field of study
items.ex_en: Medical students must complete rigorous clinical training before they can specialize in pediatric surgery.
items.ex_zh: 医学生必须完成严格的临床培训，才能专攻小儿外科方向。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to pursuing a specific discipline or academic concentration in higher education. They contrast in academic hierarchy (primary versus secondary subjects) and the breadth of intellectual focus.
groups.summary_zh: 指在高等教育中选定特定学科深造或主修，体现主次专业与研究重心的差异。
groups.desc_en: To structure one's formal university curriculum around a designated primary discipline, contrasting with general education or casual auditing.
groups.desc_zh: 指在大学教育体系中将特定学科确立为主要研习方向并修读学位，区别于通识选修或旁听。
groups.nuance_en: major: selecting as one's primary academic degree specialization (English / philosophy / finance) · minor: completing a secondary, lesser concentration of university credits (art history / German / statistics) · specialize: narrowing academic research to an advanced sub-field (neuroscience / medieval literature) · concentrate: dedicating the preponderance of coursework to a specific discipline cluster (studies / track / focus) · focus: orienting general studies or thesis research toward a targeted topic (research / thesis / coursework)
groups.nuance_zh: major: 修读大学第一主修专业 (English / philosophy / finance) · minor: 辅修第二专业学分 (art history / German / statistics) · specialize: 在高阶学段定向专修某一专科 (neuroscience / medieval literature) · concentrate: 在学分计划中集中选读某专业方向 (studies / track / focus) · focus: 将学业或论文焦点投向特定专题 (research / thesis / coursework)

groups.name: Spew & Disgorge · 呕出与喷吐 (Spew, Disgorge, Chunder)
groups.tip: 生理反胃将胃物吐出

items.def_en: (slang, chiefly Australian & British) To vomit or vomit loudly, especially after excessive drinking
items.ex_en: After five pints of strong lager, Dave rushed outside to chunder behind the pub.
items.ex_zh: 喝了五品脱烈性拉格啤酒后，戴夫冲到酒吧后面大吐特吐。

items.def_en: To violently discharge stomach contents out onto the ground or floor
items.ex_en: The seasick passenger leaned over the railing to spew up into the churning ocean.
items.ex_zh: 晕船的乘客倚在栏杆上，向翻腾的大海里大口呕吐。

items.def_en: To eject stomach contents violently or spray liquid outwards in large quantities
items.ex_en: The broken pipe started to spew filthy brown sludge all over the pristine lawn.
items.ex_zh: 破裂的水管开始向整洁的草坪上大量喷出污秽的褐色淤泥。
items.ex2_en: Thick sulfuric clouds spewed violently from the crater of the active volcano yesterday.
items.ex2_zh: 昨天，浓厚的硫磺云从活火山的火山口中剧烈喷发出来。

items.def_en: To expel or pour out contents violently from the mouth, belly, or an orifice
items.ex_en: The ancient volcano rumbled loudly before beginning to disgorge rivers of incandescent molten rock.
items.ex_zh: 这座古老的火山发出巨大的轰鸣声，随后开始喷吐出条条炽热的熔岩流。

items.def_en: (informal, especially North American) To vomit or throw up.
items.ex_en: He felt so nauseous from food poisoning that he had to upchuck in the sink.
items.ex_zh: 食物中毒让他感到恶心欲绝，不得不对着水槽吐了出来。
