groups.summary_en: This frame emphasizes the violent, voluminous, or explosive ejection of vomit, liquid, or bile. It focuses visually on the messy, uncontrollable trajectory of fluid discharged outwards.
groups.summary_zh: 指恶心时胃液或秽物像喷泉一样被猛烈喷吐出来。
groups.desc_en: To forcefully and involuntarily eject stomach contents through the mouth, contrasting with controlled ingestion, swallowing, or spitting saliva.
groups.desc_zh: 指因胃部剧烈逆蠕动将胃内容物强行喷吐或呕出体外，区别于吞咽或吐口水。
groups.nuance_en: spew: violently shooting out gastric contents or liquids under pressure (bile / vomit / lava) · spew up: actively expelling stomach contents in repeated retches (food / lunch / alcohol) · disgorge: emptying contents out of the throat or mouth forcefully (contents / meal / fluid) · upchuck: informal, colloquial expression for vomiting (dinner / food / drink) · chunder: British/Australian informal slang for throwing up profusely (guts / everywhere / after drinking)
groups.nuance_zh: spew: 势头凶猛地喷薄呕出 (bile / vomit / lava) · spew up: 反胃作呕将腹中物吐个精光 (food / lunch / alcohol) · disgorge: 倾肠倒肚地向外吐出喉胃内容物 (contents / meal / fluid) · upchuck: 口语俗称翻江倒海吐出来 (dinner / food / drink) · chunder: 英澳俚语大肆呕吐 (guts / everywhere / after drinking)

groups.name: Spin Off & Separate · 剥离与拆分 (Hive off, Spin off, Carve out)
groups.tip: 如分巢般将附属部分剥离独立

items.def_en: To split a company, asset package, or integrated service into its distinct constituent parts
items.ex_en: Telecommunications regulators forced the dominant conglomerate to unbundle its internet and television services.
items.ex_zh: 电信监管机构迫使这家占主导地位的企业集团解绑拆分其互联网与电视业务。

items.def_en: To separate a specific segment or operational unit from a company in order to sell or float it separately
items.ex_en: Executives decided to carve out the profitable digital payments division for a separate listing.
items.ex_zh: 高管们决定剥离出盈利丰厚的数字支付部门，以进行单独上市。

items.def_en: To separate a subsidiary or departmental unit from a larger parent organization, often for independent operation or sale
items.ex_en: The board finalized plans to hive off the non-core logistics arm to private equity.
items.ex_zh: 董事会敲定了将非核心物流业务剥离转让给私募股权公司的方案。

items.def_en: To form an independent company from a subsidiary or division of a larger existing organization
items.ex_en: The tech giant plans to spin off its cloud computing division into a separate company.
items.ex_zh: 这家科技巨头计划将其云计算部门剥离为一家独立公司。
items.ex2_en: The research arm spun off as a distinct commercial entity last spring.
items.ex2_zh: 该研究部门去年春天独立分拆为一家单独的商业实体。

items.def_zh: 剥离，分立；进入蜂巢，如蜂般群居
items.def_en: (also 'hive off') To separate a subsidiary or part of a business from a parent organization to form an independent unit.
items.ex_en: The corporate restructuring plan will hive the unprofitable retail arm into a separate firm.
items.ex_zh: 该企业重组计划将把不盈利的零售业务独立剥离成一家单独的公司。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on corporate, institutional, or administrative separation, where a unit, division, or function is detached from a parent body to operate independently or be sold off.
groups.summary_zh: 特指将组织、企业或政府机构的部分业务剥离独立或拆分转让。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the deliberate corporate or structural separation of a subsidiary, asset, or business unit from a parent entity to create an independent or distinct venture, contrasting with destructive dissolution or simple selling off.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过商业或组织重组将子公司、资产或业务单元从母体中剥离以设立独立实体，区别于单纯的资产清算或外部变卖。
groups.nuance_en: spin off: corporate detachment creating a new independent public company (subsidiary / unit / business) · carve out: strategic separation of a division via partial sale or IPO (niche / division / asset) · hive off: deliberate transfer of a non-core unit to another entity (operation / branch / department) · unbundle: systematic breakdown of bundled products or conglomerates into distinct units (services / conglomerate / assets)
groups.nuance_zh: spin off: 将子公司拆分成立全新独立法人公司 (subsidiary / unit / business) · carve out: 通过股权剥离或IPO独立细分业务 (niche / division / asset) · hive off: 将非核心分支或资产划拨剥离出去 (operation / branch / department) · unbundle: 解绑打包产品或分拆大型企业集团 (services / conglomerate / assets)

groups.name: Spiral & Gyrate · 盘旋与螺旋运动 (Spiral, Gyrate, Corkscrew)
groups.tip: 绕轴旋转或呈螺旋状上升

items.def_en: To move in a circular, spiraling current, typically said of water, air, smoke, or dust
items.ex_en: Autumn leaves began to eddy gently across the stone courtyard in the autumn breeze.
items.ex_zh: 秋叶在秋风中于石质庭院上轻轻打着旋儿。

items.def_zh: 呈螺旋式移动，盘旋；急剧变化
items.def_en: 1. To move in a continuous circular curve that rises or descends around a central point. 2. To increase or decrease rapidly and continuously.
items.ex_en: The hawk continued to spiral effortlessly upward on invisible thermals into the clear sky.
items.ex_zh: 老鹰顺着看不见的热气流毫不费力地盘旋向上，飞入晴朗的天空。

items.def_en: To move or advance along a twisting, helical trajectory like that of a corkscrew
items.ex_en: The fighter jet began to corkscrew uncontrollably toward the desert ground below.
items.ex_zh: 战斗机开始不受控制地呈螺旋轨迹朝下方的沙漠地面坠落。

items.def_en: To move rapidly in circles or in a spiraling motion around a central axis
items.ex_en: Colorful spinning dancers seemed to gyrate endlessly around the grand ballroom floor.
items.ex_zh: 身着彩衣的旋转舞者似乎在大宴会厅的舞池中央无休止地盘旋起舞。

items.def_en: To whirl rapidly in a circular or spiraling funnel
items.ex_en: Violent wind currents began to vortex wildly into a destructive funnel cloud across the valley.
items.ex_zh: 狂暴的下沉气流开始在山谷中疯狂旋卷成一团破坏性的漏斗云。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures motion that traces a continuously widening, tightening, climbing, or descending helix or spiral curve. It contrasts pure flat rotation with 3D helical trajectories or figurative runaway upward/downward trends.
groups.summary_zh: 指沿三维螺旋、盘旋轨迹上升或下降的运动，亦引申为急剧失控的走势。
groups.desc_en: Denotes continuous rotational or helical motion that simultaneously progresses along an axis, contrasting with simple on-the-spot spinning or linear translation.
groups.desc_zh: 指沿中心轴线一边旋转一边推进的螺旋或涡流运动，区别于原地的纯粹自转或单纯直线位移。
groups.nuance_en: spiral: continuous helical ascent, descent, or escalating loop (costs / aircraft / smoke) · gyrate: erratic circular oscillation or wild twisting (hips / financial markets / prices) · corkscrew: tight, drilling helical progression (bullet / trajectory / path) · eddy: circular swirling motion of fluids contrasting main currents (currents / dust / wind) · vortex: violent funnel-shaped rotational suction (water / whirlpool / tornado)
groups.nuance_zh: spiral: 螺旋形上升、下降或失控恶化 (costs / aircraft / smoke) · gyrate: 狂乱或摇摆的圆周回旋运动 (hips / financial markets / prices) · corkscrew: 紧密钻入式螺旋行进 (bullet / trajectory / path) · eddy: 流体逆流旋转形成的小漩涡 (currents / dust / wind) · vortex: 强力漏斗状漩涡吸入运动 (water / whirlpool / tornado)

groups.name: Spit & Expectorate · 咳出与吐出 (Cough up, Spit out, Hawk)
groups.tip: 喉咙咳痰或用力吐出口中物

items.def_en: To force saliva or secretions out of the mouth, often as an uncouth or reflex action
items.ex_en: The rude pedestrian turned aside to spit dirty saliva onto the public sidewalk.
items.ex_zh: 那名无礼的行人转过身，将脏唾沫吐到了公共人行道上。

items.def_en: To force phlegm, blood, or foreign matter out of the lungs or throat by coughing
items.ex_en: The heavy smoker sat hunched over, struggling to cough up thick gray phlegm.
items.ex_zh: 那个老烟民弓着身子坐着，吃力地想咳出浓稠的灰色痰液。

items.def_en: To eject liquid, phlegm, or an objectionable morsel forcefully from the mouth
items.ex_en: He grimaced in disgust and spit out the bitter piece of spoiled meat immediately.
items.ex_zh: 他厌恶地皱起眉头，立刻把那块变质发苦的肉吐了出来。

items.def_zh: 咳出，吐痰，吐出（呼吸道痰黏液）
items.def_en: (formal or medical) To cough up and spit out phlegm or mucus from the throat or respiratory tract.
items.ex_en: The physician instructed the patient to expectorate sputum into a sterile plastic container.
items.ex_zh: 医生嘱咐患者将痰液咳入无菌塑料盒中。

items.def_en: To clear the throat harshly and bring up phlegm from deep in the chest to spit it out
items.ex_en: The old miner paused to hawk up thick phlegm before speaking again.
items.ex_zh: 老矿工停顿了一下，用力咳出浓痰后才接着说话。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote the physiological ejection of mucus, saliva, or foreign matter from the lungs, throat, or mouth through respiratory action or deliberate spitting.
groups.summary_zh: 通过咳嗽、清嗓或口腔动作将呼吸道黏液及分泌物排出体外。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the forceful biological or figurative ejection of saliva, phlegm, or swallowed matter from the respiratory tract or mouth, contrasting with gentle passive expulsion or vomiting from the stomach.
groups.desc_zh: 指从口腔或呼吸道强力喷吐、咳出唾液或痰液等物质，区别于被动流出或胃部的呕吐。
groups.nuance_en: spit: basic oral ejection of liquid or saliva (saliva / venom / blood) · spit out: deliberate or aggressive ejection from the mouth (gum / food / insults) · cough up: expulsion from lungs/throat through coughing, or reluctant surrendering of money (phlegm / cash / secrets) · expectorate: formal or medical spitting/coughing up of phlegm (phlegm / mucus / sputum) · hawk up: coarse, throat-clearing rasping expulsion (loogie / phlegm / mucus)
groups.nuance_zh: spit: 基础的口腔吐液动作 (saliva / venom / blood) · spit out: 刻意或厌恶地吐出口中物 (gum / food / insults) · cough up: 咳出喉中积物，引申为勉强吐出钱财 (phlegm / cash / secrets) · expectorate: 正式或医学用语，咳出并吐痰 (phlegm / mucus / sputum) · hawk up: 粗鄙地使劲清嗓咯出黏痰 (loogie / phlegm / mucus)

groups.name: Splash & Scatter · 飞溅与泼洒 (Splatter, Splash, Spatter)
groups.tip: 液体碰撞击打后向外飞散

items.def_en: To mark or scatter with small spots, specks, or droplets
items.ex_en: Tiny drops of blue paint flecked the floor during the ceiling renovation.
items.ex_zh: 粉刷天花板期间，微小的蓝色油漆滴星星点点地落在了地板上。

items.def_en: To move around irregularly with a splashing sound, or spill messy liquid around
items.ex_en: Water sloshed out of the bucket as he carried it across the yard.
items.ex_zh: 他拎着水桶穿过院子时，水晃荡着泼溅出来。
items.ex2_en: The playful toddler sloshed water across the bathroom tiles during his bath.
items.ex2_zh: 爱玩耍的蹒跚学步幼童洗澡时把水溅得满浴室地砖都是。

items.def_en: To strike a liquid or surface noisily, sending drops or sheets of fluid scattering
items.ex_en: The speeding truck splashed dirty muddy water all over my clean winter coat.
items.ex_zh: 疾驰的卡车将肮脏的泥水溅了我干净的冬装大衣一身。
items.ex2_en: Cool fountain water splashed continuously against the smooth stone basin all afternoon.
items.ex2_zh: 清凉的喷泉水整个下午都不断飞溅在光滑的石盆上。

items.def_en: To scatter or splash drops of liquid messily onto a surface; to cause a liquid to do this.
items.ex_en: Hot tomato sauce splattered across the kitchen counter when the pot bubbled over.
items.ex_zh: 锅里的汤汁沸腾溢出时，热番茄酱飞溅到了整个厨房台面上。
items.ex2_en: The sloppy painter splattered white latex paint across our newly polished floorboards.
items.ex2_zh: 粗心的粉刷工把白色乳胶漆溅得我们刚打磨过的地板上到处都是。

items.def_en: To cover a surface with scattered small drops of liquid, or fly out in such drops
items.ex_en: Heavy raindrops began to spatter against the dusty glass of the front window.
items.ex_zh: 大颗的雨点开始滴滴答答地溅落在前窗落满灰尘的玻璃上。
items.ex2_en: The reckless driver spattered sticky mud over our freshly washed garden wall.
items.ex2_zh: 鲁莽的司机把黏稠的泥浆溅到了我们刚清洗过的花园围墙上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe liquids or semi-liquids striking surfaces or flying outward in scattered, messy droplets.
groups.summary_zh: 指液体或泥浆击打平面后不规则四散飞溅、形成斑驳污渍。
groups.desc_en: Denotes liquid being violently dispersed into droplets or sloshing over surfaces upon impact or agitation, contrasting with directed jet spraying or steady pouring.
groups.desc_zh: 指液体在撞击或剧烈震荡下飞溅破散成水花或点状痕迹，区别于定向喷射或平稳倾倒。
groups.nuance_en: splash: striking liquid to create dispersed flying drops or wetness (water / mud / puddle) · splatter: messy impact-burst scattering of viscous droplets (blood / sauce / paint) · spatter: dispersing in tiny scattered flecks or drops (grease / raindrops / mud) · slosh: noisy surging and spilling of liquid in a container (fuel / water / drink) · fleck: marking lightly with minute spotted specks (foam / ash / paint)
groups.nuance_zh: splash: 拍击液体使之四溅飞洒 (water / mud / puddle) · splatter: 浓稠液体受撞击炸裂泼溅 (blood / sauce / paint) · spatter: 细碎油星或水点斑斑点点地溅射 (grease / raindrops / mud) · slosh: 容器内液体晃荡扑溢 (fuel / water / drink) · fleck: 微小斑点散碎点缀 (foam / ash / paint)

groups.name: Split & Burst Open · 开裂与自然绽破 (Dehisce, Burst, Rupture)
groups.tip: 物体沿缝隙张开或爆裂

items.def_en: To divide or gape along a seam, crack, or natural line of separation
items.ex_en: The overripe watermelon split open when it dropped onto the tiled kitchen floor.
items.ex_zh: 熟透的西瓜掉在厨房瓷砖地上，猛然裂开了。
items.ex2_en: He split open the ripe coconut by striking it with a hammer.
items.ex2_zh: 他用锤子敲击成熟的椰子，将其砸开了。

items.def_en: To be or become wide open, as of a fissure or deep wound
items.ex_en: A deep fissure gaped in the earthquake-damaged road, blocking all vehicular traffic.
items.ex_zh: 地震受损的道路上裂开一道深壑，阻断了所有车辆通行。

items.def_en: To break open or apart suddenly and violently under internal pressure
items.ex_en: The water pipe burst suddenly under extreme pressure, flooding the entire basement overnight.
items.ex_zh: 水管在极高水压下突然爆开，一夜之间淹没了整个地下室。
items.ex2_en: The excited boy burst the colorful balloon with a sharp metal pin.
items.ex2_zh: 兴奋的小男孩用一枚锋利的金属别针扎破了五颜六色的气球。

items.def_en: (botany / medicine) to split or burst open spontaneously along a natural seam, as a seed pod or surgical wound
items.ex_en: In late autumn, the dry seed capsules dehisce to release their tiny seeds.
items.ex_zh: 深秋时节，干燥的蒴果自然开裂，散布出细小的种子。

items.def_en: To break or tear open suddenly, especially an anatomical structure or membrane
items.ex_en: The patient required emergency surgery when his inflamed appendix began to rupture dangerously.
items.ex_zh: 当发炎的阑尾发生危险性破裂时，病人急需进行急救手术。
items.ex2_en: Blunt abdominal trauma ruptured his spleen, requiring emergency surgical intervention that evening.
items.ex2_zh: 腹部钝挫伤使他的脾脏破裂，当晚需要进行紧急手术治疗。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe natural, biological, or pressurized rupture along lines of structural weakness or natural seams. They convey organic splitting or spontaneous popping open rather than fractured mechanical shattering.
groups.summary_zh: 指囊状物、伤口或组织沿缝线自然破裂、绽开或受压爆裂。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the structural failure of an enclosure, vessel, or natural pod due to internal pressure, biological maturity, or strain, bursting outwards without external cutting.
groups.desc_zh: 指因内部压力、张力或自然成熟而导致的表皮、容器或组织自内向外崩裂绽开，区别于外力切割破损。
groups.nuance_en: burst: explosive rupture under overwhelming internal tension (balloon / pipe / seam) · rupture: breach or tearing of a membrane, wall, or organ (appendix / pipeline / tendon) · split open: separation along seams, fissures, or grain under stress (seam / ground / fruit) · gape: wide, hollow yawn-like opening of a fissure (wound / chasm / mouth) · dehisce: specialized botanical/surgical spontaneous gaping at maturity or suture lines (pod / capsule / incision)
groups.nuance_zh: burst: 承受内压瞬间爆炸性破裂 (balloon / pipe / seam) · rupture: 管道、内脏或薄膜的撕裂破口 (appendix / pipeline / tendon) · split open: 沿接缝或纹理裂开崩缝 (seam / ground / fruit) · gape: 裂口敞开显露深坑 (wound / chasm / mouth) · dehisce: 植物荚果自然裂开，或外科伤口裂开 (pod / capsule / incision)

groups.name: Spoon & Portion · 匙取与分盛 (Spoon out, Dish out, Dollop)
groups.tip: 用勺子舀出流体食物

items.def_en: to serve food onto plates from a communal serving dish or pot
items.ex_en: Grandma began to dish out generous portions of hot stew to every hungry guest.
items.ex_zh: 奶奶开始把大份热气腾腾的炖菜盛给每一位饥肠辘辘的客人。

items.def_en: to transfer food or liquid from a container into a dish using a spoon
items.ex_en: She carefully spooned out the remaining chicken soup into two small ceramic bowls.
items.ex_zh: 她小心翼翼地把剩下的鸡汤用勺舀出，分装进两个小瓷碗里。

items.def_en: to give food to someone, especially baby or invalid, often by spooning it into their mouth
items.ex_en: The young mother patiently fed her sick toddler warm broth with a spoon.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的母亲耐心地用勺子给生病的幼儿喂温热的肉汤。

items.def_zh: 用匙舀出，用勺盛取；调情；（两人）紧密相拥而卧
items.def_en: 1. (+ into/out/up) to transfer, lift, or serve food or liquid using a spoon 2. (informal) to cuddle close together facing the same direction, or engage in amorous kissing and petting
items.ex_en: He spooned some rich homemade gravy over his mashed potatoes before eating.
items.ex_zh: 他吃之前用勺舀了些浓郁的自制肉汁淋在土豆泥上。

items.def_zh: 团盛，随手舀上一大团（稀软物）
items.def_en: to serve or drop a soft, shapeless mass of food onto a plate with a spoon
items.ex_en: The cook dolloped thick sour cream directly onto my steaming bowl of chili.
items.ex_zh: 厨师随手舀了一大团浓稠的酸奶油，扣在我热气腾腾的辣椒肉酱碗上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail transferring, serving, or measuring food and soft, semi-viscous substances using small cupped domestic utensils. The focus is on measured portioning, domestic food handling, and careful serving.
groups.summary_zh: 强调使用勺匙等细小器具分取、盛出或舀送流质食物。
groups.desc_en: Denotes extracting, transferring, or serving viscous, semi-liquid, or granular substances using a spoon or ladle, contrasting with pouring liquids or carving solids.
groups.desc_zh: 指用勺、匙等器具定量舀取、分盛浓稠食物或半流质，区别于液体倾倒或块状切分。
groups.nuance_en: spoon: using a small concave utensil to scoop or transfer (sugar / medicine / soup) · spoon out: scooping portions sequentially from a container (gravy / porridge / sauce) · dish out: distributing generous food portions, or dispensing praise/punishment freely (food / advice / punishment) · dollop: plopping a soft, shapeless lump onto something (cream / jam / mashed potatoes) · feed: supplying sustenance to mouths via utensil or hand (infant / patient / livestock)
groups.nuance_zh: spoon: 用匙舀取调味品或流质 (sugar / medicine / soup) · spoon out: 从大容器中分勺盛出 (gravy / porridge / sauce) · dish out: 盛盘分发，引申为慷慨抛撒批评或建议 (food / advice / punishment) · dollop: 粗放地挖上一团黏稠软物 (cream / jam / mashed potatoes) · feed: 给无法自理者或牲口喂食 (infant / patient / livestock)

groups.name: Spread & Disperse · 散布与蔓延 (Disperse, Scatter, Circulate)
groups.tip: 向四面八方扩散蔓延

items.def_en: To move freely around an area, or to pass information, money, or rumors continuously from person to person
items.ex_en: Wild rumors about the factory closing began to circulate rapidly among the workers.
items.ex_zh: 有关工厂即将倒闭的流言开始在工人们中间迅速流传开来。
items.ex2_en: The administrative office will circulate the updated guidelines to all departments tomorrow.
items.ex2_zh: 行政办公室明天会将更新后的准则分发给各个部门。

items.def_en: To move away from a central point and spread out over a wide expanse in a fan-like formation
items.ex_en: The rescue teams fanned out across the dense forest to locate the missing hiker.
items.ex_zh: 救援队伍在茂密的森林中呈扇形散开，寻找失踪的徒步旅行者。
items.ex2_en: The card dealer fanned out the deck smoothly across the green table.
items.ex2_zh: 发牌员在绿色的牌桌上平滑地将整副牌展开成扇形。

items.def_zh: 散播，扩散，蔓延；展开，铺开；涂，敷
items.def_en: 1. To affect a larger area or group of people, or to make something do so. 2. To open out, unfold, or stretch over an area. 3. To apply a thin layer of a substance over a surface.
items.ex_en: The viral infection spread quickly throughout the crowded school within just three days.
items.ex_zh: 病毒感染在短短三天内就在拥挤的学校里迅速蔓延开来。
items.ex2_en: The bird spread its wide wings fully before soaring into the sky.
items.ex2_zh: 那只鸟完全展开宽阔的双翼，然后展翅飞向了天空。

items.def_en: To quickly move or throw things in different directions over a wide area
items.ex_en: A sudden gust of wind scattered the loose documents across the entire parking lot.
items.ex_zh: 一阵突如其来的强风将散落的文件吹得散布在整个停车场。
items.ex2_en: The pigeons scattered in panic when the stray cat pounced toward them.
items.ex2_zh: 当野猫扑过来时，鸽子们惊恐地四散飞开。

items.def_en: To scatter in different directions and disappear, or to cause a crowd, cloud, or substance to do so
items.ex_en: The morning fog began to disperse gradually as the sun rose higher.
items.ex_zh: 随着太阳升得更高，清晨的浓雾开始渐渐消散。
items.ex2_en: Riot police deployed chemical tear gas canisters to disperse the violent rioters.
items.ex2_zh: 防暴警察使用了化学催泪瓦斯罐以驱散暴力的骚乱者。

groups.summary_en: Describes dynamic spatial propagation across a geographic region, population, or surface—encompassing the rapid transmission of news, diseases, rumors, or moving crowds scattering outward from a focal point.
groups.summary_zh: 指空间上的向外延展、传播或人群散开，如疫情、消息与群体的散布。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the multidirectional dispersion of entities, signals, or substances outward over a wide spatial or conceptual area, contrasting with focused concentration or unidirectional flow.
groups.desc_zh: 指人、物或信息向外广泛发散、蔓延或稀疏分布于广大区域，区别于定向集中或单向推进。
groups.nuance_en: spread: gradual broad extension across an entire surface or domain (disease / butter / rumor) · disperse: driving or drifting completely apart until disappearing (crowd / fog / seeds) · scatter: tossing or streaking randomly in irregular directions (debris / seeds / papers) · fan out: spreading outwards in a widening wedge formation (search party / police / troops) · circulate: moving continuously within a closed or broad network (blood / newsletter / rumor)
groups.nuance_zh: spread: 在表面或领域内平铺蔓延或传播 (disease / butter / rumor) · disperse: 驱散、飘散直至完全消散 (crowd / fog / seeds) · scatter: 凌乱随机地撒落或四散奔逃 (debris / seeds / papers) · fan out: 呈扇形向外展开搜索 (search party / police / troops) · circulate: 在闭环或广域网络中流转循环 (blood / newsletter / rumor)

groups.name: Spurt & Squirt · 喷射与迸涌 (Squirt, Spurt, Gush)
groups.tip: 液体受压向外细细喷射

items.def_zh: （使）喷出，喷射（细流）；向……喷射液体
items.def_en: To force liquid out in a thin, fast stream, or to be emitted in this way.
items.ex_en: The child giggled as he squirted cold water across the lawn with a hose.
items.ex_zh: 那个孩子咯咯笑着，用水管把凉水喷射在整个草坪上。
items.ex2_en: Salty juice squirted everywhere when she bit into the hot dumpling directly.
items.ex2_zh: 当她直接咬开热饺子时，咸鲜的汤汁溅得到处都是。

items.def_en: To shoot out vigorously in a concentrated, high-velocity stream
items.ex_en: Pressurized steam jetted from the damaged boiler valve with an ear-splitting whistle.
items.ex_zh: 高压蒸汽从损坏的锅炉阀门中猛烈喷射出来，伴随着刺耳的呼啸声。
items.ex2_en: Industrial nozzles jet high-pressure water onto raw steel plates to strip rust.
items.ex2_zh: 工业喷嘴向未加工的钢板喷射高压水流以清除锈迹。

items.def_en: To expel large quantities of liquid, gas, or debris rapidly and violently
items.ex_en: The broken pipe continued to spew filthy sewage into the residential street.
items.ex_zh: 破裂的管道继续向居民街区狂喷出肮脏的污水。
items.ex2_en: Thick black plumes of smoke spewed constantly from the active volcanic crater.
items.ex2_zh: 浓黑的烟柱不断地从活跃的火山口中喷涌而出。

items.def_en: To gush out in a sudden, forceful, and intermittent stream
items.ex_en: Red fluid spurted rhythmically from the punctured hydraulic line across the concrete floor.
items.ex_zh: 红色液体从刺破的液压管线中一阵阵地喷涌出来，洒在混凝土地面上。
items.ex2_en: The garden pump spurted cloudy pond water across the newly planted lawn.
items.ex2_zh: 花园水泵把浑浊的池塘水一股股地喷洒在刚铺好的草坪上。

items.def_en: To flow or surge out suddenly in vast, powerful quantities
items.ex_en: Crystal-clear water gushed profusely from the newly drilled mountain well.
items.ex_zh: 清澈见底的泉水从新打的高山水井中大量喷涌而出。
items.ex2_en: The massive fractured conduit gushed oily water into the surrounding pristine meadow.
items.ex2_zh: 断裂的巨大管道向周围原始的草地喷涌出油污的水。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame capture liquids or semi-fluids being ejected under sudden hydrostatic pressure in tight, rapid, or pulsatile streams. Nuances distinguish slender pressurized jets from heavier, voluminous torrents.
groups.summary_zh: 指液体在压力下呈线状或脉冲状骤然喷射、涌流。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the sudden, forceful, and pressured expulsion of a continuous stream or pulse of liquid or gas through a restricted orifice, contrasting with passive dripping or gentle pouring.
groups.desc_zh: 指流体或气体在高压或收缩作用下经窄口突然暴烈涌出或喷注，区别于平静滴沥或倾泻。
groups.nuance_en: spurt: intermittent rhythmic bursts of liquid under pressure (blood / oil / flame) · squirt: rapid thin jet expelled by localized squeezing (water / juice / liquid) · gush: copious, voluminous outward surging (oil / water / blood) · jet: sustained high-velocity forceful stream (steam / fuel / water) · spew: violent, chaotic, and continuous disgorging (lava / smoke / obscenities)
groups.nuance_zh: spurt: 承压流体一截一截的突发喷涌 (blood / oil / flame) · squirt: 受挤压自窄孔射出细流 (water / juice / liquid) · gush: 大体量无阻碍的滔滔涌出 (oil / water / blood) · jet: 高速持续的强力射流 (steam / fuel / water) · spew: 狂暴混乱的大量吐泻 (lava / smoke / obscenities)

groups.name: Sputter & Crackle · 噼啪与喷溅 (Crackle, Pop, Sizzle)
groups.tip: 火花迸溅或不连贯噼啪声

items.def_en: To make a short, quick, explosive sound
items.ex_en: Dried kernels began to pop loudly inside the hot metal pan.
items.ex_zh: 干燥的玉米粒在热金属锅里开始噼啪作响地爆开。
items.ex2_en: She popped the remaining bubble wrap pockets with her fingers to relax.
items.ex2_zh: 她用手指捏爆剩下的气泡膜小泡以放松身心。

items.def_zh: 发嘶嘶声；煎得滋滋作响
items.def_en: To make a hissing sound when frying or heating up
items.ex_en: The marinated beef strips sizzled noisily on the scorching cast iron skillet.
items.ex_zh: 腌制好的牛肉条在滚烫的铸铁煎锅上滋滋作响。

items.def_en: To make a series of short, sharp, snapping sounds like dry wood burning
items.ex_en: Dry pine logs crackled cheerily in the brick fireplace on that freezing evening.
items.ex_zh: 在那个严寒的夜晚，干燥的松木在砖砌壁炉中欢快地噼啪作响。

items.def_zh: 发噼啪声，喷溅；结结巴巴地说，气急败坏地嘟囔
items.def_en: 1. To make a series of short popping or spitting sounds, or spray out spitting drops. 2. To speak quickly, incoherently, or in a confused, angry manner.
items.ex_en: The old frying pan began to sputter dangerous hot oil onto the counter.
items.ex_zh: 旧煎锅开始噼啪作响，把滚烫的油沫喷溅到料理台上。

items.def_zh: 发噗噗声；结结巴巴地嘟囔
items.def_en: To make rapid spitting sounds or speak rapidly and unclearly in confused agitation
items.ex_en: Furious with indignation, the flustered manager could only splutter a few incoherent syllables.
items.ex_zh: 由于义愤填膺，心慌意乱的经理只能结结巴巴地嘟囔出几个断续的音节。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures erratic, sharp popping or explosive acoustics accompanied by spattering sparks, droplets, or speech delivered in short, indignant, choking bursts.
groups.summary_zh: 指火星迸裂、油脂煎炸时发出的断续清脆爆破声或激愤含混的话语。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the production of intermittent, sharp, crackling acoustic or thermal noises typically accompanied by micro-explosions or erratic bursts, contrasting with continuous droning or silent burning.
groups.desc_zh: 指物质因热、电或气阻产生连续断续的噼啪碎响或微小喷溅声，区别于平稳长鸣或无声燃烧。
groups.nuance_en: crackle: rapid succession of small, dry, snapping noises (fire / static / autumn leaves) · pop: sudden single or repeated small explosive snaps (corn / cork / bubble) · sizzle: hissing frying sound of moisture meeting hot oil or surfaces (bacon / steak / pavement) · sputter: spitting, choking noises accompanying irregular ignition or burning (engine / candle / fuse) · splutter: erratic spitting choked sounds made when choking, outraged, or misfiring (speech / engine / cough)
groups.nuance_zh: crackle: 干燥物燃烧或静电连续发生的清脆碎响 (fire / static / autumn leaves) · pop: 短促清脆的爆响 (corn / cork / bubble) · sizzle: 湿气触碰滚烫表面产生的滋滋声 (bacon / steak / pavement) · sputter: 引擎或火苗气阻导致的噗噗哑火跳动 (engine / candle / fuse) · splutter: 因呛水、激愤或失常而结巴喷唾沫 (speech / engine / cough)

groups.name: Squander & Fritter · 挥霍与耗散 (Squander, Fritter away, Blow)
groups.tip: 不加节制地空耗挥霍资财

items.def_zh: 挥霍，浪费（常与away连用）；切碎
items.def_en: (also 'fritter away') To waste time, money, or energy gradually on trivial, unimportant things.
items.ex_en: She tended to fritter her valuable study hours on pointless mobile games.
items.ex_zh: 她往往把宝贵的学习时间虚掷在无聊的手机游戏上。

items.def_en: To gradually waste time, money, or resources bit by bit on trifling, insignificant things
items.ex_en: He managed to fritter away his entire annual bonus on trivial impulse buys.
items.ex_zh: 他把全部年终奖金一点点挥霍在微不足道的冲动消费上了。

items.def_en: To spend an enormous sum of money impulsively and wastefully in a very short duration
items.ex_en: He managed to blow his entire month's salary during a single weekend.
items.ex_zh: 他居然在一个周末里把整整一个月的薪水挥霍一空。

items.def_en: To gradually scatter and waste away wealth, vitality, or energy until nothing remains
items.ex_en: The foolish heir dissipated his substantial family inheritance within five short years.
items.ex_zh: 那个愚蠢的继承人在短短五年内就将丰厚的家族遗产挥霍殆尽。
items.ex2_en: The thick chemical fumes quickly dissipated into the chilly winter air outside.
items.ex2_zh: 浓烈的化学烟雾在室外寒冷的冬日空气中迅速消散殆尽。

items.def_en: To waste money, assets, or valuable opportunities in a reckless, completely foolish manner
items.ex_en: The corrupt council squandered millions of tax dollars on an unnecessary stadium.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的市政委员会在一座毫无必要的主题场馆上滥用了数百万纳税人的钱。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on expending money, wealth, time, or opportunities foolishly, carelessly, or incrementally until they are completely exhausted. 'Squander' denotes large-scale reckless ruin, while 'fritter away' focuses on bleeding resources through trivial, petty dispersals.
groups.summary_zh: 指愚蠢、漫不经心或琐碎地挥霍浪费金钱、精力与光阴。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the reckless, careless, or gradual exhaustion of wealth, opportunities, or energy without tangible return, contrasting with strategic spending or deliberate investing.
groups.desc_zh: 指对金钱、时间或机遇进行非生产性的挥霍、耗费或逐渐消磨殆尽，区别于正常的消费或投资。
groups.nuance_en: squander: profligate waste of valuable advantages or wealth (fortune / opportunity / lead) · fritter away: petty, gradual wasting of resources on trivialities (savings / time / energy) · blow: sudden reckless, careless expenditure or ruined opportunity (money / inheritance / chance) · dissipate: gradual vanishing or dissolute spreading thin of assets (wealth / energies / clouds)
groups.nuance_zh: squander: 大肆败光宝贵财富、良机或优势 (fortune / opportunity / lead) · fritter away: 在细枝末节上一点点消磨磨损资产或精力 (savings / time / energy) · blow: 冲动挥霍败光，或瞬间搞砸良机 (money / inheritance / chance) · dissipate: 逐渐耗散、驱散或沉溺声色而化为乌有 (wealth / energies / clouds)

groups.name: Squat & Shack · 陋居与混住 (Pig, Shack, Camp out)
groups.tip: 居住定居或混迹生活于某处

items.def_zh: 像猪一样肮脏（或挤在一起）生活；大吃大喝
items.def_en: 1. (+ it / together) (informal) To live in crowded, dirty, or squalid conditions. 2. (+ out) (informal) To eat excessive amounts of food greedily.
items.ex_en: Four broke students had to pig together in a cramped, filthy one-bedroom apartment.
items.ex_zh: 四个身无分文的学生不得不挤在一间狭窄肮脏的一居室公寓里过日子。

items.def_en: (+ with) To live or cohabit casually, often in makeshift quarters or without formal marriage
items.ex_en: He decided to shack up with his new partner in a cheap flat.
items.ex_zh: 他决定和新伴侣在一间廉价公寓里同居。

items.def_zh: 露营；在简陋条件下凑合过日子
items.def_en: To sleep or lodge temporarily in rough, unconventional, or cluttered quarters
items.ex_en: We had to camp out in the living room while the bedrooms were painted.
items.ex_zh: 在卧室粉刷期间，我们只得在客厅里凑合着睡地铺。

items.def_en: To hide or lodge in a secluded or cramped place for an extended period
items.ex_en: The armed fugitives managed to hole up inside an abandoned mountain cabin.
items.ex_zh: 武装逃犯设法藏匿在了一座废弃的高山木屋里。

items.def_en: To stay in temporary, improvised living quarters with minimal shelter
items.ex_en: Weary infantrymen bivouacked in the open clearing under the cold autumn sky.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的步兵在寒冷的秋空下露天扎营宿夜。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe living, sleeping, or holing up in untidy, overcrowded, squalid, or makeshift conditions, often evoking disordered domesticity or roughing it informally.
groups.summary_zh: 指在拥挤、杂乱、简陋或不卫生的环境中凑合居住或混居。
groups.desc_en: Denotes dwelling, cohabiting, or lodging in crude, cramped, makeshift, or informal temporary quarters, contrasting with residing in comfortable, settled permanent housing.
groups.desc_zh: 指在简陋、临时、拥挤或非正式的庇护所中勉强混住或隐匿栖身，区别于正式安居。
groups.nuance_en: shack up: informal cohabitation out of wedlock, or crude lodging together (partner / roommate / friend) · camp out: sleeping outdoors in makeshift shelters, or occupying an area stubbornly (protesters / fans / tent) · hole up: hiding out in a secluded or fortified refuge to avoid capture or bad weather (criminals / troops / blizzard) · bivouac: soldiers camping in temporary open-air quarters without tents (troops / climbers / patrol) · pig: living like a swine in squalor or extreme filth (roommates / den / mess)
groups.nuance_zh: shack up: 简陋混住或未婚同居 (partner / roommate / friend) · camp out: 露天扎营宿营，或在某处通宵排队驻扎 (protesters / fans / tent) · hole up: 为避风头或恶劣气候而在隐蔽处窝藏 (criminals / troops / blizzard) · bivouac: 军人或登山者野外露宿、临时设营 (troops / climbers / patrol) · pig: 像猪一样在脏乱不堪的环境中邋遢度日 (roommates / den / mess)

groups.name: Squire & Attend · 献殷勤陪同与应酬随侍 (Squire, Attend, Escort out)
groups.tip: 陪同或护卫他人一同前往

items.def_en: (formal) Travel with or accompany an important person as a companion, attendant, or assistant
items.ex_en: Two senior diplomats will attend the visiting prime minister during his regional tour.
items.ex_zh: 两位资深外交官将在来访首相巡访该地区期间随行侍从。

items.def_en: Go with someone to a station, airport, or doorway to say goodbye when they leave
items.ex_en: The entire family went to the airport to see off their beloved daughter.
items.ex_zh: 全家人一起去了机场，为他们心爱的女儿送行。

items.def_en: (old-fashioned, + with) Court, date, or accompany someone socially as an acknowledged romantic partner
items.ex_en: In those days, young George was proudly walking out with the parson's daughter.
items.ex_zh: 在那些岁月里，年轻的乔治正自豪地与牧师的女儿谈恋爱。

items.def_en: Go somewhere socially with someone, such as to a restaurant or theatre, paying for them as host
items.ex_en: He offered to take out his hardworking team for a lavish seafood dinner.
items.ex_zh: 他主动提出带辛勤工作的团队外出享用一顿丰盛的海鲜大餐。

items.def_zh: 护送，陪同（尤指男子侍从女子）
items.def_en: 1. (dated or humorous) When a man squires a woman, he accompanies and attends her to a social event.
items.ex_en: Lord Henry gallantly squired the foreign duchess through the crowded ballroom.
items.ex_zh: 亨利勋爵殷勤体贴地护送这位外国公爵夫人穿过拥挤的宴会厅。

groups.summary_en: Describes gallantly or formally attending, escorting, and waiting upon someone (often in social, romantic, or high-society functions) with chivalry, polite attentiveness, or subservient courtesy.
groups.summary_zh: 带绅士风度或应酬色彩地陪同、服侍特定宾客或异性出游。
groups.desc_en: Denotes chivalrously, formally, or protective accompanying and entertaining another person in social or public contexts, contrasting with coercive custody or solitary movement.
groups.desc_zh: 指在社交、礼仪或涉外场合中殷勤陪护、迎送或充当男伴随侍，区别于武装押送或单纯尾随。
groups.nuance_en: squire: male gallantly accompanying or escorting a lady to social functions (lady / debutante / guest) · attend: accompanying someone to serve, wait upon, or show courtly respect (monarch / patient / ceremony) · see off: escorting a traveler to a transit point to bid farewell (guest / train / flight) · walk out: escorting someone outside on foot, or walking away in protest (visitor / partner / negotiations) · take out: inviting and paying for someone on a social outing or date (date / client / parents)
groups.nuance_zh: squire: 男士体贴、殷勤地护送或陪同女士出席社交 (lady / debutante / guest) · attend: 作为侍从随行侍奉或陪同出席 (monarch / patient / ceremony) · see off: 送行至车站/机场挥泪作别 (guest / train / flight) · walk out: 陪同走出去送客，或以退席表示抗议 (visitor / partner / negotiations) · take out: 邀请并买单带某人外出就餐消遣 (date / client / parents)

groups.name: Stack & Overlap · 叠覆与层叠 (Overlap, Shingle, Lap)
groups.tip: 鳞次栉比逐层重叠覆盖

items.def_en: To fold, project over, or lay one edge over another edge so that they partly cover each other
items.ex_en: Make sure each wooden panel laps the next by at least one inch.
items.ex_zh: 确保每块木板与下一块相互搭接至少一英寸。

items.def_en: To cover part of the edge of another object, or to lie partly over another surface
items.ex_en: The roof tiles overlap each other precisely to prevent any rainwater from seeping through.
items.ex_zh: 屋顶瓦片彼此严密叠盖，以防止任何雨水渗漏。
items.ex2_en: Workers carefully overlap consecutive metal sheets to guarantee a completely watertight roof.
items.ex2_zh: 工人们细心地将相连的金属板部分重叠，以确保屋顶完全防水。

items.def_zh: （使）鳞状重叠，（使）如瓦片般层叠
items.def_en: (formal, biology / architecture) To overlap or cause to overlap in a regular pattern, like roof tiles or fish scales.
items.ex_en: The protective scales imbricate beautifully along the entire length of the lizard's back.
items.ex_zh: 保护性的鳞片如瓦片般层层叠叠，整齐地覆盖在蜥蜴的背脊上。
items.ex2_en: Master masons imbricate delicate slate tiles to construct weather-resistant heritage roofs.
items.ex2_zh: 泥瓦大师将精美的石板瓦呈鱼鳞状重叠铺设，以建造耐候的传统屋顶。

items.def_en: To arrange or position items in successive rising horizontal rows, layers, or levels
items.ex_en: The landscape architect decided to tier the stone flower beds up the steep hill.
items.ex_zh: 景观设计师决定顺着陡峭的山坡将石头花坛做成分层阶梯式。

items.def_en: To lay or arrange boards, tiles, or hair in regular, overlapping rows
items.ex_en: The skilled carpenter carefully shingled the exterior walls with weather-resistant cedar siding.
items.ex_zh: 技艺娴熟的木匠用耐候性强的雪松壁板将外墙层层重叠铺设好。

groups.summary_en: This structural and geometric frame describes arranging flat, thin, or segmented items so that the edge of one surface partially covers or extends over the edge of the adjacent one in regular, interlocking patterns (as seen on rooftops, scales, or foliage).
groups.summary_zh: 指使物体（如瓦片、鳞片）边缘相互叠盖以形成规则排列的表面。
groups.desc_en: Denotes arranging flat or planar components so that edges partially cross and cover each other in tiered sequence, contrasting with flush edge-to-edge alignment or simple vertical piling.
groups.desc_zh: 指将平面构件以边缘相互交搭、部分遮蔽的梯级方式铺设，区别于齐缝拼接或简单垂直堆叠。
groups.nuance_en: overlap: extending over and covering part of an adjacent surface (sheets / schedules / jurisdictions) · shingle: laying flat materials in overlapping staggered rows like roof tiles (roof / hair / boards) · imbricate: precise regular overlapping of scales or plates with uniform margins (scales / tiles / armor) · lap: folding or wrapping one edge smoothly over another (boards / cloth / edge) · tier: arranging components in rising concentric or layered horizontal banks (seats / cakes / architecture)
groups.nuance_zh: overlap: 边缘部分重叠覆盖，引申为时空交叉 (sheets / schedules / jurisdictions) · shingle: 如屋顶瓦片般自下而上层层错落相叠 (roof / hair / boards) · imbricate: 鱼鳞或板甲状极为规整紧密的叠压排列 (scales / tiles / armor) · lap: 板料或织物边沿的搭接或搭扣 (boards / cloth / edge) · tier: 阶梯式逐层排布或筑级 (seats / cakes / architecture)

groups.name: Staff & Command Militarily · 配备将官与统辖 (Staff, Man, Command)
groups.tip: 统领居上位行使号令

items.def_en: To supply a post, fortification, or ship with people to operate or defend it
items.ex_en: Soldiers rushed to man the coastal artillery posts before dawn broke.
items.ex_zh: 士兵们在破晓前迅速就位，驻防操纵海岸炮兵阵地。

items.def_en: 1. To command, lead, or supply with officers.
items.ex_en: The newly raised volunteer regiment was officially officered by experienced military veterans.
items.ex_zh: 这支新组建的志愿团由经验丰富的老兵正式担任军官统领。

items.def_en: To provide a military unit, organization, or office with the necessary personnel or officers
items.ex_en: The defense ministry moved swiftly to staff the tactical intelligence command center.
items.ex_zh: 国防部迅速采取行动，为战术情报指挥中心配备干员。

items.def_en: To have formal military authority over a group of soldiers, ship, or operation
items.ex_en: General Harrison will command the multinational coalition troops during the planned counteroffensive.
items.ex_zh: 哈里森将军将在计划中的反攻行动中指挥多国联合部队。

items.def_en: To be in charge of an organization, team, or military task force
items.ex_en: She was chosen to head up the newly formed research division.
items.ex_zh: 她被选中领导新成立的研究部门。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on supplying personnel with leadership cadres or exercising formal military authority to supervise, lead, and direct units.
groups.summary_zh: 为部队或机构配备军官/指挥官，并进行正规军事管理统辖。
groups.desc_en: Denotes designating officers, assigning headquarters personnel, or exercising tactical or organizational command over a military unit or defensive station, contrasting with front-line enlistment or civil hiring.
groups.desc_zh: 指为军队编制配备军官、参谋人员或行使战术统辖指挥权，区别于基层征兵或普通的民事劳务雇佣。
groups.nuance_en: command: exercising sovereign operational authority over armed forces (battalion / army / division) · staff: providing administrative or planning personnel for a military headquarters (headquarters / brigade / task force) · officer: supplying a military unit with commissioned officers (regiment / ship / unit) · head up: serving as the principal leader of an initiative or unit (task force / command / committee) · man: assigning fighting bodies to combat positions or weapons (defenses / artillery / barricades)
groups.nuance_zh: command: 对部队行使最高战役战术指挥权 (battalion / army / division) · staff: 为司令部或指挥中枢配备参谋人员 (headquarters / brigade / task force) · officer: 为部队委派配备各级军官 (regiment / ship / unit) · head up: 领衔负责军工专案或特别行动组 (task force / command / committee) · man: 派遣官兵进驻防御阵位或操纵武器装备 (defenses / artillery / barricades)

groups.name: Staff & Post Personnel · 配备人员与守候 (Staff, Crew, Garrison)
groups.tip: 安排人手统管运作

items.def_en: 1. To provide a place, machine, or vehicle with the people needed to operate or defend it.
items.ex_en: Engineers were summoned urgently to man the emergency control room after the power failure.
items.ex_zh: 断电发生后，工程师们被紧急召集去操纵应急控制室。

items.def_en: To provide an organization, service, or facility with employees or workers
items.ex_en: The clinic will staff additional registered nurses to handle the surge in patients.
items.ex_zh: 诊所将配备更多注册护士，以应对突增的就诊患者。

items.def_zh: 为（船只、飞机等）配备乘员
items.def_en: To serve as or supply the operating personnel for a ship, aircraft, or vehicle
items.ex_en: Volunteers eagerly gathered to crew the historic sailboat on its final voyage.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者们热切聚集，为这艘历史悠久的帆船的最后一次航行担任乘员。

items.def_zh: 占驻；驻扎（工作岗位或据点）
items.def_en: To take up position in or fill an official post, post station, or premises
items.ex_en: The experienced civil servant continued to occupy the key administrative post for decades.
items.ex_zh: 这位经验丰富的公务员数十年来一直占驻着这个关键的行政职位。

items.def_en: To station soldiers in a fortress, base, or town to defend it
items.ex_en: The emperor ordered his royal guards to garrison the vulnerable border citadel permanently.
items.ex_zh: 皇帝下令皇家卫队永久派兵驻守这座易受攻击的边境要塞。

groups.summary_en: These verbs denote supplying human operators, guards, or workers to service a post, station, vessel, or operational desk. They emphasize providing functional manpower or establishing active occupancy.
groups.summary_zh: 指为设施、岗位或载具调配并派驻必要的操作及值守人员。
groups.desc_en: Denotes deploying, posting, or maintaining an adequate human workforce or military detachment to operate, service, or defend a post or vehicle, contrasting with leaving it derelict or fully automated.
groups.desc_zh: 指在岗位、设施、载具或要塞中配备足够的操作与驻防人员以维持值守运转，区别于荒废或全自动运转。
groups.nuance_en: staff: furnishing an organization with necessary operating workers (hospital / desk / hotline) · man: providing physical human operators to attend a station or machinery (helm / phones / post) · crew: supplying trained operational operators for a vessel, plane, or machine (ship / tank / aircraft) · garrison: stationing defensive military units permanently in a fort or town (fort / outpost / town) · occupy: taking physical possession of and holding a territory or installation (territory / building / base)
groups.nuance_zh: staff: 为机构或服务台配齐工作人员 (hospital / desk / hotline) · man: 派人亲自守候岗位或手动操控设备 (helm / phones / post) · crew: 为舰船、飞机配备专业乘组或机组 (ship / tank / aircraft) · garrison: 派军队常态化驻防城堡或要塞 (fort / outpost / town) · occupy: 实际接管、进驻并占据特定物理空间或基地 (territory / building / base)

groups.name: Stamp & Trample · 重踏与践踏 (Tramp, Stomp, Tread)
groups.tip: 用力跺脚甚至将物体踩碎

items.def_zh: 重踏，跺（脚），踩碎；盖章于，印上；贴邮票于
items.def_en: 1. To bring down the foot heavily on the ground or onto an object. 2. To print a pattern, mark, or words onto a surface with a special tool. 3. To affix a postage stamp to.
items.ex_en: Angry commuters stamped their cold feet on the icy railway platform while waiting.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的通勤客在冰冷的火车站台上等待时跺着冻僵的脚。

items.def_zh: 沉重步行；迈着沉重的步子走
items.def_en: To walk with heavy, firm footsteps over a long distance
items.ex_en: Exhausted soldiers tramped through the thick mud along the dark country road.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫不堪的士兵们迈着沉重的步伐，艰难穿过黑暗乡村道路上的深泥。

items.def_en: To extinguish a fire by treading forcefully upon it, or eliminate an undesirable practice
items.ex_en: The firefighter moved swiftly to stamp out the remaining smoldering embers of grass.
items.ex_zh: 消防队员迅速上前，用脚踩灭了剩余的暗燃草屑残烬。

items.def_en: To step heavily and noisily onto the ground, often out of anger or frustration
items.ex_en: Angry at the referee's unfair call, the coach stomped across the basketball court.
items.ex_zh: 因裁判不公的判决而恼火，教练怒气冲冲地大步跺脚穿过篮球场。

items.def_en: To tread heavily upon someone or something, causing destruction, injury, or flattening
items.ex_en: The panicked herd of cattle trampled the wooden fence into splinters during the thunderstorm.
items.ex_zh: 惊慌失措的牛群在雷暴中将木栅栏踩成了碎片。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers heavy, forceful downward foot movements driven by emotional turbulence (rage, impatience) or the intent to crush, squash, or punish ground-level entities beneath the soles. Nuances range from noisy auditory beats to destructive crushing.
groups.summary_zh: 强调双足沉重跺击、因怒顿足或以脚底狠踩碾碎物体的动作。
groups.desc_en: Denotes bringing the feet down violently, heavily, or destructively upon a surface or object, contrasting with graceful stepping or light walking.
groups.desc_zh: 指用脚掌猛烈、沉重或具破坏性地跺踏、踩压地面或目标物，区别于轻快行走或正常迈步。
groups.nuance_en: stamp: bringing the foot down forcefully with vertical blunt impact (foot / floor / authority) · stomp: heavy, clumsy, deliberate pounding steps often in rage (feet / room / ground) · trample: crushing, injuring, or flattening by walking all over violently (grass / rights / crowd) · tramp: walking with heavy, firm, resolute, or exhausting footsteps (roads / woods / mud) · stamp out: forcibly extinguishing or eradicating by stamping (fire / disease / dissent)
groups.nuance_zh: stamp: 愤怒或强调地垂直重重顿足或跺脚 (foot / floor / authority) · stomp: 迈着笨重而愤怒的重步粗暴踩踏 (feet / room / ground) · trample: 彻底踩扁、踩碎，引申为践踏蹂躏权益 (grass / rights / crowd) · tramp: 迈着沉重疲惫或坚定的大步长途跋涉 (roads / woods / mud) · stamp out: 用脚踩灭余烬，引申为雷霆扑灭消灭异端 (fire / disease / dissent)

groups.name: Stash & Secret Cache · 隐匿与秘密存留 (Cache, Squirrel Away, Hide Away)
groups.tip: 将物品妥善存放或暗中隐藏

items.def_en: To place something in a secure, concealed location where it cannot easily be found
items.ex_en: The author hid away in a remote cottage to finish writing her novel.
items.ex_zh: 这位作家躲在偏远的小屋里避世闭关，以完成她的小说。

items.def_en: To save or secretly put away money or valuables for future security
items.ex_en: She managed to salt away a little cash each month for emergencies.
items.ex_zh: 她设法每个月私下存一点现金，以备不时之需。

items.def_en: To hide or store money or supplies carefully in a safe place for the future
items.ex_en: Grandpa squirrelled away gold coins under the loose floorboard in the bedroom.
items.ex_zh: 爷爷悄悄把金币藏在卧室松动的地板下。

items.def_en: To store items secretly in a secure hidden location
items.ex_en: Partisans cached crates of ammunition inside a secluded cavern deep within the forest.
items.ex_zh: 游击队员将成箱的弹药隐匿在密林深处一处隐秘的洞穴中。

items.def_en: To store or hide money, valuables, or possessions in a safe or secret place.
items.ex_en: He stashed the stolen jewels beneath the passenger seat of his car.
items.ex_zh: 他把偷来的珠宝藏匿在汽车副驾驶座下方。

groups.summary_en: This frame refers to concealing or setting aside money, valuables, or contraband in a secret or out-of-the-way hiding spot for future retrieval.
groups.summary_zh: 指将财物、贵重品等隐秘存放或藏于暗处以备后用。
groups.desc_en: Denotes deliberately placing valuables, reserves, or contraband in a secret, protected repository for future use, contrasting with displaying openly or casual misplacement.
groups.desc_zh: 指出于安全或后备需要，将贵重物资、违禁品秘密藏匿于隐秘处所，区别于公开摆放或随意遗落。
groups.nuance_en: stash: hurriedly storing items in a hidden, safe, or secret spot (cash / drugs / loot) · cache: storing reserves systematically in a hidden stockpile (weapons / supplies / provisions) · squirrel away: obsessively hoarding small reserves bit by bit for the future (savings / supplies / food) · salt away: prudently saving funds out of reach for a rainy day (money / earnings / fortune) · hide away: concealing oneself or an object entirely from public view (valuables / criminal / manuscript)
groups.nuance_zh: stash: 匆匆将现钞或赃物塞进私密夹层隐匿 (cash / drugs / loot) · cache: 体系化地在地下或秘密隐蔽所储备物资或军火 (weapons / supplies / provisions) · squirrel away: 松鼠过冬般点滴囤积零散积蓄或食物 (savings / supplies / food) · salt away: 审慎地将余钱或收益“腌存”定存以备不时之需 (money / earnings / fortune) · hide away: 完全躲避外界视线将宝物或人隐蔽避世 (valuables / criminal / manuscript)

groups.name: State & Proclaim Firmly · 声明与郑重宣布 (Declare, Assert, Pronounce)
groups.tip: 从正式声明到昭告天下

items.def_en: To express something definitely or clearly in speech or writing
items.ex_en: The contract clearly states that all overdue balances incur an immediate penalty.
items.ex_zh: 合同明确陈述，所有逾期欠款均需立即缴纳滞纳金。

items.def_en: To make a public and typical formal statement about a fact, event, or intention
items.ex_en: The CEO announced a complete restructuring of the company's international sales division.
items.ex_zh: 首席执行官正式宣布对公司国际销售部门进行全面重组。

items.def_zh: 正式宣布，宣告；郑重声明；申报（应纳税品等）
items.def_en: 1. To announce or state something clearly, firmly, or officially. 2. To formally state taxable goods, income, or possessions.
items.ex_en: Passengers arriving from abroad must declare any high-value gifts at customs inspection.
items.ex_zh: 海外抵境旅客必须在海关检查时如实申报任何高价值礼品。

items.def_en: To state an opinion, decision, or judgment authoritatively or officially
items.ex_en: The presiding judge pronounced the defendant guilty on all counts of fraud.
items.ex_zh: 主审法官权威宣布被告的所有欺诈罪名成立。

items.def_en: To state something firmly and publicly as true or valid
items.ex_en: The committee affirmed its commitment to protecting all regional environmental standards.
items.ex_zh: 委员会郑重肯定了其捍卫该地区所有环境标准的承诺。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses verbs denoting unambiguous, authoritative, and binding announcements, ranging from formal state declarations to personal assertions of fact.
groups.summary_zh: 强调明确、坚定且具权威性地公开陈述立场、裁定或决定。
groups.desc_en: Denotes communicating facts, intentions, or decisions in a direct, definitive, formal, and authoritative manner, contrasting with tentative hinting or casual gossiping.
groups.desc_zh: 指以正式、笃定且权威的口吻就事实、决定或主张作出明确表态，区别于委婉暗示或私下闲聊。
groups.nuance_en: state: setting forth facts or intentions clearly and definitively in words (facts / position / intentions) · declare: explicitly and authoritatively making a formal proclamation (war / independence / dividend) · announce: publicly disseminating news or a scheduled arrival/event (decision / resignation / wedding) · pronounce: delivering an authoritative, often final or judicial judgment (verdict / dead / blessing) · affirm: upholding or reasserting the truth of something with strong conviction (truth / commitment / loyalty)
groups.nuance_zh: state: 明确、平直、定性地陈述事实或立场 (facts / position / intentions) · declare: 官方或庄严地正式宣告声明 (war / independence / dividend) · announce: 面向公众通报消息或重大变动 (decision / resignation / wedding) · pronounce: 法官或权威人士下达终审判决或裁定 (verdict / dead / blessing) · affirm: 坚定不移地确证、重申真理或忠诚 (truth / commitment / loyalty)

groups.name: State-Appropriate & Take Over · 强行征用与公有化 (Requisition, Impound, Confiscate)
groups.tip: 将关键命脉收归公有并管辖

items.def_en: To gain full operational control of a business, agency, or country by sovereign authority or force
items.ex_en: Military forces quickly took over the state television network during the sudden crisis.
items.ex_zh: 在突发危机期间，军队迅速接管了国家电视网。

items.def_en: To officially take possession of a vehicle, goods, or funds until legal requirements are satisfied
items.ex_en: Traffic police impounded the unregistered vehicle until the owner presented proof of insurance.
items.ex_zh: 交警扣押了这辆未登记的车辆，直至车主出示保险凭证。

items.def_en: To take a person's property away as a legal penalty or sovereign expropriation without payment
items.ex_en: Port customs officers confiscated the illicit cargo of smuggled ivory at dawn.
items.ex_zh: 港口海关官员在拂晓时分没收了走私象牙的非法货物。

items.def_en: To officially demand and take possession of property, supplies, or facilities for government or military service
items.ex_en: The army requisitioned all private transport vehicles to move supplies to the front.
items.ex_zh: 军队依法征用了所有私人运输车辆，将物资运往前方。

items.def_zh: 将…收归国有，实行国有化
items.def_en: (chiefly British English) to bring an industry, company, or land under the control and ownership of the government
items.ex_en: The newly elected government decided to nationalise the entire domestic railway network.
items.ex_zh: 新当选的政府决定将整个国内铁路网收归国有。

groups.summary_en: This manner frame highlights the intrusive enforcement and statutory mechanisms of sovereign acquisition. It emphasizes authoritarian commandeering, seizure of private assets, or overriding private property rights under regulatory or state powers.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重公权力通过行政或强制手段接管、扣押私有资产。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the legally sanctioned or authoritative seizure and assumption of control over private property or enterprises by a governing body, contrasting with criminal theft or voluntary acquisition.
groups.desc_zh: 指权力机构或政府依法或依职权强行扣押、征用或将私有财产与企业收归控制，区别于普通偷盗抢劫或自愿收购。
groups.nuance_en: nationalise: convert private industry into state ownership (industry / railways / assets) · requisition: officially demand property for emergency or military use (supplies / vehicles / buildings) · confiscate: seize property as a legal forfeiture or penalty (contraband / weapons / goods) · impound: take legal custody of property until clearance or settlement (vehicle / passport / documents) · take over: assume management, control, or sovereignty over an entity (company / territory / operations)
groups.nuance_zh: nationalise: 将私有企业或行业收归国有 (industry / railways / assets) · requisition: 因紧急或战时需求官方征用 (supplies / vehicles / buildings) · confiscate: 没收充公作为处罚或查禁非法物品 (contraband / weapons / goods) · impound: 依司法或行政权力暂扣代管待结案 (vehicle / passport / documents) · take over: 接管企业或掌控控制权 (company / territory / operations)

groups.name: Sterilize & Disinfect · 消毒与灭菌 (Sterilize, Disinfect, Sanitize)
groups.tip: 清除有害病菌，达到无菌状态

items.def_en: To make hygienic and safe by reducing microorganisms to acceptable public health levels
items.ex_en: Hospital staff frequently sanitize the operating tables to prevent harmful bacterial infections.
items.ex_zh: 医务人员频繁对手术台进行卫生杀菌，以防有害细菌感染。

items.def_en: 1. to make something completely clean and free from all bacteria and microorganisms 2. to make a person or animal unable to produce offspring
items.ex_en: Surgical instruments must be thoroughly sterilized in an autoclave prior to every operation.
items.ex_zh: 每次手术前，外科器械必须在高压灭菌器中彻底杀菌消毒。

items.def_en: To clean something with chemicals to destroy the harmful bacteria living on it
items.ex_en: She used bleach solution to disinfect the kitchen counters after preparing raw chicken.
items.ex_zh: 在处理完生鸡肉后，她用漂白水给厨房台面消毒。

items.def_en: To remove hazardous, toxic, chemical, or biological agents from an area or object
items.ex_en: Specialists worked tirelessly to decontaminate the soil following the toxic chemical spill.
items.ex_zh: 在有毒化学品泄漏后，专家们不知疲倦地工作以消除土壤中的污染物。

items.def_en: To apply chemical fumes or gases to an enclosed area to exterminate pathogens or pests
items.ex_en: Exterminators will fumigate the grain warehouse to eliminate persistent beetle infestations.
items.ex_zh: 消杀人员将对粮仓进行熏蒸除害，以消灭顽固的甲虫虫害。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify the rigorous removal, killing, or inactivation of pathogens, germs, and bacteria from surfaces, instruments, or wounds to achieve sanitary or aseptic safety.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过物理或化学手段杀灭或清除病原微生物，以达到卫生或无菌状态。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on purifying an object, environment, or organism by killing or neutralizing microbial pathogens and contaminants across varying degrees of efficacy, rather than merely cleaning off surface dirt.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过物理或化学手段杀灭或清除病原微生物及污染物，侧重不同级别的杀菌除污效力，区别于仅仅抹去表面尘垢的普通清洁。
groups.nuance_en: sterilize: destroy 100% of all microbial life and spores (surgical instruments / needles / soil) · disinfect: eliminate most pathogenic microorganisms on inanimate surfaces (countertops / floors / restrooms) · sanitize: reduce bacterial counts to acceptable public-health safety standards (hands / kitchenware / food surfaces) · decontaminate: neutralize hazardous biological, chemical, or radioactive agents (protective suits / disaster sites / runoff) · fumigate: eradicate pests or pathogens using gaseous chemicals (grain silos / buildings / soil)
groups.nuance_zh: sterilize: 彻底杀灭所有微生物及芽孢达到无菌 (surgical instruments / needles / soil) · disinfect: 消除物体表面的绝大多数致病菌 (countertops / floors / restrooms) · sanitize: 将细菌压减至公共卫生安全标准 (hands / kitchenware / food surfaces) · decontaminate: 清除中和化学、放射或生化危险污染物 (protective suits / disaster sites / runoff) · fumigate: 用毒性气体制剂进行熏蒸消杀或灭虫 (grain silos / buildings / soil)

groups.name: Stick Together & Cohere · 凝聚与抱团 (Cling, Congeal, Cleave)
groups.tip: 各部分互相黏附合为一体

items.def_en: (+ to) To stick firmly to a surface or join tightly with other material components
items.ex_en: The adhesive label must adhere firmly to the dry plastic surface.
items.ex_zh: 该不干胶标签必须紧密粘附在干燥的塑料表面上。

items.def_en: (+ together/to) To hold on tightly to something or stick together securely
items.ex_en: Wet snowflakes clung to the branches of the ancient pine tree outside.
items.ex_zh: 湿漉漉的雪花紧紧附着在外面那棵古松的枝丫上。

items.def_en: To solidify, thicken, or merge into a dense mass; to take a stable unified shape
items.ex_en: The cooling broth began to congeal into a thick, gelatinous mass overnight.
items.ex_zh: 冷却的肉汤在一夜之间开始凝结成厚厚的胶状块。
items.ex2_en: Freezing conditions congealed the thick oil into an unworkable waxy paste.
items.ex2_zh: 严寒的条件使稠厚的油凝固成无法使用的蜡状糊状物。

items.def_en: 1. (formal) When parts of an argument, group, or substance cohere, they stick together and form a logical, unified whole.
items.ex_en: His disparate thoughts finally began to cohere into a unified research proposal.
items.ex_zh: 他零散的想法终于开始凝聚成一份连贯一致的研究提案。

items.def_en: (+ to) (archaic/literary) To adhere strongly and unshakeably to a person, faith, or bond
items.ex_en: Through years of hardship, the villagers cleaved to their ancient ancestral traditions.
items.ex_zh: 历经数年磨难，村民们始终坚守着古老的祖训传统。
items.ex2_en: The sculptor cleaved the enormous block of granite with a single blow.
items.ex2_zh: 雕刻家一击就劈开了那块巨大的花岗岩石料。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures physical cohesion or rational solidarity, where distinct elements stick firmly together to form a stable, indivisible whole or logically unified argument. It spans literal molecular binding and abstract ideological solidarity.
groups.summary_zh: 指物理上的相互粘连凝聚，或抽象层面上紧密粘合、逻辑自洽。
groups.desc_en: Denotes physical or figurative bonding where separate parts cling together, thicken, or unite into a single continuous mass or whole, contrasting with mere spatial proximity or external strapping.
groups.desc_zh: 指分离的分子、实体或概念通过内在吸附力紧密粘连、凝固或团结为一个连贯的整体，区别于单纯空间相邻或机械捆绑。
groups.nuance_en: adhere: stick firmly via surface tension or bond (glue to surface / label / membrane) · cling: hold fast by static, moisture, or desperate physical grip (wet clothes / child to parent / vines) · congeal: solidify or thicken into a gelatinous mass (blood / grease / soup) · cohere: hold logically or structurally together as a unified whole (argument / party / particles) · cleave: split apart, or archaic/formal cling with unyielding devotion (custom / spouse / rock)
groups.nuance_zh: adhere: 凭借黏附力或分子附着紧密粘合 (glue to surface / label / membrane) · cling: 紧紧抱住、死死贴住或因潮湿静电粘附 (wet clothes / child to parent / vines) · congeal: 液体冷却凝结凝固成冻状物 (blood / grease / soup) · cohere: 论述各部分或团队逻辑且牢固地凝聚在一起 (argument / party / particles) · cleave: 紧紧依附、坚守不渝，亦可表示劈裂 (custom / spouse / rock)

groups.name: Stiffen & Reinforce · 浆硬与加固 (Starch, Stiffen, Taut)
groups.tip: 质地转为僵硬，失去柔软弯折性

items.def_en: To make a structure, material, or position stronger and firmer by adding extra support
items.ex_en: Workers reinforced the fragile concrete bridge with thick steel support beams.
items.ex_zh: 工人们用粗壮的钢支撑梁加固了这座脆弱的混凝土桥梁。

items.def_en: To reinforce or support something firmly to make it rigid and steady against physical force
items.ex_en: Carpenters braced the sloping basement walls with heavy timber beams before construction.
items.ex_zh: 施工前，木匠们用重型木梁支撑加固了倾斜的地下室墙体。

items.def_en: To become tight, rigid, or stretched without slack, or to cause something to do so
items.ex_en: The sailors quickly tautened the main sail rope as violent winds arose.
items.ex_zh: 狂风骤起，水手们迅速拉紧了主帆索。
items.ex2_en: The towline tautened suddenly under the immense weight of the disabled vessel.
items.ex2_zh: 拖缆在那艘失去动力的船只巨大的重量下突然绷紧了。

items.def_en: to make clothes, linen, or fabric stiff and crisp by applying starch
items.ex_en: The laundry attendant starched the formal dress shirts to make them crisp.
items.ex_zh: 洗衣工给礼服衬衫上了浆，使其笔挺平整。

items.def_en: To make or become firm, taut, rigid, or less flexible
items.ex_en: The freezing winter wind stiffened the wet canvas tarpaulin within minutes.
items.ex_zh: 刺骨的冬风在几分钟内就让潮湿的帆布篷布变得僵挺。
items.ex2_en: Her entire body stiffened with intense fear when she heard strange noises.
items.ex2_zh: 当她听到奇怪的声响时，她的整个身体因极度恐惧而僵硬了。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe treating fabrics, limbs, or structures so that they lose pliability, becoming crisp, firm, and upright.
groups.summary_zh: 指对织物上浆或使肢体结构变得挺括、僵硬而不易弯曲。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the process of hardening, tautening, or structurally bolstering an object or tissue to resist bending or collapse, contrasting with mere enlargement or general repair.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过硬化、紧绷或增加支撑结构来提高物体的挺括度或抗形变能力，区别于简单的尺寸扩大或日常修补。
groups.nuance_en: stiffen: make or become rigid, taut, or resistant to bending (muscles / resolving / fabric) · reinforce: strengthen by adding structural supports or additional material (concrete walls / beams / troops) · brace: steady or support against anticipated shock or lateral load (scaffold / oneself / leg) · tauten: pull into a state of high physical tension (rope / skin / sails) · starch: treat cloth with starch to make it stiff and crisp (collars / shirts / linen)
groups.nuance_zh: stiffen: 使变硬挺、僵化或意志变坚定 (muscles / resolving / fabric) · reinforce: 增加配筋、构件或兵力以加固 (concrete walls / beams / troops) · brace: 施加斜撑以抵御侧向受力或做好迎击准备 (scaffold / oneself / leg) · tauten: 绷紧或使拉紧到高度张弛状态 (rope / skin / sails) · starch: 上浆使织物挺括坚挺 (collars / shirts / linen)

groups.name: Stifle & Muffle · 隔音与捂住 (Deadensound, Smother, Gag)
groups.tip: 包裹阻隔减弱发声响度

items.def_en: To prevent a sound or physiological impulse from escaping by holding it back
items.ex_en: She tried desperately to stifle a yawn during the tedious board meeting.
items.ex_zh: 在沉闷的董事会会议上，她拼命想要忍住哈欠。

items.def_zh: 消音，捂住使声音减弱；包裹以保暖
items.def_en: 1. to make a sound quieter or less clear by wrapping or covering the source 2. to wrap someone or something up warmly
items.ex_en: Thick woollen blankets muffled the rattling sounds of the noisy antique radiator.
items.ex_zh: 厚厚的羊毛毯捂住了老式暖气片发出嘎嘎作响的噪音。

items.def_en: To reduce the resonance, sharpness, or clarity of sound through padding or insulation
items.ex_en: Heavy acoustic foam panels deaden footsteps and unwanted echoes in the studio.
items.ex_zh: 厚重的吸音泡沫板隔绝了录音室内的脚步声和多余回音。

items.def_en: To suppress or cover a sound, flame, or breath by smothering it with a heavy layer
items.ex_en: He buried his face into the soft pillow to smother his laughter.
items.ex_zh: 他把脸埋进柔软的枕头里，以抑制自己的笑声。

items.def_en: To put a cloth or object into or over someone's mouth to prevent vocal noise
items.ex_en: The intruders gagged the night watchman with a cloth before looting the safe.
items.ex_zh: 侵入者在洗劫保险柜之前用一块布塞住了夜班保安的嘴。

groups.summary_en: Covers physically covering, wrapping, or obstructing an acoustic source or vocal tract to deaden, dull, or smother the sound produced.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过物理包裹、遮盖或封堵发声源，达到隔音或压制声响的效果。
groups.desc_en: Denotes suppressing, muffling, or extinguishing sound, breathing, or vocal expression through physical obstruction or barrier attenuation, contrasting with natural silencing or ambient quiet.
groups.desc_zh: 指用物理遮盖、阻隔或挤压手段窒息呼吸、压制声浪或堵住嘴巴，区别于自然停歇或环境的自然安静。
groups.nuance_en: muffle: deaden or wrap to make a sound dull and low (explosion / cries / footsteps) · stifle: suppress a biological reflex, noise, or expression before full release (yawn / laugh / dissent) · deaden: absorb or extinguish the intensity of sound or sensation (acoustic echo / pain / noise) · smother: deprive completely of air or overwhelm with dense covering (flames / breath / baby) · gag: physically obstruct the mouth to prevent speech, or retch (hostage / victim / press)
groups.nuance_zh: muffle: 裹住或加装隔音物使声音低沉发闷 (explosion / cries / footsteps) · stifle: 强行遏制声响、生理冲动或压制言论 (yawn / laugh / dissent) · deaden: 吸收消除噪音回响或麻痹钝化感觉 (acoustic echo / pain / noise) · smother: 用厚密物体完全闷熄或阻断呼吸致窒息 (flames / breath / baby) · gag: 用异物堵住受害者嘴部或剥夺言论自由 (hostage / victim / press)

groups.name: Still Photography & Snapshot · 照相与抓拍 (Photograph, Snap, Capture)
groups.tip: 运用镜头或绘图记录画面

items.def_en: To photograph a subject, person, or setting with a camera
items.ex_en: The photographer decided to shoot the delicate ceramic vases under soft natural light.
items.ex_zh: 摄影师决定在柔和的自然光下拍摄这组精致的陶瓷花瓶。

items.def_en: 1. To take a picture of someone or something using a camera. 2. To appear or look in a particular way when photographed.
items.ex_en: Tourists eagerly photographed the ancient castle illuminated by the setting autumn sun.
items.ex_zh: 游客们争相给沐浴在秋日落日余晖中的古堡拍照。

items.def_en: To take a photograph quickly, casually, or informally
items.ex_en: She snapped a quick photo of the vibrant sunset over the bay.
items.ex_zh: 她随手抓拍了一张海湾上壮美日落的照片。

items.def_en: To take a quick series of photographs or snap an immediate picture
items.ex_en: He snapped off several frames as the race car flew past the stands.
items.ex_zh: 赛车呼啸掠过看台时，他迅速按动快门拍下了几张照片。

items.def_zh: 定格；拍摄捕捉到（画面/神态）
items.def_en: To record or depict a scene, atmosphere, or expression accurately in a photograph
items.ex_en: The camera lens captured her fleeting expression of pure relief and joy.
items.ex_zh: 照相机镜头捕捉到了她转瞬即逝的如释重负与喜悦神态。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to taking still images using a camera, capturing a frozen optical likeness of people, scenes, or objects. Nuances contrast formal portrait photography, spontaneous amateur snapping, and high-fidelity artistic capture.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过照相机按动快门凝固瞬间、拍摄静止照片的行为。
groups.desc_en: Denotes preserving a fleeting visual moment into a permanent two-dimensional still image through the operation of a camera, contrasting with drawing, recording continuous video, or mental recollection.
groups.desc_zh: 指利用相机或光学设备抓取瞬态画面并定格为静态摄影图像，区别于手工绘画、连续录像或记忆留存。
groups.nuance_en: photograph: deliberately compose and expose a still image (model / landscape / specimen) · snap: take an informal, quick, or opportunistic snapshot (casual scene / family picnic / tourist spot) · capture: successfully freeze a transient mood, detail, or decisive action (emotion / lighting / movement) · shoot: point and actuate a camera, often professional or continuous (session / portrait / film) · snap off: release the shutter abruptly in rapid fire (few quick shots / photo / frame)
groups.nuance_zh: photograph: 正式构图并曝光拍摄静态照片 (model / landscape / specimen) · snap: 随手快速按下快门抓拍日常快照 (casual scene / family picnic / tourist spot) · capture: 敏锐定格瞬间的光影、神态或关键动作 (emotion / lighting / movement) · shoot: 执机取景拍摄（常指专业外拍或连拍） (session / portrait / film) · snap off: 迅疾果断地连咔几张快照 (few quick shots / photo / frame)

groups.name: Stir & Mix Liquids · 搅拌与调和 (Stir, Swirl, Whisk)
groups.tip: 用工具在流体中打转翻动混合

items.def_zh: 翻拌（轻柔混合烘焙配料）
items.def_en: Mix an ingredient gently into another with a lifting, turning motion to avoid knocking out air
items.ex_en: Gently fold in the whipped egg whites to keep the cake batter light.
items.ex_zh: 轻柔地翻拌打发的蛋白霜，以保持蛋糕糊蓬松充气。

items.def_zh: 搅动，搅拌；激起，打动；微动
items.def_en: 1. To move an implement through a liquid or other substance in order to mix it thoroughly. 2. To arouse strong feelings or memories. 3. To move slightly.
items.ex_en: He slowly stirred the fragrant soup using a large wooden spoon over heat.
items.ex_zh: 他用一把大木勺在火上缓缓搅拌着浓香的汤。
items.ex2_en: Fresh autumn breezes stir gently through the orange canopy of the forest.
items.ex2_zh: 清爽的秋风在森林橙黄色的树冠间轻轻拂动。

items.def_en: Stir or agitate a vat of thick mixture using a paddle or broad flat blade
items.ex_en: The artisan paddled the thick vat of melted soap to blend the oils.
items.ex_zh: 工匠用桨状器具缓缓搅动那一厚缸融化的肥皂以使油脂交融。

items.def_en: Move around or cause a liquid to move gently in a circular or spiral pattern
items.ex_en: The sommelier swirled the vintage wine gently to release its rich aroma.
items.ex_zh: 侍酒师轻轻打旋摇晃着陈年老酒，以释放其浓郁的芳香。
items.ex2_en: Pale snowflakes swirled endlessly through the freezing air outside our mountain cabin.
items.ex2_zh: 洁白的雪花在我们山间小木屋外的冷空气中无休止地盘旋飞舞。

items.def_en: Beat or stir a substance, especially eggs or cream, rapidly with a light wire fork or whisk
items.ex_en: She quickly whisked the egg yolks with sugar until the mixture turned pale.
items.ex_zh: 她用打蛋器快速搅打蛋黄和糖，直到混合物颜色发白。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate circular or repetitive mechanical actions used to mix, blend, dissolve, or aerate liquids and loose culinary ingredients using an implement.
groups.summary_zh: 用勺、棒等器具在液体或物料中做圆周运动以混合或溶解。
groups.desc_en: Denotes impartially circulating, shearing, or incorporating liquid and semi-liquid ingredients together using an implement, contrasting with chaotic shaking or complete emulsifying blending.
groups.desc_zh: 指使用器具在流体或半流体中施加环形、剪切或翻动运动以使其均质化，区别于剧烈摇晃或粉碎式机打搅拌。
groups.nuance_en: stir: move an implement continuously through liquid in circular paths (coffee / soup / paint) · whisk: beat rapidly to incorporate air using wire loops (egg whites / cream / batter) · swirl: agitate liquid with a circular centrifugal wrist motion (wine in glass / coffee / solution) · fold in: gently incorporate light, aerated ingredients without deflating (whipped cream / egg whites / flour) · paddle: agitate or mix heavy slurries or dough with a flat blade (confectionery / mash / compound)
groups.nuance_zh: stir: 拿调羹或棒子在液体中作圆周移动搅拌 (coffee / soup / paint) · whisk: 用打蛋器高速击打充入空气 (egg whites / cream / batter) · swirl: 晃动手腕使液体在容器内打漩涡 (wine in glass / coffee / solution) · fold in: 自下而上轻柔翻拌以防消泡 (whipped cream / egg whites / flour) · paddle: 用平直叶片缓慢翻搅稠厚膏体或浆料 (confectionery / mash / compound)

groups.name: Stir Up Strife & Unrest · 煽动叛乱与挑起冲突 (Foment, Stir Up, Agitate)
groups.tip: 煽风点火挑起事端

items.def_en: Deliberately cause trouble, arguments, or bad feelings among people.
items.ex_en: The tabloid journalist always tried to stir up unnecessary trouble among local politicians.
items.ex_zh: 那名八卦记者总是试图在当地政客之间挑起不必要的争端。

items.def_en: Deliberately excite or escalate intense emotions, enthusiasm, or anger in a crowd.
items.ex_en: The radical speaker whipped up intense public anger against the proposed tax hike.
items.ex_zh: 激进的演讲者煽惑起公众对拟议增税的强烈愤怒。

items.def_en: Arouse or inspire an intense emotion, passion, or dispute as if setting a fire.
items.ex_en: His arrogant remarks kindled a fierce dispute among the delegates at the summit.
items.ex_zh: 他傲慢的言辞在峰会代表之间点燃了激烈的争端。
items.ex2_en: Mutual resentment kindled slowly between the two rival factions over many months.
items.ex2_zh: 两个敌对派系之间的相互怨恨在数月间慢慢滋生蔓延。

items.def_en: Campaign vigorously and publicly to stir public concern or political unrest.
items.ex_en: Labor union leaders actively agitated for shorter working hours and safer factory conditions.
items.ex_zh: 工会领袖们积极公开鼓动，争取缩短工时和更安全的工厂环境。

items.def_en: 1. (formal) To deliberately stir up or instigate trouble, rebellion, or violent discontent. 2. (medical, dated) To bathe a body part with warm liquids.
items.ex_en: Foreign agents covertly attempted to foment violent rebellion against the ruling coalition.
items.ex_zh: 外国特工暗中企图煽动针对执政联盟的暴力叛乱。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this political and conflict frame describe deliberately generating, nurturing, and spreading rebellion, ideological discontent, or mass unrest from behind the scenes.
groups.summary_zh: 指在幕后蓄意挑起、策划并滋长反叛、动乱或群体敌对情绪。
groups.desc_en: Denotes intentionally sparking, feeding, or mobilizing social or political disorder and rebellion through provocative instigation, contrasting with spontaneous rioting or calm mediation.
groups.desc_zh: 指蓄意播撒不满、挑衅唆使以煽动群体对抗、动乱或社会反叛，区别于自发的民怨爆发或和平抗议。
groups.nuance_en: foment: systematically nurture and nurse internal discord or rebellion (rebellion / revolution / unrest) · agitate: campaign vigorously, unsettling public sentiment to demand change (for reform / crowd / workers) · whip up: deliberately manipulate collective emotions into a frenzy (hysteria / nationalism / fervor) · stir up: provoke latent friction or dormant animosity into open conflict (trouble / resentment / trouble) · kindle: ignite an initial ideological or emotional spark of revolt (passions / protest / flame)
groups.nuance_zh: foment: 隐蔽而系统性地煽动酝酿叛乱与动乱 (rebellion / revolution / unrest) · agitate: 鼓动造势使群众骚动以推进行动 (for reform / crowd / workers) · whip up: 极力煽呼以激起狂热仇恨或极端情绪 (hysteria / nationalism / fervor) · stir up: 蓄意挑起本已平息或潜在的争端与祸端 (trouble / resentment / trouble) · kindle: 像点燃火星般点燃激情、叛逆或冲突导火索 (passions / protest / flame)

groups.name: Stopper & Block · 堵塞与封塞 (Plug, Obstruct, Clog)
groups.tip: 用塞子或屏障堵截孔道流通

items.def_en: To block or close an opening or hole by inserting a piece of suitable material firmly into it
items.ex_en: The handyman plugged the leaky basement pipe with a thick rubber stopper.
items.ex_zh: 维修工用一个厚橡胶塞子封堵住了地下室漏水的管道。

items.def_en: To block or become blocked with an accumulation of thick or solid matter so movement stops
items.ex_en: Fallen leaves quickly clogged the street drains during the torrential autumn downpour.
items.ex_zh: 在秋季倾盆大雨中，落叶迅速堵塞了街道排水沟。
items.ex2_en: The kitchen pipes clogged completely after months of pouring grease down drains.
items.ex2_zh: 在连续数月往排水管倾倒油脂后，厨房管道彻底堵塞了。

items.def_en: to close or seal an opening or container with a stopper or plug.
items.ex_en: The chemist carefully stoppered the glass vial to prevent hazardous fumes from escaping.
items.ex_zh: 化学家仔细地用塞子封住了玻璃小瓶，以防有害气体逸出。

items.def_en: To overcrowd, block, or clog an artery, passage, or system with an excessive volume of matter
items.ex_en: Holiday shoppers congest the narrow downtown arteries every Saturday before Christmas.
items.ex_zh: 圣诞节前的每个周六，假日购物者都会使市中心狭窄的主干道严重拥塞。
items.ex2_en: Excess mucus congests easily in the nasal passages during severe winter colds.
items.ex2_zh: 在冬季重感冒期间，过多的黏液很容易在鼻腔通道中积聚充塞。

items.def_en: To restrict or stop the flow, passage, or development of something entirely
items.ex_en: Strict trade sanctions choked off the supply of imported fuel to regional factories.
items.ex_zh: 严厉的贸易制裁彻底阻断了向当地工厂供应进口燃料的渠道。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on inserting a solid obstruction or allowing a substance to accumulate in a conduit, opening, or pipe, halting the flow of liquids, gases, or traffic.
groups.summary_zh: 以栓塞填塞孔道或沉积阻碍物，阻断流体通行流动。
groups.desc_en: Denotes obstructing or completely occluding an orifice, passage, or fluid conduit to halt circulation or flow, contrasting with orderly closing or gradual throttling.
groups.desc_zh: 指用塞子插入或因杂质积聚使管道、孔隙或通道完全梗阻闭塞，区别于阀门正常关闭或渐进节流。
groups.nuance_en: plug: insert a close-fitting stopper to fill a hole or leak (leak / hole / gap) · clog: block a conduit gradually with accumulated sludge or matter (artery / drain / filter) · stopper: seal the neck of a vessel tightly with a purpose-built bung (bottle / flask / decanter) · congest: overload a channel causing severe sluggish stagnation (traffic / nasal passages / networks) · choke off: ruthlessly constrict a channel until flow ceases entirely (supplies / oxygen / pipeline)
groups.nuance_zh: plug: 塞入合缝的塞子以堵塞孔洞或漏点 (leak / hole / gap) · clog: 因污物、杂质日积月累而堵塞管路 (artery / drain / filter) · stopper: 用专用塞子封严瓶口或器皿口 (bottle / flask / decanter) · congest: 因过载造成流道拥堵、停滞不前 (traffic / nasal passages / networks) · choke off: 掐断供给通道直至彻底断流 (supplies / oxygen / pipeline)

groups.name: Store & Keep Safe · 存储与留存备用 (Keep, Reserve, Hold)
groups.tip: 妥善存放以备后用

items.def_en: To retain possession of something or store it continually in a specific spot
items.ex_en: She always keeps her passport and official documents in the locked drawer.
items.ex_zh: 她总是把护照和正式文件存放在上锁的抽屉里。

items.def_zh: 储藏，储存；（在计算机中）保存，存储
items.def_en: 1. To keep or put something away for future use. 2. To keep data or information in a computer.
items.ex_en: Local farmers store harvested grain in insulated metal silos for the harsh winter.
items.ex_zh: 当地农民将收获的粮食储存在隔热金属筒仓内以备严冬。

items.def_en: To keep something back or set it apart for a particular future use
items.ex_en: The chef reserved three bottles of vintage wine for the wedding reception.
items.ex_zh: 大厨特意留出了三瓶陈年葡萄酒备用于婚宴。

items.def_en: To place items, furniture, or goods inside a warehouse or storage facility
items.ex_en: We put our antique oak furniture in storage while the house was renovated.
items.ex_zh: 在房屋翻修期间，我们把老式橡木家具放进了仓库暂存。

items.def_en: To contain, shelter, or hold something within an enclosure or structure
items.ex_en: The ancient cave system harbored colonies of rare subterranean bats during winter.
items.ex_zh: 古老的洞穴系统在冬季庇护容纳着成群的罕见地下蝙蝠。

groups.summary_en: This frame centres on retaining, holding, or archiving physical objects, provisions, or digital data in a designated location so that they remain available for future use.
groups.summary_zh: 指将物品、物资或数据存放在指定场所保存备用。
groups.desc_en: Denotes placing goods, funds, or provisions into a secure custody or dedicated holding facility for deferred retrieval, contrasting with immediate consumption or outright discarding.
groups.desc_zh: 指将物资、数据或财物安置在安全处所妥善保管以备日后提取使用，区别于当场耗尽或随手丢弃。
groups.nuance_en: store: hold commodities or data systematically in an allocated space (grain / files / supplies) · reserve: intentionally earmark and withhold a portion for special future need (seats / funds / rights) · harbor: shelter or keep secretly, often something illicit or persistent (fugitive / grudges / bacteria) · put in storage: transport physical assets to a dedicated warehouse facility (furniture / seasonal goods / vehicle) · keep: retain continuous possession and custody without relinquishing (records / secrets / spare key)
groups.nuance_zh: cross: 越过或横穿通道与界线 (street / bridge / border) · span: 桥梁或时间从一端实际跨接到另一端 (river / centuries / gorge) · straddle: 双腿或势力分跨在事物两边 (border / fence / horse) · bestride: 威风凛凛地跨立其上并居高临下统摄 (world / horse / industry) · bridge: 构筑物理桥梁或弥合抽象鸿沟 (gap / divide / differences)

groups.name: Straddle & Span · 跨立与横跨 (Span, Bridge, Bestride)
groups.tip: 跨立或定位于某一支撑点

items.def_en: To pass or extend from one side of a surface, line, or border to the other
items.ex_en: The hikers carefully crossed the treacherous river using a fallen tree trunk.
items.ex_zh: 徒步旅行者借助一根倒下的树干小心翼翼地横穿了湍急的河流。

items.def_en: To build a passage over an obstacle, or reduce the difference between two contrasting things
items.ex_en: Diplomats worked tirelessly to bridge the sharp differences between the opposing factions.
items.ex_zh: 外交官们不知疲倦地工作，以弥合对立派系之间的尖锐分歧。

items.def_en: To extend across or bridge a physical distance, time period, or range of topics
items.ex_en: A graceful stone suspension bridge spans the wide gorge near the mountains.
items.ex_zh: 一座优美的石制吊桥横跨在山区附近的宽阔峡谷之上。

items.def_zh: 跨立于，跨坐于；横跨（两地或两领域）
items.def_en: To sit, stand, or lie with one leg on each side of something, or to extend across two different areas or periods.
items.ex_en: The sprawling natural reserve straddles the border between two sovereign nations.
items.ex_zh: 这片辽阔的自然保护区横跨两个主权国家之间的边界。

items.def_en: To stand or sit with one leg on each side of something, or to dominate an entire sphere
items.ex_en: The legendary Colossus was said to bestride the harbor entrance in ancient times.
items.ex_zh: 传说古时候罗得岛太阳神巨像跨立于海港入口处。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on physical or figurative positions where a body or structure extends across two sides, boundaries, or categories, maintaining a stance over an intervening space or divide.
groups.summary_zh: 指双腿分开跨立，或在物理与抽象意义上横跨两个领域或界限。
groups.desc_en: Denotes physically or conceptually bridging across a spatial divide, barrier, or ideological border by extending from one edge to another, contrasting with staying strictly on one side.
groups.desc_zh: 指在空间、边界或概念界限两端横跨延伸或两脚各据一侧，区别于局限于单一侧翼。
