groups.nuance_en: span: extend completely across a physical gap or chronological era (river / centuries / chasm) · straddle: extend across both sides of a dividing boundary physically or politically (border / fence / market) · bestride: dominate or stand across with legs spread wide in mastery (horse / global stage / continent) · bridge: create a physical or figurative link overcoming a divide (gap / divide / differences) · cross: traverse from one margin across to the other (street / ocean / border)
groups.nuance_zh: span: 从空间鸿沟或时间跨度的一头实打实延展到另一头 (river / centuries / chasm) · straddle: 双腿跨坐或横跨两侧、兼顾两端边界 (border / fence / market) · bestride: 跨骑或高高凌驾横跨于其上并具备主导力 (horse / global stage / continent) · bridge: 搭建桥梁以连接两端或弥合分歧 (gap / divide / differences) · cross: 从一侧表面横行穿越至对侧 (street / ocean / border)

groups.name: Strand & Trap · 受困与搁浅 (Maroon, Trap, Corner)
groups.tip: 陷于困境动弹不得

items.def_en: To run a ship onto the seabed or shallow shore, or prohibit aircraft from flying
items.ex_en: Dense fog forced airport authorities to ground all outgoing domestic flights this morning.
items.ex_zh: 浓雾迫使机场当局在今天上午停飞所有国内离港航班。

items.def_en: To drive an opponent or prey into a tight location leaving no avenue for flight
items.ex_en: Clever questioning during the cross-examination managed to corner the elusive defense witness.
items.ex_zh: 交叉质证中巧妙的提问成功将那名狡黠的辩方证人逼入绝境。

items.def_en: To confine someone or an animal in a hazardous place from which escape is impossible
items.ex_en: Rising floodwaters threatened to trap the elderly residents inside their single-story homes.
items.ex_zh: 上涨的洪水随时可能将年迈的居民围困在他们的平房之中。

items.def_zh: 使搁浅；使陷于困境，使滞留
items.def_en: To leave someone, a boat, or a vehicle stuck in a place with no way of leaving.
items.ex_en: A severe blizzard threatened to strand thousands of holiday travelers at remote stations.
items.ex_zh: 一场猛烈的暴风雪恐将数千名度假旅客滞留在偏远的车站。

items.def_en: To leave someone abandoned in an isolated place, such as a deserted island, without means of return
items.ex_en: The pirate captain threatened to maroon the mutinous sailor on a barren sandbar.
items.ex_zh: 海盗船长威胁要将那个谋反的水手遗弃在一座荒凉的沙洲上。

groups.summary_en: Pertains to isolating people, vessels, or animals in a precarious or isolated environment without resources or practical means of escape.
groups.summary_zh: 指因事故、地理阻断或危险境地而受困或滞留无法离开。
groups.desc_en: Denotes being left immobilized in an isolated, inhospitable predicament with escape cut off, contrasting with voluntary retreat or comfortable seclusion.
groups.desc_zh: 指因外力切断退路或丧失交通能力而被遗弃、困在险境或无援之地，区别于自愿闭门或安全休憩。
groups.nuance_en: strand: leave helpless and cut off due to logistical failure or isolation (passengers / travelers / assets) · maroon: abandon deliberately or helplessly on a deserted, inaccessible place (sailor / island / desert) · ground: prohibit an aircraft or vessel from moving, or run hull into shallow seabed (fleet / flights / vessel) · trap: catch in an inescapable constriction or snare (miner / victims / animal) · corner: drive an adversary into an angle where retreat is impossible (prey / suspect / market)
groups.nuance_zh: strand: 因交通瘫痪或意外断绝退路而滞留无援 (passengers / travelers / assets) · maroon: 放逐或困弃于孤岛偏僻险绝之地 (sailor / island / desert) · ground: 船只搁浅于浅滩，或勒令飞机停飞 (fleet / flights / vessel) · trap: 陷入圈套、瓦砾或动弹不得的绝境 (miner / victims / animal) · corner: 将对手或猎物逼入无法脱身的死角 (prey / suspect / market)

groups.name: Stratify & Grade · 分层与分级 (Gradate, Rank, Tier)
groups.tip: 按梯次与类别，界限分明划层

items.def_en: To classify or separate things according to quality, rank, size, or difficulty
items.ex_en: Inspectors grade the imported coffee beans according to their size, aroma, and moisture.
items.ex_zh: 检验员根据进口咖啡豆的大小、香气和水分对其进行分级。

items.def_en: To pass or arrange through imperceptible or successive stages or shades
items.ex_en: The artist carefully selected pigments that gradate seamlessly from deep indigo to pale azure.
items.ex_zh: 艺术家精心挑选了从深靛蓝向浅天蓝自然渐变的颜料。
items.ex2_en: The master dyer gradates rich hues smoothly across the long silk fabric.
items.ex2_zh: 染色大师在长长的丝绸织物上使浓郁的色调平滑地渐变展开。

items.def_en: To arrange or organize things into multiple levels or layers of hierarchy
items.ex_en: The company decided to tier its subscription services into three distinct pricing categories.
items.ex_zh: 该公司决定将其订阅服务分层划分为三个不同的价格区间。

items.def_en: To position people or things in an ordered sequence of seniority, value, or excellence
items.ex_en: International evaluators rank the university among the top ten research institutions worldwide.
items.ex_zh: 国际评审机构将该大学列为全球排名前十的科研机构之一。

items.def_en: 1. (sociology / geology) To divide or form into distinct social classes, layers, or strata.
items.ex_en: Rigid economic systems tend to stratify society into deeply unequal socioeconomic classes.
items.ex_zh: 僵化的经济体制往往会使社会分化为极不平等的阶层。
items.ex2_en: Distinct geological strata stratify visibly throughout the rocky face of the canyon.
items.ex2_zh: 在峡谷的岩石表面上，不同的地质层清晰地层叠分化。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame deal with ordering items, society, or materials into ranked levels, geological strata, or hierarchical tiers. They emphasize progressive gradation, structural layers, or institutional ranking.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重将事物、社会或物质依层次、高低等级或结构分层归类。
groups.desc_en: Denotes categorizing, layering, or arranging items into a hierarchical or graduated series according to rank, density, or quality, contrasting with random mixing or flat non-hierarchical groupings.
groups.desc_zh: 指按质地、等级或高低序列将事物划分出阶层、层级或梯度，区别于杂乱混杂或无层级平铺。
groups.nuance_en: stratify: divide into rigid socioeconomic or geological horizontal layers (society / rock strata / population) · grade: classify materials or student work based on evaluated quality (meat / timber / exams) · tier: arrange services, prices, or seating into discrete stepped ranks (pricing / seating / system) · rank: assign an ordinal position relative to others (teams / candidates / priorities) · gradate: transition seamlessly through subtle successive stages of shade or scale (colors / tones / shades)
groups.nuance_zh: stratify: 使社会阶层化或地质沉积形成明显层状 (society / rock strata / population) · grade: 按品质好坏进行分级评分 (meat / timber / exams) · tier: 划分分层阶梯结构（如定价、座席） (pricing / seating / system) · rank: 按竞争排位依次排列先后名次 (teams / candidates / priorities) · gradate: 色彩、色调或梯度间细腻均匀地渐变过渡 (colors / tones / shades)

groups.name: Stray & Derail · 偏离与脱轨 (Derail, Run aground, Go astray)
groups.tip: 车体脱轨或走离正轨

items.def_en: Become lost or go off track physically, or fail to follow the proper course morally or procedurally
items.ex_en: Without clear guidance, inexperienced young researchers might easily go astray in their investigations.
items.ex_zh: 缺乏明确的指导，缺乏经验的年轻研究人员很容易在调研中走偏。

items.def_zh: 使转入岔道；使脱离主旨
items.def_en: Divert someone or something from the main topic, task, or course of action
items.ex_en: Irrelevant arguments threatened to sidetrack the committee from discussing the urgent budget deficit.
items.ex_zh: 无关痛痒的争论恐将使委员会脱离讨论预算赤字这一紧迫议题。

items.def_en: Come onto the shore or hit bottom; metaphorically encounter an insurmountable impasse
items.ex_en: High hopes for the trade negotiations began to run aground on agricultural tariffs.
items.ex_zh: 各方对贸易谈判寄予的厚望开始因农业关税问题受阻停滞。

items.def_en: 1. (of a train) To run off its tracks, or cause a train to do this. 2. To obstruct, spoil, or prevent a plan or process from continuing successfully.
items.ex_en: Sudden regulatory changes threaten to derail the international merger before next quarter.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的监管政策变动恐将在下季度前彻底破坏这桩跨国并购案。
items.ex2_en: The overloaded freight train derailed unexpectedly on the icy mountain curve yesterday.
items.ex2_zh: 超载的货运列车昨天在结冰的山道转弯处意外脱轨了。

items.def_en: Deliberately derail or cause a plan, venture, or negotiation to fail
items.ex_en: A sudden leak of confidential documents threatened to scupper the fragile peace deal.
items.ex_zh: 机密文件的突然泄露可能会搞砸那份脆弱的和平协议。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on vehicles or processes losing their guided track, causing systemic breakdown, disruption, or failure. It strongly contrasts physical derailment with metaphorical sabotage of negotiations, plans, and initiatives.
groups.summary_zh: 指火车出轨或规划、进程脱离预设轨道并走向失败中断。
groups.desc_en: Denotes veering disastrously off an intended path, track, or reasoned course into failure or confusion, contrasting with planned course corrections.
groups.desc_zh: 指脱离轨道、迷失正途或偏离既定主线从而引发灾难性偏转与失败，区别于有计划的航向调整。
groups.nuance_en: derail: force a train off tracks, or catastrophically disrupt a process (train / peace talks / career) · go astray: wander off the right moral, physical, or logistical path (sheep / parcel / youth) · sidetrack: distract attention away from the primary objective to trivia (discussion / investigation / project) · run aground: run a ship onto seabed, or bring an effort to an impasse (vessel / negotiations / policy) · scupper: deliberately sink or sabotage a plan beyond recovery (plans / chances / deal)
groups.nuance_zh: derail: 火车脱轨，或使谈判进程毁于一旦 (train / peace talks / career) · go astray: 迷失正道、包裹走失或误入歧途 (sheep / parcel / youth) · sidetrack: 被细枝末节带偏从而脱离主线 (discussion / investigation / project) · run aground: 船只触礁搁浅，或政策谈判陷入僵局 (vessel / negotiations / policy) · scupper: 蓄意凿沉船只或蓄意破坏方案使之流产 (plans / chances / deal)

groups.name: Strengthen & Enhance · 强化与增效 (Supercharge, Boost, Amp up)
groups.tip: 大幅提升威力与效能

items.def_en: To increase, improve, or encourage the power, value, or performance of something
items.ex_en: Tax incentives helped boost foreign direct investment across several regional manufacturing sectors.
items.ex_zh: 税收激励措施帮助提升了多个区域制造业部门的外国直接投资。

items.def_en: To make something much stronger, louder, more exciting, or more intense
items.ex_en: The coach tried to amp up the players before the critical championship match.
items.ex_zh: 在关键的冠军争夺战之前，教练竭力激发队员们的高昂斗志。

items.def_zh: 给……装涡轮增压；强力加速
items.def_en: To make something grow, develop, or operate much faster and more forcefully than normal
items.ex_en: Massive state subsidies aim to turbocharge the growth of the renewable energy sector.
items.ex_zh: 巨额的国家补贴旨在强力加速可再生能源产业的蓬勃发展。

items.def_en: To become or make something become more active, energetic, or productive
items.ex_en: Automakers plan to rev up electric vehicle production ahead of the busy spring season.
items.ex_zh: 汽车制造商计划在繁忙的春季到来前加快电动汽车的生产步伐。

items.def_zh: 大幅增强，给……强力增效；为（发动机）增压
items.def_en: 1. To greatly increase the power, efficiency, or intensity of something. 2. To supply an internal combustion engine with air or fuel at greater than atmospheric pressure.
items.ex_en: Strategic cloud integration will supercharge the company’s ability to process massive financial datasets.
items.ex_zh: 战略性的云端整合将大幅增强该公司处理海量金融数据的能力。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this dynamic frame describe drastically ramping up the speed, output, intensity, or capability of an engine, system, process, or asset far beyond its baseline parameters.
groups.summary_zh: 指大幅提升系统、效能或力量，使其进入高强度的运行状态。
groups.desc_en: Denotes drastically escalating the potency, speed, power, or output of an existing system through aggressive stimulation, contrasting with moderate natural growth.
groups.desc_zh: 指采取强效干预或增压手段使系统、引擎或业务的效能爆发式剧增，区别于温和的自然渐进增量。
groups.nuance_en: boost: lift or increase performance, confidence, or sales (confidence / economy / immune system) · supercharge: turbocharge dramatically with unprecedented vigor (growth / engine / returns) · turbocharge: accelerate an operation to high-velocity performance (productivity / engine / growth) · amp up: increase volume, intensity, or electrical power excitedly (excitement / rhetoric / volume) · rev up: spin an engine fast in neutral, or prepare vigorously for action (engine / campaign / production)
groups.nuance_zh: boost: 显著提振、托举或推动 (confidence / economy / immune system) · supercharge: 给系统输入超强动能或暴增效率 (growth / engine / returns) · turbocharge: 借助涡轮增压般赋予超高增速 (productivity / engine / growth) · amp up: 大幅放大声量、情绪张力或电能 (excitement / rhetoric / volume) · rev up: 猛踩油门轰鸣空转，或加紧战备运转 (engine / campaign / production)

groups.name: Stretch & Sprawl · 伸展与摊开 (Loll, Spread out, Stretch out)
groups.tip: 手脚摊开或无序扩张

items.def_en: To extend your arms and legs wide across a space while resting or lounging
items.ex_en: The search team spread out across the forest to look for the missing hikers.
items.ex_zh: 搜救队在森林中分散开来寻找失踪的徒步旅行者。
items.ex2_en: The gardener spread out fresh wood mulch evenly across the flowerbeds.
items.ex2_zh: 园丁把新鲜的木屑均匀地铺撒在各个花坛上。

items.def_zh: 躺下伸展身体；舒展四肢
items.def_en: To lie down at full length to rest or relax your muscles comfortably
items.ex_en: Exhausted from the marathon, he stretched out on the grass to catch his breath.
items.ex_zh: 跑完马拉松筋疲力尽的他躺在草地上歇气。
items.ex2_en: The professor had to stretch out the difficult lecture to two hours.
items.ex2_zh: 教授不得不把这堂难懂的讲座延长至两个小时。

items.def_zh: 懒散惬意地躺卧或闲坐
items.def_en: To lie, sit, or stand in a relaxed and lazy way, typically in a soft chair or sofa
items.ex_en: Guests can lounge by the heated outdoor pool while sipping fresh fruit cocktails.
items.ex_zh: 宾客们可以在室外温水泳池旁慵懒闲坐，边品尝新鲜的水果鸡尾酒。

items.def_zh: 伸开四肢坐（或躺）；（城市、植物等）杂乱无章地蔓延，随意扩展
items.def_en: 1. To sit or lie with arms and legs spread out untidily or carelessly. 2. To spread out in an irregular or uncontrolled way over a large area.
items.ex_en: Exhausted travelers often sprawl across airport benches while waiting for delayed overnight flights.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫不堪的旅客常常在等待延误的红眼航班时四仰八叉地躺在机场长椅上。

items.def_zh: 懒洋洋地坐卧；懒散倚靠
items.def_en: To sit, lie, or stand in a lazy, relaxed, or floppy posture without firm support
items.ex_en: Weary hounds loll beneath the spreading oak branches during the stifling summer heat.
items.ex_zh: 酷暑难耐之时，疲倦的猎犬在繁茂的橡树枝下懒洋洋地蜷卧着。

groups.summary_en: Describes adopting a relaxed, careless, or languid posture where the limbs or body are loosely extended across a surface. Often contrasts purposeful stretching with lazy recumbence.
groups.summary_zh: 描述肢体随意舒展或懒散瘫坐的姿态，强调松弛与无拘无束。
groups.desc_en: Denotes expanding one's limbs or bodily mass carelessly and languidly across a surface, contrasting with upright, disciplined, or compact posture.
groups.desc_zh: 指散漫、慵懒地将肢体或身躯四仰八叉摊开占据空间，区别于端坐、戒备或蜷缩紧凑姿态。
groups.nuance_en: sprawl: sit, lie, or expand with limbs flung out clumsily or widely (on sofa / across floor / suburbs) · stretch out: extend full body length horizontally to rest (on the bed / legs / on towel) · lounge: recline or pass time in an idle, relaxed posture (by pool / in armchair / around) · loll: hang or rest loosely and lazily against a support (head / tongue / in hammock) · spread out: distribute personal belongings or people across a wide surface (map / papers / troops)
groups.nuance_zh: sprawl: 懒散随意、四仰八叉摊开手脚躺卧 (on sofa / across floor / suburbs) · stretch out: 充分伸展躯干或四肢平躺休息 (on the bed / legs / on towel) · lounge: 懒洋洋地斜倚或悠闲打发时间 (by pool / in armchair / around) · loll: 脑袋耷拉、舌头吐出或身子歪倒在吊床上 (head / tongue / in hammock) · spread out: 将身体或随身物品在大面积铺展摊平 (map / papers / troops)

groups.name: Strike & Swipe · 侧扫与挥击 (Swipe, Lash out, Flail)
groups.tip: 侧向抡动武器或利爪挥击

items.def_zh: 挥击，猛打；刷（磁卡）；滑屏；偷窃
items.def_en: 1. To hit or swing at someone or something with a wide, sweeping blow. 2. To pass a card through an electronic reader, or slide a finger across a screen. 3. (informal) To steal
items.ex_en: The mischievous boy tried to swipe a handful of freshly baked warm cookies.
items.ex_zh: 那个调皮的男孩试图顺手摸走一把刚出炉的热饼干。

items.def_en: To hit someone or something forcefully, making a loud, dull slapping or thudding sound
items.ex_en: The frustrated carpenter decided to whack the stubborn iron nail with his heaviest hammer.
items.ex_zh: 懊恼的木匠决定用最重的那柄铁锤狠狠砸向那颗顽固的铁钉。

items.def_en: To hit something, especially an insect, with a sharp, quick, sweeping blow using a flat object
items.ex_en: She grabbed a rolled magazine to swat the persistent fly buzzing near the window.
items.ex_zh: 她拿起一本卷起来的杂志，去拍打窗边嗡嗡乱飞的恼人苍蝇。

items.def_en: To suddenly attempt to hit someone with a sweeping blow of a limb, weapon, or verbal fury
items.ex_en: Cornered by hostile reporters, the cornered politician began to lash out defensively during questioning.
items.ex_zh: 被怀有敌意的记者围堵逼问时，这位陷入绝境的政客开始予以猛烈反击。

items.def_en: To hit someone or something hard with the hand or a heavy blunt object in a swinging arc
items.ex_en: The furious sailor swung around and gave the insolent deckhand a heavy clout.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的水手猛地转身，狠狠给了那个傲慢的甲板水手重重一击。

groups.summary_en: This frame depicts sudden lateral or sweeping arm/limb movements aimed at striking an opponent or target, often with wide trajectory and variable precision. 'Swipe' indicates a swift horizontal cut or blow, while 'lash out' conveys aggressive kicking or swinging.
groups.summary_zh: 指甩动肢体或器具横向扫击、侧抡，常带迅猛攻势或防卫性质。
groups.desc_en: Denotes delivering a brisk, sweeping, or glancing horizontal blow with an arm, paw, or implement, contrasting with straight thrusting or blunt downward pounding.
groups.desc_zh: 指挥动手臂、爪子或扁平器具作横向扫击、扇打或盲目挥甩，区别于垂直下砸或直线突刺。
groups.nuance_en: swipe: hit with a sweeping horizontal swing or steal abruptly (cat with paw / at ball / card) · swat: slap sharply to crush or drive away insects or small annoyances (fly / mosquito / away hand) · whack: strike heavily with a sharp resounding thud (ball / opponent / weed) · lash out: strike violently outward with sudden anger or physical limbs (with fists / against critics / with hooves) · clout: deliver a heavy blow with the fist, or possess political sway (jaw / ball / over policy)
groups.nuance_zh: swipe: 横向抡臂或出爪快速扫击，或刷卡 (cat with paw / at ball / card) · swat: 用苍蝇拍或手掌迅捷拍扁蚊虫 (fly / mosquito / away hand) · whack: 势大力沉、声响清脆地猛击 (ball / opponent / weed) · lash out: 突然暴怒抡拳反击或言辞痛斥 (with fists / against critics / with hooves) · clout: 重拳击打头部面部，或指政治影响力 (jaw / ball / over policy)

groups.name: Strike Resonantly · 鸣金与振响敲击 (Gong, Chime, Toll)
groups.tip: 重力击打发出响声

items.def_en: To ring out with a clear, resonant musical bell sound
items.ex_en: Antique brass clocks chime softly on the hour throughout the quiet Victorian mansion.
items.ex_zh: 古董黄铜钟整点时在静谧的维多利亚式大宅中悠扬地鸣响报时。
items.ex2_en: The church bellringer chimed the silver bells to mark the joyous festival.
items.ex2_zh: 教堂司钟人敲响了银钟，以庆祝这个欢乐的节日。

items.def_en: To strike a large bell slowly and repeatedly to signal a solemn event
items.ex_en: Heavy bronze bells toll slowly across the valley to honor the fallen monarch.
items.ex_zh: 沉重的青铜钟声在山谷间缓缓回荡，悼念逝世的君主。
items.ex2_en: The grieving monks tolled the massive bell for three continuous days solemnly.
items.ex2_zh: 悲痛的僧侣们庄严地连续敲击了三天巨大的丧钟。

items.def_en: To strike a gong to produce a resonant sound, often as a signal.
items.ex_en: Attendants gong the large bronze basin to signal the start of the sacred feast.
items.ex_zh: 侍从敲响巨大的铜锣，宣告神圣宴席的正式开始。

items.def_en: To make or cause to make a loud, resonant metallic ringing sound
items.ex_en: Heavy iron tools clang against metal shelves whenever the warehouse elevator jolts upward.
items.ex_zh: 每当仓库升降机剧烈上晃时，沉重的铁制工具就会当啷撞向金属架。
items.ex2_en: The excited child clanged the iron pots together loudly in the kitchen.
items.ex2_zh: 兴奋的孩子在厨房里把铁锅砰砰作响地狠狠撞在一起。

items.def_en: To ring out loudly and sonorously, especially a set of church bells
items.ex_en: Cathedral bells peal joyfully across the sunlit piazza to announce the royal wedding.
items.ex_zh: 大教堂的钟声在阳光普照的广场上洪亮回响，宣告皇家婚礼的举行。
items.ex2_en: The enthusiastic townspeople pealed the brass bells to celebrate the victory feast.
items.ex2_zh: 热情的高原镇民鸣响了黄铜钟，以庆祝这场胜利的盛宴。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on striking a metal or acoustic instrument/object to yield a deep, sustained, resonant sound, typically functioning as an auditory announcement or solemn signal.
groups.summary_zh: 指敲击锣、钟等金属或发声物件使其发出浑厚鸣响，多用于鸣钟报时或信号传递。
groups.desc_en: Denotes causing a metallic or suspended percussion instrument to produce deep, reverberating acoustic soundwaves, contrasting with sharp non-resonant clicks or dull thuds.
groups.desc_zh: 指敲击悬吊的钟、磬、锣等金属器皿使其激发出深沉、悠长且有共鸣的余波音浪，区别于短促清脆的嗒嗒声或发闷的撞击声。
groups.nuance_en: toll: strike a heavy church bell slowly and solemnly, especially for funerals (death knell / bell / hours) · chime: produce a melodious, bright, ringing harmonized tune (clock / bells / melody) · peal: ring out loudly, joyfully, and continuously in festive bursts (bells / laughter / thunder) · clang: emit a harsh, loud, unyielding metallic ringing collision (cymbals / gates / metal pipes) · gong: strike a flat bronze disk producing an ominous spreading roar (signal / hour / gong)
groups.nuance_zh: toll: 缓慢、庄重且单调地鸣丧钟或报时 (death knell / bell / hours) · chime: 报时钟发出悦耳、清脆的和弦钟声 (clock / bells / melody) · peal: 欢庆时节钟声齐鸣或笑声轰鸣 (bells / laughter / thunder) · clang: 尖锐刺耳的金属器碰撞或大门当啷关上 (cymbals / gates / metal pipes) · gong: 敲击铜锣激荡出低沉深广的回响 (signal / hour / gong)

groups.name: Strip & Divest · 剥夺头衔与褫夺公权 (Strip, Divest, Dispossess)
groups.tip: 从取消权利到剥个精光

items.def_en: (+ of) Dismiss someone from a duty, command, or post, often due to misconduct
items.ex_en: The high command decided to relieve the disgraced general of his frontline military command.
items.ex_zh: 最高统帅部决定免去这位名誉扫地将军的前线军事指挥权。

items.def_en: (+ of) Officially deprive someone of power, rights, or possessions
items.ex_en: A royal decree will divest corrupt aristocrats of their ancestral landholdings and judicial privileges.
items.ex_zh: 一项王室法令将剥夺腐败贵族的祖传领地和司法特权。

items.def_zh: 剥除；彻底抹去（表象、特权）
items.def_en: Systematically remove layers, advantages, or protections from someone or something
items.ex_en: Investigators carefully strip away layers of corporate secrecy to expose the underlying accounting fraud.
items.ex_zh: 调查人员抽丝剥茧层层剥除企业的保密外衣，揭露背后的财务欺诈。

items.def_zh: 剥夺，夺走；剥去，脱去（衣服）；拆卸
items.def_en: 1. To take away an honor, possession, or rank from someone. 2. To take off your clothes, or remove the surface covering of something.
items.ex_en: Disciplinary officials voted to strip the disgraced athlete of all his championship Olympic medals.
items.ex_zh: 纪律官员投票决定剥夺这位名誉扫地的运动员所获得的所有奥运会金牌。

items.def_en: (+ of) Deprive someone of the possession of land, property, or heritage
items.ex_en: Colonial policies sought to dispossess indigenous communities of their fertile ancestral farmlands permanently.
items.ex_zh: 殖民政策企图永久剥夺原住民世代耕作的肥沃祖传土地。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote forcefully, legally, or punitively stripping someone of ranks, titles, possessions, or official privileges, often as a severe public sanction.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过权威、法律或强力强行削夺当事人的职衔或财产。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the authoritative or coercive deprivation of rights, titles, property, or psychological defenses, differing from ordinary taking by its institutional finality, punitive nature, or complete laying bare.
groups.desc_zh: 指依职权或强制手段剥夺头衔、财产、特权或心理防线，与普通“取走/拿走”不同，强调制度性的剥夺、惩戒性或彻底剥离赤裸的状态。
groups.nuance_en: relieve: dismiss formally from duty or burden (command / duties / post) · divest: shed or strip legal holdings, powers, or assets (assets / shares / authority) · strip away: systematically peel away layers, pretenses, or protections (illusions / layers / defenses) · strip: forcibly and humiliatingly deprive of status, title, or clothing (titles / rank / assets) · dispossess: legally or physically evict from ancestral or landed property (landowners / peasants / heirs)
groups.nuance_zh: relieve: 正式免除职务、兵权或卸除负担 (command / duties / post) · divest: 依法或战略性剥离资产、股权或权力 (assets / shares / authority) · strip away: 系统性层层剥除伪装、表象或保护层 (illusions / layers / defenses) · strip: 强制性、羞辱性地褫夺头衔、军衔或剥光衣物 (titles / rank / assets) · dispossess: 依法或强力剥夺土地、家产或使之流离失所 (landowners / peasants / heirs)

groups.name: Stroke & Brush · 抚摩与轻擦 (Stroke, Pat, Brush)
groups.tip: 动作温柔缓慢地顺着单向抚摸

items.def_en: Touch or sweep lightly past someone or something in passing with a smooth movement
items.ex_en: Her delicate silk scarf seemed to brush against my shoulder as she walked past.
items.ex_zh: 她走过时，精致的丝巾似乎轻轻拂过了我的肩膀。

items.def_en: Touch someone or something gently several times with a flat hand as an expression of affection or reassurance
items.ex_en: Grandmother paused to pat the weeping child's shoulder with infinite warmth and gentle care.
items.ex_zh: 祖母停下脚步，带着无尽的温暖与轻柔的关爱轻拍哭泣孩子的肩膀。

items.def_en: Touch something lightly in passing without hitting or gripping it firmly
items.ex_en: The speeding bullet managed to graze his left arm without causing any broken bones.
items.ex_zh: 飞驰的子弹仅仅擦过了他的左臂，并未造成任何骨折。

items.def_en: 1. To move your hand, a brush, or another object gently and repeatedly over a surface, usually in one direction.
items.ex_en: She knelt beside the trembling kitten to stroke its soft fur until it calmed.
items.ex_zh: 她跪在瑟瑟发抖的小猫身旁，轻轻顺抚它柔软的毛发直到它平静下来。

items.def_en: Move your hand, a cloth, or an object back and forth firmly or gently over a surface
items.ex_en: The trainer told him to rub warming ointment deeply into his aching shoulder muscles.
items.ex_zh: 教练让他把温热软膏深深搓揉进酸痛的肩部肌肉中。

groups.summary_en: Covers moving one's hand, finger, or an implement gently and repetitively along a surface. It emphasizes smooth, soothing, or tactile directional contact rather than necessarily sexual touch.
groups.summary_zh: 强调手或工具顺着表面平稳、轻柔、有方向地滑动抚摩。
groups.desc_en: Involves gentle, light, or rhythmic contact across a surface, distinguished from heavy touching or scratching by its tenderness, cleansing intent, or slightness of frictional impact.
groups.desc_zh: 指在物体表面施加温和、轻柔或有节奏的轻触与摩擦，与用力触摸或抓挠不同，带有抚慰、轻拭或微弱接触的特征。
groups.nuance_en: brush: sweep lightly across to clean or flick (hair / crumbs / shoulder) · pat: tap gently with a flat hand to comfort or check (cheek / dog / pocket) · graze: scrape or touch fleetingly in passing (skin / surface / bullet) · stroke: move hand smoothly and repetitively to soothe or caress (hair / cat / chin) · rub: apply back-and-forth pressure and friction (eyes / hands / surface)
groups.nuance_zh: brush: 轻拂、拂拭以清洁或掸落 (hair / crumbs / shoulder) · pat: 用扁平手掌轻拍以示安慰或检查 (cheek / dog / pocket) · graze: 擦过、掠过并造成轻微表皮擦伤 (skin / surface / bullet) · stroke: 平顺且重复地抚摸以示温存或沉思 (hair / cat / chin) · rub: 用力往复揉搓或摩擦 (eyes / hands / surface)

groups.name: Strut & Stride · 阔步与昂首行进 (Strut, Stride, Stalk)
groups.tip: 大步流星与昂首阔步

items.def_en: (+ into/across) To walk purposefully with long, decisive, and confident steps
items.ex_en: The commanding officer chose to stride decisively into the hall to address his troops.
items.ex_zh: 指挥官迈着坚定的步伐阔步走入大厅，向他的部队训话。

items.def_zh: 昂首阔步，趾高气扬地走；支撑
items.def_en: (+ around/about) To walk proudly and stiffly with your chest out, trying to look important.
items.ex_en: Arrogant young officers often strut about the courtyard in their immaculate, newly tailored uniforms.
items.ex_zh: 傲慢的年轻军官常常身着一尘不染、新近量身定制的制服在庭院里昂首阔步。

items.def_zh: 蹦蹦跳跳地走；得意扬扬地大摇大摆
items.def_en: (+ around/about) To walk or move with bouncing, ostentatious, or exaggerated steps
items.ex_en: The victorious players prance around the open field while hoisting the glittering championship trophy.
items.ex_zh: 获胜的队员们高高举起闪闪发光的冠军奖杯，在开阔的球场上得意忘形地大摇大摆。

items.def_zh: 摇曳生姿地走；招摇而行
items.def_en: To walk in an airy, showy, or conspicuous manner, typically with exaggerated hip movements
items.ex_en: Supermodels sashay down the illuminated runway showing off the designer’s bold spring collection.
items.ex_zh: 超级名模们在灯火通明的T台上摇曳生姿地走秀，展示设计师大胆的春季系列。

items.def_zh: 大摇大摆；昂首晃肩地走
items.def_en: To walk in a defiant, arrogant, or boastfully confident way with swinging shoulders
items.ex_en: Confident young boxers swagger into the ring while their rowdy supporters chant loudly.
items.ex_zh: 自信满满的年轻拳手在大摇大摆地走进拳击台，嘈杂的支持者在一旁高声呼喊。

groups.summary_en: This frame specifies manners of walking characterized by visible arrogance, supreme confidence, self-importance, or imposing, purposeful strides designed to assert presence.
groups.summary_zh: 指昂首挺胸、大步迈进或得意洋洋展现威势与自负的步态。
groups.desc_en: Describes ostentatious, proud, or self-conscious styles of walking, contrasting with plain locomotion by projecting vanity, confidence, power, or playful theatricality through deliberate body posture.
groups.desc_zh: 指带有炫耀、自信或高度自我表现欲的行进步态，与普通步行不同，通过刻意的身体姿态投射出傲慢、权威或戏剧化的张扬。
groups.nuance_en: stride: walk with long, decisive, purposeful steps (across the room / onto the stage / down the corridor) · strut: walk stiffly and pompously with head erect to show off (around the yard / down the catwalk / plumage) · prance: move with springy, exaggerated, self-satisfied bounds (about / across the stage / horses) · sashay: walk with exaggerated, flamboyant hip sways (into the room / down the aisle / onto the red carpet) · swagger: walk with an aggressive, insolent, chest-out roll (into the bar / down the street / gait)
groups.nuance_zh: stride: 迈着坚定自信的大步跨步前行 (across the room / onto the stage / down the corridor) · strut: 昂首挺胸、趾高气扬地大摇大摆 (around the yard / down the catwalk / plumage) · prance: 轻快欢脱、神气活现地蹦跳行进 (about / across the stage / horses) · sashay: 招摇扭捏、风骚摇曳地走动 (into the room / down the aisle / onto the red carpet) · swagger: 狂妄跋扈、大摇大摆地横行 (into the bar / down the street / gait)

groups.name: Sublime & Elevate · 升华与提炼 (Sublime, Transmute, Elevate)
groups.tip: 去除粗劣杂质，提升内在本质

items.def_zh: （使）升华，提升（思想、情感或品质）；（使）（物质）升华
items.def_en: 1. (formal) To elevate, purify, or refine feelings, thoughts, or desires into something noble or high-minded. 2. (chemistry) To change directly from a solid into vapor without melting, or cause to do so.
items.ex_en: Philosophers believe true artistic expression can sublime human suffering into profound moral wisdom.
items.ex_zh: 哲学家们相信，真正的艺术表达能够将人类的苦难升华为深刻的道德智慧。
items.ex2_en: Their vulgar desires sublimed gradually through years of devoted spiritual monastic practice.
items.ex2_zh: 经过多年专注的修道院修行，他们的粗俗欲望逐渐升华为崇高境界。

items.def_en: To give someone or something a noble quality or dignity
items.ex_en: Sacrifices made during difficult trials serve to ennoble the spirit of an entire nation.
items.ex_zh: 在艰难考验中所作出的牺牲，足以使整个民族的精神境界变得崇高。

items.def_en: To purify or free from material considerations by infusing with spiritual character
items.ex_en: Ascetic traditions often seek to spiritualize daily physical routines through persistent prayer and fasting.
items.ex_zh: 苦行传统往往试图通过坚持不懈的祈祷和斋戒，使日常的凡俗事务升华为精神追求。

items.def_zh: 蜕变；使质变为更高级形态
items.def_en: To change or be changed completely into something different and usually higher or better
items.ex_en: Alchemists mistakenly believed they could transmute crude, everyday base metals into pure gold.
items.ex_zh: 炼金术士曾错误地认为他们能将粗陋的日常贱金属蜕变为纯金。
items.ex2_en: Ordinary emotional grief transmuted slowly into quiet inner peace over many seasons.
items.ex2_zh: 普通的内心情感悲伤在历经多个季节后慢慢化作了平静的内心祥和。

items.def_en: To direct strong emotional or sexual desires into more socially acceptable or productive activities
items.ex_en: Many creative geniuses learn to sublimate their inner emotional turmoil into timeless literary masterpieces.
items.ex_zh: 许多具有创造力的天才学会将内心的情感波澜升华为永恒的文学杰作。
items.ex2_en: Repressed aggressive impulses sublimated peacefully into athletic dedication on the running track.
items.ex2_zh: 被压抑的攻击性冲动和平地转化为了在跑道上对体育的专注奉献。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to purifying, elevating, or transforming raw feelings, base instincts, or physical substances into higher, morally refined, or noble states. The focus is on qualitative spiritual, artistic, or chemical transmutation.
groups.summary_zh: 指将粗陋情感、本能或原始物质升华、提炼为高尚优美状态。
groups.desc_en: Expresses the qualitative transformation of the base, raw, or instinctual into something spiritually, morally, or aesthetically superior, contrasting with simple improvement by implying an ontological leap.
groups.desc_zh: 指将粗鄙、本能或低阶的事物提纯、转化为崇高、高尚或精神层面的形态，与一般“改良”不同，包含质变与精神跃升之义。
groups.nuance_en: sublime: transmute directly into purer, elevated aesthetic or spiritual states (emotions / love / character) · ennoble: confer moral dignity, nobility, or honor (minds / suffering / sacrifice) · spiritualize: purge of material/carnal qualities to impart religious meaning (desires / rituals / existence) · transmute: fundamentally alter nature, substance, or form into higher value (lead into gold / grief into art / energy) · sublimate: channel primitive or illicit impulses into culturally constructive pursuits (desires / aggression / instincts)
groups.nuance_zh: sublime: 使审美、情感或品格升华为纯粹至美之境 (emotions / love / character) · ennoble: 赋予道德尊严、崇高感或使精神高尚 (minds / suffering / sacrifice) · spiritualize: 净化物质与肉欲属性，使之精神化或神圣化 (desires / rituals / existence) · transmute: 将粗糙低贱之物点化重构为高阶价值 (lead into gold / grief into art / energy) · sublimate: （心理学）将原始冲动转化为具有社会创造性的追求 (desires / aggression / instincts)

groups.name: Submerge & Inundate · 漫灌与没顶 (Inundate, Submerge, Swamp)
groups.tip: 被大量液体彻底没过

items.def_en: To dip or plunge completely into a liquid so that it is thoroughly covered.
items.ex_en: Chemists must immerse the treated glass plates completely in cold chemical solvent for rinsing.
items.ex_zh: 化学家必须将处理过的玻璃板完全浸入冷化学溶剂中进行漂洗。

items.def_en: To drench or soak thoroughly by pouring liquid over or plunging directly into liquid.
items.ex_en: Firefighters had to douse the smoldering wooden beams with gallons of pressurized water.
items.ex_zh: 消防队员不得不向闷烧的木梁上泼浇数加仑的高压水。

items.def_en: To overwhelm or fill something, especially a boat, with water so that it flounders or sinks.
items.ex_en: Sudden crashing waves threatened to swamp the fragile wooden rowboat near the jagged rocks.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的巨浪眼看就要灌满礁石附近那只脆弱的木制划艇。

items.def_en: To cause something to go underwater or beneath the surface of a liquid completely.
items.ex_en: Submarines submerge quietly below choppy coastal waves to evade detection by naval surveillance radar.
items.ex_zh: 潜艇悄然潜入波涛汹涌的沿海水面之下，以躲避海军监视雷达的探测。
items.ex2_en: The researcher carefully submerged the sensitive electronic probe into the chilled water.
items.ex2_zh: 研究人员小心翼翼地将灵敏的电子探头浸入冰凉的水中。

items.def_zh: 淹没，浸水；使应接不暇，使充满
items.def_en: 1. To cover an area of land with a large flood of water. 2. (+ with) (usually passive) To overwhelm someone with a huge number of things to deal with.
items.ex_en: Heavy monsoon storms threaten to inundate low-lying coastal villages with contaminated river runoff.
items.ex_zh: 猛烈的季风风暴眼看就要用受污染的河水淹没沿海低洼村庄。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the physical immersion or swamping of objects or land beneath water, or metaphorically burying someone under an unmanageable load of demands, tasks, or information.
groups.summary_zh: 强调水位升高将物体没顶浸入水中，或引申为负担过于沉重以致无法招架。
groups.desc_en: Emphasizes the engulfment or overwhelming of a body or system under an uncontrollable volume of fluid or metaphorical demands, differing from mere wetting by complete immersion and impending loss of control.
groups.desc_zh: 强调大量液体或负荷压倒性地漫过、吞没某物，与普通浸湿不同，突出没顶之势与失控被淹的压迫感。
groups.nuance_en: immerse: plunge deep beneath fluid or intensely absorb in thought (in water / in thought / in culture) · douse: wet thoroughly by suddenly pouring water over, or extinguish quickly (with water / flames / lights) · swamp: overwhelm and threaten to sink with water or sheer volume (the boat / with calls / with work) · submerge: place completely beneath liquid surface, hiding from view (islands / feelings / beneath the waves) · inundate: flood widespread areas or bury beneath an uncontrollable deluge (farmland / with requests / with complaints)
groups.nuance_zh: immerse: 浸入液体中，或使全身心沉浸于思绪与文化中 (in water / in thought / in culture) · douse: 泼水浇透，或迅即扑灭火焰与熄灭灯火 (with water / flames / lights) · swamp: 巨浪灌入使船将沉，或海量事物令人疲于奔命 (the boat / with calls / with work) · submerge: 完全没顶潜入水下，隐匿于视线之外 (islands / feelings / beneath the waves) · inundate: 滔滔洪水泛滥淹没，或汹涌的要求如潮水压来 (farmland / with requests / with complaints)

groups.name: Submerge & Plunge · 下潜与潜水 (Submerge, Dip, Duck)
groups.tip: 头朝下纵身扎入或向下扑

items.def_en: To briefly immerse oneself or an object into liquid and quickly emerge
items.ex_en: She paused to dip her overheated bare feet into the cool mountain stream water.
items.ex_zh: 她停下脚步，将发热的双足浸入清凉的山涧溪水中片刻。
items.ex2_en: The red sun dipped quickly below the horizon before twilight settled in.
items.ex2_zh: 在暮色降临之前，那轮红日迅速沉落到了地平线以下。

items.def_en: To plunge downward or submerge the head and body rapidly beneath water
items.ex_en: Swimmers duck under the heavy crashing surf to avoid getting battered against the rocks.
items.ex_zh: 游泳者迅速钻入汹涌拍击的碎浪之下，以免被卷向礁石撞伤。

items.def_zh: 跳水；头朝下扑；俯冲，急降
items.def_en: To jump headfirst into water; to plunge or move steeply downward through air or space.
items.ex_en: Seabirds frequently dive steep angles into the cold northern ocean to catch swimming mackerel.
items.ex_zh: 海鸟频繁以陡峭的角度头朝下俯冲潜入寒冷的北方大洋中捕食游动的鲭鱼。

items.def_en: To go below the surface of water or cover completely with liquid
items.ex_en: Diver trainees learn how to submerge gradually without disturbing delicate fragile coral formations.
items.ex_zh: 潜水学员学习如何在不扰动脆弱珊瑚结构的前提下缓缓潜入水中。
items.ex2_en: Divers carefully submerged the heavy metal anchor near the shallow coral reef.
items.ex2_zh: 潜水员们小心翼翼地把沉重的铁锚沉入了浅珊瑚礁附近的水中。

items.def_en: To sweep down through the air with a sudden, sweeping motion
items.ex_en: Hungry hawks swoop down from coastal cliffs with breathtaking precision to catch unsuspecting rodents.
items.ex_zh: 饥饿的山鹰自沿海悬崖以惊人的精准度俯冲而下，捕食毫无防备的啮齿动物。

groups.summary_en: Addresses moving deliberately beneath the surface of a liquid or swooping steeply through an enveloping medium. Nuances differentiate between formal submersion, brief dips, and tactical descents.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重主体主动钻入水下、没入液体或向下俯冲潜行。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to rapid, deliberate, or kinetic descent downward into liquid or through the air, contrasting with passive sinking through its dynamic speed, agency, and targeted trajectory.
groups.desc_zh: 指主动、迅速或具动能地向水下或空中俯冲潜入，与被动沉没不同，具有速度感、自主性与明确的下潜轨迹。
groups.nuance_en: dip: lower briefly into liquid and swiftly withdraw (fingers / ladle / flag) · duck under: bend or bob quickly downward below a surface or barrier (water / wire / punch) · dive: plunge headfirst or steeply down into water or through air (into the pool / headlong / aircraft) · submerge: dive deep underwater as a vessel or swimmer (submarine / beneath the surface / creature) · swoop: sweep down through the air with sudden, predatory agility (on prey / from above / down)
groups.nuance_zh: dip: 迅速浸一下随即提出，微蘸 (fingers / ladle / flag) · duck under: 迅捷低头屈身避入水下或障碍物下方 (water / wire / punch) · dive: 头朝下纵身跳水或战机向下俯冲 (into the pool / headlong / aircraft) · submerge: 潜艇或水生动物平稳下潜至水面之下 (submarine / beneath the surface / creature) · swoop: 猛禽或飞行器自高空凌空俯冲疾掠 (on prey / from above / down)

groups.name: Substantiate & Corroborate · 证实与充实佐证 (Substantiate, Corroborate, Back up, Bear out)
groups.tip: 提出实据佐证论点，证实推断真实可信

items.def_en: To support an assertion, argument, or individual with convincing facts or data
items.ex_en: Extensive empirical research helps back up the scientist's controversial new hypothesis about genetic mutation.
items.ex_zh: 广泛的实证研究有助于证实这位科学家关于基因突变的有争议的新假说。

items.def_en: To prove that a claim, prediction, or hypothesis was correct all along
items.ex_en: The final audit results bore out all our initial suspicions about financial mismanagement.
items.ex_zh: 最终的审计结果证实了我们最初对财务管理不善的所有怀疑。

items.def_en: To provide fresh, independent evidence or details that confirm a theory, story, or finding
items.ex_en: The newly discovered surveillance footage helped corroborate the witness's original account of the robbery.
items.ex_zh: 新发现的监控录像有助于证实目击者对这起抢劫案的最初陈述。

items.def_en: To demonstrate that a contested statement, decision, or person was right and justified after skepticism
items.ex_en: Subsequent laboratory tests fully vindicated her controversial hypothesis regarding the origin of the disease.
items.ex_zh: 随后的实验室检测充分证实了她关于该疾病起源的有争议假设是正确的。

items.def_en: (formal) To provide facts or evidence to prove that an accusation, statement, or claim is true.
items.ex_en: The prosecutor failed to provide sufficient documentary evidence to substantiate the fraud allegations.
items.ex_zh: 检察官未能提供充分的书面证据来证实针对欺诈的指控。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses bringing forward solid empirical evidence, records, or independent testimony to verify claims, allegations, or theories that would otherwise remain unproven.
groups.summary_zh: 提供确凿的事实、物证或外部记录，支撑并坐实某项主张或说法。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on providing auxiliary evidence, testimony, or factual consistency to solidify an assertion, contrasting with primary proof by reinforcing what is already postulated.
groups.desc_zh: 指提供辅助证据、外部证言或事实自洽性以坐实已有论断，与第一手原创论证不同，侧重于为现有推断提供加固与支撑。
groups.nuance_en: back up: support a claim or person with facts or reinforcement (claims / arguments / files) · bear out: demonstrate the truth of a hypothesis or prediction through subsequent events (predictions / theory / evidence) · corroborate: lend independent, formal evidentiary weight to a statement (testimony / account / story) · vindicate: clear from blame or prove right against skepticism (honor / decision / innocent) · substantiate: furnish concrete, tangible material evidence for an allegation (allegations / claims / charges)
groups.nuance_zh: back up: 用论据、背景事实或备份为论断提供后盾 (claims / arguments / files) · bear out: 随后发生的事实或实验结果证实了此前的预测 (predictions / theory / evidence) · corroborate: 提供独立的旁证或证词以佐证口供与陈述 (testimony / account / story) · vindicate: 洗雪冤屈，或证明此前遭受质疑的决策是正确的 (honor / decision / innocent) · substantiate: 拿出确凿、实质性的证据坐实指控与主张 (allegations / claims / charges)

groups.name: Succeed & Triumph · 成功与达成 (Prevail, Prosper, Triumph)
groups.tip: 顺利达成既定目标取得胜果

items.def_zh: 成功，达到目的；继任，接替
items.def_en: 1. To achieve the desired aim or result. 2. To take over an official position, title, or role after someone else.
items.ex_en: She worked tirelessly for years and finally succeeded in launching her own design firm.
items.ex_zh: 她不知疲倦地工作了数年，终于成功创办了自己的设计公司。

items.def_en: (informal) To turn out well or develop successfully according to expectations
items.ex_en: We had high hopes for the venture, but things just did not pan out.
items.ex_zh: 我们对这项风投寄予厚望，但事情的发展并未如愿。

items.def_en: (+ over) To achieve a decisive victory or great success against odds
items.ex_en: The underdog team managed to triumph over their formidable rivals in the final match.
items.ex_zh: 这支处于劣势的队伍在决赛中成功战胜了强大的对手，大获全胜。

items.def_en: (+ against / over) To prove more powerful or effective and win out after struggle
items.ex_en: They firmly believed that justice and truth would eventually prevail against systemic oppression.
items.ex_zh: 他们坚信正义与真理最终将战胜体制性的压迫。

items.def_en: To become financially successful, healthy, or strong over a sustained period
items.ex_en: The coastal trade network continued to prosper despite mounting international economic sanctions.
items.ex_zh: 尽管面临日益严峻的国际经济制裁，该沿海贸易网络依然持续繁荣。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses achieving deliberate goals, flourishing over time, or emerging victorious against adversity and resistance.
groups.summary_zh: 表示达成既定目标、走向繁荣或最终胜出的动词群。
groups.desc_en: Captures the ultimate attainment of a favorable outcome after struggle, competition, or uncertainty, contrasting with plain achievement by emphasizing prevailing over obstacles or flourishing through fortune.
groups.desc_zh: 指在经历斗争、竞争或不确定性后最终取得胜利或顺遂，与普通“达成目标”不同，强调战胜阻力、大获全胜或长久繁荣。
groups.nuance_en: succeed: accomplish a planned goal or favorable outcome (in life / in business / plan) · pan out: yield a workable or successful final result over time (plans / strategy / investments) · triumph: win a glorious, decisive victory over fierce opposition (over adversity / in battle / spirit) · prevail: endure and gain ultimate mastery through superior strength or time (against odds / justice / truth) · prosper: thrive, flourish, and grow financially or physically (businesses / families / economies)
groups.nuance_zh: succeed: 实现预定目标，功成名就 (in life / in business / plan) · pan out: 经过实践检验结果证明奏效、有成效 (plans / strategy / investments) · triumph: 战胜顽敌或逆境取得辉煌耀眼的胜利 (over adversity / in battle / spirit) · prevail: 历经考验最终压倒对抗力量而占得上风 (against odds / justice / truth) · prosper: 欣欣向荣、蓬勃繁衍并取得经济上的亨通 (businesses / families / economies)

groups.name: Sudden Sharp Pulls · 猛抽与骤拉 (Jerk, Yank, Snap)
groups.tip: 施加拉力拽动位移

items.def_en: To pull or jerk something with a quick, slight suddenness
items.ex_en: The angler felt a sudden twitch on the fishing line and pulled sharply backward.
items.ex_zh: 钓客感到钓线突然轻轻一抽，随即猛地向后拉起。
items.ex2_en: His tired left eyelid twitched uncontrollably throughout the stressful job interview session.
items.ex2_zh: 在紧张的求职面试过程中，他疲倦的左眼皮不由自主地抽搐着。

items.def_en: To move or pull into a position with a quick, sharp cracking sound or motion
items.ex_en: He snapped the elastic strap back into place with a swift and practiced motion.
items.ex_zh: 他动作利落地啪的一下将松紧带拉回原位。

items.def_zh: 猛拉，急拽；猛然一动，抽动
items.def_en: 1. To pull, move, or twist suddenly and sharply. 2. To make a quick, sudden movement.
items.ex_en: She jerked the heavy steering wheel to the left to avoid the oncoming debris.
items.ex_zh: 她猛然向左急打沉重的方向盘，以避开扑面而来的碎片。
items.ex2_en: The old carriage jerked suddenly whenever the horses started pulling it forward.
items.ex2_zh: 每当马匹开始向前拉拽时，这辆旧马车就会猛地颠簸颠动一下。

items.def_en: To pull someone or something with a sudden, forceful, and sharp movement
items.ex_en: The toddler suddenly yanked the tablecloth, sending plates crashing down onto the floor.
items.ex_zh: 那个幼儿猛地一拽桌布，盘子稀里哗啦全摔在了地上。

items.def_en: To pull, strain, or twist someone or something violently away from a fixed position
items.ex_en: The thief desperately tried to wrench the purse from the elderly woman's tight grip.
items.ex_zh: 小偷拼命试图从老妇人紧紧抓着的手中猛扭硬夺过皮包。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote abrupt, violent, and highly sudden pulling or twitching motions delivered with sharp force rather than sustained traction.
groups.summary_zh: 指动作极其突兀、迅猛且干脆的猛扯、猝抽或反冲性拉动。
groups.desc_en: Involves sudden, violent, high-acceleration pulling forces exerted on an object or limb, differing from steady traction by its abrupt impulse, disruptive jolt, and risk of tearing or breaking.
groups.desc_zh: 指对物体或肢体施加短促、剧烈、高加速度的拽拉，与平稳拉动不同，具有突发冲击性、猛烈震颤并常伴有撕扯或折断风险。
groups.nuance_en: twitch: make a tiny, involuntary spasmodic jerk (curtain / muscles / tail) · snap: break cleanly or move sharply with a sharp cracking noise (twigs / rope / fingers) · jerk: pull or move with a sudden, sharp, spasmodic motion (hand away / wheel / rope) · yank: pull forcefully, aggressively, and abruptly with a heave (levers / door / hair) · wrench: twist and pull violently, causing dislocation or damage (joints / control / door handle)
groups.nuance_zh: twitch: 微小、不自觉的肌肉抽搐或细微抽动 (curtain / muscles / tail) · snap: 伴随清脆响声骤然折断或猛然绷回 (twigs / rope / fingers) · jerk: 猝不及防、急促痉挛式地猛抽或猛扳 (hand away / wheel / rope) · yank: 粗暴、用力地猛拽猛扯 (levers / door / hair) · wrench: 强力扭扯、拧拔导致关节脱臼或部件损坏 (joints / control / door handle)

groups.name: Sue & Litigate · 民事起诉与索赔诉讼 (Sue, Litigate, File Suit)
groups.tip: 向法庭呈请诉讼追究刑民责任

items.def_zh: 控告，提起诉讼；请求，恳求
items.def_en: 1. (+ for) To make a formal legal claim against someone in a court of law. 2. (+ for) (formal) To make a humble, earnest request for something, such as peace.
items.ex_en: The injured pedestrian decided to sue the reckless driver for substantial financial compensation.
items.ex_zh: 受伤的行人决定起诉那名莽撞的司机，要求巨额经济赔偿。

items.def_en: (+ against) To formally begin a legal action or lawsuit against someone in court
items.ex_en: Several local landowners plan to file suit against the corporation over groundwater contamination.
items.ex_zh: 几位当地土地所有者打算就地下水污染问题对该企业提起民事诉讼。

items.def_en: To start legal proceedings against someone to resolve a disagreement or obtain financial compensation
items.ex_en: If they breach the signed contract again, we will definitely take them to court.
items.ex_zh: 如果他们再次违反已签署的合同，我们一定会将他们告上法庭。

items.def_en: To bring a lawsuit against someone who has already filed a lawsuit against you
items.ex_en: After being sued for copyright infringement, the software company chose to aggressively countersue.
items.ex_zh: 在因侵犯版权而被起诉后，这家软件公司选择展开激烈的反诉。

items.def_en: To take a claim or dispute to a court of law, or to resolve a dispute through the court system
items.ex_en: Both corporate parties preferred to settle the commercial dispute rather than litigate for years.
items.ex_zh: 涉案双方企业都宁愿私下调解商业纠纷，而不愿耗费数年对簿公堂。

groups.summary_en: Pertains to private individuals or corporate entities initiating civil legal proceedings to claim damages or enforce rights. 'Sue' is standard and direct, while 'litigate' describes carrying out legal disputes in court more broadly.
groups.summary_zh: 指民事主体为索赔或维权依法向法院提起诉讼并进行民事抗辩。
groups.desc_en: Encapsulates formal legal action initiated by an aggrieved party seeking civil remedy or monetary relief, contrasting with criminal prosecution by its private, adversarial, and compensation-seeking nature.
groups.desc_zh: 指民事主体在法庭上为争取民事救济或经济赔偿提起的诉讼抗辩，与刑事公诉不同，属于私权性质的对抗与维权纠纷。
groups.nuance_en: sue: initiate a formal civil claim against an entity for damages (for damages / for libel / company) · file suit: officially lodge a legal petition in court to begin action (against employer / in federal court / papers) · take to court: escalate a personal or civil grievance into judicial litigation (disputes / landlord / partner) · countersue: file a retaliatory lawsuit against the original plaintiff (competitor / for breach / defendant) · litigate: engage extensively in complex, drawn-out judicial disputes (claims / disputes / in court)
groups.nuance_zh: sue: 为侵权或损害赔偿在民事法庭起诉 (for damages / for libel / company) · file suit: 正式向法庭递交立案诉状 (against employer / in federal court / papers) · take to court: 将私下纠纷对薄公堂 (disputes / landlord / partner) · countersue: （被告）对原告提起反诉以实施法律反击 (competitor / for breach / defendant) · litigate: 全面介入复杂的民事诉讼程序与法庭拉锯抗辩 (claims / disputes / in court)

groups.name: Suffocate & Gag · 哽呛与窒息 (Gag, Stifle, Suffocate)
groups.tip: 气道受阻无法换气窒息而亡

items.def_en: Struggle desperately to take in air with wide, convulsive mouth movements
items.ex_en: The rescued swimmer emerged from the water and desperately gasped for breath.
items.ex_zh: 获救的游泳者浮出水面，绝望而剧烈地倒抽着气。

items.def_en: Experience severe difficulty breathing or cause airway obstruction due to food, smoke, or constriction
items.ex_en: Thick acrid smoke filled the hallway, causing the escaping residents to choke uncontrollably.
items.ex_zh: 浓烈呛人的烟雾弥漫了走廊，令逃生的居民不由自主地剧烈呛咳窒息。
items.ex2_en: Thick poisonous fumes choked the workers trapped inside the deep mining tunnel.
items.ex2_zh: 浓烈有毒的烟气呛住了被困在深矿隧道内的工人们。

items.def_en: Choke or retch involuntarily because something blocks the throat or triggers the gag reflex
items.ex_en: The pungent smell of rotten fish made the young cleaner gag almost instantly.
items.ex_zh: 腐烂鱼类的刺鼻气味让那位年轻的清洁工几乎立刻干呕起来。

items.def_en: Prevent someone from breathing easily, or feel oppressed by extremely hot, stuffy air
items.ex_en: The humid and stagnant air inside the packed greenhouse seemed to stifle everyone.
items.ex_zh: 拥挤温室内潮湿停滞的空气似乎让每个人都感到憋闷得透不过气。

items.def_en: To die or cause someone to die because of not being able to breathe; to feel trapped or stifled.
items.ex_en: The firefighters warned that dense smoke inside the burning apartment could quickly suffocate victims.
items.ex_zh: 消防员警告说，着火公寓内的浓烟可能迅速使受困者窒息身亡。
items.ex2_en: Trapped underground miners suffocated quickly when fresh oxygen supplies failed completely overnight.
items.ex2_zh: 当新鲜氧气供应在一夜之间彻底断绝时，被困地下的矿工很快窒息了。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses internal coughing/spasm sensations from swallowed matter or oppressive atmospheric lack of fresh air, leaving the subject gasping, stifled, or unable to draw breath.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重由吸入异物呛噎，或因空气闷滞憋闷而感到窒息。
groups.desc_en: Describes the physiological or psychological restriction of airway and respiration, progressing from involuntary mechanical constriction in the throat to complete, lethal oxygen deprivation.
groups.desc_zh: 指气道通气受阻或呼吸道在物理、心理上被勒阻的过程，从喉部的痉挛阻噎逐渐升级至完全窒息甚至致命性缺氧。
groups.nuance_en: gasp for breath: struggle desperately to draw in air with an open mouth (air / breath / dying) · choke: experience internal obstruction of the windpipe (on food / with emotion / smoke) · gag: suffer an involuntary throat spasm or retching reflex (on odor / on spoon / with revulsion) · stifle: repress or smother respiratory flow or an emotional vocalization (yawns / laughter / dissent) · suffocate: undergo complete, potentially lethal deprivation of breathable oxygen (in smoke / with pillow / under rubble)
groups.nuance_zh: gasp for breath: 张大嘴巴绝望、短促地倒吸气或挣扎喘气 (air / breath / dying) · choke: 气管被异物哽住或因浓烟、情绪堵塞呼吸道 (on food / with emotion / smoke) · gag: 咽喉因恶心、异物刺激引起干呕或反胃痉挛 (on odor / on spoon / with revulsion) · stifle: 强行屏住呼吸，或扼杀压制哈欠、笑声与声音 (yawns / laughter / dissent) · suffocate: 彻底阻绝空气流通致人窒息或闷死 (in smoke / with pillow / under rubble)

groups.name: Sulk & Pout · 撅嘴与生闷气 (Pout, Sulk, Mope, Brood)
groups.tip: 面露愠色独坐一旁赌气噘嘴

items.def_en: To exhibit a morose or sullen facial attitude when crossed
items.ex_en: Forbidden from attending the ball, the young heiress began to snood in quiet discontent.
items.ex_zh: 被禁止参加舞会后，这位年轻的女继承人沉着脸拉长了面孔，暗自不悦。

items.raw_cluster: 生闷气与抱怨 Sulk & Pout
items.def_en: To push out your lips to show annoyance, sulkiness, or disappointment, or to look sexually attractive.
items.ex_en: The spoiled child began to pout when his mother refused to buy the toy.
items.ex_zh: 当母亲拒绝买下那个玩具时，被宠坏的孩子赌气噘起了嘴。

items.def_en: To wander about or sit listlessly, indulging in self-pity and gloom
items.ex_en: Instead of seeking a new job, he chose to mope around the apartment all day.
items.ex_zh: 他没有去找新工作，而是整天在公寓里无精打采、垂头丧气地闲晃。

items.def_en: (+ on/over) To dwell gloomily and persistently on unpleasant or resentful thoughts
items.ex_en: It is unhealthy to brood over past failures instead of planning for the future.
items.ex_zh: 老是沉溺于过去的失败郁结于心，而不是规划未来，是有害无益的。

items.def_en: To remain silent, bad-tempered, and uncommunicative out of annoyance or resentment
items.ex_en: Angry about the criticism, the teenager decided to sulk in his bedroom all evening.
items.ex_zh: 因受到批评而心生恼怒，那个少年整晚把自己关在卧室里生闷气。

groups.summary_en: Verbs focused on non-verbal, petulant displays of resentment, silence, or withdrawal, commonly expressing childish displeasure or brooding irritation.
groups.summary_zh: 聚焦以撅嘴、冷战沉默或郁郁寡欢宣泄不满与委屈的情态动作。
groups.desc_en: Captures the passive-aggressive externalization of grievance, disappointment, or hurt pride through petulant facial gestures, sullen silence, or prolonged psychological withdrawal, differing from active rage by its introverted, lingering nature.
groups.desc_zh: 指将不满、委屈或怨恨转化为不配合的沉默、扁嘴冷战或心理退缩，与外显愤怒不同，属于内向性、持久性的消极抵抗情绪。
groups.nuance_en: snood: withdraw aloofly or act petulantly cold (obsolete/dialectal pout) (feelings / pride) · pout: push out one's lips to display childish displeasure or pique (lips / face / child) · mope: wander aimlessly or sit listlessly in dejected self-pity (around the house / all day / in room) · brood: dwell deeply, dark and obsessively on perceived grievances (over failures / in silence / thoughts) · sulk: maintain a sullen, obstinate silence to punish others (in corner / for days / teenager)
groups.nuance_zh: snood: 显出孤僻、赌气冷漠的神态（方言/罕用） (feelings / pride) · pout: 撅起嘴唇显出孩子气的娇嗔或任性不满 (lips / face / child) · mope: 无精打采、垂头丧气地闲晃或陷入自我怜悯 (around the house / all day / in room) · brood: 阴郁且挥之不去地反复反刍深仇与失败 (over failures / in silence / thoughts) · sulk: 绷着脸生闷气、采取冷战以惩罚对方 (in corner / for days / teenager)

groups.name: Summarize & Encapsulate · 概括与浓缩 (Capsule, Digest, Synthesize)
groups.tip: 提炼要旨浓缩精髓，高度概括核心内容

items.def_en: Express the most important facts or points about something in a short statement
items.ex_en: The director concluded the meeting by attempting to sum up the main discussion points.
items.ex_zh: 主管在会议结束时试图概括总结主要的讨论要点。

items.def_en: State again the primary points that have just been discussed
items.ex_en: Before we begin today's brainstorming session, let's briefly recap yesterday's key decisions.
items.ex_zh: 在我们开始今天的头脑风暴之前，先简要回顾一下昨天的关键决议。

items.def_zh: 概括，浓缩；封装，装入胶囊
items.def_en: 1. To express or summarize the essential features of something concisely. 2. To enclose something in or as if in a capsule.
items.ex_en: His short concluding remarks seemed to encapsulate the primary themes of the entire conference.
items.ex_zh: 他简短的总结性发言似乎高度概括了整个会议的核心主旨。

items.def_en: Serve as a perfect, concise example or summary of a quality or feature
items.ex_en: Her selfless dedication to the charity work seemed to epitomize the spirit of compassion.
items.ex_zh: 她对慈善事业的无私奉献，集中体现了悲悯奉献的精神内涵。

items.def_en: Extract the essential meaning or most vital elements from complex information
items.ex_en: The analyst managed to distill vast reams of market data into three core insights.
items.ex_zh: 分析师成功地从海量的市场数据中提炼出三条核心洞见。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express condensing complex concepts, narratives, or datasets into their core essence or an overarching representation. 'Encapsulate' focuses on crystal-clear packaging of essentials, while 'sum up' and 'crystallize' capture synthesis and definitive closure.
groups.summary_zh: 指提炼并高度浓缩事物核心本质与主要特征。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to abstracting the indispensable essence or core meaning of a broader text or argument, contrasting with full reporting by condensing massive input into an elegant, highly concentrated representation.
groups.desc_zh: 指提炼并凝练庞大文本或论述的精髓与核心命题，与原原本本的复述不同，强调高度浓缩与精髓萃取。
groups.nuance_en: sum up: review and conclude with the primary takeaways (arguments / findings / situation) · recap: succinctly restate previous key developments or talking points (events / points / match) · encapsulate: pack a large, multifaceted idea completely into a compact formula (spirit / ethos / philosophy) · epitomize: serve as the quintessential, perfect embodiment of a type (era / elegance / style) · distill: extract the pure, essential insights from voluminous data or experience (essence / wisdom / argument)
groups.nuance_zh: sum up: 在结尾处统括提要并作出结论 (arguments / findings / situation) · recap: 简要重申已阐述的事项、赛况或进展 (events / points / match) · encapsulate: 将庞大复杂的气象或理念凝缩于一语 (spirit / ethos / philosophy) · epitomize: 作为最纯粹、最具代表性的缩影或化身 (era / elegance / style) · distill: 过滤芜杂，从浩繁经验中提炼出纯正的智慧或核心论点 (essence / wisdom / argument)

groups.name: Summarize & Outline · 概述与提纲 (Delineate, Sketch, Draft)
groups.tip: 概括大意勾勒轮廓

items.def_en: 1. To describe the main facts, ideas, or structure of something briefly. 2. To draw or show the outer edge of something.
items.ex_en: The CEO used her opening speech to outline the strategic goals for the coming year.
items.ex_zh: 首席执行官在开幕致辞中简要概述了下一年度的战略目标。

items.def_en: Give a brief, broad account or description without detailed exposition
items.ex_en: The preliminary report merely managed to sketch the broad contours of the proposed policy.
items.ex_zh: 这份初步报告仅粗略勾勒了拟议政策的大致轮廓。

items.def_en: Plan or indicate the overall shape or main features roughly before refining details
items.ex_en: During the first meeting, the architects began to block out the basic building layout.
items.ex_zh: 在第一次会议上，建筑师们开始草拟出大楼的基本空间布局框架。

items.def_en: Add substantial details or substance to an outline or skeleton plan
items.ex_en: The author needs to flesh out the main characters before submitting the novel manuscript.
items.ex_zh: 作者在提交小说手稿之前，需要进一步充实主要人物的细节刻画。

items.def_en: Describe, outline, or present the boundary lines or specific stages of something
items.ex_en: The agreement clearly delineated the precise boundaries between the two neighboring municipal territories.
items.ex_zh: 该协议清晰地划分勾勒了两个相邻市政辖区之间的具体边界。

groups.summary_en: This frame describes laying out the structural skeleton, boundaries, or broad strokes of a plan, idea, or document without exhausting every minor detail. 'Outline' emphasizes framework, whereas 'sketch' highlights quick, provisional presentation.
groups.summary_zh: 指勾勒结构骨架、罗列大纲要点或作粗略说明。
groups.desc_en: Relates to demarcating structural limits, defining parameters, and laying down the broad skeletal framework of an idea or project before detailed execution, differing from fine rendering by staying at the structural schematic level.
groups.desc_zh: 指在实施细节前勾画事物的主体轮廓、界限与骨架，与细部刻画不同，停留在宏观纲要与框架界定层面。
groups.nuance_en: outline: give a systematic, high-level overview of main sections (proposals / plan / speech) · sketch: draw or describe the rough, impressionistic contours quickly (ideas / scene / character) · block out: plan the coarse spatial boundaries or rough time allocations (time / scenes / composition) · flesh out: add substantive details and evidence to a bare skeleton (ideas / proposal / character) · delineate: mark out boundaries or trace precise margins with clarity (boundaries / duties / arguments)
groups.nuance_zh: outline: 给出系统化的大纲要点与逻辑框架 (proposals / plan / speech) · sketch: 快速勾勒出粗浅的轮廓或初步构思 (ideas / scene / character) · block out: 粗略划分空间布局、时间段或段落板块 (time / scenes / composition) · flesh out: 为单薄的骨架充实血肉与详实细节 (ideas / proposal / character) · delineate: 清晰界定权限边界、地理分界或严密论述脉络 (boundaries / duties / arguments)

groups.name: Summon & Convene · 召集与召开 (Convoke, Convene, Assemble)
groups.tip: 传讯或正式通知大家集合

items.def_en: To order or ask members of a group to assemble in one location
items.ex_en: The manager decided to call together the entire department to announce the major restructuring.
items.ex_zh: 经理决定召集整个部门的员工，以宣布重大的重组调整。

items.def_en: To come together in a single place, or to bring people or components together into one body
items.ex_en: Thousands of enthusiastic supporters began to assemble outside the parliament building before dawn.
items.ex_zh: 天亮之前，成千上万的热情支持者已开始在议会大厦外聚集。
items.ex2_en: The technicians will assemble the complex engine components according to standard instructions.
items.ex2_zh: 技术人员将根据标准说明书来组装复杂的发动机零部件。

items.def_en: To arrange for people to come together for a formal meeting, or to assemble as a group
items.ex_en: The committee chairperson decided to convene an emergency meeting to address the financial crisis.
items.ex_zh: 委员会主席决定召开紧急会议以应对此次财政危机。
items.ex2_en: The governing board convenes promptly at nine every Monday in the boardroom.
items.ex2_zh: 管理委员会每周一上午九点准时在董事会会议室集合开会。

items.def_en: To bring people together, especially troops, for battle, inspection, or duty
items.ex_en: The commander ordered the officers to muster the troops for an immediate tactical inspection.
items.ex_zh: 指挥官命令军官们集合召集部队，立即进行战术检阅。
items.ex2_en: Volunteers mustered in the central square early before starting the rescue operation.
items.ex2_zh: 志愿者们清晨在中央广场集结，随后展开了救援行动。

items.def_zh: 召集（会议）；召集（人员）开会
items.def_en: (formal) To call people together for a formal meeting or assembly, or to arrange such a meeting.
items.ex_en: The monarch possessed the sole constitutional authority to convoke a special session of parliament.
items.ex_zh: 君主拥有召集议会特别会议的独家宪法权力。

groups.summary_en: Formal verbs governing the authoritative gathering of councils, parliaments, committees, or delegates for official proceedings.
groups.summary_zh: 指行使法定职权或官方名义集合会议、聚集代表讨论议事。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the mobilization and bringing together of individuals or institutional bodies through authoritative instruction for a collective purpose, contrasting with voluntary gathering through its formal mandate.
groups.desc_zh: 指凭借权威号召或公信力指令，召集特定群体或机构开会协作，与自发聚集不同，带有制度化的指令性与使命感。
groups.nuance_en: call together: invite or instruct a group informally or formally to meet (staff / elders / meeting) · assemble: collect disparate persons or parts into one structured location (crowd / parts / team) · convene: formally initiate an official meeting of delegates or committees (committee / parliament / session) · muster: round up dispersed resources, courage, or troops for an urgent effort (troops / courage / strength) · convoke: exercise official sovereign or ecclesiastical authority to summon an assembly (council / synod / assembly)
groups.nuance_zh: call together: 召集众人开会商讨 (staff / elders / meeting) · assemble: 将分散的人员或部件汇聚并组装至一处 (crowd / parts / team) · convene: 正式召集代表召开立法、委员会等法定会议 (committee / parliament / session) · muster: 紧急调集兵马、筹措资源或鼓起勇气 (troops / courage / strength) · convoke: 行使主权或宗座权威召集宗教大公会议或议会 (council / synod / assembly)

groups.name: Summon & Subpoena · 传唤与司法传讯 (Subpoena, Summon, Cite)
groups.tip: 法庭传票正式传讯出庭作证

items.def_en: To order someone to appear before a court of law, often for a minor offense
items.ex_en: The magistrate decided to cite the careless motorist for repeated reckless driving violations.
items.ex_zh: 治安法官决定因多次鲁莽驾驶违章而传讯该粗心司机到庭。

items.def_zh: 签发传票责令调取文件
items.def_en: To order a person under penalty of law to bring specified physical evidence to court
items.ex_en: The grand jury issued a subpoena duces tecum demanding all encrypted corporate financial records.
items.ex_zh: 大陪审团签发了传票，责令提交所有加密的公司财务记录原件。

items.def_en: To officially order someone to appear or give evidence
items.ex_en: The defense attorney decided to call up a surprise expert witness to give testimony.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师决定传唤一位出人意料的专家证人出庭作证。

items.def_en: To officially order someone to appear in a court of law
items.ex_en: The supreme court issued an official decree to summon the high-ranking official immediately.
items.ex_zh: 最高法院发布正式法令，要求立即传唤该高级官员出庭受审。

items.def_en: (law) To officially order someone to appear in court or produce evidence using a subpoena.
items.ex_en: The congressional committee voted unanimously to subpoena the former chief executive for questioning.
items.ex_zh: 国会委员会全票通过决议，正式传讯前首席执行官接受质询。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this legal frame involve formally and authoritatively commanding a witness, defendant, or document holder to appear before a court or investigative body under penalty of law.
groups.summary_zh: 指司法或监管机构依法正式传唤当事人或调取证物。
groups.desc_en: Involves legally compulsory writs or judicial directives commanding an individual to appear before a court or supply evidence under penalty of contempt, contrasting with casual invitations by state-enforced punitive power.
groups.desc_zh: 指司法或立法机关出具具有法律约束力的令状，强制个人出庭作证或提交文书，与普通传召不同，带有受藐视法庭罪制裁的强制威慑。
groups.nuance_en: cite: quote legal precedents or issue a formal violation notice to appear (statutes / driver / for contempt) · subpoena duces tecum: order production of tangible documents and tangible evidence under penalty (documents / records / files) · call up: summon someone for military draft or onto a prominent stage (reserves / player / memories) · summon: issue an authoritative or official demand to appear (witness / courage / meeting) · subpoena: compel a witness to testify in a judicial or legislative hearing (witnesses / testimony / bank records)
groups.nuance_zh: cite: 援引判例，或开具法庭传票与违章传唤通知 (statutes / driver / for contempt) · subpoena duces tecum: （带卷传票）强制指令在法庭提交账册文件与实物证据 (documents / records / files) · call up: 征召预备役入伍，或将候补选手召入正选 (reserves / player / memories) · summon: 权威性地传唤到场，或竭力凝聚精气神 (witness / courage / meeting) · subpoena: 发出传票强制证人出庭或提供材料接受质证 (witnesses / testimony / bank records)

groups.name: Supersede & Oust · 取代、废替与罢黜 (Supersede, Supplant, Oust)
groups.tip: 后来居上直接接替旧事物

items.def_en: To take over the place or position of someone or something that previously dominated
items.ex_en: High-speed rail links threaten to displace domestic air travel on several major regional routes.
items.ex_zh: 高铁网络的发展很可能会在几条主要的区域航线上取代国内民航的地位。

items.def_en: To take precedence over or set aside an existing decision, rule, or mechanism
items.ex_en: The federal statute contains clear provisions that override conflicting local municipal regulations.
items.ex_zh: 该项联邦法规载有明确条款，优先于并推翻与之冲突的地方市政规章。

items.def_en: To force someone out of a position of authority, power, or place
items.ex_en: Dissident shareholders launched a successful proxy contest to oust the company's entrenched chairman.
items.ex_zh: 持异议的股东们发起了一场成功的代理权之争，罢黜了该公司根深蒂固的董事长。

items.def_zh: 取代；篡替（常带策略或竞争性）
items.def_en: To take the place of someone or something, often through superiority, force, or scheming
items.ex_en: Online streaming platforms quickly began to supplant traditional cable television across the country.
items.ex_zh: 在线流媒体平台迅速开始在全国范围内排挤并取代传统有线电视。

items.def_en: (variant of supersede) To take the place of a person or thing that is old, obsolete, or no longer useful.
items.ex_en: Modern digital telecommunication systems eventually superceded the obsolete analog networks entirely.
items.ex_zh: 现代数字通信系统最终彻底取代了那些被淘汰的陈旧模拟网络。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate taking over the position, role, or primacy of an incumbent person, institution, or outdated standard, usually rendering the predecessor obsolete or dislodged.
groups.summary_zh: 指后来居上取代原有的人事、制度或旧标准，使其被废弃、挤走或淘汰。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to replacing, overriding, or invalidating an established authority, rule, or occupant through official invalidation or forceful removal, contrasting with gradual substitution by decisive rupture or higher sanction.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过权威废止、法理优先或权力夺取，废除或罢黜原有的规则、职权或在位者，强调断裂式的替换与效力覆写。
groups.nuance_en: displace: unseat, dislodge, or move someone from their home or rightful spot (residents / water / workers) · override: use superior authority to nullify an existing decision or limit (veto / concerns / system) · oust: forcefully eject or depose an official or rival from power (leader / dictator / rivals) · supplant: take the place of another, often through intrigue or perceived superiority (rivals / systems / models) · supersede: render an earlier law, contract, or version obsolete by introducing an updated replacement (regulations / edition / technology)
groups.nuance_zh: displace: 使之移位、迫使居民背井离乡或被迫腾挪 (residents / water / workers) · override: 凭借更高层级的特权强行否决既定决定 (veto / concerns / system) · oust: 强力驱逐、赶下台或罢免政敌与掌权者 (leader / dictator / rivals) · supplant: 凭借权谋、优越性将旧物或对手取而代之 (rivals / systems / models) · supersede: 颁布新规使旧版规章、条例或版本作废失效 (regulations / edition / technology)

groups.name: Supersede & Oust · 迭代与取代 (Supplant, Displace, Oust)
groups.tip: 更新换代更替，旧物被新物取代

items.def_en: To force something out or prevent it from flourishing by taking over available space or resources
items.ex_en: Massive government borrowing risks to crowd out private investment across the sluggish domestic market.
items.ex_zh: 庞大的政府借贷有可能在疲软的国内市场上挤出排挤私人投资。

items.def_en: To take the position or role of someone or something, forcing them out of their place
items.ex_en: Automated warehouse robotics threaten to displace thousands of manual distribution workers nationwide.
items.ex_zh: 自动化的仓储机器人很可能会在全国范围内取代数以千计的手工分销工人。

items.def_en: To take the place of someone or something, often by becoming superior or more effective
items.ex_en: Renewable solar energy sources are steadily poised to supplant polluting fossil fuels globally.
items.ex_zh: 可再生太阳能资源正稳步准备在全球范围内替代并淘汰具有污染性的化石燃料。

items.def_en: To force someone out of a position, job, or territory, especially through competition or authority
items.ex_en: The ruling political party orchestrated a quiet internal coup to oust the prime minister.
items.ex_zh: 执政党精心策划了一场隐秘的内部政变，将首相逐出权力中心。

items.def_en: (formal) To take the place of a person or thing that is old, obsolete, or no longer useful.
items.ex_en: The updated safety protocol will formally supersede all previous instructional guidelines next month.
items.ex_zh: 这份更新后的安全规范将于下个月正式废止并替代以往所有的指导方针。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe displacing or rendering previous entities, practices, or technologies obsolete through succession or competitive superiority. Nuances range from gradual technological obsolescence to forceful expulsion.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过技术革新、版本演进或强制排挤，使旧事物或在位者被淘汰。
groups.desc_en: Governs competitive evolutionary replacement, where newer, more efficient, or dominant technologies, entities, or methods push out incumbent incumbents, contrasting with sudden deposition by incremental systemic phasing-out.
groups.desc_zh: 指在技术演进、生态位或市场竞争中，先进/优势事物对传统事物进行渐进式、系统性的优胜劣汰与迭代覆盖。
groups.nuance_en: crowd out: squeeze out or diminish space/funding for competitors by sheer presence (investment / competitors / voices) · displace: push existing traditional workers or methods out of practical use (labor / traditions / technologies) · supplant: progressively replace older standards through superior market or evolutionary utility (older models / practices / methods) · oust: expel incumbents through hostile takeover or direct competition (management / incumbent / incumbents) · supersede: make former technological paradigms obsolete by rendering them backward (antiquated tech / previous versions / methods)
groups.nuance_zh: crowd out: （挤出效应）以绝对体量或优势资源挤压挤走对手空间 (investment / competitors / voices) · displace: 凭借自动化或新技术挤占淘汰原有劳动力或旧习惯 (labor / traditions / technologies) · supplant: 凭借优越的效能全面取代陈旧模式与工艺 (older models / practices / methods) · oust: 在竞争或敌意收购中彻底逼退现任竞争者 (management / incumbent / incumbents) · supersede: 随着技术换代自然使旧标准与旧架构被历史淘汰 (antiquated tech / previous versions / methods)

groups.name: Support & Champion · 倡导与全力捍卫 (Champion, Espouse, Crusade)
groups.tip: 从日常支持上升为带头捍卫

items.def_en: To publicly recommend, urge, or argue in favor of a specific policy, cause, or course of action
items.ex_en: Prominent civil rights attorneys continue to advocate comprehensive reform of the judicial system.
items.ex_zh: 著名民权律师持续公开主张并倡导对司法体制进行全面改革。

items.def_en: To actively defend or vigorously support a person, belief, or right against criticism or attack
items.ex_en: It is essential to stand up for your beliefs even when others disagree.
items.ex_zh: 即使别人不同意，也要勇于捍卫自己的信念。

items.def_en: To choose to support, adopt, or promote a particular set of ideas, principles, or beliefs publicly
items.ex_en: Several prominent legislators chose to openly espouse the controversial new environmental conservation doctrine.
items.ex_zh: 几位杰出的立法委员选择公开拥护并支持这一颇具争议的新环保学说。

items.def_en: 1. To vigorously support, defend, or fight for a person, principle, or cause.
items.ex_en: Throughout her long political career, she continued to champion equal rights for women.
items.ex_zh: 在她漫长的政治生涯中，她始终坚定捍卫并支持妇女享有平等权利。

items.def_zh: 为……发起长期的声讨或斗争
items.def_en: (+ for / against) To engage in a vigorous, impassioned concerted effort for or against a public issue
items.ex_en: The grassroots community coalition decided to crusade relentlessly against unfair housing discrimination practices.
items.ex_zh: 该基层社区联盟决定发起长期斗争，坚决抵制不公平的住房歧视行径。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on taking an active, visible, and combative role in defending or promoting a cause, movement, or vulnerable group. While 'champion' implies publicly fighting for and safeguarding rights or beliefs, related verbs convey committed advocacy or aggressive campaigning.
groups.summary_zh: 强调以战斗姿态或高度使命感积极倡导、捍卫某项事业或原则。
groups.desc_en: Denotes active, principled advocacy where the agent puts personal or moral weight behind a cause, distinct from passive agreement.
groups.desc_zh: 表示主体出于原则或道义全力投入倡导与捍卫，不同于被动的顺应或单纯赞同。
groups.nuance_en: advocate: articulate formal recommendation or policy stance (reform / policy / rights) · stand up for: exert personal courage against opposition or bullying (rights / underdog / colleague) · espouse: formally adopt or embrace a philosophy or belief (doctrine / cause / view) · champion: aggressively defend or lead the fight for another's interests (cause / reform / underdog) · crusade: wage an impassioned, sustained moral campaign (reform / justice / cause)
groups.nuance_zh: advocate: 提出正式主张或政策倡导 (reform / policy / rights) · stand up for: 挺身而出捍卫弱小或原则 (rights / underdog / colleague) · espouse: 采纳并信奉思想或学说 (doctrine / cause / view) · champion: 作为领头人全力捍卫与争取 (cause / reform / underdog) · crusade: 发起旷日持久的道德圣战式斗争 (reform / justice / cause)

groups.name: Support & Endorse · 官方背书与公开赞同 (Endorse, Back, Sanction)
groups.tip: 赞同主张或背书支持

items.def_en: To support a plan, person, or organization with money, influence, or vocal agreement
items.ex_en: Several wealthy venture capital firms decided to back the promising medical technology startup.
items.ex_zh: 几家财力雄厚的风险投资公司决定在资金上大力支持这家极具前景的医疗科技初创企业。

items.def_en: To formally support a proposal, motion, or nomination in a meeting before debate or voting
items.ex_en: Councilor Evans raised his hand to second the formal motion for budget reallocation.
items.ex_zh: 埃文斯议员举手正式附议关于重新分配预算资金的提案。

items.def_en: To express confidence in someone's reliability, character, or the truth of a statement
items.ex_en: My former employer wrote a detailed reference letter to vouch for my integrity.
items.ex_zh: 我的前雇主写了一封详尽的推荐信，为我为人正直的品格做担保。

items.def_en: To formally authorize, permit, or approve of an action or course of events
items.ex_en: The regulatory board refused to sanction the proposed merger without stringent oversight.
items.ex_zh: 监管委员会拒绝在没有严格监管的情况下批准这项拟议的合并。

items.def_zh: 支持，赞同；（公开）代言（产品）；背书（支票等）
items.def_en: 1. To publicly declare approval or support of someone or something. 2. To appear in advertisements to recommend a product. 3. To sign the back of a cheque.
items.ex_en: The influential senator chose to endorse the reform bill during yesterday's press conference.
items.ex_zh: 这位有影响力的参议员在昨天的记者会上公开表态支持该改革法案。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote granting public, official, or reputational backing to a person, candidate, product, or plan. Whereas 'endorse' signifies an explicit formal approval or celebrity sponsorship, synonyms like 'back' and 'vouch for' span from political financing to personal character warranties.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过名誉、权威或正式声明公开赞许并担保某人或某方案。
groups.desc_en: Denotes formal, public, or authoritative ratifications that confer legitimacy or viability, beyond internal private approval.
groups.desc_zh: 强调通过官方、权威或公开手段赋予合法性或支持，区别于私下的认可。
groups.nuance_en: back: provide tangible political or financial support (candidate / proposal / plan) · second: formally endorse a motion in parliamentary procedure (motion / proposal / nomination) · vouch for: pledge personal credibility for someone's character or reliability (integrity / safety / character) · sanction: grant authoritative or legal permission (project / intervention / strike) · endorse: publicly express formal approval or commercial backing (candidate / policy / product)
groups.nuance_zh: back: 提供实质性的政治或资金支持 (candidate / proposal / plan) · second: 在会议程序中附议提案 (motion / proposal / nomination) · vouch for: 以个人信誉担保人品或真实性 (integrity / safety / character) · sanction: 官方或法律层面的权威批准 (project / intervention / strike) · endorse: 公开宣布支持或代言认可 (candidate / policy / product)

groups.name: Support & Fasten · 支架引缚与网格支撑 (Trellis, Lattice, Espalier)
groups.tip: 搭设棚架支撑植物攀爬

items.def_en: To fasten plants, stems, or vines to stakes or canes using cord or garden twine for vertical support
items.ex_en: Most of his capital is tied up in long-term real estate investments.
items.ex_zh: 他的大部分资金都被长期房地产投资套住了。

items.def_en: To tie or steady a growing plant to a wooden or metal post driven into the ground
items.ex_en: Gardeners must carefully stake each young tomato seedling against the incoming autumn winds.
items.ex_zh: 园丁们必须用木桩小心地支撑每株番茄幼苗，以抵御即将来袭的秋风。

items.def_zh: 装以格子架构；使呈网格状支撑
items.def_en: To furnish an opening or surface with crisscross framework, or to train foliage across a latticed screen
items.ex_en: Fragrant jasmine vines gracefully lattice the ancient stone terrace beneath the moonlight.
items.ex_zh: 芬芳的茉莉藤蔓在月光下优雅地交织覆盖着古老的石阶露台。

items.def_zh: 为……搭设棚架，把（植物）固定在棚架上
items.def_en: 1. To support, train, or grow climbing plants on a trellis or lattice framework.
items.ex_en: We should trellis the grapevines along the southern wall to maximize sun exposure.
items.ex_zh: 我们应该沿着南墙搭架引导葡萄藤生长，以获得最大的日照。

items.def_zh: 使（树木）在攀缘架或墙面上修剪平展生长
items.def_en: To train a fruit tree or climbing shrub to grow flat against a wall, wire, or trellis pattern
items.ex_en: Generations of gardeners painstakingly espaliered heritage pear trees against the brick wall.
items.ex_zh: 数代园丁煞费苦心地将传统梨树修剪平整，使其紧贴砖墙生长。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote training, supporting, or fastening growing plants along ornamental wooden, metal, or wire frameworks. 'Trellis' centers on guiding vines onto a lattice framework, whereas synonyms specify architectural training against flat walls or wire configurations.
groups.summary_zh: 指将藤蔓或枝条攀扎、引缚在特定棚架或网状构件上以助其生长。
