groups.nuance_zh: whiff: [体]猛力挥击落空、挥棒落空 (strike three / fastball / pitch) · swing and miss: 出招落空、错失目标 (fastball / opportunity) · slash: 大幅度挥劈砍削 (undergrowth / budget / tires) · flail: 毫无章法地胡乱挥舞甩动 (limbs / arms / helpless) · swish: 挥动时发出嗖嗖破空声 (cane / tail / skirts)

groups.name: Swoon & Collapse · 瘫软、虚脱与昏厥 (Collapse, Flake Out, Wilt)
groups.tip: 眼前发黑、失去意识软倒在地

items.def_en: To fall asleep or drop to the ground from extreme exhaustion
items.ex_en: After hiking twenty rugged miles, she completely flaked out on the living room rug.
items.ex_zh: 徒步走完二十英里崎岖山路后，她累得直接倒在客厅地毯上呼呼大睡。

items.def_en: To become limp, weak, or exhausted, especially in oppressive heat or stress
items.ex_en: The marathon runners began to wilt noticeably under the blazing midday desert sun.
items.ex_zh: 在沙漠正午烈日的暴晒下，马拉松跑者们明显开始变得无精打采、浑身无力。
items.ex2_en: Intense midday greenhouse heat wilted the delicate cut carnations within a few hours.
items.ex2_zh: 温室正午的酷热在短短几小时内就使娇嫩的剪枝康乃馨蔫了。

items.def_zh: （沉重或无力地）软瘫坐下/倒下
items.def_en: To sit or fall down heavily and suddenly because of weakness, weariness, or shock
items.ex_en: Overcome by sheer exhaustion, he slumped heavily into the worn leather armchair.
items.ex_zh: 由于极度疲惫，他沉重无力地瘫倒在那张破旧的皮扶手椅里。

items.def_zh: 昏厥，昏倒；神魂颠倒，痴迷
items.def_en: 1. (literary) To faint, especially from extreme emotion or physical weakness. 2. (+ over) To feel extreme pleasure or romantic admiration.
items.ex_en: Upon hearing the tragic news, the grief-stricken widow swooned into her sister's arms.
items.ex_zh: 一听到这悲惨的消息，悲痛欲绝的寡妇便昏厥在姐姐的怀中。

items.def_en: To fall down suddenly because of loss of strength, illness, or injury
items.ex_en: Weak from dehydration and fatigue, the hiker collapsed suddenly beside the mountain trail.
items.ex_zh: 因脱水和疲惫而极度虚弱，徒步旅行者突然瘫倒在山间小路旁。
items.ex2_en: The demolition crew collapsed the abandoned cooling tower with carefully placed explosives.
items.ex2_zh: 爆破拆除人员用精心放置的炸药使废弃的冷却塔轰然倒塌。

groups.summary_en: This frame emphasizes physical breakdown, extreme exhaustion, or dramatic emotional prostration where the body gives way. It ranges from dramatic literary fainting to utter physical exhaustion and crumbling to the ground.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重因极度疲劳、情绪冲击或虚弱导致身体瘫软、彻底垮掉或倒地晕厥。
groups.desc_en: Delineates the sudden loss of muscular tone, postural integrity, or consciousness triggered by shock, heat, exhaustion, or emotional surge, contrasting with voluntary resting or sitting.
groups.desc_zh: 描绘因休克、酷热、极度衰竭或强烈情绪冲击导致的肌张力骤失与身体瘫倒，与自主躺卧休息相比，具有不由自主的虚脱性。
groups.nuance_en: swoon: faint or drift into ecstatic or faint-hearted unconsciousness (heat / romance / delight) · collapse: abruptly fall down helplessly due to structural failure or total physical exhaustion (exhaustion / runner / building) · slump: drop heavily and listlessly into a bent or sunken posture (chair / shoulders / frame) · wilt: droop languidly from dehydration, exhaustion, or lack of confidence (heat / collar / enthusiasm) · flake out: suddenly succumb to fatigue or fail to show up due to exhaustion (exhaustion / sofa)
groups.nuance_zh: swoon: 晕厥，或因狂喜迷醉而神魂颠倒 (heat / romance / delight) · collapse: 因力竭或病体不支骤然崩溃倒地 (exhaustion / runner / building) · slump: 浑身发软颓然瘫坐 (chair / shoulders / frame) · wilt: 如植物缺水般萎靡低垂、精神不振 (heat / collar / enthusiasm) · flake out: [口]累极倒头昏睡或撂挑子 (exhaustion / sofa)

groups.name: Tail Closely & Shadow · 紧随与尾随 (Shadow, Tail, Dog)
groups.tip: 紧跟其后甚至紧逼追踪

items.def_en: to follow someone everywhere they go quietly and closely without their noticing
items.ex_en: An undercover detective shadowed the primary suspect through the bustling evening marketplace.
items.ex_zh: 一名便衣侦探在热闹的夜市中悄无声息地紧密尾随主要嫌疑人。

items.def_en: to follow close behind someone, especially secretly in order to keep them under surveillance
items.ex_en: The private investigator continued to tail the suspicious sedan along the winding coast.
items.ex_zh: 私家侦探继续沿着蜿蜒的海岸盯梢尾随那辆可疑的轿车。

items.def_zh: 紧跟（前车）行驶，咬尾行驶；紧逼尾随
items.def_en: 1. to drive dangerously close behind another vehicle. 2. to follow closely behind someone.
items.ex_en: Aggressive drivers who tailgate on icy highways dramatically increase the risk of serious accidents.
items.ex_zh: 在结冰的高速公路上紧跟前车行驶的激进司机极大地增加了发生严重事故的风险。

items.def_zh: 紧贴前车车尾开；贴后保险杠行驶
items.def_en: to drive dangerously close behind another vehicle's rear bumper
items.ex_en: That impatient delivery van has been riding my bumper for the past five miles.
items.ex_zh: 那辆没耐心的送货面包车在过去五英里里一直紧贴着我的车尾开。

items.def_en: to follow closely at the heels of someone persistently and relentlessly
items.ex_en: Tenacious paparazzi dogged the weary celebrity all the way back to her private hotel.
items.ex_zh: 顽固的狗仔队一路紧追不舍，纠缠着疲惫的名人直到她的私人酒店。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify intentional, close-range pursuit or following, either to monitor someone covertly or press dangerously close behind.
groups.summary_zh: 指紧跟其后、步步紧逼地尾随、追踪或暗中监视。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on adhering relentlessly behind a moving target either covertly for surveillance or aggressively to pressure them, contrasting with benign companionate 'following'.
groups.desc_zh: 指紧跟在移动目标之后，或为秘密盯梢，或为施加逼近压迫，与平和的“同行、尾随”相比，带有人身监控或攻击性施压意图。
groups.nuance_en: tail: persistently follow a target to track movements (suspect / vehicle / mark) · shadow: secretly and seamlessly track every step of a target (agent / suspect / mentor) · dog: persistently pursue, hound, or trouble someone without relenting (steps / heels / footsteps) · tailgate: drive dangerously and aggressively close behind another vehicle (driver / truck / car) · ride someone's bumper: aggressively hug the rear bumper of the vehicle ahead (slow driver / highway)
groups.nuance_zh: tail: 便衣盯梢、死死跟踪 (suspect / vehicle / mark) · shadow: 如影随形地暗中跟踪或见习 (agent / suspect / mentor) · dog: 像恶犬般紧紧纠缠、如影随形 (steps / heels / footsteps) · tailgate: 恶意跟车过近、压车 (driver / truck / car) · ride someone's bumper: [口]紧咬前车车屁股催逼 (slow driver / highway)

groups.name: Tailoring Alterations & Mending · 裁缝翻修与改样 (Bushel, Re-tailor, Remodel)
groups.tip: 修补破损残缺恢复旧貌

items.def_en: To tailor or adjust the structure of a garment again to change its fit or silhouette
items.ex_en: The master tailor agreed to re-tailor the vintage suit to achieve a modern fit.
items.ex_zh: 裁缝大师同意重新翻裁这套复古西装，以达到更具现代感的修身剪裁。

items.def_en: To rip apart and restitch the structural seams of a garment
items.ex_en: The elderly dressmaker carefully reseamed the delicate silk gown along its vintage contours.
items.ex_zh: 老裁缝顺着复古线条，细心地重新缝合了那件精致丝绸礼服的接缝。

items.def_en: To replace or repair the inner fabric lining of a coat or suit
items.ex_en: He paid an experienced tailor to reline his favorite wool overcoat with smooth satin.
items.ex_zh: 他付钱给一位经验丰富的裁缝，用光滑的缎面为自己心爱的羊毛大衣重装了里衬。

items.def_en: To change the design, cut, or structure of a garment to modernize or adapt it
items.ex_en: She asked the designer to remodel her grandmother's outdated wedding gown for her ceremony.
items.ex_zh: 她请设计师改造祖母那件过时的婚纱款式，以便在自己的婚礼上穿。

items.def_en: (US) To mend, alter, or repair garments or tailored clothes.
items.ex_en: The local garment shop will bushel your oversized trousers before the wedding ceremony.
items.ex_zh: 当地的服装店会在婚礼仪式前为你修整那条过大的长裤。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this specialized frame describe structural alterations, reshaping, and bespoke repairs made to finished garments or tailored clothing.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及高级西装、成衣的翻裁、修改结构及匠艺重塑。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to specialized garment alteration and structural remodeling to customize fit or restore silhouette, differing from crude general repairing (like darning) by maintaining haute sartorial architecture.
groups.desc_zh: 指针对成衣进行的专业化结构改制与尺寸微调，以优化版型合体度，与粗糙的“缝补”不同，专指合身性与制版结构的再造。
groups.nuance_en: re-tailor: reshape and refit a garment's overarching proportions completely (suit / jacket / coat) · reseam: open and restitch the structural seams to adjust size (trousers / bodice / dress) · reline: strip and replace the internal fabric lining of a garment (overcoat / jacket) · remodel: redesign the aesthetic silhouette or style of an old garment (fur coat / vintage dress) · bushel: perform minor tailored alterations and repairs on finished garments (suits / alterations / menswear)
groups.nuance_zh: re-tailor: 全面重改西服版型 (suit / jacket / coat) · reseam: 拆开衣缝重订以收放尺寸 (trousers / bodice / dress) · reline: 给大衣翻新更换内胆里衬 (overcoat / jacket) · remodel: 将旧衣结构拆改翻新款式 (fur coat / vintage dress) · bushel: [行话]对男装或成衣进行精细改样修边 (suits / alterations / menswear)

groups.name: Take a Holiday · 度假与休憩 (Holiday, Break away, Get away)
groups.tip: 放下工作度假休养身心

items.def_en: To spend the summer season in a particular place
items.ex_en: The affluent aristocratic family typically summers at their sprawling seaside estate in Maine.
items.ex_zh: 这个富裕的贵族家庭通常在缅因州占地广阔的海滨庄园度过夏季。

items.def_en: (chiefly British) To spend a vacation or holiday somewhere.
items.ex_en: Many British families choose to holiday along the sunlit beaches of southern Spain.
items.ex_zh: 许多英国本土家庭选择在西班牙南部阳光明媚的海滩度假。

items.def_zh: 外出度假；逃离日常琐事
items.def_en: To leave home or work for a period of relaxation or vacation
items.ex_en: We desperately need to get away to the quiet countryside this coming weekend.
items.ex_zh: 这个周末我们极度需要抽身外出度假，前往宁静的乡村放松一下。

items.def_en: To stay somewhere temporarily, especially during travels
items.ex_en: The wandering scholar chose to sojourn in the ancient alpine monastery for several weeks.
items.ex_zh: 这位游方学者选择在阿尔卑斯山的古老修道院中短暂旅居数周。

items.def_zh: 抽身休假；摆脱常规事务
items.def_en: To stop what you are doing in order to take a brief break or holiday
items.ex_en: She could barely break away from her exhausting corporate duties for a brief weekend.
items.ex_zh: 她几乎无法从疲惫的公司日常事务中脱身去度过一个短暂的周末。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe taking time off work or routine obligations to travel, rest, and recharge, predominantly in Commonwealth contexts. They emphasize escaping daily pressures for leisure.
groups.summary_zh: 指脱离日常工作或杂务外出度假、休养身心。
groups.desc_en: Marks taking temporary leave from workaday routines and obligations to seek rest, recreation, or seasonal relocation, distinguishing itself from indefinite migration by presupposing return.
groups.desc_zh: 指脱离日常劳役与责任，前往他处进行阶段性休养、度假或避暑避寒，与“永久迁徙”不同，预设了假毕归来的前提。
groups.nuance_en: holiday: take an official recreational vacation away from work (seaside / abroad / resort) · summer: pass the warm season residing in a specific retreat (Hamptons / cottage / coast) · get away: escape daily work pressures and familiar environments briefly (weekend / country) · sojourn: reside temporarily as an observant traveler in a foreign place (abroad / capital / village) · break away: disengage from pressing duties or groups to steal restorative time (routine / meetings / office)
groups.nuance_zh: holiday: [英]休假度蜜月或休闲 (seaside / abroad / resort) · summer: 在特定度假胜地避暑过夏 (Hamptons / cottage / coast) · get away: 抽身偷闲、外出透气避世 (weekend / country) · sojourn: 在异地进行有质感的短期旅居 (abroad / capital / village) · break away: 摆脱繁重日程以换取喘息之机 (routine / meetings / office)

groups.name: Take to & Warm to · 喜爱与亲近 (Warm to, Cotton to, Take to)
groups.tip: 产生好感并主动建立友善关系

items.def_zh: 喜欢上，亲近（与to连用）；领悟，发觉（与on连用）
items.def_en: 1. (cotton to) To begin to like someone or agree with something. 2. (cotton on) To begin to understand or realize something.
items.ex_en: The stubborn old farmer did not cotton to the proposed zoning changes at all.
items.ex_zh: 那位固执的老农夫对提议的分区规划修改一点也不喜欢。

items.def_en: To develop a rapid or spontaneous liking for someone or something
items.ex_en: The rescued puppy immediately took to its gentle new owner on the very first day.
items.ex_zh: 那只获救的小狗在第一天就立刻喜欢上了它温柔的新主人。

items.def_zh: 逐渐喜欢，对…态度转温和
items.def_en: To become friendlier toward or more enthusiastic about someone or an idea
items.ex_en: The skeptical board members gradually warmed to her bold renewable energy investment proposal.
items.ex_zh: 持怀疑态度的董事会成员逐渐对她大胆的可再生能源投资方案产生了兴趣与好感。

items.def_zh: 自然被吸引，倾向于靠近
items.def_en: To be naturally drawn or attracted toward a particular person or group
items.ex_en: Young creative minds naturally gravitate toward vibrant urban centers offering ample cultural opportunities.
items.ex_zh: 富有创造力的年轻人自然会被提供丰富文化机会的活力都市中心所吸引。

items.def_zh: 亲近并交朋友，友善对待
items.def_en: To act as a friend to someone, especially someone who is lonely or in need
items.ex_en: The generous college senior made an effort to befriend the homesick international student.
items.ex_zh: 那位慷慨的大学四年级学生特意去亲近并友善对待那个想家的国际学生。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on developing an instinctive liking, affinity, or acceptance toward a person or concept over time. Many expressions rely on idiomatic phrasal verbs indicating an initial ice-breaking transition from detachment to affection.
groups.summary_zh: 表达从陌生逐步转为接受、喜欢或对某人事物产生亲近感。
groups.desc_en: Denotes developing an instinctive liking, comfort, or social inclination toward a person, idea, or habit, differing from static 'like' by focusing on the transition from neutrality to affinity.
groups.desc_zh: 指对某人、观念或习惯产生由疏转亲、自发接纳的好感或亲近倾向，区别于静态的“喜欢”，侧重心理距离缩短的过程。
groups.nuance_en: take to: quickly adopt an affinity or habit (new hobby / stranger / routine) · warm to: gradually become enthusiastic or receptive (idea / proposal / guest) · cotton to: slowly begin to accept or feel friendly toward, often colloquial (suggestion / newcomer) · gravitate toward: move toward by natural, subconscious attraction (crowd / career / mentor) · befriend: intentionally act as a companion or ally (lonely classmate / newcomer)
groups.nuance_zh: take to: 迅速产生好感或养成习惯 (new hobby / stranger / routine) · warm to: 逐渐转为热络或接受 (idea / proposal / guest) · cotton to: 慢慢习惯或接纳（多口语或否定） (suggestion / newcomer) · gravitate toward: 受自然引力般趋向 (crowd / career / mentor) · befriend: 主动示好并建立友谊 (lonely classmate / newcomer)

groups.name: Tame & Cultivate · 驯养与归化 (Domesticate, Tame, Cultivate)
groups.tip: 驯养野生以适应环境

items.def_en: To calm, tame, or break in an unruly or skittish animal with kindness
items.ex_en: The soft-spoken wrangler gentled the trembling wild colt with patient, quiet murmurs.
items.ex_zh: 温和的牧马人轻柔低语，耐心地抚慰并调驯着那匹颤抖的野马驹。

items.def_en: To train a wild or young horse/animal to accept saddles and obey commands
items.ex_en: It takes several weeks of patient training to break in a young spirited stallion.
items.ex_zh: 需要数周耐心的训练才能调教好一匹充满活力、野性未驯的年轻种马。

items.def_en: To prepare land and grow plants or crops for human consumption and use
items.ex_en: Agronomists encourage local farmers to cultivate drought-resistant grain varieties on degraded soils.
items.ex_zh: 农学家鼓励当地农民在退化的土地上栽培抗旱谷物品种。

items.def_en: To make a wild animal gentle, obedient, and accustomed to human presence
items.ex_en: With consistent affection, she managed to tame the feral cat roaming near her porch.
items.ex_zh: 凭借始终如一的关爱，她成功驯服了在她门廊附近游荡的野猫。

items.def_zh: 驯化，驯养；使习惯于家庭生活
items.def_en: To tame an animal or cultivate a wild plant to live with or be used by humans; to make someone prefer domestic or home life.
items.ex_en: Early Neolithic communities learned to domesticate wild sheep for reliable wool and milk supplies.
items.ex_zh: 新石器时代早期的社群学会了驯化野羊，以获得稳定的羊毛和乳品供应。

groups.summary_en: This frame involves bringing wild animals, plants, or primal human traits into human custody, civil habituation, and agricultural utility.
groups.summary_zh: 指将野生动植物驯化、选育或使野性之人适应家庭与文明生活。
groups.desc_en: Involves modifying wild, resistant, or raw states through training or husbandry into compliant, productive forms, distinct from coercive 'subdue' by aiming for domestic utility.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过驯化、训练或培育使野性、生疏或未开化状态转为温顺、受控且具利用价值的形式，区别于单纯强制镇压，强调教化与功用化。
groups.nuance_en: tame: eliminate wildness or aggression through handling (wild beast / wilderness) · domesticate: systematically adapt a whole species to human habitats over generations (wild horses / plants) · break in: accustom to work through rigorous discipline (colt / new recruit) · cultivate: nurture and refine through deliberate care (crops / soil / talent) · gentle: soothe and calm a skittish animal with soft handling (spirited horse / hound)
groups.nuance_zh: tame: 除去野性或凶性 (wild beast / wilderness) · domesticate: 长期物种驯养或归化家庭 (wild horses / plants) · break in: 强力调教以适应劳作 (colt / new recruit) · cultivate: 耕作或悉心培植 (crops / soil / talent) · gentle: 用温和手法抚平野性惊悸 (spirited horse / hound)

groups.name: Taste & Sample · 品尝与抽样 (Nibble, Sip, Try)
groups.tip: 尝一口来抽取样本检验

items.def_en: To eat or drink a tiny portion of something unfamiliar to find out if one enjoys its taste
items.ex_en: I decided to try a bite of the exotic dragon fruit at the market.
items.ex_zh: 我决定在集市上尝一小口这种不常见的火龙果。

items.def_en: To taste a small amount of food or drink; to test or experience a small part of something.
items.ex_en: The sommelier invited each guest to sample three distinct vintages of local red wine.
items.ex_zh: 侍酒师邀请每位客人品尝三款截然不同年份的当地红葡萄酒。

items.def_en: To sample food or drink in an evaluative or comparative setting to judge relative quality
items.ex_en: The culinary judges will taste-test five artisanal olive oils to determine the grand winner.
items.ex_zh: 美食评审们将对五款手工橄榄油进行品尝测试，以决出最终优胜者。

items.def_en: To drink liquid in very small amounts, typically to evaluate temperature or flavor
items.ex_en: She paused to sip the scalding green tea before voicing her final corporate decision.
items.ex_zh: 在宣布她最后的公司决定之前，她停下来抿了一小口滚烫的绿茶。

items.def_en: To eat something by taking very small, tentative bites to test its flavor or texture
items.ex_en: He cautiously nibbled the spicy cheese cracker to test its pungent pepper level.
items.ex_zh: 他小心翼翼地轻咬了一小口辣味奶酪饼干，以试探其刺鼻的胡椒辣度。

groups.summary_en: This scenario pertains to testing a minute portion of food, beverage, or broader goods to gauge quality, suitability, or flavor prior to fuller consumption or procurement.
groups.summary_zh: 取用极少份量的食品或饮料以探查风味、成色或决定取舍。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to consuming an exploratory minimal portion of food or drink to test quality, flavor, or preference, differing from sustained 'eating' by its evaluative, fractional nature.
groups.desc_zh: 指为检验品质、风味或合意度而尝试性摄入极小份额的饮食，区别于持续进食，核心在探索与浅尝评价。
groups.nuance_en: sample: test a representative portion for evaluation (vintage / local cuisine) · try: experiment with something unfamiliar out of curiosity (dish / exotic fruit) · sip: drink in tiny exploratory draws (hot soup / cocktail) · nibble: bite off tiny repetitive morsels cautiously (cheese / pastry) · taste-test: formally assess and compare flavors against standards (new recipe / consumer product)
groups.nuance_zh: sample: 抽样尝鲜以作品质评估 (vintage / local cuisine) · try: 出于好奇尝试未吃过的东西 (dish / exotic fruit) · sip: 抿一口探试滋味 (hot soup / cocktail) · nibble: 小口谨慎啃咬细品 (cheese / pastry) · taste-test: 严谨盲测或对比评测 (new recipe / consumer product)

groups.name: Taste & Savor · 品尝与细品 (Savor, Discern, Smack)
groups.tip: 从浅尝味道到细细品味

items.def_en: To have a distinctive, often subtle or suggestive taste or trace flavor of something
items.ex_en: The aged fortified wine smacks of dried figs, burnt sugar, and mellow toasted oak.
items.ex_zh: 这款陈年加强葡萄酒带有一丝干无花果、焦糖与甘醇烤橡木的风味。

items.def_zh: 品尝，尝；尝出……的味道；有……味道
items.def_en: 1. To eat or drink a small amount of something to test its flavor. 2. To perceive the flavor of something. 3. To have a particular flavor.
items.ex_en: The pastry chef tasted the rich chocolate ganache to check for perfect cocoa balance.
items.ex_zh: 糕点主厨品尝了浓郁的巧克力甘纳许，以检查可可风味是否达到完美平衡。

items.def_en: To detect, identify, or distinguish delicate flavors or constituent ingredients with the palate
items.ex_en: Trained palates can easily discern subtle notes of lavender in this specialty floral tea.
items.ex_zh: 训练有素的味蕾很容易在这款特种花茶中辨察出淡淡的薰衣草香气。

items.def_en: To eat or drink something with lively, visible enjoyment and gustatory appreciation
items.ex_en: The hungry hikers relished every mouthful of the warm beef stew by the campfire.
items.ex_zh: 饥饿的徒步旅行者们围在营火旁，津津有味地品尝着热乎乎的炖牛肉。

items.def_en: To taste food or drink deliberately and slowly so as to appreciate its distinctive richness
items.ex_en: He closed his eyes to savor the intricate layers of flavor in the soup.
items.ex_zh: 他闭上双眼，细细品味汤中丰富而复杂的层层风味。

groups.summary_en: This scale ranges from neutral sensory registration of flavor on the palate to analytical discernment and full-bodied gustatory appreciation of subtle notes in dishes or drink.
groups.summary_zh: 从基础感知味道递进到细腻辨识与深度品尝食物的风味层次。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on the sensory discernment and prolonged mental or gustatory appreciation of subtle flavors or undertones, contrasting with rapid 'consuming' through reflective lingering.
groups.desc_zh: 指对微妙风味或言外余味的敏锐辨识与深度沉醉，区别于囫囵吞咽，强调感官停留与心智品鉴。
groups.nuance_en: taste: perceive basic flavor through gustatory organs (salt / sweetness) · savor: linger over and fully appreciate rich sensory or emotional flavor (moment / victory / wine) · relish: take keen, active pleasure in experiencing something (flavor / challenge / freedom) · discern: detect faint or hidden nuances perceptively (hint of oak / subtle difference) · smack of: suggest or carry an overt trace or undertone of (corruption / treason / garlic)
groups.nuance_zh: taste: 尝出最基本的味道 (salt / sweetness) · savor: 细细品味并回味余韵 (moment / victory / wine) · relish: 极具兴致地大肆享受 (flavor / challenge / freedom) · discern: 敏锐分辨出微弱细差 (hint of oak / subtle difference) · smack of: 带有……的味道或可疑迹象 (corruption / treason / garlic)

groups.name: Taunt & Jeer · 讥诮与喝倒彩 (Taunt, Jeer, Sneer)
groups.tip: 用言语讥讽嘲笑挖苦他人

items.def_zh: 加倒钩；给言辞涂毒讽刺
items.def_en: To equip words or remarks with stinging, hurtful sarcasm
items.ex_en: The disgruntled critic barbed her theatrical review with biting remarks about the lead actor.
items.ex_zh: 心存不满的评论家在戏剧评论中极尽冷嘲热讽，刻毒地挖苦了主角。

items.def_en: (+ at) To smile or speak in a mocking, contemptuous manner that shows disrespect
items.ex_en: The arrogant aristocrat sneered at the humble petitions presented by the desperate villagers.
items.ex_zh: 傲慢的贵族对走投无路的村民们提出的卑微请愿予以轻蔑的嗤笑。

items.def_en: (+ at) To laugh or shout rude, mocking remarks at someone
items.ex_en: Rival fans continued to jeer at the opposing goalkeeper after every botched clearance attempt.
items.ex_zh: 每当对方门将解围失误后，客队球迷便不断朝他大声喝倒彩起哄。

items.def_en: (+ at) To make mocking, taunting, or sarcastic remarks at someone.
items.ex_en: The cruel courtiers dared to gibe at the disgraced minister behind his bent back.
items.ex_zh: 残忍的朝臣们竟敢在那位失势大臣佝偻的背后肆意冷笑讥讽。

items.def_en: To provoke or challenge someone with insulting, cruel remarks
items.ex_en: Schoolyard bullies would cruelly taunt the boy about his stutter whenever he answered questions.
items.ex_zh: 每当那个小男孩回答问题时，校园霸凌者都会恶毒地嘲弄奚落他的口吃。

groups.summary_en: This frame describes issuing sharp, mocking, provocative, or malicious spoken barbs, often accompanied by snide facial expressions, vocal gibes, or crowd catcalls.
groups.summary_zh: 指当面或公然发出刻薄挑衅的言辞、嘲讽怪叫或冷笑。
groups.desc_en: Signifies expressing overt hostility, contempt, or provocation through mocking vocal gestures or pointed insults, differing from generic 'criticize' by its intent to wound and humiliate publicly.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过嘲讽性的肢体、尖刻言辞或起哄声公然挑衅并羞辱对手，区别于说理批评，核心在刺痛自尊与招引公愤。
groups.nuance_en: taunt: provoke repeatedly with insulting, humiliating challenges (opponent / captive) · jeer: shout loud, derisive, mocking catcalls collectively (speaker / referee) · sneer: show contempt through curling facial expressions or scornful words (critic / rival) · gibe: deliver sharp, taunting witticisms (heckler / politician) · barb: fling cutting, targeted remarks designed to sting (speech / repartee)
groups.nuance_zh: taunt: 恶意挑衅并揭短刺痛 (opponent / captive) · jeer: 聚众喝倒彩或嘲弄哄笑 (speaker / referee) · sneer: 撇嘴冷笑与轻蔑嗤之以鼻 (critic / rival) · gibe: 抛出尖酸刻薄的俏皮话 (heckler / politician) · barb: 话中带刺精准伤人 (speech / repartee)

groups.name: Tax & Duty-Charge · 课税与税率裁定 (Tax, Duty, Excise)
groups.tip: 国家依法征收税款与关税

items.def_en: To demand an official fee, tariff, or price for a specific product, border entry, or service
items.ex_en: Customs officials charge a nominal inspection fee on all oversized agricultural freight entering ports.
items.ex_zh: 海关官员对所有进入港口的超大型农产品货物收取象征性的检验费。

items.def_en: To place a legally required financial charge on wages, profits, goods, or transactions
items.ex_en: The municipal government intends to tax luxury real estate transactions to fund urban development.
items.ex_zh: 市政府打算对豪宅交易课税，以为城市建设筹措资金。

items.def_en: To charge a specific fixed tariff for passage over a designated bridge, canal, or motorway
items.ex_en: The ancient gatekeeper tolled every merchant vessel passing along the sunlit canal.
items.ex_zh: 年迈的看守人向每艘穿过阳光照耀运河的商船征收通行费。
items.ex2_en: The expressway tolls smoothly without stopping traffic thanks to electronic sensor systems.
items.ex2_zh: 得益于电子感应系统，该高速公路收费流畅且无需车辆停下。

items.def_zh: 对…征收关税；按价目表计费
items.def_en: to impose a tariff, customs duty, or fixed rate on goods or services
items.ex_en: The ministry decided to tariff foreign electronics to safeguard domestic manufacturing interests.
items.ex_zh: 该部决定对外国电子产品征收关税，以维护国内制造业的利益。

items.def_en: To assess or compel payment of a traditional tenth-part levy on agricultural yield or earnings
items.ex_en: The stern lord tithed the autumn grain harvested by the village peasants.
items.ex_zh: 严苛的领主对乡村农民收获的秋粮课征了什一税。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the administrative categorization and fiscal taxing of specific commodities, imports, or commercial transactions. It focuses on applying statutory rates, customs duties, and excises rather than punitive exactions.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重依据法定税率对商品、交易或关税进行征课。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the institutional classification, pricing, and compulsory charge applied to goods, movement, or transactions, distinct from private 'pricing' by its statutory fiscal authority.
groups.desc_zh: 指依据法定税则对商品流通、交通使用或特定标的核定征收法定税费，区别于商业定价，强调法定性与专项目录管制。
groups.nuance_en: tax: impose a statutory levy upon income, property, or goods (citizen / revenue) · duty: levy specific customs or excise fees upon goods (imported wine / luxury goods) · excise: charge an internal tax on manufacture or sale (tobacco / alcohol / fuel) · tariff: fix protective or retaliatory import duties (foreign steel / electronics) · toll: charge a user fee for transit access (bridge / highway / waterway)
groups.nuance_zh: tax: 普遍征收法定公税 (citizen / revenue) · duty: 对进出口或特定物品设关税 (imported wine / luxury goods) · excise: 对特定消费制造品征消费税 (tobacco / alcohol / fuel) · tariff: 制定保护性或报复性关税税率 (foreign steel / electronics) · toll: 征收通道通行费 (bridge / highway / waterway)

groups.name: Tax & Levy Duties · 征税与摊派 (Tax, Levy, Assess)
groups.tip: 政府依法征纳税赋

items.def_zh: 向……征税；使负重荷，使承受重压；指责
items.def_en: 1. To levy or impose a compulsory financial charge on someone or something. 2. To put a heavy strain or demand on someone's physical or mental strength. 3. (+ with) (formal) To accuse or charge someone with a fault.
items.ex_en: The municipality decided to tax commercial properties to fund the new library.
items.ex_zh: 市政府决定对商业地产征税，以资助建设新图书馆。

items.def_en: To demand and obtain money, payment, or compliance by legal authority or coercive power
items.ex_en: The magistrate had the authority to exact outstanding fines from unruly citizens.
items.ex_zh: 地方法官有权向不守规矩的公民强征未结清的罚款。

items.def_en: To officially calculate the value of property or income in order to fix the amount of tax owed
items.ex_en: The council will assess your property before calculating this year's local tax.
items.ex_zh: 市政厅将在核算今年的地方税之前对您的房产进行估价。

items.def_en: To officially impose and collect a tax, fee, fine, or tariff by authority
items.ex_en: Parliament voted to levy an emergency surtax on luxury automobile imports.
items.ex_zh: 议会投票决定对豪华汽车进口加征紧急附加税。

items.def_en: To pay or collect a tenth part of one's income or produce as an ecclesiastical or civil tax
items.ex_en: Devout farmers tithed their annual barley harvest to support the local parish.
items.ex_zh: 虔诚的农夫们交纳了每年大麦收成的十分之一，以资助当地教区。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame relate to sovereign bodies or recognized authorities legally assessing, extracting, and enforcing statutory financial contributions, tariffs, or involuntary burdens upon citizens and commerce.
groups.summary_zh: 指法定政权或机构对公民、商品或财产强制评估并征收税款与规费。
groups.desc_en: Emphasizes the sovereign act of enforcing collection, assessing valuation, and requisitioning public revenue from a population, differing from voluntary 'donate' by its coercive state power.
groups.desc_zh: 指国家或主管机构凭借公权力评估财产基数并强制征收摊派款项，区别于自愿捐助，具有强制性与法定摊派性。
groups.nuance_en: levy: officially proclaim and enforce an obligatory tax or fine (fine / duty / surcharge) · assess: calculate the official financial value for taxation (property / damages / liability) · exact: demand and compel payment under legal coercion (tribute / compliance / price) · tax: systematically draw civic revenue from resources (earnings / transactions) · tithe: levy a formal tenth-part contribution, typically ecclesiastic (parishioners / grain)
groups.nuance_zh: levy: 依法宣布征收或强加税费 (fine / duty / surcharge) · assess: 核定资产计税基数或税额 (property / damages / liability) · exact: 强行索取或催征摊派 (tribute / compliance / price) · tax: 对纳税人进行常规税额征调 (earnings / transactions) · tithe: 征收什一税或定额份钱 (parishioners / grain)

groups.name: Tearing & Cutting into Strips · 撕碎与切细 (Shred, Rip, Tear up)
groups.tip: 扯碎裁切成细小碎条

items.def_en: Cut vegetables or meat into thin, uniform matchstick-like strips
items.ex_en: The chef julienned crisp carrots into delicate matchsticks for the feast.
items.ex_zh: 大厨将脆嫩的胡萝卜切成精致的细丝，以供盛宴享用。

items.def_en: Pull paper, cloth, or a document violently or thoroughly into many pieces
items.ex_en: He tore up the draft agreement in frustration and walked out of the room.
items.ex_zh: 他沮丧地撕毁了协议草案，甩门而去。

items.def_en: Reduce food to small shreds or particles by rubbing it against a serrated surface
items.ex_en: She decided to grate fresh parmesan cheese directly over the steaming pasta.
items.ex_zh: 她决定将新鲜的帕尔马干酪直接擦碎在热气腾腾的意面上。

items.def_en: Damage or destroy something by tearing and crushing it into mangled pieces
items.ex_en: The old paper shredder began to chew up the confidential financial reports.
items.ex_zh: 旧碎纸机开始将这份机密财务报告绞碎捣烂。

items.def_en: To tear or cut material into small, narrow pieces or strips.
items.ex_en: Workers carefully shred sensitive office documents to protect vital client privacy.
items.ex_zh: 工作人员仔细粉碎敏感的办公室文件，以保护至关重要的客户隐私。

groups.summary_en: Verbs designating the physical reduction of paper, fabric, or food into narrow strips, tiny scraps, or ragged remnants through mechanical slicing or tearing.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过撕扯或刀具将纸张、布料、食材等碎裂成细条或细末碎块。
groups.desc_en: Covers mechanical destruction or culinary reduction into ragged slivers, narrow strips, or fine particles, contrasting with clean 'slice' by its violent disintegration or specialized shredding.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过撕扯、刮擦或特制刀刃将物体解构成细条、碎末或碎片，区别于平整切割，强调剥离成条状或物理毁损。
groups.nuance_en: shred: tear or cut into long, narrow strips to destroy or process (confidential documents / cabbage) · rip: tear forcefully and jaggedly apart (fabric / seam / paper) · tear up: violently rip into numerous unusable pieces (letter / contract / photo) · grate: reduce into tiny fragments by rubbing across a rough surface (cheese / nutmeg) · julienne: precisely cut vegetables into thin matchstick strips (carrots / zucchini)
groups.nuance_zh: shred: 撕碎或切成细长条 (confidential documents / cabbage) · rip: 暴力扯开或撕裂 (fabric / seam / paper) · tear up: 愤然彻底撕碎撕烂 (letter / contract / photo) · grate: 在粗糙摩擦面上磨碎擦丝 (cheese / nutmeg) · julienne: 烹饪中精细切成火柴根细条 (carrots / zucchini)

groups.name: Tempt & Provoke Desire · 诱惑与勾引欲望 (Tempt, Tantalize, Coax)
groups.tip: 用利益或欲望驱使他人顺从

items.def_en: To encourage someone to believe something false, especially by falsely raising romantic hopes
items.ex_en: He did not mean to lead her on with affectionate daily messages.
items.ex_zh: 他并非有意通过每日温情脉脉的信息来让她产生误解。

items.def_en: (+ into/to) To persuade or attract someone to do something, especially something wrong or unwise, by offering pleasure or advantage.
items.ex_en: The lavish spread was meant to tempt him into breaking his diet.
items.ex_zh: 那顿丰盛的筵席意在诱使他打破日常节食计划。

items.def_zh: 挑逗，撩拨（引诱却不满足）
items.def_en: To torment or tease someone by showing them something desirable that remains just out of reach
items.ex_en: They tantalized the captive audience with glimpses of the unreleased video footage.
items.ex_zh: 他们展示了未发布的视频片段，撩拨着被深深吸引的观众。

items.def_en: To sharpen, heighten, or stimulate someone's appetite, interest, or desire
items.ex_en: The rich aroma of roasted spices whetted his appetite for dinner.
items.ex_zh: 浓郁的烤香料气味激发了他享用晚餐的食欲。

items.def_zh: 刺激，挑逗（感官或好奇心）
items.def_en: To excite someone's imagination or senses pleasantly, often in a superficial or mildly provocative way
items.ex_en: The scandalous headline was designed to titillate readers across the nation.
items.ex_zh: 这条骇人听闻的标题旨在挑动全国读者的好奇心。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this emotional/motivational frame describe sparking an inner urge, desire, or appetite that leads someone toward an indulgence or an unwise step. They emphasize the subjective draw of an alluring prospect.
groups.summary_zh: 着眼于挑逗内在欲望、胃口或好奇心，使其难以抗拒诱惑或冲动。
groups.desc_en: Describes stimulating appetites, curiosities, or forbidden urges by dangling allurements, contrasting with direct 'persuade' through sensory baiting and psychological tension.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过展示引人垂涎的事物来挑逗欲望、好奇心或违规冲动，区别于理性说服，侧重感官钩引与欲望折磨。
groups.nuance_en: tempt: entice someone toward an attractive, often risky or illicit action (shopper / diet / fate) · tantalize: torment with sight of something desirable kept just out of reach (appetite / imagination) · titillate: arouse mild, pleasant, often superficial excitement (senses / curiosity / reader) · whet: sharpen and stimulate an appetite or interest (appetite / desire / curiosity) · lead on: falsely encourage romantic or practical expectations (admirer / investor)
groups.nuance_zh: tempt: 诱发冒险或犯戒的渴望 (shopper / diet / fate) · tantalize: 吊人胃口使其可望而不可即 (appetite / imagination) · titillate: 挑动感官或猎奇兴奋 (senses / curiosity / reader) · whet: 刺激磨砺食欲与好奇心 (appetite / desire / curiosity) · lead on: 虚假许诺吊着对方 (admirer / investor)

groups.name: Tense & Tighten · 绷紧与肌肉收缩 (Tighten, Stiffen, Clench)
groups.tip: 拉紧绳索或神经肌肉高度绷紧

items.def_zh: （使肌肉、神经）拉紧，紧绷；（使局势）紧张
items.def_en: 1. To make or become physically tight, rigid, or anxious.
items.ex_en: His shoulder muscles began to tense as the sudden noise approached.
items.ex_zh: 随着突如其来的声音逼近，他的肩部肌肉开始紧绷起来。
items.ex2_en: The sudden loud explosion tensed his facial muscles before he turned around.
items.ex2_zh: 突如其来的巨响使他转过身前脸部肌肉瞬间紧绷。

items.def_en: To become or make muscles rigid, pulled taut, or firm through strain or emotion
items.ex_en: She felt her jaw muscles tighten with intense anger during the debate.
items.ex_zh: 辩论期间，她感到自己的下颌肌肉因极度愤怒而紧绷。
items.ex2_en: Sudden anxiety tightened his throat whenever public speaking opportunities arose unexpectedly.
items.ex2_zh: 每当意外遇到公开演讲的机会时，突发的焦虑总会使他的喉咙发紧。

items.def_en: To suddenly become rigid or inflexible, especially through fear, tension, or cold
items.ex_en: His posture began to stiffen when the cold wind struck his spine.
items.ex_zh: 当寒风吹打脊背时，他的身姿骤然僵硬起来。
items.ex2_en: The chilly nighttime frost stiffened his wet leather gloves within a few minutes.
items.ex2_zh: 寒冷的夜霜在几分钟内就将他湿漉漉的皮手套冻硬了。

items.def_en: (+ oneself) To stiffen one's muscles and posture firmly in preparation for a physical or mental shock
items.ex_en: He braced himself firmly against the railing before the giant wave hit.
items.ex_zh: 巨浪袭来前，他紧靠着栏杆绷紧身体做好了准备。

items.def_en: To close your hands or teeth together tightly, especially in anger, determination, or pain
items.ex_en: The boxer clenched his fists tightly in preparation for the final round.
items.ex_zh: 拳击手紧紧握起双拳，为最后一个回合做准备。

groups.summary_en: This frame represents the physiological and psychological hardening or constriction of muscles and sinews, causing the body or body parts to contract, lock, or rigidify.
groups.summary_zh: 生理或心理上使肌肉、肢体收缩、发紧僵硬或紧绷。
groups.desc_en: Depicts contracting muscular fibers or tightening systemic tension in response to stress, impact, or readiness, distinct from passive 'bend' by active physical rigidity.
groups.desc_zh: 指肌肉群或机体在应对冲击、压力或警备时骤然收缩变硬，区别于被动弯曲，强调主动紧张与抗衡姿态。
groups.nuance_en: tense: tighten muscles in apprehension or readiness (muscles / jaw / body) · tighten: make or become tauter and more rigid (grip / muscles / hold) · stiffen: become unnaturally firm or resistant to flexing (joints / resolve / spine) · clench: squeeze tightly together in anger or resolve (fists / teeth / jaw) · brace: firmly position and stiffen body against expected impact (feet / body / nerves)
groups.nuance_zh: tense: 肌肉或神经紧绷以戒备 (muscles / jaw / body) · tighten: 收紧握力或肌肉紧致度 (grip / muscles / hold) · stiffen: 肢体僵硬或意志硬化 (joints / resolve / spine) · clench: 愤怒或忍痛时紧咬/紧攥 (fists / teeth / jaw) · brace: 绷紧全身以抵御外部冲击 (feet / body / nerves)

groups.name: Tentative Hypothesis & Possibility · 假设与或然推测 (Might, May, Posit)
groups.tip: 依据现有线索推导可能性

items.def_en: Used to express epistemic likelihood or that something is possible in reality
items.ex_en: Heavy precipitation may cause severe flooding in the southern valleys tonight.
items.ex_zh: 强降水今晚可能会在南部山谷引发严重的洪涝。

items.def_zh: 可能，也许（助动词，表示推测或假设）
items.def_en: [modal] Used to express possibility, uncertainty, or a hypothetical condition.
items.ex_en: The unexpected storm might disrupt our travel schedule across the mountain pass.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的暴风雨可能会打乱我们翻越山口的行程安排。

items.def_zh: 设想；假定（作为讨论基础）
items.def_en: To put forward or state a fact or belief as a basis for argument or principle
items.ex_en: The authors posit that early childhood education significantly shapes lifelong earnings.
items.ex_zh: 作者设想早期儿童教育对人一生的收入有着显著影响。

items.def_en: To suggest or assume the existence, fact, or truth of something as a foundation for reasoning
items.ex_en: Physicists postulate that dark matter accounts for most mass in the universe.
items.ex_zh: 物理学家假定暗物质构成了宇宙中的大部分质量。

items.def_en: To propose an explanation or theory based on limited evidence as a starting point for investigation
items.ex_en: Scientists hypothesize that ocean currents determine regional weather patterns over time.
items.ex_zh: 科学家推测，随着时间推移，洋流决定了区域的气候模式。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on epistemic possibility and tentative speculation where the speaker hedges commitment to an outcome or hypothetical state.
groups.summary_zh: 表达或然性假设与谨慎推断，保留不确定空间。
groups.desc_en: Refers to advancing an epistemic claim or conditional assumption without definitive empirical proof, contrasting with asserting factual 'prove' by its speculative stance.
groups.desc_zh: 指在缺乏确凿定论下提出可能性预设或理论假说，区别于事实确证，侧重试探性的认知建构与推演起点。
groups.nuance_en: may: express realistic, plausible possibility based on uncertainty (rain / succeed) · might: express hypothetical or remote epistemic contingency (happen / fail) · posit: put forward an assumption as a foundational basis for argument (existence / premise) · postulate: claim the truth of an unproven axiom for a theoretical system (axiom / hypothesis) · hypothesize: propose a testable scientific explanation (mechanism / link)
groups.nuance_zh: may: 表达合乎常理的或然现实 (rain / succeed) · might: 表达更微弱或虚拟的假定可能性 (happen / fail) · posit: 提出作为立论基石的假设 (existence / premise) · postulate: 将未证公理作为推演前提 (axiom / hypothesis) · hypothesize: 提出待科学检验的假说 (mechanism / link)

groups.name: Textile Mending & Weaving · 针线织补与打补丁 (Darn, Patch, Cobble)
groups.tip: 针线织补细致修葺

items.def_en: To cover a hole or worn spot in fabric or leather with a piece of matching material
items.ex_en: She patched the faded wool tunic with scraps of midnight silk.
items.ex_zh: 她用几片夜色般的丝绸修补了那件褪色的羊毛长袍。

items.def_en: To mend a hole in knitted clothes or fabric by weaving thread across it.
items.ex_en: He sat by the fireplace to darn the gaping hole in his socks.
items.ex_zh: 他坐在壁炉旁织补袜子上那个显眼的破洞。

items.def_en: To restore or repair knitted material by relooping unraveled or broken yarn
items.ex_en: The artisan managed to re-knit the damaged cuff of the vintage cardigan.
items.ex_zh: 工匠成功重新编织修补了复古开衫受损的袖口。
items.ex2_en: Fractured wrist bones re-knit gradually through proper medical splinting and therapeutic rest.
items.ex2_zh: 通过适当的医疗夹板固定和疗养，骨折的腕骨逐渐重新愈合。

items.def_en: To repair shoes or roughly piece worn leather goods back together
items.ex_en: The old artisan learned to cobble worn boots in his modest workshop.
items.ex_zh: 老匠人在简朴的作坊里学会了修补磨损的皮靴。

items.def_en: To weave or blend threads or strands together across an opening or surface
items.ex_en: The weaver carefully interwove silver threads across the frayed tapestry.
items.ex_zh: 织工细心地将银线交织在磨损的挂毯织物上。
items.ex2_en: Complex cultural traditions interweave naturally across the vibrant border town community.
items.ex2_zh: 复杂的文化传统在这个充满活力的边境小镇社区中自然交织。

groups.summary_en: Manner verbs highlighting the intricate manual craft of mending holes or tears in fabrics, knitwear, and leather goods via interlacing thread or applying material patches.
groups.summary_zh: 强调手工穿针引线、经纬交织或贴补织物与鞋革的精细动作。
groups.desc_en: Pertains to restoring, interlocking, or improvising fabric, yarn, or materials across holes and gaps, differing from manufacturing 'create' by its restorative, patchwork focus.
groups.desc_zh: 指用针线、补丁或简易手段修补破洞、交织织物或拼凑修复，区别于从无到有的制造，侧重缝补与弥合残缺。
groups.nuance_en: darn: repair a woven hole by interlacing thread across it (socks / sweater) · patch: cover a defect or tear with a supplementary piece of material (jeans / drywall / code) · re-knit: join yarn stitches together again (fracture / stitches / alliance) · cobble: clumsily or hurriedly piece together from available parts (plan / shoe / solution) · interweave: blend threads or motifs intricately together (threads / narratives / themes)
groups.nuance_zh: darn: 穿针引线织补破洞 (socks / sweater) · patch: 贴上补丁遮盖破损 (jeans / drywall / code) · re-knit: 重新织合或使骨肉/关系复原 (fracture / stitches / alliance) · cobble: 仓促粗糙地拼凑攒合 (plan / shoe / solution) · interweave: 经纬交织或线索交错 (threads / narratives / themes)

groups.name: Textual Segmentation & Structuring · 文本分段与结构化 (Paragraph, Section, Subdivide)
groups.tip: 将整体结构切割划分为各段落

items.def_en: To divide written text, documents, or instructional manuals into distinct titled sections
items.ex_en: The technical editor will section the user manual into coherent functional chapters.
items.ex_zh: 技术编辑将把用户手册按功能划分为清晰连贯的章节。

items.def_en: To divide written material, data, or audiences into discrete, meaningful segments
items.ex_en: The analysts segment the collected consumer data to identify emerging trends.
items.ex_zh: 分析师对收集到的消费者数据进行细分，以确定新趋势。
items.ex2_en: The vast customer base segments naturally into clear distinct demographic categories.
items.ex2_zh: 庞大的客户群自然细分为清晰明了的细分人群类别。

items.def_en: To separate a comprehensive text, project, or problem into smaller, easily manageable units
items.ex_en: The project manager decided to break down the task into weekly milestones.
items.ex_zh: 项目经理决定将这项任务拆解为每周的阶段性目标。
items.ex2_en: The complex machinery broke down unexpectedly during the factory's peak production shift.
items.ex2_zh: 这台复杂的机器在工厂生产高峰班次期间意外抛锚了。

items.def_zh: 将（文章等）分段；写短文报道
items.def_en: 1. To divide a piece of writing into separate paragraphs. 2. To write about something in a paragraph.
items.ex_en: The editor advised him to paragraph the dense historical narrative more clearly.
items.ex_zh: 编辑建议他将这篇密集的历史叙述分段得更加清晰。

items.def_en: To divide something that is already divided into smaller secondary sections or categories
items.ex_en: The author chose to subdivide each major chapter into numbered subsections.
items.ex_zh: 作者选择把每个主要章节进一步细分成带编号的小节。
items.ex2_en: The expansive woodland property subdivides naturally into three private residential lots.
items.ex2_zh: 这片广阔的林地自然细分为三块独立的私人住宅用地。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to organizing, structuring, or carving written compositions, texts, or cataloged information into coherent hierarchical units such as paragraphs, chapters, or headings.
groups.summary_zh: 指对文章、法律条文或书面资料进行分段、分节与层次化结构编排。
groups.desc_en: Involves logically demarcating and organizing written or intellectual material into structural units, distinct from physical 'cutting' by its communicative architectural aim.
groups.desc_zh: 指对文本、话语或方案依逻辑层次划分为结构化章节单元，区别于物理切割，核心在行文层次建构与信息区隔。
groups.nuance_en: paragraph: divide a continuous text into indented thematic units (essay / article) · section: partition a comprehensive document into discrete formal chapters (code / treatise / document) · segment: divide a whole flow into measurable distinct portions (market / audience / broadcast) · subdivide: split already separated units into finer categorical tiers (category / plot / chapter) · break down: analyze and split complex data into digestible components (costs / steps / argument)
groups.nuance_zh: paragraph: 给行文分段落分行 (essay / article) · section: 将文稿或规范切分成篇章条块 (code / treatise / document) · segment: 沿天然界限切分受众或连续体 (market / audience / broadcast) · subdivide: 对已有分块进行次级细分 (category / plot / chapter) · break down: 将复杂架构拆解细化 (costs / steps / argument)

groups.name: Thank & Acknowledge · 感谢与致谢 (Acknowledge, Appreciate, Credit)
groups.tip: 表达真诚感激与确认认同

items.def_en: 1. To tell someone that you are grateful for something they have done. 2. (have sb/sth to thank for) To hold responsible for a result.
items.ex_en: I must thank the volunteers who spent hours cleaning the community garden.
items.ex_zh: 我必须向花数小时清理社区花园的志愿者们致谢。

items.def_en: (+ with / for) To officially acknowledge someone as the author, originator, or cause of an achievement
items.ex_en: Biographers credit the young engineer with inventing the modern steam valve.
items.ex_zh: 传记作家将现代蒸汽阀门的发明归功于这位年轻的工程师。

items.def_en: To show formal appreciation or honor for someone's achievements or long service
items.ex_en: The university gathered to recognize the retiring professor for decades of service.
items.ex_zh: 大学师生齐聚一堂，表彰这位即将退休教授数十年的卓越服务。

items.def_en: To feel or express genuine gratitude and value for what someone has done
items.ex_en: The team members appreciate your thoughtful guidance throughout this difficult project.
items.ex_zh: 团队成员对你在这个艰难项目中所给予的悉心指导深表感激。
items.ex2_en: Residential property values appreciate substantially near newly constructed metro transit stations.
items.ex2_zh: 新建地铁站附近的住宅房产价值大幅升值。

items.def_en: To publicly express gratitude for help, services, or contributions received
items.ex_en: The organization published an official statement to acknowledge the patron's donation.
items.ex_zh: 该组织发表了一份官方声明，向赞助人的慷慨捐赠致谢。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame express gratitude or formally recognize someone's contribution, assistance, or merit, ranging from everyday polite appreciation to public attribution of credit.
groups.summary_zh: 表示表达感激、肯定他人贡献或正式鸣谢的动词群。
groups.desc_en: Denotes the communicative act of recognizing and expressing gratitude for another’s contribution, help, or merit, differing from 'reward' by being expressive rather than transactional.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过言语或公开声明承认并感恩他人的恩情、贡献或创见，区别于物质报酬，侧重道义回馈与贡献认定。
groups.nuance_en: thank: express direct personal gratitude to someone (host / benefactor / colleague) · acknowledge: openly admit receipt or publicly attest to a contribution (assistance / letter / defeat) · appreciate: value the intrinsic worth or feel grateful for an act (effort / beauty / hospitality) · credit: formally attribute an accomplishment or idea to an author (author / mentor / discovery) · recognize: give formal public honor to achievements (service / achievement / talent)
groups.nuance_zh: thank: 当面口头致谢 (host / benefactor / colleague) · acknowledge: 正式致谢或公开确认收到/存在 (assistance / letter / defeat) · appreciate: 领情并深度体认价值 (effort / beauty / hospitality) · credit: 将功劳或创见归功于 (author / mentor / discovery) · recognize: 官方或机构公开表彰认可 (service / achievement / talent)

groups.name: Thermal Injury & Scorch · 烫伤与灼伤 (Scald, Sear, Blister)
groups.tip: 沸水热汤烫伤皮肤组织

items.def_en: To burn superficial hairs or skin edges slightly without inflicting deep damage
items.ex_en: The stray spark managed to singe the hairs on his left arm.
items.ex_zh: 飞溅的火星燎到了他左臂上的汗毛。

items.def_en: To burn the surface of skin or clothing slightly, changing its texture or color
items.ex_en: The iron was hot enough to scorch the collar of his shirt.
items.ex_zh: 熨斗的温度太高，把他衬衫的领子都烫焦了。
items.ex2_en: Delicate silk shirts scorch easily under hot irons without damp protective cloths.
items.ex2_zh: 娇嫩的真丝衬衫在没有湿保护布的热熨斗下极易被烫焦。

items.def_en: To cause swellings under the skin filled with watery fluid, or break out in blisters
items.ex_en: Fierce solar radiation began to blister the sailor's bare forearms.
items.ex_zh: 猛烈的太阳辐射让水手裸露的小臂上开始起水疱。
items.ex2_en: Freshly painted outdoor wooden fences blister quickly when directly exposed to rain.
items.ex2_zh: 新刷漆的户外木栅栏直接淋雨时很快就会起泡。

items.def_zh: 烫伤；用沸水烫；使（奶等）微沸
items.def_en: 1. To burn skin painfully with very hot liquid or steam. 2. (cooking) To heat liquid, especially milk, almost to boiling point.
items.ex_en: The boiling soup splashed out and scalded the young chef's hand.
items.ex_zh: 沸腾的汤汁溅了出来，烫伤了年轻厨师的手。

items.def_en: To cause sudden, painful burning injury to the skin with direct dry heat
items.ex_en: The intense heat from the open furnace seared his unprotected face.
items.ex_zh: 敞开熔炉散发的烈焰灼伤了他未受保护的面庞。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers physiological skin injuries caused by extreme heat, hot liquids, or steam, extending from superficial epidermal reddening to severe blistering and carbonization.
groups.summary_zh: 由沸液、蒸汽或炽热物体接触人体组织所造成的烫伤与灼创。
groups.desc_en: Encompasses damaging tissue or surfaces through rapid, intense thermal exposure, distinct from destructive 'burn' by producing distinctive scalds, blackening, or surface crusts.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过高温液体、猛火或接触式灼热使组织或表层遭受不同程度的烫伤、烧焦或起泡，区别于彻底焚毁，聚焦表层病理或热变。
groups.nuance_en: scald: burn with hot liquid, steam, or blistering heat (skin / throat / milk) · sear: burn or cauterize the surface rapidly with intense dry heat (meat / flesh / conscience) · scorch: superficially singe, dry out, or discolour with excessive heat (fabric / earth / grass) · singe: burn merely the outer tips, edges, or fuzz (eyebrows / feather / sleeve) · blister: cause fluid-filled swellings or paint bubbles through heat (skin / paint / surface)
groups.nuance_zh: scald: 遭滚水、蒸汽或沸液烫伤 (skin / throat / milk) · sear: 用干热骤火把表面烙焦/封煎 (meat / flesh / conscience) · scorch: 烤焦、烤黄或灼烫出焦痕 (fabric / earth / grass) · singe: 燎焦毛发或衣服边缘 (eyebrows / feather / sleeve) · blister: 热度过高致使表皮起泡起褶 (skin / paint / surface)

groups.name: Thermal Metal Joining · 钎焊与热熔连接 (Braze, Solder, Weld)
groups.tip: 用黄铜高温钎焊牢固接合

items.def_en: To fix, join, or seal components in place using molten or malleable lead
items.ex_en: The glazier used melted alloy to lead the stained glass panels together.
items.ex_zh: 装配工用熔化的合金将彩色玻璃板铅封固定在一起。

items.def_en: To join metal parts together using a soft metal alloy melted at a relatively low temperature
items.ex_en: Technicians must solder the delicate copper wires directly onto the circuit board.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员必须将精细的铜线直接焊接在电路板上。

items.def_zh: 钎焊，铜焊（用黄铜等硬焊料焊接）
items.def_en: 1. (metallurgy) To join two metal pieces together by melting a brass or bronze filler alloy at high temperature.
items.ex_en: The machinist will braze the brass fittings onto the high-pressure steel pipe.
items.ex_zh: 机械师将用黄铜焊料把黄铜接头硬钎焊到高压钢管上。

items.def_en: To blend or melt separate pieces into a continuous mass through high thermal energy
items.ex_en: Intense thermal energy will fuse together the adjacent ceramic particles permanently.
items.ex_zh: 强烈的热能将把相邻的陶瓷颗粒永久熔接在一起。
items.ex2_en: The separate metal pieces fused together seamlessly during the high heat process.
items.ex2_zh: 在高温过程中，这些独立的金属碎片天衣无缝地熔合在一起。

items.def_en: To join pieces of metal or plastic together by heating the edges until they melt together
items.ex_en: Workers must weld the thick metal seams along the ship's outer hull.
items.ex_zh: 工人们必须沿着船只的外壳焊接厚重的金属接缝。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers technical craft and industrial processes of joining metal or plastic components by application of heat and filler material. The verbs contrast primarily by melting temperature and whether the base material itself melts.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过加热或添加熔料将金属等工件结合在一起的热加工工艺。
groups.desc_en: Refers to uniting separate metal components using thermal energy with or without filler alloys, contrasting with mechanical 'bolting' by creating metallurgical continuity.
groups.desc_zh: 指利用高温使金属母材自身熔化结合，或借熔点较低的焊料填缝凝固实现金属性质的连续连接，区别于螺栓等机械紧固。
groups.nuance_en: weld: fuse base metals together by melting them directly under high heat (steel plates / pipeline) · solder: join delicate metal pieces using a low-melting alloy below 450°C (circuit board / wire / pipe) · braze: join metal components using a higher-melting brass/silver filler above 450°C without melting the base (tubing / joints / bronze) · fuse together: liquefy and merge intimately into a single solid piece (metals / elements) · lead: seal or join seams with soft molten lead (stained glass / roof joints)
groups.nuance_zh: weld: 熔焊（将母材本体高温熔融结合） (steel plates / pipeline) · solder: 锡焊/软钎焊（450℃以下焊料接合） (circuit board / wire / pipe) · braze: 铜焊/硬钎焊（450℃以上高温焊料填缝，母材不熔） (tubing / joints / bronze) · fuse together: 完全熔合为一体 (metals / elements) · lead: 用铅条封接或嵌合 (stained glass / roof joints)

groups.name: Thermostatic & Homeostatic Regulation · 恒温与生理/环境反馈调控 (Thermostat, Modulate, Govern)
groups.tip: 调控参数使其平衡

items.def_en: To control or regulate the speed, output, flow, or operations of a mechanical, physical, or biological system.
items.ex_en: Complex homeostatic feedback loops govern hormone production inside the human body.
items.ex_zh: 复杂的动态平衡反馈回路调节着人体内的激素分泌。

items.def_en: To control the functioning, temperature, speed, or pressure of a device or biological system automatically.
items.ex_en: An internal thermostat helps regulate chamber temperatures within the refrigeration unit.
items.ex_zh: 内置的温控装置有助于调控冷藏机组内部的温度。

items.def_zh: 使稳固；使稳定在正常水平
items.def_en: To make or become stable and resistant to undesirable environmental or operational fluctuations.
items.ex_en: New cooling mechanisms stabilize internal core heat during prolonged high operations.
items.ex_zh: 新的冷却机制可在长时间的高负荷运转中稳定内部核心温度。
items.ex2_en: Patient heart rates stabilized rapidly after the doctor administered the critical medication.
items.ex2_zh: 医生施用关键药物后，患者的心率迅速稳定了下来。

items.def_en: To exert a controlling or modifying influence on a continuous variable, signal, or process to suit conditions.
items.ex_en: The microprocessor can modulate electrical current according to real-time workload demands.
items.ex_zh: 微处理器可以根据实时的负载需求来调节电流大小。
items.ex2_en: Vocal pitch modulates naturally during speech to convey different emotional subtleties effectively.
items.ex2_zh: 说话时声音的音调会自然调节，从而有效地传达各种微妙的情感。

items.def_en: To control or regulate temperature by means of a thermostat.
items.ex_en: The automated system will thermostat the greenhouse during cold winter nights.
items.ex_zh: 自动化系统将在寒冷的冬夜用恒温器调控温室温度。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the continuous, automated, or biological monitoring and adjusting of environmental variables (such as temperature, pressure, or hormonal balance) within preset safe or optimal limits.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过反馈控制回路或内在机制自动维持温度、压力或环境状态的稳定。
groups.desc_en: Depicts maintaining an internal physical or biological equilibrium via dynamic negative/positive feedback, differing from linear 'control' through cyclic self-correction.
groups.desc_zh: 指系统依据传感反馈，自主纠偏以维持核心参数的动态平衡与稳态，区别于单向控制，强调闭环自动调节与守衡。
groups.nuance_en: thermostat: automatically maintain a predetermined temperature via thermal sensors (heater / incubator) · regulate: adjust a system continuously to stay within normative operational limits (flow / temperature / market) · modulate: vary tone, intensity, or rhythm to suit conditions (frequency / tone / immune response) · stabilize: counteract fluctuation to hold a steady equilibrium (patient / currency / system) · govern: exert primary regulatory restraint over systemic throughput (speed / engine / process)
groups.nuance_zh: thermostat: 靠温控器自动恒温 (heater / incubator) · regulate: 依标准调节流速、体温等系统参数 (flow / temperature / market) · modulate: 调制波幅、语调或免疫反应以适配条件 (frequency / tone / immune response) · stabilize: 抑制波动使之平稳受控 (patient / currency / system) · govern: 统揽节流以限定转速或供能 (speed / engine / process)

groups.name: Thinning & Rarefying · 削薄变细与稀释 (Dilute, Taper, Attenuate)
groups.tip: 打磨使厚度变薄或浓度稀释

items.def_en: 1. To become thinner, or make something thinner. 2. To become or make something less dense, crowded, or concentrated; dilute.
items.ex_en: Morning sunlight started to thin the dense fog lingering over the valley.
items.ex_zh: 晨光开始驱散萦绕在山谷上空的浓密雾气。
items.ex2_en: The persistent morning fog thinned gradually as gentle ocean winds swept inland.
items.ex2_zh: 随着柔和的海风吹向内陆，持续的晨雾渐渐消散变薄了。

items.def_en: Become or make gradually narrower or thinner toward one end
items.ex_en: The stone pillars taper toward their summits beneath the cathedral's roof.
items.ex_zh: 石柱在大教堂屋顶下方朝着顶端逐渐变细。
items.ex2_en: Skilled carpenters taper the wooden chair legs toward the base with chisels.
items.ex2_zh: 熟练的木匠用凿子将木椅腿朝底部逐渐削细。

items.def_en: Reduce the size, thickness, or number of something gradually by trimming away excess
items.ex_en: The committee voted to pare down departmental budgets to avoid debt.
items.ex_zh: 委员会投票决定削减各部门预算以避免负债。

items.def_en: Make a liquid thinner or weaker by adding water or another solvent
items.ex_en: Chemists dilute the concentrated acid with purified water before testing samples.
items.ex_zh: 化学家在检测样品前用纯净水稀释了浓酸。
items.ex2_en: Thick coastal fog diluted quickly once warm afternoon sea breezes rolled inland.
items.ex2_zh: 一旦温暖的午后海风席卷内陆，浓重的沿海海雾便迅速消散变薄。

items.def_en: Reduce the force, effect, density, or thickness of something
items.ex_en: Acoustic panels will attenuate loud reverberations throughout the expansive auditorium.
items.ex_zh: 吸音板将减弱宽敞礼堂内嘈杂的混响回声。
items.ex2_en: Sound waves attenuate rapidly as distance increases from the primary acoustic source.
items.ex2_zh: 声波随着距原声源距离的增加而迅速衰减。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers reducing thickness, density, concentration, or width. While thin covers general diminution in cross-section or density, taper emphasizes gradual narrowing toward one end and dilute signifies lowering liquid concentration.
groups.summary_zh: 使物体截面变细、密度稀疏或液体浓度降低。
groups.desc_en: Concerns reducing the thickness, cross-section, density, or operational strength of a substance or entity, contrasting with blunt 'shorten' by spatial or structural attenuation.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过物理修削、流体稀释或能量衰减使其厚度、浓度、截面或烈度渐次变薄变弱，区别于单纯截断，强调由厚/浓至薄/稀的渐近过渡。
groups.nuance_en: thin: reduce viscosity, thickness, or crowdedness (paint / hair / crowd) · taper: gradually narrow in width toward a pointed end (cylinder / candle / trousers) · dilute: weaken concentration or purity by adding liquid or filler (solution / acid / power) · attenuate: weaken the force, thickness, or virulence of something (signal / virus / impact) · pare down: strip away excessive layers to reach an essential core (budget / workforce / costs)
groups.nuance_zh: thin: 稀释稠度、疏解密度或使之变薄 (paint / hair / crowd) · taper: 逐渐变细成尖头或阶梯递减 (cylinder / candle / trousers) · dilute: 加溶剂稀释液体浓度或冲淡效力 (solution / acid / power) · attenuate: 使信号、毒力或冲击力衰减 (signal / virus / impact) · pare down: 逐层削减剥除多余部分 (budget / workforce / costs)

groups.name: Thread & Reeve · 穿引与走绳 (Reeve, Thread, Feed Through)
groups.tip: 将绳线等穿过孔道

items.def_en: Gradually push and guide a flexible line, wire, or sheet through an opening or mechanism
items.ex_en: She managed to feed through the thin wire into the plastic conduit.
items.ex_zh: 她成功将细导线一点点送入塑料穿线管内。

items.def_en: Carefully maneuver a flexible cable or hose through narrow, winding, or obstructed pathways
items.ex_en: The technician had to snake through the fiber cable behind the wall.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员不得不把光缆从墙体后方蛇形穿引过去。

items.def_en: Thread small items onto a cord, or thread cord or wire through a series of holes
items.ex_en: The jeweler helped her string luminous pearls onto a sturdy silk cord.
items.ex_zh: 珠宝匠帮她把发光的珍珠串到结实的丝线上。

items.def_en: Pass a thread, wire, or thin cord through the eye of a needle or another small aperture
items.ex_en: She patiently tried to thread the silk yarn through the tiny needle eye.
items.ex_zh: 她耐心地试图将丝线穿过细小的针眼。

items.def_en: (nautical) To pass a rope, cable, or line through a ring, pulley block, or hole.
items.ex_en: The boatswain ordered the deckhand to reeve the hawser through the heavy block.
items.ex_zh: 水手长命令甲板水手把粗缆绳穿过沉重的滑车。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers the delicate mechanical action of guiding a flexible line, cord, rope, or filament through an opening, narrow channel, eyelet, or block. It highlights precision alignment and manipulation.
groups.summary_zh: 指将绳索、线缆或细条引导穿过孔眼、滑轮或狭槽。
groups.desc_en: Guide a flexible, elongated element through a narrow, tortuous aperture or series of openings, contrasting with plain inserting by requiring sustained pathfinding and deliberate continuous traction.
groups.desc_zh: 引导细长柔韧之物穿过狭窄开孔或连续孔道，区别于普通插入，强调顺应路径的持续穿行与引线作业。
groups.nuance_en: thread: pass through an eye or constricted passage (needle / maze / traffic) · reeve: nautical passing of a line through a block or ring (halyard / tackle / grommet) · feed through: mechanically advance continuous stock into a slot (cable / paper / wire) · snake through: wind sinuously through an irregular path (pipe / alley / corridor) · string: align and suspend multiple items along a cord (beads / lights / pearls)
groups.nuance_zh: thread: 穿针引线或穿过极窄处 (needle / maze / traffic) · reeve: [航海]穿引绳索穿过滑轮或孔眼 (halyard / tackle / grommet) · feed through: 机械式将连续物料送入缝隙 (cable / paper / wire) · snake through: 蜿蜒曲折地穿行于狭窄空间 (pipe / alley / corridor) · string: 用线绳串连悬挂成串物品 (beads / lights / pearls)

groups.name: Thwart & Foil · 阻碍与挫败 (Foil, Thwart, Frustrate)
groups.tip: 挫败对手企图使其计划落空

items.def_en: To prevent a plan or effort from progressing, succeeding, or being fulfilled
items.ex_en: Unforeseen supply chain disruptions threatened to frustrate the government's ambitious development initiative.
items.ex_zh: 无法预料的供应链中断可能挫败政府宏大的发展倡议。

items.def_en: To prevent or hinder the progress of an effort or plan by presenting an insurmountable problem
items.ex_en: A sudden computer crash threatened to stymie our progress on the group project.
items.ex_zh: 电脑突然死机，险些让我们的小组项目陷入僵局。

items.def_zh: 挫败，阻挠，使受挫；贴箔于
items.def_en: 1. To prevent someone from carrying out an undesirable plan, plot, or crime successfully. 2. (dated) To cover or back something with metal foil.
items.ex_en: Vigilant bank staff managed to foil a sophisticated cyber fraud targeting retirees.
items.ex_zh: 警惕的银行员工成功挫败了一起针对退休人员的精密网络诈骗。

items.def_en: To oppose successfully and prevent someone from accomplishing a purpose or carrying out a plan
items.ex_en: Diplomatic sanctions successfully thwarted the regime's attempts to expand its nuclear arsenal.
items.ex_zh: 外交制裁成功阻挠了该政权扩大其核武库的企图。

items.def_en: To deliberately ruin, wreck, or prevent a plan, proposal, or opportunity from succeeding
items.ex_en: A leaked memo completely scuppered our chances of sealing the lucrative merger.
items.ex_zh: 一份泄露的备忘录彻底使我们敲定这笔利润丰厚的并购案的希望化为泡影。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe successfully stopping an adversary's intentions, plots, or illicit plans before they can come to fruition.
groups.summary_zh: 彻底破坏、阻挠对立方的图谋或非法企图。
groups.desc_en: Intervene actively to bring another's planned objective to a complete standstill, differing from passive delaying or resisting by decisively shattering success.
groups.desc_zh: 主动介入阻断他人计划或图谋使其落空，区别于被动的拖延或抗拒，强调决定性地彻底粉碎成功。
groups.nuance_en: thwart: block an ambitious endeavor or ambition by countermove (attempt / ambition / plan) · foil: frustrate a dangerous or criminal plot just before fruition (heist / plot / conspiracy) · frustrate: render plans completely useless and irritatingly unproductive (efforts / hopes / designs) · stymie: perplex and bring to an impasse through unforeseen obstacles (investigation / negotiations / progress) · scupper: deliberately wreck an ongoing arrangement from within or without (deal / chances / career)
groups.nuance_zh: thwart: 采取对策阻击宏大企图或抱负 (attempt / ambition / plan) · foil: 在阴谋得逞前夕予以粉碎 (heist / plot / conspiracy) · frustrate: 使计划或努力完全落空并产生挫折感 (efforts / hopes / designs) · stymie: 因不可预见的障碍陷入僵局受阻 (investigation / negotiations / progress) · scupper: 从内部或外部故意搅黄搞垮安排 (deal / chances / career)

groups.name: Tilt & Angle · 翘起与别转 (Cock, Perch, Angle, Crook)
groups.tip: 使物体偏离水平或向一侧歪斜

items.def_zh: 向上翘起，抬起（下巴、脸等）
items.def_en: To lift or slant something (such as one's chin or cap) upwards
items.ex_en: She tilted up her chin so the makeup artist could blend the foundation.
items.ex_zh: 她抬起下巴，以便化妆师将粉底抹匀。
items.ex2_en: Her curious chin tilted up instinctively when she heard the unexpected voice.
items.ex2_zh: 当听到那突如其来的声音时，她好奇地本能扬起了下巴。

items.def_en: To place, direct, or turn something in an oblique direction
items.ex_en: Please angle the solar panels slightly southward to capture the maximum sunlight.
items.ex_zh: 请将太阳能电池板稍微向南倾斜，以吸收最多的阳光。
items.ex2_en: The steep mountain road angles sharply toward the snowy summit ahead.
items.ex2_zh: 险峻的山路朝前方白雪皑皑的山顶急剧倾斜转弯。

items.def_zh: 使翘起，歪斜；使竖起；扳上（枪的）扳机
items.def_en: 1. To tilt or turn something upward or to one side. 2. To raise the hammer of a gun so that it is ready to fire.
items.ex_en: The puppy cocked its ears curiously upon hearing the unusual squeaky noise.
items.ex_zh: 小狗听到那奇怪的吱吱声，好奇地竖起了耳朵。

items.def_en: To bend one's finger, arm, or neck into a sharp angle or hooked shape
items.ex_en: She crooked her slender finger, beckoning the hesitant child into the library.
items.ex_zh: 她弯起纤细的手指，招呼那个犹豫不决的孩子走进图书馆。

items.def_en: To stretch and twist one's neck in order to see something better
items.ex_en: Commuters craned their necks to glimpse the approaching train along the crowded platform.
items.ex_zh: 在拥挤的月台上，通勤者纷纷伸长脖子张望驶来的列车。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate deliberately tilting, angling, or curling a body part (such as the head, eyebrow, or finger) or small object in a quizzical or distinctive gesture.
groups.summary_zh: 特指有意识地歪着、翘起或别转身体部位（头、眉毛等）。
groups.desc_en: Alter the angular posture of an individual limb, head, or single small object deliberately, contrasting with whole-body tilting by localizing the articulation.
groups.desc_zh: 刻意偏转或曲折特定肢体、头部或小构件的姿态，区别于整体倾斜，强调局部关节或角度的特意扭转。
groups.nuance_en: cock: jaunty or inquisitive upward/sideways turn (head / ear / eyebrow) · angle: direct or position obliquely toward an object (mirror / lens / body) · crook: bend a joint into an angular hook shape (finger / arm / elbow) · crane: stretch and twist the neck forward to see (neck / head) · tilt up: elevate upward from a pivot (chin / face / brim)
groups.nuance_zh: cock: 探询或得意外翘偏转 (head / ear / eyebrow) · angle: 将镜头或视线刻意成角对准 (mirror / lens / body) · crook: 关节弯成钩状曲折 (finger / arm / elbow) · crane: 伸长并扭转脖颈探看 (neck / head) · tilt up: 围绕支点向上翘起 (chin / face / brim)

groups.name: Tilt & Lean · 倾侧与斜靠 (Tilt, Lean, Bank, Cant)
groups.tip: 重心偏离垂直向一侧歪斜

items.def_en: To slope or deviate from an upright position, or to place an object at an angle against a support
items.ex_en: He leaned his wet bicycle carefully against the weathered stone garden wall.
items.ex_zh: 他小心翼翼地把湿漉漉的自行车斜靠在风化的石头花园墙上。
items.ex2_en: The weather-worn wooden barn leaned precariously against heavy winter winds.
items.ex2_zh: 饱经风霜的木质谷仓在强劲的冬风中摇摇欲坠地倾斜着。

items.def_en: 1. To move, slope, or slant into a leaning position, or cause something to do so. 2. To lean toward or favor a particular opinion or side.
items.ex_en: The table began to tilt dangerously when he placed the heavy crates.
items.ex_zh: 当他把沉重的木箱放上去时，桌子开始危险地倾斜。
items.ex2_en: The pilot tilted the airplane wings smoothly to initiate a graceful turn.
items.ex2_zh: 飞行员平稳地倾斜机翼，开始进行优雅的转弯。

items.def_en: (especially of a ship) To tilt steadily to one side due to wind, water ingress, or uneven weight
items.ex_en: The battered cargo vessel began to list heavily in the violent storm.
items.ex_zh: 这艘受损的货船在狂暴的风暴中开始严重侧倾。

items.def_zh: 侧倾转向（飞行器或车辆）
items.def_en: To tilt sideways when rounding a curve, especially of an aircraft or road vehicle
items.ex_en: The agile twin-engine aircraft banked steeply before lining up with the runway.
items.ex_zh: 那架敏捷的双引擎飞机在大角度侧倾转弯后，对准了跑道。
items.ex2_en: The experienced racing driver banked his sports car smoothly around the sharp corner.
items.ex2_zh: 经验丰富的赛车手熟练地让跑车倾斜平稳地绕过急弯。

items.def_en: To tilt, bevel, or slant abruptly out of a level or vertical position
items.ex_en: The violent seismic tremor caused the old brick chimney to cant precariously.
items.ex_zh: 强烈的地震震动导致古老的砖砌烟囱危险地倾侧。
items.ex2_en: The cargo crew canted the heavy shipping container to fit narrow doorways.
items.ex2_zh: 货运组人员倾斜沉重的集装箱，以便通过狭窄的门道。

groups.summary_en: This frame describes shifting or resting at an angle away from the vertical plane, either deliberately during maneuvering (as in aviation or cycling) or through structural deflection.
groups.summary_zh: 偏离垂直轴线倾侧、斜靠或转弯时侧倾。
groups.desc_en: Shift an upright body or vehicle away from the true vertical axis during sustained movement or resting, contrasting with static angling by emphasizing gravitational or aerodynamic deviation.
groups.desc_zh: 使直立主体或运载工具偏离垂线并倾斜承重，区别于单纯成角，强调受重力、离心力或支撑影响的侧倾与倾斜靠放。
groups.nuance_en: lean: rest weight obliquely against an external support (wall / shovel / railing) · tilt: displace an object or axis away from horizontal/vertical (head / table / axis) · bank: tilt an aircraft or vehicle laterally when executing a turn (aircraft / turn / motorcycle) · list: sustain an abnormal, static tilt due to uneven ballast or damage (ship / vessel / tower) · cant: bevel or pitch a surface permanently off-square (rail / lumber / frame)
groups.nuance_zh: lean: 斜靠在外部支撑物上 (wall / shovel / railing) · tilt: 摆动偏离垂直或水平基准 (head / table / axis) · bank: 飞行器或车辆过弯时的侧倾转弯 (aircraft / turn / motorcycle) · list: [船舶等]因配重不均或受损而严重侧倾 (ship / vessel / tower) · cant: 将表面修筑成斜边或斜角 (rail / lumber / frame)

groups.name: Tilt & Slant · 斜倾与斜置 (Slant, Slope, Skew, Rake)
groups.tip: 偏离水平或垂直基准方向

items.def_en: To slope downwards or have a specific angle of incline, as of a roof
items.ex_en: Traditional Alpine chalets pitch their roofs sharply to shed heavy winter snow.
items.ex_zh: 传统的阿尔卑斯木屋将屋顶建得十分陡峭，以便排落冬季厚重的积雪。

items.def_en: To lie or move at an upward or downward inclination from the horizontal
items.ex_en: The lush green vineyard sloped gently downward toward the sunlit winding river.
items.ex_zh: 郁郁葱葱的葡萄园向着阳光照耀下蜿蜒的河流缓缓倾斜。

items.def_en: To set or be set at a deliberate sloping angle from perpendicular or horizontal
items.ex_en: The shipwright raked the wooden masts backward to improve the schooner's aerodynamics.
items.ex_zh: 造船匠将木桅杆向后倾斜安装，以改善这艘帆船的空气动力特性。

items.def_en: To deviate from a straight, symmetrical, or parallel alignment; to make crooked
items.ex_en: The intense vibration during transit threatened to skew the telescope's optical alignment.
items.ex_zh: 运输过程中的剧烈震动可能使望远镜的光学对准发生偏斜。
items.ex2_en: Economic statistics skewed noticeably after several outlier responses entered the preliminary dataset.
items.ex2_zh: 在几个异常值进入初步数据集后，经济统计数据发生了明显偏离。

items.def_zh: （使）倾斜，（使）歪斜；有偏向性地报道
items.def_en: 1. To slope or lean at an angle, or cause something to do so. 2. To present information with a particular bias or perspective.
items.ex_en: The afternoon sunlight slanted warmly across the wooden floorboards of the study.
items.ex_zh: 午后的阳光斜斜地洒在书房的木地板上，带来融融暖意。
items.ex2_en: Editorial editors slanted the controversial political story toward conservative viewpoints intentionally.
items.ex2_zh: 专栏编辑故意使这篇有争议的政治报道偏向保守派观点。

groups.summary_en: This frame emphasizes static or progressive deviation from the horizontal or vertical lines, describing physical gradients, lines, and angled surfaces.
groups.summary_zh: 呈斜坡、倾角或不对称的斜向分布与偏斜。
groups.desc_en: Exhibit or impose a deliberate geometric deviation from standard orthogonal alignment across an entire surface or plane, contrasting with dynamic tipping by describing stable slope or skewed orientation.
groups.desc_zh: 使整个平面或走向呈现偏离水平/垂直基准的几何倾斜，区别于动态翻覆，强调稳定的坡度或走向偏斜。
groups.nuance_en: slant: orient diagonally across horizontal/vertical lines (roof / handwriting / beams) · slope: gradient rising or falling gradually over distance (hill / ground / driveway) · skew: distort or veer away from symmetry or alignment (data / perspective / alignment) · rake: construct with an intentional theatrical or architectural backward pitch (stage / mast / windshield) · pitch: oscillate or slope sharply downward along a longitudinal axis (deck / roof / bow)
groups.nuance_zh: slant: 斜置或对角线倾斜走向 (roof / handwriting / beams) · slope: 地形或斜坡随距离平缓起伏 (hill / ground / driveway) · skew: 偏离对称基准或扭曲 (data / perspective / alignment) · rake: 舞台或船桅刻意设计的后仰斜度 (stage / mast / windshield) · pitch: 沿纵轴剧烈起伏或极陡斜面 (deck / roof / bow)

groups.name: Tilt & Tip · 倾侧与翻落 (Tip, Tip over, Spill, Dump)
groups.tip: 重心失衡偏斜倒下

items.def_en: 1. To lean or slant, or cause something to fall over or onto its side. 2. To empty or pour contents out of a container by turning it over. 3. To give a small sum of money to someone for service.
items.ex_en: Careful not to tip the ladder while reaching for that top branch.
items.ex_zh: 去够最高的那根树枝时，小心别把梯子弄歪倒了。
items.ex2_en: The rickety wooden ladder tipped unexpectedly when heavy winds struck the yard.
items.ex2_zh: 当强风袭击院子时，摇摇晃晃的木梯意外倾斜倒下了。

items.def_en: To empty the contents of a container by turning it upside down or leaning it sharply
items.ex_en: She tipped out the colourful plastic blocks onto the clean play mat.
items.ex_zh: 她把五颜六色的塑料积木倒在了干净的游戏垫上。

items.def_en: To fall onto its side or topple over, or cause an object to lose balance and fall
items.ex_en: The careless elbow knocked the porcelain vase, causing it to tip over.
items.ex_zh: 粗心的手肘碰到了瓷花瓶，导致它整个翻倒在地。
items.ex2_en: A sudden mischievous gust of wind tipped over the patio dining umbrella.
items.ex2_zh: 一阵突如其来的顽皮狂风刮倒了露台上的遮阳伞。

items.def_en: To flow, fall, or cause liquid/particulate matter to run over the edge of a container accidentally
items.ex_en: He walked too fast and spilled hot coffee all over his trousers.
items.ex_zh: 他走得太急，把热咖啡全洒在了裤子上。
items.ex2_en: Cold rainwater spilled over the rusted metal gutters during the torrential downpour.
items.ex2_zh: 倾盆大雨中，冰冷的雨水从生锈的金属天沟中溢流出来。

items.def_en: To empty out or deposit a load of goods or materials heavily, carelessly, or all at once
items.ex_en: The delivery guys dumped the heavy boxes right in the front hallway.
items.ex_zh: 送货员把沉重的箱子一股脑儿倒在了前门门厅里。

groups.summary_en: This frame describes tilting a vessel or object past its tipping point so that it falls over or expels its contents, contrasting gentle tipping with accidental spills.
groups.summary_zh: 倾侧容器或物体，致其翻倒或内容物倾泻倒出。
groups.desc_en: Overturn a container or edge beyond its tipping point causing the contents to escape, contrasting with mere tilting by necessitating discharge or spillage.
groups.desc_zh: 使容器或边缘越过平衡临界点倾倒，导致内部容纳物滑出溢散，区别于单纯倾侧，强调倾覆泻空的动态后果。
groups.nuance_en: tip: incline a vessel to pour or inadvertently unbalance it (cart / glass / balance) · tip over: cross the center of gravity and fall on its side (vase / lamp / canoe) · tip out: deliberately empty contents by tilting (flour / contents / water) · spill: cause liquid or granules to tumble out accidentally (milk / fuel / secrets) · dump: unceremoniously unload a mass of material in bulk (rubbish / cargo / ballast)
groups.nuance_zh: tip: 倾角微斜以倒出或失稳 (cart / glass / balance) · tip over: 越过重心侧翻翻倒 (vase / lamp / canoe) · tip out: 故意倾倒倒空内容物 (flour / contents / water) · spill: 液体或颗粒失手散落泼洒 (milk / fuel / secrets) · dump: 粗暴、批量倾倒卸下 (rubbish / cargo / ballast)

groups.name: Time & Clock Duration · 计时与测算耗时 (Clock, Chronograph, Stopwatch)
groups.tip: 运用工具或数据度量事物

items.def_zh: 测定……的时间，记录……的时间，为……计时；安排……的时间
items.def_en: 1. to measure how long somebody or something takes to do something or how fast they go 2. to arrange when something should happen
items.ex_en: The physical education teacher timed each student running the hundred-meter dash today.
items.ex_zh: 体育老师今天为每位跑百米冲刺的学生记录了时间。

items.def_zh: 为…记录时间；测定…的速度
items.def_en: To measure and register the time taken by someone or something to complete a distance or event
items.ex_en: The speed camera clocked the speeding sports car at over ninety miles per hour.
items.ex_zh: 测速摄像头测出那辆超速跑车的时速超过了九十英里。

items.def_en: To measure the exact interval or lap time of an event using a stopwatch
items.ex_en: The swim coach stopwatched every single lap to monitor her turn speed.
items.ex_zh: 游泳教练用秒表为她的每一圈计时，以监测她的转身速度。

items.def_zh: 用精密计时器记录…的时间
items.def_en: To record the precise time or duration of a fast-moving physical event with a chronographical instrument
items.ex_en: Ballistics experts chronographed the high-velocity projectile to verify its extreme muzzle velocity.
items.ex_zh: 弹道专家用精密计时器记录了该高速弹丸的运动，以验证其极高的初速。

items.def_zh: 累计达到（一定时间或里程）
items.def_en: To reach or accumulate a specified total number of hours, miles, or points
items.ex_en: The weary long-haul driver clocked up thousands of motorway miles this month.
items.ex_zh: 这位疲惫的长途司机这个月在高速公路上累计跑了数千英里。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve measuring the exact temporal duration of an event, performance, or competitor, typically employing a stopwatch, timer, or electronic sensor.
groups.summary_zh: 用跑表、计时器等测定动作、比赛或事件的持续时间与速度。
groups.desc_en: Measure, quantify, and record the elapsed temporal duration of an event using an instrument, contrasting with general estimation by focusing on objective chronological measurement.
groups.desc_zh: 使用计量工具对某项活动的耗时进行精确量化与记录，区别于粗略主观估算，强调客观精确的时钟度量。
groups.nuance_en: time: measure the duration of a run or process, or coordinate its onset (race / lap / contractions) · clock: record and verify an official high speed or elapsed time (speed / miles / laps) · chronograph: measure minute intervals with horological precision (split-second / trajectory) · stopwatch: monitor an event via handheld start-stop button (sprint / drill / debate) · clock up: accumulate a sizable total distance or operational duration over time (mileage / hours / service)
groups.nuance_zh: time: 掐表测算耗时或安排发生时间 (race / lap / contractions) · clock: 记录或测出官方极限用时或速度 (speed / miles / laps) · chronograph: 以高精度计时器测算微小时间间隔 (split-second / trajectory) · stopwatch: 用秒表按压监控时段 (sprint / drill / debate) · clock up: 长期累积达到惊人的行驶里程或运行时间 (mileage / hours / service)

groups.name: Tinge & Imbue · 润色浸染与赋味 (Tincture, Tinge, Imbue)
groups.tip: 用色素浸染改变色泽

items.def_en: To impart a small amount of a color, flavor, or feeling to something
items.ex_en: A subtle melancholy tinged her radiant smile as she waved goodbye.
items.ex_zh: 当她挥手告别时，灿烂的笑容中略带一丝淡淡的忧伤。

items.def_en: To apply a delicate or translucent shade of color to something
items.ex_en: The stylist tinted her natural brown hair with soft caramel highlights.
items.ex_zh: 发型师用柔和的焦糖色挑染为她天生的棕发轻微着色。

items.def_en: (+ with / into) To introduce or steep a substance or quality so as to permeate something thoroughly
items.ex_en: The passionate lecture aimed to infuse youthful confidence into the hesitant graduates.
items.ex_zh: 这场充满激情的讲座旨在为犹豫不决的毕业生注入年轻的自信。

items.def_en: (+ with) To inspire, permeate, or soak thoroughly with a feeling, quality, or moisture
items.ex_en: The mentor sought to imbue his eager apprentices with profound integrity.
items.ex_zh: 这位导师力求向热切求知的学徒们灌输崇高的正直品质。

items.def_zh: 给……微染颜色；使带有（轻微特征、气息）
items.def_en: (formal) To tint, color slightly, or impart a slight quality or trace to something.
items.ex_en: The evening twilight tinctured the snowy mountain peaks with a delicate rose.
items.ex_zh: 傍晚的暮霭给白雪皑皑的山峰微染上一层淡淡的玫瑰色。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote coloring, flavoring, or permeating an object or medium with a subtle, pervasive shade, quality, or emotional tone. They emphasize qualitative seasoning or delicate infusion rather than heavy, opaque coating.
groups.summary_zh: 指以微量色彩、气息或内在品性予以细微熏染与渗透灌注。
