groups.desc_en: Permeate a substrate or abstract atmosphere with a subtle shade of color, flavor, or psychological tone, contrasting with heavy saturation by preserving the underlying substance.
groups.desc_zh: 为基质、氛围或情绪赋予微妙微弱的色调、滋味或感染力，区别于浓重完全覆盖，强调若隐若现的渗透底蕴。
groups.nuance_en: tinge: impart a faint secondary trace of color or emotion (sky / regret / irony) · tint: lightly and visibly shade a base color (glass / hair / lens) · infuse: saturate deeply with a vitalizing flavor, spirit, or principle (enthusiasm / herbs / tea) · imbue: thoroughly inspire or pervade mind and spirit with enduring values (patriotism / culture / values) · tincture: historically color or flavor medicinally with an extract (remedy / speech / essence)
groups.nuance_zh: tinge: 染上一丝微弱的情感或底色 (sky / regret / irony) · tint: 给表面浅浅着色或遮光 (glass / hair / lens) · infuse: 注入并浸润出滋味或精神 (enthusiasm / herbs / tea) · imbue: 思想或灵魂深处彻底渗透熏陶 (patriotism / culture / values) · tincture: 萃取浸润赋色赋味 (remedy / speech / essence)

groups.name: Tinker & Meddle · 摆弄与瞎调 (Tinker, Meddle with, Tamper with, Mess with)
groups.tip: 漫不经心随手摆弄

items.def_zh: 漫不经心地拨弄，瞎摆弄；瞎搞，篡改；拉小提琴
items.def_en: 1. To touch, move, or play with something restlessly or nervously with the fingers. 2. (informal) To alter or manipulate dishonestly. 3. To play the fiddle or violin.
items.ex_en: He nervously fiddled with the loose brass button on his coat cuff.
items.ex_zh: 他紧张地漫不经心摆弄着大衣袖口上松动的黄铜纽扣。

items.def_en: (+ with) To make small, experimental changes or minor repairs to something in an amateur way
items.ex_en: Dad spent Sunday morning happily tinkering with the sputtering lawn mower engine.
items.ex_zh: 爸爸周日上午兴致勃勃地摆弄修理那台扑扑作响的割草机发动机。

items.def_en: To adjust, alter, or touch mechanisms or systems without knowing how to handle them properly
items.ex_en: Don't mess with the router settings unless you know what you're doing.
items.ex_zh: 除非你懂怎么弄，否则别瞎摆弄路由器的设置。

items.def_en: To touch or experiment with machinery foolishly or meddlesomely
items.ex_en: The amateur mechanic warned him not to monkey with the car's transmission.
items.ex_zh: 那位业余修理工警告他不要盲目胡乱改装汽车的变速箱。

items.def_zh: 非法篡改，乱动（机械/数据）
items.def_en: To interfere with or alter something unlawfully, secretively, or damagingly
items.ex_en: The security guards discovered that someone had tampered with the emergency exit lock.
items.ex_zh: 保安人员发现有人非法乱动了紧急出口的锁具。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame characterize amateurish, experimental, or unauthorized adjusting, repairing, or altering of mechanical devices, settings, or systems, often risking malfunction.
groups.summary_zh: 指缺乏专业技术的外行修调、乱动仪器，或暗中篡改捣弄。
groups.desc_en: Handle, adjust, or dismantle a mechanism or system without professional expertise, risking harm, contrasting with authorized maintenance by focusing on amateurish poking or meddlesome interference.
groups.desc_zh: 外行随意摆弄、拆调机械或越权干涉系统，伴有损坏风险，区别于正规维修，强调业余瞎倒腾或不当乱动。
groups.nuance_en: tinker: make casual, non-expert experimental adjustments (engine / clock / gadget) · fiddle: nervously or idly manipulate small components without plan (knobs / keys / lock) · mess with: intrusively disrupt or provoke another's domain or device (wiring / computer / settings) · monkey with: recklessly alter or play with complex equipment clumsily (controls / thermostat / brakes) · tamper with: illegitimately and maliciously alter or corrupt integrity (evidence / lock / seal)
groups.nuance_zh: tinker: 业余摆弄摸索调整 (engine / clock / gadget) · fiddle: 无目的、神经质地反复拨弄旋钮 (knobs / keys / lock) · mess with: 乱动搞乱他人系统或设置 (wiring / computer / settings) · monkey with: 笨手笨脚胡乱瞎改精密部件 (controls / thermostat / brakes) · tamper with: 非法、破坏性地篡改或触动封条 (evidence / lock / seal)

groups.name: Toil & Slave · 苦干与奴役 (Drudge, Grind, Sweat)
groups.tip: 像奴隶般辛苦艰苦劳作

items.def_en: (+ away) to work or study incessantly and laboriously over a prolonged period
items.ex_en: She had to grind away at corporate finance textbooks all weekend long.
items.ex_zh: 整个周末她都不得不埋头苦读公司金融学教材。

items.def_en: to work extremely hard under strenuous conditions; to toil for little reward
items.ex_en: Underpaid construction laborers sweated in the sweltering heat to finish the foundation.
items.ex_zh: 薪酬微薄的建筑工人们在酷暑中流汗苦干，以完成地基工程。

items.def_en: (British) to work very hard and persistently, especially at demanding manual labor
items.ex_en: He grafted on the harsh building site for ten straight freezing hours.
items.ex_zh: 他在严寒艰苦的工地上足足拼命苦干了十个小时。

items.def_en: (+ away/at) to work extremely hard and continuously under difficult or exhausting conditions
items.ex_en: The frantic chefs slaved away over blazing stoves preparing the banquet dinner.
items.ex_zh: 忙乱的厨师们在灼热的炉灶旁拼命苦干，准备宴会晚餐。

items.def_en: to do dull, menial, hard, or exhausting work without complaint
items.ex_en: The weary scullery maid drudged silently in the damp manor basement kitchen.
items.ex_zh: 疲倦的帮厨女仆在潮湿的庄园地下室厨房里默默干着粗活苦差。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate exhausting, unremitting, often menial or thankless work performed under intense pressure, harsh subordination, or monotonous conditions.
groups.summary_zh: 强调在压迫、机械或毫无乐趣的环境中日复一日地当牛做马、辛苦卖命。
groups.desc_en: Endure exhausting, monotonous physical or mental exertion under oppressive or degrading conditions, contrasting with fulfilling industry through its grim, dehumanizing hardship.
groups.desc_zh: 在压抑苛刻条件下从事枯燥消耗、摧残人性的繁重苦役，区别于充实工作，强调暗无天日与受苦折磨。
groups.nuance_en: slave: work excessively hard under subservient, exploitative duress (kitchen / over stove / factory) · drudge: perform dull, menial, and unrewarding daily labor (office / routine / housework) · grind: push persistently through soul-crushing routine labor (daily / exams / shifts) · sweat: labor so strenuously as to induce heavy perspiration under harsh conditions (foundry / brow / fields) · graft: [chiefly BrE] apply raw, tenacious sweat-equity to manual labor (construction / docks / training)
groups.nuance_zh: slave: 如奴隶般被残酷压榨苦干 (kitchen / over stove / factory) · drudge: 埋头于卑微枯燥、毫无回报的杂役 (office / routine / housework) · grind: 咬牙死磕压榨心智的日常劳作 (daily / exams / shifts) · sweat: 在恶劣环境下挥汗如雨重劳作 (foundry / brow / fields) · graft: [英] 肯吃苦、拼老命干重体力活 (construction / docks / training)

groups.name: Toil & Slog · 苦工与苦行 (Toil, Trudge, Plod)
groups.tip: 迈着沉重步伐长久艰苦干重活

items.def_en: to exert strenuous bodily or mental effort under hard or oppressive conditions
items.ex_en: Generations of brave miners labored beneath the earth under extremely hazardous conditions.
items.ex_zh: 几代勇敢的矿工在极其危险的环境下在地底深处艰难劳作。

items.def_zh: 步履沉重地走，蹒跚跋涉
items.def_en: to walk slowly with heavy steps, typically due to fatigue or severe conditions
items.ex_en: The exhausted hikers trudged through the deep muddy trail towards base camp.
items.ex_zh: 精疲力竭的徒步旅行者步履沉重地穿过泥泞深陷的小道走向大本营。

items.def_zh: 沉重缓慢地走，埋头慢干
items.def_en: to walk with heavy, slow steps, or progress laboriously and unexcitingly on a job
items.ex_en: The tired clerks plodded through the dense stacks of unfiled annual reports.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的文员们埋头慢干，艰难地处理堆积如山未归档的年度报告。

items.def_en: to work extremely hard and continuously on demanding or exhausting physical labor
items.ex_en: Immigrant sharecroppers toiled tirelessly in the expansive cotton fields under blistering heat.
items.ex_zh: 移民佃农在烈日炎炎下，广袤的棉田里不知疲倦地辛劳耕作。

items.def_zh: 苦干，辛劳工作；艰难行进；猛击
items.def_en: 1. (+ away/through) to work hard and persistently at a difficult or tedious task 2. to walk or advance with heavy, laborious steps over a long distance or rough ground 3. to hit or strike something forcefully
items.ex_en: We had to slog through hundreds of confusing legal pages before morning.
items.ex_zh: 天亮前，我们必须硬着头皮啃完数百页令人费解的法律文件。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame emphasize the heavy, exhausting physical strain and slow, wearying momentum involved in working through difficult tasks or trekking through punishing terrain.
groups.summary_zh: 强调沉重、漫长且筋疲力竭的体力劳作，或步履蹒跚的艰难跋涉。
groups.desc_en: Advance or work against dense resistance with slow, punishing, step-by-step tenacity, contrasting with swift motion through its bone-wearying friction and heavy trudging.
groups.desc_zh: 顶着巨大阻力或恶劣条件艰难跋涉劳作，区别于轻快推进，强调步步维艰的磨人阻滞与体力消耗。
groups.nuance_en: toil: labor continuously over protracted periods with taxing strain (fields / mines / long hours) · slog: force one's way heavily through deep muck or grueling tasks (mud / essay / uphill) · trudge: walk heavily and wearily with dragging feet (snow / miles / homeward) · plod: walk or work slowly, doggedly, and unimaginatively (path / files / research) · labor: exert immense physical or structural strain against heavy weight (burden / uphill / breath)
groups.nuance_zh: toil: 终日长年累月地劳碌苦干 (fields / mines / long hours) · slog: 顶着泥泞深雪或枯燥任务死磕跋涉 (mud / essay / uphill) · trudge: 拖着灌铅般沉重疲惫的双腿慢走 (snow / miles / homeward) · plod: 迟缓、机械刻板却顽强地推进 (path / files / research) · labor: 承受极重负荷极其吃力地运转 (burden / uphill / breath)

groups.name: Tone Down & Dim · 弱化与减色 (Soft-pedal, Mute, Subdue)
groups.tip: 捂住声音减弱声学传播

items.def_en: To make speech, writing, or color less forceful, harsh, or bright
items.ex_en: The senator agreed to tone down his aggressive rhetoric during the televised debate.
items.ex_zh: 参议员同意在电视辩论中缓和其咄咄逼人的言辞。

items.def_en: To de-emphasize, play down, or treat something with deliberate restraint
items.ex_en: The marketing team soft-pedaled the software's frequent bugs to prevent customer panic.
items.ex_zh: 营销团队低调淡化该软件频繁出现的缺陷，以防引起客户恐慌。

items.def_zh: 减弱……的声音，消除……的声音；压抑，减弱（颜色或情感）
items.def_en: 1. to silence or lower the sound of a device or musical instrument 2. to make something, such as an emotion or color, less bright or intense
items.ex_en: The presenter muted her microphone before coughing softly during the online seminar.
items.ex_zh: 在网络研讨会上轻轻咳嗽前，主讲人先将麦克风静了音。

items.def_en: To soften or make tone, light, color, or feelings less intense
items.ex_en: Drawn velvet curtains subdued the harsh midday glare entering the master bedroom.
items.ex_zh: 拉起的丝绒窗帘使射入主卧室的刺眼中午阳光变得柔和。

items.def_en: To diminish the strength, enthusiasm, or acoustic resonance of something
items.ex_en: The sudden heavy downpour dampened the spectators' enthusiasm for the outdoor festival.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的暴雨削弱了观众对户外节庆活动的热情。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey decreasing the perceptual prominence, vibrancy, or intensity of sounds, colors, emotions, or outspoken opinions.
groups.summary_zh: 减弱声音音量、色彩亮度、情感烈度或言辞锋芒。
groups.desc_en: Reduce the intensity, brightness, or assertiveness of an expression, sound, or color to make it unobtrusive, contrasting with outright silencing by merely softening edge and presence.
groups.desc_zh: 减弱表达、声响或色彩的锋芒强度使其趋于柔和内敛，区别于直接彻底消除，强调降调抚平、隐匿锋芒。
groups.nuance_en: tone down: moderate harsh rhetoric or garish style for palatability (rhetoric / colors / language) · soft-pedal: intentionally downplay the seriousness of an issue to avoid friction (criticism / demands / scandal) · mute: dampen acoustic volume or dull vivid optical brightness (trumpet / colors / response) · subdue: soften brilliance or suppress emotional tumult into tranquility (lighting / rebellion / laughter) · dampen: suppress the fervor, resonance, or momentum of a phenomenon (spirits / enthusiasm / vibrations)
groups.nuance_zh: tone down: 缓和言辞尖锐度或视觉俗艳 (rhetoric / colors / language) · soft-pedal: 刻意低调处理争端以免引爆矛盾 (criticism / demands / scandal) · mute: 压低音量或调暗过分亮眼的色泽 (trumpet / colors / response) · subdue: 抑制光线刺眼感或强压动荡使之平静 (lighting / rebellion / laughter) · dampen: 泼冷水挫伤热情或吸收震动 (spirits / enthusiasm / vibrations)

groups.name: Topple & Overbalance · 失去平衡与倾覆 (Overbalance, Topple, Keel over)
groups.tip: 失去重心导致的倾斜跌倒翻倒

items.def_en: To fall quickly, helplessly, and headlong, often rolling over repeatedly
items.ex_en: The clumsy toddler tripped on the rug and tumbled onto the floor.
items.ex_zh: 那个笨拙的幼童在地毯上绊了一下，摔倒滚在地板上。

items.def_zh: （使）失去平衡跌倒，（使）翻倒；在数量或重量上超过
items.def_en: 1. To lose balance and fall over, or cause someone or something to do so. 2. To outweigh or exceed in importance, weight, or quantity.
items.ex_en: Carrying the unevenly weighted parcel caused the frail porter to overbalance instantly.
items.ex_zh: 搬运重心不均的包裹导致虚弱的搬运工瞬间失去了平衡摔倒。
items.ex2_en: The immense structural weight quickly overbalanced the crane on the construction site.
items.ex2_zh: 沉重的结构重量很快使施工现场的起重机失去了平衡。

items.def_en: To fall over suddenly or collapse sideways, often from faintness, illness, or loss of balance
items.ex_en: Overcome by the stifling heat, the fatigued sentry keeled over on parade.
items.ex_zh: 由于难以忍受的闷热，疲惫的哨兵在检阅仪式上晕厥倒地。

items.def_en: To lurch, fall, or plunge abruptly forward or headlong
items.ex_en: The sudden violent gust caused the cyclist to pitch headlong into bushes.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的狂风使骑车人向前猛摔进灌木丛中。

items.def_en: To become unsteady and fall down from a tall or upright position, or cause something to do so
items.ex_en: The precariously stacked pile of wooden crates began to topple over.
items.ex_zh: 那堆叠得摇摇晃晃的木箱开始摇晃倾倒下来。
items.ex2_en: Strong autumn gusts toppled the ancient elm tree onto the quiet street.
items.ex2_zh: 强烈的秋风将古老的榆树吹倒在寂静的街道上。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame capture an entity losing equilibrium or structural stability, leaning excessively, and tumbling or collapsing downward.
groups.summary_zh: 物体或人失去重心与平衡，倾斜并栽倒在地。
groups.desc_en: Lose vertical equilibrium and collapse or fall headlong under gravitational instability, contrasting with controlled landing by the sudden, uncontrolled failure of upright balance.
groups.desc_zh: 彻底丧失竖向平衡而在重力失稳下崩塌或翻倒，区别于受控降落，强调站立支撑突然失效导致的失控倾覆。
groups.nuance_en: topple: become top-heavy and crash down from an elevated height (statue / government / tower) · overbalance: shift center of gravity past the base and tumble (ledge / chair / ladder) · keel over: suddenly collapse sideways or fall unconscious (exhaustion / deck / heat) · tumble: fall uncontrollably rolling head over heels (downhill / ruins / stairs) · pitch: lurch violently forward or overboard headlong (forward / ship / horse)
groups.nuance_zh: topple: 头重脚轻自高处轰然倾覆崩塌 (statue / government / tower) · overbalance: 重心偏移基底而失去平衡失足 (ledge / chair / ladder) · keel over: 突发晕厥或笔直横向栽倒 (exhaustion / deck / heat) · tumble: 翻滚着狼狈跌落 (downhill / ruins / stairs) · pitch: 猛然向前颠簸甩出 (forward / ship / horse)

groups.name: Torment & Torture · 恶意折磨与严刑 (Torment, Torture, Persecute)
groups.tip: 施加肉体酷刑或精神折磨

items.def_en: Cause someone persistent suffering, agony, or torment for a sustained period
items.ex_en: Chronic migraines continued to martyr the aging scholar for over two decades.
items.ex_zh: 长期偏头痛在二十多年里持续折磨着这位年迈的学者。

items.def_zh: 折磨，摧残；纠缠，使极度痛苦
items.def_en: 1. To cause someone severe, repeated physical suffering or intense mental agony. 2. To annoy, tease, or worry someone persistently.
items.ex_en: Lingering remorse continued to torment the retired detective long after the investigation.
items.ex_zh: 调查结束很久之后，挥之不去的自责依然折磨着这位退休侦探的心灵。

items.def_zh: 迫害；残害；无休止地困扰
items.def_en: Subject someone to systematic hostility, ill-treatment, or persistent harassment
items.ex_en: Corrupt state officials sought to persecute vocal political dissidents across the country.
items.ex_zh: 腐败的政府官员企图在全国范围内残酷迫害敢于发声的持不同政见者。

items.def_en: Deliberately inflict severe physical or mental pain on someone, often to force information or for cruelty
items.ex_en: The captured spy refused to speak even when interrogators threatened to torture him.
items.ex_zh: 被俘的间谍拒绝开口，即便审讯人员威胁要对他施以酷刑。

items.def_zh: 严惩；残酷折磨；严厉斥责
items.def_en: Subject someone to extreme mental torment or ruthless, destructive criticism
items.ex_en: The ruthless press will crucify the manager if our team loses this match.
items.ex_zh: 如果我们队输掉这场比赛，无情的媒体会把经理骂得体无完肤。

groups.summary_en: Involves deliberately subjecting someone to excruciating physical pain, cruelty, or relentless mental anguish. The focus is on purposeful mistreatment, sadistic pleasure, or systematic persecution.
groups.summary_zh: 强调蓄意施加的残酷肉体虐待、精神折磨或恶意迫害。
groups.desc_en: Inflict sustained, severe physical or psychological anguish maliciously, contrasting with lawful punishment by deliberate cruelty and systemic agony.
groups.desc_zh: 怀着恶意对受害者施加持续且残忍的肉体或精神剧痛，区别于合法刑罚，强调蓄意残酷折磨与持久煎熬。
groups.nuance_en: torture: deliberately inflict acute physical or mental pain for coercion or cruelty (prisoner / hostage / mind) · torment: afflict continuously with nagging anguish or harassment (victim / conscience / nightmares) · persecute: oppress and harass systematically on racial, political, or religious grounds (minority / dissidents / church) · crucify: brutally execute on a cross or subject to merciless public evisceration (prisoner / press / reputation) · martyr: kill or cause extreme suffering on account of adhered beliefs (faith / cause / saints)
groups.nuance_zh: torture: 施加剧烈肉体严刑拷打以逼供或虐待 (prisoner / hostage / mind) · torment: 长期以精神痛苦或梦魇反复折磨 (victim / conscience / nightmares) · persecute: 因宗教、政见等进行系统性迫害 (minority / dissidents / church) · crucify: 钉十字架处决或在舆论中置之死地 (prisoner / press / reputation) · martyr: 为坚持信仰而被迫害杀害或牺牲 (faith / cause / saints)

groups.name: Torpedo & Ruin · 鱼雷击沉与骤然击垮 (Torpedo, Sink, Scuttle)
groups.tip: 如鱼雷命中使计划彻底毁坏

items.def_zh: 断然拒绝；驳回（建议或论点）
items.def_en: To reject or criticize an idea, proposal, or argument firmly and immediately
items.ex_en: The committee chose to shoot down her ambitious budget proposal without any discussion.
items.ex_zh: 委员会甚至未经任何讨论，就断然否决了她那份宏大的预算提案。

items.def_zh: 消灭；使（项目、法案等）彻底告吹
items.def_en: To stop or destroy something completely, preventing it from developing or continuing
items.ex_en: Rising production costs will kill off the struggling startup before the year ends.
items.ex_zh: 不断上涨的生产成本将在今年年底前让这家苦苦挣扎的初创公司彻底夭折。

items.def_en: To cause a business, proposal, or hope to fail completely
items.ex_en: The sudden loss of foreign funding could sink their entire renewable energy initiative.
items.ex_zh: 外资的突然撤出可能会彻底断送他们整个可再生能源计划。
items.ex2_en: The damaged wooden rowboat sank rapidly into the cold dark lake waters.
items.ex2_zh: 破损的木划艇迅速沉入了冰冷漆黑的湖水中。

items.def_zh: 彻底破坏，毁坏（计划等）；用鱼雷击沉
items.def_en:
1. (figurative) to deliberately ruin, destroy, or prevent the success of a plan, policy, or negotiation
2. to attack or destroy a ship using a torpedo
items.ex_en: Leaking confidential documents will torpedo the delicate trade negotiations between both nations.
items.ex_zh: 泄露机密文件将彻底破坏两国之间微妙的贸易谈判。

items.def_zh: 故意破坏；凿沉（船只或计划）
items.def_en: To deliberately cause a plan, proposal, or enterprise to fail, or sink one's own ship intentionally
items.ex_en: A rogue director tried to scuttle the merger by leaking fabricated financial reports.
items.ex_zh: 一名心怀不轨的董事试图通过泄露伪造的财务报告来蓄意破坏这次合并。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey catastrophic, decisive actions that abruptly sink, destroy, or dismantle a proposal, negotiation, or venture.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过突发且致命的打击，彻底粉碎或蓄意断送方案或谈判。
groups.desc_en: Deliver an unexpected, destructive strike that fatally ruins a project, deal, or career, contrasting with gradual failure by its catastrophic suddenness modeled on maritime sinking.
groups.desc_zh: 给予致命突袭彻底击毁项目、交易或前程，区别于渐进消亡，强调如鱼雷击沉舰船般的骤然粉碎与彻底毁灭。
groups.nuance_en: torpedo: abruptly blast and destroy a vulnerable negotiation or initiative (bill / treaty / talks) · scuttle: intentionally sink or abandon a venture from within to avoid liability (deal / ship / career) · sink: cause the permanent economic or operational doom of an enterprise (business / economy / hopes) · shoot down: aggressively demolish an argument, proposal, or air asset (proposal / idea / aircraft) · kill off: ruthlessly terminate an ongoing concept, character, or program (franchise / subsidies / species)
groups.nuance_zh: torpedo: 突然发射致命一击击沉协议或法案 (bill / treaty / talks) · scuttle: 从内部主动凿沉自沉避免资敌或收拾残局 (deal / ship / career) · sink: 导致彻底沉沦亏损破产 (business / economy / hopes) · shoot down: 迎头痛击否定驳回提议 (proposal / idea / aircraft) · kill off: 绝情腰斩终结项目、补贴或人物 (franchise / subsidies / species)

groups.name: Touch & Palpate Medically · 触诊与探查 (Examine, Probe, Finger)
groups.tip: 用手指探触以感知病灶

items.def_en: To touch, feel, or handle something carefully with the fingers
items.ex_en: She began to finger the delicate fabric of the dress before buying it.
items.ex_zh: 买下那件连衣裙前，她开始用手指细细翻弄检查其精致的面料。

items.def_en: To inspect a patient's body closely, often by touch or viewing, to check health
items.ex_en: The doctor decided to examine the injured athlete thoroughly before clearing him to play.
items.ex_zh: 医生决定对这名受伤的运动员进行全面诊查，然后才允许他上场比赛。

items.def_en: To explore, touch, or inspect physically or cautiously to gain information
items.ex_en: We should feel out the board members before submitting the proposal.
items.ex_zh: 在提交提案之前，我们应该先探探董事会成员的口风。

items.def_en: To examine or explore physically using the hands, fingers, or a medical instrument
items.ex_en: The surgeon used a thin instrument to probe the wound for hidden shrapnel.
items.ex_zh: 外科医生用细长器械探查伤口，寻找残留的弹片。

items.def_en: (medical) To examine a part of the body by feeling it gently with the hands or fingers to diagnose illness.
items.ex_en: The physician proceeded to palpate the patient's abdomen to identify any internal swelling.
items.ex_zh: 内科医生随后触诊患者的腹部，以查明是否存在体内肿胀。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on physical touch used purposefully to examine, diagnose, or inspect someone or something by feeling textures, swelling, or internal conditions.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过双手或手指触摸探查以诊断、检验或感应内部状况。
groups.desc_en: Apply tactile pressure with the hands or clinical instruments to detect underlying organic pathology, contrasting with idle touching by its targeted diagnostic purpose.
groups.desc_zh: 用手或诊疗器械针对性按压探查解剖部位以诊断病变，区别于无意识触摸，强调具有明确医疗探查意图。
groups.nuance_en: palpate: systematically compress tissue clinically with fingers to detect pathology (abdomen / lymph nodes / liver) · probe: deeply investigate a cavity physically or scrutinize verbally (wound / tissue / background) · examine: inspect medically via observation and clinical manipulation (patient / throat / injury) · feel out: tactilely search blindness, or subtly test hidden intentions (vein / way / opinions) · finger: handle or test material repeatedly with fingertips (cloth / edges / pulse)
groups.nuance_zh: palpate: [医学触诊]以手指有系统地深按探查病灶 (abdomen / lymph nodes / liver) · probe: 用探针深部探查或深入盘查 (wound / tissue / background) · examine: 临床全面体检与触诊检查 (patient / throat / injury) · feel out: 盲摸寻找血管或暗中摸底试探意向 (vein / way / opinions) · finger: 指尖反复捏摸质感或摸索脉搏 (cloth / edges / pulse)

groups.name: Touch & Stroke Tenderly · 抚摩与爱抚 (Stroke, Fondle, Pet)
groups.tip: 动作柔和亲昵地抚摩表面

items.def_zh: 抚摸（尤指动物或所爱之人）
items.def_en: To stroke or pat an animal or child affectionately
items.ex_en: The little girl loved to pet the stray cat sitting on the porch.
items.ex_zh: 那个小女孩喜欢抚摸坐在门廊上的流浪猫。

items.def_en: To move your hand gently and repeatedly over a surface, person, or animal
items.ex_en: He paused to stroke his daughter's soft hair until she drifted off to sleep.
items.ex_zh: 他停下来轻抚女儿柔软的头发，直到她渐渐入睡。

items.def_en: To touch or stroke someone or something gently and lovingly.
items.ex_en: The gentle evening breeze seemed to caress her tear-stained cheeks with tender grace.
items.ex_zh: 温柔的晚风似乎带着怜惜之意，轻抚着她带泪的面颊。

items.def_en: To touch or stroke someone or something affectionately or erotically
items.ex_en: He continued to fondle the smooth ancient jade carving resting inside his palm.
items.ex_zh: 他继续爱抚着静卧在手心里的那块温润古玉。

items.def_zh: 用鼻子或面部亲昵地蹭/触碰
items.def_en: To touch or rub gently with the nose or face, especially to show affection
items.ex_en: The frightened golden retriever puppy began to nuzzle against its owner's warm shoulder.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的金毛幼犬开始用鼻子亲昵地蹭着主人的温热肩膀。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe touching or moving one's hand gently, affectionately, or sensually over a person, animal, or object, emphasizing tenderness and tactile warmth.
groups.summary_zh: 强调带着温柔、爱意或亲昵抚摸人、动物或物品。
groups.desc_en: Pass the hand or body tenderly over skin, fur, or another person to convey affection, intimacy, or calming comfort, contrasting with functional gripping by pure affective gentleness.
groups.desc_zh: 以手或身躯在皮肤、毛皮上柔和拂过以传递爱抚与温存，区别于功能性抓握，强调深情爱护与情感抚慰。
groups.nuance_en: stroke: glide the hand smoothly and repeatedly in one direction to soothe (hair / cheek / cat) · caress: touch or stroke with delicate, protective, sensual affection (face / skin / beloved) · fondle: touch lovingly or eroticize contact with deep intimacy (pet / lover / trinket) · pet: stroke and show affection to domestic animals or small children (dog / rabbit / child) · nuzzle: rub nose or snout affectionately against someone (cheek / neck / shoulder)
groups.nuance_zh: stroke: 顺着同一方向单向轻抚以安抚情绪 (hair / cheek / cat) · caress: 温柔爱怜地轻抚深情摩挲 (face / skin / beloved) · fondle: 亲昵地抚弄爱抚 (pet / lover / trinket) · pet: 抚摸宠物或幼童以示喜爱 (dog / rabbit / child) · nuzzle: 用鼻子或脸颊亲昵地蹭拱 (cheek / neck / shoulder)

groups.name: Tour & Campaign · 巡回与巡演 (Stump, Whistle-stop, Troupe)
groups.tip: 巡回演出或各处游历穿梭

items.def_en: to travel around different places, typically giving a series of performances or lectures
items.ex_en: The famous rock band will tour European cities throughout the upcoming summer festival.
items.ex_zh: 这支著名摇滚乐队将在即将到来的夏季音乐节期间巡演欧洲各大城市。

items.def_zh: （在多地）作短暂停留巡回竞选
items.def_en: to make a series of brief stops in small towns to address crowds and rally voters or fans
items.ex_en: The candidate will whistle-stop through several rural counties to rally local union voters.
items.ex_zh: 这位候选人将在几个农村县作短暂停留巡回竞选，以争取当地工会选民的支持。

items.def_en: to travel through a region giving speeches to build political support, especially during an election campaign
items.ex_en: The seasoned senator agreed to stump across western towns for the young nominee.
items.ex_zh: 这位经验丰富的老参议员同意前往西部城镇，为那位年轻的被提名人巡回助选。

items.def_en: to visit homes or areas directly in order to solicit votes, opinions, or subscriptions
items.ex_en: Volunteers will canvass the entire residential district to identify potential supporters this weekend.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者们本周末将挨家挨户走访整个居民区，以排查潜在的支持者。

items.def_zh: 在乡村巡回演出，巡回竞选演说，穿梭巡回
items.def_en: to travel around rural areas giving theatrical performances, political speeches, or exhibition flights.
items.ex_en: The traveling theater company planned to barnstorm across provincial towns this autumn.
items.ex_zh: 这家巡回剧团计划在今年秋天走遍各个外省小城镇进行巡回演出。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail traveling rapidly through regional districts, small towns, or venues to campaign for votes, solicit support, perform, or pitch to audiences.
groups.summary_zh: 指为竞选宣讲、文艺演播或推广，在各地小城镇进行密集巡游。
groups.desc_en: Travel continuously across a geographic region making staged public appearances to win votes, audiences, or support, contrasting with recreational touring by its relentless promotional drive.
groups.desc_zh: 在特定区域内马不停蹄巡回走访并进行公开演说表演，区别于观光游览，强调带有强烈政治竞选或造势宣传目标。
groups.nuance_en: campaign: execute an organized operational push across a region for votes (office / presidency / reform) · tour: travel on a structured circuit for performance or exhibition (country / stadium / play) · stump: travel across districts delivering stock political speeches (trail / state / candidate) · whistle-stop: make brief, rapid appearances in minor towns along a transit route (tour / campaign / visits) · barnstorm: conduct a high-energy whirlwind tour across rural or peripheral circuits (countryside / heartland / circuit)
groups.nuance_zh: campaign: 为竞选公职展开全面有组织的拉票巡回 (office / presidency / reform) · tour: 剧团或乐队按既定路线巡回演出 (country / stadium / play) · stump: 深入选区发表千篇一律的政治拉票演说 (trail / state / candidate) · whistle-stop: 沿途在小城镇短暂停靠做走马观花式闪电造势 (tour / campaign / visits) · barnstorm: 旋风式席卷乡村腹地做高调巡演造势 (countryside / heartland / circuit)

groups.name: Tout & Scalp · 黄牛倒卖与高价转售 (Scalp, Tout, Resell)
groups.tip: 转手倒卖赚取中间差价

items.def_en: To buy up tickets for an event and resell them outside the venue at inflated prices
items.ex_en: Street hustlers gathered outside the arena to tout concert passes for huge sums.
items.ex_zh: 黄牛聚集在场馆外，高价倒卖演唱会门票以谋取巨款。

items.def_zh: 倒卖（门票等）；剥去……的头皮
items.def_en: 1. (chiefly North American informal) To resell tickets or goods at an inflated price for quick profit. 2. To cut or tear the scalp from someone's head.
items.ex_en: Unlicensed vendors managed to scalp final match tickets at triple their original face value.
items.ex_zh: 无证票贩子设法以原票面价值的三倍倒卖决赛门票。

items.def_en: To strip someone of money or property by exorbitant overcharging or deceit
items.ex_en: Shady mechanics often try to fleece inexperienced drivers by recommending unnecessary costly repairs.
items.ex_zh: 不良修理工经常试图通过推荐昂贵且不必要的维修来狠宰毫无经验的司机。

items.def_en: To charge an unfairly high or extortionate price, especially during a crisis or shortage
items.ex_en: Dishonest local retailers began to gouge customers on bottled water during the severe drought.
items.ex_zh: 不诚实的当地零售商在严重干旱期间开始漫天要价哄抬瓶装水价格。

items.def_en: To sell something that one has previously bought, often for a profit
items.ex_en: He bought several rare vintage watches purely to resell them for a profit.
items.ex_zh: 他买下了几块稀有的复古名表，纯粹是为了转手卖出赚取差价。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe buying tickets, commodities, or securities to resell them rapidly at an exorbitant or inflated price, typically exploiting high demand.
groups.summary_zh: 指低买高卖、囤积居奇或倒卖紧俏票务与物资以牟取暴利的行为。
groups.desc_en: Exploitative commercial transactions where scarce or high-demand goods are resold at extortionate markups, contrasting with legitimate retailing by its predatory, opportunistic secondary-market nature.
groups.desc_zh: 利用稀缺资源或信息差进行高价倒卖或暴利盘剥的二级市场投机行为，不同于普通的合法零售与正常溢价。
groups.nuance_en: scalp: reselling scarce event access at exorbitant prices (tickets / passes) · tout: aggressively hawking or unauthorized reselling (tickets / illicit goods) · resell: neutral secondary sale that may shade into opportunism (merchandise / consoles) · gouge: overcharging ruthlessly under supply distress (customers / prices) · fleece: swindling or stripping vulnerable buyers of money (tourists / victims)
groups.nuance_zh: scalp: 投机倒卖稀缺门票以榨取暴利 (tickets / passes) · tout: 沿街强行兜售或无照倒卖 (tickets / illicit goods) · resell: 相对中性的二次转售，有时带投机意味 (merchandise / consoles) · gouge: 借物资紧缺恶意哄抬物价 (customers / prices) · fleece: 巧取豪夺式宰客或欺诈剥削 (tourists / victims)

groups.name: Tower & Loom · 耸立与隐现 (Loom, Rear up, Overhang)
groups.tip: 高高耸立带来视觉压迫

items.def_en: To stick out over something from above, casting a shadow or creating a sense of overhang
items.ex_en: Massive jagged limestone cliffs overhang the narrow winding mountain trail far below.
items.ex_zh: 高耸参差的石灰岩悬崖悬垂在下方狭窄蜿蜒的山间小径之上。

items.def_en: To be the most prominent, noticeable, or highest feature in a landscape or skyline
items.ex_en: The magnificent medieval cathedral continues to dominate the historic skyline of the city.
items.ex_zh: 那座宏伟的中世纪大教堂依然俯瞰并雄霸着这座城市的历史天际线。

items.def_en: To appear as a large, shadowy, or threatening form, especially from a distance or through mist
items.ex_en: Dark menacing storm clouds began to loom ominously over the tranquil seaside village.
items.ex_zh: 阴沉险恶的暴风雨乌云开始赫然笼罩在宁静的海滨村庄上空。

items.def_en: To rise up steeply or aggressively to an imposing height
items.ex_en: Gigantic frozen peaks rear up against the azure sky along the border ridge.
items.ex_zh: 巨大的冰峰沿着边界山脊向蔚蓝的天空高高耸起。

items.def_en: To rise to a very great height, or to be much taller, larger, or more impressive than surrounding people or things.
items.ex_en: Ancient towering sequoias easily tower over every other plant in the deep forest.
items.ex_zh: 古老的红杉巍然屹立，远比这片深林中的任何其他植物都要高耸。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe objects or figures rising to great heights or emerging menacingly above their surroundings, often evoking awe, dominance, or intimidation.
groups.summary_zh: 描绘物体或身形高高耸立、逼近或赫然显现，常带压迫感。
groups.desc_en: Static or impending vertical dominance where an entity stands far above its surroundings, projecting an overwhelming, protective, or ominous presence.
groups.desc_zh: 物体在垂直维度上高耸凸显并对周围产生压迫、遮蔽或隐现逼近的威慑感，不同于平铺的巨大或单纯的拔高。
groups.nuance_en: tower: imposing vertical height and dominance (peaks / skyscrapers / monuments) · loom: ominous, shadowy impending emergence (disaster / crags / crisis) · overhang: projecting precariously above or casting shadow over (cliffs / balconies / debts) · rear up: sudden dramatic rising up in threatening posture (beast / wave / wall) · dominate: commanding total visual or spatial prominence (landscape / skyline)
groups.nuance_zh: tower: 巍然屹立并占据绝对垂直高度 (peaks / skyscrapers / monuments) · loom: 阴森、庞大地隐现或逼近 (disaster / crags / crisis) · overhang: 悬垂遮蔽或高高突兀于上方 (cliffs / balconies / debts) · rear up: 猛烈昂起、突兀拔地而起 (beast / wave / wall) · dominate: 俯视全场、主导视野格局 (landscape / skyline)

groups.name: Toxify & Contaminate · 施毒与毒害 (Poison, Envenom, Taint)
groups.tip: 摄入毒物致伤或受到侵害

items.def_en: To give poison to a person or animal to kill or injure them; to corrupt or spoil a feeling, relationship, or environment.
items.ex_en: Harsh bitter jealousy began to poison their previously loyal and trusting working relationship.
items.ex_zh: 残酷刻薄的嫉妒开始毒害他们此前忠诚且互信的工作关系。

items.def_zh: 分泌/注入毒液；毒化（气氛）
items.def_en: To inject venom into someone or make an atmosphere, situation, or relationship bitterly poisonous
items.ex_en: Rancorous partisan rhetoric threatened to envenom the fragile spirit of civic harmony.
items.ex_zh: 充满敌意的党派言论可能会彻底毒化公民和睦相处的脆弱气氛。

items.def_en: To make a substance or place impure, dangerous, or toxic by adding a pollutant or poison
items.ex_en: Industrial chemical waste could severely contaminate the municipal drinking water supply system.
items.ex_zh: 工业化学废物可能会严重污染市政饮用水供水系统。

items.def_en: To contaminate, foul, or subtly spoil the quality, purity, or moral standing of something
items.ex_en: Unproven bribery allegations threatened to taint the brilliant diplomat's lifelong unblemished reputation.
items.ex_zh: 未经证实的受贿指控可能会玷污这位杰出外交官一生清白的名声。

items.def_en: To poison an organism via a toxic substance, or affect someone through alcohol or drugs
items.ex_en: Accidental exposure to toxic greenhouse gases can quickly intoxicate unaware farm workers.
items.ex_zh: 意外暴露于有毒温室气体中，很快就会使毫无戒备的农场工人中毒。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on administering toxic substances to harm or kill an organism, or figuratively corrupting atmospheres, minds, and relationships with malice.
groups.summary_zh: 指施加毒物致伤杀，或在精神、关系上进行毒化。
groups.desc_en: Introducing a destructive, corrupting, or venomous agent into an organism, substance, or atmosphere, moving beyond mere physical spoiling into virulent impairment.
groups.desc_zh: 将毒素或有害物质渗入机体、环境或关系中致其毒化或败坏，强调生化侵害或恶意的精神腐蚀，区别于一般的搞脏破损。
groups.nuance_en: poison: administering lethal toxin or fatally corrupting (wells / minds / food) · envenom: infusing with venom or venomous malice (blades / debates / atmosphere) · contaminate: rendering impure through contact or pollutant infiltration (water / soil / blood) · taint: spoiling moral or physical purity indelibly (reputation / meat / jury) · intoxicate: stupefying or intoxicating chemically or metaphorically (senses / crowds)
groups.nuance_zh: poison: 投毒致死或根本性毒化腐蚀 (wells / minds / food) · envenom: 淬毒或注入极具攻击性的恶意 (blades / debates / atmosphere) · contaminate: 遭外来污染物交叉感染或污染 (water / soil / blood) · taint: 使在物理或名誉上蒙受不可逆污点 (reputation / meat / jury) · intoxicate: 物质麻醉致幻或狂乱陶醉 (senses / crowds)

groups.name: Trace & Track · 追查与循迹 (Trace, Track down, Pinpoint)
groups.tip: 顺藤摸瓜追查踪迹

items.def_en: to understand or establish a complete picture by fitting scattered clues and facts together
items.ex_en: Detectives worked tirelessly through the night to piece together the victim's final movements.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们彻夜不知疲倦地工作，以拼凑查明受害者生前最后的行踪。

items.def_en: to find someone or something after a thorough and determined physical or informational search
items.ex_en: The police managed to track down the suspect after weeks of investigation.
items.ex_zh: 经过数周的调查，警方终于追查到了嫌疑人的下落。

items.def_zh: 追查，追踪，查出；追溯；描摹，勾勒
items.def_en: 1. To find, detect, or follow the course or origin of something by careful investigation. 2. To copy or draw an outline of something.
items.ex_en: Historians managed to trace the ancient manuscript back to a medieval French monastery.
items.ex_zh: 历史学家成功将这份古代手稿的源头追溯到一座中世纪法国修道院。

items.def_en: to relentlessly pursue someone or something until they are caught or discovered
items.ex_en: Detectives worked around the clock to hunt down the suspect.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们夜以继日地工作，力求将嫌疑人缉拿归案。

items.def_en: to identify or locate the exact position, cause, or nature of something with sharp precision
items.ex_en: Specialized diagnostic equipment helped engineers pinpoint the exact fault inside the rocket engine.
items.ex_zh: 专门的诊断设备帮助工程师精准查明了火箭发动机内部的确切故障。

groups.summary_en: Emphasizes the rigorous, investigative method of reconstructing a path, origin, or lineage by scrutinizing subtle remnants, paper trails, or physical evidence.
groups.summary_zh: 强调循着线索、痕迹或历史记录一步步寻根溯源的探查方式。
groups.desc_en: Systematic backward reconstruction or progressive tracking along an evidentiary chain to find an origin, person, or root cause, contrasting with serendipitous discovery.
groups.desc_zh: 循着线索、残余痕迹逆流而上或步步收网以排查源头或锁定目标，强调推导性与系统性，区别于偶然发现。
groups.nuance_en: trace: following faint historical lines or evidentiary links to origin (ancestry / calls / leaks) · track down: relentlessly locating elusive quarry through pursuit (suspects / records / fugitive) · pinpoint: locating exact precise coordinates or causation (location / source / error) · hunt down: aggressively pursuing target until captured (criminals / runaways) · piece together: assembling fragmented clues into a coherent whole (puzzle / history / narrative)
groups.nuance_zh: trace: 顺藤摸瓜回溯源头或演进脉络 (ancestry / calls / leaks) · track down: 几经周折捕获逃逸或隐蔽目标 (suspects / records / fugitive) · pinpoint: 极为精准地定位或查明死穴 (location / source / error) · hunt down: 围追堵截式的全力缉捕 (criminals / runaways) · piece together: 将零碎物证或线索拼凑还原 (puzzle / history / narrative)

groups.name: Track & Stalk · 尾随与追踪 (Stalk, Shadow, Tail, Trace)
groups.tip: 尾随留心行踪痕迹

items.def_en: To follow someone closely, persistently, and inescapably like a shadow
items.ex_en: Persistent financial troubles continued to dog the veteran politician throughout his re-election campaign.
items.ex_zh: 持续的财务困难在整个连任竞选期间一直如影随形地困扰着这位资深政客。

items.def_en: To follow the trail, footprints, electronic signals, or movements of an animal or person
items.ex_en: Forest rangers used satellite collars to track the endangered snow leopard's nocturnal movements.
items.ex_zh: 护林员利用卫星项圈追踪濒危雪豹的夜间活动路线。

items.def_en: To follow someone closely and discreetly everywhere they go without their knowledge
items.ex_en: Undercover agents were instructed to shadow the foreign diplomat across the entire capital.
items.ex_zh: 卧底特工奉命在整个首都范围内暗中跟踪监视那位外国外交官。

items.def_en: To follow closely behind someone in an ongoing, watchful, and often investigative manner
items.ex_en: Two plainclothes officers were ordered to tail the robbery suspect through the subway.
items.ex_zh: 两名便衣警察接到命令，要在地铁里一路尾随盯梢那名抢劫嫌疑人。

items.def_zh: 潜近（猎物）；非法跟踪骚扰；大步昂首走
items.def_en: 1. To follow a person or animal quietly and secretly in order to catch, attack, or harass them. 2. To walk in a proud, stiff, or angry manner.
items.ex_en: A hungry tiger crouched silently in the tall grass to stalk its prey.
items.ex_zh: 一只饥饿的老虎静静地潜伏在深草丛中，准备悄悄扑向猎物。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on surreptitiously pursuing, following, or monitoring a target. 'Stalk' conveys predatory stealth or sinister harassment, whereas 'tail' and 'shadow' are typical covert surveillance terms.
groups.summary_zh: 指潜行跟在目标之后进行秘密监视、猎捕或恶意纠缠。
groups.desc_en: Surreptitiously or doggedly following a moving quarry over time, maintaining proximity for observation, harassment, or predation without immediate confrontation.
groups.desc_zh: 暗中或死缠烂打地紧跟移动目标以监视、纠缠或伺机袭击，强调伴随性的隐秘或粘附，区别于迎头截击。
groups.nuance_en: stalk: stealthy predatory pursuit of prey or obsessive harassment (prey / victims / woods) · shadow: maintaining covert, close surveillance undetected (suspect / agent / detective) · tail: tracking vehicle or pedestrian discreetly at a distance (car / suspect) · dog: persistently hounding or adhering relentlessly (steps / athlete / footsteps) · track: monitoring sequential physical or data spoor (game / movements / phones)
groups.nuance_zh: stalk: 潜行潜伏式猎捕或病态尾随骚扰 (prey / victims / woods) · shadow: 隐秘贴身监视而不被察觉 (suspect / agent / detective) · tail: 隔开距离的专业盯梢或跟车 (car / suspect) · dog: 像恶犬般形影不离地纠缠附着 (steps / athlete / footsteps) · track: 沿物理或数据轨迹进行连续追踪 (game / movements / phones)

groups.name: Train & Apprentice · 培养与学徒 (Apprentice, Articled, Indenture)
groups.tip: 通过师徒制开展职业培训

items.def_en: To teach someone the practical skills and behavior required for a specific job, profession, or task
items.ex_en: The senior chef took personal time to train new kitchen recruits in knife skills.
items.ex_zh: 主厨亲自抽出时间对厨房新员工进行刀工等实践技能培训。

items.def_en: To advise, train, and guide a less experienced person in their professional career
items.ex_en: Experienced senior partners regularly mentor junior associates during their first year at firm.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的资深合伙人会定期带教和指导在律所工作第一年的初级律师。

items.def_en: To instruct or guide an individual student or learner directly and privately
items.ex_en: The professor agreed to tutor promising undergraduate students privately in advanced calculus concepts.
items.ex_zh: 教授同意私下为那些有潜力的本科生提供高等微积分概念的辅导。

items.def_zh: 使当学徒，送……去学艺；当学徒
items.def_en: (+ to) (usually passive) To place someone with a skilled master to learn a trade or craft.
items.ex_en: Young Oliver was apprenticed to a skilled local blacksmith to learn ironworking.
items.ex_zh: 年轻的奥利弗被送去给当地一位技术娴熟的铁匠当学徒，学习锻铁手艺。

items.def_en: To bind someone by a legal agreement or contract as an apprentice to a master or employer
items.ex_en: The court decided to indenture the orphaned boy to an experienced stone carver.
items.ex_zh: 法庭决定立契将这名孤儿交由一位经验丰富的石雕师傅当学徒雇用。

groups.summary_en: This institutional frame specifies formally binding an individual to a master craftsperson, professional, or mentor to acquire practical skills over an extended contractual or developmental period. Nuances differentiate between guild crafts ('apprentice'), formal legal contracts ('indenture'), and professional practice ('articled').
groups.summary_zh: 指通过师徒制或专门合同对某人进行长期的技能培训与职业塑造。
groups.desc_en: Institutional or vocational socialization where an novice is bound to a master to acquire craft, skill, or professional qualification through guided labor.
groups.desc_zh: 通过师徒制、条约束缚或长期言传身教传授技艺规约的职业化育过程，强调传帮带与制度依附，超越普适的基础授课。
groups.nuance_en: apprentice: legally or vocationally placing a novice under a master (youths / artisans / trade) · indenture: binding formally by contract to labor and training (servants / apprentices) · train: structured drill and instruction to instill capability (recruits / dogs / muscles) · mentor: nurturing and holistically advising a junior (protégés / students / talent) · tutor: intensive individualized remedial instruction (pupils / students / elites)
groups.nuance_zh: apprentice: 依学徒制拜师入行学艺 (youths / artisans / trade) · indenture: 签下契约束缚身份以工抵学 (servants / apprentices) · train: 结构化的实操训练与功能塑形 (recruits / dogs / muscles) · mentor: 倾囊相授的良师益友式职业点拨 (protégés / students / talent) · tutor: 一对一针对性课业补习与辅导 (pupils / students / elites)

groups.name: Transact & Trade · 交易与营商 (Conduct, Deal, Bargain)
groups.tip: 商业往来与钱货交割

items.def_en: (+ in/with) Buy and sell commercial commodities; do business
items.ex_en: The merchant firm continues to deal in rare botanical spices from Southeast Asia.
items.ex_zh: 这家商行继续经营并交易来自东南亚的稀有植物香料。

items.def_en: Buy and sell goods, currencies, or services commercially
items.ex_en: Multinational companies actively trade agricultural commodities across various dynamic international markets.
items.ex_zh: 跨国公司在活跃的国际市场上积极从事农产品大宗商品买卖。

items.def_en: (+ in) Deal or trade in something, often illicit or unregulated
items.ex_en: The border syndicate was caught attempting to traffic in illicit counterfeit luxury goods.
items.ex_zh: 该边境犯罪集团因企图非法贩卖假冒奢侈品而被当场抓获。

items.def_en: Arrange or negotiate an agreement or commercial transaction as a mediator
items.ex_en: The veteran ambassador managed to broker an historic peace treaty between rival factions.
items.ex_zh: 这位资深大使成功在敌对派系之间斡旋达成了一项历史性的和平条约。

items.def_zh: 办理，执行；进行（交易、业务）
items.def_en: To conduct, manage, or complete business, affairs, or financial negotiations.
items.ex_en: The financial institution is authorized to transact complex international wire transfers on weekdays.
items.ex_zh: 该金融机构获准在工作日办理复杂的国际电汇业务。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to conducting commercial deals, negotiating terms, and carrying out formal business or financial operations.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及开展商业往来、磋商条款及执行正式经贸交易活动。
groups.desc_en: Executing commercial exchange, negotiation, or market transactions under formal or shadow market dynamics, contrasting with passive holding or mere donating.
groups.desc_zh: 在商业或地下市场网络中开展买卖、斡旋与流通交易，强调对价交互与双向营运，区别于单向赠予或持有。
groups.nuance_en: transact: executing formal legal or commercial business (business / deals / payments) · trade: reciprocal exchanging of commodities or securities (shares / commodities / currencies) · deal: commercial bargaining or shady trafficking (drugs / cards / real estate) · broker: intermediary negotiation orchestrating accords (agreements / peace / deals) · traffic: illicit commercial dealing in forbidden goods (humans / narcotics / arms)
groups.nuance_zh: transact: 正式、依程序履行交割或办理公事 (business / deals / payments) · trade: 市场互惠买卖或平价置换 (shares / commodities / currencies) · deal: 商业盘算或隐秘的买卖做局 (drugs / cards / real estate) · broker: 作为中间人撮合、促成交易 (agreements / peace / deals) · traffic: 非法走私贩运违禁人事物 (humans / narcotics / arms)

groups.name: Transfer & Shift · 转移与位移 (Relocate, Shift, Reassign)
groups.tip: 人或物品换地安置

items.def_zh: 转移，调动；转让；转车，换乘
items.def_en: 1. To move from one place, job, or situation to another, or move someone or something there. 2. To officially pass property, rights, or control to someone else.
items.ex_en: The multinational corporation decided to transfer its regional headquarters to Singapore next spring.
items.ex_zh: 该跨国公司决定在明年春季将其区域总部转移到新加坡。
items.ex2_en: Several talented software engineers transferred to the newly opened research center yesterday.
items.ex2_zh: 几位优秀的软件工程师昨天调动到了新开设的研发中心。

items.def_en: To move something slightly or transfer emphasis, blame, or resources to another point
items.ex_en: The administration tried to shift public blame for the crisis onto foreign factors.
items.ex_zh: 政府试图将公众对这场危机的指责重心转嫁到外部因素上。
items.ex2_en: Public political opinion shifted decisively toward educational reform after the national broadcast.
items.ex2_zh: 在全国广播之后，公众的政治观点果断转向了教育改革。

items.def_en: To relinquish possession, authority, or custodial responsibility formally to another
items.ex_en: The retiring commander will formally hand over authority to his successor next Monday.
items.ex_zh: 即将退休的指挥官将于下周一正式将权力移交给他的继任者。

items.def_en: To move oneself, an office, or personnel to a completely different physical site
items.ex_en: The tech giant chose to relocate its research laboratory to a suburban park.
items.ex_zh: 这家科技巨头选择将其研发实验室迁移至郊区的科技园区。
items.ex2_en: The newly hired engineering team relocated into comfortable suburban housing last month.
items.ex2_zh: 新聘用的工程团队上个月迁入了舒适的郊区住宅。

items.def_en: To appoint someone to a different duty, post, or operational task
items.ex_en: The police chief decided to reassign the controversial detective to administrative desk duties.
items.ex_zh: 警察局长决定将那名备受争议的侦探调任负责行政内勤工作。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on conveying people, objects, rights, or obligations from one physical location, role, or administrative domain to another. It contrasts physical cartage with institutional redeployment.
groups.summary_zh: 指人、物、责任或职权从一地、岗位或系统迁移调换至另一处。
groups.desc_en: Relocating people, resources, or jurisdiction from one distinct site, account, or duty to another, distinct from haphazard drift by its intentional re-allocation.
groups.desc_zh: 有目的地将人、财、物或管辖权从一处划转、调配到另一处，强调岗位、空间或账目的转移，区别于漫无目的的漂移。
groups.nuance_en: transfer: general conveyance across entities or locations (funds / power / files) · relocate: moving physical base of operations or residence (headquarters / families / refugees) · reassign: formally shifting personnel to a different role or post (duties / troops / staff) · shift: altering position, stance, or cognitive focus (gears / blame / burden) · hand over: yielding custody or administrative possession (reins / prisoner / assets)
groups.nuance_zh: transfer: 资产、权力或人员的正式调拨过户 (funds / power / files) · relocate: 物理居所、基地或总部的连根迁徙 (headquarters / families / refugees) · reassign: 组织内部重新分配编制或任务 (duties / troops / staff) · shift: 挪动位置、转移焦点或转嫁责任 (gears / blame / burden) · hand over: 移交保管权、指挥权或掌控力 (reins / prisoner / assets)

groups.name: Transform & Convert · 转化与形变 (Transmute, Convert, Metamorphose)
groups.tip: 形式或能量本质改变

items.def_en: To change the character, form, or function of something from one state to another
items.ex_en: The city council plans to convert the abandoned warehouse into a community arts center.
items.ex_zh: 市议会计划将这座废弃的仓库改建为一个社区艺术中心。
items.ex2_en: The old factory building converts easily into modern luxury urban residential apartments.
items.ex2_zh: 这栋老厂房很容易改造为现代豪华的城市住宅公寓。

items.def_en: To direct energy, resources, or impulses into a specific new form or outlet
items.ex_en: She managed to channel into creative writing all the sorrow she had accumulated.
items.ex_zh: 她设法将自己积聚的所有悲伤完全转化为文学创作的力量。

items.def_en: To undergo a total, striking physical or structural transformation
items.ex_en: Under intense heat and pressure, common limestone can metamorphose into crystalline white marble.
items.ex_zh: 在高热和高压下，普通的石灰岩能够彻底蜕变为结晶状的白色大理石。
items.ex2_en: Visionary architects metamorphosed the crumbling brick railway warehouse into trendy creative offices.
items.ex2_zh: 富有远见的建筑师将摇摇欲坠的砖砌铁路仓库改造成了时髦的创意办公室。

items.def_en: To change or alter completely in form, nature, or substance into a higher state
items.ex_en: Alchemists spent entire lifetimes attempting to transmute common lead into pure luminous gold.
items.ex_zh: 炼金术士们耗费毕生心血，企图将普通的铅转化为纯净耀眼的金子。
items.ex2_en: Raw emotional grief transmuted into quiet enduring strength over many peaceful years.
items.ex2_zh: 在漫长而平和的岁月中，原始的悲痛蜕变为了沉静持久的力量。

items.def_en: 1. (physics / biology) To convert energy or a signal from one form into another.
items.ex_en: Specialized sensory receptor cells transduce incoming mechanical sound vibrations into electrical neural signals.
items.ex_zh: 专门的感觉受体细胞将传入的机械声音振动转换为电神经信号。

groups.summary_en: This frame refers to modifying the nature, form, or energy state of a system into another distinct format. While 'transduce' focuses on biophysical signal translation, its synonyms emphasize structural, chemical, or operational transmutation.
groups.summary_zh: 指能量形式、物质结构或系统信号由一种状态转变为另一种状态。
groups.desc_en: Profoundly altering the physical, structural, or ontological state of something into a distinct form or medium, far surpassing superficial modification.
groups.desc_zh: 使某物在物理形态、组织构型或内在本质上发生脱胎换骨式的剧变，区别于表层的微调与修补。
groups.nuance_en: convert: adapting utility or transforming format/creed (currency / heat / believers) · metamorphose: undergoing radical organic or structural change (caterpillar / character / forms) · transmute: alchemical or magical conversion into higher substance (metals / sorrow / lead) · channel into: directing raw energy or resources toward a defined form (anger / funds / aggression) · transduce: biophysical conversion of energy or signals (signals / energy / stimulus)
groups.nuance_zh: convert: 变更功用、制式或信仰皈依 (currency / heat / believers) · metamorphose: 生物学式的彻底蜕变或魔幻重构 (caterpillar / character / forms) · transmute: 炼金术般地化粗鄙为高贵、升华本质 (metals / sorrow / lead) · channel into: 将原始势能导入指定管道塑形 (anger / funds / aggression) · transduce: 生物/物理信号在介质间的转换传导 (signals / energy / stimulus)

groups.name: Transition & Segue · 过渡与转换 (Transition, Shift, Segue)
groups.tip: 平滑顺畅地过渡与转换

items.def_en: (+ to/from) To change position, direction, emphasis, or focus smoothly
items.ex_en: The debate moderator successfully shifted the focus to the urgent topic of climate reform.
items.ex_zh: 辩论主持人成功将讨论焦点平稳转移到紧迫的气候改革议题上。
items.ex2_en: Ocean wind patterns shifted abruptly toward northern shipping routes during early dawn.
items.ex2_zh: 破晓时分，海风的风向突然转向了北部的航运航线。

items.def_en: (+ to/into) To undergo or carry out a change from one condition, stage, or topic to another
items.ex_en: The enterprise plans to transition to sustainable energy sources over the next decade.
items.ex_zh: 该企业计划在未来十年内转型使用可持续能源。
items.ex2_en: The school district transitioned older elementary classrooms to digital learning environments successfully.
items.ex2_zh: 学区成功将高年级小学课堂过渡转化为数字化学习环境。

items.def_en: To merge gradually and smoothly into another state, sound, or picture so changes are indistinct
items.ex_en: The gentle piano melody began to blend into ambient electronic rhythms seamlessly.
items.ex_zh: 柔和的钢琴旋律开始自然融入氛围电子乐的节奏中。
items.ex2_en: The sound designer blended mellow synthesizer tones into ambient rainy field recordings.
items.ex2_zh: 声音设计师将圆润的合成器音调融入了环境雨声实地录音中。

items.def_zh: 转向；敏锐转换方向/策略
items.def_en: (+ to) To sharply or adaptively change strategic direction, focus, or topic
items.ex_en: The startup decided to pivot to cloud services after consulting with key investors.
items.ex_zh: 这家初创公司在咨询主要投资者后，决定转向云服务业务。
items.ex2_en: The executive board pivoted strategic investments toward renewable energy assets this quarter.
items.ex2_zh: 执行董事会本季度将战略投资重点转向了可再生能源资产。

items.def_zh: 平稳过渡，顺畅转换（至新话题、歌曲或场景）
items.def_en: (+ into/from) To move smoothly and without interruption from one song, topic, or scene to the next.
items.ex_en: The keynote speaker managed to segue into the quarterly budget review effortlessly.
items.ex_zh: 主讲人毫不费力地顺畅过渡到了季度预算审查的话题。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers fluid, uninterrupted motion or shifting from one state, stage, theme, or musical passage into another without jarring disruptions.
groups.summary_zh: 指在状态、主题、环节或音乐之间平滑、无缝地衔接与转换。
groups.desc_en: Moving progressively and smoothly between distinct states, topics, or configurations, differing from abrupt ruptures by maintaining continuum or bridge.
groups.desc_zh: 在不同阶段、话题或形态之间平稳演进或顺畅衔接，强调过渡与桥接，区别于断裂性的突变。
groups.nuance_en: transition: systemic developmental shift over a process (economies / regimes / careers) · segue: smooth, seamless narrative or musical gliding (topics / tunes / tracks) · pivot: strategic directional swiveling while grounded (business / strategy / defense) · shift: directional or attitudinal displacement (perspective / paradigm / gears) · blend into: imperceptibly merging into the backdrop or adjacent phase (crowd / horizon / scenery)
groups.nuance_zh: transition: 体系或生命周期的阶段性转型 (economies / regimes / careers) · segue: 话锋或旋律自然流转、无缝过渡 (topics / tunes / tracks) · pivot: 站稳脚跟基础上的敏捷战略掉头 (business / strategy / defense) · shift: 视角、基调或齿轮的换向偏移 (perspective / paradigm / gears) · blend into: 润物无声地融入周围或后一阶段 (crowd / horizon / scenery)

groups.name: Translate & Localize Audiovisual Media · 影视译配与转录 (Dub, Caption, Localize)
groups.tip: 为影像作品配字幕或添加译注

items.def_zh: 为（电影或电视节目）配音
items.def_en: To replace the original soundtrack of a film or broadcast with a synchronized recording in another language
items.ex_en: The studio hired professional actors to dub the animated film into Spanish.
items.ex_zh: 制片厂聘请了专业演员将这部动画电影配音为西班牙语。

items.def_zh: 为（视频或图片）配说明文字或闭合字幕
items.def_en: To provide a video, broadcast, or illustration with descriptive text or closed captions
items.ex_en: Volunteers worked through the night to caption the live broadcast for hearing-impaired viewers.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者们通宵达旦地为听障观众的直播画面添加字幕。

items.def_en: 1. To provide a film, video, or broadcast with printed subtitles translating or transcribing the dialogue. 2. To give a secondary title to a book or work.
items.ex_en: They had to subtitle the foreign documentary before submitting it to film festivals.
items.ex_zh: 在将这部外国纪录片送交电影节之前，他们必须为其添加字幕。

items.def_zh: 对（媒体内容或软件）进行本土化转换
items.def_en: To adapt translated audiovisual content or software to meet the linguistic and cultural norms of a target region
items.ex_en: Developers must localize the interface to accommodate cultural nuances within the domestic market.
items.ex_zh: 开发人员必须对界面进行本地化，以适应国内市场的文化细微差异。
items.ex2_en: The chronic joint pain localized entirely within his right shoulder joint overnight.
items.ex2_zh: 这种慢性关节疼痛在一夜之间完全局限在他的右肩关节处。

items.def_zh: 将（口述或录音）转写为文字
items.def_en: To produce a written or typed copy of spoken words, audio recordings, or dictated dialogue
items.ex_en: Court clerks must accurately transcribe the recorded testimonies of all key witnesses.
items.ex_zh: 法庭书记员必须准确转写所有关键证人的录音证词。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe adapting recorded speech or dialogue across media, either by substituting spoken audio tracks or superimposing translated or transcribed text for viewers.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及影视媒体的对白转录、翻译、字幕制作及配音本地化。
groups.desc_en: Adapting audiovisual material across languages and cultures through acoustic re-voicing, textual overlays, or contextual calibration, distinct from purely dry document translation.
groups.desc_zh: 通过重录配音、附加文本或本土文化适配来转化视听多媒体，强调音画同步与跨文化传播，非平面案头翻译可比。
groups.nuance_en: dub: replacing source dialogue with synchronous localized voices (films / anime / dialogue) · subtitle: overlaying translated captions along the lower screen (releases / episodes / dialogue) · caption: adding timed descriptive text for accessibility (broadcasts / videos / audio) · localize: adapting cultural tropes, jokes, and idioms comprehensively (software / games / marketing) · transcribe: rendering recorded spoken audio into written text (recordings / interviews / speeches)
groups.nuance_zh: dub: 进行音画同步的多语种配音重录 (films / anime / dialogue) · subtitle: 制作贴嵌于画面的多语译文底字幕 (releases / episodes / dialogue) · caption: 为听障或静音场景制作音画同步说明字幕 (broadcasts / videos / audio) · localize: 包含文化梗与习惯法的深度本土化改造 (software / games / marketing) · transcribe: 将视听语音原汁原味转写为文字实录 (recordings / interviews / speeches)

groups.name: Transplant & Graft · 移植与嫁接 (Graft, Transplant, Implant, Splice)
groups.tip: 植物枝条嫁接移栽

items.def_en: To implant living tissue or a shoot into a host organism so that biological union occurs
items.ex_en: The botanist sought to engraft the delicate scion onto the ancient woodland trunk.
items.ex_zh: 植物学家试图将娇嫩的接穗嫁接到古老的林地树干上。

items.def_en: To surgically transfer an organ or tissue to a body, or move a plant with its roots to new soil
items.ex_en: The surgical team will transplant the healthy kidney into the patient tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 手术团队将于明早将健康的肾脏移植入患者体内。

items.def_en: To insert an artificial device, tissue, or medical substance firmly into a living body
items.ex_en: Specialists will implant a miniature pacemaker directly into the patient's chest cavity.
items.ex_zh: 专家们将把一个微型起搏器直接植入患者的胸腔内。

items.def_en: To join a shoot from one plant or a piece of healthy skin/tissue onto another so that they grow together.
items.ex_en: Surgeons successfully managed to graft skin from his thigh onto the burned arm.
items.ex_zh: 外科医生成功地将他大腿上的皮肤移植到了烧伤的手臂上。

items.def_zh: 拼接；接合（基因、树枝或绳缆）
items.def_en: To join two ends of plant stems, ropes, or strands of genetic material so they function as one
items.ex_en: Researchers managed to splice the fluorescent gene into the plant's existing DNA.
items.ex_zh: 研究人员设法将荧光基因拼接进该植物现有的脱氧核糖核酸中。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to the surgical or horticultural technique of physically excising tissue, organs, or plant shoots and fusing them into another living host so they integrate and grow.
groups.summary_zh: 将活体组织、器官或植物嫩枝切取并植入另一载体使之结合生长的动作。
groups.desc_en: Surgically or botanically detaching organic or mechanical tissue from an origin and implanting it into a host organism to take root or function, contrasting with simple insertion.
groups.desc_zh: 将器官、植株或组织从供体取下并牢固植入受体以求共生融合，强调异质结合与生机维系，非单纯放置插合。
groups.nuance_en: transplant: moving living organ or plant to a new host site (kidneys / seedlings / organs) · graft: joining vascular tissue or metaphorical concepts together (tissues / scions / skin) · implant: embedding an artificial or biological device deep in tissue (pacemakers / chips / embryos) · engraft: establishing deeply and organically within host tissue (habits / tissue / ideals) · splice: connecting genetic strands or cinematic sequences end-to-end (genes / film / wires)
groups.nuance_zh: transplant: 活体器官或植株的迁移重植 (kidneys / seedlings / organs) · graft: 组织或枝条的皮肉嫁接与血脉贯通 (tissues / scions / skin) · implant: 将人工器械或胚胎深层植入体内 (pacemakers / chips / embryos) · engraft: 紧密结合、使之在母体中根深蒂固 (habits / tissue / ideals) · splice: 基因链或胶片电缆的剪接驳合 (genes / film / wires)

groups.name: Trap & Snare · 设套诱捕与困陷 (Trap, Snare, Entrap, Enmesh)
groups.tip: 从直接抓捕到设陷阱诱捕

items.def_zh: 设陷阱捕捉，诱捕；困住，使陷入困境
items.def_en: 1. To catch an animal using a trap. 2. To keep someone in a dangerous, confined, or difficult place from which they cannot escape.
items.ex_en: Rising floodwaters threatened to trap the stranded motorists inside the narrow mountain canyon.
items.ex_zh: 上涨的洪水极有可能将受困的驾车者围困在狭窄的峡谷中。

items.def_en: To catch an animal using a wire loop or noose, or to entice a person into a trap
items.ex_en: Local rangers caught poachers trying to snare endangered deer along the forest path.
items.ex_zh: 当地护林员抓获了企图在林道旁设套捕捉濒危鹿群的盗猎者。

items.def_en: To catch or entangle someone in or as if in a snare or web
items.ex_en: The cunning courtier sought to ensnare the naive young prince in deadly intrigues.
items.ex_zh: 狡猾的朝臣企图用致命的阴谋诡计将天真的年轻王子诱入圈套。

items.def_en: To lure or coax someone into an inescapable situation, illegal act, or compromising position
items.ex_en: Undercover agents were legally forbidden to entrap the suspect into committing bank fraud.
items.ex_zh: 法律明令禁止卧底探员诱骗嫌疑人从事银行诈骗。

items.def_en: To catch or involve someone in a complicated web of problems, deceit, or nets
items.ex_en: Greed threatened to enmesh the young heir in a dense web of litigation.
items.ex_zh: 贪婪使得这位年轻的继承人深陷繁复的诉讼泥潭之中。

groups.summary_en: Verbs here signify capturing animals or individuals through cunning mechanical traps, snares, or deceptive situations. The subject is physically restrained or cornered with little or no possibility of immediate escape.
groups.summary_zh: 设陷阱、罗网或圈套捕捉猎物或使人受困入局。
groups.desc_en: Ensnaring an adversary or quarry within an inescapable physical or psychological entanglement through trickery, deceit, or mechanical devices, contrasting with open pursuit.
groups.desc_zh: 运用机械陷阱、罗网或权谋诱骗将目标逼入无法挣脱的困局，强调请君入瓮与纠缠拘束，区别于正面的追捕。
groups.nuance_en: trap: confining in a physical enclosure or unescapable predicament (animals / miners / suspects) · snare: catching target by noose or cunning stratagem (birds / unwary / prey) · ensnare: tangling inextricably within deceptive webs (victims / minds / souls) · entrap: luring someone into committing a crime to prosecute (citizens / suspects / targets) · enmesh: tangling helplessly in intricate nets or complications (scandals / nets / litigation)
groups.nuance_zh: trap: 设伏封闭或截断退路使之深陷重围 (animals / miners / suspects) · snare: 用套索、绊线或巧计精准锁缚 (birds / unwary / prey) · ensnare: 运用蛛网般的心机使之作茧自缚 (victims / minds / souls) · entrap: 执法钓鱼或特意诱人入罪 (citizens / suspects / targets) · enmesh: 陷入盘根错节的纠葛、法网中动弹不得 (scandals / nets / litigation)

groups.name: Trawl & Comb Sources · 广泛撒网与拉网式排查 (Trawl, Comb, Sift)
groups.tip: 撒网排查广泛搜索资料

items.def_zh: 深入挖掘（数据或宝贵资料）
items.def_en: Dig deeply through vast amounts of information, records, or archives to extract useful data
items.ex_en: Data analysts routinely mine municipal archives to uncover shifting public health trends.
items.ex_zh: 数据分析师定期深入挖掘市政档案，以揭示不断变化的公共卫生趋势。

items.def_en: Examine a mass of information or evidence carefully to separate valuable components from the irrelevant
items.ex_en: Forensic investigators continued to sift the remaining debris for clues about the blast.
items.ex_zh: 法医调查人员继续仔细筛查残余碎片，以寻找爆炸的线索。

items.def_en: 1. To search thoroughly through a large amount of information, documents, or places in order to find something. 2. To fish by pulling a large net along the seabed.
items.ex_en: Detectives began to trawl online forums to track down the anonymous extortionist.
items.ex_zh: 侦探们开始排查网络论坛，以追踪那名匿名的敲诈勒索者。

items.def_en: Search a place or record thoroughly and systematically in order to locate someone or something
items.ex_en: Police officers will comb the abandoned warehouse district to locate the missing cargo.
items.ex_zh: 警官们将对这片废弃的仓库区进行地毯式搜查，以找寻失踪的货物。

items.def_en: Search an entire region, database, or collection of texts with intense, exhaustive thoroughness
items.ex_en: Volunteers continue to scour the dense hillside forest for any sign of survivors.
items.ex_zh: 志愿者们继续彻底搜查茂密的山坡森林，寻找幸存者的踪迹。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses exhaustive, systematic searching through massive quantities of documents, public databases, archives, or geographical areas to extract relevant clues, candidates, or evidence.
groups.summary_zh: 像撒网或梳头一样地毯式排查海量数据、文献或现场以搜求目标。
groups.desc_en: Executing an exhaustive, fine-meshed examination through large corpuses of data, physical terrain, or source material, contrasting with superficial skimming.
groups.desc_zh: 在广袤的场地或浩瀚的文献数据中展开拉网式、篦梳式的地毯式排查与筛选，强调彻底性，非浮光掠影的翻阅。
groups.nuance_en: trawl: pulling wide nets across vast data pools for candidates (archives / databases / waters) · comb: systematic strip-by-strip physical search (beaches / wreckage / files) · scour: vigorously sweeping across terrain or resources in desperation (countryside / records / horizon) · sift: separating minute valuable items from dross (evidence / ashes / data) · mine: deep extraction of rich hidden insights from large stores (data / texts / memories)
groups.nuance_zh: trawl: 撒大网捕捞、海量检索候选线索 (archives / databases / waters) · comb: 梳头式分片区无死角排查 (beaches / wreckage / files) · scour: 焦灼而全面地翻箱倒柜、扫荡搜索 (countryside / records / horizon) · sift: 细致筛分、去粗取精甄别有效物证 (evidence / ashes / data) · mine: 深度挖掘与提取深埋的高价值数据 (data / texts / memories)

groups.name: Tread & Trample · 踩踏与践踏 (Stamp, Tramp, Crush)
groups.tip: 用脚踏地或重重踩踏蹂躏

items.def_en: (+ on) To place one's feet on a surface or press something downward by stepping on it
items.ex_en: Few wanderers dare tread on the crumbling stones of that cursed mountain sanctuary.
items.ex_zh: 鲜有漫游者敢踏足那座受诅咒的高山圣所坍塌的碎石之上。

items.def_en: To bring one's foot down heavily and forcefully on the ground or onto an object
items.ex_en: He had to stamp on the burning embers to prevent the fire spreading.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不重踩燃烧的余烬，以防止火势蔓延开来。

items.def_en: To walk or tread heavily with deliberately loud, forceful, and often angry steps
items.ex_en: The angry tenant began to stomp down the hallway after the bitter argument.
items.ex_zh: 激烈争吵之后，愤怒的房客开始在大厅走廊里愤然重踏前行。

items.def_zh: 踩碎，践踏；无视，肆意践踏（权利、情感等）
items.def_en: 1. (+ on) To tread heavily on someone or something so as to cause damage or injury. 2. (+ on) To treat someone's rights, feelings, or opinions with callous disregard.
items.ex_en: Authoritarian regimes often trample on basic civil liberties during times of political unrest.
items.ex_zh: 在政治动荡时期，独裁政权往往会肆意践踏基本的公民自由。

items.def_en: To crush, flatten, or destroy completely beneath feet or heavy hooves
items.ex_en: Panicked cattle broke through fences and threatened to trample down the ripe wheat.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的牛群冲破了围栏，甚至可能将成熟的小麦彻底踩平。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on heavy, destructive, or forceful downward footsteps that crush, mark, or damage what lies beneath. Verbs vary in emotional violence from deliberate stamping to careless or crowded trampling.
groups.summary_zh: 指以重步下踩、踩踏造成破坏或碾压的激烈足部动作。
groups.desc_en: Applying downward crushing or rhythmic foot pressure upon a surface or entity, ranging from heavy stepping to destructive, contemptuous pulverization.
groups.desc_zh: 运用沉重足部或机械重压践踏物体表面，从沉重行走到彻底踩碎、践踏尊严，强调下压的毁损感与威慑力。
groups.nuance_en: tread: deliberate walking upon or stepping down heavily (boards / ground / water) · trample: crushing, injuring, or destroying by repeated chaotic stepping (flowers / rights / crowds) · stamp: striking the ground heavily with downward foot impact (feet / floor / mark) · stomp: heavy, resonant, often petulant, aggressive stomping (feet / room / ground) · trample down: thoroughly flattening underfoot with contempt or force (opposition / foliage / soil)
groups.nuance_zh: tread: 踏步走过、以足踩压 (boards / ground / water) · trample: 杂乱践踏、蹂躏致毁或践踏人权 (flowers / rights / crowds) · stamp: 跺脚、以足掌沉重撞击地面 (feet / floor / mark) · stomp: 怒气冲冲地使劲重踩顿足 (feet / room / ground) · trample down: 彻底踩扁、踩碎或武力压服 (opposition / foliage / soil)

groups.name: Treasure & Prize · 珍视与珍藏 (Prize, Value, Hold Dear)
groups.tip: 视若珍宝，倾注深厚情感呵护

items.def_en: To consider someone or something to be important, desirable, or worth having
items.ex_en: Modern software companies value creativity and collaborative problem solving above rigid corporate hierarchy.
items.ex_zh: 现代软件公司重视创造力与协作解决问题的能力，胜过刻板的企业层级。

items.def_en: To regard someone or something as having supreme value or special worth
items.ex_en: Scholars prize ancient manuscripts for their invaluable historical and linguistic insights.
items.ex_zh: 学者们高度看重这些古代手稿，因其蕴含宝贵的历史与语言学价值。

items.def_en: 1. To value someone or something highly and hold them dear; to cherish carefully.
items.ex_en: She will always treasure the handwritten letters her grandmother sent during the war.
items.ex_zh: 她将永远珍藏祖母在战火年代寄来的亲笔信件。

items.def_en: To regard someone or something with exceptional emotional devotion and care
items.ex_en: The reclusive poet continued to hold dear the quiet solitude of his retreat.
items.ex_zh: 这位避世的诗人依然无比珍爱隐居处那份宁静的独处时光。

items.def_en: To respect and admire someone or something profoundly
items.ex_en: Colleagues across the medical faculty deeply esteem her pioneering contributions to neurosurgery.
items.ex_zh: 医学院的全体同仁由衷敬重她在神经外科领域的开创性贡献。

groups.summary_en: This frame emphasizes assigning exceptional personal worth, esteem, or priceless emotional value to a possession, memory, or relationship.
groups.summary_zh: 强调视某人或某物为极其珍贵的无价之宝，予以极高评价与珍惜。
groups.desc_en: Subjectively cherishing someone or something with high emotional reverence or scarcity-value, distinct from objective utilitarian calculation.
groups.desc_zh: 将特定人事物视为至宝并在情感上深情呵护或奉为至尊，强调主观珍爱与非凡身价，非客观功利盘点。
groups.nuance_en: treasure: cherishing deeply and keeping safe with tender affection (memories / gifts / moments) · prize: valuing extraordinarily as a trophy or rare distinction (independence / talent / catch) · hold dear: harboring deeply felt personal affection towards (traditions / friends / memories) · value: assessing high worth, merit, or ethical importance to (honesty / opinions / assets) · esteem: regarding someone with lofty moral respect and honor (colleagues / character / virtues)
groups.nuance_zh: treasure: 悉心守护、奉若至宝般深情珍藏 (memories / gifts / moments) · prize: 视同战利品或极其珍视的无上瑰宝 (independence / talent / catch) · hold dear: 视若生命般珍爱、深印心底 (traditions / friends / memories) · value: 认知其极高价值并倚重赞赏 (honesty / opinions / assets) · esteem: 出于品德敬意而备加尊重推崇 (colleagues / character / virtues)

groups.name: Treat & Deal With · 对待与处置 (Handle, Manage, Address)
groups.tip: 如何看待与待人接物

items.def_en: To direct one's practical care, effort, and service toward a client, request, or duty
items.ex_en: I must attend to an urgent matter before I leave the office.
items.ex_zh: 我离开办公室前必须先处理一件紧急事务。

items.def_en: To deal with, manage, or take direct operational control of a person, situation, or task
items.ex_en: The experienced diplomat knew exactly how to handle the tense hostage negotiation calmly.
items.ex_zh: 这位经验丰富的外交官深谙如何从容应对紧张的人质谈判。

items.def_zh: 对待，看待；处理，处置；治疗，医治；款待，请客
items.def_en: 1. to act or behave towards someone or something in a particular way. 2. to deal with or handle a subject. 3. to give medical care to someone or an illness. 4. to buy or provide something special for someone.
items.ex_en: Managers must treat all employee grievances with equal seriousness and transparent accountability.
items.ex_zh: 管理人员必须以同等的严肃态度和公开透明的方式处理所有员工申诉。

items.def_en: To direct attention and effort toward understanding and resolving a specific issue or problem
items.ex_en: The city council convened an urgent session to address mounting public transit delays.
items.ex_zh: 市议会召开紧急会议，着手解决日益严重的公共交通延误问题。

items.def_en: To make a determined and vigorous effort to deal with a difficult task, challenge, or opponent
items.ex_en: The new environmental task force aims to tackle systemic pollution across river basins.
items.ex_zh: 新的环保特别工作组旨在全力整治全流域的系统性污染难题。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on the behavioral attitude and practical approach an agent adopts when handling other individuals, administrative affairs, materials, or challenges.
groups.summary_zh: 对人采取的态度，或对事件、事务采取的应对处置手法。
groups.desc_en: Applying conscious operational effort, posture, or tactical intervention to manage, process, or resolve an issue or patient, contrasting with passive neglect.
groups.desc_zh: 采取特定态度、手段或方案直面并处置人事物、问题或病症，强调主动态势与处置方法，区别于置之不理。
groups.nuance_en: treat: applying medical therapy or adopting a behavioral posture towards (patients / symptoms / guests) · handle: manually managing, regulating, or deftly bearing (crises / cargo / pressure) · address: giving focused intellectual or organizational response to (issues / concerns / crowds) · tackle: confronting a formidable obstacle with aggressive physical/intellectual force (problems / inflation / defender) · attend to: taking immediate care of needs, tasks, or clients (errands / patients / duties)
groups.nuance_zh: treat: 施以疗法或以某种态度方式接人待物 (patients / symptoms / guests) · handle: 经手操办、稳妥驾驭棘手情况 (crises / cargo / pressure) · address: 直面要害、对问题正式作出回应或发力 (issues / concerns / crowds) · tackle: 犹如擒抱般迎头痛击顽固难题 (problems / inflation / defender) · attend to: 专心照料、分身处理手头事宜 (errands / patients / duties)

groups.name: Tremble & Quake · 震颤与剧烈发抖 (Tremble, Shiver, Shudder)
groups.tip: 因恐惧寒冷微颤至剧震

items.def_en: To shake slightly and rapidly due to feeling chilled, feverish, or momentarily afraid
items.ex_en: A sudden gust made the lone sentry shiver inside his heavy woollen cloak.
items.ex_zh: 一阵突如其来的寒风让裹在厚羊毛斗篷里的孤独哨兵打了个冷战。
items.ex2_en: The icy mountain draft shivered the thin curtains beside the cracked window.
items.ex2_zh: 冰冷的山谷风让破损窗户旁的薄窗帘微微颤抖。

items.def_en: To vibrate or shake with a slight, rapid, fluttery motion
items.ex_en: Her pale lips began to quiver as she held back overwhelming sorrowful tears.
items.ex_zh: 当她强忍住夺眶而出的悲痛泪水时，苍白的嘴唇开始微微发颤。

items.def_en: To shake involuntarily, typically with subtle, rapid oscillating movements caused by cold, fear, or emotion
items.ex_en: His cold hands began to tremble noticeably while he signed the fateful surrender.
items.ex_zh: 在签署那份决定命运的投降书时，他冰冷的手明显颤抖起来。

items.def_en: To shake or tremble violently from fear, cold, or shock; (of the ground) to vibrate or shake.
items.ex_en: The stone foundations seemed to quake beneath the thunderous fury of the storm.
items.ex_zh: 在雷霆万钧的风暴肆虐下，石质地基似乎都在剧烈震颤。

items.def_en: To shake convulsively and violently with horror, revulsion, or deep vibration
items.ex_en: She could not help but shudder at the gruesome sight inside the cellar.
items.ex_zh: 目睹地窖内令人毛骨悚然的惨状，她忍不住剧烈战栗起来。

groups.summary_en: This physical and physiological motion frame covers oscillating, shaking movements varying from faint nervous twitches to massive geological or fear-induced convulsions.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖因恐惧、严寒或外力引起的从轻微打颤到剧烈摇晃。
groups.desc_en: Rapid, involuntary oscillatory shaking of the body or ground triggered by cold, fear, physical resonance, or seismic agitation, contrasting with static stillness.
groups.desc_zh: 因寒冷、惊惧、力竭或地质巨力而引起的躯体或大地快速不自主震颤，强调无力对抗的震荡性，非平稳静态。
groups.nuance_en: tremble: involuntary fine vibration from anxiety, weakness, or resonance (hands / voice / leaves) · shiver: quick brief shivering specifically provoked by cold or sudden chill (body / spine / cold) · shudder: convulsive violent spasm of revulsion, dread, or impact (ship / engine / horror) · quiver: minute, tense, rapid fluttering or oscillating (lips / arrow / feathers) · quake: deep, heavy, structural shuddering or seismic oscillation (earth / foundations / knees)
groups.nuance_zh: tremble: 因衰弱、激动或共鸣而产生的微幅战栗 (hands / voice / leaves) · shiver: 寒颤、因冷风或恐惧打激灵 (body / spine / cold) · shudder: 厌恶、剧震或惊骇引发的猛烈抽搐战栗 (ship / engine / horror) · quiver: 细碎、紧绷的微颤或疾速颤动 (lips / arrow / feathers) · quake: 大地或地基级别的深层剧烈震荡 (earth / foundations / knees)

groups.name: Trill & Warble · 颤音与婉啭 (Warble, Chirp, Yodel)
groups.tip: 运用声带歌唱或婉转颤音

items.def_zh: 突然用尖细高嗓发声或歌唱
items.def_en: To begin to sing or speak in a shrill, piercing, or distinctly high-pitched voice
items.ex_en: The toddler suddenly decided to pipe up during the quietest part of service.
items.ex_zh: 那名幼童偏偏在礼拜仪式最安静的时刻突然尖声叫喊起来。

items.def_en: To make a short, sharp, cheerful, high-pitched musical sound like a small bird
items.ex_en: Robins began to chirp cheerfully outside the sunlit bedroom window at early dawn.
items.ex_zh: 破晓时分，知更鸟开始在阳光洒照的卧室窗外欢快地唧唧鸣叫。

items.def_zh: 用颤音唱；发颤音，用颤音说；（鸟等）啼啭
items.def_en: 1. To sing, speak, or pronounce a consonant with a vibrating warbling sound; to produce a continuous trembling sound.
items.ex_en: The soprano loved to trill high notes gracefully before the spellbound royal audience.
items.ex_zh: 女高音歌唱家极喜在着了迷的皇室观众面前优雅地演唱颤音高音。

items.def_en: To sing in a gentle, melodic, and warbling manner with rapid pitch variations
items.ex_en: Larks would warble sweet melodies from high above the blooming summer meadows.
items.ex_zh: 云雀在盛开的夏日草甸上空展喉，啼唱出甜美婉转的旋律。

items.def_zh: 用真假声交替歌唱（约德尔唱法）
items.def_en: To sing by continually alternating between an ordinary voice and a high falsetto
items.ex_en: The Alpine guide began to yodel across the valley to signal clear weather.
items.ex_zh: 高山向导开始越过山谷引吭用真假声交替歌唱，示意天气转晴。

groups.summary_en: Denotes vocalizing with rapid pitch fluctuations, vibrating tongue/palate motions, or high musical undulations typical of birds and skilled vocalists.
groups.summary_zh: 指快速变音、舌音颤动或宛转如鸟语般的婉转歌鸣之声。
groups.desc_en: Producing high-pitched, fluctuating, or melodic vocalizations, differing from generic singing or speaking by foregrounding rapid pitch shifts, avian timbre, or acoustic ornamentation.
groups.desc_zh: 发出尖锐、颤动或悠扬的曲调性声音，与普通歌唱或说话的区别在于强调音高的快速波动、鸟鸣音色或声音修饰。
groups.nuance_en: pipe up: suddenly speak in a thin or shrill voice (interruption / child / dissenter) · chirp: emit a short, cheerful, high-pitched utterance (sparrow / greeting / reply) · trill: produce rapid, vibratory high-frequency oscillation (canary / laughter / voice) · warble: sing with continuous, gentle melodic variation (thrush / singer / brook) · yodel: sing alternating rapidly between normal voice and falsetto (mountaineer / tune / cry)
groups.nuance_zh: pipe up: 突然尖声插话或发声 (interruption / child / dissenter) · chirp: 发出清脆欢快的短音 (sparrow / greeting / reply) · trill: 发出快速震颤的高频音 (canary / laughter / voice) · warble: 柔和悠扬地鸣唱婉转曲调 (thrush / singer / brook) · yodel: 真假声快速交替啼唱 (mountaineer / tune / cry)

groups.name: Trip & Stumble · 绊倒与踉跄 (Trip, Stumble, Falter, Tumble)
groups.tip: 失足绊脚跌跌撞撞

items.def_zh: 绊倒，绊；绊倒某人；轻快地走；失误，犯错
items.def_en: 1. To catch one's foot on something and stumble or fall, or cause someone to do so. 2. To walk or move with light, quick steps. 3. To make a mistake, or cause someone to make a mistake.
items.ex_en: The runner managed not to trip over loose gravel during the downhill sprint.
items.ex_zh: 在下坡冲刺阶段，这名奔跑者设法避免了被松散的碎石绊倒。
items.ex2_en: The thick exposed tree root tripped the unwary hiker on the path.
items.ex2_zh: 粗大裸露的树根将小路上粗心大意的徒步者绊倒了。

items.def_en: To walk unsteadily or pause hesitantly as if on the verge of falling
items.ex_en: Exhausted after the march, the wounded soldier began to falter on the slope.
items.ex_zh: 长途行军后精疲力竭的受伤士兵在山坡上开始步履踉跄。

items.def_en: To knock one's foot against an obstacle and stumble or lose balance as a direct consequence
