items.ex_en: She was so distracted that she almost managed to trip over the cord.
items.ex_zh: 她心不在焉，险些被地上的电线绊倒。

items.def_en: (+ over/on) To hit one's foot against something while walking or running, losing balance and nearly falling
items.ex_en: Tired hikers often stumble over exposed tree roots concealed beneath wet autumn leaves.
items.ex_zh: 疲惫的徒步者经常被湿润秋叶下裸露的树根绊得踉跄不稳。

items.def_en: To fall suddenly, awkwardly, or violently, often rolling headlong downward
items.ex_en: The clumsy acrobat managed to tumble off the wooden platform onto safety mats.
items.ex_zh: 那名笨拙的杂技演员竟从木制平台上狼狈摔落到了安全垫上。

groups.summary_en: Captures catching one's foot on an obstruction or losing equilibrium, resulting in unsteady, clumsy stepping or a sudden fall. 'Stumble' highlights momentary loss of balance, while 'trip over' denotes the triggering contact.
groups.summary_zh: 指足部受阻绊顿或失去平衡导致的一过性踉跄或跌倒动作。
groups.desc_en: Losing physical or figurative balance due to an obstacle or momentary failure of control, differing from outright falling by emphasizing the intervening loss of footing or momentum.
groups.desc_zh: 因障碍物或瞬间失去控制而丧失物理或隐喻上的平衡，与直接摔倒的区别在于强调失足或动能失衡的中间过程。
groups.nuance_en: trip: catch one's foot and lose footing (curb / wire / step) · falter: stumble in motion or lose resolve (stride / voice / resolve) · trip over: physically stumble across an impediment (cord / root / threshold) · stumble: unsteadily stagger or blunder forward (rock / rhythm / explanation) · tumble: fall suddenly and roll helplessly (downhill / ruins / shares)
groups.nuance_zh: trip: 绊到障碍物而失足 (curb / wire / step) · falter: 步伐踉跄或意志动摇停滞 (stride / voice / resolve) · trip over: 被具体物品绊脚 (cord / root / threshold) · stumble: 跌跌撞撞或步履迟疑 (rock / rhythm / explanation) · tumble: 骤然跌倒翻滚下坠 (downhill / ruins / shares)

groups.name: Troll & Bait · 煽动与挑衅 (Troll, Bait, Goad)
groups.tip: 从言语挑逗到蓄意煽动事端

items.def_en: To deliberately say things that tease or annoy someone to get a rise out of them
items.ex_en: He only said those outrageous things to wind up his younger brother intentionally.
items.ex_zh: 他说那些离谱的话纯粹是为了故意逗弄并激怒他的弟弟。

items.def_zh: （在网上）发挑衅言论，故意引战；拖钓
items.def_en: 1. (internet) To post deliberately offensive or provocative messages online to upset people and cause arguments. 2. To fish by trailing a baited line behind a boat
items.ex_en: Mischievous anonymous users frequently troll public comment sections just to provoke heated arguments.
items.ex_zh: 恶作剧的匿名用户经常在公开评论区恶意挑衅引战，纯粹为了挑起激烈争论。

items.def_en: To intentionally provoke or tease someone to make them react angrily or carelessly
items.ex_en: The defense attorney tried hard to bait the witness into an angry outburst.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师极力挑衅证人，企图诱使他在法庭上愤怒失控。

items.def_en: To deliberately provoke or bring about a dispute, conflict, or negative reaction
items.ex_en: Radical activists attempted to instigate a riot during the peaceful municipal demonstration yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 激进活动分子昨天试图在原本和平的市政示威活动中挑起暴乱。

items.def_zh: 刺激，激励（促成激烈反应）
items.def_en: (+ into) To keep irritating or provoking someone until they react, often violently
items.ex_en: Hostile rivals tried to goad him into an impulsive and ruinous physical confrontation.
items.ex_zh: 心怀敌意的对手试图激怒他，诱使他卷入一场冲动且毁灭性的肢体冲突。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures maliciously or playfully provoking others—frequently online or in discourse—with deliberate hostility, taunts, or inflammatory remarks intended purely to elicit an emotional, irrational outburst.
groups.summary_zh: 指特意通过挑衅言论、设套或嘲弄来激怒他人以引出失控反应。
groups.desc_en: Deliberately provoking emotional distress, anger, or reactive behavior, contrasting with playful teasing by its targeted malice, manipulation, or disruptive intent.
groups.desc_zh: 故意挑衅以诱发他人愤怒、窘迫或冲动反应，与善意开玩笑的区别在于其蓄意的情感操纵和破坏性意图。
groups.nuance_en: wind up: systematically irritate to elicit a reaction (sibling / rival / opponent) · troll: bait online with disruptive or offensive remarks (forum / users / thread) · bait: deliberately lure someone into an angry trap (critic / witness / opponent) · instigate: incite or initiate conflict from behind the scenes (riot / dispute / rebellion) · goad: continuously prod or provoke into rash action (competitor / animal / ego)
groups.nuance_zh: wind up: 故意反复惹恼以引人发作 (sibling / rival / opponent) · troll: 在网络上故意发恶评挑衅 (forum / users / thread) · bait: 故意设套诱人中计或发怒 (critic / witness / opponent) · instigate: 暗中煽动或挑起争端 (riot / dispute / rebellion) · goad: 不断刺激或驱使某人做出过激行为 (competitor / animal / ego)

groups.name: Truncate & Curtail · 截断与缩短 (Clip, Curtail, Lop off)
groups.tip: 砍去尾部使长度减少

items.def_en: To cut off the edge, end, or small parts of something with shears or scissors
items.ex_en: The gardener used shears to clip the untidy edges of the boxwood hedge.
items.ex_zh: 园丁用大剪刀修剪了黄杨树篱杂乱不齐的边缘。

items.def_en: To cut away dead or overgrown branches, or trim back unwanted sections to reduce size
items.ex_en: Orchard workers must prune overgrown apple branches before the winter freeze sets in.
items.ex_zh: 果园工人必须在冬令霜冻来临前修剪掉多余蔓生的苹果树枝。

items.def_en: To reduce the duration, extent, or scope of an activity or privilege
items.ex_en: The university had to curtail campus research expenditures due to substantial state cutbacks.
items.ex_zh: 由于州政府大幅削减拨款，该大学不得不缩减校园科研支出。

items.def_en: To make something shorter, especially by cutting off the top, end, or a section.
items.ex_en: The editor decided to truncate the lengthy manuscript by removing three redundant chapters.
items.ex_zh: 编辑决定删去三个多余章节，从而删短这部冗长的书稿。

items.def_en: To chop or sever an extremity, branch, or section cleanly from something
items.ex_en: The arborist had to lop off the rotting branch before it hit powerlines.
items.ex_zh: 树艺师必须在腐烂的树枝砸到高压电线之前将其截断砍掉。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe shortening the length, duration, or extent of an object, process, or text by lopping off an extremity or imposing a cutoff.
groups.summary_zh: 指削去末端、强行截断或缩减长度与期限的动词群。
groups.desc_en: Shortening, lopping, or reducing an object, duration, or process, differing from plain cutting by emphasizing abrupt, premature, or corrective termination.
groups.desc_zh: 切削、截除或缩短物体、时长或进程，与普通切割的区别在于强调非正常终止、过早截断或纠正性削减。
groups.nuance_en: clip: trim edges or snip off small portions (hedge / coupon / wings) · prune: selectively cut back for efficiency or growth (budget / branches / workforce) · curtail: restrict or shorten duration and scope prematurely (rights / spending / speech) · truncate: terminate by cutting off top, end, or data prematurely (text / pyramid / process) · lop off: sever completely with a single forceful strike (limb / branch / head)
groups.nuance_zh: clip: 修剪边缘或剪下微小部分 (hedge / coupon / wings) · prune: 精简冗余以促效益 (budget / branches / workforce) · curtail: 提前削减或限制规模时长 (rights / spending / speech) · truncate: 截断尾端或强行终止 (text / pyramid / process) · lop off: 强力砍掉或一刀切除 (limb / branch / head)

groups.name: Trust & Confide · 信任与信赖 (Believe In, Confide In, Credit)
groups.tip: 对他人寄托信任与心理倚赖

items.def_zh: 信任，信赖，相信；指望，依靠；托付
items.def_en: 1. to believe in the reliability, honesty, or ability of someone or something. 2. to place something valuable in someone's care.
items.ex_en: Investors must trust the audited financial reports before committing substantial capital to ventures.
items.ex_zh: 投资者在向风投项目注入大笔资金之前，必须信赖经审计的财务报告。

items.def_en: To accept something as true or treat a person's words as trustworthy
items.ex_en: Seasoned detectives refused to credit the suspect's far-fetched alibi without solid corroborating evidence.
items.ex_zh: 在缺乏确凿佐证的情况下，经验老道的刑警们拒绝相信嫌疑人那牵强的托辞。

items.def_en: To share personal secrets or feelings with someone whom you trust completely
items.ex_en: She felt secure enough to confide in her mentor about her deepest career anxieties.
items.ex_zh: 她感到十分踏实，便向导师倾吐了自己对职业生涯最深层的焦虑。

items.def_en: To feel confident that someone is reliable, capable, or has honest intentions
items.ex_en: The board members firmly believe in his integrity and outstanding leadership during this crisis.
items.ex_zh: 董事会成员坚信他在应对这场危机时的正直为人与卓越领导力。

items.def_en: To completely believe, trust, and accept an idea, plan, or person's claims
items.ex_en: I simply refuse to buy into his absurd get-rich-quick schemes anymore.
items.ex_zh: 我绝不再相信他那些荒谬的快速暴富把戏了。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the psychological state of having unwavering faith in someone's integrity, truthfulness, benevolence, or loyalty, often extending to sharing private vulnerabilities.
groups.summary_zh: 指对他人人品、诚意或誓言抱有由衷确信，乃至托付隐秘或重托。
groups.desc_en: Placing reliance, epistemic faith, or personal vulnerability in someone or something, differing from casual liking by entailing perceived dependability and risk-bearing.
groups.desc_zh: 对人或事物寄托依赖、认知信任或袒露脆弱，与单纯喜欢的区别在于包含对可靠性的确信和承担风险的意愿。
groups.nuance_en: trust: rely completely upon honesty and integrity (partner / judgment / instincts) · credit: attribute credibility or acknowledge validity (source / story / explanation) · confide in: entrust personal secrets and vulnerabilities (friend / mentor / diary) · believe in: hold deep conviction regarding worth or existence (ideals / potential / God) · buy into: accept and support an idea uncritically (hype / philosophy / theory)
groups.nuance_zh: trust: 全然相信其诚实与能力 (partner / judgment / instincts) · credit: 认可其真实性或归功于 (source / story / explanation) · confide in: 向其袒露私密或托付心事 (friend / mentor / diary) · believe in: 笃信其价值、潜力或存在 (ideals / potential / God) · buy into: 盲目接受或信服某种说法 (hype / philosophy / theory)

groups.name: Try & Adjudicate · 审理与裁决 (Try, Hear, Adjudicate)
groups.tip: 法庭重新审理并作出裁判

items.def_en: To examine evidence in court and decide whether someone is guilty of a crime
items.ex_en: The crown court will try the suspect for armed robbery next Tuesday morning.
items.ex_zh: 巡回刑事法院将于下周二上午审理该嫌犯的持械抢劫案。

items.def_en: To listen to and evaluate formal legal evidence, witnesses, and arguments in a trial
items.ex_en: A panel of appellate judges met yesterday to hear complex arguments regarding patent infringement.
items.ex_zh: 上诉法官审判小组昨日开庭，审理了涉及专利侵权的复杂辩论。

items.def_en: To act as a judge in a dispute or make a formal decision about a legal problem
items.ex_en: An independent tribunal was appointed to adjudicate the contentious maritime boundary dispute.
items.ex_zh: 一个独立法庭获指派来正式裁决这起极具争议的海洋边界争端。

items.def_en: To act as an impartial referee to settle a dispute between two dissenting parties
items.ex_en: A retired judge agreed to arbitrate the bitter commercial dispute between the two companies.
items.ex_zh: 一位退休法官同意出面仲裁这两家公司之间激烈的商业争端。

items.def_en: To hear or try a legal case again in a court of law.
items.ex_en: The appellate court granted the motion to rehear the landmark constitutional case next month.
items.ex_zh: 上诉法院准许了下月重新审理这起具有里程碑意义的宪法案件的动议。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this legal frame describe the official examination of evidence, arguments, and testimony in a judicial forum to resolve a dispute or determine legal liability.
groups.summary_zh: 在法庭或司法程序中审理案情并做出裁决。
groups.desc_en: Formally investigating, evaluating, and issuing binding judgment on a legal dispute, differing from general evaluation by adhering to official jurisdiction and jurisprudence.
groups.desc_zh: 依司法管辖与法定程序对争议进行正式审理并做出裁决，与一般评价的区别在于具有法定约束力和法律效力。
groups.nuance_en: try: conduct formal courtroom examination of guilt (defendant / case / criminal) · hear: officially listen to evidence and arguments (appeal / testimony / grievance) · adjudicate: act as formal judge to settle a dispute (claim / dispute / matter) · arbitrate: resolve a dispute between parties as an impartial mediator (strike / wage / conflict) · rehear: examine an adjudicated case anew (appeal / lawsuit / motion)
groups.nuance_zh: try: 在法庭上正式审讯某人或审理案件 (defendant / case / criminal) · hear: 正式听取证词与诉求 (appeal / testimony / grievance) · adjudicate: 依法裁决或判决争议 (claim / dispute / matter) · arbitrate: 作为中立第三方仲裁纠纷 (strike / wage / conflict) · rehear: 依法重新复审已判案件 (appeal / lawsuit / motion)

groups.name: Try Again & Reattempt · 重试与再次努力 (Reattempt, Have Another Go, Revisit)
groups.tip: 付诸行动再次开展试验努力

items.def_en: to make another attempt to accomplish or complete something that was previously unsuccessful
items.ex_en: The engineers will reattempt the delicate satellite docking procedure early tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 工程师们将于明晨重新尝试这一精密的卫星对接程序。

items.def_en: (+ at) to try doing something again after an initial attempt
items.ex_en: Take a short rest and then have another go at that difficult puzzle.
items.ex_zh: 先歇一会儿，然后对那道难题再试一次吧。

items.def_en: to test someone or something a second or subsequent time to verify results or performance
items.ex_en: The laboratory technicians must retest the blood samples to confirm the preliminary diagnosis.
items.ex_zh: 实验室技术人员必须重新测试这些血液样本以确认初步诊断。

items.def_zh: 再碰一次运气；重新试一试
items.def_en: (+ at) to undertake a fresh attempt at a task or challenge, especially in informal speech
items.ex_en: He decided to have another crack at the notoriously difficult licensing exam next autumn.
items.ex_zh: 他决定明年秋天对那场出了名难考的执照考试再碰一次运气。

items.def_zh: 再试，重新尝试；（法律）重审，再审
items.def_en: 1. to attempt or try doing something again. 2. (law) to try a defendant or legal case a second time in court.
items.ex_en: The prosecutor announced his decision to retry the defendant following the sudden mistrial.
items.ex_zh: 在审判意外流审后，检察官宣布决定再次起诉审判该被告。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame center on repeating an effort or initiating a second attempt after an initial failure, pause, or legal review.
groups.summary_zh: 指在经历失败或中断后重新尝试、再作努力或二次审查。
groups.desc_en: Initiating a repeated effort after prior incompletion or failure, differing from the original attempt by building upon existing familiarity, frustration, or recalibration.
groups.desc_zh: 在经历未完成或失败后再次发起尝试，与初次尝试的区别在于带有对前次经验的校准、熟悉或执念。
groups.nuance_en: reattempt: make a formal new effort after failure (exam / climb / challenge) · have another go: try informally once more (puzzle / shot / task) · retest: test again to verify stability or accuracy (sample / system / hypothesis) · have another crack: take an energetic, colloquial fresh attempt (record / safe / project) · retry: execute an attempt again, often systematically (connection / transaction / action)
groups.nuance_zh: reattempt: 在受挫后发起正式的再次尝试 (exam / climb / challenge) · have another go: 口语化地再试一次 (puzzle / shot / task) · retest: 为确认结果或排错再次检测 (sample / system / hypothesis) · have another crack: 充满干劲地重新发起冲击 (record / safe / project) · retry: 尤指系统或机制性地重新执行 (connection / transaction / action)

groups.name: Twiddle & Idle Manipulation · 摆弄与闲转 (Twirl, Toy with, Diddle)
groups.tip: 无意识转动手指摆弄小物件

items.def_en: To keep touching or moving something nervously and restlessly with one's fingers
items.ex_en: Throughout the stressful interview, he continued to fidget with his cufflinks quite visibly.
items.ex_zh: 在整个紧张的面试过程中，他一直十分显眼地坐立难安地摆弄着袖扣。

items.def_en: To touch, stroke, or manipulate an object absent-mindedly or without serious purpose
items.ex_en: She continued to toy with her silver pendant while listening to the lecture.
items.ex_zh: 她一边听讲座，一边漫不经心地把玩着自己的银质吊坠。

items.def_en: To turn something round and round quickly, especially with light finger movements
items.ex_en: She began to twirl a strand of hair nervously during the awkward pause.
items.ex_zh: 在尴尬的沉默中，她开始神经质地快速卷弄着一缕头发。
items.ex2_en: The colorful autumn leaves twirled gently through the chilly afternoon mountain breeze.
items.ex2_zh: 色彩斑斓的秋叶在清冷的午后山风中轻盈旋转。

items.def_en: To turn or twist something around restlessly or idly with the fingers.
items.ex_en: He sat idly in the waiting room and started to twiddle his thumbs.
items.ex_zh: 他无所事事地坐在候诊室里，开始闲得转弄起大拇指来。

items.def_en: To pass time idly moving, turning, or playing with small mechanisms or objects
items.ex_en: Stop diddling with the thermostat dial before you accidentally break the delicate mechanism.
items.ex_zh: 别再乱拨弄温控器旋钮了，省得不小心把精细结构弄坏。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses idle, unconscious, or restless manual manipulation where small objects or body parts are spun, rotated, or trifled with without constructive intent.
groups.summary_zh: 指百无聊赖或紧张时，用手指漫不经心地捻弄、转动或把玩小物件。
groups.desc_en: Aimlessly or absentmindedly manipulating small objects, differing from purposeful handling or repair by being driven by restlessness, boredom, or casual curiosity.
groups.desc_zh: 无目的或心不在焉地拨弄小物件，与有目的的操作或修理的区别在于纯粹源于无聊、焦躁或下意识的消遣。
groups.nuance_en: fidget with: nervously handle small items out of unease (pen / button / ring) · toy with: manipulate idly or ponder half-heartedly (food / idea / pendant) · twirl: spin rapidly between fingers or on an axis (mustache / hair / baton) · twiddle: rotate or turn around repeatedly with thumbs (thumbs / knobs / dials) · diddle: tamper aimlessly or waste time fiddling (controls / lock / gadget)
groups.nuance_zh: fidget with: 因局促或焦虑而摆弄小物件 (pen / button / ring) · toy with: 漫不经心地摆弄或试探性考虑 (food / idea / pendant) · twirl: 在指尖轻快地转动或打旋 (mustache / hair / baton) · twiddle: 漫无目的地转动双拇指或旋钮 (thumbs / knobs / dials) · diddle: 瞎鼓捣或磨洋工式乱动 (controls / lock / gadget)

groups.name: Twist & Contort · 扭曲与变形 (Contort, Deform, Warp)
groups.tip: 反向扭动使其形变

items.def_en: To squeeze or twist the facial muscles tightly together in reaction to pain, sunlight, disgust, or effort
items.ex_en: The child began to screw up his face in disgust at the medicine.
items.ex_zh: 那孩子厌恶地把整张脸皱成一团，抗拒咽下这剂苦药。

items.def_en: To become bent, twisted, or uneven, especially of wood or plastic damaged by heat, damp, or age
items.ex_en: The damp basement caused the antique wooden floorboards to warp over the winter.
items.ex_zh: 潮湿的地下室导致那块老式实木地板在冬天翘曲变形了。
items.ex2_en: Excessive moisture and scorching sun warped the unvarnished wooden fence boards severely.
items.ex2_zh: 过多的水分和烈日的暴晒使未上漆的木栅栏板严重翘曲。

items.def_en: To twist or bend out of its normal shape, or cause the face or body to twist in an unnatural way.
items.ex_en: Severe muscle spasms caused his limbs to contort into painful, unnatural positions.
items.ex_zh: 严重的肌肉痉挛致使他的四肢痛苦地扭曲成不自然的姿态。
items.ex2_en: Bitter agonizing grief contorted her lovely facial features into a painful mask.
items.ex2_zh: 痛苦不堪的悲伤扭曲了她秀丽的面容，使其宛如痛苦的面具。

items.def_en: To bend, warp, or collapse under excessive pressure, extreme heat, or heavy weight
items.ex_en: The old steel support beams began to buckle under the immense warehouse weight.
items.ex_zh: 在仓库沉重的压力之下，陈旧的钢制支撑梁开始扭曲变形垮陷。
items.ex2_en: Heavy seismic vibrations buckled the reinforced concrete pillars supporting the old overpass.
items.ex2_zh: 强烈的地震震动使支撑旧立交桥的钢筋混凝土柱发生了压屈变形。

items.def_en: To spoil or distort the normal shape or structure of something through pressure, heat, or injury
items.ex_en: Extreme hydraulic pressure will deform the metal casing if safety limits are exceeded.
items.ex_zh: 若超出安全极限，极高的液压将会使金属外壳发生严重变形。
items.ex2_en: Soft clay figures deform easily under warm indoor temperatures without protective kiln-firing.
items.ex2_zh: 未经窑炉烧制保护的软泥人偶在温暖的室内温度下极易变形。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote twisting, bending, or forcing physical objects, the face, or the body into an unnatural, grotesque, or disfigured shape.
groups.summary_zh: 指物体或身体部位受外力或痛苦挤压而呈现畸形怪样。
groups.desc_en: Subjecting an entity's physical geometry or appearance to unnatural bending or twisting, differing from breaking by preserving physical continuity while distorting true shape.
groups.desc_zh: 使物体的几何形态或外观遭受非自然的弯曲、扭曲，与折断的区别在于保持连续性的同时破坏了原本的规整状态。
groups.nuance_en: screw up: squeeze or distort out of disgust or strain (face / paper / eyes) · warp: distort through heat, moisture, or bias (timber / perspective / floorboards) · contort: twist violently into unnatural, grotesque shapes (body / features / posture) · buckle: collapse or crumple under compressive stress (knees / metal / bridge) · deform: permanently alter standard physical shape (metal / skeleton / structure)
groups.nuance_zh: screw up: 挤眉弄眼扭曲或揉作一团 (face / paper / eyes) · warp: 因湿热受潮或偏见而翘曲走样 (timber / perspective / floorboards) · contort: 剧烈扭曲成痛苦或怪异姿态 (body / features / posture) · buckle: 承受重压而屈曲瘫软 (knees / metal / bridge) · deform: 使既有结构发生永久性畸变 (metal / skeleton / structure)

groups.name: Twist & Wrench · 拧拉与扭损 (Wrench, Yank, Wrest)
groups.tip: 施加旋转扭力甚至猛拧

items.def_en: To injure a joint by suddenly and painfully stretching or tearing the ligaments around it
items.ex_en: She managed to sprain her left ankle while hiking along the rugged trail.
items.ex_zh: 她在崎岖的小径上徒步时不慎扭伤了左脚踝的韧带。

items.def_en: To tear or wrench something away from where it is attached with fierce physical force
items.ex_en: Unsuspecting tourists are often ripped off by unlicensed taxi operators.
items.ex_zh: 毫无防备的游客经常被无照出租车司机敲竹杠。

items.def_en: 1. To pull or twist something violently away from its fixed position. 2. To injure a joint by suddenly twisting it.
items.ex_en: He managed to wrench the rusted crowbar from the locked storage cabinet.
items.ex_zh: 他使劲猛力一扭，从锁着的储物柜上猛拽下了生锈的撬棍。

items.def_en: To pull someone or something with a sudden, forceful, sharp tug
items.ex_en: He gave the stubborn emergency cord a sudden yank to halt the train.
items.ex_zh: 他猛拽了一下卡紧的应急拉绳，使列车紧急停了下来。

items.def_en: (+ from) To pull, twist, or force something away from another's grasp with deliberate violent effort
items.ex_en: The brave soldier managed to wrest the loaded weapon from the panicked captor.
items.ex_zh: 英勇的士兵设法从惊慌失措的劫持者手中强行夺下了上了膛的武器。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame convey applying sudden, forceful rotary or pulling leverage to tear an object from its setting or violently sprain a biological joint.
groups.summary_zh: 指施加爆发性旋拉力量强行挣脱、拔离或致使关节扭伤。
groups.desc_en: Applying forceful, abrupt torsion or traction to pull or dislodge something, differing from smooth pulling by its violent leverage and potential for physical damage.
groups.desc_zh: 施加暴力的扭转或拉拽力量以强行拔除或脱位，与平缓拉动的区别在于其突发性、杠杆力和伴随的损伤风险。
groups.nuance_en: sprain: violently twist a ligament without dislocation (ankle / wrist / joint) · rip off: tear away violently or exploit unfairly (label / consumer / band-aid) · wrench: violently twist and pull from a fixed position (pipe / arm / steering) · yank: pull with a sharp, abrupt, forceful jerk (cord / leash / door) · wrest: forcibly twist away control or possession against resistance (gun / power / control)
groups.nuance_zh: sprain: 扭伤韧带或关节 (ankle / wrist / joint) · rip off: 猛力撕扯下来或欺诈剥削 (label / consumer / band-aid) · wrench: 猛力拧转并抽离 (pipe / arm / steering) · yank: 猛烈顿拉或猝然猛扯 (cord / leash / door) · wrest: 强行从他人手中夺取或力克争得 (gun / power / control)

groups.name: Twist & Writhe · 扭动与翻腾 (Twist, Writhe, Thrash)
groups.tip: 身体因痛苦挣扎而蜷曲翻转

items.def_zh: 翻腾，扭动（身体）；拧，旋转；扭曲，歪曲
items.def_en: 1. To bend or turn the body or a part of it, especially repeatedly or in pain. 2. To turn something around, or wind things together. 3. To deliberately distort or misrepresent meaning or facts.
items.ex_en: He began to twist nervously in his hard wooden seat during the lecture.
items.ex_zh: 讲座期间，他神色紧张地在那把硬木椅子上坐立不安地扭动着身体。

items.def_en: To wave or swing arms or legs around wildly and erratically without control
items.ex_en: The panicking swimmer began to flail his arms frantically against the powerful current.
items.ex_zh: 惊慌失措的游泳者面对湍急的水流开始胡乱挥舞手臂拼命挣扎。
items.ex2_en: Broken electric cables flailed erratically across the wet street after the storm.
items.ex2_zh: 暴风雨过后，断裂的电缆在湿漉漉的街道上无规则地甩动。

items.def_en: (+ about/around) To flail, kick, or move one's limbs violently and uncontrollably in wild struggle
items.ex_en: The feverish child began to thrash about wildly beneath the tangled bedsheets.
items.ex_zh: 发着高烧的孩子在凌乱纠缠的床单下狂乱地辗转抽打挣扎。

items.def_en: (+ in/with) To twist and roll one's body continuously from side to side in violent physical pain or agony
items.ex_en: The wounded knight lay upon the muddy ground to writhe in agony.
items.ex_zh: 负伤的骑士倒在泥泞的土地上，因剧痛而辗转翻滚。

items.def_en: To shake or twist violently and uncontrollably due to seizure, agony, or intense emotion
items.ex_en: His entire body began to convulse violently as the sudden epileptic seizure struck.
items.ex_zh: 随着癫痫骤然发作，他的整个身躯开始剧烈地抽搐痉挛。
items.ex2_en: Uncontrollable hysterical laughter convulsed the playful children throughout the long theatrical performance.
items.ex2_zh: 在漫长的戏剧表演过程中，难以克制的狂笑让爱玩的孩子们前仰后合。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures intense, convulsive, or agonized twisting and rolling motions of the entire body or limbs, commonly triggered by excruciating pain, distress, or physical struggle.
groups.summary_zh: 表示躯体因剧烈痛苦或挣扎而剧烈翻腾、辗转扭曲。
groups.desc_en: Undergoing violent, continuous serpentine or spastic body movements, differing from controlled motion by reflecting extreme agony, captivity, or involuntary distress.
groups.desc_zh: 身体持续进行剧烈的蛇形扭动或痉挛抽搐，与受控动作的区别在于体现出极度的痛苦、挣扎或不由自主的痉挛。
groups.nuance_en: twist: rotate or coil the body defensively (torso / posture / snake) · flail: wave limbs erratically and out of control (arms / legs / drowning) · thrash: beat or toss violently against a surface (water / bed / opponent) · writhe: twist and squirm in sustained intense agony (pain / agony / ground) · convulse: shake uncontrollably with violent involuntary spasms (body / laughter / seizure)
groups.nuance_zh: twist: 身体局部扭转或回旋 (torso / posture / snake) · flail: 四肢无助而狂乱地挥舞 (arms / legs / drowning) · thrash: 剧烈挣扎击打水面或床铺 (water / bed / opponent) · writhe: 因极度痛苦而持续在地上翻滚打滚 (pain / agony / ground) · convulse: 剧烈抽搐或痉挛震颤 (body / laughter / seizure)

groups.name: Twitch & Quirk · 微动与挑弄 (Quirk, Twitch, Arched Curvature)
groups.tip: 物体受力拧转改变形状

items.def_en: To tilt or raise a part of the body, especially an eyebrow or head, upward or to one side inquisitively
items.ex_en: The curious terrier would cock its head inquisitively whenever it heard a whistle.
items.ex_zh: 那只好奇的梗犬每当听到口哨声，就会探询地歪起小脑袋。

items.def_en: To curve an eyebrow or body part upward into an arched shape to express surprise or disbelief
items.ex_en: The professor paused only to arch an eyebrow in disbelief at the claim.
items.ex_zh: 教授停顿了一下，只是难以置信地挑高了一侧眉毛以对该言论表示怀疑。
items.ex2_en: Her expressive dark eyebrows arched gracefully in quiet amusement at his humorous remark.
items.ex2_zh: 听到他幽默的话语，她那灵动的黑眉毛优雅地上挑，露出会心的微笑。

items.def_en: To curve upward or backward, especially of a lip expressing amusement, scorn, or contempt
items.ex_en: A subtle sneer caused his upper lip to curl in open disdain.
items.ex_zh: 一丝轻蔑的冷笑使得他的上唇讥讽地微微卷起。
items.ex2_en: The bitter biting irony curled his lips into a cold deliberate sneer.
items.ex2_zh: 辛辣刺骨的嘲讽使他的嘴角泛起一丝冰冷而蓄意的冷笑。

items.def_en: To make a short, sudden, involuntary jerking movement, especially of a muscle or facial feature
items.ex_en: Stress caused his tired left eyelid to twitch uncontrollably throughout the meeting.
items.ex_zh: 巨大的压力使他疲惫的左眼皮在整场会议期间止不住地抽动。
items.ex2_en: Nervous exhaustion twitched the corners of his mouth during the difficult interview.
items.ex2_zh: 在艰难的面试过程中，精神疲惫使得他的嘴角微微抽搐。

items.def_en: To twist or curve suddenly, especially of someone's mouth or eyebrows in response to an emotion.
items.ex_en: An amused smile caused the corner of her lips to quirk slightly upward.
items.ex_zh: 一抹被逗乐的微笑使得她的唇角微微向上挑起。
items.ex2_en: Suppressed silent amusement quirked his mouth into an ironic lopsided grin.
items.ex2_zh: 难以抑制的暗笑使他的嘴角微微翘起，露出一抹讽刺的歪笑。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures quick, subtle, and often asymmetric movements of facial features—such as eyebrows or lips—that convey irony, skepticism, amusement, or nervous tension.
groups.summary_zh: 描摹面容局部轻巧、不对称的抽动挑起，多表疑虑或戏谑。
groups.desc_en: Executing minute, subtle, or sudden involuntary contractions of facial features, differing from full expressions by conveying fleeting irony, tension, or curiosity.
groups.desc_zh: 面部或肌肉发生微小、突发或下意识的抽动与挑弄，与完整面部表情的区别在于其短暂性，常流露出机敏、讽刺或紧绷。
groups.nuance_en: cock: tilt or angle sharply upward in inquisitiveness (head / ear / eyebrow) · arch: curve upward deliberately to signal skepticism (eyebrows / back / spine) · curl: curve subtly upward in disdain or amusement (lip / mouth / toes) · twitch: jerk with brief, involuntary spasmodic micro-motion (muscle / eyelid / whiskers) · quirk: curve or lift with dry irony or amusement (eyebrow / mouth / smile)
groups.nuance_zh: cock: 偏转或警觉地挑起 (head / ear / eyebrow) · arch: 刻意挑高起弧度以示怀疑或高傲 (eyebrows / back / spine) · curl: 嘴角微撇挑起以示轻蔑或玩味 (lip / mouth / toes) · twitch: 肌肉或眼睑不由自主地短促抽动 (muscle / eyelid / whiskers) · quirk: 略带戏谑意味地微妙牵动 (eyebrow / mouth / smile)

groups.name: Unclog & Clear · 疏通与解堵 (Unblock, Unclog, Free)
groups.tip: 排清淤塞恢复管路畅通

items.def_en: To free a route, pipe, or space of whatever blocks, clutters, or obstructs it
items.ex_en: The snowplow worked through the blizzard to clear the main mountain highway completely.
items.ex_zh: 除雪车冒着暴风雪作业，彻底扫清了山区主干道上的积雪障碍。
items.ex2_en: The gloomy morning sky cleared rapidly once brisk coastal winds blew across.
items.ex2_zh: 一旦轻快的海风吹过，阴沉的清晨天空便迅速放晴了。

items.def_en: To release something from an obstruction so that movement or access can occur freely
items.ex_en: The plumber used a high-pressure snake to free up the jammed drainage pipe.
items.ex_zh: 水管工使用高压通管器疏通了被卡住的排水管道。

items.def_zh: 冲洗疏通；清除积垢或杂质
items.def_en: To forcefully flush out or clear an unwanted blockage or impurity from a pipe or system
items.ex_en: Technicians must purge the cooling pipes of chemical sediment before restarting the reactor.
items.ex_zh: 在重启反应堆之前，技术人员必须冲洗管道以清除其中的化学积垢。

items.def_zh: 疏通，清除……的堵塞；解除封锁
items.def_en: To remove an obstacle or barrier from a pipe, passage, or account so that movement or access is restored.
items.ex_en: City workers arrived promptly to unblock the flooded storm drain after the storm.
items.ex_zh: 暴雨过后，市政工人迅速赶来疏通被落叶淤塞的雨水排水渠。

items.def_en: To remove an accumulation of matter that impedes passage through a pipe, drain, or channel
items.ex_en: He poured a chemical solution down the sink to unclog the drainpipe effectively.
items.ex_zh: 他向水槽中倒入化学溶剂，从而有效地疏通了堵塞的排水管。
items.ex2_en: The blocked kitchen sink unclogged completely after hot boiling water was poured.
items.ex2_zh: 倒下滚烫的开水后，堵塞的厨房水槽完全疏通了。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate removing accumulated obstacles, detritus, or physical barriers from tubes, drains, or passageways to restore fluid movement and clear flow.
groups.summary_zh: 指清除管道或通道内的堵塞物，恢复通畅运行。
groups.desc_en: Restoring flow or transit through an obstructed conduit, differing from clean washing by specifically eliminating a physical or figurative choke point.
groups.desc_zh: 疏导通道以恢复其畅通性，与普通清洗擦拭的区别在于精准消除物理或隐喻层面的拥堵与瓶颈。
groups.nuance_en: clear: remove obstacles to open up free passage (road / throat / airway) · free up: release previously constrained space or assets (resources / memory / schedule) · purge: completely evacuate unwanted elements from a system (system / pipeline / guilt) · unblock: remove an impediment obstructing movement (drain / sink / street) · unclog: dissolve or extract dense grime causing stoppage (pipe / artery / pores)
groups.nuance_zh: clear: 移除障碍以辟出通途 (road / throat / airway) · free up: 腾出被占用的空间、时间或资源 (resources / memory / schedule) · purge: 强力排空系统中所有积压或有害残留 (system / pipeline / guilt) · unblock: 解除通道或管道的阻隔 (drain / sink / street) · unclog: 化解顽固污垢以恢复管腔畅通 (pipe / artery / pores)

groups.name: Uncork & Unseal · 开启与拔塞 (Uncork, Pop, Broach)
groups.tip: 拔开瓶塞开启封闭

items.def_zh: 打开（有塞或易拉罐的饮料）；拔塞
items.def_en: To open a bottle or can by removing the cork or tab with a popping sound
items.ex_en: The host decided to pop another bottle of champagne for the guests.
items.ex_zh: 主人决定为客人们再拔塞开启一瓶香槟。
items.ex2_en: Corn kernels pop rapidly inside the hot covered pan over medium heat.
items.ex2_zh: 在中火加热的带盖热锅中，玉米粒迅速爆裂开来。

items.def_en: To take the stopper out of a bottle or flask
items.ex_en: The apothecary carefully leaned over the table to unstopper the vintage glass vial.
items.ex_zh: 药剂师小心地俯在桌前，拔掉了那个古老玻璃药瓶的塞子。

items.def_en: To break or remove the seal of an envelope, bottle, or container
items.ex_en: The notary gathered the eager heirs to unseal the late patriarch's testament.
items.ex_zh: 公证人将急切的继承人们召集在一起，启封了老族长的遗嘱。

items.def_zh: 开启（酒桶、瓶子）；引申为提出（话题）
items.def_en: To pierce or open a cask or bottle to draw off liquid; figuratively, to raise a sensitive topic
items.ex_en: The vintner decided to broach the large oak cask for the autumn tasting.
items.ex_zh: 酿酒师决定开启那个大橡木酒桶，以备秋季品酒会之用。

items.def_zh: 拔去（瓶）塞；宣泄，发泄（感情）
items.def_en: 1. To pull the cork out of a bottle. 2. (figurative) To release strong feelings or emotions that have been held back.
items.ex_en: The lively champion proceeded to uncork the vintage prosecco in wild celebration.
items.ex_zh: 神采飞扬的冠军随后拔掉陈年普罗塞克的气泡酒塞，狂欢庆祝。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe removing stoppers, corks, or seals from containers to release liquid or contents, often extended figuratively to releasing pent-up emotions or topics.
groups.summary_zh: 拔去瓶塞、破封开瓶，或引申为释放压抑情绪。
groups.desc_en: Breaching a sealed container by removing its stopper, plug, or closure, differing from open breaking by unlocking a vessel's contained contents or pressure.
groups.desc_zh: 通过拔出塞子、封条或孔栓来开启密封容器，与粗暴打碎的区别在于释放容器的承压或使其内部液体能够流出。
groups.nuance_en: pop: open audibly by forcing out a cork under pressure (champagne / cork / top) · unstopper: pull out an inserted plug or bung (bottle / flask / vial) · unseal: break an official adhesive or legal closure (envelope / tomb / treaty) · broach: puncture or open a container to draw liquid; introduce a topic (cask / barrel / subject) · uncork: extract a bottle cork to release wine or emotion (bottle / feelings / vintage)
groups.nuance_zh: pop: 因内压发出清脆爆鸣声开塞 (champagne / cork / top) · unstopper: 拔出试管或细颈瓶的瓶塞 (bottle / flask / vial) · unseal: 启开信函、陵墓或档案的封泥印记 (envelope / tomb / treaty) · broach: 凿开桶塞倒出酒液；打破沉默引入话题 (cask / barrel / subject) · uncork: 拔开软木塞以倒酒或宣泄情感 (bottle / feelings / vintage)

groups.name: Uncouple & Estrange · 解离与隔绝 (Dissociate, Disconnect, Detach)
groups.tip: 从整体中脱钩或剥离

items.def_en: To become temporarily oblivious to one's surroundings by drifting into a daydream or daze
items.ex_en: I began to zone out during the manager's monotonous three-hour financial presentation.
items.ex_zh: 在经理长达三小时单调乏味的财务汇报中，我开始走神发呆了。

items.def_en: To separate oneself emotionally or mentally from a situation or person
items.ex_en: A seasoned emergency doctor must learn to detach emotionally from tragic patient outcomes.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的急诊医生必须学会从患者不幸的结局中保持情感上的超脱抽离。
items.ex2_en: Therapy helped him detach his intense emotions from painful childhood memories.
items.ex2_zh: 心理治疗帮助他将强烈的情感与痛苦的童年记忆分离开来。

items.def_en: To lose touch, empathy, or psychological contact with people, surroundings, or reality
items.ex_en: Burnout caused him to disconnect emotionally from his friends and immediate daily routine.
items.ex_zh: 身心俱疲导致他在情感上与朋友以及眼前的日常生活严重脱节失联。
items.ex2_en: Trauma can completely disconnect a vulnerable patient from their surrounding social environment.
items.ex2_zh: 创伤会使脆弱的病人与周围的社交环境彻底脱节。

items.def_zh: 使脱离关系，声明不赞同；使分离，使脱离；（化学）使离解
items.def_en: 1. (dissociate oneself from) To state clearly that you are not connected with or do not support a person, group, or belief. 2. To consider or treat two things as separate and unconnected.
items.ex_en: The prominent politician hastened to dissociate herself from the controversial extremist remarks.
items.ex_zh: 这位知名政客赶忙声明与那番饱受争议的极端言论脱离干系。
items.ex2_en: In moments of severe shock, the human mind can dissociate spontaneously.
items.ex2_zh: 在极度震惊的时刻，人的心智可能会自发地产生解离。

items.def_en: To cause someone to feel isolated or estranged from their environment, peers, or society
items.ex_en: His persistent arrogance began to alienate his closest colleagues and devoted team members.
items.ex_zh: 他一贯的傲慢做派逐渐使最亲密的同事和忠诚的团队成员与他疏远。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate cognitive, psychological, or state-based separation where an entity detaches its feelings, consciousness, or identity from an external event or reality.
groups.summary_zh: 指心理、意识或状态层面上抽离自我，与外界现实或情感产生割裂。
groups.desc_en: Severing an emotional, cognitive, or relational bond, differing from physical separation by leading to psychological detachment, estrangement, or social alienation.
groups.desc_zh: 割裂情感、认知或社会关联纽带，与单纯物理分离的区别在于导致心理疏离、脱节或情感隔绝。
groups.nuance_en: zone out: lose mental awareness and drift into numbness (classroom / meeting / highway) · detach: deliberately disconnect emotionally from an outcome (emotions / observer / ego) · disconnect: break a logical or functional link (device / reality / feelings) · dissociate: compartmentalize thoughts to sever mental association (trauma / identity / memory) · alienate: cause someone to become hostile or estranged (friends / voters / allies)
groups.nuance_zh: zone out: 走神放空、意识与现实脱节 (classroom / meeting / highway) · detach: 保持超然，主动隔绝情感卷入 (emotions / observer / ego) · disconnect: 切断功能性或逻辑关联 (device / reality / feelings) · dissociate: 心理机制上解离痛苦记忆或自我 (trauma / identity / memory) · alienate: 招致疏远或使他人产生排斥对抗 (friends / voters / allies)

groups.name: Uncover & Reveal · 揭露与揭示 (Uncover, Disclose, Expose)
groups.tip: 揭开掩盖探得内在真相

items.def_en: to reveal or uncover facts that had previously remained hidden or forgotten
items.ex_en: The investigative reporter worked tirelessly to bring to light the covert corporate embezzlement.
items.ex_zh: 这名调查记者不知疲倦地工作，终于揭示出了隐秘的企业侵吞公款真相。

items.def_en: to make secret or confidential information publicly or officially known
items.ex_en: The company was legally obligated to disclose the severe financial deficit immediately.
items.ex_zh: 该企业依法必须立即向公众披露严重的财政亏空状况。

items.def_zh: 发现，揭示，揭露；揭开……的盖子
items.def_en: 1. To discover or make known something secret, hidden, or unknown. 2. To remove a cover or top from something so that it can be seen.
items.ex_en: Dedicated journalists managed to uncover shocking evidence of widespread government bribery and corruption.
items.ex_zh: 敬业的记者们设法揭露了有关政府大范围受贿与贪腐的惊人证据。

items.def_en: to make known the disreputable or shocking facts about a person, institution, or scheme
items.ex_en: The documentary set out to expose the unethical labor practices of the conglomerate.
items.ex_zh: 这部纪录片旨在无情揭露这家跨国企业不合商业道德的用工黑幕。

items.def_en: to strip away all concealment and present the raw, unvarnished truth
items.ex_en: The poignant memoir served to lay bare the author's deepest personal tragedies.
items.ex_zh: 这本凄恻动人的回忆录将作者内心深处最痛苦的个人悲剧展露无遗。

groups.summary_en: Deals with bringing hidden, scandalous, or concealed information into public view, ranging from stripping away physical covers to detonating explosive public exposures.
groups.summary_zh: 指将刻意隐瞒的真相、秘密或丑闻公之于众，揭去遮蔽。
groups.desc_en: Bringing previously hidden, secret, or concealed truths into public view, differing from simple teaching by overcoming an active barrier of secrecy or concealment.
groups.desc_zh: 将原本被隐匿、掩盖或保密的真相揭示于世，与传授知识的区别在于打破了保密壁垒或拆穿了人为伪装。
groups.nuance_en: bring to light: cause hidden historical facts to be recognized (evidence / scandal / truth) · disclose: formally release confidential information (deal / identity / details) · uncover: reveal something buried or systematically hidden (plot / remains / fraud) · expose: strip away deceptive facade to display vulnerability or guilt (corruption / hypocrisy / agent) · lay bare: reveal the inner truth exhaustively and starkly (soul / mechanics / facts)
groups.nuance_zh: bring to light: 经过发掘使隐秘真相大白天下 (evidence / scandal / truth) · disclose: 官方或正式地披露私密信息 (deal / identity / details) · uncover: 发掘并揭示出被掩埋隐蔽之物 (plot / remains / fraud) · expose: 撕破伪装暴露劣迹或内情 (corruption / hypocrisy / agent) · lay bare: 彻底剥开表象，将本质赤裸裸呈现 (soul / mechanics / facts)

groups.name: Undercut & Price Below · 低价竞争与自贬 (Undersell, Undercut, Underquote)
groups.tip: 以货物换取金钱进行贸易

items.def_en: To deduct a certain amount or percentage from the regular price of an item
items.ex_en: The department store decided to discount winter coats by thirty percent this weekend.
items.ex_zh: 这家百货公司决定在本周末将冬季大衣按原价打七折出售。

items.def_en: To export or sell goods in large quantities at artificially low prices to dominate a market
items.ex_en: Foreign manufacturers conspired to dump cheap electronic components onto the domestic retail market.
items.ex_zh: 国外制造商串通一气，企图将廉价电子零件倾销至本土零售市场。

items.def_zh: 报低价，报出低于对手的价格
items.def_en: To quote an estimated price lower than that of a competitor or lower than the true cost
items.ex_en: The rogue contractor deliberately attempted to underquote rivals to secure the state tender.
items.ex_zh: 那家无良承包商故意报出低于对手的超低价格，以套取政府招标项目。

items.def_zh: 削减价格竞争，以低于……的价格出售
items.def_en: To offer goods or services at a lower price or wage than a competitor
items.ex_en: Budget airlines often undercut established carriers by eliminating costly complimentary in-flight meals.
items.ex_zh: 廉价航空公司往往通过取消昂贵的免费机上餐食，以更低票价与老牌航司竞争。

items.def_zh: 以低于竞争对手的价格出售；低估……的价值
items.def_en: 1. To sell goods or services at a lower price than a competitor. 2. ('undersell oneself') To undervalue or fail to do justice to one's own merits.
items.ex_en: Online discount retailers frequently undersell traditional brick-and-mortar shops on consumer appliances.
items.ex_zh: 在线折扣零售商在家电销售上，其价格经常比传统实体店更为便宜。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on selling goods or services at a lower price than competitors to gain market advantage, or downplaying one's own merits and skills.
groups.summary_zh: 指以低于竞争对手的价格抛售或压价竞争，亦指低估并贬低自身价值。
groups.desc_en: Pricing goods or services below a competitor or below market value, differing from broad sales promotions by aiming strategically to steal business or force rivals out.
groups.desc_zh: 以低于竞争对手或低于市价的极低价格报价与销售，与常规促销的区别在于带有抢占市场份额或挤垮竞品的掠夺性意图。
groups.nuance_en: discount: reduce the listed commercial price (rate / ticket / merchandise) · dump: sell goods overseas or in bulk below cost (surplus / steel / shares) · underquote: submit a deceptively lower cost estimate (bid / estimate / tender) · undercut: sell or offer cheaper than a direct competitor (rival / price / competitor) · undersell: sell goods cheaper, or fail to market something's true worth (merchant / market / skills)
groups.nuance_zh: discount: 在既定标价上提供常规减价打折 (rate / ticket / merchandise) · dump: 低于成本价倾销库存以求脱手 (surplus / steel / shares) · underquote: 给出过低的欺骗性报价 (bid / estimate / tender) · undercut: 制定比竞品更低的杀手级价格截杀对手 (rival / price / competitor) · undersell: 低价销货；未能充分推销宣传其价值 (merchant / market / skills)

groups.name: Undervalue & Underestimate · 低估与轻看 (Underrate, Downplay, Undervalue)
groups.tip: 粗略估算直至最终裁决

items.def_en: To think or guess that the amount, cost, difficulty, or value of something is smaller than it actually is, or to undervalue someone's ability.
items.ex_en: Never underestimate the sheer dedication required to master a completely new spoken language.
items.ex_zh: 千万不要低估精通一门全新口语所需的巨大投入与专注。

items.def_en: To try to make people think that something is less important or serious than it really is
items.ex_en: Government officials attempted to downplay the potential economic fallout of the sudden tariff.
items.ex_zh: 政府官员试图淡化这一突加关税可能带来的经济负面影响。

items.def_en: To underestimate or fail to acknowledge the full merits or potential of someone or yourself
items.ex_en: You will sell short your true creative potential if you accept that offer.
items.ex_zh: 倘若接受那个毫无挑战的提议，你可就太低估自己真正的创造潜力了。

items.def_en: To fail to recognize how good, strong, clever, or important someone or something really is
items.ex_en: Critics often underrate his tactical intelligence because of his quiet demeanor.
items.ex_zh: 由于他性格沉静，评论家们往往低估了他的战术智慧。

items.def_en: To consider someone or something to be less valuable or significant than they actually are
items.ex_en: Many companies undervalue the emotional labor performed by their support staff.
items.ex_zh: 许多公司低估了后勤支持人员所付出的情绪劳动。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate cognitive errors or deliberate rhetoric that judges a person, threat, capability, or value to be substantially smaller, weaker, or less important than reality proves.
groups.summary_zh: 对事物的重要性、能力、价值或危险性作出偏低的评估与判断。
groups.desc_en: Estimating an entity's value, ability, or danger at less than its genuine magnitude, differing from active criticism by resulting from an inaccurate, dismissive appraisal.
groups.desc_zh: 对某事物的价值、实力或危险性评估不足，与恶意贬损的区别在于其源于轻视性的偏颇认知或主观误判。
groups.nuance_en: underestimate: misjudge strength, size, or difficulty downwards (enemy / cost / power) · downplay: deliberately minimize importance or severity (risk / role / crisis) · sell short: fail to do justice to value or potential (colleague / self / abilities) · underrate: rank or appreciate lower than deserved (actor / movie / talent) · undervalue: assign an insufficient monetary or emotional worth (currency / assets / contribution)
groups.nuance_zh: underestimate: 严重低估对手实力、成本或难度 (enemy / cost / power) · downplay: 刻意淡化事态严重性或影响 (risk / role / crisis) · sell short: 看扁他人潜能或自贬身价 (colleague / self / abilities) · underrate: 对才华或作品未能给出应有评价 (actor / movie / talent) · undervalue: 在财务或情感上未赋予公允价值 (currency / assets / contribution)

groups.name: Unfold & Spread Out · 展开与铺平 (Spread out, Lay out)
groups.tip: 解开折痕并完全铺展开

items.def_en: to smooth down creases or make something level and flat after it has been folded or crumpled
items.ex_en: She used a heavy ruler to flatten out the crumpled blueprint on the drafting table.
items.ex_zh: 她用一把沉重的直尺抚平绘图桌上起皱的蓝图。
items.ex2_en: The rugged mountain terrain finally flattened out into a vast green plain.
items.ex2_zh: 崎岖的山地终于延展变成了一片广袤的绿色平原。

items.def_en: to spread something out flat so that it can be inspected, worked on, or easily seen
items.ex_en: The CEO laid out an ambitious five-year growth strategy.
items.ex_zh: 首席执行官详细阐述了一项雄心勃勃的五年增长战略。

items.def_en: to unfold or expand so as to become wider, more extensive, or completely accessible
items.ex_en: The mountain pass suddenly opened out into a vast, sunlit alpine valley.
items.ex_zh: 山隘豁然开朗，化作一片阳光普照的开阔高山谷地。
items.ex2_en: The gardener carefully opened out the folded canvas to protect young sprouts.
items.ex2_zh: 园丁小心翼翼地展开折叠的帆布，以保护嫩苗。

items.def_en: to open something fully and arrange it across a flat surface so that the entire area is covered or visible
items.ex_en: The search team spread out across the forest to look for the missing hikers.
items.ex_zh: 搜救队在森林中分散开来寻找失踪的徒步旅行者。
items.ex2_en: The gardener spread out fresh wood mulch evenly across the flowerbeds.
items.ex2_zh: 园丁把新鲜的木屑均匀地铺撒在各个花坛上。

items.def_zh: 展开，摊开，打开（折叠物）；（情节、事件等）逐渐展现，显露
items.def_en: 1. to open out something that has been folded, or to become open and flat. 2. (of events or a story) to develop or become gradually revealed.
items.ex_en: He watched the delicate paper fan slowly unfold across the mahogany table.
items.ex_zh: 他看着那把精致的折扇在红木桌面上缓缓展开。
items.ex2_en: The clerk began to unfold the detailed maps across the wide wooden counter.
items.ex2_zh: 店员开始在宽阔的木柜台上展开详细的地图。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers opening out objects that have been folded or creased (such as maps, linens, or chairs) until they are wide and flat, as well as events opening up before someone.
groups.summary_zh: 强调将折叠之物拉开、摊平，使表面充分展现，亦指情节展开。
groups.desc_en: To extend, flatten, or display something folded or compact into an expansive flat surface, contrasting with mere linear enlargement or stretching by focusing on revealing surface area.
groups.desc_zh: 将折叠或紧缩之物展布、铺平成开阔平面，与单纯的线性拉长或增大不同，其核心在于显露原本收拢的表面积。
groups.nuance_en: flatten out: remove creases or elevations to make completely level (creases / wrinkles / map) · lay out: arrange and spread systematically over an area (blanket / blueprint / tools) · open out: expand outward to reveal width or an interior (fan / landscape / petals) · spread out: distribute across a wide flat area (picnic blanket / cards / documents) · unfold: release folds to extend to full size (newspaper / map / lawn chair)
groups.nuance_zh: flatten out: 抚平褶皱或凸起使之平整 (creases / wrinkles / map) · lay out: 有条理地平铺陈列 (blanket / blueprint / tools) · open out: 向外舒展展现宽度或内部 (fan / landscape / petals) · spread out: 大面积散开或平铺分布 (picnic blanket / cards / documents) · unfold: 展开折叠处以达全幅 (newspaper / map / lawn chair)

groups.name: Uniform & Standardize Attire · 统一着装与配发制服 (Uniform, Livery, Standardize)
groups.tip: 配齐整套工具或制服行头

items.def_en: To provide a person or group with garments or dress them in a specific style
items.ex_en: The royal tailors clothed the young prince in mantle of embroidered velvet.
items.ex_zh: 宫廷裁缝为年轻的王子穿上一件刺绣天鹅绒斗篷。

items.def_en: To clothe someone in a distinctive religious habit or official dress
items.ex_en: The abbot habited the new novice in a coarse woolen tunic during the ceremony.
items.ex_zh: 仪式期间，修道院院长为新见习修士穿上粗毛呢僧袍。

items.def_en: to provide someone or a group with uniforms
items.ex_en: The airline decided to uniform all ground staff in tailored navy blazers.
items.ex_zh: 该航空公司决定为所有地勤人员统一配备定制的海军蓝西装外套。

items.def_zh: 为（侍从等）穿仆服；配备特色制服
items.def_en: To dress servants, personnel, or vehicles in a distinctive institutional livery
items.ex_en: The eccentric baron liveried his household footmen in scarlet coats and silver lace.
items.ex_zh: 这位古怪的男爵让手下的男仆统一穿上饰有银边红外套的特色仆服。

items.def_en: To dress someone in particular or formal garments
items.ex_en: Attendants attired the foreign dignitaries in traditional silk robes for the banquet.
items.ex_zh: 侍从们为外国贵宾换上传统丝绸长袍以参加晚宴。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses dressing or supplying an entire workforce, military unit, or group in identical, regulation garments. It emphasizes institutional uniformity and visual conformity over individual protection.
groups.summary_zh: 指为集体、军队或雇员配发统一制服或使着装规范化。
groups.desc_en: To supply, fit, or standardize clothing—especially according to an institutional, professional, or social code—contrasting with casual individual dressing.
groups.desc_zh: 依照机构、职业或特定身份规范配发或统一样式服饰，区别于随意的个人穿搭。
groups.nuance_en: clothe: provide with necessary apparel in general (refugees / family / needy) · habit: dress in specific traditional or religious vestments (monks / nuns / riders) · uniform: dress a group in standardized identical outfits (staff / soldiers / team) · livery: clothe servants or retainers in distinct matching heraldic dress (servants / footmen / chauffeurs) · attire: dress in formal, decorative, or elaborate garments (guests / courtiers / bride)
groups.nuance_zh: clothe: 提供日常生活所需衣物 (refugees / family / needy) · habit: 配发或穿戴特定宗教/传统制服 (monks / nuns / riders) · uniform: 给集体统一配发标准化制服 (staff / soldiers / team) · livery: 为仆役或家臣穿戴专属标识号衣 (servants / footmen / chauffeurs) · attire: 盛装打扮以适应正式场合 (guests / courtiers / bride)

groups.name: Unload & Shift · 卸载与转嫁 (Discharge, Jettison, Unburden)
groups.tip: 卸除货物转移安置

items.def_en: (+ onto/as) To dispose of something undesirable or counterfeit by transferring it to another
items.ex_en: The dishonest dealer tried to pass off damaged inventory onto an unsuspecting buyer.
items.ex_zh: 那个不良商人企图把残次存货转嫁脱手给毫无戒备的买家。

items.def_en: To unload cargo or release passengers from a ship, aircraft, or vehicle
items.ex_en: Crews worked through the night to discharge the container ship at the terminal.
items.ex_zh: 装卸队彻夜工作，在码头为那艘集装箱货轮卸货。

items.def_en: To remove goods or freight from a carrier, or rid oneself of unwanted stock or obligations
items.ex_en: The logistics firm rushed to unload the perishable cargo before morning.
items.ex_zh: 物流公司赶在天亮前将易腐烂的货物从车上卸下。
items.ex2_en: The cargo ship will unload quickly once it secures a berth tomorrow.
items.ex2_zh: 一旦明天获得泊位，这艘货轮将迅速卸货。

items.def_zh: 卸载，卸（货）；转嫁，甩掉（责任、负担）
items.def_en: 1. To unload goods or passengers from a ship, aircraft, or vehicle. 2. (+ onto) To get rid of an unwanted thing, responsibility, or task by passing it on to someone else.
items.ex_en: Management attempted to offload unprofitable business units onto a regional competitor.
items.ex_zh: 管理层试图将亏损的业务部门甩给一家区域竞争对手。

items.def_en: To throw cargo or fuel overboard in distress, or discard an unwelcome burden quickly
items.ex_en: The pilot had to jettison excess aviation fuel before attempting an emergency landing.
items.ex_zh: 飞行员在尝试紧急迫降前必须抛弃多余的航空燃油。

groups.summary_en: This frame involves removing cargo, passengers, or burdens from a vehicle or container, extending figuratively to ridding oneself of unwanted tasks, liabilities, or responsibilities.
groups.summary_zh: 指从运载体卸下载荷，或转嫁责任、摆脱累赘。
groups.desc_en: To remove, shift, or repudiate physical or figurative burdens (duties, debts, unwanted assets) onto another party or discard them entirely, contrasting with orderly internal management.
groups.desc_zh: 将实体负荷或抽象负担（责任、债务、滞销品）转移、卸除给他方或彻底抛弃，区别于内部平稳消化。
groups.nuance_en: pass off: deceptively transfer counterfeit or substandard items onto another (counterfeit / blame / responsibility) · discharge: formally relieve of an official burden or duty (debt / cargo / duty) · unload: remove physical cargo or get rid of burdensome assets (cargo / stocks / worries) · offload: strategically transfer unwanted tasks or inventory onto someone else (responsibilities / inventory / shares) · jettison: discard burdens decisively to avert disaster or lighten load (cargo / ballast / plans)
groups.nuance_zh: pass off: 欺诈性地转嫁假冒伪劣物或推卸责任 (counterfeit / blame / responsibility) · discharge: 依规免除正式债务或履行职责 (debt / cargo / duty) · unload: 卸下实物货物或倾销卸除心事包袱 (cargo / stocks / worries) · offload: 策略性地将任务或库存转手他人 (responsibilities / inventory / shares) · jettison: 遇险时为减负而果决抛弃弃用 (cargo / ballast / plans)

groups.name: Unpack & Take Out · 拆箱与取出 (Unpack, Unload, Empty)
groups.tip: 拆开包装封条倒出内部物品

items.def_en: To remove an object from the interior of a pocket, container, or case
items.ex_en: He took out a scruffy notebook from his coat pocket to scribble the address.
items.ex_zh: 他从大衣口袋里掏出一本破旧的笔记本写下地址。

items.def_en: To remove cargo, freight, or contents from a vehicle, container, or ship
items.ex_en: Dockworkers began to unload heavy crates from the vessel as soon as it docked.
items.ex_zh: 货轮一靠岸，码头工人便开始从船上卸下沉重的板条箱。
items.ex2_en: The freight trains unload steadily at the industrial terminal every single night.
items.ex2_zh: 货运列车每天夜里都在工业终点站稳定地卸货。

items.def_zh: 从（箱包等中）取出；打开……收拾行李；分析，剖析
items.def_en: 1. To take things out of a suitcase, box, or package; to remove the contents of a container. 2. (figurative) To analyze and explain a complex concept or statement in detail.
items.ex_en: After reaching the hotel, she immediately unpacked her toiletries and business suits.
items.ex_zh: 到达酒店后，她立刻从行李箱中取出洗漱用品和商务西装。

items.def_en: To unroll or unfold something packed tightly, such as a tent, sail, or roll of fabric
items.ex_en: The sailors unfurled the heavy canvas main sail against the gathering sea mist.
items.ex_zh: 水手们在渐浓的海雾中展开了沉重的帆布主帆。
items.ex2_en: The colorful flags unfurled gracefully above the castle during the grand parade.
items.ex2_zh: 盛大游行期间，色彩斑斓的旗帜在城堡上方优雅地展开。

items.def_en: To remove everything contained inside a box, bag, or room so that nothing remains
items.ex_en: Please empty your school bag completely so we can check for missing assignments.
items.ex_zh: 请把书包彻底清空，以便我们查找遗失的作业。
items.ex2_en: The crowded theater emptied quickly as soon as the closing credits finished.
items.ex2_zh: 片尾字幕一结束，拥挤的剧场就迅速空了下来。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on emptying containers, luggage, or vehicles by systematically taking contents out, transitioning an enclosed load into the open.
groups.summary_zh: 指将行李箱、箱盒或车体内的物品一件件取出并清空容器。
groups.desc_en: To extract enclosed items from containers or to clear out vessels, contrasting with systematic loading or internal storage.
groups.desc_zh: 将封装于容器内的物品取出或倒空容器，与打包储物或装载过程相对立。
groups.nuance_en: take out: remove an individual item from an enclosure (wallet / keys / trash) · unload: remove bulk freight or burdens from a vehicle or container (truck / shipment / supplies) · unpack: remove contents from luggage or shipping boxes upon arrival (suitcase / boxes / belongings) · unfurl: release a tightly rolled or bundled item to hang free (flag / banner / sail) · empty: clear out all contents until the receptacle is completely bare (pockets / dishwasher / trash can)
groups.nuance_zh: take out: 从包裹或容器中单纯取出某物 (wallet / keys / trash) · unload: 从交通工具或箱柜中成批卸除货载 (truck / shipment / supplies) · unpack: 拆启行李或箱包取出内部归宿物 (suitcase / boxes / belongings) · unfurl: 展开紧密卷束悬垂之物 (flag / banner / sail) · empty: 彻底倒空容器使之无一物 (pockets / dishwasher / trash can)

groups.name: Unroll & Roll Out · 展开与铺开 (Unfurl, Roll out)
groups.tip: 顺势摊开卷轴或平铺开来

items.def_en: to flatten out something by rolling it, or to introduce a new product or service gradually to the public
items.ex_en: The baker rolled out the chilled pastry dough onto a lightly floured surface.
items.ex_zh: 面包师在撒了少许面粉的台面上将冷藏的油酥面团擀开。

items.def_en: to unwind or take off material that is wound around a spool, bobbin, or reel
items.ex_en: The technician carefully wound off several meters of copper wire from the heavy spool.
items.ex_zh: 技术员小心翼翼地从沉重的线轴上退下几米长的铜线。

items.def_en: to remove the paper, cloth, or other covering that is wound around an object
items.ex_en: She watched her son excitedly unwrap the shiny paper around his birthday present.
items.ex_zh: 她看着儿子兴奋地撕开生日礼物外面光鲜的包装纸。
items.ex2_en: The tight outer leaves began to unwrap naturally in the gentle warmth.
items.ex2_zh: 在柔和的温暖中，紧实的外层叶子开始自然舒展开来。

items.def_zh: （使）展开，（使）铺开（卷状物）；展现，展现出来
items.def_en: 1. to open out something that has been rolled up, or to become flat and open. 2. to gradually reveal or unfold over time.
items.ex_en: The architect unrolled the massive architectural plan across the conference room table.
items.ex_zh: 建筑师在会议室桌上摊开那张巨大的建筑平面图。
items.ex2_en: The thick wool carpet unrolled smoothly across the polished oak floor.
items.ex2_zh: 厚厚的羊毛地毯在光洁的橡木地板上顺畅地展开。

items.def_zh: 使展开展开；（卷起的旗帜、帆等）张开
items.def_en: to unroll and spread out, or to cause something folded or curled up (such as a flag or sail) to open flat
items.ex_en: A sudden gust of wind caused the regal ceremonial banner to unfurl majestic.
items.ex_zh: 一阵突如其来的狂风让庄严的礼仪旗帜迎风招展。
items.ex2_en: The proud soldiers unfurled their regiment banner in front of the crowd.
items.ex2_zh: 骄傲的士兵们在人群面前展开了他们团队的旗帜。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe unwinding or flattening out something that was wound into a cylinder or coil, whether physical objects like carpets and scrolls or metaphorical plans.
groups.summary_zh: 指将卷起之物展平、铺开，或引申指逐步呈现与推行。
groups.desc_en: To unspool, lay flat, or systematically deploy something tightly wound or coiled, contrasting with rapid folding or non-planar unwinding.
groups.desc_zh: 将卷曲、紧缠之物平展放平或循序铺开，区别于折叠或立体松绑。
groups.nuance_en: roll out: deploy or spread out flat by unwinding, or introduce systematically (carpet / pastry / broadband) · wind off: unspool a continuous thread or wire from a reel (cable / yarn / spool) · unwrap: remove the outer protective or decorative wrapper (gift / parcel / bandage) · unroll: open something wound into a cylinder to lay it flat (mat / poster / parchment) · unfurl: open and spread outward gracefully in the wind or space (banner / sail / flag)
groups.nuance_zh: roll out: 展滚铺平卷材，或系统性推行新规产品 (carpet / pastry / broadband) · wind off: 从卷轴上连续倒出退解线缆 (cable / yarn / spool) · unwrap: 拆掉外部包扎封裹层 (gift / parcel / bandage) · unroll: 将圆柱卷状物舒展放平 (mat / poster / parchment) · unfurl: 随风或顺势飘逸展布 (banner / sail / flag)

groups.name: Unseal & Unbox · 拆封与开包 (Unbox, Unseal, Unwrap)
groups.tip: 打开包装取出其中物件

items.def_en: To open containers or luggage and take the items out
items.ex_en: We spent the entire afternoon unpacking cardboard boxes in our new apartment.
items.ex_zh: 我们整个下午都在新公寓里拆箱收拾物品。

items.def_en: To remove paper, plastic, or protective wrapping from an item or gift
items.ex_en: The child could hardly wait to unwrap the protective plastic on his new toy.
items.ex_zh: 那个孩子迫不及待地想撕掉新玩具上的塑料保护膜。
items.ex2_en: The fragile silk ribbon unwrapped easily when pulled by the playful kitten.
items.ex2_zh: 被顽皮的小猫一拉，脆弱的丝带便轻易解开了。

items.def_en: To break or open the seal of an envelope, parcel, container, or official document
items.ex_en: The magistrate formally unsealed the confidential dispatch before reading it aloud.
items.ex_zh: 地方法官在宣读机密公文前，正式拆开了封印。

items.def_zh: 拆盒，拆箱（取出新物品并展示）
items.def_en: To remove a newly purchased product from its packaging, especially to examine or film it.
items.ex_en: He filmed a popular video to unbox the newly released gaming console.
items.ex_zh: 他拍摄了一段热门视频，展示最新款游戏机的开箱过程。

items.def_en: To rip or open packaging eagerly and forcefully
items.ex_en: The excited children tore into the parcels under the decorated tree.
items.ex_zh: 兴奋的孩子们迫不及待地撕开装饰树下的包裹。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame detail opening newly packaged items, removing protective wrappers, seals, or outer parcel layers, often with a focus on reveal and display.
groups.summary_zh: 指拆开包装盒、撕开封条或揭开外层包裹以取出并展示新物。
groups.desc_en: To breach outer barriers, tear packaging, or unlock factory containers to access enclosed goods, contrasting with routine casual opening.
groups.desc_zh: 破除保护性封条、外包装或工业箱盒以取出新品，区别于普通门窗的开合。
groups.nuance_en: unpack: open and remove the everyday contents of luggage or crates (suitcases / gear / groceries) · unwrap: strip off paper, film, or protective casing (present / parcel / bandage) · unseal: break an official adhesive seal or airtight closure (envelope / tomb / container) · unbox: systematically unpack a newly acquired retail product for inspection (gadget / smartphone / shoes) · tear into: rip open packaging aggressively and eagerly (presents / envelope / rations)
groups.nuance_zh: unpack: 启开箱笼取出行李或杂物 (suitcases / gear / groceries) · unwrap: 撕剥外部包装纸或保护膜 (present / parcel / bandage) · unseal: 启封、拆破密封条或公文印蜡 (envelope / tomb / container) · unbox: 首次开箱拆封消费新品 (gadget / smartphone / shoes) · tear into: 迫不及待地暴力撕裂包装 (presents / envelope / rations)

groups.name: Uproot & Exterminate · 连根拔起与除绝 (Root out, Extirpate, Exterminate)
groups.tip: 连根拔起并彻底消灭祸患

items.def_en: Remove inferior, unwanted, or harmful elements from a group or system
items.ex_en: The hiring committee used rigorous assessments to weed out unqualified candidates.
items.ex_zh: 招聘委员会通过严格的评估筛选，剔除了不合格的应聘者。

items.def_en: Find and completely eliminate something harmful, dangerous, or unwanted
items.ex_en: The auditor was determined to root out financial corruption within the department.
items.ex_zh: 审计员下定决心要根除该部门内部的财务腐败。

items.def_en: Extinguish or eliminate completely by forceful, decisive measures
items.ex_en: The government launched strict medical protocols to stamp out the infectious outbreak.
items.ex_zh: 政府启动了严格的医疗方案以强行扑灭这次传染疫情。

items.def_en: Tear something up by the roots or eradicate it completely from its native environment
items.ex_en: Rapid urban expansion threatened to deracinate the indigenous cultural practices forever.
items.ex_zh: 迅猛的城市扩张恐将原住民的文化习俗彻底连根拔除。

items.def_en: (formal) To destroy or root out something completely, such as a disease, evil, or unwanted plant.
items.ex_en: Ancient reformers sought to extirpate systemic bribery through unforgivingly harsh penalties.
items.ex_zh: 古代改革者试图通过严苛无情的刑罚来根绝系统性的受贿行为。

groups.summary_en: High-intensity verbs indicating the total, unsparing destruction or pulling out by the roots of vices, populations, or hazardous entities to prevent resurgence.
groups.summary_zh: 强调连根铲除、斩草除根以绝后患的高强度毁灭动作。
groups.desc_en: To destroy, pull out, or eradicate something undesirable down to its origin or deepest root, contrasting with surface trimming or mere suppression.
groups.desc_zh: 连根拔除或彻底剿灭不良事物，区别于浮于表面的修剪或阶段性压制。
groups.nuance_en: weed out: sift through and eliminate inferior or unwanted elements (candidates / corruption / impostors) · root out: track down and violently dislodge deeply embedded evils (corruption / heresy / nests) · stamp out: extinguish or eliminate aggressively before it spreads (epidemic / rebellion / rumors) · deracinate: uproot entirely from native culture, environment, or foundation (populations / traditions / customs) · extirpate: completely eradicate and annihilate to the point of extinction (species / dissent / tumor)
groups.nuance_zh: weed out: 辨别筛选并剔除冗余不良分子 (candidates / corruption / impostors) · root out: 深挖并斩断深植的恶性根源 (corruption / heresy / nests) · stamp out: 严加踩灭掐断萌芽蔓延 (epidemic / rebellion / rumors) · deracinate: 连根拔起，使与原生文化生态彻底剥离 (populations / traditions / customs) · extirpate: 彻底除灭剿绝至不留孑遗 (species / dissent / tumor)

groups.name: Vacation & Holiday · 度假与休假 (Vacation, Holiday, Week-end)
groups.tip: 外出度假放松或度蜜月

items.def_en: To take a recreational break or travel somewhere enjoyable away from routine work
items.ex_en: The weary London family decided to holiday along the rugged coast of Cornwall.
items.ex_zh: 这户疲惫的伦敦家庭决定前往康沃尔崎岖的海岸度假。

items.def_en: To spend time away from home or employment for relaxation and recreation
items.ex_en: They usually vacation in the Colorado mountains during the peak summer months.
items.ex_zh: 他们通常在盛夏时节前往科罗拉多的山区度假。

items.def_en: To stay temporarily as a visitor or traveler at a designated location
items.ex_en: The scholar chose to sojourn in Florence while conducting archival research.
items.ex_zh: 那位学者在进行档案研究期间选择暂住在佛罗伦萨。

items.def_zh: 外出度假，逃离繁忙日常
items.def_en: To leave one's home or daily responsibilities to enjoy a short vacation or period of rest
items.ex_en: We desperate need to get away to the seaside after this hectic project.
items.ex_zh: 在忙完这个紧迫的项目后，我们极度渴望去海边彻底放松一下。

items.def_en: To spend a holiday together immediately after getting married.
items.ex_en: The newlyweds decided to honeymoon at a secluded beach resort in Bali.
items.ex_zh: 这对新婚夫妇决定在巴厘岛一处僻静的海滩度假村度蜜月。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on spending dedicated recreational periods away from home, work, or routine responsibilities, often characterized by leisure travel or seasonal retreats.
groups.summary_zh: 指脱离日常工作或居家生活，前往他处进行专属度假与休闲游憩。
groups.desc_en: To travel away from home or pause normal duties to spend a specific period of dedicated leisure, contrasting with business trips or daily leisure.
groups.desc_zh: 脱离常态工作地前往他处度过专设的休假时段，区别于差旅公干或日常晚间休闲。
groups.nuance_en: holiday: take time off away from work, esp. in British travel usage (abroad / in Spain / with family) · vacation: take an extended recreational leave away from work or school (in Hawaii / in the mountains) · sojourn: stay temporarily as a refined or extended guest in a foreign place (in Paris / in the country) · get away: escape from everyday routine and pressure for a short break (for the weekend / to the coast) · honeymoon: take a celebratory post-wedding holiday (in Venice / in the Maldives)
groups.nuance_zh: holiday: 离家度假休整，英式色彩浓厚 (abroad / in Spain / with family) · vacation: 申请较长法定假期前往他处消遣 (in Hawaii / in the mountains) · sojourn: 在异地进行有情调的短期客居逗留 (in Paris / in the country) · get away: 逃离琐碎压力外出透气度周末 (for the weekend / to the coast) · honeymoon: 专指完婚后的新婚蜜月旅行 (in Venice / in the Maldives)

groups.name: Vacation & Unwind · 度假与休养 (Vacation, Recreate, Chill out)
groups.tip: 享受假期停工休整放松

items.def_en: To spend the winter months in a particular place, often somewhere warm
items.ex_en: Many retired northern couples prefer to winter along the sunny Florida coastline.
items.ex_zh: 许多来自北方的退休夫妇更愿意在阳光明媚的佛罗里达海岸过冬。

items.def_en: (chiefly North American) To spend a holiday or vacation somewhere.
items.ex_en: Our neighbors plan to vacation on a quiet Mediterranean island this July.
items.ex_zh: 我们的邻居打算今年七月去地中海一座安静的小岛休假。

items.def_en: To spend time relaxing and not doing very much
items.ex_en: We just want to stay in the cabin and chill out all weekend.
items.ex_zh: 我们只想待在小木屋里，整个周末无所事事地彻底放松。

items.def_en: To stop working and relax completely, especially on vacation
items.ex_en: After completing finals, the college students kicked back on the sunny porch.
items.ex_zh: 期末考试结束后，大学生们在阳光普照的门廊上惬意放松。

items.def_en: To engage in recreational activities and relaxation for pleasure
items.ex_en: City dwellers often visit the national park to recreate amidst pristine nature.
items.ex_zh: 城市居民经常去国家公园游玩，在原始自然环境中休养身心。

groups.summary_en: Centered on North American and informal registers, these verbs denote spending extended leisure periods away from work to relax, tour, or decompress.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重美式表达，指休假、散心或外出游玩放松。
groups.desc_en: To decompress, rest, and shed accumulated stress through unstructured relaxation, contrasting with active rigorous recreation or dutiful rest.
groups.desc_zh: 通过无拘无束的放松与消遣来纾解累积的压力，区别于带任务的游憩或严肃规整的静养。
groups.nuance_en: winter: spend the cold season in a warmer climate or specific retreat (in Florida / abroad / in the south) · vacation: take designated recreational time off from labor (in the tropics / by the lake) · chill out: calm down completely and adopt an unhurried, carefree state (with friends / at home) · kick back: recline comfortably and cease all effort (with a beer / on the couch / by the pool) · recreate: refresh mental or physical vitality through leisurely diversion (in nature / in the outdoors)
groups.nuance_zh: winter: 前往温暖宜人地避寒过冬 (in Florida / abroad / in the south) · vacation: 享有假期待在某处悠闲休养 (in the tropics / by the lake) · chill out: 彻底松弛神经、不焦不躁 (with friends / at home) · kick back: 翘脚歇息、彻底撒手歇着 (with a beer / on the couch / by the pool) · recreate: 通过有益身心的文娱活动恢复元气 (in nature / in the outdoors)

groups.name: Validate & Authenticate · 验证与确证 (Validate, Authenticate, Verify, Confirm)
groups.tip: 确证可靠性与逻辑真实

items.def_en: To state formally and officially in writing that certain required criteria or standards have been fulfilled
items.ex_en: The board must certify that all safety measures meet regulatory standards.
items.ex_zh: 董事会必须出具书面证明，确认所有安全措施均符合监管标准。

items.def_en: To check and prove the truth, correctness, or exact details of something through formal examination
items.ex_en: Independent inspectors arrived to verify the structural integrity of the ancient bridge.
items.ex_zh: 独立质检员赶赴现场核实这座古桥的结构完整性。

items.def_en: To be examined carefully and found to be true, accurate, or above suspicion
items.ex_en: We need to check out of the hotel by noon, but let's check out the local market first.
items.ex_zh: 我们需要在中午前结账退房，不过先去看看当地的集市吧。

items.def_en: 1. To prove or confirm that something is true, valid, or logically correct. 2. To make something officially acceptable or legally binding.
items.ex_en: Empirical field experiments are required to validate the researcher's theoretical model.
items.ex_zh: 需要通过实地经验试验来证实该研究者的理论模型。

items.def_en: To prove conclusively that an object, signature, identity, or document is genuine and not forged
items.ex_en: Art historians used infrared analysis to authenticate the signature on the canvas.
items.ex_zh: 艺术史学家利用红外线分析来鉴定画布上签名的真伪。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe evaluating something against rigorous technical, legal, or emotional criteria to establish that it is genuine, functionally legitimate, or logically sound.
groups.summary_zh: 通过系统检验、技术或官方程序，确证某物的真实性、合规性或有效性。
groups.desc_en: To prove, verify, or formally confirm that something is true, legally valid, or genuinely what it claims to be, contrasting with subjective belief.
groups.desc_zh: 通过核实、检验或公认标准确认事物属实、具法律效力或货真价实，区别于主观揣测。
groups.nuance_en: certify: officially declare standard compliance or truth under formal authority (records / authenticity / documents) · verify: check through factual investigation or objective cross-referencing (identity / facts / account) · check out: inspect or test casually/empirically to ensure correctness (story / reference / alibi) · validate: establish legal efficacy, empirical soundness, or emotional legitimacy (ticket / hypothesis / feelings) · authenticate: prove historical, artistic, or material genuineness against forgery (painting / signature / relic)
groups.nuance_zh: certify: 由权威机构出具书面证明或公证 (records / authenticity / documents) · verify: 查验客观证据或交叉核对真实性 (identity / facts / account) · check out: 实地查看或初步调查确认有无破绽 (story / reference / alibi) · validate: 赋予法定有效性或证实假说逻辑成立 (ticket / hypothesis / feelings) · authenticate: 鉴别文物、书画或署名系真品而非伪作 (painting / signature / relic)

groups.name: Vent & Discharge · 宣泄与爆发 (Let out, Unleash, Blow off steam, Bottle up)
groups.tip: 由平铺直叙陈述转为激烈宣泄释放

items.def_en: to do or say something that helps get rid of excess energy, stress, or anger
items.ex_en: He went for a brisk run after work to blow off steam.
items.ex_zh: 下班后他去快跑了一阵，以宣泄心中的闷气。

items.def_en: to release or utter a sound, breath, or pent-up feeling openly
items.ex_en: She let out a heavy sigh of disappointment upon hearing the bad news.
items.ex_zh: 听到坏消息时，她发出一声沉重的失望叹息。

items.def_en: to talk openly and unrestrainedly about one's troubles, grief, or inner thoughts
items.ex_en: She poured out her troubles to her best friend over coffee.
items.ex_zh: 她一边喝咖啡一边向闺蜜倾诉自己的烦恼。
items.ex2_en: Tearful grievances poured out uncontrollably as she confronted her estranged family members.
items.ex2_zh: 当她面对疏远的家人时，满腹委屈泪如雨下地倾泻而出。

items.def_zh: 发泄，宣泄；排出（气体、烟雾等）
items.def_en: 1. to express a strong, usually negative emotion openly and forcefully. 2. to allow air, smoke, or gas to escape through an opening
items.ex_en: He just needed a trusted friend to vent about his terrible workday.
items.ex_zh: 他只是需要一个值得信赖的朋友，好倾诉发泄糟糕工作日的怨气。

items.def_en: to suddenly release a powerful force, violent emotion, or strong impulse
items.ex_en: The sudden announcement unleashed widespread fury among the local factory workers.
items.ex_zh: 那项突如其来的声明在当地工厂工人中引发了轩然大怒。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on forceful physical or verbal release of pent-up emotional pressure, especially frustration, anger, or distress.
groups.summary_zh: 指将胸中压抑已久的愤怒、怨气或压抑情绪强烈释放、发泄出来。
groups.desc_en: To release pent-up, volatile, or confined emotions and energy forcibly into the open, contrasting with stoic suppression or mild disclosure.
groups.desc_zh: 将积压、动荡的情感或能量强行释放宣泄出来，区别于克制忍耐或温和倾诉。
groups.nuance_en: blow off steam: release surplus tension or energy through harmless vigorous activity (after work / in the gym) · let out: release a pent-up vocalization, breath, or inner emotion (sigh / scream / cry) · pour out: express overwhelming feelings copiously and without reservation (grief / heart / sorrow) · vent: give aggressive or indignant verbal expression to frustration (anger / frustration / spleen) · unleash: release a powerful, destructive, or previously restrained force (fury / attack / chaos)
groups.nuance_zh: blow off steam: 通过剧烈活动无害化排解多余压力或火气 (after work / in the gym) · let out: 不自主地吐露、发出抑制的呼喊或气息 (sigh / scream / cry) · pour out: 毫无保留地倾泻大量悲痛或心事 (grief / heart / sorrow) · vent: 愤慨宣泄愤懑或积怨 (anger / frustration / spleen) · unleash: 骤然释放毁伤力极强的约束力量 (fury / attack / chaos)

groups.name: Venture & Braving · 涉险与探进 (Brave, Sally Forth, Forge Ahead)
groups.tip: 甘冒风险迈向未知险境

items.def_zh: 冒险前往，涉险迈向；敢于，冒着……的风险
items.def_en: 1. To proceed somewhere despite the risk of danger or unpleasant conditions. 2. To dare to say or do something that may be criticized or fail.
items.ex_en: No solitary traveler dared to venture into the depths of the haunted forest.
items.ex_zh: 没有任何独行旅人敢于冒险涉足那座幽暗森林的深处。

items.def_en: To face and endure hazardous conditions or weather courageously
items.ex_en: The determined rescue workers braved freezing winds to reach the stranded hikers.
items.ex_zh: 坚定的救援人员顶着刺骨寒风，赶去救助被困的徒步者。

items.def_en: To set out boldly or briskly from a secure place on an expedition or foray
items.ex_en: At dawn, the armored knights sallied forth from behind the heavy fortress gates.
items.ex_zh: 黎明时分，披甲骑士们精神抖擞地从厚重堡垒大门后挺进杀出。

items.def_zh: 坚定迈进，克服险阻前行
items.def_en: To make progress steadily and resolutely despite obstacles or hazardous terrain
items.ex_en: Despite mounting supply shortages, the expedition team continued to forge ahead.
items.ex_zh: 尽管物资日益短缺，探险队依然坚定地克服险阻继续前行。

items.def_en: To cast oneself impetuously into a dangerous place or unpredictable situation
items.ex_en: Without any proper training, he foolishly plunged into the volatile stock market.
items.ex_zh: 在毫无专业训练的情况下，他鲁莽地扎入了动荡的股票市场。

groups.summary_en: Encompasses moving outward or proceeding into unfamiliar, inhospitable, or perilous territories and situations despite clear hazards.
groups.summary_zh: 不顾潜藏危险、恶劣环境或未知挑战，冒险深入或挺进。
groups.desc_en: To move forward into unknown, hazardous, or hostile territory despite peril, contrasting with timid hesitation or cautious retreat.
groups.desc_zh: 无视凶险挺进未知、恶劣或充满敌意的险境，区别于畏缩不前或谨慎退避。
groups.nuance_en: venture: step tentatively or daringly into an unsafe or unfamiliar place (outdoors / into the dark / into the wilderness) · brave: endure and press forward directly through hazardous weather or dangers (the storm / the cold / the elements) · sally forth: depart with confident vigor from a secure base into action (into the fray / on an expedition) · forge ahead: press onward steadily with momentum despite obstacles (with the project / in the blizzard) · plunge into: dive headlong and recklessly into dangerous activity or water (darkness / the abyss / cold water)
groups.nuance_zh: venture: 大胆或试探性地涉足未知险境 (outdoors / into the dark / into the wilderness) · brave: 迎着风雨或危难坚毅向前挺进 (the storm / the cold / the elements) · sally forth: 满怀干劲地从驻地出发展开征途 (into the fray / on an expedition) · forge ahead: 顶住阻力稳步向前突进 (with the project / in the blizzard) · plunge into: 奋不顾身地猛然扎进混战或险境中 (darkness / the abyss / cold water)

groups.name: Venture & Dare · 冒险与涉足 (Risk, Stake, Braving)
groups.tip: 涉险探索未知领域

items.def_en: Expose oneself or an asset to the possibility of danger, harm, or loss
items.ex_en: He refused to risk his family's financial security on speculative crypto trades.
items.ex_zh: 他拒绝拿家庭的财务安全去投机性的加密货币交易中冒险。

items.def_en: 1. To take risks or venture boldly into the unknown. 2. To risk or hazard something on an uncertain outcome.
items.ex_en: The bold merchant decided to adventure his remaining wealth across uncharted seas.
items.ex_zh: 这位大胆的商人决定拿自己剩余的全部家当在未知海域放手一搏。

items.def_en: Dare to go somewhere that may be dangerous or unpleasant, or risk a daring statement
items.ex_en: Few local villagers would venture across the treacherous mountain pass after dusk.
items.ex_zh: 黄昏之后，几乎没有当地村民敢冒险穿过那条凶险的山隘。

items.def_en: Endure or face unpleasant, hostile, or dangerous conditions with courage
items.ex_en: The lone sailor braved furious waves to steer his craft toward safety.
items.ex_zh: 那名孤独的水手顶着狂暴的风浪，奋力将小船驶向安全地带。

items.def_en: Put something at risk of being lost or damaged; boldly make a guess or proposal
items.ex_en: I dare not hazard an opinion before reading the official scientific report.
items.ex_zh: 在阅读官方科学报告之前，我不敢冒昧发表任何意见。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe daring to go into dangerous, uncharted, or precarious environments, or risking assets, safety, and reputation on an outcome fraught with uncertainty.
groups.summary_zh: 不惧未知或危险而勇敢涉足、探涉，或下注冒险行动。
groups.desc_en: To expose oneself, wealth, or safety to potential loss or danger for a chance of gain, contrasting with prudent preservation.
groups.desc_zh: 为求收益而主动将自身、财产或安危置于损失威胁之中，区别于稳妥保全。
groups.nuance_en: risk: expose something valuable to danger or negative outcomes (life / fortune / reputation) · adventure: embark on a daring, unpredictable, and exciting enterprise (capital / everything / abroad) · venture: dare to risk capital or take a bold initiative despite uncertainty (capital / opinion / guess) · brave: confront unavoidable danger or hostility unflinchingly (dangers / elements / criticism) · hazard: commit valuable assets to a speculative chance or offer tentative conjecture (guess / life / fortune)
groups.nuance_zh: risk: 使名誉、身家面临潜在损失的风险 (life / fortune / reputation) · adventure: 投身未知且充满波折的探险或商业冒险 (capital / everything / abroad) · venture: 承担不确定性大胆投入资本或提出浅见 (capital / opinion / guess) · brave: 昂首硬抗直面危险或敌对态势 (dangers / elements / criticism) · hazard: 押上重注博取胜算，或冒昧提出揣测 (guess / life / fortune)

groups.name: Venture an Attempt · 试行与探试 (Endeavor, Undertake, Venture)
groups.tip: 做出初步努力与试验探索

items.def_en: (+ at) to make a tentative or experimental attempt at solving or performing something
items.ex_en: Even with zero mechanical experience, she decided to have a stab at fixing it.
items.ex_zh: 即便毫无机械经验，她还是决定试着动手修修看。

items.def_en: (formal) to attempt or try to do something, especially something difficult.
items.ex_en: The inexperienced orator cautiously essayed a brief defense of the controversial bill.
items.ex_zh: 那位缺乏经验的演说者谨慎地尝试为这项颇具争议的法案进行了简短辩护。
