items.def_en: To spring or shrink back suddenly from bodily pain, shock, or revolting touch
items.ex_en: The wounded soldier had to recoil instinctively from the medic's stinging antiseptic.
items.ex_zh: 受伤的士兵在军医刺痛的消毒剂触碰下本能地猛然退缩。

items.def_en: To make a quick, automatic jerking movement away from sudden pain or danger
items.ex_en: The veteran boxer did not flinch when the heavy blow grazed past.
items.ex_zh: 当重拳擦身而过时，那位经验丰富的老拳手连眼睛都没眨一下。

items.def_en: To distort one's facial features sharply in response to pain, disgust, or effort
items.ex_en: He tried not to grimace while swallowing the bitter herbal medication whole.
items.ex_zh: 他在咽下整剂苦涩的草药时，竭力不露出痛苦难忍的面容。

groups.summary_en: Instantaneous somatic and facial micro-reactions to sudden physical pain, shocking impacts, or visceral discomfort, characterized by facial contortions and sharp bodily jerks.
groups.summary_zh: 指感知突发剧痛、冲击或尴尬刺激时，面部骤然咧嘴挤眼及身体本能抽搐闪躲。
groups.desc_en: Instant involuntary physical contraction or reflexive backward movement triggered by acute pain, shock, or disgust, contrasting with deliberate surrender.
groups.desc_zh: 因剧痛、惊骇或厌恶触发的瞬间非自主肌肉紧缩或退缩反应，区别于主动撤退或投降。
groups.nuance_en: wince: quick facial spasm from momentary sharp pain or cringe (pain / memory / blow) · shudder: convulsive full-body trembling from revulsion or cold (fear / cold / disgust) · recoil: bodily spring-back in sheer horror or mechanical rebound (gun / shock / horror) · flinch: involuntary startle or dodge expecting impact (blow / bullet / scrutiny) · grimace: twisted facial expression of disgust or severe pain (pain / distaste)
groups.nuance_zh: wince: 剧痛或羞愧回忆引起的瞬间蹙额抽搐 (pain / memory / blow) · shudder: 厌恶、惊骇或寒冷引发的全身颤栗 (fear / cold / disgust) · recoil: 极度惊恐下的弹回式倒退或反冲 (gun / shock / horror) · flinch: 预感挨打受击时的本能缩头闪避 (blow / bullet / scrutiny) · grimace: 痛苦或极度嫌弃时五官扭曲的做鬼脸 (pain / distaste)

groups.name: Winnow & Deseed · 脱粒与去杂 (Gin, Winnow, Thresh)
groups.tip: 轧棉提纯分离杂质

items.def_en: To remove the seeds from a fruit, vegetable, or plant tissue
items.ex_en: The recipe requires you to carefully deseed the spicy peppers before chopping.
items.ex_zh: 这份食谱要求你在切碎辣椒之前，先仔细去除其中的籽。

items.def_en: To remove the outer covering or pod from seeds, fruits, or grains
items.ex_en: Workers patiently hull the dried hazelnuts before loading them into large sacks.
items.ex_zh: 工人们耐心地把晒干的榛子去壳，然后装入大麻袋中。

items.def_zh: 轧（棉），用轧棉机去籽；用陷阱捕捉
items.def_en: 1. (agriculture) To separate cotton fibers from their seeds using a cotton gin. 2. To catch an animal in a trap.
items.ex_en: Plantation workers toiled endlessly under the sun to gin the mountain of cotton.
items.ex_zh: 庄园工人在烈日下不知疲倦地劳作，用机器将堆积如山的棉花脱籽。

items.def_en: To separate grain from stalks and husks by beating or using a machine
items.ex_en: Modern harvesters can thresh bushels of golden wheat in mere minutes now.
items.ex_zh: 如今，现代联合收割机仅需数分钟便能将数蒲式耳的金黄小麦脱粒。

items.def_en: To blow air through grain in order to remove the chaff; metaphorically, to sift through to find what is valuable
items.ex_en: The aged farmer gently tossed the grain aloft to winnow the chaff.
items.ex_zh: 上了年纪的农夫轻轻将谷物抛向空中，借风扬去杂糠。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this agricultural processing frame denote separating desirable seeds or fibers from husks, chaff, or surrounding plant matter. They often invoke traditional farming or primary milling techniques.
groups.summary_zh: 指在农产品初加工中去除壳、籽或杂质以提取纯净纤维或粮食。
groups.desc_en: Mechanically separating valuable grain, seeds, or fibers from husks, chaff, and debris in agricultural harvesting, contrasting with cooking or pure cleaning.
groups.desc_zh: 在农业采收中将籽粒、纤维从外壳、杂质中剥离脱出，区别于烹饪清洗或一般清洁。
groups.nuance_en: deseed: manually removing interior seeds from edible produce (pepper / melon / fruit) · hull: stripping outer shell, pod, or husk (strawberries / peas / seeds) · gin: mechanically separating seeds from raw fiber (cotton) · thresh: beating cereal stalks to loosen edible grain (wheat / rice / grain) · winnow: blowing air currents to separate chaff from grain, or sorting good from bad (chaff / grain / candidates)
groups.nuance_zh: deseed: 剔除果肉内里的瓜籽或果核 (pepper / melon / fruit) · hull: 剥离坚硬的外壳、豆荚或花萼 (strawberries / peas / seeds) · gin: 机械轧花剥除棉籽 (cotton) · thresh: 击打谷穗使籽粒脱落的打谷脱粒 (wheat / rice / grain) · winnow: 风选扬场去糠秕，或甄别筛选优劣 (chaff / grain / candidates)

groups.name: Wither & Languish · 衰萎与消逝 (Wither, Languish, Fade)
groups.tip: 水分生机尽失，花叶干瘪黯淡

items.def_en: To gradually lose brightness, color, strength, or fresh vitality until nearly gone
items.ex_en: Vibrant autumn colors slowly fade as the bitter winter chill advances relentlessly.
items.ex_zh: 随着严冬寒气无情逼近，绚丽的秋色逐渐暗淡消退。
items.ex2_en: Prolonged exposure to harsh sunlight can fade delicate antique tapestry fabrics.
items.ex2_zh: 长时间暴露在强烈的阳光下会使脆弱的古董挂毯面料褪色。

items.def_en: 1. (of a plant) To dry up, shrink, and die, or cause to do so. 2. To gradually become weaker, fade away, or disappear.
items.ex_en: Deprived of natural sunlight, the delicate houseplant will quickly wither and perish.
items.ex_zh: 缺少了自然光照，这盆娇嫩的室内植物很快就会枯萎死掉。
items.ex2_en: Severe drought conditions will quickly wither tender crops throughout the entire province.
items.ex2_zh: 严重的干旱将很快使全省娇嫩的农作物枯萎。

items.def_en: To become weak, feeble, or dull through neglect, confinement, or lack of vitality
items.ex_en: The unjustly accused scholar continued to languish inside the dark, forgotten dungeon.
items.ex_zh: 蒙冤的学者继续在幽暗且被人遗忘的地牢中虚度光阴、日渐憔悴。

items.def_en: To gradually decrease in power, vigor, or prominence after a peak
items.ex_en: As twilight gathered, the empire's ancient glory seemed to wane forevermore.
items.ex_zh: 薄暮降临之际，帝国往昔的荣耀似乎正无可挽回地走向衰退。

items.def_en: To waste away or cause to waste away from lack of use, nourishment, or disease
items.ex_en: Unused leg muscles will atrophy rapidly during periods of prolonged bed rest.
items.ex_zh: 在长期卧床休养期间，废弃不用的腿部肌肉会迅速退化萎缩。
items.ex2_en: A lack of challenging intellectual stimulation may atrophy critical cognitive abilities over time.
items.ex2_zh: 缺乏具有挑战性的智力刺激随着时间的推移可能会使关键认知能力退化。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the gradual decay, decline, and loss of life force, vigor, or intensity over time. Verbs range from botanical drying and dying to figurative fading away of power, hopes, or youth.
groups.summary_zh: 描述生命力、力量或生机逐渐衰竭、凋零并最终消散的过程。
groups.desc_en: Gradual, progressive loss of vitality, vigor, or prominence leading to a depleted or ruined state, contrasting with sudden destruction.
groups.desc_zh: 生机、活力或显赫地位随着时间缓慢衰退耗竭，区别于突发性的毁灭。
groups.nuance_en: fade: losing intensity, color, or sensory clarity gradually (light / memories / fame) · wither: drying up and shriveling due to severed vitality (leaves / hopes / youth) · languish: wasting away in stagnation, neglect, or captivity (prisoner / economy / illness) · wane: periodic gradual decrease in power or brightness (moon / influence / popularity) · atrophy: wasting away from prolonged disuse or neurological decay (muscles / skills / intellect)
groups.nuance_zh: fade: 颜色、亮度或名气逐渐褪去消隐 (light / memories / fame) · wither: 因丧失生命力而干枯衰萎 (leaves / hopes / youth) · languish: 在受困、忽视或停滞中虚耗日久而萎靡 (prisoner / economy / illness) · wane: 阶段性退潮、走下坡路或衰落 (moon / influence / popularity) · atrophy: 因长期弃用或神经病变而功能/肌肉退化萎缩 (muscles / skills / intellect)

groups.name: Wither & Shrivel · 凋谢与枯萎 (Wither, Shrivel, Droop)
groups.tip: 植物失水枯瘪凋零衰败

items.def_en: 1. (of a plant) To bend downwards and become limp from lack of water or heat. 2. (of a person) To lose strength, energy, or confidence.
items.ex_en: Freshly cut roses wilt quickly if left without clean water and nourishment.
items.ex_zh: 刚剪下的玫瑰如果得不到清水和养分的滋养，很快就会蔫掉。
items.ex2_en: Intense summer heat wilts delicate green seedlings unless farmers provide adequate shade.
items.ex2_zh: 除非农民提供充足的遮阴，否则夏日酷暑会使娇嫩的绿色幼苗萎蔫。

items.def_en: To bend or hang downwards limply through exhaustion, sadness, or lack of water
items.ex_en: The tired blossoms begin to droop beneath the scorching, unrelenting summer sun.
items.ex_zh: 疲态尽显的花朵在无情酷暑的炙烤下纷纷耷拉下垂。

items.def_en: To lose all moisture or sap completely and wither away
items.ex_en: Without regular irrigation, the fertile garden soil will completely dry up.
items.ex_zh: 若是缺乏定期灌溉，这片肥沃的花园土壤将会彻底干涸板结。
items.ex2_en: The baking desert wind dried up shallow irrigation channels within two days.
items.ex2_zh: 炙热的沙漠狂风在两天之内就把浅浅的灌溉渠吹干了。

items.def_en: To become dry and shriveled, or cause a plant to lose its sap and life
items.ex_en: A severe heatwave caused the fragile tender shoots to wither and perish.
items.ex_zh: 一场严重的严酷热浪致使脆弱幼嫩的幼芽干枯萎缩乃至死去。
items.ex2_en: The severe fungal infection withered fragile leaves across the whole vineyard.
items.ex2_zh: 严重的真菌感染使整个葡萄园脆弱的叶子全部枯萎了。

items.def_en: (+ up) To wrinkle, shrink, and become dry and dead due to loss of moisture
items.ex_en: The fallen autumn grapes shrivel into wrinkled husks on the vine.
items.ex_zh: 落在藤上的秋季葡萄逐渐脱水干瘪，缩成了皱巴巴的干壳。
items.ex2_en: The harsh baking dry air shrivels unshielded fruit peels within mere hours.
items.ex2_zh: 干燥炙热的空气仅在数小时内就能使毫无保护的果皮脱水干缩。

groups.summary_en: This frame describes organic decay where vegetation loses moisture, vitality, and turgor, drying up and collapsing. Extended to humans, it signifies a loss of energy, confidence, or vigor.
groups.summary_zh: 指植物因失水或老化而萎缩干瘪，亦引申指人颓丧无力。
groups.desc_en: Physical dehydration and collapse of organic plant or skin tissue, losing moisture, volume, and rigidity, contrasting with mechanical crushing.
groups.desc_zh: 植物或有机组织因失水而萎蔫皱缩、丧失挺拔，区别于机械施压砸扁。
groups.nuance_en: wilt: flaccid drooping from heat or lack of water (flowers / lettuce / heat) · droop: downward sagging under weight or exhaustion (branches / eyelids / spirits) · dry up: total loss of internal moisture/fluid (soil / lake / wells) · wither: desiccating, shrinking, and dying completely (vines / crops / grass) · shrivel: wrinkling, curling, and shrinking tight into dry husk (leaves / apple / corpse)
groups.nuance_zh: wilt: 因缺水或暴晒而发蔫下垂 (flowers / lettuce / heat) · droop: 因重力、疲软或脱水而向下下垂 (branches / eyelids / spirits) · dry up: 水分彻底耗尽干涸 (soil / lake / wells) · wither: 彻底干枯凋萎失去生机 (vines / crops / grass) · shrivel: 极度脱水干缩成干瘪起皱一团 (leaves / apple / corpse)

groups.name: Wonder & Baffle · 惊奇与困惑 (Boggle, Mystify, Baffle)
groups.tip: 诧异费解且摸不着头脑

items.def_en: To completely bewilder, puzzle, or confound someone so they cannot find an explanation
items.ex_en: The bizarre archaeological findings continue to baffle experts across the globe today.
items.ex_zh: 那些离奇的考古发现至今仍令全球各地的专家感到大惑不解。

items.def_zh: 使不知所措；使眼花缭乱
items.def_en: To confuse someone severely by confronting them with many complicated or chaotic factors
items.ex_en: The contradictory legal documents served to bewilder the novice investigator completely.
items.ex_zh: 那些自相矛盾的法律文件使这位初出茅庐的调查员彻底手足无措。

items.def_zh: （因困惑或惊奇而）不知所措，感到难以置信；犹豫，畏缩
items.def_en: To be astonished, overwhelmed, or confused by something, especially to the point of being unable to grasp it; hesitate.
items.ex_en: Vast cosmological numbers always boggle the human mind with their sheer magnitude.
items.ex_zh: 浩瀚的天文数字总是以其纯粹的宏大令人难以置信、目瞪口呆。

items.def_zh: 使大惑不解；使神秘莫测
items.def_en: To utterly confuse or perplex someone because an occurrence seems impossible to account for
items.ex_en: The sudden disappearance of the priceless diamond will mystify the cleverest detectives.
items.ex_zh: 这颗无价钻石的突然失踪让最聪明的侦探也百思不得其解。

items.def_en: To shock or surprise someone to a startling, near-speechless degree
items.ex_en: Her extraordinary vocal range never fails to astound the entire captivated audience.
items.ex_zh: 她那惊人的音域每一次都能让全场倾倒的观众为之震撼惊叹。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses mental states and effects where an observation or concept is so extraordinary, intricate, or illogical that human comprehension stumbles and fails.
groups.summary_zh: 指事物或概念过于惊奇、离奇或费解，以致人的思维无法轻易理解或接受。
groups.desc_en: Overwhelming intellectual comprehension or expectation through mysterious, incomprehensible, or staggering phenomena, contrasting with simple ignorance.
groups.desc_zh: 因现象极度神秘、深奥或超乎想象而使人陷入认知瘫痪与惊诧，区别于单纯不知情。
groups.nuance_en: baffle: completely thwarting intellectual understanding (investigators / scientists / mystery) · bewilder: confusing with complexity, disorientation, or rapid change (tourist / novice / senses) · boggle: overwhelming the mind through sheer scale or absurdity (mind / imagination) · mystify: holding in sustained, deliberate, or occult puzzle (audience / detectives / magic) · astound: shocking into speechless disbelief (spectators / world / result)
groups.nuance_zh: baffle: 毫无头绪、彻底难倒阻断理解 (investigators / scientists / mystery) · bewilder: 纷繁复杂使人迷茫摸不着头脑 (tourist / novice / senses) · boggle: 因规模庞大或荒谬惊愕到难以置信 (mind / imagination) · mystify: 故弄玄虚或神秘莫测使人困惑 (audience / detectives / magic) · astound: 惊世骇俗震撼到令人瞠目结舌 (spectators / world / result)

groups.name: Word & Formulate · 措辞与遣词 (Word, Phrase, Couch)
groups.tip: 斟酌措辞把思想表达出来

items.def_zh: 斟酌措辞表达，用言辞表达
items.def_en: 1. To choose and use particular words to express an idea or state something.
items.ex_en: The diplomat had to word his formal response with extreme diplomatic caution.
items.ex_zh: 这位外交官不得不极其谨慎地斟酌他的正式答复措辞。

items.def_en: To express an idea, statement, or question in a specific combination of words
items.ex_en: She struggled to phrase her delicate constructive feedback without sounding overly critical.
items.ex_zh: 她费尽心思措辞以提出中肯的建议，以免显得过于尖刻。

items.def_en: To present or articulate an idea, question, or proposition in a tailored perspective or specific structure
items.ex_en: The defense attorney managed to frame the thorny issue in favorable terms.
items.ex_zh: 辩护律师设法从有利的角度来构筑和阐述这一棘手问题。

items.def_zh: 以特定语气表达（通常委婉或隐晦）
items.def_en: (often passive, + in) To express or frame something in language of a specified style, tone, or deliberate obscurity
items.ex_en: The stern ultimatum was subtly couched in polite and diplomatic language.
items.ex_zh: 这份严厉的最后通牒被巧妙地隐晦包裹在客气委婉的外交辞令之中。

items.def_en: To express thoughts, arguments, or policy in a clear, precise, and systematic manner
items.ex_en: The committee worked tirelessly to formulate a comprehensive sustainable development policy.
items.ex_zh: 委员会孜孜不倦地工作，以系统地构拟出一套全面的可持续发展政策。

groups.summary_en: This frame highlights the deliberate, stylistic, or diplomatic selection of vocabulary and phrasing used to articulate a specific nuance or impression.
groups.summary_zh: 精选字眼与特定口吻来表达或构拟思想。
groups.desc_en: Carefully selecting words, tone, and rhetorical syntax to articulate a thought with specific diplomatic or strategic nuance, contrasting with raw impromptu blurt.
groups.desc_zh: 字斟句酌地构思与组织语句，以达到特定的修辞或外交效果，区别于脱口而出。
groups.nuance_en: word: carefully choosing phrasing to avoid offense or ambiguity (letter / statement / apology) · phrase: shaping a thought into a concise verbal expression (question / idea / compliment) · frame: structuring perspective and contextual angle strategically (argument / debate / narrative) · couch: embedding meaning in guarded or veiled language (terms / veiled threat / diplomacy) · formulate: methodically drafting an exact official policy or theory (plan / policy / response)
groups.nuance_zh: word: 谨慎遣词造句以防歧义或冒犯 (letter / statement / apology) · phrase: 将特定意思凝练为言语表达 (question / idea / compliment) · frame: 从特定视角或框架来构建话语 (argument / debate / narrative) · couch: 以含蓄委婉或隐晦措辞包裹真实用意 (terms / veiled threat / diplomacy) · formulate: 系统化、严谨地拟定方案或表述 (plan / policy / response)

groups.name: Wordplay & Banter · 双关与戏谑 (Quip, Wisecrack, Banter)
groups.tip: 借双关幽默打趣或逗弄调侃

items.def_zh: 说双关语，用双关语戏谑
items.def_en: 1. (+ on) To make a humorous or witty play on words that sound alike or have multiple meanings.
items.ex_en: The cheerful host liked to pun on the guests' unusual last names.
items.ex_zh: 这位开朗的主持人喜欢拿客人们不同寻常的姓氏来谐音说双关话。

items.def_en: To speak or tease playfully and good-humouredly with someone
items.ex_en: The two old comrades continued to banter warmly over cups of coffee.
items.ex_zh: 这两位老战友一边喝着咖啡，一边继续亲切地互相打趣。

items.def_en: To make a witty, clever, or sarcastic remark quickly
items.ex_en: The seasoned politician paused to quip about the absurdity of the rumors.
items.ex_zh: 那位老练的政客停顿了一下，就那些荒谬的谣言机敏地打趣了一句。

items.def_en: To speak in a playful, humorous, or non-serious manner
items.ex_en: I beg you not to jest about such a gravely solemn matter.
items.ex_zh: 我恳求你切莫就这般极其庄重严肃的事情开轻浮的玩笑。

items.def_en: To make a sharp, clever, often sarcastic or flippant joke
items.ex_en: He could not resist the urge to wisecrack during the solemn briefing.
items.ex_zh: 在庄严肃穆的汇报会上，他还是忍不住说了一句俏皮风凉话。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe engaging in witty, humorous verbal sparring or making clever remarks and wordplays to amuse or tease.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及运用巧妙语言、俏皮话或文字游戏进行幽默调侃或戏谑互动。
groups.desc_en: Engaging in quick-witted, humorous conversational exchanges or linguistic double entendres for amusement, contrasting with formal debate or hostile insult.
groups.desc_zh: 利用语言双关、幽默机锋进行诙谐俏皮的对答嬉闹，区别于正式辩论或恶意侮辱。
groups.nuance_en: pun: humorously exploiting words with multiple meanings (headline / speaker / writer) · banter: playful, teasing reciprocal dialogue between peers (colleagues / friends / couple) · quip: tossing off a brief, clever sarcastic remark (observer / politician) · jest: joking or speaking non-seriously (courtier / fool) · wisecrack: delivering a sharp, insolent, sarcastic one-liner (heckler / teen / detective)
groups.nuance_zh: pun: 利用一词多义或谐音进行双关调侃 (headline / speaker / writer) · banter: 亲近同侪间轻松打趣对答 (colleagues / friends / couple) · quip: 随口抛出的妙语机智俏皮话 (observer / politician) · jest: 非严肃开玩笑、谑弄 (courtier / fool) · wisecrack: 尖酸讽刺、抖机灵的俏皮刻薄话 (heckler / teen / detective)

groups.name: Worry & Fret · 担忧与发愁 (Fret, Stew, Agonize)
groups.tip: 表达心神不安与为琐事发愁焦虑

items.def_zh: 闷闷不乐；独自焦躁烦恼
items.def_en: (+ over) To worry, agitate, or remain angry and distressed in silence over a problem
items.ex_en: Instead of seeking closure, he chose to stew over the past grievance.
items.ex_zh: 他没有选择释怀化解，而是独自对过去的宿怨郁结烦恼不已。

items.def_en: (+ about/over) To constantly worry or be visibly anxious and discontented about something
items.ex_en: Mothers often fret about the safety of their children during late journeys.
items.ex_zh: 深夜出行时，母亲们往往会对子女的人身安全担忧发愁不已。

items.def_en: (+ on/over/about) To dwell gloomily and persistently on distressing or upsetting thoughts
items.ex_en: It does no good to brood over past mistakes that cannot change.
items.ex_zh: 整日对自己无法改变的过往错误耿耿于怀是毫无益处的。

items.def_zh: 极度痛苦纠结；苦苦思虑
items.def_en: (+ over/about) To spend a great deal of time worrying intensely or suffering mental anguish about a decision
items.ex_en: The young graduate had to agonize over choosing between two brilliant offers.
items.ex_zh: 面对两份极好的录取通知，这位年轻的毕业生陷入了极度的纠结苦思。

items.def_zh: 发愁，担忧；使烦恼，使焦虑
items.def_en: (archaic) To worry or fret; to burden with anxiety or distress.
items.ex_en: Vain mortal anxieties should not cark the soul that seeks eternal truth.
items.ex_zh: 凡尘虚妄的忧虑不应烦扰苦恼那颗追寻永恒真理的心灵。
items.ex2_en: Worldly men often cark endlessly over temporary and insignificant material losses.
items.ex2_zh: 世俗之人常常为暂时的、微不足道的物质损失无休止地烦恼。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe brooding, fretting, and being consumed by internal anxiety or distress over uncertain outcomes and nagging troubles.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖对烦恼、不确定性感到忧心忡忡、苦思焦虑或坐立难安的心态。
groups.desc_en: Obsessively turning over perceived problems or anxieties in the mind, producing emotional distress, contrasting with productive pragmatic problem-solving.
groups.desc_zh: 在脑海中对隐忧或问题反复内耗咀嚼，诱发持续焦虑，区别于建设性解决问题。
groups.nuance_en: stew: silently seething or simmering in passive agitation (anger / guilt / mistake) · fret: restless, visible nervous irritation over small matters (details / money / safety) · brood: dark, morbid inward fixation on past wrongs (defeat / betrayal / loss) · agonize: undergoing extreme mental torture weighing difficult choices (decision / dilemma / guilt) · cark: archaic or dialectal distressing, burdensome worrying (cares / soul)
groups.nuance_zh: stew: 闷闷不乐、暗自焦躁煎熬 (anger / guilt / mistake) · fret: 为琐事烦躁不安、坐立难安地发愁 (details / money / safety) · brood: 郁郁寡欢地阴郁反刍旧创或过失 (defeat / betrayal / loss) · agonize: 在艰难抉择或痛苦中苦苦挣扎煎熬 (decision / dilemma / guilt) · cark: 令人忧心忡忡、压迫心灵的愁虑 (cares / soul)

groups.name: Wound Healing & Scarring · 结痂与创口愈合 (Scab, Cicatrize, Crust)
groups.tip: 创口凝血硬化后长出硬痂

items.def_en: To mark or become permanently marked with a fibrous mark left on skin after an injury
items.ex_en: Deep physical burns may permanently scar the sensitive surface of the skin.
items.ex_zh: 重度身体烧伤可能会在敏感的皮肤表面留下永久性的瘢痕。

items.def_en: To heal by forming scar tissue, or to cause a wound to develop a scar
items.ex_en: Clean antiseptic care allowed the warrior's battle wound to cicatrize quickly.
items.ex_zh: 干净的消毒护理使得这位勇士的战伤得以迅速结疤愈合。
items.ex2_en: The skilled battlefield surgeon used hot iron to cicatrize deep wounds.
items.ex2_zh: 经验丰富的战地外科医生用热铁使深层伤口结疤愈合。

items.def_en: To become covered with a hard, dry outer layer or surface coating during healing
items.ex_en: The raw burn began to crust over with a dry protective layer.
items.ex_zh: 那处鲜红的灼伤创面开始结起一层干燥的保护性硬痂。

items.def_en: To form a new, delicate layer of epidermal skin over an exposed lesion or sore
items.ex_en: The grazed knee took nearly a week to fully skin over cleanly.
items.ex_zh: 擦伤的膝盖花了将近一周的时间才完全长出完好的新表皮。

items.def_zh: 结痂；当工贼（罢工期间照常工作）
items.def_en: 1. (+ over) (of a wound) To form a hard protective crust while healing. 2. (disapproving) To work while other workers are on strike.
items.ex_en: The child's scratched elbow will scab naturally after several quiet days.
items.ex_zh: 孩子擦破的手肘在静养几天后就会自然而然地结痂愈合。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this physiological frame describe the biological stages of tissue repair following an injury. They focus on the formation of hard protective coverings, crusts, or fibrous scar tissue as wounds close and heal.
groups.summary_zh: 表示伤口表面变干、形成保护性硬痂或纤维化疤痕的生理愈合过程。
groups.desc_en: Biological sequence of tissue repair wherein exuded fluids dry into protective crusts and leave fibrous scar tissue, contrasting with infection or ongoing rupture.
groups.desc_zh: 创口经渗出液凝固结壳并逐渐纤维化收口愈合的过程，区别于创伤化脓或创面撕裂。
groups.nuance_en: scar: leaving a permanent fibrous mark after healing (wound / burn / trauma) · cicatrize: technical formation of permanent fibrous scar tissue (wound / flesh) · crust over: developing a hard outer coagulated layer (lesion / ulcer / sore) · skin over: newly forming a thin delicate surface membrane (graze / cut) · scab: coagulating dried blood into a thick temporary protective crust (knee / cut / scratch)
groups.nuance_zh: scar: 伤口愈合后留下永久性纤维瘢痕 (wound / burn / trauma) · cicatrize: 医学生理上的创口结疤收敛 (wound / flesh) · crust over: 渗液硬化形成坚硬干壳 (lesion / ulcer / sore) · skin over: 创面上新长出一层薄皮覆盖 (graze / cut) · scab: 血液凝结形成保护性血痂 (knee / cut / scratch)

groups.name: Wrack & Ravage · 摧残与折磨 (Wrack, Ravage, Tear apart)
groups.tip: 身心遭受极度痛楚与撕扯折磨

items.def_en: Cause someone extreme emotional distress, anguish, or inner turmoil
items.ex_en: The civil war threatens to tear the entire country apart.
items.ex_zh: 内战有让整个国家分崩离析的危险。

items.def_en: Completely absorb, exhaust, or wear away someone through relentless pain, grief, or disease
items.ex_en: Unbearable grief threatened to consume his fragile spirit following the bitter loss.
items.ex_zh: 在承受沉痛的丧亲之痛后，无边的悲伤几乎要将他脆弱的灵魂吞噬殆尽。

items.def_zh: 击溃（神经/身心）；使极度疲惫震颤
items.def_en: Completely destroy someone's physical vitality, composure, or mental resilience
items.ex_en: The relentless grueling pace of the marathon seemed to shatter his resolve.
items.ex_zh: 马拉松赛程中无休止的艰苦节奏似乎彻底击溃了他的心理防线。
items.ex2_en: The delicate crystal bowl shattered instantly upon hitting the hard tile floor.
items.ex2_zh: 精致的水晶碗一摔在坚硬的瓷砖地板上就瞬间粉碎了。

items.def_en: 1. (variant of rack, often passive) To cause severe physical or mental pain and torment to someone. 2. To wreck or destroy completely.
items.ex_en: Agonizing spasms of pain continued to wrack the invalid throughout the night.
items.ex_zh: 令人难以忍受的剧痛抽搐在整整一夜间不断折磨摧残着病榻上的人。

items.def_en: Cause extensive damage, ruin, or severe physical and mental deterioration to someone or something
items.ex_en: Fierce hurricane winds proceed to ravage the fragile coastal wooden structures.
items.ex_zh: 凶猛的飓风肆虐而过，严重摧残并摧毁了沿海脆弱的木质建筑。

groups.summary_en: Refers to inflicting severe, pervasive physical or emotional devastation that leaves the victim broken, strained, or exhausted. It emphasizes ruinous damage and agonizing strain over deliberate malice.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重剧烈病痛、悲痛对身心的深度摧残、耗竭与撕裂。
groups.desc_en: Subjecting an entity or mind to extreme, devastating torment, physical violence, or ruin, contrasting with mild irritation or localized injury.
groups.desc_zh: 对肉体、精神或地域施加剧烈、毁灭性的折磨与摧残，区别于轻度骚扰或局部轻伤。
groups.nuance_en: tear apart: brutally dismembering or ripping internal cohesion to pieces (body / country / family) · consume: completely burning, engulfing, or obsessing wholly (fire / grief / flames) · shatter: breaking completely into jagged fragments or destroying sanity (illusions / nerves / peace) · wrack: torturing acutely with physical or emotional agony (body with pain / remorse) · ravage: laying devastating, predatory waste across an area (country / disease / storm)
groups.nuance_zh: tear apart: 肢解撕裂或彻底粉碎内部团结 (body / country / family) · consume: 烈火般吞噬包围或全盘消耗 (fire / grief / flames) · shatter: 震碎毁灭心智安宁或击碎幻灭 (illusions / nerves / peace) · wrack: 剧痛折磨或负罪感肆虐肉体与心灵 (body with pain / remorse) · ravage: 灾祸、疾病或风暴洗劫蹂躏残破不堪 (country / disease / storm)

groups.name: Wrangle & Haggle · 争辩与纠缠交涉 (Wrangle, Haggle, Dispute)
groups.tip: 言语冲突针锋相对，喋喋不休争执争吵

items.def_en: (+ with) To engage in a spirited, brief, and often good-natured exchange of opposing arguments
items.ex_en: The two seasoned commentators liked to spar with each other over minor political details.
items.ex_zh: 两位经验丰富的评论员喜欢就细微的政治细节互相斗嘴打趣。

items.def_en: To argue about, contest, or formally question the truth, validity, or fairness of something
items.ex_en: Several prominent economists actively dispute the official data published by the ministry yesterday.
items.ex_zh: 几位著名经济学家对该部昨日公布的官方数据提出了公开质疑。

items.def_en: (+ over/about) To dispute or argue persistently, especially over the cost or terms of something
items.ex_en: Tourists often haggle over the price of handmade rugs in the busy outdoor bazaar.
items.ex_zh: 游客们常在繁忙的露天集市里为手工地毯的价格讨价还价。

items.def_en: (+ with/over) To disagree violently or enter into sharp, irreconcilable conflict with someone
items.ex_en: The prime minister will likely clash with senior lawmakers over the controversial immigration policy.
items.ex_zh: 首相很可能会就这项颇具争议的移民政策与资深议员发生激烈冲突。

items.def_zh: 争吵，争辩，长时间争论；放牧
items.def_en: 1. To argue or dispute noisily and stubbornly for an extended period. 2. (North American) To herd or round up livestock.
items.ex_en: The heirs continued to wrangle over the division of the valuable suburban real estate.
items.ex_zh: 继承人们继续就那处价值不菲的郊区房产的分割争吵不休。

groups.summary_en: This frame covers protracted, contentious, and stubborn verbal contests, especially when negotiating terms, settling disputes, or contesting opposing viewpoints.
groups.summary_zh: 指就利益分配、条款细节等发生的旷日持久、激烈费力的争辩与讨价还价。
groups.desc_en: Engaging in prolonged, contentious, and stubborn dispute over terms, property, or petty differences, contrasting with polite agreement or silent concession.
groups.desc_zh: 因利益、条款或细枝末节展开旷日持久且执拗激烈的扯皮争辩，区别于礼貌协商或默认让步。
groups.nuance_en: spar: engaging in defensive, probing preliminary verbal jab exchange (opponents / politicians) · dispute: formally questioning the validity of a claim or boundary (claim / boundary / election) · haggle: stubbornly bargaining back-and-forth over price or conditions (price / merchant / details) · clash: sharply and irreconcilably colliding in views or interests (factions / personalities / cultures) · wrangle: protracted, noisy, complicated petty quarreling (lawyers / politicians / over custody)
groups.nuance_zh: spar: 试探性、交锋式的言语交手切磋 (opponents / politicians) · dispute: 对权益、界线或合法性提出正式争议抗辩 (claim / boundary / election) · haggle: 围绕价格或具体条款反复磨嘴皮讨价还价 (price / merchant / details) · clash: 观点、利益或阵营正面尖锐对立碰撞 (factions / personalities / cultures) · wrangle: 旷日持久、嘈杂费解的纠缠争辩扯皮 (lawyers / politicians / over custody)

groups.name: Wrap & Enfold · 包裹与覆盖 (Envelop, Swaddle, Cloak)
groups.tip: 用外皮或织物紧紧包覆

items.def_en: 1. To cover or enclose something completely in paper, cloth, or other material. 2. (+ around/round) To fold or wind something around another object.
items.ex_en: She carefully began to wrap the fragile ceramic vase in several layers of bubble wrap.
items.ex_zh: 她小心翼翼地开始用几层气泡膜将易碎的陶瓷花瓶包裹起来。

items.def_en: To dress someone warmly in multiple layers of clothing, or pack items together tightly
items.ex_en: Make sure you bundle up before heading out into the bitter subzero morning chill.
items.ex_zh: 出门走进清晨零下的刺骨寒风之前，一定要穿暖裹严实。
items.ex2_en: Caring parents bundle up their little children before snowy winter walks.
items.ex2_zh: 有爱心的父母在雪天散步前给小孩子们穿得暖暖和和的。

items.def_en: To cover, enclose, or surround something completely with a protective or concealing layer
items.ex_en: Dense grey fog rose from the harbor to envelop the entire coastal village completely.
items.ex_zh: 浓密的灰雾从港口升腾而起，将整个沿海村落完全笼罩其中。

items.def_en: To wrap a body for burial, or cover something so that it is concealed from sight
items.ex_en: Perpetual twilight seemed to shroud the ancient cemetery in deep, eerie silence.
items.ex_zh: 永无止境的薄暮似乎将整座古老墓园笼罩在阴森可怖的死寂中。

items.def_en: To wrap an infant snugly in cloth or blankets to restrict movement and provide security
items.ex_en: The maternity nurse showed the new parents how to swaddle the newborn infant securely.
items.ex_zh: 产科护士向新手父母展示了如何将新生儿安全舒适地裹在襁褓中。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame denote encasing, draping, or shrouding an object or person with a pliable covering, whether for warmth, packaging, concealment, or physical protection.
groups.summary_zh: 指用织物、覆膜等柔软物料将人或物体全面裹覆、包藏或遮盖。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote encasing, winding, or completely covering an entity within a flexible layer, contrasting with simple covering (cover) by emphasizing circumferential protection, concealment, or confinement.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词表示用柔韧层完全包裹、缠绕或覆盖实体，区别于单纯的“覆盖 (cover)”，强调全方位的防护、隐匿或紧固约束。
groups.nuance_en: wrap: general encircling or packaging (gift / scarf / bandage) · bundle up: dressing warmly against cold (child / patient) · envelop: fully surrounding and concealing from all sides (fog / darkness / flames) · shroud: solemn or obscuring veil of secrecy or death (mystery / body / peak) · swaddle: tight restrictive wrapping of infants (newborn / baby / infant)
groups.nuance_zh: wrap: 通用环绕或包装 (gift / scarf / bandage) · bundle up: 为防寒而厚实包裹 (child / patient) · envelop: 全方位吞没与遮蔽 (fog / darkness / flames) · shroud: 如裹尸布般神秘或庄重遮蔽 (mystery / body / peak) · swaddle: 用襁褓紧紧束缚包裹 (newborn / baby / infant)

groups.name: Wreak & Inflict · 造成与降下祸端 (Wreak, Inflict, Unleash)
groups.tip: 引发后果，施加破坏影响

items.def_en: (formal/literary, + on/upon) To inflict punishment, plague, or vengeance onto someone
items.ex_en: The prophets warned that terrible plagues would visit upon the corrupt and unrepentant kingdom.
items.ex_zh: 先知警告说，可怕的瘟疫灾祸将降临在这个腐败且不知悔改的王国上。

items.def_en: (+ on/upon) To force someone to experience something very unpleasant, painful, or damaging
items.ex_en: The harsh economic sanctions will inflict severe hardship on ordinary citizens across the country.
items.ex_zh: 严厉的经济制裁将使全国各地的普通民众遭受沉重苦难。

items.def_en: To release a powerful, destructive force, feeling, or attack suddenly and uncontrollably
items.ex_en: The sudden torrential downpour threatened to unleash destructive flash floods across the narrow valley.
items.ex_zh: 突如其来的暴雨眼看就要在狭窄的山谷中引发具有破坏力的山洪。

items.def_en: To carry out or commit a harmful, illegal, or cruel act
items.ex_en: Federal agents arrested the suspects who conspired to perpetrate the sophisticated securities fraud.
items.ex_zh: 联邦探员逮捕了密谋实施这起高智商证券诈骗案的犯罪嫌疑人。

items.def_zh: 造成，招致（破坏、灾祸）；施加（报复、怒火）
items.def_en: To cause large amounts of damage, chaos, or harm; to inflict punishment or vengeance.
items.ex_en: The category five hurricane managed to wreak massive destruction throughout the fragile coastal infrastructure.
items.ex_zh: 五级飓风对沿海脆弱的基础设施造成了灾难性的大面积破坏。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on causing massive ruin, physical harm, trauma, or destructive vengeance directly upon an external target or environment. It emphasizes catastrophic outward impact.
groups.summary_zh: 强调对外强加严重的破坏、创伤、惩戒或灾祸，具有极强的破坏性与宣泄性。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote the active delivery or unloosing of severe harm, punishment, or destruction upon a recipient, differing from generic causation (cause) through high malevolence, catastrophe, or moral retribution.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词表示将剧烈伤害、惩罚或破坏降加于承受方，区别于一般因果动词（如 cause），强调灾难性、恶意度或报应色彩。
groups.nuance_en: wreak: releasing extensive havoc or vengeance (havoc / devastation / vengeance) · inflict: imposing pain, wounds, or penalties directly (pain / injury / casualties) · unleash: unbridling destructive forces without restraint (fury / war / chaos) · perpetrate: actively committing an offense or crime (crime / fraud / atrocity) · visit: formal or archaic divine dispensing of affliction (wrath / punishment / plagues)
groups.nuance_zh: wreak: 造成大规模肆虐或泄愤 (havoc / devastation / vengeance) · inflict: 直接施加痛苦、创伤或惩戒 (pain / injury / casualties) · unleash: 释放失控的毁灭性力量 (fury / war / chaos) · perpetrate: 蓄意犯下罪行或恶行 (crime / fraud / atrocity) · visit: 典雅或神圣降下灾祸与神谴 (wrath / punishment / plagues)

groups.name: Write & Spell Out · 拼写与书写 (Spell, Write, Transcribe)
groups.tip: 文字的字母拼写与笔录成文

items.def_en: 1. To say, write, or form the letters of a word in the correct order. 2. To have something, usually bad, as a result; to mean
items.ex_en: Prolonged industrial strikes of this magnitude will certainly spell economic disaster for the region.
items.ex_zh: 这种规模的长期行业罢工必然意味着该地区经济灾难的降临。

items.def_en: To write or say something letter by letter, or to explain something in clear and simple detail
items.ex_en: You don't need to spell out every detail; we get the general idea.
items.ex_zh: 你不需要把每个细节都阐释得那么细，我们明白大意。

items.def_en: To write something completely on paper, often in full words rather than abbreviations
items.ex_en: Please write out the full name of your university rather than using abbreviations.
items.ex_zh: 请完整写出你大学的全称，切勿使用缩写。

items.def_en: To write something quickly on a piece of paper so that you remember it
items.ex_en: Let me quickly jot down your flight details before I forget them entirely.
items.ex_zh: 趁我还没完全忘掉，让我赶快草草记下你的航班信息。

items.def_en: To record spoken words, notes, or audio in written form, usually verbatim
items.ex_en: The clerk had to transcribe hours of confidential audio recordings for the court archives.
items.ex_zh: 书记员不得不将数小时的机密录音逐字誊抄整理入法院档案。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to forming words letter by letter, committing spoken or thought material into orthographic script, or detailing something letter-by-letter.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及逐字拼写、书面抄录或清晰书写表达的词汇群。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe the concrete mechanical or communicative encoding of speech and thoughts into written letters or detailed words, contrasting with generic writing (write) by focusing on exact orthography, speed, or explicit articulation.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词指将语言或思维具体编码为字形或详尽文字的过程，区别于宽泛的“书写 (write)”，侧重拼字规范、记录速度或穷尽式表达。
groups.nuance_en: spell: naming or forming constituent letters (word / name / correctly) · spell out: making meticulously explicit or clarifying letter by letter (details / terms / implications) · write out: producing a complete written text in full (prescription / check / document) · jot down: making quick, brief informal notes (number / notes / idea) · transcribe: converting spoken or original text into another written form (interview / recording / manuscript)
groups.nuance_zh: spell: 拼出字词的组成字母 (word / name / correctly) · spell out: 逐字拼写或详尽阐明 (details / terms / implications) · write out: 完整写出正式文本 (prescription / check / document) · jot down: 快速草草记下 (number / notes / idea) · transcribe: 将录音或原稿誊写转录为文字 (interview / recording / manuscript)

groups.name: Yell & Holler · 呼喊与高声叫唤 (Shout, Holler, Bawl)
groups.tip: 扯开嗓门大声喊叫或喧嚷

items.def_en: To shout or say something loudly to attract attention
items.ex_en: The lost hiker decided to call out loudly whenever he heard rustling leaves nearby.
items.ex_zh: 迷路的徒步者只要听到附近树叶窸窣作响，就会大声呼喊求救。

items.def_en: To speak or utter loudly and forcefully
items.ex_en: The foreman had to shout over the deafening noise of the heavy industrial machinery.
items.ex_zh: 工头不得不盖过重型工业机械震耳欲聋的轰鸣声大声喊话。

items.def_zh: 扯着嗓子大喊；大声抱怨
items.def_en: (informal) To shout or yell loudly across a distance
items.ex_en: He had to holler across the noisy yard to get his brother's attention.
items.ex_zh: 他不得不扯着嗓子大喊穿过喧闹的院子，以引起他兄弟的注意。

items.def_zh: 叫喊，大声叫嚷；吼叫着说
items.def_en: (+ at/out) To shout or say something in a very loud, sharp, or angry voice.
items.ex_en: The furious manager began to yell at the team after their careless costly mistake.
items.ex_zh: 在团队犯下代价惨重的疏忽错误后，愤怒的经理开始冲他们大吼大叫。

items.def_en: To shout very loudly, raucously, or weep noisily
items.ex_en: The stubborn child started to bawl loudly in the middle of the crowded store.
items.ex_zh: 那个任性的孩子开始在拥挤的商店正中央放声大哭大叫起来。

groups.summary_en: This frame captures loud, forceful vocal shouting aimed at bridging a physical distance or expressing intense anger, excitement, or disciplinary warning.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过高分贝喉音大声叫嚷以呼唤远方的人、发泄怒气或警告示警。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote projecting the human voice at extreme volume, contrasting with normal vocalization (speak, say) by highlighting intense emotion, spatial distance, or loss of auditory restraint.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词表示以极高音量发声，区别于常态言语（如 speak, say），强调强烈情绪、远距传递或自控力丧失。
groups.nuance_en: call out: summoning or alerting over a distance (name / warning / challenge) · shout: generic high-volume vocal burst for communication (order / encouragement / insult) · holler: colloquial, rustic bellowing (instructions / greeting / abuse) · yell: sharp vocal emission driven by rage, panic, or urgency (pain / anger / orders) · bawl: crude, weeping or belligerent full-throat roaring (cries / commands / insults)
groups.nuance_zh: call out: 远距离呼唤或大声示警 (name / warning / challenge) · shout: 通用的大声喊叫 (order / encouragement / insult) · holler: 口语化粗犷高声喊嚷 (instructions / greeting / abuse) · yell: 因暴怒、惊恐或急迫发出的尖厉叫喊 (pain / anger / orders) · bawl: 夹杂痛哭或粗鲁放肆的扯着嗓子号叫 (cries / commands / insults)

groups.name: Adsorb & Surface-Bind · 吸附与界面结合 (Adsorb, Chemisorb, Physisorb)
groups.tip: 物质表面或内部吸附

items.def_en: To bind a substance to a surface through weak van der Waals forces without chemical bonding
items.ex_en: Noble gas molecules weakly physisorb onto graphene substrates at cryogenic laboratory temperatures.
items.ex_zh: 在实验室的深低温环境下，稀有气体分子通过弱力物理吸附在石墨烯衬底上。

items.def_en: (+ to) To adhere securely to a molecular receptor or solid surface substrate
items.ex_en: The signaling molecules bind specifically to cell surface receptors to trigger downstream enzymatic pathways.
items.ex_zh: 信号分子特异性地结合在细胞表面受体上，从而触发下游的酶反应通路。

items.def_en: (chemistry, physics) To gather a gas, liquid, or dissolved substance in a condensed layer on the surface of a solid.
items.ex_en: Porous activated carbon filters can effectively adsorb toxic volatile compounds from industrial wastewater streams.
items.ex_zh: 多孔活性炭过滤器能够高效吸附工业废水流中的有毒挥发性化合物。

items.def_en: To bind a substance to a surface through the formation of chemical bonds
items.ex_en: Oxygen molecules chemisorb irreversibly onto the clean metal catalyst surface during catalytic oxidation reactions.
items.ex_zh: 在催化氧化反应中，氧分子不可逆地化学吸附在洁净的金属催化剂表面。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe the physico-chemical phenomenon where atoms, ions, or molecules of a gas or liquid adhere specifically to the surface of a solid phase rather than penetrating into its interior.
groups.summary_zh: 物理或化学层面上，流体分子在固相表面聚集并结合粘附。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe the chemical or physical adhesion of fluid-phase molecules onto a solid or liquid interface, contrasting with bulk soaking (absorb) by occurring strictly at the surface phase boundary.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词指流体相分子粘附在固体或液体界面上的物理化学过程，区别于体相吸收（absorb），其作用严格局限于相界面表面。
groups.nuance_en: adsorb: generic gathering of molecules on an external surface (gas / moisture / ions) · bind: forming stable molecular or receptor attachments (receptor / substrate / target) · chemisorb: irreversibly binding via covalent or chemical bonds (molecules / catalyst / hydrogen) · physisorb: weakly attaching via van der Waals forces without chemical bonding (nitrogen / gas / atoms)
groups.nuance_zh: adsorb: 通用的外表面分子吸附 (gas / moisture / ions) · bind: 形成稳定的分子或受体结合 (receptor / substrate / target) · chemisorb: 通过化学键或共价作用发生强化学吸附 (molecules / catalyst / hydrogen) · physisorb: 仅靠范德华力发生的可逆物理吸附 (nitrogen / gas / atoms)

groups.name: Auscultate & Listen In · 听诊与体察 (Auscultate, Listen in, Hark)
groups.tip: 利用听诊器细听体内声音

items.def_en: To examine or test the health or depth of something by listening to produced resonance
items.ex_en: The physician used gentle percussion to sound the patient's chest cavity for fluid build-up.
items.ex_zh: 医生通过轻柔叩诊听测患者的胸腔，以探查是否有积液聚集。
items.ex2_en: The hollow brass bell sounded clearly across the quiet mountain valley.
items.ex2_zh: 中空的黄铜钟在寂静的山谷中发出清脆的回响。

items.def_en: (+ to/on) To listen deliberately and intently to sounds, often as an observer
items.ex_en: The curious intern tried to listen in to the faint cardiac murmur alongside the specialist.
items.ex_zh: 好奇的实习医生和专科医生一起，试图细听那微弱的心脏杂音。

items.def_en: (+ to) To listen with intense care, attentiveness, and diagnostic focus
items.ex_en: The experienced healer bent low to hearken to the irregular rhythm of the pulse.
items.ex_zh: 经验丰富的医者俯下身子，凝神细听那不规则的脉搏跳动。

items.def_en: (medicine) To listen to internal sounds of the body, especially the heart or lungs, typically using a stethoscope.
items.ex_en: The attending cardiologist will auscultate the patient's heart valves to evaluate the valve regurgitation.
items.ex_zh: 心内科主治医生将用听诊器对患者的心脏瓣膜进行听诊，以评估反流情况。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame involve listening with diagnostic or intent acoustic precision to internal or faint physiological sounds, typically using instruments or tuned auditory focus.
groups.summary_zh: 借助专业仪器或屏息细听体内器官机能或极其细微的声响。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe attentative, diagnostic, or covert auditory monitoring, contrasting with passive perception (hear) by requiring deliberate focus, specialized medical tools, or surreptitious intention.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词指带有诊断、专注或隐秘目的的主动聆听行为，区别于被动感知（hear），需要高度专注、医学工具或暗中刺探。
groups.nuance_en: auscultate: clinical listening to internal bodily sounds using a stethoscope (chest / heart / lungs) · listen in: surreptitiously or casually eavesdropping on a conversation (conversation / phone / chat) · sound: probing depths or testing internal acoustic resonance (depths / lungs / bell) · hearken: archaic or poetic solemn listening and heeding (voice / counsel / words)
groups.nuance_zh: auscultate: 运用听诊器临床体检聆听体内声音 (chest / heart / lungs) · listen in: 偷听或插耳探听他人谈话 (conversation / phone / chat) · sound: 探测深度或敲击探测共鸣 (depths / lungs / bell) · hearken: 典雅语体中的凝神倾听并遵从 (voice / counsel / words)

groups.name: Beak & Bill · 鸟喙啄咬与相触 (Beak, Bill, Pick)
groups.tip: 禽鸟用嘴尖戳啄取食

items.def_en: To stroke or touch bill-to-bill in bird courtship, or to nuzzle affectionately
items.ex_en: The two bonded mourning doves perched close on the branch to bill and coo softly.
items.ex_zh: 那对恩爱的哀鸽紧紧依偎在枝头，亲昵地相碰喙部、低声鸣叫。

items.def_en: To pull at, tear away, or peck small bits of something repeatedly with a beak
items.ex_en: A hungry sparrow landed on the feeder to pick at the remaining sunflower seeds.
items.ex_zh: 一只饥饿的麻雀落在喂食器上，用喙啄弄撕扯残留的葵花籽。

items.def_en: (of a bird) To strike, peck, or seize something with the beak.
items.ex_en: The territorial hawk swooped down to beak the intruder away from its high nest.
items.ex_zh: 那只护巢的猎鹰猛扑而下，用利喙啄击入侵者将其赶离高处的巢穴。

items.def_en: To clean, smooth, and arrange feathers meticulously using the beak
items.ex_en: The graceful swan paused by the lakeside to meticulously preen its ruffled white plumage.
items.ex_zh: 优雅的天鹅在湖畔停下，用喙细心整理自己略显凌乱的洁白羽毛。

groups.summary_en: This ornithological manipulation frame focuses strictly on avian actions using the beak or bill to probe, grasp, caress, or strike objects and companions.
groups.summary_zh: 专指鸟类用喙进行的啄击、夹取、互理羽毛或亲昵相触。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote avian bill actions for touching, feeding, or grooming, contrasting with generic biting (bite) through the rigid, non-dentated morphology of the beak and associated social or self-maintenance rituals.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词指鸟类使用鸟喙进行接触、啄食或梳羽的动作，区别于一般的咬（bite），体现鸟喙无齿硬质特征及相关的梳洗或求偶仪式。
groups.nuance_en: beak: touching or seizing with the bill (food / rival / partner) · bill: affectionate beak-to-beak rubbing or touching (doves / mate / courtship) · pick at: repeatedly nibbling or pecking small bits without appetite (food / carcass / feathers) · preen: cleaning, smoothing, and aligning feathers with the bill (feathers / plumage / self)
groups.nuance_zh: beak: 用喙啄住、试探或啄击 (food / rival / partner) · bill: 亲昵地双喙相触碰 (doves / mate / courtship) · pick at: 无食欲地零碎细啄 (food / carcass / feathers) · preen: 用嘴整理、理顺与清洁羽毛 (feathers / plumage / self)

groups.name: Belch & Burp · 打嗝与嗳气 (Belch, Eruct, Hick)
groups.tip: 胃部气体由食道上涌反胃出声

items.def_en: (formal/medical) To belch forth stomach wind or matter
items.ex_en: Patients with acute gastric distension frequently eruct to relieve intense intra-abdominal pressure.
items.ex_zh: 急性胃扩张患者常常频繁嗳气，以缓解腹腔内的巨大压力。

items.def_en: To make a sudden gulping sound caused by involuntary spasms of the diaphragm
items.ex_en: Drinking cold ice water too quickly caused him to hiccup continuously for several minutes.
items.ex_zh: 冰水喝得太急导致他不由自主地连续打了好几分钟嗝。

items.def_en: 1. (informal) To release air noisily from the stomach through the mouth. 2. To gently rub or pat a baby's back to make it burp.
items.ex_en: After feeding the milk bottle, the mother sat up to burp her sleepy baby.
items.ex_zh: 喂完奶瓶后，母亲坐起身来给昏昏欲睡的宝宝拍嗝。

items.def_en: To release gas noisily from the stomach through the mouth, often forcefully
items.ex_en: He did not even apologize when he proceeded to belch loudly after the heavy banquet.
items.ex_zh: 在享用丰盛的宴席后他肆无忌惮地打了个大响嗝，甚至都没道歉。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame designate involuntary or deliberate expulsions of trapped stomach gas upward through the esophagus and mouth, often accompanied by sound.
groups.summary_zh: 涉及胃部气体经食道自口腔排出的生理发声反应。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe involuntary or deliberate oral ejections of stomach gas or diaphragm spasms, contrasting with respiratory coughing (cough) by originating in the upper digestive tract.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词指胃部气体经口腔排出或膈肌痉挛的生理动作，区别于呼吸道排痰咳嗽（cough），源于上消化道或隔膜。
groups.nuance_en: belch: loudly and forcefully expelling stomach gas or smoke (gas / smoke / flames) · burp: everyday, milder release of air after feeding (infant / baby / gently) · eruct: formal, clinical expulsion of stomach gas (gas / contents / acid) · hiccup: spasmodic diaphragm contraction producing sharp sounds (spasm / rhythm / fit)
groups.nuance_zh: belch: 响亮粗野地喷吐胃气或烟火 (gas / smoke / flames) · burp: 日常较温和地排气或给婴儿拍嗝 (infant / baby / gently) · eruct: 医学或正式语体中的嗳气 (gas / contents / acid) · hiccup: 膈肌痉挛导致的打呃 (spasm / rhythm / fit)

groups.name: Break Strike · 破卡与破坏罢工 (Scab, Strike-break)
groups.tip: 罢工期间擅自顶替复工

items.def_en: To act as a strikebreaker by continuing to work or hiring substitute labor
items.ex_en: Company management recruited hundreds of temporary agency laborers to strike-break during the national walkout.
items.ex_zh: 在全国大罢工期间，公司管理层招募了数百名中介临时工来破坏罢工。

items.def_en: To enter a workplace to work despite fellow workers picketing and striking outside
items.ex_en: Desperate replacement workers decided to cross the picket line amidst loud jeers from striking miners.
items.ex_zh: 绝望的替工在罢工矿工的大声喝倒彩中，决定越过纠察线进厂上工。

items.def_en: To work during a strike or replace an employee who is striking
items.ex_en: Union leaders publicly condemned those desperate employees who chose to scab for extra overtime pay.
items.ex_zh: 工会领袖公开谴责了那些为了额外加班费而选择当工贼上工的员工。

items.def_zh: 当工贼，（在罢工期间）擅自上工
items.def_en: (chiefly British, derogatory) To continue working while fellow workers are on strike.
items.ex_en: Angry factory workers shouted furiously at any traitor who dared to blackleg during the walkout.
items.ex_zh: 愤怒的工厂工人们冲着在罢工期间胆敢擅自上工的工贼破口大骂。

groups.summary_en: This frame encompasses specific workplace actions where an individual undermines collective labor solidarity by refusing to strike or taking a striking worker's job.
groups.summary_zh: 指在工潮中背弃集体团结、充当工贼破坏罢工。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame depict the deliberate undermining of an active labor strike by continuing employment or replacing striking workers, contrasting with standard employment (work) by carrying strong sociopolitical betrayal connotations.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词描述在工会罢工期间顶替工作或强行复工的行为，区别于普通“工作 (work)”，带有强烈的劳资斗争与背叛群体共识的色彩。
groups.nuance_en: strike-break: actively organizing or participating in dismantling a strike (union / strike / protest) · cross the picket line: physically or symbolically defying fellow striking workers (workers / picket line / colleagues) · scab: derogatory term for taking a striking worker's job (plant / jobs / union) · blackleg: British derogatory equivalent for betraying a strike (workers / trade union / mine)
groups.nuance_zh: strike-break: 组织或参与瓦解罢工活动 (union / strike / protest) · cross the picket line: 越过纠察线强行上工 (workers / picket line / colleagues) · scab: 贬义指充当工贼顶替罢工者 (plant / jobs / union) · blackleg: 英式贬义工贼叛徒 (workers / trade union / mine)

groups.name: Choir & Harmonize · 诗班合唱 (Choir, Harmonize, Intone)
groups.tip: 多声部合唱或众人齐声歌唱

items.def_en: to say or sing slowly without much variation in pitch, as in prayer
items.ex_en: The robed priest continued to intone the ancient Latin prayers over the silent kneeling congregation.
items.ex_zh: 身披长袍的神父继续向沉默跪拜的信众慢腔唱诵着古老的拉丁语祷文。

items.def_en: to sing or repeat rhythmic, measured phrases together in religious or ritual style
items.ex_en: Devout monks gathered in the monastery courtyard to chant sacred scriptures in rhythmic harmony.
items.ex_zh: 虔诚的僧侣们聚集在寺院中庭，伴着富有节奏的和谐音律齐声诵唱圣典。

items.def_en: (literary) to sing in a choir or together in harmony
items.ex_en: The heavenly host seemed to choir with sweet melodic perfection across the vast cathedral ceiling.
items.ex_zh: 天上的诗班仿佛在大教堂宽阔的穹顶下齐声合唱，旋律优美绝伦。

items.def_en: to sing or play combined musical notes that produce pleasing chordal harmony
items.ex_en: The talented vocal trio managed to harmonize their distinct voices into one flawless chord.
items.ex_zh: 这支才华横溢的三重唱组合巧妙地将各自独特的嗓音协调合唱成纯净的和弦。
items.ex2_en: The instruments harmonized beautifully during the symphony's moving final movement.
items.ex2_zh: 在交响乐感人的末乐章中，乐器之间演奏出了优美的和声。

groups.summary_en: This scenario frame specifies artistic, liturgical, or communal choral singing, emphasizing structured polyphony, musical parts, and harmonious liturgical performance.
groups.summary_zh: 合唱团声部协作、多声部和声歌唱及仪式性诵唱场景。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame depict unified, multi-voiced vocal or musical production characterized by polyphony, liturgical solemnity, or tonal blending, contrasting with solo singing (sing) through collective resonant synergy.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词指多声部、礼仪性或讲求声部调和的集体歌唱发声，区别于一般独唱（sing），强调集体共鸣、复调或宗教庄严感。
groups.nuance_en: choir: singing collectively as a formal choral body (praises / anthems / voices) · harmonize: singing or blending in tonal musical chords (voices / melody / tune) · intone: chanting in solemn, slow liturgical monotones (prayer / psalm / blessing) · chant: rhythmic, repetitive unison vocal recitation (slogan / mantra / hymn)
groups.nuance_zh: choir: 作为合唱队合声齐唱 (praises / anthems / voices) · harmonize: 唱和声或使声调和谐 (voices / melody / tune) · intone: 庄重缓和、单调诵唱经文 (prayer / psalm / blessing) · chant: 齐声节奏性反复诵唱或喊口号 (slogan / mantra / hymn)

groups.name: Cower & Cringe · 畏缩与谄缩 (Cringe, Shrink back, Grovel)
groups.tip: 因恐惧或羞惭而退缩蜷缩

items.def_en: To pull one's body backward involuntarily away from danger, touch, or repulsion
items.ex_en: The frightened kitten began to shrink back into the dark corner away from the barking dog.
items.ex_zh: 受惊的小猫缩退身子躲进漆黑的墙角，不敢靠近狂吠的恶犬。

items.def_en: 1. To shrink back or bend your head and body in fear, servility, or pain. 2. To feel acute embarrassment or awkwardness.
items.ex_en: He could not help but cringe in acute embarrassment at his disastrously awkward joke.
items.ex_zh: 听到自己讲出的尴尬烂梗，他忍不住感到一阵强烈的难堪与羞窘。

items.def_en: To reel or retreat physically while showing visible loss of composure and nerve
items.ex_en: The arrogant commander did visibly quail back when the fierce rebellion breached the fortress gates.
items.ex_zh: 当凶猛的叛军攻破要塞大门时，那位傲慢的指挥官明显吓得畏缩退避。

items.def_zh: 匍匐屈从；低三下四畏缩
items.def_en: To lie or creep with one's body prone on the ground in servile submission or sheer terror
items.ex_en: The captured traitor chose to grovel at the king's feet, pleading desperately for royal mercy.
items.ex_zh: 被俘的叛徒匍匐在国王脚下卑躬屈膝，绝望地乞求陛下的宽恕。

groups.summary_en: Physical bodily postures adopted when bending down or drawing back out of fear, subservience, sudden distress, or agonizing social vicarious embarrassment.
groups.summary_zh: 强调身体受惊吓、羞耻感或奴颜卑躬驱使下而畏缩、弓背退后的躯体姿态。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe bodily shrinking, lowering, or trembling driven by acute fear, guilt, or servile submission, contrasting with strategic retreat (retreat) through overt physical humiliation and visceral dread.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词描述因极度恐惧、羞愧或卑躬屈膝而身体蜷缩下沉的状态，区别于战术撤退（retreat），具有屈辱和本能性畏怯的身体表征。
groups.nuance_en: cringe: flinching from embarrassment, disgust, or anticipated blow (blow / sight / disgust) · shrink back: instinctively recoiling away from danger or horror (horror / shadows / touch) · quail back: losing courage and withering in terror (threat / gaze / fear) · grovel: abjectly prostrating oneself in servile submission (feet / forgiveness / dust)
groups.nuance_zh: cringe: 因难堪、厌恶或预感击打而退缩 (blow / sight / disgust) · shrink back: 本能恐惧地向后蜷缩避缩 (horror / shadows / touch) · quail back: 畏惧战栗胆怯退却 (threat / gaze / fear) · grovel: 奴颜婢膝地俯首摇尾乞怜 (feet / forgiveness / dust)

groups.name: Dig & Exhume · 发掘与掘出 (Exhume, Disinter, Dig up)
groups.tip: 深挖泥土起出遗物

items.def_en: to remove something buried in the earth by cutting and loosening the surrounding ground
items.ex_en: The media managed to dig up some scandalous details about his past.
items.ex_zh: 媒体设法翻出了他过去的一些丑闻细节。

items.def_en: to find or bring to light something buried underground through excavation
items.ex_en: Archaeologists managed to unearth several pristine Roman mosaic floors during the rescue excavation campaign.
items.ex_zh: 考古学家在这次抢救性发掘工作中出土了几处保存完好的古罗马马赛克地板。

items.def_en: To dig a dead body out of the ground after burial, especially for legal or medical investigation.
items.ex_en: Forensic authorities received legal permission to exhume the buried body for crucial forensic toxicology tests.
items.ex_zh: 法医部门获得了法律许可，掘出埋葬的尸体以进行关键的毒理学鉴定。

items.def_en: to dig up a dead body or item that has been formally buried, especially for legal inquiry
items.ex_en: State investigators were finally authorized to disinter the skeletal remains of the long-missing victim.
items.ex_zh: 州调查人员终于获准掘出那位失踪已久的受害者的遗骨。

groups.summary_en: Refers to intentionally removing buried human remains, antiquities, or concealed objects from beneath the soil for legal, archaeological, or investigative scrutiny.
groups.summary_zh: 指从地下掘出遗体、文物或隐匿物以供勘验、考古或调查。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe the deliberate excavation and extraction of buried objects, human remains, or long-concealed truths from underground, contrasting with simple ground-breaking (dig) by aiming at recovery or exposure.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词指通过挖掘将深埋地下的遗体、物品或隐秘真相提取出来，区别于一般的破土动作（dig），侧重于揭示、发掘或重见天日。
groups.nuance_en: dig up: colloquial physical extraction or investigative unearthing (bones / dirt / secrets) · unearth: discovering buried antiquities or hidden evidence (relics / evidence / scandal) · exhume: legally digging up a buried corpse for forensic examination (body / corpse / remains) · disinter: formal equivalent to recovering interred remains or forgotten history (remains / grave / memories)
groups.nuance_zh: dig up: 通用铲出地下物或调查掘出隐私 (bones / dirt / secrets) · unearth: 发掘出土文物或查出隐匿线索 (relics / evidence / scandal) · exhume: 司法检验合法开棺掘尸 (body / corpse / remains) · disinter: 庄重书面语中的掘出遗骸或重提旧事 (remains / grave / memories)

groups.name: Discover & Detect · 发现与探查 (Discover, Detect, Spot)
groups.tip: 从觉察端倪到查明真相

items.def_en: to visually catch sight of someone or something, often among clutter or from a distance
items.ex_en: The sharp-eyed guide managed to spot a well-camouflaged leopard resting in the dense acacia branches.
items.ex_zh: 眼尖的向导在茂密的金合欢树枝间认出了一只伪装巧妙的花豹。

items.def_en: To find or learn about something for the first time, or to become aware of something.
items.ex_en: Marine researchers hope to discover new species of bioluminescent organisms in the abyssal oceanic trenches.
items.ex_zh: 海洋研究人员希望在深邃的深海海沟中发现新的生物发光物种。

items.def_en: to notice or identify the presence of something subtle, hidden, or barely perceptible
items.ex_en: Sensitive monitoring equipment can detect minute traces of chemical contamination in municipal drinking water.
items.ex_zh: 灵敏的监测设备能够察觉出市政饮用水中极微量的化学污染痕迹。

items.def_en: to recognize or perceive clearly through careful intellectual or visual effort
items.ex_en: Through the heavy storm, the ship captain could barely discern the lighthouse's distant flashing signal.
items.ex_zh: 穿过狂风暴雨，船长只能勉强辨别出灯塔远处闪烁的微弱信号。

groups.summary_en: Spans the spectrum of identifying unfamiliar facts, concealed cues, or physical anomalies, escalating from effortless sighting to subtle sensory or technological detection.
groups.summary_zh: 涵盖从一眼瞥见到通过敏锐观察或仪器捕捉到隐秘迹象的发现过程。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe recognizing previously hidden, elusive, or obscure stimuli, contrasting with casual vision (see) by involving active perceptual effort, technical instruments, or sudden realization.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词表示察觉或识别先前隐匿、细微或不明的目标，区别于日常无意识的注视（see），强调观察敏锐度、借助仪器或豁然省悟。
groups.nuance_en: spot: swiftly catching sight of a distinct target amidst surroundings (target / flaw / error) · discover: finding something unknown through exploration or serendipity (planet / truth / island) · detect: identifying faint signals, substances, or hidden patterns (trace / virus / signal) · discern: perceiving subtle, indistinct distinctions through acute faculties (difference / figure / intention)
groups.nuance_zh: spot: 一眼瞥见、迅速识别出显眼目标 (target / flaw / error) · discover: 探索或机缘巧合下首次发现 (planet / truth / island) · detect: 探知微弱痕迹、物质或潜伏规律 (trace / virus / signal) · discern: 凭借敏锐洞察辨明细微差异 (difference / figure / intention)

groups.name: Groan & Moan · 呻吟与叹怨 (Moan, Grunt, Utter Pain)
groups.tip: 因痛苦或无奈发出沉重叹声

items.def_en: To make a short, low, guttural sound due to effort, pain, or reluctance
items.ex_en: The moving laborer let out a loud grunt as he lifted the heavy crate.
items.ex_zh: 搬运工抬起沉重的板条箱时，从喉咙里发出一声吃力的闷哼。

items.def_en: To make a long, low sound expressing physical or mental suffering
items.ex_en: The injured athlete began to moan softly in agony until medical personnel finally arrived.
items.ex_zh: 受伤的运动员痛苦地低声呻吟，直到医护人员终于赶到现场。

items.def_zh: 呻吟，叹息；呻吟着抱怨；发出吱吱嘎嘎声（如重压之下）
items.def_en: 1. (+ with/at) To make a long, deep sound of physical pain, grief, or disapproval, or say something while groaning. 2. (+ under) To make a strained creaking sound under heavy pressure.
items.ex_en: The weary passengers began to groan loudly when the gate agent announced another flight delay.
items.ex_zh: 当登机口工作人员宣布航班再次延误时，疲惫的乘客们齐声唉声叹气起来。

items.def_en: To express deep grief, distress, or disapproval over something
items.ex_en: Critics continue to bemoan the rapid loss of traditional craftsmanship in our modern mechanized society.
items.ex_zh: 批评家们继续对现代机械化社会中传统工艺的急剧消亡深感悲叹。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on uttering deep, low, prolonged, inarticulate vocal sounds expressing severe bodily torment, grief, despair, or heavy emotional dissatisfaction.
groups.summary_zh: 指因剧烈肉体痛苦、悲伤或极度不满而发出低沉、持久的呻吟声。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote low, inarticulate guttural sounds expressing physical pain, exhaustion, or discontent, contrasting with loud crying (weep, cry) by being muted, continuous, and rooted in physical strain.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词指因肉体剧痛、极度劳累或心怀不满而发出的低沉、非清晰言语的喉音，区别于高亢哭泣（cry），侧重沉郁压抑的呻吟叹怨。
groups.nuance_en: groan: deep, heavy sound prompted by severe pain or vocalized despair (pain / agony / despair) · moan: prolonged, sorrowful or sensual low cry of distress (suffering / wind / pleasure) · grunt: short, gruff guttural burst from sudden effort or reluctance (effort / displeasure / acknowledgment) · bemoan: expressing verbal lamentation or regret over an unfavorable condition (fate / state / loss)
groups.nuance_zh: groan: 剧烈痛苦或绝望中发出的沉重沉吟 (pain / agony / despair) · moan: 悲哀、痛苦或快意中悠长的低泣呻吟 (suffering / wind / pleasure) · grunt: 用力或勉强应答时发出的粗短鼻喉音 (effort / displeasure / acknowledgment) · bemoan: 书面语中对处境的不满哀叹与痛惜 (fate / state / loss)

groups.name: Grow & Mature · 羽化与成熟 (Fledge, Mature, Ripen)
groups.tip: 幼鸟初生渐次长成丰羽

items.def_zh: （幼鸟）长齐飞羽，长羽毛；喂养（幼鸟）至能飞
items.def_en: (of a young bird) To grow wing feathers and develop the ability to fly; to care for a young bird until it can fly.
items.ex_en: Both adult falcons hunted incessantly until their young chicks grew strong enough to fledge.
items.ex_zh: 两只成年猎鹰不停地捕食，直到它们抚养的幼鸟羽翼渐丰能够离巢飞翔。
items.ex2_en: The diligent eagle parents worked tirelessly to fledge their two healthy eaglets.
items.ex2_zh: 勤劳的雕父母不知疲倦地工作，把两只健康的小雕喂养至羽翼丰满。

items.def_en: to develop to full readiness for harvest, consumption, or prime biological function
items.ex_en: The vineyard manager waited patiently for the sweet wine grapes to ripen under autumnal sun.
items.ex_zh: 葡萄园经理耐心地等待甜酿酒葡萄在秋日暖阳下完全成熟。
items.ex2_en: The warm summer sunshine will quickly ripen the sweet green figs.
items.ex2_zh: 温暖的夏日阳光会迅速催熟甜美的绿无花果。

items.def_en: to reach full physical, mental, or biological development as an adult
items.ex_en: These small saplings require several decades to mature into fully grown forest giants.
items.ex_zh: 这些小树苗需要几十年的时间才能长成参天大树。
items.ex2_en: Good barrels mature fine red wine to bring out richer subtle flavors.
items.ex2_zh: 优质的木桶使上等红酒熟化，激发出更丰富微妙的风味。

items.def_en: to undergo a complete developmental transformation from one life stage into another
items.ex_en: The aquatic larvae eventually metamorphose into winged adults during late spring.
items.ex_zh: 水生幼虫最终会在晚春蜕变发育为有翅成虫。
items.ex2_en: Extreme heat and pressure metamorphose soft sedimentary shale into hard metamorphic slate.
items.ex2_zh: 极高的温度和压力将柔软的沉积页岩转变成坚硬的变质板岩。

groups.summary_en: Charts the biological progression of an organism, plant, or offspring from vulnerable dependence toward full morphological plumage, adulthood, or functional capability.
groups.summary_zh: 指生物由幼态、稚嫩走向羽翼丰满、机能完备或性成熟的生长过程。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe reaching an advanced biological, morphological, or psychological state of completeness, contrasting with basic physical expansion (grow) by focusing on functional readiness and qualitative transformation.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词指生物学、形态或心理上达到机能完备的高阶转化阶段，区别于单纯的体积增大（grow），侧重成熟、自立与质的飞跃。
groups.nuance_en: fledge: acquiring flight feathers and preparing for independent survival (nestling / chicks / organization) · ripen: reaching biological prime, softness, or readiness for harvest (fruit / grain / conditions) · mature: developing full physical, cognitive, or financial potential (adult / wine / bond) · metamorphose: undergoing radical structural or morphological transmutation (caterpillar / character / industry)
groups.nuance_zh: fledge: 长出飞羽羽翼丰满以求自立 (nestling / chicks / organization) · ripen: 果实成熟或时机完全成熟 (fruit / grain / conditions) · mature: 身体、心智或资本完全成熟稳定 (adult / wine / bond) · metamorphose: 经历彻底质变与形变蜕变 (caterpillar / character / industry)

groups.name: Miscarry & Pregnancy Loss · 妊娠中止与流产 (Miscarry, Abort, Lose)
groups.tip: 妊娠分娩与繁衍后代

items.def_en: To suffer the spontaneous loss of an unborn child through miscarriage or stillbirth
items.ex_en: She was devastated to lose her baby during the second trimester of pregnancy.
items.ex_zh: 她在孕中期不幸流产，整个人痛苦万分。

items.def_en: (of female animals, especially livestock) to deliver a fetus prematurely and dead
items.ex_en: The harsh winter blizzard caused several pregnant ewes to slip their lambs prematurely.
items.ex_zh: 严酷的冬日暴风雪导致几只怀孕的母羊早产流产。

items.def_en: To deliberately terminate or spontaneously expel a pregnancy before viable birth
items.ex_en: The patient faced severe complications that forced medical staff to abort the pregnancy.
items.ex_zh: 该患者面临严重的并发症，医护人员不得不终止妊娠。
items.ex2_en: The secret military mission aborted automatically when unexpected equipment failures occurred.
items.ex2_zh: 当发生意外的设备故障时，这项绝密军事任务自动中止了。

items.def_en: 1. (medical) To give birth to a fetus before it is able to survive independently. 2. (of a plan, endeavor, or justice) To go wrong, fail, or not succeed.
items.ex_en: All our hopeful endeavors miscarried when the sudden economic crisis struck the realm.
items.ex_zh: 当突如其来的经济危机席卷王国时，我们满怀希望的努力皆尽落空。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame refer to premature termination or loss of a pregnancy before birth, distinguishing spontaneous loss from medical or intentional termination.
groups.summary_zh: 描述妊娠意外中断、自发流产或人工终止妊娠的相关生理事件。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame denote the premature termination of gestation and subsequent death of the fetus, contrasting with planned birth (deliver, bear) through tragedy, natural failure, or deliberate medical intervention.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词表示妊娠提前终止及胚胎死亡的过程，区别于正常的足月分娩（bear, deliver），带有不幸夭折、自然衰亡或人为流产色彩。
groups.nuance_en: miscarry: experiencing spontaneous natural termination of pregnancy (baby / pregnancy / child) · abort: terminating pregnancy prematurely, often deliberately or technically (fetus / mission / pregnancy) · lose: euphemistic and emotionally laden loss of an unborn child (baby / child / twin) · slip: veterinary term for spontaneous abortion in livestock (foal / calf / litter)
groups.nuance_zh: miscarry: 自发自然流产 (baby / pregnancy / child) · abort: 人工终止妊娠或技术性流产 (fetus / mission / pregnancy) · lose: 委婉深情表达痛失腹中胎儿 (baby / child / twin) · slip: 兽医学专指牲畜自然滑胎下胎 (foal / calf / litter)

groups.name: Occur & Coincide · 巧合与同步 (Coincide, Synchronize, Overlap)
groups.tip: 事件在时空上碰巧同时发生

items.def_en: to share part of the same timeframe, responsibility, or coverage
items.ex_en: Our work schedules overlap slightly, allowing us to coordinate the project handover smoothly.
items.ex_zh: 我们的工作日程有一小部分重叠，这让我们能顺利交接项目。
items.ex2_en: The carpenter decided to overlap the wooden roofing shingles to prevent rain leaks.
items.ex2_zh: 木工决定将木制屋顶瓦片重叠铺设，以防止雨水渗漏。

items.def_en: 1. To happen at the exact same time. 2. (of ideas, opinions, or interests) To meet or agree fully.
items.ex_en: The annual conference was arranged to coincide with the opening of the exhibition.
items.ex_zh: 年度会议特意安排在与展会开幕同一天举行。

items.def_en: (of events or circumstances) to happen together at the same time; to agree in opinion
items.ex_en: Several unfortunate circumstances concurred to produce the catastrophic failure of the expedition.
items.ex_zh: 多重不利情况同时交织发生，导致了这次探险的灾难性失败。

items.def_en: to cause events or mechanisms to operate at the exact same time and rate
items.ex_en: The technicians must synchronize the camera shutters to capture the high-speed motion accurately.
items.ex_zh: 技术人员必须使相机的快门保持同步，以精确捕捉高速动作。
items.ex2_en: The dancer's movements synchronized effortlessly with the fast tempo of the music.
items.ex2_zh: 舞者的动作与音乐明快的节奏毫不费力地保持了同步。

groups.summary_en: Captures temporal or situational alignment, where separate events occur at the exact same juncture or multiple interests harmoniously match by chance or design.
groups.summary_zh: 指不同事件在时间、空间或立场上的同时发生、巧合相遇或完全吻合。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe the simultaneous occurrence, spatial intersection, or deliberate temporal alignment of independent events, contrasting with sequential causation (follow) through temporal concordance.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词描述独立事件在时间上的偶合重叠、空间交汇或统一步调，区别于前后相随的因果关系（follow），强调共时性与协同。
groups.nuance_en: coincide: occurring at the exact same time purely by chance or planning (dates / timing / opinions) · synchronize: coordinating separate mechanisms or actions into identical timing (clocks / efforts / watches) · overlap: sharing a common temporal window or area of jurisdiction (schedules / interests / duties) · concur: formal convergence of events or agreement in opinion (events / opinions / views)
groups.nuance_zh: coincide: 偶然或巧合的时间重叠或意见一致 (dates / timing / opinions) · synchronize: 人为校准、同步使各方节拍一致 (clocks / efforts / watches) · overlap: 部分时间段或职责范围交叉重叠 (schedules / interests / duties) · concur: 正式语体中事件共时发生或见解完全赞同 (events / opinions / views)

groups.name: Parachute & Airdrop · 伞降与空中投放 (Parachute, Airdrop, Drop in)
groups.tip: 空中跳下并跳伞降落

items.def_en: To drop supplies, equipment, or troops from an aircraft by parachute into a designated area
items.ex_en: Military transport planes will airdrop emergency food supplies to the isolated mountain village.
items.ex_zh: 军用运输机将向受困的高山村庄空投紧急食品物资。

items.def_en: (+ to) To parachute directly into a specific drop zone or hostile territory
items.ex_en: Special forces prepared to drop in behind enemy lines under cover of darkness.
items.ex_zh: 特种部队准备在夜色掩护下空投伞降至敌后区域。

items.def_en: To jump out of an aircraft in an emergency using a parachute
items.ex_en: When the engine caught fire, the pilot had no choice but to bail out.
items.ex_zh: 发动机起火后，飞行员别无选择，只能跳伞逃生。

items.def_zh: 空降，跳伞；空投；空降（任职）
items.def_en: 1. (+ into) To jump from an aircraft using a parachute, or drop people or supplies by parachute. 2. To appoint someone unexpectedly to a senior position.
items.ex_en: Aid agencies plan to parachute medical parcels into the flood-ravaged border region.
items.ex_zh: 救援机构计划将医疗包裹空投至遭受洪灾的边境地区。
items.ex2_en: Elite rescue soldiers parachuted smoothly into the remote mountainous forest at dusk.
items.ex2_zh: 精锐救援士兵在黄昏时平稳地跳伞降落到偏远的森林山区。

groups.summary_en: Centers on descent from an airborne platform using decelerating canopies, or air-dropping personnel and supplies into targeted zones. Also used metaphorically for inserting specialists into troubled situations.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过降落伞从飞行器安全降落或实施空投救援/部署。
groups.desc_en: Verbs in this frame describe deploying troops, supplies, or personnel from aircraft into a target area via parachute, contrasting with regular aviation transit (fly, land) through high-risk descent directly into tactical zones.
groups.desc_zh: 本框架动词指借助降落伞从航空器投送兵力、给养或跳伞逃生，区别于常规飞行着陆（land），强调空投渗透或应急空降战术特征。
groups.nuance_en: airdrop: delivering supplies or military equipment by cargo parachutes (supplies / aid / cargo) · parachute: descending by parachute into an area (soldiers / agent / gear) · drop in: inserting specialists or troops covertly, or casually visiting (behind lines / reinforcements / visitor) · bail out: emergency abandoning of an aircraft mid-flight by parachute (pilot / crew / plane)
groups.nuance_zh: airdrop: 空投军资、救援物资或装备 (supplies / aid / cargo) · parachute: 人员或装备跳伞降落 (soldiers / agent / gear) · drop in: 敌后空降渗透部署或随性顺道拜访 (behind lines / reinforcements / visitor) · bail out: 飞机遇险时紧急跳伞弃机 (pilot / crew / plane)

groups.name: Rediscover & Reconnect · 重新发现与拾回 (Rediscover, Reclaim, Reconnect)
groups.tip: 重新发掘掩盖的真相

items.def_en: to find or come across something unexpectedly after it has been long out of sight
items.ex_en: While cleaning the attic, I managed to stumble upon my grandfather's old war journals.
items.ex_zh: 在打扫阁楼时，我偶然翻出了祖父当年的战地日记。

items.def_en: to restore interest in or active use of an old custom, memory, or feeling
items.ex_en: The community festival helped revive traditional folk customs that had almost disappeared.
items.ex_zh: 这次社区节庆活动重振了那些几近消失的传统民俗。
items.ex2_en: Faded childhood memories revived slowly as she explored her grandmother's old house.
items.ex2_zh: 当她探索祖母的老房子时，褪色的童年记忆慢慢苏醒了。

items.def_en: to recover possession, dignity, or cultural connection to something lost or neglected
items.ex_en: Indigenous leaders campaigned tirelessly to reclaim ancestral lands taken during colonization.
items.ex_zh: 原住民领袖孜孜不倦地发起抗争，以收复殖民时期失去的祖传土地。

items.def_en: To find, experience, or become interested in something again after it had been forgotten or lost.
items.ex_en: Retirement gave him the precious leisure to rediscover his passion for oil painting.
items.ex_zh: 退休生活赋予他宝贵的闲暇，让他重新找回了对油画的热爱。

groups.summary_en: Focuses on encountering, appreciating, or revitalizing ideas, talents, or relationships that were previously known but lapsed, neglected, or forgotten over time.
groups.summary_zh: 侧重对曾熟知但后来遗忘或忽视的事物重新产生认知与连接。
groups.desc_en: Involves retrieving, unearthing, or restoring contact with an entity or memory previously lost, forgotten, or neglected, contrasting with initial discovery or creation by presupposing prior existence and estrangement.
groups.desc_zh: 涉及对先前失去、遗忘或疏离的人事物或记忆重新发掘、恢复联系或认领，与纯粹的“初次发现”或“创造”相比，预设了前置存在与断连历史。
groups.nuance_en: stumble upon: accidental, serendipitous encounter (old letter / antique / clue) · rediscover: conscious or experiential realization of forgotten value (passion / author / roots) · reclaim: actively assert ownership over what was surrendered or alienated (heritage / title / land) · revive: re-infuse life or practice into something dormant (tradition / interest / consciousness)
groups.nuance_zh: stumble upon: 偶然、机缘巧合下的意外撞见 (old letter / antique / clue) · rediscover: 重新意识到被遗忘事物的价值或重温体验 (passion / author / roots) · reclaim: 积极收回或重新主张原本属于自己的所有权 (heritage / title / land) · revive: 为处于休眠或消亡状态的事物重新注入生机 (tradition / interest / consciousness)

groups.name: Severe Starvation & Hunger · 极度饥饿与饥渴 (Famish, Starve, Perish)
groups.tip: 极度匮乏食物濒临饿死

items.def_en: To feel a powerful and agonizing desire or hunger for food or substance
items.ex_en: The starving castaways began to crave fresh water and simple bread constantly.
items.ex_zh: 饥饿的落难者开始时刻极度渴望淡水和普通的面包。

items.def_en: To become steadily weaker, thinner, and waste away through starvation or grief
items.ex_en: Locked in the lonely tower, the grief-stricken captive began to slowly pine away.
items.ex_zh: 被锁在孤塔之中的囚徒悲恸欲绝，身体日渐消瘦虚弱。

items.def_en: (dated or literary) To suffer extreme hunger, or to cause someone to starve.
items.ex_en: The cruel warlord vowed to famish the besieged citadel into absolute submission.
items.ex_zh: 残暴的军阀发誓要让这座被围困的城堡在极度饥饿中彻底臣服。
items.ex2_en: The isolated mountain villagers began to famish during the harsh endless winter.
items.ex2_zh: 在严酷无尽的冬季里，孤立的山村民们开始挨饿受冻。

items.def_en: To suffer severely or die from lack of nourishment, or subject someone to starvation
items.ex_en: Drought caused severe crop failure, leaving millions of innocent civilians to starve.
items.ex_zh: 干旱导致农作物严重绝收，使得数百万无辜平民陷入饥饿。
items.ex2_en: The cruel captors decided to starve their helpless prisoners into total compliance.
items.ex2_zh: 残酷的俘获者决定让无助的囚犯挨饿，以使他们彻底顺从。

groups.summary_en: This frame centers on the intense physical suffering, physical wasting, or colloquial hyperbole caused by an acute deficit of sustenance.
groups.summary_zh: 指极度缺乏食物所引发的肉体煎熬、濒临饿死或口语夸张的饿态。
groups.desc_en: Covers states or outcomes of extreme nutritional deprivation and somatic wasting, differing from ordinary appetite by highlighting systemic physical collapse, lethal risk, or desperate physiological pining.
groups.desc_zh: 涵盖极端营养匮乏与肉体消瘦的生理状态或结果，与普通“饥饿或渴望”不同，强调系统性身体衰竭、致死风险或极度煎熬的机体渴望。
groups.nuance_en: starve: suffer or perish from protracted, severe nutrient deprivation (population / captive / body) · famish: intense, debilitating acute hunger, often hyperbolized (refugees / appetite / beast) · pine away: waste away physically from prolonged grief, yearning, or lack of sustenance (patient / lover / captive) · crave: intense psychological and physiological fixation for consumption (nourishment / sugar / fix)
groups.nuance_zh: starve: 因长期严重缺乏食物而遭受折磨或濒临死亡 (population / captive / body) · famish: 剧烈且使人衰竭的严重饥饿，亦常夸张使用 (refugees / appetite / beast) · pine away: 因长期的悲伤、渴望或营养不足而日渐憔悴消瘦 (patient / lover / captive) · crave: 对特定食物或满足感产生强烈渴求 (nourishment / sugar / fix)

groups.name: Skydive & Freefall · 跳伞与自由坠落 (Skydive, Freefall, Base-jump)
groups.tip: 从高空跃下或俯冲坠落

items.def_en: To plummet rapidly through the air without mechanical support before opening a parachute
items.ex_en: The skydivers will freefall for nearly sixty seconds before deploying their primary parachutes.
items.ex_zh: 跳伞员在打开主降落伞前将自由落体坠落近六十秒。

items.def_zh: 定点跳伞（从悬崖或高楼跳伞）
items.def_en: To parachute from a fixed high structure, cliff, or bridge as an extreme sport
items.ex_en: Thrill seekers gathered at dawn to base-jump from the towering fjord cliff.
items.ex_zh: 寻求刺激的人们黎明时分聚集在峡湾的万丈悬崖边进行定点跳伞。

items.def_en: (+ down/into) To drop or fall steeply, suddenly, and rapidly from a great height
items.ex_en: The damaged drone began to plunge toward the rocky shoreline at terrifying speed.
items.ex_zh: 受损的无人机以惊人的速度径直朝岩石海岸一头栽下。
items.ex2_en: The assassin plunged a sharp dagger straight into the dark wooden door.
items.ex2_zh: 刺客将一把锋利的匕首直接刺进了深色的木门中。

items.def_en: 1. To jump from an aircraft and perform acrobatic freefalls before opening a parachute.
items.ex_en: He conquered his acrophobia by deciding to skydive with an experienced instructor.
items.ex_zh: 他决定和一名经验丰富的教练一起跳伞，以此克服恐高症。

groups.summary_en: Encompasses intentional jumping from extreme heights (aircraft or high structures) involving prolonged freefall before deploying a parachute canopy.
groups.summary_zh: 指极限空中运动中从高空跳落、经历自由落体并最终开伞的行为。
groups.desc_en: Denotes intentional or high-velocity unpowered descent through the air before parachute deployment, contrasting with accidental falling by framing descent as an extreme aerial sport, controlled trajectory, or precipitous vertical drop.
groups.desc_zh: 特指降落伞打开前在空中进行的高速、主动或无动力下坠过程，与普通的“意外跌落”不同，它被构想为一种极限运动、受控航迹或急剧垂直坠落。
groups.nuance_en: skydive: perform high-altitude aircraft jump as an intentional sport (enthusiast / team / tandem) · freefall: descend rapidly under gravity without aerodynamic retardation (paratrooper / capsule / diver) · base-jump: leap illicitly or daringly from fixed cliffs or structures (cliff / bridge / skyscraper) · plunge: drop or dive steeply and precipitously downward (plane / diver / temperature)
groups.nuance_zh: skydive: 作为极限运动从高空飞机上主动跳伞 (enthusiast / team / tandem) · freefall: 在未受阻力减速的情况下受重力高速自由坠落 (paratrooper / capsule / diver) · base-jump: 从悬崖或固定建筑物上进行极限低空跳伞 (cliff / bridge / skyscraper) · plunge: 陡峭险峻地疾速坠落或俯冲 (plane / diver / temperature)

groups.name: Straddle & Bestride · 跨立与骑跨 (Bestride, Straddle, Span)
groups.tip: 双腿跨在两侧的骑坐或跨越姿态

items.def_en: To extend across from one side or edge of an area, river, or obstacle to the other
items.ex_en: A graceful stone suspension bridge will span the broad, fast-flowing mountain river.
items.ex_zh: 一座优雅的石拱吊桥将横跨这条宽阔湍急的山间河流。

items.def_en: To get up onto the back of a horse, bicycle, or motorcycle in order to ride it
items.ex_en: She checked the leather girth before preparing to mount her spirited young horse.
items.ex_zh: 在准备跨上她那匹充满活力的小马之前，她检查了皮革肚带。

items.def_en: To sit or stand with one leg on either side of something, or to extend across both sides of a divide
items.ex_en: The sprawling new international airport was designed to straddle two neighboring municipal jurisdictions.
items.ex_zh: 这座新建的庞大国际机场在设计上横跨两个相邻的辖区。

items.def_zh: 骑跨，跨坐；横跨；称霸，主宰
items.def_en: 1. (literary) To sit or stand with one leg on each side of something; to extend across. 2. To dominate or loom large over an era, field, or institution.
