items.ex_en: Colossal bronze statues of ancient conquerors still bestride the entrance to the harbor.
items.ex_zh: 古代征服者的巨大青铜雕像依然跨立在港口的入口处。

groups.summary_en: Involves positioning oneself or extending across an object with legs or boundaries spread to either side. 'Straddle' denotes everyday physical sitting/spanning, whereas 'bestride' possesses grand or literary overtones.
groups.summary_zh: 指双腿分开跨坐、跨立于某物两侧，或引申为横跨两界。
groups.desc_en: Denotes positioning the body or an object with legs, extensions, or borders spanning across two distinct sides of something, differing from merely sitting or bridging by stressing lateral encompassment or multi-domain presence.
groups.desc_zh: 指身体或物体以双腿、延伸物或边界横跨在某物两侧的姿势或状态，与单纯的“坐着”或“连接”不同，强调双侧包容、骑跨以及同时居于两个领域的空间或隐喻特征。
groups.nuance_en: straddle: place legs or boundaries on both sides, or remain noncommittal across categories (fence / border / horse) · bestride: dominate or stand over something with legs apart in an imposing posture (colossus / continent / steed) · span: physically or temporally stretch across an entire gap or extent (river / centuries / divide) · mount: ascend and seat oneself atop an animal or vehicle (horse / motorcycle / platform)
groups.nuance_zh: straddle: 跨坐于某物两侧，或在不同立场/边界间观望游移 (fence / border / horse) · bestride: 叉腿骑跨或以居高临下之势雄踞、支配某处 (colossus / continent / steed) · span: 空间或时间上完全横跨跨越整个鸿沟或区间 (river / centuries / divide) · mount: 登上并骑乘于牲畜或载具之上 (horse / motorcycle / platform)

groups.name: Sublet & Farm Out Tenancies · 转租与分租 (Sublet, Underlet, Subcontract)
groups.tip: 支付租金获取使用权或转租

items.def_en: To lease premises that one holds as a tenant to someone else, or lease below standard market rate
items.ex_en: The tenant covenants not to underlet the commercial premises without prior written consent.
items.ex_zh: 承租人立约承诺，未经事先书面同意，不得转租该商业用房。

items.def_en: To lease a property that is already leased by the lessor under a primary lease
items.ex_en: The corporation intends to sublease three empty floors of its downtown headquarters.
items.ex_zh: 该集团打算转租其市中心总部空置的三层办公楼。

items.def_zh: 外包；将部分场地或业务转让给他人经营
items.def_en: To assign work, obligations, or commercial tenancy space to an outside party
items.ex_en: The retail firm decided to farm out several customer service operations to contractors.
items.ex_zh: 这家零售公司决定将数项客服业务外包给承包商运营。

items.def_en: (+ to) To rent out a house, apartment, or office that you yourself are renting from a landlord.
items.ex_en: She obtained permission from her landlord to sublet the apartment for the summer.
items.ex_zh: 她获得了房东的许可，在夏季将这套公寓分租出去。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame specify the secondary leasing of leased premises or obligations, where a tenant lets property out to a third party or delegates rented space.
groups.summary_zh: 将自身已租入的房屋、场地或合同责任二次出租给他人的行为。
groups.desc_en: Denotes a tenant leasing part or all of a rented property or task to a secondary party, distinct from primary leasing or direct hiring by involving a nested, intermediary contractual relationship.
groups.desc_zh: 指租户将已租凭的房产或承包任务的部分或全部转让给第三方承租，与“直接出租”或“初次雇佣”不同，具有嵌套的中介性从属契约特征。
groups.nuance_en: sublet: lease out rented property to a secondary tenant (apartment / room / lease) · sublease: execute a formal, legally structured secondary lease (office / property / tenant) · underlet: rent property out at a subordinate tier, often in violation of head lease terms (premises / tenancy / dwelling) · farm out: outsource labor or secondary contractual responsibilities to external parties (tasks / work / processing)
groups.nuance_zh: sublet: 租户将自己承租的房屋分租或转租给次承租人 (apartment / room / lease) · sublease: 在法律或正规商务层面订立转租契约 (office / property / tenant) · underlet: 低位转租，常指未经原业主许可或受限于主租约的转租 (premises / tenancy / dwelling) · farm out: 将次级工作、生产或业务外包分派出去 (tasks / work / processing)

groups.name: Teethe & Erupt Teeth · 长牙与出齿 (Teethe, Cut, Erupt, Come through)
groups.tip: 长出乳牙机体生长发育

items.def_en: (of a baby or young child) to have a tooth emerge through the surface of the gum
items.ex_en: The irritable infant drooled constantly as he started to cut his front incisors.
items.ex_zh: 这个烦躁不安的婴儿口水流个不停，因为他开始长门牙了。

items.def_en: To emerge gradually through the gums as a visible tooth
items.ex_en: A sharp little white tooth is finally beginning to come through the gum.
items.ex_zh: 一颗尖尖的小小白牙终于开始从牙龈里冒出来了。

items.def_en: (dental) to break through the gingival tissue and become visible in the mouth
items.ex_en: The lower wisdom teeth usually erupt between the ages of seventeen and twenty-five.
items.ex_zh: 下颌智齿通常在十七岁至二十五岁之间萌出。

items.def_en: 1. (of a baby or child) To have their first teeth begin to grow and emerge through the gums.
items.ex_en: The fussy baby cried all night because he was beginning to teethe painful molars.
items.ex_zh: 这个哭闹的婴儿整夜啼哭，因为他开始长出令人疼痛的磨牙。

groups.summary_en: Verbs detailing the developmental emergence of infant or adult teeth through the gum tissue, highlighting physiological pain and physical breakthrough.
groups.summary_zh: 特指婴儿出牙及牙齿萌出牙龈的生理发展与突破过程。
groups.desc_en: Focuses on the biological emergence of teeth piercing through the gingival tissue, differing from generic anatomical growth by highlighting the physical breakthrough, eruptive process, and developmental pain.
groups.desc_zh: 特指出齿期牙齿穿破牙龈组织的生理萌出过程，与通用的“解剖生长”不同，强调物理性破龈而出、萌出阶段以及伴随的生理烦躁与疼痛。
groups.nuance_en: teethe: undergo the systemic developmental stage of tooth emergence with associated fussiness (infant / baby / toddler) · erupt: clinically emerge through the gum line (molar / incisor / wisdom tooth) · cut: pierce the gingival tissue, visible as a new tooth edge (tooth / incisor / molar) · come through: successfully break into visible emergence through the gum (first tooth / crown / tooth)
groups.nuance_zh: teethe: 经历萌牙发育期，通常伴随牙龈不适与哭闹 (infant / baby / toddler) · erupt: 牙齿自牙龈组织中临床式萌出 (molar / incisor / wisdom tooth) · cut: 牙齿割破牙龈组织露出新尖 (tooth / incisor / molar) · come through: 牙齿彻底穿透牙龈显现出来 (first tooth / crown / tooth)

groups.name: Ventilate & Air Out · 通风与透气 (Ventilate, Air, Aerate)
groups.tip: 开窗引风促空气流通

items.def_en: To allow fresh air into a room or onto clothes to remove dampness or stale smells
items.ex_en: Open all the upstairs windows to air the dusty bedroom thoroughly this afternoon.
items.ex_zh: 今天下午把楼上的窗户都打开，让积满灰尘的卧室彻底通风透气。
items.ex2_en: Heavy woolen blankets air nicely outside when hung on sunny clotheslines.
items.ex2_zh: 厚重的羊毛毯挂在阳光明媚的晾衣绳上能在户外很好地通风透气。

items.def_en: To leave a room, vehicle, or garment exposed to circulating fresh air so that odors or dampness disappear
items.ex_en: Open all the windows for a few hours to air out the freshly painted living room.
items.ex_zh: 把所有窗户打开几个小时，给刚粉刷完的客厅通通风散味。
items.ex2_en: The musty guest bedroom will air out quickly with the windows wide open.
items.ex2_zh: 窗户大开后，这间有发霉气味的客房很快就会通风散味。

items.def_zh: 使通风，使空气流通；公开发表（意见、感受）
items.def_en: 1. To let fresh air enter and circulate freely through a room or building. 2. (formal) To discuss or express opinions or complaints publicly.
items.ex_en: Modern underground facilities require specialized engineering systems to ventilate the interior tunnels properly.
items.ex_zh: 现代地下设施需要专门的工程系统来使内部隧道保持良好通风。

items.def_en: To supply or charge a liquid, soil, or substance with air or gas
items.ex_en: Gardeners must regularly aerate compacted garden soil to promote healthy, vigorous root development.
items.ex_zh: 园丁必须定期为板结的花园土壤松土透气，以促进根系茁壮健康生长。

groups.summary_en: This frame focuses on introducing fresh air into enclosed physical spaces or materials, clearing out stale air, fumes, moisture, or unwanted odors.
groups.summary_zh: 指引入新鲜空气使密闭空间、物品保持通风流通、排除浊气。
groups.desc_en: Refers to circulating fresh air through an enclosed space or substance to expel impurities or infuse oxygen, contrasting with passive drying or chilling by emphasizing air circulation and gas exchange.
groups.desc_zh: 指通过使新鲜空气在封闭空间或物质中循环以排除异味杂质或充入氧气，与单纯的“晾干”或“冷却”不同，强调空气流动循环与气体置换。
groups.nuance_en: ventilate: provide continuous air movement through architectural or mechanical systems (room / lungs / mine) · air: expose enclosed rooms or fabric to open atmosphere to dissipate stale odors (room / bedding / grievances) · air out: thoroughly freshen an interior or stored object by extensive airflow (house / wardrobe / jacket) · aerate: mechanically infuse or circulate air/oxygen within a liquid, soil, or porous mass (lawn / wine / blood)
groups.nuance_zh: ventilate: 通过建筑结构或机械系统保持空气流动与置换 (room / lungs / mine) · air: 将房间或织物敞开接触空气以散除潮气霉味 (room / bedding / grievances) · air out: 彻底开窗通风以净化密闭空间或积存衣物 (house / wardrobe / jacket) · aerate: 向液体、土壤或多孔介质中机械性充气或注氧 (lawn / wine / blood)

groups.name: Wire & Telegraph · 电信与电报通讯 (Cable, Wire, Telegraph, Telex)
groups.tip: 通过电报或线路传递紧急信息

items.def_en: To send a message or transfer money electronically via telecommunication systems
items.ex_en: Please wire the requested funds to our overseas branch account by tomorrow morning.
items.ex_zh: 请在明早之前将所需资金电汇至我们海外分行的账户。

items.def_en: To send a telegram or message to someone by international undersea cable or wire.
items.ex_en: The ambassador rushed to cable vital diplomatic updates directly to the foreign ministry.
items.ex_zh: 大使急忙向外交部直接发电报汇报重要的外交最新进展。

items.def_en: To send a text transmission using a teleprinter exchange network
items.ex_en: The maritime shipping broker had to telex urgent shipping manifests across the globe.
items.ex_zh: 海运经纪人不得不通过电传将紧急舱单发送至全球各地。

items.def_en: To transmit an electrical written message over wire or radio circuits
items.ex_en: His awkward body language began to telegraph his nervous intentions to the opponent.
items.ex_zh: 他笨拙的肢体语言开始向对手泄露出他紧张的意图。

groups.summary_en: Verbs representing early long-distance telecommunications, transmitting encoded text or financial credits via underwater cables or electrical telegraph wires.
groups.summary_zh: 指通过海底电缆、有线电报或专用线路发送电讯信息与汇款的操作。
groups.desc_en: Involves transmitting urgent text or coded communications across physical distances via historical electrical telecommunication infrastructure, contrasting with modern digital messaging by implying Morse-era apparatus and per-word urgency.
groups.desc_zh: 指利用近现代电气电信基础设施远距离发送紧急文本或编码电文，与现代数字通信相比，带有摩尔斯电码时代的特定媒介特征及惜字如金的紧迫感。
groups.nuance_en: wire: send an urgent message or funds via telegraphic electrical networks (money / instructions / news) · telegraph: transmit a written dispatch via Morse apparatus or signal intentions ahead (message / dispatch / intentions) · cable: transmit a message across transoceanic undersea cables (headquarters / ambassador / report) · telex: exchange text messages over an automated network of teleprinters (office / contract / confirmation)
groups.nuance_zh: wire: 通过电报线路紧急发送电讯或汇寄资金 (money / instructions / news) · telegraph: 用电报机发送明电，亦引申为提前表露或透露意图 (message / dispatch / intentions) · cable: 通过海底电缆系统跨洋发送长途电报 (headquarters / ambassador / report) · telex: 通过专用电传打字机网络传送商业文本 (office / contract / confirmation)

groups.name: Yawn & Gape · 哈欠与张口 (Yawn, Gape, Gasp)
groups.tip: 困倦乏力时张大嘴巴深吸气

items.def_en: To breathe quickly and loudly with an open mouth, especially after strenuous physical exertion
items.ex_en: The exhausted retriever collapsed onto the cool grass and began to pant heavily.
items.ex_zh: 那只筋疲力尽的寻回犬瘫倒在凉爽的草地上，大口大口地喘着粗气。

items.def_en: 1. To open your mouth wide and breathe in deeply because you are tired or bored. 2. (of a hole or chasm) To open wide or gape.
items.ex_en: I could not help but yawn repeatedly during the long and boring lecture.
items.ex_zh: 在漫长而乏味的讲座中，我忍不住连连打哈欠。

items.def_zh: 目瞪口呆地张开嘴；敞开
items.def_en: To stare with an open mouth in surprise or wonder, or to be wide open
items.ex_en: Astonished tourists could only gape at the magnificent ceiling of the ancient cathedral.
items.ex_zh: 目瞪口呆的游客们只能张大嘴巴凝视着古老大教堂宏伟的天花板。

items.def_en: To inhale suddenly and sharply with an open mouth, typically due to shock, pain, or breathlessness
items.ex_en: She could only gasp in sheer disbelief when the dramatic verdict was announced.
items.ex_zh: 当戏剧性的判决宣布时，她难以置信地倒抽了一口凉气。

groups.summary_en: Verbs in this frame describe involuntary or wide openings of the mouth, whether due to fatigue, shock, or hunger for air, extending metaphorically to wide chasms or apertures.
groups.summary_zh: 表示因困倦、震惊或缺氧而张大嘴，亦引申指深裂口洞开。
groups.desc_en: Denotes involuntary or sudden wide opening of the mouth caused by respiratory reflex, astonishment, or oxygen craving, distinct from vocalized shouting by focusing on aperture and respiratory mechanics.
groups.desc_zh: 指由呼吸反射、极度震惊或缺氧导致的突然大张嘴唇与呼吸动作，与言语呼喊不同，聚焦于口部张开的物理形态与呼吸机制。
groups.nuance_en: yawn: open the mouth wide involuntarily due to drowsiness, fatigue, or boredom (bored student / worker / dog) · gape: stare dumbfounded with mouth hanging wide open in shock or bewilderment (crowd / tourist / onlooker) · gasp: inhale sharply with an open mouth triggered by shock, pain, or breathlessness (audience / patient / swimmer) · pant: breathe in rapid, shallow open-mouthed gasps from heavy exertion or heat (runner / dog / athlete)
groups.nuance_zh: yawn: 因困倦、疲乏或无聊而不自主地深吸气并打哈欠 (bored student / worker / dog) · gape: 惊讶、困惑或发呆时目瞪口呆地张嘴凝视 (crowd / tourist / onlooker) · gasp: 因惊骇、剧痛或窒息而倒抽一口凉气 (audience / patient / swimmer) · pant: 因剧烈运动或酷热而张口短促急促地喘息 (runner / dog / athlete)
